dag: Ŋunkam ku nira mini ŋunkam shihi kpima, benya sambani ŋɔ ni daba ayopɔin. Yi mini yi ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb na maa zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-niŋ kasi daba ata dali mini daba ayopɔin dali.
en: Then Moses said to the soldiers, If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.

dag: Ka Zikiri ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa ku nabia Maasɛya mini Azirikam ŋun daa nyɛ nayili sapashin kpɛm la ni Ɛlikana ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpɛma m-pa naa zuɣu la.
en: An Israelite soldier named Zichri killed King Ahaz' son Maaseiah, the palace administrator Azrikam, and Elkanah, who was second in command to the king.

dag: Bɛ ni be yi sani yi sunsuuni tin shɛli bɛ ni pii yi tinsi maa ni ka di nyɛ din viɛl bɛ sani. Miriya ka yi ti muɣisi ba.
en: They may live in any of your towns that they choose, and you are not to treat them harshly.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti zahim li, ŋun daa pihi pam dini shɛli daa bi guui, ka ŋun mi daa pihi biɛla dini shɛli daa bi poog o. Sokam daa kul pihila o dibu tariga.
en: But when they measured what they had gathered, there was no shortage and there was none left over. Everyone gathered just what they needed.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pina yɛla polo, m bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni.
en: Now, brothers and sisters, I want you to understand about spiritual gifts.

dag: A ni ti nya suhupiɛlli ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, ka niriba pam gba suhuri ti paligi bia maa dɔɣibu zuɣu;.
en: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many people will rejoice at his birth.

dag: Bɛn daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba pahi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The priests who were heads of families totaled . They were experts in all the work carried on in the Temple.

dag: Bɛ ni lan me du shɛŋa din daa lu la zali. Binshɛɣukam din daa saɣim ka di yuui la zaa, bɛ ni lan mal li zali di zaashee.
en: Then the old cities that were destroyed will be rebuilt. Those ancient ruins will be made new, as they were in the beginning.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayi, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ayi yɛli, Kamina.
en: The Lamb opened the second seal. Then I heard the second living being say, Come.

dag: Mɔabnim daa zaŋla piɛbila n-yi Sɛla din be tiŋgban nɛli polo la kana ti ti ŋun diri nam ʒi Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya pam ka diri ti shɛhira biɛɣu a sani; ti tumdi tuumbiɛri, ka mi ti daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Thats because we committed crimes against our God. Our own sins speak out against us. We know we are guilty. We know we have sinned.

dag: Zom ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka tummila din viɛla; bom suhudoo n-gbibi li.
en: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.

dag: Ka ti mi ni Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni la ni ti neei ti gba kum ni pahi Yisa zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti mini ya tahi ŋun Naawuni sani.
en: God raised the Lord Jesus from death, and we know that he will also raise us with Jesus. God will bring us together with you, and we will stand before him.

dag: N daa wum a yɛla la n tibili ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n nini nya a;.
en: In the past I knew only what others had told me, but now I have seen you with my own eyes.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa kul ni beni sahakam, amaa ʒiri yɛtɔɣa bi yuura.
en: Lies last only a moment, but the truth lasts forever.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ka lala tɛhi zilima.
en: A good person knows the rights of the poor, but wicked people cannot understand such things.

dag: Ŋmam nudirigu polo, ka ŋma nuzaa polo! Bɛ ni kul zaŋ a noli kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: Sword, be sharp! Cut on the right side. Cut straight ahead. Cut on the left side. Go wherever your edge was chosen to go.

dag: Di saha maa machɛli daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, dama Filistianim maa daa yɛlimi ni di yi pa lala Izraɛlnim ni ti kuri takɔbiri bee kpana zali.
en: There were no blacksmiths in Israel because the Philistines were determined to keep the Hebrews from making swords and spears. .

dag: Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Aran.
en: Dishan was the ancestor of the clans of Uz and Aran.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili. A wuntitali zuɣu, yihim ma n wahala ŋɔ ni.
en: Rescue me, Lord , as you have promised; in your goodness save me from my troubles!.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, wain booriba kpɛm la daa tam Yisifu yɛla ka bi teeg o yɛla.
en: But the chief wine steward didnt remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Zaŋm Lɛvinim zali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa zaani, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi zali Izraɛlnim niɣi zaani, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: I, the Lord , give this command: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn men from the other families of Israel. And I will take the animals of the Levites instead of the animals of the other people. The Levites are mine.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: Surely you have read this in the Scriptures: The stone that the builders refused to accept became the cornerstone.

dag: So dini n-lee kuni neesim ni woligiwoligi luɣ shɛli bee wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ni yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli polo?.
en: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?.

dag: Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ni ti neei kum ni. Yinim bɛn zaa kpi m-be gbala ni, yiɣisimiya yili suhupiɛlli yila. Maligim ni luri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm la, lala ka tiŋgbani yɛn chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la neei.
en: Those of our people who have died will live again! Their bodies will come back to life. All those sleeping in their graves will wake up and sing for joy. As the sparkling dew refreshes the earth, so the Lord will revive those who have long been dead.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, o je m Ba gba.
en: Whoever hates me hates my Father also.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka anab maa dola sol ni, ka buŋ la mini gbuɣinli maa ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka gbuɣinli maa bi ŋub o bee n-ku buŋ maa.
en: he left. He found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and lion standing there. The lion had not eaten the body or attacked the donkey.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tim ti boli Reechɛl mini Liya ni bɛ ka o sanna o ni daa mal o biŋkɔbiri be mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli la.
en: Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah to meet him in the pasture where he kept his sheep.

dag: dama dina n-viɛla, ka nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nini.
en: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.

dag: Di saha maa ha Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni binyara zaŋ kɔhi tab zuɣu bee n-zaŋ taɣi tab yɛla ŋmaabu kali daa yi nyɛla ŋun kɔhiri pirig o namdili ti ŋun dara, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa yi niŋdi ŋmaari yɛla.
en: Now in those days, to settle a sale or an exchange of property, it was the custom for the seller to take off his sandal and give it to the buyer. In this way the Israelites showed that the matter was settled.

dag: Bɛna n-daa lan su daantal shɛŋa din daa gili di dundɔŋ la zaa mini di binzahi ni di kpahi din kpara ni di mihi fukumsi.
en: They also cared for all the posts in the courtyard around the Holy Tent. This included all the bases, tent pegs, and ropes.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni tutuɣu, ka faako yi ti kana, bɛ ku nya li. Bɛ ni ti bela tiŋgban nɛli tiŋ kuŋ ni. Tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yalim tiŋgbani, ka so ka di ni.
en: He is like a bush in the desert, which grows in the dry wasteland, on salty ground where nothing else grows. Nothing good ever happens to him.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Di simdi ni ti yili wumpaɣibo yilli paɣi ti Naawuni; dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim, ka di simdi ni ti yili yilli paɣ o.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.

dag: Bɛ daa pun baŋ Naawuni yɛligu nyaɣisim mini dunia shɛli din ti yɛn kana la yiko yɛla.
en: they knew from experience that God's word is good, and they had felt the powers of the coming age.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa chaŋ yaɣimɛra maa yiŋa ka o ti bela yaɣiri mɛbu ni.
en: So I went down to the potters house and saw him working with clay at the wheel.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ni daa ʒin o nam ʒiishee, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani ka chɛ ka o mali yiko pam.
en: Solomon, Davids son, was securely established over his kingdom because the LORD his God was with him and made him very great.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la.
en: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka yi yi mali karimbanim paai tuhi pia Masia dolibu ni, amaa ba yino ka yi lee mali; dama n leei yi ba Yisa Masia dolibu ni la n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu zuɣu.
en: For even if you have ten thousand guardians in your Christian life, you have only one father. For in your life in union with Christ Jesus I have become your father by bringing the Good News to you.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Yawɛ Jɔshua ni daa be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la zaa zaŋ tabili zuɣulaannim shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka daa mi Yawɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: As long as Joshua lived, Israel worshiped and obeyed the Lord . There were other leaders old enough to remember everything that the Lord had done for Israel. And for as long as these men lived, Israel continued to worship and obey the Lord .

dag: Ka sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ tahilaa chim shɛli, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni, ka dabindi ka di ni.
en: If the offering is bread cooked on a griddle, it is to be made of flour mixed with olive oil but without yeast.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi ni ŋun mal liɣiri kolibila, ŋun kpuɣim li; lala n-nyɛ ŋun mal adiiku gba. Ka ŋun mi ka takɔbi, ŋun zaŋm o binyɛrigu kɔhi da li.
en: Then he said to them, But now, whoever has a wallet must take it, and likewise a bag. And those who dont own a sword must sell their clothes and buy one.

dag: Binnani maa zuɣu daa nyɛla salima din nyɛ alali; ka o nyɔɣu min o bɔɣiri nyɛ anzinfa; ka o puli min o gbalipina nyɛ daanya;.
en: Its head was made of the finest gold; its chest and arms were made of silver; its waist and hips of bronze.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, Yɛlimiy o: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la polo.
en: But also say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to question the LORD: This is what the LORD, Israels God, says about the message youve just heard.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka shiri na kpalim be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: After Jesus said this, he stayed in Galilee.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sintani daa kpe Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la suhu ni;.
en: Then Satan entered the heart of Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve apostles.

dag: N kul malila shili n-guhiri sahakam ni n deei n niriba bɛn niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi din bi tuhi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli maa.
en: I extended my hands all day to a rebellious people walking in a way that isnt good, following their own plans.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya ni bɛ daa na bi dɔɣi ma, ka o pii ma leeg o dabili ni n zaŋ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima, ka yam yɔɣu la labis o sanna. Yawɛ ti ma jilima. N kpiɔŋ yirila n Naawuni sanna.
en: Before I was born, the Lord appointed me; he made me his servant to bring back his people, to bring back the scattered people of Israel. The Lord gives me honor; he is the source of my strength.

dag: N ni zaŋ ko viɛlli mihi ya ka yi yi yi daɣiri zaa ni mini yi buɣ jɛmbo zaa ni.
en: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka lan zaŋ tana ayɔbu la she n-tuɣi taba di ko.
en: They sewed five of them together in one set and the other six in another set.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tia kam wulli zooi ka viɛla. Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa tiligi ni ti nya ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiwala viɛla, ka nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ Naa ŋun ka bahigu. O suhu yi yiɣisi, tiŋgbani sɔhigirimi, ka zuliya shɛli ku tooi zan o suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: You, Lord , are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.

dag: Dama Farisiinim mini Yɛhudianim zaa daa bi saɣiri diri bindirigu ka pa ni bɛ dol bɛ yaannim kali ni nyɛ shɛm paɣi bɛ nuhi pɔi.
en: The Pharisees and all the other Jews never eat before washing their hands in this special way. They do this to follow the traditions they have from their great leaders who lived long ago.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma gili di zaa, di daa galisiya pam be vinvamli maa ni, di daa nyɛla din kuui zaa.
en: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.

dag: ka Avitinim me Nibihaz mini Taritak buɣili zali, ka Sɛfarivaimnim mi daa mali bɛ bihi nyɔri buɣim tiri Adirammɛlɛk mini Anammɛlɛk bɛn daa nyɛ Sɛravimnim buɣa la.
en: the people of Ivvah, idols of Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people of Sepharvaim sacrificed their children as burnt offerings to their gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.

dag: ka wɔr piɛla vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ata, ka wɔr fufuhisi vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah anahi mi.
en: White horses were pulling the third chariot, and horses with red spots were pulling the fourth chariot.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa.
en: Do not disgrace your father by having intercourse with any of his other wives.

dag: O pun mal o bidibbina din mali lɔɣu la shili, n-zaŋ o piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la pa.
en: he takes up his deadly weapons and aims his burning arrows.

dag: Ka so yi shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi, di yi nyɛla ninsal daɣiri bee biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi bee binshɛli dinkam bi be kasi ka ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: Also, if you eat the meat of this offering after you have touched anything ritually unclean, whether from a person or an animal, you shall no longer be considered one of God's people.

dag: Ka Hur bia Rɛfaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Rephaiah son of Hur repaired the next section of the wall. Rephaiah was the governor of half of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Sool, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Jonathan answered Saul, David begged my permission to go to Bethlehem.

dag: N ni fa a ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi, ka tilig a ninvuɣ galima gbaabu ni.
en: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: ka lan ka bikpamba bɛn yuya sabi alizanda ni la laɣiŋgu ni na. Yi lan kala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ sokam zaa sariakarita mini wuntizɔriba bɛn mali m-be tibi la shihi sanna.
en: You have come to the meeting of Gods firstborn children. Their names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the judge of all people. And you have come to the spirits of good people who have been made perfect.

dag: Yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna, o ni ŋmaligi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu m-bahi ya yoli zaa; o ni pun niŋ ya din viɛl la nyaaŋa.
en: If you leave the LORD and serve foreign gods, then he will turn around and do you harm and finish you off, in spite of having done you good in the past.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuri niriba maa, ka di daa ti kpalim n ko, ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nina kpa tiŋ kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ! A yɛn kula Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I stayed there while the men went to kill the people. I bowed with my face to the ground and said, Oh, Lord GOD, in showing your anger against Jerusalem, are you killing all the survivors in Israel.

dag: Di daa yi chana, di chanila luɣa anahi maa zaa ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: They could turn to move in any direction. But the living beings did not turn when they moved.

dag: A mi ni lan zo ti nambɔɣu, a ni zaŋ ti daalahichi sɔŋ a naba ni no li. A ni zaŋ ti daalahichi zaa bahi teeku bulli ni.
en: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.

dag: Ka a ba yi ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, nyin yɛlim o, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ o ya Bɛtilihɛm, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛn malila yuuniyuuni sara.
en: If your father takes note of my absence, tell him, David begged my permission to run down to his hometown Bethlehem, because there is an annual sacrifice there for his whole family.

dag: Ka Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim daa kuhi pam, ka Jahaznim wum bɛ kuhigu maa, hal ka bɛ tɔbbihi ni sɔhira.
en: In Heshbon and Elealeh they are crying loudly. You can hear their voices as far away as Jahaz. Even the soldiers are frightened. They are shaking with fear.

dag: Wuntizɔra ba ni mali suhupiɛlli pam; ŋunkam dɔɣi bi so ŋun mali yɛm ni mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.

dag: N zaŋ jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma la ti ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm la.
en: Ive given them the glory that you gave me so that they can be one just as we are one.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa darigi toog o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu so o shee ni n-kum o bia maa kuli dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Jacob tore his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. He mourned for his son a long time.

dag: Doo yi dɔni o do kpee kaman paɣ la, bɛ niriba ayi maa tum din chihira, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual intercourse with a man as he would with a woman, the two of them have done something detestable. They must be executed; their blood is on their own heads.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu labisi. Guhimi Yawɛ, o ni sɔŋ a.
en: Don't take it on yourself to repay a wrong. Trust the Lord and he will make it right.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee maa bahi buɣim teeku ni. Buɣim teeku maa ni kpɛbu n-nyɛ kum din pahi buyi la.
en: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

dag: Ka Tiyaawumya daa yi Filistianim maa sanna, o yuli n-daa booni Goliat ka o yi tiŋ shɛli din yuli booni Gaat na. O wɔɣilim daa nyɛla kaman mita ata laasabu.
en: A champion named Goliath from Gath came out from the Philistine camp. He was more than nine feet tall.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ kpa shɛli din be o nuu ni maa shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun niŋ alahichi sanyoo sara binʒim ʒe la.
en: He shall put some of the oil on the same places he put the blood: on the lobe of your right ear, on the thumb of your right hand, and on the big toe of your right foot.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa kali Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm kalinli n-daa bala.
en: These are the enrolled of the Kohathite clans, all who worked in the meeting tent and whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the LORDs command through Moses.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi di binʒim kam yi ni be luɣ shɛli zaa, noonsi ʒim bee biŋkɔbiri ʒim.
en: You must not consume any blood whatsoever—whether bird or animal blood—wherever you may live.

dag: Aduna ŋɔ mini Musa ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Yihimiya Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbilligbilli la.
en: The Lord had commanded Aaron and Moses to lead every family and tribe of Israel out of Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyini ka ti niŋ naani, zom ti nambɔɣu. Guli ti dabisili kam. Tiligim ti ti muɣisigu nyabu saha.
en: LORD, show us favor; we hope in you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation in times of distress.

dag: Dama Naawuni yuri dunianim hal ti zaŋ o Bi gaŋa ti ba ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ti ku bahi yoli, amaa o ni ti nyala nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: God so loved the world that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him wont perish but will have eternal life.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔhimi zuliya kam, ŋuni n-lee na mi n-wum yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo? Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ tum zaɣ biɛ titali.
en: So I, the Lord , command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu gbaag o zuli, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu gbaag o zuli maa, ka di lan leei jaaŋgbee o nuu ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Reach down and pick it up by the tail. So Moses reached down and caught it, and it became a walking stick again.

dag: N wuntia biɛhigu laara ka Yawɛ daa ti ma maa; n ni ka galimi la samli ka o yo ma maa.
en: The LORD rewarded me for my righteousness; he restored me because my hands are clean.

dag: Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin zalimi zaligu n-chɛ ka bɛ ku ba. A yi ni niŋ lala, n lo alikauli ni n ni tooi zaŋ anzinfa din sania zuɣu tibisim paai kilɔgiram tuhi kɔbisita ni pihinahi n-niŋ a liɣiri kpanjɔɣu ni.
en: Why not give orders for all of them to be killed? I can promise that you will get tons of silver for your treasury.

dag: Nyama, a pun wum Asiria naa ni pun niŋ tiŋgbɔna pam shɛm n-saɣim li zaa la yɛla. Ka a tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You have heard what the kings of Assyria did to all the other countries. We completely destroyed them! Will you be saved? No!.

dag: N daa bela Jɔpa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka n nya binshɛli din kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la ʒii puuni, ka di yi zuɣusaa sirigiri n sanna.
en: I was in the city of Joppa praying when I had a visionary experience. In my vision, I saw something like a large linen sheet being lowered from heaven by its four corners. It came all the way down to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ suhuyubu soli ka jɛmdi wun shɛŋa la ni ti bemi kaman jinjɛŋŋmaa din lan ka buchi ŋɔ ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: I will ruin them because they refuse to listen to my messages. They are stubborn and do only what they want to do. They follow and worship other gods. They will be like this linen loincloth. They will be ruined and not good for anything.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Ahaz yaha.
en: The Lord sent another message to Ahaz:.

dag: ka ŋun pahi ayɔbu daa nyɛ Ozɛm, ka Dauda daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ayopɔin.
en: Ozem his sixth, and David his seventh.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lu ka di zibiri saha shɛli, ka buɣim nyokpilli mini buɣim mokpalli daa kana ti kpe nimdi din ŋmahiŋmahi doya maa sunsuuni gari.
en: After the sun had set and darkness had deepened, a smoking vessel with a fiery flame passed between the split-open animals.

dag: Ka di ʒiɛmani maa niriba zaa gba daa ti kpi. Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din paya niriba daa yiɣisina. Bɛn daa bi mi Yawɛ bee m-mi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: That whole generation also died, and the next generation forgot the Lord and what he had done for Israel.

dag: O zaŋ saa nyaɣisibu gbib o nuu ni n-chɛ ka di nyaɣisir o ni zal li luɣ shɛli polo.
en: He seizes the lightning with his hands and commands it to hit the mark.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔb bia ka nyɛ Zɔba naa la, saha shɛli ŋun Hadadɛza ni daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi deei Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo la.
en: Next David defeated Zobahs King Hadadezer, Rehobs son, as Hadadezer was on his way to put his monument along the Euphrates River.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Aai, m bihi, n ni wum ka Yawɛ niriba maa yɛri yi yɛla shɛm luɣ shɛlikam maa bi viɛla.
en: Stop it, my sons! This is an awful thing the people of the Lord are talking about!.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina nti teei zani tiŋ maa dunol ni, ka Siria tɔbbihi bɛn daa yi Zɔba mini Rɛhɔb ni Tɔb ni Maaka na la mi laɣim ʒe mɔɣu ni mɔɣu ni.
en: The Ammonites came out and got ready for the battle. They stood at the city gate. The Arameans from Zobah and Rehob and the men from Tob and Maacah did not stand together with the Ammonites in the field.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tiligi Izraɛlnim Ijiptinim nuu ni dindali maa shɛm m-bala. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya Ijiptinim ni kpi n-do teeku duli shɛm.
en: On that day, when the Israelites saw the bodies of the Egyptians washed up on the shore, they knew that the Lord had saved them.

dag: Pashihur daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Maasɛya so mi yaha ni Ishimail ni Nɛtanɛl ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlasa.
en: Clan of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

dag: Di chɛ ka ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛlimaŋli yi a kɔbili ni. Zaŋmi li lo a nyiŋgol ni, ka sab li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Never let go of loyalty and faithfulness. Tie them around your neck; write them on your heart.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya suhupiɛlli ŋun nyɛ yi namda ŋɔ zuɣu. Ziɔnnima, maliya suhupiɛlli yi Naa zuɣu.
en: Be glad, Israel, because of your Creator; rejoice, people of Zion, because of your king!.

dag: Bɛ gbinni nyaɣa kuuya, ka bɛ zuɣusaa wula kpi.
en: Their roots below will dry up, and their branches above will die.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ wain tihi pum ti yɛn kpahi lu ka di wala moori saha shɛli, Itiɔpianim dimnim ni kana ti ku ba ka di bi to. Bɛ ni ti niŋ ba kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sua ŋ-ŋmahiri wain tiwula din teei shɛm la.
en: Before the grapes are gathered, when the blossoms have all fallen and the grapes are ripening, the enemy will destroy the Ethiopians as easily as a knife cuts branches from a vine.

dag: O ni ti taɣi ti niŋgbuna din poori ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di be kaman omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ din bi poori la. O yiko din chɛ ka o tooi su binshɛɣukam zaa la puuni ka o yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.

dag: Ka Pita daa yaag o noli yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni shiri bi gaŋdi niriba;.
en: Peter began to speak: I now realize that it is true that God treats everyone on the same basis.

dag: Suhuyiɣisilinim tahirila zabili na, amaa bɛn suhuri bi yiɣisiri yomyom goorila zabili.
en: Hotheads stir up conflict, but patient people calm down strife.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti bɔhi Izraɛl naa, M min a yɛla bi kpa. Cham a ba min a ma daanabinim la sani. Amaa ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, Aai, Yawɛ n-zaŋ ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: Why should I help you? Elisha said to the king of Israel. Go and consult those prophets that your father and mother consulted. No! Joram replied. It is the Lord who has put us three kings at the mercy of the king of Moab.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi ti ba pin shɛli noo ti gba ni daa niŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛda ka o ti ti la, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ma ka n ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni.
en: If God gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, then who am I? Could I stand in Gods way.

dag: Dama n loya ni n niŋla tiŋ ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu ka pa ni zaɣ viɛlli. N ni ti zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I have set my face against this city for harm and not for good, declares the LORD; it will be delivered to the king of Babylon, who will set it on fire.

dag: Yi yurinim zaa tam yi yɛla, bɛ baɣa lan ka yi ni; dama n ŋmɛn ya mi kaman n nyɛla yi dim la; n darigila yi tibili kaman dim so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu, dama yi taali galisiya pam, ka yi daalahichi mi galisi yaɣi.
en: You became friends with many nations, but those nations dont care about you. Your friends have forgotten you. I hurt you like an enemy. I punished you very hard. I did this because of your great guilt. I did this because of your many sins.

dag: O daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒiɛri zuɣusaa. O yiko puuni ka o daa chɛ ka nudirigu polo pɔhim ʒɛna;.
en: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast.

dag: Bɔ n-chɛ ka bɛ daa kpalim bɛ piɛri sani ni bɛ wumdi piɛguliba ni piɛbiri yuhi booni piɛri shɛm? Iin, Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: Reuben, why did you stay among your sheep pens? Was it to listen to shepherds whistling for their sheep? No one could figure out why Reuben wouldn't come.

dag: Ti yi bela Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko zuɣu, yin chɛliya ka ti doli Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu.
en: We get our new life from the Spirit, so we should follow the Spirit.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka ti mali yɛri ya maa. Dina n-nyɛ ni ti ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn mali nyɛviya hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha ti ku daŋ bɛn pun gbihiri kum ni la tooni.
en: What we are teaching you now is the Lord's teaching: we who are alive on the day the Lord comes will not go ahead of those who have died.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛm yiya mini Juda nanim yinsi ni bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri zuɣusaa binyara yiya shɛŋa mɔpila zuɣu zaa ni bɛ ni maani binnyura maligu tiri buɣa yiya shɛŋa mɔpila zuɣu zaa ni ti saɣim kaman Tɔfɛt ni saɣim shɛm maa.
en: The houses of Jerusalem, the houses of the kings of Judah, and indeed all the houses on whose roofs incense has been burned to the stars and where wine has been poured out as an offering to other gods—they will all be as unclean as Topheth.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ maligumaana maa suhupiɛlli, ka o kpuɣi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa mini binnan bihi ni dari binnani maa n-kpe m-be niriba maa sunsuuni ka bɛ chana.
en: This made the priest very happy, so he took the sacred objects and went along with them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn gbe, ka bɛ ni yino lɔrig o kpalaŋa ni o niŋ bindirigu ti o buŋa ka nya ka liɣiri be o kpalaŋ maa nol ni;.
en: That night the brothers stopped at a place to spend the night. One of the brothers opened his sack to get some grain for his donkey. And there in the sack, he saw his money!.

dag: Ka yi ni ti be Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ zuliya la ni yuui, di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: And you will live a long time in the rich and fertile land that the Lord promised to give your ancestors and their descendants.

dag: N ni suhi m Ba ka o tin ya Sɔŋda so na ka o ti be yi sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper, who will stay with you forever.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo.
en: The Israelites moved on and set up camp in the plains of Moab east of the Jordan and opposite Jericho.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa lan tim tuumba Ammɔn naa maa sani, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛl o.
en: Jephthah sent messengers back to the king of Ammon.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya; di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus reached out and touched him. I do want to, he answered. Be clean! At once the man was healed of his disease.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka paɣiba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ shiri bi nya o.
en: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.

dag: Lɛmuɛl, wumma, di bi simdi ni nanim nyuri wain bee ka nanim chɛ ka bɛ kɔre be dam din kpɛm nyubu ni.
en: It isnt for kings, Lemuel, it isnt for kings to drink wine, for rulers to crave strong drink.

dag: Naɣikɔra yi ka luɣ shɛli, bindirigu gba kani, naɣikɔra yaa puuni ka bindirigu pam yirina.
en: When there are no oxen, the stall is clean, but when there is a strong bull, there is abundant produce.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ tiŋgbani maa nim zaa nyaɣisim, ka tiŋ maa daa maai, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Atalia maa nyaaŋa.
en: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.

dag: Amaa o naɣ ni yɛlimi, M pala anabi, n nyɛla pukpara. Tiŋgbani zuɣu ka man kul kuriya nahindi m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: They will say, I am not a prophet. I am a farmer. I have worked as a farmer since I was a little child.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Ti yaa nyaŋ ba kaman ti ni pun nyandi ba shɛm la. Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lo nia yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti ŋmaligi zɔri ka bɛ dol ti, ka ti zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa solɔri zuɣu ha.
en: The Benjaminites said, We've beaten them just as before. But the Israelites had planned to retreat and lead them away from the city onto the roads.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Faashee a nya shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa, di yi pa lala, a ku niŋ yɛda.
en: Jesus said to him, You people must see miraculous signs and wonders before you will believe in me.

dag: Ti daa ʒinila tiŋa Babilɔn mɔɣa duli. Nimaani ka ti daa ʒini kum, saha shɛli ti ni daa teei Ziɔn yɛla.
en: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.

dag: Ka biɛhigu ti ku niŋ asama tin ya zuliyanim maa sani, ka yi ti ku nya luɣ shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ yi napɔŋ zali vuhi. Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira nimaani, ka ninsabiga mali ya, ka nandahima ti mali ya yi suhuri ni.
en: Among those nations you will have no rest and no place to call your own. There the LORD will give you an agitated mind, failing eyes, and a depressed spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ baŋ? Zallakudura Naa malila baŋsim.
en: They say, God will not know; the Most High will not find out.

dag: Niŋmiya Yawɛ naani sahakam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa n-taɣiri ti ka chɛri zaɣ biɛɣu sahakam.
en: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.

dag: Ka ti daa kpe Adiramitium ŋarin shɛli din daa yɛn yiɣisi doli yi Ɛsha tinsi din ʒi m-baɣi teeku nol la polo; ka Masidɔnia do so ŋun daa yi Tɛsalɔnaika na ka o yuli booni Aristakus la daa biɛl ti.
en: We went aboard a ship from Adramyttium that was about to sail to some ports along the coast of Asia. Aristarchus from Thessalonica in Macedonia sailed on the ship with us.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa tim ti boli Juda kpamba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, ka bɛ laɣim o sanna.
en: the king sent a message, and all of Judahs and Jerusalems elders gathered before him.

dag: N ni dol a zaligunima; di chɛ ma bahi zaa.
en: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.

dag: Di ni ti lu n-doya ka noonsi ti tamdi di mundili maa zuɣu, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ti be di wulikpana maa ni.
en: Now birds live in that fallen tree. Wild animals walk over its fallen branches.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa dɔɣi Yisifu nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, Bahim ma ka n kuli n ya ni n yiŋa.
en: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Send me off so that I can go to my own place and my own country.

dag: Amaa o yi zaŋ omaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka di wuhi ni o ka daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ŋun lan cham maligumaana maa sani yaha.
en: But if the rash continues to spread over the skin after they appeared before the priest for purification, they must again show themselves to the priest.

dag: Dinzuɣu man kpahimbu puuni, di ni simdi ni ninsalinim niŋ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla bɛ kul diri ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama suhupiɛlli mini bɛ tuma n-kul yɛn doli taba Naawuni ni ti ba nyɛvili shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ puuni.
en: So I commend enjoyment because theres nothing better for people to do under the sun but to eat, drink, and be glad. This is what will accompany them in their hard work, during the lifetime that God gives under the sun.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ŋub li, ti kpaamiya li bahi tiŋa kaman kom la.
en: You must not consume any of it. Pour it out on the ground, just like water.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya yaa ti Duuma min o kpiɔŋ ni o yiko ni.
en: Finally, be strengthened by the Lord and his powerful strength.

dag: Naa ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali nyɛla piɛbih ayɔbu bɛn ka dansi mini piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: The ruler will offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the Sabbath. He must provide six lambs that have nothing wrong with them and a ram that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: di saha bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ daa naan vali ti zaɣ nɛma.
en: then they would have swallowed us alive in their furious anger against us;.

dag: Kummiya kaman paɣisar so ŋun so buɣu n-kumdi nachimbil so ŋun di yɛn lo o amiliya zuɣu la.
en: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.

dag: Ka paɣitali dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi, ka o daa saɣim o ni mali shɛlikam timanim sani ka sokam tib o je la.
en: Among them was a woman who had suffered from severe bleeding for twelve years; she had spent all she had on doctors, but no one had been able to cure her.

dag: luɣ shɛli zunzuya ni bi kpira, ka buɣim mi bi kpiri ni.
en: The worms there never die, and the fire never stops burning.

dag: Dama Naawuni pala gutula ŋun ni lihi yaɣi yi tuma zuɣu bee n-lihi yaɣi yurilim shɛli yi ni wuhir o ka sɔŋdi ŋun Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda hal ka na kul niŋdi lala hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: God isnt unjust so that he forgets your efforts and the love you have shown for his names sake when you served and continue to serve Gods holy people.

dag: Dama bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim n-jɛmdi buɣa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi ya ŋɔnim zuɣu ka kɔŋ maabu.
en: My anger burns against this place, never to be quenched, because theyve deserted me and have burned incense to other gods, angering me by everything they have done.

dag: Amaa a nini yi ti bi tiɣ o, nyin bahim o ka o chaŋ, ka di zaŋ o kɔhi. Di bi simdi ni a niŋ o kaman dabili la, a ni zaŋ o dɔni m-baŋ o daashil la zuɣu.
en: If you are not pleased with her and choose to divorce her, set her free. You cannot sell her. You had sexual relations with her, so you must not treat her like a slave.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ ti teei gili Samaria.
en: After this happened, King Ben-Hadad of Aram gathered all his army and went to surround and attack the city of Samaria.

dag: Amaa a min a niriba yi lɛbi yi nyaaŋa biri ma, ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali ya ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti gbani wun shɛŋa tiŋa n-jɛmdi li.
en: But if you dont obey my laws and commands that I gave you, and if you worship other gods and serve them.

dag: Kpalimmiya be ti sani. Yi ni tooi be yi suhuri ni bɔri ni yi be luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka gɔri kɔhigu yi yubu, ka su tiŋgbani maa luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: You can live in the same land with us. You will be free to own the land and to trade here.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o dol a na, dindina a yi m pɔri ŋɔ taali ni; ka lee miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: If the young woman is not willing to come with you, you will be free from this promise. But you must not under any circumstances take my son back there.

dag: Tibidarigibo dabisili dali, Ifriim tiŋ ni ti kpalim dabari. Izraɛl zuliya ka n yɛri din shiri ti yɛn niŋ maa.
en: Ephraim will become empty at the time of punishment. I, God, warn the families of Israel that this really will happen.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ kul ku miligi ka chɛn ya hal ka di ti naai yi balibu zaa yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa.
en: The LORD will make a plague stick to you until he has totally wiped you off the fertile land you are entering to possess.

dag: dama ti bidibbina pala dunia ŋɔ bidibbina, amaa di nyɛla din mali Naawuni yiko di ni, ka daari tinsi goon kara luhira.
en: The weapons we use in our fight are not the world's weapons but God's powerful weapons, which we use to destroy strongholds. We destroy false arguments;.

dag: Yawɛ tim o niriba kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka ti ba suhudoo.
en: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.

dag: Babilɔnnima, yi bari yimaŋ zana ka di gbahi ya, amaa ka yi bi baŋ lala. Bɛ daa nyan ya n-gbahi ya yi ni daa mo Yawɛ la zuɣu.
en: Babylon, I set a trap for you, and you were caught before you knew it. You fought against the Lord , so you were found and captured.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, maliya suhupiɛlli jilima puuni. Yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila yi bindɔhi zuɣu.
en: Let his followers rejoice in this victory! Let them sing for joy, even in their beds!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi yɛli bɛ ni zaŋ liɣiri maa n-niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni ni bɛ yo tumtumdiba maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di liɣiri maa shɛm laasabu wuhi ba, dama bɛ daa doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.

dag: Ŋunkam mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, noli din dim o! Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who obstructs the legal rights of immigrants, orphans, or widows. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma so shɛŋa din kuni nyɛvili shee, ka chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa, n ni be a san la zuɣu. .
en: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa tum shɛm la. Amɔn daa kɔri biŋkɔbiri m-mali binnan shɛŋa zaa o ba Manaasa ni daa mali zal la, ka jɛmdi li.
en: Amon disobeyed the Lord , just as his father Manasseh had done, and he worshiped and offered sacrifices to the idols his father had made.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli, ka zaŋ ma doli so viɛlli, n dimnim zuɣu.
en: Teach me to follow, Lord , and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Hal ŋun pun beni maa yi yuui m-paai yuun tusaayi gba, amaa ka bi di binshɛli nyaɣisim, pa luɣ yini ka bɛ zaa kuna?.
en: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.

dag: O daa yɛlimi, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma m-pal o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli.
en: saying, Bless Israels God, the LORD, who spoke directly to my father David and now has kept his promise.

dag: Hal yi ni maani sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la mini chi sara la, n ku deei li. M mi ku gbiligi lihi yi ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb kar shɛb na nti maani suhudoo sara la.
en: Even if you offer me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. I will not even look at the fat animals you give as fellowship offerings.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal bɛ ni kul mali kpiɔŋ ka lan galisi maa zaa yoli, n ni ku n-naa ba. Hal n ni daa chɛ ka yi di wahala la, n ku lan chɛ ka yi di wahala yaha.
en: This is what the Lord says to his people Israel: Even though the Assyrians are strong and numerous, they will be destroyed and disappear. My people, I made you suffer, but I will not do it again.

dag: Ti saɣindi naŋgbankpeeni mini binshɛɣukam din duhiri dimaŋa ka nyɛ din guri Naawuni baŋsim sol la; ka gbahiri tɛha kam n-niŋdi li fukumsi ni ti chɛ ka di deei Masia noli.
en: we pull down every proud obstacle that is raised against the knowledge of God; we take every thought captive and make it obey Christ.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ li yɛri saha shɛl o yi ti yɛn tum tuma, ka o yi ti kpɛri luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ tooni bee o yi ti yirina, di ni chaɣisiri ka bɛ wumdi di vuri din ni chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: Aaron is to wear this robe when he serves as priest. When he comes into my presence in the Holy Place or when he leaves it, the sound of the bells will be heard, and he will not be killed.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni kariti ninvuɣ biɛri saria shɛm m-pal a kɔbili ni, ka saria karibu mini yɛlimaŋli gbaag a.
en: You are overly concerned about the case of the wicked; justice will be upheld in it.

dag: Ɛlifaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfi ni Gatam ni Kɛnaz ni Timna ni Amalɛk.
en: Eliphazs family: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

dag: Bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti do yi sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: People will be killed everywhere, and those who survive will acknowledge that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi dɔni bindoo kam zuɣu di ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Any bed on which he sits or lies is unclean.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ! Ŋun Naawuni nambɔzɔbo din galisi la puuni ka ti nya nyɛvili palli o ni daa neei Yisa Masia kum ni la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka ti mali tahima nɛɔŋ.
en: Let us give thanks to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! Because of his great mercy he gave us new life by raising Jesus Christ from death. This fills us with a living hope.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛɣ asiba, o yi sa chani mɔɣili ni, nyin sa zaŋm a jaaŋgbe shɛli din daa leei wahu la niŋ a nuu ni chaŋ ti zani mɔɣili maa duli gul o.
en: So go and meet him in the morning when he goes down to the Nile. Take with you the walking stick that was turned into a snake, and wait for him on the riverbank.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti shihi biŋgbamdigu din ni chɛ ka o kpe daɣiri ni bee di yi nyɛla ninsal sani ka o nya daɣiri maa, o daɣiri maa yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam;.
en: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba mini naa daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: Then the leaders of Israel and the king submitted. The LORD is right, they said.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n tuui; di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n sarigi.
en: But I had nearly lost confidence; my faith was almost gone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Karimba, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu saha.
en: Some followers asked Jesus, Teacher, when will these things happen? What will show us that it is time for these things to happen.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti daa yi tumdi tuma maa, bɛ ni pirigili gbibila kpana asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha zaŋ hal ti paai yuŋ saŋmarisi peebu saha.
en: So we continued to work on the wall of Jerusalem, and half the men held spears. We worked from the first light of the morning until the stars came out at night.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul diri wahala Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba tooi nya tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni ka mali jilima din ku naai la.
en: and so I endure everything for the sake of God's chosen people, in order that they too may obtain the salvation that comes through Christ Jesus and brings eternal glory.

dag: Di boliya so yi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, dama Naawuni yino ŋun bɛ alizanda ni ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ yi ba.
en: Dont call anybody on earth your father, because you have one Father, who is heavenly.

dag: Zaŋmiya bidib tuuli kam ti ma. Bɛ ni kul tuui dɔɣi binshɛɣukam ka o nyɛ zaɣ lɔɣu, ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu Izraɛlnim sunsuuni nyɛla n dini.
en: Dedicate to me the first-born son of every family and the first-born males of your flocks and herds. These belong to me.

dag: N kɔre daa bi kpe yi ni so daanzinfa bee salima bee situra ni.
en: When I was with you, I never wanted anyones money or fine clothes.

dag: Dama di yi pa o zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya n-di bee n-di o tuma nyaɣisim?.
en: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.

dag: Ka o mabia Ɛshɛk mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ulam n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛushi, ka Ɛlifɛlɛt mi daa pah ata.
en: Azels brother was Eshek. Eshek had some sons. These were Esheks sons: Ulam was Azels oldest son. Jeush was Esheks second son. Eliphelet was Esheks third son.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihinahi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pihinahi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Suppose there are just good people? Abraham asked. Even for them, the Lord replied, I won't destroy the city.

dag: Ka naa Sulemaana mini Hiram ni Gɛba tumtumdiba daa kpe kuɣa, ka ŋma dakuɣiri m-mal li ni bɛ zaŋ me duu maa.
en: The craftsmen of Solomon and Hiram, along with those of Byblos, prepared the timber and the stones for the construction of the temple.

dag: Buni ku tooi tiligi nir Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: Money is worthless when you face Gods punishment, but living right will save you from death.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ti, Yi mi di kul mɛnya yiya bee m-biri bimbira bee n-sa wain tihi bee m-mali dimbɔŋɔnim zaa shɛli. Amaa kul benya suɣa ni yi nyɛvili biɛhigu ni zaa din ni chɛ ka yi ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni be kaman saamba ŋɔ yuui.
en: nor are you to build or own houses or plant gardens and vineyards; rather, you are always to dwell in tents so you may live a long time in the fertile land you pass through.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka sa kura mini sakuɣa lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni ti lan chɛ ka buɣim mini chilibi lu o min o tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ shɛb bɛn be o sani zuɣu.
en: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o tumtumda maa, Ti yi chaŋ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn ti o? Dama ti lan ka bindirigu ti koligu ŋɔ ni bee bɔ ka ti lee mali? Ti ka pin shɛli din ni ti Naawuni nir maa.
en: Saul said to his servant, Sure, we can go into town, but what can we give to him? We have no gift to give the man of God. Even the food in our bags is gone. What can we give him.

dag: Naa daa malila ŋariŋ shɛŋa din yi Tarishish na m-pahi Hiram ŋarima zuɣu ka di be teeku ni, ka nyɛ din zɔri pam. Ka ŋarima din daa yi Tarishish na maa daa yi ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: The royal fleet of Tarshish-style ships was at sea with Hirams fleet, returning once every three years with gold, silver, ivory, monkeys, and peacocks.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra. Ijipti yɛnnim nyɛla jɛra bɛn wuhi niriba din bi viɛla. Bɛ ku tooi yɛli Firawuna ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnim mini na kura zuliya.
en: The officials of Tanis are fools; the wisest of Pharaohs counselors give stupid advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, Im a wise person, one of the ancient kings?.

dag: amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: But this is just the beginning of troubles.

dag: N yi tɛhi ni n yiŋ nyɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka n yi zaŋ m bindoo yɛrigi zibisim ni.
en: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.

dag: O ŋmanila jɛŋgbini n-doya gu ma, ka ŋmani gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣi doya gu.
en: He is like a bear about to attack me, like a lion that is in a hiding place.

dag: Ka so yi ti nya zahimbu, ŋun miri ka o yɛli ni Naawuni n-zahim o, dama zahimbu din ni chɛ ka nir tum zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi zahim Naawuni, ka ŋun Naawuni mi ku zahim so lala.
en: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.

dag: Di saha Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni ti chaŋ ti kuhi niŋ bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi wun shɛŋa maa, amaa bɛ kul ku tooi tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha.
en: Then the people of Judah and of Jerusalem will go to the gods to whom they offer sacrifices and will cry out to them for help. But those gods will not be able to save them when this destruction comes.

dag: ni Abiɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Anatɔt nir la ni Mɛbunai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la.
en: Abiezer from Anathoth; Mebunnai the Hushathite;.

dag: Dama di simdi ni yɛm yɛtɔɣa yiri maligumaana nol ni na, ka niriba ni bɔr o wuhibu, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tumo.
en: It is the duty of priests to teach the true knowledge of God. People should go to them to learn my will, because they are the messengers of the Lord Almighty.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ so ŋun zaɣisi ni o ku zo nti sɔɣi Naawuni sani tiligi, amaa ka naɣ niŋla o daazichi naani, ka zaŋ o daazichi maa n-leeg o sɔɣibu shee la.
en: Look, here is someone who did not depend on God for safety, but trusted instead in great wealth and looked for security in being wicked.

dag: Yihim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa yi biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ ku ta bɛ biɛhigu shee din nyɛ n ni be bɛ sani luɣ shɛli maa daɣiri.
en: You must send out both male and female. You must send them outside the camp so that they will not make their camp, where I live among them, unclean.

dag: N daa malila suhudoo, ka o pirigi ma buyi, o daa gbaala n nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ ma ŋme n-chɛrisichɛrisi, ka kul liriti ma.
en: I was living in peace, but God took me by the throat and battered me and crushed me. God uses me for target practice.

dag: Yɛl tibisili fukumsi n-ʒi n zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa polo: Bɛn mi biɛhigu soli mini bɛn ʒi biɛhigu soli ni bɛn mi gbaŋ mini bɛn ʒi gbaŋ.
en: I must serve all people—those who share in Greek culture and those who are less civilized, the educated as well as the ignorant.

dag: Paɣ jɛrigu kul tahirila pampam, o nyɛla ŋun be ʒilinsi ni, ka bi mi shɛli.
en: Stupidity is like a loud, ignorant, shameless woman.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni ninsalinim ni doli so shɛŋa maa, bɛ bi yurimi. Bɛ ni nyɛ daadamnim bɛn mali bahigu zuɣu bɛ ku tooi be viɛnyɛla.
en: I know, LORD, that our lives are not our own, that were not able to direct our paths.

dag: Ibram ni daa wum ni bɛ tuhi gbaag o dɔɣim maa chaŋ maa, ka o daa zaŋ o tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o yiŋ puuni, ka bɛ nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisaayika n-kari bɛ naba hal ti paai Dan.
en: When Abram heard that his relative had been captured, he took all of the loyal men born in his household, three hundred eighteen, and went after them as far as Dan.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kpɛhi duu, ka guhiri ni Yawɛ ti yɛli ba o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa duu maa dukpina mini di yɔɣira ni di dunɔbihi ni di pundi zaa zuɣu, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ kpe chɛrubinima n-zaŋ tabili dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: He covered the room, its beams, doorframes, walls, and doors with gold, and carved images of winged creatures on the walls.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhirimi ni n taɣirila n ni daa lo ni n niŋ shɛm? Bee n lɔri n nia mi kaman ŋun doli dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ni lɔri nia shɛm yɛra, Iin, Iin mini Aai, Aai zaa yim?.
en: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says Yes or No simply to please others?.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa lan nyɛ maligumaana la daa zaŋ li ka niriba maa sanna kaman bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa. Bɛ daa nyɛla dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bɛnkam ni tooi wum ka baŋ di gbinni. Di daa nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali.
en: So Ezra the priest brought the law before those who had met together. This was on the first day of the month. It was the seventh month of the year. Men, women, and anyone old enough to listen and understand were at the meeting.

dag: Amaa naa ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani, ka bɛnkam zaa zaŋ Naawuni yuli m-po pɔri ni mali suhupiɛlli dama ʒiŋmariba ni fo bɛ noya.
en: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa, ka poloya bɛn daa be bɛ yinsi dundɔna ni mini bɛ puri ni zaa daa kpi.
en: The Lord listened to Moses, and the frogs died everywhere—in houses, yards, and fields.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilɔi, Ilɔi, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: Then about that time Jesus shouted, Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani? which means, My God, my God, why have you deserted me.

dag: ka tɔɣisiri binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: As they were talking and thinking about what had happened.

dag: ti yɛl o, Ti dana, ti teeya ni ʒirilan la ni daa be o nyɛvil ni la, o daa yɛliya ni o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: They said, Sir, we remember what this liar said while he was still alive. He claimed in three days he would come back from death.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa be Yisifu sani ka niŋ o nirilim, ka chɛ ka dansarika gul maa suhu yu o.
en: the Lord helped him and was good to him. He even made the jailer like Joseph so much that.

dag: Di saha maa Masia cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim daa na ʒi ma ni bɛ nini.
en: No one in any of Christs churches in Judea had ever met me before.

dag: A yi mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni a yɛli, nyin garigim ma. Tɔɣisima, dama m bɔri ni n wuhi ni a ka taali.
en: But if you have an answer, go ahead and speak. Tell me your argument. I would be happy to know that you are innocent!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: You people who hear me, listen!.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ pina tari nandaamba ni bɛ suhuri zaa, bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam. Bɛ ni duhi ba ti ba jilima.
en: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.

dag: Ka tɔb shɛli daa ti lan lu bɛ sunsuuni Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni. O daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka di zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim maa zuliya ni na.
en: There was another battle at Gath. There was a very large man who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. He had fingers and toes in all. This man was also one of the giants.

dag: ka a niriba nya biɛhigu shee nimaani. Naawuni, a ti nandaamba din simdi ba a nirilim niŋbu puuni.
en: your people made their home there; in your goodness you provided for the poor.

dag: Yi yi yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o noli, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ ti yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: by loving the LORD your God, by obeying his voice, and by clinging to him. Thats how you will survive and live long on the fertile land the LORD swore to give to your ancestors: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: A wuntitali ŋmanila zoya din du pam; ka a saria karibu ŋmani teeku bulli din zilim pam. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri ninsalinim zaŋ tabili binnɛma.
en: Your goodness is higher than the highest mountains. Your fairness is deeper than the deepest ocean. Lord , you protect people and animals.

dag: Ka niriba daa be samban ni ka wum chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama vuri, ka di be kaman Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o kukoli be shɛm la.
en: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi yi taali ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu yihi yimaŋa Masia ni, ka lan ka Naawuni daalibarika puuni.
en: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: O ni daa du zuɣusaa ha la, o daa zaŋ bɛn nyɛ daba la pam mali chaŋ, ka daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinima.
en: That is why the Scriptures say, He went up high into the sky; he took prisoners with him, and he gave gifts to people. Psalm :.

dag: Amaa o daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali hal ka o ti dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga; ka Yisifu daa bol o yuli Yisa.
en: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o bia Yisahaku maa.
en: Abraham was a hundred years old when Isaac was born.

dag: Dama Naawuni nina kul gɔrimi gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam ni o kpaŋsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani suhuri. A tum jɛrilim dimbɔŋɔ puuni, dama pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, a kul yɛn bela tɔb tuhibu ni.
en: The Lord keeps close watch over the whole world, to give strength to those whose hearts are loyal to him. You have acted foolishly, and so from now on you will always be at war.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba bɛn ʒe nimaani ni yino lab o tapaɣa ka bɔh o, Lala ka a garigi maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa.
en: After Jesus spoke, one of the guards standing there slapped Jesus in the face. Is that how you would answer the high priest? he asked.

dag: Ka Jɛzibɛl daa tim ti yɛli Ilaija, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n yi sa bi ku a kaman a ni ku anabinim ŋɔ shɛm maa, n wuna bɛn kum ma.
en: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah and said, I swear that by this time tomorrow, you will be just as dead as those prophets. If I dont succeed, may the gods do the same or worse to me.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ ti cheechi na; amaa ka Diɔtrifiiz ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ bɛ toondan la bi lihi ma ni m mali yiko zaŋ chaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.

dag: Dinzuɣu taɣimiya biɛhigu yi suhuri ni, ka di lan nyɛnya tipawumlinima.
en: Stop being stubborn. Give your hearts to God.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Deemiya pɔŋli maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ pia la.
en: Then he said to some other servants standing there, Take the money away from him and give it to the servant who earned ten times as much.

dag: O ni gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim, amaa o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna m-bahi zibisim ni; dama ninsal ku tooi di nasara omaŋmaŋ yiko ni.
en: God guards the feet of his faithful ones, but the wicked die in darkness because no one succeeds by strength alone.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naa ŋɔ ni deei n suhigu, ka nyaŋ ba ti ma, dama bɛ bi taɣi, ka mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: God, who is enthroned from ancient days, will hear and humble them Selah because they dont change and they dont worship God.

dag: Ka Musa daa ti bɔhi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu bua la yɛla, ka nya ka bɛ pun zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka o suhu yiɣisi bahi Ɛliɛza mini Itama bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim maa zuɣu ka o bɔhi ba.
en: Moses looked for the goat of the sin offering, but it was already burned up. Moses became very angry with Aarons other sons Eleazar and Ithamar. Moses said.

dag: n-chɛ ka bɛ laɣim niriba maa zaa na gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali, ka bɛ mini bɛ zuliya ti sab bɛ yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gari lala.
en: and called all the Israelites together on the first day of the second month. Then the people were listed by their families and their family groups. All the men who were years old or older were listed.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ɛhab, Cham ti di ka nyu, dama saa vura.
en: Then Elijah said to King Ahab, Now, go and eat. I hear the roar of rain approaching.

dag: O zaŋd o naba kɔrisiri tiŋa ni yaa, o mali suhupiɛlli pam o yaa maa zuɣu, ka zɔri tuhiri bidibbina soli.
en: They eagerly paw the ground in the valley; they rush into battle with all their strength.

dag: O daa ku Amɔri Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi ni Keenan nanim zaa.
en: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan.

dag: Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di niŋ zina, a nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zina? Nyin ŋun je buɣa, a nyɛla ŋun zuri buɣa jɛmbu duu nɛma?.
en: You say, Do not commit adultery—but do you commit adultery? You detest idols—but do you rob temples?.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa dɔni, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, bɛ yi dɔɣ o la yiŋa bee luɣ shɛli polo.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your sister. It doesnt matter if she is the daughter of your father or your mother. And it doesnt matter if your sister was born in your house or at some other place.

dag: ni Jaarɛshia ni Ilaija ni Zikiri mi daa nyɛ Jɛrɔham bidibisi.
en: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zicri.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha Luɣ Kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: The priests carried the Box of the Lord s Agreement to its proper place inside the Most Holy Place in the Temple, under the wings of the Cherub angels.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa maa naai ka ŋmaligi, ka Ibrahimma gba daa ŋmaligi kuli.
en: The Lord finished speaking to Abraham and left. Then Abraham went back home.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinunaayi ka ti daa zaŋ tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma zaa n-naai li gol so bɛ ni booni Ɛlul la biɛɣ pisinaanu dali.
en: So the wall of Jerusalem was completed on the th day of the month of Elul. It had taken days to finish building the wall.

dag: Dindina a ni bi saɣi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛli zuɣu, a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi chɛ ka o niŋ a ni bɔri shɛli? Nyini n-ni pii, pa mani, dinzuɣu yɛlim a ni mi shɛli.
en: Since you object to what God does, can you expect him to do what you want? The decision is yours, not mine; tell us now what you think.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi sokam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Anab titali ka dunia ŋɔ ni na nti be ti sani. Ka bɛ lan yɛli, Naawuni n-ka o niriba sani maa na.
en: Everyone was frightened and praised God. They said, A great prophet is here with us! God has come to his people.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ti nyari binyara mi kaman diɣi liti ni ka ti lihira; amaa saha yi ti paai, ti nini yipa ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Pumpɔŋɔ m bi mi binshɛɣukam zaa, amaa saha kanna ka n ni ti mi zaa kaman Naawuni ni mi ma zaa shɛm la.
en: It is the same with us. Now we see God as if we are looking at a reflection in a mirror. But then, in the future, we will see him right before our eyes. Now I know only a part, but at that time I will know fully, as God has known me.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti lan deei Yawɛ noli, ka doli o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: and you will again obey him and keep all his commands that I am giving you today.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ baŋ? Zallakudura Naa malila baŋsim.
en: Only evil people would say, God Most High cannot know everything.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisifu daa ti yɛn kpi ka teei n-tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm yɛla zali; ka daa wuhi ba bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sɔɣibu polo.
en: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba maa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa.
en: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh answered the heads of the families of the western tribes:.

dag: Dama di saha a ti ku lan kaani n napɔna yaabu, a ti ku lan yuuni n daalahichi.
en: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim naa ka o dol a zaligu kariti saria, ka zaŋ a wuntia ti naa bia.
en: God, help the king be like you and make fair decisions. Help the kings son know what justice is.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi nuu be zibisim tuun yoya ni, amaa lee yihimiya tuun yoya maa la palɔni.
en: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so n-daa ti boli niriba pam ni bɛ ka o yiŋ na ti di bindira;.
en: Jesus said to him, A man gave a big dinner. He invited many people.

dag: Yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa puuni, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: During these forty years your clothes have not worn out, nor have your feet swollen up.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka naŋgbankpeeni lu niriba ayi sunsuuni ka bɛ tahi li ʒiishee, ka sariakaritiba ti ŋmaai bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka wuhi ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli.
en: Now two people have a disagreement and they enter into litigation and their case is decided, with the judges declaring one person legally right and the other legally liable.

dag: Lala zuɣu di daa nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ din be alizanda ni ŋmahima la doli maligu malibu soli ŋɔ m-mali be kasi; amaa di nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni maŋmaŋ mali sara din so.
en: So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be cleansed with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things had to be cleansed with better sacrifices than these.

dag: O wahala dibu nyaaŋa, o ni ti nya o tuma nyɔri ka o nini tiɣi li. N dabili ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra maa baŋsim zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni. O ni deei bɛ daalahichi ʒi.
en: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord . Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti do tin tital shɛl ni bɛ ni daa kpahi bɛ Duuma tabili dapulli zuɣu la solɔɣu zuɣu. Tiŋ maa yupaa n-nyɛ Sɔdom bee Ijipti.
en: Their dead bodies will lie on the street of the great city that is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

dag: Di saha ka Liya daa yɛli, Naawuni ti ma pin suŋ, pumpɔŋɔ n yidan ni ti ma jilima, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ayɔbu ti o; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Zɛbulɔn.
en: and she said, God has given me a wonderful gift. Now my husband will honor me since Ive borne him six sons. So she named him Zebulun.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa mini kaya shɛŋa ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: All these are the laws and commands that the Lord gave to Moses on Mount Sinai for the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana n-daa ti me jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni.
en: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.

dag: Amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda naɣila n ni kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Hal bɛ daa bi yɛli ma a yɛm din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla pirigili gba; a biɛhigu maa gari n ni daa wum a yɛla shɛm maa.
en: I didnt believe it until I came and saw it with my own eyes. In fact, the half of it wasnt told to me! You have far more than I was told.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kali niriba maa naai nyaaŋa ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, N tum alahichi n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, kpihimi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daalahichi maa; dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: But after David had taken the census, his conscience began to hurt, and he said to the Lord , I have committed a terrible sin in doing this! Please forgive me. I have acted foolishly.

dag: Ɛdomnim yi yɛli, Bɛ daa wurim ti tinsi, amaa ti ni lab me li. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni tooi me, amaa n kul ni wurindi li hal ka niriba ti bol li tiŋgban biɛɣu ni Yawɛ ni je suli niŋ ninvuɣ shɛba sahakam.
en: Edom may say, We are beaten down, but we will rebuild the ruins; but the LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: They may build, but I will tear them down. They will call themselves a wicked territory, the people against whom the LORD rages forever.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili m mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: Any of you who try to save the life you have will lose it. But you who give up your life for me and for the Good News will save it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Naa Sulemaana, Jɔab zo nti bela Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, nyama, o be sara maligu bimbini luɣili ni. Ka Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka yɛl o, Cham ti ŋme o luhi.
en: Someone told King Solomon that Joab was at the altar in the Lord s Tent. So Solomon ordered Benaiah to go and kill him.

dag: Ɛtan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Azaria.
en: Ethans family: Azariah.

dag: M mali niɣi mini bunsi ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka tim na ni n ti yɛli nyini n dana din ni chɛ ka a suhu maai ni mani. .
en: and now I own cattle, donkeys, and sheep, as well as many slaves. Master, I am sending these messengers in the hope that you will be kind to me.

dag: ka puu maa nyɛ dunia ŋɔ; ka alikama biɛlin suma maa nyɛ Naawuni nam ni bihi; ka piriŋkpana biɛlim la mi nyɛ Sintani bihi.
en: The field is the world. And the good seeds are the followers of the kingdom. But the weeds are the followers of the evil one.

dag: Amaa o tɔbu ku kabi, ka ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o nuhi mali kpiɔŋ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim gula, ka yihiri ba barina ni ŋɔ yuli zuɣu.
en: But his bow stayed strong, and his forearms were nimble, by the hands of the strong one of Jacob, by the name of the shepherd, the rock of Israel.

dag: Kum yi mali so, ŋun dim yiŋ pɔi ka di chɛ ka yi ku nya tibidarigibo yi laɣiŋgu ni. Zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa din kpalim polo, n yi ti kana, n ni wuhi ya di gba yɛla.
en: If some of you are hungry, they should eat at home so that getting together doesnt lead to judgment. I will give directions about the other things when I come.

dag: ni daanya sara maligu bimbini la mini di daanya kurupooti ni di dapuhi ni di zuɣu nɛma zaa ni tahili la ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: They showed him the bronze altar, the bronze screen, the poles used for carrying the altar, and everything that was used on the altar. They showed him the bowl and the base under the bowl.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋub ba yi tinsi ni, bɛn be nyam mini bɛn bi be nyam zaa yi ni tooi ŋub ba kaman yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm la.
en: But you may eat the meat from that animal at home. Anyone may eat it—people who are clean and people who are unclean. The rules for eating this meat are the same as the rules for eating gazelles and deer.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti tiligira. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: Our redeemer has spoken; the LORD of heavenly forces is his name, the holy one of Israel.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ sol zuɣu zibisi ka sarigira, ka Yawɛ malaika kariti doli ba.
en: Let their path be dark and slippery— and let the LORDs messenger be the one who does the chasing!.

dag: Amaa ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ niriba anii n-zo n-tiligi Jɔhanan nuu ni kuli Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Ishmael and eight of his men got away from Johanan and escaped to the land of Ammon.

dag: Dama a noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhiri a tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli ka a yula yɛŋkiŋkabina yɛtɔɣa.
en: Your wickedness is evident by what you say; you are trying to hide behind clever words.

dag: Teem a daba bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu yɛla, ka di doli niriba ŋɔ tipawumli bee bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali bee bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ.
en: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.

dag: O daa darig o niriba maa tibili n-chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni. O suhuyiɣisili puuni, o daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kana ti ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: The Lord punished his people by sending them into exile. He took them away with a cruel wind from the east.

dag: Naɣila biŋkɔbiri ka ti daa zaŋ leei ti ni ŋme tɔb di shɛli m-pahi ti ni daa ŋme n-fa neen shɛŋa fɔntin shɛŋa ti ni daa dee la ni.
en: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul piligi yiini wumpaɣibo yilli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka mbusim lu Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunim bɛn daa laɣim kana ti liri Judanim maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa birim ka ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu ku taba.
en: As they began to sing and to praise God, the Lord set an ambush for the army from Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir who had come to attack Judah. The enemy was defeated!.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa ti yɛli Dauda, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ di ti shɛhira, biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bee dali, n yi daa bɔhi m ba ka o bi lan lo ni o niŋ nyin Dauda zaɣ biɛɣu, n ku tim na ti yɛl a?.
en: Then Jonathan told David, I pledge by the LORD God of Israel that I will question my father by this time tomorrow or on the third day. If he seems favorable toward David, I will definitely send word and make sure you know.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn nyɛ azichilaannim la, kummiya ka fabilimiya nandahima din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu.
en: You rich people, listen! Cry and be very sad because much trouble will come to you.

dag: Ninvuɣ Suŋ ni ŋun lan nyɛ wuntialana ka yi daa zaɣisi maa, ka daa lee chɛ ka Gomna Pailɛt yihila ŋun kuri niriba bahi.
en: You rejected the holy and righteous one, and asked that a murderer be released to you instead.

dag: Di saha ka n daa galim Judanim zuɣulaannim la, ka bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tumdi Vuhim Dabisili dali n-tari li daɣiri maa?.
en: I told the important people of Judah that they were wrong. I said, You are doing a very bad thing. You are ruining the Sabbath day.

dag: Shɛbuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Musa bia Gɛrishom mi bia la n-daa nyɛ kpɛm ŋun su azichinim fukumsi.
en: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.

dag: Ibram ni daa wum ni bɛ tuhi gbaag o dɔɣim maa chaŋ maa, ka o daa zaŋ o tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o yiŋ puuni, ka bɛ nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisaayika n-kari bɛ naba hal ti paai Dan.
en: When Abram heard that his nephew had been captured, he called together all the fighting men in his camp, in all, and pursued the four kings all the way to Dan.

dag: Romnim ni ti zaŋ bɛ sitimanim na nti lu o zuɣu ka dabiɛm gbaag o. Di saha maa o ni ti lab kuli ni suhuyiɣisili, ka lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ti yɛn dolila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa saɣisigu.
en: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi n-chaŋ ti da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbiga na ti pahi.
en: In addition, he hired , soldiers from Israel at a cost of about four tons of silver.

dag: Ka o kul zaɣisira, amaa di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛli o suhu ni, Wun ni m bi zɔri Naawuni ka mi bi lihiri nyari daadam kam ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: For a while he refused but finally said to himself, I dont fear God or respect people.

dag: Saa miri niŋdi Yawɛ tihi pam, o ni biri Lɛbanɔn sida ti shɛŋa la.
en: The cedars of Lebanon get plenty of rain— the Lord 's own trees, which he planted.

dag: Yawɛ, a yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam. Di nyɛla din kul ba n-ʒe alizanda ni sahakam.
en: Your word, O Lord , will last forever; it is eternal in heaven.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Aduna, Wula ka niriba maa lee niŋ a, ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to Aaron, What did these people do to you that you led them to commit such a terrible sin.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o garig o yɛm garigibu maa ka o yɛl o, A mini Naawuni nam bi wɔɣ ni taba. Di nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu shɛli yaha.
en: Jesus noticed how wise his answer was, and so he told him, You are not far from the Kingdom of God. After this nobody dared to ask Jesus any more questions.

dag: Din chɛ ka bɛ ni bu so paa zɔri maa nyɛla o ni guli ba la liɣiri zuɣu maa n-chɛ ka o baɣa dii ka bɛ ni.
en: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.

dag: Nyini ka n kul lihira, nyini ŋun nam ʒiishee be zuɣusaa ŋɔ!.
en: Lord , I look up to you, up to heaven, where you rule.

dag: Ka Amasa daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti boli Judanim maa na, amaa ka o daa yuui hal ka bɛ ni daa zal o dabisi shɛli maa ti gari.
en: Amasa went to call them, but he did not get back by the time the king had told him to.

dag: Ti mabihi la zaa puhiri ya. Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ.
en: All the believers here send greetings. Greet one another with the kiss of peace.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, pom Naawuni kpe ni a ku yɔhim m mini m bihi ni n zuliya; amaa n ni ʒe a yim shɛm, a gba zanimi m mini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni kana ti beni ŋɔ yim.
en: So give me your word under God that you wont cheat me, my children, or my descendants. Just as I have treated you fairly, so you must treat me and the land in which you are an immigrant.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila lan shɛli kulipalinim ni zaŋ lab kom ni n-gbahi zahim balibu kam;.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like what happens when a net is thrown into a lake and catches all kinds of fish.

dag: O ni ti fa yi tumtumdi dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka deei yi naɣ viɛla mini yi bun viɛla zaa ka bɛ tumd o tuma.
en: He will take your servants and your best cattle and donkeys, and make them work for him.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka niŋ din tuhi, ka kar a daba saria n-wuhi ŋun tum taali, ka chɛ ka o tuuni maa ʒin o zuɣu. Ka a zani wuntizɔra maa nyaaŋa, ka ti o laara o wuntitali maa zuɣu.
en: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.

dag: Lɛvinim daŋ ni: Jɔzabad mini Shimɛi ni Kɛlaya, bɛ ni daa lan booni la ni Pɛtahia ni Juda ni Ɛliɛza.
