en: Among the Levites, these are the men who married foreign women: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa nya malaikanima anahi, ka bɛ ʒe dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ n-gu pɔhim soli ni di di ʒe n-kpe dunia ni bee teeku ni bee n-ʒe tihi.
en: After this happened I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth. The angels were holding the four winds of the earth. They were stopping the wind from blowing on the land or the sea or on any tree.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa yi tum din chihi Anabi Musa zaligu, bɛ kur o mi niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira zuɣu ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Anyone who disobeys the Law of Moses is put to death without any mercy when judged guilty from the evidence of two or more witnesses.

dag: Ti saɣindi naŋgbankpeeni mini binshɛɣukam din duhiri dimaŋa ka nyɛ din guri Naawuni baŋsim sol la; ka gbahiri tɛha kam n-niŋdi li fukumsi ni ti chɛ ka di deei Masia noli.
en: and every defense that is raised up to oppose the knowledge of God. They capture every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

dag: n yi daa yuli wuntaŋa saha shɛl o ni daa puhi na, bee n-nya goli ni chani ni jilima.
en: I have never openly or secretly.

dag: Di ku yuui ka n kana; gbib a ni mali shɛli kirikiri ka so ti ku fa a nam zuɣupiligu.
en: I am coming soon. Hold on to the faith you have, so that no one can take away your crown.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa ni yino daa yɛli, A ba pola pɔri yɛli niriba, Ŋunkam di bindirigu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Niriba maa daa kul gbarigimi zaa.
en: Then one of the soldiers spoke up: Your father bound the troops by a solemn pledge: Anyone who eats food today is doomed. Thats why the troops are exhausted.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o salo maa ni yi kpaŋa nti zaŋ o nubihi tim o tiba ni, ka tuhi nintɔri zaŋ shihi tikpiralan maa zilinli;.
en: Jesus took him away from the crowd by himself and put his fingers in the mans ears. Then he spit and touched the mans tongue.

dag: Tim a ba mini a ma jilima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a shɛm din ni chɛ ka a mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ ni.
en: You must honor your father and your mother. The Lord your God has commanded you to do this. If you follow this command, you will live a long time, and everything will go well for you in the land that the Lord your God gives you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun garigi bɔhigu ni yɛlimaŋli nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zɔsimdi.
en: Those who speak honestly are like those who kiss on the lips.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi bɛ naa salima zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu, ka kuɣ viɛlli daa be di ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda zuɣu ni, ka o daa va bɛ ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam.
en: David took Milcoms crown off his head. It weighed one kikkar of gold and was set with a valuable stone. It was placed on Davids head. The amount of loot David took from the city was huge.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe Pita yiŋa n-nya ka Pita deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ bii ka o doya;.
en: Jesus went to Peters house. He saw that Peters mother-in-law was in bed with a high fever.

dag: Amaa alahichinim ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din bi doya baalim, ka kul puɣiri lura n-ʒiri daɣiri mini yaɣiri kpɛhiri teeku ni la.
en: The wicked are a restless sea tossing up mud.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni, ka zaŋdi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa ti mini ti yaannim ni bi tooi ʒi ni yi ʒili ba?.
en: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni booni do so Yisa la n-gari taŋkpaɣu n-zaŋ ʒe n nina maa, ka yɛli ma ni n cham Sailom biaŋ la ni nti paɣi n nina maa. Ka n chaŋ ti paɣi, ka n nina maa dii neei.
en: He answered, The man called Jesus made some mud, rubbed it on my eyes, and told me to go to Siloam and wash my face. So I went, and as soon as I washed, I could see.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o kpambaliba min o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm ni o gomnanim ni wulaannim ni tɔbbihi nyu dam buɣi. Bɛ ni gbihi go titali, ka ku lan yiɣisi. Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make Babylons wise men and important officials drunk. I will make the governors, officers, and soldiers drunk too. Then they will sleep forever. They will never wake up. This is what the King said. His name is the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaayi dali ka ti daa yiɣisi Ahava Mɔɣili maa gbini n-kuni Jɛrusalɛm, ka ti Naawuni maa nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka o tiligi ti ti dimnim mini sɔguriba nuu ni ti chandi maa ni.
en: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started toward Jerusalem. God was with us, and he protected us from enemies and robbers along the way.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino.
en: As the Scriptures say, A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti she di nimdi maa dindali yuŋ maa ŋ-ŋubi di mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to.
en: On this night you must roast the lamb and eat all the meat. You must also eat bitter herbs and bread made without yeast.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti mali bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi din ni chɛ ka di mini binyɛribila maa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o ti mal li gar o bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: The vest will have two shoulder pieces attached to its two edges so that they may be joined together.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan labina nti neei ma kaman nir ni yi gbihiri ka bɛ neeg o shɛm la.
en: The messenger speaking with me returned and woke me like one who awakens someone who is asleep.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni zali zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili be kom ni ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili gbamdi tiŋgban ni.
en: This concludes the Instruction concerning animals, birds, all creatures that live in water, and all the creatures that swarm on the earth.

dag: Ka Jɛzibɛl daa tim ti yɛli Ilaija, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n yi sa bi ku a kaman a ni ku anabinim ŋɔ shɛm maa, n wuna bɛn kum ma.
en: She sent a message to Elijah: May the gods strike me dead if by this time tomorrow I don't do the same thing to you that you did to the prophets.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni wum ti paɣ so ŋun bol omaŋa anabi ka o yuli booni Jɛzibɛl la zuɣu. O nyɛla ŋun yɔhindi n jɛmdiba n-wuhiri ba ka bɛ niŋdi zina, ka diri buɣa maligu nimdi.
en: But I have this against you: You let that woman Jezebel do what she wants. She says that she is a prophet, but she is leading my people away with her teaching. Jezebel leads my people to commit sexual sins and to eat food that is offered to idols.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam saha miriya.
en: In the same way, when you see these things happening, you know that Gods kingdom is near.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti zal o niriba bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaɣ shɛŋa din daa be teeku polo zaŋ tabili bɛn daa be kukɔɣu polɔnim zaa ni bɛ yo farigu.
en: King Xerxes made people pay taxes. All the people in the kingdom, even the faraway cities on the seacoast, had to pay taxes.

dag: Yawɛ, guli n noli, gbibi n naŋgbampiba.
en: Lord , place a guard at my mouth, a sentry at the door of my lips.

dag: Alɔbo ni lu yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu bee ka kum ku ba yi sani. Ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu yi sani. Ka n wurim yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu mi dolisi pɔhim; ka ŋooi takɔbi kari doli ba.
en: One-third of you will die of plague and waste away by famine among you. One-third will fall by the sword all around you. And one-third I will scatter to all the winds, letting loose a sword to pursue them.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ti ni daa wum yi yɛla hal ni pɔŋɔ, ti kul suhirila Naawuni tiri ya sahakam. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi baŋ o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka pahi ya yɛm mini baŋsim zaa din nyɛ Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ya shɛl la.
en: For this reason we have always prayed for you, ever since we heard about you. We ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will, with all the wisdom and understanding that his Spirit gives.

dag: Amaa tiŋ maa nim yi bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ tin ya ni suhumahili, ka lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ya, dindina yin teemiya gili tiŋ maa.
en: But if the city refuses to make peace with you and fights against you, you should surround the city.

dag: O daa bi niŋ bɛ sani n-gari biɛɣ pia bee biɛr anii, ka yiɣisi lab Siizaria. N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o chaŋ ti ʒin o sariadibo ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pool na.
en: He stayed with them for no more than eight or ten days, then went down to Caesarea. The following day he took his seat in the court and ordered that Paul be brought in.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini niriba laɣiŋgu shee. Di saha ka Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mir o la kana ni o ti gari nimaani, ka Bɔaz bol o, Zɔri, kamina kpe ti ʒini. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini.
en: Boaz went to the place where people gather near the city gates. He sat there until the close relative he had told Ruth about passed by. Boaz called to him, Come and sit here, friend.

dag: dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: He wasn't like the teachers of the Law; instead, he taught with authority.

dag: Di simdi ni karimbia bemi kaman o karimba; ka dabili mi be kaman o duuma. Ka bɛ yi zaŋ alizin biɛri naa yuli Biilzibul m-boli yil yidana, wula ka bɛ lee ni bol o yiŋnim bɛna.
en: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family?.

dag: ka di leei nyɛvili a sani, ka leei nachiinsi bini a nyiŋgol ni.
en: They will provide you with life—a pleasant and happy life.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa yɛdaniŋdib bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-doli Pita na la alahiziba bɛ ni daa nya ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu;.
en: The Jewish believers who had come from Joppa with Peter were amazed that God had poured out his gift of the Holy Spirit on the Gentiles also.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Mɔab. O yaansi n-nyɛ Mɔabnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The older daughter gave birth to a son. She named him Moab. Moab is the ancestor of all the Moabites living today.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa kanimina ni n ti liri ya n-kari ya saria zuliya kam ninni.
en: So the Lord GOD says, So now, even I am against you! I will punish you while those other people watch.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka o niŋ a nyɔri bee m-pah a binshɛli, amaa zom a Naawuni, ka chɛ ka a mabia maa kul be a sani.
en: Dont charge them any interest on money you might loan to them. Respect your God and let those from your own country live with you.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa daa shiri chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa su, ka a daa chɛ ka bɛ su Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim la, ka daa zaŋ bɛ nanim mini bɛ niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ni bɛ niŋ ba bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: They conquered the land of Canaan; you overcame the people living there. You gave your people the power to do as they pleased with the people and kings of Canaan.

dag: Ka bɛ daa suhi alibarika suhigu ti Ribɛka n-yɛli: Ti tizɔpaɣa, Naawuni chɛ ka a leei niriba tusatusa ni tuhi piapia ma! Naawuni chɛ ka a zuliya ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: They gave Rebekah their blessing and said, We pray that God will give you many children and grandchildren and that he will help them defeat their enemies.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi shɛm maa daa viɛli n sani, ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni ninvuɣ yinoyino, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: I thought that was a good idea. So I chose twelve men from among you, one man from each tribe.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me again and said:.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir ŋun yi Zɛrɛda na, ka nyɛ Sulemaana kpambala, ka o ma nyɛ pako so ŋun yuli daa booni Zɛrua la gba daa leei naa dima.
en: There was also another person who became an enemy of Solomon. He was Jeroboam son of Nebat. He was an Ephraimite from the town of Zeredah. His mother was a widow named Zeruah. He was one of Solomons servants, but he rebelled against the king.

dag: ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pili ba; ka maligumaanitali maa leei bɛ dini sahakam. A ni ti yɛn zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa leei maligumaaniba shɛm m-bala.
en: caps, and sashes, then ordain them, because they and their descendants will always be priests.

dag: Yi gba nyɛla n shɛhiranima, yi ni pun be n sani piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: And you will tell people about me too, because you have been with me from the beginning.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also give goat as a sin offering. This must be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee kuhi pam; bɛ daa kumiya pam dindali yuŋ maa.
en: All night long the people cried out in distress.

dag: Goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali nyɛla chuɣu, yi yɛn ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the fifteenth day of this month there will be a festival. For seven days unleavened bread will be eaten.

dag: Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ a sɔŋda ŋɔ n-naɣi ni ti kpe di ni. Kpaŋsim o, dama ŋuna n-yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim deei li su.
en: But strengthen the determination of your helper, Joshua son of Nun. He will lead Israel to occupy the land.

dag: O zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka kul zaŋ o nina kpa n soya zaa.
en: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.

dag: ka kana ni nti chɛ ka a baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ a niriba dahin shɛli ha. Dahin shɛli ha yɛla ʒii m-bala.
en: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yɛli, Ti Naawuni m-bɔŋɔ! Ti pun guhir o mi ni o tiligi ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni pun guhiri so la m-bala. Chɛliya ka ti mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ti maa zuɣu.
en: When it happens, everyone will say, He is our God! We have put our trust in him, and he has rescued us. He is the Lord ! We have put our trust in him, and now we are happy and joyful because he has saved us.

dag: Ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, dama n labirila m Ba sani ka yi ku lan nya ma.
en: He will show the world it was wrong about righteousness because Im going to the Father and you wont see me anymore.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-kun ya bɔhi biɛri alikauli la zuɣu. Ka yi yi ti zo n-kuli yi fɔntinsi ni, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ yi dimnim nuu ni.
en: I will bring the sword against you, avenging the breaking of the covenant. If you retreat into your cities, I will send a plague on you, and you will be handed over to the enemy.

dag: Di zaŋ yɛm bahi, yɛm ni gbib a. Yum yɛm, ka yɛm gul a.
en: Dont turn away from wisdom, and she will protect you. Love her, and she will keep you safe.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn luri n yuli sizuura ŋɔ, n tiliginsim yiko din be kaman wuntaŋ neesim la ni nyee kpɛn ya, ka tahi tibbu na ti tin ya. Yi ni ti yiɣiri jamdi kaman naɣibihi pola n-yi naɣiluu ni na la.
en: But for you who obey me, my saving power will rise on you like the sun and bring healing like the sun's rays. You will be as free and happy as calves let out of a stall.

dag: Ka Shafan mi daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti naa ka yɛl o, A ni zal a kpambaliba maa ni bɛ tum tuun shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ be di tumbu ni.
en: who brought it to the king with this report: Your servants are doing everything youve asked them to do.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila wurigu, ka buɣim ni di ba zaa! Bɛ ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋ buɣim barina ni. Bɛ ka sala buɣim din ni wuɣisi.
en: They will be like bits of straw, and a fire will burn them up! They will not even be able to save themselves— the flames will be too hot for them, not a cozy fire to warm themselves by.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, dilan ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa bi gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gil li ka di dii lu zaa, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: But anyone who hears my words and does not obey them is like a man who built his house without laying a foundation; when the flood hit that house it fell at once—and what a terrible crash that was.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli duno shɛli din daa be dunɔdali luɣili zuɣu la yi n-chaŋ nuzaa polo du kasi shɛŋa din nyɛ maligumaaniba duri la ni, nimaani ka n daa nya luɣ shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo tariga la.
en: Then he brought me through the passage beside the gate next to the priests quarters, the holy chambers facing north. There was a place hidden away on the western side.

dag: Awa yini puuni ka di bun la zaa zani bahi yoli! Ka ŋariŋduhiriba zuɣulaannim mini ŋariŋkpɛriba ni ŋariŋduhiriba ni bɛn zaa wolima yiri teeku ni na kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: in just one hour such great wealth was destroyed. Every sea captain, every seafarer, sailors, and all who make their living on the sea stood a long way off.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya suhupiɛlli ŋun nyɛ yi namda ŋɔ zuɣu. Ziɔnnima, maliya suhupiɛlli yi Naa zuɣu.
en: Let Israel celebrate its maker; let Zions children rejoice in their king!.

dag: Dindali maa Siria naa maa ʒi tibisa ti ku lan tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu; n ni ti kab o naɣikɔra dapuhi din be yi nyiŋgoya ni la.
en: On that day, God will remove the burden from your shoulder and destroy the yoke on your neck. He has gone up from Samaria.

dag: N daa gbi kɔbilisi, ka nyu tinzun tinsi kom, ka daa siɣi Ijipti kulibɔna ni, ka n naba chɛ ka di kom zaa nyuui.
en: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.

dag: Bɛ paɣiri nir o yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ʒiɛmdi ŋun tɛha bi zilima.
en: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaa lee tumdila din ni tiɣi ti kpee nini o zaɣ viɛlli nyabu min o kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: but do what pleases them and is for their good. We should do whatever helps everyone grow stronger in faith.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba wum o kukoli din galisi la, ka chɛ ka sokam nya o suhuyiɣisili tuma. O ni ti chɛ ka buɣim dira, ka sagbana bɔɣi, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛra, ka sakuɣa luri na.
en: The Lord will cause all people to hear his great voice and to see his powerful arm come down in anger. That arm will be like a great fire that burns everything. His power will be like a great storm with much rain and hail.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli;.
en: Be joyful always.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ kpam chim li mahilaa ni zaɣ bihi, ka a gar li viɛnyɛliŋga n-zaŋ li mali sara shɛli din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: It is to be mixed with oil and cooked on a griddle and then crumbled and presented as a grain offering, an odor pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa zaŋ o niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o o siliga ni m-pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: His officials took his body back to Jerusalem in a chariot and buried him in the royal tombs in David's City.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi bidibbina be maligumaaniba bɛn daa piɛbiri kikahi maa tooni, ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn lan gbibi bidibbina doli bɛ nyaaŋa, ka bɛ kul piɛbiri kikahi maa.
en: The soldiers with weapons marched in front of the priests who were blowing the horns. And the rest of the men walked behind the Holy Box, marching and blowing their trumpets.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi, ka o daa fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bia la.
en: The Israelites begged the Lord for help, and so he chose Othniel to rescue them. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Anabi Ilaija m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, O ŋmanila anab kura la ni yino.
en: Others thought he was Elijah or some other prophet who had lived long ago.

dag: Bɛ daa bela mɔɣu ni kuhiri kaman bunsi la, ka laɣim do gɔhi tihi gbinni.
en: Out in the wilds they howled like animals and huddled together under the bushes.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu, ka garigi ma, dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana.
en: Please listen, Lord , and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan zaŋ nimaani kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti du Bɛtihɔgila kuŋkuni, ka di tintariga maa daa zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Yalim Teeku duli nuzaa polo zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili nudirigu polo. Di nudirigu polo tintariga n-daa bala.
en: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.

dag: Tinim mi pala bɛn tiri gbini bahi yoli; amaa ti nyɛla bɛn lee niŋ yɛda ka tiligi.
en: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li sɔɣi, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba bɛn daa nyɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu daa yi Kɛila maa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa naan tooi chaŋ. Ka Sool daa wum ni Dauda yi Kɛila maa zo, ka o chɛ o naba karibu.
en: So David and his men—about six hundred in all—left Keilah at once and kept on the move. When Saul heard that David had escaped from Keilah, he gave up his plan.

dag: ka tim a ba min a ma jilima; ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: Honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as you love yourself .

dag: ka bi tɛhi ni napɔŋ ni tooi no ŋ-ŋma li, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba ni tooi no li.
en: The ostrich forgets that someone might step on her eggs or that a wild animal might break them.

dag: Ka minya ni yi ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, dama yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Masia la zuɣu ka yi tumdi lala maa.
en: Remember that the Lord will give you as a reward what he has kept for his people. For Christ is the real Master you serve.

dag: Chɛ ka ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒeensi yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo mini karimbaannim bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ taba la fo.
en: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhir a, teemi n yɛla, ka lan ti ma kpiɔŋ yim kɔŋko pahi, yaa n Duuma Naawuni, ka m bɔhi Filistianim ŋɔ biɛri labisi n nina ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Samson prayed, Please remember me, Lord God. The Philistines poked out my eyes, but make me strong one last time, so I can take revenge for at least one of my eyes.

dag: Yawɛ, ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari hal ni bɔ saha? Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari maa hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: How much longer will the wicked be glad? How much longer, Lord ?.

dag: A ŋariŋduhiriba n-zaŋ a chaŋ teeku bulli ni. Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒe n-saɣim a teeku bulli maa ni.
en: and sailing across the sea, but you were wrecked by strong eastern winds.

dag: Ka Samsin daa zaŋ o nudirigu min o nuzaa n-gbaai sunsuuni daantalis ayi shɛŋa zuɣu duu maa ni tamya maa;.
en: So Samson took hold of the two middle columns holding up the building. Putting one hand on each column, he pushed against them.

dag: di simdi ni nir zaŋ o tapaɣa ti ka bɛ ŋme o, ka tu o.
en: Though beaten and insulted, we should accept it all.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni ka a sanna sagban tibisili puuni, dina n-ni chɛ ka niriba maa wum n ni tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa shɛm, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ niŋ a yɛda sahakam. Musa ni daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm zaa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: The Lord said to Moses, I will come to you in a thick cloud, so that the people will hear me speaking with you and will believe you from now on. Moses told the Lord what the people had answered.

dag: N dimnim zaa maani ma la ansarisi, ka n ʒiʒiinitab kaɣiri ma, ka n leei binzɔrigu bɛnkam mi ma sani; ka bɛnkam mi nya ma sol ni guurimi ka chɛri ma.
en: Im a joke to all my enemies, still worse to my neighbors. I scare my friends, and whoever sees me in the street runs away!.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yi ti kpe yi ni, yi ni nya yiko ka leei n shɛhiranima Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ tabili Judia mini Samaria tiŋgbana ni hal ti kpa dunia tarisi zaa.
en: Rather, you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili shee dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ su kom.
en: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa po pɔri n-lo Dauda alikauli, ka mi ku lan yi di nyaaŋa. A daa yɛliya, N ni ti zaŋ a bidibisi ni yino n-leei naa ʒil a nam ʒiishee.
en: You made a solemn promise to David— a promise you will not take back: I will make one of your sons king, and he will rule after you.

dag: O yɛliya, Maamiya yi ni ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun yuli du zuliya kam sani, ka nyɛ ŋun yuli du dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God says, Stop fighting and know that I am God! I am the one who defeats the nations; I am the one who controls the world.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka o ti miri kpibu. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Malim shili, dama a ku kpaŋ, a ni kpi. .
en: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. Isaiah the prophet went in and told him, The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, so you had better start doing what needs to be done.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: Yes, many people are invited. But only a few are chosen.

dag: Ninsalinim wurindi chɛribo kuɣa, ka lɛbiri zoya sɔŋda.
en: Humans thrust their hands into flint, pull up mountains from their roots.

dag: Bɔhimiya pumpɔŋɔ n-nya doo ni tooi dɔɣi bia? Ka bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka doo kam zaŋ o nuhi tab o saɣiŋga ni kaman paɣa n-wolisiri la? Bɔ n-niŋ ka sokam saɣim o ninni?.
en: Ask and see: Can men bear children? Then why do I see every man bent over in pain, as if hes in labor? Why have all turned pale?.

dag: Yi ni lo shɛli yi suhuri ni maa ku niŋ. Yi ni tɛhi shɛm nyɛla, chɛ ka ti gba be kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka jɛmdi dari mini kuɣa.
en: What is in your minds will never happen! Youve been saying, Lets be like the nations and the clans of the lands in the service of wood and stone.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bindiri viɛla dihiri ba. Izraɛl zoya zuɣu nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee. Nimaani ka bɛ ni ti do momah viɛla tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mo viɛla Izraɛl zoya zuɣu.
en: I will lead them to grassy fields. They will go to the place high on the mountains of Israel and lie down on good ground and eat the grass. They will eat in rich grassland on the mountains of Israel.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nya daliri jɛndi ma, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: But God finds excuses for attacking me and treats me like an enemy.

dag: Ka sokam deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri pin shɛŋa maa niriba zaa sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: Something from the Spirit can be seen in each person. The Spirit gives this to each one to help others.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Samsin zuɣu na pam, ka o zaŋ o nuzaŋa gbaai gbuɣinli maa n-darigi pirig o kaman nir ni darigiri pirigiri bubil shɛm la. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba bee o ma o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: But the Lord 's Spirit took control of Samson, and with his bare hands he tore the lion apart, as though it had been a young goat. His parents didn't know what he had done, and he didn't tell them.

dag: Yi tuuli yabidoo daa tum alahichi, ka yi yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisiriba tum alahichi n sani.
en: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim kuli. A napɔŋ yi ti kul zani tiŋ puuni, bia maa ni leei Naawuni dini.
en: As for you, get up and go back home. When your feet enter the town, the boy will die.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka bɛ baŋ o nasara dibu yɛla. O kahig o tiliginsim yiko wuhi zuliya kam.
en: The LORD has made his salvation widely known; he has revealed his righteousness in the eyes of all the nations.

dag: N ni kari toli ka chɛn ya, ka bɛ ku lan saɣim yi puri ni bindira, ka yi puri ni wain tihi ku lan kɔŋ wala walibu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will threaten the one who wants to devour you so that it doesnt spoil the fruit of your fertile land, and so that the vine doesnt abort its fruit in your field, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaɣ yino yi lu yaɣiri duɣu ni, binshɛɣukam din be di puuni leela daɣiri, ka di simdi ka yi ŋma li.
en: If any of these unclean animals dies and falls into a clay dish, anything in the dish will become unclean. And you must break the dish.

dag: Dama saha shɛli Dauda ni daa be Ɛdom la, ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm la daa chaŋ nimaani ni o ti sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Long before this, when David had conquered Edom, Joab the commander of his army had gone there to bury the dead. He and his men remained in Edom six months, and during that time they killed every male in Edom.

dag: Di saha ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu, ka bahi ba, ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So Hanun took Davids servants, shaved them, cut off half their garments from their buttocks down, and sent them off.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla Yisa Masia zuɣu m paɣiri Naawuni yi zaa zuɣu, dama yi yɛda niŋbu moli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a ti ti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri mini ti ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa ti nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa.
en: Moses said, No, we will take them all. In fact, you will give us offerings and sacrifices for us to use in worshiping the Lord our God.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Gɔg ŋun be Magɔg tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ polo tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o.
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce Gog, chief ruler of the nations of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Denounce him.

dag: Ka paɣa yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o paɣisarilim ni saha shɛl o ni be o ba yiŋa.
en: A young woman might still be living in her fathers house. And that young woman might make a special promise to give something to the Lord .

dag: Ka o ni ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: He will send his angels to gather his chosen ones from all over the earth.

dag: Ka anabi Ilaija daa sabi gbaŋ ti o na yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A bi dol a ba Jɛhɔshafat soli bee n-doli Juda Naa Asa naba.
en: A letter from the prophet Elijah came to Jehoram that read, This is what the LORD, the God of your ancestor David, says: Because you havent walked in the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or the ways of Judahs King Asa.

dag: N di yuya ni o be n sani n-zan a zaani n-sɔŋdi ma n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.

dag: Zomiya ti soli zuɣu, ka di guriya ti soli. Di lan tɔɣisiriya ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa yɛla.
en: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka o ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa bi niŋ m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa bi niŋ maa.
en: The king will say to them, Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ daa lo ba la alikauli n-yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa bee n-damdi di tooni bee n-jɛm li bee m-mal li.
en: The LORD had made a covenant with them, commanding them, Dont worship other gods. Dont bow down to them or serve them. Dont sacrifice to them.

dag: Miri ka a doli niriba maa ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa maa, a mi di zɔri bɛ ni zɔri shɛli dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, wummiya n ni wuhiri ya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ zaa, ka dol li din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni.
en: Now, Israel, listen to the laws and to the commands that I teach you. Obey them and you will live. Then you can go in and take the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

dag: Di saha ka Neetan daa bɔhi Sulemaana ma Batishiiba, A bi wum ni Hagit bia Adɔnija leei naa, ka ti dan Dauda ʒi di yɛla?.
en: Nathan said to Bathsheba, Solomons mother, Did you hear that Adonijah, Haggiths son, has become king, but our master David doesnt know about it?.

dag: Ti Duuma suhu yiɣisiya, ka o filim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga. O zaŋ Izraɛl jilima bahi, ka di yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na. O suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛli, o daa bi lan teeg o napɔntamdigu la yɛla.
en: Oh, no! In anger, my Lord put Daughter Zion under a cloud; he threw Israels glory from heaven down to earth. On that day of wrath, he didnt consider his own footstool.

dag: M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu nti be zoya zaa mini daboli kam zuɣu dari ginda. M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni, ka so kani ŋun ni lihi bo bɛ shee.
en: So my sheep wandered over the high hills and the mountains. They were scattered over the face of the earth, and no one looked for them or tried to find them.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yiɣisi lu Filistianim maa zuɣu n-ku ba hal ka o nuu ti ja ka o kɔŋ o takɔbi o nuu ni yihibu. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ di nasara pam dindali maa. Ka niriba maa daa labina ti dol o nyaaŋa yihir o ni daa ku shɛb maa bidibbina.
en: but he stood his ground and fought the Philistines until his hand was weary and stuck to the sword. But the LORD accomplished a great victory that day. The troops then returned to Eleazar, but only to plunder the dead.

dag: Amaa tinim n-ni paɣi Yawɛ pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: But us? We will bless the LORD from now until forever from now! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka tirisi tooni biɛla ha kaman nira ni ni tooi lab kuɣili paai shɛl tariga nti gbani tiŋa n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra.
en: Then he went off from them about the distance of a stone's throw and knelt down and prayed.

dag: Di takɔriti mini di zɔntua ni di abie tihi kɔtomsi daa bemi kaman dunɔdali din be wulimpuhili polo la dina ni daa be shɛm. Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini, ka di zɔŋ be di puuni.
en: Its windows, its porch, and its carvings of palm trees measured the same as the east gate. On the outside, there were seven steps leading up to the gate. Its porch was at the inside end of the gateway.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ ti.
en: All of our enemies speak angrily against us.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o jilima min o yiko nyɔhi kpe m-pali jɛmbu duu maa, ka so daa bi lan tooi kpe di ni hal ka malaikanima ayopɔin maa alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la tuma zaa ti naai.
en: The temple was filled with smoke from Gods glory and power, and no one could go into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven last angels were brought to an end.

dag: Hal malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil mini Sintani ni daa mali taba Anabi Musa niŋgbuŋ zuɣu la, o daa bi saɣi tu Sintani; o daa naɣ yɛlimi, Ti Duuma ni bɔh a.
en: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, The Lord will punish you.

dag: ka tiŋgbani daa bɔɣi, ka bɛ mini Kɔra zaa lu di ni ka buɣim di bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ kpi, ka tiŋgbani maa mum ba niŋ; ka di leei saɣisigu yɛlli ʒiɛya la.
en: That was the time when the earth opened and swallowed Korah and all of his followers. And men died! That was a warning to all the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni ti ni deei nam shɛli din ku tooi dam ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka chɛliya ka ti lan paɣi Naawuni ka zo o n-lu o sizuura ka jɛm o la jɛmbu shɛli din ni tiɣ o nini;.
en: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul no di luɣ shɛlikam di ni leei yi dini. Yi tintariga ni ti zanila Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban nɛl ni n-zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni hal ti paai Wulinluhili polo teeku la ni.
en: All the land you walk on will be yours. Your land will go from the desert in the south all the way to Lebanon in the north. It will go from the Euphrates River in the east all the way to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Zafɔn ti bɔhi Jɛfita, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka bi yɛl ti ka ti kana ti pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ? Ti ni niŋ buɣim nyo a yiŋa ka di di n-kab lu a zuɣu.
en: The Ephraimites were called up for battle and crossed over to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, Why did you cross over to fight the Ammonites and not call us to go with you? Were going to burn down your house over you.

dag: Lihimiya ŋarima gba: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ kara ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ ʒiɛri li n-chani la zaa yoli, dabihi shɛŋa din lo di nyoya ni n-nyɛ din ŋmaligiri li kpari ŋun duhiri li ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.

dag: Dama zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Izraɛlnim la mini Izraɛl nanim ni Juda nanim saha la zaa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-lan puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: This festival had not been celebrated in this way since the time that tribal leaders ruled Israel or the kings ruled Israel and Judah.

dag: Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba kalinli ni zooi gari Lɛvinim kalinli kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata la zuɣu.
en: Since the first-born Israelite sons outnumber the Levites by , you must buy back the extra sons.

dag: Ribɛka daa mali tizɔdoo ka o yuli booni Leeban. Ka Leeban daa guui yi n-chaŋ nachin kpɛm maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.
en: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.

dag: To, ninvuɣ so yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi chani gindi yɛra, N ni yihi ya waazu din wuhiri ni wain mini binnyuri kpɛma pam nyubu viɛla, ŋuna ka yi ni bɔri ni o nyɛ yi waazuyihira.
en: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, Drink and get drunk.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti labisi Ammɔnnim daazichi ti ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Ammonites will be taken away as captives. But the time will come when I will bring the Ammonites back. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ŋun baɣa ka Yawɛ tuma ni, noli ni di o, ka ŋun bi bɔri ni o zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba, noli ni di o.
en: Cursed is the one who is halfhearted in doing the LORDs work. Cursed is the one who restrains the sword from bloodshed.

dag: Di saha zaŋ chana, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lo nia ni o bahi Yisa, amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa kuhi yɛl o, A yi bahi doo ŋɔ a pala Naa Siiza sima, dama ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ leei naa lola Naa Siiza zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: When Pilate heard this, he tried to find a way to set Jesus free. But the crowd shouted back, If you set him free, that means that you are not the Emperor's friend! Anyone who claims to be a king is a rebel against the Emperor.

dag: Musa daa gulila o deemba Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana la biŋkɔbbaligu maa. Ka o daa ti zaŋ ba ti kpe tiŋgban nɛli ni n-gari chaŋ Naawuni zoli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini.
en: One day while Moses was taking care of the sheep and goats of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, he led the flock across the desert and came to Sinai, the holy mountain.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Ŋun nyɛ kasi ŋɔ baŋbu tahiri tɛhi zilima na.
en: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD; the knowledge of the holy one is understanding.

dag: Damli dambu zooya n-leei ninvuɣ biɛtali jaaŋgbee. Bɛ ni so ku kpalim, bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa mini bɛ daazichi ni bɛ jilima ku kpalim.
en: Violence produces more wickedness. Nothing of theirs will remain, nothing of their wealth, their splendor, or their glory.

dag: N ni zaŋ a leei Izraɛl naa, ka chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri tiŋgbani shɛm tariga zaa.
en: But I will accept you, and you will rule over all that you could desire. You will be king of Israel.

dag: Dama Sulemaana ŋarima daa yi zaŋdila Hiram tumtumdiba n-chani Tarishish. Ŋarima maa daa yi yiri Tarishish labirina yim yuma ata puuni bɛ ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka biŋkɔbigu la mini dunia nanima ni bɛ tɔbbihi laɣim lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ŋun ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa min o tɔbbihi.
en: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to fight against the one who was riding the horse and against his army.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka dunianim baŋ a soli, ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ a tiliginsim yiko yɛla.
en: so that the whole world may know your will; so that all nations may know your salvation.

dag: Yawɛ, n guhirila saha shɛli a ni yɛn tiligi ma.
en: I long for your victory, LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri, n mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, I assure you that anyone who has left house, brothers, sisters, mother, father, children, or farms because of me and because of the good news.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kul kuhiri boona, di chɛ ka n di vi. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri di vi; chɛ ka bɛ fo baalim n-chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: I call to you, Lord ; don't let me be disgraced. May the wicked be disgraced; may they go silently down to the world of the dead.

dag: Yi ni ŋmaligi yomyom ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun boli ya Masia daalibarika puuni, ka lan ŋmaligi n-doli lahibal sun shɛli din be di ko ka chɛ Masia lahibal suŋ la yɛla gari ma pam.
en: A short time ago God chose you to follow him. He chose you through his grace that came through Christ. But now I am amazed that you are already turning away and believing something different from the Good News we told you.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: The second row will be a turquoise, a sapphire, and a moonstone.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti sahi o takɔbi maa naai alizanda ni, o ni zaŋ li lu Ɛdomnim bɛn nyɛ o ni zali ni o ku shɛb la zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, This will happen when my sword in the sky is covered with blood. Look, the Lord s sword will cut through Edom. He judged them guilty, and they must die.

dag: Jɛrilim n-kul pali bia suhu ni, amaa tibidarigibo fiɛbiga n-kariti li bahiri katiŋa.
en: Folly is bound up in a childs heart; the rod of discipline removes it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi bi tum daɣiri tuma mini daɣiri ni ka shɛb suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi jɛmdi buɣa, ka mi bi doli yɔhiŋgu soli alikauli lɔbu ni.
en: Only the one with clean hands and a pure heart; the one who hasnt made false promises, the one who hasnt sworn dishonestly.

dag: ni Bɛnabinadab ŋun daa su Nafatido tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka daa kpuɣi Sulemaana bipuɣiŋga Tafat la.
en: Ben Abinadab was governor of Naphoth Dor. He was married to Taphath, daughter of Solomon.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kom leei ʒim, ka chɛ ka bɛ zahim kpi.
en: He turned their rivers into blood and killed all their fish.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so sunsuuni bɛ ni paɣibu kali dolibu zuɣu.
en: Some of Johns followers had an argument with another Jew about religious washing.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa kana ti dii ŋme Naa Hɛrɔd o ni daa bi tiri Naawuni jilima la zuɣu, ka zunzuya wɔɣ o ni ŋ-ŋub o ka o kpi.
en: Immediately an angel from the Lord struck Herod down, because he didnt give the honor to God. He was eaten by worms and died.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba ti shihi ma, ka di yi niŋ lala, di ni wuhi ni n mal o la ansarisi maa; ka di ni chɛ ka o yɛli noli ti ma ka pa ni o niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: If my father touches me and realizes I am trying to trick him, he will put a curse on me instead of giving me a blessing.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, dama so kani ŋun bi tumd alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ gbahi ba daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ katiŋa bee yoma.
en: When they sin against you, for there is no one who doesnt sin, and you become angry with them and hand them over to an enemy who takes them away as prisoners to enemy territory, whether distant or nearby.

dag: Di saha ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Firawuna, N teegi n galimi ni nyɛ shɛli zuŋɔ.
en: Then the chief wine steward spoke to Pharaoh: Today Ive just remembered my mistake.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa piligi tir o kpiɔŋ saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanɛdan din be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la.
en: Then, while Samson was staying at Dan's Camp between the towns of Zorah and Eshtaol, the Spirit of the Lord took control of him.

dag: O sɔɣimi doya gu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka chɛ ka niriba pam bi ʒe yim.
en: A bad woman waits for you like a thief, and she causes many men to be unfaithful to their wives.

dag: n-daa mali ti paai di ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Salamis n-kpɛri nimaani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni n-yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu tiri ba. Ka Jɔn Maak daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: When Barnabas and Saul came to the city of Salamis, they told the message of God in the Jewish synagogues. John Mark was with them to help.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihir shɛli Yisa ni daa wuhi pahi buyi, o ni daa yi Judia ka Galili na la.
en: This was the second miracle that Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.

dag: ka Buki nyɛ Abishua bia, ka Abishua nyɛ Finɛhas bia, ka Finɛhas nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza mi nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulana Aduna bia.
en: son of Abishua son of Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the chief priest.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Akishi daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Nyamiya, yi nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla yinyaa, ka yi zaŋ o kani n sanna?.
en: So Achish said to his officials, Look! The man is crazy! Why did you bring him to me?.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niriba maa lur a sizuura, ka gbib a zaligunim saha shɛlikam bɛ ni yɛn be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: Do this so that your people will fear and respect you all the time that they live in this land you gave to our ancestors.

dag: dama pagɔrili ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli, paɣ zinalan ŋmanila kɔbil muɣiliŋga.
en: Prostitutes and bad women are a trap. They are like a deep well that you cannot escape.

dag: n ku lan kari zuliya shɛb Jɔshua ni daa bi kari ka kpi la ti ba.
en: I in turn will no longer drive out before them any of the nations that Joshua left when he died.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ chamiya ti bom mɔri yi n-ni nya li luɣ shɛli na, amaa yi tuma bi yɛn filim hal biɛla gba. .
en: Go and find your own straw wherever you can, but you must still make as many bricks as before.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni di nyɛla yi fa m-bahi zuɣu ka n daa chɛ Kɔrinti kandina.
en: I call on God as my witness—I didnt come again to Corinth because I wanted to spare you.

dag: Nimaani ka sapashini maa daa nya Alikizandria ŋariŋ din chani Itali, ka o daa zaŋ ti kpɛhi di ni.
en: There the army captain found a ship from Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he ordered us to board that ship.

dag: Ti bɔri ni ti lan lab yi sanna. Hal man Pool maŋmaŋ kpaŋ mmaŋ gari yimyim bushɛm ni n kana, amaa ka Sintani kul guri ti soli.
en: We wanted to come to you—I, Paul, tried over and over again—and Satan stopped us.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Yaamiya yi noya ka n dihi ya.
en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt. Open your mouth, and I will feed you.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Din yɛn niŋ ma, dina n-yɛn niŋ jɛra; ka bɔzuɣu ka di lee simdi ni m mali yɛm pam? Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I thought to myself, What happens to fools is going to happen to me, too. So what have I gained from being so wise? Nothing, I answered, not a thing.

dag: Jɛra n-wuhiri bɛ suhuyiɣisili yomyom, amaa yɛnnim baɣa ka turi ni.
en: Fools are easily upset, but wise people avoid insulting others.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya ma bahi teeku ŋɔ ni ka teeku maa fo n-dɔni baalim, dama m mi ni n zuɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu ŋɔ ʒiɛri ya maa.
en: Jonah said to the men, I know I did wrong—that is why the storm came on the sea. So throw me into the sea, and the sea will become calm.

dag: Dama di dabisa maa ni mini di saha maa n yi ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lan tɔŋ.
en: At that time I, the Lord , will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.

dag: Ka bɛ mini so daa bi lan tuhi tɔbu hal ti paai Asa nam dibu maa yuun pihitanaanu saha.
en: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, yi ni ti wum kuŋa Zahim Dunɔdal la gbini, ka wum fabila yiya pala la ni, ka wum vuri pam daboya zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord , promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ .
en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a sacred pillar and where you made a solemn promise to me. Now, get up and leave this country and go back to the land of your relatives.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba! Di yi pa lala, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna nti zaŋ n nol ni takɔb la tuhi bɛn niŋdi lala maa tɔbu.
en: So change your hearts! If you dont change, I will come to you quickly and fight against these people with the sword that comes out of my mouth.

dag: A nyɛla Naawuni suŋ, ka tumdi din viɛla; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.

dag: N ni ti ŋme n-wurim o buɣa la zaa, ka nyo bɛ ni zaŋ laɣ shɛŋa zaa yo o samli buɣim, dama buɣa jɛmbu shee pagɔrisigu tuma puuni ka o daa nya li, ka o dimnim ni ti kana ti ŋme n-di di zaa chaŋ ti lan zaŋ li tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma.
en: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes.

dag: A yi yɛli niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ bɔh a, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ kara ŋɔ zaa jɛndi ti? Ti taali lee nyɛla dini? Alahichi bɔ ka ti lee tum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Jeremiah, you will tell the people of Judah these things, and the people will ask you, Why has the Lord said these terrible things to us? What have we done wrong? What sin have we done against the Lord our God.

dag: A mini Judanim ni Izraɛlnim daa niŋdila daabiligu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi alikama din yi Minnɛt na mini za ni shiri ni kpam ni ti shɛli din niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ka di bi poori la na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: Judah and Israel gave you their finest wheat, fancy figs, honey, olive oil, and spices in exchange for your merchandise.

dag: Teemi ni n saha bi waɣa; dama a nam ninsalinim zaa ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpira.
en: Remember how short my life is! Have you created humans for no good reason?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti suui li zali, o yɛrimi, Yawɛ labimi Izraɛlnim tuhituhi zuɣa ŋɔ sanna.
en: And whenever it stopped, he would say, Return, Lord , to the thousands of families of Israel.

dag: Yi yi tuɣi ma ka n yɛligu be yi suhuri ni, ka yi suhi yi ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa, yi ni nya li.
en: Stay joined together with me, and follow my teachings. If you do this, you can ask for anything you want, and it will be given to you.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya ma ka boli ma, ka n garigi yɛl o, N-nyɛ ma.
en: He turned around and saw me, then he called to me. Yes, sir, I answered.

dag: N yɛliya, Timiya ma pini? Bee Piimiya yi buni shɛli m-pa talima ti ma?.
en: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift.

dag: A daalikauli nyɛla din tiri ma nyɛvili; dina n-nyɛ n suhu kpaŋsibo n wahala dibu puuni.
en: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi maligumaani zuɣulaantali tuma Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din be tanti jɛmbu du maŋli la ni, ka di nyɛ ti Duuma ni zali shɛli, ka pa ni ninsal ni zali shɛl la.
en: Our high priest serves in the Most Holy Place. He serves in the true place of worship that was made by God, not by anyone here on earth.

dag: N dimnim kul karitimi doli ma. Bɛ loya ni bɛ di n nyɛvili. Bɛ chɛ ka n ʒila zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: My enemies have hunted me down and completely defeated me. They have put me in a dark prison, and I am like those who died long ago.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi niŋ ania din ni chɛ ka yi tum Naawuni yubu, ka nya o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la palibu.
en: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.

dag: Dama yi yi bi pal alikauli zaŋ chaŋ laɣ yoya ŋɔ polo, ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi zaŋ azichi maŋli niŋ yi nuu ni?.
en: If you cannot be trusted with this wicked wealth, who will trust you with true wealth?.

dag: Jɔnatan tɔbu daa ʒi n-lab kuli ka pa ni o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ʒim mini kpiɔŋlaannim kpam n-varim li. Ka Sool mi takɔbi na ʒi n-chɛ n-ziŋ.
en: Jonathans bow killed its share of enemies, and Sauls sword killed its share! They have spilled the blood of men now dead. They cut into the fat of strong men.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o yɛli.
en: Her children bless her; her husband praises her.

dag: Amaa ka yi ti malila suhupiɛlli ka puhiri chuɣu, ka kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri ŋ-ŋubiri bɛ nimdi ka nyuri wain ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti di ka nyu, dama biɛɣuni ti sa ni kpi.
en: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ sarika ni daba ata.
en: Joseph kept them all under guard for three days.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa n-chɛ ka n yiɣisi zani m ba Dauda zaani n-ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord has done what he promised. I am the king of Israel like my father, and I've built a temple for the Lord our God.

dag: A dimnim bela a jɛmbu duu maa luɣ kasi shee la n-tahiri nasara dibu tahigu; ka zaŋ bɛ tuutanim sa nimaani.
en: The enemy shouted their war cries in the Temple. They put up their flags there to show they had won the war.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛli kumsi, ka nyɛhi nintam a ninni, dama a tuma mali laara. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni labina.
en: But the Lord says, Stop crying. Dont fill your eyes with tears. You will be rewarded for your work. This message is from the Lord . The people of Israel will come back from their enemys land.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam bɛ zaa suhuri, ka mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: God is the one who made all their hearts, the one who knows everything they do.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Kul suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tim ti, ka o fa ti Filistianim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: and said to Samuel, Keep praying to the Lord our God to save us from the Philistines.

dag: n yi niŋ ŋun ka ma taali zaɣ biɛɣu bee n yi niŋ n dima zaɣ biɛɣu ka di ka soli.
en: I have done nothing to hurt a friend or to help his enemies.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ suhukpeennim dolila soya kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, ka sandaantimdiba kuhiri pampam.
en: But then those in Ariel cried out in the streets; messengers of peace wept bitterly.

dag: N yɛr a mi, Yiɣisim zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti sɔɣ dɔni gili Gibia.
en: Then the army of Israel hid some men all around the city of Gibeah.

dag: Ka o yi yɛn zaŋla piɛɣu na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋmi piɛnyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli na.
en: If you offer a sheep as a purification offering, it must be a flawless female.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli soli be katiŋa ka chɛ ti, ka din tuhi mi ku tooi miri ti. Yɛlimaŋli tuui niriba laɣiŋgu shee soli zuɣu, ka biɛhigu din tuhi kɔŋ kpɛhili shee nimaani.
en: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa bidibisi mi daa su tulaalɛnim maa zaŋ gari tab tuma fukumsi.
en: But only the priests could mix the spices.

dag: ka gbihiri yuŋ kam, ka yiɣisiri asiba kam, ka bimbira maa mali hal nti bilina zooi, ka o bi mi din chɛ ka di niŋ lala maa.
en: then sleeps and wakes night and day. The seed sprouts and grows, but the farmer doesnt know how.

dag: Ka bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ gbib niriba ŋɔ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: so give me the wisdom and knowledge I need to rule over them. Otherwise, how would I ever be able to rule this great people of yours.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o ŋmaligi yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ti zo Lazarɔs gbihirimi, amaa n chanimi ni n ti neeg o o gom maa ni.
en: He continued, Our friend Lazarus is sleeping, but I am going in order to wake him up.

dag: ka bɛ zaŋ Anabi Aizaia litaafi ti o, ka o kpabigi li bo n-nya luɣ shɛli din daa sab yɛli.
en: and was handed the book of the prophet Isaiah. He unrolled the scroll and found the place where it is written.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa paligi Sulemaana ni suhi binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord was happy that Solomon asked for wisdom.

dag: Ti mali yɛla pam ni ti yɛli ya zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo ka di mi kahigibu to, dama yi nyɛla suhutunanima.
en: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.

dag: Napɔŋ buta ka n kani yi sanna pahiri ŋɔ. So taali nyabu kam ni, di simdi ni niriba ayi bee ata n-di shɛhira.
en: This is now the third time that I am coming to visit you. Any accusation must be upheld by the evidence of two or more witnesses—as the scripture says.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ daŋ shɛli niriba fali tarili n-tom ti daŋ shɛli niriba; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba vili gbibila bɛmaŋmaŋ fali tarili.
en: So the land must not be passed from tribe to tribe among the Israelites. Each Israelite will keep the land that belonged to their own ancestors.

dag: Ka n nya ka vuhim daa yi Naawuni sanna nti kpe bɛ ni di daba ata ni pirigili maa dali ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi zani, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi bɛnkam nya ba.
en: After three and a half days a life-giving breath came from God and entered them, and they stood up; and all who saw them were terrified.

dag: amaa ka bɛn daa mali yɛm la bɛn daa ʒi kpam pahi bɛ firilanim zuɣu.
en: The wise girls took their lamps and more oil in jars.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Zarɛfat din be Sidɔn tiŋgban ni la nti be ni. Nyama, n yɛli pako so ŋun be nimaani ni o tim a bindirigu.
en: Get up and go to Zarephath near Sidon and stay there. I have ordered a widow there to take care of you.

dag: Doo ŋɔ daa bɔhim ti Duuma soli yɛla pam. O ni daa jɛmdi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisiri ka wuhiri Yisa yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa kulla Jɔn Baptaizira kom baptaizibu la yɛla kɔŋko ka o daa mi.
en: He had been taught about the Lord and was always excited to talk to people about Jesus. What he taught was right, but the only baptism he knew about was the baptism that John taught.

dag: Dama Dauda mini Asaf saha la kurimbuni maa ni ha, yiliyiiniba toondana daa beni, ka wumpaɣibo mini Naawuni puhigu yila daa beni.
en: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa nya bɛ ni tum ma taali shɛm, karimi n yɛla maa saria.
en: LORD, look at my mistreatment; judge my cause.

dag: Naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa filim Judanim maa, dama o daa bi gbibi Judanim viɛnyɛla, ka daa bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim.
en: Because King Ahaz of Judah had violated the rights of his people and had defied the Lord , the Lord brought troubles on Judah.

dag: nti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo piɛɣu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o mali alahichi sanyoo sara luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la.
en: You shall put your hand on its head and kill it on the north side of the altar, where the animals for the burnt offerings are killed.

dag: Anzinfa mini salima palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daazichi ka tariga. Yuri palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ka tariga.
en: Their land is full of silver and gold, and there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses, and there is no end to their chariots.

dag: Yi nini na bi nya o, amaa ka yi kul yur o; ka hal yi nini ni na kul bi nya o maa zaa yoli, yi niŋ o yɛda ka kul mali suhupiɛl shɛli din galisi hal ka so ku tooi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa kahigi li wuhi gba.
en: Although youve never seen him, you love him. Even though you dont see him now, you trust him and so rejoice with a glorious joy that is too much for words.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din bi tuhi ni yi nahim niriba.
en: Just look at those lawmakers who write evil laws and make life hard for the people.

dag: Chamiya ti kum niŋ yi ni pii buɣ shɛŋa jɛmdi maa, ka bɛ fan ya bahi yi muɣisigu ŋɔ saha.
en: You like worshiping those gods, so go call to them for help. Let them save you when you are in trouble.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banima, di yihiri ya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka di ti chɛ ka bɛ suhuri miligi, amaa zaŋmiyala saɣisigu din nyɛ ti Duuma dini wumsiri ba.
en: Parents, do not treat your children in such a way as to make them angry. Instead, raise them with Christian discipline and instruction.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn kalinli pɔri ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama di nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni o tin ya nam.
en: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the Kingdom.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Shɛbuɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma.
en: The leader among Gershom's sons was Shebuel.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa su tɔbbi shɛb kalinli nyɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisita ni tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi sɔŋ naa ka o tuhi o dimnima.
en: These family leaders were in charge of an army of , men who fought with great power. These soldiers helped the king against the enemy.

dag: Amaa ka ti yaannim ni daa ku Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sul la zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Kalidia nir la daa kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba; ka wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka gbahi niriba maa n-ʒi ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa na bi chaŋ alizanda ni, amaa ka daa yɛli: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: David was not the one who was lifted up to heaven. David himself said, The Lord God said to my Lord: Sit at my right side.

dag: N je tuumbiɛtumdiba; ka m mi bi ʒiini ninvuɣ biɛri sani.
en: I hate the company of the evil and avoid the wicked.

dag: Piɛbimiya gbɛri Gibia tiŋ puuni, ka piɛbiya kikahi Rama tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛmiya tɔb chiriga Bɛtavɛn tiŋ puuni. Bɛnjamin zuliya, lumiya abirima.
en: Blow the war trumpets in Gibeah! Sound the alarm in Ramah! Raise the war cry at Bethaven! Into battle, men of Benjamin!.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu Jɛrusalɛm n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu biŋkɔbiri gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: King Josiah celebrated the Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem. The Passover lamb was killed on the th day of the first month.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka di pala mani n-tim ba la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Amaa tɔbu mini kum ni ku anabinim maa.
en: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali, bomiya yuma ayi piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi, ka bo zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam ŋmiri li m-pahi binnyura sara zuɣu.
en: On the Sabbath day offer two one-year-old male lambs without any defects, pounds of flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering, and the wine offering.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ teeku nol ni, ka salo pam yi Galili dol o; ka shɛb mi daa yi Judia.
en: Jesus led his disciples down to the shore of the lake. Large crowds followed him from Galilee, Judea.

dag: ka yi ti bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman zoma ni bɔbindi gindi zibisim ni shɛm la, amaa ka ku nya soli ka bɛ naɣ ti kul filindi ya mi, ka fari yi nɛma waawaayili, ka so ku beni ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: In daylight you will have to feel your way like a blind man. You will fail in everything you do. Again and again people will hurt you and steal from you. And there will be no one to save you.

dag: Bɛ zuliya ni mali kpiɔŋ bɛ tiŋgban ni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun be tibi zuliya ni mali alibarika.
en: Their descendants will be given power on earth. Those who do right will be greatly blessed.

dag: Amaa di yɛtɔɣa chaŋ gili dunia ŋɔ zaa, ka dunia ŋɔ yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di tarisi zaa palila di yɛtɔɣa. Ka o ti suɣili zuɣusaa ti wuntaŋa;.
en: yet their message goes out to all the world and is heard to the ends of the earth. God made a home in the sky for the sun;.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, ka o ti tin ya vuhim yi dimnim bɛn gili ya la zaa sani, ka chɛ ka yi be ni alaafee.
en: But you are about to cross the Jordan River and will settle in the land the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance. Then he will give you rest from all your enemies on every side so that you live safely and securely.

dag: Ka baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni la ni ti nyɛlisira, ka ne kaman sagban piɛla la. Ka bɛn mi nyɛ bɛn daa wuhi niriba pam din tuhi la ti ne kaman saŋmarisi la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Those skilled in wisdom will shine like the sky. Those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and always.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mali biɛhiŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni diri shɛli polo ka diri li mali taali o ni niŋdi shɛli maa ni bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na zuɣu, dama binshɛɣukam din bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na nyɛla alahichi.
en: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.

dag: Zaŋm ma mali kuli, chɛ ka ti niŋ yomyom. Naa zaŋ ma kpe o duu. Ti ni di dari ka mali suhupiɛlli a zuɣu; ti ni paɣ a yurilim maa gari wain; dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yur a maa.
en: Take me along with you; lets run! My king has brought me into his chambers, saying, Lets exult and rejoice in you. Lets savor your loving more than wine. No wonder they all love you.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bol o kpambaliba na nti zaŋ yɛla maa zaa yɛli ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam.
en: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.

dag: Dama yi kpimi ka yi nyɛviya pahi Masia zuɣu n-sɔɣi Naawuni ni.
en: You died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm ti o maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana ni.
en: Davids sons who were born in Jerusalem are Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa niŋla Bɛtani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn ni daa baptaiziri niriba kom ni la.
en: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany.

dag: N kpalimla kɔba noli, biɛla n-chɛ n naan kpi.
en: My bones cling to my skin and flesh; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

dag: Dama o daa yɛl o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shih o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She thought, If I only touch his robe Ill be healed.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn luri n yuli sizuura ŋɔ, n tiliginsim yiko din be kaman wuntaŋ neesim la ni nyee kpɛn ya, ka tahi tibbu na ti tin ya. Yi ni ti yiɣiri jamdi kaman naɣibihi pola n-yi naɣiluu ni na la.
en: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa ŋmanila buɣim diri zoli maa zuɣu Izraɛlnim sani.
en: Moses did so and stayed there days and nights. To the people, the Lord 's glory looked like a blazing fire on top of the mountain.

dag: dama yi daazichi ni be shɛli, nimaani ka yi suhuri gba ni be.
en: For your heart will always be where your riches are.

dag: A yi ŋmaligi labi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, o ni labis a zali a zaashe kurili ni. A yi yihi ninvuɣ biɛtali zaa a yiŋa.
en: Yes, you must humbly return to God and put an end to all the evil that is done in your house.

dag: A tihi ŋmanila pumpɔrinchihi tihi puu din wandi wal suma din nyɛ hɛnna mini naad.
en: Your limbs are an orchard of pomegranates with all kinds of luscious fruit, henna, and spices.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N zabirila nyuli tiri nyin ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama Izraɛlnim yi a mini ba daalikauli la nyaaŋa, ka daag a sara maligu bimbina luhi, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku a daanabinim zaa, ka n kɔŋko nti kpalim, ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku man gba.
en: Elijah answered, Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka o saɣim pam. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa dolila so yini.
en: Just like her sister, she did vulgar things.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni lu yi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi nyɛ yi daba la ŋmaligi nyaŋ ya. Ka lala yi niŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: Watch and see how I will punish them: Their own slaves will become their masters and take all their wealth. Then you will know it was the Lord All-Powerful who sent me to tell you these things.

dag: Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa kunila luɣ yini, taŋkpaɣu ni ka bɛ yina, ka bɛ zaa lan yɛn labila taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.

dag: n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ paag a maa. A ni tum pagɔrisigu tuma ni zuliya shɛba, ka jɛm bɛ buɣa saɣim amaŋa la zuɣu.
en: have led to this. You were the one determined to have sex with men from other nations and to worship their idols.

dag: Ka sokam daa nya o ni chani ka paɣiri Naawuni maa.
en: All the people recognized him. They knew he was the crippled man who always sat by the Beautiful Gate to beg for money. Now they saw this same man walking and praising God. They were amazed. They did not understand how this could happen.

dag: Zoya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la? Daboya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la?.
en: You mountains, why did you skip like goats? You hills, why did you jump around like lambs?.

dag: Yɛlim Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Sulemaana bia ka nyɛ Juda naa la mini Juda zuliya niriba ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba zaa ni man Yawɛ yɛliya.
en: Tell Judahs King Rehoboam, Solomons son, and all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka n ni baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma. Dina n-nyɛ: a bi chɛ ka n dimnim nyaŋ ma.
en: Then Ill know you are pleased with me because my enemy wont be shouting in triumph over me.

dag: Man karimba ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa m-be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: I, the Philosopher, have been king over Israel in Jerusalem.

dag: dama n sani, di bi tuhi ni n chɛ ka bɛ tahi dansarika so Naa Siiza sani ka m bi sabi wuhi o taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: For it seems unreasonable to me to send a prisoner without clearly indicating the charges against him.

dag: Hal di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni m birigiya, m biriginsim maa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: Have I really gone astray? If so, my error remains hidden inside me.

dag: Di pala yi kalinli n-daa zooi gari zuliya shɛb zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu gbaai ya ka o pii ya maa, dama yinima n-daa pɔri gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: It was not because you were greater than all other people that the LORD loved you and chose you. In fact, you were the smallest of peoples!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka maligumaani so doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ gari ka chɛ o.
en: It happened that a Jewish priest was going down that road. When he saw the man, he did not stop to help him. He walked away.

dag: Hal bɛ daa yi zaŋ anchitinima bee situra din shihi ŋun Pool nti pa barinim zuɣu bɛ nyarila alaafee, ka alizin biɛri gba daa zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: Even handkerchiefs and aprons he had used were taken to the sick, and their diseases were driven away, and the evil spirits would go out of them.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di puhibu saha.
en: to say to the people, Celebrate Passover.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi ni ŋun mal liɣiri kolibila, ŋun kpuɣim li; lala n-nyɛ ŋun mal adiiku gba. Ka ŋun mi ka takɔbi, ŋun zaŋm o binyɛrigu kɔhi da li.
en: But now, Jesus said, whoever has a purse or a bag must take it; and whoever does not have a sword must sell his coat and buy one.

dag: Luk ŋun nyɛ dɔɣite so ti ni yuri la mini Diimas gba puhiri ya.
en: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.

dag: Nɛbo daŋ ni: Jɛiɛl mini Matitia ni Zabad so yaha ni Zɛbina ni Jadai ni Joɛl ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Clan of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.

dag: Amaa nyamiya, m mini ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa n-laɣim ʒi teebuli gbini diri ŋɔ.
en: The one who will betray me is here at the table with me!.

dag: Sɛt ni daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni ayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and then lived another years. He had other children.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, m be a sani. Mani n nyɛ a Naawuni. Kul di zɔri dabiɛm! N ni ti a kpiɔŋ ka sɔŋ a, n ni tilig a ka gul a, ka chɛ ka a di nasara.
en: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.

dag: Yi ni daa bi jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni suhupiɛlli yi ni mali binshɛɣukam pam la zuɣu.
en: The Lord blessed you in every way, but you would not serve him with glad and joyful hearts.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suɣilo tumdi din tuhi ka bɔri jilima mini paɣibu ni niŋgbuŋ din ku pooi la, Naawuni ni ti ti ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu;.
en: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.

dag: Yinim Filistianim zaa, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya pam. Yi tiŋ mini di dunoya kuhima! Dama taŋkpagbiligu ni yi nuzaa polo na, di nyɛla tɔbbihi bɛn kanna ka dabiɛmlana ka bɛ ni.
en: People near the city gates, cry! People in the city, cry out! Everyone in Philistia, your courage will melt like hot wax. Look to the north! There is a cloud of dust. An army is coming, and everyone in that army is strong.

dag: Tin shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari dunia zaa lu n-dahim. Babilɔn leela tin shɛli din yɛla mali zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: Babylonia was a hammer pounding every country, but now it lies broken. What a shock to the nations of the world!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni pam, dama lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn tuhi yi dimnim shɛb zaa.
en: Then Joshua said to them, Dont be afraid or terrified. Be brave and strong, because this is how the LORD will deal with all the enemies you fight.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla Mɛmfisinim mini Tapanhɛsinim ŋme ŋ-ŋma yi zuɣuŋmana.
en: As well, the people of Memphis and Tahpanhes lay open your scalp.

dag: Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, a kul yoli piligimi n-wuhir a dabili a galisim min a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, wuni ŋuni n-lee be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani zuɣu n-ni tooi tum yiko tuma mini tuun kar shɛŋa a ni tum ŋɔ?.
en: Lord GOD, I am your servant. I know that you have shown me only a small part of the wonderful and powerful things you will do. There is no god in heaven or earth that can do the great and powerful things you have done.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lan niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm la; bɛ daa suhi Ijiptinim maa anzinfa mini salima yɛri ni situra.
en: The Israelites did as Moses had told them and asked the Egyptians for their silver and gold jewelry as well as their clothing.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna sani n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: So Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD.

dag: nti nya zaɣ yini din mali shaara pam, ka chaŋ nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da li.
en: One day he found a very fine pearl. He went and sold everything he had to buy it.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tuɣili tulaale zim din bi be kasi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu. Yi mi di zaŋya biŋkɔbigu nyo buɣim bee n-zaŋ bindir kuma mali sara di zuɣu bee m-booi wain bahi di zuɣu.
en: Dont offer the wrong incense on the altar or an entirely burned offering or a grain offering. Dont pour a drink offering on it.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lo ti alikauli shɛl la zuɣu, tinim kul guhirila zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ pala, ka wuntitali be di ni la.
en: But according to his promise we are waiting for a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness is at home.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la mini ŋun maŋmaŋ ni mali pin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima binyɛra la zaa nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: He brought into Gods temple the various silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated.

dag: M puhiri Mariama ŋun tum tuma pam yi ni la.
en: Greetings also to Mary. She worked very hard for you.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa fiɛbi Midiannim Orɛb tampiŋ gbini shɛm la. N ni ti kpuɣi n fiɛbiga maa teeku kom puuni n-fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la.
en: Then the Lord All-Powerful will beat Assyria with a whip, just as he defeated Midian at Raven Rock. He will punish his enemies, as he did when he raised his stick over the sea and led his people from Egypt.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi ti deei piɛɣu maa yi nuu ni n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: The priest will then take the basket from you and place it before the LORD your Gods altar.

dag: Ka a pii Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ba ti Aduna min o bidibisi, ka bɛ nyɛ o ni su shɛb fukumsi zaa.
en: They are assigned to help Aaron and his sons.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o Bia maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: A nyɛla Naawuni, a nam ʒiishee kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Wuntia jaaŋgbee n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni a nam fukumsi tam la wuntia zuɣu.
en: But he says to his Son, God, your throne is forever and your kingdoms scepter is a rod of justice. .

dag: Bɛ ni tooi dɔɣi nabia ka o nyɛla faralana, amaa o ni tooi yi sarika ni na ti di nam.
en: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni zuɣulaannim daa bi mi n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n ni niŋ shɛli. N daa na bi yɛli Yɛhudianim mini maligumaaniba ni kpamba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yɛn tum tuma maa ni so shɛli.
