en: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali bans anahi tam daanya kurupooti maa naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu din yɛn gbibi di dapuhi.
en: He made four carrying rings and put them on the four corners.

dag: O ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana ni o ti tuhi Naa Dauda soli maa, ka naa bɔh o, Mɛfibɔshɛt, bɔzuɣu ka a daa bi doli ma chaŋ.
en: When Mephibosheth arrived from Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, Mephibosheth, you didn't go with me. Why not.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni n-zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpira n-nyo wurigu mi.
en: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa zali ni bɛ malim adaka zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali gbini.
en: The king ordered the Levites to make a box for contributions and to place it at the Temple gate.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku piɛguliba mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku pukpariba mini bɛ naɣikɔra. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku gomnanim mini bɛ wulaannima.
en: With you I will crush shepherds and flocks. With you I will crush farmers and oxen. With you I will crush governors and officials.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa, n chaŋ Yawɛ timsim maa, n gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag na ka ku Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: I did obey the Lord , Saul replied. I went out as he told me to, brought back King Agag, and killed all the Amalekites.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini buɣa sunsuuni? Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ jɛmbu duu kaman ŋun Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm la: N ni be bɛ ni, ka chani gindi bɛ sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: Gods temple cannot have anything to do with idols, and we are the temple of the living God. As God said, I will live with them and walk with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people. Leviticus :-.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kɔral bee kirisital la buɣisi li. Yɛm liɣiri gari yɛri liɣiri.
en: It is far more valuable than coral and jasper, more precious than rubies.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Tapua ni Rɛkɛm ni Shɛma.
en: Hebrons sons were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla leeŋa, ka nyɛ mahim din taɣiri ba tulim wuntaŋ ni ni sɔɣibu shee ni leeŋa din taɣiri ba pɔhim mini saa.
en: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.

dag: ka lan yɛl o, Ka din pahi nyɛla, a dabili Yaakubu doli ti nyaaŋa na. Dama Yaakubu daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini ŋɔ daŋ n tooni ti ti o, n ni maag o suhu, ka di nyaaŋa m min o nini yi ti nya taba, di pa shɛli o ni deei ma.
en: And Jacob told them to be sure to say that he was right behind them. Jacob hoped the gifts would make Esau friendly, so Esau would be glad to see him when they met.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam mini alaka balibu kam din yɛla bi sabi zaligu kundi ŋɔ ni lu yi zuɣu hal ti naai yi balibu.
en: He will also send all kinds of diseases and epidemics that are not mentioned in this book of God's laws and teachings, and you will be destroyed.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yuŋ ŋɔ yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, Tonight you will all fall away because of me. This is because it is written, I will hit the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will go off in all directions .

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa lee bi baŋ o, ka daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm. Lala ka Daadam bia gba yɛn di wahala bɛ nuu ni.
en: But I tell you, Elijah has already come. People did not know who he was, and they treated him badly, doing whatever they wanted to do. It is the same with the Son of Man. Those same people will make the Son of Man suffer.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.

dag: Ka ti lan mi ni Naawuni Bia daa kana nti ti ti la baŋsim ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli; ka ti nyɛla bɛn be Naawuni maŋli ni o Bia Yisa Masia puuni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli, ka lan nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we know the true God. We live in union with the true God—in union with his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and this is eternal life.

dag: A mi Naawuni ni zali ba o zaligu shɛm n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisir o sagbana ni ŋɔ?.
en: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Saamba sani. O ni daa yɛli ni saamba sani maa, ka Yisa yɛli, Ka dindina tiŋbihi bɛn nuu kani.
en: From strangers, he said. Jesus said to him, Then the children dont have to pay.

dag: Alɔbɔnima n-doli taba, tiŋgbani maa zaa bahila yoli. Yim ka bɛ daa ti dii saɣim n suɣa, ka chahi m pateesanima.
en: Disaster follows disaster. The whole country is destroyed. Suddenly my tents are destroyed. My curtains are torn down!.

dag: ka Uzi nyɛ Zɛrahia ba, ka Zɛrahia nyɛ Mɛrayɔt ba.
en: Zerahiah, Meraioth.

dag: Tuumba maa ni daa ti paai Gibia din nyɛ Sool ya la nti yɛli yɛlli maa ka di lu niriba tiba ni, bɛ daa dii duhila kuŋa n-kuhiri pampam.
en: The messengers came to Gibeah where Saul lived. They told the news to the people. The people cried loudly.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣim bɛmaŋa paɣiba bɔbu ni la; bɛn ʒi paɣiba n-nyɛ ba. Ka Piɛbil maa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam bɛ min o dolila taba, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui tiligi ninvuɣ shɛba n-ti Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa.
en: These are the ones who did not do sinful things with women. They kept themselves pure. Now they follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were bought from among the people of the earth as the first to be offered to God and the Lamb.

dag: Di dabisa maa saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka wuntizɔr so yi Dauda zuliya ni na, ŋuna n-ni ti doli zaligu mini wuntia soli n-su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.

dag: Ka yi yi lihi zuɣusaa nya wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni zuɣusaa binyara zaa, yin miriya ka yi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li ka di chɛ ka yi birigi. Di nyɛla binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Do not be tempted to worship and serve what you see in the sky—the sun, the moon, and the stars. The Lord your God has given these to all other peoples for them to worship.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn pun niŋ yɛda la paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani. Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani. Naawuni daa yɛli dimbɔŋɔ la hal saha shɛl o ni daa pun nam dunia naai la nyaaŋa;.
en: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, God became angry and told the people, You will never enter my place of rest! God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim puuni zana m-beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiinila yila, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Evil people are trapped in their own sins, while honest people are happy and free.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mi ni bɛ yi lab me tiŋ maa ka me di goma maa gba naai, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni a ku lan tooi su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili maa nima.
en: We tell the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will then have no possession in the province Beyond the River.

dag: amaa di zaa yoli, o kul tumdi tuun suma din wuhiri ni o beni. O tiri ya saa ka di chɛ ka yi bindira niŋdi ka yi diri tiɣiri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But God was always there doing the good things that prove he is real. He gives you rain from heaven and good harvests at the right times. He gives you plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy.

dag: ni zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbihi ni sariakaritiba ni anabinima ni baɣisi ni kpamba.
en: their heroes and their soldiers, their judges and their prophets, their fortunetellers and their statesmen.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri, ka bɛ jilima zaa ŋmanila mɔpuma. Mɔri kpira, ka di puma kpahiri lura.
en: Thus, All human life on the earth is like grass, and all human glory is like a flower in a field. The grass dries up and its flower falls off, .

dag: Piimiya sariakaritiba mini tuma kpamba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa tin ya maa zaa ni kaman yi daŋdaŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ ti doli zaligu soli maani niriba yɛla.
en: Appoint judges and other officials in every town that the Lord your God gives you. These men are to judge the people impartially.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni; o saria karibu be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: The LORD—he is our God. His justice is everywhere throughout the whole world.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli naa, Cham ti niŋ a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛm, Yawɛ ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Nathan said to the king, Go ahead and do whatever you are thinking, because the LORD is with you.

dag: ka kula ŋun tiri nyɛvili; amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni. Tinima n-nyɛ di shɛhiranima.
en: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛhab daa ti yɛli Nabɔt, Zaŋm a puu ŋɔ ti ma ka n zaŋ niŋ n ʒiɛvari puu, dama di miri n yiŋa; ka n ti a pu shɛli din viɛli gari dimbɔŋɔ bee a yi bɔra, n ni yo a di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Ahab ordered Naboth, Give me your vineyard so it can become my vegetable garden, because it is right next to my palace. In exchange for it, Ill give you an even better vineyard. Or if you prefer, Ill pay you the price in silver.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu paai Gazanima, ka Ashikɛlɔnnim fo. Yinim Anaki zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ binyara zaŋ ŋmahiri yimaŋa?.
en: The Anakim who survive in Gaza and Ashkelon will mourn for you by shaving their heads and sitting in silence.

dag: Teemiya n ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la, Ye dabili bi gar o duuma. Bɛ yi daa niŋ ma wahala, lala ka bɛ ni niŋ yi gba wahala; bɛ mi yi daa deei n noli, bɛ ni deei yi gba dini.
en: Remember what I told you: Slaves are not greater than their master. If people persecuted me, they will persecute you too; if they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours too.

dag: Bɛ daa teeri ni Naawuni n-nyɛ bɛ Tampiŋ Kpiɔŋ ŋun tiligiri ba, ka lan teeri ni Zallakudura Naa n-nyɛ ŋun fari ba bahira.
en: They would remember that God was their Rock. They would remember that God Most High had saved them.

dag: Yi ni ti laɣim niriba maa, dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bibihi zaŋ tabili saamba bɛn be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti wum li, ka bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka gbaai bɛmaŋa n-doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Gather everyone—men, women, children, and the immigrants who live in your cities—in order that they hear it, learn it, and revere the LORD your God, carefully doing all the words of this Instruction.

dag: Baansi maa mi, Hɛman mini Asaf ni Ɛtan n-daa nyɛ bɛn ŋmɛri daanya guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa la.
en: The singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan played bronze cymbals.

dag: ka tɔɣisiri binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: They were talking about everything that had happened.

dag: Ka Sool daa chɛ Dauda kari doli ka lab kuli ni o ti tuhi Filistianim maa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani zo n-tiligi tampiŋ.
en: So Saul stopped pursuing David and went to fight the Philistines. That is why that place is called Separation Hill.

dag: Din pahi, o daa lan me fɔntinsi zali Juda zoya ni, ka daa lan me yiya mini du wɔɣila n-zali yɔɣu puuni, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: He built towns in Judahs highlands and fortresses and towers in the wooded areas.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Anabi Aizaia ni daa pun yɛli yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli kaman di ni daa sab shɛm ni Naawuni yɛliya: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: Jesus answered them, How right Isaiah was when he prophesied about you! You are hypocrites, just as he wrote: These people, says God, honor me with their words, but their heart is really far away from me.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu sɔɣira, o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee muɣisigu saha.
en: The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed, a place of safety in times of trouble.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka n sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa ŋma la ni m-pa di zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Cut two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi be kaman o yab Dauda. O daa niŋ o ba Jɔash ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: Amaziah did what the Lord said was right, but he did not follow God completely like David his ancestor. Amaziah did everything that Joash his father had done.

dag: Yinim Filistianim zaa, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya pam. Yi tiŋ mini di dunoya kuhima! Dama taŋkpagbiligu ni yi nuzaa polo na, di nyɛla tɔbbihi bɛn kanna ka dabiɛmlana ka bɛ ni.
en: Wail, gate! Cry out, city! Melt in terror, all you Philistines! Smoke is coming from the north; there is no straggler in its ranks.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a paɣiba zaa min a bidibisi yi nti ti Babilɔnnima, ka amaŋmaŋ ku tiligi bɛ nuu ni. Amaa Babilɔn naa ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaag a, ka nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim.
en: The Babylonian army will take your wives and children captive, you will be taken as a prisoner to the King of Babylonia, and Jerusalem will be burned down.

dag: Ti nyɛviya dabisa nyɛla yuun pisopɔin, ka ti yi mali yaa, di ni niŋ yuun pihinii; amaa di yuma maa zaa tiri ti la wahala mini suhugarigu; ka di ku yuui ka di naai ka vuui.
en: We live at best to be seventy years old, maybe eighty, if were strong. But their duration brings hard work and trouble because they go by so quickly. And then we fly off.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla kurugu alikalimi sabi Judanim daalahichi, ka zaŋ daimɔnd chiriga n-chirigi li pa bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ sara maligu bimbina binyila zuɣu.
en: Judahs sin is engraved with an iron pen. Its etched with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a mi Sool ni niŋ shɛm, o kari bukpahinim mini jinwariba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka wula ka a ti kana ti bari n nyɛvili tɔŋ ni a chɛ ka n kpi.
en: But the woman said to him, You know that Saul forced all the mediums and fortunetellers to leave the land of Israel. You are trying to trap me and kill me.

dag: O yiɣisiri faranim taŋkpaɣu ni, ka yiɣisiri nandaamba tampiligim ni.
en: God lifts up the poor from the dirt and raises up the needy from the garbage pile.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk bɔhi Ibrahimma, A ni woligi piɛsah ayopɔin shɛb zali bɛ ko maa mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: and Abimelech asked him, Why did you do that.

dag: Amaa ka o lee yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Dinzuɣu miri ka a nyu wain bee binnyuri kpiɔŋ; a mi miri ka a di binshɛli din chihiri dibu; dama bia maa ti yɛn nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani o dɔɣibu dali zaŋ hal ti paag o kum dali. .
en: He said to me, You are pregnant and will give birth to a son, so dont drink wine or brandy or eat anything that is ritually unclean, because the boy is going to be a nazirite for God from birth until the day he dies.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi salo maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi n-kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa? M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma.
en: Jesus said to the mob, Why do you come with swords and clubs to arrest me like a criminal? Day after day I sat and taught in the temple, and you didn't arrest me.

dag: Ka o dii ŋmaligi zo n-lab Naa maa sani ti yɛl o, M bɔri ni a zaŋla Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu niŋ pɔŋ ni ti ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The girl hurried back at once to the king and demanded, I want you to give me here and now the head of John the Baptist on a plate.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni n-nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ daa gbarigila Izraɛlnima ni bɛ di chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa.
en: They went as far as Eshcol Valley and saw the land, but when they returned, they discouraged the people from entering the land which the Lord had given them.

dag: O zuli kpɛmmi kaman sida tia la; ka o gbalipina ni jila kpɛnkpe tab ni.
en: His tail stands up like a cedar, and the muscles in his legs are strong.

dag: Kum chɛ ka ti niŋgbuna biimi kaman duduhugu puuni la.
en: Our skin is hot like an oven. We have a high fever because of our hunger.

dag: Ka o daa yul o luɣa ni ka bi nya so, ka daa ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa n-zaŋ o pi bihigu ni.
en: Moses looked all around, and when he saw that no one was watching, he killed the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.

dag: Ka n ti bahi yi fɔntinsi yoli, ka chɛ ka yi jɛmbu shɛhi leei dabari, ka m baɣa ku lan be yi binyɛra din nyom viɛl ni.
en: I will turn your cities into ruins, destroy your places of worship, and refuse to accept your sacrifices.

dag: Salima pipihi din diba ayi kam daa bi ŋman taba ka bɛ daa mali nyuri binnyura. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ni nyuri wain shɛli pam ti niriba maa.
en: Drinks were served in gold cups, no two of them alike, and the king was generous with the royal wine.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindira bɛ sani di, ka lan zaŋ liɣiri da kom bɛ sani nyu.
en: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.

dag: Di saha ka n daa neei gom ni n-lihi ka n gom maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: Then I woke up and looked around. What a pleasant sleep I had!.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili yi tɛha ni ka gbibi yimaŋa, ka zaŋ yi tahima niŋ anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn niŋ niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dabisi shɛli dal la.
en: So prepare your minds for service. With complete self-control put all your hope in the grace that will be yours when Jesus Christ comes.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa bah o, ka o yi Rama chaŋ la nyaaŋa. Bɛ daa lo o la zoligɔnima m-pahi bɛ ni daa gbahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-zaŋ ba kuni Babilɔn la zuɣu.
en: The Lord spoke to me after Nebuzaradan, the commanding officer, had set me free at Ramah. I had been taken there in chains, along with all the other people from Jerusalem and Judah who were being taken away as prisoners to Babylonia.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpamba ni Ijiptinim zaa daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa ka kuŋ mɔni Ijipti fɔŋ ni zaa, dama yili shɛli daa kani ka kum bi ku nimaani.
en: That night the king, his officials, and everyone else in Egypt got up and started crying bitterly. In every Egyptian home, someone was dead.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baɣa kul be ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi tab suhuri ni, ka di chɛ ka ti wuhiri ti yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm ka tumdi tuun suma.
en: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bara maa, M bia, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: Seeing how much faith they had, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, My son, your sins are forgiven.

dag: di saha ka o wuhiri ba bɛ tuma mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ karimbaani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God points out their sin and their pride.

dag: ka yɛli Taai din be teeku noli, ka bɛ mini tin shɛŋa din be teeku duli nim niŋdi daabiligu la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, a yɛliya, N viɛl zaa.
en: the city that is built along the sea and that trades with nations along the coast. Tell the people of Tyre that the following message is from me: Tyre, you brag about your perfect beauty.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni lo ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o o niriba zaa sani.
en: I will keep my promise to you when your people.

dag: O daa kurigimi zaa ka naanyi kpi m-pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: Then he grew weak and died. He had lived a long and satisfying life. He died and went to be with his people.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛdomnima, Nyamiya, n ni filim ya zuliya kam sani; ka chɛ ka sokam ʒiɛm ya.
en: The Lord says to Edom, I will make you weak; everyone will despise you.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli Firawuna, Pa mani n-wuhiri di gbinni maa, amaa Naawuni ni wuhi nyin Firawuna di gbinni ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: Joseph answered, I cannot! But God can explain the dream for you, Pharaoh.

dag: N zaŋla tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni sinnamɔn tulaalɛnim la mihi li.
en: My bed smells wonderful with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

dag: chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bidibis ayopɔin ti ti ka ti zaŋ ba chaŋ Gibiɔn nti ku ba Yawɛ zol la zuɣu ŋun Yawɛ tooni. Ka naa daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ ba tin ya.
en: Give us seven of his descendants. We will hang these men near the place where the Lord is worshiped in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, the Lord 's chosen king. I'll give them to you, David said.

dag: Dabisili din pah anahi dali, Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu ŋun daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the fourth day Reubens Chief Elizur, Shedeurs son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul doya gil tiŋ maa m-mali hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini saha.
en: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kalima anahi ni ʒe m-baɣi chɛrubinim maa. Kalinli yini daa ʒe m-baɣi la chɛrubi yino kam. Kalima maa daa ŋmanila diɣi n-nyaɣisira.
en: Then I noticed that there were four wheels. There was one wheel by each Cherub angel, and the wheels looked like a clear yellow jewel.

dag: Yi ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa daa nyɛla biɛɣ pihinahi. Dinzuɣu dabisi yini kam yɛn leela yuun muni. Yi ni ʒi yi daalahichi ʒili yuun pihinahi, ka baŋ ni yi ni niŋ shɛm bi tiɣi n nini. .
en: For as many days as you explored the land, that is, forty days, just as many years youll bear your guilt, that is, forty years. This is how you will understand my frustration.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee din mali kpiɔŋ; ka chɛ ka barina shɛli ka n soli zuɣu.
en: This God is my strong refuge; he makes my pathway safe.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Joseph got up and, during the night, took the child and his mother to Egypt.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Naawuni ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah did everything God told him to do.

dag: Simiɔn mini Lɛvi nyɛla nir ni o mabia. Bɛ malila bɛ bidibbina tumdi barina.
en: Simeon and Levi are brothers. They are violent with their swords.

dag: Ka naazɔnim maa daa yɛl o, Haman be kpe; o ʒe zɔŋ ni. Ka naa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiy o ni o kpɛmina.
en: So the servants answered, Haman is here, waiting to see you. Show him in, said the king.

dag: Yisifu saha ka o daa zali zaligu maa, saha shɛl o ni daa liri Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ la. N wumla n ni ʒi kukol shɛli, ka di yɛra:.
en: He gave it to the people of Israel when he attacked the land of Egypt. I hear an unknown voice saying.

dag: Dama din yɛn niŋ ninsalinima, dina n-yɛn niŋ biŋkɔbiri gba. Ninsalinim kpirimi ka biŋkɔbiri gba kpira. Vuhim yini ka bɛ zaa mali. Ka ninsal bi so biŋkɔbigu. Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: because human beings and animals share the same fate. One dies just like the other—both have the same life-breath. Humans are no better off than animals because everything is pointless.

dag: Di ni tilig a zaɣ biɛɣu ni, ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: Wisdom will rescue you from the evil path, from people who twist their words.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ŋunkam niŋ a naani mal alibarika!.
en: Lord All-Powerful, great blessings belong to those who trust in you!.

dag: Ka Manɔa bɔh o, A yɛligu maa yi ti niŋ pali, bia maa biɛhigu ti yɛn nyɛla wula, ka tuun bɔ ka o lee ti yɛn tum.
en: Then Manoah said, Now then, when your words come true, what must the boy do? What kind of a life must he lead.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu.
en: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan zaŋ n vuhim dabisa ti ba ka di leei shihirili m mini ba sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-maani ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: And I commanded them to respect the Sabbath as a way of showing that they were holy and belonged to me.

dag: M be yi sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm. N ni laɣim yi zuliya bɛn be wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo zaa na.
en: Do not be afraid—I am with you! From the distant east and the farthest west I will bring your people home.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribila maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the lower part of the front of the two shoulder straps of the ephod, near the seam and above the finely woven belt.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔb chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka nya bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam gari yi tɔbbihi, yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la be yi sani.
en: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lo ti Naawuni maa alikauli, ka yihi tinzun paɣiba mini bɛ bihi n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ kaman n dana mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum ti Naawuni zaligu ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la ni daa wuhi shɛm, ka chɛ ka di niŋ kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Now let us make an agreement before our God to send away all these women and their children. We will do that to follow the advice of Ezra and the people who respect the laws of our God. We will obey Gods law.

dag: Ka tumtumdi kpeem bilikɔɣino ŋɔ dan maa daa paɣ o pam o dahin shɛli tɛha maa zuɣu, dama bɛn doli zibisim soli dunia ŋɔ ni mali yɛmbimbiɛri bɛ tuma ni gari bɛn doli neesim soli.
en: The master commended the dishonest manager because he acted cleverly. People who belong to this world are more clever in dealing with their peers than are people who belong to the light.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani buɣim sal nɛma, ka ŋmani buɣim mokpala chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa binnɛma maa sunsuuni. Buɣim maa daa ne pam, ka saa nyaɣisibu daa yiri buɣim maa ni na.
en: Regarding the creatures forms: they looked like blazing coals, like torches. Fire darted about between the creatures and illuminated them, and lightning flashed from the fire.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu sahakam; n lan yɛri ya mi yaha, kul maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: Always be filled with joy in the Lord. I will say it again. Be filled with joy.

dag: A nyɛla a ma ŋun daa zaɣis o yidana min o bihi la bipuɣiŋga. A nyɛla a biɛyanim bɛn daa zaɣisi bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi la tizo. A ma daa nyɛla Hiti paɣa, ka a ba mi nyɛ Amɔri doo.
en: You really are your mother's daughter. She detested her husband and her children. You are like your sisters, who hated their husbands and their children. You and your sister cities had a Hittite mother and an Amorite father.

dag: Bɛ kuri pakoya mini saamba, ka kuri kpibisi.
en: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.

dag: N yi yɛli, N ni tam n fabila maa yɛla, ka yihi suhugarigu ŋɔ n suhu ni, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: If I smile and try to forget my pain, all my suffering comes back to haunt me; I know that God does hold me guilty.

dag: N yɛligu bi bemi kaman buɣim bee zali din nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli ŋmɛri wurindi kuɣa la? Man Yawɛ m-bɔhi lala maa.
en: Yes, the Lord says, You must treat my message carefully, like a fire or like a hammer that can smash a rock.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim ti polo na! Be alizanda ni ka lihina nya; tiligim wain tia ŋɔ.
en: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.

dag: M mabihi, lala n-nyɛ li. Yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu polo, yi ni nyɛ Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛl la zuɣu ni di chɛ ka yi tooi leei Masia ŋun daa neei kum ni la ni su shɛba din ni chɛ ka ti tum tuun suma ti Naawuni.
en: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.

dag: Ti mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti, ti neei shɛlikam wuhi ya; ti yooi ti suhuri tin ya.
en: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm, ka ŋmari ma ʒiri, ka bi lan tɛhiri n yɛla yi suhuri ni? N ni shini ya ka di yuui, ka ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi lan zɔri ma maa.
en: Whom did you dread and fear so that you lied, didnt remember me or give me a thought? Isnt it because I was silent and closed my eyes that you stopped fearing me?.

dag: M mabihi, Klɔi yiŋnim shɛb daa yɛli ma ni naŋgbankpeeni kpe yi sunsuuni.
en: My brothers and sisters, some members of Chloes family told me that there are arguments among you.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din bi tu kamaata yi saria karibu ni bee binyɛra wɔɣilim buɣisibu ni bee di tibisim zahimbu ni bee di galisim zahimbu ni.
en: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka Itai daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini n dan naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n dan ni yɛn kpe luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla kum shee bee nyɛvili shee, nimaani ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛn kpe.
en: But Ittai answered the king, As the Lord lives, and as long as you live, I will stay with you, in life or death.

dag: Bɛ kuhigu maa ni, bɛ ni ti yili kuyilli a zuɣu. Tin dini n-na mi n-wurim teeku sunsuuni kaman Taai ni wurim shɛm ŋɔ?.
en: In their lamentation they raise a lament for you; they sing lamentions over you: Who was like Tyre, silenced in the middle of the sea.

dag: Ka Leeban mini Bɛtuɛl daa yɛl o, Yɛlli ŋɔ ni yila Yawɛ sani ŋɔ na, dindina ti ku tooi yɛl a din bie bee din viɛl zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, We see that this is from the Lord , so there is nothing we can say to change it.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni nya yolisim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ dolila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n tɛha ni, amaa ka doli alahichi zaligu n ninsalitali biɛhigu ni.
en: I thank God for his salvation through Jesus Christ our Lord! So in my mind I am a slave to Gods law, but in my sinful self I am a slave to the law of sin.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim, ka o daa ku o gba.
en: This made the Lord angry. So he killed Onan also.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa yi bɛ sansani maa ni na chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli.
en: Moses, Eleazar, and all the other leaders of the community went out of the camp to meet the army.

dag: Dama naa maa niŋla Yawɛ naani; ka Zallakudura Naa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu chɛ ka binshɛli ku tooi vuug o.
en: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.

dag: m-pahi paɣ shɛb o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ dɔriti naai min o ni daa kari alizin biɛri paɣ shɛb zuɣu bahi la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na ka nyɛ alizin biɛr ayopɔin ni daa ʒi so zuɣu la.
en: There were also some women with him. Jesus had healed these women of sicknesses and evil spirits. One of them was Mary, who was called Magdalene. Seven demons had come out of her.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa kpalim be vinvamli maa ni Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la.
en: So we remained in the valley opposite the town of Bethpeor.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. Chɛ ka a suhu doya, a ku kpi.
en: But the LORD said to him, Peace! Dont be afraid! You wont die.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa chɛ ka o bidibis ayopɔin maa kana ti gari Samuɛl tooni, ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Jɛsi, Yawɛ bi pii bɛmbɔŋɔ ni so.
en: Jesse showed seven of his sons to Samuel. But Samuel said to Jesse, The Lord has not chosen any of these men.

dag: N ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim o mamanim maa ninni, ka so ti ku tooi fa o n nuu ni bahi.
en: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.

dag: Amaa o zuɣu palo maa ni bee gbɛ palo maa ni yi mali dɔr biɛɣu bimmɔriŋ zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu m-piligir o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni maa.
en: But if a reddish-white sore appears on the bald spot, it is a dreaded skin disease.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ni tooi lan niŋ nyɛvili? Ka n garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, nyini m-mi.
en: He asked me, Human one, can these bones live again? I said, LORD God, only you know.

dag: Ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Sool lo o la zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu, ka daa yɛli Abiata ŋun nyɛ maligumaana maa, Zaŋmi tan la na.
en: When David heard that Saul was planning to attack him, he said to the priest Abiathar, Bring the ephod here.

dag: O ni daa kul wuhi ti di gbinni shɛm, di daa ti shiri niŋla pali; a daa labisi ma n tuma ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la mi ti yili tia.
en: His interpretations came true exactly: Pharaoh restored me to my position but hanged him.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pahi bɛ zuɣu; ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: When he got into the boat with the followers, the wind stopped. The followers were completely amazed.

dag: Tumtumdiba yi di n-tiɣi bee bɛ yi bi di n-tiɣi, bɛ yi dɔni, bɛ gbihirimi pali bɛ nina, amaa bundana ŋun buni zuɣu chɛmi ka o gaani gom.
en: Sweet is the workers sleep, whether theres a lot or little to eat; but the excess of the wealthy wont let them sleep.

dag: Wummi saɣisigu ka deei wuhibu din ni chɛ ka a ti mali yɛm dahin shɛli.
en: Listen to advice and accept instruction, so you might grow wise in the future.

dag: Aduna ku paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa ni, o ni kpi, yi ni daa zaɣisi n zaligu Mɛriba kom la yɛla ni la zuɣu.
en: Aaron is not going to enter the land which I promised to give to Israel; he is going to die, because the two of you rebelled against my command at Meribah.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti kpimsi Ɛdom yɛnnima; ka kpimsi Iso Zoli zuɣunim baŋsim.
en: The Lord says, On that day I will destroy the wise people from Edom. I will destroy the intelligent people from the mountain of Esau.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N yɛli noli ti Keenan. O ni nyɛla o biɛyanim dabili.
en: he said, A curse on Canaan! He will be a slave to his brothers.

dag: Sokam birigiya, bɛ zaa laɣim dolila biriginsim soli; so kani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu; amaa di daba ata dali, o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: They will hand him over to the foreigners, who will laugh at him and beat him with whips, and then they will kill him on a cross. But on the third day after his death, he will be raised to life again.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Rɛfidim maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sinai tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Naa maa yɛligu maa bahi ka bɛ yi n-gbaai chandi; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka saŋmar so bɛ ni daa nya wulimpuhili polo maa dii gari bɛ tooni hal nti kpalim zani bia maa ni daa be yil shɛli maa dɛde.
en: And so they left, and on their way they saw the same star they had seen in the East. When they saw it, how happy they were, what joy was theirs! It went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyɛra ni ka ni tooi zaŋ dari kpe m-mali nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuuni kam.
en: for cutting jewels to be set; for carving wood; and for every other kind of artistic work.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka bɔ n-lee bala.
en: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, What does all this mean.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi kpi kaman sokam zaa ni kpiri shɛm bee yɛl shɛli din paari sokam zaa yi paai ba, dindina, pa Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: These men will die, but if they die in a normal way—the way people always die—then that will show that the Lord did not really send me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o mabia maa gba daa yina ka gali ʒee maa lo o nuu, ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Zɛra.
en: Then his brother was born with the red thread on his arm, and he was named Zerah.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya: Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: This is a list of Calebs descendants: Hur was Calebs first son. He was born to Ephrathah. Hurs sons were Shobal, the founder of Kiriath Jearim.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Farisiinim yɛri taba, Nyamiya, ti kul nahindila timaŋ yoli! Dunianim zaa n-kabiri dol o la.
en: The Pharisees then said to one another, You see, we are not succeeding at all! Look, the whole world is following him.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa tim boli anabinim kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, Ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: So Ahab called in the prophets, about four hundred of them, and asked them, Should I go and attack Ramoth, or not? Attack it, they answered. God will give you victory.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchinima; din kul ka buchi mi din ka buchinima! Di zaa shiri ka buchi.
en: Perfectly pointless, says the Teacher, perfectly pointless. Everything is pointless.

dag: Yi yi doli n noli, ka gbibi n zaligunima ka tumdi di tuma.
en: If you live according to my rules, keep my commands, and do them.

dag: Amaa naa daa bi saɣi zaŋ Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia ka nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la ŋun ti ba, ŋun Dauda mini Sool bia Jɔnatan ni daa lo tab alikauli shɛli Yawɛ tooni la zuɣu.
en: But because of the sacred promise that he and Jonathan had made to each other, David spared Jonathan's son Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul.

dag: So ka suhupiɛlli tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam maa ni. So bi tahiri bee n-yiini yila wain tihi puri maa ni. So mi bi nɔri wain tihi wala ni o yihi wain, ka so bi wumdi suhupiɛlli tahigu damli.
en: No one is happy now in the fertile fields. No one shouts or sings in the vineyards. No one tramples grapes to make wine; the shouts of joy are ended.

dag: Zuliya shɛb buɣili na mi n-fa o tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi?.
en: Did any of the gods of other nations save their land from the king of Assyria?.

dag: ka yi yi karim n ni pun sab shɛli maa, yi ni tooi nya n ni baŋ Masia daashili maa yɛla shɛm.
en: and if you will read what I have written, you can learn about my understanding of the secret of Christ.

dag: Dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam hal ka nir ni tooi ʒe luɣ kasi shee din be Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa tooni la ka lihi nya di zuɣuri mini di nyoya, amaa nir yi be samban ni, o ku tooi nya li, ka dapuhi maa na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The carrying poles were so long that their tips could be seen from the holy place in front of the inner sanctuary, though they werent visible from outside. They are still there today.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bee yi bi nya li? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Jesus replied, Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul zaɣisir o? Yi bɔrila tibidarigibo din galisi? Izraɛlnima, yi zuɣuri zaa malila dansi, ka yi suhuri mini yi tɛha ka alaafee.
en: Why do you keep on rebelling? Do you want to be punished even more? Israel, your head is already covered with wounds, and your heart and mind are sick.

dag: Di nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana, ka bɔ ka a lee ni tooi niŋ? Di nyɛla din zilim gari kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka bɔ ka yɛn tooi baŋ?.
en: That knowledge is higher than the heavens and deeper than the place of death. So what can you do? How can you learn it all?.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam wum o yɛligu maa alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi niŋdi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm alaka la? Ka ŋuna n-daa ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛn gba niŋ Yisa yɛda tahi maligumaaniba kpamba san la.
en: Everyone who heard him was baffled. They questioned each other, Isnt he the one who was wreaking havoc among those in Jerusalem who called on this name? Hadnt he come here to take those same people as prisoners to the chief priests.

dag: Di pala lahibal sun shɛli n-shiri lan beni pahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb beni chirindi ya yi tɛha ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ taɣi Masia lahibal suŋ maa.
en: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.

dag: Damaskus yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Damaskus ku lan nyɛla tiŋa. Di ni kabi lu n-duhi doya.
en: An oracle about Damascus. Look! Damascus is finished as a city; it will become a fallen ruin.

dag: Yihim ma sarika ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka m paɣ a yuli. Wuntizɔriba ni laɣim gili ma, dama a ni niŋ ma nirilim pam.
en: Set me free from my distress; then in the assembly of your people I will praise you because of your goodness to me.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza tɔbbihi maa ni daa teei gili Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, ka ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza maŋmaŋ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar himself arrived at the city while his officers were blockading it.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka doo ŋɔ tɔɣisiri lala? O mɔri Naawuni! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: How does he dare talk like this? This is blasphemy! God is the only one who can forgive sins.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ mini n tizo Bɛnjamin zaa nini nyaya ni mmaŋmaŋa n-yaagi n noli yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: All of you, including my brother Benjamin, can tell by what I have said that I really am Joseph.

dag: O zaŋla o nuzaa gbaai n zuɣu mali, ka zaŋ o nudirigu bɔbindi ma.
en: His left arm is beneath my head, his right embraces me.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm hal ti kpi, ka shɛb di bɛ nɛma fali.
en: All that we have is taken away; we die, still lacking wisdom.

dag: Bɛ bi diri wahala kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni diri wahala shɛm. Alɔbo mi bi luri bɛ zuɣu kaman di ni luri ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu shɛm.
en: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.

dag: Biŋgbamda zaa bɛn be tiŋgban ni gbamda nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira, di bi simdi ka yi di ba.
en: Every creature that swarms on the earth is detestable; it must not be eaten.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini tuya ʒiɛri maa ti Iso ka o di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi chaŋ o chandi shee. Lala ka Iso daa niŋ ʒiɛm o kpamdi maa.
en: Jacob then gave Esau some bread and some of the bean stew, and when Esau had finished eating and drinking, he just got up and left, showing how little he thought of his rights as the first-born.

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa naai, o daa chaŋ ti dula daboli zuɣu.
en: After Saul finished prophesying, he went to the place of worship.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la jɛmbu duu ni kpɛbu, ka jɛmdila buɣili Ashɛra binyɛra mini binnana. Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu bɛ taali tumbu maa zuɣu.
en: They all stopped worshiping at the Temple of the Lord , the God their ancestors worshiped. Instead, they started worshiping Asherah poles and other idols. Because they sinned in this way, God was angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bidibiga kam ni tooi ŋub li, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ka vibi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim niŋ ya, ka yi ti nyɛligi di puuni.
en: I will gather you, fan the flames of my wrath under you, and melt you down in the middle of it.

dag: ka Yisa daa tim Pita mini Jɔn n-yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu shili gul ti, ka ti kana ti di di bindirigu.
en: Jesus sent Peter and John with these instructions: Go and get the Passover meal ready for us to eat.

dag: O ni ti kana ti saɣim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ, ka chɛ ka alɔbo di di ni yɛn di shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb daba, ka chɛ ka tɔbu mi di di ni yɛn di shɛba.
en: Nebuchadnezzar will come and defeat Egypt. Those people who are doomed to die of disease will die of disease, those doomed to be taken away as prisoners will be taken away as prisoners, and those doomed to be killed in war will be killed in war.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe du titali puuni nti buɣisi di pilanima. Yaɣa maa zaa pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita ata.
en: Then the man led me into the Holy Place. He measured the walls on either side of the room. The side walls were cubits thick on each side.

dag: Bɛ sahi li mi ni bɛ ku niriba, ka so n-neei li ni di nyaɣisira kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga mini tibidarigibo kam zaa, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: The sword was made sharp for killing. It was polished to flash like lightning. My son, you ran away from the stick I used to punish you. You refused to be punished with that wooden stick.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun viɛla kaman saŋkpaliŋ la, ka simdi ni a yu o. Chɛ ka o biha tiɣ a nini sahakam, ka chɛ ka o ni yur a shɛm ku a zuɣu.
en: She is like a beautiful deer, a lovely fawn. Let her love satisfy you completely. Stay drunk on her love.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yiko niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kana ti tum tuma maa zaa na.
en: Then Moses brought together these workers who were eager to work.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ni daa nya ka o tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni. Ka o bia Jɛhoyakin daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Everything else Jehoiakim did, the terrible sins he did, and everything he was guilty of doing, are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah . Jehoiakims son Jehoiachin became the new king in his place.

dag: Zomiya yi ʒiri ŋmabu ni, yi mi miriya ka yi ku ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli ka nyɛ ŋun ka taali, dama m pala ŋun ni chɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tum taali.
en: Do not make false accusations, and do not put an innocent person to death, for I will condemn anyone who does such an evil thing.

dag: o yi ti nya alaafee n-yiɣisi kpuɣi jaaŋgbee chana, di saha ŋun daa ŋme o maa lan ka taali, amaa di lee simdi ka ŋun daa ŋme o maa yo o ni saɣim o saha shɛli maa samli, ka lih o hal ka o ti kpaŋ zaa.
en: if he recovers and is able to walk around outside with a cane, then the one who hit him shouldnt be punished, except to pay for the loss of time from work and to pay for his full recovery.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Sin tiŋgban nɛli ni m-piri taba gbilligbilli n-chani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai Rɛfidim n-ti suɣa nimaani, amaa ka kom daa lee ka nimaani ka bɛ ni nyu.
en: The Israelites left the western Sinai desert. They traveled all together from place to place as the Lord commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ bahigu, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyu Kpiɔŋlan Naa suhuyiɣisili.
en: Let them see their own punishment. Let them feel the anger of God All-Powerful.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla leeŋa, ka nyɛ mahim din taɣiri ba tulim wuntaŋ ni ni sɔɣibu shee ni leeŋa din taɣiri ba pɔhim mini saa.
en: His glory will shade the city from the heat of the day and make it a place of safety, sheltered from the rain and storm.

dag: Teem a ni daa yɛli mani a dabili ŋɔ shɛm, ka m mali tahima di zuɣu la yɛla.
en: Remember your promise to me, your servant. It gives me hope.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla, ka mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya ni di nyɛla din chihiri la.
en: Be certain that you do not forget the covenant that the Lord your God made with you. Obey his command not to make yourselves any kind of idol.

dag: N nya n niriba ni diri wahala shɛŋa Ijiptinim nuu ni, ka lan wum bɛ fabila la, lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti fa ba bahi. Ka yɛl o, Dinzuɣu kamina ka n tim a Ijipti.
en: I have seen the cruel suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans, and I have come down to set them free. Come now; I will send you to Egypt.

dag: Ka n nya lala, ka di shɛhira ni ŋuna n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa.
en: I have seen and testified that this one is Gods Son.

dag: Yawɛ, di yi nyɛla a dimnima, a dimnim maa ni ti kpi; ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa ti wurim.
en: Look at your enemies, LORD! Look at how your enemies die, how all evildoers are scattered abroad!.

dag: Ka a lihi bɛ ni m-piig a nin ni tiɣi paɣisar so n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee. Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa tiɣi naa nini ka o shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then let the young woman who pleases you most take Vashti's place as queen. King Xerxes liked these suggestions, and he followed them.

dag: Ɛzra ni daa suhiri n-kahigiri bɛ daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka kumdi ka luri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tooni shɛm maa, ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi pam daa laɣim o sani. Bɛ gba daa kumiya pam.
en: While Ezra was bowing in prayer in front of the Temple, weeping and confessing these sins, a large group of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, weeping bitterly.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti naa maa daa yɛli ba, Musa mini Aduna, bɔzuɣu ka yi chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa bi tumdi bɛ tuma? Chamiya ti tum yi tuma.
en: The king said to Moses and Aaron, What do you mean by making the people neglect their work? Get those slaves back to work!.

dag: N dol a zaligunima, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I follow your rules. I love them very much.

dag: Wuntitali ni daŋ o tooni nti mali soli zal o.
en: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.

dag: Amaa ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim ʒe siliga maa gbini kumda. O ni daa kumdi maa ka o ti vɔbisi lihi siliga maa puuni.
en: Mary stood outside near the tomb, crying. As she cried, she bent down to look into the tomb.

dag: Ka kikaa ni ti tahi pam, ka o ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: He will send his angels with the sound of a great trumpet, and they will gather his chosen ones from the four corners of the earth, from one end of the sky to the other.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka sagbani sirigina wuntaŋ ni ti lim Ziɔn Zoli mini bɛnkam zaa laɣim nimaani, ka nyɛ nyɔhi ni buɣim niɛm din diri ne yuŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni jilima din be nimaani ni ti nyɛla leeŋa.
en: Then over Mount Zion and over all who are gathered there, the Lord will send a cloud in the daytime and smoke and a bright flame at night. God's glory will cover and protect the whole city.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛn be kpaŋa lun ya sizuura, ka yi mi ku lihiri so ninni ni o dihi ya.
en: That way youll behave appropriately toward outsiders, and you wont be in need.

dag: buɣim dibu la buɣim dibu, daŋ la daŋa, fiɛb bɔba la fiɛb bɔba la n-darigi dilan tibili.
en: a burn for a burn, a bruise for a bruise, a wound for a wound.

dag: Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ bɔhim baŋ shɛli, amaa ka lee ku tooi baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: These women always want to learn something new, but they are never able to fully understand the truth.

dag: kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm kurimbuni la.
en: This is what he promised through his holy prophets long ago.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl bila Yawɛ sani. O ni lan zaŋ Mɔabnim niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: That simple thing isn't all the Lord is going to do. He will also help you defeat Moab's army.

dag: O kparima ŋmanila tulaale tihi vuɣa din wandi tulaale din nyom viɛla. O naŋgbampiba ŋmanila paɣiviɛligakushihikom, ka mɛɛr kom be di ni.
en: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.

dag: nti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, ka nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni lee nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ bee bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima ka nya bɛ nyɛla bɛn galisi bee bɛn pɔra.
en: You must inspect the land. What is it like? Are the people who live in it strong or weak, few or many?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka n ni ti darigi di buɣa la tibili, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya dansi ni ti do di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ŋ-ŋuhira.
en: The Lord says, The time is coming, when I will punish the idols of Babylon. At that time wounded people will cry with pain everywhere in that country.

dag: N ni lan chahi yi sarisi ŋɔ, ka fa n niriba bɛn be yi nuu ni maa bahi, ka bɛ ku lan be yi nuu ni n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn ku shɛba. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: And I will tear up those scarves and save my people from your power. They will escape from your trap, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hazɔrinima, zomiya chaŋ katiŋa, sɔɣimiya voya ni. Dama Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, ka mali shili gun ya.
en: Run and hide, you people of the desert who live in villages! Nebuchadnezzar has big plans for you.

dag: N saɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛlli ŋɔ puuni m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ zaɣ suŋ nyabu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi naai yi ni daa piligi niŋdi shɛli yuuni la ha. Di pa ni yi daa daŋmi piligi li kɔŋko, amaa yi daa daŋmi yu ni yi niŋ li.
en: This is what I think you should do: Last year you were the first to want to give, and you were the first who gave.

dag: Zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ puuni, yinim ka m pii, dinzuɣu n ni darigi yi tibili yi tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu.
en: Of all the nations on earth, you are the only one I have known and cared for. That is what makes your sins so terrible, and that is why I must punish you for them.

dag: Di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, dama muɣisigu be yoma, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ma.
en: Do not stay away from me! Trouble is near, and there is no one to help.

dag: Bɛ ni daa laɣim maa ka bɛ yihi Yisa tuumba ayi maa na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni m-bɔhi ba, Ŋun yiko bee ŋun yuli ka yi lee zaŋ tum yi ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: They made the apostles stand before them and asked them, How did you do this? What power do you have or whose name did you use.

dag: Ka zim maa daa shiri bi naai di duɣu maa ni; ka kpam la gba daa bi naai di ŋmani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: As the Lord had promised through Elijah, the bowl did not run out of flour nor did the jar run out of oil.

dag: Ka a yi nya li, a gba ni chaŋ ti pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a biɛli Aduna ni pahi bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: After you have seen this land, you will die like your brother Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ko Ziɔn kaman puu la yi zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni ti leei tanduya, ka jɛmbu duu zol la ti leei tihi nyɔŋ.
en: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.

dag: bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒii bunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahi.
en: but each of them had four faces and four wings.

dag: Dama o zuliya ni ti galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa ni ti nya alibarika la o zuɣu.
en: since his family will become a great and powerful nation that will be a blessing to all the other nations on earth.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta duu bihi mini namɔɣilisi ni daa kana ti yɛl o Mɔdɛkai yɛla, di daa niŋ o suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka o daa bo binyɛra n-ti ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Mɔdɛkai ka o ye ka chɛ buɣu maa, ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: When Esthers female servants and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, the queens whole body showed how upset she was. She sent everyday clothes for Mordecai to wear instead of mourning clothes, but he rejected them.

dag: Yili kam nyɛla ninvuɣ so ni me shɛli, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun me binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Every house, of course, is built by someone—and God is the one who has built all things.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Siɣim yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: At the same time, the Lord said to Moses, Go down from this mountain. Your people, the people you brought out of the land of Egypt, have committed a terrible sin.

dag: Ti mi ni Masia ni daa neei kum ni maa, o ku lan kpi yaha; dama kum lan ka o yiko.
en: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi pam dini daa bi guura; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi biɛla dini mi daa bi poor o.
en: just as the Scriptures say, Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.

dag: Karimbaani tahirila saɣiŋgu na, ka maŋduhibu mi tahiri lubu na.
en: Too much pride will destroy you.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa ti ma. Ka o daa deei bia maa paɣ maa sani n-zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa o ni daa be du shɛl ni nti zaŋ o sɔŋ omaŋmaŋ garo zuɣu;.
en: Give the boy to me, Elijah said. He took the boy from her arms, carried him upstairs to the room where he was staying, and laid him on the bed.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir anahi puuni Ziv gol ni ka bɛ daa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa.
en: They started working on the Lord s Temple in the month of Ziv, the second month of the year. This was during Solomons fourth year as king of Israel.

dag: Dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim maa. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Miriya ka yi ŋubi binnɛɔŋ kam ʒim, dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim, ka ŋunkam ŋub li, bɛn yihim o o niriba ni.
en: This is because the life of every kind of animal is in its blood. So I give this command to the Israelites: Dont eat meat that still has blood in it! Whoever eats blood must be separated from their people.

dag: Teem niriba maa ni bɛ doli zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi yɛligu ka deeri bɛ noli, ka mali shili n-tum tuun suŋ kam zaa.
en: Remind your people to submit to rulers and authorities, to obey them, and to be ready to do good in every way.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ma ni n zaŋ wuhi ya ka yi ti doli li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.

dag: Di saha maa yi ni ti yɛli, Ti min a n-daa yi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka a be pala zuɣu wuhiri ti la.
en: Then you will begin to say, We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai bɛ sansani maa ni, Izraɛlnim zaa daa yola vuri hal ka tiŋgbani ti damda.
en: brought the chest into camp, the army cheered so loudly that the ground shook.

dag: ka zali di tariga, ka niŋ dunoya niŋ li n-kpari li zali.
en: I set the limits for the sea and put it behind locked gates.

dag: Dunɔdali maa tooni zaŋ hal ti paai zɔntua puuni dunoli maa ni, di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu.
en: It was seventy-five feet from the front of the outer gate to the front of the inner porch of the gate.

dag: Ti mali mɔri mini difu din ni ti ti bunsi ŋɔ, ka mali m min a bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ni nachimbil so ŋun be tinim a daba ŋɔ sani ŋɔ bindirigu mini wain. Ti mali ti ni bɔri binshɛlikam.
en: even though we have fodder and straw for our donkeys, as well as bread and wine for my concubine and me and for my servant. We have everything we need.

dag: Zoya daa nya a ka sɔhigi. Kopaliga daa ŋme n-gari, ka teeku bulli duhi di kukoli. Wuntaŋ duhi di nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: When the mountains saw you, they trembled; water poured down from the skies. The waters under the earth roared, and their waves rose high.

dag: Kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm, lala ka ti nini nya li. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tiŋa din nyɛ ti Naawuni tiŋ la ni, ŋun Naawuni ni daa zali shɛli ni di beni sahakam la.
en: We have heard what God has done, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord Almighty; he will keep the city safe forever.

dag: To, yinima n-su Ɛhab bidibisi la fukumsi, ka su o chɛchɛbunsi min o yuri ni bidibbina ni bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛŋa la, dinzuɣu yi yi deei gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni tuɣili Ijiptinima, ka bɛ tuhi taba. Nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee ni tuhi taba, ka tins ayinim tuhi taba, ka nanim tuhi taba.
en: I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian, and they will fight, one against another, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

dag: Ka yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo hal ni Gatihɛfa m-mali hal ni Ɛtikazin nti ŋmaligi kpa Niya polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Rimɔn.
en: and continued north to Gath-Hepher, Ethkazin, and Rimmonah, where it curved toward Neah.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ka niriba baŋ a kpiɔŋ tuma min a nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla.
en: so that everyone will know your mighty deeds and the glorious majesty of your kingdom.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa yɛn chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pita tah o sanna dahin shɛli dazɔhigu dali yuŋ, Pita daa dola dansarika guliba ayi sunsuuni gbihira. Bɛ daa zaŋla zoligɔnim ayi lo o, ka dugul shɛb ʒe n-guli dunoli.
en: The night before Herod was going to bring Peters case forward, Peter was asleep between two soldiers and bound with two chains, with soldiers guarding the prison entrance.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya tiŋgban maa tariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Isaka zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Simeon from the eastern border to the western border: Issachar, one portion.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti mooni Masia molo n-kpamdi sokam jaande, ka wuhiri sokam baŋsim zaa puuni ni di chɛ ka sokam zooi m-bi niriba Masia ni, ka ti zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino tahi Naawuni sani.
en: So we continue to tell people about Christ. We use all wisdom to counsel every person and teach every person. We are trying to bring everyone before God as people who have grown to be spiritually mature in Christ.

dag: O daa pilila daanya zuɣupiligu ka ye kurigu gbaɣino din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihinu ni ayopɔin.
en: He wore a bronze helmet and had bronze armor to protect his chest and legs. The chest armor alone weighed about kilograms. He carried a bronze sword strapped on his back.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a daa deei bɛ suhigu. A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun daa chɛ bɛ taali, amaa a nyɛla ŋun daa darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.

dag: ka o yɛli Musa, Gbahim niriba maa toondaannima n-zaŋ kpana kuhi ba tabili bini zali wuntaŋa man Yawɛ tooni, ka n vuui n suhuyiɣisili titali maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: and said to Moses, Take all the leaders of Israel and, in obedience to me, execute them in broad daylight, and then I will no longer be angry with the people.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ti bela yi nuu ni; niŋmiya ti yi ni nya ka di simdi ni yi niŋ ti shɛm.
en: Now we are your servants. You can do whatever you think is right.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋbu saha? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: Tell us, when will these things happen? What sign will show that all these things are about to come to an end.

dag: Ka yi yi ku tooi niŋ bin din pɔri ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi jiɣindi binshɛŋa din kpalim zuɣu?.
en: If you don't have power over small things, why worry about everything else?.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Chɛl paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Chɛ ka o niŋ li gu n sɔɣibu dali.
en: But Jesus said, Leave her alone! Let her keep what she has for the day of my burial.

dag: N ni yili yila yɛli ʒiɛyimtali mini zaligu soli yɛla. N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: I will sing about love and justice. Lord , I will sing to you.

dag: Ka o daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti gbaai dari maa ŋmabu.
en: So Elisha went with the group of prophets. When they arrived at the Jordan River, they began to cut down some trees.

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Niriba nahindi ma ka di ka soli. Sɔŋm ma!.
en: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.

dag: Ka o daa tim tɔbbihi pam, ka bɛ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti teei gili tiŋ maa.
en: He ordered his best troops to go there with horses and chariots. They marched out during the night and surrounded the town.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni n-chani Firawuna sani nti yihiri Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Moses said to God, I am not a great man! How can I be the one to go to Pharaoh and lead the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka niriba ni niŋ shɛb naani leeri biriti, ka mɔŋdi kpamba baŋsim.
en: He silences those who are trusted, and takes the wisdom of old people away.

dag: Chamiya ti bɔhim dimbɔŋɔ gbinni: M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu. Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Go and learn what this means: I want mercy and not sacrifice . I didnt come to call righteous people, but sinners.

dag: M-pahi Hɛshibɔn mini di tin kara din daa be tintan ni la zaa ni Dibɔn ni Bamɔtibaal ni Bɛtibaalimiɔn.
en: The land continued to Heshbon. It included all the towns on the plain. Those towns were Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ti Mɔrɛshɛtigatinim chɛbisibu pina, ka Akizibnim ni ti nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi Izraɛl nanima.
en: So you must give goodbye gifts to Moresheth in Gath. The houses in Aczib will trick the kings of Israel.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ alɔbo shɛŋa mini jɛŋgbar shɛb bɛn bahi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yoli maa kɔtomsi, ka di lan simdi ni yi ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa jilima, di pa shɛli o ku lan darigi yi mini yi buɣa ni yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tibili yaha.
en: You must make these models of the tumors and of the mice that are ravaging your country, and you must give honor to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will stop punishing you, your gods, and your land.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kum dɔro n-gbaag o maa. O ku lan yiɣisi o dooshee maa yaha.
en: They say, He is fatally ill; he will never leave his bed again.

dag: Ka Jɛrubaal Jɔash bia maa daa kul omaŋmaŋ yiŋ ti ʒini.
en: Jerubbaal, Joashs son, went home to live with his own household.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa yɛn chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pita tah o sanna dahin shɛli dazɔhigu dali yuŋ, Pita daa dola dansarika guliba ayi sunsuuni gbihira. Bɛ daa zaŋla zoligɔnim ayi lo o, ka dugul shɛb ʒe n-guli dunoli.
en: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni yihi Judanim gba n sani bahi kaman n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim bahi shɛm la, ka zaɣisi Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni daa pii tiŋ shɛl la mini du shɛli n ni daa yɛli, Kpe n yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la. .
en: The LORD said, I will remove Judah from my presence just as I removed Israel. I will reject this city, Jerusalem, which I chose, and this temple where I promised my name would reside.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina. Ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: You must wash the internal organs and the hind legs, and the officiating priest will burn the whole sacrifice on the altar. The odor of this food offering is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Leeban ni daa nya nintua la mini bansi la, ka wum o tizɔpaɣa Ribɛka ni yɛli ni doo maa yɛl o shɛm zuɣu, ka o daa guui chaŋ doo maa sani nti nya ka o ʒiɛla laakumnim maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.
en: When he had seen the ring and the bracelets on his sisters arms, and when he had heard his sister Rebekah say, This is what the man said to me, he went to the man, who was still standing by the spring with his camels.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kul nyari yaa pahira, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: David continued to grow greater, and the Lord All-Powerful was with him.

dag: Liya nina daa dii ka alaafee, amaa ka Reechɛl ŋun daa viɛli pam ka o ninni kul nyɛlisira.
en: Leah had delicate eyes, but Rachel had a beautiful figure and was good-looking.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Yi gba nyɛla anabinim maa yaansi, ka su alikauli shɛli Naawuni ni daa lo yi yaannim maa. O daa yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni o zuliya zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika.
en: And what those prophets talked about is for you, their descendants. You have received the agreement that God made with your fathers. God said to your father Abraham, Every nation on earth will be blessed through your descendants.

dag: nti yɛl o, N wum a suhigu shɛli a ni suhi ma la. M mali jɛmbu du shɛli a ni me ŋɔ ka di be kasi ni di nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn jɛmdi ma luɣ shɛli sahakam. N kul ni gul li ka chɛ ka n suhu be di ni sahakam.
en: The Lord said: I heard your prayer and what you asked me to do. This temple you have built is where I will be worshiped forever. It belongs to me, and I will never stop watching over it.

dag: Yinim Shafirinima, zaŋmiya yi zaɣim mini yi vi gari chaŋ. Zaanannima, di yin ya na. Bɛtɛzɛlnim kuhirimi, ka ku lan sɔŋ ya.
en: You people living in Shaphir, pass on your way, naked and ashamed. The people living in Zaanan will not come out. The people in Beth Ezel will cry and take their support from you.

dag: ka Zabad daa nyɛ Ɛfilal ba, ka Ɛfilal nyɛ Obɛd ba.
en: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama.

dag: N shɛla buɣu m-pɔbi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ n yaa sɔŋ taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: I am very sad, so I wear this sackcloth. I sit here in dust and ashes, feeling defeated.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: This message from the Lord came to Jeremiah.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ŋmanila gɔ shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ labi; dama so ku tooi zaŋ o nuu kpuɣi ba.
en: But despicable people are like thorns, all of them good for nothing, because they cant be carried by hand.

dag: Ka Keenannim Naa Arad ŋun daa be Nɛgɛb din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa wum Izraɛlnim kandina damli.
en: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Dauda, Nyama, Filistianim tuhirila Kɛilanima, ka fari bɛ bindira bɛ puri ni.
en: One day some people told David, The Philistines keep attacking the town of Keilah and stealing grain from the threshing place.

dag: Amaa Hanna ŋun daa bi chaŋ, dama o daa yɛlila o yidana, Faashee bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili ka n zaŋ o tahi Yawɛ sani ka o ti kpalim be nimaani hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: But Hannah stayed home, because she had told Elkanah, Samuel and I won't go until he's old enough for me to stop nursing him. Then I'll give him to the Lord , and he can stay there at Shiloh for the rest of his life.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, Kalimiya niriba maa n-nya ninvuɣ banima n-lee yi ti ni chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa kali ba n-nya ka Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa n-kani.
en: Saul said to the troops with him, Take a count and see who is missing. So they counted, and Jonathan and his armor-bearer were gone.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni nya yolisim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ dolila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n tɛha ni, amaa ka doli alahichi zaligu n ninsalitali biɛhigu ni.
en: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.

dag: Bɛ lubu vuri ni ti dam tiŋgbani, ka bɛ kuhigu ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: At the sound of Edoms fall, the earth will shake. Their cry will be heard all the way to the Red Sea.

dag: Dauda ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛma yila fukumsi bɛ ni daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la labisina la nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: David put the following in charge of the music in the LORDs house after the chest was placed there.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni gbib ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga sahakam, ka gul ti.
en: The wicked are everywhere, and everyone praises what is evil. Keep us always safe, O Lord , and preserve us from such people.

dag: Wula ka yi lee tɛhiri Masia yɛla? Ŋun yaaŋa n-lee nyɛ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: He said, What do you think about the Messiah? Whose son is he? The Pharisees answered, The Messiah is the Son of David.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni ʒiɛm tuma biɛla dabisili? Niriba yi ti nya tammɛri bimbuɣisirigu Zɛrubabɛl nuu ni, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Firilanima ayopɔin la wuhirila Yawɛ nina din lihiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa la.
en: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord —and they see everything on this earth.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ paɣisaribil ti doo, ka na bi kulis o, ka do so ti chirig o tiŋ puuni n-zaŋ o dɔni.
en: A man might meet a virgin girl engaged to another man. He might have sexual relations with her. If this happens in the city.

dag: Ka o daa paɣi bimbiɛhi mini namanama n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.

dag: A daalikaulinim nyɛla alikauli maŋa! Ka mani a dabili ŋɔ yuri li.
en: How certain your promise is! How I love it!.

dag: Naa, a daa nya binnan titali. Binnani maa daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka kul nyɛlisira, ka mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Your Majesty, in your vision you saw standing before you a giant statue, bright and shining, and terrifying to look at.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Yisa yi Galili na la daa doli Yisifu chaŋ ti nya siliga maa ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa shɛm;.
en: The women who had come from Galilee with Jesus followed Joseph. They saw the tomb. Inside they saw where he put Jesus body.

dag: Yi daa zɔrila takɔbi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Are you afraid of swords? I will bring soldiers with swords to attack you.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla alizanda tiŋbihi, ka ti suhuri kul yɛla tiligir so ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia m-be alizanda ni la labbuna zuɣu.
en: But the government that rules us is in heaven. We are waiting for our Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, to come from there.

dag: N niriba, wummiya n wuhibu; wummiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: My people, listen to my teachings. Listen to what I say.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Man Yisifu m-bala. M ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Amaa ka di daa gar o biɛyanim maa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: Joseph said to his brothers, Im Joseph! Is my father really still alive? His brothers couldnt respond because they were terrified before him.

dag: Yawɛ mali shili ni o saɣim dunia ŋɔ n-dahimdahim li sɔŋ. O ni chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam ka sokam gbaai zɔbu.
en: Look, the Lord is destroying this land. He will clean out the land completely and force all the people to go far away.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ a yaannim ni daa kpa shɛli kurimbuni ha.
en: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors.

dag: A dim yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla, nyin di niŋ li yɛda, dama din chihira ayopɔin sɔɣi be di ni.
en: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!.

dag: Biɛrim yi ti paai ba, bɛ ni bɔri suhudoo, amaa ka ku nya li.
en: Despair is coming. You will look for peace and never find it.

dag: ni Dɛbir naa ni Gɛda naa.
en: the king of Debir, the king of Geder.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ o bia pakoli Tama maa n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi ayi pahi, bɛna n-nyɛ Pɛrɛz mini Zɛra. Juda bidibisi zaa daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: His daughter-in-law Tamar bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.

dag: Ka a zaŋ di zaa tuɣi taba ka di leei da yini n-nyɛ zaɣ yini a nuu ni.
en: Then join the two sticks together. In your hand, they will be one stick.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ kurugu bidibbini, ka daanya piɛm ni to ba pili yi.
en: Maybe he will run away from an iron sword, but then a bronze arrow will strike him down.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ yi yab Ibrahimma Mɔɣili duli maa polo na nti chɛ ka o chaŋ gili Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa. Ka n daa ti o bihi pam. N daa chɛ ka o dɔɣi Yisahaku;.
en: But I brought Abraham across the Euphrates River and led him through the land of Canaan. I blessed him by giving him Isaac, the first in a line of many descendants.

dag: ka yɛli, Aai, ti ni ba yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zo n-tiligi, dindina zomiya tiligi. Yi tɛhiya ni yi yuri zɔri pam, amaa bɛn kariti doli ya maa yuri zɔri gari yi yuri.
en: You said, No! Well flee on horses— therefore, you will indeed flee— and well ride off; on swift steeds we will ride— therefore, your pursuers will be swift.

dag: Dama bɛ daa kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa hal ka tiŋgbani ti ku n-sabigi. Ka bɛ daa ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim bimbil shɛŋa la mini tiwala zaa, ka va mahali bee tihi vari bee puri ni bimbilima daa lan ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: The ground was black with locusts, and they ate everything left on the trees and in the fields. Nothing green remained in Egypt—not a tree or a plant.

dag: N dɔni n gom shee yuŋ tɛhi n suhu ni yuri so pam yɛla; m bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: Asleep on my bed, night after night I dreamed of the one I love; I was looking for him, but couldn't find him.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ko Ziɔn kaman puu la yi zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni ti leei tanduya, ka jɛmbu duu zol la ti leei tihi nyɔŋ.
en: Leaders, because of you, Zion will be destroyed. It will become a plowed field. Jerusalem will become a pile of rocks. Temple Mount will be an empty hill overgrown with bushes.

dag: N ni zaŋ bɛ ni shɛb leei maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will also choose some of these people to be priests and Levites. The Lord himself said this.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni a zani ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyaaŋa saria karibu ni, ka mɔŋ ŋun ka taali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu ni.
en: Favoring the wicked isnt good; it denies justice to the righteous.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni, di nyɛla Yawɛ vuhim yuuni; di ti biriya yi puri bee n-wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi.
en: But during the seventh year, you will let the land rest. This will be a special time of rest to honor the Lord . You must not plant seed in your field or trim your vineyards.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu. Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! .
en: And so your Temple will be abandoned. I assure you that you will not see me until the time comes when you say, God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord.

dag: Ninsal nini ni ni tooi nya Masia so la nyɛla Naawuni so ninsal nini ni ku tooi nya ŋɔ ŋmahinli, ka lan nyɛ Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun gari binnamda zaa.
en: Christ is the visible likeness of the invisible God. He is the first-born Son, superior to all created things.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti daa yi tumdi tuma maa, bɛ ni pirigili gbibila kpana asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha zaŋ hal ti paai yuŋ saŋmarisi peebu saha.
en: So we continued the work, with half of them holding spears from dawn until dusk.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni;.
en: But God raised him from death.

dag: Ka Absalom daa bɔhi Hushai, A ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ a zo maa sani ni bahindi shɛm m-bala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi dol a zo maa chaŋ.
en: But Absalom said to Hushai, Is this how you show loyal love to your friend? Why didnt you go with him.

dag: ka gbala yɔhi; ka kpiimba pam bɛn daa nyɛ wuntizɔriba la neei kum ni.
en: Graves opened, and many of God's people were raised to life.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-nyo buɣim mali chi sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Ka binnyurigu sara din yɛn pahi di zuɣu n-nyɛ wain lita yini.
