en: You must also offer a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil. You must also offer quart of wine. The smell of that offering will please the Lord .

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga? Bɛ yɛn jɛmdila nanima ka pa ni tarimba.
en: Do you see people who work skillfully? They will work for kings but not work for lowly people.

dag: Salo ni daa ti laɣimna m-muɣi saha shɛli ka Yisa piligi yɛra, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihirili, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: As the people crowded around Jesus, he went on to say, How evil are the people of this day! They ask for a miracle, but none will be given them except the miracle of Jonah.

dag: Amaa ka o tumtumda maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili be tiŋ ŋɔ ni ka bɛ tir o jilima pam. O yɛligu bi yiɣisira. Chɛ ka ti chaŋ o sani, di pa shɛli o ni tooi wuhi ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: But the servant answered, A man of God is in this town. People respect him. Everything he says comes true, so lets go into town. Maybe the man of God will tell us where we should go next.

dag: ni Lɛvinim ni su tiŋ shɛli la ni ti bela naa tiŋgbani maa sunsuuni. Naa tiŋgbani maa ni ti dola Juda zuliya tiŋgbani mini Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbani sunsuuni.
en: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, di simdi ka yi lo noli ka di tumiya tuma dindali, yinim bɛn nyɛ tiŋbihi bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani.
en: This will be a permanent rule for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month, you must deny yourselves. You must not do any work—neither the citizen nor the immigrant who lives among you.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi yi yaannim ni daa ku anab shɛb gbala.
en: How terrible for you! You make fine tombs for the prophets—the very prophets your ancestors murdered.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha ka Juda Naa Jɔash bia Naa Amazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Amaziah, the son of Judahs King Jehoash, became king in the second year of Israels King Joash, who was Jehoahazs son.

dag: nti zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu maa m-booi di ni kpam bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa; ka yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi, ka di niŋ zinchili.
en: pour this olive oil on his head, and say, The Lord proclaims that he anoints you king of Israel. Then leave there as fast as you can.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ayi.
en: Amon was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years.

dag: Ka o yɛl ba, Yi nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka yi yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Pharaoh answered, You are lazy, and you dont want to work! That is why you ask me to let you go. And that is why you want to leave here and make sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, Din kariya! A ku kpi. Nyama, m ba na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛla bin titali bee bimbila ka bi yɛli ma. Ka bɔ zuɣu ka m ba ni sɔɣi ma dimbɔŋɔ dina? Pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: My father can't be trying to kill you! He never does anything without telling me about it. Why would he hide this from me? It can't be true.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri Bɛtisaida polo, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: Then Jesus told the followers to get into the boat. He told them to go to the other side of the lake to Bethsaida. He said he would come later. He stayed there to tell everyone they could go home.

dag: Harim daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisi.
en: from the town of Harim:.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubila n-niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni, ka lan zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni buyopɔin.
en: Aaron will dip his finger into the bulls blood and sprinkle it on the front of the Holy Box. Then he will sprinkle the blood seven times onto the front of the mercy-cover.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum o deemba yɛligu maa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zaa.
en: Moses followed Jethro's advice.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ba ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: Israels sons did for him just as he had ordered.

dag: Asahɛl bia Jɔnatan mini Tikiva bia Jazɛya n-daa zaɣisi yɛlli maa, ka Mɛshulam mini Shabɛtai ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir la daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Only a few men were against this plan. They were Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah. Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite also were against the plan.

dag: Di tuhiya ni a chɛ ka a kɔbilinina yam luɣilikam n-nyɛ kɔzɔrim be solɔri zuɣu?.
en: and dont let your water flow out into the streets.

dag: N yilikpɛrilaannima, n nya ka sarati ni paai ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni, ka di pala neen shɛŋa din be ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni bee ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ kɔŋko m-be barina ni, amaa timaŋmaŋ gba nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: Men, I see that our voyage from here on will be dangerous; there will be great damage to the cargo and to the ship, and loss of life as well.

dag: Ka Sulemaana yɛli, A daa yur a dabili m ba Dauda pam, o ni daa dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali mini wuntitali ni biɛritibitali o suhu ni la zuɣu, ka a daa yu o yurilim maa tatabo, ka ti o bidibiga ni o ʒin o nam ʒiishee zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.

dag: A ni ti kahi a nɛma yina wuntaŋ ni bɛ ninni kaman nira ni yɛn zo kuŋkɔɣim ka kahi o nɛma shɛm la, ka a ti yi bɛ ninni zaawuni kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la.
en: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di saha maa kpa shɛli din daa kpa luɣ viɛlli shee la ti ku lan beni, bɛ ni ti ŋma li luhi, ka ʒi shɛli din daa ʒi di zuɣu la kpalim yoli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When that happens, the peg that was firmly fastened will pull loose and fall. And that will be the end of everything that was hanging on it. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Hal Yisa mabihi gba daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: Jesus brothers said this because even they did not believe in him.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi nyari taba bee so ti yi n-chaŋ shɛli polo daba ata maa ni zaa. Amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn yaɣili polo zaa daa malila neesim.
en: None of the people could see each other, and no one got up to go any place for three days. But there was light in all the places where the Israelites lived.

dag: Ifriimnim yɛliya, Aa, ti mali buni, ti bo buni zali timaŋa! Amaa bɛ buni maa zaa ku tooi yo bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa samli.
en: We are rich, they say. We've made a fortune. And no one can accuse us of getting rich dishonestly.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpiɔŋlan yi lo kpara n-ʒe n-gul o yili, o nɛma zaa tiligirimi;.
en: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own palace, his possessions are secure.

dag: Yuun pisi zaa ka m be a yiŋa. N tum tuma ti a la yuun pinaanahi a bipuɣins ayi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka gul a biŋkɔbiri mi yuma ayɔbu; ka a taɣi n yɔri siɣimsiɣim bupia.
en: Ive now spent twenty years in your household. I worked for fourteen years for your two daughters and for six years for your flock, and you changed my pay ten times.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ paɣ maa zali Yawɛ tooni ka lɔrigi paɣ maa zabiri, ka zaŋ nyuli zabbu chi sara din yɛn chɛ ka bɛ teei taali tumbu yɛla maa gbibili paɣ maa nuhi ni. Ka maligumaana maa mi kpuɣi kɔtɔɣu din tahiri tibidarigibo na la.
en: Then he shall loosen the woman's hair and put the offering of flour in her hands. In his hands the priest shall hold the bowl containing the bitter water that brings a curse.

dag: Ka so yi yɛli ni o yuri Naawuni ka je o mabia, o nyɛla ʒirilana; dama ŋunkam bi yur o mabi so o nini ni nyari ku tooi yuri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o ni bi nyari so la.
en: If we say we love God, but hate others, we are liars. For we cannot love God, whom we have not seen, if we do not love others, whom we have seen.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so daa ka shɛli din ni yo o, ka o daa chɛ sama maa ti bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu yɛlim ma, bɛ niriba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, ŋuni n-lee ni yuri sandihira ŋɔ gar o kpee.
en: The men had no money, so they could not pay their debt. But the banker told the men that they did not have to pay him. Which one of those two men will love him more.

dag: N daa gbi kɔbilisi, ka nyu tinzun tinsi kom, ka daa siɣi Ijipti kulibɔna ni, ka n naba chɛ ka di kom zaa nyuui.
en: I have dug wells, have drunk waters in foreign lands. With my own feet, I dried up all of Egypts streams.

dag: Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses had also given a part of the land to the families of the tribe of Gad as their possession.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl.
en: Then Samuel received this message from the Lord :.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibi fifinyiiŋa gba ku yiɣisi fashee di zaa ti naɣ niŋla pali.
en: Heaven and earth may disappear. But I promise you not even a period or comma will ever disappear from the Law. Everything written in it must happen.

dag: Ifriim zuliya niriba daa sula nudirigu polo, ka Manaasa zuliya niriba mi su nuzaa polo ka Teeku do bɛ sunsuuni n-nyɛ bɛ tintarisi bolo. Asha daa bela nuzaa polo ka Isaka mi be wulimpuhili polo.
en: The land to the south belonged to Ephraim. And the land to the north belonged to Manasseh. The Mediterranean Sea was the western border. The border touched Ashers land in the north and Issachars land in the east.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan boli niriba pam na ti yɛli ba, Yi zaa luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: Jesus called the people to him again. He said, Everyone should listen to me and understand what I am saying.

dag: Bɛ daa dari chɛchɛbunsi Ijipti la anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu; ka dari yuri mi anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga ni pihinu. Ka naa kɔhigɔriba maa mi daa mali yuri maa n-tomdi kɔhiri Hitinim mini Siria nanim zaa zuɣu.
en: and the export of chariots from Egypt. They supplied the Hittite and Syrian kings with horses and chariots, selling chariots for pieces of silver each and horses for each.

dag: Ŋunkam ti mali dalinli ŋun di mirina, do so ŋun nyɛ zoma bee wɔbiga bee ŋun ninni mali dansi bee ŋun bɔɣu yini gari zaɣ yini.
en: Any man who has something wrong with him must not serve as priest and bring sacrifices to me. These men cannot serve as priests: blind men, crippled men, men with bad scars on their faces, men with arms or legs that are too long.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu bimbir shɛŋa yi ni yɛn biri zuɣu, bimbira maa ni viɛla.
en: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.

dag: Yi nyari suhukpaŋsibo yi ni be Masia ni la zuɣu? Yi nyari suhumaabo o yurilim zuɣu? Yi mini Naawuni Shia Kasi mali simdi ni taba? Yi niŋdi tab nirilim ka zɔri tab nambɔɣu?.
en: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ a nini sɔɣi, ka zaŋ ma leeg a dima?.
en: Why do you avoid me? Why do you treat me like an enemy?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nina ni sabigimi gari sala. So bi lan baŋdi ba soya zuɣu. Bɛ niŋgbuŋgbana kuumi pa bɛ kɔba zuɣu; di kuumi kaman dari la.
en: But their appearance grew darker than soot; they werent recognized in the streets. Their skin shriveled on their bones; it became dry like wood.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti laɣimna ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Then the day came for the angels to meet with the Lord . Even Satan was there with them.

dag: Dama din yɛn niŋ ninsalinima, dina n-yɛn niŋ biŋkɔbiri gba. Ninsalinim kpirimi ka biŋkɔbiri gba kpira. Vuhim yini ka bɛ zaa mali. Ka ninsal bi so biŋkɔbigu. Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi sɔŋbu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni n lab ŋun tim ma na maa sani, dama n yi bi labi, Sɔŋda la ku ka yi sanna; amaa n yi labi, n ni tim o yi sanna.
en: Let me assure you, it is better for you that I go away. I say this because when I go away I will send the Helper to you. But if I did not go, the Helper would not come.

dag: O ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi li niŋ Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kul niŋdi ba fitiina shɛm, lala ka bɛ zuliya maa daa kul nabiri ka yɛligiri pahira. Ka jɛlinsi mini dabiɛm daa kpe Ijiptinim maa suhuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But the more the Egyptians oppressed the Israelites, the more they increased in number and the farther they spread through the land. The Egyptians came to fear the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: But I am not really the one doing the evil. It is sin living in me that does it.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: So the Philistines camped in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ka yuri ti, ka nyɛ ŋun ti ti suhukpaŋsibo din ka bahigu mini tahima suŋ o daanfaani puuni la.
en: We pray that the Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father will comfort you and strengthen you in every good thing you do and say. God loved us and gave us through his grace a wonderful hope and comfort that has no end.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda, ka niŋ man gba yɛda.
en: Do not be worried and upset, Jesus told them. Believe in God and believe also in me.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yubu nyɛla ni ŋunkam nya o Bia la ka niŋ o yɛda ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.

dag: Wummiya vuri! Wummiya, di kanna. Vuri pam n-yi nuzaa polo na ni di ti chɛ ka Juda fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka leei yɔbahi gɔbu shee.
en: Listen! A loud noise! The noise is coming from the north. It will destroy the cities of Judah. Judah will become an empty desert. It will be a home for jackals.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi lihi ma ni n nyɛla a tumtumdikpee, nyin deem o kaman a ni ni deei ma shɛm.
en: So, if you think of me as your partner, welcome him back just as you would welcome me.

dag: Ka ti yi kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti doli Masia n-yi taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa ka nya ka ti nyɛla alahichinima kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, di wuhiri ni Masia nyɛla ŋun ʒe alahichi tumbu nyaaŋa? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!.

dag: Ka yinim Judanima, n zali yi gba dabisili, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn labisi n niriba daazichi ti ba.
en: Judah, there is also a time of harvest for you. It will happen when I bring my people back from captivity.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni vuhi pɔhim shɛli bahi. Bɛ dabisa ŋmanila shilinshia din garita.
en: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi so daa kana nti yɛl o, Karimba, n ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you.

dag: Ti daa yulila sɔŋsim soli hal ka ti nini ti sabi, ti daa yuunila zuliya shɛb soli ni bɛ tiligi ti, ka bɛ daa bi tooi tiligi ti.
en: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋuna n-lan nyɛ n yaa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ti ma tiliginsim. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n ni paɣir o. O nyɛla n yab Naawuni, ka n ni duh o pam.
en: The Lord is my strength, the reason for my song, because he has saved me. I praise and honor the Lord — he is my God and the God of my ancestors.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli mini bɛn be katiŋa, wummiya! Yawɛ daa pun pii ma ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma; n daa na bela m ma pul ni, ka o pun boli n yuli.
en: Listen to me, coastlands; pay attention, peoples far away. The LORD called me before my birth, called my name when I was in my mothers womb.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai, ka o teeg o nuhi min o naba wuhi ba.
en: After Jesus told them this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; ka n niŋ o naani. Ka n nyari sɔŋsim, ka n suhu piɛla; ka n yiini yila paɣir o.
en: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusts him. I was helped, my heart rejoiced, and I thank him with my song.

dag: N je ʒiri, ka zaɣisi li, amaa n yur a zaligu.
en: I hate lies; they make me sick! But I love your teachings.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi bindir shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ.
en: Then the priest will take that part to the altar to be burned up as food, a gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Mɔab. O yaansi n-nyɛ Mɔabnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The older daughter had a son, whom she named Moab. He was the ancestor of the present-day Moabites.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ lee niŋ ka yimaŋmaŋ bi baŋdi din tuhi?.
en: Why don't you understand the right thing to do?.

dag: ka daadam kam ti nya Naawuni tiliginsim. .
en: The whole human race will see God's salvation.

dag: Ka a yi ka shɛli, nyin wumma; foma, ka n wuh a yɛm.
en: But if not, be quiet and listen to me, and I will teach you how to be wise.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord , and he rescued you.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka a biɛli suhuyiɣisili maa ti chɛ.
en: Stay with him for a short time until your brother stops being angry.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbiga bɛn daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai sansani maa shee yuntisuɣu saha tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛli n-dii piɛb bɛ kikahi ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ ni gbib duɣubihi shɛŋa maa.
en: So Gideon and the men with him went to the edge of the enemy camp. They came there just after the enemy changed guards. It was during the middle watch of the night. Gideon and his men blew their trumpets and smashed their jars.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni m-pun nyɛ n naa kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ; ka tumdi tiliginsim tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God, you have been our King for a long time. You have saved us many times on this earth.

dag: Ka naa maa daa tim ti boli Haman na yomyom ni bɛ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ Ɛsta sani ni bɛ ti di ka nyu binnyura maa.
en: Then the king said, Bring Haman quickly so that we may do what Esther asks. So the king and Haman went to the party Esther had prepared for them.

dag: Shɛm mini Aripakishad ni Shɛla.
en: The family line from Shem to Abram is as follows: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah.

dag: N Duuma, luɣim a tiba wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu min a daba bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti a yuli jilima la suhigu. Tim a dabili nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka o nya nambɔzɔbo naa sani. Di saha maa mani n-daa nyɛ ŋun boori wain tiri naa.
en: LORD, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight in honoring your name. Please give success to your servant today and grant him favor in the presence of this man.

dag: Miriya ka yi kpuɣi dimbɔŋɔ gbibi! Miriya ka yi di dimbɔŋɔ! Miriya ka yi shihi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.?.

dag: Dama bɛ ku tooi gbihi ka pa ni bɛ tumla din bi tuhi; bɛ yi bi chɛ ka so tuui, di niŋdi ba la gɔgaliga.
en: They dont sleep unless they do evil; they are robbed of sleep unless they make someone stumble.

dag: Bɛ daa guni ma la daba anii dali. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Izraɛl nira. N yila Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Hiburu alali. Ka zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim zaligunim mi dolibu polo n daa nyɛla Farisii;.
en: I was circumcised on the eighth day. I am from the people of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a Hebrew of the Hebrews. With respect to observing the Law, Im a Pharisee.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dahin shɛli chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin bomiya kuɣ kara n-niŋ tari ta li.
en: You will soon go across the Jordan River into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. On that day you must put up large stones. Cover them with plaster.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ʒini yi sani. Guliya ti ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ti maa ku paai ti. Ŋun nahindi ti maa yi ti lan kani, saɣiŋgu maa ni zani tariga; ka ninvuɣ kuriba maa gba ku lan be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Let our people live in your country and find safety here. Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.

dag: Saɣiŋgu! Dabari zanibu! Saɣiŋgu! Niriba suhuri ŋooya, ka bɛ duna ŋmɛri taba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ nina mɔhi zaa.
en: Nineveh is destroyed, deserted, desolate! Hearts melt with fear; knees tremble, strength is gone; faces grow pale.

dag: N yi tɛhi Naawuni yɛla, n kul ŋuhirimi, ka n yi kul zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋ suhir o, gbariginsim nti kpɛri n ni.
en: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔri ni o bahi Yisa, dinzuɣu ka o daa lan lab tɔɣisi ba di yɛla maa;.
en: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he spoke again to the crowds.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka di sabi Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛli ti Musa ni o ti niriba maa la puuni ni Izraɛlnim yi ti yɛn puhi chuɣ shɛli bɛ ni puhiri chira ayopɔin ni la, bɛn be suɣa ni.
en: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.

dag: Yi ni tooi bɔhi yimaŋa, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bi yɛli.
en: You may wonder how you can tell when a prophet's message does not come from the Lord .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ kum shɛli ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn kpi la polo yɛla niŋ pali.
en: This was so that Jesus word might be fulfilled when he indicated how he was going to die.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o ma min o ni daa yuri nyaandol so la ʒe nimaani maa, ka o yɛl o ma, N-nyɛ a bia.
en: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, This man is now your son.

dag: Yi yi ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dindina n ni lan chɛ ka yi nya yaa, ka n ku lan daai ya luhi. N ni zaŋ ya sa, ka ku lan vuɣi ya, dama n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa, di lan niŋ ma yoli pam. .
en: If you live in this land, I will build you up and not pull you down. I will plant you and not dig you up because I grieve over the disaster I have brought upon you.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bi niŋ yɛlimaŋli la yɛda, amaa ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla alahichi tumbu nyaɣisim zuɣu la ni ti nya saria karibu.
en: The result will be that everyone will be judged who is not convinced by the truth but is happy with injustice.

dag: Bɛ dimi ŋmɛlim, ka bɛ niŋgbuna be polipoli. Bɛ tuumbiɛri ka tariga. Bɛ bi doli zaligu soli n-kariti kpibisi saria tiri ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔŋ, bɛ mi bi zabiri nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: why they are fat and well fed. There is no limit to their evil deeds. They do not give orphans their rights or show justice to the oppressed.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yisa daa yi yiŋ chaŋ ti ʒini teeku duli.
en: That same day Jesus left the house and went out beside Lake Galilee, where he sat down to teach.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu kana ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni booni Naawuni sara maligu bimbini la. Ka niriba ni ti kumdi ka fabinda, ka tiŋ maa zaa ni be kaman ʒim ni ŋam sara maligu bimbin shɛli.
en: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilisi tibili wum n siɣimbu.
en: Lord , listen to me and understand what I am trying to say.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha, ka Omri bia Ɛhab daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya ʒinila Samaria n-su Izraɛlnim la yuun pisinaayi.
en: In the thirty-eighth year of Judahs King Asa, Ahab, Omris son, became king of Israel. He ruled over Israel in Samaria for twenty-two years.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal tiŋgbani yi damda, ka zoya vuuri ti luri teeku kɔbulli ni;.
en: So we are not afraid when the earth quakes and the mountains fall into the sea.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Zaŋ chaŋ yuun yini saha din nyɛ kaman bɛ ni bu tumtumda so paa tuma yuma tariga saha, Kɛdar jilima ni zan tariga.
en: Then the Lord said to me, In exactly one year the greatness of the tribes of Kedar will be at an end.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be zibisim ni yipa nya neesim titali. Bɛn daa be zibisim tital ni, neesim neei paai ba.
en: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light. On those living in a pitch-dark land, light has dawned.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni yi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria, o sariakaribo maa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisahaku daa suhi alibarika din ti yɛn kana saha shɛli n-niŋ Yaakubu mini Iso ni.
en: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Do so paɣ yi birigi, ka bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o yidan sani.
en: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o di nyɛvili ŋɔ nyaɣisim ka nya dabisi suma, ŋun gbaam o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu, ka mi di chɛ ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa yir o nol ni na.
en: As the scripture says, If you want to enjoy life and wish to see good times, you must keep from speaking evil and stop telling lies.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim kari dunianim saria, dama nyini n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: Come, O God, and rule the world; all the nations are yours.

dag: Saha shɛli ha o daa ka a buchi, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun mali buchi m min a zaa sani.
en: At one time he was of no use to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.

dag: A wuntitali la zuɣu, yihim ma ka fa ma bahi. Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma.
en: Because you are righteous, help me and rescue me. Listen to me and save me!.

dag: Ka yi mi nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ zuliya shɛba shɛlikam zaa yi zuɣu la; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi ba tin ya.
en: Youve seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you. It is the LORD your God who fights for you.

dag: Laabira salo ŋɔ ʒi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, lala zuɣu Naawuni noli ni di ba.
en: This crowd does not know the Law of Moses, so they are under God's curse.

dag: Di saha ka o kuhi yɛli, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda nyaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: So the blind man shouted, Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ti nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri n-lee mali suhupiɛlli. Tuumbiɛtumdiba biɛhigu kul tɔŋdimi, ka pa di kɔŋko, hal bɛ yi buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya, binshɛli bi niŋdi ba. .
en: We think proud people are happy. Evil people succeed. They do evil things to test Gods patience, and God does not punish them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti niŋ bindirigu ti o nimaani, ka Maata kpuɣ bindirigu maa na ti zali, ka Lazarɔs gba daa be bɛn ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa ni.
en: There they had a dinner for Jesus. Martha served the food, and Lazarus was one of the people eating with Jesus.

dag: ka nyo bɛ buɣa buɣim; dama buɣa maa pala Naawuni; amaa di nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛli, ka di nyɛ dari mini kuɣa, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa saɣim li maa.
en: The Assyrians burned the gods of those nations with fire because they arent real gods. They are only man-made creations of wood and stone. Thats how the Assyrians could destroy them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Ramɛsis n-chaŋ Sukɔt, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu m-pahi paɣiba mini bihi.
en: The Israelites traveled from Rameses to Succoth. There were about , men, not counting the small boys.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa nim kpillikpilli mini zuɣu ti o, ka o nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: They handed him the entirely burned offering in pieces, including the head, and he completely burned them on the altar.

dag: N daa mali suhupiɛlli o dunia din pali binnɛma ŋɔ zuɣu, ka mali suhupiɛlli ninsalinim zuɣu.
en: happy with the world and pleased with the human race.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ, gbaam amaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-malila biɛr kasi mini wuntitali ni yɛda ni yurilim ni ania niŋbu ni biɛribaalimtali.
en: But you, man of God, avoid all these things. Strive for righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.

dag: Dama so na mi n-yɛli Naawuni, N nyɛla alahichilana, amaa n ku lan tum lala yaha.
en: Has Job said to God, I have borne punishment; I wont sin again?.

dag: Zaŋmiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nina ka nyɛ zoomba la na, ka zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tiba ka nyɛ tikpiranim la na.
en: Bring out the people who have eyes but are blind. Bring out the people who have ears but are deaf.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpamba ni Ijiptinim zaa daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa ka kuŋ mɔni Ijipti fɔŋ ni zaa, dama yili shɛli daa kani ka kum bi ku nimaani.
en: That night someone died in every house in Egypt. Pharaoh, his officials, and all the people of Egypt began to cry loudly.

dag: Ka salo maa ni niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra n-teeri sɔŋdi sol ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb mi ŋahiri tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: A large crowd of people spread their cloaks on the road while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

dag: N ni dɔni gbihi ni suhudoo; dama nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-chɛ ka n dooni ni alaafee.
en: I will lie down and fall asleep in peace because you alone, LORD, let me live in safety.

dag: Saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi yɛn liri nira? Yi zaa yɛn bula yi ni gbaai ninvuɣ so, kaman yi ni yɛn niŋ dikili ŋmaŋ bee kikara din kab ŋuniya m-bɔri ni di lu shɛm la?.
en: How long will all of you attack others; how long will you tear them down as if they were leaning walls or broken-down fences?.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba ŋɔ bɛn kpe yɔɣu ka bi lan labina? Bɛ dolila yɔhiŋ soli ka zaɣisi labbuna.
en: The people of Judah went the wrong way. But why do the people of Jerusalem continue going the wrong way? They believe their own lies. They refuse to turn around and come back.

dag: Miriya ka yi kpuɣi dimbɔŋɔ gbibi! Miriya ka yi di dimbɔŋɔ! Miriya ka yi shihi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Dont handle! Dont taste! Dont touch.

dag: Daabihi ni saɣi di o daa? Bɛ ni saɣi pirig o ti kɔhigɔriba?.
en: Will fishermen try to buy him from you? Will they cut him into pieces and sell him to the merchants?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa bahi noli ka bɛ mali duri maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka n daa labisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lahi mini chi ni kawana sara ni tulaale zim la niŋ di ni.
en: Then I gave orders that the rooms be purified, and I put back the temple equipment, along with the grain offering and the incense.

dag: A yi niŋ Naawuni ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ, dindina a wumsim maa ni baligi. Ka niriba ŋɔ zaa ni lab bɛ biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: If you do this as God directs you, then you will be able to do your job without tiring yourself out. And the people can still have all their problems solved before they return home.

dag: Bɛ buɣa maa ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa zali watamilo puu ni n-varisiri binnɛma, ka bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la. Niriba n-kpuɣiri ba chana, dama bɛ ku tooi chaŋ. Miriya ka yi zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ mi ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: The idols of the other nations are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field. They cannot walk. They cannot talk, and the people must carry them. So dont be afraid of their idols. They cannot hurt you. And they cannot help you either.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa doli ti mini Pool kuhiri yɛra, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Zallakudura Naa daba bɛn wuhiri ya tiliginsim soli.
en: She began following Paul and us, shouting, These people are servants of the Most High God! They are proclaiming a way of salvation to you.

dag: Dama dabisili maa miriya. Yawɛ dabisili maa miriya; di ni ti nyɛla sagbana dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla mbusim dabisili zuliya kam sani.
en: The day is near, the day when the Lord will act, A day of clouds and trouble for the nations.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba chaŋ Ribila nti ti Babilɔn naa.
en: Nebuzaradan led them to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar had them killed. The people of Judah no longer lived in their own country.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ yi nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ, ka yi zaa yinoyino nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.

dag: Shɛkania bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya. Ka Shɛmaya bidibisi daa nyɛ Hatush mini Igal ni Baria ni Niaria ni Shafat, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayɔbu.
en: Shecaniahs family: Shemaiah and his family, Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six in all.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o doli yuri dunoli polo nti kpe nayili n-ku o nimaani.
en: They seized her, took her to the palace, and there at the Horse Gate they killed her.

dag: Ka o paɣ Zipɔra daa bo kuɣili din dira n-gun o bidibiga, ka zaŋ di ʒim ʒe Musa naba ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ, a nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: But Zipporah circumcised her son with a flint knife. She touched his legs with the skin she had cut off and said, My dear son, this blood will protect you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ ti kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: Jesus left that place and went into their synagogue.

dag: Ka yɛli Izraɛlnima, Zaŋmiya bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ naɣibil ŋun paai yuuni mini piɛbil ŋun paai yuuni m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la;.
en: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord . The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun bo o kpee paɣa. Ŋunkam shihi paɣa maa ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: So is the man who approaches his neighbors wife; anyone who touches her will be punished.

dag: N yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi zaa ha polo kul zoorimi pahira Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ami!.
en: My love is with all of you in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka n daa ta ba daɣiri bɛmaŋmaŋ pina tibu ni din nyɛ bɛ bidib tuuli kam zaŋ mali sara puuni ni di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri saɣim din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I defiled them with their very gifts when they offered up all their oldest children. They were supposed to be so horrified that they would acknowledge that I am the LORD.

dag: N ni kum ka fabili zoya zuɣu, ka fabili mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu, dama di bahila yoli doya ka so bi lan gariti nimaani. So bi lan wumdi niɣi kumsi nimaani. Noombihi mini biŋkɔbiri zaa yi nimaani zo.
en: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi dabisa ti nabi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ ti yi yaannim la ni n-yuui nimaani kaman sagbana ni be tiŋgbani zuɣusaa shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.

dag: Yi bipuɣinsi yi gɔri pagɔrisigu, m bi yɛn darigi bɛ tibili bee n-darigi yi bihi paɣiba tibili bɛ yi niŋ zina. Dama yi dɔbba maŋmaŋ gba chana ka bɛ mini buɣa ni pagɔra ti doona kaman buɣa maligu la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛm bahi yoli.
en: I cannot blame your daughters or your daughters-in-law for doing this, because your men go and have sex with the temple prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them. This is how foolish people destroy themselves.

dag: Amaa ti yi niŋ tahima ti nini ni na bi nya shɛli zuɣu, dindina ti ni di suɣilo guhiri li.
en: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.

dag: Pahatimɔab daŋ ni: Adina mini Kɛlal ni Bɛnaaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Matania so yaha ni Bɛzalɛl ni Binnui ni Manaasa.
en: From the descendants of Pahath Moab, these men: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

dag: Wuntizɔriba alibarika duhirila tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri noli ni yɛtɔɣa wurindila tiŋa.
en: Blessings from the honest people living in a city will make it great, but the things evil people say can destroy it.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina, ka Pool balim niriba maa zaa ni bɛ dim bindirigu ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ pahirila biɛɣ pinaanahi ka nandahima mali ya ka yi bi di bindirigu.
en: Just before dawn, Paul begged them all to eat some food: You have been waiting for fourteen days now, and all this time you have not eaten a thing.

dag: Bee a ʒiɛmla Naawuni nirilim din galisi min o nambɔzɔbo ni o suɣilɔdibo la? A bi mi ni din chɛ ka Naawuni niŋd a nirilim maa nyɛla o bɔrimi ni a niŋ tuuba?.
en: Or perhaps you despise his great kindness, tolerance, and patience. Surely you know that God is kind, because he is trying to lead you to repent.

dag: Man Pool mini Timoti bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia daba la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la mini cheechi zuɣulaannim ni sɔŋdiba bɛn be Filipai.
en: From Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus. To all those in Philippi who are Gods people in Christ Jesus, along with your supervisors and servants.

dag: O daa yɛli Yisifu zuliya: Yawɛ daalibarika ni be o tiŋgban ni m-pahi zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani puuni pin gahinda.
en: Moses said this about Joseph: May the Lord bless Josephs land with rain from the skies above and water from the ground below.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi li ka di leei Naawuni chuɣu yuuni puuni. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka di simdi ka yi gbib li la gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa ni.
en: You will celebrate this festival to the LORD for seven days each year; this is a permanent rule throughout your future generations. You will celebrate it in the seventh month.

dag: ni yi ni ti tiligi m ba mini m ma ni m mabihi ni bɛ ni su shɛb zaa, ka fa ti nyɛviya kum ni bahi.
en: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.

dag: O zaŋ o lɔɣu ni piɛm to n suhu.
en: He shot his arrows deep into my body.

dag: ni Bɛtiharam vinvamli ni Bɛtinimira ni Sukɔt ni Zafɔn ni Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli daa nyɛ di tiŋgbani tariga zaŋ chaŋ ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku tariga ha sirigili zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la.
en: In the Jordan Valley it included Beth Haram, Bethnimrah, Sukkoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of King Sihon of Heshbon. Their western border was the Jordan River as far north as Lake Galilee.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Praise the Lord because he is good! His faithful love will last forever!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa daa niŋmi ni ti Duuma ni daa chɛ ka anab so yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Now all this happened in order to make come true what the Lord had said through the prophet.

dag: A daanab shɛb bɛn daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛri ni Babilɔn naa ku kana ti tuh a bee n-tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim la lee be ya?.
en: King Zedekiah, where are your prophets now? They told you a false message. They said, The king of Babylon will not attack you or this land of Judah.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li dindali maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni dindali maa kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Lakishinim shɛm la.
en: captured it that same day, then killed everyone, as they had done at Lachish.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka o wum vu shɛli damli ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.

dag: ka zaɣisi n saɣisigunima, ka lihi ʒiɛm n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.

dag: Bahi n-kul gili ma; tuumbiɛtumdiba pam n-teei gili ma. Bɛ malila binyara kuhiri n nuhi mini n naba.
en: The dogs are all around me— a pack of evil people has trapped me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

dag: Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba: Sɔtai daŋ niriba mini Sofɛrɛt daŋ niriba ni Pɛrida daŋ niriba.
en: The descendants of Solomons servants: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi, ka o daa fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bia la.
en: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord , and he sent someone to free them. This was Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n nya a jilima.
en: Moses said, Please show me your glorious presence.

dag: Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn la bɛn daa pun deei bɛ tarili. Yawɛ dabili Musa n-daa pun pirigi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the other half of the tribe of Manasseh had already received all their land. The Lord s servant, Moses, gave them the land east of the Jordan River.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi tɛhiya ni n tahila puli niŋbu na ka ku tahi di dɔɣibu na?.
en: Will I open the womb and not bring to birth? says the LORD. Will I, who create life, close the womb? says your God.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul kuhirimi ni n suhu zaa, garigim ma, n ni dol a zaligunima.
en: I cry out with all my heart: LORD, answer me so I can guard your statutes.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim mali galimi o sani. Ʒiɛyimtali lan kani, ka nirilim lan kani, ka so bi lan mi Naawuni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Hear the LORDs word, people of Israel; for the LORD has a dispute with the inhabitants of the land. Theres no faithful love or loyalty, and no knowledge of God in the land.

dag: ka daa me binwɔɣila mini Ashɛra binnana zalizali zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: On all the hills and under every shady tree they put up stone pillars and images of the goddess Asherah.

dag: Pa Zallakudura Naa n-zaani zaɣ viɛlli mini zaɣ biɛɣu ka di niŋda?.
en: From the mouth of the Most High evil things dont come, but rather good!.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman mɔpilli zuɣu mɔri, din ni kpi ka na bi zooi.
en: May they all be like grass growing on the housetops, which dries up before it can grow;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa duhi Sulemaana pam Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka lan chɛ ka o nam mali dariza pam gari na shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ o tooni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa.
en: The Lord made the whole nation stand in awe of Solomon, and he made him more glorious than any other king that had ruled Israel.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa suhi Yawɛ ti o paɣ maa, dama o daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo; ka Yawɛ daa deeg o suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka o paɣ Ribɛka niŋ pua.
en: Isaac prayed to the LORD for his wife, since she was unable to have children. The LORD was moved by his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

dag: Yi ni daa fa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya nɛma, ka ku ba la zuɣu, yi ni di vi, ka n kpihim yi birili hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You will be covered with shame because you were very cruel to your brother Jacob. So you will be destroyed completely.

dag: Miriya ka yi chaŋ hal ka yi naba ti fuɣi bee n-chɛ ka kɔnyuri kuui yi lɔna. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti bɔrila saamba, saamba ka ti kul ni jɛmda.
en: Judah, stop chasing after idols! Stop wanting those other gods. But you say, It is no use! I cannot stop! I love those other gods. I cant stop chasing them.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama n ni be a sani din ni fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Dont be afraid of anyone. I am with you, and I will protect you. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka niriba booni ya bɛ duumanima, dama Duuma yino kɔŋko ka yi mali, ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Dont be called teacher , because Christ is your one teacher.

dag: Yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma m-bo yɛlli ŋɔ tin ya. Di mali ya. Di biɛri pam! Di nyooi yi suhuri.
en: People of Judah, your hearts will be in pain, but it's your own fault that you will be punished.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋdi binyɛra paŋdi ya, amaa yinim ti ku zaŋ shɛli paŋ ba. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ zuɣu, ka yi nyɛ zuli.
en: The foreigners will have money to loan you, but you will not have any money to loan them. They will control you the way the head controls the body. You will be like the tail.

dag: N ni daa nya li yuŋ maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɔhim n-daa kul ʒiɛri kpari luɣ shɛlikam teeku kom zuɣu.
en: Daniel said, I saw my vision at night. In the vision the wind was blowing from all four directions. These winds made the sea rough.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaanu mini chi kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pihinu yo o zuɣu.
en: So I paid pieces of silver and about kilograms of grain for such a woman.

dag: N ni zaŋ nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam maa yihi ya yi ni wurim be zuliya shɛb sani tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa zaa ni na.
en: and my power, when I gather you from the places where you are scattered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-yɛn daŋ chandi, m pun zaŋ tiŋgbani maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni.
en: The Lord said to the Israelites, The tribe of Judah will go. I will let them take this land.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi: Labimiya ti yɛli yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tu ma la zuɣu.
en: he sent back this answer: The Lord tells you not to let the Assyrians frighten you with their claims that he cannot save you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan bol li Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Ninvuɣ kubo Vinvamli. Dama bɛ ni ti sɔɣi ba Tɔfɛt hal ka palo ti lan kani.
en: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul beni n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma, ka mali tampiɛlli din be kaman mukur la lɔr o shee ni.
en: Now Samuel was serving the LORD. He was a young boy, clothed in a linen priestly vest.

dag: Chɛ ka zuliya kam suhuri paligi, chɛ ka bɛ yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama a kariti niriba saria ka di tuhi, ka wuhiri zuliya kam soli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Let the people celebrate and shout with joy because you judge the nations fairly and guide all nations on the earth. Selah.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la Naawuni n-ti o tumo Yisa jilima maa; Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani nti di o saria ka o daa bɔri ni o bah o ka yi zaɣisi la.
en: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our ancestors, has given divine glory to his Servant Jesus. But you handed him over to the authorities, and you rejected him in Pilate's presence, even after Pilate had decided to set him free.

dag: A ni ti nya n ni yɛn niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka di biɛr a ka a zabiri ba nyuli; amaa nyin daŋ ni so ku lan nya kɔb piɛlli o zuɣu ni hal abada.
en: Good things will happen to Israel, but you will see bad things happening at home. No one in your family will live to be an old man.

dag: O nyɛla Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni be, ka dunianim ku tooi deeg o, dama bɛ bi nyar o, bɛ mi bi mi o; amaa yinim mi o, dama o be yi sani ka ni ti be yi ni.
en: He is the Spirit, who reveals the truth about God. The world cannot receive him, because it cannot see him or know him. But you know him, because he remains with you and is in you.

dag: ka zooi kaman tia ni zoori shɛm. A daa zooya niŋ wɔɣilim m-bi paɣa. A daa yi biha, ka a tooni bili kɔbiri, amaa a daa na bela a zaɣim.
en: I helped you grow like a plant in the field. You grew and grew. You became a young woman: your periods began, your breasts grew, and your hair began to grow. But you were still bare and naked.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm ti ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ. Ti mali niriba anahi bɛn po pɔri.
en: This is what we want you to do. There are four men here who have taken a vow.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni nir ŋubi nimdi bee n-nyu dam bee n-niŋ binshɛli din ni chɛ ka o kpee tuui lu.
en: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.

dag: Ka Giliad sapashinnim daa bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni chaŋ ti piligi Ammɔnnim ŋɔ tuhibu? Dilan ni leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: Gileads rulers said to each other, Whoever is willing to launch the attack against the Ammonites will become the leader over all those living in Gilead.

dag: Ka malaika maa lan yɛli Zakaria, Mani n-nyɛ malaika Gabirɛl ŋun ʒe Naawuni tooni la, ka o tim ma na ni n ti ti a lahibal suŋ ŋɔ.
en: I am Gabriel, the angel answered. I stand in the presence of God, who sent me to speak to you and tell you this good news.

dag: di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so nti yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa ti ma.
en: Nevertheless, you yourself wont build that temple. Instead, your very own son will build the temple for my name.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔs daa garigi yɛli Amazia, M pala anabi, m mi pala anabi bia; amaa n nyɛla biŋkɔbigula ni ŋun sari fiig tihi.
en: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma daa pii ninvuɣ pisopɔin n-tim ba niriba ayiyi ni bɛ daŋ o tooni chaŋ tin shɛŋa zaa omaŋmaŋ gba ni daa yɛn chaŋ.
en: After this, the Lord chose more followers. He sent them out in groups of two. He sent them ahead of him into every town and place where he planned to go.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn yi samban ni niriba sani, di simdi ka bɛ yeei bɛ ni ye neen shɛŋa tum tuma maa sɔŋ du kasinim la ni, ka taɣi neen shɛŋa ye din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku ye bɛ nɛma maa n-zaŋ kasitali maa chaŋ niriba maa sani.
en: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛriya mi, Wummiya; chɛliya ka n gba yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: Therefore, I say: Listen to me; Ill state my view, even I.

dag: O labisi n yaa ti ma. O wuhi ma soya din tuhi o yuli zuɣu.
en: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be Yisa sani saha shɛl o ni daa neei Lazarɔs kum ni gballi ni la daa di o shɛhira.
en: There were many people with Jesus when he raised Lazarus from death and told him to come out of the tomb. Now they were telling others about what Jesus did.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa tiɣi Naawuni nin la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa ka daa na bi nya Naawuni ni daa lo ba binshɛŋa alikauli la;.
en: What a record all of these have won by their faith! Yet they did not receive what God had promised.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim maa bɛn tim bɛ suɣa gili alikauli suɣili maa n-gul li, ka Naawuni suhu ti ku yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: But the Levites shall camp around the Tent to guard it, so that no one may come near and cause my anger to strike the community of Israel.

dag: Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni daba mini bilichinnima ni dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bi be kɔŋkɔba; yi zaa nyɛla zaɣ yini Yisa Masia ni.
en: There is neither Jew nor Greek; there is neither slave nor free; nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be palli zuɣu la, pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be daa ni la. O daa kul dola lɔriga kam ni guhira.
en: She walked the streets, always looking for someone to trap.

dag: Zaŋmi dam din kpɛma n-ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn kpi, ka zaŋ wain ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nandahima pam ni.
en: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.

dag: Yi ni ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, amaa di ti chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: You will hear about wars that are being fought. And you will hear stories about other wars beginning. But dont be afraid. These things must happen before the end comes.

dag: O ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naai, o daa zaŋ ma mi doli duno shɛli din be wulimpuhili polo la yi nti buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa palo zaa gili.
en: The man had finished measuring inside the Temple area. Then he brought me out through the east gate and measured all around that area.

dag: Daadam Bia ni chaŋ kaman di ni ʒe o shɛm, amaa mbusim be ŋun yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will do what God has planned. But it will be very bad for the one who hands over the Son of Man to be killed.

dag: Hal sakpaleensi mɛrila bɛ duri, ka ŋmanʒiɛhi mali bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛri a jɛmbu duu puuni; ka mali bɛ bihi sɔŋdi baɣind a sara maligu bimbini; nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ n naa ni n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Even the sparrows have built a nest, and the swallows have their own home; they keep their young near your altars, Lord Almighty, my king and my God.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya nira ni o mabia: Saimɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.

dag: Ka Samsin bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, M poya ni n ku chɛn ya, faashee ka m bɔhi ya biɛri labisi ka naanyi chɛ.
en: Then Samson said to the Philistines, You did this bad thing to me, so now I will do bad things to you. Then I will be finished with you.

dag: Ka n yi vuɣi ba, di nyaaŋa n ni lan zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni.
en: But after I have taken them away, I will have mercy on them; I will bring each nation back to its own land and to its own country.

dag: Ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni tiligi, amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli ni ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: Those who walk in innocence will be saved, but those who go on twisted paths will fall into the grave.

dag: Ka yaɣ din la gba daa mali lala; lɔndo maa dunoli nudirigu mini nuzaa polo zaa daa malila pateesanim din wɔɣilim daa pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: The wall of curtains on the other side of the entrance was also cubits long. There were three posts and three bases on that side.

dag: Ka a lihi bɛ ni m-piig a nin ni tiɣi paɣisar so n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee. Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa tiɣi naa nini ka o shiri niŋ lala.
en: Let the young woman who pleases you the most take Vashtis place as queen. The king liked the plan and implemented it.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee m-bilina zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: But a few seeds did fall on good ground where the plants grew and produced or or even times as much as was scattered.

dag: Ka Ai naa ni daa nya Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa, o min o tiŋ maa ni niriba zaa daa niŋla yomyom n-daŋ yibu asibaasi n-kab sirigi Araba zolɔŋni ni bɛ mini Izraɛlnim ti tuhi. Amaa bɛ daa bi mi ni tɔbbihi sɔɣ do bɛ tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa.
en: When the king of Ai saw Joshua's men, he acted quickly. He and all his men went out toward the Jordan Valley to fight the Israelites at the same place as before, not knowing that he was about to be attacked from the rear.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan zaŋ o nuhi shihi o nina maa; ka zom maa lan neeg o nina lihi yaha, ka o nina maa dii neei zaa, ka o nyari binshɛɣukam viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Jesus again placed his hands on the man's eyes. This time the man looked intently, his eyesight returned, and he saw everything clearly.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛya, ka naa ŋmalig o nini bahi bɛ polo n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ bɛ zaa ni.
en: As the people stood there, King Solomon turned to face them, and he asked God's blessing on them.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni dunia ŋɔ ni, n ku lan nya Yawɛ bee ninsala yaha.
en: So I said, I will not see the Lord YAH in the land of the living again. I will not see the people living on earth.

dag: Ka a yɛli niriba maa, Yi yɛn kpɛla yi dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya ka be Ɛdom la tiŋgban ni gari, bɛ ni zɔri ya dabiɛm. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa.
en: And give the people these orders: Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun birigi ka chɛ yɛm soli ni chaŋ ti pahi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: Death is waiting for anyone who wanders away from good sense.

dag: Daadam, nyama, bɛn Izraɛlnim yɛra, O ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa yuma na galisiya, ka o daanabitali maa nyɛ saha shɛli din be katiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: Mortal man, the Israelites think that your visions and prophecies are about the distant future.

dag: Ka sokam zaa nya li ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-niŋ li. Bɛ ni baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di niŋ maa.
en: I will do this so that people will see it and know who did it. They will notice what happened. Then they will understand that the Lord s hand made it happen, that the Holy One of Israel created it all.

dag: N na bi birigi zaligu shɛli din daa yi o noli ni na, n zaŋ o noli ni yɛligu niŋ n suhu ni.
en: I always obey his commands. I love the words from his mouth more than I love my food.

dag: Dama Aram mini Ifriim zuliya ni Rɛmalia bia maa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka yɛra.
en: their evil threats.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun daa sabiri bina yɛla zaani la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka lab Hɛzɛkia sanna nti yɛl o Rabishake maa ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Hilkiahs son Eliakim, who was the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Asaphs son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with ripped clothes. They told him what the field commander had said.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa shiri biɛra, hal ti yɛn kpimi gba; amaa ka Naawuni daa zo o nambɔɣu, ka di pala o kɔŋko ka o daa zo nambɔɣu maa, amaa zaŋ tabili man gba ni di chɛ ka n ku mali nandahima n-lan pahi.
en: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.

dag: Yinim danyuriba, yiɣisimiya kum; yinim wain nyuriba zaa, kummiya wain nyaɣisili la zuɣu, dama yi noli ŋmaala di nyubu maa.
en: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.

dag: O nuhi tuma nyɛla din ʒe yim ka tuhi. O zaligunim zaa mali naani niŋbu.
en: Everything he does is good and fair. All his commands can be trusted.

dag: O chɛ ka goli mini saŋmarisi su yuŋ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The moon and the stars to rule the night— Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa ka o sanna siɣimsiɣim buyi nti yɛl o ni o miri ka o jɛm buɣa la zaa yoli; Sulemaana daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o jɛmbu. Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ Sulemaana.
en: The LORD grew angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from being with the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya, ŋuna n-nyɛ yi naa, ka m mi kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi zaa, ka m bidibisi be yi sani. N nachimbilim ni mi ka n kul be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: and now you have him to lead you. As for me, I am old and gray, and my sons are with you. I have been your leader from my youth until now.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab sabbu shɛli Giriikili ni mini Latinli ni ni Hiburuli ni n-tabili o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka bɛ daa sab li: Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Above him were written these words: This is the King of the Jews.

dag: Ka n daa nya Piɛbil maa ni tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ni zaɣ yini, ka wum ka binnɛma anahi maa ni zaɣ yino ŋun kukoli ŋmani saa tahigu kuhi yɛli, Kamina.
en: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, Come out.

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa wum Ahaz ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ Damaskus nti ŋme n-nyaŋ ba, ka ku Rɛzin; ka gbahi di niriba n-kuli Kɛɛr nti leei daba.
en: Tiglath Pileser, in answer to Ahaz' plea, marched out with his army against Damascus, captured it, killed King Rezin, and took the people to Kir as prisoners.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya n ni tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa alizanda ni na shɛm.
en: The Lord commanded Moses to tell the Israelites: You have seen how I, the Lord , have spoken to you from heaven.

dag: M bi lan yɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ, dama n labirila a sanna, amaa bɛn kul ni beni. M Ba Suŋ, gbib ba a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm.
en: Now I am coming to you. I will not stay in the world, but these followers of mine are still in the world. Holy Father, keep them safe by the power of your name—the name you gave me. Then they will be one, just as you and I are one.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti pii wuntizɔr so Dauda daŋ ni, ka o ti di nam n-zaŋ yɛm su niriba, ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntitali tuma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: This message is from the Lord : The time is coming, when I will raise up a good branch from Davids family. He will be a king who will rule in a wise way. He will do what is fair and right in the land.

dag: Dimiya li, di nyɛla din be kasi. Dɔbba kɔŋko n-ni tooi di li. Di nyɛla din be kasi yi sani.
en: You must eat these things in a holy place, and only males may eat them; consider them holy.

dag: Bɛ yi ti muɣisi ya tin shɛl ni, yin yimiya ni n-taɣi tiŋa; dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi na ku chaŋ tuui Izraɛl tinsi zaa ka Daadam Bia labina.
en: When they persecute you in one town, run away to another one. I assure you that you will not finish your work in all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

dag: Kpɛmiya kuɣa voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni.
en: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.

dag: Di chɛ ka a nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpɛh a alahichi ni. A mi miri ka a ti yɛli adiini karimba ni pa lala ka a di yɛli. Di chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu a yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka a tuma bahi yoli.
en: Dont let your mouth make a sinner of you, and dont say to the messenger: It was a mistake! Otherwise, God may become angry at such talk and destroy what you have accomplished.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti Asiria naa maa nuu ni, ka dunia ŋɔ nama zaa niriba baŋ ni a kɔŋko n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: But you are our Lord and our God! We ask you to keep us safe from the Assyrian king. Then everyone in every kingdom on earth will know that you are the only Lord .

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba shɛb daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli salo bɛn daa laɣim maa zaa.
en: Then some of the elders stood up and spoke to all the people.

dag: Di simdi ni a vili zaɣ yini gbibi, amaa ka di chɛ din la gba bahi; dama ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Naawuni ni tooi gbibi di bina ayi maa zaa.
en: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yisahaku zuliya jɛmbu shee saɣim; ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim sara maligu bimbin la shee saɣim; chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam zuliya zaa.
en: The shrines of Isaac will be made desolate, and the holy places of Israel will be laid waste, and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn kpalim la daa pah o zuɣu n-dol o bilikɔnsi soli maa hal ka Baanabas gba daa birigi pahi bɛ zuɣu n-doli bɛ bilikɔnsi soli maa.
en: And the rest of the Jews also joined him in this hypocrisy so that even Barnabas got carried away with them in their hypocrisy.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai ka Yisa nyaandoliba ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the followers came to Jesus. They said, We will prepare everything for you to eat the Passover meal. Where do you want us to have the meal.

dag: ni Arivadnim ni Zɛmarinim ni Hamatinima. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Keenannim daa ti yɛligi chaŋ katiŋa.
en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. After this the Canaanite clans were dispersed.

dag: Ka ti yaannim maa daa zaɣis o noli, ka woligi bɛmaŋa ka chɛ o, ka daa paɣila Ijipti labbu bɛ suhuri ni.
en: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn goon titali ŋɔ ni ti lu tiŋgban ni dahim, ka di dunɔdaya din du pam la ti di buɣim. Niriba maa daa kul nahimla bɛmaŋ yoli, di daa kul wum ba la yoli, ka buɣim ti yɛn di li.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Babylons massive walls will come down, down to the ground; and its high gates will be burned to the ground. People labor in vain; nations toil for nothing but ashes!.

dag: Hal bɛ daa timla tuumba katinsi ni bɛ ti boli dɔbba ti ba, ka bɛ daa shiri kana. Bɛ zuɣu ka a su kom, ka bali chilo, ka zaŋ yɛ viɛla ye.
en: They sent messengers to attract men from far away. When those men arrived, the two sisters bathed themselves and put on eye shadow and jewelry.

dag: N dimnim yi ŋmaligi, bɛ tuurimi lu n-kpi a tooni.
en: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam n sani, hal di nyaɣisi n nol ni pam gari shiri!.
en: Your words are so sweet to me, like the taste of honey!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ a ni ti be n sani Naawuni yili.
en: Jesus said to him, I promise you that today you will be in Paradise with me.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Aduna zuliya ni.
en: The Lord remembers us and will bless us; he will bless the people of Israel and all the priests of God.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee taɣi teeku kom zali saha shɛli di ni daa tahi yi tiŋgbani puuni la na?.
en: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries.

dag: Zuliya kam je suli, ka a gba suhu yiɣisi. Ka saha paai ni a kari kpiimba saria, ka bahi bɛn saɣindi dunia la yoli. Ka saha lan paai ni a zaŋ laara ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim mini ninvuɣ gahinda ni tarimba mini wɔɣira bɛn zɔr a la.
en: The nations were enraged, but your wrath came. The time came for the dead to be judged. The time came to reward your servants, the prophets and saints, and those who fear your name, both small and great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ dimnim maa pam hal ti naai, ka bi lan nyari so, dama bɛ ni shɛb daa zomi ti kpe bɛ tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gil ni.
en: So Joshua and the Israelites killed the enemy. But some of them were able to go to their cities that had tall walls around them and hide. These men were not killed.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti min o mali dolintabitali ka be zibisim ni, dindina ti ŋmarila ʒiri ti yɛtɔɣa ni mini ti tuma puuni.
en: So if we say that we share in life with God, but we continue living in darkness, we are liars, who dont follow the truth.

dag: Amaa azichi ŋɔ m-be tinim bɛn ŋmani yaɣiri duɣiri ŋɔ ni ni di wuhi ni di yiko din galisi nyɛla Naawuni dini, ka pa ni ti dini.
en: We have this treasure from God, but we are only like clay jars that hold the treasure. This is to show that the amazing power we have is from God, not from us.

dag: Pa Jɛhoyachin ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni lihi ʒiɛm duɣu ŋmaŋ shɛli, ni duɣ shɛli so ni je la? Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o min o bihi vil labi bɛ ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni?.
en: I said, Has King Jehoiachin become like a broken jar that is thrown away and that no one wants? Is that why he and his children have been taken into exile to a land they know nothing about.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu gbaag o zuli, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu gbaag o zuli maa, ka di lan leei jaaŋgbee o nuu ni.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Reach out and grab the snake by the tail. So Moses reached out and grabbed it, and it turned back into a rod in his hand.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda nimaani.
en: And many people there believed in Jesus.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa, miligimiya Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee.
en: Tell the people to move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi yi lɔri noli, yin di zaɣiriya yi ninani kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ zaɣirila bɛ ninani ni niriba nya ba m-baŋ ni bɛ lɔri noli. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you fast, dont make yourselves look sad like the hypocrites. They put a look of suffering on their faces so that people will see they are fasting. The truth is, thats all the reward they will get.

dag: N je tuumbiɛtumdiba; ka m mi bi ʒiini ninvuɣ biɛri sani.
en: or go with evil crowds.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ʒin o yiŋa ka Yawɛ ti o vuhim o dimnim bɛn daa gil o zaa sani.
en: King David moved into his new palace, and the Lord let his kingdom be at peace.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, litaafi shɛli n ni daa tuui sab la wuhirila Yisa ni daa piligi wuhiri niriba ka tumdi shɛm.
en: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha: Ti Duuma mi ka yɛnnim tɛha nyɛla yoli.
en: The Scriptures also say, The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.

dag: ka yi tiŋgbani mi ti be kaman tahiʒiɛɣu. Yi ni ti yihi yi yaa tum tuma yoli, ka yi tiŋgbani ku niŋ bindirigu, ka di tihi gba ti ku wali wala.
en: so that your strength will be spent for no reason: your land will not produce its yield, and the trees of the land wont produce their fruit.

dag: O ku ŋme naŋgbankpeeni bee n-yo vuri, ka so ku wum o kukoli solɔri zuɣu.
en: He wont argue or shout, and nobody will hear his voice in the streets.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Siizaria o daa chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm nti puhi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be nimaani ka naanyi gari chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: When Paul arrived at Caesarea, he went to Jerusalem and visited the church there. After that he went to Antioch.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba laɣiŋgunim daa laɣim yi luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Nɛtɔfa tiŋkpansi.
en: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yu Ɛsta gari paɣiba maa zaa. Hal o nini daa tiɣ o ka o yur o gari paɣisar bɛn la zaa. Dinzuɣu ka o daa dii zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee.
en: The king loved Esther more than all the other women; she had won his love and his favor more than all the others. He placed the royal crown on her head and made her ruler in place of Vashti.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita daa yɛli Yisa, Nyama, ti chɛla ti yinsi ka dol a.
en: Peter said, Look, we left everything we own and followed you.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The rest of Jehoiakims deeds and all that he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ka o daa wum binshɛŋa yɛla nimaani, ka di nyɛ ninsal ni ku tooi zaŋ shɛli n-niŋ yɛtɔɣa ni, ka lan nyɛ ninsal ni ku tooi zaŋ shɛli tɔɣisi.
en: I know that this man was caught up into paradise and that he heard unspeakable words that were things no one is allowed to repeat. I dont know whether it was in the body or apart from the body. God knows.

dag: Amaa ka Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba ni ti deei nam maa n-su li sahakam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But Gods holy people will receive the kingdom, and they will have the kingdom forever and ever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna. Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.

dag: Ka Ishipan mini Ɛba ni Ɛliɛl.
en: Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o ŋmaligi yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: I will prove to you, then, that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. So he said to the paralyzed man, Get up, pick up your bed, and go home.

dag: N daa lan bo tiŋguliba tin ya ka yɛli, Wummiya kikaa kumsi. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Ti ku wum.
en: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kpi maa, o bia Ahazia n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahab died and was buried with his ancestors. His son Ahaziah became the next king after him.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaka ni nyɛ shɛli maa ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: So Moses gave Eleazar the tax as a special contribution to the Lord , as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka Hɔshaya mini Juda zuɣulaannim pirigili daa pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders of Judah followed the singers.

dag: Ŋunkam bi yuri ma je ni o doli n yɛligu. Yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa dini.
en: But anyone who does not love me does not obey my teaching. This teaching that you hear is not really mine. It is from my Father who sent me.

dag: Amaa man ŋmanila olivi ti mahili din sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni. N niŋla Naawuni yurilim maŋli la naani sahakam.
en: But I am like a green olive tree growing in Gods Temple. I will trust Gods faithful love forever and ever.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa gbaag o n-kpaɣ o nina, ka zaŋ o tahi Gaza ti zaŋ daanya bandi baŋ o, ka chɛ ka o niɛmdi chi sarika ni.
en: The Philistines grabbed Samson and poked out his eyes. They took him to the prison in Gaza and chained him up. Then they put him to work, turning a millstone to grind grain.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni chɛ ka yi tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ n sani, dama yi yi ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, di ni leei tɔna gbahi ya.
en: Dont allow them to live in your land, or else they will lead you to sin against me. If you worship their gods, it will become a dangerous trap for you.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Go to the king and tell him that the Lord says, Let my people go, so that they can worship me.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kuli ka fahim? Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal pul ni bi tar o daɣiri?.
en: He answered, Don't you know what I am talking about by now? You surely know that the food you put into your mouth cannot make you unclean.

dag: Do so daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee ka o yuli booni Maika.
en: Micah belonged to the Ephraim tribe and lived in the hill country.

dag: Ka Hadad daa ti kpi, ka Samla ŋun daa nyɛ Masirɛka nir la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah became king.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Nyin Ahitub bia ŋɔ wumma. Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, n wumda.
en: Saul said to Ahimelech, Listen now, son of Ahitub. Ahimelech answered, Yes, sir.

dag: Mani n-yiɣisi Sairus n wuntia puuni. N ni mal o soya ka di tuhi. O ni me n tiŋ la, ka ti n niriba yolisim. O bi yɛn niŋ li ka deei shɛli. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli maa duya gari sagbana, ka a ʒiɛyimtali chaŋ hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: because your faithful love is higher than heaven; your faithfulness reaches the clouds.

dag: ka o zaŋ Makipɛla siliga din be o palo la tariga la ti ma yi ninni; ka n yo o di liɣiri ka di leegi n dini, ka m mali n kpiimba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku lan kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ ma bee n-lan zaŋ bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ zaa ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri. Di saha bɛ ni ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: so that the house of Israel wont stray away from me again or make themselves impure with any of their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Ka jɛra la daa yɛli bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim la, Niŋmiya yi kpam ŋɔ shɛli ti ti, dama tinim firilanim maa kpirimi.
en: Then the foolish ones said to the wise ones, Let us have some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.

dag: Bɛ gba daa zaŋla bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi bahi tiŋa, ka di leei waɣiri. Amaa ka Aduna jaaŋgbee maa daa zaŋ bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa vali.
en: They threw their walking sticks on the ground, and their sticks became snakes. But then Aarons walking stick ate theirs.

dag: N Naa ni n Naawuni, wummi n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim shɛm ŋɔ, dama nyini ka n suhira.
en: My God and King, listen to my prayer.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa wum ni Asiria naa yiɣisi Lakishi, ka o daa labi ti nya ka ŋun naa tuhirila Libinanima.
en: The Assyrian official learned that the emperor had left Lachish and was fighting against the nearby city of Libnah; so he went there to consult him.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni boli shɛb Izraɛlnima, ka yi yi Juda zuliya ni na la, wummiya! Yawɛ yuli ka yi mali pɔri pɔri, ka yɛri ni yi jɛmdila Izraɛl Naawuni, amaa ka lee bi jɛmd o ni yɛlimaŋli ni wuntia.
en: Listen to this, house of Jacob, who are known by the name of Israel, descendants of Judah, who swear by the LORDs name and invoke Israels God dishonestly and unrighteously.

dag: Saŋmarisi bɛn laɣim gbilligbilli be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ti ku ne; ka wuntaŋ ti ku ne o puhibu na saha, ka goli ti ku piɛla.
en: Heavens stars and constellations wont show their light. The sun will be dark when it rises; the moon will no longer shine.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi yolisim maa leei kuɣituurili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la sani.
en: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.

dag: Hal a ni kul bi mi ma ŋɔ zaa yoli, mani m-piig a ni a sɔŋ n daba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb la. Mani m-bol a yuli.
en: I appoint you to help my servant Israel, the people that I have chosen. I have given you great honor, although you do not know me.

dag: N ni daa siɣisi mmaŋa n-yihi Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya ka bi deei ya shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi nya duhibu la, n tumla taali maa?.
en: Did I commit a sin by humbling myself to give you an advantage because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o ba, Wɛi, n zuɣu n-yaara, n zuɣu n-yaara! Ka bia maa ba yɛl o tumtumdi so, Zaŋm bia maa kuli ti ti o ma.
