en: He said to his father, Oh, my head! My head! The father said to a young man, Carry him to his mother.

dag: Di simdi ni yi mini yi yinsinim ti zaŋdi ba chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa nti kɔriti ba ŋubiri Yawɛ tooni yuuni kam.
en: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.

dag: Ka o gba daa duɣi o ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti o ba. O daa yɛlila o ba, M ba, yiɣisim ŋub a bia mɔɣu ni nimdi ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Esau prepared the food in the special way his father loved. He brought it to his father and said, Father, I am your son. Get up and eat the meat from the animals that I killed for you. Then you can bless me.

dag: Zaŋmiya Alikauli Adaka la zali di puuni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili limsi li.
en: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zali Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab maa samli ka bɛ yo, ka bɛ naanyi bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: After Jason and the others posted bail, they released them.

dag: Ka kurim n-zaŋ o nubila n-lan sabiri tiŋa.
en: Bending down again, he wrote on the ground.

dag: Nyam n ni yur a zaligunim maa shɛm. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili.
en: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ daa bi yu ni o bahi Judanim yoli o dabili Dauda zuɣu, dama o daa pun lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ firila ti o min o bidibisi.
en: But the Lord would not destroy Judah because of the promise to his servant David. He had promised David that someone from his family would always be king.

dag: Amaa ka o ba maa yɛl o yiŋ bihi, Zaŋmiya kpar suŋ na yomyom ti yɛl o, ka zaŋ nintua na ti pir o, ka zaŋ namda na ti pir o pahi.
en: But the father called to his servants. Hurry! he said. Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and shoes on his feet.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni daa yɛli ni n ni niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛl la, n daa bi diɛmdimi maa.
en: but they will learn that I am the Lord . Then they will know that if I say that I will do something, I will do it! They will know that I caused all the troubles that happened to them.

dag: Amaa ka Sukɔt kpamba daa bɔh o, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu.
en: But the leaders of Sukkoth said, Why should we give your army any food? You haven't captured Zebah and Zalmunna yet.

dag: Banima n-lee ni tooi du n-tam Yawɛ dabol la zuɣu? Bee banima n-lee ni tooi zan o luɣ kasi la shee?.
en: Who may climb the Lord 's hill or stand in his holy temple?.

dag: O chɛ ka wuntaŋ su wuntaŋ ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He made the sun to rule the day. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Pɔhim ni ʒe ba chaŋ, ka bɛ maligu bimbina zuɣu ti chɛ ka vi gbahi.
en: The wind has wrapped her in its wings; they will be ashamed of their sacrifices.

dag: Anabinim bɛn be di puuni naala noli n-lo nia biɛri. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣima n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa ka ŋumda. Bɛ di ninsalinim nyɛviya, ka fa azichi mini binviɛla, ka chɛ ka pakoya galisi.
en: The prophets in Jerusalem are making evil plans. They are like a lion—it roars when it begins to eat the animal it caught. They have destroyed many lives. They have taken many valuable things and made widows of many of the women in Jerusalem.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi ni a chɛli bɛ taali, ka a yi ku chɛ bɛ taali maa, dindina nyin kpihimmi n yuli a ni sab li niŋ litaafi shɛl ni la.
en: But now, please forgive their sin! And if not, then wipe me out of your scroll that youve written.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa yɛli, Nanim pisopɔin bɛn nubihilɔri mini bɛ napombihilɔri ŋmahiŋmahi n-yi gahindi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa n tooni, n ni niŋ shɛm ka Naawuni niŋ ma labisi maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Jɛrusalɛm ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: Adonibezek said, Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. God has now done to me what I did to them. He was taken to Jerusalem, where he died.

dag: Ka ŋmana maa zaa daa ti pali; ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa ni yino, Zaŋm ŋman shɛl na. Ka o yɛl o, Ŋman shɛl lan kani. Ka kpam maa mi dii ŋmaai, ka bi lan yirina.
en: When she had filled the containers, she said to her son, Bring me another container. He said to her, There arent any more. Then the oil stopped flowing.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan daa bɔhi Stiivin, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri paliya.
en: The High Priest asked Stephen, Is this true.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi fa piɛri mini niɣi, ka o niriba maa daa taɣiri niɣi maa be tooni ka yɛra, Dauda ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He also recovered all the flocks and herds; his men drove all the livestock in front of them and said, This belongs to David.

dag: Dama o shiri timla Babilɔn na ti yɛli ti, Di ni yuui pam. Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira. .
en: He has sent a letter telling those of us in Babylon: You are going to be there a long time, so build houses and settle down, plant gardens and eat what they produce.

dag: Ŋunkam tiri nandaamba pini, shɛli ku poog o, amaa ŋunkam lab o nini kpaŋa, noli ni di o.
en: Give to the poor and you will never be in need. If you close your eyes to the poor, many people will curse you.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: Ti min o yi daa laɣim kpi, ti min o ni ti lan laɣim be.
en: Here is a true message: If we died with Christ, we will live with him.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a suhu kpɛh a yɔɣu, ka bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a nini mooi.
en: But you are excited and glare at us in anger.

dag: O yɛliya, N niriba, gbilisimiya tibili ka n yɛli ya ka yi wum. Izraɛlnima, n ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya. Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la.
en: Listen, my people, and I will speak; I will testify against you, Israel. I am God, your God.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Naawuni ni ti kari niriba saria yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni tɔɣisi zuɣu;.
en: I tell you that everyone will have to answer for all the careless things they have said. This will happen on the day of judgment.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka yi suhuri saɣim bee n-je suli niŋ taba, yi ni daa zaŋ ma kɔhi kpe ŋɔ maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa niriba nyɛviya bahi.
en: Now do not be upset or blame yourselves because you sold me here. It was really God who sent me ahead of you to save people's lives.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima ni.
en: Egypt fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim.

dag: Saa miri niŋdi Yawɛ tihi pam, o ni biri Lɛbanɔn sida ti shɛŋa la.
en: The LORDs trees are well watered— the cedars of Lebanon, which God planted.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka sokam zahim omaŋ pɔi ka naanyi ŋub bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyu pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ.
en: Each individual should test himself or herself, and eat from the bread and drink from the cup in that way.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli ya na din ni chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbi gbaliŋ maa zuɣu, ka Ijiptinim maa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: Ill make Pharaoh stubborn, and hell chase them. Ill gain honor at the expense of Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD. And they did exactly that.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira jɛnd o kpee, dilan ŋmanila tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu bee takɔbi bee piɛm din dira.
en: A person who gives false testimony against a neighbor is as deadly as a club, a sword, or a very sharp arrow.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nya li, ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka bɛn ka taali lara, ka maani ba ansarisi yɛra.
en: Those who do what is right are happy to see them destroyed. The innocent laugh at them and say.

dag: Ka n daa lihi bɔri bɛ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun ni mali me gooni maa zali, ka zani tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaani gooni maa voli ni n tooni din ni chɛ ka n ku wurim li, amaa ka bi nya so.
en: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.

dag: Ka a saa tahibu be pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni, ka a saa nyaɣisibu neei dunia ŋɔ ni zaa, ka dunia sɔhiri ka damda.
en: The crash of your thunder was in the swirling storm; lightning lit up the whole world; the earth shook and quaked.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa Gɔg yi ti kana ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ, n suhu ni yiɣisi pam.
en: The Lord GOD said, At that time Gog will come to fight against the land of Israel. I will show my anger.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-nyɛ: Jɛramiil mini Ram ni Kɛlubai.
en: Hezrons sons were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

dag: N ni daa nya ka a bihi la ni shɛb doli yɛlimaŋli kaman ti Ba Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm la, di daa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.

dag: Mɔabnim zaa ni daa wum ni nanim shɛb kana ni bɛ ti tuhi ba, bɛ daa laɣimla bipola zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa bɛn ni tooi ye gbaɣinɔnim na nti sɔŋ bɛ tintariga.
en: When the Moabites heard that the three kings had come to attack them, all the men who could bear arms, from the oldest to the youngest, were called out and stationed at the border.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The news about this spread all around the area.

dag: Jɔn nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: When Johns followers left, Jesus began talking to the people about John. He said, What did you people go out to the desert to see? Someone who is weak, like a stem of grass blowing in the wind?.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam la daa wum di yɛla, ka yi Ijipti maa kuna.
en: When Jeroboam, Nebats son, heard the news, he returned from Egypt where he had fled from King Solomon.

dag: Ka doo maa kɔŋ maa daa dii naai, ka o niŋgbuŋ lan lab di bebu ni zaa.
en: Immediately the leprosy disappeared, and the man was healed.

dag: Bɛ yi ti nya so, bɛ ni zaŋ bini kuh o ka di pili yi, ka bɛ mi yi ti gbaai so, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku o.
en: Anyone caught by the enemy will be killed with a sword.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla din wuhiri Naawuni jilima! Ka sagbana wuhir o nuhi tuma!.
en: The heavens tell about the glory of God. The skies announce what his hands have made.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa guhi hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman Samuɛl ni daa zal o shɛm, amaa ka Samuɛl daa na bi ka Giligal na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sool sani maa ti zɔri ka chɛr o.
en: He waited seven days, the time appointed by Samuel, but Samuel didnt come to Gilgal, and his troops began to desert.

dag: Dindina, ka bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ buɣisi? So bi ŋman o.
en: The Holy One says, Can you compare me to anyone? No one is equal to me.

dag: Yinim bɛn yɔhindi niriba ŋɔ, wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ ya? O ku darigi yi tibili?.
en: Liars, do you know what the Lord has for you? Do you know what you will get?.

dag: Yi nyuri piɛri maa bihim, ka yɛri bɛ ni zaŋ piɛri kɔbiri wuɣi situr shɛŋa, ka kɔriti biŋkɔb pola bɛn mali kpam. Amaa yi bi dihiri piɛri.
en: You drink their milk and use their wool to make your clothes. Then you butcher the best ones for food. But you don't take care of the flock!.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam pihi di wala ni di li ka paɣi Yawɛ, ka bɛnkam pihi wain tiwala laɣim sɔŋ ni nyu di wain n jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lan yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash, Kpuɣim piɛma; ka o kpuɣ li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋm li fiɛb tiŋa; ka o zaŋ li fiɛb tiŋ buta ka chɛ lala.
en: Elisha said, Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them. Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Saimɔn, Saimɔn, Sintani lo nia ni o kpɛhi ya nuu ni yɛli ya kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la.
en: Simon, Simon! Listen! Satan has received permission to test all of you, to separate the good from the bad, as a farmer separates the wheat from the chaff.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Jɛziriil, ka Jɛzibɛl wum o yɛla, o daa bal la chilo, ka mal o zuɣu n-vɔbisi lihiri takɔro ni.
en: Jehu then went to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard of it, she put on her eye shadow and arranged her hair. She looked down out of the window.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ tiŋgbani kɔhi ti so ka o su li sahakam, dama tiŋgbani maa nyɛla n dini, yi nyɛla tinzunnim mini saamba n sani.
en: The land really belongs to me, so you cannot sell it permanently. You are only foreigners and travelers living on my land with me.

dag: N dan naa, ka pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnim zaa lihirila a ninni ni a wuhi ba ŋun yɛn zani a zaani n-di nam a kalinsi nyaaŋa ʒin a nam ʒiishee.
en: As for you, my master the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you to tell them who will follow you on the throne of my master the king.

dag: Ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam, Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba polo nim zaa daa baŋ ni Samuɛl nyɛla Yawɛ daanabi maŋli.
en: Then all Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, knew that Samuel was a true prophet of the Lord .

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni nya bindirigu pam n-di n-tiɣi; ka paɣi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum ya tuun kara maa. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: Then you will have plenty to eat. You will be full. You will praise the name of the Lord your God. He has done wonderful things for you. My people will never again be ashamed.

dag: Dauda ni daa kurigi ka o dabisa ti pali, o daa zaŋla o bia Sulemaana leei Izraɛlnim naa.
en: When David was very old, he made his son Solomon king of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Liya daa yɛli, Naawuni ti ma pin suŋ, pumpɔŋɔ n yidan ni ti ma jilima, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ayɔbu ti o; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Zɛbulɔn.
en: She said, God has given me a fine gift. Now surely Jacob will accept me, because I have given him six sons. So she named this son Zebulun.

dag: ka o daa dihi bɛn nahindi ba vi, ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: he showed contempt for their oppressors and made them wander in trackless deserts.

dag: Ka n yi nyɛ yi Duuma ni yi karimba ka paɣi yi naba, dindina di simdi ni yi gba paɣiri tab naba lala;.
en: I am your Lord and Teacher. But I washed your feet. So you also should wash each others feet.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn ʒe dunol ni n-nyɛ ninkura mini bipola maa zaa zom, ka chani bɔbindi bɔri dunoli shee.
en: Then they did something to the men outside the door—they caused all these evil men, young and old, to become blind. So the men trying to get in the house could not find the door.

dag: Naawuni bi bela zuɣusaa ha? Nyam saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha ni be zuɣusaa ha shɛm!.
en: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.

dag: Ahia ni Hanan so mi ni Anan ni.
en: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nam kana, ka chɛ ka a yubu niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni ka di ni niŋdi alizanda ni shɛm la.
en: may your Kingdom come; may your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

dag: Di saha niriba ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu.
en: And the answer will be, It is because the Lord 's people broke the covenant they had made with him, the God of their ancestors, when he brought them out of Egypt.

dag: Tirimiya wuhi soli din kuni Ziɔn. Zomiya yomyom tiligi, ka di niŋya zinchili, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi nuzaa polo na. Ka di ni ti di niriba pam.
en: Raise the signal flag toward Zion. Run for your lives! Dont wait! Do this because I am bringing disaster from the north. I am bringing terrible destruction.

dag: N ni zaŋ n jaaŋgbee taɣi ya, ka lɔn ya alikauli.
en: I will judge you guilty and punish you according to the agreement.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ mini n tizo Bɛnjamin zaa nini nyaya ni mmaŋmaŋa n-yaagi n noli yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: You and my brother Benjamin have seen with your own eyes that Im speaking to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bo tuma zuɣulaannim ti ba ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma hal ka bɛ shia ti yi bɛmaŋ ni, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ me Firawuna nɛma zaashee fɔntinsi ti o Pitom mini Ramɛsis.
en: So the Egyptians put slave drivers over them to crush their spirits with hard labor. The Israelites built the cities of Pithom and Rameses to serve as supply centers for the king.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ni binshɛɣukam ni niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ sani, ka yɛri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ tipawumli doli bɛ tipawumli suhuyubu maa mi ni zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ba.
en: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, The Lord has promised everything will be fine.

dag: Amaa galimi ni ka m biɛhigu ni zuɣu, a sɔŋ ma, ka zaŋ ma zal a tooni sahakam.
en: I was innocent and you supported me. You let me stand and serve you forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka tinim bɛn daa tuui mali tahima Masia ni la chɛ ka ti biɛhigu nyɛ din tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.

dag: Bɛ ni so bi labina ni o ti paɣi Naawuni shee tinzun nir ŋɔ kɔŋko.
en: No one returned to praise God except this foreigner.

dag: So ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili m-me dikili gɔŋbu shee, ka so mi ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili me tanzaa. A yɛn kpalimla dabari doya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: None of the stones from your ruins will ever be used again for building. You will be like a desert forever. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla wuntia sariakarita; ka wuhir o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo dabisili kam.
en: God is a righteous judge, a God who is angry at evil every single day.

dag: A bi tiri di ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyura, ka mɔŋdi kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu.
en: Maybe you failed to give water or food to people who were tired or hungry.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Death is the punishment for attacking your father or mother.

dag: Kpiɔŋlana, lom a takɔbi tabil a gbalipini a jilima min a nam dariza ni.
en: Buckle on your sword, mighty king; you are glorious and majestic.

dag: Ka Shɛla daa nyɛ Kainan bia, ka Kainan nyɛ Arifazad bia, ka Arifazad nyɛ Shɛm bia, ka Shɛm nyɛ Nuhu bia, ka Nuhu mi nyɛ Lamɛk bia.
en: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech.

dag: O daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun kul suhiri Naawuni sahakam, ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa zɔri Naawuni, ka o tiri nandaamba pina pam.
en: He was a religious man. He and all the others who lived in his house were worshipers of the true God. He gave much of his money to help the poor people and always prayed to God.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sipirɛs dari pili pie tab tabili duu maa puuni dukpini, ka dooi salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali abie tihi mini zoligɔnim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: The main room was paneled with cedar and overlaid with fine gold, in which were worked designs of palm trees and chain patterns.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn zaŋ alikauli shɛli ti a ŋɔ niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: Then put in the Box the two stone tablets that I will give you, on which the commandments are written.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Ɛliɛza mini Ishija ni Malikija so mi ni Shɛmaya.
en: Clan of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

dag: A yɛm n-chɛ ka wubiga pa zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka teeg o kpiŋkpama kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ?.
en: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe a yim, a gba ʒe ba la yim; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi, a wuhir o a gba ni ka galimi shɛm.
en: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o ni nimmoo, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: Peter answered even more strongly, I will never say that, even if I have to die with you! And all the other disciples said the same thing.

dag: Jaande, ŋmaligimiya, ka di tumiya taali. Ŋmaligimiya pumpɔŋɔ, yi zilisi n nimmaŋtali.
en: You have gone far enough. Stop being unjust. Don't condemn me. I'm in the right.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ, dama kpe pala vuhim shee, daɣ shɛli din tahiri saɣiŋgu na ni tahi saɣiŋgu shɛli din bie na zuɣu.
en: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord 's people, and you will be destroyed.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Naawuni ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah did everything that God commanded.

dag: Di simdi ka o wurim yili maa ka va di kuɣa mini di yɔɣira ni di tari zaa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba bɛn daa nyɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu daa yi Kɛila maa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa naan tooi chaŋ. Ka Sool daa wum ni Dauda yi Kɛila maa zo, ka o chɛ o naba karibu.
en: So David and his troops—approximately six hundred men—got up and left Keilah. They kept moving, going from one place to the next. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he didnt go there.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman wain pipia la, ka zuliya kam bɛn gil li nyu li n-jeeni kaman danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣ la. Ka bɛ yi ti teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni teei gili Juda tinsi la gba.
en: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla kom din zilima, ka yɛm kɔbilinini nyɛ kulibɔŋ kom din zɔra.
en: A person's words can be a source of wisdom, deep as the ocean, fresh as a flowing stream.

dag: O teei gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka n nya biɛrim mini naŋgbantom pam.
en: He built up bitterness and trouble against me. He surrounded me with bitterness and trouble.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma dabisili la dali ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni chani shɛm la; di saha maa zuɣusaa ni ti vuui ni vuɣɔbu pam, ka buɣim ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa nyɛligi; ka buɣim ti di dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binyara din be di zuɣu.
en: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. On that day the heavens will pass away with a dreadful noise, the elements will be consumed by fire, and the earth and all the works done on it will be exposed.

dag: Yisa Masia puuni yi zaa nyɛla Naawuni bihi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: You are all Gods children through faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn puuni. Ŋmɛmiya kuŋa n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la kanna, hal di miriya.
en: Blow the trumpet; sound the alarm on Zion, God's sacred hill. Tremble, people of Judah! The day of the Lord is coming soon.

dag: Bɛ daa kul darimi gindi kaman bɛn kɔŋ kpɛhili shee, ka be mɔɣu ni mini zoya zuɣu chana, ka be kuɣa lɔna ni mini voyari ni. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma n-yaɣi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu zuɣu.
en: The world was not good enough for them! They wandered like refugees in the deserts and hills, living in caves and holes in the ground.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kummiya ka fabili dabisili maa zuɣu.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Egypt that I am saying: Cry out in despair.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn chɛ ka yi ʒiʒiinitab nyuri yi suhuyiɣisili dam, ka yi kul boori yi lɔɣu pahiri hal ka bɛ ti nyu m-buɣi ni di chɛ ka yi nya bɛ zaɣim la zuɣu.
en: Doom to the one who makes his companions drunk, pouring out your wrath in order to see them naked.

dag: O daa pun wum Yisa yɛla, ka daa gil o nyaaŋa nti ŋaɣisi kpe salo maa ni nti shihi o binyɛrigu.
en: Because she had heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn darigiri gbabigiri kpibisi bɛ manim biha ni, ka deeri nandaamba biliɛri talima.
en: They take a nursing baby from its mother. They take a poor persons child to guarantee a loan.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni nyɛ Naawuni biyurisi la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi bebu be kaman o bebu.
en: Therefore, imitate God like dearly loved children.

dag: Ka o yɛli, A mi ni mani n-daa su nam ŋɔ, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yu ni mani n-di li, amaa ka nam maa ti ŋmaligi leela n tizo dini, dama Yawɛ n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: He said, You know how the kingdom was mine. All Israel had appointed me as their king. Then suddenly the kingdom went to my brother as the LORD willed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Shɛkɛm pii la zaa laɣim bela nimaani.
en: Abimelech heard that all the leaders of the Tower of Shechem had gathered together.

dag: Piɛri ni ti a situra, ka a buhi mi yo a palo samli.
en: You can make clothes from the wool of your sheep and buy land with the money you get from selling some of your goats.

dag: ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛha bie ka lan nyɛ bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli la sanna. Bɛ tɛhiri ni wuntia soli dolibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir nya azichi. Gbaam amaŋa ni niriba ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo.
en: and constant arguments from people whose minds do not function and who no longer have the truth. They think that religion is a way to become rich.

dag: O daa lan buɣisi zɔŋ la mini dunɔdali din daa baɣi daantalisi la ni dundɔŋ ni luɣilikam, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: The room at the far end led out to a courtyard. He measured that room and found it was feet wide.

dag: Dauda ni daa kpe o yili la ni naai, ka o daa ti yɛli anabi Neetan, Nyama, man bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ din be suɣili ni.
en: King David was now living in his palace. One day he sent for the prophet Nathan and said to him, Here I am living in a house built of cedar, but the Lord 's Covenant Box is kept in a tent.

dag: M bihi, kul kpalimmiya be o ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka o ti yi palo ka ti tooi mali suhukpeeni, ka ti ku tiri gbini n-zo o sani vi zuɣu o labbuna dali.
en: Yes, my children, remain in union with him, so that when he appears we may be full of courage and need not hide in shame from him on the Day he comes.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya pɔi ka naanyi piri ba. Bɛ daa niŋla bɛ zaa lala, dama luɣ kasi shee tumtumdiba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni tuma daa be Ɛliɛza mini Itama bidibisi maa zaa ni.
en: They divided both groups by lots because there were holy leaders, even outstanding leaders, among both Eleazars and Ithamars descendants.

dag: Ti yi saɣi ka bɛ be ti sani, bɛ niɣi mini bɛ binshɛɣukam ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa ku leei ti dini.
en: Their livestock, their property, and all of their animals—wont they be ours? Lets agree with them and let them live with us.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ zilinli gba: di nyɛla din pɔra, amaa ka nyɛ din nyuri bara yɛri yɛl kara. Lihimiya buɣim biɛla ni yi taai tibɔŋ ni n-di li shɛm!.
en: It is the same with our tongue. It is a small part of the body, but it can boast about doing great things. A big forest fire can be started with only a little flame.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun pihinahi maa yi ti naai n ni yihi Ijiptinim maa bɛ ni daa wurim be ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni na.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, After forty years I will bring the Egyptians back from the nations where I have scattered them.

dag: M pun tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam, n ku lan garigi; n ku lan yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: I have spoken once, I wont answer; twice, I wont do it again.

dag: Gbɛm kpe yuŋ ŋɔ, ka di sa neei ka ti nya dilan ni saɣi tum di tuma bee o ku saɣi. O yi saɣi ni o ni niŋ li, di viɛla, ka o yi bi saɣi, dindina m-po Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ ni n ni tum di tuma maa. Dinzuɣu dɔnimi ka biɛɣ neei.
en: Stay the night. And in the morning, if hell redeem you—good, let him redeem. But if he doesnt want to redeem you, then—as the LORD lives—I myself will redeem you. Lie down until the morning.

dag: Malimiya yimaŋ ti Yawɛ. Yinim Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, gunimiya yi suhuri ni, di yi pa lala n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu kaman buɣim la n-diri ka so ku tooi kpihi li, yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. *.

dag: Lala niŋbu ni ka Lɔt bipuɣins ayi maa zaa daa zaŋ puhi bɛ ba sani.
en: In this way both of Lot's daughters became pregnant by their own father.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli paɣ maa, N chɛ a daalahichi maa paŋ a.
en: Then Jesus said to the woman, Your sins are forgiven.

dag: m ba daa wuhiri ma, ka yɛri ma, Chɛ ka n yɛligu kpe a suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga; gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli ka be.
en: he taught me and said to me: Let your heart hold on to my words: Keep my commands and live.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus body.

dag: Ka neesim maa kul neeri zibisim ni, ka zibisim maa bi tooi nyaŋ li.
en: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-niŋ ya alaka, ka kun ya; ka zuliya kam ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.

dag: Naawuni, labisim ti a sanna, Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: God, accept us again. Smile down on us and save us!.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti pala puɣisiriba, ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba.
en: We told him, Were honest men, not spies.

dag: Amaa maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi na bi dɔɣi bia ka niŋ pakoli bee n-yi o yidan yiŋa n-lab o ba yiŋ na ti ʒiya kaman o ni daa nyɛ bia shɛm la, o ni tooi di o ba bindirigu maa, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pa maligumaana yiŋ nira, ŋun miri ka o di li.
en: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food.

dag: Yinim Galilinim ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee ʒiɛya lihiri zuɣusaa lala? Ka lan yɛli ba, Yisa so yi ni nya ka o yi yi sani chani alizanda ni shɛm maa, lala ka o ti lan yɛn labina.
en: They said, Galileans, why are you standing here, looking toward heaven? This Jesus, who was taken up from you into heaven, will come in the same way that you saw him go into heaven.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa laɣim o sani na maa pah o zuɣu n-laɣim zani Alikauli Adaka maa tooni n-kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi pam bɛn ka kalinli m-mali sara.
en: Solomon and a crowd of people stood in front of the chest and sacrificed more sheep and cattle than could be counted.

dag: N yi ti teei n nuu darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili ka yihi Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will punish the people of Egypt, and they will learn that I am the Lord . Then I will lead my people out of their country.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti ni yɛli shɛm yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka Yawɛ lee kahig o yiko wuhi?.
en: Who really believed what we heard? Who saw in it the Lord s great power?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka mɔɣu ni buŋ gɔr o yubu? Ka ŋuni n-lee gaai mɔɣu ni bun so ŋun zɔri pam naba ni tanachi?.
en: Who set wild donkeys free?.

dag: dama n yɛri ya mi ni zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ hal ka Naawuni nam ti kana.
en: I will never drink wine again until Gods kingdom comes.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: Now the Lord All-Powerful says, Think about what is happening.

dag: Nanima, wummiya! Zuɣulaannima, wummiya! N ni yili yila niɣim n kukoli paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Listen, kings and rulers, while I sing for the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Amaa pihimiyala kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba kaman bɛ daŋ dɔɣirikpamba yuya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But you must use lots to decide which tribe gets which part of the land. Each tribe will get its share of the land, and that land will be given the name of that tribe.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa ka o su Izraɛlnima; ka lala naa maa kpihim Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba birili zuŋɔ.
en: For this reason the LORD will raise up a king over Israel who will eliminate the house of Jeroboam. This begins today. Whats that? Even now!.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N zɔrila Yɛhudianim bɛn zo nti pahi Babilɔnnim maa zuɣu la, bɛ ti zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni ka bɛ niŋ ma alaka zuɣu.
en: Zedekiah answered, I can't surrender to the Babylonians. I'm too afraid of the people of Judah who have already joined them. The Babylonians might hand me over to them, and they would torture me.

dag: Ka Musa daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu zalizali, ka zaŋ di dapaɣa la tamtam di zuɣu, ka zaŋ di dapuhi la niŋ li, ka zaŋ di daantalisi la sa;.
en: The posts, stands, and framework were put in place.

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu; wummi n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi zuliya balibu kam ni mini dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa pun wum Sulemaana yɛm maa yɛla sani n-ka o sanna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: Kings all over the world heard of his wisdom and sent people to listen to him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun nini tiɣ a, ka zaŋ a ʒili Izraɛl nam ʒiishee ŋɔ simdi paɣibu. Yawɛ ni kul yuri Izraɛlnim saha shɛlikam la zuɣu ka o piig a leei bɛ naa ni a doli yɛlimaŋli mini wuntia soli su ba.
en: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. The Lord has always loved Israel, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam o dirila nasara; dama Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: and was successful in all he did, because the Lord was with him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi la daa lan lab Izraɛl naa sanna ti yɛl o, Lan malimiya shili gu, ka baŋ yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama zaŋ chaŋ shɛɣuni, Siria naa ni lan labina ti liri ya.
en: Later, the prophet went back and warned Ahab, Benhadad will attack you again next spring. Build up your troops and make sure you have some good plans.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Lɛvinim n-ni ti zaŋ tɔto binyɛra din nyɛ chi mini wain ni kpam tahi nɛma du shɛŋa ni luɣ kasi shee lahi ni be. Nimaani ka maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi tuma mini dunɔguliba ni yiliyiiniba gba be. Ti ku chɛ ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa bahi.
en: The Israelites and the Levites must bring the contribution of grain, wine, and oil to the storerooms where the sanctuary equipment is kept, and where the priests on duty, the gatekeepers, and the singers reside. We wont neglect our Gods house!.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi mini teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: Make two coverings to go over the outer tent. One covering should be made from ram skins dyed red. The other covering should be made from fine leather.

dag: Daadam ŋun nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi so ŋɔ dabisa bi yaɣi lala, ka wahala n-kul pali di ni.
en: We are all human beings. Our life is short and full of trouble.

dag: Ka Timoti ni daa yi yi sani labina, o daa yɛli ti yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi yurilim yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. O yɛli ti ni yi kul tɛhirila ti yɛla ka bɔri ni yi nya ti kaman ti gba suhuri ni ye yi nyabu zuɣu shɛm.
en: Now Timothy has come back, and he has brought us the welcome news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always think well of us and that you want to see us just as much as we want to see you.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Yuun pihinahinaayɔbu ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duu ŋɔ, ka nyin ti yɛli ni a ni labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: Are you going to build it again in three days? they asked him. It has taken forty-six years to build this Temple.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku nyini Ahimɛlɛk min a daŋ zaa.
en: But the king said, Ahimelech, you and all your relatives must die.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrimia Libina nir bia ka o yuli booni Hamutal.
en: Jehoahaz was years old when he became king. He ruled three months in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee mi ma? Ka Yisa garigi n-yɛl o, A ni di be fiig tia gbini ka Filip na bi nya a la, ka n di nya a.
en: Nathanael asked him, How do you know me? Jesus answered, Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.

dag: Di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be tiŋkpansi zaŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali leei suhupiɛlli vuhim mini chuɣu puhibu dabisili, ka daa niŋ bindira tari taba.
en: This is why Jews who live in small towns observe the fourteenth day of the month of Adar as a joyous holiday, a time for feasting and giving gifts of food to one another.

dag: M mabiyurisi, wummiya! Pa Naawuni m-pii ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛ nyɛ azichinima zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu polo, ka lan nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn di nam shɛli o ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la?.
en: Listen, my dear friends! God chose the poor people of this world to be rich in faith and to possess the kingdom which he promised to those who love him.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: If someone asks you why you are untying it, tell him that the Master needs it.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n niŋ li. N ku chɛ ka bɛ galim n yuli maa. N ku zaŋ n jilima ti so.
en: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ni zali zaligu, ka yiya kara ŋma n-lu, ka yiya bihi mi lu m-burisiburisi.
en: At the Lord 's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.

dag: Ka din daa chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ ti niŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim ni daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la sani zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa yihi ba Ijipti Naa Firawuna nuu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti kpalim jɛmdila buɣa.
en: All this happened because the Israelites sinned against the LORD their God, who brought them up from the land of Egypt, out from under the power of Pharaoh, Egypts king. They worshipped other gods.

dag: Yi bɔhira, Wula ka o bi lan deeri li? Dama Yawɛ n-daa di a min a ni daa kpuɣi paɣ so a bipolitali ni shɛhira, hal paɣ maa ni kul nyɛ a mini ŋun be, ka lan nyɛ a daalikauli paɣ maa zaa yoli, a bi ʒe o yim.
en: But you say, Why? Because the LORD testifies about you and the wife of your youth against whom you cheated. She is your partner, the wife of your covenant.

dag: N ku bɔri ni n yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ninsal na mi m-bɔri ni binshɛli val o?.
en: Should someone inform him that I wish to speak, or would anyone say he wants to be devoured?.

dag: Mani yi Duuma Naawuni yɛliya, n ni ku Ashidɔdnima, ka ku Ashikɛlɔn naa. N ni darigi Ɛkurɔn tibili, ka chɛ ka Filistianim bɛn kpalim zaa kpi.
en: I will eliminate the people from Ashdod, the one who rules from Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, and the Philistines who remain will perish, says the LORD God.

dag: ni Gɛdɔr ni Ahio ni Zakaria ni Mikilɔt daa dol o nyaaŋa.
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lo noli, ka kpe duu nti teei dɔni tiŋgban ni suhiri Naawuni bia maa zuɣu din dali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: So David went without eating to show his sorrow, and he begged God to make the boy well. David would not sleep on his bed, but spent each night lying on the floor.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tintariga kpaa din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha bee n-fa kpibisi palo.
en: Never move an old property line or take over land owned by orphans.

dag: Neem a nina, ka luɣ a tiba wum a dabili suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ tir a daba Izraɛlnima ka kahigiri Izraɛlnim daalahichi shɛŋa ti ni tum a sani wuhiri ŋɔ. M mini n yaannim tum alahichi.
en: Look at me, Lord , and hear my prayer, as I pray day and night for your servants, the people of Israel. I confess that we, the people of Israel, have sinned. My ancestors and I have sinned.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun Ɛhud maŋmaŋ daa zani kuɣikpɛra shee din miri Giligal la ŋ-ŋmaligi labi ti yɛli, Naa, m malila ashili yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka naa maa daa yɛl o naazɔnim ni bɛ yima. Ka bɛ zaa daa yiɣis o sani yi.
en: But he himself turned back at the carved stones near Gilgal, and he said, I have a secret message for you, King. So Eglon said, Hush! and all his attendants went out of his presence.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, n yi na kul yihiri gunibu yɛla waazu, di chaŋ wula ka n na kul nyari nahiŋgu? Di yi nyɛ lala, dapulli waazu yihibu yɛla din nyɛ kuɣituurili la naan vuui.
en: Brothers and sisters, if Im still preaching circumcision, why am I still being harassed? In that case, the offense of the cross would be canceled.

dag: So ti ku me o yili ka shɛb deei li kpe m-beni, ka so mi ti ku sa tihi ka shɛb deei di wala di. N niriba maa ni di bɛ nuhi tuma daanfaani. Tihi ni yɛn yuuri shɛm, lala ka n niriba maa gba yɛn yuura.
en: They wont build for others to live in, nor plant for others to eat. Like the days of a tree will be the days of my people; my chosen will make full use of their handiwork.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus answered them, People who are well do not need a doctor, but only those who are sick.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zali ba zaligu yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim bɛn ti ka tuma ni na Vuhim Dabisili dali pirigibu buta zuɣu yim n-yɛn guli nayili.
en: Then Jehoiada gave them a command. He said, This is what you must do. One-third of you, from those who go on duty on the Sabbath day, must stand guard at the royal palace.

dag: Dama a yi bi dol ti chaŋ, wula ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni a nini tiɣi m min a niriba ŋɔ? Ka bɔ n-leei yɛn woligi m min a niriba ŋɔ biɛhigu ka chɛ dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa biɛhigu.
en: Also, how will we know if you are pleased with me and these people? If you go with us, we will know for sure. If you dont go with us, these people and I will be no different from any other people on the earth.

dag: Tɛha maa ni daa be bɛ suhuri ni saha shɛli maa ka Yisa baŋ li ka dii bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: At once, Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said, Why are you thinking such things?.

dag: Di simdi ka o kpuɣila paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin.

dag: Dindali maa, maasim bee sakuɣa ti ku beni.
en: On that day, there will be no light. Splendid things will disappear.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba sani ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi gbaai o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: So Judas went off and spoke with the chief priests and the officers of the Temple guard about how he could betray Jesus to them.

dag: N yi daa yɛli, N kul ni tɔɣisiri lala, n naan nyɛla ŋun bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli a bihi puuni.
en: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.

dag: O daa niŋla lala hal ti paai nayili samban dunol ni. O daa bi kpe nayili maa, dama bɛ daa bi saɣiri ka ninvuɣ so ŋun pili buɣu zaŋdi li kpɛri nayili.
en: But Mordecai went only as far as the kings gate. No one was allowed to enter the gate dressed in sackcloth.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn leei yuɣimpina biɛhigu shee ni ko dooshee, ka zaŋ sɔɣu din ni saɣim li n-kol li bahi. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Samsin zuɣu na pam, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Ashikɛlɔn ti ku ninvuɣ pihita, ka di bɛ nɛma na nti zaŋ bɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa baŋ ŋahili maa gbinni maa; ka daa je suli pam ŋ-ŋmaligi kul o ba yiŋa.
en: Then the Lord 's Spirit took control of Samson. He went to Ashkelon, where he killed men and took their clothing. Samson then gave it to the young men at Timnah and stormed back home to his own family.

dag: Izraɛlnim kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Parɔsh daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: The family of Parosh .

dag: Ka Pita daa bɔh o, Ananias, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka Sintani kpe a suhu ni ka a pii liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka ŋmari Naawuni Shia Kasi ʒiri?.
en: Peter said to him, Ananias, why did you let Satan take control of you and make you lie to the Holy Spirit by keeping part of the money you received for the property?.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Alikizanda bɛn nyɛ n ni zaŋ shɛb niŋ Sintani nuu ni bɛmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni di bi simdi ni bɛ mo Naawuni la.
en: such as Hymenaeus and Alexander. Ive handed them over to Satan so that they can be taught not to speak against God.

dag: Anabi Hanania ni daa kabigi naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: and a little while later, the Lord told me.

dag: Dama bɛ ni na be bɛ nyɛvili ni ŋɔ, ŋun kɔhi maa ku lan nya o ni kɔhi shɛli maa, dama ʒii maa yɛrila bɛ zaa yɛla, ka di mi ku vuui, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, bɛ ti ku lan mali bɛ nyɛviya.
en: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul bɔrila duŋtaabo, amaa bɛ ni tim tumo ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana ka o lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Death will come like a cruel messenger to wicked people who are always stirring up trouble.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zali ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaa di saha maa.
en: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord 's commands.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu lomiya ania n-chɛ ka zaɣisuntali pahi yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka baŋsim pahi yi zaɣisuntali zuɣu.
en: Because you have these blessings, do all you can to add to your life these things: to your faith add goodness; to your goodness add knowledge;.

dag: dama tibili zahindi yɛtɔɣa kaman zilinli ni zahindi bindira shɛm la.
en: for the ear tests words like the palate tastes food.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani; Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bala. Naawuni ni zaŋ tarili shɛli zali ba m-bala.
en: That is what God will do to those who are evil. That is what he plans to give them.

dag: Jɛrilim n-kul pali bia suhu ni, amaa tibidarigibo fiɛbiga n-kariti li bahiri katiŋa.
en: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.

dag: ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu biɛlabiɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu dali, ka kom maa daa filim.
en: The waters receded gradually from the earth. After one hundred fifty days, the waters decreased.

dag: mini yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ni ti tizɔpaɣa Afia ni Aakipus ŋun nyɛ ti tɔbbikpee la.
en: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.

dag: O daa tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim hal ti paai Gaza mini di tintariga tinsi; ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili di fɔntinsi.
en: He struck down the Philistines as far as Gaza and its territories, from watchtower to fortified city.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa yɛn niŋ la saha daa ti paai, ka bindira maa daa shiri niŋ pam.
en: During the seven good years, the crops in Egypt grew very well.

dag: Hiburɔn yuli piligu ni ha daa nyɛla Kiriatariba; Ariba ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Anakinim ni wɔɣirili. Ka tɔbu daa chɛ tuhibu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Before this, Hebron was called the city of Arba. There was now peace in the land.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa Yawɛ, ti suhir a, ti yi yihi doo ŋɔ nyɛvili, nyin di bɔhi ti biɛri ku ti. Dama nyin Yawɛ zuɣu ka yɛlli maa ʒiya. A ni yu shɛm m-bala.
en: So they prayed to the Lord , Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.

dag: A yi je suli, nyin miri ka a chɛ ka a sujee maa ti kpɛh a alahichi ni, ka a mi miri ka a je suli hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir daa ti ka Ɛli sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa kahigi mmaŋ wuh a yab yiŋnim bɛ ni daa nyɛ Ijipti naa daba m-be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la.
en: A prophet came to Eli with this message from the Lord : When your ancestor Aaron and his family were slaves of the king of Egypt, I revealed myself to Aaron.

dag: dama yuri maa yiko daa bela bɛ noya ni mini bɛ zuya ni. Ka bɛ zuya ŋmani tinvura ka mali zuɣuri; dina ka bɛ daa mali dimdi niriba.
en: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.

dag: Sara maligu yini ŋɔ zuɣu ka Masia chɛ ka Naawuni ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la be dɛde hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: With one sacrifice, then, he has made perfect forever those who are purified from sin.

dag: Hal n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi saɣim ŋ-ŋɔ, ka n niŋgbuŋ na beni, dindina n ni nya Naawuni.
en: After I leave my body and my skin has been destroyed, I know I will still see God.

dag: Di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam nti yaɣi ka bɛ yɛra, O niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, hal o chɛ ka tikpiranim wumda, ka chɛ ka biriti gba tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: They were all completely amazed. They said, Look at what he has done. Its all good. He makes deaf people able to hear and gives a new voice to people who could not talk.

dag: ka zaŋ gbana lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka vili baŋtab viɛla, bɛ zaa daa ŋmanila sapashinnima. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔnnima bɛn daa nyɛ Kalidia tiŋbihi la.
en: wearing only loincloths around their hips and flowing headbands on their heads. All of them had the appearance of warriors of the third rank, the likeness of Babylonians whose native land is Chaldea.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya yɛla: Hal Izraɛl yaansi ni galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni niriba bɛn kpalim biɛla kɔŋko n-ni tiligi;.
en: But Isaiah cries out for Israel, Though the number of Israels children will be like the sand of the sea, only a remaining part will be saved, .

dag: Ŋunkam zu ninsal ti kɔhi bee n-na gbib o ka bɛ gbaag o, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever steals someone to sell them as a slave or to keep them for their own slave must be killed.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Ɛliɛza mini Ishija ni Malikija so mi ni Shɛmaya.
en: From the descendants of Harim, these men: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yi ti mabihi gari kɔbisinu zuɣu yim, ka bɛ ni pam na be bɛ nyɛviya ni hal ni pɔŋɔ, ka bɛ ni biɛla mi gbihiri kum ni.
en: and then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers and sisters at once—most of them are still alive to this day, though some have died.

dag: Na so ŋun ka tɛhi zilima nyɛla putɔɣulana ŋun niŋdi niriba fitiina, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun je zalinsi bini ni mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa zuɣu, bɛ suhuri ku zɔhiri bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: Since God has allowed us to be happy, we will not worry too much about how short life is.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo ti niŋ Izraɛlnim ni? Di chaŋ wula ka daŋ yini niriba ti ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni.
en: LORD, God of Israel, they said, why has this happened among us that as of today one tribe will be missing from Israel.

dag: N daa ti lihi n yiŋ takɔro voya ni.
en: One day I was looking out my window.

dag: O daa lan wurim Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi ni zaa buɣa mini bɛ ni daa yi tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka suhudoo be o nam ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: He also removed the shrines and incense altars from all the cities of Judah so that the kingdom was at peace under him.

dag: Nimaani daa mali momaha pam, ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa ni bɛ ʒinima. Ka dɔbba bɛn daa ʒini kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu.
en: Jesus said, Have the people sit down. There was plenty of grass there. They sat down, about five thousand of them.

dag: Bɛn daa niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zaa daa malila suhu yini ni tɛhi yini, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛli ni o ni su shɛli nyɛla o kɔŋko dini, amaa bɛ zaa daa laɣim sula bɛ ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The group of believers was one in mind and heart. None of them said that any of their belongings were their own, but they all shared with one another everything they had.

dag: Kalim bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛnkam zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: Count all the men who are from to years old and come to serve. These men will do a special work for the Meeting Tent.

dag: O ni daa be o ma pul ni, o daa gbaala o jabil kpee napɔŋkpaa; ka o ni daa ti bi doo, o daa vala Naawuni.
en: Their ancestor Jacob struggled with his twin brother Esau while the two of them were still in their mother's womb; when Jacob grew up, he fought against God—.

dag: Din kariya, ka n yɛli ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli. Ka pa ni n kpimi, n kul ku bahi n nimmaŋtali maa.
en: I will never say that you men are right; I will insist on my innocence to my dying day.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni yɛligu, ka lihi ʒiɛm ŋun Zallakudura Naa wuhibu la zuɣu.
en: because they had disobeyed Gods instructions and rejected the Most Highs plans.

dag: Yuma shɛm nyaaŋa ha, Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia Naa saha shɛl la, do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Ɛzra. Ɛzra daa nyɛla Sɛraya bia, ka Sɛraya nyɛ Azaria bia, ka Azaria nyɛ Hilikia bia.
en: After this, in the rule of Persias King Artaxerxes, Ezra son of Seraiah son of Azariah son of Hilkiah.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Jarib ni Zɛra ni Shaul.
en: Simeons family: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o buɣili Nisirok duu n-jɛmdi li, ka o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi be fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ŋɔ, yi bi wum fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm? Yɛlimiya ma!.
en: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?.

dag: Wain kalinsi zuɣu chɛ ka niriba doli soya kumda, ka suhupiɛlli kam naai, ka dunia ŋɔ suhupiɛlli zo;.
en: People still ask for wine in the marketplaces, but all the joy is gone. It was carried off with everything else.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kani, yin zaŋmiy o binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi maa ti o bidibisi maa ka bɛ ye, ka yi booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba.
en: Aarons holy clothes should be passed on to his sons after him. His sons should be anointed in them and ordained in them.

dag: Bɛ ni dɔɣ ma dahin shɛli zaŋ na hal ni pɔŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ mmaŋ dalim, ka m ma ni dɔɣ ma hal ni zuŋɔ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: You have been my God since the day I was born. I was thrown into your arms as I came from my mothers womb.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ gili Jɛriko goma hal ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, ka goma maa lu.
en: And the walls of Jericho fell because of the faith of Gods people. They marched around the walls for seven days, and then the walls fell.

dag: Ka n ti pii maligumaana so ŋun ni ʒe ma yim ka tumdi n suhu mini n tɛha ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa; biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ti me o yili ti o, ka o ti be n ninvuɣ gahindili sani n-tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: I will choose a priest I can trust. This priest will listen to me and do what I want. I will make his family strong, and he will always serve before my chosen king.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-tɛhi ni dabisi shɛli so di kpee, ka so mi beni n-tɛhi ni dabisa zaa nyɛla yim. Chɛliya ka sokam doli o ni tɛhi shɛm omaŋmaŋ suhu ni.
en: Some people think that a certain day is more important than other days, while others think that all days are the same. We each should firmly make up our own minds.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo, anabi maa mini ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhi ni o baŋ maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛla yim.
en: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.

dag: Namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa daa taɣi ba la yuya: O daa boli Daniɛl la Bɛlitishaaza, ka boli Hanania Shadirak, ka boli Mishɛl Mɛshak, ka boli Azaria mi Abɛdnɛgo.
en: Ashpenaz gave them Babylonian names. Daniels new name was Belteshazzar, Hananiahs was Shadrach, Mishaels was Meshach, and Azariahs was Abednego.

dag: Ti lan suhiri ti Duuma ni o chɛ ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab mini sokam zaa sani zooi pahi kaman ti gba yurilim ni galisi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani shɛm la.
en: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa bela o ko ka chɛ shɛba? Bɔ ka a yura maa lee zaŋ gar o taba ka a ti yɛli ti lala?.
en: How is your lover different from any other lover, you who are the most beautiful of women? How is your lover different from any other lover, that you make us swear a solemn pledge?.

dag: O daa yi ʒiinila Dɛbɔra dɔbino tia din be Rama mini Bɛtɛl sunsuuni Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ la ni gbini, ka Izraɛlnim chan o sani ka o ti kariti bɛ yɛla saria tiri ba.
en: She would sit under a certain palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people of Israel would go there for her decisions.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bindir nyaɣisili maa min o ni mali bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti o bia Yaakubu.
en: Then she got the food she had cooked and gave it to Jacob.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, N ni daa ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira so zuɣu la n-lan neei kum ni na maa.
en: But when Herod heard about Jesus, he said, This must be John! I had his head cut off, and now he has come back to life.

dag: Baasha ni daa kul di nam maa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija Shilo nir la yɛli shɛm la. O daa bi chɛ hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino gba; o daa kula bɛ zaa.
en: At once he began killing all the members of Jeroboam's family. In accordance with what the Lord had said through his servant, the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh, all of Jeroboam's family were killed; not one survived.

dag: Azimavɛt — pihinahinaayi.
en: from the town of Azmaveth:.

dag: Bina anahi yɛla n-niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: There are three or four things I cannot understand:.

dag: Yawɛ n-su ti naba chandi ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ baŋ timaŋmaŋ soya?.
en: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim polo shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Uzia mini Jɔtam ni Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni n-daa bala.
en: The vision about Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah, Amozs son, saw in the days of Judahs kings Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah.

dag: Ti ni daa nya filiŋ la o daa bi tam ti yɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He remembered us when we were defeated. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa ti mali salima binnani, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li zali palo ni Babilɔn luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Dura.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar made a gold statue. It was ninety feet high and nine feet wide. He set it up in the Dura Valley in the province of Babylon.

dag: Izraɛlnim tipawumli ŋmanila naɣisaa tipawumli. Yawɛ ni tooi lan dihi ba kaman piɛbil ni be mɔri pam shee shɛm la?.
en: The Lord has given many things to Israel. He is like a shepherd who takes his sheep to a large field with plenty of grass. But Israel is stubborn like a young cow that runs away again and again.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a zaŋsim be mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ ni, ka wum n kuhigu mini n suhigu shɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But please listen to my prayer and my request. I am your servant, and you are the Lord my God. Hear this prayer that I am praying to you today.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Sagbana yi ti mɔhi zaawun mahili, yi yɛrimi ni di sa ni neei biɛɣu ni.
en: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.

dag: Amaa man ni yili yila n-yɛl a kpiɔŋ yɛla; n ni duhi n yee n-yili yila asiba n-yɛl a yurilim maŋli yɛla. Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha.
en: But I will sing about your strength. I will rejoice in your love every morning. You have been my place of safety, the place I can run to when troubles come.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk daa nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Shavisha daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara.
en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was court secretary;.

dag: Yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna, o ni ŋmaligi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu m-bahi ya yoli zaa; o ni pun niŋ ya din viɛl la nyaaŋa.
en: If you turn your backs on the Lord and worship the gods of other nations, the Lord will turn against you. He will make terrible things happen to you and wipe you out, even though he had been good to you before.

dag: Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim kuhiya, ka bɛ kuhigu maa chaŋ ti paai Jahaz mini Zɔa ni Hɔrɔnaim ni Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama hal Nimrim kom gba nyuuya.
en: Weeping from Heshbon can be heard as far as Elealeh and Jahaz; cries from Zoar are heard in Horonaim and Eglath-Shelishiyah. And Nimrim Creek has run dry.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ galisiya pam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba, ka yi bɔri ni bɛ chɛ tuun kpema tumbu bebɔ.
en: Pharaoh continued, The lands people are now numerous. Yet you want them to stop their hard work.

dag: O daa na bi ʒini tiŋ gba ka paɣ so pun wum o yɛla ka kana nti gban o tooni, dama alizin biɛɣu n-daa ʒi o bipuɣim bil zuɣu.
en: A woman heard that he was there. Her little daughter had an evil spirit inside her. So the woman came to Jesus and bowed down near his feet.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔshua sani Giligal sansani la ni nti yɛl o mini Izraɛlnima. Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na ni ti mini ya ti lo tab alikauli.
en: Then they went to the camp at Gilgal and said to Joshua and the Israelites, We have come from a distant land. We want you to make a treaty with us.

dag: Niriba maa mi daa niŋ ti viɛnyɛliŋga pam, bɛ daa bi niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu, ti mi binshɛli daa ʒi m-bɔrigi saha shɛli ti ni daa be bɛ sani mɔɣu maa ni maa.
en: Yet they were very good to us; they never bothered us, and all the time we were with them in the fields, nothing that belonged to us was stolen.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔhim ti ʒiʒiinitab biɛri siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin zuɣu, ansarisi shɛŋa bɛ ni maan a la zuɣu.
en: Lord, pay the other nations back seven times for all the insults they have hurled at you.

dag: Yɛndana tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, jɛra bɛn tɛha puuni pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools have none.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yɛl o bia pakoli Tama, Kulim a ba yiŋ ti ʒini pakolim hal ka m bia Shɛla ti zooi. O daa zɔrimi ni Shɛla gba ti kpi kaman o biɛyanim maa ni daa kpi shɛm maa. Dinzuɣu ka Tama daa kul o ba yiŋ ti ʒiya.
en: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, Return to your father's house and remain a widow until my son Shelah grows up. He said this because he was afraid that Shelah would be killed, as his brothers had been. So Tamar went back home.

dag: N fabili yi zuɣu gari n ni fabindi Jazanim zuɣu shɛm. Yinim Sibimanima, yi ŋmanila wain tia din wula baai du teeku n-zo hal ti paai Jaza. Ŋun saɣindi la lu yi siɣili saha tiwala mini yi wain tiwala zuɣu.
en: Ill weep for you, vine of Sibmah, more than I would for Jazer. Though your branches extended to the sea and reached the coast of Jazer, now the destroyer has come to harvest your grapes and summer fruits.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti chɛ ka ŋmani yiɣi yi ni o nyaa kom maa nyuuya.
en: Noah wanted to find out if the water had gone down, so he sent out a dove.

dag: Piɛla so a ni daa nya ka o mali yil ayi la wuhirila Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim nanim yɛla.
en: The two-horned ram you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-gbani Ilaisha naba ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa, ka kpuɣ o bia maa yi.
en: She came and fell at his feet, facedown on the ground. Then she picked up her son and left.

dag: Timaŋmaŋ kom ka ti lan ŋmaligi dari nyura, ka lan ŋmaligi yɔri timaŋmaŋ dari zuɣu.
en: We must pay for the water we drink; we must buy the wood we need for fuel.

dag: N daa tum tuun kara. N daa me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri.
en: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave Moses.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila wɔbinyina ka bɛ zaŋ me pii zali. A nina ŋmanila Hɛshibɔn kom din do m-miri Batirabim dunol la. A nyee ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn pia din be Damaskus polo la.
en: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon near the gate of Bath Rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon that looks toward Damascus.

dag: Maligumaana Aduna bidibisi mi n-yɛn piɛbiri kikahi maa. Kikahi maa n-yɛn nyɛ yi kali soli bini yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.

dag: A mi nini bi tiɣiri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la.
en: you werent pleased with entirely burned offerings or a sin offering. .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma n wuntitali laara, n ni ka galimi o sani la zuɣu.
en: So the Lord rewarded me for doing what is right. He could see that I am innocent.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Di ku o, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nuu shihi Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni, ka ku mali taali.
en: But David said, You must not harm him! The Lord will certainly punish whoever harms his chosen king.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn bahi maa ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ nyaandolitab sani nti yɛli ba maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa ni yɛli ba shɛm zaa.
en: Peter and John left the meeting of Jewish leaders and went to their own group. They told the group everything that the leading priests and the older Jewish leaders had said to them.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mal ʒiishee ti a maa.
en: Where do you want us to get it ready? they asked him.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi Azimɔn maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni m-mali lala hal ni teeku ni.
en: where it will turn toward the valley at the border of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti paai yuun pihinu, bɛn chɛli di tuma maa tumbu.
en: At years old each will retire from service. They will perform their duties no longer.

dag: dama o daalahichi dumi hal ti paai sagbana, ka Naawuni teeg o tuumbiɛri yɛla.
en: That citys sins are piled up as high as heaven. God has not forgotten the wrongs she has done.

dag: Masia ni daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima ti zuɣu la puuni ka ti baŋ yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli, ka di simdi ni ti gba zaŋ ti nyɛviya pa talima ti mabihi zuɣu.
en: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa nya dansi ni nahiŋgu maa. O ni daa nya tibidarigibo shɛli zuɣu n-chɛ ka nyaɣisim kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni. O fiɛbbu dansi zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti nyari tibbu.
en: But he was being punished for what we did. He was crushed because of our guilt. He took the punishment we deserved, and this brought us peace. We were healed because of his pain.

dag: Paɣimiya yi situra daba ayopɔin dali din ni chɛ ka yi be kasi. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi kpe sansani ŋɔ ni na.
en: On the seventh day you must wash all of your clothes. Then you will be pure. After that you can come into camp.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi sizuura lubu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ na titali. Ŋuna n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: The Lord Most High is awesome. He is the great King over all the earth.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbani tariga yɛn kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ shee zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli. Ka nuzaa polo tiŋgbani tariga mi piligi Yalim Teeku maa ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli shee.
en: The east border was the Dead Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The border on the north side ran from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.

dag: Niriba turi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋdi bindira sɔɣira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔhir li mali alibarika.
en: People curse those who hoard grain, but they bless those who sell it.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu. Yɛlimaŋli, hal n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu.
en: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.

dag: Di chɛliya ka wuhibu balibubalibu mini wuhibu kɔŋkɔba din be di ko la birigi ya; di niŋ kamaata ni ti nya suhukpaŋsibo la Naawuni daanfaani puuni, ka pa ni bindira chihibu din bi sɔŋdi bɛn doli di wuhibu sol la.
en: Dont be misled by the many strange teachings out there. Its a good thing for the heart to be strengthened by grace rather than by food. Food doesnt help those who live in this context.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnhur ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la.
en: Here are their names: Ben-hur in the highlands of Ephraim.

dag: Ka chira ayi maa daa ti naai ka o lab o ba sanna, ka o ti zaŋ o niŋ kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli ni o zaŋ o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa nyɛla paɣipiɛliga. Ka di daa leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When two months had passed, she returned to her father, and he did to her what he had promised. She had not known a man intimately. But she gave rise to a tradition in Israel where.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa niŋ yomyom bo luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn zani kum, dama o suhu n-daa palig o tizo maa zuɣu ti yaɣi. O daa kpɛla o duu puuni ti kum.
en: Then, because of his love for Benjamin, he rushed off to his room and cried.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa duu maa dukpina mini di yɔɣira ni di dunɔbihi ni di pundi zaa zuɣu, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ kpe chɛrubinima n-zaŋ tabili dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: He covered the inside of the Temple with the gold. He put the gold on the ceiling beams, doorposts, walls, and doors. He carved Cherub angels on the walls.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni ŋme n-saɣim Damaskus duno kara, ka kari Avɛn vinvamlinim mini Bɛtɛdɛn naa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Sirianim kuli Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ zaa din nyɛ yi ni be tiŋgban shɛli puuni n-nyɛ saamba ŋɔ n-ti a min a zuliya maa, ka yi su li sahakam, ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will give you and them the land in which you are now a foreigner. I will give the whole land of Canaan to your family forever, and I will be their God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Hazaɛl daa yi Ilaisha sani n-lab o dan maa sani, ka o ti bɔh o, Ka wula ka Ilaisha lee yɛl a? Ka o garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma ni a ni kpaŋ.
en: Then Hazael left Elisha and returned to his master. What did Elisha say to you? Ben-hadad asked. He told me that you will certainly live, Hazael replied.

dag: Jɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that King Joash did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Alikizandria tiŋbia ka o yuli booni Apolɔs daa ti ka Ɛfɛsus na. O daa nyɛla zilinvaliŋgalana, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mi Naawuni Kundi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A Jewish man named Apollos came to Ephesus. Apollos had been born in the city of Alexandria. He was a very good speaker and knew a lot about the Scriptures.

dag: Nyamiya n ni zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu n-sab bachibihi kar shɛŋa tin ya!.
en: See what big letters I make as I write to you now with my own hand!.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na nti zaŋ ba kpɛhi anabi Igidalia bia Hanan bidibisi duu din daa miri kpambaliba duu ka be Shallum bia Maasɛya ŋun daa su dunoli fukumsi la duu zuɣusaa la.
en: I brought them to the room in the LORDs temple assigned to the sons of Hanan, Igdaliahs son, the man of God. The room was next to the one used by the chief officers and right above the room of Maaseiah, Shallums son, the temple doorkeeper.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Be sure to always love the Lord your God.

dag: ka maligumaana maa zaŋ ba mali sara; yino ni nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Ka maligumaana maa yo din yi o tooni na maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest shall offer one of them as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way he will perform the ritual of purification for the man.

dag: Yɛm so tɔbutuhiri bidibbina. Amaa alahichilan yino saɣindi bin viɛla pam.
en: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa be kozɔrim maa zuɣusaa polo la, Saha yuusim wula puuni ka alahiziba yɛla ŋɔ tariga yɛn paai.
en: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, How long before these amazing things happen.

dag: Timiya ti naɣilah ayi, ka chɛ ka bɛ pii naɣila yino kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu, ka di niŋ buɣim niŋ li; ka n gba kɔrigi naɣila ŋun la ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu ka ku niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: So bring us two bulls. Let the prophets of Baal have one bull. Let them kill it, cut it into pieces, and then put the meat on the wood. But dont start the fire. I will do the same with the other bull, and I will not start the fire either.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila lala ni bɛ zahim o nya o taali ka fiɣis o. Ka Yisa daa silim n-zaŋ o nubila sabiri tiŋa.
en: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi Firawuna sani chaŋ, ka Musa daa ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ zaŋ chaŋ poloya maa polo kaman o mini Firawuna ni daa saɣi shɛm maa.
en: After Moses and Aaron left the palace, Moses begged the Lord to do something about the frogs he had sent as punishment for the king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o nuu tim o koligu ni yihi kuɣili niŋ o kuɣilɔŋ ni n-zaŋ labi Filistia doo maa gbɛɣu, ka kuɣili maa chaŋ ti firi o gbɛɣu maa ni, ka o lu m-pil o puli zuɣu, ka o nini kpa tiŋa.
en: David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone. He slung it, and it hit the Philistine on his forehead. The stone penetrated his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, N ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani ni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim alikauli shɛli maa shihirili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The rainbow that I have put in the sky will be my sign to you and to every living creature on earth. It will remind you that I will keep this promise forever.

dag: Ka o lan tim so yaha, ka bɛ daa ti ku ŋuna. Ka o lan tim niriba pam pahi, ka bɛ ti fiɛb bɛ shɛba, ka ku bɛ gba ni shɛba.
en: Then the man sent another servant, and they killed him. He kept sending servant after servant. They beat some of them and killed some.

dag: Amaa ka ŋariŋ maa zuɣu polo daa chaŋ ti firi bihigu ni ka di tarigi chandi, ka kɔgbana daa ŋmɛri di nyaaŋa polo hal ka di ti ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: But the ship hit a sandbank and went aground; the front part of the ship got stuck and could not move, while the back part was being broken to pieces by the violence of the waves.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi jiɣindi situra zuɣu? Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda, di mi bi miri gumdi.
en: And why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow: they do not work or make clothes for themselves.

dag: Yawɛ, a tuma galisiya pam! A tɛha zilim pam!.
en: You do great things, Lord . Your thoughts are too deep.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ zina.
en: Do not commit adultery.

dag: O lan yɛli luɣ shɛli yaha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: In another place, God says, You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.

dag: Amaa naa daa bi saɣi zaŋ Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia ka nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la ŋun ti ba, ŋun Dauda mini Sool bia Jɔnatan ni daa lo tab alikauli shɛli Yawɛ tooni la zuɣu.
en: David had made a promise to Jonathan with the Lord as his witness, so he spared Jonathan's son Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul.

dag: Bɛ daa kul dolila nyaaŋa n-kuhiri yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o.
en: The mob that followed kept screaming, Away with him.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni yi nya suhudoo n zuɣu. Yi ni nya nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! M pun nyaŋ dunia.
en: Ive said these things to you so that you will have peace in me. In the world you have distress. But be encouraged! I have conquered the world.

dag: dama bɛ daa pun deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, amaa ka na lee bi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: These people had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus, but the Holy Spirit had not yet come down on any of them. This is why Peter and John prayed.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Bɛ pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha? Yi bi mi dunia ni daa nam shɛm?.
en: Do you not know? Were you not told long ago? Have you not heard how the world began?.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Patrɔs zani dabari. N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Zɔan, ka ti kari Tɛbisinim saria.
en: I will make southern Egypt desolate and set fire to the city of Zoan in the north. I will punish the capital city of Thebes.

dag: N jɛmd a mi ni n suhu zaa, di chɛ ka m birig a zaligunima.
en: I try with all my heart to serve you. Help me obey your commands.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin maa daa zaŋ kawaan kar ayopɔin maa vali. Ka n zaŋ li yɛli timanima, amaa ka bɛ ni so bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: Then the thin heads of grain ate the seven good heads of grain. I told these dreams to my magicians. But no one could explain the dreams to me. What do they mean.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛl o, Nyama, n kurigiya, m mi ku tooi baŋ n kum dali.
en: Isaac said, I am old. Maybe I will die soon.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din bi tu kamaata yi saria karibu ni bee binyɛra wɔɣilim buɣisibu ni bee di tibisim zahimbu ni bee di galisim zahimbu ni.
en: You must be fair when you judge people, and you must be fair when you measure and weigh things.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi mini binyila n-yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naa ŋɔ tooni.
en: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!.

dag: Dama ti yaannim daa bi ʒe yim, ka tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Bɛ daa zaɣis o, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ o biɛhigu shee, ka lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa biri ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ.
en: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord , but they also completely ignored his temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa; ka daa yihi zɔhi pam maa zaa Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o niriba sani, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: and the Lord did as Moses asked. The flies left the king, his officials, and his people; not one fly remained.

dag: Ti zaŋmiya ti viɛla wala mini abie tihi vari ni ti shɛŋa din mali vari wulikpana ni kul tihi na di piligu dali maa nti wuhi yi suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the first day you will take good fruit from fruit trees. And you will take branches from palm trees, poplar trees, and willow trees by the brook. You will celebrate before the Lord your God for seven days.

dag: Naawuni daa kahigi ashili nia shɛl o ni daa lo la wuhi ma. M pun sab di yɛla biɛla gbaŋ ŋɔ ni tin ya.
en: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
