dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim maa daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni shɛm ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: The Jewish teachers of the law and the Pharisees thought to themselves, Who is this man who dares to say such things? What an insult to God! No one but God can forgive sins.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi baŋ n ni niŋdi ya shɛli ŋɔ gbinni pumpɔŋɔ, amaa saha shɛli ka a ni ti baŋ di gbinni.
en: Jesus answered, You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.

dag: Gidɛl ni Gahar ni Reeya ni.
en: Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma kul maani ma la ansarisi. Bɛ yi nya ma, bɛ viinila bɛ zuɣuri.
en: My enemies insult me. They look at me and shake their heads.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus traveled through all the towns and villages. He taught in their synagogues and told people the Good News about Gods kingdom. He healed all kinds of diseases and sicknesses.

dag: ŋun woligim omaŋ ka chɛ wain mini binnyuri kpɛma, ka di nyu bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi komihigu mali shɛli bee binnyuri kpeen shɛli, o mi di nyu wain tiwala kom bee n-di di zaɣ maha bee di zaɣ kuma.
en: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: A ni suhi ma yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Then Isaiah sent a message telling King Hezekiah that in answer to the king's prayer.

dag: Niriba yɛla bɛ noya gu ma, bɛ lab ma tapaɣisi din ku dɔni, ka laɣim tab liri ma.
en: People sneer at me; they crowd around me and slap my face.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: One day the Lord told Joshua:.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa mini sapashinnim bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi ni sariakaritiba ni Izraɛl toondaannim zaa ni daŋ kam ni kpamba zaa na.
en: Solomon summoned all Israel, including the officers of the army, the judges, and every Israelite leader who was the head of a family.

dag: Dama bɛ chira tariga yi ti paai, bɛ baɣa bɔ n-lee lan be bɛ malibu ni, bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ bi zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ kɔhi kaman tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri n-zaŋ ti nandaamba.
en: Why wasn't this perfume sold for silver coins and the money given to the poor.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di chɛ ka a nuzaa mi a nudirigu ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: So when you give to the poor, dont let anyone know what you are doing.

dag: Abijam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu.
en: The rest of what Abijah did is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah . There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam during the whole time that Abijah was king.

dag: To, bidibis ayi maa ni ŋuni n-daa lee tum o ba yubu? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Kpɛm san la. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, farigudeeriba mini pagɔra daŋ ya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Which one of the two did what his father wanted? The older one, they answered. So Jesus said to them, I tell you: the tax collectors and the prostitutes are going into the Kingdom of God ahead of you.

dag: ka n tiri ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti ku bahi yoli, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba n nuu ni.
en: I give my sheep eternal life. They will never die, and no one can take them out of my hand.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa loya ni a ni darigi ti tibili, ka mi shiri niŋ lala. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a kul tumdila din tuhi, dama tinima n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu.
en: You, O Lord our God, were prepared to punish us, and you did, because you always do what is right, and we did not listen to you.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣisi ninvuɣ so mali suhupiɛlli. Dinzuɣu miri ka a ʒiɛm Kpiɔŋlan Naa saɣisigu.
en: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.

dag: Di saha ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, Ka n yi chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yi yaannim Naawuni n-tim ma yi sanna. Ka bɛ bɔhi ma, O yuli lee booni bɔ? Man yɛlim ba wula.
en: Moses answered, I will tell the people of Israel that the God their ancestors worshiped has sent me to them. But what should I say, if they ask me your name.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ vuui yomyom kaman kɔzɔrim la; ka chɛ ka bɛ no n-taai ba kaman sol zuɣu mɔri la ka bɛ kpi.
en: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.

dag: Ka n daa kpahim yɛlli maa nti baŋ ni di pala Naawuni n-wuh o ni o yɛli lala, amaa ka daa baŋ ni Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat n-daa ti o liɣiri m-puh o ni o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: I knew that God had not sent Shemaiah. I knew that he had prophesied against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to do that.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bɔrila dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba, yi ni tooi da dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya sani.
en: If you want slaves, buy them from other nations.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Bashan oki tihi m-mali a ŋariŋ duhirisi. Bɛ zaŋla Saipurus teeku duli wolifahi dari mali a puuni ka niŋ wɔbinyina pa di zuɣu.
en: Oak trees from Bashan were shaped into oars; pine trees from Cyprus were cut for your deck, which was then decorated with strips of ivory.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma yaha, A na ni nya bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa pam gari lala.
en: He said to me: You will see them performing even more detestable practices.

dag: Ka o daa yi n nyaaŋa n-kana ti ŋma ʒiri pa ma nyini n dan naa sani. Amaa nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: So Ziba has slandered your servant to my master and king, but my master and king is a messenger of God. So do whatever seems best to you.

dag: N Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni bi wum o noli zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla bɛn dari gindi yɔɣu zuliyanim sunsuuni.
en: Because they havent listened to him, my God will reject them; they will wander among the nations.

dag: N vu n tiliginsim mirina, ka di shee bi wɔɣa. N tiliginsim maa kandina ku yuui. N ni tiligi Jɛrusalɛm, ka di ti Izraɛlnim jilima.
en: I am bringing the day of victory near— it is not far away at all. My triumph will not be delayed. I will save Jerusalem and bring honor to Israel there.

dag: dama n zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa tɔɣisi ma la tɔɣisi ba, ka bɛ dee li ka baŋ ni n shiri yila a sanna, ka niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I gave them the message that you gave me, and they received it; they know that it is true that I came from you, and they believe that you sent me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi niŋ n dab bidibisi mini n dab bipuɣinsi ni, ka bɛ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Even upon my servants, men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy. .

dag: Ka Amalɛknim daa lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim Rɛfidim maa.
en: The Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa zaŋ sarikanim bɛn zaa be sarika maa ni niŋ Yisifu nuu ni, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa nimaani.
en: The commander of the guards put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners. Joseph was their leader, but he still did the same work they did.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: You people who hear me, listen!.

dag: Naawuni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli ni bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ. Di daa pala o ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa lo o alikauli maa, amaa o ni daa niŋ yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la zuɣu.
en: Abraham and his descendants received the promise that they would get the whole world. But Abraham did not receive that promise because he followed the law. He received that promise because he was right with God through his faith.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi deei binshɛli ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun zo nti be tiliginsim tiŋ ni lab ti be o ya ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan na bi kpi.
en: If a person killed someone and then ran to one of the cities of safety, dont take money to let that person go home. That person must stay in that city until the high priest dies.

dag: Keenan bihi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan was the father of Sidon. Sidon was Canaans first son. Canaan was also the father of the Hittites.

dag: Pa kapinta ŋun nyɛ Mariama bia la m-bala? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Joses ni Judas ni Saimɔn la? Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o.
en: Isn't he the carpenter, the son of Mary? Aren't James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon his brothers? Don't his sisters still live here in our town? The people were upset because of what he was doing.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa doli vinvamli ni yuŋ maa n-yuuni nimaani polo chani ka yuuni gooni maa. Ka n daa lan ŋmaligi doli Vinvamli Dunɔdal la labi.
en: I went up by way of the valley by night and inspected the wall. Then I turned back and returned by entering through the Valley Gate.

dag: Ka n daa lan zaŋ Araba gba mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili mini di duli zaŋ Kinɛrɛt ni Araba Teeku din nyɛ Teeku Kpiŋ la ni Pisiga zo lɔŋ din be wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: The Jordan River near the desert is their western border. Lake Galilee is north of this area and the Dead Sea is to the south. It is at the bottom of the cliffs of Pisgah, which are to the east.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani baɣisiri Galili Teeku n-daa ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ti ʒini.
en: Then Jesus went from there to the shore of Lake Galilee. He went up on a hill and sat down.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka gbilisir o tibili wumdi bɛ kuhigu.
en: The Lord watches over those who do what is right, and he hears their prayers.

dag: Ka n daai yi ni zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi goon shɛli maa luhi tiŋa n-wurim li ka chɛ di tanzahi zali. Di ni ti lu n-kun ya, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I intend to break down the wall they whitewashed, to shatter it, and to leave the foundation stones bare. It will collapse and kill you all. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, bɔɣilɔ titali n-do ti mini ya sunsuuni, ka so ku tooi yi ti sani m-baai yaɣ li ka yi sanna; ka so mi ku tooi yi yi sani ka ti sanna.
en: Besides all that, there is a deep pit lying between us, so that those who want to cross over from here to you cannot do so, nor can anyone cross over to us from where you are.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti tim sandaani niŋ nandaamba, ka labisi bɛ buni ti ba.
en: Their children will repay the poor; their hands will give back their wealth.

dag: Kɛnaz ni Tɛman ni Mibizar.
en: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar.

dag: Yi ni daa labina ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, Yawɛ daa bi wum yi kuhigu maa bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa be yi ni.
en: Then you came back crying to the Lord for help, but the Lord refused to listen to you.

dag: N nuu ka n daa zaŋ nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ n nudirigu teei sagbana pa zuɣusaa. N yi yɛli ni di niŋ shɛli, di tiɣisirimi zani niŋ li.
en: I made the earth with my own hands. My right hand made the sky. And if I call them, they will come to stand before me.

dag: Dama yi ni ti di vi yi ni yuri buɣa oki ti shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka yi suhuri ti saɣim yi ni pii yi sambani pu shɛŋa ti yi wuna la zuɣu.
en: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.

dag: Ti mi bi tibigirila timaŋa yi sani yaha, amaa ti wuhiri ya la dalir shɛli din ni chɛ ka yi nyu bara ti zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka yi tooi garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali ninsal niŋgbuŋkom lihibu nyuri bara, ka pa ni o biɛhigu la bɔhigu.
en: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu maa ni benibu zuɣu hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala. N niŋgbuŋ yaɣa pinaayi kul yiinila yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣiri nyin Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ.
en: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa laɣim maa fo baalim wumdi Baanabas mini Pool ni daa kahigiri shihir shɛŋa bɛ ni wuhi mini alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum bɛn pa Yɛhudianim maa sani yɛla wuhiri ba.
en: The whole group was silent as they heard Barnabas and Paul report all the miracles and wonders that God had performed through them among the Gentiles.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli ni maa zuɣu! Di chɛ ka alibarika be m ma ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa ni!.
en: Curse the day that I was born! Dont bless the day my mother had me.

dag: ni Jarimut ni Ɛnganim ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Jarmuth, and Engannim, with their pasture lands.

dag: kaman tɔŋ la, dama di ni ti paai ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: like a trap. For it will come upon all people everywhere on earth.

dag: N lo a alikauli, a ni niŋ zuliya pam yaba.
en: I promise that you will be the father of many nations. So now I'm changing your name from Abram to Abraham.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni n-kul tɛhiri di yɛla.
en: Mary remembered all these things and thought deeply about them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Hɛzɛkia suhigu maa, ka chɛ niriba maa taali, ka bi ku ba.
en: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer; he forgave the people and did not harm them.

dag: Nyamiya, n timla n tumo ni o ti mali soli ti ma. Ka yi ni yuuni bɔri yi Duuma so maa ni ti ka o jɛmbu duu na libigi ya. Alikauli tumo ŋun nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa shiri kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa yɛl o lala ka chaŋ naai, ka o bol o yiŋbih ayi mini tɔbbi so ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka gul o sahakam la na.
en: The angel who spoke to Cornelius left. Then Cornelius called two of his servants and a soldier. The soldier was a religious man, one of his close helpers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔh o, M mabia, tin bɔnim ka a lee zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tinsi maa yuli Keebal tiŋgbɔŋ hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He said, Solomon, my friend, are these the kind of towns you want to give me? So Hiram called the region Cabul because he thought it was worthless.

dag: O puli zuɣu gbaŋ ŋmanila salichɛhi; o teer omaŋ dooni baɣiri ni kaman kaburi dɔɣu la.
en: The skin on his belly is like sharp pieces of broken pottery. He leaves tracks in the mud like a threshing board.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zal li saha shɛli yi ti paai, Siria naa maa ni lan labina ti liri Ijiptinim yaha, amaa din yɛla ni ti be di ko.
en: At the right time, the northern king will attack the southern king again. But this time he will not be successful as he was before.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Ɛbiasaf ni Asir ni.
en: Elkanah was Assirs son. Ebiasaph was Elkanahs son. Assir was Ebiasaphs son.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ti be soli n-chana, ka do so ti yɛl o, N ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: As they went on their way, a man said to Jesus, I will follow you wherever you go.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, piimiya yi ni niriba ayopɔin shɛb Shia Kasi ni pali, ka bɛ mali shɛhira suma ka lan mali yɛm pam, ka ti chɛ ka bɛ su tuma ŋɔ fukumsi;.
en: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ ni: Jɛhɔhanan mini Hanania ni Zabai ni Atilai.
en: Clan of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

dag: Dama o daa zali zaligu n-chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi n-kpuɣi teeku kɔgbana zuɣusaa.
en: He gave the command, and a strong wind began to blow. The waves became higher and higher.

dag: Molimi zuliya kam ni. Samiya tuuta, ka mol di yɛla. Miriya ka yi sɔɣi di shɛli. Yɛlimiya, Bɛ tuhi deei Babilɔn Bɛl di vi. Di niŋ Mariduk alahiziba. Bɛ dih o binnana vi, ka di gar o buɣa la.
en: Raise the signal flags; shout so all nations can hear— Babylon will be captured! Marduk, Babylon's god, will be ashamed and terrified, and his idols broken.

dag: ni Ɛluzai ni Jɛrimɔt ni Biilia ni Shɛmaria ni Shɛfatia ŋun daa nyɛ Harufi nir la.
en: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, and Shemariah; Shephatiah from Haruph;.

dag: Timiya ma soli ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa naai, di nyaaŋa, yin malimiya ma ansarisi.
en: Be patient while I speak. Then after I have finished speaking, you may make fun of me.

dag: Bɛ yiya ni ti leei shɛb dini, ka bɛ puri mini bɛ paɣiba leei shɛb dini, dama n ni darigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim tibili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their homes will be turned over to others, their fields and wives as well. I will stretch out my hand against the people of this land, declares the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zo n-kuli Gaat Naa Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Maok bia la sani.
en: So David set out with his six hundred soldiers and went to Achish, Maochs son and Gaths king.

dag: Dauda n-daa nyɛ biasani, ka bidib kpamba ata maa daa doli Sool chaŋ.
en: These three older sons followed Saul.

dag: Ka dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so m-pɔri gɔŋ o yuun pisaayika ka o ku tooi teeg omaŋ zaa la daa be nimaani.
en: A woman was there who had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and couldnt stand up straight.

dag: o nyɛla do so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ka maligumaana yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, o nyɛla ŋun mali dɔro o zuɣu ni.
en: the priest shall pronounce you unclean, because of the dreaded skin disease on your head.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ Ɛziɔngɛba mini Ɛlat tin shɛŋa din daa be teeku noli Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Solomon went to Ezion-Geber and Eloth, two Edomite towns on the Red Sea.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔrili zaɣ titali kpiŋkpama ayi ti paɣ maa ni o yiɣi zo ka chɛ wahu maa n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti be luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn dihir o hal ti paai yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: But the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle so that she could fly to her place in the desert. There she would be taken care of—out of the snakes reach—for a time and times and half a time.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni Yisa nyɛla Naa Hɛrɔd sulinsi ni nira, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Hɛrɔd sani, dama Naa Hɛrɔd gba daa kala Jɛrusalɛm na di saha maa.
en: After Pilate learned that Jesus came from the region ruled by Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem at that time.

dag: Di doli daadamnim bɛn vuhim kul be bɛ nyɛhi ni kɔŋko la yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ bukaata nyɛ bɔ?.
en: Stop trusting other people to save you. Do not think too highly of them; they are only humans who have not stopped breathing yet.

dag: ni wuntaŋ ni kpɛri tiwal viɛl shɛŋa, ka di wandi pam di goya ni.
en: May their land be blessed with sun-ripened fruit, Rich with the best fruits of each season.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa guli naa maa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya li, amaa ka a nol lee ku to li.
en: The personal attendant of the king said to Elisha, That can't happen—not even if the Lord himself were to send grain at once! You will see it happen, but you won't get to eat any of the food, Elisha replied.

dag: bɛ daa kul darimi gindi tinsi, ka dari gindi nam sulinsi tiŋgbana.
en: They traveled around from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ so shɛli tiligi Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib nuu ni m-bala. O daa lan tiligi Hɛzɛkia o dimnim zaa nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi luɣilikam zaa.
en: In this way the Lord rescued King Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the power of Sennacherib, the emperor of Assyria, and also from their other enemies. He let the people live in peace with all the neighboring countries.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛli, M bia maa ku doli ya chaŋ, dama o biɛli kpiya, ka o kɔŋko n-kpalim. Shɛli yi niŋ o yi ni yɛn chaŋ chandi shɛli ŋɔ ni, yi ni chɛ ka n dɔni kabiri puuni ni n kɔb piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: But Jacob said, My son cannot go with you; his brother is dead, and he is the only one left. Something might happen to him on the way. I am an old man, and the sorrow you would cause me would kill me.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu so zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la.
en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be crushed. And the stone will crush the person it falls on.

dag: M mabiyurisi, wummiya! Pa Naawuni m-pii ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛ nyɛ azichinima zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu polo, ka lan nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn di nam shɛli o ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la?.
en: My dear brothers and sisters, listen! Hasnt God chosen those who are poor by worldly standards to be rich in terms of faith? Hasnt God chosen the poor as heirs of the kingdom he has promised to those who love him?.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi nya doo maa, dabiɛm gbaari ba mi pam ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: When the Israelite soldiers saw Goliath, they were scared and ran off.

dag: Amaa n dana, o bi boli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini maligumaana Zadok ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni a bia Sulemaana.
en: Adonijah didnt invite me, your servant, Zadok the priest, Jehoiadas son Benaiah, or your servant Solomon.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li pie tab kulis ayi n-gili lansi maa zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpilli din tam daanya daantalisi la zaɣ yini zuɣu; ka daa lan niŋ din la gba lala.
en: He made the pillars and two rows of pomegranates for each network to adorn each of the capitals.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa zaŋ tabili tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ.
en: So Joshua went up from Gilgal with the entire army and all the bravest soldiers.

dag: Ka di daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb suli pam ka bɛ yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale ŋɔ lala?.
en: This made some of the guests angry, and they complained, Why such a waste?.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi deei n noli bee n-wum n yɛligu. Sokam daa niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi tuumbiɛri kaman bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka tibidarigibo shɛŋa zaa yɛla n ni daa yɛli n daalikauli lɔbu puuni la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: But they did not listen or obey. Instead, everyone continued to be as stubborn and evil as ever. I had commanded them to keep the covenant, but they refused. So I brought on them all the punishments described in it.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jarimiya yi kɔbiti din bi jari ŋɔ, ka miriya ka yi biriti yi bimbira niŋdi gɔhi ni.
en: The Lord says to the people of Judah and Jerusalem, Plow up your unplowed fields; do not plant your seeds among thorns.

dag: di saha ka o luɣiri ninsalinim tiba, ka kpahiri bɛ zuɣuri ni ka dabiɛm mali ba.
en: He may whisper something in their ear, and they are frightened when they hear his warnings.

dag: zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi paag a, ka alɔbo shɛli mi ku tooi mir a yiŋ na.
en: no evil will happen to you; no disease will come close to your tent.

dag: ka di be kaman taŋkpa balli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: They will spread out like fine dust over all the land of Egypt, and everywhere they will produce boils that become open sores on the people and the animals.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbaai Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin chaŋ, di yuun pihitanaayopɔin gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi biɛɣu pisinaanu dali, ka Ivilmɛrɔdak ŋun daa di nam Babilɔn di yuuni maa la daa niŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim n-yih o sarika ni.
en: Judahs King Jehoiachin had been in exile for thirty-seven years when Awil-merodach became king in Babylon. He took note of Jehoiachins plight and released him from prison on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month of that very year.

dag: Bɛ daa bi gbibi Naawuni ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la, ka daa zaɣis o zaligu dolibu.
en: They did not keep their covenant with God; they refused to obey his law.

dag: A ni mali sida dari pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a nyɛ naa maa? A ba daa pala ŋun diri ka nyura, ka niŋdi din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli? Dinzuɣu ka shɛlikam daa niŋ viɛnyɛla o sani.
en: Is this what makes you a king, having more cedar than anyone else? Didnt your father eat and drink and still do what was just and right? Then it went well for him!.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka Ɛhab bia Jɛhɔram daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi.
en: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Jehoshaphat's eighteenth year as king of Judah. Joram ruled twelve years from Samaria.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti chaŋ tɔbu ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka a chɛ ka bɛ be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa a ni pii tiŋ shɛli ka m me a duu zali ti a yuli jilima ŋɔ polo na n-suh a.
en: Sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.

dag: A kuhigu maa nyɛla din ni sɔŋ yih a muɣisigu ni bee a yaa zaa n-ni ti a sɔŋsim?.
en: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress.

dag: Kamiyana ka yi mini n dan Asiria naa maa puli. Yi yi ni tooi nya wɔribariba, n ni tin ya yuri tusaayi.
en: So now, make a wager with my master, Assyrias king. Ill give you two thousand horses if you can supply the riders!.

dag: ni bɛ ti to jina baŋ bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o.
en: and made plans to arrest Jesus secretly and put him to death.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Lɛvi bidibisi maa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yi mali yimaŋa m-be kasi ni yi tumdi Yawɛ tuma, yi zaa yinoyino bidibisi mini yi mabihi kubu ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya alibarika zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to them, You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.

dag: M mabihi, baŋmiya ni so ku tooi nya yolisim Anabi Musa zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka ti yihiri ya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu doo ŋɔ zuɣu maa, ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya yolisim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, know this: Through Jesus we proclaim forgiveness of sins to you. From all those sins from which you couldnt be put in right relationship with God through Moses Law.

dag: Tɔbaya ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la daa ʒiɛmi tab o, ka gba daa yɛli, Kuɣa goon shɛli bɛ ni mɛri maa, hal ŋɔɣu yi du n-tam di zuɣu, o ni daai li luhi.
en: Tobiah the Ammonite was with Sanballat. Tobiah said, What do these Jews think they are building? If even a small fox climbed up on it, he would break down their wall of stones.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani yi zahira, ka bɛ nini nya li. Izraɛlnim ni ti tuui lu bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni. Ka Judanim gba ni ti tuui lu m-pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Israels pride is a witness against him; both Israel and Ephraim stagger because of their guilt; Judah staggers with them.

dag: Nyama, bɛ yi kul ʒini luɣ shɛli bee bɛ yi kul yiɣisi luɣ shɛli, mani ka bɛ yiini yila tura.
en: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa yi zaani Musa tooni n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa kaman nir ni tɔɣisir o zo yɛtɔɣa shɛm la. Musa daa yi ti yi suɣili maa ni n-labi sansani maa ni, o sɔŋda Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia, ka nyɛ nachimbil la n-daa yi kpalindi be suɣili maa ni.
en: In this way the Lord spoke to Moses face to face like a man speaks with his friend. Then Moses would go back to the camp, but his helper, Joshua son of Nun, always stayed in the tent.

dag: Dama a sani ka nyɛvili kɔbilisirim be. A neesim zuɣu ka ti nyari neesim.
en: You are the source of all life, and because of your light we see the light.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim maligu bimbina din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la mini bɛ ni daa tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa n-va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: They took all the altars that had been used in Jerusalem for offering sacrifices and burning incense and threw them into Kidron Valley.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ bia maa ti yɛn yaag o noli yɛli, M ba bee M ma, di saha Asiria naa ni ti kana ti zaŋ Damaskus azichi, ka di Samaria nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: He said that because before the boy learns to say Mama and Daddy, God will take all the wealth and riches from Damascus and Samaria and give them to the king of Assyria.

dag: O ni daa mali bia maa chani Yisa sani ka alizin biɛɣu maa yiɣis o n-darig o. Ka Yisa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bia maa kpaŋ, ka o zaŋ o labisi ti o ba maa.
en: While the boy was coming, the demon threw the boy to the ground. The boy lost control of himself. But Jesus gave a strong command to the evil spirit. Then the boy was healed, and Jesus gave him back to his father.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti sariakarita, ŋuna n-su ti, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti naa. O ni tiligi ti.
en: All the rigging on those ships is useless; the sails cannot be spread! We will seize all the wealth of enemy armies, and there will be so much that even the lame can get a share. The Lord himself will be our king; he will rule over us and protect us.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu, Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa waawaayili ka yi zaɣisi wumbu, ka n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku saɣi.
en: You people of Judah were doing all these evil things too. This message is from the Lord ! I spoke to you again and again, but you refused to listen to me. I called to you, but you did not answer.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi diri nam, niriba malila suhupiɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi su fukumsi, niriba fabindimi.
en: Show me a righteous ruler and I will show you a happy people. Show me a wicked ruler and I will show you a miserable people.

dag: Siɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Hɔri nir la bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋbihi la n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn.
en: Seir, a Horite man, lived in Edom before Esau. These are the sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah.

dag: Di saha ka Balak suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Balaam zuɣu, ka o zaŋ o nuhi kpahi taba ka yɛli Balaam, N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri bahi n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka a ti niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: Balak was angry with Balaam. He pounded his fists. Balak said to Balaam, I summoned you to curse my enemies, but now youve given a blessing these three times.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m bɔɣusapiŋ kɔbili kparigi ka m bɔɣu kabi.
en: If I ever did that, may my arm be pulled from its socket and fall from my shoulder!.

dag: Tiŋgban ni bindira niŋya pam; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni.
en: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!.

dag: Mani yi Duuma Naawuni yɛliya, n ni ku Ashidɔdnima, ka ku Ashikɛlɔn naa. N ni darigi Ɛkurɔn tibili, ka chɛ ka Filistianim bɛn kpalim zaa kpi.
en: And I will destroy the one who sits on the throne in Ashdod. I will destroy the king who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will punish the people of Ekron. Then the Philistines who are still left alive will die. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: ka bɛn be zibisim ni mini kum mahim ni ni ti nya neesim maa, ka di ni ti wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli nya suhudoo.
en: and to shine from heaven on all those who live in the dark shadow of death, to guide our steps into the path of peace.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda daŋ silisi la zuɣusaa polo. Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa sɔɣ o jilima sɔɣibu. Ka o bia Manaasa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Hezekiah died, he was buried in the section of the royal tombs that was reserved for the most respected kings, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem honored him. His son Manasseh then became king.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ka Filip so ŋun daa yi Bɛtisaida Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti bɔri ni ti nyala Yisa.
en: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and made a request: Sir, we want to see Jesus.

dag: Nir yi lo wahu kabire o dimbu nyaaŋa, di ku ku ŋun lo o kabire maa buchi.
en: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n sɔɣila a sani; fam ma bɛn zaa kariti doli ma la nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma.
en: Lord my God, I come to you for protection. Save me from those who are chasing me.

dag: Dama n ni gbahi Ifriimnim kaman gbuɣinli ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la, ka gbahi Judanim kaman gbuɣimbil ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni dari tɔhi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a young lion to the nation of Judah. I—yes, I myself—will rip them to pieces. I will carry them away, and no one can save them.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tan shɛli din guui, ka nyɛ tani maa pirigili la n-yili m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa polo.
en: The extra cloth that is left over from the tent curtains, that is, the half curtain that remains, should hang over the back of the dwelling.

dag: Yisa ni daa deei baptaizibu naai ka puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, di saha ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi, ka o nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he came up out of the water. Then heaven was opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and lighting on him.

dag: Di saha ka zuɣulaannima ayi la mini kpambaliba la daa lo nia m-bɔri ni bɛ nya Daniɛl taali o ni tumdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tuma shɛm puuni, amaa ka bi tooi. Dama Daniɛl daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim o suhu ni, ka bi tumdi din nyɛ chirimbu bee bilikɔnsi tuma.
en: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋlan ŋun fari ma bahira. A zaŋ bini pili n zuɣu tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.

dag: Ayuba bipuɣinsi maa viɛlim kpee daa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Ka bɛ ba daa ti ba fali pahi bɛ tizɔdɔbba maa zuɣu.
en: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.

dag: Yawɛ, n je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a. N ʒiɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpɛhir a nini.
en: Dont I hate everyone who hates you? Dont I despise those who attack you?.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm.
en: People of Israel, listen to the message that the Lord has for you.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, So yi lan yɛl a shɛli, nyin tahim o n sanna, ka o ku lan tooi niŋ a shɛli yaha.
en: He said, If anyone gives you trouble, bring them to me, and it won't happen again.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi yuntisuɣu n-kpuɣi man a dab paɣ ŋɔ bia ŋun do m-baɣi maa nti sɔŋ o tooni, ka zaŋ o bi kpiŋ maa na nti sɔŋ n tooni saha shɛli n ni daa gbihira.
en: She got up during the night, took my son from my side while I was asleep, and carried him to her bed; then she put the dead child in my bed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli niriba maa; ka daa laɣim Izraɛlnim kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin na nti chɛ ka bɛ zani gili suɣili maa.
en: Moses told the people what the Lord had said. Then he chose respected leaders and went with them to the sacred tent. While the leaders stood in a circle around the tent, Moses went inside.

dag: Siɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Hɔri nir la bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋbihi la n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn.
en: The original inhabitants of the land of Edom were divided into tribes which traced their ancestry to the following descendants of Seir, a Horite: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa zaŋ o niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o o siliga ni m-pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: His servants carried him back in a chariot to Jerusalem. He was buried in his tomb with his ancestors in Davids City.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni jɛm a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ka tum din tuhi a sani shɛm yɛla; ka daa kum pam.
en: Remember, Lord , that I have served you faithfully and loyally, and that I have always tried to do what you wanted me to. And he began to cry bitterly.

dag: ni dundɔŋ din gil la pilanim mini di binzahi ni kpahi ni mihi ni di nɛma zaa ni di neen kparisi zaa; ka a boli sokam zaa yuli n-wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn ʒi neen shɛŋa.
en: They must also carry the posts that are around the courtyard. They must carry the bases, the tent pegs, the ropes, and everything that is used for the poles around the courtyard. List the names and tell each man exactly what he must carry.

dag: Amaa dabiɛm daa bi gbaai naa min o kpambaliba bɛn daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ni so bee n-niŋ ba suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: And, when King Jehoiakim and his servants heard the message from the scroll, they were not afraid. They did not tear their clothes to show sorrow for doing wrong.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ di puuni maa n-nyɛ nimdi, ka tiŋ maa mi nyɛ duɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yihi yinim di puuni.
en: Now, the Lord GOD says this: The dead bodies are the meat, and the city is the pot. But someone will come and take you out of this safe pot.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Ka daɣila a nyɛla naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma dunia ŋɔ ni ni n dila yɛlimaŋli shɛhira. Ka ŋunkam suhu ye yɛlimaŋli zuɣu wumdi n yɛligu.
en: So you are a king, Pilate replied. You are saying that I am a king, Jesus told him. I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.

dag: Yi nyuri piɛri maa bihim, ka yɛri bɛ ni zaŋ piɛri kɔbiri wuɣi situr shɛŋa, ka kɔriti biŋkɔb pola bɛn mali kpam. Amaa yi bi dihiri piɛri.
en: You drink the milk, wear clothes made from the wool, and kill and eat the finest sheep. But you never tend the sheep.

dag: Tibigim yɛm, ka o duh a. A yi vili yɛm gbibi, o ni ti a jilima.
en: Highly esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will honor you if you embrace her.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Kom din be foliŋga tiŋli ŋɔ laɣimmi dɔni luɣ yini, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban kuŋ yi n-dɔni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then God said, Let the water under the sky be gathered together so that the dry land will appear. And it happened.

dag: Musa daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi chɛla paɣiba ŋɔ zaa ka bi ku ba?.
en: Moses said to them, Have you let all the women live?.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn chɛ ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ kpuɣi Ilaija chaŋ alizanda ni saha shɛli, o mini Ilaisha daa yila Giligal m-be soli zuɣu chana.
en: It was near the time for the Lord to take Elijah by a whirlwind up into heaven. Elijah and Elisha started to leave Gilgal.

dag: ni o yihi bɛ shihi gballi ni na, ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan nya nyɛvili neesim.
en: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.

dag: O daa poya yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka jɛmdi ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm;.
en: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear.

dag: Ɛliɔnai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔdavia mini Ɛliashib ni Pɛlaya ni Akub ni Jɔhanan ni Dalaiya ni Anani, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.

dag: Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la ti ma suhumahili kaman a ni lo mani a dabili ŋɔ alikauli shɛm la.
en: I serve you, Lord . Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.

dag: Ka naa Ivilmɛrɔdak daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣ dira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.

dag: Kpɛmiya tampima voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni saha shɛl o yi ti kana ni o ti dam dunia ŋɔ.
en: Go into caves in the rocks and holes in the dust before the terror of the LORD and the splendor of Gods majesty, when he arises to terrify the earth.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, labisimiya bɛ puri mini bɛ wain tihi puri ni bɛ olivi tihi puri ni bɛ yiya ti ba. Ka labisi yi ni niŋdi ba nyɔri shɛli yi liɣiri mini yi chi ni yi wain ni yi kpam zuɣu la ti ba.
en: Cancel all the debts they owe you—money or grain or wine or olive oil. And give them back their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses right now.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jɛrimia ti niŋ bɔɣili ni jɛriyali maa ni, ka o daa be di puuni niŋ daba ayi.
en: I was put in an underground cell and kept there a long time.

dag: Rubin zuliya nti yɛn ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli be nudirigu polo. Rubin niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu.
en: The flag of Reubens camp will be south of the Holy Tent. Each group will camp near its flag. The leader of the tribe of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka tɔbbihi pali a ni kaman tol la. Bɛ ni ti ŋme nasara dibu kuŋa m-bah a zuɣu.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces has sworn by his own name: Im going to fill your cities with soldiers like a swarm of locusts; they will celebrate their victory over you.

dag: Laɣimmiya niriba maa na Chɛliya ka laɣiŋgu maa be kasi. Laɣimmiya ninkura na, ka laɣimmiya bihi mini bimɔɣirisi gba na. Hal di nyɛla talahi ni aŋgɔnim yi bɛ duri na, ka amiliyanim yi amiliya lɔbu duri na.
en: Bring the people together. Call for a special meeting. Bring together the old men, the children, and the small babies still at their mothers breasts. Let the bride and her new husband come from their bedroom.

dag: yin piimiya fɔntins ata Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni.
en: divide the territory into three parts, each with a city that can be easily reached. Then any of you that kill will be able to escape to one of them for protection.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, n da yi mini yi puri n-ti Firawuna zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Pumpɔŋɔ deemiya bimbira ŋɔ zali nti biri.
en: Then Joseph said to the people, You and your land now belong to the king. I'm giving you seed to plant.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahim nya ka bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa piila jilima ʒiishɛhi. Di saha maa ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: Jesus noticed how some of the guests were choosing the best places, so he told this parable to all of them:.

dag: ti yɛl o, Amiliya lɔbu ni sokam daŋdila wain viɛlli tibu pɔi, ka niriba yi ti nyu n-tiɣi, di saha ka bɛ naanyi zaŋdi wain piti na, amaa nyin zaŋla wain nyaɣisili sɔɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: and said, Everyone serves the good wine first. They bring out the second-rate wine only when the guests are drinking freely. You kept the good wine until now.

dag: Dinzuɣu malaikanim lee nyɛla bɔ? Bɛ nyɛla shihi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ o ni timdi shɛb ka bɛ ti sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn nyari tiliginsim.
en: All the angels are spirits who serve God and are sent to help those who will receive salvation.

dag: Ŋunkam maani o kpee ansarisi nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm, amaa yɛndana ŋun kul shinila o noli.
en: It is foolish to speak scornfully of others. If you are smart, you will keep quiet.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani, ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na; dama ŋun pɔri yi zaa ha ni, dilana n-nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni.
en: Then he said to his disciples, When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me. Whichever one of you is the most humble is the greatest.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdali yi n-gili samban ni n-chaŋ samban ni dunɔdali din kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini, ka kom maa zɔri yiri nudirigu polo na.
en: He led me out through the north gate and around the outside to the outer east gate, where the water flowed out under the facade on the south side.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Biŋkpam zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: The priest will then completely burn all of this on the altar as food—as a food gift for a soothing smell. All fat belongs to the LORD.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun yuli daa booni Siiva bidibis ayopɔin n-daa niŋdi lala maa.
en: Seven sons of a high priest named Sceva were doing this.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi Dauda paɣiba ayi la gba chaŋ; Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la.
en: Even David's two wives, Ahinoam and Abigail, had been taken away.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, Di deei bɛ sara maligu. N na ʒi n-deei bɛ so buŋa, m mi na ʒi n-niŋ bɛ ni so zaɣ biɛ shɛli.
en: Moses became very angry and he said to the LORD, Pay no attention to their offering. I havent taken a single donkey from them, nor have I wronged any one of them.

dag: Kom pam ku tooi kpihi yurilim, ka kokpɛɣu mi ku tooi di li. Nir yi zaŋ o yiŋ azichi zaa ni o da yurilim, bɛ ni mal o ansarisi.
en: Rushing waters cant quench love; rivers cant wash it away. If someone gave all his estate in exchange for love, he would be laughed to utter shame.

dag: ka yi ŋme n-nyaŋ bɛ ni me birininim gili bɛ tin shɛŋa la nim mini tiŋ gahinda la, ka ŋma bɛ ti suŋ kam zaa luhi; ka ŋari bɛ kɔbil nina zaa, ka kahi kuɣa sɔŋ luɣ shɛŋa din tam vuhiri shee zaa n-saɣim li.
en: You will attack every strong city and every good city. You will cut down every good tree. You will stop up all the springs of water. You will ruin every good field with stones.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia alali nyɛla ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia o suhu ni, ka gunibu maŋli mi nyɛ suhu ni yɛla din nyɛ Naawuni Shia ni niŋdi shɛli, ka di pala niŋgbuŋ ni kɔŋko yɛla. Ka dilana nyari paɣibu la Naawuni sani, ka pa ni ninsalinim sani.
en: A true Jew is one who is a Jew inside. True circumcision is done in the heart. It is done by the Spirit, not by the written law. And anyone who is circumcised in the heart by the Spirit gets praise from God, not from people.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi ni Ɛdirɛi ni Ɛnhazɔr.
en: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor.

dag: dindina yi ni zɔri tɔb shɛli maa ni liri ya nimaani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka yi ni zɔri kum shɛl la ni doli ya kpe Ijipti, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: You are afraid of war, starvation, and disease here in Judah, but they will follow you to Egypt and kill you there. None of you will survive the disasters I will send.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka gɔhi bili m puu ni, ka pa ni alikama, ka chɛ ka yihim bili ka pa ni chi. Ayuba yɛtɔɣa tariga m-bala.
en: then instead of wheat and barley, may weeds and thistles grow. The words of Job are ended.

dag: Ka o mini ba zaa daa chaŋ Baalɛjuda ni bɛ ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na. Bɛ daa zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka o nam kuɣ tam chɛrubinim zuɣu la yuli boli Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: David and all the troops who were with him set out for Baalah, which is Kiriath-jearim of Judah, to bring Gods chest up from there—the chest that is called by the name of the LORD of heavenly forces, who sits enthroned on the winged creatures.

dag: Di tuhiya a sani ni a niŋ a ni zaŋ a nuhi tum tuun shɛli alaka ka lihi ʒiɛm li, ka lee yurila ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli?.
en: Is it right for you to be so cruel? To despise what you yourself have made? And then to smile on the schemes of wicked people?.

dag: Cham Naa Dauda sani yomyom ti bɔh o, N dan naa, a daa bi po pɔri man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani ni a ni chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ti di nam n-ʒin a nam ʒiishee? Ka di chaŋ wula ka Adɔnija nti di nam.
en: go at once to King David and ask him, Your Majesty, didn't you solemnly promise me that my son Solomon would succeed you as king? How is it, then, that Adonijah has become king.

dag: Dama niriba maa pam daa bi mali bɛmaŋ kasi. Dinzuɣu Lɛvinim n-daa kɔriti bɛnkam bi be kasi maa Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbihi, ni di chɛ ka sara maa be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Since many in the congregation hadnt made themselves holy, the Levites slaughtered the Passover lambs, making them holy to the LORD for all who werent ceremonially clean.

dag: Ka ti daa chaŋ ti baɣisi tiŋgban bil shɛli din be kom sunsuuni ka bɛ booni li Kauda la gari, ka di daa taɣi ti ka chɛ pɔhim maa. Ti wahala nyabu ŋɔ puuni ti daa kpaŋ timaŋa ni ti lo ŋarin bil din daa baɣi ŋarin titali maa tabili ka di ku lu.
en: We went below a small island named Cauda. With the island protecting us from the wind, we were able to bring in the lifeboat, but it was very hard to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu m po pɔri yɛli Ɛli min o yiŋnima ni sara maligu bee wumpaɣibo pini lan kani din ni tooi nyahi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa hal abada.
en: Because of that I swore about Elis household that his familys wrongdoing will never be reconciled by sacrifice or by offering.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini di niriba zuɣu din nyɛ yɛl biɛ shɛŋa zaa din sabi kundi shɛli bɛ ni karim wuhi Juda naa maa ni la.
en: Josiah, I am the Lord ! And I intend to punish this country and everyone in it, just as this book says.

dag: Ka Musa mini Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, chɛliya vuri ka wum, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi leei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba.
en: Then Moses and the levitical priests said to all Israel: Quiet down and listen, Israel! This very moment you have become the people of the LORD your God.

dag: M biɛhigu ni be kaman Masia biɛhigu la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi gba biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: Imitate me, then, just as I imitate Christ.

dag: Zaɣ biɛ shɛli ka n nya dunia ŋɔ ni, chirimbu titali maa mi yirila zuɣulaannim sanna.
en: Rulers do some things that are terribly unfair:.

dag: Liya bihi daa nyɛla Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bituuli la mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: The sons of Leah were Reuben, Jacobs oldest son, and Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

dag: A tinsi din be kasi la mini Ziɔn leela dabari. Ka Jɛrusalɛm leei bɛ ni zo ka chɛ tin shɛli.
en: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi bahi yi tuuli yurilim la.
en: But I have this against you: You have left the love you had in the beginning.

dag: Doo min o bia noya ni ti woli taba ka bɛ zaɣisi taba; ka paɣ min o bipuɣiŋga ti zaɣisi taba; ka paɣ ni ti zaɣis o bia paɣa, ka paɣ gba ti zaɣis o yidana ma.
en: Father will square off against son and son against father; mother against daughter and daughter against mother; and mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.

dag: Ka o nyintaa daa yi kur o suli pam n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisira, Yawɛ ni daa bi ti o bia maa zuɣu.
en: Peninnah always upset Hannah and made her feel bad because the Lord had not made her able to have children.

dag: O daa ti lan ku Ijipti do viɛl so gba. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni, amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa kpani maa o nuu ni n-zaŋ omaŋmaŋ kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: Benaiah also killed a big Egyptian soldier. The Egyptian had a spear in his hand, and Benaiah only had a club. He grabbed the spear in the Egyptians hands and took it away from him. Then Benaiah killed the Egyptian with his own spear.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ lzraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn ŋmanila chi bubu saha kabɔɣili; di kpalim biɛla ka o daatam kpuɣibu saha paai.
en: Soon the enemy will cut them down and trample them like grain on a threshing place. I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, have spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti Naawuni. Zaɣisimiya Sintani, ka o zo ka chɛn ya.
en: Therefore, submit to God. Resist the devil, and he will run away from you.

dag: Turi mini yɔhiŋgu ni niriba nahiŋgu yɛla n-kul be bɛ noya ni; ka zilima yɛlibu mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri kul be bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Their speech is filled with curses, lies, and threats; they are quick to speak hateful, evil words.

dag: ka wuh a din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli din ni chɛ ka a garigi bɛn tim a na yɛlimaŋli garigibu?.
en: and will teach you what the truth really is. Then when you are sent to find it out, you will bring back the right answer.

dag: Ka bia maa ba maa baŋ ni di nyɛla saha shɛli Yisa ni sa yɛl o ni o bia maa ni gal la. Ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Then the father realized that this was the hour when Jesus had said to him, Your son lives. And he and his entire household believed in Jesus.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: Everyone who makes themselves important will be made humble. But everyone who makes themselves humble will be made important.

dag: Yinim bɛn kpiri kum pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti tiɣi. Yinim bɛn kumdi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti la.
en: Great blessings belong to you who are hungry now. You will be filled. Great blessings belong to you who are crying now. You will be happy and laughing.

dag: Naa maa ni ti nyu sokpaŋ kulibɔŋ kom n-nya kpiɔŋ di nasara.
en: The king will drink from a stream on the way. Then he will lift his head and become strong!.

dag: Naawuni ni daa duh o n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo maa ka o deei Shia Kasi so o Ba Naawuni ni daa zaŋ lo ti alikauli la n-ti ti na. Alikauli maa palibu shihira ka yi nya ka wum ŋɔ.
en: He was exalted to Gods right side and received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit. He poured out this Spirit, and you are seeing and hearing the results of his having done so.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka dunianim baŋ a soli, ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ a tiliginsim yiko yɛla.
en: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, N daa pun yɛl a ni daa tim a tuun shɛb n sanna la.
en: Balaam answered, I told the messengers you sent to me that.

dag: Kpuɣim a nɛma maa buɣi a bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu bɛ ninni, ka zaŋ bini pɔb a nina n-ʒi li yi liɣa din ni chɛ ka a nini ku nya tiŋgbani. Dama n zaŋ a leela shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti mi ni a nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛra ni ŋun wuhiri din tuhi ka bi gaŋdi so, amaa ka wuhiri Naawuni soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: The spies said to him, Teacher, we know you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.

dag: M Ba ni zaŋ shɛb zaa ti ma ni ka n sanna, ka ŋunkam mi ka n sanna, n ku zaɣis o.
en: The Father gives me my people. Every one of them will come to me. I will always accept them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nyɛ n dimnim yi liri ma m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma, bɛ ni tuui lu.
en: When evildoers come at me trying to eat me up— its they, my foes and my enemies, who stumble and fall!.

dag: Ka din pah ayɔbu gbaai Bukia min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Sixth, there were men chosen from Bukkiahs sons and relatives.

dag: dama o daa na bela o yab Ibrahimma niŋgbuŋ ni, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣ o saha shɛli Mɛlikizɛdɛk ni daa tuhi ti yab Ibrahimma sol la.
en: For Levi had not yet been born, but was, so to speak, in the body of his ancestor Abraham when Melchizedek met him.

dag: Jɛra noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-saɣindi ba, ka bɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛ zana din gbahiri bɛmaŋmaŋa.
en: When a fool speaks, he is ruining himself; he gets caught in the trap of his own words.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa zaa tooni, ka kuhi yɛli, Sokam yiɣisim n sani yi. Dinzuɣu so daa ka Yisifu sani saha shɛl o ni daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa o ni nyɛ so.
en: Joseph could not control himself any longer. He cried in front of all the people who were there. Joseph said, Tell everyone to leave here. So all the people left. Only the brothers were left with Joseph. Then he told them who he was.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ mɔɣa kom leei ʒim, ka bɛ ku tooi lan nyu bɛ kulibɔna kom.
en: He turned the rivers into blood, and the Egyptians had no water to drink.

dag: Ka yɛm shia daa pali Nan bia Jɔshua, dama Musa daa zaŋla o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa deeg o noli, ka niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Moses had put his hands on Joshua and appointed him to be the new leader. Then Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom. So the Israelites began to obey Joshua, and they did what the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be yoma mini tin shɛŋa din be katinsi zaa ni ti mali ya ansarisi, tin shɛli din yuli bi du ka gadama pali di ni ŋɔ.
en: Countries nearby and countries far away sneer at you because of your lawlessness.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe m-pali dunia, ka ŋariŋ maa du m-pa di zuɣu.
en: The water continued to rise, and the boat floated on the water high above the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa dii zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni n-zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu.
en: One of them at once ran and grabbed a sponge. He soaked it in wine, then put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus.

dag: Puhimiya tab yurilim puhigu! Naawuni tim yinim bɛn nyɛ Masia ni su shɛb la zaa suhudoo!.
en: Greet one another with the kiss of Christian love. May peace be with all of you who belong to Christ.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti kana ti kpuɣi binshɛɣukam zaa din be a yili ŋɔ min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n-kuli Babilɔn; ka di shɛli ku guui, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The days are nearly here when everything in your palace and all that your ancestors collected up to now will be carried off to Babylon. Not a single thing will be left, says the LORD.

dag: Kaman tampiŋ sabinli ni kpɛm gari chɛribo kuɣili shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Di zɔri ba bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: A diamond is harder than flint rock. In the same way you will be more stubborn than they are, and your head will be harder. Then you will not be afraid of them or those who always turn against me.

dag: Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin dihi niriba tusaanahi la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi di gba pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: And the seven loaves that fed the four thousand and how many large baskets of leftovers you gathered?.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin saɣisim o; o yi deeg o galimi, nyin chɛl o taali paŋ o.
en: Watch yourselves! If your brother or sister sins, warn them to stop. If they change their hearts and lives, forgive them.

dag: ka o zaŋ li ŋubi bɛ zaa nini maa ni.
en: While the followers watched, he took the fish and ate it.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zuɣu kul ʒiɛla ya n-gari n dimnim bɛn gil ma. Ka n ni mali sara o jɛmbu duu, ka tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu; n ni yili yila n-niɣim n-lɔŋni paɣi Yawɛ.
en: So I will triumph over my enemies around me. With shouts of joy I will offer sacrifices in his Temple; I will sing, I will praise the Lord .

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali sania maŋa ni zahimbu maŋa ni tahi maŋa ni kuruwa maŋa: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: You must have accurate scales and accurate weights, an accurate ephah and an accurate hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

dag: bɔɣili maa lan ni yo samli. Di simdi ka o yo biŋkɔbigu maa lana, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb kpiŋ maa.
en: the owner of the pit must make good on the loss. He should pay money to the oxs owner, but he may keep the dead animal.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Mani n-nyɛ Firawuna, so ku tooi kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa bee n-vuug o napɔŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni, ka pa ni nyini m-bah o noli.
en: Then Pharaoh said to him, I am Pharaoh, the king over everyone in Egypt, but no one else in Egypt can lift a hand or move a foot unless you say he can.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti piligi Aroa mini fɔn tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Gaad din be Jaza polo la.
en: They crossed the Jordan and camped south of Aroer, the city in the middle of the valley, in the territory of Gad. From there they went north to Jazer.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa gba daa kana ti damd o tooni ka yɛli, Ti nyɛla a daba.
en: His brothers wept too, fell down in front of him, and said, Were here as your slaves.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa, ka niriba maa kpalim zani ka bi lan kariti doli Izraɛlnim maa bee n-lan tuhiri ba.
en: So Joab blew a trumpet, and his people stopped chasing the Israelites. They did not try to fight the Israelites anymore.

dag: So yi bi saɣi li, yin di chɛliya ka yi baɣa be o ni.
en: If you do not accept this, you will not be accepted.

dag: Ka Jɛhu lan yɛl o, Doli ma nti nya n suhu ni ye Yawɛ zuɣu shɛm, ka daa chɛ ka o kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ni pah o zuɣu.
en: saying, Come with me and see for yourself how devoted I am to the Lord . And they rode on together to Samaria.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ba ni bɛ deem kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa balim Pita ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali yi daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi nya, ka wum malaika bɔbili bɛn nyɛ tusatusa paai shɛm kukoya. Bɛ daa ʒe n-gilila nam ʒiishee maa ni binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la.
en: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels. The angels were around the throne, the four living beings, and the elders. There were thousands and thousands of angels—, times .

dag: Ti Duuma, nyam bɛ ni kpɛhi ti dabiɛm shɛm. Chɛ ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ na kul tɔɣisim a yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: And now, Lord, take notice of the threats they have made, and allow us, your servants, to speak your message with all boldness.

dag: Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n sɔŋda. Ŋuna n Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi n nyɛvili.
en: But God is my helper. The Lord is my defender.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛri ni bari ma zana la zaa yoli, n ku tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: Though the wicked have surrounded me with their ropes, I havent forgotten your Instruction.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gbaai Yisa maa zaŋ o tahi Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la yiŋa; nimaani ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there.

dag: Bɛ ni ti labina ti ʒini m mahim. Bɛ ni ti yirigi puma kaman sambani puu la. Bɛ ni ti wali wala kaman wain tia la, ka bɛ nyom viɛlim ni ti ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn wain nyom viɛlim.
en: Once again they will live under my protection. They will grow crops of grain and be fruitful like a vineyard. They will be as famous as the wine of Lebanon.

dag: Di saha ka m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa daa yɛl ti, Yi mi ni m paɣ daa dɔɣ ba la bidibis ayi ti ma.
en: Your servant my father said to us, You know that my wife gave birth to two sons for me.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi kpe n niriba dunɔdaya ni bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali ba ansarisi bɛ wahala dibu mini bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Ka di mi daa bi simdi ni yi fa bɛ daazichi bɛ daashaara nyabu dali.
en: You should not have entered the city gate of my people and laughed at their problems. You should not have taken their treasures in the time of their trouble.

dag: ka ŋun saɣisiri niriba, ŋun saɣisim ba; ka ŋun tɔhiri tɔto, ŋun tɔhimi ni o suhu zaa; ka ŋun ʒe fukumsi zaashee, ŋun tummi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋun mi niŋdi nirilim, ŋun niŋmi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: if it is to encourage others, we should do so. Whoever shares with others should do it generously; whoever has authority should work hard; whoever shows kindness to others should do it cheerfully.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa nam puu niŋ Idɛn din be wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ o ni nam ninsal so maa niŋ nimaani.
en: Then the Lord God planted a garden in Eden, in the East, and there he put the man he had formed.

dag: N di yuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chirindi ya maa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dii leela namɔɣilisi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: I wish that the ones who are upsetting you would castrate themselves!.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi maligumaani zuɣulaantali tuma Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din be tanti jɛmbu du maŋli la ni, ka di nyɛ ti Duuma ni zali shɛli, ka pa ni ninsal ni zali shɛl la.
en: Hes serving as a priest in the holy place, which is the true meeting tent that God, not any human being, set up.

dag: Ti daa da puu maa mini siliga din be di ni maa la Hitinim sani.
en: That cave is in the field that was bought from the Hittites.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Chɛliya ka yi ni shɛb lo kpara n-chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannima m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti Yawɛ.
en: Then Moses told the people, The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, Di chaŋya Ijipti. Baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni n wuhi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then I continued, The Lord has told you people who are left in Judah not to go to Egypt. And so I warn you now.

dag: So na mi n-nya lahizibu yɛlli ŋɔ? Tiŋgbɔŋ niriba ni tooi zani dahin yini yɛligi? Bee zuliya ni tooi zani dahin yini yɛligi? Ziɔn ku nahim ka di yuui, ka o niriba yɛligi.
en: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi ʒe yim ku tɔŋ. Ka ŋunkam ŋmari ʒiri kul bela barina ni.
en: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.

dag: n-yɛra, Di niŋya dunia bee teeku bee tihi shɛli hal ka ti ti zaŋ bintabinda tabili ti Naawuni jɛmdiba gbiɛri zuɣu naai pɔi.
en: The angel said, Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we mark the servants of our God with a seal on their foreheads.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa mini Izraɛlnima n-daa tuhi nyaŋ nanim maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ dabili Musa daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana n-ti Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili ni bɛ su li.
en: The Lord s servant Moses and the Israelites defeated all these kings. And Moses gave that land to the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh. Moses gave them this land to be their own.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti ŋmanila tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima o niriba bɛn tiligi sani.
en: A day is coming when the Lord Almighty will be like a glorious crown of flowers for his people who survive.

dag: Piim Lɛvinim Izraɛlnim puuni m-mali ba kasi.
en: Separate the Levites from the Israelites and cleanse them.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni, yin di mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ din ka gbinni kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ zuɣu ka Naawuni ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: When you pray, do not use a lot of meaningless words, as the pagans do, who think that their gods will hear them because their prayers are long.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋahi piɛlaa maa, ka Musa zaŋ binzuɣu mini nim ŋmahira maa ni biŋkpam nyo buɣim.
en: He cut up the ram into pieces, and then completely burned the head, pieces, and fat.

dag: M mabihi, m paɣi ti tizɔpaɣ so ŋun yuli booni Fiibi, ka o nyɛ ŋun tumdi Naawuni tuma Sɛnkiria cheechi ni la.
en: Im introducing our sister Phoebe to you, who is a servant of the church in Cenchreae.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa kuhirimi ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu, ka bɛn bɔɣiri mini bɛ gbaya daa kpi ni gbariti pam daa nya alaafee.
en: Evil spirits came out from many people with a loud cry, and many paralyzed and lame people were healed.

dag: Ka ŋunkam zaɣis a zaligu dolibu bee n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu, a ni zali ni o niŋ shɛlikam ni, bɛn kum o. Kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam.
en: Anybody who stubbornly opposes what you declare and doesnt obey any of your commands will be put to death. Be brave and strong.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba. O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi mini wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi, ka daa zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi maa shɛŋa zali tin shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mi zali Jɛrusalɛm ŋun naa sani.
en: Solomon had a great number of chariots and horses. He had chariots and , horse soldiers. He built special cities for these chariots. So the chariots were kept in these cities. King Solomon also kept some of the chariots with him in Jerusalem.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha ŋɔ tatabo pam wuhiri salo Naawuni yɛligu kaman bɛ baŋsim tariga ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: With many such parables he continued to give them the word, as much as they were able to hear.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di luɣilikam zaa ni di binyila la, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold, including its top, all its sides, and its horns. He also made a gold molding all around it.

dag: O sɔɣimi doya gu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka chɛ ka niriba pam bi ʒe yim.
en: Indeed, she ambushes like a robber and increases the number of the faithless.

dag: N daa ti baɣisila vinnyaɣilan puu gari, ka daa ti lan baɣisi jɛrigu wain tihi puu gari.
en: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.

dag: Amaa yi daalahichi n-leei kuɣituurili be yi mini yi Naawuni maa sunsuuni. Yi daalahichi maa zuɣu ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ya, ka ku wum yi suhigu.
en: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.

dag: Ibrahimma daa nyɛla Yisahaku ba, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Yaakubu ba, ka Yaakubu mi nyɛ Juda min o tizɔbihi ba.
en: From Abraham to King David, his ancestors were: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Judah and his brothers , Hezron; Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz , Obed , Jesse, and King David.

dag: Saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka yi ni ti wurim zo n-kuli yi yinsi ka chɛ ma n ko, amaa m pala n ko, dama m Ba maa be n sani.
en: Listen to me. A time is coming when you will be scattered, each to his own home. In fact, that time is already here. You will leave me, and I will be alone. But I am never really alone, because the Father is with me.

dag: Kulla dindali maa yuŋ ka bɛ daa ku Bɛlishaaza ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim naa maa.
en: That very same night, Belshazzar, king of the Babylonians, was killed.

dag: Yihim ʒiri mini yɔhiŋ n kɔbili ni. Di chɛ ka n nyɛ faralana bee bundana. Tim ma bindir shɛli din ni saɣi ma.
en: keep me from lying, and let me be neither rich nor poor. So give me only as much food as I need.

dag: Yinim jɛra ŋɔ, pa ŋun nam di nyaaŋ maa n-nam di puuni maa gba?.
en: Foolish people! Didnt the one who made the outside also make the inside?.

dag: Dabisili din daŋ tooni dali yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: You must have a special meeting on the first day of this festival. You will not do any work on that day.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa sani nti boli ba ka bɛ kana ti dol o. Ka o daa lan tim ti boli Asha mini Zɛbulɔn ni Naftali zuliya niriba, ka bɛ gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: He sent messengers throughout the territory of both parts of Manasseh to call them to follow him. He sent messengers to the tribes of Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, and they also came to join him.

dag: Ka ti yi kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti doli Masia n-yi taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa ka nya ka ti nyɛla alahichinima kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, di wuhiri ni Masia nyɛla ŋun ʒe alahichi tumbu nyaaŋa? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: But if it is discovered that we ourselves are sinners while we are trying to be made righteous in Christ, then is Christ a servant of sin? Absolutely not!.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mɔŋ nandaamba bɛ ni bɔri shɛli bee n-chɛ ka pakoli kɔŋ tahima.
en: If I have denied what the poor wanted, made a widows eyes tired.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita daa yɛli Yisa, Nyama, ti chɛla ti yinsi ka dol a.
en: Peter said, Look, we left everything we had and followed you.

dag: Ka yi ti ku Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni la zaa, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu. Miriya ka yi ti jɛm bɛ wuna, dama di ni ti leei zana yi sani.
en: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.

dag: Ka Firawuna suhu daa yiɣisi bah o tumtumdiba ayi bɛn daa nyɛ o wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm zuɣu.
en: He was angry with these two officials.

dag: M mabihi, chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu kul be kaman m biɛhigu. Ti pun wuhi ya biɛrisuŋ soli, dinzuɣu kpahimmiya nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol li.
en: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣi yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛ bɔrila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ni nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ dini.
en: People who say this kind of thing make it clear that they are looking for a homeland.

dag: Ka yi ni bi mi ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti di yi puri ni bindira ni yi tuma zaa daanfaani. Yi ti kul ni bela turi mini nahiŋgu ni sahakam.
en: A nation that you dont know will take all your crops and everything you worked for. People will treat you badly and abuse you.

dag: A ŋariŋduhiriba n-zaŋ a chaŋ teeku bulli ni. Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒe n-saɣim a teeku bulli maa ni.
en: When your oarsmen brought you out to sea, An east wind wrecked you far from land.

dag: Yɛlim Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda gomna la ni di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: for Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah: I am about to shake heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Shɛva daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara. Ka Zadok mini Abiata daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Sheva was the secretary. Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ jɛrigu niŋ tol ni pahi bɛ ni yɛn to shɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ tiliga to o, di zaa yoli, bɛ ku tooi to jɛrilim yih o ni.
en: Even if you grind fools in a mortar, even grinding them along with the grain, their folly wont be driven from them.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya kam lɔri duŋ taabo nia, ka zuliya kam lɔri nia biɛri din ka buchi?.
en: Why are the nations so angry? Why are the people making such foolish plans?.

dag: Ibrahimma daa kurigiya pam, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: As the days went by and Abraham became older, the LORD blessed Abraham in every way.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yidana zaɣisir o min o paɣa laɣimbu; ka paɣ gba di zaɣisir o min o yidana laɣimbu.
en: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.

dag: amaa ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi ni nya jilima mini paɣibu ni suhudoo, Yɛhudianima n-lan daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: But there will be glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does what is good, for the Jew first and also for the Greek.

dag: A naŋgbampiba ŋmanila gali ʒee, ka a noli viɛli pam. A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti zo n-tiligi tɔb maa ni ni ti yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla niriba biɛla. Ka Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa kpalim, ka chaŋ ti be Ijipti la ti baŋ ŋun yɛligu yɛn niŋ pali, n dini bee bɛ dini.
en: Those who actually survive war and return from Egypt to the land of Judah will be very few. Then the few remaining Judeans living in Egypt will know for certain whose word is true—mine or theirs!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti zaŋ li tin ya kaman o ni daa lo yi mini yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord will bring you into the land of the Canaanites, which he solemnly promised to you and your ancestors. When he gives it to you.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka bɛ tum tuma maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ tum li shɛm maa, ka o daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Moses looked closely at all the work and saw that it was done exactly as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

dag: N kul ku tam yi yɛla. Nyama, n pun sab yi yuli niŋ n nutaya ni.
en: Jerusalem, I can never forget you! I have written your name on the palms of my hands.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgban ni tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti man Yawɛ, di nyɛla yi dini; ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: The early produce of everything in their land, which they bring to the LORD, will be yours. Anyone who is clean in your household may eat it.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya o ka baŋ ni o dɔni nimaani yuui maa ka o bɔh o, A bɔri ni a nya alaafee.
en: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, Do you want to be healed.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa labina nti nya o mini paɣ maa ni diri alizama maa ka di gari ba pam, amaa bɛ ni so daa bi bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra? Bɛ mi daa bi bɔhi Yisa, Bɔzuɣu ka a mini paɣ maa diri alizama.
en: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Naawuni, N na doli Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni? Amaa ka o bi garig o dindali maa.
en: So Saul asked God, Shall I attack the Philistines? Will you give us victory? But God did not answer that day.

dag: Di saha Napaɣ Vashiti gba daa laɣimla paɣiba na, ka bɛ ti be nayili maa puhiri bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu maa.
en: At the same time, Queen Vashti held a feast for women in King Ahasuerus palace.

dag: Saa mini sakuɣa ni yiri zuɣusaa lurina, ka bi lan labiri zuɣusaa amaa ka mahigiri tiŋgbani n-chɛ ka bindira bimbira tɔri yirina n-zoori niŋdi bindira tiri bindiridiriba, ka niŋdi bimbira tiri bɛn biriti shɛm la.
en: My word is like the snow and the rain that come down from the sky to water the earth. They make the crops grow and provide seed for planting and food to eat.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino kpuɣim o labila, ka di kalinli yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka yi niŋ tulaale zim niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ka Yawɛ tooni na. Ka a gba mini Aduna gbibi yi tulaale lahi.
en: Every person should take his censer, place incense on it, and present it before the LORD. Each person will carry his censer, two hundred fifty censers in all, including you and Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila yɛndaan so ŋun daa me o yili tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: So then, anyone who hears these words of mine and obeys them is like a wise man who built his house on rock.

dag: Ka tɔrili zaɣ titali so daa lan beni m-mali kpiŋkpan kara, ka mali kɔbiri pam. Nyama, ka yɔɣili maa ŋmaligi di nyaɣa kpa o polo, ka teei di wula kpa o polo ni o niŋ kom yɔɣi li, ka bɛ sibigi li bɛ ni biri li luɣ shɛli maa.
en: There was another giant eagle with huge wings and thick plumage. And now the vine sent its roots toward him and turned its leaves toward him, in the hope that he would give it more water than there was in the garden where it was growing.

dag: Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla nyɛla jɛrilim bɛn be bahi yoli sol ni sani, amaa tinim bɛn tiligi ŋɔ sani, di nyɛla Naawuni yiko.
en: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, labisimiya bɛ puri mini bɛ wain tihi puri ni bɛ olivi tihi puri ni bɛ yiya ti ba. Ka labisi yi ni niŋdi ba nyɔri shɛli yi liɣiri mini yi chi ni yi wain ni yi kpam zuɣu la ti ba.
en: You must give their fields, vineyards, olive fields, and houses back to them, right now! And you must give back the interest you charged them. You charged them one percent for the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you loaned them.

dag: ka kpihim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani mɔpila zuɣu n-jɛmdi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi la ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani pɔri Yawɛ, amaa ka lan pɔri buɣili Milikom ŋɔ.
en: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi, dama so kani m-be ka nyini, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani m-pah a zuɣu kaman ti ni wum shɛm ti tiba ni.
