en: Lord GOD, this is why you are so great! There is no one like you. There is no god except you! We know that because of what we ourselves have heard about what you did.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli paɣiba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la.
en: The angel said to the women, Dont be afraid. I know you are looking for Jesus, the one who was killed on the cross.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri gbinni yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o, ka zaŋ zabba yɛl o, ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa yɛl o, ka zaŋ balati lo o.
en: Moses put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, and dressed him in the robe. Moses then put the priestly vest on Aaron, tied the woven waistband of the vest around him, and secured the vest to him with it.

dag: Naa, n tɛhi ni n nyɛla zuɣusuŋlana n ni zan a tooni zuŋɔ ni n tɔɣisi chihi mmaŋ noli Yɛhudianim ni fiɣisiri ma yɛl shɛŋa zaa zuɣu la.
en: King Agrippa! I consider myself fortunate that today I am to defend myself before you from all the things these Jews accuse me of.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o mi zuɣu nyɛ Shamma Agee ŋun daa nyɛ Hara nir la bia. Filistianim daa ti laɣim tab lo tɔb Lɛhi luɣ shɛli tuya balibu pam ni daa be la, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa.
en: Next in command was Agees son Shammah, who was from Harar. The Philistines had gathered at Lehi, where there was a plot of land full of lentils. The troops fled from the Philistines.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli ka dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri so shɛli ni bɛ yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani sol la dolibu ni.
en: They have not known the way in which God puts people right with himself, and instead, they have tried to set up their own way; and so they did not submit themselves to God's way of putting people right.

dag: saha shɛli yi ni guhiri Naawuni dabisili dali ka yi suhuri kul ye di kandina zuɣu ŋɔ. Dindali maa buɣim ni ti taai zuɣusaa di li zaa, ka buɣim maa ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa maa nyɛligi.
en: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: The Lord said to Elijah the prophet.

dag: Yurilim maa nyɛla ni ti doli Naawuni zaligunima. Ka o zaligu maa dolibu nyɛla ni ti yum taba kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm piligu ni la.
en: This love I speak of means that we must live in obedience to God's commands. The command, as you have all heard from the beginning, is that you must all live in love.

dag: Laɣimmiya tab na. Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa, vumiya mirina. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ dari ginda, ka jɛmdi wuna din ku tooi tiligi ba la nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni.
en: Gather and come, draw near together, fugitives of the nations! Those who carry their wooden idols dont know; those who pray to a god who wont save.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyini Masia, a daanabitali puuni wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: and said, You think you are the Messiah! So tell us who hit you.

dag: Ka o ti bɔhi ba, Alizam bɔ ka yi lee diri chani maa? Ka bɛ kpalim zani ni suhugarigu.
en: He said to them, What are you talking about as you walk along? They stopped, their faces downcast.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Job answered:.

dag: Amaa ka Iso daa guuina ti tuh o soli m-bɔb gbaag o n-zaŋ o zuɣu ti pa o nyingol zuɣu m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka bɛ zaa dii kuhira.
en: But Esau ran to meet him, threw his arms around him, and kissed him. They were both crying.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Asiria naa sapashin kpamba kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ mii tu o nyee ni, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: So the LORD brought the army commanders of Assyrias king against them. They captured Manasseh with hooks, bound him with bronze chains, and carried him off to Babylon.

dag: ka so mi yi yihi shɛli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, Naawuni ni yih o tarili nyɛvili tia la mini tiŋ kasi shɛli din yɛla sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la ni.
en: And if any take anything away from the prophetic words of this book, God will take away from them their share of the fruit of the tree of life and of the Holy City, which are described in this book.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lo tɔbu tuh a, amaa bɛ ti ku tooi nyaŋ a. Dama m be a sani ni n fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will attack you, but they wont defeat you, because I am with you and will rescue you, declares the LORD.

dag: Paɣisarili ni tooi tam o salima yɛri yɛla? Bee amiliya ni tooi tam o daamiliya binyɛra yɛla? Amaa n niriba ŋɔ bɛn ni tam n yɛla dabisi shɛŋa ka kalinli.
en: A young woman does not forget her jewelry. A bride does not forget to wear her wedding dress. But my people have forgotten me too many times to count.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti boli Yisifu n-zaŋ o sarika maa ni na yomyom; ka o daa pini o ninni ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-kpe Firawuna sani.
en: The king sent for Joseph, and he was immediately brought from the prison. After he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came into the king's presence.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnima m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then God said to Moses, These are the other laws that you will give to the people:.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔash ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin saha, ka Jɛhɔahaz bia Jɛhɔash daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king over Israel in Samaria. This was during the th year that Joash was king of Judah. Jehoash ruled Israel for years.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri n-luhiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyari kpɛhili shee bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: Wicked people bring about their own downfall by their evil deeds, but good people are protected by their integrity.

dag: Ka nabihi mini gomnanim ni sapashinnim ni kpambaliba bɛn daa laɣim maa na zaa kana ti nya niriba ata maa, ka buɣim maa bi tooi niŋ ba shɛli. Bɛ zabiri daa bi di; ka buɣim daa bi shihi bɛ situra gba, hal bɛ niŋgbuna daa bi nyo nyɔhi.
en: The chief administrators, ministers, governors, and the kings associates crowded around to look at them. The fire hadnt done anything to them: their hair wasnt singed; their garments looked the same as before; they didnt even smell like fire!.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paag a n-kpims a zaa. N ni ku a daŋ ni doo kam ŋun nyɛ bilichina bee dabili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So the Lord says to you, I will bring disaster on you. I will do away with you and get rid of every male in your family, young and old alike.

dag: Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka kanya n sanna. Wummiya n yɛligu, ka tiligi. N ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛli din ku yiɣisi, ka niŋ ya nirilim shɛli n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni niŋ Dauda la.
en: Listen and come to me; listen, and you will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful loyalty to David.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ŋɔ daa jɛmdi la Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛ buɣa; ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi na kul niŋdimi kaman bɛ yaannim maa ni daa niŋdi shɛm maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So these nations worship the LORD, but they also serve their idols. The children and the grandchildren are doing the very same thing their parents did. And thats how things still are today.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa garigi yɛli bɛ ni yino, Zɔri, m bi din ya zalinsi. Ka bɔh o, Bee yi di bi saɣi ni yi ni deei tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: Listen, friend, the owner answered one of them, I have not cheated you. After all, you agreed to do a day's work for one silver coin.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: For those who ask will receive, and those who seek will find, and the door will be opened to anyone who knocks.

dag: amaa ninsal ku tooi maai zilinli nini. Di nyɛla din bi saɣi ni so su li, ka lan nyɛ lɔɣu ni pali shɛl ni!.
en: But no one has ever been able to tame the tongue. It is evil and uncontrollable, full of deadly poison.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣa daa wum Sulemaana yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu polo, ka kana nti bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa din kpɛma ni o buɣis o nya.
en: The queen of Sheba heard about Solomon, so she came to test him with hard questions.

dag: Amaa n wuhiri n yurilim ni galisi shɛm niriba tusatusa bɛn yuri ma ka doli n zaligunim sani.
en: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zani baɣil o ka yɛli, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a ni do tiŋgban shɛli ni ŋɔ ti a min a zuliya;.
en: And there was the Lord standing beside him. I am the Lord , the God of Abraham and Isaac, he said. I will give to you and to your descendants this land on which you are lying.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu kpiɔŋ daa galisi pam hal ka ŋarin titali maa ti be kaman di yɛn chɛrisimi la.
en: But the LORD hurled a great wind upon the sea, so that there was a great storm on the sea; the ship looked like it might be broken to pieces.

dag: Bɛn zaa daa di li maa puuni, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu laasabu.
en: The number of men who were fed was five thousand.

dag: O daa lan lab me Naa Hiram ni daa zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa ti o la, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani.
en: Solomon next rebuilt the cities Huram had given him, and he settled Israelites there.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Biɛɣuni sa nyɛla gol palli dabisili, ka bɛ sa ni bɔ a kɔŋ, dama a sa ku ʒi a ʒiishee.
en: Then Jonathan said to him, Since tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, your absence will be noticed if you aren't at the meal.

dag: Ka n ku zo o bihi nambɔɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla pagɔrili bihi.
en: I will also have no compassion on her children because they are children of prostitution.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa su tɔbbihi fukumsi ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la nyɛ gbansabira wulana.
en: Joab, whose mother was Zeruiah, was the commander of the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was in charge of the records;.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihita mini bipuɣinsi pihita. Ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣinsi pihita maa ti dɔbba kpaŋa bɛn pa o daŋ puuni niriba; ka daa bo paɣiba pihita kpaŋ na ti ti o bidibisi maa mi. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayopɔin.
en: He had daughters and sons, and he let them all marry outside his clan. Ibzan was a leader for seven years.

dag: O daɣiri maa daa yila palo, ka o baɣa daa ka yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn paag o ni. O lubu maa daa mali alahiziba, ka so daa kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. Yawɛ, lihimi n ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, dama n dimnim di nasara.
en: Her uncleanness shows on her clothing; she didnt consider what would happen to her. Shes gone down shockingly; she has no comforter. LORD, look at my suffering—the enemy has definitely triumphed.

dag: Ti tumdi din yiɣisiri ti Duuma suhu, ka o zabiri nyuli di zuɣu? Ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o?.
en: Or should we make the Lord jealous? We arent stronger than he is, are we?.

dag: Dama pa paɣ ni ka doo yina, amaa doo ni ka paɣ ŋun yina.
en: for man was not created from woman, but woman from man.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha kanna ka niriba ni ti yi tinsi pam ni kana.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Peoples will still come, the inhabitants of many cities.

dag: M mini ŋun doli gbaai mani ŋun nyɛ o zo ŋɔ, ka yiɣisi o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli.
en: This one who was once my friend now attacks his friends. He is breaking every promise he made.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn tuui chɛ ka Hozia zaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnima, o daa yɛlila ŋun Hozia, Cham ti kpuɣi pagɔrili n-dɔɣi pagɔrili bihi. Dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim tum yolimyolim pam ka zaɣisi man Yawɛ, ka bi ʒe ma yim.
en: The Lord said, Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.

dag: Dama m mini n saawaranim ayopɔin n-timd a ni a chaŋ ti vihi nya Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda yɛla kaman a Naawuni zaligu din be a nuu ni ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I and my seven advisors send you to Judah and Jerusalem. Go and see how your people are doing in obeying the law of your God. You have that law with you.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: Jesus and his disciples reached Bethphage and Bethany near the Mount of Olives. When they were getting close to Jerusalem, Jesus sent two of them on ahead.

dag: So yi bol a ni a ka o daamiliya lɔbu ni na, nyin miri ka a chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti boli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yuli gar a;.
en: When someone invites you to a wedding, dont sit in the most important seat. They may have invited someone more important than you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali kam sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi dabisili kam sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini di binnyura sara.
en: This is the entirely burned offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular entirely burned offering and its drink offering.

dag: Nir ni tooi dɔɣi bihi kɔbiga, ka beni n-yuui pam, hal o yi yuui ti yaɣi gba, amaa ka bi di dunia ŋɔ binyara nyaɣisim, ka ti bi nya sɔɣiri viɛlli, dindina man ni yɛli shɛm nyɛla, Zaŋbahi so o.
en: A man might live a long time and have children. But if he is not satisfied with those good things, and if no one remembers him after his death, I say that a baby who dies at birth is better off than that man.

dag: ka kpihim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani mɔpila zuɣu n-jɛmdi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi la ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani pɔri Yawɛ, amaa ka lan pɔri buɣili Milikom ŋɔ.
en: I will destroy anyone who goes up on the roof and worships the sun, the moon, and the stars. I will also destroy those who worship me and swear loyalty to me, but then take oaths in the name of the god Molech.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛna, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ka ti na ʒi n-zaɣis o. Aduna bidibisi n-nyɛ ti maligumaaniba bɛn maani sara tiri Yawɛ ka Lɛvinim nyɛ bɛn sɔŋdi ba.
en: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.

dag: Dama Yawɛ m-pun zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili n-sɔŋ ti mini yinim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ sunsuuni wuhi ti tintarisi ni nyɛ shɛm, dinzuɣu yi ka tarili Yawɛ sani. Di saha, di pa shɛli ka yi yaansi ti chɛ ka ti yaansi chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: He made the Jordan a boundary between us and you people of Reuben and Gad. You have nothing to do with the Lord . Then your descendants might make our descendants stop worshiping the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi tiŋ maa ni dɔbba, Ka jɛmbu duu pagɔr so ŋun yi ʒiini Inaim palli naŋgbanyee ŋɔ la lee be ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: He asked the locals of that place, Wheres the consecrated worker who was at Enaim on the road? But they said, Theres no consecrated worker here.

dag: Kpɛm sani yuli n-daa booni Ohola, ka o tizo maa mi yuli booni Oholiba. Ka n daa kpuɣi ba leei m paɣiba, ka bɛ dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bɛ yuya maa ni wuhi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ohola nyɛla Samaria, ka Oholiba mi nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The older one was named Oholah , and the younger one was named Oholibah . I married both of them, and they bore me children.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ kɔhigɔriba gba ni ti kum ka fabili paɣ maa zuɣu, so ni bi lan dari bɛ nɛma zuɣu.
en: The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their cargoes anymore.

dag: Wummiya, di simdi ni n wuhi ya shihir shɛŋa min alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Zallakudura Naa ni kahigi wuhi ma.
en: Im delighted to share the signs and miracles that the Most High God has worked in my life.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mali sochandiba kpɛhili shee tiŋgban nɛli ni, n di naan chɛ n niriba ŋɔ ka zo, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni nyaanyiriba.
en: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God.

dag: Bin yini ka n suhiri Yawɛ sani, ka n suhu kul ye di zuɣu: dina n-nyɛ ni m be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga, ka n nya Yawɛ viɛlim, ka jɛmd o o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: I have asked the Lord for one thing; one thing only do I want: to live in the Lord 's house all my life, to marvel there at his goodness, and to ask for his guidance.

dag: Nyama, dabisi shɛŋa kanna ka n ni ti mɔŋ a min a yab yiŋnim zaa yaa, ka ninkurigu ti ku be yi daŋ maa ni yaha.
en: The time will come when I will kill you and everyone else in your family. Not one of you will live to an old age.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli.
en: He used parables to teach them many things, saying to them:.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, a shiri viɛli pam; a nina bemi kaman ŋmana la.
en: How beautiful you are, my love; how your eyes shine with love!.

dag: O yuri takarifiɛma mini o chɛchɛbunsi gbaya vuri ni ti chɛ ka bihi banim ku lan bɔhi bɛ bihi yɛla, bɛ bɔɣiri ti kul yɛn zalizalimi.
en: They will hear the sound of running horses, the noisy chariots, the rumbling wheels. Fathers will not be able to protect their children. They will be too weak to help.

dag: lala ka n yɛligu shɛli din yiri n nol ni na gba ku labi n sanna yoli. Di ni tum n ni lo ni di tum shɛli. Ka di nasara n ni tim li ni di ti tum shɛm puuni.
en: so is my word that comes from my mouth; it does not return to me empty. Instead, it does what I want, and accomplishes what I intend.

dag: Di pala o daa yurila nandaamba zuɣu ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ tayiɣ la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibila, ka zuri piiri liɣiri maa.
en: But Judas did not really care about the poor. He said this because he was a thief. He was the one who kept the moneybag for the group of followers. And he often stole money from the bag.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n yɛligu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n soli mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Now children, listen to me: Happy are those who keep to my ways!.

dag: Sulemaana daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zahim nɛma maa m-baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm; dama di daa zooya pam. Bɛ daa bi baŋ daanya maa tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: There were so many bronze things that Solomon never bothered to weigh them, and no one ever knew how much bronze was used.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni ti kum ka fabili. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun pirig o zaɣim ka ʒi tiŋa.
en: There will be crying and sadness in the meeting places by the city gates. Jerusalem will sit there empty, like a woman who has lost everything to thieves and robbers and now just sits on the ground and cries.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum li maa zaŋ li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni ka bɔhira, Bɔtaa nira n-lee ti yɛn nyɛ bia ŋɔ? Dama sokam daa baŋya ni ti Duuma zaɣa be o ni.
en: Everyone who heard of it thought about it and asked, What is this child going to be? For it was plain that the Lord's power was upon him.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli palo maa yuli, Ʒim Palo hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Thats why that field is called Field of Blood to this very day.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo ŋmanila kulibɔŋ kuma mini sagban shɛŋa sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒiɛri chana, ka Naawuni mali biɛhigu shee bumbɔn ni zali gu ba.
en: These false teachers are springs without water, mists driven by the wind. The underworld has been reserved for them.

dag: Shɛli ka ti ni din ni chɛ ka ti yɛli ni ti nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum tuma ŋɔ. Din chɛ ka ti tooi tumdi li yila Naawuni sanna.
en: I dont mean that we are able to do anything good ourselves. It is God who makes us able to do all that we do.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛli ma, ka n yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa. Amaa nyin ŋuna, n ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi n-niŋ zuliya titali.
en: So now let me destroy them in anger. Then I will make a great nation from you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, a nini yi shiri tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma a soya din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a, ka a nini maan tiɣi ma pahi. Lan teema ni niriba maa nyɛla a niriba.
en: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhu Naawuni, ka daa kpalim be nimaani yuŋ zaa suhiri Naawuni.
en: A few days later, Jesus went out to a mountain to pray. He stayed there all night praying to God.

dag: Zaŋm li lo n-niŋ a suhu ni sahakam, ka zaŋ li lo a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: always keep it in mind and never forget it.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa diɛhi duɣubihi mini kikahi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn kpalim la sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa lab kuli ka chɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa. Ka Midiannim daa zaŋ bɛ tantinim kpa n-do bɛ ni daa be zo shɛli zuɣu maa vinvamli ni.
en: Then Gideon gave these orders, You men stay here. The rest of you may go home, but leave your food and trumpets with us. Gideon's army camp was on top of a hill overlooking the Midianite camp in the valley.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Yisa yi Galili na la daa doli Yisifu chaŋ ti nya siliga maa ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa shɛm;.
en: The women who had followed Jesus from Galilee went with Joseph and saw the tomb and how Jesus' body was placed in it.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti yɛligi, ka chɛ ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ tintarisi yɛligi pahi, ka ti ti a jilima di zuɣu.
en: Youve enlarged the nation, LORD. Youve enlarged the nation; you are glorified. Youve expanded all the lands boundaries.

dag: Lala ka n yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Zaŋm a nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni, ka jɛm o min o niriba ka be.
en: I delivered the same message to Judahs King Zedekiah: If you want to live, put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him and his people.

dag: N yura nyɛla n ni su so, ka n gba nyɛ o ni su so. O zaŋd o biŋkɔbbaligu chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni.
en: I belong to my lover and he belongs to me— the one grazing among the lilies.

dag: dindina di simdi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, ka o ti po pɔri wuhi ni o nuu bi tim o kpee maa azichi maa ni, ka di simdi ni biŋkɔbigu maa lan saɣi pɔri maa, ka samli yɔbu lan kani.
en: the person should swear a solemn pledge before the LORD in the presence of the owner that he didnt touch the others property. The owner must accept that, and no payment needs to be made.

dag: Ka na shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Hadadɛza sulinsi ni nya Izraɛlnim ni tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Izraɛlnim maa ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti ba. Di saha zaŋ chana ka Sirianim maa daa zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ lan sɔŋ Ammɔnnim yaha.
en: When all the kings who served Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and became their subjects. Never again would the Arameans come to the aid of the Ammonites.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi bɛ zɔnima laara nyabu zuɣu, bɛ bihi ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: You know what people say: A man neglects his own children to help his friends. But my friends have turned against me.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba mi daa gari chaŋ tiŋ puuni ni bɛ ti da bindirigu na. Ka Samaria paɣ so daa kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom; ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋm kom ti ma ka n nyu.
en: A Samaritan woman came to draw some water, and Jesus said to her, Give me a drink of water. .

dag: Amaa nyama, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn tibi Izraɛlnima, Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri yirila palo, ka Samarianim ninvuɣ biɛtali yi zahira; dama bɛ ŋmari ʒiri, ka tayiɣisi kabiri yiya n-kpɛri ti zura, ka ninvuɣ fariba mi be samban ni fara.
en: I will heal Israel! Then people will know that Ephraim sinned. They will know about Samarias lies. They will know about the thieves who come and go in that town.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba na ti ʒili, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ku lan tooi yihi ba n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa ni yaha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will plant my people on their land, and never again will they be pulled up out of the land that I gave them. This is what the Lord your God said.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni nir doli ŋun be nam fukumsi ni yɛligu, ka di pa ni o yi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ni kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa o suhu ni tɛha gba dɔnibu zuɣu.
en: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N tum alahichi; dama m birigi Yawɛ zaligu, ka lan zaɣis a noli. N daa zɔrila niriba maa dabiɛm ka saɣi bɛ noli.
en: Then Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned. I did not obey the Lord s commands, and I did not do what you told me. I was afraid of the people, and I did what they said.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n neesim mini n tiliginsim; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra? Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɛvili birini; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra?.
en: Lord , you are my Light and my Savior, so why should I be afraid of anyone? The Lord is where my life is safe, so I will be afraid of no one!.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ laɣim taba.
en: The Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, so they regrouped.

dag: Amaa sokam ni ti ʒila o wain tia bee o fiig tia gbini, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yaag o noli yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone will live in peace among their own vineyards and fig trees, and no one will make them afraid. The Lord Almighty has promised this.

dag: Dauda ni daa chani Aruna sani ka Aruna nya o, o daa yila kabɔɣili maa ni chaŋ ti damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: As soon as Araunah saw King David approaching, he left the threshing place and bowed low, with his face touching the ground.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yiɣisi Obɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Abarim yɔɣu din daa miri Mɔabnim tintariga zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: Then they left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim in the desert east of Moab.

dag: Mani m-mi o, amaa yinim kul ʒi o. Ka n yi yɛli ni n ʒi o, n ni leei ʒirilana kaman yinim la. M mi o, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: You have never known him, but I know him. If I were to say that I do not know him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know him, and I obey his word.

dag: Yawɛ, wumma, zom ma nambɔɣu! Yawɛ, leemi ŋun sɔŋdi ma!.
en: Have pity, Lord ! Help.

dag: Ka viri mini kahiŋkɔri zaŋ li leei bɛ biɛhigu shee. Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka di lan leei tiŋgban kpiŋ yaha, kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Owls and ravens will take over the land. The Lord will make it a barren waste again, as it was before the creation.

dag: amaa lee niŋmiya lala la biɛribaalimtali mini sizuura lubu puuni. Kul chɛliya ka yi suhuri ni tɛha ku mali galimi, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi ya ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri yi biɛrisuntali yi ni doli Masia la zuɣu di vi.
en: Yet do this with respectful humility, maintaining a good conscience. Act in this way so that those who malign your good lifestyle in Christ may be ashamed when they slander you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni kpuɣi yi mini n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim ŋɔ zuɣusaa n sani n-zaŋ labi katiŋa.
en: I will lift you up and cast you out of my presence, together with the city that I gave to your ancestors.

dag: Ka yi nimaani hal ti gari Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni zaŋ lab Jɛbusi nudirigu polo, Jɛrusalɛm m-bala n-lan kpuɣi nimaani hal ti du zo shɛli din do Hinnom Vinvamli wulinluhili polo la zaŋ lab Rɛfaim Vinvamli tariga nuzaa polo.
en: The border went up by the valley of Ben-Hinnom to the slope of the Jebusite city, Jerusalem, on the south. The border went up to the top of the mountain that is opposite the Hinnom Valley on the west, which is at the north end of the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gɔhi din gabi taba, ka ŋmani danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣi; buɣim ni di ba kaman mokuma la.
en: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.

dag: Ŋunkam be nyam niŋm li mihi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam daba ata dali ni daba ayopɔin dali. O niŋm lala yihi ba daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin dali, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ paɣi bɛ binyɛra ka su kom, zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ka bɛ leei bɛn be nyam.
en: Then that clean person must sprinkle this water on you on the third day and again on the seventh day. On the seventh day you will become clean. You must wash your clothes in water and you will become clean in the evening.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal; ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, who was the father of Micah.

dag: Miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmani bahi ka nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la, ka miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpaŋsiri niŋgbuŋ ŋmaabu yɛla la.
en: Watch out for those who do evil things, those dogs, those who insist on cutting the body.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋna nti nya zoondɔɣirili.
en: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.

dag: Bɛ yooi mɔɣili dunɔdaya, ka nayili dam.
en: The gates of the rivers are opened; the palace melts.

dag: Ka Naawuni malaika ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim maa tooni la daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo, ka sagban daantaliga la gba daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: Then the angel of God moved to the back of the people. So the tall cloud moved from in front of the people and went to the back of the people.

dag: Doo yi yɛn zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o kpee, ŋun di deeg o nɛli bee o nɛkaŋ sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o li, dama o yi niŋ lala, nyɛvili ka o deei sɔŋ talima pabu ni maa.
en: When you lend someone something, you must not take as security any part of the stones used to grind flour. That would be the same as taking away their food.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Zanim a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini, ka n yi kpaŋ ha; di pa shɛli ka Yawɛ ka n sanna. Ka o yi wuhi ma shɛlikam, n ni zaŋ li yɛl a. Ka o daa chaŋ ti du n-tam kuŋkun nɛli zuɣu.
en: Then Balaam said, Wait here beside your offerings, and I'll go somewhere to be alone. Maybe the Lord will appear to me. If he does, I will tell you everything he says. And he left.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet. .

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, N wuhirila niriba palɔni, ka kul wuhiri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛŋa Yɛhudianim ni laɣindi la. N na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni.
en: Jesus answered, I have always spoken publicly to everyone; all my teaching was done in the synagogues and in the Temple, where all the people come together. I have never said anything in secret.

dag: Pool ni daa kul yɛn yaag o noli saha shɛli ka Gallio dii yɛli ba, Yinim Yɛhudianim ŋɔ, di yi di nyɛla tuun gala bee tuumbiɛ shɛli ka o tum ka yi tah o ŋɔ na, n naan wum yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma bari ma la tɔŋ, ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti ma biɛrim la mi yu ni m bahi yoli; bɛ na ʒi n-chɛ ma yikombiɛlim tuma tumbu dabisili kam puuni.
en: Those who want to kill me lay traps for me, and those who want to hurt me threaten to ruin me; they never stop plotting against me.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni daa zaŋ doo maa du alizanda ni. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: And I know that this man was taken up to paradise. I dont know if he was in his body or away from his body, but he heard things that he is not able to explain. He heard things that no one is allowed to tell.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa nanima ayi maa ni ti laɣim ʒini n-di, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu tɛha din be bɛ suhuri ni zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim taba. Ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛm mi ti ku niŋ, dama di saha na bi paai.
en: Then the two kings will sit down to eat at the same table, but their motives will be evil, and they will lie to each other. They will not get what they want, because the time for it has not yet come.

dag: N daa kul fomi baalim ka bi yɛli shɛli, hal n daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ din viɛli gba polo! Amaa ka n wahala daa lee kul pahira;.
en: I kept quiet, not saying a word, not even about anything good! But my suffering only grew worse.

dag: O biɛhi ŋmanila alabasita daantalisi din tam salima binzahi zuɣu. O biɛhigu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn sida ti gahinda.
en: His legs are like marble pillars on bases of fine gold. He stands tall like the finest cedar tree in Lebanon!.

dag: Mahili bidibisi ni Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga la n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel.

dag: Bɛ ni kɔhiri nin shɛli zaa nakɔhi duu, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya.
en: You are free to eat anything sold in the meat market, without asking any questions because of your conscience.

dag: Di saha maa Ahazia daa yila o yiŋ jirambisa zuɣusaa duu luɣili ni dunɔdura zuɣu lu tiŋa o ya Samaria m-biɛri doya, ka daa tim tuumba ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la sani nti bɔh o nya n ni nya alaafee dɔro ŋɔ ni, bee.
en: Ahaziah fell out the window of his second-story room in Samaria and was hurt. He sent messengers, telling them, Go to Ekrons god Baal-zebub, and ask if I will recover from this injury.

dag: Amalɛknima m-be Nɛgɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Hitinim mini Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim be zoya ni tinsi ni; ka Keenannim mi ʒi m-baɣi teeku mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili.
en: The Amalekites live in the land of the arid southern plain; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the mountains; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.

dag: N dabisa gariya, n ni daa lo nia shɛŋa ka di nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛŋa la saɣimya.
en: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.

dag: Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛli, N nyala alimɔnd tiwulli.
en: The Lord s message came to me: Jeremiah, what do you see? I answered, I see a stick made from almond wood.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn shihi ba, ŋun zaŋmila kur bini mini kpan dɔɣu n-niŋ lala, ka buɣim di ba zaa nimaani.
en: but with a sharp spear and are burned on the spot.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ gba, niriba biɛla ka Naawuni piig o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: So also in the present time there is a remaining group by the choice of Gods grace.

dag: Ka o yi ti yoog omaŋmaŋ piɛri maa zaa, o bela bɛ tooni ka piɛri maa dol o, bɛ ni mi o kukoli zuɣu.
en: He brings all of his sheep out. Then he goes ahead of them and leads them. The sheep follow him, because they know his voice.

dag: dama hal bɛn guni gba maŋmaŋ bi doli fukumsi zaligu, amaa din chɛ ka bɛ bɔri ni yi guni nyɛla ni bɛ tooi nyu bara yi niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: They are circumcised, but they dont obey the law themselves. They want you to be circumcised so that they can boast about what they did to you.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa mali.
en: For seven months, the house of Israel will bury them in order to cleanse the land.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa nyɛla Salɛm Naa mini Naawuni Zallakudura Naa maligumaana. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa chaŋ ti tuhi nanim tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ka labirina la, Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋɔ n-daa tuh o soli niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Melchizedek was the king of Salem and a priest for God the Most High. He met Abraham when Abraham was coming back after defeating the kings. That day Melchizedek blessed him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa bi lan saɣi yiri palo gɔri Yɛhudianim maa ni, amaa ka daa yi nimaani chaŋla luɣ shɛli din miri yɔɣu ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Ifriim la, ka o min o nyaandoliba ti be nimaani.
en: So Jesus stopped traveling around openly among the Jews. He went away to a town called Ephraim in an area near the desert. He stayed there with his followers.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm lala, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zali zaligu Susa tiŋ puuni. Ka bɛ daa shiri zaŋ Haman bidibisi maa ti yili gar dari.
en: King Xerxes did what Esther had requested, and the bodies of Haman's sons were hung in Susa.

dag: Wuntizɔra laara nyɛla din tahir o nyɛvili shee, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyɔri nyɛ din kpɛhir o alahichi ni.
en: The reward for doing good is life, but sin leads only to more sin.

dag: Dabisa kanna, ka bɛ ni ti duhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli ŋɔ ka di du n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboya. Ka niriba ti daai ka di gbinna.
en: In the last days the mountain of the Lord s Temple will be on the highest of all mountains. It will be raised higher than the hills. There will be a steady stream of people going there.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n nyɛ Masia tumo ŋun ʒe o zaani, ka bɛ lo ma zoligɔnim di zuɣu ŋɔ. Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma ka n tooi mali suhukpeeni n-kul tɔɣisiri lahibal suŋ maa yɛla kaman di ni simdi ni n tɔɣisiri li shɛm.
en: I have the work of speaking for that Good News, and that is what I am doing now, here in prison. Pray that when I tell people the Good News, I will speak without fear as I should.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ku tooi zaŋ mmaŋ zali Naawuni zaani.
en: But Joseph told them, Don't be afraid! I have no right to change what God has decided.

dag: N daa zaɣis a la saha biɛla puuni, amaa n nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam puuni, n ni lan zaŋ a labisi n sanna.
en: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ niriba biɛla tiligi takɔbi maa mini fifali ni ni alɔbo ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛli bɛ ni yɛn chaŋ zuliya shɛb sani maa, bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa, di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: But I will let a few of the people live. They will not die from the disease, hunger, and war. I will let them live so that they can tell other people about the terrible things they did against me. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Saa miri niŋdi Yawɛ tihi pam, o ni biri Lɛbanɔn sida ti shɛŋa la.
en: The great cedar trees of Lebanon belong to the Lord . He planted them and gives them the water they need.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni zibigi ka saŋmarisi gba ni zaɣisi peebu.
en: The sun and the moon grow dark, and the stars no longer shine.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la ka di yi alizanda ni na yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni n-su tiliginsim mini yiko, ka simdi tibigibu!.
en: After this I heard what sounded like a huge crowd in heaven. They said, Hallelujah! The salvation and glory and power of our God!.

dag: Dama bɛ zina niŋbu maa daa bi muɣisi ba. Bɛ daa saɣim tiŋgbani maa, ka niŋ zina kuɣili kam mini tia kam gbini.
en: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi nam ʒiishee maa gbin na yɛra, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba, ka nyɛ Naawuni daba bɛn zɔr o ŋɔ paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: From the throne a voice said, If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.

dag: Ka Zakaria daa nya malaika maa ka di gar o, ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pam.
en: When Zechariah saw the angel, he was startled and overcome with fear.

dag: N ni wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun shɛba ni bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi, ka bɛn gba bi mi ba, ka chɛ ka tɔb lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n ti kpihim bɛ birili.
en: I will scatter them among nations about whom neither they nor their ancestors have ever heard. I will pursue them with the sword until all are gone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Isaka zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Issachar, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: N kul tɛhirila di yɛla sahakam ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: with these instructions: Go to the village there ahead of you. As soon as you get there, you will find a colt tied up that has never been ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

dag: Bindir maŋli nyɛla ninkura bɛn zaŋ bɛ tɛha bɔhim baŋ zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu ni nyɛ shɛm dini.
en: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum piɛguliba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa alahiziba.
en: Everyone was surprised when they heard what the shepherds told them.

dag: Tizɔra kam gbibila omaŋ binshɛɣukam puuni. Bɛ niŋdi lala maa ni bɛ ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din saɣinda, amaa tinim niŋdi lala ni ti ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din bi saɣinda.
en: All who compete in the games use strict training. They do this so that they can win a prize—one that doesnt last. But our prize is one that will last forever.

dag: Amaa yi zuɣu ka n daa ku Amɔrinima daa wɔɣawɔɣa kaman sida tihi, ka mali yaa kaman oki tihi la. N daa ku bɛ mini bɛ bihi zaa.
en: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was as tall as cedar trees, and whose strength was as strong as oak trees. I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m bɔɣusapiŋ kɔbili kparigi ka m bɔɣu kabi.
en: may my arm fall from my shoulder, my forearm be broken at the elbow.

dag: Ti leela ti ʒiʒiinitab ni maani shɛb ansarisi, ka leei bɛn gili ti ni maani shɛb ansarisi ka lari ti.
en: The surrounding nations insult us; they laugh at us and mock us.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ma jɛmbu ka tuɣindila tulaale zim maani bɛ buɣa la zuɣu, bɛ chɛ ka bɛ nuhi tuma zaa ku ma suli ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi yaŋɔ nim zuɣu ka ku maai.
en: My anger burns against this place, never to be quenched, because theyve deserted me and have burned incense to other gods, angering me by everything they have done.

dag: Niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ kaman a yurilim maŋli la ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.

dag: Ka yi bihi ŋɔ mi ni leei piɛguliba mɔɣu ŋɔ ni yuun pihinahi. Bɛ ni di wahala yi ni bi ʒe yim la zuɣu hal ka yi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ti kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Your children will wander in the wilderness for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last one of you dies.

dag: Dama n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa biɛrim nyabu chɛ ka n gba nyala biɛrim. N fabiliya ka di niŋ ma yoli.
en: Because my people are crushed, I am crushed; darkness and despair overwhelm me.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mi Leeban Nahɔr bia la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti mi o.
en: Then he said to them, Do you know Laban, Nahors grandson? They said, We know him.

dag: N ni zaŋ zuliya biɛri na ka bɛ ti deei bɛ yiya su. N ni chɛ ka bɛn mali yaa karimbaani naai, ka bɛ ta bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri.
en: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n yuli m-bala. M bi zaŋdi n jilima tiri so. M mi bi zaŋdi m paɣibu tiri binnana.
en: I alone am the Lord your God. No other god may share my glory; I will not let idols share my praise.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man gba zo Ninive din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ nambɔɣu gari lala? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni kalinli gari tuhi kɔbiga ni pisi, ka nyɛ bɛn ʒi bɛ tooni ni bɛ nyaaŋa m-pahi biŋkɔbiri pam zuɣu.
en: In that city of Nineveh there are more than , people who cannot tell right from wrong, and many cattle are also there. Don't you think I should be concerned about that big city?.

dag: Ka din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa ka gbib li kirikiri bɛ suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di dɔɣira n-niŋdi biɛlim pam bɛ suɣilo dibu puuni la.
en: Those seeds that fell on good ground are the people who listen to the message and keep it in good and honest hearts. They last and produce a harvest.

dag: Dama n wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛra, Dabiɛm kul bela luɣilikam. Zaɣisimiy o, chɛliya ka ti zaɣis o. N zɔsimnim kul guhirimi ni n tuui lu, ka yɛra, Di pa shɛli ti ni kpɛh o kɔre n-nyaŋ o, ka bɔh o biɛri.
en: I hear everybody whispering, Terror is everywhere! So let's report him to the authorities! Even my close friends wait for my downfall. Perhaps he can be tricked, they say; then we can catch him and get revenge.

dag: A daa yina ni a ti tilig a niriba, ka daa yina ni a ti tilig a ninvuɣ gahindili. Nyini n-ŋme wurim ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili, ka wurim di mɔpilli hal ti tabili di tanzaa.
en: You go out to save your people. For the salvation of your anointed you smashed the head of the house of wickedness, laying bare the foundation up to the neck. Selah.

dag: Salo ni daa ti laɣimna m-muɣi saha shɛli ka Yisa piligi yɛra, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihirili, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: The crowd grew larger and larger. Jesus said, The people who live today are evil. They ask for a miracle as a sign from God. But no miracle will be done to prove anything to them. The only sign will be the miracle that happened to Jonah.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa duh o yee yɛli yi salo maa zaa zoli maa gbini buɣim mini sagbani ni zibisim titali sunsuuni la; ka o daa bi lan pahi yɛtɔɣ shɛli. O daa sab li pala kuɣ parilana ayi zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti ma.
en: Those are the words the LORD spoke to your entire assembly with a loud voice while on the mountain, from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick smoke. He added no more. God wrote them on two stone tablets, then gave them to me.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa na kul wuhiri niriba maa saha shɛli maa ka maligumaaniba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛma ni Sadusiinim dii vana ti zani bɛ tooni.
en: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple guard, and the Sadducees confronted them.

dag: Putɔɣunim muɣisigu lan ka nimaani; ka di ni wum shɛb la nya vuhim.
en: There the wicked rage no more; there the weak rest.

dag: Dinzuɣu n zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. O nyɛla Yawɛ ni yɛn su so hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o daa chɛ o ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: So now I give this boy back to the LORD. As long as he lives, he is given to the LORD. Then they worshipped there before the LORD.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋmanila mɔri din zoori wuntaŋ nyeebu ni, ka bɛ nyaɣa teei ʒiɛvari puu ni.
en: Evil people sprout like weeds in the sun, like weeds that spread all through the garden.

dag: M bia, di tam n ni wuh a shɛli, amaa gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli maa a suhu ni.
en: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.

dag: N yi yi mɔɣ kpaŋa, n nyarila bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛb sɔŋ. Ka n yi kpe tiŋ puuni, n nyarila kum ni gbarigi shɛb sɔŋ. Ka anabinim mini maligumaaniba kul tumdi bɛ tuma tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni, ka bi mi ni binshɛli niŋda.
en: When I go out in the fields, I see the bodies of men killed in war; when I go into the towns, I see people starving to death. Prophets and priests carry on their work, but they don't know what they are doing.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Pɛriʒia mini Miidia paɣiba yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm maa, bɛ ni zaŋ di yɛla yɛri naa kpambaliba. Ka paɣiba ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima, ka bɛ yidaannim maa suhuri ni yiɣisi pam bahi paɣiba maa zuɣu.
en: Before this day is over, the wives of the officials of Persia and Media will find out what Queen Vashti has done, and they will refuse to obey their husbands. They won't respect their husbands, and their husbands will be angry with them.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa niŋ wɔɣirili, dama o daa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa soli.
en: Jotham became powerful because he faithfully obeyed the Lord his God.

dag: Muɣisigu yi ti paai ba ka bɛ kuhira, Naawuni ni sɔŋ ba?.
en: without listening when they beg for mercy.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tooi mali bɛ wuna? Binyara lala pala Naawuni.
en: worthless idols made by human hands.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Onan.
en: she named the next one Onan.

dag: Yi yi di daa pun doli n zaligunima, yi naan nya alibarika, ka di be kaman kɔzɔrim din bi ŋmaara. Ka yi nasara dibu mi be kaman teeku kɔgbana la.
en: If you had obeyed me, then peace would have come to you like a full flowing river. Good things would have come to you again and again, like the waves of the sea.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tir o ba min o ma jilima, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who dishonors his father or mother. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti kuhi bahi Jɔab ha bɔh o, Ti kul yɛn zaŋla takɔbiri ŋɔ n-kuri tab hal ni saha din ka bahigu? A bi mi ni di bahigu ti yɛn nyɛla dimdi din ku naai? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn yɛl a niriba maa ka bɛ chɛ bɛ mabihi ŋɔ kari doli.
en: Abner shouted to Joab and said, Must we fight and kill each other forever? Surely you know that this will only end in sadness. Tell the people to stop chasing their own brothers.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ti pin kɔŋkɔb shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zaŋ li tum tuma ŋun Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ ti ni la zuɣu: Naawuni ni ti ti pin shɛli yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, chɛliya ka ti tɔɣisi li kaman ti yɛda ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: We have different gifts that are consistent with Gods grace that has been given to us. If your gift is prophecy, you should prophesy in proportion to your faith.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du ni bɛ ti tuhi Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka nandahima daa mal Izraɛlnim pam.
en: The Ammonites even crossed the Jordan to fight the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim. Israel was in great distress.

dag: Ka Balak daa kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri duɣi tahi ti ti Balaam mini kpamba bɛn daa be o sani.
en: where Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and gave some of the meat to Balaam and the officials who were with him.

dag: Zoya sɔhirila o tooni, ka daboya nyɛligira ka tiŋgbani mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋuhir o tooni.
en: Mountains quake in the presence of the Lord ; hills melt before him. The earth shakes when the Lord appears; the world and all its people tremble.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ wumpaɣibo mali sara ti ma la ti ma la jilima, ka bɛnkam mi doli soli din tuhi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya tiliginsim man Naawuni sani.
en: The one who offers a sacrifice of thanksgiving is the one who honors me. And it is to the one who charts the correct path that I will show divine salvation.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛli ba, N nyaya ka yi ba bi lan bɔri n yɛla kaman o ni daa yi bɔri n yɛla shɛm la. Amaa m ba Naawuni la kul be n sani.
en: He said to them, I have noticed that your father is not as friendly with me as he used to be. But the God of my father has been with me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zuliya bɔbili laɣimla taba ni bɛ lir a ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ta o daɣiri, chɛliya ka ti mooi ti nini bahi Ziɔn zuɣu.
en: Now many nations may gather against you; they say, Let her be defiled, or Let our eyes look with desire at Zion.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela sarika ni, ka wum Yisa Masia tuma yɛla, ka daa tim o nyaandoliba.
en: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni tam n yɛla, ka zaŋ ma niŋ a baɣaka zuɣu, dim a pagɔrisigu min a kɔre tuma maa nyɔri.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: Because you forgot me and turned your back on me, you alone will bear the consequences of your betrayal and promiscuities.

dag: Ka Mɛlatia ŋun daa yi Gibiɔn na la mini Jadɔn ŋun daa yi Mɛrɔnɔt na la ni Gibiɔnnim ni Mizipanim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo gomna sulinsi ni la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: The men from Gibeon and Mizpah fixed the next section of the wall. Melatiah from Gibeon and Jadon from Meronoth did the work. Gibeon and Meronoth are places that are controlled by the governors of the area west of the Euphrates River.

dag: Di ni ti lu n-doya ka noonsi ti tamdi di mundili maa zuɣu, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ti be di wulikpana maa ni.
en: Birds will then nest on the stump of the fallen tree, and wild animals will trample its branches.

dag: ka yɛra, Na so ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Suhudoo be alizanda ni! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: They said, Welcome! God bless the king who comes in the name of the Lord. Psalm : Peace in heaven and glory to God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani gindi tiŋkpansi n-yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋdi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: The disciples left and traveled through all the villages, preaching the Good News and healing people everywhere.

dag: Ka a yi yaag a noli yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla a Duuma, ka niŋ yɛda a suhu ni ni Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni, a ni tiligi.
en: If you confess that Jesus is Lord and believe that God raised him from death, you will be saved.

dag: Amaa wula ka n kɔŋko lee ni tooi maani yi yɛlimuɣisira ŋɔ, ka maani yi zabili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: But how can I handle all your troubles, burdens, and disputes by myself?.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Stiivin, ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa nya Naawuni jilima, ka nya ka Yisa ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be o sani daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu. Ka niriba pam daa yi Lɛbɔhamat mini Ijipti kulibɔŋ polo kana.
en: So there at the Temple, King Solomon and all the people of Israel celebrated the festival. People came from as far away as Hamath Pass in the north and the border of Egypt in the south. This huge crowd of people enjoyed themselves for seven days.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa ba min o ma daa dɔɣ o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi chir muna ata ka bi zo dabiɛm ni bɛ zaɣisi naa zaligu, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka bia maa nyɛla bi viɛlli.
en: By faith Moses was hidden by his parents for three months when he was born, because they saw that the child was beautiful and they werent afraid of the kings orders.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tiligi bɛn vu m-miri Naawuni o zuɣu la sahakam, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul be ni o timdi sandaani tiri ba Naawuni sani.
en: So Christ can save those who come to God through him. Christ can do this forever, because he always lives and is ready to help people when they come before God.

dag: Kum zana n-daa kul gili ma; ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee dabiɛm gbaai ma; ka wahala mini suhusaɣiŋgu gbaai ma pam.
en: The danger of death was all around me; the horrors of the grave closed in on me; I was filled with fear and anxiety.

dag: ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ karit alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira.
en: He also wanted them to have the power to force demons out of people.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana, ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka bɛ yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: When John came, he fasted and drank no wine, and everyone said, He has a demon in him.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o yiko din be kasi la tum tuma. O ni tilig o niriba, ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa nya.
en: The Lord will use his holy power; he will save his people, and all the world will see it.

dag: Sulemaana daa me omaŋmaŋ yili. Yuun pinaata ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: King Solomon also built a palace for himself. It took years to build Solomons palace.

dag: Dina ka ti mali paɣiri ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la, ka lan mal li turi ninsalinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni nam shɛba ŋ-ŋmahind omaŋ la.
en: We use our tongues to praise our Lord and Father, but then we curse people who were created in Gods likeness.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, ka mali baŋsim shɛli din yiri Zallakudura Naa sanna. O nyɛla ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii. O luya, amaa ka bi pɔb o nina.
en: My knowledge comes from God Most High, the Lord All-Powerful. I bowed down to him and saw a vision of Israel.

dag: Shɛhira diba ata m-be alizanda ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini bɛ ni booni so Yɛligu la ni Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka bɛba ata ŋɔ nyɛla yino. Ka shɛhira diba ata be dunia ŋɔ ni:.
en: So there are three witnesses that tell us about Jesus:.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɛ alahichi daba saha shɛl la, wuntia daa bi su yi fukumsi.
en: When you were the slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ bom naɣisa ʒee ŋun ka dalinli ni galimi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni na bi zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua n-niŋ so na.
en: to give the Israelites the following regulations. Bring to Moses and Aaron a red cow which has no defects and which has never been worked.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ka bɛ daa daŋ tiŋgbani tibu kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa dola Juda mini Yisifu zuliya niriba tiŋgbana sunsuuni.
en: The tribe of Benjamin was given the land that was between the areas of Judah and Joseph. Each family in the tribe of Benjamin got its land. This is the land that was chosen for Benjamin:.

dag: Di saha maa, naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu sokam zaa daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: In those days there was no king in Israel; each person did what they thought to be right.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig anu saha ka o daa lan chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb lan ʒiya ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ʒi kpe yoli biɛɣu zaa.
en: About five oclock the man went to the marketplace again. He saw some other people standing there. He asked them, Why did you stand here all day doing nothing.

dag: N niriba maa kul kpɛrila yɔɣu ka chɛri ma, dinzuɣu ka n zali ba ni bɛ ʒi ʒi tibisa maa, ka so ku tooi yihi li.
en: My people are bent on turning away from me; and though they cry out to the Most High, he will not raise them up.

dag: Wulinluhili polo din ti yɛn nyɛ mita tusaayi ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la gba ni ti malila dunɔdaya ata. Gaad zuliya dunɔdali mini Asha zuliya dunɔdali ni Naftali zuliya dunɔdali.
en: There are three gates on the west side along its . miles: one gate for Gad, one gate for Asher, and one gate for Naphtali.

dag: A buhi bihim ni saɣ a min a yiŋnim bindirigu, ka dih a daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba.
en: The rest of the goats will provide milk for you and your family, and for your servant women as well.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga, N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam hal ka so ti ku tooi kali ba.
en: The LORDs messenger also said to her, I will give you many children, so many they cant be counted.

dag: Ka yi mi yi ti nya ka pɔhim ʒiɛri yiri nudirigu polo na, yi yɛrimi ni woligu ni niŋ, ka di ti shiri niŋ.
en: When the south wind blows, you say, It's going to get hot, and it does.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi.
en: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman; when he died, he left no children.

dag: Yinim Filipainim mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni lahibal suŋ molo molibu piligu ni saha, n ni daa yiɣisi Masidɔnia la, yi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ cheechi shɛli niriba bɛn pahi n zuɣu baŋ deebu mini tibu yɛla.
en: You Philippians know very well that when I left Macedonia in the early days of preaching the Good News, you were the only church to help me; you were the only ones who shared my profits and losses.

dag: Ka bɛ tintariga daa zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Tabo mini Shahazuma ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-zaŋ ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: The border also touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh, ending at the Jordan. It included sixteen cities along with the towns around them.

dag: Yawɛ gari zuliya kam zaa, ka o jilima yaɣi sagbana zuɣu.
en: The LORD is high over all the nations; Gods glory is higher than the skies!.

dag: Ŋunkam ka dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tɛhijihilana ni zoma, ka lan nyɛla ŋun tam ni o daalahichi pun kpihim.
en: But if you do not have them, you are so shortsighted that you cannot see and have forgotten that you have been purified from your past sins.

dag: Zaŋmi gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinii ni anii, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make a table out of acacia wood, inches long, inches wide, and inches high.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lɔrigiri buŋ maa ka bɛn su o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o.
en: They untied it, but its owners came out. They said to the followers, Why are you untying our donkey.

dag: dama di naan nyɛla buɣim din ni di hal ni gballi puuni ka di naan di m puu atam zaa.
en: It would be like a destructive, hellish fire, consuming everything I have.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba ŋmanila teeku ni zahim, ka ŋmani biŋgbamda bɛn ka naa.
en: How can you treat people like fish or like a swarm of insects that have no ruler to direct them?.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti lan labina nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N daa timna ti yɛl a ni a zaŋ a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣiba ni a bihi ti ma na.
en: Later, Benhadad sent another messenger to say to Ahab, I already told you to give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your children.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla wuntia sariakarita; ka wuhir o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo dabisili kam.
en: God is a righteous judge and always condemns the wicked.

dag: ka o ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na, ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi gbala polo na tuhir o soli.
en: When he was getting out of the boat, a man with an evil spirit quickly ran to him.

dag: O min o niriba bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. O ni ti zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi takɔbiri lu Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku niriba yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He and his ruthless army will come to devastate the land. They will attack Egypt with swords, and the land will be full of corpses.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu maa sɔŋ baɣil omaŋ hal ka Yisifu dan maa ti kuna.
en: She kept his garment with her until Josephs master came home.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi, di chɛ ka n di vi dahin shɛlikam.
en: Lord , I depend on you for protection. Dont let me be disappointed.

dag: N ni zaŋ piɛbihi pola mali sara n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim ti a, ka zaŋ piɛlahi sara nyɔhi ti a, ka zaŋ naɣilahi mini buhi mali sara.
en: I will offer sheep to be burned on the altar; I will sacrifice bulls and goats, and the smoke will go up to the sky.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti nya a, bɛ ni yɛli, O paɣa m-bala, ka ku ma ka chɛ a.
en: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, This is his wife, and they will kill me but let you live.

dag: Zuliya kam ni niriba, kamiyana ti wum! Daadamnima, Wummiya! Dunia mini bɛnkam be di ni zaŋ tabili binshɛɣukam zaa, kamiyana ti wum!.
en: Draw near, you nations, to hear; and listen, you peoples. Hear, earth and all who fill it, world and all its offspring.

dag: Yɛndan yi tahi jɛra ʒiishee, vuri yɔbu mini ansarisi ku mali tariga.
en: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.

dag: ka nya ka gɔhi n-kul zooi lim li; ka yihim lan zibigi di ni, ka di kuɣa gooni lu n-doya.
en: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi taba, O ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla maa gbinni lee nyɛla wula? Ti bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: They also asked, What does he mean by a short time? We dont understand what he is saying.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa di bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa di bi nyara.
en: Those statues have mouths, but cannot talk. They have eyes, but cannot see.

dag: Dama o ni lo ni o niŋ ma shɛli maa, o ni niŋ li naai; ka lala binyara pam kul be o suhu ni.
en: He carries out what is decreed for me and can do many similar things with me.

dag: Bɛ maanila niriba ansarisi ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri; bɛ nyɛla karimbaannim bɛn lɔri niriba nahiŋgu nia biɛri.
en: They make fun of others and say cruel things about them. In their pride they make plans to hurt people.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi ya ŋɔ leei dabiɛm shee mini ansarisi malibo shee, ka ŋunkam ti gari kpe, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka o mal li ansarisi zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa zuɣu.
en: I will completely destroy this city. People will whistle and shake their heads when they pass by Jerusalem. They will be shocked when they see how the city was destroyed.

dag: Miri ka a di zunyuŋnim bindira bee n-chɛ ka a kɔre kpe di ni di nyaɣisim zuɣu;.
en: Dont eat food with stingy people; dont long for their delicacies.

dag: amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa, din pala man tibu, amaa Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: But I do not have the right to choose who will sit at my right and my left. It is God who will give these places to those for whom he has prepared them.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o Izraɛl nanim Silisi la ni. Ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz lay down with his ancestors and was buried in the city, in Jerusalem, but not in the royal cemetery of Israels kings. His son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni Judanim ni ti tiligi, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mi ti be ni alaafee. Ka bɛ ni ti yɛn booni li yu shɛli n-nyɛ: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia.
en: In those days, Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. And this is what he will be called: The LORD Is Our Righteousness.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zanimiya baalim ka m mini ya laɣim suhi Yawɛ o ni tum tiliginsim tuun shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim zaa la zuɣu.
en: So now stand here, and I will judge you in the LORDs presence because of all the LORDs righteous acts that he has done for you and your ancestors.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma leei di molomoona mini tumo ni karimba ŋun ni wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yɛda niŋbu mini yɛlimaŋli soli yɛla. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri maa; m bi ŋmarila ʒiri!.
en: and that is why I was sent as an apostle and teacher of the Gentiles, to proclaim the message of faith and truth. I am not lying; I am telling the truth!.

dag: Naawuni, n suhu kul ʒiɛla yim. N ni yili yila ni kukoli viɛlli. N shia, neema!.
en: I have complete confidence, O God! I will sing and praise you! Wake up, my soul!.

dag: Ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun kpuɣ a nɛma, nyin di lan bɔh o di yɛla.
en: Give to everyone who asks and don't ask people to return what they have taken from you.

dag: Nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali ni di ti tum tuma o kalinsi nyaaŋa, di bi tumdi tuma naɣila o ti shiri kpimi;.
en: In the case of a will it is necessary to prove that the person who made it has died.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yuri ti m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni daa nyɛ alahichinim saha shɛl la ka Masia daa kpi ti zuɣu.
en: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.

dag: Ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: The commander of the kings special guards took Seraiah the high priest and Zephaniah the next highest priest as prisoners. The three doorkeepers were also taken as prisoners.

dag: Sulemaana daa diri n-sula na shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli zaŋ hal ti paai Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ti kpa Ijiptinim tiŋgbɔŋ tariga; ka bɛ daa yɔri farigu o sani ka jɛmd o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Solomon ruled every kingdom between the Euphrates River and the land of the Philistines down to Egypt. These kingdoms paid him taxes as long as he lived.

dag: Musa ni daa ti Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili la naai dahin shɛli, o daa boola kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mali di mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa ka di be kasi, ka lan booi kpam bahi sara maligu bimbini mini di nɛma zaa zuɣu m-mali di gba ka di be kasi.
en: Moses finished setting up the Holy Tent. On that day he dedicated it to God. Moses anointed the Tent and everything in it. He also anointed the altar and all the things used with it.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛl Anabi Hagai ni o bɔhim o niriba maa ŋ-ŋɔ:.
en: Then the LORDs word came through Haggai the prophet.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ pala ŋun ka yiko din ni tooi tiligi ya bee ŋun nyɛ tikpiralana, ka ku tooi wum yi suhigu.
en: Look! The LORD does not lack the power to save, nor are his ears too dull to hear.

dag: Bɛ ni kpɛhi shɛb duu yɛla daa niŋ ya nambɔɣu, ka bɛ ni daa fa yi nɛma zaa la, yi daa niŋ suɣilo dee li ni suhupiɛlli, yi ni mi ni yi mali binshɛŋa din so ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu.
en: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn fiɣisiri ma maa nya filiŋ, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ vi ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: Humiliate my enemies! Let them wear their shame like a coat.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb yi niŋdi din wuhiri ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni ka di nyɛla daliri suŋ zuɣu, din nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli sahakam, din dee yi pala n yi ti be yi sani kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: It is good for you to work hard, of course, if it is for something good. Thats something you should do whether I am there or not.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di ni kɔbiri bi piɛla, ka di mi bi kpe puuni, amaa ka sabigi, maligumaana maa ŋun kparim o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the priest examines it, and there is no white hair in the shiny spot, it is not lower than the skin, and it is faded, the priest will quarantine the person seven days.

dag: Ŋuna n-damdi dunia ŋɔ di zaashee, ka di daantalisi sɔhira.
en: He can shake the earth, and it will tremble down to its foundations.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi gba daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of David's bodyguards; and David's sons were priests.

dag: Ka Kishɔn Mɔɣili kokpɛɣu daa ʒi ba chaŋ. Kishɔn kom din zɔri n-daa ʒi ba chaŋ. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi ni kpiɔŋ!.
en: and his soldiers were swept away by the ancient Kishon River. I will march on and be brave.

dag: Miriya ka yi birigi mɔɣu bee n-doli pala, dama yi dimnim maa gbibila takɔbiri ka dabiɛm be luɣilikam.
en: Dont go out into the field! Dont walk on the road! The enemies sword terrorizes at every turn.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa garigi yɛli paɣ maa, N yi bɔh a bɔhigu nyin di sɔɣi ma shɛli. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dan naa, bɔhim ma.
en: The king answered the woman, I must ask you something—dont hide anything from me! The woman said, Please, my master and king, speak.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ; amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: Whoever says a word against the Son of Man can be forgiven; but whoever says evil things against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni nti zaŋ ma gari dundɔŋ lɔrisi anahi la ni, ka dundɔŋ maa ni lɔriga kam ti mali dundɔŋ.
en: Then he took me to the outer courtyard, and he had me pass through its four corners, and I saw that there were additional courtyards in each of the corners.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ bɔ n-lee tuhi ya soli n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: Ahaziah said to the messengers, What did the man look like who met you and told you this.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali ninkur shɛb bɛn daa pun ʒiini o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba maa la wula.
en: King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon when he was alive. What do you advise? Rehoboam asked. How should I respond to these people.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ ŋun Keenan Naa Jabin maa muɣisigu hal ti ku o.
en: So the Israelites became stronger and stronger until they defeated King Jabin of Canaan. The Israelites finally destroyed him.

dag: ka o ti kɔrig o sara maligu bimbini la nuzaa polo Yawɛ tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa ti zaŋ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: You must slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aarons sons the priests will toss its blood against every side of the altar.

dag: Ka ŋun paya la gba daa niŋ lala nya nyɔri ka di min o gba laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: It was the same with the servant who had two bags. That servant invested the money and earned two more.

dag: Ka kum yi ti lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee alɔbo yi ti lu bee bindira yi ti kuura bee maligu bee toli yi ti yina bee zunzuya, ka bee bɛ dimnim yi ti kana nti teei gili ba bɛ tinsi ŋɔ ni zaɣ yin ni, ka alɔbo kam bee dɔr shɛlikam yi ti lu.
en: When there is famine in the land or an epidemic or the crops are destroyed by scorching winds or swarms of locusts, or when your people are attacked by their enemies, or when there is disease or sickness among them.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ku tooi niŋ lala ka pa ni piɛri maa zaa laɣimmina pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli, ka ti ŋɔŋ kom maa ti ba.
en: They said to him, We cant until all the herds are gathered, and then we roll the stone away from the wells opening and water the flock.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Family of Israel, listen to the Lord !.

dag: Yinim pukpariba mini wain tihi kpariba, maliya nandahima. Kummiya alikama mini chi zuɣu. Dama puri atam saɣimiya.
en: Be shocked, you farmers; howl, you vinedressers, over the wheat and the barley, for the crops of the field are destroyed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ʒiɛmdila bɛn nya yɛl biɛri, amaa ka di lee mali shili gu bɛn naba bi ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You have no troubles, and yet you make fun of me; you hit someone who is about to fall.

dag: Ka yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala.
en: Do for others what you want them to do for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, niŋmi alibarika niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuliya ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ kul be a sani sahakam. Dama nyini Yawɛ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ binshɛli ni, alibarika maa kul ni kpalim be di ni sahakam.
en: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.

dag: Lɛbanɔn, yoom a dunoya ka buɣim tooi di a sida tihi luhi.
en: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.

dag: Yawɛ daalikaulinim nyɛla alali; di nyɛla alali kaman anzinfa maŋli shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she tiŋgban ni buɣim ni m-mal li buyopɔin ka di yi zaa la.
en: The Lord s words are true and pure, like silver purified by fire, like silver melted seven times to make it perfectly pure.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bindir nyaɣisili maa min o ni mali bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti o bia Yaakubu.
en: She handed him the tasty food, along with the bread she had baked.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisiyinika ni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛma ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan ka o nyɛ Babilɔn naa kpambal la daa kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: On the tenth day of the fifth month of the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia, Nebuzaradan, adviser to the king and commander of his army, entered Jerusalem.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, and in this way perform the ritual of purification for the people.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya do so ŋun yɛli ma binshɛɣukam zaa n ni pun niŋ. Pa ŋuna n-ni nyɛ Masia la.
en: Come and see the man who told me everything I have ever done. Could he be the Messiah.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛna, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ka ti na ʒi n-zaɣis o. Aduna bidibisi n-nyɛ ti maligumaaniba bɛn maani sara tiri Yawɛ ka Lɛvinim nyɛ bɛn sɔŋdi ba.
en: But us? The LORD is our God, and we havent abandoned him. Aarons descendants serve as the LORDs priests, assisted in the work by the Levites.

dag: Nini ku tooi yɛli nuu, A ka ma buchi; ka zuɣu mi ku tooi yɛli napɔŋ, A ka ma buchi.
en: The eye cannot say to the hand, I dont need you! And the head cannot say to the foot, I dont need you.

dag: Ti zaa nyɛla alahichinima, ka ti wuntia tuma zaa ŋmanila binchɛr biɛri. Ti daalahichi zuɣu chɛ ka ti ŋmanila vari din kuui n-suui lu ka pɔhim ʒe li bahi.
en: All of us have been sinful; even our best actions are filthy through and through. Because of our sins we are like leaves that wither and are blown away by the wind.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di yi pala wunsuhigu mini nolɔbo zuɣu so ku tooi kari alizini ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Jesus answered, Only prayer can force out this kind of demon.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna maa yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: During Passover the governor always freed a prisoner chosen by the people.

dag: Naawuni Kundi bi yɛli ni Masia yɛn yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi Bɛtilihɛm din nyɛ Naa Dauda ya na la.
en: The scripture says that the Messiah will be a descendant of King David and will be born in Bethlehem, the town where David lived.

dag: Ka o daa ti tim ti yɛli Dauda, N tuhi nyaŋ Rabanim maa hal ka fa bɛ tin shɛli din mali kom la gba.
en: He sent messengers to David to report: I have attacked Rabbah and have captured its water supply.

dag: Dama ŋun yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina la n-nyɛ ŋun lan yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsal la. Ka a yi bi niŋ zina, amaa ka lee ku ninsala, dindina a leei Naawuni zaligusaɣinda m-bala.
en: God said, Dont commit adultery. The same God also said, Dont kill. So if you dont commit adultery, but you kill someone, you are guilty of breaking all of Gods law.

dag: O daa lan me bindira mini wain palli ni kpama zaashee duri, ka daa lan me o niɣi balibu kam duri ni o biŋkɔbbaligu buzɔna.
en: Hezekiah had storage buildings for the grain, new wine, and oil that people sent to him. He had stalls for all the cattle and stalls for the sheep.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm wahala mini o yɔɣu dabu dabisa la puuni, ka o teei o ni daa mali bin viɛl shɛŋa kurimbuni ha la yɛla. Saha shɛli o dimnim ni daa nyaŋ o niriba ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ba la, ka o dimnim maa daa yuun o ni lu maa, ka maani o ansarisi.
en: While suffering and homeless, Jerusalem remembers all her treasures from days long past. When her people fell by the enemys hand, there was no one to help her. Enemies saw her, laughed at her defeat.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yoya yɔhim ya, dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhu kul yiɣisiri bahiri bɛn bi deer o noli zuɣu.
en: Do not let anyone deceive you with foolish words; it is because of these very things that God's anger will come upon those who do not obey him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, Zaligu ŋɔ ka a ba daa zali ti pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: So they sent this message to Joseph: Before our father died.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o nubil tim alahichi sanyoo maligu ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ti vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: The priest will take some of the blood from the sin offering on his finger and put it on the corners of the altar of burnt offering. He will pour out the rest of the lambs blood at the base of the altar.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa yihi ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ puuni binyara n-lan bahi kom maa ni.
en: On the third day, they picked up the ships gear and hurled it into the sea.

dag: Amaa n Duuma, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ŋun niŋdi nirilim, a bi jɛri suli yom, ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali mi galisi pam.
en: But you, my Lord, are a God of compassion and mercy; you are very patient and full of faithful love.

dag: Amaa yi yi mali nyuli zabbu din yiri putɔɣu ni na mini diribarilim tɛha yi suhuri ni, yin miriya ka yi nyuri bara, ka leei bɛn chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: However, if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, then stop bragging and living in ways that deny the truth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ biŋkɔbiri gbana n-she n-ti Adam min o paɣ maa ka bɛ so.
en: The Lord God used animal skins and made some clothes for the man and his wife. Then he put the clothes on them.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa ti niŋ ŋun kani Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Tɛra daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: Terah lived to be years old and died in Haran.

dag: Ka maligumaana Pashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Imɛr bia, ka nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu kpɛm la daa wum Jɛrimia anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ binyara ŋɔ polo.
en: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said.

dag: A ku lan ti ti kpiɔŋ, ka a niriba ŋɔ lan nya suhupiɛlli a sani yaha?.
en: Please, give us new life! Make your people happy to be yours.
