dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o lab kuli o ya Rama. Ŋuna n-daa lan maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani gba. O daa lan me sara maligu bimbini nimaani ti Yawɛ.
en: But Samuel always went back to his home in Ramah. There he built an altar to the Lord and judged Israel.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-chɛ ka ti doli Masia o nasara dibu dari dibu chandi ni m-be kaman o ni ŋme tɔbu gbahi dab shɛba, ka chɛ ka ti moli Masia yɛla ka di be kaman tulaale nyom la gili luɣilikam.
en: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in victory through Christ. God uses us to spread his knowledge everywhere like a sweet-smelling perfume.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: An argument arose among the disciples about which of them was the greatest.

dag: Ka a ti she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti a mabia Aduna din ni nyɛ o jilima min o nachiinsi binyɛra.
en: Make priestly garments for your brother Aaron, to provide him with dignity and beauty.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima n-fa nam maa ti ŋun Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: Rehoboam went back to Jerusalem and gathered together an army of , men from the families of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin. Rehoboam wanted to go fight against the Israelites and take back his kingdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sihɔn min o niriba zaa ni daa yina ti liri ti n-tuhi ti Jahaz.
en: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz.

dag: Duuma yino mini ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la ni baptaizibu yini m-beni.
en: There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism;.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ba kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni chana, o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ kpi kɔnyuri. O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na ka bɛ nyu.
en: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyini ŋun yuri nyaɣisim pam ni nyini ŋun tɛhi ni shɛli ku niŋ a la, wumma! A tɛhiya ni a galisimi m-be kaman Naawuni la, ka so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A bi tɛhi ni a ni leei pakoli bee n-kɔŋ bihi.
en: Listen to this, you lover of pleasure, you that think you are safe and secure. You claim you are as great as God— that there is no one else like you. You thought that you would never be a widow or suffer the loss of your children.

dag: Ka niriba daa be samban ni ka wum chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama vuri, ka di be kaman Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o kukoli be shɛm la.
en: The noise made by the creatures' wings was heard even in the outer courtyard. It sounded like the voice of Almighty God.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim tam ŋun nam ba yɛla, ka mɛla nanim yiya. Ka Judanim me fɔntinsi pam, ka me goondahi gil li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka buɣim lu bɛ fɔntinsi maa zuɣu n-di bɛ sɔɣisili shɛhi zaa.
en: The people of Israel have built palaces, but they have forgotten their own Maker. The people of Judah have built fortified cities. But I will send fire that will burn down their palaces and their cities.

dag: di saha ka a chɛ ka zahima varisiri ma, ka chɛ ka ʒiinim nyabu kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm;.
en: But you—you terrify me with dreams; you send me visions and nightmares.

dag: Dabisili din pah anii dali Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the eighth day Manassehs Chief Gamaliel, Pedahzurs son.

dag: Ka maligumaani maa ti booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ o nuzaa nutal ni;.
en: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand.

dag: Firawuna ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Naawuni daa bi zaŋ ba doli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ polo, nimaani polo ni daa nyɛ so jia maa zaa yoli, dama Naawuni daa yɛlimi, Tɔbu yi ŋme niriba maa, bɛ tɛha ni taɣi ka bɛ zo n-labi Ijipti.
en: After the king had finally let the people go, the Lord did not lead them through Philistine territory, though that was the shortest way. God had said, If they are attacked, they may decide to return to Egypt.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnima m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord gave Moses the following laws for his people:.

dag: O nuhi tuma nyɛla din ʒe yim ka tuhi. O zaligunim zaa mali naani niŋbu.
en: Gods handiwork is honesty and justice; all Gods rules are trustworthy.

dag: Dama niriba maa ni daa laɣim maa, Jabɛshigiliad ninvuɣ so daa ka nimaani.
en: at the roll call of the army no one from Jabesh had responded.

dag: Miriya ka yi be kaman yi yaannim mini yi mabihi bɛn daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ yim, ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya naŋgbantom yi zaa ninni la.
en: Dont be like your ancestors and relatives, who were unfaithful to the LORD, the God of their ancestors, so that he made them an object of horror as you can see for yourselves.

dag: ka n daa ti nya ʒii ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Zom yom yi Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ ku deeg a shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ m polo.
en: in which I saw the Lord, as he said to me, Hurry and leave Jerusalem quickly, because the people here will not accept your witness about me.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a ni lihiri ti ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa kpi? Zaŋm bindirigu taɣi ti mini ti puri maa, ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa leei Firawuna daba; ka ti ti bimbira din ni chɛ ka ti gali ka ku kpi, ka ti puri maa gba ku kpalim doya yoli.
en: Don't let us die. Do something! Don't let our fields be deserted. Buy us and our land in exchange for food. We will be the king's slaves, and he will own our land. Give us grain to keep us alive and seed so that we can plant our fields.

dag: Daba ata maa dali, ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ ka tiligi, dama n zɔri Naawuni.
en: On the third day, Joseph said to them, Do this and you will live, for Im a God-fearing man.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zahima maa n-chɛ ka n niriba tam n yɛla saha shɛli bɛ ni tɔɣisiri tab di yɛla maa, kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa tam n yɛla ka jɛmdi Baal shɛm la.
en: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.

dag: M min a n-simdi lala, dama tinim tuma nyɔri ka ti diri ŋɔ; amaa ŋun bi tum taal shɛli.
en: Ours, however, is only right, because we are getting what we deserve for what we did; but he has done no wrong.

dag: O bi nyari n ni doli so shɛŋa, ka kaani n napɔna yaabu zaa?.
en: God knows everything I do; he sees every step I take.

dag: Di saha ka Naa daa tim boli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm kpamba zaa na.
en: King Josiah called together the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tɔbu daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba n-tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: The next time there was a war with the Philistines, David fought hard and forced them to retreat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la gari wain ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: There they tried to give him wine mixed with a drug called myrrh, but Jesus would not drink it.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka duh o nam maa ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: And so David realized that the Lord had established him as king of Israel and was making his kingdom prosperous for the sake of his people.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni liri ba kaman gbuɣinli ni liriti binyara shɛm la, n ni dɔni sol naŋgban kpaŋ gu ba kaman jɛŋgbini ni doya gu binyara shɛm la.
en: So I will attack you like a lion. Like a leopard I will lie in wait along your path.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa naan ku lan tooi zani Musa tooni yaha bintɔra maa zuɣu, dama bintɔra maa daa tola timanim maa mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: The magicians could not stop Moses from doing this, because even the magicians had the sores. This happened everywhere in Egypt.

dag: N ni yɛn niŋ kpe ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kpe ŋɔ shɛm m-bala. N ni niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ka di be kaman Tɔfɛt la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That is what I will do to this place and its residents, declares the LORD: I will make this city like Topheth.

dag: dama di ŋmanila buɣim sala ka a zaŋ pa bɛ zuɣuri ni maa. Ka Yawɛ ni ti a di laara.
en: You will make them burn with shame, and the Lord will reward you.

dag: Ka saɣiŋgu kul be di puuni, ka nahiŋgu mini ŋarili kul be di ni.
en: There is destruction everywhere; the streets are full of oppression and fraud.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ ŋuni maa yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka a bia nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ! Ka paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni maa yɛli, Aai! A bia n-nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, ka m bia nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ! Lala ka bɛ daa yɛri naa maa tooni.
en: But the other woman said, No! The living child is mine, and the dead one is yours! The first woman answered back, No! The dead child is yours, and the living one is mine! And so they argued before the king.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan bɔhi, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: Think about what I have said!.

dag: Dauda ni daa kurigi ka o dabisa ti pali, o daa zaŋla o bia Sulemaana leei Izraɛlnim naa.
en: When David had grown old after a long life, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

dag: Ka naa maa baŋdiba daa kana ti zani, amaa ka so daa ka bɛ ni ŋun ni tooi karim sabbu maa bee n-wuhi di gbinni.
en: The royal advisers came forward, but none of them could read the writing or tell the king what it meant.

dag: Mani n-su Giliad; mani n lan su Manaasa; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurigu zuɣupiligu din taɣiri n zuɣu, ka Juda mi nyɛ n nam kurigu jaaŋgbee.
en: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.

dag: A nuu ni bo n-nya a dimnim zaa. A nudirigu ni bo n-nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je a.
en: With your mighty arm, Lord , you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.

dag: N ni ti ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri bɛn be kulisi ni, ka ninsalinim naba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha, ka niɣi takarifiɛma gba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha.
en: I will remove all its livestock from beside the plentiful waters so that neither human foot nor livestocks hoof will trouble it again.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa ŋme n-wurim daanya daantalisi mini tɔrokɔnim daanya ni daanya kɔniŋdi bin titali din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, ka kpuɣi daanya maa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonian soldiers broke into pieces all the bronze things in the Lord s Temple. They broke the bronze columns, the bronze carts, and the large bronze tank that were in the Lord s Temple. Then they took all of that bronze to Babylon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti nyo buɣim mali sara maa daa nyɛla naɣilahi pisopɔin mini piɛlahi kɔbiga ni piɛbihi kɔbisiyi. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛb nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Seventy bulls, rams, and lambs were brought as sacrifices to please the Lord ;.

dag: ka yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu nabi, ka yi daazinfa mini yi salima nabi, ka yi binshɛɣukam nabi.
en: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.

dag: N Duuma, n yiŋ bia bɔɣu min o gbali zaa n-kpi, ka di muɣis o pam ka o do yiŋa.
en: Sir, my servant is sick in bed at home, unable to move and suffering terribly.

dag: O ni daa ti paana, o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba, m puhir a! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Just then he came to Jesus and said, Hello, Rabbi. Then he kissed him.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaannim dunoya ni dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ ni daa kali zuliya shɛb la zuɣulaannim daa mali sara.
en: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlli ŋɔ puuni, so miri ka o tum o kpee din bi tuhi bee ŋ-ŋar o kpee. Ti daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka na kul kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ni ti Duuma ni darigi bɛn tumdi din bi tuhi ŋɔ tatabo tibili.
en: Never wrong any of your fellow believers or cheat them in this way. The Lord will punish those who do that. We have already told you this and warned you about it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣim kaman yalim zim la yuɣisi sokam zuɣu, ka ti niŋ yalim yuɣisi sara kam gba zuɣu.
en: Everyone will be purified by fire as a sacrifice is purified by salt.

dag: N Duuma, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda dabisi muni zaa.
en: You are my God, so be merciful to me; I pray to you all day long.

dag: Naawuni, a chandi mali jiri pam ka niriba nyari li. N Naawuni ni n Naa maa chanimi ni o ti kpe o jɛmbu duu.
en: They saw your procession, God— the procession of my God, my king, into the sanctuary.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa ni ti jɛm o min o bia ni o yaaŋa hal ka omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ lubu saha ti paai, ka zuliya pam mini na kara ti zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: All nations will serve him, and they will serve his son and his grandson until the time comes for his own nation to fall. Then his nation will serve powerful nations and great kings.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N nya ka Sintani yi zuɣusaa luna kaman saa n-nyaɣisi la.
en: Jesus answered them, I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

dag: yɛra, Sabimi a ni yɛn nya shɛli maa niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ tim ti ti cheechinima ayopɔin la. Di tinsi n-nyɛ: Ɛfɛsus mini Smɛɛna ni Pɛɛgamum ni Taiatira ni Saadis ni Filadɛlfia ni Laodisia.
en: It said, Write down on a scroll whatever you see, and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa pihi bɛ napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka yi ni chaŋ Aikɔnium.
en: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from their feet and went to Iconium.

dag: Kaman m Ba Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni tim ma na ka m be m Ba maa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ gba ni be n zuɣu.
en: The Father sent me. He lives, and I live because of him. So everyone who eats me will live because of me.

dag: ka di nyɛla n daa zɔrila zama dabiɛm zuɣu bee n-zɔri ni niriba ti lihi ʒiɛm ma zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n fo n noli ka bi yi samban ni na.
en: I have never feared what people would say; I have never kept quiet or stayed indoors because I feared their scorn.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa niŋ pua, ka tim na ti yɛli Dauda ni o malila pua.
en: Later, Bathsheba became pregnant. She sent word to him saying, I am pregnant.

dag: dilan ŋun baŋmi ni ŋunkam ŋmaligi alahichilana o biriginsim sol ni n-labisi zali yɛlimaŋli sol ni ni tiligi alahichilan maa kum ni, ka chɛ ka alahichi pam nya chɛ m-paŋ.
en: remember this: whoever turns a sinner back from the wrong way will save that sinner's soul from death and bring about the forgiveness of many sins.

dag: ka mali tahima ni mmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti neei kum ni.
en: in the hope that I myself will be raised from death to life.

dag: Yi yurinim zaa tam yi yɛla, bɛ baɣa lan ka yi ni; dama n ŋmɛn ya mi kaman n nyɛla yi dim la; n darigila yi tibili kaman dim so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu, dama yi taali galisiya pam, ka yi daalahichi mi galisi yaɣi.
en: All your lovers have forgotten you; they no longer care about you. I have attacked you like an enemy; your punishment has been harsh because your sins are many and your wickedness is great.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Naawuni tooni nimaani n-duhi bɛ yee kum pam ka fabili yɛli.
en: After the war with Benjamin, the Israelites went to the place of worship at Bethel and sat there until sunset. They cried loudly and bitterly.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa lihirila a ninni ni a ti ba bɛ bindirigu di tibu saha.
en: All of these depend on you to provide them with food.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: People were bringing children to Jesus so that he would bless them. But the disciples scolded them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni labi n-neei Naa Dauda yili din daa lu la. N ni lan me o dabɔɣu maa zali.
en: After this I will return, and I will rebuild Davids fallen tent; I will rebuild what has been torn down. I will restore it .

dag: Di saha maa, n shiri ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ yi dab bidibisi mini yi dab bipuɣinsi ni.
en: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛn yɛli Zɛdɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah answered them: This is what you should tell Zedekiah.

dag: ni Kain ni Gibia ni Timna: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pia m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah: ten cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ gba mi Timoti ni pun kpaŋd omaŋ shɛm m min o ni laɣim kaman ba min o bia n-tumdi lahibal suŋ tuma la yɛla.
en: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.

dag: bɛ daa kulila Gɛdalia sani Mizipa. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni Tanhumɛt bia Sɛraya ni Ɛfaai ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la bidibisi ni Jɛzania ŋun daa nyɛ Maakati nir la ni bɛ tɔbbihi.
en: So they went out to meet Gedaliah at Mizpah: Ishmael, Nethaniahs son; Johanan and Jonathan, Kareahs sons; Seraiah son of Tanhumeth; the sons of Ephai the Netophathite; Jezaniah son of the Maacathite; and their troops.

dag: Ka dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so m-pɔri gɔŋ o yuun pisaayika ka o ku tooi teeg omaŋ zaa la daa be nimaani.
en: A woman was there who had an evil spirit inside her. It had made the woman crippled for years. Her back was always bent; she could not stand up straight.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim birigi n-tum alahichi pam gari Yawɛ ni daa ku zuliya shɛb ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani la ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa.
en: Manasseh encouraged the people of Judah and the people living in Jerusalem to do wrong. They were worse than the nations that were in the land before the Israelites—and the Lord destroyed those people.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn suhuri ni paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani. Bɛ suhuri shiri ni paligi ka bɛ wa waa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: But let good people be happy. Let them gather before God and enjoy themselves together.

dag: ka di ʒiɛmya anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: do not despise inspired messages.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai zuɣulan maa yiŋa n-nya ka yupiɛbiriba mini salo pam beni n-yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri.
en: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners.

dag: Bɛ yi ti naai bɛ shɛhira tuma maa, biŋkɔb so ŋun yi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni na ni ti tuhi ba tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ku ba.
en: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.

dag: N je tuumbiɛtumdiba; ka m mi bi ʒiini ninvuɣ biɛri sani.
en: I detest the company of evildoers, and I dont sit with wicked people.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi gbaag omaŋa ŋmanila bɛ ni kabi kpe gooni ni gili tin shɛli ni shɛm la.
en: People who cannot control themselves are like cities without walls to protect them.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa bela zuɣusaa. O ni yu shɛm ka o tumda.
en: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.

dag: Daadam, piimi dapaɣili sabi, Juda dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka a lan pii dapaɣili shɛli sabi Yisifu dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu.
en: You, human one, take a stick, and write on it, Belonging to Judah and to the Israelites associated with him. Take another stick and write on it, Stick of Ephraim belonging to Joseph and everyone of the house of Israel associated with him.

dag: dindina o mabia maa paɣa maa ŋun cham o sani kpamba maa ninni nti pirigi doo maa namdili o napɔŋ ni, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun je ni o me o mabia yili.
en: then the sister-in-law will approach him while the elders watch. She will pull the sandal off his foot and spit in his face. Then she will exclaim: Thats whats done to any man who wont build up his own brothers family.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, di chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛli yi ni nyaŋ alizin biɛri maa zuɣu; amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛlila yi yuya ni sab alizanda ni la zuɣu.
en: Nevertheless, dont rejoice because the spirits submit to you. Rejoice instead that your names are written in heaven.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi bɛ taba, ka maani ba ansarisi la ti ku lan beni. Bɛ ni ti ku tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: The tyrant will be no more, the mocker will perish, and all who plot evil will be eliminated.

dag: Yi niriba anu ni ti kar doli niriba kɔbiga, ka yi niriba kɔbiga ni ti kar doli niriba tuhi pia n-zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dimnim maa.
en: five of you will be able to defeat a hundred, and a hundred will be able to defeat ten thousand.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli, N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, amaa di chaŋya katiŋ ti yaɣi. Suhimiya Naawuni ti ma.
en: Then the king told him, I'll let you go into the desert to offer sacrifices, if you don't go very far. But in the meantime, pray for me.

dag: Mani n-su anzinfa mini salima zaa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All silver and gold belong to me.

dag: Yurilim bi chɛ ka nir tumd o ʒiʒiinikpee zaɣ biɛɣu, dinzuɣu yurilim nyɛla din paani Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal n ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya la, di daa pala ŋun tum taali la zuɣu bee o ni daa tum so taali la zuɣu, amaa di daa nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka yi baɣa ni be ti ni shɛm la yi palo Naawuni sani.
en: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naawuni yi ti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, yin ʒimiya n kɔba mali kuli; ka daa chɛ ka bɛ po di pɔri.
en: Joseph made Israels sons promise, When God takes care of you, you must bring up my bones out of here.

dag: Ka Aruna daa ti lihi nya Naa Dauda min o kpamba ni kani o sanna, ka o daa tuhi ba soli ti lu naa sizuura n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Araunah looked and saw King David and his officers coming to him. Araunah went out and bowed his face to the ground.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa yɛli Anabi Musa, N ni niŋ ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nirilim, ka zo ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nambɔɣu.
en: God said to Moses, I will show mercy to anyone I want to show mercy to. I will show pity to anyone I choose.

dag: Ʒiɛmiya anzinfa! Ʒiɛmiya salima! Azichi maa ka tariga, ka bin suma pam beni.
en: Plunder silver! Plunder gold! There is no end to the supplies, an abundance of precious objects!.

dag: Ka o daa zani, ka dunia dam. Ka o daa lihi, ka niriba ni sɔhira. Ka kurimbuni ha zoya la wurim, ka o kurimbuni ha daboya din nyɛ o so kurisi la firi.
en: When he stops, the earth shakes; at his glance the nations tremble. The eternal mountains are shattered; the everlasting hills sink down, the hills where he walked in ancient times.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la niŋ naa tɔɣino yɛli, Ami! Ka lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan naa Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: It shall be done, answered Benaiah, and may the Lord your God confirm it!.

dag: O yiɣis o suhu bahi n zuɣu, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: His anger burns against me. He treats me like an enemy.

dag: Ŋun Yawɛ n-daa lan kari Amɔrinim zaa bɛn daa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu tinim gba ni jɛmla Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: The Lord helped us defeat the people living in these lands. He helped us defeat the Amorites who lived in this land where we are now. So we will continue to serve the Lord , because he is our God.

dag: Bee wula ka a ni tooi yɛl a mabia ni o chɛ ka a yihi bimburigin shɛli din be o ninni ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni?.
en: How can you say, My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye, when you don't see the log in your own eye?.

dag: A chɛ ka a mini Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ a ʒiʒiinitaba, ka nyɛ kɔribiɛrinim la tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam, ni a chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: To make me angry, you even offered yourself to Egyptians, who were always ready to sleep with you.

dag: Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa, amaa ka lee nyɛ pagɔrili bia. Jɛfita ba n-daa nyɛ Giliad.
en: Jephthah was from the tribe of Gilead. He was a strong soldier. But Jephthah was the son of a prostitute. His father was a man named Gilead.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinim bɛn tɛhi ni tiliginsim be katiŋ ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Listen to me, you bullheaded people who are far from victory.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmɛlimmi yi kparima, ka kpam niŋ bɛ shɛhi ni.
en: They cover their face with grease and make their loins gross.

dag: Amaa n ni be, ka chɛ ka man Yawɛ jilima pali dunia ŋɔ zaa la zuɣu.
en: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yɛli Lɔt, Di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe m min a sunsuuni; a mi di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe a biŋkɔbiguliba mini m biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni, dama ti nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: Abram said to Lot, Lets not have disputes between me and you and between our herders since we are relatives.

dag: Miri ka a va n-zani naa tooni bee n-zani wɔɣira zaashee.
en: When you stand before the king, don't try to impress him and pretend to be important.

dag: Pool ni daa paana ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana la zani gil o m-mali yɛl biɛ shɛŋa pam bɛmaŋmaŋ ni ku tooi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli fiɣisir o.
en: As soon as Paul came in, the leaders from Jerusalem crowded around him and said he was guilty of many serious crimes. But they could not prove anything.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Ziɔn. O bɔri ni o zaŋ li leeg o biɛhigu shee. O daa yɛliya.
en: The Lord has chosen Zion; he wants to make it his home:.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa chaŋ Baala, di gbinni nyɛla Kiriatijiarim din daa be Juda tiŋgban ni la ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka shɛli zuɣu Naawuni yuli ni daa be, ka o nam ʒiishee tam chɛrubinim zuɣu la na.
en: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, gbilisimiya tibili wum n noli ni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.

dag: Shɛli kani din ni lan ti ma suhupiɛlli gari n yi ti wum ni m bihi doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi Musa sani kuli.
en: All the people of Israel left.

dag: Di yih a ʒiɛyimtali maa n daŋ ni. Ka Yawɛ yi ti kpihim nyin Dauda dimnim zaa birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: dont ever stop being loyal to my household. Once the LORD has eliminated all of Davids enemies from the earth.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim bɛn daa birigi chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa ka chɛ ma saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: But the Levites, who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, will bear their guilt.

dag: nyin chɛl a sara maa nimaani, ka chaŋ a kpee maa sani ka yi ti mali yi yɛlli maa pɔi ka a naanyi labi nti zaŋ a sara maa ti Naawuni.
en: leave your gift at the altar and go. First make things right with your brother or sister and then come back and offer your gift.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi o zuɣu biŋkpam bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so biŋkpam tum tuun shɛli, amaa miriya ka yi ŋub li.
en: You may use the fat from any animal that has died by itself or was torn by other animals, but you must never eat it.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi Naawuni nam maa ni kpɛbu tahima la nti bahi bumbɔn ni; nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa yoli, bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ʒiri mabihi maa daa bi labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa ka naɣ ŋmarila ʒiri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israels unfaithful sister did not come back to me with her whole heart. She only pretended that she came back to me. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Tuuli Adam nyɛla Naawuni ni daa nam so ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ, ka Adam ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa mi nyɛ Shi so ŋun tiri nyɛvili.
en: So it is also written, The first human, Adam, became a living person, and the last Adam became a spirit that gives life.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o garig o yɛm garigibu maa ka o yɛl o, A mini Naawuni nam bi wɔɣ ni taba. Di nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu shɛli yaha.
en: Jesus saw that the man answered him wisely. So he said to him, You are close to Gods kingdom. And after that time, no one was brave enough to ask Jesus any more questions.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: But now Im not the one doing it anymore. Instead, its sin that lives in me.

dag: Miriya ka yi lo tab zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. Yi mi miriya ka yi pɔri pɔri n-diri ʒiri shɛhira. N je dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Dont plan evil for each other. Dont adore swearing falsely, for all of these are things that I hate, says the LORD.

dag: Sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya daba ayi bee goli bee di daa yi kpalim ʒe Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa yuui, Izraɛlnim maa kul kpalindimi doya ka bi chana; amaa di daa yi ti vuui saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.
en: If the cloud stayed over the Holy Tent for two days, a month, or a year, the people stayed at that place. They did not leave until the cloud moved. When the cloud rose from its place and moved, they also moved.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa darigi toog o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu so o shee ni n-kum o bia maa kuli dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Jacob mourned for Joseph a long time, and to show his sorrow he tore his clothes and wore sackcloth.

dag: Bɛ ni kpɛhi shɛb duu yɛla daa niŋ ya nambɔɣu, ka bɛ ni daa fa yi nɛma zaa la, yi daa niŋ suɣilo dee li ni suhupiɛlli, yi ni mi ni yi mali binshɛŋa din so ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu.
en: You even showed sympathy toward people in prison and accepted the confiscation of your possessions with joy, since you knew that you had better and lasting possessions.

dag: Yi yi bi nya saɣisigu kaman o bihi zaa, dindina di wuhiri ni yi pala o bihi alali, amaa yi nyɛla kaman dagɔr bihi.
en: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli Masia wuhibu, amaa ka kpahi yaɣi di zuɣu chana, dilana maa ka Naawuni; ka ŋunkam mi doli Masia wuhibu nyɛla ŋun mali ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia.
en: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisili kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan boli kpe Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Niriba Kubu Vinvamli.
en: Now people call this place Topheth and the Valley of Hinnom. But I give you this warning. This message is from the Lord : The days are coming, when people will call this place the Valley of Slaughter.

dag: Ti ni nya piɛri mini niɣi n-ku n-ti ba ka di saɣi ba? Bee ti yi gbahi teeku zahim zaa ti ba, di ni saɣi ba.
en: If we were to kill all the sheep and cattle, that would still not be enough to feed this many people for a month. And if we caught all the fish in the sea, it would not be enough for them.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu gba. Bɛ ni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛli sɔɣi nyɛla din poora, ka din neerina mi nyɛ din bi poora.
en: This is how it will be when the dead are raised to life. When the body is buried, it is mortal; when raised, it will be immortal.

dag: Ɛdom naa ni daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari maa, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa taɣi doli shɛli polo gari.
en: Because the Edomites would not let the Israelites pass through their territory, the Israelites turned and went another way.

dag: Bɛ yi bɔri ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, bɛn bɔhimi bɛ yidaannim yiŋa, dama di nyɛla vi ni paɣ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa cheechi ni.
en: If they want to find out about something, they should ask their husbands at home. It is a disgraceful thing for a woman to speak in a church meeting.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti yiɣis o garo zuɣu wuntaŋ ŋmalli saha n-du n-tam nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa chana nti lihi nya paɣ so ni suri kom, paɣ maa daa viɛli pam.
en: One evening, David got up from his couch and was pacing back and forth on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing; the woman was very beautiful.

dag: dama di ŋmanila buɣim sala ka a zaŋ pa bɛ zuɣuri ni maa. Ka Yawɛ ni ti a di laara.
en: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.

dag: Shɛm daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Shɛm ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Aripakishad, yuma ayi din daa doli dunia ŋɔ kom dibu nyaaŋa la.
en: These are Shems descendants. When Shem was years old, he became the father of Arpachshad, two years after the flood.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka vi mali ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu! Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yɛndan shiri ka yi ni ŋun ni tooi kari yi mabihili puuni yɛla saria?.
en: Im saying this because you should be ashamed of yourselves! Isnt there one person among you who is wise enough to pass judgment between believers?.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuun shɛŋa din pahi fukumsi.
en: Heman and Asaphs brothers were from the tribe of Levi. The tribe of Levi was also called Levites. The Levites were chosen to do the work in the Holy Tent. The Holy Tent was Gods house.

dag: Ka yiɣisi nimaani yi zɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so gba ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa ŋun yi Nazarɛt na ŋɔ sani.
en: When he went over to the gate, another woman saw him and said to those who were there, This man was with Jesus, the man from Nazareth.

dag: So yi zaŋ o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli ti Yawɛ, dindina di daa yɛn dolila di ni yɛn tooi deei bimbira shɛm. Pal shɛli din ni biri siŋkaafa tah ayi daa ni nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: If a person dedicates part of the land from their family property to the LORD, the value will be set according to the seed needed to plant it: fifty silver shekels per homer of barley seed.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa yuya m-bala. Ka Musa daa taɣi Nan bia Hɔshia yuli Jɔshua.
en: These are the spies Moses sent to explore the land. He changed the name of Hoshea son of Nun to Joshua.

dag: Ka a ti lan yɛli ba yaha ni Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bee sara maligu.
en: Any Israelites or any foreigners living in the community who offer a burnt offering or any other sacrifice.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, dinzuɣu gbibiya n zaligunim mini n ni yɛli ya shɛm, ka tummiya tuun shɛli din ni chɛ ka daadam be.
en: Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord .

dag: O ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la, o daa pola pɔri pahi alikauli maa zuɣu ti Yisahaku.
en: God made an eternal promise.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o baŋ ni o bidib tuuli nyɛla o ni bi yur paɣ so la bidibiga maa, ka pirig o ni su shɛli maa ʒiibuyi zuɣu ti o, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ saha bia, ka bituuli tarili nyɛla o dini.
en: He is to give a double share of his possessions to his first son, even though he is not the son of his favorite wife. A man must acknowledge his first son and give him the share he is legally entitled to.

dag: Bɔ ka n niŋ ya ka di be di ko ni cheechi shɛŋa din kpalim la n-naɣ pahila n ni bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya la? Chɛliya dimbɔŋɔ taali paŋ ma!.
en: How were you treated worse than the other churches, except that I myself wasnt a financial burden on you? Forgive me for this wrong!.

dag: Kɔbulli yɛliya, Di ka n ni, ka teeku yɛli, Di ka n sani.
en: The Deep says, Its not with me; the Sea says, Not alongside me.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣibɔɣili din daa be Sukɔt mini Zarɛtan sunsuuni la ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa.
en: The king had it all made in the foundry between Sukkoth and Zarethan, in the Jordan Valley.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛla gbaai dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam dabiɛm, Hɛzɛkia bia Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa la ni daa tum shɛm Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu.
en: I will make the people of Judah an example of something terrible for all the people on earth. I will do this to the people of Judah because of what Manasseh did in Jerusalem. Manasseh was the son of King Hezekiah. Manasseh was a king of Judah.

dag: Piɛri ni ti a situra, ka a buhi mi yo a palo samli.
en: then the lambs will provide your clothes, and the goats will be the price of your fields.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! He is good to us, and his love never fails.

dag: O kɔr o biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ o wain gabi taba, ka mali bindira dibu shili zali.
en: She slaughtered her animals, mixed her wine, and set her table.

dag: Bɛtani do so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa ti biɛra. O min o tizɔpaɣiba Mariama mini Maata zaa ya n-daa bala.
en: A man by the name of Lazarus was sick in the village of Bethany. He had two sisters, Mary and Martha. This was the same Mary who later poured perfume on the Lord's head and wiped his feet with her hair.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Maika yiŋ maa, ka bɛ nya nachimbil ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir maa m-baŋ o o yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee tah a kpe na? Ka bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe? Bee tuun bɔ ka a lee tumdi kpe.
en: When they were in the area of Micahs house, they recognized the accent of the young Levite. They turned in there and said to him, Who brought you here? What are you doing in these parts? What is there for you here.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya, ka Na so ŋun mali jilima maa gari kpɛna.
en: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din na kpalim ka yi yɛn deei maa n-nyɛ: Filistianim tiŋgbani zaa mini Gɛshurinim tiŋgbani.
en: You have not yet taken the land of Geshur or the land of the Philistines.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ pini maa daŋ o tooni, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpalim gbe suɣa maa shee dindali maa yuŋ.
en: He sent the gifts on ahead of him and spent that night in camp.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yi naa maa sani, zaŋ chaŋ o ti yɛn paai zɔn titali sunsuuni ka Yawɛ yɛl o.
en: Isaiah hadnt even left the middle courtyard of the palace when the LORDs word came to him.

dag: O ku deei sandaani sanyoo kam, o mi ku deei birapu, di yi kul galisi kabo.
en: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: Then he shall offer the second bird as a burnt offering, according to the regulations. In this way the priest shall offer the sacrifice for your sin, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia maa ni daa tum tuun shɛli n-zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu m-bala.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada did many brave things like that. He was as famous as the Three Heroes.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: So you do away with Gods Law for the sake of the rules that have been handed down to you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti yi o nyaandoliba piniyini bɛn daa kpalim la zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒimi diri bindirigu. Ka o daa galim ba bɛ ni nyɛ suhutunanim mini bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la yɛligu yɛda.
en: Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, A ŋmanila zo shɛli din kuri niriba, ka ku dunia zaa. N yi n-zani a zuɣu. N ni teei n nuu n-wurim a nahi tiŋgbani ka buɣim di a zaa.
en: Babylonia, you are like a mountain that destroys the whole world, but I, the Lord , am your enemy. I will take hold of you, level you to the ground, and leave you in ashes.

dag: Ka o daa chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: Then Jesus told the Good News in the synagogues in Judea.

dag: N zaŋ n yɛligu niŋ a nol ni, ka zaŋ a niŋ n nuu mahim ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa, ka nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. N yɛli Ziɔnnima, Yi nyɛla n niriba.
en: My servant, I gave you the words I want you to say, and I covered you with my hands to protect you. I did this to make a new heaven and earth and so that you would say to Israel, You are my people.

dag: Ka Sool yɛli Dauda, A ku tooi chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, dama a na nyɛla bia, ka o mi nyɛ doo ŋun pun tuhiri tɔbu o bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Saul answered, You cant go out and fight against this Philistine. Youre not even a soldier! Goliath has been fighting in wars since he was a boy.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ daa karim Musa litaafi n-wuhi niriba maa, ka bɛ daa nya di ni luɣ shɛli din sabi yɛli ni di bi simdi ka bɛ chɛ ka Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali Naawuni niriba ni bɛ laɣiŋgu ni.
en: On that day, when the scroll from Moses was being read to the people, they found written in it that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter Gods assembly.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o mi o ka bi dol o zaligunima, o ŋmarila ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ka o ni.
en: If we say we know God but do not obey his commands, we are lying. The truth is not in us.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ya o daalikauli shɛli o ni zali ya ni yi doli, dina n-nyɛ o fukumsi zaligunim pia la. Ka o daa sabi li pa kuɣiparilana ayi zuɣu.
en: He told you what you must do to keep the covenant he made with you—you must obey the Ten Commandments, which he wrote on two stone tablets.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ma nyintaa bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ o ba dapala dɔni, dama o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa.
en: or half sister.

dag: Ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ o chandi.
en: At that, Paul left the council.

dag: ni tibikpara ni bansi ni sarisi.
en: and on their wrists. He will take away their veils.

dag: Amaa n ni ti woligi Izraɛlnim bɛn biŋkɔbiri ka chɛ Ijiptinim biŋkɔbiri, ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn so biŋkɔbigu ti ku kpi. .
en: But the Lord will protect the animals that belong to the people of Israel, and none of theirs will die.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Yi ni yino yɛliya, M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia, ka ŋun la mi yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ maa, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia. .
en: Then King Solomon said, Each of you claims that the living child is hers and that the dead child belongs to the other one.

dag: Ka aŋgo zo maa vooi ko shɛli din leei wain maa ka bi baŋ di ni yi shɛli na, amaa yili maa ni bihi bɛn daa tooi kom maa bɛn daa mi. Ka o daa boli aŋgo na.
en: which now had turned into wine, and he tasted it. He did not know where this wine had come from ; so he called the bridegroom.

dag: Nyama, timbil din ʒiɛya ŋɔ nyɛla din mirina ka nir ni zo nti kpe di ni. Chɛliya ka n zo nti kpe di ni tiligi. Yi nya di ni nyɛ timbil shɛm, ka m mi ni tooi zo nti kpe di ni tiligi.
en: Do you see that little town? It is near enough. Let me go over there—you can see it is just a small place—and I will be safe.

dag: Ka toli daa yi nyɔhi maa ni lu tiŋgban ni na, ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nɔnsi yiko tatabo ti ba.
en: Then locusts came forth from the smoke and onto the earth. They were given power like the power that scorpions have on the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara, ka zaŋ li da yaɣimɛr so palo ni bɛ mali saamba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: So they decided to use it to buy the potters field where strangers could be buried.

dag: Naawuni daa ti nachimbih anahi ŋɔ baŋsim mini yɛn bɔhimbu balibu kam puuni. Ka din pahi nyɛla o daa lan ti Daniɛl baŋsim shɛli din chɛ ka o tooi kahigiri ʒiinim mini zahima gbinni wuhira.
en: God gave these four young men the wisdom and ability to learn many different kinds of writing and science. Daniel could also understand all kinds of visions and dreams.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti puhi chuɣu ti ma. .
en: After Moses and Aaron talked to the people, they went to Pharaoh and said, The Lord , the God of Israel, says, Let my people go into the desert so that they can have a festival to honor me.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛn kpɛla tiŋ ŋɔ ni na nti ku Ijiptinima, ka o yi ti nya ʒim maa yili shɛli dunoli zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira ni, o ni yaɣi lala yili maa gari, ka ku chɛ ka kum maa kpe yi yinsi ti kun ya.
en: When the Lord goes through Egypt to kill the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the beams and the doorposts and will not let the Angel of Death enter your houses and kill you.

dag: Ka n yi ti lan ka yi sanna yaha, yi ni mali daliri din ni chɛ ka yi maan paɣi Yisa Masia n ni lab yi sanna maa zuɣu.
en: When I am there with you again, you will be bursting with pride over what Christ Jesus did to help me.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga dɔni, dama di nyɛla vi tuuni.
en: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti puhi chuɣu ti ma. .
en: Then Moses and Aaron went to the king of Egypt and said, The Lord , the God of Israel, says, Let my people go, so that they can hold a festival in the desert to honor me.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi din niŋ ti la yɛla; lihimi ti ni nya filiŋ shɛm.
en: Remember, O Lord , what has happened to us. Look at us, and see our disgrace.

dag: Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba; amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana yi baŋ o, dama yi pun nya o.
en: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn biri yuun shɛli din pahir anii ni, yi ni ti dirila bindir kura, ka yi ti kul ni dirila bindir kura maa hal ni yuun shɛli din pahir awɛi, ka bindir pala ti naanyi niŋ.
en: When you plant your fields in the eighth year, you will still be eating what you harvested during the sixth year, and you will have enough to eat until the crops you plant that year are harvested.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛli ma, Daadam, pumpɔŋɔ kpuɣim a zuɣu zuɣusaa lihi nuzaa polo. Di saha ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nuzaa polo n-nya ka nyuli zabbu binnani la ʒe sara maligu bimbini nuzaa polo dunoli ni.
en: God said to me, Ezekiel, son of man, look north. And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha kanna ka niriba ni ti yi tinsi pam ni kana.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, In the future, people from many cities will come to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa lan chaŋ Manaasa mini Ifriim ni Simiɔn zuliya tinsi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Naftali zuliya tinsi ni nti gili bɛ dabari la ni zaa.
en: He did the same things in the towns and ruined villages in the territories of West Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as the border of Naphtali.

dag: Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini Alikauli Adaka la mini di yɔrigu ni suɣili maa puuni nɛma zaa.
en: the meeting tent, the chest containing the covenant, the cover that is on top of it, all the tents furnishings.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔh o, N zuɣu ka a zabiri nyuli maa? N di bi zaɣisi ka Yawɛ niriba zaa nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ di zaŋ o shia niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Moses said to him, Are you jealous for my sake? If only all the LORDs people were prophets with the LORD placing his spirit on them.

dag: Naawuni ni tim so na maa tɔɣisirila Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, dama Naawuni zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti o ka di ka buɣisibu.
en: The one whom God has sent speaks God's words, because God gives him the fullness of his Spirit.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ka binyila ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Yila maa nyɛla din ʒe dunia ŋɔ yikonim bɛn daa wurim Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ni Jɛrusalɛmnima kpɛhi yɔɣu la zaani.
en: I asked the angel that had been speaking to me, What do these horns mean? He answered, They stand for the world powers that have scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir maa daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal a yi zaŋ a yiŋ pirigili ti ma, n ku dol a kuli. Ka m mi ku di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: The prophet answered, Even if you gave me half of your wealth, I would not go with you or eat or drink anything with you.

dag: Ka n timdi m mabihi ŋɔ na pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu shɛm la ku kpalim yoli, ka di chɛ ka yi mali shili kaman n ni yɛli ni yi pun mali shili shɛm la.
en: But Im sending the brothers so that our bragging about you in this case wont be empty words, and so that you can be prepared, just as I keep telling them you will be.

dag: Di piligu dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, daba ayopɔin maa dali gba, di simdi ka yi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di bi simdi ka yi tum tuma di dabisa maa ni, amaa yi ni tooi duɣi yi bindira dina.
en: There will be holy assemblies on the first day and the last day of the festival. You must not do any work on these days. The only work you can do is preparing the food for your meals.

dag: Di saha Jɛrimia daa kul gɔrila o yubu niriba maa sani, dama bɛ daa na bi kpɛh o duu.
en: I had not yet been put in prison and was still moving about freely among the people.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli.
en: These are the things God told his people:.

dag: Amaa ka wain tia maa bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wain shɛli din tiri wuna mini ninsalinim suhupiɛlli la tɔɣibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the grape vine replied, My wine brings cheer to people and gods. I won't stop making wine, just so my branches can wave above the other trees.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, bɔhim Naawuni nya ti ni di nasara ti chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: They said to him, Please ask God if we are going to be successful on our trip.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa ti bahi di nam maa labina, ka daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bolim o ni daa zaŋ liɣiri ti o yiŋbi shɛb ka chaŋ la na ka o ti nya bɛ ni go kɔhigu maa nya nyɔri shɛm tariga.
en: After receiving his kingdom, he returned and called the servants to whom he had given the money to find out how much they had earned.

dag: Ka tibili yi yɛli ni di pala nini, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni, lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: And if the ear were to say, Because I am not an eye, I don't belong to the body, that would not keep it from being a part of the body.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, m mihirila n ninni niŋdi ba, bɛ ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.

dag: Ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa ti yi Tiriza n-ka Samaria na ti ŋme Jabɛshi bia Shallum maa luhi Samaria n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah to Samaria, assassinated Shallum, and succeeded him as king.

dag: di saha ka o luɣiri ninsalinim tiba, ka kpahiri bɛ zuɣuri ni ka dabiɛm mali ba.
en: then he opens peoples ears, scares them with warnings.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb yi daa bi ʒe yim, di wuhiri ni Naawuni mi bi ʒe yim?.
en: It is true that some Jews were not faithful to God. But will that stop God from doing what he promised?.

dag: Ŋun tumdi putuma deerila shɛli o tuma zuɣu, ka laɣindi atam maa sɔŋdi guli nyɛvili din ka bahigu saha ni di chɛ ka ŋun biriti mini ŋun chɛri zaa ti laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Even now, the people who harvest the crop are being paid. They are gathering crops for eternal life. So now the people who plant can be happy together with those who harvest.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim daa yɛli nabihi mini niriba maa zaa, Doo ŋɔ simdi kubu, dama o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi ya ŋɔ ka yi zaa wum li.
en: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the rulers and all the other people. They said, Jeremiah should be killed. He said bad things about Jerusalem. You heard him say those things.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiini yila paɣiri ka puhiri Yawɛ yɛra: Dama o viɛla ka o yurilim zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo kul beni sahakam. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kul tahiri pampam paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ duu maa tampuɣili maa zuɣu.
en: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever. Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.

dag: N daa lo nia ni n ka yi sanna nti kaai ya ka gari chaŋ Masidɔnia; ka ti lan yi Masidɔnia lab yi sanna ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ Judia.
en: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi ya yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa, ka laɣim ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa na nti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya.
en: So tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying. I will gather them out of the countries where I scattered them, and will give the land of Israel back to them.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔhimi, Pa Yisifu bia Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti ni mi so ba min o ma la m-bala? Ka di chaŋ wula ka o ti yɛli ni o yila alizanda ni na.
en: They were asking each other, Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti nya filiŋ Ijipti zo n-kuli maa ni, ka Firawuna ti chɛ ka bɛ di vi bɛ ni bɔri sɔŋsim shɛli maa puuni.
en: Pharaohs refuge will become your shame, hiding in Egypts shadow your disgrace.

dag: O nam maa ni daa ti niŋ yaa naai, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o kpamba bɛn daa ku o ba ŋun daa nyɛ naa la.
en: He became a strong king and killed the officials who had killed his father the king.

dag: Ka nyin Firawuna ni nya zahindi maa buyi la wuhiya ni Naawuni n-zal li, ka ni chɛ ka di ku yuui, ka di niŋ.
en: Pharaoh, you had two dreams about the same thing. That means God wanted to show you that he really will make this happen, and he will make it happen soon!.

dag: Ŋunkam gariti ʒiɛrila o nɛma; ka o leeg o ʒiʒiinitab ni maani so ansarisi.
en: Everyone passing by steals from him. His neighbors laugh at him.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni yɛn nam zuɣusaa zaɣ palli shɛli mini dunia palli shɛl la ni yɛn yuui shɛm, lala ka yi zuliya ni yi yuli yɛn yuui.
en: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale din ni mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet-smelling incense;.

dag: Naawuni daa ti tim tuun so ŋun yuli booni Jɔn na.
en: A man named John was sent from God.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Balaam, Di doli ba chaŋ, a mi miri ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla alibarika ni be shɛb ni.
en: God said to Balaam, Dont go with them. Dont curse the people, because they are blessed.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayɔbu dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah anii mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the sixth day offer eight young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla; ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Sisɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hazɔrinim naa Jabin sapashin kpɛm la nuu ni. Ka lan zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim mini Mɔabnim nanim nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme ba tɔbu.
en: But your ancestors forgot the LORD their God, so he handed them over to Sisera the commander of Hazors army, and to the Philistines, and to the Moabite king, all of whom fought against them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: The Israelites buried him in his own land at Timnath-Serah, north of Mount Gaash in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: ka zaŋ naɣilaa mini piɛlaa ni zim shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni, dama zuŋɔ Yawɛ ni yi zahira yi sani.
en: an ox and a ram as a well-being sacrifice before the LORD; and a grain offering mixed with oil, because today the LORD will appear to you.

dag: Ka nahiŋgu mini wahala ni suhugarigu daa ti chɛ ka bɛ filim.
en: But because of disaster and troubles, their families became small and weak.

dag: O daa suhi Naawuni, ka Naawuni daa wum o fabila ka deeg o suhigu maa, ka daa lan zaŋ o labisi Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ o nam maa ni yaha. Di saha ka Manaasa daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: God accepted Manasseh's prayer and answered it by letting him go back to Jerusalem and rule again. This convinced Manasseh that the Lord was God.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ Midiannim nanim niŋ yi nuu ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Orɛb mini Ziib. Ka n ni tum shɛli lee nyɛla dini, ka n-ni tooi zaŋ li buɣisi yi dini? Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ o sani maa kpi.
en: After all, through the power of God you killed the two Midianite chiefs, Oreb and Zeeb. What have I done to compare with that? When he said this, they were no longer so angry.

dag: Yɛlim bɛnkam suhuri zɔhiri la, Maliya kpiɔŋ ka di zɔriya dabiɛm! Yi Naawuni maa yɛn kamina ti bɔhi yi dimnim biɛri tin ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: People are afraid and confused. Say to them, Be strong! Dont be afraid! Look, your God will come and punish your enemies. He will come and give you your reward. He will save you.

dag: Ka Baalihanan Akibɔr bia maa daa ti kpi, ka Hada daa di nam zan o zaani. O ya yuli n-daa booni Pau, ka o paɣ yuli daa booni Mɛhɛtabɛl. O daa nyɛla Mɛtirɛd bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ Mɛzahab yaaŋa.
en: When Baal Hanan died, Hadad ruled that country. Hadad was from the city of Pau. His wifes name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ toomiya li ti ti aŋgo zo. Ka bɛ tooi li ti ti o.
en: he said, Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast. The servants did as Jesus told them.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Dauda daa niŋ yuun bɔbili ka kurigi pam; ka bɛ daa kul mali chinchin tibisa m-pind o, amaa di zaa yoli, di daa bi kur o wari.
en: King David was very old and could not keep warm. His servants covered him with blankets, but he was still cold.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim daa bi baŋ? Anabi Musa n-nyɛ ŋun tuui garigi. O daa yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni chɛ ka yi zab zuliya shɛb bɛn pa zuliya maŋli nyuli; ka chɛ ka yi suhuri yiɣisi bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra zuɣu.
en: But I ask you again, didnt Israel understand? First, Moses says, I will make you jealous of those who arent a people, of a people without understanding. .

dag: Dama Babilɔn naa maa ʒiɛla sochira zuɣu ni o vihi nya o ni yɛn doli so shɛli. O chaɣisi piɛma, ka niŋ buɣa saawara, ka vihi maligu biŋkɔbigu binsabili.
en: When the Babylonian king stands at that signpost, he will decide which way to go by shaking his arrows, by asking his idols, and by carefully looking at the liver of a sacrificed animal.

dag: Ka nyamiya o ni ʒe palɔni shɛm tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka so bi niŋ o shɛli! Di ni bɔŋɔ ti zuɣulaannim baŋya ni doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Masia yɔɣɔ?.
en: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?.

dag: N kuhimi hal ka n nimbihi ti fulim. Di biɛri m puuni. Bɛ ni ku n niriba shɛm maa zuɣu, n suhu saɣimmi, dama biliɛri mini biyaɣilima tarigimi lu tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu.
en: My eyes are worn out with weeping; my soul is in anguish. I am exhausted with grief at the destruction of my people. Children and babies are fainting in the streets of the city.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ, Nyin Yawɛ, a daa yɛli ma, Labim a ya min a dɔɣiriba sani ka n niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Then Jacob prayed: You, Lord , are the God who was worshiped by my grandfather Abraham and by my father Isaac. You told me to return home to my family, and you promised to be with me and make me successful.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma labi Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la, ka di yomi.
en: Then the man brought me back to the east gate of the Temple area. We were outside the gate and the gate was shut.

dag: Musa daa zaŋla o paɣa Zipɔra labisi ka o deemba Jɛtro daa deeg.
en: Moses father-in-law Jethro took with him Zipporah, Moses wife whom he had sent away.

dag: ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim, ka di dunoya kabisikabisi.
en: All that is left is destruction. Even the gates are crushed.

dag: Jɛzibɛl ni daa kul wum ni bɛ lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o, ka o yɛli Ɛhab, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti deei Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la wain tihi pu shɛli o ni daa zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ kɔh a zuɣu la su, dama Nabɔt lan ka o nyɛvil ni, o kpiya.
en: As soon as Jezebel received the message, she said to Ahab, Naboth is dead. Now go and take possession of the vineyard which he refused to sell to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirigi bɛ ni yɛn kpa tiŋgbani maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo ti taba. Ɛhab kɔŋko daa kpala yaɣ yini polo; ka Obadia mi kɔŋko kpa yaɣ din la polo.
en: You go one way, and I'll go the other. Then they left in separate directions.

dag: Ka bɛnkam pun mi o ni daa ti nya ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ yɛli taba, Ka bɔ n-lee siɣi Kish bia ŋɔ zuɣu na? Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: When all the people who had known Saul saw him prophesying with the prophets, they said to each other, Whats happened to Kishs son? Is Saul also one of the prophets.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Zaŋ chaŋ a paɣ Zarai mi polo, di lan bol o Zarai, amaa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana bolim o la Zara.
en: God said to Abraham, I will give Sarai, your wife, a new name. Her new name will be Sarah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlima, kpiimba ni ti doya kaman naɣibina n-do mɔɣu ni la, bee kaman chi ni dɔndo kachɛriba nyaaŋa shɛm la, ka so ti ku kpuɣi ba.
en: The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni Mɛdɛba tintan zaŋ hal ti paai Dibɔn.
en: Their land started at Aroer by the Arnon Ravine and continued to the town in the middle of the ravine. And it included the whole plain from Medeba to Dibon.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka di mini li laɣim zooi ka gɔhi maa girimgirim li.
en: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.

dag: M bi bɔri ni n ti nyan ya la biɛla ka gari; ti Duuma yi saɣi n niŋdi tahima ni n ni ti yuui yi sani.
en: I dont want to come see you now, because I would have to leave to go to other places. I hope to stay a longer time with you, if the Lord allows it.

dag: N yi tɛh a soya yɛla, ŋ-ŋmaligirimi dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I thought very carefully about my life, and I decided to follow your rules.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa yi ninvuɣ yino so o ni daa nam la ni na, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka zali ʒiɛmana balibu kɔŋkɔba mini tiŋgbana tarisi.
en: From one person God created every human nation to live on the whole earth, having determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their lands.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Amaŋmaŋ mi n ni tum shɛm ti a, ka lan mi n zuɣu ni chɛ ka a niɣi yɛligi shɛm.
en: Jacob answered, You know that I have worked hard for you. Your flocks have grown and been well while I cared for them.

dag: Dindina, ka bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ buɣisi? So bi ŋman o.
en: The holy God asks, Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal.

dag: Amaa ka Hanna yɛl o, N dana, Aai, n nyɛla paɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni pam. M bi nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ, amaa n zaŋdila n suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira zaa wuhiri Yawɛ.
en: Hannah answered, Sir, I have not drunk any wine or beer. I am deeply troubled, and I was telling the Lord about all my problems.

dag: Dama niriba lala tatabo bi doli ti Duuma Yisa Masia, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre ka bɛ doli, ka mali yɛtɔɣ suma mini naŋgbammalisim yɔhindi bɛn tɛha bi zilima.
en: People like that arent serving the Lord. They are serving their own feelings. They deceive the hearts of innocent people with smooth talk and flattery.

dag: Shɛma daa nyɛla Raham ba, ka Raham nyɛ Jokiam ba, ka Rɛkɛm mi daa nyɛ Shammai ba.
en: Shema was the father of Raham, Jorkeams father; and Rekem was the father of Shammai.

dag: Kom daa beni n-sɔŋ li. Ka tiŋgbani ziliŋ daa chɛ ka di zooi niŋ wɔɣilim, ka chɛ ka di mɔɣa kom daa zo n-tiɛli bɛ ni daa sa li luɣ shɛli maa, ka di kɔsoya kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa.
en: Waters nourished it; the deep raised it up, because its streams flowed around the place where it was planted. From there, water trickled down to all the other trees of the field.

dag: Amaa tinim ni nyɛ wuntaŋ ni niriba la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti maŋa ka zaŋ yɛda mini yurilim leei nyɔtaɣirigu m-pa ti nyɔri zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti tiliginsim tahima kaman tɔbutuhiri zuɣupila la pili.
en: But we belong to the day, so we should control ourselves. We should wear faith and love to protect us. And the hope of salvation should be our helmet.

dag: Ŋuna n-tiri dansi, ŋuna n-lan lɔri dansi maa yuma. Ŋuna n-ŋmɛri tiri dansi, amaa ka o nuu tibiri dansi maa.
en: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.

dag: ni teebul la mini di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi.
en: the table, its poles, and all its equipment; the bread offered to God;.

dag: Noombihi bɛn gbahiri binnɛma dira bi mi di soli ni be shɛli, ka suligu nini na ʒi n-nya li.
en: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni daa zaŋ doo maa du alizanda ni. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: I repeat, I know that this man was snatched to Paradise , and there he heard things which cannot be put into words, things that human lips may not speak.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ dari kpe chɛrubinima, n-dooi salima pa bɛ zuɣu, ka o zaŋ ba zali luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa.
en: The king also had his workers make two winged creatures out of metal, cover them with gold, and place them in the Most Holy Place.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum buyi.
en: Jesus answered, The truth is, tonight you will say you dont know me. You will say it three times before the rooster crows twice.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bo bumbila m-ba kaman di ni daa sab shɛm la. Di sabiya:.
en: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the scripture says.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi ni daa na ʒi Naawuni la, yi daa bela dunia ŋɔ binshɛŋa din pa bin jɛmda dabitim ni.
en: In the past you did not know God, and so you were slaves of beings who are not gods.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni o nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianim maa.
en: When Joab saw that the battle would be fought on two fronts, he chose some of Israels finest warriors and deployed them to meet the Arameans.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Ɛdomnim tiŋa n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Kɛriɔt la. Ka Mɔabnim ni kpi tɔbu tuhibu vuri mini tɔbbihi tahigu ni kikahi kumsi zuɣu.
en: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab.

dag: Di bi simdi ni nir di shiri pam bee m-bɔri jilima ti yaɣi.
en: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.

dag: Nir yi nya yɛm, di so salima, ka nir yi pii tɛhi zilima, di so anzinfa.
en: Wisdom is worth much more than gold. Understanding is worth much more than silver.

dag: Amaa ti mabihi, yinim bi be zibisim ni ka dindali maa ni ti libigi ya kaman tayiɣa ni libigiri niriba shɛm la.
en: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.

dag: Asiba kam, n ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. N ni yihi tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa Yawɛ tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Day after day I will destroy the wicked in our land; I will expel all who are evil from the city of the Lord .

dag: Ti malila ti tizɔpaɣa, ka o biha bi yaɣi lala. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa, dɔbba yi ti kana ti bɔr o?.
en: We have a young sister, and her breasts are still small. What will we do for her when a young man comes courting?.

dag: ka daa lan mali kɔniŋdi bini ni naɣilahi pinaayi shɛb zuɣu di ni daa tamya la.
en: the large bowl and the twelve bulls that held it up.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm ba Hamɔr daa kana ni o ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu di yɛtɔɣa.
en: Shechem's father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa bɛ ku tooi nya.
en: They have mouths, but cannot speak, and eyes, but cannot see.

dag: Yi yurinim zaa tam yi yɛla, bɛ baɣa lan ka yi ni; dama n ŋmɛn ya mi kaman n nyɛla yi dim la; n darigila yi tibili kaman dim so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu, dama yi taali galisiya pam, ka yi daalahichi mi galisi yaɣi.
en: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa kpi maa, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la so shɛli din daa kuni Ɛfirat la sokpaŋa, nimaani ka bɛ booni Bɛtilihɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Rachel died and was buried near the road to Ephrath, that is, Bethlehem.

dag: Tuma maa nyɛla balibubalibu, amaa kulla Naawuni yino maa n-chɛ ka di zaa tumdi sokam zaa ni.
en: and there are different activities but the same God who produces all of them in everyone.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yɛli, Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ne nini gari Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm la. Dama Yawɛ daa zaliya ni Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm maa di nya nasara, ka di chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Absalom.
en: Then Absalom and everyone in Israel agreed, The advice of Hushai from Erek is better than Ahithophels advice. This was because the LORD had decided to counter Ahithophels good advice so that the LORD could bring disaster on Absalom.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee kabiɛlli kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di yi pa lala, di kul ni nyɛla kabiɛl yini maa ko; amaa di yi kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di ni nabi.
en: It is a fact that a grain of wheat must fall to the ground and die before it can grow and produce much more wheat. If it never dies, it will never be more than a single seed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri yiɣisi bah a zuɣu ni di vi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a mi ni kpalim yoli ka kpi.
en: All who rage against you will be shamed and disgraced. Those who contend with you will be as nothing and will perish.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba.
en: So then, you will know the false prophets by what they do.

dag: Ka n ti pii maligumaana so ŋun ni ʒe ma yim ka tumdi n suhu mini n tɛha ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa; biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ti me o yili ti o, ka o ti be n ninvuɣ gahindili sani n-tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: I have chosen someone else to be my priest, someone who will be faithful and obey me. I will always let his family serve as priests and help my chosen king.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ ninkura, wummiya; yinim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na min niŋ yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni bee yi yaannim ʒiɛmana la ni?.
en: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa zali dunɔguliba Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya ni ni bɛ kariti bɛn bi be kasi.
en: He posted guards at the gates of the LORDs temple so that no one who was unclean in any way could enter.

dag: Niriba maa zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi bɛ ni ŋooi takɔb shɛli mini bɛ ni vooi tɔb shɛli ni bɛ to barina ni.
en: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Kom ŋɔ zɔri kparila wulimpuhili polo yaɣili n-zɔri chani Araba vinvamli ni. Ka di yi zo nti lu teeku kom din bi zɔri ŋɔ ni, teeku kom maa ni niŋ ko nyaɣisili.
en: He said to me, These waters go out to the eastern region, flow down the steep slopes, and go into the Dead Sea. When the flowing waters enter the sea, its water becomes fresh.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa nya lala ka bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi tiri niriba maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ʒiya ka niriba maa zaa ʒe n-gil a asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: Jethro saw how much Moses had to do for the people, and he asked, Why are you the only judge? Why do you let these people crowd around you from morning till evening.

dag: Ka o yi bi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuuni maa puuni, dindina yili din be bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni maa ni leela ŋun da li maa dini sahakam o ʒiɛman ni, ka di bi simdi ka bɛ ti deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: But if you do not buy it back within the year, you lose the right of repurchase, and the house becomes the permanent property of the purchasers and their descendants; it will not be returned in the Year of Restoration.

dag: Ka n nya malaika ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka o kuhiri pampam bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee simdi ni o tabigi bintabinda ŋɔ ka bɔɣi litaafi ŋɔ n-lihi di puuni.
en: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi halibiɛri zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa zali ya lala.
en: Jesus said to them, Moses wrote this law for you because you are so hard to teach.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: And the Lord said, If they pronounce my name as a blessing upon the people of Israel, I will bless them.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba maa mini Izraɛlnim zaa baŋ dindali maa ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr kubu maa pala naa suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: All the people of Judah and Israel understood that King David had not killed Abner son of Ner.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi ba, ka o min o nyaandoliba dii kpe ŋariŋ m-baai du teeku duli chaŋ Dalimanuta tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: then got into a boat with his disciples and went over to the region of Dalmanutha.

dag: Dunia niriba ŋmanila nooŋa tiɛɣu, ka n laɣim bɛ daazichi n-vaai li kaman nir ni vari gala shɛm la, ka so bi zaŋ o kpiŋkpaŋ gahi ma bee n-yaag o noli ni o chɛ n-kari ma.
en: My hand found the wealth of the peoples as if it were in a nest. Just as one gathers abandoned eggs, I have gathered the entire earth; no creature fluttered a wing or opened a mouth to chirp.

dag: Kiriatijiarim zuliya n-daa nyɛ Itirinim mini Putinim ni Shumatinim ni Mishiranima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zuliya ni ka Zɔranim mini Ɛshitaolnim yina.
en: and the tribes from Kiriath Jearim. These are the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites came from the Mishraites.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣa daa wum Sulemaana yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu polo, ka kana nti bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa din kpɛma ni o buɣis o nya.
en: The queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame, and she traveled to Jerusalem to test him with difficult questions.

dag: Guli ma, ka fa ma bahi; di chɛ ka n di vi, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka m mali suhupiɛlli; ka n niŋgbuŋ gba tiligi;.
en: So my heart and soul will be very happy. Even my body will live in safety.

dag: Bɛn su bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ku lan di o baɣibuɣibo maa nyɔri maa ka bɛ daa gbaai Pool mini Silas n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani daa puuni.
en: Her owners realized that their hope for making money was gone. They grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them before the officials in the city center.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Bee yi tɛhiya ni Sailom du shɛli din daa du pam la ni daa lu n-ku ninvuɣ pisaayika shɛb la daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm la?.
en: What about those eighteen people in Siloam who were killed when the tower fell on them? Do you suppose this proves that they were worse than all the other people living in Jerusalem?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, Hal a kul lihiya ni a pɔri maa zaa yoli, pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya zaa zuɣulana? Yawɛ n-daa booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa.
en: Samuel said, In the past you didnt think that you were important, but the Lord chose you to be the king. So you became the leader of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Nira yi je yɛlimaŋli, o ni tooi su niriba? A ni galim ŋun nyɛ Wuntialana ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlana?.
en: Are you condemning the righteous God? Do you think that he hates justice?.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daa ka taɣinamsi, di daa kul bela vau, ka zibisim limsi bɔɣ zilinli, ka Naawuni shia daa be kom zuɣusaa ginda.
en: the earth was without shape or form, it was dark over the deep sea, and Gods wind swept over the waters.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kaman bɛ zuliya maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm, bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannima ka be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim nyɛla bɛn fari niriba mini ŋmɛnditoya. Bɛ muɣisiri faranim mini nandaamba, ka fari saamba nɛma, ka bi labisiri li tiri ba.
en: The important people of the land have practiced extortion and have committed robbery. Theyve oppressed the poor and mistreated the immigrant. Theyve oppressed and denied justice.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ka Sool sanna nti pilig o tuma tumbu, ka Sool daa yu o pam, ka o zaŋ o leeg o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira.
en: David went to Saul and started working for him. Saul liked him so much that he put David in charge of carrying his weapons.

dag: Suhugarigu so lari, dama nandahima nyɛla din tahiri suhukpaŋsibo na.
en: Sorrow is better than laughter; it may sadden your face, but it sharpens your understanding.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla yuun pisi m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini ŋun Sulemaana nam yili.
en: It took Solomon twenty years to build the Temple and his palace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ɛlim, ka kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani m-miri kom maa.
en: Later the Israelites came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and palm trees. So they camped there.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: and then he added, I have something to ask of you. What is it? she asked.

dag: Rubin zuliya bɛn daa ʒiya gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni pihinu ni yini ni kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ bɛn yɛn doli pahi buyi.
en: All those enlisted in Reubens camp with their military units are . They will march second.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa; ka Filistianim maa daa dol ba ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: Meanwhile, the Philistines fought against the Israelites, and the Israelites ran from them. There were many dead bodies that fell at Mount Gilboa.

dag: Judanim daa tum din bie Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa tum alahichi gari bɛ yaannim ni daa tum shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: The people of Judah sinned against the Lord and did more to arouse his anger against them than all their ancestors had done.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣi, ka chɛ ka amiliya niŋbu dakulo maa naai, ka Leeban daa lan zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So that is what Jacob did. He completed the celebratory week with this woman, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni, ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: Then the demons came out of the man and went into the pigs. The herd of pigs ran down the hill into the lake, and all were drowned.

dag: Zalim ba dimbɔŋɔ lala, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku mali galimi.
en: Teach these things so that the families will be without fault.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni.
en: Jesus answered, Stop grumbling among yourselves.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Hivinim maa, Wula ka ti mini ya ni tooi lo tab alikauli? Dama di pa shɛli ka yi kul bela yomayoma kpe.
en: Israel said to the Hivites, Perhaps you live among us. How then could we make a treaty with you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Judanima, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Judanim maa nyaŋ ba.
en: The Israelites fled from the Judeans, and God let the Judeans overpower them.
