dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gbahi Midian paɣiba mini bɛ bihi, ka gbahi bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu zaa, ka di bɛ nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: The Israelites took captive the Midianite women, their little ones, all their cattle, their herds, and their possessions.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ nanim maa zaa, ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔna maa yim, dama ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa tuhi ti bɛn Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Joshua conquered all these kings and their territory in one campaign because the Lord , Israel's God, was fighting for Israel.

dag: Nyama, bɛ zali ma la zaligu ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. O pun niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka n ku tooi vuui li.
en: I received a blessing, and he blessed. I cant take it back.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a ni lihi ʒiɛm ma ka kpuɣi Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la paɣa maa zuɣu, ninvuɣ kubo kul ku milig a yili ŋɔ.
en: Now, in every generation some of your descendants will die a violent death because you have disobeyed me and have taken Uriah's wife.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yili yidana yi di mi tayiɣ ni yɛn ka o yiŋ na yuŋ saha shɛli, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o, ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: But you understand that if the head of the house knew at what time the thief would come, he would keep alert and wouldnt allow the thief to break into his house.

dag: Izar daŋ ni, Kɛnania min o bidibisi ka bɛ daa pii ni bɛ tumdi samban ni tuma, ka nyɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn maani Izraɛlnim yɛla.
en: Kenaniah was from the Izhar family. Kenaniah and his sons had work outside the Temple. They worked as court officers and judges in different places in Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Zara sanna nti niŋ o kaman o ni daa pun lo o alikauli yɛli ni o ni niŋ o shɛm la.
en: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n dana, nyama, Adɔnija n-nyɛ naa, hal a ni kul bi mi di yɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: But Adonijah has already become king, and you don't know anything about it.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri mali nyɛvili, amaa o zaŋdi bɛn diri wahala yɛlimaŋli tiri ba.
en: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim ka Shunɛm na nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani; ka Sool gba daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ mi ti bɛ suɣa do Gilibɔa.
en: The Philistines gathered their forces and advanced to camp at Shunem. Saul gathered all Israel, and they camped at Gilboa.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nɛmi kaman wuntaŋa ka be kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la. Ŋuna n-niŋdi ti nirilim ka chɛ ka niriba tiri ti jilima. Yawɛ bi mɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi binsuma.
en: The Lord God is our protector and glorious king. He blesses us with kindness and honor. The Lord freely gives every good thing to those who do what is right.

dag: Ka Keen daa yi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti be tiŋgban shɛli din be Idɛn puu la wulimpuhili polo, ka di yuli booni Nɔd la.
en: But Cain had to go far from the Lord and live in the Land of Wandering, which is east of Eden.

dag: ka zaŋ o nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: because they will hear of your great reputation, your great power, and your outstretched arm. When the immigrant comes and prays toward this temple.

dag: Barina ni paai tin shɛli maa lumi dahim, ka yili kam zaa dunoya kpari, ka so ku tooi kpe di ni.
en: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina.
en: You have heard that it was said, Do not commit adultery.

dag: Ŋuna n-saɣindi yɛmbimbiɛrinim ni lo nia ni bɛ tum tuun shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nuhi bi diri nasara.
en: who frustrates the schemes of the clever so that their hands achieve no success.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋ jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: Whoever does not bow down and worship this gold idol will immediately be thrown into a very hot furnace.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa n-yiɣisi lab doo maa sani yaha.
en: And take your brother, get ready, and go back to the man.

dag: So yi mali dunia ŋɔ buni, ka nya o mabia ŋun simdi sɔŋbu ka yih o suhu o ni, wula ka Naawuni yurilim ni tooi be nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.

dag: ka zaŋ ʒiri shɛhiranim maa na ka bɛ ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ kul galindila Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛli din be kasi shee la mini Anabi Musa zaligu;.
en: The Jews brought some men into the meeting to tell lies about Stephen. These men said, This man is always saying things against this holy place and against the Law of Moses.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiri bimbira chani biribu, ka kumdi ti ʒi bɛ ni biri shɛli maa bɔba kuna ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who wept as they went out carrying the seed will come back singing for joy, as they bring in the harvest.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa labina, di saha maa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jabɛshigiliad paɣ shɛb bɛ ni daa bi kula ti ba. Amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi saɣi ba.
en: The Benjaminites came back, and the other Israelites gave them the young women from Jabesh whom they had not killed. But there were not enough of them.

dag: n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ paag a maa. A ni tum pagɔrisigu tuma ni zuliya shɛba, ka jɛm bɛ buɣa saɣim amaŋa la zuɣu.
en: have brought this on you. You were a prostitute for the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa na kpalim be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka be luɣ shɛlikam, nimaani niriba bɛn sɔŋmi ba n-ti ba anzinfa mini salima ni nɛma m-pahi biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ suhuyubu pina, ka bɛ zaŋ ti tum Naawuni duu maa tuma Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Everyone else must provide what is needed. They must give money, supplies, and animals, as well as gifts for rebuilding God's temple.

dag: Bɛ pihim kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ niriba galisi mini bɛn daŋ niriba pɔra.
en: Whether they are large or small, each tribe will inherit by means of the lot.

dag: Hal kawana ni lan kani, ka wain tihi mini fiig tihi ni yɔɣa ni olivi tihi na bi wal la zaa yoli, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Jɛriko, ka bɛ mini salo pam daa ti yiri Jɛriko maa, ka Timius bia Baatimius ŋun daa nyɛ zoma, ka nyɛ barimaana ʒi sokpaŋa.
en: Jesus and his disciples went to Jericho. And as they were leaving, they were followed by a large crowd. A blind beggar by the name of Bartimaeus son of Timaeus was sitting beside the road.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun daa bɔhi biɛri ti ma, ka zaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: He gives me victory over my enemies; he subdues the nations under me.

dag: Ka di ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni su shɛli, ka bɛ ni ti di li luɣ kasi shee la, dama di nyɛla o tarili din be kasi zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ puuni; ka di nyɛla o ni su shɛli sahakam.
en: It will belong to Aaron and his sons. They must eat it in a holy place because it is the most holy part of their share of the LORDs food gifts, a permanent portion.

dag: A yi di nyɛla jɛrigu ŋun duhir amaŋa bee a yi di lɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu, nyin zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli;.
en: If youve been foolish and arrogant, if youve been scheming, put your hand to your mouth.

dag: Ka n daa nya tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm palli, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina, ka malimali m-be kaman amiliya ni yi mal omaŋa n-gu o daaŋgo shɛm la.
en: Then I saw New Jerusalem, the holy city, coming down from God in heaven. It was like a bride dressed in her wedding gown and ready to meet her husband.

dag: amaa di yi ti bilina, di zoorimi gari tutuɣ kam n-niŋ wul kara hal ka noonsi ni tooi te bɛ tɛri di wula maa zuɣu.
en: but when its planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all vegetable plants. It produces such large branches that the birds in the sky are able to nest in its shade.

dag: N Naawuni maa tim o malaika na ka o ti mum gbuɣima maa noya, ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ ma shɛli. Naa, o niŋla lala, dama n ka taali o sani, ka ka taali a gba sani; ka m mi bi tum a taal shɛli.
en: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.

dag: A yi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa talim jɛrigu, di ŋmanila a zaŋla sua ŋmaag a napɔŋ bahi ka bɔri yɛla.
en: If you let a fool deliver a message, you might as well cut off your own feet; you are asking for trouble.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti mali bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi din ni chɛ ka di mini binyɛribila maa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o ti mal li gar o bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: Two shoulder straps, by which it can be fastened, are to be attached to the sides.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhi pateesanim maa tuɣ taba din ni chɛ ka m biɛhigu shee maa ti nyɛ zaɣ muni yini.
en: Then make gold rings to join the curtains together. This will join the Holy Tent together into one piece.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti diri bindirigu saha shɛli, bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ galima shɛb daa ti kana ti teei gili yili maa kpahiri di dunoli ka yɛri ninkurigu ŋun nyɛ yil maa lan maa, Zaŋm do so ŋun kpe a yili ŋɔ na la ti ti ka ti gol o.
en: They were having a good time, when some worthless men of that town surrounded the house and started banging on the door and shouting, A man came to your house tonight. Send him out, so we can have sex with him.

dag: Niɣi mini bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la ni ti laɣim ŋubiri mɔri, ka bɛ bihi ti laɣim doya. Ka gbuɣinli ni ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman nahu la.
en: Cows and bears will eat together, and their calves and cubs will lie down in peace. Lions will eat straw as cattle do.

dag: ni Anduru ni Filip ni Baatolomiu ni Matiu ni Tomas ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Patriot.

dag: Ka o mini Mariama so bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti o ka o mali puu la kuli bɛ ya Bɛtilihɛm ni bɛ ti sab bɛ yuya.
en: He went to register with Mary, who was promised in marriage to him. She was pregnant.

dag: Ka dabili maa yi niŋ a ni wuh o shɛm maa, a ni puh o di zuɣu? Aai!.
en: You wont thank the servant because the servant did what you asked, will you?.

dag: Ka Asiria naa Tiligatipilinɛza daa lee ti kana ti lir o mi n-nahim o, ka bi sɔŋ o.
en: King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria came and gave Ahaz trouble instead of helping him.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi di gooni maa gba kaman ninsal ni buɣisir binyara shɛm, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pihiyɔbu.
en: The angel also measured the wall. It was cubits high.

dag: Neesim viɛla, ka nina yi nya wuntaŋa, di viɛla.
en: It is good to be able to enjoy the pleasant light of day.

dag: Lala ka di simdi ni yidaannim gba yuri bɛ paɣiba kaman bɛ ni yuri bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛm la. Ŋun yur o paɣa yurila omaŋa.
en: Men ought to love their wives just as they love their own bodies. A man who loves his wife loves himself. .

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi wuhimi taba, ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri taba, ka di chɛ ka yi nya alaafee. Wuntizɔra nimmoo wunsuhigu mali yiko pam di tuma puuni.
en: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.

dag: Bɛ buɣa maa ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa zali watamilo puu ni n-varisiri binnɛma, ka bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la. Niriba n-kpuɣiri ba chana, dama bɛ ku tooi chaŋ. Miriya ka yi zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ mi ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you?.

dag: Amaa sara maligunim ŋɔ daa kul teerila niriba maa bɛ daalahichi yɛla yuuni kam;.
en: But thats not what happens. Their sacrifices make them remember their sins every year.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa tim ti deeg o o yidan Palitiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Laishi bia la sanna.
en: Ishbosheth then sent for Michal and took her from her husband Paltiel, Laishs son.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ka salo maa tɔɣisiri Yisa yɛla lala maa zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa tim Naawuni duu tuumba ni bɛ ti gbaag o na.
en: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about Jesus, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent guards to arrest him.

dag: Ka di daa bi yuui ka biasani maa laɣis o ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha. Nimaani ka o daa ti zaŋ o buni maa zaa tum yoliyoli.
en: After a few days the younger son sold his part of the property and left home with the money. He went to a country far away, where he wasted his money in reckless living.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ko yi gbansɔri yuma ayɔbu n-kpuɣi di daatam.
en: Plant and harvest your crops for six years.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ku tooi niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni neeri kpiimba?.
en: Why is it inconceivable to you that God raises the dead?.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ zim sara maligu nti tooi li pal o nuu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba la zuɣu.
en: He presented the grain offering and took a handful of flour and burned it on the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka wuntizɔriba zaa suh a bɛ muɣisigu saha, ka kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ ku paai ba.
en: Thats why all the faithful should pray to you during troubled times, so that a great flood of water wont reach them.

dag: Kpuɣimiya paɣiba n-dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bomiya paɣiba ti yi bidibisi, ka zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti dɔbba; nabimiya pahi nimaani, ka di filimya.
en: Marry and have children. Then let your children get married, so that they also may have children. You must increase in numbers and not decrease.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni, ka tɛhiya din yɛn niŋ ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani yɛla nya. Yi ni daa na bi piligi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mɛbu tuma.
en: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi, dama yi yi bi niŋ yɛda ni n nyɛla n ni pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la, yi shiri ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi.
en: This is why I told you that you would die in your sins. If you dont believe that I Am, you will die in your sins.

dag: dama tuma so titali ka n nya kpe, ka sɔguriba pam mi lee beni.
en: There is a real opportunity here for great and worthwhile work, even though there are many opponents.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu wummi n saɣisigu ŋɔ. Chɛl alahichi tumbu ka tumdila din tuhi, ka zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nambɔɣu. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a nya suhudoo ka di yuui.
en: So then, Your Majesty, follow my advice. Stop sinning, do what is right, and be merciful to the poor. Then you will continue to be prosperous.

dag: Ka din lan pahi nyɛla, ninvuɣ biɛri yi zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, bɛ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: And if wicked people start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.

dag: Yinim pukpariba mini wain tihi kpariba, maliya nandahima. Kummiya alikama mini chi zuɣu. Dama puri atam saɣimiya.
en: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka di pala ti yɛn zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee m-maani sara shɛli di zuɣu.
en: So we decided to build this altar. But we did not plan to use it for burning offerings and sacrifices.

dag: Abana mini Faaripa mɔɣa din be Damaskus la bi so koma zaa din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni? N naan dii ku chaŋ nimaani nti mim ka nya alaafee? Dinzuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, are better than all the water in Israel. Why cant I wash in those rivers in Damascus and become clean? He was very angry and turned to leave.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila maligumaaniba zuɣulana Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋ bipuɣin so ti kana.
en: While Peter was still in the courtyard, a servant girl of the high priest came up.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla mani bee bɛna, lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri tiri ya, ka lahibal suŋ maa mi nyɛ yi ni daa niŋ shɛli yɛda la.
en: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi dabisa ti nabi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ ti yi yaannim la ni n-yuui nimaani kaman sagbana ni be tiŋgbani zuɣusaa shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Then you and your children will live a long time in the land that the Lord your God promised to give to your ancestors. You will live there as long as there is a sky above the earth.

dag: Pa omaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni Yisa ni ti kpi bɛ zuliya maa zuɣu;.
en: Caiaphas did not think of this himself. As that years high priest, he was really prophesying that Jesus would die for the Jewish people.

dag: Ahaz daa nyɛla Jɛhɔada ba, ka Jɛhɔada nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba; Zimiri mi daa nyɛla Mɔza ba;.
en: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, who was the father of three sons: Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.

dag: Saha shɛli Pool ni daa be Milɛtus maa ka o daa tim ti boli Ɛfɛsus Cheechi kpamba.
en: In Miletus Paul sent a message back to Ephesus, telling the elders of the church in Ephesus to come to him.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhi tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli? bee Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: Instead, each one of them should ask their friends and their relatives, What answer has the Lord given? What has the Lord said.

dag: Dindali maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntins anu nim ni ti tɔɣisi Keenannim yɛtɔɣa, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. Ka tinsi maa ni zaɣ yini yuli ni ti boonila Wuntaŋ tiŋa.
en: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord . One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sool daa tim ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gu Dauda o yiŋa, o daa lomi ni o ku o asiba. Amaa ka Dauda paɣa Mikal daa yɛl o, A yi bi tilig a nyɛvili yuŋ ŋɔ, biɛɣuni bɛ sa ni ku a.
en: Saul sent guards to watch David's house all night and then to kill him in the morning. Michal, David's wife, told him, If you don't escape tonight, they'll kill you tomorrow.

dag: Bihi kabirila dari, ka dɔbba maani buɣim, ka paɣiba mi ŋɔriti zim ni bɛ mali maha ti wuni so bɛ ni booni Zuɣusaa Paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa la, ka boori binnyura tiri wun shɛŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead dough to make sacrificial cakes for the queen of heaven. And to offend me all the more, they pour out drink offerings to foreign gods.

dag: N ni daa bi baŋ n ni yɛn gbaai yɛlli maa shɛm zuɣu ka n daa bɔhi Pool ni o bɔri ni o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar o saria nimaani.
en: I was undecided about how I could get information on these matters, so I asked Paul if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried there on these charges.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yina naŋgban yini. Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaŋ tabili Giliad. Ka salo maa daa laɣim naŋgban yini Yawɛ tooni Mizipa.
en: So all the Israelites joined together. They all came together to stand before the Lord in the city of Mizpah. People came from everywhere in Israel. Even the Israelites from Gilead were there.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Samsin chaŋ ni o ti puh o paɣ maa alikama chɛbu saha, ka ʒi bubil polli mali ni o ti ti o paɣ maa. Ka Samsin daa ti yɛl o paɣ maa ba, N ni kpe m paɣ sani. Amaa ka o paɣ ba maa bi saɣi;.
en: At the time of the wheat harvest, Samson went to visit his wife. He took a young goat with him as a gift. He said, I am going to my wifes room. But her father would not let Samson go in.

dag: ka daa mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi kɔbisinahi ni o zaŋ li niŋ o ni daa wuɣi binyar shɛŋa la. O daa zaŋ li mi pie tab kulis ayiyi n-gili o ni daa wuɣi binyar shɛŋa maa zaɣ yini kam ni o zaŋ pili biŋkpila ayi din daa tam daantalisi maa zuɣu la.
en: pomegranates for the chain designs;.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Amaa yi yi ti nya ka tɔbbihi teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, yin baŋmiya ni di wurimbu saha miriya.
en: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then you will know that its destruction is close at hand.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa sani karim; ka kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi. .
en: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee tiri zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka satahiŋga mini sakuɣa ni buɣim lu tiŋgban ni na. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then Moses raised his shepherds rod toward the sky, and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and lightning struck the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.

dag: Yila pia la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn ti yɛn su fukumsi nam maa ʒiɛman ni. Di nyaaŋa na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ ŋun be o ko ni o tab bɛn daŋ o tooni na la, ka ni ti yihi nanim ata nam ni.
en: The ten horns are ten kings who will rule that empire. Then another king will appear; he will be very different from the earlier ones and will overthrow three kings.

dag: Ka Bɛbai bia Zakaria daa nyɛ Bɛbai daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pihitaayika daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Bebai, Zechariah, Bebais son and with him men.

dag: N yura maa chaŋla o puu ni, o chaŋla tulaale tihi puu vuɣisi ni ni o ti chɛ ka o piɛri ŋub mɔri ka o bo paɣiviɛligakushihikom na.
en: My lover has gone down to his garden, where sweet-smelling spices grow. There, like a sheep, he will eat the grass, and he will enjoy the lilies.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa lan tɛhimi ni nyin naa yɛligu nyɛla din ni ti ma vuhim, dama nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika ŋun mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni be a sani.
en: I know that the words of my lord the king will give me rest, because you are like an angel from God. You know what is good and what is bad. And the Lord your God is with you.

dag: ka Shallum nyɛ Hilikia ba, ka Hilikia nyɛ Azaria ba.
en: Hilkiah, Azariah.

dag: Niriba maa ni ti nahindi taba, ka sokam ti nahind o kpee; ka bipala ku tiri bɛ kpamba jilima, ka tarimba ku tiri bɛ zuɣulaannim jilima.
en: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni yi ti shɛb azichi mini nɛma, ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tarili n-di bɛ tuma nyaɣisim, Naawuni pini m-bala.
en: Also, whenever God gives people wealth and riches and enables them to enjoy it, to accept their place in the world and to find pleasure in their hard work—all this is Gods gift.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni naɣila o Bi gaŋ ŋun ʒi n-dalim o Ba Naawuni nyɔɣu la kɔŋko. Ŋuna n-wuhi ti Naawuni ni nyɛ so.
en: No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is the same as God and is at the Father's side, he has made him known.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka Yisahaku mi dɔɣi Yaakubu mini Iso. Ka n daa zaŋ Ɛdom zoya zuɣu tiŋgbani ti Iso ni di nyɛ o dini, amaa ka Yaakubu ŋun min o bihi daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti.
en: Then I gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Mount Seir, but your ancestor Jacob and his children went to live in Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya kɔniŋdi bini ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli, ka di naŋgbanyɛra zaŋ ti tuui tab nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: Then he made a large tank from melted bronze. It was round and it measured cubits across from edge to edge. It was cubits tall and about cubits around.

dag: Ŋun zaŋ omaŋ tabili tayiɣa je omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili; o yi wumdi niriba ni yɛri zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn niŋ tayiɣ maa, amaa ka o bi viir o gbini.
en: You are your own worst enemy if you take part in a crime. You will not be able to tell the truth even when people threaten you.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni kpuɣi pu shɛli atam, ka be kaman bɛ ni yihi binyiha pu shɛli din be Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni.
en: Israel will be like a field where the grain has been cut and harvested, as desolate as a field in Rephaim Valley when it has been picked bare.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ saa tahigu daa be zuɣusaa; ka Zallakudura Naa daa chɛ ka o kukoli yɛra.
en: The Lord thundered from the sky; God Most High let his voice be heard.

dag: Dama Yɛhudianim bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihira, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi bɔri yɛm.
en: The Jews ask for miraculous signs, and the Greeks want wisdom.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anu ni, yi ni tooi di di wala, ka lala chɛ ka di woli wala pam tin ya: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: But in the fifth year you may eat the fruit. If you do all this, your trees will bear more fruit. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Amaa Hɛfa bia Zɛlɔfɛhad ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi. Bipuɣinsi kɔŋko ka o daa dɔɣi. Bipuɣinsi maa yuya n-daa booni, Mahila ni Nɔa ni Hɔgila ni Milika ni Tiriza.
en: But Zelophehad, Hephers son, had no sons, only daughters. The names of Zelophehads daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi deei Naawuni nam kaman bia ni deeri li shɛm ti ku kpe di ni.
en: I assure you that whoever does not receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it.

dag: ni zaŋdi ya tahiri maa, ka yi ti di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu, yin zaŋmiya di shɛli ti Yawɛ.
en: When you eat the food that grows in that land, you must give part of that food as an offering to the Lord .

dag: Naawuni bi lihi ti ka ti be ti ko ka chɛ ba; dama bɛ gba yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: To God, those people are not different from us. When they believed, God made their hearts pure.

dag: Firawuna kpambaliba ni daa nya o, bɛ daa paɣ o pam Firawuna sani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Firawuna yiŋa.
en: When Pharaohs princes saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaohs household.

dag: ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn zaa mali suhukpeeni daa yi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti yihi Sool min o bidibisi maa Bɛtishan gooni maa zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ Jabɛshi ti nyo ba buɣim nimaani.
en: the bravest men started out and marched all night to Beth Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall, brought them back to Jabesh, and burned them there.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛrilim n-dihi bɛn tɛha bi zilima nachiinsi, amaa baŋsim n-nyɛ yɛnnim zuɣupila.
en: Fools are rewarded with more foolishness. Smart people are rewarded with knowledge.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ ni nam dabisi shɛli. Chɛliya ka ti suhuri paligi ka mali suhupiɛlli di ni.
en: This is the day of the Lord 's victory; let us be happy, let us celebrate!.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni bɛ nya, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ o, ka bi dol o zaligunima, amaa ka bɛ daa ti ŋmaligi n-leei bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.

dag: Yiɣisima, kuhimi pampam zaawuni, tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛl la. Chɛ ka a suhu saɣim pam ti Duuma tooni. Suhim o a bihi nyɛviya zuɣu; kum ni tarigi bi shɛb sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Get up throughout the night and cry for help. Let your sorrow pour out before the Lord like water. Lift up your hands in prayer to him. Ask him to let your children live. They are starving to death on every street corner.

dag: Chɛliya ka sokam be kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni o be shɛm min o ni daa pun be shɛm ka ti Duuma bol o la. N ni zali shɛm cheechi kam ni m-bala:.
en: Each of you should go on living according to the Lord's gift to you, and as you were when God called you. This is the rule I teach in all the churches.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua ni o mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla biŋkɔb lɔɣu bee zaɣ nyaŋ, di simdi ka o zaŋla ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa.
en: If the offering for a communal sacrifice of well-being for the LORD is from the flock—whether it is male or female—you must present a flawless specimen.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ, ka neeri ni shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili. Dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ yi beni, shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili gba nyɛla din beni.
en: When buried, it is a physical body; when raised, it will be a spiritual body. There is, of course, a physical body, so there has to be a spiritual body.

dag: Ka Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ salindoora la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa mal li mi me hal ti paai Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba mini kɔhigɔriba yili din daa be Vihibu Dunɔdali shee la hal ti paai zuɣusaa duu din daa be gɔŋbu shee la.
en: Malchijah, a goldsmith, built the next section, as far as the building used by the Temple workers and the merchants, which was by the Miphkad Gate to the Temple, near the room on top of the northeast corner of the wall.

dag: So na mi n-nya lahizibu yɛlli ŋɔ? Tiŋgbɔŋ niriba ni tooi zani dahin yini yɛligi? Bee zuliya ni tooi zani dahin yini yɛligi? Ziɔn ku nahim ka di yuui, ka o niriba yɛligi.
en: Whoever heard of such a thing? Whoever saw such things as these? Can a land come to birth in one day? Can a nation be born all at once? Yet as soon as birth pangs came, Zion bore her children.

dag: ka bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka yi lee sɔɣ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kamina ti nya ti ni sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: Where have you buried him? he asked them. Come and see, Lord, they answered.

dag: Amaa Lɔt ni daa ti yi Sɔdom dindahin shɛli, ka buɣim ni chilibi buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: They were doing these things even on the day when Lot left town. Then fire and sulfur rained down from the sky and killed them all.

dag: Ka n yɔri lee nyɛla dini? Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: M bi zaŋ n ni mali yolisim so shɛl la tumdi di tuma n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu maa puuni, dama m bi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu tiri niriba ka zaani ba ni bɛ yo shɛli di zuɣu.
en: So what do I get for doing it? My reward is that when I tell people the Good News I can offer it to them for free and not use the rights that come with doing this work.

dag: Yawɛ, a binnamda zaa ni paɣ a, ka a niriba bɛn zaa ʒe yim ni paɣ a.
en: All that you have made gives thanks to you, LORD; all your faithful ones bless you!.

dag: mini nɛma balibu kam ni pali yiya shɛŋa, ka di pala yinima n-zaŋ li niŋ di ni ni kɔbil shɛŋa din gbi n-doya, ka di pala yinima n-gbi li ni wain tihi mini olivi tihi puri, ka di pala yinima n-sa li, ka yi yi ti di n-tiɣi.
en: houses stocked with all kinds of goods that you didnt stock, cisterns that you didnt make, vineyards and olive trees that you didnt plant—and you eat and get stuffed.

dag: Maata ni daa ti wum ni Yisa be soli kanna o daa yiɣisimi ti tuh o soli, ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim be yiŋa.
en: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o niriba maa chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti jɛm o. Amaa ka a na kul bi saɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Tell him this: The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, sent me to you. He told me to tell you to let his people go worship him in the desert. Until now you have not listened to the Lord.

dag: O bi zaŋdi kaburi jaambɔn titali buri buŋgu bee n-zaŋdi naɣikɔra tɔroko nɔri nili, amaa kaburi jaambɔn bila ka o zaŋdi buri buŋgu, ka zaŋdi li ŋmari nili.
en: Fennel isnt threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cart wheel rolled over cumin, but fennel is beaten with a staff, and cumin with a rod.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga maa daa kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ la tariga mini di kulinol ni n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: This southern border ran from the south end of the Dead Sea.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi ba naai ka o chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni.
en: After he said goodbye to them, he went up into the hills to pray.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ni, amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni pii ma, ka ti ma soli ni n zaŋ lahibal suŋ din nyɛ Masia daazichi din ka buɣisibu la yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: God gave his grace to me, the least of all Gods people, to preach the good news about the immeasurable riches of Christ to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee maa bahi buɣim teeku ni. Buɣim teeku maa ni kpɛbu n-nyɛ kum din pahi buyi la.
en: Then death and the world of the dead were thrown into the lake of fire.

dag: ni bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni ninvuɣ biɛtali ni yɔhiŋ ni biɛr yoli ni nyuli zabbu ni nyaanzubo ni karimbaani ni jɛrilim.
en: adultery, greed, doing bad things to people, lying, doing things that are morally wrong, jealousy, insulting people, proud talking, and foolish living.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa paai Mahanaim. Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa mi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
en: David had reached Mahanaim by the time Absalom and all the Israelites who were with him crossed the Jordan River.

dag: Di saha nir yi ti tooi mali naɣisa yino mini piɛr ayi.
en: When that time comes, even if a farmer has been able to save only one young cow and two goats.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun chɛri niriba taali ni di chɛ ka bɛ zɔr a.
en: But forgiveness is with you— thats why you are honored.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ suma n-kul pali n suhu ni saha shɛli n ni ŋma yilli ŋɔ ni n-yili jɛm naa. N zilinli ŋmanila gbansabir so ŋun mi yila sabbu daalikalimi.
en: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.

dag: Ka Judanim daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din du pam mɔɣu ni la shee, ka bɛ daa du li n-lihi tɔbbi gbaliŋ la polo, n-nya ka kpiimba n-do tiŋa, ka bɛ so bi tiligi.
en: When Judah arrived at the point overlooking the wilderness, all they could see were corpses lying all over the ground. There were no survivors.

dag: Ka n dan maa paɣ Zara dɔɣi bidibiga ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; ka n dan maa zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ti o bia maa.
en: Sarah was my masters wife. When she was very old, she gave birth to a son, and my master has given everything he owns to that son.

dag: Pool ni daa kul yɛn yaag o noli saha shɛli ka Gallio dii yɛli ba, Yinim Yɛhudianim ŋɔ, di yi di nyɛla tuun gala bee tuumbiɛ shɛli ka o tum ka yi tah o ŋɔ na, n naan wum yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to the Jews, If there had been some sort of injury or criminal behavior, I would have reason to accept your complaint.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla bɛn doli adiini soli kaya, amaa ka lee chihi di yiko. Gbaam amaŋ ni niriba ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa ŋun pahi ayi ka nyɛ maligumaana leebu piɛlaa la na. Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

dag: Ifriimnim ni daa nya bɛ dɔro maa, ka Judanim mi nya bɛ daŋ la, di saha ka Ifriimnim daa chaŋ Asiria natital la sani ti bo sɔŋsim. Amaa o ku tooi chɛ ka yi kpaŋ bee n-tibi yi daŋ maa.
en: When Israel saw how sick she was and when Judah saw her own wounds, then Israel went to Assyria to ask the great emperor for help, but he could not cure them or heal their wounds.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a niŋ yuun pinaanu pahi. N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will let you live years more, while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria. I will defend this city as an honor to me and to my servant David.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi n dan Naa Dauda nyɛvili.
en: Bathsheba bowed low and said, May my lord the king live forever.

dag: Ka Shisha bihi Ɛlihɔrɛf mini Ahija nyɛ gbansabiriba. Ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ ŋun su gbana gbibbu fukumsi.
en: The court secretaries: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha In charge of the records: Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa ka bɔhir o, Bɔ ka ti yɛn nyu.
en: The people complained against Moses, What will we drink.

dag: lala ka a gba bi yi a pagɔrisigu tuma daɣiri ni. A ku lan yi a daɣiri maa ni hal ka n ti tum a n suhuyiɣisili tuma.
en: You sinned against me and became stained with sin. I wanted to wash you and make you clean, but the stains would not come out. I will not try washing you again until my hot anger is finished with you!.

dag: Ka n daa suhi Yawɛ di saha maa gba yɛli.
en: At that time I earnestly prayed.

dag: Naa Darius daa pii kpambaliba kɔbiga ni pisi zal o tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni.
en: Darius decided to appoint one hundred twenty chief administrators throughout the kingdom.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpaai kom bahina; ka saa daa tahira, ka a saa nyaɣisibu piɛma nyaɣisiri gindi luɣilikam zaa.
en: The thick clouds dropped their water. Thunder roared in the sky above. Your arrows of lightning flashed through the clouds.

dag: N niriba, niŋmiy o o ni daa niŋ ya shɛm labisi, ka yɔny o o tuma samli siɣimsiɣim buyi! Niŋmiy o binnyurigu ka di to n-gari o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-tin ya la!.
en: Give her what she has given to others. Give her back twice as much for what she has done. In the cup that she has poured, pour her twice as much.

dag: ka din pahi pinaata gbaai Hupa, ka din pahi pinaanahi gbaai Jɛshɛbiab.
en: The thirteenth was Huppahs group. The fourteenth was Jeshebeabs group.

dag: A ni daa mali karimbaani saha shɛli la a daa bi maanila a mabia Sɔdom ansarisi.
en: Jerusalem, you were so arrogant that you sneered at Sodom.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, Naawuni yur a pam. Yiɣisim zani n-luɣ a tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga; bɛ tim ma la a sanna. O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n yiɣisi zani ka n ni na kul sɔhira.
en: and then said, Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention. I stood trembling, while the angel said:.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa daa chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ yiŋ din daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.

dag: Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ bɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa la puhibu dali mini Yawɛ chuɣu puhibu dali?.
en: And when the time comes for the appointed festivals in honor of the Lord , what will they do then?.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: yumiya yi dimnim gba, ka niŋmiya alibarika niŋdi bɛn turi ya ni, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli; ka suhimiya Naawuni n-tiri bɛn niŋdi ya alaka.
en: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who harass you.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa kana ti paɣiri Naawuni ka tɔɣisiri bia maa yɛla bɛnkam zaa daa yuuni Jɛrusalɛmnim tiliginsim nyabu sol la sani.
en: She approached at that very moment and began to praise God and to speak about Jesus to everyone who was looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

dag: dinzuɣu m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma nam shɛm, lala ka n gba zali ya nam.
en: And I confer royal power on you just as my Father granted royal power to me.

dag: ni Shallum so mi ni Amaria ni Yisifu.
en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha ka Jɔash daa di nam n-ʒi Jɛrusalɛm. O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi. O ma daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba paɣa, ka o yuli booni Zibia.
en: In the seventh year of the reign of King Jehu of Israel, Joash became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for forty years. His mother was Zibiah from the city of Beersheba.

dag: Ti ni lan zaŋdi ti bidib kpamba mini ti niɣi ni ti biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ lo shɛba n-tahiri ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu na nti tiri maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm zaligu ni.
en: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.

dag: M biyurisi, ti suhuri yi bi wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, ti ni mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: And so, my dear friends, if our conscience does not condemn us, we have courage in God's presence.

dag: O ni ti wurim kuɣa binnana din be Hɛliɔpolis Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka nyo Ijiptinim buɣa jɛmbu duri buɣim.
en: He will shatter the sacred pillars in the temple of the sun in Egypt and burn down the temples of the Egyptian gods.

dag: Yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi nyaŋ Sintani yɛŋkiŋkabina soya zaa.
en: Wear the full armor of God. Wear Gods armor so that you can fight against the devils clever tricks.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni ka a sanna sagban tibisili puuni, dina n-ni chɛ ka niriba maa wum n ni tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa shɛm, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ niŋ a yɛda sahakam. Musa ni daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm zaa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Im about to come to you in a thick cloud in order that the people will hear me talking with you so that they will always trust you. Moses told the LORD what the people said.

dag: Di saha ka o buɣisi dundɔŋ ni dunɔdali puuni tooni din be tiŋli polo la tooni zaŋ hal ni sambani dunɔdali gbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The man measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner courtyard. It was cubits on the east side as well as on the north side.

dag: Bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la ka bɛ daa zaŋ me gooni maa, ka tiŋ maa maŋmaŋ nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself was made of pure gold, as clear as glass.

dag: kaman o ni daa lo ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli shɛli hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: He has remembered to show mercy to Abraham and to all his descendants forever.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun daa pun be ka ti lan kani la nyɛla naa ŋun pah anii, amaa o nyɛla nanima ayopɔin la ni yino, ka o gba ni bahi yoli.
en: And the beast that was once alive, but lives no longer, is itself an eighth king who is one of the seven and is going off to be destroyed.

dag: Yisifu mini Mariama ni daa niŋ ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛlikam zaa naai maa, ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ ya Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When Joseph and Mary had finished doing all that was required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to their hometown of Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim zaa. Paɣimiy o! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri ŋarima teeku ni mini teeku puuni binnɛma zaa ni teeku dulinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord ! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Judanima, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Judanim maa nyaŋ ba.
en: The men of Israel ran away from the men of Judah. God let the army from Judah defeat the army from Israel.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka Sintani dii kana nti yihi yɛligu shɛli din lu bɛ suhuri ni maa.
en: This is the meaning of the seed that fell on the path: When the word is scattered and people hear it, right away Satan comes and steals the word that was planted in them.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Kurimbuni ha bɛ daa yi yɛrila niriba, Chamiya Ɛbɛl n-ti bɔhi ka bɛ wuhi ya. Lala ka bɛ daa yi niŋdi maani yɛla.
en: She said, Long ago they used to say, Go and get your answer in the city of Abel—and that's just what they did.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Naawuni ni bi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu? Bee wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli ni Naawuni ni wuhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bi simdi tibidarigibo simdi ni bɛ nya tibidarigibo?.
en: But God is not against them, so I cannot speak against them either! The Lord has not asked for bad things to happen to these people. So I cannot do that either.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi tiligira. N ni zaɣisi Ijipti mini Itiɔpia ni Siiba, ka tiligi ya.
en: For I am the Lord your God, the holy God of Israel, who saves you. I will give up Egypt to set you free; I will give up Ethiopia and Seba.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai naa bia Abija.
en: At that time, Jeroboams son Abijah became sick.

dag: Zaŋmi kuɣ kara niŋ a nuu ni n-chaŋ ti zaŋ li pi bɛ ni zaŋ yaɣiri malimali duno shɛli bɛ ni doli kpɛri Firawuna yili shɛli din be Tapanhɛs maa la ni. Chɛ ka Judanim maa nya a ni piri li shɛm.
en: Take some large stones and set them in the clay pavement in front of Pharaohs palace in Tahpanhes while the people of Judah are watching.

dag: Aristakus ŋun be sarika ni pahi n zuɣu ŋɔ mini Maak ŋun nyɛ Baanabas ŋahiŋga la puhiri ya. Yi pun wum di ni simd ni yi niŋ o shɛm; ka o yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o.
en: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, says hello to you. So does Mark, Barnabas cousin .

dag: Nyamiya, yinim bɛn be vinvamli ni ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn be bɔpiɛligu ni ŋɔ, m mini ya mali zabili. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa. Yinim bɛn yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi siɣina ti liri ti? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kpe ti sɔɣisili shee ŋɔ na.
en: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord , am angry.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Ifriimnima? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Judanima? Yi yurilim ŋmanila asiba sagbaŋ, di ŋmanila maligim din bi yuuri ka kpahiri luri la.
en: Ephraim, what will I do with you? Judah, what will I do with you? Your love is like a morning cloud, like the dew that vanishes quickly.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Makɛda n-gari chaŋ Libina ti liri Libinanima.
en: After this, Joshua and his army went on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal nti naai bɛ birili n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: I will bring war, famine, and disease against them. I will attack them until they have all been killed. Then they will no longer be on the land that I gave to them and to their ancestors.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi nti tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: The Pharisees went out and met in order to find a way to destroy Jesus.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: When it was evening, Jesus and the twelve disciples sat down to eat.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni; dama yi puu biɛri n zuɣu.
en: Saul told them: You've done me a big favor, and I pray that the Lord will bless you.

dag: Ka na palo daa ti di Ijipti, ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu.
en: Many years later a new king came to power. He did not know what Joseph had done for Egypt.

dag: Naawuni yila Tɛman na. Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yila Paran Zoli zuɣu na. Ka o jilima pili zuɣusaa. Ka o paɣibu pali dunia zaa.
en: God comes from Teman and the holy one from the mountain of Paran. Selah His majesty covers the heavens and his praise fills the earth.

dag: Zaŋmi gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinii ni anii, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make an acacia-wood table, three feet long, eighteen inches wide, and twenty-seven inches high.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kaɣili fiɛb o zuɣu ni, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka damdir o tooni puhir o.
en: They kept on beating his head with a stick and spitting on him. Then they bowed down on their knees and pretended to honor him as a king.

dag: Dauda ni daa yi Hiburɔn na nyaaŋa o daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi, ka bo mamanim pahi, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pah o.
en: After moving from Hebron to Jerusalem, David took more concubines and wives, and had more sons and daughters.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya n kpe m puu maa ni. N laɣim n tulaalɛnim mini mɛɛr. N di n shigbana shiri. N nyu n wain ni m bihim. Zɔrinima, dimiya ka nyu, n yurinima, nyumiya yurilim hal ti buɣi.
en: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Eat and drink until you are drunk with love.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti paai piɛri biɛhigu shee ka tampiŋ voli daa be nimaani so naŋgbanyee; ka Sool daa kpe di puuni ni o ti damdi yɔɣu ni ka Dauda min o niriba gba daa be voli maa puuni ha.
en: He came to a cave close to some sheep pens by the road and went in to relieve himself. It happened to be the very cave in which David and his men were hiding far back in the cave.

dag: Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba maa zuɣulana; ŋuna n-daa lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su luɣ kasi shee la.
en: The head chief over the chiefs of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest. He was supervisor over those performing the duties of the sanctuary.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka o daa lan lab Naawuni jɛmbu duu yaha; ka niriba daa laɣim o sanna, ka o ʒini gbaai ba wuhibu.
en: Early in the morning he went back to the Temple area. The people all came to him, and he sat and taught them.

dag: Bɛ yila dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa na. Yawɛ zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina na ni o ti saɣim dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha, Ŋunkam deeri ya deerila mani, ka ŋunkam deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na.
en: Whoever welcomes you welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N ku dol a kuli bee n-kpe a yiŋa bee n-di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: I can't go back with you, the prophet replied, and I can't eat or drink anything with you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli wuhibu daa be o nol ni, ka galimi yɛtɔɣa daa ka o nol ni. O daa kul doli ma mi ni nimmaŋtali mini biɛrisuntali, ka daa yihi niriba pam tuumbiɛri tumbu ni.
en: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa pie taba kulis anahi. Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni;.
en: Then the workers put four rows of beautiful jewels on the judgment pouch. The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and a beryl.

dag: Di simdi ni nir siɣis omaŋ Naawuni tooni ;.
en: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka gom gbaai doo maa pam, o ni daa gbihiri saha shɛli maa, ka o daa yih o sapir kɔb yini ka daai nimaani nimdi ŋari;.
en: So the LORD God put the human into a deep and heavy sleep, and took one of his ribs and closed up the flesh over it.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu, ka n suhu kul yu a zaligu.
en: LORD, I long for your saving help! Your Instruction is my joy!.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm mali ba kasi m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋm ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la mihi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ pini bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri zaa, ka paɣi bɛ situra m-mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.

dag: Asa ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahiyinika o nam maa ni saha shɛli, ka naba polo dɔro daa gbaag o, ka o dɔro maa daa muɣis o pam; amaa dɔro maa ni daa muɣis o maa zaa yoli, o daa bi suhi Yawɛ, amaa ka naɣ dolila timanim bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Asas feet became infected in his th year as king. Even though the infection was very serious, Asa did not go to the Lord for help. He went to the doctors instead.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti pii din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, chɛliya ka ti maŋmaŋ lihi n-nya din viɛla.
en: So let us test these arguments and decide for ourselves what is right. Together we will learn what is good.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yum ayi saha ka o daa ti zahim zahindi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔŋ gom.
en: During the second year that Nebuchadnezzar was king, he had such horrible nightmares that he could not sleep.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti dolila yɛlimaŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: Thats how we know we belong to the way of truth. And when our hearts make us feel guilty, we can still have peace before God, because God is greater than our hearts. He knows everything.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ti yɛn kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu la zali di zaani la, di dabisa ti yɛn nyɛla biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛi.
en: There will be , days from the time that the daily sacrifices are stopped, until someone sets up the Horrible Thing that causes destruction.

dag: Amaa n daa zo ba nambɔɣu, ka daa bi ku ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bee n-kpihim bɛ birili.
en: But I had too much compassion to destroy them, so I didnt put an end to them in the desert.

dag: Yawɛ, ti garigim a muɣisigu nyabu dali! Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ni gul a.
en: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.

dag: Ka ti dimnim maa daa yɛli, Bɛ ku baŋ bee n-nya binshɛli pɔi, ka ti kana ti liri ba ku ba, ka tuma maa zani tariga.
en: And our enemies are saying, Before the Jews know it or see us, we will be right there among them. We will kill them and that will stop the work.

dag: Naawuni m-mi di shee, ka mi di soli ni be shɛli.
en: God understands her way; he knows her place.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la daa yiɣisi Dauda tiŋ la ni n-kul omaŋmaŋ yil shɛli Sulemaana ni daa me n-ti o la ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa me ŋ-ŋari luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Millo la.
en: Solomon filled in the land on the east side of the city, after his wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, had moved from David's City to the palace Solomon built for her.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Yawɛ duu maa gbini Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ puuni daŋ kam zuɣulaannim shɛb daa tila pina din yi bɛ suhuyubu ni na ni bɛ zaŋ li n-sɔŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: When they arrived at the LORDs house in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families brought spontaneous gifts for the rebuilding of Gods house on its site.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni chaɣisanima ni feensi ni dawulɛnim n-wari wahi ni bɛ yaa zaa ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: Meanwhile, David and the entire house of Israel celebrated in the LORDs presence with all their strength, with songs, zithers, harps, tambourines, rattles, and cymbals.

dag: Tiŋgbani damdila bɛ tooni; ka sagbana sɔhira. Ka wuntaŋ mini goli niŋ zim, ka saŋmarisi gba bi lan ne.
en: Before them, earth and sky shake. The sun and the moon become dark, and the stars stop shining.

dag: Saɣimi ti Naawuni, ka tim sandaani niŋ o, ka bin viɛla lan ka a sanna.
en: Get along well with God and be at peace; from this something good will come to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: So that is what has happened here. The Lord made your prophets lie to you. The Lord himself decided to bring this disaster to you.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni palila ʒiŋmabo. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu. Naawuni ni ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ maligu bimbina maa, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila maa.
en: The people whose hearts are deceitful must now suffer for their sins. God will break down their altars and destroy their sacred pillars.

dag: ka yim zuɣu be nayili, ka yim zuɣu mi be tanzaa dunɔdal la gbini. Ka zama zaa mi kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: And one-third of you will be at the kings palace, and one-third of you will be at the Foundation Gate. But all the other people will stay in the yards of the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be tiŋ maa ni mini bɛn daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza la ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn zaa pahi kuli.
en: He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ifriimnim gba kpɛla buɣ jɛmbo ni, chɛliya ba.
en: The people of Israel are under the spell of idols. Let them go their own way.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: He made carrying poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold.

dag: Ka o daa mali nti kpe yil shɛli, ka zoomba maa dol o kpe; ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi niŋ yɛda ni n ni tooi niŋ yi ni bɔri shɛli maa? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: When Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came to him, and he asked them, Do you believe that I can heal you? Yes, sir! they answered.

dag: ka hal malaikanim bɛn mali yaa mini kpiɔŋ gari karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ bi doli ʒiɛmbu soli fiɣisiri bɛn mali jilima maa ti Duuma sani.
en: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.

dag: Dama a piɛma nyɔɣ ma n-kpe nti lim, ka a zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma.
en: You have hurt me. You punished me and hurt me deeply.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka oki tihi laani ginda, ka chɛ ka nyɔŋ tihi vari suu. Ka bɛnkam zaa be o jɛmbu duu puuni yɛli, Timiya Naawuni jilima.
en: The LORDs voice convulses the oaks, strips the forests bare, but in his temple everyone shouts, Glory.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi zaɣisi li o ni wum di yɛla saha shɛli maa, dindina yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam din yi o nol ni na zaŋ chaŋ o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ku zani; o yidan ni zaɣisi li maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a zaligunim soya, ka n dol li hal ni di tariga.
en: Teach me, Lord , the meaning of your laws, and I will obey them at all times.

dag: O chɛ ka n niŋgbuŋ nya wahala, ka kabi n kɔba.
en: He wore out my flesh and my skin; he broke my bones.

dag: O daa yihi ba bumbɔni mini zibisim ni, ka kabi bɛ bandi.
en: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.

dag: Amaa o daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom di Ijipti naa min o tɔbbihi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: And tossed Pharaoh and his army into the Reed Sea— Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa ʒii buta, ka zaŋ kikahi mini firilanim ni be duɣubihi shɛŋa ni ti bɛ zaa.
en: He divided his three hundred men into three groups and gave each man a trumpet and a jar with a torch inside it.

dag: Dama m mi ni n tiligira nyɛla ŋun be, o nyɛla ŋun kul ni ti bahi ka dunia ni na.
en: I know that there is someone to defend me and that he lives! And in the end, he will stand here on earth and defend me.

dag: ni bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛlahi gban shɛŋa ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: rams skins dyed red; beaded leather; acacia wood.

dag: Ka nahiŋgu mini wahala ni suhugarigu daa ti chɛ ka bɛ filim.
en: But when they do diminish— when theyre brought down by oppression, trouble, and grief.

dag: Amaa o yi bi paɣ o situra bee n-su kom, o taali maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.

dag: Nimdi din shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi bi simdi ni bɛ ŋub li. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be kasi ni tooi ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi.
en: People must not eat any of the meat that touches anything unclean. They must burn this meat in the fire. Whoever is clean may eat the meat from the fellowship offering.

dag: Mbayooi! Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni tim na.
en: Hey! What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are. You are the holy one from God.

dag: Bihi, wummiya yi ba wuhibu, wummiya li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi nya tɛhi zilima.
en: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ɛdom zoli polo, n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce the country of Edom.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ niŋ a niriba fitiina, ka nahim a ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: They crush your own people, LORD! They abuse your very own possession.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Zaŋm Lɛvinim zali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa zaani, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi zali Izraɛlnim niɣi zaani, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.

dag: Sool daa bela zoli maa yaɣi yini polo, ka Dauda min o niriba mi be yaɣi din la polo, ka Dauda daa kpaŋ zɔri yomyom ni o yi Sool nuu ni saha shɛli Sool ni daa ti chɛ ŋun Dauda min o niriba maa kpe ni kpe ni o gbahi ba la.
en: Saul was going around a hill on one side, and David and his men were on the other side, trying to get away. Saul and his soldiers were just about to capture David and his men.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri lala saha shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan, ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Abiata bia la dii paana. Ka Adɔnija yɛl o, Kpɛmina, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka ʒiri lahiba suŋ na.
en: While he was still speaking, Jonathan, Abiathar the priests son, arrived. Adonijah said, Come on in! You are an honest man and will bring a good report.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya daa sabi pa binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ tabili maa zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Hakalia bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la, mini Zɛdɛkia ni.
en: These are the names on the sealed agreement: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah. Zedekiah.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim maa daa yɛli Dauda, Anzinfa bee salima din pala din ni mali ti mini Sool ni o zuliya maa yɛlli maa, di mi pala ti bɔrimi ni ti ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ so. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: The Gibeonites said to David, There isnt enough gold and silver for Sauls family to pay for what they did. But we dont have the right to kill anyone else in Israel. David said, Well, what can I do for you.

dag: Dama o yurilim maŋli la galisiya pam zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka o ʒiɛyimtali kul ni beni sahakam. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka Naa Jɔash mini niriba lo Yawɛ alikauli ni bɛ ni nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ niriba; ka lan chɛ ka niriba maa mini naa gba lo tab alikauli.
en: Jehoiada then made a covenant between the LORD, the king, and the people, that the people would belong to the LORD. The king and the people also made a covenant.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna ti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason.

dag: Ti daa ʒinila tiŋa Babilɔn mɔɣa duli. Nimaani ka ti daa ʒini kum, saha shɛli ti ni daa teei Ziɔn yɛla.
en: We sat by the rivers in Babylon and cried as we remembered Zion.

dag: Di chɛliya ka wuhibu balibubalibu mini wuhibu kɔŋkɔba din be di ko la birigi ya; di niŋ kamaata ni ti nya suhukpaŋsibo la Naawuni daanfaani puuni, ka pa ni bindira chihibu din bi sɔŋdi bɛn doli di wuhibu sol la.
en: Do not let all kinds of strange teachings lead you from the right way. It is good to receive inner strength from God's grace, and not by obeying rules about foods; those who obey these rules have not been helped by them.

dag: Ka naa maa mini Juda kpamba ni Jɛrusalɛmnim maa zaa zaŋ tabili maligumaaniba mini anabinim ni sokam zaa ni wɔɣira ni tarimba zaa daa chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka o ti karim Naawuni zaligu kundi shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ka bɛ wum.
en: Then he went to the Lord 's temple, together with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, the priests, and the prophets. Finally, when everybody was there, he read aloud The Book of God's Law that had been found in the temple.

dag: Bɛ wahala maa puuni ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: Then in their trouble they called to the Lord , and he saved them from their distress.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka suhukpeeni din ni zaŋ bɛmaŋ gari bɛ ni, amaa ka daa lee tiri ba jilima pam.
en: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛla ba yaha, Dinzuɣu di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: So dont be afraid of those people. Everything that is hidden will be shown. Everything that is secret will be made known.

dag: O pun yɛli nyin daadam binshɛli din viɛla. Ka bɔ ka Yawɛ lee bɔri ni a niŋ? O bɔri ni a doli din tuhi, ka yuri nirilim niŋbu, ka jɛmd a Naawuni ni siɣisimaŋtali.
en: No, the Lord has told us what is good. What he requires of us is this: to do what is just, to show constant love, and to live in humble fellowship with our God.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi ni o kar o naba ti balim o zaŋ o lab o yiŋa. Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋla o tumtumda pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ buns ayi chaŋ. Ka o daa mali ti paari paɣ maa ba yiŋa, ka paɣ maa ba maa nya o ka chaŋ ti tuh o soli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: her husband decided to try and talk her into coming back. So he went to Bethlehem, taking along a servant and two donkeys. He talked with his wife, and she invited him into her family's home. Her father was glad to see him.

dag: M bela n dimnim bɛn be kaman gbuɣima bɛn ŋubiri ninsalinim la sunsuuni. Bɛ nyina ŋmanila kpana mini piɛma; ka bɛ zilima mi ŋmani takɔbiri din diri pam.
en: I am surrounded by enemies, who are like lions hungry for human flesh. Their teeth are like spears and arrows; their tongues are like sharp swords.

dag: Bɛna nti yɛn be laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tooni n-tumdi tuma tir o mini niriba maa zaa ka tumdi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la gba tuma.
en: They shall do the work required for the Tent of my presence and perform duties for the priests and for the whole community.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili puuni ka a daa no tiŋgbani. A sujee puuni ka a daa du n-tam zuliya shɛb zuɣu no ba.
en: You marched across the earth in anger; in fury you trampled the nations.

dag: Yi yi da Yɛhudia nira ka o leei dabili, o ni tum yi tuma yuma ayɔbu, ka yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, di simdi ka yi chɛ ka o chaŋ yoli, ka ku yo shɛli.
en: When you buy a male Hebrew slave, he will serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he will go free without any payment.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu paɣirila ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mini ba bi tuhira.
en: Those who refuse to obey the law promote evil. Those who obey the law oppose evil.

dag: Ka do so daa nya o ka yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, n nyala Absalom ka o yili oki tia zuɣu.
en: and one of them went and told Joab, I saw Absalom hanging in a tree.

dag: Pa ti zuɣu ka o yɛl lala maa? Ti zuɣu ka di shiri sabi yɛl lala maa, dama ŋun kɔri mini ŋun buri chi zaa malila tahima yini, dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ laɣim di puu maa atam.
en: He was really talking about us. Yes, that was written for us. The one who plows and the one who separates the grain should both expect to get some of the grain for their work.

dag: Ti daa chaŋmi ti ŋme Nɛgɛb din nyɛ Chɛrɛtinim tiŋ ka be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka di bɛ nɛma. Ka ti daa lan chaŋ ti ŋme Nɛgɛb shɛli din nyɛ Kalɛb daŋ niriba tiŋ la gba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka nyo Zikilag yiya zaa buɣim.
en: We had attacked the Negev area where the Kerethites live. We also attacked Judah and the Negev area where Calebs people live. We burned Ziklag.

dag: Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda; di mi bi miri gumdi. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: Notice how the lilies grow. They dont wear themselves out with work, and they dont spin cloth. But I say to you that even Solomon in all his splendor wasnt dressed like one of these.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka saa miri ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli mini tiŋgban nɛli ni din nyɛ daadamnim ni ka luɣ shɛli?.
en: Who makes it rain even in desert places where no one lives?.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ so n ni doli ŋɔ ni chɛ ka a min o malaika doli chaŋ, ka ti a nasara ka a kpuɣi paɣa n yaannim ya ni n dɔɣiriba sanna ti ti m bia maa.
en: He said to me, The LORD, whom Ive traveled with everywhere, will send his messenger with you and make your trip successful; and you will choose a wife for my son from my relatives and from my fathers household.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim daa tim Giligal sansan la ni ti yɛli Jɔshua, Di chɛ tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ bahi. Kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ti tiligi ti; dama Amɔri nanim zaa bɛn be zoya polo tinsi la ni laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi kana ti teei gili Gibiɔn n-doya ni bɛ tuhi ti.
en: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry.

dag: Yisa ni daa baŋ ni niriba maa loya ni bɛ gbaag o ni kiŋkansi ti leei bɛ naa maa, ka o daa ŋoli yi bɛ sunsuuni n-chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu m-be nimaani o kɔŋko.
en: Jesus understood that they were about to come and force him to be their king, so he took refuge again, alone on a mountain.

dag: Zaŋm a yɛla niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka chɛ ka o tilig a. Chɛ ka o fa o nini ni tiɣi so bahi.
en: He committed himself to the LORD, so let God rescue him; let God deliver him because God likes him so much.

dag: Niriba maa kul bela nimaani kuhira, amaa ka o bi garigi ba, bɛ karimbaani mini bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: They cry for help, but God doesn't answer, for they are proud and evil.

dag: A yi nyɛ yɛndana, nyini n-yɛn di a yɛm maa nyɔri, a mi yi maani ansarisi, a kɔŋko n-yɛn di wahala.
en: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili zani. Zaŋmiya yɛlimaŋli leei shɛlɔriti lo yi shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ wuntitali leei yi nyɔtaɣirisi;.
en: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ, dama a zaŋ ma leei naa ni n su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi ka taŋkpaɣu ŋɔ.
en: Now, LORD God, let your promise to my father David be fulfilled because you have made me king over a people as numerous as the earths dust.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Mbo, di viɛla, garim ka ti chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Naawuni nir maa ni daa be tiŋ maa ni luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Saul said to the boy, Great idea! Lets go. So they went into the town where the man of God lived.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi gba daa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti mi lee yɛn niŋ? Ka o yɛli ba, Di muɣisiriya niriba bee n-diri shɛhir kpɛma fari bɛ nɛma; ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣimi yi yɔri.
en: Soldiers asked, What about us? What should we do? He answered, Dont cheat or harass anyone, and be satisfied with your pay.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi tɔbu kikaa, o kumdimi ni suhupiɛlli. Tɔbu yi be katiŋa, o taɣirila di ʒiɛɣu, ka wumdi sapashin kpamba ni tahira kaman saa tahigu la.
en: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.

dag: M bela Yawɛ tooni chani nyɛvilinim tiŋgban ni.
en: so Ill walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

dag: Nyama, o garitila n sani, ka m bi nyar o; o chana, amaa ka m bi mi ni o beni.
en: If God goes by me, I cant see him; he glides past, and I cant perceive him.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa damdi tiŋa n-jɛm Daniɛl, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm pina mini tulaale viɛlli na ti mal o maligu.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar bowed to the ground and gave orders for sacrifices and offerings to be made to Daniel.

dag: Ka Maluk daa nyɛ Hashabia bia, ka Hashabia nyɛ Amazia bia, ka Amazia nyɛ Hilikia bia.
en: Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah.

dag: ni Atirɔtishɔfan ni Jaza ni Jɔgbɛha.
en: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Gaad zuliya paya. Gaad niriba maa toondan n-yɛn nyɛ Riuɛl bia Ɛliasaf.
en: The tribe of Gad will also camp next to the tribe of Reuben. The leader of the tribe of Gad is Eliasaph son of Deuel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Lakishinim niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme n-deei li dabisi shɛli din pah ayi dali, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Libinanim shɛm la.
en: The LORD gave Lachish into the power of Israel. Joshua captured it on the second day. With a sword, he struck it and everyone in it without mercy, just exactly as he had done to Libnah.

dag: Iso daa kpuɣila Keenan paɣiba. Bɛ yuya n-nyɛ: Ada ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛlɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir bipuɣiŋga la mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn ŋun nyɛ Hivi nir bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Esau married Canaanite women: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite; Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah son of Zibeon the Hivite;.

dag: Di saha ka buɣim daa yi Yawɛ sanna ti di ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu bɛn daa tuɣili tulaale zim maa.
en: Then fire went out from the LORD and consumed the two hundred fifty men offering incense.

dag: Dama n wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛra, Dabiɛm kul bela luɣilikam. Zaɣisimiy o, chɛliya ka ti zaɣis o. N zɔsimnim kul guhirimi ni n tuui lu, ka yɛra, Di pa shɛli ti ni kpɛh o kɔre n-nyaŋ o, ka bɔh o biɛri.
en: I heard the crowds whisper, Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah! All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka n ni zaŋ n yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suh o suhigu shɛli mini n ni suhi binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yɛla be o suhu ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa; ka zo mani ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ min o niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: I pray that the Lord our God will always remember this prayer and what I have asked. I pray that he will do these things for his servant, the king, and for his people, Israel. I pray that he will do this every day.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye binyoya jɛmbu mini din chihiri tumbu zuɣu la, n ni chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ŋmaligi lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: As for those whose hearts continue to go after their disgusting and detestable things, I will hold them accountable for their ways. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Nyini n-nam nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo; Tabo Zoli mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli paɣir a yuli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The mountains Tabor and Hermon shout praises to your name.

dag: Di zaŋya bindira dibu yɛla saɣim Naawuni tuma. Binshɛli kani n-chihiri dibu, amaa di nyɛla taali ni so chɛ ka o ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka o tab lu.
en: Do not, because of food, destroy what God has done. All foods may be eaten, but it is wrong to eat anything that will cause someone else to fall into sin.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, amaa ka daari ninvuɣ biɛri luhira.
en: The Lord supports the humble, but he shames the wicked.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni so yi ni tooi saɣim n ni lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli shɛl la, ka biɛɣu ku lan neei bee ka yuŋ ku lan zibi n ni zal li saha shɛli maa.
en: I have made a covenant with the day and with the night, so that they always come at their proper times; and that covenant can never be broken.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Nyamiya, n lɔrila nia ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu yi daŋ ŋɔ niriba zuɣu, ka yi ku tooi yi di ni, ka yi mi ku lan tooi chaŋ karimbaan chandi, dama di ti yɛn nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu saha.
en: But here is what the Lord says: I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa ti nya ka Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so ti Ibrahimma la min o bia Yisahaku diɛmda.
en: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, ŋun pah ata n-daa nyɛ Jahaziɛl, ŋun pah anahi n-daa nyɛ Jɛkamiam.
en: Hebrons family: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

dag: Nyama, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na, nyin zaŋm mi ʒiɛ shɛl a ni zaŋ tiri takɔro ni ka ti dol li yina ŋɔ n-lo a yiŋ maa takɔro maa, ka laɣim a ba min a ma ni a mabihi ni a ba yiŋnim zaa na nti niŋ a yiŋ maa ni.
en: unless, when we come into the land, you tie this red woven cord in the window through which you lowered us. Gather your father, your mother, your brothers, and your whole family into the house with you.

dag: Goma bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Difat ni Tɔgarima.
en: The descendants of Gomer were the people of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: Nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi nyɛla yɔhiŋ, ka viɛlim nyɛ din naara, amaa paɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu.
en: Charm is deceptive and beauty disappears, but a woman who honors the Lord should be praised.

dag: Ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam kum shɛli din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa na maa zuɣu, dama kum maa ni ti mii pam.
en: No one will remember the abundance in the land because the famine that follows will be so very severe.

dag: N ni ti a niriba bɛn yɛn ŋma dakuɣiri maa alikama biɛlim din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi ni wain lita tuhi kɔbisinahi ni olivi kpam lita tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: I will pay the woodcutters twenty thousand kors of crushed wheat, twenty thousand kors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of olive oil.

dag: Ka Dauda yɛl o, A ʒim yihibu taali ʒi a zuɣu, dama amaŋmaŋ noli n-di a shɛhira yɛli, Mani n-ku Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so maa. .
en: and David said to the Amalekite, You brought this on yourself. You condemned yourself when you confessed that you killed the one whom the Lord chose to be king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi pam m-bɔhi, Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Naawuni Bia? A kamina ni a ti nahim ti ka saha na bi paai.
en: At once they screamed, What do you want with us, you Son of God? Have you come to punish us before the right time.

dag: Nyama, di pun sabimi ʒiɛya n sani, m bi yɛn shini, amaa n ni darigi bɛ tibili.
en: I have already decided on their punishment, and their sentence is written down. I will not overlook what they have done, but will repay them.

dag: Dama di sabiya, Yinim Yɛhudianim zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kul ʒiɛmdi Naawuni yuli.
en: As the Scriptures say, People in other nations insult God because of you.

dag: Ka zoya daa sɔhigi nyin Yawɛ tooni, nyin ŋun daa yi zahira Sinai Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ, nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni tooni ka di daa sɔhigi maa.
en: The mountains quaked before the Lord of Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ŋunkam doli wuntitali soli ni be, amaa ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri ni kpi.
en: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.

dag: N ni be a tooni, ka dahim zoya ti a. N ni kabi daanya dunoya ti a, ka kabi dunoya ni kuriti ti a.
en: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ka n sanna nti zani baɣili ma ka yɛli, M mabia Sool, a nina maa neema! Ka n nina naa daa dii neei di saha maa, ka n nya o.
en: He came to me and said, Saul, my friend, you can now see again! At once I could see.

dag: Yi ŋmanila mɔɣu ni buŋa ŋun be tiŋgban nɛli ni. O yi ti kpabigi, o ʒiɛmi taɣiri ʒiɛɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yih o kɔre maa ni? Bɛnkam bɔr o bi lan yɛn nahim bɛmaŋa, o bɔbu goli yi zani, bɛ ni nya o.
en: You are like a wild donkey that lives in the desert. At mating time, she sniffs the wind. No one can control her when she is in heat. At mating time, every male that wants her will get her. She is easy to find.

dag: Ka Jɔbab daa ti kpi, ka Husham ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛmannim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni, Gidiɔni bia Abidan n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Benjamin, Abidan, Gideonis son.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, dolimi Ishimail nyɛvili.
en: To God Abraham said, If only you would accept Ishmael.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku pirigi ka chɛ ka bɛ siɣi di ni gari, o daa chɛ ka kom laɣim ti dɔni kaman kunkuni la.
