en: God split the sea and led them through, making the waters stand up like a wall.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn daa mali kikah ayopɔin la niŋ shili ni bɛ piɛb bɛ kikahi maa.
en: Then the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to blow them.

dag: Ka nabihi kukoya daa fo, ka bɛ kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: the voices of officials were hushed, their tongue stuck to their palate.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin di dabisa maa ni. Di bi simdi ka yi chɛ ka so nya dabindi bɔrɔbɔro yi sani yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: Only unleavened bread should be eaten for seven days. No leavened bread and no yeast should be seen among you in your whole country.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Gaza ti nya pagɔr so nimaani ka o kɔre kpe o ni, ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: One day Samson traveled to Gaza. While there, he saw a prostitute and had sex with her.

dag: O daa lan me buɣa jɛmbu shee zali Juda fɔŋ kam ni, n-tuɣindi tulaale zim n-tiri buɣa, ka di daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la suhu yiɣisi.
en: In every town in Judah Ahaz made high places for burning incense to worship other gods. Ahaz made the Lord , the God his ancestors obeyed, very angry.

dag: Di saha ka zuliya bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn gili ya la zaa ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali luɣ shɛŋa din daa wurim maa me, ka labi biri luɣ shɛŋa din daa leei tiŋgban nɛl la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka ni niŋ li.
en: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord , make this promise.

dag: Naawuni yino m-beni, ka sandaantimda yino kɔŋko mi m-be Naawuni mini salinim sunsuuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ daadam.
en: For there is one God, and there is one who brings God and human beings together, the man Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka binshɛɣukam din mali daɣiri ti ku kpe tiŋ maa ni bee ŋunkam tumdi din chihiri bee ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri, amaa kulla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya sab Piɛbil maa nyɛvili litaafi la ni kɔŋko nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Dauda ni man Yawɛ yɛliya ni bini diba ata ka n zal o, ni o piimi di ni zaɣ yini ka n niŋ li ti o.
en: Go and tell David, This is what the Lord says: There are three ways you can be punished. Choose the one you want.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na ʒi n-yɛli noli ti Yisa, ka so mi ku tooi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla o Duuma, ka pa ni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: So I tell you that no one who is speaking with the help of Gods Spirit says, Jesus be cursed. And no one can say, Jesus is Lord, without the help of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma ti niriba ŋɔ bee n-kum bee n-zani bɛ zaani suhi ma, dama bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma bɛ muɣisigu saha, n ku garigi ba.
en: Jeremiah, don't pray to me or plead with me on behalf of these people. When they are in trouble and call to me for help, I will not listen to them.

dag: Ka Nɔba daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei Kɛnat mini di tiŋkpansi, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli Nɔba boli tinsi maa.
en: Nobah attacked and captured Kenath and its villages, and he renamed it Nobah, after himself.

dag: Kɛlub ŋun daa nyɛ Shuha mabia la daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Mɛhir. Mɛhir maa n-daa nyɛ Ɛshitɔn ba.
en: Chelub, Shuhahs brother, was the father of Mehir, who was Eshtons father.

dag: Amaa ka putɔɣulaannim mini ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa pahi doli Dauda chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti bi yɛn ti ba ti ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa ŋɔ shɛli, naɣila bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ka ti ni zaŋ ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ, dama bɛ daa bi dol ti chaŋ.
en: There were some troublemakers in the group who went with David who started complaining, These men didnt go with us, so why should we give them any of the things we took. These men get nothing but their own wives and children.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Judah—Nahshon son of Amminadab;.

dag: Malikiram ni Pɛdaya ni Shɛnaza ni Jɛkamia ni Hɔshama ni Nɛdabia.
en: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

dag: Ka din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li ni suhupiɛlli, amaa ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka zahimbu yi ti paai ba, bɛ zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who gladly hear the message and accept it. But they don't have deep roots, and they believe only for a little while. As soon as life gets hard, they give up.

dag: Gbuɣima ti ku be nimaani, biŋkɔb biɛɣu mi ti ku doli soli maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi kɔŋko nti yɛn dol li.
en: No lions will be there; no fierce animals will pass that way. Those whom the Lord has rescued will travel home by that road.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o daalibarika zuɣu ka o pii ba, dindina di pala bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu. Ka di yi nyɛla bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu, dindina alibarika maa naan ku lan nyɛla alibarika yaha.
en: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.

dag: So bi piiri maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima o tolitoli; kulla Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-piiri nir leeri maligumaaniba zuɣulana kaman o ni daa piig Aduna shɛm la.
en: To be a high priest is an honor. But no one chooses himself for this work. That person must be chosen by God just as Aaron was.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N loya ni n chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka n kpihim Judanim zaa birili.
en: Therefore, the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Im determined to bring disaster on you, to eliminate all of Judah.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Balak zaŋ Balaam du Bamɔtibaal din nyɛ luɣ shɛli din miri ka o ni tooi lihi nya Izraɛlnim maa viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, from where Balaam could see a part of the people of Israel.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Yisahaku zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba.
en: Isaac was the son of Abraham.

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka yɛli fiig tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: So the trees said to the fig tree, You come and be king over us.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa baŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni bebɔ? Ka bɛ saɣi, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: Then Jesus asked his followers, Do you understand all these things? They said, Yes, we understand.

dag: Tiŋ maa dunoya ti ku yɔri wuntaŋ ni, ka yuŋ mi ti ku zibiri nimaani.
en: Its gates will never be shut by day, and there will be no night there.

dag: Ŋun biriti omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla din poora niŋgbuŋ kɔre maa zuɣu; amaa ŋun biriti Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu, Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu.
en: If you plant in the field of your natural desires, from it you will gather the harvest of death; if you plant in the field of the Spirit, from the Spirit you will gather the harvest of eternal life.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa niŋ shɛhira ka tɔɣisi ti Duuma yɛligu naai maa ka bɛ daa doli Samaria tiŋkpansi pam chani yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-labiri kuni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then the two apostles told the people what they had seen Jesus do. They told them the message of the Lord. Then they went back to Jerusalem. On the way, they went through many Samaritan towns and told people the Good News.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔh o, Shihir bɔ ka a lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti ka di wuhi ni a mal soli ni a niŋ a ni niŋdi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Then the Jewish leaders asked him, By what authority are you doing these things? What miraculous sign will you show us.

dag: A mi dunia ŋɔ yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm? A yi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa, nyin yɛlim ma!.
en: Do you really understand how big the earth is? Tell me, if you know all this.

dag: Ka n garigi bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli ma, Man Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: I answered, Who are you, Lord? I am Jesus the Nazarene, whom you are harassing, he replied.

dag: Ninsalinim yi yɛn po pɔri, bɛ pɔrila ŋun gari ba; ka naŋgbankpeeni kam puuni, pɔri n-nyɛ din ŋmaari li.
en: When we make a vow, we use the name of someone greater than ourselves, and the vow settles all arguments.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. N daa kul timdila n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim la bɛ sani waawaayili, amaa ka yi gba zaɣisi wumbu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This will happen to them because they did not obey the message that I kept on sending to them through my servants the prophets. They refused to listen.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bikpamba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who struck down the Egyptians oldest offspring— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa garigi yɛl o, Din kariya, din kariya ka n saɣim bee n-wurim ya ŋɔ.
en: Joab answered, I would never, ever annihilate or destroy such a thing!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi ti ni ti paabuna ka niŋ ti nirilim pam, dama bɛ daa malila buɣim ti ti saa ni daa miri ka wari beni zuɣu.
en: The natives there were very friendly to us. It had started to rain and was cold, so they built a fire and made us all welcome.

dag: Yɛm viɛla, ka ŋmanila fali, ka niŋdi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni anfaani.
en: Everyone who lives ought to be wise; it is as good as receiving an inheritance.

dag: M pun zaŋ n naa maa ʒili Ziɔn din nyɛ n zo kasi la zuɣu.
en: He says, I have chosen this man to be king, and he will rule on Zion, my holy mountain.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o duhi ya, ka yi nyari paɣibu mini yudua ni jilima n-gari o ni nam zuliya shɛb zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ti niŋ zuliya kasi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: He will make you greater than any other nation that he has created, and you will bring praise and honor to his name. You will be his own people, as he promised.

dag: Kum maa ni daa ti mii Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa saha shɛli, ka niriba daa kuhiri niŋdi Firawuna ni o tim ba bindira. Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Ijiptinim zaa, Chamiya Yisifu sani, o yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛli, yin niŋmiya li.
en: When the famine ravaged the entire land of Egypt and the people pleaded to Pharaoh for bread, Pharaoh said to all of the Egyptians, Go to Joseph. Do whatever he tells you.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa kul o yiŋa ni sujee nti fo n-ʒiya, Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zuɣu. Dama o daa yɛl o mi, N ku zaŋ n yaannim fali bini ti a. Ka Naa Ɛhab dɔni o bindoo zuɣu ŋ-ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: So Ahab went home angry and upset because Naboth told him, I will not give you my familys land. Ahab went to bed, turned away from everyone, and refused to eat.

dag: ka o daa zaŋ ba siɣi kom din zilim pam ni du duli, ka bɛ naba daa be kaman yuri naba la ka bɛ bi sarigi.
en: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ pala din kpɛm pam yi sani bee din be katiŋ ha.
en: This commandment that Im giving you right now is definitely not too difficult for you. It isnt unreachable.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ lala, wula ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni shee lala niŋya la yɛn niŋ pali.
en: But it must happen this way to show the truth of what the Scriptures said.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yir o nyɛvoya ni na, ka buɣimniɛm din diri binyɛra yir o nol ni na; ka sala buɣimniɛm yir o sanna.
en: Smoke poured out of his nostrils, a consuming flame and burning coals from his mouth.

dag: Juda Naa Manaasa ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa, hal ka tum tuumbiɛri gari Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka chɛ ka Judanim jɛm o buɣa n-tum alahichi la zuɣu.
en: King Manasseh has done more disgusting things than the Amorites, and he has led my people to sin by forcing them to worship his idols.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di lihibu daa mali dabiɛm hal ka Anabi Musa ti yɛli, N ni sɔhirimi dabiɛm zuɣu.
en: The sight was so frightening that Moses said, Im terrified and shaking.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti niŋ Naa Ɛhab naŋgban malisim ka o chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad ka bɛ ti ku o? Ka ŋumbɔŋɔ yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The LORD said, Who will persuade Israels King Ahab so that he attacks Ramoth-gilead and dies there? There were several suggestions.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa ŋme binshɛɣukam din daa be palo ni luhi tiŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa. Ka daa lu n-fiɛri puri ni bimbilima zaa, ka da tihi luhi.
en: The storm destroyed everything in the fields in Egypt. The hail destroyed people, animals, and plants. The hail also broke all the trees in the fields.

dag: Ka n daa ti yiɣis asiba ni o mɔɣi, ka nya ka o kpimi. Amaa ka n daa lih o viɛnyɛliŋga asiba maa n-nya ka o pala m bi so n ni daa dɔɣi maa.
en: The next morning, when I woke up and was going to nurse my baby, I saw that it was dead. I looked at it more closely and saw that it was not my child.

dag: Amaa alɔbo maa ni daa pun ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi.
en: but it had already killed twenty-four thousand people.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni kaman a ni niŋ bɛ ba shɛm maa, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma, ka kpam booi bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni maa ni ti ba soli ka bɛ kul nyɛ maligumaaniba sahakam bɛ ʒiɛman ni.
en: Then anoint them, just as you anointed their father, so that they can serve me as priests. This anointing will make them priests for all time to come.

dag: Maliya biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi mali yolisim, amaa lee di zaŋya yi yolisim maa tumdi tuumbiɛri; kul maliyala biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi nyɛla Naawuni daba.
en: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, A ni nya kulisi ko shɛŋa ka pagɔrili la du n-ʒi di zuɣu la nyɛla salo bɛn yi niriba balibu pam ni mini zuliyanim pam ni ni tinzun yɛligu pam nim ni na.
en: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi, bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ. Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: After the flood Shem, Ham, and Japheth had many descendants.

dag: Ka fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Gibiɔn mini Rama ni Bɛrɔt.
en: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli n soya mini n zaligunima ni n fukumsi zalikpana la kaman a ba Dauda ni daa dol li shɛm la, dindina n ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: And I will give you a long life if you follow me and obey my laws and commands as your father David did.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara, ka daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu ka chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: He built an altar to the Lord there and offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire from heaven to burn the sacrifices on the altar.

dag: Doo ŋɔ daa bɔhim ti Duuma soli yɛla pam. O ni daa jɛmdi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisiri ka wuhiri Yisa yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa kulla Jɔn Baptaizira kom baptaizibu la yɛla kɔŋko ka o daa mi.
en: He also knew much about the Lord's Way, and he spoke about it with great excitement. What he taught about Jesus was right, but all he knew was John's message about baptism.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anu ni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi ni ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Juda fɔntinsi ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na zaa daa moli nolɔbo molo Yawɛ tooni.
en: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king, a fast was announced. All those who lived in the city of Jerusalem and everyone who had come into Jerusalem from the towns of Judah were supposed to fast before the Lord .

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Jɔab, dama Jɔab daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe Adɔnija nyaaŋa hal o ni daa bi ʒe Absalom ŋun nyaaŋa la zaa yoli. Ka ŋun Jɔab daa zo n-chaŋ Yawɛ Jɛmbu Duu nti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Joab heard what had happened. So he fled to the Tent of the Lord 's presence and took hold of the corners of the altar.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ ba niŋ Yisifu nuu ni ka o sɔŋdi ba. Ka bɛ daa be duu maa ni n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: They spent a long time in prison, and the official in charge of the palace guard, made Joseph their servant.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ kahig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi tuun shɛŋa din bi doli wuntia soli mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ninsalinim ni tumdi zuɣu wuhi, dama bɛ zaŋdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa guri yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di daa bi yuui ka Yisa chani tin shɛli din yuli booni Nain la; ka o nyaandoliba mini salo pam dol o.
en: A little later Jesus went to a city called Nain. His disciples and a great crowd traveled with him.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma nyɛla jɛmbu tuma mini ʒiʒibo.
en: This is the duty of the Gershonite clans for work and for carrying the load.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi deeri din simdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, wula ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini alahichinim bɛn ku deeri din simdi ba?.
en: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.

dag: A naɣ ni zaŋla a nina lihi nya ninvuɣ biɛri tibidarigibo.
en: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-deeri o ba saɣisigu, amaa ansarisimaana bi deeri zuɣu ni kpahibu.
en: A wise son listens to the discipline of his father, but a mocker doesnt listen to correction.

dag: Salo maa ni daa yi n-naai, ka o kpe nti gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu, ka o neei n-yiɣisi zani.
en: But as soon as the people had been put out, Jesus went into the girl's room and took hold of her hand, and she got up.

dag: Ka n nya malaika ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka o kuhiri pampam bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee simdi ni o tabigi bintabinda ŋɔ ka bɔɣi litaafi ŋɔ n-lihi di puuni.
en: And I saw a powerful angel, who called in a loud voice, Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋ hal ka o ti saɣi ka Amnɔn mini nabihi maa zaa daa dol o chaŋ.
en: But Absalom urged him until he sent Amnon and all the other princes. Then Absalom made a banquet fit for a king.

dag: O zaŋdi wahala n-fari bɛn be wahala ni bahira, ka zaŋdi nandahima n-yoori bɛ tiba.
en: God saves those who suffer by using their suffering. He uses their troubles to speak in a way that makes them listen.

dag: Ka o dii boli bɛ gba, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ ba Zɛbidii min o tumtumdiba ŋariŋ maa ni ka dol o.
en: As soon as Jesus saw them, he called them; they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and went with Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛli daa bol o, M bia Samuɛl. Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But Eli said to Samuel, Samuel, my son. Samuel answered, Yes, sir.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni daa kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa ni sujee mini suhuyiɣisili pam la, n ni yihi ba nimaani n-zaŋ ba labisi kpe na nti chɛ ka bɛ ʒiya ni alaafee.
en: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.

dag: Ka Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi daa nyaɣi lɔɣiri ba yuri n-zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi kana. Ka Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi mi daa gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: Elam carried the quiver with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

dag: Aduna bidib shɛb bɛ ni daa pii ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni ni bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi tuma maligumaana tuma duu yuya m-bala.
en: These are the names of Aarons sons, who are the anointed priests and ordained to the priesthood.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli Musa, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni niŋ nyini ti dan ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.

dag: Ti tumdi din yiɣisiri ti Duuma suhu, ka o zabiri nyuli di zuɣu? Ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o?.
en: Or do we want to make the Lord jealous? Do we think that we are stronger than he?.

dag: O daa lan nyo tindaannim kɔba buɣim bɛ bimbina zuɣu, ka daa yihi Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm daɣiri ni.
en: Josiah then had the bones of the pagan priests burned on the altars. And so Josiah got rid of the worship of foreign gods in Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli salo pah o nyaandoliba zuɣu na nti yɛli ba, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Then Jesus called the crowd and his followers to him. He said, Any of you who want to be my follower must stop thinking about yourself and what you want. You must be willing to carry the cross that is given to you for following me.

dag: Yi vihiri Naawuni Kundi, dama yi tɛhiya ni di ni ka yi ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka Naawuni Kundi maa maŋmaŋ gba diri ma shɛhira.
en: You carefully study the Scriptures. You think that they give you eternal life. These same Scriptures tell about me!.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhu yɛmi ni n tumla a yubu, a zaligu be n suhu ni.
en: I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart. .

dag: N firila baɣiri ni, ka n naba ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu kani, m paala kɔbulli ni, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri ma garita.
en: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.

dag: Yawɛ, a vihi ma m-baŋ ma zaa.
en: Lord , you have tested me, so you know all about me.

dag: Ka Stiivin garigi yɛli, M banim mini m mabihi, wummiya! Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka na bi yiɣisi looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ daa yi o zuɣu.
en: Stephen answered, Brothers and fathers, listen to me! Before our ancestor Abraham had gone to live in Haran, the God of glory appeared to him in Mesopotamia.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha mini tiŋgban ni; dina n-nyɛ: ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi din tuɣiri sagbana ni.
en: I will work wonders in the sky and on the earth. There will be blood, fire, and thick smoke.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Judanim tum alahichi n ninni. Bɛ zaŋ din chihiri kpe n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛl la ni n-ta li daɣiri.
en: The people of Judah have done what displeases me, declares the LORD. They have corrupted the temple that bears my name by setting up their disgusting idols.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Wummi niriba maa ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa, dama pa nyini ka bɛ zaɣisi, amaa mani ka bɛ zaɣisi ni n di lan nyɛ bɛ naa maa.
en: The Lord answered: Samuel, do everything they want you to do. I am really the one they have rejected as their king.

dag: Ka Musa daa ti bɔhi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu bua la yɛla, ka nya ka bɛ pun zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka o suhu yiɣisi bahi Ɛliɛza mini Itama bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim maa zuɣu ka o bɔhi ba.
en: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said.

dag: Ti jɛmbu duu maa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee din mali jilima, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa pun duhi shɛli piligu ni ha.
en: Our Lord , your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiy o, Tɔbbi so ŋun na lɔri kpara bi simdi ka o nyuri bara kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lɔrigi kpara ni nyuri bara shɛm. .
en: Then Israels king replied, The one who prepares for battle shouldnt brag like one returning from battle.

dag: Ka banima n-daa lee ku Naawuni suli yuun pihinahi puuni la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa tum alahichi ka kpi n-do yɔɣu ni la?.
en: And with whom was God angry for forty years? Wasnt it with the ones who sinned, whose bodies fell in the desert?.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ li sɔɣi ti bihi, ti ni zaŋ Yawɛ jilima tuma min o tuun kara ni o daalahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum la yɛla yɛli ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba.
en: We will not keep them from our children; we will tell the next generation about the Lord 's power and his great deeds and the wonderful things he has done.

dag: Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔanim yabidoo la daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli n-daa booni Hɛla, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Naara.
en: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti chana, di yuma ayi nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani kuli. Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda bɛ ni niŋ tuumba maa shɛm, ka o daa tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka Naa daa yɛli tuumba maa, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti lan bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: Davids men were too embarrassed to go home. Some people went to David and told him what happened to his men. So King David sent this message to his men: Stay in the town of Jericho until your beards grow again. Then you can come back home.

dag: Dan zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa mali shili, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihitaayika ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: from Dan, , armed for battle.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa zaligu yɛliya, Siɣim na yomyom! .
en: Ahaziah sent another captain with men to Elijah. He said to Elijah, Man of God, the king says, Come down quickly.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔnnim naa Nahash daa yɛl ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n fɔɣi yi nudiriti polo nimbihi zaa din ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa nya filiŋ, n ni chɛ ka m mini ya tɔɣisi.
en: Nahash answered, Sure, I'll sign a treaty! But not before I insult Israel by poking out the right eye of every man who lives in Jabesh.

dag: Ti yi di chɛ nyin ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣa.
en: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to some strange deity.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti yi mabihi maa vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo ba alikauli shɛm la, dinzuɣu labimiya kuli yi biɛhigu shee din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli polo, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun zaŋ luɣ shɛli tin ya la.
en: Now, as he promised, the Lord your God has given the other Israelites peace. So go back home to the land which you claimed for your own, the land on the east side of the Jordan, that Moses, the Lord 's servant, gave you.

dag: O ni daa mali tɔrokɔnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: di daa malila dapaɣa, ka o zaŋ li kpɛhi firimnim ni.
en: The carts were made with square panels set in frames.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka wɔɣ shɛb bɛn mal lɔɣu pam yina ti dimdi Izraɛlnima ka bɛ pam daa kpi.
en: Then the Lord sent poisonous snakes among the people, and many Israelites were bitten and died.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tim tuumba pinaayi maa ka kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, yi mi di kpɛnya Samarianim tin shɛl ni.
en: Jesus sent the twelve men out with these instructions: Dont go to the non-Jewish people. And dont go into any town where the Samaritans live.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni yɛliya, Benya kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: It is written, You will be holy, because I am holy. .

dag: Amaa alizanda ni Jɛrusalɛm la nyɛla bilichina. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ma.
en: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o kɔrigi nahu maa, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ binʒim maa ti ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ li mihi gili Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: You shall kill the bull there, and the Aaronite priests shall present the blood to the Lord and then throw it against all four sides of the altar located at the entrance of the Tent.

dag: N daa tuui zaŋ li yɛl la Ziɔnnima, ka zaŋ di lahiba suŋ molo m-moli Jɛrusalɛmnim sani.
en: I, the Lord, was the first one to tell Zion about these things. I sent a messenger to Jerusalem to say, Look, your people are coming back.

dag: Nimaani ka ŋun gbibi yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ min o naan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n sariakarita maa naan bahi ma zaa.
en: because I am innocent, and he would say, I now set you free.

dag: di saha yi ni ti boli ma, amaa ka n ku garigi ya. Yi ni ti bo ma ni nimmoo, amaa ka ku nya ma.
en: Fools will call for me, but I will not answer. They will look for me, but they will not find me.

dag: Bɛ kul bemi kaman shihi la n-gili n luɣilikam, ka ŋmaligi kpi yomyom kaman buɣim n-di gɔhi la, ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord , I got rid of them and their fiery sting.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande: Kpahimiya gbinyaɣinim zuɣu ni; ka kpaŋsimiya bɛn suhuri miligi la suhuri; ka sɔŋmiya bɛn gbarigi la; ka maliya suɣilo ni sokam.
en: We ask you, brothers and sisters, to warn those who will not work. Encourage those who are afraid. Help those who are weak. Be patient with everyone.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Yawɛ ni zal o ni o tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa maa naai, di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinima ni niriba maa zaa daa gbaag o, ka yɛli, Ti ni ku a!.
en: and as soon as I had finished all that the Lord had commanded me to speak, they grabbed me and shouted, You ought to be killed for this!.

dag: Binneembihi kam zaa bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali bɛ naba anahi zaa chana nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Joɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pihita pah o zuɣu.
en: Joel, the leader of Gershoms family, and of his relatives.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n tooi zani Ziɔn dunɔdaya ni n-yɛli n ni paɣir a shɛlikam zuɣu shɛm yɛla, n ni mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma la zuɣu.
en: so I can declare all your praises, so I can rejoice in your salvation in the gates of Daughter Zion.

dag: Liya ni daa nya ka o bi lan dɔɣiri maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Yaakubu ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: When Leah realized that she had stopped having children, she gave her slave Zilpah to Jacob as his wife.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dauda daa tuui zaŋ wumpaɣibo yilli ŋɔ ti Asaf min o mabihi maa ni bɛ yili paɣi Yawɛ.
en: It was then that David first gave Asaph and the other Levites the responsibility for singing praises to the Lord .

dag: Amaa bɛn so bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛ ni bi dɔɣi shɛb ka bɛ nini nya ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma din tumdi dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: But happier than both are those who have never existed, who havent witnessed the terrible things that happen under the sun.

dag: Din beni nyɛla, chɛliya ka ti kul chani tooni doli so shɛŋa ti ni pun doli hal ni pɔŋɔ la.
en: But we should continue following the truth we already have.

dag: A ni saɣi diɛmd o kaman noombil la bee n-lo o zal a tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi?.
en: Will you tie him like a pet bird, like something to amuse your servant women?.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli.
en: One day the Lord said to some of his prophets:.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi nyɛla Sintani nira, dama piligu ni ha ka Sintani pun tumd alahichi. Ka daliri din chɛ ka Naawuni Bia daa kana nyɛla ni o ti saɣim Sintani tuma.
en: Whoever continues to sin belongs to the Devil, because the Devil has sinned from the very beginning. The Son of God appeared for this very reason, to destroy what the Devil had done.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ dimnim maa pam hal ti naai, ka bi lan nyari so, dama bɛ ni shɛb daa zomi ti kpe bɛ tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gil ni.
en: Joshua and the Israelites finished dealing them a stunning blow until they were finished off. Some survivors among them escaped into the fortified cities.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣila dab paɣ bia maa kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bia kam shɛm, ka daa dɔɣi bilichin paɣ bia maa mi alikauli lɔbu puuni.
en: The son by the slave woman was conceived the normal way, but the son by the free woman was conceived through a promise.

dag: Nyini n-zali tɔrili ni o yiɣimi du zuɣusaa katiŋa ka tɛr o tiɛɣu luɣ shɛli din du pam la?.
en: Or at your command does the eagle soar, the vulture build a nest on high?.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N dana, ka yuri ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka malaika so ŋun daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa garigi yɛli ma, N ni wuh a bɛ yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka do so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa daa garigi yɛli.
en: I asked him, Sir, what do these horses mean? He answered, I will show you what they mean.

dag: nti pahi Ɛliɛl mini Obɛd ni Jaasiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛzɔba nir la.
en: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

dag: Ka ŋun paya yɛli, N dala naɣikɔra pia, ka yɛn zaŋ ba chaŋ ti zahim bɛ tuma, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: Another man said, I have just bought five pairs of work animals; I must go and try them out. Please excuse me.

dag: Duri pam be m Ba yiŋa. N chanimi ni n ti mali biɛhigu shee zali ya. Di yi di pa lala n naan ku yɛli ya di yɛla.
en: There are many rooms in my Father's house, and I am going to prepare a place for you. I would not tell you this if it were not so.

dag: Bɛ ni baŋ Naawuni maa zaa yoli: Bɛ bi tir o jilima kaman Naawuni; bɛ mi bi puhir o taalitaali; amaa ka bɛ tɛha zaa naɣ leela tɛhi yoya, ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tɛhi yoya maa ni.
en: People knew God, but they did not honor him as God, and they did not thank him. Their ideas were all useless. There was not one good thought left in their foolish minds.

dag: Dama piɛguliba maa nyɛla jɛra, ka bi bɔhiri Yawɛ ni bɛ baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ bi tɔŋda, ka bɛ piɛri zaa wurim kpe yɔɣu.
en: But I told them, Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord . And so we've been scattered like sheep.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn sɔŋ ya n-nyɛ: Rubin zuliya ni, Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: These are the names of the men who will stand with you and help you: from the tribe of Reuben—Elizur son of Shedeur;.

dag: Ijipti naa Firawuna daa pun chaŋ ti tuhi deela Gɛza ka ku Keenannim bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka nyo li buɣim; ka zaŋ li ti o bipuɣin so Sulemaana ni daa kpuɣila ka di leeg o daamiliya lɔbu pini;.
en: Pharaoh, Egypts king, had attacked and captured Gezer, setting it on fire. He killed the Canaanites who lived in the city and gave it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomons wife.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa teei dɔni m puli zuɣu Yawɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi kaman n ni daa pun niŋ shɛm la, n daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom yi ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi yi tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu la.
en: Then once again I lay face downward in the Lord 's presence for forty days and nights and did not eat or drink anything. I did this because you had sinned against the Lord and had made him angry.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa lo tab alikauli Bɛrishiiba. Di nyaaŋa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa lab kuli Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Abraham and Abimelech made an agreement at Beersheba. Then Abimelech and Phicol, his military commander, went back to the country of the Philistines.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, m mi n ni lɔn ya nia shɛŋa. Di nyɛla nia shɛŋa n ni lo zaŋ chaŋ yi zaɣ viɛlli polo ka pa ni yi zaɣ biɛɣu polo. N ni chɛ ka yi kul mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima.
en: I say this because I know the plans that I have for you. This message is from the Lord . I have good plans for you. I dont plan to hurt you. I plan to give you hope and a good future.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-jiɣiri yi ni wum ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali pun gari la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli so n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee n-yihi waazu yɛl lala bee ŋ-ŋɔ so n-yɛli ni tinima n-sabi gbaŋ puuni yɛl lala.
en: Dont let yourselves be easily upset or worried if you hear that the day of the Lord has already come. Someone might say that this idea came from us—in something the Spirit told us, or in something we said, or in a letter we wrote.

dag: Naawuni, guli ma; dama a sani ka n sɔɣi.
en: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ sipirɛs tihi dari m-mali dunoyɔriti ayi, ka duno yini dini nyɛ dunoyɔriti ayi din kpabira; ka duno din la gba dini nyɛ dunoyɔriti ayi din kpabira.
en: There were two folding doors made of pine.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛligu daa maan chaŋ tooni, ka nyaandoliba maa kalinli daa zooi pahi Jɛrusalɛm puuni hal ka maligumaaniba pam gba daa niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Mahalalɛl daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka toli mini sakɔri bɛn ka kalinli waɣi yɛrigi.
en: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.

dag: Di saha zaŋ chana, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lo nia ni o bahi Yisa, amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa kuhi yɛl o, A yi bahi doo ŋɔ a pala Naa Siiza sima, dama ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ leei naa lola Naa Siiza zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: After this, Pilate tried to let Jesus go free. But the Jewish leaders shouted, Anyone who makes himself a king is against Caesar. So if you let this man go free, that means you are not Caesars friend.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ o ni ŋme tɔb maa di neen shɛŋa n-lab kul o ya, ka ni ti lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ni ti tum o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka naanyi lab o ya.
en: He will return to his country with great wealth and set his mind against a holy covenant. He will do what he wants and then return to his country.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana maa chɛ ka paɣ maa po pɔri, ka maligumaana maa yɛli, Do so yi bi zaŋ a dɔni, ka a mi bi tum daɣiri tuun shɛli a ni be a yidan fukumsi ni saha shɛli ŋɔ, kɔtɔɣu ŋɔ ni yɛn tahi tibidarigibo shɛl na din di niŋ a shɛli.
en: Then the priest shall make the woman agree to this oath spoken by the priest: If you have not committed adultery, you will not be harmed by the curse that this water brings.

dag: Leedan daa malila bidibisi ata, Jɛhiɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Zɛtam pa, ka Joɛl daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ata.
en: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.

dag: Sagban tibisa lim o n-chɛ ka o bi nyara, ka be zuɣusaa kpaakpanyom ni chana.
en: You think the thick clouds keep him from seeing, as he walks on the dome of the sky.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka sanzali zani, ka siɣili saa bi lan mira. Amaa ka yi nini kul moola zina niŋbu zuɣu, ka vi bi mali ya.
en: So I, the Lord , refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛl o, Rut, nyama, a kpee maa lab o niriba min o wuna sani, dinzuɣu a gba dol o labi.
en: Naomi then said to Ruth, Look, your sister-in-law is going back to her people and to her gods! Why don't you go with her.

dag: Dama so na mi n-yɛli Naawuni, N nyɛla alahichilana, amaa n ku lan tum lala yaha.
en: A person should say to God, I am guilty; I will not sin anymore.

dag: Ka o daa chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: So he preached in the synagogues throughout the country.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛrusalɛm Naa Adɔnizɛdɛk daa tim ti yɛli Hiburɔn Naa Hɔham mini Jarimut naa Piram ni Lakishi Naa Jafia ni Ɛgilɔn Naa Dɛbir.
en: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said.

dag: O wuhi ma yili palli, di nyɛla yil shɛli din nyɛ ti Naawuni paɣibu yilli. Niriba pam ni nya ka lu Yawɛ sizuura, ka niŋ o naani.
en: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see what he did and worship him. They will put their trust in the Lord .

dag: Di zaa yoli, n kul bela a sani sahakam, ka a gbibi n nudirigu.
en: Yet I always stay close to you, and you hold me by the hand.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim maa ni yu shɛm zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Pool, A bɔri ni a chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar a saria nimaani.
en: Festus, wanting to put the Jews in his debt, asked Paul, Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me concerning these things.

dag: dama o daa na bela o yab Ibrahimma niŋgbuŋ ni, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣ o saha shɛli Mɛlikizɛdɛk ni daa tuhi ti yab Ibrahimma sol la.
en: because he was still in his ancestors body when Abraham paid the tenth to Melchizedek.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni zɔri shɛli dina m-paari ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyarila bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The righteous get what they want, but the wicked will get what they fear most.

dag: O suhu kpɛmmi kaman kuɣili la, di kpɛmmi kaman nɛli la.
en: His stony heart is without fear, as unyielding and hard as a millstone.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi gba daa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti mi lee yɛn niŋ? Ka o yɛli ba, Di muɣisiriya niriba bee n-diri shɛhir kpɛma fari bɛ nɛma; ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣimi yi yɔri.
en: The soldiers asked him, What about us? What should we do? He said to them, Dont use force or lies to make people give you money. Be happy with the pay you get.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Misia tintariga shee m-bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Bitinia, amaa ka Yisa Shia daa bi saɣi;.
en: When they reached the border of Mysia, they tried to go into the province of Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti wum ka Filip yihi Naawuni nam mini Yisa Masia yuli waazu maa ka bɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: But when they believed Philip's message about the good news of the Kingdom of God and about Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

dag: dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba m-pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka kum daa ti lu Ijipti mini Keenan tiŋgbɔna ni zaa n-ti ba wahala pam, ka ti yaannim maa daa ti lan ka bindirigu.
en: Then there was a famine all over Egypt and Canaan, which caused much suffering. Our ancestors could not find any food.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, I won't let it be destroyed.

dag: Wuntizɔra laara nyɛla din tahir o nyɛvili shee, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyɔri nyɛ din kpɛhir o alahichi ni.
en: The wages of the righteous lead to life; the earnings of the wicked lead to sin.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka n wum li. N wum a yɛtɔɣa maa vuri.
en: You certainly said in my hearing; I heard the sound of your words.

dag: Chɛ ka puri atam niŋ pam. Chɛ ka daboya zuɣu zaa zibigi bindira, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pam kaman Lɛbanɔn bindira ni niŋdi shɛm la. Chɛ ka fɔntinsi ni pali niriba kaman mɔri ni zibigi mɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: May the fields grow plenty of grain and the hills be covered with crops. May the fields be as fertile as Lebanon, and may people fill the cities as grass covers a field.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti niŋ binchimda zim maa shɛli mini kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim maa zaa nyo buɣim n-yihi di chihili. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: The priest will completely burn the token portion—some of the crushed new grain and oil along with all of the frankincense—as a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka buchi, ka so bi mi bɛ yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ ni daa fiɛbi ninvuɣ shɛb yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ kpa shɛli din kpalim be o nuu ni maa ʒe ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni n-yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: The rest of the oil that is in his palm he shall put on your head and in this way perform the ritual of purification.

dag: Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Ziɔn ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya sɔŋ la, yɛlimaŋli, bɛn nyɛ bɛn kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm la, bɛ ni boli ba bɛn be kasi.
en: Everyone who is left in Jerusalem, whom God has chosen for survival, will be called holy.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, Kalimiya niriba maa n-nya ninvuɣ banima n-lee yi ti ni chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa kali ba n-nya ka Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa n-kani.
en: Saul told his officers, Call the roll and find out who left our camp. When they had finished, they found out that Jonathan and the soldier who carried his weapons were missing.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa suhi ti Naawuni maa, ka bo niriba zali gu ba wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: So we prayed to our God and set a guard as protection against them day and night.

dag: Amaa yinim gbibi n ni zali zaligu shɛŋa, ka miriya ka yi ni tiŋbia bee saan so ŋun be yi sani tum din chihiri maa.
en: So you must obey my laws and rules. You must not do any of these terrible sins. These rules are for the citizens of Israel and the people living among you.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa ayi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa lɔris ayi la ni.
en: They also made two frames for the corners at the back of the Holy Tent.

dag: ka yi chaŋ Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni n-chaŋ ti zani salichɛhi dunɔdali ni m moli n ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ nimaani.
en: Then go out to the Ben-hinnom Valley at the entrance of the gate called Broken Pots and proclaim there the words I will tell you.

dag: Ka Musa daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani, ka boli di yuli, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nasara tuuta.
en: Then Moses built an altar and named it, The Lord is My Flag.

dag: Ka ŋunkam po Naawuni jɛmbu duu pola di mini Naawuni ŋun be di ni maa.
en: Those who swear by the temple swear by it and by everything thats part of it.

dag: Ka o daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma ata. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mikaya, o daa nyɛla Uriɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia nir la bipuɣiŋga. Ka tɔb daa ti lu Abija mini Jɛrɔbɔam sunsuuni.
en: Abijah ruled in Jerusalem for three years. His mothers name was Maacah. She was the daughter of Uriel, from the town of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

dag: Hal bɛ daa gbaai Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Ibram tizo bia la gba, ka zaŋ o nɛma pahi chaŋ.
en: They also captured Abram's nephew Lot, who lived in Sodom. They took him and his possessions and then left.

dag: Ti mi ni ti pun yi kum ni n-kpe nyɛvil ni ti ni yuri ti mabihi la zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia bela kum ni.
en: We know that we have left death and come over into life; we know it because we love others. Those who do not love are still under the power of death.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. A yi di saɣi, n naan ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini, Anabi Ilaija gba zaɣ yini.
en: Peter said to Jesus, Lord, it is good that we are here. If you want, I will put three tents here—one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Dinzuɣu di di simdi ka bɛna m-be kpe n-zan a tooni wuhi bɛ ni nya ka n taali nyɛ shɛli.
en: But there were some Jews from the province of Asia. They should be here making their accusations, if indeed they have something against me.

dag: O ku chɛ ka n vuhi lu m puuni, ka chɛ ka naŋgbantom kul paari ma.
en: He won't let me catch my breath; he has filled my life with bitterness.

dag: Naawuni, nyam ti nyɔtaɣirigu, lihim a ni pii na so ŋɔ ninni!.
en: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla yi yɛli ma mi, Ti du m-bala Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Pa o bimbina ka Hɛzɛkia pun wurim ka yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Yi yɛn jɛmd o la bimbini ŋɔ gbin la.
en: The Assyrian official went on, Or will you tell me that you are relying on the Lord your God? It was the Lord 's shrines and altars that Hezekiah destroyed when he told the people of Judah and Jerusalem to worship at one altar only.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bela fɔntiŋ shɛŋa din kpalim dabari ni, ka be yiya shɛŋa din nyɛ nir ni ku be yiya shɛŋa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ wurim shɛŋa la.
en: They lived in ruined cities, unoccupied houses that turn to rubble.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ dol o hal ka o ti saɣi. O yɛtɔɣ nyaɣisa maa ka o daa zaŋ gbaag o.
en: She seduces him with all her talk. She entices him with her flattery.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia, ka nyɛ maligumaana la min o daŋ zaa bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba m-be Nɔb maa na. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa sanna.
en: Saul sent a message to Ahimelech and his whole family of priests at Nob, ordering them to come to him. When they came.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na kul bi baŋ Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni o ni ti neei kum ni la gbinni.
en: They didnt yet understand the scripture that Jesus must rise from the dead.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu maa wumbu, hal n ni ti yɛn tum alahiziba shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: But Ill make Pharaoh stubborn, and Ill perform many of my signs and amazing acts in the land of Egypt.

dag: zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: All those enlisted were .

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Yawɛ kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la m-mali sara.
en: Aaron will present the goat selected by the LORDs lot and perform a purification offering with it.

dag: M biɛhigu din ka buchi ŋɔ puuni, n nya binshɛɣukam zaa. Wuntizɔriba kpiri bɛ wuntitali tuma puuni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: In my short life, I have seen everything. I have seen good people die young, and I have seen evil people live long lives.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanim maa daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni, ka piɛguliba maa yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti nya yɛl shɛli din niŋ ka ti Duuma yɛli ti ŋɔ.
en: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.

dag: Ka o daa lan wurim bɛ ni daa me binshɛli zali nayili Vuhim Dabisili zuɣu la, ka ŋari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu sambani polo duno shɛli bɛ ni daa chib ti naa ni o doli kpɛr la. Asiria naa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Workers had built a covered place inside the Temple area for the Sabbath meetings. But Ahaz removed the covered place and the outside entrance for the king. He removed all these from the Lord s Temple. Ahaz did this because of the king of Assyria.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi maa daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia nti gbaag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But the Babylonian army chased King Zedekiah and caught him on the plains of Jericho. All of Zedekiahs soldiers ran away.

dag: Barinim pam bɛn gbarigi n-daa kul do lunfanim maa ni: Zoomba mini gbariti ni bɔɣukpimanima ni gbalikpimanima. Bɛ daa doya gulila kom maa dambu.
en: and a crowd of people who were sick, blind, lame, and paralyzed sat there.

dag: Amaa so ni yɛli, A malila yɛda, ka m mi mali tuma. N gba ni yɛli, Wuhim ma a yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma maa, ka m mi wuh a n yɛda niŋbu n tuma tumbu puuni.
en: But someone will say, One person has faith, another has actions. My answer is, Show me how anyone can have faith without actions. I will show you my faith by my actions.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya ka biriti maa leei bɛn tɔɣisira, ka bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni maa kpaŋ, ka gbariti chana, ka zoomba gba nina neei maa, ka bɛ daa tibigi Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ pam.
en: The people were amazed as they saw the dumb speaking, the crippled made whole, the lame walking, and the blind seeing; and they praised the God of Israel.

dag: Zaŋmi bɛ zaa laɣim sɔɣi tiŋgban ni, ka lo ba niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua la.
en: He said: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

dag: ni jɛra ni bɛn bi ʒe yim ni ninkuunsinima ni bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: They are without understanding, disloyal, without affection, and without mercy.

dag: Ka o tiba maa dii yooi, ka o zilinli lɛbigi ka o dii gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: As soon as Jesus did this, the man was able to hear. He was able to use his tongue, and he began to speak clearly.

dag: Ka yi yi lihi zuɣusaa nya wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni zuɣusaa binyara zaa, yin miriya ka yi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li ka di chɛ ka yi birigi. Di nyɛla binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Dont look to the skies, to the sun or the moon or the stars, all the heavenly bodies, and be led astray, worshipping and serving them. The LORD your God has granted these things to all the nations who live under heaven.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Listen to this message from the Lord All-Powerful:.

dag: Ka zaŋ waagasi kpil pia ŋɔ mi ti ti bɛ yaɣili maa sapashin kpɛma, ka nya a biɛyanim maa daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ʒi shɛhirili bini bɛ sani mali kuna.
en: And here are ten large chunks of cheese to take to their commanding officer. Find out how your brothers are doing and bring back something that shows that they're all right.

dag: dama n ni ti tin ya yɛm ni noli ka yi dimnim ti ku tooi tɔɣisi luhi ya bee n-tooi garigi yi bɔhigu.
en: Ill give you words and wisdom that none of your opponents will be able to counter or contradict.

dag: Yi kul nahindi yimaŋa n-chani bɔri buɣa shee ni yi jɛm li, ka bi yɛri ni di ka buchi. Yi tɛhiya ni dina n-tiri ya kpiɔŋ, ka yi bi gbarigira.
en: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: May his name be praised, now and forever.

dag: Dabisa shɛŋa puuni zaa o ni wolig omaŋ maa, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: It is holy because you have given yourself fully to the Lord for the full time of that dedication.

dag: Sɔdom nanima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! Gomɔranima, wummiya Naawuni ni wuhiri ya shɛli.
en: Hear the LORDs word, you leaders of Sodom. Listen to our Gods teaching, people of Gomorrah!.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa deei baptaizibu, ka Yisa gba daa deei baptaizibu ka suhiri Naawuni; di saha maa ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi.
en: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus came and was baptized too. And while he was praying, the sky opened.

dag: Ka Salɛm Naa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun daa lan nyɛ Zallakudura Naa maligumaana la daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini wain na nti ti Ibram;.
en: Melchizedek, the king of Salem and a priest of God Most High, also went to meet Abram. He brought bread and wine.

dag: Yawɛ tim o niriba kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka ti ba suhudoo.
en: May the Lord make his people strong. May the Lord bless his people with peace.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe a yim, a gba ʒe ba la yim; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi, a wuhir o a gba ni ka galimi shɛm.
en: You deal faithfully with the faithful; you show integrity toward the one who has integrity.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ chinchin sabilitim yirigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They shall put a fine leather cover over it, spread a cloth of solid blue on top, and then insert the carrying poles.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili shee dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ su kom.
en: Present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the meeting tent and wash them with water.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka sokam buɣis omaŋmaŋ tuma nya, di nyaaŋa o ni mali dalir shɛli ni o nyu bara ni bela omaŋmaŋ tuma ni, ka pa ni o ʒiʒiinikpee tuma ni.
en: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa beni ka barina shɛli kani. Yaakubu zuliya kɔŋko n-daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bindira mini wain; ni luɣ shɛli maligim ni yiri zuɣusaa luri tiŋ na.
en: So Jacob's descendants live in peace, secure in a land full of grain and wine, where dew from the sky waters the ground.

dag: Yi nya nir ni yiri taali ni Naawuni sani o tuma tumbu zuɣu shɛm, ka pa ni o yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: You see, then, that it is by our actions that we are put right with God, and not by our faith alone.

dag: Dan zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Jɔgili bia Buki.
en: from the tribe of the Danites, a chief, Bukki, Joglis son.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka o yɛl o, N dana, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: What do you want me to do for you? Lord, I want to see! he answered.

dag: Amaa mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun kpihindi yi daalahichi. Mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka n niŋdi lala maa. N ku lan teei yi daalahichi maa yɛla.
en: And yet, I am the God who forgives your sins, and I do this because of who I am. I will not hold your sins against you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zɔri vi ni a di ti Duuma bee man ŋun nyɛ o dansarika ŋɔ shɛhira, amaa Naawuni yiko ni, chɛ ka m min a laɣim di wahala lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu.
en: So dont be ashamed to tell people about our Lord Jesus. And dont be ashamed of me—I am in prison for the Lord. But suffer with me for the Good News. God gives us the strength to do that.

dag: ka Ibram daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Shɛkɛm ti ʒini Mɔre oki tia gbini. Keenannima n-daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni di saha maa.
en: Abram went as far as the sacred tree of Moreh in a place called Shechem. The Canaanites were still living in the land at that time.

dag: Ka Yisa daa saɣisi ba yɛli ni bɛ di chɛ ka so wum li; ka yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma ni bɛ tim bia maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: He gave them strict orders that no one should know what had happened. Then he told them to give her something to eat.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ŋuni ka a bɔra? Mariama daa tɛhiya ni puu maa lana m-bala ka yɛl o, N dana, nyini n-yi yih o, nyin wuhim ma a ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: Woman, why are you crying? Jesus asked her. Who is it that you are looking for? She thought he was the gardener, so she said to him, If you took him away, sir, tell me where you have put him, and I will go and get him.

dag: Bɛraya mi zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hɛbɛr daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Hɛbɛrnima; ka Malikiɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Malikiɛlnima.
en: The family groups from Beriah were Heber—the Heberite family group; Malkiel—the Malkielite family group.

dag: Dindali maa o ni ti lan boli ma o yidana yaha, ka pa ni o Baal.
en: On that day, says the LORD, you will call me, My husband, and no longer will you call me, My Lord.

dag: Bihi maa ni daa ti zooi, Iso daa niŋla tɔha biiŋa ŋun daa kul be mɔɣu ni; ka Yaakubu mi be baalim m-be yiŋa.
en: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skilled hunter, a man who loved the outdoors, but Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.

dag: Chɛ ka ti me dubil tam ti yil ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka bo garo mini teebuli ni kuɣa ni firila zali di ni, o yi ti lan ka ti sanna ka o kpe nimaani.
en: Why don't we build him a small room on the flat roof of our house? We can put a bed, a table and chair, and an oil lamp in it. Then whenever he comes, he can stay with us.

dag: Ka nachimba maa daa chaŋ nti yihi Reehab min o ba ni o ma ni o tizɔdɔbba ni o dɔɣiriba zaa n-zaŋ ba ti ʒili kpaŋ ha miri Izraɛlnim sansani.
en: So the two men went into the house and brought out Rahab, her father, mother, brothers, all her family, and all those who were with her. They put all the people in a safe place outside the camp of Israel.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka vi gbahi o dimnim zaa; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa suhuri daa paligi tuun kar shɛŋa o ni tum maa zuɣu.
en: When Jesus said this, all those who were criticizing him felt ashamed of themselves. And all the people were happy for the wonderful things he was doing.

dag: Biɛŋmarisi ni daa laɣim yili yila, ka alizanda ni malaikanim zaa yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri la, a daa beni?.
en: while morning stars sang, and angels rejoiced?.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi ni jɛm niriba maa zuŋɔ, ka zaŋ zilin balli yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: They answered, If you are like a servant to them today, they will sincerely serve you. If you speak kindly to them, they will always work for you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim zaŋ laɣiŋgu suɣili la be suɣa maa sunsuuni doli kaman bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa maa zali shɛm, ka sokam ʒe o zaashee o tuuta gbini.
en: The meeting tent and the Levites camp will march in the center of the camps. They will march in the same order as they camp: each in position under his banner.

dag: Yi yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ n kul timdila n daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna dabisili kam.
en: From the day that your ancestors came out of Egypt until this very day I have kept on sending to you my servants, the prophets.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima ka wolindi dira, di so ni a wuhi ni a nyɛla wɔɣirili ka kum kur a.
en: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, o je m Ba gba.
en: Whoever hates me also hates my Father.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ yuuni ni pirigili nimaani n-wuhiri niriba Naawuni yɛligu.
en: So he stayed there for eighteen months, teaching Gods word among them.

dag: Amaa ka Zarai daa lee nyɛ paɣiŋoo; o daa ka bia.
en: Sarai was not able to have children.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee kuhi pam; bɛ daa kumiya pam dindali yuŋ maa.
en: After the Israelites heard the report from the twelve men who had explored Canaan, the people cried all night.

dag: Bi shɛb bɛn doli zaligu nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm. Amaa bi shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi pulaannim zuɣu nyɛla bɛn dihiri bɛ banim mini bɛ manim vi.
en: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi ni Izraɛlnim zaa ni man Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:.

dag: nti yɛl o, N wum a suhigu shɛli a ni suhi ma la. M mali jɛmbu du shɛli a ni me ŋɔ ka di be kasi ni di nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn jɛmdi ma luɣ shɛli sahakam. N kul ni gul li ka chɛ ka n suhu be di ni sahakam.
en: The Lord said to him, I heard your prayer and what you asked me to do. You built this Temple, and I have made it a holy place. So I will be honored there forever. I will watch over it and think of it always.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa ʒini naai di daba ata dali ka o daa yi Siizaria chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Three days after arriving in the province, Festus went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ʒila n ni kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma ni n kamina ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Do you think I have attacked your country and destroyed it without the Lord 's help? The Lord himself told me to attack it and destroy it.

dag: N chɛ ka a nya jilima dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tum tuun shɛlikam a ni daa ti ma ni n tum la naai.
en: I have glorified you on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.

dag: Ka Piɛgul Kpɛm la yi ti kana, yi ni deei nam zuɣupila din mali jilima ka di viɛlim ku kpaai.
en: Then when Christ the Ruling Shepherd comes, you will get a crown—one that will be glorious and never lose its beauty.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba o wuhibu maa ni, Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la.
en: As he was teaching, he said, Watch out for the legal experts. They like to walk around in long robes. They want to be greeted with honor in the markets.

dag: A chɛ ka puri atam niŋdi pam yuuni puuni; ka a naɣikɔra tɔroko lɔɣu pali bindira hal ti puuri bahira.
en: What a rich harvest your goodness provides! Wherever you go there is plenty.

dag: Hal Naawuni yi chɛ ka n nyɛvili pahi yi yɛda niŋbu sara zuɣu n-leei sara maligu ŋun Naawuni sani, di ni niŋ ma suhupiɛlli, ka yi zaa gba pahi n zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.

dag: Bɛ daa nya n ni zaɣisi Izraɛlnim ka kari ba bahi bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim ka niŋ zina shɛŋa zaa la zuɣu, amaa ka dabiɛm daa bi gbahi bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa. Amaa ka bɛn gba daa chaŋ ti niŋ zina.
en: She also saw that I sent unfaithful Israel away with divorce papers because of all her acts of unfaithfulness; yet disloyal sister Judah was not afraid but kept on playing the prostitute.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri nambɔɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti zo bɛ gba nambɔɣu.
en: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!.

dag: ka piligi bur o taba, ka pahi danyuriba zuɣu diri ka nyura.
en: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.

dag: Biɛrim chɛ ka n nimbihi bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋmanila shilinshia.
en: My grief has almost made me blind; my arms and legs are as thin as shadows.

dag: N zaŋ a yɛligu ti ba, ka dunianim zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni lan pa dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ania zahimbu puuni mal alibarika, dama zahimbu maa yi buɣis o ka o nyaŋ li, o ni ti nya laara din nyɛ nyɛvil shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la.
en: Great blessings belong to those who are tempted and remain faithful! After they have proved their faith, God will give them the reward of eternal life. God promised this to all people who love him.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ biɛhiŋ, nyin bipuɣiŋga ŋun ka yɛda ŋɔ? Dama n yɛn namla bin palli niŋ dunia ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣa n-ni ti nyɛ ŋun taɣiri doo barina ni.
en: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ŋmaligi yɛli Adam mi, A ni deeg a paɣ noli, ka di ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la zuɣu, n yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; a yɛn tumdila tuun kpɛma di ni n-nyari bindirigu diri hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: To the man he said, Because you listened to your wifes voice and you ate from the tree that I commanded, Dont eat from it, cursed is the fertile land because of you; in pain you will eat from it every day of your life.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu n-sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus replied, Foxes have dens and the birds in the sky have nests, but the Human Onehas no place to lay his head.

dag: So bi lan nyuri wain ka yiini yila; ka binnyuri kpɛma leei din to bɛn nyuri li sani.
en: There is no more happy singing over wine; no one enjoys its taste any more.

dag: Ka anab maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, A ni zaŋ n ni yɛl a ni a ku do so la bahila zuɣu, a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili yo o nyɛvili samli; ka zaŋ a tɔbbihi gba nyɛviya yo o tɔbbihi nyɛviya samli. .
en: The prophet said, The Lord told you to kill Benhadad, but you let him go. Now you will die in his place, and your people will die in place of his people.

dag: O daa lan tum alahiziba tuma Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: wondrous works in the land of Ham, awesome deeds at the Reed Sea.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka yi tum alahichi ni yɛlimaŋli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Yi daa ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi doli so shɛli maa, ka doola naɣibil kɔtomsi zali yimaŋa.
en: I looked and I saw you had sinned against the Lord your God. I saw the calf you made from melted gold! You stopped obeying the Lord so quickly.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino bɔhi ma, Bɛn ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒiɛya ŋɔ lee nyɛla banima, ka ya polo ka bɛ lee yina.
en: One of the elders asked me, Who are these people dressed in white robes, and where do they come from.

dag: dama bɛ daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin n-zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ daba ayopɔin mi m-puhi chuɣu, ka daa laɣim dabisi shɛli din pah anii dali jɛm Naawuni.
en: On the eighth day there was a gathering. They had dedicated the altar for seven days and celebrated the festival for another seven days.

dag: Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo din kul zoori pahiri Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa baŋbu puuni!.
en: May grace and peace be yours in full measure through your knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii wɔribariba ayi, ka naa maa tim ba Siria tɔbbihi maa sani ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya.
en: So the men took two chariots with horses. The king sent these men after the Aramean army. He told them, Go and see what happened.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni lu yi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi nyɛ yi daba la ŋmaligi nyaŋ ya. Ka lala yi niŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Bɛ chib bɔɣili n-gbi li sɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli maa ni.
en: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ ŋmɛnditoya nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme ba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gil ba nyaŋ ba, ka Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛmaŋ zuɣu zabbu.
en: And so the Lord became furious with Israel and let raiders attack and rob them. He let the enemies all around overpower them, and the Israelites could no longer protect themselves.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, o ni pɔbilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirigi o kpiŋkpama na ti to Mɔabnima.
en: The Lord has promised that a nation will swoop down on Moab like an eagle with its outspread wings.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka Pool mini Silas suhiri Naawuni ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni, ka bɛ dansarika tab ʒiya wumda.
en: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.

dag: Paɣ jɛrigu kul tahirila pampam, o nyɛla ŋun be ʒilinsi ni, ka bi mi shɛli.
en: Woman Folly is noisy; shes stupid and doesnt even know it.

dag: Zaŋm ba pahi amaŋ zuɣu ka yi mali yimaŋ kaman di ni wuhi shɛm, ka zo ba liɣiri kuŋa ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri. Dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni bɛ ni yɛli ni a niŋ shɛm maa pala yɛlimaŋli, amaa ni hal amaŋmaŋ gba doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Join with them and prepare yourself for the ceremony that goes with the promises. Pay the cost for their heads to be shaved. Then everyone will learn that the reports about you are not true. They will know you do obey the Law of Moses.

dag: Di saha ka a yipa ni bɔri sara maligunima din tuhi ni sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la; di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan zaŋ naɣilahi m-mali sara a sara maligu bimbin la zuɣu.
en: Then you can enjoy the kind of sacrifices you want. You will receive whole burnt offerings, and people will again offer bulls on your altar.

dag: n-chaŋ ti moli o nasara dibu molo shihi bɛn be sarika ni la sani.
en: and in his spiritual existence he went and preached to the imprisoned spirits.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ n ti yɛn kana, kpaŋm amaŋ karimmi Naawuni Kundi niriba ni, ka yihimi waazu, ka wuhimi niriba.
en: Until I arrive, pay attention to public reading, preaching, and teaching.

dag: Buni nyɛla din taɣiri nir nyɛvili, amaa so bi varisiri faralana.
en: The rich have to use their money to save their lives, but no one threatens the poor.

dag: N daa tum tuun maŋli shihira wuhibu tuma yi sani ni suɣilo dibu zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: shihira wuhibu mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni yiko tuma.
en: The signs of an apostle were performed among you with continuous endurance through signs, wonders, and miracles.

dag: Tɔɣisim yɛtɔɣ maŋa din nyɛ so ni ku tooi galim shɛli, ka di chɛ ka bɛn chihir a di vi ka ku tooi mali zaɣ biɛ shɛli ni bɛ yɛli dalim ti.
en: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.

dag: Bɛ daa dari chɛchɛbunsi Ijipti la anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu; ka dari yuri mi anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga ni pihinu. Ka naa kɔhigɔriba maa mi daa mali yuri maa n-tomdi kɔhiri Hitinim mini Siria nanim zaa zuɣu.
en: A chariot from Egypt cost about pounds of silver, and a horse cost almost pounds of silver. Solomon sold horses and chariots to the kings of the Hittites and the Arameans.

dag: Sɛt ni daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni ayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Enosh was born, Seth lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N tum tuun yini ka di gari yi zaa ha.
en: Jesus answered, I performed one miracle, and you were all surprised.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa bɔhi Dauda, Baa n-nyɛ ma ka a zaŋ kpahi kani n sanna? Ka o daa kar o buɣa bahiri Dauda zuɣu.
en: He said to David, What's that stick for? Do you think I'm a dog? And he called down curses from his god on David.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Babɛl , dama nimaani ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woligiwoligi; nimaani ka o daa lan wurim ba kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: That is the place where the Lord confused the language of the whole world. That is why it is called Babel. And it was from there that the Lord caused the people to spread out to all the other places on earth.

dag: Tayiɣ bi kanna ka pa ni o yɛn zumi bee n-ku bee n-saɣim bahi. Amaa man kamina ni niriba ti nya nyɛvili n-kul nya li la pam.
en: A thief comes to steal, kill, and destroy. But I came to give life—life that is full and good.

dag: Wummiya vu shɛli din yɔri pampam tiŋ puuni ŋɔ, ka wumya vuri din yiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu na ŋɔ! Yawɛ n-darigir o dimnim tibili maa!.
en: Listen! That loud noise in the city, that sound in the Temple, is the sound of the Lord punishing his enemies!.

dag: ni Jɛshua ni Molada ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-Pelet.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Dolintab biɛr biɛɣu dolibu saɣindi biɛrisuŋ.
en: Dont be deceived, bad company corrupts good character.

dag: Dama bɛ daa ku o suli bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni, ka daa chɛ ka nyuli gbaag o bɛ binnana jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: They built high places and made God angry. They built statues of false gods and made him jealous.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi gbibi n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and I command you to obey my laws.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa gba daa kana ti damd o tooni ka yɛli, Ti nyɛla a daba.
en: His brothers went to him and bowed down in front of him. They said, We will be your servants.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa lan tim tuumba Ammɔn naa maa sani, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛl o.
en: So the messengers of Jephthah took this message back to Jephthah. Then Jephthah sent the messengers to the king of the Ammonites again.

dag: ka paɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni daanya ni kuriti ni dari ni kuɣa mali shɛŋa.
en: and praised gods made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.

dag: Di saha maa ka Kalidianim shɛb daa nya soli ni bɛ doli fiɣisi Yɛhudianima.
en: It was then that some Babylonians took the opportunity to denounce the Jews.

dag: Gallimnima, tahimiya! Laishanima, Wummiya! Anatɔtnima, garigimiya!.
en: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.

dag: Ifriim zuliya maa tinzuɣu nyɛla Samaria, ka Samarianim zuɣulana nyɛ Rɛmalia bia la. Yi yi bi niŋ yɛda viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ku di nasara.
en: the chief of Ephraim is Samaria; and the chief of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you dont believe this, you cant be trusted.

dag: Tins ayɔbu ka yi yɛn yihi zali ka di nyɛ yi tiliginsim tinsi maa.
en: Choose six cities.

dag: O daa ku Bashan Naa Ogi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Og, king of Bashan— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa darigi cheeicheei bɛ binyɛra, ka kpuɣi bɛ ʒiya pa bɛ bunsi zuɣu ŋ-ŋmaligi lab tiŋ maa ni.
en: This upset the brothers so much that they began tearing their clothes in sorrow. Then they loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.

dag: ka leei ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ka di pala o yila maligumaaniba zuliya ni na kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu, amaa ka nyɛla maligumaana nyɛvil shɛli din ku bahi yol la yiko zuɣu.
en: He was made a priest, not by human rules and regulations, but through the power of a life which has no end.

dag: Dama alahichi ku lan tooi sun ya yi ni yi fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni kpe Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni la zuɣu.
en: Sin must not be your master; for you do not live under law but under God's grace.

dag: Ti dana, wummi ti ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, A nyɛla zuɣulaan titali ti sani. Ti ni so ku mɔŋ a o siliga bee n-yɛl a ni a di sɔɣ a kpima. Dinzuɣu piim a ni bɔri ti silisi ŋɔ ni shɛli n-zaŋ a kpim maa sɔɣi di ni.
en: Listen to us, sir. You are an eminent man of God among us. Bury your dead in one of our own select burial sites. None of us will keep our own burial plots from you to bury your dead.

dag: Di simdi ni a ti kɔrigiri naɣilaa dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara. Di lan simdi ka a maani alahichi kpihimbu sara maligu bimbini maa kasitali zuɣu; ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi.
en: Every day you should offer a bull as a purification offering for reconciliation. You should remove the sin from the altar through a ritual of reconciliation, and you should anoint the altar to make it holy.

dag: O daa zaŋla niriba niŋ sapashin kpamba nuu ni, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣim fɔŋ maa dunɔdali palo ni, ka o daa tɔɣisi ba suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: He appointed military officers over the troops, assembled them in the square of the city gate, and spoke these words of encouragement.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam hal ka o ti kari ba o sani. Zɛdɛkia daa nyɛla ŋun zaɣisi Babilɔn naa noli.
en: It was because the LORD was angry against Jerusalem and Judah that he thrust them out of his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

dag: Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n sɔŋda. Ŋuna n Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi n nyɛvili.
en: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Man Yisifu m-bala. M ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Amaa ka di daa gar o biɛyanim maa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: Joseph asked his brothers if his father was still alive, but they were too frightened to answer.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim bɛn be vinvamli ni ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn be bɔpiɛligu ni ŋɔ, m mini ya mali zabili. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa. Yinim bɛn yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi siɣina ti liri ti? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kpe ti sɔɣisili shee ŋɔ na.
en: You, Jerusalem, are sitting high above the valleys, like a rock rising above the plain. But I will fight against you. You say that no one can attack you or break through your defenses.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim laɣim pahi Ibrahimma Naawuni la niriba zuɣu. Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa. Ŋuna n-simdi duhibu pam.
en: The leaders of the nations have come together with the people of the God of Abraham. All the rulers of the world belong to God. He is over them all!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, yim kpe siɣi tiŋ yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la tum tuumbiɛɣu, bɛ ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛli maa; ka doola binnani zali bɛmaŋa.
en: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lan niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm la; bɛ daa suhi Ijiptinim maa anzinfa mini salima yɛri ni situra.
en: Then the Israelites did what Moses asked them to do. They went to their Egyptian neighbors and asked for clothing and things made from silver and gold.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu n-yɛli ba, M pina din nyɛ bindir shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma ka di nyom niŋdi ma nyaɣisim la, zaŋmiya li tim ma di tibu saha.
en: Give this command to the Israelites. Tell them to be sure to give the grain offerings and sacrifices to me at the right time as sweet-smelling gifts.

dag: Fam ma gbuɣinli nol ni bahi! Fam ma yɔnaɣilahi yila ni bahi.
en: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls.
