dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ti ma noli din ni tooi wuhi niriba ni di chɛ ka n tooi kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi suhuri. O neeri ma la asiba kam, ka yoori n tiba ni n wum kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri wuhibu.
en: The LORD God gave me an educated tongue to know how to respond to the weary with a word that will awaken them in the morning. God awakens my ear in the morning to listen, as educated people do.

dag: Ka fɔntiŋ maa kpamba zaŋ naɣisaa maa chaŋ vinvamli ni kulibɔŋ shɛli din kom zɔr ni, ka so na ʒi n-ko nimaani bee m-biri binshɛli nimaani nti kabi naɣisaa maa nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni.
en: They are to take it down to a spot near a stream that never runs dry and where the ground has never been plowed or planted, and there they are to break its neck.

dag: dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na sani mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di.
en: Let the crowds leave, so they can go to the farms and villages near here and buy something to eat.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Keenan Naa Jabin ŋun daa diri ʒi Hazɔr, ka o sapashin kpɛm nyɛ Sisɛra ŋun daa be Harɔshɛtihagɔim la nuu ni.
en: So the LORD gave them over to King Jabin of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, and he was stationed in Harosheth-ha-goiim.

dag: Ka o daa ti tim ti yɛli Dauda, N tuhi nyaŋ Rabanim maa hal ka fa bɛ tin shɛli din mali kom la gba.
en: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, I have fought against Rabbah and captured the citys water supply.

dag: N lo a alikauli, a ni niŋ zuliya pam yaba.
en: I make this covenant with you: I promise that you will be the ancestor of many nations.

dag: n-sɔɣi ŋuniya mal li tɔri ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali; bɛ kul tɔrila niriba libigiri ba, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: They fearlessly ambush and shoot innocent people.

dag: Yisifu daa beni hal ti nya Ifriim bihi ni o yaantibichahi. O daa lan beni hal ti nya Manaasa bihi ni Makiri gba bihi n-zaŋ ba ʒil o naba zuɣu.
en: and saw Ephraims grandchildren. The children of Machir, Manassehs son, were also born on Josephs knees.

dag: Nuhu nini ni daa ti neei, ka bɛ yɛl o o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani maa ni niŋ o shɛm.
en: Later, Noah woke up. When he learned what his youngest son Ham had done to him.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia maa daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa zaŋ ma chaŋ, ka n daa chaŋ ni suhugarigu pam mini suhuyiɣisili, dama Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu pam.
en: Then the wind picked me up and took me away. With the LORDs power pressing down against me I went away, bitter and deeply angry.

dag: So beni n-ni tooi ŋme ma naŋgbankpeeni? Dindina n ni fo n noli, ka kpi.
en: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die.

dag: ka zaŋ tani n-yirigi pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka kpuɣi binshɛli din yɛn pili suɣili maa pil li kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: He spread out the covering over the Tent and put the outer covering over it, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: M puhiri Ampiliatus n ni yuri so ti Duuma ni la.
en: Say hello to Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.

dag: Nuhu ʒiɛman ni, n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ku chɛ ka kom lan di dunia la, lala ka n lo alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ka mi ku lan darig a tibili.
en: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.

dag: Di saha n yi ti laɣim ya, n ni zaŋ ya kuli yiŋa, dama n ni chɛ ka yi yuli du, ka yi nya jilima dunianim zaa sani saha shɛli n yi ti lan labisi yi daazichi la na ka yi nina nya li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa bo bɔrɔbɔro mini wain koligu pali ni busaa n-zaŋ pa buŋ zuɣu ti o bia Dauda ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ Sool sani.
en: So Jesse got some things as a gift for Saul. Jesse got a donkey, some bread and a leather bag full of wine, and a young goat. He gave them to David and sent him to Saul.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Hɛzɛkia yɛliya, Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini ti zuɣu ni kpahibu ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani n-dɔɣiri ba.
en: They said to him, This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, punishment, and humiliation. Its as if children are ready to be born, but theres no strength to see it through.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuliya kam wummiya, ka baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ ba.
en: So listen, all you nations, and pay attention, you people in those countries.

dag: dama dindali maa ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya, ka yihi ya daɣiri ni; yi ni ti yi yi daalahichi zaa daɣiri ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan tirisi tooni ha ti zani luɣ muɣiliŋga shee ka palo lan kani ka nir ni tooi birigi nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: Once more the angel moved ahead; he stood in a narrow place where there was no room at all to pass on either side.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiy o, Tɔbbi so ŋun na lɔri kpara bi simdi ka o nyuri bara kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lɔrigi kpara ni nyuri bara shɛm. .
en: Ahab then answered, Benhadad, don't brag before the fighting even begins. Wait and see if you live through it.

dag: Bɛ vuhim yi ti naai, bɛ labirila tiŋgban ni; di saha ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa kpalim yoli.
en: People die and are buried. Then all their plans to help are gone.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be adaka maa luɣa ni la ni n-kpuɣiri li.
en: and put them through the rings on each side of the Box.

dag: Ka o daa bɔh o bipuɣinsi maa, Ka o be ya? Wula ka yi chɛ o zali samban ni? Bolimiy o na ka o ti di bindirigu.
en: Where is he? he asked his daughters. Why did you leave the man out there? Go and invite him to eat with us.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti bi nya o, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti bo o shee.
en: but they did not find him. So they went back to Jerusalem to look for him there.

dag: Ka a daa zaŋ yuma pam di ba suɣilo, ka daa zaŋ a shia niŋ a daanabinim ni, ka bɛ kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ba niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim nuu ni.
en: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kuhiri niŋdi ma? Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ cham tooni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Why are you still crying to me? Tell the Israelites to start moving.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti niŋ yuun shɛŋa, ka Ijipti naa maa daa kpi. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul be bɛ dabitim maa ni fabinda, ka kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka bɛ dabitim ni kuhigu maa daa paai Naawuni.
en: Years later the king of Egypt died, but the Israelites were still groaning under their slavery and cried out for help. Their cry went up to God.

dag: dindina n ni yihi ya n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni, ka zaɣisi n ni daa pii jɛmbu du shɛli ni yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ŋɔ gba, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam mal li ansarisi ka ʒiɛm li.
en: then I will uproot you from my land that I gave you, and I will reject this temple that I made holy for my name. I will make it a joke, insulted by everyone.

dag: Nyama, bɛ zali ma la zaligu ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. O pun niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka n ku tooi vuui li.
en: My command from God was to bless these people, and there's nothing I can do to change what he has done.

dag: Hal laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa bɔh o tumtumdib kpɛma, Ka paɣisar ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Boaz asked the man in charge, Who is that young woman.

dag: Yinim bɛn be Rom gba be Naawuni ni boli shɛba ni bɛ leei Yisa Masia niriba maa kalinli ni.
en: You who are called by Jesus Christ are also included among these Gentiles.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o yihi ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni suhuyiɣisili tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The LORD ripped them off their land in anger, wrath, and great fury. He threw them into other lands, and thats how things still stand today.

dag: Zaŋm a tuma niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni, ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa niŋ pali.
en: Ask the Lord to bless your plans, and you will be successful in carrying them out.

dag: Chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat, bɛ daa yɛlimi, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lu o zuɣu ni bɛ tuh o, ka o daa kuhi, ka Yawɛ sɔŋ o n-kari ba bahi ka chɛ o.
en: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But Jehoshaphat prayed, and the Lord made the Syrian soldiers stop.

dag: Bɛn zɔr o, bɛna ka o mi zɔri nambɔɣu ʒiɛmani zaŋ ti kpa ʒiɛmani.
en: He always gives mercy to those who worship him.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu maa wumbu, hal n ni ti yɛn tum alahiziba shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: But I will make the king stubborn, and he will not listen to you, no matter how many terrifying things I do in Egypt. Then I will bring severe punishment on Egypt and lead the tribes of my people out of the land.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa di nam ʒila Pɛriʒianim tinzuɣu din yuli daa booni Susa la. O daa di nam maa n-sula tiŋgbana kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Ŋuna n-daa su India tiŋgbɔŋ zaŋ hal ni Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: This is what happened back when Ahasuerus lived, the very Ahasuerus who ruled from India to Cush—one hundred twenty-seven provinces in all.

dag: amaa ka daa lee yɛli ni bɛ di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama ni di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu zuɣu.
en: We must not do it during the festival, they said, or the people will riot.

dag: Di saha a mini Lɛvinim ni saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani zaa ni puhi chuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a min a yiŋnim binshɛŋa zaa o nirilim puuni maa zuɣu.
en: Be grateful for the good things that the Lord your God has given you and your family; and let the Levites and the foreigners who live among you join in the celebration.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kpihim yi birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you.

dag: Mani m-mi o, dama n yila o sanna, ŋun mi n-nyɛ ŋun tim ma na.
en: I know him because I am from him and he sent me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Di chɛ ka so baŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, di yi pa lala a ni kpi.
en: Zedekiah replied, Don't let anyone know about this conversation, and your life will not be in danger.

dag: Ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti dol o ba chaŋ puu ni kachɛriba sani.
en: The child grew up. One day he ran to his father, who was with the harvest workers.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Daina ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu mini Liya bipuɣiŋga la daa ti chaŋ ni o ti puhi tiŋ maa ni paɣiba;.
en: Dinah, the daughter whom Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to meet the women of that country.

dag: Ka yi ti chaŋ maligumaana ŋun tumdi tuma di saha maa sani ti yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni m paai ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
en: and tell the priest, Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.

dag: Fɔntin shɛli ni niriba ni daa kul palila n-leei dabari maa! Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin titali niriba sani la nti be kaman pakoli maa. Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ nabipuɣiŋga fɔntinsi ni la leela dabili.
en: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ salima jɛŋgbaris adaka mini alɔbo kɔtomsi la niŋ di ni.
en: Then they put the chest on the cart, along with the bag that had the gold rats and sores in it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni ka yi teeri di yɛla, ka yɛli Jɔshua ka di kpe o tibili ni ni n ni kpihim Amalɛknim maa birili dunia yili.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Write this as a reminder on a scroll and read it to Joshua: I will completely wipe out the memory of Amalek under the sky.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Labimiya yaɣ yini polo, ka m mini m bia Jɔnatan mi labi yaɣ yini polo. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Sool, A ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, nyin niŋmi li.
en: Saul told his army, You stand on that side of the priest, and Jonathan and I will stand on the other side. Everyone agreed.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Yɛlimiya ma.
en: Was Johns baptism of heavenly or of human origin? Answer me.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Sariakarita so n-daa be tinshee; o daa bi zɔri Naawuni, ka mi bi lan lihiri nyari daadam kam.
en: In a town there was once a judge who didn't fear God or care about people.

dag: Ŋun daa nya li ni o nini n-yɛl li ni yi niŋ yɛda. O yɛligu maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka o mi ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The one who saw this has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he speaks the truth, and he has testified so that you also can believe.

dag: Paɣiba pam gba daa be nimaani n-kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni din niŋ maa. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn doli Yisa yi Galili na, ka nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o la.
en: Many women had come with Jesus from Galilee to be of help to him, and they were there, looking on at a distance.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa ʒe binfalafala maa lɔŋni, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama teei tuhi, ka yino kpiŋkpaŋ kpa o kpee polo. Ka binnɛma maa zaɣ yino kam daa zaŋ o kpiŋkpama ayi pɔbi omaŋa.
en: Just below the dome, their outstretched wings touched each other. They each also had two wings to cover their bodies.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, ka kari mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti be mɔɣu maa ni, ka gbɛri nimaani ka barina shɛli kani.
en: And I will make a peace agreement with my sheep. I will take harmful animals away from the land. Then the sheep can be safe in the desert and sleep in the woods.

dag: M piila ʒiɛyimtali soli. N zaŋla a zaligunim zali n tooni.
en: I have chosen to be obedient; I have paid attention to your judgments.

dag: Dama di nyɔri so anzinfa, ka di nyɔri lan so salima.
en: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes, just as his ancestor David had done.

dag: A ni ti boli ma, ka n saɣi. A kɔre ni ti be a nuhi tuma ni.
en: God, you would call me, and I would answer you. Then I, the one you made, would be important to you.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Timna ti nya Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga;.
en: Samson traveled down to Timnah. While he was in Timnah, a Philistine woman caught his eye.

dag: Ninvuɣ pia n-yi kpalim be yili yin ni, bɛ ni kpi.
en: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.

dag: Di saha ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, Ka n yi chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yi yaannim Naawuni n-tim ma yi sanna. Ka bɛ bɔhi ma, O yuli lee booni bɔ? Man yɛlim ba wula.
en: But Moses replied, When I go to the Israelites and say to them, The God of your ancestors sent me to you, they will ask me, What is his name? So what can I tell them.

dag: N zaŋ jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma la ti ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm la.
en: I have given them the glory that you gave me. I gave them this glory so that they can be one, just as you and I are one.

dag: Kuhimiya boli ma yi muɣisigu dali, ka n tiligi ya, ka yi ti ma jilima.
en: Cry out to me whenever you are in trouble; I will deliver you, then you will honor me.

dag: A daag o tiŋ gooni luhi, ka wurim o birininima.
en: You have torn down the walls of his city and left his forts in ruins.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti niŋ anabinim ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la naani pam. Ka yi yi niŋ ania dol li, yi niŋ din tuhi viɛnyɛliŋga, dama di ŋmanila firila din ne zibisim ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neerina ka biɛŋmariga neesim neei yi suhuri ni la.
en: So we are even more confident of the message proclaimed by the prophets. You will do well to pay attention to it, because it is like a lamp shining in a dark place until the Day dawns and the light of the morning star shines in your hearts.

dag: Bimbɔ zuɣu ka di daantalisi daa lee tamiya? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee sɔŋ di tuuli tampuɣili?.
en: What holds up the pillars that support the earth? Who laid the cornerstone of the world?.

dag: Yi yaanniin daa di bindir shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni ka kpi.
en: Your ancestors ate manna in the wilderness and they died.

dag: Amiram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Jokɛbɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi ni daa dɔɣi bipuɣin so Ijipti la. Ka Jokɛbɛd daa dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Miriam Amiram yiŋa.
en: Amrams wife was named Jochebed. She was also from the tribe of Levi. She was born in Egypt. Amram and Jochebed had two sons, Aaron and Moses. They also had a daughter, Miriam.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi di gooni maa gba kaman ninsal ni buɣisir binyara shɛm, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pihiyɔbu.
en: The angel also measured the wall, and it was feet high, according to the standard unit of measure which he was using.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ayi nyɛ Chiliab. O ma n-daa nyɛ Abigeel ŋun nyɛ Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la. Ka ŋun pah ata nyɛ Absalom. O ma n-daa nyɛ Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛshur Naa Talimai bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Chileab, whose mother was Abigail, Nabal's widow, from Carmel; Absalom, whose mother was Maacah, the daughter of King Talmai of Geshur;.

dag: Wurimbu, wurimbu, n ni wurim li! Di tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Naɣila ŋun mali soli ni o su li maa ti kana, ka n zaŋ li ti o. .
en: Ruin, ruin! Yes, I will make the city a ruin. But this will not happen until the one comes whom I have chosen to punish the city. To him I will give it.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.

dag: O daa bi biɛhim Naawuni daalikauli hal baabiɛla. O ni daa kul tibigiri Naawuni maa puuni ka o yɛda daa kul niŋdi kpiɔŋ pahira.
en: His faith did not leave him, and he did not doubt God's promise; his faith filled him with power, and he gave praise to God.

dag: Di saha ka ŋun nyɛ ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la daa kana ti kari saria sɔŋ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka saha daa paai ni wuntizɔriba maa deei nam su.
en: until the Ancient One came. Then judgment was given in favor of the holy ones of the Most High. The set time arrived, and the holy ones held the kingship securely.

dag: Di ka buchi, di nyɛla yɔhiŋ tuma. Di tibidarigibo saha, di ni bahi yoli.
en: They are a delusion, a charade; at the appointed time they will vanish!.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim zaa daa wum Filistianim maa ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa zaa.
en: When all the people of Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ʒili marigi yi dim buŋ sɔŋ tiŋa, yin di chɛ o mini ʒili maa sɔŋ, amaa yin sɔŋm o yiɣisi buŋ maa zali.
en: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kuli nti di ka nyu, ka niŋ shɛli tari, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa baŋ bɛ ni karim shɛli n-wuhi ba maa gbinni la zuɣu.
en: Then all the people went to eat the special meal. They shared their food and drinks. They celebrated that special day. They were happy that they could hear the reading of Gods law and were now able to understand it.

dag: ka zaŋ naɣilaa mini piɛlaa ni zim shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni, dama zuŋɔ Yawɛ ni yi zahira yi sani.
en: Take a bull and a ram for fellowship offerings. Take these animals and a grain offering mixed with oil for an offering to the Lord . Do this because the Lord will appear to you today.

dag: Amaa ka n daa kul timdi n daba bɛn zaa nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna ti yɛri ya, Jaande, miriya ka yi tum din chihiri shɛli n ni je.
en: Time after time I sent my servants the prophets to tell the people of Judah how much I hated their disgusting sins. The prophets warned them to stop sinning.

dag: Cham nuzaa polo ti moli yɛligu ŋɔ n-yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ku lan yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra. N ku je suli niŋ ya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Go proclaim these words to the north and say: Return, unfaithful Israel, declares the LORD. I wont reject you, for Im faithful, declares the LORD; I wont stay angry forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Yuŋ ka yɔɣili maa daa zani bili zooi n-neei biɛɣu niŋ dahin yini ka lan ŋmaligi kpi yuŋ. A bi niŋ li shɛli; pa nyin mi n-chɛ ka di zooi, amaa ka a zɔri li nambɔɣu.
en: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ wain tihi pum ti yɛn kpahi lu ka di wala moori saha shɛli, Itiɔpianim dimnim ni kana ti ku ba ka di bi to. Bɛ ni ti niŋ ba kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sua ŋ-ŋmahiri wain tiwula din teei shɛm la.
en: Before the harvest, when the bloom is finished, when the blossom is becoming a ripening fruit, God will cut the shoots with a pruning knife, and lop off the spreading branches.

dag: ka tum birigi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka bi doli n zalikpana la.
en: if they disregard my instructions and do not keep my commandments.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyolɔrigu lo o pahi, ka zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ di ni;.
en: Moses put the judgment pouch on Aaron and put the Urim and Thummim inside its pocket.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi daa ŋmanila biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bear la, ka o yiɣisi n-gbiligi ʒiɛya; ka sapir kɔba ata gbab o noli. Ka kuko shɛli daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim ŋubi nimdi pam.
en: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It was holding three ribs between its teeth, and a voice said to it, Go on, eat as much meat as you can.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin shɛli dihi niriba tusaanahi la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛr ayopɔin.
en: Jesus then asked, And how many baskets of leftovers did you pick up when I broke seven small loaves of bread for those , people? Seven, they answered.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti tiligi saɣi bɛ daalahichi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa tum ma bɛ yɔhiŋ puuni la mini bɛ ni zaɣisi ma dolibu.
en: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right.

dag: Jɛramiil daa lan mali paɣ so ka o yuli booni Atara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Onam ma.
en: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puu ni bindir tuuli mini yi puu ni tiwala kom na ti ti ma di tibu saha, ka di niŋya zinchili. Zaŋmiya yi bidib tuuli kam ti ma.
en: Dont delay offering the produce of your vineyards and winepresses. Give me your oldest son.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri yi suhuri ni?.
en: Jesus perceived what they were thinking, and so he said, Why are you thinking such evil things?.

dag: Ramanim mini Gɛbanim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisi ni yini.
en: of Ramah and Geba.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun nyɛ binneembila, ka nyɛ daadam ŋun nyɛ zunzuli ŋɔ.
en: how much less a human, a worm, a persons child, a grub.

dag: Yinima ŋ-ŋubiri n niriba ka shiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka ŋmari bɛ kɔba ka ŋmahiŋmahi ba kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣubil ni bee kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣutitali ni la.
en: You are destroying my people. You take their skin off them and break their bones. You chop their bones up like meat to put in the pot!.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ Shia o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli bee n-saɣis o?.
en: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o yab Dauda soli, ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee o nuzaa polo.
en: He did what was pleasing to the Lord ; he followed the example of his ancestor King David, strictly obeying all the laws of God.

dag: Daadamnim zaa tumdila bɛ tuma zaa dibu zuɣu, amaa bɛ na ʒi n-di n-tiɣi.
en: We do all our work just to get something to eat, but we never have enough.

dag: ti daa ti zahimla zahindi yuŋ dahin yini, ka ti zaa yino kam zahindi daa mali di gbinni.
en: We both dreamed one night, he and I, and each of our dreams had its own interpretation.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia hal ti paag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But the Chaldean army chased King Zedekiah and caught up with him in the Jericho plains. His entire army deserted him.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa yi ka luɣ shɛli nimaani nim baɣa ka shɛl ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: A nation without God's guidance is a nation without order. Happy are those who keep God's law!.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o binnamda zaa, ka be o nam sulinsi ni zaa ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni.
en: All Gods creatures, bless the LORD! Everywhere, throughout his kingdom, let my whole being bless the LORD!.

dag: Yawɛ dabisi titali la miriya. Di miriya, ka kanna yomyom. Ka Yawɛ dabisili maa kandina ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu pam, ka tɔbbihi ni ti ŋme tɔbuchiriga dindali maa.
en: The great day of the Lord is near—very near and coming fast! That day will be bitter, for even the bravest soldiers will cry out in despair!.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa di zuɣu.
en: God was angry when he saw it, so he rejected his people completely.

dag: Di simdi ka o wurim yili maa ka va di kuɣa mini di yɔɣira ni di tari zaa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: The house must be torn down. All the stones, plaster, and pieces of wood must be taken to the special unclean place outside the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Jɛhoyakim ŋun nyɛ Juda naa Jɔsia bia la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ti ku fabili o zuɣu yɛli, Mbaye, m mabia! Mbaye, m mabia! Bɛ mi ti ku fabili o zuɣu n-yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Mbaye, n naa.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD says to Jehoiakim son of Judahs King Josiah: They wont grieve for him, saying, My brother, my sister! They wont grieve for him, saying, My master, my majesty.

dag: O yaa bela o shee polo, ka o yiko be o pugbana puuni.
en: but what strength there is in his body, and what power there is in his muscles!.

dag: Di daa nyɛla chɛrubinim mini abie tihi kɔtomsi, chɛrubinima ayi sunsuuni abie tia n-daa beni. Chɛrubi yino kam daa malila ninni diba ayi.
en: of Cherub angels and palm trees. A palm tree was between each Cherub angel. Every Cherub angel had two faces.

dag: O mi o tuma ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuh o.
en: They learn this from their God.

dag: Amaa saha ni daa ti paai, Naawuni daa tim o Bia na n-chɛ ka paɣ dɔɣ o fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni.
en: But when the right time came, God sent his Son, who was born from a woman and lived under the law.

dag: lala n-nyɛ ti gba: Ti galisiya, amaa ti nyɛla niŋgbun yini Masia ni, ka ti zaa yinoyino nyɛ niŋgbuŋ yini maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Jesus warned the disciples not to tell anyone about him.

dag: ka chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒin o chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi puuni, ka chɛ ka bɛn be o tooni kuhiri yɛra, Damdimiy o tiŋa! Lala ka o daa niŋ zaŋ Yisifu leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zuɣulana.
en: Then he told Joseph to ride in his second chariot. Pharaohs officials said, Let him be the governor over the whole land of Egypt.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Amaria bia, ka Amaria nyɛ Azaria so bia, ka Azaria so maa nyɛ Mɛrayɔt bia.
en: son of Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraioth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu n-chani bɔri Yawɛ shee, amaa bɛ ti ku nya o, dama o zo bɛ sani.
en: With their sheep and their cattle they will go to seek the LORD, but they will not find him; he has withdrawn from them.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas daa yɛli Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili daŋ niriba maa, Zuŋɔ ti baŋya ni Yawɛ be ti sani, dama yi bi tum tuumbiɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani. Yi fa Izraɛlnim Yawɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: So Phinehas the priest said, Now we know that the Lord is with us and that you did not turn against him. We are happy that the Israelites will not be punished by the Lord .

dag: Ɛlam beni, ka di tɔbbihi zaa gili di gballi. Takɔbi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi guni ka kpe tiŋgban ni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ di vi chaŋ ti pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee zuɣu.
en: Elam is there, with the graves of her soldiers all around. They were all killed in battle, and they went down, uncircumcised, to the world of the dead. In life they spread terror, but now they lie dead and disgraced.

dag: Nol lɔbu maa daba ata dali ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o nam binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe n-ʒe nayili zɔŋ ni tuhi nam ʒiishee duu. Naa maa daa ʒila o nam ʒiishee tuhi dunoli.
en: Three days later, Esther put on royal clothes and stood in the inner courtyard of the palace, facing the palace itself. At that moment the king was inside sitting on his royal throne and facing the palace doorway.

dag: O lan nyɛla bɛn guni gba yaba, ka di pala bɛ ni guni maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ka di lee nyɛla bɛ gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni ka niŋ yɛda shɛm la zuɣu.
en: He is also the father of those who are circumcised, that is, of those who, in addition to being circumcised, also live the same life of faith that our father Abraham lived before he was circumcised.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyumiya hal ti kuli, ka ti li bahi, ka lu ka ku lan tooi yiɣisi yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka tɔb shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: Jeremiah, say to those nations, this is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says: Drink this cup of my anger. Get drunk from it and vomit. Fall down and dont get up. Dont get up because I am bringing wars against you.

dag: Zɛra zuliya ni, Jɛwɛl mini bɛ daŋ maa niriba kalinli daa nyɛla niriba kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiwɛi.
en: From Zerahs family: Jeuel and their relatives— in all.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so n-daa ti boli niriba pam ni bɛ ka o yiŋ na ti di bindira;.
en: Jesus said to him, There was once a man who was giving a great feast to which he invited many people.

dag: Dama n ni tibi yi dansi maa, ka tin ya alaafee, dama bɛ lihi ya la bɛn ka so. Ziɔn ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ bɛ baɣa ka maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well.

dag: Ka binshɛŋa din pahi nyɛla, n suhu kul zɔhirila cheechinim zaa zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: And there are many other problems. One of these is the care I have for all the churches. I worry about each group of believers every day.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa kpalim be vinvamli maa ni Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la.
en: So we stayed in the valley across from Beth Peor.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. N ni ti kari ya saria Izraɛl tintariga, ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You will fall by the sword! At Israels borders I will judge you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli, Nyama, wuntaŋ ni n-na bɔŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri maa taɣ kuli yiŋ saha na bi paai, dinzuɣu ŋɔŋmiya kom ti piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu, ka yi zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: He said to them, Its now only the middle of the day. Its not time yet to gather the animals. Water the flock, and then go, put them out to pasture.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl bɔh o, Ya ka a dabili ŋun nyɛ baa ŋɔ yɛn nya yiko n-tum tuun karili ŋɔ! Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ kahigi wuhi ma ni a ni ti leei Siria naa.
en: Hazael replied, How could your servant, who is nothing but a dog, do such mighty things? Elisha said, The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Aram.

dag: Ka o daa bi tooi baŋ o, dama o nuhi daa malila kɔbiri ŋ-ŋman o biɛli Iso nuhi. Ka o daa yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Isaac did not know it was Jacob, because his arms were hairy like Esaus. So Isaac blessed Jacob.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Let's go out to this field, and I'll tell you, Jonathan answered. When they got there.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Pool yɛli Baanabas, Chɛ ka ti lab tin shɛŋa ni ti ni daa moli ti Duuma yɛligu molo la nti kaai ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani maa n-nya bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go back and visit the believers in every town where we preached the word of the Lord, and let us find out how they are getting along.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbala du shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ kalo paligi di nyaansi ka di lihibu viɛla, amaa ka kpiimba kɔba mini daɣiri balibu kam pali di puuni la.
en: How terrible it will be for you legal experts and Pharisees! Hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs. They look beautiful on the outside. But inside they are full of dead bones and all kinds of filth.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti be sagbana ni kanna, ka sokam nina ni ti nya o, hal bɛn daa zaŋ kpani kuh o luɣili la gba ni ti nya o, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ti fabili bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛm zuɣu. Lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ. Ami.
en: Look, Jesus is coming with the clouds! Everyone will see him, even those who pierced him. All peoples of the earth will cry loudly because of him. Yes, this will happen! Amen.

dag: Yi bi teei ni n ni daa be yi san la, n daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla?.
en: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di chɛ ka paɣ so lan zali pua di yuŋ maa yaha. Di chɛ ka so lan wum suhupiɛlli vuri di ni yaha.
en: make it a barren, joyless night.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: Now this is the Instruction that Moses set before the Israelites.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa ti Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn kpiɔŋ ka o lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: The Israelites again did things that the LORD saw as evil, and the LORD put Moabs King Eglon in power over them, because they did these things that the LORD saw as evil.

dag: O yihi ma gballi ni. O zaŋ yurilim maŋli min o nambɔzɔbo leei zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: saves your life from the pit, crowns you with faithful love and compassion.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba o wuhibu maa ni, Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la.
en: Jesus continued teaching. He said, Be careful of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around wearing clothes that look important. And they love for people to show respect to them in the marketplaces.

dag: Tiŋgbani maŋmaŋ n-chɛ ka di niŋdi maa: Tuuli, di tɔrimi duna niŋ vari; din paya, ka di ti va puya n-naanyi dɔɣi;.
en: The soil itself makes the plants grow and bear fruit; first the tender stalk appears, then the head, and finally the head full of grain.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu ni nahim tin shɛli, ka di bi nya sɔŋsim ŋɔ, n ni zaŋ kuɣ viɛla me a zali, ka zaŋ safaya kuɣa sɔŋ a tanzaa.
en: You poor city! Enemies came against you like storms, and no one comforted you. But I will rebuild you. I will use a beautiful mortar to lay the stones of your walls. I will use sapphire stones when I lay the foundation.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Obɛdɛdom bidibisi. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ mabihi daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim, ka simdi ni bɛ tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Obɛdɛdom daŋ maa ni niriba.
en: There were descendants of Obed-Edom who were strong enough to be guards at the temple.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa daa dam, ka niriba zo n-laɣimna nti gbaai Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-dar o yi, ka dii yo di dunoya.
en: Confusion spread through the whole city, and the people all ran together, grabbed Paul, and dragged him out of the Temple. At once the Temple doors were closed.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kun ya tɔbu ni, ka gbahi yi ni shɛba ti leei daba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa na ku zan tariga. O daa loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yihi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda puuni sɔŋsim mini niriba ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ni bindira sɔŋsim zaa ni kom sɔŋsim zaa.
en: Now the Lord, the Almighty Lord , is about to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything and everyone that the people depend on. He is going to take away their food and their water.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N ni kana nti chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: I will go and make him well, Jesus said.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Zɔfai ni Nahat.
en: his son Elkanah, his son Zophai, his son Nahath.

dag: Nachimba daa yi nya ma, bɛ labiri la nyaaŋa, ka ninkura yiɣisi ti ma jilima.
en: the young leaders stepped aside, *.

dag: Di saha maa ha Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni binyara zaŋ kɔhi tab zuɣu bee n-zaŋ taɣi tab yɛla ŋmaabu kali daa yi nyɛla ŋun kɔhiri pirig o namdili ti ŋun dara, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa yi niŋdi ŋmaari yɛla.
en: In Israel, in former times, this was the practice regarding redemption and exchange to confirm any such matter: a man would take off his sandal and give it to the other person. This was the process of making a transaction binding in Israel.

dag: Ka Zua bia Nɛtanɛl nyɛ Isaka zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul dumi hal ti kpe zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mi du hal ni sagbana ni.
en: But your loyal love, LORD, extends to the skies; your faithfulness reaches the clouds.

dag: Ti zaa yinoyino deerila pin gahinda kaman Masia ni buɣisiri li shɛm tiri ti.
en: God has given his grace to each one of us measured out by the gift that is given by Christ.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol li Dauda tiŋa.
en: Because David went to live in the fortress, it came to be called David's City.

dag: Ka o ʒim maa yi na yir o, ka o dɔni bindo shɛlikam zuɣu, di ni bemi kaman o ni yi pun nyari sɔrilim ka dooni bindo shɛli zuɣu ka di nyɛ shɛm la. Ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim la.
en: Any bed she lies on during the discharge should be treated like the bed she uses during her menstruation; and any object she sits on will be unclean, as during her menstruation.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa ni barinyuriba, amaa bɛ barinyubo maa nyɛla yoli.
en: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.

dag: Sool gbaɣinɔʒiri maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi m-pah o zuɣu.
en: When the helper saw that Saul was dead, he took out his own sword, fell on it, and died there with Saul.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali yaa daa yi ti duri taba, Yaakubu zaŋdila dari maa sɔŋ bɛ tooni kɔbɔɣili maa gbini ni bɛ be dari maa gbini duri taba.
en: When the stronger sheep were mating near the drinking place, Jacob made sure that the spotted branches were there.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi nyaŋ o, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar attacked him, bound him with bronze chains, and took him to Babylon.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Aai, ti ni jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Then the people said to Joshua, No! The LORD is the one we will serve.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yi bihi zaa bɛn be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni so yi ti mali daɣiri ka miri binyɛr kasi shɛŋa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ ti man Yawɛ la, n ni yihi dilana n sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: If any one of your descendants touches these things, that person will become unclean. That person must be separated from me. The Israelites gave these things to me. I am the Lord .

dag: ni daŋ kam ni kpɛm bom jaaŋgbe yini ka jaaŋgbɛhi maa kalinli yiɣisi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ti a. Ka a sabi sokam yuli pa o jaaŋgbee zuɣu.
en: Tell the people of Israel to give you twelve walking sticks, one from the leader of each tribe. Write each man's name on his stick.

dag: Ka o mini Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni, ka bɛ to jina m-bɔri soli ni bɛ ku o.
en: He often had arguments with the Greek-speaking Jews, who began making plans to kill him.

dag: Naa, ti gba ni nyar a nam daanfaani la zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi bɔri ni ti nya a filiŋ, dinzuɣu ka ti timna ti yɛl a.
en: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.

dag: Amaa n dana, o bi boli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini maligumaana Zadok ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni a bia Sulemaana.
en: But he did not invite me, sir, or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or Solomon.

dag: O lan bom bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pali mini bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛlli shɛli maha ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam pa shɛli zuɣu ni chi sara, ni binnyura sara.
en: and a basket of loaves of unleavened bread made with fine flour and mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, along with their grain offering and their drink offering.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni, dama ŋun sani bɛ zaa kul bemi.
en: So they were not still dead, because he is the God only of living people. Yes, to God they are all still living.

dag: Ka ŋunkam niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yɛda mali shɛhira ŋɔ o suhu ni. Ka ŋunkam mi bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda zaŋ o leela ʒirilana, o ni bi niŋ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛl la yɛda zuɣu.
en: The one who believes in Gods Son has the testimony within; the one who doesnt believe God has made God a liar, because that one has not believed the testimony that God gave about his Son.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Nyamiya, n je yi kan shɛŋa yi ni pirita ka zaŋ li diri n niriba nyɛviya maa. N ni dari chihi li yi nuhi ni ka chɛ ka yi ni mal li doli shɛba ni yi di bɛ nyɛviya kaman noonsi la nya bɛmaŋa.
en: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Whoever does Gods will is my brother, sister, and mother.

dag: Ka naa maa baŋdiba daa kana ti zani, amaa ka so daa ka bɛ ni ŋun ni tooi karim sabbu maa bee n-wuhi di gbinni.
en: All of King Belshazzar's highest officials came in, but not one of them could read the writing or tell what it meant.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Iyim n-chaŋ ti dɔni Dibɔngaad.
en: They marched from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.

dag: Ka o daa yihiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla waazu, ka wuhiri ba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛla palɔni, ka so daa bi kar o lala niŋbu ni.
en: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.

dag: Dama o daa lab me buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim la; ka lan lab me Baal mini Ashɛra bimbina zali kaman Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa niŋ shɛm la; ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi.
en: He rebuilt the pagan places of worship that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he built altars for the worship of Baal and made an image of the goddess Asherah, as King Ahab of Israel had done. Manasseh also worshiped the stars.

dag: Hal Naa Dauda kpambaliba zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni daa be o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo maa zaa yoli, doo maa daa pihila kuɣa labiri Dauda mini ba zaa.
en: He threw rocks at David and at all of King Davids servants, even though the entire army and all the warriors were on either side of him.

dag: Ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Kum o! Kum o! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, N kpahimi yi Naa maa tabili dapulli zuɣu? Ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ka naa pahila Naa Siiza.
en: Kill him! Kill him! they yelled. Nail him to a cross! So you want me to nail your king to a cross? Pilate asked. The chief priests replied, The Emperor is our king.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Ɛliɛza mini Ishija ni Malikija so mi ni Shɛmaya.
en: Of the family of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋa n-leei yi zaa ha bia.
en: But the one who is greatest among you will be your servant.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Anɛr mini Biliam ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti Kɔhat ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim la mi.
en: and from half the tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasturelands, and Bileam with its pasturelands, for the Kohathite clans who remained.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o lee suhimi ni yɛda ka bi biɛhinda, dama ŋun biɛhindi ŋmanila teeku kɔgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri ka di laŋsira.
en: But when you ask God, you must believe. Dont doubt him. Whoever doubts is like a wave in the sea that is blown up and down by the wind.

dag: O daa tɛhiya ni o mabihi maa baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o na ni o ti fa ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ lala.
en: Moses thought that his people would understand that God was using him to save them. But they did not understand.

dag: Nam din ti yɛn doli a nam ŋɔ nyaaŋa ti ku paag a dini ŋɔ. Di nyaaŋa, ka nam din pah ata n-nyɛ daanya ka ti yɛn su dunia zaa la deei.
en: After you there will be another empire, not as great as yours, and after that a third, an empire of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram bidibisi ni, Shubaɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shubaɛl bidibisi ni, Jɛdɛiya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: These are other heads of families descended from Levi: Jehdeiah, a descendant of Amram through Shebuel;.

dag: Tinsi ŋɔ zaa wuna maa puuni wun ŋuni n-na tooi fa bɛ tinsi maa shɛli n nuu ni bahi, ka Yawɛ ti yɛn fa Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahi? .
en: Which one of the gods from those countries has rescued their land from my power? Will the LORD save Jerusalem from my power.

dag: Ka Juda maa daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia, ka Yaakubu nyɛ Yisahaku bia, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Ibrahimma bia, ka Ibrahimma nyɛ Tɛra bia, ka Tɛra mi nyɛ Nahɔr bia.
en: Jacob, Isaac, Abraham, Terah, Nahor.

dag: Di saha ka nolɔɣu dii kum pahi buyi, ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni nolɔɣu ti yɛn kum buyi o ni chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa la yɛla. Ka di daa niŋ Pita suhugarigu ka o kum pam.
en: As soon as Peter said this, the rooster crowed the second time. Then he remembered what Jesus had told him: Before the rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you dont know me. Then Peter began to cry.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Faashee a nya shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa, di yi pa lala, a ku niŋ yɛda.
en: Jesus told the official, You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders.

dag: Bɛ yɛla mali dabiɛm pam, bɛ karimbaani zuɣu bɛ zalila bɛmaŋmaŋ zaligunima.
en: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔab yaa naaya. Di lan ka yiko.
en: Moabs horn is cut off; its arm is broken, declares the LORD.

dag: Amaa ka daa naɣ piila Juda zuliya mini Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ o ni yuri shɛl la.
en: Instead, he chose the tribe of Judah, the mountain of Zion, which he loves.

dag: Ŋunkam chihi Bia maa, o ka ti Ba Naawuni. Ka ŋunkam deei Bia maa mali ti Ba Naawuni gba.
en: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.

dag: Ibrahimma Naawuni mini Nahɔr Naawuni ni bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti ti. Ka Yaakubu daa po o ba Yisahaku ni jɛmdi Naawuni so maa.
en: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor will keep order between us. So Jacob gave his word in the name of the awesome one of his father Isaac.

dag: N ni ti vuɣi Ashɛra binwɔɣila la yi sani, ka wurim yi fɔntinsi.
en: I will tear down your sacred poles in your midst; I will destroy your cities!.

dag: Ka timpani yi bi kum tɔb chiriga kumsi ŋuni n-lee ni mali shili chaŋ tɔb tuhibu?.
en: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama o ni tɔɣisi suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-ti o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku ŋmaligi labi jɛrilim biɛhigu ni yaha.
en: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ wumpaɣibo mali sara ti ma la ti ma la jilima, ka bɛnkam mi doli soli din tuhi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya tiliginsim man Naawuni sani.
en: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri n nasara dibu la suhuri paligi ka bɛ tahiri suhupiɛlli tahigu yɛri sahakam, Yawɛ ŋun bɔr o dabili nasara dibu ŋɔ galisiya pam.
en: May those who want to see me acquitted shout for joy and say again and again, How great is the Lord ! He is pleased with the success of his servant.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni daŋ kam ni dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔb ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: The official record of their descendants by families listed , men eligible for military duty.

dag: Ka Musa daa silim o zuɣu tiŋ yomyom n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Sool ni daa ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee, o daa tuh o dimnim bɛn be bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa. O daa tuhi Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnima ni Ɛdomnima ni Zɔba nanima ni Filistianima; o ni daa tuhi shɛb zaa, o daa dila nasara.
en: Saul took full control of Israel and fought all the enemies who lived around Israel. Saul fought Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the king of Zobah, and the Philistines. He defeated Israels enemies wherever he went.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Hazɛrɔt saha shɛli maa ka Miriam mini Aduna daa galim Musa o ni daa kpuɣi Itiɔpia paɣ so la zuɣu, dama o daa kpuɣila Itiɔpia zuliya ni paɣa.
en: When they were in Hazeroth, Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses on account of the Cushite woman whom he had married—for he had married a Cushite woman.

dag: Tuumba bɛn ʒe yim ŋmanila atam kpuɣibu saha sakuɣili din maai bɛ kpamba sani; bɛ chɛ ka bɛn tim ba suhuri maara.
en: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.

dag: Di saha ka Finɛhas daa yiɣisi zani n-tim sandaani ka alɔbo maa chɛ.
en: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, cham ti nya guliŋguhi biɛhigu, ka niŋ yɛm.
en: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Go to Pharaoh and say to him, This is what the LORD, the Hebrews God, says: Let my people go so that they can worship me.

dag: Ka yɛda niŋbu wunsuhigu ni tiligi bara maa, ka ti Duuma ni yiɣis o; ka o yi tumla alahichi gba, o ni nya di chɛ m-paŋ.
en: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.

dag: A zaŋ a yiko nuu tilig a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu mini Yisifu zuliya la.
en: By your power you saved your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

dag: Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm; ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛli, dama ti bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: Teach us what to say to God; our minds are blank; we have nothing to say.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yeeg omaŋmaŋ kparibu shɛli o ni ye n-ti Dauda, ka zaŋ o gbaɣino ti o, hal ka zaŋ o takɔbi min o tɔbu ni o gban shɛli o ni mali lɔr o shee ni ti o pahi.
en: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his armor, as well as his sword, his bow, and his belt.

dag: Yisa noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka do so yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na ti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Di lan muɣisiri karimba maa yaha.
en: While Jesus was speaking, someone came from Jairus' home and said, Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda nayili polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ŋmanila Giliad n sani, ka ŋmani Lɛbanɔn zoya, amaa m poya ni n ni zaŋ a leei tiŋgban nɛli, ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli.
en: To me, Judah's royal palace is as beautiful as the land of Gilead and as the Lebanon Mountains; but I will make it a desolate place where no one lives.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ ŋme n-dila nɛma, ka bɔri ni bɛ pir li tari taba; ka tɔbbia kam nya paɣisar yino bee bɛba ayi, ka Sisɛra nya chinchin suŋ, ka man gba nya nɛma maa ni yɛri zaɣ suma ayi ye.
en: Wouldnt they be finding and dividing the loot? A girl or two for each warrior; loot of colored cloths for Sisera; loot of colored, embroidered cloths; two colored, embroidered cloths as loot for every neck.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti yɛl a, A ku wuhi ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni.
en: When your people ask you to tell them what this means.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣili paɣ maa lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing for me.

dag: bɛ yi yɛli ya di yɛla bee yi yi wum di yɛla, ka yi vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din chihiri maa shiri tumiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If you hear bad news like this, you must check it carefully. You must learn if it is true that this terrible thing has really happened in Israel. If you prove that it is true.

dag: ni Jɛshua ni Molada ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: in Jeshua, in Moladah and Beth-pelet.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi anabinim gbala, ka maani wuntizɔriba yɛla teebu binyara zaana.
en: How terrible it will be for you legal experts and Pharisees! Hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ so ni ti di nam, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be Iri.
en: The nation of Israel will trample them down And wipe out the last survivors.

dag: Yawɛ Yɛliya, Tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni ti kpalim dabari, amaa n ti ku saɣim di zaa.
en: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli neesim maa wuntaŋ ni, ka boli zibisim maa mi yuŋ. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din daŋ tooni.
en: God named the light day, and he named the darkness night. There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the first day.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n ti zaŋ ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be kaman yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli chi mini kawana ni wain ni bindira ni tihi puri ni be.
en: until I come to take you to a land just like your land. It will be a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

dag: Doo yi chɛ ka o dɔbilim yina, ŋun sum o niŋgbuŋ zaa kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If a man has a flow of semen, he must bathe his whole body in water. He will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ti leela ti ʒiʒiinitab ni maani shɛb ansarisi, ka leei bɛn gili ti ni maani shɛb ansarisi ka lari ti.
en: The countries around us insult us. The people around us laugh at us and make fun of us.

dag: Naa yi doli zaligu soli n-kariti nandaamba saria, o nam ni zani yuui.
en: If a king judges the poor fairly, he will rule for a long time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda Aiya bipuɣiŋga Rizipa ŋun daa nyɛ Sool mam la ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: People told David what Sauls slave woman Rizpah was doing.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a fɔntinsi wurim, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o sani palli naŋgbanyee ti yɛl o, Kamina ti chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Dama o daa bi mi ni o bia pakoli maa m-bala. Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma ka chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: and asked her to sleep with him. She asked, What will you give me if I do.

dag: A mini Speen daa gɔrila kɔhigu tab tiŋgbɔna ni, yi ni daa mali azichi pam zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ di anzinfa mini kuriti ni dalima ni nuɣiso n-taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: Tarshish was one of your best customers. They traded silver, iron, tin, and lead for all the wonderful things you sold.

dag: Ka Hiburu nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a la sapashin kpɛm dabili daa be ti sani, ka ti yɛl o, ka o daa wuhi ti ti zaa yinoyino zahindi gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: A young Hebrew man, a servant of the commander of the royal guard, was with us. We described our dreams to him, and he interpreted our dreams for us, giving us an interpretation for each dream.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dab so Naawuni ni pii ka boli ni n leei tumo m-moli ŋun Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sanna.
en: From Paul, a slave of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle and set apart for Gods good news.

dag: Ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: Those in the field shouldnt come back to grab their clothes.

dag: N daa kuhi pam niŋ o, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣ o.
en: I cried out to him for help, and I praised him. If I had been hiding sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened to me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam binnɛma zaɣ kara niŋ teeku ni, ka nam binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be kom ni chana ni noonsi balibu kam. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: So God created the great sea monsters, all kinds of creatures that live in the water, and all kinds of birds. And God was pleased with what he saw.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa lan tum tuun biɛ shɛli pahi; dina n-nyɛ o ni daa gbaai Jɔn kpɛhi duu la.
en: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi nyala daŋa, dindina yin doliya zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: If there is further injury, then you will give a life for a life.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi nyɛla bi biɛɣu, ka yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundina.
en: But if he is a bad servant, he will tell himself that his master will not come back for a long time.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o jaaŋgbee maa tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani maa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim yi wulimpuhili polo na n-ʒe dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka pɔhim maa ʒi toli na.
en: So Moses stretched out his shepherds rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD made an east wind blow over the land all that day and all that night. When morning came, the east wind had carried in the locusts.

dag: Di saha maa, n shiri ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ yi dab bidibisi mini yi dab bipuɣinsi ni.
en: In those days I will pour out my Spirit even on servants, both men and women.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na kul bi baŋ Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni o ni ti neei kum ni la gbinni.
en: At that time Peter and the other disciple did not know that the Scriptures said Jesus would rise to life.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa n-du n-kpɛhi ti sɔŋ Naawuni nir maa garo zuɣu; ka yina n-vooi dunoli yo.
en: She carried him upstairs to Elisha's room and laid him across the bed. Then she walked out and shut the door behind her.

dag: N niŋ ti Duuma naani ni yi ku doli din be di ko ka chɛ n ni doli so shɛl la. Ka ŋun chirindi ya yi kul nyɛ sokam, o ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: I trust in the Lord that you will not believe those different ideas. Someone is trying to confuse you. Whoever it is will be punished.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Riu.
en: When Peleg was years old, he became the father of Reu.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim ni daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ daa tala bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma daɣiri. Bɛ ni daa be shɛm n sani daa ŋmanila paɣa ni nya sɔrilim ka bi lan be nyam shɛm la.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm Chɛdolaoma la yuun pinaayi, amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pinaata la ni ka bɛ daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku lan jɛm o.
en: For twelve years they had served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they revolted.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi pa di olivi tihi dari pundi maa zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka lan dooi shɛli pa chɛrubinim mini abie tihi la gba zuɣu.
en: They made the two doors from olive wood. The workers carved pictures of Cherub angels, palm trees, and flowers on the doors. Then they covered the doors with gold.

dag: ni binshɛɣukam din mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa daa kpi.
en: Everything on dry land with lifes breath in its nostrils died.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa chɛ ka tɔbbi shɛb lɔɣi gilila Judanim maa nyaaŋa nti sɔɣi dɔni gu ba, ka bɛn kpalim mi be bɛ tooni polo.
en: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.

dag: ni Kɛila ni Akizib ni Marɛsha ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara awɛi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah. In total: nine cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ: ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni nandahima ni ti beni sahasaha.
en: Remember this: There are some terrible times coming in the last days.

dag: Ka di daa gari Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka doo ŋɔ lee niŋ mi yɛla ŋɔ, ka pa ŋun nya bɔhimbu.
en: Astonished, the Jewish leaders asked, Hes never been taught! How has he mastered the Law.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka a bi dol a ni daa po pɔ shɛli Yawɛ sani maa mini zaligu shɛli n ni daa zal a maa.
en: So why didnt you obey me? Why did you break your promise to the Lord ?.

dag: Suhugarigu so lari, dama nandahima nyɛla din tahiri suhukpaŋsibo na.
en: Sorrow is even better than laughter, because when our face is sad, our heart becomes good.

dag: Kpiɔŋlana, lom a takɔbi tabil a gbalipini a jilima min a nam dariza ni.
en: Strap on your sword, great warrior, with your glory and grandeur.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be wuhibu ni, ka gbilisi tibili wum baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Pay attention to your teacher and learn all you can.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri firila na mi n-kpi? Bɛ na mi n-nya ashaara? Ka Naawuni suhu na mi n-yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka biɛrim paai ba?.
en: How often does the lamp of the wicked flicker or disaster come upon them, with its fury inflicting pain on them?.

dag: ka Zikiri daa nyɛ Abija daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Pilitai daa nyɛ Miniamin mini Mɔadia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Abijahs family was Zicri. The leader of Miniamin and Maadiahs families was Piltai.

dag: Wuntizɔra laara nyɛla din tahir o nyɛvili shee, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyɔri nyɛ din kpɛhir o alahichi ni.
en: What good people do brings life, but wicked people produce only sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Keenan Naa Jabin.
en: On that day God defeated King Jabin of Canaan for the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a paɣiba zaa min a bidibisi yi nti ti Babilɔnnima, ka amaŋmaŋ ku tiligi bɛ nuu ni. Amaa Babilɔn naa ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaag a, ka nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim.
en: All your wives and children will be brought out. They will be given to the Babylonian army. You yourself will not escape from the army of Babylon. You will be captured by the king of Babylon, and Jerusalem will be burned down.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ku lɔrig o nahu bee o buŋa n-taɣ o chaŋ kuliga ka o ti nyu kom Vuhim Dabisili dali?.
en: The Lord answered him, You hypocrites! Any one of you would untie your ox or your donkey from the stall and take it out to give it water on the Sabbath.

dag: A ni nyɛ Yisa Masia tɔbbia ŋun ʒe yim la zuɣu, pahimi ti zuɣu di wahala.
en: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa zuɣu, bɛ suhuri ku zɔhiri bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: People dont have many years to live, so they must remember these things all their life. God will keep them busy with the work they love to do.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn su laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nɛma fukumsi, ka tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni, ka lan tumdi tuma tiri Izraɛlnima.
en: They will be responsible for all the equipment of the meeting tent and the duties on behalf of the Israelites when they do the work of the dwelling.

dag: Zilinli ŋmanila buɣim. Zilinli lan ŋmanila dunia ŋɔ yɛl biɛri m-be ti niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-tari ti niŋgbuna maa zaa daɣiri, ka zaŋdi buɣim n-juuri ti dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu, ka buɣim din bi kpiri la mi taari li.
en: The tongue is a small flame of fire, a world of evil at work in us. It contaminates our entire lives. Because of it, the circle of life is set on fire. The tongue itself is set on fire by the flames of hell.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni bɛ bo mɔri na.
en: So the people went everywhere in Egypt looking for straw.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla sokam dim ka nyuma, ka diri bɛ tuma nyaɣisim. Di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.

dag: O tihi nyɔŋ maa ni tihi din kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, hal ka bia ni tooi kal li.
en: There will be a few trees left standing in the forest—so few that even a child could count them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piripiri ba kaman Lɛvi bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then David divided them into three groups named after Levis family members: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka mali yɛm, o so ninvuɣ kurigu ŋun nyɛ naa, ka nyɛ jɛrigu ŋun ku saɣi deei saɣisigu.
en: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Zuf, ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun daa be o sani maa, Kamina ka ti lab kuli, di yi pa lala m ba ni chɛ bunsi ŋɔ yɛla tɛhibu ka kpalim tɛhirila ti yɛla.
en: Finally they came to the territory where the clan of Zuph lived. Let's go back home, Saul told his servant. If we don't go back soon, my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.

dag: Isaka zuliya n-daa pah anahi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The lot went out fourth for the clans of Issachar.

dag: ka booi kom din be kasi niŋ laa ni, ka tooi taŋkpaɣu din do Naawuni jɛmbu shee tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ li niŋ kom maa ni.
en: Then he will take some special water and put it in a clay jar. He will put some dirt from the floor of the Holy Tent into the water.

dag: Jona ni daa piligi chani gindi tiŋ maa, o daa chanimi ka kuhiri yɛra, Di kpalim biɛɣ pihinahi ka Naawuni chɛ ka Ninive lɛb pili. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ti paai dahin yini chandi tariga.
en: Jonah started into the city, walking one day, and he cried out, Just forty days more and Nineveh will be overthrown.

dag: Yisa ni daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni lan baai du duli ha nti ʒe teeku noli ka salo pam daa lan laɣim o sanna.
en: Jesus went back to the other side of the lake in the boat. There, a large crowd of people gathered around him on the shore.

dag: amaa paɣ kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu, ka di bemi kaman o pin la o zuɣu maa la.
en: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.

dag: Yawɛ, n wum a yuli ni du shɛm yɛla. Yawɛ, ka a tuma chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Tummi li ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yaha, ka chɛ ka ti baŋ li ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni; a suhuyiɣisili saha, teemi nambɔzɔbo yɛla.
en: I know your reputation, Lord , and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba laɣiŋgunim daa laɣim yi luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Nɛtɔfa tiŋkpansi.
en: And all the singers also came to Jerusalem. They came from the towns all around Jerusalem. They came from the town of Netophah, from Beth Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth. The singers had built small towns for themselves in the area around Jerusalem.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a so Tɛbis din baɣi Nail ka kom gil li, ka teeku nyɛ din taɣiri li ka kom nyɛ di gooni la?.
en: Are you better than Thebes, situated by the Nile, waters surrounding her, whose fortress is sea and whose city wall is waters?.

dag: Nyamiya, Naawuni be ti sani, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zuɣulana, ka o maligumaaniba mi mali tɔbutuhiri kikahi ni bɛ piɛb niŋ ti ka ti tuhi ya. Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, miriya ka yi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, dama yi ku di nasara.
en: Listen! God is on our side, at our head, along with his priests, who are ready to sound the battle trumpets against you. So, Israelites, dont fight against the LORD, the God of your ancestors, for you wont succeed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti bi nya Yisa tuumba maa sarika maa ni ka labina ti yɛli.
en: However, the guards didnt find them in the prison. They returned and reported.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee be ya.
en: Where is the king of Hamath? The king of Arpad? The king of the city of Sepharvaim? The kings of Hena and Ivvah.

dag: N ni ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka ku noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini teeku ni zahim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuui; n ni ku ninsalinim zaa dunia yili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will destroy all the people and all the animals. I will destroy the birds in the air and the fish in the sea. I will destroy the evil people and everything that makes them sin. I will remove all people from the earth. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Joɛl n-daa nyɛ zuɣulana ka Shafam nyɛ ŋun pa o zuɣu, ka Janai mini Shafat mi doli bɛ nyaaŋa Bashan tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Joel was the first, Shapham the second, and Janai governed Bashan.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛla teebu mali alibarika. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun yuli ni kpi.
en: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked rots.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiy o, A dabili Yaakubu n-su ba, ka zaŋ ba ti ti ni ti zaŋ ba na ti ti nyini n-dan Iso pini, ka din pahi nyɛla, omaŋmaŋ doli ti nyaaŋa na. .
en: So tell him, They belong to your servant Jacob, who is coming this way. He is sending them as a gift to his master Esau. .

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisiya pam ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: As the crowd heard these words, they became furious and started shouting, Great is Artemis of Ephesus.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim polo pɔhim ni ŋme shɛli ka di zaɣi daa to n-yina pahi kawaan kara maa zuɣu.
en: Later, seven other heads of grain appeared, but they were thin and scorched by a wind from the desert.

dag: bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: They counted all the men from to years old who were able to serve. These men were given special work to do for the Meeting Tent.

dag: Amaa m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni doo kam zuɣulana nyɛla Masia; ka paɣ zuɣulana nyɛ o yidana; ka Masia mi zuɣulana nyɛ Naawuni.
en: Now I want you to know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, ŋunkam daa kpe yili maa ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kpar li zali la nyɛla ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, Amaŋmaŋ n-kul bɔhi ma lala bee shɛba n-yɛl a n yɛla lala.
en: Jesus said, Is that your own question, or did other people tell you about me.

dag: Ka Musa daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: Moses enrolled them according to the LORDs word as he was commanded.

dag: O ni daa ti miri Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani zo shɛli bɛ ni booni Olivi Tihi zol la gbini ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: As he came near Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, he sent two disciples ahead.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli Pita, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! A nyɛla tigbirigu n soli zuɣu, dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: Jesus turned around and said to Peter, Get away from me, Satan! You are an obstacle in my way, because these thoughts of yours don't come from God, but from human nature.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yinyari mini zoontali ni suhufuŋbo be yi suhuri ni;.
en: The Lord will make you lose your mind; he will strike you with blindness and confusion.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi tuhi nintɔri ka di shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka daɣiri, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If the one with the emission spits on a clean person, the clean person must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la, zaŋ labi Hamat polo, o ni daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ bini zal o Sulinsi tariga Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli luɣ shɛli la.
en: Next, David attacked King Hadadezer of the Syrian state of Zobah, near the territory of Hamath, because Hadadezer was trying to gain control of the territory by the upper Euphrates River.

dag: ni Araba zaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɔt Teeku din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt polo zaŋ kpa Araba Teeku din nyɛ Yalim Teeku n-do n-lab nudirigu polo Pisiga tintan ni la.
en: He also ruled over the eastern side of the Jordan Valley from Lake Galilee to the Dead Sea . And he ruled from Beth Jeshimoth to the south to the hills of Pisgah.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa be bɛ ni galim Yisa nyaandoliba maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi diri ka nyura.
en: Some Pharisees and some teachers of the Law who belonged to their group complained to Jesus' disciples. Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and other outcasts? they asked.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔhi tihi din yi Sɛnir na m-mali a dapaɣa zaa. Bɛ daa ŋmahila Lɛbanɔn sida tihi daantalisi na ti sa a ni.
en: They used fir trees from Mount Hermon for timber And a cedar from Lebanon for your mast.

dag: O kɔŋko n-daa yɛrigi sagbana, ka no teeku kɔgbana sɔŋ.
en: stretched out the heavens alone and trod on the waves of the Sea.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn ku wum a yɛligu, dama bɛ bi bɔri ni bɛ wum n yɛligu maa; Izraɛlnim zaa ni nyɛ bɛn suhuri kpɛma mini tipawumlinim zuɣu.
en: But none of the people of Israel will be willing to listen; they will not even listen to me. All of them are stubborn and defiant.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛm la. O daa lan ka bidibisi yaha, amaa Rɛhabia ŋun bidibisi daa galisiya pam.
en: Eliezers oldest son was Rehabiah. Eliezer had no other sons. But Rehabiah had very many sons.

dag: O zuɣu nyɛla salima alali. O zabikpila kul gahirimi, ka sabigi kaman kahiŋkɔɣu la.
en: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is curly and as black as a raven.

dag: Dama tinim ku tooi chɛ ti ni daa nya ka wum shɛli maa yɛla tɔɣisibu.
en: We cannot be quiet. We must tell people about what we have seen and heard.

dag: Yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi nyaŋ Sintani yɛŋkiŋkabina soya zaa.
en: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.

dag: Ka kpambal so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti boli Mikaya na maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa ni naai noli yɛli shɛm nyɛla din doli naa suhu ni yu shɛm. A gba kul yɛlimi la din tiɣi naa nini kaman bɛ zaa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Meanwhile, the messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, Listen, the prophets all agree that the king will succeed. You should say the same thing they say and prophesy success.

dag: Ka Jɔshua garigi yɛli ba, Yi yi galisi pam, ka Ifriim zuliya niriba zoya tiŋgban la pɔri ka bi saɣi ya, yin chamiya Pɛrizinim mini Rɛfaimnim tiŋgban ni yɔɣu la ni nti ŋma nyɔŋ ʒini.
en: Joshua replied, If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa, ka zaŋ li niŋ o baɣaka.
en: Pharaoh ignored what Moses and Aaron had done. He turned and went into his house.

dag: Di chɛ ka kɔgbana lim ma bee n-chɛ ka kɔbulli di ma bee n-chɛ ka bɔɣ zilinli mum ma niŋ.
en: Dont let the waves drown me. Dont let the deep sea swallow me or the grave close its mouth on me.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ka Yawɛ zali ya ni yi niŋ, ka ŋun Yawɛ jilima yi zahira yi sani.
en: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.

dag: Kpambaliba bɛn be di ni ŋmanila kunduna n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa, ka kuri niriba ni bɛ doli bibiɛlim soya nya buni.
en: The government officials are like wolves tearing apart the animals they have killed. They commit murder in order to get rich.

dag: Ka Kɛnan maa daa nyɛ Ɛnɔs bia, ka Ɛnɔs nyɛ Sɛt bia, ka Sɛt mi nyɛ Adam bia, ka Adam mi nyɛ Naawuni bia.
en: Cainan was the son of Enos. Enos was the son of Seth. Seth was the son of Adam. Adam was the son of God.

dag: Ka binnɛɔŋ balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, noonsi mini yiŋ biŋkɔbiri ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛn be dunia ni zaŋ tabili ninsalinim zaa.
en: Not a bird, animal, reptile, or human was left alive anywhere on earth.

dag: Chɛ ka di leei liɣa, ka zibisim titali be di ni. Chɛ ka sagbana zibigi niŋ di ni. Chɛ ka zibisim nyaŋ di neesim.
en: Make it a day of gloom and thick darkness; cover it with clouds, and blot out the sun.

dag: Dama ʒiri ʒiinim ti ku lan beni, ka ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa gba ti ku lan be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: There will not be any more false visions in Israel. There will not be any more magicians telling things that dont come true.

dag: Bɛn daa nyɛ jɛra maa daa zaŋla bɛ firilanima, ka lee bi ʒi kpam pahi ni bɛ ti gu bɛmaŋa;.
en: The foolish girls took their lamps with them, but they did not take extra oil for the lamps.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd pie kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: in the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;.

dag: Yɛm yɛla nyɛla din kpɛm pam ŋun ka yɛm sani. O yi be dunɔdali shee o bi yaar o noli.
en: Fools cannot understand wisdom. They have nothing to say when people are discussing important things.

dag: Nyama, n Duuma NAAWUNI daa wuhi ma, ka n nya ka o namla toli ka bɛ galisi pam, bɛ ni daa chɛ nayili wɔrimɔri, ka mɔri maa lan piligi puhirina saha shɛli.
en: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.

dag: Ibrahimma mam ŋun yuli daa booni Kɛtuura la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-daa nyɛ: Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua. Jokishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan.

dag: N ni zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi n-kɔhi Judanim zuɣu; ka bɛ mi zaŋ ba kɔhi Sabinim bɛn nyɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋ la nim zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will let your sons and daughters be sold to the people of Judah; they will sell them to the far-off Sabeans. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul diri wahala Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba tooi nya tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni ka mali jilima din ku naai la.
