en: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so ti chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A gba yi be Yisa ŋun yi Galili na ŋɔ sani.
en: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant woman came and said to him, You were also with Jesus the Galilean.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti yɛl o zuliya maa, N saɣi kpibu; amaa Naawuni ni ti ka yi sanna nti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya kulisi o ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: Joseph said to his brothers, Im about to die. God will certainly take care of you and bring you out of this land to the land he promised to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ŋmanila Ziɔn Zoli din ku tooi dam, ka kul ni beni sahakam la.
en: The people who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion: never shaken, lasting forever.

dag: Di nyɛnya gbinnyaɣinima, amaa lee tummiya ni yi suhuri zaa, ka jɛmmiya ti Duuma.
en: Work hard and do not be lazy. Serve the Lord with a heart full of devotion.

dag: tiri m biyurigu Timoti. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya nia nyɛla nia biɛri, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila buɣim nyoori niriba.
en: Worthless people dig up trouble; their lips are like a scorching fire.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Lala ka Izraɛlnim ti yɛn ŋubiri bɛ bɔrɔbɔro daɣiri n ni ti yɛn kari ba tahi zuliya shɛb ni maa sani.
en: The Lord said, This represents the way the Israelites will have to eat food which the Law forbids, when I scatter them to foreign countries.

dag: Amaa so yi bɔri ni o ŋme dimbɔŋɔ naŋgbankpeeni, ti ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu, ka Naawuni cheechinim gba lan ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu.
en: But if someone wants to argue about this, we dont have such a custom, nor do Gods churches.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi niɣi chani vinvamli ni shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ Shia daa ti o niriba vuhim. Lala ka o daa wuh o niriba maa soli, ka di ti o yuli jilima.
en: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka Ijipti do so muɣisir o mabihi maa ni yino ka di ka soli, ka o ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa.
en: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he defended him. Moses hit the Egyptian to pay him back for hurting the man. He hit him so hard that it killed him.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka bol o, Ibrahimma, Ibrahimma! Ka o saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven, Abraham, Abraham! He answered, Yes, here I am.

dag: Maika daa malila binnana jɛmbu duu; ka daa she mukuru laasabu din nyɛ bɛ ni daa lihiri shɛli ni buɣiri baɣa niŋ di ni, ka daa zaŋ o bidib yino leeg o maligumaana.
en: Micah had a temple for worshiping idols. He made an ephod and some house idols. Then Micah chose one of his sons to be his priest.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa bɔhi Dauda, Baa n-nyɛ ma ka a zaŋ kpahi kani n sanna? Ka o daa kar o buɣa bahiri Dauda zuɣu.
en: The Philistine asked David, Am I some sort of dog that you come at me with sticks? And he cursed David by his gods.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka duh o nam maa ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Then David knew that the Lord had really made him king of Israel and had made him ruler over his kingdom for the good of his people, Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni; amaa ka yɛl o, Ti mabia, a nya Yɛhudianim tusatusa ni niŋdi yɛda ka na kul kumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu shɛm bebɔ?.
en: When the leaders heard this, they praised God. Then they said to Paul, Brother, you can see that thousands of Jews have become believers, but they think it is very important to obey the Law of Moses.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sool daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim mini suhudoo sara maligu pina la ti ma na.
en: So Saul said, Bring me the burnt offerings and the fellowship offerings. Then Saul offered the burnt offering.

dag: Binnamda zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Let every living creature praise the Lord . Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Dabisili din pah ata dali, zaŋmiya naɣilahi piniyini mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the third day offer eleven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Molimiya nolɔbo molo; laɣimmiya salo maa zaa na! Laɣimmiya kpamba mini bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la ni nti kum niŋ ŋun Yawɛ.
en: Give orders for a fast; call an assembly! Gather the leaders and all the people of Judah into the Temple of the Lord your God and cry out to him!.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa yɛli biasan la, Nyama, Mam mini m ba sa dɔniya yuŋ la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lan niŋ wain maa ti o yuŋ ŋɔ, ka a gba kpe o sani ka a min o ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, I slept with him last night; now let's get him drunk again tonight, and you sleep with him. Then each of us will have a child by our father.

dag: Naa Siiza Agasitus daa ti bahi noli ni bɛ sab o tiŋgbɔŋ ni niriba zaa yuya baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: In those days Caesar Augustus declared that everyone throughout the empire should be enrolled in the tax lists.

dag: Bɛ ni ti leeni taŋkpaɣu kaman wahu la bee kaman tiŋgban ni biŋgbamda la. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa na ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ni dabiɛm pam. Bɛ ni ti zɔr a dabiɛm.
en: They will lick dust like the snake, like things that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling from their strongholds to the LORD our God; they will dread and fear you!.

dag: Ka maligumaana ni zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gbini.
en: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.

dag: yɛli, Doo ŋɔ daa yɛliya ni o mali yiko din ni tooi wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka lan me li daba ata sunsuuni.
en: and said, This man said, I can destroy the Temple of God and build it again in three days.

dag: Ka Naa Ahaz daa wurim tɔroko shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la naba, ka yihi tahi shɛŋa din tamtam di zuɣu; ka yihi kɔniŋdi bini din daa tam daanya naɣilahi bɛn be di lɔŋni zuɣu n-zaŋ li tam tanzaa kuɣili zuɣu.
en: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord 's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni, di simdi ni yi bahi yi ni da Hiburu dab so kam ŋun tum yi tuma hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu ka o chaŋ. Di bi lan simdi ka yi chɛ ka bɛ tum yi tuma yaha. Amaa ka yi yaannim maa daa zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: I said that every seventh year each of you must free any Hebrews who have been sold to you. After they have served you for six years, you must set them free. But your ancestors didnt obey or pay any attention to me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti sɔɣ dɔni gili Gibia.
en: So the Israelites set ambushes around Gibeah.

dag: Ka nir yi zaŋ kpaa din be o nuu ni ka nyɛ din ni ku nir ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura; bɛn kum o.
en: If you use a piece of wood large enough to kill someone and you kill another person, you are a murderer, and you must die.

dag: Chɛli ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku birigi kpe mɔɣu ni bee n-tim yi wain tihi puri ni; ti mi ku nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu hal ti gari yi tintariga.
en: Allow us to travel through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard. We will not drink water from any of your wells. We will travel only along Kings Road. We will stay on that road until we have traveled through your country.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zunzuya kana ti ŋub bɛ bindira, ka chɛ ka toli kana ti saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: God handed over their crops to caterpillars, their lands produce to locusts.

dag: Ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yɛhudianima ni Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ la.
en: Then the man left and went back to the Jews who questioned him. He told them that Jesus was the one who made him well.

dag: Dinzuɣu Vuhim Dabisili na kul ʒiɛmi guli Naawuni niriba ni bɛ vuhi;.
en: So you see that a sabbath rest is left open for Gods people.

dag: A suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti kpe n tibili ni zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo tu a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige niŋ a nol ni ŋ-ŋmalig a bah a ni doli so shɛli kana zuɣu.
en: Yes, you were upset at me. I heard your proud insults. So I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth. Then I will turn you around and lead you back the way you came.

dag: O daa ku tiŋgbana pam niriba, ka ku nanim bɛn mali yaa.
en: God struck down many nations and killed mighty kings.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi bihi mini yi puu atam ni yi niɣi bɛn yɛligi ni yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi.
en: Your own fertility, your soils produce, your cattles young, and your flocks offspring will be cursed.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋ yimaŋ barina titali ŋɔ ni yi ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bibihi ni biliɛri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka so ku lan kpalim?.
en: Why do you now insist on heading for another disaster? A disaster that will destroy not only you, but also your children and babies.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Gidiɔn daa bɔhi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, Ninvuɣ banim ka yi daa lee ku Tabo la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Bɛ zaa daa bela a ni be shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ daa ŋmanila nabihi.
en: Then Gideon said, Zebah and Zalmunna, tell me about the men you killed at Tabor. They were a lot like you, the two kings answered. They were dignified, almost like royalty.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa lu solɔɣu chana, ka Shimɛi daa be zolɔŋni m-baɣisir o luɣili polo dol o chani tur o, ka labir o kuɣa, ka toori taŋkpaɣu chɛr o.
en: David and the others went on down the road. Shimei went along the hillside by the road, cursing and throwing rocks and dirt at them.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi nya, ka wum malaika bɔbili bɛn nyɛ tusatusa paai shɛm kukoya. Bɛ daa ʒe n-gilila nam ʒiishee maa ni binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la.
en: Again I looked, and I heard angels, thousands and millions of them! They stood around the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim la kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: Then the priests carried the Box of the Lord s Agreement to the place that was prepared for it in the Most Holy Place inside the Temple. They put the Box of the Agreement under the wings of the Cherub angels.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be yi tooni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni tuhi tɔbu maa tin ya kaman o ni daa kul niŋ shɛm Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ninni la.
en: The LORD your God is going before you. He will fight for you just as he fought for you in Egypt while you watched.

dag: A mi zaligu shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa? A ni tooi zaŋ lala zaligunim zali dunia ŋɔ ni?.
en: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?.

dag: Sool ni daa su ti saha shɛl la, nyini n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi fa Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa yɛl a, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti guli n niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ, ka ti nyɛ ŋun ni su Izraɛl. .
en: In the past, when Saul ruled over us, you were the one who led Israel out to war and back. Whats more, the LORD told you, You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will be Israels leader.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni bi baptaizi yi ni so maa zuɣu, naɣ gbaai yihila Krispus mini Gaiɔs kɔŋko.
en: Thank God that I didnt baptize any of you, except Crispus and Gaius.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa o ni daa suh o bɔri binshɛŋa zaa. O daa ti o pina ka di gari ŋun paɣ maa ni daa ʒi pin shɛŋa na ti ti ŋun naa, di nyaaŋa ka o min o niriba maa daa lab kuli bɛ ya.
en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she asked for. He gave her more than she brought to give him. Then the queen of Sheba and her servants left and went back to their own country.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa boli baŋdiba maa ashilɔni na nti vihi ba viɛnyɛliŋga ni o baŋ saha shɛli saŋmariga maa ni daa puhi.
en: Then Herod had a private meeting with the wise men from the east. He learned from them the exact time they first saw the star.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: along with one male goat for a purification offering to seek reconciliation for yourselves.

dag: Ka salo zaa daa kpalim samban ni suhiri Naawuni tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu saha.
en: There was a large crowd outside praying at the time the incense was offered.

dag: N daa lihi dunia ni n-nya ka di bahila yoli, ka binshɛli lan ka di ni, ka n lihi zuɣusaa, ka neesim kani.
en: I looked at the earth—it was a barren waste; at the sky—there was no light.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni din tuui mal alikauli di ni yɛliya: Tim a ba min a ma jilima.
en: Respect your father and mother is the first commandment that has a promise added:.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ba sɔɣi sɔɣibu shee a sani, ka ninsalinim ku tooi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu. A gbib ba a ni zaŋ ba niŋ a sani luɣ shɛli maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka so ku tooi paa ba tu ba.
en: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yil yidan yi di mi saha shɛli tayiɣ ni yɛn kana, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: What would a homeowner do if he knew when a thief was coming? You know he would not let the thief break in.

dag: yɛra, Saha paaya, ka Naawuni nam gba mirina; dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka niŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛda.
en: He said, The time has come! God's kingdom will soon be here. Turn back to God and believe the good news.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim Farisiinim mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaanib shɛb Yisa sani ni bɛ ti puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Later, the Jewish leaders sent some Pharisees and some men from the group called Herodians to Jesus. They wanted to catch him saying something wrong.

dag: Yi gba yumiya saamba, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So you must also love them, because you yourselves were strangers in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka hal n yi kari so saria gba, n saria karibu maa nyɛla din tuhi, dama pa n kɔŋko n-kariti saria maa, amaa m mini ŋun tim ma na maa n-kariti li.
en: But if I were to do so, my judgment would be true, because I am not alone in this; the Father who sent me is with me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Ainim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa dindali maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pinaayi.
en: Twelve thousand men and women died that day, all the people of Ai.

dag: paɣimiy o cheechi ni mini Yisa Masia ni, ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus for all time, forever and ever. Amen.

dag: Di saha niriba ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu.
en: They will deduce: It was because those people abandoned the covenant of the LORD, their ancestors God, which he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o mi zuɣu nyɛ Shamma Agee ŋun daa nyɛ Hara nir la bia. Filistianim daa ti laɣim tab lo tɔb Lɛhi luɣ shɛli tuya balibu pam ni daa be la, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa.
en: Next there was Shammah son of Agee from Harar. The Philistines came together to fight. They fought in a field of lentils. The people ran away from the Philistines.

dag: n-chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab daa yɛli paɣ maa o ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Go to the king and talk to him using these words that I tell you. Then Joab told the wise woman what to say.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and with their swords they will kill those who live in her towns on the mainland. Then Tyre will know that I am the Lord .

dag: shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa. Timmi bɛ zuliya kam puuni ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli tumo maa, A ni yɛn chaŋ ti yɛli Jɔab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ kpaŋs o suhu, Di chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ muɣis a, dama takɔb bi chihiri so kubu, mali suhukpeeni ka liri tiŋ maa nim ni nimmoo n-nyaŋ ba. .
en: David said to the messenger, Encourage Joab and tell him not to be upset, since you never can tell who will die in battle. Tell him to launch a stronger attack on the city and capture it.

dag: Hal kabiɛlli bee wain din ni zaŋ ti mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu duu gba kani. Maligumaaniba fabindimi, ka Yawɛ tumtumdiba gba fabinda.
en: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord 's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.

dag: Bɛ daa birila alikama, ka ti chɛla gɔhi. Bɛ tum tuma ka di wum ba, amaa ka bi nya shɛli. Bɛ yi ti kpuɣi bɛ puri atam, vi ni gbahi ba, Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: The people will plant wheat, but they will harvest only thorns. They will work hard until they are very tired, but they will get nothing for all their work. They will be ashamed of their crop. The Lord s anger caused this.

dag: ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be nyam zaŋ taaŋkɔro vari tim kom maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa ni niriba bɛn be di ni ni ninvuɣ so ŋun shihi ninsal kɔbili bee bɛ ni ku so bee kpima bee gballi.
en: Then a clean person will take hyssop, dip it into the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the jars, on the people who were there, and on anyone who touched bone, the slain, the dead, or the grave.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa yɛli Jɛfita, Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti ka a sanna pumpɔŋɔ maa. Ti bɔrimi ni a kana ti pahi ti zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka a leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: Gileads elders answered Jephthah, That may be, but now were turning back to you, so come with us and fight the Ammonites. Then youll become the leader over us and everyone who lives in Gilead.

dag: Ka di zaa ha yi di nyɛla yaɣ yini, ya ka niŋgbuŋ naan be?.
en: There would not be a body if it were all only one part!.

dag: O ni lan chɛ ka a lara, ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.

dag: amaa ka Hadad min o ba tumtumdiba shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛdomnim la shɛba daa tiligi n-zo n-kuli Ijipti.
en: except Hadad and some of his father's Edomite servants, who escaped to Egypt.

dag: Amaa m pun suhi Naawuni a zuɣu ni a yɛda di filim; ka a yi ti lan lab zani dɛde, nyin kpaŋsim a mabihi suhuri.
en: I have prayed that you will not lose your faith! Help your brothers be stronger when you come back to me.

dag: Ti yi zahim timaŋa ni yɛlimaŋli, dindina ti ku lan nya saria karibu.
en: If we would examine ourselves first, we would not come under God's judgment.

dag: Yi mi ti ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm mini ti ni daa tim zuliya gbaliŋ ni garina shɛm.
en: You remember how we lived in the land of Egypt. And you remember how we traveled through the countries that were on our way here.

dag: N ni daa be shɛm daa pala din sɔɣi a sani. Bɛ ni daa nam ma ashilɔni saha shɛli, bɛ daa zaŋ ma tuɣila tab alahizibu tuɣibu tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: My bones werent hidden from you when I was being put together in a secret place, when I was being woven together in the deep parts of the earth.

dag: O ni daa paai Nazarɛt, o daa bi yuui, ka yi nimaani gari chaŋ Kapɛrinium din be teeku duli Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali tiŋgbana ni la.
en: He left Nazareth and settled in Capernaum, which lies alongside the sea in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: Amaa ka Onan daa mi ni o bi yɛn su bihi maa. Dinzuɣu o min o biɛli pakoli maa daa yi ti dɔni, o daa yihirila o kom bahi tiŋa ni di chɛ ka o ku dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Onan knew the child would not be his, and when he had sex with Tamar, he made sure that she would not get pregnant.

dag: Ka n daa wum tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kalinli, ka di nyɛla tuhi piapia ʒii tuhi pia.
en: By listening, I could tell there were more than . war horses.

dag: N zaŋ n kayeeni ŋmani n-yɛli ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ dunɔdaya ni. N chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bɛ niriba. M bahi n niriba maa yoli. Bɛ ni bi chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the gates of their country. I will bereave and destroy my people because they havent changed their ways.

dag: Sagban tibisa lim o n-chɛ ka o bi nyara, ka be zuɣusaa kpaakpanyom ni chana.
en: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?.

dag: ti lan zaɣisim a zaligunim maa yaha ka chaŋ ti kpuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din chihiri ŋɔ bipuɣinsi n-niŋ ti paɣiba? A ku je suli m-bahi ti yoli zaa kahikahi, ka chɛ ka ti ni so ku lan tiligi?.
en: So we know that we must not break your commands. We must not marry those people. They do very bad things. God, if we continue to marry these bad people, we know you will destroy us. Then there would be no one from the Israelites left alive.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di ka nyu. Ka paɣ maa ba maa daa yɛli doo maa, Niŋm ania kpalim gbe m-pahi, ka chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: The two men sat down together and ate a big meal. Come on, the man's father-in-law said. Stay tonight and have a good time.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara, ka daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu ka chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: David built an altar for worshiping the Lord there. David offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He prayed to the Lord . The Lord answered David by sending fire down from heaven. The fire came down on the altar of burnt offering.

dag: Mani n-zal a ni a kul mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul be a sani luɣ shɛlikam a ni chana.
en: Ive commanded you to be brave and strong, havent I? Dont be alarmed or terrified, because the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ya o daalikauli shɛli o ni zali ya ni yi doli, dina n-nyɛ o fukumsi zaligunim pia la. Ka o daa sabi li pa kuɣiparilana ayi zuɣu.
en: The LORD declared his covenant to you, which he commanded you to do—the Ten Commandments—and wrote them on two stone tablets.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Aai, di pa shɛli yi yi yɛn sib li, yi ni ti sib alikama maa gba pahi.
en: But the landowner said, No, because if you gather the weeds, youll pull up the wheat along with them.

dag: Mbusim din daŋ tooni pun gari; amaa ka mbusim diba ayi na doli di nyaaŋa na.
en: The first terror is now past. There are still two other terrors to come.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ka di ni ŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni ti lan be di fɔntinsi zaa ni ka piɛguliba ti lan guli bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu nimaani.
en: The Lord Almighty said, In this land that is like a desert and where no people or animals live, there will once again be pastures where shepherds can take their sheep.

dag: Di sabi yi zaligu ni ni niriba ayi shɛhiradibo n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: It is written in your Law that when two witnesses agree, what they say is true.

dag: Di pala ti daa kala soli ni ti deei shɛli yi sani zuɣu ka ti daa niŋdi lala maa, amaa ti daa bɔrimi ni ti niŋ li ka yi nya, ka di chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu.
en: We did this to give you an example to imitate, not because we didnt have a right to insist on financial support.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka m baŋ n kum dali. Ka daba ala n-lee kpalim ma? Chɛ ka m baŋ n nyɛvili ni naari yomyom shɛm.
en: Please, Lord , show me my future. Will I soon be gone?.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun kura, ka lan nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ŋuna n-tahiri niriba kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka lan neeri ba.
en: The LORD! He brings death, gives life, takes down to the grave, and raises up!.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm din yuli daa lan nyɛ Jɛbusi la, dama nimaani ka Jɛbusinim daa be, bɛna n-daa nyɛ di tiŋbihi.
en: Then David and all Israel marched to Jerusalem, that is, Jebus, where the Jebusites lived.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya; di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus reached out his hand and touched him, saying, I do want to. Become clean. Instantly his skin disease was cleansed.

dag: Gbarigu napɔna ni bi shihiri tiŋ shɛm, lala ka jɛrigu ŋahili gba be.
en: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.

dag: ka yɛl o, Wuhim ma a ba ni nyɛ so. Duri be a ba yiŋa ka ti ni gbe nimaani.
en: The servant asked, Who is your father? And is there a place in your fathers house for me and my men to sleep.

dag: O yi ti nya wɔribariba ayiyi bee bumbariba bee laakumbariba ka bɛ kanna, ŋun gbilisim o tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: If he sees riders coming on horseback, two by two, and riders on donkeys and camels, he is to observe them carefully.

dag: dindina n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan zɔr o dabiɛm, dama m mi ni m pala bɛ ni tɛhi ni n nyɛ so maa.
en: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.

dag: Chɛ ka o zuliya kpi zaa; ka o yuli kpihim ʒiɛmana din pahir ayi ni.
en: Let his descendants be eliminated; let their names be wiped out in just one generation!.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali, ka chani gind a sara maligu bimbini.
en: I wash my hands—they are innocent! I walk all around your altar, LORD.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala. Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Gidiɔn yiɣisi asiba, o daa kahim piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu maligim palila pipia.
en: And that's just what happened. Early the next morning, Gideon got up and checked the sheep skin. He squeezed out enough water to fill a bowl.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ o dabili Ibrahimma zuliya mini Yaakubu bihi bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.

dag: Bɛ zaa kul tulimi kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu la, ka kuri bɛ nanima. Bɛ ku nanim zaa, ka bɛ so bi suhi ma ni n sɔŋ o.
en: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.

dag: Sokam kul kpalimmi be kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni bol o.
en: Each one of you should stay the way you were when God chose you.

dag: Neemiya yi nina lihi gili nya, bɛ zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni shiri be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa ye kaman amiliya ni yɛri o salima yɛri shɛm la.
en: Look up all around and see: they are all gathered; they come to you. As surely as I live, says the LORD, you will put them all on like ornaments, bind them on like a bride.

dag: Musa daa zali ba, Yuma ayopɔin kam ni, saha shɛli din nyɛ yi ni kuri sama tiri taba, ka nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu puhibu saha la.
en: Then Moses spoke to the leaders. He said, At the end of every seven years, in the Year of Freedom, read these teachings at the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Ka Jɔn garigi yɛli, Kom ni ka man baptaiziri niriba; amaa so ʒe yi sani kpe, ka yi bi mi o.
en: John answered, I baptize with water, but among you stands the one you do not know.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba. Ti yab Ibrahimma ʒi ti, ka Yaakubu gba bi mi ti. Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti ba, ka a yuli nyɛ ti Tiligira kurimbuni ha.
en: You are surely our father, even though Abraham doesnt know us, and Israel doesnt recognize us. You, LORD, are our father; your reputation since long ago is that of our redeemer.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka dansarika gula maa daa tom ba kpɛhi duu din be puuni ha ni nti ba ba bandi ʒili.
en: When the jailer heard this special order, he put Paul and Silas far inside the jail and bound their feet between large blocks of wood.

dag: Gol so ŋun daa pahir ata ni ka bɛ daa piligi li gbilligbilli sɔŋbu, zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka bɛ daa sɔŋ li gbilligbilli maa naai.
en: They began stacking up the piles in the third month and finished them in the seventh.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti nyɛla juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka so ti ku kari ba.
en: The corpses will be food for the birds and wild animals, and there will be no one to scare them off.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni ku bɛ naa min o kpambaliba, ka zali n nam ʒiishee Ɛlam.
en: I will show Elam that I am in control, and I will destroy its king and his officials. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: I was angry and made a solemn promise: You will never enter the land where I would have given you rest.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima m-mali binshɛŋa ni daanya lahi ni kuriti binyara din nyɛla binshɛŋa din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni zaŋ dina nti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: All the things made from silver, gold, bronze, and iron belong to the Lord . They must be put in the Lord s treasury.

dag: N ni daa paai Troas ni n ti yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu, n Duuma daa mali soli ti ma.
en: When I arrived in Troas to preach the Good News about Christ, I found that the Lord had opened the way for the work there.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi Amasa, M mabia, a mal alaafee? Ka daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Amasa teeŋa n-niŋ kaman o yɛn mɔɣisila o kpariŋ la.
en: Joab asked Amasa, How are you doing, brother? Joab reached out with his right hand and grabbed Amasa by the beard to greet him with a kiss.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the message from the Lord came to me.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi ʒiɛra, ka teeku maa kɔgbana kul puɣiri lura.
en: The water was getting rough because a strong wind was blowing.

dag: Dama yi yi taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma ka be yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ tab sani.
en: No, if you truly reform your ways and your actions; if you treat each other justly.

dag: yɛl o, Kpɛm Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni nti zaŋ binshɛli dalim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa siɣinda ka ŋuhira bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa zaa di ni la gbɛri zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to him, Go through the city of Jerusalem. Put a mark on the forehead of everyone who feels sad and upset about all the terrible things people are doing in this city.

dag: Ba maa ni mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni shɛm, lala ka o ti o Bia maa yiko ni o gba mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni.
en: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.

dag: N sabila dimbɔŋɔ tin ya ni n yɛli ya bɛn bɔri ni bɛ yɔhim ya la yɛla;.
en: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.

dag: ni salima lahi pihita ni anzinfa la shɛŋa kɔbisinahi ni pia ni la shɛŋa yaha, ka di gba nyɛ tuhili.
en: thirty gold bowls, four hundred ten larger silver bowls, and one thousand other objects.

dag: Amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o zaŋ kpe Yisa sani; ka daa dula duu zuɣusaa ti chib voli n-zaŋ o min amaŋka maa tiri voli maa ni siɣisi li ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: But there were so many people that they could not find a way to Jesus. So they went up on the roof and lowered the crippled man down through a hole in the ceiling. They lowered the mat into the room so that the crippled man was lying before Jesus.

dag: Zɔnim shɛb zaŋla zɔtali yɛla niŋ asahi, amaa zɔ maŋli so beni gari nir mabia gba.
en: There are persons for companionship, but then there are friends who are more loyal than family.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa niŋdi lala maa, bɛ daa nya ma ka m malila mmaŋa m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka salo bee duŋtaariba daa ka n sani hal ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la ti kana.
en: This is what I was doing when I was found going through a ceremony in the temple. I wasn't with a crowd, and there was no uproar.

dag: Zuliya kam buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima, ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: The gods of other nations are only gold and silver idols that people have made.

dag: amaa di buɣisi di dundɔŋ la dina, dama bɛ zaŋ li tila bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ ni ti no n-gili tiŋ kasi la puuni chir pihinahinaayi.
en: But do not measure the outer courts, because they have been given to the heathen, who will trample on the Holy City for forty-two months.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim o, N zaŋ sandaani timbu tuma ti o;.
en: But instead of punishing them, I forgave them. So because of the loyalty that Phinehas showed, I solemnly promise that he and his descendants will always be my priests.

dag: Muɣisigu yi ti paai ba ka bɛ kuhira, Naawuni ni sɔŋ ba?.
en: When trouble comes, will God hear their cries?.

dag: Amaa Aduna ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka naanyi kpe luɣ kasi maa puuni m-bɔŋɔ: O bom naɣila polli ŋun ni mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini piɛlaa ŋun ni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na.
en: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, To, cham a chandi! A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa. Ka o nina maa daa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus told him, You may go. Your eyes are healed because of your faith. At once the man could see, and he went down the road with Jesus.

dag: Yi ni tooi bɔhi yimaŋa, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bi yɛli.
en: You may be asking yourselves, How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu pali bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na.
en: Good people bring good things out of their hearts, but evil people bring evil things out of their hearts.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times, and finally the whole thing was drawn back up into heaven.

dag: Ka Mikal daa zaŋ biŋŋmahindili na ti sɔŋ garo zuɣu n-zaŋ bukɔbiri difiɛli sɔŋ zaŋ di zuɣu kuɣ li, ka zaŋ chinchini pil li.
en: Then Michal took the households divine image and laid it in the bed, putting some goats hair on its head and covering it with clothes.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi tɛhiri ni m mi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa gili ba niŋla sunsuuni, ka bɛ ʒe n tooni.
en: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum Pool yɛtɔɣa maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai o ni yoli yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o! Dama nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo bi simdi ni o be.
en: The crowd listened until Paul said this. Then they started shouting, Get rid of this man! He doesn't deserve to live.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma pam. Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n ni guhiri shɛm yɛn zan tariga?.
en: My whole body is completely terrified! But you, LORD! How long will this last?.

dag: ka zo n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim niŋ amaŋkanim ni ʒiri chani bɛ ni daa wum ni o be luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: so they ran to tell others throughout that area. They brought sick people on mats to every place Jesus went.

dag: Niriba, niŋmiy o naani sahakam. Yɛlimiy o yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛlikam zaa, Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: All you people: Trust in him at all times! Pour out your hearts before him! God is our refuge! Selah.

dag: N ni yili yila yɛli ʒiɛyimtali mini zaligu soli yɛla. N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Oh, let me sing about faithful love and justice! I want to sing my praises to you, LORD!.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka m biɛhigu di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la, kaman saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa yuuni ma la;.
en: I wish my life could be the same as it was a few months ago, when God watched over me and cared for me.

dag: Naa ni daa nyo Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Baruk yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka o sabi li niŋ gban shɛli ni maa buɣim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: The LORDs word came to Jeremiah after the king had burned the scroll containing the words written by Baruch at Jeremiahs dictation.

dag: N yura, a viɛlimi kaman Tiriza, ka viɛli kaman Jɛrusalɛm la, ka a ni be shɛm ŋmanila tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanima.
en: My love, you are as beautiful as Jerusalem, as lovely as the city of Tirzah, as breathtaking as these great cities.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. O daa nyɛla Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he was appointed king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah from the town of Libnah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni sa gɔhi ŋar o soli, ka me gooni gu o soli, ka o ku lan tooi nya soli.
en: So I am going to fence her in with thorn bushes and build a wall to block her way.

dag: Ka o ba Yisahaku bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o yɛl o, Mani a bituuli Iso.
en: Who are you? Isaac asked. I am Esau, your first-born son.

dag: A mi ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr maa kamina ni o ti yɔhim a baŋ a ni doli so shɛli yiri min a ni doli so shɛli kpɛra; ka lan baŋ a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: Dont you know the evil ways of Abner, Ners son? He came to trick you, to find out where you come and go, and to learn everything you do.

dag: M bɔri ni zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani din ya shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n zaŋla nyɛvili mini kum ni alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu piimiya nyɛvili, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mini yi zuliya be.
en: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!.

dag: Ka Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba ni yino ka nyɛ ŋun daa ti yɛn yi Yisa nyaaŋa la bɔhi.
en: Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples , complained.

dag: Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa yi Mizipa kana ni o ti tuhi ba soli ka kumda. O ni daa tuhi ba soli maa ka o yɛli ba, Kamiya Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sanna.
en: Ishmael left Mizpah and went to meet the men. He cried while he walked out to meet them. Ishmael met them and said, Come with me to meet with Gedaliah son of Ahikam.

dag: Ka din nyɛ yɛlikpeeni nyɛla, baŋmiya ni anabitali yɛtɔɣa din be Naawuni Kundi ni pala ninsal ni ni tooi kahigi shɛli gbinni wuhi omaŋmaŋ baŋsim puuni;.
en: Above all else, however, remember that none of us can explain by ourselves a prophecy in the Scriptures.

dag: Man ŋuna, n tɔŋbu puuni, n daa yɛliya, Shɛli ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: I felt secure and said to myself, I will never be defeated.

dag: Pa pumpɔŋɔ ka yi boli ma, Ti ba, a nyɛla ŋun daa yuri ti ti bilim ni.
en: But didnt you just call me Father? Didnt you say, You have been my friend since I was a child?.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, n yɛn chɛmi ka alɔbo lu niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ tuma nyɔri, dama bɛ zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu, ka zaɣisi n wuhibu gba.
en: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.

dag: Ka Aduna daa kpuɣi Aminadab bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa nyɛ Nashɔn tizɔpaɣa ka o yuli booni Ɛlishɛba la, ka o daa dɔɣi Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron married Elisheba, Amminadabs daughter and Nahshons sister. She gave birth to Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha Luɣ Kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: The priests brought the chest containing the LORDs covenant to its designated spot beneath the wings of the winged creatures in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the most holy place.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a tir a kpee zalige bee bɔzuɣu ka a ʒiɛmd a kpee? Dama ti zaa ni ti zani Naawuni tooni ka o kari ti saria.
en: You then, who eat only vegetables—why do you pass judgment on others? And you who eat anything—why do you despise other believers? All of us will stand before God to be judged by him.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin.
en: You will present an entirely burned offering as a soothing smell to the LORD: two bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old.

dag: Pita ni daa ti kul zaŋ o zuɣu tiriti dunol ni ka Kɔniilius dii yiɣisi nti gban o tooni jɛmd o.
en: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in order to honor him.

dag: Bɛ daa bi gbibi Naawuni ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la, ka daa zaɣis o zaligu dolibu.
en: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.

dag: Nyo bɔ ka n daa naan tooi nya bɛ nuhi tuma ni? Bɛ yaa zaa daa naaya.
en: Their strength, whats it to me, their energy having perished?.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini jintɔriba zaa daa bo niriba ni bɛ di Yisa ʒiri shɛhira ka bɛ tɔɣisi luh o, ka ku o.
en: The leading priests and the high council tried to find something against Jesus so that they could kill him. They tried to find people to lie and say that Jesus had done wrong.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, N ni daa be yi sani ka yɛri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la m-bɔŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim ni ni Yila litaafi ni zaŋ chaŋ n polo la daa kpami ni di zaa ha niŋ pali.
en: Jesus said to them, These are my words that I spoke to you while I was still with you—that everything written about me in the Law from Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms must be fulfilled.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a wurim duɣu maa, a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chaŋ maa ninni.
en: Jeremiah, tell this to the people, and while they are watching, break the jar.

dag: Ka Ozini daŋ niriba nyɛ Ozininima; ka Ɛri daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛrinima;.
en: from Ozni, the Oznite clan; from Eri, the Erite clan.

dag: N yura, niŋm yomyom, be kaman molifu la bee kparibua ŋun be tulaale tihi zoya zuɣu.
en: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.

dag: O dunɔdaya firi tiŋgban ni. Naawuni kabisi o dunokparita n-saɣim li. O naa mini nabihi bela tinzunnim sani. So bi lan wuhiri ba Naawuni yɛla, ka o daanabinim bi lan nyari ʒii Yawɛ sani.
en: Jerusalems gates have sunk into the ground. The bars on her gates are completely destroyed. Her king and princes have been taken to other nations. The teaching of the law has stopped. And her prophets no longer receive visions from the Lord .

dag: Sanzali lu bɛ kulisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka di koma nyuui. Dama di nyɛla binnana ni pali tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Ka bɛ suhuri zaa kul ye buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: Sword, strike the waters of Babylon. Those waters will be dried up. Babylon has many, many idols. These idols show that the people of Babylon are foolish. So bad things will happen to them.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋ maa nim daa yɛli Jɔash, Yihim a bia maa na ka ti ku o. O ni wurim Baal bimbini, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi la zuɣu.
en: So the men of the city came to Joash and said, You must bring your son out. He pulled down the altar for Baal, and he cut down the Asherah pole that was beside it. So your son must die.

dag: Di yi pa lala n ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o shɛm. N ni niŋ o kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din tam chaai la, ka chɛ ka kɔnyuri ku o.
en: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a mabia Sɔdom min o bipuɣinsi daa bi tum tuumbiɛri ka di paag a min a bipuɣinsi ni tum shɛm ŋɔ.
en: I am the Lord GOD. As I live, I swear that your sister Sodom and her daughters never did as many bad things as you and your daughters.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ o, ka daa tim anabi o sani ka o ti yɛl o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a jɛmdi tinzun buɣ shɛŋa din daa bi tooi tiligi dimaŋmaŋ niriba a nuu ni la.
en: This made the Lord very angry, and he sent a prophet to ask Amaziah, Why would you worship these foreign gods that couldn't even save their own people from your attack.

dag: Yi ni ti teerila dabiɛm din daa yi mali ya la yɛla ka bɔhira, Ka ŋun kaani liɣiri la lee be ya? Ka ŋun zahindi farigu binyara tibisim la lee be ya? Ka ŋun kaani pihi la lee be ya.
en: Then you will ask yourself, Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa tiligi Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka o suhu bi piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ zaligu saɣindiba daɣiri tuma zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: And he rescued righteous Lot, who was made miserable by the unrestrained immorality of unruly people. .

dag: Ka n daa gbi mɔɣa ŋ-ŋɔŋdi di kom yɔɣiri li.
en: I made pools of water for myself, and I used them to water my growing trees.

dag: Dauda daa gbahila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili mini wɔribariba tusaayopɔin ni tɔbbi tinchandiba tuhi pisi. O daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali, ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa napɔn jila.
en: David captured , chariots, , chariot drivers, and , soldiers. And he crippled all but of the horses.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n yɛl lala? M bi yuri ya mi zuɣu ka n yɛl lala maa? Naawuni gba mi ni n yuri ya!.
en: Why? Is it because I dont love you? God knows that I do!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe Babilɔn, ka ŋunkam ti ʒe li ni tiɣi. Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: Babylonia will be looted, and those who loot it will take everything they want. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: N yi daa niŋ kpibiga zaɣ biɛɣu, n ni mali nyaanzaaniba dunɔdali gbini zuɣu.
en: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a zaligunim soya, ka n dol li hal ni di tariga.
en: LORD, teach me what your statutes are about, and I will guard every part of them.

dag: Amaa ka Hanna yɛl o, N dana, Aai, n nyɛla paɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni pam. M bi nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ, amaa n zaŋdila n suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira zaa wuhiri Yawɛ.
en: Sir, please don't think I'm no good! Hannah answered. I'm not drunk, and I haven't been drinking. But I do feel miserable and terribly upset. I've been praying all this time, telling the Lord about my problems.

dag: ka guhir o Bia ni o yi alizanda ni labina, ŋuna n-nyɛ o Bia Yisa so o ni daa neei kum ni ka o nyɛ ŋun fa ti Naawuni suhuyiɣisili din ti yɛn kana la ni bahi.
en: And you began waiting for Gods Son to come from heaven—the Son God raised from death. He is Jesus, who saves us from Gods angry judgment that is coming.

dag: A ni lari saɣiŋgu mini kum, ka ti ku zɔri dunia ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dabiɛm.
en: You will laugh at destruction and famine. You will not be afraid of wild animals!.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa be bia maa sani hal ka o mali ti zooi. O daa bela mɔɣu ni n-daa ti leei tɔha ŋun mi piɛm tɔbu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: God continued to be with the boy while he grew up. Ishmael lived in the desert and became a hunter. He learned to shoot a bow very well.

dag: Nyama, niriba maa yiɣisirimi kaman gbuɣin nyaŋ la, ka bɛ ni nyamdi kaman gbuɣindaa la. O bi doona ka pa ni o ŋubila o ni gbaai binshɛɣu, ka nyu o ni ku binshɛɣu maa ʒim.
en: The people are as strong as lions, and they fight like lions. And a lion will not rest until it eats what it has caught, until it drinks the blood of what it has killed.

dag: Pa Naawuni yino maa n-nam paɣ maa? Niŋgbina mini shia maa zaa nyɛla o dini. Ka bɔ ka o lee bɔra? O bɔri ni Naawuni biɛhigu be ti bihi ni. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka di chɛn ya ka so bi ʒe o ni daa kpuɣi paɣ so o bipolitali ni yim.
en: Didnt he make her the one and the remnant of his spirit? What is the one? The one seeking godly offspring. You should guard your own spirit. Dont cheat on the wife of your youth.

dag: Ka a yi kali ninvuɣ so, di simdi ka dilan yo anzinfa laɣifu pirigili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ. .
en: Each man who is counted must pay / shekel of silver. This half shekel is an offering to the Lord .

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yalim be yi yɛtɔɣa ni ka di viɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi mi yi ni yɛn garigi sokam shɛm.
en: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni nya yi daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.

dag: Ka Musa daa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, niriba ma tum alahichi titali, dama bɛ zaŋla salima mali buɣili.
en: Moses then returned to the Lord and said, These people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a god out of gold and worshiped it.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni zaŋla bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu maa sɔŋ gu bɛ bihi; chɛ ka o zaŋ li labisi yo ba ka bɛ baŋ li.
en: But you say, God is saving their punishment for their children. No! Let God punish the evil people themselves so that they will know what they have done!.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba ni sɔhirimi, ka sokam ninni biɛhigu taɣira.
en: In their presence, peoples shake with fear; all faces turn red with worry.

dag: Ŋunkam deei n zaligu ka dol li, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun yuri ma; ka m Ba ni yuri ŋun yuri ma maa, ka n gba ni yuri dilana ka kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir o.
en: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe pam pali dunia hal ka zoya din du pam zaa ti lim.
en: Finally, the mighty flood was so deep that even the highest mountain peaks were about seven meters below the surface of the water.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Dan zuliya niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligina bɔhi Maika, Bɔ n-chɛ ka a zaŋ salo ŋɔ tatabo pa amaŋ zuɣu na.
en: They called out to the Danites, who turned around and said to Micah, Why have you summoned men for battle.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino daa teeg o nuu chɛrubinim maa sanna n-tim buɣim shɛli din daa be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni la ni m-mooi di shɛli n-zaŋ li niŋ do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa nuu ni, ka o zaŋ li yi.
en: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.

dag: Niaria bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɔnai mini Hizikia ni Azirikam, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Neariah had three sons. They were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri kum, ka kum bi kanna, ka o gbi m-bo di shee n-gari azichi sɔɣirili;.
en: They wait for death, but it never comes; they prefer a grave to any treasure.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ nam hal ka Izraɛlnim ti naanyi mali nanima yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛɔr bia Bɛla ŋun ya daa nyɛ Dinhaba la.
en: Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah.

dag: Kum ku gbuɣinli ŋun mali yaa, ka gbuɣinnyaŋ bihi wurim.
en: like a lioness that cannot find prey. They died, and their cubs starved to death.

dag: Ɛliashib mini Joyada ni Jɔhanan ni Jadua saha la, bɛ daa sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba yɛla hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: The names of the leaders of the families of the Levites and the priests in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua were written down during the rule of Darius the Persian king.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Dɔr bɔ n-lee be a suhu ni ka a tum dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa, din nyɛ vi kalinsi pagɔrisigu tuma ŋɔ?.
en: I, the Lord God, say that you were so disgusting that you would have done anything to get what you wanted.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa din pahi ni o yɛm tuma la yɛla sab be Sulemaana tuma litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the book about him and his wisdom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ sida dapaɣa n-siili li hal ti gari du shɛŋa din daa tam pilanim pihinahinaanu zuɣu la zuɣusaa. Kuliga kam daa malila pilanim pinaanu.
en: There were cedar beams going across the rows of columns. There were beams for each section of columns, making a total of beams. On top of these beams there were cedar boards for the ceiling.

dag: Ka wula ka yi ni tooi zaŋ binshɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ maai n suhu? Yi lan ka yi ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm naɣila ʒiri kɔŋko.
en: So your empty words are no comfort to me. There is no truth at all in your answers.

dag: Tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, ka tiŋgban kuŋ gba ti mali suhupiɛlli ka bimpuma ti yirigi di ni m-be kaman taaŋkɔro la.
en: The dry desert will rejoice. The desert will be glad and blossom.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kalima anahi ni ʒe m-baɣi chɛrubinim maa. Kalinli yini daa ʒe m-baɣi la chɛrubi yino kam. Kalima maa daa ŋmanila diɣi n-nyaɣisira.
en: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka di niŋdiya shɛli bɛ nini yi beni zuɣu ni bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiya lala ni suhu yini Naawuni zɔbu zuɣu.
en: Servants, obey your masters in everything. Obey all the time, even when they cant see you. Dont just pretend to work hard so that they will treat you well. No, you must serve your masters honestly because you respect the Lord.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu kpaŋsimiya tab suhuri, ka niŋdi din ni sɔŋ yi taba ka bɛ zooi Naawuni dolibu ni kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: So encourage each other and help each other grow stronger in faith, just as you are already doing.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham ti tuhi, mali kpiɔŋ tɔb maa tuhibu ni. Di yi pa lala Naawuni ni ŋme a luh a dimnim maa tooni. Dama Naawuni mali yiko din ni sɔŋ nira bee n-ŋme o luhi.
en: Should you go with them anyway, even if you fight fiercely, God will make you stumble before the enemy, because God has the ability to either help or make someone stumble.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla kaman awa yini laasabu yaha ka so lan yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa sani, dama o nyɛla Galili nira.
en: An hour or so later, someone else insisted, This man must have been with him, because he is a Galilean too.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ n ni daa tim ba ka bɛ yi Kadɛshibarinia chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: Your ancestors did this, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun kari zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam bahi ka chɛn ya, ka so na bi tooi zani yi tooni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The LORD has removed great and powerful nations before you. To this day, no one has stood up to you.

dag: dama dina n-viɛla, ka nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nini.
en: This is good and it pleases God our Savior.

dag: Ka n yi chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti kuri ba, ka di leei dabari, ka so ku lan gari nimaani biŋkɔb biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be kaman yɛndana? Ka ŋuni n-lee baŋdi yɛla gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm? Yɛm chɛmi ka nir ninni ne zaa, ka chɛ ka o ninni lihibu biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Only the wise know what things really mean. Wisdom makes them smile and makes their frowns disappear.

dag: Chamiya ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali anfaani mini atam maa ni, amaa n ku doli ya chaŋ nimaani. Di yi pa lala n ni ti kun ya sol ni, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: Go to this land full of milk and honey. But I wont go up with you because I would end up destroying you along the way since you are a stubborn people.

dag: Bɛ yi wum ka jɛmd o, bɛ ni mali buni ni suhudoo hal ni bɛ nyɛvili tariga.
en: If they listen and serve, they spend their days in plenty, their years contentedly.

dag: Nir jɛrilim tuma bahir o yoli, di zaa yoli ka o suhu yiɣisiri bahiri Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino chuɣu puhibu binyɛra, amaa ka daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita mini chuɣu puhibu binyɛra ata ti Bɛnjamin.
en: Joseph gave some new clothes to each of his brothers, but to Benjamin he gave five new outfits and pieces of silver.

dag: Bɛ pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒii buyopɔin ka sab wuhi di ni nyɛ shɛm na ti ti ma, ka m bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni n-lihi nya.
en: But you should describe the land and divide it into seven parts. Bring the map to me, and we will throw lots to let the Lord our God decide how to divide the land among the tribes.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa paɣ o nɛma, ka pin o zabiri zaa, ka su kom yi daɣiri ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi labi yi biɛhigu shee maa na, amaa o ni ti bela o suɣili samban ni daba ayopɔin.
en: The person who needs purification will then wash their clothes, shave off all of their hair, and bathe in water; at that point, they will be clean. After that, they can return to the camp, but they must live outside their tent for seven days.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun daa zali ya ŋɔ yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛli la zuɣu. Bɛ maanila maligu tiri Baal n-yiɣisiri n suhu.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. *.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋmanila mɔri din zoori wuntaŋ nyeebu ni, ka bɛ nyaɣa teei ʒiɛvari puu ni.
en: Its like a well-watered plant in the sun; its runners spread over its gardens.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa ka kokpɛɣu daa kpe m-pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Seven days later the flood came.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha nti ku o. Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ ba?.
en: They threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What will the owner of the vineyard do to them?.

dag: Ka alizin birigu maa kuhi, ka lan yiɣisi bia maa pam ka naanyi zo ka chɛ o; ka bia maa be kaman o kpimi la hal ka sokam tɛhi ni o shiri kpimi.
en: After screaming and shaking the boy horribly, the spirit came out. The boy seemed to be dead; in fact, several people said that he had died.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Yɛlim a biɛyanim maa ni bɛ ʒilim bɛ bunsi ʒiya n-lab Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So the king said to Joseph: Tell your brothers to load their donkeys and return to Canaan.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o, ka wuɣ gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o;.
en: They put a purple robe on Jesus, made a crown from thorny branches, and put it on his head.

dag: Di daa kul malila takɔriti di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni kaman dimbalanim takɔriti ni daa be shɛm la. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: There were windows in the guardrooms of this gate and in the entrance room, just like the others, and this gate was also meters long and . meters wide.

dag: Ka nimaani leei jɛŋgbina mini kunduna gɔbu shee, ka alizinnim be nimaani booni taba; ka Lilit ni kani nimaani na ti vuhira.
en: Wild cats will live there with hyenas. Wild goats will call to their friends. Night animals will spend some time there and find a place to rest.

dag: ni Lɛbaɔt ni Shilihim ni Ain ni Rimɔn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pihitayinika m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon: twenty-nine cities in all, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka Zakius daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ti Duuma Yisa, N Duuma, n ni zaŋ n nɛma pirigili ti nandaamba, ka n yi daa dila so bini zalinsi, n ni lan labisi dilan bini lala siɣimsiɣim bunahi zuɣu ti o.
en: Later that day Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, I will give half of my property to the poor. And I will now pay back four times as much to everyone I have ever cheated.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa tum tuma, ka duu maa malibu tuma chaŋ tooni. Ka bɛ daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm, ka lan niŋ yaa pahi.
en: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli yaha, Goli palli kam chuɣu dali mini Vuhim Dabisili dali kam di simdi ni zuliya kam zaa kana ti jɛm ma.
en: On every New Moon Festival and every Sabbath people of every nation will come to worship me here in Jerusalem, says the Lord .

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu sahakam; n lan yɛri ya mi yaha, kul maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: Be glad in the Lord always! Again I say, be glad!.

dag: Paɣipuulan ti ku zaŋ bahi, ka paɣiŋoo mi ti ku be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni tin ya nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: Your women will all be able to have babies. None of their babies will die at birth. And I will allow you to live long lives.

dag: Ka Hagai lan bɔh o, Ka nir yi shihi kpima, ka kana ti shihi bindira maa, di ni chɛ ka bindira maa leei din pa kasi? Ka Maligumaana maa garigi yɛli, Iin.
en: Then Haggai said, Whoever touches a dead body will become unclean. Now if they touch anything else, will it also become unclean? The priests answered, Yes, it will become unclean.

dag: dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun kul tumdi lala yi ni ni o chɛ ka yi saɣ o yubu, ka tin ya yiko ka yi tooi tum o ni yu shɛm.
en: Yes, it is God who is working in you. He helps you want to do what pleases him, and he gives you the power to do it.

dag: Dinzuɣu chira awɛi ni biɛɣ pisi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: At the end of nine months and twenty days, after going through the entire country, they came back to Jerusalem.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ kɔŋko ka buchi; shia n-nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ka n ni pun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la mi nyɛla shia mini nyɛvili yɛla.
en: It is the Spirit that gives life. The body is of no value for that. But the things I have told you are from the Spirit, so they give life.

dag: Naawuni zaŋd o kukoli din nyɛ satahiŋga ŋɔ tumdi alahiziba tuma; o tumdi tuun kara din gari ti yɛm.
en: God roars with his wondrous voice; he does great things we cant know.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti pii wuntizɔr so Dauda daŋ ni, ka o ti di nam n-zaŋ yɛm su niriba, ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntitali tuma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord says, The time is coming when I will choose as king a righteous descendant of David. That king will rule wisely and do what is right and just throughout the land.

dag: M biyurisi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba, dama yurilim yirila Naawuni sanna; ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka mi Naawuni.
en: Dear friends, we should love each other, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has become Gods child. And so everyone who loves knows God.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa baŋ Naawuni bee Naawuni yipa baŋ ya, ka di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛn lab dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gbarigi ka ka yaa ŋɔ dabitim ni yaha? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan bɔri ni yi labi di sulinsi ni yaha?.
en: But now, after knowing God , how can you turn back again to the weak and worthless world system? Do you want to be slaves to it again?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be yi tooni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni tuhi tɔbu maa tin ya kaman o ni daa kul niŋ shɛm Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ninni la.
en: The Lord your God is in front, leading you. He will fight for you just as he did in Egypt.

dag: N ni yu shɛm mini n tahima nyɛla ni n di kɔŋ n tuma tumbu, amaa ka kul ni tumdi li mi sahakam, di bahi bamdi pumpɔŋɔ. N ni mali suhukpeeni ka di chɛ ka n ti Masia jilima n niŋgbuŋ zaa puuni, n yi be bee n yi kpimi.
en: My deep desire and hope is that I shall never fail in my duty, but that at all times, and especially right now, I shall be full of courage, so that with my whole being I shall bring honor to Christ, whether I live or die.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛli ba o ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa saha shɛli Baruk ni daa karindi gbaŋ maa ka niriba maa wumdi maa.
en: Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read from the scroll.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, yi nyɛla wuna, yi zaa nyɛla Zallakudura Naa bihi.
en: I, God Most High, say, You are gods, my own sons.

dag: ka Joyada nyɛ Jɔnatan ba; ka Jɔnatan mi nyɛ Jadua ba.
en: Joiada was the father of Jonathan and the grandfather of Jaddua.

dag: Maak mini Aristakus ni Diimas ni Luk bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditab la gba puhiri ya.
en: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tinzun tiŋ wuna din be bɛ sani zaa mini bɛ ni daa kpa tibikpar shɛŋa ti Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li sɔɣi ti shɛli din nyɛ oki tia din miri Shɛkɛm la gbini.
en: So they gave Jacob all of the foreign gods they had, as well as the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the terebinth at Shechem.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa yi Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na. O daa nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira m-be nimaani.
en: One day a young Levite came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim. He had been staying with one of the clans of Judah in Bethlehem, but he had left Bethlehem to find a new place to live where he could be a priest.

dag: Tiŋgbani, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, amaa chɛ ka a suhu piɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli; dama Yawɛ tum tuun kara.
en: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate.

dag: amaa bɛ ni ti yɛrimi, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim o ni daa kari ba tahi nuzaa polo tin shɛŋa zaa ni la zuɣu. Di saha bɛ ni ti be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Instead, they will say, As the LORD lives who brought up the descendants of the people of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where he has banished them so that they can live in their own land.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yi ni so miri ka o ti chɛ ka o min o dɔɣira dɔni.
en: The Lord gave the following regulations. Do not have sexual intercourse with any of your relatives.

dag: O daa yɛl o mi, Zaŋm nɛma maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu la ni, ka lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: The emperor told him to take them and return them to the Temple in Jerusalem, and to rebuild the Temple where it had stood before.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ o ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna nti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu, ka tɔɣi o ʒim bahi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ o nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: The priest will bring it to the altar. He will tear off its head and completely burn it on the altar. Its blood will be drained against the side of the altar.

dag: mini dundɔŋ din gil li maa daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni dundɔŋ maa dunɔdali daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi zaa ni dundɔŋ din daa gil li maa kpahi zaa.
en: the bases for the surrounding enclosure and for the entrance of the enclosure, and all the pegs for the Tent and the surrounding enclosure.

dag: Ka molomoona daa ti kuhi pam yɛli, Bɛ zaliya ni niriba mini zuliya kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim.
en: Then an official stood up and announced: People of every nation and race, now listen to the king's command!.

dag: Ka bintɔra daa tɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi kpi mi, ka tiŋ maa nim daa kum pam.
en: Many people died, and those who did not, had tumors. The people of Ekron cried loudly to heaven.

dag: Amaa fɔntinsi maa ni biŋkɔbiri mini di nɛma zaa, ti daa zaŋ li ka di leei ti ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: The only things we kept for ourselves were the animals and the plunder from the towns.

dag: ka n suhu kul be yiriŋ. N ni daa kul tɛhiri di yɛla shɛm, lala ka di yɛla maa daa niŋ ma muɣisigu. Di saha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli.
en: My heart got hot inside me; while stewing over it, the fire burned. Then I spoke out with my tongue.

dag: ka di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛlimaŋli zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni pun yɛl a shɛlikam la polo.
en: I want you to have confidence in the soundness of the instruction you have received.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa zali Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka wuh o niriba ni bɛ niŋm ʒim vie bɛ yinsi dunoya, ka di chɛ ka Kum malaika so ŋun daa yɛn kana ti ku bikpamba la ti ku ku bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bikpamba.
en: It was faith that made him establish the Passover and order the blood to be sprinkled on the doors, so that the Angel of Death would not kill the first-born sons of the Israelites.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti yɛli Filip, Yiɣisima n-dol a nudirigu polo mɔɣu ni pal shɛli din yiri Jɛrusalɛm kuni Gaza la.
en: An angel of the Lord said to Philip, Get ready and go south to the road that goes from Jerusalem to Gaza.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ yɛligi kaman o ni daa lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord your God promised your fathers that he would make your land larger. He will give you all the land that he promised to give to your ancestors.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni yi baŋ ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli ni ti beni. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda la ansarisi.
en: First of all, you must understand that in the last days some people will appear whose lives are controlled by their own lusts. They will make fun of you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ do shɛb bɛn bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn bi kuli dɔb la yɛla polo, n ka zaligu shɛli din yi ti Duuma sanna, amaa n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so bɛ ni ni niŋ naani ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo puuni la zuɣu, n ni yɛli ya n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Now, concerning what you wrote about unmarried people: I do not have a command from the Lord, but I give my opinion as one who by the Lord's mercy is worthy of trust.

dag: O ni daa ti paai ti Asɔs ka ti zaŋ o niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ Mitilin.
en: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.

dag: Yaakubu daa di n-tiɣi. Jɛshurun daa ŋmɛlimya ka tiri gbini. A ŋmɛlimya piri m-muɣi lɔŋ. O daa zaɣisi Naawuni ŋun nam o, ka maani o tiliginsim tampiŋ ansarisi.
en: Jacob ate until he was stuffed; Jeshurun got fat, then rebellious. It was you who got fat, thick, stubborn! Jeshurun gave up on the God who made him, thought the rock of his salvation was worthless.

dag: Man Jeemsi ŋun nyɛ Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabili la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri yinim bɛn nyɛ ti zuliya pinaayi bɛn wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam la m-puhiri ya.
en: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ, nyamiya doo ŋɔ ni bɔri ti vuri shɛm. O daa pun timna nti yɛli ma ni o bɔrila m paɣiba mini m bihi ni n daanzinfa ni n salima, ka m bi mɔŋ o.
en: King Ahab called in all the leaders of the country and said, You see that this man wants to ruin us. He sent me a message demanding my wives and children, my silver and gold, and I agreed.

dag: Bɛ vaam tampiligim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka zaŋ chinchin bɔribɔri pil li;.
en: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu, darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. Darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ nuhi tuma ni simdi shɛm; tim ba bɛ tuma laara.
en: Punish them for what they have done, for the evil they have committed. Punish them for all their deeds; give them what they deserve!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim lo nia ni bɛ kana nti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-tahi girigiri niŋbu na.
en: They plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and to create a disturbance in it.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ma leei dunia ŋɔ zaa naa, ka zali ma ni m me duu ti o Jɛrusalɛm, Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: From King Cyrus of Persia: The Lord , the God of heaven, gave all the kingdoms on earth to me. And he chose me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in the country of Judah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi ma pahi buyi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala duɣu ni bini ni kpeera, ka gbiligi yi nuzaa polo na.
en: The LORD asked me again, What do you see? I said, A pot boiling over from the north.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o sɔŋda Bidikar, Yihim o bahi Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ŋɔ ni. Ka bɔh o, A teei m min a ni daa laɣim dol o ba Ɛhab nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo la?.
en: and Jehu said to his aide Bidkar, Get his body and throw it in the field that belonged to Naboth. Remember that when you and I were riding together behind King Joram's father Ahab, the Lord spoke these words against Ahab:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ka di ni ŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni ti lan be di fɔntinsi zaa ni ka piɛguliba ti lan guli bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu nimaani.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: This wasteland, without humans or animals—and all its towns—will again become pastures for shepherds to care for their flocks.

dag: Birimiya wuntitali ti yimaŋa, ka ti kpuɣi atam din nyɛ yurilim din ka ŋmali. Komiya yi tiŋgbani din doya ka bi ko la, dama saha paaya ni yi bo Yawɛ ka o kana ti tiligi ya.
en: If you plant goodness, you will harvest faithful love. Plow your ground, and you will harvest with the Lord . He will come, and he will make goodness fall on you like rain.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mbo! A garigi viɛnyɛliŋga; niŋmi lala ka be.
en: Jesus said to him, You have answered correctly. Do this and you will live.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun zaŋmi daba ayopɔin niŋ o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa, ka paɣ o situra, ka su ko viɛlli n-yi daɣiri ni.
en: When it comes time for a man with a discharge to be made clean, he must wait seven days. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe his body in running water. Then he will become clean.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla saha din ka bahigu naa. Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim ni bahi yoli o tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: The LORD rules forever and always! The nations will vanish from his land.

dag: A tinsi din be kasi la mini Ziɔn leela dabari. Ka Jɛrusalɛm leei bɛ ni zo ka chɛ tin shɛli.
en: Your holy cities are as empty as the desert. Zion has become a desert. Jerusalem is destroyed.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali luɣ shɛli yi sansani maa kpaŋa n-chani nimaani ti damdiri yɔɣuni.
en: The latrines must be outside the camp. You will use them there, outside the camp.

dag: Kul niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm Yawɛ ni pii tin shɛl maa ni, ka doliya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: There at the Lord s special place they will tell you their decision. You must do whatever they say. Be sure to do everything they tell you to do.

dag: Pa dahin yini ka yi yɛn ŋub li bee daba ayi bee daba anu bee biɛɣu pia bee biɛɣ pisi.
en: You wont eat for just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba la daa tɔɣisiri ti Duuma Yisa kum ni neebu yɛla ni yiko pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika pam daa be bɛ zaa ni.
en: With great power the apostles gave witness to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and God poured rich blessings on them all.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ ʒim; yi ni ti kpaai li mi bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: But you must not eat the blood from the animal. You must pour the blood out on the ground like water.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the message the Lord spoke through the prophet Jeremiah about Babylon and its people.

dag: Di ni simdi ni shɛli be daadam biɛhigu ni nyɛla ʒiɛyimtali, ka nir yi nyɛ faralana di so ʒiŋmara.
en: People long for trustworthiness; it is better to be poor than a liar.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim Izraɛlnim bɛ wahala zaa ni.
en: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma: Bɛ paɣiba ŋmaligi n-gɔndila bɛ paɣ taba;.
en: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli din yɛli ni Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la niŋ pali; dina n-chɛ ka Naawuni daa bol o o zo.
en: This shows the full meaning of the Scriptures that say, Abraham believed God, and because of this faith he was accepted as one who is right with God. Abraham was called Gods friend.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa laɣim zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔn palli la ni, ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kana ti zani bɛ sani.
en: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem in the LORDs temple in front of the new courtyard.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba ŋɔ bɛn kpe yɔɣu ka bi lan labina? Bɛ dolila yɔhiŋ soli ka zaɣisi labbuna.
en: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?.

dag: Kaman paɣili ni bi simdi siɣili saha shɛm bee di ni bi simdi ni saa mi puri atam kpuɣibu saha shɛm, lala ka jilima bi simdi jɛrigu.
en: Like snow in the summer or rain at harvest, so honor isnt appropriate for a fool.

dag: Ka Obadia bɔhi Ilaija, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee tum ka a bɔri ni a chɛ ka Ɛhab ku man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ?.
en: Then Obadiah said, How have I sinned that you are handing me, your servant, over to Ahab so he can kill me?.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli tɔŋbu saha, ka yɛla mi yi ti paag a, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n-tahiri suhupiɛlli mini yɛlimuɣisira maa zaa na. Dinzuɣu ninsalinim ku tooi baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla peentɔriba, ka daa naan tooi zaŋ bɛ nudiriti bee bɛ nuzahi n-to piɛma bee n-labi kuɣilɔna. Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ Sool dɔɣiriba.
en: members of the tribe of Benjamin, to which Saul belonged. They could shoot arrows and sling stones either right-handed or left-handed.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali dabili, ka o nyɛla ŋun kɔri bee ŋun guli biŋkɔbiri ka ti kuna, ka a dii yɛl o, Kamina ti ʒini di bindirigu.
en: Suppose one of you has a servant who has been working in the field, plowing or caring for the sheep. When he comes in from work, what would you say to him? Would you say, Come in, sit down and eat?.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba na ti ʒili, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ku lan tooi yihi ba n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa ni yaha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will plant my people on the land I gave them, and they will not be pulled up again. The Lord your God has spoken.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, dama bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli leei bɛ bin jɛmdili nyɛla be niŋgbuŋ kɔre; bɛ nyuri bara la di ni simdi ni vi mali ba shɛli zuɣu, ka bɛ baɣa kul bela dunia ŋɔ binyara ni kɔŋko.
en: Their lives end with destruction. Their god is their stomach, and they take pride in their disgrace because their thoughts focus on earthly things.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord Almighty gave this message to Zechariah:.

dag: Hal n yi bela kum vinvamli zibisim ni chana, n ku zo shɛli dabiɛm; dama a be n sani. A jaaŋgbee min a piɛgul jaaŋgbee la nyɛla din kpaŋsiri n suhu.
en: Even when I walk through the darkest valley, I fear no danger because you are with me. Your rod and your staff— they protect me.

dag: Amaa o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ ku bɛ bihi bɛna, kaman di ni daa sabi shɛm Musa zaligu kundi ni la. Luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Di kunya bihi banima bɛ bihi taali zuɣu bee n-ku bihi bɛ banim taali zuɣu, amaa di simdi ni sokam kpila omaŋmaŋ taali zuɣu.
en: But the children of those officers were not killed; the Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba mini m ma ti chɛ ma bahi, amaa Yawɛ ŋun kul ni gbib ma.
en: Even if my mother and father leave me, the Lord will take me in.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni piɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa zuɣu? Bɛ ni suhiri Naawuni sahakam?.
en: They should have desired the joy he gives; they should have constantly prayed to him.
