dag: Yisa daa ti be tin shɛl ni, ka kɔŋ ni daa wuligi do so niŋgbuŋ zaa ka o sanna ti damd o tooni balind o yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: Once Jesus was in a town where there was a man who was suffering from a dreaded skin disease. When he saw Jesus, he threw himself down and begged him, Sir, if you want to, you can make me clean.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bo tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbi wɔribariba pa n zuɣu, ka n daa lu soli m-mali hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo maa gomnanim sani n-daa zaŋ naa gbana maa ti ba.
en: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa taɣ o biɛhigu bɛ sani n-niŋdi kaman o nyɛla yinyaa la, ka bo bini n-chihiri dunɔdali punu chiha, ka chɛ ka o nintɔri zɔri dolisir o teeŋkɔbiri.
en: so he pretended to be crazy in front of Achish and his officers. While David was with them, he acted like a crazy man. He spat on the doors of the gate. He let spit fall down his beard.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa ka pii maa gbinna ni o ti tuhi ba, ka chaŋ ti miri di dunol ni ni o niŋ buɣim nyo li.
en: Abimelech and his army rushed to the fortress and tried to force their way inside. Abimelech himself was about to set the heavy wooden doors on fire.

dag: N-kaai biɛɣu ka bɛ paai Siizaria, ka Kɔniilius pun laɣim o dɔɣiriba min o zo suma na ka bɛ ti ʒiya guli ba.
en: They arrived in Caesarea the following day. Anticipating their arrival, Cornelius had gathered his relatives and close friends.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ wuhi ni di simdi ni niriba suhiri Naawuni sahakam ka di niŋdi anyinsi.
en: Jesus was telling them a parable about their need to pray continuously and not to be discouraged.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, a kul darigirila n tibili; ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai kaman wuuni saha tulim ni nyuuri mahili shɛm la.
en: Day and night you punished me, Lord ; my strength was completely drained, as moisture is dried up by the summer heat.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ dunianim zaa yipa vuhiya, ka nya suhudoo, ka sokam yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: But now, the whole country rests and is quiet. Now the people begin to celebrate.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa bɔhi bɔhigu shɛlikam min o ni daa zaŋ yɛlimuɣisir shɛlikam na puuni, nachimbih anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn mi di yɛla paai siɣimsiɣim bu pii zuɣu n-gari timlan kam bee saŋmaribaŋda kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: From then on, whenever the king asked for advice, he found their wisdom was ten times better than that of any of his other advisors and magicians.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, bɛ bi zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab nambɔɣu.
en: Wicked people are always hungry for evil; they have no mercy on anyone.

dag: n ku lan kari zuliya shɛb Jɔshua ni daa bi kari ka kpi la ti ba.
en: I will no longer drive out any of the nations that were still in the land when Joshua died.

dag: O yi ti zaŋ o paai yiŋa, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya m piɛ so ŋun daa bɔrigi la.
en: and carry it back home. Then you call your friends and neighbors together and say to them, I am so happy I found my lost sheep. Let us celebrate.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam je o mabia, o bela zibisim ni ka kul chanila zibisim maa puuni ka ʒi o ni kpari shɛli polo, dama zibisim maa zom o nina.
en: But the person who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and lives in the darkness, and doesnt know where to go because the darkness blinds the eyes.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ni ŋun nam ba la yɛliya, Yi ni tooi bɔhi ma bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ m bihi polo? Bee n-wuhi ma di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm?.
en: The LORD, the holy one of Israel and its maker, says: Are you questioning me about my own children? Are you telling me what to do with the work of my hands?.

dag: Chamiya ti du zoya zuɣu ŋ-ŋma dari na ti me n jɛmbu duu maa; ka n suhu paligi di zuɣu, ka lan nya jilima di ni.
en: Now go up into the hills, get lumber, and rebuild the Temple; then I will be pleased and will be worshiped as I should be.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di ni kɔbiri bi piɛla, ka di mi bi kpe puuni, amaa ka sabigi, maligumaana maa ŋun kparim o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o tee li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa m-be kaman o nu din la.
en: Then Jesus said to the man with the crippled hand, Hold out your hand. The man held out his hand, and it became well again, the same as the other hand.

dag: Yawɛ ti ti nasara. Chɛliya ka ti moli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ti ti ŋɔ Ziɔn.
en: The Lord got even for us. Come, lets tell about that in Zion. Lets tell what the Lord our God has done.

dag: O ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa din nyɛ o ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la zuɣu, ka o daa kpi lala maa. O daa dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli min o daalahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli.
en: So Zimri died because he sinned and did what the Lord said was wrong, just as Jeroboam did when he caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛli Rut, M bia, a yi shiri chani Bɔaz puu maa ni nti yihiri kayiha maa, di so. Di pa shɛli ka a chaŋ so puu ni ka puu maa lan ti yih a halibiɛɣu.
en: Naomi said to Ruth, Yes, daughter, it will be better for you to work with the women in Boaz' field. You might be molested if you went to someone else's field.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: Make a screen for the tents entrance of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and of fine twisted linen, decorated with needlework.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa tim Baanabas Antiɔk.
en: When the church in Jerusalem heard about this, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛli daa bol o, M bia Samuɛl. Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But Eli called Samuel, saying: Samuel, my son! Im here, Samuel said.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Uzia bia Jɔtam mi daa di Juda nam.
en: Jotham, Uzziahs son, became king of Judah in the second year of Israels King Pekah, Remaliahs son.

dag: Doo yi tum zina ni o kpee paɣa, bɛn kum o mini paɣ maa zaa.
en: If a man commits adultery with a married woman, committing adultery with a neighbors wife, both the adulterer and the adulteress must be executed.

dag: Hal ti ni daa paai Masidɔnia ti niŋgbuna daa bi nya vuhim baabiɛla. Ti daa nya wahala shɛlikam ni: Zabili daa yiri kpaŋ na, ka dabiɛm be ti suhuri ni.
en: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.

dag: Masia gba daa bi pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima. Naawuni n-daa lee piig o ka yɛl o: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: In the same way, Christ did not take upon himself the honor of being a high priest. Instead, God said to him, You are my Son; today I have become your Father.

dag: Shɛli ka ti ni din ni chɛ ka ti yɛli ni ti nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum tuma ŋɔ. Din chɛ ka ti tooi tumdi li yila Naawuni sanna.
en: There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God;.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira.
en: The voice of the Lord makes the lightning flash.

dag: O kul ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni saha shɛli zaa dɔro ŋɔ ni na be o ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni o yi kpaŋ ti be o ko.
en: They are unclean the whole time that they have the infection. They are unclean and must live outside the camp.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pia puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pinaayi dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the twelfth day of the tenth month of the tenth year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: N ni kul di tiŋgban shɛli fali maa biɛhigu shee viɛla; n ni di fali shɛli maa viɛla.
en: How wonderful are your gifts to me; how good they are!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ a niŋ a ni je ninvuɣ shɛba ka ŋmaligi ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la nuu ni.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Im now handing you over to those whom you hate and from whom you recoil.

dag: N ni zaŋ a leei Izraɛl naa, ka chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri tiŋgbani shɛm tariga zaa.
en: But I will make you king of Israel. You will rule over everything you want.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: But the king turned stubborn again and would not let the people go.

dag: Amaa Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani. N ni pirigi n namda pa Ɛdom zuɣu; ka tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim mi.
en: Moab will be the bowl for washing my feet. Edom will be the slave who carries my sandals. I will defeat the Philistines and shout in victory.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Mbo mfaaŋa, bi suŋ! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ tinsi pia fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: The king replied, Excellent! You are a good servant. Because you have been faithful in a small matter, you will have authority over ten cities.

dag: Chɛliya ka dunianim zaa ni sɔhiri o tooni. Dunia nyɛla din ba n-ʒiɛya, ka ku lan vuui.
en: Everyone on earth should tremble before him! But the world stands firm and cannot be moved.

dag: N daa fabili niŋ a n wahala dabisili dali, ka a garigi ma.
en: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe ha! Bee n-yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe! Ti miriya ka yi chaŋ bee nti doli ba.
en: People will say to you, Look there! or Look here! Dont leave or go chasing after them.

dag: Ka o naanyi zaŋ dari maa din kpalim mali o wuni zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li, ka suhiri li yɛra, Tiligim ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n wuni.
en: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. Protect me! he says. You are my god.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni saria karibu shee kpamba ni Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm kpamba ni nuhi tuumbaŋdiba ni machɛlinim ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm la nyaaŋa.
en: The letter was sent after King Jeconiah, the queen mother, the court officials, the government leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen and smiths had left Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a chɛ ti bahi yɔbahi sunsuuni, ka lan chɛ ti niŋ zibisim tital ni.
en: But youve crushed us in the place where jackals live, covering us with deepest darkness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn ti Kalɛb kaman Musa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la; ka o daa kari Anaki bidibis ata la nimaani.
en: The tribe of Judah gave the town of Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had told them to do. Caleb defeated the three Anakim clans and took over the town.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa tuumba ayi maa ni bɛ na yim kpaŋ pɔi. Ka jintɔriba maa daa niŋ tab saawara.
en: After ordering them to wait outside, the council members began to confer with each other.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa yaha, Yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni n-teei li tiri kulibɔna mini ko soya ni kopurim ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti n-yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam.
en: Moses, now command Aaron to hold his stick over the water. Then frogs will come from all rivers, canals, and ponds in Egypt, and they will cover the land.

dag: dama yi zaa ni tooi tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka ti taba, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi bɔhim shɛli, ka lan nya kpaŋsibu.
en: You can all prophesy one at a time so that everyone can learn and be encouraged.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka Pita mini Jɔn yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni saha shɛli maa, ka o maani ba bara.
en: That day he saw Peter and John going into the Temple area. He asked them for money.

dag: N kul gbibi n yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani sahakam, ka gbibi m min o daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I will always guard my loyal love toward him. My covenant with him will last forever.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, fam ma bahi. Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, sɔŋm ma yomyom.
en: Save me, O God! Lord , help me now!.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee viɛli gari? Siɣimiya tiŋgban ni ti dɔni pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu.
en: Egypt, you are no better than anyone else! Go down to the place of death. Go lie down with those foreigners.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But the farmers said to each other, This is the owners son, and this vineyard will be his. If we kill him, it will be ours.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o na. O ni daa ti mirina ka Yisa bɔh o.
en: Jesus stopped there and said, Bring that man to me! When he came close, Jesus asked him.

dag: Ka n daa gbi mɔɣa ŋ-ŋɔŋdi di kom yɔɣiri li.
en: I dug ponds to irrigate them.

dag: Di yi ni nani, yin chɛliya ka yi mini sokam ʒini ni suhudoo.
en: Do everything possible on your part to live in peace with everybody.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛn Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani maa ni daa tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Following the disgusting practices of the nations whom the Lord had driven out of the land as his people advanced, Manasseh sinned against the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ fo, dama bɛ daa ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: They didnt respond, since on the way they had been debating with each other about who was the greatest.

dag: Amaa m bi zaŋ Naawuni ni zali zaligu shɛli ŋɔ tumdi di tuma bee n sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya mi ni n deei shɛli yi sani, dama m paɣiya ni n kpi n-gari ni so niŋ ma shɛli din ni chɛ ka n kɔŋ n ni yɛn nyu bara shɛli zuɣu.
en: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.

dag: pakoli ŋɔ ni kaɣindi ma sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kari bɛ saria ŋɔ n-ti o nasara. Di yi pa lala, o waawaayili kandina ŋɔ ni nyɔni n nyee pam. .
en: I will help this widow because she keeps on bothering me. If I don't help her, she will wear me out.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul kpalim be nayili maa hal ti paai Naa Sairus nam dibu yuun tuuli saha.
en: So Daniel served the king until the first year that Cyrus was king.

dag: Suhimiya alibarika tim bɛn yɛri ya zilima; ka suhimiya Naawuni tim bɛn turi ya la.
en: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

dag: O daa lan buɣisi zɔŋ la mini dunɔdali din daa baɣi daantalisi la ni dundɔŋ ni luɣilikam, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi biɛhigu shee wɔɣa, ka yi ku tooi zaŋ li chaŋ nimaani, ka di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii tin shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani wɔɣilim maa zuɣu.
en: But that place might be too far for you to travel to. Maybe you will not be able to carry one-tenth of all the crops that the Lord has blessed you with. If that happens.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a ni lihi ʒiɛm ma ka kpuɣi Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la paɣa maa zuɣu, ninvuɣ kubo kul ku milig a yili ŋɔ.
en: So your family will never have peace! When you took Uriahs wife, you showed that you did not respect me.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka jila be di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ be di ni, ka gbaŋ pɔbi bɛ zaa. Amaa ka vuhim daa ka bɛ ni.
en: While I watched, the bones were covered with sinews and muscles, and then with skin. But there was no breath in the bodies.

dag: Lala ka Yisifu so tuumba maa ni daa ti yuli Baanabas la daa niŋ. O daa nyɛla Saipurus tiŋbia, ka nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nira.
en: Joseph, whom the apostles nicknamed Barnabas , was a Levite from Cyprus.

dag: Yinim bɛna, yi zaŋla ʒiri leei situra ye; yi zaa nyɛla timalaannim bɛn ka buchi.
en: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.

dag: Naawuni zaliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Didn't God command you to respect your father and mother? Didn't he tell you to put to death all who curse their parents?.

dag: N ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam zaa Masia ni tiri ma yaa la zuɣu.
en: Christ is the one who gives me the strength I need to do whatever I must do.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaɣisi din viɛla, bɛ dimnim ni ti kari doli ba.
en: they have rejected what is good. Because of this their enemies will pursue them.

dag: A yi chɛ ka a suhu ʒe dɛde, a ni tooi teeg a nuhi tir o.
en: Put your heart right, Job. Reach out to God.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi baŋdi n yɛligu gbinni? Yi ni bi deeri n yɛligu maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi baŋdi di gbinni maa.
en: Why dont you understand what Im saying? Its because you cant really hear my words.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Man Yisifu m-bala. M ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Amaa ka di daa gar o biɛyanim maa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: Joseph said to his brothers, I am Joseph. Is my father still alive? But when his brothers heard this, they were so terrified that they could not answer.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti bɔhi ma zaadali, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, ti daa bi malila a yuli yihiri waazu, ka mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka mal a yuli tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.

dag: Ti wumya ni ti ni shɛb daa ka yi sanna nti mali yɛl shɛŋa doli ya ni yi niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri bi doya, amaa pa tinima n-wuhi ba lala maa.
en: Weve heard that some of our number have disturbed you with unsettling words we didnt authorize.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa nimdi min o gbaŋ ni o nyɔri dina, zaŋm li yi yi sansani maa kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim, dama din nyɛla alahichi sara maligu.
en: Then take the bulls meat, his skin, and his other parts and go outside your camp and burn them. This bull is an offering to take away the sins of the priests.

dag: N saɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛlli ŋɔ puuni m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ zaɣ suŋ nyabu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi naai yi ni daa piligi niŋdi shɛli yuuni la ha. Di pa ni yi daa daŋmi piligi li kɔŋko, amaa yi daa daŋmi yu ni yi niŋ li.
en: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Taai polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti kuri niriba a puuni, ka bɛn dɛhi dansi la ŋuhira, ka bɛ ti daag a luhi, a lubu damli ni ti sɔhigi tin shɛŋa din ʒe teeku duli.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: The countries along the Mediterranean coast will shake at the sound of your fall. That will happen when your people are hurt and killed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti mali jɛma shili, di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zani bɛ zaashɛhi, ka Lɛvinim mi daa piripiri taba zani kaman naa ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: When everything was ready, the priests and the Levites took their places as the king had ordered.

dag: Wuntizɔriba muɣisigu galisiya pam, amaa Yawɛ yihiri ba di zaa ni.
en: Good people suffer many troubles, but the Lord saves them from them all;.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tiba mal alibarika, a ni zaŋ a zaligu wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb gba mal alibarika.
en: Lord , how happy are those you instruct, the ones to whom you teach your law!.

dag: Amaa ka o tumtumda maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili be tiŋ ŋɔ ni ka bɛ tir o jilima pam. O yɛligu bi yiɣisira. Chɛ ka ti chaŋ o sani, di pa shɛli o ni tooi wuhi ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: But the boy said to him, Listen, theres a man of God in this town. Hes famous—everything he says actually happens! So lets go there. Maybe hell be able to tell us which way we should go.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba du n-tam ti zuɣu; ti kpe buɣim mini kom ni gari yi, amaa a zaŋ ti tahi luɣ shɛli din galisi na.
en: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.

dag: Nyama, a wuhi niriba pam, ka kpaŋsi bɛn nuhi ka yaa.
en: Remember how your words.

dag: Man mɛla du shɛli din mali jilima ti a ni di nyɛ a ni yɛn be luɣ shɛli sahakam.
en: Now I have built a majestic temple for you, a place for you to live in forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua.

dag: Paɣ zinalan biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O dirimi ka nyɛh o noli ka yɛli, M bi tum gala.
en: An unfaithful wife says, Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi kpamba maa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka lan mal o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒiin o tooni la saawara.
en: But Rehoboam did not listen to the advice from the older men. He asked the young men who were his friends.

dag: Di tiwul kpana kuumi kab lu, ka paɣiba va li ti mali buɣim. Dama niriba maa nyɛla bɛn bi baŋdi shɛli, dinzuɣu ŋun nam ba maa ku zo ba nambɔɣu bee n-niŋ ba nirilim.
en: The branches of the trees are withered and broken, and women gather them for firewood. Because the people have understood nothing, God their Creator will not pity them or show them any mercy.

dag: Ka ŋunkam saɣim Naawuni zaligu zaɣ yini ni mali di zaa saɣimbu taali.
en: Whoever breaks one commandment is guilty of breaking them all.

dag: ka doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa, ka ti a a ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Eli replied, Go home. Everything will be fine. The God of Israel will answer your prayer.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti zahim li, ŋun daa pihi pam dini shɛli daa bi guui, ka ŋun mi daa pihi biɛla dini shɛli daa bi poog o. Sokam daa kul pihila o dibu tariga.
en: Everyone had exactly what they needed, just the right amount.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun tum zina, o ka yɛm. Ŋun tum lala o saɣim omaŋa.
en: But a man who commits adultery is a fool. He brings about his own destruction.

dag: Bɛ kuhigu maa ni, bɛ ni ti yili kuyilli a zuɣu. Tin dini n-na mi n-wurim teeku sunsuuni kaman Taai ni wurim shɛm ŋɔ?.
en: In their grief they sing a funeral song for you: Tyre, you were greater than all other cities. But now you lie in silence at the bottom of the sea.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, ka ti leei n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Then you will live in the land that I gave to your ancestors, you will be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: Ka Isaka zuliya ni toondaannim daa doli Dɛbɔra; Isaka zuliya niriba maa daa ʒe Barak yim, ka dol o du o napɔŋkpahi siɣi vinvamli maa ni. Amaa Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: The leaders of Issachar came along with Deborah; Issachar was attached to Barak, and was sent into the valley behind him. Among the clans of Reuben there was deep soul-searching.

dag: A ku ŋmaligi a nini bahi kpaŋ biɛla, ka chɛ ma hal ka n ti vali n nintɔri?.
en: Won't you look away long enough for me to swallow my spit?.

dag: Di simdi ni yi mini yi yinsinim ti zaŋdi ba chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa nti kɔriti ba ŋubiri Yawɛ tooni yuuni kam.
en: Year after year, you and your family are allowed to eat these animals in the presence of the LORD your God, in the location the LORD selects.

dag: Chɛ ka n wuhibu ŋɔ lu kaman saa la, ka n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣi lu kaman maligim la bee kaman saa ni yi luna baalim bahi mɔri zuɣu shɛm la; ka lan be kaman sa yuɣiyuɣi din yuɣisiri bahiri bimbilima zuɣu la.
en: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti bɔhi Naawuni, Ti ni daŋ dini niriba n-simdi ni bɛ daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa? Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-ni daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: The Israelites went up to the city of Bethel. At Bethel they asked God, Which tribe will be first to attack the tribe of Benjamin? The Lord answered, The tribe of Judah will go first.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi daŋdi yibu chan o sani Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ti wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Early each morning all the people went to the Temple to listen to him.

dag: Di saha ka waɣ biɛ titali maa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi paɣ maa zuɣu, ka o lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi paɣ maa zuliya bɛn kpalim n-nyɛ bɛn doli Naawuni zaligunima ka mali Yisa shɛhira la.
en: The dragon was furious with the woman and went off to fight against the rest of her descendants, all those who obey God's commandments and are faithful to the truth revealed by Jesus.

dag: Nooŋa ni siɣi zana ni ka bɛ bi bari li? Ka tɔŋ ni tooi tɔhi ka pa ni bɛ bari li mi ka binshɛɣu no li?.
en: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Others are like the seed planted among the thorny weeds. They hear the teaching.

dag: Yinim bɛn bari bun piɛla ka ʒi bunnyaampar gahinda zuɣu mini yinim bɛn doli soya, yɛlimiya di yɛla.
en: Listen, everyone! Whether you ride a donkey with a padded saddle or have to walk.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala yihi nanima anu maa vol maa ni na ti ti o. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa.
en: So Joshuas men brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.

dag: Amaa lee daŋmiya m-bola Naawuni nam dubu min o wuntia, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: Instead, desire first and foremost Gods kingdom and Gods righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ yɔhim bɛmaŋa n-niŋ din ka buchi naani, dama din ka buchi maa n-ni ti nyɛ bɛ sanyoo.
en: If they are foolish enough to trust in evil, then evil will be their reward.

dag: Daba ata maa dali, ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ ka tiligi, dama n zɔri Naawuni.
en: After three days Joseph said to them, I am a God-fearing man. Do this, and I will let you live.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛli daa kani ka ti bi dee li bɛ sani. Di daa nyɛla fɔntinsi pihiyɔbu, Arigɔb yaɣili zaa mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi nam ʒiishee la.
en: Then we took all the cities that belonged to Og at that time. We took all the cities from Ogs people— cities in the area of Argob, Ogs kingdom in Bashan.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabi zali ni faashee Masia di wahala, ka lan neei kum ni daba ata dali;.
en: He said to them, This is what is written: the Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day.

dag: Amaa ŋun zaŋ omaŋa tabili ti Duuma min o leela shi yino.
en: But he who joins himself to the Lord becomes spiritually one with him.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa mini kaya shɛŋa ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: These are the laws, rules, and teachings that the Lord gave to the Israelites. These laws are the agreement between the Lord and the Israelites. The Lord gave these laws to Moses at Mount Sinai.

dag: Chamiya Lɛbanɔn nti kuhi pam, ka duhi yi yee Bashan. Kuhimiya Abarim polo bahina, dama bɛ ku yi ni yuri shɛba.
en: People of Jerusalem, go to Lebanon and shout, go to the land of Bashan and cry; call out from the mountains of Moab, because all your allies have been defeated.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na chana, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna nti tiriti wuhir o Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duri.
en: After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, Look at all these buildings.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, told me to go and say to King Zedekiah of Judah, I, the Lord , will hand this city over to the king of Babylonia, and he will burn it down.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , because he is good; his love is eternal.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Malimiya yimaŋa, dama biɛɣuni Yawɛ sa ni tum alahiziba tuma yi sani.
en: Joshua told the people, Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord , because he is going to do some amazing things for us.

dag: Ka tumtumdi kpeem bilikɔɣino ŋɔ dan maa daa paɣ o pam o dahin shɛli tɛha maa zuɣu, dama bɛn doli zibisim soli dunia ŋɔ ni mali yɛmbimbiɛri bɛ tuma ni gari bɛn doli neesim soli.
en: Later, the master told the dishonest manager that he had done a smart thing. Yes, worldly people are smarter in their business with each other than spiritual people are.

dag: Imɛr daŋ ni: Hanani mini Zɛbadia.
en: Clan of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ n-daa yɛli ma.
en: So I said to them, The LORDs word came to me.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked at them carefully and said, Its impossible for human beings. But all things are possible for God.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni wuɣi tampiɛl viɛl shɛli niŋ a ŋariŋ tani, ka di nyɛ a tuuta. Ka a zuɣusaa bimparigu din nyɛ zaɣ sabinli mini zaɣ ʒee la yi Ɛlisha teeku duli na.
en: Your sails were made of linen, Embroidered linen from Egypt, Easily recognized from afar. Your awnings were made of finest cloth, Of purple from the island of Cyprus.

dag: Ka Rut yɛli, N ni niŋ a ni yɛl shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Ruth answered, I will do everything you say.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili; ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to wait on them.

dag: A mi bɛ ni turi ma, ka dihiri ma vi, ka filindi ma shɛm yɛla; a mi n dimnim zaa.
en: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n daa dihirila Yɛhudianim mini zuɣulaannim ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi tinzun tinsi din gili ti ni n-ka ti sanna.
en: Also, I regularly fed Jews who were always welcome at my table, and I fed those who came to us from the nations around us.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mali yurilim maŋli sahakam zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani, ka chɛ ka o wuntitali yiri zahira bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi sani ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yuri ti m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni daa nyɛ alahichinim saha shɛl la ka Masia daa kpi ti zuɣu.
en: But Christ died for us while we were still sinners, and by this God showed how much he loves us.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa ti paai yuun pihiwɛi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Kɛnan.
en: After Enosh was years old, he had a son named Kenan.

dag: Ka yi ni so yi zaɣisi ti ni yɛli ya shɛm gbaŋ ŋɔ ni deebu, yin kpahimmiya dilana, ka di chɛliya ka yi min o lan mali jina, ka di ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: It may be that some there will not obey the message we send you in this letter. If so, take note of them and have nothing to do with them, so that they will be ashamed.

dag: yɛlimaŋli, yi ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ninvuɣ so n-leei yi naa ka o sun ya. Yi ni tooi zaŋ yi zuliya ni nira n-leei yi naa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ tinzun nira ŋun pa yi mabia n-leei yi naa.
en: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.

dag: Alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ beni, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba beni; amaa alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba viɛlim be di ko.
en: There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. The heavenly bodies have one kind of glory, and the earthly bodies have another kind of glory.

dag: Naawuni bi bela zuɣusaa ha? Nyam saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha ni be zuɣusaa ha shɛm!.
en: Doesn't God live in the highest heavens and look down on the stars, even though they are high?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ. .
en: I am the God who appeared to you at Bethel, where you dedicated a stone as a memorial by pouring olive oil on it and where you made a vow to me. Now get ready and go back to the land where you were born.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna, di saha ti ni du n-chaŋ, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ ti nuu ni. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ shihirili ti sani.
en: But if the Philistine men say, Come up here, then we will climb up to them. That will be a sign from God. That will mean that the Lord will allow us to defeat them.

dag: Nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuntialana, ka mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni ŋɔ, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri zan tariga, ka niŋ wuntizɔriba zaɣ viɛlli.
en: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.

dag: A ni kpi ŋun bi guni kum tinzunnim nuu ni. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala. .
en: You will die as the uncircumcised do, at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken. This is what the LORD God has said.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni na.
en: Moses and Aaron went and stood in front of the Tent.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni ti kpihim kum birili, ka nyahi sokam zaa nintam, ka vuui o niriba ni nyari filiŋ shɛl la dunia ŋɔ ni zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa bahi yoli, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila kol pala ni.
en: Nor does anyone pour new wine into used wineskins, because the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the skins will be ruined. Instead, new wine must be poured into fresh wineskins.

dag: Ka viri mini kahiŋkɔri zaŋ li leei bɛ biɛhigu shee. Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka di lan leei tiŋgban kpiŋ yaha, kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Birds and small animals will own that land. It will be a home for owls and ravens. God will leave that land in ruins. People will call it the empty desert.

dag: Tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini mini di dapuhi ni kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili dunol la.
en: the altar for burning incense and its poles; the anointing oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain that covers the door at the entrance to the Holy Tent;.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka zɔri Yawɛ, di so ni nir mali buni pam ka di mal o muɣisigu.
en: Better to be poor and fear the Lord than to be rich and in trouble.

dag: Ka Yawɛ gba ni tuhi lala zuliyanim maa tɔbu kaman o ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tɔbu tuhibu dal la.
en: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ o yɛda maa, Yi yi doli n yɛligu, yi ni niŋ n nyaandol maŋa.
en: So Jesus said to the Jews who believed in him, If you continue to accept and obey my teaching, you are really my followers.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa Gɔg yi ti kana ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ, n suhu ni yiɣisi pam.
en: When you invade Israel, I will become furious.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni tɛha bi wuhi ma ni m mali galimi, amaa dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni m bebu tuhiya zaa. N Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun kariti ma saria.
en: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.

dag: Teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di puuni vuma, dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni, yilimiya yila.
en: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.

dag: Tuuni kam nyɛla din tuhi ŋun tum li sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi suhu.
en: Everyones path is straight in their own eyes, but the LORD weighs the heart.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali. Ka dabisi shɛli din paya n-nyɛ biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, bɛ daa bi lan ku so pahi. Bɛ daa zaŋ dindali maa leela suhupiɛlli chuɣu dabisili.
en: This happened on the th day of the month Adar. On the th day the Jews rested and made that day a happy day of feasting.

dag: ni zoli kam zuɣu mɔɣu ni la yɛla. N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ zaa ni n-yo yi daalahichi maa samli.
en: and on the mountains in the open country. I will have your enemies take away your wealth and your treasures because of all the sins you have committed throughout your land.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul laɣindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni suhu yini biɛɣukam, ka laɣindi taba yinsi n-laɣindi diri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The believers shared a common purpose, and every day they spent much of their time together in the Temple area. They also ate together in their homes. They were happy to share their food and ate with joyful hearts.

dag: Musa ni daa piri tiŋgbani maa tari Mɔab bɔpiɛligu la ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la shɛm m-bala.
en: This is how Moses divided the land east of Jericho and the Jordan when he was in the plains of Moab.

dag: ka bɛ gula maa yi ti nya ka tɔbu kani tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o piɛbi kikaa yɛli niriba maa di yɛla.
en: When he sees the sword coming against the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy— To the people of the church in Thessalonica, who belong to God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: May grace and peace be yours.

dag: Jɔab n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya la mi daa su Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim fukumsi.
en: Joab was captain of the whole army of Israel. Benaiah son of Jehoiada led the Kerethites and Pelethites.

dag: Biɛɣ asiba ka Yawɛ daa be sagban buɣim daantaliga maa ni, ka lihi tiŋ na n-nya Ijipti tɔbbihi maa, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lu abirima.
en: Early that morning the Lord looked down from the tall cloud and column of fire at the Egyptian army. Then he made them panic.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ka niriba baŋ a kpiɔŋ tuma min a nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla.
en: So others will learn about the mighty things you do, about the glory of your kingdom—how marvelous it is!.

dag: Ŋuna n-yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa n-wuhi di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm n-zaŋ li tari ba; ka bɛ kul su li sahakam, ka be di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: It is the Lord who will divide the land among them and give each of them a share. They will live in the land age after age, and it will belong to them forever.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa piri tɔbbihi maa sɔŋ n-gu tɔbu maa. Bɛ daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam dola tiŋ maa nuzaa polo, ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim mi do tiŋ maa wulinluhili polo. Amaa ka Jɔshua daa gbe vinvamli maa ni.
en: Now all his troops were in place. Part of the army was in the camp to the north of Ai, and the others were hiding to the west, ready to make a surprise attack. That night, Joshua went into the valley.

dag: Di bi simdi ni doo zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dama o nyɛla Naawuni kɔtomsi min o jilima, ka paɣ mi nyɛ doo jilima.
en: But a man should not cover his head, because he is made like God and is Gods glory. But woman is mans glory.

dag: Hɛman mini Jɛdutun n-daa nyɛ bɛn piɛbiri kikahi ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ni biŋkumdi shɛŋa din pahi n-yiini yila din be kasi la. Ka bɛ daa pii Jɛdutun bidibisi n-leei dunɔguliba.
en: Heman and Jeduthun were with them. They had the job of blowing the trumpets and playing cymbals. They also had the job of playing other musical instruments when songs were sung to God. Jeduthuns sons guarded the gates.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun be sarika ŋɔ ni pahi n zuɣu Yisa Masia zuɣu la puhir a.
en: Epaphras, who is in prison with me for the sake of Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ lumiya Yawɛ sizuura, ka jɛm o ni yɛlimaŋli, ka ʒe o yim. Zaŋmiya wun shɛŋa yi yaannim ni daa jɛmdi Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti la bahi ka jɛm Yawɛ.
en: So now, revere the LORD. Serve him honestly and faithfully. Put aside the gods that your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt and serve the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini din ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.

dag: Wula ka ninvuɣ yino ni tooi kari doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka niriba ayi mi tuhi nyaŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka pa ni bɛ Tampiŋ n-kɔhi ba? Ka pa ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni?.
en: How could one person chase off a thousand in battle? How could two people make ten thousand flee for their lives? Only because their rock sold them off, only because the LORD handed them over!.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa niŋ shɛhira ka tɔɣisi ti Duuma yɛligu naai maa ka bɛ daa doli Samaria tiŋkpansi pam chani yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-labiri kuni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After they had given their testimony and proclaimed the Lord's message, Peter and John went back to Jerusalem. On their way they preached the Good News in many villages of Samaria.

dag: Yawɛ, yihim ma ʒirinim mini bɛn yɔhindi niriba nuu ni.
en: Save me, Lord , from liars and deceivers.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yi ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, bɛn kpalimmi zani di kom maa ni baalim.
en: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, Doo maa ka kpe na? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl ba, Nyamiya, o sɔɣ be kpalansi ŋɔ nyaaŋa.
en: The people prayed, Our Lord , is Saul here? Yes, the Lord answered, he is hiding behind the baggage.

dag: M pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla siɣimsiɣim paai shɛm, ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan labi yɛli ya di yɛla ni nintam. Niriba pam beni ka bɛ biɛhigu zaŋ ba leela Masia dapulli zuɣu kum la dimnima.
en: As I have told you many times and now say with deep sadness, many people live as enemies of the cross.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyini ka ti niŋ naani, zom ti nambɔɣu. Guli ti dabisili kam. Tiligim ti ti muɣisigu nyabu saha.
en: Lord , be kind to us. We have waited for your help. Give us strength every morning. Save us when we are in trouble.

dag: O daa ʒe yim ŋun piig o maa sani kaman Anabi Musa ni daa ʒe yim o tuma ni Naawuni niriba sani shɛm la.
en: He was faithful to God, who chose him to do this work, just as Moses was faithful in his work in God's house.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa ti miri kum, o daa bolila o bia Yisifu ti yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ, nyin zaŋm a nuu tim n gbalipini lɔŋni ka lo alikauli ni a ni tum ma ʒiɛyimtali tuma ni yɛlimaŋli. Di sɔɣi ma Ijipti ŋɔ.
en: Israels death approached. He summoned his son Joseph and said to him, If you would be so kind, lay your hand under my thigh, and be loyal and true to me. Dont bury me in Egypt.

dag: O daa zaŋ o zali tiŋgbani luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu; ka daa zaŋ puri ni bindira dihir o. O daa zaŋ tampima voya ni shiri mini chɛribo kuɣa voya ni kpam dih o.
en: God made Israel glide over the highlands; he fed him with food from the field, nursed him with honey from a boulder, with oil from a hard rock.

dag: Binnui so mi daŋ ni: Shimɛi so yaha.
en: Clan of Binnui: Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka teeku vuri fɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔgbana vuri fɔra; nyini n-lan chɛ ka niriba bɛn taai duŋ gba fɔra.
en: You can calm the roughest seas or the nations raging around us.

dag: ŋun woligim omaŋ ka chɛ wain mini binnyuri kpɛma, ka di nyu bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi komihigu mali shɛli bee binnyuri kpeen shɛli, o mi di nyu wain tiwala kom bee n-di di zaɣ maha bee di zaɣ kuma.
en: shall abstain from wine and beer. You shall not drink any kind of drink made from grapes or eat any grapes or raisins.

dag: o ni daa zali teeku di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka di kom ku zo n-yaɣi o ni zal li shɛli tariga, o ni daa booi tiŋgbani tarisi saha shɛli.
en: when he set a limit for the sea, so the water couldnt go beyond his command, when he marked out the earths foundations.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunoli daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu mini daanya sara maligu bimbini ni di daanya kurupooti la ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma.
en: That bronze was used to make the bases at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. They also used the bronze to make the altar and the bronze grating. And the bronze was used to make all the tools and dishes for the altar.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim maligumaaniba, yi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.

dag: Lala zuɣu Masia ŋun daa zaŋ omaŋ mali sara yim ni o kpihim niriba pam daalahichi la ni lan labina pahi buyi, ka di pala alahichi zuɣu, amaa o yɛn labina ti tiligila bɛn suhuri kul ye o labbuna zuɣu ka guhir o la.
en: In the same way, Christ was also offered once to take on himself the sins of many people. He will appear a second time, not to take away sin but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

dag: di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Amɔz bia Aizaia, Pirigim a buɣu ŋɔ min a namda ŋɔ, ka o daa niŋ lala, ka chani o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa.
en: At that time the Lord spoke through Isaiah son of Amoz. He said, Go, take the sackcloth off your waist and the sandals off your feet. So Isaiah obeyed the Lord and went without clothes or sandals.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, dim n ni zaŋ binshɛli ti a maa, ŋubimi gbaŋ maa ka chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord said, Ezekiel, son of man, after you eat this scroll, go speak to the people of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa niŋ yɛda maa laɣim be, ka laɣim su bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa.
en: All the believers continued together in close fellowship and shared their belongings with one another.

dag: Ti yi zahim timaŋa ni yɛlimaŋli, dindina ti ku lan nya saria karibu.
en: But if we had judged ourselves, we wouldnt be judged.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham Juda tin shɛl ni ti ʒini? Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Chama. Ka Dauda lan bɔhi, N cham tiŋ kani? Ka o yɛl o, Cham Hiburɔn.
en: Later, David asked the Lord , Should I go back to one of the towns of Judah? The Lord answered, Yes. David asked, Which town should I go to? Go to Hebron, the Lord replied.

dag: Ŋariŋ kara pala di kom zuɣu chana, ka Lɛviatan be di ni diɛmda.
en: Ships sail over the ocean, and playing there is Leviathan, the great sea creature you made.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, A bia Yisifu kana; ka o daa kpaŋ omaŋ yiɣisi ʒin o bindoo zuɣu.
en: When Joseph arrived, someone told Israel, Your son Joseph has come to see you. Israel was very weak, but he tried hard and sat up in his bed.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa chaŋ ti liri Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ tuhi ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia Bɛzɛk.
en: When Judah went up, the LORD handed them the Canaanites and Perizzites. They defeated ten thousand men at Bezek.

dag: Yi yi kali ninvuɣ so ka o yuma paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, di simdi ka o yo man Yawɛ ni zali farigu shɛli maa.
en: Everyone being counted in the census, that is, every man twenty years old or older, is to pay me this amount.

dag: Di saha tiŋ maa dɔbba zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa ku o. Lala ka yi ni niŋ n-yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum di yɛla ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: Then the men in the town must kill the son with stones. By doing this you will remove this evil from your group. Everyone in Israel will hear about this and be afraid.

dag: Dinzuɣu yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o ni yɛli shɛm min o fukumsi zalikpana ni o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi sahakam.
en: So you must love the Lord your God. You must do what he tells you to do and always obey his laws, rules, and commands.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ ba kaman o ni daa ku Ogi mini Sihɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanima ka niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm la.
en: The Lord will destroy those people, just as he defeated Sihon and Og, kings of the Amorites, and destroyed their country.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya, Yi ni niŋdi shɛli ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla dini.
en: When your children ask you, What does this ritual mean.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri, ŋun na kul be tuumbiɛri maa tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mali tabizahim, ŋun na kul be o tabizahim tuma maa ni; ka ŋunkam nyɛ wuntizɔra, ŋun na kul be din tuhi tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mi be kasi, ŋun na kul kpalimmi be kasi.
en: Whoever is evil must go on doing evil, and whoever is filthy must go on being filthy; whoever is good must go on doing good, and whoever is holy must go on being holy.

dag: So kani m-be kasi kaman nyin Yawɛ, so lan kani m-pah a zuɣu. Tampin shɛli mi kani m-be kaman nyin Yawɛ.
en: No other god is like you. And with you we are safer than on a high mountain.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita daa yɛli Yisa, Nyama, ti chɛla ti yinsi ka dol a.
en: Then Peter said, Look! We have left our homes to follow you.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam deei n tumo deela mani, ka ŋunkam mi deei ma deela ŋun tim ma na.
en: I assure you, whoever accepts the person I send also accepts me. And whoever accepts me also accepts the one who sent me.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Biɛɣuni sa nyɛla gol palli dabisili, ka bɛ sa ni bɔ a kɔŋ, dama a sa ku ʒi a ʒiishee.
en: Jonathan said to David, Tomorrow is the New Moon celebration. Your seat will be empty, so my father will see that you are gone.

dag: Ka o daa pii bɛ niriba tuhi pisopɔin ni bɛ ʒiri ʒiya, ka pii niriba tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ zoya tiŋgban ni ti kpɛri kuɣa, ka zaŋ niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa.
en: He assigned , of them to transport materials and , to cut stones in the mountains, and appointed , supervisors to make sure the work was done.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa lihi Amalɛknima, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Amalɛknima n-daa be zuliya kam tooni, Amaa bɛ bahigu ni ti nyɛla bahi yoli zaa.
en: And I saw this vision about the Amalekites: Their nation is now great, but it will someday disappear forever.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima.
en: Was Johns baptism of heavenly or of human origin.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda, ka niŋ man gba yɛda.
en: Dont be troubled. Trust in God. Trust also in me.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa na bi chaŋ alizanda ni, amaa ka daa yɛli: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: For it was not David who went up into heaven; rather he said, The Lord said to my Lord: Sit here at my right side.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla, ka malila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini kɔŋko bɛ ŋariŋ ni.
en: The disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.

dag: O filim karimbaannima; ka saɣim bɛ tiŋ din mali yaa; ka daai di goma luhi tiŋa.
en: He has humbled those who were proud; he destroyed the strong city they lived in, and sent its walls crashing into the dust.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka binshɛli kani n-so m-pahila di simdi ni ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa di bɛ tuma nyɔri, bɛ tarili m-bala. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ ba labisina ka bɛ ti nya din yɛn be bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.

dag: Yawɛ darigi n tibili pam, amaa o bi chɛ ka n kpi.
en: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini n-zaŋ doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo ni bɛ lɔɣi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ maa gari. Ka niriba maa suhuri daa ti yiɣisi pam soli maa ni.
en: The Israelites had to go around the territory of Edom, so when they left Mount Hor, they headed south toward the Red Sea. But along the way, the people became so impatient.

dag: Samarianim maa ni daa wum Filip yɛligu ka nya o ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa ni suhu yini.
en: The people there heard Philip and saw the miraculous signs he was doing. They all listened carefully to what he said.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-nyɛ ŋun biri alikama biɛlin suma la.
en: He answered, The man who planted the good seed in the field is the Son of Man.

dag: Amaa o suhu yi na kul yumi ni o niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka m bi kana ti yɛl a ka a zo n-tiligi ni alaafee, Yawɛ ŋun niŋmi mani Jɔnatan zaɣ biɛɣu n-gari m ba ni yɛn niŋ a shɛm maa, Yawɛ ni be a sani kaman o ni be m ba sani shɛm la.
en: But if he wants to harm you, I promise to tell you and help you escape. And I ask the Lord to punish me severely if I don't keep my promise. I pray that the Lord will bless you, just as he used to bless my father.

dag: Nyama, mɔɣili kopaliga yi ti kpɛma, o bi zɔri dabiɛm; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kopaliga yi ŋmɛr o noli o suhu ʒimi.
en: If the river surges, he doesnt hurry; he is confident even though the Jordan gushes into his mouth.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm maa min o nyaaŋa daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na; amaa bɛ daa bi lan gbahi ba ni kiŋkansi yaha, dama bɛ daa zɔrimi ni niriba ti lab ba kuɣa.
en: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba binshɛɣukam.
en: Jesus said, Only you can know the secret truth about Gods kingdom. But to those other people I tell everything by using stories.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋm chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnima, ka di niŋ din pahi napɔŋ buyi.
en: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa nya Ilaija, o daa bɔh o mi, Nyin ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnim maa m-bala.
en: When Ahab saw Elijah he said, Is that really you, the troublemaker of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Nan bia Jɔshua zali ka yɛl o, Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, n ni be a sani.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun and said, Be strong and brave. You will lead the Israelites into the land I promised them, and I will be with you.

dag: O daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub sara maligu bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li ti ti bɛn daa be o sani maa.
en: He went into the house of God, took the bread offered to God, ate it, and gave it also to his men. Yet it is against our Law for anyone except the priests to eat that bread.

dag: Dama a suhuyiɣisili chɛmi ka ti dabisa garita; ti yuma kul naarimi kaman siɣimbu la.
en: Yes, all our days slip away because of your fury; we finish up our years with a whimper.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Dindina zaŋmiya wuna la bahi, ka zaŋya yi suhuri niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni.
en: Then Joshua said, So throw away the false gods that you have among you. Love the Lord , the God of Israel, with all your heart.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn simdi ni bɛ ti neei kum ni n-kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee ti ku kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: Some people will be worthy to be raised from death and live again after this life. In that life they will not marry.

dag: O yi niŋ ya kaman o daba n-nyɛn ya la bee n-saɣim yi bini bee n-din ya zalinsi bee n-ʒiɛm ya bee ŋ-ŋmɛn ya tapaɣa, yi dir o suɣilo.
en: You put up with it if someone enslaves you, if someone exploits you, if someone takes advantage of you, if someone places themselves over you, or if someone hits you in the face.

dag: Bɛ ni yo a a pagɔrisigu tuma maa samli, ka a nya yi buɣijɛmbo alahichi tibidarigibo, ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ a Duuma Yawɛ.
en: They will punish you for the wicked things you did. You will be punished for worshiping your filthy idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi nimaani n-chani Samaria n-daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Piɛguliba Dooshee la.
en: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, Who are you? We are relatives of Ahaziah, they answered. We're going to visit his family.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti yihi alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa kpam zaa, kpam din pili namanama la mini namanama maa ni kpam zaa.
en: From this bull he shall take all the fat, the fat on the internal organs.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi yi ti boli ma n-suhi ma, n ni wum yi suhigu maa.
en: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.

dag: Ka Tiyaawumya daa yi Filistianim maa sanna, o yuli n-daa booni Goliat ka o yi tiŋ shɛli din yuli booni Gaat na. O wɔɣilim daa nyɛla kaman mita ata laasabu.
en: The Philistine army had a hero named Goliath who was from the town of Gath and was about three meters tall.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul zoori ka mali zuɣu Yawɛ mini salinim sani.
en: The boy Samuel continued to grow and to gain favor both with the Lord and with people.

dag: Dim a bindira ni suhupiɛlli, ka nyum a wain ni suhupiɛlli, dama Naawuni pun saɣi ti a ni niŋdi shɛm maa ka di waɣa.
en: Go ahead—eat your food and be happy; drink your wine and be cheerful. It's all right with God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ni bɔhim n niriba maa soya ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka zaŋdi n yuli pɔri bɛ pɔri yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi n niriba maa ka bɛ pɔri Baal shɛm la, dindina bɛ ni pahi n niriba ni.
en: If with all their hearts they will accept the religion of my people and will swear, As the Lord lives—as they once taught my people to swear by Baal—then they will also be a part of my people and will prosper.

dag: Ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: And whoever kills another person must be put to death.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa lab kuli, ka naa maa ti bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ŋmaligi labina.
en: When messengers came back to Ahaziah, he asked them, Why did you come back so soon.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ti ma vuhim luɣilikam, ka n ka dima bee zuɣubiɛɣu yɛl shɛli.
en: Now, thanks to the Lord God, there is peace in my kingdom and no trouble or threat of war anywhere.

dag: Di saha ka a dol a soli ni alaafee, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui shɛli.
en: As you go through life, you will always be safe and never fall.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri ni o saɣim o yuli yɛra, N daa kpuɣila paɣ ŋɔ, amaa ka m min o ti dɔni, ka m bi nya o paɣipalitali shihira.
en: So he makes up false charges against her, accusing her of not being a virgin when they got married.

dag: mini Jɔana ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛrɔd yiŋ tumtumdi so ŋun yuli daa booni Chuza la paɣa ni Suzaana ni niriba pam bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli zɔri Yisa min o nyaandoliba kuŋ la.
en: Joanna , Susanna, and many others who provided for them out of their resources.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Jɔtam bia Naa Ahaz mi daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaz, Jothams son, became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah, Remaliahs son.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila jɛr so ŋun daa me o yili zali bihigu ni.
en: But everybody who hears these words of mine and doesnt put them into practice will be like a fool who built a house on sand.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Saadis Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali Naawuni shih ayopɔin mini saŋmaris ayopɔin la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi mali yuli din wuhiri ni yi ne, amaa yi kpimi.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis: These are the words of the one who holds Gods seven spirits and the seven stars: I know your works. You have the reputation of being alive, and you are in fact dead.

dag: Dama ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia la palɔni kɔŋko pala Yɛhudia alali, ka gunibu maŋli mi pala din niŋ niŋgbuŋ palɔni kɔŋko.
en: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛba yo wuntizɔriba talima samli, ka zaŋ bɛn ka yɛda yo bɛn biɛhigu tuhi samli.
en: The wicked must pay for what happens to good people—the cheaters will be taken in exchange for the honest.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn tuui chɛ ka Hozia zaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnima, o daa yɛlila ŋun Hozia, Cham ti kpuɣi pagɔrili n-dɔɣi pagɔrili bihi. Dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim tum yolimyolim pam ka zaɣisi man Yawɛ, ka bi ʒe ma yim.
en: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, the LORD said to him,Go, marry a prostitute and have children of prostitution, for the people of the land commit great prostitution by deserting the LORD.

dag: Ibram paɣa Zarai daa bi dɔɣi bihi. Zarai daa mali Ijipti dab bipuɣiŋga ka o yuli booni Haga.
en: Abram's wife Sarai had not borne him any children. But she had an Egyptian slave woman named Hagar.

dag: O ni daa di nam ti paai yuma anahi ni gol so ŋun pahir ayi daba ayi dali ka o daa piligi duu maa mɛbu.
en: Solomon started to build on the second day of the second month of his fourth year as king of Israel.

dag: O yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin yɛlimiya yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min o nyaandoliba lee yɛn ʒini puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: He will go into a house. Tell the owner of the house, The Teacher asks that you show us the room where he and his followers can eat the Passover meal.

dag: Dama alikauli maa nyɛla yi mini yi bihi zaŋ tabili bɛn be katiŋ ha ka nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ni na yɛn boli ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dini.
en: For God's promise was made to you and your children, and to all who are far away—all whom the Lord our God calls to himself.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti yɛligi, ka chɛ ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ tintarisi yɛligi pahi, ka ti ti a jilima di zuɣu.
en: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord . We have more land than before, and you are honored.

dag: Di yɛliya di yɛla Gaat fɔŋ ni, di kul chɛliya ka nintam yi yi nina ni na. Bilimmiya taŋkpaɣu ni Bɛtiliafra tiŋ puuni.
en: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim nuu ni ka bɛ su ba yuun pihinahi.
en: Again the people started doing what the Lord said was wrong. So the Lord allowed the Philistines to rule over them for years.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ zaa mi ni n daa kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni nti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ a yɛda m-bu ba ka kpɛhi ba duu.
en: I replied, Lord, they know that in many of our synagogues I arrested and beat people who had faith in you.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o pul zuɣu suhiri Naawuni ni di yi ni nani, saha ŋɔ din miligim o zuɣu.
en: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt down on the ground and prayed, Father, if it is possible, don't let this happen to me! Father, you can do anything. Don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi buɣa maa maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani zaa n-ku ba pa bimbina zuɣu, ka daa nyo ninsalinim kɔba buɣim bimbina maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He killed all the pagan priests on the altars where they served, and he burned human bones on every altar. Then he returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti yiɣisi ni o dam dunia ŋɔ, niriba ni ti zo nti kpe tampima lɔna voya ni mini tiŋgbani vokaba ni ni bɛ tilig o dabiɛm zɔbu ni min o jilima dabiɛm zɔbu ni.
en: They will hide in fissures of rocks and in crevices of cliffs before the terror of the LORD and the splendor of Gods majesty when he arises to terrify the earth.

dag: O mi ni o daguya mali nyɔri, o firila bi kpiri yuŋ.
en: She realizes that her trading is successful; she doesnt put out her lamp at night.

dag: Naawuni, n ni zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ shɛli ti a la ti a. N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo pini ti a.
en: I will fulfill my promises to you, God. I will present thanksgiving offerings to you.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya saha shɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: Someday your children will ask, Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings.

dag: Ka bɛnkam pun mi o ni daa ti nya ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ yɛli taba, Ka bɔ n-lee siɣi Kish bia ŋɔ zuɣu na? Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: Some people who had known Saul for a long time saw that he was speaking and behaving like a prophet. They said to each other, What's happened? How can Saul be a prophet.

dag: Di chɛ ka n ni yɛl a ni faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣ a yaha maa niŋ a alahiziba.
en: Dont be surprised that I told you, You must be born again.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ti bahi sahakam lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli niŋ tinim bɛn nyɛ a piɛ shɛb a ni dihiri ŋɔ?.
en: Why have you abandoned us like this, O God? Will you be angry with your own people forever?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa me bɛ yiya dunoya baɣili n dunoli, ka bɛ dunɔpaɣira baɣi n dunɔpaɣira, ka gooni daa be m mini ba sunsuuni saha shɛl la ka bɛ daa tum din chihira n-saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka n daa ku ba n suhuyiɣisili puuni maa.
en: Israel's kings built their palaces so close to my holy temple that only a wall separated them from me. Then these kings disgraced me with their evil ways, and in my fierce anger I destroyed them.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa garigi yɛli bɛ ni yino, Zɔri, m bi din ya zalinsi. Ka bɔh o, Bee yi di bi saɣi ni yi ni deei tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: But he replied to one of them, Friend, I did you no wrong. Didnt I agree to pay you a denarion?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Ibram sanna ti yɛl o, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Di saha ka Ibram daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani zali Yawɛ ŋun daa ka o sani maa na.
en: The Lord appeared to Abram and said, I will give this land to your descendants. Abram built an altar to honor the Lord who appeared to him there.

dag: Ka a zaligu ŋɔ yi moli gili a sulinsi tiŋgbɔn titali ŋɔ zaa ni, di ni chɛ ka paɣ kam lu o yidan sizuura, o yidana yi nyɛla wɔɣirili bee tarima.
en: When the women in your great kingdom hear about this new law, they will respect their husbands, no matter if they are rich or poor.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mali taali. Yi ŋmanila goon wɔɣinli din tahi bɔɣi, di ku yuui ka di lu n-libigi niriba.
en: You are guilty. You are like a high wall with a crack running down it; suddenly you will collapse.

dag: Yawɛ, saha yuusim wula ka a yɛn tam n yɛla? A ni tam n yɛla sahakam? A yɛn ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma ka di yuusim paai bɔ saha?.
en: How long will you forget me, Lord ? Will you forget me forever? How long will you refuse to accept me?.

dag: A yi ŋmaligi labi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, o ni labis a zali a zaashe kurili ni. A yi yihi ninvuɣ biɛtali zaa a yiŋa.
en: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored; if you keep wrongdoing out of your tent.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa mini Lɛvinim daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni di puuni la shɛŋa din be kasi la zaa na.
en: They brought the LORDs chest, the meeting tent, and all the holy equipment that was in the tent. The priests and the Levites brought them up.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ firilatamdigu la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali tuhi teebuli maa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo.
en: Then Moses put the lampstand in the Meeting Tent on the south side of the Tent, across from the table.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni zaligubaŋda ti bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu ni o zahim o.
en: Then one of them, an expert in the Law of Moses, asked Jesus a question to test him.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa ŋme n-kari Anaki bidibis ata bɛn daa nyɛ: Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ ŋun Anaki zuliya la bahi.
en: Caleb forced the three Anakite families living in Hebron to leave there. Those families were Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. They were from the family of Anak.

dag: Ka sokam ti nya ka di nyɛla man Yawɛ n-juui buɣim maa, ka di ku kpi. .
en: Everyone will see that I, the LORD, have set it on fire. It wont be quenched.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋna nti nya zoondɔɣirili.
en: As Jesus was walking along, he saw a man who had been born blind.

dag: ka a dabisa yi ti pali ka a dɔni a yaannim tooni, n ni piig a bihi ni yino ŋun nyɛ a dahalali bia n-chɛ ka o nam nya zaashee zani.
en: When the time comes for you to die and you lie down with your ancestors, I will raise up your descendant—one of your very own children—to succeed you, and I will establish his kingdom.

dag: N ni darigi bɛn be Ijipti maa tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili ka chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: I will punish those who have gone to live in Egypt. I will use war, hunger, and disease to punish them. I will punish them just as I punished the city of Jerusalem.

dag: bɔhim dunia ni tihi ka di wuh a; ka teeku ni zahim ni yɛl a.
en: or talk to earth, and it will teach you; the fish of the sea will recount it for you.

dag: Huram daa lan mali daanya taha pia, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita yini ni sɛntimita pihinii, ka di zaɣ yini kam daa deerila kom litanim kɔbisinii.
en: Huram also made ten basins, one for each cart. Each basin was feet in diameter and held gallons.

dag: Amiram bihi n-daa nyɛ: Aduna mini Musa ni Miriam. Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Amram had two sons, Aaron and Moses, and one daughter, Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tuma yiɣisi Yawɛ suhu, ka o daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord became angry with his people, so he made them sick.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so ti chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A gba yi be Yisa ŋun yi Galili na ŋɔ sani.
en: Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard when one of the High Priest's servant women came to him and said, You, too, were with Jesus of Galilee.

dag: di saha ka o wuhiri ba bɛ tuma mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ karimbaani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: he informs them about their offenses and their grave sins.

dag: Ka gbib yɛlimaŋ shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun be ti ni ni zaŋ niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: This teaching is a treasure that you have been trusted with. Protect it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives inside us.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum piɛguliba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa alahiziba.
en: All who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: I can promise you that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all this happens.

dag: Bɛ bi zɔri lahiba biɛri. Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: They wont be frightened at bad news. Their hearts are steady, trusting in the LORD.

dag: Sulemaana bihi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Abija daa nyɛla o bihi, ka Asa nyɛ o bia, ka Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ o bia.
en: Solomons son was Rehoboam. Rehoboams son was Abijah. Abijahs son was Asa. Asas son was Jehoshaphat.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee ŋun mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, di simdi ni o saɣi ni n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ nyɛla ti Duuma zaligu.
en: If you think you are a prophet or that you have a spiritual gift, you should understand that what I am writing to you is the Lords command.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, Naawuni malaikanim gba malila suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, In the same way God's angels are happy when even one person turns to him.

dag: Dindali maa ka Ibrahimma min o bia Ishimail daa guni.
en: They were both circumcised on the same day.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi.
en: You will become so hungry that you will eat the bodies of your sons and daughters.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo kuɣ shɛŋa zali bɛ ni daa yihi kuɣ shɛŋa la zaani, ka lan bo tari na ti ta yili maa.
en: Then different stones will be used in place of the first ones, and new coating will be used to replaster the house.

dag: mini Pateesa shɛŋa din yili dundɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ ni dunol ni n-liri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili mini sara maligu bimbin la ni di mihi zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: They cared for the curtain in the courtyard. And they cared for the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard. This courtyard was around the Holy Tent and the altar. And they cared for the ropes and for everything that was used with the curtains.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mini Yisa daa laɣim diri maa gbaai bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi yɛra taba, Ŋun mi n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ti chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba.
en: The other table guests began to say among themselves, Who is this person that even forgives sins.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mi Leeban Nahɔr bia la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti mi o.
en: Then he asked, Do you know Nahor's grandson Laban? Yes we do, they replied.

dag: O ni lan chɛ ka a lara, ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: He will still fill your mouth with joy, your lips with a victorious shout.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm? A nya Izraɛlnim ni tumdi din chihiri pam shɛm kpe ni bɛ kari ma bahi katiŋa ka chɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ? Amaa a na ni nya din chihiri shɛŋa din galisi pam gari lala.
en: Then God said to me, Son of man, do you see what terrible things the people of Israel are doing? They built that thing here, right next to my Temple! And if you come with me, you will see even more terrible things.

dag: ni yi ni ti tiligi m ba mini m ma ni m mabihi ni bɛ ni su shɛb zaa, ka fa ti nyɛviya kum ni bahi.
en: Promise me that you will save my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all their families! Don't let us be killed.

dag: Mani n-ni ti nyɛ o ba ka o mi nyɛ m bia, ka o yi ti tum taali, n ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb o n-saɣis o kaman ninsalinim ni saɣisiri bɛ bihi shɛm.
en: I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to me. Whenever he does wrong, I will discipline him with a human rod, with blows from human beings.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ ŋun pun guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan kul kpalimmi be lala. Ka so mi beni n-nyɛla ŋun bi guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan di bɔri ni o leei ŋun guni.
en: If someone was circumcised when called, he shouldnt try to reverse it. If someone wasnt circumcised when he was called, he shouldnt be circumcised.

dag: Di saha ka Ila bia Hɔshia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Rɛmalia bia Pɛka polo ŋ-ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani, Uzia bia Jɔtam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha.
en: Hoshea son of Elah made plans against Pekah son of Remaliah and killed him. Then Hoshea became the new king. This was during the th year that Jotham son of Uzziah was king of Judah.

dag: Yi ni so yi zaŋ o mabia tahi ʒiishee, yi dihila yimaŋ vi maa. Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ku dihi yɛla sɔŋ yi suhuri ni? Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ni so yi din ya zalinsi ka yi ku chɛ di yɛla bahi?.
en: The lawsuits that you have against each other show that you are already defeated. It would be better for you to let someone wrong you. It would be better to let someone cheat you.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni ha nti nya Alifius bia Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma! Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: As he walked along, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus. Levi was sitting at the place for paying taxes, and Jesus said to him, Follow me! So he got up and went with Jesus.

dag: Dama di sab Yila litaafi ni yɛli: Chɛ ka o yili zani dabɔɣu, ka so ku kpe di ni; ka Chɛ ka so zani o zaani n-deeg o ni chɛ tuun shɛli maa.
en: Peter said, In the book of Psalms, this is written about Judas: People should not go near his land; no one should live there. Psalm : And it is also written: Let another man have his work. Psalm :.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka Otiniɛl daa kpam o jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na; ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: On the wedding day Othniel urged her to ask her father for a field. She got down from her donkey, and Caleb asked her what she wanted.

dag: ka o zaŋ wain paɣ o dansi maa, ka niŋ kpam bɔbili li, ka zaŋ tana lo li, ka zaŋ o balisi omaŋmaŋ buŋa n-zaŋ o ti kpɛhi saamba yilikpɛrili n-gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Samaritan went to him and poured olive oil and wine on his wounds. Then he covered the mans wounds with cloth. The Samaritan had a donkey. He put the hurt man on his donkey, and he took him to an inn. There he cared for him.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yi o ba bihi maa sani chaŋ ti be Tɔb tiŋgban ni. Ka nimaani bibiɛhi daa laɣim Jɛfita sanna ti dol o chani ŋ-ŋmɛri fari dira.
en: Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. There he attracted a group of worthless men, and they went around with him.

dag: ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ ti yi mɔɣu polo na yim nti ʒe n-daai yili maa zaa luhi bipola maa zuɣu, ka bɛ kpi. N kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: when a storm swept in from the desert. It blew the house down and killed them all. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina nti paala salo pam.
en: The next day, when Jesus, Peter, John, and James had come down from the mountain, a large crowd met Jesus.

dag: Di ŋmanila nam leebu kpa shɛli din daa yi Aduna zuɣu ni n-zo nti tɛl o teeŋa n-zo hal ti tɛl o binyɛrigu nyiŋgol la.
en: It is like the sweet-smelling oil that is poured over the high priests head, that runs down his beard flowing over his robes.

dag: ka ŋun mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli m-buɣi doli ma gba bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: Those who dont pick up their crosses and follow me arent worthy of me.

dag: N nyaya ka Ifriimnim bidibisi simdi ni binyara ŋub ba. Di simdi ni Ifriimnim zaŋ bɛ bidibisi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ku ba.
en: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka Pita ni daa yi duu maa ni shɛm yɛla gari duguliba maa pam, ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri di zuɣu.
en: When morning came, there was a tremendous confusion among the guards—what had happened to Peter?.

dag: Pashihur daŋ — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayopɔin.
en: the descendants of Pashhur:.

dag: Goma tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi zaa mini Bɛtitɔgarima din be nuzaa polo la tɔbbihi zaa be a sani, bɛ galisiya pam.
en: All the fighting men of the lands of Gomer and Beth Togarmah in the north are with him, and so are men from many other nations.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, A yuma na bi paai yuun pihinu, ka wula ka a niŋ n-nya ti yab Ibrahimma.
en: They said to him, You are not even fifty years old—and you have seen Abraham.

dag: N nya ka Kushan suɣa be muɣisigu ni, ka nya ka Midian tiŋgbɔŋ suɣa pateesanim sɔhira.
en: I saw the tents of Cushan under duress. The curtains of the land of Midian were quaking.

dag: Mbaye tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu!.
en: O land, land, land! Listen to what the Lord has said:.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa ti laɣim zaŋ bɛ noya naai Abinɛr ka bɛ min o leei zaɣ yini n-du zoli maa zuɣu ti zani.
en: Abner brought the men of Benjamin together in one group on top of a hill, and they got ready to fight.

dag: Di saha ka o kpamba maa daa bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ shɛm maa? Bia maa ni daa na ne, a daa lola noli ka kum o zuɣu pam, amaa ka o ti lee kpi ka a yiɣisi di bindirigu.
en: Davids servants asked him, Why are you doing this? When the baby was alive, you cried and refused to eat. But when the baby died you got up and ate food.

dag: Di saha bɛ yi ti wum kikaa maa kumsi ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka, ka tɔbu maa kana ti di ba, bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If any of these people hear the signal and ignore it, they will be killed in battle. But it will be their own fault, because they could have escaped if they had paid attention.
