dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man kul suhira. Naawuni, garigim ma a ni zali saha shɛli a yurilim maŋli din galisi la puuni min a ʒiɛyimtali sɔŋsim la puuni.
en: But me? My prayer reaches you, LORD, at just the right time. God, in your great and faithful love, answer me with your certain salvation!.

dag: Daadam napɔŋ ti ku lan no di ni, ka biŋkɔbiri gba napɔna ti ku lan no di ni. Binvuhirigu ti ku lan be di ni hal ni yuun pihinahi.
en: No foot, animal or human, will walk across it, and it wont be inhabited for forty years.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu bahi Pɛlusium din nyɛ Ijiptinim tɔbu tuhibu yaa shee la zuɣu, ka saɣim Tɛbisinim daazichi.
en: I will pour out my anger on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and I will cut down pompous Thebes.

dag: dindina di simdi ka dilan pini. Amaa o di pini dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: you shall shave the head except the area around the sore. The priest shall then isolate you for another seven days.

dag: Ka yi yi mali yi bina m-paŋdila ninvuɣ shɛb yi ni tɛhiri ni yi ti lan dee li bɛ sani yaha, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba paŋdila bɛ daalahichilan taba ni bɛ ti lan deei bɛ ni paŋ ba shɛm maa tariga.
en: If you lend money only to someone you think will pay you back, will God be pleased with you for that? Even sinners lend to sinners because they think they will get it all back.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim ni daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ daa tala bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma daɣiri. Bɛ ni daa be shɛm n sani daa ŋmanila paɣa ni nya sɔrilim ka bi lan be nyam shɛm la.
en: Son of man, the family of Israel lived in their own country, but they made that land filthy by the bad things they did. To me, they were like a woman who becomes unclean because of her monthly time of bleeding.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: The renters grabbed the servant, beat him up, and sent him away without a thing.

dag: Musa daa zaŋla o paɣa Zipɔra labisi ka o deemba Jɛtro daa deeg o min o bidibis ayi la ʒili.
en: Moses father-in-law Jethro took with him Zipporah, Moses wife whom he had sent away.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒi nimaani maa zaa mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka nya o ninni ka di ŋmanila malaika ninni.
en: All those sitting in the Council fixed their eyes on Stephen and saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.

dag: Ka n daa lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya chɛchɛbunsi anahi ka di yi daanya zoya ayi sunsuuni na.
en: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa, ka kuhi pam ka naanyi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: The evil spirit made the man shake. Then the spirit made a loud noise and came out of him.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kali niriba maa naai nyaaŋa ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, N tum alahichi n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, kpihimi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daalahichi maa; dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: But after this David felt terrible that he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, LORD, please take away the guilt of your servant because I have done something very foolish.

dag: Hatush ni Shɛbania ni Maluk ni.
en: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch.

dag: Ti nyari wahala binshɛɣukam zaa ni, amaa ti bi ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi; ti birinda, amaa ti suhuri bi saɣinda;.
en: We are experiencing all kinds of trouble, but we arent crushed. We are confused, but we arent depressed.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti nya a ni tirisi labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ a ka yɛli, Ninive bahi yoli, ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili di zuɣu? Ya polo ka n lee yɛn nya bɛn ni maag a suhu ti a? .
en: All who see you will shrink back. They will say, Nineveh lies in ruins! Who has any sympathy for her? Who will want to comfort her.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni tooi chɛ ka aŋgo zɔnim lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli?.
en: Jesus replied, You cant make the wedding guests fast while the groom is with them, can you?.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli niriba maa zaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa ti o ka tim o ni o ti yɛli ba la naai.
en: I finished telling the people everything that the Lord their God had sent me to tell them.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayi maa daa mali ti paai Sɔdom zaawuni, ka Lɔt daa ʒi Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dunol ni. Lɔt ni daa nya ba, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli.
en: That evening, while Lot was sitting near the city gate, the two angels arrived in Sodom. When Lot saw them, he got up, bowed down low.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ o bituuli Iso binyɛr suma din be o sani yiŋa n-yɛl o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa;.
en: Then she took Esau's best clothes, which she kept in the house, and put them on Jacob.

dag: Ziɔnnima, dumiya zoya zuɣu nti moli lahiba suŋ molo. Jɛrusalɛmnima, duhimiya yi yee moli lahiba suŋ molo. Duhimiya yi kukoya pam yɛli Juda fɔntinsi ni nima, Yi Naawuni kanna! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: Your God is here.

dag: Nuhu zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Nuhu daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka ka galimi o ʒiɛman ni.
en: and this is the story about him. Noah was the only person who lived right and obeyed God.

dag: Suhugarigu so lari, dama nandahima nyɛla din tahiri suhukpaŋsibo na.
en: Aggravation is better than merriment because a sad face may lead to a glad heart.

dag: ni Sidɔnnim ni Amalɛknim ni Maɔnim ni daa nahindi ya, ka yi kum niŋ ma la, n daa bi fan ya bɛ nuu ni bahi?.
en: the Sidonians, the Amalekites, and the Maonites oppressed you in the past, and you cried out to me. Did I not save you from them?.

dag: di yi ti wum kom ʒiɛɣu, di ni puhi n-niŋ wula kaman ti polli la.
en: but with water, it will grow again. It will grow branches like a new plant.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti laɣim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni luɣ shɛl o ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la, yin karimmi zaligu ŋɔ ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum.
en: At that time all the Israelites must come to meet with the Lord your God at the special place he will choose. Then you must read the teachings to the people so that they can hear them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa duhi bɛ yɛhi n-kum hal ti lan ka yaa din ni kum.
en: David and his men started crying and did not stop until they were completely exhausted.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul puɣisirila wuntizɔriba m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: Wicked people watch good people and try to kill them;.

dag: O daa yihi ti ti dimnim nuu ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: he freed us from our enemies; his love is eternal.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Sool ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pool la, ka o mirig o nina niŋ bukpaha maa.
en: But Saul , filled with the Holy Spirit, looked hard at Elymas.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku ba hal ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi guui. Dauda daa kula Siria chɛchɛbumbariba kɔbisiyopɔin, ka ku wɔribariba mi tuhi pihinahi, ka daa ti Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ kamɔna kpɛm maa daŋa, ka o kpi nimaani.
en: The Arameans attacked, but then they ran from Israel. David killed chariot drivers and , cavalry. He also killed Shobach, their commander.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli o tuun viɛla yɛla n-sani, ka daa zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o. Ka Tɔbaya daa kul sabiri gbana tiri ma na ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm.
en: People would talk in front of me about all the good deeds Tobiah had done and would tell him everything I said. And he kept sending me letters to try to frighten me.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi nyɛla n zɔnima.
en: And you are my friends if you do what I command you.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka teeku kom nyuui, ka a mali soli kom puuni sɔŋ, ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la dol li du.
en: It was you also who dried up the sea and made a path through the water, so that those you were saving could cross.

dag: ka boli Yisa tuumba maa na ti fiɛb ba, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan zaŋ Yisa yuli tɔɣisiri niriba, ka daa bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: They called the apostles in, had them whipped, and ordered them never again to speak in the name of Jesus; and then they set them free.

dag: ni Gɛdɔr ni Ahio ni Zɛkɛr.
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker, and Mikloth .

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai yiŋa, ka o yidan ma bɔh o, M bia, ka di nyɛ wula zaŋ chaŋ a polo? Ka Rut daa yɛl o Bɔaz ni yɛl o shɛlikam zaa.
en: When she arrived home, her mother-in-law asked her, How did you get along, daughter? Ruth told her everything that Boaz had done for her.

dag: Dama man bi yu ni yi so kpi. Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I do not want anyone to die, says the Sovereign Lord . Turn away from your sins and live.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tim ti boli Ɛliɛza mini Ariɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛlnatan ni Jarib ni Ɛlnatan so yaha ni Neetan ni Zakaria ni Mɛshulam bɛn daa nyɛ zuɣulaannim la ni Joyarib mini Ɛlnatan so mi yaha bɛn daa nyɛ yɛnnim la.
en: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.

dag: Miri ka a leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛ nɛma pari talima la ni yino bee n-zani ti so ni o di samli.
en: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.

dag: Ka zuliya biɛɣu ŋɔ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn kpalim, ka be n ni kari ba bahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa, bɛ ni ti paɣi kum gari biɛhigu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken.

dag: Pinimiya zuɣukpina, yi ni yuri yi bi shɛb la zuɣu. Pinimiya zuɣukpina ka di be kaman juɣu zuɣu la, dama bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni.
en: Make yourself bald and cut off your hair because of your cherished children! Make yourself as bald as the vulture, for they have gone from you into exile.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, niriba maa na kul galisiya. Zaŋm ba chaŋ kuliga ni ka n ti buɣisi ba nimaani ti a; ka n yi yɛl a ni so ni dol a chaŋ, dilana n-ni dol a chaŋ; ka m mi yi ti yɛl a ni so ku dol a chaŋ, dilan shiri ku dol a chaŋ.
en: Then the Lord said to Gideon, There are still too many men. Take the men down to the water, and I will test them for you there. If I say, This man will go with you, he will go. But if I say, That one will not go with you, then he will not go.

dag: Amaa n yi ti yɛli bia maa, Nyama, piɛma maa be a tooni ha; dindina nyin zoma, dama Yawɛ n-wuh a ni a zom maa.
en: But if I tell him, The arrows are on the other side of you, then leave, because the Lord is sending you away.

dag: Wuntizɔriba muɣisigu galisiya pam, amaa Yawɛ yihiri ba di zaa ni.
en: Good people might have many problems, but the Lord will take them all away.

dag: A mi Naawuni ni zali ba o zaligu shɛm n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisir o sagbana ni ŋɔ?.
en: Do you know how God controls the clouds? Do you know how he makes his lightning flash?.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul ye anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zuɣu, ka di zaɣisiya tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gba.
en: So then, brothers and sisters, use your ambition to try to get the gift of prophecy, but dont prevent speaking in tongues.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ Naawuni ŋun bi kpiri ŋɔ jilima taɣi ti binnana din ŋmani ninsalinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ bee noonsi bee biŋkɔbiri bee biŋgbamda.
en: Instead of honoring the divine greatness of God, who lives forever, they traded it for the worship of idols—things made to look like humans, who get sick and die, or like birds, animals, and snakes.

dag: Niriba maa daa yi ti nya ka sagbani maa ʒe suɣili maa dunol ni, sokam yiɣisirimi zan o suɣili dunol ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: As soon as the people saw the pillar of cloud at the door of the Tent, they would bow down.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: The LORD relented concerning this: It wont take place, says the LORD.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa puuni ka nyɛ bɛn daa zo n-chaŋ o sani mini bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni la kuli Babilɔn.
en: Nebuzaradan was the commander of the king of Babylons special guards. He took all the people who had surrendered to him and all the people still in Jerusalem and made them captives. He carried them away to Babylon.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a be kaman daanya gooni la niriba maa sani. Bɛ ni tuh a, amaa bɛ ku tooi nyaŋ a; dama n ni be a sani n-tilig a ka fa a bahi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be kasi la ʒi n-gbaai chandi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa ti sa pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai ni.
en: Then came the Kohath family. They carried the holy things from inside the Holy Tent. These people came at this time so that the other people could set up the Holy Tent and make it ready at the new camp before these people arrived.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu maa mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ tari salo maa.
en: Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and fish and handed them to his disciples to give to the people.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina mali nam ʒiishe titali, ka zaŋ salima alali dihi li nachiinsi.
en: King Solomon also built a large throne with ivory decorations. It was covered with pure gold.

dag: ni bɛ niŋm binzusa niŋ bɛ binyɛra luɣa ni bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka niŋ mi sabilitim niŋ binzusa kam din be bɛ luɣa ni maa.
en: to say to the people of Israel, Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.

dag: Barizillai daa nyɛla yuun pihinii nira, ŋuna n-daa ti bo bindira n-zaŋ ti Naa Dauda saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanaim la, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: Barzillai was years old. He was very rich and had sent food to David in Mahanaim.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya kam saria, ka chɛ ka niriba kpi n-yɛrigi bɛ tiŋgbana ni. O ni ti nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: He will judge the nations. The ground will be covered with dead bodies. He will punish the leaders of powerful nations all around the world.

dag: Bɛ dihila Mɔab vi, dama bɛ wurim li. Kuhimiya ka fabili. Molimiya di yɛla Arinɔn mɔɣili duli ni Mɔab lu n-dahim.
en: Moab will be ruined and filled with shame. Moab will cry and cry. Announce at the Arnon River that Moab is destroyed.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be sapashin kpɛm maa sani daa daai goon shɛŋa din daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la zaa luhi.
en: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n-chɛ ka n kpi zaŋ chaŋ di dolibu polo ni di chɛ ka n tooi be Naawuni zuɣu.
en: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.

dag: Amaa bɛ daalikama mini bɛ ni daa yi booni alikama shɛli sipɛlit la, din daa bi saɣim, dama di daa bi daŋdi niŋbu.
en: But none of the wheat was ruined, because it ripens later.

dag: A yi yɛli niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ bɔh a, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ kara ŋɔ zaa jɛndi ti? Ti taali lee nyɛla dini? Alahichi bɔ ka ti lee tum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: They will ask, Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni nyu a biɛli pipi shɛli din yɛlima ka zilim la ni binnyurigu. Bɛ ni ti la a, ka mal a ansarisi, dama di puuni bini galisiya pam.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Deep and wide is your sisters cup. Drink! Appointed for abuse and scorn, it overflows.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya di puuni na nti zaŋ ya niŋ tinzunnim nuu ni, ka bɛ kari ya saria.
en: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia zaa, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku duli tiŋgbana nima, maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: The Lord rules, and the earth is happy. All the faraway lands are happy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti zaŋ o tɔbbihi maa lu bɛ zuɣu. Dauda ni daa piɛl o tɔbbihi bahi Sirianim maa zuɣu maa, ka bɛ min o daa gbaai tab tuhibu.
en: When David heard of it, he gathered the Israelite troops, crossed the Jordan River, and put them in position facing the Syrians. The fighting began.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: And if I throw out demons by the authority of Beelzebul, then by whose authority do your followers throw them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.

dag: N yi dɔni tiŋa m bɔhirimi, Bɔ saha ka n lee yɛn yiɣisi? Amaa ka biɛɣu neebu wɔɣa. Ka n kul mali mmaŋ wolisiri hal ka biɛɣu ti miri neebu.
en: When I lie down to sleep, the hours drag; I toss all night and long for dawn.

dag: Dama yɛm ni ka a suhu ni na, ka baŋsim niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na ni ti kɔri bɛ puri nimaani.
en: People from the city will farm the land, no matter which tribe they belong to.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la nira n-nyɛ ma: N nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun be mɔɣu ni m-mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma soli ka di tuhi. .
en: John answered by quoting the prophet Isaiah: I am the voice of someone shouting in the desert: Make a straight path for the Lord to travel.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Adam la alahichi tumbu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka alahichi kpe dunia ŋɔ ni, ka alahichi maa tahi kum na. Dina n-chɛ ka kum paari sokam, dama sokam zaa tum alahichi.
en: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama tuun kar shɛŋa din daa tum yi tinsi maa ni la yi di daa tumla Sɔdom, di naan na kpalim ʒiɛya hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: And as for you, Capernaum! Did you want to lift yourself up to heaven? You will be thrown down to hell! If the miracles which were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would still be in existence today!.

dag: Dauda daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi yaha, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Ibihar mini Ɛlishama ni Ɛlifɛlɛt.
en: Ibhar, Eli-shama, Eliphelet.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi shihi yaɣiri laa kam, bɛn ŋmam li, ka di yi nyɛ dari bini, bɛn paɣimi li kom.
en: If a man with a discharge touches a clay bowl, that bowl must be broken. If he touches a wooden bowl, that bowl must be washed in water.

dag: Teeku n-doya ŋɔ, di galisiya ka yɛlim pam, biŋgbamda bɛn ka kalinli m-be di ni. Bɛ nyɛla binneen kara ni zaɣ bihi.
en: And then theres the sea, wide and deep, with its countless creatures— living things both small and large.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim yi ti niŋ ka yi bi deei n noli, di saha n ni darigi yi tibili ʒiibuyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: After these things, if you still dont obey me, I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

dag: anabi Jɛrimia sani ti yɛl o, Niŋmi ania wummi ti fabila ŋɔ ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti. Suhim o ti tinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa, dama ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ gbaliŋ, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, kulla ti niriba biɛla ŋɔ n-kpalim kaman a nini ni nya ti shɛm ŋɔ.
en: They said to him, Jeremiah, please listen to what we ask. Pray to the Lord your God for all those who are survivors from the family of Judah. Jeremiah, you can see that there are not many of us left. At one time there were many of us.

dag: Saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi yɛn liri nira? Yi zaa yɛn bula yi ni gbaai ninvuɣ so, kaman yi ni yɛn niŋ dikili ŋmaŋ bee kikara din kab ŋuniya m-bɔri ni di lu shɛm la?.
en: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka kum lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din tiri bindirigu.
en: He caused a famine in that country, and people did not have enough food.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nuu din mali jilima n-gbaai Musa nudirigu chana, ka daa chɛ ka kom din do bɛ tooni pirigi ni o zali yuli din ku kpi ti omaŋa.
en: the one who guided Moses strong hand with his glorious arm; who split the water for them to create an enduring reputation for himself.

dag: Azigad daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisita ni pisinaayi.
en: the descendants of Azgad:.

dag: Dama zuliya kam zaa wuna nyɛla binnana, amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.

dag: Juda zuliya maa mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shɛlanima; ka Pɛrɛz daŋ niriba nyɛ Pɛrɛzinima; ka Zɛra mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Zɛranima.
en: Judahs descendants according to their clans: from Shelah, the Shelanite clan; from Perez, the Perezite clan; from Zerah, the Zerahite clan.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun Ɛhud maŋmaŋ daa zani kuɣikpɛra shee din miri Giligal la ŋ-ŋmaligi labi ti yɛli, Naa, m malila ashili yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka naa maa daa yɛl o naazɔnim ni bɛ yima. Ka bɛ zaa daa yiɣis o sani yi.
en: When Ehud reached the statues near Gilgal, he turned and went back to King Eglon and said, King, I have a secret message for you. The king told him to be quiet and then sent all the servants out of the room.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din yiri kpaŋ na nti kpɛri ninsal ni ku tooi ta o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri. .
en: There is nothing people can put in their mouth that will make them wrong. People are made wrong by what comes from inside them.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ mi bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ku ma. Di chɛ bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi a sani. Chɛ ka bɛ lu a tooni, ka a darigi bɛ tibili a suhuyiɣisili ŋɔ saha.
en: But, Lord , you know all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their evil or pardon their sin. Throw them down in defeat and deal with them while you are angry.

dag: Ka o daa mal ti paai yiŋa m-bo sua pa o mam maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋmah o niŋkpil pinaayi n-zaŋ o niŋkpil yini kam tim ti ti Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nim zaa.
en: When he got home, he took a butcher knife and cut her body into twelve pieces. Then he told some messengers, Take one piece to each tribe of Israel.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn wuhi ba n jilima ni nyɛ shɛm maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The common people will bury the enemy soldiers, and the people will become famous on the day that I bring honor to myself. The Lord GOD said those things.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika maa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔri ni n wuh a n yuli? Dama n yuli maa nyɛla alahiziba yuli.
en: The LORDs messenger responded to him, Why do you ask my name? You couldnt understand it.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi daɣiri ni m-bala, di yi pa lala bɛ ni saɣim m biɛhigu shee din be bɛ sunsuuni ŋɔ ka kpi ni bɛ daɣiri.
en: You must separate the Israelites from their uncleanness so that they dont die on account of it, by making my dwelling unclean, which is in their midst.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ŋun ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, Ŋoom a takɔbi na n-kuhi ku ma, di so ka bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ ti kana ti zaŋ ma diɛm. Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaag o neen ʒira maa ka o bi saɣi ku o. Di saha ka Sool daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ takɔbi zali n-lu di zuɣu.
en: Saul said to his armor-bearer, Draw your sword and kill me with it! Otherwise, these uncircumcised men will come and kill me or torture me. But his armor-bearer refused because he was terrified. So Saul took the sword and impaled himself on it.

dag: Hal ti ni daa paai Masidɔnia ti niŋgbuna daa bi nya vuhim baabiɛla. Ti daa nya wahala shɛlikam ni: Zabili daa yiri kpaŋ na, ka dabiɛm be ti suhuri ni.
en: Even after we arrived in Macedonia, we did not have any rest. There were troubles everywhere, quarrels with others, fears in our hearts.

dag: Ka o ni ti kpuɣi bɛ wuna mini bɛ binnana ni neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa mali n-zaŋ ti bɛ wuna la n-lab kuli Ijipti. Ka yuma biɛla din ti nyɛ suhudoo saha puuni.
en: He will even carry off their gods to Egypt, along with their statues and their silver and gold equipment. For years he will avoid the northern king.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka malaika so ŋun daa pun yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa la kana ti zani, ka malaika so daa ka o sanna.
en: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him.

dag: Ka bol o dan maa sandiriba zaa yinoyino na ti bɔhi ŋun daŋ tooni, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a.
en: So the manager called in each person who owed the master some money. He asked the first one, How much do you owe my master.

dag: So yi tum taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o, ka bɛ zaŋ o yili tia ku o.
en: If someone has been put to death for a crime and the body is hung on a post.

dag: ka bɛ yi yɛli ti zilima, ti zaŋdila zilim balli yɛtɔɣa labisi ba. Ti kul bemi kaman dunia ŋɔ bin chɔɣima la, hal ti ŋmanila saɣiri dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: when our reputation is attacked, we are encouraging. We have become the scum of the earth, the waste that runs off everything, up to the present time.

dag: Di saha ka n yɛli, Din niŋ ma suhugarigu nyɛla, Zallakudura Naa nudirigu yiko la taɣimi.
en: Then I said, God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.

dag: Di chɛ ka a dabili nyari saɣisibu, ka di dolibu mali laara pam.
en: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.

dag: M Ba ŋun nyɛ wuntialan ŋɔ, dunianim bi mi a, amaa man mi a, ka bɛmbɔŋɔ gba mi ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: Righteous Father, even the world didnt know you, but Ive known you, and these believers know that you sent me.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti maa? Di pa shɛli ka yaŋɔnim ni so di zaŋ a paɣ maa dɔni. A naan chɛ ka di taali ʒin ti zuɣu.
en: Abimelech said, What are you trying to do to us? Before long, one of the people would have slept with your wife; and you would have made us guilty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: They buried him on his own land at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash.

dag: A yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a ni baŋ ni n ni daa niŋ shɛlikam maa, pa yoli ka n daa niŋ lala di ni maa, ka a suhu ni maai. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will be convinced that I, the Lord God, was right in doing what I did.

dag: di bahi bamdi a ni nyɛ ŋun mi Yɛhudianim kaya mini bɛ naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla zuɣu. N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: I am very happy to talk to you, because you know so much about all the Jewish customs and the things the Jews argue about. Please listen to me patiently.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa boli Nɛria bia Baruk na nti yɛl o Yawɛ ni yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka Baruk daa sabi li niŋ gbaŋ ni.
en: I sent for Baruch son of Neriah and asked him to help me. I repeated everything the Lord had told me, and Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n jɛrigiya pam ni bɛ boli ma daadam. N ka daadam tɛhi zilima.
en: I am stupid. I am not as smart as other people are.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma polo ka o kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma. Mani m-bala.
en: Just then Jesus spoke to them, Be encouraged! Its me. Dont be afraid.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Dama ti bɔri ni ti ʒi a zilinli lab ti yɛli bɛn tim ti na. Nyin lee yɛliya ni a nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Then they said, Who are you? Tell us about yourself. Give us an answer to tell the people who sent us. What do you say about yourself.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi niriba maa zuɣu ni ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla, amaa o ni daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bahi mol li gili.
en: Jesus told the people not to tell anyone about this. But the more he told them not to say anything, the more people they told.

dag: Ka o daa kar o dimnim maa bahi; ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi din ku naai.
en: God beat back his foes; he made them an everlasting disgrace.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa; ka Filistianim maa daa dol ba ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The Philistines fought a battle against the Israelites on Mount Gilboa. Many Israelites were killed there, and the rest of them, including King Saul and his sons, fled.

dag: Suhu n-nyɛ din mali yɔhiŋgu gari binshɛɣukam; di bi ʒe yim. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li?.
en: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ Naawuni ka pa ni nyini Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ tampiŋ ka pa ni ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.

dag: Amaa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa biŋkɔbigu kpam min o binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla, o daa zaŋ li nyola buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: He took the fat, the kidneys, and the fat part of the liver from the sin offering. He burned them on the altar just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ daanya mali wahu maa n-zaŋ li tabili da wɔɣinli zuɣusaa; ka wahu daa yi dim so, ka o lihi li, o tiligirimi.
en: Moses made a bronze snake and placed it on a pole. If a snake bit someone, that person could look at the bronze snake and live.

dag: Chɛ ka tuumba bɛn ka Juda naa Zɛdɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm maa zaŋ lahibali ti ti Ɛdom naa mini Mɔab naa ni Ammɔn naa ni Taai naa ni Sidɔn naa.
en: Then the Lord told me to send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through their ambassadors who had come to Jerusalem to see King Zedekiah.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o paɣiba ni o kpambaliba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon, along with his mother, his wives, his officials, and the most important leaders of Judah.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaanu.
en: Manasseh was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled years from Jerusalem.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa teei gili ma kaman tin shɛli bɛ ni liri, ka o tum ma o yurilim maŋli tuun shɛli din mali alahiziba la zuɣu.
en: Bless the LORD, because he has wondrously revealed his faithful love to me when I was like a city under siege!.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dahin shɛli tɛha ni yɛm n-zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Now Pharaoh should find an intelligent, wise man and give him authority over the land of Egypt.

dag: ni Libina naa ni Adulam naa.
en: the king of Libnah one.

dag: Ka a mini Rɔdinim daa laɣindi niŋdi daabiligu, teeku duli tinsi pam daa nyɛla a da gahinda, ka bɛ zaŋdi wɔbinyina mini lanjiŋ dari yɔr a nɛma zuɣu.
en: Islanders from Rhodes were your agents. By contract they procured ebony and ivory for you from many coastlands.

dag: dama daba ayopɔin dali yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli yɛli: Naawuni daa vuh o tuma zaa puuni daba ayopɔin dali.
en: Yes, somewhere in the Scriptures he talked about the seventh day of the week. He said, So on the seventh day God rested from all his work.

dag: Ka baŋdiba maa garigi yɛl o, So ka dunia ŋɔ ni ŋun ni tooi yɛli nyin naa a ni bɔri ni a baŋ shɛli maa. Na so kani, hal na kara bɛn mali yiko pam ni yino na ʒi n-yɛl o timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni bɛ wuhim o yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo.
en: His advisors explained, Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ teer a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni. Dinzuɣu niriba ni ti paɣir a sahakam.
en: You will be famous for generations. People will praise you forever and ever.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma. Yawɛ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma.
en: Save me, Lord ! Help me now!.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinima n-yɛn tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni tuma ka bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi ʒi bɛ zuɣu. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ li yi ʒiɛmani kam ni. Lɛvinim mi ku pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu su tiŋgbani palo.
en: The Levites will do the work of caring for the Meeting Tent. They must bear the responsibility for anything done against it. This is a law that will continue forever. The Levites will not get any of the land that I promised to the other Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛ ka Asaf min o mabihi maa be Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa gbini ni bɛ tumdi di tuma sahakam kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: King David put Asaph and the other Levites in permanent charge of the worship that was held at the place where the Covenant Box was kept. They were to perform their duties there day by day.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli ma, Daadam, lihimi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni yɛn wuh a binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa ni. Dama n zaŋ a mi ka kpe na ni n ti wuh a li. Yɛlim Izraɛlnim a ni nya shɛli maa zaa.
en: He said to me, Watch, mortal man. Listen carefully and pay close attention to everything I show you, because this is why you were brought here. You are to tell the people of Israel everything you see.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: So you also must be ready. The Son of Man will come at a time when you dont expect him.

dag: yi ma ni ti di vi pam, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi ya ti nya filiŋ. Nyama, o ni ti be zuliya kam nyaaŋa. O ni ti bemi kaman tiŋgban nɛli din kuui ka kom ka di ni la.
en: but your own great city will be humiliated and disgraced. Babylonia will be the least important nation of all; it will become a dry and waterless desert.

dag: So dini n-lee kuni neesim ni woligiwoligi luɣ shɛli bee wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ni yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli polo?.
en: Have you been to the place where the sun comes up, or the place from which the east wind blows?.

dag: ka daa daŋ tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli nti mali shili n-gul o;.
en: He sent some men ahead of him. They went into a town in Samaria to make everything ready for him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti sɔɣ o mi kaman bɛ ni sɔɣiri buŋ shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti vu o ti labi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdali tooni ha.
en: The people of Jerusalem will bury Jehoiakim like a donkey. They will drag his body away and throw it outside the gates of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Akishi daa garigi yɛli Dauda, M mi ni a ka galimi shɛli kaman Naawuni malaika ni ka galimi shɛm la, amaa di zaa yoli, Filistia sapashinnim maa yɛliya ni a di dol ti chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Achish answered, I believe that you are a good man. You are like an angel from God. But the Philistine captains still say, David cant go with us into battle.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali, yin zaŋmiya naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka di niŋ kasi.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, On the first day of the first month you are to sacrifice a bull without any defects and purify the Temple.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhiri ni o ni niŋ o ni lo alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: This will be your sign from the LORD that he will do what he promised.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan tim tuumba Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋmi m paɣ Mikal ŋun nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ Filistianim yokol gbana kɔbiga yo so zuɣu la ti ma na.
en: And David also sent messengers to Ishbosheth to say, Give me back my wife Michal. I paid a hundred Philistine foreskins in order to marry her.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn chaŋ, bɛ ni tooi chaŋ luɣa anahi maa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi. Amaa tooni kalinli maa daa yi kul kpa shɛli polo, kalima maa zaa doli li mi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.

dag: Amaa tinim daa niŋ tahima ni ŋuna n-yɛn tiligi Izraɛlnima; ka din pahi ŋɔ zaa ha zuɣu nyɛla, di ni niŋ maa zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: We were hoping that he would be the one to free Israel. But then all this happened. And now something else: It has been three days since he was killed.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri yi ti nya o, ŋun kum o.
en: The dead person's nearest relative has the responsibility for putting the murderer to death. When he finds you, he is to kill you.

dag: Nachimba daa yi nya ma, bɛ labiri la nyaaŋa, ka ninkura yiɣisi ti ma jilima.
en: young men stepped aside as soon as they saw me, and old men stood up to show me respect.

dag: Dama jɛra lari ŋmanila gɔhi ni be buɣim ni duɣu gbinni tahiri shɛm la; ka dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: because the fools merriment is like nettles crackling under a kettle. That too is pointless.

dag: Naftali tiŋgbani zaa mini Ifriim tiŋgbani ni Manaasa tiŋgbani ni Juda tiŋgbani zaa zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili polo teeku noli.
en: all the parts belonging to Naphtali along with the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, as well as the entirety of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka Haran daa ti kani ka chɛ o ba, o dɔɣiritiŋ din daa nyɛ Ur ka be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: and Haran died in his hometown of Ur in Babylonia, while his father was still living.

dag: ka pumpɔŋɔ o shiri niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi zaa ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani ka bi deeg o nol la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka yɛlli ŋɔ paai ya maa.
en: But they continued to rebel against him, and now he has punished them just as he threatened.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mini zuliya kam ni ti bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ lee niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ? Bɔ n-daa lee chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam lala.
en: Indeed, all nations will ask: Why did the LORD do this to this land? What led to this terrible display of anger?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ ba jila yi suhuri ni, ka yi ti ku zani ni yi tɛhi pɔi ka naanyi garigi;.
en: Make up your minds not to prepare your defense in advance.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Filistianim mini Ammɔnnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: So the Lord became angry with the Israelites and allowed the Philistines and the Ammonites to defeat them.

dag: Dinzuɣu n kul ni yiini yila paɣir a yuli, n yi ti zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ binshɛli n-tir a dabisili kam la na ti ti a.
en: So I will always sing praises to you, as I offer you daily what I have promised.

dag: Amaa o daa tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la tatabo. O daa bi lɔɣ li.
en: Yet, like King Jeroboam son of Nebat before him, he led Israel into sin and would not stop.

dag: Dama tinim bɛn be ti nyɛviya ni ŋɔ kul bela kum barina ni Yisa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni.
en: We who are alive are always being handed over to death for Jesus sake so that Jesus life can also be seen in our bodies that are dying.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zahin shɛrili ti o;.
en: They gave him a piece of baked fish.

dag: Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daa bela tiŋgbani maa ni; bɛ daa galisiya pam n-ʒini Bashan zaŋ hal ni Baalihɛrimɔn ni Sɛnir zaŋ kpa Hɛrimɔn Zoli polo.
en: Half the tribe of Manasseh lived in the area of Bashan all the way to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. They became a very large group of people.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka o gba vuhi, faashee ka o me Jɛrusalɛm zali, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa paɣi li.
en: and dont allow God to rest until he establishes Jerusalem, and makes it the praise of the earth.

dag: Kiriatijiarim zuliya n-daa nyɛ Itirinim mini Putinim ni Shumatinim ni Mishiranima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zuliya ni ka Zɔranim mini Ɛshitaolnim yina.
en: Kiriath-jearims clans: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. From these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ m bia, wummi n noli n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ ni.
en: Now, my son, listen carefully to what I want you to do.

dag: Ti mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala din galisi shɛm, lala ka ti lan laɣindi nyari suhumaabo din galisi Masia zuɣu.
en: We share in the many sufferings of Christ. In the same way, much comfort comes to us through Christ.

dag: Yisa ʒim zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim. Dina n-nyɛ alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka di mi nyɛla o daanfaan shɛli din galisi.
en: Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli; dama o noli ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam ba.
en: Let them praise the Lord s name, because he gave the command and created them all!.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun zani dabari ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ situr ʒiɛkpain niŋ amaŋa? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ salima nɛma niŋ amaŋa, ka bali chilo? A kul dihirila amaŋ nachiinsi yoli, dama a mamanim lihi ʒiɛm a, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku a.
en: And you, devastated one, why dress up in scarlet, deck yourself in gold jewelry, and color your eyes with paint? In vain you get all decked out; your lovers have rejected you and now seek your life.

dag: Judanim mi Naawuni, o yuli tibisi pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.

dag: A ni tum tuun kpɛma ka woligu yiri a ni ka a nyari bindirigu diri hal ti lab tiŋgbani maa ni, dama di ni ka a daa yina. Taŋkpaɣu n-nyɛ a, ka a ni ti lan lab taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: You will work hard for your food, until your face is covered with sweat. You will work hard until the day you die, and then you will become dust again. I used dust to make you, and when you die, you will become dust again.

dag: Kush bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Raama bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Cushs family: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabteca. Raamahs family: Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila dakol pala ni.
en: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ di ku ba, amaa ni bɛ nahimmi ba mi chira anu, ka bɛ mi yi dim nira, di biɛrim ŋmanila nɔŋ dimbu biɛrim.
en: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa pii Izraɛlnim dahin shɛli la, n daa po pɔri bɛn Yaakubu zuliya maa sani, ka zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N daa po pɔri yɛli ba, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Tell them that long ago I, the Lord God, chose Israel to be my own. I appeared to their ancestors in Egypt and made a solemn promise that I would be their God and the God of their descendants.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la.
en: They made the ephod from gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn.

dag: O daa lan yɛli di yɛla yaha: Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: We also read that he later said, You people will never enter my place of rest.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ yuuni ni pirigili nimaani n-wuhiri niriba Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.

dag: Nyama, ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa kabina ni bɛ ti nya Yisa; bɛ ni daa ti nya o, ka bɛ balim o ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the whole town went out to see Jesus. When the people saw him, they begged him to leave their area.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli ba, Chamiya Bɛtilihɛm nti bo bia maa viɛnyɛliŋga; yi yi ti nya o ni be shɛli, yin labimiyana ti yɛli ma, ka n gba chaŋ ti jɛm o.
en: Then he sent them to Bethlehem with these instructions: Go and make a careful search for the child; and when you find him, let me know, so that I too may go and worship him.

dag: Di ti Sintani soli hal biɛla!.
en: and don't give the devil a chance.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi yɛn galim a, a ni mali yɛlimaŋli, amaa chɛ ka m bɔh a m bɔhigu ŋɔ. Bɔzuɣu ka tuumbiɛrilana tɔŋda? Bɔzuɣu ka ʒiŋmariba kul tɔŋda?.
en: If I took you to court, LORD, you would win. But I still have questions about your justice. Why do guilty persons enjoy success? Why are evildoers so happy?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe ma yim maa wuhiya ni bɛ taali bi paai Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa taali.
en: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.

dag: Shallum mini Akub ni Talimɔn ni Ahiman ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa nyɛ dunɔguliba .
en: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa ka su li n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Naaran din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Gɛza din daa be wulinluhili polo la mini di tiŋkpansi ni Aya mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, to the east Naaran, and to the west Gezer and its towns, and Shechem and its towns as far as Ayyah and its towns.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: He said, Whoever has ears to listen should pay attention.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ o ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna nti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu, ka tɔɣi o ʒim bahi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ o nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: The priest will bring the offering to the altar. There the priest will remove the birds head, drain out the blood on the side of the altar, and burn the bird on the altar.

dag: Yi lihi ʒiɛm m binshɛŋa din be kasi la, ka bi tiri n vuhim dabisa jilima.
en: You despise my holy things and degrade my sabbaths.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Judanim la mini bɛ yaansi su n zoya ni tiŋgbana la. N ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn jɛmdi ma n-yɛn be nimaani.
en: I will keep some of the people of Jacob. Some of the people of Judah will get my mountains. I will choose the people who will get the land. My servants will live there.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛlli ŋɔ puuni? Ŋun chaŋ tɔb maa tuhibu shee tarili ni nyɛ shɛm, ŋun ʒiya guli nɛma gba tarili yɛn nyɛla lala. Bɛ zaa tarili yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: How could anyone agree with you on this plan? The share of those who went into battle and the share of those who stayed with the supplies will be divided equally.

dag: Ka bɛ daa jɛm o, ka lan lab Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli.
en: They worshipped him and returned to Jerusalem overwhelmed with joy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa ka o sanna, ka o leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka Otiniɛl daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Otiniɛl nyaŋ o. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord took control of Othniel, and he led Israel in a war against Cushan Rishathaim. The Lord let Othniel win.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Naawuni nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa yɛn go, ka bol o yiŋbihi na ti zaŋ o liɣiri pirigi ti ba ni bɛ deei wolimma.
en: The kingdom is also like what happened when a man went away and put his three servants in charge of all he owned.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria, ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria; di zaŋdiya tab taali, ka Naawuni ti ku zaŋ yi gba taali; chɛliya yi tab taali paŋmi ba, ka Naawuni ti chɛ m-paŋ yi gba.
en: Dont judge, and you wont be judged. Dont condemn, and you wont be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Ti zaligu wuhiya ni ti karimi nir saria ka na bi bɔh o baŋ o ni niŋ shɛli.
en: According to our Law we cannot condemn people before hearing them and finding out what they have done.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ tia maa, ka yi mi nyɛ di wula; ŋun kul tuɣ ma ka n gba tuɣ o, ŋuna n-wandi wala pam; dama yi yi bi tuɣ ma, yi ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I to you, you will produce plenty of fruit. But separated from me you wont be able to do anything.

dag: Ka shɛb pun yɛli ba a yɛla ni a wuhirila Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn be bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tinsi ni la ni bɛ zaɣisim Anabi Musa zaligu, ka lan yɛri ba ni bɛ di gundi bɛ bihi, ka mi di lan doli bɛ kaya.
en: They have been told that you teach the Jews who live in non-Jewish regions to stop following the Law of Moses. They have heard that you tell them not to circumcise their sons or follow our other customs.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni be kaman zunzuya Ifriimnim sani ka be kaman bin pɔŋ Judanim sani.
en: I will bring destruction on Israel and ruin on the people of Judah.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ dabisili maa dali shiri kanna. Di ti yɛn nyɛla o sujee min o suhuyiɣisili ni o putɔɣu niŋbu dali. O ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ kpalimla tiŋgban nɛli, ka ku alahichinim bɛn be di ni zaa.
en: I, the Lord , will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.

dag: Kum mini nyɛvili bela zilinli yiko ni, ka bɛn yuri li ni di di nyɔri.
en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

dag: Amaa dunia ŋɔ ni ti leei tiŋgban nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: And the earth will become desolate because of her inhabitants, because of the fruit of their actions.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ yaɣ shɛli polo katiŋa nti du n-tam zoli zuɣu ka o mini ba daa danigi tab pam.
en: David crossed over to the other side of the valley. He stood on top of the mountain across the valley from Sauls camp. David and Sauls camp were far apart.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni bi ku ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn ka bɛ ti leeg o min o bihi daba hal ka Pɛriʒia nam ti nya zaa zani.
en: The survivors were taken to Babylonia as prisoners, where they were slaves of the king and his sons, until Persia became a powerful nation.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Guhimiya ka m-bɔhi Yawɛ wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi polo.
en: Moses said to them, I will ask the Lord what he says about this.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ n ni be shɛm.
en: I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa be yi sani, ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim; ti daa kul bela baalim, ka gbib ya kaman paɣ ni gbib o bihi shɛm la.
en: even though as apostles of Christ we could have made demands on you. But we were gentle when we were with you, like a mother taking care of her children.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu pam. So ku tooi baŋ o galisim maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Lord is great and deserves all our praise! No one can fully understand his greatness!.

dag: Di chani a ʒiʒiinikpee yiŋa waawaayili, di yi pa lala, o nyee ni ti nyɔn a, ka o ku lan bɔr a.
en: Dont spend too much time in your neighbors house. Otherwise, theyll get fed up with you and hate you.

dag: Jɔsia bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɔhanan ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛma, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛhoyakim, ka ŋun pah ata nyɛ Zɛdɛkia, ka ŋun pah anahi nyɛ Shallum.
en: Josiahs family: the oldest Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

dag: daa ti lo tɔbu bɛ ʒiɛman ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Sɔdom Naa Bɛra mini Gomɔra Naa Birisha ni Adima Naa Shinab ni Zɛbɔiim Naa Shɛmɛba ni Bɛla bee Zɔa naa.
en: All these kings fought a war against King Bera of Sodom: King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni daa zaɣis o yɛligu zuɣu.
en: God sent darkness, and it became dark, but the Egyptians rejected his word.

dag: A ni ti du n-tam gbuɣima mini tinvura zuɣu; a ni du n-tam gbuɣim polli mini wɔɣimaha zuɣu n-no ba.
en: Youll march on top of lions and vipers; youll trample young lions and serpents underfoot.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ niriba lee nyɛ banima bee m ba zuliya mi lee nyɛ banim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n ti yɛn leei naa deemba.
en: David answered, Who am I and what is my family that I should become the king's son-in-law.

dag: n-zaŋ ba bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: They will throw them into the place of fire. There the people will be crying and grinding their teeth with pain.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: Then the Lord said to Elijah, the prophet from Tishbe.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: You have treated your servant well, LORD, according to your promise.

dag: O daa yi kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla puri ni bee tiŋkpansi ni bee fɔntinsi ni, bɛ ʒirila barinim na nti sɔŋdi di dahi ni, ka suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shihi o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus went into towns, cities, and farms around that area. And every place he went, the people brought sick people to the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch any part of his coat. And all those who touched him were healed.

dag: Ka ŋunkam siɣis omaŋ leei kaman bibil ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: The greatest in the Kingdom of heaven is the one who humbles himself and becomes like this child.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini tuya ʒiɛri maa ti Iso ka o di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi chaŋ o chandi shee. Lala ka Iso daa niŋ ʒiɛm o kpamdi maa.
en: So Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate, drank, got up, and left, showing just how little he thought of his birthright.

dag: Ka paɣ so mi yi mali yidan ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda, ka doo maa yu ni o mal o, ŋun miri ka o yi o yiŋa.
en: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi wulinluhili polo m-buɣisi li, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He went around to the west side and measured it. It was cubits long.

dag: Izar bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Nɛfɛg ni Zikiri.
en: Izhar's sons were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.

dag: Bɛ leeri nanima, ka bi niŋdi ma saawara. Bɛ piiri kpamba, amaa ka m bi mi di yɛla. Bɛ zaŋdi bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa maani binnana din yɛn bahi bɛn maŋmaŋ yoli.
en: My people chose kings, but they did it on their own. They appointed leaders, but without my approval. They took their silver and gold and made idols—for their own destruction.

dag: Ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li? Bɛ daa zɔrila niriba, dama sokam zaa daa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But if we say, From human beings ....

dag: Ka yi mi yi ti nya ka pɔhim ʒiɛri yiri nudirigu polo na, yi yɛrimi ni woligu ni niŋ, ka di ti shiri niŋ.
en: And when a south wind blows, you say, A heat wave is coming. And it does.

dag: Zatu daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Ɛliashib so ni Matania so mi ni Jɛrɛmɔt so gba ni Zabad ni Aziza.
en: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna ku wum a yɛligu maa, ka di chɛ ka n daalahiziba tuma maa galisi pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: What the Lord had earlier said to Moses came true. He had said, The king of Egypt won't listen. Then I will perform even more miracles.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, di simdi ni yi niŋ n ni zali ya shɛm n-gbibi n zaligunim ka dol li.
en: You must obey my rules and follow my laws. Be sure to follow my rules because I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka o daa lan gbihi n-zahim zahindi din pah ayi. Kawaan kara ayopɔin din viɛla n-daa nyaɣi kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu.
en: He went back to sleep and had a second dream, in which seven ears of grain, full and healthy, grew on a single stalk.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina, ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: God parted the skies and came down; thick darkness was beneath his feet.

dag: Waazuyihira maa boya ni o nya yɛtɔɣa din tuhi, ka o ni sab yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa.
en: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.

dag: ka yɛl o, Cham Sailom biaŋ ni ti paɣ a nina maa. Ka o chaŋ ti paɣ o nina maa, ka di dii neei, ka o labina.
en: Then he said, Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool. The man went and washed in Siloam, which means One Who Is Sent. When he had washed off the mud, he could see.

dag: N wum Izraɛlnim ni ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni shɛm maa. Yɛlim ba ni yi yɛn ŋubirila nimdi yuŋ, ka diri bindirigu mi tiɣiri asiba, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I have heard my people complain. Now tell them that each evening they will have meat and each morning they will have more than enough bread. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhim wuntizɔriba kpɛhi zaɣ biɛɣu ni ni ti lu bɛmaŋmaŋ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛŋa ni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni ti nya laara din viɛla.
en: Whoever misleads those who do right onto an evil path will fall into their own pit, but the blameless will inherit good things.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba bɛn be kasi. Yawɛ n-daa pii ya dunia ŋɔ zuliya pam sunsuuni n-leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord , so don't behave like those who worship other gods.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛra daa ti tum birigi bɛ dan Ijipti naa maa.
en: Some time later the king of Egypt's wine steward and his chief baker offended the king.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu bi saɣi ni bɛ wuhi ni nir mali taali bee galimi zaŋ chaŋ taali shɛlikam tumbu polo naɣila niriba ayi bee niriba ata shɛhira dibu ka yi ni doli n-wuhi ni nir mali taali.
en: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.

dag: Pin suma mini pina din be tibi zaa yirila Naawuni ŋun nam alizanda mini neesim, ka nyɛ ŋun ka taɣibu, ka mi ka shilinshia din limsiri neesim maa la sanna.
en: Everything good comes from God. Every perfect gift is from him. These good gifts come down from the Father who made all the lights in the sky. But God never changes like the shadows from those lights. He is always the same.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun bɔhi biɛri ti ma; ka nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be n sulinsi ni ti ma.
en: He is the God who punishes my enemies for me, the one who puts people under my control.

dag: Dama pa paɣ ni ka doo yina, amaa doo ni ka paɣ ŋun yina.
en: Man didnt have his origin from woman, but woman from man.

dag: Yawɛ yurilim din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi kpi; o nambɔzɔbo ka tariga.
en: The Lord 's unfailing love and mercy still continue.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ Bɛtɛl maa hal ni Luz n-gari chaŋ hal ti paai Atarɔt din nyɛ Arikinim tiŋgban la.
en: From Bethel it went to Luz, passing on to Ataroth Addar, where the Archites lived.

dag: Ti Duuma ni chɛ ninvuɣ so daalahichi taali paŋ o ka bi lan maani di laasabu mal alibarika.
en: It is a great blessing when the Lord accepts people as if they are without sin! Psalm :-.

dag: ni Yirɔn ni Migidalɛl ni Hɔrɛm ni Bɛtanat ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pisiyinika m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Yiron, Migdalel, Horem, Bethanath, and Beth Shemesh: nineteen cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Yi ni so di bɔh o kpee biɛri, amaa niŋmiya ania n-kul niŋmi yi taba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa din viɛla.
en: Be sure that no one pays back wrong for wrong. But always try to do what is good for each other and for all people.

dag: Amaa Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi ka kpi. O daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi ko. Ka Kish ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni nir la bidibis daa kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi maa.
en: Eleazar died without sons, but he did have daughters who married their relatives from Kishs family.

dag: ka n yɛli, n di bi zaɣisi ka m mali kpiŋkpama kaman ŋmani la. N naan yiɣi chaŋ ka vuhi.
en: I say to myself, I wish I had wings like a dove! Id fly away and rest.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: He took Peter, James, and John with him. Distress and anguish came over him.

dag: Yuun pihinahi zaa ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul birigiri bɛ suhuri ni ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: For forty years I was disgusted with those people. I said, How disloyal they are! They refuse to obey my commands.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino kpuɣim o labila, ka di kalinli yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka yi niŋ tulaale zim niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ka Yawɛ tooni na. Ka a gba mini Aduna gbibi yi tulaale lahi.
en: Each of you take along your fire pan with incense in it and offer the incense to the Lord .

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa di nam maa su Izraɛlnim yuma ata.
en: Abimelech had been a military commander of Israel for three years.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu luɣ shɛli tam ni bi zilim pam n-dii bilina yomyom, nimaani tam ni bi zilim zuɣu.
en: Other seeds fell on thin, rocky ground and quickly started growing because the soil wasn't very deep.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛra zaani zaashe kara ni, ka zaŋdi bundaannim zaani tarimba zaashee.
en: Fools are given important positions, while the rich get jobs that are not important.

dag: Ka shia maa daa kpalim zani, amaa n daa bi tooi baŋ di ŋmahiŋgbana ni nyɛ shɛm. Kɔtomsi shɛli n-daa ʒe n tooni, ka vuri daa fo, di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli ni yɛli.
en: I could see something standing there; I stared, but couldn't tell what it was. Then I heard a voice out of the silence:.

dag: Ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu maa yi malaika ŋun daa ʒe Naawuni tooni maa nuu ni n-kpuɣ du zuɣusaa.
en: The smoke of the incense offered for the prayers of the saints rose up before God from the angels hand.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali tɛhi yini mini yurilim yini, ka mali suhu yini tɛhi yini puuni, ka di chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa.
en: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.

dag: Ka ŋmalig o nyaandoliba maa polo yɛli ba ashilɔni, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nina nyari yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said to them privately, How fortunate you are to see the things you see!.

dag: Ka a ni ti lan nya ka a zuliya galisi. Ka a bihi ti galisi kaman mɔri ni galisi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ bɛ ni daa nya Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam Gibiɔn, ka kari doli bɛn kpalim hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn zolɔŋni n-kul kuri ba hal ti paai Azɛka mini Makɛda.
en: The Lord made the Amorites panic at the sight of Israel's army. The Israelites slaughtered them at Gibeon and pursued them down the mountain pass at Beth Horon, keeping up the attack as far south as Azekah and Makkedah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yihi o niriba maa; ka bɛ daa ʒi anzinfa mini salima yi, bɛ ni so daa bi tuui.
en: He led his people out of Egypt. They were carrying gold and silver, and none of them stumbled or fell behind.

dag: amaa zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka ti sani kpe zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gba.
en: but also with those standing here with us right now before the LORD our God, and also with those who arent here with us right now.

dag: O chɛ ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm ma, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛri n ninni.
en: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.

dag: Ŋun kɔra, o ni mali bindirigu pam, amaa ŋun doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi, fara ni gbaag o pam.
en: A hard-working farmer has plenty to eat. People who waste time will always be poor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, A na ʒi n-di ti ni so bini zalinsi bee n-nahim ti bee n-fa ti ni so bini.
en: The Israelites answered, No, you never did anything bad to us. You never cheated us or took things from us.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim nya yiko m-baŋ Masia yurilim yɛliŋ mini di wɔɣilim ni di dubu ni di ziliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: so that you, together with all God's people, may have the power to understand how broad and long, how high and deep, is Christ's love.

dag: Bahigu maa paana. Di bahigu saha paaya. Di nyɛla din yiɣisi lu yi zuɣu. Nyama, di kanna.
en: It's all over. This is the end. You are finished.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni, Sallu daa nyɛla Mɛshulam bia, ka Hɔdavia nyɛ Hasɛnua bia.
en: These are the people from the tribe of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem: Sallu was Meshullams son. Meshullam was Hodaviahs son. Hodaviah was Hassenuahs son.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba ni bɛ su li. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Handing their land over as an inheritance— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zo n-gili bimbini maa, ka pali bɔɣili la gba.
en: The water flowed around the altar, and even the trench filled with water.

dag: Ka namɔɣili maa daa bɔhi Filip, Ŋun yɛla ka Anabi maa lee yɛri maa, omaŋmaŋ yɛla bee so yɛla.
en: The official said to Philip, Please, tell me, who is the prophet talking about? Is he talking about himself or about someone else.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli n dana, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti zaŋ a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni yiya mini Juda nanim yiya shɛŋa bɛ ni daa wurim zaŋ taɣi bɛmaŋa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa teei gili ba, ka kahi kuɣa duhi ni bɛ tuhi ba la polo m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, proclaims about the houses of this city and the palaces of the kings of Judah that were torn down to defend against the siege ramps and weapons.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ku ti Duuma Yisa mini anabinima, ka daa niŋ ti gba alaka la. Bɛ kul tumdila din bi tiɣiri Naawuni nini, ka kul guri ninsalinim soli.
en: They killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets and drove us out. They dont please God, and they are hostile to the entire human race.

dag: ka Shimia nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Baasɛya bia, ka Baasɛya nyɛ Malikija bia.
en: Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka bɛ nyom yaɣi; ka bɛ ʒim ti zɔri teeni zoya zuɣu.
en: Their dead will be cast out, the stench of their corpses will rise, and the mountains will melt from their blood.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so; n lo alikauli ni n ni gbib a yɛligu.
en: You are all I want, O Lord ; I promise to obey your laws.

dag: bee n-suh o galli, ka o gbaai nɔŋa ti o?.
en: Or, if he asked for an egg, would you give him a scorpion? Of course not!.

dag: ni Jɛdiayɛl min o mabia Jɔha bɛn daa nyɛ Shimri Tizi nir bihi la.
en: Jediael, Shimris son, and his brother Joha the Tizite.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma laara n wuntitali mini m biɛrisuntali zaŋ chaŋ o sani zuɣu.
en: And so he rewards me because I do what is right, because he knows that I am innocent.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ tuuli naɣ kara ayopɔin la ŋubi.
en: The thin, sick cows ate the first healthy cows.

dag: Di saha maa Judanim zaa mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ biliɛri ni bɛ bi kura zaa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ tooni.
en: All the men of Judah stood before the Lord with their wives, babies, and children.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, o di chɛ ka n nini nya o. Dinzuɣu ka Absalom daa be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, ka bi chani naa sani.
en: David told Joab, I don't want to see my son Absalom. Tell him to stay away from me. So Absalom went to his own house without seeing his father.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ kuɣili ŋɔ sa luɣ shɛli ŋɔ ni leei nyin Naawuni yiŋa, ka a yi ti ma binshɛlikam zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni yihi di bini pia kam ni zaɣ yini ti a.
en: This rock will be your house, and I will give back to you a tenth of everything you give me.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Dinzuɣu deemiya liɣiri maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ tuhi pia ŋɔ;.
en: Therefore, take from him the valuable coin and give it to the one who has ten coins.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti teei yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛhigu din daa bi viɛl la yɛla, ka ku lan bɔri yi ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa la.
en: Then you will remember your evil ways and no-good deeds, and you will feel disgust for yourselves because of your sinful and detestable practices.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bibil so na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni n-kpuɣ o buɣi ka yɛli ba.
en: Then Jesus asked a child to stand near him. He put his arm around the child and said.

dag: Teemiya kurimbuni ha yɛla. Tɛhimiya yuun gbaliŋ din gari la yɛla. Bɔhimiya yi ba, o ni wuhi ya, ka bɔhi yi dɔɣirikpamba, bɛ ni yɛli ya.
en: Remember the days of the past. Think about what happened so long ago. Ask your father; he will tell you. Ask your leaders; they will tell you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, sɔŋm ma! Tiligim ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Help me, O Lord my God; because of your constant love, save me!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul piligi yiini wumpaɣibo yilli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka mbusim lu Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunim bɛn daa laɣim kana ti liri Judanim maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa birim ka ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu ku taba.
en: As they broke into joyful song and praise, the LORD launched a surprise attack against the Ammonites, the Moabites, and those from Mount Seir who were invading Judah, so that they were defeated.

dag: Ka niriba daa be samban ni ka wum chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama vuri, ka di be kaman Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o kukoli be shɛm la.
en: The sound of the winged creatures wings could be heard as far as the outer courtyard. It was like the sound of God Almighty when he speaks.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti yi, ka alibarika ti lan be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti lab kpɛna.
en: The Lord will bless everything you do.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka mɔri niŋ mɔɣu ni ka yi biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: And I will make grass grow in your fields for your cattle. You will have plenty to eat.

dag: ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Then we did what the Lord told me to do. We went back into the desert on the road that leads to the Red Sea. We traveled for many days to go around the mountains of Seir.

dag: Naftali zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jaziil daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jaziilnima; ka Guni daŋ niriba nyɛ Guninima;.
en: Naphtalis descendants according to their clans: from Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; from Guni, the Gunite clan.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa kpuɣ o zuɣu ŋmaligi lihi n-nya piɛlaa ka o ʒiɛya, ka o yila shɛbi tiwula ni. Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ ti gbaai piɛlaa maa na nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka chɛ o bia maa.
en: Abraham looked up and saw a single ram caught by its horns in the dense underbrush. Abraham went over, took the ram, and offered it as an entirely burned offering instead of his son.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa chaŋ bɛn bi gundi sani, ka a mini ba ti laɣindi timdi dira.
en: You were a guest in the home of uncircumcised Gentiles, and you even ate with them.

dag: Ka ti zaa kul nyari anfaani din galisi n-yir o kɔbili ni na pari taba.
en: From his fullness we have all received grace upon grace.

dag: Bɛ kuhigu maa ni, bɛ ni ti yili kuyilli a zuɣu. Tin dini n-na mi n-wurim teeku sunsuuni kaman Taai ni wurim shɛm ŋɔ?.
en: They chant a funeral song for you: Who can be compared to Tyre, To Tyre now silent in the sea?.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yi ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: The people of Israel said, Thats not fair! The Lord isnt fair! I am fair! You are the ones who are not fair!.

dag: Ka Rut daa kul be o kayiha maa ni hal ka zaawuni ti paai, ka o daa zaŋ o ni nya shɛm tariga m-bu li yɛli ka di niŋ kilɔgiram pia.
en: Ruth worked in the field until evening. Then after she had pounded the grain off the stalks, she had a large basket full of grain.

dag: A daa tahi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu zuɣu ka di kom vuui; ka chɛ ka bɛ no tiŋkuŋ zuɣu kaman tiŋgban nɛl la du.
en: He gave a command to the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led his people across on dry land.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu. Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! .
en: Now your home will be left completely empty. I tell you, you will not see me again until that time when you will say, Welcome! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord. .

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa buɣisi n-kpe ka di mali shaara mini sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duri maa zuɣusaa.
en: On top of them were other stones, cut to measure, and cedar beams.

dag: Nolɔɣu kukoli saha ka Samuɛl daa ti boli Sool pii maa zuɣu yɛl o, Yiɣisim ka m biɛl a zali soli. Ka Sool yiɣisi ka o mini Samuɛl daa lu soli.
en: and Saul slept there. About sunrise the next morning, Samuel called up to Saul on the roof, Time to get up! I'll help you get started on your way. Saul got up. He and Samuel left together.

dag: Filistianim maa daa du n-tamla zoli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli polo ka Izraɛlnim mi tam zoli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli polo, ka vinvamli be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines lined up on one hill and the Israelites on another, with a valley between them.

dag: ka yɛri ni yinim yi di daa be yi yaannim saha la, yi daa naan ku pahi bɛ zuɣu ku anabinim maa.
en: And you say, If we had lived during the time of our ancestors, we would not have helped them kill these prophets.

dag: A ni ti lula palɔni, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa daadambiɛligu nabi, ka niriba ʒini yi fɔntinsi ni, ka yi lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: I will make your population grow. You will live in the cities and rebuild everything that was left in ruins.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa ayɔbu mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: They made six more frames for the back of the Holy Tent.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi sɔŋbu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni n lab ŋun tim ma na maa sani, dama n yi bi labi, Sɔŋda la ku ka yi sanna; amaa n yi labi, n ni tim o yi sanna.
en: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.

dag: Bɛ mini Pool zaa tuma daa nyɛla tanti wuɣibu tuma, dinzuɣu ka Pool daa chaŋ ti be bɛ sani ni o mini ba laɣim wolindi dira.
en: and stayed and worked with them, because he earned his living by making tents, just as they did.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni Yɛhudianim bɛn yi a sani n-kuli ti sanna la chaŋ ti ʒinila Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ lab mɛrila di tiŋ din nyɛ tin biɛɣu ni duŋtaabo tiŋ maa yaha. Bɛ pun sɔŋ di tanzahi, ka me di goma maa miri naabu.
en: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa suhuri daa paligi ka bɛ yiini yila yɛri taba, Sool kula tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia.
en: The women sang, Saul has killed his thousands, but David has killed tens of thousands.

dag: A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisili pam, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, filimm a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒil ti ʒitibisi shɛl la; ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father made our workload very hard for us. If you will lessen the demands your father made of us and lighten the heavy workload he demanded from us, then we will serve you.

dag: dama Naawuni chɛ ka sokam kpe bɛmaŋmaŋ nɔzaɣisibo ni m-be kaman dansarikanima n-nyɛ ba la ni di chɛ ka o zo sokam nambɔɣu.
en: For God has made all people prisoners of disobedience, so that he might show mercy to them all.

dag: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la daa lan mali bidib shɛba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Haroi ŋun zuliya nyɛ Mɛnuhɔtinim pirigili la.
en: Shobal was the founder of Kiriath Jearim. This is a list of Shobals descendants: Haroeh, half the people in Manahti.

dag: Amazia ni daa tuhi Ɛdomnim naai ka labiri kuna, o daa kpuɣila bɛ wuna m-mali kuli ti zaŋ li leeg omaŋmaŋ wuna n-jɛmdi li ka maani li.
en: Amaziah came home after he defeated the Edomites. He brought the idols that the people of Seir worshiped. He started to worship those idols. He bowed down in front of them and burned incense to them.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba mini naa daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, The Lord is right. We have deserted him.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla din viɛla kɔŋko, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla suhuyiɣisili.
en: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.

dag: Dama Yawɛ chɛ ka gom gbaai ya ni yi gbihi gbihiri biɛɣu. O pɔbi yi daanabinim nina, ka zaŋ bini pili yi nyariba zuɣuri.
en: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.

dag: Teem a niriba la, ka kpam ba jaande Naawuni zuɣu ni bɛ zom yi yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu din tahiri naŋgbankpeeni na la ni. Di ka buchi, di naɣ saɣindila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li.
en: Remind your people of this, and give them a solemn warning in God's presence not to fight over words. It does no good, but only ruins the people who listen.

dag: Bani so mi daŋ ni: Maadai mini Amiram ni Uɛl.
en: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu from the family of Bani;.

dag: Di saha Bɛtishɛmɛshinim daa bela vinvamli ni n-chɛri alikama, bɛ ni daa ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi nya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka di niŋ ba suhupiɛlli.
en: The people of Beth Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley. They looked up and saw the Holy Box. They were very happy to see it again. They ran to get it.

dag: Amaa Bɛzalɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Uri bia, ka nyɛ Hur yaaŋa la ni daa mali daanya sara maligu bimbini shɛl la din daa kpalim bela Gibiɔn Yawɛ biɛhigu shee la tooni, ka Naa Sulemaana mini zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni nimaani.
en: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, who was the son of Hur, had made was in front of the Holy Tent at Gibeon. So Solomon and the people went there to ask the Lord for advice.

dag: Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa mini bɛ tab bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la ni daa wuhi tab shihirili shɛli nyɛla ni bɛ yi ti nya ka nyɔhi yiɣisi mɔni tiŋ maa puuni.
en: Now the men of Israel had made a plan with the men who were hiding. The men who were hiding were supposed to send a special signal. They were supposed to make a big cloud of smoke.

dag: wulimpuhili polo daa malila dunoya ata, nuzaa polo diba ata, nudirigu polo diba ata, wulinluhili polo mi diba ata.
en: There were three gates on the east, three gates on the north, three gates on the south, and three gates on the west.

dag: Duu daa beni ka di dunoli be dunɔdali zɔntua puuni, nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣiri bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim.
en: There was also a doorway in the side walls of the gates. That doorway led into a room where the priests washed the sacrifices.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani ni a suhu zaa, ka miri ka a niŋ amaŋmaŋ milinsi naani.
en: Trust the Lord completely, and dont depend on your own knowledge.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sukɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam din miri tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.

dag: Ka yi mi din na taɣi di niŋbu zali. Dina n-nyɛ ni di chɛ ka Zaliguzaɣisira la ti yi zahira o saha dɛde.
en: Yet there is something that keeps this from happening now, and you know what it is. At the proper time, then, the Wicked One will appear.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tir o ba min o ma jilima, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who belittles their father or mother. All the people will reply: We agree.
