dag: Areebianim mini Kɛdar nabihi zaa daa nyɛla a daabi yurisi bɛn niŋdi piɛnyama mini piɛlahi ni buhi daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar traded for you. They procured lambs, rams, and goats for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, wummiya n ni wuhiri ya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ zaa, ka dol li din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni.
en: Then Moses said to the people, Obey all the laws that I am teaching you, and you will live and occupy the land which the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

dag: O chɛ ka tɔbu tuhibu chɛ dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam. O kab tɔbiri ka saɣim kpana, ka nyo nyɔtaɣirisi buɣim.
en: bringing wars to an end in every corner of the world, breaking the bow and shattering the spear, burning chariots with fire.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Naftali zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their towns were in the land which the families of the tribe of Naphtali received as their possession.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka n dii tim a sanna maa, ka a mi ni kana maa a niŋ viɛnyɛla. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ ti zaa bela Naawuni tooni ni ti wum ŋun Naawuni ni ti a zilin shɛli ni a ti ti. .
en: I sent for you right away, and you were kind enough to come. Now, here we are, gathered in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has directed you to say.

dag: N yi be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, m malila a zaligunim maa yiini yila.
en: Your laws are the songs I sing wherever I am living.

dag: O daa yɛl ti Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tin ya yurilim shɛl la yɛla.
en: He has told us of the love that the Spirit has given you.

dag: Di saha maa ka anab shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: About that time some prophets went from Jerusalem to Antioch.

dag: O chɛ ka ti tahi a nasara dibu suhupiɛlli tahigu, ka sa ti tuutanim ti Naawuni yuli zuɣu. Yawɛ deem a suhigu zaa.
en: We will celebrate when he helps you. We will praise the name of God. May the Lord give you everything you ask for.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra:.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, You may now speak to defend yourself. Paul raised his hand to get their attention and began to speak.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jɛrimia ti niŋ bɔɣili ni jɛriyali maa ni, ka o daa be di puuni niŋ daba ayi.
en: They put Jeremiah into a cell under the house of Jonathan. The cell was in a dungeon under the ground. Jeremiah was there for a long time.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n nya saŋmar so ŋun daa yi zuɣusaa lu dunia ni na la, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɔɣ shɛli din ziliŋ ka tariga saafɛbia ti o.
en: The fifth angel blew his trumpet. Then I saw a star fall from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the deep hole that leads down to the bottomless pit.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa puuni, a ka taali, dama a nyɛla ŋun ʒe ti yim, ka tinim lee tum din bie.
en: You have always been fair when you punished us for our sins.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa ti bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate asked Jesus, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus answered, Yes, that is right.

dag: Yɛlim Lɛvinima, Yi yi ti deei zaka bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini Izraɛlnim sani, din nyɛ n ni deei shɛli bɛ sani tin ya ka di nyɛ yi tarili la, yin yihimiya di bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini ti man Yawɛ, ka di nyɛ zaka binyɛra puuni mi zaka.
en: to say to the Levites: When you receive from the people of Israel ten percent of their crops and newborn animals, you must offer a tenth of that to me.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba n-daa su Tapua tiŋgbani maa, amaa Tapua fɔŋ din daa ʒi Manaasa zuliya niriba tintariga la dina, Ifriim zuliya niriba n-daa su li.
en: The land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town of Tappuah, on the border, belonged to the descendants of Ephraim.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Judanima, Wuhimiya ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Benya kaman ti shɛli din chɛ ka di mahim luri ti zuɣu wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha. Ti nyɛla bɛn zona ti kpɛn ya ni ti tiligi, zaŋmiya ti sɔɣi.
en: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.

dag: M bi tɛhi ni n nyɛla ŋun pɔri tuun shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I dont think that those super apostles are any better than I am.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Sool daa ʒi o yiŋa n-gbibi kpani o nuu ni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu yaa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka Dauda ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o.
en: One day an evil spirit from the Lord took control of Saul. He was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand, and David was there, playing his harp.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba mini Kɔra daŋ niriba la daa yiɣisi zani ŋ-ŋme kuŋ pam paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The Levites from the Kohath family groups and the Korah family stood up to praise the Lord , the God of Israel. They sang very loudly.

dag: N ku zo dabiɛm muɣisigu saha, saha shɛli n dimnim yi ti teei gili ma.
en: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia daa yɛli gbaŋŋmara Shafan, N nyala Naawuni zaligu kundi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni; ka daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan ka o karim li.
en: Shaphan delivered the king's order to Hilkiah, and Hilkiah told him that he had found the book of the Law in the Temple. Hilkiah gave him the book, and Shaphan read it.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi.
en: Jesus answered, It isn't right to take the children's food and throw it to the dogs.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka ŋun ti yab Ibrahimma ba daa ti kpi, ka Naawuni lan zaŋ o nimaani tahi yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ na.
en: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After Abrahams father died, God had him resettle in this land where you now live.

dag: M be a sani, ka so ku tooi niŋ a shɛli, dama m mali niriba pam tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: I am with you, and no one will be able to hurt you. Many of my people are in this city.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan zaŋ ʒim mihi tanti Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mini binshɛlikam bɛ ni daa mali tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma.
en: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni darigi Amalɛknim ŋɔ tibili bɛ ni daa niŋ Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila zuɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says: When the Israelites came out of Egypt, the Amalekites tried to stop them from going to Canaan. I saw what the Amalekites did.

dag: O ni daa niŋ Rubin bia Ɛliab bidibisi Datan mini Abiram shɛm la, tiŋgbani ni daa bɔɣi n-vali bɛ mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ suɣa ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun daa be bɛ sani Izraɛlnim zaa sunsuuni la.
en: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.

dag: Ka Daniɛl dimnim la daa naai noli kana ti nya o ka o suhiri la o Naawuni.
en: Just then these men, all ganged together, came upon Daniel praying and seeking mercy from his God.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zɔhi waɣi pam muɣisi ba, ka chɛ ka poloya gba waɣi n-saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: God sent swarms against them to eat them up, frogs to destroy them.

dag: Dama tɔbbihi bɛn kana namdanim zaa mini bɛ binyɛra din ŋam ʒim zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire.

dag: Pa ti ninni ka bindira maa zaa zani m-bahi yoli, ka suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim lan ka ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu?.
en: We look on helpless as our crops are destroyed. There is no joy in the Temple of our God.

dag: M bi bɔri ni di be kaman n sabirila gbana ni n kpɛhi ya dabiɛm.
en: I do not want it to appear that I am trying to frighten you with my letters.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, chɛli paŋ ba, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛli maa gbinni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ n-tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: Jesus said, Father, forgive them. They dont know what they are doing. The soldiers threw dice to divide Jesus clothes between them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti bol o bia Sulemaana na ti yɛl o ni o mɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Then David called for his son Solomon and told him to build the Temple for the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ti Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ so ka o fa ba Sirianim maa nuu ni bahi; ka Izraɛlnim daa lan ʒi bɛ yinsi ni suhudoo kaman bɛ ni daa pun ʒiya shɛm.
en: So the Lord sent a man to save Israel. The Israelites were free from the Arameans. So the Israelites went to their own homes, as they did before.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔh o, N zuɣu ka a zabiri nyuli maa? N di bi zaɣisi ka Yawɛ niriba zaa nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ di zaŋ o shia niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Moses answered, Are you concerned about my interests? I wish that the Lord would give his spirit to all his people and make all of them shout like prophets.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni yino kuli ti zaŋ yi tizo maa na, ka yinim bɛn kpalim be sarika ni, ka ti buɣisi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa nya yɛlimaŋli ka yi yɛli maa, di yi pa lala, m po Firawuna ni yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: Choose one of you to go after your brother, while the rest of you stay here in jail. That will show whether you are telling the truth. But if you are lying, I swear by the life of the king that you are spies!.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Ijipti ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kuriba tusa anahi n-taai duŋ zo n-kpe mɔɣu la.
en: Aren't you that Egyptian who started a riot not long ago and led , terrorists into the desert.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya! Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: Show me a silver coin. Whose face and name are these on it? The Emperor's, they answered.

dag: Aai, yɛligu maa kul bela yi sani, di bela yi noya ni mini yi suhuri ni ni yi dol li.
en: Not at all! The word is very close to you. Its in your mouth and in your heart, waiting for you to do it.

dag: Sɔɣim ma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa ashilɔni zaŋ chaŋ m polo la, ka sɔɣi ma ka chɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba ni lɔri yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Protect me from the secret plans of the wicked. Hide me from that gang of evil people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti lan zahim zahindi shɛli, ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa yaha. O daa yɛli ba mi: Nyamiya, n lan zahimla zahindi shɛli. N sa nyami ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi piniyini damdi ma tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph had another dream, and he told his brothers about it. He said, I had another dream. I saw the sun, the moon, and eleven stars bowing down to me.

dag: Yi tibidarigibo dali, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ, ka zaɣ biɛɣu ni ti yɛn yi katiŋ na ti paai ya dahin shɛli, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ? Ŋun sani ka yi lee ti yɛn zo n-chaŋ ti bo sɔŋsim bee luɣ dini ka yi lee ti yɛn zaŋ yi daazichi sɔŋ?.
en: What will you do on the day of punishment when disaster comes from far away? To whom will you flee for help; where will you stash your wealth?.

dag: So di bɔr omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko sɔŋsim nyabu, amaa o bom o tab gba sɔŋsim nyabu.
en: We should think about others and not about ourselves.

dag: Nyo bɔ ka n daa naan tooi nya bɛ nuhi tuma ni? Bɛ yaa zaa daa naaya.
en: Their fathers are still too weak to be of any use to me. All their strength is gone.

dag: Ninsalinim bi mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli paai li. Di ka ninvuɣ nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: Humankind doesnt know its value; it isnt found in the land of the living.

dag: Dama Yawɛ chɛ ka gom gbaai ya ni yi gbihi gbihiri biɛɣu. O pɔbi yi daanabinim nina, ka zaŋ bini pili yi nyariba zuɣuri.
en: The Lord will make you sleepy. He will close your eyes. He will cover your heads.

dag: Amaa n ni daa tɛhi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni, n daa nyaya ka di nyɛla tuun shɛli din to n sani.
en: But when I tried to understand these things, it just seemed like hard work.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiri ka ti ku yi zahira, ka binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ku baŋ di yɛla ka di yi palo.
en: There is nothing hidden that will not be found. There is no secret that will not be well known.

dag: Ashili pini nyɛla din maari suhuyiɣisili, ka ashilɔni birapu tibu gba nyɛ din maari suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: If anyone is angry with you, give them a gift in private. A gift given in secret will calm even the strongest anger.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa baŋ Naawuni bee Naawuni yipa baŋ ya, ka di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛn lab dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gbarigi ka ka yaa ŋɔ dabitim ni yaha? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan bɔri ni yi labi di sulinsi ni yaha?.
en: But now that you know God—or, I should say, now that God knows you—how is it that you want to turn back to those weak and pitiful ruling spirits? Why do you want to become their slaves all over again?.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Jɛriko, ka bɛ mini salo pam daa ti yiri Jɛriko maa, ka Timius bia Baatimius ŋun daa nyɛ zoma, ka nyɛ barimaana ʒi sokpaŋa.
en: Then they came to the town of Jericho. When Jesus left there with his followers, a large crowd was with them. A blind man named Bartimaeus was sitting by the road. He was always begging for money.

dag: O daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam ni tumtumdiba gba pam, ka Filistianim daa ti zabir o nyuli di zuɣu.
en: He had many flocks and herds of animals. He also had many slaves. All the Philistines were jealous of him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa fiig tia o puu ni, ka di walibu saha ti paai ka o chaŋ ti bɔri wala di zuɣu ka bi nya.
en: Jesus told this story: A man had a fig tree. He planted it in his garden. He came looking for some fruit on it, but he found none.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: Jesus asked, What do you want me to do for you.

dag: dama o daa tib barinim pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ŋunkam mali dɔro ŋaɣisiri niriba maa ni ni o ti shih o.
en: He had healed many of them, so all the sick people were pushing toward him to touch him.

dag: Ti daa da puu maa mini siliga din be di ni maa la Hitinim sani.
en: It is the field and the cave in it that belonged to the Hittites.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi mali yi yaa nyuri bara? Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, yi yaa naarimi maa. Yi niŋ yi daazichi naani ka yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi liri ti.
en: Why do you unfaithful people boast? Your strength is failing. Why do you trust in your power and say that no one would dare attack you?.

dag: Dandiɛɣu n-daa mali o bipuɣinsi ayi, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Tim ti, tim ti. Bina pam beni n-nyɛ din bi tiɣira. Di puuni diba anahi din kpɛm pam n-nyɛ:.
en: A leech has two daughters, and both are named Give me! There are four things that are never satisfied:.

dag: O daa lan mali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu binyara zaa. Di duɣuri mini di soobuya ni di taha ni di dirijaba ni lahi din ni moori buɣim. Daanya ka o daa zaŋ mali di zaa.
en: Then he used bronze to make all the tools to be used on the altar. He made the pots, shovels, bowls, forks, and pans.

dag: Timoti, gbib Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ a nuu ni ni a yuuni li la viɛnyɛliŋga. Gbaam amaŋa ni din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb ni chirim booni baŋsim la.
en: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.

dag: Onam bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shammai mini Jada. Shammai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abishur.
en: Onams family: Shammai and Jada. Shammais family: Nadab and Abishur.

dag: Zaŋ kpa Manaasa tintarisi polo, Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia la mi bidibisi n-daa ʒini nimaani n-su Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni Taanak mini di tiŋkpansi ni Mɛgido mini di tiŋkpansi ni Dɔri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: The descendants of Manasseh controlled the cities of Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, and the towns around them. All these are the places where the descendants of Joseph son of Jacob lived.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mariama daa yiɣisi chaŋ yomyom ti paai zoya ni tin shɛli din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Mary got up and hurried to a city in the Judean highlands.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa gbaŋŋmara daa gooi salo maa ka yɛli, Ɛfɛsusnima, ŋuni n-lee beni n-ʒi ni Ɛfɛsusnim nyɛla bɛn guli buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun galisi ŋɔ duu mini kuɣ shɛli din daa yi zuɣusaa luna la?.
en: At last the city clerk was able to calm the crowd. Fellow Ephesians! he said. Everyone knows that the city of Ephesus is the keeper of the temple of the great Artemis and of the sacred stone that fell down from heaven.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa mali buni ka lan mali jilima pam, ka o daa ti bɔri paɣa Ɛhab sani ni o ti o daŋ ni so.
en: Jehoshaphat became very rich and famous. He made an agreement with King Ahab through marriage.

dag: Bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu ka zaŋ li ti Naawuni saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim zaŋ binshɛŋa mali sara maa n-daa nyɛ; anzinfa parantɛnim pinaayi mini anzinfa taha pinaayi ni salima lahi pinaayi.
en: So all these things were the gifts from the leaders of the Israelites. They brought them during the time that Moses dedicated the altar by anointing it. They brought silver plates, silver bowls, and gold spoons.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim kpuɣiri paɣiba ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: Jesus said to the Sadducees, On earth, people marry each other.

dag: O daa yɛli Naftali zuliya: Yinim Naftalinima, yi nya yurilim tiɣi, ka Yawɛ daalibarika pali yi ni. Yinima n-su wulinluhili mini nudirigu polo.
en: Then he told Naphtali: Naphtali—you are full of favor, overflowing with the LORDs blessing— go possess the west and the south.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ o ti paai Lɛhi, ka Filistianim kul zɔri kani o sanna, ka tahira. Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na pam, ka mi shɛŋa din daa lo o maa zaa dii chihichihi; ka di be kaman buɣim ni di gali shɛm la.
en: When Samson arrived at Lehi, the Philistines met him and came out shouting. The LORDs spirit rushed over him, the ropes on his arms became like burned-up linen, and the ties melted right off his hands.

dag: Yinim ninsalinima, saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi kul yɛn dihiri ma vi? Saha yuusim wula puuni, ka yi kul yɛn yuri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka doli din nyɛ ʒiri?.
en: How long, you people, will my reputation be insulted? How long will you continue to love what is worthless and go after lies? Selah.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Ti Duuma, o yi gbihirimi dindina o ni nya alaafee.
en: The followers answered, But, Lord, if he can sleep, he will get well.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe di ni deei li su. Amaa bɛ daa bi deeg a noli bee n-dol a zaligunima. Bɛ daa bi niŋ a ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛl la. Dinzuɣu ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa.
en: But when they came into this land and took possession of it, they did not obey your commands or live according to your teaching; they did nothing that you had ordered them to do. And so you brought all this destruction on them.

dag: Ka Bɛrɛkia mini Ɛlikana daa nyɛ Alikauli Adaka duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: Berekiah and Elkanah were two of the guards for the Holy Box.

dag: Miriya ka yi muɣisi sana, dama yi mi sana suhu ni be shɛm, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Do not mistreat a foreigner; you know how it feels to be a foreigner, because you were foreigners in Egypt.

dag: Ti tum alahichi ka birigi, ka a bi chɛ ti taali.
en: We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!.

dag: Yawɛ di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa, amaa lee saami kpan shɛli din sa o zuɣusaa ŋɔ ka kpuɣ o ko gaɣili ŋɔ ka ti chaŋ.
en: But I pray that the Lord will keep me from harming his chosen king. Let's grab his spear and his water jar and get out of here.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli palo maa yuli, Ʒim Palo hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: This is why people still call that place Field of Blood.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuma ayopɔin saha ka Izraɛlnim shɛb mini Maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba gba daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Among the people who came with Ezra were Israelites, priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and Temple servants. They arrived in Jerusalem during the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

dag: Pita ni daa kul ʒiya tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛl o, Nyama, niriba ata kana ti bɔr a.
en: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, Three men are here looking for you.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka piɛlaa ŋun mali yil wɔɣila ayi ʒe mɔɣili maa noli. O yila maa zaɣ yini daa wɔɣimi gari yin la, ka nyɛ din bahindi nyaaŋa yina.
en: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa piligi tir o kpiɔŋ saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanɛdan din be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la.
en: The Spirit of the Lord began to work in Samson while he was in the city of Mahaneh Dan. That city is between the cities of Zorah and Eshtaol.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu mini suhugarigu ni nintam pam puuni ka n daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya, ka di daa pala n lomi ni n tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu, amaa n daa bɔrimi ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ n yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: I wrote you with a greatly troubled and distressed heart and with many tears; my purpose was not to make you sad, but to make you realize how much I love you all.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Mikal, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma lala n-chɛ ka n dim maa zo n-tiligi? Ka Mikal garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ; a yi bi chɛ ka n chaŋ n ni ku a. .
en: Why have you tricked me this way? Saul asked Michal. You helped my enemy get away! She answered, He said he would kill me if I didn't help him escape.

dag: O daa niŋ li wuhi ya ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The Lord has shown you this, to prove to you that he alone is God and that there is no other.

dag: Yi yi chana, yin yihimiya waazu yɛra, Alizanda nam mirina.
en: Go and preach, The Kingdom of heaven is near.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Ɛbiasaf ni Asir ni.
en: Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ maa ni ti kpe Maika yiŋa.
en: They went on from there and came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee. Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ ka kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: it says to itself, I will go back to my house. So it goes back and finds the house empty, clean, and all fixed up.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Jɔnatan, biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi. Ka n yi bi niŋ a lala, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma gari n ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm gba.
en: Saul said to him, May God strike me dead if you are not put to death.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara, ka zaŋ li da yaɣimɛr so palo ni bɛ mali saamba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: Then they had a meeting and decided to buy a field that belonged to someone who made clay pots. They wanted to use it as a graveyard for foreigners.

dag: Jafɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Goma mini Magɔg ni Madai ni Javan ni Tubal ni Mɛshɛk ni Tiras.
en: The sons of Japheth—Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras—were the ancestors of the peoples who bear their names.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuui pam, di simdi ni bɛ mali suhupiɛlli di yuma zaa puuni, amaa di simdi ni bɛ teei ni zibisim saha dabisa ni ti galisi pam. Dinkam zaa niŋdi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni, ka niŋ kɔpaɣirim niŋ di ni.
en: He put the washbasin between the Tent and the altar and filled it with water.

dag: Niriba pam beni n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra: Yawɛ, niŋm alibarika niŋ ti ni! Niŋm ti nirilim.
en: Many people say, I wish I could enjoy the good life. Lord , give us some of those blessings.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu somiya buri, ka kum ka fabili, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa na bi miligi ka chɛ ti.
en: The Lord is angry with us, so put on sackcloth and cry out loud!.

dag: dama bɛ daa pun deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, amaa ka na lee bi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: This was because the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen on any of them; they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka Dibɔn Mɔɣili kom daa deei ʒim mɔhi, amaa di zaa yoli, n ni niŋ Dibɔnnim din bie n-gari lala. Iin, gbuɣinli ni doli Mɔab ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim, ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la.
en: At the town of Dibon the river is red with blood, and God has something even worse in store for the people there. Yes, there will be a bloody slaughter of everyone left in Moab.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija.
en: The Lord told Elijah.

dag: Yɛm mali biɛhigu shee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛhi zilima tɛha ni, amaa di ka jɛra bɛn suhuri ni.
en: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o kpɛhi tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee ka bɛ ti fiɛb o n-vih o baŋ din chɛ ka niriba maa tahiri pampam o zuɣu maa.
en: the commander directed that Paul be taken into the military headquarters. He ordered that Paul be questioned under the whip so that he could find out why they were shouting at him like this.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ dansarika n ni tumdi n Duuma tuma la zuɣu kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali biɛhigu din doli Naawuni ni daa zali ya biɛhigu so shɛl o ni daa boli ya boligu shɛl la puuni.
en: So, as a prisoner for the Lord, I beg you to live the way Gods people should live, because he chose you to be his.

dag: Amaa chamiya ti yɛl o nyaandoliba mini Pita ni Yisa daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: Now go and tell his followers. And be sure to tell Peter. Tell them, Jesus is going into Galilee and will be there before you come. You will see him there, as he told you before.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, hal Anabi Musa daa wuhi di yɛla o ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni n-yɛli shɛm la puuni. O daa boli ti Duuma la, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: Moses clearly showed that people are raised from death. When Moses wrote about the burning bush, he said that the Lord is the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

dag: Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ni ti bɔ Izraɛlnim taali kɔŋ, ka Judanim daalahichi ti kpihim. Dama n ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ n ni tiligi shɛb la taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, if one searches for the sin of Israel, they will find nothing; if one seeks out the wrongdoing of Judah, they will look in vain. I will forgive those I have spared.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti ŋmaai bihili, ka o bo yuma ata naɣilaa mini zim din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pia ni wain gaɣili pali m-pahi bia maa zuɣu chaŋ Shilo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bia maa daa na nyɛla ŋun pɔra.
en: When he had been weaned and was still very young, Hannah took him, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a jar of wine, and brought him to the LORDs house at Shiloh.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ŋɔ, pa ninsal wuhibu ka o zaɣisi, amaa Naawuni ŋun ti ti o Shia Kasi la wuhibu ka o zaɣisi maa.
en: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.

dag: N suhu ni yuri so, yɛlim ma, Ya polo ka a zaŋd a piɛri chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri? Ya polo ka a chɛ ka bɛ dooni vuhiri wuntaŋ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka m be kaman paɣ so ŋun pa sariga dol a tab biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: Tell me, my love, Where will you lead your flock to graze? Where will they rest from the noonday sun? Why should I need to look for you among the flocks of the other shepherds?.

dag: Amaa nir yi zaŋ kurigu ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, bɛn kum o.
en: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: The ax is ready to cut down the trees at the roots; every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown in the fire.

dag: Di saha ka o ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa bi niŋ m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa bi niŋ maa.
en: The King will reply, I tell you, whenever you refused to help one of these least important ones, you refused to help me.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛli din nyuri sakom din luri di zuɣu waawaayili ka bindira zoori di ni n-leeri din mali buchi bɛ ni biri li shɛb zuɣu la sani, Naawuni niŋdi alibarika niŋdi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Some people are like land that gets plenty of rain and produces a good crop for those who farm it. That kind of land has Gods blessing.

dag: Ka o ti yih o fiɛɣu min o kɔbiri bahi sara maligu bimbini maa wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri la.
en: He will remove the birds tail and inner parts and throw them onto the pile of ashes east of the altar.

dag: Di sɔɣiya ka chɛ binnɛma zaa nina, di limsiya ka chɛ noombihi bɛn be zuɣusaa.
en: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.

dag: Ka o daa kahig o daashili zaa wuh o ka yɛl o, N nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani hal n ni daa na be m ma pul ni saha shɛli, ka piliŋ na ʒi n-shihi n zuɣu ni. Ka n yi pini, n kpiɔŋ maa ni yi n ni ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: So he told her his whole secret. He said to her, No razor has ever touched my head, because Ive been a nazirite for God from the time I was born. If my head is shaved, my strength will leave me, and Ill become weak. Ill be like every other person.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mal alaafee ka lan yuui dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: and you will have a long and happy life.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: So do not be afraid; you are worth much more than many sparrows!.

dag: Chɛ ka Mɔabnim nyu dam kuli bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ pam niŋ Yawɛ la zuɣu. Bɛ ni dɔni bɛmaŋmaŋ tiri ni bilim. Bɛ gba ni leei niriba ni yɛn lari shɛba.
en: The people of Moab thought they were greater than the Lord . So punish them until they act like a drunk, falling and rolling around in his vomit. Then people will make fun of them.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! N ni puhi Yawɛ ni n suhu zaa, o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yi ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: And you Israelites say, What the Lord does isn't right. You think my way isn't right, do you? It is your way that isn't right.

dag: N kul yɛla n noli vuhiri nyahigira, dama n suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: My desire to hear your commands is so strong that I wait with open mouth, gasping for breath.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi tumla alahichi paai Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He did what the Lord said was wrong, but he was not as bad as the kings of Israel who had ruled before him.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min o nam yil la, ka me o ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛlikam la naai nyaaŋa.
en: Now once Solomon finished building the LORDs temple, the royal palace, and everything else he wanted to accomplish.

dag: Di bi simdi ka maligumaana di biŋkɔb so bee noon so ŋun kpi o zuɣu bee biŋkɔbiri ni ku so. .
en: The priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or is killed by another animal.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini nimmaŋtali gbibi sokam zaa.
en: David was king over all Israel. He did what was right and fair for everyone.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kum kana, ka n ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka zaŋ ba labisina. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ doli kulibɔna din mali kom, ka doli soli din tuhi ka ku tuura. Dama n leela Izraɛlnim ba, ka Ifriim nyɛ m bi kpɛma.
en: My people will return weeping, praying as I lead them back. I will guide them to streams of water, on a smooth road where they will not stumble. I am like a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my oldest son.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N dabili Aizaia ni daa chaŋ o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa yuma ata la, di nyɛla din yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim mini Itiɔpianim shihirili.
en: When Ashdod was captured, the Lord said, My servant Isaiah has been going around naked and barefoot for three years. This is a sign of what will happen to Egypt and Ethiopia.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni so ku tooi yɛli ni n yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya.
en: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.

dag: Amaa Yisa nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o mali jilima pam gari Anabi Musa kaman ŋun me yili ni mali jilima gari o ni me yil shɛli maa shɛm la.
en: But he deserves greater glory than Moses in the same way that the builder of the house deserves more honor than the house itself.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa teei dɔni m puli zuɣu Yawɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi kaman n ni daa pun niŋ shɛm la, n daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom yi ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi yi tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu la.
en: Then I fell before the LORD as I had done the previous forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water, all because of the sin that you had committed by doing such evil in the LORDs sight, infuriating him.

dag: Yi zaŋ yimaŋ niŋ alaha n-chani ginda, ka taɣiri jɛmbu soya. Ijiptinim ni ti dihi ya vi kaman Asirianim ni daa dihi ya vi shɛm la.
en: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu ka kpabi yim zuɣu, ka di wɔɣilim ti nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: It is to be centimeters square and folded double.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ti o bɛ ni zaŋ fiig tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa mini wain wal kuma yila ayi. O ni daa di n-naai ka o nini neei, dama o daa bi di shɛli bee n-nyu kom wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ dabisi muna ata.
en: They also gave him a piece of fig cake and two raisin cakes. He ate and regained his strength because he hadnt eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and nights.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni labi n-neei Naa Dauda yili din daa lu la. N ni lan me o dabɔɣu maa zali.
en: I will return after this. I will build Davids house again. It has fallen down. I will build again the parts of his house that have been pulled down. I will make his house new.

dag: Masia ni daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima ti zuɣu la puuni ka ti baŋ yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli, ka di simdi ni ti gba zaŋ ti nyɛviya pa talima ti mabihi zuɣu.
en: This is how we know love: Jesus laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din pa salinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ takɔbi n-ku Asirianima. Bɛ ni ti yi tɔbu ni n-zo ni bɛ tiligi. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ nachimba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Assyria will be destroyed in war, but not by human power. The Assyrians will run from battle, and their young men will be made slaves.

dag: A tiligiri tarimba, ka pa nina lihiri karimbaannima ni a filim ba.
en: You rescue the humble, but you look for ways to put down the proud.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya n-daa pah ayi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa bela Juda zuliya tiŋgban ni.
en: Simeon was the second tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans was inside Judah's borders.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shihi o kɔbili min o niŋgbuŋ pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: But now suppose you hurt his body—he will curse you to your face.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kɔral bee kirisital la buɣisi li. Yɛm liɣiri gari yɛri liɣiri.
en: Coral and jasper shouldnt be mentioned; the price of wisdom is more than rubies.

dag: Aroa ka o daa piligi ba ŋmɛbu m-mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din daa baɣi Minnit la n-daa nyaŋ nimaani tinsi pisi zaa; ka daa lan zaŋ ba nimaani n-doli ba hal ni Ɛbɛlikɛramim n-daa ku ba kuri biɛɣu. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Ammɔnnim maa.
en: Jephthah and his army destroyed the towns between Aroer and Minnith, and others as far as Abel-Keramim. After that, the Ammonites could not invade Israel any more.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o binyɛrigu ti mɔhi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nɔri wain tiwala binyɛrigu la?.
en: Why is his clothing so red, like that of someone who tramples grapes to make wine.

dag: Bɛ ni kpi kaman piɛri la, ka kum ni nyɛ bɛ gula. Bɛ ni faai siɣi gbala ni yomyom; ka bɛ niŋgbuna pooi kpiimba biɛhigu shee din yɛn nyɛ bɛ yinsi la.
en: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di daa bi yuui ka Yisa chani tin shɛli din yuli booni Nain la; ka o nyaandoliba mini salo pam dol o.
en: Soon Jesus and his disciples were on their way to the town of Nain, and a big crowd was going along with them.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma? Nyama, n na ka bia, ka daɣila Ɛliɛza ŋun nyɛ Damaskus nir la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: But Abram answered, Sovereign Lord , what good will your reward do me, since I have no children? My only heir is Eliezer of Damascus.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna ku wum a yɛligu maa, ka di chɛ ka n daalahiziba tuma maa galisi pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh wont listen to you so that I can perform even more amazing acts in the land of Egypt.

dag: ka Naawuni nira Ilaisha sɔŋda Gɛhaazi yɛl o suhu ni, N dana fa Naaman ŋun nyɛ Siria nir ŋɔ bahi, o ni zaɣis o ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na nti ti o la zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kar o naba ti deei shɛli o sani.
en: Gehazi thought, My master let this Aramean Naaman off the hook by not accepting the gift he brought! As surely as the LORD lives, Ill go after him and accept something from him.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana, ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka bɛ yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He has a demon.

dag: Chɛ ka n wumd a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba kam; dama nyini ka n niŋ naani. N suhir a, wuhim ma n ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda.
en: Remind me each morning of your constant love, for I put my trust in you. My prayers go up to you; show me the way I should go.

dag: Ŋun daa ʒiya maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa jasipa ni kanɛlian la; ka sagani din ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli ɛmɛrald la booi gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: His face gleamed like such precious stones as jasper and carnelian, and all around the throne there was a rainbow the color of an emerald.

dag: Yawɛ yoog o bidibbina ni be luɣ shɛli n-yih o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina, dama ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ mali tuma ni o tum Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Lord has opened up his storeroom and brought out the weapons of his anger. The Lord GOD All-Powerful brought out those weapons, because he has work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

dag: ka Jɔnatan daa nyɛ Maluki daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ Shɛbania daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Malluchs family was Jonathan. The leader of Shecaniahs family was Joseph.

dag: Ka bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu kaman bɛ daŋ kam mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm daa nyɛla tɔbbihi bɔŋbɔŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu, dama bɛ daa mali paɣiba pam ni bidibisi.
en: They had so many wives and children that their descendants were able to provide , men for military duty.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yi o mabihi maa sani chaŋ Adulam nti be do so ŋun yuli daa booni Hira la sani.
en: About that time Judah left his brothers and went to stay with a man named Hirah, who was from the town of Adullam.

dag: Ka o daa kpabigi li n tooni, di daa sabila di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa. Ka sabbu din daa be di ni daa nyɛla fabila mini kuyila ni mbusim.
en: The hand unrolled the scroll open in front of me. Words were on the front and on the back of the scroll. There were all kinds of sad songs, sad stories, and warnings.

dag: Dama n nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka m mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. N ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka ni tooi yɛli n dabili mi ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: I, too, am a man under the authority of superior officers, and I have soldiers under me. I order this one, Go! and he goes; and I order that one, Come! and he comes; and I order my slave, Do this! and he does it.

dag: Ti daa chaŋmi ti ŋme Nɛgɛb din nyɛ Chɛrɛtinim tiŋ ka be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka di bɛ nɛma. Ka ti daa lan chaŋ ti ŋme Nɛgɛb shɛli din nyɛ Kalɛb daŋ niriba tiŋ la gba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka nyo Zikilag yiya zaa buɣim.
en: We had attacked some towns in the desert where the Cherethites live, in the area that belongs to Judah, and in the desert where the Caleb clan lives. And we burned down Ziklag.

dag: Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba kalinli ni zooi gari Lɛvinim kalinli kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata la zuɣu.
en: To rescue the remaining oldest Israelites over and above the number of Levites.

dag: ŋun daa chɛ o yidaan tuuli, ka tam o ni daa lo Naawuni alikauli shɛli yɛla la.
en: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.

dag: Tayiɣisi yi ka yi yinsi na bee ŋmɛnditoya yi kana yuŋ, pa bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko ka bɛ zura? Ka puri tumtumdib yi kana ni bɛ ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, bɛ ku chɛ binyiha bahi? Amaa yi dimnim bɛn ni kpimsi ya zaa!.
en: When thieves come at night, they take only what they want. When people gather grapes, they always leave a few. But your enemies have wiped you out completely.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn zaŋ noombihi nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋmila ŋmanʒiɛhi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi.
en: If you are offering a bird as a burnt offering, it must be a dove or a pigeon.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Zakaria, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka a paɣ Ɛlizabɛt ni niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a ti bol o yuli Jɔn.
en: But the angel said to him, Zechariah, dont be afraid. Your prayer has been heard by God. Your wife Elizabeth will give birth to a baby boy, and you will name him John.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kana ti zani sansani maa dunɔdali ni ka yɛli, Ŋunkam be Yawɛ polo, ŋun kam n sanna. Ka Lɛvi bidibisi zaa daa laɣimna ti zani gil o.
en: So he stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, Everyone who is on the Lord 's side come over here! So all the Levites gathered around him.

dag: Ifriimnim yɛliya, Aa, ti mali buni, ti bo buni zali timaŋa! Amaa bɛ buni maa zaa ku tooi yo bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa samli.
en: Ephraim has said, Im rich, Ive gained wealth for myself; in all of my gain no offense has been found in me that would be sin.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim naa ka o dol a zaligu kariti saria, ka zaŋ a wuntia ti naa bia.
en: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan lab teeku nol ni, ka salo maa zaa lan laɣimna nti gil o ka o wuhiri ba.
en: Jesus went to the lake again, and many people followed him there. So Jesus taught them.

dag: Ka n yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, n ni daa po pɔri ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and you will know that I, the Lord , am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.

dag: Yawɛ, a binnamda zaa ni paɣ a, ka a niriba bɛn zaa ʒe yim ni paɣ a.
en: All your creatures, Lord , will praise you, and all your people will give you thanks.

dag: di saha yin miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: dont become arrogant, forgetting the LORD your God: the one who rescued you from Egypt, from the house of slavery.

dag: Ka o daa baŋ li ka yɛli, M bia maa binyɛrigu m-bala; mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o maa. Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ o kul dari tɔhitɔhila Yisifu zaa.
en: Jacob knew it was Joseph's coat and said, It's my son's coat! Joseph has been torn to pieces and eaten by some wild animal.

dag: Ka so daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni m-bɔri ni bɛ nya a n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Someone told Jesus, Your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to talk with you.

dag: Dauda ni daa chaŋ Zikilag, ka Manaasa zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb zo n-chaŋ o sani n-daa nyɛ: Adina mini Jɔzabad ni Jɛdiayɛl ni Maikil ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlihu ni Zilɛtai bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi Manaasa zuliya niriba ni la.
en: These are the soldiers from Manasseh who went over to David's side when he was returning: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. In Manasseh they had all commanded units of a thousand men.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim di tiŋgbani maa ni di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bi yi daɣiri ni bee saa ni bi mi n-niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili dabisili dali.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that their country is full of sin, and that I, the Lord , am furious!.

dag: Dauda ni daa ku Filistia doo maa naai ka labina, ka Abinɛr daa zaŋ o chaŋ Sool sani, ka o na kul gbibi Filistia doo maa zuɣu la o nuu ni.
en: So when David came back from killing the Philistine, Abner sent for him and presented him to Saul. The Philistines head was still in Davids hand.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be vinvamli ni ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim ŋmaligimi guui, ka Sool min o bidibisi kpi, ka bɛ daa yi bɛ tinsi ni zo. Ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ti be di ni.
en: When the Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley heard that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and ran off. Then the Philistines came and occupied them.

dag: Ti ni zaŋ alikama din bi viɛli kɔhi shaara, ka zaŋ liɣiri da tarimba, ka zaŋ namda diba ayiyi n-taɣi nandaamba.
en: The poor cannot pay their loans, so we will buy them as slaves. We will buy those helpless people for the price of a pair of sandals. Oh, and we can sell the wheat that was spilled on the floor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Bɛ nya nanima anu la ka bɛ sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: It was reported to Joshua, The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.

dag: N duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni, n duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni ni o deei n suhigu.
en: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.

dag: Ka amiliya yilinim maa wain daa ti pooi ba, ka Yisa ma yɛl o, Bɛ lan ka wain din nyura.
en: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, They don't have any more wine.

dag: Amaa Hiram ni daa ti yi Taai kana ni o ti nya tin shɛŋa Sulemaana ni zaŋ ti o maa, o nini daa bi tiɣi li.
en: Hiram went from Tyre to inspect the towns Solomon had given him. They didnt seem adequate in his view.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa daa mali zim bihi biɛla pahi, ka o daa zaŋ di gba niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm li tari ba pahi.
en: They also had a few little fish, and after Jesus had blessed these, he told the disciples to pass them around.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrimia bia Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Habazinia yaaŋa la min o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni o bidibisi zaa ni Rɛkab daŋ niriba zaa na.
en: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, who was the son of Habazziniah. And I got all of Jaazaniahs brothers and sons and the whole family of the Recabites together.

dag: A yi gbib a noli min a zilinli, a ni yi yɛla ni.
en: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.

dag: O tiri nandaamba pina, ka tiri bɛn ka pina.
en: She reaches out to the needy; she stretches out her hands to the poor.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: Don't you know? he asked. No sir, I don't, was my answer.

dag: Ka salo bɛn be o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: The crowds in front of him and behind him shouted, Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa chaŋ Sukɔt ti yɛli ba, N-nyɛ Zɛba mini Zalimuna. Yi daa mɔŋ m mini n tɔbbi shɛb di ni daa wum pam la bindirigu, ka maani ma ansarisi yɛra, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna n-kpɛh a nuu ni, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu? .
en: When Gideon came to the city of Succoth, he said to the men of that city, Here are Zebah and Zalmunna. You made fun of me by saying, Why should we give food to your tired soldiers? You have not caught Zebah and Zalmunna yet.

dag: O daa diya ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ata. O ma daa nyɛla Absalom bia, ka o yuli booni Maaka.
en: He ruled for three years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Maacah, and she was Abishaloms daughter.

dag: ni Jɛhud ni Bɛnɛbɛrak ni Gatirimɔn.
en: Jehud, Beneberak, Gathrimmon.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ daa chɛ ka Asa suhu yiɣisi bahi anab maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o kpɛhi duu nti ga o zoligɔnim zali, dama yɛlli maa daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi anabi maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Asa daa gbaai niriba maa shɛb nahimbu.
en: Asa was angry with Hanani because of what he said. He was so mad that he put Hanani in prison. He was also very rough and cruel to some of the people then.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ zuliya la luya, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha! Bɛ chɛ ba sɔŋ tiŋa, ka so kani n-ni yiɣisi ba zali.
en: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wumbu, m poya, yili ŋɔ ni leei dabɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: But if you do not obey my commands, then I swear to you that this palace will fall into ruins. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb gba niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbiri pam bɛn nyɛ piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi n-doli ba chaŋ.
en: A great number of people who were not Israelites went with them, along with many sheep, cattle, and other livestock.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la yɛliya: N wum a kumsi maa, ka deeg a suhigu maa. N ni pah a yuun pinaanu.
en: Go and say to Hezekiah: The LORD, the God of your ancestor David, says this: I have heard your prayer and have seen your tears. I will add fifteen years to your life.

dag: Yi daa lan nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbibi ya shɛm tiŋgban nɛl la ni kaman nira ni buɣiri bia shɛm la, ka yi chaŋ na hal ti paai kpe.
en: and as you saw him do in the desert. Throughout your entire journey, until you reached this very place, the LORD your God has carried you just as a parent carries a child.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, ʒiɛnya dɛde ka di damdiya. Kul tummiya ti Duuma tuma ni yi kpiɔŋ zaa, yi ni mi ni yi tuma ku kpalim yoli ti Duuma ni la zuɣu.
en: So, my dear brothers and sisters, stand strong. Dont let anything change you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord. You know that your work in the Lord is never wasted.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun ti o niriba Izraɛlnim vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la; ka o yɛtɔɣ yini gba bi kɔŋ palibu kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o dabili Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: Praise the Lord ! He has kept his promise and given us peace. Every good thing he promised to his servant Moses has happened.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti vuui, amaa nyin kul ni kpalim be; di zaa ni kurigi kaman situra ni kurigiri shɛm la.
en: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.

dag: Wuntizɔra noli nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini. Amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni.
en: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.

dag: Ŋunkam nini nya ma ku lan nya ma yaha. A nina kul yɛn lihiri ma mi, ka n chaŋ.
en: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima din ni chɛ ka o ku tahi zibisim na, ka yi tuui zoya zuɣu wuntaŋ ni; yi yi ti bɔri neesim saha shɛli, o chɛrimi ka di niŋ zibisim titali, ka chɛ ka di niŋ bumbɔni.
en: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.

dag: Ti yaannim daa tum alahichi, bɛ lan kani, ka ti diri wahala bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Our ancestors sinned, but now they are gone, and we are suffering for their sins.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni nya alibarika pam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o nya buni yomyom ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: People who can be trusted will have many blessings, but those who are just trying to get rich in a hurry will be punished.

dag: Ka Baruk garigi yɛli ba, Ŋuna n-daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa, ka m mi zaŋ tadabo sab li niŋ gbaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Baruch answered, Jeremiah dictated every word of it to me, and I wrote it down in ink on this scroll.

dag: N ni ti ku binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri. Alɔbo titali nti yɛn lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: I will kill everything living in Jerusalem, both people and animals. They will die from a terrible disease that will spread all through the city.

dag: Bɛ lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a niriba polo; ka niŋdi tab saawara zaŋ chaŋ a ni guli a ninvuɣ shɛb la polo.
en: They are making secret plans against your people. Your enemies are discussing plans against the people you love.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm ni nimmoo, dama ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nyɛla ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu.
en: Take advantage of every opportunity because these are evil times.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi yi tum niriba gaŋbu tuun shɛli ashilɔni, o ni darigi yi tibili.
en: He will certainly correct you if youve been secretly partial.

dag: Amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na yirila o suhu ni na; dina n-nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: But what goes out of the mouth comes from the heart. And thats what contaminates a person in Gods sight.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin din pal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din bahindi nyaaŋ la ni yino daa ka n sanna ti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a Piɛbil la Daamiliya Paɣa.
en: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues spoke with me. Come, he said, I will show you the bride, the Lambs wife.

dag: A suhu yi ye bindirigu maa dibu zuɣu, nyin gbaam amaŋa.
en: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.

dag: N ku kuli n yiŋa bee n-dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: I wont enter my house, wont get into my bed.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa mi zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani nam ʒiishee, ka di biɛhigu ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛli safaya la. Ka binshɛli daa ʒi nam ʒiishee maa zuɣusaa, ka di kɔtomsi ŋmani daadam kɔtomsi.
en: Above the dome over their heads, there appeared something like lapis lazuli in the form of a throne. Above the form of the throne there was a form that looked like a human being.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa mali.
en: It will take the Israelites seven months to bury all the corpses and make the land clean again.

dag: ŋun pah ata gba kpuɣ o; lala ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi.
en: And the third brother married the woman, and he died. The same thing happened with all the other brothers. They all died and had no children.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋa n-leei yi zaa ha bia.
en: The greatest one among you must be your servant.

dag: Ka Shɛlɛmia bia Hanania mini Hanun ŋun daa nyɛ Zalaf bia ŋun pah ayɔbu la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam daa mali me o ni daa be luɣ shɛli la tooni.
en: Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun son of Zalaph repaired the rest of that section of wall. Meshullam son of Berekiah repaired the section in front of his house.

dag: dama Naawuni bi zaŋla shia ŋun ni chɛ ka ti zɔri dabiɛm ti ti, amaa shi so ŋun ni chɛ ka ti mali yiko mini yurilim ni maŋgbibbu ka o zaŋ ti ti.
en: For the Spirit that God has given us does not make us timid; instead, his Spirit fills us with power, love, and self-control.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ Sool min o tumtumda maa kpɛhi du tital ni nti ti ba ʒiishe gahinda bɛ ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa sani, niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pihita laasabu.
en: Then Samuel took Saul and his young servant and brought them to the banquet room. He gave them an honored place among the invited guests. There were about thirty total.

dag: Yihimiya tins ata zali Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli, ka yihi tins ata zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi.
en: three east of the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan.

dag: Bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa yinoyino baɣa kul bela bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka pa ni Yisa Masia yɛla ni.
en: Everyone else is concerned only with their own affairs, not with the cause of Jesus Christ.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Death is the punishment for cursing your father or mother.

dag: N zaŋmi m bɔrɔbɔro mini ko shɛli ni nim shɛli n ni ku n-zali bɛn chɛri m piɛri kɔbiri maa ti ninvuɣ shɛba n ni bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: Why should I take my bread, my water, and the meat Ive butchered for my shearers and give it to people who came here from who knows where.

dag: Yiɣisim a suhu zaa pam n-lihi bɛnkam mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba.
en: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa fan ya bahi, dinzuɣu ka n zaani ya zaligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God set you free; that is why I am now giving you this command.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali, ka di nyɛla din yɛligir o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, This is leprosy—you are unclean.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ zaa la Firawuna ninni, amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: That is why Moses and Aaron did all these great miracles in front of Pharaoh. And that is why the Lord made Pharaoh so stubborn that he would not let the Israelites leave his country.

dag: N gom shee ka n daa nya ti titali ʒii puuni ka di kul ʒe dunia sunsuuni.
en: In my mind, as I lay in bed, I saw a vision: At the center of the earth was a towering tree.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdisi mini di firilanima ni bɛ nyɔri li zaani luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: the lampstands and the lamps that burned in front of the most holy place.

dag: Ka a yi bahi a dabili ni o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka o chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—.

dag: O daa kul lu n-gbala o tooni ka yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka taali ŋɔ ʒi n kɔŋko zuɣu. N suhir a mi, gbilisim tibili wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: She fell at his feet and said, Put the blame on me, my master! But please let me, your servant, speak to you directly. Please listen to what your servant has to say.

dag: A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣim gil a maa zaa niŋmiya shili gu ka a leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: So keep your troops prepared to fight.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa, Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ di gbinni. Yi ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli.
en: Then the Lord said, Go and tell the people, Listen closely, but dont understand. Look closely, but dont learn.

dag: Chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana dol a fukumsi zaligunim min a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa, ka tumdi di tuma din ni chɛ ka o tooi me a jɛmbu du shɛli n ni pun bo nɛma zali ni di me ŋɔ.
en: And help my son Solomon be true to you. Help him always obey your commands, laws, and rules. Help Solomon do these things. And help him build this Temple that I have planned.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. A yi di saɣi, n naan ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini, Anabi Ilaija gba zaɣ yini.
en: So Peter said to him, Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim shɛli zaa na ti mali sara ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma luɣ kasi shee la tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tuhili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The people gave over a ton of gold as an offering to the Lord for his holy place.

dag: amaa o daa niŋla lala ni o kahigi wuhi pumpɔŋɔ ni omaŋmaŋ nyɛla ŋun ka taali, ka chɛ ka bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda gba yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani.
en: during the time of Gods patient tolerance. He also did this to demonstrate that he is righteous in the present time, and to treat the one who has faith in Jesus as righteous.

dag: Yawɛ bela n sani ni o sɔŋ ma. N ni di nasara bɛn je ma sani.
en: The Lord is my helper. I will see my enemies defeated.

dag: O daa lan mali salima firilatamdisi pia kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, diba anu nudirigu polo, diba anu din la mi nuzaa polo.
en: He made ten gold lampstands as prescribed and put them in the sanctuary, five on the south and five on the north.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa kul be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni hal ni dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa ti ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So Jeremiah stayed under guard in the courtyard of the guardhouse until the day Jerusalem was captured.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o tɔbbihi zaa Tɛlaim na nti kali ba, ka bɛ tinchandiba kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyi, ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Saul sent messengers who told every town and village to send men to join the army at Telaim. There were , troops in all, and , of these were from Judah. Saul organized them.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛr ayopɔin.
en: All the people ate until they were full. After this, the followers filled seven baskets with the pieces of food that were not eaten.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia gbarigimi n ni, ka n yihi tahima n suhu ni.
en: So I am ready to give up; I am in deep despair.

dag: A ni ti bahi yɛmbahiga, dama tahima beni; Naawuni ni ti gul a, ka a vuhiri ka barina kani.
en: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.

dag: Ti tum alahichi ka birigi, ka a bi chɛ ti taali.
en: We are the ones who did wrong; we rebelled. But you, God, have not forgiven.

dag: Di saha maa Babilɔn Naa tɔbbihi daa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa kpari anabi Jɛrimia niŋ guliba dundɔŋ din daa be Juda nayili la ni.
en: At that time the army of the king of Babylonia was attacking Jerusalem, and I was locked up in the courtyard of the royal palace.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Aai, a paɣ Zara ni dɔɣi bidibiga ti a, ka a bol o yuli Yisahaku. Ka n ni lo a min o zuliya alikauli shɛli din ni be sahakam.
en: But God said, No, your wife Sarah will give birth to a son for you, and you will name him Isaac. I will set up my covenant with him and with his descendants after him as an enduring covenant.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni bitali maa mi bi yila ninsalinim ni dɔɣi ba la ni na bee n-yi ninsalinim yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni yubu ni ka di yina.
en: They became Gods children, but not in the way babies are usually born. It was not because of any human desire or plan. They were born from God himself.

dag: Bɛ kali ma pahila kpiimba ni; n ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka sɔŋsim.
en: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi bɛ zuɣu, ka ti Duuma jilima neesim neei gil ba ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam.
en: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord was shining around them. The shepherds were very afraid.

dag: Naawuni pin gahindi shɛl o ni daa ti ma o yiko puuni la zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ma leei lahibal suŋ la tumtumda.
en: I became a servant of the gospel because of the grace that God showed me through the exercise of his power.

dag: O ni ŋma ba luhi kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi kpaŋa ŋ-ŋmari tibɔŋ ni tihi luhiri shɛm la, ka di lu kaman Lɛbanɔn ti suma ni luri shɛm la.
en: He will strike down the forest thickets with an ax, and mighty Lebanon will fall.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yaannim ni daa zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdi buɣa ka lan zaɣisi n zaligu dolibu la zuɣu.
en: Then tell them that the Lord has said, Your ancestors turned away from me and worshiped and served other gods. They abandoned me and did not obey my teachings.

dag: dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nanda.
en: Nothing is impossible for God.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Zakaria di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam died and was buried with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. Jeroboams son Zechariah became the new king after him.

dag: Alibarika pipi shɛli ti ni niŋd alibarika niŋdi di ni la, di pala Masia ʒim ka ti laɣindi nyura? Ka bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti ni ŋmahiri la, di pala Masia niŋgbuŋ ka ti laɣindi ŋubiri maa?.
en: Isnt the cup of blessing that we bless a sharing in the blood of Christ? Isnt the loaf of bread that we break a sharing in the body of Christ?.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim lala, dama yi tuumbiɛri galisiya pam. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛkaali, bɛ ni ti ku Izraɛlnim naa.
en: It will indeed happen to you, Bethel, because of your great wickedness. At dawn, the king of Israel will be cut off completely.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima mali bans ayi niŋ di yaɣ ayi zuɣu salima din kɔɣili li gili la lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba ni bɛ zaŋdi dapuhi la turi di ni n-kpuɣiri bimbini maa.
en: He made two gold rings, and he attached them under the molding on two opposite sides of the altar. They housed the poles used to carry it.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo n-chaŋ Gɛshur Naa Ammihud bia Talimai sani. Ka Naa Dauda daa kul kumd o bia Amnɔn zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: Absalom fled and went to the king of Geshur, Talmai son of Ammihud, and stayed there three years. David mourned a long time for his son Amnon;.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din ni miligi Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bee Naawuni cheechinim suhuri.
en: Never do anything that might make other people do wrong—Jews, non-Jews, or anyone in Gods church.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl bituuli ŋun yuli daa booni Rubin la daa dɔɣi bidibis anahi; Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya ni kpamba.
en: These are the names of the leaders of the families of Israel: Israels first son, Reuben, had four sons. They were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: N daa zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi ni yuri n-kana ti ku ba. N daa ŋme ba luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu. N daa pɔbisi ba mi bahi kaman bɛ ni pɔbisiri kpihiri firila mia buɣim shɛm la.
en: who brings out chariot and horse, army and battalion; they will lie down together and will not rise; they will be extinguished, extinguished like a wick.

dag: Bɛ ninani biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛba anahi maa daa malila ninsal ninni bɛ tooni polo, ka gbuɣinli ninni be bɛ nudiriti polo, ka naɣilaa ninni be bɛ nuzaa polo, ka lan mali tɔrili ninni bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: Each living being had four faces. In the front they each had a mans face. There was a lions face on the right side and a bulls face on the left side. There was an eagles face on the back.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaɣisi Naawuni, ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, A ku kari ti saria di zuɣu.
en: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, God won't punish us.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bundaannima bɛ gom saha, amaa bɛ yi ti neei, bɛ ku lan mali shɛli.
en: One last time they will lie down rich, and when they wake up, they will find their wealth gone.

dag: Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni yɛra, N Duuma, Naawuni tiligim ti! Di ku niŋ a lala.
en: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, God would never let this happen to you, Lord.

dag: Amaa ka namɔɣilisi maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Napaɣ Vashiti naa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o daa zaɣisi ni o ku kana. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa maa suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: But when the servants told Queen Vashti of the king's command, she refused to come. This made the king furious.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli puuni Ishimail ni daa zaŋ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa niŋ maa daa nyɛla kɔbil titali shɛli Naa Asa ni daa gbi n-gu omaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛl Naa Baasha la. Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ti pali kɔbiliga maa.
en: The well that he filled with bodies had been dug by King Asa of Judah to store rainwater, because he was afraid that King Baasha of Israel might surround Mizpah and keep the people from getting to their water supply.

dag: Amaa dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam, ka so daa yi ʒe luɣ kasi shee maa ka lihi, o ni tooi nya di nyoya ni. Amaa so daa yi zani samban ni, o ku tooi nya li. Di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The ends of the poles could be seen by anyone standing directly in front of the Most Holy Place, but from nowhere else.

dag: ka n naanyi chaŋ ka ku lan labi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa mini zibisim titali ŋɔ ni na.
en: I am going soon and will never come back— going to a land that is dark and gloomy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Mara nti kɔŋ di kom nyubu, dama di daa tomi, di zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Mara.
en: Then they came to Marah. There was water at Marah, but it was too bitter to drink.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n diri wahala ŋɔ. Amaa vi bi mali ma, dama m mi n ni niŋ so yɛda, ka mi ni o ni tooi gbibi n ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ o nuu ni la hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ dol o hal ka o ti saɣi. O yɛtɔɣ nyaɣisa maa ka o daa zaŋ gbaag o.
en: This is what the woman said to tempt the young man, and her smooth words tricked him.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mi daa bo alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini kpa viɛlli lita tuhi kɔbisinahi n-ti Hiram min o yiŋnima. Lala ka Sulemaana daa kul niŋdi tiri Hiram yuuni kam.
en: Solomon gave Hiram about , bushels of wheat and about , gallons of pure olive oil every year for his family.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti tim Adɔniram ŋun daa su tuma fukumsi la Izraɛlnim sani, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lab o kuɣa ku. Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa yiɣisi n-niŋ yomyom kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-zo kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoniram, who was in charge of the forced labor, to go to the Israelites, but they stoned him to death. At this, Rehoboam hurriedly got in his chariot and escaped to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yisifu kɔba m-mali chaŋ kaman ŋun Yisifu ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm la. Dama Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Naawuni yi ti ka yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti tiligi ya, ka yi yɛn chaŋ, yin zaŋmiya n kɔba mali chaŋ.
en: Moses carried the bones of Joseph with him. Before Joseph died, he made the Israelites promise to do this for him. He said, When God saves you, remember to carry my bones with you out of Egypt.

dag: Amaa Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la n-daa nyɛ bɛn naɣi bi kpi.
en: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh were among the men who were sent out to explore the land. They are the only ones who did not get the sickness that caused the others to die.

dag: N ni be Izraɛlnim sani kaman maligim la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom la. Bɛ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman nyoo la.
en: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily; he will cast out his roots like the forests of Lebanon.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni tam pagɔr so yɛla ŋɔ, kpuɣim a mɔɣilo chaŋ gili tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛm biŋkumda ka di nyaɣisa, ka yili yila pam ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan teeg a yɛla.
en: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa yila Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o niriba daa ku ba.
en: David and his soldiers killed these three men from Gath who were descendants of the Rephaim.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma. Yawɛ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma.
en: Favor me, LORD, and deliver me! LORD, come quickly and help me!.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Ilaisha daa bol anab bil so na nti yɛl o, Malim shili n-zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu ŋɔ gbib a nuu ni chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: Meanwhile the prophet Elisha called one of the young prophets and said to him, Get ready and go to Ramoth in Gilead. Take this jar of olive oil with you.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka bɛ daa doli ka tiri bɛ suɣa doona, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu yiɣisiri chana. Bɛ daa dolila Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Musa zali ba zaligu shɛli n-tumdi Yawɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: They set up camp and broke camp in obedience to the commands which the Lord gave through Moses.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka niriba booni ya bɛ duumanima, dama Duuma yino kɔŋko ka yi mali, ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia.
en: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ŋmanila azichi wain ti shɛli din wali wala. Bɛ zuliya ni kul galisiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul mɛri maligu bimbina pahira. Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ dariza ni kul pahiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul pahiri bɛ ni jɛmdi binwɔɣil shɛŋa la gba dariza.
en: Israel is like a vine that grows plenty of fruit. But as Israel got more and more things, he built more and more altars to honor false gods. His land became better and better, so he put up better and better stones to honor false gods.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam n niŋgbuŋ luɣilikam zaa; nyini n-daa zaŋ ma tuɣi taba m ma pul ni.
en: You formed the way I think and feel. You put me together in my mothers womb.

dag: Ti chandi maa daa muɣisi ti, amaa ka ti kul mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Fɛɛhavɛns, ka di miri Lasia la.
en: We sailed along the coast, but the sailing was hard. Then we came to a place called Safe Harbors, near the city of Lasea.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi ka wum ka tɔrili be zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbusim, mbusim, mbusim be dunianim zuɣu, malaikanima ata shɛb bɛn kpalim n-na yɛn piɛb bɛ kikahi la zuɣu.
en: Then I looked and I heard an eagle flying high overhead. It said with a loud voice, Horror, horror, oh! The horror for those who live on earth because of the blasts of the remaining trumpets that the three angels are about to blow.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa boli dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi maa ni niriba, ka nyɛ o ni daa pun pii shɛb zuliya yini kam ni la na.
en: So Joshua chose one man from each tribe. Then he called the twelve men together.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋari ma ka sɔɣi zo, ka bi yɛli ma. N naan chɛbis a ni suhupiɛlli, ka ŋme goonjɛnim ka chaɣisi sayɛya ka yili yila niŋ a.
en: Why did you deceive me and slip away without telling me? If you had told me, I would have sent you on your way with rejoicing and singing to the music of tambourines and harps.

dag: Rɛkab Jɔnadab bihi maa doli bɛ yabidoo maa ni zali ba shɛm, amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn bi deei n noli.
en: The descendants of Jonadab, Rechabs son, have thoroughly obeyed their ancestor, but this people have not listened to me.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla, ka dunia ŋɔ nim wumdi tiri ba.
en: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri ti tab maa m-bɔŋɔ. Dina ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ li ti zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la.
en: Then Moses told the people, You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii pam dindali maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa daa do n-dalim chɛchɛbuŋ maa puuni, ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo hal ni zaawuni, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka o kpi.
en: The armies continued fighting all that day. King Ahab leaned against the side of his chariot to hold himself up, facing the Arameans. He watched until evening. Then, just as the sun was setting, he died.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba ni bɛ su li. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God took away their land. God's love never fails.

dag: Amaa nyin min a niriba ŋɔ na bi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: But I know that you and your officials do not yet fear the Lord God.

dag: ka yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam, Piim di ni zaɣ tolima pia, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyama, n dari tɔhila Izraɛl nam Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: He said to Jeroboam, Take ten pieces, because Israels God, the LORD, has said, Look, I am about to tear the kingdom from Solomons hand. I will give you ten tribes.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa sani maa daa daai goon shɛŋa din zaa daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la luhi.
en: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.

dag: M pun nya ka binshɛɣukam zaa viɛlim malila tariga, amaa a zaligunim din viɛlim nyɛla din ka tariga.
en: Nothing is completely perfect, except your teachings.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, N ni jɛmdi Yawɛ so ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di yi di pala n ni ti Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat jilima zuɣu, n naan ku ŋmaligi lih a bee nti nya a.
en: Elisha said to him, I serve the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as he lives, I swear I wouldn't even look at you if I didn't respect King Jehoshaphat.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti o na ka o zaŋ o dɔni, Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa.
en: So David sent messengers to take her. When she came to him, he had sex with her. Then she returned home.

dag: Yɛm viɛla, ka ŋmanila fali, ka niŋdi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni anfaani.
en: Wisdom is better if you also have property. Wise people will get more than enough wealth.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi ti paai ti, kaman tibidarigibo tɔbu bee alɔbo bee fifali, ka ti ka a duu ŋɔ gbin na nti zani a tooni n-fabili niŋ a ti muɣisigu saha a ni wum ti fabila maa ka tiligi ti dama a be duu ŋɔ ni. .
en: They said, If trouble comes to us—the sword, punishment, sicknesses, or famine—we will stand in front of this Temple and in front of you. Your name is on this Temple. We will shout to you when we are in trouble. Then you will hear and save us.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus called together his twelve disciples. He gave them the power to force out evil spirits and to heal every kind of disease and sickness.

dag: Amaa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba maa daa lee bi kari Keenannim bɛn daa be Gɛza, dina n-chɛ ka Keenannim mini Ifriim zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be hal ni zuŋɔ; amaa ka bɛ lee chɛ ka Keenannim maa tumdi dabitim tuma tiri ba.
en: But the Ephraimites were not able to force the Canaanites to leave the town of Gezer. So the Canaanites still live among the Ephraimites today, although they did become slaves of the Ephraimites.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa siɣi tiŋgban kuŋ ni du, ka kom maa daa kul pirigi ʒiɛya kaman goma la bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: But the Israelites crossed the sea on dry land. The water was like a wall on their right and on their left.
