dag: Zuliya kam, yi zaa wummiya! Dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, wummiya! Chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ka be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ŋɔ ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Listen, all you peoples! Pay attention, earth, and all that fills it! May the LORD God be a witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

dag: Ka di daa kpaŋsi nimaani yɛdaniŋdib suhuri, ka niriba kul pahiri bɛ zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and every day their numbers flourished.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: Because he is praiseworthy, I cried out to the LORD, and I was saved from my enemies.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka nanim diri nam. Mani n-sɔŋdi zuɣulaannim ka bɛ zaani zaligu shɛŋa din doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: With my help kings rule, and governors make good laws.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka nyɛ na titali ŋun gari wuna zaa.
en: For the Lord is a mighty God, a mighty king over all the gods.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔra daa laɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa taai duŋ maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Korah gathered the entire community with them to the entrance of the meeting tent. Then the LORDs glory appeared to the entire community.

dag: Ti ni yɛri shɛli maa yɛlikpani m-bɔŋɔ: Ti mali maligumaani titali ŋɔ tatabo ka o ʒi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa nam ʒiishee nudirigu polo alizanda ni.
en: Now the main point of what we are saying is this: We have this kind of high priest. He sat down at the right side of the throne of the majesty in the heavens.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa gbaai mɔɣili du ni o ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ daa shiri zaŋ ba niŋ o nuu ni.
en: So Jephthah crossed the river to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave him victory.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yɛli ya n ni yɛn niŋ n tihi puu maa shɛm. N ni sibigi di gariche bahi, ka wurim gooni din gil li, ka chɛ ka binsaɣinda kana ti saɣim li, ka daai li luhi.
en: Here is what I am going to do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge around it, break down the wall that protects it, and let wild animals eat it and trample it down.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ, amaa ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalindi Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: Anyone who says something against the Son of Man can be forgiven; but whoever says something against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven—now or ever.

dag: Di saha ka yɔɣ ni tihi zaa ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni; dama o kamina ni o ti kari dunia saria.
en: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord . He is coming to judge all people on earth.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be o sani zaa ŋmaligi guui n-niŋ kaman Ainim nyaŋ ba mi la n-zo n-kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: Joshua and his men pretended that they were retreating, and ran away toward the barren country.

dag: Ka o bia maa yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani; hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba.
en: The son said, Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you. I am no longer good enough to be called your son.

dag: Dama Naawuni ŋun daa yɛli ni neesim neem zibisim ni la, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka o neesim neei ti suhuri ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ Naawuni jilima neesim din neeri yiri Masia ninni na la.
en: God said that light should shine out of the darkness. He is the same one who shone in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of Gods glory in the face of Jesus Christ.

dag: Lom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ alikauli ni a ni gbib ma viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka karimbaannim nahim ma.
en: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ jintɔriba la daa laɣim n-zaŋ Yisa tahi bɛ jina tɔbu shee ti yɛl o.
en: The next morning, the older leaders of the people, the leading priests, and the teachers of the law came together. They led Jesus away to their high council.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni sariakaribo din tuhi shihira, ka di wuhiri ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi ŋun Naawuni nam shɛli zuɣu yi ni diri wahala ŋɔ ni kpɛbu.
en: This shows that Gods judgment is right, and that you will be considered worthy of Gods kingdom for which you are suffering.

dag: Yawɛ shia ni ti siɣ o zuɣu na nti ti o yɛm mini baŋsim, ka ti o yiko mini saɣisigu ni baŋsim mini Naawuni zɔbo.
en: The spirit of the Lord will give him wisdom and the knowledge and skill to rule his people. He will know the Lord 's will and honor him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛba n-yi Ijipti na, bɛ kul yɛrigila luɣ shɛlikam; kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma; di pa shɛli ka n tooi tuhi nyaŋ ba ka kari ba. .
en: This is the message: A new nation of people has come out of Egypt. There are so many people that they cover the land. So come and curse these people. Then maybe I will be able to fight them and force them to leave my land.

dag: Niaria bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɔnai mini Hizikia ni Azirikam, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni saria karibu shee kpamba ni Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm kpamba ni nuhi tuumbaŋdiba ni machɛlinim ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm la nyaaŋa.
en: I wrote it after King Jehoiachin, his mother, the palace officials, the leaders of Judah and of Jerusalem, the engravers, and the skilled workers had been taken into exile.

dag: A ni bi mi vuhim ni kpɛri bia kɔba ni o ma puuni shɛm, lala ka a ku tooi baŋ Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa ŋɔ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Just as you dont understand what the life-breath does in the fetus inside a pregnant womans womb, so you cant understand the work of God, who makes everything happen.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ liɣiri paŋ n niriba bɛn be yi ni ŋɔ nandaan so, yin di zaŋ yimaŋ leeg o sandihiriba, yi mi miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri di zuɣu.
en: If you loan money to any of my people, that is, the poor among you, dont be like a moneylender and charge them interest.

dag: Di simdi ka yi lo biŋkɔbigu maa zali hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, dindali zaawuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni ti kɔri bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: Each family must take care of its animal until the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, when the animals are to be killed.

dag: Amaa Naawuni so be alizanda ni ka nyɛ ŋun kahigiri ashiya gbinni wuhiri niriba. Dina n-chɛ ka o kahigi yɛl shɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha n-wuhi nyin Naa Nɛbukadnɛza. N ni yɛl a a zahindi maa min a ni daa nya ʒii shɛli a gom puuni maa.
en: But there is a God in heaven, a revealer of mysteries, who has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the days to come! Now this was your dream—this was the vision in your head as you lay in your bed.

dag: Amaa lahaba shɛli din ti yɛn yi wulimpuhili mini nuzaa polo na ni ti kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka o yiɣis o suhu n-tuhi ku niriba pam.
en: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.

dag: Dama nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri guri bɛ tɔbiri n-zaŋ bɛ piɛma pa tɔbimii zuɣu n-kpuɣi tiri ni bɛ to ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi zibisim ni.
en: Like hunters, the wicked hide in the dark. They get their bows ready and aim their arrows. They shoot at good, honest people.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Iso ka o mini ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi kanna. Ka o daa pirigi bihi ti Liya mini Reechɛl ni dabipaɣiba ayi la.
en: Jacob saw Esau coming with his four hundred men, so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two concubines.

dag: Ka yi ni pam ni daa naai noli n-darig o tibili shɛm la saɣ lala.
en: The punishment that most of your group gave him is enough for him.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita nini daa neei ka o yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o malaika na ka o ti fa ma Naa Hɛrɔd mini Yɛhudianim zaa ni lɔri nia ni bɛ niŋ ma bɛ ni yu shɛm la nuu ni bahi.
en: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.

dag: Hal malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil mini Sintani ni daa mali taba Anabi Musa niŋgbuŋ zuɣu la, o daa bi saɣi tu Sintani; o daa naɣ yɛlimi, Ti Duuma ni bɔh a.
en: Not even the archangel Michael did this. Michael argued with the devil about who would have the body of Moses. But Michael did not dare to condemn even the devil for his false accusations. Instead, Michael said, The Lord punish you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi chana, ka dabiɛm gbaai tiŋ shɛŋa din daa gili ba nim pam, ka bɛ daa bi kari doli Yaakubu bihi maa.
en: While Jacob and his family were traveling through Canaan, God terrified the people in the towns so much that no one dared bother them.

dag: Marɔtinim kul guhirimi, ka bɛ suhuri ye zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu pun yi Yawɛ sani siɣi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdal ni na.
en: How she longs for good, inhabitants of Maroth! Calamity has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ ni ninsalinim zaa baŋ Yawɛ yiko ni galisi shɛm. Ka di chɛ ka yi lu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura sahakam.
en: The Lord did this so that all the people in this country would know that he is very powerful. Then they will always be afraid of the Lord your God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni kabi naɣikɔra dapua o nyiŋgoli zuɣu bahi, ka kabisi o bandi maa, ka tinzunnim ku lan zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: The Lord Almighty says, When that day comes, I will break the yoke that is around their neck and remove their chains, and they will no longer be the slaves of foreigners.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu bee n-doli alahichinim biɛhigu bee n-doli ansarisi maaniba biɛhigu mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those who reject the advice of evil people, who do not follow the example of sinners or join those who have no use for God.

dag: Sintani ni daa zahim Yisa zahimbu balibu kam ŋɔ zaa naai ka o daa na chɛ o, ka lan bɔri so shɛli yaha.
en: When the Devil finished tempting Jesus in every way, he left him for a while.

dag: N nyar alibarika a zaligunim maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: I find my happiness in obeying your commands.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi.
en: Once there were seven brothers; the oldest got married and died without having children.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun yɛli, N ni me mmaŋmaŋ yili titali, ka me zuɣusaa du kara, ka niŋ takɔriti niŋ li, ka zaŋ sida dari pa di zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ piɛnta ʒee piɛnti li.
en: Doomed is the one who says, I will build myself a mansion with spacious rooms upstairs. So he puts windows in his house, panels it with cedar, and paints it red.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o Shia Kasi tin ya ka tumd alahiziba tuma yi san la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o niŋdi lala maa?.
en: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa piligi ŋ-ŋmaari Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ bahira. Hazaɛl daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be bɛ tintarisi tinsi la ni zaa.
en: In those days the LORD began to reduce Israels size. Hazael struck them down in every region of Israel.

dag: Wain nyɛla ansarisimaana, ka dam din kpɛma mi nyɛ vuyɔra, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka di kpɛh o yɔɣu nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm.
en: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.

dag: Ka Gɛza naa Hɔram daa kana ti sɔŋ Lakishinim maa, amaa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku o min o tɔbbihi zaa hal ka bɛ ni so bi tiligi.
en: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vooi li kpɛhi di puuni; ka bo mihi lo ŋarin titali maa gba kiŋkiŋ. Bɛ ni daa zɔri ni bɛ ti chaŋ ti firi Libia kulinol bihigu ni zuɣu ka bɛ daa sirigi tanti din sɔŋdi ŋariŋ maa ka di chanila lo tiŋli, ka pɔhim daa ʒiɛri ti chana.
en: They pulled it aboard and then fastened some ropes tight around the ship. They were afraid that they might run into the sandbanks off the coast of Libya, so they lowered the sail and let the ship be carried by the wind.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi, ka bɛ ŋmaag o bihili, ka Ibrahimma daa puhi chuɣu dahin shɛli Yisahaku ni daa ŋmaai bihili maa.
en: Isaac continued to grow, and soon he was old enough to begin eating solid food. So Abraham gave a big party.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba maa ni daa yi bɛ tantinim ni na chani ni bɛ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa daa gari bɛ tooni chana.
en: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni din kɔŋ jilima, ka neeri ni jilima. Di sɔɣirimi ni chɔɣinsi, ka neeri ni yiko.
en: These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong.

dag: ni Bazilit daŋ niriba ni Mɛhida daŋ niriba ni Harisha daŋ niriba.
en: Bazlith, Mehida, Harsha.

dag: Ka salo zaa daa kpalim samban ni suhiri Naawuni tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu saha.
en: All the people who gathered to worship were praying outside during this hour of incense offering.

dag: N ni ti be Izraɛlnim sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will be at home among the Israelites, and I will be their God.

dag: Ka Hanna daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, Naawuni ti ma suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka n nya kpiɔŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani. N larila n dimnima, dama m mali suhupiɛlli n nasara dibu puuni.
en: Hannah prayed: You make me strong and happy, Lord . You rescued me. Now I can be glad and laugh at my enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Gazanim ni Samsin be nimaani, ka bɛ laɣimna ti teei gil o ni be shɛli maa, ka chaŋ ti gu o tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa kul fomi chichi dindali maa yuŋ maa, ka yɛra Ti ni do n-gul o hal ka biɛɣu ti neei ka ti ku o.
en: The word spread among the people of Gaza, Samson has come here! So they circled around and waited in ambush for him all night at the city gate. They kept quiet all night long, thinking, Well kill him at the first light in the morning.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa bɔri ni n laɣim n niriba, amaa ka bɛ daa ŋmanila wain tia din ka wala bee fiig tia din ka wala, hal bɛ ŋmanila tia din vari suui. N ni daa zaŋ binshɛli ti ba la faaya ka chɛ ba.
en: I will take away their fruit and crops so that there will be no harvest, says the Lord . There will be no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig tree. Even the leaves will become dry and die. I will take away the things I gave them.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ kuɣili ŋɔ sa luɣ shɛli ŋɔ ni leei nyin Naawuni yiŋa, ka a yi ti ma binshɛlikam zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni yihi di bini pia kam ni zaɣ yini ti a.
en: This memorial stone which I have set up will be the place where you are worshiped, and I will give you a tenth of everything you give me.

dag: Bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka kaɣi ʒe kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Bɛ bi zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ tuhi nintɔri n tooni.
en: They hate me and stay far away from me, except when they come to spit in my face!.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋun taali tumbu zuɣu n-lee chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ ti paai ti ŋɔ? Yɛlim ti! Tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda? Tiŋkani ka a lee yina? Ka zuliya bɔ n-lee nyɛ a.
en: So they said to him, Tell us, since youre the cause of this evil happening to us: What do you do and where are you from? Whats your country and of what people are you.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nyɛ ti naa? Bee a shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn su ti fukumsi? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani daa maan pahi, o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa maa min o yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: His brothers asked, Do you really think you are going to be king and rule over us? Now they hated Joseph more than ever because of what he had said about his dream.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord also told Moses.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ku zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara ti Yawɛ, dindina doo maa ŋun zaŋm biŋkɔbigu maa chaŋ maligumaana sani.
en: If the solemn promise involves any kind of unclean animal that cannot be offered to the LORD, the promise maker must set the animal before the priest.

dag: Zaŋmi n talima ni nyɛ shɛli zal a sani. Ŋuni n-lee beni ŋun ni zani n nyaaŋa?.
en: Take my guarantee. Who else is willing to make an agreement?.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino kpiŋkpan yini wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni chɛrubi kpiŋkpan yini nyol ni zaŋ ti kpa o kpiŋkpan din la nyol ni wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: The wings of the first winged creature were each seven and a half feet long. It was fifteen feet from the end of one wing to the end of the other.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim maa vie bɛ dunɔpaɣira mini bɛ dunoya zuɣusahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋubi nimdi maa.
en: They should take some of the blood and smear it on the two doorposts and on the beam over the door of the houses in which they are eating.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Failimɔn ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpe so ti ni yuri la.
en: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you.

dag: To, Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni be vinvama ni la zuɣu, biɛɣuni, sa ŋmaligimiya kpe mɔɣu n-doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valley, tomorrow turn and march into the desert by the route of the Reed Sea.

dag: Niŋmi lala pɔi ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni neesim naanyi zibigi, ka sagbana chɛ ka saa luna.
en: before the sun and the light grow dark, the moon and the stars too, before the clouds return after the rain.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labisir o mi na ni n ti ti a, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni n zaŋla n suhu m-pah o zuɣu ti a.
en: Im sending him back to you, which is like sending you my own heart.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni gbiri binyara ŋubira;.
en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the hillside.

dag: Asiba kam, n ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. N ni yihi tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa Yawɛ tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord .

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Ti dan Yisa, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: and shouted, Jesus! Master! Have pity on us.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa bɔri daliri shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisi luhi Yisa ka ku o, amaa ka daa lee bi nya di daliri.
en: The leading priests and the whole high council tried to find something that Jesus had done wrong so they could kill him. But the council could find no proof that would allow them to kill Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir maa daa wum Izraɛl naa ni darigi toog o binyɛrigu shɛm maa yɛla, ka tim ti bɔhi naa maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a darigi toog a binyɛrigu? Chɛ ka doo maa ka n sanna nti baŋ ni anabi be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Elisha, the man of God, heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes. So Elisha sent this message to the king: Why did you tear your clothes? Let Naaman come to me. Then he will know there is a prophet in Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Maika yiŋ maa chaŋ ha, ka Maika daa kuhi bol o ʒiʒiinitaba n-chɛ ka bɛ pah o zuɣu ka bɛ kari Dan zuliya niriba maa naba.
en: They had traveled a good distance from the house when Micah called his neighbors out for battle. They caught up with the Danites.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba ŋɔ zaa daa malila shili doli taba kaman bɛ ni chani tɔb tuhibu shɛm n-ka Hiburɔn na ni suhuyini, ka bɛ nia daa nyɛla bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa; lala ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa yu ni bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei bɛ naa.
en: All these soldiers, ready for battle, went to Hebron, determined to make David king over all Israel. All the rest of the people of Israel were united in the same purpose.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni ti ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day she will take two turtledoves or two pigeons and bring them to the priest at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yi ti mabihi gari kɔbisinu zuɣu yim, ka bɛ ni pam na be bɛ nyɛviya ni hal ni pɔŋɔ, ka bɛ ni biɛla mi gbihiri kum ni.
en: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo, o ʒiɛm a, ka mal a ansarisi; Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga be a nyaaŋa polo n-gbaɣisir o zuɣu niŋd a.
en: the Lord had said, The city of Jerusalem laughs at you, Sennacherib, and makes fun of you.

dag: A ni da binshɛli a kpee sani ka di dolila chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa yuma kalinli yaakaza tariga. Ka o mi kɔhi li ti a ka di dol a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam yuma shɛm tariga.
en: The price is to be set according to the number of years the land can produce crops before the next Year of Restoration.

dag: Dama Naawuni pala gutula ŋun ni lihi yaɣi yi tuma zuɣu bee n-lihi yaɣi yurilim shɛli yi ni wuhir o ka sɔŋdi ŋun Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda hal ka na kul niŋdi lala hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: God is fair, and he will remember all the work you have done. He will remember that you showed your love to him by helping his people and that you continue to help them.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛn pa wuntizɔriba zaa ku kpe Naawuni nam ni? Di yɔhimya yimaŋa, dama bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma mini buɣijɛmdiba ni zinaniŋdiba ni dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba.
en: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual.

dag: Yi ti bi yɛn niŋdi kaman ti ni niŋdi shɛm kpe zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ti zaa kul niŋdila ti suhuri ni yu shɛm.
en: You must not continue to worship the way we have been worshiping. Until now each of us has been worshiping God any way we wanted.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ o yiko puuni. O yɛm puuni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ. O baŋsim puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: God made the earth by his might, shaped the world by his wisdom, and crafted the skies by his knowledge.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli, N daa ŋma Jɔn zuɣu; ka ŋuni mi yɛla ka n lee lan wumdi ŋɔ? Ka daa lo nia ni o nya Yisa.
en: But Herod said, I had John's head cut off! Who is this I hear so much about? Herod was eager to meet Jesus.

dag: O daa pun wum Yisa yɛla, ka daa gil o nyaaŋa nti ŋaɣisi kpe salo maa ni nti shihi o binyɛrigu.
en: The woman heard about Jesus, so she followed him with the other people and touched his coat.

dag: Mɔɣa kom zɔri ti lurila teeku ni, amaa ka di bi paana. Kɔzɔrima maa ni zɔri yiri luɣ shɛŋa na, nimaani ka di na kul zɔri yirina.
en: Every river flows into the sea, but the sea is not yet full. The water returns to where the rivers began, and starts all over again.

dag: Ka Tomas bɔh o, N Duuma, ti bi mi a ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka wula ka ti ni tooi baŋ di soli.
en: Thomas asked, Lord, we dont know where you are going. How can we know the way.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlim Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima ni Yawɛ yɛliya, N nyɛla yaɣimɛra, ŋun maani zaɣ biɛɣu shili n jɛndiri ya, ka lɔri di nia zaŋ chaŋ yi sani. Pumpɔŋɔ yi zaa zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu maa tumbu ni, ka taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma.
en: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi woligi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni noombihi shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbigu bee noombil bee binshɛli n ni wuhi ni di nyɛla daɣiri la kpɛhi yimaŋ daɣiri ni.
en: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean —this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.

dag: Yawɛ daa naan ku tooi lan deei yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa maa, dinzuɣu ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari ka bahi yoli doya ka bɛ turi li, ka so ka di ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: This very day your land lies in ruins and no one lives in it. It has become a horrifying sight, and people use its name as a curse because the Lord could no longer endure your wicked and evil practices.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: Then the owner will show you a large room upstairs that is ready for us. Prepare the meal there.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔa paɣ maa daa yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka a ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam zambu ʒi m mini n daŋ zaa zuɣu, ka a min a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ku mali taali di puuni.
en: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, My master and king, let the guilt be on me and on my fathers household. The king and his throne are innocent.

dag: Miriya ka yi yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ yoya bee n-tu yi niriba toondana.
en: Dont say a curse against God, and dont curse your peoples chief.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa tɔbbihi nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme n-dee li.
en: I was also telling them that the Lord had said, I am going to give the city to the Babylonian army, and they will capture it.

dag: N yi bi tumdi m Ba tuma, yin di niŋ ma yɛda;.
en: If I dont do the works of my Father, dont believe me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti mol o tiliginsim yɛla molo bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb sani yɛra, o pun niŋ li.
en: Each generation will tell their children about the good things the Lord has done.

dag: To, n yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ pali ka yi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: I have told you this now, before it happens. Then when it happens, you will believe.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ku niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: They didnt destroy the nations as the LORD had ordered them to do.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi ti kul chani suɣili maa ni niriba zaa yiɣisirimi, ka sokam ʒe o suɣili dunol ni lihir o hal ka o ti kpe suɣili maa puuni.
en: Whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise and stand at the entrance to their tents and watch Moses until he had gone into the tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa.
en: Then they all left and went home.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu bihi mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ni bɛ ti da bindira maa, dama kum maa daa lula Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni gba.
en: The sons of Jacob came with others to buy grain, because there was famine in the land of Canaan.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, N gba bɔri ni n wum doo maa yɛtɔɣa. Ka Fɛstus yɛl o, A sa ni wum li biɛɣuni.
en: Then Agrippa said to Festus, I would also like to hear what this man has to say. Festus answered, You can hear him tomorrow.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya din be di ni maa tim nandaamba; ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ nyam yi sani.
en: But give what is in your cups and plates to the poor, and everything will be ritually clean for you.

dag: Ka o tuma dabisa daa ti naai ka o kul o yiŋa.
en: When his period of service in the Temple was over, Zechariah went back home.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɔhimi ba. Niriba yi lu, bɛ bi lan yiɣisir yaha? Ka bee bɛ yi birigi kpe yɔɣu, bɛ bi lan labirina?.
en: The Lord told me to say to his people, When someone falls down, doesn't he get back up? If someone misses the road, doesn't he turn back?.

dag: Bɛ daa kul darimi gindi kaman bɛn kɔŋ kpɛhili shee, ka be mɔɣu ni mini zoya zuɣu chana, ka be kuɣa lɔna ni mini voyari ni. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma n-yaɣi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu zuɣu.
en: The world didnt deserve them. They wandered around in deserts, mountains, caves, and holes in the ground.

dag: Jɛrikɔnim daa kparila Jɛriko goondaa dunoya Izraɛlnim zuɣu; ka so ku tooi gari yi bee n-gari kpe di ni.
en: The gates of Jericho were kept shut and guarded to keep the Israelites out. No one could enter or leave the city.

dag: Ti tum a taali pam, ka bi dol a ni zali ti zaligu shɛl la zaŋ tabili zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ a ni daa zaŋ shɛŋa ti a dabili Musa la.
en: We Israelites have been very bad to you. We have not obeyed the commands, rules, and laws you gave your servant Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa piig o Bia n-tuui tim o la yi sanna ni o ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka taɣi yi zaa biɛhigu n-yihi ya yi tuumbiɛri ni.
en: After God raised his servant, he sent him to you first—to bless you by enabling each of you to turn from your evil ways.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa malim shili n-ka Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni na. Ka n ti ʒin nimaani n-kari zuliya kam bɛn gili luɣilikam zaa la saria.
en: Let the nations prepare themselves, and come up to the Jehoshaphat Valley; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim maa zaa ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: All the Israelites years old and above eligible for military service in Israel were enlisted by their households.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma din ni chɛ ka n tooi tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu n-kahigiri di gbinni wuhiri kaman di ni simdi ni n kahigiri li wuhiri shɛm.
en: Pray that I might be able to make it as clear as I ought to when I preach.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam. Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri viɛli pam. Ti bindoo nyɛla momaha.
en: Look at you—so beautiful, my love! Yes, delightful! Yes, our bed is lush and green!.

dag: Di ni lan chɛ ka tarimba nya fahim, ka wuhi bipola baŋsim mini yɛm.
en: They can make an inexperienced person clever and teach young people how to be resourceful.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, di simdi ka di nyɛla dilan naɣikpahi ni nahu bee o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua.
en: for the Israelites to observe when they offer their sacrifices. When you offer an animal sacrifice, it may be one of your cattle or one of your sheep or goats.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma gili di zaa, di daa galisiya pam be vinvamli maa ni, di daa nyɛla din kuui zaa.
en: There were many bones lying on the ground in the valley. The Lord made me walk all around among the bones. I saw the bones were very dry.

dag: Dama daba ayɔbu ka man Yawɛ daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, ka daa vuhi daba ayopɔin dali. Lala zuɣu man Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili kasi.
en: Because the LORD made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and everything that is in them in six days, but rested on the seventh day. That is why the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ chira ata saha ka so daa ti yɛli Juda, Tama ŋun nyɛ a bia pakol la gɔrila pagɔrisigu, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla, o niŋla pua o pagɔrisigu maa gɔbu ni. Ka Juda daa yɛli, Zaŋmiy o na ti niŋ buɣim nyo o.
en: About three months later someone told Judah, Your daughter-in-law Tamar has been acting like a whore, and now she is pregnant. Judah ordered, Take her out and burn her to death.

dag: Binshɛli bi lan kpalim bɛ yiŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ chilibi yaɣiri bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa.
en: Now anyone may live in their tents— after sulfur is sprinkled to disinfect them!.

dag: O daa lan bo salima laa din tibisim nyɛ giram kɔbiga ni pia, ka tulaale zim pal li.
en: one gold bowl weighing ten shekels full of incense.

dag: Bɛ yi yɛl a, Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, chɛ ka ti dɔni gu n-ku so, ka chɛ ka ti liri bɛn ka taali.
en: They will say, Come with us. Lets hide and beat to death anyone who happens to walk by.

dag: Amaa tinim ni nyɛ wuntaŋ ni niriba la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti maŋa ka zaŋ yɛda mini yurilim leei nyɔtaɣirigu m-pa ti nyɔri zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti tiliginsim tahima kaman tɔbutuhiri zuɣupila la pili.
en: Since we belong to the day, lets stay sober, wearing faithfulness and love as a piece of armor that protects our body and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali laɣiŋgu suɣili la tooni, ka laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa na.
en: Bring the Levites to the area in front of the Meeting Tent. Then bring all the Israelites together at that place.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa niŋ yomyom bo luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn zani kum, dama o suhu n-daa palig o tizo maa zuɣu ti yaɣi. O daa kpɛla o duu puuni ti kum.
en: Joseph felt a strong desire to show his brother Benjamin that he loved him. He was about to cry and didnt want his brothers to see him, so he ran into his private room and cried there.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kpe ni o ti mali maligu, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Jɛhu daa zaŋla ninvuɣ pihinii zali samban ni di saha maa ka yɛli ba, Ŋun chɛ ka n ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni ŋɔ ni so zo n-tiligi, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: The worshipers of Baal went into the temple of Baal to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. But outside, Jehu had men waiting. He told them, Dont let anyone escape. If any man lets one person escape, that man must pay with his own life.

dag: hal ti damdi Yisa tooni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋ puhir o. Doo maa daa nyɛla Samaria nira.
en: He fell on his face at Jesus feet and thanked him. He was a Samaritan.

dag: Tiŋbunsi nyɛla bɛn ka yiko, amaa bɛ maani bɛ biɛhigu shee la kuɣa ni.
en: Rock badgers: they are not strong either, but they make their homes among the rocks.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli;.
en: Always be joyful.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu di niŋ ma nyaɣisim n ni daa ka nimaani maa zuɣu, dama dina n-ni chɛ ka yi niŋ yɛda. Ka yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o sani.
en: but for your sake I am glad that I was not with him, so that you will believe. Let us go to him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya ma, mani m-bala. Wuni so lan kani m-pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kura, ka lan neera. Mani n-tir dansi; mani n-lan tibira, ka so ku tooi fa shɛli n nuu ni.
en: Now, see that I, and only I, am God! There is no other God! I put people to death, and I let people live. I can hurt people, and I can make them well. No one can save another person from my power!.

dag: N kul tɔɣisirimi kaman yinyaa n-nyɛ ma la. Bɛ nyɛla Masia tumtumdiba? N nyɛla Masia tumtumda gari ba: N tum pam gari ba gba; bɛ kpɛhi ma sarika n-gari ba: n nya buri din ka kalinli; ka be kum barina ni waawaayili.
en: Are they Christ's servants? I sound like a madman—but I am a better servant than they are! I have worked much harder, I have been in prison more times, I have been whipped much more, and I have been near death more often.

dag: O ni dihi bɛn je a vi, ka ninvuɣ biɛri yiŋ ti ku lan beni.
en: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ ma tila ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋ ma niŋ putɔɣunim nuu ni.
en: God delivers me to a criminal and forces me into the hands of the wicked.

dag: Hal bihi siŋdi ma mi, n yi yiɣisi, bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa jɛndiri ma.
en: Children despise me and laugh when they see me.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka mahim tirisi yaɣi dunɔdura shɛŋa Ahaz ni daa me la dura pia zuɣu lab nyaaŋa. Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri tirisi lab nyaaŋa dunɔdura pia maa.
en: Look, I am causing the shadow that is on the steps of Ahaz to move back ten steps. The suns shadow will go back up the ten steps that it has already been on.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa nyɛ Libini daŋ mini Shimɛi daŋ; Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa bala.
en: To Gershon belonged the clans of Libni and Shimei. These were the clans of the Gershonites.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka lan chɛ ka o nam du pam o niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: David now knew that the Lord had made him a powerful king of Israel for the good of his people.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi yɛli, N kpuɣila paɣa, dinzuɣu n ku tooi kana.
en: Another one said, I have just gotten married, and for that reason I cannot come.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia alali nyɛla ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia o suhu ni, ka gunibu maŋli mi nyɛ suhu ni yɛla din nyɛ Naawuni Shia ni niŋdi shɛli, ka di pala niŋgbuŋ ni kɔŋko yɛla. Ka dilana nyari paɣibu la Naawuni sani, ka pa ni ninsalinim sani.
en: Rather, the real Jew is the person who is a Jew on the inside, that is, whose heart has been circumcised, and this is the work of God's Spirit, not of the written Law. Such a person receives praise from God, not from human beings.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi bɛ zɔnima laara nyabu zuɣu, bɛ bihi ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: He denounces his friends for gain, and his childrens eyes fail.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Paɣ yi niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: for the people of Israel. For seven days after a woman gives birth to a son, she is ritually unclean, as she is during her monthly period.

dag: Nyin Naa n-zali zaligu ni biŋkumda la yi ti piligi kumsi, sokam ŋun damdim tiŋa n-jɛm salima binnan la.
en: You commanded everyone to bow down and worship the gold statue when the music played.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi ni yi yaansi ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi nyɛvili ni zaa, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaŋ wuhiri ya ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: As long as you live, you and your descendants are to honor the Lord your God and obey all his laws that I am giving you, so that you may live in that land a long time.

dag: n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi bi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi; n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi bi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka daa ti lan be sarika ni, ka yi bi kana ti kaai ma.
en: I was a stranger, but you did not welcome me, and I was naked, but you did not give me any clothes to wear. I was sick and in jail, but you did not take care of me.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa kpi maa, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la so shɛli din daa kuni Ɛfirat la sokpaŋa, nimaani ka bɛ booni Bɛtilihɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Rachel was buried on the road to Ephrath .

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ku tooi zaŋ mmaŋ zali Naawuni zaani.
en: Then Joseph said to them, Dont be afraid. I am not God! I have no right to punish you.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yihi nandaamba bɛ nandahima ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ malibu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: But he rescues the poor from their misery. He makes their families large like flocks of sheep.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kari ma a sani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma?.
en: Lord , why have you abandoned me? Why do you refuse to listen to me?.

dag: O ti zaŋm ba na ti ti maligumaana, ka o ti daŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maa malibu. O ti ŋmɛlimi kabi ŋmani maa nyiŋgoli, amaa o di ti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu.
en: You will bring them to the priest, who will first present the one for the purification offering. He will pinch off its head at the back of its neck without splitting it.

dag: tutuɣu daa na kani, ka binshɛli mi daa na bi bili yi tiŋgban ni na, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa bi chɛ ka saa mira, ka so mi daa kani kɔra;.
en: before any wild plants appeared on the earth, and before any field crops grew, because the LORD God hadnt yet sent rain on the earth and there was still no human being to farm the fertile land.

dag: N ku saɣim n ni lo o alikauli shɛli, bee n-taɣi n ni yaai n noli yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: I will not break my agreement with David. I will never change what I said.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa nya gariŋga maa ni kaai vil o nuu maa ka yɛli taba, Biɛhiŋ kani, doo ŋɔ nyɛla ninvuɣ kura; hal o ni tiligi kom dibu ni teeku ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, biɛr bɔhibu na kul bi saɣi ni o be.
en: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.

dag: Naawuni m-mi di shee, ka mi di soli ni be shɛli.
en: God alone knows the way, Knows the place where wisdom is found.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayɔbu saha, ka Baasha bia Ɛla daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuma ayi.
en: In the twenty-sixth year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he ruled in Tirzah for two years.

dag: N dimnim mini bɛn nahindi ma galisiya pam, amaa m bi chɛ a zaligunim dolibu.
en: I have many enemies and oppressors, but I do not fail to obey your laws.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa bi lan saɣi yiri palo gɔri Yɛhudianim maa ni, amaa ka daa yi nimaani chaŋla luɣ shɛli din miri yɔɣu ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Ifriim la, ka o min o nyaandoliba ti be nimaani.
en: So Jesus did not travel openly in Judea, but left and went to a place near the desert, to a town named Ephraim, where he stayed with the disciples.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: They said, Tell us what authority you have to do these things. Who gave you this authority.

dag: Amaa Masia yi be yi ni, hal yi niŋgbuna yi ni kpi alahichi zuɣu gba, yi shihi lee ni ne yi ni yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: If Christ is in you, the Spirit is your life because of Gods righteousness, but the body is dead because of sin.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba salo maa ni ka sokam wum.
en: While all the people were listening to Jesus, he said to his followers.

dag: N yɛlila n suhu ni, Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so. Dinzuɣu n ni mali tahima o sani.
en: I say to myself, The Lord is my God, and I trust him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti yɛligu yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka ti Duuma lee kahig o yiko wuhi.
en: This was to give full meaning to what Isaiah the prophet said: Lord, who believed what we told them? Who has seen the Lords power? Isaiah :.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani. Ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: Let everyone see that you are gentle and kind. The Lord is coming soon.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu n ni kum ka fabili. N ni chaŋ napɔnzaŋa ni n zaɣim. N ni fabili kaman yɔbahi la, ka kum kaman taatahi la.
en: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.

dag: Wain tiwal pɔhiriba yi ka yi sanna, bɛ ku pɔhi ka guui zaɣ yiha niŋ? Tayiɣisi yi kana yuŋ, bɛ ni kpuɣila bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko.
en: People who harvest grapes leave some for the poor. Thieves who break in at night take only what they want.

dag: Yi mi ni yi ni daa nyɛ chɛfirinim saha shɛl la, buɣa din ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa n-daa sun ya ka birigi ya.
en: You remember the lives you lived before you were believers. You let yourselves be influenced and led away to worship idols—things that have no life.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii chirigi ba soli maa ni puhi ba; ka bɛ chaŋ ti gban o tooni m-bɔbil o naba, ka jɛm o.
en: Suddenly, Jesus was there in front of them. He said, Hello! The women went to him and, holding on to his feet, worshiped him.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim yɛtɔɣa nyɛla zana din gbahiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiri yɛla ni.
en: The wicked are trapped by their foolish words, but good people escape from such trouble.

dag: Amaa Hɛfa bia Zɛlɔfɛhad ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi. Bipuɣinsi kɔŋko ka o daa dɔɣi. Bipuɣinsi maa yuya n-daa booni, Mahila ni Nɔa ni Hɔgila ni Milika ni Tiriza.
en: Zelophehad was the son of Hepher. But he had no sons—only daughters. His daughters names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

dag: Shɛmida bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahian mini Shɛkɛm ni Likihi ni Aniam.
en: The members of Shemidas family were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

dag: o tuma ni ti yi palɔni. Di dabisili ni ti kahigi li wuhi, dama buɣim nti yɛn kahigi li wuhi, ka buɣim maa ni ti buɣisi sokam tuma n-kahigi di ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi.
en: But the work that each person does will be clearly seen, because the Day will make it plain. That Day will appear with fire, and the fire will test everyones work.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya paya. Bɛnjamin niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Gidiɔni bia Abidan.
en: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its , troops.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu.
en: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig anu saha ka o daa lan chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb lan ʒiya ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ʒi kpe yoli biɛɣu zaa.
en: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing.

dag: Tinim mi pala bɛn tiri gbini bahi yoli; amaa ti nyɛla bɛn lee niŋ yɛda ka tiligi.
en: But we arent the sort of people who timidly draw back and end up being destroyed. Were the sort of people who have faith so that our whole beings are preserved.

dag: Di saha ka o daa teeg omaŋ pa bia maa zuɣu napɔŋ buta, ka suhi Yawɛ, yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka bia ŋɔ nyɛvili lab o ni na yaha.
en: Elijah stretched himself out over the boy three times, while praying, Lord God, bring this boy back to life.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa po pɔri Yawɛ sani yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, a yi ni zaŋ niriba ŋɔ niŋ ti nuu ni, ti ni saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi zaa.
en: Then Israel made a solemn promise to the LORD and said, If you give this people into our hands, we will completely destroy their city.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa zo n-kuli Ijipti ni o yi Naa Sulemaana nuu ni ka o ku paag o ku o la daa wum di yɛla, ka yi Ijipti maa kuna.
en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had gone to Egypt to escape from King Solomon, heard this news, he returned from Egypt.

dag: Di saha maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Filistia Teeku noli ni ti yɛli, Nyamiya din niŋ ti ni zaŋ ti tahima niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni la mini ti ni daa zo nti paai shɛb ni bɛ fa ti Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tiligi? .
en: On that day, those who live on this coast will say, Look at those in whom we had hoped, to whom we fled for help and rescue from the king of Assyria. How then will we escape.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim di bindir yin shɛli Naawuni ni daa ti ba la.
en: They all ate the same spiritual food.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ, M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, Firawuna ku bɔri ni o wum n yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses, standing there before the Lord , said, You know me. Im a very bad speaker. How will I make the king listen to me.

dag: Yawɛ nini ni tiɣi piɛlahi tusa shɛm mini kpam pam din be kaman mɔɣa tuhi pia kom la? N zaŋmi mmaŋmaŋ bituuli ŋun nyɛ n niŋgbuŋ nyɔri n-yo m biriginsim mini n daalahichi samli?.
en: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with many torrents of oil? Should I give my oldest child for my crime; the fruit of my body for the sin of my spirit?.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula; ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛla pam.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, he saw this large crowd, and his heart was filled with pity for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began to teach them many things.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli niriba maa yi ti yɛn laɣimmi, yin piɛbimi kikaa maa, amaa ka di piɛb li kika biɛɣu piɛbbu.
en: But if you want to gather the people together for a special meeting, blow the trumpets in a different way—blow a long steady blast on the trumpets.

dag: ka Hashabia daa nyɛ Hilikia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Nɛtanɛl mi daa nyɛ Jɛdaya so mi daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The leader of Hilkiahs family was Hashabiah. The leader of Jedaiahs family was Nethanel.

dag: Ka a daa zaŋ yuma pam di ba suɣilo, ka daa zaŋ a shia niŋ a daanabinim ni, ka bɛ kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ba niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim nuu ni.
en: You were very patient with our ancestors. You let them mistreat you for many years. You warned them with your Spirit. You sent the prophets to warn them. But our ancestors didnt listen. So you gave them to people in other countries.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Zadok, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi tiŋ maa puuni ti zali, Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ma, o ni lan zaŋ ma labisina ka n nini ti nya di min o biɛhigu shee.
en: Then the king said to Zadok, Carry Gods chest back into the city. If the LORD thinks well of me, then he will bring me back and let me see it and its home again.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ gali pa o buŋa n-chaŋ Gaat naa Akishi sani ni o ti bo o daba maa shee. Ka o daa shiri bo n-nya ba n-zaŋ ba lab yiŋ na.
en: he saddled his donkey and went after them. He found them and brought them back to Jerusalem.

dag: Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o.
en: We are now on our way to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses. They will sentence him to death.

dag: dama yi yi gbihira, o ni ti paana libigi ya.
en: Dont let him show up when you werent expecting and find you sleeping.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sidɔn, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni nya jilima a ni. N yi kar a saria a ni, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira a ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Tell the people there what I, the Sovereign Lord , say about them: I am your enemy, Sidon; people will praise me because of what I do to you. They will know that I am the Lord , when I show how holy I am by punishing those who live in you.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yawɛ daa yɛli nyini n dan Musa ni a pihim kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari Izraɛlnima. Yawɛ daa lan yɛli nyini n dana ni a zaŋm ti mabia Zɛlɔfɛhad tarili ti o bipuɣinsi.
en: They said, Sir, the Lord commanded us to get our land by throwing lots. And sir, the Lord commanded that the land of Zelophehad our brother be given to his daughters.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kana ti paai Yaakubu. Yaakubu daa tila o suɣa zali zoya ni, ka Leeban mi min o dɔɣiriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zali zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la.
en: Jacob had set up his camp on a mountain, and Laban set up his camp with his relatives in the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Tumtumdiba ni bɔri bindirigu zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi tuma, ka kum nyɛ din kpaŋsiri ba ka bɛ tumda.
en: The thought of hunger keeps the workers working so that they can eat.

dag: N ni fo baalim, ka ku yɛli shɛli, dama nyini n-niŋ lala.
en: I will not open my mouth. I will not say anything. You did what should have been done.

dag: Asaf n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa nyɛ Zakaria mini Jɛiɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhiɛl ni Matitia ni Ɛliab ni Bɛnaaya ni Obɛdɛdom ni Jɛiɛl bɛn daa nyɛ mɔɣilo mini goonjɛŋmɛriba la. Asaf n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa la.
en: Asaph was the leader, and Zechariah his assistant; also Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel with harps and lyres; Asaph sounding the cymbals.

dag: Laakumnim maa ni daa nyu kom maa naai, ka nachin kpɛm maa zaŋ nyee ni baŋa din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu pirigili mini bans ayi din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu bupia ti o ni o pir o nuhi ni.
en: After the camels finished drinking, he gave Rebekah a gold ring that weighed / ounce. He also gave her two gold arm bracelets that weighed ounces each.

dag: O daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni, amaa di daa yi ti kpalim o min o nyaandoliba maa ko, o kahigirila binshɛɣukam gbinni wuhiri ba.
en: He always used stories to teach them. But when he was alone with his followers, Jesus explained everything to them.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn doli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu soli bo buni niŋ yi yinsi, ka te yi tɛri luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ni barina di paai ya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, I'm above the law.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha.
en: At noon the whole country was covered with darkness, which lasted for three hours.

dag: Ibram daa zaŋla o paɣ Zarai min o tizo Haran bia Lɔt, ka bɛ daa laɣim bɛ ni mali binshɛlikam zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-yiɣisi kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ni daa paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the slaves, and all the other things he had gotten in Haran. Then he and his group moved to the land of Canaan.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yi daa zaŋ sara mini pina na ti ti ma saha shɛli n ni daa mali ya be mɔɣu ni la?.
en: Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings during the forty years in the wilderness, house of Israel?.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yɛli Lɔt, Di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe m min a sunsuuni; a mi di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe a biŋkɔbiguliba mini m biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni, dama ti nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: Abram said to Lot, We are close relatives. We shouldn't argue, and our men shouldn't be fighting one another.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Lɛhi tiŋgban ni vinvamli tahi bɔɣi, ka kom yi di ni na, ka Samsin nyu ka o ni maai, ka o kpiɔŋ lan labina yaha. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbili nini maa yuli Ɛnhakɔr. Ka di na kul be Lɛhi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: There is a hole in the ground at Lehi. God made that hole crack open, and water came out. Samson drank the water and felt better. He felt strong again. So he named that water spring En Hakkore. It is still there in the city of Lehi today.

dag: Ka salindooriba mini kɔhigɔriba daa mali me zuɣusaa duu din be gɔŋbu shee la mini Piɛri Dunɔdali sunsuuni la.
en: The goldsmiths and the merchants built the last section, from the room at the corner as far as the Sheep Gate.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kamiyana ka ti labi Yawɛ sani ka o ti tibi ti, dama ŋuna n-daa darigi tooi ti. Ŋuna n-daa ti daŋa, o ni niŋ tim niŋ ti daŋ maa.
en: Come, lets return to the LORD; for it is he who has injured us and will heal us; he has struck us down, but he will bind us up.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti bɔh o, N daa bi chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ka n kpah a zuɣu ni yɛli ni a yi ti yi kpe chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani? Ka a daa yɛli ma, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla, n ni dol a noli.
en: So Solomon sent for him and said, I made you promise in the Lord s name not to leave Jerusalem. And I warned you that if you went anywhere, you would die. And you agreed to what I said. You said that you would obey me.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni, o daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka o nubihi min o napombihi zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na.
en: Later, the Israelites fought another war with the Philistines at the town of Gath. In this town there was a very large man. He had fingers and toes. He had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. He also was a son of the giants.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan yɛli Kɔra, Yinim Lɛvi zuliya ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?.

dag: Amaa yinim Judanim zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ yɛliya, M po n yuli din galisi ŋɔ, Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ so ku lan boli n yuli yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But now listen to the vow that I, the Lord , have made in my mighty name to all you Israelites in Egypt: Never again will I let any of you use my name to make a vow by saying, I swear by the living Sovereign Lord .

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti Yawɛ zaa, di yi nyɛla daadam bee biŋkɔbigu bee o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali, di bi simdi ni bɛ kɔhi li bee n-yo di zuɣu ka dee li, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Yawɛ nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: None of you may sell or buy back what you have unconditionally dedicated to the Lord , whether it is a human being, an animal, or land. It belongs permanently to the Lord .

dag: Ti daa pun bi yɛl a Ijipti ni a chɛl ti baalim ka ti jɛmdi Ijiptinima? Dama ti yi di daa jɛmdi Ijiptinim maa, di di so ti ni yɛn kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: Didn't we tell you before we left that this would happen? We told you to leave us alone and let us go on being slaves of the Egyptians. It would be better to be slaves there than to die here in the desert.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a yurilim kpe ma nyaɣisim pam. M bɔr a yurilim gari wain. A tulaale nyom viɛl gari tulaale kam nyom.
en: How beautiful is your loving, my sister, my bride! Your loving is so much better than wine, and your fragrance better than any perfume!.

dag: Ka nahu kam mini piɛɣu kam ŋun pahiri pia ka nyɛ biŋkɔbigul ni guli so nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: One of every ten domestic animals belongs to the Lord . When the animals are counted, every tenth one belongs to the Lord .

dag: Di ni tɔɣisi binshɛŋa yɛla zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma so polo ŋɔ daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, ka o zuliya ni so mi daa bi tum maligumaaniba tuma bimbini gbini.
en: We are talking about our Lord Christ, who belonged to a different tribe. No one from that tribe ever served as a priest at the altar. It is clear that Christ came from the tribe of Judah. And Moses said nothing about priests belonging to that tribe.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tim ti boli Yisahaku na ti bɔh o, O nyɛla a paɣa; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa? Ka Yisahaku garigi yɛl o, N tɛhimi ni n yi yɛli ni m paɣa m-bala, bɛ ni ku ma o zuɣu.
en: Abimelech called for Isaac and said, This woman is your wife. Why did you tell us that she was your sister? Isaac said to him, I was afraid that you would kill me so that you could have her.

dag: Dama Masia ni, nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa yɛda niŋbu din tumdi di tuma yurilim ni n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: For when we are in union with Christ Jesus, neither circumcision nor the lack of it makes any difference at all; what matters is faith that works through love.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, cham Izraɛlnim sani nti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ba.
en: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa.
en: They should make the vest of gold, of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and of fine twisted linen with embroidered designs.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa, amaa filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee.
en: His younger advisors said: Here's what we think you should say to them: Compared to me, my father was weak.

dag: Ka paɣ maa mi daa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa mali zal o tiŋgban nɛli ni ni o be nimaani ka o dihir o hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu la.
en: The woman fled to the desert, to a place God had prepared for her, where she will be taken care of for , days.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma gbuɣinli nyinyɛhi ni bahi ka lan fa ma kunduŋ nyinyɛhi ni bahi ŋɔ ni lan fa ma Filistia doo ŋɔ gba nuu ni bahi. Ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, Chama, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The Lord saved me from the lion and the bear. He will also save me from this Philistine. Saul said to David, Go and may the Lord be with you.

dag: Miriya ka yi siŋ Ɛdomnim ni so, dama bɛ nyɛla yi mabihi, miriya ka yi siŋ Ijiptinima, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba m-be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians.

dag: O daa yɛliya: Yawɛ daa yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na, ka yi Siɛr ka ti sanna; o daa yi Paran Zoli zuɣu n-niŋ neesim bahi ti na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi tuhi pia be o sani; ka omaŋmaŋ dini din galisi be o nudirigu polo.
en: The Lord came from Mount Sinai; he rose like the sun over Edom and shone on his people from Mount Paran. Ten thousand angels were with him, a flaming fire at his right hand.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mini saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: This law applies both to native Israelites and to those foreigners who live among you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn diri wahala Jɛrusalɛm, ka buɣi ka di pala wain ka yi nyu ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Listen to me, poor Jerusalem. You are weak like a drunk, but you are not drunk from wine. You are weak from that cup of poison.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ku tooi niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni neeri kpiimba?.
en: Why do you people think it is impossible for God to raise people from death?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Their brothers repaired the next section. They worked under Binnui son of Henadad. Binnui was the governor of the other half of the district of Keilah.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiya ni o tɔɣisi zab omaŋ zuɣu. O zaniya ni o kari o niriba saria.
en: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanim maa daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni, ka piɛguliba maa yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti nya yɛl shɛli din niŋ ka ti Duuma yɛli ti ŋɔ.
en: The angels left the shepherds and went back to heaven. The shepherds said to each other, Lets go to Bethlehem and see this great event the Lord has told us about.

dag: Di saha maa Jɔab daa na kul tuhirila Ammɔnnim bɛ tin zuɣu din nyɛ Raba la ni.
en: Meanwhile, Joab fought the Ammonites at Rabbah and captured the royal city.

dag: So ka pɔhim yiko din ni tooi gooi li, so mi ka kum dabisili yiko. So ku tooi lɔrigi kpara sɔŋ tɔbu tuhibu saha. Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma gba ku tooi tiligi ŋun tumdi li.
en: No one can keep from dying or put off the day of death. That is a battle we cannot escape; we cannot cheat our way out.

dag: N ni lan kpaŋsi bɛ ʒiɛyimtali n sani. N ni yuri ba ni n suhu zaa, dama n suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani maaya.
en: The Lord says, I will bring my people back to me. I will love them with all my heart; no longer am I angry with them.

dag: ni Dan ni Naftali ni Gaad ni Asha.
en: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔhi taba, So n-tahi bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di yɔɣɔ.
en: So the disciples started asking among themselves, Could somebody have brought him food.

dag: Ti ni daa kul wum li; ti suhuri zaa daa dii fuŋmi, ka suhukpeeni lan ka ti ni so suhu ni yi zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Naawuni.
en: We heard this and our hearts turned to water. Because of you, people can no longer work up their courage. This is because the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on earth below.

dag: N ni yɛli nuzaa polo nim ni bɛ bahimi ba ka bɛ kuna; ka yɛli nudirigu polo nim ni bɛ di gbibi ba. Chɛliya ka m bidibisi bɛn be katiŋ ha kuna, ka chɛ ka m bipuɣinsi bɛn be dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ ni zaa kuna.
en: Ill say to the north, Give them back! and to the south, Dont detain them. Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the end of the earth.

dag: Naawuni yi nuzaa polo na ni jilima din be kaman salima la, ka nam dariza din mali dabiɛm gil o.
en: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bɔhir o lala maa zuɣu ka o yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Ŋun na ʒi n-tum alahichi yi ni, ŋun daŋm o kuɣili labbu.
en: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinim la. O pii shɛb leela tuumba, ka pii shɛb leeg anabinima, ka pii shɛb leei Masia lahibal suŋ molomooniba, ka pii shɛb leei pastanima, ka pii shɛb mi leei karimbanima.
en: And that same Christ gave these gifts to people: He made some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to go and tell the Good News, and some to care for and teach Gods people.

dag: Waazuyihira maa pala yɛndana kɔŋko, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhi niriba baŋsim, ka bɔhim, ka kpahim yɛla baŋ li, ka ŋahi ŋaha pam.
en: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum piɛguliba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa alahiziba.
en: Everyone who heard it was amazed at what the shepherds told them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa ku ti ka lo ni o kpihim ti birili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa maa.
en: They replied, Saul tried to kill all our people so that none of us would be left in the land of Israel.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhi tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli? bee Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: This is what you should ask each other: What has the LORD said? What has the LORD declared.

dag: Yawɛ ti ma bidibisi pam, ka m bidibisi maa zaa ni, Sulemaana ka Naawuni pii ni o ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee n-su Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord has given me many sons. And from all those sons, he chose Solomon to be the new king of Israel. But really, Israel is the Lord s kingdom.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti yɛl o tizo Ɛbɛl, Ti cham mɔɣu ni. Bɛ ni daa ti be mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli, ka Keen yiɣisi lu o tizo Ɛbɛl maa zuɣu n-ku o.
en: Then Cain said to his brother Abel, Let's go out in the fields. When they were out in the fields, Cain turned on his brother and killed him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni lu Babilɔn zuɣu n-wurim li, ka ku bɛn kpalim be di ni mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ zuliya; man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord Almighty says, I will attack Babylon and bring it to ruin. I will leave nothing—no children, no survivors at all. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ti bi nyu dam kuli kaman yi ni tɛhiri shɛm maa, dama yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ na kul nyɛla asiba kurig awɛi.
en: These men are not drunk as you think; its only nine oclock in the morning.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka foliŋga maa pirigi kom din be di tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa maa buyi. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: And that's what happened. God made the dome.

dag: M bia, wumma, niŋmi yɛm, ka niŋ tɛha niŋ a suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a biɛhigu polo.
en: Listen, my child, and be wise! Keep your mind straight on the path.

dag: Goma bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Difat ni Tɔgarima.
en: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: A na mi n-chɛ ka biɛkaali neesim neei gili dunia zaa, n-kari ninvuɣ biɛri zaa di ni?.
en: so it would take hold of earth by its edges and shake the wicked out of it?.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum waɣigbahiriba kukoya, bee n-wum waɣigbahiriba yila.
en: which does not hear the voice of the snake charmer, or the chant of the clever magician.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim niriba maa ni ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm ka o ni sɔhira, ŋun lab kuli. Ka Gidiɔn daa buɣisi ba lala, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi daa lab kuli; ka chɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia kɔŋko.
en: So now, announce in the peoples hearing, Anyone who is afraid or unsteady may return home from Gideons mountain. At this, twenty-two thousand people went home, and ten thousand were left.

dag: ka bɔhi Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa, Ka ŋuni n-lee be kpe ha palo ni n-chani tuhiri ti soli ŋɔ na? Ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N dana m-bala. Ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ sariga pa n-lims o ninni.
en: and asked Abraham's servant, Who is that man walking toward us in the field? He is my master, the servant answered. So she took her scarf and covered her face.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi Naa Zɛdɛkia bidibisi n-ku ba o ninni, ka kpaɣ o mi nina; ka ba o bandi n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: Zedekiah's sons were killed right in front of him. His eyes were then poked out, and he was put in chains and dragged off to Babylon.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima, yi Naawuni sɔŋsim zuɣu, labimiya o sani. Gbibiya yurilim mini yɛlimaŋli, ka kul guhimiya yi Naawuni maa sahakam.
en: So come back to your God. Be loyal to him. Do the right thing, and always trust in your God!.

dag: Asha zuliya ni, tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa mali shili ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu saha shɛlikam daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi.
en: From the tribe of Asher there were , trained soldiers ready for war.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu Masia ni daa yɛn ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, o daa yɛli Naawuni: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara malibu balibu kam, amaa ninsal niŋgbuŋ ka a zaŋ ti ma.
en: For this reason, when Christ was about to come into the world, he said to God: You do not want sacrifices and offerings, but you have prepared a body for me.

dag: pa yi suhu ni tɛha yɛla ka n yɛri maa, amaa dilan maa suhu ni tɛha. So ni bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka so ni tooi zaŋ o suhu ni tɛha yɛla gu n ni mali yolisim shɛli soli?.
en: that is, not your own conscience, but the other person's conscience. Well, then, someone asks, why should my freedom to act be limited by another person's conscience?.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi halli zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka yi yihiri yi paɣiba, amaa piligu ni ha, pa lala n-daa nyɛ li.
en: Jesus answered, Moses gave you permission to divorce your wives because you are so hard to teach. But it was not like that at the time of creation.

dag: Bɛ di ti zaŋ li kɔhi bee n-zaŋ li taɣi so dini. Bɛ di ti zaŋ tiŋgbani kasi maa taɣi ti so. Dama di nyɛla tiŋgban kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: The Levites will not sell or trade any of this land. They will not be able to sell any of it. They must not cut up this part of the country, because this land belongs to the Lord —it is very special. It is the best part of the land.

dag: Ti daa ʒiɛm o ka zaɣis o. O daa nyɛla ŋun mili suhugarigu mini wahala dibu. O daa ŋmanila niriba ni ŋmaligiri bɛ nina bahiri kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ so. Ti daa ʒiɛm o, ka bi lih o ka o nyɛ shɛli.
en: We despised him and rejected him; he endured suffering and pain. No one would even look at him— we ignored him as if he were nothing.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi yi yuri ma, yi ni doli n zaligunima.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.

dag: Ka suli daa ku bɛnkam zaa be jɛmbu duu maa ni n-wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: When the people in the synagogue heard this, they were very angry.

dag: dindina niriba bɛn zaŋm zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm kpe ninvuɣ kura maa mini ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kubo biɛri maa sunsuuni m-mal li.
en: If that happens, the community must decide what to do. The court must decide if a member of the dead persons family can kill you.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma mini bɛn yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ma la laara.
en: My enemies said these evil things against me. But may those curses be the way the Lord punishes them.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa niŋdila binyari viɛla mini situr sabilifaa shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi ni duu puuni tiŋgban ni kuntu shɛŋa bɛ ni liɣisiliɣisi, ka zaŋ mihi wuɣi ka di mali yaa daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: They procured fine finished goods for you, garments of purple and brocade, and plush carpets rolled up and securely tied with ropes, among your acquisitions.

dag: Amaa Aduna ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka naanyi kpe luɣ kasi maa puuni m-bɔŋɔ: O bom naɣila polli ŋun ni mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini piɛlaa ŋun ni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na.
en: He may enter the Most Holy Place only after he has brought a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tulila zaliŋ, ka bi tuli viɛnyɛliŋga ka mi bi mahi la zuɣu, n ni tuhi ya n nol ni bahi.
en: But because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, I am going to spit you out of my mouth!.

dag: Di saha ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa yɛli, Chɛ ka man guui kuli nti ti naa lahibali ni Yawɛ fa o o dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Then Ahimaaz son of Zadok said to Joab, Let me run to the king with the good news that the Lord has saved him from his enemies.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, niŋmiya ania n-lihi ma, dama m bi yɛn ŋmanya ʒiri yi ninni.
en: Now, look me in the face, and see that I am telling the truth!.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd min o tɔbbihi daa ʒiɛm Yisa ka mal o ansarisi; ka daa zaŋ kpar viɛlli yɛl o, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o labi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Herod and his soldiers treated Jesus with contempt. Herod mocked him by dressing Jesus in elegant clothes and sent him back to Pilate.

dag: N ni ti mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ mini sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka lan mali Aduna min o bidibisi la gba ka bɛ be kasi, ka tumdi maligumaaniba tuma tiri ma.
en: I will make the Tent and the altar holy, and I will set Aaron and his sons apart to serve me as priests.

dag: saha shɛli yi ni guhiri Naawuni dabisili dali ka yi suhuri kul ye di kandina zuɣu ŋɔ. Dindali maa buɣim ni ti taai zuɣusaa di li zaa, ka buɣim maa ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa maa nyɛligi.
en: waiting for and hastening the coming day of God. Because of that day, the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt away in the flames.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib shɛb daa yɛli, Karimba, a yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Some of the legal experts responded, Teacher, you have answered well.

dag: Binnɛma ayi kɔtomsi din wuhiri ni Naawuni jilima be bɛ sani n-daa tam adaka maa zuɣusaa n-kul lihiri di zuɣusaa luɣ shɛli din booni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo shee la. Amaa ti ku tooi wuhi yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Above the chest there were magnificent winged creatures casting their shadow over the seat of the chest, where sin is taken care of. Right now we cant talk about these things in detail.

dag: Ka o mayilinim maa daa zan o zaani n-zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Shɛkɛmnim zaa ti o, ka Shɛkɛmnim maa daa wuhi ni bɛ ni doli Abimilɛk, dama ni o nyɛla bɛ mabia.
en: His mother's relatives talked to the men of Shechem about this for him, and the men of Shechem decided to follow Abimelech because he was their relative.

dag: O ni ti zaɣisi binshɛɣukam ninsalinim ni jɛmdi mini ninsalinim ni lihi so Naawuni la; o ni ti duh omaŋ gari dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha; hal o ni ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti ʒini, ka yɛri ni o nyɛla Naawuni.
en: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chaŋ zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi maa ni, hal Musa mini Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la ni daa kul kpalim be bɛ sansani maa ni la zaa yoli.
en: But the people did not believe Moses. They went toward the high hill country. But Moses and the Box of the Lord s Agreement did not go with the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ ba Riuɛl bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ti daŋ kundina lala.
en: When Jethro's daughters returned home, their father asked, Why have you come back so early today.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni a zani ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyaaŋa saria karibu ni, ka mɔŋ ŋun ka taali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu ni.
en: It is not right to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from receiving justice.

dag: ka be yi tanti suɣa ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni yɛra, Yawɛ ni je ti maa zuɣu ka o daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni o ti zaŋ ti niŋ Amɔrinim ŋɔ nuu ni ka bɛ ku ti.
en: You grumbled to one another: The Lord hates us. He brought us out of Egypt just to hand us over to these Amorites, so that they could kill us.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a kɔre kpe o viɛlim ni a suhu ni, ka miri ka a chɛ ka o gbaag a o nina ni lihiri shɛm puuni.
en: Dont desire her beauty in secret; dont let her take you in with her eyelashes.

dag: Yawɛ be katiŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa o deeri wuntizɔriba suhigu.
en: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he listens to the prayers of the righteous.

dag: N ni ti yihi yi ni bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba la mini bɛn birigi n sani la bahi. N ni ti yihi ba bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nyɛ saamba la na, amaa bɛ ti ku kpe Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will remove from among you those who rebel and transgress against me. I will lead them out from the land where they lived as immigrants, but they wont enter Israels fertile land. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Dama yi yi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni mi ni chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: If you forgive others the wrongs they have done to you, your Father in heaven will also forgive you.

dag: Yawɛ tiligi Yaakubu zuliya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o yiko. Alizanda, yilimi yila. Tiŋgbani, yɛrimi saɣi. Zoya mini nyɔŋ puuni tia kam, yɛrimiya saɣi.
en: Shout for joy, you heavens! Shout, deep places of the earth! Shout for joy, mountains, and every tree of the forest! The Lord has shown his greatness by saving his people Israel.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni nti kurigi n ni daa zaŋ jinjɛŋŋmaa maa pi luɣ shɛli maa n-yihi li na. Amaa ka jinjɛŋŋmaa maa daa saɣim ka lan ka buchi.
en: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya Yisa ni daa kuhi lala ka bahi maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: The army officer who was standing there in front of the cross saw how Jesus had died. This man was really the Son of God! he said.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋ maa n-yi soli chani ha ka gbuɣinli chirig o n-gbaag o ku o, ka vu o sɔŋ sol ni; ka buŋ maa ʒe m-baɣ o; ka gbuɣinli maa gba ʒe m-baɣ o.
en: and the prophet from Judah left. Along the way, a lion attacked and killed him, and the donkey and the lion stood there beside his dead body.

dag: Amaa ka Pita daa garigi yɛl o, A min a liɣiri maa zaa bahim yoli! Dama a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi zaŋ liɣiri da Naawuni pini.
en: Peter responded, May your money be condemned to hell along with you because you believed you could buy Gods gift with money!.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim bɛn daa birigi chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa ka chɛ ma saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: The Lord said to me, I am punishing those Levites who, together with the rest of the people of Israel, deserted me and worshiped idols.

dag: Amaa yi ni ti yɛn niŋ ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti daamiya bɛ maligu bimbina luhi, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila la, ka chɛ ŋ-ŋmaai bɛ Ashɛrim la luhi tiŋa, ka nyo bɛ wuna buɣim.
en: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ tiŋgbani maa nim zaa nyaɣisim, ka tiŋ maa daa maai, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Atalia maa nyaaŋa.
en: All the people were filled with happiness, and the city was quiet, now that Athaliah had been killed.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini wain sara pahi naɣilabihi maa mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi pola maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha ka Yisa lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti wuhiri niriba, ka do so ŋun nudirigu bɔɣu kpi daa beni.
en: On another Sabbath, Jesus entered a synagogue to teach. A man was there whose right hand was withered.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: For false Messiahs and false prophets will appear. They will perform miracles and wonders in order to deceive even God's chosen people, if possible.

dag: ka yihiri wain na ka di tiri ninsalinim suhupiɛlli, ka yihiri olivi tihi kpam na ka di chɛ ka ninsalinim ninni nyɛlisira, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyari bindirigu diri ka di tiri ba kpiɔŋ.
en: You give us the wine that makes us happy, the oil that makes our skin soft, and the food that makes us strong.

dag: Shɛlomɔt ŋɔ min o mabihi n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naa Dauda min o dɔɣirikpamba ni sapashinnim bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni bɛn su kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi ni sapashin kpamba ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti maani sara la fukumsi.
en: Shelomith and the members of his family were in charge of all the gifts dedicated to God by King David, the heads of families, leaders of clan groups, and army officers.

dag: Di zaa daa nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu. Dapaɣili kam daa tamla diba ayi zuɣu.
en: There were eight frames for the west side of the Holy Tent. And there were silver bases—two bases for each frame.

dag: Ba ni zɔr o bihi nambɔɣu shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o la nambɔɣu.
en: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him.

dag: Ka Absalom sapashinnim daa kana yili maa ni nti bɔhi paɣ maa, Ahimaaz mini Jɔnatan be ya? Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛli ba, Bɛ du kulibɔŋ ŋɔ ha. Ka bɛ lihilihi ka bi nya ba, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
