en: Absalom's soldiers came to the woman and demanded, Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan? The woman answered, They went across that stream. The soldiers went off to look for the two men. But when they did not find the men, they went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Hɛzɛkia mini kpambaliba ni daa kana ti nya di ni doya gbilligbilli shɛm maa, ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ min o niriba Izraɛlnim di zuɣu.
en: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa wurim nimaani, ka sokam lab omaŋmaŋ daŋ niriba min o malibu sani, ka bɛ daa yi nimaani lab bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Likewise, the Israelites set out from there at that time, heading home to their respective tribes and clans. They all left there for their own territories.

dag: Ka o zabiri piɛli kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri bee gumbɔrigu; ka o nina be kaman buɣim zilinli la.
en: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔshafat daa silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa lu tiŋa Yawɛ tooni jɛm o.
en: Then Jehoshaphat bowed down with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD in worship.

dag: Tim o o nuhi tuma tarili, ka chɛ ka o tuma paɣ o tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni.
en: Give her the reward she deserves. Praise her in public for what she has done.

dag: O daa yɛl ti Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tin ya yurilim shɛl la yɛla.
en: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi shɛm maa daa viɛli n sani, ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni ninvuɣ yinoyino, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: This idea seemed good to me, so I selected twelve men, one from each tribe.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam bia Zakaria daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ayɔbu.
en: In the thirty-eighth year of the reign of King Uzziah of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam II became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for six months.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ba yɛlimaŋtali mini maŋgbibbu ni zaadali saria karibu yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbaai Gomna Filiksi ka o yɛli Pool, Na yim pɔi; n yi ti lan nya dahima, n ni bol a.
en: But Felix became afraid when Paul spoke about things like doing right, self-control, and the judgment that will come in the future. He said, Go away now. When I have more time, I will call for you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Yuŋ ka yɔɣili maa daa zani bili zooi n-neei biɛɣu niŋ dahin yini ka lan ŋmaligi kpi yuŋ. A bi niŋ li shɛli; pa nyin mi n-chɛ ka di zooi, amaa ka a zɔri li nambɔɣu.
en: But the LORD said, You pitied the shrub, for which you didnt work and which you didnt raise; it grew in a night and perished in a night.

dag: chɛliya ka paɣiba shini baalim cheechinim ni, dama bɛ ka soli ni bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛ toondaannim kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: The women should keep quiet in these church meetings. They are not allowed to speak out but should be under authority, as the Law of Moses says.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa dii zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni n-zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu.
en: One of them ran up at once, took a sponge, soaked it in cheap wine, put it on the end of a stick, and tried to make him drink it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Gɛhaazi daa shiri yiɣisi kariti Naaman naba. Ka Naaman daa ti nya ka so zɔri dol o nyaaŋa na, ka o sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli bɔh o, Alaafee.
en: So he set off after Naaman. When Naaman saw a man running after him, he got down from his chariot to meet him, and asked, Is something wrong.

dag: N yura, a viɛlimi kaman Tiriza, ka viɛli kaman Jɛrusalɛm la, ka a ni be shɛm ŋmanila tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanima.
en: You are as beautiful, my dearest, as Tirzah, as lovely as Jerusalem, formidable as those lofty sights.

dag: Yi pun wum n ni daa mali biɛhigu shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa doli Yɛhudianim adiini sol la yɛla. N daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka pam, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n saɣim li.
en: You have heard about my past life in the Jewish religion. I persecuted the church of God very much. I tried to destroy his people.

dag: Di saha maa, yi ni ti fabili pam yi ni pii na so maa zuɣu, amaa ka Yawɛ ti ku garigi ya dindali maa.
en: When that time comes, you will cry because of the king you chose. But the Lord wont answer you at that time.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka n ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri.
en: Come on, he challenged David, and I will give your body to the birds and animals to eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ, Izraɛlnim bi saɣiri ŋubiri binsakpuɣu zuɣu nimdi, doo maa ni daa shihi Yaakubu sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: Even today the descendants of Israel do not eat the muscle which is on the hip joint, because it was on this muscle that Jacob was hit.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Everyone ate until they were full, and the disciples filled twelve baskets with the leftovers.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ li ti sa tiŋgban nɛli ni, luɣ shɛli kom ni kani, ka di tiŋgbani kuui.
en: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and waterless land.

dag: suhimiya Naawuni sahakam.
en: Never stop praying.

dag: Cham gili bɛ ni saɣim luɣ shɛli zaa kahikahi maa; ti dimnim maa saɣim binshɛɣukam din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la.
en: March to the unending ruins, to all that the enemy destroyed in the sanctuary.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, so yi po pɔri n-zaŋ daadam ti Yawɛ kaman yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: Tell the Israelites: You might promise to give someone to the Lord as a servant. The priest must set a price for that person.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan fa Amalɛknim maa ni daa ŋme n-di binshɛŋa maa zaa, ka lan fa o paɣiba ayi la gba.
en: David rescued everyone and everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives;.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ŋun daa bo vuri maa daag o bahi ha ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti toondana mini ti sariakarita?.
en: The man who was hurting the other one pushed Moses away and said to him, Did anyone say you could be our ruler and judge?.

dag: Bɛ ni ko tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ zaɣ nɛli la, ka di ku lan nyɛ zaɣ nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti nimaani sani.
en: The desolate land will be farmed, and it wont be like it was when it seemed a wasteland to all who passed by.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa dari tɔhila o binyɛra, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: When King Hezekiah heard this, he ripped his clothes, covered himself with mourning clothes, and went to the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka lala ni chɛ ka ti lir o o ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-lu o zuɣu kaman maligim ni luri tiŋgbani zuɣu shɛm la, ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa so ku tiligi.
en: When we attack him wherever he might be, we will fall on him like dew that falls on the ground. No one will survive—not him and not one of the soldiers who are with him!.

dag: Ka Jeemsi mini Jɔn, Zɛbidii bihi la, daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti di bɔri ni a niŋ ti la ti ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came up to Jesus and asked, Teacher, will you do us a favor.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya binshɛɣukam zaa ni, dama dina n-tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.

dag: n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa; ka bipuɣiŋga maa mi daa zaŋ li ti ti o ma.
en: brought his head on a plate, and gave it to the young woman, and she gave it to her mother.

dag: Yɛlim Lɛvinima, Yi yi ti deei zaka bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini Izraɛlnim sani, din nyɛ n ni deei shɛli bɛ sani tin ya ka di nyɛ yi tarili la, yin yihimiya di bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini ti man Yawɛ, ka di nyɛ zaka binyɛra puuni mi zaka.
en: Speak to the Levites and say to them: When you receive from the Israelites the one-tenth portion that I have given you from them as your inheritance, you also must present a gift offering to the LORD from it, a tenth from the one-tenth portion.

dag: Aduna bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: O bituuli Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron had four sons: Nadab, the oldest, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa yi yi ni wum n yɛligu, ka ku ʒi ʒiya doli yaŋɔ dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpɛna Vuhim Dabisili dali, amaa ka ni gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi, ka bi tum tuma dindali.
en: If you are careful to obey me, declares the LORD, and dont conduct business at the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, if you keep the Sabbath day holy by not working.

dag: Safaya kuɣa be tiŋgbani puuni, ka salima be di taŋkpazim ni.
en: In the rocks there are sapphires and grains of pure gold.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam binnɛma zaɣ kara niŋ teeku ni, ka nam binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be kom ni chana ni noonsi balibu kam. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: So God created the large sea animals. He created all the many living things in the sea and every kind of bird that flies in the air. And God saw that this was good.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa yi n-kpe yɔɣu ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima. Bɛ daa tuhi tab la Ifriim tiŋgban ni yɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: Davids army went out into the field against Absaloms Israelites. They fought in the forest of Ephraim.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya zuɣusa palli mini dunia palli; dama tuuli zuɣusaa mini tuuli dunia la daa vuuya, ka teeku gba lan kani.
en: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Bɛtani dahin shɛli ka o wum ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Lazarɔs daba anahi dali m-bala.
en: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka m baŋ n kum dali. Ka daba ala n-lee kpalim ma? Chɛ ka m baŋ n nyɛvili ni naari yomyom shɛm.
en: Let me know my end, LORD. How many days do I have left? I want to know how brief my time is.

dag: Ka so daa yi yɛn tɛh o naɣikɔra kubiɛlim bee o lɛbiɛlim, bɛ deer o la anzinfa laɣibaligu giram ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka so mi daa yi yɛn tɛh o kpanbiɛlim bee n-kpɛhi naɣikɔra peeŋkpaa, bɛ deer o la anzinfa laɣibaligu giram anahi.
en: the charge was one small coin for sharpening axes and for fixing goads, and two coins for sharpening plows or hoes.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a ti zaŋ li leei niŋgbina kpaʒiɛrim, di mi bi simdi ka a lan niŋ di tatabo yaha. Di nyɛla din be kasi, ka kul ni be kasi a sani.
en: Dont allow anyone else to use this oil. Dont make another oil like it by using the same formula. This oil is holy, and you should regard it as holy.

dag: Daadam, a ni kari ba saria? A ni kari ba saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ yaannim ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Are you ready to pass sentence on them, mortal man? Then do so. Remind them of the disgusting things their ancestors did.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni wurim n-leei dabari, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya maa ti jɛm Babilɔn naa yuun pisopɔin.
en: This whole land will be left in ruins and will be a shocking sight, and the neighboring nations will serve the king of Babylonia for seventy years.

dag: Di pala yi kalinli n-daa zooi gari zuliya shɛb zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu gbaai ya ka o pii ya maa, dama yinima n-daa pɔri gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: The Lord did not love you and choose you because you outnumbered other peoples; you were the smallest nation on earth.

dag: Amaa Sool ni daa nya ka Yawɛ be Dauda sani, ka o bipuɣiŋga Mikal gba yur o maa.
en: He saw that the Lord was with David and he also saw that his daughter, Michal, loved David.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka niriba booni ya bɛ duumanima, dama Duuma yino kɔŋko ka yi mali, ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Nor should you be called Leader, because your one and only leader is the Messiah.

dag: Nyin bilikɔɣindan ŋɔ! Vuɣim daantal shɛli din sa a ninni maa ka nyari viɛnyɛliŋga pɔi, ka naanyi yihi bimburigin shɛli din be a mabia ninni.
en: You deceive yourself! First take the log out of your eye, and then youll see clearly to take the splinter out of your brothers or sisters eye.

dag: Di ti piniya yi tapaɣisi kɔbiri bee n-kɔrisi taɣi yi teeŋkɔbiri.
en: Do not cut the hair on the sides of your head or trim your beard.

dag: ni Bɛnabinadab ŋun daa su Nafatido tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka daa kpuɣi Sulemaana bipuɣiŋga Tafat la.
en: Ben-abinadab in all of Naphath-dor.

dag: Di saha ka a yipa ni bɔri sara maligunima din tuhi ni sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la; di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan zaŋ naɣilahi m-mali sara a sara maligu bimbin la zuɣu.
en: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka ŋun kɔri ni ti niŋdi yomyom gari ŋun kpuɣiri puu atam, ka ŋun kahindi wain wala kom ni ti niŋdi yomyom gari ŋun biriti li. Wain nyaɣisili ni ti yi zoya zuɣu n-tɔɣiri lurina, ka di ni ti zo n-tiɛli daboya zaa.
en: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka a tibiginsim du n-gari zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ni zaa.
en: Show your greatness in the sky, O God, and your glory over all the earth.

dag: Pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi maa daa nyɛla bini pihiwɛinaayɔbu m-be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka pumpɔrinchihi din daa gɔhigɔhi kur shɛŋa din gabigabi taba gili maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga.
en: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides, a total of one hundred pomegranates around the ornate design.

dag: Yawɛ wurindi karimbaandan yili, amaa ka guli pakoli tiŋgbani tarisi.
en: The LORD snatches away the arrogant ones house, but he preserves the widows boundaries.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligu nyɛla din be kasi; Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla din be kasi mini din tuhi ni din viɛla.
en: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.

dag: Ham bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Kush mini Ijipti ni Put ni Keenan.
en: Hams sons: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, N kpa kasi shɛli n ni yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni m-bala.
en: Tell the Israelites that the anointing oil is holy—it must always be used only for me.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu; nyini n-chɛ ka n dimnim lu n naba ni.
en: You give me strength for the battle and victory over my enemies.

dag: Amaa alɔbo maa ni daa pun ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi.
en: Yet those who died by the plague numbered twenty-four thousand.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti o Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a binshɛŋa zaa la ni shɛli. A ni tooi piig a biŋkɔbbaligu ti o bee a puu atam bee a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain ti o ni a suhu zaa.
en: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.

dag: Ka Rut lan yɛli Naomi, Ka din gari dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla, o yɛli ma ni n kul dol o kachɛriba yihimi kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ n-naai.
en: Ruth told her, Boaz even said I could stay in the field with his workers until they had finished harvesting all his grain.

dag: sapashini maa daa yɛlila Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya bindirigu maa, amaa ka a noli lee ku to li.
en: But the officer refused to believe that even the Lord could do that. So Elisha warned him that he would see it happen, but would not eat any of the food.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi kariti ti saria, o darigirila ti tibili ni ti di pahi dunianim zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: However, we are disciplined by the Lord when we are judged so that we wont be judged and condemned along with the whole world.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ni malaika gahinda zuɣu, n zal a ni a gbib wuhibunim ŋɔ, ka di zo so vi dimbɔŋɔ ni bee n-yaai so yuri ka chɛ so a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: I charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to follow these practices without bias, and without playing favorites.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ ti ma a yuli zuɣu. Fam ma bahi, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla.
en: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Kurimbuni ha bɛ daa yi yɛrila niriba, Chamiya Ɛbɛl n-ti bɔhi ka bɛ wuhi ya. Lala ka bɛ daa yi niŋdi maani yɛla.
en: She said, People used to say long ago: Ask your question at Abel, and that settled the matter.

dag: Dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa piɛma nyɔɣi ma, ka di lɔɣu kpe n ni. Naawuni zaŋla dabiɛm sɔŋ tuɣi tab gu ma.
en: Almighty God has shot me with arrows, and their poison spreads through my body. God has lined up his terrors against me.

dag: Ka Shɛva daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara. Ka Zadok mini Abiata daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Sheva was the court secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka gbaai mal o ka o ba.
en: They brought it to Jesus, threw their clothes on the colt, and lifted Jesus onto it.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa chɛ ka Tarishish ŋarima tatabo chaŋ Ofiri ni bɛ ti ʒi salima na; amaa ka di daa bi paai, dama ŋarima maa daa saɣimla Ɛziɔngɛba.
en: Jehoshaphat had seagoing ships built to sail to Ophir for gold. But they were wrecked at Ezion-Geber and never sailed.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka di mi pala bindirigu kum bee kɔnyuri, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu kum.
en: I, the Lord , also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.

dag: Yi yi ti biri yi bimbira, o ni chɛ ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ, ka yi kpuɣi atam pam, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nya mɔri pam ŋubira.
en: At that time the Lord will send you rain. You will plant seeds, and the ground will grow food for you. You will have a very large harvest. You will have plenty of food in the fields for your animals. There will be large fields for your sheep.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, maliya suɣilo hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha. Kpahimmiya pukpara ni diri suɣilo n-guhir o puu atam din mali buchi hal ka saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa gba ti mi la.
en: Be patient, then, my friends, until the Lord comes. See how patient farmers are as they wait for their land to produce precious crops. They wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains.

dag: A mi di bi puhi ma ka mɔɣisi n kpariŋ kaman ti kali ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa n ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na hal ni wayo, paɣ ŋɔ na bi chɛ n naba bɔbilibu.
en: You did not welcome me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing my feet since I came.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn soli ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim, di kul neerimi pahiri hal ti be kaman wuntaŋ yi ti zani zuɣu ni la.
en: The road the righteous travel is like the sunrise, getting brighter and brighter until daylight has come.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni ku bɛ naa min o kpambaliba, ka zali n nam ʒiishee Ɛlam.
en: Your king and his officials will die, and I will rule in their place. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa yeeg o sarika binyɛra sɔŋ, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi diri bindirigu sahakam hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum gbahi ya, ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zaŋ manna dihi ya, din daa nyɛ yi mini yi yaannim ni ʒi shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni pa bindirigu kɔŋko n-chɛ ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Yawɛ nol ni na n-chɛ ka daadam be.
en: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.

dag: Du shɛli din daa nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di dubu nyɛ mita awɛi; ka o dooi salima din nyɛ alali pa di luɣ shɛlikam zuɣu; ka daa lan zaŋ sida dari m-mali sara maligu bimbini.
en: The inner sanctuary was thirty feet in length, width, and height. Solomon overlaid it with pure gold and covered the altar with cedar.

dag: Amaa wahu ni daa zaŋ o yɛmbimbiɛri n-yɔhim Awa shɛm la, n zɔri ni yi gba tɛha ti ŋmaligi kpe yɔɣu lala ka chɛ yi suhuyini mini yi ʒiɛyimtal shɛli yi ni mali zaŋ chaŋ Masia san la.
en: I am afraid that your minds will be corrupted and that you will abandon your full and pure devotion to Christ—in the same way that Eve was deceived by the snake's clever lies.

dag: So bi jɛmd a, so mi bi bɔri sɔŋsim a sani. Dama a lɛbila a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ti niŋ ti daalahichi maa ni.
en: No one turns to you in prayer; no one goes to you for help. You have hidden yourself from us and have abandoned us because of our sins.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli Musa.
en: because the Lord had said to Moses.

dag: Dama a piɛma nyɔɣ ma n-kpe nti lim, ka a zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma.
en: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.

dag: ka lan pii din bi ŋmani shɛli, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li ka tɛhi ni di pa shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni la, ni o zaŋ li chɛ ka binshɛŋa din beni niŋ yoli.
en: And God chose what the world considers low-class and low-life—what is considered to be nothing—to reduce what is considered to be something to nothing.

dag: n-chani kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri ka kpamdi ba jaande ni bɛ kul gbibi yɛda, ka yɛli ba ni nir yi bɔri ni o kpe Naawuni nam ni, o ni bahi di wahala.
en: They strengthened the believers and encouraged them to remain true to the faith. We must pass through many troubles to enter the Kingdom of God, they taught.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya ba ka bɛ gbaai Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab shɛba n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani ka kuhiri yɛra, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɛbigiri dunia pindi tiŋ la paai ti ya ŋɔ gba na.
en: When they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some of the other believers to the city leaders. The people shouted, These men have made trouble everywhere in the world, and now they have come here too!.

dag: Ka Musa bɔɣu daa ti ja, ka bɛ bo kuɣili na ti sɔŋ ka o ʒini di zuɣu, ka Aduna mini Hur daa gub gbaag o nuhi maa mali. Yino daa ʒiɛla o nudirigu polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe o nuzaa polo, ka o nuhi maa daa kul ʒe tibi hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When Moses' arms grew tired, Aaron and Hur brought a stone for him to sit on, while they stood beside him and held up his arms, holding them steady until the sun went down.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa tuumba la sani nti kahigi Sool ni daa nya ti Duuma sol ni ka o yɛl o shɛm wuhi ba, ka lan yɛli ba Sool ni daa zaŋ Yisa yuli yihi waazu ni suhukpeeni shɛm Damaskus.
en: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.

dag: Bin biɛri balibu kam ŋɔ zaa yirila ninsal suhu ni na, ka nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: These evil things come from inside a person. And these are the things that make people unacceptable to God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni asiba m-mal lala hal ti paai saha shɛl o ni daa zal li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin.
en: So the LORD sent a plague on Israel from that very morning until the allotted time. Seventy thousand people died, from Dan to Beer-sheba.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan chaŋ ti lu Keenannim bɛn be Hiburɔn la nim zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai.
en: Then the men of Judah went to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the city of Hebron. They defeated the men named Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim siɣi teeku puuni n-chaŋ du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who brought Israel through— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, di kuhiriya n zuɣu, amaa kuhimiyala yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: Jesus turned to the women and said, Daughters of Jerusalem, dont cry for me. Rather, cry for yourselves and your children.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ biɛhiŋ, nyin bipuɣiŋga ŋun ka yɛda ŋɔ? Dama n yɛn namla bin palli niŋ dunia ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣa n-ni ti nyɛ ŋun taɣiri doo barina ni.
en: Unfaithful daughter, how long will you wander around? The Lord has created something new in the land: A woman surrounding a man. .

dag: Bɛ kpuɣiri li tamdila bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu chana. Bɛ yi ti zaŋ li zali luɣ shɛli, di kul kpalim ʒiɛla nimaani; di ku tooi vuui chaŋ shɛli. Ka so yi suhi li, di ku tooi yɛli shɛli bee n-yihi dilana o muɣisigu ni.
en: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.

dag: Chɛ ka di be kaman chinchin la, ka o zaŋ li vil omaŋa, ka chɛ ka di be kaman shɛlɔrigu la, ka o zaŋ li lɔri dabisili kam.
en: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.

dag: Lala ka a yɛn niŋ woligi Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: This will make the Levites holy. They will be different from the other Israelites. The Levites will belong to me.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumda gbilisiri tibili wumdi ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiŋmara mi gbilisiri tibili wumdi yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi liɣiri yi naai, yin zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbiri na ti taɣi bindirigu.
en: If you don't have any money, Joseph answered, give me your animals, and I'll let you have some grain.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Dama nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuhi mani a dabili ŋɔ ka yɛli, N ni me a yili ti a, dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a suhigu ŋɔ.
en: After all, you really are Israel's God, the Lord All-Powerful. You've told me that you will let my descendants be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.

dag: Binshɛɣukam bɛn be kom ni ka ka gɔhi mini paɣiri nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: It is a sickening thought for you to touch anything that lives in the water and does not have fins and scales.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari n-dahim doya, ka bɛ ni daa mali yiko shɛli nyuri bara maa zani tariga; ka Izraɛl zoya zaa ti kpalim zaɣ nɛya hal ka so ku lan gari di gbini.
en: I will make the land empty and a waste. That country will lose all the things it was proud of. The mountains of Israel will become empty. No one will pass through that place.

dag: zaŋ tabili Kɛnnim mini Kɛnizinim ni Kadimɔninim.
en: This is the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa kpalim be Jɛhɔshɛba sani n-sɔɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu, ka Atalia daa diri nam su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: Then Joash and Jehosheba hid in the Lord s Temple. Joash hid there for six years. During that time Athaliah ruled over the land of Judah.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa ti ka Yisa sanna nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti mini Farisiinim lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: At that time Johns disciples came and asked Jesus, Why do we and the Pharisees frequently fast, but your disciples never fast.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kɛhɛlata maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Shɛfa Zoli gbini.
en: They left Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

dag: a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni leei zana bar a, ka a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni gbaag a.
en: you will be trapped by your words; you will be caught by your words.

dag: Piɛguliba pam saɣim n wain tihi puu, bɛ no n ni su shɛli sɔŋ tiŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka n tiŋgbɔn shɛli din viɛli pam la leei dabari ni tiŋgban nɛli.
en: Many foreign rulers have destroyed my vineyard; they have trampled down my fields; they have turned my lovely land into a desert.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes, just as his father Amaziah had done.

dag: Naawuni, ti kul tɛhir a yurilim maŋli la yɛla a jɛmbu duu la puuni.
en: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa deei tɔrokɔnim maa mini naɣilahi maa n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim maa.
en: So Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and he gave them to the Levites.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: But Peter said, Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you. All the others said the same thing.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni n-kuli Ɛliashib bia Jɛhɔhanan yiŋa nti gbe nimaani, ka kul bela suhugarigu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi la polo. O mi daa bi di bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ piɛma to o tɔbbihi zuɣulana, bɛn daa kana kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni bɛ ti wurim ti, ka bɛ pulaantali be kaman bɛn mali shili ni bɛ ku tarimba bɛn sɔɣi la.
en: You used Moses walking stick to stop the enemy soldiers. Those soldiers came like a powerful storm to fight against us. They thought they could defeat us easily, as robbing the poor in secret.

dag: Yawɛ, zanimi n nyaaŋa ni n ka taali; dama galimi ka m biɛhigu ni. N niŋ Yawɛ naani ka bi tiriti gbini.
en: Lord , you be the judge and prove that I have lived a pure life. I have depended on you, Lord , to keep me from falling.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ o naba ni. Amaa di ni sab yɛli ni o zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni maa, di bi wuhi ni ŋun Naawuni pah o ni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛli sɔŋ o naba ni maa zuɣu.
en: For the scripture says, God put all things under his feet. It is clear, of course, that the words all things do not include God himself, who puts all things under Christ.

dag: amaa di zaa yoli, o kul tumdi tuun suma din wuhiri ni o beni. O tiri ya saa ka di chɛ ka yi bindira niŋdi ka yi diri tiɣiri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti puhi yi o zuɣu buɣim niɛm puuni tutuɣu ni, ka Musa daa lihi nya ka buɣim diri tutuɣu ni, amaa ka lee bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: On that mountain, Moses saw the angel of the Lord in a burning bush. Moses saw a bush that was burning without being destroyed.

dag: O ni daa di wahala kpi la nyaaŋa o daa lan zaŋ omaŋa wuhi ba shihira balibu pam puuni ni o shiri neei kum ni. Ka bɛ nina daa nya o ka bɛ min o be hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o daa wuhi ba Naawuni nam yɛla pam.
en: For forty days after his death he appeared to them many times in ways that proved beyond doubt that he was alive. They saw him, and he talked with them about the Kingdom of God.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi ni be n yurilim maa ni kaman n gba ni doli m Ba zaligu ka be o yurilim ni shɛm.
en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, just as I kept my Fathers commandments and remain in his love.

dag: Ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa daa po pɔri yɛli bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm ni yi tum tuma ti Babilɔnnima. Ʒinimiya tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛla tin ya.
en: Gedaliah said to them, I give you my word that there is no need for you to be afraid to surrender to the Babylonians. Settle in this land, serve the king of Babylonia, and all will go well with you.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ suhimiya Naawuni ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka niŋ ti nirilim. Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali taali. O ni niŋ yi so nirilim? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Now try asking God to be good to you. But he will not listen to you, and it is all your fault. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Daadam napɔŋ ti ku lan no di ni, ka biŋkɔbiri gba napɔna ti ku lan no di ni. Binvuhirigu ti ku lan be di ni hal ni yuun pihinahi.
en: No person or animal will pass through Egypt. Nothing will pass through or settle there for years.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka wuntaŋ mini maligu ni sakuɣa kanna ti kuri yi ni biri binshɛlikam, amaa ka yi na kul bi bɔri ni yi ŋmaligi lab n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I sent scorching winds and hail to ruin everything you tried to grow, but still you did not repent.

dag: Ti ni daa ti yiɣisi nimaani ti daa dolila so gɔŋ ti paai Rijium n-daa yi biɛɣu ka nudirigu polo pɔhim din daa sɔŋ ti pam yiɣisi ʒiɛra. Di daba ayi dali ka ti daa paai Putioli.
en: From there we sailed to Rhegium. After one day a south wind came up, and we arrived on the second day in Puteoli.

dag: O ni tooi sɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari zahimbu pumpɔŋɔ, dama omaŋmaŋ daa nya zahimbu ka di wahala.
en: Hes able to help those who are being tempted, since he himself experienced suffering when he was tempted.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bo bulah ayi ti o ka o mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛla yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: From the whole community of Israel, Aaron will accept two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha ka Jɔash daa di nam n-ʒi Jɛrusalɛm. O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi. O ma daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba paɣa, ka o yuli booni Zibia.
en: He became king in Jehus seventh year, and he ruled for forty years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Zibiah; she was from Beer-sheba.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yisahaku Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni. Di saha ka Musa daa pɔb o nina, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yuuni Naawuni.
en: He continued, I am the God of your father, Abrahams God, Isaacs God, and Jacobs God. Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya n yɛligu ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni mini yi biɛhigu ni, zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Remember these commands I give you. Keep them in your hearts. Write them down and tie them on your hands and wear them on your foreheads as a way to remember my laws.

dag: N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I will put my spirit in you and will see to it that you follow my laws and keep all the commands I have given you.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ gɔhi n-wuɣi zuɣupiligu zaŋ pili Yisa, ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple robe.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ kul be n sani sahakam, dama o kul bela n nudirigu polo, ka shɛli ku tooi dam ma.
en: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.

dag: Dɔbba kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu. Ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ chɛ ka salo maa ʒini gbilligbilli kaman ninvuɣ pihinunu laasabu.
en: Jesus said to his followers, Tell the people to sit in groups of about people.

dag: Ka gomna Rɛhum gba mini Shimshai ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmar la daa sab gbaŋ ti Naa Atazɛrikisɛs zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm yɛla polo. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then Rehum the commanding officer and Shimshai the secretary wrote a letter against the people of Jerusalem. They wrote the letter to Artaxerxes the king. This is what they wrote:.

dag: N naan bo sɔɣibu shee yomyom, ka pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ku tooi paai ma.
en: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.

dag: Shɛli kani din ni lan ti ma suhupiɛlli gari n yi ti wum ni m bihi doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: It always gives me the greatest joy when I hear that my children are following the way of truth.

dag: N nyari baŋsim a zaligunim maa puuni, dinzuɣu n je ʒiri soli kam.
en: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa ni m-pahila kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa Musa ni daa zaŋ niŋ di ni Sinai Zoli gbini luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: The only things kept in the chest were the two flat stones Moses had put there when the Lord made his agreement with the people of Israel at Mount Sinai, after bringing them out of Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa bɔri ni o baŋ Yisa, amaa ka salo zoosim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kɔŋ o nyabu, dama ŋun Zakius daa nyɛla ninvuɣ jia.
en: Jesus was heading his way, and Zacchaeus wanted to see what he was like. But Zacchaeus was a short man and could not see over the crowd. So he ran ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree.

dag: A yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, nyin zaŋmi li lo n-tabili kuɣili n-zaŋ li ti bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili sunsuuni.
en: Seraiah, when you finish reading this book to the people, then tie it to a rock and throw it into the Euphrates River.

dag: Ŋmɛnditɔya ni ti liri Gaad, amaa o ni ti kari doli ba ti fa bɛ nɛma.
en: A group of robbers will attack Gad, but Gad will chase them away.

dag: Iso ni daa nya ka Yisahaku niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni ka chɛ ka o kuli Mɛsopoteemia ni o ti kpuɣi paɣ nimaani maa, ka lan baŋ ni o ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni maa o daa yɛl o mi, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Mesopotamia to find a wife. He also learned that when Isaac blessed him, he commanded him not to marry a Canaanite woman.

dag: O lan bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi sara pahi di zuɣu asiba kam pari taba, ni kpam lita yini n-zaŋdi ŋmiriti zim viɛlli maa m-mali chi sara ti Yawɛ. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din yɛn ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: You will provide a grain offering along with it every morning, one-sixth of an ephah along with one-third of a hin of oil to moisten the choice flour. This is a permanent and perpetual regulation for the grain offering to the LORD.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi, ka niŋ tipawumli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. .
en: But if you refuse to listen and rebel against me, your enemies will destroy you. The Lord himself said this.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa dɔɣi Riu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaawɛi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Reu was born, Peleg lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Tin shɛli din daa ʒe yim la yipa ŋmanila pagɔrili! Yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali n-daa yi be di ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ ninvuɣ kuriba m-be di ni.
en: This faithful town has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness lived in her— but now murderers.

dag: ni Hɛziro ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la ni Paarai ŋun daa nyɛ Aribi nir la.
en: Hezro the Carmelite; Paarai the Arbite;.

dag: Dabiɛm gbahi tinzunnima, ka bɛ yiri bɛ ni me birini gili bɛ tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-kani n sanna, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They lose their courage and come trembling from their fortresses.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛli ma, Daadam, pumpɔŋɔ kpuɣim a zuɣu zuɣusaa lihi nuzaa polo. Di saha ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nuzaa polo n-nya ka nyuli zabbu binnani la ʒe sara maligu bimbini nuzaa polo dunoli ni.
en: He said to me: Human one, look toward the north. So I looked north, and there, north of the altar gate, was this outrageous image in the entrance.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tiɛriŋ zuɣu m-bilina, ka mahili ni daa bi yuuri tiŋ nimaani zuɣu chɛ ka di zaɣi kpi.
en: Some of it fell on rocky ground, and when the plants sprouted, they dried up because the soil had no moisture.

dag: Ifriimnim gba kpɛla buɣ jɛmbo ni, chɛliya ba.
en: Ephraim has joined his idols, so leave him alone.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti mabia Apolɔs polo, m balim o pam ni o pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu ka yi sanna, ka o bi yu ni o ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ; amaa o yi ti nya dahima o ni bahi kana.
en: Now, about brother Apollos. I have often encouraged him to visit you with the other believers, but he is not completely convinced that he should go at this time. When he gets the chance, however, he will go.

dag: ka n chɛ ka bɛ niŋ bindirigu tin ya na, yi ni ka mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani ŋɔ na zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi gari. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I will get some food for you, and you can eat as much as you want. Then you can continue your journey. The three men said, Do as you wish.

dag: ni nintuhi ni nyee nintuhi.
en: the signet rings and nose rings.

dag: Ka sokam daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: So the people rested on the seventh day.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun daa siɣina maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa lan lab du zuɣusaa n-gari chaŋ ha ni o ti pali luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.

dag: Lɔdinim mini Hadidnim ni Onɔnim niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisi ni yini.
en: from the towns of Lod, Hadid, and Ono:.

dag: Ka o daa kar o dimnim maa bahi; ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi din ku naai.
en: He drove his enemies back in lasting and shameful defeat.

dag: A nini yi nya shɛli, nyin di bo yomyom zaŋ li tahi kootu ni, dama a kpee yi ti dih a vi, di nyaaŋa wula ka a yɛn niŋ?.
en: dont be quick to quarrel over; what will you do in the future when your neighbor shames you?.

dag: Ka nyin naa ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi; ka bɛ zani a yaannim zaani, ka a ti zaŋ ba leei nanim dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Your sons will be kings like their ancestors. You will make them rulers throughout the land.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa pinila bɛ zuɣuri mini bɛ teensi, ka chihi bɛ bɔɣiri zaa chiha ka so buri.
en: Everyone has a shaved head. Everyones beard is cut off. Everyones hands are cut and bleeding. Everyone is wearing sackcloth around their waists.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛli, A takɔbi ni daa kul chɛ ka paɣiba kɔŋ bihi shɛm la, lala ka a ma gba yɛn kɔŋ bia paɣiba ni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahiŋmahi Agag sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Giligal.
en: Samuel said, Just as your sword left women without their children, now your mother will be childless among women. Then Samuel cut Agag to pieces in the LORDs presence at Gilgal.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo.
en: The Israelites marched and camped in the plains of Moab across the Jordan from Jericho.

dag: Di pa shɛli n niŋgbuŋ mini n suhu zaa ni ti gbarigi. Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ n suhu ni ni ŋun kul su ma sahakam.
en: My mind and my body may grow weak, but God is my strength; he is all I ever need.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo bahi yoli din ka bahigu puuni; ka bɛ mini ti Duuma ni o yiko din mali jilima la ni ti woligi taba.
en: They will be punished with a destruction that never ends. They will not be allowed to be with the Lord but will be kept away from his great power.

dag: Bɛ bi mi, bɛ mi bi baŋ, bɛ tɛha mini bɛ nina zommi, ka bɛ ku tooi baŋ shɛli bee n-nya shɛli.
en: People like that dont know what they are doing! They dont understand. It is as if they have mud in their eyes so they cannot see. Their minds cannot understand.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa tiligi Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka o suhu bi piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ zaligu saɣindiba daɣiri tuma zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: But he saved Lot, a good man who lived there. Lot was greatly troubled by the morally bad lives of those evil people.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ li gari taba kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka di leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni.
en: Prepare a holy anointing oil, blending them like a skilled perfume maker to produce the holy anointing oil.

dag: Buɣa ni naai kahikahi.
en: the idols will completely pass away.

dag: Amaa Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Laribunim ni Ammɔnnim ni Ashidɔdnim ni daa wum ni Jɛrusalɛm goma maa mali me tuma chani tooni hal ka di voya piligi ŋaribu la, ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam.
en: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the men from Ashdod were very angry. They heard that the people continued working on the walls of Jerusalem. They heard the people were repairing the holes in the wall.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili tia ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbi gbaai li gbibi sani. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi li kirikiri nyɛ bɛn mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Wisdom is like a life-giving tree to those who hold on to her; she is a blessing to those who keep her close.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka zaligubaŋdi so daa ti bɔri ni o zahim Yisa, ka yiɣisi zani bɔh o, Karimba, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A legal expert stood up to test Jesus. Teacher, he said, what must I do to gain eternal life.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana.
en: The Lord said to Solomon.

dag: Bɛ dihila Mɔab vi, dama bɛ wurim li. Kuhimiya ka fabili. Molimiya di yɛla Arinɔn mɔɣili duli ni Mɔab lu n-dahim.
en: Moab has fallen, they will answer, weep for it; it is disgraced. Announce along the Arnon River that Moab is destroyed.

dag: Di bi kpa talahi ni n sabi n-wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yuri yi mabihi shɛm, dama Naawuni pun wuhi ya yimaŋmaŋ ni yɛn yuri tab shɛm.
en: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba tusa gari shɛm daa laɣimna hal ti nɔri tab naba bɛ galisim zuɣu, ka Yisa daa daŋ piligi saɣisir o nyaandoliba yɛra, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi din nyɛ bɛ bilikɔnsi la;.
en: Many thousands of people came together. There were so many people that they were stepping on each other. Before Jesus spoke to the people, he said to his followers, Be careful of the yeast of the Pharisees. I mean that they are hypocrites.

dag: Naa daa malila ŋariŋ shɛŋa din yi Tarishish na m-pahi Hiram ŋarima zuɣu ka di be teeku ni, ka nyɛ din zɔri pam. Ka ŋarima din daa yi Tarishish na maa daa yi ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa yɛli naa maa, Mal a pina maa bee zaŋmi li ti so. Amaa n ni karim sabbu maa, ka wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, I will read the writing and tell you what it means. But you may keep your gifts or give them to someone else.

dag: N tɔɣisirila n nini ni nya shɛli m Ba sani; ka yi mi niŋdi yi nini ni nya shɛli yi ba sani.
en: Im telling you what Ive seen when I am with the Father, but you are doing what youve heard from your father.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ ti du Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka Abimilɛk ti zaŋ lɛhu ŋ-ŋma dabɔbili n-zaŋ li buɣi; ka yɛli bɛn be o sani, Yi ni nya ka n niŋ shɛm maa, yi gba niŋmiya lala yomyom.
en: So Abimelech and all the men who were with him went up on Mount Zalmon. He grabbed an ax, cut off a bundle of branches, and hoisted them onto his shoulder. Then he ordered the men who were with him, Hurry up and do what youve seen me do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-su tiŋgbani, ka bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima be di ni.
en: You used your power and your position to take over the whole land.

dag: A mi n ʒinibu saha, ka mi n yiɣisibu saha. Hal n yi tɛhi ni m bela katiŋa, a mi n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You know when I sit down and when I get up. You know my thoughts from far away.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ni gbib yi mini yi bihi. Lala ka o daa lan lo ba alikauli ka kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri.
en: Don't be afraid! I will take care of you and your children. After Joseph said this, his brothers felt much better.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Tapua ni Rɛkɛm ni Shɛma.
en: Hebrons family: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpe bɛ sani asiba n-nya ka bɛ malila suhugarigu.
en: The next morning, when Joseph went to see the men, he could tell they were upset.

dag: Yawɛ niŋ o ni daa lo ni o niŋ shɛl la; o niŋ o ni daa yɛli kurimbuni ha ni o ni niŋ shɛl la. O wurim a ka bi lan zo a nambɔɣu. O chɛ ka a dimnim mali suhupiɛlli a zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a dimnim maa nya yaa.
en: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.

dag: Ka kum bee kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim bee biisim shɛli mi ku lan kpe ba.
en: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.

dag: Yi goli kam piligu ni, bomiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: On the first day of each month you will offer a special burnt offering to the Lord . This offering will be male bulls, ram, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ŋɔ simdi paɣibu pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Let glory be given to God our Father forever and always. Amen.

dag: Naa Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la nam dibu yuun tuuli la ni ka n daa yiɣisi n-niŋ nia kpaŋs o.
en: During the first year that Darius the Mede was king, I stood up to support Michael in his fight against the prince of Persia.

dag: ka olivi tih ayi ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu maa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo.
en: It has two olive trees beside the lampstand, one to the right of its bowl and one to the left.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinima.
en: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites.

dag: Ka yi ni tooi zaŋ paɣiba mini biliɛri ni niɣi ni binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ maa ni zaa leei yi ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa. Yi ni tooi di Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ yi dimnim neen shɛŋa tin ya maa.
en: However, you can take for yourselves the women, the children, the animals, and all that is in the city—all its plunder. You can then enjoy your enemies plunder, which the LORD your God has given you.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Lari nyɛla jɛrilim, ka nyaɣisim bɔbu mi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Merriment, I thought, is madness; pleasure, of no use at all.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa sula Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tinsi ni la kɔŋko.
en: and Rehoboam ruled over only the Israelites who lived in the cities of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ gbibi bɛnkam zaa yɛn lu; ka yiɣisiri bɛnkam zaa pun lu.
en: The Lord lifts up people who have fallen. He helps those who are in trouble.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka a daa zal a zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali zaa.
en: The rules that you have given are completely fair and right.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ŋun mini pagɔrili laɣim min o leela niŋgbun yini? Dama di sabiya ni niriba ayi ni leei niŋgbun yini.
en: The Scriptures say, The two people will become one. So you should know that anyone who is joined with a prostitute becomes one with her in body.

dag: ka turi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ bɛ ni daa nya biɛrim shɛli maa mini yuma din gbahi ba la zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: and they cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and sores; but they didnt turn away from what they had done.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛbil yino mali sara asiba, ka ti zaŋ piɛbil ŋun la mi mali zaawuni.
en: Offer one lamb in the morning and offer the other lamb at twilight.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: and they answered, When you come into your glory, please let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo n-chani ginda m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara.
en: When an evil spirit comes out of a person, it travels through dry places looking for a place to rest, but it finds none.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa n-du n-kpɛhi ti sɔŋ Naawuni nir maa garo zuɣu; ka yina n-vooi dunoli yo.
en: She went up and laid him down on the bed for the man of God. Then she went out and closed the door.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb tuumbiɛri taali paŋ ba min o ni kpihim shɛb daalahichi mal alibarika.
en: Happy are those whose actions outside the Law are forgiven, and whose sins are covered. .

dag: Binshɛli din gɔŋ ku tooi lan teei tuhi; ka nir mi ku tooi yɛli binshɛli din kani yɛla.
en: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.

dag: Dama Naawuni daalibarika niŋbu min o niriba piibu yɛla bi taɣira.
en: Gods gifts and calling cant be taken back.

dag: tiri m biyurigu Timoti. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Timothy, my dear son: May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

dag: Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba zaa n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Ka ya polo ka doo ŋɔ lee bɔhim yɛla ŋɔ zaa.
en: And his sisters, arent they here with us? Where did this man get all this.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, Daadam Bia mini malaika kasinim yi ti labina o Ba jilima ni, o gba ni ti zo vi ni o zaŋ dilan pah o niriba ni.
en: If you are ashamed of me and of my teaching in this godless and wicked day, then the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

dag: O darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili. Yawɛ ku niŋ zinchili zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili darigibu polo.
en: but the Lord punishes people who hate him. He will destroy them. He will not be slow to punish those who hate him.

dag: ka yɛli, Ti nuhi ka doo ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni bee n-di di shɛhira.
en: and say, We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.

dag: Hal yi yi nyaŋ Babilɔn tɔbbi shɛb bɛn tuhiri ya maa zaa, ka di ti kpalimla bɛn nya dansi kɔŋko bɛ suɣa ni gba, bɛ ni yiɣisina ti nyo ya ŋɔ buɣim. .
en: Even if you were to crush the entire Babylonian army thats attacking you and only the wounded in their tents remained, they would rise up and burn this city down.

dag: Ŋun wuhiri shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni bɔrila omaŋmaŋ jilima nyabu, amaa ŋun bɔri ŋun tim o na jilima nyabu nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka ʒiri ka o nol ni.
en: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.

dag: Antiɔk yɛdaniŋdiba maa ni daa tim ba maa, bɛ daa zaŋ doli yila Fɔnisia mini Samaria polo n-yɛri nimaani yɛdaniŋdiba zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba ni niŋ tuuba shɛm yɛla chana, ka di daa niŋ ba suhupiɛlli pam.
en: The church sent this delegation on their way. They traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling stories about the conversion of the Gentiles to everyone. Their reports thrilled the brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ zaa din nyɛ yi ni be tiŋgban shɛli puuni n-nyɛ saamba ŋɔ n-ti a min a zuliya maa, ka yi su li sahakam, ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will give you and your descendants the land in which you are immigrants, the whole land of Canaan, as an enduring possession. And I will be their God.

dag: Bɛ daa tum bɛ Naawuni tuma mini binyɛra mali ka di be kasi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka yiliyiiniba mini dunɔguliba gba daa tum bɛ tuma kaman Dauda min o bia Sulemaana ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: because they performed the ceremonies of purification and the other rituals that God had commanded. The Temple musicians and the Temple guards also performed their duties in accordance with the regulations made by King David and his son Solomon.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka Pool mini Silas suhiri Naawuni ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni, ka bɛ dansarika tab ʒiya wumda.
en: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing songs to God. The other prisoners were listening to them.

dag: ni di taɣi Sintani bahi ka o ku nyaŋ ti, dama ti bi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ o yikombiɛri tuma la polo.
en: This is so that we wont be taken advantage of by Satan, because we are well aware of his schemes.

dag: Di saha maa tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn zaa kana ti liri tin shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la mini bɛ bidibbina ni bɛ tɔbutuhiri nɛma ni bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la bee nir ni nya binshɛli ʒii yuŋ shɛm la.
en: The horde of nations fighting against Ariel, and all who make war on her and her fortress and besiege her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

dag: Ka o nina maa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chani ka paɣiri Naawuni. Salo maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ gba daa gbaai Naawuni paɣibu.
en: At once he was able to see, and he began to follow Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they praised God too.

dag: Ka o daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, du shɛli yɛla Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la.
en: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods.

dag: Di zaa yoli, n kul bela a sani sahakam, ka a gbibi n nudirigu.
en: But I am always with you. You hold my hand.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Miunnim shɛb daa ti lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: Some time later, the Moabites and the Ammonites, along with some of the Meunites, attacked Jehoshaphat.

dag: Ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa ti yi Tiriza n-ka Samaria na ti ŋme Jabɛshi bia Shallum maa luhi Samaria n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Menahem, Gadis son, went up from Tirzah and came to Samaria. He struck down Jabeshs son Shallum in Samaria, murdering him. Menahem then succeeded him as king.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilabil yino maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul be lala dunia ŋɔ ni hal ti paai biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu.
en: The water continued to cover the earth for days.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na dahin shɛl la, n daa bi yɛli ba shɛli bee n-zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara maligunim polo.
en: I brought your ancestors out of Egypt. I spoke to them, but I did not give them any commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices.

dag: M bɔri ni yi di ma suɣilo ka n tɔɣisi ya jɛritali yɛtɔɣa biɛla. N suhiri ya ni yi shiri dim ma suɣilo!.
en: I wish you would tolerate me, even when I am a bit foolish. Please do!.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ daadamnim sariakarita. Yawɛ, karim ma saria ka di doli n wuntitali mini n galimi kalinsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Our Lord , judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga, N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam hal ka so ti ku tooi kali ba.
en: I will give you a son, who will be called Ishmael, because I have heard your cry for help. And someday I will give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them all.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni liri ba kaman gbuɣinli ni liriti binyara shɛm la, n ni dɔni sol naŋgban kpaŋ gu ba kaman jɛŋgbini ni doya gu binyara shɛm la.
en: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee mi ka tinim bi mi li? Bɔ gbinni ka a lee baŋ ka tinim bi baŋ li?.
en: What do you know that we dont know; what do you understand that isnt among us?.

dag: Ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam, Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba polo nim zaa daa baŋ ni Samuɛl nyɛla Yawɛ daanabi maŋli.
en: All Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel was trustworthy as the LORDs prophet.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunima lola tɔb na ni bɛ ti liri ti. Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka a bi saɣi ni bɛ kpe zuliya shɛba tiŋgbɔna ni, ka bɛ daa chɛ ba ka bi ku ba la.
en: But now, here are men from Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir. You would not let the Israelites enter their lands when they came out of Egypt. So the Israelites turned away and didnt destroy them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni zɔri ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpamdi niriba jaande; amaa Naawuni mi ti biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka ti mali tahima ni yi gba mi li yi suhuri ni.
en: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will get much more than they left. They will get many times more in this life. And in the world that is coming they will get the reward of eternal life.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yɛli ŋun su bɛ kpariti biɛhigu shee fukumsi, Zaŋm kpariti na nti ti Baal jɛmdiba maa zaa. Ka o daa zaŋ kpariti maa na nti ti ba.
en: Jehu said to the man who kept the robes, Bring out the robes for all the worshipers of Baal. So that man brought out the robes for the Baal worshipers.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti nya a biɛyanim maa mini biŋkɔbiri maa mal alaafee, ka labina ti yɛli ma. Di saha ka o daa tim o ka o yi Hiburɔn vinvamli ni chaŋ Shɛkɛm.
en: His father said, Go and see if your brothers are safe. Come back and tell me if my sheep are all fine. So Josephs father sent him from the Valley of Hebron to Shechem.

dag: Sanzali mini biisim ni chɛ ka maligim kuuri shɛm, lala ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba darigiri deeri alahichinima.
en: As hot, dry weather melts away the winter snows, so the grave takes away those who have sinned.

dag: ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro na ti tam di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: after which the bread was set on the table.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum a niriba Izraɛlnim maa suhigu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi ka lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni na.
en: Please listen in heaven, please listen to the prayers of your people Israel. Forgive them for their sins and let them have their land again. You gave this land to their ancestors.

dag: zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be.
en: Moses gave these teachings, laws, and rules to the people after they came out of Egypt.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa kpamba maa zaŋ doo maa ti darig o tibili.
en: Then the town leaders are to take the husband and beat him.

dag: Amaa a yi bi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba maa, dindina bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, ka bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka a ku tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: But if you don't surrender, I will let the Babylonian army capture Jerusalem and burn it down, and you will be taken prisoner.

dag: Dinzuɣu a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yihim nanim pihitanaayi la zaa nam ni, ka zaŋ sapashin kpamba zali bɛ zaashɛhi maa.
en: Also, dont let the kings command the armies. Put your commanders in charge of the armies.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ ku Lazarɔs gba.
en: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus too.

dag: O ni wurim zoya din du pam mini kunkuna din du pam zaa.
en: all high mountains and hills.

dag: ka daa zaŋ maha tari Izraɛl salo bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba maa zaa, ka sokam daa deei mahi yiniyini mini nim kpillikpilli ni bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa zaɣ yiniyini pahi. Di nyaaŋa ka sokam daa wurim kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: He also gave a share of bread, a raisin cake, and some date bread to every man and woman of Israel. Then all the people went home.

dag: Di viɛli gari salima, hal di viɛli gari salima alali; ka lan nyaɣisi gari shiri, ni shigbani din tɔɣiri shiri.
en: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Bia maa ku tooi niŋ shɛli omaŋmaŋ yubu ni naɣila o ni nya ka o Ba niŋdi shɛli, dama Ba maa ni niŋdi shɛli, dina ka Bia maa gba niŋda.
en: Jesus responded to the Jewish leaders, I assure you that the Son cant do anything by himself except what he sees the Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son does likewise.

dag: Ka o daa lan piri daanya muɣiri ka zaŋ daanya kpani pa o bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: Goliath wore bronze protectors on his legs. He had a bronze javelin tied on his back.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum. Yawɛ, neem a nina nya; ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tim na nti yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-mali nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm.
en: LORD, turn your ear this way and hear! LORD, open your eyes and see! Listen to Sennacheribs words. He sent them to insult the living God!.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili Jɔpa zaa, ka niriba pam daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: People everywhere in Joppa learned about this, and many believed in the Lord.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa kum niŋ Yawɛ Midiannim zuɣu maa.
en: Then the people of Israel cried out to the Lord for help against the Midianites.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nir niŋ siɣa dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Ŋunkam mali kookali ni tooi baŋ biŋkɔbigu maa namba maa, dama di nyɛla ninsal namba. O namba maa nyɛla kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Anyone who has understanding can find the meaning of the beasts number. This requires wisdom. This number is the number of a man. It is .

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ saa tahigu daa be zuɣusaa; ka Zallakudura Naa daa chɛ ka o kukoli yɛra.
en: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni lu ka ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba yiŋ ni zani.
en: When evil people are destroyed, they are gone and forgotten, but good people are remembered long after they are gone.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani m-mali suhudoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ daa wum bɛ ni suh o Izraɛl tiŋgbani maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka vuug alɔbo maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: David built an altar there for the LORD and offered entirely burned offerings and well-being sacrifices. The LORD responded to the prayers for the land, and the plague against Israel came to an end.

dag: Bɛ paɣiri nir o yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ʒiɛmdi ŋun tɛha bi zilima.
en: If you are intelligent, you will be praised; if you are stupid, people will look down on you.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa guli naa maa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya li, amaa ka a nol lee ku to li.
en: The chief officer there with the king replied, I don't believe it! Even if the Lord sent a rainstorm, it couldn't produce that much grain by tomorrow. You will see it happen, but you won't eat any of the food, Elisha warned him.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba zaa daa mali suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ tiŋ maa daa maai bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku Atalia nayili puuni maa nyaaŋa.
en: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda lan ka saria karibu ni, amaa ŋunkam bi niŋ o yɛda, bɛ pun kar o saria, dilan ni bi niŋ Naawuni Bi gaŋ maa yɛda zuɣu.
en: Whoever believes in him isnt judged; whoever doesnt believe in him is already judged, because they dont believe in the name of Gods only Son.

dag: Tin shɛli din daa ʒe yim la yipa ŋmanila pagɔrili! Yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali n-daa yi be di ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ ninvuɣ kuriba m-be di ni.
en: Look at Jerusalem. She was a faithful city. What made her become like a prostitute? In the past, Jerusalem was filled with justice, and goodness should live there now. Instead, there are murderers.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛl o, Cham ti sɔɣ a ba kaman o ni daa chɛ ka a po ni a ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The king answered, Go and bury your father, as you promised you would.

dag: Bɛ yi ti naai bɛ shɛhira tuma maa, biŋkɔb so ŋun yi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni na ni ti tuhi ba tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ku ba.
en: When they finish proclaiming their message, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will fight against them. He will defeat them and kill them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Then Jesus said to him, Listen! Don't tell anyone, but go straight to the priest and let him examine you; then in order to prove to everyone that you are cured, offer the sacrifice that Moses ordered.

dag: Ka o ni po pɔ shɛŋa bee o noli ni faag o ka o yɛli ni o niŋ shɛli, o yi ti kuli doo.
en: Suppose a woman makes a promise to the Lord and then gets married. If her husband later hears about the promise but says nothing, she must do what she said, whether she meant it or not.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba; dama Jabin daa malila kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi; ka daa zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Izraɛlnim pam yuun pisi.
en: Sisera had iron chariots, and he was very cruel to the Israelites for years. So they cried to the Lord for help.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni vili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba labi. N ni chɛ ka nandahima gbaai ba hal ka bɛ ni ti mii.
en: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yisa, o ni daa yɛli ni o nyɛla bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na la zuɣu.
en: Some Jews began to complain about Jesus because he said, I am the bread that comes down from heaven.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa gbaai piɛbil ŋun na mɔɣiri kɔrigi n-zaŋ o zaɣ muni nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ. Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa deei Samuɛl suhigu maa.
en: So Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as an entirely burned offering to the LORD. Samuel cried out in prayer to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb Jeemsi ni daa tim la ni daa na bi paana, Pita mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim daa laɣindimi timdi dira, amaa ka bɛ daa ti paana, ka o yaag omaŋa bɛ ni n-woligi ka chɛ ba, dama o daa zɔrila bɛn kpaŋsiri gunibu yɛla.
en: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.

dag: A paɣ ni ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala a yiŋ puuni. A bihi ni ŋmanila olivi tia wula n-ʒi n-gil a, ka yi laɣim diri ŋman yini ni.
en: In your house, your wife will be like a vine full of fruit. All around your table, your children will be like olive trees, freshly planted.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa nya lala ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, dama naa daa yi kul niŋ shɛli, di niŋdila niriba nyaɣisim.
en: All the troops took notice of this and were pleased by it. Indeed, everything that the king did pleased them.

dag: Dinzuɣu o tumtumdiba yi lɛbigi bɛmaŋa m-be kaman wuntizɔriba n-nyɛ ba la, di bi simdi ni di gari ti. Bɛ bahigu ni ti bemi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: It is no great surprise then that his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will be what their actions deserve.

dag: Amaa ka ti yaannim ni daa ku Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sul la zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Kalidia nir la daa kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba; ka wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka gbahi niriba maa n-ʒi ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: But because our ancestors made the God of Heaven angry, he let them be conquered by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia, a king of the Chaldean dynasty. The Temple was destroyed, and the people were taken into exile in Babylonia.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nɛmi kaman wuntaŋa ka be kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la. Ŋuna n-niŋdi ti nirilim ka chɛ ka niriba tiri ti jilima. Yawɛ bi mɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi binsuma.
en: The Lord is our protector and glorious king, blessing us with kindness and honor. He does not refuse any good thing to those who do what is right.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal; ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah.

dag: Nyɛvili be wuntizɔbo soli ni, ka nir yi doli di soli maa o ku kpi.
en: The way of the righteous leads to life, but the detestable path leads to death.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligu nyɛla din be kasi; Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla din be kasi mini din tuhi ni din viɛla.
en: Now the law is holy, and the command is holy and right and good.

dag: Ka o daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yuŋ maa ti yɛli ba, Yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yiɣisimiya n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka chɛ n niriba ŋɔ; chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: During the night the king sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, Get your people out of my country and leave us alone! Go and worship the Lord , as you have asked.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wuna bee ka yimaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ binshɛli dooi mali binnana. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not abandon me and worship idols; do not make gods of metal and worship them. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Farisii maa daa kaɣimi ʒe o kɔŋko ha suhiri Naawuni yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, m paɣir a pam n ni bi be kaman ninvuɣ fariba bee zalinsi diriba bee zinaniŋdiba bee farigudeera ŋun ʒiɛya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Pharisee stood over by himself and prayed, God, I thank you that I am not greedy, dishonest, and unfaithful in marriage like other people. And I am really glad that I am not like that tax collector over there.

dag: Yɛl biɛr ayi n-yɛn paai ya; ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili sɔŋ ya? Yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni wurim, ka kum lu yi zuɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn maai yi suhuri?.
en: These two things have happened to you— Who will be sorry for you?— destruction and devastation, famine and sword— who will comfort you?.

dag: Ka Musa daa sabi Yawɛ yɛligu maa zaa sɔŋ, ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asiba me sara maligu bimbini zali zoli maa gbini, ka sa bin wɔɣila pinaayi ka di zani Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la zaani.
en: Moses then wrote down all the LORDs words. He got up early in the morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain. He set up twelve sacred stone pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka Zara daa la o suhu ni ka yɛli, N kurigiya, ka n yidan gba kurigi, ka n kɔre ni lan be doo ni.
en: So Sarah laughed to herself, thinking, Im no longer able to have children and my husbands old.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, ka o be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm. O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: So God created humans in his own image. He created them to be like himself. He created them male and female.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag zaɣ nɛɔŋ, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba maa zaa.
en: he captured King Agag of Amalek alive and killed all the people.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ka salo maa tɔɣisiri Yisa yɛla lala maa zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa tim Naawuni duu tuumba ni bɛ ti gbaag o na.
en: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, so they and the chief priests sent some guards to arrest him.

dag: A yi zaŋ n ni wuh a shɛli ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la, a ni niŋ Yisa Masia tumtumdi suŋ, a ni zaŋ yɛda niŋbu yɛtɔɣa mini wuhibu suŋ shɛli a ni pun dol la n-dih amaŋ la zuɣu.
en: If you point these things out to the believers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus who has been trained by the words of faith and the good teaching that youve carefully followed.

dag: Naawuni timiya yaa mini kpiɔŋ din yir o yiko din galisi pam ka mali jilima la ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi niŋ ania ka mali suɣilo suhupiɛlli puuni.
en: by being strengthened through his glorious might so that you endure everything and have patience.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, N dana, di darigi ti tibili, ti ni tum jɛrilim ka tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: he said to Moses, Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias yɛli bɛn ʒe m-miri Pool maa ni bɛ ŋmɛm o naŋgbani.
en: The high priest Ananias ordered those standing beside Paul to strike him in the mouth.

dag: Neemiya yi nina lihi gili nya, bɛ zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni shiri be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa ye kaman amiliya ni yɛri o salima yɛri shɛm la.
en: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord , promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o yɛm zali dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o baŋsim nam zuɣusaa.
en: But God made the earth by his might; he shaped the world by his wisdom, crafted the skies by his knowledge.

dag: ka o daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu o tɔbbihi bɛn daa gul o la sapashin kpɛm yiŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yisifu ti niŋ maa.
en: and he put them under arrest with the commander of the royal guard in the same jail where Joseph was imprisoned.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun daa pun be ka ti lan kani la nyɛla naa ŋun pah anii, amaa o nyɛla nanima ayopɔin la ni yino, ka o gba ni bahi yoli.
en: As for the beast that was and is not, it is itself an eighth king that belongs to the seven, and it is going to destruction.

dag: Ka yi ni ti zaŋ o ʒim shɛli niŋ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila anahi la, ka niŋniŋ di tariga kɔnanim anahi la zuɣu, ka niŋniŋ di baŋa din kɔɣili li gil la. Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi, ka yi zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the projections on the top corners of the altar, on the corners of the middle section of the altar, and all around its edges. In this way you will purify the altar and consecrate it.

dag: Dama tinim ku tooi chɛ ti ni daa nya ka wum shɛli maa yɛla tɔɣisibu.
en: As for us, we cant stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, N daalibarika saɣ a, dama n yaa niŋdi dɛde chɔɣinsi ni. Ka n kul ni nyuri bara m-pahiri ni suhupiɛlli n chɔɣinsi zuɣu ka di chɛ ka Masia yiko tooi be n ni.
en: But the Lord said, My grace is all you need. Only when you are weak can everything be done completely by my power. So I will gladly boast about my weaknesses. Then Christs power can stay in me.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaŋ a na ti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bɔɣ zilinli ni.
en: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.

dag: Dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zaa niŋ pali la yɛtɔɣ yini puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: All the Law has been fulfilled in a single statement: Love your neighbor as yourself .

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan liri vinvamli ni nim maa n-lan tuhi ba, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: When the Philistines plundered the valley a second time.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛiayika ka di yɛlim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: He made the table out of acacia wood, inches long, inches wide, and inches high.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntinsi pia Ifriim mini Dan ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgbana ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: The rest of the descendants of Kohath acquired ten cities by lot from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha a ni gbib bidibiga a nuu ni. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Aai. Wɛi, n dana, a nyɛla Naawuni nira, di yɔhim man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ.
en: and Elisha said to her, By this time next year you will be holding a son in your arms. Oh! she exclaimed. Please, sir, don't lie to me. You are a man of God.

dag: Wuntizɔriba pihinu yi be tiŋ maa ni, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa ka ku tiligi li wuntizɔriba pihinu bɛn be di ni maa zuɣu?.
en: If there are fifty innocent people in the city, will you destroy the whole city? Won't you spare it in order to save the fifty?.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima zaa niŋla buni nyaɣisim dibu ni, bɛ ni ti chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini di ni ka me a luɣ kasi shee ni bɛ jɛmd a ka yɛra.
en: His descendants lived in this land, and built a Temple for your name.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Lɛvinim mini bɛ daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔnnima; ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba nyɛ Kɔhatinima; ka Mɛrari daŋ niriba nyɛ Mɛrarinima.
en: The tribe of Levi consisted of the clans of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Wuntizɔriba pihinu yi be tiŋ maa ni, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa ka ku tiligi li wuntizɔriba pihinu bɛn be di ni maa zuɣu?.
en: Wouldn't you spare the city if there are only good people in it?.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bindila gɔhi mini mɔri din ka buchi, dindina Naawuni ni yɛli noli ti li, ka buɣim di li.
