en: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun mi yɛl shɛli din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha piligu. Kurimbuni ha ka m pun mi yɛl shɛŋa din na bi niŋ yɛla. Mani n-yɛli, n ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa ni pali, ka n ni niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: From the beginning I predicted the outcome; long ago I foretold what would happen. I said that my plans would never fail, that I would do everything I intended to do.

dag: Ka daa lan zaŋ Giliad hal ni Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni n-ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba, ka kulibɔŋ maa sunsuuni nyɛ bɛ tintariga vulo zaŋ ti du Jabok, kulibɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tintariga.
en: To the Reubenites and the Gadites, I gave land from the Gilead, as far as the Arnon River—the middle of the river being the boundary line—to the Jabbok River, which is the boundary line with the Ammonites.

dag: N ni nya ka shɛli viɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni ninsalinim diri ka nyura, ka di bɛ tuma zaa nyaɣisim dunia ŋɔ ni dabisa biɛla shɛli Naawuni ni ti ti ŋɔ puuni, dama ti tarili m-bala.
en: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa kpuɣila o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka gbaai Naawuni suhibu yɛra, M Ba, saha yipa paaya ni a chɛ ka a Bia nya jilima, ka a Bia maa gba chɛ ka a nya jilima.
en: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.

dag: dindina n ni be yi sani kpe, n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim kurimbuni ha ni bɛ su li sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: If you obey me, I will let you live in this place. I gave this land to your ancestors for them to keep forever.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu din mali nyɛvili ka ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu ka yi nya dɔɣim palli, ka yɛligu maa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din bi kpira, ka mi ku pooi.
en: For through the living and eternal word of God you have been born again as the children of a parent who is immortal, not mortal.

dag: Di saha paɣisara ni ti wari waa ni suhupiɛlli, ka nachimba mini ninkura ti mali suhupiɛlli. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ kumsi leei suhupiɛlli. N ni ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhugarigu leei suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the young women will dance for joy; the young and old men will join in. I will turn their mourning into laughter and their sadness into joy; I will comfort them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi nyɛla Sintani nira, dama piligu ni ha ka Sintani pun tumd alahichi. Ka daliri din chɛ ka Naawuni Bia daa kana nyɛla ni o ti saɣim Sintani tuma.
en: The person who practices sin belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning since the beginning. Gods Son appeared for this purpose: to destroy the works of the devil.

dag: Dindali maa, paɣiba ayopɔin ni ti gbaai do yino n-yɛl o, Saɣimi ni ti yidana n-nyɛ a, ka ti yi vi ni; amaa ti ni dihiri timaŋa, ka sooni timaŋa.
en: When that time comes, seven women will grab hold of one man and say, We can feed and clothe ourselves, but please let us say you are our husband, so that we won't have to endure the shame of being unmarried.

dag: Ka di daa gari Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka doo ŋɔ lee niŋ mi yɛla ŋɔ, ka pa ŋun nya bɔhimbu.
en: The Jewish authorities were greatly surprised and said, How does this man know so much when he has never been to school.

dag: Dama Ayuba yɛliya, N ka taali, ka Naawuni mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: Job claims that he is innocent, that God refuses to give him justice.

dag: ni shɛlɔr shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyara pa di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: the sashes of fine twisted linen, and of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, decorated with needlework, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ dunɔdal shɛli din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la nti du dunɔdura maa m-buɣisi li di dunɔbia zaŋ kpe puuni, ka di nyɛ mita ata.
en: Then he went to the gateway that faced east. He went up the steps, and at the top he measured the entrance; it was feet deep.

dag: Mbaye n zɔnima, zomiya ma nambɔɣu, zomiya ma nambɔɣu! Dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma lala maa!.
en: Pity me, my friends, pity me, because God is against me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ o yiko puuni. O yɛm puuni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ. O baŋsim puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: God used his great power and made the earth. He used his wisdom to build the world and his understanding to stretch out the skies.

dag: Ka Pita kpuɣ o nuhi gahi wuhi ni bɛ foma, ka o daa kahigi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm yih o duu maa ni wuhi ba; ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim Jeemsi mini yɛdaniŋdiba zaa di yɛla. Ka daa yi nimaani chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: Peter made a sign with his hand to tell them to be quiet. He explained to them how the Lord led him out of the jail. He said, Tell James and the other brothers what happened. Then he left and went to another place.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata naabu saha, ka di daa ti niŋ daliri ka Shimɛi daba niriba ayi yi o sani n-zo n-chaŋ Maaka bia Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat naa la sani. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Shimɛi, Nyama, a daba la be Gaat.
en: But three years later, two of Shimeis slaves ran away. They went to King Achish of Gath, who was the son of Maacah. Shimei heard that his slaves were in Gath.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ daantalisi la mini kɔniŋdibin la ni di ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la ni la shɛŋa din kpalim tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces proclaims about the pillars, the Sea, the stands, and the rest of the equipment left in this city.

dag: Di nyaaŋa Naa Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla o daa yɛlimi, M mini n nam ŋɔ ka taali shɛli Yawɛ sani zaŋ chaŋ Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ŋɔ polo hal baabiɛla gba.
en: When David heard the news, he said, The Lord knows that my subjects and I are completely innocent of the murder of Abner.

dag: Yiɣisim kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni ka bɛ ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Now get up and enter the city. You will be told what you must do.

dag: Bɛ maani maligunim zoya zuɣu mini oki tihi ni ti shɛŋa bɛ ni booni pɔpila ni tɛribint la gbini, dama di mahim viɛla. Dinzuɣu ka yi bipuɣinsi gɔri pagɔrisigu, ka yi daamiliyanim niŋdi zina.
en: At sacred places on the mountaintops they offer sacrifices, and on the hills they burn incense under tall, spreading trees, because the shade is so pleasant! As a result, your daughters serve as prostitutes, and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tia kam wulli zooi ka viɛla. Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa tiligi ni ti nya ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiwala viɛla, ka nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: The time is coming when the Lord will make every plant and tree in the land grow large and beautiful. All the people of Israel who survive will take delight and pride in the crops that the land produces.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa zo a tiŋgbɔŋ la nambɔɣu; ka daa chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya lan tɔŋ yaha.
en: LORD, youve been kind to your land; youve changed Jacobs circumstances for the better.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, dini n-lee be asama ni nir yɛli: A yi yɛli gbalikpimalana ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim zaŋ o daamaŋka chaŋ.
en: Is it easier to say to this paralyzed man, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Get up, pick up your mat, and walk?.

dag: A mi sagbana ni yili zuɣusaa shɛm? Ŋuna ŋun mi binshɛɣukam ŋɔ daalahiziba tuma ni ka di niŋda.
en: Do you know how the clouds hang in the sky? This is just one of the amazing works of the one who knows everything.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zani, di gba zaanimi, ka bɛ daa yi yiɣi, di gba doli ba mi yiɣi, dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela di ni.
en: If they flew into the air, the wheels went with them. If they stood still, so did the wheels, because the spirit of the living being was in them.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mi daa bi yɛli ni o ni kpihim Izraɛl yuli dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam tiligi ba.
en: The Lord did not say that he would take away the name of Israel from the world. So he used Jeroboam son of Jehoash to save the Israelites.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, ti naba ʒiɛla a dunoya ni.
en: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ taaya n-yɔri vuri, ka di vuri kaman teeku vubu la. Aa, niriba maa yɔrila vuri, ka di vuri kaman kom pam vubu la.
en: Powerful nations are in commotion with a sound like the roar of the sea, like the crashing of huge waves.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim ni ti lan jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tibigi bɛ Naa Dauda, ka bɛ ti zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri zaɣ viɛlli o sani dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: But the time will come when the people of Israel will once again turn to the Lord their God and to a descendant of David their king. Then they will fear the Lord and will receive his good gifts.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb bɛn laɣim lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ n sani maa lala. Bɛ biɛhigu ni zan tariga, ka bɛ kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: I am the Lord , and I have spoken. And I promise that I will do these things to all these evil people. They have come together against me. So they will all die here in this desert.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni yino daa kana nti wum ka Yisa garigi bɛn daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni maa bɔhigu viɛnyɛliŋga ka bɔh o, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: One of the legal experts heard their dispute and saw how well Jesus answered them. He came over and asked him, Which commandment is the most important of all.

dag: Amaa n ni zaŋ n daalikauli n-lola Yisahaku so Zara ni yɛn dɔɣi ti a yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha la.
en: But I will keep my covenant with your son Isaac, who will be born to Sarah about this time next year.

dag: Yi lihirila binyara niŋgbuŋkom. So be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla Masia nira? Di simdi ni dilan teeg omaŋa ni ti gba nyɛla Masia niriba kaman o ni nyɛ Masia nir shɛm.
en: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.

dag: Shɛb yi nya azichi, nyin di chɛ ka di yɛla muɣis a, hal bɛ yinsi daazichi maa yi kul zoori pahiri gba.
en: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ salima alali m-mali di yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Then make a lid, the mercy-cover. Make it from pure gold. Make it / cubits long and / cubits wide.

dag: Yi bi lan yuuni n sara din be kasi la zuɣu. Amaa yi bola tinzunnima n-chɛ ka bɛ zani yi zaani n-yuuni di zuɣu n jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: They have not taken charge of the sacred rituals in my Temple, but instead have put foreigners in charge.

dag: Ka o daa lan wuhi ba yɛra, Di yi niŋ ka yi ni so mali o zo ka ti chaŋ o sani yuntisuɣu ti yɛl o, Zɔri, paŋm ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila ata.
en: Then Jesus went on to say: Suppose one of you goes to a friend in the middle of the night and says, Let me borrow three loaves of bread.

dag: Lala ka yi ni shɛb daa be. Amaa ka Naawuni daa paɣi yi daalahichi bahi, ka mali ya ka yi be kasi. Ka yi leei wuntizɔriba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: That is what some of you used to be! But you were washed clean, you were made holy to God, and you were made right with God in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa ti kpe n-zani dunol ni ha, ka Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Nyin Zimiri ŋun ku a dan ŋɔ, Alaafee.
en: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam je Ziɔn di vi, ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: May everyone who hates Zion be defeated and driven back.

dag: Hɔrinim mi n-daa pun be Ɛdom, amaa ka Iso zuliya daa ti ŋme n-deei li, ka ku ba ka ʒini nimaani n-zani bɛ zaani kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ shɛm Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su li la ni la.
en: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them.

dag: Dama di saha a ti ku lan kaani n napɔna yaabu, a ti ku lan yuuni n daalahichi.
en: Then you will watch every step I take, but you will not keep track of my sins.

dag: Chu shɛli din yuli booni Yaɣigari Chuɣu ka lan booni Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu daa ti miri.
en: The Festival of Thin Bread, also called Passover, was near.

dag: Amaa bɛ so bi bɔhi, Naawuni ŋun nam ma, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ma yaa yuŋ ŋɔ lee be ya?.
en: But they forget to say, Where is God, the one who made me? He is the one who gives us songs to sing in the night.

dag: Kika biɛɣu ni kum tiŋ ni, ka dabiɛm ku gbahi niriba? Yɛlibiɛɣu ni niŋ tiŋ ni, ka pa ni Yawɛ n-niŋ li?.
en: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?.

dag: Bɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa ni ti kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ti ku sɔɣi ba, ka so mi ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu. So ti ku zaŋ bini ŋmaag omaŋ bee m-pini o zuɣu bɛ zuɣu.
en: The rich and the poor will die in this land, but no one will bury them or mourn for them. Not one of you will gash yourself or shave your head to show your grief.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Dol o chaŋ ka di zɔr o dabiɛm. Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi dol o chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o.
en: The angel from the Lord said to Elijah, Go with him and don't be afraid. So Elijah got up and went with the officer.

dag: Yɛlim niriba, Bɛna m-bɔŋɔ! Molimi molo jɛndi Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛli, Bɛn yɛn teei gili ya yi tiŋgban shɛli ni katiŋ kanna. Bɛ tahirila Juda tinsinim zuɣu.
en: The Lord said, Tell the nations that my people have rebelled against me. And so an army will come from far away to surround Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Jotibata maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Abirɔna.
en: They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la daa lab deei tin shɛŋa Naa Bɛnhadad Hazaɛl bia ni daa tuh o ba Jɛhɔahaz ka fa la. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka Jɛhɔash daa tuhi nyaŋ Bɛnhadad ka fa Izraɛlnim tinsi o sani.
en: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.

dag: Saa mini sakuɣa ni yiri zuɣusaa lurina, ka bi lan labiri zuɣusaa amaa ka mahigiri tiŋgbani n-chɛ ka bindira bimbira tɔri yirina n-zoori niŋdi bindira tiri bindiridiriba, ka niŋdi bimbira tiri bɛn biriti shɛm la.
en: Rain and snow fall from the sky and dont return until they have watered the ground. Then the ground causes the plants to sprout and grow, and they produce seeds for the farmer and food for people to eat.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni mali bidibbin shɛlikam jɛndi ya ku tooi niŋ ya shɛli; ka yi ni tooi garigi ŋunkam zaŋ ya taali bɔhigu. Man Yawɛ ni zabi n daba zuɣu, ka ti ba nasara.
en: But no weapon will be able to hurt you; you will have an answer for all who accuse you. I will defend my servants and give them victory. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka n niriba ni nya dan shɛli maa ni, ka naɣ yɛrimi, Suhudoo beni, suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani.
en: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya kumdi ka fabindi la ni Yisa neei kum ni.
en: She went and told his companions. They were mourning and crying; After this, Jesus himself sent out through his disciples from the east to the west the sacred and everliving message of eternal salvation.

dag: Ka di yi ti simdi ni n gba chaŋ, n ni pahi bɛ zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: If it seems right for me to go too, theyll travel with me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o jilima min o yiko nyɔhi kpe m-pali jɛmbu duu maa, ka so daa bi lan tooi kpe di ni hal ka malaikanima ayopɔin maa alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la tuma zaa ti naai.
en: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛl o deemba maa, Niriba maa kanimina ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ Naawuni yɛla.
en: Then Moses said to his father-in-law, The people come to me and ask me to ask for Gods decision for their problem.

dag: Yinim Dibɔnnim bɛn ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ, yiɣisimiya jilima ʒiishee maa ti ʒini tiŋgban ni. Dama ŋun saɣindi Mɔab la kana ti liri ya. O saɣim yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli la.
en: People in the town of Dibon, you will be honored no more, so have a seat in the dust. Your walls will be torn down when the enemies attack.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda!.
en: Jesus answered them, Have faith in God.

dag: Yi ni na mali neesim maa zuɣu, niŋmiya neesim maa yɛda, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi leei neesim maa bihi. Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa chaŋmi ti sɔɣi.
en: As long as you have the light, believe in the light so that you might become people whose lives are determined by the light. After Jesus said these things, he went away and hid from them.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim maa daa yɛli Dauda, Anzinfa bee salima din pala din ni mali ti mini Sool ni o zuliya maa yɛlli maa, di mi pala ti bɔrimi ni ti ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ so. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: The Gibeonites said to him, We dont want any silver or gold from Saul or his family, and it isnt our right to have anyone in Israel killed. What do you want? David asked. Ill do it for you.

dag: ka Yawɛ bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɔhim Ɛhab ka o chaŋ ti lu Ramɔtigiliad? Ka yino yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋun la mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The Lord said, Which of you will go fool Ahab into attacking the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead so that he will be killed? The angels discussed many different plans.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili buɣim di ba, ka n labisi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I will turn my anger loose on them, and like a fire I will destroy them for what they have done. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Kuɣa wurim bahi saha beni, ka kuɣa laɣisi sɔŋ saha beni. Tab nuhi tibu saha beni, ka tab nuhi tibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: a time for throwing stones and a time for gathering stones, a time for embracing and a time for avoiding embraces.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yi o nyaaŋa n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: His own officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.

dag: di saha bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ daa naan vali ti zaɣ nɛma.
en: They would have swallowed us alive when they became angry with us.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ je suli ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale maa lala?.
en: The followers saw the woman do this and were upset at her. They said, Why waste that perfume?.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ mɔɣa kom leei ʒim, ka bɛ ku tooi lan nyu bɛ kulibɔna kom.
en: God turned their rivers into blood; they couldnt drink from their own streams.

dag: ni Makinadɛbai ni Shashai ni Sharai.
en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai.

dag: Di simdi ka a wuhi ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ni yɛn be shɛm mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm zaa.
en: You should explain Gods laws and teachings to the people. Warn them not to break the laws. Tell them the right way to live and what they should do.

dag: ka chɛ ka dɔro gbaag a nyɔri, ka dɔro maa ni nyɛla din kul yɛn pahiri dabisili kam hal ka a nyɔri ti yirina.
en: You yourself will become deathly ill with a chronic disease that will cause your intestines to fall out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ni suhupiɛlli m-mali hal ti kpɛhi nayili maa.
en: With joy and gladness they come and enter the king's palace.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ daa chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: When they heard what Jesus said, they were amazed. They left him and went away.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi zaŋdi tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ŋɔ tiri ya la yi wuntitali zuɣu, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: You can be sure that the Lord is not giving you this fertile land because you deserve it. No, you are a stubborn people.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, Dinzuɣu bɔ ka a lee lan guhira? Yiɣisima n-deei kom baptaizibu ka kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ka a daalahichi kpihim. .
en: What are you waiting for? Get up! Be baptized, and wash away your sins by praying to the Lord.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zuri bɛ tab nyaaŋa mini bɛn fari tuumbiɛtumdiba bahira saria karibu ni ni bɛn ŋmari ʒiri m-mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli la.
en: all who incriminate others wrongly, who entrap the judge in the gate, and pointlessly postpone justice for the innocent.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi la kum shɛli o ni daa ti yɛn kpi la yɛla.
en: Jesus said this to show how he would die.

dag: Di saha ka Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi daa lo tɔbu kana ti do Giliad. Ka Izraɛlnim gba daa laɣim ti do Mizipa.
en: The Ammonites called out their army and made camp in Gilead, while the Israelites gathered and set up their camp at Mizpah.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times, then everything was pulled back into heaven.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa shihir shɛŋa yi ni sa nya la zuɣu ka yi bɔri n shee maa, amaa yi ni sa ŋub bɔrɔbɔro la tiɣ la zuɣu.
en: He answered, Why are you looking for me? Is it because you saw miraculous signs? The truth is, you are looking for me because you ate the bread and were satisfied.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-yɛn daŋ chandi, m pun zaŋ tiŋgbani maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni.
en: Judah! the Lord answered. I'll help them take the land.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuma yɔri pala pini, amaa di nyɛla o tuma yɔri.
en: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli n soya mini n zaligunima ni n fukumsi zalikpana la kaman a ba Dauda ni daa dol li shɛm la, dindina n ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: And if you walk in my ways and obey my laws and commands, just as your father David did, then I will give you a very long life.

dag: ka mali tahima ni mmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti neei kum ni.
en: Then there is hope that I myself will somehow be raised from death.

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ, a jɛmbu duu nyɛla din simdi ni di kul be kasi sahakam.
en: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa siɣi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu na, ka sagbani maa daa limsi li hal ni daba ayɔbu; dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka o daa boli Musa sagbani maa ni.
en: The Glory of the Lord came down on Mount Sinai. The cloud covered the mountain for six days. On the seventh day, the Lord spoke to Moses from the cloud.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ka n daa po pɔri yɛli Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu, N zaŋ li ti yi Zuliya. N chɛ ka a nini nya li, amaa a ku paai nimaani.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, This is the land that I promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob I would give to their descendants. I have let you see it, but I will not let you go there.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai Sirakus n-zani nimaani niŋ daba ata.
en: We arrived in the city of Syracuse and stayed there for three days.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka bɛ chirigi Sairiini nira ŋun yuli booni Saimɔn, ka bɛ gbaag o ti muɣis o n-zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li.
en: As they were going out, they found Simon, a man from Cyrene. They forced him to carry his cross.

dag: Ŋunkam shihi ya, n nimbiɛlim ka o shihi maa. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zaŋ o yɛligu tim ma ni n yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn nahind o niriba la:.
en: The Lord sent me to the nations that took away your wealth. He sent me to bring you honor. And this is what the Lord All-Powerful said: If anyone even touches you, it is as if they did it to the pupil of my eye.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la yuli duya pam. Ti pun wum o yɛla; ka wum o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa Ijipti la yɛla;.
en: The men answered, We are your servants. We have come from a faraway country. We came because we heard of the great power of the Lord your God. We heard about what he has done and about everything he did in Egypt.

dag: Teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di puuni vuma, dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni, yilimiya yila.
en: Let the sea and everything in it, the earth and all who live in it shout his praise!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Hazɛrɔt maa chaŋ ti dɔni Ritima.
en: They left Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

dag: Lala ka o yɛn bɔri piɛri mini chi ni kpam asiba kam ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pari taba.
en: So the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil are provided every morning as a perpetual entirely burned offering.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun tiri dunianim bɛn tumd o yubu suhudoo ŋɔ.
en: Glory to God in the highest heaven, and peace on earth to those with whom he is pleased.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa chaŋ ti lu Tapua zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ bɛnkam zaa be di ni zaŋ tabili di tintarisi tinsinima. O daa kpuɣila Tiriza zaŋ chaŋ, bɛ ni daa bi taɣ deeg o zuɣu. Ka o daa nyaŋ bɛ zaa, ka kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya.
en: Menahem defeated Tiphsah and the area around it. The people refused to open the city gate for him. So Menahem defeated them and ripped open all the pregnant women in that city.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka piɛ yino ti bɔrigi ka o ku chɛ piɛri kɔbigayinika la bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu hal ti nya o?.
en: If any of you has sheep, and one of them gets lost, what will you do? Won't you leave the in the field and go look for the lost sheep until you find it?.

dag: ni daŋ kam ni kpɛm bom jaaŋgbe yini ka jaaŋgbɛhi maa kalinli yiɣisi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ti a. Ka a sabi sokam yuli pa o jaaŋgbee zuɣu.
en: Call together the twelve tribes of Israel and tell the leader of each tribe to write his name on the walking stick he carries as a symbol of his authority. Make sure Aaron's name is written on the one from the Levi tribe, then collect all the sticks.

dag: ka filim ya, ka yi di vi din ka naabu, ka ku tam di yɛla.
en: I will bring on them everlasting shame and disgrace that will never be forgotten.

dag: O ni yo ba bɛ tuumbiɛri samli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni kpihim bɛ birili bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa zuɣu.
en: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa, dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni tɛhi ni o mali shɛl la.
en: Pay attention to how you listen! Everyone who has something will be given more, but people who have nothing will lose what little they think they have.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba, hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.

dag: Kul leemiya jɛra! Kul leemiya zoomba! Buɣimiya n-chani laana, ka bi nyu wain bee binnyuri kpɛma!.
en: Be shocked and stunned; blind yourselves; be blind! Be drunk, but not on wine; stagger, but not on account of beer!.

dag: Ifriimnim jilima ni ti yiɣi bɛ sani chaŋ kaman noombil la. Bɛ ti ku lan dɔɣi bihi, paɣipuulan ti ku lan beni, bɛ paɣiba ti ku lan zali puhi.
en: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.

dag: O ʒiɛla fɔntinsi dunɔdaya ni, o bela dunɔdaya maa gbini n-kuhiri boona:.
en: She is near the entrance to the city, calling from the open gates.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul doya gil tiŋ maa m-mali hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini saha.
en: His army stayed around Jerusalem until Zedekiahs eleventh year as king of Judah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa diri maa ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: As they were eating he said, I assure you that one of you will betray me.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ paɣ so ŋun bala: Ka so yɛl o, Iliam bia Batishiiba ŋun nyɛ Yuria Hiti nir la paɣa m-bala.
en: So he sent a messenger to find out who she was, and learned that she was Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.

dag: Ka duu maa dunol ni kazala puuni ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili; ka di yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di mini jɛmbu duu maa maŋmaŋ yɛliŋ nyɛ yim.
en: The entrance room was feet deep and feet wide, as wide as the sanctuary itself.

dag: Di malila dabiɛm yuŋ, amaa zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ asiba, ka di zo. Lala n-yɛn niŋ bɛnkam kana ni bɛ ti ʒe ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: That night, the people will be frightened. By morning, nothing will be left. So our enemies will get nothing. They will come to our land, but nothing will be there.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But those tenants said to one another, This is the owner's son. Come on, let's kill him, and his property will be ours.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a suhu kpɛh a yɔɣu, ka bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a nini mooi.
en: Why will you not understand? Why can you not see the truth?.

dag: Piimiya ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: From each tribe of Israel send a thousand men to war.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ n nina lihira. A sani ka n sɔɣi. Di chɛ ma ka m bahi yoli!.
en: My Lord GOD, I look to you for help. I look to you for protection; dont let me die.

dag: Miriya ka yi wum Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya shɛm maa; dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Timmiya sandaani niŋ ma, ka yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi diri yimaŋmaŋ wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi wala, ka nyuri yimaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi kom.
en: Don't listen to Hezekiah. The emperor of Assyria commands you to come out of the city and surrender. You will all be allowed to eat grapes from your own vines and figs from your own trees, and to drink water from your own wells—.

dag: Hal muɣisigu yi gili ma niŋ sunsuuni gba, a yihiri ma di puuni ni alaafee. A kul yihiri ma n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu nuu ni. A teer a nudirigu n-fari ma bahira.
en: Whenever I am in deep trouble, you make me live again; you send your power against my enemies wrath; you save me with your strong hand.

dag: ka bahi noli ni niriba maa ni yu shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: So Pilate passed the sentence on Jesus that they were asking for.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka di chɛ ka bɛ yi tɔɣisiri n-dalindi ya ni yi nyɛla tuumbiɛtumdiba, bɛ ni bahi nya yi tuun suma ka ti Naawuni jilima o kandina dali.
en: People who dont believe are living all around you. They may say that you are doing wrong. So live such good lives that they will see the good you do, and they will give glory to God on the day he comes.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa booni Gidiɔn la Jɛrubaal, Di gbinni nyɛla, Chɛliya ka buɣili Baal min o va; dama o bimbini ka o wurim maa.
en: That same day, Joash changed Gideon's name to Jerubbaal, explaining, He tore down Baal's altar, so let Baal take revenge himself.

dag: Ka o ti bɔhi ba, Alizam bɔ ka yi lee diri chani maa? Ka bɛ kpalim zani ni suhugarigu.
en: He asked them, Whats this I hear you discussing with each other as you walk? The two men stopped, their faces looking very sad.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun gari dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa; nyini n-gari dunia ŋɔ wuna zaa.
en: Lord Almighty, you are ruler of all the earth; you are much greater than all the gods.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa kum o kuli maa ni daa ti gari, ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna yiŋnima, N suhiri ya, yi nini yi tiɣi ma, yin yɛlimiya Firawuna.
en: After the period of mourning had passed, Joseph spoke to Pharaohs household: If you approve my request, give Pharaoh this message.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋdila bɛn niŋdi ya viɛnyɛliŋga zaɣ viɛlli, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba niŋdila lala.
en: And if you do good only to those who do good to you, why should you receive a blessing? Even sinners do that!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yawɛ di saɣi ka n niŋ n dan ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ŋɔ lala. O di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shih o, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bihi so zuɣu ni.
en: and he said to his men, May the Lord keep me from doing any harm to my master, whom the Lord chose as king! I must not harm him in the least, because he is the king chosen by the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Izraɛlnim maa zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka wula ka Firawuna ŋun lee ni wum mani ŋun bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: But Moses replied, Even the Israelites will not listen to me, so why should the king? I am such a poor speaker.

dag: N ni baŋ ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: Youve been rebellious toward the LORD from the day I met you.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba kɔbisiyi ni pisi bɛn yaannim daa nyɛ Naa Dauda min o kpambaliba ni daa pii shɛb zali ni bɛ sɔŋdi Lɛvinim la. Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ zaa yinoyino yuya sɔŋ.
en: In addition there were Temple workers whose ancestors had been designated by King David and his officials to assist the Levites. They were all listed by name.

dag: N ni niŋ n daalibarika niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu maa ni din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yuma ata bindira.
en: I will order my blessing to come to you during the sixth year. The land will continue growing crops for three years.

dag: Amaa lɛhu ni tooi wuhi ni di gari ŋun mal li tumdi tuma? Sua gari ŋun mal li ŋmari binyara? Jaaŋgbee bi kpuɣiri ninsal gbibi, amaa ninsala n-kpuɣiri jaaŋgbee gbibi.
en: Will the ax glorify itself over the one who chops with it? Or will the saw magnify itself over its user? As if a rod could wave the one who lifts it! As if a staff could lift up the one not made of wood!.

dag: Ka n ni daa dɔɣi maa nyaaŋa, di daba ata dali, ka paɣ ŋɔ gba daa dɔɣi, m min o kɔŋko n-kul be yili maa ni, ka so ka ti sani n-kul pahila ti niriba ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: Three days later she also gave birth to her baby. There was no one else in the house with us, just the two of us.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Di yi nyɛla din to ni wuntizɔra tiligi, wula ka di ni be bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini alahichinim la sani.
en: If the righteous are barely rescued, what will happen to the godless and sinful?.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm yi nya ka barina kanna bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa bɛn ka yɛm bɛn ni chaŋ ti kpe di ni n-di wahala.
en: Sensible people will see trouble coming and avoid it, but an unthinking person will walk right into it and regret it later.

dag: n-daa puhi zani o sani ni jilima, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛlikam Jɛrusalɛm ka naanyi kpi la yɛla.
en: who appeared in heavenly glory and talked with Jesus about the way in which he would soon fulfill God's purpose by dying in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Biligimiya kuɣili maa bahi! Ka Maata ŋun tizɔdoo daa kpi maa yɛl o, N Duuma, ŋ-ŋɔ o pooya, dama o ni kpi maa daba anahi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Jesus said, Remove the stone. Martha, the sister of the dead man, said, Lord, the smell will be awful! Hes been dead four days.

dag: O bi ŋme ba luhi kaman o ni daa ŋme bɛn ŋme ba luhi la shɛm la. O mi bi ku ba kaman o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku ba la shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord , didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, Aduna ni zaŋdi li zaani ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni kaman lzraɛlnim ʒiɛyimtali, ka di leei alikauli sahakam.
en: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.

dag: Ka di mahim chaŋ ti luri zoya zuɣu; ka di wula mi zooi lim sida ti kara la.
en: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba; ka ti gbahi bɛn kpalim ti leei daba zuliya kam ni; ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ti deei Jɛrusalɛm n-yɔɣiri gindi hal ti paai Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ su li yuma shɛm tariga.
en: Some will be killed by the sword, and others will be taken as prisoners to all countries; and the heathen will trample over Jerusalem until their time is up.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: They all ate until they were full. And there was a lot of food left. Twelve baskets were filled with the pieces of food that were not eaten.

dag: Gbaam amaŋ ni jɛritali yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu, dama a mi ni di bahigu tahirila naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu na.
en: Stay away from foolish and stupid arguments. You know that these arguments grow into bigger arguments.

dag: Kuriinius n-daa nyɛ Siria Gomna niriba yuya tuui sab maa saha.
en: This first enrollment occurred when Quirinius governed Syria.

dag: Dindina ka ya polo ka yɛm lee yirina? Ka ya polo ka baŋsim lee be?.
en: So where does wisdom come from? Where can we find understanding?.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ man Naa Sulemaana ni, ka chɛ ka Dauda nam nya zaashee zani ŋun Yawɛ sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Naa Ɛhab. Kum daa mii Samarianim pam di saha maa.
en: So Elijah started out. The famine in Samaria was at its worst.

dag: Dama n ni ti zo ba nambɔɣu bɛ biriginsim puuni, ka ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla hal abada.
en: And I will forgive the wrongs they have done, and I will not remember their sins. Jeremiah :-.

dag: ka me bimbini n-chɛ ka di kuɣa do m-pa tab zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga tam zoli ŋɔ zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi la mali sara zaŋ o pa Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli shɛli a ni daai luhi la dari zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim.
en: Then build an altar for worshiping me on the highest part of the hill where your town is built. Use layers of stones for my altar, not just a pile of rocks. Cut up the wood from the pole, make a fire, kill the bull, and burn it as a sacrifice to me.

dag: O ni daa siɣis omaŋ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa milig o zuɣu, ka o daa bi ku ba zaa, ka biɛhigu daa lan niŋ nyaɣisim viɛnyɛliŋga Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Rehoboam humbled himself, and the Lord stopped being angry with him. So he did not completely destroy Rehoboam. There was some good in Judah.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa ti kurigi ka o dabisa pali ka o kpi. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛl o ni daa kpi maa.
en: After reaching the very old age of a hundred and thirty, he died.

dag: O ni daa mali Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni la, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zali.
en: Solomon finished the inner room in the back part of the Temple. This room was for the Box of the Lord s Agreement.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri soli n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa ni bɛ taba, ka di dihiri bɛmaŋmaŋ nama vi.
en: So God abandoned them to their hearts desires, which led to the moral corruption of degrading their own bodies with each other.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-kpuɣi kuɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kuɣ o zuɣu la sa nimaani, ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu.
en: Jacob got up very early in the morning. He took the rock he had slept on and set it up on its edge. Then he poured oil on the rock. In this way he made it a memorial to God.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar: Long live the king!.

dag: Zaliguzaana ni sariakarita yino kɔŋko ŋun ni tooi tiligi niriba ka ni tooi bahi ba yoli m-beni. Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a mi ka a karit a daadamkpee saria?.
en: God is the one who gave us the law, and he is the Judge. He is the only one who can save and destroy. So it is not right for you to judge anyone.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛbihi ni ti laɣindi dira, ka gbuɣima ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman niɣi la, ka tinvura bindirigu ni nyɛla taŋkpaɣu. Bɛ ti ku lan dim so bee n-ku so n zoli din be kasi maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Wolf and lamb will graze together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, but the snake—its food will be dust. They wont hurt or destroy at any place on my holy mountain, says the LORD.

dag: Naa suhu nyɛla kɔzɔrim m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o ŋmaligiri li kpari o ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: To the Lord , a kings mind is like a ditch used to water the fields. He can lead the king wherever he wants him to go.

dag: Bɛ pala dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm.
en: They dont belong to this world, just as I dont belong to this world.

dag: ka o daa zaŋ ba siɣi kom din zilim pam ni du duli, ka bɛ naba daa be kaman yuri naba la ka bɛ bi sarigi.
en: and who guided them through the depths? Like a horse in the desert, they didnt stumble.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: The rest of the army Joab placed under the command of his brother Abishai. When they took up their positions to meet the Arameans.

dag: O mali yɛm o suhu ni, ka o kpiɔŋ galisi; ŋuni n-na mi m-mo o ka di nasara?.
en: He is wise and powerful; who can resist him and prosper?.

dag: Wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli soli n-nyɛ a nam ʒiishee tanzaa, ka yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali be a tooni.
en: Your kingdom is built on truth and justice. Love and faithfulness are servants before your throne.

dag: Naawuni bi zali ti ni o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ti di ti, amaa o zali ti ni ti nyala tiliginsim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: God didnt intend for us to suffer his wrath but rather to possess salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa mini bɛ fiilinima ni sipuɣisinim ni bɛ kpiŋkpama ni kalima maa zaa daa malila nina ti tuui.
en: Their whole body—backs, hands, and wings—as well as their wheels, all four of them, were covered with eyes all around.

dag: O yihi ma gballi ni. O zaŋ yurilim maŋli min o nambɔzɔbo leei zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.

dag: N daa ʒila niriba pam yi kpe chaŋ, amaa ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka n labimina ni nuzaŋa. Ŋun Yawɛ n-chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa paai ma, ka wula ka yi lan booni ma Naomi.
en: I had everything when I left, but the Lord has brought me back with nothing. How can you still call me Naomi, when God has turned against me and made my life so hard.

dag: Mahili bidibisi ni Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga la n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Mahli had two sons, Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish had one son, Jerahmeel.

dag: O daa tiligi shɛba, ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa. O nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa. To, o siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti niŋ o yɛda.
en: He saved others, but he cant save himself. Hes the king of Israel, so let him come down from the cross now. Then well believe in him.

dag: Di daa paai yuma ata ka Izraɛlnim mini Sirianim bi lan tuhi taba.
en: For the next two years there was peace between Israel and Aram.

dag: Amaa a ni bi niŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm maa yɛda zuɣu, a ni leei birigu ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa faashee n yɛligu ŋɔ zaa ti niŋ pali; di mi ti kul yɛn niŋla pali saha shɛli Naawuni ni zal li maa.
en: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim pam bɛn mini Mariama daa doli kana la daa nya Yisa ni tum shɛm maa, ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: There were many Jews who came to visit Mary. When they saw what Jesus did, many of them believed in him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti puhi yi o zuɣu buɣim niɛm puuni tutuɣu ni, ka Musa daa lihi nya ka buɣim diri tutuɣu ni, amaa ka lee bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: There an angel of the Lord appeared to him from a burning bush. Moses saw that the bush was on fire, but it was not burning up.

dag: N kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: I call to the Lord , and he saves me from my enemies. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka o mi buɣisi yɛli ba ni bɛ tim o gbaŋ; ka bɛ daa ti o gbaŋ maa ka o sab yɛli, Bia maa yuli Jɔn. Ka di daa gari sokam pam.
en: Zechariah asked for a writing pad and wrote, His name is John. How surprised they all were!.

dag: Neemi n nina ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n nya alahiziba binshɛŋa din be a zaligu puuni.
en: Open my eyes, so that I may see the wonderful truths in your law.

dag: Nyama, yi ni ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya ti zo n-ka yi sanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tibigi ya shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Look, you will call a nation you dont know, a nation you dont know will run to you because of the LORD your God, the holy one of Israel, who has glorified you.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilo paɣi ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Sing to the LORD with thanks; sing praises to our God with a lyre!.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋdila suɣili maa nti tiri zaani kpaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ sansani maa. O daa booni li la Yawɛ chirigibu shee, ka ŋunkam daa yi bɔri ni o bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ shɛli, o chanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini sansani maa kpaŋ maa ha.
en: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the meeting tent, and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.

dag: A deei ti suhigu ka tiligi ti alahizibu tuun kara puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, binnamda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa zaŋ tabili bɛn be teeku ni katiŋ ha mali tahima la a sani.
en: In righteousness you answer us, by your awesome deeds, God of our salvation— you, who are the security of all the far edges of the earth, even the distant seas.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee kuhi pam; bɛ daa kumiya pam dindali yuŋ maa.
en: The entire community raised their voice and the people wept that night.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa zaŋ ti mɔɣilɔnim yili tihi.
en: On the willows near by we hung up our harps.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daantalisi maa sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdali luɣa zuɣu; yini daa sala nudirigu polo, ka din la mi sa nuzaa polo. Ka bɛ daa boli din sa nudirigu polo maa Jachin, ka boli din sa nuzaa polo maa mi Bɔaz.
en: The columns were set at the sides of the Temple entrance: the one on the south side was named Jachin and the one on the north side was named Boaz.

dag: Bɛ ti yɛn zahindila kom kɔpu buyi tir a ka a nyura. A ni ti nyuri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a nyu li saha shɛli.
en: You can drink only cups of water each day. You can drink it from time to time throughout the day.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan kahig o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa wuhi, ka yo o ni tum taal shɛli maa samli zaa, ka lan yo di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi n-zaŋ li ti o ni tum so taali maa.
en: You must confess that sin. Then you must fully pay for that wrong thing you did. You must add one-fifth to the payment and give it all to the person you had done wrong to.

dag: Ka paɣitali dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi, ka o daa saɣim o ni mali shɛlikam timanim sani ka sokam tib o je la.
en: A woman was there who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on doctors, but no doctor was able to heal her.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas, ka o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la yɛli ba, Yi ʒi shɛli!.
en: One of them, named Caiaphas, who was High Priest that year, said, What fools you are!.

dag: O ni daa woligi Izraɛlnim bahi ka chɛ Juda zuliya saha shɛli maa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam leei bɛ naa. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yihi Izraɛlnim Yawɛ jɛmbu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi pam.
en: When Israel broke away from Davids dynasty, they made Nebats son Jeroboam the king. Jeroboam drove Israel away from the LORD. He caused them to commit great sin.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o tiliginsim shee bi wɔɣa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd o sani din ni chɛ ka o jilima kul kpalim be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: He will soon save his faithful followers. His glory will again live in our land.

dag: Timmi bɛ ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa chaŋ maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Shɛmaya ŋun nyɛ Nɛhilam nir la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Shɛmaya ni tɔɣisi ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-chɛ ka yi niŋ ʒiri yɛda ka di pala mani n-tim o na la zuɣu.
en: Jeremiah, send this message to all the captives in Babylon: This is what the Lord says about Shemaiah, the man from the Nehelam family: Shemaiah has spoken to you, but I didnt send him. He has made you believe a lie.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Asha mini Mikimɛtat din be Shɛkɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka di tintariga bɔbili daa zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Ɛntapuanima.
en: The lands of Manasseh were in the area between Asher and Micmethath. This is near Shechem. The border went south to the En Tappuah area.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ pun ku gbuɣima mini kunduna, ka Filistia do so ŋun bi guni ŋɔ gba ni lee bɛ ni yino, dama o ta Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ tɔbbihi daɣiri.
en: I killed both a lion and a bear like that! And I will kill that foreigner, Goliath, just like them. Goliath will die because he made fun of the army of the living God.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tinsi tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin di ti chɛnya binvuhirigu kam;.
en: But in the case of any of the cities of these peoples—the ones the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance—you must not spare any living thing.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka yihi Juda zuliya mini Simiɔn zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti ni boli tin shɛŋa yuya ŋɔ tinsi shɛŋa ti ba.
en: The towns in the territories of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin, mentioned above, were also assigned by drawing lots.

dag: Dama lala naan nyɛla zaɣ biɛtitali di naan nyɛla bibiɛlim tuuni.
en: To do such a thing would be shameful, a sin that must be punished.

dag: N suhu ŋmanila wain koligu din pali wain, ka n yi bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di ni tahi.
en: Look, my belly is like unopened wine; like new wineskins it will burst.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli neesim maa wuntaŋ ni, ka boli zibisim maa mi yuŋ. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din daŋ tooni.
en: God named the light Day and the darkness Night. There was evening and there was morning: the first day.

dag: ka n chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni a ku kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga n-ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: By the LORD, God of heaven and earth, give me your word that you wont choose a wife for my son from the Canaanite women among whom I live.

dag: Aai, bɛ zaa pa shɛli, bɛ tuma ka buchi; bɛ binnana gba ka yiko.
en: Those gods are all less than nothing. They cannot do anything. They are worthless.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya o ka baŋ ni o dɔni nimaani yuui maa ka o bɔh o, A bɔri ni a nya alaafee.
en: Jesus saw him lying there, and he knew that the man had been sick for such a long time; so he asked him, Do you want to get well.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, chamiya ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛlimuɣisir shɛli ŋɔ. Bɛ tiŋ maa ka dunɔdaya bee dunokparitisi. Di ʒiɛla di ko.
en: Come on! We'll attack those people that feel safe and secure! Their city has no gates or locks and is completely unprotected.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ayi yuli booni Gihɔn. Dina n-nyɛ din zɔri gindi Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The name of the second river was Gihon. This river flowed around the whole land of Cush.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du mɔɣili maa ni bɛ ti zaŋ naa malibu duhi na, ka niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm. Naa ni daa ti yɛn du mɔɣili maa saha shɛli, ka Shimɛi Gɛra bia maa daa kana ti damdi naa tooni.
en: They crossed the river to escort the royal party across and to do whatever the king wanted. As the king was getting ready to cross, Shimei threw himself down in front of him.

dag: Ka o yɛl o ba, M bihi m-bala, Naawuni ni ti ma bi shɛb ya ŋɔ m-bala. Ka o daa yɛl o, Niŋm ania, zaŋm ba ti ma na ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Joseph answered, These are my sons, whom God has given me here in Egypt. Jacob said, Bring them to me so that I may bless them.

dag: Ka saɣiŋgu kul be di puuni, ka nahiŋgu mini ŋarili kul be di ni.
en: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.

dag: O ni ti kana ti saɣim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ, ka chɛ ka alɔbo di di ni yɛn di shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb daba, ka chɛ ka tɔbu mi di di ni yɛn di shɛba.
en: He will come here and attack Egypt. He will bring death to those who are to die. He will bring captivity to those who are to be taken captive. And he will bring the sword to those who are to be killed with a sword.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan malila chɛchɛbunsi yuri duri tuhi pihinahi; ka mali wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi.
en: Solomon had forty thousand horse stalls for his chariots and twelve thousand additional horses.

dag: Ka yi ni yi alahichi tumbu dabitim ni la zuɣu chɛ ka yi yipa leela wuntia daba.
en: Now that you have been set free from sin, you have become slaves of righteousness.

dag: Goma tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi zaa mini Bɛtitɔgarima din be nuzaa polo la tɔbbihi zaa be a sani, bɛ galisiya pam.
en: Gomer and all his troops, Beth-togarmah from the far north and all his troops; many peoples are with you.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam lihi paɣa kɔre lihigu pun niŋ zina ni paɣ maa o suhu ni.
en: But I tell you that if a man looks at a woman and wants to sin sexually with her, he has already committed that sin with her in his mind.

dag: Naawuni ni booni so Nyɛvili Yɛligu la daa pun bela piligu ni, ka ti daa wum o yɛla, ka ti nini daa nya o ka ti lih o hal ka ti zaŋ ti nuhi tabis o.
en: We want to tell you about the Word that gives life—the one who existed before the world began. This is the one we have heard and have seen with our own eyes. We saw what he did, and our hands touched him.

dag: Zaŋm a nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ di bɛ dabisa nyaɣisim kaman tumtumdiba la.
en: So stop watching us; leave us alone, and let us enjoy this hard life until we have put in our time.

dag: Daadam, sabimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yuli sɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Babilɔn naa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Son of man, write todays date and this note: On this date the army of the king of Babylon surrounded Jerusalem.

dag: ni o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-tiligi bɛn be fukumsi zaligu maa sulinsi ni, ka zaŋ ti leei ŋun Naawuni bihi.
en: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.

dag: O kul gbibila bɛ kɔba zaa, ka di zaɣ yini gba ku kabigi.
en: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili buɣim di ba, ka n labisi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I will show them my anger—I will completely destroy them. I will punish them for the evil things they have done. It is all their fault. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ ŋmɛnditoya nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme ba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gil ba nyaŋ ba, ka Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛmaŋ zuɣu zabbu.
en: So the LORD became angry with Israel, and he handed them over to raiders who plundered them. He let them be defeated by their enemies around them, so that they were no longer able to stand up to them.

dag: Amaa hal Taitus ŋun daa be n san la ni daa kul nyɛ Giriiki maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi muɣis o ni o guni.
en: However, not even Titus, who was with me and who was a Greek, was required to be circumcised.

dag: ni Jahaz ni Kɛdɛmɔt ni Mɛfaat.
en: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath.

dag: Ka Aduna daa lan kɔri naɣilaa mini piɛlaa bɛn daa nyɛ niriba maa suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri la, ka o bidibisi maa daa taɣi binʒim zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: Aaron then slaughtered the ox and the ram—the peoples communal sacrifice of well-being. Aarons sons handed him the blood, which he tossed against all sides of the altar.

dag: O daa yi ti chɛ ka bɛ kpira, bɛ ŋmaligirimi lab o sani ti niŋ tuuba, ka jɛmd o ni nimmoo.
en: But whenever God killed them, they went after him! They would turn and earnestly search for God.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka zaŋ yi nuhi tum tuma n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi tum yimaŋ barina. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you did not listen to me. This message is from the Lord . You worshiped idols that someone made, and that made me angry. And it only hurt you.

dag: Ka wula ka yi lee tɛhira? So yi mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka bɛ ni yino ti bɔrigi, o ku chɛ kɔbigayinika la zoya zuɣu bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu?.
en: If a man has sheep, but one of the sheep is lost, what will he do? He will leave the other sheep on the hill and go look for the lost sheep. Right?.

dag: Bumiya tɔbu zambu bahi bɛ zuɣu luɣilikam. Bɛ gbaɣisi tɔbu; bini din taɣi ba luya. Bɛ daai di goma luhi. Dama Yawɛ m-bɔhi ba biɛri maa. Bɔhimiya ba biɛri. Niŋmiya ba kaman bɛ gba ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: Raise a victory shout against her on every side! Shes surrendered; her towers have collapsed; her walls are destroyed. This is the LORDs retribution; now pay her back: do to her what shes done to others!.

dag: Ibram daa lan yɛli, Nyama, a ni bi ti ma bia maa zuɣu, bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so n yiŋ puuni la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: He continued, Since you havent given me any children, the head of my household will be my heir.

dag: O nam maa dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa ti karindi litaafi kasinim ni, ka tɛhiri Jɛrusalɛm ni wurim doya yuun pisopɔin kaman Naawuni ni daa pun yɛli anabi Jɛrimia shɛm la yɛla.
en: During his first year as king, I was studying the Scriptures and noticed in the Lord s message to Jeremiah that years would pass before Jerusalem would be rebuilt.

dag: A soli daa timla teeku ni gari, ka a sɔbil mi tim ko titaŋa ni gari, amaa ka so daa bi nya ka a napom bɔba doya.
en: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.

dag: ka bɔh o, Ka bindir bɔ ka a lee mali? Tim ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu bee a ni kul mali bindir shɛli kpe.
en: Now, what food do you have with you? Give me five loaves of bread or whatever you have to eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi yihiri waazu yɛri ni Masia daa neei kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka yi ni shɛb yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani?.
en: So if the message that is preached says that Christ has been raised from the dead, then how can some of you say, Theres no resurrection of the dead?.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa n-yiɣisi lab doo maa sani yaha.
en: Take Benjamin with you and leave at once.

dag: Ka bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔb tusaanu laasabu m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: There were about , men who ate, not counting the women and children.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala Yaakubu zuliya ni, ka o ku lan di shɛhira bee n-garigi yɛtɔɣ shɛli bee n-zaŋ pina na ti ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: May the Lord remove from the community of Israel those who did this, and never again let them participate in the offerings our nation brings to the Lord Almighty.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi baŋdi n yɛligu gbinni? Yi ni bi deeri n yɛligu maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi baŋdi di gbinni maa.
en: You dont understand the things I say, because you cannot accept my teaching.

dag: Ka sokam daa kpuɣ o laa m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu. Ka bɛ mini Musa ni Aduna daa zani Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Then every person took his censer, placed fire on it, put incense on it, and stood at the entrance of the meeting tent with Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ansarisimaana bɔrila yɛm kɔŋda, amaa baŋsim yɛla bi to ŋun mali tɛhi zilima sani.
en: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn be dahima biɛhigu Ziɔn zuɣu. Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be luɣ viɛlli shee Samaria Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ninvuɣ kara bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni kani shɛb sanna nti bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: How terrible it will be for you that have such an easy life in Zion and for you that feel safe in Samaria—you great leaders of this great nation Israel, you to whom the people go for help!.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Pul daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-ti Asiria Naa Pul ni o sɔŋ o ka o kul su o nam maa.
en: King Pul of Assyria came to fight against Israel. Menahem gave Pul , pounds of silver so that Pul would support him and help him gain complete control of the kingdom.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni nya tibigibu yi sani, ka yi gba nya tibigibu o sani ti Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika zuɣu.
en: Then the name of our Lord Jesus will be honored because of you, and you will be honored because of him. This can happen only by the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: n wahala ŋɔ zaa lan chɛmi ka dabiɛm mali ma; dama m mi ni a ku yɛli ni n ka taali.
en: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be nam ʒiishee maa tooni ŋ-ŋmani teeku kom din be kaman takɔriti diɣisi kɔtomsi la, ka lan be kaman diɣi la. Ka binnɛma anahi bɛn nyɔri zaŋ tabili bɛ puya mini bɛ nyaansi daa pali nina gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.

dag: Amaa Dauda tɔbbihi maa bɛn daa kula Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Abinɛr tɔbbihi maa ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: But Davids soldiers had defeated the Benjaminites, killing three hundred sixty of Abners soldiers.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali. Ka dabisi shɛli din paya n-nyɛ biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, bɛ daa bi lan ku so pahi. Bɛ daa zaŋ dindali maa leela suhupiɛlli chuɣu dabisili.
en: This was on the thirteenth day of Adar. On the next day, the fourteenth, there was no more killing, and they made it a joyful day of feasting.

dag: Yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti! Ti bi tum yi ni so taali; ti bi saɣim yi ni so; ti mi bi di yi ni so zalinsi.
en: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri bɔɣiri ni ti kabi. Amaa Yawɛ ni sɔŋ wuntizɔriba.
en: The wicked will be destroyed, but the Lord cares for those who are good.

dag: N daa zaŋ liiga viɛlli yɛl a, ka zaŋ gban duɣira namda pir a, ka zaŋ bɔb piɛlli bɔb a, ka zaŋ chinchin nyɛlisira sol a.
en: I gave you a nice dress and soft leather sandals, a linen headband, and a silk scarf.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni yi dooi samafuu pa yaɣiri duɣu zuɣu shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla o noli ni, ka zaɣ biɛɣu be o suhu ni.
en: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.

dag: bee gomnanim bɛn nyɛ o ni tim shɛb ni be ti darigi bɛn tumdi taali tibili, ka paɣi bɛn tumdi tuun suma la.
en: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.

dag: Di simdi ka a chibi di nyiŋgoli ka o zuɣu ni tooi kpe di ni, ka a ti niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili kaman bɛ ni niŋdi kur tolinli niŋdi gbaɣino nyiŋgoli shɛm la ni kaman teela ni niŋdi shɛm la din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: Make a hole in the center for the head. And sew a piece of cloth around the edge of this hole. This cloth will be like a collar that keeps the hole from tearing.

dag: Zomiya dinkam nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and don't have anything to do with evil.

dag: Ka o chɛ, ka chaŋ ŋun paya sani ti yɛl o kaman o ni yɛl o bikpɛm maa shɛm maa. Ka o saɣi yɛli, M ba, n ni chaŋ; amaa ka bi chaŋ.
en: Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. Yes, sir, he answered, but he did not go.

dag: Naawuni, nyam ti nyɔtaɣirigu, lihim a ni pii na so ŋɔ ninni!.
en: God, watch over the king, our protector. Be kind to him, the one you have chosen.

dag: bee do so ŋun napɔŋ bee o nuu mali daŋa.
en: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed.

dag: Zaŋm a tuma niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni, ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa niŋ pali.
en: Commit your work to the LORD, and your plans will succeed.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi tɛr ni bahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Sujee mini suhuyiɣisili ni biɛr biɛɣu. Ka di chɛliya ka turi mini yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na.
en: But now put these things out of your life: anger, losing your temper, doing or saying things to hurt others, and saying shameful things.

dag: Miri ka a bo yomyom n-zaŋ a nuhi pa so zuɣu m-piig o ni o tum ti Duuma tuma; a mi miri ka a chɛ ka a nuu be so daalahichi tumbu ni. Gbib amaŋa m-be kasi.
en: Dont rush to commission anyone to leadership, and dont participate in the sins of others. Keep yourself morally pure.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali ninkuunsi ka ku tiri ninkura jilima bee n-niŋ bipola nirilim.
en: These people will be cruel. They will not care about old people or show mercy to young children.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza naai Ijipti daazichi zaa.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will use the king of Babylon. I will use Nebuchadnezzar to destroy the people of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ zuɣu sahakam, ka suhimiya Naawuni din ni chɛ ka yi nya kpiɔŋ nti tiligi din ti yɛn niŋ maa ni, ka ti zani Daadam Bia tooni.
en: Stay alert at all times, praying that you are strong enough to escape everything that is about to happen and to stand before the Human One.

dag: ka di nyɛ niriba bɛn gili ya wuna, bɛn be yoma bee katiŋ ni yinima, ka nyɛ bɛn be dunia yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la;.
en: Some of them may encourage you to worship the gods of the people who live near you or the gods of those who live far away.

dag: saha shɛl o firila ni daa ne n zuɣusaa, ka n dol o firila maa neesim gari zibisim ni la.
en: Gods light shined above me, so I could walk through the darkness.

dag: Yawɛ yɛm puuni ka o daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. O yɛla baŋbu puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: The LORD laid the foundations of the earth with wisdom, establishing the heavens with understanding.

dag: Dama ti Duuma kul ku zaɣisiri nir sahakam.
en: He should remember that the Lord does not reject people forever.

dag: Lɛvinima m-bɔŋɔ: Azania bia Jɛshua la mini Binnui Hɛnadad daŋ ni nir la ni Kadimiɛl.
en: The Levites: Jeshua, Azaniahs son; Binnui of the descendants of Henadad; Kadmiel.

dag: Yi ni tooi gaŋ niriba ti o? Yi ni tooi zabi Naawuni zuɣu?.
en: Will you be partial or contend for God?.

dag: Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ti, o ni zaŋ ti tahi tiŋgban shɛli din vuhiri maa ni nti zaŋ li ti ti.
en: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will take us there and give us that rich and fertile land.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm a yɛm tuma puuni, amaa lee di chɛ ka o zuɣu ti paligi ka o kpi ni suhudoo.
en: You know what to do; you must not let him die a natural death.

dag: Bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini bɛ zuɣulaannim ni daa bi baŋdi anabinim yɛligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi karindi Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, ka daa bi baŋ Yisa ni nyɛ so la zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ o puhi kubu, ka lala daa chɛ ka anabinim yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: For the people who live in Jerusalem and their leaders did not know that he is the Savior, nor did they understand the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath. Yet they made the prophets' words come true by condemning Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Kpe ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ti yɛn be, ka Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn zaŋdi sara nyɔri buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu be kpe.
en: David said, The Temple of the Lord God and the altar for burning offerings for the Israelites will be built here.

dag: Lala ka n yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Zaŋm a nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni, ka jɛm o min o niriba ka be.
en: I said the same thing to King Zedekiah of Judah, Submit to the king of Babylonia. Serve him and his people, and you will live.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi doli buzɔŋ dunoli kpe, ka dula gooni kpe dilan nyɛla tayiɣa ni ŋmɛnditoli;.
en: Jesus said, It is certainly true that when a man enters the sheep pen, he should use the gate. If he climbs in some other way, he is a robber. He is trying to steal the sheep.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba na ti yɛli ba, Saha shɛli din gari la puuni, yi daa kul bɔri ni Naa Dauda n-leei yi naa.
en: Abner went to the leaders of Israel and said to them, For a long time you have wanted David to be your king.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ gba mi Timoti ni pun kpaŋd omaŋ shɛm m min o ni laɣim kaman ba min o bia n-tumdi lahibal suŋ tuma la yɛla.
en: And you yourselves know how he has proved his worth, how he and I, like a son and his father, have worked together for the sake of the gospel.

dag: bɔhim dunia ni tihi ka di wuh a; ka teeku ni zahim ni yɛl a.
en: ask the creatures of earth and sea for their wisdom.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Jɔshua, Ti nyɛla a daba. Ka Jɔshua bɔhi ba, Banima n-lee nyɛn ya? Ka ya ka yi lee yina.
en: Then they said to Joshua, We are your servants. Joshua said to them, Who are you? Where have you come from.

dag: ka Tɔa nyɛ Zuf bia, ka Zuf nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Mahat bia, ka Mahat nyɛ Amasai bia.
en: son of Zuph son of Elkanah son of Mahath son of Amasai.

dag: Bɛnkam mali ba mini bɛnkam niŋ ba naani ni be kaman bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa maa.
en: Those who make idols and trust in them will become just like the idols they have made.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa gbaag o n-kpaɣ o nina, ka zaŋ o tahi Gaza ti zaŋ daanya bandi baŋ o, ka chɛ ka o niɛmdi chi sarika ni.
en: The Philistine men captured Samson. They tore out his eyes and took him down to the city of Gaza. Then they put chains on him to keep him from running away. They put him in prison and made him work grinding grain.

dag: N ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka yaŋɔ paɣisara ti kana ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom.
en: I will stand here by the spring while the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.

dag: Nama ŋɔ tariga paabu yi ti miri, ka bɛ leei ninvuɣ biɛri n-simdi tibidarigibo, na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ hal kpiɔŋlana ni baŋda ni ninvuɣ yɔhinda.
en: When the end of those kingdoms is near and they have become so wicked that they must be punished, there will be a stubborn, vicious, and deceitful king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o nachimba ka bɛ ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣiri mini bɛ naba n-zaŋ li ti lo n-yili baɣili Hiburɔn biaŋ. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu maa ti sɔɣi Abinɛr siliga din be Hiburɔn la ni.
en: So David commanded his young helpers to kill Recab and Baanah. The young men cut off the hands and feet of Recab and Baanah and hanged them by the pool of Hebron. Then they took the head of Ish Bosheth and buried it where Abner was buried at Hebron.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni paai Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ni ti yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, ka bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni suhugarigu naai.
en: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu din mali nyɛvili ka ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu ka yi nya dɔɣim palli, ka yɛligu maa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din bi kpira, ka mi ku pooi.
en: You have been born again. This new life did not come from something that dies. It came from something that cannot die. You were born again through Gods life-giving message that lasts forever.

dag: Pa ti yaannim kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ŋɔ, amaa tinim bɛn zaa na be ti nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: not only with our fathers, but with all of us who are living today.

dag: amaa ka bɛ zaŋ nyini bahila katiŋ kaman bimpɔŋ la ka chɛ a gballi; ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb pa a zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi kuɣa bɔɣili ni kaman niriba ni nɔri kpiin shɛb garita.
en: But you are cast away from your own grave like a rejected branch, covered by the dead and those pierced by the sword— who go down to the stony pit— like a trampled corpse.

dag: N teeya ni n ni daa naɣ lan baptaizi shɛb nyɛla Stɛfanas yiŋnima, din mi nyaaŋa m bi tɛhi ni n lan baptaizi so yaha.
en: Oh, I baptized the house of Stephanas too. Otherwise, I dont know if I baptized anyone else.

dag: Dama di ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka chɛ ka a biɛhigu tɔŋ pam.
en: My teaching will give you a long and prosperous life.

dag: Ŋunkam chihi Bia maa, o ka ti Ba Naawuni. Ka ŋunkam deei Bia maa mali ti Ba Naawuni gba.
en: Everyone who denies the Son does not have the Father, but the one who confesses the Son has the Father also.

dag: Naftali tiŋgban ni bɛ daa yihila Kɛdɛshi din be Galili la mini Hamɔn ni Kiriataim ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: In the territory of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam wum n yɛligu ka niŋ ŋun tim ma na maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka bɛ ti ku lan kar o saria, dama o pun yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni.
en: I assure you, anyone who hears what I say and believes in the one who sent me has eternal life. They will not be judged guilty. They have already left death and have entered into life.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya daa lab mali me tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Dibɔn mini Atarɔt ni Aroa.
en: The people of Gad built the cities of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer.

dag: Di saha ka Stiivin daa yɛli, Nyamiya, n nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Daadam Bia la ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: Stephen said, Look! I see heaven open. And I see the Son of Man standing at Gods right side.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo kul niŋdila bɛ suhuri ni yu ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti gbahi ba kɔri la; bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ ni bi baŋ yɛl shɛŋa gbinni. Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman biŋkɔbiri la.
en: But these false teachers speak evil against what they dont understand. They are like animals that do things without really thinking—like wild animals that are born to be caught and killed. And, like wild animals, they will be destroyed.

dag: amaa chamiyala Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la sani.
en: But go to the people of Israel. They are like sheep that are lost.

dag: Naawuni daazichi min o yɛm ni o baŋsim galisiya pam! Naawuni ni maani yɛla shɛm to ni baŋbu, ka o soya yɛla gariti sokam!.
en: How great are God's riches! How deep are his wisdom and knowledge! Who can explain his decisions? Who can understand his ways?.

dag: Hɛshibɔnnima, kuhimiya, dama Ai wurimya. Raba paɣiba, kummiya. Somiya buri; kummiya, ka fiɛbimiya yimaŋ fiɛbisi. Dama bɛ ni ti gbahi Milikom min o tindaannima ni bɛn jɛmd o daba chaŋ.
en: People in Heshbon, cry because the town of Ai is destroyed! Women in Rabbah of Ammon, cry! Put on sackcloth and cry. Run to the city for safety, because the enemy will take away the god Milcom, with his priests and officials.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum tuun viɛl shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni sab li shɛm Yawɛ zaligu kundi ni la.
en: Everything else Josiah did while he was king, from the beginning to the end of his rule, is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah . The book tells about the way he served God faithfully by obeying the law of the Lord .

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti kpe ŋariŋ ni ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du teeku ŋɔ duli ha. Ka bɛ dii gbaai chandi.
en: One day, Jesus and his disciples got into a boat, and he said, Let's cross the lake. They started out.

dag: Bɛ daa lan niŋ o yiko ni o lo tɔbu tuhi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nyaŋ ba. Ka lan niŋ o yiko ni o su dɔɣim kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima.
en: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.

dag: Do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa bi tɔɣisi ti suhumahili yɛtɔɣa, ka yɛli ni ti nyɛla puɣisiriba bɛn kana ni ti ti puɣisi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: The man, the countrys governor, spoke to us with a harsh tone and accused us of being spies in the country.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa lu o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa yirigi zana pil o n-gbaag o bɛ ni daa gbi bɔɣ shɛli sɔŋ ni.
en: Nations plotted to kill him, and people came from all over to spread out a net and catch him in a trap.

dag: Dinzuɣu, a yi yɛn tum shɛlikam, nyin tummi li ni a kpiɔŋ zaa; dama kpiimba biɛhigu shee din nyɛ a ni kuni luɣ shɛli maa, tuun shɛli bee tɛhi shɛli bee baŋsim bee yɛm ka nimaani.
en: Every time you find work to do, do it the best you can. In the grave there is no work. There is no thinking, no knowledge, and there is no wisdom. And we are all going to the place of death.

dag: Ti mabihi, zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna mini ti ni ti yɛn laɣim tuh o sol la yɛla polo, ti suhiri ya.
en: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to be with him: I beg you, my friends.

dag: Ka bɛ daa maani niriba maa yɛla sahakam. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi yɛtɔɣ kpɛma n-kani Musa sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa maani li.
en: They served as judges for the people on a permanent basis, bringing the difficult cases to Moses but deciding the smaller disputes themselves.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn gbaag omaŋmaŋ naɣikpahi ni naɣinyaŋ bee naɣilaa m-mali suhudoo sara maligu, di simdi ka o zaŋla naɣ so ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa ti Yawɛ.
en: If the offering is a communal sacrifice of well-being, the one who offers the herd animal—whether it is male or female—must present a flawless specimen before the LORD.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Itiɔpianim maa ti Asa mini Judanima ka Itiɔpianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba ka bɛ yɛri taba, Nyamiya, bɛn zaa tɔɣisiri ŋɔ pala Galilinima?.
en: In amazement and wonder they exclaimed, These people who are talking like this are Galileans!.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan di li naɣila di gbinni ti niŋ pali Naawuni nam ni.
en: I tell you I will not eat another Passover meal until it is finally eaten in God's kingdom.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa, Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ di gbinni. Yi ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli.
en: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see. The Lord also said.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛl anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa, Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni zaɣis o noli, ka bi doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: and the old prophet spoke to the man of God from Judah. He said, The Lord said that you did not obey him! You did not do what he commanded.

dag: N zahimya ni ti ni diri wahala shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ bi saɣi shɛli ni ti zaŋ li buɣisi jilima shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn ti ti la.
en: We have sufferings now, but these are nothing compared to the great glory that will be given to us.

dag: A zaŋ sagbani lims amaŋa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti suhigu bi lan paar a.
en: You wrapped yourself in a cloud so that no prayer could get through.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag zaɣ nɛɔŋ, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba maa zaa.
en: Agag was the king of the Amalekites. Saul captured Agag alive. Saul let Agag live, but he killed all the men in Agags army.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu niriba maa zuɣu bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Aduna mali naɣibil so la zuɣu.
en: So the Lord caused a terrible sickness to come to the people. He did this because they told Aaron to make the golden calf.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-kpuɣ a bindoo chaŋ.
