en: Jesus told him, Pick up your mat and walk.

dag: Dinzuɣu n wum Izraɛlnim maa fabila zaŋ chaŋ Ijiptinim ni zaŋ ba leei daba maa polo, ka teei n ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Ive also heard the cry of grief of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians have turned into slaves, and Ive remembered my covenant.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma gbuɣinli nyinyɛhi ni bahi ka lan fa ma kunduŋ nyinyɛhi ni bahi ŋɔ ni lan fa ma Filistia doo ŋɔ gba nuu ni bahi. Ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, Chama, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The Lord has rescued me from the claws of lions and bears, and he will keep me safe from the hands of this Philistine. All right, Saul answered, go ahead and fight him. And I hope the Lord will help you.

dag: ni Ibram, .
en: and Abram, that is, Abraham.

dag: Dama nyama, Ijiptinim ni ti laɣim ba, ka Mɛmfisinim sɔɣi ba, ka lan deei bɛ daazinfa neen viɛla la, ka gɔhi bili bɛ yinsi.
en: When the disaster comes and the people are scattered, the Egyptians will gather them up—gather them for burial there at Memphis! Their treasures of silver and the places where their homes once stood will be overgrown with weeds and thorn bushes.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili shee dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ su kom.
en: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Meeting Tent. Wash them with water.

dag: N ni sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya maa bi wuhi ni yi ʒila yɛlimaŋli, amaa yi ni lee mi li ka baŋ ni ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ni la zuɣu.
en: I dont write to you because you dont know the truth but because you know it. You know that no lie comes from the truth.

dag: Dama Naawuni yɛliya: N daa wum yi suhigu n daalibarika saha, ka daa sɔŋ ya yi tiliginsim dabisili dali. Nyamiya! Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alibarika deebu saha. Nyamiya! Zuŋɔ n-nyɛ tiliginsim nyabu dabisili.
en: He says, I listened to you at the right time, and I helped you on the day of salvation. Look, now is the right time! Look, now is the day of salvation!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa nam puu niŋ Idɛn din be wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ o ni nam ninsal so maa niŋ nimaani.
en: The Lord made a garden in a place called Eden, which was in the east, and he put the man there.

dag: Di simdi ka bansi maa miri naŋgbaŋkuɣila din ti yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa yi ni ti yɛn zaŋ buɣiri teebuli maa la.
en: The rings that house the poles used for carrying the table should be close to the frame.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma, hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm yuun pihinahi puuni la zaa yoli.
en: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.

dag: N zɔnim ni m mini bɛn doli bi lan miriti ma n yuma maa zuɣu; hal n ʒiʒiinitab gba kaɣiri ma mi.
en: Because of my sickness, my friends and neighbors will not visit me; my family will not come near me.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yiinila yila maani ma ansarisi, ka n leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi.
en: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib gba zuɣu! Dama yi ʒiini niriba ʒi tibisi shɛŋa din ʒibu to, amaa ka yimaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ yi nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: Jesus answered, How terrible also for you teachers of the Law! You put onto people's backs loads which are hard to carry, but you yourselves will not stretch out a finger to help them carry those loads.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daansi ŋɔ ni ka bɛn tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni yɛn duɣiri niriba maa sara maligu binyara.
en: The man told me, These are the kitchens where the Temple servants are to boil the sacrifices the people offer.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni mini bɛn doli nyaaŋa zaa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: In front of Jesus and behind him, people went along shouting, Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord!.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn wuhiri binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din bi be kasi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri mini binshɛŋa din pa daɣiri.
en: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpalim be mɔɣu ni sɔɣisili shee din be Zif mɔɣu ni zoya tiŋgbɔŋ la ni. Ka Sool daa kul lihiri bɔr o dabisili kam, amaa ka Naawuni daa bi zaŋ o niŋ o nuu ni.
en: David stayed in hiding in the hill country, in the wilderness near Ziph. Saul was always trying to find him, but God did not turn David over to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa yinima n-daa tahi ma kpe na, amaa Naawuni n-daa tahi ma na nti zaŋ ma leei Firawuna ba ni ŋun su o yiŋnim zaa fukumsi, ka lan zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa zuɣulana.
en: You didnt send me here; it was God who made me a father to Pharaoh, master of his entire household, and ruler of the whole land of Egypt.

dag: Dabili yi di nam ni jɛrigu yi di nti yaɣi.
en: a slave who becomes a king, fools who have everything they need.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti mali Babilɔn naa ansarisi yɛli, Na putɔɣulan la luya ka ku lan tooi nahim so yaha!.
en: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased! How the flood has receded!.

dag: Ka puu atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti miri, ka wɔɣiri kɔba pihita la ni niriba ata daa chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni. Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: One year at harvest time, the Three Warriors went to meet David at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Iso zuliya ni nanim yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla kaman bɛ malibu mini bɛ biɛhigu shee ni daa nyɛ shɛm doli bɛ yuya. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: Esau was the father of these Edomite families: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, and Iram. Each of these families lived in an area that was called by the same name as their family.

dag: Dama o daa bi niŋ so nirilim, amaa ka daa naɣ lula faranim mini nandaamba ni suhugarigunim zuɣu n-ku ba.
en: That man never thought of being kind; he persecuted and killed the poor, the needy, and the helpless.

dag: Ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni zaŋdi ti tiŋgban ni bindir daŋda mini ti tia kam wala din daŋdi moobu zaa n-tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na yuuni kam.
en: We will take to the Temple each year an offering of the first grain we harvest and of the first fruit that ripens on our trees.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Midiannim nuu ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Once again the people of Israel sinned against the Lord , so he let the people of Midian rule them for seven years.

dag: Amaa a yi zɔri dabiɛm ni a chaŋ, nyin zaŋm a tumtumda Pura pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ.
en: But if you are afraid to attack, go down to the camp with your servant Purah.

dag: Man Yawɛ m-bol a wuntitali puuni. Mani n-gbaag a nuu ni ka gbib a. N zaŋ a mi lo niriba alikauli, ni a nyɛ zuliya kam neesim.
en: I, the Lord , have called you and given you power to see that justice is done on earth. Through you I will make a covenant with all peoples; through you I will bring light to the nations.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa pii Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili vinvamli polo maa n-daa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo. Bɛ ni daa woligi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself, and as he started out toward the east, he and Abram separated.

dag: Bɔ n-lee pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli nyabu. Naawuni ni daa pii niriba biɛla shɛb la n-naɣ nya li, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛn suhuri daa kpɛmmi.
en: So this is what has happened: The people of Israel wanted Gods blessing, but they did not all get it. The people he chose did get his blessing, but the others became hard and refused to listen to him.

dag: Ka o dii boli bɛ gba, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ ba Zɛbidii min o tumtumdiba ŋariŋ maa ni ka dol o.
en: At that very moment he called them. They followed him, leaving their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired workers.

dag: N yɛn zaŋla ziŋgoo kuhi a yɛno, ka chɛ ka a kɔsoya ni zahim kpe n-shɛbis a salichɛhi ni, ka n voog a yih a kɔsoya maa ni na n-tabil a kɔsoya maa ni zahim shɛb zaa bɛn be a salichɛhi maa ni zaa du duli.
en: I will set hooks in your jaws; I will make the fish from the Niles canals cling to your scales. I will drag you out of the Niles canals, and also all the fish from the Niles canals clinging to your scales.

dag: Nyama, ti ni daa nya laɣ shɛli ti kpalansi noya ni la, ti daa ʒi li yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni labina ti ti a, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti ni ti zu anzinfa bee salima a dan yiŋa?.
en: We even returned the money we found in our grain sacks when we got back to Canaan. So why would we want to steal any silver or gold from your master's house?.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ kul ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The LORD will rule forever and always.

dag: Ka o daa gɔri gindi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: Then Jesus went to their synagogues everywhere in Galilee, where he preached and forced out demons.

dag: A tiri ba faako wahala nyabu saha hal ka bɛ ti gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: You give them rest from days of trouble until a pit is dug to trap the wicked.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka yi mini ba tuhi, n ti ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbani maa hal napɔŋ ŋmɛbu yim gba tin ya, dama n daa pun zaŋ Ɛdom Zoli maa tila Iso ni o su li.
en: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Ti yaannim Naawuni m-piig a ni a baŋ o yubu ka nya ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana n-wum o nol ni yɛligu;.
en: He said, The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will, to see his righteous Servant, and to hear him speaking with his own voice.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yi Ijipti kana ka bɛ ni sɔhiri kaman noombihi la. Ka shɛb ti yi Asiria kana kaman ŋmana la, ka n ti zaŋ ba labisi bɛ yinsi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will come from Egypt, as swiftly as birds, and from Assyria, like doves. I will bring them to their homes again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: di yi simdi ni bɛ bu ŋun mali taali maa, dindina sariakarita maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o sɔŋ n fiɛb o o ninni, ka o fiɛbbu kalinli yɛn dolila o taali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If the judge decides a person must be beaten with a whip, the judge must make that person lie face down. Someone will beat the guilty person while the judge watches. The number of times he must be hit depends on the crime.

dag: Saɣisigu kpɛri ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima pam n-gari bɛ fiɛbi jɛrigu fiɛbiga bukɔbiga.
en: A rebuke goes deeper to an understanding person than a hundred lashes to a fool.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nanim ni tum zina ni paɣ so, ka dunianim zaa nyu o zina maa wain n-kul la.
en: The kings of the earth practiced sexual immorality with her, and the people of the world became drunk from drinking the wine of her immorality.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli, Bolimiya maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ti ma. Ka bɛ daa ka naa sanna.
en: King David said, Bring me Zadok the priest, the prophet Nathan, and Benaiah, Jehoiadas son. They came to the king.

dag: ŋun daa be yi tooni mali ya be soli chana ni o ti bo palo tin ya ka yi ti yi suɣa dɔni la yɛda. O daa bela buɣim ni yuŋ, ka be sagban ni wuntaŋ ni ni o wuhi ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: even though he always went ahead of you to find a place for you to camp. To show you the way, he went in front of you in a pillar of fire by night and in a pillar of cloud by day.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o nuu niŋ Ibrahimma gbalipina lɔŋni, ka po pɔri zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: So the servant put his hand under his masters leg and made the promise.

dag: Yi daa lan nya bɛ binyoya din nyɛ buɣa din mali daɣiri ka nyɛ dari mini kuɣa ni anzinfa ni salima din daa be bɛ san la.
en: You saw their hated things—the idols they had made from wood, stone, silver, and gold.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaija daa garigi yɛli ba, N yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni nira, Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa luna n-di a min a tɔbbihi pihinu ŋɔ. Di saha ka Naawuni buɣim daa shiri yi zuɣusaa luna n-di sapashini maa min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa.
en: Elijah said to them, If I really am a man of God, may fire come down from the sky and burn up you and your fifty soldiers. Then Gods fire came down from the sky and burned up the commander and his fifty soldiers.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na chana, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna nti tiriti wuhir o Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duri.
en: Now Jesus left the temple and was going away. His disciples came to point out to him the temple buildings.

dag: Yinim gba maliya suɣilo lala; ka kul maliya suhukpeeni, dama ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!.

dag: Di yi pala Yawɛ m-me yili, bɛn mɛri li dirila wahala yoli. Di yi pala Yawɛ n-guli tiŋa, tiŋguliba gul li la yoli.
en: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba mini bɛ mabia Simiɔn zuliya niriba daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Keenannim bɛn be Zɛfat la n-ku ba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Hɔrima.
en: Some Canaanites lived in the city of Zephath. The men of Judah and men from the tribe of Simeon attacked them and completely destroyed the city. So they named the city Hormah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa je suli Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu; ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then David got angry because the LORDs anger lashed out against Uzzah, and so that place is called Perez-uzzah today.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ʒi tibisa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, o ni sɔŋ ya; o kul ku chɛ wuntizɔra bahi.
en: Give your worries to the Lord , and he will care for you. He will never let those who are good be defeated.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili ŋme ma mi gari, ka a ni lu n zuɣu ka di mali dabiɛm shɛm bahi jahi ma.
en: Your furious anger crushes me; your terrible attacks destroy me.

dag: Yawɛ, a yi yɛn niŋ ti daalahichi laasabu, ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee ni tiligi?.
en: Lord , if you punished people for all their sins, no one would be left alive.

dag: O ni daa sɔɣ o maa nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, N yi ti kpi, yin zaŋmiya ma sɔɣi ti ni sɔɣi anabi ŋɔ gbal shɛli ni ŋɔ n-zaŋ n kɔba sɔŋ baɣil o kɔba.
en: He said to his sons, When I die, bury my body next to this prophet.

dag: dindina n ni zo ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ darigi yi tibili buyopɔin yi daalahichinim maa zuɣu.
en: then I will really show my anger! I—yes, I myself—will punish you seven times for your sins.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla bɛ ni zɔri so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni, o nyɛla ŋun galisi ni ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm gari bɛnkam zaa gil o.
en: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.

dag: Nyama, karimbaannima! Bɛ suhuri ni tɛha bi tuhi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni bela bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: And this is the message: Those who are evil will not survive, but those who are righteous will live because they are faithful to God.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛl Yawɛ sani, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn be tibi yi suhuri ni mi, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu.
en: Good people, rejoice and be very happy in the Lord . All you who want to do right, rejoice!.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni dabili mini Yisa Masia tuun so o ni tim ni n ti kpaŋsi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda yɛda mini bɛ yɛlimaŋli baŋbu din nyɛ din luri Naawuni sizuura la sanna.
en: From Paul, a slave of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. Im sent to bring about the faith of Gods chosen people and a knowledge of the truth that agrees with godliness.

dag: dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, ti yi kul niŋ ti ni daa tuui mali tahima shɛl la naani viɛnyɛliŋga hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: We have the honor of sharing in all that Christ has if we continue until the end to have the sure faith we had in the beginning.

dag: Lɛvinim tuma soli ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn nyɛ yuun pisinaanu zaŋ chana ni tooi piligi laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni tuma tumbu.
en: Levites who are between the ages of and must work at my sacred tent. But once they turn , they must retire.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋdi anzinfa pari sania zuɣu zahindi li, ka zaŋdi bɛ kola ni salima pahiri tiri machɛlinim ka bɛ maani wuna tiri ba, ka bɛ damdiri tiŋ jɛmdi li!.
en: Those who pour out gold from a bag and weigh silver with a balance hire a metalworker; then he makes a god. They bow down; they worship.

dag: A yi mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni a yɛli, nyin garigim ma. Tɔɣisima, dama m bɔri ni n wuhi ni a ka taali.
en: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.

dag: dama n yɛri ya mi ni zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ hal ka Naawuni nam ti kana.
en: I tell you that from now on I will not drink this wine until the Kingdom of God comes.

dag: Ka Mikaya yɛl o, A yi labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-wuhi ma n ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka lan yɛli, Yinim salo ŋɔ zaa, wummiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Micaiah said, Listen to me, everyone! Ahab, if you come back alive from the battle, the Lord has not spoken through me.

dag: Laɣimmiya dakuɣiri duhi, ka niŋ buɣim niŋ li n-niŋ binnyoma niŋ nimdi maa ni duɣi li, ka chɛ ka di kɔba di buɣim.
en: Put plenty of wood under the pot. Light the fire. Cook the meat until it is well done. Mix in the spices, and let the bones be burned up.

dag: M pun po n kasitali pumpɔŋɔ ni sahakam; n ku ŋma Dauda ʒiri.
en: Once and for all I have promised by my holy name: I will never lie to David.

dag: ka tiligi bɛ shihi ka di ku kpe gballi ni; ka chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.

dag: A daanabinim nyala ʒiinim din pa yɛlimaŋli mini ʒiinim din nyɛ yɔhiŋ. Bɛ bi kahigir a daalahichi wuhir a din ni chɛ ka a yi dabitim ni. Amaa bɛ tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka di kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Your prophets gave you worthless and empty visions. They didnt reveal your sin so as to prevent your captivity. Instead, they showed you worthless and incorrect prophecies.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then his son Jehoram became the next king.

dag: Zoya nyɛligirimi kaman kpam la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ dunia zaa Duuma ŋɔ tooni.
en: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

dag: dama yɛm soli ka a ni tooi doli tuh a tɔbu, ka saawaranim pam mi chɛ ka nir diri nasara.
en: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka noli yɛlibu yɛla ŋɔ zaa di yi dimnim bɛn daa nahim ya la.
en: He will turn all these curses against your enemies, who hated you and oppressed you.

dag: Amaa duŋtaariba mini alahichinim zaa ni ti bahi yoli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ mi ni ti kpi.
en: But all the criminals and sinners will be destroyed. Those who stopped following the Lord will be removed.

dag: Buɣisim nya Yawɛ ni viɛli shɛm; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo nti sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: Taste and see how good the LORD is! The one who takes refuge in him is truly happy!.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi zaa n-zaŋ li chaŋ yoli, yi ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: Your wealth and belongings I will deliver as plunder, without a fee, because of all your sins throughout your territory.

dag: N yi di daa bi tum daadam ni na ʒi n-tum tuun shɛli bɛ sani, bɛ naan ku mali taali; amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nya n ni tum shɛlikam maa, ka yaɣ di zuɣu zaɣisi m mini m Ba zaa.
en: I did things among the people of the world that no one else has ever done. If I had not done those things, they would not be guilty of sin. But they have seen what I did, and still they hate me and my Father.

dag: Naawuni ni be ti polo zuɣu, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn no n-taai ti dimnim maa ti ti.
en: With God we will triumph; hes the one who will trample our adversaries.

dag: Cham maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia sani nti chɛ ka o mali dunɔguliba bɛn zaani Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni n-deeri laɣ shɛli niriba ni zaŋdi tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la laasabu.
en: Go to the high priest Hilkiah. Have him carefully count the money that has been brought to the LORDs temple and that has been collected from the people by the doorkeepers.

dag: ni Goshɛn ni Holɔn ni Gilo: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara piniyini m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh: eleven cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: N daa mali nyɛvili saha shɛli n ni daa na ʒi zaligu yɛla la, amaa n ni daa ti baŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa, ka alahichi neei ka man lee kpi.
en: I used to be alive without the Law, but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Doli ma, ka chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba.
en: Follow me, Jesus answered, and let the dead bury their own dead.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla mani bee bɛna, lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri tiri ya, ka lahibal suŋ maa mi nyɛ yi ni daa niŋ shɛli yɛda la.
en: So then, whether you heard the message from me or them, this is what we preach and this is what you have believed.

dag: So yi zaŋ o buŋa bee o nahu bee o piɛɣu bee o biŋkɔb so ti o kpee ni o zali, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa bee bɛ taɣ o pah o tab ni chaŋ ka so bi nya o.
en: When someone gives a donkey, ox, sheep, or any other animal to another person to keep safe, and the animal dies or is injured or taken and no one saw what happened.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ saguya ŋɔ, baŋmiya, jɛra ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn niŋ yɛm?.
en: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kana ti teei gili yi fɔntinsi zaa hal ka yi goon wɔɣila shɛŋa din gili ya, ka yi niŋ li naani ŋɔ ti lu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Bɛ ni ti teei gili ya yi fɔntinsi zaa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni.
en: They will attack every town in the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and the high, fortified walls in which you trust will fall.

dag: daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm.
en: went into the boat with Noah. These animals went into the boat in groups of two, male and female, just as God commanded.

dag: Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa kunila luɣ yini, taŋkpaɣu ni ka bɛ yina, ka bɛ zaa lan yɛn labila taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: The bodies of people and animals end the same way. They came from the earth, and, in the end, they will go back to the earth.

dag: ka Asiriɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Asiriɛlnima, ka Shɛkɛm daŋ niriba nyɛ Shɛkɛmnima.
en: Asriel, Shechem.

dag: Dama bɛnkam zaa tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim mini bɛnkam zaa bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bi bɔri shɛba.
en: The Lord hates people who cheat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Naa Hɛzɛkia sani ti yɛl o, Ti mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bimbini mini di lahi zaa; ni bɛ ni zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro kasi tamdi teebuli shɛli zuɣu la mini di lahi zaa.
en: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ mi bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ku ma. Di chɛ bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi a sani. Chɛ ka bɛ lu a tooni, ka a darigi bɛ tibili a suhuyiɣisili ŋɔ saha.
en: Lord , you know about their plans to kill me. So dont forgive their crimes or erase their sins. Make them fall down in defeat. Punish them in your anger!.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n ka kpe ŋɔ na ni n ti tumla a yubu kaman di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm nyin Naawuni Kundi ni la. .
en: So then I said, Look, Ive come to do your will, God. This has been written about me in the scroll. .

dag: Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ tooni na ti gbani? N zaŋmi yuun yini naɣ bihi ka o tooni na nti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la?.
en: With what should I approach the LORD and bow down before God on high? Should I come before him with entirely burned offerings, with year-old calves?.

dag: Bɛn daa kari doli ti maa daa guuri gari tɔrili ni yiɣiri zuɣusaa shɛm la. Bɛ daa kari doli ti la zoya zuɣu, bɛ daa gu ti la soli mɔɣu ni.
en: The men who chased us were faster than eagles in the sky. They chased us into the mountains. They hid in the desert to catch us.

dag: ka yi chaŋ Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni n-chaŋ ti zani salichɛhi dunɔdali ni m moli n ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ nimaani.
en: Go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the front of the Potsherd Gate. I have a message I want you to announce there.

dag: Areebianim mini Kɛdar nabihi zaa daa nyɛla a daabi yurisi bɛn niŋdi piɛnyama mini piɛlahi ni buhi daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: Arabia and all the leaders of Kedar traded lambs, rams, and goats for your goods.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka bɔh o nyaandoliba maa, Bɔzuɣu ka yi karimba maa mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira.
en: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners.

dag: ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkania bia la daa nyɛ Dauda daŋ zuɣulana. Ka Zakaria daa nyɛ Parɔsh daŋ zuɣulana, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pah o zuɣu sabi bɛ yuya daa nyɛ dɔbba kɔbiga ni pihinu.
en: from the descendants of Shecaniah: the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and other men;.

dag: Bɛ zaa kala damli dambu na. Ka bɛ nina kul lihiri tooni; ka laɣisiri daba kaman taŋkpaɣu la.
en: They come for violence, the horde with all their faces set toward the desert. He takes captives like sand.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Duuma Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba ni doli solɔri n-kumdi ka fabindi yɛra, Mbaye! mbaye! Bɛ ni ti boli pukpariba na ti pahi bɛ ni tiri shɛb liɣiri ka bɛ kumdi kuyila zuɣu, ka bɛ kum ka fabili.
en: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.

dag: A ni ti nyu m-buɣi, ka nya suhugarigu. A biɛli Samaria pipia maa nyɛla bahiyoli mini dabiɛm pipia.
en: You will be filled with drunken sadness. A cup of devastation and dismay is the cup of your sister Samaria.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa birili, ka kpihim yuŋ shɛli bɛ ni daa yɛli, Bɛ zali bidibbil puu la gba birili.
en: Perish the day I was born, the night someone said, A boy has been conceived.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Menahem did what the Lord said was wrong. He did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat who caused Israel to sin.

dag: o ni daa wum Lazarɔs bariŋ maa yɛla o daa kpalim o ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa n-niŋla biɛr ayi pahi;.
en: When he heard that Lazarus was ill, he stayed where he was. After two days.

dag: Amaa Absalom daa bi yɛli Amnɔn zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, dama o daa lan je Amnɔn yɛlli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi niŋ o tizɔpaɣ Tama shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Absalom never spoke to Amnon, good word or bad, because he hated him for raping his sister Tamar.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Judanima, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi zo n-kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Judah was defeated by Israel, and everyone ran home.

dag: Dama piɛguliba maa nyɛla jɛra, ka bi bɔhiri Yawɛ ni bɛ baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ bi tɔŋda, ka bɛ piɛri zaa wurim kpe yɔɣu.
en: The shepherds are stupid. They dont try to find the Lord . They are not wise, so their flocks are scattered and lost.

dag: Ɛhab daa lan mɛla buɣili Ashɛra gba binnani zali. O daa tum din ni yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ suhu n-gari Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He also put up an image of the goddess Asherah. He did more to arouse the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than all the kings of Israel before him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa darig a tibili, ka filim a tarili, ka chɛ ka a tumd a dimnim bɛn nyɛ Filistianim yubu, bɛn nyɛ vi ni gbahi shɛba a biɛriyoli tuma maa zuɣu la.
en: So I used my power against you, cut off your allowance, and gave you up to the passions of the Philistine women who had been confounded by your infamous ways and had rejected you.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul tahiri bindira na ti tiri Naa Sulemaana mini bɛnkam zaa dir o yiŋa, bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o ni su gol shɛli, bɛ mi daa bi chɛri ka binshɛli poor o.
en: His twelve governors, each one in the month assigned to him, supplied the food King Solomon needed for himself and for all who ate in the palace; they always supplied everything needed.

dag: O lan yɛli ni a lɔri nia ni a chɛ ka anabinim moli gili Jɛrusalɛm puuni zaŋ chaŋ a polo n-yɛri ni a nyɛla Juda naa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Pɛriʒia naa. Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni a chirigim ma ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla maa.
en: You have also appointed prophets to make this announcement about you in Jerusalem: There is a king in Judah! Now, the king will hear of these reports, so come; lets talk together.

dag: Mani, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti guli m piɛri maa, ka n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ dɔni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Yes, I will feed my flock, and I will lead them to a place of rest. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini paɣiŋoo ni tiŋgbani din bi nyuri kom tiɣira ni buɣim din na ʒi n-yɛli, Di saɣiya.
en: the grave and a barren womb, a land never filled with water, and fire that doesnt say, Enough.

dag: Yɛndaannim bela neesim ni, ka jɛra mi be zibisim ni. Amaa m mi ni yɛl yini n-ʒe n-guli bɛ zaa.
en: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.

dag: Ŋunkam shihi ya, n nimbiɛlim ka o shihi maa. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zaŋ o yɛligu tim ma ni n yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn nahind o niriba la:.
en: Anyone who strikes you strikes what is most precious to me. So the Lord Almighty sent me with this message for the nations that had plundered his people:.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi n-dol o kaman naɣilaa ka bɛ vɔri chani ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la bee n-nyɛ tɔŋtɔŋ kaman molifu n-zɔri chani tɔŋ ni la.
en: He goes headlong after her, like an ox to the slaughter, like a deer leaping into a trap.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa lola alikauli din ka lɔrigibu n-zaŋ nam ti Dauda min o bidibisi ni bɛ su Izraɛlnim ʒiɛmani kam ni?.
en: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.

dag: Nyama, bihi ayi bɛn nyɛ Zadok bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan be bɛ sani nimaani, a ni tooi tim ba ka bɛ kana ti yɛli ma a ni wum shɛlikam zaa. .
en: Zadoks son Ahimaaz and Abiathars son Jonathan will be with them. You can send them to tell me everything you hear.

dag: A teei teeku pa di zuɣu kaman binyɛrigu la, ka chɛ ka kom lim zoya.
en: You covered it with the watery deep like a piece of clothing; the waters were higher than the mountains!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa daa gbaai Firawuna kpamba maa shɛb dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zo n-kuli yiŋ yomyom.
en: Some of the king's officials were afraid because of what the Lord had said, and they brought their slaves and animals indoors for shelter.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ, Nyin Yawɛ, a daa yɛli ma, Labim a ya min a dɔɣiriba sani ka n niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Then Jacob said, God of my father Abraham! God of my father Isaac! Lord , you told me to come back to my country and to my family. You said that you would do good to me.

dag: Ka Nail Mɔɣili maa puuni zahim zaa daa kpi n-niŋ kom maa ni, ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim daa kɔŋ Nail Mɔɣili maa ni kom maa nyubu; ka ʒim daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The fish in the Nile died, and the Nile began to stink so that the Egyptians couldnt drink water from the Nile. There was blood all over the land of Egypt.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di chɛ ka a nuzaa mi a nudirigu ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Jɛrusalɛm shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A piligu shee mini bɛ ni dɔɣ a luɣ shɛli nyɛla Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A ba daa nyɛla Amɔri nira, ka a ma mi nyɛ Hiti nira.
en: You must say, This is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Look at your history. You were born in Canaan. Your father was an Amorite. Your mother was a Hittite.

dag: N yɛn chɛmi ka zuliya shɛb yi katiŋ kana ti liri yinim Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla zuliya kurili. Yi bi mi zuliya maa yɛtɔɣa bee yi ti tooi baŋ bɛ ni yɛri shɛm gbinni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am about to bring a distant nation against you, people of Israel, declares the LORD. It is an established nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you dont know, whose speech you wont understand.

dag: ka di ti pali, ka bɛ vo li duhi dul na nti ʒini n-gahim zin suma niŋ piɛri ni ka zaŋ zaɣ biɛri bahi.
en: It was full, so the fishermen pulled it to the shore. They sat down and put all the good fish in baskets. Then they threw away the bad fish.

dag: Bɛ chanila bɛ zaɣim, ka ka situra, ka ʒiri kabɔba, ka kum mali ba.
en: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.

dag: Di simdi ka dari maa ti kpalim be adaka maa bansi maa ni, di ti yihiya li.
en: The poles are to be left in the rings and must not be taken out.

dag: Dindali maa ŋun ti be dufahirili zuɣu ka o nɛma be duu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe n-kah o nɛma maa. Ka ŋun mi ti be puu ni di lan kuli yiŋa.
en: On that day, those on the roof, whose possessions are in the house, shouldnt come down to grab them. Likewise, those in the field shouldnt turn back.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mɛri tandi mi daa zaŋla takɔbi n-so o shee ni ka mɛra. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa piɛbiri kikaa gba daa kul baɣi ma.
en: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mali sochandiba kpɛhili shee tiŋgban nɛli ni, n di naan chɛ n niriba ŋɔ ka zo, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni nyaanyiriba.
en: I wish I had a place to stay in the desert where I could get away from my people. They are all unfaithful, a mob of traitors.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa asiba, zaŋ chani zaawuni ka m paɣa kpi. Dindali maa yi biɛɣu asiba ka n daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni zali ma shɛm maa.
en: Early in the day I was talking with the people. That evening my wife died, and the next day I did as I had been told.

dag: Ka o daa lan gbihi n-zahim zahindi din pah ayi. Kawaan kara ayopɔin din viɛla n-daa nyaɣi kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu.
en: The king went back to sleep and had another dream. This time seven full heads of grain were growing on a single stalk.

dag: Naa Bɛlishaaza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka man Daniɛl daa nya ʒii din pah ayi.
en: After that vision, I, Daniel, saw another vision during the third year that Belshazzar was king.

dag: Ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti ku tooi labi. Ti tizo ŋɔ yi ku dol ti chaŋ, dindina ti ku chaŋ; dama ti tizo maa yi ka ti sani, doo maa nini ku nya ti.
en: But we told him, We can't go back to Egypt without our youngest brother. We will never be let in to see the governor, unless he is with us.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia A min a bia Shiajashub cham Ahaz sani. O be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ la polo kpaluhi solɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: But the LORD said to Isaiah, Go out to meet Ahaz, you and your son Shear-jashub, at the end of the channel of the Upper Pool, by the road to the field where laundry is washed.

dag: ka hal dɔro maa ni daa mali ma maa zaa yoli, di zuɣu daa bi chɛ ka yi zo ka chɛ ma, ka mi daa bi mali ma ansarisi n-ʒiɛm ma, amaa ka daa deei ma kaman Naawuni malaika bee kaman Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa.
en: Though my poor health burdened you, you didnt look down on me or reject me, but you welcomed me as if I were an angel from God, or as if I were Christ Jesus!.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti ka lu ti zuɣu; a je suli niŋ ti. Labisim ti zali yaha!.
en: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!.

dag: Yi mi n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, ka mi di soli.
en: You know the way to where I am going.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛla ba, Di bi simdi ni bɛ chaŋ. Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di.
en: They don't have to leave, answered Jesus. You yourselves give them something to eat.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ninkuunsi takɔbi ŋɔ ni; fam ma tinzunnim nuu ni bahi. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. Hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: Save me from my cruel enemies; rescue me from the power of foreigners, who never tell the truth and lie even under oath.

dag: Ka Ribɛka dɔɣibu dali daa ti paai, ka jahi m-be o pul ni.
en: When the right time came, Rebekah gave birth to twins.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu maa sɔŋ baɣil omaŋ hal ka Yisifu dan maa ti kuna.
en: Then she kept his coat until her husband, Josephs master, came home.

dag: m bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam. Amaa bɛ bi tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: from youth people have constantly attacked me— but they havent beaten me!.

dag: ka daa ʒi nimaani gul o.
en: Then they sat down to guard him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: You people worshiping the Lord , say it: His faithful love will last forever.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o noli naai tinduyanima ni o yɔhim ba, ka o kpiɔŋ ni ti zoori pahira, hal o ni kul nyɛla ŋun yɛn di n-su la niriba biɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: From the moment they make an agreement with him, he will act deceitfully. He will gain power at the expense of a small nation.

dag: Ninvuɣ so sa di dol a duna, miri ka a chɛ ka ninvuɣ so sa be zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Miri ka a sa chɛ ka biŋkɔbbaligu bee niɣi ŋub mɔri zoli maa gbini.
en: No one is to come up with you; no one is to be seen on any part of the mountain; and no sheep or cattle are to graze at the foot of the mountain.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake maa daa duh o yee kuhi yɛli Judanim yɛtɔɣa puuni, Wummiya Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then the commander, shouting loudly in Hebrew, gave this warning to them all: Hear this message from the great king, the king of Assyria!.

dag: Benya n ni, ka n gba be yi ni. Tiwulli ku tooi wali wala dimaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka pa ni di tuɣila tia; yi gba ku tooi wali wala, shee yi tuɣila mani.
en: Stay joined to me and I will stay joined to you. No branch can produce fruit alone. It must stay connected to the vine. It is the same with you. You cannot produce fruit alone. You must stay joined to me.

dag: Ka n yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, n ni daa po pɔri ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you to Israels fertile land, to the land that I swore to give to your ancestors.

dag: Dali gba bɛ daa ni bɔ a pam kɔŋ, dinzuɣu cham yɛla ŋɔ ni daa yiɣisina ka a sɔɣi luɣ shɛl la nti ŋuni kuɣa din duhiya la lɔŋni.
en: The day after tomorrow your absence will be noticed even more; so go to the place where you hid yourself the other time, and hide behind the pile of stones there.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ nuzaa polo dunɔdali ni nti buɣisi li. Ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then the man took me to the north gateway. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, di daa niŋ o muɣisigu pam, ka o kpaŋ omaŋa m-bɔri soli ni o yihi Daniɛl, ka daa kul be lala nia niŋbu ni hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When the king heard this, he was upset and did his best to find some way to rescue Daniel. He kept trying until sunset.

dag: dama yɛlimaŋli maa be ti ni, ka kul ni kpalim be ti ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.

dag: Yi bi chaŋ dikiya din lu maa ni ti gu voya shee bee m-mali me gooni ti Izraɛlnima din ni chɛ ka tɔbu ti ku daai li luhi Yawɛ dabisili dali.
en: They don't guard the places where the walls have crumbled, nor do they rebuild the walls, and so Israel cannot be defended when war comes on the day of the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima ni o Ba Naawuni mini malaika kasinim jilima, o gba ni ti zo vi dilana zuɣu.
en: If you are ashamed of me and of my teaching, then the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zali sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zaligu ka zuɣusaa dunoya daa yooi;.
en: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.

dag: Wula ka bɛ zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi nya soli ka nyɛ Naawuni ni sa gariche gili so?.
en: But God keeps their future a secret and builds a wall around them to protect them.

dag: Yɛndana tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, jɛra bɛn tɛha puuni pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Wise people say things that give you new knowledge, but fools say nothing worth hearing.

dag: Bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la ni daa wum di gbinni ka di viɛl maa, ka o daa yɛli Yisifu, N gba sa zahimla zahindi. Bɔrɔbɔro piɛr ata n-sa tam n zuɣu ni.
en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to Joseph, It was the same for me. In my dream, there were three baskets of white bread on my head.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka nyɛ bɛn daa be Ɛfɛsus daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, ka dabiɛm kpe bɛ zaa, ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli daa du n-chaŋ haliya.
en: All the Jews and Gentiles who lived in Ephesus heard about this; they were all filled with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was given greater honor.

dag: Bɛ daa niŋ naani, ka naani goo ti kuhi ba. Ka bɛ daa ti paai, ka bɛ laasabu parigi.
en: They are sure they can find water, but they will be disappointed.

dag: Musa ni daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai.
en: When Moses finished giving these teachings to the people.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima din ŋmɛli kaman gabisi maa n-gɔhi bansi diba ayi din be nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya maa.
en: Attach the two gold cords to the two rings at the edges of the chest pendant.

dag: Naa Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa ti wum ni o bia Ahazia kpiya, ka o dii yiɣisi gbaai nabihi kubu.
en: Athaliah was Ahaziahs mother. She saw that her son was dead, so she got up and killed all the kings family.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kpi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣimna ti kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ yiŋa Rama. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Samuel died, and people from all over Israel gathered to mourn for him when he was buried at his home in Ramah. Meanwhile, David moved his camp to Paran Desert.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ yuli jilima din simd o, zaŋmiya pina ka o jɛmbu duu na!.
en: Give to the LORD the glory due his name! Bring gifts! Enter his courtyards!.

dag: Bɛ kpirila ninvuɣ kaha, ka bɛ nyɛviya bahigu nyɛla vi bahigu.
en: They will die while they are still young, like the male prostitutes.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa kul mɔhiri vuri yɛra, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But they kept shouting, Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross.

dag: Yi ni ŋubiri mo viɛla ŋɔ di bi saɣi? Ka wula ka yi lan nɔri mo shɛŋa din kpalim ŋɔ sɔŋdi tiŋa? Yi yi nyu ko viɛlli, di lan kpami ni yi zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli din kpalim?.
en: Some of you eat the greenest grass, then trample down what's left when you finish. Others drink clean water, then step in the water to make the rest of it muddy.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri naa nam dibu yuma ayopɔin la ni gol so ŋun pahir anu ni ka o daa paai Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: They reached Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king.

dag: Dahin shɛli o yi ti yɛn kpe luɣ kasi shee dundɔŋ ni ti tum tuma, di simdi ka o mali o daalahichi sara luɣ kasi maa shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and then go into the inner courtyard of the Temple and offer a sacrifice for his purification, so that he can serve in the Temple again. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yɛndan tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, amaa jɛrilim n-yiri jɛra noya ni na.
en: The tongue of the wise enhances knowledge, but the mouth of a fool gushes with stupidity.

dag: Jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla fiɛbiga n-fiɛbiri bɛ yaansi zuɣu, amaa yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa n-gbibi ba.
en: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.

dag: O chɛ ka sɔŋsim yi o jɛmbu duu mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na ti sɔŋ a.
en: Let God send help to you from the sanctuary and support you from Zion.

dag: Yisifu biɛyanim ni daa nya ka bɛ ba kpi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Di pa shɛli ka Yisifu zaɣisi ti ka bɔhi ti biɛri ti ni daa niŋ o zaɣ biɛ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: After Jacob died, Joseph's brothers said to each other, What if Joseph still hates us and wants to get even with us for all the cruel things we did to him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna din ka bukaata la zaŋ bɛ ʒiɛyimtali biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ a sani bahi.
en: Some people worship useless idols, but those statues never help them.

dag: ni Hashɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Gizɔn nir la ni Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Shage Harar nir la bia.
en: Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan, Shagees son from Harar.

dag: A ni ti kurigi zaa ka naanyi dɔn a gballi ni kaman bɛ ni yi chɛ siŋkaafa ti sɔŋ siŋkaafabɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: You will be like the wheat that grows until harvest time. Yes, you will live to a ripe old age.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti bɔhi naa, Wula ka ti mabihi Judanim ŋɔ lee sɔɣi zaŋ a min a malibu ni a niriba ŋɔ zaa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili na.
en: All the Israelites came to the king and said to him, Why did our brothers, the people of Judah, steal you away? Why did they bring you and your family back across the Jordan River with your men.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu nimaani ka o yɛli ma, Yiɣisim zani n-chaŋ vinvamli ni ka n ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: The Lord took control of me and said, Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti bi nya o, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti bo o shee.
en: When they didnt find Jesus, they returned to Jerusalem to look for him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu Dɛɛbi ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda, ka bɛ daa yi ni n-lab Listra mini Aikɔnium ni Antiɔk.
en: Paul and Barnabas preached the Good News in Derbe and won many disciples. Then they went back to Lystra, to Iconium, and on to Antioch in Pisidia.

dag: Samarianim daa bi tum a daalahichi ŋɔ pirigili, a tum din chihiri gari ba. Ka a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka a mabihi maa ŋmanila wuntizɔriba.
en: And Samaria did only half as many bad things as you did. You did many more terrible things than Samaria! You have done so many more terrible things than your sisters have done. Sodom and Samaria seem good compared to you.

dag: ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Buɣili ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na, ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama lala na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: They became afraid and said, Gods have come to their camp! Were in trouble. This has never happened before.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-nyɛ ŋun biri alikama biɛlin suma la.
en: Jesus answered: The one who scattered the good seed is the Son of Man.

dag: Ka ti daa yi Taai m-be kom maa ni m-mali ti paai Tolɛmais n-daa chaŋ ti puhi ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani, ka gbe bɛ sani dahin yini.
en: We continued our trip from Tyre and went to the city of Ptolemais. We greeted the believers there and stayed with them one day.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun kari zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam bahi ka chɛn ya, ka so na bi tooi zani yi tooni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: When you attacked powerful nations, the Lord made them run away, and no one has ever been able to stand up to you.

dag: Dama yi mi ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika ni nyɛ shɛm: O daa nyɛla bundana, amaa yi zuɣu ka o leei nandana ni yi leei bundaannima o nandaantali maa zuɣu.
en: You know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ; rich as he was, he made himself poor for your sake, in order to make you rich by means of his poverty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka o kukoli be o tɔbbihi tooni tahira. Dama o tɔbbihi galisiya pam, ka bɛn deer o noli ka kalinli. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ dabisili nyɛla dabisili titali ka mali dabiɛm pam. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li?.
en: The Lord calls loudly to his army. His camp is very large. The army obeys his commands. His army is very powerful. The Lord s special day is a great and terrible day. No one can stop it.

dag: Silas mini Timoti ni daa yi Masidɔnia paai Pool sani, o nini daa kul moola waazu yihibu zuɣu, ka o yɛri Yɛhudianim ni Yisa n-shiri nyɛ Masia.
en: When Silas and Timothy arrived from Macedonia, Paul gave his whole time to preaching the message, testifying to the Jews that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: Miri ka a nahind amaŋa buni nyabu zuɣu, niŋmi yɛm din ni chɛ ka a yi di yɛla ni.
en: Dont ruin your health trying to get rich. If you are smart, you will give it up.

dag: Bɛ paɣiri nir o yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ʒiɛmdi ŋun tɛha bi zilima.
en: You praise people for their intelligence, but no one respects those who are stupid.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ nimaani n-kpe duu maa ni ni o ti vuhi.
en: So one day Elisha came there, headed to the room on the roof, and lay down.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Izraɛlnim maa, Ijiptinim mini Amɔrinim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim.
en: The Lord answered the Israelites, You cried to me when the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, and the Philistines hurt you. I saved you from these people.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ puuni ti viɛla din nyɛ paain mini junipa ni sipirɛs dari n-kana ti mali n jɛmbu duu ka di viɛla, ka ti chɛ ka n naba tambu shee mali jilima.
en: The wood of the pine, the juniper, and the cypress, The finest wood from the forests of Lebanon, Will be brought to rebuild you, Jerusalem, To make my Temple beautiful, To make my city glorious.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku deei pin shɛli a sani. Ka Naaman daa balim o ni o deem li, amaa ka o zaɣisi.
en: But Elisha said, The Lord is the one I serve, and as surely as he lives, I will not accept any gift. Naaman tried hard to make Elisha take the gift, but he refused.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan pii Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba ni Izraɛl daŋ kam puuni kpɛma n-leei Jɛrusalɛm sariakaritiba ni bɛ kariti saria tiri Yawɛ, ka maani niriba yɛla. Bɛ daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jehoshaphat also appointed judges in Jerusalem from among the Levites, the priests, and the family heads of Israel to administer the LORDs Instruction and to settle disputes among those living in Jerusalem.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o zilinli ti anab Neetan ka o kana m-mi ti boli bia maa yuli Jɛdidia; di gbinni nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri so.
en: and sent word by the prophet Nathan to name him Jedidiah because of the LORDs grace.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o ni buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini di dubihi ni di nɛma ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni ni di zuɣusaa duri ni di puuni duri ni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo kuɣ ni ti yɛn be du shɛl ni gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for building the Temple. They included plans for the porch around the Temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper rooms, its inside rooms, and the room for the mercy-cover.

dag: Nyama, m bi ʒe yi nyaaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni nyo yi chɛchɛbunsi buɣim ka di gbili nyɔhi, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gbuɣim pola. N ni ti mɔŋ ya bindirigu, ka so ti ku lan wum yi tuumba kukoya.
en: Look! I am against you, proclaims the LORD of heavenly forces. I will burn your chariots in smoke; the sword will devour your young lions; I will cut off your prey from the earth, the voice of your messengers will never again be heard!.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kubiɛlima n-kuri takɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi su kara mi kuri kpana. Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ gbarima gba yɛli, Ti nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba.
en: Beat your plows into swords. Make spears from your pruning hooks. Let the weak man say, I am a strong soldier.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa dooi bini mali naɣibil zali ka daa yɛli, Yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti na la m-bɔŋɔ! la, bɛ daa mo nyin Naawuni pam.
en: They made an idol in the shape of a bull-calf and said it was the god who led them from Egypt! How much they insulted you, Lord !.

dag: Nimaani ka n yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuhi Izraɛlnima, ka n jilima ni ti chɛ ka nimaani mali be kasi.
en: I will meet with the Israelites there, and it will be made holy by my glorious presence.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim tahima; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha. Wula ka a be kaman sana n-nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee kaman yuŋ ni sabigi sochanda so ka o yɛn zani gbe luɣ shɛli maa?.
en: You are Israel's only hope; you are the one who saves us from disaster. Why are you like a stranger in our land, like a traveler who stays for only one night?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlim Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima ni Yawɛ yɛliya, N nyɛla yaɣimɛra, ŋun maani zaɣ biɛɣu shili n jɛndiri ya, ka lɔri di nia zaŋ chaŋ yi sani. Pumpɔŋɔ yi zaa zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu maa tumbu ni, ka taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma.
en: Now then, tell the people of Judah and of Jerusalem that I am making plans against them and getting ready to punish them. Tell them to stop living sinful lives—to change their ways and the things they are doing.

dag: Ka o naanyi zaŋ dari maa din kpalim mali o wuni zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li, ka suhiri li yɛra, Tiligim ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n wuni.
en: The rest of the wood he makes into an idol, and then he bows down and worships it. He prays to it and says, You are my god—save me.

dag: ni Gɛdɔr ni Ahio ni Zɛkɛr.
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Maika yiŋ maa chaŋ ha, ka Maika daa kuhi bol o ʒiʒiinitaba n-chɛ ka bɛ pah o zuɣu ka bɛ kari Dan zuliya niriba maa naba.
en: After they had gone a good distance away from Micahs house, the men who were in the houses around Micahs home were summoned for battle and caught up to the Danites.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa wuhi ma machɛlinim anahi.
en: Then the LORD showed me four metalworkers.

dag: Ka n ŋubirila naɣilahi nimdi bee n nyurila buhi ʒim?.
en: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?.

dag: Yino ni ti nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi chi sara zuɣu, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli Yawɛ sani.
en: one as a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering along with the grain offering. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation before the LORD for the person needing purification.

dag: ni Ɛlitɛke ni Gibɛtɔn ni Baala.
en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath.

dag: Ka bipuɣimbil maa daa ti yɛli Naaman paɣa, N di bi zaɣisi ka n dana chaŋ anab so ŋun be Samaria ŋɔ sani! O naan tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: She said to her mistress, I wish that my master could come before the prophet who lives in Samaria. He would cure him of his skin disease.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: At that time, the officers of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar attacked Jerusalem and laid siege to the city.

dag: Niriba pam n-nyɛ naa jilima, amaa niriba yi kani, naa pala shɛli.
en: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.

dag: Ka n lu tiŋa ka wum kukol shɛli damli ka di booni ma yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa Masia wuh o suɣilɔdibo zaa ni nyɛ shɛm man ŋun nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam zaa ŋɔ sani; ka di leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn niŋ o yɛda n-nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la ni ni doli so shɛli.
en: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.

dag: Mabi so bɛ ni tum taali mali yaa gari fɔntiŋ din nyɛ zaɣ titali, ka lala zabili ŋmanila dapua din kpari birini dunoli.
en: An offended ally is more formidable than a city; such quarreling is like the bars of a castle.

dag: Ka Anakinim maa ni so daa lan ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, naɣila Gaza mini Gaat ni Ashidɔd ka bɛ ni shɛb daa be.
en: The Anakim no longer remained in the land of the Israelites. They survived only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

dag: Amaa ŋun zaŋ omaŋa tabili ti Duuma min o leela shi yino.
en: But anyone who is joined with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

dag: Babilɔn yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni ʒiɛri tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm, lala ka mbusim pɔhim yɛn yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali dabiɛm ni na.
en: This is a message about Babylonia. Like a whirlwind sweeping across the desert, disaster will come from a terrifying land.

dag: A ni niŋ shɛm maa bi viɛla. Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi simdila kubu, dama yi bi gul yi dan naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyam naa kpan la min o ko gaɣili din ʒe o zuɣusaa la ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: What youve done is terrible! As surely as the LORD lives, all of you are dead men because you didnt keep close watch over your master, the LORDs anointed. Have a look around! Where are the kings spear and the water jug that were by his head.

dag: Naɣ kul miriya ka yi ti ŋubila binʒim, dama ʒim nyɛla nyɛvili, ka di bi simdi ni yi ti ŋubi nimdi mini di nyɛvili.
en: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.

dag: amaa ka n daa ti lan gariti nimaani ka bɛ kani; ka n lihi bo ba ka bi nya ba.
en: but later I passed by, and he wasn't there; I looked for him, but couldn't find him.

dag: Yɛndan nyɛla ŋun tumdi din tuhi, amaa ka jɛrigu mi nyɛ ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi.
en: The thoughts of the wise lead them the right way, but the thoughts of the foolish lead them the wrong way.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka chɛ bɛ taali, ka niŋ kaman a ni mi ka sokam biɛhigu nyɛ shɛm o suhu ni ti o.
en: Please listen to their prayer while you are in your home in heaven and forgive them and help them. Only you know what people are really thinking, so only you can judge them fairly.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu luɣ shɛli tam ni bi zilim pam n-dii bilina yomyom, nimaani tam ni bi zilim zuɣu.
en: Other seed fell on rocky ground where the soil was shallow. They sprouted immediately because the soil wasnt deep.

dag: Binnɛma zaa niŋgbuŋ bela kɔŋkɔbakɔŋkɔba: Ninsalinim niŋgbuŋ bela di ko, ka biŋkɔbiri niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka noonsi niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka zahim niŋgbuŋ mi be di ko.
en: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n yiŋa daa yɛra, Bɛnkam kpe yili ŋɔ na dirimi tiɣira.
en: All those who work for me know that I have always welcomed strangers.

dag: A ʒinila gar shɛli din mali jilima zuɣu, ka zaŋ teebuli zali di tooni n-zaŋ n tulaale zim mini n kpam tam di zuɣu.
en: You took your place on a splendid couch with a richly set table in front of it, and you set my incense and my oil on it.

dag: Yɛlim ti a ni tɛhiri shɛm: Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: So tell us what you think: Does the Law allow people to pay taxes to Caesar or not.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, A ku tooi nya n ninni, dama ninsal ku tooi nya n ninni ka lan be.
en: But, the LORD said, you cant see my face because no one can see me and live.

dag: Nadab bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sɛlɛd mini Apaim. Amaa Sɛlɛd ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Nadabs family: Seled and Appaim, but Seled died without children.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zuliya n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒini baɣili teeku. Bɛna n-nyɛ Jafɛt zuliya bɛn daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni, ka mali bɛmaŋmaŋ zuliyazuliya yɛtɔɣ kɔŋkɔba bɛ tiŋgban ni.
en: they were the ancestors of the people who live along the coast and on the islands. These are the descendants of Japheth, living in their different tribes and countries, each group speaking its own language.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu yo n-zaŋ li zali luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Put the mercy-cover on the Box of the Agreement in the Most Holy Place.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, deemiya saɣisigu, di yi pa lala n ni je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛn ya, ka chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: People of Jerusalem, let these troubles be a warning to you, or else I will abandon you; I will turn your city into a desert, a place where no one lives.

dag: Dinzuɣu do yino ŋun niŋgbuŋ daa gbarigi zaa la daa leei ŋun dɔɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi kaman saŋmarisi bee kaman teeku noli bihigu din ka kalinli ŋɔ.
en: Abraham was so old he was almost dead. But from that one man came as many descendants as there are stars in the sky. So many people came from him that they are like grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: To, Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni be vinvama ni la zuɣu, biɛɣuni, sa ŋmaligimiya kpe mɔɣu n-doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: in whose valleys the Amalekites and the Canaanites now live. Turn back tomorrow and go into the wilderness in the direction of the Gulf of Aqaba.

dag: Chɛ ka o dabisa filim, ka so deeg o zaani zani.
en: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.

dag: Nir suhu ni karimbaani n-tahir o saɣiŋgu na, amaa maŋsiɣisibu m-be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: A proud person will soon be ruined, but a humble person will be honored.

dag: Harim — kɔbisita ni pisi.
en: of Harim.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu zaa saɣimla Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman bɛ ni zaŋ mɔɣilo ŋmɛri nandahima yil shɛli.
en: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.

dag: Yawɛ ni wuhi ti o jilima, ka chɛ ka ti ʒini baɣili mɔɣ kara mini kulibɔna, amaa ka ti dimnim ŋarima ku gari nimaani.
en: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships.

dag: Ninvuɣ so sa di dol a duna, miri ka a chɛ ka ninvuɣ so sa be zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Miri ka a sa chɛ ka biŋkɔbbaligu bee niɣi ŋub mɔri zoli maa gbini.
en: No one will be allowed to come with you. No one should even be seen anywhere on the mountain. Even your herds of animals or flocks of sheep will not be allowed to eat grass at the bottom of the mountain.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba ni ti kari ba saria ka yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla sariakaritiba bɛn nyɛ bɛn niŋ zina ka ku niriba. Dama bɛ nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: Righteous men will condemn them on the charge of adultery and murder, because they practice adultery and their hands are stained with blood.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Asha zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their towns were in the land which the families of the tribe of Asher received as their possession.

dag: Tiŋgbani ni ti dam damdi biɛɣu n-tahi bɔɣi n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: The earth is shattering, shattering; the earth is shaking, shaking; the earth is teetering, tottering.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku zaŋ amaŋ ti ba, Yawɛ ni kahigi shɛli wuhi ma ʒii puuni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But if you refuse to surrender, this is what the LORD has shown me.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Yi gba nyɛla anabinim maa yaansi, ka su alikauli shɛli Naawuni ni daa lo yi yaannim maa. O daa yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni o zuliya zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika.
en: The promises of God through his prophets are for you, and you share in the covenant which God made with your ancestors. As he said to Abraham, Through your descendants I will bless all the people on earth.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Zanimi piɛgul zaani n-gul piɛ shɛb bɛ ni yɛn ku ŋɔ.
en: The Lord my God says, Care for the sheep that have been raised to be killed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N chɛ ka biisim ku yi bindira, ka chɛ ka toli saɣim yi puri mini yi tihi puri ni yi fiig tihi ni yi olivi tihi, di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I struck you with disease and mildew. I destroyed your gardens and your vineyards. The locust devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you didnt return to me, says the LORD.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhi tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli? bee Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, What answer did the Lord give? or What has the Lord said.

dag: Nuzaa polo dunɔdali maa tooni, dunoli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ ni kaman di ni daa be shɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka o daa buɣisi dunoli zaŋ ti kpa dunoli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: Across the courtyard from this north gateway was another gateway leading to the inner courtyard, just as there was on the east side. The man measured the distance between these two gateways, and it was feet.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Di tamya ni m bela bandi ni. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: With my own hand I write this: Greetings from Paul . Do not forget my chains! May God's grace be with you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yi yi ku wum n ni yɛli shɛm, Naawuni ni chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ tinzun yɛtɔɣa wuhi ya.
en: If you won't listen to me, then God will use foreigners speaking some strange-sounding language to teach you a lesson.

dag: O daa kaai gili nimaani tinsi zaa n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri pam m-mali ti paai Giriis.
en: On his way through Macedonia he had many words of encouragement for the followers in various places. Then he went to Greece.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.

dag: So daa bi zo a nambɔɣu n-niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli ti a nambɔzɔbo zuɣu. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ a mi ti bahi samban ni, dama bɛ daa zaɣis a mi bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli maa.
en: Not one person loved you enough to do any of these things, and no one even felt sorry for you. You were despised, thrown into a field, and forgotten.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka gbaŋŋmara Shafan lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma; ka daa zani naa maa tooni karim li.
en: Then he told the king, And Hilkiah the priest also gave this book to me. Then Shaphan read the book to the king.

dag: ni Hiburɔnnima ni ŋun Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa gɔri chani tiŋ shɛŋa zaa la nima.
en: and Hebron. He sent it to all the places where he and his men had roamed.

dag: Nachimba daa yi nya ma, bɛ labiri la nyaaŋa, ka ninkura yiɣisi ti ma jilima.
en: the young saw me and drew back; the old rose and stood.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛb daa bɔhi, Pa doo ŋɔ ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku la?.
en: Some of the people of Jerusalem said, Isn't this the man the authorities are trying to kill?.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubiri la bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi la hal ni daba ayɔbu, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, di simdi ni yi ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di ti tumiya tuun shɛli dindali maa.
en: You must eat unleavened bread six days. On the seventh day you must not do any work. On this day the people will come together for a special meeting to honor the Lord your God.

dag: N ni tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa. N suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din mali baŋsim.
en: I have some very wise words for you. My thoughts will give you understanding.

dag: Amaa a nini yi ti bi tiɣ o, nyin bahim o ka o chaŋ, ka di zaŋ o kɔhi. Di bi simdi ni a niŋ o kaman dabili la, a ni zaŋ o dɔni m-baŋ o daashil la zuɣu.
en: But if you arent pleased with her, you must send her away as she wishes. You are not allowed to sell her for money or treat her as a slave because you have humiliated her.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la, ka zaɣis o zaligunim gba dolibu.
en: He rejected the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and disobeyed the Lord 's commands.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti paai piɛri biɛhigu shee ka tampiŋ voli daa be nimaani so naŋgbanyee; ka Sool daa kpe di puuni ni o ti damdi yɔɣu ni ka Dauda min o niriba gba daa be voli maa puuni ha.
en: Saul came to some sheep pens beside the road. There was a cave near there, so Saul went in to relieve himself. David and his men were deep inside that same cave.

dag: ka Ɛlam daa pah anu ka Jɛhɔhanan pah ayɔbu, ka Ɛliɛhɔinai daa pah ayopɔin.
en: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a yi dol ti chaŋ, Yawɛ yi ti niŋ ti zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam, lala ka ti gba ni niŋ a.
en: If you go with us, whatever good the LORD does for us, well do for you.

dag: Bɛ teebuya zuɣu zaa nyɛla tiri, ka di luɣ shɛli ka nyam.
en: The tables where they sit are all covered with vomit, and not a clean spot is left.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna yiŋa n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: So Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord .

dag: ka Saimɔn Pita daa buɣisi yɛl o ni o wuhim ba Yisa ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: Simon Peter nodded at him to get him to ask Jesus who he was talking about.

dag: Faralan tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa ni sizuura lubu, amaa bundan ŋun kul tuhirimi bahira.
en: The poor are polite when they beg for help. The rich are rude with their answer.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ? O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni.
en: Jesus asked, What do you think the owner of the vineyard will do? He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.

dag: Ka Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia la daa leei bɛ zuɣulan saha shɛli ha, ka Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: In the past, Phinehas was in charge of the gatekeepers. Phinehas was Eleazars son. The Lord was with Phinehas.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ zaa saha shɛli, ka buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara shɛŋa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali duu maa.
en: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from the sky and burned up the burnt offering and the sacrifices. The Glory of the Lord filled the Temple.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yinim alahichinim ŋɔ yiɣisimi zani yi yaannim zaashee ni yi chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu!.
en: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dali ka bɛ mali shili, dama dali man Yawɛ ni yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu siɣina niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: and be ready by the day after tomorrow, when I will come down to Mount Sinai, where all of them can see me.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ bɛ nanim niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi ti kpihim bɛ yuya dunia ŋɔ ni. So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya hal ka yi ti ku bɛ zaa.
en: He will help you defeat their kings. You will kill them, and the world will forget they ever lived. No one will be able to stop you. You will destroy them all!.

dag: ka yɛli ma, Kɔniilius, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina shɛm la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: He said, Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and has seen your gifts to the poor. He remembers you and all you have done.

dag: Bɛ ni daa duri daboli n-kpɛri tiŋ maa ni, ka bɛ daa tuhi paɣisara soli ka bɛ chani kuliga, ka bɛ bɔhi ba, Ŋun nyari niriba yɛla la beni.
en: As they were going up the hill to the town, they met some young women coming out to get water, and the two men said to them, We're looking for the man who can see visions. Is he in town.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni ʒirinim lu n zuɣu. Bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me.

dag: ka daa tim o yiŋbihi ni bɛ ti yɛli o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na; amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi kandina.
en: He invited some people to the feast. When it was ready, the king sent his servants to tell the people to come. But they refused to come to the kings feast.

dag: N Duuma n-teegi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma ŋ-ŋɔ ni o yihi ma vi ni niriba sani maa.
en: This is the Lords doing. He has shown his favor to me by removing my disgrace among other people.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima din ŋmɛli kaman gabisi maa n-gɔhi bansi diba ayi din be nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya maa.
en: Put the two golden chains through the two rings at the corners of the judgment pouch.

dag: Ka o bapir daa ti bɔh o min o tumtumda maa, Ya ka yi lee chaŋ? Ka Sool garigi yɛl o, Ti daa chaŋla bunsi la bɔbu; ka daa ti bo ba je ka chaŋ Samuɛl sani.
en: Saul's uncle saw him and the servant, and he asked them, Where have you been? Looking for the donkeys, Saul answered. When we couldn't find them, we went to see Samuel.

dag: Naomi yidan Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣir so daa beni ka o yuli booni Bɔaz, o daa nyɛla bundana ni yulilana.
en: Naomi had a relative named Boaz, a rich and influential man who belonged to the family of her husband Elimelech.

dag: ka ʒi o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-labiri kuni ka karindi Anabi Aizaia litaafi.
en: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.

dag: Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda ŋun nyɛ Ibrahimma yaaŋa la zuliya ni na dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the family history of Jesus the Messiah. He came from the family of David, who was from the family of Abraham.

dag: Tiŋgbani maŋmaŋ n-chɛ ka di niŋdi maa: Tuuli, di tɔrimi duna niŋ vari; din paya, ka di ti va puya n-naanyi dɔɣi;.
en: It is the ground that makes the seeds sprout and grow into plants that produce grain.

dag: Ŋariŋ kara pala di kom zuɣu chana, ka Lɛviatan be di ni diɛmda.
en: The ships sail on it, and in it plays Leviathan, that sea monster which you made.

dag: Ka Judanim daa laɣim ni bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka o sɔŋ ba. Bɛ daa yila Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni n-laɣimna ni bɛ ti niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ.
en: The people of Judah came together to ask the Lord for help. They came from out of all the towns of Judah to ask for the Lord s help.

dag: Di saha maa o bikpɛm sani la ŋun daa na bela puu polo nti kun na miri yiŋ na wum diɛma biŋkumda kumsi.
en: In the meantime the older son was out in the field. On his way back, when he came close to the house, he heard the music and dancing.

dag: amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ ma niŋ piɛɣu ni n-kpuɣ ma tiri tiŋ maa gooni vol ni n-siɣisi tiŋ ha ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: But I was let down in a basket through an opening in the wall and escaped from him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni ʒirinim lu n zuɣu. Bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: because the mouths of wicked liars have opened up against me, talking about me with lying tongues.

dag: Di saha ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, Ka n yi chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yi yaannim Naawuni n-tim ma yi sanna. Ka bɛ bɔhi ma, O yuli lee booni bɔ? Man yɛlim ba wula.
en: But Moses said to God, If I now come to the Israelites and say to them, The God of your ancestors has sent me to you, they are going to ask me, Whats this Gods name? What am I supposed to say to them.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ti duɣi bindir suma n-di ka nyu binnyuri nyaɣisa, ka niŋya shɛli ti bɛn bi duɣi la, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ dabisili kasi. Di chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, dama Yawɛ ni tiri suhupiɛlli shɛli n-nyɛ yi kpiɔŋ.
en: Go, eat rich food, and drink something sweet, he said to them, and send portions of this to any who have nothing ready! This day is holy to our LORD. Dont be sad, because the joy from the LORD is your strength.

dag: A daa lan nya napɔnvari mini napombihi la ka di shɛli polo nyɛla yaɣiri, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ kuriti. Di nam maa ni ti pirigi. Di ni ti mali kuriti kpiɔŋ la shɛli, kuriti maa mini yaɣiri ni gari tab la zuɣu.
en: You also saw that the feet and the toes were partly clay and partly iron. This means that it will be a divided empire. It will have something of the strength of iron, because there was iron mixed with the clay.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa bahi noli, ka bɛ daa vihi luɣ shɛŋa litaafinim ni daa be Babilɔn.
en: So King Darius gave an order to search the writings of the kings before him. The writings were kept in Babylon in the same place the money was kept.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba bɛn miri ma na ŋɔ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi, di yi pa lala, man Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Even the priests who come near me must purify themselves, or I will punish them.

dag: Ifriimnim taɣirila pɔhim chana, ka zɔri doli wulimpuhili polo pɔhim dabisili kam. Bɛ ʒiri mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili kul pahirimi. Ka bɛ mini Asirianim niŋdi daabiligu, ka bɛ tiri Ijiptinim kpam.
en: Ephraim is wasting its time; Israel chases the wind all day long. The people tell more and more lies and steal more and more. They have made agreements with Assyria, and they are carrying their olive oil to Egypt.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣidira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: The Babylonian king provided him daily provisions for the rest of his life, right up until he died.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa yi nayili n-chaŋ ti yɛli naa.
en: Ebed-melech left the palace and said to the king.

dag: ka yɛra, A yi shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa, nyin tiligim amaŋa.
en: and said, Save yourself if you are the king of the Jews.

dag: Kumiya bɛ naɣilahi zaa. Kɔrimiya ba. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ biɛɣu neeya, bɛ tibidarigibo saha paaya.
en: Kill all the young men in Babylon. Let them be slaughtered like bulls. How terrible for them that their day of defeat has come! It is time for them to be punished.

dag: O zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ malibu yuya m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali ba m-baŋ bɛ kalinli la. Naa mini Jɛiɛl ni Zakaria.
en: His relatives, by their clans when their genealogy was listed in the records, were: Jeiel the first; Zechariah.

dag: Dama nyamiya, Yawɛ yɛn yila o biɛhigu shee na. O ni ti siɣina ti tam dunia ni daboya zuɣu chana.
en: Look! The LORD is coming out from his place; he will go down and tread on the shrines of the earth.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli Ilaija, Pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla Naawuni nira, ka Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli a ni mali tɔɣisiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Now I know that you really are a man of God, the woman said to Elijah, and that the LORDs word is truly in your mouth.

dag: Ti bi ŋmaligi ti suhuri ka chɛ a; ti mi bi birigi ka chɛ a soli.
en: We have not been disloyal to you; we have not disobeyed your commands.

dag: O ni daa ba n-chana, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni.
en: As he rode on, people spread their cloaks on the road.

dag: A kul moola a nini lihiri bɔri n shee kaman gbuɣinli la, ka lan tumdi tuma jɛndiri ma.
en: I could boast like a lion, and you would hunt me; you would do awesome things to me again.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ n ni be shɛm.
en: Tychicus, my loved brother and faithful servant of the Lord, can inform you about my situation and what Im doing.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dapuhi maa n-tuntu ban shɛŋa din daa be sara maligu bimbini maa luɣa zuɣu la ni, ka bɛ mal li kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa. O daa zaŋla taabo dari mal li, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu.
en: put them through the rings for carrying the altar, which was shaped like an open box.

dag: Dunɔdali daa be dundombil ni nudirigu polo. Ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti kpa dunɔdali din be nudirigu polo, ka di nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also meters.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni daa yihi sapir kɔb shɛli maa nam paɣa n-zaŋ o ti doo maa.
en: With the rib taken from the human, the LORD God fashioned a woman and brought her to the human being.

dag: Zaŋmi dam din kpɛma n-ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn kpi, ka zaŋ wain ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nandahima pam ni.
en: Give beer to people without hope. Give wine to those who are in trouble.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka labina.
en: After exploring the land for forty days, the spies returned.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ tan tolima anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: The workers joined the curtains together into two groups of curtains. They joined five curtains together to make one group and five curtains together to make the other group.
