dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka Babilɔnnim bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim mini bɛn tahiri damli dambu na, ka nyɛ bɛn chani gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa ni bɛ tuhi fa yiya din pa bɛ dini ŋɔ nya yaa.
en: I will make the Babylonians a strong nation. They are cruel and powerful fighters. They will march across the earth. They will take houses and cities that dont belong to them.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ kpi. Zaŋm ba zaɣ nɛma nti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama zaɣ biɛɣu m-be bɛ yinsi puuni mini bɛ suhuri ni.
en: I wish death would take my enemies by surprise! I wish the earth would open up and swallow them alive, because they plan such terrible things together.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda zuɣu ka Naawuni daa ŋmahi ba bahi, amaa nyin gba kpalim ʒiɛla a yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu. Dinzuɣu di nyuri bara; amaa chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: That is true. But those branches were broken off because they did not believe. And you continue to be part of the tree only because you believe. Dont be proud, but be afraid.

dag: Sɛt ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni anu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh.
en: When Seth was , he had a son, Enosh.

dag: Nandaamba ni ti di n-tiɣi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ni paɣ o. Naawuni chɛ ka yi kul tɔŋdi sahakam.
en: Poor people, come eat and be satisfied. You who have come looking for the Lord , praise him! May your hearts be happy forever.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni Hɔshaya bia Azaria ni niriba maa zaa, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura daa chaŋ.
en: While they were at Geruth Kimham, Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah went to Jeremiah the prophet. All the army officers went with Johanan and Jezaniah. All the people, from the least important to the most important, went to Jeremiah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni, ka daa bol li Dauda tiŋa. Ka Naa Dauda daa piligi me yiya Millo polo na ti gil li.
en: David lived in the fort and called it The City of David. David built up the city from the Millo inward.

dag: Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli: Zallakudura Naa yi di daa bi chɛ ti shɛba, ti naan kpi zaa kaman Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim la.
en: It is as Isaiah had said before, If the Lord Almighty had not left us some descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam neesim kara ayi n-chɛ ka din galisi pam la ne wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka din pa di zuɣu mi ne yuŋ; ka daa nam saŋmarisi gba.
en: God made the stars and two great lights: the larger light to rule over the day and the smaller light to rule over the night.

dag: Yɛm shɛli yɛla n ni mali tɔɣisiri maa nyɛla Naawuni daashili yɛmsɔɣirili shɛli o ni daa zali ti jilima nyabu zuɣu hal ka na bi nam dunia ŋɔ la.
en: We talk about Gods wisdom, which has been hidden as a secret. God determined this wisdom in advance, before time began, for our glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu o yidana maa yi na be o nyɛvil ni ka o chaŋ ti kul do so, bɛ ni bol o zinaniŋda; amaa o yidana maa yi kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni; ka o yi lan kul do so, dindina o pala zinaniŋda.
en: So then, if she lives with another man while her husband is alive, shes committing adultery. But if her husband dies, shes free from the Law, so she wont be committing adultery if she marries someone else.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam mini Balak daa doli chaŋ ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Huzɔt la.
en: So Balaam went with Balak to the town of Huzoth.

dag: Bɛ ku lan di jifa bee ŋ-ŋub nin shɛli din chihiri ŋubbu. Ka bɛ puuni bɛn kpalim ni leei n niriba, ka mali bɛ daŋ Juda zuliya puuni kaman Jɛbusinim la.
en: They will no longer eat meat with blood in it, or other forbidden food. All the survivors will become part of my people and be like a clan in the tribe of Judah. Ekron will become part of my people, as the Jebusites did.

dag: ka bɛ daa lan mali gbuɣima pinaayi n-tamtam dura maa yaɣ ayi maa zaa naŋgbaŋgbirima zuɣu. O nam ʒiishee maa ŋmali daa ka na so sani.
en: There were also two lions on each of the six steps, one at each end. There was nothing like it in any other kingdom.

dag: Ŋunkam ti zɔri ni o yi dabiɛm maa ni ni ti lu bɔɣili ni. Ka ŋunkam ti yiri bɔɣili maa ni na, tɔŋ ni gbaag o. Dama Mɔabnim tibidarigibo dali, n ni ti chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim niŋ ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; and if you crawl out of the pit, you'll get caught in a trap. The time has come for you to be punished. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be kurimbuni ha la, so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla. Lala n-nyɛ li ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn yi dunia palo ŋɔ ni na nyaaŋa ti ku teei bɛ gba yɛla.
en: People dont remember what happened long ago. In the future, they will not remember what is happening now. And later, other people will not remember what the people before them did.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣisiri nachimba ka bɛ niɛmdi zim, ka chɛ ka bidibisi ʒiri dabɔb kara chani ʒiɛhira.
en: The enemy made our young men grind grain at the mill. Our young men stumbled under loads of wood.

dag: N Duuma, wummi n kuhigu! Gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: My Lord, listen to me. Listen to my cry for help.

dag: Ŋunkam chihi Bia maa, o ka ti Ba Naawuni. Ka ŋunkam deei Bia maa mali ti Ba Naawuni gba.
en: For those who reject the Son reject also the Father; those who accept the Son have the Father also.

dag: Daanya kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛri mii barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili, ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la. Di daa deerila kom lita tuhi pihiyɔbu.
en: The large bronze tank was inches thick. The edge of the large tank was like the edge of a cup. The edge looked like a lily blossom. The tank could hold about , gallons.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin mi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi pɔhim ni, ka kukol shɛli daa yi jɛmbu duu nam ʒiishee la na n-tahiri pampam yɛra, Di naaya.
en: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl in the air. A loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, It is done.

dag: Di kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam kaman goli ŋun kul nyɛ shɛhiralana m-be sagbana ni ŋɔ.
en: and moon appear in the sky.

dag: Ŋunkam goli biŋkɔbigu kam, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who has sex with any kind of animal. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli.
en: God said to the people of Israel:.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe niriba maa, ka sokam ni ti gbaag o kpee nuu ni ka bɛ ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: On that day, a great panic brought on by the LORD will fall upon them; they will all grasp at the hand of their neighbors; neighbors will attack each other.

dag: yi mi miriya ka yi tam Man Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla. Kul miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: and you shall not forget the covenant I made with you.

dag: M mi ni n chandi nyaaŋa ninvuɣ kundun biɛri ni ti kana ti kpe yi ni, ka ku chɛ Naawuni piɛri maa.
en: I know that after I leave, some men will come into your group. They will be like wild wolves and will try to destroy the flock.

dag: M mabihi, yi zuɣu ka n zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmahindi m mini Apolɔs yɛla ni di chɛ ka yi doli di ni sabi yɛli shɛm, Miriya ka yi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali shɛm zuɣu. Di mi bi simdi ni yi ni so duhi karimba yino ka ʒiɛm karimba ŋun la.
en: For your sake, my friends, I have applied all this to Apollos and me, using the two of us as an example, so that you may learn what the saying means, Observe the proper rules. None of you should be proud of one person and despise another.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, Pirigim a ni ye binyɛr shɛli pa zuɣusaa ŋɔ n-teei li sɔŋ. Ka o daa pirigi li na, ka o tooi chi ka di ni paai kaman kilɔgiram pisi n-kpaai niŋ o di ni, ka kpuɣi li sɔŋ o ka o ʒi li kuli.
en: He said, Bring the cloak that you have on and hold it out. She held it out, and he measured out six measures of barley and placed it upon her. Then she went into town.

dag: ka di dolibu zuɣu chɛ ka n daa niŋ cheechi alaka. Ka ninsal ni ni doli Yɛhudianim zaligunim ka tooi mali wuntia biɛhigu shɛli di zuɣu la puuni, n daa ka taali.
en: I was so eager to defend my religion that I persecuted the church. And no one could find fault with the way I obeyed the Law of Moses.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla m min a ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛl la dina, Yawɛ ni be m min a sunsuuni sahakam.
en: But he will always watch us to make sure that we keep the promise we made to each other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni zɔri ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpamdi niriba jaande; amaa Naawuni mi ti biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka ti mali tahima ni yi gba mi li yi suhuri ni.
en: We know what it means to fear the Lord, so we try to help people accept the truth. God knows what we really are, and I hope that in your hearts you know us too.

dag: bɛ ni daa nahim ya, ka yɔhim ya Pɛɔr yɛla ni la mini Kɔzibi yɛla ni la zuɣu. Kɔzibi daa nyɛla Midian toondaan so bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ bɛ tizɔpaɣ so bɛ ni daa ku Pɛɔr alɔbo la dal la.
en: because of the evil they did to you when they deceived you at Peor, and because of Cozbi, who was killed at the time of the epidemic at Peor.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi mi ni pa naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ka ti daa zaŋ ka yi sanna; Naawuni mi n-nyɛ ti shɛhiralana ni ti pala diribarilimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa limsi diribarilim maa.
en: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din be dukpina ni ni kuhi bahi ya na, ka dapua din be dari ni garigi saɣi.
en: Even the stones of the walls cry out against you, and the rafters echo the cry.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka bɛ nyom yaɣi; ka bɛ ʒim ti zɔri teeni zoya zuɣu.
en: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.

dag: Sokam ni mali niriba ŋɔ ansarisi, ka salindi salima maani ba ansarisi yɛra, Mbusim be yinim bɛn laɣisi binshɛŋa din pa yi dini duhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Yi yɛn deeri binyara yi sandiriba sani sɔŋdi yi sani hal ti paai bɔ saha.
en: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.

dag: Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ naa sahakam. Ziɔn, Naawuni n-kul nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naawuni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and its drink offering.

dag: Naawuni, fam ma ʒim yihibu taali ni bahi; nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ n zilinli yili yila pam yɛl a fa m-bahi maa yɛla.
en: Deliver me from violence, God, God of my salvation, so that my tongue can sing of your righteousness.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti zani Niriba Dunɔdal la ni, Juda nanim ni doli shɛli yira, ka lan dol li kpɛri la, ka lan chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya zaa ni.
en: This is what the Lord said to me: Jeremiah, go and stand at the Peoples Gate, where the kings of Judah go in and out. Tell the people my message, and then go to all the other gates of Jerusalem and do the same.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, zuŋɔ ka bɛ mali bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, amaa di zaa yoli ka yɛla ŋ-ŋɔ ti paai ma! N yi di di alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ Yawɛ naan saɣi lala.
en: Their father Aaron replied, Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord , and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin.

dag: Tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim malila so shɛli din so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim dini? Aai, ti bi mali so shɛli din so. Di bemi kaman n ni pun yɛli shɛm la, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, alahichi nyaŋ bɛ zaa.
en: Well then, are we Jews in any better condition than the Gentiles? Not at all! I have already shown that Jews and Gentiles alike are all under the power of sin.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa tumdila din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din viɛla, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But all of them are corrupt; no one does right.

dag: ka Aduna bihi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa mali buɣim, ka malimali dari viɛnyɛla niŋ buɣim maa ni.
en: and the priests shall arrange firewood on the altar and light it.

dag: Kaman Yawɛ ni daa kul chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni kpiri shɛm la, lala ka yi gba yɛn kpi, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: If you do not obey the Lord , then you will be destroyed just like those nations that he is going to destroy as you advance.

dag: Pa Naawuni ŋun boli ya la n-nyɛ ŋun kari ya di ni.
en: It certainly wasnt the one who chose you.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa duh a niriba ni, ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Go and tell Jeroboam that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to him: I chose you from among the people and made you the ruler of my people Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu, poloya ŋɔ zaa ni yi a min a yiŋnim zaa yinsi, ka lan yi a kpamba min a niriba zaa yinsi. Bɛ ni bela Nail Mɔɣili la ni kɔŋko.
en: You, your officials, and your people will be rid of the frogs, and there will be none left except in the Nile.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yisa, ti teemi n yɛla a nam ni.
en: Then he said to Jesus, Remember me when you come into power.

dag: ni pipihi ni firila kpihindisi ni taha ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu lahi ni salima alali buɣim moori taha ni salima chɛulɔnim din gbib Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni Luɣ Kasi shee la pununim mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sambani polo pununim la.
en: cups, lamp snuffers, and small sprinkling bowls; dishes for incense; fire pans; and the hinges for the doors to the most holy place and the main room of the temple.

dag: Dama a pala Naawuni ŋun yu gala tumbu, a mi mini zaɣ biɛɣu bi kpɛra.
en: You are not a God who is pleased with wrongdoing; you allow no evil in your presence.

dag: Dama o daa zali zaligu n-chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi n-kpuɣi teeku kɔgbana zuɣusaa.
en: God spoke and stirred up a storm that brought the waves up high.

dag: Sokam dirila tiŋgbani daatam, hal naa gba dirila tiŋgbani daatam anfaani.
en: Even a king depends on the harvest.

dag: Yisa daa ti zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo doli fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba chana.
en: Jesus went through towns and villages, teaching the people and making his way toward Jerusalem.

dag: Lala ka Yisifu so tuumba maa ni daa ti yuli Baanabas la daa niŋ. O daa nyɛla Saipurus tiŋbia, ka nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nira.
en: Joseph was one of the followers who had sold a piece of property and brought the money to the apostles. He was a Levite from Cyprus, and the apostles called him Barnabas, which means one who encourages others.

dag: N yi yi mɔɣ kpaŋa, n nyarila bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛb sɔŋ. Ka n yi kpe tiŋ puuni, n nyarila kum ni gbarigi shɛb sɔŋ. Ka anabinim mini maligumaaniba kul tumdi bɛ tuma tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni, ka bi mi ni binshɛli niŋda.
en: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.

dag: wula ka din nyɛ Naawuni Shia din la ku gari lala?.
en: So surely the new agreement that comes from the life-giving Spirit has even more glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu tintariga maa yɛn zaŋla teeku tariga hal ni Hazɛrɛnɔn din be Damaskus tintariga nuzaa polo, ka chɛ Hamat tintariga bahi nuzaa polo. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ nuzaa polo maa yaɣili.
en: So the boundary from the Mediterranean Sea to Hazar-enon will run north of the boundary of Damascus, with the boundary of Hamath to the north. This is the northern limit.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ Pita niŋ duu, amaa ka cheechi daa kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo o zuɣu.
en: While Peter was held in prison, the church offered earnest prayer to God for him.

dag: Bahigu maa paana. Di bahigu saha paaya. Di nyɛla din yiɣisi lu yi zuɣu. Nyama, di kanna.
en: The end has come! Oh, yes, it has come! It has come to you! Look, its here!.

dag: Kuɣili tibisa, ka bihigu tibisa, amaa jɛrigu ni tahiri suhuyiɣisili shɛl na tibisi gari di zaa.
en: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.

dag: Ka o daa vaai yiɣisi n-lɛb lu tiŋa n-fo n-do paɣ maa naba ni. Paɣ maa naba maa ni ka o daa yiɣ lɛb lu. O ni daa yiɣ lɛb lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka o daa dii kpi.
en: Sisera sank to his knees and fell dead at her feet.

dag: Yaansi nyɛla ninkura jilima zuɣupiligu; ka bihi mi jilima nyɛ bɛ laamba.
en: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, just as children are proud of their parents.

dag: Ka o mam ŋun daa be Shɛkɛm gba daa dɔɣ o bidib yino, ka o bol o yuli Abimilɛk.
en: His secondary wife who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

dag: Dinzuɣu n zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. O nyɛla Yawɛ ni yɛn su so hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o daa chɛ o ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: And now I give this child to the Lord . He will serve the Lord all his life. Then Hannah left the boy there and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka so zaŋ salinim ni ni tooi niŋ shɛli nyuri bara, dama binshɛɣukam nyɛla yi dini.
en: No one, then, should boast about what human beings can do. Actually everything belongs to you:.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Ɛfɛsus Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni m-be salima firilatamdis ayopɔin sunsuuni n-chani gindi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: These are the words of the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven gold lampstands.

dag: Di saha ka Dɔdavahu ŋun daa nyɛ Marɛsha nir la bia Ɛliɛza daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, A ni zaŋ amaŋ tabili Ahazia maa zuɣu Yawɛ ni saɣim a tuma maa. Ka ŋarima maa daa chaŋ ti saɣim sol ni ka bi paai Speen.
en: But Eliezer son of Dodavahu, from the town of Mareshah, warned Jehoshaphat, Because you have made an alliance with Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy what you have built. And the ships were wrecked and never sailed.

dag: Nandaamba kul ku kɔŋ dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya, Teemiya yi nuu n-tim faranim mini yi ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni pina.
en: There will always be some Israelites who are poor and needy. That's why I am commanding you to be generous with them.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ niriba maa kuli Yisifu yiŋa kaman o ni daa wuh o shɛm maa.
en: The servant did as he was told. He brought the men into Josephs house.

dag: O ni daa be suhusaɣiŋgu ni pam zuɣu ka o daa suhuri Naawuni ni nimmoo hal ka o niŋgbuŋ ni woligu ti tɔɣiri luri tiŋa kaman ʒim la.
en: He was in anguish and prayed even more earnestly. His sweat became like drops of blood falling on the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa kar o yihi Idɛn puu maa ni ni o ti kɔr o ni daa yi tiŋgban shɛli ni na maa.
en: So the Lord God forced the man out of the Garden of Eden to work the ground he was made from.

dag: A yi lo alikauli ka bi pal li, dindina a yi bi lo li, di so.
en: Better not to promise at all than to make a promise and not keep it.

dag: Tuma maa nyɛla balibubalibu, amaa kulla Naawuni yino maa n-chɛ ka di zaa tumdi sokam zaa ni.
en: There are different abilities to perform service, but the same God gives ability to all for their particular service.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz leei naa zal o ba zaani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After the death of Josiah, the people of Judah crowned his son Jehoahaz their new king.

dag: binnɛɔŋ kam naan laɣim kpi, ka daadam di labi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: then everything on earth would die. We would all become dust again.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nyini ŋun yuri niriba ŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi zaa daa bela a nuu ni, bɛ daa dolila a naba, ka deer a noli.
en: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini neen shɛŋa din be nayili zaa chaŋ; ka daa lan kpuɣi salima nyɔtaɣirisi shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa chɛ ka bɛ mali la.
en: He seized the treasures of the LORDs temple and the royal palace. He took everything, even all the gold shields that Solomon had made.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ nyɛla bɛn birigi n niriba ka yɛra, Suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani. Ka n niriba maa yi me gooni, anabinim ŋɔ zaŋdila bimpiɛlli paligi li.
en: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ. Ka Judas ŋun yi o nyaaŋa maa ʒiɛya m-pahi niriba maa zuɣu.
en: Jesus of Nazareth, they answered. I am he, he said. Judas, the traitor, was standing there with them.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛli ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni o ka taali, dilan nyɛla niriba ni yɛn turi so, ka zuliya kam zaɣis o;.
en: If they pronounce a guilty person innocent, they will be cursed and hated by everyone.

dag: Ka Naaman daa chaŋ o naa sani nti yɛl o, Izraɛl bipuɣimbil la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Naaman went to the king and told him what the Israelite girl said.

dag: Amaa yi ni da dab so ka gun o, o ni tooi di bindirigu maa o gunibu nyaaŋa.
en: A foreigner who is only a hired worker or is only staying in your country is not allowed to eat the meal. But if someone buys a slave and circumcises him, then the slave can eat the Passover meal.

dag: Nyamiya, ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ kanimina ni o ti zaŋ yiko pam di nam. O ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani; o laara gba be o sani.
en: The Lord GOD is coming with power. He will use his power to rule all the people. He will bring rewards for his people. He will have their payment with him.

dag: Amaa n na ʒi n-zo ka chɛ piɛgulibo din nyɛ a ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti ma maa bee m-bɔri ni zaɣ biɛɣu paa ba. A mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yiri n nol ni na; dama di daa niŋla a ninni.
en: But, Lord , I never urged you to bring disaster on them; I did not wish a time of trouble for them. Lord , you know this; you know what I have said.

dag: ka n ti lan labi m ba yiŋ yaha ni suhudoo, dindina Yawɛ n-ni nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: and if I return in peace to my fathers house—if he does all these things—then the Lord will be my God.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi yaannim daa lan mo ma bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la puuni.
en: So now, son of man, speak to the family of Israel. Tell them, This is what the Lord GOD says: The people of Israel said bad things about me and made evil plans against me.

dag: A yu zaɣ biɛɣu gari zaɣ viɛlli, ka yu ʒiri ŋmabu gari yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu.
en: You love evil more than good and falsehood more than truth.

dag: Dama alɔbo n-lu n zuɣu dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka n nyari tibidarigibo asiba kam.
en: Im weighed down all day long. Im punished every morning.

dag: Ka bɛ daa karim Naawuni zaligu din be litaafi maa ni, ka kahigi di ni yɛli shɛm wuhi. Bɛ daa wuhi di gbinni ka di chɛ ka niriba baŋ karimbu maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: They gave an oral translation of God's Law and explained it so that the people could understand it.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi niriba ayi shɛba Juda naa ni tim n sanna ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be n sani ŋɔ, yi ni ti yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Firawuna tɔbbihi bɛn yina ni bɛ ti sɔŋ a ŋɔ ni labi kuli Ijipti bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The LORD, the God of Israel, proclaims: Tell the king of Judah who sent his emissaries to seek advice from me: Pharaohs army that came to assist you is heading back to Egypt.

dag: A tizɔpaɣ yurigu la bihi puhir a.
en: The children of your dear Sister send you their greetings.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ, bɛna n-nyɛ o zɔnima, ka o kahigir o daalikauli wuhiri ba.
en: The LORD counsels those who honor him; he makes his covenant known to them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl anabinim yino ni o yɛlim o kpee, Ŋmɛm ma. Amaa ka o kpee maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku ŋme o.
en: About this time the Lord commanded a prophet to say to a friend, Hit me! But the friend refused.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulimpuhili polo na nti ʒe teeku maa kom labisi nyaaŋa yuŋ maa zaa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ tiŋ kuŋ.
en: Moses held out his hand over the sea, and the Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind. It blew all night and turned the sea into dry land. The water was divided.

dag: N yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ mi ni yi di chɛ ka so zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa yɔhim ya.
en: I tell you this so that no one can fool you by telling you ideas that seem good, but are false.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo, ka niŋdi nirilim; yurilim bi zabiri nyuli, di bi nyuri bara, di mi bi duhiri dimaŋa.
en: Love is patient, love is kind, it isnt jealous, it doesnt brag, it isnt arrogant.

dag: Pool min o nyaaŋa maa ni daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka niriba maa daa balim ba ni bɛ lan labimina Vuhim Dabisili din kanna dali nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people asked them to come again on the next Sabbath day and tell them more about these things.

dag: N tim ya mi ni yi ti kpuɣi yi ni bi di puu atam shɛli wahala. Shɛba m-pun di di wahala ka yinim ti lee yɛn di di nyɔri.
en: I have sent you to harvest what you didnt work hard for; others worked hard, and you will share in their hard work.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many will come in my name, saying, Im the Christ. They will deceive many people.

dag: Juda ni daa nya o, o daa tɛhiya ni o nyɛla pagɔrili, dama o daa zaŋla sariga m-pil lims o ninni.
en: Judah saw her and thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.

dag: Ka di mi pala yi ni tum shɛli zuɣu ka yi tiligi, dinzuɣu shɛli kani ka yi ni nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.

dag: Ti Duuma chɛ ka ti niŋ ya naani, ka mi ni yi niŋdi ti ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka kul ni niŋdi ti ni wuhi shɛm maa.
en: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni nti kuhi yɛli ba ni man Naawuni nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma la.
en: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed.

dag: A nɛma daa yi kul yi teeku ni na, niriba pam nyari li mi. A daa zaŋ a daazichi min a daguya sɔŋ dunia ŋɔ nanima ka bɛ nya azichi.
en: When your merchandise went overseas, You filled the needs of every nation. Kings were made rich By the wealth of your goods.

dag: Hal putɔɣulaannim yi kul zoori kaman mɔri la, ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul tɔŋda, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers seem to blossom, they do so only to be destroyed forever.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na. O yɛri bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Come in, ignorant people! And to the foolish she says.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih ayopɔin la zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and cups with each of the lambs.

dag: O nyɛla tampiŋ ŋun ka ŋmali. O tuma nyɛla din viɛl zaa, ka o soya zaa nyɛ din tuhi. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ka ka galimi. O nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi ka be tibi.
en: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.

dag: Yi yi ŋub li daba ata maa dali, di nyɛla din chihira, ka n ku deei li.
en: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.

dag: Musa daa yɛli ba, Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya bɛn zaa lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu ni Yawɛ ninni ŋɔ, yi doli ya gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du, ka yi ti tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, dindina yin zaŋmiya Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: Moses said to them, The people of Gad and Reuben will cross the Jordan River. They will march before the Lord into battle. They will help you take the land. And you will give the land of Gilead as their part of the country.

dag: ka yɛli a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba, ka yɛli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla yuŋ.
en: It is good to sing about your love in the morning and about your faithfulness at night.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: Joab went, and she asked, Are you Joab? Yes, I am, he answered. Listen to me, sir, she said. I'm listening, he answered.

dag: Di ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuliya shɛb yɛri ŋumaŋuma, ka Gɛshɛm gba yɛli ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni a mini Yɛhudianim lola nia ni yi taai duŋ ni dizuɣu n-chɛ ka yi lab mɛri gooni maa. O lan yɛli ma ni a loya ni a zaŋla amaŋ leei naa.
en: It read: Geshem tells me that a rumor is going around among the neighboring peoples that you and the Jewish people intend to revolt and that this is why you are rebuilding the wall. He also says you plan to make yourself king.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdali gbini. Ka bɛ daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, naa ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdal la gbini. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa tooni na. Di saha maa Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino daa pun zomi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: So the king went and sat down in the city gate. All the troops were told that the king was sitting in the gate, so they came before the king. Meanwhile, the Israelites had fled to their homes.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni wuh a zuliya maa zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyamma yɛligi pam.
en: All your children will be disciples of the LORD— I will make peace abound for your children.

dag: N dana, ka so yi ti dol a ni o ku a, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun zaŋm a nyɛvili ŋɔ pahi nyɛviya pam zuɣu n-gul li, amaa o ni ti zaŋ a dimnim nyɛviya labi kaman kuɣilɔŋ kuɣili ka bɛ labi la.
en: If someone chases after you and tries to kill you, my master, then your life will be bound up securely in the bundle of life by the LORD your God, but he will fling away your enemies lives as from the pouch of a sling.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ʒini Sool zuɣu m-muɣis o pam.
en: The Lord s Spirit left Saul. Then the Lord sent an evil spirit to Saul that caused him much trouble.

dag: Yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna, o ni ŋmaligi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu m-bahi ya yoli zaa; o ni pun niŋ ya din viɛl la nyaaŋa.
en: and if you leave him to serve foreign gods, he will turn against you and punish you. He will destroy you, even though he was good to you before.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dii lu Pita tooni kpi. Ka nachimba maa daa kpɛna nti nya ka o kpimi doya, ka bɛ kpuɣ o gba yi nti sɔɣ o baɣil o yidan maa gballi.
en: At once she fell down at his feet and died. The young men came in and saw that she was dead, so they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa bo chɛchɛbuŋ mini yuri ka zaŋ ninvuɣ pihinu bah o tooni.
en: Some time later, Absalom got himself a chariot with horses to pull it, and he had men run in front.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka oki tihi laani ginda, ka chɛ ka nyɔŋ tihi vari suu. Ka bɛnkam zaa be o jɛmbu duu puuni yɛli, Timiya Naawuni jilima.
en: The Lord s voice frightens the deer. He destroys the forests. In his temple everyone shouts, Glory to God.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka ti mali tahima. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti sɔŋsim mini ti nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: So we will wait for the Lord . He helps us and protects us.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo, anabi maa mini ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhi ni o baŋ maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛla yim.
en: Both prophets and anyone who consults them will get the same punishment.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmiya yomyom ka bɛ ti yɛli Dauda ni o di gbe kulibɔŋ duli maa yuŋ ŋɔ, amaa ni o chɛ ka o min o niriba maa tirisi tooni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kpimsi ŋun naa mini niriba bɛn be o sani maa birili zaa.
en: Now send word immediately to David and tell him, Dont spend the night in the desert plains. You must cross over immediately. Otherwise, the king and all the troops who are with him will be swallowed up whole.

dag: Sulemaana wain tihi puu daa bela Baalihamɔn ka pukpariba daa haayi li o sani, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yɔrila anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-Hamon, which he rents to others for a thousand pieces of silver each.

dag: Naawuni ʒin o ʒiishee saria karibu ni; o kari saria wuna sunsuuni.
en: God takes his stand in the divine council; he gives judgment among the gods.

dag: ni Atirɔtishɔfan ni Jaza ni Jɔgbɛha.
en: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah.

dag: Labisim a tiliginsim suhupiɛlli la ti ma, ka chɛ ka m mali pupiɛlim.
en: Your help made me so happy. Give me that joy again. Make my spirit strong and ready to obey you.

dag: Ka daba ayɔbu dali bɛ ni tooi pihi daba ayi dibu tariga na ti duɣi.
en: On the sixth day they are to bring in twice as much as usual and prepare it.

dag: Lala ka o daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata ni bɛn zaa daa taɣiri biŋkɔbiri maa; Yi yi ti tuhi Iso soli, yin yɛlimiy o yɛtɔɣ yini maa.
en: He gave the same order to the second, the third, and to all the others who were in charge of the herds: This is what you must say to Esau when you meet him.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisi dali ka sagbani maa daa vuui alikauli biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa.
en: On the twentieth day of the second month in the second year, the cloud ascended from the covenant dwelling.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ o daa zaŋla Yisa yihina nti ʒin o saria karibu ʒiishee din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gabata Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla luɣ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali.
en: When Pilate heard these words, he led Jesus out and seated him on the judges bench at the place called Stone Pavement .

dag: ka o yɛli ba, Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ lihiri ka ku nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka ku baŋdi di gbinni.
en: So he answered: I have explained the secrets about God's kingdom to you. But for others I use stories, so they will look, but not see, and they will hear, but not understand.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa lan me duri zali buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka pii niriba maa ni shɛb bɛn pa Lɛvi zuliya n-leei maligumaaniba.
en: Jeroboam made shrines on the high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, but none were Levites.

dag: N ni daa suh a dahin shɛli, a daa deei n suhigu, ka pahi ma kpiɔŋ.
en: On the day I cried out, you answered me. You encouraged me with inner strength.

dag: Ka tia maa daa kul zoori n-niŋdi zaɣ titali hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: It grew bigger and bigger until it reached the sky and could be seen by everyone in the world.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ ŋun maŋmaŋ nuzaa ni.
en: The priest will also take some of the oil and pour it into his own left palm.

dag: O bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Shiira. Ŋuna n-daa me Bɛtihɔrɔn tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa polo ni Uzɛnishiira la.
en: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.

dag: Anabi Musa daa sab taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli din yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na yɛla n-wuhi ni ŋunkam doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa ni nya nyɛvili di zuɣu.
en: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ni kpaŋsi Jɛrusalɛm, ka sɔŋ o luɣ shɛli polo din lu n-dahim. N ni chɛ ka o tiŋgban nɛli be kaman Idɛn puu din nyɛ man Yawɛ puu la; ka chɛ ka suhupiɛlli mini wumpaɣibo yila be o ni.
en: I will show compassion to Jerusalem, to all who live in her ruins. Though her land is a desert, I will make it a garden, like the garden I planted in Eden. Joy and gladness will be there, and songs of praise and thanks to me.

dag: Ka Zara daa ti kpi Kiriatariba Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Ibrahimma daa kpe nti kum o kuli.
en: She died in Kiriath-arba, that is, in Hebron, in the land of Canaan; and Abraham cried out in grief and wept for Sarah.

dag: O saria dibu dolila yɛlimaŋli soli ni din tuhi. O kari pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun zaŋ o zina niŋbu n-saɣim dunia la saria, ka bɔh o biɛri ti o ni daa yihi ŋun Naawuni dab shɛb ʒim la.
en: His judgments are true and just, because he judged the great prostitute, who ruined the earth by her whoring, and he exacted the penalty for the blood of his servants from her hand.

dag: Judanim bi ʒe yim, ka din chihiri kul tumdi Izraɛl mini Jɛrusalɛm puuni. Dama Judanim saɣim Yawɛ ni yuri o jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka kpuɣi tinzunnim bɛn jɛmdi buɣa bipuɣinsi.
en: The people of Judah have broken their promise to God and done a horrible thing in Jerusalem and all over the country. They have defiled the Temple which the Lord loves. Men have married women who worship foreign gods.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa sab gbaŋ ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni yɛli: Naawuni timi ya suhudoo pam!.
en: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: Greetings to all of you!.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaŋ o pagɔrisigu tuma maa chaŋ katiŋa. O daa nya bɛ ni mali dɔbba kɔtomsi pa dukpini zuɣu. Di daa nyɛla Babilɔnnim anfooni ka bɛ mali pa dukpina zuɣu, ka bɛ ye neen ʒiɛfaa.
en: Oholibah continued to be unfaithful to me. In Babylon, she saw pictures of men carved on the walls. These were pictures of Chaldean men wearing their red uniforms.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Kpe ka di tu ni bɛ di ma saria, dama Naa Siiza ni zali sariakarita so tooni ka n zani ŋɔ. Amaŋmaŋ gba mi ni m bi tum Yɛhudianim taal shɛli.
en: Paul said, I am standing before the Emperor's own judgment court, where I should be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you yourself well know.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ziŋ maa ni o gbuɣimi Jona bahi, ka o daa zaŋ o ti gbuɣi bahi duli.
en: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni ti kahigi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi, ka dunia zaa ti yiɣisi jɛndi ba.
en: Heaven exposes their guilt; earth opposes them.

dag: Dunia zaa ni kul be ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la sulinsi ni la zaa yoli, tinim mi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: We know that we belong to God even though the whole world is under the rule of the Evil One.

dag: Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni chani ti kpɛrila o pul ni n-gariti ti yira?.
en: Dont you know that everything that goes into the mouth enters the stomach and goes out into the sewer?.

dag: Mɔri yi ti naai, ka mɔ pala bili, di saha ka bɛ chɛri zoya ni mɔri sɔŋda.
en: Cut the hay, and new grass will grow. Then gather the new plants that grow on the hills.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ka bɛ ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛl la niŋ pali: So m-birita, ka so mi chɛra.
en: For the saying is true, Someone plants, someone else reaps.

dag: Niŋm ania zaŋ amaŋ wuhi ni a nyɛla tumtumdi so Naawuni ni di shɛhira, ka a ku di vi a tuma ni, ka ni nyɛla ŋun wuhiri Naawuni yɛligu yɛlimaŋtali dɛde.
en: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ nɛ karili lo n-yili dilan nyiŋgoli n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni, di naan so o zuɣu gar o chɛ ka bibihi ŋɔ ni yino birigi.
en: It will be very bad for anyone who makes one of these little children sin. It would be better for them to have a millstone tied around their neck and be drowned in the sea.

dag: Shihir shɛŋa Naawuni ni wuhiri ti mal alahiziba! Alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa o ni tumdi mali yiko pam. Naawuni nam nyɛla nam din ka bahigu, ka o kul ni nyɛ Naa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: How great are the wonders God shows us! How powerful are the miracles he performs! God is king forever; he will rule for all time.

dag: Di saha maa, do so daa beni n-nyɛ ŋun yi Zɔra na, ka o yuli booni Manɔa. O daa nyɛla Dan zuliya ni nira, ka o paɣ nyɛ paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi.
en: At that time there was a man named Manoah from the town of Zorah. He was a member of the tribe of Dan. His wife had never been able to have children.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ noya ni; bɛ suhuri kul yula saɣiŋgu. Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbal kaba, ka bɛ lan mali naŋgban malisim.
en: What my enemies say can never be trusted; they only want to destroy. Their words are flattering and smooth, but full of deadly deceit.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhiri n niriba maa binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: The priests are to teach my people the difference between what is holy and what is not, and between what is ritually clean and what is not.

dag: O ni daa mali Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni la, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zali.
en: The sacred chest was kept in the most holy place.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ a hal ni n nyɛvili tariga. N ni kpuɣi n nuhi zuɣusaa m-paɣ a yuli.
en: So I will bless you as long as Im alive; I will lift up my hands in your name.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tɔɣisiri niriba maa la yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Jesus disciples came and said to him, Why do you use parables when you speak to the crowds.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: He had seven sons and three daughters.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, Izraɛlnima, yi ŋmanila Itiɔpianima n sani? Pa mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na? Pa mani n-daa yihi Filistianim Kafitɔr na, ka daa yihi Aramnim Kiri na?.
en: This is what the Lord says: Israel, you are like the Ethiopians to me. I brought Israel out of the land of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir. .

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Sokam tiligim o nyɛvili. Di kpinya di taali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ni bɔhiri biɛri saha shɛli m-bɔŋɔ; o yɔr li la di tuma samli.
en: Run away from Babylonia! Run for your lives! Do not be killed because of Babylonia's sin. I am now taking my revenge and punishing it as it deserves.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛli; ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla din chihiri n noli ni yibu na.
en: My words are true, and I will not say anything that is wrong.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Paɣa, a yɛda galisiya pam! Di ni niŋ kaman a ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka o bipuɣiŋga maa daa dii kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Jesus answered, Woman, you have great faith. It will be just as you wish. And right then her daughter was healed.

dag: Di saha ka Judas ŋun daa yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa bɔh o, Karimba, mani? Ka Yisa yɛl o, Iin, nyini.
en: Judas said, Teacher, you surely don't mean me! That's what you say! Jesus replied. But later, Judas did betray him.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe, di simdi ni bɛ mini naa kpe, ka bɛ yi ti lan yɛn yi, di simdi ni bɛ min o yi.
en: The prince is to come in when the people come, and leave when they leave.

dag: Di simdi ka yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You must carefully follow the LORD your Gods commands along with the laws and regulations he has given you.

dag: nti mali Lɛvi nir ŋun nyɛ maligumaana mini sariakarita ŋun be tuma ni di dabisa maa ni saawara, ka bɛ ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm.
en: and present your case to the levitical priests and to the judge who is in office at that time, and let them decide the case.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti lan nya wuntizɔra mini ninvuɣ biɛɣu biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm, ka lan nya ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni mini ŋun bi jɛmd o biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm.
en: Once again my people will see the difference between what happens to the righteous and to the wicked, to the person who serves me and the one who does not.

dag: N naan wum o ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm, ka baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm.
en: He could give his response, and I would understand. I would listen closely to what he says.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa ti kpe yili maa ni dahin shɛli ni o ti tum o tuma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be yili maa ni kani.
en: But one day when Joseph went into the house to do his work, none of the house servants was there.

dag: Ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mali yiko pam. O baŋsim galisiya yaɣi.
en: Our Lord is great and powerful. There is no limit to what he knows.

dag: Bɛ ni kɔhiri nin shɛli zaa nakɔhi duu, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya.
en: Eat any meat that is sold in the meat market. Dont ask questions about it to see if it is something you think is wrong to eat.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Yi mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni gul li; chamiya ti niŋ yi ni ni niŋ shɛm gul li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Pilate said to them, All right, take some of your soldiers and guard the tomb as well as you know how.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Bɛnkam doli di soli mali baŋsim viɛlli. O paɣibu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Wisdom begins with fear and respect for the Lord . Those who obey him are very wise. Praises will be sung to him forever.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka Asirianim ti kani Ijipti na, ka Ijiptinim gba kani Asiria na; ka Ijiptinim mini Asirianim ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ.
en: When that time comes, there will be a highway between Egypt and Assyria. The people of these two countries will travel back and forth between them, and the two nations will worship together.

dag: Yawɛ n-zali ni ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka ti yo yi daalahichi samli.
en: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.

dag: Ka Pita garigi yɛli ba, Niŋmiya tuuba ka deeya kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yul ni, ka Naawuni chɛ yi daalahichi paŋ ya, ka yi deeg o Shia Kasi ŋun nyɛ pin la.
en: Peter replied, Change your hearts and lives. Each of you must be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. Then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ka bɛ ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛl la niŋ pali: So m-birita, ka so mi chɛra.
en: This is a true saying, that one sows and another harvests.

dag: M bia, wumm a ba ni wuhir a shɛli, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: My son, listen to your father when he corrects you, and dont ignore what your mother teaches you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ niɣi, ka chɛ ka saa tahi ku bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: God delivered their cattle over to disease, their herds to plagues.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk yɛl o, M bi mi ŋun daa niŋ lala maa, ka a mi daa bi yɛli ma, ka n gba mi na bi wum di yɛla shee zuŋɔ ka n ti wum li maa.
en: This is the first I've heard about it, Abimelech replied. Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.

dag: Di saha ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa daa yɛli o suhu ni, N dana yi yihi ma o tuma ŋɔ ni, wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N lan ka yaa din ni tooi tum tuun kpɛma, ka mi zɔri vi ni m mali bara.
en: The manager said to himself, What shall I do now that my master is going to fire me? I can't dig ditches, and I'm ashamed to beg.

dag: Mani n-yi di nyɛ niriba ŋɔ toondana, n naan kpimsi Abimilɛk birili zaa. N naan yɛl o, Bom tɔbbihi pam pahi kana. .
en: If I were the ruler of Shechem, I'd get rid of that Abimelech. I'd tell him, Get yourself an even bigger army, and we will still defeat you.

dag: Pa Zallakudura Naa n-zaani zaɣ viɛlli mini zaɣ biɛɣu ka di niŋda?.
en: God Most High commands both good and bad things to happen.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa be bia maa sani hal ka o mali ti zooi. O daa bela mɔɣu ni n-daa ti leei tɔha ŋun mi piɛm tɔbu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: God blessed Ishmael, and as the boy grew older, he became an expert at hunting with his bow and arrows. He lived in the Paran Desert, and his mother chose an Egyptian woman for him to marry.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tibig o niriba laɣiŋgu ni, ka paɣ o kpamba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Let them exalt God in the congregation of the people and praise God in the assembly of the elders.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o chaŋ.
en: Jesus left and made his way to the Mount of Olives, as was his custom, and the disciples followed him.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ŋun Naawuni biɛhigu zaa be o Bia maa ni.
en: God was pleased for all of himself to live in the Son.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni, o daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka o nubihi min o napombihi zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na.
en: Another battle took place at Gath, where there was a giant with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. He was a descendant of the ancient giants.

dag: Teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di puuni vuma, dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni, yilimiya yila.
en: Roar, sea, and every creature in you; sing, earth, and all who live on you!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua tuumba maa daa kpa zoya maa polo nti be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn daa biɛhi bɛ naba la ti lab kuli; dama bɛ daa vihimi m-bo ba sol ni zaa ka bi nya ba.
en: The spies went out and entered the highlands. They stayed there for three days until those chasing them came back. Those chasing them had searched all along the road but never found them.

dag: So yi zaŋ o buŋa bee o nahu bee o piɛɣu bee o biŋkɔb so ti o kpee ni o zali, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa bee bɛ taɣ o pah o tab ni chaŋ ka so bi nya o.
en: If anyone agrees to keep someone else's donkey, cow, sheep, or other animal for him, and the animal dies or is injured or is carried off in a raid, and if there was no witness.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi, ka bɛ mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaaniba ti dii tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: At that, the Pharisees got together with the supporters of Herod to plan how to destroy Jesus.

dag: M mabihi, di daa kpami ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Naa Dauda yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judas ŋun daa zaŋ niriba chaŋ ka bɛ ti gbaai Yisa la polo la niŋ pali.
en: He said: My friends, long ago by the power of the Holy Spirit, David said something about Judas, and what he said has now happened. Judas was one of us and had worked with us, but he brought the mob to arrest Jesus.

dag: N ni zaŋ rubis me a pihi, ka zaŋ kuɣ shɛŋa din nyɛlisiri me a dunoya, ka zaŋ kuɣ viɛla m-mal a gooni.
en: I will build your towers with rubies, your gates with stones that glow like fire, and the wall around you with jewels.

dag: Ka Omri mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa yi Gibɛtɔn n-chaŋ ti teei gili Tiriza.
en: Omri and the entire army then went up from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.

dag: Amaa Naawuni pun zaŋ niŋgbuŋ yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa n-niŋ niŋgbun yini kaman o ni yu shɛm.
en: If each part of the body were the same part, there would be no body. But as it is, God put the parts in the body as he wanted them. He made a place for each one.

dag: M Ba, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n nya jilima a sani, jilima shɛli n ni daa pun mal a sani ka dunia na bi nam la.
en: Father! Give me glory in your presence now, the same glory I had with you before the world was made.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ishimail ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba Mizipa maa zaa daa ŋmaligi zo n-labi Karia bia Jɔhanan sani.
en: and turned around and ran toward Johanan.

dag: Nyam n wahala ŋɔ, ka tiligi ma, dama m bi tam a zaligu yɛla.
en: Look at my suffering, and save me, because I have not neglected your law.

dag: Di niŋya binshɛli nyuli zabbu tɛha puuni bee m-bɔri ni yi doli alaha soli nyu bara; amaa siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani ka miriya ka yi tɛhiri ni yi so yi taba.
en: Don't do anything from selfish ambition or from a cheap desire to boast, but be humble toward one another, always considering others better than yourselves.

dag: ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Next, we turned around and headed back toward the wilderness along the Reed Sea road, exactly as the LORD instructed me. We traveled all around Mount Seir for a long time.

dag: Paɣimiya yi nuhi maa ka di yi. Chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka n nini nyari maa tumbu. Chɛliya tuumbiɛri maa tumbu.
en: Wash yourselves and make yourselves clean. Stop doing the evil things I see you do. Stop doing wrong.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛl o, Naawuni ni ŋme nyin dukpin piɛlli ŋɔ! A ʒinimi ni a kari ma saria kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka ti yaɣi zaligu maa zuɣu yɛli ni bɛ ŋmɛm ma.
en: Paul said to Ananias, God will hit you too! You are like a dirty wall that has been painted white. You sit there and judge me, using the Law of Moses. But you are telling them to hit me, and that is against the law.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛl o, Nyama, n kurigiya, m mi ku tooi baŋ n kum dali.
en: He said, Im old and dont know when I will die.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni dahin shɛli yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Yiko Zaa Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: You said it, Jesus replied. But I say to you that from now on youll see the Human One sitting on the right side of the Almighty and coming on the heavenly clouds .

dag: Di ti chɛliya ka so nya dabindi yi sani daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni, yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa bee n-chɛ ka yi ni kɔrigi biŋkɔb so dabisi tuuli dali maa nimdi zani yuŋ hal ti neei biɛɣu.
en: No dough with yeast should appear in any of your territory for seven days. Furthermore, none of the meat that you sacrificed on the first night should remain until morning.

dag: Mushi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa n-doli bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.

dag: Biɛŋmarisi ni daa laɣim yili yila, ka alizanda ni malaikanim zaa yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri la, a daa beni?.
en: when the morning stars sang together and the angels shouted with joy?.

dag: Yi ŋarima saɣimya, ka di mihi chihi, ka di tana chahi. Ti ni fa ti dimnim tɔbbihi nɛma zaa piri ti taba. Hal gbariti gba ni nya tarili di ni.
en: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta m-bɔŋɔ ka m mali shili ni n ka yi sanna; ka m mi ku zaŋ n yɛla doli ya, dama m bi bɔri yi binshɛli, amaa yimaŋmaŋ ka m bɔra. Pa bihi n-dihiri bɛ laamba, amaa bihi laamba n-dihiri ba.
en: This is now the third time that I am ready to come to visit you—and I will not make any demands on you. It is you I want, not your money. After all, children should not have to provide for their parents, but parents should provide for their children.

dag: Ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n dan maa ni pam ka o leei bundana. O ti o piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni anzinfa mini salima ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: The Lord has greatly blessed my master and made him a rich man. He has given him flocks of sheep and goats, cattle, silver, gold, male and female slaves, camels, and donkeys.

dag: bɛna n-nyɛ Zilipa so Leeban ni daa zaŋ ti o bipuɣiŋga Liya la bidib shɛb o ni daa dɔɣi ti Yaakubu, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ pinaayɔbu.
en: These sixteen are the descendants of Jacob by Zilpah, the slave woman whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa zaa tooni, ka kuhi yɛli, Sokam yiɣisim n sani yi. Dinzuɣu so daa ka Yisifu sani saha shɛl o ni daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa o ni nyɛ so.
en: Since Joseph could no longer control his feelings in front of his servants, he sent them out of the room. When he was alone with his brothers, he told them, I am Joseph.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka jila be di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ be di ni, ka gbaŋ pɔbi bɛ zaa. Amaa ka vuhim daa ka bɛ ni.
en: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.

dag: Ka chuɣu maa daa ti puhi naai ka bɛ labiri kuna, ka Yisa ŋun daa na nyɛ bisariŋga la kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ba min o ma bi mi.
en: When the festival was over, they started back home, but the boy Jesus stayed in Jerusalem. His parents did not know this;.

dag: Ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa ti nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ matarika kuri salin shɛli din nyɛ alali.
en: The whole lampstand with the flowers and branches must be made from pure gold. All this gold must be hammered and joined together into one piece.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam nya sɔɣibu shee a sani mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka bɛ kul yiini suhupiɛlli yila sahakam. Guli ba, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli nya suhupiɛlli a sani.
en: But let those who trust in you be happy forever. Protect and strengthen those who love your name.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ ti ma a yuli zuɣu. Fam ma bahi, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla.
en: But you, LORD, my Lord!— act on my behalf for the sake of your name; deliver me because your faithful love is so good.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni di n-tiɣi ka zaɣis a ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ. Bee n yi nyɛ faralana n ni zu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ta n Naawuni yuli daɣiri.
en: Or Ill be full and deny you, and say, Who is the LORD? Or Ill be poor and steal, and dishonor my Gods name.

dag: Ka n daa garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ti nasara. Tinim bɛn nyɛ o daba ŋɔ ni piligi mɛbu maa. Amaa yinima nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka tarili bee n-su shɛli bee ka so ti teei yi yɛla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The God of heaven will give us success! I replied. As Gods servants, we will start building. But you will have no share, right, or claim in Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soli, ka n dol a yɛlimaŋli la; tim ma suhuyini, ka n tibigir a yuli.
en: Teach me, Lord , what you want me to do, and I will obey you faithfully; teach me to serve you with complete devotion.

dag: M puhiri Filolɔgus mini Julia ni Nɛrius min o tizɔpaɣa ni Olimpas ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn zaa be bɛ san la gba.
en: Say hello to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: People are trying to kill me. Please disappoint them. Humiliate them! They want to hurt me. Make them run away in shame.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim yi wum n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli ma.
en: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anahi nyɛ Mishimana, ka ŋun pahi anu nyɛ Jɛrimia.
en: Mishmannah was the fourth in command. Jeremiah was the fifth in command.

dag: sapashini maa daa yɛlila Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya bindirigu maa, amaa ka a noli lee ku to li.
en: the officer had answered the man of God, Come on! Even if the LORD should make windows in the sky, how could that happen? Then Elisha had said, You will see it with your own eyes, but you wont eat from it.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ka ti kul ni jɛm, ka deeg o noli.
en: Then the people said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord our God. We will obey him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan lab teeku nol ni, ka salo maa zaa lan laɣimna nti gil o ka o wuhiri ba.
en: Jesus went back again to the shore of Lake Galilee. A crowd came to him, and he started teaching them.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla jɛlinsi yɛtɔɣa m-muɣisiri ma, ka lu n zuɣu ka di ka daliri.
en: and they say evil things about me, attacking me for no reason.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋmi bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa buɣisi n ni yɛli shɛm. Bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa yi be di ko ka chɛ n dini maa di wuhiya ni neesim bee yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ ni.
en: what it should do. None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!.

dag: A yi ka binshɛli din ni zaŋ yo, bɛ ni kpuɣi a bindoo chaŋ ka chɛ a.
en: If you should be unable to pay, they will take away even your bed.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi niŋ yomyom m-ba buŋa, ka o paɣisara anu bɛn daa be o sani n-tumd o tuma pah o zuɣu ka bɛ doli Dauda tuumba maa chaŋ, ka o ti leei Dauda paɣa.
en: Abigail quickly got ready and went back with David's messengers. She rode on her donkey, while five of her servant women walked alongside. She and David were married as soon as she arrived.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, dama nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ m birini, nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ma yurilim maŋli ŋɔ.
en: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.

dag: Wuntitali ni daŋ o tooni nti mali soli zal o.
en: Righteousness walks before God, making a road for his steps.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim nya yiko m-baŋ Masia yurilim yɛliŋ mini di wɔɣilim ni di dubu ni di ziliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I ask that youll have the power to grasp loves width and length, height and depth, together with all believers.

dag: Ka dindali maa nasara dibu suhupiɛlli maa daa leela suhugarigu dabisili Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa sani; dama bɛ daa wumya ni naa kumdila o bia maa kuli.
en: And so the joy of victory was turned into sadness for all of David's troops that day, because they heard that the king was mourning for his son.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti lo nia ni o ku Jɛrɔbɔam, amaa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zo n-kuli Ijipti Naa Shishak sani nti be Ijipti maa hal ka Sulemaana ti kpi.
en: Then Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam fled to Egypt and its king Shishak. Jeroboam remained in Egypt until Solomon died.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, m bɔri ni a mali duu zali ma, dama m mali tahima ni Naawuni ni deeg a suhigu, ka labisi ma ti a.
en: At the same time, get a room ready for me, because I hope that God will answer the prayers of all of you and give me back to you.

dag: A yi je suli, nyin miri ka a chɛ ka a sujee maa ti kpɛh a alahichi ni, ka a mi miri ka a je suli hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: If you become angry, do not let your anger lead you into sin, and do not stay angry all day.

dag: A daa nyɛla dabili ka ti Duuma bol a? Di chɛ ka di muɣis a. Amaa a yi ni tooi nya yolisim, nyin bom li.
en: Were you a slave when God called you? Well, never mind; but if you have a chance to become free, use it.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli yɛli, Chamiya! Ka bɛ daa yi dɔb maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ zaa daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋariti taba, amaa zomiya yi Naawuni, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must not cheat each other but fear your God because I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lih o ka yɛli, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni!.
en: When Jesus saw this, he said, Its very hard for the wealthy to enter Gods kingdom!.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒi m-baɣi kom pam ka mali buni pam ŋɔ, yi bahigu saha paaya. Yi shihi siɣiya.
en: People of Babylon, you live along the Euphrates River and are surrounded by canals. You are rich, but now the time has come for you to die.

dag: Ka nyini Izraɛl na biɛɣu ŋun dabisa pali ŋɔ, a tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha paaya.
en: But you vile, wicked prince of Israel whose day has come, the time of final punishment.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti wum lala niriba maa yɛligu. Di zɔnya ba nambɔɣu bee n-fa ba bahi.
en: You must not agree with them. Dont listen to them or feel sorry for them. Dont let them go free or protect them.

dag: dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi ni nabipuɣinsi ni Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaa be Ahikam bia Shafan san la chaŋ. Bɛ daa zaŋ anabi Jɛrimia mini Nɛria bia Baruk gba chaŋ.
en: Baruch and I and others in the group had been staying with Gedaliah, because Nebuzaradan, the Babylonian officer in charge of the guard, had ordered him to take care of the king's daughters and quite a few men, women, and children.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa malim shili n-ka Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni na. Ka n ti ʒin nimaani n-kari zuliya kam bɛn gili luɣilikam zaa la saria.
en: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n wuhi tuumbiɛrinima a soya, ka alahichinim ŋmaligi lab a sanna.
en: Then I will teach sinners your commands, and they will turn back to you.

dag: Zaŋmiya sania maŋa mini kuruwa maŋa ni taha din nyɛ zaɣ maŋa n-zahindi binyara.
en: You must use fair scales, a fair ephah, and a fair bath.

dag: N yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ mi ni yi di chɛ ka so zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa yɔhim ya.
en: Im telling you this so that no one deceives you with convincing arguments.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ nti ʒini tin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la ni di chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Bɛ daa yɛliya ni bɛ ni ti bol o Nazarɛt nira.
en: He went to a town called Nazareth and lived there. This gave full meaning to what God said through the prophets. God said the Messiah would be called a Nazarene.

dag: Lumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka jɛmiy o kɔŋko, ka zaŋya yimaŋ ti o, ka zaŋd o yuli pɔri pɔri.
en: You must respect the Lord your God and worship only him. Never leave him. When you make promises, you must use his name only.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ daanya mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi kɔbisinahi n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi zoligɔnim zaŋ lo zuɣuri ayi la kulis ayi.
en: pomegranates in two rows for the chain designs.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi be yi ni?.
en: Surely you know that you are God's temple and that God's Spirit lives in you!.

dag: Nyo bɔ ka n daa naan tooi nya bɛ nuhi tuma ni? Bɛ yaa zaa daa naaya.
en: They were a bunch of worn-out men, too weak to do any work for me.

dag: A yuli zuɣu, di tabigi ti bahi. Miri ka a filim a nam ʒiishee din mali jilima ŋɔ. Teema, ka miri ka a saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la.
en: Remember your promises and do not despise us; do not bring disgrace on Jerusalem, the place of your glorious throne. Do not break the covenant you made with us.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa, ka di bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔb sabila ka di ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi ninvuɣ so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: If, when the priest examines you, the sore does not appear to be deeper than the surrounding skin, but there are still no healthy hairs in it, he shall isolate you for seven days.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛla wuntizɔbo yɛtɔɣa, di shɛli pala ʒiri bee n-nyɛ din gɔŋ.
en: All the words of my mouth are righteous; nothing in them is twisted or crooked.

dag: ka yɛli Kɔra min o nyaandoliba maa, Biɛɣuni asiba Yawɛ sa ni wuh o ni pii so ni ŋun be kasi ni o ni yɛn chɛ ka so ka o sanna. O ni pii so, o ni chɛ ka dilan ka o sanna.
en: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sulemaana n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Salima sara maligu bimbini mini salima teebuli shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: Solomon also made all the equipment for the LORDs temple: the gold altar; the gold table for the bread of the presence.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Lamɛk.
en: When Methuselah was years old, he became the father of Lamech.

dag: hal niriba ata ŋɔ yi be nimaani, hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibisi bee bɛ bipuɣinsi, bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko n-naan tiligi. Amaa tiŋgbani maa naan kpalim zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and even if those three men lived there—as surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God—they would not be able to save even their own children. They would save only their own lives, and the land would become a wilderness.

dag: Ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Bɔzuɣu ka a ŋari ma zaŋ m bipuɣinsi zo kaman tɔbu ka a tuhi gbahi ba maa? Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma maa?.
en: Laban said to Jacob, What have you done? You have deceived me and taken off with my daughters as if they were prisoners of war.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan tim tuumba Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋmi m paɣ Mikal ŋun nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ Filistianim yokol gbana kɔbiga yo so zuɣu la ti ma na.
en: David sent messengers to Sauls son Ish Bosheth. David said, Give me my wife Michal. She was promised to me. I killed Philistines to get her.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bo bulah ayi ti o ka o mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛla yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: He will take from the Israelite community two male goats for a purification offering and one ram for an entirely burned offering.

dag: A ni niŋ shɛm maa bi viɛla. Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi simdila kubu, dama yi bi gul yi dan naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyam naa kpan la min o ko gaɣili din ʒe o zuɣusaa la ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: You made a big mistake. As surely as the Lord is alive, you and your men should die, because you didnt protect your master, the Lord s chosen king. Look for the kings spear and the water jug that was near Sauls head. Where are they.

dag: Ka o daa yaag o noli m-mɔri Naawuni, ka galindi Naawuni yuli min o biɛhigu shee zaŋ tabili bɛnkam be alizanda ni.
en: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.

dag: Ka so di ti bɔhi ni o nyɛla ŋun viɛl bee ŋun bi viɛla, ka so mi di ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, ka so yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, dindina o min o ni zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o maa zaa ni leei din be kasi, ka so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn dol Naawuni zaligunima, ka ʒe Yisa yim la mal ania.
en: This means that Gods holy people must be patient. They must obey Gods commands and keep their faith in Jesus.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Wummiya, ka kpahi Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu ni yɛli.
en: Hear this and speak against the house of Jacob, says the LORD God, the God of heavenly forces.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku a min a niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm jɛndi zuliya shɛli din zaɣisi ni di ku jɛm Babilɔn Naa la?.
en: Why should you and your people die in war or of starvation or disease? That is what the Lord has said will happen to any nation that does not submit to the king of Babylonia.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a ni lihiri ti ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa kpi? Zaŋm bindirigu taɣi ti mini ti puri maa, ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa leei Firawuna daba; ka ti ti bimbira din ni chɛ ka ti gali ka ku kpi, ka ti puri maa gba ku kpalim doya yoli.
en: Surely we will die while you are watching. But if you give us food, we will give Pharaoh our land, and we will be his slaves. Give us seed so that we can plant. Then we will live and not die, and the land will grow food for us again.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvi zuliya polo m-bɔŋɔ; Zaŋm a Tumim ti Lɛvi zuliya ka zaŋ a Urim ti ŋun ʒe a yim a ni daa zahim so Masa la, a mini ŋun daa mo Mɛriba kom ni la.
en: About the tribe of Levi he said: You, Lord , reveal your will by the Urim and Thummim Through your faithful servants, the Levites; You put them to the test at Massah And proved them true at the waters of Meribah.

dag: Amaa Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Laribunim ni Ammɔnnim ni Ashidɔdnim ni daa wum ni Jɛrusalɛm goma maa mali me tuma chani tooni hal ka di voya piligi ŋaribu la, ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam.
en: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum? Dahin shɛli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kana ti kpe a tuma ni hal ni zuŋɔ, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum ka di bi tiɣ a nini, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ku tooi doli chaŋ ti tuhi n-dan naa dimnima.
en: But what have I done? David asked. Do you know of anything I've ever done that would keep me from fighting the enemies of my king.

dag: A yɛn gbibila so kur shɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni daa doli la?.
en: Job, you are walking on the old path that evil people walked on long ago.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya do so bee paɣ so ŋun tum tuumbiɛɣu maa ti zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini n-labi doo maa bee paɣa maa kuɣa ku o.
en: you must punish the person who did this evil thing. You must take that man or woman out to a public place near the city gates and kill them with stones.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu maa ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani. Di yuuni maa ni, di ti biriya bee n-kpuɣi bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli bee m-pɔhiya yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni wala.
en: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee year for you. Do not plant, do not harvest the secondary growth, and do not gather from the freely growing vines.

dag: Ka timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni laasabuniŋdiba daa laɣim na ka n ti yɛli ba n zahindi maa, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: Then all the fortunetellers, magicians, wizards, and astrologers were brought in, and I told them my dream, but they could not explain it to me.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi kpe m-me sara maligu bimbini maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: because any altar you build for the Lord your God must be made of uncut stones. There you are to offer the sacrifices that are to be burned.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ kurugu tahipɔŋ zali, ka di leei kurugu gooni a mini tiŋ maa sunsuuni. Ka a zaŋ a ninni kpa li, ka chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni teei gili shɛli, ka di nyɛ nyini n-teei gil li. Ka dimbɔŋɔ maa leei shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu Jɛrusalɛm n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu biŋkɔbiri gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: Josiah commanded that Passover be celebrated in Jerusalem to honor the Lord . So, on the fourteenth day of the first month, the lambs were killed for the Passover celebration.

dag: amaa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ gar o yi ti lir o n-nyaŋ o, o farila o bidibbin shɛŋa o ni niŋ yɛda maa, ka fa o nɛma maa.
en: But if a stronger man comes and defeats him, he will carry off the weapons in which the strong man trusted. Then he will divide with others what he has taken.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, A ku tooi nya n ninni, dama ninsal ku tooi nya n ninni ka lan be.
en: But you cannot see my face. No one can see me and continue to live.

dag: A niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri kaman saɣiri la, dinzuɣu ka n yur a zaligunima.
en: You throw away the wicked of this world like trash. So I love your rules.

dag: ka Okiran bia Pagiɛl daa nyɛ Asha zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Pagiel, Ochrans son, commanded the military of the tribe of Asher.

dag: Malimiya firilanim ayopɔin tam di zuɣu, ka di ne di tooni.
en: Make its seven lamps and set up its lamps so that they direct their light in front of the lampstand.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali maa daa moli bahi ha, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li yɛli nayilinima.
en: Then the gatekeepers of the city shouted out and told the people in the kings palace.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam n-su Izraɛlnim maa, o daa dila nam maa yuma ayi. Amaa Judanim bɛn daa dolila Dauda.
en: Sauls son Ishbosheth was years old when he became king over Israel, and he ruled for two years. The house of Judah, however, followed David.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa bɔhi Lɔt, A mali ninvuɣ shɛb yaŋɔ pahi? A bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a deennim bee a dɔɣiriba shɛb yi be yaŋɔ, nyin cham ti zaŋ ba yi yaŋɔ.
en: The two men said to Lot, Are there any other people from your family living in this city? Do you have any sons-in-law, sons, daughters, or any other people from your family here? If so, you should tell them to leave now.

dag: Masia n-nyɛ ti suhudoo. Ŋuna n-daai dimdi goon shɛli din be Yɛhudianim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim la sunsuuni la luhi, ka zaŋ ba naai taba.
en: Christ is our peace. He made both Jews and Gentiles into one group. With his body, he broke down the barrier of hatred that divided us.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa nya ka o bi dɔɣi bihi ti Yaakubu maa zuɣu ka o daa zabir o biɛli nyuli, ka yɛli Yaakubu, Tim ma bihi, di yi pa lala, n ni kpi.
en: Rachel saw that she was not giving Jacob any children. She became jealous of her sister Leah. So Rachel said to Jacob, Give me children, or I will die.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ pateesa maa yili bansi maa, ka zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la na ti zali di puuni, ka pateesa maa woligi luɣ kasi shee ka chɛ luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Place the curtain under the row of hooks in the roof of the Tent, and put behind the curtain the Covenant Box containing the two stone tablets. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhi, N napɔŋ yɛn sarigi la, Yawɛ, ka a yurilim maŋli la gbaai ma zali.
en: I said, I am falling; but your constant love, O Lord , held me up.

dag: Ka Musa mini Nan bia Jɔshua daa kana ti zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ wum li.
en: Moses and Joshua son of Nun recited this song, so that the people of Israel could hear it.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi maligumaaniba maa yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka Lɛvinim mi bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, bɛ yuya ka bɛ daa sabira kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni kaman bɛ ni daa piripiri ba shɛm.
en: The priests were assigned their duties by clans, and the Levites twenty years of age or older were assigned theirs by work groups.

dag: Yihim ʒiri mini yɔhiŋ n kɔbili ni. Di chɛ ka n nyɛ faralana bee bundana. Tim ma bindir shɛli din ni saɣi ma.
en: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.

dag: ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani, bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini niɣi ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be yi sani, ka doli ya yi ŋariŋ maa ni na alikauli.
en: This includes the birds and the animals that came out of the boat.

dag: Daadam Bia mi kamina ni o ti bo n-nya bɛn bɔrigi la n-tiligi ba.
en: The Son of Man came to look for and to save people who are lost.

dag: Pallu zuliya n-daa nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: The descendants of Pallu were Eliab.

dag: Nyama, ka paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ dunɔgula ʒiya maani alikama, ka gom ti gbaag o ka o gbihi, di saha ka Rɛkab min o mabia Baana daa sɔɣ kpe.
en: The woman at the door had become drowsy while she was sifting wheat and had fallen asleep, so Rechab and Baanah slipped in.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: You men are so wise, so clever; listen now to what I am saying.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o mini Yɛhudianim ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn daa jɛmdi Naawuni tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla bɛ jɛmbu duu; ka o daa yi lan yiri daa ni nti tɔɣisiri ŋunkam yɛn gar o sani Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.

dag: Di saha ka ŋarin shɛŋa din daa yi Taibɛrias na kana ti zani miri luɣ shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni sa paɣi Naawuni bɔrɔbɔro zuɣu ka zaŋ li ti niriba ka bɛ ŋub la.
en: Some boats came from Tiberias, near the place where they had eaten the bread over which the Lord had given thanks.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niriba leei daba.
en: He moved the people to the cities from one end of Egypt to the other.

dag: Ka shɛb pun yɛli ba a yɛla ni a wuhirila Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn be bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tinsi ni la ni bɛ zaɣisim Anabi Musa zaligu, ka lan yɛri ba ni bɛ di gundi bɛ bihi, ka mi di lan doli bɛ kaya.
