en: But they have been told that you are teaching those who live among the Gentiles to disobey this Law. They claim that you are telling them not to circumcise their sons or to follow our customs.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: These are the rules for the guilt offering, which is very holy:.

dag: Amaa yinim ti miriya! Dinzuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: So be careful. Now I have warned you about all this before it happens.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kul tia, din wula chaŋ ti kpe kɔzɔrim ni, wuuni yi ti du, di baɣa kani, ka di vari kul nyɛ va maha sahakam. Ka sanzali yuuni puuni, di baɣa kani, ka wala kul bi kɔŋdi di zuɣu.
en: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.

dag: N ni zaŋ Raba leei laakuma mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka zaŋ Ammɔnnim fɔntinsi leei biŋkɔbbaligu gariche. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will make the city Rabbah a pasture for camels and the country of Ammon a sheep pen. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo kul niŋdila bɛ suhuri ni yu ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti gbahi ba kɔri la; bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ ni bi baŋ yɛl shɛŋa gbinni. Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman biŋkɔbiri la.
en: These false teachers are like irrational animals, mere creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They slander what they dont understand and, like animals, they will be destroyed.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa, ka tummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ni yi tum shɛm maa, ka miriya ka yi birigi kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo.
en: People of Israel, be sure that you do everything that the Lord your God has commanded you. Do not disobey any of his laws.

dag: Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ leei Juda naa n-zali Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin zaani.
en: Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Zedekiah, Josiahs son, to succeed Coniah, Jehoiakims son, as king of Judah.

dag: Sokam fom baalim Yawɛ tooni, dama o yiɣisi zani luɣ kasi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Everyone, be quiet! The Lord is coming out of his holy house.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, n yi yɔhi yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I open the graves where my people are buried and bring them out, they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Kaɣili ni tooi zooi luɣ shɛli ka pa ni baa ni? Kaɣili ni tooi zooi viɛnyɛliŋga ka pa ni kom ni be luɣ shɛli?.
en: Can papyrus grow tall on a dry land? Can reeds grow without water?.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ka tumdi n yubu hal nti paai di bahigu, n ni ti o yiko ka o su zuliya paai shɛm fukumsi.
en: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yoog o daazichi duu din nyɛ zuɣusaa ŋɔ tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saa mibu saha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni; ka yi ti dihi zuliya pam samli, amaa yinim ti ku di so samli.
en: The Lord will open his storehouse where he keeps his rich blessings. He will send rain at the right time for your land. He will bless everything you do. You will have money to lend to many nations. And you will not need to borrow anything from them.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bidib kpamba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba Ham suɣa ni la.
en: He killed all the firstborn sons in Egypt. He killed every firstborn in Hams family.

dag: Dinzuɣu wulimpuhili polo nim ni ti tibigi Yawɛ; ka bɛn ʒi n-dolisi teeku tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli.
en: They will say, People in the east, praise the Lord ! People in faraway lands, praise the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chani ti miri Jɛriko, ka zoon so daa ʒi sokpaŋ maani bara.
en: As Jesus came to Jericho, a certain blind man was sitting beside the road begging.

dag: Ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani, ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ nya Yisa taali ka fiɣis o. Ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nira chɛ ka so kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: In the synagogue there was a man with a crippled hand. Some Jews there were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus of doing wrong. So they asked him, Is it right to heal on the Sabbath day.

dag: Yinim Izraɛl bipuɣinsi, kummiya Sool zuɣu. Ŋuna n-zaŋ mulifu viɛlli soli ya. Ŋuna n-zaŋ salima yɛri yɛli ya.
en: Women of Israel, mourn for Saul! He clothed you in rich scarlet dresses and adorned you with jewels and gold.

dag: Di simdi ka a daa beei chɛriga gili zoli maa, ka di chɛ ka so baai yaɣ li, ka yɛli ba ni so di miri zoli maa gbini bee so ti du li. Ka ŋunkam ti shihi zoli maa, bɛn kum o.
en: Warn the people that they are forbidden to touch any part of the mountain. Anyone who does will be put to death.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ galisiya gari wuna zaa, o ni daa tiligi niriba maa Ijiptinim nuu ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa niŋdi ba fitiina la zuɣu.
en: Now I know that the Lord is the greatest God, because he has rescued Israel from their arrogant enemies.

dag: Yiɣisimiya gbaai soli chaŋ ti siɣi Arinɔn vinvamli ni du. Nyamiya, n zaŋ Sihɔn Amɔri nir ŋun nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa ŋɔ min o tiŋgbɔŋ niŋ yi nuu ni, ŋmɛmiy o tɔbu m-piligi li deebu.
en: So get going. Cross the Arnon ravine. I have handed Sihon the Amorite king of Heshbon and his land over to you. Its time to possess the area! Its time to fight him in battle!.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, A ni suhi shɛli maa yɛla kpɛma, di zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti kpuɣ ma a sani chani ka a nya ma, a ni nya a ni bɔri shɛli maa, amaa a yi ti bi nya ma, a ku nya li.
en: Elijah said, Youve made a difficult request. If you can see me when Im taken from you, then it will be yours. If you dont see me, it wont happen.

dag: A yi je suli, nyin miri ka a chɛ ka a sujee maa ti kpɛh a alahichi ni, ka a mi miri ka a je suli hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: Be angry without sinning. Dont let the sun set on your anger.

dag: Man Tɛrisius ŋun sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri ya ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Judanim mali kpiɔŋ; ka fa Izraɛlnim mi bahi. N ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ba labisi yiŋ na. Bɛ ni be kaman n na ʒi n-zaɣisi ba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka ni wum bɛ suhigu.
en: I will make Judahs family strong. I will help Josephs family win the war. I will bring them back safely and comfort them. It will be as if I never left them. I am the Lord their God, and I will help them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn naa ni ti zaŋ o takɔbi na ti lu a zuɣu.
en: The LORD God proclaims: The sword of the king of Babylon is coming against you!.

dag: Dama Judanima, yi wuna kul galisimi kaman yi fɔntinsi ni galisi shɛm, ka yi sara maligu bimbin shɛŋa yi ni me n-zali m maani maligu tiri Baal ka di nyɛ vi la mi galisi kaman Jɛrusalɛm pala ni galisi shɛm.
en: You have as many gods as you have towns, Judah, and you have as many shameful altars for worshipping Baal as you have streets in Jerusalem.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu soli wuhiri ya ni doo yi mali zab wɔɣila di nyɛla vi.
en: Isn't it unnatural and disgraceful for men to have long hair?.

dag: Di tiriya nimmira yɛlimaŋli, amaa doliyala yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Stop judging by the way things look. Be fair and judge by what is really right.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Sool daa yihi Dauda o sani n-zaŋ o leei tɔbbihi tuhili zuɣulana, ka o daa zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ka labirina.
en: So Saul removed David from his service, placing him in command of a unit of one thousand men. David led the men out to war and back.

dag: N suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu; ka yihi ma n dabeenzɔbo zaa ni.
en: I sought the LORD and he answered me. He delivered me from all my fears.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn be maa sani, dama bɛ zaa ninni ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba, ka yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But I acted for my names sake, so that it wouldnt be degraded in the sight of the nations among whom they lived, and in whose sight I made it known that I would lead them out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu gol so ŋun daa daŋ tooni yuun shɛli din pahir ayi maa ni dahin yini dali, ka o daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the dwelling was set up.

dag: Ka Hiburunim bɛn daa pun be Filistianim sani hal ti paai tɔb maa tuhibu saha maa mini bɛn daa pahi doli ba chaŋ bɛ sansani maa ni zaa daa dii ŋmaligi pahi Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zuɣu.
en: There were also some hired soldiers in the Philistine camp, who now switched to Israel's side and fought for Saul and Jonathan.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Soon after Josiah's son Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ku vuui, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ku kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Righteous people will always have security, but the wicked will not survive in the land.

dag: Ka firila ti ku lan ne a ni; ka so mi ti ku lan wum amiliya aŋgo min o daamiliya kukoya a ni, dama a kɔhigɔriba daa nyɛla dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira, ka a daa zaŋ a baɣibuɣibo yɔhim zuliya kam.
en: The light of a lamp will never shine among you again. The sound of a bridegroom and bride will never be heard among you again because your merchants ran the world, because all the nations were deceived by the spell you cast, and because.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni; o saria karibu be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Lord is our God. He rules the whole world.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi lee ŋmɛri maa.
en: Jesus asked his disciples, What are you arguing with them about.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi kaman o ni daa kpi shɛm, dindina ti shiri ni pah o zuɣu neei kum ni kaman o ni daa neei kum ni shɛm la.
en: Christ died, and we have been joined with him by dying too. So we will also be joined with him by rising from death as he did.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri ti Naa Sulemaana yɛm kaman o ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm, ka suhudoo daa be o mini Hiram sunsuuni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa niŋ naŋgban yini.
en: The Lord made Solomon wise as he had promised. Hiram and Solomon made a treaty between themselves and were at peace with one another.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ li na ka o piligi li n-nya bia maa, ka bia maa dii gbaai kuhigu. Ka di daa niŋ o yoli, ka o yɛli, Hiburunim bihi la ni yino m-bala.
en: The princess opened it and saw a baby boy. He was crying, and she felt sorry for him. This is one of the Hebrew babies, she said.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛɣu ŋɔ, amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa ka n yɛn zaŋ kar a saria! A mi ni m mali halli, ka bɔri ni n nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri n ni bi biri binshɛli bebɔ?.
en: The king replied, I will judge you by the words of your own mouth, you worthless servant! You knew, did you, that Im a stern man, withdrawing what I didnt deposit, and harvesting what I didnt plant?.

dag: Ka n teei ti Duuma ni daa yɛli ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinima ni dee la Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu la yɛla.
en: I remembered the Lords words: John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛlimi, To! Yawɛ shiri niŋmi lala. Yawɛ chɛ ka a ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ niŋ pali, ka o zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa mini ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛ ni daa gbahi n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: Wonderful! I hope the Lord will do this! I certainly hope he will make your prophecy come true and will bring back from Babylonia all the Temple treasures and all the people who were taken away as prisoners.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn daŋ yi tooni du kaman buɣim din dira. O ni nyaŋ ba ka gbarigi ba tin ya din ni chɛ ka yi kari ba yihi, ka ku ba yomyom kaman Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm.
en: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ niriba pam na ti lir a, ka bɛ ti lab a kuɣa, ka zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmahiŋmah a jilajila.
en: They will stir up a crowd to stone you, and they will cut you to pieces with their swords.

dag: O ni daa nya ba maa ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti zaŋ yimaŋ wuhi maligumaaniba. Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus saw them, he said, Go, show yourselves to the priests. As they left, they were cleansed.

dag: Yawɛ ni bi tooi zaŋ niriba ŋɔ kulisi o ni daa po ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni zuɣu, ka o ku ba mɔɣu maa ni maa.
en: The Lord was not able to bring them into the land he promised them. So he killed them in the desert.

dag: hal nimaani gba n yɛn bela a nuu ni, ka a nudirigu gbib ma kirikiri.
en: you would be there to lead me, you would be there to help me.

dag: ka Farigudeeriba kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Zakius ka o nyɛ bundana daa be nimaani.
en: where a man named Zacchaeus lived. He was in charge of collecting taxes and was very rich.

dag: Tɛra ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ibram mini Nahɔr so ni Haran.
en: After Terah was years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ni niŋ lala, dindina yin lomiya kpara Yawɛ nini ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa maag o paɣa Batishiiba suhu, ka o min o daa lan dɔni ka o dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Sulemaana. Ka Yawɛ daa yur o pam.
en: David comforted his wife Bathsheba and slept with her. Later on, she gave birth to another son and named him Solomon. The Lord loved Solomon.

dag: ka di yi nyɛla niriba sɔŋbu, chɛliya ka ti sɔŋm ba. Ka ŋun nyɛ karimba, ŋun wuhima;.
en: If your gift is service, devote yourself to serving. If your gift is teaching, devote yourself to teaching.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; di chɛ ka ninsalinim yaa gari a yaa! Chɛ ka zuliya kam ka a sanna ka a ti kari ba saria.
en: Lord , get up and judge the nations. Dont let anyone think they can win against you.

dag: Shɛmida bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahian mini Shɛkɛm ni Likihi ni Aniam.
en: Shemida had four sons: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan gbaag o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu mini ʒiŋmabo.
en: Then you must keep your tongue from evil and keep your lips from speaking lies!.

dag: Ka anabinim shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl daa yina ti bɔhi Ilaisha, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: The group of prophets from Bethel came out to Elisha. These prophets said to Elisha, Do you know that the LORD is going to take your master away from you today? Elisha said, Yes, I know. Dont talk about it.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyari bindirigu diri tiɣira, amaa ka kum mali ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The righteous eat their fill, but the wicked have empty stomachs.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino mi yi ni yɛn doli kasitali biɛhigu mini jilima soli shɛm n-kpuɣ omaŋmaŋ paɣa.
en: and learn how to control your own body in a pure and respectable way.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yi Sulemaana zuɣu yuŋ yɛl o, N wum a suhigu maa, ka pii kpe ŋɔ ni di nyɛ n sara maligu duu.
en: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon at night and said to him, Solomon, I have heard your prayer, and I have chosen this place for myself to be a house for sacrifices.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayɔbu saha, ka Baasha bia Ɛla daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuma ayi.
en: In the twenty-sixth year of Judahs King Asa, Elah, Baashas son, became king over Israel. He ruled in Tirzah for two years.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ zuliya kam zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni yi wɔbi olivi tiwala din bahindi nyaaŋa ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha bɛ ni yi wɔbi li naai saha shɛli la.
en: This is what will happen in every nation all over the world. It will be like the end of harvest, when the olives have been beaten off every tree and the last grapes picked from the vines.

dag: N ni wuh o o ni yɛn di wahala shɛm n yuli zuɣu.
en: I will show him all that he must suffer for me.

dag: Miri ka a sɔɣi doya ni a liri wuntizɔra yiŋa kaman ninvuɣ biɛɣu la. Miri ka a liri wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: Wicked one, dont wait secretly at the home of the righteous. Dont destroy their dwelling.

dag: dindina di simdi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, ka o ti po pɔri wuhi ni o nuu bi tim o kpee maa azichi maa ni, ka di simdi ni biŋkɔbigu maa lan saɣi pɔri maa, ka samli yɔbu lan kani.
en: If you swear with me as your witness that you did not harm the animal, you do not have to replace it. Your word is enough.

dag: Ka shia maa daa kpalim zani, amaa n daa bi tooi baŋ di ŋmahiŋgbana ni nyɛ shɛm. Kɔtomsi shɛli n-daa ʒe n tooni, ka vuri daa fo, di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli ni yɛli.
en: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say.

dag: Dama Mani Naawuni m-mɔŋ o yɛm, ka mɔŋ o baŋsim.
en: God didnt endow her with sense, didnt give her some good sense.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na n-zɔri chani tiŋgban nɛli zuɣu kaman mɔɣili la.
en: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.

dag: amaa n zɔrila bɛ dimnim ni yɛn kuri ma sul shɛli, dama bɛ dimnim maa ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ka ni yɛli, Ti nuhi n-ti ti nasara, pa Yawɛ n-daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: but their enemies rage concerned me; their opponents might misunderstand. They might say, Our strong hands, not the LORDs, did all this.

dag: Yɛhudia do so daa be Susa din nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni ka o yuli booni Mɔdɛkai. O daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira. Mɔdɛkai ba n-daa nyɛ Jair. O yaba n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi, ka o yab do kurili mi nyɛ Kish.
en: At this time a Jew named Mordecai was living in Susa. His father was Jair, and his grandfather Shimei was the son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti di daa, ka bɛ saɣi ni o yom ba tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri; ka o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ o puu maa ni.
en: He agreed to pay the workers one silver coin for working that day. Then he sent them into the vineyard to work.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun saɣisiri ma ŋɔ, ka n suhu ni tɛha mi wuhiri ma yuŋ.
en: I will bless the LORD who advises me; even at night I am instructed in the depths of my mind.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa .
en: Jesus said to them, Come with me, and I will teach you to catch people.

dag: Nyini n-ti wɔhu yaa? Nyini n-zaŋ gbɛm tam o nyiŋgoli zuɣu?.
en: Did you give the horse its strength? Did you put the mane on its neck?.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wuna bee ka yimaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ binshɛli dooi mali binnana. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not worship idols. Do not make statues of gods for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti ni yɛli? Ti tummi alahichi ti ni lan ka fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ka bela Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni maa zuɣu? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: So what should we do? Should we sin because we are under grace and not under law? Certainly not!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Sandihir so n-daa be m-mal o sandaannima ayi; yino daa di o samli ka di paai tumtumda yuma ayi tuma yɔri, ka ŋun la mi di o samli ka di paai tumtumda chira ayi tuma yɔri.
en: There were two men who owed money to a moneylender, Jesus began. One owed him five hundred silver coins, and the other owed him fifty.

dag: N zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bɔhi n yɛla, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bo ma nya ma. N yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn bi suhiri ma, Mani m-bɔŋɔ, mani m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I helped people who had not come to me for advice. Those who found me were not looking for me. I spoke to a nation that does not use my name. I said, Here I am! Here I am.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni wum n suhigu ka deei n suhigu maa.
en: But God definitely listened. He heard the sound of my prayer.

dag: Ka daantalis ayi mini kɔniŋdi bini ni tɔroko shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, di zaa daanya daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ ku tooi buɣisi baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed.

dag: Ka o daa yi nimaani chaŋ Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu, ka daa ti yi nimaani lab Samaria.
en: Elisha went up to Mount Carmel, then returned to Samaria.

dag: ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum mini alɔbo ti luri pam; ka binyara din kpɛhiri niriba dabiɛm ti beni, ka shihir kara ti wuhiri zuɣusaa.
en: There will be great earthquakes, and in many places people will starve to death and suffer terrible diseases. All sorts of frightening things will be seen in the sky.

dag: amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun kul tumdila o maligumaanitali tuma, dama o kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But Jesus lives on forever, and his work as priest does not pass on to someone else.

dag: Ka n yi tumdila mmaŋmaŋ ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina n saɣiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tuhiya.
en: But if Im doing the thing that I dont want to do, Im agreeing that the Law is right.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Mɛsopoteemia m-mali hal ti paai Shɛkɛm din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ni alaafee nti ti suɣa dɔni tiŋ maa tooni polo.
en: Jacob arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan on his trip from Paddan-aram, and he camped in front of the city.

dag: Chɛ ka so ku niŋ o nirilim. So di zo o kpibisi maa nambɔɣu.
en: May no one ever be kind to him or care for the orphans he leaves behind.

dag: ka di yi ti bi, o dii piinila di chɛbu, di chɛbu saha ni paai zuɣu.
en: Then when harvest season comes and the grain is ripe, the farmer cuts it with a sickle.

dag: Ɛvilmɛrɔdak daa tɔɣisi Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o jilima ʒiishee n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa laɣim niriba maa tampiŋ maa gbini ka Musa ti yɛli ba, Yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ, wummiya pumpɔŋɔ, ti chɛ ka kom yi kuɣili ŋɔ ni na n-tin ya.
en: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly before the rock. He said to them, Listen, you rebels! Should we produce water from the rock for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa fa Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛlnima, ka a ti bɔri ni a fa li?.
en: So now that the LORD, Israels God, has driven out the Amorites before his people Israel, will you take possession of their land?.

dag: N kpalimla yɔbahi mabia, ka nyɛ taatahi dolinikpee.
en: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Filistianim maa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei bɛ ni ku shɛb maa nɛma, ka daa nya ka Sool min o bidibis ata maa lu n-dola Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The day after the battle, when the Philistines returned to the battlefield to take the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers, they found Saul and his three sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Jɛrigu n-yihiri suhuyiɣisili palo ni. Amaa yɛndan ŋun kul gbib li la baalim.
en: Fools are quick to express their anger, but wise people are patient and control themselves.

dag: Ka Yisa daa nya o m-bol o na ti yɛl o, A yipa nya amaŋa a dɔro ŋɔ ni.
en: When he saw her, Jesus called her to him and said, Woman, you are set free from your sickness.

dag: Ka Filistia nanim anu maa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ lab kul Ɛkurɔn dindali maa.
en: The five Philistine rulers watched the people of Beth Shemesh do this and then went back to Ekron that same day.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi la. N ni zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a zuliya maa, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: I will give you as many descendants as there are stars in the sky, and I will give them all this territory. All the nations will ask me to bless them as I have blessed your descendants.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋmi bia ŋɔ kuli ti wubis o ti ma ka n yo a. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa kuli ti wubis o.
en: and the king's daughter told her, Take care of this child, and I will pay you. The baby's mother carried him home and took care of him.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim noya lan woli.
en: Again there was a division among the people because of these words.

dag: yi yɛra, Bɔ saha ka goli palli dabisili lee yɛn gari, ka chɛ ka ti kɔhi ti kawana, ka bɔ saha ka Vuhim Dabisili lee yɛn gari ka chɛ ka ti kɔhi ti alikama? Ti ni doli ŋarili soli n-filim kaŋmɛri ŋmani, ka lee kpaŋsi di daa.
en: saying, When will the new moon be over so that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath so that we may offer wheat for sale, make the ephah smaller, enlarge the shekel, and deceive with false balances.

dag: Bɛ ti ma dansi n yaaŋa zuɣu. Bɛ niŋ li la zaɣ wɔɣila kaman pukpara ni wɔriti vuɣisi shɛm la.
en: They plowed my back like farmers; they made their furrows deep.

dag: Nol lɔbu maa daba ata dali ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o nam binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe n-ʒe nayili zɔŋ ni tuhi nam ʒiishee duu. Naa maa daa ʒila o nam ʒiishee tuhi dunoli.
en: On the third day of her fast Esther put on her royal robes and went and stood in the inner courtyard of the palace, facing the throne room. The king was inside, seated on the royal throne, facing the entrance.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so ti Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn ku so, so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, bɛ kul ni ku o mi.
en: No human beings that have been devoted can be bought back; they must be executed.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa; ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, and Caleb let him marry Achsah.

dag: Tarim so ŋun nahind o tarim taba ŋmanila sa so ŋun mi n-ʒi bindira zaa chaŋ.
en: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Bɛtimaakabɔt ni Hazarisusa.
en: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah.

dag: Amaa n ni tɔɣisila Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛtɔɣa, n yuya ni n yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisila Naawuni sani.
en: But I dont want to argue with you. I want to speak to God All-Powerful. I want to argue with God about my troubles.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa naai ka o yiɣisi n-zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo.
en: When Jesus had finished saying all this, he went on toward Jerusalem.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini fukumsi zaligu dolibu gbib o niriba zaa.
en: David ruled all Israel with fairness and justice.

dag: Ka bɛ yi di daa bi pun baŋ wuntia soli yɛla, di naan so n-gari bɛ baŋ li ka lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni zaligu kasi shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: It would be better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than, having come to know it, to turn back from the holy commandment entrusted to them.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋmɛri ŋun nam o naŋgbankpeeni zuɣu. Yaɣiri ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ ka a lee mɛra? bee m-bɔh o, A niŋ nuhi niŋ ma.
en: Doom to the one who argues with the potter, as if he were just another clay pot! Does the clay say to the potter, What are you making? or Your work has no handles?.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum? Dahin shɛli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kana ti kpe a tuma ni hal ni zuŋɔ, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum ka di bi tiɣ a nini, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ku tooi doli chaŋ ti tuhi n-dan naa dimnima.
en: David answered, What have I done wrong, sir? If, as you say, you haven't found any fault in me since the day I started serving you, why shouldn't I go with you, my master and king, and fight your enemies.

dag: M mi yi tɛha mini yi ni lo nia shɛli na ni yi ti birigi ma.
en: But I know what you are thinking, and I know you want to hurt me.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Absalom yiŋa nti bɔh o, Bɔ zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a tumtumdiba nyo m puu buɣim.
en: Joab went to Absalom's house and demanded, Why did your servants set fire to my field.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni zuɣulaannim daa bi mi n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n ni niŋ shɛli. N daa na bi yɛli Yɛhudianim mini maligumaaniba ni kpamba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yɛn tum tuma maa ni so shɛli.
en: The officials didnt know where I had gone or what I was doing. I hadnt yet told the Jews, the priests, the officials, the officers, or the rest who were to do the work.

dag: Pa Jɔn maŋmaŋa n-daa nyɛ neesim maa, amaa o daa kamina ni o ti niŋ neesim maa shɛhiralana.
en: He himself was not the light; he came to tell about the light.

dag: A bapir Shallum bia Hanamɛl ni ka a sanna ti yɛl a, Dam m puu din be Anatɔt la, dama nyini m-mali soli ni a da li.
en: Your cousin Hanamel, Shallums son, is on his way to see you; and when he arrives, he will tell you: Buy my field in Anathoth, for by law you are next in line to purchase it.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri bɔri ma? Yi bi mi ni di nyɛ ma la talahi ni m be m Ba duu.
en: He answered them, Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I had to be in my Father's house.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di bahigu saha ni ti paai ka o bahi nam balibu kam mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yiko balibu kam yoli, ka zaŋ o nam ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba la.
en: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.

dag: Sool daa bi yɛli shɛli dindali maa, dama o daa tɛhimi, Binshɛli n-niŋ o ka o bi be kasi, biɛhiŋ kani, o shiri bi bela kasi.
en: but Saul said nothing that day, because he thought, Something has happened to him, and he is not ritually pure.

dag: Ŋunkam zani sana nyaaŋa ka o paŋ binshɛli, yin deem dilan binyɛrigu, ŋunkam zaŋ binshɛli pa talima ka deei binshɛli ti tinzunnima, yin deemiy o ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima maa.
en: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Ainim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa dindali maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pinaayi.
en: All the people of Ai died that day; there were , men and women.

dag: Ka dilan naan yili yila yɛli niriba, N daa tumla alahichi, ka bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labisi di samli yo ma.
en: They sing before people and say: I have sinned, perverted justice, but didnt experience the consequences.

dag: N dabisa zɔri yomyom gari tizɔra; di kul zɔrimi gariti ka zaɣ viɛlli ka di ni.
en: My days race by, not one of them good.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia ka di ti chɛ biɛla ni o kpi, ka o daa suhu Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu maa, ka wuh o shihirili.
en: Around that same time, Hezekiah became deathly ill and prayed to the LORD, who answered him with a miraculous sign.

dag: N daa chɛ n yaaŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buri ma, ka chɛ n jira ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dariti sibiri n teeŋkɔbiri. M mi daa bi ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi bee bɛn tuhiri nintɔri viɛri ma.
en: Instead, I gave my body to attackers, and my cheeks to beard pluckers. I didnt hide my face from insults and spitting.

dag: Cheechi maa ni zaŋ dimaŋ ti Masia shɛm la, lala ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣiba gba zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti bɛ yidaannim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: The church serves under Christ, so it is the same with you wives. You should be willing to serve your husbands in everything.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Salinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the Lord , all nations! Praise him, all peoples!.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa ti paai Kapɛrinium nti kpe duu ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi di lee ŋmɛri sol ni la.
en: They came to Capernaum, and after going indoors Jesus asked his disciples, What were you arguing about on the road.

dag: Ka Gomna maa daa lan bɔhi ba pahi, Niriba ayi maa ni, ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Barabas.
en: Pilate asked the crowd again, Which of these two men do you want me to set free? Barabbas! they shouted.

dag: ka yi Sintani ŋun gbahi ba n-chɛ ka bɛ dol o nol la zana ni.
en: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.

dag: Guhimi Yawɛ, niŋmi yaa ka mali suhukpeeni. Guhimi Yawɛ!.
en: Hope in the LORD! Be strong! Let your heart take courage! Hope in the LORD!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa yɛli Samuɛl, Cham ti dɔni, o yi ti lan bol a, nyin yɛlima, Yawɛ, yɛlima, a dabili wumda. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa lan lab ti dɔni o dooshee maa.
en: So he said, Go back and lie down! If someone speaks to you again, answer, I'm listening, Lord . What do you want me to do? Once again Samuel went back and lay down.

dag: Ka Hadadɛza daa tim ti zaŋ Sirianim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la n-ka Hɛlam na, ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Hadadezer sent messengers to call in the Arameans who were on the other side of the Euphrates River. Then Shobach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led them to the town of Helam.

dag: Dinzuɣu paɣ maa ni daa nya ka tia maa wala lihibu mali kɔre, ka viɛl ni dibu, ka lan nyɛ ti shɛli din ni ti nir baŋsim maa, ka o pɔhigi li di, ka zaŋ di shɛli ti ti o yidana, ka o gba di.
en: The woman saw that the tree was beautiful with delicious food and that the tree would provide wisdom, so she took some of its fruit and ate it, and also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it.

dag: Ka maligumaana ni mali sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun chirim maa, o yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, o ni mali sara ti o Yawɛ sani, ka o nya taali chɛ m-paŋ.
en: At the altar the priest shall perform the ritual of purification to purify you from your sin, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Ka o daa tim nachimbi pola pia ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Kamɛl nti chaŋ Nabal sani ti zaŋ n yuli puh o.
en: David sent ten young men to talk to Nabal. He told them, Go to Carmel. Find Nabal and tell him Hello for me.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, N dana, a ka guuka, ka kɔbiliga ŋɔ mi zilim pam; ka wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ nya nyɛvili kom maa?.
en: Sir, the woman said, you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Di tamya ni m bela bandi ni. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I, Paul, am writing this greeting personally. Remember that Im in prison. Grace be with you.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ la.
en: But David did take the fort of Zion. This fort became the City of David.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo ti di, amaa ka kum na kul mali ba. Bɛ ni ti lan zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Hal bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bihi gba leei bindirigu.
en: Everywhere in the country people snatch and eat any bit of food they can find, but their hunger is never satisfied. They even eat their own children!.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti nya a ni tirisi labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ a ka yɛli, Ninive bahi yoli, ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili di zuɣu? Ya polo ka n lee yɛn nya bɛn ni maag a suhu ti a? .
en: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza tɔbbi kpamba salima nyɔtaɣira n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezers servants and brought them to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ fɔɣi Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi ni bɛ zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: Then his eyes were poked out, and he was put in chains, so he could be dragged off to Babylonia.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi gbani n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, man ŋun nyɛ yi dabipaɣ ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun ni paɣi n dan tumtumdiba naba.
en: Abigail bowed her face to the ground. She said, I am willing to be your slave woman, even if it is only to wash the feet of my masters servants.

dag: Di bi simdi ni ti be kaman Keen ŋun daa nyɛ Sintani nira ka ku o mabia la. Bɔzuɣu ka o daa lee ku o? Di nyɛla o tuma ni daa bi tuhi ka o mabia maa ŋun tuma tuhi la zuɣu.
en: We must not be like Cain; he belonged to the Evil One and murdered his own brother Abel. Why did Cain murder him? Because the things he himself did were wrong, and the things his brother did were right.

dag: Sabbu maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: MENE, MENE, TƐKƐL UFARISIN.
en: This is what was written: Number, number, weight, divisions.

dag: Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Amaziah did, from beginning to end, is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Ka Jɛrubaal Jɔash bia maa daa kul omaŋmaŋ yiŋ ti ʒini.
en: Gideon son of Joash went home.

dag: Hal o yi tum a taali siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin dahin yini ka ŋmaligi deeg o galimi siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin maa zaa, di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ m-paŋ o.
en: If he sins against you seven times in one day, and each time he comes to you saying, I repent, you must forgive him.

dag: Ka Mikaya lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu wummi Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. N daa nyala Yawɛ ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo;.
en: But Micaiah said, Listen to this message from the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne. All of heavens army was standing around him, some on his left side and some on his right side.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti ti din viɛla, ka ti puri atam niŋ pam.
en: Yes, the LORD gives what is good, and our land yields its produce.

dag: Chɛ ka n galimi kalinsi mini m biɛhigu din tuhi gbib ma, dama nyini ka n niŋ naani.
en: You are good and do what is right. I trust you to protect me.

dag: dama Naawuni nyɛla yino ka ni chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn guni yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka mi ni lan chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka bi guni la gba yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: There is only one God, and he accepts Gentiles as well as Jews, simply because of their faith.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm ka yɛdaniŋdiba mini Yisa tuumba maa ni cheechi kpamba maa daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam yɛla.
en: When they arrived in Jerusalem, the church, the apostles, and the elders all welcomed them. They gave a full report of what God had accomplished through their activity.

dag: Ka anabi kurili maa daa kpuɣi anab ŋuni maa pa buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kuli yiŋa ni bɛ ti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o.
en: The old prophet picked up the body, put it on his own donkey, and took it back to Bethel, so he could bury it and mourn for the prophet from Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ ba kaman o ni daa ku Ogi mini Sihɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanima ka niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm la.
en: The LORD will do to these enemies the same thing he did to the Amorite kings Sihon and Og, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa bɔhi Ilaija, Wɛi, n dima, a nya ma? Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a tum tuun biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka n nya a maa.
en: Ahab said, So, my enemy, you found me at last. Elijah answered: Yes, I did! Ahab, you have managed to do everything the Lord hates.

dag: Goli maa daba anu dali daa nyɛla bɛ ni daa gbaai Naa Jɛhɔyakin chaŋ la yuma anu saha.
en: It happened on the fifth day of the month, in the fifth year after King Jehoiachins deportation.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li, ŋunkam bi chɛ o ni mali shɛlikam ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: So then, you cannot be my disciple unless you give away everything you own.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Wula ka di lee sab Naawuni zaligu ni? Wula ka a lee karindi li.
en: Jesus replied, What is written in the Law? How do you interpret it.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee malila shili guli ba. Di yaala di noli gu ni di vali Jɛrusalɛm zuɣulaannim mini di tarimba bɛn galisi ni bɛnkam zaa mali suhupiɛlli be di ni.
en: The world of the dead is hungry for them, and it opens its mouth wide. It gulps down the nobles of Jerusalem along with the noisy crowd of common people.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. N ni ti kari ya saria Izraɛl tintariga, ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord , have done these things.

dag: Ka naa daa kpuɣ o salima jaaŋgbee la tir o.
en: The king held out the gold scepter to her, so she stood up and said.

dag: Miriya anab ʒirinim bɛn kani yi sanna m-be kaman piɛri n-nyɛ ba, amaa ka lee nyɛ kunduna bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Yisa min o nyaandoliba gba ni bɛ ka amiliya maa ni na.
en: Jesus and his followers were also invited.

dag: Cham ti sab niŋ litaafi ni zali wuhi niriba maa ni nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri shɛm; ka di ti di ba shɛhira sahakam.
en: God told me to write down in a book what the people are like, so that there would be a permanent record of how evil they are.

dag: Dama dindali yuŋ maa n ni tim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gari, ka ku Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa, ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka darigi Ijipti buɣa zaa tibili. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Ill pass through the land of Egypt that night, and Ill strike down every oldest child in the land of Egypt, both humans and animals. Ill impose judgments on all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim daa muɣisi Dan zuliya niriba n-kari ba labisi zoya ni tinsi la ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ siɣi tintan ni na.
en: The Amorites forced the tribe of Dan to live in the hill country. They had to stay in the hills because the Amorites would not let them come down to live in the valleys.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din pa salinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ takɔbi n-ku Asirianima. Bɛ ni ti yi tɔbu ni n-zo ni bɛ tiligi. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ nachimba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim mini bɛ kpamba maa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ suhuri zɔhira.
en: When the city leaders and the other people heard this, they became very upset.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti ni labisi bɛ binshɛɣukam ti ba, ka ku lan bɔhi ba shɛli yɛla. Ka n daa boli maligumaaniba na nti chɛ ka bɛ po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni lo alikauli ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The leaders answered, We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid. So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛli ba, Man ni chaŋ kulipaligu. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti gba ni dol a chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa yi nti kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, amaa dindali maa yuŋ maa bɛ daa bi gbaai shɛli.
en: Simon Peter said, I'm going fishing! The others said, We will go with you. They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol li Dauda tiŋa.
en: Then David made his home in the fortress. That is why it is named the City of David.

dag: Amaa ka di daa mali ti paai Naa Jɔash nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka maligumaaniba maa na bi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣ shɛli.
en: In the rd year that Joash was king, the priests still had not repaired the Temple.

dag: Juda Naa Ahaz ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha ka Ɛla bia Hɔshia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma awɛi.
en: Hoshea, Elahs son, became king in Samaria in the twelfth year of Judahs king Ahaz. He ruled over Israel for nine years.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni daa bɔri ni o kahigi wuhi bɛn ti yɛn nya o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la palibu, ka lan wuhi ni o ku taɣ o ni lo shɛm la zuɣu, ka o daa po pɔri pah o daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: To those who were to receive what he promised, God wanted to make it very clear that he would never change his purpose; so he added his vow to the promise.

dag: O nam sulinsi ni zaŋla teeku noli hal ti kpa teeku shɛli noli yaha, ka lan zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli hal ti kpa dunia tariga zaa.
en: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.

dag: N daa bi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tiŋ maa ni, dama ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa mini Piɛbil la n-nyɛ di jɛmbu duu.
en: I didnt see a temple in the city, because its temple is the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb.

dag: N tumdi tuun kpɛma ka nyari wahala, ka gaani gom waawaayili, ka kpiri kum ni kɔnyuri, ka kɔŋdi bindirigu waawaayili, ka chani gbinfini ka wari mali ma.
en: I have done hard and tiring work, and many times I did not sleep. I have been hungry and thirsty. Many times I have been without food. I have been cold and without clothes.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋum o lɔŋni, ka zaŋ o jilima kukoli ŋɔ tahi, ka o bi goori saanyaɣisibu saha shɛli ti yi wum o kukoli maa.
en: After the flashes of lightning you can hear his roaring voice. He thunders with his wonderful voice! And while his voice thunders, the lightning flashes continue.

dag: di saha ka o daa nya yɛm ka kahigi li, ka zal li, ka bo n-yihi li na.
en: He looked at wisdom and discussed it. He examined it and saw how much it is worth.

dag: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun daŋ tooni ni ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ni ŋun lan nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: I am the alpha and the omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

dag: ni Dimna ni Nahalal ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Dimnah and its pastures, Nahalal and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: Amaa o di ti miri sariga la gbinna bee n-ka sara maligu bimbini la gbinna, dama o nyɛla ŋun mali dalinli, ka lala chɛ ka o ku dihi n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ vi; dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord , the one who makes a priest holy.

dag: Ka o daa ʒini ka boli bɛ pinaayi maa na ti yɛli ba, Ŋun bɔri ni o gari sokam zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei bia sokam zaa sani, ka zaŋ omaŋ leei sokam zaa dabili.
en: Jesus sat down and called the twelve apostles to him. He said, Whoever wants to be the most important must make others more important than themselves. They must serve everyone else.

dag: Ninsalinim daa di malaikanim bindirigu. O daa ti ba li pam.
en: Each person ate the bread of the powerful ones; God sent provisions to satisfy them.

dag: Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia Judas la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ka mi nyɛ bɛ pinaayi maa ni yino la.
en: He was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. For Judas, even though he was one of the twelve disciples, was going to betray him.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan n-zaŋd o nuu timdi laa ni hal ka bi bɔri ni o ŋmaai bindirigu ti kpar o nol ni.
en: Some people are too lazy to take care of themselves. They will not even lift the food from their plate to their mouth.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛri ni tin shɛli nyɛla dabari, ka ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu lan ka di ni la, Juda fɔntinsi mini Jɛrusalɛm pal dahi din leei dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbigu lan ka di ni ŋɔ, bɛ ni ti lan wum.
en: This is what the Lord says: You people say that your country is an empty desert. There are no people or animals living there. It is now quiet in the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. But it will be noisy there soon.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave Moses.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin kul nyɛla naa sahakam; ka a yuli kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But you, Lord , will rule as king forever! Your name will continue forever and ever!.

dag: Lala ka o daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata ni bɛn zaa daa taɣiri biŋkɔbiri maa; Yi yi ti tuhi Iso soli, yin yɛlimiy o yɛtɔɣ yini maa.
en: He also ordered the second group, the third group, and everybody following the herds, Say exactly the same thing to Esau when you find him.

dag: amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba ŋub maa, so daa naan ku tooi baŋ ni bɛ zaŋ ba ŋubi, dama bɛ daa na kul gaŋsigaŋsimi, ka be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa yirigi neei.
en: but they still looked thin and sick. You couldnt even tell they had eaten the healthy cows. They looked as thin and sick as they did in the beginning. Then I woke up.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋ Izraɛlnim maa zaa tooni.
en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before the assembled Israelite community.

dag: n ni zaŋ shɛli zali gu muɣisigu saha mini zabili ni tɔbu tuhibu dal la?.
en: I save them there for times of trouble, for the times of war and battle.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li; amaa ka Yisa do di ni gbihira.
en: A huge storm arose on the lake so that waves were sloshing over the boat. But Jesus was asleep.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, amaa alahichi nyɛla din bahiri ninvuɣ biɛri yoli.
en: Goodness protects honest people, but evil destroys those who love to sin.

dag: Naftali zuliya ni, Ɛnan bia Ahira n-yɛn sɔŋ ya.
en: from Naphtali, Ahira, Enans son.

dag: Di saha ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mi ni bɛ paɣiba maanila buɣa mini paɣiba bɛn zaa daa ʒe nimaani, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Patrɔs Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa garigi yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then all the men who knew that their wives had made offerings to other gods, along with the great crowd of women who were present, as well as the people living in Pathros in the land of Egypt, all answered Jeremiah.

dag: Ka Musa daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani, ka boli di yuli, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nasara tuuta.
en: Moses built an altar and named it The Lord is my Banner.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni wuhiri ba bɛ galimi ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ ninni? Ka ŋuni n-lee yɔri ba bɛ tuma samli?.
en: No one points out their sin or punishes them.

dag: Ka maligumaani maa ti booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ o nuzaa nutal ni;.
en: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand.

dag: Ɛkurɔn mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi gba daa beni Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli daa nyɛla.
en: Ekron, its dependent cities and surrounding areas.

dag: Di ni nyɛ nyini n-fa bɛ yɛm ka bɛ bi lan mi shɛli maa, dinzuɣu a ku chɛ ka bɛ di nasara.
en: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.

dag: Ibrahimma daa nyɛla Yisahaku ba, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Yaakubu ba, ka Yaakubu mi nyɛ Juda min o tizɔbihi ba.
en: Abraham was the father of Isaac. Isaac was the father of Jacob. Jacob was the father of Judah and his brothers.

dag: Ti ŋmanila zoomba bɛn chani baɣisiri dukpini ka tuuri wuntaŋ zuɣusaa kaman di nyɛla yuŋ la. Bɛn mali yaa sunsuuni, ti ŋmanila kpiimba.
en: We grope along the wall like the blind; like those without eyes we grope. We stumble at noonday as if it were twilight, and among the strong as if we were dying.

dag: Di simdi ni Izraɛl tiŋbia kam ŋun yɛn mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: All native Israelites are to do this when they present a food offering, an odor pleasing to the Lord .

dag: dama m mi yi ni pun yu ni yi niŋ shɛm yɛla. Ka n nyuri bara yi zuɣu Masidɔnianim sani, ka yɛri ni Akaianim gba pun malila shili yuuni la ha, ka yi ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi bɛ ni shɛb pam suhuri.
en: I know that you want to help. I have been bragging about you to the people in Macedonia. I told them that you people in Achaia have been ready to give since last year. And your desire to give has made most of the people here ready to give also.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ba daa chaŋ ti kpe fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus and his followers went into Capernaum. Immediately on the Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and started teaching.

dag: A ni ti yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Juda nanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu kpe ŋɔ, ka ŋunkam ti wum di yɛla tiba ni vura.
en: Listen to the LORDs word, you kings of Judah and those of you living in Jerusalem: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, says: Im going to bring such disaster upon this place that it will shock all who hear of it.

dag: Pa ti zuɣu ka o yɛl lala maa? Ti zuɣu ka di shiri sabi yɛl lala maa, dama ŋun kɔri mini ŋun buri chi zaa malila tahima yini, dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ laɣim di puu maa atam.
en: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.

dag: N kul ni be yi sani chana, ka nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi nyɛ n niriba.
en: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir maa daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal a yi zaŋ a yiŋ pirigili ti ma, n ku dol a kuli. Ka m mi ku di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: But the man of God said to the king, I will not go home with you, even if you give me half of your kingdom! I will not eat or drink anything in this place.

dag: ka Izraɛl daa yɛli, Di saɣiya! M bia Yisifu na shiri be o nyɛvil ni. N ni chaŋ ti nya o pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Israel said, Now I believe you. My son Joseph is still alive! I am going to see him before I die.

dag: Gbuɣinli yi ŋum, ŋuni ka dabiɛm lee ku gbaai? Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yi zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ li tɔɣisi niriba.
en: When a lion roars, who can keep from being afraid? When the Sovereign Lord speaks, who can keep from proclaiming his message?.

dag: M bi sabiri dimbɔŋɔ ni n dihi ya la vi, amaa n sab li mi ni n saɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ m biyurisi la zuɣu.
en: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.

dag: dama n wum a ni niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda shɛm min a ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba shɛm la yɛla.
en: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.

dag: Nir yi niŋdi nandaamba alaka ni o nya buni pahi ni ŋun tiri bundaamba pini, bɛ zaa ni leei nandaamba.
en: These two things will make you poor: hurting the poor to make yourself rich and giving gifts to the rich.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab daa bɔhi Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat, A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka o garigi yɛl o, M bela a polo ka n niriba nyɛ a niriba, ti ni pah a zuɣu chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: He asked, Will you go with me to attack Ramoth? Jehoshaphat replied, I am ready when you are, and so is my army. We will join you.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu; n ku beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Miligim ka chɛ ma, dama n dabisa kul nyɛla vuhim.
en: I reject life; I dont want to live long; leave me alone, for my days are empty.

dag: Ka nyin na bɔri yɛl kara ni a ti amaŋa? Di lan bɔ li, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ninsalinim zaa. Amaa n ni tilig a nyɛvili a ni yɛn chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am bringing disaster everywhere, so don't even think about making any big plans for yourself. However, I promise that wherever you go, I will at least protect you from death. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Naawuni daa bi chɛ ka Anabi Ilaija chaŋ bɛ so sani; amaa pakol so ŋun daa be tin shɛli din yuli booni Zarɛfat Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la sani kɔŋko ka o daa chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: Yet Elijah was sent to none of them but only to a widow in the city of Zarephath in the region of Sidon.

dag: Ka bia maa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui, ka bɛ laɣimna ni bɛ ti gun o. Bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla o ba yuli Zakaria la ti o.
en: When the baby was eight days old, they came to circumcise him. They wanted to name him Zechariah because this was his fathers name.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Saimɔn, yi gbihirimi? Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: Then he returned and found the three disciples asleep. He said to Peter, Simon, are you asleep? Weren't you able to stay awake for even one hour.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ko yi gbansɔri yuma ayɔbu n-kpuɣi di daatam.
en: Plant seeds, harvest your crops, and work the ground for six years.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa kpah o zuɣu ni di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka buŋ ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsal la n-kari anabi maa o yinyari tuma ni.
en: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.

dag: Ka n wum damli shɛli binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni kaman kukol la ka di yɛra, Alikama lita yini nyɛla tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri, ka chi lita ata mi nyɛ tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri; amaa di niŋ kpam mini wain shɛli.
en: I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures. It said, A quart of wheat for a denarion, and three quarts of barley for a denarion, but dont damage the olive oil and the wine.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ yi bi so ti ni bɛ nyo buɣim mali buɣili Molɛk ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi saɣim yi Naawuni yuli. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.

dag: Yɛm bi bela ninkura sani, ka baŋsim mi bi bela nir yuusim ni?.
en: People say, Wisdom is to be found in those who are old. Long life brings understanding.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi wuntizɔriba ni bɛ di tum alahichi, ka bɛ bi tum alahichi maa, bɛ shiri ni be bɛ ni deei saɣisigu maa zuɣu, ka a mi tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: If you do warn a good man not to sin and he listens to you and doesn't sin, he will stay alive, and your life will also be spared.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ tuma zuɣulaantab la daa niŋ kaman Naa Darius ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors carefully obeyed King Darius.

dag: Dabisili din pahir ayi dali ka niriba maa zaa dunoya dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim daa laɣim chaŋ Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ zaligubaŋda la sani ni bɛ ti bɔhim baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu maa ni.
en: Then on the second day of the month, the leaders of all the families went to meet with Ezra, the priests, and the Levites. They all gathered around Ezra the teacher to study the words of the law.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Yuria Ijipti na ti ti Naa Jɛhoyakim, ka o daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o n-zaŋ ti bahi tintarimba gbala ni.
en: They brought Uriah from Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim. Jehoiakim ordered Uriah to be killed with a sword. Uriahs body was thrown into the burial place where the poor are buried.

dag: Man ŋuna, Naawuni ka n yɛn jɛmda, ka zaŋ n yɛla niŋ Naawuni nuu ni.
en: If I were you, I would turn to God and present my case to him.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn luri Yawɛ sizuura daa tɔɣisiri tab yɛtɔɣa, ka Yawɛ gbilisi tibili wum li, ka sabi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri ŋun Yawɛ, ka tir o yuli jilima maa yɛla niŋ yɛla teebu litaafi ni o sani.
en: Then the people who feared the Lord spoke to one another, and the Lord listened and heard what they said. In his presence, there was written down in a book a record of those who feared the Lord and respected him.

dag: M bia, chɛ ka a baɣa be n yɛligu ni. Gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛr a shɛm.
en: My son, pay attention to what I say. Listen closely to my words.

dag: Di saha yi ni baŋ wuntitali mini zaligu soli ni biɛrisuntali ni so viɛlli kam.
en: If you listen to him, you will understand what is just and fair and how to do what is right.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi di ni daa fo n-dɔni baalim maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ ba na ti zali bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ zani kulino shɛl ni.
en: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa daa laɣimna.
en: Then Jesus was taken to the High Priest's house, where all the chief priests, the elders, and the teachers of the Law were gathering.

dag: Ka Maligumaaniba daa mali me Wɔhu Dunɔdali zuɣusaa polo. Sokam daa mali mɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋ tooni.
en: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.

dag: A ni varisi pɔhim ni ʒe n-tɔhigi va shɛli bahi, ka kari doli wurigu din kuui?.
en: Will you cause a wind-tossed leaf to tremble, or will you pursue dry straw?.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi lan yɛli yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna yɛla, dama yɛlimuɣisirili maa nyɛla sokam maŋmaŋ yɛligu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi taɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka nyɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, Here is news from the Lord , you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Asirianim sani a ni nyɛ pulaandan la zuɣu. A daa tum pagɔrisigu tuma bɛ sani, ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi li.
en: Still not satisfied, you prostituted yourself to the Assyrians, but they werent enough for you either.

dag: Wɛi, yɛl biɛɣu ni paai Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbini, ka nyɛ Dauda ni daa be tin shɛli ni la. Chɛ ka churi ŋɔ kul puhiri yuuni kam.
en: Oh, Ariel, Ariel, town where David encamped! Year by year, let the festivals come around.

dag: M paɣiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun ti ma yaa ni n tum ŋɔ. M paɣir o o ni lihi ma ka n simdi ni o pii ma ka n tum o tuma.
en: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength because he considered me faithful. So he appointed me to ministry.

dag: Amaa o fari nandaamba bɛ noya ni bahira, ka fara ba kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira.
en: Yet he rescues the orphan from the sword of their mouth, the needy from the grip of the strong.

dag: ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din viɛl la ni bi bɔra. Amaa Naawuni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ tuɣi taba, ka pahiri yaɣ shɛŋa din pooi viɛlim la jilima pam.
en: which the more beautiful parts do not need. God himself has put the body together in such a way as to give greater honor to those parts that need it.

dag: Yɛm chɛ ka nir nyari jilima, amaa bɛn ka li soli nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: Intelligence wins respect, but those who can't be trusted are on the road to ruin.

dag: ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi wuntitali soya dolibu ka dolila zibisim soya la.
en: those who have abandoned a righteous life to live in the darkness of sin.

dag: Yi lan wum ka di pun sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a yi a pɔri nyaaŋa, amaa niŋmila a ni pɔ pɔri ni a niŋ shɛli maa ti ti Duuma.
en: You have also heard that people were told in the past, Do not break your promise, but do what you have vowed to the Lord to do.

dag: Yawɛ tumtumsa galisiya pam, ka ŋunkam yuri li bɔhindi li mi.
en: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ nya n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntinsi ni shɛm. Lihimiya li, zuŋɔ di zaa leela dabari, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, said, You yourselves have seen the destruction I brought on Jerusalem and all the other cities of Judah. Even now they are still in ruins, and no one lives in them.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka Izraɛl nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Naawuni yi chɛ ka o niriba tɔŋ, Yaakubu zuliya ni mali suhupiɛlli; ka Izraɛlnim suhuri paligi.
en: I wish the one who lives on Mount Zion would bring victory to Israel! When God makes Israel successful again, the people of Jacob will be very happy; the people of Israel will be glad.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o wum n suhigu maa.
en: When I was in trouble, I called to the Lord , and he answered me.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ lala. Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni daa chaŋ maa nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ mi ʒee maa lo n-tabil o takɔro maa.
en: I'll do exactly what you said, Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Judanim ku tooi zabi bɛmaŋ zuɣu. Dindali maa, yi daa chaŋla tibɔŋ ni bidibbina duu la ni nti yihi bidibbina.
en: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka tummi din viɛla; ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka a be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: So trust in the Lord and do good. Live on your land and be dependable.

dag: ka zaŋ zuliya pia ti a, ka zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: Solomon will keep one tribe for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen to be my own from the whole land of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. A sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: Lord , I come to you for protection. Save me from my enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii bɛ buɣili Baalibɛriti duu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisopɔin ti o. Ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ liɣiri maa ti da ninvuɣ galima mini ninkuunsinima n-zaŋ ba pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: They gave him seventy pieces of silver from the temple of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless men, who became his posse.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garigi paɣ maa ni bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa zaa; ka shɛli daa kani ka naa kɔŋ li kahigi wuh o.
en: Solomon answered all the questions. None of her questions was too hard for him to explain.

dag: Dinzuɣu Dimitirius min o tumtumditab maa yi zaŋla so taali, saria karibu duu beni ka sariakaritiba be di ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn zaŋm taba tahi ni.
en: We have courts of law and there are judges. Do Demetrius and those men who work with him have a charge against anyone? They should go to the courts. Let them argue with each other there.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la daa lo ni bɛ ku dansarikanim maa, dama ni di yi pa lala bɛ ni duɣi kom maa du n-zo n-tiligi.
en: The soldiers made a plan to kill all the prisoners, in order to keep them from swimming ashore and escaping.

dag: A gba ni ti nyu dam kuli, a ni ti zo n-sɔɣi. A ni ti bɔri sɔɣisili shee a dim sani.
en: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac said, Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice? My son, Abraham answered, God will provide the lamb. The two of them walked on, and.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yɛhi tahi pampam m-po pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka piɛbi kikahi mini binyila.
en: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord , then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.

dag: Huramabi daa lan zaŋ daanya viɛlli mali duɣuri mini soobuya ni dirijaba ni nɛma balibu kam zaa ti Naa Sulemaana ni o zaŋ niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: pans for hot ashes, as well as shovels and meat forks. Huram made all these things out of polished bronze.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka Ijipti do so muɣisir o mabihi maa ni yino ka di ka soli, ka o ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa.
en: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his help and took revenge on the Egyptian by killing him. .

dag: Ijipti ŋmanila naɣisa viɛlli, ka viɛbiga yi nuzaa polo na ni o ti tabil o.
en: Egypt is like a splendid cow, attacked by a stinging fly from the north.

dag: N ni lan labisi bɛ daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba, ka labisi Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi a gba maŋmaŋ daazichi ti a pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: I destroyed Sodom and the towns around it, and I destroyed Samaria and the towns around it. And I will destroy you too, Jerusalem. But I will build those cities again, and I will rebuild you too.

dag: yi nina ni daa nya zahimbu kar shɛŋa mini shihiri shɛŋa ni alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa teeg o nuu din mali yaa yihi ya na shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛn niŋ yi ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm maa zaa.
en: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.

dag: M mabiyurisi, yi yi nyari wahala din be kaman buɣim ka di paari ya ni di buɣisi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya kaman di nyɛla din na ʒi n-niŋ so n-niŋdi ya maa.
en: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.

dag: N niriba, zomiya yi di ni. Tiligimiya yi nyɛviya Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ ni.
en: Get out of Babylon, my people! Run for your lives from the LORDs fierce anger.

dag: Niriba kul paɣir a mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka a yuli du pam dunia ŋɔ zaa ni; ka a doli yɛlimaŋli soli su nam.
en: Your name is known everywhere, God, and people throughout the earth praise you. You have shown that you do what is right.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka ti mali tahima. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti sɔŋsim mini ti nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: We put our hope in the Lord ; he is our protector and our help.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti yɛl a, A ku wuhi ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni.
en: When your people ask you, Why wont you tell us what these sticks mean to you.

dag: ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di nyaaŋa yi ni tooi labina, ka ku mali talahi yɛl shɛli Yawɛ mini Izraɛlnim sani; ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ leei yi ni su shɛli Yawɛ sani.
en: and the land is subdued in the LORDs presence. Then you may return innocently before the LORD and Israel, and this land will be your property before the LORD.

dag: Ka Bɔaz garigi yɛl o, M pun wum a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti a yidan ma a yidan maa kum nyaaŋa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ yɛla. N lan mi a ni chɛ a ba min a ma ni a maŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ, ka kana ni a ti be a ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb sani shɛm yɛla.
en: Boaz responded to her, Everything that you did for your mother-in-law after your husbands death has been reported fully to me: how you left behind your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and came to a people you hadnt known beforehand.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum n yɛla, bɛ daa paɣi ma mi, ka bɛn nina daa nya ma mi di ma shɛhira.
en: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tiŋgbana pihinuayika din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinima.
en: From the land that the people of Israel possessed, a total of forty-eight cities, with the pasture lands around them, was given to the Levites.

dag: Ka a zaŋ a noli yɛtɔɣa duhiri amaŋa n-niŋdi ma, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa pam jɛndiri ma, n wum li.
en: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.

dag: ka yɛli, N tum alahichi, dama n yi ŋun ka taali nyaaŋa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka dimbɔŋɔ nya ti ya? A yɛla m-bala.
en: I have sinned by betraying an innocent man to death! he said. What do we care about that? they answered. That is your business.

dag: Dimiya binnɛɔŋ kam. N ni zaŋ ʒiɛvari tin ya shɛm lala ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa tin ya.
en: and I have given them to you for food. From now on, you may eat them, as well as the green plants that you have always eaten.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-su zuɣusaa ni zuɣusaa mi zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa;.
en: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.

dag: Bɛ ku zaŋ a pahi bɛ zuɣu sɔɣi, dama a daa saɣim a tiŋgbɔŋ, ka ku a niriba. So ku teei a zuliya bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la ni so yɛla.
en: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, di nyɛla talahi ni woligibu kpe yi sunsuuni n-chɛ ka di kahigi wuhi bɛn nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinim ni nyɛ shɛb yi ni.
en: Its necessary that there are groups among you, to make it clear who is genuine.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: But the Lord spoke to a man of God named Shemaiah. He said.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dama bɛ yɛri ya, Yi ŋubirila niriba, ka chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi.
en: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni nya n ni yɛn niŋ Firawuna shɛm: N yi niŋ o firimiinsi o ni chɛ ka bɛ yi, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ o firimiinsi, ka o kari ba yih o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The LORD replied to Moses, Now you will see what Ill do to Pharaoh. In fact, hell be so eager to let them go that hell drive them out of his land by force.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.

dag: A daa pirigi teeku buyi ka chɛ ka a niriba doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du, amaa ka a daai bɛn daa doli ba maa niŋ teeku maa bulli ni, kaman kuɣili ni lu kɔtitali ni shɛm la.
en: You divided the sea before them so that they went through it on dry land. But you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

dag: Ka so yi dolina ni o ti ku o yo samli, bɛn di zaŋ o ti o, o ni ku o kpee maa ka di nyɛla sarati zuɣu, ka pa ni o min o pun malila taali la zuɣu.
en: If the one looking for revenge follows you there, the people of the city must not hand you over to that one. They must protect you because you killed the person accidentally and not out of anger.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba maa daa kana, ka Lɛvinim daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: When all Israels elders had arrived, the Levites picked up the chest.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa suhi Naawuni ka Naawuni tibi Abimilɛk min o paɣa ni o dabipaɣiba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: The Lord made all the women in Abimelechs family not able to have children. God did this because Abimelech had taken Sarah, Abrahams wife. But Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his servant girls.

dag: Nyin ŋun suhu yiɣisi ka a dar tɔh amaŋ ŋɔ, a tɛhiya ni bɛ ni chɛ dunia ti a bee n-vuɣi tampiŋ di biɛhigu shee a zuɣu?.
en: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *.

dag: Ka o yi po pɔri shɛlikam ni o niŋ shɛli, o yidana mali soli ni o saɣi li bee n-zaɣisi li.
en: Her husband has the right to affirm or to annul any vow or promise that she has made.

dag: Ka Pita teei ka yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, nyam fiig ti shɛli a ni sa yɛli noli ti la ni kuui zaa shɛm.
en: Peter remembered what Jesus had said to the tree. Then Peter said, Teacher, look! The tree you put a curse on has dried up.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam ŋun mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, ka nyɛ ŋun gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiy o.
en: You are also allowed to eat any animal with a divided hoof—the hoof being divided into two parts—and that rechews food among the various kinds of animals.

dag: M bolila nuzaa polo ninvuɣ so ka o kana. O yila wulimpuhili polo na ka nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi ma. O ni du n-tam nanim zuɣu n-no ba kaman tandi la bee kaman yaɣimɛr ni nɔri yaɣiri shɛm la.
en: I called someone in the north to come. He is coming from the east where the sun rises, and he honors my name. He tramples kings the way a potter softens clay with his feet.

dag: Bɛ piɛbi kikaa, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, amaa so ku chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu, dama n suhuyiɣisili maa ni lu bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: They have blown the horn, and everything is ready, but no one goes to battle, because my wrath overcomes the whole crowd.

dag: Dinzuɣu di wum bɛ yɛligu maa, dama bɛ niriba gari ninvuɣ pihinahi do sol ni gu o. Bɛ laɣimmi po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ guhirila a nol ni yɛligu.
en: But don't listen to them, because there are more than forty men who will be hiding and waiting for him. They have taken a vow not to eat or drink until they have killed him. They are now ready to do it and are waiting for your decision.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli o shee ni zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ka di be kaman daanya din nyaɣisira la, ka be kaman buɣim n-gili o luɣilikam zaa la. Ka n daa nya o shee tiŋli polo ka di ŋmanila buɣim. Ka neesim din ne pam daa ne n-gili o.
en: The figure seemed to be shining like bronze in the middle of a fire. It shone all over with a bright light.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari nyɔri zaɣ maŋli, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biri wuntitali nyari laara maŋli.
en: Wicked people do not really gain anything, but if you do what is right, you are certain to be rewarded.

dag: Bɛ ku lan di jifa bee ŋ-ŋub nin shɛli din chihiri ŋubbu. Ka bɛ puuni bɛn kpalim ni leei n niriba, ka mali bɛ daŋ Juda zuliya puuni kaman Jɛbusinim la.
en: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Maika bidibisi ni, Shamir n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Uzziels family: Micah; from Micahs family: Shamir.

dag: A tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔ tuhiya? A yɛliya, M mali yɛlimaŋli Naawuni sani.
en: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Pihahirɔt n-chaŋ ti tim teeku sunsuuni gari kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni n-daa chaŋ daba ata chandi Itam tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Mara.
en: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the Red Sea into the desert of Shur; after a three days' march they camped at Marah.

dag: Bɔhimiya pumpɔŋɔ n-nya doo ni tooi dɔɣi bia? Ka bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka doo kam zaŋ o nuhi tab o saɣiŋga ni kaman paɣa n-wolisiri la? Bɔ n-niŋ ka sokam saɣim o ninni?.
en: Now stop and think! Can a man give birth to a child? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor? Why is everyone so pale?.

dag: Yɛnnim yi nya ka barina kanna, bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa ka tarimba bɛn chaŋ ti di di wahala.
en: When you see trouble coming, don't be stupid and walk right into it— be smart and hide.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa Yawɛ, ti suhir a, ti yi yihi doo ŋɔ nyɛvili, nyin di bɔhi ti biɛri ku ti. Dama nyin Yawɛ zuɣu ka yɛlli maa ʒiya. A ni yu shɛm m-bala.
en: So they called on the LORD, saying, Please, LORD, dont let us perish on account of this mans life, and dont blame us for innocent blood! You are the LORD: whatever you want, you can do.

dag: Ka guliba maa zaa daa gbib bɛ bidibbina n-ʒiɛya gu Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ ti kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti gili sara maligu bimbini mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: These guards stood with their weapons in their hands from the right corner of the Temple to the left corner. They stood around the altar and the Temple and around the king when he went to the Temple.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ daa zali Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu saha shɛl o ni daa zali Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ sara maligunim na ti ti ŋun Yawɛ Sinai mɔɣu ni la.
en: The Lord gave these laws to Moses on Mount Sinai when he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord in the desert of Sinai.

dag: Sɛnaa niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaata ni kɔbisiwɛi ni pihita.
en: of Senaah .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi zaa naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛgulibo ni na ni a ti leegi n niriba Izraɛlnim toondana n-su ba.
en: So then, say this to my servant David: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be leader over my people Israel.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani mini bɛ malibu na ka bɛ ti ʒini Hiburɔn fɔndi ni.
en: David also told his men and their families to come and live in the villages near Hebron.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ di mini bindir pala bɔrɔbɔro ni piɛbihi ayi n-gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara Yawɛ sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ zaŋ ti maligumaana maa.
en: The priest will lift up the two sheep, along with the bread of the early produce, as an uplifted offering before the LORD. These will be holy to the LORD and will belong to the priest.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a yaa ti paɣiba, a mi di zaŋ a soya ti bɛn kuri nanima.
en: Don't spend all your energy on sex and all your money on women; they have destroyed kings.

dag: a kul lɔrila saɣiŋgu nia. A zilinli ŋmanila piliŋ. A kul dolila ʒiŋmabo soli sahakam.
en: Your tongue devises destruction: its like a sharpened razor, causing deception.
