dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n yɛn zaŋla nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam ka di nyɛ yi naa sun ya.
en: The Lord GOD says, By my life, I swear that I will rule over you as king. But I will raise my powerful arm and punish you. I will show my anger against you!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛl a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe, ka o ku ma? .
en: But even after all that, you tell me, Say to your master, Elijah is here! Ahab will kill me.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nira daa chaŋ naa maa sani ti yɛl o, N dan naa, di chɛ ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi ŋɔ pahi dol a chaŋ, dama Yawɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ŋɔ zaa so sani.
en: But a prophet went to the king and said to him, Don't take these Israelite soldiers with you. The Lord is not with these people from the Northern Kingdom.

dag: Ka malaika so daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-duh o yee kuhiri yɛri ŋun ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa, Dunia atam biya zaa ka di chɛbu saha paai. Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-tim di ni chɛ.
en: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.

dag: Du bihi atata n-daa be wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali maa yaɣa ayi zaa. Du bihi atata maa zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di daantalisi din be di luɣa zuɣu zaa barilim nyɛ yim.
en: There were three little guardrooms on each side of the gateway. All these rooms and their side walls measured the same.

dag: Bɛ daa kpahi ŋmɛnditoya ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu; yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo.
en: Then they crucified two bandits with Jesus, one on his right and the other on his left.

dag: dama bɛ bari ma la zana, ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ ni bɛ di n nyɛvili, ka di ka daliri.
en: I did nothing wrong, but they tried to trap me. For no reason at all, they dug a pit to catch me.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ni mani m-bɔŋɔ; dinzuɣu yi yi bɔrila mani, yin chɛ ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa chaŋ.
en: I have already told you that I am he, Jesus said. If, then, you are looking for me, let these others go. .

dag: Ʒiri sanianim mini ʒiri binzahindisi zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.

dag: Ti suhupiɛlli la naaya. Ti wahi wabu la leela kuyila.
en: Joy has left our heart; our dancing has changed into lamentation.

dag: n-yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo m-mali hal ti paai Mariɛl n-zaŋ ti to Dabɛshɛt n-gari chaŋ hal ti paai Jokiniam wulimpuhili polo kulibɔŋ la.
en: Then the border went west to Maralah and just touched Dabbesheth. Then it went along the ravine near Jokneam.

dag: N zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini la ti Lɛvinima ni di nyɛ bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri.
en: Ten percent of the Israelites' crops and one out of every ten of their newborn animals belong to me. But I am giving all this to the Levites as their pay for the work they do at the sacred tent.

dag: dama kaman nir ni kahim bihim ka bihikpam yirina shɛm ni nir ni yi ŋmahim nyee pam ka ʒim yirina shɛm, lala ka suhuyiɣisili pam gba tahiri zabili na.
en: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a mini Jɛsi bia ŋɔ gbiri ma zamba bɔɣa? Bɔzuɣu ka a daa ti o bindirigu ka ti o takɔbi ka lan bɔhi Naawuni n-nya o yɛla ti o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yiɣisi lu n zuɣu n-sɔɣi do n-gu ma kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Saul demanded, Why did you plot against me with that son of Jesse? You helped him rebel against me by giving him food and a sword, and by talking with God for him. Now he's trying to ambush me.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralan maanila zaligu ansarisi, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli vaani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Using a criminal as a witness makes a joke of justice. People like that only want to do wrong.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi lihi ma ni n nyɛla a tumtumdikpee, nyin deem o kaman a ni ni deei ma shɛm.
en: If you accept me as your friend, then accept Onesimus back. Welcome him like you would welcome me.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so ti chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A gba yi be Yisa ŋun yi Galili na ŋɔ sani.
en: While Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, a servant girl came up to him and said, You were with Jesus from Galilee.

dag: Izraɛl bihi min o yaansi bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayɔbu. O bidibisi paɣiba daa ka bɛ kalinli maa ni.
en: The total number of the direct descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt was sixty-six, not including his sons' wives.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama n yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam ni ti bɔri ni bɛ dol li kpe ka ku tooi.
en: Make every effort to enter through the narrow gate. Many, I tell you, will try to enter and wont be able to.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A yi ti zaŋ firilanim ayopɔin la zali, nyin chɛ ka di ne firilatamdigu la tooni. .
en: Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na. Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: When it was time, he sent a servant to collect from the tenants his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants sent him away, beaten and empty-handed.

dag: Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli.
en: When Jesus died, the curtain in the Temple was torn into two pieces. The tear started at the top and tore all the way to the bottom.

dag: Chɛ ka di kul be nyin Yawɛ tooni sahakam, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teeg o yɛla dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.

dag: Ti nyari duhibu, ka lan nyari filiŋ; ti nyari ʒiɛmbu, ka lan nyari tibiginsim. Bɛ niŋdi ti mi kaman ʒirinima, amaa ka ti lee nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinima.
en: Some people honor us, but others shame us. Some people say good things about us, but others say bad things. Some people say we are liars, but we speak the truth.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ nyɛla do yino ŋun be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bihi pinaayi, ŋun nyɛ ti zaa ha biasani be ti ba maa sani ka yino ŋun kani.
en: They said, We were twelve brothers in all, sir, sons of the same man in the land of Canaan. One brother is dead, and the youngest is now with our father.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim mini ʒiŋmariba bihi ŋɔ, ŋuni ka yi lee maani ansarisi? Bee ŋuni ka yi lee mɛrigiri yi noya niŋda?.
en: You are children out of control, full of lies. You make fun of me. You make faces and stick out your tongue at me.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla. A nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, ŋmaligim m polo na.
en: Answer me, Lord ! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.

dag: Di simdi ka di mali daanya daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tam binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi, amaa ban shɛŋa din yɛn yili daantalisi maa mini di dapuhi dina, zaŋmiya anzinfa mal li.
en: Use posts and bronze bases under the posts. The hooks for the posts and the curtain rods should be made from silver.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dab so Naawuni ni pii ka boli ni n leei tumo m-moli ŋun Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sanna.
en: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus and an apostle chosen and called by God to preach his Good News.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chani Zarɛfat nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni ka nya pako so ka o be nimaani pihiri dari, ka o bol o yɛl o, Kpɛm ti tooi kom biɛla niŋ pipia ni ti ma na ka n nyu.
en: So Elijah went to Zarephath, and as he came to the town gate, he saw a widow gathering firewood. Please bring me a drink of water, he said to her.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuɣusaa duri maa daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi, dama folinsi maa daa di palo pam zuɣusaa n-gari sunsuuni mini tiŋ duri la.
en: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa teei o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la, ka yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla puɣisiriba, yi kamina ni yi ti nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Joseph remembered the dreams he had dreamed about them, and said to them, You are spies. Youve come to look for the countrys weaknesses.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Giliad ti Makiri.
en: I also gave Gilead to Machir.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli wumbu ka zaŋ bɛ zaɣa niŋla kurimbuni ha lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: They will turn away from listening to the truth and give their attention to legends.

dag: N ni chɛ ka daadamnim nyabu ti niŋ tom kaman salima din viɛla nyabu ni to shɛm la, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyabu niŋ tom kaman Ofiri salima nyabu ni to shɛm la.
en: There will be only a few people left. They will be as rare as pure gold.

dag: ni bɛ ti to jina baŋ bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o.
en: They planned how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ; dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ! Sing to the Lord , all the world!.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; dama m bela nandahima ni, deemi n suhigu yomyom.
en: Dont hide your face from me, your servant, because Im in deep trouble. Answer me quickly!.

dag: Ka bɛ lan garigi yɛli naa yaha, Naa, a yi ni yɛli ti a zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ti mi ni wuh a di gbinni.
en: They answered the king again, If Your Majesty will only tell us what the dream was, we will explain it.

dag: Ka hal bɛ dimnim yi gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya ka bɛ ti nyɛ daba, n ni chɛ ka be zaŋ takɔbi ku ba nimaani. N ni pa n nini lihiri ba n-niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni zaɣ suŋ.
en: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam nyuri bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: So then, as the scripture says, Whoever wants to boast must boast of what the Lord has done.

dag: Ka lan lihi nya tiŋgbani maa vuhiri bee di nyɛla tiŋgban kpiŋ, ka nya tihi be di ni bee di kani. Niŋmiya suhukpeeni n-ʒi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na. Wain tihi wal daŋda moobu saha n-daa bala.
en: Find out whether the soil is fertile and whether the land is wooded. And be sure to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kadɛshi maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hɔr Zoli gbini din miri Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ tintariga la shee.
en: They marched from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia mini tia kam:.
en: Then Jesus told them a story: When you see a fig tree or any other tree.

dag: n-daa mali ti paai di ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Salamis n-kpɛri nimaani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni n-yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu tiri ba. Ka Jɔn Maak daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: In Salamis they proclaimed Gods word in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their assistant.

dag: Ka Rɛkab bia Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihakɛrɛm yaɣili polo naa la daa mali me Saɣiri Dunɔdali maa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi li, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Malkijah son of Recab repaired the Gate of Ash Piles. Malkijah was the governor of the district of Beth Hakkerem. He repaired the gate. He put the doors on the hinges. Then he put the locks and bolts on the doors.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa saɣisi miri buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ha ka boli, Shadirak! Mɛshak! Abɛdnɛgo! Yinim Zallakudura Naa daba ŋɔ, yimiyana ka kpe na! Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa dii yi buɣim maa ni na.
en: Nebuchadnezzar went closer to the flaming furnace and said to the three young men, You servants of the Most High God, come out at once! They came out.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n ni yɛn tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, chɛ ka di kpe a tiba ni, ka a deei li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: He said to me: Human one, listen closely, and take to heart every word I say to you.

dag: N tiliginsim mini n jilima yirila Naawuni sanna; ŋuna n-nyɛ n gula ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔh o, Shihir bɔ ka a lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti ka di wuhi ni a mal soli ni a niŋ a ni niŋdi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: The Jewish authorities came back at him with a question, What miracle can you perform to show us that you have the right to do this.

dag: Bɛ lan ka yɛmbahiga bɛ chandi ni, ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa luhi ba.
en: Their steps, once strong and fast, become weak. Their own evil plans make them fall.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka bol o, Ibrahimma, Ibrahimma! Ka o saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But the LORDs messenger called out to Abraham from heaven, Abraham? Abraham? Abraham said, Im here.

dag: mini Ɛburɔn ni Rɛhɔb ni Hamɔn ni Kana m-mali hal ti paai Sidɔn din nyɛ tin tital la.
en: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Sidon.

dag: di simdi ni a yo ba bɛ dabisili kam tuma yɔri, ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu, ; di yi pa lala bɛ ni fabili niŋ Yawɛ, ka a kpe taali ni.
en: Give him his pay every day before sunset, because he is poor and depends on the money. If you dont pay him, he will complain against you to the Lord , and you will be guilty of sin.

dag: M mabiyurisi, ti ni mal alikaulinim ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti paɣ ti nuhi n-yi dinkam nyɛ din ni ta nir niŋgbuŋ min o shia daɣiri ni, ka chɛliya ka biɛrikasitali niŋ dɛde ti Naawuni zɔbu puuni.
en: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o biɛhigu shee; chɛliya ka ti jɛm o o napɔntamdigu shee.
en: Then we said, Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Sisɛra ni Barak Abinɔam bia la be Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: Someone told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam was at Mount Tabor.

dag: Ka Aduna garigi yɛl o, N dana, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi pam bahi n zuɣu, a mi ni niriba maa suhuri zaa kul yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: Aaron replied, Dont get angry with me, sir. You know yourself that these people are out of control.

dag: Ka ti daa bo n-nya Yisa nyaandoliba n-kpalim nimaani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin. Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛli Pool Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: We found the Lords followers there and stayed with them for seven days. They warned Paul not to go to Jerusalem because of what the Spirit had told them.

dag: Naa, nyini n-nyɛ ti shɛli din wɔɣa ka mali kpiɔŋ maa. A galisiya hal ti tɔr la sagbana, ka su dunia ŋɔ zaa yiko.
en: Your Majesty, that tree is you! You have grown large and become powerful. Your greatness is as high as the sky; your rule extends to the edge of the earth!.

dag: Amaa zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu be asama gari Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibil fifinyiiŋa gba yiɣisibu.
en: But even the smallest part of a letter in the law cannot be changed. It would be easier for heaven and earth to pass away.

dag: Kpahimmiya kahiŋkɔri: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna bee kunchuna; amaa Naawuni n-dihiri ba. Yi mali bukaata pam gari noonsi.
en: Look at the crows! They don't plant or harvest, and they don't have storehouses or barns. But God takes care of them. You are much more important than any birds.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin ni daa be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali ka Ivilmɛrɔdak daa leei Babilɔn naa, ka niŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yih o sarika ni.
en: In the year that Awil-merodach became king of Babylon, he released Judahs King Jehoiachin from prison. This happened in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.

dag: N ni chɛ ba n-zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni doli man Yawɛ soli kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: As a test for Israel, to see whether they would carefully walk in the LORDs ways just as their ancestors had done.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus answered them, I will ask you just one question, and if you give me an answer, I will tell you what right I have to do these things.

dag: Binnɛma maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana. Ka binnɛma maa daa yi wuɣi du zuɣusaa, kalima maa gba wuɣirimi du zuɣusaa.
en: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.

dag: Ka Makiri zuliya ni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa bia daa chaŋ ti liri Giliadnima ŋ-ŋme n-deei li ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani la.
en: The descendants of Machir, Manassehs son, went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

dag: Dam yɛlimaŋli mini yɛm ni wuhibu ni baŋsim, ka miri ka a zaŋ li kɔhi.
en: Truth, wisdom, learning, and understanding are worth paying money for. They are worth far too much to ever sell.

dag: Ka naa daa yiɣisi Jɛshurun, saha shɛli niriba zuɣulaannim ni daa laɣim, din nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya naŋgban yini laɣiŋgu la.
en: The Lord became king of his people Israel when their tribes and leaders were gathered together.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: That night they served their father wine, and the older daughter went in and lay down with her father, without him noticing when she lay down or got up.

dag: O ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la, o daa pola pɔri pahi alikauli maa zuɣu ti Yisahaku.
en: He will keep the agreement he made with Abraham and the promise he made to Isaac.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a bi niŋ tulaale niŋ n zuɣu, amaa paɣ ŋɔ ŋun zaŋ tulaale niŋ n naba.
en: You didn't even pour olive oil on my head, but she has poured expensive perfume on my feet.

dag: Ka o daa tim tɔbbihi pam, ka bɛ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti teei gili tiŋ maa.
en: So the king sent horses and chariots there with a strong army. They came at night and surrounded the city.

dag: ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Ɛr.
en: The Canaanite girl gave birth to a son and named him Er.

dag: Yiɣisimiya gbaai soli chaŋ ti siɣi Arinɔn vinvamli ni du. Nyamiya, n zaŋ Sihɔn Amɔri nir ŋun nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa ŋɔ min o tiŋgbɔŋ niŋ yi nuu ni, ŋmɛmiy o tɔbu m-piligi li deebu.
en: After we had passed through Moab, the Lord told us, Now, start out and cross the Arnon River. I am placing in your power Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon, along with his land. Attack him, and begin occupying his land.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka jɛmd o, ka zaŋm o yuli kɔŋko pom pɔri.
en: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.

dag: Ka o daa bɔri ni o baŋ Yisa, amaa ka salo zoosim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kɔŋ o nyabu, dama ŋun Zakius daa nyɛla ninvuɣ jia.
en: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but he was a little man and could not see Jesus because of the crowd.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ mini m birini ŋɔ, a ninni ka n-kul lihira.
en: I have confidence in your strength; you are my refuge, O God.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ʒiri, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tuma nyɛla vidibo mini filiŋ nyabu.
en: Good people hate lies, but the wicked do evil, shameful things.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣirina ka zaŋ sagbani n-ye kaman chinchin la, ka sagani booi gil o zuɣu, ka o ninni be kaman wuntaŋa, ka o biɛhi mi be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down out of heaven. He was wrapped in a cloud and had a rainbow around his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like columns of fire.

dag: dama di kɔŋko n-nyɛ o ni mali shɛli pinda, ka bɔ ka o ti yɛn zaŋ pili gbihi? O yi fabili niŋ ma, n ni wum o fabila maa, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: because it is the only covering he has to keep him warm. What else can he sleep in? When he cries out to me for help, I will answer him because I am merciful.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu bara ni o ni ti pini ka bi ti li ŋmanila saa ni yi ku ka bi mi la.
en: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli duno shɛli din daa be dunɔdali luɣili zuɣu la yi n-chaŋ nuzaa polo du kasi shɛŋa din nyɛ maligumaaniba duri la ni, nimaani ka n daa nya luɣ shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo tariga la.
en: Then the man took me to the entrance of the rooms facing north near the gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. These are holy rooms for the priests. He pointed out a place on the west side of the rooms.

dag: Yi ni daa je yɛm, ka bi zaŋ Yawɛ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: That is because they hated knowledge. They refused to fear and respect the Lord .

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali karimbaani na ʒi n-dol li, ka gbuɣinli gba na ʒi n-dol li.
en: No lion or other fierce beast Ever travels those lonely roads.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm mɛmi kaman fɔntin titali din me n-shɛbisi tab ni.
en: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali. Ka dabisi shɛli din paya n-nyɛ biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, bɛ daa bi lan ku so pahi. Bɛ daa zaŋ dindali maa leela suhupiɛlli chuɣu dabisili.
en: They acted on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar. Then on the fourteenth day they rested, making it a day of feasts and rejoicing. .

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛl o ni o bom naa ti ba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: Then Samuel explained everything the LORD had said to the people who were asking for a king.

dag: Amaa ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Hazaɛl niŋ kom mahigi bɔdua n-zaŋ pa naa maa ninni hal ka o ti leei Naawuni dini. Ka Hazaɛl daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: But on the following day Hazael took a blanket, soaked it in water, and smothered the king. And Hazael succeeded Benhadad as king of Syria.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Brothers and sisters will hand each other over to be executed. A father will turn his child in. Children will defy their parents and have them executed.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka doo maa bo piɛlaa ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti mali taali sanyoo sara.
en: The man shall bring a ram to the entrance of the Tent of my presence as his repayment offering.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nira niŋ siɣa ni yɛm dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Zuɣur ayopɔin maa nyɛla zoya ayopɔin shɛŋa zuɣu paɣ maa ni du n-ʒiya;.
en: This calls for an understanding mind. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman is seated. They are also seven kings.

dag: O bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla, o mi bi tamd o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zali ʒiɛmana tuhili niriba yɛla.
en: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lo a dabili alikauli ni a ni niŋ o zaɣ viɛlli ŋɔ.
en: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ya dabitim bandi ni.
en: I am the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, ka mmaŋmaŋ gba bɔhi baŋ dinkam daa niŋ maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɛhi ni di simdi ni n gba sab di yɛla ti a.
en: Now, after having investigated everything carefully from the beginning, I have also decided to write a carefully ordered account for you, most honorable Theophilus.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kul chani Bɛrishiiba hal ni Ifriim zoya ni tinsi la zaa ni niriba sani nti lan labisi ba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ni yaha.
en: Though Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, he regularly went out among the people between Beer-sheba and Ephraims highlands, and encouraged them to return to the LORD, the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛli Izraɛl naa, Daŋ bɔhi Yawɛ m-baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: But first, let's ask the Lord .

dag: Amaa n yi ti neei kum ni, n ni daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili.
en: But after Im raised up, I will go before you to Galilee.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: There are , men in his division.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, A ŋmanila zo shɛli din kuri niriba, ka ku dunia zaa. N yi n-zani a zuɣu. N ni teei n nuu n-wurim a nahi tiŋgbani ka buɣim di a zaa.
en: The Lord says, Babylon, you are like a volcano that destroys the whole country. But I have turned against you, and I will turn you into a burned-out mountain.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yi o zuɣu mɔɣu ni kulibɔn shɛli din daa be Shur soli polo.
en: The LORDs messenger found Hagar at a spring in the desert, the spring on the road to Shur.

dag: O ni dih o piɛri kaman piɛgul ni dihir o piɛri shɛm la. O laɣisi piɛbihi niŋ o bɔɣiri ni, ka zaŋ ba buɣi o nyɔɣu zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ manim baalim kuli.
en: Like a shepherd, God will tend the flock; he will gather lambs in his arms and lift them onto his lap. He will gently guide the nursing ewes.

dag: Dama bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim n-jɛmdi buɣa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi ya ŋɔnim zuɣu ka kɔŋ maabu.
en: The people of Judah have left me and have burned incense to other gods. They made me very angry. They made many idols. That is why I will show my anger against this place. My anger will be like a fire that cannot be stopped.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ku chaŋ. Amaa di nyaaŋa ka o suhu ti lɛbigi ka o chaŋ.
en: I don't want to, he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi lan labina, n ku nya yɛndana yi ni.
en: But come on, all of you, and try to prove me wrong. I dont find any of you to be wise.

dag: Din daa pun beni na kul ni beni. Ka din daa pun niŋ mi na kul ni niŋda. Binshɛli kani n-nyɛ bin palli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Whatever has happened—thats what will happen again; whatever has occurred—thats what will occur again. Theres nothing new under the sun.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili m-pali n ni, ka n ku lan tooi gbib li yaha. Kpaam li bahi bihi zuɣu sol ni, ka lan kpaai li bahi nachimba laɣiŋgu shee gba. Bɛ ni ti gbaai doo min o paɣa chaŋ, ka gbahi ninkura mini bɛn kurigi zaa chaŋ.
en: But Im filled with the LORDs rage and am tired of holding it in. Pour it out on the children in the streets and on the youths gathered together; husband with wife will be trapped, as will those old and gray.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.

dag: Amaa di ni kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣa mini yuya ni yimaŋmaŋ zaligu yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku di di saria. Yimaŋmaŋ malimiya li.
en: But it is only about words and names—arguments about your own law. So you must solve this problem yourselves. I dont want to be a judge of these matters.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ bi kɔŋ zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, dama Masia zaligu sulinsi ni ka m be, amaa n yi chaŋla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu sani, m bemi kaman ŋun bi doli fukumsi zaligu ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu maa.
en: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.

dag: N niriba bɛn suhiri ma, ka wurim be Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya la ni ti zaŋ pina na ti ti ma.
en: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa suhuri daa yiɣisi bahi Jɛrimia zuɣu, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ bu o, ka zaŋ o ti kpɛhi duu Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la yiŋa, dama bɛ daa zaŋ o yiŋ maa leela jɛriyali.
en: who were furious with him. They beat him and threw him into the house of the scribe Jonathan, which had been turned into a prison.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbaai Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn zaɣisi ma bɛ buɣa zuɣu la suhuri.
en: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.

dag: Ana bihi n-daa nyɛ: Dishɔn mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Ana maa bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Anah was the father of Dishon and Oholibamah.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindi timaŋa, ka o be kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka bɛ su zahim mini noonsi ni niɣi ni dunia ŋɔ zaa ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi.
en: Then God said, Let us make humanity in our image to resemble us so that they may take charge of the fish of the sea, the birds in the sky, the livestock, all the earth, and all the crawling things on earth.

dag: bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba ni azichilaannim ni faranim zaa, wummiya!.
en: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa yi Hazɛrɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the wilderness of Paran.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa ʒii buta, ka zaŋ kikahi mini firilanim ni be duɣubihi shɛŋa ni ti bɛ zaa.
en: Gideon divided his little army into three groups of men, and he gave each soldier a trumpet and a large clay jar with a burning torch inside.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋ kara zani dabari; ka saɣim bɛ ni me bin shɛŋa taɣi bɛmaŋa. Tinzunnim ni me nayiya shɛŋa luya, ka so ku lan lab me li zali yaha.
en: You have turned the city into rubble, the fortified town into a ruin, the fortress of foreigners into a city no more, never to be rebuilt.

dag: Yisa daa ti lan wuhiri niriba dahin shɛli, ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi m-mir o; bɛ daa yila Jɛrusalɛm mini Galili ni Judia tiŋkpansi na. Ka ti Duuma yiko din daa chɛ ka Yisa tibiri barinim maa daa be ŋun Yisa sani.
en: One day Jesus was teaching the people. The Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there too. They had come from every town in Galilee and Judea and from Jerusalem. The Lord was giving Jesus the power to heal people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zani baɣil o ka yɛli, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a ni do tiŋgban shɛli ni ŋɔ ti a min a zuliya;.
en: The Lord was standing beside the ladder and said: I am the Lord God who was worshiped by Abraham and Isaac. I will give to you and your family the land on which you are now sleeping.

dag: A sujee naai ti mi zaa; ka a suhuyiɣisili nyaŋ ti zaa.
en: We are destroyed by your anger; we are terrified by your fury.

dag: ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa yɛli ma o yɛla, ka yɛli ni n karim o saria n-luh o ti ba.
en: When I was in Jerusalem, the Jewish chief priests and elders brought charges against him and requested a guilty verdict in his case.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa yɛli naa, Nyama, nabihi maa kunna kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni pun yɛl a shɛm la.
en: So Jonadab said to King David, Look, I was right! The kings sons are coming.

dag: Ka so kani ŋun mali suhukpeeni din ni tooi niŋ o ka o suhu yiɣisi. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zan o tooni?.
en: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Wahu n-yɔhim ma ka n di li.
en: Then the Lord God said to the woman, What have you done? She said, The snake tricked me, so I ate the fruit.

dag: Amaa Absalom daa bi yɛli Amnɔn zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, dama o daa lan je Amnɔn yɛlli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi niŋ o tizɔpaɣ Tama shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Absalom treated Amnon as though nothing had happened, but he hated Amnon for what he had done to his sister Tamar.

dag: Ka Ibram daa lan gbaai chandi zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb polo.
en: Then he moved on toward the Negev, stopping for a time at several places on the way.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so n-ti yɛn me jɛmbu duu maa ti n yuli jilima.
en: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build the temple to honor me.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, Bɛn wumdi Naawuni yɛligu ka gbib li n-lee mal alibarika.
en: But he said, Happy rather are those who hear Gods word and put it into practice.

dag: Musa daa zali ba, Yuma ayopɔin kam ni, saha shɛli din nyɛ yi ni kuri sama tiri taba, ka nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu puhibu saha la.
en: He commanded them, At the end of every seven years, when the year that debts are canceled comes around, read this aloud at the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tia dari m-mali pund ayi n-zaŋ yo Luɣ Kasi shee din be puuni la ha dunoli, ka dapaɣili din pa dunoli maa zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira dasara daa mulisi ka mali yaɣ anu.
en: He made the doors of the inner sanctuary from olive wood and carved the doorframes with five recesses.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ yi kpee ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nira, yin miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri, di yi nyɛ liɣiri nyɔri bee bindira nyɔri bee yi ni kul zaŋ binshɛlikam paŋ o nyɔri.
en: When you loan something to another Israelite, you must not charge interest. Dont charge interest on money, on food or on anything that may earn interest.

dag: Bee miri ka a zu.
en: You must not steal.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Naawuni pun tahi tiliginsim yɛligu ŋɔ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn ni wum li. .
en: Paul said, You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba mini salo maa, M bi nya doo ŋɔ taali.
en: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, I find no reason to condemn this man.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zal o tumtumdiba zaa bɛn ʒe o dunol ni ni bɛ tim Haman jilima n-damdir o tiŋa. Amaa ka Mɔdɛkai ŋun daa zaɣisi ni o ku damd o tiŋa bee n-ti o jilima.
en: The king ordered all the officials in his service to show their respect for Haman by kneeling and bowing to him. They all did so, except for Mordecai, who refused to do it.

dag: Amaa zaligu palli ka n zaani ya ŋɔ; dina n-nyɛ, Yumiya taba! N ni yuri ya shɛm, yi gba yumiya tab lala.
en: I give you a new commandment: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, so you also must love each other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hiram daa ti Sulemaana sida mini Sipirɛs dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa o ni daa bɔra.
en: Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar and pine logs he needed.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: None of us knows what is going to happen, and there is no one to tell us.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus answered them, I will ask you just one question, and if you give me an answer, I will tell you what right I have to do these things.

dag: Yawɛ zaɣisi n tɔbbihi zaa bɛn be n sani. O zali ma saha shɛl o ni yɛn ku n nachimba. N Duuma no Juda paɣisarili ŋun nyɛ paɣipiɛliga sɔŋ kaman bɛ ni nɔri wain di bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: My Lord has despised my mighty warriors. He called a feast for me—in order to crush my young men! My Lord has stomped on the winepress of the young woman Daughter Judah.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku wɔribara min o wɔhu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ku chɛchɛbunduhira.
en: to shatter cavalry and chariots.

dag: Yawɛ ni bi tooi zaŋ niriba ŋɔ kulisi o ni daa po ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni zuɣu, ka o ku ba mɔɣu maa ni maa.
en: that you killed your people in the wilderness because you were not able to bring them into the land you promised to give them.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi nya filiŋ, ka niriba zaa ʒiɛm ya ka filim ya yi ni bi doli n soya, amaa ka chɛ ka niriba gaŋbu be yi wuhibu ni la zuɣu.
en: So I, in turn, will make the people of Israel despise you because you do not obey my will, and when you teach my people, you do not treat everyone alike.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla kom din zilima, ka yɛm kɔbilinini nyɛ kulibɔŋ kom din zɔra.
en: Words from wise people are like water bubbling up from a deep well—the well of wisdom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yeeg o binyɛra maa ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ tampiligim maa yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: Then he shall change his clothes and take the ashes outside the camp to a ritually clean place.

dag: Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa ni daa wum bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: When Abrahams servant heard what they said, he bowed low before the LORD.

dag: Ka Jɔbab daa ti kpi, ka Husham ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛmannim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Jobab died, Husham ruled. Husham was from the land of the Temanites.

dag: n-ti Nɛria bia Baruk ŋun daa nyɛ Masɛya yaaŋa la, m mabia Hanamɛl mini shɛhiranim bɛn daa dihi bɛ nuhi dabu gbana maa zuɣu la ni Judanim zaa bɛn daa be guliba dundɔŋ maa ni ninni.
en: and gave it to Baruch, Neriahs son and Mahseiahs grandson, before my cousin Hanamel and the witnesses named in the deed, as well as before all the Judeans who were present in the prison quarters.

dag: Naawuni yi saɣi ti ni kpaŋ timaŋ chaŋla tooni.
en: Let us go forward! And this is what we will do, if God allows.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tia kam wulli zooi ka viɛla. Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa tiligi ni ti nya ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiwala viɛla, ka nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: On that day, the LORDs branch will become beautiful and glorious. The earths fruit will be the pride and splendor of Israels survivors.

dag: Ka di nyɛla Baasha min o bia Ɛla ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa la mini bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi shɛŋa ka di yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu la zuɣu.
en: This happened because of all the sins of Baasha and his son, Elah. They sinned and they caused the Israelites to sin. They worshiped worthless idols, and this made the Lord angry.

dag: Ka bidibbihi mini bipuɣimbihi ni doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri diɛmda.
en: while boys and girls play in the streets.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n yihi Ijipti vi shɛli yi ni diri la ka chɛn ya. Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Giligal, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord told Joshua, It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace. So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ ni: Jɛhɔhanan mini Hanania ni Zabai ni Atilai.
en: From the descendants of Bebai, these men: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

dag: Bɛ yiya ni ti leei shɛb dini, ka bɛ puri mini bɛ paɣiba leei shɛb dini, dama n ni darigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim tibili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their houses will be given to others, and so will their fields and their wives. I am going to punish the people of this land.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ku Midian paɣ so maa mi yuli daa boonila Kɔzibi. O daa nyɛla Zur bipuɣiŋga, ka Zur daa nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba dɔɣirikpɛma Midian.
en: And the Midianite woman killed with him was Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite clan leader named Zur.

dag: Amaa m mali yɛm kaman yi gba ni mali yɛm shɛm maa. M pala ŋun biɛhigu pooi yi biɛhigu; ka ŋuni n-lee bi mi dimbɔŋɔnima?.
en: I am also intelligent; Im not inferior to you. Who isnt like these people?.

dag: Dama Aram tinzuɣu nyɛla Damaskus, ka Rɛzin gba nyɛ Damaskus zuɣulana.
en: because Aram depends on its capital Damascus, and Damascus is led by its weak king Rezin. And dont worry about Ephraim. Within years it will be crushed, no longer a nation.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan bɔrila shɛlikam pahi ni a zaŋ tum a Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin yihim li nayili kpanjɔɣu la ni.
en: If anything else is required for Gods house that you are responsible to provide, you may provide it from the royal treasury.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a ni kari Ohola mini Oholiba saria, ka yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa?.
en: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, it's time for you to tell Oholah and Oholibah that they are guilty. Remind them of their evil ways!.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi o nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka o shia kasi suhu saɣim pam. Dinzuɣu ka o daa leei bɛ dima, ka ŋmaligi tuhi ba o toli.
en: Then the Lord 's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛri pampam, Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku ŋɔ simdi ni o mali yiko mini azichi ni yɛm ni kpiɔŋ, ka nya tibiginsim mini jilima ni alibarika.
en: and they were saying in a loud voice, The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuun suma bi zɔri nam fukumsinim dabiɛm, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun biɛri n-zɔri ba dabiɛm. A bɔri ni a ku zɔri ŋun be nam fukumsi ni dabiɛm? Dindina tummi din viɛla, ka a ni nya paɣibu o sani.
en: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun mali shɛhira suŋ bɛn be kpaŋ sani, di yi pa lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti tum vi tuma, ka Sintani zana gbaag o.
en: He should be a man who is respected by the people outside the church, so that he will not be disgraced and fall into the Devil's trap.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a mabia nahu bee o piɛɣu ni chaŋ yirigi ka a baɣa ka o ni; di simdi ka a taɣ o labisi ti ti o lana.
en: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Naawuni ŋ-ŋman a, ka nyɛ ŋun chɛr o niriba bɛn kpalim taali, ka bi lan doli bɛ biriginsim tuma? A suhu yi yiɣisi, di lan maara; dama a yuri nambɔzɔbo.
en: There is no God like you. You take away peoples guilt. God will forgive his people who survive. He will not stay angry with them forever, because he enjoys being kind.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka yi leei nyɛviyanima, ka n zaŋ ya niŋ yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka mi shiri ni niŋ li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi n yɛligu, ka ʒe n dunɔdali gbini dabisili kam, ka ʒe n dunoli ni guhiri mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Whoever waits at my door and listens for me will be blessed.

dag: amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela zibisim ni. Dama din di naan nyɛ a neesim yi niŋ liti, dindina nyin baŋmi ni di zibisim maa ku mali kpee.
en: But if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how terrible that darkness will be!.

dag: Waazuyihira maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchi; di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Everything is so meaningless. The Teacher says that it is all a waste of time!.

dag: di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Di je suli n-kari man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bahi. Nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ, di chɛ ma bee n-zaŋ ma bahi.
en: Please dont hide it from me! Dont push your servant aside angrily— you have been my help! God who saves me, dont neglect me! Dont leave me all alone!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa wuhi ma nyɛvili kom mɔɣili, ka di zɔri yiri Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la gbin na n-doya nyaɣisiri kaman diɣi la.
en: The angel showed me the river of the water of life, clear as crystal. The river flows from the throne of God and the Lamb.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma Baal binnan la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duu maa, ka zaŋ nimaani leei bimbɔɣili hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then they smashed the memorial stones of Baal. They also smashed the temple of Baal. They made the temple of Baal into a public toilet, which is still used today.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti ku yi ni chani ni yi ti deei zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka chɛ ka yi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, yi yi ti deei li ʒini bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: You are going to take your land from other people. The Lord your God will destroy these people for you. You will force them out of that land, and then you will live there.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka chilibi buɣim yi o sani alizanda ni n-lu Sɔdom mini Gomɔra zuɣu na.
en: and the Lord sent burning sulfur down like rain on Sodom and Gomorrah.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ Naawuni nir maa sani Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu. Naawuni Nir maa ni daa nya paɣ maa ka o kanna ka o yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Nyama, Shunɛm paɣ la m-be katiŋ kanna ŋɔ.
en: So she set out and went to Mount Carmel, where Elisha was. Elisha saw her coming while she was still some distance away, and he said to his servant Gehazi, Look, there comes the woman from Shunem!.

dag: Bɛ daa kpala tanti, ka booni di puuni luɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni Luɣ Kasi Shee. Firilatamdigu mini teebuli shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro shɛli bɛ ni mali maani sara Naawuni sani m-pari di zuɣu la n-daa be nimaani.
en: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: So they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and God brought them out safe from their desperate circumstances.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Ribɛka na nti bɔh o, A ni doli doo ŋɔ chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni dol o chaŋ.
en: So they called Rebecca and asked, Do you want to go with this man? Yes, she answered.

dag: Malimiya yimaŋ kasi n-kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛɣu ka mali yi zuliya niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali shɛm la.
en: Kill the Passover lambs and make yourselves holy to the Lord. Get ready to help your fellow Israelites. Do everything the Lord commanded us in the laws he gave to Moses.

dag: M mabiyurisi, n ni sabiri gban shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ pahirila diba ayi. Gbana maa zaa puuni, n loya ni n neela yi nimmoo tɛha la n-teei ya yɛla ŋɔ.
en: My friends, this is the second letter I have written to you. I wrote both letters to you to help your honest minds remember something.

dag: O ni tooi zo n-kuli tinsi maa zaɣ yin ni chaŋ ti zani tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini n-kahig o yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba; ka bɛ zaŋ o kpe tiŋ maa ni ti ti o biɛhigu shee, ka o kpalim be bɛ sani.
en: You can run away to one of these cities, go to the place of judgment at the entrance to the city, and explain to the leaders what happened. Then they will let you into the city and give you a place to live in, so that you can stay there.

dag: Tola bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Rɛfaya ni Jɛriɛl ni Jamai ni Ibisam ni Shɛmuɛl, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Tola zuliya maa dɔɣirikpamba, ka daa lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi. Dauda ʒiɛman ni, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were , people in Tola's family by the time David became king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni lo a alikauli; amaa bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni a niŋ, dina n-nyɛ: a yi ti yɛn kana ti nya ma nyin zaŋm Mikal Sool bipuɣiŋga la mali na, di yi pa lala a yi ti kana a ku nya n ninni.
en: Good! David answered. I will make an agreement with you on one condition: you must bring Saul's daughter Michal to me when you come to see me.

dag: Dama ni o nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka o mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. Ka o ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka mi ni tooi yɛl o dabili ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: I, too, am a man placed under the authority of superior officers, and I have soldiers under me. I order this one, Go! and he goes; I order that one, Come! and he comes; and I order my slave, Do this! and he does it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa me goon ŋmaa zali du bila kam tooni, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu, ka di barilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu di yaɣa zaa, ka dubihi buɣisibu nyɛ mita atata di yaɣa zaa.
en: In front of each of the guardrooms there was a low wall inches high and inches thick.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi Firawuna sani chaŋ, ka Musa daa ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ zaŋ chaŋ poloya maa polo kaman o mini Firawuna ni daa saɣi shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh. Moses prayed to the Lord about the frogs he had sent against Pharaoh.

dag: A lɛhu yi gbilim ka a bi sahi li, ka zaŋ li ni a tum tuma, a ni di wahala pam; amaa yɛm nyɛla din sɔŋdi nir ka o diri nasara.
en: If your ax is dull and you don't sharpen it, you have to work harder to use it. It is smarter to plan ahead.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri nɛma yihiri.
en: When Jesus entered the temple, he threw out those who were selling things there.

dag: Ka di nyaaŋa kɔr biɛri yi tiɣi pua, di dɔɣirila alahichi; ka alahichi mi yi ti bi zaa, di tiɣirila pua n-dɔɣi kum.
en: Once those cravings conceive, they give birth to sin; and when sin grows up, it gives birth to death.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bindirigu ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o.
en: Do any of you have a son? If he asked for bread, would you give him a rock?.

dag: Hal Ijiptinim yi wum ni Taai wurimya, di ni niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.

dag: Ka timaŋmaŋ gba baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka niŋ yɛda. Naawuni nyɛla yurilim, ka ŋunkam kul be yurilim puuni nyɛla ŋun be Naawuni ni, ka Naawuni gba be o ni.
en: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Pa Bɛnjamin zuliya din pɔri gari Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa la ni nira n-nyɛ ma? Pa n yiŋnim m-pɔri gari sokam Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni? Ka wula ka a ti tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Why are you telling me this? Saul asked. I'm from Benjamin, the smallest tribe in Israel, and my clan is the least important in the tribe.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee la. Dina n-daa chɛ ka niriba maa daa na bi zaŋ bɛ suhuri zaa labisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni jɛmbu polo.
en: with the exception that he didnt remove the shrines. The people were still not committed with all their hearts to the God of their ancestors.

dag: M puhiri Asinkiritus mini Flɛgɔn ni Hɛrimɛs ni Patirɔbas ni Hɛrimas ni ti mabihi bɛn be bɛ san la.
en: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.

dag: Ka niɣi maa daa dii zaŋ li lu solɔɣu n-kpa Bɛtishɛmɛshi polo, bɛ daa bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, bɛ daa kul chanimi ka kuhira. Ka Filistia nanim daa dol ba hal ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi tintariga.
en: The cows went straight to Beth Shemesh. The cows stayed on the road, mooing all the way. They did not turn right or left. The Philistine rulers followed the cows as far as the city limits of Beth Shemesh.

dag: Nir yi niŋdi nandaamba alaka ni o nya buni pahi ni ŋun tiri bundaamba pini, bɛ zaa ni leei nandaamba.
en: If you make gifts to rich people or oppress the poor to get rich, you will become poor yourself.

dag: Amaa bɛ dɔɣila ninsalinim niŋ yɛlimuɣisira ni, kaman buɣim ni yi tahi yiɣi zuɣusaa shɛm la.
en: But people are born to have trouble, as surely as sparks rise from a fire.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ni tim so na.
en: Then Jesus said to his followers, And who do you say I am? Peter answered, You are the Messiah from God.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Di zaŋ binshɛɣu n-tabili limsi anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, dama saha miriya.
en: Then he said to me, Dont seal up the words of the prophecy contained in this scroll, because the time is near.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo ŋɔ na. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tin ya ka yi nyuri bara bɛ zuɣu la lee be ya?.
en: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka Naawuni deei li ka di leeg o daalahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You shall put your hand on its head, and it will be accepted as a sacrifice to take away your sins.

dag: Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka alizin biɛ so ʒi Sool zuɣu maa daa yi ti kul lan siɣina saha shɛlikam, Dauda zaŋdila mɔɣilo maa ŋmɛra, ka alizin biɛɣu maa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka o ni maai, ka o nya omaŋa.
en: Whenever the evil spirit from God affected Saul, David would take the lyre and play it. Then Saul would relax and feel better, and the evil spirit would leave him alone.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zɔri ni bɛ ti du tampima, ka zaŋ kur tibisa anahi din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kɔtiŋa di nyaaŋa polo, ka kari bɛ buɣa ka jiɣiri biɛɣu neebu zuɣu.
en: They were afraid that the ship would go on the rocks, so they lowered four anchors from the back of the ship and prayed for daylight.

dag: Wulipolli ni ti puhi yi Jɛsi gbirili ni na. Wulli ni ti to n-yi o nyaɣa ni na n-wali.
en: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa. Ka bɛ kul tɔɣisirila din tuhi yɛla.
en: The mouths of the righteous recite wisdom; their tongues discuss justice.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli nyɛla din mali yiko; o kukoli mali jilima pam.
en: The Lord s voice is powerful. It shows the Lord s glory.

dag: ka yihi nanim bɛ nama ni, ka tibigi tarimba.
en: He has pulled the powerful down from their thrones and lifted up the lowly.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yoomiya vol maa yihi nanima anu la ti ma na.
en: Joshua said, Move the rocks that are covering the entrance to the cave. Bring the five kings to me.

dag: Ka yi yi tum taali ka bɛ fiɛbi ya di zuɣu, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya di zuɣu? Amaa yi yi tum din tuhi ka bɛ niŋ ya wahala di zuɣu ka yi niŋ suɣilo dee li, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani di zuɣu.
en: But if you are punished for doing wrong, there is no reason to praise you for bearing that punishment. But if you suffer for doing good and you are patient, this pleases God.

dag: Jɛrigu ŋɔ! A ni biri binshɛli ku bilina ka pa ni di poomi.
en: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.

dag: Di saha maa Dauda daa ʒila tiŋ maa dunoya ayi sunsuuni, ka tiŋgula daa ti du n-tam dunɔdali dufahirili zuɣusaa n-lihi ha nya do so ni zɔrina o kɔŋko.
en: David was sitting in the space between the inner and outer gates of the city. The lookout went up to the top of the wall and stood on the roof of the gateway; he looked out and saw a man running alone.

dag: shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa. Timmi bɛ zuliya kam puuni ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Send some men to explore the land of Canaan. I will give this land to the Israelites. Send one leader from each of the twelve tribes.

dag: Pa Naawuni ŋun boli ya la n-nyɛ ŋun kari ya di ni.
en: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.

dag: Amaa Dauda zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni daa ti Abijam firila Jɛrusalɛm n-chɛ ka o bia di nam zan o zaani gbib Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David had always obeyed the Lord 's commands by doing right, except in the case of Uriah. And since Abijam was David's great-grandson, the Lord kept Jerusalem safe and let Abijam have a son who would be the next king.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ni ti zaŋ o binshɛɣukam fukumsi niŋ o yiŋbia maa nuu ni.
en: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.

dag: Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o kpambaliba ni o sapashinnima ni o niriba zaa ni ti nyu li.
en: The second place I went was Egypt, where everyone had to drink from the cup, including the king and his officials, the other government workers, the rest of the Egyptians.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti neei kaman yuntisuɣu saha n-lɛbig omaŋ tuug o ka di gar o, o ni nya ka paɣ do o naba tiŋli maa zuɣu.
en: About midnight, Boaz rolled over in his sleep and woke up. He was very surprised. There was a woman lying near his feet.

dag: Yi yi kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi ma, hal yi yi suhi ma kabo, n ku lihi yi polo na; m mi ku wum yi suhigu maa. Yi nuhi tim ʒim ni.
en: No matter how much you pray, I won't listen. You are too violent.

dag: Ti ni daa doli ti niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa chɛ ka ti kɔr biɛri yiɣisi, ka ti tumdi tuun shɛŋa din nyɛ kum dini ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣili kam ni.
en: In the past we were ruled by our sinful selves. The law made us want to do sinful things. And those sinful desires controlled our bodies, so that what we did only brought us spiritual death.

dag: dindina yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yin baŋmiya ni Yisa Masia Nazarɛt ninvuɣ so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ka Naawuni neeg o kum ni la yuli zuɣu ka do so ŋun yi nyɛ gbarigu ŋɔ ti ʒe yi sani ni alaafee ŋɔ.
en: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.

dag: Pa ŋun Hɛzɛkia n-daa wurim o buɣa maligu shee min o sara maligu bimbina zaa, ka zali Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima yɛli Bimbini yini kɔŋko gbini ka yi ni jɛmdi Naawuni ka maani sara di zuɣu la.
en: But Hezekiah himself took away the high places and altars that belonged to that god. He told you people of Judah and Jerusalem that you must worship and burn incense on only one altar.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija.
en: Later, the Lord said to Elijah.

dag: Teeku bula mini biŋkɔb kara bɛn be di ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ dunia ni.
en: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa suhuri daa yiɣisi bahi Jɛrimia zuɣu, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ bu o, ka zaŋ o ti kpɛhi duu Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la yiŋa, dama bɛ daa zaŋ o yiŋ maa leela jɛriyali.
en: They were angry and ordered the soldiers to beat me. Then I was taken to the house that belonged to Jonathan, one of the king's officials. It had been turned into a prison, and I was kept in a basement room. After I had spent a long time there.

dag: Chɛli sujee mini suhuyiɣisili. Chɛli suhuyiɣisili, dama di nyɛla din kpɛhiri nir zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma: Siria na so ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka soli ni o di nam maa, amaa o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu fa nam maa di n-libigi ba.
en: A worthless person will arise in his place. Royal majesty will not have been given to him, but he will come in a time of security and seize the kingdom by deceitful means.

dag: Ka daa yɛli sapashini ni o zaŋm Pool ti kpɛhi duu, amaa ka lee wɔɣis o, ka chɛ ka o zɔnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋd o kan o sanna.
en: He arranged for a centurion to guard Paul. He was to give Paul some freedom, and his friends were not to be hindered in their efforts to provide for him.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kuhiri yɛri zoya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na! Ka ni ti yɛri kuŋkuna mi, Limsimiya ti! .
en: That will be the time when people will say to the mountains, Fall on us! and to the hills, Hide us.

dag: Ti malila ti tizɔpaɣa, ka o biha bi yaɣi lala. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa, dɔbba yi ti kana ti bɔr o?.
en: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tiba mal alibarika, a ni zaŋ a zaligu wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb gba mal alibarika.
en: Lord , great blessings belong to those you discipline, to those you teach from your law.

dag: O doonila gɔtihi gbin ni, ka baa ni kaɣili lims o.
en: He lies under the lotus plants. He hides among the reeds of the swamp.

dag: Ka n daa deei litaafi bila maa malaika maa nuu ni n-zaŋ ŋubi; ka di shiri malisi n nol ni kaman shir la, ka n ni daa ti ŋub li naai, ka di shiri to m puuni.
en: So I took the scroll from the angels hand and ate it. And it was sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I swallowed it, it made my stomach churn.

dag: Lala ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa, ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa nyɛ din viɛla ni din tuhi ka lan wuh o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun daa teeg n nuu n-zaŋ n yiko din galisi pam yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la; damdimiya n tooni ka maani yi sara maligu tiri ma.
en: Instead, worship only the LORD. Hes the one who brought you up from the land of Egypt with great strength and an outstretched arm. Bow down to him! Sacrifice to him!.

dag: ka yɛli Dauda, A nyɛla wuntizɔra pam gari ma, dama a tum ma din viɛla, ka man zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo a samli.
en: Then he said to David, You are right, and I am wrong. You have been so good to me, while I have done such wrong to you!.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa na kpalim be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka be luɣ shɛlikam, nimaani niriba bɛn sɔŋmi ba n-ti ba anzinfa mini salima ni nɛma m-pahi biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ suhuyubu pina, ka bɛ zaŋ ti tum Naawuni duu maa tuma Jɛrusalɛm.
en: And so in any place where there might be survivors of Israel, the men in that place must support these survivors. Give them silver, gold, animals, and other things. Give them gifts for Gods Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Nandaamba mini faranima ni ti lan nya suhupiɛl shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tiri la.
en: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord , the holy God of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka vuhim kpe yi ni ka yi niŋ nyɛviyanima.
en: I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrimia Libina nir bia ka o yuli booni Hamutal.
en: Jehoahaz was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem only months. His mother Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

dag: Dinzuɣu, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn yɔhila yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ n-zaŋ ya labisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So prophesy to my people Israel and tell them that I, the Sovereign Lord , am going to open their graves. I am going to take them out and bring them back to the land of Israel.

dag: M biyurisi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba, dama yurilim yirila Naawuni sanna; ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka mi Naawuni.
en: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.

dag: Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba zaa n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Ka ya polo ka doo ŋɔ lee bɔhim yɛla ŋɔ zaa.
en: And dont all his sisters still live here in town? How is he able to do these things.

dag: A mi ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr maa kamina ni o ti yɔhim a baŋ a ni doli so shɛli yiri min a ni doli so shɛli kpɛra; ka lan baŋ a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: You know Abner—he came to trick you. He wants to find out how strong your army is and to know everything you're doing.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya ti Duuma zuɣu, dama dina n-tuhi.
en: Children, it is your Christian duty to obey your parents, for this is the right thing to do.

dag: ka di be o sani, ka o karindi li dabisili kam o biɛhigu ni din ni chɛ ka o bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu ŋɔ ni mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling.

dag: ka boli laɣiŋgu maa niriba zaa ka bɛ ka Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni na.
en: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Ka do so daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o chani ni bɛ ti sɔɣi, ka nya Mɔab ŋmɛnditoya ka zaŋ kpim maa bahi Ilaisha siliga ni ka zo. Kpim maa ni daa kul lu siliga maa ni ha n-shihi Ilaisha kɔba, o dii neemi yiɣisi zani.
en: Some Israelites were burying a dead man when they saw that group of soldiers. The Israelites quickly threw the dead man into Elishas grave. As soon as the dead man touched the bones of Elisha, he came back to life and stood up on his feet.

dag: yinim bɛn zaŋ ʒim me Ziɔn, ka zaŋ tuumbiɛri me Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni fa ninvuɣ kura maa ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o labisi o ni daa pun be tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka bɛ ni daa booi kpam din be kasi bahi maligumaaniba zuɣulaan so zuɣu ni ti kpi.
en: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.

dag: ka paɣimiya Naawuni shɛlikam zaa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yu shɛli yi biɛhigu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Give thanks in every situation because this is Gods will for you in Christ Jesus.

dag: ka Arɔd daŋ niriba nyɛ Arɔdnima; ka Arɛli mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Arɛlinima.
en: Arod, and Areli.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Naawuni daa ka Naa Sulemaana sanna ti yɛl o, Suhimi ma a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: That night God appeared to Solomon and said, Ask whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so cheechinim zaa ni luri sizuura o lahibal suŋ molo molibu zuɣu la n-dolisir o na.
en: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.

dag: Nyama, pa bɛ buni ka bɛ gbibi bɛ nuhi ni maa? Man kul ku deei ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Look, isnt their well-being the work of their own hands? A sinners logic is beyond me.

dag: Ka naa maa daa mali saawara, ka zaŋ salima mali naɣilabih ayi zali; ka yɛli niriba maa, Yi chani Jɛrusalɛm ka di saha wɔɣa. Izraɛlnima, nyamiya yi buɣa bɛn daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: So the king asked for advice and then made two gold calves. He said to the people, Its too far for you to go all the way up to Jerusalem. Look, Israel! Here are your gods who brought you out from the land of Egypt.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa bela zuɣusaa. O ni yu shɛm ka o tumda.
en: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever he wishes.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbidii paɣa daa zaŋ o bih ayi kana ti gbani Yisa tooni n-suhir o binshɛli.
en: Then the wife of Zebedee came to Jesus with her two sons, bowed before him, and asked him for a favor.

dag: N daa nya n suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam. N daa bi zaɣisi n suhu ni kul bɔri nyaɣisim shɛlikam. N daa nyu bara n ni tum nya shɛli zuɣu. N tuma laara zaa ni daa nyɛ shɛli m-bala.
en: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.

dag: A chɛ ka n dabisa bi yaɣ lala. N nyɛvili yuusim pa shɛli a sani. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal kam biɛhigu ŋmanila vuhim.
en: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. Human life is but a breath.

dag: Dama ti ni daa birigi maa nyaaŋa ti daa niŋ tuuba, ti ni daa ti baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka ti daa zaŋ ti zuɣuri ba tiŋa. Vi daa gbahi ti, ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisi, ti ni daa nya filiŋ ti bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa wolig o piɛsah ayopɔin zali bɛ ko.
en: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep.

dag: Din simdi ya m-bala. N ni lo ni n niŋ ya shɛm m-bala! Dama yi tam n yɛla, ka niŋla ʒiri naani. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: This is the future that I have prepared for you, declares the LORD, because you have forgotten me and trusted in lies.

dag: Ka zuliya kam ni zaŋ bɛ tibiginsim mini bɛ jilima na nti kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka n ka yi sanna ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni yubu puuni, ka nya suhukpaŋsibo m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim be zuɣu.
en: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.

dag: Miri ka a tam ka bi paɣi Naawuni o tuma zuɣu, dama niriba pun yiinila wumpaɣibo yila zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Remember to praise his work that all of us have seen.

dag: Yawɛ daalikaulinim nyɛla alali; di nyɛla alali kaman anzinfa maŋli shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she tiŋgban ni buɣim ni m-mal li buyopɔin ka di yi zaa la.
en: The promises of the Lord can be trusted; they are as genuine as silver refined seven times in the furnace.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su tahi shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa din be kasi la fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su bɔrɔbɔro zim mini wain ni kpam ni tulaale zim ni tulaalɛnim zaa fukumsi.
en: Others were in charge of the other sacred equipment, and of the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices.

dag: Yawɛ, pa tinima, pa tinima, amaa a yuli ka ti tiri jilima, a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu.
en: Not to us, LORD, not to us— no, but to your own name give glory because of your loyal love and faithfulness!.

dag: Ka Pita daa dii yiɣisi doli ba. O ni daa mali ti paai, ka bɛ zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa duu maa ni, ka tiŋ maa ni pakoya zaa daa ʒe n-gili Pita kumda, ka wuhir o binyɛr shɛŋa Dɔɔkas ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka she n-ti ba.
en: Peter went with them. Upon his arrival, he was taken to the upstairs room. All the widows stood beside him, crying as they showed the tunics and other clothing Dorcas made when she was alive.

dag: Ŋmaligim lab ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia ŋun nyɛ n niriba naa maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, N wum a suhigu maa, ka nya a nintam maa. Nyama, n ni chɛ ka a kpaŋ, ka zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, a ni chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Go back and speak to Hezekiah, the leader of my people. Tell him, This is what the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, says: I heard your prayer and I saw your tears, so I will heal you. On the third day you will go up to the Temple of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn nyari tibidarigibo ni biɛrim bɛ bindoo zuɣu, ka kul nyari biɛrim bɛ kɔba ni.
en: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.

dag: A ni daa tim ma dunia ŋɔ ni na shɛm, lala ka n gba tim ba.
en: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.

dag: Chamiya ti maan lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya o shiri beni, ka baŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka lan baŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nya o nimaani maa, dama bɛ yɛli ma ni o neeya pam.
en: Go now and get everything ready. Find out everything you can: where he stays, where he goes, who has seen him. I am told he is very shrewd.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ gili yɛli niriba maa ni bɛ bom bindira m-mali shili gu, dama ni di kpalim daba ata ni bɛ gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: Go through the camp and give orders to the people. Say, Get supplies ready for yourselves because in three days you will be crossing over the Jordan to enter the land and take it over. The LORD your God is going to give it to you as your possession.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni ti daa chaŋla Juda yaɣili Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ duu la ni. Bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni kpe kuɣ shɛŋa mɛri li, ka zaŋ dapaɣa kpɛhi di goma ni. Bɛ tumdi tuma maa viɛnyɛliŋga pam, ka di kul chani tooni.
en: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa ni ti yɛli bɛn ʒe o nudirigu polo la, Yinim bɛn mal alibarika m Ba Naawuni sani ŋɔ, kamiyana ti di nam shɛli o ni daa pun zaŋ zali ya tum dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: Then the king will say to those on his right, Come, you who will receive good things from my Father. Inherit the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world began.

dag: O ku deei sandaani sanyoo kam, o mi ku deei birapu, di yi kul galisi kabo.
en: No payment—no amount of money—will stop him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bɔhir o lala maa zuɣu ka o yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Ŋun na ʒi n-tum alahichi yi ni, ŋun daŋm o kuɣili labbu.
en: They continued to question him, so he stood up and replied, Whoever hasnt sinned should throw the first stone.

dag: Bɛ kabi kana kaman tɔbbihi n-doli gooni voli ni kpɛna la; binshɛɣukam ni daa luri saha shɛl la, ka bɛ daa kul kabirina.
en: They advance as if through a destroyed wall; they roll along beneath the ruin.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n lan yɛri ya, saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka kpiimba ni ti wum Naawuni Bia maa kukoli, ka bɛnkam ti wum li ni mali nyɛvili.
en: I assure you that the time is coming—and is here!—when the dead will hear the voice of Gods Son, and those who hear it will live.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa duh a niriba ni, ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Tell Jeroboam: This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: When I lifted you up from among the people, I appointed you as a leader over my people Israel.

dag: N kul lihirila zoya zuɣu. Ya polo ka n sɔŋsim lee yɛn yina?.
en: I look to the mountains; where will my help come from?.

dag: O daa bi siɣis omaŋa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa siɣis omaŋ shɛm la, amaa Amɔn ŋɔ ŋun daa kul tumdila tuumbiɛri pahira.
en: But unlike his father Manasseh, Amon didnt submit before the LORD; instead, Amon increased his guilt.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛba n-yi Ijipti na, bɛ kul yɛrigila luɣ shɛlikam; kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma; di pa shɛli ka n tooi tuhi nyaŋ ba ka kari ba. .
en: that a people who came from Egypt has spread out over the whole land. He wants me to curse them for him, so that he can fight them and drive them out.

dag: Chɛrili nyɛla bɛn ka yaa, amaa bɛ nyari bindirigu diri siɣili saha.
en: Ants: they are weak, but they store up their food in the summer.

dag: Ti Duuma kul yɛn zaɣisi ti mi pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani ka kul ku lan niŋ ti nirilim sahakam?.
en: Will the Lord always reject us? Will he never again be pleased with us?.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tiligi ti ka boli ti ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi, ka di pala ti ni tum shɛli zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ni lo shɛm min o daanfaan shɛl o ni daa pun niŋ niŋ ti ni Yisa Masia zuɣu ʒiɛmana din gari la ni ha la zuɣu.
en: God is the one who saved and called us with a holy calling. This wasnt based on what we have done, but it was based on his own purpose and grace that he gave us in Christ Jesus before time began.

dag: Ka a ti daŋ n tooni chaŋ Giligal, nyama, n ni ka nimaani na ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligunima. Di simdi ka a ti guhi ma nimaani daba ayopɔin hal ka n ti kana ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Go to Gilgal before me. Then I will come there to you. And I will offer burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. But you must wait seven days. Then I will come and tell you what to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu do yino ŋun niŋgbuŋ daa gbarigi zaa la daa leei ŋun dɔɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi kaman saŋmarisi bee kaman teeku noli bihigu din ka kalinli ŋɔ.
en: So descendants were born from one man . They were as many as the number of the stars in the sky and as countless as the grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: Di saha ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli Yawɛ. A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ ma tuhi fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: But then Gideon said to God, To see if you really intend to rescue Israel through me as you have declared.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Dan zuliya niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligina bɔhi Maika, Bɔ n-chɛ ka a zaŋ salo ŋɔ tatabo pa amaŋ zuɣu na.
en: and shouted at them. The Danites turned around and asked Micah, What's the matter? Why all this mob.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma.
en: They should run away without wasting time to stop for anything. If someone is on the roof of their house, they must not go down to take things out of the house.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-baai du teeku duli kul o ya.
en: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biɛkaali, ka piɛli kaman goli, ka ne kaman wuntaŋa, ka o ni be shɛm ŋmani tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanim chani la?.
en: Who is that young woman? She shines out like the dawn. She is as pretty as the moon. She is as bright as the sun. She is as awesome as the stars in the sky.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ni leei faralana ni vidira, amaa ŋun deeri wuhibu ni nya jilima.
en: Someone who will not learn will be poor and disgraced. Anyone who listens to correction is respected.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa lan yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl sapashin kpamba ka n ta daɣiri ŋɔ. Bomiya do so na ka m min o ti tuhi.
en: I insult Israels troops today! The Philistine continued, Give me an opponent, and well fight.

dag: o naan zo dilan nambɔɣu ka yɛli, Famiy o bahi, ka o ku siɣi gballi ni; dama n nya soli ni n fa o bahi.
en: Maybe the angel will be kind and say to God, Save this one from the place of death! I have found a way to pay for his life.

dag: Nimaani ka n yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuhi Izraɛlnima, ka n jilima ni ti chɛ ka nimaani mali be kasi.
en: I will meet with the Israelites at that place, and my Glory will make that place holy.

dag: dama sokam tum alahichi ka kɔŋ soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ paai Naawuni sani.
en: everyone has sinned and is far away from God's saving presence.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim ya ka yi ŋmaligi doli wuna jɛmdi li, dama di saha.
en: He says, Be careful! Dont be fooled. Dont turn away from me to serve other gods and to bow down to them.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ninkura maa yɛligu maa wumbu, ka dolila o bipalitab bɛn min o laɣim zooi ka bɛ be o san la yɛligu.
en: But Rehoboam did not listen to the advice from the older men. He asked the young men who were his friends.

dag: ka o daa po pɔri n-lo alikauli ni bipuɣiŋga maa yi suh o shɛlikam zaa, o ni ti o li.
en: so much he swore to give her whatever she wanted.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan laɣim ka Rɛfaim vinvamli maa ni na ti doya yaha.
en: Again the Philistines came up and camped in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, N suhir a, wuhim ma a yuli. Amaa ka doo maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a baŋ n yuli? Di nyaaŋa ka doo maa daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni nimaani.
en: Jacob also asked and said, Tell me your name. But he said, Why do you ask for my name? and he blessed Jacob there.

dag: Daadam, kummi Ijipti tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa niŋ tiŋgban ni m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: Human one, mourn for Egypts hordes. Send Egypt down with the mighty nations subject to it, to the world below, among those who go down to the pit.

dag: Bɛ ni niŋ shɛli naani ka yaa, di ŋmanila kpatinariga yili.
en: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—.

dag: Ka o daa lan wuhi ba yɛra, Di yi niŋ ka yi ni so mali o zo ka ti chaŋ o sani yuntisuɣu ti yɛl o, Zɔri, paŋm ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila ata.
en: And Jesus said to his disciples, Suppose one of you should go to a friend's house at midnight and say, Friend, let me borrow three loaves of bread.

dag: Ka di lan sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa.
en: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married.

dag: ka kuhi yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zan a naba zuɣu! Ka gbarigu maa dii vaai yiɣisi zani gbaai chandi.
en: Raising his voice, Paul said, Stand up straight on your feet! He jumped up and began to walk.

dag: Dinzuɣu kom maa na kul nyɛla ko viɛlli hal ni zuŋɔ kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
