en: The water has stayed pure right up to this very day, in agreement with the word that Elisha spoke.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dooshee din nyɛ gbuɣim polli dibu shee, ka nyɛ gbuɣindaa ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka gbuɣimbihi be ni, ka so ku tooi dam ba la lee be ya?.
en: Where is the lions den, the meadow of the young lions, where lion, lioness, even lion cub go about with no one to terrify them?.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa lee yi ha nti nya o kpe so ŋun daa di o gba samli ka di bi yaɣi lala, ka o ʒe n-di dilan maa nyiŋgol ni ka yɛl o, Yom ma n samli la.
en: Later, that same servant found another servant who owed him a hundred silver coins. He grabbed him around the neck and said, Pay me the money you owe me.

dag: Yihim ʒiri mini yɔhiŋ n kɔbili ni. Di chɛ ka n nyɛ faralana bee bundana. Tim ma bindir shɛli din ni saɣi ma.
en: Dont let me tell lies. And dont make me too rich or too poor—give me only enough food for each day.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛli, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Jɛrusalɛm mini Judanima, ka di chɛ ka ŋunkam wum di yɛla niŋgbuna sɔhigi.
en: Because of this, the LORD, Israels God, has said: Im about to bring on Jerusalem and Judah such a great disaster that the ears of anyone who hears about it will ring.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti gbarigi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suma tumbu polo dama ti yi bi gbarigi, chɛbu saha yi ti paai, ti ni chɛ ti ni biri shɛli.
en: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.

dag: A ku zɔri yuŋ varisigu bee peen shɛŋa din yiɣiri wuntaŋ ni.
en: Dont be afraid of terrors at night, arrows that fly in daylight.

dag: amaa ka daa ti wum ni Arikilɔs n-di nam zan o ba Hɛrɔd zaani Judia, ka dabiɛm daa mal o ni o kul ni; ka Naawuni daa lan wuh o zahindi ni ni o ŋmaligim chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But he heard that Archelaus was now king in Judea. Archelaus became king when his father Herod died. So Joseph was afraid to go there. Then, after being warned in a dream, he went away to the area of Galilee.

dag: Yi ni daa je yɛm, ka bi zaŋ Yawɛ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord .

dag: Chɛliya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma maa baalim. Chɛliya Juda gomna mini Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa baalim ka bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili la ni.
en: Dont bother the workers. Dont try to stop the work on this Temple of God. Let the Jewish governor and the Jewish leaders rebuild it. Let them rebuild Gods Temple in the same place it was in the past.

dag: Ka daadam kam ŋun ti zaɣisi anab maa yɛligu wumbu ni ti bahi yoli zaa kahikahi.
en: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. O chɛ ka o neesim paai ti. Ŋahimiya tihi vari ka ti di chuɣu puhibu dari n-chaŋ ti gili sara maligu bimbini.
en: The Lord is God; he has been good to us. With branches in your hands, start the festival and march around the altar.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka n daa galim nanim mini zuɣulaannima n-yɛli ba, Yi zaa deeri binyɛra nyɔri yimaŋmaŋ niriba sani. Ka n daa laɣim salo pam na ni ti ti baŋ ti ni yɛn niŋ yɛlli maa shɛm.
en: I calmed myself down, and then I went to the rich families and the officials. I told them, You are forcing your own people to pay interest on the money you loan them. You must stop doing that! Then I called for all the people to meet together.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔŋ ni, duri daa be nimaani ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali gili di dundɔŋ maa zaa. Duri pihita n-daa be bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali luɣ shɛli maa tooni.
en: The man took me through the gateway into the courtyard. There were thirty rooms built against the outer wall, and in front of them there was an area paved with stones.

dag: N daa chɛ n yaaŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buri ma, ka chɛ n jira ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dariti sibiri n teeŋkɔbiri. M mi daa bi ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi bee bɛn tuhiri nintɔri viɛri ma.
en: I will let those people beat me and pull the hair from my beard. I will not hide my face when they say bad things to me and spit at me.

dag: M pala ŋun mali yolisim? M pala tumo? N nini daa bi nya ti Duuma Yisa? Yi pala n tuma nyɔri ti Duuma ni?.
en: I am a free man. I am an apostle. I have seen Jesus our Lord. You people are an example of my work in the Lord.

dag: ti kuli do so.
en: Then suppose she marries another man.

dag: Ka Filistianim shɛb daa ʒiri pina mini anzinfa na ti jɛmdi Jɛhɔshafat. Ka Laribunim gba daa zaŋ piɛlahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini bulahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin na ti ti o.
en: Philistines brought him silver and other gifts to keep peace. Some of the Arab people brought him , rams and the same number of goats.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ zaa ni gbilisi tibili wum, ka taɣi bɛ biɛhigu din bi viɛl maa, ka n gba taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ n ni lo ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu la polo.
en: Perhaps the people will listen and give up their evil ways. If they do, then I will change my mind about the destruction I plan to bring on them for all their wicked deeds.

dag: Malimiya salima bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di naba anahi ni, yaɣ yini bans ayi yaɣ din la mi bansi ayi.
en: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn chɛmi ka sanʒiɛ biɛɣu ʒe Babilɔn mini di niriba.
en: I, the Lord , am sending a wind to destroy the people of Babylonia and Babylon, its capital.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuna n-tiri nandaamba pina pam luɣilikam. O nirilim niŋbu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: As the scripture says, He gives generously to the needy; his kindness lasts forever.

dag: O vuui Izraɛlnim yaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni. O daa yih o nuu ka chɛ ba bɛ dimnim ninni. O ŋmanila buɣim niɛm din diri Yaakubu zuliya sunsuuni n-di n-gili luɣilikam.
en: In his fury he shattered the strength of Israel; He refused to help us when the enemy came. He raged against us like fire, destroying everything.

dag: Zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni.
en: Never forget these commands that I am giving you today.

dag: UFARISIN gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni pirigi a nam maa n-ti Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianima.
en: Uparsin : Your kingdom is being taken from you. It will be divided among the Medes and Persians.

dag: Pɛnuɛl daa nyɛla Gɛdɔr ba, ka Ɛzɛr mi daa nyɛ Husha ba. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Hur bidibisi: o bituuli n-daa nyɛ Ɛfirat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛmnim yabidoo la.
en: Penuel was Gedors father, and Ezer was Hushahs father. This was the family of Hur the oldest son of Ephrathah, Bethlehems father.

dag: di zaa yoli, a ni zaŋ ma bahi daɣiri ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ situra gba zaɣisi ma.
en: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.

dag: amaa pumpɔŋɔ ti gbarigimi, ka binshɛli kani n-naɣ pahila manna shɛli ti ni kul lihiri ŋɔ.
en: But now our strength is gone. There is nothing at all to eat—nothing but this manna day after day! .

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ni hal ni di tintariga Arinɔn Mɔɣili noli shee la zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok n-yi di yɔɣu maa ni m-mali hal ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: They took possession of all the Amorite territory from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the desert to the Jordan.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya niriba ayi o sani. Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija.
en: Then two men were there, talking with him. They were Moses and Elijah.

dag: Biŋgbamda zaa bɛn be tiŋgban ni gbamda nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira, di bi simdi ka yi di ba.
en: You must not eat any of the small animals that move on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa.
en: Then Pilate had Jesus taken and whipped.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa Jɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba Juda tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtishɛmɛshi la ni.
en: So King Jehoash of Israel met King Amaziah of Judah face to face at the town of Beth Shemesh in Judah.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Ziba, Nyama, Mɛfibɔshɛt ni daa su shɛlikam zaa leeg a dini pumpɔŋɔ. Ka Ziba garigi yɛli, N nyɛla ŋun luri n dan sizuura. Chɛ ka nyini n dan naa nini kul tiɣiri ma sahakam.
en: The king said to Ziba, Everything that belonged to Mephibosheth is yours. I am your servant, Ziba replied. May I always please Your Majesty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo di ni ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: The LORD said to the Adversary, Where have you come from? The Adversary answered the LORD, From wandering throughout the earth.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa kul o ba Yisahaku sani Mamri bee Kiriatariba luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Hiburɔn ka di nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni daa be shɛl la.
en: Jacob went to his father Isaac at Mamre in Kiriath Arba . This is where Abraham and Isaac had lived.

dag: Hɛzɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Abija, o daa nyɛla Zakaria bipuɣiŋga.
en: Hezekiah became king when he was years old. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Abijah. Abijah was Zechariahs daughter.

dag: M bilim ni n daa bela mmaŋmaŋ tindɔɣirili ni mini Jɛrusalɛm; ka di saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ Yɛhudianim zaa mi m bebu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: All the Jews have known me since I was a child. They know what kind of life I have lived in my own country and in Jerusalem. And if they were willing, they could tell you I was a Pharisee, a member of a group that is stricter than any other.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti me buɣili zali yimaŋa.
en: Dont make metal gods for yourself.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi zahim maa shɛm maa zuɣu ka di daa niŋ Saimɔn mini bɛnkam zaa be o sani maa alahiziba pam.
en: Peter and those with him were overcome with amazement because of the number of fish they caught.

dag: Hal bɛ yi du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti sɔɣi, n ni bo n-nya ba gbahi ba. Ka bɛ yi zomi kpe teeku ni nti sɔɣi di bulli ni, n ni chɛ ka teeku ni wahu dim ba.
en: If they hide on the top of Mount Carmel, I will search for them and catch them. If they hide from me at the bottom of the sea, I will command the sea monster to bite them.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Foliŋga, niŋmi kom ŋɔ sunsuuni m-pirigi kom maa buyi.
en: Then God commanded, Let there be a dome to divide the water and to keep it in two separate places—and it was done. So God made a dome, and it separated the water under it from the water above it.

dag: Dabisili din pah anu dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah awɛi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the fifth day offer nine young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Ka Pita daa dol o yi ka bi baŋ ni malaika maa ni niŋ o shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa tɛhi ni o zahimla zahindi.
en: Following the angel, Peter left the prison. However, he didnt realize the angel had actually done all this. He thought he was seeing a vision.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa bahi noli, ka bɛ daa vihi luɣ shɛŋa litaafinim ni daa be Babilɔn.
en: So Emperor Darius issued orders for a search to be made in the royal records that were kept in Babylon.

dag: Ka o daa yaag o noli m-mɔri Naawuni, ka galindi Naawuni yuli min o biɛhigu shee zaŋ tabili bɛnkam be alizanda ni.
en: It opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God. It blasphemed Gods name and his dwelling place .

dag: Amaa Dauda zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni daa ti Abijam firila Jɛrusalɛm n-chɛ ka o bia di nam zan o zaani gbib Jɛrusalɛm.
en: But for David's sake the Lord his God gave Abijah a son to rule after him in Jerusalem and to keep Jerusalem secure.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni n nuu zuɣu tuma ka n daa zaŋ dihi m mini n dolintaba, hal ka daa yɛli ba situra pahi.
en: You yourselves know that I have provided for my own needs and for those of my companions with my own hands.

dag: Ka ti paɣ li sahakam mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka puhir a pam.
en: All of us are always grateful for what you have done.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa galisiya pam. Dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda niŋbu mini yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni baŋsim ni nimmoo niŋbu shɛlikam ni ni yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ ti sani. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi gba ni niŋdi shɛm galisi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ni.
en: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.

dag: Bɛn kpalim mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ, pa ti Duuma n-yɛli dina: Yi ni so yi mali paɣa ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda ka paɣ maa yu ni o be o sani, ŋun miri ka o yih o.
en: The advice I have for the others is from me. The Lord did not give us any teaching about this. If you have a wife who is not a believer, you should not divorce her if she will continue to live with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya, dama Masia daa di wahala yi zuɣu, ka o niŋsim maa nyɛ di ni simdi ni yi zaa dol shɛli.
en: It was to this that God called you, for Christ himself suffered for you and left you an example, so that you would follow in his steps.

dag: A daa zaŋ wain tia Ijipti na nti kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ li sa.
en: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, n ni wuɣ a mukuru pa a ninni, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam nya a zaɣim, ka nanim nya a ni di vi shɛm.
en: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.

dag: Kom daa beni n-sɔŋ li. Ka tiŋgbani ziliŋ daa chɛ ka di zooi niŋ wɔɣilim, ka chɛ ka di mɔɣa kom daa zo n-tiɛli bɛ ni daa sa li luɣ shɛli maa, ka di kɔsoya kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa.
en: This tree had plenty of water to help it grow tall, and nearby streams watered the other trees in the forest.

dag: Yawɛ tiligir o daba nyɛviya; ka bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani so ku nya tibidarigibo.
en: The LORD saves his servants lives; all those who take refuge in him wont be held responsible for anything.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa yi kul chanimi nti be luɣ shɛli din miri napaɣiba yili maa dundɔŋ dabisili kam. O daa chanimi gindi ni o baŋ Ɛsta nimaani benibu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm ni din yɛn niŋ o.
en: Every day Mordecai walked back and forth near the area where the kings women lived. He did this because he wanted to find out how Esther was, and what was happening to her.

dag: Ka yuma din kpalim maa yi na galisi, ŋun yom o ni daa deei laɣ shɛli yuma maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ o ni yo laɣ shɛli ni o deeg omaŋa.
en: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti tum tuma dindali maa, n ni yihi dilan maa niriba sunsuuni.
en: Moreover, I will destroy from their people anyone who does any work on that day.

dag: Ka Naara daa dɔɣi Ahuzam mini Hɛfa ni Tɛmɛni ni Haahashitari; bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naara bidibisi.
en: He and Naarah had four sons: Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ziŋ maa ni o gbuɣimi Jona bahi, ka o daa zaŋ o ti gbuɣi bahi duli.
en: Then the Lord ordered the fish to spit Jonah up on the beach, and it did.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya n ni tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa alizanda ni na shɛm.
en: The Lord told Moses to say to the people of Israel: With your own eyes you saw me speak to you from heaven.

dag: Kul guhimiya Yawɛ, ka dol o soli, ka o duhi ya n-chɛ ka yi su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka yi nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɛn bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi daa nyɛla: Adda mini Gɛra ni Abihud.
en: Belas sons were Addar, Gera, Abihud, Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yaba n-nyɛ Ibrahimma. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi, yi naan tumdi kaman Ibrahimma ni daa tumdi shɛm.
en: The people said to Jesus, Abraham is our father! Jesus replied, If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛnkam mali Naawuni ni ti ba pina balibubalibu shɛŋa tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga zaŋdi li sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: God has shown you his grace in many different ways. So be good servants and use whatever gift he has given you in a way that will best serve each other.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Hal tumtumda chira anii yɔri ku tooi da bindirigu ka niriba ŋɔ zaa paai biɛlabiɛla gba di.
en: Philip replied, More than a half years salary worth of food wouldnt be enough for each person to have even a little bit.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nɔrila tandi, ka ŋmari bilichiisi, ka tumdi bɛ puri ni tuma zaa, ka lan muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma ni di chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋ ba tom.
en: that their lives were miserable. The Egyptians were cruel to the people of Israel and forced them to make bricks and to mix mortar and to work in the fields.

dag: Naawuni bi lihi ti ka ti be ti ko ka chɛ ba; dama bɛ gba yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: He made no distinction between us and them, but purified their deepest thoughts and desires through faith.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ni yino wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka yɛl o, Dindina ŋun ti yɛn ʒini Naawuni nam ni di bindirigu ni ti nya alibarika.
en: When one of the guests sitting at the table heard this, he said to Jesus, How happy are those who will sit down at the feast in the Kingdom of God.

dag: Shɛm bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram ni Uzi ni Hul ni Gɛta ni Mɛshɛk.
en: Shems sons were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. Arams sons were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla suhuyiɣisili dabisili; di ni ti nyɛla nandahima mini biɛrim dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla saɣiŋgu mini dabari zalibu dabisili, ka ni ti nyɛla zibisim mini bumbɔni dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla sagbana mini zibisim titali dabisili.
en: That day is a day of fury, a day of distress and anxiety, a day of desolation and devastation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and deep darkness.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi bi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ gbinni? Ka wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahi shɛŋa din kpalim la gbinni?.
en: Jesus then told them: If you don't understand this story, you won't understand any others.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N yi chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zaa chaŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ be yi sani? Zaɣ biɛɣu ka yi lo maa.
en: Pharaoh said to them, The Lord really will have to be with you before I let you and all of your children leave Egypt. Look, you are planning something evil.

dag: ka a bɔri ni a nya n taali, ka vihiri ni a baŋ n daalahichi.
en: Then why do you track down all my sins and hunt down every fault I have?.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali buŋa bee nahu ka o ti lu biliga ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku chaŋ ti yaag o yomyom.
en: He said to them, Suppose your child or ox fell into a ditch on the Sabbath day. Wouldnt you immediately pull it out.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mali o ni su binshɛlikam maa zaa yiko, amaa lee miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shih o. Di saha ka Sintani daa yi Yawɛ sani chaŋ.
en: The Lord replied, All right, Satan, do what you want with anything that belongs to him, but don't harm Job. Then Satan left.

dag: Alahichi nyɛla din tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa bɛ suhuri puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ suhuri ni.
en: Sin speaks to the wicked deep in their hearts; they reject God and do not have reverence for him.

dag: Dama biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni n kum nyaaŋa, yi ni tum tuumbiɛri, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zali ya ni yi doli so shɛli ŋɔ, di nyaaŋa zaɣ biɛɣu ni ti lu yi zuɣu, dama yi ni ti tum zaɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ ninni, ka chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam yi nuhi tuma zuɣu.
en: I know that after my death the people will become wicked and reject what I have taught them. And in time to come they will meet with disaster, because they will have made the Lord angry by doing what he has forbidden.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ma paai nimaani, do so daa be nimaani ka o niŋgbuŋ daa nyɛlisira kaman daanya la. O daa gbibila mi piɛlli mini bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli buɣisiri binyara la o nuu ni. O daa ʒiɛla dunɔdali gbini.
en: In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other.

dag: Bom tulaale viɛla, mɛɛr kom din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mini tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla ka bɛ booni li sinnamɔn la kilɔgiram ata ni kaɣa tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla kilɔgiram ata.
en: Find the finest spices. Get pounds of liquid myrrh, half that amount of sweet-smelling cinnamon, and pounds of sweet-smelling cane.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban nɛli ni ni ti kana ti damd o tooni, ka o dimnim mi ti kana ti lu o tooni ka bɛ noya vaai taŋkpaɣu.
en: Let the desert dwellers bow low before him; let his enemies lick the dust.

dag: Di pala ninkura kɔŋko m-mali yɛm bee bɛn gbaai kpamli kɔŋko m-mi din tuhi.
en: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba min o biɛyanim maa ʒili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmaai tiŋgban viɛlli Ramɛsis tiŋgban ni ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: Joseph did what Pharaoh said and gave his father and brothers land in Egypt. It was the best land in Egypt, in the eastern part of the country, around Rameses.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tim ma nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka niŋ n dan Ibrahimma nirilim maŋli.
en: The servant prayed: You, Lord , are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.

dag: Yawɛ, a nudirigu mali yiko ni jilima. Yawɛ, a nudirigu ka a zaŋ dari tɔh a dim bahi.
en: Your right hand, Lord , is awesome in power; it breaks the enemy in pieces.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-nyɛ yɛndana ni baŋda? Di simdi ni o zaŋ o biɛrisuntali n-wuh o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm tarimtali yɛm puuni.
en: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dauda daa tuui zaŋ wumpaɣibo yilli ŋɔ ti Asaf min o mabihi maa ni bɛ yili paɣi Yawɛ.
en: That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord :.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya sahakam. Ka o suhu ni tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But his plans endure forever; his purposes last eternally.

dag: Ka pukpar kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, N dana, chɛl li zali yuuni ŋɔ pahi, ka n gbi bɔɣili gil li n-niŋ kulim niŋ li.
en: But the servant answered, Master, let the tree have one more year to produce fruit. Let me dig up the dirt around it and fertilize it.

dag: Lala ka o daa me buɣa jɛmbu shee ti o tinzun paɣiba la zaa, ka bɛ daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani bɛ buɣa maa, ka tuɣindi li tulaale zim.
en: He also built places of worship where all his foreign wives could burn incense and offer sacrifices to their own gods.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Naawuni ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la?.
en: Surely you have read what God said to you about people rising from death.

dag: ni bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni ninvuɣ biɛtali ni yɔhiŋ ni biɛr yoli ni nyuli zabbu ni nyaanzubo ni karimbaani ni jɛrilim.
en: unfaithfulness in marriage, greed, meanness, deceit, indecency, envy, insults, pride, and foolishness.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Ijipti Firawuna Nɛko daa yi n-chani Asiria naa sani Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka Naa Jɔsia daa chaŋ ti lir o sol ni, amaa ka Firawuna Nɛko daa nya o Mɛgido n-ku o.
en: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Neco, the king of Egypt, went to fight against the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River. Josiah went out to meet Neco at Megiddo. Pharaoh saw Josiah and killed him.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛli shɛm maa bi wuhirila chɛfirinim bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma ka nyɛ kɔrɛnim mini ninvuɣ fariba ni buɣijɛmdiba la; di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi naɣ ni yila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But I wasnt talking about the sexually immoral people in the outside world by any means—or the greedy, or the swindlers, or people who worship false gods—otherwise, you would have to leave the world entirely!.

dag: Ka lala ni chɛ ka ti lir o o ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-lu o zuɣu kaman maligim ni luri tiŋgbani zuɣu shɛm la, ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa so ku tiligi.
en: We will find David wherever he is, and attack him before he knows what's happening. Neither he nor any of his men will survive.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni yɛl shɛli din gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu be kpe.
en: I tell you that there is something here greater than the Temple.

dag: Zaŋm li lo n-niŋ a suhu ni sahakam, ka zaŋ li lo a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Keep their words with you always, locked in your heart.

dag: A jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka nanim ʒiri pina na ti tir a.
en: Kings will bring their wealth to you, to your Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: buɣim dibu la buɣim dibu, daŋ la daŋa, fiɛb bɔba la fiɛb bɔba la n-darigi dilan tibili.
en: burn for burn, cut for cut, and bruise for bruise.

dag: Bɛ daa zanila bɛ zaashɛhi kaman Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la. Lɛvinim n-daa yi taɣiri biŋkɔbiri ʒim n-zaŋna ti ti maligumaaniba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋdi li mihira.
en: They now took their places as laid out in the Instruction from Moses the man of God, and the priests splashed the blood they received from the Levites against the altar.

dag: Gbuɣim pola mi n-ti kɔŋ bindirigu dira, ka kum mali ba; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn kul ku kɔŋ binsuma.
en: Even strong lions get weak and hungry, but those who go to the Lord for help will have every good thing.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli Pita, Labisim takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni! Ka bɔh o, N di nyu pipi shɛli m Ba ni zaŋ ti ma la ni binnyurigu maa.
en: Jesus told Peter, Put your sword away. I must drink from the cup that the Father has given me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti bo ʒiɛvari na nti nya mɔɣu ni yɔɣili m-pɔhi li buɣi na nti ŋmahiŋmahi li niŋ ʒɛduɣu maa ni, ka bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: So one of them went out to the field to gather plants; he found a wild vine and gathered wild gourds from it, filling his garment. He came and cut them up into the pot of stew, but no one knew what they were.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bindirigu pam be di ni. N ni ti ti di nandaamba bindirigu.
en: I will bless this city with plenty of food. Even the poor will have enough to eat.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura nyari alibarika.
en: Thats how it goes for anyone who honors the LORD: they will be blessed!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna. Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Restore us, LORD God of heavenly forces! Make your face shine so that we can be saved!.

dag: din yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni la: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn ni di chɛ ka niriba tuui li; di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Amaa ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: that the scripture speaks of: Look, I place in Zion a stone that will make people stumble, a rock that will make them fall. But whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din be tibi; ka nyɛ din tiri nyɛvili. Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din mali naani niŋbu, ka lan nyɛ din tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi shɛli baŋsim.
en: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni, ka be kasi ŋɔ, a pala ŋun daa pun be kurimbuni ha? Ti ku kpi. Yawɛ, nyini n-zali ba ni bɛ kari saria; nyini ŋun nyɛ ti tampiŋ ŋɔ n-zali ba ni bɛ darigiri niriba tibili.
en: LORD, arent you ancient, my God, my holy one? Dont let us die. LORD, you put the Chaldean here for judgment. Rock, you established him as a rebuke.

dag: M mabiyurisi, zaŋmiya yi daadiini wuhibu din be kasi la kpaŋsiri yimaŋa, ka kul suhimiya Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: But you, dear friends, use your most holy faith to build yourselves up even stronger. Pray with the help of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ n daalahichi, ka kpihim n tuumbiɛri zaa.
en: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.

dag: dindina n ni pa n nina lihiri doo maa min o yiŋnima, ka ku o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol o jɛmdi Molɛk maa.
en: I myself will turn against you and your whole family and against all who join you in being unfaithful to me and worshiping Molech. I will no longer consider any of you my people.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa daa bɔri ni bɛ ka Sulemaana sanna nti wum Naawuni ni ti o yɛm shɛli maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: People everywhere wanted to see King Solomon and listen to the great wisdom that God had given him.

dag: Jɛra maanila alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ansarisi, amaa Naawuni niŋdi wuntizɔriba nirilim.
en: Foolish people don't care if they sin, but good people want to be forgiven.

dag: Ka din pahi piniyini daa gbaai Azarɛl min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Eleventh, there were men chosen from Azarels sons and relatives.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ kɔba mini jila tuɣituɣi ma, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini gbaŋ pili ma.
en: You formed my body with bones and sinews and covered the bones with muscles and skin.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa daa zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din daa be di ni maa ti Ibrahimma, ka di leeg o dini, ka o zaŋ li leeg o kpiimba sɔɣibu shee.
en: he had bought from the Hittites.

dag: N tir a zaligunim din nyɛ n ni yuri shɛli maa jilima; n kul ni bɔhindi li.
en: I will lift up my hands to your commandments because I love them, and I will contemplate all your statutes.

dag: Gbaridɔɣirili so daa be Listra. Bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dahin shɛli hal ti paag o ninkurilim ni o daa na ʒi n-yiɣisi zani chaŋ.
en: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛl o maa, A shiri nya o? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a di bi chɛ o sua luhi tiŋ na nimaani? N suhu naan paligi ka n ti a anzinfa laɣibaligu pia mini gbaŋ din lɔr sheeni.
en: Joab said, You saw Absalom? Why didn't you kill him? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a special belt.

dag: A yi bi fa bɛ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ so chani ni bɛ ti ku m-bahi, ka o chani ŋun yɛn ku o sani ka o naba sɔhira.
en: Don't hesitate to rescue someone who is about to be executed unjustly.

dag: O chɛ ka suhudoo be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka zaŋ alikama viɛlli dihiri ya.
en: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋmahindi binneen so ŋun gbamdi tiŋgbani zuɣu bee ŋ-ŋmahindi zahim bɛn be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni ŋɔ.
en: an insect that crawls on the earth, or a fish that lives in the sea.

dag: N daa bi bɔhim yɛm bee m-mi ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni nyɛ so.
en: I have not learned to be wise. I know nothing about the Holy One.

dag: Ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihiri ba, ka tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛn ti o la shɛli.
en: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.

dag: N nya ka Kushan suɣa be muɣisigu ni, ka nya ka Midian tiŋgbɔŋ suɣa pateesanim sɔhira.
en: I saw the people of Cushan afraid and the people of Midian tremble.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa chɛ ka Yaakubu kuli Mɛsopoteemia Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir bia, ka nyɛ Yaakubu mini Iso ma Ribɛka tizɔdoo la sani.
en: Isaac then sent Jacob to stay with Rebekah's brother Laban, the son of Bethuel the Aramean.

dag: Dama Ifriimnim mali maligu bimbina pam pahi ni bɛ tumdi alahichi. Ka di leei alahichi tumbu maligu bimbina bɛ sani.
en: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.

dag: nti zaŋ a kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o; ka zaŋ a yiko niŋ o nuu ni, ka o leei Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ba.
en: I will take your robe and put it on him. I will give him your scepter. I will give him the important job you have, and he will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and Judahs family.

dag: N dabiɛm zɔbu puuni, n daa yɛliya ni so ku tooi niŋ so naani.
en: though in my confusion I said, I can't trust anyone.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa niŋla Bɛtani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn ni daa baptaiziri niriba kom ni la.
en: These things all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan River. This is where John was baptizing people.

dag: Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ gahinda, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi n sani. Miriya ka yi ŋubi mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku binshɛli, di simdi ni yi zaŋ li tila bahi.
en: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.

dag: N kul ku tam a zaligunim maa yɛla; dama di zuɣu ka a ti ma nyɛvili.
en: I will never forget your commands, because through them you gave me new life.

dag: Bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa ni daa su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi la n-daa daŋ tooni. Ka Bɛnhadad daa tim o naazɔnim ni bɛ yina ti nya, ka bɛ daa yina ti nya ka lab ti yɛl o, Niriba n-yi Samaria kanna.
en: The servants of the district officials were at the head of the march. Ben-hadad sent for information and was told, Some men have marched out of Samaria.

dag: Yi yi ti kuli yiŋ na, noli ni din ya, ka yi yi ti yi samban ni, noli ni din ya.
en: The Lord will curse everything you do.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu soli wuhiri ya ni doo yi mali zab wɔɣila di nyɛla vi.
en: Even nature itself teaches you that wearing long hair is shameful for a man.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: the descendants of Elam:.

dag: Kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni fɔntin shɛŋa din baɣi li ni daa wurim shɛm la, lala ka di gba ni wurim; ka so ti ku lan be nimaani, ka so mi ti ku lan ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The same thing will happen to Edom that happened to Sodom and Gomorrah, when they and the nearby towns were destroyed. No one will ever live there again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama bɛ ma daa gɔrila pagɔrisigu; paɣ so ŋun daa tiɣi bɛ pua daa tumla vi tuma. Dama o daa yɛliya, N ni chaŋ m mamanim bɛn tiri ma bindirigu mini kom ni ago ni atampanima ni kpam ni dam ŋɔ sani.
en: Their mother has played the prostitute; she who conceived them has behaved shamefully. She said, I will seek out my lovers; they give me my bread and my water, my wool and my linen cloth, my oil and my drink.

dag: Chɛ ka m be din ni chɛ ka m paɣir a, ka chɛ ka a zaligunim sɔŋ ma.
en: Let me live again so I can praise you! Let your rules help me!.

dag: ka daa tim o yiŋbihi ni bɛ ti yɛli o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na; amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi kandina.
en: He sent his servants to tell the invited guests to come to the feast, but they did not want to come.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli tiŋgban kuŋ maa Tiŋgbani, ka boli kom din laɣim do luɣ yini maa mi Teeku. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: He named the land Earth, and the water which had come together he named Sea. And God was pleased with what he saw.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira pam paai ma, ka m mini kum bi lan wɔɣ ni taba.
en: because my whole being is filled with distress; my life is at the very brink of hell.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa ŋɔ sa niŋ bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ biɛɣuni yaha; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ sa zaŋ Haman bidibisi pia la ti yili dari.
en: Esther answered, Your Majesty, please let the Jews in Susa fight to defend themselves tomorrow, just as they did today. And order the bodies of Haman's ten sons to be hanged in public.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛli ka di kul zaɣizaɣimi to n-yina pahi di zuɣu.
en: And then seven more heads of grain grew after them, but they were thin and scorched by the hot wind.

dag: Bɛ yihi suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim Mɔab tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niŋdi bindira pam la ni. N chɛ ka wain tɔɣibu ŋmaai wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ni. So bi lan tɔɣiri wain ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni yɔri vu shɛli maa pala suhupiɛlli vuri.
en: Joy and gladness have been taken from the orchards and farms of Moab. I have stopped making wine in the presses. No one shouts with joy while treading the grapes. Though there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy!.

dag: Bɛn mali ba bemi kaman bɛ ni be shɛm. Lala n-nyɛ bɛnkam zaa niŋ wuna maa naani.
en: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee maa ni ni o ti yo alahichi samli, di bi simdi ka so kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni hal ka o ti yo omaŋmaŋ min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli ni Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi samli, ka naanyi yina.
en: No one must be in the Meeting Tent when Aaron goes in to purify the Most Holy Place. No one is to go in there until Aaron comes out after purifying himself, his family, and all the Israelites.

dag: Ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni Wulimpuhili polo nim la zaa daa laɣim do vinvamli maa ni, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Bɛ laakumnim daa ka kalinli; bɛ galisim daa ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu.
en: The Midianites, the Amalekites, and all the other people from the east were camped in that valley. There were so many people that they seemed like a swarm of locusts. It seemed like they had as many camels as there are grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: A ti ba pam, ka chɛ ka vuhirigu kam di n-tiɣi.
en: opening your hand and satisfying the desire of every living thing.

dag: Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ tim ninsal kam laara o wuntitali min o ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka man lee bi saɣi teegi n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi nyin ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord put you in my power today, but you are his chosen king and I wouldn't harm you. The Lord rewards people who are faithful and live right.

dag: Lɛvinim maa shɛb talahi tuma daa nyɛla bɛ su tah shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni kalibu fukumsi. Bɛ daa yi yɛn zaŋ li yi ni bɛ daa yi ti zaŋ li labisina.
en: Some of them were responsible for the worship objects; they counted them when they were brought in and taken out.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yi, bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma ka bɛ kpi n-doya, ka zunzuya bɛn yɛn di ba bi kpira; ka buɣim din yɛn di ba gba bi kpira. Ka bɛ dooshee maa ni mali dabiɛm pam sokam zaa sani.
en: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.

dag: Banima n-lee zɔri yomyom kaman sagbana ŋɔ bee n-zɔri yomyom kaman ŋmani n-yiɣiri chani ni o ti kpe o tiɛɣu ni ŋɔ?.
en: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?.

dag: Ifriimnim taɣirila pɔhim chana, ka zɔri doli wulimpuhili polo pɔhim dabisili kam. Bɛ ʒiri mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili kul pahirimi. Ka bɛ mini Asirianim niŋdi daabiligu, ka bɛ tiri Ijiptinim kpam.
en: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt.

dag: Ka Pita daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi; ka o gban tiŋ suhi Naawuni, ka naanyi ŋmaligi kpim maa polo yɛl o, Tabita, yiɣisima! Ka o neeg o nina nya Pita, ka dii yiɣisi ʒini.
en: Peter sent everyone out of the room, then knelt and prayed. He turned to the body and said, Tabitha, get up! She opened her eyes, saw Peter, and sat up.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka niriba daa tahi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu zaa Yisa sanna.
en: That evening, at sunset, people brought to Jesus those who were sick or demon-possessed.

dag: Anabi Ilaisha saha la kɔnsi pam daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa bɛ so daa bi nya tibbu; Siria do so ŋun yuli daa booni Neeman la kɔŋko n-daa nya tibbu.
en: There were also many persons with skin diseases in Israel during the time of the prophet Elisha, but none of them were cleansed. Instead, Naaman the Syrian was cleansed.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛl a, amaa m bi bɔri ni n zaŋ alikalimi mini tadabo -sab li ti a.
en: I have so much to tell you, but I do not want to do it with pen and ink.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa yi ti be o naba ni, di saha Naawuni Bia maa maŋmaŋ gba ni ti zaŋ omaŋ ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun zaŋ binshɛɣukam sɔŋ o naba ni maa, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni su binshɛɣukam zaa, ka nyɛ binshɛɣukam sokam zaa sani.
en: But when all things have been brought under his control, then the Son himself will also be under the control of the one who gave him control over everything so that God may be all in all.

dag: O mi o tuma ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuh o.
en: They know how to do their work, because God has taught them.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm min o ni daa me o yil shɛli maa.
en: The queen of Sheba heard Solomon's wisdom and saw the palace he had built.

dag: Amaa ti yi bɔri ni bɛ be ti sani ka ti mini ba nyɛ ninvuɣ yinsi, faashee ka ti dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: But these men will agree to live among us and be one people with us only on the condition that we circumcise all our males, as they are circumcised.

dag: amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni daba ata dali ka chɛ ka o yi palo.
en: but God raised him up on the third day and allowed him to be seen.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka paɣ maa daa nya ka o bia maa viɛli pam, ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣiri hal ni chira ata.
en: and she bore him a son. When she saw what a fine baby he was, she hid him for three months.

dag: N dana, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, n zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din be di ni maa zaa ti a n niriba ŋɔ ninni ni a sɔɣ a kpim maa nimaani.
en: No, sir. Here in front of my people, I give you that land and the cave on it so that you can bury your wife.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ni Gomna Fɛstus ni bɛn zaa daa ʒi bɛ sani yiɣisi yi.
en: The king stood up, as did the governor, Bernice, and those sitting with them.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ tulaale zim tuɣindi laa m-mooi buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni m-pal li, ka niŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla nukurigu pali buyi ŋ-ŋmiri li biɛlabiɛla n-zaŋ li kpe pateesa maa puuni.
en: Then he will take an incense pan full of burning coals from the altar, from before the LORD, and two handfuls of finely ground perfumed incense and bring them inside the inner curtain.

dag: amaa gol muni zaa hal ka di ti yiri yi nyɛhi ni, ka nyɔni yi nyee, dama yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun be yi sani ŋɔ ka kumdi niŋd o yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka ti daa lee yi Ijipti na? .
en: but for a whole month until it comes out of your nostrils and nauseates you. Youve rejected the LORD whos been with you and you have cried before him, saying, Why did we leave Egypt? .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka yi kanna ti zaani n tooni du shɛli din nyɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛra, Ti tiligiya. Ka lan yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi din chihirinim ŋɔ yaha.
en: You do these things I hate, and then you come and stand in my presence, in my own Temple, and say, We are safe.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrubaal mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa daa daŋ yibu chaŋ ti dɔni baɣili Harɔd kulibɔŋ. Ka Midiannim mi daa do vinvamli ni zaŋ lab nuzaa polo miri Mɔre daboli.
en: Early in the morning Jerub-Baal and all his men set up their camp at the spring of Harod. The Midianites were camped in the valley at the bottom of the hill called Moreh, north of Gideon and his men.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jɛfita zuɣu na. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti tim Giliad mini Manaasa tiŋgbana ni n-gari chaŋ Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni la n-daa yi Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni maa gari chaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgban ni.
en: Then the spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah. He went through Gilead and Manasseh and returned to Mizpah in Gilead and went on to Ammon.

dag: Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o.
en: Listen, he told them, we are going up to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law. They will condemn him to death.

dag: Bin viɛla kul palila yɛndan yiŋa, amaa jɛrigu ŋun dirila di zaa.
en: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.

dag: Yi daazichi pooya, ka lɛla ŋubi saɣim yi situra.
en: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ je suli ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale maa lala?.
en: Now when the disciples saw it they were angry and said, Why this waste?.

dag: Ka di buɣisibu chɛriga ni ti yi nyaaŋa chaŋ katiŋa n-tuhi hal ni Garɛb daboli gbini, di nyaaŋa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ Gɔa.
en: The measuring line will stretch from the Corner Gate straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn to the place named Goah.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la. O ni daa yɛli ba shɛm ka niŋ alibarika shɛŋa din simdi bɛ zaa yinoyino niŋ bɛ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said as he spoke a suitable word of farewell to each son.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛb ni. Ifriimnim nyɛla bɛn dɔni yaɣ yini tabili, ka bɛ lɛbigi.
en: Ephraim mixes himself among the people; Ephraim is like flatbread that is cooked on only one side.

dag: O wuhi kpiɔŋ, ka wurim karimbaannima bɛ suhuri ni tɛhi biɛri zuɣu.
en: He has stretched out his mighty arm and scattered the proud with all their plans.

dag: Bɛ ni lan me du shɛŋa din daa lu la zali. Binshɛɣukam din daa saɣim ka di yuui la zaa, bɛ ni lan mal li zali di zaashee.
en: They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore formerly deserted places; they will renew ruined cities, places deserted in generations past.

dag: Bɛ daa sɔɣila Abinɛr Hiburɔn, ka naa daa yaag o noli kum pam Abinɛr gballi maa gbini, ka niriba maa zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: Abner was buried at Hebron, and the king wept aloud at the grave, and so did all the people.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi garig o bɔhigu maa; ka dindali maa zaŋ chana, so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: None of the Pharisees could answer Jesus question. And after that day, no one was brave enough to ask him any more questions.

dag: Ka o dii siɣina ti puh o, ka deeg o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Zacchaeus hurried down and gladly welcomed Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ yi di daa bi pun baŋ wuntia soli yɛla, di naan so n-gari bɛ baŋ li ka lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni zaligu kasi shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: Yes, it would be better for them to have never known the right way. That would be better than to know the right way and then to turn away from the holy teaching that was given to them.

dag: N ni yɛn niŋ kpe ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kpe ŋɔ shɛm m-bala. N ni niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ka di be kaman Tɔfɛt la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I promise that I will make this city and its inhabitants like Topheth.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka dansarika gula maa daa tom ba kpɛhi duu din be puuni ha ni nti ba ba bandi ʒili.
en: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.

dag: Yi daa bɔrigimi kaman piɛr la, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa ŋmaligi labila yi Piɛgula ŋun nyɛ ŋun gbibi ya la sanna.
en: You were like sheep that had lost their way, but now you have been brought back to follow the Shepherd and Keeper of your souls.

dag: Bɛ zaa kala damli dambu na. Ka bɛ nina kul lihiri tooni; ka laɣisiri daba kaman taŋkpaɣu la.
en: Their armies advance in violent conquest, and everyone is terrified as they approach. Their captives are as numerous as grains of sand.

dag: O dolila wuntia soli kariti dunianim saria; o bi gaŋdi so o saria karibu ni.
en: He judges everyone on earth fairly. He judges all nations honestly.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, yi yi ni labi n sanna, yi yi chɛ din chihira n sani maa tumbu, ka chɛnya ʒiɛhi gili.
en: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.

dag: Ka o daa lan guhi daba ayopɔin pahi, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi n-chaŋ yaha, dindina, ka ŋmani maa daa bi lan labina.
en: He waited seven more days and sent out the dove, but it didnt come back to him again.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm ŋɔ; fom ka n yɛl a.
en: Job, pay attention and listen to me. Be quiet and let me talk.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni tia maa gbini gbihi. Ka malaika daa shih o ka yɛl o, Yiɣisim di bindirigu.
en: Then Elijah lay down under the bush and went to sleep. An angel came to him and touched him. The angel said, Get up and eat.

dag: Daadam, kummi ka fabili, dama di nyɛla din yɛn lu n niriba zuɣu, di nyɛla din yɛn lu Izraɛl nanim zaa zuɣu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini n niriba. Mbaye! Kpahimiya yi gbalipina.
en: Son of man, shout out and scream because the sword will be used against my people and all the rulers of Israel. They wanted war—so they will be with my people when the sword comes. So slap your thigh to show your sadness.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani ŋɔ, maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni.
en: All who trust the Lord , be cheerful and strong.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Abraham lived to the age of .

dag: Ka naa maa ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu n-saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni bɛn ni ti zani dɛde, ka chɛ ka bɛ min o tuhi.
en: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔriti ŋmana ni.
en: You will have plenty of bread to eat.

dag: M bi sabila yɛtɔɣa pihita ti a ni di ti a saɣisigu mini baŋsim.
en: Havent I written for you thirty sayings full of advice and knowledge?.

dag: Dama Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Moses said, You must respect your father and mother. He also said, Whoever says anything bad to their father or mother must be killed.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ya mi tahiri tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali kulibɔna din kom zɔri mini kɔbil nina ni tiŋgbani puuni kom din puhiri yiri vinvama ni mini daboya ni na;.
en: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land—a land with rivers and pools of water. Water flows out of the ground in the valleys and hills.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋmanila kundun biɛɣu. O gbahiri binyara asiba ni zaawuni ŋubira.
en: Benjamin, you are a fierce wolf, destroying your enemies morning and evening.

dag: Ka lan chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ Masia yurilim maa, hal di ni nyɛ nir ni ku tooi baŋ shɛli zaa la, ka di chɛ ka binshɛɣukam din pali Naawuni ni la pali yi gba ni.
en: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi daa pala ninvuɣ maŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nyɛla Naawuni niriba; ka saha shɛli ha yi daa bi nya Naawuni nambɔzɔbo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nya nambɔzɔbo o sani.
en: Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma chɛri fali zaani bɛ yaansi, amaa alahichinim buni nyɛla wuntizɔriba ni ti yɛn su shɛli.
en: Good people will have wealth to leave to their grandchildren, but the wealth of sinners will go to the righteous.

dag: N niriba, zomiya yi di ni. Tiligimiya yi nyɛviya Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ ni.
en: People of Israel, run away from there! Run for your life from my fierce anger.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa dol o zaligunim maa be o ni, ka o mi be bɛ ni. O ni zaŋ o Shi so ti ti la n-chɛ ka ti baŋ ni o be ti ni.
en: Those who obey God's commands live in union with God and God lives in union with them. And because of the Spirit that God has given us we know that God lives in union with us.

dag: N nyaya ka Ifriimnim bidibisi simdi ni binyara ŋub ba. Di simdi ni Ifriimnim zaŋ bɛ bidibisi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ku ba.
en: I can see that Ephraim is leading his children into a trap. Ephraim will lead his children out to the killer.

dag: Yuun pisi ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min o nam yil la.
en: It took years for King Solomon to build the Lord s Temple and the kings palace.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa pahi buyi yɛli.
en: Then the message from the Lord came to me a second time.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛra zaani zaashe kara ni, ka zaŋdi bundaannim zaani tarimba zaashee.
en: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani. Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces is with us! The God of Jacob is our place of safety. Selah.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa ti tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ka ti ku kpi; dama ti bo naa ti timaŋa n-lan tum alahichi pahi ti ni pun tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: and they said to Samuel, Please, sir, pray to the Lord your God for us, so that we won't die. We now realize that, besides all our other sins, we have sinned by asking for a king.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba maa mini Izraɛlnim zaa baŋ dindali maa ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr kubu maa pala naa suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: All of David's people and all the people in Israel understood that the king had no part in the murder of Abner.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ mali karimbaani pam. Ti lan wum bɛ duhimaŋtali mini bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ barinyubo ni bɛ nyarimaŋtali yɛla.
en: We have heard about Moabs pride. He was very proud. He thought he was important. He was always bragging. He was very, very proud.

dag: Izraɛl daa yuri Yisifu pam gar o bihi bɛn kpalim maa zaa, o ni daa nyɛ o ni dɔɣi bi so o kuriginsim saha la zuɣu. O daa shɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din baɣiri wɔɣa n-ti o.
en: Jacob loved Joseph more than he did any of his other sons, because Joseph was born when Jacob was very old. Jacob had even given Joseph a fancy coat.

dag: Di saha ka Ahimɛlɛk daa garigi yɛli, Naa, a sapashin kpamba ŋɔ ni ŋuni n-lee ʒe a yim kaman Dauda ŋun nyɛ nyin naa deemba, ka lan nyɛ a tɔbbi shɛb bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛma ni ŋun mali jilima a yili ŋɔ n-gari sokam la?.
en: Ahimelech answered the king, Out of all your servants, who is as trustworthy as David? He is the kings son-in-law, does whatever you ask, and is well respected in your house.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa kpe di puuni nti bi nya ti Duuma Yisa niŋgbuŋ;.
en: but when they went in, they didnt find the body of the Lord Jesus.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, N ni gbaai mmaŋ zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm polo din ni chɛ ka n zilinli ku tum alahichi. N ni gbib n noli saha shɛlikam ninvuɣ biɛri yi ti be n sani.
en: I promised I would watch my steps so as not to sin with my tongue; promised to keep my mouth shut as long as the wicked were in my presence.

dag: Di saha ka yɔɣ ni tihi zaa ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni; dama o kamina ni o ti kari dunia saria.
en: The trees of the forest will sing for joy when they see the Lord , because he is coming to rule the world.

dag: A chɛ ka n fabila leei waa. A piligi buɣu n zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: You have changed my sorrow into dancing. You have taken away my sackcloth and clothed me with joy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Anabi Neetan be kpe. Ka Neetan daa kpe naa sani nti damd o tooni n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa;.
en: The king was informed, The prophet Nathan is here. Then Nathan came in before the king and bowed his face to the ground.

dag: N ŋmaligi pola mmaŋa, n yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli; di bi taɣira. Sokam ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni ʒe ma yim.
en: My promise is true, and it will not be changed. I solemnly promise by all that I am: Everyone will come and kneel before me and vow to be loyal to me.

dag: Bia ŋɔ ka n daa suhi maa, ka Yawɛ daa deei n suhigu ka shiri ti ma n ni daa suh o bɔri shɛli maa.
en: I prayed for this boy, and the LORD gave me what I asked from him.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ o sani nti fiɣisi Pool, ka balim o.
en: The chief priests and Jewish leaders presented their case against Paul. Appealing to him.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Hal tumtumda chira anii yɔri ku tooi da bindirigu ka niriba ŋɔ zaa paai biɛlabiɛla gba di.
en: Philip answered, Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun doli anyinsi soli biri shɛli ni ti kpuɣila mbusim, ka o suhuyiɣisili mi ku ti o nasara.
en: If you plant the seeds of injustice, disaster will spring up, and your oppression of others will end.

dag: Ka Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma.
en: But sir, the man replied, the property is worth only pieces of silver. Why should we haggle over such a small amount? Take the land. It's yours.

dag: Amaa o daa dolila Izraɛl nanim biɛhigu. Hal o daa zaŋla kuriti m-mali Baal binnana zali.
en: Instead, he walked in the ways of Israels kings, making images of the Baals.

dag: Ka yi mi ti lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Ka yi yi yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, o suhu sa ni yiɣisi bahi tinim Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu biɛɣuni.
en: Today you are turning away from following the LORD. If you rebel against the LORD today, he will be angry with the entire community of Israel tomorrow.

dag: Ka Dauda niriba maa daa ti nya Ijipti nachimbil so mɔɣu maa ni n-zaŋ o ka Dauda sanna nti ti o bɔrɔbɔro ka o ŋubi, ka ti o kom ka o nyu.
en: They found an Egyptian in the countryside and brought him to David. They gave him bread, and he ate, and they gave him water to drink.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn timmi boli kulipalinim pam na ka bɛ ti gbahi ba. Di nyaaŋa ka n lan tim boli tɔhinim pam na, ka bɛ ti bo bɛ shee zoli kam mini daboli kam zuɣu, ka yihi ba tampima voya ni na.
en: The Lord says, I am sending for many fishermen to come and catch these people. Then I will send for many hunters to hunt them down on every mountain and hill and in the caves among the rocks.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa puri zaa n-ti Firawuna; dama Ijiptinim zaa daa zaŋla bɛ puri kɔhi, kum maa ni daa mii ba pam maa zuɣu. Ka puri maa daa leei Firawuna dini.
en: So Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh. All the people in Egypt sold Joseph their fields. They did this because they were very hungry.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul yɛri lala maa, ka sagbani dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam bɛ ni kpe sagbani maa ni maa zuɣu.
en: Peter was still speaking when a cloud overshadowed them. As they entered the cloud, they were overcome with awe.

dag: Amaa yinima nina mal alibarika, dama di nyara; ka yi tiba gba mal alibarika, dama di wumda.
en: But God has blessed you, because your eyes can see and your ears can hear!.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa sabi yɛli pahi: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ti su bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yila Jɛsi zuliya ni na. O ni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tahima ni ti be.
en: And again, Isaiah says, A descendant of Jesse will appear; he will come to rule the Gentiles, and they will put their hope in him.

dag: ka di chɛ ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin shɛŋa din be yi tooni la ha, ka di chɛ ka ti ku nyu bara ninvuɣ shɛb ni pun tum shɛm luɣ shɛŋa polo la zuɣu.
en: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun wumdi bɛn be sarika ni ŋuhibu, ka fari bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la bahira.
en: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni na.
en: Command the priests carrying the Box that holds the Agreement to come out of the river.

dag: N suhir a, deemi n ni zaŋ pin shɛl na ti ti a maa, dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma nirilim ti ma n ni mali shɛlikam maa, ka m mi mali pam. Lala ka Yaakubu daa balim o hal ka o ti dee li.
en: Take this present that Ive brought because God has been generous to me, and I have everything I need. So Jacob persuaded him, and he took it.

dag: Di saha ka Reehab daa zaŋ mii tir o yiŋ maa takɔro ni n-chɛ ka tuumba maa dol li yi tiŋ maa ni, dama o yiŋ maa daa me n-tabilila tiŋ maa gooni.
en: So she lowered the spies on a rope through the window. Her house was on the outer side of the city wall, and she lived inside the wall.

dag: Zaŋm taaŋkɔro paɣi ma ka n yi daɣiri ni, ka paligi laɣilaɣi gari gumbɔrigu.
en: Remove my sin and make me pure. Wash me until I am whiter than snow!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛn mi, amaa ka zaɣisi ni bɛ saɣi ni tum dunia piligu ni ha, Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛtɔɣa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ. Kom ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka di yi kom ni na.
en: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.

dag: Nir yi yiini yila niŋdi ŋun mali suhugarigu, di ŋmanila bɛ ni niŋ bilisitom pa yum ni la. Kaman binneembila ni be situra ni bee nɔyɛla ni be dari ni shɛm, lala ka suhugarigu dimdi daadam suhu ni.
en: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanim na ʒi n-tum shɛli n-naɣi pahila tuumbiɛri ka bɛ tumdi n sani bɛ bilim ni hal ni pɔŋɔ. Izraɛlnim na ʒi n-tum shɛli n-naɣi pahila bɛ zaŋla bɛ nuhi tumdi tuun shɛŋa din chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisira. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in my eyes since their youth; the people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but anger me by the work of their hands, declares the LORD.

dag: dama bɛ zaa daa nya o ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam. Ka o dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! Mani m-bala.
en: They were all terrified when they saw him. Jesus spoke to them at once, Courage! he said. It is I. Don't be afraid.

dag: n ni daa po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛl a A bia Sulemaana ni ti di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-zani n zaani ʒini n nam ʒiishee la, n ni niŋ lala zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: regarding what I swore to you by the LORD, Israels God, Your son Solomon will certainly succeed me; he will sit on the throne after me—Ill see that it happens today.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi kpɛla daadamnim ni me Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din nyɛ alali din la ŋmahinli la ni, amaa alizanda maŋmaŋ ni ka o kpe nti zani Naawuni tooni ti zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Christ didnt enter the holy place made by human hands, but into heaven itself, so that he now appears in Gods presence for us.

dag: O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ sariakaritiba doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ti bɛn ʒe dunɔdali gbini kariti bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti liri ba la suhukpeeni.
en: and a spirit of justice for the one who sits in judgment, and a strength for those who repel the assault at the gate.

dag: ka di be kaman n daa na ʒi m-be, ka bɛ daa kul dɔɣi ma n-zaŋ ma ti niŋla gballi ni.
en: I wish I had never lived. I wish they had carried me from my mothers womb straight to the grave.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Lihimiya, yi yi ti nya ka Amnɔn nyu wain kuli ka n yɛli ya, Kumiya Amnɔn, yin kumiy o. Di zɔriya dabiɛm, mani m-puhi ya. Maliya suhukpeeni ka tum bidibilim tuma.
en: But he told his servants, Keep an eye on Amnon. When he gets a little drunk from the wine and is feeling relaxed, I'll give the signal. Then kill him! I've commanded you to do it, so don't be afraid. Be strong and brave.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N yaaŋa, teemi ni a ni daa be a nyɛvil ni la, a daa nyar a suhu yubu, ka Lazarɔs mi daa nyari wahala, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o suhu maaya, ka a mi be azaaba ni.
en: But Abraham said, Child, remember that during your lifetime you received good things, whereas Lazarus received terrible things. Now Lazarus is being comforted and you are in great pain.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛbisi Izraɛlnima, ka sokam daa lab kuli ni bɛ ti deei bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa ti ba maa.
en: When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites each went to settle on their own family property in order to take possession of the land.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka niriba ni niŋ shɛb naani leeri biriti, ka mɔŋdi kpamba baŋsim.
en: He makes trusted advisors be silent. He takes away the wisdom of the older leaders.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya kam lɔri duŋ taabo nia, ka zuliya kam lɔri nia biɛri din ka buchi?.
en: Why do the nations rant? Why do the peoples rave uselessly?.

dag: Ka Anduru daa dii chaŋ ti bo n-nya o mabia Saimɔn n-yɛl o, Ti nya Masia la.
en: The first thing Andrew did was to go and find his brother Simon. Andrew said to him, We have found the Messiah.

dag: Di saha maa ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Mirimiya ma na ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-mir o. Ka o daa mali me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli bɛ ni daa daai luhi la zali.
en: Elijah told everyone to gather around him while he repaired the Lord 's altar.

dag: Naftali bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jaziɛl mini Guni ni Jɛzar ni Shallum, bɛ daa nyɛla Biliha zuliya.
en: Naphtalis sons were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. And these are the descendants of Bilhah.

dag: Yilimiya yila pampam paɣi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ!.
en: Be happy and sing to God, our strength. Shout with joy to the God of Jacob.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla daa niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, ka o daa chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus arrived and saw a large crowd, he had compassion for them and healed those who were sick.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa yi tɔb maa ni kuni ka zaŋ doli yi Hɛrɛs kunkuni polo.
en: Then Gideon, Joashs son, returned from the battle by the Heres Pass.

dag: O daa bi tooi tum tuun kar shɛli nimaani n-naɣ pahila o daa kul zaŋla o nuhi pa barinim biɛla zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus could not work any miracles there, except to heal a few sick people by placing his hands on them.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Pa sokam zaa n-ni tooi doli dimbɔŋɔ naɣila Naawuni ni zaŋ lala ti shɛba.
en: He replied, Not everybody can accept this teaching, but only those who have received the ability to accept it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima ni o Ba Naawuni mini malaika kasinim jilima, o gba ni ti zo vi dilana zuɣu.
en: Whoever is ashamed of me and my words, the Human Onewill be ashamed of that person when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka Lɛvinim su n daalikauli suɣili la mini di nɛma zaa ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni fukumsi. Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa, ka ti bɛ suɣa gil li.
en: Rather, assign the Levites to the covenant dwelling, to all its equipment, and to everything that belongs to it. They will carry the dwelling and all its equipment, perform its religious ceremonies, and camp around the dwelling.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka alahichi su yi niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ n-chɛ ka yi deei yi niŋgbuna maa noli tum di kɔr biɛri tuma.
en: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli do so ŋun ye binyɛr piɛlli la, Cham kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim tiŋli la gbini nti mooi buɣimsal nɛma chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni pali a nuhi n-zaŋ li yaɣiri tiŋ maa zuɣu. Ka n daa yuun o ka o chaŋ.
en: God said to the man wearing linen clothes, Go between the wheels under the creatures and fill your hands with burning coals. Then scatter the coals over the city. I watched him go.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa booni Izraɛlnim maa chani bɛ buɣa maligunim ni, ka bɛ ti jɛmdi buɣa maa ka diri di maligu bindira.
en: These women invited them to sacrificial feasts, where the god of Moab was worshiped. The Israelites ate the food and worshiped the god.

dag: O daa bɔrimi ni o diri bundan maa bindir burisa din luri tiŋa; ka bahi daa kanna ti leen o yuma maa.
en: hoping to eat the bits of food that fell from the rich man's table. Even the dogs would come and lick his sores.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake maa daa duh o yee kuhi yɛli Judanim yɛtɔɣa puuni, Wummiya Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi ninsal ŋun kpi, bɛ ni leei bɛn bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: If you touch a dead body, you will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Dama o ni ti ti sokam o tuma ni simdi shɛli:.
en: He will reward or punish everyone for what they have done.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaai yɛla maa yiniyini n-kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:.

dag: Ka yiɣisi guui chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, M bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni. Ka o daa labi ti dɔni.
en: Samuel hurried to Eli and said, Im here. You called me? I didnt call you, Eli replied. Go lie down. So he did.

dag: Amaa n ni ti deei nam maa o bia nuu ni n-zaŋ li ti nyin ŋun su zuliya pia ŋɔ.
en: Then I will give you ten tribes to rule.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu, Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa waawaayili ka yi zaɣisi wumbu, ka n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku saɣi.
en: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.

dag: Bɛ daa pun nyala o mini Trɔfimus Ɛfɛsus tiŋbia la tiŋ puuni, ka tɛhi ni Pool ʒi o kala Naawuni jɛmbu duu na.
en: They said this because they had seen Trophimus from Ephesus with Paul in the city, and they thought that Paul had taken him into the Temple.

dag: Amaa man sani, di viɛli ni n vu m-miri Naawuni. N zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ leei n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n zaŋ a tuma zaa yɛla moli gili!.
en: But me? Its good for me to be near God. I have taken my refuge in you, my LORD God, so I can talk all about your works!.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Zaŋmi binchɛra maa niŋ gabisi maa min a bɔɣulɔna puuni. Ka Jɛrimia daa niŋ lala.
en: and called to Jeremiah, Put these old rags and scraps of clothing under your arms and hold on to the ropes. When Jeremiah did this.

dag: Yisa mini Pita ni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa ti paai Yisa nyaandol bɛn la sani nya ka salo pam n-laɣim gil ba, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib ŋmɛr o nyaandoliba maa naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Then Jesus, Peter, James, and John went to the other followers. They saw many people around them. The teachers of the law were arguing with the followers.

dag: Marɔtinim kul guhirimi, ka bɛ suhuri ye zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu pun yi Yawɛ sani siɣi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdal ni na.
en: The people of Maroth anxiously wait for relief, because the Lord has brought disaster close to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa kaman paɣ so ŋun bi ʒe o yidan yim ni zo ka chɛ o shɛm, lala ka yinim lzraɛlnim gba bi ʒe ma yim. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni din tuui mal alikauli di ni yɛliya: Tim a ba min a ma jilima.
en: Obey your father and your mother.

dag: Suhuyiɣisilinim tahirila zabili na, amaa bɛn suhuri bi yiɣisiri yomyom goorila zabili.
en: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa daa saɣi ni o ni be Maika sani m-be kaman o bidibisi ni yino.
en: then he agreed to stay with Micah and be his priest. He lived in Micah's house, and Micah treated him like one of his own sons.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ; yi nyɛla n-daba. Mani n-nam ya ni yi nyɛ n daba. N ku tam yi yɛla.
en: Jacob, remember these things! Israel, remember, you are my servant. I made you, and you are my servant. So, Israel, dont forget me.

dag: n-daa kpalim ni niŋ chira ata. Ka daa ti yɛn yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria ka wum ni Yɛhudianim gu o soli, ka o daa lo nia ni o ni zaŋ doli Masidɔnia polo chaŋ.
en: where he stayed three months. He was getting ready to go to Syria when he discovered that there were Jews plotting against him; so he decided to go back through Macedonia.

dag: Bɛ kuhiri booni ma, Ti Naawuni, tinim Izraɛlnim mi a.
en: They yell out at me, My God, we in Israel know you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim siɣi teeku puuni n-chaŋ du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He led Israel through the sea. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka di niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza alahiziba, ka o vaai yiɣisi zani ka bɔh o kpambaliba, Pa niriba ata ka ti lo mihi niŋ buɣim ŋɔ ni la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Naa, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Suddenly the king jumped up and shouted, Weren't only three men tied up and thrown into the fire? Yes, Your Majesty, his officers answered.

dag: Ka Haga daa boli Yawɛ ŋun tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa maa yuli, Naawuni ŋun nyara; dama o daa yɛlimi, Ka daɣila n shiri nyala Naawuni ka na be n nyɛvil ni n ni nya o maa nyaaŋa.
en: The Lord talked to Hagar. She began to use a new name for God. She said to him, You are God Who Sees Me. She said this because she thought, I see that even in this place God sees me and cares for me.

dag: Ti ni daa bi tooi yih o di ni maa ka ti chɛ o ka yɛli, Ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmi lala.
en: We could not persuade him to stay away from Jerusalem. So we stopped begging him and said, We pray that what the Lord wants will be done.

dag: N chɛ ka a nya jilima dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tum tuun shɛlikam a ni daa ti ma ni n tum la naai.
en: I finished the work you gave me to do. I brought you glory on earth.

dag: Ka Akishi daa garigi yɛli Dauda, M mi ni a ka galimi shɛli kaman Naawuni malaika ni ka galimi shɛm la, amaa di zaa yoli, Filistia sapashinnim maa yɛliya ni a di dol ti chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: I agree, Achish replied. I consider you as loyal as an angel of God. But the other kings have said that you can't go with us into battle.

dag: Hal n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi saɣim ŋ-ŋɔ, ka n niŋgbuŋ na beni, dindina n ni nya Naawuni.
en: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti nyɛla n ni su shɛba n ni ti yɛn bɔhi biɛri dabisi shɛli dali maa, ka nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n ni ti tiligi ba kaman bihilaamba ni tiligiri bɛ bihi bɛn jɛmdi ba shɛm la.
en: On the day that I am preparing, says the LORD of heavenly forces, they will be my special possession. I will spare them just as parents spare a child who serves them.

dag: A zaŋla a nini kpa lala nira? A zaŋ ma mi na ni a ti kari ma saria?.
en: Yes, you open your eyes on this one; you bring me into trial against you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni be ti sani kaman o ni daa be ti yaannim maa sani shɛm la. O di chɛ ti bee n-zaŋ ti bahi.
en: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us or abandon us;.

dag: Di saha ka biŋkɔbiri chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee nti kpalim do bɛ lɛya ni.
en: The wild animals go to their dens.

dag: N daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman taŋkpa zim la. N daa burisi ba ka no n-taai ba kaman soli zuɣu batibati la.
en: I crush them, and they become like dust; I trample on them like mud in the streets.

dag: dindina n ni chɛ ka a ʒi Izraɛl nam ʒiishee sahakam kaman n ni daa pun lo a ba Dauda alikauli yɛli, N kul ku chɛ ka ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kɔŋ o zuliya ni.
en: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, just as I promised your father David, You will never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.

dag: n ni ti zaŋ li niŋ zuliya shɛb naa nuu ni, ka o ti niŋ li kaman di tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm. N ni ti yihi li bahi.
en: So I, the Lord God, will reject the tree and hand it over to a foreign ruler, who will punish it for its wickedness.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yurilim niŋ dɛde ti ni ni di chɛ ka ti ti tooi mali suhukpeeni saria karibu dali, dama o ni be shɛm, lala ka ti gba biɛhigu be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Love is made perfect in us in order that we may have courage on the Judgment Day; and we will have it because our life in this world is the same as Christ's.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li dindali maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni dindali maa kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Lakishinim shɛm la.
en: That day they captured the city and killed everyone in the city. This was the same thing they had done to Lachish.

dag: ka po Naawuni ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ni dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ni teeku mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋɔ n-yɛli ni guhibu lan kani.
en: and took a vow in the name of God, who lives forever and ever, who created heaven, earth, and the sea, and everything in them. The angel said, There will be no more delay!.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa baŋ dinkam zaa niŋ maa, ka o suhu daa saɣim, ka o dar tɔh o situra, ka zaŋ buɣu pili, ka niŋ tampiligim puɣ o zuɣu n-yi n-kpe tiŋ puuni chani gindi kuhiri fabila kuhigu pampam ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: When Mordecai heard about all that had been done, he tore his clothes. Then he put on sackcloth, put ashes on his head, and went out into the city crying loudly.

dag: Salo maa ni daa ti wurim naai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim o sani bɔh o yɛtɔɣ ŋaha la yɛla.
en: Later, Jesus was away from the people. The twelve apostles and his other followers asked him about the stories.

dag: Tihi din vari kul sabigi sahakam, fabilimiya, dama sida tihi luya; ti suma la zaa bahi yoli! Bashan oki tihi, fabilimiya, dama bɛ ŋma nyɔŋ tihi la zaa luhi!.
en: Weep and wail, cypress trees— the cedars have fallen; those glorious trees have been destroyed! Weep and wail, oaks of Bashan— the dense forest has been cut down!.

dag: Dama jɛra lari ŋmanila gɔhi ni be buɣim ni duɣu gbinni tahiri shɛm la; ka dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: The laughter of fools is such a waste. It is like thorns burning under a pot. The thorns burn so quickly that the pot does not get hot.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya ni dabeenzɔbo mini ni sɔhibu, ka niŋmiya lala ni nimmoo kaman yi niŋdi li tirila Masia la.
en: Slaves, obey your masters here on earth with fear and respect. And do this with a heart that is true, just as you obey Christ.

dag: Di simdi ni ti zaŋ ti niɣi zaa chaŋ, hal naɣ takarifeeni ku kpalim. Di simdi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa, dama ti bi mi ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ shɛli mali sara ti Yawɛ naɣila ti paala nimaani.
en: So our livestock must go with us. Not one animal can be left behind. Well need some of them for worshipping the LORD our God. We wont know which to use to worship the LORD until we get there.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ti nambɔɣu. Kul zom ti nambɔɣu, dama bɛ dihi ti vi ti yaɣi.
en: Have mercy on us, LORD! Have mercy because weve had more than enough shame.

dag: Dama a ni kpuɣ a piɛma tiri ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: You will make them turn and run away when you aim your arrows at their faces.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me omaŋmaŋ ya o tiŋ maa ni, ka daa mali luɣ shɛli n-ti suɣili nimaani zali Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: For his own use, David built houses in David's City. He also prepared a place for God's Covenant Box and put up a tent for it.

dag: ka anzinfa pa ŋmana kpiŋkpama zuɣu, ka salima alali pa bɛ kɔbiri zuɣu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ni shɛb daa kpalim be yiŋ buzɔna ni?.
en: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.

dag: Bɛ bi lan tiri ti mɔri, amaa ka na kul yɛra, Ŋmamiya bilichiisi maa! Nyam bɛ ni buri a tumtumdiba shɛm, amaŋmaŋ niriba maa tum din bi tuhi.
en: You give us no straw, but you tell us to make as many bricks as before. And now our masters are beating us. Your people are wrong for doing this.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Di ku o, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nuu shihi Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni, ka ku mali taali.
en: But David said to Abishai, Dont kill Saul! Anyone who hurts the Lord s chosen king must be punished.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yisifu kɔba m-mali chaŋ kaman ŋun Yisifu ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm la. Dama Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Naawuni yi ti ka yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti tiligi ya, ka yi yɛn chaŋ, yin zaŋmiya n kɔba mali chaŋ.
en: Moses took the body of Joseph with him, as Joseph had made the Israelites solemnly promise to do. Joseph had said, When God rescues you, you must carry my body with you from this place.

dag: Diimas ni yuri dunia ŋɔ la zuɣu, o zoya chaŋ Tɛsalɔnaika ka chɛ ma; Krɛshɛnsi chaŋ Galɛshia, ka Taitus mi chaŋ Dalimatia.
