en: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ yi nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ, ka yi zaa yinoyino nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: All of you are Christ's body, and each one is a part of it.

dag: Ka o daa deei salima maa n-zaŋ li nyɛligi mali salima naɣilabila. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He took the earrings, melted them, poured the gold into a mold, and made a gold bull-calf. The people said, Israel, this is our god, who led us out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Hanani bia Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ anabi la daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi Naa Jɛhɔshafat soli n-yɛl o, A tɛhiya ni di simdi ni a sɔŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri ka yuri bɛn je Yawɛ? A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a zuɣu.
en: Jehu son of Hanani the seer came out to meet him and said, Why did you help the wicked? Why have you loved those who hate the LORD? This is why the LORD is angry with you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kamina ti zani baɣili ma n-ku ma, dama n nya daŋ pam, ka m mi shia na bi siɣi.
en: He said to me, Please come over here and kill me, because convulsions have come over me but Im still alive.

dag: n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. Yi ni ti teei dɔni ka bɛ kun ya. Dama n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu; amaa ka tumdila tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka dolila n ni je shɛli.
en: I will offer you to the sword. You will all bow down for slaughter, because I called and you didnt answer; I spoke and you wouldnt hear. You did what I considered evil, and chose what I didnt want.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi.
en: Jesus replied, You dont know what youre asking! Can you drink from the cup that Im about to drink from? They said to him, We can.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa kar o yihi Idɛn puu maa ni ni o ti kɔr o ni daa yi tiŋgban shɛli ni na maa.
en: the LORD God sent him out of the garden of Eden to farm the fertile land from which he was taken.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, ŋunkam daa kpe yili maa ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kpar li zali la nyɛla ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Any who enter the house while it is locked up will be unclean until evening.

dag: Zaŋmiya binyara sa n-dalim yi pala, malimiya dapaɣa din mali sabbu. Kpahimmiya palidaa la viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ni daa doli shɛli chaŋ la. Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ labimiyana. Labimiya yi tinsi ŋɔ ni na.
en: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.

dag: O ni ka yaa maa zuɣu, di nyɛla talahi ni o maani maligu omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu kaman o ni maani niriba daalahichi zuɣu shɛm.
en: Because of his weakness, he must offer sacrifices for his own sins as well as for the people.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi daa be Gɛba luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ Mikimash mini Aija ni Bɛtɛl ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: The descendants of the family of Benjamin from Geba lived in Micmash, Aija, Bethel, and the small towns around it.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi, ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni wahala paai ma la ŋmaligi labi ni vi.
en: People are trying to kill me. Please disappoint them. Humiliate them completely! They wanted to hurt me. Make them run away in shame!.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, dilana be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: Those who eat my flesh and drink my blood live in me, and I live in them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa fa Amɔrinim maa fɔntinsi zaa n-ʒini Hɛshibɔn zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: Israel took all the Amorite cities and began living in them. They even defeated the city of Heshbon and all the small towns around it.

dag: Ka n lo alikauli ni n ni yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni wahala maa ni n-zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: I have decided that I will bring them out of Egypt, where they are being treated cruelly, and will take them to a rich and fertile land—the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

dag: Binnamda zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Let every living thing praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!.

dag: ni Ɛliab ni Jɛrɔham ni Ɛlikana.
en: Eliab, Jeroham, Elkanah.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Jɔa bia Asaf ŋun daa su bɛ ni sab gban shɛŋa sɔŋ tuma la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka ŋmaligi lab Hɛzɛkia sani nti yɛl o Rabishake ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah tore their clothes in grief, and went and reported to the king what the Assyrian official had said.

dag: Suhu m-mi biɛrim shɛli din be di ni, ka di mini zino ku tooi laɣim mali di suhupiɛlli.
en: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.

dag: M pun nya jɛra ni maani bɛ biɛhigu shee, amaa ka n yɛli noli niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee maa libigi ba.
en: I saw a fool who thought he was safe, but suddenly he died.

dag: ka o tim puɣisiriba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka Sool shiri be ni.
en: he sent spies and found out that Saul was indeed there.

dag: Di yi ti wum o ka o suhu zɔhira saha shɛli, ka n dii lir o n-kpɛh o dabiɛm ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa zo ka chɛ o, ka n ku ŋun naa maa kɔŋko.
en: I will attack him while he is tired and weak, and I will throw him into a panic. All the troops with him will run off. I promise to kill the king alone.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa ka mali suhukpeeni, dama yi dan Sool kpiya ka Judanim mi zaŋ ma leei bɛ naa.
en: Saul is dead, but the tribe of Judah has made me their king. So be strong and have courage.

dag: Dama ti Duuma NAAWUNI lan yɛli, N niriba daa tuui kulila Ijipti ti be nimaani. Nyama, di nyaaŋa ka Asirianim gba daa ti nahim ba yoli.
en: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin daŋmi yili maa nim puhibu ŋ-ŋɔ: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ yili ŋɔ nim ni.
en: Whenever you enter a house, first say, May peace be on this house.

dag: Zuliya kam kul taarila duŋ ka nam kam damda. O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, tiŋgbani nyɛligirimi.
en: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.

dag: ka o daa dihi bɛn nahindi ba vi, ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: God shames even great leaders and makes them wander through empty deserts.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim zaa daa ti chaŋ Naawuni sani ni bɛ yaa ti mali yuuniyuuni sara la Yawɛ sani, ka pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: The time came again for Elkanah and his family to go to Shiloh and offer to the Lord the yearly sacrifice and the special sacrifice he had promised.

dag: Ka o daa lihi bɛn ʒi o sani maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He looked at the people sitting around him and said, Look! Here are my mother and my brothers!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ku ma suli, ka n suhu yiɣisi la, n daa loya ni n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba; ka daa bi taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Just as I planned evil against you when your ancestors angered me, says the LORD of heavenly forces, and did not relent.

dag: O ʒiinila o yiŋ dunɔdali gbini bee tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee.
en: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.

dag: Ka tuumbaŋdiba bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee maa daa ti yi bɛ tuma shee na.
en: that finally everyone stopped working.

dag: piɛri mini niɣi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba.
en: People rule over the sheep and cattle and all the wild animals.

dag: Nir ni ti zaŋ tɔbu mini piɛma kpe nimaani ni o ti go mɔɣu, dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: That land will be wild and used only as a hunting ground where people go with bows and arrows.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi sabilifaa niŋ li ni bɛ zaŋ li lɔri pari bantabiga maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: They fastened to it a blue cord to tie it to the top of the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira maa neei biɛɣu, ka manna la daa chɛ lubu na. Ka Izraɛlnim daa bi lan nya li di yaha, amaa ka daa kpalim dirila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira di yuuni maa ni.
en: The next morning, the manna from heaven stopped coming. This happened the first day after the people ate the food that grew in the land of Canaan. From that time on, the Israelites did not get the manna from heaven.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla ka mali hal ti baai du teeku yaɣili.
en: The disciples had forgotten to bring any bread when they crossed the lake.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka yi ku tum alahichi, amaa yi ni so yi tum alahichi, ti mali sandaantimda ŋun be ti Ba Naawuni sani: ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ wuntialan la.
en: My dear children, I write this letter to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone sins, we have Jesus Christ to help us. He always did what was right, so he is able to defend us before God the Father.

dag: Bɛ yi yiɣiri luri zoya zuɣu, di vurimi kaman chɛchɛbunsi vubu la; ka lan vuri kaman buɣim n-diri mokuma ka di tahiri la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila tɔbbi gbaliŋ n-teei zani ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb la.
en: Listen to them. It is like the noise of chariots riding over the mountains. It is like the noise of flames burning the chaff. They are a powerful people, who are ready for war.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli Bɛri bia Hozia Naa Uzia mini Naa Jɔtam ni Naa Ahaz ni Naa Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ni Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛmana ni m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the message which the Lord gave Hosea son of Beeri during the time that Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah, and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.

dag: Saha paaya ni yi me yimaŋmaŋ yinsi n-kpe n-doya ka chɛ ka man jɛmbu duu lu n-dahim doya?.
en: My people, why should you be living in well-built houses while my Temple lies in ruins?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba, ka bɛ yɔri farigu o sani. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda kul diri nasara o ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Then David put his soldiers in Damascus, Aram. The Arameans became Davids servants and brought tribute. The Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.

dag: O ni daa paai nimaani, Ɛli daa ʒila o kuɣ zuɣu sɔnaŋgbanyee lihira, dama o suhu daa bi doya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Doo maa ni daa kpe tiŋ puuni nti moli lahibali maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa.
en: Eli, who was very worried about the Covenant Box, was sitting in his seat beside the road, staring. The man spread the news throughout the town, and everyone cried out in fear.

dag: Dama ŋuna m-bɔhiri biɛri niriba ʒim yihibu zuɣu. O bi tamdi bɛn nyari nahiŋgu kumsi yɛla.
en: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.

dag: yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɔrili zaɣ titali ŋun daa mali kpiŋkpaŋ kara, ka o kpiŋkpan piɛma wɔɣa, ka o mali kɔb garigari pam daa ti ka Lɛbanɔn na. O daa gbaala sida tia.
en: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: A large eagle with big wings came to Lebanon. He had feathers covered with spots.

dag: N yi yɛli ni zibisim sɔɣim ma, ka neesim din gili ma zaa leei zibisim.
en: Or suppose I said, I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Ilaija so ŋun yɛn kana la.
en: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir anahi ni, di wala zaa ni nyɛla wal suma ka ni nyɛla wumpaɣibo sara pina Yawɛ sani.
en: In the fourth year, the fruit from that tree will belong to the Lord , a holy offering of praise to him.

dag: Ka lan yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti nya ka alizanda dunoli yooi, ka Naawuni malaikanim siɣiri Daadam Bia sanna ka labiri dura.
en: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, tiŋgban ni ti fabili, ka zuɣusaa ti zibigi. Mani n-yɛli lala, m mi pun lola di nia. N ku chɛ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli bee n-labi nyaaŋa.
en: Therefore, the earth will grieve and the heavens grow dark because I have declared my plan and will neither change my mind nor cancel the plan.

dag: Di saha ka a chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa zani Aduna min o bidibisi la tooni, ka a zaŋ ba ti Yawɛ kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la.
en: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ti gari ka bol omaŋmaŋ yuli, Yawɛ, Yawɛ. N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ka niŋdi nirilim. N suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka yurilim din bi naara mini ʒiɛyimtali galisi n sani.
en: The LORD passed in front of him and proclaimed: The LORD! The LORD! a God who is compassionate and merciful, very patient, full of great loyalty and faithfulness.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni, n nyaya ka zaligu dolibu ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali bela nimaani; ka lan nya ka wuntitali ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali lan bela nimaani gba.
en: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.

dag: Nuhu bidibis ata maa zuliya m-pali dunia ŋɔ zaa ŋɔ.
en: These were Noahs three sons, and from them the whole earth was populated.

dag: Ti bi be kaman Anabi Musa ŋun daa zaŋ sariga pili n-lir o ninni ni Izraɛlnim di nya jilima din daa ti yɛn vuu la bahigu la.
en: We are not like Moses, who had to put a veil over his face so that the people of Israel would not see the brightness fade and disappear.

dag: Ka Mikal daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o doli takɔro ni yi n-zo n-tiligi.
en: So Michal lowered David through a window. He took off and ran, and he got away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: After they finished making fun of him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him again. Then they led him out of the palace to be killed on a cross.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɛn yihi yili maa daɣiri ni, ŋun zaŋmi noombihi tintiins ayi mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro.
en: Then, to make the house clean, the priest must take two birds, a piece of cedar wood, a piece of red cloth, and a hyssop plant.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa chaŋ Kɛila nti tuhi Filistianim maa n-ku ba pam, ka fa bɛ niɣi. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ fa Kɛilanim maa bahi.
en: So David and his men went to Keilah. Davids men fought the Philistines. They defeated them and took their cattle. In this way David saved the people of Keilah.

dag: Nyam biŋkɔbiri ni bamdi shɛm. Niɣi kul chanimi gindi mɔri ni kani ka bɛ ni ŋubi zuɣu; ka piɛri mini buhi gba kul diri wahala.
en: The animals are hungry and groaning. The herds of cattle wander around confused because they have no grass to eat. The sheep are dying.

dag: Ka maligumaana Aduna daa du Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu nti kpi nimaani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu dahin yini dali n-daa bala.
en: Aaron the priest obeyed the Lord and went up Mount Hor. Aaron died at that place on the first day of the fifth month. That was the th year after the Israelites had left Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya din be di ni maa tim nandaamba; ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ nyam yi sani.
en: Therefore, give to those in need from the core of who you are and you will be clean all over.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Asiria na, ka o niriba bɛn kpalim maa dol li kaman o ni daa mali soli ti Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na la.
en: Then Gods people who are left in Assyria will have a way to leave. It will be just like the time God took the people out of Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hazɔrinima, zomiya chaŋ katiŋa, sɔɣimiya voya ni. Dama Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, ka mali shili gun ya.
en: Run away; take cover, you people of Hazor, declares the LORD. Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar has taken counsel and devised a plan against you.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii pam dindali maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa daa do n-dalim chɛchɛbuŋ maa puuni, ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo hal ni zaawuni, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka o kpi.
en: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He stayed there until evening, and by sundown he was dead.

dag: Dama n shee kul tulimi ka biɛra, ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: My insides are burning up; theres nothing in my body that isnt broken.

dag: Kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya yi ni niŋ tuuba zuɣu, amaa ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n kpuɣ o namda gbibi. Ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: I baptize with water those of you who have changed your hearts and lives. The one who is coming after me is stronger than I am. Im not worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so ka o ku tooi nyaŋ o daɣiri ni yibu sara maligu zaligu m-bala.
en: This is the Instruction concerning those who have an infection of skin disease but who cannot afford the normal means of purification.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni tiligi shɛba. Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni ti bol a la, Tiŋ gahindili, ka lan bol a, Tin shɛli din be kasi, ka Naawuni bi zaɣis a.
en: They will be called The Holy People, Redeemed By the LORD. And you will be called Sought After— A City That Is Not Abandoned.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Baruk, Bɛ bi lan saɣi ni n kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then Jeremiah said to Baruch, I cannot go to the Lord s Temple. I am not allowed to go there.

dag: Miri ka a nyuri bara biɛɣuni zuɣu, dama a bi mi dabisili maa ni yɛn tahi yɛl shɛli na.
en: Dont brag about tomorrow, for you dont know what a day will bring.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Masia mini Sintani sunsuuni? Bee yɛdaniŋdiba mini bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba yɛla kpɛri tab ni?.
en: What harmony does Christ have with Satan? What does a believer have in common with someone who doesnt believe?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: The Lord said to the prophet Elijah.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mali biɛhiŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni diri shɛli polo ka diri li mali taali o ni niŋdi shɛli maa ni bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na zuɣu, dama binshɛɣukam din bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na nyɛla alahichi.
en: But those who have doubts are convicted if they go ahead and eat, because they arent acting on the basis of faith. Everything that isnt based on faith is sin.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha, ka Asa bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di Juda nam.
en: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in Ahab's fourth year as king of Israel.

dag: bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li duhi, amaa ninvuɣ suma n-ni ye li, ka bɛn ka taali mi ti pirigi anzinfa maa ti taba.
en: But their piles of clothes will be worn by those who have lived right. All that silver will be given to those who have done no wrong.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim mini Kalidianim zaa ni Pɛkɔdnima ni Shɔanima ni Kɔanima ni Asirianim zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla, ka gomnanim mini sapashin kpamba ni sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi ni ti be bɛ ni. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla wɔribariba.
en: I will gather all the handsome young officials and the high-ranking cavalry officers from Babylonia and Assyria, as well as from the Chaldean tribes of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa beni ka barina shɛli kani. Yaakubu zuliya kɔŋko n-daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bindira mini wain; ni luɣ shɛli maligim ni yiri zuɣusaa luri tiŋ na.
en: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.

dag: Amaa ka yi ti malila suhupiɛlli ka puhiri chuɣu, ka kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri ŋ-ŋubiri bɛ nimdi ka nyuri wain ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti di ka nyu, dama biɛɣuni ti sa ni kpi.
en: But look, everyone was happy. The people rejoiced, saying, Kill the cattle and sheep, and lets celebrate. Lets eat meat and drink wine. Eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan su saha mini saha taɣibu; o vuuri nanima ka zaani nanima; ŋuna n-tiri yɛnnim yɛm, ka tiri baŋdiba baŋsim.
en: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ŋun zuɣu ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ lee paai ti ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka di gbaala Jona.
en: Meanwhile, the sailors said to each other, Come on, lets cast lots so that we might learn who is to blame for this evil thats happening to us. They cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ pihita la puuni niriba ata daa ti chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni saha shɛli Filistia tɔbbihi ni daa lo tɔbu n-do Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni la.
en: One day three of the thirty leading soldiers went to a rock where David was staying near Adullam Cave, while a band of Philistines was camping in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa maa ka zuɣulan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛl o, M bipuɣiŋga n-na kul yoli kpi; amaa kamina nti zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu ka o lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: While Jesus was speaking to them, a ruler came and knelt in front of him, saying, My daughter has just died. But come and place your hand on her, and shell live.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye wuntia zuɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: Happy are those whose greatest desire is to do what God requires; God will satisfy them fully!.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ Naawuni daalibarika din be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni cheechinim ni yɛla.
en: Brothers and sisters, we want to let you know about the grace of God that was given to the churches of Macedonia.

dag: So bi yɛn teeri yɛndana bee jɛrigu yɛla sahakam; dama saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti tam bɛ zaa yɛla, dama bɔzuɣu ka yɛnnim mini jɛra zaa yɛn kpi kpiri yini?.
en: Whether people are wise or foolish, they will still die, and no one will remember either one of them forever. In the future, people will forget everything both of them did. So the two are really the same.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya lala maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni ŋun niŋ ninsalinim yiko ŋɔ tatabo maa.
en: When the people saw it, they were afraid, and praised God for giving such authority to people.

dag: Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ naa min o nabihi kuli tinzun tiŋ ni, Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their king and his officers will go into exile.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti yɛli Filip, Yiɣisima n-dol a nudirigu polo mɔɣu ni pal shɛli din yiri Jɛrusalɛm kuni Gaza la.
en: The Lord's angel said to Philip, Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.

dag: Dinzuɣu karimbaani n-nyɛ bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dolibi, ka duŋ taabo mi nyɛ bɛ kparibu.
en: So they are proud and hateful. This is as easy to see as the jewels and fancy clothes they wear.

dag: Ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga daa yi salo maa ni na nti wa waa, ka di niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd mini bɛn daa ʒi o sani maa zaa nyaɣisim pam. Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa, Yɛlim ma a suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam zaa, ka n ti a li.
en: The daughter of Herodias came to the party and danced. When she danced, Herod and the people eating with him were very pleased. So King Herod said to the girl, I will give you anything you want.

dag: N ni be a tooni, ka dahim zoya ti a. N ni kabi daanya dunoya ti a, ka kabi dunoya ni kuriti ti a.
en: I will go in front of you and make the mountains flat. I will break the city gates of bronze and cut the iron bars on the gates.

dag: Ka bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinu.
en: Their enrollment by their clans was .

dag: Ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika n-kuri chɛrubinim ayi n-zaŋ ba tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ nabia alali, ka di zuɣulaannim diri di ni simdi ni bɛ diri saha shɛli ni bɛ nya kpiɔŋ ka pa ni bɛ nyu m-buɣi, di tiŋgbɔŋ maa mal alibarika.
en: But a country is fortunate to have a king who makes his own decisions and leaders who eat at the proper time, who control themselves and don't get drunk.

dag: Bɛ daa mali bɛ ni shɛb ansarisi ka fiɛb ba, ka daa ga shɛb zoligɔnima n-zaŋ ba kpɛhi duu.
en: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Pɔɔshius Fɛstus daa kana ni o ti deei Gomna Filiksi, ka Gomna Filiksi ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim ni yu shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ Pool niŋ sarika ni.
en: But after two years, Porcius Festus became governor. So Felix was no longer governor. But he left Paul in prison to please the Jews.

dag: O bi zaŋdi bini din ni saɣim siŋkaafa buri li. O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ naɣikɔra tɔroko kpe di ni no li ka di biɛlim ku bɔɣi.
en: They do not ruin the wheat by threshing it endlessly, and they know how to thresh it by driving a cart over it without bruising the grains.

dag: Man Jɔn n-nyɛ ŋun daa wum yɛla ŋɔ, ka nya dimbɔŋɔnima. N ni daa wum li ka nya li maa, ka n daa gbani malaika so ŋun wuhi ma binyara maa tooni ni n jɛm o;.
en: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn daa nya Yisa ka o kpari o polo na ka o yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbila ŋun kpihindi dunianim daalahichi la.
en: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, Look! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!.

dag: Dama Babilɔn naa maa ʒiɛla sochira zuɣu ni o vihi nya o ni yɛn doli so shɛli. O chaɣisi piɛma, ka niŋ buɣa saawara, ka vihi maligu biŋkɔbigu binsabili.
en: The king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road where the two roads begin and performs his divinations. He shakes the arrows, consults the divine images, and inspects the liver.

dag: Dama n fabila n-leei m bindirigu, ka n ŋuhibu galisi kaman kɔzɔrim la.
en: My groans become my bread; my roars pour out like water.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam o jɛmbu duu puuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni! O tir o niriba yiko mini kpiɔŋ. Paɣimiya Naawuni!.
en: How awesome is God as he comes from his sanctuary— the God of Israel! He gives strength and power to his people. Praise God!.

dag: Dama Naawunitali biɛhigu zaa be Masia daadamtali niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: For the full content of divine nature lives in Christ, in his humanity.

dag: Yi niŋla yi takɔbiri naani, ka tumdi din chihira, ka yi zaa yinoyino bɔri yi tab paɣiba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: You rely on your swords. Your actions are disgusting. Everyone commits adultery. What makes you think that the land is yours?.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya daa lab mali me tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Dibɔn mini Atarɔt ni Aroa.
en: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the fortified towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer.

dag: Hal bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ zaa. N yi zo ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni nya mbusim.
en: But even if the Israelites do raise their children, it will not help, because I will take the children away from them. I will leave them, and they will have nothing but troubles.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni tintariga daa zaŋla Mɛsha hal ti paai Sɛfar din be wulimpuhili polo zoya ni la.
en: The land in which they lived extended from Mesha to Sephar in the eastern hill country.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Dama sokam kul yɛri ma la yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa yɛla.
en: So he said to them, Why are you doing these things? Everybody tells me about the evil you are doing.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o tilig o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili ni ti lan nya li.
en: Whoever tries to preserve their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life will preserve it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra; pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: When Jesus heard this, he said to them, It is the sick people who need a doctor, not those who are healthy. I did not come to invite good people. I came to invite sinners.

dag: Lala zuɣu ti suhuri saɣimmi; dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ti nina fulimmi.
en: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;.

dag: Yi tamla Naawuni ni zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ omaŋmaŋ bihi la yɛla? O yɛliya: M bia, a Duuma yi saɣis a, nyin wumma; ka o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu miligi.
en: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.

dag: M bia, wummi n yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka luɣi a tiba wum m baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma kpe o bindira dibu duu, ka o ni daa lo shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m polo nyɛla o bɔri ma mi.
en: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.

dag: amaa ka niŋ tipawumli n-dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu n-jɛmdi Baalinima kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa wuhi ba shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Instead, they have followed their own willful hearts and have gone after the Baals, as their ancestors taught them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋmɛnditoya liri ba libigi ba, ka chɛ ka kunsi mɔni bɛ yinsi, dama bɛ gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ni n lu di ni, ka bari zana ni bɛ gbaai ma.
en: Send a mob to plunder their homes without warning; make them cry out in terror. They have dug a pit for me to fall in and have set traps to catch me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nyina ŋmanila takɔbiri, ka ŋmani suhi, bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku faranim dunia ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku nandaamba daadamnim sunsuuni.
en: There are people who take cruel advantage of the poor and needy; that is the way they make their living.

dag: Nyam n wahala ŋɔ, ka tiligi ma, dama m bi tam a zaligu yɛla.
en: Look at my suffering and deliver me because I havent forgotten your Instruction.

dag: N kul lihirila zoya zuɣu. Ya polo ka n sɔŋsim lee yɛn yina?.
en: I raise my eyes toward the mountains. Where will my help come from?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri ti tab maa m-bɔŋɔ. Dina ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ li ti zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la.
en: Moses commanded the Israelites: This is the land that you will inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine and a half tribes.

dag: Naawuni kul tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa sahakam, amaa ka ninsalinim bi baŋdi li.
en: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yihi dɔro maa ni be kuɣ shɛŋa ni maa n-yihi tiŋ maa kpaŋa nti bahi tampuli zuɣu.
en: he shall order that the stones on which the mildew is found be removed and thrown into some unclean place outside the city.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ din tari ninsal daɣiri, amaa nir yi bi doli ni paɣibu kali soli m-paɣir o nuhi ka diri bindirigu, din bi tar o daɣiri.
en: These contaminate a person in Gods sight. But eating without washing hands doesnt contaminate in Gods sight.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ti mali biɛhigu shee maa zali ya, n ni labina nti zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu shee, ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yi gba ni ti be.
en: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm mali ba kasi m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋm ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la mihi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ pini bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri zaa, ka paɣi bɛ situra m-mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: This is what you will do to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purification on them, have them shave their bodies, wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

dag: Yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa yi ti kuna nya o ni lala, o ni nya suhupiɛlli.
en: Happy are the servants whom the master finds fulfilling their responsibilities when he comes.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania, Hanania, wumma, pa Yawɛ n-tim a na ka a ti chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ ʒiri yɛda maa.
en: Then I told Hananiah this, and added, Listen, Hananiah! The Lord did not send you, and you are making these people believe a lie.

dag: Kum yi mali tayiɣisi ka bɛ zu bindirigu di, niriba ku lihi ʒiɛm ba di zuɣu.
en: People dont despise a thief if he steals to fill his starving stomach.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma mi tuhi pia. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba du Sɛla Zoli zuɣu nti daai ba Sɛla Zoli maa zuɣu luhi zolɔŋni, ka bɛ zaa chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: They also captured , men from Seir and took them to the top of a cliff. Then the army of Judah threw them from the top of the cliff while they were still alive and their bodies were broken on the rocks below.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn kpe Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni bee n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbin la gbini, bɛ paɣirila bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: Whenever they went into the meeting tent and whenever they approached the altar, they washed themselves, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka yi mini Giriisinim ni Tubalnim ni Mɛshɛkinim daa lan niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi ninsalinim mini daanya nɛma na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your agents in human trafficking. They gave you bronze vessels for these wares of yours.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa daari taba ni bɛ paag o shihi, dama o niŋgbuŋ ni ka tibbu yiko maa daa yirina n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpaŋda.
en: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yi tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun wuhiri ya din ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli, ka lan wuhiri ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: The Lord , the Savior, the Holy One of Israel, says, I am the Lord your God. I teach you for your own good. I lead you in the way you should go.

dag: dama n nini nya a tiliginsim shɛli.
en: I have seen with my own eyes how you will save your people.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra; pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus heard them and answered, Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do. I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.

dag: A na mi n-siɣi teeku kɔbilnin ni bee n-tam teeku bulli ni tiŋgbani zuɣu chaŋ?.
en: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa lan yɛli, Wummiya sariakarita bilikɔɣindan maa ni daa yɛli shɛm.
en: The Lord said: Think about what that crooked judge said.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya n kpe m puu maa ni. N laɣim n tulaalɛnim mini mɛɛr. N di n shigbana shiri. N nyu n wain ni m bihim. Zɔrinima, dimiya ka nyu, n yurinima, nyumiya yurilim hal ti buɣi.
en: I have entered my garden, my sweetheart, my bride. I am gathering my spices and myrrh; I am eating my honey and honeycomb; I am drinking my wine and milk. Eat, lovers, and drink until you are drunk with love!.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ liɣiri paŋ so, bɛ bi yɛri dilana ni o niŋm ba nyɔri di yɔbu ni. Bɛ mi bi diri birapu ka diri ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndiri ŋun ka taali. Bɛnkam tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim kul ku vuui bɛ zaashee.
en: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Salinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Worship him, all you peoples!.

dag: ka zibisim din ni chɛ ka a ku tooi nya mini kɔgbana lim a maa.
en: or a darkness that you cant see; rushing water will cover you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa yi Hazɛrɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ Bɛtɛl maa hal ni Luz n-gari chaŋ hal ti paai Atarɔt din nyɛ Arikinim tiŋgban la.
en: It goes from Bethel to Luz and passes on to the border of the Archites at Ataroth.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa be n sani, o na ʒi n-chɛ ma n ko, dama n kul tumdila din tiɣir o nini sahakam.
en: He who sent me is with me. He doesnt leave me by myself, because I always do what makes him happy.

dag: kuhi pam yɛli, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a Naawuni yuli zuɣu, di nahim ma.
en: shouting, What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Swear to God that you wont torture me.

dag: Wuntizɔriba muɣisigu galisiya pam, amaa Yawɛ yihiri ba di zaa ni.
en: The righteous have many problems, but the LORD delivers them from every one.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka niriba diri Naawuni daalikauli maa nyɔri, dindina ninsal yɛda niŋbu ka buchi, ka Naawuni daalikauli maa gba ka buchi.
en: If they inherit because of the Law, then faith has no effect and the promise has been canceled.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Lord , you did good things for me, your servant. You did what you promised to do.

dag: Ka Asha bidibisi daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Sɛra. Ka Bɛraya bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl.
en: Ashers sons were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. Also there were Beriahs sons, Heber and Malkiel.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛra.
en: and he taught them:.

dag: Ti yipa baŋya ni a mi binshɛɣukam zaa, ka di bi lan simdi ni so vih a; dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka ti baŋ ni a shiri yila Naawuni sanna.
en: Now we know that you know everything and you dont need anyone to ask you. Because of this we believe you have come from God.

dag: O bihi n-daa lan nyɛ: Maika mini Reeya ni Baal.
en: his son Micah, his son Reaiah, his son Baal.

dag: A zaɣisila Judanim zaa? A suhu lan je Ziɔnnima? Wula ka a ŋme ti luhi ka so ku tooi lan tibi ti yaha? Ti yuuni bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ti bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, ka yuuni bɔri faako saha, amaa ka naɣ nyarila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Lord , have you completely rejected Judah? Do you hate the people of Zion? Why have you hurt us so badly that we cannot be healed? We looked for peace, but nothing good happened; we hoped for healing, but terror came instead.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa wuhirila o Bia yɛla: Zaŋ chaŋ o daadamtali polo, bɛ daa dɔɣ o la Naa Dauda zuliya ni;.
en: God promised this good news about his Son ahead of time through his prophets in the holy scriptures. His Son was descended from David.

dag: O ni daa ti miri tiŋ maa ni kpɛbu, ka tiŋ maa ni nachimbil so kpi ka bɛ ʒir o yirina, ka tiŋ maa niriba kabiri doli. Kpim maa ma daa nyɛla pakoli; o mi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ pakoli maa bia.
en: When Jesus came near the town gate, he saw some people carrying a dead body. It was the only son of a woman who was a widow. Walking with her were many other people from the town.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City and his son Jehoram succeeded him as king.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku nanim maa n-zaŋ ba yili tih anu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa yili tihi maa zuɣu hal ti paai zaawuni.
en: Then Joshua killed the five kings and hanged their bodies on five trees. He left them hanging in the trees until evening.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa n-nya Yisa ka o ʒiɛya, amaa ka o lee bi baŋ ni Yisa m-bala.
en: As soon as she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she didnt know it was Jesus.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni, ka ti yi yuri taba Naawuni ni be ti ni ka o yurilim ni niŋ dɛde ti ni.
en: No one has ever seen God, but if we love one another, God lives in union with us, and his love is made perfect in us.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa dii baŋ ni yiko shɛli yi o ni, ka ŋmaligi salo maa ni bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi m binyɛrigu ŋɔ.
en: Jesus immediately felt power go out from him, so he stopped and turned around. Who touched my clothes? he asked.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa n-chɛ ka n yiɣisi zani m ba Dauda zaani n-ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: So the Lord has kept his promises. I am the king now in place of my father David. I rule the people of Israel as the Lord promised. And I have built the Temple for the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: N di darigi bɛ tibili yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu? Ka n di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri? n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The LORD declares: Shouldnt I confront these acts? Shouldnt I take revenge on such a nation?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Musa dindali maa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses that very same day.

dag: O ni daa paai Nazarɛt, o daa bi yuui, ka yi nimaani gari chaŋ Kapɛrinium din be teeku duli Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali tiŋgbana ni la.
en: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ malila omaŋmaŋ amaŋka, Lɛbanɔn tihi dapaɣa ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: King Solomon is carried on a throne made of the finest wood.

dag: ni sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi pihinunu fukumsi ni zuɣulaannima ni bɛn wuhiri niriba din niŋ kamaata ni alahiziba tumtumsa tumdiba ni bukpahinima.
en: officials and advisors, fortunetellers and others who tell the future.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fiɣisi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda? Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ni bɛ ka taali.
en: Who will bring a charge against Gods elect people? It is God who acquits them.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni daŋ kam niriba laɣim gbilligbilli, ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Matiri daŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ Matiri daŋ maa ni dɔbba zaa zali, ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Kish bia Sool. Amaa bɛ ni daa ti bɔr o bɛ daa bi nya o.
en: Samuel told each family in the tribe of Benjamin to pass by. Matris family was chosen. Then Samuel told each man in Matris family to walk by. Saul son of Kish was chosen. But when the people looked for Saul, they could not find him.

dag: Ka dindali maa nasara dibu suhupiɛlli maa daa leela suhugarigu dabisili Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa sani; dama bɛ daa wumya ni naa kumdila o bia maa kuli.
en: David's army found out he was crying because his son had died, and their day of victory suddenly turned into a day of sadness.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Juda ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina n ni paɣi Yawɛ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chɛ dɔɣibu.
en: Then Leah gave birth to another son. She named this son Judah. Leah named him this because she said, Now I will praise the Lord . Then Leah stopped having children.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi ŋuna n-yɛn kpi. Bia ku di wahala o ba daalahichi zuɣu. Ka bialan ku di wahala o bia daalahichi zuɣu. Wuntizɔra wuntia tuma yɛn nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ko dini, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu mi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ko dini.
en: It is the one who sins who will die. A son is not to suffer because of his father's sins, nor a father because of the sins of his son. Good people will be rewarded for doing good, and evil people will suffer for the evil they do.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa ka o sanna, ka o leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka Otiniɛl daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Otiniɛl nyaŋ o. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: The spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he became Israel's leader. Othniel went to war, and the Lord gave him the victory over the king of Mesopotamia.

dag: A ni me goonda shɛŋa gil a tinsi zaa ŋmanila fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi. Bɛ yi kul gbaɣiri li, di lurila ŋun yɛn di li nol ni.
en: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with ripe figs: shake the trees, and the fruit falls right into your mouth!.

dag: ka turi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ bɛ ni daa nya biɛrim shɛli maa mini yuma din gbahi ba la zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: They cursed the God of heaven because of their pain and the sores they had. But they refused to change their hearts and turn away from the evil things they did.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni n-dari gindi saha shɛl la ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa lala maa. Amaa nyama, di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla yuun pihinahinaanu, ka o na kul chɛ ka m be. Ka nyama, n nyɛla yuun pihiniinaanu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But now, look. It has been forty-five years since the Lord said that to Moses. That was when Israel was going through the desert, and the Lord , as he promised, has kept me alive ever since. Look at me! I am eighty-five years old.

dag: Karimbaannim gbi ma la bɔɣ biɛri. Bɛ maanila a zaligu ansarisi.
en: The proud, who do not obey your law, have dug pits to trap me.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a bi chɛ n taali ka kpihim n daalahichi maa? Dama pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn dɔnila tiŋgban ni. A ni ti lihi bo ma, amaa ka n ku beni.
en: Can't you ever forgive my sin? Can't you pardon the wrong I do? Soon I will be in my grave, and I'll be gone when you look for me.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Bahim niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di ka gbe nimaani, dama kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni.
en: When the day was almost over, the Twelve came to him and said, Send the crowd away so that they can go to the nearby villages and countryside and find lodging and food, because we are in a deserted place.

dag: A yi tum alahichi, Naawuni bimbɔ ka di yɛn pii? Ka a yi birigi bushɛm, bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ o?.
en: and think! Do your sins hurt God?.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ a nini sɔɣi, ka zaŋ ma leeg a dima?.
en: Why hide your face from me and consider me your enemy?.

dag: Dama bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, di laara ka Naawuni yɛn ti ba, ka darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: for he repays people based on what they do, paying back everyone according to their ways.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? Well, you will go down to hell!.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa ti yɛli Samsin, Niŋm ania wuhi ma din chɛ ka a mali kpiɔŋ pam maa, ka wuhi ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi nyaŋ a.
en: The next time Samson was at Delilah's house, she asked, Samson, what makes you so strong? How can I tie you up so you can't get away? Come on, you can tell me.

dag: bee m-mirigi bɛ nina kpa tiŋgban ni, amaa bɛ ni nyala suhusaɣiŋgu mini zibisim ni bumbɔni din mali barina ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli puuni bɛ ni yɛn kari ba ti kpɛhi.
en: And when the captives turn their faces to the ground, there is only a depressing darkness closing in—the dark sadness of people forced to leave their country.

dag: So yi mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla o yɛn yola o ni po pɔr shɛli samli bee o kul yɛn malila o suhu yubu sara, ka di nyɛla o piila o niɣi ni bee o piɛri ni na, n yi ni deei li, di simdi ka o nyɛla ŋun viɛl zaa. Di bi simdi ka o mali daŋa.
en: When anyone presents a fellowship offering to the Lord , whether as fulfillment of a vow or as a freewill offering, the animal must be without any defects if it is to be accepted.

dag: Bɛ puhim chuɣu maa ka di di bindirigu mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaanahi dali.
en: you are permitted to observe it one month later instead, on the evening of the fourteenth day of the second month. Celebrate it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, M pun bi yɛl a ni Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm ka n yɛn niŋ.
en: Balaam answered, I told you before that I can only say what the Lord tells me to say.

dag: amaa ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm maa ti yil tia kaman Yisifu ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: But Pharaoh hanged the baker, and everything happened the way Joseph said it would.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla anzinfa viɛlli yi Speen na, ka zaŋ salima yi Ufaz na. Di nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba mini salindooriba nuhi tuma. Di situra nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa mini zaɣ ʒiɛhi. Di zaa nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba ni mali binshɛŋa.
en: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim ni ti lan jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tibigi bɛ Naa Dauda, ka bɛ ti zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri zaɣ viɛlli o sani dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: After this, the people of Israel will come back and look for the Lord their God and for David their king. In the last days they will come to honor the Lord and his goodness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Asha zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Mishal mini Abidɔn.
en: The tribe of Asher gave them Mishal, Abdon.

dag: Di tahi dokurili zuɣu, amaa zaŋm zilim balli n-tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa kaman a ba la; ka niŋmi nachimbihi kaman a mabihi la;.
en: Dont correct an older man, but encourage him like hes your father; treat younger men like your brothers.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa su bi nɛɔŋ maa puu daa biɛr o bia maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli naa, N dana, zaŋm bia maa ti o ka di ku o. Amaa ka paɣ ŋun la yɛli, Pirigim o buyi, ka o lan pa n dini bee o dini.
en: The real mother, her heart full of love for her son, said to the king, Please, Your Majesty, don't kill the child! Give it to her! But the other woman said, Don't give it to either of us; go on and cut it in two.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku zani, di mi ku niŋ pali.
en: I, the Lord , promise that this will never happen.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, bɛ ni nyɛ zuliya yini ka mali zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini maa zuɣu ka bɛ tumdi lala maa, ka bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm piligu n-na bɔŋɔ; ka binshɛli kani ka bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ niŋ li ka di ku nani.
en: he said: These people are working together because they all speak the same language. This is just the beginning. Soon they will be able to do anything they want.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee daa kpuɣila Atarɔtada wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn Duli polo.
en: This was the territory for the clans of the people of Ephraim. The border of their legacy ran from Ataroth-adar on the east as far as Upper Beth-horon.

dag: Bɛ noya ni yɛtɔɣa piinimi ni jɛritali, ka naari ni putɔɣu ni yinyari.
en: Fools start out talking foolishness and end up speaking awful nonsense.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛ ka Asaf min o mabihi maa be Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa gbini ni bɛ tumdi di tuma sahakam kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: Then David left Asaph and his brothers there in front of the Box of the Lord s Agreement. David left them there to serve in front of it every day.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni bɛ yi me tiŋ la mini di goma maa naai, bɛ ku lan yo farigu balibu kam ti a, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka a nam farigu liɣiri filim.
en: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.

dag: Ka Rut daa chaŋ kabɔɣili maa ni nti shiri niŋ kaman o yidan ma maa ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So Ruth went down to the threshing floor and did everything that her mother-in-law told her to do.

dag: Bipola kpiɔŋ n-nyɛ bɛ jilima, amaa ninkura mi zab piɛla n-nyɛ bɛ jilima.
en: We admire a young man for his strength, but we respect an old man for his gray hair.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi nya ka so tum alahichi, di niŋ kamaata ni yinim bɛn mali Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ŋɔ zaŋ tarimtali biɛhigu yiɣis o zali. Ka lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, dama di pa shɛli ka yi gba ti nya zahimbu.
en: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.

dag: Yi ni daa ti zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni Sinai Zoli gbini ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, Laɣimmi niriba maa na ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ wum n yɛligu din ni chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura saha shɛli zaa bɛ ni be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka wuhi bɛ bihi lala.
en: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord 's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.

dag: Amaa n ni tiligi yi shɛba, ka yi ni shɛba zo n-tiligi takɔbi kum ni zuliya shɛb sani, ka wurim kpe tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations.

dag: ka salo ŋɔ zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋdila takɔbi bee kpani n-tiligir o niriba, dama tɔb ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ tɔbu, ka o mi ni zaŋ ya niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: And all those gathered here will know that the LORD doesnt save by means of sword and spear. The LORD owns this war, and he will hand all of you over to us.

dag: A teei teeku pa di zuɣu kaman binyɛrigu la, ka chɛ ka kom lim zoya.
en: You placed the ocean over it like a robe, and the water covered the mountains.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo bahi yoli din ka bahigu puuni; ka bɛ mini ti Duuma ni o yiko din mali jilima la ni ti woligi taba.
en: They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and from his glorious might.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn boli niriba ka bɛ ka a yiŋ na ti di bindira, nyin bolimila nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni gbariti mini zoomba.
en: Instead, when you give a banquet, invite the poor, crippled, lame, and blind.

dag: Aduna bidibis ayi la ni daa chaŋ miri Yawɛ ka kpi la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: After the death of Aarons two sons, which happened when they approached the LORD and died, the LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: ka ŋun Yaakubu kɔŋko daa kpalim be nyaaŋa. Di saha ka do so daa kana ka o min o ti kpe val ni n-va hal ka biɛɣ ti neerina.
en: But Jacob stayed apart by himself, and a man wrestled with him until dawn broke.

dag: m-mali Naawuni jilima, ka nyɛlisiri kaman bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la, ka lan ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The city had Gods glory. Its brilliance was like a priceless jewel, like jasper that was as clear as crystal.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia, Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛli maa viɛla. Dama o daa yɛlila o suhu ni, Suhudoo mini alaafee yi ni be n ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, di viɛla.
en: King Hezekiah understood this to mean that there would be peace and security during his lifetime, so he replied, The message you have given me from the Lord is good.

dag: M bɔhirila bɔhigu ŋɔ: Bɛ daa bi wum? Bɛ daa wumya ni yɛlimaŋli; dama di sabiya: Bɛ kukoya damli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa; ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ tarisi zaa.
en: But I ask you, didnt they hear it? Definitely! Their voice has gone out into the entire earth, and their message has gone out to the corners of the inhabited world. .

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn kpe tɔb maa tuhibu ni, yin chɛliya ka maligumaaniba kana ti zani tooni n-tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa.
en: When you go to the battle, the priest must go to the soldiers and speak to them.

dag: maligumaaniba deemi li bɛn zaŋdi li tahirina maa sani m-mal li maani Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛŋa din bɔri malibu la.
en: The priests should take the money from their donors and use it to repair the temple wherever such a need for repair is discovered.

dag: Ti dimnim maa ni daa wum ni ti baŋ bɛ ni lɔri nia shɛli maa yɛla, ka baŋ ni Naawuni nyaŋ ba bɛ ni lo nia shɛli maa ni, ka ti zaa daa lan lab gooni maa gbini, ka sokam ti tumd o tuma.
en: Then our enemies heard that we knew about their plans. They knew that God ruined their plans. So we all went back to work on the wall. Everyone went back to their own place and did their part.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpuɣim a jaaŋgbɛ shɛli a ni daa zaŋ fiɛbi Nail la n-niŋ a nuu ni, ka zaŋ Izraɛl kpamba pah amaŋ zuɣu, ka yi gari niriba maa tooni chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Take some of the leaders of Israel with you, and go on ahead of the people. Take along the stick with which you struck the Nile.

dag: Niŋmi lala pɔi ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni neesim naanyi zibigi, ka sagbana chɛ ka saa luna.
en: That is when the light of the sun, the moon, and the stars will grow dim for you, and the rain clouds will never pass away.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo kabiri laɣindina maa, ka o tah alizin birigu maa zuɣu yɛli, Nyin alizin tikpiralan birigu ŋɔ, n yɛr a mi, wari ka chɛ bia maa, ka di lan lab o sanna yaha.
en: Noticing that the crowd had surged together, Jesus spoke harshly to the unclean spirit, Mute and deaf spirit, I command you to come out of him and never enter him again.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa maa zaa yoli, n kɔba ni chɔɣisimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Zɛruya bihi maa nyɛla ninvuɣ yarisi. Yawɛ ni yo tuumbiɛrilana san shɛli din simd o putɔɣu tuma.
en: And it was on the very same day that I was anointed to be the king. These sons of Zeruiah have caused me a lot of trouble. May the Lord give them the punishment they deserve.

dag: O ni daa di nam Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, o daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi nira. O daa dila nam maa n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma anii.
en: at the age of thirty-two, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eight years.

dag: Ka bɛ ti yɛra, Tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ tiŋgban nɛl la kpalim ŋmanila Idɛn puu. Ka niriba lan pali fɔntin shɛŋa din daa wurim leei dabari la zaa ni, ka bɛ me gooni gil li.
en: Everyone will talk about how this land, which was once a wilderness, has become like the Garden of Eden, and how the cities which were torn down, looted, and left in ruins, are now inhabited and fortified.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wun so ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni ŋ-ŋman a; a dol a ni lo alikauli shɛli ka mali yurilim din bi naari zaŋ chaŋ a daba zaa sani.
en: and prayed, Lord God of Israel, there is no god like you in heaven above or on earth below! You keep your covenant with your people and show them your love when they live in wholehearted obedience to you.

dag: Nyamiya o ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ titali shɛm! Hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛlikam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o.
en: You can see that Melchizedek was very great. Abraham, our great ancestor, gave him a tenth of everything he won in battle.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa ti nyo buɣim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni luɣ kasi shee la.
en: You are to take the bull that is offered as a sacrifice for sin and burn it at the specified place outside the Temple area.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n dabili Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: But now hear this, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

dag: Ka yil maa lana daa yi bɛ sani ti yɛli ba, M mabihi, doo maa nyɛla n sana, dinzuɣu di tumiya tuun biɛɣu ŋɔ bee n-tum vi tuuni ŋɔ.
en: But the old man went outside and said to them, No, my friends! Please! Don't do such an evil, immoral thing! This man is my guest.

dag: Chɛ ka a ninni neesim neei niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Accept your servant, and teach me your laws.

dag: Amaa Dauda tɔbbihi maa bɛn daa kula Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Abinɛr tɔbbihi maa ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: But David's soldiers had killed of Abner's men from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Nyama, ka Kush nir la gba daa ti paana nti yɛli, Lahibal suŋ ka n ʒina ni n ti ti nyini n dan naa, dama zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ fa a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: The Ethiopian came and said, Your Majesty, today I have good news! The Lord has rescued you from all your enemies.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi puuni, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili n-deei li.
en: During Hezekiahs th year as king, Sennacherib king of Assyria went to fight against all the strong cities of Judah. Sennacherib defeated those cities.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Musa, Ti kpe yɔɣu, ti zaa ni kpi.
en: The Israelites said to Moses, We are perishing. We are being destroyed. All of us are being destroyed.

dag: O tim a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli, ka chɛ ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa pali.
en: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.

dag: Wɔribariba niŋdi shili, ka takɔbi chɛri piɣibpiɣib, ka kpana nyaɣisira. Ka bɛ ku niriba pam, n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ duyaduya. Kpiimba maa ka tariga, ka bɛ tuuri kpiimba maa.
en: Charging cavalry, flashing sword, and glittering spear; countless slain, masses of corpses, endless dead bodies—they stumble over their dead bodies!.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ tum Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa zaa.
en: So all the work on the Holy Tent, that is, the Meeting Tent, was finished. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka o zo maa ni do duu puuni ha ka garigi yɛl o, Di nahim ma, dama n dunol kparimi ka m mini m bihi do gom ni; dinzuɣu n ku tooi yiɣisi zaŋ li ti a.
en: Imagine further that he answers from within the house, Dont bother me. The door is already locked, and my children and I are in bed. I cant get up to give you anything.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a suhu kpɛh a yɔɣu, ka bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a nini mooi.
en: Why has your mind seized you, why have your eyes flashed.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam kpalim bo ti Duuma, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn zaa kpe n yuli gba bo ma.
en: Then the rest of the world will look for the Lord God— all those of other nations who are my people too. The Lord said this. And he is the one who does all these things. Amos :-.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.

dag: Kalim bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛnkam zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: and to register all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who were qualified to work in the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bɔhi baŋ Ziɔn soli, ka zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri kpa nimaani polo, ka bɛ mini Yawɛ ti laɣim lo alikauli din kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam ka ku yiɣisi, ka bɛ ku lan tam di yɛla.
en: They will search for Zion, turning their faces toward it. They will come and unite with the LORD, in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.

dag: A mini Harannima ni Kannɛnima ni Idɛnnima ni Ashurinima ni Kilimadnim daa niŋdila daabiligu.
en: You also did business with merchants from the cities of Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.

dag: Amaa doo maa yi mali bidibiga ŋun nya o ba ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka ŋun bi tum lala.
en: But suppose he has a child who sees all the sins that his father committed. He becomes alarmed and doesnt do them.

dag: Yi ŋmanila abie tihi din vuɣisi waɣa. Yi ŋmanila pu shɛŋa din do m-baɣ mɔɣili. Yi ŋmanila aloosi ti shɛŋa Yawɛ ni sa. Yi ŋmanila sida ti shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi kom.
en: Like long rows of palms Or gardens beside a river, Like aloes planted by the Lord Or cedars beside the water.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ba ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: So Jacob's sons did as he had commanded them;.

dag: Chɛliya ka n yili yilli ŋɔ ka yi wum, di nyɛla n yura min o tihi puu yilli: N yura m-mal o tihi puu ka di be daboli din tiŋgbani vuhiri zuɣu.
en: Now I will sing a song for my friend, my love song about his vineyard. My friend had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.

dag: nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni, ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba;.
en: then listen to their prayer and request from your heavenly dwelling place. Do what is right for them.

dag: Ʒe tibi a ni doli so shɛli ni, ka a soya zaa ni mali viɛla.
en: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, Bia maa ku tooi wolig o ba, o yi wolig o, o ba maa ni kpi.
en: and we answered that the boy could not leave his father; if he did, his father would die.

dag: A bi kpini shɛli yɛla ŋɔ ni, a mi nuu ka di ni, dama a suhu bi ʒe yim ni Naawuni.
en: You can have no part or share in Gods word because your heart isnt right with God.

dag: Yawɛ, a yi yɛn niŋ ti daalahichi laasabu, ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee ni tiligi?.
en: If you kept a record of our sins, who could escape being condemned?.

dag: Yi salima mini yi daanzinfa zahimya ka di zahimbu maa din ya shɛhira biɛɣu, ka ni di yi niŋgbuna kaman buɣim ni diri binyara shɛm la. Yi kahi azichi guli dabisa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Your gold and silver have rusted, and their rust will be evidence against you. It will eat your flesh like fire. Consider the treasure you have hoarded in the last days.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Nyamiya, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: Then he returned to the disciples and said, Are you still sleeping and resting? Look! The hour has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to the power of sinners.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka anabinim zaa yɛli ni o Masia ni ti di wahala pam la n-niŋ pali maa.
en: But God said these things would happen. Through the prophets he said that his Messiah would suffer and die. I have told you how God made this happen.

dag: Amaa m bi lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ shɛli, man dee yi ni tooi naai tuun shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni ti ma la; dina n-nyɛ ni m moli Naawuni daalibarika lahibal suŋ hal ti paai n nyɛvili tariga.
en: But I don't care what happens to me, as long as I finish the work the Lord Jesus gave me to do. And this work is to tell the good news about God's gift of undeserved grace.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yili yilli ŋɔ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yɛli, Ti tiŋ ŋɔ mali yaa! Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun guli di goma!.
en: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.

dag: Nachimbili ni kpuɣiri paɣipiɛliga shɛm la, lala ka bɛn me a zali yɛn kpuɣ a. Aŋgo suhu ni piɛl o daamiliya zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a Naawuni suhu yɛn piɛl a zuɣu.
en: As a young man takes a bride and she belongs to him, so your land will belong to your children. As a man is happy with his new wife, so your God will be happy with you.

dag: A yi ni doli Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga, a biɛhigu ni tɔŋ. Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, Di zɔri dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: If you obey all the laws which the Lord gave to Moses for Israel, you will be successful. Be determined and confident, and don't let anything make you afraid.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka bɛ zab Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi na maa.
en: Pilate knew that they had handed Jesus over to him because they were jealous of him.

dag: Ka hal n yi nyu bara gba, m bi tum jɛrilim, dama n ni tɔɣisila yɛlimaŋli di puuni. Amaa n zaɣisila lala niŋbu ni di chɛ ka so ku duhi ma n-gar o ni nya ma ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu bee o ni wum ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu.
en: If I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be telling the truth. But I will not boast, because I do not want any of you to have a higher opinion of me than you have as a result of what you have seen me do and heard me say.

dag: ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nini nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka o nya binshɛli ka di kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la, ka di sirigiri o sanna hal ti paai tiŋa.
en: He saw heaven opened and something coming down that looked like a large sheet being lowered by its four corners to the earth.

dag: Di saha ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli naa Bɔ n-niŋ ka ba kpiŋ ŋɔ doli yɛri n dan naa zilima lala? Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: Abishai said, Your Majesty, this man is as useless as a dead dog! He shouldn't be allowed to curse you. Let me go over and chop off his head.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa yi saha mini zibisim yiko saha m-paai.
en: Day after day I was with you in the temple, but you didnt arrest me. But this is your time, when darkness rules.

dag: Paɣisarili ni tooi tam o salima yɛri yɛla? Bee amiliya ni tooi tam o daamiliya binyɛra yɛla? Amaa n niriba ŋɔ bɛn ni tam n yɛla dabisi shɛŋa ka kalinli.
en: Does a young woman forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding dress? Yet you have forgotten me days without end!.

dag: Dama ti daa wum yi ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm la yɛla;.
en: For we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of your love for all God's people.

dag: Amaa Masia yi be yi ni, hal yi niŋgbuna yi ni kpi alahichi zuɣu gba, yi shihi lee ni ne yi ni yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: But if Christ lives in you, the Spirit is life for you because you have been put right with God, even though your bodies are going to die because of sin.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa lan nyɛ: Maɔn mini Kamɛl ni Zif ni Juta.
en: The people of Judah were also given these towns: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah.

dag: Ka Jɔab mini Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim ni wɔɣira zaa daa pahi Abishai zuɣu ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ni bɛ ti biɛhi Bikiri bia Shiiba maa naba.
en: So Joab's men, the royal bodyguards, and all the other soldiers left Jerusalem with Abishai to go after Sheba.

dag: A yi niŋ Naawuni ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ, dindina a wumsim maa ni baligi. Ka niriba ŋɔ zaa ni lab bɛ biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: If you do this and God directs you, then you will be able to endure. And all these people will be able to go back to their homes much happier.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi binnana ka mali wun shɛŋa din ka buchi nyuri bara la zaa di vi; dama wuna maa gbaanila o tooni.
en: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord .

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi Azimɔn maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni m-mali lala hal ni teeku ni.
en: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, yum maa yi paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, o shiri nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: The priest will examine it. If the infection has turned white, the priest will declare the infected person clean; at that point, the person is clean.

dag: Ka suhudoo daa be Naa Jɛhɔshafat ʒiɛmani maa ni, dama o Naawuni daa ti o vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: so Jehoshaphat ruled in peace, and God gave him security on every side.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Ahimaaz ba.
en: Ahitub of Zadok, Zadok of Ahimaaz.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim la zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni chirigibu min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol la tooni.
en: Put the altar for entirely burned offerings in front of the entrance to the meeting tent dwelling.

dag: Ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni pun kari dunia ŋɔ naa saria.
en: And he will show them how wrong their judgment is, because their leader has already been condemned.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba bi gbɛri kum, amaa o chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The Lord takes care of good people and gives them the food they need, but he keeps the wicked from getting what they want.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a so Tɛbis din baɣi Nail ka kom gil li, ka teeku nyɛ din taɣiri li ka kom nyɛ di gooni la?.
en: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.

dag: Sokam ni mali niriba ŋɔ ansarisi, ka salindi salima maani ba ansarisi yɛra, Mbusim be yinim bɛn laɣisi binshɛŋa din pa yi dini duhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Yi yɛn deeri binyara yi sandiriba sani sɔŋdi yi sani hal ti paai bɔ saha.
en: Wont everyone tell parables about him or mocking poems concerning him? They will say: Doom to the one who multiplies what doesnt belong to him and who increases his own burden. How long?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kumiya bidibbihi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: So now kill every boy and kill every woman who has had sexual intercourse.

dag: ka yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka yi mini yi bihi ti deeg o noli ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa kaman n ni zaani ya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: and you must return to the LORD your God, obeying his voice, in line with all that Im commanding you right now—you and your children—with all your mind and with all your being.

dag: ka n ti lan labi m ba yiŋ yaha ni suhudoo, dindina Yawɛ n-ni nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: and bring me safely home again, you will be my God.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa yi Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na. O daa nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira m-be nimaani.
en: Now there was a young man from Bethlehem in Judah, from the area of the Judahite clan. He was a Levite residing there as an immigrant.

dag: Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Aran.
en: Dishan had two sons. They were Uz and Aran.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: n teei n nuu jɛndi ya, ka zaŋ ya ti zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di ninvuɣ shɛba, ka n ti kun ya niriba maa sani n-kpihim yi birili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. N ni ti kun ya, di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: And so I will hand you over to enemies who will rob you. I will completely destroy you. There won't be enough of your people left to be a nation ever again, and you will know that I, the Lord , have done these things.

dag: saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋuni bɛ biɛhigu shee, bee n-do bɛ dooshee n-gu?.
en: Do you send an animal into their den?.

dag: A ni kul yiɣisina, a na mi n-zali asiba di ni yɛn piligi saha shɛli? Ka chɛ ka biɛɣu neebu mi di biɛhigu shee?.
en: Did you ever in your life command the morning to begin or the day to dawn?.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, dama di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani ni bɛ di baŋ li, ka bɛ mi daa zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: But the followers did not understand what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them so that they could not understand it. But they were afraid to ask Jesus about what he said.

dag: Asa daa tum din tuhi ka viɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Asa did what the Lord his God said was good and right.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayɔbu bɛ tinsi maa ni na nti pahi Gibianim zuɣu.
en: They called out twenty-six thousand soldiers from their cities that day. Besides these, the citizens of Gibeah gathered seven hundred specially chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a strand of hair and never miss.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ lahibali ni daa ti nti to Hazɔr Naa Jabin saha shɛli, ka o daa tim ti yɛli Madɔn Naa Jɔbab mini Shimrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: However, listen closely to what I have to say to you and all the people.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri kul yɛrigila mɔɣu ni; ka bindira kul zibigi vinvama ni, ka bɛ tahira, ka laɣim duhiri bɛ yɛhi yiini yila suhupiɛlli zuɣu.
en: The meadowlands are covered with flocks, the valleys decked out in grain— they shout for joy; they break out in song!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ka mali nia biɛri la mirina. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋa ka chɛ a zaligu.
en: Here come those who have evil plans to hurt me. They live far away from your teachings.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntuhi mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim. Ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Like them, it also had guardrooms, decorated inner walls, an entrance room, and windows all around. Its total length was feet and its width feet.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o mini ba zaa gban tiŋa ka o suhi Naawuni.
en: When Paul finished, he knelt down with them and prayed.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me yaɣ shɛli din daa be pia din du pam la tooni hal ti paai Ofɛl gooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: The men of Tekoa built the next section, their second one, from a point opposite the large tower guarding the Temple as far as the wall near Ophel.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tuɣili tulaale zim din bi be kasi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu. Yi mi di zaŋya biŋkɔbigu nyo buɣim bee n-zaŋ bindir kuma mali sara di zuɣu bee m-booi wain bahi di zuɣu.
en: Do not offer on this altar any forbidden incense, any animal offering, or any grain offering, and do not pour out any wine offering on it.

dag: Aduna mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya Musa ka o ninni nyaɣisira maa ka bɛ zɔri ni bɛ mir o.
en: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw the skin of Moses face shining brightly, they were afraid to come near him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Daniɛl daa ti kana. O nyɛla wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia ni be so ni, ka n daa yɛl o n zahindi maa. N daa yɛl o mi:.
en: Finally, Daniel came to me. I told him about my dream.

dag: ka o suhu ti maai ka o tam a ni niŋ o shɛm maa yɛla. Di nyaaŋa ka n naan yi tim na ka bɛ ti zaŋ a na. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn kɔŋ m bidibis ayi zaa dahin yini.
en: and forgets what you have done to him, I'll send for you to come home. Why should I lose both of my sons on the same day.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni ka jɛmdila Naawuni ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbani maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛ ʒini maa buɣa.
en: But they sinned against the God their ancestors had worshiped. They began worshiping the false gods of the people God had destroyed, the people who had lived in the land before them.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yi ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, bɛn kpalimmi zani di kom maa ni baalim.
en: The priests will carry the Box of the Agreement. Tell them this, Walk to the shore of the Jordan River and stop just before you step into the water.

dag: Naawuni, ninʒeensinim yiɣisi lu n zuɣu; ninkuunsinim laɣimya m-bɔri ni bɛ yihi n nyɛvili, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi lihi nya a.
en: Proud people are attacking me, God. A gang of cruel men is trying to kill me. They dont respect you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka malaika kana ti wuhi ya soli, ka n kari Keenannim mini Amɔrinim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima.
en: Ill send a messenger before you. Ill drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, a mi ni bihi ŋɔ ka yaa, ka biŋkɔb bihi bɛn mɔɣiri be biŋkɔbiri maa ni, ka di simdi ni n chɛ ka n zaɣa be bɛ ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti yi taɣi ba chaŋ pam dahin yini, bɛ zaa ni kpi.
en: But Jacob answered, Master, you know traveling is hard on children, and I have to look after the sheep and goats that are nursing their young. If my animals travel too much in one day, they will all die.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ wain tihi pum ti yɛn kpahi lu ka di wala moori saha shɛli, Itiɔpianim dimnim ni kana ti ku ba ka di bi to. Bɛ ni ti niŋ ba kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sua ŋ-ŋmahiri wain tiwula din teei shɛm la.
en: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.

dag: Amaa sanʒiɛɣu n-lee ni ti ʒe ti ti bahi tiŋgban bil din be kom sunsuuni zuɣu.
en: But we will first be shipwrecked on some island.

dag: Amaa n zaŋla Lɛvinim maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bikpamba zaa.
en: But now I will take the Levites in their place. I will take the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons from the other families in Israel.

dag: Bin yini mi kɔŋko n-simdi bɔbu. Mariama pii din viɛli maa, ka di mi ku lan yi o nuu ni.
en: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti yiɣisi wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋchaŋ ti paai Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɔpiɛligu ni n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
