en: Then people began to move from the East. They found a plain in the land of Babylonia and stayed there to live.

dag: Amaa ka sapashin la daa bɔri ni o tiligi Pool ka gɔŋ ba ni bɛ di niŋ lala, ka naɣ yɛli ba mi ni bɛn mi kɔduɣili, bɛn lum kom maa ni n-daŋ duɣi du.
en: However, the centurion wanted to save Paul, so he stopped them from carrying out their plan. He ordered those who could swim to jump overboard first and head for land.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba. Sool daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

dag: Hakalia bia Nɛhimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pisi puuni gol so bɛ ni booni Kisilɛv ni, man Nɛhimia daa bela Susa tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin zuɣu la ni.
en: This is the account of what Nehemiah son of Hacaliah accomplished. In the month of Kislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was emperor of Persia, I, Nehemiah, was in Susa, the capital city.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni.
en: God said, I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. So they were not still dead, because he is the God only of living people.

dag: Nabipuɣinsi be a dundɔŋ ni paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima la ni, ka a paani ʒe a nudirigu polo n-ye salima din yi Ofiri na.
en: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi gbaag omaŋa ŋmanila bɛ ni kabi kpe gooni ni gili tin shɛli ni shɛm la.
en: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.

dag: N daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛli Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa tim ma ka n yi Kadɛshibarinia n-kana ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; ka daa ʒi di lahiba maŋli ti yɛl o.
en: I was years old when Moses the LORDs servant sent me from Kadesh-barnea to scout out the land. I brought back a report to him of what I really thought.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya paɣisar shɛb bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi kɔbisinahi Jabɛshigiliadnim maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Shilo sansani din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: Among the people of Jabesh-gilead, they found four hundred young women who had not known a man intimately or slept with one, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh in the land of Canaan.

dag: ka yi lula ŋun ye binyɛr suma la sizuura ka yɛl o, N dana, ʒinim ʒiishe viɛlli ŋɔ ni; ka ŋmaligi yɛli nandan la ŋuna, Ʒe nimaani bee kamina nti ʒin tiŋa n naba ŋɔ shee.
en: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni sokam zaa kpi yim, ka saria karibu lee be di nyaaŋa.
en: Everyone must die once, and after that be judged by God.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti zaɣisi zuɣulaannim maa noli; ka kul jɛmdila wuna. Di daa bi yuui ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ yaannim bɛn daa doli Yawɛ zaligunim ni daa doli so shɛl la, ka shiri bi dol li.
en: But they wouldnt even obey their own leaders because they were unfaithful, following other gods and worshipping them. They quickly deviated from the way of their ancestors, who had obeyed the LORDs commands, and didnt follow their example.

dag: Tiŋgbani ni ti dam damdi biɛɣu n-tahi bɔɣi n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: The earth will crack and shatter and split open.

dag: M min a n-simdi lala, dama tinim tuma nyɔri ka ti diri ŋɔ; amaa ŋun bi tum taal shɛli.
en: We got what was coming to us, but he didn't do anything wrong.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ fukumsi mini bɛ yiko zaa n-ti biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: All ten of these rulers have the same purpose. And they will give their power and authority to the beast.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ san la nya taali chɛ m-paŋ, niriba maa zaa nuu ni be chirimbu maa ni la zuɣu.
en: The entire Israelite community and the immigrant residing among them will be forgiven, because all the people acted unintentionally.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisa lan lab Kapɛrinium ka di mol gili ni o lab yiŋ na.
en: After a few days, Jesus went back to Capernaum, and people heard that he was at home.

dag: Saa miri niŋdi Yawɛ tihi pam, o ni biri Lɛbanɔn sida ti shɛŋa la.
en: Our Lord , your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.

dag: Bɛ kpibu bi to, yuntisuɣu ka niriba maa tabitabi kpi, ka bɛ zaŋ wɔɣira maa chaŋ ka di pala daadam nuu n-niŋ li.
en: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us.

dag: nti zaŋ tulaale zim maa niŋ buɣim maa ni Yawɛ tooni, ka chɛ ka di nyɔhi tuɣi kpe bimpindigu din pili Alikauli Adaka la, di yi pa lala o ni kpi.
en: He will put the incense on the fire before the LORD so that the cloud of incense conceals the cover that is on top of the covenant document, or else he will die.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Damaskusnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Giliadnima nahindi biɛɣu.
en: The Lord says, The people of Damascus have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They treated the people of Gilead with savage cruelty.

dag: M bi baŋ mmaŋmaŋ yɛla gba, dama m bi tumdi mmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri ni n tum shɛli, amaa n ni je shɛl la, dina ka n tumda.
en: I dont know what Im doing, because I dont do what I want to do. Instead, I do the thing that I hate.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, a kul yɛn dola nimaani hal ni saha dini? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn neei a gom ni?.
en: You lazy people, how long are you going to lie there? When will you get up?.

dag: Ka Zɛdɛkia ŋun daa nyɛ Chɛnaana bia la daa zaŋ kuriti kuri binyila kɔtomsi ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Dimbɔŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe n-ku Sirianim maa zaa. .
en: Zedekiah, Chenaanahs son, made iron horns for himself and said, This is what the LORD says: With these horns you will gore the Arameans until theres nothing left of them.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa chɛ naɣikɔra maa, ka guui doli Ilaija nti yɛl o, Chɛ ka n chɛbisi m ba mini m ma pɔi ka naanyi dol a. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labima, ka n yɛl a la wula?.
en: Elisha stopped plowing and ran after him. Let me kiss my parents goodbye, then I'll go with you, he said. You can go, Elijah said. But remember what I've done for you.

dag: Ka o daa ti nyu tihi maa wain kuli n-do o zaɣim o suɣili ni.
en: After he drank some of the wine, he became drunk, took off his clothes, and lay naked in his tent.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti yɛligi, ka chɛ ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ tintarisi yɛligi pahi, ka ti ti a jilima di zuɣu.
en: Lord , you have helped the nation you love. You made our nation grow and brought honor to yourself.

dag: Paɣiba bɛn zaa be naa nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima. Bɛ ni yɛli, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa tim ti boli Napaɣ Vashiti ni o kana ka o zaɣisi.
en: The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu paai Gazanima, ka Ashikɛlɔnnim fo. Yinim Anaki zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ binyara zaŋ ŋmahiri yimaŋa?.
en: The people from Gaza will be sad and shave their heads. The people from Ashkelon will be silenced. Survivors from the valley, how long will you cut yourselves?.

dag: M bi yɛn kari ba yuun yini puuni, ka tiŋgbani maa doya yoli, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yɛligi nti muɣisi ya.
en: I wont drive them out before you in a single year so the land wont be abandoned and the wild animals wont multiply around you.

dag: Di yi nyɛla nir min o kpee chaŋla mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti ŋma dari, ka o ti yaai kpaŋ ni o ŋmaai tia luhi, ka kpan zuɣu ŋooi n-ŋme o kpee maa ka o kpi, ŋun ku o maa ni tooi zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin yin ni tiligi.
en: For example, if two of you go into the forest together to cut wood and if, as one of you is chopping down a tree, the ax head comes off the handle and kills the other, you can run to one of those three cities and be safe.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba ni ti kurim dunɔdali maa shee Yawɛ tooni vuhim dabisa dali mini goli palli dabisa dali.
en: On the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon, the common people will also worship the Lord at that gate.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti ŋmaligi chaŋ bɛ namda ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani.
en: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. N ni ti kari ya saria Izraɛl tintariga, ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You will die by the sword. I will punish you here in Israel, so you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di ni simdi ni yi yɛli shɛm nyɛla: Ti Duuma yi saɣi, ti ni be ka niŋ dimbɔŋɔ bee dini ŋɔ.
en: You should say, If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me again and said:.

dag: Dunianim ku tooi zaɣisi ya, amaa bɛ ni zaɣisi mani, n ni yɛri ni bɛ tuma bie la zuɣu.
en: The world cant hate you. It hates me, though, because I testify that its works are evil.

dag: Yinim peentɔriba zaa, teemiya zani yi zaashɛhi gili Babilɔn. Tomiya ba piɛma, di tɔn ya ka guui peen gaŋa, dama bɛ tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Take up your positions around Babylon, all you archers; now shoot at her; save none of your arrows, because shes sinned against the LORD.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpaɣim li, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti kpe Naawuni nam ni, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: If your eye causes you to fall into sin, tear it out. Its better for you to enter Gods kingdom with one eye than to be thrown into hell with two.

dag: N suhu daa yiɣisiya bahi n niriba zuɣu, ka n daa niŋ ba kaman bɛ pala n niriba la. N daa zaŋ ba niŋla yi nuu ni, ka yi daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu, hal ka daa nahim bɛ ninkura pam.
en: I was angry with my people; I treated them as no longer mine: I put them in your power, and you showed them no mercy; even the aged you treated harshly.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun garigi bɔhigu ni yɛlimaŋli nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zɔsimdi.
en: An honest answer is a sign of true friendship.

dag: Ka timpani yi bi kum tɔb chiriga kumsi ŋuni n-lee ni mali shili chaŋ tɔb tuhibu?.
en: And if the one who plays the bugle does not sound a clear call, who will prepare for battle?.

dag: Malimiya m biɛhigu shee mini di puuni nɛma ka di be kaman n ni yɛn wuh a ka yi mal li shɛm.
en: You should follow the blueprints that I will show you for the dwelling and for all its equipment.

dag: A mi nini bi tiɣiri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la.
en: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.

dag: Ka din pahi piniyini gbaai Ɛliashib, ka din pahi pinaayi gbaai Jakim.
en: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim.

dag: Banima n-lee be kaman mani? Bɛ wuhim li, bɛ wuhim li n tooni. Banima n-daa lee yɛli binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ yɛla zali kurimbuni ha. Bɛ yɛlim ti binshɛŋa din na yɛn niŋ yɛla.
en: There is no other God like me. If there is, that god should speak now. Let him lay out everything he has done since the time I made these ancient people. Let him show me the signs he gave long ago that prove he knew what would happen in the future.

dag: Yi tumdila yi ba tuma. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti pala dagɔribihi; ti malila ba yino, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: You are doing your fathers works. They said, Our ancestry isnt in question! The only Father we have is God.

dag: Nyamiya, n ʒiɛla dunol ni n-niŋdi gaafara, ka ŋun wum n kukoli ka yooi, n ni kpe dilan sani ka m min o ti laɣim di.
en: Listen! I stand at the door and knock; if any hear my voice and open the door, I will come into their house and eat with them, and they will eat with me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi yɛli, Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ pala alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu yɛtɔɣa. Alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu ni tooi neei zom nina.
en: But others said, These arent the words of someone controlled by a demon. A demon cannot heal the eyes of a blind man.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dikili, ka di barilim nyɛ mita ata. Ka du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣa zuɣu gil la zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi.
en: Then the man measured the wall of the Temple. It was cubits thick. There were side rooms all around the Temple. They were cubits wide.

dag: Kum chɛ ka ti niŋgbuna biimi kaman duduhugu puuni la.
en: Our skin is as hot as an oven because of the burning heat of famine.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti chɛ ka dimdi kpe Abimilɛk mini Shɛkɛmnim sunsuuni, ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa.
en: Then God made Abimelech and the men of Shechem hostile to each other, and they rebelled against Abimelech.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place Attack on Uzzah, and it's been called that ever since.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti niŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: They obeyed and did what Jesus told them to do. They prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Zoya sɔhirila o tooni, ka daboya nyɛligira ka tiŋgbani mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋuhir o tooni.
en: At the sight of the Lord , mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti, dama ti niŋ yɛda ni ti ka galimi ti suhuri tɛha ni; ka di nyɛla ti ni bɔri ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka di tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Pray for us. Were sure that we have a good conscience, and we want to do the right thing in every way.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya Juda fɔntinsi ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa tɔhi liɣiri ka yi zaŋ li na ka ti ti maani yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuuni kam. Niŋmiya lala yomyom. Amaa ka Lɛvinim maa daa bi niŋdi yomyom.
en: Joash called the priests and the Levites together. He said to them, Go out to the towns of Judah and gather the money all the Israelites pay every year. Use that money to rebuild your Gods Temple. Hurry and do this. But the Levites didnt hurry.

dag: Kpiɔŋlana, lom a takɔbi tabil a gbalipini a jilima min a nam dariza ni.
en: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Yawɛ wuhiri ya la zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe ni biɛlifu kpe. O niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka yi lɛb lu yi kpaya zuɣu n-nya dansi, ka zana gbahi ya, ka bɛ zaŋ ya chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: That is why the Lord is going to teach you letter by letter, line by line, lesson by lesson. Then you will stumble with every step you take. You will be wounded, trapped, and taken prisoner.

dag: Ka o ma daa wuh o o ni yɛn suhi shɛli; ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛli Naa Hɛrɔd, Ŋmam Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu n-niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti ma.
en: Herodias told her daughter what to ask for. So she said to Herod, Give me the head of John the Baptizer here on this plate.

dag: Pita ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm ka bɛn doli Yɛhudianim gunibu kali soli daa galim o.
en: When Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-zaŋdi kom duri zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka di leeri sakom.
en: He draws up drops of water that distill rain from his flood.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yiɣisi dol o paɣ maa chaŋ doo maa sani ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa tɔɣisi paɣ ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa la? Ka o yɛli, mani.
en: Manoah got up and followed his wife. He came to the man and said to him, Are you the man who spoke to this woman? I am, he replied.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, garim niriba maa tooni leei bɛ zuɣulana ka yi lan gbaai soli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni.
en: Then he told me to go and lead you, so that you could take possession of the land that he had promised to give to your ancestors.

dag: A daabiligu maa ni daa ti yɛligi, a daa zaŋla gadama kpɛh a kɔbili ni, ka tum alahichi, dinzuɣu ka n kar a Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu bahi kaman daɣiri bini maa, ka chɛrubi ŋun daa gul a maa mi kar a yihi buɣim kuɣa maa ni.
en: But because of your trade, your oppressive business practices piled up, and you became impure. So I expelled you from Gods mountain. I removed you, winged creature, guardian, from among the stones of fire.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ka wɔɣawɔɣa, ka nyɛ Anaki zuliya bɛn nyɛ yi ni pun mi shɛb la. Yi pun wum ka niriba yɛri bɛ yɛla, Ŋuni n-leei ni tooi zani Anakinim tooni.
en: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.

dag: O yi di nyɛla dikili, ti naan me anzinfa pia tam o zuɣu; ka o yi di nyɛla dunoli, ti naan zaŋ sida dapaɣa yo o.
en: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ ŋman yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, o ni shihi kpima n-tum alahichi shɛl la zuɣu. Ka o lan mal o zuɣu maa ka di be kasi dindali maa.
en: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.

dag: Amaa so yi ti yihi yɛli ya, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa, yin di dinya li ŋun yɛli ya maa zuɣu mini suhu ni tɛha zuɣu;.
en: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?.

dag: Doo maa yi di pala Naawuni nira, o naan ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: If this man wasnt from God, he couldnt do this.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zaŋ zaligu din yi Yawɛ sanna zali Izraɛlnima. O daa yɛli ba, Yisifu zuliya niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Then Moses commanded the Israelites according to the LORDs word: The tribe of Josephs descendants are correct in what theyre saying.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di yipa kahigi wuhi ti Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira kandina la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa nyaŋ kum zaa, ka kahigi wuhi ni nyɛvili mini niŋgbun shɛli din bi poori beni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu.
en: Now his grace is revealed through the appearance of our savior, Christ Jesus. He destroyed death and brought life and immortality into clear focus through the good news.

dag: Ka biɛɣuni asiba, wuntaŋ yi sa kul puhi na, yin kamiyana ti liri ba tiŋ maa ni. Gaal min o niriba maa yi sa yina ni yi mini ba zaŋ nya taba, yin niŋmiya ba yi ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Get up the next morning at sunrise and rush out of your hiding places to attack the town. Gaal and his followers will come out to fight you, but you will easily defeat them.

dag: O daa piila o dabili Dauda, o daa yih o la piɛgulibo ni.
en: He chose David to be his special servant. He took him from the sheep pens.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya azaaba mini muɣisigu ni maa. Ka yɛli, Aai! Bom naa ti ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi zuliya kam laɣimmi tab gbilligbilli ka Yawɛ sanna.
en: God has rescued you from your troubles and hard times. But you have rejected your God and have asked for a king. Now each tribe and clan must come near the place of worship so the Lord can choose a king.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa gbaŋ min o nimdi zaa ni o zuɣu ni o biɛhi ni o namanama ni o bindi.
en: But he shall take its skin, all its flesh, its head, its legs, and its internal organs, including the intestines.

dag: Ammɔnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba ŋmaligi Jɔab mabia Abishai sani guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni, ka chɛ Abishai Jɔab mabia maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they also fled from his brother Abishai and retreated into the city. So Joab returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛndan lee bela ya? Ka zaligubaŋda lee bela ya? Ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛlibuɣisira lee bela ya? Pa Naawuni m-pun wuhi ni dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim?.
en: So what does this say about the philosopher, the law expert, or anyone in this world who is skilled in making clever arguments? God has made the wisdom of the world look foolish.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa du nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa nti ti suɣili zali Absalom, ka Absalom daa mal o ba mamanim maa dooni nimaani Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: So they set up a tent for Absalom on the palace roof, and in the sight of everyone Absalom went in and had intercourse with his father's concubines.

dag: Ŋunkam kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di nyaaŋa o ni nya yurilim dilan sani n-gari ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o.
en: Correct someone, and later they will thank you. That is much better than just saying something to be nice.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi be fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ŋɔ, yi bi wum fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm? Yɛlimiya ma!.
en: Let me ask those of you who want to be subject to the Law: do you not hear what the Law says?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛ ka n ʒim yi n-lu tiŋa tiŋgban shɛli din mini Yawɛ shee wɔɣa ni taba ŋɔ ni, dama Izraɛl naa kana ti kariti doli ma kaman nir ni kariti doli kɔriŋga zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Don't let me die in a land far away from the Lord . I'm no more important than a flea! Why should the king of Israel hunt me down as if I were a bird in the mountains.

dag: Di simdi ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛlaa maa zuɣu nyɛla lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛbihi la zuɣu dina, o kul bom o ni bɔri ni o ti shɛm tariga, ka bo kpam lita ata tahili kam zuɣu.
en: a grain offering of one ephah for the ram, and a grain offering at his discretion for the lambs, with one hin of oil for each ephah.

dag: Ka n daa deei litaafi bila maa malaika maa nuu ni n-zaŋ ŋubi; ka di shiri malisi n nol ni kaman shir la, ka n ni daa ti ŋub li naai, ka di shiri to m puuni.
en: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.

dag: N ni daa nya ka a bihi la ni shɛb doli yɛlimaŋli kaman ti Ba Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm la, di daa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: How happy I was to find that some of your children live in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.

dag: O ni daa paai ni, o daa kuhila fabila kuhigu m-boli Daniɛl bɔh o, Daniɛl, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ dabili ŋɔ, a Naawuni so a ni jɛmdi viɛnyɛliŋga maa tooi fa a gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi.
en: He was anxious and shouted, Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions.

dag: Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Shɛbɛr mini Tirihana.
en: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ŋarima ni n-labisi Ijipti; n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni yi nini ku lan nya luɣ shɛl la. Ka yi ti zaŋ yimaŋ ni yi kɔhi yi dimnim maa zuɣu nimaani n-leei bɛ dabidɔbba mini bɛ dabipaɣiba, amaa ka ŋun ni dan ya ku beni.
en: Finally, the LORD will take you back to Egypt in ships, by the route I promised you would never see again. There you will try to sell yourselves as slaves—both male and female—but no one will want to buy you.

dag: Ti nyɛla jɛra Masia zuɣu, amaa ka yinima nyɛ yɛnnim Masia puuni. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima, amaa ka yinima nyɛ kpiɔŋlaannima. Yi nyɛla bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima, amaa ka tinim nyɛ bɛ ni ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: We are fools for Christ, but you think you are so wise in Christ. We are weak, but you think you are so strong. People give you honor, but they dont honor us.

dag: Hal bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka ti ku yihi waazu din tahiri tiliginsim na la n-ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alahichi shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni bɛ tum zan tariga; amaa Naawuni suhuyiɣisili la pun paai ba.
en: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni zali zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili be kom ni ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili gbamdi tiŋgban ni.
en: This, then, is the law about animals and birds, about everything that lives in the water, and everything that moves on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Naa daa tim boli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm kpamba zaa na.
en: King Josiah summoned all the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Chɛ ka buɣim salinɛma lu bɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi bɔɣ zilima ni, ka bɛ ku lan tooi yi di ni na.
en: Let burning coals fall on them! Let them fall into deep pits and never get out again!.

dag: O ni ti mali luɣ kasi shee maa, ka mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka yo maligumaaniba mini niriba maa zaa daalahichi samli.
en: and perform the ritual to purify the Most Holy Place, the rest of the Tent of the Lord 's presence, the altar, the priests, and all the people of the community.

dag: Yɛm kuhiri pampam solɔri zuɣu, o duhir o yee niriba laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Wisdom shouts in the street; in the public square she raises her voice.

dag: Ŋmɛnditoya kana ti bela tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zoya zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ tɔbu n-lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam; ka so ku tiligi.
en: The empty hills are covered with soldiers who have come to destroy everything. The Lord is using them to punish that land from one end to the other. No one is safe.

dag: Shɛm daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Shɛm ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Aripakishad, yuma ayi din daa doli dunia ŋɔ kom dibu nyaaŋa la.
en: Two years after the flood, when Shem was , he had a son named Arpachshad. He had more children and died at the age of . This is a list of his descendants:.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din be naa noli ni, ka o ka alahichi saria karibu ni.
en: The king speaks with divine authority; his decisions are always right.

dag: A ko pin titali zali amaŋa, ka me binshɛŋa din dundu zal amaŋa niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam.
en: but you also built places on every street corner.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa yɛli do so ŋun kpaŋ maa, Zuŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali; di bi luhi ni a kpuɣ a bindoo maa n-ʒiri li chana.
en: The Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, Its the Sabbath; you arent allowed to carry your mat.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ la.
en: The Scriptures say, If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa woligi piɛbihi bɛ ko, ka ŋmaligi biŋkɔbiri maa nina kpa Leeban biŋkɔbiri bɛn mali bomaboma mini zaɣ sabila zaa la polo; ka wolig o biŋkɔbiri zali bɛ kɔŋko ka bi chɛ ka bɛ laɣim Leeban biŋkɔbiri maa ni.
en: Jacob sorted out the lambs, turning the flock to face the striped and black ones in Labans flock but keeping his flock separate, setting them apart from Labans flock.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa tim ni bɛ kuli ti yɛli Dauda tɔb maa lahibali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Joab sent a report to David about what happened in the battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaɣisi n noli yi ni bi bahi yi ʒiʒiinitab mini yi zɔnim maa zuɣu. N yɛn tin ya la faako. Faako din nyɛ tɔbu mini alɔbo ni dimpooi. N ni chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa dabiɛm. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Gidiɔn zuɣu na, ka o zaŋ kikaa piɛb boli Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni bɛ kana ti dol o.
en: Then the LORDs spirit came over Gideon, and he sounded the horn and summoned the Abiezrites to follow him.

dag: Ŋunkam gariti ʒiɛrila o nɛma; ka o leeg o ʒiʒiinitab ni maani so ansarisi.
en: All those who pass by plunder him. Hes nothing but a joke to his neighbors.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ka dindina tim ti bindirigu maa sahakam.
en: Sir, they asked him, give us this bread always.

dag: Inhii, n suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga bela Asirianim nuu ni.
en: The Lord said, Assyria! I use Assyria like a club to punish those with whom I am angry.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba min o ma ni Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam bɛn daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba.
en: Ahaziah disobeyed the Lord , just as his father, his mother, and Jeroboam had done. They all led Israel to sin.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ; ka biasani maa gba daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.

dag: Manaasa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Makiri daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Makirinima. Makiri bia n-daa nyɛ Giliad; ka Giliad daŋ niriba nyɛ Giliadnima.
en: The tribe of Manasseh. Machir son of Manasseh was the father of Gilead, and the following clans traced their ancestry to Gilead:.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ a ni pun darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili alaka; ka nahind a ni ti shɛb dansi la pahira.
en: Because they go after those youve already struck; they talk about the pain of those youve already pierced.

dag: Dama ti Duuma n-daa chɛ ka Siria tɔbbihi maa wum tɔbbihi pam chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri kandina vuri ka bɛ yɛli taba, Izraɛl naa dala Hiti nanim mini Ijipti nanim bahi ti na.
en: the Lord had made the Aramean camp hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a strong army. They had said to each other, Listen! Israels king has hired the Hittite and Egyptian kings to come against us.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n shia yɛn siɣi; ka wahala dabisa gbaai ma gbibi.
en: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.

dag: Ka Sintani daa yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣili ŋɔ leei bindirigu.
en: The devil said to him, If you are the Son of God, tell this rock to become bread.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha dabili m-be.
en: Whoever wants to be first must serve the rest of you like a slave.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim n ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ninni maa sani.
en: But I did not destroy them. The other nations saw me bring Israel out of Egypt. I did not want to ruin my good name, so I did not destroy Israel in front of those other people.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Ti shihila kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka bɔzuɣu ka tinim ku tooi pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu n-zaŋ Yawɛ pini na ti ti o di tibu saha.
en: Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba pam daa kul niŋdi ti Duuma yɛda pahira.
en: But more and more people were added to the group—a crowd of men and women who believed in the Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa boli Naawuni ni tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa yuli Bɛtɛl.
en: He named the place Bethel.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri binshɛɣukam nyɛvili ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun daa zani Gomna Pɔntius Pailɛt tooni n-niŋ shɛhira suŋ la zuɣu, n zal a.
en: Before God and Christ Jesus I give you a command. Jesus is the one who confessed that same wonderful truth when he stood before Pontius Pilate. And God is the one who gives life to everything. Now I tell you this:.

dag: Yi nini yi nya tayiɣ kam, yi laɣir o la zɔri, ka lan chɛ ka yi mini zinaniŋdiba be.
en: You become the friend of every thief you see, and you associate with adulterers.

dag: Ka yi yi bi tum taali ka diri wahala, ka mali suɣilo di puuni Naawuni zuɣu, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani.
en: Now, it is commendable if, because of ones understanding of God, someone should endure pain through suffering unjustly.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma n-ti niriba ŋɔ. Miri ka a duh a yee n-suhi bɛ zuɣu, a mi miri ka a balim ma, n ku deeg a suhigu.
en: As for you, dont pray for these people, dont cry out or plead for them, and dont intercede with me, for I wont listen to you.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam din be teekunim puuni bee kulibɔna ni ka ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, binneen shɛb bɛn duɣiri kom mini kom ni binnɛma zaa, bɛ nyɛla yi ni chihiri binshɛba.
en: but anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales must not be eaten.

dag: Di saha maa ka Kalidianim shɛb daa nya soli ni bɛ doli fiɣisi Yɛhudianima.
en: At that moment some Chaldeans came forward, seizing a chance to attack the Jews.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa zaŋ kpa piɛla so n ni daa nya ka o ʒe mɔɣili nol la polo n-daa kab chaŋ o sani ni o kpiɔŋ zaa ti bibig o.
en: The he-goat came to the ram that had two horns, the one Id seen standing in front of the canal. The he-goat charged the ram in powerful anger.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya ni o ni kari Yaakubu zuliya saria, ka di kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord gave a command against Jacob and someone in Israel fell.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni saɣim ninvuɣ biɛri yiko, amaa n ni pahi wuntizɔriba yiko.
en: He will break the power of the wicked, but the power of the righteous will be increased.

dag: Ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali dirimi kaman buɣim din diri suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ka diri neeri yɔɣu zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa la.
en: The wickedness of the people burns like a fire that destroys thorn bushes and thistles. It burns like a forest fire that sends up columns of smoke.

dag: O niŋ o mini Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la yiko ni bɛ wuhi niriba.
en: The Lord has given Bezalel and Oholiab special skills to teach other people.

dag: Bɛcha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛmira mini Jɔash ni Ɛliɛza ni Ɛliɔnai ni Omri ni Jɛrimɔt ni Abija ni Anatɔt ni Alɛmɛt. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Bɛcha bidibisi.
en: Becher had nine sons: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a nam jaaŋgbee yi Ziɔn na, ka a di nam a dimnim sunsuuni.
en: From Zion the Lord will extend your royal power. Rule over your enemies, he says.

dag: Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up.

dag: Naawuni bi zali ti ni o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ti di ti, amaa o zali ti ni ti nyala tiliginsim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ zim viɛlli mali bɔrɔbɔro kpil pinaayi. Zaŋm zim kilɔgiram yini m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpilli kam.
en: Take fine flour and bake twelve loaves with it. Use cups of flour for each loaf.

dag: Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa kana ti yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a yɛtɔɣa n-viig a gbini.
en: A short time later those standing there came and said to Peter, You must be one of them. The way you talk gives you away.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa ŋmaligi Dauda sani yi nti tim ni bɛ cham ti gɔŋ Abinɛr labisina. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paag o Sira kɔbiliga gbini n-gɔŋ o labisina, amaa Dauda daa bi mi di yɛla.
en: Joab left David and sent messengers after Abner. They brought him back from the well at Sirah, but David didnt know anything of this.

dag: ka o daa dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga n-zaŋ chinchini pil o sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni, dama bɛ daa bi nya palo saamba yilikpɛrili ni.
en: She gave birth to her firstborn child, a son, wrapped him snugly, and laid him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the guestroom.

dag: Ka o daa zani kpiimba mini ninvuɣ nɛma sunsuuni, ka alɔbo maa chɛ.
en: He stood between the dead and the living, and the plague stopped.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni mɛri du shɛli ŋɔ polo, a yi ni doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali pahi la zaa, n ni niŋ a kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm la.
en: Regarding this temple that you are building: If you follow my laws, enact my regulations, and keep all my commands faithfully, then I will fulfill for you my promise that I made to your father David.

dag: O ni daa ti wuhi ba naai ka o yɛli Saimɔn, Chamiya teeku ŋɔ bulli ni ha ti lab yi lansi maa gbahi zahim.
en: When he finished speaking, he said to Simon, Push the boat out further to the deep water, and you and your partners let down your nets for a catch.

dag: A chɛ ka n nini kɔŋ pɔbbu, ka di muɣisi ma pam hal ka n ti kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: Youve kept my eyelids from closing. Im so upset I cant even speak.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib gba daa maan o ansarisi ka yɛri taba, O daa tiligi shɛba ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said to each other, He saved others, but he can't save himself.

dag: N ni wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni.
en: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, amaa ka mi daa lee zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: The disciples did not understand what Jesus meant, and they were afraid to ask.

dag: Ka n yi bi mi tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli gbinni, dindina n nyɛla tinzun nira ŋun tɔɣisiri li maa sani, ka o gba nyɛ tinzun nira n sani.
en: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bɛrishiiba; dama nimaani ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa laɣim po pɔri.
en: And so the place was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them made a vow.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: He called his twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits to throw them out and to heal every disease and every sickness.

dag: Naa Lɛmuɛl yɛtɔɣa, din nyɛ o ma ni daa wuh o anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: These are the wise sayings that King Lemuels mother taught him:.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi lo ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni alikauli, naɣ wurimmiyala bɛ buɣa bimbina la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n ni zali ya shɛm maa niŋbu. Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa?.
en: But in return, you must never make any agreement with the people living in that land. You must destroy their altars. I told you that, but you didnt obey me.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-mali duu maa puuni zaa, ka mali salima zoligɔnima n-zaŋ lo du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee la tooni, ka dooi salima pa di gba zuɣu.
en: The inside of the Temple was covered with gold, and gold chains were placed across the entrance of the inner room, which was also covered with gold.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zabiri zibigi. Di simdi ka bɛ wahiri bɛ zabiri.
en: They must neither shave their heads nor let their hair grow long, but they will trim the hair on their heads.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba n-dihi duu maa nachiinsi. Parivaim salima ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: The king decorated the Temple with beautiful precious stones and with gold imported from the land of Parvaim.

dag: Ka yi ti pirigi li ka di saɣisi taba. N daa poya ni n ni zaŋ li ti yi yaannima, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti leei yi dini ni yi fali.
en: What I swore to give to your ancestors, you will distribute as an inheritance equally. This land is given to you as an inheritance.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Yisa ka bɔhiri taba, Yi lee zahimla wula? O ni ka Chuɣu ŋɔ ni na bee o ku kana.
en: They were looking for Jesus, and as they gathered in the Temple, they asked one another, What do you think? Surely he will not come to the festival, will he.

dag: Kasitali sara maligu biŋkɔbiri daa nyɛla naɣilahi kɔbisiyɔbu mini piɛri tusaata.
en: they also brought bulls and , sheep as sacrifices for the people to eat.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni, ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Lets be brave and strong while we fight for our people and for the cities of our God! May the Lord do what he thinks is right.

dag: Sulemaana ŋaha shɛŋa din pahi m-bɔŋɔ, ka Juda naa Hɛzɛkia kpambaliba daa yaai li sabi sɔŋ.
en: Here are more of Solomon's proverbs, copied by scribes at the court of King Hezekiah of Judah.

dag: Amaa maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa fiɣis o, o daa bi garigi shɛli.
en: And when the chief priests and leaders brought their charges against him, he did not say a thing.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛlishaaza daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ago kparibu na ti yɛli Daniɛl, ka bo salima dolibi din mali jilima na ti yɛl o pahi, ka chɛ ka o leei naa ŋun pah ata o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: Belshazzar gave a command for Daniel to be made the third most powerful man in his kingdom and to be given a purple robe and a gold chain.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tiligi tɔb ni la daa nya nambɔzɔbo tiŋgban nɛl la ni. Izraɛlnim ni daa bɔri vuhim shee la.
en: The LORD proclaims: The people who survived the sword found grace in the wilderness. As Israel searched for a place of rest.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi pahi ʒiibukɔbiga zuɣu, ka bɛ zaa ni nyɛla n dan naa tɔbbihi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa lan bɔr ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha? Bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa bɔri ni o bo taali ti Izraɛlnima.
en: Joab answered, Your Majesty, even if the Lord made your kingdom a hundred times larger, you would still rule everyone in it. Why do you need to know how many soldiers there are? Don't you think that would make the whole nation angry.

dag: ka o ba wum o ni po pɔri shɛli bee o ni lo alikauli shɛli maa ka bi yɛl o shɛli, dindina o pɔri maa zaa ni zani, ka o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa ni zani.
en: If her father hears about it and says nothing, she must keep her promise.

dag: Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Juda Naa Ahaz bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam.
en: Hezekiah son of Ahaz was king of Judah. Hezekiah began to rule during the third year that Hoshea son of Elah was king of Israel.

dag: Ka o yi ti liri tinsi maa, hal Ijipti gba ti ku tiligi.
en: He will extend his power into other countries. Even Egypt wont escape.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba daa yi Galili n-chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni ni Jɔn ti baptaiz o.
en: At that time Jesus arrived from Galilee and came to John at the Jordan to be baptized by him.

dag: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Maaz mini Jamin ni Ɛkɛr.
en: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

dag: Amaa Sool ni daa nya ka Yawɛ be Dauda sani, ka o bipuɣiŋga Mikal gba yur o maa.
en: When Saul knew for certain that the LORD was with David and that his daughter Michal loved him.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan wum ka kukol shɛli yi alizanda ni na yɛra, N niriba, yimiya o ni na ka o daalahichi ku tabili ya, ka o daalɔbo balibubalibu mi ku din ya.
en: Then I heard another voice from heaven say, Come out of her, my people, so that you dont take part in her sins and dont receive any of her plagues.

dag: Lɛvinim tuma soli ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn nyɛ yuun pisinaanu zaŋ chana ni tooi piligi laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni tuma tumbu.
en: From the age of twenty-five each Levite shall perform his duties in the Tent of my presence.

dag: Bɛ daa wɔbirila giŋgaɣiri mini tuturi vari ni sɔɣu jila ŋ-ŋubira.
en: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood.

dag: Ka bɛn daa be sansani maa ni mini bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni ni niriba maa zaa suhuri dii fuŋ, ka tɔbbihi zaŋ tabili ŋmɛnditoya zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira ka tiŋgbani daa dam, ka bɛ yɛma ŋma pam.
en: Panic broke out in the camp, in the field, and among all the troops. Even those in the fort and the raiders shook with fear. The very ground shook! It was a terror from God.

dag: Ka n daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a kpalim be n sani dabisi gbaliŋ. Di bi simdi ka a lan go pagɔrisigu bee n-chɛ ka do so su a yaha. N gba ni be a sani lala.
en: Then I said, Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be Naawuni Kundi ni yila Naawuni nol ni na, ka nyɛ din mali buchi pam zaŋ chaŋ wuhibu mini saɣisibu ni zuɣu ni kpahibu ni wuntia soli wuhibu polo.
en: Every scripture is inspired by God and is useful for teaching, for showing mistakes, for correcting, and for training character.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi nya ma, ka n labisi yi daazichi zaa tin ya, ka yihi ya zuliya shɛb ni zaa mini luɣ shɛŋa zaa n ni daa kari ya tahi la n-zaŋ ya labisi n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya yi luɣ shɛŋa ni chaŋ la na. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will be present for you, declares the LORD, and I will end your captivity. I will gather you from all the nations and places where I have scattered you, and I will bring you home after your long exile, declares the LORD.

dag: hal n ni kul yɛli ni biɛhiŋ kani wuntizɔriba ni be maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi niŋ bɛ wuntitali maa naani ka tum alahichi, n ku lan teei bɛ wuntitali tuun shɛli yɛla. Amaa bɛ ni kpi bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa puuni.
en: Suppose I promise good people that they will live, then later they start sinning and believe they will be saved by the good they did in the past. These people will certainly be put to death because of their sins. Their good deeds will be forgotten.

dag: Bɔ ka a su kpe? Ŋuni ka a lee mi kpe hal ka ti gbir amaŋmaŋ gballi kpe n-chibiri daboli zuɣu tampiŋ ni?.
en: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ kpiɔŋ jilima. A nirilim zuɣu ka ti di nasara.
en: because you are the splendor of their strength. By your favor you make us strong.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o tee li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa m-be kaman o nu din la.
en: Then he said to the man with the paralyzed hand, Stretch out your hand. He stretched it out, and it became well again, just like the other one.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbib o nuu ni n-du Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: So Moses cut two stone tablets like the first ones. He got up early in the morning and climbed up Mount Sinai, just as the LORD had commanded him. He carried the two stone tablets in his hands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali bɛ bidibisi bɛn nyɛ goli yini bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura, ka bɛ kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata; dama bɛ daa bi zaŋ Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni, bɛ ni daa bi pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa pal shɛli ti ba la zuɣu.
en: The total number of males one month or older from the tribe of Levi was . But these men were not counted with the other Israelites. They did not get a share of the land that the Lord gave to the other people.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni yɛliya, Benya kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: In the Scriptures God says, Be holy, because I am holy.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ zuɣu sahakam, ka suhimiya Naawuni din ni chɛ ka yi nya kpiɔŋ nti tiligi din ti yɛn niŋ maa ni, ka ti zani Daadam Bia tooni.
en: Watch out and keep praying that you can escape all that is going to happen and that the Son of Man will be pleased with you.

dag: O fa n jilima, ka piligi n nam zuɣupiligu.
en: and stripped of respect.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi ka bɛ daa tabili, Rubin zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Gaad zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: , from Judah, , from Reuben, , from Gad.

dag: amaa sagbani maa daa yi bi vuui, bɛ bi chani shɛli naɣila di yi ti vuui chana ka bɛ chana.
en: But when the cloud stayed on the Holy Tent, the people did not try to move. They stayed in that place until the cloud rose.

dag: Noli deebu mini ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu ni chɛ ka nir daalahichi kpihim, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu ni chɛ ka nir yi zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Faithful love and loyalty will remove your guilt. Respect the Lord , and you will stay far away from evil.

dag: Yinim bɛn be dabitim ni ka mali tahima pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, labimiya yi birini ni na. N yɛri ya mi, n ni niŋ alibarika ʒii buyi zuɣu niŋ yi ni.
en: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.

dag: Filistianim maa daa ŋari kɔbil shɛŋa o ba Ibrahimma ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka o tumtumdiba gbi la.
en: and they stopped up the wells that Abraham's servants had dug before his death.

dag: Yili kam nyɛla ninvuɣ so ni me shɛli, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun me binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

dag: A ni ti dɔni, ka so ku lan kpɛh a dabiɛm, ka niriba pam ti bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim.
en: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.

dag: Do shɛb bɛn na bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba ni pakoya la mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Bɛ yi ni kpalim be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, di viɛla.
en: Im telling those who are single and widows that its good for them to stay single like me.

dag: Absalom dii yɛrila dilana, Nyama, a yɛtɔɣa viɛla ka tuhi, amaa naa bi bo so zal o zaani ni o wum a ni mali shɛli.
en: then Absalom would say to him, No doubt your claims are correct and valid, but the king wont listen to you.

dag: Hal o ni daa ŋme tampiŋ ka kom tɔhi yi di ni na zɔri maa, o ni tooi ti bindira gba bee n-ti o niriba nimdi.
en: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat.

dag: Ŋuna n-dihiri nabihi vi, ka lɔrigiri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ shɛlɔriti.
en: He brings disgrace to important people. He takes power away from rulers.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn nyɛ azichilaannim la, kummiya ka fabilimiya nandahima din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu.
en: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.

dag: N dabisa ŋmanila zaawuni shilinshia; n kuumi kaman mɔri la.
en: My life is almost finished, like the long shadows at the end of the day. I am like dry and dying grass.

dag: Dinzuɣu n zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. O nyɛla Yawɛ ni yɛn su so hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o daa chɛ o ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: So I am dedicating him to the Lord . As long as he lives, he will belong to the Lord . Then they worshiped the Lord there.

dag: Bɛ yi kul be luɣ shɛlikam, dabiɛm m-mali ba, ka kariti doli ba duri bɛ napɔŋkpahi.
en: Terrors round about scare them; they follow their steps.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, N kpa kasi shɛli n ni yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni m-bala.
en: Say to the people of Israel, This holy anointing oil is to be used in my service for all time to come.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛtɔɣili ti yɛn yi n nol ni na, ka a pun mi li zaa.
en: There isnt a word on my tongue, LORD, that you dont already know completely.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti mabia Apolɔs polo, m balim o pam ni o pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu ka yi sanna, ka o bi yu ni o ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ; amaa o yi ti nya dahima o ni bahi kana.
en: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly encouraged him to visit you with the other brothers. He prefers not to come now, but he will come when he has the opportunity.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa kana ti paɣiri Naawuni ka tɔɣisiri bia maa yɛla bɛnkam zaa daa yuuni Jɛrusalɛmnim tiliginsim nyabu sol la sani.
en: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa puuni ka nyɛ bɛn daa zo n-chaŋ o sani mini bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni la kuli Babilɔn.
en: Finally Nebuzaradan, the commanding officer, took away as prisoners to Babylonia the people who were left in the city, together with those who had deserted to him.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti boli paɣisarili maa na nti bɔh o nya.
en: They answered, Let's ask Rebekah what she wants to do.

dag: Ka biɛhigu ti ku niŋ asama tin ya zuliyanim maa sani, ka yi ti ku nya luɣ shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ yi napɔŋ zali vuhi. Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira nimaani, ka ninsabiga mali ya, ka nandahima ti mali ya yi suhuri ni.
en: You will not have any peace among these nations. You will have no place to rest. The Lord will fill your mind with worry. Your eyes will feel tired. You will be very upset.

dag: N daa lo mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni n ni yɛn kana ti kaai ya kaari shɛl la ku nyɛla din ni tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: So I decided that, for my own sake, I wouldnt visit you again while I was upset.

dag: Aai, lala ku niŋ. Yi dɔbba kɔŋko cham ti jɛm Yawɛ, dama yi ni bɔri shɛm m-bala. Ka bɛ daa kari ba Firawuna tooni yihi.
en: The men can go worship the Lord . That is what you asked for in the beginning. But all of your people cannot go. Then Pharaoh sent Moses and Aaron away.

dag: Yi daanabinim ŋmanila ŋɔri m-be Izraɛl dikilijina ni.
en: Israel, your prophets have been like jackals among ruins.

dag: Kaman kom ni chɛ ka nir nyar o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ninsal suhu nyari di kpee.
en: Just as you can see your own face reflected in water, so your heart reflects the kind of person you are.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn baŋ din viɛli piibu ka zaɣisi din bi viɛla, o ni ti dirila waagasi mini shiri.
en: He will eat butter and honey, and learn to reject evil and choose good.

dag: O nyari binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa, o nyɛla biŋkɔbiri zaa naa.
en: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.

dag: Ka Hadadɛza daa tim ti zaŋ Sirianim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la n-ka Hɛlam na, ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: King Hadadezer sent for the Syrians who were on the east side of the Euphrates River, and they came to Helam under the command of Shobach, commander of the army of King Hadadezer of Zobah.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ tibig a yuli ʒiɛmani kam ni ka yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka a chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaashee zani a tooni.
en: Then your name will be honored forever. People will say, The Lord God All-Powerful rules Israel! And may the family of your servant David continue to be strong in serving you.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri ti tab maa m-bɔŋɔ. Dina ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ li ti zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la.
en: So Moses said to the Israelites, This is the land that you will receive by drawing lots, the land that the Lord has assigned to the nine and one-half tribes.

dag: Dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim maa. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Miriya ka yi ŋubi binnɛɔŋ kam ʒim, dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim, ka ŋunkam ŋub li, bɛn yihim o o niriba ni.
en: The life of every living thing is in the blood, and that is why the Lord has told the people of Israel that they shall not eat any meat with blood still in it and that anyone who does so will no longer be considered one of his people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi, ka Musa daa zaŋ piɛlaa maa zaa nyo buɣim, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: After he washed the insides and lower legs with water, Moses completely burned the whole ram on the altar. It was an entirely burned offering for a soothing smell; it was a food gift for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Aduna daa kpuɣi Aminadab bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa nyɛ Nashɔn tizɔpaɣa ka o yuli booni Ɛlishɛba la, ka o daa dɔɣi Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon; she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali nti paai jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋa, ka o nya ka salo be nimaani yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri, ka kumdi ka fabinda.
en: They went to the synagogue leaders house, where Jesus saw many people crying loudly. There was a lot of confusion.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ a gula. O nyɛla a nudirigu polo mahim.
en: The LORD is your protector; the LORD is your shade right beside you.

dag: O suhu zaa daa kul yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu zuɣu, ka din pahi nyɛla o daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini Ashɛrim ŋmahima zaa din be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: Jehoshaphat took pride in the LORDs ways and again removed the shrines and the sacred poles from Judah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mali o ni su binshɛlikam maa zaa yiko, amaa lee miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shih o. Di saha ka Sintani daa yi Yawɛ sani chaŋ.
en: The LORD said to the Adversary, Look, all he has is within your power; only dont stretch out your hand against him. So the Adversary left the LORDs presence.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana ka yuri wuntia tuma. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi n-nyɛ bɛn ni tooi nya o ni bɛ nini.
en: The Lord always does what is right, and he loves seeing people do right. Those who live good lives will be with him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Zaŋm Lɛvinim zali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa zaani, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi zali Izraɛlnim niɣi zaani, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: Take the Levites in place of all the oldest Israelites and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle. The Levites are mine; I am the LORD.

dag: Amaa n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: But if I throw out demons by the powerof God, then Gods kingdom has already overtaken you.

dag: Miriya ka yi siŋ Ɛdomnim ni so, dama bɛ nyɛla yi mabihi, miriya ka yi siŋ Ijiptinima, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba m-be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dont detest Edomites, because they are your relatives. Dont detest Egyptians because you were immigrants in their land.

dag: Doo yi mali paɣiba ayi ka yuri yino ka bi yuri ŋun la, ka o ni yuri paɣ so maa min o ni bi yuri paɣ so maa zaa dɔɣ o bidibisi, ka o ni bi yuri paɣ so maa bidibiga n-nyɛ o bituuli.
en: A man might have two wives. He might love one wife more than the other. Both wives might have children for him, but the firstborn son might be from the wife he does not love.

dag: Tiŋgbani, sɔhigim ti Duuma tooni. Sɔhigim ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni di tiŋkpansi shɛm la, lala ka so ti ku lan be nimaani gba bee n-ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns, and I will destroy Babylon just as completely. No one will live there again.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisim a nam ʒiishee nti ʒini tiŋ taŋkpaɣu ni. Bɛ ku lan bol a ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.

dag: Yawɛ yiko puuni, o daa kpahi n zuɣu ni ni n di doli niriba maa naba. O daa yɛli ma.
en: With his great power the Lord warned me not to follow the road which the people were following. He said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lo noli n-jɛmdi ti Duuma ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛli ba, Piimiya Baanabas mini Sool ti ma, ka n chɛ ka bɛ tum n ni yɛn ti ba tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila zuɣupil shɛli din mali jilima be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka lan be kaman nam zuɣupiligu la be a Naawuni nuu ni.
en: You will be like a beautiful crown that the Lord holds up, like a kings crown in the hand of your God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ m-bɔhi.
en: So Jesus told them this parable:.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu biɛyanim ninvuɣ pia la daa chaŋ Ijipti ni bɛ ti da kawana.
en: So Joseph's ten half brothers went to buy grain in Egypt.

dag: A wuhiya ni chɛfirinim mali taali, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bahi yoli; ka a kpihim bɛ yuya zaa zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You have condemned the heathen and destroyed the wicked; they will be remembered no more.

dag: Hal a ni kul bi mi ma ŋɔ zaa yoli, mani m-piig a ni a sɔŋ n daba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb la. Mani m-bol a yuli.
en: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.

dag: Bɛ yi kar o saria, bɛn wuhimi ni o mali taali, ka chɛ ka o wunsuhigu leei alahichi.
en: When the sentence is passed, let him be found guilty— let his prayer be found sinful!.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bihi, wummiya n yɛligu ka di zaɣisiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Now sons, listen to me, and dont deviate from the words of my mouth.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a gbaai n suhu. A nina lihibu min a nyiŋgokɔrigu yabiɛlim yini chɛ ka a gbaai n suhu.
en: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then he released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus whipped, then handed him over to be crucified.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa maani buɣa polo, ti mi ni di nyɛla kaman shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la: Ti zaa mali baŋsim. Amaa baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo tahirila maŋduhibu na; yurilim n-naɣ nyɛ din kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.

dag: Dɔro ni daa mali do so yuun pihinahaayika gba daa do nimaani.
en: A man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa zaa daa ka Jɛrimia sanna nti bɔh o; ka o garigi yɛli ba kaman naa ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bi lan bɔh o shɛli, dama bɛ daa bi wum bɛ daalizama maa.
en: It happened that the royal officials of the king did come to Jeremiah to question him. So Jeremiah told them everything the king had ordered him to say. Then they left Jeremiah alone. No one had heard what Jeremiah and the king had talked about.

dag: Ka a yi ka shɛli, nyin wumma; foma, ka n wuh a yɛm.
en: But if you have nothing to say, then listen to me. Be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania maligumaaniba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa ʒe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni ninni.
en: Then in the presence of the priests and of all the people who were standing in the Temple, I said to Hananiah.

dag: Ŋun yuri liɣiri, ku nya liɣiri tiɣi; ka ŋun yuri buni mi ku nya buni tiɣi. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: The money lover isnt satisfied with money; neither is the lover of wealth satisfied with income. This too is pointless.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka di puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini diribarilim.
en: It will be bad for you teachers of the law and you Pharisees! You are hypocrites! You wash clean the outside of your cups and dishes. But inside they are full of what you got by cheating others and pleasing yourselves.

dag: Nina neesim chɛ ka nir suhu piɛla, ka lahibali viɛlli tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: A smile makes people happy. Good news makes them feel better.

dag: Kurugu ŋmanila muriga o sani, ka daanya mi ŋmani da kpima.
en: He breaks iron as easily as straw. He breaks bronze like rotten wood.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ pirigi teeku kom buyi; ka daa ŋme m-bɔri wɔɣ biɛri la zuɣuri kom ni.
en: With your great power you split open the sea and broke the heads of the sea monster.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa labi kuli ti yɛl o deemba Jɛtro, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n labi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n niriba sani nti nya bɛ na be bɛ nyɛviya ni. Ka Jɛtro daa yɛli Musa, Cham ni suhudoo.
en: Then Moses went back to Jethro, his father-in-law. Moses said to him, Please let me go back to Egypt. I want to see if my people are still alive. Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam maa, bɛ zaŋm daɣiri ni yibu sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim tampiligim niŋ tahili ni, ka booi kɔzɔrim kom niŋ di ni;.
en: To remove the uncleanness, some ashes from the red cow which was burned to remove sin shall be taken and put in a pot, and fresh water added.

dag: O filim karimbaannima; ka saɣim bɛ tiŋ din mali yaa; ka daai di goma luhi tiŋa.
en: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.

dag: Doliy o dunoya kpe ni wumpaɣibo, ka kpe o dundɔŋ ni ni paɣibu! Puhimiy o, ka paɣ o yuli!.
en: Enter his gates with thanks; enter his courtyards with praise! Thank him! Bless his name!.

dag: M mabiyurisi n suhiri ya, yi ni nyɛ saamba be tinzun tinsi ni la zuɣu, zomiya niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma din mini yi biɛhigu tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: I appeal to you, my friends, as strangers and refugees in this world! Do not give in to bodily passions, which are always at war against the soul.

dag: yɛlimaŋli m Ba, dama lala n-viɛl a sani.
en: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti zani, ka kuhi bahi Izraɛl tɔbbihi na, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lo tɔbu na ni yi ti tuhi ti? Pa Filistia nira n-nyɛ ma? Ka yi mi pala Sool tɔbbihi? Dinzuɣu piimiya yi ni ninvuɣ yino n-chɛ ka o siɣi n sanna.
en: Goliath went out and shouted to the army of Israel: Why are you lining up for battle? I'm the best soldier in our army, and all of you are in Saul's army. Choose your best soldier to come out and fight me!.

dag: Di saha a yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, n ni garig a, bee chɛ ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka a garigi ma.
en: Then call and Ill answer, or Ill speak and you can reply.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ li vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la naba zaashee.
en: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.

dag: O tab ni daa nya lala maa ka di niŋ ba yoli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli naa doo maa ŋun ni niŋ shɛm.
en: When his fellow servants saw what happened, they were deeply offended. They came and told their master all that happened.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nya du kara ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, You see these great buildings? Not a single stone here will be left in its place; every one of them will be thrown down.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma mini bɛn yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ma la laara.
en: Lord , punish my enemies in that way— those who say such evil things against me!.

dag: Amaa bin yini ŋɔ ka n naɣ kpahim nya: Naawuni nam ninsalinim dɛde, amaa tinim lee bo yɛligabira pam ti timaŋa. .
en: See, this alone I found: God made human beings straightforward, but they search for many complications.

dag: Yawɛ Yɛliya, Tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni ti kpalim dabari, amaa n ti ku saɣim di zaa.
en: This is what the Lord says: The whole country will be ruined, but I will not completely destroy the land.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pii dɔbba zali ka bɛ gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam n-sɔɣiri bɛn daa kana ti liri ba maa kpiimba bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ mali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin vihi.
en: They will appoint people who will continually cross through the land and bury the human remains that are left on the surface of the ground in order to purify it. They will begin their search at the end of seven months.

dag: ni tammɛriba ni kuɣikpɛriba, ka da dari mini nyolimbɔɣa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan zaŋ di shɛli mi mali duu maa luɣ shɛlikam din simdi ni bɛ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: the masons, and the stone cutters, buy the timber and the stones used in the repairs, and pay all other necessary expenses.

dag: Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan boli ya n daba, dama dabili bi mi o duuma daashili; amaa n ni boli ya la n zɔnima, dama n ni wum shɛlikam zaa m Ba sani, n zaŋ li wuhi ya.
en: I dont call you servants any longer, because servants dont know what their master is doing. Instead, I call you friends, because everything I heard from my Father I have made known to you.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Naa Dauda daa bol o o Duuma? O daa yɛliya:.
en: He said, Then how is it that David, inspired by the Holy Spirit, called him Lord when he said.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A ku garigi ma? A bi mi ni m mali yiko din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpah a tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka lan mali yiko din ni tooi tilig a.
en: Pilate said to him, You will not speak to me? Remember, I have the authority to set you free and also to have you crucified.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ daa na bi kpɛhi Jɔn duu.
en: This was before John was put in prison.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni so ku tooi yɛli ni n yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya.
en: I am thankful because now no one can say that you were baptized in my name.

dag: Dama yi ni so yi yɛli, Man dolila Pool; ka so mi yɛli, N dolila Apolɔs; di yi nyɛ lala, yi gba bi bemi kaman dunianima?.
en: When someone says, I belong to Paul, and someone else says, I belong to Apollos, arent you acting like people without the Spirit?.

dag: Yi mi ni dali nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia ti ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: You know that the Passover is two days from now. And the Human One will be handed over to be crucified.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa zali Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka wuh o niriba ni bɛ niŋm ʒim vie bɛ yinsi dunoya, ka di chɛ ka Kum malaika so ŋun daa yɛn kana ti ku bikpamba la ti ku ku bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bikpamba.
en: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, kum n dimnima. N nyɛla a dabili, kum n dimnim zaa.
en: Because of your love for me, kill my enemies and destroy all my oppressors, for I am your servant.

dag: N yura ŋmanila molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ polli. Nyama, ŋuna n-ʒe ti gooni nyaaŋa n-vɔbisiri lihiri ti takɔriti ni, ka lihiri dari din puli gabi tab voya ni ŋɔ.
en: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window.

dag: Ka dim pahi nyɛla: Bɛ daa lan ta n jɛmbu duu la daɣiri dindali maa, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa.
en: They also treated my special days of rest and my holy place as though they were not important.

dag: O biɛhi ŋmanila alabasita daantalisi din tam salima binzahi zuɣu. O biɛhigu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn sida ti gahinda.
en: His thighs are pillars of whitest stone set on pedestals of gold. His appearance—like Lebanon, stately, like the cedars.

dag: Ka paɣ maa paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihitanaata. Di bi simdi ni o shihi binshɛli din be kasi bee n-kpe luɣ kasi shee hal ka o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa maa ti naai.
en: Because of the blood from childbirth, another days must pass before she can touch anything that is holy. She must not enter the Holy Place until the time of her purification is finished.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa, yin zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni be kuɣu shɛŋa ni ŋɔ ti sa Ɛbal zoli zuɣu, ka niŋ tari ta li.
en: and you are on the other side of the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am instructing you today, and cover them with plaster.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko n-daa wuh o soli, ka tinzun buɣili daa ka o sani.
en: The Lord alone led his people without the help of a foreign god.

dag: Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ tooni na ti gbani? N zaŋmi yuun yini naɣ bihi ka o tooni na nti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la?.
en: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?.

dag: Dama m bi niŋ n tɔbu naani bee n-niŋ n takɔb yɛda ni di ni tiligi ma.
en: I dont put my trust in my bow. My sword cannot save me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yihi ti kum barina titali maa ni, ka na kul yihiri ti di ni, ka ti mali tahima ni o ni lan yihi ti yaha.
en: From such terrible dangers of death he saved us, and will save us; and we have placed our hope in him that he will save us again.

dag: N ni kana ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tipawumli nim ŋɔ n-fiɛb ba. Ka n yi ti fiɛb ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri buyi maa zuɣu, zuliya shɛb ni laɣisi tab na ti liri ba.
en: I will attack this sinful people and punish them. Nations will join together against them, and they will be punished for their many sins.

dag: Ka yi mi ti lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Ka yi yi yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, o suhu sa ni yiɣisi bahi tinim Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu biɛɣuni.
en: Are you going to refuse to follow him now? If you rebel against the Lord today, he will be angry with everyone in Israel tomorrow.

dag: Ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya paɣiba ayi ka bɛ yiɣiri kpari m polo na, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama ŋmani shinshingooro kpiŋkpama. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣ piɛɣu maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ li yiɣi chaŋ.
en: I looked up and saw two women flying toward me with powerful wings like those of a stork. They picked up the basket and flew off with it.

dag: Amaa lɛhu ni tooi wuhi ni di gari ŋun mal li tumdi tuma? Sua gari ŋun mal li ŋmari binyara? Jaaŋgbee bi kpuɣiri ninsal gbibi, amaa ninsala n-kpuɣiri jaaŋgbee gbibi.
en: An ax is not better than the one who cuts with it. A saw is not better than the one who uses it. Is a stick stronger than the one who picks it up? It cant do anything to the person who is using it to punish someone!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Wɛi, n niriba bɛn mali tipawumli, ka lɔri nia shɛli din pa n dini, ka lan laɣiri niriba zɔri ka di pa n ni yu shɛli. Bɛ kul tumdila alahichi pahira.
en: Doom to you, rebellious children, says the LORD, who make a plan, which is not mine; who weave a plot, but not by my spirit, piling up sin on sin.

dag: dindina n naan zaɣisi Yaakubu mini n dabili Dauda zuliya, ka ku piig o bihi ni yino ka o su Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu zuliya. Dama n ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka labisi bɛ daazichi ti ba.
en: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.

dag: Yɛlim Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda gomna la ni di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.

dag: Dama Musa daa pun piri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbɔŋ la tari zuliya ayi ni pirigili la. Amaa o daa bi pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: In fact, Moses had given out the legacy of the two and a half tribes on the other side of the Jordan. But he gave no legacy among them to the Levites.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa duri maa, maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla mɔɣili maa sunsuuni tiŋkuŋ zuɣu hal ka niriba maa zaa ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa naai.
en: The ground at that place became dry, and the priests carried the Box of the Agreement of the Lord to the middle of the river and stopped. They waited there while all the Israelites walked across the Jordan River on dry land.

dag: Ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ka tahira, ka vuri mɔni, ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋgbani dambu lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ daadamnim nambu piligu ni zaŋ kana di saha maa.
en: There were flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder, and a terrible earthquake. There has never been such an earthquake since the creation of human beings; this was the worst earthquake of all!.

dag: N niriba alahichi tumbu puuni ka bɛ nyari bindirigu, ka bɔri ni bɛ kul tumdi alahichi.
en: The priests fed on the peoples sins. They wanted more and more of their sin offerings.

dag: Lihimiya n nuhi mini n naba, ka baŋ ni mani m-bala. Tabisimiya ma nya, dama alizini ka niŋgbuŋ mini kɔba ka n ni mali shɛm ŋɔ. .
en: Look at my hands and my feet. Its really me. Touch me. You can see that I have a living body; a ghost does not have a body like this.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba zaa kalinli pirigibu buta puuni ʒii buyi kpi.
en: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka o bihi deer o noli ka tir o jilima binshɛɣukam puuni;.
en: he must be able to manage his own family well and make his children obey him with all respect.

dag: Ti sa bela puu ni lɔri kabɔba, yim ka n ti nya ka n kabɔbili yiɣisi zani, ka yi kabɔba laɣimna ti gili n kabɔbili maa n-damdi li tiŋa.
en: We were all in the field tying up sheaves of wheat, when my sheaf got up and stood up straight. Yours formed a circle around mine and bowed down to it.

dag: Di saha bɛ mini Sool ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa daa bela Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-tuhiri Filistianima.
en: King Saul, your brothers, and all the other Israelites are in Elah Valley fighting the Philistines.

dag: Niriba pam daa di o shɛhira kpɛma, amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa daa lee bi doli taba.
en: Many witnesses told lies against Jesus, but their stories did not agree.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, dama so kani ŋun bi tumd alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ gbahi ba daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ katiŋa bee yoma.
en: Your people will sin against you. I know this because everyone sins. And you will be angry with your people. You will let their enemies defeat them. Their enemies will make them prisoners and carry them to some faraway land.

dag: Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa ni a kpiɔŋ tariga.
en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Ŋun daa zo o nambɔɣu la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A gba cham ti niŋmi lala.
en: The teacher of the law answered, The one who helped him. Jesus said, Then you go and do the same.

dag: Ka n teei ti Duuma ni daa yɛli ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinima ni dee la Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu la yɛla.
en: Then I remembered the words of the Lord Jesus: John baptized people in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli ba ka ba bɛ nyɛviya zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ mal alibarika dunia ŋɔ ni; o mi ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zaŋ o Shi so tin ya maa pala ŋun ni zaŋ ya leei daba n-lan kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm yaha, amaa Naawuni Shia maa lee chɛ ka yi leerila Naawuni bihi. Ka ti kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: For the Spirit that God has given you does not make you slaves and cause you to be afraid; instead, the Spirit makes you God's children, and by the Spirit's power we cry out to God, Father! my Father.

dag: Dindina a ni bi saɣi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛli zuɣu, a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi chɛ ka o niŋ a ni bɔri shɛli? Nyini n-ni pii, pa mani, dinzuɣu yɛlim a ni mi shɛli.
en: Job, you want God to reward you, but you refuse to change. It is your decision, not mine. Tell me what you think.

dag: Di daa niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nya Ibrahimma ni daa nya alibarika shɛl la Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka ti zaa tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi so o ni daa lo ti alikauli la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Because of what Jesus Christ did, the blessing God promised to Abraham was given to all people. Christ died so that by believing in him we could have the Spirit that God promised.

dag: ka Jarɛd nyɛ Ɛnok ba, ka Ɛnok nyɛ Mɛtusɛla ba, ka Mɛtusɛla nyɛ Lamɛk ba, ka Lamɛk mi daa nyɛ Nuhu ba.
en: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech.

dag: Ka zom maa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ chana; amaa bɛ ŋmanila tihi.
en: The man looked up and said, Yes, I can see people, but they look like trees walking around.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: News about this spread all over that part of the country.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi zaɣisi ma, yi lɛbila yi nyaansi biri ma, dinzuɣu ka n teegi n nuu m-bahi ya yoli. N niŋla suɣilo hal ka n nyee ti nyɔni.
en: You have deserted me, declares the LORD. You have turned your back on me. So I will turn my hand against you and destroy you. Im tired of holding back.
