dag: Ti zaa chirindi pam, ka so yi bi chirim o yɛtɔɣa puuni, dilan nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu be dɛde, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali yiko din ni tooi gbib o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: All of us often make mistakes. But if a person never makes a mistake in what he says, he is perfect and is also able to control his whole being.

dag: Bɛ ni ti sɔɣ o mi kaman bɛ ni sɔɣiri buŋ shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti vu o ti labi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdali tooni ha.
en: They will give him a donkeys burial, dragging him outside the gates of Jerusalem and dumping him there.

dag: Ka Krispus ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda ka Kɔrintinim pam bɛn daa wum Pool yɛligu maa gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Crispus was the leader of that synagogue. He and all the people living in his house believed in the Lord Jesus. Many other people in Corinth also listened to Paul. They, too, believed and were baptized.

dag: Ka n ni di paai kɔbiliga maa gbinna zuŋɔ, ka n yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, a yi ni ti ma nasara n chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: When I came to the well today, I prayed, Lord , God of my master Abraham, please give me success in what I am doing.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda! Ka dii gbaag o jɛmbu.
en: The man said, Lord, I put my faith in you! Then he worshiped Jesus.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Mbo n-faaŋa, bi suŋ ni n yɛdalana ŋun ʒe ma yim! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ a leei bin din zooi pam zuɣulana; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli kaman n suhu ni piɛli shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Wonderful! his master replied. You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tum tuma yuma ayopɔin Reechɛl zuɣu, amaa ka di daa ŋmanila dabisa biɛla o sani, o ni daa yuri Reechɛl maa zuɣu.
en: Jacob worked for Rachel for seven years, but it seemed like a few days because he loved her.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Galili maa, ka Galilinim maa deeg o ni suhupiɛlli bɛ nini ni daa pun nya o ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa chuɣu puhibu ni Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu, dama bɛ gba daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni.
en: When he came to Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him because they had seen all the things he had done in Jerusalem during the festival, for they also had been at the festival.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi Hadirak tiŋgbɔŋnim mini Damaskusnim tibili. Pa Izraɛlnim zuliya kɔŋko ka Yawɛ su, amaa ŋuna n-su Siria tiŋgbɔŋ gba.
en: This is the Lord 's message: He has decreed punishment for the land of Hadrach and for the city of Damascus. Not only the tribes of Israel but also the capital of Syria belong to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl bituuli ŋun yuli daa booni Rubin la daa dɔɣi bidibis anahi; Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya ni kpamba.
en: The following men were the heads of their ancestral clans: The sons of Reuben, Jacob's oldest son, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo pam laɣim gil o maa ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ baami n-du duli ha.
en: When Jesus noticed the crowd around him, he ordered his disciples to go to the other side of the lake.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ma ni Zɛbidii bihi ma la gba daa be bɛ ni.
en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedees sons.

dag: Ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: Peter went out and wept bitterly.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim daa ka Yisa sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tried to test him by asking for a sign from heaven.

dag: Ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa be bɛ ni.
en: There among the people was a woman who had been bleeding for the past twelve years.

dag: Paɣ jɛrigu kul tahirila pampam, o nyɛla ŋun be ʒilinsi ni, ka bi mi shɛli.
en: Foolishness is that other woman, who is loud, stupid, and knows nothing.

dag: O daa tɛhimi ni Pool ni ti o liɣiri, dinzuɣu ka o daa kul timdi ti boon o na waawaayili ka o min o ti diri alizama.
en: After this, Felix often sent for Paul and talked with him, because he hoped that Paul would offer him a bribe.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o ti o bidibiga ni o niŋ o paɣa, di simdi ka o gbib o kaman o bipuɣiŋga la.
en: If a man buys a female slave to give to his son, he is to treat her like a daughter.

dag: Ka o daa sab gbaŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo pahi ba. O ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then the commander wrote a letter that went like this:.

dag: O yi bi nahind o taba, amaa ka labisiri o ni deei binshɛŋa talima tiri bindaamba, ka pa ŋun fari niriba, ka nyɛ ŋun dihiri kum ni mali shɛba, ka sooni gbinfini ni mali shɛba.
en: He doesn't cheat or rob anyone. He returns what a borrower gives him as security; he feeds the hungry and gives clothing to the naked.

dag: Ʒiɛnya yim yi yɛda niŋbu puuni ka zaɣis o, dama yi mi ni yi mabihi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nyarila wahala shɛŋa yi gba ni nyari maa tatabo.
en: Be firm in your faith and resist him, because you know that other believers in all the world are going through the same kind of sufferings.

dag: N daa wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛli ni, ka bɛ ti wurim kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka n daa kari ba saria kaman bɛ tuma mini bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: and scattered them throughout the nations, just as they deserved.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ dol o hal ka o ti saɣi. O yɛtɔɣ nyaɣisa maa ka o daa zaŋ gbaag o.
en: So she tempted him with her charms, and he gave in to her smooth talk.

dag: o ni daa zali teeku di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka di kom ku zo n-yaɣi o ni zal li shɛli tariga, o ni daa booi tiŋgbani tarisi saha shɛli.
en: and ordered the waters of the sea to rise no further than he said. I was there when he laid the earth's foundations.

dag: Ka o daa lan lu Dauda sizuura ka yɛli, Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka a ti lihi nya mani ŋun nyɛ ba kpiŋ ŋɔ lala.
en: Mephibosheth bowed to David again and he said, I am no better than a dead dog, but you are being very kind to me.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, Izraɛlnim miri ka bɛ kana ti miri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: The Israelites will no longer be able to approach the meeting tent, or they will be responsible for their sin and die.

dag: nti chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni nimaani ka o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka yi piɛb kikaa ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: where Zadok and Nathan are to anoint him as king of Israel. Then blow the trumpet and shout, Long live King Solomon.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Yawɛ Jɔshua ni daa be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la zaa zaŋ tabili zuɣulaannim shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka daa mi Yawɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: The Israelites served the Lord during the time Joshua was living. After Joshua died, the people continued to serve the Lord while their leaders were alive. These were the leaders who had seen what the Lord had done for Israel.

dag: Amaa ka o daa fɔh o nuu maa kpɛhi, ka o mabia maa daŋ o yibuna; ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda maa yɛli, A niŋla kpaɣikpaɣi nya soli yina maa! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Pɛrɛz.
en: But he pulled his arm back, and his brother was born first. Then the midwife said, So this is how you break your way out! So he was named Perez.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni tinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ di suɣilo n-sɔŋ bɛn ka yaa, ka di bɔri ni ti tum din ni tiɣi timaŋmaŋ nini.
en: We who are powerful need to be patient with the weakness of those who dont have power, and not please ourselves.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri nyɛla n ʒim. Ka Yaakubu daa be o sani goli yini.
en: Laban said, You are my nephew, and you are like one of my own family. After Jacob had been there for a month.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini Masia ni laɣim neei kum ni la zuɣu, bomiyala binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni Masia ni ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo luɣ shɛl la.
en: Therefore, if you were raised with Christ, look for the things that are above where Christ is sitting at Gods right side.

dag: Amaa kul ʒiɛnya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim kaman yi ni pun niŋdi shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ la.
en: Instead, be faithful to the Lord , as you have been till now.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, n niriba maa pirigili n-daa tumdi mɛbu maa tuma, ka pirigili mi ye gbaɣinɔnima ka gbib kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni tɔbiri. Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul ʒe Judanim zaa bɛn mɛri gooni maa nyaaŋa.
en: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yuya ni pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la kuli dɔbba dɔɣi bihi n-ʒi bɛ yinsi gbib ba, ka di chɛ ka ti dimnim ku nya soli n-yɛli ti din bie;.
en: So I want younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their homes so that they wont give the enemy any reason to slander us. .

dag: O zuliya kul ni beni sahakam, ka n chɛ ka o nam kul ba n-ʒe n sani kaman wuntaŋ la.
en: He will always have descendants, and I will watch over his kingdom as long as the sun shines.

dag: Yinim malaikanima, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali yaa ka tumd o ni yɛli shɛm, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: Angels, praise the Lord ! You angels are the powerful soldiers who obey his commands. You listen to him and obey his commands.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɛfita daa tim tuumba Ammɔnnim naa sani ti bɔh o, Taal bɔ n-lee be m min a sunsuuni, ka a ti kana ni a ti tuhi ma n tiŋgbani zuɣu.
en: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites with this message: What is the problem between the Ammonites and the Israelites? Why have you come to fight in our land.

dag: Dama nyini ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni a ni chɛ ka n zuliya yɛligi. Dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a ŋɔ.
en: I have the courage to pray this prayer to you, my God, because you have revealed all this to me, your servant, and have told me that you will make my descendants kings.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm leei tampuli, ka leei kunduna biɛhigu shee. N ni chɛ ka Juda fɔndi zan dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: The Lord says, I will make Jerusalem a pile of ruins, a place where jackals live; the cities of Judah will become a desert, a place where no one lives.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum o wuhibu maa ŋahili, dama bɛ daa mirila Jɛrusalɛm ka niriba maa tɛhiri ni o dii yɛn chɛmi ka Naawuni nam piligi.
en: As the crowd listened to what he was saying, Jesus went on to tell a story. He was now near Jerusalem and knew that the people thought it was almost time for Gods kingdom to come.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Yuma ala ka a yɛn niŋ nimaani, ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn labina? Di saha o paani daa ʒimi baɣ o. Ka di daa niŋ naa nyaɣisim ni o tim ma, ka n daa yɛl o n ni yɛn labina saha shɛli.
en: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, How long will it take, and when will you be back? The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.

dag: Hal o ni daa ti ti wahala maa zaa yoli, o ni zo ti nambɔɣu, o yurilim maŋli din galisi pam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: When he punishes, he also has mercy. He has mercy because of his great love and kindness.

dag: Di saha bɛ yi ti wum kikaa maa kumsi ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka, ka tɔbu maa kana ti di ba, bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If someone hears it but pays no attention and the enemy comes and kills him, then he is to blame for his own death.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Jotibata maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Abirɔna.
en: They marched from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n na zaŋdila pini tahiri Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti sɔŋ Yisa nyaandoliba.
en: Now I am going to Jerusalem to help Gods people there.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Gbuɣinli la mini saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Jɛŋgbini la, ni saŋmaribihi shɛba bɛ ni booni Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi bɛn nyɛ nudirigu polo saŋmarisi la.
en: made the Bear and Orion, Pleiades and the southern constellations.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wurim Mɔab, ka di niriba ku lan beni, bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ ti yaɣi Yawɛ san la zuɣu.
en: The nation of Moab will be destroyed, because they thought that they were more important than the Lord .

dag: Kpiimba shihi sɔhirimi, ka bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee sɔhira.
en: The spirits of the dead tremble in the waters under the earth.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni fɔŋ kara n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Shiiba ni Molada.
en: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following towns with their surrounding villages: Beersheba, Shema, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Balah, Ezem, Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazar-Susah, Beth-Lebaoth, and Sharuhen.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kuri yi liɣiri binshɛli din pa bindirigu zuɣu, ka tumdi tuma din ku tiɣi ya zuɣu? Wummiya n yɛligu viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dinya din viɛla ni bindir suma ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli palli n ʒim ni. Kul nyumiya li waawaayili teemi n yɛla.
en: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup and said, This cup is God's new covenant, sealed with my blood. Whenever you drink it, do so in memory of me.

dag: ka dam zuliya kam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ daazichi zaa kuli kpe na, ka n chɛ ka duu ŋɔ mali jilima.
en: I will overthrow all the nations, and their treasures will be brought here, and the Temple will be filled with wealth.

dag: ni Sɛrug ni Nahɔr ni Tɛra.
en: Serug, Nahor, Terah.

dag: Ka o bapir daa ti bɔh o min o tumtumda maa, Ya ka yi lee chaŋ? Ka Sool garigi yɛl o, Ti daa chaŋla bunsi la bɔbu; ka daa ti bo ba je ka chaŋ Samuɛl sani.
en: Sauls uncle asked Saul and his servant, Where have you been? Saul said, We were looking for the donkeys. When we couldnt find them, we went to see Samuel.

dag: O ʒi n-niŋ zuliya shɛb lala; bɛ ʒi o zaligunima. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: A mi n yibu saha ni n dɔnibu saha, ka mi n soya zaa.
en: You see me, whether I am working or resting; you know all my actions.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ o tiŋgban nɛl la ni, ka daa saɣim o suhu pam!.
en: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.

dag: Teebuya ayi n-daa ʒe zɔntua maa samban ni dunɔdali nuzaa polo, ka teebuya ayi ʒe zɔntua maa dunɔdali yaɣ din la polo.
en: Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai zuɣulan maa yiŋa n-nya ka yupiɛbiriba mini salo pam beni n-yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri.
en: Then Jesus went into the official's house. When he saw the musicians for the funeral and the people all stirred up.

dag: O daa bela Paran mɔɣu ni, ka o ma daa ti bo Ijipti paɣ ti o.
en: He lived in the Paran desert, and his mother found him an Egyptian wife.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhu ni, Zuliyanim ŋɔ galisiya gari ti, wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari ba.
en: Do not tell yourselves that these peoples outnumber you and that you cannot drive them out.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣiriba kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinunaayɔbu kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The family history of Benjamin shows there were of them living in Jerusalem. All these men were leaders in their families.

dag: O daa mali nyolɔrigu ka di be kaman bɛ ni daa she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm la. Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest.

dag: Dama ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni ti yi zuɣusaa n-siɣina ni tahigu mini malaikanim zuɣulan kukoli ni Naawuni kikaa kumsi. Ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la ni ti daŋ kum ni neebu;.
en: There will be the shout of command, the archangel's voice, the sound of God's trumpet, and the Lord himself will come down from heaven. Those who have died believing in Christ will rise to life first;.

dag: Nyama, m pɔri pam. Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi garig a? N ni zaŋ n nuhi pɔbi n noli.
en: I am not worthy to speak! What can I say to you? I cannot answer you! I will put my hand over my mouth.

dag: amaa m mi ni hal a yi suhi shɛlikam Naawuni sani pumpɔŋɔ, o ni ti a li.
en: But I know that even now God will give you anything you ask.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Ijipti baŋdiba mini bukpahinim bɛn nyɛ timanim na, ka bɛ gba daa ti tum bɛ tabibi tuma niŋ lala.
en: Then Pharaoh called together his wise men and wizards, and Egypts religious experts did the same thing by using their secret knowledge.

dag: O mi yi ŋme n-vuɣ o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nyini, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nyini maa zuɣu.
en: If a master hits his slave in the mouth, and the slave loses a tooth, then the slave will be allowed to go free. The slaves tooth is payment for the slaves freedom. This is the same for a man or a woman slave.

dag: Ti ni daa nya so ka wum o yɛla maa yɛla ka ti yɛri ya maa ni di chɛ ka ti mini ya mali dolintabitali, ka ti mi dolintabitali maa bela ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia Yisa Masia sani.
en: What we have seen and heard, we also announce it to you so that you can have fellowship with us. Our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

dag: N ni zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ barina shee, ka zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu ni.
en: I am ready to risk my life.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-naai saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: When the whole nation had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla nir ni daa yi zɔri kuni tin shɛŋa ni tiligiri la ti ba. Shɛkɛm din be zoya ni la mini Gɛza ni di momaha tiŋgbana ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba.
en: They were given the city of Shechem. Shechem is a city of safety. They were also given the towns of Gezer.

dag: Abigeel n-daa dɔɣi Amasa, Amasa ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la.
en: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti suui li zali, o yɛrimi, Yawɛ labimi Izraɛlnim tuhituhi zuɣa ŋɔ sanna.
en: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, Our Lord , stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.

dag: Molimi molo Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛli: Piɛbimi kikaa gili tiŋgbani maa ni, ka tahiri pampam yɛra, Laɣimmiya taba ka ti chaŋ ti kpe bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni.
en: Give this message to the people of Judah: Tell everyone in the city of Jerusalem: Blow the trumpet all over the country. Shout out loud and say, Come together! Let us all escape to the strong cities for protection.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, ka o garigi ma. N daa bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee din zilim pam la ka kuhi bol a, ka a wum n kuhigu maa.
en: In my distress, O Lord , I called to you, and you answered me. From deep in the world of the dead I cried for help, and you heard me.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal min o mabihi daa ti ka Shɛkɛm na, Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa niŋ o naani.
en: A man named Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers moved to the city of Shechem. The leaders of the city of Shechem decided to trust and follow Gaal.

dag: Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la. O yi ti yɛli ya shɛlikam, yin doliya li.
en: Moses said, The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya maa tiŋgbani tariga. Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Rubin zuliya maa ni bɛ su li.
en: The land that was given to Reuben stopped at the shore of the Jordan River. So the land that was given to the family groups of Reuben included all these towns and their fields that were listed.

dag: Ka n yi be bɛ ni ka a mi be n ni, dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini ni yɛlimaŋli, ka dunianim baŋ ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na, ka lan baŋ ni a yuri bɛn niŋ ma yɛda maa kaman a ni yuri ma shɛm.
en: I in them and you in me, so that they may be completely one, in order that the world may know that you sent me and that you love them as you love me.

dag: Tiŋgbani, sɔhigim ti Duuma tooni. Sɔhigim ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: The earth shook in front of the Lord, the God of Jacob.

dag: ka lan bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla m bia Iso? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: but asked again, Are you really Esau? I am, he answered.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba pirigibu balibu buyi bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni maa zaa daa mali hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka zuɣulaannim pirigili daa be n sani.
en: Then both groups of those who gave thanks stood in Gods house. I was there too along with the half of the officials who were with me.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla din pun beni, ka din yɛn beni nyɛla din pun beni. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mi din pun gari yɛla.
en: What happened in the past has happened, and what will happen in the future will happen. But God wants to help those who have been treated badly.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o zaligunima, ka jɛmd o ni bɛ suhuri zaa mali alibarika.
en: Those who guard Gods laws are truly happy! They seek God with all their hearts.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan yɛli Yisifu, N daa bi tɛhi ni n ni lan nya a ni n nini, amaa ka Naawuni mi ti chɛ ka n nya a bihi gba.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, I never expected to see you again, and now God has even let me see your children.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o ni pun tum shɛm min o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa wuhi ba la yɛla.
en: They forgot the great things he had done and the amazing things he had shown them.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o biɛhigu shee; chɛliya ka ti jɛm o o napɔntamdigu shee.
en: Lets enter Gods dwelling place; lets worship at the place God rests his feet!.

dag: Pashihur ni Amaria ni Malikija ni.
en: Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah.

dag: Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni daa ŋmaai bihili, ka o lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga yaha.
en: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.

dag: A daa zaŋ liiga shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi n-yɛli ba, ka zaŋ n kpam mini n tulaale zim la zali bɛ tooni.
en: You took the embroidered clothes I gave you and put them on the images, and you offered to the images the olive oil and incense I had given you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa sab gbaŋ ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni yɛli: Naawuni timi ya suhudoo pam!.
en: Then King Darius wrote to the people of all nations, races, and languages on earth: Greetings!.

dag: Bɛ bo n-nya ma pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ teemi gili ma, bɛ lihirimi bɔri bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli n-voo ma luhi.
en: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.

dag: Ninsalinim daa di malaikanim bindirigu. O daa ti ba li pam.
en: So they ate the food of angels, and God gave them all they wanted.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi sani ka Naawuni yɛligu yina? Bee yi kɔŋko sani ka di kana?.
en: Did the word of God originate with you? Has it come only to you?.

dag: O ni wurim zoya din du pam mini kunkuna din du pam zaa.
en: against all the high mountains; against all the lofty hills.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n yuli m-bala. M bi zaŋdi n jilima tiri so. M mi bi zaŋdi m paɣibu tiri binnana.
en: My name is the Lord ! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.

dag: O zaŋ kuɣikpɛra me ŋ-ŋari n soli. O chɛ ka n soya niŋla so gɔna.
en: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka a zaŋ naɣ bindi she bɔrɔbɔro maa ka chɛ ninsal bindi maa.
en: So God said, Very well. I will let you use cow dung instead, and you can bake your bread on that.

dag: N ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ sɔŋda; n ni lab yi sanna.
en: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.

dag: dama Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa zaŋ wuntia soli ka yi sanna la, yi daa bi niŋ o yɛda; amaa ka farigudeeriba mini pagɔra bɛn daa niŋ o yɛda. Ka hal yi ni daa nya lala maa zaa yoli, di nyaaŋa yi daa bi niŋ tuuba ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: For John the Baptist came to you showing you the right path to take, and you would not believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. Even when you saw this, you did not later change your minds and believe him.

dag: Niŋmi li la ashilɔni, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni ŋɔ ti a di laara.
en: Then your gift will be given in secret. Your Father knows what is done in secret and will reward you.

dag: Nir yi doli ʒiri soli bo n-nya buni, di nyɛla kaman gulisigu mini kum zana.
en: Wealth that comes from telling lies disappears quickly and leads to death.

dag: Ka bɛ ni teeri nam zuɣupiligu maa yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya ni Jɔsia n-yɛn su di fukumsi.
en: The crown will be a memorial in the Lord 's Temple in honor of Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.

dag: So ku tooi yo omaŋmaŋ talima samli bee n-yo Naawuni o nyɛvili samli.
en: Wealth? It cant save a single person! It cant pay a lifes ransom-price to God.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani m-bala, Cham ti yɛl a dana Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: Elijah replied, I am. Go and say to your master, Elijah is here.

dag: Lala ka Sulemaana daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma zaa din nyɛ: salima sara maligu bimbini mini teebu shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: Solomon also made all the equipment for Gods temple: the gold altar; the tables for the bread of the presence.

dag: Ka pukpar kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, N dana, chɛl li zali yuuni ŋɔ pahi, ka n gbi bɔɣili gil li n-niŋ kulim niŋ li.
en: The gardener responded, Lord, give it one more year, and I will dig around it and give it fertilizer.

dag: Dama ti bi mali baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zaa, ti mi bi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zaa;.
en: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.

dag: Ti yi saɣi ka bɛ be ti sani, bɛ niɣi mini bɛ binshɛɣukam ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa ku leei ti dini.
en: If we do this, we will become rich from all their cattle and other animals. We should make this agreement with them so that they will stay here with us.

dag: ka yɛli ba, N yi ti paai sansani maa shee, yin lihimiya ma ka niŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Now watch me, he ordered them, and do what I do. When I get to the outpost of the camp, do just what I do.

dag: A daalikauli nyɛla din tiri ma nyɛvili; dina n-nyɛ n suhu kpaŋsibo n wahala dibu puuni.
en: My comfort during my suffering is this: your word gives me new life.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa. Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa.
en: Lord , your faithful love fills the earth. Teach me your laws.

dag: N kuhimi ka n nina mɔhi, ka zibisim titali limsi n niŋkari.
en: I have cried until my face is red, and my eyes are swollen and circled with shadows.

dag: Dan ni ti ŋmanila sokpaŋ tinvurigu. O nyɛla sokpaŋ gariŋga ŋun dimdi wɔhu napɔŋkpaa, ka ŋun bar o lɛbiri lur o kpali zuɣu.
en: Dan will be a snake at the side of the road, A poisonous snake beside the path, That strikes at the horse's heel, So that the rider is thrown off backward.

dag: Bɛ to tɛte di m binyɛrigu, ka piri n situra ti taba.
en: They took my clothes and gambled for them.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi so zuɣu maa dii kahi nti kpe bɛ ni n-nyaŋ bɛ zaa m-bu n-ti ba dansi, ka bɛ zo ni bɛ zaɣim n-yi yili maa ni.
en: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and beat them up. They ran out of the house, naked and bruised.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli ti ni daa kul chɛ alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa malibu, ka bi lan boori kom bahir o, ti daa lan ka binshɛli, ka tɔbu mini kum kuri ti.
en: But ever since we stopped sacrificing to the Queen of Heaven and stopped pouring out wine offerings to her, we have had nothing, and our people have died in war and of starvation.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia ni bɛ di n nyɛvil la ni chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.

dag: ka n suhu paligi pam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ ni.
en: and I am glad because of God my Savior.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yɛn saɣim la yimaŋa kaman yi yaannim ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋ shɛm maa, ka gba birigi jɛmdi n ni je bɛ binshɛŋa maa?.
en: Then ask the Israelites why they are following the example of their wicked ancestors.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni o nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianim maa.
en: Joab saw that he had to fight in front and behind at the same time, and he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Arameans.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a nambɔzɔbo min a yurilim maŋli la yɛla; dama di nyɛla din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha.
en: Please, Lord , remember, you have always been patient and kind.

dag: N ni ti ti maligumaaniba bindir suma, ka n niriba ti di m pina din galisi tiɣi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will give the priests plenty of food. And my people will be filled and satisfied with the good things I give them. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Naawuni ni, ka ku tam Naawuni tuma yɛla, ka kul dol o zaligunima.
en: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu ni bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba bahi yoli.
en: In the same way, my Father who is in heaven doesnt want to lose one of these little ones.

dag: Ka Samsin daa zaŋ o nudirigu min o nuzaa n-gbaai sunsuuni daantalis ayi shɛŋa zuɣu duu maa ni tamya maa;.
en: Samson grabbed the two central pillars that held up the temple. He leaned against one with his right hand and the other with his left.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka nuu teei tiri ma na, ka bɛ ni sabi gbaŋ shɛli kpabikpabi be di ni.
en: I saw a hand reaching out toward me, and it was holding a scroll.

dag: Di saha maa ha so daa yi yɛn chaŋ shɛli polo ka labina o suhu bi doya; dama tinsi maa nim daa kul zabirimi.
en: In those times of trouble, no one could travel safely. There was great trouble in all the nations.

dag: ni Danna ni Kiriatisɛfa.
en: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah .

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana ti kpaag o kaman bɛ ni kpaari wain di duɣuri ni shɛm la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duɣuri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But the time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will send to him someone to spill it—to pour out his wine and to smash his jars.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: At that time the disciples came to Jesus, asking, Who is the greatest in the Kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia yɛli ba, Di viɛla, n ni suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛm maa. Ka o ni garigi yɛli shɛm, n ni yɛli ya. N ku sɔɣi ya shɛli.
en: The prophet Jeremiah replied, Yes, Ill pray to the LORD your God as you have asked. And Ill tell you whatever the LORD says; I wont hide anything from you.

dag: dama o daa niŋ yɛda ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Naawuni ni tooi niŋ o ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛl la.
en: He was fully convinced that God was able to do what he promised.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka kum daa ti lu Ijipti mini Keenan tiŋgbɔna ni zaa n-ti ba wahala pam, ka ti yaannim maa daa ti lan ka bindirigu.
en: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni gari o ni niŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ni.
en: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila, dama n kanimina ni n ti be yi sani.
en: The Lord says, Zion, be happy, because I am coming, and I will live in your city.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi tiŋ dunɔdali gbini ni zuri so nyaaŋa, ka danyuriba zaŋ ma niŋ yila ni yiina.
en: They talk about me in public places. The beer drinkers make up songs about me.

dag: Sool mam daa beni ka o yuli booni Rizipa. O daa nyɛla Aiya bipuɣiŋga, ka Ishibɔshɛt daa ti bɔhi Abinɛr, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ m ba mam maa dɔni.
en: Saul had a slave woman named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. Ish Bosheth said to Abner, Why did you have sexual relations with my fathers servant woman.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, A tizo Ɛbɛl be ya? Ka Keen garigi yɛli, M bi mi; mani n-nyɛ n tizo maa gula.
en: The LORD said to Cain, Where is your brother Abel? Cain said, I dont know. Am I my brothers guardian.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisili, di kul kpɛrila ninsal niŋgbuna puuni.
en: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Zɛnan mini Hadasha ni Migidaligad.
en: The tribe of Judah was also given these towns: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad.

dag: Nir ni tooi di bindir shɛli din be piti ka pa ni yalim be di ni? Bee nyaɣisim bɔ n-lee be no gal piɛlli ni?.
en: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?.

dag: Bee m-bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣi tiŋgban ni? .
en: or Who will go down into the region below? .

dag: Damaskus yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Damaskus ku lan nyɛla tiŋa. Di ni kabi lu n-duhi doya.
en: The Lord said, Damascus will not be a city any longer; it will be only a pile of ruins.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu ku tɔŋ, amaa ŋunkam yihi li palɔni, ka zaɣisi li ni nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: You will never succeed in life if you try to hide your sins. Confess them and give them up; then God will show mercy to you.

dag: Iso bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlifaz mini Riuɛl ni Jɛushi ni Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: Esaus sons were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, Naawuni zahimmi n yɛla nya, ka deei n suhigu ka ti ma bidibiga; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Dan.
en: Rachel said, God has judged in my favor, heard my voice, and given me a son. So she named him Dan.

dag: Jɛrikɔnim daa kparila Jɛriko goondaa dunoya Izraɛlnim zuɣu; ka so ku tooi gari yi bee n-gari kpe di ni.
en: The gates of the city of Jericho were closed. The people in the city were afraid because the Israelites were near. No one went into the city, and no one came out.

dag: Dama chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa baŋ ni pa Izraɛl naa maa m-bala maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: The chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, so they stopped pursuing him.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni alikauli suɣili maa ni.
en: Moses then put all the sticks in the Tent in front of the Lord 's Covenant Box.

dag: Chɛ ka n dol a zaligunim soli, dama n suhu yuri li pam.
en: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.

dag: Gomna Filiksi ni daa wum lala ka mi mi soli ŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga la zuɣu ka o daa chɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa zali soli ka yɛli ba, Sapashin kpɛm Lisias n-ni kana ka n naanyi ŋmaai yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Felix already understood a lot about the Way. He stopped the trial and said, When commander Lysias comes here, I will decide what to do with you.

dag: Ka o ti yih o fiɛɣu min o kɔbiri bahi sara maligu bimbini maa wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri la.
en: Then the priest will remove its throat along with its contents and throw it by the east side of the altar, into the place for the ashes.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o ba yiŋ Ofira nti ku o ba bihi ninvuɣ pisopɔin bɛn nyɛ Gidiɔn bidibisi la tampin yini zuɣu. Amaa ka Jɔtam ŋun daa nyɛ Gidiɔn kaluɣ la ŋun daa sɔɣi, ka bɛ bi nya o ku o.
en: Abimelech went to his fathers house at Ophrah and murdered his brothers. He killed the sons of his father Gideon. He killed them all at the same time, but Gideons youngest son hid from Abimelech and escaped. The youngest sons name was Jotham.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi zɔnim zaa yɔhim ya. Bɛ kari ya tahi yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga. Yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi ka taali nyaŋ ya. Yi mini yi zɔnim bɛn laɣindi timdi diri bari ya zana, ka yi ku tooi baŋ li.
en: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.

dag: ni Ishimɛrai ni Izilia ni Jɔbab daa nyɛla Ɛlipaal bidibisi.
en: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.

dag: Harif daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pinaayi.
en: the descendants of Hariph:.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm dahin shɛli n ni daa tuui ka Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na nti be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: When they arrived, he said to them, You know how I spent the whole time I was with you, from the first day I arrived in the province of Asia.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kab chaŋ bɛ ni daa tuhi fa neen shɛŋa maa gbini nti kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi ni naɣinyama sɔŋ, ka niriba maa daa ŋub ba, bɛ mi daa bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: and so they rushed over to what they had captured from the enemy, took sheep and cattle, slaughtered them on the spot, and ate the meat with the blood still in it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka gbaŋŋmara Shafan lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma; ka daa zani naa maa tooni karim li.
en: And then he said, I have here a book that Hilkiah gave me. And he read it aloud to the king.

dag: Miri ka a fa nandaamba nɛma bɛ ni nyɛ nandaamba zuɣu bee m-muɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala dunɔdali ni;.
en: Dont steal from the poor, because they are poor. Dont oppress the needy in the gate.

dag: A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisili pam, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, filimm a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒil ti ʒitibisi shɛl la; ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father Solomon treated us harshly and placed heavy burdens on us. If you make these burdens lighter and make life easier for us, we will be your loyal subjects.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan kpi yaha; bɛ biɛhigu mini malaikanim biɛhigu ti kul yɛn nyɛla yim. Bɛ ti yɛn nyɛla Naawuni bihi bɛ ni nyɛ kum ni neebu bihi maa zuɣu.
en: They will be like angels and cannot die. They are the children of God, because they have risen from death.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinima n-yɛn tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni tuma ka bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi ʒi bɛ zuɣu. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ li yi ʒiɛmani kam ni. Lɛvinim mi ku pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu su tiŋgbani palo.
en: From now on only the Levites will take care of the Tent and bear the full responsibility for it. This is a permanent rule that applies also to your descendants. The Levites shall have no permanent property in Israel.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Yaamiya yi noya ka n dihi ya.
en: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni o ni niŋ anfaan shɛli din mali jilima niŋ ti ni yoli o Biyurigu zuɣu la.
en: Let us praise God for his glorious grace, for the free gift he gave us in his dear Son!.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Ijiptinima n-daa yi nyɛ o yaa, ka di mi daa ka tariga. Putinim mini Libianim n-daa nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o.
en: Cush and Egypt constituted her strength, without limit; Put and the Libyans were her help.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi Bɛtani chana, ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: The next day, Jesus was leaving Bethany. He was hungry.

dag: Ŋun daa nya li ni o nini n-yɛl li ni yi niŋ yɛda. O yɛligu maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka o mi ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.

dag: Yɛm shɛli yɛla n ni mali tɔɣisiri maa nyɛla Naawuni daashili yɛmsɔɣirili shɛli o ni daa zali ti jilima nyabu zuɣu hal ka na bi nam dunia ŋɔ la.
en: The wisdom I proclaim is God's secret wisdom, which is hidden from human beings, but which he had already chosen for our glory even before the world was made.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma laara n wuntitali mini m biɛrisuntali zaŋ chaŋ o sani zuɣu.
en: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ wuntitali kaman shɛlɔrigu la n-lo o shee ni; ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali kaman shɛlɔrigu la n-lo o shee ni pahi.
en: Righteousness will be the belt around his hips, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

dag: Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ zali ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nima, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛba ti paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Let this be written down for the next generation so that people not yet created will praise the LORD.

dag: Ka alizin birigu maa kuhi, ka lan yiɣisi bia maa pam ka naanyi zo ka chɛ o; ka bia maa be kaman o kpimi la hal ka sokam tɛhi ni o shiri kpimi.
en: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa daa niŋmi ni ti Duuma ni daa chɛ ka anab so yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Now all of this took place so that what the Lord had spoken through the prophet would be fulfilled.

dag: Nir jɛrilim tuma bahir o yoli, di zaa yoli ka o suhu yiɣisiri bahiri Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: Some people ruin themselves by their own stupid actions and then blame the Lord .

dag: Amaa yinim ta li daɣiri yi ni yɛli ni ti Duuma bindirigu shee bi be nyam, ka di bindirigu maa nyɛ bɛ ni ni tooi ʒiɛm shɛl la zuɣu.
en: But even you priests insult me by saying, There's nothing special about the Lord 's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Jɔshua sani Makɛda sansan la ni ni alaafee. Ka so daa bi tooi yaar o noli yɛri shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim maa polo.
en: Then the whole people came back safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah. Not a single person threatened the Israelites.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni tum alahichi shɛŋa min o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu ka o yɛn chɛ Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: He will let the Israelites be defeated because Jeroboam sinned, and then he made the Israelites sin.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma.
en: I received this message from the Lord All-Powerful:.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Yawɛ ni zal o ni o tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa maa naai, di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinima ni niriba maa zaa daa gbaag o, ka yɛli, Ti ni ku a!.
en: And when Jeremiah finished saying everything the LORD told him to say, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him and said, You must die!.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, n gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani;.
en: Therefore, everyone who acknowledges me before people, I also will acknowledge before my Father who is in heaven.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm! Bɛ ku Jɔnatan sɔŋ zoya zuɣu!.
en: Look how the mighty warriors have fallen in the midst of battle! Jonathan lies dead on your heights.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jarimiya yi kɔbiti din bi jari ŋɔ, ka miriya ka yi biriti yi bimbira niŋdi gɔhi ni.
en: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.

dag: Di bi simdi ni doo zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dama o nyɛla Naawuni kɔtomsi min o jilima, ka paɣ mi nyɛ doo jilima.
en: A man shouldnt have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is mans glory.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋme n-wurim bɛ ni daa me binwɔɣila shɛŋa zal la, ka chɛ n-kabi buɣili Ashɛrim binnani luhi; ka zaŋ ninsalinim kɔba niŋ di zaashɛhi maa bɔɣa ni.
en: He broke all the memorial stones and Asherah poles. Then he scattered dead mens bones over that place.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Apolɔs? Bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Pool? Ti kul nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn sɔŋ ya ka yi niŋ yɛda kaman ti Duuma ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm.
en: After all, what is Apollos? What is Paul? They are servants who helped you to believe. Each one had a role given to them by the Lord.

dag: amaa di daa sabila ti gba zuɣu. Naawuni ni zaŋ tinim bɛn niŋ ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni yɛda ŋɔ gba zali wuntia zaani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: They were also written for us. God will also accept us because we believe. We believe in the one who raised Jesus our Lord from death.

dag: M mali yiko ni n di niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa a ba Yisahaku Naawuni la sa yɛli ma yuŋ la, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I have the power to really hurt you. But last night the God of your father came to me in a dream. He warned me not to hurt you in any way.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa maani o tuumba maa ansarisi, ka zaɣis o yɛligu wumbu, ka lar o daanabinima, ka Yawɛ suhu ti yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu pam hal ka di ti kɔŋ tim.
en: But they made fun of Gods prophets and refused to listen to them. They hated Gods messages. Finally, the Lord could not hold his anger any longer. He became angry with his people and there was nothing that could be done to stop it.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni zaligu malaikanim nuu ni, amaa ka lee bi dol li.
en: You are the ones who received God's law, that was handed down by angels—yet you have not obeyed it.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, chɛliya ka ti be Yawɛ neesim ni chana.
en: Now, descendants of Jacob, let us walk in the light which the Lord gives us!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kiburɔtihataava maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hazɛrɔt.
en: They left Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

dag: Gbuɣima ŋum bahi bɛ zuɣu. Bɛ ŋumiya pam. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbani bahi yoli, ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: Lions roar at him; they growl. They destroy his land and make his towns desolate until nothing is left.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o mini Yɛhudianim ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn daa jɛmdi Naawuni tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla bɛ jɛmbu duu; ka o daa yi lan yiri daa ni nti tɔɣisiri ŋunkam yɛn gar o sani Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: He began to interact with the Jews and Gentile God-worshippers in the synagogue. He also addressed whoever happened to be in the marketplace each day.

dag: Isaka zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tola daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Tolanima; ka Puva daŋ niriba nyɛ Puvanima.
en: Issachars descendants according to their clans: from Tola, the Tolaite clan; from Puvah, the Punite clan.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam kuhi yɛli, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la luya! Di leela alizin biɛri biɛhigu shee ka leei tabizahim shia kam zaŋ tabili noom biɛɣ kam bɛn mali daɣiri biɛhigu shee.
en: The angel shouted, Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.

dag: N ŋmanila sana dunia ŋɔ ni; di zaŋ a zaligunim sɔɣi ma.
en: I am here on earth for just a little while; do not hide your commands from me.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira. Tɛhi shɛli ni bi mali yinim shɛb ŋɔ, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya. Pirigimiya yi situra sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buri so yi shɛhi ni.
en: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali sara maa naai, ka naa mini bɛn zaa daa be o sani gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Na kul yum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la, ka ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la polo.
en: Our Lord , keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnima nti ku ba, ka n daa bi ŋmaligi labi n nyaaŋa hal ka ti naai bɛ balibu zaa.
en: I kept chasing my enemies until I caught them and destroyed them.

dag: Kpambaliba yi wum ni n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka kana ti yɛl a, Kul yɛlim ti a ni yɛli naa shɛm, di sɔɣi ti shɛli, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a. Wula ka naa lee yɛl a.
en: If the officials hear that I have talked with you, they will come and ask you what we said. They will promise not to put you to death if you tell them everything.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A healthy tree does not bear bad fruit, nor does a poor tree bear good fruit.

dag: Bɛ tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nyɛla bɛ ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee dasara mini di kuruwɔɣila ni daantalisi ni di binzahi.
en: They shall be responsible for carrying the frames, bars, posts, and bases of the Tent.

dag: Ka ŋunkam dɔni tiŋa yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka ŋunkam di bindirigu yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra.
en: Any who lie down or eat in the house must wash their clothes.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Wula ka di lee sab Naawuni zaligu ni? Wula ka a lee karindi li.
en: Jesus answered him, What do the Scriptures say? How do you interpret them.

dag: Dama n yi lan labi m-me n ni daa pun wurim shɛl la, dindina n leela ŋun tum din chihi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: But I would be wrong to begin teaching again those things that I gave up.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Jabin sapashin kpɛm Sisɛra zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi kana ti chirigi ya Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni; ka n zaŋ o niŋ a nuu ni.
en: The Lord will trick Sisera into coming out to fight you at the Kishon River. Sisera will be leading King Jabin's army as usual, and they will have their chariots, but the Lord has promised to help you defeat them.

dag: Amaa kom yi be bimbira maa ni ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli lu di zuɣu, bimbira maa leei daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: But if you put water on some seed and if any part of a dead, unclean animal falls on those seeds, they are unclean for you.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ wuna din pa Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka zaŋ bɛ buɣa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi. Lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka bɛn pa niriba niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi.
en: With their idols they have made me angry, jealous with their so-called gods, gods that are really not gods. So I will use a so-called nation to make them angry; I will make them jealous with a nation of fools.

dag: Saimɔn Pita pun wuhi ti Naawuni ni daa tuui pii bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ leeg o niriba shɛm yɛla.
en: Simon has just explained how God first showed his care for the Gentiles by taking from among them a people to belong to him.

dag: N ni daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ n daalahichi polo, n kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka n kul ŋuhiri hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When I did not confess my sins, I was worn out from crying all day long.

dag: Bɛ leela ninvuɣ diɣilima bɛn bi zɔri vi. Bɛ tumdila kɔr biɛri tuma, ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla daɣiri tuma balibu kam tumbu zuɣu.
en: They have lost all feeling of shame; they give themselves over to vice and do all sorts of indecent things without restraint.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so; n lo alikauli ni n ni gbib a yɛligu.
en: You, Lord , are my choice, and I will obey you.

dag: dama yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti be, ka pa ni ti nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu.
en: But we live by faith, not by what we see.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti ni yɛli shɛm yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka Yawɛ lee kahig o yiko wuhi?.
en: Who can believe what we have heard, and for whose sake has the LORDs arm been revealed?.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tuumba maa mini yɛdaniŋdib bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa wum ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The apostles and the brothers and sisters throughout Judea heard that even the Gentiles had welcomed Gods word.

dag: Ŋuni ka o daa niŋ saawara ni o baŋ shɛli, ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o yɛlimaŋli soli. Ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o baŋsim bee n-wuh o o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm?.
en: With whom does God consult in order to know and understand and to learn how things should be done?.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ kpana pam to n-chib o gbaŋ bee n-zaŋ zahimgbahiri kpana to o zuɣu ni?.
en: Can you throw spears into his skin or head?.

dag: Ŋun biriti omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla din poora niŋgbuŋ kɔre maa zuɣu; amaa ŋun biriti Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu, Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu.
en: Those who plant only for their own benefit will harvest devastation from their selfishness, but those who plant for the benefit of the Spirit will harvest eternal life from the Spirit.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali gali sabilifaa bee gali ʒiɛkpeein bee gali ʒiɛkpain bee tan piɛl viɛlli bee buhi kɔbiri bee bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛ gban shɛŋa bee teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana daa zaŋ li na.
en: Everyone who had fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn brought it to the Lord. Anyone who had goat hair or ram skins dyed red or fine leather brought it to the Lord.

dag: Yinim bɛn be dabitim ni ka mali tahima pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, labimiya yi birini ni na. N yɛri ya mi, n ni niŋ alibarika ʒii buyi zuɣu niŋ yi ni.
en: Prisoners, go home! Now you have something to hope for. I am telling you now, I am coming back to you.

dag: Amaa wula ka n kɔŋko lee ni tooi maani yi yɛlimuɣisira ŋɔ, ka maani yi zabili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: But how can I alone bear the heavy responsibility for settling your disputes?.

dag: Naa daa ʒinila o ʒiishee din tab dukpini kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka Jɔnatan ʒiɛya, ka Abinɛr mi ʒini baɣili Sool, amaa ka Dauda ŋun ʒiishee daa nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ.
en: by the wall, just as he always did. Jonathan sat across from him, and Abner sat next to him. But David's place was empty.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpalim guhiri saha shɛli maa, ka Ɛhud daa chaŋ hal ti gari kuɣikpɛra shee la n-zo n-kuli Siɛra tiligi.
en: Ehud had gotten away while they were waiting and had passed the carved stones and escaped to Seirah.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni daalibarika n-tim bɛn niŋdi ya alaka; chɛliya ba turi, ka kul suhimiyala Naawuni daalibarika tim ba.
en: Wish only good for those who treat you badly. Ask God to bless them, not curse them.

dag: ka daa doli Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri n-yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.

dag: Ka Sool daa wum Jɔnatan ni yɛl o shɛm maa zaa, ka po pɔri yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku lan ku o.
en: Saul was convinced by what Jonathan said and made a vow in the Lord 's name that he would not kill David.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔɣisimiya ka niŋmiya kaman bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ o zaligu shɛli din tiri yolisim la kari shɛb saria.
en: You will be judged by the law that makes people free. You should remember this in everything you say and do.

dag: Ka tɔrili zaɣ titali so daa lan beni m-mali kpiŋkpan kara, ka mali kɔbiri pam. Nyama, ka yɔɣili maa ŋmaligi di nyaɣa kpa o polo, ka teei di wula kpa o polo ni o niŋ kom yɔɣi li, ka bɛ sibigi li bɛ ni biri li luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Now there was another great eagle with great wings and much plumage. This vine bent its roots and turned its branches toward him so that it might draw more water from him than from its own bed.

dag: A yiko puuni, cham ti di nasara; ka taɣi yɛlimaŋli mini din tuhi zali. Chɛ ka a nudirigu tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm.
en: Ride on in majesty to victory for the defense of truth and justice! Your strength will win you great victories!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa lo noli suhi ti Naawuni di zuɣu, ka o daa deei ti suhigu maa.
en: So we fasted and prayed to our God for this, and he responded to us.

dag: Wummiya! Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn zo n-tiligi yi Babilɔn kanna ni bɛ ti yɛli Ziɔnnima Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu zuɣu shɛm.
en: Refugees escape from Babylonia and come to Jerusalem, and they tell how the Lord our God took revenge for what the Babylonians had done to his Temple.

dag: N ni bɔri shɛli zaa nyɛla ni m baŋ Masia, ka baŋ o kum ni neebu yiko yɛla, ka pah o zuɣu di wahala, ka be kaman ŋuna o kum puuni.
en: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him from death. I want to share in his sufferings and be like him even in his death.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Di pun sabi anabinim litaafinim ni ni Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni wuhi sokam zaa. Ka ŋunkam wum ka bɔhim m Ba sani n-nyɛ ŋun kani n sanna.
en: It is written in the Prophets, And they will all be taught by God. Everyone who has listened to the Father and learned from him comes to me.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa diri Judia saha shɛl la, ka maligumaani so daa beni ka o yuli booni Zakaria. O daa nyɛla Abija daŋ ni nira, ka o paɣ mi daa nyɛ Aduna daŋ ni nira, ka o yuli booni Ɛlizabɛt.
en: During the time when Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly order of Abijah. His wife's name was Elizabeth; she also belonged to a priestly family.

dag: Lɛla ni ŋub ba kaman bɛ ni ŋubiri situra shɛm la. Zunzuya ni di ba kaman piɛkɔbiri la. Amaa n faako tibu mini n tiliginsim din nyɛ zuliya kam zaa dini la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end.

dag: O tiri nandaamba pina, ka tiri bɛn ka pina.
en: She is generous to the poor and needy.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi yi tum niriba gaŋbu tuun shɛli ashilɔni, o ni darigi yi tibili.
en: Even though your prejudice is hidden, he will reprimand you.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi, dabisi shɛli dali yi ni sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. Kpahimmiya nya din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: Today you have completed the foundation for my temple, so listen to what your future will be like.

dag: O ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana ni o ti tuhi Naa Dauda soli maa, ka naa bɔh o, Mɛfibɔshɛt, bɔzuɣu ka a daa bi doli ma chaŋ.
en: When he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked him, Mephibosheth, why didnt you go with me.

dag: Tim ti suhupiɛlli dabisi gbaliŋ kaman a ni daa chɛ ka ti nya suhugarigu shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paligi yuun gbaliŋ kaman ti ni daa nya zaɣ biɛɣu shɛm.
en: Make us happy for the same amount of time that you afflicted us— for the same number of years that we saw only trouble.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa garigi yɛli Leeban, N daa zɔr a mi, dama n daa tɛhimi ni di pa shɛli ka a ti zaŋ kiŋkansi fa a bipuɣinsi maa n sani.
en: Jacob answered, I left secretly because I was afraid you would take your daughters from me by force.

dag: Bɛ daa guhiri ma mi kaman bɛ ni guhiri saa shɛm la. Bɛ suhuri daa kul yɛla n zuɣu kaman niriba suhuri ni ye siɣili saa zuɣu shɛm la.
en: They waited for my words as they would for rain. They drank them in like rain in the springtime.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni maa zaa biɛlabiɛla; yi ku tooi kari ba naai yomyom, di yi niŋ lala mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni ti galisi nyaŋ ya.
en: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.

dag: Yawɛ yɛn zaŋla buɣim min o takɔbi n-darigi dunia ŋɔ niriba bɛn zaa mali taali tibili. O ni ti chɛ ka niriba pam kpi.
en: By fire and sword he will punish all the people of the world whom he finds guilty—and many will be put to death.

dag: Bɛ mali nuhi, amaa di bi tabisiri shɛli. Bɛ mali naba, amaa di bi chana. Bɛ ku tooi zaŋ bɛ kukoya yɛli shɛli.
en: They have hands, but cannot feel, and feet, but cannot walk; they cannot make a sound.

dag: Ti zaŋdila ti nyɛviya pari talima n-chani ti bɔri bindirigu na, dama tɔbutuhiriba be mɔɣu ni.
en: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣi Naawuni o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ nyin Naawuni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sunsuuni ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.

dag: Bɛ daa tim na nti yɛli ma la zilin yini maa siɣimsiɣim bunahi, ka n gba daa labisi garigibu yini maa ti ba.
en: They sent me the same message four times, and each time I sent them the same reply.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: Heres the meaning of the seed that fell on rocky ground: When people hear the word, they immediately receive it joyfully.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Di simdi ni ti yili wumpaɣibo yilli paɣi ti Naawuni; dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim, ka di simdi ni ti yili yilli paɣ o.
en: Praise the Lord because he is good. Sing praises to our God. It is good and pleasant to praise him.

dag: Mbusim be yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi wuhiri ni nir yi po Naawuni jɛmbu duu di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po salima din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.

dag: O daa lan buɣisi zɔŋ la mini dunɔdali din daa baɣi daantalisi la ni dundɔŋ ni luɣilikam, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: Next he made out the perimeter of the hallway, defined by the arches inside the gate: it was ninety feet.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam mini noonsi ni biŋgbamda ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be teeku ni nyɛla ninsal ni ni tooi maai shɛb nina hal ka pun maai li gba.
en: Humans have control over every kind of wild animal, bird, reptile, and fish, and they have controlled all these things.

dag: Yi ŋmanila mɔɣu ni buŋa ŋun be tiŋgban nɛli ni. O yi ti kpabigi, o ʒiɛmi taɣiri ʒiɛɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yih o kɔre maa ni? Bɛnkam bɔr o bi lan yɛn nahim bɛmaŋa, o bɔbu goli yi zani, bɛ ni nya o.
en: rushing into the desert. When she is in heat, who can control her? No male that wants her has to trouble himself; she is always available in mating season.

dag: O chɛ ka sokam chɛ o tuma, ni di chɛ ka bɛ tɛhi ŋun Naawuni tuma yɛla.
en: He brings our work to a stop; he shows us what he can do.

dag: M biyurigu, n suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka shɛlikam be viɛnyɛla a sani, ka a lan mal alaafee a niŋgbuŋ ni gba kaman n ni mi ni a shia mal alaafee shɛm.
en: My dear friend, I know that you are doing well spiritually. So I pray that everything else is going well with you and that you are enjoying good health.

dag: So mi ni yɛli, Bindirigu nyɛla puli dini, ka puli gba nyɛ bindirigu dini. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa Naawuni ni ti saɣim di zaa yim. Niŋgbuŋ bi bela kɔr biɛri tuma tumbu zuɣu; amaa di nyɛla ti Duuma dini, ka ti Duuma gba nyɛ niŋgbuŋ dini.
en: Someone else says, Food is for the stomach, and the stomach for food. Yes, and God will destroy them both. But the body is not for sexual sin. The body is for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Malimiya shili zaŋ chaŋ dali, so di chɛ ka o mini paɣa dɔni.
en: Then Moses said to the people, Be ready for the meeting with God in three days. Until that time do not have sexual relations.

dag: n-yɛra, Miriya ka yi nahim n ninvuɣ gahinda maa; ka miriya ka yi niŋ n daanabinim zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Don't harm my chosen servants; do not touch my prophets.

dag: ni Nɛzia daŋ niriba ni Hatifa daŋ niriba.
en: Neziah, and Hatipha.

dag: Ti daa ʒinila tiŋa Babilɔn mɔɣa duli. Nimaani ka ti daa ʒini kum, saha shɛli ti ni daa teei Ziɔn yɛla.
en: Alongside Babylons streams, there we sat down, crying because we remembered Zion.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa di nam ʒin o ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka o nam maa daa ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Solomon succeeded his father David as king, and his royal power was firmly established.

dag: Ishimail bidibisi yuya kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ ba pa tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛbaiɔt ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Kɛdar ni Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: Ishmael had twelve sons, in this order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: What a big help you are to me— poor, weak man that I am!.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, Bia maa ku tooi wolig o ba, o yi wolig o, o ba maa ni kpi.
en: We told you that our father would die if Benjamin left him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi wuhi ni m mali yiko; bɛ ni tibigi ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Now I will arise, says the LORD. Now I will exalt myself; now I will stand tall.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Yaakubu n-leeg o dahalali nira. O zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: Because the LORD chose Jacob as his own, God chose Israel as his treasured possession.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu ŋmanila mɔri. Bɛ zoorimi kaman mɔɣu ni tipum la;.
en: As for us, our life is like grass. We grow and flourish like a wild flower;.

dag: Ka din pah anahi gbaai Iziri min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Fourth, there were men chosen from Izris sons and relatives.

dag: ni Araba zaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɔt Teeku din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt polo zaŋ kpa Araba Teeku din nyɛ Yalim Teeku n-do n-lab nudirigu polo Pisiga tintan ni la.
en: it included the Jordan Valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth Jeshimoth and on toward the foot of Mount Pisgah.

dag: A zaŋ a niriba kɔhi alaha, a bi zali ba da kpiɔŋ.
en: You sold your own people for a small price as though they had little value.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ni leei faralana ni vidira, amaa ŋun deeri wuhibu ni nya jilima.
en: If you refuse to learn from your mistakes, you will be poor, and no one will respect you. If you listen when you are criticized, you will be honored.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni n-dari gindi saha shɛl la ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa lala maa. Amaa nyama, di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla yuun pihinahinaanu, ka o na kul chɛ ka m be. Ka nyama, n nyɛla yuun pihiniinaanu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Joshua, it was years ago that the Lord told Moses to make that promise, and now I am . Even though Israel has moved from place to place in the desert, the Lord has kept me alive all this time as he said he would.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa yinoyino saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Niŋmiya tuuba, ka zo n-yi yi tuumbiɛri zaa tumbu ni, di yi pa lala tuumbiɛri tumbu maa ni chɛ ka yi bahi yoli.
en: Now I, the Sovereign Lord , am telling you Israelites that I will judge each of you by what you have done. Turn away from all the evil you are doing, and don't let your sin destroy you.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli, ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim a yurilim maŋli zuɣu. Dama a nya n ni diri wahala shɛli; ka mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni.
en: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni, ka chɛ ka kom zɔri teeni puri.
en: who provides rain over the earths surface, sends water to the open country.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka o daa fa ba bahi, amaa ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daalahichi daa chɛ ka bɛ nya filiŋ.
en: God delivered them numerous times, but they were determined to rebel, and so they were brought down by their own sin.

dag: N ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaa yɛla. Dama bɛ ni tum wuntitali tuun shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni be. .
en: None of the sins that they committed will be held against them, but they will live because they do the right things.

dag: Di bi simdi ni doo zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dama o nyɛla Naawuni kɔtomsi min o jilima, ka paɣ mi nyɛ doo jilima.
en: A man has no need to cover his head, because he reflects the image and glory of God. But woman reflects the glory of man;.

dag: N yi di daa bi tum daadam ni na ʒi n-tum tuun shɛli bɛ sani, bɛ naan ku mali taali; amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nya n ni tum shɛlikam maa, ka yaɣ di zuɣu zaɣisi m mini m Ba zaa.
en: They would not have been guilty of sin if I had not done among them the things that no one else ever did; as it is, they have seen what I did, and they hate both me and my Father.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ninsalinim zɔr o; o bi lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ yɛnnim la.
en: No wonder, then, that everyone is awed by him, and that he ignores those who claim to be wise.

dag: Ka ti zaa bɛn nyɛ chinchini ni bi pili liri shɛb ninni ŋɔ lihirila ti Duuma jilima ŋɔ, ka jilima maa mi nyɛla din kul pahiri jilima, ka nyɛ din taɣiri ti biɛhigu ni ti mal o ŋmahinli, dama dimbɔŋɔ yirila ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Shia la sanna.
en: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.

dag: Di saha ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Balaam gave this message: This message is from Balaam son of Beor. I am speaking about things I see clearly.

dag: Ka buŋ maa nya ma, ka birigi siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa. O yi di bi birigi, yɛlimaŋli, ŋ-ŋɔ n di pun ku a, ka chɛ o.
en: But your donkey saw me and turned aside three times. If it hadn't, I would have killed you and spared the donkey.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani n-tuhi ninvuɣ biɛri ti ma? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani tuhi tuumbiɛtumdiba ti ma?.
en: Who will stand up for me against the wicked? Who will help me against evildoers?.

dag: A puli ni fahiri ka a puuni biɛri waawaayili la zuɣu, di lan nyuri kom kɔŋko, amaa nyum wain biɛlabiɛla pahira.
en: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl .
en: He put up an altar there and named it for El, the God of Israel.

dag: ka yihi nanim bɛ nama ni, ka tibigi tarimba.
en: He brought down rulers from their thrones and raised up the humble people.

dag: di saha yin bom zim viɛlli lita ata n-zaŋ kpam lita ayi ŋmir li;.
en: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi bina chɛrisichɛrisi bɛ ninni, ka ʒe bɛ yinsi nɛma, ka bili bɛ paɣiba.
en: Everything in their houses will be stolen. Their wives will be raped, and their little children will be beaten to death while they watch.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣira ata maa daa chaŋ ti tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm samban ni dunɔdali shee kɔbiliga maa ni ti tooi kom maa na ti ti Dauda ni o nyu. Amaa ka o daa bi nyu li, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: So the Three Heroes fought their way through the Philistine army and got some water from the well near the city gate in Bethlehem. They took it to David, but he refused to drink it. He poured it on the ground as an offering to the Lord .

dag: Di simdi ni shɛhiranim maa n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni daŋ zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ bɛ ni yɛn ku ninvuɣ so maa kubu ni, di nyaaŋa ka sokam naanyi zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpɛhi di ni. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: In the execution, the hands of the witnesses must be against the guilty person from the start; the hand of all the people will be involved at the end. Remove such evil from your community!.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun nya nahiŋgu pam, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga fiɛbbu ni maa.
en: I am one who knows what it is to be punished by God.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni n yula pina deebu hali, amaa n lee bɔrimi ni yi nya laara pahi.
en: Im not hoping for a gift, but I am hoping for a profit that accumulates in your account.

dag: nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o pahi bilikɔɣinim ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: The master will cut him in pieces and make him share the fate of the hypocrites. There he will cry and gnash his teeth.

dag: Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina.
en: He said, Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.

dag: Dama yi yi zaɣisi ka zaŋ yimaŋa n-tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni ŋɔ, ka kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi n-niŋdi yi paɣiba ka bɛ gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi n-niŋdi bɛ paɣiba.
en: But if you should turn away and join the rest of these nations that remain with you, intermarry with them, and associate with each other.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li girimgirim li, ka di bi niŋ.
en: Some of the seed fell among thorn bushes, which grew up and choked the plants, and they didn't bear grain.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a kɔŋko ŋun yuli nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ, n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim shɛb zaa bɛn nyɛ Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛl kpamba ni daa kali kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the Israelites counted all the people in Levis family group. They had counted each family and each family group.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ me luɣ kasi shee ti ma din ni chɛ ka m be bɛ sani.
en: The people must make a sacred Tent for me, so that I may live among them.

dag: nti yɛli Aduna, Zaŋm naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛlaa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Di simdi ni bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn ka dalima, ka a zaŋ ba mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: He said to Aaron, Take a young bull from the herd as a purification offering and a ram as an entirely burned offering, both flawless animals, and bring them before the LORD.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-su ti nyɔtaɣirigu, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-su ti naa.
en: The king, our protector, belongs to the Lord , who is the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Zɔri, wula ka a lee niŋ hal ti kpe kpe na ni ka bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ binyɛrigu? Ka o kɔŋ garigibu.
en: The king asked, Friend, why didn't you wear proper clothes for the wedding? But the guest had no excuse.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm bɛn daa be duu maa daa ti zahim zahima dahin shɛli yuŋ. Sokam zahindi daa bela di ko, ka mali di gbinni.
en: One night there in prison the wine steward and the chief baker each had a dream, and the dreams had different meanings.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ŋmanila Ziɔn Zoli din ku tooi dam, ka kul ni beni sahakam la.
en: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ din niŋ o maa, ka dabiɛm kpe o pam ka o ni dii sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o din niŋ o maa zaa.
en: The woman knew that she was healed, so she came and bowed at Jesus feet. She was shaking with fear. She told Jesus the whole story.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa mali shili n-yiɣisi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After this, we got ready and left for Jerusalem.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Di chaŋ wula ka yi booni ma yi Duuma, yi Duuma, ka lee bi tumdi tuun shɛŋa n ni wuhi ya ni yi tum?.
en: Why do you call me, Lord, Lord, but you dont do what I say?.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zali sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zaligu ka zuɣusaa dunoya daa yooi;.
en: But then God opened the clouds above, and manna rained down on them for food. It was as if doors in the sky opened, and grain poured down from a storehouse in the sky.

dag: Hal bɛ kalinli ni daa bi galisi, ka bɛ lan nyɛ saamba nimaani.
en: When they were few in number— insignificant, just immigrants.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ o tuma zuɣulaannim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Zadok bia Azaria n-daa nyɛ maligumaana.
en: and these were his high officials: The priest: Azariah son of Zadok.

dag: Kuɣili tibisa, ka bihigu tibisa, amaa jɛrigu ni tahiri suhuyiɣisili shɛl na tibisi gari di zaa.
en: The weight of stone and sand is nothing compared to the trouble that stupidity can cause.

dag: Amaa o ni zaŋ kokpɛɣu naag o dimnim zaa, ka kar o dimnim maa kpɛhi zibisim ni.
en: Like a great rushing flood he completely destroys his enemies; he sends to their death those who oppose him.

dag: A na mi n-chɛ ka biɛkaali neesim neei gili dunia zaa, n-kari ninvuɣ biɛri zaa di ni?.
en: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn tumdi naa tuma m-pah o ni daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb ʒil o ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti du zuɣusaa m-pobilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirig o kpiŋkpama to Bɔziranima. Dindali maa Ɛdom tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi suhu ni be shɛm la.
en: Just as an eagle flies high to see the animal it will attack, so the Lord will spread his wings over Bozrah. And Edoms soldiers will be filled with fear like a woman giving birth.

dag: A soli daa timla teeku ni gari, ka a sɔbil mi tim ko titaŋa ni gari, amaa ka so daa bi nya ka a napom bɔba doya.
en: You walked through the waves; you crossed the deep sea, but your footprints could not be seen.

dag: O ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ noombil maa ʒim mini kom maa ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa ni sida dari ni taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee maa n-yihi yili maa daɣiri ni m-bala.
en: In this way he will use these things to make the house clean.

dag: ka di yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag Anabi Musa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o bi lan saɣi ni o lihi li.
en: I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.

dag: Di saha ka yi mini kum zɔri la saɣim, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee alikauli la yiɣisi. Di nyaaŋa alɔbo yi ti lu, di ni din ya.
en: Your agreement with death will be erased. Your contract with Sheol will not help you. Someone will come and punish you. He will make you like the dirt he walks on.

dag: Ka Amazia daa bɔhi Naawuni nira maa, Ka n ni pun zaŋ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi shɛli da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiriba maa na, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ chaŋ di polo? Ka Naawuni nira maa garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni tooi ti a anzinfa din gari li.
en: Amaziah replied, What am I supposed to do about all the silver I paid those troops? The Lord will give you back even more than you paid, the prophet answered.

dag: M bela n dimnim bɛn be kaman gbuɣima bɛn ŋubiri ninsalinim la sunsuuni. Bɛ nyina ŋmanila kpana mini piɛma; ka bɛ zilima mi ŋmani takɔbiri din diri pam.
en: My life is in danger. My enemies are all around me. They are like man-eating lions, with teeth like spears or arrows and tongues like sharp swords.

dag: ni o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-tiligi bɛn be fukumsi zaligu maa sulinsi ni, ka zaŋ ti leei ŋun Naawuni bihi.
en: God did this so that he could buy the freedom of those who were under the law. Gods purpose was to make us his children.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana maa zaŋ sida dari mini taaŋkɔro wulli ni mi ʒee bahi buɣim din diri nahu maa ni.
en: The priest will take cedarwood, hyssop, and crimson cloth and throw them into the fire where the cow is burning.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ so daa kpuɣ nɛkaŋa n-daai li bah o zuɣu ni na, ka di ŋma o zuɣuŋmaŋ.
en: when a woman on the roof dropped a large rock on his head and cracked his skull.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: After seven days, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n suhir a, taɣimi tim so.
en: But Moses said, My Lord, I beg you to send someone else, not me.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu, miriya ka yi doli zaligusaɣindiba ŋɔ biriginsim soli maa ka kɔŋ yimaŋmaŋ ʒiɛyimtali zaashee la ni zanibu.
en: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.

dag: Ka so yi ti yi a yiŋ maa ni na m-be soli zuɣu chana, dilan kum taali ni ti ŋmaligi ʒila omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti nuu kani. Amaa so yi ti ku bɛn be a sani a yiŋ maa puuni, dilan kum taali ni ti ʒila ti zuɣu.
