en: Those who go outside the doors of your house into the street will have only themselves to blame for their own deaths. We wont be responsible. If anyone lays a hand on those who are with you in the house, we will take the blame for their death.

dag: Miriya ka yi di binshɛŋa din chihiri dibu.
en: Dont eat anything that the Lord hates.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ti doli n ni kariti zuliya shɛb ka chɛri ya ŋɔ kaya, dama bɛ daa tumdila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, dinzuɣu ka n zaɣisi ba.
en: Do not adopt the customs of the people who live there; I am driving out those pagans so that you can enter the land. They have disgusted me with all their evil practices.

dag: Ŋuna ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti daalahichi zuɣu ni o fa ti ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni bahi kaman ti Ba Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: In order to set us free from this present evil age, Christ gave himself for our sins, in obedience to the will of our God and Father.

dag: Dama nir yi bari zana noombil ninni, yoli ka o bari li maa.
en: You cannot trap birds with a net if they see you spreading it out.

dag: Amaa ka yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Pumpɔŋɔ yinim Izraɛlnima wummiya, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yinima ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: You people of Israel accuse me of being unfair! But listen—I'm not unfair; you are!.

dag: N ni na be yi sani ŋɔ ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: I have spoken these things to you while I am with you.

dag: Naawuni, ti paɣir a, ti paɣir a; dama a miri ti. Sokam yɛr a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: We give thanks to you, God. Yes, we give thanks! Your name is near. Your marvelous deeds are declared.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, kum n-nyɛ a sanyoo, ka a mi ku tooi yi di ni. Ninvuɣ kubo taali ʒi a zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ kubo maa ni dol a.
en: So then—as surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God—death is your fate, and you cannot escape it. You are guilty of murder, and murder will follow you.

dag: Amazia daa lan ku Ɛdom tɔbbihi tuhi pia Yalim Vinvamli ni, ka tuhi fa Sɛla m-boli di yuli Joktiɛl, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: While Amaziah was king, he killed , Edomite soldiers in Salt Valley. He captured the town of Sela and renamed it Joktheel, which is still its name.

dag: Naawuni n-daa mali bimparilana maa, ka sabbu maa nyɛ Naawuni sabbu, ka o daa chirigi li pa bimparilana maa zuɣu.
en: God himself had made the tablets and had engraved the commandments on them.

dag: maa ŋunkam nyu ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada; dama ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa ni leei nyɛvili din ka bahigu kɔbilisirim o pul ni.
en: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔh o, Naawuni maligumaaniba zuɣulana ka a tu lala maa.
en: The men close to Paul said to him, You are insulting God's High Priest.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o noli naai tinduyanima ni o yɔhim ba, ka o kpiɔŋ ni ti zoori pahira, hal o ni kul nyɛla ŋun yɛn di n-su la niriba biɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: Many nations will make agreements with that cruel and hated ruler, but he will lie and trick them. He will gain much power, but only a few people will support him.

dag: Ka tuumba maa mini cheechi kpamba maa daa laɣim ni bɛ to yɛlli maa jina.
en: The apostles and the elders met together to consider this question.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ tuumba ayi maa sɔɣi ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, do shɛb di kpe n yili ŋɔ na, amaa m bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: Some men did come to my house, she answered, but I don't know where they were from. They left at sundown before the city gate was closed. I didn't find out where they were going, but if you start after them quickly, you can catch them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa puuni binshɛŋa din daa kpalim ka tɔbbihi maa zaŋ li kalinli daa nyɛla piɛri tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni tuhi pisopɔinnaanu.
en: The soldiers had taken , sheep.

dag: n-chaŋ Taai birini la mini Hivinim ni Keenannim tinsi zaa ni. Ka bɛ daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ Nɛgɛb din be Juda tiŋgban ni Bɛrishiiba polo la.
en: They went to the fort of Tyre. They went to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites. Then they went south to Beersheba in the southern part of Judah.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba kulis anahi zuɣu. Yi ni ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni.
en: Set in it four rows of gemstone settings. The first row will be a row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald stones.

dag: Bee a ʒiɛmla Naawuni nirilim din galisi min o nambɔzɔbo ni o suɣilɔdibo la? A bi mi ni din chɛ ka Naawuni niŋd a nirilim maa nyɛla o bɔrimi ni a niŋ tuuba?.
en: God has been kind to you. He has been very patient, waiting for you to change. But you think nothing of his kindness. Maybe you dont understand that God is kind to you so that you will decide to change your lives.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya. Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner said to Joab, Let's have some of the young men from each side fight an armed contest. All right, Joab answered.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu maa mini Yisa Masia shɛhira ni omaŋmaŋ nini ni daa nya shɛlikam zaa shɛhiralana.
en: and John has told all that he has seen. This is his report concerning the message from God and the truth revealed by Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa, ka chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm. Ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa kana ti tuh o soli ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana.
en: Samuel did what the Lord told him to do and went to Bethlehem, where the city leaders came trembling to meet him and asked, Is this a peaceful visit, seer.

dag: Yɛndana suhu bɔrila kumsi ni be yil shɛli, amaa jɛra suhuri bɔrila suhupiɛlli ni be yil shɛli.
en: A wise person thinks about death, but a fool thinks only about having a good time.

dag: Ka o tumtumdib kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, Tinzun paɣisar so ŋun daa doli Naomi yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bala.
en: The man answered, She is the foreigner who came back from Moab with Naomi.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ yɛda; dama Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi Aizaia, Ka bɔ n-lee yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka n kpaŋ maa mini n ni yɛn chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu daba ata dali maa shihirili? Ka Aizaia garigi yɛli.
en: Hezekiah asked Isaiah, What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I will go up to the Temple of the Lord on the third day.

dag: ni viɣu ni kulijuɣu ni kpiliŋkpi.
en: owls, cormorants, great owls.

dag: Yisa mabihi maa ni daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni nyaaŋa ka o gba daa ti yiɣisi chaŋ chuɣu maa ni ashilɔni.
en: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa guli naa maa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya li, amaa ka a nol lee ku to li.
en: Then the officer who was close to the king answered the man of God. The officer said, Even if the Lord made windows in heaven, this could not happen. Elisha said, You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of that food.

dag: O daa ku Ijipti ninsalinim bikpamba zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba.
en: In Egypt he killed all the first-born of people and animals alike.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi yɛtɔɣa nyɔni Yawɛ nyee. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee chɛ ka o nyee nyɔni? Yi ni yɛra, Ŋunkam tum zaɣ biɛɣu, di nyɛla din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ o ni bɔri shɛl la. Bee yi ni bɔhira, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan maa lee be ya la.
en: You have tired the Lord out with your talk. But you ask, How have we tired him? By saying, The Lord Almighty thinks all evildoers are good; in fact he likes them. Or by asking, Where is the God who is supposed to be just.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi fɔŋ maa ni chani Yisa sani.
en: So the people left the town and went to see Jesus.

dag: Zɛbulɔn ni ti ʒini n-tabila teeku noli. O kulinoli ni ti nyɛla ŋariŋ kara zaashee. O tintariga ti yɛn zaŋmi hal ni Sidɔn.
en: Zebulun will live near the sea. His seacoast will be a safe place for ships. His land will continue as far as the city of Sidon.

dag: M pun tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam, n ku lan garigi; n ku lan yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: I did speak once or twice, but never again.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a labi tiŋgban ni; palɔni ka n ti yɛn zaŋ a bahi, ka chɛ ka noonsi zaa kana ti lu a zuɣu, ka dunia zaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dari tɔh a ŋubi.
en: I will throw you out on the ground and bring all the birds and animals of the world to feed on you.

dag: Ka pumahigu mini niŋgbun duɣili daa ti gbaag o ba, ka Pool daa kpe nti kaag o ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti o ka o kpaŋ zaa.
en: Publius' father was in bed, sick with fever and dysentery. Paul went into his room, prayed, placed his hands on him, and healed him.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Naa Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn maa, ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa.
en: During the meeting, David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now the king of Israel.

dag: Yisifu ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Ijipti daa nyɛla bidibis ayi. Yaakubu yiŋnim zaa bɛn daa kuli Ijipti kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin.
en: Two sons were born to Joseph in Egypt, bringing to seventy the total number of Jacob's family who went there.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o niriba, Gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma! Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba zaɣ nɛma n-ku ba Bɛtɛkɛd bɔɣili gbini. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinahinaayi. Ka bɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ ni zaɣ yino gba.
en: Jehu then commanded, Take them alive! His soldiers took them alive, then slaughtered them at the well of Beth-eked. There were forty-two of them, but not one was left.

dag: Yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zaa zuɣu, n ni niŋ ya n ni na ʒi n-niŋ ya shɛm, ka mi ku lan niŋ di kpee yaha.
en: I will do things to you that I have never done before. And I will never do those terrible things again, because you did so many terrible things.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Yaakubu je Liya maa, ka o ti Liya nama, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl nyɛ paɣiŋoo.
en: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, he opened her womb; but Rachel was unable to have children.

dag: Nama ŋɔ tariga paabu yi ti miri, ka bɛ leei ninvuɣ biɛri n-simdi tibidarigibo, na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ hal kpiɔŋlana ni baŋda ni ninvuɣ yɔhinda.
en: When the end is near for those kingdoms, there will be a very bold and cruel king who will be very tricky. This will happen when many people have turned against God.

dag: Naawuni ni tim so na maa tɔɣisirila Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, dama Naawuni zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti o ka di ka buɣisibu.
en: God sent him, and he tells people what God says. God gives him the Spirit fully.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa gbaag o chaŋ ka o leei dabili, ka ŋme n-chɛrisi o biliɛri sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu. Bɛ daa to tɛte o ninvuɣ zuɣuri zuɣu, ka zaŋ bandi ba o kpambaliba.
en: Yet even she was destined for exile; she went into captivity. Indeed, her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her officials; all of her powerful citizens were bound in chains.

dag: Di saha ka Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nyaaŋa ka nyɛ niriba maa zaa guliba la daa yiɣisi paya. Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: Finally, those under the banner of the division led by the tribe of Dan, serving as the rear guard of all the divisions, would start out, company by company, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.

dag: Ka daa chɛ ka Timoti mini Ɛrastus bɛn daa nyɛ o sɔŋdib la chaŋ Masidɔnia, amaa ka ŋun Pool maŋmaŋ daa kpalim Ɛsha n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: Timothy and Erastus were two of his helpers. Paul sent them ahead to Macedonia. But he stayed in Asia for a while.

dag: ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said.

dag: Alibarika pipi shɛli ti ni niŋd alibarika niŋdi di ni la, di pala Masia ʒim ka ti laɣindi nyura? Ka bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti ni ŋmahiri la, di pala Masia niŋgbuŋ ka ti laɣindi ŋubiri maa?.
en: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?.

dag: Yawɛ, ti garigim a muɣisigu nyabu dali! Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ni gul a.
en: May the Lord answer you when you are in trouble! May the God of Jacob protect you!.

dag: ni o ti darigi bɛn bi mi Naawuni mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ti Duuma Yisa lahibal suŋ wumbu la tibili.
en: He will come with burning fire to punish those who dont know God—those who refuse to accept the Good News about our Lord Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa deei paɣ maa ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na maa ka yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋ ni suhudoo, nyama, n wum a yɛligu maa, ka ni niŋ a ni fabili niŋ ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then David accepted everything she had brought for him. Return home in peace, he told her. Be assured that Ive heard your request and have agreed to it.

dag: So ku tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa o nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi. Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: No one gets into the house of a strong person and steals anything without first tying up the strong person. Only then can the house be burglarized.

dag: Ka Gibianim daa ti kana ti liri ma yuŋ n-teei gili n yilikpɛrili. Bɛ daa lo ma la kubu; ka daa gbaai m mam maa chaŋ ti goli ku o.
en: The men of Gibeah came to get me and surrounded the house at night. They intended to kill me; instead they raped my concubine, and she died.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so ti ni buɣisi waawaayili n-nya ka o nyɛla ŋun suhu kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla pam puuni la n-dolisiri ba na. Ka pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun suhu na kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu gari lala, o ni niŋ ya naani pam la zuɣu.
en: We are sending our brother with them. We have tested his commitment in many ways and many times. Now hes even more committed, because he has so much confidence in you.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Samaria, o daa kula Ɛhab daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim Samaria zaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Ilaija shɛm la.
en: When Jehu arrived in Samaria, he killed all those belonging to Ahab who were left in Samaria until they were completely wiped out, in agreement with the LORDs word that was spoken to Elijah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔh o, M mabia, tin bɔnim ka a lee zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tinsi maa yuli Keebal tiŋgbɔŋ hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Hiram remarked, My brother, are these towns youve given me good for anything? The cities are thus called the land of Cabul to this very day.

dag: Dama chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama n-lim Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa, dinzuɣu chɛrubinim maa n-daa nyɛ bimpindigu din pili Adaka maa mini di dapuhi la.
en: The wings of the Cherub angels spread out over the Holy Box, and they covered the Holy Box and its carrying poles.

dag: kul gbaai yihila bin yin shɛli n ni daa zani bɛ sani kuhi yɛl la. N daa yɛlimi, Kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla zuɣu ka yi kariti ma saria zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: The only charge they can bring against me is what I shouted out in court, when I said, I am on trial today because I believe that the dead will be raised to life.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa. N ni yili yila paɣ a wuna sani.
en: I give thanks to you with all my heart, LORD. I sing your praise before all other gods.

dag: Pa wuuni m-bɔŋɔ? N yɛn suhila Yawɛ ka o chɛ ka saa kum ka mi, ka yi nya ka baŋ ni yi tum taali din galisi Yawɛ sani, yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔr naa maa zuɣu.
en: It's the dry season, isn't it? But I will pray, and the Lord will send thunder and rain. When this happens, you will realize that you committed a great sin against the Lord when you asked him for a king.

dag: N lɔri nol la buyi dakulo kam, ka yihiri n ni nya shɛlikam zaka.
en: I fast two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all my income.

dag: Dama ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ti mini ti yaannima Ijipti luɣ shɛli din nyɛ dabitim ni la na, ka daa tum alahiziba tuun kara ti ninni, ka tiligi ti ti ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa ni mini ti ni daa kpe zuliya shɛb ni garina nuu ni.
en: We know that it was the Lord God who brought our people out of Egypt. We were slaves in that land, but he did great things for us there. He brought us out of that land and protected us while we traveled through other lands.

dag: Gala tumbu ŋmanila diɛma jɛrigu sani, amaa yɛm biɛhigu niŋdila tɛhi zilimalan nyaɣisim.
en: It is foolish to enjoy doing wrong. Intelligent people take pleasure in wisdom.

dag: N ni ŋme solɔɣu du n zoya zaa, ka mali n soya ka di viɛla.
en: I will make a highway across the mountains and prepare a road for my people to travel.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes to live in. The birds have nests. But the Son of Man has no place to rest.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ayi yuli booni Gihɔn. Dina n-nyɛ din zɔri gindi Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The second river is the Gihon; it flows around the country of Cush.

dag: Ka sapashin maa yɛl o, N Duuma, m pɔri ni a ka n yiŋ na; amaa kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛn yɛli, ka n yiŋbia maa kpaŋ.
en: Oh no, sir, answered the officer. I do not deserve to have you come into my house. Just give the order, and my servant will get well.

dag: Lala ka Ɛdomnim daa niŋ n-zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan su ba, o ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Duuma Naawuni jɛmbu la zuɣu.
en: Edom has been independent of Judah ever since. During this same period the city of Libnah also revolted, because Jehoram had abandoned the Lord , the God of his ancestors.

dag: Bɛ biɛhi daa kul tuhimi, ka bɛ naba puuni be kaman naɣibila napɔŋ puuni la, ka nyaɣisira kaman daanya shɛli bɛ ni nyahi ka di nyaɣisir la.
en: Their legs were straight, and they had hoofs like those of a bull. They shone like polished bronze.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋ chaŋ yuntisuɣu saha, n ni kpe Ijipti tiŋ puuni.
en: Moses said, This is what the LORD says: At midnight Ill go throughout Egypt.

dag: Dama yi je saɣisigu; ka zaŋ n yɛligu labisi yi kpali nyaaŋa.
en: You refuse to let me correct you; you reject my commands.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: The anointed priest must get some of the bulls blood and take it into the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ti daa wumya ka o yɛli ni o ni wurim bɛ ni daa zaŋ nuhi me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka me din pa nuhi mɛbu zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: We heard him saying, I will destroy this temple, constructed by humans, and within three days I will build another, one not made by humans.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu mini m balima ŋɔ; a yuli zuɣu ŋmaligim a nini lihi nya a jɛmbu duu la ni wurim doya shɛm.
en: Now, our God, hear your servants prayer. Listen to my prayer for mercy. For your own sake, do good things for your holy place.

dag: Amaa Yisa ni daa nya lala maa ka di ku o suli, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: When Jesus noticed this, he was angry and said to his disciples, Let the children come to me, and do not stop them, because the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o yo pia kam puuni yim maa zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi.
en: If you wish to buy any of it back, you must pay the standard price plus an additional percent.

dag: Ka o daa boli bipuɣin kpɛm sani yuli Jɛmaima, ka boli ŋun paya yuli Kɛzia, ka boli ŋun pah ata maa mi yuli Kɛrɛnhapuk.
en: He called the oldest daughter Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the youngest Keren Happuch.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga kɔhi ka o leei dabili, di bi simdi ka o ti chaŋ kaman dɔbba ni chani shɛm.
en: A man might decide to sell his daughter as a slave. If this happens, the rules for making her free are not the same as the rules for making the men slaves free.

dag: A mali nuu ka di be kaman Naawuni nuu? A mali kukoli din ŋmani saa tahibu kaman o kukol la?.
en: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?.

dag: Ka bɛ fo, dama bɛ daa ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: They had been arguing about which one of them was the greatest, and so they did not answer.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni, ka di bi simdi ni n tam o nirilim yɛla.
en: Praise the Lord , my soul, and do not forget how kind he is.

dag: Amaa ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni ti ma nasara shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka n lan kpalim be kpe, timiya ma soli ka n labi n dan sani.
en: But he said to them, Dont delay me. The LORD has made my trip successful. See me off so that I can go to my master.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tum din nyɛ Naawuni tuma.
en: So they asked him, What can we do in order to do what God wants us to do.

dag: Hal kawana ni lan kani, ka wain tihi mini fiig tihi ni yɔɣa ni olivi tihi na bi wal la zaa yoli, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: Your seed for planting is still in the barn. And look at the vines, the fig trees, and the pomegranate and olive trees. They have not yet produced any fruit. But beginning today, I will bless you.

dag: N kul ku nyari n niriba maa taali bee n yiɣisiri n suhu bahiri bɛ zuɣu sahakam, dama di yi nyɛ lala n ni ti bɛn ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛvili maa ni kpi.
en: I gave my people life, and I will not continue to accuse them or be angry with them forever.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim Jɛhudi ni o ti zaŋ gbaŋ maa na. Ka o daa zaŋ li Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa duu maa ni na nti karim li wuhi naa mini kpambaliba bɛn zaa daa ʒe naa sani maa.
en: The king sent Jehudi to take the scroll, and he retrieved it from the room of Elishama the scribe. Then Jehudi read it to the king and all his royal officials who were standing next to the king.

dag: Dama o kul chɛrila o gala sɔŋ tiŋa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani biisim kpɛr li.
en: The ostrich leaves her eggs on the ground for the heat in the soil to warm them.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman alahichi ni nyaŋ sokam kum puuni shɛm, lala ka Naawuni daalibarika gba nyaŋ di nasara wuntia puuni, ka tahi nyɛvili din ka bahigu na ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo.
en: Sin once used death to rule us. But God gave us more of his grace so that grace could rule by making us right with him. And this brings us eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

dag: Gunimiya, ka di nyɛ m mini ya daalikauli maa shihirili.
en: You will cut the skin to show that you follow the agreement between me and you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ o ti paai Lɛhi, ka Filistianim kul zɔri kani o sanna, ka tahira. Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na pam, ka mi shɛŋa din daa lo o maa zaa dii chihichihi; ka di be kaman buɣim ni di gali shɛm la.
en: When he got to Lehi, the Philistines came running toward him, shouting at him. Suddenly the power of the Lord made him strong, and he broke the ropes around his arms and hands as if they were burnt thread.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ti Kɔhat bihi la shɛli, dama bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din be kasi la buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: But to the Kohathites he gave nothing because their duty concerned the holy things that had to be carried on the shoulders.

dag: Bɛ malila ka shɛŋa din bi simdi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ Romnim ŋɔ doli n-wuhiri niriba.
en: They are telling people to do things that are not right for us as Romans to do.

dag: n ni ti lan labisi Ijipti zali di zaashee, ka zaŋ ba labisi Patrɔs din nyɛ bɛ virili shee la. Ka bɛ nam ti ku mali yaa nimaani.
en: and I will let them live in southern Egypt, their original home. There they will be a weak kingdom.

dag: Dama n yidana ka yiŋa. O go n-chaŋla katiŋa.
en: For my husband isnt home; hes gone far away.

dag: Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa kunila luɣ yini, taŋkpaɣu ni ka bɛ yina, ka bɛ zaa lan yɛn labila taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: They are both going to the same place—the dust. They both came from it; they will both go back to it.

dag: Balaam ni daa nya ka Yawɛ lo ni o niŋla alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni maa zuɣu, o daa bi lan lihi o ni daa yi lihiri binshɛŋa ni baŋdi din yɛn niŋ kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la, amaa ka zaŋ o zuɣu ʒila mɔɣu polo.
en: Balaam was sure that the Lord would tell him to bless Israel again. So he did not use any magic to find out what the Lord wanted him to do, as he had the first two times. Instead, he looked out toward the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni darigi a tibili ka di dol a suhuyiɣisili min a nyuli zabbu ni a ni je ba shɛm la soli. N yi kar a saria, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni nyɛ so.
en: So then, as surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God, I will pay you back for your anger, your jealousy, and your hate toward my people. They will know that I am punishing you for what you did to them.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka bɛ siɣisi bɛmaŋ maa ka o daa yɛli Shɛmaya, Bɛ ni saɣi ni bɛ tum taali maa, n ku lan ku ba, ka ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli, amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya faako n-yi Shishak nuu ni.
en: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N lan yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, Daadam Bia gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa Naawuni malaikanim sani;.
en: I assure you that those who declare publicly that they belong to me, the Son of Man will do the same for them before the angels of God.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanania daa paai naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kabigi li.
en: Then Hananiah took the yoke off my neck, broke it in pieces.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti dolila yɛlimaŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: This, then, is how we will know that we belong to the truth; this is how we will be confident in God's presence.

dag: Ka o daa yuuni salo maa gindi ni o nya ŋun niŋ lala maa.
en: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.

dag: Nyamiya, di zuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: Now I have warned you about this before it happens.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka salo maa zaa daa pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi bɛn mali suhukpeeni n-tim ba ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya takɔbiri chaŋ ti ku Jabɛshigiliadnima, hal kumiya paɣiba mini bihi gba.
en: The community dispatched twelve thousand warriors there with these orders: Go kill all the people in Jabesh-gilead, including women and children.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya alikauli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi di nasara yi tuuni kam ni.
en: So then keep the words of this covenant and do them so you can succeed in all you do.

dag: Ka bɛ daa karim li hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din wuhi Bigitana mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣilis ayi bɛn guli naa zɔntua dunol la ni daa lo nia ni bɛ sɔɣ ku Naa Ahasivɛrɔs, ka Mɔdɛkai daa wum li ka zaŋ yɛli naa la.
en: The part they read included the account of how Mordecai had uncovered a plot to assassinate the king—the plot made by Bigthana and Teresh, the two palace eunuchs who had guarded the king's rooms.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Masia mini Sintani sunsuuni? Bee yɛdaniŋdiba mini bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba yɛla kpɛri tab ni?.
en: How can Christ and the Devil agree? What does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?.

dag: Ti bi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm tariga ti ni daa ka yi sanna la puuni; dama tinima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui zaŋ Masia lahibal suŋ na ti tin ya.
en: We would be boasting too much only if we had not already come to you. But we have come to you with the Good News about Christ.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka doo maa bo piɛlaa ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti mali taali sanyoo sara.
en: The man must bring as his compensation to the LORD at the meeting tents entrance a ram for a compensation offering.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ɛdomnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri n-kari doli bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim ka nambɔɣu zɔbu kani. Bɛ sujee maa kɔŋla tim, ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili mi kɔŋ tariga zanibu.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka di pala ti yɛn zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee m-maani sara shɛli di zuɣu.
en: As a result we said, Lets protect ourselves by building an altar. It isnt to be for an entirely burned offering or for sacrifice.

dag: Bɛn daa diri bindir viɛla la nti kpiri kum solɔri zuɣu ŋɔ. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi wumsi shɛb la nti do tampuya zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: Those who ate rich food are now dying in the streets. Those who grew up wearing nice red clothes now pick through garbage piles.

dag: Ŋun daa nya li ni o nini n-yɛl li ni yi niŋ yɛda. O yɛligu maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka o mi ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The one who saw this happen has spoken of it, so that you also may believe. What he said is true, and he knows that he speaks the truth.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata naabu saha, ka di daa ti niŋ daliri ka Shimɛi daba niriba ayi yi o sani n-zo n-chaŋ Maaka bia Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat naa la sani. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Shimɛi, Nyama, a daba la be Gaat.
en: After three years, two of Shimeis servants fled to the king of Gath, Achish, Maacahs son. Shimei was informed, Your servants are now in Gath.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba zuɣulana daa yi zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la ti maani sara alahichi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maa zaɣ muna yiri tin tariga ti nyɔri buɣim.
en: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place and offers that blood for sins. But the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.

dag: Gidiɔn kum nyaaŋa, di daa bi yuui ka Izraɛlnim lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnima. Bɛ daa zaŋla alikauli lɔbu Baal n-leei bɛ wuni.
en: Right after Gideon died, the Israelites once again acted unfaithfully by worshipping the Baals, setting up Baal-berith as their god.

dag: Ka yi nya ka wum ka di pala Ɛfɛsus ŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ka Pool ŋɔ kul yɛri niriba ni salinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali buɣ shɛŋa pala shɛli; lala ka o niŋdi lɛbigiri niriba pam suhuri.
en: But you have surely seen and heard how this man Paul is upsetting a lot of people, not only in Ephesus, but almost everywhere in Asia. He claims that the gods we humans make are not really gods at all.

dag: ka mol li bɛ fɔndi zaa ni mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛli, Chamiya zoya zuɣu ti ŋma olivi tiwula mini mɔɣu ni olivi tiwula ni mitil tiwula ni abie tihi vari ni ti shɛŋa din mali vari na nti ti suɣa kaman di ni sabi shɛm.
en: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya la mi, kalim ba kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Lord said: Moses, find out how many men between and are in the two Levite clans of Merari, but count only those who are able to work at the sacred tent.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa wum lala maa ka o zo n-chaŋ Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Nimaani ka o daa be hal nti dɔɣi bidibis ayi.
en: When Moses heard him say this, he left Egypt. He went to live in the land of Midian, where he was a stranger. During the time he lived there, he had two sons.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛli, M mabihi, m bi mi ni o nyɛla maligumaaniba zuɣulana; dama di sabiya, Miri ka a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalim a zuliya zuɣulana. .
en: Paul replied, Brothers, I wasnt aware that he was the high priest. It is written, You will not speak evil about a ruler of your people .

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n yi tam a yɛla, n nudirigu din tammi di ni mi shɛli niŋbu.
en: Jerusalem! If I forget you, let my strong hand wither!.

dag: Sania din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli mini binyara zahimbu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ dini. Bintibisa zaa din be kpalaŋ puuni nyɛla o tuma.
en: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam. Di simdi ni ti lur o sizuura gari wuna zaa.
en: because the LORD is great and so worthy of praise. He is awesome beyond all other gods.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lan zo Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu, ka lan pii ba n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha; ka chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi Yaakubu zuliya maa zuɣu n-doli ba labi.
en: The LORD will have compassion on Jacob, will again choose Israel, and will give them rest in their own land. Immigrants will join them, and attach themselves to the house of Jacob.

dag: Ka bia maa ma maa daa yɛli Ilaisha, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyin ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi dol o.
en: But the childs mother said, I promise, as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave without you! So Elisha got up and followed her.

dag: Sulemaana ʒini nam ʒiishee.
en: Solomon is now king.

dag: Di saɣi ka so ʒiɛm a a bipalitali zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa min a ni niŋdi shɛm ni a yurilim ni a yɛda niŋbu ni a biɛr kasi wuhi ni a biɛhigu nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba ni ni dol shɛli naba.
en: You are young, but dont let anyone treat you as if you are not important. Be an example to show the believers how they should live. Show them by what you say, by the way you live, by your love, by your faith, and by your pure life.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka suhi Yawɛ yɛli.
en: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall that faced the Temple and began praying to the Lord .

dag: Di kul simdi ni ti chaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi nti mali sara maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa kaman o ni zali ti shɛm maa.
en: Let us go three days into the desert and offer sacrifices to the Lord our God. This is what he told us to do.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli yi sariakaritiba maa, Wummiya yi niriba yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka karimiya yɛtɔɣa din be nir min o kpee sunsuuni zaŋ tabili saamba bɛn be yi sani saria ka di tuhi.
en: At that same time, I commanded your judges: Listen to your fellow tribe members and judge fairly, whether the dispute is between one fellow tribe member or between a tribe member and an immigrant.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n taali niŋ kpalaŋ ni lo li, ka a ti zaŋ bini limsi n tuumbiɛri.
en: My rebellion is sealed in a bag; you would cover my sin.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka kum dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: My heart pounds in my chest because deaths terrors have reached me.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la min o maligumaanitab la mi su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee din daa be Gibiɔn Jɛmbu shee la fukumsi.
en: David also placed the priest Zadok and his other priestly relatives at the LORDs dwelling at the shrine in Gibeon.

dag: Di pala o daa yurila nandaamba zuɣu ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ tayiɣ la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibila, ka zuri piiri liɣiri maa.
en: He said this not because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief. He carried the money bag and would take what was in it.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m biri ka so ti di li; ka shɛb ti gbi m puu bindira.
en: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ŋɔ, yi diri jɛra suɣilo ni suhupiɛlli!.
en: You yourselves are so wise, and so you gladly tolerate fools!.

dag: Dama pa malaikanim yɛla m-muɣis o, amaa ti yab Ibrahimma yaansi yɛla m-muɣis o.
en: Clearly, it is not angels that Jesus helps. He helps the people who are from Abraham.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa kul turi ba ka yɛra, Wara, wara, nyin ninvuɣ kur ŋɔ, nyin ninvuɣ yoli ŋɔ.
en: Shimei was yelling at David, Get out of here, you murderer! You good-for-nothing.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma, n jilima zoya kaman pɔhim n-ʒe li chaŋ la, ka n tɔŋsim zo kaman sagbani n-fuɣi gari la.
en: I am overcome with terror; my dignity is gone like a puff of wind, and my prosperity like a cloud.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ li zali sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila la lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai sara maligu bimbini maa pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: Put the grating under the ledge at the bottom of the altar. The grating will go halfway up into the altar from below.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka n ni ti nyu di zaɣ palli Naawuni nam ni.
en: I assure you that I wont drink wine again until that day when I drink it in a new way in Gods kingdom.

dag: amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa, din pala man tibu, amaa Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: But it is not for me to say who will sit at my right or my left. God has prepared those places for the ones he chooses.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zɛbida. O daa nyɛla Ruma nir ŋun yuli daa booni Pɛdaya la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoiakim was years old when he became king. He ruled eleven years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima alali mali Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: He made a cover for the chest out of pure gold, forty-five inches long and twenty-seven inches wide.

dag: Dari yi kani, buɣim ni kpi. Tikub yi kani, zabili ku beni.
en: Without wood a fire goes out; without gossips, conflict calms down.

dag: Jɛramiil ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli san la mini Buna ni Orɛn ni Ozɛm ni Ahija.
en: Jerahmeel was Hezrons first son. Jerahmeels sons were Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. Ram was Jerahmeels first son.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa ti miri kum, o daa bolila o bia Yisifu ti yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ, nyin zaŋm a nuu tim n gbalipini lɔŋni ka lo alikauli ni a ni tum ma ʒiɛyimtali tuma ni yɛlimaŋli. Di sɔɣi ma Ijipti ŋɔ.
en: When Jacob knew he did not have long to live, he called in Joseph and said, If you really love me, you must make a solemn promise not to bury me in Egypt.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni wuh a zuliya maa zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyamma yɛligi pam.
en: I myself will teach your people and give them prosperity and peace.

dag: Di tɛhiriya ni n ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla m Ba sani; ŋun ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla o sani beni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa yi ni zaŋ yi tahima zaa niŋ so ni la.
en: Do not think, however, that I am the one who will accuse you to my Father. Moses, in whom you have put your hope, is the very one who will accuse you.

dag: Yawɛ bemi kaman tɔbbia la, o ŋmanila tɔbutuhira ŋun suhu ye tuhibu zuɣu. O kuhirimi yɛri pampam, ka wuhiri ni o mali yaa gar o dimnima.
en: The Lord will go out like a strong soldier. Like a man going into battle, he will be full of excitement. He will shout with a loud cry, and he will defeat his enemies.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli, Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi a ni daa zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini yiko n-yih a ninvuɣ shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa zuɣu?.
en: But Moses pleaded with the Lord his God and said, Lord , why should you be so angry with your people, whom you rescued from Egypt with great might and power?.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi din daa nyɛ Naa Dauda dini, ka be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-ti sapashinnim maa.
en: He gave the officers the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and had been kept in the Temple.

dag: O daa jɛmdila Baal, ka dol o ba ni daa niŋ shɛlikam la soli n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He worshiped and served Baal, and like his father before him, he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa ti tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ka ti ku kpi; dama ti bo naa ti timaŋa n-lan tum alahichi pahi ti ni pun tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: All of them said to Samuel, Please pray for us, your servants, to the LORD your God so we dont die because we have added to our many sins the evil of asking for a king.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu. A yurilim maŋli min a nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, kpihimmi n daalahichi!.
en: God, be merciful to me because of your faithful love. Because of your great compassion, erase all the wrongs I have done.

dag: Ka o daa yi nimaani chaŋ Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu, ka daa ti yi nimaani lab Samaria.
en: From there Elisha went to Mount Carmel and then back to Samaria.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa ka o su Izraɛlnima; ka lala naa maa kpihim Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba birili zuŋɔ.
en: Soon, the Lord will put a new king over Israel who will destroy Jeroboams family.

dag: Ka binshɛb bɛn mali kpiŋkpama ka be nyam, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: You may eat any clean insect.

dag: n-zaŋ ba zali tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu suhi Naawuni ti ba.
en: The community presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

dag: amaa m bi bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ka di pala a yubu ni, dama m bɔri ni a tuun suŋ yila amaŋmaŋ yubu ni na, ka pa ni muɣisigu ni na.
en: But I did not want to do anything without asking you first. Then whatever you do for me will be what you want to do, not what I forced you to do.

dag: Ka a yi bahi a dabili ni o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka o chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: When you set them free, do not send them away empty-handed.

dag: O lan bom bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pali mini bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛlli shɛli maha ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam pa shɛli zuɣu ni chi sara, ni binnyura sara.
en: You shall also offer a basket of bread made without yeast: thick loaves made of flour mixed with olive oil and thin cakes brushed with olive oil, and in addition the required offerings of grain and wine.

dag: ni Jarimut ni Adulam ni Soko ni Azɛka.
en: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah.

dag: Ka Sool daa yi kul tim Dauda luɣ shɛlikam zaa, o ti nyarila nasara, lala zuɣu ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda leei tɔbbihi zuɣulana, ka lala daa tiɣi niriba zaa nini, ka lan tiɣi Sool tumtumdiba zaa nini.
en: David was successful in all the missions on which Saul sent him, and so Saul made him an officer in his army. This pleased all of Saul's officers and men.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana.
en: The names of his children in Jerusalem were as follows: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o yo pia kam puuni yim maa zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi.
en: So if you want to get back your tenth, you must add one-fifth to its price and then buy it back.

dag: Bundaannim di yo n-gari lala, faranim mi di yo ka di pooi laɣifu pirigili maa saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yo li yi nyɛviya zuɣu kaman sara maligu la Yawɛ sani.
en: The rich must not give more than / shekel, and the poor must not give less than / shekel. All people will make the same offering to the Lord . This will be a payment for your life.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin.
en: How much bread do you have? Jesus asked. Seven loaves, they answered.

dag: kul gbaai yihila bin yin shɛli n ni daa zani bɛ sani kuhi yɛl la. N daa yɛlimi, Kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla zuɣu ka yi kariti ma saria zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Perhaps it concerns this one statement that I blurted out when I was with them: I am on trial before you today because of the resurrection of the dead.

dag: O daa zali Yaakubu zuliya zaligu, ka zali zaligu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla o ni daa zali ti yaannim zaligu shɛli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: He established a law for Jacob and set up Instruction for Israel, ordering our ancestors to teach them to their children.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi zaɣisi ba bee m-bahi ba yoli. A nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔbo Naawuni!.
en: In your great mercy, however, you didnt make an end of them. Neither did you forsake them, because you are a merciful and compassionate God.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Yi mi ma, ka mi n ni shiri yi shɛl na? Pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n kana; ka ŋun tim ma na maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa yi bi mi o.
en: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Taai Naa Hiram, A ni daa ti m ba Dauda sida dari ka o me o yil la, niŋmi n gba lala.
en: Then Solomon sent this message to King Hiram of Tyre: Help me as you helped my father David. You sent him cedar logs so that he could build a palace for himself to live in.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lan yɛli, Yi ku gari. Ka Ɛdom naa maa daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam bɛn gbib bidibbina pam kana ti gu ba soli.
en: But the king insisted, You can't go through our land! Then Edom sent out its strongest troops.

dag: Zaŋna hal ni zuŋɔ, kum mini kɔnyuri n-kul mali ti, ka ti chani gbinfini, ka nyari buri, ka ka biɛhigu shee.
en: Even now we still dont have enough to eat or drink, and we dont have enough clothes. We often get beatings. We have no homes.

dag: Ka yinim teeku noli tinsi ŋɔ, yi ni ti leei biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee mini piɛguliba ni yɛn chɛri momaha luɣ shɛli, ka leei biŋkɔbbaligu gbɛbu shee.
en: Your land by the sea will become open fields with shepherd's huts and sheep pens.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa yubu nyɛla ni n di bahi o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ti ma la ni yino, amaa ni n ti neei ba kum ni zaadali.
en: This is the will of the one who sent me, that I wont lose anything he has given me, but I will raise it up at the last day.

dag: Nyin Naawuni zuɣu ka ti kul nyuri bara, ka ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: We have praised you all day long, and we will praise your name forever. Selah.

dag: N di yuya ni yi ni so kpari Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka yi ku lan mali buɣim pa n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ka di ka buchi. N nini bi lan tiɣi ya, ka n ku lan deei yi ni maani sara shɛli tiri ma. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord Almighty says, I wish one of you would close the Temple doors so as to prevent you from lighting useless fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you; I will not accept the offerings you bring me.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ata maa ni ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Izraɛl naa sani.
en: but in the third year King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to see King Ahab of Israel.

dag: Judanim ni ti niŋ ayɛi, niriba maa ni daa bi tooi sɔŋ ba la zuɣu. Bɛ ni chɛ ka Judanim maa di vi.
en: all will become shamed because of a people who cant assist them. They are no help; they are no profit; rather, shame and disgrace.

dag: N tiŋgbani yi di kuhi jɛndi ma, ka m puu ni pimpama di laɣim kum.
en: If my land has cried out against me, its rows wept together.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa kpahiri yi nuhi, ka mali yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yi suhuri paligi yi ni lo zaɣ biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo la zuɣu.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Because you clapped your hands and stamped your feet when you rejoiced with utter contempt for Israels fertile land.

dag: ka chɛ ka sochandiba ku yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni! Ti suhir alibarika tiri ya Yawɛ yuli zuɣu.
en: No one who passes by will say, May the Lord bless you! We bless you in the name of the Lord .

dag: Zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni.
en: Memorize his laws.

dag: Ka buɣim daa yi di mundili maa ni n-di di wula mini di wala. Ka di daa lan ka mundili din mali yaa din ni niŋ nam jaaŋgbee, ka bɛ zaŋ li su nam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla fabila yilli, ka di simdi ni bɛ yiini li fabila saha.
en: and fire has gone out from her branch and consumed her foliage and fruit, leaving her no strong branch or rulers scepter. This is a lamentation, and it will serve as a lamentation.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba, saha shɛli n yi ti kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: I will make this covenant with them when I take away their sins.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ni ti mali suhudoo. N ni ti ti o suhudoo o dimnim bɛn zaa gil o sani; dama o yuli nti yɛn booni Sulemaana. Ka n ni ti ti Izraɛlnim suhudoo, ka binshɛli ku lan dam ba o ʒiɛman ni.
en: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti du tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋ lu tiŋ sa;.
en: Then the Devil took him to Jerusalem and set him on the highest point of the Temple, and said to him, If you are God's Son, throw yourself down from here.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka so daa ti niŋdi amiliya Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la. Yisa ma daa be amiliya maa ni.
en: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.

dag: O yi di nyɛla dikili, ti naan me anzinfa pia tam o zuɣu; ka o yi di nyɛla dunoli, ti naan zaŋ sida dapaɣa yo o.
en: If she is a wall, we will build her a silver tower. But if she is a gate, we will protect her with panels of cedar.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bom tulaale shɛŋa din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛŋa stakiti mini onika ni galibanom ni tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni booni firanki tulaale la alali din nyom viɛla.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Get these sweet-smelling spices: resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense. Be sure that you have equal amounts of these spices.

dag: Teeku n-doya ŋɔ, di galisiya ka yɛlim pam, biŋgbamda bɛn ka kalinli m-be di ni. Bɛ nyɛla binneen kara ni zaɣ bihi.
en: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.

dag: Bɛ ba daa ti ba pina pam din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni anfaani binyara, ka daa zaŋ bɛ ni me goondahi gili Juda tin shɛŋa la ti ba pahi, amaa o daa zaŋ o nam maa tila Jɛhɔram, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bituuli.
en: Their father gave them large amounts of gold, silver, and other valuable possessions, and placed each one in charge of one of the fortified cities of Judah. But because Jehoram was the oldest, Jehoshaphat made him his successor.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din pahir anahi ni ka bɛ ni ti lab kpe na, dama Amɔrinim tuumbiɛri na bi galisi yaɣi.
en: After four generations your people will come to this land again and defeat the Amorites. That will happen in the future because the Amorites are not yet guilty enough to lose their land.

dag: N suhu ni yɛla yi ti galisi pam, a suhukpaŋsibo nyɛla din tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: I was very worried and upset, but you comforted me and made me happy!.

dag: Bɛ dimi ŋmɛlim, ka bɛ niŋgbuna be polipoli. Bɛ tuumbiɛri ka tariga. Bɛ bi doli zaligu soli n-kariti kpibisi saria tiri ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔŋ, bɛ mi bi zabiri nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: and prosperous, but you refuse to help the poor get the justice they deserve.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni yi kummi ka fabili, ka pini zuɣukpina, ka pili buri.
en: So the Lord GOD All-Powerful told the people to cry and mourn for their dead friends. He told them to shave their heads and wear mourning clothes.

dag: Jilima mini nam yiko n-gil o; kpiɔŋ mini viɛlim be o biɛhigu shee.
en: He lives in the presence of glory and honor. His Temple is a place of power and beauty.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka tummi din viɛla; ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka a be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Trust in the Lord and do good; live in the land and be safe.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Harada maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Makihilɔt.
en: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

dag: Mani n-daa guli ya mɔɣu ni tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of no rain.

dag: ka ti wum salo ni garita ka o bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee niŋdi maa.
en: When he heard the crowd passing by, he asked, What is this.

dag: ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛtɛl. M bɔri ni m mɛla bimbini nimaani zali Naawuni so ŋun daa deei n suhigu n nandahima nyabu dali, ka be n sani n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam la.
en: Then lets rise and go up to Bethel so that I can build an altar there to the God who answered me when I was in trouble and who has been with me wherever Ive gone.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ piri tiŋgbana maa tari Izraɛlnima ka bɛ su li.
en: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.

dag: Di chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la nyaŋ ma, ka di dari niŋ ma; a mi di chɛ ka bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri la chani n-kaɣiri bɛ nina lihiri ma.
en: Dont let my lying enemies keep on laughing at me. They have no reason to hate me. Surely they will be punished for their secret plans.

dag: Yawɛ, wula ka a yɛn niŋ ba? Chɛ ka bɛ paɣiba zaŋdi bahira, ka bɛ biha nyuui.
en: What shall I ask you to do to these people? Make their women barren! Make them unable to nurse their babies!.

dag: dama anabitali yɛtɔɣa daa bi yirila ninsal suhu yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi n-daa be ninsalinim ni n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa yir o sanna maa.
en: For no prophetic message ever came just from the human will, but people were under the control of the Holy Spirit as they spoke the message that came from God.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kanna maa zaa daa yi ʒirila bɛ pina din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni kpariti ni mɛɛr ni tulaale ni yuri ni buntaansi na ti tir o yuuni kam.
en: Year after year they came with tribute: objects of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mal o yiko, amaa leei di ku o.
en: So the Lord said to Satan, All right, he is in your power, but you are not to kill him.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din na kpalim ka yi yɛn deei maa n-nyɛ: Filistianim tiŋgbani zaa mini Gɛshurinim tiŋgbani.
en: This is the land that remains: All the districts of the Philistines and all those of the Geshurites.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa, dama ŋunkam be ya ŋɔ mi ni a nyɛla paɣ so ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ.
en: And now, my daughter, dont be afraid. Ill do for you everything you are asking. Indeed, my people—all who are at the gate—know that you are a woman of worth.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣi bɛ binyɛra ni bɛ ti mali soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ di nyɛvili tia la wala, ka doli tiŋ la dunoya kpe di ni la mal alibarika.
en: Favored are those who wash their robes so that they may have the right of access to the tree of life and may enter the city by the gates.

dag: Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ bɔhim baŋ shɛli, amaa ka lee ku tooi baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba doli soli din tuhi hal ti paai bɛ ni yɛn ʒini tin shɛl ni.
en: He led them by a straight road to a city where they could live.

dag: O ni yɛli ma, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba ni n Naawuni ni n tiliginsim tampiŋ.
en: He will say to me, You are my father and my God; you are my protector and savior.

dag: Naawuni zuɣu, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ puuni!.
en: What I write is true. God knows that I am not lying!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya, dama Masia daa di wahala yi zuɣu, ka o niŋsim maa nyɛ di ni simdi ni yi zaa dol shɛli.
en: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.

dag: Ka yɛnnim maa daa garigi yɛli ba, Di pa shɛli di ku saɣ ti mini ya zaa; dinzuɣu chamiya kpakɔhiriba sani nti da yi dintol dini na.
en: No, indeed, the wise ones answered, there is not enough for you and for us. Go to the store and buy some for yourselves.

dag: N ni kar a saria kaman bɛ ni kariti paɣ shɛb bɛn tum zina ka ku niriba ka bɛ kariti ba saria shɛm la, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒil a ni suhuyiɣisili mini nyuli.
en: I will condemn you for adultery and murder, and in my anger and fury I will punish you with death.

dag: ka bi di bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛm Izraɛlnim buɣa la, ka bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni.
en: He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife.

dag: Satahins ayopɔin maa ni daa tahi saha shɛli maa ka n niŋ shili ni n sabi, amaa ka daa wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛra, Gbib satahins ayopɔin maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ashilɔni, ka di sab li sɔŋ.
en: When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven say, Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and dont write it down.

dag: Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni noli ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Naawuni la, yi bi teei Naawuni suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu shɛm la yɛla? Ka di pala Ɛkan kɔŋko n-daa kpi o daalahichi maa tumbu zuɣu. .
en: Remember how Achan son of Zerah refused to obey the command about the things condemned to destruction; the whole community of Israel was punished for that. Achan was not the only one who died because of his sin.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yɛli ma, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: I heard a voice saying to me, Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti kpe yili maa ni, ka Leeban daa paai laakumnim maa ʒiya, ka niŋ taɣitaɣi mini mɔri ti o ni o ti laakumnim maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Leeban daa tooi kom na ti ti o mini bɛn daa be o sani ni bɛ paɣi bɛ naba.
en: So the man went into the house, and Laban unloaded the camels and gave them straw and fodder. Then he brought water for Abraham's servant and his men to wash their feet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a dɔni a nuzaa luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim tibidarigibo pa amaŋ zuɣu n-ʒi bɛ tibidarigibo maa dabisa shɛŋa ni zaa a ni yɛn do nimaani maa.
en: Then you must lie down on your left side. You must do this thing that shows that you are taking the sins of the people of Israel on yourself. You will carry the guilt for as many days as you lie on your left side.

dag: Hal Naa Asa daa yihila Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ o yabipaɣ la Napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me buɣili Ashɛra ŋmahinli zal la zuɣu. Ka Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ daai o ni me ŋmahinli shɛli zali maa luhi n-wurim li ka zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi biŋkɔbigu la nam ʒiishee, ka o nam sulinsi tariga zaa daa zibigi, ka niriba daa dimdi be zilima biɛrim zuɣu.
en: The fifth angel poured his bowl over the beasts throne, and darkness covered its kingdom. People bit their tongues because of their pain.

dag: ni Ifriim Dunɔdal la zuɣusaa ni Dunɔdal Kurili la gbini ni Zahim Dunɔdali ni Hananɛl Pia ni Kɔbiga Pia la gbini m-mali hal ti paai Piɛri Dunɔdal la gbini, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani Guliba Dunɔdal la gbini.
en: and from there we went past Ephraim Gate, Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, to the Sheep Gate. We ended our march near the gate to the Temple.

dag: faashee n ni daa ti chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka n naanyi baŋ bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: until I went into your Temple. Then I understood what will happen to the wicked.

dag: Ka Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim daa kuhi pam, ka Jahaznim wum bɛ kuhigu maa, hal ka bɛ tɔbbihi ni sɔhira.
en: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; as far as Jahaz their voice is heard. The armed men of Moab shout, spirits trembling.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku lo kpara pahi yi zuɣu du, yi mini ba zaa tarili ni bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But if they do not cross the Jordan and go into battle with you, they are to receive their share of the property in the land of Canaan, as you do.

dag: Di saha maa, yi ni ti fabili pam yi ni pii na so maa zuɣu, amaa ka Yawɛ ti ku garigi ya dindali maa.
en: When that time comes, you will complain bitterly because of your king, whom you yourselves chose, but the Lord will not listen to your complaints.

dag: Zatu daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Ɛliashib so ni Matania so mi ni Jɛrɛmɔt so gba ni Zabad ni Aziza.
en: Clan of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

dag: Ka so mi daa ti lan yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, n ni dol a; amaa lee chɛ ka n kuli nti chɛbisi n yiŋnim pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Another man said, I will follow you, Lord, but first let me go and say goodbye to my family.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ leei Naawuni zaligu karimbanima, amaa ka lee bi baŋdi bɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-tɔɣisiri maa gbinni bee m-mi bɛ ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ka tɔɣisiri di yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They want to be teachers of God's law, but they do not understand their own words or the matters about which they speak with so much confidence.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli Izraɛlnim maa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni nasara la.
en: The Lord made the king stubborn, and he pursued the Israelites, who were leaving triumphantly.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din bɛ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, bɛ daa mɛla sara maligu bimbin titali zali nimaani.
en: They came to the districts of the Jordan that are in the land of Canaan. The people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, an altar that appeared to be immense.

dag: Ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni tiligi, amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli ni ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: Honest people will be safe, but dishonest people will be ruined.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa nini daa shiri neei, ka bɛ nya ka bɛ bela bɛ zaɣim, ka bɛ daa ŋahi fiig tia vari she n-zaŋ so.
en: At once they saw what they had done, and they realized they were naked. Then they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna: Ŋunkam yɛli ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyɛ ŋum mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna;.
en: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ti Ijipti n-zaŋ ti na ti niŋ luɣ shɛli din bi viɛli ŋɔ? Luɣ shɛŋa nir ni yɛn biri chi bee n-sa fiig tihi bee n-sa wain tihi bee n-sa pumpɔrinchihi tihi kani, ka kom gba kani ka ti ni nyu.
en: Egypt was better than this horrible place. At least there we had grain and figs and grapevines and pomegranates. But now we don't even have any water.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida mini sipirɛs ni ɛligum dakuɣiri ti ma na. N ni chɛ ka n niriba kana ti pah a niriba zuɣu, dama m mi ni a niriba maa mi Lɛbanɔn dakuɣiri maa ŋmabu pam.
en: I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ daŋ yibu ti chaŋ gili tiŋ maa kaman bɛ ni daa yi pun gindi li shɛm la napɔŋ buyopɔin. Kulla dindali maa kɔŋko ka bɛ daa gil li napɔŋ buyopɔin maa.
en: On the seventh day they got up at daybreak and marched seven times around the city in the same way—this was the only day that they marched around it seven times.

dag: O yɛm puuni ka o nam zuɣusaa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka malaika so gba daa yi alizanda ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-gbibi gɔr dirili.
en: Then I saw another angel come out of the temple in heaven, and he also had a sharp sickle.

dag: ka Vɔfisi bia Nabi daa yi Naftali zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi, Vophsis son.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ mali wumpaɣibo sara, ka yili suhupiɛlli yila yɛl o tuma yɛla.
en: Offer sacrifices of thanks to him. Sing with joy about all that he has done.

dag: Dunoli kam daa malila yoobu buyi, ka yoobu kam mali chɛulo diba ayi.
en: They were double doors that swung open in the middle.

dag: Ka do so daa ti nya o ka o be mɔɣu ni chani ginda, ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra.
en: and was wandering around in the country when a man saw him and asked him, What are you looking for.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba nyɛla Galili nira yɔɣɔ? Vihim Naawuni Kundi! A yi vihi li, a ni nya ka di bi wuhi ni anab so ni ti yi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: They answered him, You are not from Galilee too, are you? Look it up and you will see that the prophet doesnt come from Galilee.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun daa pii Ibram ka yih o Ur din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka daa taɣ o yuli m-bol o Ibrahimma.
en: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.

dag: Amaa man ni yili yila n-yɛl a kpiɔŋ yɛla; n ni duhi n yee n-yili yila asiba n-yɛl a yurilim maŋli yɛla. Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha.
en: But I will sing about your strength; every morning I will sing aloud of your constant love. You have been a refuge for me, a shelter in my time of trouble.

dag: Amaa n Duuma, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ŋun niŋdi nirilim, a bi jɛri suli yom, ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali mi galisi pam.
en: My Lord, you are a kind and merciful God. You are patient, loyal, and full of love.

dag: Di saha ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zahim paɣiri la daa dii yi o nina ni luna, ka o nina maa dii neei. Ka o daa yiɣisi deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Instantly, flakes fell from Sauls eyes and he could see again. He got up and was baptized.

dag: Paɣimiya ti Duuma ŋun kul gbib ti dabisili kam ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ti tiliginsim.
en: Praise the Lord! Every day he helps us with the loads we must carry. He is the God who saves us. Selah.

dag: Maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛl kpamba n-daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Shilo, tanti suɣili la dunol ni lihi nya, ka piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam tari. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ tari li naai.
en: These are the legacies that Eleazar the priest, Joshua, Nuns son, and the heads of the families of the Israelite tribes assigned by lot at Shiloh. They did this before the LORD at the entrance of the meeting tent and finished dividing up the land.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi zaa daa laɣimna. Bɛ tɔbbihi maa daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ galisim maa daa ti ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi gba daa galisi pam.
en: They went out with all their battalions as a great army. They were as numerous as the grains of sand on the seashore. There were very many horses and chariots.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa zaŋ Maika ni daa mali binshɛŋa maa min o maligumaana la ti liri Laishinim bɛn daa be baalim, ka ka zilisigu la n-zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: The Danites took along the things that Micah had made, as well as the priest who had been with him, and came to Laish, to a people who were undisturbed and secure. They killed the people and burned down the city.

dag: Kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, kpahimmi wuntizɔriba nya; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhudoo, bɛ ni mali zuliya bɛn dol bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Observe those who have integrity and watch those whose heart is right because the future belongs to persons of peace.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ŋun Jɔn sani nti yɛl o Yisa ni daa niŋdi shɛlikam maa zaa yɛla.
en: Johns disciples informed him about all these things. John called two of his disciples.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani ka nyɛ bɛn dɔɣi bihi ni ti pirigi li ti taba, ka di leei yi dini. Bɛ ni ti be yi sani kaman Izraɛl tiŋbihi n-nyɛ ba la. Bɛ ni ti mali tarili Izraɛl zuliya maa sani.
en: It will belong to the Israelites and to any foreigners living among them whose children were born in Israel. These foreigners must be treated like any other Israelite citizen, and they will receive.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about.

dag: So yi be yi ni n-nyɛ ŋun ka, ka nyɛ yi ʒilɛl ni nira m-be yi tin shɛl ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin di kuuya yi nini niŋ o bee n-kpibi yi nuu zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ka maa polo.
en: When you are living in the land the Lord your God is giving you, there might be some poor people living among you. You must not be selfish. You must not refuse to give help to them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ buɣim dabi tiŋ maa, ka di di tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, naɣila anzinfa mini salima ni daanya kuriti la kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma biɛhigu shee.
en: Then they set fire to the city and burned it to the ground, along with everything in it, except the things made of gold, silver, bronze, and iron, which they took and put in the Lord 's treasury.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Yinim Dauda zuliya ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, yi ni niŋdi shɛm chɛ ka ninsalinim nyee nyooni la, lala ka yi bɔri ni yi niŋ chɛ ka n Naawuni ŋɔ gba nyee nyɔni.
en: Then Isaiah said, Family of David, listen very carefully! Is it not enough that you would test the patience of humans? Will you now test the patience of my God?.

dag: Dinzuɣu n lan zaŋ ya taali yaha, ka zaŋ yi yaansi gba taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And so I, the Lord , will state my case against my people again. I will bring charges against their descendants.

dag: Amaa Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛn tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba shɛm.
en: But Moses did not assign any land to the tribe of Levi. He told them that their possession was to be a share of the offerings to the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ bihi yiri chani kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la, ka bɛ bihi maa yiɣiri jamda.
en: They send their children out to play like lambs. Their children dance around.

dag: O boli o sapashin kpamba, ka bɛ kanna ka tuura, bɛ zo yomyom chaŋ gooni gbini, bɛ zaŋ nyɔtaɣirigu zali.
en: He musters his officers; they stumble as they press forward. They hurry to the city wall, and the portable shield is set up.

dag: Ti yaannim daa jɛmdila Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka yinim Yɛhudianim ti yɛri ni Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu shee.
en: Our ancestors worshipped on this mountain, but you and your people say that it is necessary to worship in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa yi ni ti yɛn niŋ ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti daamiya bɛ maligu bimbina luhi, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila la, ka chɛ ŋ-ŋmaai bɛ Ashɛrim la luhi tiŋa, ka nyo bɛ wuna buɣim.
en: This is what you must do to those nations: You must smash their altars and break their memorial stones into pieces. Cut down their Asherah poles and burn their statues.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Yaakubu pam ka o suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa pirig o niriba bɛn be o sani min o biŋkɔbbaligu ni o niɣi ni o laakumnim ʒii buyi.
en: Jacob was terrified and felt trapped, so he divided the people with him, and the flocks, cattle, and camels, into two camps.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya azichi mini mɔ viɛla. Ka tiŋgbani maa lan galisi ka vuri kani ka suhudoo beni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be nimaani daa nyɛla Hamnima.
en: They found plenty of fertile pasture lands there in a stretch of open country that was quiet and peaceful. The people who had lived there before were Hamites.

dag: N daa niŋdi ba alaka waawaayili Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m muɣisi ba ka bɛ tu Yisa. N suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu pam maa zuɣu ka n daa du tin duya ni ni m paai ba nimaani ti niŋ ba alaka.
en: In one synagogue after another—indeed, in all the synagogues—I would often torture them, compelling them to slander God. My rage bordered on the hysterical as I pursued them, even to foreign cities.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ka yuri ti, ka nyɛ ŋun ti ti suhukpaŋsibo din ka bahigu mini tahima suŋ o daanfaani puuni la.
en: Our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father loved us and through grace gave us eternal comfort and a good hope.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni bɛ nya, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ o, ka bi dol o zaligunima, amaa ka bɛ daa ti ŋmaligi n-leei bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: But they tested God Most High and made him very sad. They didnt obey his commands.

dag: bee alɔbo din be zibisim ni bee mbusim din paarina wuntaŋ ni agbaa saha la.
en: or the plagues that strike in the dark or the evils that kill in daylight.

dag: dama bɛ wahala dibu zahimbu pam nyabu puuni mini bɛ ni kul nyɛ faranim la zaa yoli, bɛ suhupiɛlli din galisi pam zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tɔhiri tɔto ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.

dag: Amaa man ni lih a ninni wuntitali puuni; n yi ti neei n-lihi nya a kɔtomsi, di ni ti tiɣi n nini.
en: I am innocent, Lord , and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.

dag: O daa yi kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla puri ni bee tiŋkpansi ni bee fɔntinsi ni, bɛ ʒirila barinim na nti sɔŋdi di dahi ni, ka suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shihi o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: And everywhere Jesus went, to villages, towns, or farms, people would take their sick to the marketplaces and beg him to let the sick at least touch the edge of his cloak. And all who touched it were made well.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli Firawuna, N ni gɔri gindi ŋɔ, n yuma nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita. N yuma maa mini di dabisa bi galisi, amaa ka yɛl biɛri lee be di puuni. Di bi be kaman yuma mini dabisa shɛŋa n yaannim ni daa zaŋ gɔri gindi la.
en: Jacob answered, My life of wandering has lasted a hundred and thirty years. Those years have been few and difficult, unlike the long years of my ancestors in their wanderings.

dag: Ka Musa daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu zalizali, ka zaŋ di dapaɣa la tamtam di zuɣu, ka zaŋ di dapuhi la niŋ li, ka zaŋ di daantalisi la sa;.
en: Moses put down its bases, set up its frames, attached its crossbars, and put up its posts.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya. Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner said to Joab, Lets have the young men fight in a contest before us. All right, Joab said, lets do it.

dag: Bɛ daa kpɛnkpɛla sida dari din be duu maa puuni m-malimal li, ka ŋme yɔɣa mini tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi m-pampa di zuɣu, sida dapaɣa maa noli ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi pa di puuni zaa hal ka kuɣ yini gba ti bi lan nyiya.
en: The inside walls were lined with cedar to hide the stones, and the cedar was decorated with carvings of gourds and flowers.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Doo ŋun daa neei zom nina ŋɔ daa naan ku faai Lazarɔs gba bahi ka o ku kpi.
en: But some of them said, He healed the eyes of the man born blind. Couldnt he have kept Lazarus from dying.

dag: Ka Naomi daa kpuɣi bia maa ʒil o naba zuɣu m-mal o.
en: Naomi loved the boy and took good care of him.

dag: ka ninvuɣ yino bee a niriba Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino yi ti baŋ din muɣis o o suhu ni, ka teeg o nuu tiri duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: When any of these things happen, and people feel compelled in their hearts to spread their hands in prayer toward this Temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili buɣim di ba, ka n labisi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So Ive poured out my anger on them. With my furious fire Ive finished them off. Ive held them accountable. This is what the LORD God proclaims.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Mɔabnim polo m-bala.
en: That is the message the Lord gave earlier about Moab.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yibu asibaasi n-liri ba n-tuhi ba hal ni zaawuni, ka do so daa bi zo n-tiligi naɣila nachimba kɔbisinahi n-daa ba laakumnim zo n-tiligi.
en: David attacked just before sunrise the next day and fought until sunset. Four hundred Amalekites rode away on camels, but they were the only ones who escaped.

dag: Ashidɔdnim ni daa nya di ni be shɛm maa ka bɛ yɛli, Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ku lan be ti sani, dama o darigi ti tibili n-tabili ti buɣili Dagɔn.
en: Finally, they said, The God of Israel did this. He is the one who caused all this trouble for us and our god Dagon. We've got to get rid of this chest.

dag: O daa kari zuliya shɛba, ka piri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ti Izraɛl zuliya, ka deei bɛ yinsi ti ba ka bɛ kpe m-beni.
en: He forced the other nations out before them and gave each family its share of the land. He gave each tribe of Israel a place to live.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Nuhu min o bidibisi la ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: God blessed Noah and his sons and said, Have many children, so that your descendants will live all over the earth.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa kul be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni hal ni dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa ti ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jeremiah remained in the prison quarters until Jerusalem was captured.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia ŋɔ niŋ o nuu ni? Ka ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia zaa fukumsi ti o?.
en: Who placed earth in his care, and who gave him dominion over the entire world?.

dag: Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana ŋun daa gul o ba Zibiɔn bunsi ka ti nya kɔbilisirim mɔɣu ni la.
en: Zibeon had two sons, Aiah and Anah.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu; ka o chɛ ka bɛ ŋme ba tɔbu, ka di be kaman buɣim la gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ di daliri, ka di di ba kaman buɣim la, amaa ka bɛ bi lihi li ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: So he poured out his anger on them and brought wars against them. It was as if there were fires all around them, but they didnt know what was happening. It was as if they were burning, but they didnt try to understand.

dag: ni Hɛziro ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la ni Paarai ŋun daa nyɛ Aribi nir la.
en: Hezro from Carmel; Paarai from Erab.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum lala maa ka o bɔhi ni Yisa nyɛla Galili nira?.
en: When Pilate heard this, he asked, Is this man a Galilean.

dag: ka zibisim din ni chɛ ka a ku tooi nya mini kɔgbana lim a maa.
en: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood.

dag: Ka Pita daa zani dunol ni niŋdi gaafara, ka paɣisar so ŋun yuli booni Roda daa kana ni o ti nya ŋun bala.
en: Peter knocked on the outside door. A servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya n taali yim ŋɔ yaha, ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa ti ma ka o yihi ma kum ŋɔ ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Now forgive my sin this one time and pray to the Lord your God to take away this fatal punishment from me.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuma ata puuni, Mɔabnim ni ti kɔŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli saha biɛla puuni kaman padiriba saha ni bi galisi shɛm la. Bɛ ni kul galisi maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, ka bɛ mi ku mali yaa.
en: And now the Lord says, In exactly three years Moab's great wealth will disappear. Of its many people, only a few will survive, and they will be weak.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa;.
en: When Jesus finished saying these things, the crowd was amazed at the way he taught.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi duɣu n-doori anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim titali n-doori salima shɛm, lala ka bɛ buɣisiri ninsal gba o paɣibu ni.
en: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.

dag: ka yɛl o, Aai! Ti ni dol a kul a niriba sani.
en: Then the daughters said, But we want to come with you and go to your family.

dag: N di suɣilo guhi Yawɛ, ka o gbilis o tibili wum n kuhigu.
en: I called to the Lord , and he heard me. He heard my cries.
