dag: Ti yi kul mal ania, ti min o ni ti laɣim di nam. Ti yi zaɣis o, o gba ni ti zaɣisi ti.
en: If we remain faithful even in suffering, we will also rule with him. If we refuse to say we know him, he will refuse to say he knows us.

dag: N kuhimi hal ti gbarigi, ka n kukoli biɛra, ka n nina niŋ liti, ka n kul guhirila n Naawuni.
en: I am getting weak from calling for help. My throat is sore. I have waited and looked for your help until my eyes are hurting.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabinim mini wuntizɔriba pam suhuri daa yɛmi ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bi nya li; ka bɛ suhuri daa lan ye ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka daa bi wum li.
en: I assure you that many prophets and many of God's people wanted very much to see what you see, but they could not, and to hear what you hear, but they did not.

dag: Miri ka a leei dabiɛm bini n sani, nyini n-nyɛ n ni yɛn sɔɣi so sani m muɣisigu saha.
en: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.

dag: Nyama, bɛ yi kul ʒini luɣ shɛli bee bɛ yi kul yiɣisi luɣ shɛli, mani ka bɛ yiini yila tura.
en: From morning till night they make fun of me.

dag: Ka yi ti di bindir kura hal ni saha shɛli, ka yi ni ti kɔrigila bindir kura ka su zaɣ pala.
en: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.

dag: Tiligim ma takɔb kum ni, fam n nyɛvili baa nuu ni bahi.
en: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.

dag: Hal bɛ yi du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti sɔɣi, n ni bo n-nya ba gbahi ba. Ka bɛ yi zomi kpe teeku ni nti sɔɣi di bulli ni, n ni chɛ ka teeku ni wahu dim ba.
en: If they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, I will search for them there and remove them. If they hide from my sight at the bottom of the sea, I will give an order to the sea serpent, and it will bite them.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri, amaa tummiyala din viɛla ka sokam zaa nya.
en: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others.

dag: Dama ʒiɛmana pam din gari la ha zaŋ kana ni pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ kul karindila Anabi Musa zaligu Yɛhudianim tiŋ kam jɛmbu duu ni Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka karimbanima naanyi yihir o yɛligu waazu.
en: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒi gbariti mini bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni ni zoomba ni biriti ni dɔro balibu kam ni mali shɛb pam tahi o sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Large crowds came to him, including those who were paralyzed, blind, injured, and unable to speak, and many others. They laid them at his feet, and he healed them.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o laɣim bɛn bi ʒe yim ni.
en: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.

dag: Ka n yi kul yi a sani chaŋ, Yawɛ shia ni kana nti kpuɣ a kpa shɛli polo n ni ʒi, ka n chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab ka o ti bi nya a, o ni ku ma, hal man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kul nyɛ ŋun doli Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga m bilim ni ha la zaa yoli.
en: What if the Lord 's Spirit takes you away as soon as I leave? When Ahab comes to get you, he won't find you. Then he will surely kill me. I have worshiped the Lord since I was a boy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa vinvamli din be Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la. Amaa so bi mi bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He buried Moses in Moab. This was in the valley across from Beth Peor. But even today, no one knows exactly where Moses grave is.

dag: Ka Amazia daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-gari tooni zaŋ o niriba maa chaŋ Yalim Vinvamli la ni nti ku Ɛdomnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Then Amaziah became very brave and led his army to the Salt Valley in the country of Edom. There his army killed , men from Seir.

dag: Sool ni daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka kpi shɛm m-bala. O daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka bi doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka daa lan chaŋ ti buɣi baɣa m-bɔr sɔŋsim.
en: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord . He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ li na; ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: They brought him one, and he asked, Whose face and name are these? The Emperor's, they answered.

dag: ka Aduna bihi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa mali buɣim, ka malimali dari viɛnyɛla niŋ buɣim maa ni.
en: The sons of Aaron the priest will light the altar and lay wood on the fire.

dag: Ka o sɔrilim maa yi na bi naai ka o dɔni binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, o yi lan ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu, di gba ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.

dag: dindina n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan zɔr o dabiɛm, dama m mi ni m pala bɛ ni tɛhi ni n nyɛ so maa.
en: Then I would speak—unafraid— for Im not that way.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛ ka o mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni, yin kum o.
en: Put to death any man who has sexual relations with an animal.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa su fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa daa bela nudirigu polo ha zaŋ kpa Ɛdom tintariga polo. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ Kabiziil mini Ɛda ni Jagur.
en: The outlying cities of the tribe of the people of Judah ran down to the border of Edom. In the arid southern plain: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur.

dag: Dama n ni zɔri binshɛli pam n-ka n sanna, ka binshɛli din kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm lu n zuɣu.
en: and my worst fears have all come true.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: Jesus again gave a loud cry and breathed his last.

dag: Shallum ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛl la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Shallum did, including an account of his conspiracy, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya din niŋ maa ka paɣi Naawuni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla ŋun ka taali.
en: The army officer saw what had happened, and he praised God, saying, Certainly he was a good man.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Itiɔpia ni mini bɛn mali Ijipti nyuri bara la, ka vi gbahi ba.
en: They will be shattered and shamed because of Cush their hope, and because of Egypt their glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Judanima n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: So I will start a fire in Judah that will destroy the high towers of Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka bɛ nyom yaɣi; ka bɛ ʒim ti zɔri teeni zoya zuɣu.
en: Their bodies will be thrown outside. The stink will rise from the bodies, and the blood will flow down the mountains.

dag: Ka o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ maa ba yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni o kpalimmi gbe, ka o daa kpalim gbe daba ata. Ka bɛ daa laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka o gbɛri nimaani.
en: and did not want him to leave. So the man stayed three days, eating and drinking with his father-in-law.

dag: So kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya. Tim kani din ni tibi yi daŋ maa. Yi ku nya tibbu.
en: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ niriba zuɣulaannim ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na nti nya ka baŋ alahichi shɛli din tum zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then Saul said, All you officers in the army, come forward! Lets find out what sin was committed today.

dag: ka lan nyɛ zuɣusaa neesim din ne dunia ni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: They will be in the sky to shine light on the earth. And it happened.

dag: Ti zaŋdi galigɛnima n-lɛri yuri ni bɛ tum ti yubu, ka ti ŋmaligiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa kpari ti ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: We put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us. With these bits we can control their whole body.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu maa naai, ka o zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni;.
en: After David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Kul kpalimmiya be Naawuni yurilim la puuni, ka guhimiya saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu la.
en: Keep yourselves safe in Gods love, as you wait for the Lord Jesus Christ in his mercy to give you eternal life.

dag: Sagban tibisa lim o n-chɛ ka o bi nyara, ka be zuɣusaa kpaakpanyom ni chana.
en: Thick clouds hide us from his eyes, so he cannot see us as he walks around the edge of the sky.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti mali Babilɔn naa ansarisi yɛli, Na putɔɣulan la luya ka ku lan tooi nahim so yaha!.
en: When he does this, they are to mock the king of Babylon and say: The cruel king has fallen! He will never oppress anyone again!.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o zali ni bɛ be kaman o Bia la, ka di chɛ ka o Bia maa leei bikpɛma o mabihi pam ni.
en: God knew them before he made the world. And he decided that they would be like his Son. Then Jesus would be the firstborn of many brothers and sisters.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ bihi maa mali bɛ buɣa dahin shɛli maa, dindali maa ka bɛ daa kpe n jɛmbu duu ti ta li daɣiri. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ n duu maa ni.
en: When they slaughtered their children for their idols, they came into my sanctuary and made it impure on that very same day. They actually did this inside my temple.

dag: Yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen, people of Israel.

dag: Ka o yi yɛn zaŋla piɛɣu na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋmi piɛnyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli na.
en: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Amaa yum yi na be o niŋgbuŋ ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, This is leprosy—you are unclean.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti sɔŋdi niriba lala tatabo, ka di chɛ ka ti leei bɛn mini ba laɣindi tumdi yɛlimaŋli la puuni.
en: So we should help them. When we help them, we share with their work for the truth.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli, ka lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku bɛ zaa n-kpihim bɛ birili, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: The Lord made those people feel brave enough to fight against Israel. This was so that Israel could destroy them completely without mercy just as the Lord had commanded Moses to do.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa chɛ ka o bidibis ayopɔin maa kana ti gari Samuɛl tooni, ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Jɛsi, Yawɛ bi pii bɛmbɔŋɔ ni so.
en: Jesse presented seven of his sons to Samuel, but Samuel said to Jesse, The LORD hasnt picked any of these.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ vinnyaɣilana o duu yɔɣira gɔŋdimi, ka o baɣa yi ka di ni, o duu maa ti yindimi.
en: If someone is too lazy to work, their house will begin to leak, and the roof will fall in.

dag: Ka Amasa daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti boli Judanim maa na, amaa ka o daa yuui hal ka bɛ ni daa zal o dabisi shɛli maa ti gari.
en: Amasa started bringing the army together, but it was taking him more than three days.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa ti bahi di nam maa labina, ka daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bolim o ni daa zaŋ liɣiri ti o yiŋbi shɛb ka chaŋ la na ka o ti nya bɛ ni go kɔhigu maa nya nyɔri shɛm tariga.
en: But the man was made king. When he came home, he said, Call those servants who have my money. I want to know how much more money they earned with it.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba maa nabi, ka a ti ba suhupiɛlli pam. Bɛ malila suhupiɛlli a sani kaman niriba ni kpuɣiri puu atam ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la bee kaman tɔbbihi ni yi pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: Our Lord , you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa wum niriba maa yɛligu maa, ka o gba daa lan zaŋ li yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Samuel listened to them and then told the Lord exactly what they had said.

dag: dindina o dana maa ŋun zaŋm o chaŋ Naawuni sani nti zaŋ o zali baɣili dunoli bee duno paɣirili, ka zaŋ peenkpaa chib o tibili voli, ka o leeg o dabili hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: then his master shall take him to the place of worship. There he is to make him stand against the door or the doorpost and put a hole through his ear. Then he will be his slave for life.

dag: Ka gomna maa daa nya din niŋ maa ka niŋ yɛda, dama ti Duuma yɛligu maa wuhibu daa gar o pam.
en: When the governor saw this, he believed. He was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

dag: Nyamiya, n ʒiɛla dunol ni n-niŋdi gaafara, ka ŋun wum n kukoli ka yooi, n ni kpe dilan sani ka m min o ti laɣim di.
en: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and eat with you. And you will eat with me.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn garigi yɛl o, Ndana, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi fa Izraɛlnim bahi? Nyama, n daŋ niriba nyɛla bɛn ka yaa Manaasa zuliya ni, ka m mi nyɛ ŋun pɔri n yiŋnim ni.
en: But Gideon answered and said, Pardon me, sir. How can I save Israel? My family group is the weakest in the tribe of Manasseh, and I am the youngest one in my family.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya niŋdi yaa, di nyaaŋa ka o bahi ba yoli. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya yɛligira, di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ ba bahi.
en: He makes nations strong and great, but then he defeats and destroys them.

dag: Zaŋm bindira balibu kam gba n-niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka di ti nyɛ a mini ba bindirigu.
en: Store up enough food both for yourself and for them.

dag: Ka Musa yɛl o, A yi ku doli ti chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka ti yiɣisi kpe.
en: Then Moses replied, If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.

dag: ka o ba wum o ni po pɔri shɛli bee o ni lo alikauli shɛli maa ka bi yɛl o shɛli, dindina o pɔri maa zaa ni zani, ka o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa ni zani.
en: If her father hears about the promise and agrees, the young woman must do what she promised.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, dɔbba gba daa tumdila dagɔr tuma bɛ buɣa maa malibu shee. Judanim daa tum din chihiri shɛlikam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Yawɛ ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa kana ti ʒini maa ni daa tumdi la.
en: Even worse, they allowed prostitutes at the shrines, and followed the disgusting customs of the foreign nations that the Lord had forced out of Canaan.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o yi ku yiɣisi zaŋ li ti o o min o simdi maa zuɣu, amaa o nimmoo suhigu maa zuɣu o ni yiɣisi zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa ti o.
en: I assure you, even if he wouldnt get up and help because of his friendship, he will get up and give his friend whatever he needs because of his friends brashness.

dag: M maŋmaŋ ni bo shɛhiradiriba ayi shɛb n ni dihi tabili. Bɛna n-nyɛ maligumaana Yuria mini Zakaria ŋun nyɛ Jɛbɛrikia bia la.
en: Summon trusted people, Uriah the priest and Zechariah, Jeberechiahs son, to witness it.

dag: Hal ka wuhiri li buri ni mini duu kpɛhibu ni ni muɣisigu nyabu duŋtaariba nuu ni ni tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ni gɔgaliga ni ni kumkpibo puuni.
en: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.

dag: Jaande chɛ ka n labi n ya ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma baɣili m ba mini m ma gbala. Amaa a dabili Chimham m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka o doli nyini n dan naa kuli ka a ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: Let your servant return so I may die in my own town near the grave of my parents. But here is your servant Chimham. Let him cross over with my master and king, and treat him as you think best.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi lo ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni alikauli, naɣ wurimmiyala bɛ buɣa bimbina la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n ni zali ya shɛm maa niŋbu. Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa?.
en: and you are not to make a covenant with those who live in this land. You should break down their altars. But you didnt obey me. What have you done?.

dag: Miriya ka yi siŋ Ɛdomnim ni so, dama bɛ nyɛla yi mabihi, miriya ka yi siŋ Ijiptinima, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba m-be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: You must not hate Edomites, because they are your relatives. You must not hate Egyptians, because you were a stranger in their land.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Libianim daa mali tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba, amaa a ni daa niŋ Yawɛ naani la zuɣu, o daa zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Didn't the Ethiopians and the Libyans have large armies with many chariots and cavalry troops? But because you relied on the Lord , he gave you victory over them.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Ɛbiasaf ni Asir ni.
en: his son Elkanah, his son Ebiasaph, his son Assir.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi ti ni ti paabuna ka niŋ ti nirilim pam, dama bɛ daa malila buɣim ti ti saa ni daa miri ka wari beni zuɣu.
en: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, M bɔri ni a baŋ ka biɛhiŋ kani, ni a zuliya ni ti chaŋ ti be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din pa bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ daba nimaani, ka bɛ ni ti nahim ba yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: Then the LORD said to Abram, Have no doubt that your descendants will live as immigrants in a land that isnt their own, where they will be oppressed slaves for four hundred years.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima suhu yɛla baŋsim zuɣu, amaa jɛrilim m-be jɛra noya ni.
en: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.

dag: N wumla n yura kukoli. Nyama, o yila zoya zuɣu zɔrina. O zɔrimi duri kunkuna kani n sanna.
en: Listen! Its my lover: here he comes now, leaping upon the mountains, bounding over the hills.

dag: N daa loya ni n yi ka yi sanna, n ku zaŋ yɛli shɛli yɛla wuhi ya n-naɣ pahila Masia min o dapulli zuɣu kpahibu la yɛla.
en: I decided that while I was with you I would forget about everything except Jesus Christ and his death on the cross.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ʒini di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa ni ʒini binshɛli zuɣu, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who sits on something that the one with the emission also sat on must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: O daa malila paɣiba kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ nabipuɣinsi, ka mali mamanim mi kɔbisita; ka o paɣiba maa daa ti chɛ ka o birigi.
en: Seven hundred of his wives were daughters of kings, but he also married other women. As Solomon got older, some of his wives led him to worship their gods. He wasn't like his father David, who had worshiped only the Lord God.

dag: Amaa yɛm din yiri alizanda ni na nyɛla alali, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri suhudoo mini biɛribaalimtali, ka nyɛ din deeri wuhibu, ka lan nyɛ din pali nambɔzɔbo mini tuun suma, ka mali ʒiɛyimtali ka ka bilikɔnsi baabiɛla.
en: But the wisdom from above is pure first of all; it is also peaceful, gentle, and friendly; it is full of compassion and produces a harvest of good deeds; it is free from prejudice and hypocrisy.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa laɣim sɔŋ o gballi maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ Reechɛl gballi maa kuɣiduli, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Jacob set up a tombstone over her grave, and it is still there.

dag: A ni tooi tahi sagbani zuɣu n-chɛ ka kom kpe n-lim a?.
en: Can you shout at the clouds and command them to cover you with rain?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yuri ya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka a lee yuri ti? Yawɛ yɛliya, Iso daa pala Yaakubu mabia? Di zaa yoli, n daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: The Lord said, I love you people. But you said, What shows you love us? The Lord said, Esau was Jacobs brother, but I chose Jacob.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashee kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni so yi ni tooi saɣim n ni lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli shɛl la, ka biɛɣu ku lan neei bee ka yuŋ ku lan zibi n ni zal li saha shɛli maa.
en: The Lord says, I have an agreement with day and night. I agreed that they would continue forever. You cannot change that agreement. Day and night will always come at the right time. If you could change that agreement.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Zɛnan mini Hadasha ni Migidaligad.
en: There were also Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka naŋgbankpeeni lu niriba ayi sunsuuni ka bɛ tahi li ʒiishee, ka sariakaritiba ti ŋmaai bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka wuhi ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli.
en: Suppose two Israelites go to court to settle a dispute, and one is declared innocent and the other guilty.

dag: Yi yaannim bɛn daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti la daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin, ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: When your ancestors went down into Egypt, there were only people. Now the Lord your God has made you as many as the stars in the sky.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi yɛtɔɣa nyɔni Yawɛ nyee. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee chɛ ka o nyee nyɔni? Yi ni yɛra, Ŋunkam tum zaɣ biɛɣu, di nyɛla din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ o ni bɔri shɛl la. Bee yi ni bɔhira, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan maa lee be ya la.
en: You have made the LORD tired with your words. You say, How have we made him tired? When you say: Anyone doing evil is good in the LORDs eyes, or He delights in those doing evil, or Where is the God of justice.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa ʒe bimbini maa gbini ni o tuɣili tulaale zim maa saha shɛli ka anab so daa yi Juda n-zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu ka Bɛtɛl na.
en: A man of God came from Judah by Gods command to Bethel. Jeroboam was standing at the altar burning incense.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Duhimiya Yawɛ tuuta maa zuɣusaa, Yawɛ kul ni tuhiri Amalɛknim maa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: He said, The power of the LORDs banner! The LORD is at war with Amalek in every generation.

dag: Ka Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir maa daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Aijalɔn Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni.
en: Then Elon from the tribe of Zebulun died and was buried in the city of Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

dag: daa ti lo tɔbu bɛ ʒiɛman ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Sɔdom Naa Bɛra mini Gomɔra Naa Birisha ni Adima Naa Shinab ni Zɛbɔiim Naa Shɛmɛba ni Bɛla bee Zɔa naa.
en: went to war against five other kings: Bera of Sodom, Birsha of Gomorrah, Shinab of Admah, Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela .

dag: Di zaɣisiriya tab laɣimbu naɣila yi yi ti naai noli ni yi lo noli suhi Naawuni saha shɛli, ka di nyaaŋa yin lan laɣimmiya taba, ka di chɛ ka Sintani ku tooi zahim ya yi kɔŋ maŋgbibbu puuni.
en: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti zaɣisi anab maa ni yɛn zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa wumbu, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti kari dilan saria.
en: He will speak in my name, and I will punish anyone who refuses to obey him.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni wum dimbɔŋɔ bee n-ni ti bɔri ni o zaŋ o zaɣa niŋ di ni dahin shɛli ha?.
en: Will any of you pay attention to this warning? Will you ever learn to listen?.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla; ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Sisɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hazɔrinim naa Jabin sapashin kpɛm la nuu ni. Ka lan zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim mini Mɔabnim nanim nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme ba tɔbu.
en: But the people forgot the Lord their God, and so he let the Philistines and the king of Moab and Sisera, commander of the army of the city of Hazor, fight against your ancestors and conquer them.

dag: Yawɛ ni yu shɛlikam, dina ka o niŋda zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni, ni teekunim ni mini kɔbula zaa ni.
en: The Lord does whatever he wants, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and the deep oceans.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaayi.
en: of Elam .

dag: Yi lo nia shɛŋa din ka buchi, yimaŋmaŋ vuhim ni ŋmaligi din ya kaman buɣim la.
en: You people have done useless things. These things are like hay and straw. They are worth nothing! Your breath will be like a fire and burn you.

dag: Mbaye, ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm! N na mi m-be kaman tiŋgban nɛl la Izraɛlnim sani? Bee n na mi m-be kaman zibisim titali ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni shɛm la? Ka wula ka yi yɛra, Ti sula timaŋa, ti ku lan lab a sanna.
en: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you.

dag: dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.

dag: dama yi niriba ayi maa daa bi ʒe ma yim Izraɛlnim sunsuuni Mɛribatikadɛshi kom la gbini Zin tiŋgban nɛl la ni, yi ni daa bi gbibi m biɛrikasitali Izraɛlnim sunsuuni la zuɣu.
en: because the two of you were unfaithful toward me in front of the Israelites at the waters of Meribath-kadesh, in the Zin wilderness, because you didnt treat me with proper respect before the Israelites.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ Gibianim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka chaŋ ti liri ba.
en: This is what were now going to do to Gibeah: Well march up against it as the lot determines.

dag: Ka kuhigu pam ni ti be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ yaha.
en: Everywhere in Egypt there will be loud crying. Nothing like this has ever happened before or will ever happen again.

dag: Amaa ka Nabal nachimba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti yɛli Nabal paɣ Abigeel, Nyama, Dauda timla tuumba ka bɛ yi o sani mɔɣu maa ni na ni bɛ ti puhi ti kpɛm maa, ka o tu ba.
en: One of Nabals servants told his wife Abigail, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master, but he just yelled at them.

dag: Ka Pool daa garigi yɛli Di chaŋ wula ka yi kuhiri ŋ-ŋmari n yɛma? M mali shili gu shɛlikam, pa ni bɛ ti lo ma mihi Jɛrusalɛm n-kpɛhi duu kɔŋko, amaa n loya ni n ti kpi nimaani gba n Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: But Paul answered, Why are you crying and breaking my heart? I am not only willing to be put in jail for the Lord Jesus, but I am even willing to die for him in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti dana, a daba kala bindira dabu na.
en: No sir, they replied. We're your servants, and we have only come to buy grain.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma nambɔɣu zɔbu. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la kul guli ma.
en: Lord , I know you will never stop being merciful to me. Your love and loyalty will always keep me safe.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan tim wɔribar so ŋun pah ayi, ka o tuhi ba soli nti yɛli, Naa ni n ti bɔh a nya Alaafee? Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim doli n nyaaŋa.
en: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit. What's it to you? Jehu asked. Just get behind me with the rest of my troops.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n tooi zani Ziɔn dunɔdaya ni n-yɛli n ni paɣir a shɛlikam zuɣu shɛm yɛla, n ni mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma la zuɣu.
en: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, di saha maa Juda ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa sabila gbana pam ti Tɔbaya, ka Tɔbaya gba daa sabi gbana ti ba.
en: In addition, in those days the officials of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiahs letters were coming to them.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari m-mali dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Make upright frames for the Tent out of acacia wood.

dag: ka kaari ba asiba kam, ka zahindi ba saha shɛlikam?.
en: visit them each morning, test them every moment?.

dag: Ka yili maa ni paɣa daa zaŋ bini pa kɔbiliga maa noli n-yɛrigi chi diɛli di zuɣu, ka so daa bi baŋ ni shɛli be nimaani.
en: The mans wife took a covering and spread it over the wells opening, then scattered grain over it so no one would notice.

dag: Dindina nir yi mɔɣi tampiligim di so. O suhu ni tɛha m-birig o maa, ka o ku tooi tilig omaŋa bee n-yɛli, N ni gbib binshɛli n nudirigu ni ŋɔ pala Naawuni.
en: Someone like that is deceived. They dont know what they are doing. They cannot save themselves, and they will not admit, This statue I am holding is a lie.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa ʒin o ba nam ʒiishee n-nya yaa naai, o daa zaŋla takɔbi ku o tizɔbihi maa zaa, ka daa lan ku Izraɛl kpambal shɛb gba.
en: When Jehoram was in firm control of the kingdom, he had all his brothers killed, and also some Israelite officials.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka puu maa lan yɛl o nachin kpɛma, Cham ti boli tumtumdiba maa na ti yo ba. Daŋmi bɛn yoli kana la yɔbu pɔi, ka naanyi yo bɛn di daŋna la.
en: When evening came, the owner told his foreman, Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with those who were hired last and ending with those who were hired first.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shini ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama naa daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: But the people were silent. They did not say a word to the commander, because King Hezekiah had commanded them, Dont say anything to him.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ku lan kana ti ŋme ba tɔbu ka di bɛ nɛma, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni biŋkɔbiri ku lan gbahi ba. Bɛ ni ti beni ni alaafee ka so ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: They will not be caught like an animal by the nations anymore. Those animals will not eat them anymore. No, they will live safely. No one will make them afraid.

dag: Ka goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, yin chɛ ka bɛ piɛb kikahi pampam. Ka dabisi shɛli din nyɛ samli yɔbu dali maa, yin chɛliya ka bɛ piɛbi kikahi gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: On the Day of Atonement, you must blow a rams horn. That will be on the tenth day of the seventh month. You must blow the rams horn through the whole country.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi ni paɣ ŋɔ nya o daalahichi din galisi ŋɔ zaa chɛ m-paŋ, dama o yurilim galisiya pam; amaa ŋun nya o daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ ka di pɔri nyɛla ŋun yurilim pɔra.
en: I tell you, then, the great love she has shown proves that her many sins have been forgiven. But whoever has been forgiven little shows only a little love.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti ʒe teeku duli.
en: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, bɛn daa nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛr o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maa.
en: Jeremiah said to all the people, men and women alike, in fact everyone who had spoken this way.

dag: Ŋuna n-duhiri tarimba, ka tiri bɛn be nandahima ni nasara.
en: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli wumbu ka zaŋ bɛ zaɣa niŋla kurimbuni ha lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: People will stop listening to the truth. They will begin to follow the teaching in false stories.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli bo n-nya buni ŋmanila noon so ŋun ŋuni o ni bi nye gal shɛŋa zuɣu wɔɣi li. Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu pirigili puuni, bɛ ni ti kɔŋ li, ka bɛ bahigu saha, niriba ni ti boli ba jɛra.
en: The person who gets money dishonestly is like a bird that hatches eggs it didn't lay. In the prime of life he will lose his riches, and in the end he is nothing but a fool.

dag: Ka ŋun yuri Naawuni daalibarika yi be yili maa ni, yi daalibarika puhigu maa ni kpalim o ni; amaa lala nir yi ka yili maa ni, di ni lab yi sanna yaha.
en: If anyone there shares Gods peace, then your peace will rest on that person. If not, your blessing will return to you.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ zuɣulaantab daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti bɔhi Yɛhudianim maa: Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu ŋɔ hal ka yi me li ti naai.
en: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, Who told you to rebuild this temple?.

dag: Ka a niŋgbuŋ zaa yi nɛmi hal ka zibisim biɛla ka di ni, dindina di ni nɛmi zaa kaman firila ni ne a shɛm la.
en: If you have light, and nothing is dark, then light will be everywhere, as when a lamp shines brightly on you.

dag: Yinim jɛra ŋɔ, pa ŋun nam di nyaaŋ maa n-nam di puuni maa gba?.
en: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila wurigu, ka buɣim ni di ba zaa! Bɛ ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋ buɣim barina ni. Bɛ ka sala buɣim din ni wuɣisi.
en: They are just like stubble; the fire burns them. They wont save themselves from the powerful flames. This is no warming ember or fire to sit beside.

dag: Amaa n dimnim bɛn daa bi bɔri ni n su ba la, zaŋmiya ba na nti ku ba n nini ŋɔ ni.
en: As for my enemies who dont want me as their king, bring them here and slaughter them before me.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel! He always was and will always be worthy of praise! All the people praised the Lord and said Amen.

dag: Yi mi n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, ka mi di soli.
en: You know the way to the place where I am going.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Ahimaaz daa garigi yɛl o, Jɔab ni di tim ma saha shɛli na maa, n di nya zama ni laɣim yo vuri, amaa n di bi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: The king said, Is my boy Absalom okay? Ahimaaz said, I saw a large crowd right when Joab, the kings servant, sent your servant off, but I dont know what it was about.

dag: Kamiyana ka ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Chɛliya ka ti yo suhupiɛlli vuri m-paɣi ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ!.
en: Sing joyful songs to the Lord ! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa n-garigi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Then the Lord answered the angel who was talking with me. He spoke good, comforting words.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi tinsi ni mini yi puri ni.
en: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the field.

dag: Ka Jabɛshi kpamba daa yɛl o, Tim ti daba ayopɔin ka ti tim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ti yɛl ba, ka so yi kani ŋun ni fa ti bahi, di saha ti ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a.
en: The leaders of Jabesh said to Nahash, Let us have seven days. We will send messengers through all Israel. If no one comes to help us, we will come up to you and surrender to you.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋmanila mɔri din zoori wuntaŋ nyeebu ni, ka bɛ nyaɣa teei ʒiɛvari puu ni.
en: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: So they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and God saved them from their desperate circumstances.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o kpe salo maa ni, amaa ka nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba daa bi saɣi.
en: Paul wanted to go out and speak to the people, but the Lord's followers would not let him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi bɛ dooshee maa chana, Yawɛ sagban la daa kul ʒiɛla bɛ zuɣusaa dɛde wuntaŋ ni.
en: As they moved on from each camp, the cloud of the Lord was over them by day.

dag: Judanim gba daa bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zalikpana la, amaa ka daa dolila Izraɛlnim ni daa zali ka shɛŋa la.
en: But even the people of Judah did not obey the commands of the Lord their God. They lived just as the Israelites had.

dag: M bihi, di bi simdi ni ti yurilim nyɛla yɛtɔɣa bee ti ni yɛri shɛm kɔŋko, amaa di simdi ni di nyɛla yurilim maŋli di tuma puuni.
en: Little children, lets not love with words or speech but with action and truth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti gbaai niŋbu, di saha yin kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa, dama yi tiliginsim saha ti miritimi maa.
en: When these things begin to happen, stand up tall and dont be afraid. Know that it is almost time for God to free you.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N suhu kul yɛla Ziɔn sɔŋbu zuɣu, ka n zabiri nyuli ni suhuyiɣisili di zuɣu. .
en: I have longed to help Jerusalem because of my deep love for her people, a love which has made me angry with her enemies.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni din niŋ ma la shiri sɔŋ chɛ ka lahibal suŋ la tuma chaŋ tooni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that all that has happened to me has helped to spread the Good News.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Judanima, Wuhimiya ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Benya kaman ti shɛli din chɛ ka di mahim luri ti zuɣu wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha. Ti nyɛla bɛn zona ti kpɛn ya ni ti tiligi, zaŋmiya ti sɔɣi.
en: They say to the people of Judah, Tell us what to do. Protect us like a tree that casts a cool shadow in the heat of noon, and let us rest in your shade. We are refugees; hide us where no one can find us.

dag: ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ yaɣ din la mi polo dapaɣa, ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ di nyaaŋa wulinluhili polo dapaɣa.
en: five bars for the boards on the other side of the dwelling, and five bars for the boards on the back wall of the dwelling on the west.

dag: N gbilisi tibili ni n wum, amaa ka bɛ bi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ ninvuɣ so bi niŋ tuuba o tuumbiɛri zuɣu yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka n niŋ lala? Bɛ zaa kparila bɛ kpabu kaman wɔhu ni sibigi ʒi n-kpɛri tɔb gɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: I have listened carefully but havent heard a word of truth from them. No one regrets their wrongdoing; no one says, What have I done? Everyone turns to their own course, like a stallion dashing into the thick of battle.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa chaŋ teeku ni.
en: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.

dag: Ka n yɔri lee nyɛla dini? Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: M bi zaŋ n ni mali yolisim so shɛl la tumdi di tuma n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu maa puuni, dama m bi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu tiri niriba ka zaani ba ni bɛ yo shɛli di zuɣu.
en: What pay do I get, then? It is the privilege of preaching the Good News without charging for it, without claiming my rights in my work for the gospel.

dag: Ka chɛchɛbun duhiriba mini wɔribariba daa pahi dol o chaŋ. Niriba maa daa galisiya pam.
en: So there was a large crowd of people with him. There was even a group of soldiers riding in chariots and some on horses.

dag: ka n yi suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam, n kul suhirimi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Im thankful for all of you every time I pray, and its always a prayer full of joy.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni zaŋ n suhuyubu pini mali sara ti a. Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a yuli, dama a nyɛla ŋun viɛla.
en: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord . I will praise your name because you are good.

dag: Bina anahi m-be dunia ni ka nyɛ bɛn pɔra, amaa ka lee mali yɛm pam.
en: There are four things on the earth that are small but very wise:.

dag: Dama ti Duuma ni boli so yi daa nyɛla dabili, o yipa nya yolisim ti Duuma sani. Lala n-nyɛ ŋun pun nyɛ bilichina ka ti Duuma bol o, dilan mi leela Masia dabili.
en: For a slave who has been called by the Lord is the Lord's free person; in the same way a free person who has been called by Christ is his slave.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo n-chaŋ Gɛshur Naa Ammihud bia Talimai sani. Ka Naa Dauda daa kul kumd o bia Amnɔn zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: David cried for his son every day. Absalom ran away to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka o daa kpam Otiniɛl jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na, ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked, What's bothering you.

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Azaria ni Raamia ni Nahamani ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipɛrɛt ni Biɣivai ni Nɛhum ni Baana n-daa doli kuna.
en: They returned with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. This is the list of names and numbers of men from Israel who came back:.

dag: Yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-nyɛ alibarika maa.
en: the blessing if you obey the LORD your Gods commandments that I am giving you right now.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm! Bɛ ku Jɔnatan sɔŋ zoya zuɣu!.
en: Strong men have fallen in the battle. Jonathan is dead on Gilboas hills.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Taai goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses.

dag: Amaa o ni ti ti wun so ŋun guli sansana la jilima. O ni ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni kuɣ viɛla binyara ni pin suma n-ti wun so ŋun nyɛ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm.
en: The northern king will not worship any god, but he will worship power. Power and strength will be his god. His ancestors didnt love power as he does. He will honor the god of power with gold and silver, expensive jewels, and gifts.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti niŋ o yɛda nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: so that everyone who believes in him will have eternal life.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ chɛ tin shɛli din yuli daa du pam ŋɔ bahi? Di nyɛla n suhu ni piɛli tiŋ shɛli zuɣu.
en: The famous city that used to be happy is completely deserted.

dag: Neesim din be bɛ suɣili ni leei zibisim, ka firila din yili bɛ zuɣusaa kpi.
en: The light in their houses will become dark. The lamps next to them will go out.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya ni dabeenzɔbo mini ni sɔhibu, ka niŋmiya lala ni nimmoo kaman yi niŋdi li tirila Masia la.
en: Slaves, obey your human masters with fear and trembling; and do it with a sincere heart, as though you were serving Christ.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu Ijiptinim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ku niriba Ijipti ka va bɛ daazichi chaŋ, ka daai di tanzahi luhi. Biɛrim pam ni ti be Itiɔpia.
en: There will be war in Egypt And great distress in Ethiopia. Many in Egypt will be killed; The country will be plundered And left in ruins.

dag: Bɛ ni bi darigi bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri tibili yomyom zuɣu chɛ ka niriba kul lo bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ tumla tuumbiɛri.
en: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda pahila ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa niŋ yɛda maa zuɣu nya alibarika.
en: Therefore, those who believe are blessed together with Abraham who believed.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so cheechinim zaa ni luri sizuura o lahibal suŋ molo molibu zuɣu la n-dolisir o na.
en: We are sending with Titus the brother who is praised by all the churches. He is praised because of his service to the Good News.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la kalinsi nyaaŋa, Juda Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu pahi dunia yili.
en: Judahs King Amaziah, Jehoashs son, lived fifteen years after the death of Israels King Joash, Jehoahazs son.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ ni o nyaandoliba maa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛtɔɣili maa zuɣu ka bɔhi ba, Yi suhuri miligimi yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, Does this bother you?.

dag: O ni daa ti miri Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani zo shɛli bɛ ni booni Olivi Tihi zol la gbini ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: As he was getting near Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples on ahead.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu na nti yɛli zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo n-chɛ ka niriba maa zaa ŋum bɛ kparima ni niŋ Yawɛ la.
en: The men Moses sent to explore the new land were the ones who came back complaining about him to all the Israelites. They said that the people were not strong enough to enter that land.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino ŋmanila luɣ shɛli nira ni ni zo nti sɔɣi tiligi pɔhim bee sanʒiɛɣu. Bɛ ŋmanila kɔzɔrim din zo n-tiɛli tiŋgban nɛli, ka ŋmani mahim din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tampin titali lɔŋni.
en: If this would happen, the king would be like a shelter to hide from the wind and rain, like streams of water in a dry land, and like the cool shadow of a large rock in a hot land.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yiɣisi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu duu maa ni yi nayili tihi puu ni. Ka Haman daa baŋ ni naa ni darig o tibili yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpalim ni o suh o nyɛvili Napaɣ Ɛsta sani.
en: The king got up in a fury, left the room, and went outside to the palace gardens. Haman could see that the king was determined to punish him for this, so he stayed behind to beg Queen Esther for his life.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ, tiligim amaŋa! A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na.
en: shouted, So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days! If you are God's Son, save yourself and come down from the cross.

dag: Dinzuɣu siɣisimiya yimaŋa Naawuni nuu din mali yiko la ni, ka di chɛ ka o ti duhi ya o ni yu saha shɛli.
en: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.

dag: Di simdi ni yi tumdi din tuhi mini din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: Do what is right and good in the LORDs sight so that things will go well for you and so you will enter and take possession of the wonderful land that the LORD swore to your ancestors.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni zab o niriba zuɣu. O ni zo o daba nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs zaligu maa ni daa moli gili, bɛ daa laɣim paɣisara pam tahi Susa din daa nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni na, ka Ɛsta gba daa be bɛ ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ ba kpɛhila nayili maa puuni nti zaŋ ba niŋ Hɛgai ŋun daa su napaɣiba fukumsi la nuu ni ni o lihiri ba.
en: When the king ordered the search for beautiful women, many were taken to the king's palace in Susa, and Esther was one of them. Hegai was put in charge of all the women.

dag: Nir yi tum din tuhi, di niŋdila wuntizɔriba suhupiɛlli, amaa ka lee tiri tuumbiɛtumdiba suhugarigu.
en: A decision that is fair makes good people happy, but it makes those who are evil very afraid.

dag: Ka Sool daa chɛ Dauda kari doli ka lab kuli ni o ti tuhi Filistianim maa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani zo n-tiligi tampiŋ.
en: Saul stopped going after David and went back to fight the Philistines. That's why the place is called Escape Rock.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, Mani? Mani.
en: The disciples were upset and began to ask him, one after the other, Surely you don't mean me, do you.

dag: Doo yi yih o paɣa, ka paɣ maa yi o yiŋa n-chaŋ ti kuli do so, o ni tooi lan biɛhi o paɣ maa naba? Di tiŋgbani maa ku saɣim pam? Yi tum zina yi mamanim pam sani, ka lan yɛn labi n sanna? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If a man divorces his wife, and after she leaves him marries another, can he return to her again? Wouldnt such an act completely corrupt the land? Yet you have prostituted yourself with many lovers. Would you return to me? declares the LORD.

dag: Ka ti yi nyɛla Naawuni bihi, dindina ti nyɛla o bindiriba. Ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ Naawuni bindiriba, tinim dee min o yi laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka ti min o ti laɣim nya jilima.
en: Since we are his children, we will possess the blessings he keeps for his people, and we will also possess with Christ what God has kept for him; for if we share Christ's suffering, we will also share his glory.

dag: N ni ti wurim yi fɔntinsi din be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka daai yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa luhi.
en: I will destroy the cities in your country. I will pull down all your fortresses.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la, dina n-nyɛ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋla tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ni di leei yi vuhim shee.
en: Remember the command that Moses the LORDs servant gave you: The LORD your God will give you rest and give you this land.

dag: Ka n daa garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ti nasara. Tinim bɛn nyɛ o daba ŋɔ ni piligi mɛbu maa. Amaa yinima nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka tarili bee n-su shɛli bee ka so ti teei yi yɛla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I answered, We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.

dag: So miri ka o ti ta Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa na ti mali sara ti Yawɛ la daɣiri.
en: The priests shall not profane the sacred offerings.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa yɛli, Di daa niŋla daliri ka n chaŋ Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu nti chirigi Sool ka o zaŋ omaŋ dalim o kpani, ka chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba daa kabiri kani o sanna.
en: The young soldier said, I happened to be on Mount Gilboa. I saw Saul leaning on his spear. The Philistine chariots and horse soldiers were coming closer and closer to Saul.

dag: Ka o daa zani paɣ maa zuɣusaa n-tahi dɔro maa zuɣu, ka paɣ maa niŋgbun biisim maa maai, ka o dii yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: He went and stood at her bedside and ordered the fever to leave her. The fever left her, and she got up at once and began to wait on them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a lan zaŋ piɛla ŋun la na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on the other ram.

dag: N ni daa kul tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa saha shɛli maa, ka Bɛnaaya bia Pɛlatia daa kpi. Di saha ka n daa lu tiŋa n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka kuhi pam yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yɛn bahi naala Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: As soon as I finished speaking for God, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died! I fell to the ground. I bowed with my face touching the ground and said, Oh, Lord GOD, you are going to completely destroy all the survivors of Israel.

dag: N daa zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi ni yuri n-kana ti ku ba. N daa ŋme ba luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu. N daa pɔbisi ba mi bahi kaman bɛ ni pɔbisiri kpihiri firila mia buɣim shɛm la.
en: Those who fight against me with their chariots, horses, and armies will be defeated. They will never rise again. They will be destroyed. They will be put out like the flame in a lamp.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ mali suhu yini, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli so yini din ni chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura sahakam bɛmaŋmaŋ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu mini bɛ bihi bɛn yɛn doli bɛ nyaaŋa gba zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: I will give them one heart and one mind so that they may worship me all the days of their lives, for their own good and for the good of their children after them.

dag: Bani so mi daŋ ni: Maadai mini Amiram ni Uɛl.
en: Of the family of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli ŋɔ kul be ti sani, ti ni mali tahima a san la zuɣu.
en: Lord , we worship you, so show your great love for us.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ Gaza, ka Ashikɛlɔn ti zani dabari. Bɛ ni ti taɣi Ashidɔdnim chaŋ wuntaŋ ni, ka wurim Ɛkurɔn.
en: No one will be left in Gaza. Ashkelon will be destroyed. By noon, the people will be forced to leave Ashdod. Ekron will be empty.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu gba daa mali shili ni o yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Dauda ya la, dama o daa yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: Since Joseph belonged to Davids house and family line, he went up from the city of Nazareth in Galilee to Davids city, called Bethlehem, in Judea.

dag: Chɛliya ka zuliya kam mali shili lir o, Miidia nanim mini bɛ gomnanim ni bɛ wulaannima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din be bɛ sulinsi ni zaa.
en: Prepare the nations for war against her, the kings of Media, its governors, all its officials, and all the countries they rule.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Doo ŋun daa neei zom nina ŋɔ daa naan ku faai Lazarɔs gba bahi ka o ku kpi.
en: But some of them said, Jesus healed the eyes of the blind man. Why didnt he help Lazarus and stop him from dying.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali yɛm gari biŋkɔbiri bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ lee be ya.
en: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli din beni nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Masia daa shiri neei kum ni, ka leei bɛn gbihiri kum ni la toondana.
en: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli n zaligunima, ka gbibi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka saɣi li. Di saha bɛ ni ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then they will keep my laws and faithfully obey all my commands. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Nyum amaŋmaŋ kɔduɣu ni kom din yi amaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga puuni na.
en: Drink water from your own cistern, gushing water from your own well.

dag: Amaa ti yi bɔri ni bɛ be ti sani ka ti mini ba nyɛ ninvuɣ yinsi, faashee ka ti dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: But the men will agree to live with us and become one people only if we circumcise every male just as they do.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yinim Lɛvinima, wummiya, Malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, ka maliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka yihiya neen daɣiri din bi be kasi luɣ kasi shee la.
en: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ŋunkam yuli bi sabi nyɛvili litaafi la ni gba bahi buɣim teeku maa ni.
en: Then anyone whose name wasnt found written in the scroll of life was thrown into the fiery lake.

dag: ka Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Eliab son of Helon was in command of the tribe of Zebulun.

dag: A mini Vɛdannim ni Javannim bɛn yi Uzal na daa niŋdila a nɛma daabiligu. Bɛ daa lan zaŋdila kuriti mini kasia ni tulaale na ti taɣiri a daguya.
en: Vedan and Javan from the region of Uzal traded with you. They exchanged wrought iron, cinnamon, and spices for your wares.

dag: Fɔŋ kara din daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin daŋ niriba tinsi n-nyɛ: Jɛriko mini Bɛtihɔgila ni Ɛmɛkɛziiz.
en: The cities belonging to the families of the tribe of Benjamin were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba.
en: You will know these false people by what they do.

dag: Miri ka a doli niriba maa ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa maa, a mi di zɔri bɛ ni zɔri shɛli dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: Dont think there is a plan against you just because the people say there is. Dont be afraid of what they fear. Dont let them frighten you.

dag: Yawɛ, a nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You have so much compassion, LORD— make me live again, according to your rules.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku wuntizɔr shɛba dunia ŋɔ ni, Ɛbɛl ŋun daa bi tum taal shɛl la kubu saha zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria Bɛrakia bi so yi ni daa ku Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la taali ʒili ya.
en: As a result, the punishment for the murder of all innocent people will fall on you, from the murder of innocent Abel to the murder of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the Temple and the altar.

dag: Dama o shiri timla Babilɔn na ti yɛli ti, Di ni yuui pam. Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira. .
en: He must be stopped because he told the people in Babylonia that they would be prisoners there a long time and should build houses, settle down, plant gardens, and eat what they grow.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee be sagbana ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ? Ŋuni n-leei be alizanda ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ?.
en: Is there any in the sky who could compare to the LORD? Who among the gods is equal to the LORD?.

dag: Amaa o bihi yi ti zaɣisi n zaligu, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali sara maligu bimbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla. Malimiya li zaɣ mɔɣu.
en: Use acacia wood and build an altar. The altar should be square. It must be cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high.

dag: Ti ni daa ti yiɣisi nimaani ti daa dolila so gɔŋ ti paai Rijium n-daa yi biɛɣu ka nudirigu polo pɔhim din daa sɔŋ ti pam yiɣisi ʒiɛra. Di daba ayi dali ka ti daa paai Putioli.
en: We came to the city of Rhegium. The next day a wind began to blow from the southwest, so we were able to leave. A day later we came to the city of Puteoli.

dag: ka Jɛza daŋ niriba nyɛ Jɛzanima; ka Shilɛm daŋ niriba nyɛ Shilɛmnima.
en: from Jezer, the Jezerite clan; from Shillem, the Shillemite clan.

dag: Fɔntinsi zaa din daa be tintan ni mini Giliad zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ni Salɛka ni Ɛdirɛi, fɔn shɛŋa din daa be Bashan Naa Ogi nam sulinsi ni la.
en: We took all the territory of King Og of Bashan: the cities on the plateau, the regions of Gilead and of Bashan, as far east as the towns of Salecah and Edrei. .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sairus ŋun nyɛ o ni pii so la, N niŋ a yiko ni a tuhi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka fa nanim yaa. N ni yooi dunoli kam ti a, ka bɛ ku kpari duno shɛli.
en: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.

dag: Di saɣiya Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm maa. Dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Kamiyana ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ma din ni chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino tooi di omaŋmaŋ tiwala min o fiig tia wala, ka nyu omaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga ni kom.
en: Dont listen to Hezekiah! This is what the king of Assyria says: Come out here and show me that you want peace. Then you will all be free to have grapes from your own vines, figs from your own trees, and water from your own well.

dag: Bɛ daa tila Pɛriʒia gomnanti tuma zuɣulaannim birapu ni bɛ gbarigi bɛ ni daa lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus ʒiɛman ni zaŋ hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work.

dag: A nyɛla puu ni kɔbil nini mini nyɛvili kom kɔbiliga ni kulibɔna kom din zɔri yiri Lɛbanɔn na.
en: You are like a garden fountain— a well of fresh water— flowing down from the mountains of Lebanon.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Use seventy-five pounds of pure gold to make the lampstand and all this equipment.

dag: Bɛ ni so bi labina ni o ti paɣi Naawuni shee tinzun nir ŋɔ kɔŋko.
en: This man is not even one of our people. Is he the only one who came back to give praise to God.

dag: N dabeenzɔbo puuni n daa yɛliya, Bɛ kari ma a sani tahi katiŋa. Amaa ka n daa kuhi niŋ a bɔri sɔŋsim, ka a daa wum n ni kuhi niŋ a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu maa.
en: I was afraid and thought that he had driven me out of his presence. But he heard my cry, when I called to him for help.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋ zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim la tiŋgbana tin ya ni di leei yi dini m-pahi n ni pun nyaŋ zuliya shɛba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku wulinluhili polo la.
en: Look. Ive allotted to you these remaining nations as a legacy for your tribes, along with all the nations I have destroyed. They stretch from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, n yi na kul yihiri gunibu yɛla waazu, di chaŋ wula ka n na kul nyari nahiŋgu? Di yi nyɛ lala, dapulli waazu yihibu yɛla din nyɛ kuɣituurili la naan vuui.
en: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.

dag: Liya ni daa nya ka o bi lan dɔɣiri maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Yaakubu ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: When Leah realized she could not have any more children, she let Jacob marry her servant Zilpah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛlnim zuliya dunoli kam dɔɣirikpamba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: Then Moses said to Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ bia maa nti ti o ma; ka o zaŋ o ʒil o naba zuɣu n-gbib o hal ti paai wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: So he picked up the boy and brought him to his mother. The boy sat on her lap until noon. Then he died.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ lee ŋmanila bɔ?.
en: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?.

dag: ni Dɛbir naa ni Gɛda naa.
en: Debir, Geder.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ti dimnima, ka ti dimnim maa di ti nɛma.
en: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.

dag: Dama di daa bi ŋari m ma bidɔɣirisurigu noli, din ni chɛ ka m bi nya wahala.
en: because it let me be born into a world of trouble.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who dont have a problem accepting me.

dag: Nanim ŋɔ zaa daa naala noli n-laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi ti do Siddim vinvamli ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Teeku Kpiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: All these kings joined their armies in the Valley of Siddim.

dag: Saɣisigu kpɛri ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima pam n-gari bɛ fiɛbi jɛrigu fiɛbiga bukɔbiga.
en: An intelligent person learns more from one rebuke than a fool learns from being beaten a hundred times.

dag: Ŋmahimiya gɔpiɛliga daantalis anu n-niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi n-gɔhigɔhi pateesa maa n-zaŋ li yili daantalisi maa, ka zaŋ daanya mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba anu.
en: Make five acacia-wood posts for the screen. Cover the posts with gold. Their hooks should be gold. Cast five copper bases for the posts.

dag: Ka daa siɣis omaŋ doli nɔdeebo soli ti paai kum, hal kum din nyɛ dapulli zuɣu kum gba.
en: he humbled himself by being fully obedient to God, even when that caused his death—death on a cross.

dag: Yawɛ, guli n noli, gbibi n naŋgbampiba.
en: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa n-doli tuumba maa wuhibu, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni n-wuhiri bɛ dolintabitali ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ laɣimdi mini bɛ wunsuhigu ni.
en: They spent their time in learning from the apostles, taking part in the fellowship, and sharing in the fellowship meals and the prayers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi tin tariga nti siɣi wain adaka maa puuni nɔra, ka ʒim daa zɔri yiri wain tɔɣiri adaka maa ni na n-zo n-chaŋ hal ti paai kaman kilomita kɔbisita wɔɣilim tariga, ka di zilim mi paai wɔhu nyɔɣu tariga.
en: Then the winepress was trampled outside the city, and the blood came out of the winepress as high as the horses bridles for almost two hundred miles.

dag: Amaa bomiya nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli yi zuliyanim maa zaa sani n-leeg o biɛhigu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani la.
en: Instead, you must search for the location the LORD your God will select from all your tribes to put his name there, as his residence, and you must go there.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Sool ni be luɣ shɛli maa ti nya o ni do luɣ shɛli polo, ka Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi zuɣulan la do o sani. Sool daa dola suɣa maa sunsuuni, ka tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: He went at once and located the exact place where Saul and Abner son of Ner, commander of Saul's army, slept. Saul slept inside the camp, and his men camped around him.

dag: O ʒila o nam ʒiishee, ka lihirina n-nyari ninsalinim zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: From his dwelling place God observes all who live on earth.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni maa biɛɣu pinaanahi dali, yin ti puhimiya Yaɣigari chuɣu, ka sokam ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: Your Passover will be on the fourteenth day of the first month. Unleavened bread will be eaten during the seven days of the festival.

dag: M banima, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun mi ŋun daa be piligu ni ha la zuɣu. Nachimbihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun nyaŋ Tuumbiɛrilan la zuɣu.
en: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who has existed from the beginning. I write to you, young people, because you have defeated the Evil One.

dag: M mi yi wahala dibu ni yi fara yɛla, amaa yinima n-lee nyɛ azichinima. Ka lan mi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ya, ka yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianim la gba yɛla. Bɛ pala Yɛhudianima, amaa bɛ nyɛla Sintani jɛmdiba.
en: I know your troubles, and I know that you are poor, but really you are rich! I know the insults you have suffered from people who say they are Jews. But they are not true Jews. They are a group that belongs to Satan.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bia maa kuhigu maa; ka Naawuni malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Haga m-bɔh o, Haga, bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama Naawuni wum bia maa kuhigu o ni be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.

dag: Ka ŋun yuri Naawuni daalibarika yi be yili maa ni, yi daalibarika puhigu maa ni kpalim o ni; amaa lala nir yi ka yili maa ni, di ni lab yi sanna yaha.
en: If the people living there love peace, your blessing of peace will stay with them. But if not, your blessing of peace will come back to you.

dag: Adam zuliya yuya n-sab kpe ŋɔ. Naawuni ni daa nam ninsala, o daa nam o ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa.
en: This is the list of the descendants of Adam. When God created human beings, he made them like himself.

dag: Jɛrigu n-zaɣisir o ba ni wuh o shɛli, amaa ŋunkam deeri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun mali yɛm.
en: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.

dag: N niriba ŋmanila wubiga ka tɔra laɣim gili ni bɛ di o. Cham ti laɣim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa, n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti ŋub o.
en: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni paai Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ni ti yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, ka bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni suhugarigu naai.
en: Then let those ransomed by the LORD return and come to Zion with singing and with everlasting joy upon their heads. Let happiness and joy overwhelm them; let grief and groaning flee.

dag: Nyama, ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa kabina ni bɛ ti nya Yisa; bɛ ni daa ti nya o, ka bɛ balim o ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu. Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! .
en: Now your temple will be deserted. You won't see me again until the time when you say, Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.

dag: N ni gɔŋ Juda kaman tɔb la, ka zaŋ Ifriim mi leei di piɛma. N ni zaŋ Ziɔn leei takɔbi n-tuhi Giriisinima.
en: I will use Judah like a soldier's bow and Israel like the arrows. I will use the men of Zion like a sword, to fight the men of Greece.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka di zaa laɣim bi, ka chɛbu saha ti paai ka n yɛli bɛn yɛn chɛ li: Daŋmiya piriŋkpana la chɛbu n-laɣim li lo bɔba n-nyo buɣim, amaa ka chɛ alikama la zaa n-laɣimna nti niŋ n kambɔŋ ni. .
en: Leave the weeds alone until harvest time. Then I'll tell my workers to gather the weeds and tie them up and burn them. But I'll order them to store the wheat in my barn.

dag: N ku zaŋ binshɛli naɣila n nachimba ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli ma chaŋ la ni pun di shɛl la; amaa naɣ chɛ ka Anɛr mini Ɛshikol ni Mamri n-yihi bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli di ni.
en: Let my share be the food that my men have eaten. But Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre went with me, so give them their share of what we brought back.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛm, Nyin Ziɔn, di zɔri dabiɛm; di chɛ ka a baɣiri ni cheei kom.
en: On that day, it will be said to Jerusalem: Dont fear, Zion. Dont let your hands fall.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul tam luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani zuɣu, n ni zaŋ li tin ya kaman n ni daa pun lo Musa alikauli yɛli shɛm la.
en: As I told Moses, I have given you and all my people the entire land that you will be marching over.

dag: Doli n ni zal a shɛm, ka be. Gbibi n ni wuhir a shɛli kaman a nimbil biɛlim la.
en: Keep my commands and live, and my instruction like the pupil of your eye.

dag: Lala ka di simdi ni yidaannim gba yuri bɛ paɣiba kaman bɛ ni yuri bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛm la. Ŋun yur o paɣa yurila omaŋa.
en: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.

dag: Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli vuri yi Jɛrusalɛm na; ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani sɔhira. Amaa Yawɛ sani n-nyɛ o niriba sɔɣibu shee; Izraɛlnim sɔɣibu viɛlli shee m-bala.
en: The Lord roars from Mount Zion; his voice thunders from Jerusalem; earth and sky tremble. But he will defend his people.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ninsal kpi n-do mɔɣu ni ka yi bi mi ŋun ku o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ka yi su li maa ni.
en: If a corpse is found on the ground the LORD your God is giving you to possess, lying in a field, and the identity of the killer is unknown.

dag: Di yi nyɛla piɛlaa sara, yin bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ni pirigili ŋmir li;.
en: For a ram you will offer a grain offering of two-tenths of a measure of fine flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil.

dag: Di maan kahigi yɛla ŋɔ wuhi ni maligumaani so ni ti yiɣisi ŋmani Mɛlikizɛdɛk.
en: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.

dag: N ni fa a ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi, ka tilig a ninvuɣ galima gbaabu ni.
en: I will rescue you from the hand of the wicked; I will redeem you from the grasp of the violent.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya ka sapashinnim ʒiya tɔri jina, ka o yɛli, Sapashini, m malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Ti ni ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa? Ka o yɛli Jɛhu, N dana, nyini ka n yɛri maa.
en: He came in, and the military commanders were sitting right there. He said, Commander, I have a word for you. For which one of us? Jehu asked. The young prophet said, For you, Commander.

dag: dama m bipolitali saha ka n daa wums o kaman o ba la, ka kul sɔŋdi pakoli sahakam.
en: All my life I have been like a father to orphans and have taken care of widows.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti lan labisi Mɔabnim daazichi ti ba dabisa shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni. Mɔabnim tibidarigibo tariga m-bala.
en: But in days to come the Lord will make Moab prosperous again. All of this is what the Lord has said will happen to Moab.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ ŋarima maa na ti zali duli, bɛ daa chɛla bɛ binshɛɣukam maa zaa ka doli Yisa.
en: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa gbahi bɛ mabihi Judanim maa niriba tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣiba mini bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi, ka di nɛma pam n-zaŋ kuli Samaria.
en: The Israelite army captured , of their own relatives living in Judah. They took women, children, and many valuable things from Judah and carried them back to Samaria.

dag: Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ zali ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nima, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛba ti paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Write these things for future generations, so that they will praise the Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ bulah ayi maa ti zali Naawuni tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni chɛ ka bɛ teei yi tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka yi biriginsim yi palo, ka yi daalahichi yi palo yi tuuni kam puuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ teei yi yɛla la zuɣu, bɛ ni gbahi ya bɛ nuhi ni.
en: This then is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: Your sins are exposed. Everyone knows how guilty you are. You show your sins in your every action. You stand condemned, and I will hand you over to your enemies.

dag: Dama bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛliya, Ti mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi galisiya pam. Di simdi ni ti nya chi din ni chɛ ka ti di n-tiligi.
en: Some said, We have large families, we need grain to keep us alive.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yuri so, dilan zuɣu ni ka o kpahira kaman doo ni kpahir o ni yur o bidib so zuɣu ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord corrects the one he loves, just as a father corrects a child he cares about.

dag: dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. Nyini n-nyɛ binwɔɣinli shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari a dimnima.
en: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu nti be nimaani.
en: Then everyone went home, but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

dag: A zaŋla neesim ye kaman binyɛrigu la. A teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman tanti la.
en: you cover yourself with light. You have spread out the heavens like a tent.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima n-ku ba pam; dindali maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ka bɛ daa ku.
en: Battles were being fought all over the forest, and David's soldiers were winning. Twenty thousand soldiers were killed that day, and more of them died from the dangers of the forest than from the fighting itself.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nambɔzɔbo kpe Ashpɛnaz suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus answered, I have just one question to ask you. If you answer it, I will tell you where I got the right to do these things.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛba yo wuntizɔriba talima samli, ka zaŋ bɛn ka yɛda yo bɛn biɛhigu tuhi samli.
en: The wicked bring on themselves the suffering they try to cause good people.

dag: Dama niriba maa kaya nyɛla ʒiri kaya. Bɛ ŋmaala mɔɣu ni tia, ka ŋun kpɛri binyara zaŋ lɛbil kpe li.
en: The religion of these people is worthless. A tree is cut down in the forest; it is carved by the tools of the woodworker.

dag: Biɛɣu pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ niŋ tim maa ʒe o niŋgbuŋ maa, dama bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi dabisi shɛŋa n-tumdi di tuma m-bala. Ka Ijiptinim daa zaŋ biɛɣ pisopɔin kum o kuli.
en: It took forty days, the normal time for embalming. The Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

dag: Ka wula ka o yi darigi tinim bɛn be ti nyɛvil ni ŋɔ tibili ti daalahichi zuɣu ka ti fabinda?.
en: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.

dag: Di saha zuliya kam ni ti booni ya la suhupiɛllinima, dama nyaɣisim ni ti be yi tiŋgban ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People from other nations will be good to you. You will have a wonderful country. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim polo, bɛ saɣisiri ti ka ti luri ba sizuura. Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni ti deei ti Ba Naawuni saɣisigu ka be.
en: Whats more, we had human parents who disciplined us, and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of spirits and live?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni ti chɛ o niriba bahi hal ka paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi maa ti dɔɣi. Di saha Izraɛlnim bɛn na kpalim be dabitim ni la ni ti labi bɛ mabihi sanna.
en: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi binfalafala din daa be chɛrubinim zuɣuri zuɣusaa la, ka binshɛli daa be bɛ zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani safaya kuɣili, di kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee.
en: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti ŋma bilichiisi n-nyo li buɣim viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka bɛ daa ŋma bilichiisi maa ka di be kaman kuɣa la, ka zaŋ kootaali mi n-leei tandi.
en: They said to each other, Come, lets make bricks and bake them hard. They used bricks for stones and asphalt for mortar.

dag: Ka di yi pa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni nini ku tiɣi nira. Dama ŋunkam chaŋ Naawuni sani, di niŋ kamaata ni o niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni beni ka deeri bɛn bɔr o ni bɛ suhuri zaa suhigu.
en: No one can please God without faith, for whoever comes to God must have faith that God exists and rewards those who seek him.

dag: Yawɛ, di zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛb ŋɔ taali; ka di chɛ ka ŋun ka taali ŋɔ ʒim yihibu taali be a niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Di saha ka bɛ ni yi ʒim yihibu taali ni.
en: LORD, please forgive your people Israel, whom you saved. Dont put the guilt of innocent bloodshed on your people Israel. Then the bloodguilt will be forgiven them.

dag: Ka Shɛshibaza daa kana nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ; ka mɛbu maa tuma kul tumdi di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka di na lee bi me n-naai.
en: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira gba daa bela Ɛnɔn tin shɛli din miri Salim la m-baptaiziri niriba, dama kom daa be nimaani pam; ka niriba chani o sani ka o ti baptaiziri ba.
en: John had not yet been put in jail. He was at Aenon near Salim, where there was a lot of water, and people were coming there for John to baptize them.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla anzinfa mali dapaɣa pisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu bini pihinahi. Dapaɣili kam daa malila di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka di dashɛbira ayi shɛb di ni.
en: They made forty silver bases under the twenty boards, with two bases under the first board for its two pegs, two bases under the next board for its two pegs, and so on.

dag: ka kuhi yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zan a naba zuɣu! Ka gbarigu maa dii vaai yiɣisi zani gbaai chandi.
en: and shouted, Stand up! The man jumped up and started walking around.

dag: Bɛ kul niŋdila nirilim sahakam, ka zaŋdi bɛ liɣiri paŋdi niriba, ka alibarika be bɛ bihi ni.
en: At all times they give freely and lend to others, and their children are a blessing.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ni be shɛli, naŋgbankpeeni gba bela nimaani. Ka jilima tibu yi ka shɛli, filiŋ bela nimaani.
en: Wrongdoing leads to shame and disgrace.

dag: N yi yihi ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa na, n ni ti deei ya kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl la, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira yi sani yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa ninni.
en: Then I will be pleased with the sweet smell of your sacrifices. That will happen when I bring you back. I scattered you among many nations, but I will gather you together and make you my special people again. And all the nations will see it.

dag: Daba ni lihiri ŋun su ba ninni shɛm la, dab paɣa ni lihiri ŋun su o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ti kul lihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ninni, hal ni o ti zo ti nambɔɣu.
en: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ yi nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ, ka yi zaa yinoyino nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: All of you together are the body of Christ. Each one of you is a part of that body.

dag: Bɛ nuhi zaa ni ti gbarigi, ka bɛ duna ni chɔɣisi.
en: They will be too tired and sad to raise their arms. Their legs will be like water.

dag: A ni tooi lo o mihi n-chɛ ka o ko a? Bee o ni tooi yɛbisi a kɔbu ti a ka a biri?.
en: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni Yisa nyɛla Naa Hɛrɔd sulinsi ni nira, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Hɛrɔd sani, dama Naa Hɛrɔd gba daa kala Jɛrusalɛm na di saha maa.
en: When he learned that Jesus was from the region ruled by Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

dag: Juda, a mabihi ni ti paɣ a. A ni ti zaŋ a nuu gbaag a dimnim nyiŋgoya ni. A ba bidibisi ni ti damd a tooni.
en: Judah, your brothers will praise you. You will defeat your enemies. Your brothers will bow down to you.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa me Mɔabnim buɣili Chɛmɔshi din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Molɛk din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee zali Jɛrusalɛm wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu.
