en: Solomon built shrines on a hill east of Jerusalem to worship Chemosh the disgusting god of Moab, and Molech the disgusting god of Ammon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ijipti do so n-fa ti piɛguliba maa nuu ni bahi hal ka ŋɔŋ kom ti ti ka ti nyuhi ti biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: The girls answered, The shepherds chased us away, but an Egyptian rescued us. He got water for us and gave it to our animals.

dag: ni o ni daa tum Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Ijipti la;.
en: and his miracles. You saw what he did to the king of Egypt and to his entire country.

dag: O ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa pa omaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka di ti yɛn yina. O ni ti saɣim binyara saɣindi biɛɣu, ka ni ti di nasara o ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni. O ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yiko mini wuntizɔriba zaa yoli.
en: At the height of his power, he will wreak unbelievable destructions. He will succeed in all he does. He will destroy both the mighty and the people of the holy ones.

dag: dindina yi ni tooi saɣim n ni daa lo n dabili Dauda alikauli shɛl la gba din ni chɛ ka o ku lan mali bidibiga ŋun ni ʒin o nam ʒiishee mini n ni daa lo n tumtumdiba Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la.
en: only then could my covenant with my servant David and my covenant with the levitical priests who minister before me be broken; only then would David no longer have a descendant to rule on his throne.

dag: Dama bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka bɛ yihi ya yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya tahi katiŋa. N ni kari ya bahi ka yi ti kpi.
en: They are lying to you, and their lies will lead to banishment from your land. I will drive you out, and you will perish.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niriba chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Nɛtania bia Ishimail. Bɛ daa ti paag o la Gibiɔn been tital la ni.
en: So they and their troops chased Ishmael and caught up with him at the large pit at Gibeon.

dag: ti nyari alaka, amaa ti na ʒi n-kpalim ti ko; bɛ ŋmɛri ti luhira, amaa ti bi kpira.
en: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.

dag: Yinim bɛn kpiri kum pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti tiɣi. Yinim bɛn kumdi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti la.
en: Happy are you who hunger now, because you will be satisfied. Happy are you who weep now, because you will laugh.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa garigi yɛli ba ni Pool be duu Siizaria, ka omaŋmaŋ mi lɔri nia ni o lab nimaani daba ayi sunsuuni.
en: But Festus responded by keeping Paul in Caesarea, since he was to return there very soon himself.

dag: n-wurim di bimbina la, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma buɣili Ashɛrim min o binnana la zaa m-baɣisibaɣisi li ka di be kaman taŋkpa zim, ka daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbina din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Everywhere in the northern kingdom of Israel, Josiah tore down pagan altars and Asherah poles; he crushed idols to dust and smashed incense altars. Then Josiah went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka na so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam ni ti yiɣisi n-di nam su o nam sulinsi ni yiko, ka tumd o ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then a very strong and powerful king will come who will rule with much power. He will do anything he wants.

dag: N shia, Neema! Mɔɣilo mini goonje, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake the dawn itself!.

dag: Ka doo maa daa gbibi binshɛli din buɣisiri la o nuu ni n-kpa wulimpuhili polo nti buɣisi mita kɔbisinu tariga, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ napɔŋkpuɣila tariga.
en: The man walked east, then took out his measuring stick and measured meters downstream. He told me to wade through the stream there, and the water came up to my ankles.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi jilima yi tab sani, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu kun ya ŋmaai yi yuma jia.
en: If you do, others will get the honor you should have had. Some stranger will get everything you worked years to get.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Niriba maa zaŋ nɛma maa na pam n-gari ti ni bɔri shɛm tariga ni ti zaŋ tum Yawɛ ni zali ti ni ti tum tuun shɛli maa.
en: and said, Moses, there is already more than we need for what the Lord has assigned us to do.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura; dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura binshɛli bi poori ba.
en: The Lord s holy people should fear and respect him. Those who respect him will always have what they need.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, naa kumdimi ka fabindi Absalom zuɣu.
en: Joab was told that King David was weeping and mourning for Absalom.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, want you to learn a lesson.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-su zuɣusaa ni zuɣusaa mi zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa;.
en: Clearly, the LORD owns the sky, the highest heavens, the earth, and everything in it.

dag: Yi yi bi nya saɣisigu kaman o bihi zaa, dindina di wuhiri ni yi pala o bihi alali, amaa yi nyɛla kaman dagɔr bihi.
en: But if you dont experience discipline, which happens to all children, then you are illegitimate and not real sons and daughters.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Bihi laamba di wain tiwala din miha, ka bihi nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: People will not use this saying anymore: The parents ate the sour grapes, but the children got the sour taste.

dag: O min o yiŋ zaa ni daa deei kom baptaizibu nyaaŋa ka o balim ti yɛli, Yi yi zahim ma nya ka n nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim n suhu ni ni ti Duuma, yin kamiyana ti be n yiŋa. Ka o ni daa balim ti ni nimmoo zuɣu chɛ ka ti niŋ lala.
en: After she and the people of her house had been baptized, she invited us, Come and stay in my house if you have decided that I am a true believer in the Lord. And she persuaded us to go.

dag: Dabili yi di nam ni jɛrigu yi di nti yaɣi.
en: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much.

dag: O pun yɛli nyin daadam binshɛli din viɛla. Ka bɔ ka Yawɛ lee bɔri ni a niŋ? O bɔri ni a doli din tuhi, ka yuri nirilim niŋbu, ka jɛmd a Naawuni ni siɣisimaŋtali.
en: Human, the Lord has told you what goodness is. This is what he wants from you: Be fair to other people. Love kindness and loyalty, and humbly obey your God.

dag: n-daa yi gbala maa ni na Yisa kum ni neebu nyaaŋa n-chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni tiŋ kasi la puuni, ka niriba pam daa nya ba ni bɛ nini.
en: After Jesus resurrection they came out of their graves and went into the holy city where they appeared to many people.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampima bɔɣi yɔɣu sunsuuni, ka o daa ti ba kom pam din be kaman teeku kɔbulli ni kom la, ka bɛ nyu.
en: He split rocks open in the desert and gave them water from the depths.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Bɛnijaakan maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hɔrihagidigad.
en: They marched from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.

dag: Takɔriti kulis ata daa beni. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: There were three rows of windows across from each other on the side walls.

dag: O miri ka o di biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dari tɔhi biŋkɔb so, ka di kpɛh o daɣiri ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: He must not eat an animal that has died naturally or that was killed by another animal, becoming unclean by doing so; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali bɛ ni yɛn nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: For burning offerings, he made an altar out of acacia wood. It was square, 1⁄2 feet long and 1⁄2 feet wide, and it was 1⁄2 feet high.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla duno shɛli din labiri wulinluhili polo la mini Shalɛkɛt duno shɛli din be pal shɛli din be kunkuni zuɣu palli polo n-ti Shupim mini Hɔsa. Ka bɛ daa gul li ka tiri taba.
en: Hosah was assigned the West Gate, that is, the chamber gate on the upper road. The guards had the same task.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka o yɛl o, N dana, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: What do you want me to do for you? He said, Lord, I want to see again.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini maligumaana Abiata n-leeg o saawaranima, ka bɛ dol o n-sɔŋd o.
en: He took advice from Joab, Zeruiahs son, and from the priest Abiathar. They assisted Adonijah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi nya filiŋ, ka niriba zaa ʒiɛm ya ka filim ya yi ni bi doli n soya, amaa ka chɛ ka niriba gaŋbu be yi wuhibu ni la zuɣu.
en: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike.

dag: Jɛzibɛl daa sabimi yɛli gbana maa ni, Molimiya molo ni sokam lom noli, ka chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna ka yi ti chɛ ka Nabɔt ʒini jilima ʒiishee.
en: This is what she wrote in the letters: Announce a fast and place Naboth at the head of the people.

dag: Miri ka a di zunyuŋnim bindira bee n-chɛ ka a kɔre kpe di ni di nyaɣisim zuɣu;.
en: Dont eat with selfish people. Control any desire you have for their finest foods.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli, Kalidianim laɣimla tab ʒiibuta zuɣu n-kana ti lu laakumnim la zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn guli ba maa, ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: That messenger was still speaking when another one came in and said, The Chaldeans sent out three raiding parties that attacked us and took the camels! They killed the other servants. I am the only one who escaped to come and tell you the news.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ bimbira pam chaŋ yi puri ni, amaa ka ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, dama toli ni ti ŋub di zaa.
en: Your fields will produce plenty of grain. But your harvest will be small, because the locusts will eat your harvest.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa, ka Aduna daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa bahi Firawuna min o kpamba tooni, ka di leei wahu.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the LORD commanded. Aaron threw down his shepherds rod in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it turned into a cobra.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi bi yuri ka tum birigi n ni zali ya ni yi di tum shɛl la n-tum alahichi.
en: Tell the Israelites this: A person might sin without meaning to and do something that the Lord commanded should not be done. For example:.

dag: Sool ni daa nya Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o suhu fuŋ pam.
en: Saul took one look at the Philistine army and started shaking with fear.

dag: O daa shiri kpila sokam zaa zuɣu ni bɛn mali nyɛviya la di lan be bɛmaŋmaŋ yubu tumbu zuɣu, amaa ka ni bela ŋun daa kpi bɛ zuɣu ka lan neei maa yubu tumbu zuɣu.
en: He died for all so that those who live would not continue to live for themselves. He died for them and was raised from death so that they would live for him.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka maligumaaniba daa kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka Kasi maa buɣi.
en: When all the leaders had gathered, the priests lifted the Covenant Box.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋuni n-lee ku zo a ka tibig a yuli? Dama a ko m-be kasi. Zuliya kam ni kana nti jɛm a, dama a wuntia saria karibu yi palo.
en: Who wont fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? You alone are holy. All nations will come and fall down in worship before you, for your acts of justice have been revealed.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nyɛla yino, ka o mi bi bɔri sandaantimda ŋun Naawuni yino maa zuɣu.
en: But when God gave the promise, there was no mediator, because a mediator is not needed when there is only one side, and God is one.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi tihi yɛla. Sida tihi din be Lɛbanɔn zaŋ tabili taaŋkɔro tuturi din bili tam goma zuɣu yɛla; ka daa lan tɔɣisi biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi ni nyɛbisi ni zahim gba yɛla.
en: Solomon also knew very much about nature. He taught about many different kinds of plants—everything from the great cedar trees of Lebanon to the little vines that grow out of the walls. He also taught about animals, birds, and snakes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du n-kpe tiŋ maa ni. Bɛ ni daa kpɛri tiŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya Samuɛl ka o yiri ni o chaŋ sara maligu daboli maa zuɣu.
en: So Saul and the boy went up to the town, and as they entered it, suddenly Samuel came toward them on his way up to the shrine.

dag: Lihimiya n nuhi mini n naba, ka baŋ ni mani m-bala. Tabisimiya ma nya, dama alizini ka niŋgbuŋ mini kɔba ka n ni mali shɛm ŋɔ. .
en: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.

dag: Hal bihi siŋdi ma mi, n yi yiɣisi, bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa jɛndiri ma.
en: Even little children make fun of me. When I get up, they say bad things about me.

dag: bɛ daa kul darimi gindi tinsi, ka dari gindi nam sulinsi tiŋgbana.
en: They wandered from country to country, from one kingdom to another.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana. O chihi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo ti mi shɛŋa.
en: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.

dag: Ka Amiram daa kpuɣ o piriba Jokɛbɛd n-zaŋ o dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa. Amiram daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Amram lived years. He married his fathers sister, Jochebed. Amram and Jochebed gave birth to Aaron and Moses.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋun bi niŋ yɛda bee ŋun ka yi kalinli ni kpɛna, yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni chih o suhu, ka yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni lan vih o.
en: But suppose you are all prophesying and someone comes in who does not believe or who is without understanding. Their sin will be shown to them, and they will be judged by everything you say.

dag: Bɛ daa yi ŋmɛrila mɔɣilɔnim jɛmd a, amaa pumpɔŋɔ nyini m-be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ŋɔ. Binneen yiɣira bɛn ŋmani zunzuya n-nyɛ a bindoo, ka zunzuya nyɛ a chinchini ka a zaŋ pili.
en: Your pride has been sent down to Sheol. The music from your harps announces the coming of your proud spirit. Maggots will be the bed you lie on, and other worms will cover your body like a blanket.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ galima be n niriba maa ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn fari bɛ tab nɛma. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana kaman nooŋgbahiriba la n-gbahiri ninsalinima.
en: Criminals are found among my people; they set traps to catch people, like hunters lying in wait.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dee lala, ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi yil yidan maa.
en: When they received it, they grumbled against the landowner.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n suhira.
en: To you, O Lord , I offer my prayer;.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nyɛla n tizɔdoo ŋun daa mɔɣi m ma bihili! N yi di nya a samban ni, n naan mɔɣis a noli ka so ku galim ma.
en: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.

dag: Nyama, m bi ʒe yi nyaaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni nyo yi chɛchɛbunsi buɣim ka di gbili nyɔhi, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gbuɣim pola. N ni ti mɔŋ ya bindirigu, ka so ti ku lan wum yi tuumba kukoya.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.

dag: Sulemaana daa yi nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuuni kam puuni.
en: Every year King Solomon received over twenty-five tons of gold.

dag: Ka Matania mini Bakibukia ni Obadia ni Mɛshulam ni Talimɔn ni Akub bɛn nyɛ dunɔguliba la daa ʒe n-guli nɛma du shɛŋa din daa be dunɔdaya shee la.
en: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, and Obadiah. Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers standing guard by the storerooms of the gates.

dag: Ka di pala Adam ka Sintani daa yɔhim, amaa Awa ka o daa yɔhim ka o leei ŋun saɣim Naawuni zaligu.
en: Adam wasnt deceived, but rather his wife became the one who stepped over the line because she was completely deceived.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, n pun naai Iso zuliya zaa, ka yihi ba bɛ sɔɣisili shee, ka bɛ ku tooi lan sɔɣi. O bihi min o dɔɣiriba ni o ʒiʒiinitaba bahi yoli ka so lan kani.
en: But I will take everything from Esau. I will find all his hiding places. He will not be able to hide from me. His children, relatives, and neighbors will all die.

dag: Di simdi ni a baŋ a biŋkɔbbaligu daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka lihi a niɣi viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: You should take good care of your sheep and goats.

dag: Dauda daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi yaha, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Ibihar mini Ɛlishama ni Ɛlifɛlɛt.
en: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

dag: Wuhim ma a nirilim shihirili, ka lala chɛ ka bɛnkam je ma la nya li ka di vi; dama nyini Yawɛ pun sɔŋ ma ka maai n suhu.
en: Show me a sign of your goodness so that those who hate me will see it and be put to shame— show a sign that you, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

dag: Ti daa wum bɛ yɛla ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisimi, ka biɛrim pam mali ti, ka biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: Then the people said, Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli nyin Baruk shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: that the Lord , the God of Israel, had said, Baruch.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu.
en: the Covenant Box containing the stone tablets, its poles, and its lid;.

dag: Amaa ka o paɣ yɛl o, Naawuni yi di bɔri ti kubu, o naan ku deei ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti o ŋɔ ti nuu ni bee n-yɛl ti o ni yɛl ti yɛl shɛŋa ŋɔ bee n-wuhi ti o ni wuhi ti binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa.
en: But his wife replied to him, If the LORD wanted to kill us, he wouldnt have accepted the entirely burned offering and grain offering from our hands. He wouldnt have shown us all these things or told us all of this now.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul bela luɣilikam, ka o yuuni ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma.
en: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku labi nyaaŋa alakanim ŋɔ nyabu zuɣu. Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ti nya alakanim ŋɔ tatabo.
en: We sent him so that none of you would be upset by the troubles we have now. You yourselves know that we must have these troubles.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu; yi nyɛla wain nyur wɔɣira, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm ni yi zaŋ binnyura gari taba.
en: They are famous for drinking wine and are heroes known for mixing drinks.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n yaa; ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiliginsim.
en: The Lord makes me powerful and strong; he has saved me.

dag: Dama wulimpuhili zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili, n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani, ka bɛ kul tuɣindi tulaale zim ka maani sara din be kasi tiri ma luɣilikam, dama n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People from one end of the world to the other honor me. Everywhere they burn incense to me and offer acceptable sacrifices. All of them honor me!.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wum kukoli maa zibisim maa sunsuuni ka buɣim dir zoli maa, yi zuliya zuɣulaannim mini yi kpamba daa vumi miri ma na.
en: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Saha yipa paaya ni Daadam Bia nya jilima.
en: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Saimɔn, o daa warila bukpahigu ka wuhir omaŋa ni o nyɛla wɔɣirili, ka o yɛla daa mali Samarianim alahiziba pam.
en: Now there was a man named Simon who lived in that city. Before Philip came there, Simon had been doing magic and amazing all the people of Samaria. He bragged and called himself a great man.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa nya ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni alizini m-bala ka kuhi pam.
en: but they saw him walking on the water. It's a ghost! they thought, and screamed.

dag: Yi ni ti di di suhumaabo daazichi din galisi pam la daanfaani kaman bia ni mɔɣiri o ma bihili shɛm la.
en: so that you may nurse and be satisfied from her comforting breasts, that you may drink and be refreshed from her full breasts.

dag: Dama bɛ birila pɔhim, bɛ ni chɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga. Bɛ chi ni saai ʒiɛya ka ku niŋ bindirigu. Ka di yi niŋ bindirigu, tinzunnima n-ni di li.
en: When they sow the wind, they will reap a storm! A field of grain that doesn't ripen can never produce any bread. But even if it did, foreigners would eat it up.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda niriba maa daa bɔh o, Nyama, ti na be Juda tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka dabiɛm mali ti mi, ka ti yi ti chaŋ Kɛila ni ti ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi ŋɔ, wula ka di lee yɛn be.
en: But David's men said to him, We have enough to be afraid of here in Judah; it will be much worse if we go to Keilah and attack the Philistine forces.

dag: Ka Pool daa yaa chaŋ bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Vuhim Dabisa buta pa taba, ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla.
en: As was Pauls custom, he entered the synagogue and for three Sabbaths interacted with them on the basis of the scriptures.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim shɛli zaa na ti mali sara ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma luɣ kasi shee la tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tuhili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: According to the official weights, the amount of gold given was a ton.

dag: Ŋunkam ti mo Yawɛ, o yi nyɛla Izraɛl tiŋbia bee sana, bɛn kum o, Izraɛlnim maa zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa.
en: Anyone who speaks against the name of the Lord must be put to death. All the people must stone him. Any foreigner or anyone born in Israel who uses the Lords name in a bad way must be put to death.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi la kum shɛli o ni daa ti yɛn kpi la yɛla.
en: He said this to show how he was going to die.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka di shɛli kpalim ka biɛɣu neei paai li bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili. Bɛ doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa zaligu puhi li.
en: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ yiko mini dunia ŋɔ nama zaa zoosim ti Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nam maa ku mali tariga, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni ti kana ti tumdi tuma tiri ba, ka deei bɛ noli.
en: Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti zali ya ni yi gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ gbinnyaɣinima ka bi doli wuhibu shɛli ti ni daa wuhi ya la.
en: Brothers and sisters, we command you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to stay away from every brother or sister who lives an undisciplined life that is not in line with the traditions that you received from us.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Zakaria, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka a paɣ Ɛlizabɛt ni niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a ti bol o yuli Jɔn.
en: But the angel said to him, Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayer, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son. You are to name him John.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaija daa garigi yɛli ba, N yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni nira, Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa luna n-di a min a tɔbbihi pihinu ŋɔ. Di saha ka Naawuni buɣim daa shiri yi zuɣusaa luna n-di sapashini maa min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa.
en: If I am a man of God, Elijah answered, fire will destroy you and your soldiers. And God sent down fire from heaven on the officer and his men.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, sabimi yilli ŋɔ n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnima, zaŋm li niŋ bɛ noya ni din ni chɛ ka yilli ŋɔ leei shɛhira n sani n-jɛndi Izraɛlnima.
en: Now, write down this song. Teach it to the people of Israel, so that it will stand as evidence against them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Ka di sambani mini di duu ni goma wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The man measured the outside of the Temple, and it was feet long. And from the back of the Temple, across the open space to the far side of the building to the west, the distance was also feet.

dag: nti yɛl o, N dana, ti daa pun kala kpe na ti da bindira.
en: Sir, we came to Egypt once before to buy grain.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam wum o yɛligu maa alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi niŋdi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm alaka la? Ka ŋuna n-daa ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛn gba niŋ Yisa yɛda tahi maligumaaniba kpamba san la.
en: All who heard him were amazed and asked, Isn't he the one who in Jerusalem was killing those who worship that man Jesus? And didn't he come here for the very purpose of arresting those people and taking them back to the chief priests.

dag: A nyɛla puu ni kɔbil nini mini nyɛvili kom kɔbiliga ni kulibɔna kom din zɔri yiri Lɛbanɔn na.
en: You are a garden spring, a well of fresh water, streams from Lebanon.

dag: Daadamnim bi malila tuun kpɛma tumbu dunia ŋɔ ni? Ka bɛ dabisa bi ŋmanila bɛ ni bu so paa dabisa?.
en: Isnt slavery everyones condition on earth, our days like those of a hired worker?.

dag: Di daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi la daa nyɛla daanya. Amaa ban shɛŋa din daa yili daantalisi maa mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa.
en: with twenty posts, twenty copper bases, and silver hooks and bands for the posts.

dag: Maligumaana yi yɛn kpe dundɔŋ maa ni, di bi simdi ka o nyu wain.
en: Priests must not drink any wine before going into the inner courtyard.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n kana ni n ti tumla a yubu. Naawuni daa kpihim tuuli sara maligunim la ka zalila din pah ayi.
en: Then he said, Here I am, O God, to do your will. So God does away with all the old sacrifices and puts the sacrifice of Christ in their place.

dag: Yi wulimpuhili polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Hazarɛnan hal ni Shɛfam.
en: Your eastern border will begin at Enan and it will go to Shepham.

dag: Nyama, bɛ zali ma la zaligu ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. O pun niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka n ku tooi vuui li.
en: He told me to bless them. He blessed them, so I cannot change that.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu, nyini n-nyɛ n jilima, ka chɛ ka n zuɣu ʒe ya.
en: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.

dag: Ka nyuli zabbu mini diribarilim tɛha ni be shɛli, nimaani ka chirachira mini tuumbiɛri balibu kam tumbu be.
en: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.

dag: Amaa ka yi ti yiɣisi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-lu m ba malibu zuɣu n-zaŋ o bidibisi pisopɔin pa tampin yini zuɣu ku ba; ka zaŋ Abimilɛk ŋun nyɛ o dab paɣ bia la leei yi naa ni o su Shɛkɛmnima o ni nyɛ yi dɔɣira la zuɣu.
en: but today youve risen up against my fathers household, killed his seventy sons on a single stone, and made Abimelech, his female servants son, king over the leaders of Shechem, because hes your relative.

dag: Ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n dan maa ni pam ka o leei bundana. O ti o piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni anzinfa mini salima ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: The Lord has greatly blessed my master in everything. My master has become a great man. The Lord has given him many flocks of sheep and herds of cattle. He has much silver and gold and many servants. He has many camels and donkeys.

dag: Amaa m bi lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ shɛli, man dee yi ni tooi naai tuun shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni ti ma la; dina n-nyɛ ni m moli Naawuni daalibarika lahibal suŋ hal ti paai n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I dont care about my own life. The most important thing is that I finish my work. I want to finish the work that the Lord Jesus gave me to do—to tell people the Good News about Gods grace.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni yi nya suhudoo n zuɣu. Yi ni nya nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! M pun nyaŋ dunia.
en: I have told you this so that you will have peace by being united to me. The world will make you suffer. But be brave! I have defeated the world.

dag: Zaŋmiya daanya mali kurupooti, ka zaŋ daanya mali bans anahi niŋ di tarisi bunahi zuɣu.
en: Make a grating for the altar. This grating will be shaped like a net. And make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the grating.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Iin, lala n-nyɛ ma; ka yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: Jesus answered, Yes, I am the Son of God. And in the future you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful. And you will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven.

dag: Ninsalinim dabisa pun buɣisimi zali, ka a mi bɛ chira kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyini n-zali bɛ tariga ni nyɛ luɣ shɛli ka bɛ ku tooi yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: If our days are fixed, the number of our months with you, you set a statute and we cant exceed it.

dag: Ka yi ni duɣ li yaɣiri duɣ shɛl ni maa, di simdi ka yi ŋma li. Ka di yi nyɛ kurigu duɣu, di simdi ka yi nan li, ka niŋ kom suui li.
en: A pottery container in which the purification offering is cooked must be broken, but if it is cooked in a bronze container, that must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.

dag: Kaiafas maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛli Yɛhudianim ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu la.
en: It was Caiaphas who had advised the Jewish authorities that it was better that one man should die for all the people.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fabili fabila ŋɔ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: David sang this lament for Saul and his son Jonathan.

dag: Yi nyari suhukpaŋsibo yi ni be Masia ni la zuɣu? Yi nyari suhumaabo o yurilim zuɣu? Yi mini Naawuni Shia Kasi mali simdi ni taba? Yi niŋdi tab nirilim ka zɔri tab nambɔɣu?.
en: Your life in Christ makes you strong, and his love comforts you. You have fellowship with the Spirit, and you have kindness and compassion for one another.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna ti bɔh o, Banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ.
en: God came to Balaam and said, Who are these men with you.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn di nam n-zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee su zuliya kam, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ to n-kpuɣ o bia maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ o tahi Naawuni sani o nam ʒiishee.
en: Then she gave birth to a son, who will rule over all nations with an iron rod. But the child was snatched away and taken to God and his throne.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti wumya ni Izraɛl nanim nyɛla nambɔzɔriba, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ buri so, ka zaŋ gabisi n-kaŋka n-vili ti zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl Naa maa sani, di pa shɛli ka o tilig a nyɛvili.
en: His servants said to him, We heard that the kings of Israel are merciful. Lets dress in rough cloth with ropes on our heads. Then lets go to the king of Israel. Maybe he will let us live.

dag: Nir ni tooi gbaai baandɔɣu niŋ o nuu ni, amaa o bela nanim yinsi.
en: You can catch lizards in your hand, but they are in kings palaces.

dag: Ka yɛl biɛ shɛli ti kana ti ŋme n-ku li, hal ka bɛ ti bi chɛ shɛli zali bɛ bihi gba.
en: and then lose it all in some bad deal and end up with nothing left to pass on to their children.

dag: N nyaya ka Ifriimnim bidibisi simdi ni binyara ŋub ba. Di simdi ni Ifriimnim zaŋ bɛ bidibisi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ku ba.
en: Lord , I can see their children being hunted down and killed.

dag: Ti chandi maa daa muɣisi ti, amaa ka ti kul mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Fɛɛhavɛns, ka di miri Lasia la.
en: We went slowly along the coast and finally reached a place called Fair Havens, not far from the town of Lasea.

dag: M bia, wumm a ba ni wuhir a shɛli, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: My child, pay attention to what your father and mother tell you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl tuun shɛb bɛn kana maa, Yi yi kuli yin yɛlimiya Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga maa nima, Biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ sa ti yɛn bii, yi ni nya faako. Tuumba maa ni daa lab kuli ti yɛli Jabɛshinim lala, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Saul and his army told the messengers from Jabesh, Tell the people at Jabesh in Gilead that by noon tomorrow, you will be saved. The messengers told Sauls message to the people at Jabesh, and they were very happy.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya nyaŋ ti, amaa ka a chɛ li paŋ ti.
en: When wrongdoings become too much for me, you forgive our sins.

dag: O bi darigiri ti tibili kaman ti daalahichi ni simdi shɛm bee n-yɔri ti ti tuumbiɛri samli.
en: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma dabisili la dali ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni chani shɛm la; di saha maa zuɣusaa ni ti vuui ni vuɣɔbu pam, ka buɣim ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa nyɛligi; ka buɣim ti di dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binyara din be di zuɣu.
en: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. On that Day the heavens will disappear with a shrill noise, the heavenly bodies will burn up and be destroyed, and the earth with everything in it will vanish.

dag: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba leei shihirili mini bɛ ni maani shɛba ansarisi, ka yihi ba n niriba sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will turn against them and destroy them. They will be an example to others. People will laugh at them. I will remove them from my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord !.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ ma la lala, nyin niŋm ma nirilim n-dii ku ma, ka lala chɛ ka n ku nya n nandahima biɛhigu.
en: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life!.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Aai, yi kana ni yi ti nyala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Joseph said to them, No, you have come to spy on us.

dag: Ka Juda daa bo paɣ ti o bituuli Ɛr. Paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Tama.
en: Judah married his oldest son Er to a woman named Tamar.

dag: Chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi gili luɣilikam wurim a dimnima. Zaŋm a piɛma to ba ka bɛ guui.
en: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma ŋɔ zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka Ijipti Naa Nɛko daa chaŋ Karikɛmish din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la ni o ti tuhi tɔbu; ka Jɔsia gba daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Naa Nɛko.
en: After King Josiah had done all this for the Temple, King Neco of Egypt led an army to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates River. Josiah tried to stop him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Abimilɛk daa kpah o niriba zuɣu ni yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ doo ŋɔ bee o paɣ ŋɔ shɛli, bɛn kum o.
en: Then Abimelech warned his people that anyone who even touched Isaac or Rebekah would be put to death.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin biɛɣu maa bahi.
en: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and said, Why couldnt we throw the demon out.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛl o kpambaliba, Yi mi ni Ramɔtigiliad nyɛla ti ni su luɣ shɛli, ka ti kul shini ka bi deei li Siria Naa sani maa.
en: Ahab asked his officials, Remember when the king of Aram took Ramoth Gilead from us? That city is ours, so why have we done nothing to get it back.

dag: Ka o daa ka kɔbo din ni yo, ka naa maa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm sandira maa min o paɣa ni o bihi n-tabil o ni mali shɛlikam zaa ti kɔhi na nti yo o samli maa.
en: Because the servant didnt have enough to pay it back, the master ordered that he should be sold, along with his wife and children and everything he had, and that the proceeds should be used as payment.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ yi gba me n-tamla Yisa Masia tuumba min anabinim ni daa zali tanza shɛli din gbinni kuɣ gahindili nyɛ Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ la zuɣu.
en: You, too, are built upon the foundation laid by the apostles and prophets, the cornerstone being Christ Jesus himself.

dag: Amaa n ni tɔɣisila Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛtɔɣa, n yuya ni n yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisila Naawuni sani.
en: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—.

dag: Bɛ bihi ʒiɛla bɛ tooni, ka bɛ nina nya bɛ yaansi.
en: They have children and grandchildren, and live to watch them all grow up.

dag: Tikub ku tooi gbibi ashili, dinzuɣu miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋlana.
en: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.

dag: Amaa o cham maligumaana Ɛliɛza sani ka o lihi Urim puuni Yawɛ sani m-baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm ti o. O mini Izraɛlnim zaa doli Ɛliɛza ni yɛli ba shɛm, o yi yɛli ni bɛ yima, bɛn yima, ka o yi yɛli ni bɛ labimina, bɛn labimina.
en: He will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will determine for him the decision by lot before the LORD. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him, the entire community, will go out, and at his command they will return.

dag: N kuhi niŋ a m-bɔri sɔŋsim ka a bi garigi ma, ka n ʒiɛya ka a baɣa ka n ni.
en: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o pam; dama Gibiɔn daa nyɛla tin titali kaman tin titali kam din mali naa. Di daa galisi gari Ai, ka di dɔbba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: The people of Jerusalem were greatly alarmed at this because Gibeon was as large as any of the cities that had a king; it was larger than Ai, and its men were good fighters.

dag: N na bi birigi zaligu shɛli din daa yi o noli ni na, n zaŋ o noli ni yɛligu niŋ n suhu ni.
en: kept the commandments from his lips and not departed, valued the words from his mouth more than my food.

dag: o yi doli n zaligunima, ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka ʒe yim, o nyɛla wuntizɔra, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They follow my regulations, keep my case laws, and act faithfully. Such people are innocent, and they will live, proclaims the LORD God.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nyɛla n tizɔdoo ŋun daa mɔɣi m ma bihili! N yi di nya a samban ni, n naan mɔɣis a noli ka so ku galim ma.
en: If you were a baby, like my little brother nursing at his mothers breasts, and if I found you outside, I could kiss you, and no one would say it was wrong.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ ni daa niŋ ania la zuɣu, ti booni ba la bɛn mal alibarika. Yi pun wum Ayuba ania niŋbu yɛla, ka nya ti Duuma daliri ni daa nyɛ shɛm di puuni, ka lan nya ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo zaŋ chaŋ o polo min o baɣa ni daa be o ni shɛm.
en: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.

dag: Shallum mini Akub ni Talimɔn ni Ahiman ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa nyɛ dunɔguliba .
en: These are the gatekeepers who lived in Jerusalem: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was their leader.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka m min a ni a zuliya mali alikauli din ni ʒiɛya sahakam bɛ ʒiɛmana ni. Ka n ni nyɛ a min a zuliya maa Naawuni.
en: And I will prepare an agreement between me and you. This agreement will also be for all your descendants. It will continue forever. I will be your God and the God of all your descendants.

dag: Yi tɔbbia kam yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du Yawɛ ninni chaŋ ti lu o dimnim maa zuɣu hal ka o ti kari ba.
en: Your soldiers must cross the Jordan River and be ready to fight for the Lord until he forces the enemy to leave.

dag: Bɛ daa mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli o muɣisigu maa ni. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli o zuliya yɛla? Dama bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away.

dag: Malimi tɔbbihi ni teei gili shɛm kɔtomsi tabili li, ka booi tɔbbihi ni me bindura tabili gooni shɛm gil li, ka mali goma din sirigina tabili li, ka lan mali tɔbutuhiriba bimbina baɣilibaɣili li gili ti tuui.
en: Prepare the siege: Build a wall, construct ramps, set up army camps, and place battering rams all around.

dag: Ti ni daa tum alahichi shɛli Pɛɔr ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu, ka ti na kul diri di wahala la bi galisi nyaŋ ti?.
en: Remember what happened at Peor? Was the sin we committed there not bad enough? Because of that sin, the Lord punished his people with a terrible sickness. And we are still suffering from that sin.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yuli ba ti tuui taba ni suli, ka o suhu daa lan saɣim pam bɛ ninkuunsi zuɣu, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o daa tee li ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus was angry as he looked around at the people. Yet he felt sorry for them because they were so stubborn. Then he told the man, Stretch out your hand. He did, and his bad hand was healed.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yihi yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli yi puri ni pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu zali yuuni kam.
en: You must reserve a tenth part of whatever your fields produce each year.

dag: Ka karimbanim bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim ŋɔ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ ni nam yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya ni bɛ zaŋ ya bo liɣiri. Amaa bɛ Sariakarita ŋun ni bahi ba yoli pun mali shili ka di wɔɣa; ka mi bi gbihira.
en: These false teachers only want your money. So they will use you by telling you things that are not true. But the judgment against these false teachers has been ready for a long time. And they will not escape God who will destroy them.

dag: Ka bɛ ti lo tɔbu n-tuhi Piɛbil la, amaa ka Piɛbil maa ni ti nyaŋ ba, dama o nyɛla duumanim zaa Duuma ni nanim zaa Naa, ka bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb o ni boli min o ni pii ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe o yim.
en: They will make war against the Lamb. But the Lamb will defeat them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings. And with him will be his chosen and faithful followers—the people he has called to be his.

dag: Ka Musa daa shiri kpuɣi jaaŋgbee maa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: Moses obeyed and took his stick from the sacred tent.

dag: Ka salo daa pahi bɛ zuɣu liri ba; ka sariakaritib maa daa dari tɔhi Pool mini Silas binyɛra, ka bahi noli ni bɛ zaŋm jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛb ba.
en: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ ni Yisa baŋya ni ŋuna n-shih o maa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni salo maa zaa ninni, n-kahigi wuhi daliri din chɛ ka o shih o ka dii nya alaafee maa.
en: When the woman saw that she couldnt escape notice, she came trembling and fell before Jesus. In front of everyone, she explained why she had touched him and how she had been immediately healed.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be taŋkpaɣu yiya ni, ka bɛ piligu shee nyɛla taŋkpaɣu ni, ka bɛ ni tooi no n-ku ba kaman zunzuli ŋɔ?.
en: So surely people are worse! They live in houses of clay built on dust. They can be crushed as easily as a moth!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buŋ maa tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu ka o ba.
en: They brought the colt to Jesus and threw their clothes upon it, and he sat on it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ li chaŋ a niriba bɛn be tinzun tinsi ni la sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi wum li bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: Then go to all of your people in exile and tell them, This is what the Lord GOD says .... They will not listen, and they will not stop sinning, but you must still tell them my message.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gɔhi din gabi taba, ka ŋmani danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣi; buɣim ni di ba kaman mokuma la.
en: You will be destroyed completely like thornbushes burning under a pot. You will be destroyed like dry weeds that burn quickly.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa galisiya pam. Dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda niŋbu mini yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni baŋsim ni nimmoo niŋbu shɛlikam ni ni yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ ti sani. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi gba ni niŋdi shɛm galisi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ni.
en: You are rich in everything—in faith, in speaking ability, in knowledge, in the willingness to help, and in the love you learned from us. So now we want you to be rich in this work of giving too.

dag: O daa di nam be Hiburɔn n-su Judanim la yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu. Ka o daa lan ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa yuun pihitanaata.
en: In Hebron he ruled over Judah for years and months, and in Jerusalem he ruled over all Israel and Judah for years.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei Makɛda dindali maa, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di naa min o niriba. O daa ku sokam zaa, ka bi chɛ hal ninvuɣ yino gba; ka daa niŋ Makɛda naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: Joshua attacked and captured Makkedah and its king that day. He put everyone in the city to death; no one was left alive. He did to the king of Makkedah what he had done to the king of Jericho.

dag: Ka o daa kpab litaafi maa zaŋ li labisi ti jɛmbu duu maa sɔŋda so ŋun ʒe nimaani ka naanyi ʒini. Ka bɛnkam daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni kpaai bɛ nina kpa o.
en: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fiɛb ba pam ka zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu, ka yɛli dansarika gula ni o guli ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: When Paul and Silas had been severely beaten, the authorities threw them into prison and ordered the jailer to secure them with great care.

dag: ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka lan tam o ni lihi nya omaŋ shɛm maa kɔtomsi.
en: and doing nothing about what you saw. You go away and immediately forget how bad you looked.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni pam di zuɣu. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa bo niriba pahi Pool mini Baanabas zuɣu n-tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ Yisa tuumba la mini cheechi kpamba bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la sani nti nya ba yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: Paul and Barnabas got into a fierce argument with them about this, so it was decided that Paul and Barnabas and some of the others in Antioch should go to Jerusalem and see the apostles and elders about this matter.

dag: N dol a zaligunim min a wuhibu, dama a mi n soya zaa.
en: I keep your precepts and your laws because all my ways are seen by you.

dag: Ka yi nɔdeebo yi ti niŋ pali, ti mali shili ni ti darigi bɛn tumdi nɔzaɣisibo tuma la tibili.
en: We are ready to punish anyone there who does not obey, but first we want you to be fully obedient.

dag: ni Nɛbo ni Baalimiɔn ni Sibima; ka bɛ daa ti bɛ ni me tin shɛŋa maa yu pala.
en: Nebo, Baal Meon , and Sibmah. They gave new names to the towns they rebuilt.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro zim kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: I dont have any regular bread on hand, the priest answered David, just holy bread—but only if your troops have abstained from sexual activity.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo na, ka bɛ mini Ibrahimma ni Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ti laɣim ʒini alizanda nam ni ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: O daa zaŋla Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni niriba tuhili pa omaŋ zuɣu na. Ka Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool daŋ niriba tumtumda la daa zaŋ o bidibisi pinaanu min o tumtumdiba pisi n-zo n-daŋ naa tooni chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: , others from Benjamin had come with him. Ziba, the chief servant of Saul's family, also came to the Jordan River. He and his sons and servants waded across to meet David.

dag: Ti daa bi bɔri paɣibu so sani, di yi nyɛla yi sani bee shɛb sani, hal ti di mali soli ni ti tooi suhi ya binshɛŋa ti ni nyɛ Masia tuumba la zuɣu.
en: We were not looking for praise from people—not from you or anyone else.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tuumbiɛri taali ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu. Yi nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri. Yi nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ, ka lɛb yi nyaaŋa bir o!.
en: You are doomed, you sinful nation, you corrupt and evil people! Your sins drag you down! You have rejected the Lord , the holy God of Israel, and have turned your backs on him.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa ni bɛ doo kam mini paɣ kam suhim o ʒiʒiinikpee anzinfa mini salima nɛma.
en: Now go and tell my people to ask their Egyptian neighbors for gold and silver jewelry.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti ku yi yuri, ka saɣim yi chɛchɛbunsi.
en: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots.

dag: Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔ yɛla ka man Dauda lee lan yɛn yɛl a yaha? Dama a mi man a dabili Dauda.
en: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts, so there is nothing more that I need to say.

dag: Bɛ yih a niriba ʒim Jɛrusalɛm, ka di doya zɔri kaman kom la, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔɣi ba.
en: Theyve poured out the blood of the faithful like water all around Jerusalem, and theres no one left to bury them.

dag: Bɛ wurim n suɣili, ka chihi di mihi zaa. M bihi chaŋya ka chɛ ma; bɛ lan kani, ka so kani ŋun ni lan ti n suɣili maa yaha, ka zaŋ m pateesanim yili di ni.
en: But now my tent is destroyed; all its ropes are cut, and my children are gone for good. Theres no one left to set up my tent frame and to attach the fabric.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o daa pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianima.
en: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anii nyɛ Jɔhanan, ka ŋun pahi awɛi nyɛ Ɛlizabad.
en: Johanan eighth, Elzabad ninth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bɔri naa, ka Naawuni daa pii Kish bia Sool leei bɛ naa, ka o daa di nam maa yuun pihinahi. Sool daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira.
en: Then the people asked for a king. God gave them Saul, the son of Kish. Saul was from the tribe of Benjamin. He was king for years.

dag: Ŋun bɔri ni o jɛm ma, ŋun doli ma. N ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka n yiŋbia gba ni ti be. Ŋun jɛmdi ma, dilana ka m Ba Naawuni tiri jilima.
en: If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko nyɛla tɔbutuhiri baŋsim mini kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu? Bee ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka zaɣisi n noli maa?.
en: Do you think that empty words are the same as good strategy and the strength to fight? Who are you trusting in that you now rebel against me?.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni bɛ tummi din viɛla, ka nyɛ bundaannim tuun suma tumbu ni; ka lan nyɛ bɛn tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli, ka yu ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli n-sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.

dag: O daa nyɛla ŋun yuli du ninvuɣ pihita maa puuni, amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli ŋun Dauda la zuɣulana.
en: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu pina na; ka niriba maa daa ʒini tiŋa ni bɛ di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi diɛmdi kɔr biɛri mini vi diɛma.
en: They got up early the next day and offered up entirely burned offerings and brought well-being sacrifices. The people sat down to eat and drink and then got up to celebrate.

dag: n-zaŋ o binyɛr wɔɣinli din bɔɣiri wɔɣ maa nti ti bɛ ba ka yɛl o, Ti pihi li mi, lihim li nya, a bia binyɛrigu m-bala bee pa dina.
en: They took the robe to their father and said, We found this. Does it belong to your son.

dag: dama Yawɛ zabiri bɛ zuɣu, ka ni ku bɛnkam bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: The LORD will take up their case and press the life out of those who oppress them.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka anab maa dola sol ni, ka buŋ la mini gbuɣinli maa ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka gbuɣinli maa bi ŋub o bee n-ku buŋ maa.
en: The old prophet went to find the body lying on the road. The donkey and the lion were still standing near it. The lion had not eaten the body or hurt the donkey.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa daari taba ni bɛ paag o shihi, dama o niŋgbuŋ ni ka tibbu yiko maa daa yirina n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpaŋda.
en: The whole crowd wanted to touch him, because power was going out from him and he was healing everyone.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo ni o zaŋ niŋ o tulaale, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Whoever makes incense with this same formula to enjoy its fragrance will be cut off from the people.

dag: Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi zuliya kam niriba zuɣu. O suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zali ni o ni ku ba.
en: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.

dag: Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa biɛ ŋ-kpaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa sabi sabbu ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: After Hezekiah recovered from his illness, he wrote this song of praise:.

dag: Yawɛ n-su zuɣusaa ha, amaa ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ ti ninsalinima.
en: Heaven belongs to the Lord alone, but he gave the earth to us humans.

dag: Hal Siria tɔbbihi maa ni daa bi galisi maa zaa yoli, Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, dama tɔbbihi maa daa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa darigi Jɔash tibili.
en: The Aramean army came with only a small group of men, but the Lord let them defeat the much larger army of Judah. This was a punishment for Joash because the people of Judah had left the Lord , the God their ancestors worshiped.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Saimɔn, m mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, yɛlim ma.
en: Jesus said to the Pharisee, Simon, I have something to say to you. Teacher, what is it? Simon replied.

dag: Dama bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, di laara ka Naawuni yɛn ti ba, ka darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He rewards people for what they do and treats them as they deserve.

dag: ni Baala ni Iim ni Ɛzɛm.
en: Baalah, Iim, Ezem.

dag: So yi yɛn zaŋ chi bee kawana na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋm li niɛm zim, ka bo kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pahi di zuɣu.
en: When anyone presents a grain offering to the LORD, the offering must be of choice flour. They must pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

dag: Yɛm so tɔbutuhiri bidibbina. Amaa alahichilan yino saɣindi bin viɛla pam.
en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one incompetent person destroys much good.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mali bindir shɛli ka yi bi mi li.
en: But he answered, I have food to eat that you know nothing about.

dag: N lo n suhu ni ni n ni dol a zaligunim maa sahakam.
en: I have decided to obey your laws until the day I die.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: Then some Pharisees and teachers of the Law came from Jerusalem to Jesus and asked him.

dag: O daa bi nya ka di nyɛ shɛli ni o tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la tatabo. O daa kpuɣila Sidɔn Naa Ɛtibaal bipuɣiŋga Jɛzibɛl n-niŋ o paɣa, ka daa jɛmdi buɣili Baal.
en: It was not enough for Ahab to commit the same sins that Jeroboam, son of Nebat, had done. Ahab also married Jezebel, daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon. Then Ahab began to serve and worship Baal.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ma, Di niŋ lala! N nyɛla a min a mabihi bɛn nyɛ anabinima ni bɛn dol litaafi ŋɔ puuni yɛligu la dab kpee. Jɛmmi la Naawuni.
en: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n yi tam a yɛla, n nudirigu din tammi di ni mi shɛli niŋbu.
en: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.

dag: Ka Gaal daa gari tooni zaŋ Shɛkɛmnim chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Abimilɛk ti tuhi.
en: Gaal and the leaders of Shechem went out and fought Abimelech.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija puhi zan o sani ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Jesus.

dag: Ka n yɔri lee nyɛla dini? Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: M bi zaŋ n ni mali yolisim so shɛl la tumdi di tuma n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu maa puuni, dama m bi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu tiri niriba ka zaani ba ni bɛ yo shɛli di zuɣu.
en: What reward do I get? That when I preach, I offer the good news free of charge. Thats why I dont use the rights to which Im entitled through the gospel.

dag: N lola noli hal ka n duna ti gbarigi, ka n niŋgbuna ti kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: My legs are weak from fasting; my body is skin and bones.

dag: Dama a deei talima a mabihi sani ka di ka daliri, ka deei bɛ situra sɔŋ ka chɛ ba bɛ zaɣim.
en: You have taken payments from your family for no reason; stripped the naked, leaving no clothes.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa ni, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: But all seven men had married her. So when people rise from death, whose wife will she be.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ gba ti leei din bi kpira.
en: Its necessary for this rotting body to be clothed with what cant decay, and for the body that is dying to be clothed in what cant die.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa ŋun pahi ayi ka nyɛ maligumaana leebu piɛlaa la na. Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Moses then presented the second ram, the ram for ordination, and Aaron and his sons pressed their hands on its head.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.

dag: Buɣim yirila o sani n-chani ti diri o dimnim bɛn gil o luɣilikam zaa.
en: Fire goes before him and destroys his enemies.

dag: Dama m mi ni n tiligira nyɛla ŋun be, o nyɛla ŋun kul ni ti bahi ka dunia ni na.
en: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni yubu n-su yi dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu, ka pa ni daadamtali kɔr biɛri.
en: Strengthen yourselves so that you will live your lives here on earth doing what God wants, not the evil things that people want to do.

dag: N kukoli daa niŋla kukol bila ka bi kpɛma, ka n daa bamdi kaman ŋmani la. N daa lihila zuɣusaa hal ka n nina ti fulim. N Duuma, yihim ma muɣisigu ŋɔ ni.
en: I cried like a bird and moaned like a dove. My eyes became tired, but I continued looking to the heavens. Lord, I am so depressed. Promise to help me.

dag: ka di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛlimaŋli zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni pun yɛl a shɛlikam la polo.
en: I did this so that you can be sure that what you have been taught is true.

dag: Naawuni daa pun daŋ piig o mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam dunia ŋɔ, amaa ka o daa lee ti yi palo la ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni yi zuɣu.
en: Christ was chosen before the world was made, but he was shown to the world in these last times for you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim bɛn daa be o sani maa na nti piripiri ba, ka niriba tuhili kam bee niriba kɔbiga kam mali di sapashin kpɛma.
en: David divided his soldiers into groups of and groups of . Then he chose officers to be in command of each group.

dag: Ka so yi dolina ni o ti ku o yo samli, bɛn di zaŋ o ti o, o ni ku o kpee maa ka di nyɛla sarati zuɣu, ka pa ni o min o pun malila taali la zuɣu.
en: If a member of the victims family follows, seeking revenge, they wont hand the killer over. This is because the killer struck down the neighbor by accident and hadnt been an enemy in the past.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darig a tibili kaman a ni daa niŋ shɛm maa, nyin ŋun bi lihi nya pɔri, ka saɣim alikauli ŋɔ.
en: The LORD God proclaims: I will do to you just as you have done, despising solemn pledges and breaking covenants.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Zuliya ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka zaɣisi saɣisigu; yɛlimaŋli vuuya, di lan ka bɛ noya ni.
en: Therefore, say to them: This nation neither obeys the LORD its God nor accepts correction; truth has disappeared; it has vanished from their lips.

dag: Amaa bɛ kul domi gu ni bɛ ŋmaligi ku bɛmaŋa. Bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya ka bɛ doya gu maa.
en: but people like that are setting a trap for themselves, a trap in which they will die.

dag: Bansi maa daa baɣila di naŋgbaŋkuɣila din daa yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: The rings that housed the poles used for carrying the table were close to the frame.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa lee bela ya? Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam, ka dabiɛm kpe ba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: He said to his followers, Where is your faith? They were afraid and amazed. They said to each other, What kind of man is this? He commands the wind and the water, and they obey him.

dag: Bɛ kpirila ninvuɣ kaha, ka bɛ nyɛviya bahigu nyɛla vi bahigu.
en: They die while they are still young, worn out by a life of disgrace.

dag: ka Sɔdi bia Gaddiɛl daa yi Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Zebulun—Gaddiel son of Sodi;.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyo a yiya buɣim, ka kar a saria paɣiba pam ninni. N ni chɛ ka a ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka a gba ku lan ti so pina.
en: They will burn your houses down and let crowds of women see your punishment. I will make you stop being a prostitute and make you stop giving gifts to your lovers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa maani niriba maa yɛla sahakam. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi yɛtɔɣ kpɛma n-kani Musa sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa maani li.
en: They served as judges, deciding the easy cases themselves, but bringing the more difficult ones to Moses.

dag: Daba anii dali bɛ ni guni bia maa.
en: On the eighth day, the flesh of the boys foreskin must be circumcised.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli n soya mini n zaligunima ni n fukumsi zalikpana la kaman a ba Dauda ni daa dol li shɛm la, dindina n ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.

dag: bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒii bunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahi.
en: except that each one had four faces and four wings.

dag: Dama yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa bi be kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na la, nimaani yi daa yi biri yi bimbira, yi chanila yi naba zuɣu ti ŋɔŋ kom na ti yɔɣi li kaman ʒiɛvari puu la.
en: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ka boli ninvuɣ shɛb o ni bɔra, ka bɛ daa ka o sanna.
en: Jesus went up on a mountain and called those he wanted, and they came to him.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ni bɛ mali baŋsim maa birigiya ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: For some have claimed to possess it, and as a result they have lost the way of faith. God's grace be with you all.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi nini tiɣi yi yɛm pam, ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla yɛnnima.
en: You think you are clever and smart.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ŋme ma, amaa m bi nya daŋa. Bɛ bu ma, amaa di bi biɛra. Bɔ saha ka n nini yɛn neei? N lan bɔrila wain ni n nyu.
en: Though hit, I feel no pain; though beaten up, I dont know anything about it. When I wake up, Ill look for wine again.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti boli paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bi kuri bidibbihi maa ka chɛ ba.
en: The king called them in again and asked, Why are you letting those baby boys live.

dag: Di saha maa ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: Then a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and touched the hem of his clothes.

dag: Yi gba ni nyɛ Naawuni bihi maa zuɣu ka Naawuni tim o Bia maa Shia ka o kana ti be ti suhuri ni kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: Since you are now Gods children, he has sent the Spirit of his Son into your hearts. The Spirit cries out, Abba , Father.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Jɛhɔzabad, o mi daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinu bɛn daa gbibi bidibbina m-mali shili gu tɔbu.
en: next to him was Jehozabad, together with one hundred eighty thousand soldiers.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa wum niriba maa yɛligu maa, ka o gba daa lan zaŋ li yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Samuel listened to the people and then repeated their words to the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi tirisi tooni nti lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka so daa bi lan niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yaha; dinzuɣu ka o daa boli di mi yuli Rɛhɔbɔt ka yɛra, Yawɛ yipa ti ti luɣ shɛli din mali palo pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti ni tɔŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: He moved away from there and dug another well. There was no dispute about this one, so he named it Freedom. He said, Now the Lord has given us freedom to live in the land, and we will be prosperous here.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa ni ti kpila bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu. Ŋunkam di wain tiwala din miha nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: No, people will die for their own sins. Those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste.

dag: Ka Jair daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Kamɔn.
en: When he died, he was buried in the town of Kamon.

dag: Salo maa ni daa ti wurim naai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim o sani bɔh o yɛtɔɣ ŋaha la yɛla.
en: When Jesus was alone, some of those who had heard him came to him with the twelve disciples and asked him to explain the parables.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be yi sani tumd o tuma la, ti suhiri ya ni yi lum ba sizuura. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn wuhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande la.
en: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.

dag: Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka m be, dama n suhu yu a zaligunim maa pam.
en: Comfort me and let me live. I enjoy your teachings.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah did everything the Lord told him to do.

dag: Miri ka a di zunyuŋnim bindira bee n-chɛ ka a kɔre kpe di ni di nyaɣisim zuɣu;.
en: Don't eat at the table of a stingy person or be greedy for the fine food he serves.

dag: amaa ka daa bi boli anabi Neetan mini Bɛnaaya bee o tizo Sulemaana bee naa ninvuɣ kpɛma la bɛna.
en: but he did not invite his half brother Solomon or Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the king's bodyguards.

dag: n-zaŋ o dalinli tabili ti, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.

dag: Ka n daa ŋmahiŋmahi m mam maa jilajila n-zaŋ tari Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama bɛna n-tum din chihiri ŋɔ mini biŋkɔb tuuni ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa.
en: I took her, chopped her up, and sent her pieces into every part of Israels territory, because they had committed a disgraceful act in Israel.

dag: Dahin shɛli yuŋ ka o daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti mi ni a nyɛla karimba ŋun yi Naawuni sanna, dama so kani ŋun ni tooi wuhi shihir shɛŋa a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ka pa ni Naawuni m-be o sani.
en: One night he went to Jesus and said, Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa duhi bɛ yɛhi n-kum hal ti lan ka yaa din ni kum.
en: David and the troops with him broke into tears and cried until they could cry no more.

dag: Wula ka yi zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni, ka tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun be naŋgbantom ni nyɛvili?.
en: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?.

dag: Amaa nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma pul ni na; nyini n-daa chɛ ka m mɔɣi m ma bihim baai.
en: God, the truth is, you are the one who brought me into this world. You made me feel safe while I was still at my mothers breasts.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Lɛvinim ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ʒi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka pa ni shɛb yaha, dama bɛna ka Yawɛ daa pii ni bɛ ʒiri li, ka tumd o jɛma tuma sahakam.
en: He said, Only Levites will be allowed to carry the chest, because the Lord has chosen them to do that work and to serve him forever.

dag: Dama bɛ kumdila pampam duri Luhit zoli, ka wum biɛrim mini nandahima kuhigu Hɔrɔnaim zolɔŋni.
en: and cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they will tell of disasters.

dag: Bihi nyɛla pini din yi Yawɛ sanna. Bihi nyɛla bidɔɣibo laara din yi Yawɛ sanna.
en: No doubt about it: children are a gift from the LORD; the fruit of the womb is a divine reward.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nini na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: because it will be a time of great trouble. There will be more trouble than has ever happened since the beginning of the world. And nothing as bad as that will ever happen again.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔŋ ni, duri daa be nimaani ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali gili di dundɔŋ maa zaa. Duri pihita n-daa be bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali luɣ shɛli maa tooni.
en: Then he brought me to the outer courtyard, which consisted of chambers and a pavement all the way around. Thirty chambers came up to the pavement.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti nyɛla gandammoya ka nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: You claim that your soldiers are strong and brave.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali kam sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi dabisili kam sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini di binnyura sara.
en: This is a special offering for the day of rest. This offering is in addition to the regular daily offering and drink offering.

dag: Ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Paɣ ŋɔ n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm a bidibiga ŋɔ ka ti duɣi ŋubi zuŋɔ; ka sa zaŋ m mi bidibiga duɣi ŋubi biɛɣuni.
en: But then the king asked her, Whats troubling you? She answered, A woman said to me, Give up your son so we can eat him today; well eat my son tomorrow.

dag: O yi yiɣisi zani, dabiɛm gbahirila wuna, ka bɛ zɔri dabiɛm ka labi nyaaŋa.
en: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni kul du shɛm, ka tiŋgbani mi zilim shɛm, lala n-nyɛ nanim tɛha, di ka vihi baŋ.
en: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.

dag: Ka yi ni ti be Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ zuliya la ni yuui, di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: and so that you might prolong your life on the fertile land that the LORD swore to your ancestors to give to them and their descendants—a land full of milk and honey.

dag: Yɛlim do kura la ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali yɛm, ka doli wuhibu maŋli, ka mali yurilim, ka nyɛ bɛn mal ania yɛda niŋbu ni.
en: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.

dag: Bɛ taɣi kpibiga buŋ chaŋ, ka deei pakoli nahu talima.
en: drive off an orphans donkey, take a widows ox as collateral.

dag: Bɛ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu lu o zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun yɛn fiɣis o zan o nudirigu polo.
en: Choose some corrupt judge to try my enemy, and let one of his own enemies accuse him.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni yɛli naa ti a.
en: Very well, she answered. I will speak to the king for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun daa tiligi Ibrahimma o muɣisigu puuni la yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, Yi ku lan di vi, yi mi ninni biɛhigu ku lan taɣi.
en: So the Lord , who made Abraham free, speaks to Jacobs family. He says, Now the people of Jacob will not be embarrassed and ashamed.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa lo Gibiɔnnim alikauli maa nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka bɛ ti wum ni Gibiɔnnim maa nyɛla bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, ka bɛ mini ba kul bela luɣ yini.
en: Three days after the treaty had been made, the Israelites learned that these people did indeed live nearby.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaayi Rubin mini Gaad ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba.
en: The descendants of Merari acquired twelve cities for their clans from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: That is why I am sending him. I want you to know how we are, and I am sending him to encourage you.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka di chɛ ka yi ni pun tum shɛli zuɣu la ku yi yi nuu ni, amaa ka di lee chɛ ka yi ti deela di laara zaa.
en: Be careful! Dont lose the reward we have worked for. Be careful so that you will receive all of that reward.

dag: Saipurusinim ni ti kpe ŋarima kana ti liri ya. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ashurinim mini Ɛbanima. Amaa bɛ gba ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Ships will come from Cyprus. They will defeat Assyria and Eber, but those ships will also be destroyed.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋya nirilim shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, pomiya ni yi gba ni ti niŋ m mini m ba yiŋnim nirilim lala, ka wuhi ma di shihirili.
en: Please promise me in the Lord 's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la daa bi pahi tipawumlinim zuɣu bahi yoli, o ni daa deei ninvuɣ puɣisiriba la ni suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: And Rahab, the prostitute, welcomed the Israelite spies like friends. And because of her faith, she was not killed with the ones who refused to obey.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a ti zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di ka nyu. Ka paɣ maa ba maa daa yɛli doo maa, Niŋm ania kpalim gbe m-pahi, ka chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: So the Levite and his father-in-law sat down to eat and drink together. After that the young womans father said to the Levite, Please stay tonight. Relax and enjoy yourself. So the two men ate together.

dag: O daa nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim; o daa nyo yil titali kam buɣim.
en: He burned down the LORDs temple, the royal palace, all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the important buildings.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka tiŋgbani mi nyɛ n napɔntamdigu. Ka yil bɔ ka yi lee yɛn me n-ti ma? Bee luɣ shɛli be dunia ŋɔ ni ka n ni ʒini nimaani vuhi?.
en: Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me, says the Lord, or where is my resting place? .

dag: Ka Simiɔn bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la.
en: Simeons sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, and Zohar. There was also Shaul.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn baŋ din viɛli piibu ka zaɣisi din bi viɛla, o ni ti dirila waagasi mini shiri.
en: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.

dag: O me o tiŋa n-tam zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: Gods foundation is set on the holy mountains.

dag: Ka Nɛgɛbinim ti deei Iso Zoli su; ka bɛn be zolɔna ni wulinluhili polo la ti deei Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Izraɛlnim ni ti deei Ifriim mini Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi ti deei Giliad su.
en: Then people from the Negev will live on the mountain of Esau. And people from the foothills will take the Philistine lands. They will live in the land of Ephraim and Samaria. Gilead will belong to Benjamin.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Neesim, neema! Ka neesim dii neei.
en: Then God said, Let there be light! And light began to shine.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa kpalim zani puu maa sunsuuni, ka bɛ zabi di zuɣu n-ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa tiligi ba ni nasara dibu tital la.
en: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Tamiya duu maa daɣiri, ka ku niriba sɔŋ dundɔna ni, chamiya! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti ku niriba.
en: God said to them, Defile the Temple. Fill its courtyards with corpses. Get to work! So they began to kill the people in the city.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: O ni daa du zuɣusaa ha la, o daa zaŋ bɛn nyɛ daba la pam mali chaŋ, ka daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinima.
en: As the Scriptures say, When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ o ba sani ti bol o, M ba! Ka o saɣi ka bɔh o, Ka m bi ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: Jacob went to his father and said, Father, here I am. Which one of my sons are you? his father asked.

dag: Yawɛ zaɣisi n tɔbbihi zaa bɛn be n sani. O zali ma saha shɛl o ni yɛn ku n nachimba. N Duuma no Juda paɣisarili ŋun nyɛ paɣipiɛliga sɔŋ kaman bɛ ni nɔri wain di bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: You, Lord , have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.

dag: Nyama, o ni daa kul yɛri maa o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nabihi maa dii kpɛna nti duhi bɛ yee kumda, ka naa min o kpamba zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: As soon as he finished saying this, David's sons came in; they started crying, and David and his officials also cried bitterly.

dag: O tahiri teeku zuɣu, ka di kom nyuura. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka mɔɣa kom nyuura; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl tihi vari suura, ka Lɛbanɔn tipuma suura.
en: He commands the sea, and it dries up! He makes the rivers go dry. The fields of Bashan wither, Mount Carmel turns brown, and the flowers of Lebanon fade.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sɔɣimi doya gu ma ni bɛ ku ma; amaa a zaligunim maa yɛla ka man kul tɛhira.
en: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.

dag: Ka n daa yihi ba tinzun yɛlli kam daɣiri ni; ka daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni sokam tuuni ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: So I purified them of everything foreign and established the services of the priests and Levites with specific duties for each person.

dag: Amaa tinim n-ni paɣi Yawɛ pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Amaa lee bomiyala Naawuni nam dubu, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: Instead, be concerned with his Kingdom, and he will provide you with these things.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnim ti a, ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit here at my right side until I put your enemies under your feet.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya niriba gba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Bɛtɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ba.
en: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh went to attack the city of Bethel, at that time called Luz. The Lord helped them. They sent spies to the city.

dag: Mishima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamuɛl mini Zakur ni Shimɛi.
en: Mishmas son was Hammuel. Hammuels son was Zaccur. Zaccurs son was Shimei.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma yaha, Di pun niŋ! N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla, Piligu ni Bahigu. Kɔnyuri ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la, n ni ti ba nyɛvili kom din nyɛ kɔbilisirim la yoli.
en: And he said, It is done! I am the first and the last, the beginning and the end. To anyone who is thirsty I will give the right to drink from the spring of the water of life without paying for it.

dag: nti yɛl o, N dana, ti daa pun kala kpe na ti da bindira.
en: They said, Sir, I promise this is the truth. The last time we came, we came to buy food.

dag: Ulam bidibisi daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ peentɔriba ni yɛlimaŋli. O daa mali bidibisi mini yaansi pam. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: Ulams family were mighty warriors and archers, having many children and grandchildren— in all and all were Benjaminites.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti teei yi biɛhigu mini yi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-saɣim yimaŋ la yɛla, ka galim yimaŋa yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Then you will remember all the disgraceful things you did and how you defiled yourselves. You will be disgusted with yourselves because of all the evil things you did.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lu ka di zibiri saha shɛli, ka buɣim nyokpilli mini buɣim mokpalli daa kana ti kpe nimdi din ŋmahiŋmahi doya maa sunsuuni gari.
en: Sometime after sunset, when it was very dark, a smoking cooking pot and a flaming fire passed between the two halves of each animal.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka so ni ti yi Jɛsi zuliya ni na n-lee shihirili zuliya kam sani, ka o biɛhigu shee ni ti viɛla, ka niriba ti bɔhiri bɔr o shee.
en: At that time there will be someone special from Jesses family. He will be like a flag that all the nations gather around. The nations will come to him and ask him what they should do. And the place where he is will be filled with glory.

dag: Tinzunnim luri ma la sizuura; ka man dee yi kul yɛli shɛlikam ka bɛ wum, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: They obey and come crawling.
