dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm o daalibarika ni zuɣu ka n niŋ tammɛr yɛndana ŋun zali duu gbinni tanzaa, ka so mɛri tamdi di zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam gba yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, ŋun mɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I laid a foundation like a wise master builder according to Gods grace that was given to me, but someone else is building on top of it. Each person needs to pay attention to the way they build on it.

dag: O bidib kpɛm sani yuli daa boonila Joɛl, ka ŋun paya mi yuli booni Abija; Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba zuɣulaannima.
en: The name of his oldest son was Joel; the name of the second was Abijah. They served as judges in Beer-sheba.

dag: ka daa bol o yiŋbihi pia na nti ti bɛ zaa pɔŋlipɔŋli, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ mal li gom kɔhigu hal ka o ti labina.
en: He called together ten servants and gave each of them money worth four months wages.He said, Do business with this until I return.

dag: O ba min o ma ni daa ti nya o, di daa gari ba pam, ka o ma bɔh o, M bia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? A bi nya m min a ba ni lihiri bɔr a shee ni suhusaɣiŋgu shɛm.
en: When his parents saw him, they wondered how this was possible. And his mother said, Son, why did you do this to us? Your father and I were very worried about you. We have been looking for you.

dag: Amaa ka o sɔŋda maa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ tari ninvuɣ kɔbiga? Ka Ilaisha daa lan garigi yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ba ka bɛ ŋubi, dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ŋub li tiɣi ka guui. .
en: There's not enough here for people, his servant said. Just give it to them, Elisha replied. The Lord has promised there will be more than enough.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Pa yi ninvuɣ pinaayi ka m pii ka yi ni yino ti nyɛ Sintani nir la.
en: Jesus replied, I chose the twelve of you, didn't I? Yet one of you is a devil.

dag: Ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Ʒimiy o ka n sanna ka n ti nya o.
en: Then you said to us, Bring that brother to me. I want to see him.

dag: Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛli, N nyala alimɔnd tiwulli.
en: The Lord asked me, Jeremiah, what do you see? I answered, A branch of an almond tree.

dag: amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba ŋub maa, so daa naan ku tooi baŋ ni bɛ zaŋ ba ŋubi, dama bɛ daa na kul gaŋsigaŋsimi, ka be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa yirigi neei.
en: But after they swallowed them whole, no one would have known it. They looked just as bad as they had before. Then I woke up.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya nam ʒiishe titali din nyɛ zaɣ piɛlli ka lan nya ŋun ʒi nimaani, ka tiŋgbani mini sagbana daa laligi ka chɛ o, ka so bi lan nya li yaha.
en: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.

dag: Yɛlim Yaakubu zuliya dimbɔŋɔ, molimi li Juda:.
en: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.

dag: Ka lan yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti nya ka alizanda dunoli yooi, ka Naawuni malaikanim siɣiri Daadam Bia sanna ka labiri dura.
en: And he said to them, I am telling you the truth: you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.

dag: Nyama, a kari ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka kari ma a sani; ka n leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ŋunkam ti nya ma ni ku ma.
en: You are driving me off the land and away from your presence. I will be a homeless wanderer on the earth, and anyone who finds me will kill me.

dag: Chamiya chuɣu maa ni. Man na ku chaŋ di ni, dama n saha na bi paai.
en: You go on to the festival. I am not going to this festival, because the right time has not come for me.

dag: N dimnim zaa ni di vi, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam; di ku yuui ka bɛ di vi maa, ka ŋmaligi zo.
en: All my enemies will be ashamed and completely terrified; they will be defeated and ashamed instantly.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti yɛl a mini Yawɛ finafina; suhim Yawɛ ti ti ka o vuui tinvura maa ka chɛ ti. Ka Musa daa suhi Naawuni ti niriba maa.
en: The people went to Moses and said, Weve sinned, for we spoke against the LORD and you. Pray to the LORD so that he will send the snakes away from us. So Moses prayed for the people.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ suhimiya Naawuni ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka niŋ ti nirilim. Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali taali. O ni niŋ yi so nirilim? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Now, you priests, try asking God to be good to us. He will not answer your prayer, and it will be your fault.

dag: Dindali maa n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli min o yiŋnim polo la ni ti niŋ pali, di piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: I will punish Eli and his family, just as I promised.

dag: Amaa ka o paɣ yɛl o, Naawuni yi di bɔri ti kubu, o naan ku deei ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti o ŋɔ ti nuu ni bee n-yɛl ti o ni yɛl ti yɛl shɛŋa ŋɔ bee n-wuhi ti o ni wuhi ti binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa.
en: The Lord isn't going to kill us, Manoah's wife responded. The Lord accepted our sacrifice and grain offering, and he let us see something amazing. Besides, he told us that we're going to have a son.

dag: Amaa n ni mali tahima sahakam; ka kul ni paɣir a waawaayili.
en: But me? I will hope. Always. I will add to all your praise.

dag: Ka n zaŋ buɣu leei n situra ye, ka bɛ maani ma ansarisi.
en: When I wore funeral clothes, people made fun of me.

dag: Ka Sintani yi kariti Sintani bahira, o ŋmaligimi tuhir omaŋa m-bala; ka wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani?.
en: If Satan throws out Satan, he is at war with himself. How then can his kingdom endure?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Bɛtilihɛm maa ka Mariama dɔɣibu saha paai.
en: and while they were there.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Yɛhudianim to jina n-naai noli ni bɛ suh a ka a sa zaŋ Pool tahi jintɔriba sanna biɛɣu ni, ka di be kaman bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: He replied, The Jewish leaders have conspired to ask that you bring Paul down to the council tomorrow. They will pretend that they want to investigate his case more closely.

dag: Juda Naa Manaasa ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa, hal ka tum tuumbiɛri gari Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka chɛ ka Judanim jɛm o buɣa n-tum alahichi la zuɣu.
en: King Manasseh of Judah has done these hated things and has done more evil than the Amorites before him. He also has caused Judah to sin because of his idols.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu n-chani bɔri Yawɛ shee, amaa bɛ ti ku nya o, dama o zo bɛ sani.
en: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛhab daa ti yɛli Nabɔt, Zaŋm a puu ŋɔ ti ma ka n zaŋ niŋ n ʒiɛvari puu, dama di miri n yiŋa; ka n ti a pu shɛli din viɛli gari dimbɔŋɔ bee a yi bɔra, n ni yo a di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: One day Ahab said to Naboth, Let me have your vineyard; it is close to my palace, and I want to use the land for a vegetable garden. I will give you a better vineyard for it or, if you prefer, I will pay you a fair price.

dag: Ka tin tital la daa bɔɣi ʒii buta, ka zuliya kam tinsi daa lu n-dahim zaa. Ka Naawuni daa teei Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la yɛla, ka zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili wain pipia la n-ti Babilɔnnima ni bɛ nyu di zaa.
en: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. God remembered Babylon the great so that he gave her the wine cup of his furious anger.

dag: Ka Firawuna suhu daa yu Hadad pam hal ka o ti gbaag o paɣ Tapɛnis tizo n-ti o paɣ pini.
en: Pharaoh was so delighted with Hadad that he gave him one of his wifes sisters for marriage, a sister of Queen Tahpenes.

dag: Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili.
en: Their hands will catch you so that you will not hit your foot on a rock.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yi Bɛtɛl chani ti miri Ɛfirat ka Reechɛl piligi wolisibu ka o wolisibu maa daa kpɛm pam.
en: They left Bethel, and when they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel went into hard labor.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi m-bo chi pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti pa sara maligu tampiŋ bimbini zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma ŋɔ.
en: So Manoah took a young goat and a grain offering and offered them on a rock to the LORD. While Manoah and his wife were looking, an amazing thing happened.

dag: Ka Ram daa nyɛ Aminadab ba, ka Aminadab nyɛ Nashɔn ba, ka Nashɔn mi nyɛ Salimɔn ba.
en: Ram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Salmon.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia yɛli ba, Di viɛla, n ni suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛm maa. Ka o ni garigi yɛli shɛm, n ni yɛli ya. N ku sɔɣi ya shɛli.
en: I answered, Very well, then. I will pray to the Lord our God, just as you have asked, and whatever he says, I will tell you. I will not keep back anything from you.

dag: Hal o ni daa ti ti wahala maa zaa yoli, o ni zo ti nambɔɣu, o yurilim maŋli din galisi pam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.

dag: Di kpalim biɛla ka yuŋ gari, ka di ku yuui ka biɛɣu neei. Chɛliya ka ti chɛ zibisim tuma, ka zaŋ bidibbina n-tuhi tɔbu neesim ni.
en: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O nyɛla tɔbutuhira ŋun tiri nasara. O ni ti di dari yi zuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. O ni ti zaŋ ya leei ninvuɣ pala o yurilim puuni. O ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli yi zuɣu.
en: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.

dag: Naawuni pala ninsala ŋun ni ŋma ʒiri. O mi pala daadam ŋun taɣir o tɛha. O yi lo alikauli, o paani li mi. O mi yi yɛli shɛli, o niŋdi li mi.
en: God is not like people, who lie; He is not a human who changes his mind. Whatever he promises, he does; He speaks, and it is done.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti do tin tital shɛl ni bɛ ni daa kpahi bɛ Duuma tabili dapulli zuɣu la solɔɣu zuɣu. Tiŋ maa yupaa n-nyɛ Sɔdom bee Ijipti.
en: and their bodies will lie in the street of the great city, where their Lord was crucified. The symbolic name of that city is Sodom, or Egypt.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ, ka neeri ni shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili. Dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ yi beni, shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili gba nyɛla din beni.
en: The body that is planted is a physical body. When it is raised, it will be a spiritual body. There is a physical body. So there is also a spiritual body.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa nya ka Leeban bi lan bɔr o yɛla kaman o ni daa pun bɔr o yɛla shɛm la.
en: Jacob also noticed that Laban was not as friendly as he had been before.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, a nini yi shiri tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma a soya din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a, ka a nini maan tiɣi ma pahi. Lan teema ni niriba maa nyɛla a niriba.
en: Now if you do think highly of me, show me your ways so that I may know you and so that you may really approve of me. Remember too that this nation is your people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim shɛb bɛn be zoya tinsi ni mini bɛn be Nɛgɛb ni bɛn be zolɔna ni tinsi ni la.
en: Later, they went down to fight against some more Canaanites who lived in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the western foothills.

dag: Bɛ doonila bɛ zaɣim yuŋ kam, ka ka situra. Bɛ ka binshɛli din ni pili wari saha.
en: At night they sleep with nothing to cover them, nothing to keep them from the cold.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: So you must speak to the people for me. Son of man, prophesy against the people.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli. Dama n nya ka girigiri niŋbu mini duŋ taabu be tiŋ puuni.
en: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city.

dag: Niŋmiya siɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinitaba polo, ka miriya ka yi niŋ yi mabia kam naani, dama mabihi zaa nyɛla yɔhindiba, ka ʒiʒiinikpee kam nyɛ ŋun chani saɣindi niriba yuya.
en: Be wary of your friends! Dont trust your sibling! Every sibling is a cheater, and every friend traffics in slander.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka niriba paɣ a, chɛ ka niriba zaa paɣ a!.
en: May the peoples praise you, O God; may all the peoples praise you!.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka n naba be kaman saŋkpaliŋ naba la, ka chɛ ka n du n-tam luɣ shɛŋa din du.
en: He makes me sure-footed as a deer; he keeps me safe on the mountains.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa lu soli chani Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka o gba dii gbaai anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu m-mali lala hal ti paai Naiɔt Rama tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: As he was going there, the spirit of God took control of him also, and he danced and shouted all the way to Naioth.

dag: Amaa ka Pita mini Jɔn bɔhi ba, Naawuni sani, di luhiya ni ti wumla yi noli bee ŋun Naawuni dini? Yɛlimiya ti!.
en: But Peter and John answered them, What do you think is right? What would God want? Should we obey you or God?.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi lu soli gbaai chandi m-mali hal ti paai wulimpuhili polɔnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: As Jacob continued on his way to the east.

dag: ka yɛli ni bɛn fiɣisir o maa kamila a sanna. Amaŋmaŋ yi zahim o a ni baŋ ti ni yɛli ni o tum tuun shɛŋa maa.
en: By examining him yourself, you will be able to verify the allegations we are bringing against him.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin puhimiya ba puhiri suŋ.
en: When you go to a home, give it your blessing of peace.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ bi wuhiri ni n zaani ya la zaligu, amaa n zaŋdila shɛb nini ni mooi bɛ tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla n-wuhiri ya ni n nya ni yi gba yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli.
en: Im not giving an order, but by mentioning the commitment of others, Im trying to prove the authenticity of your love also.

dag: Ka nahiŋgu mini wahala ni suhugarigu daa ti chɛ ka bɛ filim.
en: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.

dag: Dama o pala ninsala kaman n ni nyɛ ninsal shɛm ŋɔ, ka n ni tooi garigi yɛl o shɛli, bee ka m min o ni ti chaŋ ʒiishee.
en: God is not a human like me, so I cannot argue with him. I cannot take him to court.

dag: ka tin yin nim ni ti yɛli tin shɛlinima, Ti chanimi ni ti ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. Kamiyana ka ti mini ya chaŋ.
en: Those of one town will go to another and say, We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Naa Amɔn polo maa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: The people of Judah killed Amon's assassins and made his son Josiah king.

dag: O ni ti fa yi puri mini yi wain tihi ni yi Olivi tihi puri zaa din mali vuhim n-zaŋ ti o tumtumdiba.
en: He will take your best fields, vineyards, and olive groves and give them to his servants.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Dama Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba. .
en: So the Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ gbahi n niriba chaŋ ka bɛ bi baŋ. Kum ni ku yi zuɣulaannima, ka kɔnyuri ku yi tarimba mi.
en: and so you will be carried away as prisoners. Your leaders will starve to death, and the common people will die of thirst.

dag: Rama tiŋ puuni ka bɛ wum vuri din nyɛ fabila mini kumsi ni nandahima yɛla pam. Reechɛl kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka bɛ balim o je, dama bɛ zaa lan kani.
en: In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.

dag: O daa zali maligumaaniba ka ti ba bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni, ka kpaŋsi ba bɛ tuma maa ni.
en: He assigned the priests to their posts, encouraging them to fulfill their responsibilities in the LORDs temple.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohaths sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: N ni darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna, ka wuna maa nyɛ din galisi gari wuna din be Jɛrusalɛm mini Samaria la tibili.
en: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.

dag: O daa piila o dabili Dauda, o daa yih o la piɛgulibo ni.
en: And God chose David, his servant, taking him from the sheepfolds.

dag: N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: I have filled him with the divine spirit, with skill, ability, and knowledge for every kind of work.

dag: Ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo, ka daa zaŋ Giliadnim ninvuɣ pihinu chaŋ Samaria nti kpe nayili puuni birini ni nti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Pekah, Remaliahs son and Pekahiahs officer, plotted against him. Pekah struck Pekahiah in Samaria at the palace fortress, along with Argob and Arieh. Pekah had fifty Gileadites with him. He murdered Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.

dag: N ni saɣim kikaa saha yiya, ka saɣim woligu saha yiya, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali yiya shɛŋa lu n-dahim, ka chɛ ka yiya din nyɛ zaɣ kara wum. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will destroy winter houses and summer houses. The houses decorated with ivory will fall in ruins; every large house will be destroyed.

dag: Ka doo kam ŋun bi guni, bɛn yihim o o daŋ ni, o ni bi gbibi n daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: Any uncircumcised male whose flesh of his foreskin remains uncircumcised will be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Absalom, ka o kana ti damdi naa tooni, ka naa daa mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: So Joab went to King David and told him what Absalom had said. The king sent for Absalom, who went to him and bowed down to the ground in front of him. The king welcomed him with a kiss.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ ma Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni nti tam zo titali din du pam zuɣu n-wuhi ma tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina.
en: The Spirit took control of me, and the angel carried me to the top of a very high mountain. He showed me Jerusalem, the Holy City, coming down out of heaven from God.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam pala bindira mini binnyura yɛla, amaa di nyɛla wuntia mini suhudoo ni suhupiɛlli yɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.

dag: Hɔrinim mi n-daa pun be Ɛdom, amaa ka Iso zuliya daa ti ŋme n-deei li, ka ku ba ka ʒini nimaani n-zani bɛ zaani kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ shɛm Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su li la ni la.
en: The Horites used to live in Edom, but the descendants of Esau chased them out, destroyed their nation, and settled there themselves, just as the Israelites later chased their enemies out of the land that the Lord gave them.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. N ni lan chɛ ka yi be suɣa ni yaha kaman yi ni daa pun be di ni shɛm yi chuɣu puhibu dabisa saha la.
en: Israel, I, the Lord , am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini pagɔrili ŋɔ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Therefore, you prostitute, hear the LORDs word!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi ʒini momaha zuɣu. Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba, ka bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: He ordered the people to sit down on the grass; then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave thanks to God. He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri bɛnkam mali takarifiɛma ka di wɔrigi ka pa zaɣ muna bee ka bi gbuɣiri ŋubira nyɛla ŋun nyɛ daɣiri bini, ka ŋunkam shihi ba ni be daɣiri ni.
en: All animals that have divided hoofs, but they are not completely split, and that do not rechew food are unclean for you—whoever touches them will be unclean.

dag: Ka Judanim ti sɔŋ zabi Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ŋme n-di zuliya kam bɛn gili ba nɛma din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni situra pam.
en: Even Judah will fight in Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected: gold, silver, and a great abundance of garments.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan yi nti yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ o mi yina nti wuhi ya ka yi baŋ ni m bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: Pilate went back out once more and said to the crowd, Look, I will bring him out here to you to let you see that I cannot find any reason to condemn him.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba ni di pala Romnim kali ni bɛ kari so saria ka dilan maŋmaŋ kani n-ni zani ka o mini bɛn fiɣisir o maa gbiɛri kpa taba, ka o tɔɣisi chihi o noli bɛ ni fiɣisir o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa.
en: But I told them, When a man is accused of doing something wrong, Romans dont hand him over for others to judge. First, he must face the people accusing him. And then he must be allowed to defend himself against their charges.

dag: Amaa n daa bi lan niŋ lala, dama n daa je ni n yuli saɣim lala zuliyanim maa sani. Dama bɛ ninni ka n da yihi ba na.
en: But I did not. That would have disgraced me in front of the nations that had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bua, ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If you offer a goat.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ; Niŋmiya tuuba, ka chɛ yi buɣa ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka zo n-yi din chihiri la tumbu ni.
en: Therefore, say to the house of Israel, The LORD God proclaims: Come back! Turn away from your idols and from all your detestable practices. Turn away!.

dag: Ka di ti leei shihirili shɛli din yɛn lo yi nuu ni, ka be yi gbɛri zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi teeri di yɛla din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ zaligu maa yɛla kul be yi noya ni, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu ka o daa zaŋ yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: This celebration will be like wearing a sign on your hand or on your forehead, because then you will pass on to others the teaching of the Lord , whose mighty power brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka peentɔriba daa to Naa Jɔsia piɛm ka di gbaag o, ka o daa yɛl o kpambaliba bɛn be o sani, Zaŋmiya ma yi kpaŋa, dama n nya daŋ pam.
en: Then King Josiah was shot by arrows while he was in the battle. He told his servants, Take me away, I am wounded badly.

dag: Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni shɛb bɛn kpalim la? Dama ti pun po Yawɛ sani ni ti ni so di zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti ba.
en: What can we do to provide wives for the ones who are left, since we ourselves have made a pledge before the LORD not to allow our daughters to marry them.

dag: Ŋuni ka Izraɛl naa lee yina kariti doli ŋɔ? Ŋuni ka a lee kariti doli ni a ku ŋɔ? A kariti dolila ba kpiŋ! A kariti dolila buduli zaɣ bila.
en: So who is Israels king coming after? Who are you chasing? A dead dog? A single flea?.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa ʒi gbaridɔɣirili na nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duno shɛli din yuli daa booni Duno Viɛlli la shee. Bɛ daa yi pun ʒir o la lala na nti sɔŋdi nimaani sahakam ka o maani bɛn kpɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bara.
en: There at the Beautiful Gate, as it was called, was a man who had been lame all his life. Every day he was carried to the gate to beg for money from the people who were going into the Temple.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yi bihi yi ti bɔhi bɛ banim dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: And he said to the people of Israel, In the future, when your children ask you what these stones mean.

dag: ka a ni tooi zaŋ li zali di tuma shee ka mi so shɛŋa din kuni di yiŋa?.
en: Can you lead them home?.

dag: Ka n daa lihi bɔri bɛ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun ni mali me gooni maa zali, ka zani tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaani gooni maa voli ni n tooni din ni chɛ ka n ku wurim li, amaa ka bi nya so.
en: I looked for someone who could build a wall, who could stand in the places where the walls have crumbled and defend the land when my anger is about to destroy it, but I could find no one.

dag: Sool ni daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ yɛlli maa ni nyɛ shɛm, Yawɛ daa bi garig o zahindi puuni bee Urim puuni bee n-chɛ ka anab so yɛl o shɛli.
en: He prayed to the Lord , but the Lord did not answer him. God did not talk to Saul in dreams. God did not use the Urim to give him an answer, and God did not use prophets to speak to Saul.

dag: hal ti damdi Yisa tooni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋ puhir o. Doo maa daa nyɛla Samaria nira.
en: He bowed down at Jesus feet and thanked him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa gbaai Reechɛl kpariŋ mɔɣisi ka kum suhupiɛlli kuhigu pam.
en: He then kissed Rachel and started crying because he was so happy.

dag: Ka yi yi mali karimbanim paai tuhi pia Masia dolibu ni, amaa ba yino ka yi lee mali; dama n leei yi ba Yisa Masia dolibu ni la n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu zuɣu.
en: You may have ten thousand teachers in Christ, but you dont have many fathers. Through the Good News I became your father in Christ Jesus.

dag: Naawuni ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili din zooi pam niŋ bɛ puya ni ka di pali, ka o chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu na kaman saa la, ka di leei bɛ bindirigu.
en: Let them eat all they want! God will punish them in fury and anger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul yɛr o di yɛla dabisili kam, ka o zaɣisi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Haman ni bɛ nya Mɔdɛkai yɛligu maa ni zani, dama o daa pun yɛli ba ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nira.
en: Day after day they questioned him, but he paid no attention to them. So they let Haman know about it just to see whether or not Mordecais words would hold true.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa sɔŋdi niriba pam, amaa jɛra kpirila bɛ yɛm kalinsi zuɣu.
en: A good person's words will benefit many people, but you can kill yourself with stupidity.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa n-leei tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, ka zaŋ maligumaana Zadok mi n-zali Abiata zaani.
en: In his place, the king gave leadership of the army to Benaiah, Jehoiadas son. The king put the priest Zadok in Abiathars position.

dag: N ni ti ba suhu shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni; dama bɛ ni ti labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: I will give them the desire to know that I am the Lord . Then they will be my people, and I will be their God, because they will return to me with all their heart.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti chaŋ tɔbu ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka a chɛ ka bɛ be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa a ni pii tiŋ shɛli ka m me a duu zali ti a yuli jilima ŋɔ polo na n-suh a.
en: When you command your people to go into battle against their enemies and they pray to you, wherever they are, facing this city which you have chosen and this Temple which I have built for you.

dag: n-yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo m-mali hal ti paai Mariɛl n-zaŋ ti to Dabɛshɛt n-gari chaŋ hal ti paai Jokiniam wulimpuhili polo kulibɔŋ la.
en: From there the border went west to Mareal, touching Dabbesheth and the stream east of Jokneam.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ, ka zaŋ o tanti suɣili kpa nimaani. Ka o tumtumdiba daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli nimaani yaha.
en: So Isaac built an altar and worshiped the Lord in that place. He set up camp there, and his servants dug a well.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛ ʒiʒiinitab maa zaa, ka yɛlli ŋɔ daa moli gili Judia zoya zuɣu tinsi zaa.
en: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and everyone throughout the Judean highlands talked about what had happened.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni din kɔŋ jilima, ka neeri ni jilima. Di sɔɣirimi ni chɔɣinsi, ka neeri ni yiko.
en: When the body is planted, it is without honor. But when it is raised, it will be great and glorious. When the body is planted, it is weak. But when it is raised, it will be full of power.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ɛlim, ka kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani m-miri kom maa.
en: Then the people traveled to Elim. At Elim there were twelve springs of water and palm trees. So the people made their camp there near that water.

dag: Rɛzin ni Nɛkɔda ni Gazam ni.
en: Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam.

dag: Di saha maa Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la daa gbibila bɛ tɔbutuhiri bidibbina ʒe dunol ni.
en: The men from the tribe of Dan stood at the entrance of the gate. They all had their weapons and were ready for war.

dag: Ka o bapir daa ti bɔh o min o tumtumda maa, Ya ka yi lee chaŋ? Ka Sool garigi yɛl o, Ti daa chaŋla bunsi la bɔbu; ka daa ti bo ba je ka chaŋ Samuɛl sani.
en: Sauls uncle said to him and to his young servant, Where did you go? To look for the donkeys, Saul replied, but when we couldnt find anything, we went to Samuel.

dag: N zaŋla yurilim din bi naari gbibi niriba tuhilituhili ka chɛri bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi taali, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ biɛri bihi tibili mini bɛ yaansi tibili zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmana din pahir ata mini anahi ni.
en: I keep my promise for thousands of generations and forgive evil and sin; but I will not fail to punish children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generation for the sins of their parents.

dag: Ka yaɣ yini yi biɛra, yaɣa maa zaa biɛrimi; ka yaɣ yini yi nya jilima, yaɣa maa zaa malila suhupiɛlli.
en: If one part of the body suffers, then all the other parts suffer with it. Or if one part is honored, then all the other parts share its honor.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba n-daa kul pali duu maa ni, ka Filistianim nanim zaa gba be nimaani. Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn kalinli daa nyɛ kaman tusaata daa be duu maa dufahirili zuɣusaa lihiri Samsin ni diɛmdi maa.
en: The Philistine rulers were celebrating in a temple packed with people and with , more on the flat roof. They had all been watching Samson and making fun of him.

dag: Lala ka di lan simdi ni yi zaŋ yi naɣilabil tuuli bee yi biŋkɔbbaligu bi tuuli kam ti ma. O ni be o ma sani daba ayopɔin, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ o ti ma.
en: Give me the first-born of your cattle and your sheep. Let the first-born male stay with its mother for seven days, and on the eighth day offer it to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-ka Hɛlam na. Ka Sirianim maa daa niŋ shili yina ti liri Dauda ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba.
en: When David heard about this, he gathered all the Israelites together. They crossed over the Jordan River and went to Helam. There the Arameans prepared for battle and attacked.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ mi sabilifaa n-lo li tabili bantabiga la, ka di ti be bantabiga maa tooni polo.
en: Tie it to the front of the turban with a blue cord.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima.
en: The descendants of Egypt were the people of Lydia, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirimina ti zani kpe. Ka o dii yiɣisi zani niriba maa ni.
en: But Jesus knew their thoughts and said to the man, Stand up and come here to the front. The man got up and stood there.

dag: N yaannim daa tuhi saɣim fɔntinsi din nyɛ Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ka daa ku Bɛtidɛn niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa, ka bɛ zaa naawuna daa bi tooi tiligi ba.
en: My ancestors destroyed the cities of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and killed the people of Betheden who lived in Telassar, and none of their gods could save them.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Chɛliya ka o niŋ yomyom n-tum o tuma ka ti nya; kul chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tum o ni lo shɛm ka ti baŋ li.
en: And you say, Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa yur o paɣ Maaka ŋun nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga maa n-gar o paɣ shɛb bɛn pahi min o mamanim zaa. .
en: Rehoboam loved Absaloms daughter Maacah more than all his wives and secondary wives. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty secondary wives, twenty-eight sons, and sixty daughters.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa bahi nimaani, ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa kahi di zaa chaŋ.
en: The Philistines left the statues of their gods behind at Baal Perazim. David and his men took them away.

dag: Di piligu dali zaŋ hal ti paai di naabu dali, Ɛzra daa kul karindila Naawuni zaligu litaafi maa dabisili kam. Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ daa zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa, ka daa niŋ Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali kaman zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: From the first day of the festival to the last they read a part of God's Law every day. They celebrated for seven days, and on the eighth day there was a closing ceremony, as required in the Law.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di tuhiya ni n neei yi tɛha ka yi teeri yɛla ŋɔ, n ni na kul be n nyɛvili ni ŋɔ.
en: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dabisili dali kam, sokam zaa yihim kaman Naawuni ni lɔrig o shɛm tariga na ti zali, ka di chɛ ka n ti kana ka laɣ tɔhibu yɛla ku lan beni yaha.
en: Every Sunday each of you must put aside some money, in proportion to what you have earned, and save it up, so that there will be no need to collect money when I come.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛ ni boli ni bɛ ka Piɛbil maa amiliya lɔbu chuɣu bindirigu dibu ni na mal alibarika! Ka lan yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu maŋli.
en: Then the angel said to me, Write this: Happy are those who have been invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb. And the angel added, These are the true words of God.

dag: O ni daa yɛl o lala bahi ka kpe yili maa ni, o nya ka niriba pam m-pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: Peter continued talking with Cornelius. Then Peter went inside and saw a large group of people gathered there.

dag: Di saha ka n daa zaŋ wain duɣuri mini pipihi zali Rɛkabinim maa ka yɛli ba, Nyumiya wain.
en: Then I set bowls full of wine before the Rechabites, along with several cups, and I said to them, Have some.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. O daa nyɛla Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eleven years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hamutal; she was a daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni mali bidibbin shɛlikam jɛndi ya ku tooi niŋ ya shɛli; ka yi ni tooi garigi ŋunkam zaŋ ya taali bɔhigu. Man Yawɛ ni zabi n daba zuɣu, ka ti ba nasara.
en: No weapon fashioned against you will succeed, and you may condemn every tongue that disputes with you. This is the heritage of the LORDs servants, whose righteousness comes from me, says the LORD.

dag: Amɔri nanima anu la daa zo nti sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: But during the fight, the five kings ran away. They hid in a cave near Makkedah.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛba ayiyi bɛn mali nyɛvili daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu.
en: All these animals went into the boat with Noah. They came in groups of two from every kind of animal that had the breath of life.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka sagbana zibigi ka sagani booi sagbana maa ni.
en: Whenever I cover the sky with clouds and the rainbow appears.

dag: dama bɛ daa kul zaŋ li tila bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu malibu tuma maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tum di malibu maa tuma kɔŋko.
en: It went only to pay for repairs.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi zaa la yi nti yɛli ba, Gbaamiy o tim tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni chaŋ, ka so yi dol o na, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dilana. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛliya, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: Then the priest Jehoiada brought out the unit commanders who were in charge of the army. Take her out under guard, he told them, and kill anyone who follows her. This was because the priest had said, She must not be executed in the LORDs temple.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim paɣi yi naba, ka yi bahi mi lɛli yi dimnim maa ʒim.
en: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.

dag: ka o niŋ li pam niŋ ti ni la zuɣu. Naawuni yɛm min o ni nyari din be tooni zaa la zuɣu.
en: God gave us that grace fully and freely. With full wisdom and understanding.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣi Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, man daa pun beni.
en: I assure you, Jesus replied, before Abraham was, I Am.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba, Yumiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ karimbaandan tibili pam.
en: All you who are faithful, love the LORD! The LORD protects those who are loyal, but he pays the proud back to the fullest degree.

dag: Bɛ kul teemi gili ma luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: Yes, they surrounded me on every single side, but I cut them down in the LORDs name.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus daa zaŋ li n-tila Mitrɛdat ŋun daa nyɛ laɣiguliba kpɛm ŋun daa niŋ di laasabu n-ti Juda gomna Shɛshibaza la.
en: He handed them over to Mithredath, chief of the royal treasury, who made an inventory of them for Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.

dag: Doo maa ni daa na kul ʒe n sani maa, ka n daa wum ka so tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni na.
en: I heard someone speaking to me from inside the Temple. The man was still standing beside me.

dag: Wummiya Hɔrɔnaimnim kuhigu na. Damili dambu mini saɣiŋgu pam.
en: Listen to the cries from Horonaim. They are cries of much confusion and destruction.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lan labi pahi naba ayi ka Yisifu daa kahig omaŋ n-wuh o biɛyanim maa ka bɛ baŋ o, ka Firawuna gba daa baŋ ŋun Yisifu biɛyanim maa.
en: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.

dag: O gbibila gummua o nuu ni, ka mali o nubihi wahiri jɛni.
en: She spins her own cloth.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni saɣim yɛnnim yɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali fahim fahim ŋari.
en: It is written in scripture: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will reject the intelligence of the intelligent .

dag: ka bo wain lita ayi din nyɛ binnyura sara la ni sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: You will present a half hin of wine for a drink offering as a food gift that is a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina o ni yihi paɣ so maa sani.
en: He said, Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman has sinned against his wife. He is guilty of adultery.

dag: nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Nyama, n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim tɛha, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni puuni so ku ŋman a, ka so mi ti ku yiɣis a kalinsi nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman a.
en: I will do what you have asked. I will give you more wisdom and understanding than anyone has ever had before or will ever have again.

dag: Dauda ni daa kul yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Jɔnatan suhu dii gbaai Dauda, ka o daa yur o kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm.
en: David and Saul finished talking, and soon David and Jonathan became best friends. Jonathan thought as much of David as he did of himself.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu Dɛɛbi ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda, ka bɛ daa yi ni n-lab Listra mini Aikɔnium ni Antiɔk.
en: Paul and Barnabas proclaimed the good news to the people in Derbe and made many disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch, where.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam ni o ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: All the things that Manasseh did, including the sins that he committed, are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda ŋun nyɛ Ibrahimma yaaŋa la zuliya ni na dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the list of the ancestors of Jesus Christ, a descendant of David, who was a descendant of Abraham.

dag: Kurimbuni ha zaŋ na ni pumpɔŋɔ, so nini na ʒi n-nya bee n-wum ni Naawuni so beni pah a zuɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi tuun kara tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guhir o.
en: From ancient times, no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any god but you who acts on behalf of those who wait for him!.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ Dauda din viɛl zaa yɛla yɛl o ba Sool, ka lan yɛl o, Naa, di bi simdi ni a tum taali zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda polo, dama o na ʒi n-tum a taali, ka o tuma zaa lan nyɛ din sɔŋd a.
en: Jonathan praised David to Saul and said, Sir, don't do wrong to your servant David. He has never done you any wrong; on the contrary, everything he has done has been a great help to you.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa wum Naawuni zaligu kundi maa ni yɛli shɛm, o daa darigimi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: As soon as the king heard what the Instruction scroll said, he ripped his clothes.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka bi saɣi ka naɣ yɛli ma mi, Di saɣiya, di lan yɛli ma yɛlli ŋɔ yaha.
en: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. That's enough! he said. I don't want to hear any more.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, dinzuɣu gbibiya n zaligunim mini n ni yɛli ya shɛm, ka tummiya tuun shɛli din ni chɛ ka daadam be.
en: Follow the practices and the laws that I give you; you will save your life by doing so. I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Izraɛl Naa Pɛka daa kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka teei gil li, amaa ka daa bi tooi nyaŋ Naa Ahaz.
en: Then Arams King Rezin and Israels King Pekah, Remaliahs son, came up to Jerusalem to fight. They surrounded Ahaz, but they werent able to defeat him.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka yi ni niŋ yaa. So ku lan nahim ya, ka dabiɛm ku lan mali ya. So ku lan kpɛhi ya dabiɛm, di ni ti niŋ ya katiŋa.
en: Justice and right will make you strong. You will be safe from oppression and terror.

dag: Lihimi zuɣusaa ka a nya, nyam sagbana din be a zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha.
en: Look up at the sky. Look at the clouds, which are so much higher than you.

dag: Ka Naawuni malaika ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim maa tooni la daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo, ka sagban daantaliga la gba daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: The angel of God, who had been in front of the army of Israel, moved and went to the rear. The pillar of cloud also moved until it was.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Zanim a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini, ka n yi kpaŋ ha; di pa shɛli ka Yawɛ ka n sanna. Ka o yi wuhi ma shɛlikam, n ni zaŋ li yɛl a. Ka o daa chaŋ ti du n-tam kuŋkun nɛli zuɣu.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Stay by your entirely burned offering. I will go and perhaps the LORD will grant me an appearance and speak. Whatever he shows me, I will tell you. Then he went off to a high outlook.

dag: N ni chɛ ka pɔhim yi zuɣusaa yaɣa anahi ŋɔ na ti ʒe Ɛlamnima, ka n chɛ ka pɔhim maa ʒe ba bahi luɣilikam, ka Ɛlam kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ti zo n-kuli zuliya kam ni.
en: I will bring the four winds against Elam. I will bring them from the four corners of the skies. I will send the people of Elam to every place on the earth where the four winds blow. Elams captives will be carried away to every nation.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa jɛndi Ijiptinim maa, ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm, ka bɛ niŋ Yawɛ min o dabili Musa yɛda.
en: Israel saw the amazing power of the LORD against the Egyptians. The people were in awe of the LORD, and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.

dag: ka lɔri zaɣ biɛɣu o tɛha puuni, ka tahiri tuɣiligu na sahakam.
en: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.

dag: Ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira maa yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, di ku yuui ka n shiri kana! Ami! Chɛ ka di niŋ lala. Kamina, ti Duuma Yisa!.
en: The one who has spoken these things says, I am coming soon! So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!.

dag: Bɛ ni yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, amaa yinima ni kum ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.

dag: Amaa saha ni daa ti paai, Naawuni daa tim o Bia na n-chɛ ka paɣ dɔɣ o fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni.
en: But when the right time finally came, God sent his own Son. He came as the son of a human mother and lived under the Jewish Law.

dag: Damaskus yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Damaskus ku lan nyɛla tiŋa. Di ni kabi lu n-duhi doya.
en: This is a message about Damascus : Damascus is now a city, but it will be destroyed. Only ruined buildings will be left there.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu Abib goli ni, dama Abib goli maa ni yuŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisahaku daa suhi alibarika din ti yɛn kana saha shɛli n-niŋ Yaakubu mini Iso ni.
en: By faith Isaac also blessed Jacob and Esau concerning their future.

dag: Ka o daa gindi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo tinsi zaa n-yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So he went through the whole area around the Jordan River and told the people Gods message. He told them to be baptized to show that they wanted to change their lives, and then their sins would be forgiven.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni lab kuli nti lan laɣim tɔbbihi bɛn galisi gar o tuuli tɔbbihi la. Ka saha ti paai ka o zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam ka mali bidibbina n-lan labina.
en: The king of Syria will go back and gather a larger army than he had before. When the proper time comes, he will return with a large, well-equipped army.

dag: Mani n-zal a ni a kul mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul be a sani luɣ shɛlikam a ni chana.
en: Remember that I have commanded you to be determined and confident! Do not be afraid or discouraged, for I, the Lord your God, am with you wherever you go.

dag: O daa wurim tinzun buɣa maligu bimbina la mini buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka ŋme n-kabisi di daantalisi, ka wurim Ashɛrim.
en: He took away the altars of the foreigners and the high places. He also smashed the memorial stones and cut down the Asherah poles.

dag: Ka ŋun vo bua la tahi Azazɛl sani la, di simdi ka o paɣ o nɛma ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.

dag: Hiram daa lan yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa ni dunia, ka nyɛ ŋun ti Naa Dauda bi so ŋun mali baŋsim mini yɛm, ka lan mi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga, din ni me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka lan me omaŋmaŋ nam yili ŋɔ.
en: Bless the LORD, Israels God, who made heaven and earth. He gave King David a wise son who possesses the knowledge and understanding to build a temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself.

dag: Dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa piɛma nyɔɣi ma, ka di lɔɣu kpe n ni. Naawuni zaŋla dabiɛm sɔŋ tuɣi tab gu ma.
en: The Almightys arrows are in me; my spirit drinks their poison, and Gods terrors are arrayed against me.

dag: Buɣim be bɛ tooni dira ka buɣim zilima be bɛ nyaaŋa polo dira, ka tiŋgbani din be bɛ tooni be kaman Idɛn puu la, amaa ka bɛ nyaaŋa polo ŋmani tiŋgban nɛli, ka binshɛli kani n-ni tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: The army will destroy the land like a burning fire. In front of them the land will be like the Garden of Eden. Behind them the land will be like an empty desert. Nothing will escape them.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi n-jɛm binyoya din ka buchi, ka ku tooi tiligi ya ŋɔ, dama di ka buchi.
en: Dont turn aside to follow useless idols that cant help you or save you. Theyre absolutely useless!.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama bɛn be ti sani gari bɛn be bɛ sani.
en: Elisha said, Dont be afraid. The army that fights for us is larger than the army that fights for Aram.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ puuni, a ka yɛlimaŋli, n ni garig a: Naawuni galisiya gari daadam kam.
en: But I tell you, Job, you are wrong. God is greater than any human being.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira. Tɛhi shɛli ni bi mali yinim shɛb ŋɔ, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya. Pirigimiya yi situra sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buri so yi shɛhi ni.
en: Tremble, all of you who are at ease; shudder, all of you who are secure! Strip yourselves, bare your skin, and tie mourning clothes around your waist.

dag: Ka yi ni zaŋ yi bimbɔba maa na ti mali gahibu sara vuhim dabisi shɛli dali maa neei biɛɣu, yin kalimiya dabisa hal ti paai bakɔi ayopɔin dɛde.
en: You must count off seven weeks starting with the day after the Sabbath, the day you bring the bundle for the uplifted offering; these must be complete.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni bɛ di ŋubi mɔri bee bimbilli kam bee tihi vari, amaa ni bɛ nahimmila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka Naawuni bintabinda la bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu la.
en: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.

dag: M bihi, kamiyana nti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ; n yɛn wuhi ya la Yawɛ sizuura lubu.
en: Come, children, listen to me. Let me teach you how to honor the LORD.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ku ŋma ʒiri bee n-taɣ o ni pun yɛli shɛm, dama o pala ninsala ka ni yɛli shɛli ka lan taɣi.
en: Besides, the eternal God of Israel isn't a human being. He doesn't tell lies or change his mind.

dag: Lala ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la gba daa niŋ yi taali ni Naawuni sani, o ni daa deei tuumba la n-chɛ ka bɛ taɣi doli so shɛli n-zo n-tiligi la puuni.
en: Another example is Rahab. She was a prostitute, but she was made right with God by something she did. She helped those who were spying for Gods people. She welcomed them into her home and helped them escape by a different road.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He did what the Lord said was wrong. He did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat that caused Israel to sin.

dag: Di pa shɛli na so ni tooi mali napaɣiba pihiyɔbu, ka mali mamanim pihinii ni paɣisara bɛn ka kalinli.
en: What if I could have sixty queens, eighty wives, and thousands of others!.

dag: A yɛla gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli maa tinsi ni zaa, ka dabiɛm pam gbahi bɛ nanima a zuɣu, ka bɛ nina ni maligi.
en: People living along the coast are shocked at the news. Their rulers are horrified, and terror is written across their faces.

dag: Ka o mali Naawuni Kundi yɛligu kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra, Di daa kpala talahi ni Masia di wahala ka lan neei kum ni, dinzuɣu n ni yihiri Yisa so waazu maa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: and explaining the Scriptures, and proving from them that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from death. This Jesus whom I announce to you, Paul said, is the Messiah.

dag: Amaa o daa bi wurim buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul maani maligu nimaani, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: However, the shrines werent removed. People kept sacrificing and burning incense at them.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be man Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, yɛlimiy o ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa.
en: But also say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to question the LORD: This is what the LORD, Israels God, says about the message youve just heard.

dag: M bia, dol a ba zaligu, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: My son, keep your fathers command; dont abandon your mothers instruction.

dag: Ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba, ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri ye n-chaŋ Amɔz bia anab Aizaia sani.
en: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell me:.

dag: Amaa yiya din be tiŋkpan shɛŋa bɛ ni bi me goma gili ni, din mini puri din be mɔɣu ni ni ti nyɛla yim, bɛ ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, ka ni ti tooi lan deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: But houses in unwalled villages are to be treated like fields; the original owner has the right to buy them back, and they are to be returned in the Year of Restoration.

dag: N ni yɛri ya yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda.
en: But I tell the truth, and that is why you do not believe me.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya n-daa nyɛ Mahilinim daŋ mini Mushinim daŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Mɛrari zuliya.
en: The family groups of Mahli and Mushi belonged to the Merari family. There were men and boys who were one month old or older in the Mahli family group.

dag: Amaa dindali maa, n ni woligi Goshɛn, n niriba ni be luɣ shɛli polo la, ka zɔhi maa ti ku be nimaani dina din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord 's people in Goshen won't be bothered by flies, but your people in the rest of the country will be tormented by them. That's how you will know that the Lord is here in Egypt. This miracle will happen tomorrow.

dag: dama di bemi kaman so ni daa yɛli la: O zuɣu ka ti be ka damda, ka kul be ŋɔ. Di lan bemi kaman yi baŋdib shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la, Ti gba shiri yila Naawuni ni na.
en: In God we live, move, and exist. As some of your own poets said, We are his offspring.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab said to Abishai, If the Arameans are too strong for me, you must help me. But if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will help you.

dag: Ka salo maa tahi bɛ zuɣu ni bɛ foma; amaa ka bɛ maan kuhi pam yɛli, Ti dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, Lord and Son of David, have pity on us.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su maa ni, ka n ti zaŋ dɔr biɛɣu niŋ so yil ni yi ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: I am giving the land of Canaan to your people. Your people will enter that land. At that time I might cause mildew to grow in someones house.

dag: ka yɛl o, Wuhim ma a ba ni nyɛ so. Duri be a ba yiŋa ka ti ni gbe nimaani.
en: He said, Please tell me whose daughter you are. Is there room in your fathers house for us to spend the night.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti kabi bɛ ni daa kpahi niriba ayi shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu pahi Yisa zuɣu la ŋun daŋ tooni min o kpee la gbaya;.
en: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.

dag: Di kari mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ saria, dama so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ka taali a sani.
en: Don't put me, your servant, on trial; no one is innocent in your sight.

dag: O ku kabigi gbiŋgbaŋ din dalim. O mi ku kpihi firila mia din diri biɛlabiɛla. O ni wuhi zaligu soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: He will not break off a bent reed nor put out a flickering lamp. He will bring lasting justice to all.

dag: A mi zaligu shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa? A ni tooi zaŋ lala zaligunim zali dunia ŋɔ ni?.
en: Do you know heavens laws, or can you impose its rule on earth?.

dag: Di yi pa lala Masidɔnianim shɛb yi nyɛla bɛn doli ma kana nti nya ka yi bi mali shili, ti ni di vi zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋ ya naani shɛm la polo, amaa di bahi bamdi yinima.
en: However, if the people from Macedonia should come with me and find out that you are not ready, how ashamed we would be—not to speak of your shame—for feeling so sure of you!.

dag: Paɣ bee doo yi leei jinwara bee bukpaha bɛn kum o. Bɛn labimi ba kuɣa. Bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.

dag: di simdi ni a yo ba bɛ dabisili kam tuma yɔri, ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu, ; di yi pa lala bɛ ni fabili niŋ Yawɛ, ka a kpe taali ni.
en: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord , and he will punish you.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe Kapɛrinium tiŋ puuni saha shɛli, ka Rom sapashin so daa ka o sanna nti balind o yɛra.
en: When Jesus went to Capernaum, a centurion approached.

dag: Dama o kul wuhirila zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe, biɛlifu kpe.
en: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.

dag: Ka so yi je o kpee ka daag o luhi bee n-zaŋ bini lab o bee n-sɔɣi dɔni gu o ku o.
en: If you hate someone and kill him by pushing him down or by throwing something at him.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋ maa yiya pia kam puuni zaɣ yini lu, ka ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin daa kpi tiŋgbani dambu maa ni, ka dabiɛm gbahi bɛn kpalim, ka bɛ ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo bahi yoli din ka bahigu puuni; ka bɛ mini ti Duuma ni o yiko din mali jilima la ni ti woligi taba.
en: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lords presence and away from his mighty glory.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi jɛrigu nya yɛla; jɛrigu ba ka suhupiɛlli.
en: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni yɛli naa ti a.
en: All right, she said. I'll ask him.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Mariama, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama a mali zuɣusuŋ pam Naawuni sani.
en: The angel said to her, Don't be afraid, Mary; God has been gracious to you.

dag: Ka n daa lan kab jaaŋgbe shɛli din pah ayi ka di yuli booni Naŋgban yini la, ka Juda mini Izraɛl naŋgbanyini biɛhigu la daa saɣim.
en: Then I broke the stick named Unity and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.

dag: Ninsal yɛlli kam ʒila o zuɣu, amaa yɛlli kam malila di soli ni di saha.
en: because theres a right time and right way for every matter. But human misfortunes are overwhelming.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me yaɣ shɛli din daa be pia din du pam la tooni hal ti paai Ofɛl gooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.

dag: n-wurim di bimbina la, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma buɣili Ashɛrim min o binnana la zaa m-baɣisibaɣisi li ka di be kaman taŋkpa zim, ka daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbina din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Throughout the territory of the Northern Kingdom he smashed the altars and the symbols of Asherah, ground the idols to dust, and broke into bits all the incense altars. Then he returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sokam ŋmanila shilinshia. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam nyɛla yoli. Bɛ laɣindila bɛ nyamma sɔŋda, ka bi mi ŋun ti yɛn di li.
en: Our life is like an image in a mirror. We rush through life collecting things, but we dont know who will get them after we die.

dag: Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tiligim ti! Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tim ti nasara!.
en: Save us, Lord , save us! Give us success, O Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa yiɣisi bo tɔbutuhiri biinsi niriba tusaata Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Zif mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee Zif mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul took , of Israel's best soldiers and went to look for David there in Ziph Desert.

dag: Ʒiri be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɛha ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri din viɛli tumbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: People who work for evil make trouble, but those who plan for peace bring happiness.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɔnatan daa ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, Kamina ka ti chaŋ Filistia tɔbbi shɛb bɛn be yaɣili ŋɔ polo ha nim sani. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba.
en: That day, Sauls son Jonathan was talking with the young man who carried his weapons. Jonathan said, Lets go to the Philistine camp on the other side of the valley. But Jonathan did not tell his father.

dag: So daa bi lo a nuhi, so mi daa bi ba a naba bandi. A lumi kaman nir ni lu putɔɣulan tooni shɛm la. Ka niriba maa zaa daa lan kum o zuɣu yaha.
en: Your hands werent bound, your feet werent chained, but you have fallen like someone falls before the wicked. Then the troops cried over Abner again.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli Ɛli, Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yi tɔb maa tuhibu shee n-zo m-paai kpe na zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Ɛli bɔh o, M bia, tɔb maa be wula.
en: I escaped from the fighting today and ran here. Young man, what happened? Eli asked.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa bi so ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu tirila o ma suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise child makes a father glad, but a foolish child brings sorrow to his mother.

dag: Shɛla ni daa dɔɣi Ɛba maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Eber was born, Shelah lived years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anii puuni ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Bɛrɛkia bia Anabi Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la yɛli.
en: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:.

dag: Naawuni, a nam nyɛla din kul ni beni sahakam. A nam jaaŋgbee tumdila din tuhi.
en: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka yi ku ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ʒim yihibu taali ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Do this, so that innocent people will not die and so that you will not be guilty of putting them to death in the land that the Lord is giving you.

dag: A mini Dɛdannim daa niŋdila wɔrinyaampara daabiligu.
en: Dedan was your agent for saddle blankets.

dag: Hal Babilɔn naa kpambaliba tuumba ni daa kana ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ shihirili shɛli din niŋ o tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Naawuni daa chɛ o mi ni o niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm, ka di chɛ ka o zahim o baŋ dinkam zaa be o suhu ni.
en: and even when the Babylonian ambassadors came to inquire about the unusual event that had happened in the land, God let Hezekiah go his own way only in order to test his character.

dag: ka Zɛfania nyɛ Tahat bia, ka Tahat nyɛ Asir bia, ka Asir nyɛ Ɛbiasaf bia, ka Ɛbiasaf nyɛ Kɔra bia.
en: Zephaniah was Tahaths son; Tahath was Assirs son; Assir was Ebiasaphs son; Ebiasaph was Korahs son;.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa bi tooi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pun be Jɛrusalɛm la bahi. Dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Judanim na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the people of Judah were not able to drive out the Jebusites, who lived in Jerusalem. The Jebusites still live there with the people of Judah.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, Karimba, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini.
en: Peter said to Jesus, Teacher, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa ti ka mɔɣili maa ni na ni o ti su kom. Ka o min o paɣisara daa baɣisiri mɔɣili maa chana, ka o daa ti nya piɛɣu maa ni su kaɣili ni, ka o tim o paɣisara maa ni yino ni o chaŋ ti zaŋ li na.
en: About that time one of the king's daughters came down to take a bath in the river, while her servant women walked along the river bank. She saw the basket in the tall grass and sent one of them to pull it out of the water.

dag: A yi bi fa bɛ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ so chani ni bɛ ti ku m-bahi, ka o chani ŋun yɛn ku o sani ka o naba sɔhira.
en: If you see someone on their way to death or in danger of being killed, you must do something to save them.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Kpamiya zoya ŋɔ polo, ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ku chirigi ya; kul sɔɣimiya be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ti labina pɔi ka yi naanyi yiɣisi kuli.
en: Go into the hill country, she said, or the king's men will find you. Hide there for three days until they come back. After that, you can go on your way.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Anyone who obeys my Father in heaven is my brother or sister or mother.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: They also made acacia-wood bars: five for the boards on one side of the dwelling.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka vi gbahi ba, ka sokam baŋ a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Cover their faces with shame, LORD, so that they might seek your name.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa daa mali zim bihi biɛla pahi, ka o daa zaŋ di gba niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm li tari ba pahi.
en: They also had a few fish. He said a blessing over them, then gave them to the disciples to hand out also.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din daa pahiri daba ayi maa dali, bɛ daa chaŋ gili tiŋ maa la napɔŋ yim ko, ka lan lab bɛ sansani maa ni yaha. Bɛ daa niŋ lala la daba ayɔbu.
en: On this second day they again marched around the city one time and then returned to camp. They did this for six days.

dag: Zuliya kam, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu, ka mol li gili teeku noli tiŋgbana din be katinsi. Yɛlimiya, Ŋun daa wurim Izraɛlnim kpɛhi yɔɣu la ni lan laɣim ba, o ni gul ba kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la.
en: Nations, listen to this message from the Lord ! Tell this message in the faraway lands by the sea: God scattered the people of Israel, but he will bring them back together. And he will watch over his flock like a shepherd.

dag: Niɣi mini bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la ni ti laɣim ŋubiri mɔri, ka bɛ bihi ti laɣim doya. Ka gbuɣinli ni ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman nahu la.
en: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.

dag: A chɛ a niriba tuumbiɛri paŋ ba; ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa paŋ ba.
en: You have forgiven the bad things your people did. You have taken away the guilt of their sins! Selah.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya ka o ba zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim zuɣu ni maa, di daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o daa gbaag o ba nuu ni o paai li Ifriim zuɣu ni n-zaŋ li pa Manaasa zuɣu ni;.
en: When Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraims head, he was upset and grasped his fathers hand to move it from Ephraims head to Manassehs head.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi la daa lan lab Izraɛl naa sanna ti yɛl o, Lan malimiya shili gu, ka baŋ yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama zaŋ chaŋ shɛɣuni, Siria naa ni lan labina ti liri ya.
en: Then the prophet went to King Ahab and said, Go back and build up your forces and make careful plans, because the king of Syria will attack again next spring.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni di ba. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi n-chaŋ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Kalidianim bɛn teei gili ya ŋɔ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: Anyone who stays in Jerusalem will die in war or from hunger or disease. But anyone who goes out of Jerusalem and surrenders to the Babylonians attacking you will live. Only those who leave the city will win anything in this war—their lives!.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti lab bɛ yilikpɛrili na ka bɛ bɔh o yɛtɔɣ yini maa gbinni yaha.
en: When they went back into the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.

dag: Dama n wum ka niriba pam sɔɣiri yɛra; ka dabiɛm kul be luɣilikam zaa. Bɛ laɣimmi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma.
en: I hear many enemies whispering; terror is all around me. They are making plans against me, plotting to kill me.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam tiŋgbani pa kom zuɣu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: he built the earth on the deep waters; his love is eternal.

dag: Ka Ibram min o paɣa daa zaŋ bɛ ni su binshɛlikam zaa n-yi Ijipti chaŋ Nɛgɛb, ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ.
en: Abram went north out of Egypt to the southern part of Canaan with his wife and everything he owned, and Lot went with him.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa bɔh o, Ka daɣila a shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia? Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: They all said, Then are you the Son of God? Jesus said to them, You are right in saying that I am.

dag: A sani ka n ni paɣir a shɛm yirina a niriba laɣiŋgu tital ni; ka n ni mali n ni pun po pɔri ni m mali sara shɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura sani la.
en: Lord, because of you I offer praise in the great assembly. In front of all these worshipers I will do all that I promised.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ waagasi mini bihim ni naɣilabil kpabili so bɛ ni daa kɔrigi duɣi maa nimdi na nti zali bɛ tooni, ka ʒe bɛ sani tia maa gbini ka bɛ dira.
en: Abraham brought the meat and some milk and cheese and set them down in front of the three men. Then he stood near the men, ready to serve them while they sat under the tree and ate.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni ti laɣim tab kana ti kumdi bɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord says, At that time the people of Israel and the people of Judah will be together. They will cry and cry together, and together, they will go look for the Lord their God.

dag: Di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni, amaa yihim ti zaɣ biɛɣu ni. Dama nyini n-su nam mini yiko ni jilima hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami.
en: Dont let us be tempted, but save us from the Evil One.

dag: mini Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi ni o tizo Jɔn, o ni daa pa shɛb mi yupaa Bɔanɛjiiz la.
en: There were also James and John, the two sons of Zebedee. Jesus called them Boanerges, which means Thunderbolts.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti laɣim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni luɣ shɛl o ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la, yin karimmi zaligu ŋɔ ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum.
en: when all Israel comes to appear before the LORD your God at the location he selects, you must read this Instruction aloud, in the hearing of all the people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim la zali di ko, ka daa tar li ka di doli bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ naɣilahi la gba lala.
en: The Levites set aside the parts of the animal that the worshipers needed for their sacrifices to please the Lord , just as the Law of Moses required. They also did the same thing with the bulls.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa Anabi Musa n-daa tin ya bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa; amaa m Ba n-tiri ya bindiri maŋli din yiri alizanda ni na maa.
en: Jesus said, I can assure you that Moses was not the one who gave your people bread from heaven. But my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.

dag: n-nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ka di nyom nyɛ din tiɣir o nini.
en: Then burn everything on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord . It is a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi nya di yiko, ka pa ni Naawuni n-ti a li; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni ŋɔ daalahichi galisi gar a dini.
en: Jesus answered, The only power you have over me is the power given to you by God. So the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa nambɔɣu, ka o shihi bɛ nina maa ka di dii neei, ka bɛ yiɣisi doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they were able to see, and they followed him.

dag: N di yuya ni Naawuni saɣi ku ma. O wɔɣisim o nuu ka chɛ ka n lu.
en: I wish he would crush me— just go ahead and kill me!.

dag: Ka Imɛr bia Zadok daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Shɛkania bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa guli Wulimpuhili polo Dunɔdal la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: After them, Zadok, Immers son, made repairs opposite his own house. After him, Shemaiah, Shecaniahs son, the keeper of the East Gate, made repairs.

dag: Hɛbɛr n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt mini Shoma ni Hɔtam ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Shua ba.
en: Heber had three sons: Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham; and one daughter, Shua.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, A daa ŋmanila paɣiŋoo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, yilimi yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli. Nyini ŋun na ʒi n-wolisi ŋɔ! Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, a ni mali bihi gari paɣ so ŋun mali yidana.
en: Jerusalem, you have been like a childless woman, but now you can sing and shout for joy. Now you will have more children than a woman whose husband never left her.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe Pita yiŋa n-nya ka Pita deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ bii ka o doya;.
en: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.

dag: ka yɛri ba, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu nyɛla wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: saying to them, It is written in the Scriptures that God said, My Temple will be a house of prayer. But you have turned it into a hideout for thieves.

dag: Dama n leela ŋun ka buchi kaman wain koligu din yili nyɔhi ni; amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: I am as useless as a discarded wineskin; yet I have not forgotten your commands.

dag: Samsin daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisi shɛŋa puuni Filistianim ni daa su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: Samson was a leader of Israel for years, but the Philistines were still the rulers of Israel.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka mɔri niŋ mɔɣu ni ka yi biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: He will also make your fields lush for your livestock, and you will eat and be satisfied.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ŋumaŋuma jɛndiri ma? Yi zaa taala duŋ zaɣisi ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: What is your complaint? Why have you rebelled against me?.

dag: Amaa ti mi ku tooi zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti ba. Dama tinim Izraɛlnim pun po n-yɛli ni ti ni so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga n-ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, noli din dim o.
en: but we cannot allow them to marry our daughters, because we have put a curse on anyone who allows a Benjaminite to marry one of our daughters.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni n-zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpira n-nyo wurigu mi.
en: The shovel he uses to sift the wheat from the husks is in his hands. He will clean out his threshing area and bring the wheat into his barn. But he will burn the husks with a fire that cant be put out.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yi ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: But you still say that I am unfair. You are the ones who have done wrong and are unfair!.

dag: Ka tiŋ ŋɔ yuli ti ma suhupiɛlli mini paɣibu ni jilima dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam bɛn wum n ni tum tuun suŋ shɛŋa ti ba maa yɛla sani, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa mini tɔŋsim shɛli zaa n ni ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: Then this city will bring me great joy, praise, and renown before all nations on earth, when they hear of all the good I provide for them. They will be in total awe at all the good and prosperity I provide for them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn zaa be bɛ tiŋ maa ni laɣim yi n-kari doli Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi maa. Bɛ ni daa kariti doli Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ainim maa n-yi kpaŋ ka chɛ bɛ tin maa.
en: Next, all the troops who were still in the city were called out to chase them. They chased after Joshua and so let themselves be drawn away from the city.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo gili bɛ sansani maa ni zaa yɛli, Doo bee paɣa miri ka o lan niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma la polo. Ka bɛ daa gooi niriba maa ka bɛ bi lan zaŋdi pina maa na.
en: So Moses sent a command throughout the camp that no one was to make any further contribution for the sacred Tent; so the people did not bring any more.

dag: Ka Rut daa chaŋ ti doli kachɛriba nyaaŋa yihiri bɛ ni daa chɛri ka guuri shɛŋa bahiri la zaɣ yiha. Ka di daa ti niŋ daliri ka o chaŋ Bɔaz ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣim la puu ni.
en: So Ruth went out to the fields and walked behind the workers, picking up the heads of grain which they left. It so happened that she was in a field that belonged to Boaz.

dag: yɛra, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ni ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: He said, We are going to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be handed over to the leading priests and teachers of the law. They will say that he must die and will hand him over to the foreigners.

dag: ka Shɛmida daŋ niriba nyɛ Shɛmidanima, ka Hɛfa daŋ niriba nyɛ Hɛfanima.
en: from Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; and from Hepher, the Hepherite clan.

dag: Ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani! .
en: So I was angry and made a promise: They will never enter my place of rest. Psalm :-.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi yɔɣili maa zuɣu? Ka Jona garigi yɛli, Di simdi ni n suhu yiɣisi, hal ka m bi zaɣisi ni n kpi gba.
en: God said to Jonah, Is your anger about the shrub a good thing? Jonah said, Yes, my anger is good—even to the point of death.

dag: Ka Naaman daa zaŋ o yuri min o chɛchɛbuŋa ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ ti zani Ilaisha yiŋ dunol ni.
en: Naaman left with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha's house.

dag: Ka Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma.
en: Ephron responded to Abraham.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni nyɛ bɛn yi Naawuni ni na maa zuɣu, di bi simdi ni ti tɛhi ni Naawuni ŋmanila buɣ shɛŋa tuumbaŋdiba ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni kuɣa maani bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm puuni la.
en: Therefore, as Gods offspring, we have no need to imagine that the divine being is like a gold, silver, or stone image made by human skill and thought.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha bia;.
en: But it should not be that way with you. Whoever wants to be your leader must be your servant.

dag: A yi yɛn goog o, di ŋmanila pɔhim ka a yɛn gooi bee kpa kom ka a yɛn zaŋ kpib a nudirigu ni.
en: How can you keep her quiet? Have you ever tried to stop the wind or ever tried to hold a handful of oil?.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpalim be Yawɛ sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi, o daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom. Ka o daa sabi alikauli maa yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ fukumsi zaligunim pia la pa bimparilana ayi maa zuɣu.
en: Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights. He didnt eat any bread or drink any water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten words.

dag: amaa ka Pool ŋun daa bi tɛhi ni di luhiya ni bɛ lan ʒi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zani Pamfilia ŋ-ŋmaligi lab ka chɛ ba ka bi doli ba paai bɛ tuma tariga la.
en: but Paul did not think it was right to take him, because he had not stayed with them to the end of their mission, but had turned back and left them in Pamphylia.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli niriba maa yi ti yɛn laɣimmi, yin piɛbimi kikaa maa, amaa ka di piɛb li kika biɛɣu piɛbbu.
en: but in order to call the community together, long blasts are to be sounded.

dag: Dama di simdi ni ninvuɣ kura maa kul kpalim be tiliginsim tiŋ maa ni hal ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ti kpi, amaa maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa kum nyaaŋa, ninvuɣ kura maa ni tooi lab omaŋmaŋ ya.
en: The killer must live in his refuge city until the high priests death. After the high priests death the killer may return to the land he owns.

dag: amaa ka Ammɔn nabihi daa yɛli bɛ dan Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim tuumba na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ka o be a maa? Dauda timla niriba ŋɔ na ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ yaŋɔ daashili zaa ka tuhi nyaŋ ti.
