en: the Ammonite leaders said to the king, Do you think that it is in your father's honor that David has sent these men to express sympathy to you? Of course not! He has sent them here as spies to explore the city, so that he can conquer us.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa daa bɔrimi ni bɛ kpɛhi ti dabiɛm ka tɛhira, Bɛ kɔba ni ni chɔɣisi, ka bɛ kɔŋ tuma tumbu. Ka n daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, N Naawuni, kpaŋsim n kɔba ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: All of them were trying to make us afraid, saying, They will be discouraged, and the work wont get finished. But now, God, strengthen me!.

dag: Ka Baruk garigi yɛli ba, Ŋuna n-daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa, ka m mi zaŋ tadabo sab li niŋ gbaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Baruch replied, He dictated all the words to me, and I wrote them with ink in the scroll.

dag: Hal di nyaɣa yi kul kurigi tiŋgban ni, ka di mundili kuui do tiŋa.
en: if its roots age in the ground and its stump dies in the dust.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha n ni zaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa zaa kpe n-kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.

dag: Zaŋmiya jilima din simdi Yawɛ yuli ti o. Zaŋmiya pina tah o sanna, Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni tibiginsim din be kasi.
en: Praise the Lord 's glorious name; bring an offering and come into his Temple. Bow down before the Holy One when he appears;.

dag: N Duuma Yisa zuɣu, m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni binshɛɣ kani m-mali daɣiri dimaŋmaŋ puuni, amaa so yi tɛhi ni binshɛli mali daɣiri, o sani di shiri mali daɣiri.
en: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.

dag: Malimiya yimaŋ kasi n-kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛɣu ka mali yi zuliya niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali shɛm la.
en: You are to kill the Passover lambs and goats. Now make yourselves ritually clean and prepare the sacrifices in order that your fellow Israelites may follow the instructions which the Lord gave through Moses.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.

dag: n-lan yi nimaani zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti du Bɛtaraba Zoli m-mali lala hal ti siɣi Araba.
en: and passed north of the ridge overlooking the Jordan Valley. It then went down into the valley.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bia Zuriɛl. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila laɣiŋgu suɣili maa nuzaa polo.
en: The leader of the Merari family group was Zuriel son of Abihail. This family group was given the area to the north of the Holy Tent. This is the area where they camped.

dag: Dama n shee kul tulimi ka biɛra, ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.

dag: N daa kul dolila o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi zaa, ka bi birig o zaligunim maa shɛli.
en: I have observed all his laws; I have not disobeyed his commands.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua ni o mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla biŋkɔb lɔɣu bee zaɣ nyaŋ, di simdi ka o zaŋla ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa.
en: If you offer a sheep or a goat as a fellowship offering to the Lord , whether it is a male or a female, it must have nothing wrong with it.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa niŋ Ibram nirilim viɛnyɛliŋga Zarai zuɣu. O daa ti Ibram piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni bundibisi ni bunnyama ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnima.
en: Things went well for Abram because of her: he acquired flocks, cattle, male donkeys, men servants, women servants, female donkeys, and camels.

dag: Ŋun Naawuni daa fa alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bidibbina, ka zaŋ ba wuhi palɔni o dari dibu chandi puuni ni o nyaŋ ba Masia dapulli la zuɣu.
en: And on that cross Christ freed himself from the power of the spiritual rulers and authorities; he made a public spectacle of them by leading them as captives in his victory procession.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Pa mani n-nyɛ ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnima, amaa a min a daŋ niriba n-nahindi Izraɛlnima. Dama yinima n-zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka jɛmdila Baal buɣa.
en: I'm not the troublemaker, Elijah answered. You are—you and your father. You are disobeying the Lord 's commands and worshiping the idols of Baal.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili ni wurim, amaa ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suɣili kul ni ʒiɛya.
en: The house of the wicked is destroyed, but the tent flourishes for those who do right.

dag: Amaa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba maa daa lee bi kari Keenannim bɛn daa be Gɛza, dina n-chɛ ka Keenannim mini Ifriim zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be hal ni zuŋɔ; amaa ka bɛ lee chɛ ka Keenannim maa tumdi dabitim tuma tiri ba.
en: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.

dag: M min o gbɛri kparila taba, ka n tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ka di do palɔni, ka pa ni ŋaha puuni; ka o nyari man Yawɛ kɔtomsi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi bi zo dabiɛm ni yi galim n dabili Musa maa.
en: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.

dag: O daa zaŋ zibisim din gil o leeg o sampaa, ka sagban tibisa leeg o kom dooshee.
en: God made darkness his covering; water gathered in dense clouds!.

dag: Ka biisim ti kpe li ka di nyɛligi. Tulim yi ti kana, a ku lan nya li di biɛhigu maa shee.
en: But when the weather is hot and dry, the water stops flowing, and the stream disappears.

dag: hal ka na bi dɔɣi ba, ka bihi maa mi na bi tum zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu la, Naawuni daa yɛl o ni bikpɛm ni ti jɛm biasani. Naawuni daa niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka o ni piir o ninvuɣ gahinda shɛm zani, ka di nyɛla o bolibu zuɣu, ka pa ni bɛ tuma zuɣu.
en: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabiya: Man Naawuni duu ni boonila wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu.
en: Jesus said to them, The Scriptures say, My Temple will be called a house of prayer. But you are changing it into a hiding place for thieves. .

dag: Di saha ka a pii di biɛla gbini a binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: But then you must get a few of those hairs and wrap them up in your robe.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ kaman n ni niŋ shɛm maa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini pɔbi yi zuɣusaa naŋgbampiba, yi mi di ti di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Then you will do the same things I have done. You will leave your face uncovered and refuse to eat the food that mourners usually eat.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn sabi alikauli shɛli ti a la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ di yɔrigu maa yo di noli.
en: I will give you the Agreement. Put it in the Box, and put the mercy-cover on the Box.

dag: Shɛbuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Musa bia Gɛrishom mi bia la n-daa nyɛ kpɛm ŋun su azichinim fukumsi.
en: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom, Moses son, was the chief officer in charge of the treasuries.

dag: Yisifu daa beni hal ti nya Ifriim bihi ni o yaantibichahi. O daa lan beni hal ti nya Manaasa bihi ni Makiri gba bihi n-zaŋ ba ʒil o naba zuɣu.
en: During Josephs life Ephraim had children and grandchildren. And his son Manasseh had a son named Makir. Joseph lived to see Makirs children.

dag: N ni darigi Bɛl din be Babilɔn ŋɔ tibili, ka chɛ ka o gbuɣ o ni daa vali binshɛŋa la bahi. Zuliya kam ku lan jɛm o. Babilɔn goma luya.
en: I will punish Bel in Babylon; I will force him to vomit what hes consumed. Then nations will no longer stream to him, and Babylons walls will collapse!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒini n-diri bindirigu maa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, m mini yinim bɛn laɣim diri ŋɔ ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: While they were all at the table eating, he said, Believe me when I say that one of you will hand me over to my enemies—one of you eating with me now.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter said, All the other followers may lose their faith. But my faith will never be shaken.

dag: n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi omaŋmaŋ silig pal shɛli o ni daa yoli chib tampiŋ ni la ni; ka daa bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo di noli, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had carved out of the rock. After he rolled a large stone at the door of the tomb, he went away.

dag: Di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋ lala, di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee situra lala. A ʒiʒiinikpee binshɛɣukam yi bɔrigi, ka a nya li, di simdi ni a niŋ lala, di bi simdi ka a zaɣis o sɔŋbu.
en: Do the same thing if you find a donkey, a piece of clothing, or anything else that an Israelite may have lost.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli ka na bi niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni n-niŋ bɛ bɔrɔbɔro shɛr lahi ni n-guri adiikunim ni n-zaŋ pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: So the people picked up their bread dough before the yeast made it rise, with their bread pans wrapped in their robes on their shoulders.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm. Izraɛlnim bɛn daa yi Ijipti na n-nyɛ:.
en: You must count every man who is years old or older. The Lord gave Moses this command. Here is the list of the Israelites who came out of Egypt:.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yɛli, Ti Naawuni m-bɔŋɔ! Ti pun guhir o mi ni o tiligi ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni pun guhiri so la m-bala. Chɛliya ka ti mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ti maa zuɣu.
en: They will say on that day, Look! This is our God, for whom we have waited— and he has saved us! This is the LORD, for whom we have waited; lets be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihitaniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛdida, o daa nyɛla Adaya, Bɔzikat nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Josiah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jedidah; she was Adaiahs daughter and was from Bozkath.

dag: Amaa man yi chɛ ka n dabili bee n tumo yɛli shɛli, n chɛrimi ka din niŋ pali. N yɛli Jɛrusalɛm ni niriba ni lan ʒini di ni, ka yɛli Juda fɔntinsi ni bɛ ni lan me li zali. Bɛ ni lan me tin shɛŋa din daa lu maa zaa zali.
en: But who confirms the word of my servant, and fulfills the predictions of my messengers; who says about Jerusalem, It will be resettled; and who says about the cities of Judah, They will be rebuilt, and I will restore their ruins.

dag: Yi yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba, dunianim naan yuri ya, amaa yi pala dunia ni su shɛba, dama mani m-pii ya, dinzuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim jɛn ya maa.
en: If you belonged to the world, then the world would love you as its own. But I chose you from this world, and you do not belong to it; that is why the world hates you.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya n ni lo nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo mini n ni yɛn niŋ Tɛmannim shɛm. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ niriba dabiɛm.
en: So listen to what the Lord has planned to do to the people of Edom. Listen to what he has decided to do to the people in Teman. The enemy will drag away the young kids of Edoms flock. Edoms pastures will be empty because of what they did.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha, ka wuntaŋ daa bi lan ne. Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu la cheei di sunsuuni m-pirigi buyi.
en: Around noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until the middle of the afternoon.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ n ti yɛn kana, kpaŋm amaŋ karimmi Naawuni Kundi niriba ni, ka yihimi waazu, ka wuhimi niriba.
en: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.

dag: ka o zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina; ka di chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ku be kaman piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: I pray that you will choose a leader who will lead them out of this land and bring them into the new land. Then your people will not be like sheep without a shepherd.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma labi Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la, ka di yomi.
en: The man led me to the outer gate at the east side of the Temple area. The gate was closed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli mini laasabuniŋdiba zaa ni ti di vi, ka tabi bɛ noya, dama Naawuni ti ku garigi ba.
en: Those who predict the future will be disgraced by their failure. They will all be humiliated because God does not answer them.

dag: O ni daa duh omaŋa o tuumbiɛri zuɣu la zuɣu, niŋmiy o nahiŋgu ka o fabili lala! Dama o yɛli o suhu ni: N dila nam ʒiya! M pala pakoli! Lala zuɣu n ku nya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. Deep in her heart Babylon said, I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Nachimbila, ŋun dapala n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A dabili Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala n-nyɛ ma.
en: Saul asked him, Young man, who is your father? David answered, I am the son of your servant Jesse, from Bethlehem.

dag: Amaa niriba maa n-daa va ti ni tuhi di binshɛŋa maa zaa na, piɛri mini naɣilahi ni di ni daa simdi ni bɛ saɣim bin viɛl shɛŋa zaa, bɛ daa zaŋ li mi na ni bɛ ti mali sara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani Giligal.
en: But my men did not kill the best sheep and cattle that they captured; instead, they brought them here to Gilgal to offer as a sacrifice to the Lord your God.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti ŋme n-chib o zuɣu ka dih o vi.
en: Then the man sent another servant to the farmers. They hit this servant on the head, showing no respect for him.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn ʒiini nyuri wain yuura ni binnyuri kpɛma balibubalibu.
en: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.

dag: Amɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa piɛgul la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. O daa nya li zaŋ chaŋla Izraɛlnim polo Juda Naa Yuzaia mini Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman ni. Di saha di daa chɛla yuma ayi ni tiŋgbani dambu la niŋ.
en: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali du shɛli din be puuni la mini du titali maa dukpina ka ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi ŋmahima pa di zuɣu.
en: Solomon carved all the walls of the temple—inner and outer rooms—with engravings of winged creatures, palm trees, and blossoming flowers.

dag: Dauda yɛligu din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim zaa bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana.
en: On the basis of David's final instructions all Levites were registered for service when they reached the age of twenty.

dag: Siɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Hɔri nir la bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋbihi la n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn.
en: Seir was from the Horite tribe that had lived in Edom before the time of Esau. The clans that had descended from him were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah.

dag: Dundombil ni dunɔdali samban ni, duri daa beni din nyɛ baansi duri. Yini daa bela nuzaa polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nudirigu polo, ka zaɣ yini mi ʒe nudirigu polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nuzaa polo.
en: The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ me luɣ kasi shee ti ma din ni chɛ ka m be bɛ sani.
en: They should make me a sanctuary so I can be present among them.

dag: Di daa ti lu Farisiinim tibili ni ni Yisa nyari nyaandoliba pam baptaiziri ba n-gari Jɔn Baptaizira.
en: Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was making more disciples and baptizing more than John .

dag: Nyamiya, di zuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: But I have warned you ahead of time.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o dɔɣiriba, Pihimiya kuɣa na, ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa maa na nti kahi li duhi, ka daa ʒini kuɣ duli maa gbini di bindirigu.
en: and said to his relatives, Gather stones. So they took stones, made a mound, and ate there near the mound.

dag: Dama bɛ kul bɔr o mi kaman dɔbba ni bɔri pagɔrili shɛm la. Lala ka bɛ daa bɔri Ohola mini Oholiba bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri dɔbba pam maa.
en: They come as if coming to a prostitute, first to Oholah, and then to Oholibah, those traitorous women.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti kabi bɛ ni daa kpahi niriba ayi shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu pahi Yisa zuɣu la ŋun daŋ tooni min o kpee la gbaya;.
en: Therefore, the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men who were crucified with Jesus.

dag: ni Kiriataim ni Bɛtigamul ni Bɛtimɛɔn.
en: Judgment has come to the towns of Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul, and Beth Meon.

dag: Bɛ daa bela bɛ suɣa ni ŋ-ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Our ancestors complained in their tents and refused to obey the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa shihir shɛŋa yi ni sa nya la zuɣu ka yi bɔri n shee maa, amaa yi ni sa ŋub bɔrɔbɔro la tiɣ la zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.

dag: A mi n yibu saha ni n dɔnibu saha, ka mi n soya zaa.
en: You study my traveling and resting. You are thoroughly familiar with all my ways.

dag: Yi niŋgbuna ni ti leei noombil kam mini dunia ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu, ka so ti ku beni ŋun ni kari ba.
en: When you die, birds and wild animals will come and eat your bodies, and there will be no one to scare them off.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka m biɛhigu di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la, kaman saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa yuuni ma la;.
en: I long for the past, when God took care of me.

dag: Amaa Nuhu kɔŋko ka Yawɛ nini daa naɣ kul tiɣi.
en: But the Lord was pleased with Noah.

dag: Ka o yi wurim binshɛli, so ku tooi lan me li zali. O yi kpɛhi so duu, so ku tooi yooi dilan bahi.
en: Anything God tears down cannot be rebuilt. Anyone he puts in prison cannot be set free.

dag: Shɛla ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛba.
en: When Shelah was years old, he had a son, Eber;.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa, dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni tɛhi ni o mali shɛl la.
en: Be careful, then, how you listen; because those who have something will be given more, but whoever has nothing will have taken away from them even the little they think they have.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiri pini mali alibarika, dama bɛ niŋdi bɛ bindirigu tiri nandaamba.
en: Happy are generous people, because they give some of their food to the poor.

dag: ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-nya ka naɣikɔhiriba mini piɛkɔhiriba ni ŋmaŋkɔhiriba be di puuni m-pahi laɣitaɣiriba bɛn ʒi bɛ teebuya gbini.
en: There in the Temple he found people selling cattle, sheep, and pigeons, and also the moneychangers sitting at their tables.

dag: ka Naawuni daa sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ Hagirinim mini bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu maa zaa. Dama bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni yɛda ka suh o ni o sɔŋ ba tɔb maa ni.
en: They put their trust in God and prayed to him for help, and God answered their prayers and made them victorious over the Hagrites and their allies.

dag: Shɛshan daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi kɔŋko, o daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa o daa mal o dabili ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nira, ka o yuli booni Jariha.
en: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum Yawɛ yɛligu, ka zaɣis o zaligu dolibu, dindina ŋun Yawɛ ni darigi yi tibili.
en: But if you do not listen to the Lord but disobey his commands, he will be against you and your king.

dag: Bɛ daa dolila bɛ kɔribiɛri soli mɔɣu maa ni, ka daa buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: They were filled with craving in the desert and put God to the test;.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ʒiishee leei dabari, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan be bɛ yinsi.
en: Let their camp be devastated; let no one dwell in their tents.

dag: Kɔz daa nyɛla Anub mini Zɔbɛba ba, ka daa lan nyɛ Harum bia Aharihɛl daŋ niriba yaba.
en: Koz was the father of Anub, Hazzobebah, and the clans of Aharhel, Harums son.

dag: Ŋun Naawuni daa fa alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bidibbina, ka zaŋ ba wuhi palɔni o dari dibu chandi puuni ni o nyaŋ ba Masia dapulli la zuɣu.
en: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini tɔbbihi maa zaa daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ Ai, ka Jɔshua daa pii tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Ai yuŋ.
en: So Joshua got ready to go to Ai with all his soldiers. He picked out thirty thousand of his best troops and sent them out at night.

dag: Paɣ so a ni daa nya maa ni nyɛla tin tital shɛli din su dunia nanim zaa yiko.
en: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.

dag: Ka yɛli, Laɣimmiya n niriba bɛn ʒe ma yim la ti ma na, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ma sara maligu alikauli la.
en: He says, My followers, gather around me. Come, my worshipers, who made an agreement with me.

dag: ni Gɛdɛrɔt ni Bɛtidagɔn ni Naama ni Makɛda: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah. In all, there were towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi o ninni Ribila maa; Babilɔn naa maa daa lan ku Juda kpambaliba zaa.
en: At Riblah he put Zedekiah's sons to death while Zedekiah was looking on, and he also had the officials of Judah executed.

dag: A ni sabi jaaŋgbe shɛŋa zuɣu maa yi ti be a nuu ni ka bɛ nya li.
en: Take the sticks that you wrote on and hold them in front of you.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli pahi, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli yaha, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee ka je a dima.
en: You have heard people say, Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.

dag: dama n wum a ni niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda shɛm min a ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba shɛm la yɛla.
en: I thank God because I hear about the love you have for all of Gods holy people and the faith you have in the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tiligi Izraɛlnim bɛ daalahichi zaa ni.
en: and he is the one who will save the people of Israel from all their sins.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa nyɛla bɛn be o maligumaaniba kalinli ni. Samuɛl gba daa nyɛla ŋun be bɛn jɛmd o kalinli ni. Bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei bɛ suhigu.
en: Moses and Aaron were his priests, and Samuel was one who prayed to him; they called to the Lord , and he answered them.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira; ka m bi bɔri ni bɛ kuli ni kum, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti tarigi sol ni.
en: Now Jesus called his disciples and said, I feel sorry for the crowd because they have been with me for three days and have nothing to eat. I dont want to send them away hungry for fear they wont have enough strength to travel.

dag: Tinzun nira yi di a samli, a ni tooi bɔh o dee li, amaa a mabia ŋun be yi ʒilɛl ni ŋuna, di simdi ni a ku san shɛli din be a min o sunsuuni.
en: You may require a foreigner to repay you, but you must cancel any debt another Israelite owes you.

dag: Amaa m mini n niriba ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ banima, ka ni tooi zaŋ pina ŋɔ ti a ti suhu yubu puuni? Dama binshɛɣukam zaa yila a sanna, a ni su shɛli ka ti lan zaŋ ti a maa.
en: Yet my people and I cannot really give you anything, because everything is a gift from you, and we have only given back what is yours already.

dag: Ka so daa ti bɔh o, N Duuma, niriba biɛla kɔŋko n-yɛn tiligi? Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Someone said to him, Lord, will only a few be saved? Jesus said to them.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ nyɛla din chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe tibi yɛma ŋma. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali yiɣisi wuɣili ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu.
en: Those who claim to be honest are shocked, and they all condemn me as godless.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaata Isaka mini Asha ni Naftali ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni ti Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba.
en: The clans that were descendants of Gershon were given towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh.

dag: ni Ahio ni Shashak ni Jɛrɛmɔt.
en: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na ni ti kɔri bɛ puri nimaani.
en: The citys workers from every tribe of Israel will farm it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlima, kpiimba ni ti doya kaman naɣibina n-do mɔɣu ni la, bee kaman chi ni dɔndo kachɛriba nyaaŋa shɛm la, ka so ti ku kpuɣi ba.
en: Declare what the LORD says: Dead bodies will lie like dung on the fields, like bundles of grain after the harvest, with no one to pick them up.

dag: Ka di tiri mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kom, ka mɔɣu ni bunsi nyuri li kuri kɔnyuri.
en: providing water for every wild animal— the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi be a nuu ni, nyin yihimi li kpaŋa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be a yiŋa.
en: if you throw out the sin in your hands and dont let injustice dwell in your tents.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi bɛ daalaafee yɛla; ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi ba do kur so yɛla yi ni daa yɛli ma la na be o nyɛvil ni? O mal alaafee.
en: After Joseph had asked how they were, he said, What about your elderly father? Is he still alive.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlana zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: Who is the wise and trusted servant? The master trusts one servant to give the other servants their food at the right time. Who is the one the master trusts to do that work?.

dag: Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, Nyɛvili bi ʒir ka dimsira! Ninsal ni zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa taɣi o nyɛvili.
en: Satan answered, Skin for skin! A man will give everything he has to protect himself.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna sani n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: Moses left the palace and prayed.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa lo o nia biɛɣu. Ka naa daa bahi ba noli ka bɛ lab kuɣa ku o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: But the people made plans against Zechariah. The king commanded the people to kill Zechariah, so they threw rocks at him until he was dead. The people did this in the courtyard of the Lord s Temple.

dag: n-zaŋ li gari taba m-mali tulaale zim kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka niŋ yalim niŋ di ni din ni chɛ ka di be kasi ka ku mali daɣiri.
en: Mix the spices together to make a sweet-smelling incense. Do this the same as a perfume maker would do it. Also mix salt with this incense. This will make it pure and special.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, hal n ni kul yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni kpi maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi zo n-yi bɛ daalahichi ni, ka tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi.
en: Suppose I warn wicked people that they will die because of their sins, and they stop sinning and start doing right.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai soli nti zani Chimham din miri Bɛtilihɛm la m-bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Ijipti.
en: They set out for Egypt, stopping on the way at Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Dindina niŋmiya zim ti ma na. Ka o daa zaŋ zim maa yuɣisi ʒiɛri maa ni ka yɛli ba, Toomiya li ti niriba maa ka bɛ piɛbi. Ka barina shɛli daa lan ka di ni yaha.
en: Bring me some flour, Elisha said. He sprinkled the flour in the stew and said, Now serve it to them. And the stew tasted fine.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni la shiri yi a zuɣu.
en: Do this, the Lord said, and the Israelites will believe that you have seen me, the God who was worshiped by their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ siɣili saha, saha shɛli nanim ni daa chani tɔb la, ka Jɔab daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti saɣim Ammɔnim tiŋgbɔŋ, ka daa chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm. Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ ti lu Raba zuɣu n-wurim li.
en: The following spring, at the time of the year when kings usually go to war, Joab led out the army and invaded the land of Ammon; King David, however, stayed in Jerusalem. They besieged the city of Rabbah, attacked it, and destroyed it.

dag: O ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o di miri kpima.
en: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo. Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa guli nayili maa daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya niriba pam ni doli Hɔrɔnaim soli m-baɣisiri zoli kanna.
en: and Absalom has run away. One of the guards noticed a lot of people coming along the hillside on the road to Horonaim. He went and told the king, I saw some men coming along Horonaim Road.

dag: m bɔri ni zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani dinya shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di ku yuui ka yi kpi zaa yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa; yi ti ku yuui di ni, amaa yi ni ti kpi zaa.
en: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that, if you disobey me, you will soon disappear from the land. You will not live very long in the land across the Jordan that you are about to occupy. You will be completely destroyed.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti zal o niriba bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaɣ shɛŋa din daa be teeku polo zaŋ tabili bɛn daa be kukɔɣu polɔnim zaa ni bɛ yo farigu.
en: King Xerxes imposed forced labor on the people of the coastal regions of his empire as well as on those of the interior.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o ni buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini di dubihi ni di nɛma ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni ni di zuɣusaa duri ni di puuni duri ni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo kuɣ ni ti yɛn be du shɛl ni gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.

dag: Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa puuni, Yɛhudianim daa kula dɔbba kɔbisinu.
en: In the fortified part of Susa, the Jews killed five hundred people.

dag: O ka ba bee ma bee zuliya; o ka piligu, o mi ka bahigu, amaa o ŋmanila Naawuni Bia, ka kul nyɛ maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: No one knows who his father or mother was or where he came from. And no one knows when he was born or when he died. Melchizedek is like the Son of God in that he will always be a priest.

dag: Gul a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, a ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd a luɣ shɛl la din ni chɛ ka a gbilisiri tibili n-wumd a dabili suhigu saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ n nini kpa a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ na ka suhir a.
en: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.

dag: Amaa man ni lih a ninni wuntitali puuni; n yi ti neei n-lihi nya a kɔtomsi, di ni ti tiɣi n nini.
en: But I will see you, because I have done no wrong; and when I awake, your presence will fill me with joy.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Di pun sabi anabinim litaafinim ni ni Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni wuhi sokam zaa. Ka ŋunkam wum ka bɔhim m Ba sani n-nyɛ ŋun kani n sanna.
en: It is written in the prophets: God will teach them all. People listen to the Father and learn from him. They are the ones who come to me.

dag: Ka alɔbo shɛli din ŋmani alɔbo ŋɔ ni lu bɛ dimnim yuri mini buntaansi ni laakumnim ni bunsi ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be bɛ sansan ni maa ni zuɣu.
en: This plague will also affect the horses, mules, camels, donkeys, and any cattle in those camps during this plague.

dag: A yi ni tooi garigi ma, nyin garigim ma; malimi a yɛtɔɣa shili n-zani n tooni.
en: If you are able, answer me; lay out your case before me and take a stand.

dag: Bɛ yi ti gbahi tinvura bee n-nyu binshɛli din nyɛ lɔɣu, di ku niŋ ba shɛli; ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa barinim zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them.

dag: Di saha suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ni ti zooi lim wain tihi din mali wula tuhilituhili, ka di zaɣ yini kam ni tooi da anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: There are now fields that have grapevines, and each grapevine is worth pieces of silver. But those fields will be covered with weeds and thorns.

dag: Nir yi ŋme o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nimbila ka di saɣim, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nimbil maa zuɣu.
en: If someone hits his male or female slave in the eye and puts it out, he is to free the slave as payment for the eye.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Shɛm ni; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: He also said, Bless the LORD, the God of Shem; Canaan will be his servant.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni fa n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni bahi, dama o ni deei ma.
en: But God will rescue me from the power of death.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa dɔɣi Tɛra maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisiyinika. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Terah was born, Nahor lived another years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka di varanda wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita awɛi, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di mini jɛmbu duu maa puuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛla yim, ka di dubu mi daa nyɛ mita pihinunaanahi, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima alali pa di puuni dukpina zuɣu.
en: The porch in front of the Temple was cubits long and cubits high. He covered the inside of the porch with pure gold.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bunnyaŋ min o bia ka bɛ loya ka yi lɔrigi ba na.
en: He told them, Go into the next village, where you will at once find a donkey and her colt. Untie the two donkeys and bring them to me.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be o sani chaŋ ti dɔni Ai nuzaa polo m-miri li, ka vinvamli do bɛ mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: The soldiers with him went toward the main entrance to the city and set up camp on the north side, with a valley between themselves and Ai.

dag: Baa ni yi gbuɣi, ka lan labi ti dir li shɛm la, lala ka jɛrigu labir o jɛrilim tuma ni.
en: Like a dog that returns to its vomit, a fool does the same foolish things again and again.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya shɛli din niriba be ŋ-ŋɔ biɛri?.
en: Shouldnt I punish such acts? declares the LORD. Shouldnt I repay that nation for its deeds?.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋdi mahili niŋdi sagban tibisa ni, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri yiri sagbana maa ni na.
en: He also fills clouds with moisture; his lightning scatters clouds.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya ŋumaŋuma shɛli yi ni wumdi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu. Yi kul wumdila ŋumaŋuma yuuni kam. Yi wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni bɛ yɛn taala duŋ, ka na so yɛn tuhi na so.
en: Do not lose courage or be afraid because of the rumors you hear. Every year a different rumor spreads—rumors of violence in the land and of one king fighting another.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti kabisi Izraɛlnim bidibbina zaa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: And in Jezreel Valley I will at that time destroy Israel's military power.

dag: O ni daa ti paana, o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba, m puhir a! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: So he went to Jesus and said, Hello, Teacher! Then Judas kissed him.

dag: Lan yɛlimiya, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira ŋɔ, fam ti. Yihim ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim ti na nti tiligi ti, ka ti paɣir a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka paɣir a ni jilima.
en: Say to him, Save us, God our Savior. Bring us back together, and save us from the other nations. Then we will give thanks to your holy name and joyfully praise you.

dag: Bɛ bili paɣiba Ziɔn tiŋ puuni, ka bili paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Juda fɔntinsi ni.
en: Our wives have been raped on Mount Zion itself; in every Judean village our daughters have been forced to submit.

dag: Ka n garigi yɛl o, N dana, m bi mi. Wuhim ma! Ka o yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla bɛn yi wahala titali dibu ni na ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ Piɛbil la ʒim paɣ shɛb binyɛra ka di paligi zaa la.
en: I said to him, Sir, you know. Then he said to me, These people have come out of great hardship. They have washed their robes and made them white in the Lambs blood.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali bindirigu mini situra, ti n-chɛ ka ti nini tiɣ li.
en: So then, if we have food and clothes, that should be enough for us.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yuya pun bi sabi niŋ Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku la nyɛvili litaafi la ni tun dunia piligu ni la ha ni ti jɛm biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: Everyone living on earth would worship the beast. These are all the people since the beginning of the world whose names are not written in the Lambs book of life. The Lamb is the one who was killed.

dag: n-chɛ ka bɛ laɣim niriba maa zaa na gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali, ka bɛ mini bɛ zuliya ti sab bɛ yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gari lala.
en: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older.

dag: Ka a yi nya li, a gba ni chaŋ ti pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a biɛli Aduna ni pahi bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: After you have seen it, you will die, just like your brother Aaron.

dag: Ka din lan pahi nyɛla, ninvuɣ biɛri yi zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, bɛ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: And when the wicked turn from their wicked deeds and act justly and responsibly, they will preserve their lives.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi fa piɛri mini niɣi, ka o niriba maa daa taɣiri niɣi maa be tooni ka yɛra, Dauda ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: including their livestock. David also took the sheep and cattle that the Amalekites had with them, but he kept these separate from the others. Everyone agreed that these would be David's reward.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba maa, Yi shiri galisiya pam, ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka di simdi ni yi mali tiŋgbani yaɣ bɔbili.
en: Your tribes do have a lot of people, Joshua admitted. I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu n ni kum ka fabili. N ni chaŋ napɔnzaŋa ni n zaɣim. N ni fabili kaman yɔbahi la, ka kum kaman taatahi la.
en: Then Micah said, Because of this I will mourn and lament. To show my sorrow, I will walk around barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and wail like an ostrich.

dag: Saɣimmi ninvuɣ biɛri mini tuumbiɛtumdiba yiko; darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu hal ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ti ku lan beni yaha.
en: Break the arms of those who are wicked and evil. Seek out their wickedness until theres no more to find.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni ŋɔ ni shɛba, amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba maa mali m-be kasi. Lala mi ka di yɛn be hal ti paai di tariga kaman Naawuni ni zali di saha shɛm.
en: Some of the teachers too will fall in order that they might be refined, purified, and cleansed—until an end time, because it is still not yet the set time.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Nyama, a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ noli zuɣu, a yi ŋmaligi n sani chana, di ku yuui ka gbuɣinli gbaag a ku. Ka o ni daa kul ŋmalig o sani, ka gbuɣinli shiri chirig o gbaag o ku.
en: So he said to his friend, Because you didnt obey the LORDs voice, a lion will attack you as soon as you leave me. And as the friend left the prophet, a lion found him and attacked him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa lan yɛli paɣ maa, Cham ni suhudoo; a yɛda niŋbu n-tilig a.
en: Jesus said to the woman, Because you believed, you are saved from your sins. Go in peace.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yiriŋyiriŋ, dama Yawɛ ku chɛ ŋunkam boon o yuli yiriŋyiriŋ taali.
en: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.

dag: Yi zuri yi mabihi nyaaŋa, ka zaŋdi yimaŋmaŋ mapuuni bihi taali.
en: You are ready to accuse your own relatives and to find fault with them.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm Naa Dauda bia ŋun nyɛ karimba la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the words from the Teacher, a son of David and king of Jerusalem.

dag: Yi ni ti mali olivi tihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, amaa yi ti ku ʒe di kpam, dama di wala zaa ni ti wɔbi lu.
en: Olive trees will grow everywhere in your land, but you will not have any olive oil, because the olives will drop off.

dag: Nyin biɛŋmariga ŋun ne pam ŋɔ, nyam a ni yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na shɛm! Nyin ŋun daa dihi zuliya pam vi ŋɔ, bɛ daag a luhi tiŋa.
en: How youve fallen from heaven, morning star, son of dawn! You are cut down to earth, helpless on your back!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi puu atam di kpuɣibu saha nyɛla yɛndana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun doya gbihiri atam kpuɣibu saha nyɛla vi dira.
en: A sensible person gathers the crops when they are ready; it is a disgrace to sleep through the time of harvest.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Bolim o na. Ka o daa boli paɣ maa, ka o kana ti zani dunol ni.
en: Tell her to come here, Elisha ordered. She came and stood in the doorway.

dag: tiŋgbani maa tintariga; o ni yɛn su shɛli m-bala Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka n nanim maa ku lan muɣisi n niriba maa. Amaa bɛ ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim su tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman bɛ zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: This area will be the share the ruling prince will have in the land of Israel, so that he will no longer oppress the people, but will let the rest of the country belong to the tribes of Israel.

dag: A ni wuhi Yaakubu ʒiɛyimtali, ka wuhi Ibrahimma ʒiɛyimtali din bi taɣira kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim shɛm kurimbuni ha la.
en: God, please be true to Jacob. Be kind and loyal to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors long ago.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha, Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: It is also written, Their hands will catch you so that you will not hit your foot on a rock. Psalm :.

dag: ni Shɛfatia daŋ ni Hatil daŋ ni Pokɛrɛt Hazɛbaim daŋ ni Ami daŋ.
en: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pokereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: She said, Israels glory has been taken away because the Philistines had taken Gods Holy Box.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pom n nini ŋɔ ni; ka Yisifu daa shiri po. Di saha ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa o bindoo zuɣusaa polo.
en: Israel said, Give me your word! and Joseph gave his word. Then Israel slumped down at the head of the bed.

dag: Turi mini yɔhiŋgu ni niriba nahiŋgu yɛla n-kul be bɛ noya ni; ka zilima yɛlibu mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri kul be bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Their mouths are filled with curses, dishonesty, violence. Under their tongues lie troublemaking and wrongdoing.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni tiri n gba, ka Naawuni ti ma n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka n tooi tɔɣisiri li ni suhukpeeni n-kahigiri lahibal suŋ la ashili gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba.
en: Also pray for me—that when I speak, God will give me words so that I can tell the secret truth about the Good News without fear.

dag: Yawɛ be n sani, m bi zɔri dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: The LORD is for me—I wont be afraid. What can anyone do to me?.

dag: Obɛd daa nyɛla Jɛhu ba, ka Jɛhu nyɛ Azaria ba.
en: Obed was Jehus father. Jehu was Azariahs father.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka ku tum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa tuma.
en: The Lord said, If you will not obey my commands, you will be punished.

dag: Nyin zoli din do Zɛrubabɛl tooni ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee nyɛ a? A ni leei tintani. O ni me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa. Ka o yi ti zaŋ kuɣ shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa pa di zuɣu, di saha maa niriba ni ti kuhi yɛli, Naawuni nirilim galisiya, Naawuni nirilim galisiya. .
en: That tall mountain will be like a flat place for Zerubbabel. He will build the Temple, and when the most important stone is put in place, the people will shout, Beautiful! Beautiful.

dag: Hanna daa suhiri Naawuni la o suhu ni, amaa ka o naŋgbampiba lee damda, ka so daa bi wumd o kukoli. Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa tɛhi ni o nyula dam kuli.
en: Now Hannah was praying in her heart; her lips were moving, but her voice was silent, so Eli thought she was drunk.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Everyone ate all they wanted. What was left over filled twelve baskets.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka zaŋ dari mali adaka n-zaŋ li du zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka n sanna.
en: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.

dag: To, lala zuɣu m bi zɔrila yiriŋ; m mi bi be kaman chɔriŋmɛra ŋun ŋmɛri pɔhim.
en: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti chirigi Firawuna saha shɛl o ni chani mɔɣili ni la n-yɛl o ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Early tomorrow morning go and meet the king as he goes to the river, and tell him that the Lord says, Let my people go, so that they can worship me.

dag: Shia Kasi maa n-nyɛ Shi so o ni daa zaŋ niŋ ti ni pam Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la zuɣu.
en: God poured out the Holy Spirit abundantly on us through Jesus Christ our Savior.

dag: Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ni ti tarigi n-kpalim zani Hɛshibɔn, dama buɣim yi Hɛshibɔn na ka buɣim niɛm yi naa Sihɔn yiŋ na. Di di Mɔabnim ninvuɣ zuɣuri, ka di duŋtaariba zuɣuŋmana.
en: People have run from the powerful enemy. They ran to safety in the town of Heshbon. But a fire started in Heshbon. That fire started in Sihons town, and it is destroying the leaders of Moab. It is destroying those proud people.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛman nim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: Jesus answered, Evil and sinful people are the ones who want to see a miracle as a sign. But no miracle will be done to prove anything to them. The only sign will be the miracle that happened to the prophet Jonah.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n ni teei n nuu chɛ ka alɔbo lu a min a niriba zaa zuɣu n-naai yi balibu zaa dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: I could use my power and cause a disease that would wipe you and your people off the earth.

dag: M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu nti be zoya zaa mini daboli kam zuɣu dari ginda. M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni, ka so kani ŋun ni lihi bo bɛ shee.
en: My flock strayed on all the mountains and on every high hill throughout all the earth. My flock was scattered, and there was no one to look for them or find them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya yaha, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: Jesus replied, Again its written, Dont test the Lord your God .

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Aduna bidibisi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: These are the groups to which the descendants of Aaron belong. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Di zaŋ pako so ŋun na bi paai yuun pihiyɔbu yuli pahi pakoya kalinli ni. Ka din pahi nyɛla, di simdi ni ŋun yuli ni tooi pahi bɛ kalinli ni nyɛla ŋun daa pun kulila do yino kɔŋko;.
en: Put a widow on the list who is older than years old and who was faithful to her husband.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka m po pɔri ka o yɛli ma, Miri ka a kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa;.
en: My master made me promise with a vow to obey his command. He said, Do not choose a wife for my son from the young women in the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka Krispus ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda ka Kɔrintinim pam bɛn daa wum Pool yɛligu maa gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Crispus, who was the leader of the synagogue, believed in the Lord, together with all his family; and many other people in Corinth heard the message, believed, and were baptized.

dag: yin ti zaŋmiya bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba zaa ti Yawɛ. Yi biŋkɔbiri ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣilɔ shɛb zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: you must remember to give the Lord every firstborn boy. And every male animal that is the firstborn must also be given to the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ suhuyubu soli ka jɛmdi wun shɛŋa la ni ti bemi kaman jinjɛŋŋmaa din lan ka buchi ŋɔ ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: These evil people have refused to obey me. They have been as stubborn and wicked as ever, and have worshiped and served other gods. So then, they will become like these shorts that are no longer any good.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma pahi.
en: The Lord said:.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Patrɔs zani dabari. N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Zɔan, ka ti kari Tɛbisinim saria.
en: I will turn Pathros into a desolation, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgments in Thebes.

dag: Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm: Yiɣisimiya n-zaŋ yi yɛla maa fabili niŋ zoya, ka chɛ ka daboya wum yi kukoya.
en: Hear what the LORD is saying: Arise, lay out the lawsuit before the mountains; let the hills hear your voice!.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Naawuni yihi ma vi ni.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She said, God has taken away my disgrace by giving me a son.

dag: M pala ŋun mali yolisim? M pala tumo? N nini daa bi nya ti Duuma Yisa? Yi pala n tuma nyɔri ti Duuma ni?.
en: Am I not a free man? Am I not an apostle? Haven't I seen Jesus our Lord? And aren't you the result of my work for the Lord?.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi yila yilibu zani tariga, ka so ku lan wum yi mɔɣilɔnim kumsi.
en: I will put an end to all your songs, and I will silence the music of your harps.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka Manaasa daa zaŋ niriba maa m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ birigi n-tum tuumbiɛri hal gari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka Naawuni ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa ʒin nimaani la.
en: But they wouldnt listen. Manasseh led them into doing even more evil than the nations the LORD had wiped out before the Israelites.

dag: Nyam n ni yur a zaligunim maa shɛm. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili.
en: Look at how much I love your precepts. Make me live again, LORD, according to your faithful love!.

dag: Di bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee ŋun nyɛ vubɔra, amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun be baalim, ka pa ni ŋun ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu nti yaɣi.
en: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli? Amaa tinim nyɛla bɛn mali Masia tɛha.
en: As the Scriptures say, Who can know what is on the Lords mind? Who is able to give him advice? Isaiah : But we have been given Christs way of thinking.

dag: Dama lala ni chɛ ka yi bihi maa chɛ ma dolibu ka jɛmdi binnana, di saha Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kun ya yomyom.
en: If you do, they will turn your children away from following me. Then your children will serve other gods, and the Lord will be very angry with you. He will quickly destroy you!.

dag: O ʒiɛla luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu mini so naŋgban kpansi ni sochira zuɣu.
en: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.

dag: Ka Naawuni sɔŋ Judanim gba n-ti ba naŋgbanyini ni bɛ niŋ naa min o kpambaliba ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm kaman Yawɛ yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Also, in Judah Gods power united the people so that they would obey the king and his officials concerning the word of the Lord .

dag: Pa palo n-kul do a tooni ŋɔ? Woligim ka chɛ ma. A yi zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo, n ni zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo; ka a yi zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo, m mi ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo.
en: There is plenty of land for you to choose from. Let's separate. If you go north, I'll go south; if you go south, I'll go north.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa po pɔri Yawɛ sani yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, a yi ni zaŋ niriba ŋɔ niŋ ti nuu ni, ti ni saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi zaa.
en: Then the Israelites made a vow to the Lord : If you will let us conquer these people, we will unconditionally dedicate them and their cities to you and will destroy them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya Naawuni nam.
en: I assure you that some standing here wont die before they see Gods kingdom.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Dauda zuliya ni so di nam nimaani. A ni guli n ni pii na so maa.
en: Here I will make one of David's descendants a great king; here I will preserve the rule of my chosen king.

dag: Ɛdom naa ni daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari maa, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa taɣi doli shɛli polo gari.
en: Edom refused to allow Israel to cross his border. And Israel turned away from him.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka o daa zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtisaida.
en: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He took them with him, and they went off by themselves to a town named Bethsaida.

dag: Pahatimɔab daŋ ni: Adina mini Kɛlal ni Bɛnaaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Matania so yaha ni Bɛzalɛl ni Binnui ni Manaasa.
en: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;.

dag: Di nyɛla vi ni nir tɔɣisi niriba ni niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni yɛla.
en: Its embarrassing to even talk about what certain persons do in secret.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ n tiliginsim; dina n-nyɛ ni ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku paag o sanna.
en: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la.
en: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy— To the people of the church in Thessalonica, who belong to God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zahimmi yɛlli maa ka baŋ a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm; dama dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi tahi zaɣ biɛɣu ti kpɛm maa sanna n-tabil o yiŋnim zaa, ka o mi yɛla kpɛm pam ka nir ku tooi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Think about that and see what you can do, because trouble is coming for our master and his whole household. But hes such a despicable person no one can speak to him.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋuna n-lan nyɛ n yaa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ti ma tiliginsim. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n ni paɣir o. O nyɛla n yab Naawuni, ka n ni duh o pam.
en: The Lord is my strong defender; he is the one who has saved me. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father's God, and I will sing about his greatness.

dag: ka piligi bur o taba, ka pahi danyuriba zuɣu diri ka nyura.
en: And suppose they began to beat their fellow servants and to eat and drink with the drunks?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ka yi ti tɛhi ni yi ni mali niriba pam, ka lan mali salima naɣila shɛb Jɛrɔbɔam ni mali tin ya, ka bɛ nyɛ yi buɣa la zuɣu yi ni tooi tuhi Yawɛ nam shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ Dauda bihi nuu ni ŋɔ.
en: Now you propose to fight against the royal authority that the Lord gave to David's descendants. You have a huge army and have with you the gold bull-calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ni binshɛɣukam ni niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ sani, ka yɛri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ tipawumli doli bɛ tipawumli suhuyubu maa mi ni zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ba.
en: They keep saying to those who scorn Gods message, All will go well for you, and to those who follow their own willful hearts, Nothing bad will happen to you.

dag: Ka gɔtihi maa tir o mahim, ka kuligara gil o niŋ sunsuuni.
en: or hides among reeds in the swamp.

dag: Ka yi yi ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin ti miriya ka yi vuɣi yi kpee tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha niriba ni daa kpa shɛli, ka di be bɛ ni yɛn piri tiŋgban shɛŋa tin ya la ni.
en: You must not move the stones that mark your neighbors property. People put them there in the past to mark each persons property. These stones mark the land that the Lord your God gave you.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan bɔhi Ibrahimma, Wula ka a daa lee tɛhi hal ti niŋ lala maa.
en: What were you thinking when you did this?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Izraɛlnim maa tooni guui kpa mɔɣu polo, amaa bɛ daa bi tooi zo n-tiligi. Bɛn daa yi tiŋ maa puuni na la daa taɣi ba niŋ sunsuuni n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: They turned back before the Israelites in the direction of the desert, but the fighting caught up with them, and those from the towns were slaughtering them there.

dag: Bɛ daa me duu maa naala gol so bɛ ni daa booni Ada la daba ata dali, yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayɔbu la ni.
en: They finished the Temple on the third day of the month Adar in the sixth year of the reign of Emperor Darius.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Tishibi nir la, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti tuhi Samaria naa tuumba ŋɔ soli m-bɔhi ba, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka yi ti chanila Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la sani ni a ti bɔh o nya.
en: About the same time, an angel from the Lord sent Elijah the prophet from Tishbe to say to the king's messengers, Ahaziah has rejected Israel's own God by sending you to ask Baalzebub about his injury.

dag: Pa so n-yɛn yihi n nyɛvili maa, amaa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n yɛn zaŋ li sɔŋ. M mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ li sɔŋ, ka lan mali yiko din ni ti lan kpuɣ li yaha. M Ba ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.

dag: Bɛ pahimi yi zuɣu ka yi tummi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma mini bɛ tuun shɛŋa din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni zaa; ka ninvuɣ zino miri ka o zaŋ omaŋ bali yi ni.
en: They will join you and work with you. They will be responsible for caring for the Meeting Tent. All the work that must be done in the Tent will be done by them. No one else may come near the place where you are.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o yila nimaani n-kpe fɔntin shɛli ni, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa ni bo gabisi yina nti vo tiŋ maa ti bahi zolɔŋni hal ka nir ti ku lan nya di kuɣibil nimaani gba.
en: If they go into a walled town, we will put ropes around that town and drag it into the river. We won't leave even one small piece of a stone.

dag: amaa di buɣisi di dundɔŋ la dina, dama bɛ zaŋ li tila bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ ni ti no n-gili tiŋ kasi la puuni chir pihinahinaayi.
en: But dont measure the yard outside the temple. Leave it alone. It has been given to those who are not Gods people. They will show their power over the holy city for months.

dag: O daa kamina ti nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim. O daa nyo yil karili kam buɣim.
en: Nebuzaradan burned down the Lord 's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi n dan Naa Dauda nyɛvili.
en: Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground and said, Your Majesty, I pray that you will live a long time.

dag: Lihimi Bɛhɛmɔt so n ni nam kaman n ni nam a shɛm ŋɔ; o ŋubirila mɔri kaman naɣilaa la.
en: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ niŋ daɣiri yihibu kom niŋ bɛmaŋa daba ata dali mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka leei bɛn be nyam. Amaa bɛ yi bi niŋ lala daba ata mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa dali, bɛ ku leei bɛn be nyam.
en: That person must be cleansed with water on the third and seventh days to be clean. If he fails to be cleansed with water on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia mini yurilim shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu ni yi pahimi n zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ma.
en: Brothers and sisters, I beg you to help me in my work by praying to God for me. Do this because of our Lord Jesus and the love that the Spirit gives us.

dag: N nya mbusim, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so kum ni mali ka o bi nya tiwalli bee wain tiwala dira. Dama bɛ pun pɔhi wain tiwala mini fiig tiwala zaa.
en: Im doomed! Ive become like one who, even after the summer fruit has been gathered, after the ripened fruits have been collected, has no cluster of grapes to eat, no ripe fig that I might desire.

dag: N ni lan yɛli yaha, so di tɛhi ni n nyɛla jɛrigu, ka yi yi tɛhi lala, yin shiri lihimiya ma kaman jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka n gba tooi nyu bara biɛla.
en: I tell you again: No one should think that I am a fool. But if you think I am a fool, then accept me as you would accept a fool. Then I can boast a little too.

dag: Benya kaman biliɛri la din ni chɛ ka yi suhuri kul ye Naawuni yɛligu din ŋmani bihim alal la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi zooi nya tiliginsim.
en: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.

dag: Anabinima n-su bɛmaŋmaŋ shihi fukumsi.
en: The spirits of prophets are under the control of the prophets.

dag: Hur n-daa nyɛ Uri ba, ka Uri mi daa nyɛ Bɛzalɛl ba.
en: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka n lan ka tahima yaha.
en: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.

dag: O ni daa yɛli bia maa yɛla shɛm maa daa chɛ ka di gar o ba min o ma pam.
en: His father and mother were amazed by what was said about him.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Shɛkɛmnim daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti do mɔɣu ni, ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: The next day, the men of Shechem went out into the fields. When it was reported to Abimelech.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn zaɣisi ma, ka tam n zoli din be kasi la yɛla, ka puhiri churi ka jɛmdi zuɣusuŋ wuna la.
en: But it will be different for you that forsake me, who ignore Zion, my sacred hill, and worship Gad and Meni, the gods of luck and fate.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka yɛli Yisa, Nyam a nyaandoliba maa ni tumdi din chihiri ni bɛ tum Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim lan ka yɛm yɔɣo? Yɛnnim la bi lan tiri niriba yɛm saɣisigu? Bɛ yɛm maa naami?.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says about Edom: Wisdom and common sense have vanished from Teman.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a paɣiba zaa min a bidibisi yi nti ti Babilɔnnima, ka amaŋmaŋ ku tiligi bɛ nuu ni. Amaa Babilɔn naa ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaag a, ka nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim.
en: Then I added, All your women and children will be taken out to the Babylonians, and you yourself will not escape from them. You will be taken prisoner by the king of Babylonia, and this city will be burned to the ground.

dag: M biɛhigu nyɛla ŋmahinli niriba pam sani, amaa nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee din mali kpiɔŋ.
en: My life has been an example to many, because you have been my strong defender.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la daa chaŋ Galili zo shɛli zuɣu Yisa ni daa wuhi ba la.
en: The eleven disciples went to the hill in Galilee where Jesus had told them to go.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa shiri niŋ lala dindali maa yuŋ. O daa chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kummi, amaa ka chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani din gil li zaa.
en: That night, God made the stone floor wet with dew, but he kept the sheep skin dry.

dag: Hal n yi bela kum vinvamli zibisim ni chana, n ku zo shɛli dabiɛm; dama a be n sani. A jaaŋgbee min a piɛgul jaaŋgbee la nyɛla din kpaŋsiri n suhu.
en: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.

dag: Amaa ka Samaria do so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti paai nimaani nya o, ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu pam;.
en: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him.

dag: N ni ti mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ mini sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka lan mali Aduna min o bidibisi la gba ka bɛ be kasi, ka tumdi maligumaaniba tuma tiri ma.
en: So I will make the Meeting Tent and the altar holy. I will also make Aaron and his sons holy so that they can serve me as priests.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔŋ ma, bɛmaŋ ka bɛ tum barina maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je ma nyɛla bɛn yuri kum.
en: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.

dag: ka ninvuɣ yino bee a niriba Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino yi ti baŋ din muɣis o o suhu ni, ka teeg o nuu tiri duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: whatever prayer or petition is made by any individual or by all of your people Israel—because people will recognize their own pain and spread out their hands toward this temple.

dag: Bɔ saha ka o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani maa? Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la bee o gunibu la nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o zali di ni maa? Di nyɛla o ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la, ka pa ni o ni daa gun la nyaaŋa.
en: So how did this happen? Did God accept Abraham before or after he was circumcised? God accepted him before his circumcision.

dag: Zara daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Zara yuma ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: Sarah lived to be years old; this was how long she lived.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yihi ma biŋkɔbigulibo maa ni ka yɛli ma, Cham ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ti n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: I was a shepherd and the Lord took me from following the sheep. The Lord said to me, Go, prophesy to my people Israel.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpiɔŋlan yi lo kpara n-ʒe n-gul o yili, o nɛma zaa tiligirimi;.
en: When a strong man, with all his weapons ready, guards his own house, all his belongings are safe.

dag: Ka o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu maa n-yɔhim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bahi yol la. Din chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn bahi yoli maa nyɛla bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ yu yɛlimaŋli ka tiligi la zuɣu.
en: and use every kind of wicked deceit on those who will perish. They will perish because they did not welcome and love the truth so as to be saved.

dag: Nanima, wummiya! Zuɣulaannima, wummiya! N ni yili yila niɣim n kukoli paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Hear, kings! Listen, rulers! I, to the LORD, I will sing. I will make music to the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya suhudoo.
en: There is no well-being, says the LORD, for the wicked.

dag: N zanila n Duuma zaani ni n yɛli dimbɔŋɔ kpahi yi zuɣu ni, di lan maliya bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ka bɛ tɛha nyɛ tɛhi yoya la biɛhigu.
en: In the Lord's name, then, I warn you: do not continue to live like the heathen, whose thoughts are worthless.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛl o kpambaliba, Yi mi ni Ramɔtigiliad nyɛla ti ni su luɣ shɛli, ka ti kul shini ka bi deei li Siria Naa sani maa.
en: Israels king said to his servants, You know, dont you, that Ramoth-gilead is ours? But we arent doing anything to take it back from the king of Aram.

dag: Amaa a dabili maa yi yɛl a, N ku chaŋ ka chɛ a, ka di nyɛla o ni yur a mini a yiŋnima yi ni gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: Now if your male servant says to you: I dont want to leave your service because he loves you and your family and because life is good for him in your service.

dag: Cham gili bɛ ni saɣim luɣ shɛli zaa kahikahi maa; ti dimnim maa saɣim binshɛɣukam din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la.
en: God, come walk through these ancient ruins. Come back to the Holy Place that the enemy destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Tamiya duu maa daɣiri, ka ku niriba sɔŋ dundɔna ni, chamiya! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti ku niriba.
en: He said to them: Make the temple unclean! Fill the courts with the slain! Go! And they went out and attacked the city.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Mɛshɔbab mini Jamlɛk ni Amazia bia Jɔsha.
en: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.

dag: di saha ka o wuhiri ba bɛ tuma mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ karimbaani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God shows them their sins and their pride.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla yabiga nyuhi niriba ŋɔ, ka zaŋ lɔɣu ni be ko shɛl ni nyuhi ba.
en: So the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says, I will soon make the people of Judah eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi zaɣisi ba bee m-bahi ba yoli. A nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔbo Naawuni!.
en: But you are so kind! You didnt completely destroy them. You didnt leave them. You are such a kind and merciful God!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛl ti shɛlikam maa zaa, ka ni chaŋ a ni kul yɛl ti ni ti cham luɣ shɛlikam.
en: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Lala n-nyɛ ŋun bo n-nya bun la omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, lala nir pala bundana.
en: And Jesus concluded, This is how it is with those who pile up riches for themselves but are not rich in God's sight.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la kuna. Ka Jɔab daa chɛ ka Yuria kuli Dauda sani.
en: David sent a message to Joab: Send Uriah the Hittite to me. Joab sent Uriah.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuma ayopɔin saha ka Izraɛlnim shɛb mini Maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba gba daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Some of the Israelites and some of the priests and the Levites, the singers and gatekeepers and the temple servants also came up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

dag: n-chaŋ ti ʒe Yisa sani kumda, ka o nintam tɔɣiri luri Yisa naba zuɣu, ka o mal li paɣiri Yisa naba maa, ka mal o zabiri nyɛhiri li, ka bɔbindi li ka zaŋ tulaale maa ʒiɛri li.
en: Then she came and stood behind Jesus. She cried and started washing his feet with her tears and drying them with her hair. The woman kissed his feet and poured the perfume on them.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kul ka fahim?.
en: Jesus said, Do you still have trouble understanding?.

dag: Ninive yɛla ŋɔ zaa ŋmanila pagɔr tuma din nyɛ kɔre kpɛhibu din ka kalinli; di ŋmanila paɣ timalana ŋun zaŋ kɔre kpɛhibu gbahi zuliya pam, ka zaŋ o tima maa yɔhim niriba pam la.
en: Because of the many whorings of the whore, the lovely graces of the mistress of sorceries, the one who sells nations by means of her whorings and peoples by means of her sorceries.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ dundɔŋ gili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunoli. Lala ka Musa daa niŋ naai tuma maa.
en: He set up the courtyard around the dwelling and the altar, and he hung up the screen at the courtyards gate. When Moses had finished all the work.

dag: Ka o yi shini, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi galim o? Ka o yi zaŋ o nini sɔɣi, ninvuɣ so beni ŋun ni tooi nya o? Amaa ŋuna n-su daadamnim mini zuliya kam zaa.
en: Still, if he remains quiet, who can condemn; if he hides his face, who can see him?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Izraɛl zuɣulana hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Samuel led Israel all his life.

dag: Di saha maa zuliya pam ni ti zo n-ka Yawɛ sanna nti leeg o niriba. Ka ŋun Yawɛ ni be yi sani, ka yi baŋ ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma yi sanna maa.
en: At that time people from many nations will come to me. They will become my people, and I will live in your city. Then you will know it was the Lord All-Powerful who sent me to tell you these things.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim n ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ninni maa sani.
en: But I did not, since that would have brought dishonor to my name among the nations which had seen me lead Israel out of Egypt.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, ti daa kpalim be nimaani la daba ata.
en: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.

dag: O yihi ma gballi ni. O zaŋ yurilim maŋli min o nambɔzɔbo leei zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: He keeps me from the grave and blesses me with love and mercy.

dag: O ni doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o lan yɛn doli labi; o ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Hell go back by the same way he came. He wont enter this city, declares the LORD.

dag: Miriya daadamnima! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.

dag: Yɛl shɛŋa n ni pun wuhi ya la n-chɛ ka yinim mali zaa ka ka daɣiri ŋɔ.
en: You are already trimmed because of the word I have spoken to you.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not work on my special days of rest. You must honor my holy place. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka n daa kahigi n daalahichi wuh a; ka bi sɔɣi n ni tum taal shɛŋa. N daa yɛliya, Yawɛ, n ni kahigi n daalahichi maa wuh a, ka a daa chɛ n daalahichi maa zaa.
en: So I admitted my sin to you; I didnt conceal my guilt. Ill confess my sins to the LORD, is what I said. Then you removed the guilt of my sin. Selah.

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka bɛ bi lan tiri Lɛvinim bɛ dihili ni nyɛ shɛli, dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim mini yiliyiiniba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma maa daa chɛ li ka chaŋ bɛ puri ni.
en: I also found out that the Levites hadnt been given their portions, so they and the singers who did the work had gone back to their fields.

dag: N naba kul ʒiɛla luɣ pasi shee; ka n kul ni paɣiri nyin Yawɛ jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni.
en: I am safe from all danger as I stand here praising you, Lord , in the assembly of your people.

dag: Ka sokam ti nya ka di nyɛla man Yawɛ n-juui buɣim maa, ka di ku kpi. .
en: Then all people will see that I, the Lord , have started the fire. The fire will not be put out.

dag: Javan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Rodanim.
en: Javans family: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa kuhi yɛli ma, Nyama, wɔr shɛb bɛn zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la nyɛla bɛn chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu maai.
en: Then he shouted at me and said, Look, those horses that were going north finished their job in Babylon . They have calmed my spirit; I am not angry now.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi bɛ naa salima zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu, ka kuɣ viɛlli daa be di ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda zuɣu ni, ka o daa va bɛ ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam.
en: David took the crown off their kings head. The crown was gold and weighed about pounds. This crown had precious stones in it. They put the crown on Davids head. David took many valuable things out of the city.

dag: ka o daa yɛli Yaakubu, Niŋm a ʒiɛri din mɔhi ŋɔ ti ma ka m piɛbi, dama kum wum ma pam. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o Ɛdom.
en: So Esau said to Jacob, I am weak with hunger. Let me have some of that red soup.

dag: Jɔab min o mabia Abishai ni daa ku Abinɛr shɛm m-bala. O ni daa ku bɛ mabia Asahɛl Gibiɔn tɔb la ni zuɣu.
en: Joab and his brother Abishai killed Abner because Abner had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chamiya gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yihi tiliginsim lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti sokam.
en: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.

dag: N dana, daŋmi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ tooni, ka m mali biŋkɔbiri maa mini bihi maa chani biɛlabiɛla na hal ti paag a Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So you go on ahead. I will follow you slowly. I will go slowly enough for the cattle and other animals to be safe and so that my children will not get too tired. I will meet you in Seir.

dag: ni Shaaraim ni Aditaim ni Gɛdɛra ni Gɛdɛrɔtaim: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaanahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim: fourteen cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ bi simdi ni di gari ti, dama Sintani gba lɛbigir omaŋa m-be kaman neesim malaika n-nyɛ o la.
en: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali ba pam mali alibarika. O yi ʒe o dimnim tooni saria karibu shee o ku di vi.
en: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.

dag: Ɛlikana daa yi kɔrigi binshɛli m-mali sara dahin shɛli o ŋmahirila nimdi tar o paɣ Pɛnina min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi zaa.
en: Whenever Elkanah offered his sacrifices, he always gave one share of the food to his wife Peninnah and a share of the food to each of Peninnahs children.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Doo ŋun daa neei zom nina ŋɔ daa naan ku faai Lazarɔs gba bahi ka o ku kpi.
en: Some of them said, He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying.

dag: Ka n yi kul yi a sani chaŋ, Yawɛ shia ni kana nti kpuɣ a kpa shɛli polo n ni ʒi, ka n chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab ka o ti bi nya a, o ni ku ma, hal man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kul nyɛ ŋun doli Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga m bilim ni ha la zaa yoli.
en: If I go tell King Ahab that you are here, the Spirit of the Lord might carry you away. Then when King Ahab comes here and cannot find you, he will kill me! I have followed the Lord since I was a boy.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya sara maligu bimbini ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: King Solomon had a bronze altar made, which was feet square and feet high.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ cham ti ku Amalɛknim maa, ka saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa, di chɛ ka bɛ ni so kpalim, amaa kum dɔbba mini paɣiba ni biliɛri ni bimɔɣirisi n-tabili naɣilahi mini piɛri ni laakumnim ni bunsi zaa. .
en: Go and attack the Amalekites! Destroy them and all their possessions. Don't have any pity. Kill their men, women, children, and even their babies. Slaughter their cattle, sheep, camels, and donkeys.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, N yilikpɛrinima, yi nya zahim? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai.
en: Jesus called to them, Children, have you caught anything to eat? They answered him, No.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka ŋun ti yab Ibrahimma ba daa ti kpi, ka Naawuni lan zaŋ o nimaani tahi yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ na.
en: And so he left his country and went to live in Haran. After Abraham's father died, God made him move to this land where you now live.

dag: N daa nyɛla nandaamba ba; ka daa zaani saamba nyaaŋa bɛ yɛla ni.
en: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima mini diɣi buɣisi li bee nir ti zaŋ li taɣi salima din viɛli yɛri.
en: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.

dag: O ni ti kpa o nam tanti suɣ kara teeku mini zo shɛli din be kasi la sunsuuni. Amaa o ni ti kpi, ka so ku be o sani sɔŋ o.
en: He will even set up his huge royal tents between the sea and the mountain on which the Temple stands. But he will die, with no one there to help him.

dag: Chɛliya ka zuliya kam mali shili lir o, Miidia nanim mini bɛ gomnanim ni bɛ wulaannima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din be bɛ sulinsi ni zaa.
en: Get the nations ready for battle against her. Get the kings of the Medes ready. Get their governors and all their important officials ready. Get all the countries they rule ready for battle against Babylon.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya kpiɔŋ Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ ni ti n yuli jilima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , will make my people strong, and they will live for me. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Dama mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka fan ya dabitim bandi ni bahi, ka daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam nyɛ yi toondaannima.
en: I brought you out of Egypt; I rescued you from slavery; I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead you.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Daina ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu mini Liya bipuɣiŋga la daa ti chaŋ ni o ti puhi tiŋ maa ni paɣiba;.
en: One day Dinah, the daughter of Jacob and Leah, went to visit some of the Canaanite women.
