dag: ka yi nini daa nya zahimbu kara mini shihir kara ni alahiziba tuun kara la.
en: You saw the terrible plagues, the miracles, and the great wonders that the Lord performed.

dag: Chɛ ka ti mini ya kpuɣiri tab bihi niŋdi ti paɣiba. Zaŋmiya yi bipuɣinsi tiri ti, ka kpuɣimi ti gba bipuɣinsi niŋdi yi paɣiba.
en: Arrange marriages with us: give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa du nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa nti ti suɣili zali Absalom, ka Absalom daa mal o ba mamanim maa dooni nimaani Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: Then they put up a tent for Absalom up on the roof of the house. Absalom had sexual relations with his fathers wives so that all the Israelites could see what happened.

dag: Di dinya buɣa maligu nimdi mini binʒim ni jifa; yi mi di niŋya zina. Yi yi gbaai yimaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. Naawuni sɔŋmi ya.
en: eat no food that has been offered to idols; eat no blood; eat no animal that has been strangled; and keep yourselves from sexual immorality. You will do well if you take care not to do these things. With our best wishes.

dag: Di saha Sɔdomnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛn tumd alahichi pam Yawɛ sani.
en: The Lord knew that the people of Sodom were very evil sinners.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Yes, anyone who does what my Father in heaven wants is my true brother and sister and mother.

dag: Bundana bee nandana bee nabia bee tarima ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ shɛli sɔŋ Ijiptinima.
en: Neither head nor tail, palm branch nor reed will be able to do anything for Egypt.

dag: N daa lihi zoya zuɣu n-nya ka di sɔhirimi, ka daboya zaa daa chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa.
en: I looked at the mountains and they were quaking; all the hills were rocking back and forth.

dag: So ni tooi wuhi Naawuni ŋun kariti wɔɣira saria ŋɔ yɛm?.
en: Can anyone teach God, who judges even those in high places?.

dag: Yawɛ yuri Jɛrusalɛm gari tin shɛŋa din zaa be Izraɛl.
en: The LORD loves Zions gates more than all of Jacobs houses combined.

dag: Doo miri ka o kpuɣ o ba paɣa n-filim o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o nya o ba zaɣim.
en: A man cannot marry his fathers former wife so that his fathers private matters are not exposed.

dag: Ka Gaad daa ka Dauda sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o, Cham Aruna Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili la ni ti me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: That same day Gad went to David and said to him, Go up to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa vuɣi li ni suhuyiɣisili n-daai li luhi tiŋa. Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim daa ʒe li ka di kuui. Ka di wala zaa daa suui, ka di mundili din mali yaa la daa kuui, ka buɣim di li.
en: But angry hands pulled it up by the roots and threw it to the ground. The east wind dried up its fruit. Its branches were broken off; they dried up and were burned.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o Bia maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: A nyɛla Naawuni, a nam ʒiishee kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Wuntia jaaŋgbee n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni a nam fukumsi tam la wuntia zuɣu.
en: About the Son, however, God said: Your kingdom, O God, will last forever and ever! You rule over your people with justice.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Tabɛra, Yawɛ buɣim ni daa di bɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: So that place was called Taberah. The people gave the place that name because the Lord caused a fire to burn in their camp.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun doli yili maa dunoli yi, ka yo yili maa zali hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: he will have the house closed for seven days.

dag: Bɛrɔtnim maa daa zo n-chaŋla Giteem nti ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The people who used to live in Beeroth had run away to Gittaim, and they still live there.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla m mini n niriba kɔhi ni bɛ ku ti kpihim ti birili. Di yi di nyɛla bɛ zaŋla ti dɔbba mini paɣiba kɔhi ni ti leei daba, n naan shini ka ku zaŋ di yɛla muɣis a, dama nir ku tooi zaŋ ti ni yɛn di wahala shɛli buɣisi nyin naa ni yɛn kɔŋ shɛli.
en: We have been sold—I and my people—to be wiped out, killed, and destroyed. If we simply had been sold as male and female slaves, I would have said nothing. But no enemy can compensate the king for this kind of damage.

dag: Ka hal yɛlli maa yi lula Gomna tibili ni gba, ti ni bo shɛli ti o ka o ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: If the governor hears about this, we will talk to him and keep you out of trouble.

dag: ka kuhi yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zan a naba zuɣu! Ka gbarigu maa dii vaai yiɣisi zani gbaai chandi.
en: So Paul shouted, Stand up on your feet! The man jumped up and began walking around.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun daa siɣina maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa lan lab du zuɣusaa n-gari chaŋ ha ni o ti pali luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: The one who went down is the same one who climbed up above all the heavens so that he might fill everything.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o tee li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa m-be kaman o nu din la.
en: Then Jesus told the man, Hold out your hand. The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihitaayika n-daa be bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛ zuɣulana n-daa nyɛ Zabidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hagɛdolim bia la.
en: and their associates, for a total of courageous people. Their supervisor was Zabdiel, Haggedolims son.

dag: Chinchin tibisi shɛli daa yili di puuni, ka bɛ booni tanti du shɛli din be chinchini maa nyaaŋa mi Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee.
en: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place.

dag: Daadam Bia kamina ni o ti tiligi nyɛviya, ka pa ni o ti di nyɛviya. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi taɣi tiŋkpan shɛli.
en: Then he and his followers went to another town.

dag: Pa ninsal yɛm yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali wuhiri yɛla ŋɔ maa, amaa di nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ wuhi ti, ka ti mi mal li kahigiri Naawuni Shia yɛla wuhiri bɛn mali Naawuni Shia.
en: When we say this, we dont use words taught to us by human wisdom. We use words taught to us by the Spirit. We use the Spirits words to explain spiritual truths.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, gunibu mali buchi la a yi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm; amaa a yi bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, dindina a bemi kaman ŋun bi guni.
en: If you follow the law, then your circumcision has meaning. But if you break the law, then it is as if you were never circumcised.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: The notice of the accusation against him said: The King of the Jews.

dag: Amaa zoli nyɛla din luri wurinda, ka tampiŋ vuɣiri di dooshee.
en: But an eroding mountain breaks up, and rock is displaced.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ daŋ shɛli niriba fali tarili n-tom ti daŋ shɛli niriba; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba vili gbibila bɛmaŋmaŋ fali tarili.
en: and the property will not pass from one tribe to another. Each tribe will continue to possess its own property.

dag: Yi yi ti birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ soli, yi ni ti wum o kukoli yi nyaaŋa polo ka di yɛra, Soli maa m-bɔŋɔ, doliya li.
en: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, This is the road! Now follow it.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ti ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka kul ni kpalim bela ninvuɣubiɛtali maa tuma ni. Naɣila bɛn mali yɛm kɔŋko n-ni ti baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Many people will be made pure—they will make themselves clean. But evil people will continue to be evil. And those wicked people will not understand these things, but the wise people will understand them.

dag: Ka o daa gɔri gindi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: He traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and throwing out demons.

dag: Ŋunkam wuhi zom soli kpɛhi yɔɣu, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who tricks a blind man into going the wrong way! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni dabiɛm mini ni sɔhibu.
en: Serve the LORD reverently— trembling.

dag: Amaa ka Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la mini Tɔbaya ŋun mi daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tumtumdiba zuɣulan la daa wum ni ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti tum tuun shɛli din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima, ka di daa bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim zaa.
en: But Sanballat, from the town of Beth Horon, and Tobiah, an official in the province of Ammon, heard that someone had come to work for the good of the people of Israel, and they were highly indignant.

dag: maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ bo noombihi nɛma ayi bɛn ka daɣiri mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro na.
en: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani nyɛla Kɔɔban .
en: But you say, If you tell your father or mother,Everything Im expected to contribute to you is corban .

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni di n-tiɣi ka zaɣis a ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ. Bee n yi nyɛ faralana n ni zu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ta n Naawuni yuli daɣiri.
en: If I have too much, I might deny that I need you, Lord . But if I am too poor, I might steal and bring shame to the name of my God.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛli Mɔabnim yɛtɔɣ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ar zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi. Kɛɛr zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi.
en: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka kpiɔŋnim zaŋ takɔbiri na ti ku a tɔbbihi. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ ni ti saɣim Ijiptinim ni mali binshɛŋa nyuri bara la, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa.
en: Your soldiers will be killed by the cruelest army in the world, and everything you take pride in will be crushed.

dag: Di pa shɛli n niŋgbuŋ mini n suhu zaa ni ti gbarigi. Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ n suhu ni ni ŋun kul su ma sahakam.
en: My body and my heart fail, but God is my hearts rock and my share forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim kana ti taai di nimdi maa mini dari maa ni kuɣa ni taŋkpaɣu, ka chɛ ka ko shɛli din daa be bɔɣili maa ni farifari nyuui.
en: The Lord sent fire down, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones, scorched the earth and dried up the water in the trench.

dag: O ʒi n-niŋ zuliya shɛb lala; bɛ ʒi o zaligunima. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He did not do this for any other nation. He did not teach his laws to other people. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ maa ni ti kpe Maika yiŋa.
en: Then they went into the hill country of Ephraim. When they came close to Micah's house.

dag: Ti dimnim maa ni daa wum ni ti baŋ bɛ ni lɔri nia shɛli maa yɛla, ka baŋ ni Naawuni nyaŋ ba bɛ ni lo nia shɛli maa ni, ka ti zaa daa lan lab gooni maa gbini, ka sokam ti tumd o tuma.
en: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.

dag: O mabia Shɛmɛr mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahi mini Rɔga ni Jɛhuba ni Aram.
en: His brother Shomer had three sons: Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

dag: Naawuni, a daa chɛ ka saa mi pam luɣilikam; a chɛ ka a tiŋgbani din gbarigi la neei.
en: You showered down abundant rain, God; when your inheritance grew weary, you restored it yourself.

dag: Awa yini puuni ka di bun la zaa zani bahi yoli! Ka ŋariŋduhiriba zuɣulaannim mini ŋariŋkpɛriba ni ŋariŋduhiriba ni bɛn zaa wolima yiri teeku ni na kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: All these riches have been destroyed in one hour! Every sea captain, all those who travel on ships, the sailors, and all those who earn money from the sea stood far away from Babylon.

dag: Aduna mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya Musa ka o ninni nyaɣisira maa ka bɛ zɔri ni bɛ mir o.
en: Aaron and all the people of Israel saw that Moses face was shining bright. So they were afraid to go near him.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini Sapashin kpamba, Chamiya ti kali Izraɛlnim zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ti kpa Dan, ka labina ti yɛli ma di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka m baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: So David said to Joab and the leaders of the people, Go and count all the Israelites. Count everyone in the country—from the town of Beersheba all the way to the town of Dan. Then tell me, so I will know how many people there are.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi n-jɛm binyoya din ka buchi, ka ku tooi tiligi ya ŋɔ, dama di ka buchi.
en: Don't go after false gods; they cannot help you or save you, for they are not real.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahim a la ni ka a sanna. Bɛ ni kana ti damdi tiŋ lu a sizuura. Bɛnkam zaa daa ʒiɛm a la ni kana ti jɛm a. Bɛ bol a Yawɛ tiŋa; ka lan bol a Ziɔn din nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la tin titali.
en: The descendants of those who oppressed you will come And bow low to show their respect. All who once despised you will worship at your feet. They will call you The City of the Lord , Zion, the City of Israel's Holy God.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ ni daa niŋ ania la zuɣu, ti booni ba la bɛn mal alibarika. Yi pun wum Ayuba ania niŋbu yɛla, ka nya ti Duuma daliri ni daa nyɛ shɛm di puuni, ka lan nya ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo zaŋ chaŋ o polo min o baɣa ni daa be o ni shɛm.
en: Look at how we honor those who have practiced endurance. You have heard of the endurance of Job. And you have seen what the Lord has accomplished, for the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

dag: Yisifu dan maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa o paɣ ni zaŋ yɛl o ka lan yɛli, Lala ka a dabili maa niŋ ma, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: When Josephs master heard the thing that his wife told him, This is what your servant did to me, he was incensed.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei gunibu maŋli, dama ti jɛmdila Naawuni o Shia Kasi zuɣu ka mali suhupiɛlli ti bebu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ti ka tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni.
en: We are the circumcision. We are the ones who serve by Gods Spirit and who boast in Christ Jesus. We dont put our confidence in rituals performed on the body.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni di leei yi fali shɛli yi ni yɛn su la ni, ka yi deei li su n-ʒini di ni.
en: You will soon enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you. You will take that land and live there.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kpuɣim tɔbu mini piɛma; ka o kpuɣi tɔbu mini piɛma maa.
en: Get a bow and some arrows, Elisha ordered him. Jehoash got them.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tuma ni chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la, ka n chɛ ka yi chaŋ ti tumdi tuma tiri yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni. Dama n suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka di kul ni diri sahakam.
en: You will lose the land I gave you. I will let your enemies take you to be their slaves. That is because I am very angry. My anger is like a hot fire, and you will be burned forever.

dag: o daa yɛlimi, O nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yɛli ni o paɣa m-bala. O daa tɛhimi ni o yi yɛl lala, di pa shɛli ka nimaani nim maa ti ku o Ribɛka zuɣu, dama o daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: When the men there asked about his wife, he said that she was his sister. He would not admit that she was his wife, because he was afraid that the men there would kill him to get Rebecca, who was very beautiful.

dag: Dama Atalia ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ putɔɣulan la bidibisi daa kabila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa kpe, hal ka daa lan zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen kasinim zaa ti jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.

dag: Naawuni ni tim so na maa tɔɣisirila Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, dama Naawuni zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti o ka di ka buɣisibu.
en: The one whom God sent speaks Gods words because God gives the Spirit generously.

dag: Zaŋmiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: You will give burnt offerings to the Lord . The burnt offerings will be bulls, ram, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla peentɔriba, ka daa naan tooi zaŋ bɛ nudiriti bee bɛ nuzahi n-to piɛma bee n-labi kuɣilɔna. Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ Sool dɔɣiriba.
en: armed with bows, and they could use either hand to shoot arrows or sling stones. They were Sauls relatives from Benjamin.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔash ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin saha, ka Jɛhɔahaz bia Jɛhɔash daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: In the thirty-seventh year of the reign of King Joash of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for sixteen years.

dag: Bɛ yaannim ninni ka o daa tum alahiziba tuma Zɔan bɔpiɛligu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: While their ancestors watched, he showed his great power at Zoan in Egypt.

dag: ka di yi nyɛla niriba sɔŋbu, chɛliya ka ti sɔŋm ba. Ka ŋun nyɛ karimba, ŋun wuhima;.
en: if it is to serve, we should serve; if it is to teach, we should teach;.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya ŋun yɛn su n niriba; ka daa zaŋ bidibbihi n-kɔhi bo pagɔra, ka zaŋ bipuɣinsi mi n-kɔhi nyu wain.
en: They threw dice to decide who would get the captives. They sold boys and girls into slavery to pay for prostitutes and wine.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a mini bɛn vari ma la va; ka chɛ ka a mini bɛn tuhiri ma la tuhi!.
en: Oppose those who oppose me, Lord , and fight those who fight against me!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: This is what the Lord said, The time is coming when I will make a new agreement with the family of Israel and with the family of Judah.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni, n lan nya shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yɛm polo, ka di nyɛ yɛlikpeeni n sani.
en: I also saw a person doing a wise thing in this life, and it seemed very important to me.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi nyo tin shɛŋa din daa me n-tam zoya zuɣu la buɣim, gbaai yihila Hazɔr kɔŋko ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo m-bahi.
en: However, the Israelites did not burn any of the cities built on mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua did burn.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim na kul mali duŋ ni Dauda yilinim hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

dag: N ni kul di tiŋgban shɛli fali maa biɛhigu shee viɛla; n ni di fali shɛli maa viɛla.
en: The property lines have fallen beautifully for me; yes, I have a lovely home.

dag: Amaa luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni pii yi zuliya yini sani, nimaani kɔŋko ka yi ni ti maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa, ka niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa nimaani.
en: No, only at the location the LORD selects from one of your tribal areas—thats where you must offer up your entirely burned offerings and thats where you must perform everything Im telling you.

dag: Yi yi ti di n-tiɣi, ka me yiya viɛla be di ni.
en: When you have all you want to eat and have built good houses to live in.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n yi tam a yɛla, n nudirigu din tammi di ni mi shɛli niŋbu.
en: Jerusalem, if I ever forget you, may I never play a song again.

dag: Amaa ka Olivi tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli bɛ ni mali ma doori kpa shɛli ka di tiri wuna mini ninsalinim jilima la tuma ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the olive tree replied to them, Should I stop producing my oil, which is how gods and humans are honored, so that I can go to sway over the trees.

dag: Ansarisimaana bɔrila yɛm kɔŋda, amaa baŋsim yɛla bi to ŋun mali tɛhi zilima sani.
en: Anyone who makes fun of wisdom will never find it, but knowledge comes easily to those who understand its value.

dag: ni Makɛda naa ni Bɛtɛl naa.
en: the king of Makkedah, the king of Bethel.

dag: Hal n ni kul mali yɛlimaŋli maa zaa yoli, bɛ boli ma ʒirilana. Hal n ni bi tum alahichi maa yoli, n dɔro maa ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ti yɛn kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu la zali di zaani la, di dabisa ti yɛn nyɛla biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛi.
en: The daily sacrifice will be stopped. There will be days from that time until the time that the terrible thing that destroys is set up.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wumma, Yawɛ piig a ni a me o jɛmbu duu din nyɛ luɣ kasi shee. Mali yaa n-tum di tuma.
en: Now then, since the LORD has chosen you to build a temple for him as the sanctuary, work hard.

dag: Ka o sɔŋda maa daa zaŋ li ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri ŋub li ka guui kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Then Elishas servant put the food in front of the group of prophets. The group of prophets had enough to eat, and they even had food left over. This happened just as the Lord had said.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ku lan kum. Yi Duuma nyɛla nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi kum niŋ o, o ni wum ka garigi ya.
en: You people who live in Jerusalem will not weep any more. The Lord is compassionate, and when you cry to him for help, he will answer you.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn, ka di ti kpalim be nimaani hal ti paai dabisi shɛli n ni lan yɛn zaŋ n zaŋsim labisi di polo. Di saha ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ li nimaani na ti zali kpe yaha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will be carted off to Babylon where they will remain until the day I come looking for them, declares the LORD; then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ʒili naa dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn guli Lɛvinim yaɣili polo dunɔdal la gbini.
en: Down to that time members of their clans had been stationed at the eastern entrance to the King's Gate. Formerly they had stood guard at the gates to the camps of the Levites.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Lari nyɛla jɛrilim, ka nyaɣisim bɔbu mi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa ti mali salima binnani, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li zali palo ni Babilɔn luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Dura.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar ordered a gold statue to be built meters high and nearly meters wide. He had it set up in Dura Valley near the city of Babylon.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaŋ do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa tahi Farisiinim sani.
en: Then they took to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

dag: Shɛfatia daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: of Shephatiah.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ʒi karimbu.
en: Or you can give the book to someone who cannot read and tell that person to read it. That person will say, I cannot read the book because I dont know how to read.

dag: Di lan simdi ni a pii kpambal shɛb ka bɛ su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tuma fukumsi, ka bɛ ti laɣim bindira pirigibu bunu puuni yim zuɣu zali bindira ni ti yɛn niŋ pam yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni la.
en: You must also appoint other officials and take a fifth of the crops during the seven years of plenty.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni ni tooi neei Yisahaku kum ni; ka di bemi kaman lala n-daa shiri niŋ, dama ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun sani, Yisahaku daa bemi kaman ŋun shiri neei kum ni na.
en: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chani ti miri Jɛriko, ka zoon so daa ʒi sokpaŋ maani bara.
en: Jesus came near the city of Jericho. There was a blind man sitting beside the road. He was begging people for money.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: When the Son of Man comes, it will be the same as what happened during Noahs time.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: Many people are invited, but few people are chosen.

dag: Dindali maa yuntisuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti ku Ijipti bikpamba zaa. Firawuna ŋun daa ʒi o nam ni la bidib kpɛm daa kpiya, hal dansarika so ŋun daa be vol ni sarika ni bidibituuli gba daa kpiya zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi biŋkɔb dib shɛb zaa.
en: At midnight the Lord killed all the firstborn sons in Egypt, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh to the firstborn son of the prisoner sitting in jail. Also all the firstborn animals died.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi ti niŋ pali, di mi nyɛla din ni niŋ pali, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi daa be bɛ ni.
en: But when all your words come true—and they will come true—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa dɔni n-shiri niŋ kaman o biɛrimi la. Ka naa daa ti kana ni o ti kaag o, ka Amnɔn yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka Tama kana ti mali maha ti ma n ninni, ka zaŋ li na ti gbib o nuu ni ka n ŋubi.
en: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. The king came to see him, and Amnon told the king, Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of heart-shaped cakes in front of me so I can eat from her hand.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ma nyintaa bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ o ba dapala dɔni, dama o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa.
en: Do not have intercourse with a half sister; she, too, is your sister.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ kul ku miligi ka chɛn ya hal ka di ti naai yi balibu zaa yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa.
en: He will send disease after disease on you until there is not one of you left in the land that you are about to occupy.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n sani n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, saha shɛli bɛ yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti na hal ni zuŋɔ la zuɣu. .
en: This will happen because they have done what is evil in my eyes, making me angry from the day their ancestors left Egypt until this very moment.

dag: Yinim Gilibɔa zoya, maligim bee saa ku lan lu yi zuɣu na bee bimbilima ti lan bili yi zolɔna ni. Dama nimaani ka kpiɔŋlaannim bidibbina nya filiŋ. Ka Sool nyɔtaɣirigu bi lan nya kpam ʒe.
en: May no rain or dew fall on Gilboa's hills; may its fields be always barren! For the shields of the brave lie there in disgrace; the shield of Saul is no longer polished with oil.

dag: Ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda ti niŋ o yiŋ dindali maa, ka bi saɣi ni o lan kul o ba yiŋa.
en: From that point forward, Saul kept David in his service and wouldnt allow him to return to his fathers household.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tum din tuhi. Bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni ʒe neen shɛŋa mini bɛ ni fa neen shɛŋa m-pali bɛ nayiya.
en: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sabimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛtɔɣa maa ka n zaŋ lo a mini Izraɛlnim alikauli.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Write everything that I have told you. This is the agreement that I made with you and the Israelites.

dag: Ŋun di nasara, n ni chɛ ka m min o laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee kaman n gba ni daa di nasara ka m mini m Ba Naawuni laɣim ʒi o nam ʒiishee shɛm la.
en: As for those who emerge victorious, I will allow them to sit with me on my throne, just as I emerged victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.

dag: Molimiya molo ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni n-yɛli ba: Malimiya shili n-tuhi tɔbu; bolimiya yi tɔbutuhiriba. Chɛliya ka tɔbutuhiriba zaa yina n-vu m-mirina!.
en: Announce this among the nations: Prepare a holy war, wake up the warriors; let all the soldiers draw near, let them come up!.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Man bi mi bee m-baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Ka zo n-yi nti ʒe dunol ni, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: But Peter said this was not true. That makes no sense, he said. I dont know what you are talking about! Then he left and went to the entrance of the yard, and a rooster crowed.

dag: Ka tanyibiga yɛli ba, Yi yi shiri bɔri ni n leei yi naa ni yɛlimaŋli, yin kamiyana ti ʒini m mahim, ka yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina, n ni chɛ ka buɣim yi n ni na ti di Lɛbanɔn sida tihi.
en: And the thornbush replied to the trees, If youre acting faithfully in anointing me king over you, come and take shelter in my shade; but if not, let fire come out of the thornbush and burn up the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di pala doo ŋɔ daalahichi bee o laamba daalahichi zuɣu, amaa di niŋmi ni Naawuni tumtumsa yi palo o ni.
en: Jesus answered, It was not any sin of this man or his parents that caused him to be blind. He was born blind so that he could be used to show what great things God can do.

dag: Hal bɛ daa gbaai Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Ibram tizo bia la gba, ka zaŋ o nɛma pahi chaŋ.
en: Lot, Abram's nephew, was living in Sodom, so they took him and all his possessions.

dag: Jafɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Goma mini Magɔg ni Madai ni Javan ni Tubal ni Mɛshɛk ni Tiras.
en: Japheths sons were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

dag: Hal n ni filim mmaŋa n-gari ŋ-ŋɔ gba, ka lihi ʒiɛm mmaŋa, amaa dabipaɣiba shɛb yɛla a ni yɛli ŋɔ bɛn ni ti ma jilima.
en: I might do things that are even more embarrassing! Maybe you will not respect me, but the girls you are talking about are proud of me.

dag: Adam n-daa nyɛ Shɛt ba, ka Shɛt nyɛ Ɛnɔsh ba.
en: Adam was the father of Seth, and his descendants were Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah, who had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti ŋma bilichiisi n-nyo li buɣim viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka bɛ daa ŋma bilichiisi maa ka di be kaman kuɣa la, ka zaŋ kootaali mi n-leei tandi.
en: They said to one another, Come on! Let's make bricks and bake them hard. So they had bricks to build with and tar to hold them together.

dag: Ka Baasha ŋun daa nyɛ Ahija ŋun yi Isaka zuliya ni na bia la daa lo nia n-chaŋ ti liri Nadab n-ku o Gibɛtɔn din be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama Nadab mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa teei gilila Gibɛtɔn.
en: Baasha, Ahijahs son from the house of Issachar, plotted against him and attacked him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines. Nadab and all Israel were laying siege against Gibbethon.

dag: Bashan Zoli din galisi, Bashan Zoli din mali chunchuna pam.
en: What a mighty mountain is Bashan, a mountain of many peaks!.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kambɔna pali bindira balibu kam. Chɛ ka ti biŋkɔbbaligu bɛn be mɔɣu ni la nabi n-niŋ tuhilituhili ni tuhi piapia.
en: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, dama di kpɛm pam. Mbusim be bɛ sujee zuɣu, dama ninkuunsi be di ni. N ni woligi ba Yaakubu daŋ ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ luɣilikam ni.
en: Their anger is so strong that it is a curse. They are too cruel when they are angry. They will not get their own land in the land of Jacob. They will be spread throughout Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ lala, dama bɛ bi mi ma balle m-mi m Ba Naawuni.
en: They will do these things because they dont know the Father or me.

dag: Nam fukumsi yi nahindi tarimba ka bi niŋdi din tuhi, ka mɔŋ ba bɛ yɛlimaŋli soya, nyin di chɛ ka di gar a; dama tuma zuɣulan kam gba malila zuɣulana, ka ŋun nyɛ bɛ zaa mi zuɣulan gba beni.
en: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.

dag: O suh a nyɛvili, ka a ti o li; ka di nyɛ nyɛvil wɔɣinli din ka bahigu.
en: He asked for life, and you gave it, a long and lasting life.

dag: Di saha ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim zaa mini na shɛb bɛn ʒi Dauda ʒiishee la ni maligumaaniba ni anabinima ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nyu dam kuli.
en: Then say to them: I am the Lord , and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.

dag: Biɛri bɔhibu mini sanyoo nyɛla n dini, saha shɛli bɛ napɔna yi ti sarigi; dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha kanna yomyom.
en: Revenge is my domain, so is punishment-in-kind, at the exact moment their step slips up, because the day of their destruction is just around the corner; their final destiny is speeding on its way!.

dag: Ka so yi ti yi a yiŋ maa ni na m-be soli zuɣu chana, dilan kum taali ni ti ŋmaligi ʒila omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti nuu kani. Amaa so yi ti ku bɛn be a sani a yiŋ maa puuni, dilan kum taali ni ti ʒila ti zuɣu.
en: We will protect everyone who stays in this house. If anyone in your house is hurt, we will be responsible. But if they go out of your house and are killed, we will not be responsible. It will be their own fault.

dag: Sa zaŋm labihi m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zani Yawɛ tooni biɛɣuni, ka Yawɛ yi sa pii ninvuɣ so, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi. Yinim Lɛvi zuliya ŋɔ, yi va n-ʒi pam.
en: Tomorrow put fire and incense in some special pans. Then bring those pans before the Lord . He will choose the man who is holy. You Levites have gone too far—you are wrong.

dag: Ka daa lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu niŋm tuuba a biɛribiɛtali ŋɔ zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni; di pa shɛli o ni chɛ a tɛhi biɛri din nyɛ alahichi maa paŋ a.
en: Change your heart! Turn away from these evil thoughts and pray to the Lord. Maybe he will forgive you.

dag: A lee tɛhiya ni ŋuni ka a turi ka maani ansarisi maa? Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a niŋ karimbaani lihi ʒiɛm maa.
en: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted and sneered at me, the holy One of Israel.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim di tiŋgbani maa ni di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bi yi daɣiri ni bee saa ni bi mi n-niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili dabisili dali.
en: Human one, say to her, You are an unclean land without rain on the day of reckoning.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tinima bee malaika so ŋun yi alizanda ni na yi yihi lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ ti ni daa pun yihi shɛli waazu tin ya la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: We told you the true Good News message. So anyone who tells you a different message should be condemned—even if its one of us or even an angel from heaven!.

dag: o daa yɛlimi, O nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yɛli ni o paɣa m-bala. O daa tɛhimi ni o yi yɛl lala, di pa shɛli ka nimaani nim maa ti ku o Ribɛka zuɣu, dama o daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: When the men who lived there asked about his wife, he said, Shes my sister, because he was afraid to say, my wife, thinking, The men who live there will kill me for Rebekah because shes very beautiful.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib daa ʒe nimaani kul fiɣisir o ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: The chief priests and the legal experts were there, fiercely accusing Jesus.

dag: dama ninsal sujee mini Naawuni wuntia tuma bi dol taba.
en: Human anger does not achieve God's righteous purpose.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim tam ŋun nam ba yɛla, ka mɛla nanim yiya. Ka Judanim me fɔntinsi pam, ka me goondahi gil li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka buɣim lu bɛ fɔntinsi maa zuɣu n-di bɛ sɔɣisili shɛhi zaa.
en: Israel has built palaces for their kings, and now Judah builds fortresses. But they have forgotten their Maker! So I will send a fire to destroy their cities and fortresses.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa lo ni o ni kun ya la, n daa teemi dɔni m puli zuɣu Yawɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: But I fell on my knees in the LORDs presence forty days and forty nights, lying flat out, because the LORD planned on wiping you out.

dag: naɣila o talahi nira, kaman o ba bee o ma bee o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga bee o mabidoo.
en: except your mother, father, son, daughter, brother.

dag: Ka Pita mini nyaandol ŋun maa daa yina n-zaŋ kpa siliga maa polo.
en: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛl lala maa nyɛla bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima, dama Yɛhudianim maa daa pun yɛli ni so yi ti yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, bɛ ni kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish authorities, who had already agreed that anyone who said he believed that Jesus was the Messiah would be expelled from the synagogue.

dag: din ni gu a ka a ku bo paɣ yoli, ka yih a paɣ zinalan naŋgbam malisim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: It can keep you away from bad women, from the seductive words of other men's wives.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paya ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi Tɛlimɛla mini Tɛliharisha ni Kɛrub ni Addɔn ni Imɛr n-lab kuli na la, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi tooi wuhi bɛ yaannim ni nyɛ shɛba bee bɛ ni yi shɛli na din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya.
en: There were belonging to the clans of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda who returned from the towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not prove that they were descendants of Israelites.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛri ni bɛ jɛmdila mani, amaa ka bɛ ni yɛri shɛm ka gbinni, dama bɛ suhuri bela katiŋ ka chɛ ma. Ninsalinim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya soli ka bɛ doli jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord said, These people claim to worship me, but their words are meaningless, and their hearts are somewhere else. Their religion is nothing but human rules and traditions, which they have simply memorized.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ tima baŋdiba ni bɛ niŋm tim ʒe o ba niŋgbuŋ ka di ku pooi. Ka tima baŋdiba maa daa niŋ tim ʒe Izraɛl niŋgbuŋ.
en: Then Joseph gave orders to embalm his father's body.

dag: O ni daa ti yɛn kpe Ijipti saha shɛli ka o yɛl o paɣ Zarai, M mi ni a nyɛla paɣ viɛlli, ka a lihibu mali kɔre.
en: Just before he arrived in Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, I know you are a good-looking woman.

dag: Ti mali bimbin shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi sara maligu malibu tuma tanti jɛmbu duu la ni ka soli ni bɛ di binshɛli din pa di zuɣu.
en: The priests who serve in the Jewish place of worship have no right to eat any of the sacrifice on our altar.

dag: Amaa Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa bɛn be o sani ni daa wum Nɛtania bia Ishimail ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Johanan, Kareahs son, and all the army officers at his side heard of the terrible acts committed by Ishmael, Nethaniahs son.

dag: Amaa n ni tiligi yi shɛba, ka yi ni shɛba zo n-tiligi takɔbi kum ni zuliya shɛb sani, ka wurim kpe tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: God said, But I will let a few of your people escape. They will live in other countries for a short time. I will scatter them and force them to live in other countries.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa gindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yihiri waazu, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka shihir shɛŋa din wuhiri ni lahibal suŋ maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli niŋda.
en: Then the disciples left and preached everywhere. The Lord was with them, and the miracles they worked proved that their message was true.

dag: Ka di mahim chaŋ ti luri zoya zuɣu; ka di wula mi zooi lim sida ti kara la.
en: It covered the mountains, and its leaves shaded even the giant cedar trees.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ daa ti kari bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bahi kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka bɛ na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: until the Lord took Israel away from his sight. And he said this would happen. He sent his prophets to tell the people this would happen. So the Israelites were taken out of their country into Assyria. And they have been there to this day.

dag: Ka yi ti sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga m-pa kuɣa maa zuɣu.
en: Make sure to write all the words of this Instruction on the stones plainly and clearly.

dag: So yi bi lih o dɔɣiriba, di bahi bamdi omaŋmaŋ malibu, dindina o tum din chihir o daadiini soli zuɣu, ka leei ŋun bie n-gari ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda.
en: But if someone doesnt provide for their own family, and especially for a member of their household, they have denied the faith. They are worse than those who have no faith.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa yihi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya ni salima ni ŋun maŋmaŋ Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa zaŋ salima shɛli m-mali dunoya la pahi n-zaŋ ti Asiria naa maa.
en: he also stripped the gold from the temple doors and the gold with which he himself had covered the doorposts, and he sent it all to Sennacherib.

dag: nti kpuɣi Baal jɛmbu binnan shɛli din be di ni na nti nyo li buɣim.
en: They brought out the memorial stones that were in the temple of Baal and burned that temple.

dag: O ʒila Salɛm, ka o biɛhigu shee nyɛ Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu.
en: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jɛrimia ti niŋ bɔɣili ni jɛriyali maa ni, ka o daa be di puuni niŋ daba ayi.
en: So Jeremiah was put in a cistern, which was like a dungeon, where he remained a long time.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi daa nyɛla bɛba ata, Shɛlomɔt mini Haziɛl ni Haran. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Leedan daŋ niriba kpamba.
en: who were the heads of the clans descended from Ladan.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni bi zɔri Naawuni maa zuɣu, bɛ yɛla ku so, ka bɛ nyɛviya gba ku wɔɣa.
en: But it will not go well for the wicked; they wont live long at all because they arent reverent before God.

dag: Nyini daadam, wuhimi Izraɛlnim maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ buɣisi di biɛhigu maa, ka chɛ ka vi gbahi ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: And the Lord continued, Mortal man, tell the people of Israel about the Temple, and let them study its plan. Make them ashamed of their sinful actions.

dag: ni Azaria. Azaria daa nyɛla Hilikia bia, ka Hilikia nyɛ Mɛshulam bia, ka Mɛshulam nyɛ Zadok bia, ka Zadok nyɛ Mɛrayɔt bia, ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Ahitub bia. Ahitub daa nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣulana.
en: Azariah. Azariah was Hilkiahs son. Hilkiah was Meshullams son. Meshullam was Zadoks son. Zadok was Meraioths son. Meraioth was Ahitubs son. Ahitub was the important official responsible for Gods Temple.

dag: ni Hanan ŋun daa nyɛ Maaka bia la ni Jɔshafat ŋun daa nyɛ Mitan nir la.
en: Hanan, Maacahs son; Joshaphat the Mithnite.

dag: N tɔɣisirila n nini ni nya shɛli m Ba sani; ka yi mi niŋdi yi nini ni nya shɛli yi ba sani.
en: I am telling you what my Father has shown me. But you do what your father has told you.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee ko o wain tihi puu ka na bi di di wala? Dilan labimi kul o yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so di di nyaɣisim maa.
en: Is there any man here who has planted a vineyard but has not yet gathered any of the grapes? That man should go back home. If that man dies in the battle, someone else will enjoy the fruit from his field.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ bubil polli maa ti o zo ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la ni o ti ti paɣ maa ka deeg o neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira la na, amaa ka o daa bi nya paɣ maa.
en: Later, Judah sent his friend Hirah to Enaim to give the prostitute the goat he promised. Judah also told Hirah to get the special seal and the walking stick from her, but Hirah could not find her.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la kalinsi nyaaŋa, Juda Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu pahi dunia yili.
en: Amaziah lived years after Jehoash died. Amaziahs father was King Joash of Judah.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, Bɛn wumdi Naawuni yɛligu ka gbib li n-lee mal alibarika.
en: But Jesus answered, Rather, how happy are those who hear the word of God and obey it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya paɣ maa ka yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai.
en: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith. At that moment she was healed.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti guli bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ gbarima ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman Dauda la. Ka Dauda zuliya maa ni ti gari tooni m-be kaman Yawɛ malaika la bee Naawuni maŋmaŋ la m-mali ba chana.
en: At that time the Lord will protect those who live in Jerusalem, and even the weakest among them will become as strong as David was. The descendants of David will lead them like the angel of the Lord , like God himself.

dag: ka m mi yi bɔhi ya, yi ku garigi ma.
en: And if I ask you, you will not answer.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N wum Mɔabnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla, ka wum Ammɔnnim turi yɛla. Bɛ maani n niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara ni bɛ ni fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: I have heard the taunting of Moab and the defamation of the Ammonites; they taunted my people and enlarged their borders.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni paɣiba daa boli bia maa yuli Obɛd ka yɛli, Bɛ dɔɣi bidibiga ti Naomi! Ka Obɛd daa ti dɔɣi Jɛsi, ka Jɛsi mi dɔɣi Naa Dauda.
en: The neighbors gave the boy his name. These women said, Naomi has a son now! They named him Obed. Obed was the father of Jesse, and Jesse was the father of David.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ti lihi tiŋ na nya li.
en: I will continue to cry until you look down and see us, Lord ! I will continue to cry until you see us from heaven.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee wuhi Naawuni o soli ni nyɛ shɛm, bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli Naawuni, A tum gala?.
en: No one can tell him what to do. No one can say, God, you have done wrong.

dag: Doo yi chirigi bɛ ni bi zaŋ paɣisaribil so ti doo n-zaŋ o dɔni ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa kaman o ni daa zali ma shɛm maa, ka vuhim daa kana ti kpe bɛ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima n-yiɣisi zani bɛ naba zuɣu. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: I prophesied just as he commanded me. When the breath entered them, they came to life and stood on their feet, an extraordinarily large company.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di shiri niŋ kaman o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Yes, throughout the whole country the Sovereign Lord Almighty will bring destruction, as he said he would.

dag: Yi goli kam piligu ni, bomiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: On the first day of each month, bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came to Jesus and asked.

dag: Ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa ti nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ matarika kuri salin shɛli din nyɛ alali.
en: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni kpɛbu, o jilima ni daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa puuni maa zuɣu.
en: and the priests could not go in.

dag: ni Anatɔt ni Alimɔn.
en: Anathoth, and Almon. They gave them these four towns and some of the land near the towns for their animals.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi ŋariŋ maa chaŋ kaman maal anahi bee ata nti nya Yisa ka o tam kom zuɣu chanina ti miriti bɛ ŋariŋ maa, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam.
en: The disciples had rowed about three or four miles when they saw Jesus walking on the water, coming near the boat, and they were terrified.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa nimdi min o gbaŋ ni o nyɔri dina, zaŋm li yi yi sansani maa kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim, dama din nyɛla alahichi sara maligu.
en: Burn the rest of the meat of the bull, its hide, and the intestines with their contents with a fire outside the camp. It is a purification offering.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n yɛn filimla Jɛrusalɛmnim bindirigu. Bɛ ni ti zahindila bɛ bindira tiri ba, ka bɛ diri li ni dabiɛm, ka zahindi kom tiri ba, ka bɛ nyuri li ni suhuzɔhibo.
en: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, bɛ ni nyɛ zuliya yini ka mali zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini maa zuɣu ka bɛ tumdi lala maa, ka bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm piligu n-na bɔŋɔ; ka binshɛli kani ka bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ niŋ li ka di ku nani.
en: and he said, Now then, these are all one people and they speak one language; this is just the beginning of what they are going to do. Soon they will be able to do anything they want!.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilis a tibili wum n kuhigu. Di nya n kumsi nintam ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu. N leela saan garito a sani, ka nyɛ sochanda kaman n yaannim la.
en: Lord , hear my prayer! Listen to the words I cry to you. Look at my tears. I am only a traveler passing through this life with you. Like all my ancestors, I will live here only a short time.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ kuruwa shɛli zahindi biŋkuma mini yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛli zahindi binshɛŋa din nyɛ zaɣ kom saɣila taba. Kuruwa pia n-nyɛ tahili. Tahili n-nyɛ sokam ni yɛn zaŋdi shɛli zahindi binyara.
en: The ephah for dry measure is to be equal to the bath for liquid measure. The standard is the homer . The resulting measures are as follows: homer = ephahs = baths.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa la zuɣu. Dama bɛ suhuri daa kul bela bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: because they rejected my case laws, didnt follow my regulations, and degraded my sabbaths. They had their hearts set on their idols.

dag: Di pɔ dunia ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla Naawuni napɔntamdigu; ka di pɔ Jɛrusalɛm gba, dama di nyɛla Natitamlan tiŋa;.
en: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di simdi ni dunɔdali ŋɔ kul yo n-ʒiɛya, di bi simdi ni di yooi, ka so mi di doli li kpe. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa doli li kpe, dinzuɣu di simdi ni di kul yomi ʒiɛya.
en: The LORD said to me, This gate remains closed. It shouldnt be opened. No one should come in through it because the LORD, Israels God, has entered through it. It will remain closed.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali shɛm la.
en: Three days later, Jeroboam and the others came back.

dag: Gol tuuli biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni nyɛla yi ni yɛn zaŋdi Yaɣigari chuɣu pina tiri Yawɛ saha shɛli.
en: The Passover, celebrated to honor the Lord , begins at sunset on the fourteenth day of the first month.

dag: Laɣimmi niriba zaa n-gil amaŋa, ka ʒini a nam ʒiishee alizanda ni su ba.
en: so bring together all the peoples around you, and rule over them from above.

dag: Ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: Someone who is in the field must not go back to the house for a cloak.

dag: Ka doo maa kɔŋ maa daa dii naai, ka o niŋgbuŋ lan lab di bebu ni zaa.
en: Instantly, the skin disease left him, and he was clean.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N tin ya nyina din viɛla, ka chɛ ka kum lu yi tiŋ kam ni, di zaa yoli ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I have sent a famine in all your cities, and not provided enough bread in all your places, yet you didnt return to me, says the LORD.

dag: Amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda naɣila n ni kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Hal bɛ daa bi yɛli ma a yɛm din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla pirigili gba; a biɛhigu maa gari n ni daa wum a yɛla shɛm maa.
en: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are greater than I was told.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa ŋmalig o sani o ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa n-lab alizanda ni.
en: Then God ascended, leaving him alone in the place where he spoke to him.

dag: A ni wuhi Yaakubu ʒiɛyimtali, ka wuhi Ibrahimma ʒiɛyimtali din bi taɣira kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim shɛm kurimbuni ha la.
en: You will provide faithfulness to Jacob, faithful love to Abraham, as you swore to our ancestors a long time ago.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ yalim gari biŋkuma sara kam zaa ni, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini Naawuni yalim alikauli la ti pooi yi sara maligu maa ni, dinzuɣu yi sara maligu kam ni di simdi ka yi chɛ ka yalim be di ni.
en: You must season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not omit the salt of your Gods covenant from your grain offering. You must offer salt with all your offerings.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di zɔr o; dama n zaŋ o min o niriba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niŋ a nuu ni, niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la shɛm la.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Don't be afraid of Og. I will help you defeat him and his army, just as you did King Sihon who ruled in Heshbon. Og's territory will be yours.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake maa daa duh o yee kuhi yɛli Judanim yɛtɔɣa puuni, Wummiya Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then the field commander stood up and shouted in Hebrew at the top of his voice: Listen to the message of the great king, Assyrias king.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti yɛli yi suhuri ni, Timaŋmaŋ yiko mini ti nuhi kpiɔŋ ka ti zaŋ nya azichi ŋɔ.
en: Dont ever say to yourself, I got all this wealth by my own power and ability.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla zoomba, yi naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yɛliya ni yi nyara, dinzuɣu yi taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.

dag: Miri ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka miri ka a zaŋ ʒiŋmabo kpɛh a kɔbili ni.
en: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.

dag: Amaa ka daa naɣ piila Juda zuliya mini Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ o ni yuri shɛl la.
en: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah and Mount Zion, which he dearly loves.

dag: Ka Abiata maa daa yɛli Dauda ni Sool ku Yawɛ maligumaaniba la.
en: and told him, Saul has murdered the Lord 's priests at Nob.

dag: O daa lan mali me Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zoli zuɣu la mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zolɔŋni la, ka me goondahi gil li, ka niŋ dunɔdaya mini binyara din kpariti dunɔdaya maa niŋ di ni.
en: He strengthened Upper Beth-Horon and Lower Beth-Horon by adding walls and gates that could be locked.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihinahi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pihinahi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Once again Abraham spoke, What if forty are there? The LORD said, For the sake of forty, I will do nothing.

dag: Bipolli, mali suhupiɛlli a bipolitali saha. Chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a bipolitali saha. Dol a suhu ni bɔri shɛm, ka niŋm a ni bɔri shɛm. Amaa lee baŋmi ni Naawuni ni ti kar a saria di zaa maa zuɣu.
en: So young people, enjoy yourselves while you are young. Be happy. Do whatever your heart leads you to do. Do whatever you want, but remember that God will judge you for everything you do.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nya lala ka o suhu yiɣisi, ka o tabig o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi bahi.
en: The LORD saw this and rejected out of aggravation his sons and his daughters.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa tim ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ba Yaakubu min o daŋ zaa na; bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were of them.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi niŋ Yawɛ ni ti ti binshɛŋa maa lala, dama ŋuna n-daa gul ti ka zaŋ ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa kana ti liri ti maa niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: But David said: My friends, don't be so greedy with what the Lord has given us! The Lord protected us and gave us victory over the people who attacked.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka dam ŋɔ yɛn yi a ninni? Ka yɛl o, Chɛli wain nyubu.
en: He said to her, You have had too much to drink. It is time to put away the wine.

dag: Amaa yinim ti miriya! Dinzuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: But be on your guard! That's why I am telling you these things now.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: And David was angry because the Lord had shown his anger in killing Uzzah. So that place has been called Perez Uzzah ever since then.

dag: Zunzuya mini daɣiri m-pali n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ kul mɔri ti puhigira.
en: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tinim Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ ka yɔɣu ŋɔ ni na ni ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri ti kpi kpe?.
en: Why have you brought the LORDs assembly into this desert to kill us and our animals here?.

dag: Tiŋgban ni bindira niŋya pam; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni.
en: The earth has yielded its harvest. God blesses us—our God blesses us!.

dag: A ni bi mi vuhim ni kpɛri bia kɔba ni o ma puuni shɛm, lala ka a ku tooi baŋ Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa ŋɔ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, O yi nyɛ alahichilana bee o pa alahichilana n ku tooi baŋ. Bin yini kɔŋko ka n naɣ mi: N daa nyɛla zoma, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n neeya.
en: The man answered, I dont know whether hes a sinner. Heres what I do know: I was blind and now I see.

dag: Dama o kul pala nina lihiri ninsalinim biɛhigu, ka nyari bɛ napɔna yaabu zaa.
en: He watches every step we take.

dag: n-kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya, ka zaŋ ya na ti zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya, ka yi su li kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: in order to remove larger and stronger nations from before you and bring you into their land, giving it to you as an inheritance. Thats where things stand right now.

dag: N ni yɛri ya shɛm ŋɔ, sokam zaa ka n yɛra, Di gbihiriya.
en: I tell everyone just what I have told you. Be alert!.

dag: A suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti kpe n tibili ni zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo tu a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige niŋ a nol ni ŋ-ŋmalig a bah a ni doli so shɛli kana zuɣu.
en: I have received the report of that rage and that pride of yours, and now I will put a hook through your nose and a bit in your mouth, and take you back by the same road you came.

dag: Teemi ni n nyɛvili nyɛla vuhim kɔŋko, n nini ku lan nya din viɛla.
en: Remember that my life is wind; my eyes wont see pleasure again.

dag: Ka Imɛr bia Zadok daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Shɛkania bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa guli Wulimpuhili polo Dunɔdal la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Zadok son of Immer built the next section, which was in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, keeper of the East Gate, built the next section.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N ni chaŋ ka yi ti bo ma kɔŋ, ka yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi. N ni chani luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: Jesus also told them, I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ yɔhindiba pam be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣi ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na. Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛl lala nyɛla ninvuɣ yɔhinda ni Masiachihira.
en: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.

dag: Gibiɔn daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiwɛinaanu.
en: the descendants of Gibeon:.

dag: A ni vihi m binshɛɣukam zaa ni maa, a yiŋ bimbɔ ka a nya di ni? Zaŋm li zali n dɔɣiriba min a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ninni, ka bɛ baŋ ti ni ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: After searching through everything I have, did you find anything of yours? If so, put it here, where your relatives and mine can see it. Then we can decide what to do.

dag: Ka goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali mi nyɛla Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu Yawɛ sani. Ka yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin.
en: The Lord s Festival of Unleavened Bread is on the th day of the same month. You will eat unleavened bread for seven days.

dag: Naawuni, hal n yi ti kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi, nyin di chɛ ma bahi! Be n sani hal ka n ti zaŋ a yiko min a kpiɔŋ yɛla moli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim zaa sani.
en: Now that I am old and my hair is gray, do not abandon me, O God! Be with me while I proclaim your power and might to all generations to come.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi sandiriba maa ni ti yiɣisi libigi ya, ka bɛn ni chɛ ka yi ni sɔhigi yiɣisi? Di saha ka yi leei bɛ ni yɛn ʒe ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Wont they suddenly rise up to bite you? Those who frighten you will awaken; you will become plunder for them.

dag: Yawɛ tim a a ni tum shɛm maa laara. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni so baɣiri ni a ni kana ni a ti sɔɣ ŋɔ ni ti a laara din galisi.
en: May the Lord reward you for what you have done. May you have a full reward from the Lord God of Israel, to whom you have come for protection.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, yi yi ni labi n sanna, yi yi chɛ din chihira n sani maa tumbu, ka chɛnya ʒiɛhi gili.
en: If you return, Israel, return to me, declares the LORD. If you get rid of your disgusting idols from my presence and wander no more.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma bahi. N Naawuni, di be ma katiŋa!.
en: Dont leave me all alone, LORD! Please, my God, dont be far from me!.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn daa guli naa la sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba tahi Babilɔn naa sani Ribila.
en: Nebuzaradan led them all to Riblah.

dag: Hal bɛ sapashinnim mini bɛ tuumba ni pun paai Ijipti tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Zɔan mini Hanɛs la zaa yoli.
en: Your leaders have gone to Zoan, and your representatives have gone to Hanes.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni gahi nuu boli zuliya kam, ka wuhi niriba shihirili; bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi maa ŋmab bɛ bɔɣuri ni na ti tin ya; ka zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi tuɣi na ti tin ya.
en: The LORD God says: Look, I will raise my hand to the nations, and to the peoples I will lift up my signal. They will bring your sons in their arms, and will carry your daughters on their shoulders.

dag: n-ʒiya diri bindirigu, ka paɣ so zaŋ luɣulu viɛlli din pali tulaale din mali shaara pam ka o sanna ti kpaa li niŋ o zuɣu ni.
en: While Jesus was eating, a woman came to him with an alabaster jar filled with an expensive perfume, which she poured on his head.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila di yubu polo, ka a wumdi di damli, amaa ka bi mi di ni yiri shɛli polo na bee di ni kpari shɛli polo; lala mi ka Naawuni Shia ni dɔɣ sokam be.
en: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord told Moses and Aaron.

dag: Balak ni daa wum ni Balaam kanna, o daa yimi chaŋ ti tuh o soli Ar fɔntiŋ shɛli din ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Mɔab tintariga polo la.
en: Balak heard that Balaam was coming. So Balak went out to meet him at the Moabite town near the Arnon River. This was at the northern border of his country.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn niŋ lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn laɣim wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku, ka wuntizɔriba maa pahi ninvuɣ biɛri maa zuɣu nya tibidarigibo. Di niŋ lala! Nyin ŋun nyɛ dunianim zaa sariakarita ŋɔ ku niŋ din tuhi.
en: Surely you won't kill the innocent with the guilty. That's impossible! You can't do that. If you did, the innocent would be punished along with the guilty. That is impossible. The judge of all the earth has to act justly.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka o chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: King Solomon gave the command to Benaiah, and Benaiah went out and killed Adonijah.

dag: ka yi lula ŋun ye binyɛr suma la sizuura ka yɛl o, N dana, ʒinim ʒiishe viɛlli ŋɔ ni; ka ŋmaligi yɛli nandan la ŋuna, Ʒe nimaani bee kamina nti ʒin tiŋa n naba ŋɔ shee.
en: Then suppose that you were to take special notice of the one wearing fine clothes, saying, Heres an excellent place. Sit here. But to the poor person you say, Stand over there; or, Here, sit at my feet.

dag: ka bɛ gula maa yi ti nya ka tɔbu kani tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o piɛbi kikaa yɛli niriba maa di yɛla.
en: When he sees the enemy approaching, he sounds the alarm to warn everyone.

dag: Miri ka a laɣi suhuyiɣisilinim zɔri, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a mini haliyoyanim laɣim be.
en: Dont be friends with people who become angry easily. Dont stay around quick-tempered people.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛri din nyɛ: saŋkpana.
en: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.

dag: Yil yidan yi ti yiɣisi kpari dunoli maa ka yi kana ti ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara yɛra, Ti Duuma, yoom ti ka ti gari, o ni ti garigi yɛli ya, N ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na.
en: The master of the house will get up and close the door; then when you stand outside and begin to knock on the door and say, Open the door for us, sir! he will answer you, I don't know where you come from.

dag: Amaa ti yi be neesim ni kaman o ni be neesim ni shɛm, ti ni mali dolintabitali ni taba, ka o Bia Yisa ʒim kul ni kpihindi ti daalahichi zaa bahira.
en: But if we live in the light—just as he is in the light—then we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from every sin.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi lihi paɣ maa ka bɔhi Saimɔn, A nya paɣ ŋɔ? N ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na, a bi ti ma kom ni m paɣi n naba; amaa paɣ ŋɔ zaŋ o nintam paɣi n naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhi li.
en: Jesus turned to the woman and said to Simon, Do you see this woman? When I entered your home, you didnt give me water for my feet, but she wet my feet with tears and wiped them with her hair.

dag: Kɛnaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Otiniɛl mini Sɛraya, ka Otiniɛl mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hatat mini Mɛɔnɔtai.
en: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. Othniels sons were Hathath and Meonothai.

dag: Ka tɔroko maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Bɛtishɛmɛshi maa do so ŋun yuli daa booni Jɔshua la puu ni. Kuɣ titali daa do nimaani, ka bɛ daa wɔri tɔroko maa dari n-kɔri niɣi maa pa di zuɣu n-nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: The wagon came to a field belonging to a man named Joshua, who lived in Beth Shemesh, and it stopped there near a large rock. The people chopped up the wooden wagon and killed the cows and burned them as a burnt sacrifice to the Lord .

dag: Ka Ashikɛlɔnnim nya li, ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka Gazanim gba nya li, ka di zab ba pam. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛkurɔnnim gba, ka bɛ tahima zaa ni bɔrigi. Gaza ni kɔŋ naa, ka Ashikɛlɔn kpalim zan dabari.
en: The people in Ashkelon will see this and they will be afraid. The people of Gaza will shake with fear, and the people of Ekron will lose all hope when they see this happen. There will be no king left in Gaza. No one will live in Ashkelon anymore.

dag: Hal bɛ daa yi zaŋ anchitinima bee situra din shihi ŋun Pool nti pa barinim zuɣu bɛ nyarila alaafee, ka alizin biɛri gba daa zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: Some people carried away handkerchiefs and clothes that Paul had used and put them on those who were sick. The sick people were healed, and evil spirits left them.

dag: Di pa shɛli yi ni saɣi ni m bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya, amaa ka lee yɛli ni n nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana ŋun zaŋ yɔhiŋgu gbahi ya.
en: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.

dag: Hal kawana ni lan kani, ka wain tihi mini fiig tihi ni yɔɣa ni olivi tihi na bi wal la zaa yoli, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: Is the seed yet in the granary— or the vine, the fig tree, or the pomegranate— or has the olive tree not borne fruit? From this day forward, I will bless you.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ nab pam, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri filim.
en: God blesses them, and they become many. God wont even let their cattle diminish.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o dan Ibrahimma laakumnim pia, ka deei pin suma balibu kam o sani n-yiɣisi chaŋ Nahɔr ya din be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: The servant, who was in charge of Abraham's property, took ten of his master's camels and went to the city where Nahor had lived in northern Mesopotamia.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yuri ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu. Maranaata! Ti Duuma, kamina!.
en: If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be separated from God—lost forever! Come, O Lord!.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka mi yi ni nahindi shɛm yɛla mini yi daania niŋbu ni yi ni je tuumbiɛrinim shɛm yɛla. N lan mi yi ni kpahim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-boli Yisa tuumba, amaa ka pa o tuumba la ni yi ni nya ka bɛ nyɛla ʒirinim la.
en: I know your works, your labor, and your endurance. I also know that you dont put up with those who are evil. You have tested those who say they are apostles but are not, and you have found them to be liars.

dag: Nyama, n ni kpihim nyin Baasha min a daŋ niriba zaa birili; ka niŋ a yiŋa kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋ shɛm la.
en: that I will destroy you and your family, just as I did the family of Jeroboam.

dag: Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Yisa.
en: Look! You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus.

dag: Tɛhimiya o ni daa di wahala alahichinim bɛn daa je o nuu ni shɛm yɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi ku gbarigi ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa fiɛbi Midiannim Orɛb tampiŋ gbini shɛm la. N ni ti kpuɣi n fiɛbiga maa teeku kom puuni n-fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la.
en: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.

dag: Amaa so yi bɔri ni o ŋme dimbɔŋɔ naŋgbankpeeni, ti ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu, ka Naawuni cheechinim gba lan ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu.
en: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa chɛ ka Yaakubu kuli Mɛsopoteemia Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir bia, ka nyɛ Yaakubu mini Iso ma Ribɛka tizɔdoo la sani.
en: Isaac sent Jacob away to Mesopotamia, to Laban, who was the son of Bethuel the Aramean and the brother of Rebecca, the mother of Jacob and Esau.

dag: Amaa dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam, ka so daa yi ʒe luɣ kasi shee maa ka lihi, o ni tooi nya di nyoya ni. Amaa so daa yi zani samban ni, o ku tooi nya li. Di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The poles are still there today. They were too long for the Most Holy Place, so their ends could be seen by anyone standing in the Holy Place, although no one outside could see them.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa kul niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Bɛ ni daa tiri bɛ suɣa ʒiini bɛ tuutanim gbini shɛm, lala ka sokam min o malibu daa doli chani kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So the Israelites did everything the Lord told Moses. Each group camped under its own flag. And everyone stayed with their own family and family group.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan kana ti zani nimaani m-boon o kaman o ni di pun boon o shɛm la, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlima, a dabili wumda.
en: The Lord came and stood there, and called as he had before, Samuel! Samuel! Samuel answered, Speak; your servant is listening.

dag: Lihimi puu maa ni n-nyari bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam polo chɛra, ka kul doli ba. M pun yɛli n kachɛriba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba maa ni bɛ miri ka bɛ niŋ a shɛli. Ka kɔnyuri yi ti mal a, nyin cham ti tooi bɛ ni ŋɔŋ kom pali kɔduɣ shɛŋa zal la ni nyu.
en: watch them to see where they are reaping and stay with them. I have ordered my men not to molest you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and drink from the water jars that they have filled.

dag: Ka daɣila yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni ŋun ku kari saria n-ti o ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb bɛn suhir o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam la nasara? O ku sɔŋ ba yomyom?.
en: Now, will God not judge in favor of his own people who cry to him day and night for help? Will he be slow to help them?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka zaŋ fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinim kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: The Lord had told Moses that he would show the Israelites which towns and pastures to give to the clans of Levi, and he did.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ka mali nia biɛri la mirina. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋa ka chɛ a zaligu.
en: The people who love to plot wicked schemes are nearby, but they are so far from your Instruction!.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa maa puuni, timiya ba tins ayɔbu din yɛn nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku ninsala ka zo n-kuli di ni tiligi, ka ti ba tinsi pihinahinaayi pahi.
en: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites other towns.

dag: Ka di lan be kaman wulimpuhili polo pɔhim n-ʒiɛri Speen teeku ni ŋarima ka di saɣindi la.
en: like ships tossing in a furious storm.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din daa sabi kurimbuni ha daa sabila ti wuhibu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daanzansi niŋbu mini Naawuni Kundi suhukpaŋsibo chɛ ka ti mali tahima.
en: Everything that was written in the past was written to teach us. Those things were written so that we could have hope. That hope comes from the patience and encouragement that the Scriptures give us.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o ni pun tum shɛm min o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa wuhi ba la yɛla.
en: They forgot what he had done, the miracles they had seen him perform.

dag: N ni yɛli Naawuni, Di wuhi ni m mali taali. Chɛ ka m baŋ a ni tuhiri ma daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Pool ka yɛli ni bɛ lom o zoligɔnima ayi; di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔhi ni o baŋ Pool ni nyɛ so min o ni tum shɛli.
en: When the commander arrived, he arrested Paul and ordered him to be bound with two chains. Only then did he begin to ask who Paul was and what he had done.

dag: amaa o yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o tumtumdiba ni yino pini, di ni nyɛ o dini hal ni faako yuuni, di nyaaŋa ka o labisi li ti naa. O bidibisi kɔŋko n-ni tooi su o ni zaŋ binshɛli ti ba pini.
en: But if the ruling prince gives any of his land to anyone who is in his service, it will become the prince's property again when the Year of Restoration comes. It belongs to him, and only he and his sons can own it permanently.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma la di vi ka bahi yoli. Chɛ ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yinim bɛn yiɣisiri asiba n-gbaai dam nyubu la, yi kul niŋdila lala hal ni yuŋ n-nyu li buɣi.
en: Doom to those who wake up early in the morning to run after beer, to those who stay up late, lit up by wine.

dag: N yura maa chaŋla o puu ni, o chaŋla tulaale tihi puu vuɣisi ni ni o ti chɛ ka o piɛri ŋub mɔri ka o bo paɣiviɛligakushihikom na.
en: My darling has gone down to his garden of spices, where he will feed his sheep and gather lilies.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan su saha mini saha taɣibu; o vuuri nanima ka zaani nanima; ŋuna n-tiri yɛnnim yɛm, ka tiri baŋdiba baŋsim.
en: He controls the times and the seasons; he makes and unmakes kings; it is he who gives wisdom and understanding.

dag: Yawɛ ku saɣi zaŋ o niriba bah o yuli din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, dama ŋuna n-daa yu ka pii ya leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: For the sake of his reputation, the LORD wont abandon his people, because the LORD has decided to make you his very own people.

dag: O daa yi chɛ o zabiri o zaŋdila nayili sania zahim li ka di tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi.
en: When he shaved his head—he had to shave his head at the end of each year because his hair was so heavy that he had to shave it—the weight of the hair from his head was two hundred shekels by the royal weight.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din galisi la di ba.
en: Show them how angry you are. Let them feel what your anger can do.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla halibiɛrinima, amaa man yur a zaligunim pam.
en: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.

dag: Kamiyana pumpɔŋɔ ka ti ku o n-zaŋ o ti bahi bɔɣa ŋɔ zaɣ yin ni, ka yɛli ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o ŋubi, ka ti nya o ni zahim zahin shɛŋa maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: Come on now, let's kill him and throw his body into one of the dry wells. We can say that a wild animal killed him. Then we will see what becomes of his dreams.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi halli zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka yi yihiri yi paɣiba, amaa piligu ni ha, pa lala n-daa nyɛ li.
en: Jesus answered, Moses allowed you to divorce your wives because you refused to accept Gods teaching. But divorce was not allowed in the beginning.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daalahichi daa ti galisi pam Yawɛ sani, dama bɛ daa bi tiri Yawɛ sara maligu pina maa jilima.
en: Eli's sons did not show any respect for the sacrifices that the people offered. This was a terrible sin, and it made the Lord very angry.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin daa kpi.
en: So the Lord sent a horrible disease on Israel, and , Israelites died.

dag: Ka Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Rama nir la daa nyɛ ŋun lihiri wain tihi puri, ka Zabidi ŋun daa nyɛ Shifam nir la daa lihiri wain ni be du shɛŋa ni.
en: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of the storage and care of the wine that came from the vineyards.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a nam zuliya pam, ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi, ka nanim ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: I will make you very fertile. I will produce nations from you, and kings will come from you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun be di ni nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi; o bi tumdi din bie. O kariti saria asiba kam, ka ʒi n-naɣi li nolɔɣu kukoli kam. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi zɔri vi.
en: But the Lord is still in the city; he does what is right and never what is wrong. Every morning without fail, he brings justice to his people. And yet the unrighteous people there keep on doing wrong and are not ashamed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Ninvuɣ kɔbisita shɛb bɛn mali bɛ zilima nyuri kom ŋɔ ka n ni zaŋ fan ya bahi, ka zaŋ Midiannim maa niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zaa lab kuli.
en: Then the LORD said to Gideon, With the three hundred men who lapped I will rescue you and hand over the Midianites to you. Let everyone else go home.

dag: Yuun pisi ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min o nam yil la.
en: It took years for the Lord 's temple and Solomon's palace to be built.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ n ni daa tim ba ka bɛ yi Kadɛshibarinia chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛl o yɛla shɛm la niŋ pali, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Omaŋmaŋ n-daa deei ti niŋgbun biisim mini ti dɔriti zaa ʒi.
en: This happened so that what Isaiah the prophet said would be fulfilled: He is the one who took our illnesses and carried away our diseases.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Bihi laamba di wain tiwala din miha, ka bihi nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: In those days, people will no longer say: Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a bitter taste in the mouths of their children.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuma ata puuni, Mɔabnim ni ti kɔŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli saha biɛla puuni kaman padiriba saha ni bi galisi shɛm la. Bɛ ni kul galisi maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, ka bɛ mi ku mali yaa.
en: But now the LORD has said: In three years, like the years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab, with all its great multitude, will dwindle. The small remnant will be few and feeble.

dag: Dama o zaɣisila Naawuni m-pah o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O bela ti sani m-maani Naawuni ansarisi, ka yɛr o zilima pahira.
en: He adds rebellion to his sin; mocks us openly and adds to his words against God.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli. Dama n nya ka girigiri niŋbu mini duŋ taabu be tiŋ puuni.
en: Confuse the speech of my enemies, O Lord! I see violence and riots in the city.

dag: N ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka yaŋɔ paɣisara ti kana ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom.
en: Here I am at the well where the young women of the city will be coming to get water.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi yurilim nyɛ yurilim maŋli. Di niŋ kamaata ni yi je din bie, ka gbibiya din viɛli kirikiri.
