en: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.

dag: O ku ŋme naŋgbankpeeni bee n-yo vuri, ka so ku wum o kukoli solɔri zuɣu.
en: He will not argue or shout; no one will hear his voice in the streets.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din viɛla.
en: Only fools think there is no God. People like that are evil and do terrible things. They never do what is right.

dag: Dama ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ti mini ti yaannima Ijipti luɣ shɛli din nyɛ dabitim ni la na, ka daa tum alahiziba tuun kara ti ninni, ka tiligi ti ti ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa ni mini ti ni daa kpe zuliya shɛb ni garina nuu ni.
en: The Lord is our God. We were slaves in Egypt as our ancestors had been, but we saw the Lord work miracles to set our people free and to bring us out of Egypt. Even though other nations were all around us, the Lord protected us wherever we went.

dag: Ishimail daa lan ku Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Gɛdalia sani mini Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Then they killed the Jews who were with Gedaliah, and they also killed the Babylonian soldiers who were there.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Kapɛrinium ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto deeriba kana ti bɔhi Pita, A karimba ŋɔ bi tɔhiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto la.
en: When they came to Capernaum, the people who collected the half-shekel temple tax came to Peter and said, Doesnt your teacher pay the temple tax.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ pini maa daŋ o tooni, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpalim gbe suɣa maa shee dindali maa yuŋ.
en: Jacob's men took the gifts on ahead of him, but he spent the night in camp.

dag: n-yiini Naawuni dabili Musa mini Piɛbil la yilli n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa, a tuma nyɛla tuun kara ni alahiziba tuma! Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa ŋɔ, a soya nyɛla din tuhi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli!.
en: They sing the song of Moses, Gods servant, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and awe-inspiring are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, king of the nations.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli Pita, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! A nyɛla tigbirigu n soli zuɣu, dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: But he turned to Peter and said, Get behind me, Satan. You are a stone that could make me stumble, for you are not thinking Gods thoughts but human thoughts.

dag: A yi mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni a yɛli, nyin garigim ma. Tɔɣisima, dama m bɔri ni n wuhi ni a ka taali.
en: But if you have something to say, let me hear it; I would gladly admit you are in the right.

dag: N kul zaŋ n nina kpala Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-ni yihi n naba zana ni.
en: I always look to the Lord for help. Only he can free me from my troubles.

dag: Dama ti Duuma nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka o tiba kul wumdi be suhigu. Amaa ti Duuma kul lihirila bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nimbiɛɣu.
en: The Lord watches over those who do what is right, and he listens to their prayers. But he is against those who do evil. Psalm :-.

dag: Bɛ daa lab bɛ shɛb kuɣa ku ba, ka daa zaŋ sua m-pirigi bɛ shɛb buyiyi; ka daa zahim bɛ shɛba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba. Bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛrila piɛri mini buhi gbana chani ginda. Bɛ daa nyɛla nandaamba ni bɛn nyari muɣisigu mini nahiŋgu.
en: They were killed with stones. They were cut in half. They were killed with swords. The only clothes some of them had were sheepskins or goatskins. They were poor, persecuted, and treated badly by others.

dag: Dama yi je saɣisigu; ka zaŋ n yɛligu labisi yi kpali nyaaŋa.
en: You refused correction and rejected my commands.

dag: Ka dabiɛm ni gbaai sokam zaa, ka bɛ yɛli Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla, ka zaŋ o ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla niŋ bɛ suhuri ni.
en: Then all people will honor God, will announce the act of God, will understand it was Gods work.

dag: Ka sapashin kpamba maa yi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa maa naai, sapashinnim bɛn leemi bɛn su tɔbbihi maa fukumsi.
en: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.

dag: Puhimiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ duumanim zaa Duuma ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the Lord of all lords— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti suh o, o ni deei yi suhigu, ka yi yi ti ŋme kuŋa m-bɔri sɔŋsim, o ni yɛli, M be kpe ni n sɔŋ ya. Yi yi ni ti yi ni nahindi shɛb la vuhim, ka chɛ niriba ansarisi malibu ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu;.
en: Then you will call to the Lord , and he will answer you. You will cry out to him, and he will say, Here I am. Stop causing trouble and putting burdens on people. Stop saying things to hurt people or accusing them of things they didnt do.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni niŋ yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini yi daazichi naani la zuɣu, bɛ ni ti gbahi yi gba chaŋ ka gbaai Chɛmɔshi min o maligumaaniba, ni o kpambaliba la daba chaŋ.
en: Moab, you trusted in your strength and your wealth, but now even you will be conquered; your god Chemosh will go into exile, along with his princes and priests.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai niriba wuhibu biɛɣukam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o;.
en: Jesus was teaching daily in the temple. The chief priests, the legal experts, and the foremost leaders among the people were seeking to kill him.

dag: di saha bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ daa naan vali ti zaɣ nɛma.
en: then they would have swallowed us up whole with their rage burning against us!.

dag: Bɛ suhuri yɛla niriba puri zuɣu, ka bɛ far li, ka ye niriba yinsi zuɣu, ka bɛ far li. Bɛ nahim yililana n-tabil o yiŋnima, ka nahim niriba n-tabili bɛ fali.
en: They want fields, so they take them. They want houses, so they take them. They cheat a man and take his house and his land.

dag: Hal di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni m birigiya, m biriginsim maa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: Even if I have sinned, it is my problem, not yours!.

dag: Ka salo daa baŋ ka kar o naba; ka o daa ti puhi ba ni bɛ paabuna, ka tɔɣisi ba Naawuni nam yɛla, ka tib barinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: But the people learned where Jesus went and followed him. He welcomed them and talked with them about Gods kingdom. He healed the people who were sick.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ o ni lo o suhu ni ni o me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ mini du shɛŋa din yɛn me n-gil li ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni daazichi zaashee ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa maani sara tiri Naawuni zaashee zaa buɣisibu gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: He provided all of the plans he had in mind: for the courtyards of the LORDs temple, and for all its surrounding rooms where the treasures of Gods temple and the dedicated gifts would be stored.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi bi maha, yi mi bi tula. N di bɔri ka yi mahimi bee n-tula!.
en: I know what you have done; I know that you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were either one or the other!.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn fabili? Ka saha yuusim wula ka luɣilikam mɔri yɛn kuui? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri zuɣu chɛ ka biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi zaa kpira; ka din pahi nyɛla, niriba yɛra, O nini bi nyari ti ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, God can't see the sins we commit.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dabisili dali kam, sokam zaa yihim kaman Naawuni ni lɔrig o shɛm tariga na ti zali, ka di chɛ ka n ti kana ka laɣ tɔhibu yɛla ku lan beni yaha.
en: On the first day of every week, each of you should take some of your money and put it in a special place. Save up as much as you can from what you are blessed with. Then you will not have to gather it all after I come.

dag: Dama ti yaannim daa bi ʒe yim, ka tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Bɛ daa zaɣis o, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ o biɛhigu shee, ka lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa biri ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ.
en: Our ancestors were not faithful and did what the Lord says is evil. They stopped following him. They no longer paid any attention to the Lord s house and turned their backs on him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o ti kpalim be bɛ sani nimaani m-baptaiziri niriba.
en: After this, Jesus and his disciples went to the province of Judea, where he spent some time with them and baptized.

dag: O ni ti wurim kuɣa binnana din be Hɛliɔpolis Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka nyo Ijiptinim buɣa jɛmbu duri buɣim.
en: He will destroy the sacred stone monuments at Heliopolis in Egypt and will burn down the temples of the Egyptian gods.

dag: Doo mini paɣ yi dɔni, bɛ niriba ayi maa bɛn sum kom, ka nyɛ bɛn ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: After sexual intercourse both the man and the woman must take a bath, and they remain unclean until evening.

dag: n-zaŋ suɣilo gbib ba mɔɣu ni kaman yuun pihinahi;.
en: and for about years he took care of them in the desert.

dag: Ka o yɛl o ba, M bihi m-bala, Naawuni ni ti ma bi shɛb ya ŋɔ m-bala. Ka o daa yɛl o, Niŋm ania, zaŋm ba ti ma na ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Joseph told his father, Theyre my sons, whom God gave me here. Israel said, Bring them to me and I will bless them.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa pa ni Naawuni sani; dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked at them and said, There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.

dag: Ka sapashinnim maa daa niŋ kaman maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ bɛ niriba bɛn bi yɛn be tuma ni mini bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali n-ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada sanna.
en: The officers obeyed Jehoiada's instructions and brought their men to him—those going off duty on the Sabbath and those going on duty.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun niŋdi sokam zaa zaɣ viɛlli, ka zɔri o ni nam binshɛɣukam zaa nambɔɣu.
en: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.

dag: Ka a yi ti kanna, nyin zaŋmi m binyɛr tibisi shɛli n ni daa chɛ n-sɔŋ Kaapus sani Troas la m-mali ma na; ka zaŋ litaafinim la gba pahi na, di bahi bamdi gbandi la.
en: When I was in Troas, I left my coat there with Carpus. So when you come, bring it to me. Also, bring my books. The books written on parchment are the ones I need.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai zoli maa gbini, ka o deei li bɛ sani n-zaŋ kpɛhi duu; ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi labi.
en: When they reached the hill where Elisha lived, Gehazi took the two bags and carried them into the house. Then he sent Naaman's servants back.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, N daa pun yɛl a ni daa tim a tuun shɛb n sanna la.
en: Balaam said to Balak, You sent men to ask me to come. Dont you remember what I told them? I said.

dag: Di saha ka m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa daa yɛl ti, Yi mi ni m paɣ daa dɔɣ ba la bidibis ayi ti ma.
en: Then my father said to us, You know that my wife Rachel gave me two sons.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat mini Gɛshɛm daa tim na ti yɛli ma ni n chirigim ba tiŋkpan shɛli din be Ono Bɔpiɛligu ni la. Amaa bɛ daa lomi ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: Come, lets meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they wanted to harm me.

dag: M bia, di tam n ni wuh a shɛli, amaa gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli maa a suhu ni.
en: My son, dont forget my instruction. Let your heart guard my commands.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfo ni Onam.
en: These are Shobals sons: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

dag: Yi dimnim tɔbbi yino ni ti kari yi ninvuɣ tuhili ka yi ŋmaligi guui, ka bɛ tɔbbih anu ni tooi kari ya ka yi zaa ŋmaligi guui, ka yi tɔbbi yino gba ti ku kpalim zani naɣila binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili din be zoli zuɣu la n-ni ti kpalim beni.
en: One enemy soldier will make threats, and a thousand of your men will run away. And when five of them make threats, all of you will run away. The only thing that will be left of your army will be a flagpole on a hill.

dag: N daa ŋme ba luhi n naba ni, ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: I struck them down; they couldnt get up again; they fell under my feet.

dag: Ijiptinim ni guui ka niŋdi vuri kaman wahu la, dama bɛ dimnim kabirimi kanna. Bɛ gbibila kpandi kanna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmari tihi la ni bɛ ti liri ba.
en: Egypt runs away, hissing like a snake, as the enemy's army approaches. They attack her with axes, like people cutting down trees.

dag: di yi pa lala, so yi wum li, o ni dih a vi, ka a yu saɣiŋgu ku mali tariga.
en: Otherwise, the one who hears it will vilify you; the slander against you will never stop.

dag: Ka yi ni yi alahichi tumbu dabitim ni la zuɣu chɛ ka yi yipa leela wuntia daba.
en: You were set free from sin and became the slaves of righteousness.

dag: Di saha ka Reehab daa zaŋ mii tir o yiŋ maa takɔro ni n-chɛ ka tuumba maa dol li yi tiŋ maa ni, dama o yiŋ maa daa me n-tabilila tiŋ maa gooni.
en: Rahab lived in a house built into the city wall, so she let the men down from the window by a rope.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Yi yi ti nya binshɛli din chihiri Naawuni sani la, ka di ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu Luɣ Kasi Shee, kaman Anabi Daniɛl ni daa pun yɛli di yɛla la, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm!.
en: Daniel the prophet spoke about the terrible thing that causes destruction. You will see this terrible thing standing in the holy place.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti ni yɛli ni a nyɛla Samaria nira ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi a zuɣu la, di pala yɛlimaŋli.
en: The people told Jesus, We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you.

dag: Ka maligumaana ni mali sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun chirim maa, o yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, o ni mali sara ti o Yawɛ sani, ka o nya taali chɛ m-paŋ.
en: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ ni gbib buɣim kana. O chɛchɛbunsi yuri zɔbu yɛn ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o zaŋ li kana ti darig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu tibili.
en: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.

dag: Bom tulaale viɛla, mɛɛr kom din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mini tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla ka bɛ booni li sinnamɔn la kilɔgiram ata ni kaɣa tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla kilɔgiram ata.
en: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture.

dag: Cheechi maa ni zaŋ dimaŋ ti Masia shɛm la, lala ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣiba gba zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti bɛ yidaannim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: And so wives must submit themselves completely to their husbands just as the church submits itself to Christ.

dag: A ni ti ma suhupiɛl shɛli n suhu ni gari bɛ ni yi ŋahi kawana pam, ka tɔɣi wain pam, ka mali suhupiɛl shɛl la.
en: But you have made me happier than they will ever be with all their wine and grain.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la daa puhi gari, ka ti mi kpe ŋariŋ Filipai n-zaŋ daba anu chaŋ ti paai ba Troas; ka ti daa niŋ daba ayopɔin nimaani.
en: After the Festival of Thin Bread, we sailed from Philippi. Five days later we met them in Troas and stayed there for a week.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindirigu a sani di, ka zaŋ liɣiri da kom a sani nyu. N kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka n chaŋla n naba zuɣu na ti gari.
en: We will pay you in silver for any food we eat or any water we drink. We only want to march through your country.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu bahi kom ni ni bɛ zahim kom maa ziliŋ, ka daa nya ka di nyɛla mita pihinahi. Ka bɛ daa tirisi tooni biɛla n-lan buɣisi n-nya ka di ziliŋ nyɛla mita pihita.
en: They dropped a weighted line to take soundings and found the water to be about one hundred twenty feet deep. After proceeding a little farther, we took soundings again and found the water to be about ninety feet deep.

dag: ka Shimɛi nyɛ Jahat bia, ka Jahat nyɛ Gɛrishom bia, ka Gɛrishom mi nyɛ Lɛvi bia.
en: son of Jahath son of Gershom son of Levi.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbihi daa woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnima n-zani kahigi bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi wuhi.
en: Those people who were true Israelites separated themselves from foreigners. The Israelites stood and confessed their sins and the sins of their ancestors.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba wurindila tiŋa, amaa yɛnnim bɛn maarila niriba suhuri.
en: People with no regard for others can throw whole cities into turmoil. Those who are wise keep things calm.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, ka so bi yɛri yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ wuhila bɛ zilima ʒiri ŋmabu. Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri ka di gbarigi ba hal ka bɛ ku lan tooi niŋ tuuba.
en: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu kpiɔŋ daa galisi pam hal ka ŋarin titali maa ti be kaman di yɛn chɛrisimi la.
en: But the Lord sent a strong wind on the sea, and the storm was so violent that the ship was in danger of breaking up.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ni daa nya ka o tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni. Ka o bia Jɛhoyakin daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: The rest of Jehoiakims deeds, including his detestable practices and all that was charged against him, are written in the official records of Israels and Judahs kings. His son Jehoiachin succeeded him as king.

dag: Naa Ahaz kum yuuni ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa kana:.
en: This message was given to me the year King Ahaz died :.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka o daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: That is why Abraham, through faith, was accepted as righteous by God.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa kuhirimi ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu, ka bɛn bɔɣiri mini bɛ gbaya daa kpi ni gbariti pam daa nya alaafee.
en: Many of these people had evil spirits inside them, but Philip made the evil spirits leave them. The spirits made a lot of noise as they came out. There were also many weak and crippled people there. Philip made these people well too.

dag: Nyini n-su Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi, zaŋm a ba min a biɛyanim maa ʒili luɣ viɛlli shee; chɛ ka bɛ ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Ka a yi mi bɛ ni bɛn mi biŋkɔbiri gbibbu, nyin chɛ ka bɛ guli n niɣi.
en: I will let them live anywhere they choose in the land of Egypt, but I suggest that they settle in Goshen, the best part of our land. I would also like for your finest shepherds to watch after my own sheep and goats.

dag: Amaa alahichinim ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din bi doya baalim, ka kul puɣiri lura n-ʒiri daɣiri mini yaɣiri kpɛhiri teeku ni la.
en: But evil people are like the angry ocean. They cannot be quiet and peaceful. They are angry, and like the ocean, they stir up mud.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o dol a na, dindina a yi m pɔri ŋɔ taali ni; ka lee miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: If the girl refuses to come with you, you will be free from this promise. But you must not take my son back to that place.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi tiligi o kandina dabisili maa dali? Ka o yi ti yi palo, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? Dama o ni ŋmanila saviɣu ni buɣim, ka ŋmani chibo din paɣiri yiri zaa.
en: But who will be able to endure the day when he comes? Who will be able to survive when he appears? He will be like strong soap, like a fire that refines metal.

dag: Jɛrigu yɛtɔɣa tahirila zabili na, ka jɛrigu noli ni yɛtɔɣa lan bɔri buri tir o.
en: The lips of fools make accusations; their mouths elicit beatings.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o niŋ bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni, ka yo li n-kpar o niŋ di ni ni o di lan yɔhim zuliya kam hal ti paai yuun tuhili maa tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti lan yoog o bahi biɛla.
en: Then the angel threw the dragon into the pit. He locked and sealed it, so , years would go by before the dragon could fool the nations again. But after that, it would have to be set free for a little while.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deei pipia maa a nuu ni nyu, di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di nyɛla talahi ni yi nyu li.
en: They will refuse to take the cup from your hand. They will refuse to drink it, but you will tell them, This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: You will surely drink from this cup!.

dag: Paɣipuulan ti ku zaŋ bahi, ka paɣiŋoo mi ti ku be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni tin ya nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: and no woman will miscarry or be infertile in your land. Ill let you live a full, long life.

dag: Amaa kulibɔŋ bee kɔbil shɛli din mali kom, din nyɛla din ka daɣiri. Amaa binshɛɣukam din shihi binkpiŋ ni leei din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam yirila o sanna; ka binshɛɣukam bela o zuɣu; ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla o ni su shɛli. Ŋuna n-simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: All things are from him and through him and for him. May the glory be to him forever. Amen.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Niriba maa ku tooi du Sinai Zoli ŋɔ na, dama nyin maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ti ni m beemi chɛriga gil li, ka mal li ka di be kasi.
en: Moses replied, The people cannot come up the mountain. You warned us to stay away because it is holy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ʒim m-bala. Nanim maa ŋ-ŋmaligi zabi n-ku tab maa! Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, chamiya ti di nɛma.
en: and shouted, Look at that blood! The armies of those kings must have fought and killed each other. Come on, let's go take what's left in their camp.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o lee suhimi ni yɛda ka bi biɛhinda, dama ŋun biɛhindi ŋmanila teeku kɔgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri ka di laŋsira.
en: Whoever asks shouldnt hesitate. They should ask in faith, without doubting. Whoever doubts is like the surf of the sea, tossed and turned by the wind.

dag: Tahima ŋɔ puuni ka ti daa tiligi; amaa pa nir nini ni nya shɛli n-nyɛ tahima, dama ŋuni n-lee ni niŋ tahima o nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu?.
en: We were saved in hope. If we see what we hope for, that isnt hope. Who hopes for what they already see?.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee nim malila shili ni bɛ deei Babilɔn naa. Bɛnkam zaa daa nyɛ nanim dunia ŋɔ ni yiɣisiya ni bɛ puh a. Bɛn zaa daa nyɛ zuliya shɛb nanim ni yiɣisi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi puh a.
en: The underworld beneath becomes restless to greet your arrival. It awakens the ghosts, all the leaders of earth; it makes the kings of the nations rise from their thrones.

dag: Ka so daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigila Absalom polo.
en: A messenger came and told David, Everyone in Israel is on Absalom's side.

dag: Ka Shallum Jabɛshi bia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-daa ŋme o luhi Ibiliam n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.

dag: Niriba pam daa nya o ka di gari ba pam. O biɛhigu daa taɣimi, ka o bi ŋmani ninsala.
en: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.

dag: Jaazia bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔham mini Zakur ni Ibiri.
en: Meraris family by his son Jaaziah: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

dag: Ka zim shɛli din kpalim ni leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ maa zuɣu.
en: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Nuzaa polo maa daa tim ti boli Jɛrɔbɔam na. Ka o mini Izraɛlnim maa daa kana ti yɛli Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: The people sent and called for Jeroboam, who along with all Israel came and said to Rehoboam.

dag: Nir karimbaani n-tahir o filiŋ na, amaa ŋun siɣisir omaŋ ni nya jilima.
en: Pride lays people low, but those of humble spirit gain honor.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu pam, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, N Duuma, mani? N Duuma, mani.
en: The disciples were very sad, and each one said to Jesus, Lord, you can't mean me.

dag: Bundaannim mini faranim zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun nam bɛ zaa.
en: The rich and the poor are all created by the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi binnana ka mali wun shɛŋa din ka buchi nyuri bara la zaa di vi; dama wuna maa gbaanila o tooni.
en: All those who worship images, those who are proud of idols, are put to shame. All gods bow down to the Lord!.

dag: Yuun pinaayi shɛŋa ni zaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ma leei bɛ gomna Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi la saha zaŋ hal ti paag o yuun pihitanaayi la saha, mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi daa bi di bindir shɛŋa din nyɛ gomna tarili.
en: In addition, from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah , neither I nor my family ate from the governors food allowance.

dag: N niriba bahi yoli bɛ ʒilinsi zuɣu. Yi ni zaɣisi baŋsim zuɣu n gba zaɣisi ya, yi lan pala m maligumaaniba. Ka yi ni tam n zaligu yɛla zuɣu, n gba ni tam yi bihi yɛla.
en: My people are destroyed because they have no knowledge. You priests have refused to learn, so I will refuse to let you be priests for me. You have forgotten the law of your God, so I will forget your children.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times. Then the whole thing was taken back up into heaven.

dag: Chɛ ka chɛrubi yino be di yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ yini polo, ka yino la mi be di tariga yaɣ din la polo. Chɛrubinim mini yɔrigu maa ni ti nyɛla bin yini di yaɣa maa zaa.
en: one for each end of the lid. Make them so that they form one piece with the lid.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛri ni bari ma zana la zaa yoli, n ku tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: The wicked tried to trap me, but I have not forgotten your teachings.

dag: Di nuzaa polo gba daa mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi la daa nyɛ daanya, amaa bin shɛŋa din daa yili daantalisi maa mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa.
en: The enclosure was the same on the north side.

dag: Dama yi ni ti bemi kaman oki ti shɛli din vari suui, ka be kaman mahili ni ka pu shɛl ni.
en: You will be like an oak with withering leaves, like a garden without water.

dag: Izraɛlnima, di maliya suhupiɛlli. Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhu paligi kaman zuliya shɛb la. Dama yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ka tumdila yolimyolim. Yi yuya ni yi tum yolimyolim maa ka deei yi sanyoo kabɔɣili kam ni.
en: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.

dag: N daa zaŋ yɛ viɛla dih a paɣisarilim, ka zaŋ bansi pir a nuhi ni, ka zaŋ dolibi yɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: I adorned you with fine jewelry, and put bracelets on your wrists and a necklace around your neck.

dag: Di ni simdi ni shɛli be daadam biɛhigu ni nyɛla ʒiɛyimtali, ka nir yi nyɛ faralana di so ʒiŋmara.
en: It is a disgrace to be greedy; poor people are better off than liars.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mali bɛ buɣili Dagɔn; ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Ti buɣili n-zaŋ ti dim Samsin niŋ ti nuu ni maa.
en: The rulers of the Philistines gathered together to make a great sacrifice to their god Dagon and to hold a celebration. They cheered, Our god has handed us Samson our enemy.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zo dabiɛm n-kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha o nahimbu biɛrim nyabu maa zuɣu ka yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye! Nyin tin titali ŋɔ, nyin Babilɔn ŋun nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ, awa yini puuni ka a zani lu n-dahim zaa.
en: They will stand a long way off because they are afraid of the pain she suffers, and they will say, Oh, the horror! Babylon, you great city, you powerful city! In a single hour your judgment has come.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ni nyɛ daba ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni zaa daa zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: God allowed them to receive compassion from all their captors.

dag: O ni daa di nam yuun shɛli maa goli so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni ka o daa kparigi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la dunoya n-chɛ ka bɛ malimali di zaa.
en: Hezekiah repaired the doors of the Lord s Temple and made them strong. He opened the Temple again. He did this in the first month of the first year after he became king.

dag: Ka naa lan bɔhi ba, Ka ŋuni n-lee be zɔŋ ni? Di saha maa ka Haman mi daa kpɛna ti ʒe zɔŋ ni. O daa kamina ni o ti yɛli naa ka o bah o noli ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Mɔdɛkai ti yili gar da shɛli o ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ sa n-zal la.
en: Haman had just entered the outer area of the kings palace. He had come to ask the king to hang Mordecai on the hanging post Haman had commanded to be built. The king said, Who just came into the courtyard.

dag: Ka a zaŋ o ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o yi tintariga ti kɔrig o o ninni.
en: You will give it to Eleazar the priest, and he will take it outside the camp and slaughter it in front of him.

dag: Ka Hamat din mini Hadirak di tintarisi la gba nyɛla o ni su shɛli zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn hal bɛ ni mali baŋsim la zaa yoli.
en: Hamath also borders on it. Tyre and Sidon, indeed, each is exceedingly wise.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pahi bɛ zuɣu; ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: Then he got into the boat with them, and the wind died down. The disciples were completely amazed.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda mini bɛn zaa be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Amaa mbusim be dunia mini teeku zuɣu! Dama Sintani siɣi yi sanna ni sujee zaɣ titali o ni mi ni o saha bi lan wɔɣa zuɣu.
en: Therefore, rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them. But oh! The horror for the earth and sea! The devil has come down to you with great rage, for he knows that he only has a short time.

dag: Dama dabisili maa miriya. Yawɛ dabisili maa miriya; di ni ti nyɛla sagbana dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla mbusim dabisili zuliya kam sani.
en: because you will soon be punished! That will be a time of darkness and doom for all nations.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o.
en: People walked by and shouted insults at Jesus. They shook their heads.

dag: O ni daa ti yina, o daa kɔŋla yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka bɛ baŋ ni o nya ʒii Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama o daa kul malila o nuhi buɣisira, ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: When he came out, he was unable to speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he gestured to them and couldnt speak.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa yi kul chanimi nti be luɣ shɛli din miri napaɣiba yili maa dundɔŋ dabisili kam. O daa chanimi gindi ni o baŋ Ɛsta nimaani benibu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm ni din yɛn niŋ o.
en: Every day Mordecai would walk back and forth in front of the courtyard of the harem, in order to find out how she was getting along and what was going to happen to her.

dag: dindina a ni lan nya suhupiɛlli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, ka kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi ŋun Naawuni.
en: Then you will take pleasure in the Almighty; lift up your face to God.

dag: Dama nir tibiginsim bi yirila wulimpuhili polo na bee wulinluhili polo na; ka di mi bi yirila mɔɣu ni na.
en: There is no power on earth that can make a person important.

dag: Kpahimi bɛn tumd alahichi la zuɣu ni palɔni din ni chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe bɛn kpalim la.
en: Rebuke publicly all those who commit sins, so that the rest may be afraid.

dag: N tɔɣisi jɛrilim m barinyubo ni, amaa yinima m-muɣisi ma ka n niŋ lala. Di di simdi ni yinim paɣi ma, dama hal n yi kul pa shɛli, n lee pala ŋun pɔri tuum shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I have been talking like a fool, but you made me do it. You people are the ones who should say good things about me. I am worth nothing, but those super apostles are not worth any more than I am!.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli daa maan du pam chaŋ haliya, ka salo pam daa laɣimna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛtɔɣa, ka nya bɛ dɔriti tib kpaŋ.
en: News about Jesus kept spreading. Large crowds came to listen to him teach and to be healed of their diseases.

dag: A ni lo nia ni a niŋ bin suŋ shɛŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura galisiya pam. Ka a lan nyɛ ŋun lo nia ni a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo na ti sɔɣ a sani din viɛli pam sokam zaa ninni.
en: How great is the goodness that youve reserved for those who honor you, that you commit to those who take refuge in you— in the sight of everyone!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Bɛ ni ti me gooni gili ya niŋ, ka me bimbina taɣi li, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi taɣi bɛmaŋa.
en: First, he will attack your towns along the coast and kill the people who live there. Then he will build dirt ramps up to the top of your city walls and set up rows of shields around you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi nyɛla din tuhi ni jilima ka yi ti Gidiɔn min o malibu maa, yin maliya suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ Abimilɛk sani, ka o gba mali suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: So if you have been completely honest to Gideon and his family today, then may you be happy with Abimelech as your king. And may he be happy with you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, You may speak for yourself. So Paul gestured with his hand and began his defense.

dag: Ka shɛb gba daa ʒi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋkpaŋ kɔɣilikɔɣili kana, ka bɛ zaa daa ti nya alaafee.
en: And crowds of people came in from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing those who were sick or who had evil spirits in them; and they were all healed.

dag: Dindali maa a ni ti yaag a noli tɔɣisi ŋun zo n-tiligi maa yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan shini yaha. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka a ni leei shihirili bɛ sani, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: That same day you will be able to talk to the messenger. You will not be silent anymore. This will be a sign to the people, and they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Niriba maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka o chaŋ ti kpe yili shɛli, ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: When he left the crowd and went into the house, his disciples asked him to explain this saying.

dag: Maligumaaniba: Jɛdaya daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: This is the list of the priestly clans that returned from exile: Jedaiah - Immer - , Pashhur - , Harim - .

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi yo alizanda nam dunoli ni niriba di kpe di ni. Yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi bi saɣiri ni bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni kpe. .
en: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You lock the door to the Kingdom of heaven in people's faces, but you yourselves don't go in, nor do you allow in those who are trying to enter!.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku anab shɛb zaa, tum dunia piligu ni la ha taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba.
en: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma. Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac said, Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice? My son, Abraham answered, God will provide the lamb. The two of them walked on, and.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli niriba yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum, dindina n ni vuɣi di zuliya maa zaa n-ku ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Bɛ bi tɔɣisiri suhudoo yɛtɔɣa; amaa bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi niŋ kamaata zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni polo.
en: They do not speak in a friendly way; instead they invent all kinds of lies about peace-loving people.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa yiɣisi zaŋ bɛ tuuta doli tab gbilligbilli pa bɛ zuɣu. Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: Next, those under the banner of the division led by the tribe of Reuben would start out, company by company, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni n ni ti zaŋ n Shia Kasi niŋ daadam kam ni. Ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi nachimba ti nya ʒii; ka yi ninkura mi ti zahim zahima.
en: In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young will see visions. Your elders will dream dreams. .

dag: O niŋgbuŋ kul kpɛla tab ni, di kpɛmmi kirikiri, ka so ku tooi dam li.
en: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron.

dag: Dama nyini ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni a ni chɛ ka n zuliya yɛligi. Dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a ŋɔ.
en: You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a dynasty. That is why your servant has found the courage to pray this prayer to you.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa. Ka bɛ kul tɔɣisirila din tuhi yɛla.
en: Those who do what is right give good advice. Their decisions are always fair.

dag: ka ŋun boli ya maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a ni a yiɣisim ka ti ŋun gar a maa ʒiishee, di saha di ni mal a vi ni a chaŋ ti ʒini tariŋ ʒiishee.
en: and your host, who invited both of you, would have to come and say to you, Let him have this place. Then you would be embarrassed and have to sit in the lowest place.

dag: Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa yi bɛn na kpalim, ka tiligi yi niriba pam nyɛviya tin ya.
en: But God sent me on ahead of you to keep your families alive and to save you in this wonderful way.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya ni zim maa ku naai di duɣu ni, ka kpam la gba ku naai di ŋman ni hal ti paai dahin shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛn chɛ ka saa mi.
en: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: The bowl will not run out of flour or the jar run out of oil before the day that I, the Lord , send rain.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba zuɣu, di bi lan kpa ni sara maligu din ni kpihim alahichi mali yaha.
en: And after everything is forgiven, there is no more need for a sacrifice to pay for sins.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni o ni ku ba, ka Musa ŋun nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahindili daa zan o tooni n-taɣ o ni o maag o suhu; ka o ku ku ba.
en: So God determined that he would destroy them— except for the fact that Moses, his chosen one, stood in the way, right in front of him, and turned Gods destructive anger away.

dag: Nira yi je yɛlimaŋli, o ni tooi su niriba? A ni galim ŋun nyɛ Wuntialana ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlana?.
en: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.

dag: Ka o yɛl o ba, M bihi m-bala, Naawuni ni ti ma bi shɛb ya ŋɔ m-bala. Ka o daa yɛl o, Niŋm ania, zaŋm ba ti ma na ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Joseph said to his father, These are my sons. These are the boys God gave me. Israel said, Bring your sons to me. I will bless them.

dag: Hal n ni kul wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni la zaa yoli, bɛ ni be katinsi maa ha ka teeri n yɛla. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni tiligi, ka ni ti laɣim tab labina.
en: Though I sowed them among the peoples, they will remember me in the distant places where they are living with their children until they return.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ti gari ka bol omaŋmaŋ yuli, Yawɛ, Yawɛ. N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ka niŋdi nirilim. N suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka yurilim din bi naara mini ʒiɛyimtali galisi n sani.
en: The Lord then passed in front of him and called out, I, the Lord , am a God who is full of compassion and pity, who is not easily angered and who shows great love and faithfulness.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka yi yɔri lampoo gba zuɣu, dama nam fukumsinim nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn tuma nyɛ ni bɛ niŋ lala.
en: And this is why you pay taxes too. Those rulers are working for God, and they give all their time to the work of ruling.

dag: Kamina ka ti dɔni bo taba hal ka biɛɣu ti neei. Chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli taba bɔbu ni.
en: Come, lets drink deep of love until morning; lets savor our lovemaking.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka o ku duh omaŋ yaɣ o mabihi maa sani, ka mi ku birigi fukumsi zaligu maa n-kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo din ni chɛ ka o min o zuliya ti di nam yuui Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: by not being overbearing toward his fellow Israelites, and by not deviating even a bit from the commandment. If the king does all that, he will ensure lasting rule in Israel for himself and for his successors.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋa, ka kɔŋ yɛligu.
en: When he said this, I stared at the ground, speechless.

dag: Ka a ti she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti a mabia Aduna din ni nyɛ o jilima min o nachiinsi binyɛra.
en: Make special clothes for your brother Aaron. These clothes will give him honor and respect.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na bi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu, niriba daa maani sara la maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: The Temple to honor the Lord had not yet been finished, so people were still making animal sacrifices on altars at the high places.

dag: N Naawuni ni n Naa, n ni duh a, ka paɣ a yuli sahakam.
en: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.

dag: ni lala chɛ ka bɛ dol o zalikpana, ka dol o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a yihi ba di ni, dama di nyɛla vi ni bɛ mali wuhibu shɛŋa bɛ ni ka soli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi so m-birigiri yiya pam puuni niriba liɣiri nyabu zuɣu.
en: They must be silenced because they upset entire households. They teach what they shouldnt to make money dishonestly.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa teei o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la, ka yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla puɣisiriba, yi kamina ni yi ti nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Joseph remembered the dreams that he had dreamed about his brothers. Joseph said to his brothers, You have not come to buy food! You are spies. You came to learn where we are weak.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the Lord because he is good. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka nudirigu polo tintariga mi kpuɣi Kiriatijiarim tintariga n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛfurɔn m-mali hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔŋ ni.
en: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.

dag: Dunianima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o jilima min o kpiɔŋ.
en: Praise the Lord , all people on earth, praise his glory and might.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa n-yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara biŋkɔb so nyɔri buɣim la.
en: The priest will then perform the purification offering and make reconciliation for the person needing purification from their uncleanness. After that, the entirely burned offering will be slaughtered.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who gladly hear the message and accept it at once.

dag: Ka o mini do so yi dɔni, ka o daɣiri maa tabil o, doo maa ni be daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin, ka bindo shɛlikam zuɣu doo maa ni dɔni ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: If a man has sexual intercourse with her and her menstruation gets on him, he will be unclean for seven days. Any bed he lies on will be unclean.

dag: A ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim neesim din ni kahig a soli wuhi ba, ka duh a niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: Its a light for revelation to the Gentiles and a glory for your people Israel.

dag: N daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa zaŋmiya yi ni yuri bimbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa labi, ka miriya ka yi zaŋ Ijipti buɣa la n-saɣim yimaŋa. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I told them to throw away the disgusting idols they loved and not to make themselves unclean with the false gods of Egypt, because I am the Lord their God.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampima bɔɣi yɔɣu sunsuuni, ka o daa ti ba kom pam din be kaman teeku kɔbulli ni kom la, ka bɛ nyu.
en: He split the rocks in the desert and gave them an ocean of fresh water.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ bɛ ni daa bahi dab shɛba, ka bɛ nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba la leei daba yaha.
en: But afterward they broke their promise, took back the men and women they had freed, and enslaved them again.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ka dindina tim ti bindirigu maa sahakam.
en: The people said, Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop.

dag: Bɛ teebuya zuɣu zaa nyɛla tiri, ka di luɣ shɛli ka nyam.
en: Every table is covered with vomit. There is not a clean place anywhere.

dag: Zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ bɛ dɔɣi yi tiligira ŋun nyɛ Masia ni yi Duuma la Naa Dauda ya Bɛtilihɛm.
en: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa nam ya yi manim puya ni; n ni sɔŋ ya. N dabili Yaakubu zuliya, Jɛshurun ŋun nyɛ n ni pun pii so ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: The LORD your maker, who formed you in the womb and will help you, says: Dont fear, my servant Jacob, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala ka yɛli, O dɔro maa pala kum dɔro, amaa di nyɛla din ni chɛ ka Naawuni nya jilima, ka Naawuni Bia gba nya jilima di zuɣu.
en: When he heard this, Jesus said, This illness isnt fatal. Its for the glory of God so that Gods Son can be glorified through it.

dag: O ni daa di nam ti paai yuma anahi ni gol so ŋun pahir ayi daba ayi dali ka o daa piligi duu maa mɛbu.
en: He began building in the second month of the fourth year of his rule.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima mali bans ayi niŋ di yaɣ ayi zuɣu salima din kɔɣili li gili la lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba ni bɛ zaŋdi dapuhi la turi di ni n-kpuɣiri bimbini maa.
en: He made two gold carrying rings for it and attached them below the border on the two sides, to hold the poles with which it was to be carried.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi; ka yi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni ŋɔ mi chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi.
en: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord 's worshipers will be encouraged.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la daa lab deei tin shɛŋa Naa Bɛnhadad Hazaɛl bia ni daa tuh o ba Jɛhɔahaz ka fa la. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka Jɛhɔash daa tuhi nyaŋ Bɛnhadad ka fa Izraɛlnim tinsi o sani.
en: Then Jehoahazs son Joash recaptured from Hazaels son Ben-hadad those cities that Hazael had won in battle from Joashs father Jehoahaz. Joash attacked Ben-hadad three times and took back these Israelite cities.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai yiŋa, ka o yidan ma bɔh o, M bia, ka di nyɛ wula zaŋ chaŋ a polo? Ka Rut daa yɛl o Bɔaz ni yɛl o shɛlikam zaa.
en: Ruth went to the home of her mother-in-law, Naomi. Naomi went to the door and asked, Whos there? Ruth went in telling Naomi everything that Boaz did for her.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ma mi, Malim buɣili ŋun yɛn be ti tooni ti ti, dama Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o. .
en: They said to me, We don't know what has happened to this man Moses, who brought us out of Egypt; so make us a god to lead us.

dag: Ka kum daa wum o pam ka o bɔri bindirigu ni o di, amaa ka bɛ daa na duɣirimi; di saha maa ka o daa nya ʒii.
en: He was hungry and wanted to eat. But while they were preparing the food for Peter to eat, he had a vision.

dag: ka daa daŋ tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli nti mali shili n-gul o;.
en: He sent some messengers on ahead to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum sapashini maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli salo bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: Jesus was surprised when he heard this; he turned around and said to the crowd following him, I tell you, I have never found faith like this, not even in Israel.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim maa daa bo tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin ti Dilaila na, ka o zaŋ li lo Samsin.
en: So the Philistine kings brought Delilah seven new bowstrings that were not dried out, and she tied Samson up.

dag: Chɛ ka zaligu litaafi ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa kul be a nol ni sahakam, kul bɔhimmi li wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ din ni chɛ ka a tooi doli din sab di ni maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka di chɛ ka a tɔŋ a sol ni, ka lan chɛ ka a di nasara viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Never stop speaking about this Instruction scroll. Recite it day and night so you can carefully obey everything written in it. Then you will accomplish your objectives and you will succeed.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi wumbu, n ni kum ashilɔni yi karimbaani maa zuɣu. N ni kum pam hal ka nintam ti zɔri n nina ni, bɛ ni gbahi Yawɛ niriba leei daba maa zuɣu.
en: If you people of Judah dont listen to him, I will hide and cry. Your pride will cause me to cry. I will cry very hard. My eyes will overflow with tears, because the Lord s flock will be captured.

dag: min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa piligu ni hal ni bahigu ni, nyama, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: and his history from beginning to end—is all recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn deei n noli, ka doli n zaligunima?.
en: The LORD said to Moses, How long will you refuse to obey my commandments and instructions?.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr piɛlli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi tɔbu, ka bɛ ti o nam zuɣupiligu, ka o chani gindi n-tuhiri diri nasara.
en: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.

dag: Ka Liya daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Rubin. Dama o daa yɛliya, Yawɛ nya m muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli; Yɛlimaŋli, n yidan ni yu ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Leah gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben. She named him this because she said, The Lord has seen my troubles. My husband does not love me. So now maybe my husband will love me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛman ni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: During the time when Jehoiakim, son of King Josiah, was king of Judah, the Lord spoke this message to Jeremiah:.

dag: A wuhiya ni chɛfirinim mali taali, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bahi yoli; ka a kpihim bɛ yuya zaa zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Youve denounced the nations, destroyed the wicked. Youve erased their names for all time.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛba bɛn birigi n niriba la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti nya n-di saha shɛli, bɛ kuhirimi yɛra, Suhudoo beni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ti ba ka bɛ di, bɛ yɛrimi ni bɛ ni tuhi ba.
en: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Shia Kasi n-tahiri ma Jɛrusalɛm, ka m mi bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ ma nimaani.
en: Now, compelled by the Spirit, Im going to Jerusalem. I dont know what will happen to me there.

dag: amaa chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu nyɛla binshɛli din be yi suhuri ni, ka pa ni din saɣinda. Dina n-nyɛ tarimtali mini suhumahili, dama dimbɔŋɔnima m-mali buchi pam Naawuni sani.
en: No, your beauty should come from inside you—the beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit. That beauty will never disappear. It is worth very much to God.

dag: Amaa lee maliyala suhupiɛlli yi mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka yi suhuri ti paligi, ka yi tooi mali suhupiɛlli pam saha shɛl o jilima yi ti yi palo la.
en: Instead, rejoice as you share Christs suffering. You share his suffering now so that you may also have overwhelming joy when his glory is revealed.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnim saliŋ lɔhili. Yɛlim ba yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ.
en: Mortal man, he said, tell the Israelites a parable.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi n-gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali ka bɛ paai Gibiɔnnim ni daa be tin shɛŋa maa ni. Bɛ tinsi maa n-nyɛ Gibiɔn mini Chɛfira ni Bɛrɔt ni Kiriatijiarim.
en: So the Israelites went to the place where they lived. On the third day the Israelites came to the cities of Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ bihi kpi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti be tinduya ni.
en: and scatter their descendants among the heathen, letting them die in foreign countries.

dag: N ni daa tuui tɔɣisi n-zabi mmaŋ zuɣu saha shɛl la, so daa bi zani n nyaaŋa; sokam zaa daa zomi ka chɛ ma. Naawuni di zaŋ di taali ʒili ba!.
en: No one took my side at my first court hearing. Everyone deserted me. I hope that God doesnt hold it against them!.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zo n-kuli Gaat Naa Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Maok bia la sani.
en: So David and his men left Israel and went to Achish son of Maoch. Achish was king of Gath.

dag: O zaŋ ma luhi baɣiri ni, ka m be kaman taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim la.
en: He throws me down in the mud; I am no better than dirt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti me timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka me pii tam di zuɣu ka di du hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana n-zali yuli, dama di yi pa lala, ti ni ti wurim gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They said, Come, lets build for ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the sky, and lets make a name for ourselves so that we wont be dispersed over all the earth.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma ŋɔ? N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi n dimnim zuɣu, nyama, ka a ti bi niŋ ba shɛli, ka naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them.

dag: A tiligiri tarimba, ka pa nina lihiri karimbaannima ni a filim ba.
en: You help those who are humble, but as soon as you see the proud, you humiliate them.

dag: ka daa tari Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba ni paɣiba zaa bɔrɔbɔro kpillikpilli mini niŋkpillikpilli ni wain tihi wala mahilimahili ti kpa.
en: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.

dag: N nyɛla sana m-be yi sani, timiya ma luɣ shɛli ka n zaŋ li leei n kpiimba sɔɣibu shee n-zaŋ n kpim ŋɔ ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: I am a foreigner living here among you; sell me some land, so that I can bury my wife.

dag: Din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ni na nyɛla: Yurilim mini suhupiɛlli ni suhudoo ni suɣilɔdibo ni nirilimtali ni zaɣisuntali ni ʒiɛyimtali ni.
en: But the Spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o zahindi maa ni, Iin, m mi ni a bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni a tum taali, amaa mani n-chɛ ka a bi tum alahichi n sani maa; di zuɣu ka m bi chɛ ka a shih o maa.
en: Then God continued: I know you are innocent. That's why I kept you from sleeping with Sarah and doing anything wrong.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim yirila gbinni polo na, ka wari yiri kikaa pɔhim ni na.
en: The storm winds come from the south, and the biting cold from the north.

dag: Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee piɛlabil kam bee bubil kam sara maligu ni.
en: That is what shall be offered with each bull, ram, sheep, or goat.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Amaŋmaŋ mi n ni tum shɛm ti a, ka lan mi n zuɣu ni chɛ ka a niɣi yɛligi shɛm.
en: Jacob said to him, You know how Ive worked for you, and how well your livestock have done with me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa ti be puu maa ni zaawun mahili saha n-chani ginda, ka doo maa min o paɣ maa wum o damli, ka zo nti sɔɣi puu maa ni tihi ni ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ di nya ba.
en: That evening they heard the Lord God walking in the garden, and they hid from him among the trees.

dag: Dama yi mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi lo tab alikauli, ka bɛ ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, ka mal li, bɛ ni boli ya ka yi ti di di maligu bindira.
en: Do not make any treaties with the people of the country, because when they worship their pagan gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you to join them, and you will be tempted to eat the food they offer to their gods.

dag: Nir lala di tɛhiri ni o ni deei shɛli ti Duuma sani.
en: People like that should never imagine that they will receive anything from the Lord.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini, di nyɛla zaligu shɛli din kul yɛn be yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Yi mini tinzunnim zaa yɛn nyɛla yim Yawɛ sani.
en: The same rules will be for everyone—the Israelites and the foreigners living among you. This law will continue forever. You and the people living among you will be the same before the Lord .

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ situra zaa.
en: and the LORD said to Moses: Go to the people and take today and tomorrow to make them holy. Have them wash their clothes.

dag: Wummi n suhigu, dama bɛ filim ma. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni, dama bɛ mali yaa gari ma.
en: Listen to my prayer. I am so weak. Save me from those who are chasing me. They are stronger than I am.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛli ba, N nyaya ka yi ba bi lan bɔri n yɛla kaman o ni daa yi bɔri n yɛla shɛm la. Amaa m ba Naawuni la kul be n sani.
en: He said to them, I am aware that your father no longer likes me as much as he used to. But my fathers God has been with me.

dag: Ti ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la, lala ka n na kul yɛri ya yaha: So yi yihiri lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ yi ni daa pun deei shɛl la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: I said this before. Now I say it again: You have already accepted the Good News. Anyone who tells you another way to be saved should be condemned!.

dag: Zaɣ biɛ shɛli ka n nya dunia ŋɔ ni, chirimbu titali maa mi yirila zuɣulaannim sanna.
en: Theres an evil that I have seen under the sun: the kind of mistake that comes from people in power.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daai Taai goma luhi, ka wurim di binwɔɣila, ka n ti yihi di taŋkpaɣu ka chɛ ka di kpalim tampin nɛli doya.
en: The enemy soldiers will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers. I will also scrape the topsoil from her land. I will make Tyre a bare rock.

dag: Yisa tuumba maa daa wuhiri shihira pam, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa niriba sani; ka yɛdaniŋdib la zaa daa laɣim be Sulemaana Kazala ni.
en: Many miracles and wonders were being performed among the people by the apostles. All the believers met together in Solomon's Porch.

dag: Naawuni, tim ma suhu yini, ka ti ma tɛh pala din tuhi n suhu ni.
en: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.

dag: Ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: when seven cows, fat and sleek, came up out of the river and began to feed on the grass.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Duɣu shɛli din zahim, ka di zahimbu maa bi yi. Yaami nimdi maa di puuni yiniyini, ka miri ka a gahinda.
en: These words mean that Jerusalem is doomed! The city is filled with murderers and is like an old, rusty pot. The meat is taken out piece by piece, and no one cares what happens to it.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti timanim gba daa tum bɛ tabibi tuma n-gba daa niŋ lala. Ka di daa kpaŋsi Firawuna suhu, ka o daa bi wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: But the Egyptian religious experts did the same thing with their secret knowledge. As a result, Pharaoh remained stubborn, and he wouldnt listen to them, just as the LORD had said.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ duɣi chuɣu bindir suma, ka bo wain kura mini bindir suma din mali kpam ni wain shɛli bɛ ni te viɛnyɛliŋga n-ti zuliya kam zaa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka zaŋ dari mali adaka n-zaŋ li du zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka n sanna.
en: At that time the Lord said to me, You must cut out two stone tablets like the first two stones. Then you must come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden box.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ baŋ ni n ni ti su li.
en: Abram asked, Lord God, how can I know the land will be mine.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, a ni lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ka ti di wahala shɛŋa di ni bi simdi ni ti di?.
en: Lord , are you unmoved by all this? Are you going to do nothing and make us suffer more than we can endure?.

dag: Ti ni ti wum wumpaɣibo yila din tibigiri Wuntialan ŋɔ dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Amaa ka n yɛli, Mbusim paai ma. N lan ka tahima, dama bilikɔɣinim kul tumdila bɛ bilikɔnsi tuma pahira.
en: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous!.

dag: di yi pa lala a ni daa yihi ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na maa nim ni yɛli, Yawɛ ni kɔŋ ba zaŋ tahi o ni daa lo ba alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la zuɣu min o ni je ba zuɣu ka o yihi ba tahi tiŋgban nɛl ni ni o ti chɛ ka bɛ kpi.
en: Otherwise, the Egyptians will say that you were unable to take your people into the land that you had promised them. They will say that you took your people out into the desert to kill them, because you hated them.

dag: ka yihi bɛn daa be dabitim ni bɛ bebu puuni zaa kum dabiɛm zuɣu la bahi.
en: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi chana.
en: Jesus was walking through some wheat fields on a Sabbath. As his disciples walked along with him, they began to pick the heads of wheat.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Kpiɔŋlan Naa mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ti jɛmd o? Ka ti yi suhir o, nyo bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya.
en: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?.

dag: Lihimiya Ziɔn din nyɛ ti ni puhiri ti daadiini churi tin shɛli ni la. Lihimiya Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ alaafee biɛhigu shee la. Di tanti suɣili bi vuura, ka di dasara kul ku vuɣi, ka di gabisi mi bi chihira.
en: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali tahima ŋɔ timiya suhupiɛlli mini suhudoo zaa yi ni niŋ yɛda zuɣu, din ni chɛ ka yi mali tahima din galisi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: I pray that the God who gives hope will fill you with much joy and peace as you trust in him. Then you will have more and more hope, and it will flow out of you by the power of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa bo bɔrɔbɔro mini wain koligu pali ni busaa n-zaŋ pa buŋ zuɣu ti o bia Dauda ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ Sool sani.
en: Jesse loaded a donkey with bread and a goatskin full of wine, then he told David to take the donkey and a young goat to Saul.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa yi tɔb maa ni n-zo hal ni Shilo dindali maa, o daa dari tɔhi la o situra, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu.
en: A man from the tribe of Benjamin ran all the way from the battlefield to Shiloh and arrived there the same day. To show his grief, he had torn his clothes and put dirt on his head.

dag: Zaŋmiya zaligu kundi ŋɔ ti sɔŋ baɣili Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la, ka di be nimaani nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: This is The Book of God's Law . Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nirilim yɛla, ka kuhi yɛl a wuntia yɛla.
en: They will talk about your goodness and sing about your justice.

dag: Ka Barak daa laɣim Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba maa Kɛdɛshi, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pia daa dol o mini Dɛbɔra chaŋ.
en: where Barak called together the troops from Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand soldiers gathered there, and Barak led them out from Kedesh. Deborah went too.

dag: Ka ninsal daa boli niɣi zaa mini noonsi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa yuya; amaa ka ninsal ŋun daa lee ka sɔŋda ŋun nyɛ o kpee.
en: So the man named all the birds and all the animals; but not one of them was a suitable companion to help him.

dag: O zaŋd o bumbil lɔri wain tia, ka zaŋd o bunsaa bia lɔri wain ti viɛlli. O zaŋdi wain paɣir o situra, ka zaŋdi wain wala kom paɣir o binyɛr titali.
en: You will tie your donkey to a choice grapevine and wash your clothes in wine from those grapes.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni kaman a ni niŋ bɛ ba shɛm maa, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma, ka kpam booi bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni maa ni ti ba soli ka bɛ kul nyɛ maligumaaniba sahakam bɛ ʒiɛman ni.
en: and ordain them in the same way, so they and their descendants will always be my priests.

dag: Ka n ni darigi Dauda zuliya tibili, amaa m bi yɛn darigi li hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: Because of Solomon's sin I will punish the descendants of David, but not for all time.

dag: ka koma maa daa labina ti lim Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ni o tɔbbihi bɛn daa doli Izraɛlnim maa siɣi teeku maa ni zaa, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: The water came and covered the chariots, the cavalry, and the whole Egyptian army that had followed the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them was left alive.

dag: ka sagbani maa zuɣu chɛ ka Maligumaaniba maa kɔŋ bɛ tuma tumbu, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa.
en: and the priests were unable to carry out their duties due to the cloud because the LORDs glory filled the LORDs temple.

dag: ka dihi bɛn kpiri kum bindir suma, ka kari bundaannim ni nuzaŋa bahi.
en: He has filled the hungry with good things and sent the rich away empty-handed.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Chamiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa gbini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti pii kuɣ yiniyini m-pa yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu, ka di kalinli saɣisi yi Izraɛlnim zuliya pinaayi ŋɔ kalinli.
en: He said to them, Go out into the river where the Holy Box of the Lord your God is. Each of you must find one rock. There will be one rock for each of the twelve tribes of Israel. Carry that rock on your shoulder.

dag: Naawuni ni booni so Nyɛvili Yɛligu la daa pun bela piligu ni, ka ti daa wum o yɛla, ka ti nini daa nya o ka ti lih o hal ka ti zaŋ ti nuhi tabis o.
en: We announce to you what existed from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we have seen and our hands handled, about the word of life.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa lan zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa chɛ ka o po Naawuni ni o ni jɛm o la, ka daa lan niŋ karimbaani ni tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la sani.
en: Moreover, he rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, despite the solemn pledge Nebuchadnezzar had forced him to swear in Gods name. He became stubborn and refused to turn back to the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Ka naa yi bi yura ka tum birigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi kpe taali ni.
en: If a leader sins by unintentionally breaking any of the commands of the LORD his God, doing something that shouldnt be done, and becomes guilty of sin.

dag: N ni be a tooni, ka dahim zoya ti a. N ni kabi daanya dunoya ti a, ka kabi dunoya ni kuriti ti a.
en: I myself will go before you, and I will level mountains. I will shatter bronze doors; I will cut through iron bars.

dag: N ni zaŋ n jaaŋgbee taɣi ya, ka lɔn ya alikauli.
en: I will make you walk under the rod, and I will bring you into the covenant bond.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ; kulimi ni suhudoo, a yipa kpaŋya zaa.
en: Jesus said to the woman, You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace! You are healed, and you will no longer be in pain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu na ti sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: His body was carried to Jerusalem on a horse, and he was buried in the royal tombs in David's City.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Izraɛl do so bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl do so yi ti zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, bɛn kum o; tiŋ maa nim bɛn labim o kuɣa.
en: to say to the people of Israel, Any of you or any foreigner living among you who gives any children to be used in the worship of the god Molech shall be stoned to death by the whole community.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa niŋ shɛhira ka tɔɣisi ti Duuma yɛligu naai maa ka bɛ daa doli Samaria tiŋkpansi pam chani yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-labiri kuni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di shiri niŋ kaman o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to them to be crucified. So they took charge of Jesus.

dag: Di pala ninkura kɔŋko m-mali yɛm bee bɛn gbaai kpamli kɔŋko m-mi din tuhi.
en: Old men are not the only wise people. They are not the only ones who understand what is right.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka yi leei nyɛviyanima, ka n zaŋ ya niŋ yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka mi shiri ni niŋ li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I will put my breath in them, bring them back to life, and let them live in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord . I have promised that I would do this—and I will. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Siria tinsi ni zani dabari zaa. Mɔri ni be nimaani, ka niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubira, ka so ku kari ba.
en: The villages of Aroer are abandoned forever. They will be pastures for flocks, which will lie down undisturbed.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-nyɛ: Jɛramiil mini Ram ni Kɛlubai.
en: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza vali ma. O kabisi ma; o chɛ ka n kpalimla zaɣ vuɣu. O vali ma mi kaman wahu ni vaani bini shɛm la. O vali m bin viɛla tiɣi, ka tuhi ma bahi.
en: The people of Jerusalem say, King Nebuchadnezzar made us panic. That monster stuffed himself with us and our treasures, leaving us empty— he gobbled up what he wanted and spit out the rest.

dag: N ni ti yihi bukpahigu yi kɔbili ni, ka baɣisi ti ku lan beni.
en: I will destroy the magic charms you use and leave you without any fortunetellers.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi mini Naa Hɛrɔd dabindi la.
en: He gave them strict orders: Watch out and be on your guard for the yeast of the Pharisees as well as the yeast of Herod.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi yaannim Tɛra min o bihi Ibrahimma mini Nahɔr daa bela Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli kurimbuni ha n-jɛmdi buɣa.
en: Then Joshua said to the entire people, This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Long ago your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates. They served other gods. Among them was Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o bia maa, ka di chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya kul diri nam Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli leei n jɛmbu shee la.
en: I will let Solomons son keep one tribe to rule over. I will do this for my servant David, so he will always have someone to rule near me in Jerusalem, the city that I chose to be my own.

dag: Naawuni ni mali soli ti ba, ka yihi ba dabitim ni. Bɛ ni ti kabi dunɔdali n-dol li gari yi. Bɛ naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ maŋmaŋa ni ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: The One Who Breaks Through Walls will push through and walk to the front of his people. They will break through the gates and leave that city. They will leave with their king marching before them— with the Lord at the front of his people.

dag: Shɛmia bidibisi maa n-daa nyɛ: Otini mini Rɛfaɛl ni Obɛd ni Ɛlizabad ŋun mabihi daa nyɛ bɛn mali yiko la ni Ɛlihu ni Sɛmakia.
en: Shemaiahs family: Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, and his relatives, Elihu and Semachiah, who were valiant men.

dag: Ka farigudeeriba gba daa kana ni bɛ ti deei baptaizibu ka bɔh o, Karimba, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: Some tax collectors came to be baptized, and they asked him, Teacher, what are we to do.

dag: Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa ti ka n sanna ti ʒini n tooni.
en: Some of the leaders of the Israelites came to consult me about the Lord 's will.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi bɛn mini bɛ malibu daa kuli Ijipti yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The sons of Jacob who went to Egypt with him, each with his family, were.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu n-vihir o ni o baŋ o nyaandoliba min o wuhibu yɛla.
en: The high priest asked Jesus questions about his followers and what he taught them.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛsta daa boli Hatak ŋun daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣili so naa ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o sɔŋd o la na nti yɛl o ni o cham ti bɔhi Mɔdɛkai nya din niŋ o ni din tahi lala na.
en: Then she called Hathach, one of the palace eunuchs appointed as her servant by the king, and told him to go to Mordecai and find out what was happening and why.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaam amaŋa ni bi pala kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-mali biɛr kasi mini yɛda ni yurilim ni suhudoo, ka di chɛ ka a pahi bɛn doli ti Duuma ka bɛ suhuri ka daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: Avoid the passions of youth, and strive for righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who with a pure heart call out to the Lord for help.

dag: Di kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam kaman goli ŋun kul nyɛ shɛhiralana m-be sagbana ni ŋɔ.
en: It will be as permanent as the moon, that faithful witness in the sky.

dag: N kamina ni n ti tuɣili bidibiga min o ba ni bipuɣiŋga min o ma ni paɣa min o yidana ma;.
en: I came to set sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law;.

dag: Amaa m piila Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ tiri n yuli jilima nimaani ka pii Dauda ni o su n niriba Izraɛlnima. .
en: But now I have chosen Jerusalem as the place where I will be worshiped, and you, David, to rule my people.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa lan lab Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni chani ginda, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: Jesus and his disciples returned to Jerusalem. And as he was walking through the temple, the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses came over to him.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ kul nyɛla yi ni chihiri binshɛba, di ŋubiya bɛ nimdi, ka bɛ zaɣ kpima nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛli.
en: and must remain so. You must not eat their flesh, and you must detest their dead bodies.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita, ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ata, ka o daa zaŋ di zaa niŋ Lɛbanɔn dakuɣuri yil la ni.
en: He also made smaller shields of hammered gold. He used about / pounds of gold for each shield. The king put them in the Forest-of-Lebanon House.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat maa daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili Izraɛl Naa Ahazia ŋun daa tum tuumbiɛri pam la.
en: At one time King Jehoshaphat of Judah made an alliance with King Ahaziah of Israel, who did many wicked things.

dag: Zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim daa bi niŋ yɛda bee dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ so ti niŋ yɛda ni dimnim ni tooi kpe Jɛrusalɛm puuni.
en: No one anywhere, not even rulers of foreign nations, believed that any invader could enter Jerusalem's gates.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita nini daa neei ka o yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o malaika na ka o ti fa ma Naa Hɛrɔd mini Yɛhudianim zaa ni lɔri nia ni bɛ niŋ ma bɛ ni yu shɛm la nuu ni bahi.
en: Peter realized then what had happened. He thought, Now I know that the Lord really sent his angel to me. He rescued me from Herod and from everything those Jews thought would happen to me.

dag: Dama ʒiri ʒiinim ti ku lan beni, ka ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa gba ti ku lan be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gili ba tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa, ka bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka maligumaaniba daa piɛbi bɛ kikahi.
en: The Judeans looked around and saw that they were surrounded. They cried to the Lord for help, and the priests blew the trumpets.

dag: Bɛ yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka ŋmari ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: the people who talk about you, but only for wicked schemes; the people who are your enemies, who use your name as if it were of no significance.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa duhi bɛ yɛhi n-kum hal ti lan ka yaa din ni kum.
en: They started crying and kept it up until they were too weak to cry any more.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya lala maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni ŋun niŋ ninsalinim yiko ŋɔ tatabo maa.
en: When the crowds saw this, they were afraid and praised God for giving such authority to people.

dag: A ni tooi sɔŋ o yɛrigi sagbana ka di kpɛm kaman bɛ ni dooi diɣi la?.
en: Can you help God stretch out the sky and make it as hard as polished metal?.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa nti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na. O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku nol la yiŋa.
en: Send someone to Joppa for a man whose full name is Simon Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner of leather, who lives by the sea.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa kana di saha maa ti ku Anakinim zaa bɛn daa be zoya tinsi ni la. Bɛ daa bela Hiburɔn mini Dɛbir ni Anab ni zoya zuɣu tinsi din zaa daa be Juda mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔna ni la. Jɔshua daa ku niriba maa zaa, ka saɣim bɛ tinsi.
en: The Anakites lived in the hill country in the area of Hebron, Debir, Anab, and Judah. Joshua fought them and completely destroyed all the people and their towns.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ piligi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they began to speak different languages. The Holy Spirit was giving them the power to do this.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul bɔrila zabili, ka tikuba mi woligir nir min o zɔsimo.
en: Troublemakers are always causing problems. Their gossip breaks up the closest of friends.

dag: Di yi shiri nyɛla yi duhila yimaŋa n-jɛndi ma, ka zaŋ n filiŋ ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: If you look down on me and use my disgrace to criticize me.

dag: Aripakishad daa nyɛla Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi pɔri ŋɔ taali ni nyɛla a yi chaŋ n dɔɣiriba maa sani, ka bɛ ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku ti a paɣ na, dindina a yi m pɔri maa taali ni.
en: There is only one way for you to be free from your vow: if you go to my relatives and they refuse you, then you will be free.

dag: Dama di daa simdi ni nyini n dan naa ku m ba daŋ niriba zaa, amaa ka a daa zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ m-pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. N lan malila n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-naɣ pahila n kum niŋ nyin naa.
en: Even though all the members of my grandfathers family were nothing short of demonic toward my master and king, you still put your servant with those who eat at your table. So what right do I have to beg for still more from the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu kamina ka n ti tim a Firawuna sani ka a chaŋ ti yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So now I am sending you to Pharaoh. Go! Lead my people, the Israelites, out of Egypt.

dag: ka di gari Farisii maa, o ni daa nya ka Yisa bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣ o nuhi ka ʒini ni o di maa zuɣu.
en: But the Pharisee was surprised when he saw that Jesus did not wash his hands first before the meal.
