dag: Yawɛ yi ti yiɣisi ni o dam dunia ŋɔ, niriba ni ti zo nti kpe tampima lɔna voya ni mini tiŋgbani vokaba ni ni bɛ tilig o dabiɛm zɔbu ni min o jilima dabiɛm zɔbu ni.
en: They will go down into cracks in the rocks and boulders because they are afraid of the Lord and his glorious power as he stands to shake the earth.

dag: M pola pɔri ka ʒe di nyaaŋa ni n dol a wuntia zaligunim la.
en: I will keep my solemn promise to obey your just instructions.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soya, ka chɛ ka m baŋ li.
en: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;.

dag: Pool ni daa nya ʒii maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa dii gbaai nia lɔbu ni ti chaŋ Masidɔnia maa ti ni daa baŋ ni Naawuni n-tim ti ni ti ti yihi Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ waazu ti nimaani nim gba zuɣu.
en: Immediately after he saw the vision, we prepared to leave for the province of Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to proclaim the good news to them.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi nya bula shɛb zaa bɛn duri buhi ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri, dama n nya Leeban ni niŋd a shɛm.
en: Look, he continued, all the male goats that are mating are striped, spotted, and speckled. I am making this happen because I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu Izraɛl fɔntinsi zuɣu n-daa tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni nɛma ni daa be fɔntin shɛŋa ni zaa Naftali tiŋgban ni.
en: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa polo n-nyɛ ni bɛ kulim bɛ suhuri ni yu dɔbba shɛba, amaa ni bɛ lee kulimila bɛmaŋmaŋ daŋ puuni dɔbba.
en: This is the Lord s command to Zelophehads daughters: If you want to marry someone, you must marry someone from your own tribe.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba mini Kɔra daŋ niriba la daa yiɣisi zani ŋ-ŋme kuŋ pam paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Levites from the lines of Kohath and Korah stood up to loudly praise the LORD, the God of Israel.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, Ti ninkura mini ti bipola zaa ni ti bidibisi mini ti bipuɣinsi zaa zaŋ tabili ti biŋkɔbbaligu mini ti niɣi zaa. Dama ti yɛn chaŋmi ti puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Moses answered, We will all go, including our children and our old people. We will take our sons and daughters, our sheep and goats, and our cattle, because we must hold a festival to honor the Lord .

dag: N ka galimi o sani; ka gbaai mmaŋa zaŋ chaŋ taali tumbu polo.
en: He knows I did nothing that was wrong. I have kept myself from sinning.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun karindi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li ka doli din sabi litaafi ŋɔ puuni mal alibarika, dama saha maa miriya.
en: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.

dag: Bɛ bi mi, bɛ mi bi baŋ, bɛ tɛha mini bɛ nina zommi, ka bɛ ku tooi baŋ shɛli bee n-nya shɛli.
en: Such people are too stupid to know what they are doing. They close their eyes and their minds to the truth.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ŋun mini pagɔrili laɣim min o leela niŋgbun yini? Dama di sabiya ni niriba ayi ni leei niŋgbun yini.
en: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, The two of them will be like one person.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum Abarim zoya din pie tab ŋɔ zuɣu ti nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Go up on one of mountains in the desert east of the Jordan River. There you will see the land that I am giving to the Israelites.

dag: A ni pahi ma jilima; ka maai n suhu yaha.
en: Please increase my honor and comfort me all around.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lan lih o, ka yum maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, This is leprosy—you are unclean.

dag: Ka bɛ ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: The people of Israel and Judah will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Ka o daa baŋ li ka yɛli, M bia maa binyɛrigu m-bala; mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o maa. Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ o kul dari tɔhitɔhila Yisifu zaa.
en: He recognized it and said, Yes, it is his! Some wild animal has killed him. My son Joseph has been torn to pieces.

dag: O teei gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka n nya biɛrim mini naŋgbantom pam.
en: He has shut me in a prison of misery and anguish.

dag: Ka ti nya dimbɔŋɔ ka di li shɛhira n-yɛri ni ti Ba Naawuni daa tim o Bia na ni o ti leei dunianim Tiligira.
en: We have seen that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world, and this is what we tell people now.

dag: di saha ka o daa nya yɛm ka kahigi li, ka zal li, ka bo n-yihi li na.
en: It was then he saw wisdom and tested its worth— He gave it his approval.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli.
en: After they crossed the lake, they came to the shore at Gennesaret.

dag: Kaman yinyaa ni zaŋdi buɣim datɛhi labiri ka tɔri piɛma din mali lɔɣu shɛm la.
en: Someone who tricks someone else and then claims that he was only joking is like a crazy person playing with a deadly weapon.

dag: mini Gɛbalnim tiŋgban la ni Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban la zaa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo ni Baaligad din be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni la ni zaŋ ti paai Lɛbohamat kpɛbu shee la.
en: the land of the Gebalites; all of Lebanon to the east, from Baalgad, which is south of Mount Hermon, to Hamath Pass.

dag: N zaŋdi n yɛlimuɣisira n-yɛr o asiba mini wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, ka ŋuhiri niŋd o, ka o mi ni wum n kuhigu maa.
en: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.

dag: Bɛ daa je bindirigu kam; di daa chɛ biɛla ka bɛ kpi.
en: They had absolutely no appetite for food; they had arrived at deaths gates.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be yɔɣu maa ni yuun pihinahi la, a daa dihi ba, ka binshɛli daa bi pooi ba; bɛ situra daa bi kpi, ka bɛ naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni dunia ŋɔ ni, n ku lan nya Yawɛ bee ninsala yaha.
en: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord , or any of the people who live on this earth.

dag: Yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛli maa nyɔri nyɛla yi ni nya tiliginsim shɛl la.
en: because you are receiving the salvation of your souls, which is the purpose of your faith in him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ gili Mɔab tintarisi; ka fabila yɛtɔɣa daa tin ti to Ɛgilaimnim mini Bɛrilimnima.
en: An outcry sounds within the borders of Moab, as far as Eglaim, a cry of distress, as far as Beer-elim, a cry of distress.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiri ni ti yɛda niŋbu ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri: Yi yɛda ni kpaŋsi n suhu, ka n gba yɛda kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri.
en: I mean that I want us to help each other with the faith that we have. Your faith will help me, and my faith will help you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la ka di yi alizanda ni na yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni n-su tiliginsim mini yiko, ka simdi tibigibu!.
en: After this I heard what sounded like a large crowd of people in heaven. The people were saying, Hallelujah ! Victory, glory, and power belong to our God.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbani ni la dina. Di zaa yoli, Asa daa kul ʒiɛla yim o biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: Although the shrines werent removed from Israel, Asa nevertheless remained committed with all his heart throughout his life.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Obɔt.
en: As the Israelites continued their journey to Canaan, they camped at Oboth.

dag: Masia zuɣu m mali suhupiɛlli chɔɣinsi ni mini ʒiɛmbu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni alaka nyabu ni ni wahala dibu puuni, dama n yi ti gbarigi, di saha ka n lan nyari yaa.
en: Therefore, Im all right with weaknesses, insults, disasters, harassments, and stressful situations for the sake of Christ, because when Im weak, then Im strong.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan bol a labisina kaman paɣ so bɛ ni zaɣisi ka o mali suhugarigu la. Naawuni yɛliya, A ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun kuli dooyili o paɣisarilim ni ka bɛ ti zaɣis o.
en: As an abandoned and dejected woman the LORD has summoned you; as a young wife when she is rejected, says your God.

dag: Ka o paɣ Zipɔra daa bo kuɣili din dira n-gun o bidibiga, ka zaŋ di ʒim ʒe Musa naba ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ, a nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: But Zipporah took a sharp-edged flint stone and cut off her sons foreskin. Then she touched Moses genitals with it, and she said, You are my bridegroom because of bloodshed.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kal ti pahi niɣi ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a lihi ti jɛra?.
en: What makes you think we are as stupid as cattle?.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm kaman di ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm la.
en: I tell you, however, that Elijah has already come and that people treated him just as they pleased, as the Scriptures say about him.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa ni barinyuriba, amaa bɛ barinyubo maa nyɛla yoli.
en: We have heard that the people of Moab are very proud and conceited. They are hot-tempered braggers, but their boasts are only empty words.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Naawuni o jɛmbu duu. Paɣimiy o zuɣusaa din nyɛ o yiko ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise God in his fortress, the sky!.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam pihi di wala ni di li ka paɣi Yawɛ, ka bɛnkam pihi wain tiwala laɣim sɔŋ ni nyu di wain n jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: Those who harvest will eat it and will praise the LORD; those who gather will drink it in my holy courtyards.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Miriya ka yi tahi bee n-chɛ ka so wum yi kukoya vuri bee n-chɛ ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi yi nol ni na; naɣila dahin shɛli n yi ti bahi ya noli ni yi tahima.
en: Joshua had told the people not to give a war cry. He said, Dont shout. Dont say a word until the day I tell you. Then you will shout.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni laɣim a mamanim maa zaa, a mini bɛn diri nyaɣisim maa, a ni daa yuri shɛb zaa min a ni daa je shɛb la zaa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi luɣilikam laɣimna ti lir a, ka m pirig a a zaɣim wuhi ba, ka bɛ nya a zaɣim zaa.
en: So I am bringing all of your lovers together. I will bring all the men you loved and all the men you hated. I will bring them all together and let them see you naked. They will see you completely naked.

dag: amaa ka bɛn daa mali yɛm la bɛn daa ʒi kpam pahi bɛ firilanim zuɣu.
en: But the wise ones took their lamps and also brought containers of oil.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ din niŋ o maa, ka dabiɛm kpe o pam ka o ni dii sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o din niŋ o maa zaa.
en: The woman, full of fear and trembling, came forward. Knowing what had happened to her, she fell down in front of Jesus and told him the whole truth.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: and said to him, Tell us, what right do you have to do these things? Who gave you such right.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa yo bɛn daa yoli kana maa tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: The men who had begun to work at five o'clock were paid a silver coin each.

dag: Ka o daa lu soli n-kariti anab maa naba nti nya o ka o ʒila oki tia gbini, ka o bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ anab so ŋun yi Juda na la? Ka o garigi yɛli Iin, mani.
en: down the road after the prophet from Judah and found him sitting under an oak tree. Are you the prophet from Judah? he asked. I am, the man answered.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-nyɛ yɛndana ni baŋda? Di simdi ni o zaŋ o biɛrisuntali n-wuh o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm tarimtali yɛm puuni.
en: Are there any of you who are wise and understanding? You are to prove it by your good life, by your good deeds performed with humility and wisdom.

dag: Ŋunkam zani sana nyaaŋa ka o paŋ binshɛli, yin deem dilan binyɛrigu, ŋunkam zaŋ binshɛli pa talima ka deei binshɛli ti tinzunnima, yin deemiy o ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima maa.
en: Take the garment of the person who secures a loan for a stranger; take his pledge for a foreigner.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa sabi yɛli pahi: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ti su bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yila Jɛsi zuliya ni na. O ni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tahima ni ti be.
en: And Isaiah says, Someone will come from Jesses family. He will come to rule over the nations, and they will put their hope in him. Isaiah :.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la .
en: They came to a place called Golgotha, which means, The Place of the Skull.

dag: Kunduna ni ti tam bɛ pihi zuɣu kumda, ka yɔbahi be bɛ nayili viɛla puuni kumda. Babilɔn saha miriya, ka di dabisili ku lan tirisi tooni.
en: The towers and palaces will echo with the cries of hyenas and jackals. Babylon's time has come! Her days are almost over.

dag: Amaa ka Samsin zabiri maa daa ti lan bilina gbaai zoobu o pinibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But the hair on his head began to grow again right after it had been shaved.

dag: Yi yi ti lo noli n-nahim yimaŋa, lala nolɔbo ka n zali? Di nyɛla yi silim yi zuɣuri tiŋa kaman gbiŋgbama la, ka pili buri n-teei do tampiligim ni? Dina ka yi booni nolɔbo? Yi tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ni saɣi deei di dabisili maa?.
en: Is this the kind of fast I choose, a day of self-affliction, of bending ones head like a reed and of lying down in mourning clothing and ashes? Is this what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti sa zahimla zahima ka bi nya ŋun ni wuhi ti di gbinni. Ka Yisifu bɔhi ba, Pa Naawuni n-wuhiri zahindi gbinni? N suhiri ya, yɛlimiya ma yi zahima maa.
en: They answered, Each of us had a dream, and there is no one here to explain what the dreams mean. It is God who gives the ability to interpret dreams, Joseph said. Tell me your dreams.

dag: ka yi ti kari yi dimnim bɛn zaa be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm.
en: and you will drive out your enemies, as he promised.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ wɔɣirili ŋun be ninvuɣ pihita la ni, ka nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. O bia Amizabad n-daa nyɛ ŋun zan o zaani n-su o niriba maa fukumsi.
en: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;.

dag: Ka napaɣ kuro daa wum naa min o kpambaliba ni tɔɣisiri yɛlli maa yɛla ka kpe bɛ chuɣu puhibu duu maa ni na ti yɛli, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Di chɛ ka yɛla maa muɣis a ti yaɣi, ka a chɛ ka a ninni biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Then the kings mother came into the place where the party was. She had heard the voices of the king and his royal officials. She said, King, may you live forever! Dont be afraid! Dont let your face be so white with fear!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti ʒini maa, yin zaŋmiya alibarika ŋɔ ti tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu, ka zaŋya noli dibu ŋɔ mi ti tam Ɛbal Zoli zuɣu.
en: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.

dag: Teemiya Vuhim Dabisili yɛla, ka chɛ ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi.
en: Observe the Sabbath and keep it holy.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa be Jɛrusalɛm, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi ni di taɣi Judanima.
en: Rehoboam ruled from Jerusalem, and he had several cities in Judah turned into fortresses so he could use them to defend his country. These cities included.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin din kanna puuni, bindira ni niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: There will be seven years of great plenty in all the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, A tizo Ɛbɛl be ya? Ka Keen garigi yɛli, M bi mi; mani n-nyɛ n tizo maa gula.
en: Afterwards the Lord asked Cain, Where is Abel? How should I know? he answered. Am I supposed to look after my brother.

dag: Ɛdom yɛla ni ti mali dabiɛm. Ŋunkam ti gari nimaani dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka di gar o yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn niŋ nimaani la zuɣu.
en: Then Edom will become a wasteland. All who pass by will be shocked by its injuries.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bi nɛɔŋ maa ti paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni ŋɔ ka di ku o, ŋuna n-nyɛ bia maa ma.
en: Then Solomon said, Don't kill the child! Give it to the first woman—she is its real mother.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naa daa bi saɣi niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la yɛli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: It was the will of the Lord God to bring about what he had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh. This is why the king did not pay any attention to the people.

dag: ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paai ba Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, bɛ dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: But they dont allow it to go deep into their lives. They keep it only a short time. As soon as trouble or persecution comes because of the teaching they accepted, they give up.

dag: N daamiliya, yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Sheemi Amana Zoli zuɣu na. Sheemi Sɛnir mini Hɛrimɔn Zoya din nyɛ gbuɣima mini jɛŋgbina ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu na.
en: Come with me, my bride, from Lebanon. Come with me from Lebanon. Come from the peak of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions caves, from the mountain of the leopards.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba sani ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi gbaai o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: Judas went to talk with the chief priests and the officers of the temple police about how he could help them arrest Jesus.

dag: M pun po n kasitali pumpɔŋɔ ni sahakam; n ku ŋma Dauda ʒiri.
en: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.

dag: ka yɛra, Yawɛ bi nya; Yaakubu Naawuni maa ku baŋ.
en: And they say the Lord does not see them doing these evil things! They say the God of Jacob does not know what is happening.

dag: Naawuni gbaɣisi n tɔbu ka filim ma, lala zuɣu ka bɛ liri ma ka binshɛli bi gu ba soli.
en: Because God has made me weak and helpless, they turn against me with all their fury.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi deei farigu yaɣi bɛ ni zali ya ni yi deemi shɛm tariga.
en: Don't collect more than is legal, he told them.

dag: Dabisi muni puuni, di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la; di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni luɣilikam zaa.
en: All day long they surround me like a flood; they close in on me from every side.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra.
en: Agrippa told Paul, You may now speak for yourself. Paul stretched out his hand and said:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dama bɛ yɛri ya, Yi ŋubirila niriba, ka chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Land of Israel, people say bad things to you. They say you destroyed your people. They say you took the children away from your people.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa ti be mɔɣu ni Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la ka o daa yihiri waazu yɛra.
en: Years later, John the Baptist started preaching in the desert of Judea.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa garigi yɛl o, Din kariya, din kariya ka n saɣim bee n-wurim ya ŋɔ.
en: Never! Joab answered. I will never ruin or destroy your city!.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Bipuɣinsi ŋɔ nyɛla m bipuɣinsi, ka bihi ŋɔ nyɛ m bihi, ka biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ nyɛ m biŋkɔbiri; ka a ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa kpe ŋɔ nyɛla n dini. Amaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ wula ka n yɛn niŋ m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ mini bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛb ŋɔ?.
en: Laban answered Jacob, These young women are my daughters; their children belong to me, and these flocks are mine. In fact, everything you see here belongs to me. But since I can do nothing to keep my daughters and their children.

dag: M bihi, chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi tuma ni, dama Yawɛ m-pii ya ni yi zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka leeg o tumtumdiba m-maani sara tir o.
en: Dont be careless, my sons! The LORD has chosen you to stand in his presence to serve him, so that you can be his servants and burn incense to him.

dag: M mabihi ŋmarila ʒiri kaman kulibɔŋ kɔzɔrim la, bee kaman saa ni yi mi ka kom zɔri garita.
en: But you are treacherous.

dag: Ti kpaŋ timaŋ ni ti tibi Babilɔn, amaa ka kɔŋ li tibbu. Chɛliya li ka ti zaa kuli timaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama o tibidarigibo maa du zuɣusaa hal ti kpe sagbana ni.
en: Foreigners living there said, We tried to help Babylonia, but it was too late. Let's leave now and go back home. God has punished Babylonia with all his might and has destroyed it completely.

dag: Bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni; dama nir na ʒi m-pɔhi fiig tia wala goo zuɣu, ka so mi na ʒi m-pɔhi gaya pirinkpaŋ zuɣu.
en: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.

dag: Ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a. Kɔhim a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: When Jesus heard this, he said, Theres one more thing. Sell everything you own and distribute the money to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven. And come, follow me.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu, ka yi yi di baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni, yi naan ku zaŋ bɛn ka galimi taali.
en: If you had known what this means, I want mercy and not sacrifice , you wouldnt have condemned the innocent.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di miri kpe na, pirigim a namda maa, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee.
en: God replied, Don't come any closer. Take off your sandals—the ground where you are standing is holy.

dag: Absalom daa dɔɣila bidibis ata ni bipuɣin yino ŋun yuli daa booni Tama, o daa nyɛla paɣisar viɛlli.
en: Absalom had three sons and one daughter. Her name was Tamar, and she was a beautiful woman.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Wula ka yinim bɛn bi bɔri jilima Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani, amaa ka bɔri jilima la yi tab sani ŋɔ lee yɛn tooi niŋ yɛda?.
en: You like to receive praise from one another, but you do not try to win praise from the one who alone is God; how, then, can you believe me?.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti bɔhi, Sool daŋ ni ninvuɣ so na beni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: One day, David thought, I wonder if any of Saul's family are still alive. If they are, I will be kind to them, because I made a promise to Jonathan.

dag: Ka Liya daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Rubin. Dama o daa yɛliya, Yawɛ nya m muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli; Yɛlimaŋli, n yidan ni yu ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She said, The Lord has seen my trouble, and now my husband will love me; so she named him Reuben.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim kpiya dola bɛmaŋmaŋ gbala ni ni jilima;.
en: All the kings of the nations lie down honored, all of them, each in his own tomb.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila bɛ nyaansi biri ma ka pa bɛ tooni. Hal n ni daa kul wuhiri ba sahakam maa zaa yoli, bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum wuhibu ka deei saɣisigu.
en: They turned their backs to me and not their faces; and though I taught them over and over, they wouldnt accept my correction.

dag: Bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini bɛ zuɣulaannim ni daa bi baŋdi anabinim yɛligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi karindi Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, ka daa bi baŋ Yisa ni nyɛ so la zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ o puhi kubu, ka lala daa chɛ ka anabinim yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti bɔhi Izraɛl naa, M min a yɛla bi kpa. Cham a ba min a ma daanabinim la sani. Amaa ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, Aai, Yawɛ n-zaŋ ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: Elisha said to the king of Israel, What do you want from me? Go to the prophets of your father and mother. The king of Israel said to Elisha, No, we have come to see you because the Lord called us three kings together to let the Moabites defeat us.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka a yɛla mali dabiɛm pam. A nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni a ni lo alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunim polo.
en: I said: LORD God of heaven, great and awesome God, you are the one who keeps covenant and is truly faithful to those who love you and keep your commandments.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: He made the poles from acacia wood and covered them with gold.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti mi ni a nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛra, ka bi zɔri sal kam nini, dama a bi zɔri niriba nini bɛ ni ʒe zaashe shɛŋa ni zuɣu, amaa ka wuhiri Naawuni soli ni yɛlimaŋli. Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi?.
en: They went to him and said, Teacher, we know that you are honest. You treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are. And you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. Tell us, should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not.

dag: Di saha m ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: My father David wanted very much to build a temple to honor the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Fam ma baɣiri firibu ni bahi. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. Tiligim ma kɔbulli ŋɔ ni.
en: Pull me from the mud, and dont let me sink down deeper. Save me from those who hate me. Save me from this deep water.

dag: ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka palo pɔri ni bɛ zaa tooi laɣim be nimaani; dama bɛ ni daa su binshɛŋa daa galisiya pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi laɣim be luɣ yini.
en: And so there was not enough pasture land for the two of them to stay together, because they had too many animals.

dag: Kuɣ viɛla balibu kam ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi tiŋ maa gooni maa gbinni nachiinsi, ka di kɔtomsi daa be kɔŋkɔba. Kuɣ viɛla maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla jasipa, ka din pah ayi nyɛ safaya, ka din pah ata nyɛ agɛt, ka din pah anahi nyɛ ɛmɛrald.
en: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ sani.
en: He put all of this food in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and they presented it as a special gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka ti zaŋ m bia duɣi ŋubi n-kaai biɛɣu, ka n yɛl o, Zaŋm a bidibiga la na ka ti duɣi ŋub, ka ŋun zaŋ o bidibiga maa ti sɔɣi. .
en: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I told her that we would eat her son, but she had hidden him.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ puuni, bɔ ka bɛ lee nyari di ni?.
en: You spend your life working, laboring, and what do you have to show for it?.

dag: Naawuni yiko ni o daa tɔɣisi luhi Yɛhudianima niriba ni, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni Kundi n-kahigiri wuhiri niriba ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Masia.
en: He would vigorously defeat Jewish arguments in public debate, using the scriptures to prove that Jesus was the Christ.

dag: Ka bɛ laɣim bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa sɔŋ kaman zunzuya ni laɣindi binyara shɛm la, ka yiɣiri luri di zuɣu kaman toli ni yiɣiri luri binyara zuɣu shɛm la.
en: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.

dag: Ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri nazuɣuri mini bɛn su fukumsi din ni chɛ ka ti be ni alaafee, ka mali suhudoo n-niŋdi din luri Naawuni sizuura ka tumdi din tuhi daadamnim ninni;.
en: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.

dag: ka daa lan zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ salima bimparilan din be kasi niŋ di tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: He placed the turban on his head, and on the front of it he put the gold ornament, the sacred sign of dedication, just as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma: Bɛ paɣiba ŋmaligi n-gɔndila bɛ paɣ taba;.
en: Because people did those things, God left them and let them do the shameful things they wanted to do. Women stopped having natural sex with men and started having sex with other women.

dag: ni salima sara maligu bimbin ni bɛ ni yɛn boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini suɣili maa dunoli.
en: the gold altar; the anointing oil; the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance of the Tent;.

dag: Yɛm ni zaŋ jilima zuɣupiligu pil a, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli ti a.
en: Wisdom will reward you with a crown of honor and glory.

dag: Zuliya bɛn kpalim mi: Wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Bɛnjamin zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Now for the rest of the tribes: From the eastern border to the western border: Benjamin, one portion.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal bɛ ni kul mali kpiɔŋ ka lan galisi maa zaa yoli, n ni ku n-naa ba. Hal n ni daa chɛ ka yi di wahala la, n ku lan chɛ ka yi di wahala yaha.
en: This is what the Lord said: The people of Assyria are at full strength. They have many soldiers, but they will all be cut down. They will all be finished. My people, I made you suffer, but I will make you suffer no more.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa bɔhi Amnɔn, Nabia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim mali suhugarigu biɛɣukam lala? Yɛlim ma din muɣis a. Ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, N kɔre n-kpe m mabia Absalom tizɔpaɣ Tama ni.
en: Jonadab said to Amnon, You are the king's son, yet day after day I see you looking sad. What's the matter? I'm in love with Tamar, the sister of my half brother Absalom, he answered.

dag: O daa nyɛla Pɛrɛz yaaŋa, ka daa nyɛ ŋun su tɔbbi kpamba zaa fukumsi goli tuuli maa ni.
en: a descendant of Perez;.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Piɛr ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph said: This is the meaning of your dream. The three baskets are three days.

dag: Jɛrimia daa yɛliya, Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: While Jeremiah was a prisoner, he said, This message from the Lord came to me. This was the message:.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ Gaza, ka Ashikɛlɔn ti zani dabari. Bɛ ni ti taɣi Ashidɔdnim chaŋ wuntaŋ ni, ka wurim Ɛkurɔn.
en: Gaza will certainly be abandoned; and Ashkelon destroyed. Ashdod will be driven out at noon; Ekron will be uprooted.

dag: ni bɛ niŋ o kaman a ni daa pun lo shɛm a yiko ni min a milinsi ni la, dama di daa ʒe o la lala.
en: They did what your power and plan had already determined would happen.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka n guhira. Nyini n Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun ni garigi ma.
en: But I trust in you, O Lord ; and you, O Lord my God, will answer me.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, n pun naai Iso zuliya zaa, ka yihi ba bɛ sɔɣisili shee, ka bɛ ku tooi lan sɔɣi. O bihi min o dɔɣiriba ni o ʒiʒiinitaba bahi yoli ka so lan kani.
en: But I will take everything that belongs to you, people of Edom, and I will uncover every place where you try to hide. Then you will die, and so will your children, relatives, and neighbors.

dag: Ka n ti wum lahibali ni Yɛhudianim dɔni n-gu o soli, dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka bɛ tah o a sanna yomyom maa; ka yɛli bɛn fiɣisir o maa ni bɛ kam a sanna nti yɛl a bɛ ni fiɣisir o shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: And when I was informed that there was a plot against him, at once I decided to send him to you. I have told his accusers to make their charges against him before you.

dag: Yɛl tibisili fukumsi n-ʒi n zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa polo: Bɛn mi biɛhigu soli mini bɛn ʒi biɛhigu soli ni bɛn mi gbaŋ mini bɛn ʒi gbaŋ.
en: I have a responsibility both to Greeks and to those who dont speak Greek, both to the wise and to the foolish.

dag: Dama yi mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi lo tab alikauli, ka bɛ ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, ka mal li, bɛ ni boli ya ka yi ti di di maligu bindira.
en: Be careful not to make any agreements with the people who live in that land. If you do this, you might join them when they worship their gods. They will invite you to join them, and you will eat their sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ taɣimiya yi biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi binshɛɣukam zaa din be mɔɣu ni kulisi yiŋa, dama daadam bee biŋkɔbigu ŋun be mɔɣu ni ka bi kuli yiŋa, sakuɣa maa ni lu n-ku ba. .
en: Now give orders for your livestock and everything else you have in the open to be put under shelter. Hail will fall on the people and animals left outside unprotected, and they will all die.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni nini daa ti bi tiɣi bɛ zaa; kulla bɛ ni biɛla kɔŋko ka o nini daa tiɣi, ka daa chɛ ka bɛn kpalim la zaa bahi yoli mɔɣu ni luɣ kɔŋkɔba shee.
en: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.

dag: O daa yɛli ba ni bɛ suhim Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu n-kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ ba pahi Babilɔn baŋdiba shɛb bɛn kpalim la zuɣu ku.
en: so that they would ask the God of heaven for help about this mystery, in hopes that Daniel and his friends wouldnt die with the rest of Babylons sages.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yɛli, Yɛm so kpiɔŋ. Amaa bɛ daa lihi ʒiɛm doo maa yɛm maa, ka bi deeg o yɛligu.
en: So I thought, Wisdom is better than might, but the wisdom of commoners is despised and their words arent heeded.

dag: M mabiyurisi, ti ni mal alikaulinim ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti paɣ ti nuhi n-yi dinkam nyɛ din ni ta nir niŋgbuŋ min o shia daɣiri ni, ka chɛliya ka biɛrikasitali niŋ dɛde ti Naawuni zɔbu puuni.
en: All these promises are made to us, my dear friends. So then, let us purify ourselves from everything that makes body or soul unclean, and let us be completely holy by living in awe of God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti karim Naawuni zaligu min anabinim sabbu naai ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulaannim daa tim so ni o cham ti yɛli Pool min o nyaaŋa maa, Ti mabihi, yi yi mali yɛligu din ni kpaŋsi niriba ŋɔ suhuri, yin yɛlimiya li.
en: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.

dag: Molimiy o jilima molo zuliya kam ni, ka yɛl o daalahizib tuma yɛla niriba zaa sani.
en: Proclaim his glory to the nations, his mighty deeds to all peoples.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Lari nyɛla jɛrilim, ka nyaɣisim bɔbu mi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I discovered that laughter is foolish, that pleasure does you no good.

dag: Amaa yinim birigimi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ soli, ka yi wuhibu chɛ ka niriba pam tuui, yi saɣim n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛli maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, dama bɛ daa bɔrimi ni bɛ nya o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: Wanting to bring charges against Jesus, they were watching Jesus closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ayuba daa ti yaag o noli n-tu bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dabisi shɛli dali.
en: Then Job opened his mouth and cursed the day he was born.

dag: dama n sani, m bia ŋɔ daa kpimi ka lan neei na, o daa bɔrigimi ka n lan nya o yaha. Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai diɛma diɛmbu ni suhupiɛlli.
en: because this son of mine was dead and has come back to life! He was lost and is found! And they began to celebrate.

dag: N ni tɔɣis a dunia ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣa ka a bi niŋ li yɛda ŋɔ, ka n yi tɔɣis a alizanda ni yɛtɔɣa, wula ka a ni tooi niŋ li yɛda?.
en: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ti Duuma tɛha bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ o saawaralana?.
en: As the Scriptures say, Who can know what is on the Lords mind? Who is able to give him advice? Isaiah :.

dag: A yi chana, binshɛli ku gabi a naba, ka a yi guui, a ku tuui.
en: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.

dag: Ka maligumaana yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti so, ŋun maligumaana maa n-su o ni mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ.
en: The skin of an animal offered as a burnt offering belongs to the priest who offers the sacrifice.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Chɛli di zaa ha ka chaŋ, dama o nyɛla n ni pii so ni o zaŋ n yuli wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini nazuɣuri ni Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord replied, Go! This man is the agent I have chosen to carry my name before Gentiles, kings, and Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Nyama, n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ŋunkam ti wum li tiba puuni ni chahira.
en: The Lord said: Samuel, I am going to do something in Israel that will shock everyone who hears about it!.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma: Siria na so ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka soli ni o di nam maa, amaa o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu fa nam maa di n-libigi ba.
en: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, bɛ nyɛla bɛn chani kpɛri yiya ni n-saɣindi bɛ dahima; ka di pala di kɔŋko, bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn leei niriba nyaanzuriba mini bɛn dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-yɛri din bi simdi ni bɛ yɛli.
en: They also learn to waste their time in going around from house to house; but even worse, they learn to be gossips and busybodies, talking of things they should not.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba! Di yi pa lala, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna nti zaŋ n nol ni takɔb la tuhi bɛn niŋdi lala maa tɔbu.
en: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni tum alahichi shɛŋa min o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu ka o yɛn chɛ Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: Because of the sins Jeroboam committed, and because he made Israel sin too, God will give Israel up.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba n-daa kul pali duu maa ni, ka Filistianim nanim zaa gba be nimaani. Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn kalinli daa nyɛ kaman tusaata daa be duu maa dufahirili zuɣusaa lihiri Samsin ni diɛmdi maa.
en: Now the temple was filled with men and women. All the rulers of the Philistines were there, and about three thousand more men and women were on the roof watching as Samson performed.

dag: Ka o ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba, ka to n-wurim ba kaman yaɣiri duɣiri ni ŋmari n-wurisiri shɛm la, ka o yiko maa ni be kaman mmaŋmaŋ gba ni daa deei yiko shɛli m Ba Naawuni san la;.
en: They will rule the nations with an iron rod. They will break them to pieces like clay pots.

dag: Rubin daa yɛli ba, Di yihiya o ʒim, zaŋmiy o niŋ bɔɣili ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka di niŋy o shɛli. O daa yɛlila lala ni o fa o bɛ nuu ni bahi n-zaŋ o kulisi ti ti bɛ ba.
en: Just throw him into this well in the wilderness, but don't hurt him. He said this, planning to save him from them and send him back to his father.

dag: Wuntizɔriba alibarika duhirila tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri noli ni yɛtɔɣa wurindila tiŋa.
en: A city is honored by the blessing of the virtuous; it is destroyed by the words of the wicked.

dag: Ka na so bee zuliya shɛb yi lo ni bɛ yiɣisi zaligu ŋɔ ka saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa, ŋun Naawuni ŋun pii nimaani n-leeg o jɛmbu shee ŋɔ ŋun vuum ba bahi. Man Naa Darius n-zali zaligu ŋɔ. Ka di kpa talahi ni sokam dol li.
en: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold border around it.

dag: Ashidɔdnim ni daa nya di ni be shɛm maa ka bɛ yɛli, Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ku lan be ti sani, dama o darigi ti tibili n-tabili ti buɣili Dagɔn.
en: When Ashdods inhabitants saw what was happening, they said, The chest of Israels God must not stay here with us because his hand is hard against us and against our god Dagon.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a jɛmbu duu n-kul yiini yila paɣir a sahakam mal alibarika.
en: Those who live in your house are truly happy; they praise you constantly. Selah.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛhɔadin.
en: at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kul ka fahim?.
en: Jesus said, Dont you understand yet?.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tihi wali, ka yi puri ni bindira niŋ pam din ni chɛ ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu ka yi di vi zuliya shɛb sani.
en: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yaa, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa. Di yi nyɛla din tuhi dolibu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tah o ʒiishee?.
en: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Paɣa, a yɛda galisiya pam! Di ni niŋ kaman a ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka o bipuɣiŋga maa daa dii kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: So Jesus answered her, You are a woman of great faith! What you want will be done for you. And at that very moment her daughter was healed.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, Ka chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ shɛb kpalim pah a zuɣu. Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, lala bi kpa, n kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka a suhu m-maai ni mani.
en: Esau replied, Let me leave some of my men with you. You don't have to do that, Jacob answered. I am happy, simply knowing that you are friendly to me.

dag: Yɛm be Yawɛ sizuura lubu ni. Yawɛ kukoli tahiri yɛri tiŋ maa: Wummiya, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn laɣim be tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: I am the Lord , and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:.

dag: Yawɛ, n nya wahala pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la.
en: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord , as you have promised.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ku tooi niŋ lala ka pa ni piɛri maa zaa laɣimmina pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli, ka ti ŋɔŋ kom maa ti ba.
en: But they replied, We can't do that until they all get here, and the rock has been rolled away from the well.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Kiriatijiarim maa yuui pam. Di daa niŋ la yuun pisi nimaani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa kul ye Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: The Box stayed there at Kiriath Jearim for a long time. Twenty years passed while the Holy Box was in Kiriath Jearim, and the Israelites began to follow the Lord again.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan gbaai chandi n-kana ti ti o suɣa zali Ɛda pii tooni.
en: Then Israel continued his journey. He camped just south of Eder tower.

dag: O daa chaŋ nti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni o mini bɛn daa be o sani ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la.
en: He went into the house of God, and he and his men ate the bread offered to God, even though it was against the Law for them to eat it—only the priests were allowed to eat that bread.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gari nimaani n-lan gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ ti yɛn lu ka bɛ paai Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: So they passed by Jebus and continued on their way. It was sunset when they came to Gibeah in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi ni kpiimba be nimaani, ka o saamba be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Her victims do not know that the people die who go to her house, that those who have already entered are now deep in the world of the dead.

dag: Siɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan.
en: Seirs family: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

dag: Ka Atai daa nyɛ Neetan ba, ka Neetan mi daa nyɛ Zabad ba.
en: The family line from Attai to Elishama is as follows: Attai, Nathan, Zabad.

dag: Yi lan pihiri nimaani nyolinsi n-leeri buɣa jɛmdi li; ka boori binyɛra mini zimbuli bahiri di zuɣu. Yi tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ni chɛ ka n suhu piɛla?.
en: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Naa Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn maa, ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa.
en: So all the leaders of Israel came to King David at Hebron. He made a sacred alliance with them, they anointed him, and he became king of Israel.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya bɛn nuhi gbarigi la mini bɛn duna gbarigi la.
en: Make the weak arms strong again. Strengthen the weak knees.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ yɔhim bɛmaŋa n-niŋ din ka buchi naani, dama din ka buchi maa n-ni ti nyɛ bɛ sanyoo.
en: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din kpaŋsi ti suhuri. Ka din pahi timaŋmaŋ suhukpaŋsibo ŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli pam Taitus suhupiɛlli nyabu la zuɣu, dama o tɛha dɔniya yi zaa zuɣu.
en: That is why we were encouraged. Not only were we encouraged; how happy Titus made us with his happiness over the way in which all of you helped to cheer him up!.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o wuhibu maa gari ba pam.
en: When the people heard this, they were amazed at Jesus teaching.

dag: Absalom daa lan yɛli; Mani n-yi di nyɛ sariakarita Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ŋunkam yi di zaŋ o kpee tahi n sanna bee n-zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam na, n naan kari saria maa dɛde n-ti o nasara.
en: Absalom would also say, Oh, I wish someone would make me a judge in this country! Then I could help everyone who comes to me with a problem. I would help them get a fair solution to their problem.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab mini Abishai bɛn daa kari doli Abinɛr, zaŋ chaŋ wuntan luhili saha ka bɛ daa paai Amma Zoli din be Gia polo Gibiɔn mɔɣu ni soli zuɣu la gbini.
en: But Joab and Abishai started out after Abner, and at sunset they came to the hill of Ammah, which is to the east of Giah on the road to the wilderness of Gibeon.

dag: Maligumaana so ŋun leei kpɛma o tab sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni mal o kasi n-wolig o zali ni o yɛri maligumaana binyɛra miri ka o chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim bee n-dari chɛh o binyɛra.
en: The High Priest has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been consecrated to wear the priestly garments, so he must not leave his hair uncombed or tear his clothes to show that he is in mourning.

dag: ka Oholibama mi dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-bala.
en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. All these sons were born to Esau in the land of Canaan.

dag: zaawuni yuŋ lihaliha saha ni yuŋ zibisim saha.
en: in the early evening, at the onset of night and darkness.

dag: ka Ahimaaz nyɛ Azaria ba, ka Azaria nyɛ Jɔhanan ba.
en: Ahimaaz of Azariah, Azariah of Johanan.

dag: ka yipa zaŋla biɛr palli kpɛhi yi ni, Dina n-nyɛ: Biɛr pal shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ di namda la ni zaŋd omaŋmaŋ ŋmahinli n-kul lɛbigiri li zaɣ palli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ŋun Naawuni la.
en: Now you are wearing a new life, a life that is new every day. You are growing in your understanding of the one who made you. You are becoming more and more like him.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka zooi pam ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anakinim la. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa ku ba ka chɛ ka Ammɔnnim maa deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani.
en: The Zamzummim were a large and powerful tribe and were as tall as the Anakim. But the Lord helped the Ammonites, and they killed many of the Zamzummim and forced the rest to leave. Then the Ammonites settled there.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, O be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, M bi mi.
en: Where is he now? they asked. I don't know, he answered.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Benya o naba ni jɛmm o. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa yɛli biasan la, Nyama, Mam mini m ba sa dɔniya yuŋ la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lan niŋ wain maa ti o yuŋ ŋɔ, ka a gba kpe o sani ka a min o ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, Since I lay down with our father last night, lets serve him wine tonight too, and you go in and lie down with him so that we will both have children from our father.

dag: Di saha ka naazɔnim bɛn daa kul be o san la yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka bɛ vihi nya paɣisara bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛl viɛla na ti ti a.
en: Then the kings personal servants had a suggestion. They said, Search for beautiful young virgins for the king.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa laɣim Musa sanna ka o ti zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o zaligu shɛŋa yɛla Sinai Zoli zuɣu maa ti ba.
en: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

dag: ka di chɛ ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin shɛŋa din be yi tooni la ha, ka di chɛ ka ti ku nyu bara ninvuɣ shɛb ni pun tum shɛm luɣ shɛŋa polo la zuɣu.
en: We hope that our work grows even to the point of the gospel being preached in places beyond Corinth, without bragging about what has already been done in another persons work area.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Alɔbo zaɣ yini n-kpalim ka n yɛn chɛ ka di lu Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, o ni kari ya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, I will send only one more punishment on the king of Egypt and his people. After that he will let you leave. In fact, he will drive all of you out of here.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa teei Reechɛl yɛla n wum o fabila ka yoog o dɔɣim soli ti o.
en: Finally, God remembered Rachel—he answered her prayer by giving her a son. God has taken away my disgrace, she said.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ni yɛli shɛm ka n wum maa, n ni niŋ ya lala.
en: Now give them this answer: I swear that as surely as I live, I will do to you just what you have asked. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannima ayi maa mini kpambaliba la daa naai noli chaŋ naa sani nti yɛl o, Naa Darius, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili.
en: So the two supervisors and the satraps went as a group to the king. They said, King Darius, live forever!.

dag: ni Nɔha ŋun daa pah anahi ni Rafa ŋun daa pah anu la.
en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

dag: Ka o daa lan saɣim Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni la ni di chɛ ka so ku lan zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga m-mali buɣili Molɛk.
en: Josiah defiled the Topheth in the Ben-hinnom Valley so no one could burn their child alive in honor of the god Molech.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtishɛmɛshinim maa daa yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tooni? Ka o yi yi ti sani, banim sani ka o lee yɛn chaŋ.
en: The people of Beth-shemesh said, Who can stand before the LORD, this holy God? Where can he go that is away from us here.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, deem n suhigu. Yaakubu Naawuni, gbilisim tibili wum!.
en: Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty. Listen, O God of Jacob!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, tiŋgban ni ti fabili, ka zuɣusaa ti zibigi. Mani n-yɛli lala, m mi pun lola di nia. N ku chɛ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli bee n-labi nyaaŋa.
en: So the people in the land will cry for the dead. The sky will grow dark. I have spoken and will not change. I have made a decision, and I will not change my mind.

dag: Amaa n wuhiri n yurilim ni galisi shɛm niriba tusatusa bɛn yuri ma ka doli n zaligunim sani.
en: But I show my love to thousands of generations of those who love me and obey my laws.

dag: Ka salo pam dii laɣimna hal ka palichee ti lan ka yili maa ni, ka so daa naan ku tooi lan miri dunol ni gba, ka Yisa yihiri ba waazu.
en: So many people came together that there was no room left, not even out in front of the door. Jesus was preaching the message to them.

dag: Kulla niriba biɛla n-daa yi Asha zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni n-siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa Anabi Musa n-daa tin ya bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa; amaa m Ba n-tiri ya bindiri maŋli din yiri alizanda ni na maa.
en: Jesus told them, I assure you, it wasnt Moses who gave the bread from heaven to you, but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, O yi di pala ŋun tum taali, ti naan ku tah o a sanna.
en: They answered, He is a bad man. That is why we brought him to you.

dag: Bɛna bɛn zaa nyɛ n niriba maa, mani n-daa nam ba n jilima zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛba.
en: Bring to me all the people who are mine—the people who have my name. I made them for myself. I made them, and they are mine.

dag: Adɔnikam daŋ — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: the descendants of Adonikam:.

dag: Ka di tintariga daa ŋmaligi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtidagɔn m-mali hal ti paai Zɛbulɔn mini Ifitahɛl Vinvamli din be Bɛtimɛk mini Nɛyɛl soli nuzaa polo la, ka kul zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo maa hal ti paai Kabul.
en: The border reversed eastward to Beth-dagon. It touched Zebulun and the Iphtah-el Valley on the north, also Beth-emek and Neiel. It went to Cabul on the north.

dag: ka o daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm di puuni nti nya bɛ ni niŋdi vi binshɛŋa din chihiri shɛm kpe.
en: Go in, God said, and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.

dag: Piligu ni, Naawuni daa namla zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: In the beginning, when God created the universe.

dag: Ifriimnima, wula ka n ni tooi zaɣisi ya? Izraɛlnima, wula ka n ni tooi chɛn ya bahi? Wula ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Adimanim shɛm la? Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Zɛbɔiimnim shɛm la? N suhu taɣiya, ka n nambɔzɔbo galisi.
en: How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart winces within me; my compassion grows warm and tender.

dag: N daa laɣisi anzinfa mini salima ni nanim azichi na ti puli, ka su tiŋgbana. N daa mali baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka daa mali mamanim pam n-di niŋgbuŋ nyaɣisim.
en: I also gathered silver and gold for myself. I took treasures from kings and their nations. I had men and women singing for me. I had everything any man could want.

dag: Yi yi tuɣi ma ka n yɛligu be yi suhuri ni, ka yi suhi yi ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa, yi ni nya li.
en: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhiri ni o ni niŋ o ni lo alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: This is the sign from the Lord to show you that he will do what he says:.

dag: Chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zali di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒi luɣ shɛŋa mini bɛ yaannim dunoya tuutanim ni sa luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suɣa maa noya kpa laɣiŋgu suɣili maa luɣilikam polo.
en: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti mini Pool chaŋ ti puhi Jeemsi, ka cheechi kpamba la zaa gba daa be o sani.
en: Paul went with us to see James the next day, and all the church leaders were present.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni a ni leei naa, ka Izraɛl nam ti nya zaashee zani a kɔbili ni.
en: Now even I know that you will definitely become king, and Israels kingdom will flourish in your hands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla ka o lan tim tuun shɛba, ka bɛ gba ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Ka Sool daa lan tim tuun shɛb yaha m-pahi buta, ka bɛ gba daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Saul heard of this, he sent more messengers, and they also began to dance and shout. He sent messengers the third time, and the same thing happened to them.

dag: Niŋmiya lala pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara zuɣu n-zaŋ di mini di binnyura sara mali sara. Di bi simdi ni bɛ mali dansi.
en: You must give these offerings in addition to the daily burnt offerings and the grain offering you give with them. Be sure there is nothing wrong with the animals or the drink offerings that you give with them.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ zuɣuri chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi pɔbi bɛ noya.
en: princes restrained speech, put their hand on their mouth.

dag: Samsin daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisi shɛŋa puuni Filistianim ni daa su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: Samson was a judge for the Israelites for years during the time of the Philistines.

dag: Dama bɛ chaŋ Asiria kaman yɔɣuni buntaaŋa ŋun gɔr o ko la. I friimnim darila niriba ni bɛ sɔŋdi ba.
en: Ephraim went to his lovers. Like a stubborn donkey, they led him off to Assyria.

dag: Sool chandi maa dazɔhigu dali, Yawɛ daa pun daŋ kahigi wuhi Samuɛl yɛli.
en: The day before, the Lord had told Samuel.

dag: N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo n-wum ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama ti bi bɔri ni ti chɛ ka a ʒini yuui.
en: I don't want to bother you, but please be patient with us and listen to me for just a few minutes.

dag: Ka Hiburu nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a la sapashin kpɛm dabili daa be ti sani, ka ti yɛl o, ka o daa wuhi ti ti zaa yinoyino zahindi gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: A young Hebrew, who was a servant of the captain of the guard, was there with us at the time. When we told him our dreams, he explained what each of them meant.

dag: Ka Asirianim gba pahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka Lɔt zuliya nya yaa.
en: Even the Assyrians have joined them. They have made Lots descendants very powerful. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa bahi Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa noli yɛli Zaŋmi niriba ata kpe m-pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti yihi anabi Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ka o ku kpi.
en: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Cushite, Take thirty men from here and take Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni lab kuli nti lan laɣim tɔbbihi bɛn galisi gar o tuuli tɔbbihi la. Ka saha ti paai ka o zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam ka mali bidibbina n-lan labina.
en: The northern king will get another army that will be larger than the first one. After several years he will attack. His army will be ready for war. It will be very large and it will have many weapons.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mɛri tandi mi daa zaŋla takɔbi n-so o shee ni ka mɛra. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa piɛbiri kikaa gba daa kul baɣi ma.
en: Each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. The man who blew the trumpet to warn the people stayed next to me.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o di nyɛvili ŋɔ nyaɣisim ka nya dabisi suma, ŋun gbaam o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu, ka mi di chɛ ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa yir o nol ni na.
en: Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Judia n-ka Antiɔk na n-daa ti gbaai Yisa nyaandoliba wuhibu yɛri ni shee bɛ guniya kaman Anabi Musa ni daa zali shɛm la ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku tiligi.
en: Some people came down from Judea teaching the family of believers, Unless you are circumcised according to the custom weve received from Moses, you cant be saved.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya polo ka niriba maa lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ yila Babilɔn din nyɛ tin shɛli din be katiŋ la n-ka n sanna.
en: I asked Hezekiah, Where did these men come from? What did they want? They came all the way from Babylonia, Hezekiah answered.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o yɛli.
en: Her children say good things about her. Her husband brags about her and says.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni n-zaŋ bɛ naba siɣi di kom ni saha shɛli, .
en: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti taai duŋ niŋ Ijipti naa. Ka nyin Daniɛl zuliya ni ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb gba ni ti taai duŋ pahi ni di chɛ ka ʒii la ni yɛla la niŋ pali, amaa bɛ ni ti kɔŋ nasara.
en: In those times many people will be against the southern king. Some of your own people who love to fight will rebel against the southern king. They will not win, but they will make the vision come true.

dag: Ka tiŋgban bihi din zaa be teeku sunsuuni daa vuui, ka zoya zaa gba vuui;.
en: Every island disappeared and there were no more mountains.

dag: Ka yi ti kari doli yi dimnima n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: You will chase and destroy your enemies.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ naa nini daa galimi, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm niriba tuma yɛla teebu ni be yɛlikura litaafi shɛl ni la na, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li na.
en: That same night, the king could not sleep. So he told a servant to bring the history book and read it to him.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Then the disciples returned to the place where they were staying.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul ni su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka kul ni be di ni sahakam.
en: The righteous will possess the land; they will live on it forever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi li bahi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni la zuɣu m-mali di zaa.
en: Moses then took the anointing oil and anointed the dwelling and everything in it, making them holy by doing so.

dag: Lala ka n daa shiri niŋ Jɛrusalɛm. Maligumaaniba kpamba daa ti ma yiko, ka n gbahi Yisa nyaandoliba pam ti kpɛhi duu, amaa pa lala kɔŋko ka n daa niŋ. Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn ku bɛ ni shɛb la n gba daa ʒiɛla bɛn yɛn ku ba maa nyaaŋa.
en: That is what I did in Jerusalem. I received authority from the chief priests and put many of God's people in prison; and when they were sentenced to death, I also voted against them.

dag: Bɛ yɛrila Naawuni, Zom ka chɛ ti! Ti bi bɔri ni ti baŋ a soli.
en: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.

dag: Bɛn mali ba bemi kaman bɛ ni be shɛm. Lala n-nyɛ bɛnkam zaa niŋ wuna maa naani.
en: The people who make and trust in those statues will become like them!.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ zaa ni gbilisi tibili wum, ka taɣi bɛ biɛhigu din bi viɛl maa, ka n gba taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ n ni lo ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu la polo.
en: Maybe they will listen and obey my message. Maybe they will stop living such evil lives. If they change, I will change my mind about my plans to punish them. I am planning this punishment because of the many evil things they have done.

dag: dama n nini nya a tiliginsim shɛli.
en: With my own eyes I have seen your salvation.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o salo maa ni yi kpaŋa nti zaŋ o nubihi tim o tiba ni, ka tuhi nintɔri zaŋ shihi tikpiralan maa zilinli;.
en: Jesus led the man away from the people to be alone with him. He put his fingers in the mans ears. Then he spit on a finger and put it on the mans tongue.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n lee ni kuhi ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a ku wum? Bee ka n ni kuhi yɛl a Damli damiya! ka a ku tiligi ti?.
en: O Lord , how long must I call for help before you listen, before you save us from violence?.

dag: Ka Zara daa ti kpi Kiriatariba Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Ibrahimma daa kpe nti kum o kuli.
en: She died in the city of Kiriath Arba in the land of Canaan. Abraham was very sad and cried for her there.

dag: N dimnim kul karitimi doli ma. Bɛ loya ni bɛ di n nyɛvili. Bɛ chɛ ka n ʒila zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.

dag: Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, m bi mi n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛm, dama n na nyɛla bia.
en: I answered, Sovereign Lord , I don't know how to speak; I am too young.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli ba alɔbo shɛli yɛla la lu bɛ zuɣu, n ni tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu, ka m boli ba ka bɛ zaɣisi saɣibu la zuɣu. .
en: So now, I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, will bring on you people of Judah and of Jerusalem all the destruction that I promised. I will do this because you would not listen when I spoke to you, and you would not answer when I called you.

dag: N yaannim ni daa ku tiŋ shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa la, buɣ dini n-daa lee tooi fa di niriba n nuu ni, ka yinim Naawuni ni ti tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni?.
en: Which one of any of the gods of these nations that my predecessors destroyed was able to rescue them from my power? So why should your god be able to rescue you from my power?.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei paɣ shɛb niriba bɛn daa kpi kum ni ti ba. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaɣisi yolisim shɛli din nyɛ daadamnim dini, ka nya azaaba hal ti kpi di puuni ni bɛ ti neei kum ni m-mali nyɛvili din so.
en: There were women who lost loved ones but got them back when they were raised from death. Others were tortured but refused to accept their freedom. They did this so that they could be raised from death to a better life.

dag: A zaŋ ma bahila bɔɣ zilinli ni, luɣ shɛli din zibisi ka zilima.
en: You put me in that hole in the ground. Yes, you put me in that dark place.

dag: ka bɛn kpalim mi gbahi naa maa yiŋbihi maa n-dihi ba vi, ka ku ba.
en: Some of the other people grabbed the servants, beat them, and killed them.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o dabili Izraɛl zuliya, ka lan nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ!.
en: You belong to the family of Israel, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.

dag: dindina n ni pa n nina lihiri doo maa min o yiŋnima, ka ku o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol o jɛmdi Molɛk maa.
en: I will set my own face against such a person and their extended family, cutting off from their people both the guilty party and anyone with them who faithlessly followed Molech.

dag: A yi yɛn deei nir binshɛli sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o binshɛlikam, nyin di dol o kpe o yiŋ puuni ti deei li.
en: When you make any type of loan to your neighbor, dont enter their house to receive the collateral.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, litaafi shɛli n ni daa tuui sab la wuhirila Yisa ni daa piligi wuhiri niriba ka tumdi shɛm.
en: Dear Theophilus, The first book I wrote was about everything Jesus did and taught from the beginning.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa, ka a wuntia zaligunim zaa nyɛla din kul ni be sahakam.
en: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.

dag: A nini yi nya shɛli, nyin di bo yomyom zaŋ li tahi kootu ni, dama a kpee yi ti dih a vi, di nyaaŋa wula ka a yɛn niŋ?.
en: Don't be too quick to go to court about something you have seen. If another witness later proves you wrong, what will you do then?.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaanu laasabu chaŋ ti dɔni Ai wulinluhili polo luɣ shɛli din be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: Then Joshua chose about men. He sent these men to hide in the area west of the city, between Bethel and Ai.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o, o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.

dag: Pa dahin yini ka yi yɛn ŋub li bee daba ayi bee daba anu bee biɛɣu pia bee biɛɣ pisi.
en: You will eat it for more than one, or two, or five, or ten, or even twenty days!.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Ka dindina zaŋmiy o chaŋ ti doli yimaŋmaŋ zaligu soli kar o saria. Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti ka soli ni ti ku nira.
en: Pilate said to them, Then you yourselves take him and try him according to your own law. They replied, We are not allowed to put anyone to death. .

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be bɛnkam zaa yuri ti Duuma Yisa Masia yurilim shɛli din ku naai la ni!.
en: May God's grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with undying love.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa ni leei saɣiri maa zuɣu, n ni laɣim ya sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ sunsuuni.
en: So now I, the Sovereign Lord , am telling them that they are just as useless as that. I will bring them all together in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Bɔzuɣu ka bidibiga ku di wahala o ba tuumbiɛri zuɣu? Bidibiga maa yi nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, ka nyɛ ŋun doli n zaligunim zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: You will say, Why doesnt the child bear his parents guilt? The child has acted justly and responsibly. The child kept all my regulations and observed them. The child will surely live.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi yɛli, Alaafee. N dana n-tim ma na ni nti yɛl a ni nachimbih ayi bɛn nyɛ anabinima n-yi Ifriim zoya tiŋ ni kana; ni o suhir a ni a ti ba anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra na.
en: Yes, Gehazi answered. But my master has sent me to tell you about two young prophets from the hills of Ephraim. They came asking for help, and now Elisha wants to know if you would give them , pieces of silver and some new clothes.

dag: Ka din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibu kam chɛ ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: As for the seed that fell among thorny plants, these are the ones who, as they go about their lives, are choked by the concerns, riches, and pleasures of life, and their fruit never matures.

dag: Nyama, n ni dihi ya sɔŋ tiŋa yi biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni vari kabɔba m-marigiri taba tɔroko lɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: You have become more than I can bear. I am bent low like a wagon loaded with grain.

dag: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ muni la di pun ka buchi, bɛ ni ti yɛri ni buɣim di li ka di niŋ sala? Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li niŋ binshɛli yaha.
en: The wood is useless before it is burned, and afterwards, it is completely worthless.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti lan lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Dauda daa pah o tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti tuhi hal ka di ti gbarigi Dauda.
en: Once again war broke out between the Philistines and Israel. David and the soldiers who were with him went down and fought the Philistines. When David grew tired.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka bɛ bahi ba ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: Early in the morning the brothers were sent on their way with their donkeys.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma ni deei bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa maa. Naawuni ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa bahi teeku ni, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim ka di di n-lu n-dahim.
en: But the Lord will take it all. He will destroy her powerful navy and that city will be destroyed by fire!.

dag: Di lan sabi: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, maliya suhupiɛlli pah o niriba zuɣu.
en: And the Scriptures say, You people of other nations should be happy together with Gods people. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ti lan labina pahi buyi nti shih o ka yɛli, Yiɣisim di ka nyu, di yi pa lala a chandi maa ni ti nyaŋ a.
en: The LORDs messenger returned a second time and tapped him. Get up! the messenger said. Eat something, because you have a difficult road ahead of you.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala ni kom mini Naawuni Shia, di yi pa lala o ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Jesus answered, I assure you, unless someone is born of water and the Spirit, its not possible to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba daa lan tuhi deei Gaza ni di tintarisi mini Ashikɛlɔn ni di tintarisi ni Ɛkurɔn ni di gba tintarisi.
en: The men of Judah also captured the cities of Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron and all the small towns around them.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli kul ni beni sahakam. Yawɛ, a niriba kul ni mi a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Lord , you will always be proclaimed as God; all generations will remember you.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yuŋ ŋɔ yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, During this very night, all of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say, I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.

dag: Yawɛ n-nam tibili din wumda mini nini din nyari ŋɔ zaa.
en: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: So in anger I swore: They will never enter my place of rest.

dag: Ka n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni zuɣu chɛ ka ti mabihi pam niŋ ti Duuma naani, naɣ kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni niriba biɛla. Ka bɛn niŋ naani maa kul mali suhukpeeni sahakam ka yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu ka dabiɛm zɔbu kani.
en: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.

dag: Yiɣisim doli tiŋgbɔŋ maa wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ nya, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: Now walk back and forth across the land, because I am going to give it to you.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Naa Sool, A tum jɛrilim tuma. Dama a bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛli. Pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ naan chɛ ka a min a zuliya diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: That was a foolish thing to do, Samuel answered. You have not obeyed the command the Lord your God gave you. If you had obeyed, he would have let you and your descendants rule over Israel forever.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya nam ʒiishe titali din nyɛ zaɣ piɛlli ka lan nya ŋun ʒi nimaani, ka tiŋgbani mini sagbana daa laligi ka chɛ o, ka so bi lan nya li yaha.
en: Then I saw a great white throne and the one who sits on it. Earth and heaven fled from his presence and were seen no more.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ba gbilligbilli n-zaŋ ba niŋ o tumtumdiba nuu ni, ka bɛ taɣiri ba gbilligbilli dol taba ka o yɛli ba, Garimiya n tooni chani ka chɛ ka larigim be yi sunsuuni.
en: He gave each flock of animals to his servants. Then he said to them, Separate each group of animals. Go ahead of me and keep some space between each herd.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim a la ni zo, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn me a kana ti me a zali.
en: Your builders come quickly; those who destroy and demolish you will depart from you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be anabi shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu, ka bi nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo bahi yoli din ka bahigu puuni; ka bɛ mini ti Duuma ni o yiko din mali jilima la ni ti woligi taba.
en: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.

dag: ni Nɔga ni Nɛfɛg ni Jafia.
en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi yɛli shɛli, biɛhiŋ kani, n niriba ŋɔ naan kari doli bɛ mabihi maa hal ni biɛɣuni asiba.
en: I swear by the living God, Joab answered, that if you had not spoken, my men would have kept on chasing you until tomorrow morning.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la, ka so ku lan nya ba. Bɛ ni kari ba kaman yuŋ ʒii la.
en: They will vanish like a dream, like a vision at night, and never be seen again.

dag: Ka nachimba daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli niŋ o n-zaŋ o yi nti sɔɣi.
en: The young men came in, wrapped up his body, carried him out, and buried him.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ kpam chim li mahilaa ni zaɣ bihi, ka a gar li viɛnyɛliŋga n-zaŋ li mali sara shɛli din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Ahazia daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi nira saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa; o daa di nam la maa yuun yini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Izraɛl Naa Omri yaaŋa, ka o yuli booni Atalia.
en: Ahaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled from Jerusalem for only one year. His mother was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri of Israel.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lura, nyin zaŋmi li labisi ti ti o, ka o zaŋ o chinchini maa pili gbihi ka paɣ a, ka di ti a laara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Instead, be certain to give the pawned coat back by sunset so they can sleep in their own coat. They will bless you, and you will be considered righteous before the LORD your God.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a mini bɛn vari ma la va; ka chɛ ka a mini bɛn tuhiri ma la tuhi!.
en: Lord , oppose those who oppose me. Fight those who fight me.

dag: Yinim Aduna zuliya, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Trust in the LORD, house of Aaron! God is their help and shield.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa tum tuun shɛli zaa pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Uzziah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni chɛ ka bɛ teei yi tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka yi biriginsim yi palo, ka yi daalahichi yi palo yi tuuni kam puuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ teei yi yɛla la zuɣu, bɛ ni gbahi ya bɛ nuhi ni.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: You have done many evil things. Your sins are very clear. You forced me to remember that you are guilty, so the enemy will catch you in his hand.

dag: Luk ŋun nyɛ dɔɣite so ti ni yuri la mini Diimas gba puhiri ya.
en: Greetings also from Demas and our dear friend Luke, the doctor.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilaa maa zuɣu; ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram.

dag: O bihi n-daa lan nyɛ: Maika mini Reeya ni Baal.
en: Micah was Shimeis son. Reaiah was Micahs son. Baal was Reaiahs son.

dag: Isaka bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tola mini Pua ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi.
en: Issachar had four sons. Their names were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.

dag: Man ŋuna, Naawuni ka n yɛn jɛmda, ka zaŋ n yɛla niŋ Naawuni nuu ni.
en: If I were you, I would turn to God and tell him about my problems.

dag: N ni teegi n nuu n-tum alahiziba tuma n-darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili, di nyaaŋa ka o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ.
en: so I will use my great power against Egypt. I will cause amazing things to happen in that land. After I do this, he will let you go.

dag: Uzi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Izirahia, ka Izirahia bidibisi daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Obadia ni Joɛl ni Ishia, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu; bɛ zaa daa nyɛla zuɣulaannima.
en: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila bɛ suhuri ni, Ti kul ku vuui; ʒiɛmani kam puuni muɣisigu shɛli ku paai ti.
en: They say to themselves, We will never fail; we will never be in trouble.

dag: amaa di yi yila Naawuni sanna, dindina yi ku tooi nyaŋ ba; hal yi yi dol li gba, di pa shɛli yi ni ti nya ka di nyɛla Naawuni ka yi tuhiri maa. Ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa.
en: If it originates with God, you wont be able to stop them. Instead, you would actually find yourselves fighting God! The council was convinced by his reasoning.

dag: O tahiri teeku zuɣu, ka di kom nyuura. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka mɔɣa kom nyuura; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl tihi vari suura, ka Lɛbanɔn tipuma suura.
en: He will speak harshly to the sea, and it will become dry. He will dry up all the rivers. The rich lands of Bashan and Carmel become dry and dead. The flowers in Lebanon fade away.

dag: Yuun pisi zaa ka m be a yiŋa. N tum tuma ti a la yuun pinaanahi a bipuɣins ayi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka gul a biŋkɔbiri mi yuma ayɔbu; ka a taɣi n yɔri siɣimsiɣim bupia.
