en: I had to work of these long years to earn your two daughters and another years to buy your sheep and goats. During that time you kept changing my wages.

dag: Nyama, yinim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, zahimmiya yɛlli maa nya ka wuhi ti ni yɛn gbaai li shɛm.
en: All you Israelites, say what you think should be done here and now.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a yɛla gari niriba. Ka a yɛla ti gbaai bɛ nanim dabiɛm pam, ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. N yi ti ŋooi n takɔbi bɛ tooni, bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam niŋgbuna kul yɛn sɔhirimi sahakam bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu a lubu maa dali. .
en: What I do to you will shock many nations. When I swing my sword, kings will shudder with fright. On the day you fall, all of them will tremble in fear for their own lives.

dag: Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli, N nɔrila zuliya kam niriba kaman wain tiwala la, ka so bi sɔŋ ma. Ka n daa no ba ni suli mini suhuyiɣisili, ka bɛ ʒim varim m binyɛrigu ka di gabisi zaa.
en: The Lord answers, I have trampled the nations like grapes, and no one came to help me. I trampled them in my anger, and their blood has stained all my clothing.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Nahɔr daa kpuɣi paɣiba. Ibram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Zarai, ka Nahɔr mi paɣ yuli booni Milika. Milika mini Isika ba n-daa nyɛ Haran.
en: Abram and Nahor both married. Abrams wife was named Sarai. Nahors wife was named Milcah. Milcah was the daughter of Haran. Haran was the father of Milcah and Iscah.

dag: Ka paɣ yi po pɔri ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o yidan yiŋa.
en: If a woman makes a solemn promise in her husbands household or makes a binding obligation for herself with a solemn pledge.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi daa nyɛla: Adda mini Gɛra ni Abihud.
en: Bela had a family: Addar, Gera, Abihud.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛl o, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: Daniel answered, Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm Naa Dauda bia ŋun nyɛ karimba la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the words of the Philosopher, David's son, who was king in Jerusalem.

dag: ka din pahi pinaata daa gbaai Shubaɛl min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Thirteenth, there were men chosen from Shubaels sons and relatives.

dag: Binnamda zaa kul guhirimi ka bɛ suhuri kul ye saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn yih o bihi palɔni la zuɣu;.
en: Everything that God made is waiting with excitement for the time when he will show the world who his children are. The whole world wants very much for that to happen.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka a nini nya a yaansi. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: And may you see your grandchildren. Peace be on Israel!.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama m bela muɣisigu ni. N kummi hal ka n nina ti biɛra, ka n niŋgbuŋ gba gbarigi.
en: Be merciful to me, Lord , for I am in trouble; my eyes are tired from so much crying; I am completely worn out.

dag: Ka n ŋubirila naɣilahi nimdi bee n nyurila buhi ʒim?.
en: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.

dag: Nyama, m min a zaa nyɛla yim Naawuni sani. Taŋkpaɣu ka o daa zaŋ nam man gba.
en: Notice that Im just like you to God; I also was pinched from clay.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi dimnim ti nyaŋ ya, ka sun ya. Ka yi ti guura ka so bi kariti ya.
en: I will be against you, so your enemies will defeat you. These enemies will hate you and rule over you. You will run away even when no one is chasing you.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka bimmɔrim biɛri mɔri yi duna mini yi biɛhi, ka yi ku tooi tibi li. Di ni ti zaŋ yi napɔnvari ni hal ni yi zuɣutalisi ni.
en: The Lord will punish you with sore boils that cannot be healed. These boils will be on your knees and legs. The boils will be on every part of your body—from the bottom of your feet to the top of your head.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm niŋ pali ti bebu puuni; dama ti nyɛla bɛn bi lan doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu, amaa ka naɣ dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ti shɛm.
en: God did this so that the righteous demands of the Law might be fully satisfied in us who live according to the Spirit, and not according to human nature.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wulimpuhili polo tintariga daa kpuɣi chaŋ. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini maa, ka tintarisi ŋɔ zaa daa gili niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The Jordan River was the eastern border. So this was the land that was given to the tribe of Benjamin. These were the borders on all sides.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis di nachiinsi pam, ka bɛ mini sapashinnim mini tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ ti kpe bɛ laɣiŋgu duu. Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ Pool na.
en: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came with great fanfare. They entered the auditorium with the military commanders and the citys most prominent men. Festus then ordered that Paul be brought in.

dag: Aduna yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisinaata saha shɛl o ni daa kpi Hɔr Zoli zuɣu maa.
en: He was years old at the time.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ maa, ka bɛ tiŋsi lab nyaaŋa ti lu tiŋa.
en: When Jesus said to them, I am he, they moved back and fell to the ground.

dag: Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni?.
en: But we cannot sing the Lord s songs in a foreign country!.

dag: O ni daa di nam Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, o daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi nira. O daa dila nam maa n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma anii.
en: Jehoram was years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem.

dag: A tiŋguliba ŋmanila sakɔri, ka a zaligubaŋdiba ŋmani toli bɛn galisi ni yi tabili gariche di ni maha pam dahin shɛli, ka wuntaŋ ti nyee, ka bɛ yiɣi chaŋ, ka so bi mi bɛ ni chaŋ luɣ shɛl la.
en: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.

dag: Nimaani ka Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ o kpari maa. Zɛdɛkia daa bɔh o mi, Bɔzuɣu ka a tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-deei li.
en: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord , and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla Yɛhudianim kɔŋko Naawuni? Bee o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni? Iin, o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni.
en: Or is God the God of the Jews only? Is he not the God of the Gentiles also? Of course he is.

dag: amaa m mi ni hal a yi suhi shɛlikam Naawuni sani pumpɔŋɔ, o ni ti a li.
en: Yet even now I know that God will do anything you ask.

dag: Ka Bɔaz garigi yɛl o, M pun wum a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti a yidan ma a yidan maa kum nyaaŋa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ yɛla. N lan mi a ni chɛ a ba min a ma ni a maŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ, ka kana ni a ti be a ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb sani shɛm yɛla.
en: Boaz answered, I've heard how you've helped your mother-in-law ever since your husband died. You even left your own father and mother to come and live in a foreign land among people you don't know.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo, bɛ daa piila Bɛza din be Rubin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la mini Ramɔt din be Giliad Gaad zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la ni Golan din be Bashan Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: The Israelites had already decided on the following three towns east of the Jordan River: Bezer in the desert flatlands of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, which was a town that belonged to Gad, and Golan in Bashan, which belonged to Manasseh.

dag: Amaa yinim bi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu ni wuhiri ya shɛm, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi shiri be yi ni, yi ni dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Masia Shia, o pala Masia ni su so.
en: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm pam la dali naanyi kana.
en: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi la ni.
en: Manasseh built altars for all the stars in the sky in both courtyards of the LORDs temple.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, bimmɔriŋ piɛlli yi be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu din chɛ ka nimaani kɔbiri leei zaɣ piɛla ka mari na be bimmɔriŋ maa ni.
en: If the priest sees that there is a white swelling on the skin, it has turned the hair white, and there is a patch of raw flesh in the swelling.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda, Nyini n-nyɛ lala nir maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa piig a leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka daa fa a Sool nuu ni bahi.
en: Then Nathan told David: You are that rich man! Now listen to what the Lord God of Israel says to you: I chose you to be the king of Israel. I kept you safe from Saul.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi ti chɛ ka n sariakaribo yɛlibiɛri anahi lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu, di ku viɛla, dina n-nyɛ takɔbi mini fifali ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni alɔbo din yɛn kuri ninsalinima mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni la.
en: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi Jona bahi teeku maa ni, ka teeku maa daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: Then they picked Jonah up and threw him into the sea, and it calmed down at once.

dag: Miri ka a va n-zani naa tooni bee n-zani wɔɣira zaashee.
en: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.

dag: n-zaŋ li yɛrigi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni daa yuri binshɛŋa ka tumdi di tuma, ka dol li, ka jɛmdi li la, ka so ti ku lan va bɛ kɔba maa bee n-zaŋ li pi. Di ti kul yɛn dola tiŋgban ni kaman naɣibindi la.
en: Instead of being gathered and buried, their bones will be like manure lying on the ground. They will be spread out before the sun, the moon, and the stars, which these people have loved and served, and which they have consulted and worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli: Yawɛ, a yɛliya ni a ni bela zibisim tital ni.
en: Then Solomon prayed: You, Lord , have placed the sun in the sky, yet you have chosen to live in clouds and darkness.

dag: Gɔhi mini zana m-be ninvuɣ biɛri sol zuɣu; yɛnnim bɛn ni laligi ka chɛ li.
en: Crooks walk down a road full of thorny traps. Stay away from there!.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai tin shɛli ka bɛ bi deei ya, yi yi ti yɛn yi di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi tiŋ maa nim zuɣu, ka di niŋ shɛhira biɛɣu jɛndi ba.
en: If people won't welcome you, leave the town and shake the dust from your feet as a warning to them.

dag: A tiri ba faako wahala nyabu saha hal ka bɛ ti gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: giving them relief from troubling times until a pit is dug for the wicked.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni, yi yi ti ʒini di ni ka be di ni.
en: You are about to cross the Jordan River and occupy the land that the Lord your God is giving you. When you take it and settle there.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni ku o bee o kum dali yi paai, o ni kpi bee ŋun chaŋ tɔb ni ka bɛ ti ku o.
en: By the living Lord , David continued, I know that the Lord himself will kill Saul, either when his time comes to die a natural death or when he dies in battle.

dag: ka Hilikia nyɛ Shallum bia, ka Shallum nyɛ Zadok bia, ka Zadok nyɛ Ahitub bia.
en: son of Shallum son of Zadok son of Ahitub.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra. Ijipti yɛnnim nyɛla jɛra bɛn wuhi niriba din bi viɛla. Bɛ ku tooi yɛli Firawuna ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnim mini na kura zuliya.
en: The leaders of the city of Zoan are fools. Pharaohs wise advisors give bad advice. They say they are wise. They say they are from the old family of the kings, but they are not as smart as they think.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa nyɛ Arab mini Duma ni Ɛshan.
en: Arab, Dumah, Eshan.

dag: Ka biɛrisuntal maŋa din nyɛ Masia kɔŋko ni tiri shɛl la kpe m-pali yi bebu ni zaa Naawuni tibigibu min o paɣibu zuɣu.
en: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God.

dag: Dama bɛ tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa nyɛla diribarilimnima bɛn suhuri kul yɛla zalinsi dibu zuɣu. Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Everyone, great and small, tries to make money dishonestly; even prophets and priests cheat the people.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun mi daa yi Kamɛl na la chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: So David went there, along with his two wives: Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, Nabals widow, from Carmel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o suhu ni, Di simdi ni n zaŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli sɔɣi Ibrahimma?.
en: The Lord said to himself, Should I tell Abraham what I am going to do now?.

dag: Ka Shaul daa ti kpi, ka Baalihanan Akibɔr bidibiga la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Shaul died, Baal-hanan, Achbors son, became king.

dag: Kaman sala buɣim ni tahiri biisim na, ka dari chɛ ka buɣim diri shɛm, lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili chɛ ka zabili neera.
en: Charcoal keeps the embers glowing, wood keeps the fire burning, and troublemakers keep arguments alive.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni paɣ a. Nyini n nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni tibig a.
en: You are my God, and I give you thanks; I will proclaim your greatness.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu, ka di leei o ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: the two kidneys and the fat around them at the loins; and the lobe on the liver, which should be removed with the kidneys.

dag: dama yi na bi paai vuhim shee mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ luɣ shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: because you have not yet entered the land that the Lord your God is giving you, where you can live in peace.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa kpalim be vinvamli maa ni Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la.
en: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.

dag: ka o daa pii di liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka o paɣ maa mi di yɛla. Ka Ananias daa zaŋ din kpalim maa ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: But with his wife's agreement he kept part of the money for himself and turned the rest over to the apostles.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla bɛn be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka lahi maa nyɛ din be kasi; ka anzinfa mini salima maa nyɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Baruk, Bɛ bi lan saɣi ni n kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then I said, Baruch, the officials refuse to let me go into the Lord 's temple.

dag: Dama zuliya pam mini na kara ni ti zaŋ bɛ gba leei daba, ka n ti yo ba bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ nuhi tuma samli kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: Yes, the people of Babylon will have to serve many nations and many great kings. I will give them the punishment they deserve for all the things they have done.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu n-vihir o ni o baŋ o nyaandoliba min o wuhibu yɛla.
en: The High Priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu shɛli din bɔri ni a niŋ din tuhi ti ma ŋɔ. Wummi n kuhigu ŋɔ; gbilisim a tibili wum man ŋun nyɛ ʒiri ni ka so nol ni ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ.
en: Listen, O Lord , to my plea for justice; pay attention to my cry for help! Listen to my honest prayer.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti gbani bɛ buɣa la tooni bee n-jɛm ba bee n-tum kaman bɛ ni tumdi shɛm, amaa ti daamiya bɛ buɣa maa zaa luhi, ka wurim bɛ ni me buɣa maa binwɔɣil shɛŋa zaa zali.
en: Dont worship their gods. Dont ever bow down to those gods. You must never live the way those people live. You must destroy their idols. And you must break the stones that help them remember their gods.

dag: Bɛ vaam tampiligim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka zaŋ chinchin bɔribɔri pil li;.
en: They must clean the ashes out of the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

dag: Kɛlub ŋun daa nyɛ Shuha mabia la daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Mɛhir. Mɛhir maa n-daa nyɛ Ɛshitɔn ba.
en: Caleb, the brother of Shuhah, had a son, Mehir. Mehir was the father of Eshton.

dag: Di tiriya nimmira yɛlimaŋli, amaa doliyala yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Dont judge according to appearances. Judge with right judgment.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ni o ti sɔɣ o ba. Ka Firawuna kpambaliba zaa min o yiŋ kpamba ni Ijipti ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa.
en: So Joseph went to bury his father. All of Pharaohs officials, personal advisors, and all the older leaders of Egypt went with Joseph.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ chi bee kawana mali maha na ti mali sara, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni m-mal li, ka dabindi ka di ni bee karikaasi shɛli din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ shɛli ni.
en: If the offering is bread baked in an oven, it must be made without yeast. It may be thick loaves made of flour mixed with olive oil or thin cakes brushed with olive oil.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina asibaasi, ka Ilaisha sɔŋda yina nti nya ka tɔbbihi mini yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi n-kul teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa zaa. Ka Ilaisha sɔŋda maa kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: Early the next morning Elisha's servant got up, went out of the house, and saw the Syrian troops with their horses and chariots surrounding the town. He went back to Elisha and exclaimed, We are doomed, sir! What shall we do.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Bilichin tital so n-daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha nti di nam labina;.
en: and Jesus told them this story: A prince once went to a foreign country to be crowned king and then to return.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam zaa jɛmdi li ni di vi. Daadamnim bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba m-me wuna bee n-kpe li zali. Chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣimna nti yiɣisi zani. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ba ka bɛ zaa di vi.
en: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified.

dag: Bomiya yalim ti Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ka di ku yiɣi, dama di ni wurim; di fɔntinsi ni zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Spread salt over the fields in Moab. The country will be an empty desert. Moabs towns will become empty. No one will live in them.

dag: Zabili daa be Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni yuui pam, ka Dauda yaa daa kul pahira, ka Naa Sool niriba maa mi yaa daa kul gbarigiri pahira.
en: This battle was the beginning of a long war between the followers of Saul and the followers of David. Saul's power grew weaker, but David's grew stronger.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. A yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Izraɛlnima; ka lan yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Yisahaku zuliya.
en: So listen to the Lord s message. You tell me, Dont prophesy against Israel. Dont speak against Isaacs family.

dag: ni Zimiri nanim zaa ni Ɛlam nanim zaa ni Miidia nanim zaa.
en: all the kings of Zimri, Elam, and Media.

dag: A ni mali yɛm pam zaŋ chaŋ daabiligu polo maa zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a buni nabi pahi, ka a mali karimbaani a buni maa zuɣu.
en: You made clever business deals and kept on making profits. How proud you are of your wealth!.

dag: Dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana. N suhu saɣimya pam.
en: I am poor and needy; I am hurt to the depths of my heart.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be o biɛhigu shee din be kasi la nyɛla kpibisi ba, ka nyɛ ŋun gbibi pakoya.
en: Father of orphans and defender of widows is God in his holy habitation.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti paɣa maa? Ka Gɛhaazi garigi yɛl o, To, paɣ maa ka bidibiga, ka o yidana mi kurigi.
en: Elisha said to Gehazi, What can we do for her? He answered, I know! She does not have a son, and her husband is old.

dag: Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nir niŋ siɣa dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Ŋunkam mali kookali ni tooi baŋ biŋkɔbigu maa namba maa, dama di nyɛla ninsal namba. O namba maa nyɛla kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is , and it stands for a person.

dag: nti duɣi n ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Make me the delicious food that I love and bring it to me so I can eat. Then I can bless you before I die.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zaŋ o Shi so tin ya maa pala ŋun ni zaŋ ya leei daba n-lan kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm yaha, amaa Naawuni Shia maa lee chɛ ka yi leerila Naawuni bihi. Ka ti kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: The Spirit that we received is not a spirit that makes us slaves again and causes us to fear. The Spirit that we have makes us Gods chosen children. And with that Spirit we cry out, Abba , Father.

dag: Doo yi chɛ ka o dɔbilim yina, ŋun sum o niŋgbuŋ zaa kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If it is an emission of semen, the man must bathe his whole body in water and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka o yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiy o fali maa ti o ba mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he has no brothers, everything he owns will be given to his fathers brothers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim lo nia ni bɛ kana nti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-tahi girigiri niŋbu na.
en: So they all plotted together to come and attack Jerusalem and create confusion.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihira, ka na kul wumdi yilli zaɣ bil la yɛtɔɣ kara la. Ka n ni daa na kul lihiri maa, ka n ti nya ka bɛ ku biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la n-zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim ni, ka di di n-saɣim o.
en: While I was looking, I could still hear the little horn bragging and boasting. As I watched, the fourth beast was killed, and its body was thrown into the flames and destroyed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka piɛguliba maa daa yi ni labiri kuna ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa wum ka nya shɛm maa zuɣu, dama di daa kul nyɛla kaman malaika la ni daa yɛli ba shɛm.
en: The shepherds went back, singing praises to God for all they had heard and seen; it had been just as the angel had told them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni sɔŋdi ma zuɣu, n ku di vi. Dinzuɣu ka n zuɣu ʒe ya. M mi ni n ku di vi.
en: The Lord GOD will help me, so the bad things they say will not hurt me. I will be strong. I know I will not be disappointed.

dag: O daa yɛli ma, Izraɛl nyɛla n dabili, a sani ka n yɛn nya jilima.
en: The Lord said to me, Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.

dag: Saha shɛli ha a daa kana ti tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam, ka ti bi tɛhi ni a ni niŋ lala, ka zoya daa sɔhig a tooni.
en: When you accomplished wonders beyond all our expectations; when you came down, mountains quaked before you.

dag: Zuliya shɛli na mi n-taɣi bɛ wuna, hal bɛ ni kul pa Naawuni maa zaa? Amaa n niriba bɛn zaŋla binshɛli din ka nyɔri taɣi bɛ jilima.
en: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.

dag: Bɛ boonila niriba duri zoya zuɣu; nimaani ka bɛ maani sara din tuhi. Dama teeku puuni ka bɛ nyari bɛ daazichi, ka nyari azichi sɔɣira bihigu ni.
en: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ, ka neeri ni shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili. Dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ yi beni, shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili gba nyɛla din beni.
en: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirim ma na.
en: Jesus told the man to stand up where everyone could see him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti chɛ ka ŋmani yiɣi yi ni o nyaa kom maa nyuuya.
en: Meanwhile, Noah sent out a dove to see if the water had gone down.

dag: M biɛhigu shee ni ti be bɛ sani ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ gba nyɛ n niriba.
en: and I will live among my people and be their God.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zal o daa ka di dol o ni viɛl shɛm bee o ni bi viɛl shɛm. Kaman ŋun maligumaana ni zal o daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: and let him determine its value.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi dindali maa, ka yiɣimiya jɛmmi ni suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anabinim gba.
en: Rejoice when that happens! Leap for joy because you have a great reward in heaven. Their ancestors did the same things to the prophets.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ nandaamba yɛlimaŋli bɛ saria karibu ni.
en: In court, dont let anyone take advantage of a person simply because that person is poor.

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni shɛb dolila Balaam wuhibu. Ŋuna n-daa wuhi Balak ka o bo kuɣituurili sɔŋ Izraɛlnim sol zuɣu ni bɛ di buɣa maligu nimdi ka tum zina la.
en: But I have a few things against you, because you have some there who follow Balaams teaching. Balaam had taught Balak to trip up the Israelites so that they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.

dag: ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, Doo ŋɔ kul chɛri ka alahichinim kanila o sanna hal ka o mini ba ti laɣindi dira.
en: The Pharisees and legal experts were grumbling, saying, This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yiɣisi kpe duu, ka anab bil maa ti booi kpam maa bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa;.
en: Jehu got up and went into the house. Then the young prophet poured the oil on Jehus head and said to him, The Lord , the God of Israel, says, I am anointing you to be the new king over the Lord s people, Israel.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ yaha: Naawuni zaɣisila o niriba? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Mmaŋmaŋ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma yaaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na.
en: I ask, then: Did God reject his own people? Certainly not! I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi n zuɣu na ka o yɛli ma, Yɛlima, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, yi ni tɛhi shɛm m-bala? M mi binshɛŋa din kpe yi tɛha ni.
en: The Lord 's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.

dag: N sabi Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri sɔŋ, n zaŋ bɛ daalahichi maa niŋ sɔɣisili shee.
en: Israel's sin and guilt are on record, and the records are safely stored away.

dag: Di saha a yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, n ni garig a, bee chɛ ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka a garigi ma.
en: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.

dag: N daa da daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi daba n yiŋ puuni. Ka n daa lan mali niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ n tooni be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I acquired male servants and female servants; I even had slaves born in my house. I also had great herds of cattle and sheep, more than any who preceded me in Jerusalem.

dag: Yi yi wum zaligunim ŋɔ ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbib o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani la.
en: If you listen to these commands and obey them faithfully, then the Lord your God will continue to keep his covenant with you and will show you his constant love, as he promised your ancestors.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli ka chɛ ka m biɛhigu niŋ tom ŋɔ.
en: As God lives, who rejected my legal claim, the Almighty, who made me bitter.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya ni suhudoo. Yawɛ nuu pa yi zuɣu yi chandi maa ni.
en: The priest answered, You have nothing to worry about. The Lord is taking care of you on this trip.

dag: Nyamiya, biŋkura la zaa gariya; pumpɔŋɔ bimpala yɛla ka n yɛra. N yɛn daŋmi yɛli ya di yɛla pɔi, ka di naanyi kana.
en: The things announced in the past—look—theyve already happened, but Im declaring new things. Before they even appear, I tell you about them.

dag: Bɔ ka a su kpe? Ŋuni ka a lee mi kpe hal ka ti gbir amaŋmaŋ gballi kpe n-chibiri daboli zuɣu tampiŋ ni?.
en: Who do you think you are? What right do you have to carve a tomb for yourself out of the rocky hillside?.

dag: N ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ n ni ti ba binshɛli, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛli bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ba.
en: Ill strike them down with a plague and disown them. Then Ill make you into a great nation, stronger than they.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yaakubu daa ti duɣi ʒiɛri, ka Iso yi mɔɣu ni na ka kum wum o pam.
en: One day Esau came back from hunting. He was tired and weak from hunger. Jacob was boiling a pot of beans.

dag: Musa ni daa ti Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili la naai dahin shɛli, o daa boola kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mali di mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa ka di be kasi, ka lan booi kpam bahi sara maligu bimbini mini di nɛma zaa zuɣu m-mali di gba ka di be kasi.
en: On the day Moses finished setting up the Tent of the Lord 's presence, he anointed and dedicated the Tent and all its equipment, and the altar and all its equipment.

dag: Ka o yɛli, A mi ni mani n-daa su nam ŋɔ, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yu ni mani n-di li, amaa ka nam maa ti ŋmaligi leela n tizo dini, dama Yawɛ n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: Adonijah said, You know that at one time the kingdom was mine. All the people of Israel wanted me to be their king. But things have changed, and now my brother is the king. The Lord chose him to be king.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa garigi yɛli ba, M mi Yisa, ka mi Pool; ka banima n-lee nyɛ yi mi.
en: But one time an evil spirit said to these Jews, I know Jesus, and I know about Paul, but who are you.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi a suhu ni ni a gba tur a tab pam.
en: and you know yourself that you have insulted other people many times.

dag: Teemiya yi ni daa wum shɛli mini yi ni daa deei shɛl la yɛla, ka niŋya tuuba ka gbib li. Yi yi ku neei, n ni ka yi sanna kaman tayiɣa la, ka yi ku baŋ n kandina saha.
en: So dont forget what you have received and heard. Obey it. Change your hearts and lives! You must wake up, or I will come to you and surprise you like a thief. You will not know when I will come.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N saha na bi paai; amaa yinim nyɛla bɛn kul mali saha sahakam.
en: Jesus replied, For you, anytime is fine. But my time hasnt come yet.

dag: N ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaa yɛla. Dama bɛ ni tum wuntitali tuun shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni be. .
en: All their sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they did right.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun doli yili maa dunoli yi, ka yo yili maa zali hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: the priest will exit the house, go to the front door, and quarantine the house for seven days.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhilituhili bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na maa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa gbibi Naawuni jɛmbu shee lahi mini kikahi din ni piɛbi boli niriba o nuu ni la chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses sent them to war under the command of Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, who took charge of the sacred objects and the trumpets for giving signals.

dag: ni Nan ni Jɔshua.
en: his son Nun, and his son Joshua.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Hal man bi mi do so yi ni yɛri maa gba.
en: Then Peter began to curse. He said, I swear to God, I dont know this man you are talking about.

dag: A gbilisi tibili wum Naawuni yɛm yɛtɔɣa? Ka a tɛhiya ni a kɔŋko m-mali yɛm?.
en: Did you listen in Gods council; is wisdom limited to you?.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa nya ka Yisifu chɛ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ o nuu ni ka guui yi yili maa ni maa.
en: When this happened.

dag: bɛ yi tiri yɛlimaŋgɔba, yi tɛhiya ni ti Duuma bi nyari li?.
en: The Lord does not like anyone to cheat another person. He does not like any of these things.

dag: Gbibiy o zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi mini yi bihi biɛrisuŋ zuɣu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: Keep the Lords regulations and his commandments. Im commanding them to you today for your well-being and for the well-being of your children after you, so that you may extend your time on the fertile land that the LORD your God is giving you forever.

dag: Ka o ni po pɔ shɛŋa bee o noli ni faag o ka o yɛli ni o niŋ shɛli, o yi ti kuli doo.
en: If she marries while her solemn promise is in effect or makes a statement by which she binds herself.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ti teei zani ni bɛ zaŋ nya taba.
en: The army of Israel and the Philistine army stood there facing each other.

dag: Ka bihi daa ti var o pul ni ka o yɛli, Di yi yɛn nyɛ ŋ-ŋɔ n ni be? Ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti bɔhi Yawɛ nya.
en: Before Rebekah gave birth, she knew she was going to have twins, because she could feel them inside her, fighting each other. She thought, Why is this happening to me? Finally, she asked the Lord why her twins were fighting.

dag: Di daa ti lu Farisiinim tibili ni ni Yisa nyari nyaandoliba pam baptaiziri ba n-gari Jɔn Baptaizira.
en: The Pharisees heard that Jesus was winning and baptizing more disciples than John. .

dag: Dama saha shɛl o ni daa nya tibiginsim mini jilima o Ba Naawuni sani la ka kukoli daa yi Zallakudura Naa Jilima Biɛhigu Shee na n-di o shɛhira yɛli, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala.
en: He received honor and glory from God the Father when a voice came to him from the magnificent glory, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well-pleased.

dag: Ti zaa daa bela lala, ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, ka tumdi dinkam tiɣiri timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini ti tɛha nini. Ka ti zaa daa nyɛla bɛn ti yɛn di Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo wahala shɛli sokam ni ti yɛn di la.
en: Actually all of us were like them and lived according to our natural desires, doing whatever suited the wishes of our own bodies and minds. In our natural condition we, like everyone else, were destined to suffer God's anger.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa, Yimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni na.
en: So Joshua commanded the priests, Come out of the Jordan River.

dag: Alizin biɛri ni daa nahindi shɛb zaa gba daa nya alaafee.
en: They all came to hear Jesus teach and to be healed of their sicknesses. He healed the people who were troubled by evil spirits.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi mini Jɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Saimɔn tumtumdi tab la gba alahiziba. Ka Yisa yɛli Saimɔn, Di zɔri dabiɛm, a nyɛla kulipal ŋun gbahiri zahim, amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a ni leela ŋun vɔri ninsalinim tiri Naawuni.
en: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were amazed too. Jesus said to Simon, Dont be afraid. From now on your work will be to bring in people, not fish.

dag: Paɣ yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi, o malila suhusaɣiŋgu o biɛrim nyabu saha ni paai zuɣu; amaa o yi ti dɔɣi bia maa naai, o bi lan teer o biɛrim maa yɛla yaha, o ni dɔɣi bia dunia ni maa zuɣu.
en: When a woman is about to give birth, she is sad because her hour of suffering has come; but when the baby is born, she forgets her suffering, because she is happy that a baby has been born into the world.

dag: n ni chɛ ka a nam kul beni sahakam kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli n-yɛli ni so kul ku kɔŋ o daŋ ni ŋun ni di nam su Izraɛlnim la.
en: then I will make you a strong king and your kingdom will be great. That is the agreement I made with David your father when I told him that Israel would always be ruled by one of his descendants.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka so kani, ka noonsi zaa yiɣi.
en: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.

dag: Amaa biɛɣu yi neei bee di yi niŋ daba ayi ka dabili maa kpaŋ, di bi simdi ni bɛ darig o tibili dama ŋuna n-su dabili maa.
en: However, if the slave lives a few days after the beating, you are not to be punished. After all, you have already lost the services of that slave who was your property.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti tim boli tindaannim mini laasabuniŋdiba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ Izraɛlnim Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ? Ka ti yi yɛn zaŋ li labisi di biɛhigu shee, bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ pahi di zuɣu labisi.
en: The Philistines called their priests and magicians and said, What must we do with the Lord s Box? Tell us how to send it back home.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti vulim vuliŋga m-boli Ijiptinim ka bɛ yi Nail Mɔɣili polo kana kaman zɔhi la, ka Asirianim gba ti kana kaman shihi la.
en: At that time the Lord will call for the Fly that is now near the streams of Egypt, and he will call for the Bee that is now in the country of Assyria. Those enemies will come to your country.

dag: O chɛ ka a dunokparitisi mali kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: He makes your gates strong, and he blesses the people in your city.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi tinsi ni mini yi puri ni.
en: The Lord will bless your towns and your fields.

dag: Lɔt daa ti yɛn paai Zɔa, ka wuntaŋ pun puhimi.
en: Lot was entering the town as the sun came up.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka n lee nya ka di do tooni ŋɔ ha? Ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl o, Naawuni daanabi ŋun daa yi Juda na nti yɛl a ni niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbini ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla siliga m-bala.
en: Whats this gravestone I see? Josiah asked. The people of the city replied, That tomb belongs to the man of God who came from Judah and announced what you would do to the altar of Bethel.

dag: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa duɣuri mini di lahi zaa zaŋ tabili di kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi zaa ti nyɛ daanya binyɛra.
en: All the dwellings equipment for any use and all its tent pegs and all the courtyards tent pegs will be made of copper.

dag: Bɛ yi pooi dabili o bilim ni, di bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: If you give your servants everything they want from childhood on, some day they will take over everything you own.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Diblaim bipuɣiŋga Goma ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So Hosea married a woman named Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim. After the birth of their first child, a son.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili nɛma duu la zaa ti o.
en: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was in the LORDs temple and in the palace treasuries.

dag: Ŋun daa pa Ɛhud zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Anat bia Shamga ŋun daa zaŋ naɣikpar kpaa ku Filistianim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la. Ŋun gba daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: After Ehud saved the Israelites, another man saved Israel. That mans name was Shamgar son of Anath. Shamgar used an ox goad to kill Philistine men.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛm o o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ni wuh a dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa zuɣu, so kani m-mali tɛhi wɔɣila ni yɛm kaman nyini.
en: The king said to Joseph, God has shown you all this, so it is obvious that you have greater wisdom and insight than anyone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa piig o Bia n-tuui tim o la yi sanna ni o ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka taɣi yi zaa biɛhigu n-yihi ya yi tuumbiɛri ni.
en: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.

dag: Zaŋm biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi la zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi la zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: Take seven pairs of every kind of animal that can be used for sacrifice and one pair of all others.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kɔri naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin mali sara, Naawuni ni daa sɔŋ ba maa zuɣu.
en: God had helped the Levites who carried the Box of the Lord s Agreement. So they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams to him.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zal li saha shɛli yi ti paai, Siria naa maa ni lan labina ti liri Ijiptinim yaha, amaa din yɛla ni ti be di ko.
en: Later on he will invade Egypt again, but this time things will turn out differently.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli:.
en: The commander told Paul he could speak. So he stood on the steps and waved his hand so that the people would be quiet. The people became quiet and Paul spoke to them in Aramaic.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn biri yuun shɛli din pahir anii ni, yi ni ti dirila bindir kura, ka yi ti kul ni dirila bindir kura maa hal ni yuun shɛli din pahir awɛi, ka bindir pala ti naanyi niŋ.
en: When you plant in the eighth year, you will still be eating from the old crop. You will eat the old crop until the ninth year, when the crop you planted in the eighth year comes in.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ dundɔŋ gili di zaa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunɔdali.
en: Set up the courtyard all around. Hang up the screen at the courtyard gate.

dag: Ka Pita min o nyaandolitab piniyin la daa yiɣisi zani ka Pita duh o yee pam yɛli, Yinim Judianim mini yi zaa bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ ka baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni.
en: Then Peter stood up with the other eleven apostles. He spoke loudly so that all the people could hear. He said, My Jewish brothers and all of you who live in Jerusalem, listen to me. I will tell you something you need to know. Listen carefully.

dag: Bɛ noya ni alahichi mini bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛ ka bɛ karimbaani gbahi ba! Bɛ ninvuɣ tubo mini bɛ ʒiŋmabo zuɣu.
en: For the sin of their mouths, the words that they speak, let them be captured in their pride. For the curses and lies they repeat.

dag: ka pihi kuɣa sɔŋ n-lihi nya bulah ayi maa sunsuuni, kuɣ yini ni ti nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka kuɣ yini ti nyɛ Azazɛl dini.
en: There he shall draw lots, using two stones, one marked for the Lord and the other for Azazel.

dag: O tiri nandaamba pina, ka tiri bɛn ka pina.
en: She always gives to the poor and helps those who need it.

dag: Neesim din be bɛ suɣili ni leei zibisim, ka firila din yili bɛ zuɣusaa kpi.
en: leaving their tents dark.

dag: Amaa ka timanim gba daa niŋ tabibi n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The magicians used their magic to do the same thing—so even more frogs came out onto the land in Egypt!.

dag: Bɛn gbilisi tibili wum yɛlli ni tɔŋ. Ka bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Good things happen to those who learn from their experiences, and the Lord blesses those who trust him.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Jɔshua ti zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini salo maa zaa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and placed him before Eleazar the priest and the entire community.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka di zanila dabari, ka di nyɛ dabari n-fabindi niŋdi ma. Tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zanila dabari, amaa ka so baɣa kani.
en: They have made it a wasteland; it lies desolate before me. The whole land has become a desert, and no one cares.

dag: Di saha ka a niriba zaa ti leei bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka su tiŋgbani maa sahakam. Mani n-nam ba, ka zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani ni di chɛ ka n nya jilima.
en: All your people will be good. They will get the land forever. They are the young plant in my garden that will grow to be a wonderful tree. I made them with my own hands.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chɛ ka bɛ lab ti yɛli Juda Naa Amazia ni dahin shɛli ka Lɛbanɔn goo tutuɣu daa ti tim ti yɛli Lɛbanɔn sida, Zaŋm a bipuɣiŋga ti ma ka n-niŋ m paɣa; ka Lɛbanɔn mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb so daa kana ti no goo tutuɣu maa sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: But King Jehoash sent back the following reply: Once a thorn bush on the Lebanon Mountains sent a message to a cedar: Give your daughter in marriage to my son. A wild animal passed by and trampled the bush down.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Kɔnyuri m-mali ma. N suhir a, tim ma kom biɛla ka n nyu. Ka paɣ maa daa yooi bihim koligu m-booi bihim ti o ka o nyu, ka o lan zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: Could I have a little water? he asked. I'm thirsty. Jael opened a leather bottle and poured him some milk, then she covered him back up.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: The scripture says, All who have faith in him wont be put to shame .

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni sɔŋ o ni pii na so ŋɔ; o ni be o daalizanda din be kasi la ni ka garig o, ka chɛ ka o nudirigu sɔŋ o ka o di nasara din galisi.
en: I am certain, Lord , that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.

dag: ka bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka bi niŋdi ba nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka doli n zaligunima ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam, o ku kpi o ba tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: He refrains from oppressing the poor by taking neither interest nor profit. He observes my case laws and follows my regulations. He wont die because of his fathers guilt. He will surely live.

dag: O darigiri deera, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu o soli? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi maa.
en: If he takes something away, no one can stop him. No one can say to him, What are you doing.

dag: Musa daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, This is what the LORD has commanded.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu ka taari duŋ, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha dii paami maa.
en: When you hear about wars and riots, dont be afraid. These things must happen first. Then the end will come later.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa daa dam, ka niriba zo n-laɣimna nti gbaai Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-dar o yi, ka dii yo di dunoya.
en: The entire city was stirred up. The people came rushing, seized Paul, and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the gates were closed.

dag: Wula ka bɛ zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi nya soli ka nyɛ Naawuni ni sa gariche gili so?.
en: Why is light given to the person whose way is hidden, whom God has fenced in?.

dag: ni Nɔha ŋun daa pah anahi ni Rafa ŋun daa pah anu la.
en: Nohah, and Rapha.

dag: Naawuni daa bi chɛ ka Anabi Ilaija chaŋ bɛ so sani; amaa pakol so ŋun daa be tin shɛli din yuli booni Zarɛfat Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la sani kɔŋko ka o daa chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.

dag: A ŋmanila abie tia, ka a biha be kaman di wala yila la.
en: You are tall and slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are full.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma? Nyama, n na ka bia, ka daɣila Ɛliɛza ŋun nyɛ Damaskus nir la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: But Abram said, LORD God, what can you possibly give me, since I still have no children? The head of my household is Eliezer, a man from Damascus.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi n-lo tɔbu; bɛ daa laɣimla Soko din be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka ti bɛ suɣa Soko maa mini Azɛka tiŋ shɛli din be Ɛfɛsidammim tiŋgban ni la sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines got ready for war and brought their troops together to attack the town of Socoh in Judah. They set up camp at Ephes-Dammim, between Socoh and Azekah.

dag: M mabihi, n yɛri ya mi ni saha maa bi lan wɔɣa. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni bɛn mali paɣiba be kaman bɛn ka paɣiba.
en: This is what Im saying, brothers and sisters: The time has drawn short. From now on, those who have wives should be like people who dont have them.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N ku tooi zaŋ n ni tum shɛm buɣisi yi ni tum shɛm. Hal yinim Ifriim zuliya niriba ni tum biɛla shɛli maa gari tinim Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni tum shɛm zaa.
en: But he said to them, What have I done now, compared to you? Arent Ephraims leftovers better than Abiezers main harvest?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ a niŋ a ni je ninvuɣ shɛba ka ŋmaligi ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la nuu ni.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am giving you to the men you hate. I am giving you to the men you became disgusted with.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri yi ti nya o, ŋun kum o.
en: A member of the dead persons family can chase you and kill you.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, Izraɛlnim yi ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ka ti dimnim nya ti kpaya, wula ka n lee lan yɛn yɛli?.
en: What can I say, O Lord, now that Israel has retreated from the enemy?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du n-kpe tiŋ maa ni. Bɛ ni daa kpɛri tiŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya Samuɛl ka o yiri ni o chaŋ sara maligu daboli maa zuɣu.
en: Saul and the servant started walking up the hill to town. Just as they came into town, they saw Samuel coming out of town, walking toward them. He was on his way to the place for worship.

dag: Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Sɔtai daŋ mini Hasofɛrɛt daŋ ni Pɛruda daŋ.
en: Clans of Solomon's servants who returned from exile: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa bi tooi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pun be Jɛrusalɛm la bahi. Dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Judanim na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the people of Judah couldnt remove the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem. So today the Jebusites still live along with the people of Judah in Jerusalem.

dag: Kalim Izraɛlnim kaman sokam min o malibu ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Sabimiya doo kam yuli.
en: Take a census of the entire Israelite community by their clans and their households, recording the name of every male.

dag: ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi wuntitali soya dolibu ka dolila zibisim soya la.
en: Such people have left the straight path and now walk in darkness.

dag: Nir yi ŋma ʒiri nya bindirigu di nyaɣisa, amaa di nyaaŋa taŋkuɣa n-yɛn pal o noli.
en: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.

dag: Juda bidibisi daa nyɛla Ɛr mini Onan, bɛ zaa daa kpila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: These are the family groups from the tribe of Judah: Shelah—the Shelanite family group; Perez—the Perezite family group; Zerah—the Zerahite family group.

dag: hal ka deei gbana maligumaaniba kpamba sani n-ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛnkam dol a.
en: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.

dag: Naawuni, di simdi ni ti paɣ a Ziɔn. Ka zaŋ ti ni lo alikauli ni ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa ti a la ti a.
en: O God, it is right for us to praise you in Zion and keep our promises to you.

dag: Ka Firawuna pipia daa be n nuu ni, ka m pɔhi wain tiwala maa kahim di kom niŋ Firawuna pipia maa ni n-zaŋ li ti ti ŋun Firawuna.
en: Pharaohs cup was in my hand, so I took the grapes, crushed them into Pharaohs cup, and put the cup in Pharaohs hand.

dag: Naawuni kukoli daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ o lo alikauli yɛli, N ku lan chɛ ka tiŋgbani kɔŋko dam, amaa n ni lan chɛ ka zuɣusaa gba dam.
en: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zaa nyɛla a niriba, dinzuɣu, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi hal ti yaɣi. A mi di gbibi ti taali sahakam.
en: Dont rage so fiercely, LORD; dont hold our sins against us forever, but gaze now on your people, all of us.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli wahu, A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni yɛli noli ti a n-gari yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa; a ni nyɛritila a puli zuɣu, ka diri taŋkpaɣu hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: The LORD God said to the snake, Because you did this, you are the one cursed out of all the farm animals, out of all the wild animals. On your belly you will crawl, and dust you will eat every day of your life.

dag: Yiɣisim a suhu zaa pam n-lihi bɛnkam mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba.
en: Unleash your raging anger; look on all the proud and humble them.

dag: Hadad ni daa ti kpi, Samla ŋun daa nyɛ Masirɛka nir la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ tiri ya maa, ka yi yihi ba, ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni n-kpe m-be bɛ yiya ni.
en: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgbani daa kuui zaa.
en: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was completely dry.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n zo Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so ni yɛlimaŋli la.
en: From the elder. To my dear friend Gaius, whom I truly love.

dag: Zaadali paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ naa n-yi nudirigu polo na la gba ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama o daa yi katiŋa n-kana ni o ti wum Sulemaana yɛm yɛtɔɣa; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Sulemaana be kpe.
en: The Queen of the South will also stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something much greater than Solomon.

dag: Dama a zaŋ alibarika pam na ti ti o; ka zaŋ salima alali nam zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: You bring rich blessings right to him; you put a crown of pure gold on his head.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija puhi zan o sani ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔh o ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa dɔɣi ma lala? bee m-bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka a daa wolisi dɔɣi? Mbusim be dilan zuɣu.
en: Doom to one who says to a father, What have you fathered? and to a woman, With what are you in labor.

dag: O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, kom din be sagbana ni damdimi. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka paɣili kpɛri dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zaŋ li niŋ luɣ shɛli na.
en: At his command the waters above the sky roar; he brings clouds from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning flash in the rain and sends the wind from his storeroom.

dag: Ka o ti yih o fiɛɣu min o kɔbiri bahi sara maligu bimbini maa wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri la.
en: He shall remove the crop and its contents and throw them away on the east side of the altar where the ashes are put.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛli, Naawuni daa ŋmahila tiwula maa bahi ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ma tuɣi.
en: You will say then, Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.

dag: ka bɛ gula maa yi ti nya ka tɔbu kani tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o piɛbi kikaa yɛli niriba maa di yɛla.
en: If this guard sees enemy soldiers coming, he blows the trumpet and warns the people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb be a ni ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri ka kuri niriba, ka shɛb be a ni n-diri bindira zoya zuɣu ka be biɛriyoli.
en: In you slanderers show up to shed blood. In you they eat on the mountains. In you they do obscene things.

dag: Naɣilaa bee piɛlaa ŋun gbali bee o bɔɣu zaɣ yini wɔɣ gari di tab maa bee n-nyɛ zaɣ jia n-gari di tab maa, yi ni tooi zaŋ o na ti mali yi suhu yubu sara, amaa yi yi zaŋ o mali sara ni yi yo yi ni po pɔr shɛli samli, n ku deei li.
en: You can, however, offer an ox or sheep that is deformed or stunted as a spontaneous gift, but it will not be acceptable as payment for a solemn promise.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima kaman di ni simdi shɛm ti Duuma sani.
en: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, for that is what you should do as Christians.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bahila yoli zama laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Im on the brink of utter ruin in the assembled community.

dag: Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani, pumpɔŋɔ kul mali we!.
en: Israel, wait for the LORD— from now until forever from now!.

dag: Suhudoo tirila ninsal niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili, amaa kɔr yoya chɔɣisirila nir kɔba ni.
en: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpalim guhiri saha shɛli maa, ka Ɛhud daa chaŋ hal ti gari kuɣikpɛra shee la n-zo n-kuli Siɛra tiligi.
en: Ehud got away while they were waiting. He went past the carved stones and escaped to Seirah.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N ku dol a kuli bee n-kpe a yiŋa bee n-di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: But the man of God said, I cannot go home with you. I cannot eat or drink anything in this place.

dag: N kuhimi hal ka n nimbihi ti fulim. Di biɛri m puuni. Bɛ ni ku n niriba shɛm maa zuɣu, n suhu saɣimmi, dama biliɛri mini biyaɣilima tarigimi lu tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu.
en: My eyes are worn out from weeping; my stomach is churning. My insides are poured on the ground because the daughter of my people is shattered, because children and babies are fainting in the city streets.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba yuri o ni tim o Bi so na maa, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpaŋsi Pool suhu ka o lo nia ni o ni doli Masidɔnia mini Akaia polo chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm; ka daa lan yɛli ni o yi paai Jɛrusalɛm, shee ka o gari Rom gba.
en: After all this had happened, Paul decided to visit Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. Paul had said, From there I will go on to Rome.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Ahimaaz ba.
en: Zadok, Ahimaaz.

dag: Di ni sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni yɛligu mir a; hal di be a nol ni min a suhu ni. .
en: This is what the Scripture says: Gods teaching is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart. It is the teaching of faith that we tell people.

dag: Alɔbo ni lu yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu bee ka kum ku ba yi sani. Ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu yi sani. Ka n wurim yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu mi dolisi pɔhim; ka ŋooi takɔbi kari doli ba.
en: A third of your people will die inside the city from diseases and hunger. Another third will die in battle outside the city. And then I will pull out my sword and chase the last third of your people into faraway countries.

dag: Saimɔn ni daa nya ka tuumba maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu ka o daa bɔ liɣiri ni o ti ba.
en: When Simon perceived that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles hands, he offered them money.

dag: Dindali maa, paɣiba ayopɔin ni ti gbaai do yino n-yɛl o, Saɣimi ni ti yidana n-nyɛ a, ka ti yi vi ni; amaa ti ni dihiri timaŋa, ka sooni timaŋa.
en: Seven women will grab one man on that day, saying, We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes—only let us take your name; take away our disgrace.

dag: Ka zuɣulan maa yɛl o, N Duuma, kamina paai m bia maa ka o na bi kpi.
en: The kings official said, Sir, come before my little son dies.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a fɔh a nuu ka chɛ ti, hal ka di nyɛla a nudirigu gba? Yihim a nuhi a jɔɣu ni na m-bahi ba yoli.
en: Why have you refused to help us? Why do you keep your hands behind you?.

dag: Paɣa bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o yidana n-su li; lala mi n-nyɛ li, doo gba bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o paɣa n-su li.
en: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daadamnim zaa, kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya! N kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: Turn to me now and be saved, people all over the world! I am the only God there is.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n nyɛ Masia tumo ŋun ʒe o zaani, ka bɛ lo ma zoligɔnim di zuɣu ŋɔ. Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma ka n tooi mali suhukpeeni n-kul tɔɣisiri lahibal suŋ maa yɛla kaman di ni simdi ni n tɔɣisiri li shɛm.
en: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N ni niŋ Naawuni naani. Ka daa lan yɛli yaha, M mini bi shɛba n Duuma Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ma la ni laɣim be.
en: He also says, I will rely on him. And also, Here I am with the children whom God has given to me. .

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Hal man bi mi do so yi ni yɛri maa gba.
en: But he cursed and swore, I dont know this man youre talking about.

dag: M mabihi, n yɛri ya mi ni saha maa bi lan wɔɣa. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni bɛn mali paɣiba be kaman bɛn ka paɣiba.
en: What I mean, my friends, is this: there is not much time left, and from now on married people should live as though they were not married;.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri sunsuuni bee n-kɔrisi taɣi bɛ teensi bee n-chihi chiha bɛ niŋgbuna ni.
en: Priests must not shave their heads bald. They must not shave off the edges of their beards. They must not make any cuts in their bodies.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim daa wum Filistianim ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa.
en: But when all the people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul.

dag: M mali n yɛtɔɣa shili, m mi ni bɛ ni wuhi ni n ka galimi.
en: Look, I have laid out my case; I know that Im innocent.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛlimaŋli maa lee nyɛla dini? Gomna Pailɛt ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan yi Yɛhudianim maa sani ti yɛli ba, M bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: And what is truth? Pilate asked. Then Pilate went back outside to the people and said to them, I cannot find any reason to condemn him.

dag: bee do so ŋun napɔŋ bee o nuu mali daŋa.
en: no one with a crippled hand or foot;.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: There in Jerusalem, David married more wives and had more sons and daughters.

dag: Bɔhim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba maa mini maligumaaniba maa, Yi ni daa lɔri noli, ka fabindi gol so ŋun pah anu ni mini gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin ni zaŋ ti paai yuun pisopɔin la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi lala tiri maa?.
en: Tell the priests and the other people in this country this: For seventy years you fasted and showed your sadness in the fifth month and in the seventh month. But was that fasting really for me?.

dag: Ka Naa Sairus maŋmaŋ daa zaŋ neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la nti niŋ o buɣa duu la na.
en: Also, King Cyrus brought out the things that belonged in the Lord s Temple that Nebuchadnezzar had taken away from Jerusalem. He had put them in his temple where he kept his false gods.

dag: Amaa malimiya bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ hal ni daba ayopɔin, dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin n-nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali, Miriya ka yi tum tuma dindali.
en: Offer your food offerings to the Lord for seven days. On the seventh day you shall again gather for worship, but you shall do none of your daily work.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni tinsi n-nyɛ: Hɛlikat mini Hali ni Bɛtin ni Akishaf.
en: This is the land that was given to that tribe: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph.

dag: ka daa tari Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba ni paɣiba zaa bɔrɔbɔro kpillikpilli mini niŋkpillikpilli ni wain tihi wala mahilimahili ti kpa.
en: Then he gave a loaf of bread, some dates, and raisins to every Israelite man and woman.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee bɔri nyɛvili, ka bɔri ni o mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli, n-di din viɛli nyaɣisim?.
en: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni. Ka o yɛligu maa daa gari ba pam.
en: So Jesus said, Well, then, pay to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, and pay to God what belongs to God. And they were amazed at Jesus.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi dɔɣi nabia ka o nyɛla faralana, amaa o ni tooi yi sarika ni na ti di nam.
en: Maybe the young ruler was born a poor man in the kingdom. And maybe he came from prison to rule the country.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o bia maa, Zom chaŋ ti pihi n ni yɛn to peen shɛŋa ŋɔ na. Bia maa ni daa zɔri chani maa, ka o to piɛm bah o tooni ha.
en: and said to him, Run and find the arrows I'm going to shoot. The boy ran, and Jonathan shot an arrow beyond him.

dag: Ka Hushai daa kana, ka Absalom ti yɛl o, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛl ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ti niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa? Di yi pa lala, nyin yɛlim ti.
en: Hushai came to Absalom. Absalom said to Hushai, This is the plan Ahithophel gave. Should we follow it? If not, tell us.

dag: N daa lan ti a bindirigu din nyɛ zim viɛlli mini kpam ni shiri ni a di, ka a daa zaŋ li zali bɛ tooni ni di nyɛ din nyom viɛla, ka di daa shiri nyɛ lala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I supplied you with fine flour, olive oil, and honey, but you sacrificed it all as offerings to please those idols. I, the Lord God, watched this happen.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Di pala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kali ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ biasani daŋ o biɛli doo kulibu.
en: Laban said, Where we live, we dont give the younger woman before the oldest.

dag: Ka a daa kul lihir o hal ka kuɣili din pa ninsal nuu ni ŋme ŋ-ŋmaai shɛli bahi na daa ti kana ti lu binnani maa napɔnvari din daa nyɛ kuriti mini yaɣiri la zuɣu n-wurisiwurisi li buɣibuɣi.
en: You observed this until a stone was cut, but not by hands; and it smashed the statues feet of iron and clay and shattered them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ pala binshɛli din ka buchi yi sani, amaa di nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ nyɛvili. Di puuni ka yi ni ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli su maa ni.
en: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.

dag: Yi yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, yin niŋmiya ania n-zaŋ li ti Laodisianim gba ka bɛ karim. Ka yi gba niŋ ania n-karim gban shɛli Laodisianim ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya na la.
en: After this letter is read to you, be sure it is also read to the church in Laodicea. And you read the letter that I wrote to them.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa kul jiɣindi sahakam; amaa yi Ba Naawuni mi ni di zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Your Father knows that you need these things.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni, ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be strong and courageous! Let's fight hard for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the Lord 's will be done.

dag: amaa niriba daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu, Masia daa malila sara maligu yim din kul ni ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But when this priest offered one sacrifice for sins for all time, he sat down at the right side of God.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Yisa yi Galili na la daa doli Yisifu chaŋ ti nya siliga maa ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa shɛm;.
en: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph. They saw the tomb and how Jesus body was laid in it.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka di niŋ a alahiziba? N ni yɛl a paɣ maa min o ni bar biŋkɔb so ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia maa daashili yɛla.
en: Why are you amazed? the angel asked me. I will tell you the secret meaning of the woman and of the beast that carries her, the beast with seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Neem a nina nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim suhigu, ka gbilisi a tibili wum ti suhigu ti yi ti suh a saha shɛlikam.
en: Sovereign Lord , may you always look with favor on your people Israel and their king, and hear their prayer whenever they call to you for help.

dag: Naawuni ni be ti polo zuɣu, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn no n-taai ti dimnim maa ti ti.
en: With God on our side we will win; he will defeat our enemies.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord God of Israel said, Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.

dag: Kɔra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asir mini Ɛlikana ni Abiasaf. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ niriba.
en: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph.

dag: O pun mal o bidibbina din mali lɔɣu la shili, n-zaŋ o piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la pa.
en: God has deadly weapons in store for those who wont change; he gets his flaming arrows ready!.

dag: Nyaandol maa n-nyɛ ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira ni ŋun sabi dimbɔŋɔnim ŋɔ, ka ti mi ni o shɛhira maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.

dag: Yawɛ, saha yuusim wula ka a yɛn tam n yɛla? A ni tam n yɛla sahakam? A yɛn ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma ka di yuusim paai bɔ saha?.
en: How much longer, Lord , will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?.

dag: Di yi pa lala, nyini n dan naa yi ti di saɣim saɣ a tariga, bɛ ni wuhi ni m mini m bia Sulemaana nyɛla bɛ nyaanyiriba.
en: When my master the king lies down with his ancestors, then I and my son Solomon will become outlaws.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: They have plenty, and they gave only what they did not need. This woman is very poor, but she gave all she had to live on.

dag: ka bi zaŋ li ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni na ti mal li ti Yawɛ, bɛn yihim dilan Yawɛ niriba ni.
en: as an offering to the Lord anywhere except at the entrance of the Tent shall no longer be considered God's people.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm lala, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zali zaligu Susa tiŋ puuni. Ka bɛ daa shiri zaŋ Haman bidibisi maa ti yili gar dari.
en: The king ordered this to be done, and the proclamation was issued in Susa. The bodies of Haman's ten sons were publicly displayed.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa sɔŋ. O daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim bɛn zaa be yoma mini katinsi Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: Mordecai wrote these things down and sent letters to all the Jews in all the provinces, both near and far, of King Ahasuerus.

dag: Lala ka Yisifu so tuumba maa ni daa ti yuli Baanabas la daa niŋ. O daa nyɛla Saipurus tiŋbia, ka nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nira.
en: And so it was that Joseph, a Levite born in Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas .

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Shɛmaria ni Zaham.
en: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

dag: O daa kul lu n-gbala o tooni ka yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka taali ŋɔ ʒi n kɔŋko zuɣu. N suhir a mi, gbilisim tibili wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: at David's feet, and said to him, Please, sir, listen to me! Let me take the blame.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa tɛhi ni di luhiya ni n tum shɛlikam chihi Yisa Nazarɛt nira yuli.
en: I once thought that I should do everything I could to oppose Jesus from Nazareth.

dag: Di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi ku o shia; amaa zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi zaŋ daadam niŋgbuŋ min o shia zaa niŋ buɣim ni la.
en: Dont be afraid of people. They can kill the body, but they cannot kill the soul. The only one you should fear is God, the one who can send the body and the soul to be destroyed in hell.

dag: Ka Pita daa zaŋ ba kpe duu ka o mini ba ti gbe. N-yi biɛɣu ka Pita yiɣisi ni o mini Kɔniilius tuumba maa chaŋ, ka Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔpa pahi Pita zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Peter asked the men to come in and stay for the night. The next day Peter got ready and went away with the three men. Some of the believers from Joppa went with him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu din galisi. Di simdi ka ti lur o sizuura gari wuni kam.
en: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.

dag: mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋ la.
en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.

dag: Saha shɛli paɣiba ni siɣiri kuliga zaawuni ka o daa chɛ ka laakumnim maa gbani tiŋ tariga kɔbiliga gbini.
en: In the evening, when the women come out to get water, he went to the water well outside the city. He made the camels kneel down at the well.

dag: O chɛ ka tɔbu tuhibu chɛ dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam. O kab tɔbiri ka saɣim kpana, ka nyo nyɔtaɣirisi buɣim.
en: He stops wars all over the world. He breaks the soldiers bows, shatters their spears, and burns their shields.

dag: yin karimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa mini kuriti mali wun shɛŋa zaa, ka wurim bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: you will drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. You will destroy all their carved figures. You will also destroy all their cast images. You will eliminate all their shrines.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma mi ka n ni sɔhira, ka dabiɛm din galisi nyaŋ ma;.
en: I am trembling with fear. I am terrified!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o paɣa bee o mabi dɔbba bee o ba min o mabihi Naawuni nam zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, I can promise that everyone who has left their home, wife, brothers, parents, or children for Gods kingdom.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka nir yi ni tooi kali bihigu, o ni ti tooi kal a zuliya gba.
en: I will give you more descendants than there are specks of dust on the earth, and someday it will be easier to count those specks of dust than to count your descendants.

dag: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ shɛli din pahir ayi m-be nuzaa polo la gba simdi ka di mali dapaɣa pisi.
en: Make more frames for the other side of the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli ba Yisa ni di yɛli ba shɛm la, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: They told them just what Jesus said, and they left them alone.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, bɛ tahima lee nyɛ dini saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti chɛ ba bahi, saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti deei bɛ nyɛviya?.
en: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down.

dag: Asaf bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani ka o wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-daa nyɛ: Zakur mini Yisifu ni Nɛtania ni Asharɛla. Naa n-daa wuhiri ba luɣ shɛŋa ni saha shɛli di ni simdi ni bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: From Asaphs family: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. King David chose Asaph to prophesy. And Asaph led his sons.

dag: Pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi maa daa nyɛla bini pihiwɛinaayɔbu m-be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka pumpɔrinchihi din daa gɔhigɔhi kur shɛŋa din gabigabi taba gili maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga.
en: There were pomegranates on the sides of the pillars. All together, there were pomegranates above the net design that went around the pillars.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋmanila kundun biɛɣu. O gbahiri binyara asiba ni zaawuni ŋubira.
en: Benjamin is a wolf who hunts: in the morning he devours the prey; in the evening he divides the plunder.

dag: Amaa yinim lihi ʒiɛmla nandaamba. Pa bundaannima n-nahindi ya la? Pa bɛna n-dariti ya tahiri ʒiishee la?.
en: But you show no respect to those who are poor. And you know that the rich are the ones who always try to control your lives. And they are the ones who take you to court.

dag: Di saha ka Sɛrafinim maa ni yino ŋun daa gbib buɣim sal nɛɔŋ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ gbabo gbabi yihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu daaŋa ni n-yiɣi ka n sanna.
en: Then one of the winged creatures flew to me, holding a glowing coal that he had taken from the altar with tongs.

dag: a yi be kasi ka a biɛhigu be tibi zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni ka a sanna nti labisi din simd a ti a.
en: If you are pure and do the right thing, then surely he will become active on your behalf and reward your innocent dwelling.

dag: Haman daa lan yɛli, Ka din gari lala nyɛla, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ Napaɣ Ɛsta ni boli so pahi naa zuɣu ni ti kana nti di bindira ka nyu binnyura. Hal o lan bol ti ni ti sa labina biɛɣuni yaha.
en: Haman added, That's not all! Besides the king himself, I'm the only person Queen Esther invited for dinner. She has also invited the king and me to dinner tomorrow.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa chɛ salo maa ka kul o yilikpɛrili. Ka o nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Wuhim ti piriŋkpana din be puu ni la yɛla ŋahili la gbinni.
en: After Jesus left the crowd and went inside, his disciples came to him and said, Explain to us the story about the weeds in the wheat field.

dag: Mɔabnim yudua la naaya. Bɛ lo ba zaɣ biɛɣu Hɛshibɔn. Kamiyana ka ti wurim li, ka di ku lan beni. Ka nyini yinyahi tiŋ ŋɔ gba, bɛ ni ti chɛ ka a fo. Takɔb ni ti dol a.
en: the splendor of Moab is gone. The enemy have captured Heshbon and plot to destroy the nation of Moab. The town of Madmen will be silenced; armies will march against it.

dag: Ŋun yɛn da kul yɛrimi, Di mali shaara, di mali shaara, di nyaaŋa ka o chaŋ ha ti nyuri bara.
en: When buying something, people always say, Its no good. It costs too much. Then they go away and tell others what a good deal they got.

dag: Dinzuɣu Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: This is why the Human One is Lord even over the Sabbath.

dag: Ka n daa wum tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kalinli, ka di nyɛla tuhi piapia ʒii tuhi pia.
en: The number of cavalry troops was two hundred million. I heard their number.

dag: Ka chuɣu maa daa ti puhi naai ka bɛ labiri kuna, ka Yisa ŋun daa na nyɛ bisariŋga la kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ba min o ma bi mi.
en: When the festival was over, they went home, but Jesus stayed in Jerusalem. His parents did not know about it.

dag: ka n naanyi chaŋ ka ku lan labi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa mini zibisim titali ŋɔ ni na.
en: before I go and dont return to a land of deepest darkness.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam doli nam fukumsinim yɛligu; dama nam fukumsi nir kani ka pa ni Naawuni n-zal o, ka nam fukumsi din beni nyɛla Naawuni ni zali shɛli.
en: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be yoma mini tin shɛŋa din be katinsi zaa ni ti mali ya ansarisi, tin shɛli din yuli bi du ka gadama pali di ni ŋɔ.
en: People far and near will make fun of you. You have ruined your name. You are filled with confusion.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa bi tooi baŋ o.
en: But they did not know who he was.

dag: Di zaŋ ma ti n dimnima, dama ʒiri shɛhira diriba yiɣisimi lu n zuɣu, bɛ suhuri kul yɛla gadama niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Dont give me over to the desires of my enemies, because false witnesses and violent accusers have taken their stand against me.

dag: Banima n-lee zɔri yomyom kaman sagbana ŋɔ bee n-zɔri yomyom kaman ŋmani n-yiɣiri chani ni o ti kpe o tiɛɣu ni ŋɔ?.
en: Who are these who fly like a cloud, like doves to their shelters?.

dag: Yawɛ, a kul yɛn lihiri yɛlli maa la hal ni bɔ saha? Fam ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma maa nuu ni bahi. Fam n nyɛvili gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi!.
en: My Lord, how long will you watch this happen? Save my life from these people who are attacking me like lions and trying to destroy me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka yi yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, John has a demon in him.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa kpuɣila o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka gbaai Naawuni suhibu yɛra, M Ba, saha yipa paaya ni a chɛ ka a Bia nya jilima, ka a Bia maa gba chɛ ka a nya jilima.
en: After Jesus finished saying this, he looked up to heaven and said, Father, the hour has come. Give glory to your Son, so that the Son may give glory to you.

dag: O yi di be dunia ŋɔ ni, o naan ku nyɛla maligumaana hal baabiɛla, maligumaaniba bɛn zaŋdi pina maani maligu kaman Yɛhudianim zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni beni la zuɣu.
en: If he was located on earth, he wouldnt be a priest because there are already others who offer gifts based on the Law.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Yisa ka o be katiŋa, ka o guui ti damd o tooni.
en: When he saw Jesus from far away, he ran and knelt before him.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la mini bɛnkam zaa je ma la nuu ni bahi; dama bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari ma.
en: He saved me from my powerful enemies, who hated me. They were too strong for me, so he saved me.

dag: Daadam, Taainim ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba maa dunɔdaya kabisiya n-yooi yali ti ti pumpɔŋɔ. Mbo! di ni wurim doya ŋɔ zuɣu, ti ni tɔŋ.
en: Human one, because Tyre laughed at Jerusalem: The gate of the peoples is broken, she lies open before me, she is destroyed, but I will succeed.
