dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Bolim o na. Ka o daa boli paɣ maa, ka o kana ti zani dunol ni.
en: Elisha said, Call her. So Gehazi called her, and she stood at the door.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋun sani ka ti yɛn chaŋ? Nyini m-mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Simon Peter answered, Lord, where would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka naŋgbammalisimnim maa yɛtɔɣa zan tariga. Chɛ ka barinyuriba fo bɛ noya.
en: Let the LORD cut off all slick-talking lips and every tongue that brags and brags.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali shee zɔntua, ka di nyɛ mita anahi.
en: at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ. Ka Yisa daa ʒi omaŋmaŋ dapulli maa hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: Carrying his cross by himself, he went out to a place called Skull Place .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni bɔhim baŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni waawaayil la ni bɔri ni bɛ nya wuhibu, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Those who wander in spirit will have understanding, and those who grumble will gain insight.

dag: A ni yɛligi kpa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo, ka a niriba ni su zuliya shɛba, ka yi ti ʒini tin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ dabari la ni.
en: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.

dag: Dama ʒii maa saha na kparimi. Di yɛrila naabu saha yɛla, ka bi ŋmari ʒiri. Di yi ŋmanila di bi niŋdi yomyom, nyin kul guhim li. Biɛhiŋ kani, di ni niŋ, di ku yuui.
en: This message is about a special time in the future. This message is about the end, and it will come true. Just be patient and wait for it. That time will come; it will not be late.

dag: A biɛli n-nyɛ Samaria ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nuzaa polo la, ka a tizo nyɛ Sɔdom ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nudirigu polo la.
en: Your older sister, with her villages, is Samaria, in the north. Your younger sister, with her villages, is Sodom, in the south.

dag: Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi bee n sɔŋdiba bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ guliba bɛn doli ma la ni so daa bi yeei ti situra. Ti zaɣ yino kam daa kul gbibila o bidibbini o nudirigu ni.
en: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.

dag: Yawɛ kahig omaŋ wuhi, o kari saria ka tuumbiɛrinim maŋmaŋ nuhi tuma leei zana ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.

dag: Musa mini Izraɛlnim ni daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni n-kumdi saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl do so daa zaŋ Midian paɣ na ti kpe o suɣili ni bɛ zaa ninni.
en: An Israelite man brought a Midianite woman to his brothers in the sight of Moses and the entire Israelite community, who were weeping at the entrance of the meeting tent.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o ka o kabiri dari maa daa zaŋ o tahi Musa mini Aduna ni niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses, Aaron, and the entire community.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ni ti mali suhudoo. N ni ti ti o suhudoo o dimnim bɛn zaa gil o sani; dama o yuli nti yɛn booni Sulemaana. Ka n ni ti ti Izraɛlnim suhudoo, ka binshɛli ku lan dam ba o ʒiɛman ni.
en: He did, however, make me a promise. He said, You will have a son who will rule in peace, because I will give him peace from all his enemies. His name will be Solomon, because during his reign I will give Israel peace and security.

dag: Ka Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm tuma maa zaa min o ni daa me yil shɛl la.
en: The Queen was amazed at Solomon's wisdom. She was breathless when she saw his palace, the food on his table, his officials, his servants in their uniforms, the people who served his food, and the sacrifices he offered at the Lord 's temple.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tiŋ maa ni nɛma, ka gbahi niɣi pahi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Jɔshua shɛm.
en: The Israelites kept for themselves the livestock and goods captured in the city, as the Lord had told Joshua.

dag: Hashum daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihitaayika.
en: the descendants of Hashum:.

dag: Bɛ pakoya zooya gari teeku noli bihigu. N ku nachimba wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ bɛ manima, ka chɛ ka biɛrim mini dabiɛm lu bɛ zuɣu libigi ba.
en: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a zaligunim mali suhudoo pam; ka binshɛli ku chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu.
en: Those who love your law have perfect security, and there is nothing that can make them fall.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti wum li, dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan tum zaɣ biɛɣu lala tatabo yaha.
en: Then all the people of Israel will hear what happened; they will be afraid, and no one will ever again do such an evil thing.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so bahi maa so, dama zibisim ni ka o ŋmaligi labi, ka so ʒi o yɛla.
en: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you.

dag: Nandahimalana n-nyɛ ma! Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ma n ninsalitali biɛhigu din tahiri ma kum ni ŋɔ bahi?.
en: What an unhappy man I am! Who will rescue me from this body that is taking me to death?.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa pun niŋ yɛda kana nti kahigiri bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa wuhiri palɔni.
en: Many of the believers came, publicly admitting and revealing what they had done.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Pa ŋuna nti yɛn di a fali; amaŋmaŋ bia nti yɛn di a fali.
en: Then he heard the Lord speaking to him again: This slave Eliezer will not inherit your property; your own son will be your heir.

dag: Hal n ni kul mali yɛlimaŋli maa zaa yoli, bɛ boli ma ʒirilana. Hal n ni bi tum alahichi maa yoli, n dɔro maa ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: because of my cause Im thought a liar; my wound from an arrow is incurable, even though I didnt rebel.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o bahi noli ni bɛ niŋmi lala.
en: The king was sad, but because of the promise he had made in front of all his guests he gave orders that her wish be granted.

dag: Yi daa bi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee n-nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You did not have any food with you. You did not have any wine or anything else to drink. But he took care of you so that you would understand that he is the Lord your God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ninsalitali yubu ku tooi tiɣi Naawuni nini.
en: Those who obey their human nature cannot please God.

dag: ka o chɛ ka manna lu bɛ sanna ni bɛ di, ka o daa ti ba zuɣusaa bindirigu.
en: and rained manna on them so they could eat. He gave them the very grain of heaven!.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa la daa nya lala ka yiɣisi niriba maa ni kpuɣi kpani.
en: Phinehas was the son of Eleazar and the grandson of Aaron the priest. Phinehas saw this man bring the woman into camp. So he left the meeting and got his spear.

dag: N ni tilig a a niriba mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb sani n ni timd a maa nuu ni.
en: The Lord also said, I will protect you from the Jews and from the Gentiles that I am sending you to.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ Shia o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli bee n-saɣis o?.
en: Who could know the Lord s mind? Who could be his teacher or give him advice?.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shihi o kɔbili min o niŋgbuŋ pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: But stretch out your hand and strike his bones and flesh. Then he will definitely curse you to your face.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ŋme ma, amaa m bi nya daŋa. Bɛ bu ma, amaa di bi biɛra. Bɔ saha ka n nini yɛn neei? N lan bɔrila wain ni n nyu.
en: I must have been hit, you will say; I must have been beaten up, but I don't remember it. Why can't I wake up? I need another drink.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soya, ka chɛ ka m baŋ li.
en: Lord , help me learn your ways. Show me how you want me to live.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Ti ku tooi zaŋ ti tizɔpaɣ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun bi guni, dama lala nyɛla vi ti sani.
en: They said to him, We cannot let our sister marry a man who is not circumcised; that would be a disgrace for us.

dag: N kukoli daa niŋla kukol bila ka bi kpɛma, ka n daa bamdi kaman ŋmani la. N daa lihila zuɣusaa hal ka n nina ti fulim. N Duuma, yihim ma muɣisigu ŋɔ ni.
en: My voice was thin and weak, And I moaned like a dove. My eyes grew tired from looking to heaven. Lord , rescue me from all this trouble.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna maa tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: The governors soldiers took Jesus into the governors house, and they gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

dag: man Yawɛ daa yi katiŋa n-ka bɛ sanna. N kul yuri ya mi sahakam, dinzuɣu ka n kul gbibi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: From far away, the Lord will appear to his people. The Lord says, I love you people with a love that continues forever. That is why I have continued showing you kindness.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Gɛdalia naai yi biɛɣu ka so na bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: The day after Gedaliah was killed, before anyone knew of it.

dag: Amaa ka Ayuba garigi yɛl o, A yɛtɔɣa maa ŋmanila paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra la yɛtɔɣa. Ti deemi din viɛli Naawuni nuu ni, ka ku deei din bie dina? Yɛla ŋɔ zaa ni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi o noli yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: Job answered, You are talking nonsense! When God sends us something good, we welcome it. How can we complain when he sends us trouble? Even in all this suffering Job said nothing against God.

dag: Ka di ni daa be shɛm di saha maa, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ so kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bihi shɛm ni daa muɣisiri bɛ ni dɔɣ so Naawuni Shia yiko ni shɛm la, lala n-na kul nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But just as it was then, so it is now also: the one who was conceived the normal way harassed the one who was conceived by the Spirit.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ka n diri wahala, ka bɛ ba ma bandi kaman tuumbiɛrilana n-nyɛ ma la, amaa so ku tooi ba Naawuni yɛligu bandi.
en: Because I preach the Good News, I suffer and I am even chained like a criminal. But the word of God is not in chains.

dag: O daa bɔh o bipalitab maa mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli niriba bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛl a ba ni daa ʒil ti la? .
en: He asked, What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier.

dag: ka baŋdi ŋaha mini yɛliŋmahima din nyɛ yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ saliŋlɔha.
en: so that they can understand the hidden meanings of proverbs and the problems that the wise raise.

dag: Ka nanim mini bɛ tɔbbihi gbaai zɔbu! Ka paɣiba bɛn be yiŋa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa pirigi ti taba.
en: Kings and their armies are running away! The women at home divided what was captured:.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ daba ayi ha, n ni lan labisi Ɛlamnim nyamma ti ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But I promise that someday I will bring your people back to their land.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be tiŋ maa ni mini bɛn daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza la ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn zaa pahi kuli.
en: Then Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard exiled the people who were left in the city, those who had already surrendered to Babylons king, and the rest of the population.

dag: N ni lan labisi bɛ daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba, ka labisi Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi a gba maŋmaŋ daazichi ti a pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: I will improve the circumstances of Sodom and her daughters and the circumstances of Samaria and her daughters. And whats left of your fortune will go to them.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ tuma zaa kul wuhirila lala, bɛ zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, lala ka bɛ niŋd a gba maa.
en: Ever since I brought them out of Egypt, they have turned away from me and worshiped other gods; and now they are doing to you what they have always done to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Giliad mini Bashan ni di fɔntinsi ni zaa ni Sharɔn tiŋgban ni luɣ shɛŋa din daa mali biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zaa.
en: The people in the tribe of Gad lived in the area of Gilead. They lived in the area of Bashan, in the small towns around Bashan, and in all the pastures in the area of Sharon all the way to the borders.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ gabiga tu o nyee ni bee n-zaŋ goo kuh o yɛno pili yi?.
en: Can you put a rope through his snout or put a hook through his jaws?.

dag: Yi ni di bindira, amaa ka ku tiɣi, ka kum na kul ni mali ya. Yi ni ti zaŋ yi binyara sɔɣi, amaa ka di ku tiligi. Ka yi yi ti zali binshɛŋa, n ni chɛ ka tɔbu di li.
en: You devour, but you arent satisfied; a gnawing emptiness is within you. You put something aside, but you dont keep it safe. That which you do try to keep safe, I will give to the sword.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛlnim zaa lala.
en: This, then, is what Moses said to Aaron, the sons of Aaron, and to all the people of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa, Jɔn Baptaizira mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli waawaayili ka suhiri Naawuni, amaa ka nyin nyaandoliba bɛn kul diri ka nyura.
en: Some people said to Jesus, John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.

dag: Ka piɛguliba shɛb daa kana ti kari ba, amaa ka Musa daa yiɣisi zab bɛ zuɣu ka niŋ kom ti bɛ piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: But some shepherds drove Jethro's daughters away. Then Moses went to their rescue and watered their animals for them.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, jɛra kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. So bi mi din yɛn niŋ, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛl o kpee din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha?.
en: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: Other people are like the seed planted on rocky ground. They hear the teaching, and they quickly and gladly accept it.

dag: Pinimiya yi zabiri bahi, ka kumiya kuyila zoya zuɣu, dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ya, ka zaŋ ya bahi, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi ŋɔ.
en: Jeremiah, cut off your hair and throw it away. Go up to the bare hilltop and cry, because the Lord has rejected this generation of people. He has turned his back on these people. And in anger he will punish them.

dag: Bɛ nini daa nya Yawɛ tuma din nyɛ o daalahiziba tuma la teeku bulli maa ni.
en: They saw what the LORD had made; they saw his wondrous works in the depths of the sea.

dag: Ka Shupim mini Hupim daa nyɛ Iri bidibisi, ka Hushim mi daa nyɛ Ahɛr bidibiga.
en: Shuppim and Huppim also belonged to this tribe. Dan had one son, Hushim.

dag: Filistianim maa daa du n-tamla zoli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli polo ka Izraɛlnim mi tam zoli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli polo, ka vinvamli be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines took positions on one hill while Israel took positions on the opposite hill. There was a valley between them.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayɔbu ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka Yisa daa chaŋla Bɛtani din nyɛ o ni daa neei Lazarɔs so la ni daa be tin shɛl la.
en: Six days before the Passover festival, Jesus went to Bethany. That is where Lazarus lived, the man Jesus raised from death.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa mali hal ti zooi, ka Yawɛ be o sani, ka chɛ ka o yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: So Samuel grew up, and the LORD was with him, not allowing any of his words to fail.

dag: Ka Pool daa mirig o nina kpa jintɔriba maa ka yɛli, M mabihi, m bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: Paul looked straight at the Council and said, My fellow Israelites! My conscience is perfectly clear about the way in which I have lived before God to this very day.

dag: Bɔhimi Midiannim biɛri ti Izraɛlnima. Di nyaaŋa n ni deeg a nyɛvili.
en: Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.

dag: N yi nyɛla tuumbiɛ tumda bee n yi tumla tuun shɛli din simdi kum, m bi bɔri soli ni n yi di ni; bɛ ni fiɣisiri ma shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ zaa yi nyɛla ʒiri, so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni. N ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani.
en: If I had done something deserving death, I would not ask to escape the death penalty. But I am not guilty of any of these crimes, and no one has the right to hand me over to these people. I now ask to be tried by the Emperor himself.

dag: Ka Ahitɔfɛl daa ti lan yɛli Absalom yaha, Chɛ ka m pii niriba tuhi pinaayi n-zaŋ ba biɛhi Dauda naba yuŋ ŋɔ.
en: Not long after that, Ahithophel said to Absalom, Let me choose twelve thousand men, and tonight I will set out after David.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, dama so kani ŋun bi tumd alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ gbahi ba daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ katiŋa bee yoma.
en: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.

dag: Yi yi yihi di ni zaɣ viɛla zaka ka di li, yi bi tum taali. Amaa miriya ka yi ta Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri; yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: And if you always give the best part of it to the Lord, you will never be guilty. You will always remember that these gifts are the holy offerings from the Israelites. And you will not die.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, garim niriba maa tooni leei bɛ zuɣulana ka yi lan gbaai soli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni.
en: The Lord said to me, Go and lead the people on their trip. They will go in and live in the land that I promised to give to their ancestors.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba sani ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi gbaai o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: and he went and talked with the leading priests and some of the soldiers who guarded the Temple. He talked to them about a way to hand Jesus over to them.

dag: Miriya ka yi zura bee n-niŋdi tab bilikɔnsi bee ŋ-ŋmar tab ʒiri.
en: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu; ka o chɛ ka bɛ ŋme ba tɔbu, ka di be kaman buɣim la gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ di daliri, ka di di ba kaman buɣim la, amaa ka bɛ bi lihi li ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: So he made us feel the force of his anger and suffer the violence of war. Like fire his anger burned throughout Israel, but we never knew what was happening; we learned nothing at all from it.

dag: Di simdi ka tan tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi, di simdi ka tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu nyɛ yim.
en: Make each piece twelve meters long and two meters wide.

dag: Di simdi ni yi teei anab suma ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-zal la mini ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira zaligu shɛl o ni zaŋ ti yi tuumba la ni be zaŋ yɛli ya la yɛla.
en: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui, ka sokam daa zo n-kul o yiŋa. Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama Izraɛlnim tɔbbi tinchandib tuhi pihita ka bɛ daa ku.
en: So the Philistines fought. Israel was defeated, and everyone fled to their homes. It was a massive defeat: thirty thousand Israelite foot soldiers fell.

dag: Di yuri gbihibu, di yi pa lala fara ni gbaag a. Neem a nina, a ni nya bindirigu pam.
en: If you spend your time sleeping, you will be poor. Keep busy and you will have plenty to eat.

dag: Tɔrokɔnim maa zaa daa malila daanya gbaya mini daanya spindilinima, ka di yaɣa anahi maa zaa mali taha tambu shee. Ka o daa niŋ biŋgolima niŋ taha maa tambu shee kam polo.
en: Each cart had four bronze wheels with bronze axles. At the corners there were bronze supports for a large bowl. The supports had designs of flowers hammered into the bronze.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza tɔbbihi maa ni daa teei gili Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, ka ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza maŋmaŋ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: During the siege Nebuchadnezzar himself came to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: So in my anger I made this vow: They will never enter my land of rest.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyɛla Masia tuumba bɛn ʒe o zaani, ka Naawuni be ti ni n-kul booni niriba. Lala zuɣu ka ti kul ʒe Masia zaani n-suhiri ya yɛra, Zaŋmiya yimaŋa n-naai Naawuni.
en: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.

dag: Buɣim be bɛ tooni dira ka buɣim zilima be bɛ nyaaŋa polo dira, ka tiŋgbani din be bɛ tooni be kaman Idɛn puu la, amaa ka bɛ nyaaŋa polo ŋmani tiŋgban nɛli, ka binshɛli kani n-ni tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma ka bi zaɣis o ba min o ma ni o paɣa ni o mabi dɔbba ni o tizɔpaɣiba ni hal zaŋ tabili omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili gba, o ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: You cannot be my disciple, unless you love me more than you love your father and mother, your wife and children, and your brothers and sisters. You cannot follow me unless you love me more than you love your own life.

dag: Kɛros ni Siaha ni Padɔn ni.
en: Keros, Siaha, Padon.

dag: N kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: I praise you, Lord ! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Maika ni chɛ ka n niŋdi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O bu ma la paa ka n nyɛ o maligumaana.
en: The young man told them what Micah had done for him. Micah hired me, he said. I am his priest.

dag: Naa ni daa nyo Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Baruk yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka o sabi li niŋ gban shɛli ni maa buɣim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: After King Jehoiakim had burned the scroll that I had dictated to Baruch, the Lord told me.

dag: Yi ni zaŋdi yi pin shɛŋa na maa ka buchi. Chɛliya li zaŋbuna. Yi tulaale zim nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu n sani. Yi goli palli churi puhibu mini vuhim dabisa ni yi ni booni laɣiŋgu shɛŋa puuni, n je alahichi ni be yi jɛmbu laɣiŋgu shɛŋa ni.
en: Dont keep bringing me those worthless sacrifices. I hate the incense you give me. I cannot stand your festivals for the New Moon, the Sabbath, and other special meeting days. I hate the evil you do during those holy times together.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, Di deei bɛ sara maligu. N na ʒi n-deei bɛ so buŋa, m mi na ʒi n-niŋ bɛ ni so zaɣ biɛ shɛli.
en: So Moses became very angry. He said to the Lord , I never did anything wrong to these people. I never took anything from them—not even a donkey! Dont accept their gifts.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa na kpalim be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka be luɣ shɛlikam, nimaani niriba bɛn sɔŋmi ba n-ti ba anzinfa mini salima ni nɛma m-pahi biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ suhuyubu pina, ka bɛ zaŋ ti tum Naawuni duu maa tuma Jɛrusalɛm.
en: If any of his people in exile need help to return, their neighbors are to give them this help. They are to provide them with silver and gold, supplies and pack animals, as well as offerings to present in the Temple of God in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma daa zani n nyaaŋa, ka ti ma yaa ka m mol lahibal suŋ molo zaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa wum li. Ti Duuma daa yihi ma gbuɣinli nol ni.
en: But the Lord stood by me and gave me strength, so that the entire message would be preached through me and so all the nations could hear it. I was also rescued from the lions mouth!.

dag: Nyin ka n kuhiri niŋda. Tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: I call to you; save me, and I will keep your laws.

dag: N kuhimi hal ka n nimbihi ti fulim. Di biɛri m puuni. Bɛ ni ku n niriba shɛm maa zuɣu, n suhu saɣimmi, dama biliɛri mini biyaɣilima tarigimi lu tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu.
en: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.

dag: O daa kul chanila buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini nti maani maligu ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: He also sacrificed and burned incense at the shrines on every hill and beneath every shady tree.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ti dɔni ni yi tuhi yi dimnima, yin gbaamiya yimaŋa ni zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: When your army goes to fight against your enemies, stay away from everything that would make you unclean.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim ninʒeensinim ŋɔ, tɛhimiya ka naanyi bahi yoli, dama n tum tuun karili yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, tuun kar shɛli so ni yɛli ya di yɛla ka yi ku niŋ yɛda. .
en: Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom biŋkɔb so yo o samli; nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: Whoever kills an animal that belongs to another person must give another animal to take its place.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka shihir bɔ ka a yɛn wuhi ka ti nya ka niŋ a yɛda? Alahiziba tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda?.
en: They replied, What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛhab bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anu saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la daa di nam.
en: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah. He began to rule in the fifth year that Joram son of Ahab was king of Israel.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa o biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Naawuni la.
en: You must press your hand on the head of the offering and slaughter it before the meeting tent. Aarons sons will toss the blood against every side of the altar.

dag: Ka luɣa ni duri maa dunoya daa yoori bahiri pal shɛli din daa kpalim polo. Duno yini daa kpala nuzaa polo, ka duno din la mi kpa nudirigu polo. Ka pal shɛli din daa guui yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili.
en: The doors of the side rooms opened onto the raised base. There was one entrance on the north side and one entrance on the south side. The raised base was cubits wide all around.

dag: bomiya kom na ti ti kɔnyuri ni mali shɛba. Yinim Tɛma tiŋgbɔŋnima, bomiya bindira ti kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba.
en: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.

dag: Amaa bɛ nimdi nyɛla yi dini kaman bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu nyɔɣu polo mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli gahiri zuɣusaa mini nudirigu gbalipaɣa ni nyɛ yi dini shɛm la.
en: But the meat from these animals will be yours. And also the breast that was lifted up to the Lord will be yours. And the right thigh from other offerings will be yours.

dag: Bee nir ni tooi no buɣimsal nɛɔŋ ka di ku nyoog o napɔŋ?.
en: Can you walk on hot coals without burning your feet?.

dag: So ni tooi fa tɔbbihi ni tuhi tɔbu di binshɛŋa bɛ sani bee n-fa daba na biɛɣu nuu ni?.
en: If a strong soldier takes a prisoner, can you set him free? If a powerful soldier guards someone, can the prisoner escape?.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nyɛla n tizɔdoo ŋun daa mɔɣi m ma bihili! N yi di nya a samban ni, n naan mɔɣis a noli ka so ku galim ma.
en: If only you were as my brother— the one who nursed at my mothers breast. I would find you in the street and kiss you, and no one would shame me for it.

dag: Ka Aduna daa miri sara maligu bimbini maa nti kɔrigi omaŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo naɣila polli maa.
en: Aaron went to the altar and killed the young bull which was for his own sin offering.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, man Rut m-bala. Kpuɣim ma leeg a paɣa, dama a nyɛla n dɔɣira ŋun ni tooi gbib ma.
en: Who are you? he asked. It's Ruth, sir, she answered. Because you are a close relative, you are responsible for taking care of me. So please marry me.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa garigi bɔhi Yawɛ, Ayuba Naawuni zɔbo maa nyɛla yoli?.
en: Why shouldn't he respect you? Satan remarked.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnima, N ni darigi yi tibili, ka n ni yɛn niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu, malimiya shili gu man ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Truly, Israel, I will act in this way toward you; therefore, I will do this to you. Prepare to meet your God, Israel!.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ so ŋunkam mali salima yihi li na. Ka bɛ daa yihi li na ti ti ma, ka n zaŋ li bahi buɣim ni, ka naɣibil ŋɔ yina.
en: So I told the people, If you have any gold rings, then give them to me. The people gave me their gold. I threw the gold into the fire, and out of the fire came this calf.

dag: Di pa shɛli Judanim yi wum n ni lo ni n niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ yɛla bɛ zaa ni chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ daalahichi taali.
en: Maybe the people of Judah will hear what I am planning to do to them and will stop doing bad things. If they will do that, I will forgive them for the terrible sins they have committed.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa maa ka zuɣulan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛl o, M bipuɣiŋga n-na kul yoli kpi; amaa kamina nti zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu ka o lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: While Jesus was saying this, a Jewish official came to him, knelt down before him, and said, My daughter has just died; but come and place your hands on her, and she will live.

dag: Ka yi ni daa be Kadɛshibarinia, ka Yawɛ tim ya ka yɛli ya, Chamiya ti deei n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa, ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu maa, ka bi niŋ o yɛda bee n-deeg o yɛligu.
en: And when he sent you from Kadesh Barnea with orders to go and take possession of the land that he was giving you, you rebelled against him; you did not trust him or obey him.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa yi gbaag a piɛɣu, m bi zaŋd o na ti wuhir a, amaa n daa yi gbaarila mmaŋmaŋ piɛɣu zal o zaani. Bɛ daa yi zu binshɛli wuntaŋ ni bee yuŋ, a chɛrimi ka n yo a li.
en: Any time a sheep was killed by wild animals, I always paid for the loss myself. I did not take the dead animal to you and say that it was not my fault. But I was robbed day and night.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di?.
en: What advantage do people have if they gain the whole world for themselves yet perish or lose their lives?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntinsi pia Ifriim mini Dan ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgbana ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: The other members of the Kohath clans received towns from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and West Manasseh.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa tim tumo ni o yim na ti yɛli Naaman ni o cham Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti mim di ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni ka o nya alaafee.
en: Elisha sent out a messenger who said, Go and wash seven times in the Jordan River. Then your skin will be restored and become clean.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri lala saha shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan, ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Abiata bia la dii paana. Ka Adɔnija yɛl o, Kpɛmina, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka ʒiri lahiba suŋ na.
en: Before he finished speaking, Jonathan, the son of the priest Abiathar, arrived. Come on in, Adonijah said. You're a good man—you must be bringing good news.

dag: Nandaamba yi kuhira ka a baɣa kani, a gba ni ti kuhira ka so ku wum.
en: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ku lan lihiri Ijiptinim ninni bɔri sɔŋsim. Bɛ yi ti teei din daa niŋ Ijiptinim maa yɛla, di saha bɛ ni baŋ bɛ ni daa bɔri sɔŋsim bɛ sani maa galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: The house of Israel will never again bring guilt on itself by faithlessly turning to Egypt for help, for they will know that I am the LORD God.

dag: Zaŋmiya dari mali sara maligu bimbini maa, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu. Malimiya li kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Make the altar with planks but hollow inside. All these should be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

dag: A pun mali paɣa? Di bɔri soli ni a yih o. A na ka paɣa? Di bo paɣa.
en: If you have a wife, dont try to get free from her. If you are not married, dont try to find a wife.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun bɔhim o yɛla, ka yi ni nyɛ o nyaandoliba la zuɣu, bɛ daa pun wuhiya yɛlimaŋ shɛli din be Yisa ni maa.
en: I know that you heard about him, and in him you were taught the truth. Yes, the truth is in Jesus.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai Saimɔn Pita sani, ka Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, a yɛn paɣila n naba.
en: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, Are you going to wash my feet, Lord.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ ti kpuɣi pagɔrili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani.
en: A priest shall not marry a woman who has been a prostitute or a woman who is not a virgin or who is divorced; he is holy.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Job responded.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa niŋ Naa Ahaz ni yɛli ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Uriah did everything Ahaz told him.

dag: Yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Tiligim ti a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu!.
en: Stand up! Help us! Save us for the sake of your faithful love.

dag: M mabihi, fiig tia ni tooi wali olivi tia wala bee gaa ni tooi wali fiig tia wala? Lala ka ko nyaɣisili ku tooi yi ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ ni na.
en: My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree produce olives? Can a grapevine produce figs? Of course not, and fresh water doesnt flow from a saltwater spring either.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb zaa ka va anzinfa mini salim shɛŋa la pahi di zuɣu ti Yawɛ.
en: King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations that he had subdued.

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka ninsalinim tuma mini bɛ baŋsim puuni, bɛ zabirila tab nyuli. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I also observed that people work hard and become good at what they do only out of mutual envy. This too is pointless, just wind chasing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: His body was carried back to Jerusalem on a horse and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi wumbu, n ni kum ashilɔni yi karimbaani maa zuɣu. N ni kum pam hal ka nintam ti zɔri n nina ni, bɛ ni gbahi Yawɛ niriba leei daba maa zuɣu.
en: If you will not listen, I will cry in secret because of your pride; I will cry bitterly, and my tears will flow because the Lord 's people have been taken away as captives.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan malila chɛchɛbunsi yuri duri tuhi pihinahi; ka mali wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi.
en: Solomon had , stalls of chariot horses and , chariot soldiers.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jehoram did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo nti kpe fɔŋ ni n-yɛli niriba dinkam daa niŋ maa mini din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu maa yɛla zaa.
en: Those who tended the pigs ran into the city and told everything that had happened to the demon-possessed men.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daantalisi maa sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdali luɣa zuɣu; yini daa sala nudirigu polo, ka din la mi sa nuzaa polo. Ka bɛ daa boli din sa nudirigu polo maa Jachin, ka boli din sa nuzaa polo maa mi Bɔaz.
en: Solomon had one of the columns placed on the south side of the temple's entrance; it was called Jachin. The other one was placed on the north side of the entrance; it was called Boaz.

dag: tarimtali ni maŋgbibbutali. Ka zaligu shɛli kani din galindi dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against things like this.

dag: N zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ n suhu ni, ka zahim di zaa nya wuntizɔriba mini yɛnnim tuma ni be Naawuni nuu ni shɛm. Di yi nyɛ yurilim bee jɛlinsi, so ku tooi baŋ. Binshɛɣukam din paari ba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: So I considered all of this carefully, examining all of it: The righteous and the wise and their deeds are in Gods hand, along with both love and hate. People dont know anything thats ahead of them.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so ti ni buɣisi waawaayili n-nya ka o nyɛla ŋun suhu kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla pam puuni la n-dolisiri ba na. Ka pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun suhu na kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu gari lala, o ni niŋ ya naani pam la zuɣu.
en: Also, we are sending with them our brother who is always ready to help. He has proved this to us in many ways. And he wants to help even more now because he has much faith in you.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpuɣimiya yi bɔɣiri din zali ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka kpaŋsi yi dun gbarima ŋɔ.
en: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n suhu piɛla, ka m paɣiri Naawuni pam. Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, n niŋgbuŋ gba mali tahima;.
en: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nti yɛn nyɛ o suhu ni yuri shɛli. O ti ku kari nimmira saria bee n-kari, Bɛ yɛliya, saria.
en: and find pleasure in obeying him. He will not judge by appearance or hearsay;.

dag: Di saha ka yi mini kum zɔri la saɣim, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee alikauli la yiɣisi. Di nyaaŋa alɔbo yi ti lu, di ni din ya.
en: Your deal with death will be dissolved, and your pact with the grave wont stand. The rushing flood: when it passes through, you will be annihilated by it.

dag: Yɛm mini kpiɔŋ zaa bela Naawuni sani, ŋuna m-mali ninkurilim mini baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.

dag: Nir ni tooi di o ba min o ma yili mini bɛ buni fali, amaa yidaampaɣ so ŋun mali yɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord .

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka saa ku n-zibigi, ka pɔhim gbaai ʒiɛbu, ka sa kurili dii piligi mibu. Ka Ɛhab daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-zo nti kpe Jɛziriil.
en: After a short time the sky was covered with dark clouds. The wind began to blow, and a heavy rain began to fall. Ahab got in his chariot and started back to Jezreel.

dag: N ni daa wum bɛ fabila maa mini bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.

dag: A yi ni chɛ ka ti tizo maa dol ti chaŋ, ti ni chaŋ ti da bindira maa na ti a;.
en: If you send Benjamin with us, we will go down and buy grain.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yo Aruna salima laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu o kabɔɣili maa zuɣu.
en: So David gave Araunah about pounds of gold for the place.

dag: Amaa hal Taitus ŋun daa be n san la ni daa kul nyɛ Giriiki maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi muɣis o ni o guni.
en: Titus, who was with me, is a Greek. But these leaders still did not force him to be circumcised.

dag: A daa ku m bihi nyo buɣim mali buɣa maa.
en: You slaughtered my sons and then passed them through the fire to those false gods.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni tahir o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: The people who were going along with Jesus told the man to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, Son of David, have pity on me.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti ku ninvuɣ biɛri la tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka darigi yihi bɛn bi ʒe yim di ni.
en: But the wicked will be forced to leave. Those who lie and cheat will be thrown out of the land.

dag: Bɛ bo n-nya ma pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ teemi gili ma, bɛ lihirimi bɔri bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli n-voo ma luhi.
en: They are around me now, wherever I turn, watching for a chance to pull me down.

dag: Ka gbarigu maa daa kul vili Pita mini Jɔn gbibi kirikiri, ka di niŋ niriba alahiziba, ka bɛ kab doli ba hal ni kazal shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni.
en: The man was holding on to Peter and John. All the people were amazed. They ran to Peter and John at Solomons Porch.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ni o ni zo ti yaannim nambɔɣu shɛm la niŋ pali, ka teeg o daalikauli suŋ.
en: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila bɛ suhuri ni, Ti kul ku vuui; ʒiɛmani kam puuni muɣisigu shɛli ku paai ti.
en: They think to themselves, Well never stumble. Well never encounter any resistance.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti kani tin shɛli din yuli booni Kalɛb Ɛfirata la ni nyaaŋa ka o pakoli Abija daa dɔɣi Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa ba la.
en: After Hezrons death, Caleb went to Ephrath. Abijah, Hezrons wife, bore him Ashhur, Tekoas father.

dag: Amaa di yɛliya tammɛriba zuɣulaannim maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di laɣ shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti ba maa laasabu n-wuhi ya, dama bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: They are honest, so we won't ask them to keep track of the money.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tia dari m-mali pund ayi n-zaŋ yo Luɣ Kasi shee din be puuni la ha dunoli, ka dapaɣili din pa dunoli maa zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira dasara daa mulisi ka mali yaɣ anu.
en: The two doors to the most holy place were made out of olive wood and were decorated with carvings of palm trees, flowers, and winged creatures. The doors and the carvings were covered with gold. The door frame came to a point at the top.

dag: ka be yi tanti suɣa ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni yɛra, Yawɛ ni je ti maa zuɣu ka o daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni o ti zaŋ ti niŋ Amɔrinim ŋɔ nuu ni ka bɛ ku ti.
en: You went to your tents and began to complain. You said, The Lord hates us! He brought us out of the land of Egypt just to let the Amorites destroy us.

dag: Saa malila ba? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣi maligim din tɔɣiri luri ŋɔ?.
en: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?.

dag: O ni daa mali tɔrokɔnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: di daa malila dapaɣa, ka o zaŋ li kpɛhi firimnim ni.
en: The sides were made with panels attached to frames decorated with flower designs. The panels themselves were decorated with figures of lions, bulls, and winged creatures.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yi naa maa sani, zaŋ chaŋ o ti yɛn paai zɔn titali sunsuuni ka Yawɛ yɛl o.
en: Before Isaiah had left the middle courtyard, he received this message from the Lord .

dag: ka di leei nyɛvili a sani, ka leei nachiinsi bini a nyiŋgol ni.
en: They will be life for your whole being, and an ornament for your neck.

dag: Ka sokam daa nya o ni chani ka paɣiri Naawuni maa.
en: The people there saw him walking and praising God.

dag: Di saha maa ka naa daa bahi Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya noli, ka o chaŋ ti ŋme Shimɛi luhi ka o kpi. Di saha ka nam maa daa nya zaashee zani Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: Then the king gave orders to Benaiah, who went out and killed Shimei. Solomon was now in complete control.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Yisa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ ni shɛb yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la.
en: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, He must be the Prophet.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ba ka bɛ doli tipawumli soya n-tumdi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni yu shɛm.
en: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi boli nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ o gbaɣino ʒira yomyom yɛl o, Ŋoom a takɔbi kuhi ku ma, di yi pa lala, niriba ni yɛli ni paɣa n-ku ma. Ka o nachimbil maa daa shiri zaŋ o takɔbi kuh o, ka o kpi.
en: The soldier who carried his weapons was nearby, and Abimelech told him, Take out your sword and kill me. I don't want people to say that I was killed by a woman! So the soldier ran his sword through Abimelech.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɛ suɣa wulimpuhili polo kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒiishee nyɛ luɣ shɛli n-nyɛ: Juda zuliya. Juda niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Aminadab bia Nashɔn.
en: On the east side toward the sunrise will be the banner of Judahs camp with its military units. The chief of the people of Judah is Nahshon, Amminadabs son.

dag: Mani n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka nam ninsalinim niŋ di ni. N nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa, ka su binshɛɣukam din be nimaani fukumsi.
en: I made the earth, and I created the people on it. I used my own hands to make the skies. And I command all the armies in the sky.

dag: Dama n wumla kuhigu kaman paɣa n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la. Ka di biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn tuui dɔɣi la. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi vuhibu ka kuhira, ka teeg o nuhi ka yɛra, Mbusim paai ma! N tarigiri lurila bɛn yɛn ku ma tooni. .
en: I hear a cry like a woman in labor, a scream like a woman giving birth to her first baby. It is the cry of daughter Zion. She is lifting her hands in prayer, saying, Oh! I am about to faint! Murderers are all around me.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Firawuna, Zalim ma saha shɛli a ni bɔri ni n suhi Naawuni ti a min a niriba ni a kpamba zaa, ka poloya maa kpi yi yinsi, ka chɛla bɛn be Nail Mɔɣili ni la kɔŋko.
en: Moses replied, I will be glad to pray for you. Just set the time when I am to pray for you, your officers, and your people. Then you will be rid of the frogs, and there will be none left except in the Nile.

dag: Ka ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun bɔri ni a paŋ o binshɛli, nyin paŋm o.
en: Give to those who ask, and dont refuse those who wish to borrow from you.

dag: n-saɣim di tinsi maa mini di vinvamli zaa ni tinsi maa niriba zaa ni tiŋgban ni bimbilli kam zaa.
en: and destroyed them and the whole valley, along with all the people there and everything that grew on the land.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ŋɔ, yi diri jɛra suɣilo ni suhupiɛlli!.
en: Because you, who are so wise, are happy to put up with fools.

dag: N ni bo zuɣulaannim bɛn ni guli ba, ka bɛ ku lan zɔri dabiɛm bee n-gbarigi bee ka bɛ ni so ti bɔrigi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will appoint rulers to take care of them. My people will no longer be afraid or terrified, and I will not punish them again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka o dan maa daa nya ka Yawɛ be Yisifu sani, ka chɛ ka o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa tɔŋda.
en: who saw that the Lord was with Joseph and had made him successful in everything he did.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o ba, Wɛi, n zuɣu n-yaara, n zuɣu n-yaara! Ka bia maa ba yɛl o tumtumdi so, Zaŋm bia maa kuli ti ti o ma.
en: The boy said to his father, Oh, my head! My head hurts! The father said to his servant, Carry him to his mother.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm ti ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ. Ti mali niriba anahi bɛn po pɔri.
en: So we will tell you what to do: Four of our men have made a vow to God.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti kaman o ni lo shɛm o suhu ni, ka pa ni yolitim bee muɣisigu zuɣu, dama Naawuni yurila ŋun tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli.
en: You should each give, then, as you have decided, not with regret or out of a sense of duty; for God loves the one who gives gladly.

dag: Ka Biliha daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: Bilhah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Jacob.

dag: Niriba turi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋdi bindira sɔɣira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔhir li mali alibarika.
en: People curse someone who hoards grain, waiting for a higher price, but they praise the one who puts it up for sale.

dag: Yisa ni daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni lan baai du duli ha nti ʒe teeku noli ka salo pam daa lan laɣim o sanna.
en: Jesus went back across to the other side of the lake. There at the lakeside a large crowd gathered around him.

dag: Ka Judanim daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana ti liri ti? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo Samsin mihi n-zaŋ o chaŋ ti niŋ o o ni niŋ ti shɛm labisi.
en: The people of Judah asked, Why have you marched up against us? Weve marched up to take Samson prisoner, they replied, and to do to him just what he did to us.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi di ni daa fo n-dɔni baalim maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ ba na ti zali bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ zani kulino shɛl ni.
en: The sailors were happy that the sea became calm, and he led them safely to where they wanted to go.

dag: Haman daa lan yɛli, Ka din gari lala nyɛla, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ Napaɣ Ɛsta ni boli so pahi naa zuɣu ni ti kana nti di bindira ka nyu binnyura. Hal o lan bol ti ni ti sa labina biɛɣuni yaha.
en: Best of all, Haman said, Queen Esther has invited no one else but me to join the king for food and drinks that she has prepared. In fact, Ive been called to join the king at her place tomorrow!.

dag: Di saha ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A ni nyɛ n dɔɣira maa zuɣu, a yɛn tumla tuma ti ma yoli? Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n yo a shɛm.
en: Laban said to Jacob, You shouldn't work for me for nothing just because you are my relative. How much pay do you want.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ, a dimnim taala duŋ; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a gba mal a gadama.
en: because—look!—your enemies are growling; those who hate you are acting arrogantly.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihitaayika n-daa be bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛ zuɣulana n-daa nyɛ Zabidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hagɛdolim bia la.
en: There were members of this clan who were outstanding soldiers. Their leader was Zabdiel, a member of a leading family.

dag: O saria dibu dolila yɛlimaŋli soli ni din tuhi. O kari pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun zaŋ o zina niŋbu n-saɣim dunia la saria, ka bɔh o biɛri ti o ni daa yihi ŋun Naawuni dab shɛb ʒim la.
en: True and just are his judgments! He has condemned the prostitute who was corrupting the earth with her immorality. God has punished her because she killed his servants.

dag: O daa lan wuh o o ni ti yɛn piri maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma zaa shɛm ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋdi tumdi tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all their responsibilities within the LORDs temple, and for all the equipment used in its service.

dag: Ka o daa ka kɔbo din ni yo, ka naa maa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm sandira maa min o paɣa ni o bihi n-tabil o ni mali shɛlikam zaa ti kɔhi na nti yo o samli maa.
en: The servant did not have enough to pay his debt, so the king ordered him to be sold as a slave, with his wife and his children and all that he had, in order to pay the debt.

dag: Nyama, n dabili ni tɔŋ. Bɛ ni duh o, ka ti o jilima pam.
en: Look, my servant will succeed. He will be exalted and lifted very high.

dag: Ka malaika maa lan yɛli Zakaria, Mani n-nyɛ malaika Gabirɛl ŋun ʒe Naawuni tooni la, ka o tim ma na ni n ti ti a lahibal suŋ ŋɔ.
en: The angel answered, I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.

dag: O daba maa bihi ni ti su li, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ti be nimaani.
en: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.

dag: Naawuni tim a sakom din mal alibarika, ka chɛ ka a tiŋgbani vuhira. Naawuni tim a kawana mini wain pam.
en: May God give you showers from the sky, olive oil from the earth, plenty of grain and new wine.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ baŋya ni binshɛɣukam a ni zaŋ ti ma la yila a sanna;.
en: Now they know that everything I have came from you.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ bɛ fɔntin titali din mali yaa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni di nyɛla goon shɛli din du pam.
en: The riches of the wealthy are a strong city and like a high wall in their imagination.

dag: Dama Jɛrɔbɔam min o bidibisi daa kari ba mi ni bɛ di lan tum Yawɛ maligumaaniba tuma. Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ tiŋgbana ni n-chɛ bɛ binshɛɣukam ka kuli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The Levites abandoned their pastures and other land and moved to Judah and Jerusalem, because King Jeroboam of Israel and his successors would not let them serve as priests of the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn diri wahala ka di nyɛ Naawuni yubu la kul tumdi din tuhi, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya niŋ bɛ Namda ŋun kul ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa la nuu ni.
en: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ kahig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi tuun shɛŋa din bi doli wuntia soli mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ninsalinim ni tumdi zuɣu wuhi, dama bɛ zaŋdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa guri yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: God's anger is revealed from heaven against all the sin and evil of the people whose evil ways prevent the truth from being known.

dag: Di saha ka Finɛhas daa yiɣisi zani n-tim sandaani ka alɔbo maa chɛ.
en: But Phinehas stood up and punished the guilty, and the plague was stopped.

dag: O gba daa dolila Naa Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba, dama o ma n-daa nyɛ o saawaralana n-wuhir o ka o tumdi tuumbiɛri.
en: and she encouraged her son to sin against the Lord . He followed the evil example of King Ahab and his descendants.

dag: Ka ti daa ti laɣim bakɔi piligu dali ni ti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro n-laɣim di Ti Duuma Bindirigu, ka Pool ni daa lɔri ni biɛɣu neei ka o chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa tɔɣisi ba Naawuni soli yɛla hal ni yuntisuɣu.
en: On Sunday we all met together to eat the Lords Supper. Paul talked to the group. Because he was planning to leave the next day, he continued talking until midnight.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa la zuɣu. Dama bɛ suhuri daa kul bela bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: I said this because they had not only ignored my laws and teachings, but had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped idols.

dag: ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mali suhukpeeni daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti zaŋ Sool min o bihi maa niŋgbuna maa chaŋ Jabɛshi nti zaŋ ba sɔɣi Jabɛshi oki tia gbini, ka daa lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Azariah did what the Lord said was right, just as his father Amaziah had done.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: Then, when the sun came up, it burned the young plants; and because the roots had not grown deep enough, the plants soon dried up.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.

dag: Bɔ saha ka ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋum niŋ ma? N wum ŋumaŋuma shɛli Izraɛlnim maa ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma maa.
en: How much longer are these wicked people going to complain against me? I have heard enough of these complaints!.

dag: Daadam, n yɛn zaŋla a ni yuri ninvuɣ so pam yim ka chɛ a. Amaa miri ka a ti fabili bee n-kum bee n-chɛ ka nintam yi a ninni.
en: Son of man, you love your wife very much, but I am going to take her away from you. Your wife will die suddenly, but you must not show your sadness. You must not cry loudly. You will cry and your tears will fall.

dag: yin piimiya yi dan bidibisi maa ni ŋun be viɛnyɛla ka simdi ni o niŋ naa n-zaŋ o ʒil o ba nam ʒiishee; ka tuhi sɔŋ yi naa maa daŋ niriba.
en: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.

dag: N dana, ka so yi ti dol a ni o ku a, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun zaŋm a nyɛvili ŋɔ pahi nyɛviya pam zuɣu n-gul li, amaa o ni ti zaŋ a dimnim nyɛviya labi kaman kuɣilɔŋ kuɣili ka bɛ labi la.
en: If anyone should attack you and try to kill you, the Lord your God will keep you safe, as someone guards a precious treasure. As for your enemies, however, he will throw them away, as someone hurls stones with a sling.

dag: Zaligunim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Musa zali Izraɛlnima Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi Jɛriko polo la.
en: So these are the laws and commands that the Lord gave to Moses in the Jordan Valley in Moab by the Jordan River, across from Jericho.

dag: Kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛm la, lala ka ninsal nina gba na ʒi n-tiɣi.
en: Human desires are like the world of the dead—there is always room for more.

dag: Sintani daa pun niŋ tɛha niŋ Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la suhu ni ni o yi Yisa nyaaŋa. Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti laɣim diri yuŋ bindirigu saha shɛli.
en: Jesus and his disciples were sharing the evening meal. The devil had already provoked Judas, Simon Iscariots son, to betray Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o dan Ibrahimma laakumnim pia, ka deei pin suma balibu kam o sani n-yiɣisi chaŋ Nahɔr ya din be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: The servant took ten of his masters camels and all of his masters best provisions, set out, and traveled to Nahors city in Aram-naharaim.

dag: Musa daa ti tim tuumba Ɛdom naa sani, ka bɛ yi Kadɛshi chaŋ ti yɛl o, A mabihi Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A mi wahala shɛli ti ni pun nya zaa yɛla.
en: Moses sent messengers from Israel's camp near Kadesh with this message for the king of Edom: We are Israelites, your own relatives, and we're sure you have heard the terrible things that have happened to us.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sulemaana daa kari maligumaana Abiata Yawɛ maligumaanitali tuma ni, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli yiŋnim polo Shilo la niŋ pali.
en: So Solomon expelled Abiathar from the LORDs priesthood in order to fulfill the LORDs word that was spoken against Elis family at Shiloh.

dag: O daa ku na shɛb bɛn yuya du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: And killed powerful kings— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Bɛ chani gindila zoya zuɣu bɔri mɔri, ka chani bɔri momaha kam.
en: The mountains are the pastures where they feed, where they search for anything green to eat.

dag: ka tiŋgbani mi ti saɣi ti kawana mini wain ni kpam, ka di mi ti saɣi ti Jɛziriil.
en: The earth will answer the corn, the new wine, and the fresh oil, and they will answer Jezreel.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba ni; ka chɛ ka a yurilim taɣi ba kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la.
en: Because you, LORD, bless the righteous. You cover them with favor like a shield.

dag: Bɛ piɛbi kikaa, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, amaa so ku chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu, dama n suhuyiɣisili maa ni lu bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: The trumpet blows, and everyone gets ready. But no one goes off to war, for God's anger will fall on everyone alike.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Tapua ni Rɛkɛm ni Shɛma.
en: Hebron had four sons: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe o yilikpɛrili ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ashilɔni, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin birigu maa bahi.
en: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, Why couldn't we drive the spirit out.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daa ka taɣinamsi, di daa kul bela vau, ka zibisim limsi bɔɣ zilinli, ka Naawuni shia daa be kom zuɣusaa ginda.
en: the earth was formless and desolate. The raging ocean that covered everything was engulfed in total darkness, and the Spirit of God was moving over the water.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni bɛ bo mɔri na.
en: So the people spread out all through the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaɣisi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa, ka daa nahim ba, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛn yɛn bahi ba yoli nuu ni hal ti kari ba o sani bahi.
en: The Lord rejected all the Israelites, punishing them and handing them over to cruel enemies until at last he had banished them from his sight.

dag: Yi bɔhira, Wula ka o bi lan deeri li? Dama Yawɛ n-daa di a min a ni daa kpuɣi paɣ so a bipolitali ni shɛhira, hal paɣ maa ni kul nyɛ a mini ŋun be, ka lan nyɛ a daalikauli paɣ maa zaa yoli, a bi ʒe o yim.
en: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.

dag: O shɛrila tan piɛla binyɛra kɔhira, ka maani shɛlɔriti kɔhiri kɔhigɔriba zuɣu.
en: She makes clothes and belts and sells them to the merchants.

dag: A tiri ba faako wahala nyabu saha hal ka bɛ ti gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ʒim m-bala. Nanim maa ŋ-ŋmaligi zabi n-ku tab maa! Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, chamiya ti di nɛma.
en: They said, Look at the blood! The kings must have fought against each other. They must have destroyed each other. Lets go take the valuable things from the dead bodies.

dag: To, lala zuɣu m bi zɔrila yiriŋ; m mi bi be kaman chɔriŋmɛra ŋun ŋmɛri pɔhim.
en: So I run like someone who has a goal. I fight like a boxer who is hitting something, not just the air.

dag: Ka baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni la ni ti nyɛlisira, ka ne kaman sagban piɛla la. Ka bɛn mi nyɛ bɛn daa wuhi niriba pam din tuhi la ti ne kaman saŋmarisi la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.

dag: Ti daa fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ li ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili.
en: We took possession of their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, Gadites, and half of Manassehs tribe.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ tin shɛli yi ni yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: You people are saying, The king of Babylon will capture Jerusalem. He will use war, hunger, and disease to defeat this city. But this is what the Lord , the God of the people of Israel, says:.

dag: Dari yi kani, buɣim ni kpi. Tikub yi kani, zabili ku beni.
en: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.

dag: Di yi nyɛla lala, ti Naawuni so ti ni jɛmdi maa yi ni tooi yihi ti buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni, o ni yihi ti, ka ni lan yihi ti a gba nuu ni.
en: If you throw us into the hot furnace, the God we serve can save us. And if he wants to, he can save us from your power.

dag: Yi mi ni ti daa niŋdi ya mi kaman ba ni niŋd o bihi shɛm la: Ti daa kpam ya jaande ka kpaŋsi ya, ka zali ya.
en: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku la, n ni zaŋ li ti a, ka ni lan zaŋ li ti a zuliya a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: I gave Abraham and Isaac some special land. Now I give the land to you and to all your people who will live after you.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti ka bɛ ku tooi nya, ka chɛ ka bɛ wahala leei ʒi tibisili m-marigi ba sahakam.
en: Let their eyes be closed so that they cannot see. And let them be troubled forever. Psalm :-.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti zaŋ daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda tiŋgbana ni.
en: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.

dag: Bɛ bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim, dama bɛ dɔɣi tinzun bihi. Pumpɔŋɔ yi gol paliga churi puhibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi puri zaa bahi yoli.
en: They have acted faithlessly against the LORD; for their children have produced illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them along with their fields.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ ba niŋ foliŋga maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ ne dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God put them in the dome of the sky to shine on the earth.

dag: Ka bɔh o di saha maa, Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: Tell us, should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not.

dag: Amaa wula ka n kɔŋko lee ni tooi maani yi yɛlimuɣisira ŋɔ, ka maani yi zabili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.

dag: Dama mani a dabili ŋɔ daa zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima bia maa zuɣu m ba sani ka yɛli, N yi ti bi ʒi bia maa kuna, di taali din ʒinimi n zuɣu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I promised my father that I would bring him safely home. If I don't, I told my father he could blame me the rest of my life.

dag: O chɛ ka kɔbulli ni kom gbirigiri kaman duɣu ni ka di be la; o chɛ ka teeku bemi kaman kpaʒiɛrim m-be duɣu ni la.
en: He stirs up the water like a boiling pot. He makes it bubble like a pot of boiling oil.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa nya li maa ka di gar o pam, ka o tirisi mir li ha ni o lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka wum ti Duuma kukoli.
en: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini yaɣ shɛli din gili n zoli ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka saa miri ba saa mibu saha. Di ni ti nyɛla alibarika saa.
en: I will bless the sheep and the places around my hill. I will cause the rains to fall at the right time and will shower them with blessings.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naa Dauda piligu ni o bahigu tuma zaa sab bela anabi Samuɛl yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafi ni, ka lan sab be anabi Neetan mini anabi Gaad yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafinim ni.
en: The account of King David from beginning to end is written in the records of Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet, and Gad the visionary.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka boli Aduna mini Miriam, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kana ti zani.
en: Then the LORD descended in a column of cloud, stood at the entrance of the tent, and called to Aaron and Miriam. The two of them came forward.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnim saliŋ lɔhili. Yɛlim ba yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel the following story.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ din niŋ o maa, ka dabiɛm kpe o pam ka o ni dii sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o din niŋ o maa zaa.
en: The woman realized what had happened to her, so she came, trembling with fear, knelt at his feet, and told him the whole truth.

dag: Shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni vuɣi ba bee n-wurim ba ka ku ba.
en: There may come a time when I will speak about a nation or a kingdom that I will pull up by its roots or tear down and destroy it.

dag: dama m Ba maa maŋmaŋ yuri ya, yi ni yuri ma ka niŋ yɛda ni n yila m Ba maa sanna zuɣu.
en: for the Father himself loves you. He loves you because you love me and have believed that I came from God.

dag: Di saha Samuɛl daa na bi mi Yawɛ ka Yawɛ mi daa na ʒi n-kahig o yɛligu wuh o.
en: Samuel did not yet know the Lord because the Lord had not spoken directly to him before.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba ata daa yi Siizaria paai yil shɛli n ni daa be maa na. Bɛ daa tim ba la n sanna.
en: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.

dag: Di saha maa Filistianim maa daa chaŋmi ti tuhi Rɛfaim tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli ni la nima, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Philistines had invaded and were plundering the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Gidiɔn kum nyaaŋa, di daa bi yuui ka Izraɛlnim lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnima. Bɛ daa zaŋla alikauli lɔbu Baal n-leei bɛ wuni.
en: As soon as Gideon died, the Israelites again were not faithful to God—they followed Baal. They made Baal Berith their god.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun nya nahiŋgu pam, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga fiɛbbu ni maa.
en: I have suffered much because God was angry.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya o maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ dii zɔri chan o sani ti puhir o.
en: Suddenly the whole crowd caught sight of Jesus. They ran to greet him, overcome with excitement.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: That night they gave him wine to drink, and the older daughter had intercourse with him. But he was so drunk that he didn't know it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu nti be nimaani.
en: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima ni bɛn ka yɛda ni bɛn bi deeri Yawɛ wuhibu.
en: These are rebellious people, lying children, children unwilling to hear the LORDs teaching.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sariakaritiba ni bɛ tuma kpamba na nti yɛli ba, N kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders, their heads, their judges, and their officers. He said to them, Ive grown very old.

dag: Bɛn daa diri bindir viɛla la nti kpiri kum solɔri zuɣu ŋɔ. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi wumsi shɛb la nti do tampuya zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: Those who once ate gourmet food now tremble in the streets. Those who wore the finest purple clothes now cling to piles of garbage.

dag: Ka maligumaana ŋun yɛn yih o daɣiri ni maa ni zaŋ dilan mini binyɛra maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.

dag: Bɛ buɣa maa ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa zali watamilo puu ni n-varisiri binnɛma, ka bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la. Niriba n-kpuɣiri ba chana, dama bɛ ku tooi chaŋ. Miriya ka yi zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ mi ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Such idols are like scarecrows in a field of melons; they cannot speak; they have to be carried because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them: they can cause you no harm, and they can do you no good.

dag: Ka paɣiba daa yɛli Naomi, Paɣimi Yawɛ! O ti a yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni o ti gbib a. Yawɛ chɛ ka bia maa yuli ti du pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni!.
en: The women said to Naomi, Praise the Lord ! He has given you a grandson today to take care of you. May the boy become famous in Israel!.

dag: ka zaŋ zuliya pia ti a, ka zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: But Solomon will still rule one tribe, since he is the son of David my servant, and Jerusalem is my chosen city.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi. O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino jɛm o ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: You cannot be the slave of two masters. You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than to the other. You cannot serve God and money.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛr ya shɛm ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi ti boli buɣili yuli n-jɛm li bee n-chɛ ka so wum lala yɛtɔɣa yi noya ni.
en: Be sure that you obey all these laws. Dont worship false gods. You should not even speak their names!.

dag: N ŋmaligi pola mmaŋa, n yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli; di bi taɣira. Sokam ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni ʒe ma yim.
en: When I make a promise, that promise is true. It will happen. And I swear by my own power that everyone will bow before me and will take an oath to obey me.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soya, ka chɛ ka m baŋ li.
en: Make your ways known to me, LORD; teach me your paths.

dag: N ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani zuɣu, n ni deeg o suhuyiɣisili hal ka o ti lan zani n nyaaŋa n-kari ma saria, ka ti ma yɛlimaŋli. O ni zaŋ ma yihi neesim ni ka n ti nya o wuntitali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I sinned against the Lord , so he was angry with me. But he will argue my case for me in court. He will do what is right for me. Then he will bring me out into the light, and I will see that he is right.

dag: Ka n daa paai Jɛrusalɛm m-be nimaani dabisi muna ata.
en: I went on to Jerusalem, and for three days.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, piimiya yi ni niriba ayopɔin shɛb Shia Kasi ni pali, ka bɛ mali shɛhira suma ka lan mali yɛm pam, ka ti chɛ ka bɛ su tuma ŋɔ fukumsi;.
en: So then, friends, choose seven men among you who are known to be full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, and we will put them in charge of this matter.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa tuumba la sani nti kahigi Sool ni daa nya ti Duuma sol ni ka o yɛl o shɛm wuhi ba, ka lan yɛli ba Sool ni daa zaŋ Yisa yuli yihi waazu ni suhukpeeni shɛm Damaskus.
en: Then Barnabas came to his help and took him to the apostles. He explained to them how Saul had seen the Lord on the road and that the Lord had spoken to him. He also told them how boldly Saul had preached in the name of Jesus in Damascus.

dag: Ka Bɔaz garigi yɛl o, M pun wum a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti a yidan ma a yidan maa kum nyaaŋa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ yɛla. N lan mi a ni chɛ a ba min a ma ni a maŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ, ka kana ni a ti be a ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb sani shɛm yɛla.
en: Boaz answered, I have heard about everything that you have done for your mother-in-law since your husband died. I know how you left your father and mother and your own country and how you came to live among a people you had never known before.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ku o tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa, ka bɛn mi ti gali ni wurim kpe luɣilikam. Ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All his elite fighters along with all his troops will fall by the sword, and those who are left will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sab yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ niŋ Naawuni zaligu litaafi ni; ka bo kuɣ titali sɔŋ oki tia gbini nimaani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Joshua wrote these commands in the book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up under the oak tree in the Lord 's sanctuary.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi zuliya balibu kam ni mini dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa pun wum Sulemaana yɛm maa yɛla sani n-ka o sanna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: People came from everywhere to listen to Solomons wisdom; even the earths kings who had heard about his wisdom came!.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Lɛvinim zuliya kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.

dag: Deemiya ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm Naawuni dolibu ni, amaa ka di niŋy o naŋgbankpeeni o ni chihiri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpansi mi n-daa nyɛ Itam mini Ain ni Rimɔn ni Tochɛn ni Ashan, di daa nyɛla tins anu.
en: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralan maanila zaligu ansarisi, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli vaani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: There is no justice where a witness is determined to hurt someone. Wicked people love the taste of evil.

dag: M bi tɛhi ni n nyɛla ŋun pɔri tuun shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di zuɣu kɔbiri maa bi paligi, ka di mi bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, amaa ka nyɛla din sabigi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in it, it is not lower than the skin, and it is faded, the priest will quarantine the person seven days.

dag: Bɛn daa gbahi ti maa daa yɛli ti mi ni ti yilim yila, ka bɛn daa nahindi ti maa daa yɛli ti ni ti yilimi yila ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim, ka yɛra, Yilimiya Ziɔn yilli ka ti wum.
en: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, Sing about Zion.

dag: Maligumaaniba ni su shɛli niriba maa sani n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yɛn mali sara, ka di nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, di simdi ka o yihi bimbɔɣigbini mini yɛno ni bimpuli ti maligumaana.
en: Now this is what the priests may keep from the peoples sacrifices of oxen or sheep: They must give the priest the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.

dag: N daa lan lo ba alikauli ni n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba, bɛ ni daa nyɛ saamba be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la.
en: I made an agreement and promised them the land of Canaan, where they were living as foreigners.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa tahirila alibarika na, ka yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa kaman di ni daa niŋ shɛm yi sani dahin shɛli yi ni daa tuui wum Naawuni daanfaani yɛla ka baŋ ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli la.
en: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai Naawuni yɛla tɔɣisibu ni suhukpeeni; ka Akuila mini Prisila daa wum o wuhibu maa, ka zaŋ o ti maan wuh o Naawuni yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga pahi.
en: He began speaking with confidence in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they received him into their circle of friends and explained to him Gods way more accurately.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa yɛli, Aai, di bi simdi ni ti ku so zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnim faako.
en: No you won't! Saul told them. The Lord rescued Israel today, and no one will be put to death.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn ʒi, ka lan ka baŋsim; yi bela zibisim ni, dunia ŋɔ tiŋgbani tanzahi zaa dammi.
en: They dont know what is happening. They dont understand! They dont know what they are doing. Their world is falling down around them.

dag: Naawuni, kom ni daa nya a, kom maa ni daa shiri nya a, dabiɛm daa gbaai li mi, ka kɔbulli ni daa sɔhira.
en: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Judas ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri. Ka o daa piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: They were glad to hear this, and they promised to pay him. So Judas started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus.

dag: Bɛ daa lan sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba yɛla n-niŋ nanim yɛlikura litaafinim ni hal ti paai Ɛliashib bia Jɔhanan saha la.
en: The Levites who were heads of families were recorded in the official records until the time of Johanan, Eliashibs son.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, A yuma na bi paai yuun pihinu, ka wula ka a niŋ n-nya ti yab Ibrahimma.
en: You are not even years old! they said. How could you have seen Abraham.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti niŋ bindirigu ti o nimaani, ka Maata kpuɣ bindirigu maa na ti zali, ka Lazarɔs gba daa be bɛn ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa ni.
en: A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.

dag: Dama hal so ku lan be nayili, bɛ ni ti zo zaa ka chɛ tiŋ maa. Ka tiŋgula biɛhigu shee mini yiya lu n-dahim zaa n-kul doya sahakam. Ka nimaani leei mɔɣu ni bunsi gɔrim shee ni piɛri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: People will leave the capital city. The palace and towers will be left empty. People will not live in houses—they will live in caves. Wild donkeys and sheep will live in the city—animals will go there to eat grass.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kulima! A bia maa ni gali. Ka zuɣulan maa daa niŋ Yisa ni yɛl o shɛm maa yɛda, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Jesus then said, Your son will live. Go on home to him. The man believed Jesus and started back home.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛl o, Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka n yɛl a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: But the king said, How many times must I demand that you tell me the truth when you speak in the LORDs name.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino.
en: The servant girl saw Peter again and said to the people standing there, This man is one of them.

dag: Shiina Naa Amirafɛl mini Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ni Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal.
en: While Amraphel was king of Shinar, Ellasars King Arioch, Elams King Chedorlaomer, and Goiims King Tidal.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni zali zaligu, ka dam Izraɛlnim bɛn be zuliya kam tinsi ni. M mi yɛn niŋ ba mi kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la, hal ka kabiɛl yini gba ku lu tiŋa.
en: I am giving the command to scatter the people of Israel among all nations. But it will be like someone sifting flour. A person shakes flour through a sifter. The good flour falls through, but the bad lumps are caught.

dag: Dindali maa di simdi ka yi moli molo, ka laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu ʒiɛmani kam ni yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: On that day do none of your daily work, but gather for worship. Your descendants are to observe this regulation for all time to come, no matter where they live.

dag: Ŋun yuri liɣiri, ku nya liɣiri tiɣi; ka ŋun yuri buni mi ku nya buni tiɣi. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
