dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ku yi Kalidianim maa nuu ni; amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag o ti Babilɔn Naa, ka o min o nina pali taba, ka bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa garigi taba.
en: King Zedekiah of Judah will not escape from the army of the Babylonians. But he will surely be given to the king of Babylon. And Zedekiah will speak to the king of Babylon face to face. He will see him with his own eyes.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a chɛ ka neesim din be a ni ti leei zibisim.
en: So be sure your light isn't darkness.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa yɛliŋ zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka di ti mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi yil li, ka di mali daantalisi pia mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: On the west side there are to be curtains yards long, with ten posts and ten bases.

dag: Ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Yɛlim ma a ni mali shɛl a yiŋa. Ka o yɛl o, A dabipaɣa ka shɛli; kulla kpaŋman yini kɔŋko ka m mali.
en: What shall I do for you? he asked. Tell me, what do you have at home? Nothing at all, except a small jar of olive oil, she answered.

dag: Yɛm ni zaŋ jilima zuɣupiligu pil a, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli ti a.
en: She will be your crowning glory.

dag: O ni daa ti yɛn kpe Ijipti saha shɛli ka o yɛl o paɣ Zarai, M mi ni a nyɛla paɣ viɛlli, ka a lihibu mali kɔre.
en: When he was about to cross the border into Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, You are a beautiful woman.

dag: Babilɔnnim gbahibu maa vuri ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, ka zuliya kam ti wum bɛ kuhigu.
en: The earth quakes at the sound of Babylons capture; its screams echo throughout the world.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anabinim la ni yino.
en: Some say that you are John the Baptist, they answered; others say that you are Elijah, while others say that you are one of the prophets.

dag: Ka o daa kpe vokabili puuni zoli maa zuɣu nti gbe nimaani. Ka Yawɛ daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: and he spent the night there in a cave. While Elijah was on Mount Sinai, the Lord asked, Elijah, why are you here.

dag: A daanabinim nyala ʒiinim din pa yɛlimaŋli mini ʒiinim din nyɛ yɔhiŋ. Bɛ bi kahigir a daalahichi wuhir a din ni chɛ ka a yi dabitim ni. Amaa bɛ tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka di kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Your prophets saw visions for you, but their visions were only worthless lies. They didnt speak against your sins. They didnt try to make things better. They spoke messages for you, but they were false messages that fooled you.

dag: Jɔsia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka daa dol o yab Dauda naba o tuma ni ka bi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: Josiah did what was pleasing to the Lord ; he followed the example of his ancestor King David, strictly obeying all the laws of God.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti be sagbana ni kanna, ka sokam nina ni ti nya o, hal bɛn daa zaŋ kpani kuh o luɣili la gba ni ti nya o, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ti fabili bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛm zuɣu. Lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ. Ami.
en: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.

dag: Yɛndaan yino chaŋ ti liri tɔbutuhiriba tiŋa n-wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli ka bɛ niŋ li naani la.
en: A wise person can defeat a city full of warriors and tear down the defenses they trust in.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, ŋuhima; ŋuhimi ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini biɛrim pam bɛ ninni.
en: Son of man, make sad sounds like a sad person with a broken heart. Make these sad sounds in front of the people.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni kpuɣi pu shɛli atam, ka be kaman bɛ ni yihi binyiha pu shɛli din be Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni.
en: Israel will be like wheat fields in Rephaim Valley picked clean of grain.

dag: Timiya ti naɣilah ayi, ka chɛ ka bɛ pii naɣila yino kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu, ka di niŋ buɣim niŋ li; ka n gba kɔrigi naɣila ŋun la ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu ka ku niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: Give us two bulls. Let Baals prophets choose one. Let them cut it apart and set it on the wood, but dont add fire. Ill prepare the other bull, put it on the wood, but wont add fire.

dag: O daa tum tuun kara Juda fɔntinsi ni. O daa zaŋ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ti ʒili Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He kept many supplies in the storage towns. And Jehoshaphat kept trained soldiers in Jerusalem.

dag: Ti bi nyuri bara n-yaɣiri di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga ninvuɣ shɛb tuma zuɣu, amaa ti tahima nyɛla ni yi yɛda yi zooi pahi, ti tuma soya gba ni yɛligi yi sani.
en: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pal piɛr ayopɔin.
en: They all ate until they were full. Then the followers filled seven baskets with the pieces of food that were left.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla sokam dim ka nyuma, ka diri bɛ tuma nyaɣisim. Di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: All of us should eat and drink and enjoy what we have worked for. It is God's gift.

dag: di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Amɔz bia Aizaia, Pirigim a buɣu ŋɔ min a namda ŋɔ, ka o daa niŋ lala, ka chani o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa.
en: About this same time the Lord had told me, Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals! I did this and went around naked and barefoot.

dag: Biliha ŋun daa nyɛ Leeban ni daa zaŋ so ti o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb ti Yaakubu m-bala; ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: These were the sons of Jacob and Bilhah. There were seven people in this family.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nudirigu polo dunɔdali n-kpe dundombil ni nti buɣisi nudirigu polo dunɔdali maa, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: The man took me through the south gateway into the inner courtyard. He measured the gateway, and it was the same size as the gateways in the outer wall.

dag: Ka Gɛza naa Hɔram daa kana ti sɔŋ Lakishinim maa, amaa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku o min o tɔbbihi zaa hal ka bɛ ni so bi tiligi.
en: King Horam of Gezer came to help Lachish, but Joshua also defeated him and his army. No one was left alive.

dag: A ni ti boli ma, ka n saɣi. A kɔre ni ti be a nuhi tuma ni.
en: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛli, A takɔbi ni daa kul chɛ ka paɣiba kɔŋ bihi shɛm la, lala ka a ma gba yɛn kɔŋ bia paɣiba ni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahiŋmahi Agag sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Giligal.
en: But Samuel said to Agag, Your sword took babies from their mothers. So now, your mother will have no children. And Samuel cut Agag to pieces before the Lord at Gilgal.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt puu maa chira ayɔbu ni ka Naawuni daa tim malaika Gabirɛl Galili fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la.
en: In the sixth month of Elizabeth's pregnancy God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee named Nazareth.

dag: Yurilim bi mali suhupiɛlli taali tumbu ni, amaa di naɣ mali suhupiɛlli la yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: love is not happy with evil, but is happy with the truth.

dag: N dooni gbihira, ka lan yirisira, dama Yawɛ n-guli ma.
en: I lie down and sleep, and all night long the Lord protects me.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa wum niriba maa yɛligu maa, ka o gba daa lan zaŋ li yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Samuel listened to everything they said and then went and told it to the Lord .

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zuliya kul beni sahakam; ka chɛ ka o zuliya diri nam ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: I will establish his dynasty for all time. His throne will last as long as heaven does.

dag: Isaka ŋmanila bun so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ piɛri sunsuuni.
en: Issachar is like a donkey that has worked too hard. He will lie down under his heavy load.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ti mali taɣitaɣi mini mɔri, ka palo beni ka yi ni gbe.
en: There is plenty of straw and fodder at our house, and there is a place for you to stay.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka bɛ gbibi n zaligunima, di yi pa lala bɛ yi birigi li, bɛ ni kpe alahichi ni di zuɣu ka kpi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord , the one who makes a priest holy.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ni o pin o zuɣu min o teeŋkɔbiri ni o ninkari ni o niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o paɣ o situra ka su kom n-leei ŋun yi daɣiri ni.
en: On the seventh day you shall again shave your head, your beard, your eyebrows, and all the rest of the hair on your body; you shall wash your clothes and take a bath, and then you will be ritually clean.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin din pal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din bahindi nyaaŋ la ni yino daa ka n sanna ti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a Piɛbil la Daamiliya Paɣa.
en: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka daa kari alizin biɛri niriba pam zuɣu bahi, ka bi saɣi ni alizin biɛri maa yɛli shɛli, dama bɛ daa mi o ni nyɛ so.
en: Jesus healed all kinds of terrible diseases and forced out a lot of demons. But the demons knew who he was, and he did not let them speak.

dag: A bihi maa daa tumla alahichi o sani, bɛ daalahichi maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛ shɛm ka o niŋ ba maa.
en: If your children sinned against him, then he delivered them into the power of their rebellion.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a ni zɔr o zuɣu n-chɛ ka o kpahir a zuɣu ni, ka kariti a saria ŋɔ?.
en: Does he rebuke you for your piety, bring you in for judgment?.

dag: Musa daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ binshɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses called together the people of Israel and told them that the Lord had said:.

dag: Dindali maa Sool tumtumdib ni do so daa bela nimaani ni o mali maligu shɛli Yawɛ tooni, o daa nyɛla Ɛdom nira ka o yuli booni Doɛg, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Sool piɛgul kpɛma.
en: It so happened that one of Saul's officers was there, worshiping the Lord that day. His name was Doeg the Edomite, and he was the strongest of Saul's shepherds.

dag: ka dam zuliya kam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ daazichi zaa kuli kpe na, ka n chɛ ka duu ŋɔ mali jilima.
en: I will shake up the nations, and they will come to you with wealth from every nation. And then I will fill this Temple with glory. That is what the Lord All-Powerful said!.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni no n-taai ninvuɣ shɛb la di vi; chɛ ka tarimba mini nandaamba paɣ a yuli.
en: Your people were treated badly. Dont let them be hurt anymore. Let your poor, helpless people praise you.

dag: A zaŋla ti tuumbiɛri zal a tooni, ka ti ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa ashilɔni yi n-do palɔni a ninni.
en: You put our sins right in front of you, set our hidden faults in the light from your face.

dag: Di zaa daa nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu. Dapaɣili kam daa tamla diba ayi zuɣu.
en: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases, two under each frame.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Reuben were .

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: These were the names of Gershons sons by their clans: Libni and Shimei.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka n ti be yi sani ka yi muɣisi ma ni n wuhi dɔbilim, dama m mi ni n ni tooi wuhi n dɔbilim ni nyɛ shɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhiri ni ti dolila dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ka mal li kuuni la sani.
en: I beg you that when Im with you in person, I wont have to boss you around. Im afraid that I may have to use that kind of behavior with those people who think we live by human standards.

dag: Ka Abinɛr yɛl o, Ŋmaligim a nudirigu bee a nuzaa polo n-gbaai nachimba ŋɔ ni yino n-fa o ni mali shɛli. Amaa ka Asahɛl bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: Abner said, There are soldiers all around. Stop chasing me and fight one of them! Kill him and take his clothes and weapons for yourself. But Asahel refused to stop.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli, A ni suhi ma ŋɔ zuɣu, n chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: The Lord answered, Yes, I will forgive the people as you asked.

dag: Zakaria min o maligumaanitab daa yi tumdila maligumaanitali tuma deeri taba.
en: One day Zechariah was serving as a priest before God because his priestly division was on duty.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti ti o yaa tariga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm.
en: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba Izraɛlnima. O daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ su li.
en: and gave their property to his people Israel.

dag: Ka di daantalisi anahi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa anahi zuɣu daa nyɛ daanya, ka di bansi daa nyɛ anzinfa, ka o daa niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni, ka di mihi gba daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: It had four posts, their four copper bases, their silver hooks, and their tops and bands covered with silver.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim, mali alibarika.
en: Our Lord , you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din kpaŋsi ti suhuri. Ka din pahi timaŋmaŋ suhukpaŋsibo ŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli pam Taitus suhupiɛlli nyabu la zuɣu, dama o tɛha dɔniya yi zaa zuɣu.
en: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa baŋ ni Aduna kpiya, ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ biɛɣ pihita n-kum o kuli.
en: When the entire community saw that Aaron had died, the entire household of Israel wept thirty days for Aaron.

dag: Lee baŋmiya ni yi yi ku ma, ŋun ka taali ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi mini ya ŋɔ tiŋgbani ni ya ŋɔ nim zuɣu, dama yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ n-tim ma yi sanna ni n ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli ya ka yi wum.
en: Only know for certain that if you sentence me to death, you and the people of this city will be guilty of killing an innocent man. The LORD has in fact sent me to speak everything I have said to you.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la niŋ naa tɔɣino yɛli, Ami! Ka lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan naa Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: Benaiah, Jehoiadas son, responded to the king, Yes, may it happen as the LORD, the God of my king, says.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee malila shili guli ba. Di yaala di noli gu ni di vali Jɛrusalɛm zuɣulaannim mini di tarimba bɛn galisi ni bɛnkam zaa mali suhupiɛlli be di ni.
en: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.

dag: Dama yuŋ la ka n Duuma Naawuni ŋun su ma ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ malaika sa ka n sanna.
en: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni daa kpe hal ti pibigi gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni la, bɛna n-daa baai du li chaŋ ti kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be vinvamli ni wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo zaa la.
en: In the first month of one year, the time when the Jordan River overflowed its banks, they crossed the river, scattering the people who lived in the valleys both east and west of the river.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla. A nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, ŋmaligim m polo na.
en: Answer me, Lord , in the goodness of your constant love; in your great compassion turn to me!.

dag: Ka o ni ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: He will send his angels all around the earth. They will gather his chosen people from every part of the earth.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi Dauda yɛla, ka teeg o ni daa di wahala shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: Lord , remember how David suffered.

dag: O yi ti yiɣis o luɣ shɛlikam, o luhir o mi ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋarit o noli, ka o ŋubir o nyina ka kpaŋ dilinli; ka n suhi a nyaandoliba ŋɔ ni bɛ kari alizin birigu maa, ka bɛ bi tooi.
en: Whenever the spirit attacks him, it throws him to the ground, and he foams at the mouth, grits his teeth, and becomes stiff all over. I asked your disciples to drive the spirit out, but they could not.

dag: Juda bidibisi daa nyɛla Ɛr mini Onan, bɛ zaa daa kpila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Judah; they were from the clans of Shelah, Perez, and Zerah, as well as Hezron and Hamul, whose ancestor was Perez. Judah's sons Er and Onan had died in Canaan.

dag: amaa ka o daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa. Bɛ daa kul ʒiɛla tiŋ maa dunol kam ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa gu ni bɛ ku o.
en: They were watching the city gates day and night. They wanted to kill Saul, but he learned about their plan.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Yawɛ tooni n-kum niŋ o, ka lo noli hal ni zaawuni; ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Then all the Israelite troops went back up to Bethel and wept, just sitting there in the LORDs presence. They fasted that whole day until evening. Then they offered entirely burned offerings and well-being sacrifices to the LORD.

dag: N di n-tiɣi kaman chuɣu ka m puhi la, ka yaai n noli paɣ a ni suhupiɛlli.
en: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Wɛi, n niriba bɛn mali tipawumli, ka lɔri nia shɛli din pa n dini, ka lan laɣiri niriba zɔri ka di pa n ni yu shɛli. Bɛ kul tumdila alahichi pahira.
en: The Lord has spoken: Those who rule Judah are doomed because they rebel against me. They follow plans that I did not make, and sign treaties against my will, piling one sin on another.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni tilig o niriba, ka zo o daba nambɔɣu, o yi ti nya ka bɛ lan ka yiko, ka bɛ ni lo so bee bɛ ni bi lo so ti ku lan kpalim.
en: But the LORD will acquit his people, will have compassion on those who serve him, once he sees that their strength is all gone, that both prisoners and free people are wiped out.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ maŋdahimbu mali nyɔri shɛli di ni, amaa wuntia soli puuni maŋdahimbu malila nyɔri shɛlikam ni, dama di lo ti nyɛvili alikauli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili saha din ka bahigu puuni.
en: While physical training has some value, training in holy living is useful for everything. It has promise for this life now and the life to come.

dag: Dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo? Naawuni yi ʒe ti nyaaŋa, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo ti?.
en: So what are we going to say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan chɛ ka o shia siɣi ti zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban shɛli din kpi la leei tiŋgban shɛli din vuhira; ka puri atam niŋ pam.
en: This will continue until God gives us his Spirit from above. Then the desert will become rich farmland and the farmland will be like thick forests.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam tin ya la, yi di ba zalinsi n-zaɣisi ba yɔbu. Wummiya bɛ fabila! Tumtumdiba maa kuhigu chaŋ ti lu ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa tibili ni.
en: You have not paid any wages to those who work in your fields. Listen to their complaints! The cries of those who gather in your crops have reached the ears of God, the Lord Almighty.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti du zuɣusaa m-pobilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirig o kpiŋkpama to Bɔziranima. Dindali maa Ɛdom tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi suhu ni be shɛm la.
en: The enemy will attack Bozrah like an eagle swooping down with outspread wings. On that day Edom's soldiers will be as frightened as a woman in labor.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi yi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di ni gbuɣi ya bahi kaman di ni daa gbuɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be yi tooni la bahi shɛm la.
en: and then the land will not reject you, as it rejected the pagans who lived there before you.

dag: Naawuni yi nuzaa polo na ni jilima din be kaman salima la, ka nam dariza din mali dabiɛm gil o.
en: In the same way Gods golden glory shines from the Holy Mountain. He is surrounded by the brightest light.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya yi bihi maa, Ti daa nyɛla Firawuna daba be Ijipti, amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa yihi ti Ijipti maa na.
en: Then you will say to them, We were Pharaohs slaves in Egypt, but the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his great power.

dag: Dapaɣili kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Each frame was feet tall and inches wide.

dag: Sokam diri Dimitirius shɛhira suŋ, hal yɛlimaŋli maŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira suŋ. Ka timaŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira pahi; ka a mi ni ti ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Everyone speaks highly of Demetrius, even the truth itself. We also speak highly of him, and you know that what we say is true.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lan yɛli, Yi ku gari. Ka Ɛdom naa maa daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam bɛn gbib bidibbina pam kana ti gu ba soli.
en: The Edomites repeated, We refuse! and they marched out with a powerful army to attack the people of Israel.

dag: ka yi nina ni ti yɛn nya shɛli ni ti kpɛhi ya yinyari.
en: Your sufferings will make you lose your mind.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ŋun ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, Ŋoom a takɔbi na n-kuhi ku ma, di so ka bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ ti kana ti zaŋ ma diɛm. Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaag o neen ʒira maa ka o bi saɣi ku o. Di saha ka Sool daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ takɔbi zali n-lu di zuɣu.
en: He said to the young man carrying his weapons, Draw your sword and kill me, to keep these godless Philistines from gloating over me. But the young man was too terrified to do it. So Saul took his own sword and threw himself on it.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn daa kpalim maa n-nyɛ: Filistia nanima anu mini Keenannim zaa ni Sidɔnnim ni Hivinim bɛn be Lɛbanɔn Zoli zuɣu n-zaŋ Baalihɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu hal ti paai Lɛbohamat dunoli shee la.
en: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the people of Sidon, and the Hivites who lived in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

dag: Puhimiya dakulɔdakulo churi mini ka daŋda chɛbu chuɣu ni wuuni atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni ŋme n-saɣim Damaskus duno kara, ka kari Avɛn vinvamlinim mini Bɛtɛdɛn naa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Sirianim kuli Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: I will also break open the gates of Damascus and remove the one who sits on the throne in the Valley of Aven. I will remove the symbol of power from Beth Eden, and the Arameans will be defeated and taken back to Kir. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Dama n yi kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n ti kuhirimi ka tahi yɛli, Duŋtaabo mini saɣiŋgu! Dama nyin Yawɛ yɛligu maa leela turi mini ansarisi bini n sani asiba hal ni yuŋ.
en: Whenever I speak, I have to cry out and shout, Violence! Destruction! Lord , I am ridiculed and scorned all the time because I proclaim your message.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa gbaala Ai naa zaɣ nɛɔŋ n-zaŋ o ti ti Jɔshua.
en: But they seized the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni, o ni bɔh o bɔhigunim tuhili, ka o ku tooi garigi bɔhigu yini gba.
en: Anyone who chose to argue with him could not answer one question in a thousand!.

dag: Yi ni so yi mali taali ni o kpee, o ni buɣisi ni o zaŋ di yɛla maa tahi sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka pa ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sani?.
en: When someone in your assembly has a legal case against another member, do they dare to take it to court to be judged by people who arent just, instead of by Gods people?.

dag: Miri ka a mali jɛlinsi a suhu ni ni a kpee, amaa chɛ ka a min a kpee maa tɔɣisi mali yi yɛtɔɣa, di yi pa lala a ni ti tum alahichi o zuɣu.
en: You must not hate your fellow Israelite in your heart. Rebuke your fellow Israelite strongly, so you dont become responsible for his sin.

dag: Ka o daa ti bɔhi Yawɛ n-nya o yɛla ti o, ka ti o bindirigu, ka lan zaŋ Goliat Filistia doo la takɔb la ti o.
en: Ahimelech questioned the LORD for David, and gave him provisions as well as the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Dauda bidibisi nti pahi o mamanim bidibisi zuɣu, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Tama.
en: They were all Davids sons. Their sister was named Tamar. David also had other sons by his slave women.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din daa nyɛ kuɣ kara ka mali shaara, ka di shɛŋa wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili, ka shɛŋa mi nyɛ mita anahinahi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali duri maa tanzahi.
en: The foundation was laid with large stones of high quality, some of fifteen feet and some of twelve feet.

dag: M puhiri Mariama ŋun tum tuma pam yi ni la.
en: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o chɛ ka mahim maa lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia kaman Ahaz ni daa buɣisi wuntaŋ chandi yɛla zali shɛm la.
en: Isaiah prayed to the Lord , and the Lord made the shadow go back ten steps on the stairway set up by King Ahaz.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka n dii tim a sanna maa, ka a mi ni kana maa a niŋ viɛnyɛla. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ ti zaa bela Naawuni tooni ni ti wum ŋun Naawuni ni ti a zilin shɛli ni a ti ti. .
en: So I sent for you immediately. It was very good of you to come here. Now we are all here before God to hear everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mali yurilim maŋli sahakam zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani, ka chɛ ka o wuntitali yiri zahira bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi sani ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But the Lord has always loved his followers, and he will continue to love them forever and ever! He will be good to all their descendants.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni daadamnim ni ti bɔri kum ka ku nya; bɛ ni ti bɔri ni bɛ kpi, ka kum zo ka chɛ ba.
en: During those days people will look for a way to die, but they will not find it. They will want to die, but death will hide from them.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, niŋmiya ania n-lihi ma, dama m bi yɛn ŋmanya ʒiri yi ninni.
en: Look me in the face. I won't lie.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka kuɣili ni marigi ŋun biligi li.
en: Whoever digs a pit can fall into it. Whoever rolls a large stone can be crushed by it.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya bi biɛ yoli ŋɔ ti bahi kpaŋ ha, zibisim ni be shɛl la. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: You are a worthless servant, and you will be thrown out into the dark where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Jɛrimia m-pahi buyi saha shɛli bɛ ni daa na kul kpar o duu duguliba dundɔŋ ni la.
en: While I was still in prison in the courtyard, the Lord 's message came to me again.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋuni n-lee ku zo a ka tibig a yuli? Dama a ko m-be kasi. Zuliya kam ni kana nti jɛm a, dama a wuntia saria karibu yi palo.
en: Who will not stand in awe of you, Lord? Who will refuse to declare your greatness? You alone are holy. All the nations will come and worship you, because your just actions are seen by all.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Jona bahi kom maa ni maa, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka ziŋ karili zaŋ o vali, ka o daa be ziŋ maa puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa daba ata.
en: Meanwhile, the LORD provided a great fish to swallow Jonah. Jonah was in the belly of the fish for three days and three nights.

dag: hal sakuɣa yi ti luna saɣim tibɔŋ la zaa, ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim zaa.
en: But before this happens, the forest must fall and the city must be torn down.

dag: Ka Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia la daa leei bɛ zuɣulan saha shɛli ha, ka Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: Phinehas, Eleazars son, the LORD be with him, was their leader in former times.

dag: Piim dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la ni niriba.
en: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, kum n dimnima. N nyɛla a dabili, kum n dimnim zaa.
en: Show me your love and defeat my enemies. Destroy those who are trying to kill me because I am your servant.

dag: Ka Aduna bia Ɛliɛza gba daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Gibia fɔntin shɛli din be Ifriim zoya tiŋgban ni, ka o daa zaŋ li ti o bia Finɛhas la.
en: Aarons son, Eleazar, died and was buried at Gibeah in the hill country of Ephraim. Gibeah had been given to Eleazars son Phinehas.

dag: ŋun be chɛchɛbuŋ ni zuɣusaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Wummiya o kukoli din mali kpiɔŋ la tahigu.
en: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem, they came to Bethphage at the Mount of Olives. There Jesus sent two of the disciples on ahead.

dag: Ka Maata saɣi, Iin n Duuma, n niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-nyɛ Masia, Naawuni Bi so bɛ ni daa yɛli ni o ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la.
en: Yes, Lord! she answered. I do believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim saha shɛli maa, ka Giliad kpamba daa chaŋ Tɔb tiŋgban ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ Jɛfita na.
en: When this happened, the leaders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah back from the land of Tob.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti a Ba maa ni nyɛ so! Dina ka ti kul bɔra.
en: Philip said to him, Lord, show us the Father; that is all we need.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n yi ti niŋ ya din viɛla n yuli zuɣu ka pa ni yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛri yoli ni simdi shɛm zuɣu, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni n-yɛli ni bɛ kali ma pahila tuumbiɛrinim ni la ni bahi niŋ pali m bebu ni; dama di kpala talahi ni di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm maa niŋ pali.
en: Do this because the Scriptures say, He was considered a criminal. This was written about me, and it will soon come true.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Judas daa chaŋ ti zaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa tim tɔbbi shɛb mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuun shɛb la pa omaŋ zuɣu; ka bɛ bo firilanim mini buɣim mokpala ni bidibbina n-kari Yisa naba nimaani.
en: So Judas led a group of soldiers to the garden, along with some guards from the leading priests and the Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns, and weapons.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ niŋ a niriba fitiina, ka nahim a ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord .

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o noli naai tinduyanima ni o yɔhim ba, ka o kpiɔŋ ni ti zoori pahira, hal o ni kul nyɛla ŋun yɛn di n-su la niriba biɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: By making treaties, he will deceive other nations, and he will grow stronger and stronger, even though he rules only a small nation.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpahiri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu ni ni mali suhupiɛlli, ka nya alibarika pam.
en: But if a judge punishes the guilty, then people will be happy with him, and he will be a blessing to them.

dag: ni Jaarɛshia ni Ilaija ni Zikiri mi daa nyɛ Jɛrɔham bidibisi.
en: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko; bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi.
en: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John with him. They went up on a high mountain, where they could be alone. There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed.

dag: Bɛ ni bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligunim maa dolibu maa zuɣu, bɛ bom bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara tahi Yawɛ tooni na ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices.

dag: A yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, ka na kul gbib ba.
en: If you continue to hold them and refuse to let them go.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma bari ma la tɔŋ, ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti ma biɛrim la mi yu ni m bahi yoli; bɛ na ʒi n-chɛ ma yikombiɛlim tuma tumbu dabisili kam puuni.
en: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu maa mini Yisa Masia shɛhira ni omaŋmaŋ nini ni daa nya shɛlikam zaa shɛhiralana.
en: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.

dag: Dama yi ni yɛn kari zuliya shɛb maa nyɛla bɛn doli baɣisi mini bihiŋmɛriba yɛligu, amaa yinim bɛna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi saɣi ni yi niŋ lala.
en: These nations you are displacing listened to sign readers and diviners, but the LORD your God doesnt permit you to do the same!.

dag: Binshɛli ku niŋ ba n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ ni kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: They wont harm or destroy anywhere on my holy mountain. The earth will surely be filled with the knowledge of the LORD, just as the water covers the sea.

dag: O ni be alizanda ni ka timna ti tiligi ma. O ni chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn duri tamdi n zuɣu la di vi. Naawuni ni wuhi ma o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ n sani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka bɛ bahi ba ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: Early the next morning, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ sariakarita, yiɣisima. Tim karimbaannim din simdi ba!.
en: Rise up, judge of the earth! Pay back the arrogant exactly what they deserve!.

dag: zaŋ tiŋ hal ti yaɣi dunoya zuɣusaa, chɛrubinim mini abie tihi kɔtomsi ka bɛ daa ŋme m-pa di dukpina zuɣu.
en: From the ground to above the entrance, the walls of the main hall were carved with winged creatures and palm trees.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Ka dindina zaŋmiy o chaŋ ti doli yimaŋmaŋ zaligu soli kar o saria. Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti ka soli ni ti ku nira.
en: Pilate said to them, You take him yourselves and judge him by your own law. The Jewish leaders answered, But your law does not allow us to punish anyone by killing them.

dag: Antiɔk yɛdaniŋdiba maa ni daa tim ba maa, bɛ daa zaŋ doli yila Fɔnisia mini Samaria polo n-yɛri nimaani yɛdaniŋdiba zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba ni niŋ tuuba shɛm yɛla chana, ka di daa niŋ ba suhupiɛlli pam.
en: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba kulis anahi zuɣu. Yi ni ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni.
en: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;.

dag: ni Hadid ni Zɛboim ni Nɛbalat.
en: in Hadid, Zeboim, and Neballat.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi biɛɣ asiba, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anab Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la n-yɛl o.
en: The Lord said to Gad, David's prophet, Go and tell David that I am giving him three choices. I will do whichever he chooses. The next morning, after David had gotten up.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Do so paɣ yi birigi, ka bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o yidan sani.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: A man may suspect that his wife has had an affair and has broken faith with him.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool Zanimi ka n yɛl a Yawɛ ni sa yɛli ma shɛm yuŋ la. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Stop! Samuel said. Let me tell you what the Lord told me last night. All right, Saul answered.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yaha, Naawuni nam ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun chaŋ o puu ni nti ko m-biri bimbira.
en: Then Jesus said, This is what Gods kingdom is like. Its as though someone scatters seed on the ground.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino chuɣu puhibu binyɛra, amaa ka daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita mini chuɣu puhibu binyɛra ata ti Bɛnjamin.
en: He gave each brother a suit of beautiful clothes. But to Benjamin he gave five suits of beautiful clothes and pieces of silver.

dag: Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, a kul yoli piligimi n-wuhir a dabili a galisim min a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, wuni ŋuni n-lee be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani zuɣu n-ni tooi tum yiko tuma mini tuun kar shɛŋa a ni tum ŋɔ?.
en: Our Lord , it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.

dag: Dama ŋunkam zaa ŋubiri li ka nyuri li ka bi zahim baŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ yɛla gbinni, o ŋubiri li ka nyuri li bɔrila tibidarigibo tir omaŋa.
en: If you eat and drink without paying attention to those who are the Lords body, your eating and drinking will cause you to be judged guilty.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku lo kpara pahi yi zuɣu du, yi mini ba zaa tarili ni bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But if they do not cross the river with you ready to fight, they will not get any land on this side. They will get only a share of the land of Canaan with the rest of you.

dag: O ni ti liri nuzaa polɔnima, ka wurim Asiria. O ni ti chɛ ka Ninive kpalim dabari n kuui doya kaman tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: The Lord will use his power to destroy Assyria. He will make the city of Nineveh a deserted ruin, a waterless desert.

dag: Ka Shallum Jabɛshi bia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-daa ŋme o luhi Ibiliam n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Shallum, Jabeshs son, plotted against Zechariah. He struck him down in public, murdering him. Shallum then succeeded him as king.

dag: Nyama, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n zaŋ a leei zuliya pam mini nanim zuɣulana, ni a vuɣi, ka daai luhi, ni a wurim ka ŋme m-paai, ni a me ka sa.
en: Today I have put you in charge of nations and kingdoms. You will pull up and tear down. You will destroy and overthrow. You will build up and plant.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ jɛlinsi lu a zuɣu n-fa a ni tum tuma nya binshɛŋa la zaa, ka chɛ a zaɣ nɛli. Ka a pagɔrisigu tuma la yi palo. A kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuma maa.
en: And because they hate you, they will take away everything you have worked for and leave you stripped naked, exposed like a prostitute. Your lust and your prostitution.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini ka bi garigi shɛli. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa lan bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Alibarikalan Bia la.
en: But Jesus kept quiet and did not say a word. The high priest asked him another question, Are you the Messiah, the Son of the glorious God.

dag: Yi wulimpuhili polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Hazarɛnan hal ni Shɛfam.
en: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋ yur anu bɛn kpalim ŋɔ chaŋ, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni gba kul bela barina ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti tim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya.
en: One of his officials said, The people here in the city are doomed anyway, like those that have already died. So let's send some men with five of the horses that are left, so that we can find out what has happened.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe ŋariŋ ni yiri kpaŋa.
en: They departed in a boat by themselves for a deserted place.

dag: Anzinfa doora ŋun yuli daa booni Dimitirius daa malila anzinfa n-doori buɣili Aritɛmis binnana, ka o mini bɛn daa laɣim tumdi di tuma nyari liɣiri pam di ni.
en: There was a man named Demetrius. He worked with silver. He made little silver models that looked like the temple of the goddess Artemis. The men who did this work made a lot of money.

dag: Nabipuɣinsi be a dundɔŋ ni paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima la ni, ka a paani ʒe a nudirigu polo n-ye salima din yi Ofiri na.
en: The royal princess is standing in your precious jewels; the queen stands at your right, dressed in the gold of Ophir.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana min o nyaaŋa bɛn nyɛ Sadusiinim la daa zab Yisa tuumba maa nyuli.
en: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.

dag: Ka doo maa yi taali ni, amaa ka paɣ maa ŋun taali ʒi o zuɣu.
en: The man will be free from guilt, but the woman will bear her guilt.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, M paɣir a ni n suhu zaa, ka ni tibigir a yuli sahakam.
en: My Lord God, I praise you with all my heart. I will honor your name forever!.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Ti ni niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: and they all promised, We will do everything the Lord has commanded. So Moses told the Lord about this.

dag: Di saha ka Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm daa chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni nti yɛli tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: Hamor and his son Shechem went to their citys gate and spoke to the men of their city.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ malaikanim mi polo: Naawuni chɛ ka o malaikanim be kaman pɔhim; ka chɛ ka o tuumba be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: But about the angels God said, God makes his angels winds, and his servants flames of fire.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋme n-deei bɛ fɔntinsi mini bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. Dindali maa Mɔab tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka o suhu be shɛm la.
en: The towns of Moab will be captured. The strong hiding places will be defeated. At that time Moabs soldiers will be filled with fear, like a woman giving birth.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa yɛl o.
en: They answered.

dag: Miri ka a bo yomyom n-zaŋ a nuhi pa so zuɣu m-piig o ni o tum ti Duuma tuma; a mi miri ka a chɛ ka a nuu be so daalahichi tumbu ni. Gbib amaŋa m-be kasi.
en: Think carefully before you lay your hands on anyone to make him an elder. Dont share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa, ka a wuntia zaligunim zaa nyɛla din kul ni be sahakam.
en: Every word you say can be trusted. Your laws are fair and will last forever.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ ma, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni yu binshɛŋa ka Yawɛ je li maa bahi bee n-chɛ Ijiptinim buɣa la jɛmbu. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi ni n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods. In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt.

dag: Hal di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni m birigiya, m biriginsim maa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim bɛn bi niŋdi anabinim yɛligu yɛda ŋɔ!.
en: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayɔbu bɛ tinsi maa ni na nti pahi Gibianim zuɣu.
en: On that day, the Benjaminites called up from their cities twenty-six thousand men armed with swords, not counting those living in Gibeah.

dag: Puri dola zaɣ nɛya; ka tiŋgbani fabinda, dama bindira saɣimya zaa, ka wain naai, ka kpam gba lan kani.
en: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa laɣim Yisa sani maa ka o bɔhi ba.
en: Now as the Pharisees were gathering, Jesus asked them.

dag: ka daa ti lan yi Bamɔt mi chaŋ vinvamli shɛli din daa do Mɔab tintariga Pisiga zolɔŋni zaŋ lab tiŋgban nɛli polo la.
en: from Bamoth to the valley in the Moabite countryside, to the top of Pisgah overlooking Jeshimon.

dag: Kuɣa pihi sɔŋ lihi nya nyɛla din ŋmaari naŋgbankpeeni, ka lan nyɛ din maani wɔɣira ayi bɛn mali taba yɛla.
en: The dice settle conflicts and keep strong opponents apart.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa nyɛ anab maa daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: The young prophet left for Ramoth.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani ŋun laɣim Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be yɔɣu la na ni laɣim zuliya shɛb na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Sovereign Lord , who has brought his people Israel home from exile, has promised that he will bring still other people to join them.

dag: O bidibisi maa daa yi chanila tab yinsi ti puhiri churi sokam dabisili dali, ka daa yi timdi booni bɛ tizɔpaɣiba maa na ka bɛ mini ba ti diri ka nyura.
en: Jobs sons took turns having dinner parties in their homes, and they invited their sisters.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa do bɛ sansana ni n-lihiri taba daba ayopɔin. Ka bɛ daa ti gbaai tab tuhibu daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Sirianim tɔbbihi bɛn chan tiŋ tuhi kɔbiga dindali maa.
en: For seven days the Syrians and the Israelites stayed in their camps, facing each other. On the seventh day they started fighting, and the Israelites killed a hundred thousand Syrians.

dag: Paɣ kam ŋun nyɛ sɔnya, yin kum o.
en: Dont allow a female sorcerer to live.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu pali bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na.
en: Those who are good have good things saved in their hearts. Thats why they say good things. But those who are evil have hearts full of evil, and thats why they say things that are evil.

dag: dindina di simdi ka dilan pini. Amaa o di pini dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: the person must shave the area, without shaving the scabies. The priest will then quarantine that person another seven days.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ ka di ti paag a sanna, ka nyin ka suɣilo? Di shihir a mi, ka nyin yihi tahima.
en: Now it's your turn to be in trouble, and you are too stunned to face it.

dag: Judas ni daa ti paana o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: So Judas went over to Jesus and said, Teacher! Then he kissed him.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Dama ti bɔri ni ti ʒi a zilinli lab ti yɛli bɛn tim ti na. Nyin lee yɛliya ni a nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Then tell us who you are, they said. We have to take an answer back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself.

dag: Ti yi kul mal ania, ti min o ni ti laɣim di nam. Ti yi zaɣis o, o gba ni ti zaɣisi ti.
en: If we endure, we will also rule together. If we deny him, he will also deny us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli bo n-nya buni ŋmanila noon so ŋun ŋuni o ni bi nye gal shɛŋa zuɣu wɔɣi li. Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu pirigili puuni, bɛ ni ti kɔŋ li, ka bɛ bahigu saha, niriba ni ti boli ba jɛra.
en: Like a partridge gathering a brood that is not its own, so are those who acquire their wealth corruptly. By midlife it will be gone; afterward they will look like fools.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛriya mi, Wummiya; chɛliya ka n gba yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: That's why I ask you to listen to me. *.

dag: Daliri din ni chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋa n-yaɣi n ni daa nya kahigibunim pam shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka go shɛli din be kaman Sintani tumo la kuhi ma n-kpalim be n niŋgbuŋ ni ni di muɣisi ma n-chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋ yaɣi.
en: I was given a thorn in my body because of the outstanding revelations Ive received so that I wouldnt be conceited. Its a messenger from Satan sent to torment me so that I wouldnt be conceited.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabiya: Man Naawuni duu ni boonila wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu.
en: He said to them, Its written, My house will be called a house of prayer. But youve made it a hideout for crooks.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi paŋ liɣiri so sani, bɛ je ni bɛ yo li, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyɛla bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ka tiri pini.
en: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.

dag: N yɛn ŋahila ŋaha. N yɛn tɔɣisila kurimbuni ha ashili yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba bi tiligi; ka daa deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: So the Israelites defeated Og and his army. They killed him, his sons, and all his army. Then the Israelites took all his land.

dag: N ni kari toli ka chɛn ya, ka bɛ ku lan saɣim yi puri ni bindira, ka yi puri ni wain tihi ku lan kɔŋ wala walibu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will not let insects destroy your crops, and your grapevines will be loaded with grapes.

dag: ni kom baptaizibu ni nuhi zaŋ pa niriba zuɣu mini kpiimba kum ni neebu ni tibidarigibo din ka bahigu yɛla.
en: of the teaching about baptisms and the laying on of hands; of the resurrection of the dead and the eternal judgment.

dag: Yi daa be muɣisigu ni ka kuhi boli ma, ka n tiligi ya. N daa bela n daashili biɛhigu shee din nyɛ saa tahibu la puuni, ka garigi ya. N daa zahim ya Mɛriba kom la shee.
en: When you were in trouble, you called to me, and I saved you. From my hiding place in the storm, I answered you. I put you to the test at the springs of Meribah.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa lan yɛli Izraɛl naa maa, Daŋ bɔhi baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm pɔi.
en: Then he added, But first let's consult the Lord .

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias yɛli bɛn ʒe m-miri Pool maa ni bɛ ŋmɛm o naŋgbani.
en: Then Ananias the high priest ordered the men standing beside Paul to hit him on the mouth.

dag: Yawɛ, n zaŋ tiliginsim lahiba suŋ la yɛla n-yɛli niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni. Yawɛ, nyama, a mi ni n kul ku fo n noli zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: In the assembly of all your people, Lord , I told the good news that you save us. You know that I will never stop telling it.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa yi n-chaŋ ti yɛl o deennim bɛn daa yɛn kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi la, Yiɣisimiya n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, dama Yawɛ yɛn saɣim li mi. Amaa ka o deennim maa daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ asahi.
en: Lot went to speak to his sons-in-law, married to his daughters, and said, Get up and get out of this place because the LORD is about to destroy the city. But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi kalinli ti ku lan galisi Yawɛ ni yɛn kari ya bahi zuliya shɛb ni maa.
en: The Lord will scatter you among other nations, where only a few of you will survive.

dag: N yura ŋmanila molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ polli. Nyama, ŋuna n-ʒe ti gooni nyaaŋa n-vɔbisiri lihiri ti takɔriti ni, ka lihiri dari din puli gabi tab voya ni ŋɔ.
en: My lover is like a gazelle, like a young stag. There he stands beside the wall. He looks in through the window and glances through the lattice.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be tintan zuɣu nya saria karibu. Dina n-nyɛ: Holɔn mini Jaaza ni Mɛfaat.
en: Judgment has come on the cities of the plateau: on Holon, Jahzah, Mephaath.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitaniyini.
en: Josiah was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled years from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti dol o ba chaŋ puu ni kachɛriba sani.
en: The boy grew. One day the boy went out into the fields to see his father and the men cutting the grain.

dag: Dama yi mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi yi dimnim maa, ka o chɛ ka yi di nasara.
en: The Lord your God is going with you to help you fight against your enemies. He will help you win.

dag: Dama n suhuyiɣisili maa dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka ni di hal ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Di saɣindi dunia mini di binshɛɣukam, ka niŋdi buɣim nyɔri zoya tanzahi.
en: A fire burns in me— it will blaze to the depths of the grave; it will destroy the land and its crops; it will blacken the base of the mountains.

dag: Amaa ka Hadad daa be Ijipti maa ka ti wum ni Dauda min o sapashin kpɛm Jɔab zaa kpiya, ka o daa yɛli Firawuna, Tim ma soli ka n lab kuli n ya.
en: In Egypt Hadad heard that David had died and that Joab, the commander of the army, was dead. So Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me go home to my own country.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun wumdi bɛn be sarika ni ŋuhibu, ka fari bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la bahira.
en: to hear the prisoners groans, to set free those condemned to death.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi ni n-kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Asɔs ni ti ti zaŋ Pool pahi timaŋ zuɣu; ti min o ni daa pun tɔɣisi zali shɛm m-bala, dama o daa yɛliya ni ŋun yɛn chaŋla tiŋ paai ni.
en: We went on to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we intended to take Paul on board. Paul had arranged this, since he intended to make his way there by land.

dag: O yi di milig o jaaŋgbee ka chɛ ma, ka bi chɛ ka o yɛla kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm.
en: remove his rod from me, so his fury wouldnt frighten me.

dag: ka dihi ti nam n-zaŋ ti leei maligumaaniba ni ti jɛmd o Ba Naawuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu, ka simdi ni o su yiko hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: who made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be glory and power forever and always. Amen.

dag: N ni daa ti gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu saha shɛli ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kana nti kpe bɛ ni kaman o ni daa kpe ti ni shɛm di piligu ni la.
en: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa daa kul ba n-ʒe bɛ zaashɛhi ni gili Midiannim sansani maa, ka Midiannim maa daa kuhi ka yiɣisi guui.
en: Gideons men stayed where they were. But inside the camp, the men of Midian began shouting and running away.

dag: ni Ofiri ni Havila ni Jɔbab; bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jokitan bidibisi.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these men were Joktans sons.

dag: Bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ diribarilim zuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli n-kul dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli.
en: Israels evil greed made me angry, so I punished them. I turned away from them because I was angry. But they continued to do wrong. They did whatever they wanted.

dag: Ka yi kul ni mali pam din ni chɛ ka yi tiri nirilim niŋbu pina, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni nya paɣibu ti ni niŋdi shɛm puuni;.
en: You will be made rich in every way so that you can be generous in every way. Such generosity produces thanksgiving to God through us.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti daŋ yibu nolɔɣu kukoli saha chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Very early the next morning, long before daylight, Jesus got up and left the house. He went out of town to a lonely place, where he prayed.

dag: Amaa tinim kul ku nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga; ti kul ni ʒiɛla Naawuni ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm tariga la puuni hal ni zaŋ chaŋ yi gba sani.
en: But we will not boast about anything outside the work that was given us to do. We will limit our boasting to the work God gave us, but this work includes our work with you.

dag: A mi sagbana ni yili zuɣusaa shɛm? Ŋuna ŋun mi binshɛɣukam ŋɔ daalahiziba tuma ni ka di niŋda.
en: Do you understand the positioning of the clouds, the amazing deeds of one with perfect knowledge.

dag: N ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri fo bɛ sani. Ka nir ku lan wum aŋgo kukoli bee amiliya kukoli bee n-wum nɛya niɛmbu vuri bee n-nya firila neesim.
en: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.

dag: Ka Leeban mini Bɛtuɛl daa yɛl o, Yɛlli ŋɔ ni yila Yawɛ sani ŋɔ na, dindina ti ku tooi yɛl a din bie bee din viɛl zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Laban and Bethuel answered, The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila, ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni dawulɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka piɛbiri kikahi n-wari waa ni bɛ yaa zaa Naawuni tooni.
en: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

dag: ni Shaaraim ni Aditaim ni Gɛdɛra ni Gɛdɛrɔtaim: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaanahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim. In total: fourteen cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ bidibbina ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ni bɛ ti fa nam Sool sani n-ti o kaman Naawuni ni daa yɛli shɛm la kalinli m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the numbers of the commanders of those armed for battle who came to David in Hebron to make sure he took over Sauls kingdom, according to the LORDs word.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Saadis Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali Naawuni shih ayopɔin mini saŋmaris ayopɔin la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi mali yuli din wuhiri ni yi ne, amaa yi kpimi.
en: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ni o binyɛri bɔribɔri n-kpɛhi naa sani; ka o zɔnim bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi dol o.
en: Clothed in beauty, she is led to the king, followed by her bridesmaids.

dag: Naɣ kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam; ka doli zaligu shɛŋa zaa n dabili Musa ni daa zali ya la viɛnyɛliŋga; ka miri ka a ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li, ka di chɛ ka a tooi diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: But you must be strong and brave about obeying the commands my servant Moses gave you. If you follow his teachings exactly, you will be successful in everything you do.

dag: Ka pako faralaan so daa kana nti tɔhila pihinu diba ayi din nyɛ kɔbo.
en: then a poor widow came along and dropped in two little copper coins, worth about a penny.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ mani m-pii duu ŋɔ m-mal li ka di be kasi ni di chɛ ka yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka n ni chɛ ka n zaɣa be di ni ka lan yuuni li sahakam.
en: I have chosen this Temple, and I have made it a holy place. So I will be honored there forever. I will watch over it and think of it always.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni ʒirinim lu n zuɣu. Bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: Wicked people and liars have attacked me. They tell lies about me.

dag: Amaa di zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka leei din bie n-gari zuliya shɛŋa mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din gil li zaa ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la.
en: But Jerusalem rebelled against my commands and showed that she was more wicked than the other nations, more disobedient than the countries around her. Jerusalem rejected my commands and refused to keep my laws.

dag: Dama ŋun be nam ʒiishee maa sunsuuni ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ gula, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yɛn zaŋdi ba tahiri nyɛvili kɔbilisirim shee. Ka Naawuni ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi.
en: The Lamb in front of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to springs of water that give life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi nɛma labisi ti yuuni puuni yi ni zal li da shɛli, di daa n-kul yɛn bala.
en: If the person dedicates the piece of land during the Jubilee year, its value will stay fixed.

dag: O daa diya ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ata. O ma daa nyɛla Absalom bia, ka o yuli booni Maaka.
en: and he ruled three years in Jerusalem. His mother was Maacah, the daughter of Absalom.

dag: N kul bela filiŋ ni dabisili kam; ka vi kul mali ma;.
en: All day long my disgrace confronts me, and shame covers my face.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, zom ma nambɔɣu n-tim Lazarɔs na ka o ti zaŋ o nubil tim kom ni n-tɔɣisi pa n zilinli zuɣu ka di maai, dama n nyari azaaba pam buɣim ŋɔ ni.
en: He shouted, Father Abraham, have mercy on me. Send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because Im suffering in this flame.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ku ŋma ʒiri bee n-taɣ o ni pun yɛli shɛm, dama o pala ninsala ka ni yɛli shɛli ka lan taɣi.
en: Israel's majestic God does not lie or change his mind. He is not a human being—he does not change his mind.

dag: Ka naa daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina m-mali nam ʒiishee zaɣ titali, ka chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaa m-pa di zuɣu.
en: King Solomon also built a large throne with ivory decorations. It was covered with pure gold.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka Sairiini do so ŋun yuli daa booni Saimɔn yi tinshee garita, ka bɛ gbaag o nti zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li doli Yisa.
en: As they led Jesus away, they grabbed Simon, a man from Cyrene, who was coming in from the countryside. They put the cross on his back and made him carry it behind Jesus.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Naa Dauda yaaŋa n-ni bala yɔɣɔ.
en: All the people were amazed at what Jesus did. They said, Maybe he is the promised Son of David.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o yihi ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni suhuyiɣisili tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord became very angry and upset with them. So he took them out of their land. He put them in another land, where they are today.

dag: Yawɛ zal o ni yɛn siɣisi karimbaannim zaa mini ninʒeensinim ni bɛnkam zaa duhi bɛmaŋa dahin shɛli.
en: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.

dag: Ka Biliha ŋun daa nyɛ Reechɛl dabipaɣ la bidibisi daa nyɛ Dan mini Naftali.
en: His sons by Bilhah, Rachels maid, were Dan and Naphtali.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛn kpɛla tiŋ ŋɔ ni na nti ku Ijiptinima, ka o yi ti nya ʒim maa yili shɛli dunoli zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira ni, o ni yaɣi lala yili maa gari, ka ku chɛ ka kum maa kpe yi yinsi ti kun ya.
en: When the LORD comes by to strike down the Egyptians and sees the blood on the beam above the door and on the two doorposts, the LORD will pass over that door. He wont let the destroyer enter your houses to strike you down.

dag: Aduna ni daa nya li ka o me maligu bimbini zali di gbini, ka moli molo yɛli, Biɛɣuni ti sa yɛn puhila Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf. Then Aaron announced, Tomorrow will be a festival to the LORD.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Filistianim daa ti lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima. Ka Akishi daa yɛli Dauda, Baŋmi ni di simdi ka a min a niriba ŋɔ pahi n tɔbbihi ŋɔ zuɣu doli ma chaŋ.
en: Later, the Philistines gathered their armies to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, Do you understand that you and your men must go with me to fight against Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, n ku deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, n ni chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa hal ni o nyɛvili tariga n dabili Dauda ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pii so ka o doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: So I will take the kingdom away from Solomons family. I chose David because he obeyed all my laws and commands. So for my servant David, I will let Solomon be the king for the rest of his life.

dag: Yɛlim do kura la ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali yɛm, ka doli wuhibu maŋli, ka mali yurilim, ka nyɛ bɛn mal ania yɛda niŋbu ni.
en: Instruct the older men to be sober, sensible, and self-controlled; to be sound in their faith, love, and endurance.

dag: Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbala din kabi, ka bɛ mali bɛ zilima yɔhindi niriba. Tinvura lɔɣu be bɛ naŋgbampiba ni.
en: Their throat is a grave that has been opened. They are deceitful with their tongues, and the poison of vipers is under their lips. .

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa mi ni Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili soli mini kum soli sɔŋ ya.
en: Then the Lord told me to say to the people, Listen! I, the Lord , am giving you a choice between the way that leads to life and the way that leads to death.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anahi daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi wuntaŋ zuɣu, ka ti o yiko ni o tulim be kaman buɣim la n-wɔb daadamnima;.
en: The fourth angel poured his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to burn people with fire.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi Hadirak tiŋgbɔŋnim mini Damaskusnim tibili. Pa Izraɛlnim zuliya kɔŋko ka Yawɛ su, amaa ŋuna n-su Siria tiŋgbɔŋ gba.
en: This is the Lord s message against the land of Hadrach and against the city of Damascus. The tribes of Israel are not the only people who know about the Lord . Everyone looks to him for help.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa bɔhi Amnɔn, Nabia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim mali suhugarigu biɛɣukam lala? Yɛlim ma din muɣis a. Ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, N kɔre n-kpe m mabia Absalom tizɔpaɣ Tama ni.
en: He said to Amnon, You are the kings son. So why do you always look so sad? Tell me what the trouble is! Amnon told Jonadab, I love Tamar. But she is the sister of my half-brother Absalom.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nini tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm nyɛla jɛra, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛm soli ni yi barina ni.
en: It is foolish to be too confident. Those who ask for advice are wise and will escape disaster.

dag: Bɛ balim ti ni nimmoo ni ti ti ba soli ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuu kpɛhi Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu ni.
en: They urgently begged us for the privilege of sharing in this service for the saints.

dag: Ka napaɣ Atalia daa wum vuri maa, ka kpe niriba maa sani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Queen Athaliah heard the noise from the guards and the people, so she went to them at the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan dɔɣ o tizo Ɛbɛl gba. Ɛbɛl daa nyɛla piɛgula, ka Keen mi nyɛ pukpara.
en: Later she had another son and named him Abel. Abel became a sheep farmer, but Cain farmed the land.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o ni pun tum shɛm min o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa wuhi ba la yɛla.
en: They forgot Gods deeds as well as the wondrous works he showed them.

dag: Abimilɛk kum nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn fa Izraɛlnim bahi yi palo. Lala nir maa n-daa nyɛ Pua bia Tola ŋun daa nyɛ Dɔdo yaaŋa la. O daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka be Shamir din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la.
en: Tola was the next person to rescue Israel. He belonged to the Issachar tribe, but he lived in Shamir, a town in the hill country of Ephraim. His father was Puah, and his grandfather was Dodo.

dag: Di daa nyɛla chɛrubinim mini abie tihi kɔtomsi, chɛrubinima ayi sunsuuni abie tia n-daa beni. Chɛrubi yino kam daa malila ninni diba ayi.
en: there were carved winged creatures and palm trees. The palm trees were positioned between the winged creatures, and each winged creature had two faces.

dag: Yi ni ti biri, amaa ka ku kpuɣi atam. Yi ni ti kahim olivi kpam, amaa ka ku zaŋ kpam maa ʒe yimaŋa. Yi ni ti tɔɣi wain, amaa ka ku nyu wain maa.
en: You sow, but you dont gather. You tread down olives, but you dont anoint with oil; you tread grapes, but dont drink wine.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni bɛ ni kpi mɔɣu maa ni. Bɛ ni so daa bi kpalim, naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: because the Lord told them that they would all die in the desert. The only two men who were left alive were Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

dag: Bom yɛm, bom tɛhi zilima. Mira ka a tam bee n-zaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n noli ni bahi.
en: Get wisdom; get understanding. Dont forget and dont turn away from my words.

dag: Tuun kpɛma tumbu tiri nir yiko, amaa vinnyaɣili chɛ ka nir leerila dabili.
en: Those who work hard will be put in charge of others, but lazy people will have to work like slaves.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi Pita. Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla.
en: The Lord turned around and looked straight at Peter, and Peter remembered that the Lord had said to him, Before the rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you do not know me.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha ni bɛ zaŋm tɔrokɔnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni m-mali kuli ti zaŋ bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bibihi ni yi ba n-kuli kpe na.
en: Also tell your brothers to take some wagons from Egypt for their wives and children to ride in. And be sure they bring their father.

dag: Pirigili din daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili maa ni, Musa daa yihila ninsalinim ninvuɣ yino ninvuɣ pihinu kam puuni, ka yihi biŋkɔbiri pihinu kam puuni biŋkɔb yino n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn daa su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma la kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: From this share Moses took one out of every fifty prisoners and animals, and as the Lord had commanded, gave them to the Levites who were in charge of the Lord 's Tent.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa lan pihi kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa.
en: Again the Jewish opposition picked up stones in order to stone him.

dag: mini Jɔana ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛrɔd yiŋ tumtumdi so ŋun yuli daa booni Chuza la paɣa ni Suzaana ni niriba pam bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli zɔri Yisa min o nyaandoliba kuŋ la.
en: Also with these women were Joanna, the wife of Chuza , Susanna, and many other women. These women used their own money to help Jesus and his apostles.

dag: Ijiptinim ni ti di vi, bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo na nuu ni. .
en: Daughter Egypt will be humiliated, handed over to people from the north.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa ti buŋ maa noli ka o bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ a ka a fiɛb ma buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then the Lord caused the donkey to speak. The donkey said to Balaam, Why are you angry at me? What have I done to you? You have hit me three times.

dag: Nyini n-zali dunia di tariga, nyini n-zali woligu saha mini kikaa saha.
en: You set all the boundaries of the earth in place. Summer and winter? You made them!.

dag: Yaɣimɛr ka yiko ni o zaŋ yaɣ kpil yini me duɣ shɛli din ni ku buchi zama ni, ka lan zaŋ li me duɣ shɛli din ku yi zama ni?.
en: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa wum ni Asiria naa yiɣisi Lakishi, ka o daa labi ti nya ka ŋun naa tuhirila Libinanima.
en: The field commander heard that the Assyrian king had left Lachish. So he went back to the king and found him attacking Libnah.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yiko daa be bɛ sani, ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋmaligi jɛmdi ti Duuma.
en: The Lords power was with them, and a large number came to believe and turned to the Lord.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. Yilimiya yila paɣ o yuli, dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim.
en: Praise the Lord , because he is good. Praise his name, because it brings such joy!.

dag: Ka bɛ yiɣisi zani n-yɛrigi luɣilikam chaŋ ti teei gili Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda biɛhigu shee mini Naawuni tin yurigu la; ka buɣim ti yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba.
en: They came up across the whole earth and surrounded the saints camp, the city that God loves. But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.

dag: A paɣ ni ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala a yiŋ puuni. A bihi ni ŋmanila olivi tia wula n-ʒi n-gil a, ka yi laɣim diri ŋman yini ni.
en: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ ni di wuhi ni n kɔŋla shɛli, dama m bɔhim ni n chɛ ka n nini tiɣi n ni mali shɛli.
en: I am telling you this, but not because I need something. I have learned to be satisfied with what I have and with whatever happens.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi ni n-kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Asɔs ni ti ti zaŋ Pool pahi timaŋ zuɣu; ti min o ni daa pun tɔɣisi zali shɛm m-bala, dama o daa yɛliya ni ŋun yɛn chaŋla tiŋ paai ni.
en: Paul decided to travel by land to Assos. The rest of us went on ahead by ship, and we were to take him aboard there.

dag: Ka n ni di paai kɔbiliga maa gbinna zuŋɔ, ka n yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, a yi ni ti ma nasara n chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, You, Lord , are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son.

dag: Dɛhi nɔri li mi sɔŋdi tiŋa, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gɔri mɔɣu ni diri li.
en: wild hogs trample it down, and wild animals feed on it.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: He went into the presence of Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

dag: N dabisa ŋmanila zaawuni shilinshia; n kuumi kaman mɔri la.
en: My life is like the evening shadows; I am like dry grass.

dag: amaa n ni yɛli zuliya shɛli maa nim yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, n ni taɣi n tɛha, ka ku lan chɛ ka n ni lo ni alɔbo shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu maa paai ba.
en: but then that nation turns from its evil, I will not do what I said I would.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa di zuɣu.
en: God heard what they were doing and became very angry. So he rejected Israel completely!.

dag: Ka o zaŋ li mihi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa buyopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka o yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ maa bahi ka o yiɣi.
en: He must sprinkle the blood seven times on those who had the skin disease. Then he must announce that they are clean. After that the priest must go to an open field and let the living bird go free.

dag: Ka n daa gari a sani n-nya a ni be a ʒim ni talinda, a ni daa do a ʒim ni maa, ka n yɛl a, Niŋmi nyɛvili.
en: Then I passed by. I saw you lying there, kicking in the blood. You were covered with blood, but I said, Please live! Yes, you were covered with blood, but I said, Please live.

dag: yɛra, Ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋun be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, ti paɣir a a ni deeg a yiko din galisi n-diri nam zuɣu.
en: The elders said, We give thanks to you, Lord God All-Powerful. You are the one who is and who always was. We thank you because you have used your great power and have begun to rule.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Di yi nyɛla saha biɛla bee pam puuni, pa a kɔŋko gba, amaa bɛn zaa be kpe n-wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, n di bi zaɣisi ni yi zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ kul gbaai yihila zoligɔnim din lo ma ŋɔ.
en: Paul said, It is not important if it is easy or if it is hard. I pray to God that not only you but that everyone listening to me today could be saved and be just like me—except for these chains I have.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa kaman bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba yi tin shɛŋa na maa niriba ni daa niŋdi shɛm.
en: So they worshipped the LORD, but they also served their own gods according to the religious practices of the nations from which they had been exiled.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ni zaŋ suhudo shɛli tin ya la su yi suhuri, dama suhudoo maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya n-laɣim ya niŋgbun yin la ni. Ka paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: Let the peace that Christ gives control your thinking. It is for peace that you were chosen to be together in one body. And always be thankful.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, m baŋya ni ʒilinsi zuɣu ka yi mini yi kpamba daa niŋ Yisa lala maa.
en: And now, my friends, I know that what you and your leaders did to Jesus was due to your ignorance.

dag: Dama kaman niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini ka mali yaɣ bɔbili, ka di yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa nyɛ niŋgbun yin la, lala mi n-nyɛ Masia gba.
en: Christ is like a single body, which has many parts; it is still one body, even though it is made up of different parts.

dag: Amaa o daa timdi anabinim bɛ sani ni bɛ ti chɛ ka bɛ labi ŋun Yawɛ sanna. Ka anabinim maa daa saɣisi ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: The Lord sent prophets to warn them to return to him, but the people refused to listen.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi din daa nyɛ Naa Dauda dini, ka be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-ti sapashinnim maa.
en: Then the priest gave the unit commanders King Davids spears and shields, which were kept in the LORDs temple.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa sɔɣi Ibrahimma min o paɣ Zara ni Yisahaku min o paɣ Ribɛka; ka n gba daa sɔɣi Liya nimaani.
en: Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried in that cave. Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried in that cave. I buried my wife Leah in that cave.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nina ni sabigimi gari sala. So bi lan baŋdi ba soya zuɣu. Bɛ niŋgbuŋgbana kuumi pa bɛ kɔba zuɣu; di kuumi kaman dari la.
en: Now they lie unknown in the streets, their faces blackened in death; their skin, dry as wood, has shriveled on their bones.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mali yurilim maŋli sahakam zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani, ka chɛ ka o wuntitali yiri zahira bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi sani ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But for those who honor the Lord , his love lasts forever, and his goodness endures for all generations.

dag: wula ka din nyɛ Naawuni Shia din la ku gari lala?.
en: Wont the ministry of the Spirit be much more glorious?.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi yi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di ni gbuɣi ya bahi kaman di ni daa gbuɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be yi tooni la bahi shɛm la.
en: so that the land does not vomit you out because you have made it unclean, just as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

dag: ti yɛl o, Amiliya lɔbu ni sokam daŋdila wain viɛlli tibu pɔi, ka niriba yi ti nyu n-tiɣi, di saha ka bɛ naanyi zaŋdi wain piti na, amaa nyin zaŋla wain nyaɣisili sɔɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: and said to him, People always serve the best wine first. Later, when the guests are drunk, they serve the cheaper wine. But you have saved the best wine until now.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa zaŋ tabili tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ.
en: So Joshua and his whole army, including the best troops, started out from Gilgal.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.

dag: n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be Jɛrusalɛm; ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka n zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini wuntitali su ba.
en: Ill bring them back so they will dwell in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God—in truth and in righteousness.

dag: Ka Musa mini Nan bia Jɔshua daa kana ti zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ wum li.
en: Moses and Joshua son of Nun came and sang all the words of this song for the Israelites to hear.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa mɛbu tuma, di daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla lala hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi saha.
en: Work on the Temple had been stopped and had remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Emperor Darius of Persia.

dag: O daa lan mali me Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zoli zuɣu la mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zolɔŋni la, ka me goondahi gil li, ka niŋ dunɔdaya mini binyara din kpariti dunɔdaya maa niŋ di ni.
en: Solomon also rebuilt the following cities: Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon .

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi gbaai bɛ tuuli chandi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba shɛm.
en: They marched for the first time at the LORDs command through Moses.

dag: bɛ bi zɔri nambɔɣu, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: they have no pity and speak proudly.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba nyɛla Galili nira yɔɣɔ? Vihim Naawuni Kundi! A yi vihi li, a ni nya ka di bi wuhi ni anab so ni ti yi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: Then they said, Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.

dag: ni Kɛnaz ni Tɛman ni Mibizar.
en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: When the sun came up, it scorched the plants; and they dried up because they had no roots.

dag: O zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ o zaligu wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.

dag: ka zaŋ zuliya pia ti a, ka zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: I will let Davids family keep only one tribe. I will do this because of my servant David and because of Jerusalem, the city that I chose from among all the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ŋun be kasi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn miri ma sani, ka chɛ ka sokam nya n jilima. Ka Aduna daa kul shini.
en: Moses said to Aaron, When the LORD said, I will show that I am holy among those near me, and before all the people I will manifest my glorious presence, this is what he meant! But Aaron was silent.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihita mini bipuɣinsi pihita. Ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣinsi pihita maa ti dɔbba kpaŋa bɛn pa o daŋ puuni niriba; ka daa bo paɣiba pihita kpaŋ na ti ti o bidibisi maa mi. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayopɔin.
