en: Ibzan had sons and daughters. He told his daughters to marry men who were not his relatives. And he found women who were not his relatives, and his sons married these women. Ibzan was a judge for the Israelites for seven years.

dag: Ka Ibram ni daa ti kpe Ijipti, Ijiptinim daa shiri nyaya ka paɣ maa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: When he crossed the border into Egypt, the Egyptians did see that his wife was beautiful.

dag: Jarɛd daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihiyɔbunaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Jared lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: ni bɛ ni je paɣ so yi kuli doo ni dab paɣisarili ŋun zan o lana ŋun nyɛ paɣa zaani.
en: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi Troas kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Samɔtirɛsi n-yi biɛɣu n-naanyi paai Niapolis.
en: We left Troas in a ship and sailed to the island of Samothrace. The next day we sailed to the city of Neapolis.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ, amaa yalim yi niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha.
en: Salt is a good thing. But if the salt loses its salty taste, you cant make it salty again.

dag: Yawɛ, n nyɛla a dabili. N nyɛla a dab bipuɣiŋga bia. A kabisi m bandi.
en: I worship you, Lord , just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka bi lan niŋ o tiliginsim yiko naani la zuɣu.
en: because they had no faith in him and did not believe that he would save them.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yil yidan yi di mi saha shɛli tayiɣ ni yɛn kana, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: And you can be sure that if the owner of a house knew the time when the thief would come, he would not let the thief break into his house.

dag: Ka nyin daadam, bɛ ni ti niŋ mihi niŋ a n-zaŋ li lo a, ka a ku lan tooi yina niriba ni.
en: You will be tied with ropes, mortal man, and you will not be able to go out in public.

dag: Alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa yɛn puh o bia daamiliya lɔbu chuɣu.
en: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. Once there was a king who prepared a wedding feast for his son.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaai Sintani ŋun yɔhindi ba maa n-zaŋ o bahi buɣim teeku din nyɛ chilibi buɣim ni, luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbigu la min o daanabi ʒirilan la ni pun be, ka bɛ ni nyari nahiŋgu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the devil, who had deceived them, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet also were. There painful suffering will be inflicted upon them day and night, forever and always.

dag: N tuumbiɛri dumi yaɣi n zuɣu, di tibisim bemi kaman ʒi shɛli din tibisi nyaŋ ma.
en: are so heavy that I am crushed.

dag: Chira ayɔbu zaa ka o daa zaŋ wuh o niriba maa azichi din be o nam puuni mini di jilima ni di dariza ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: He showed off the awesome riches of his kingdom and beautiful treasures as mirrors of how very great he was. The event lasted a long time—six whole months, to be exact!.

dag: Ka yɛm yi pooi yi ni so, ŋun suhimi Naawuni ka o ti o li; dama Naawuni nyɛla ŋun tiri sokam ka di galisira, ka bi nyari so taali di puuni.
en: But anyone who needs wisdom should ask God, whose very nature is to give to everyone without a second thought, without keeping score. Wisdom will certainly be given to those who ask.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam tuma din pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Rehoboams deeds and all that he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ɛlikana bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Amasai mini Ahimɔt.
en: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi Aizaia, Ka bɔ n-lee yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka n kpaŋ maa mini n ni yɛn chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu daba ata dali maa shihirili? Ka Aizaia garigi yɛli.
en: Hezekiah asked Isaiah, Can you prove that the Lord will heal me, so that I can worship in his temple in three days.

dag: O daa tila Bɛtɛlnim mini Ramɔt din be Nɛgɛb Jatir tiŋgban ni la nima.
en: He sent it to the people in Bethel, to the people in Ramah in the southern part of Judah, and to the people in the towns of Jattir.

dag: Ka o daa saɣisi ba yɛli, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu ni boonila zuliya kam wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: Then Jesus began teaching the people and said, It is written in the Scriptures, My Temple will be called a house of prayer for all nations. But you have changed it into a hiding place for thieves. .

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni daa nya ka ti ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka ti daa saɣi ni ti kɔŋko kpalim be Atɛnsi.
en: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛla ba, Di bi simdi ni bɛ chaŋ. Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di.
en: Jesus said, The people dont need to go away. You give them some food to eat.

dag: Bɛ yi ti gbahi tinvura bee n-nyu binshɛli din nyɛ lɔɣu, di ku niŋ ba shɛli; ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa barinim zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: If they pick up snakes or drink any poison, they will not be hurt. They will lay their hands on sick people, and they will get well.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Ʒe dunoli maa ni. So yi ti kana ti bɔh a ni so be kpe, nyin yɛlim o ni so kani.
en: Then Sisera said to Jael, Go stand at the entrance to the tent. If anyone comes by and asks you, Is anyone in there? say, No.

dag: o ni daa wum Lazarɔs bariŋ maa yɛla o daa kpalim o ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa n-niŋla biɛr ayi pahi;.
en: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days.

dag: dama m bi yɛri shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa n-zali ma n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ka tɔɣisi shɛm.
en: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.

dag: dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ a ni yɛn niŋ so naani, ka o mi ku chɛ ka tɔŋ gbaag a napɔŋ.
en: The LORD will be your confidence; he will guard your feet from being snared.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti ma, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam kul ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: He will be the one to build a temple for me, and I will make sure that his dynasty continues forever.

dag: ka daa lab kuli ti bo tulaale mini kpaʒiɛrim zali. Ka bɛ daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: then they went away and prepared fragrant spices and perfumed oils. They rested on the Sabbath, in keeping with the commandment.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be salo maa ni yɛli Yisa, Karimba, kpahim a nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni ka bɛ fo.
en: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, Teacher, make your disciples stop shouting.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o sani ka bɛ bɔri bindirigu la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered, Haven't you read what David did when he and his followers were hungry and in need?.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, M paɣir a ni n suhu zaa, ka ni tibigir a yuli sahakam.
en: I will praise you with all my heart, O Lord my God; I will proclaim your greatness forever.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba. Bɛ ŋmanila bɔrɔbɔro du shɛli bɛ ni mali buɣim niŋ ka di bii, ka bɔrɔbɔromaana bi lan niŋ buɣim niŋ di ni bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔribu saha hal ti paai di dubu saha la.
en: They are all treacherous and disloyal. Their hatred smolders like the fire in an oven, which is not stirred by the baker until the dough is ready to bake.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zɔri vi ni a di ti Duuma bee man ŋun nyɛ o dansarika ŋɔ shɛhira, amaa Naawuni yiko ni, chɛ ka m min a laɣim di wahala lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu.
en: So dont be ashamed of the testimony about the Lord or of me, his prisoner. Instead, share the suffering for the good news, depending on Gods power.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ, a dimnim taala duŋ; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a gba mal a gadama.
en: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.

dag: Duumanima, niŋmiya yi daba din niŋ kamaata, dama yi mi ni yi gba mali Duuma alizanda ni.
en: Masters, be just and fair to your slaves, knowing that you yourselves have a master in heaven.

dag: Ka anab maa daa lan chaŋ do so sani ti yɛl o, Ŋmɛm ma. Ka doo maa daa ŋme o, ŋ-ŋme n-ti o daŋa.
en: Then this same prophet went to another man and said, Hit me! This man did so; he hit him a hard blow and hurt him.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din gba daa be yɔɣu ni la n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtaraba mini Midin ni Sɛkaka.
en: In the desert: Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Yɛlimiya ma.
en: Tell me: When John baptized people, did his authority come from God or was it only from other people? Answer me.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo, bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa piligila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-zaŋ hal ti du Jɛriko nuzaa polo kuŋkuni n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo ti du zoya zuɣu m-mali hal ti paai di tariga Bɛtavɛn yɔɣu ni.
en: On the north their border began at the Jordan and then went up the slope north of Jericho and westward through the hill country as far as the desert of Bethaven.

dag: Nandaamba yi kuhira ka a baɣa kani, a gba ni ti kuhira ka so ku wum.
en: If you refuse to listen to the cry of the poor, your own cry for help will not be heard.

dag: Ka Naa Darius daa dih o nuu zaligu gbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: So King Darius made the law and signed it.

dag: A dabili yɛn guhi hal ti paai bɔ saha? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka la tibili?.
en: How long must I wait for you to punish those who persecute me?.

dag: Ka vuri daa mɔni, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim daa yiɣisi zani n-zaɣisi ka yɛli, Ti bi nya doo ŋɔ galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di pa shɛli shi so bee malaika n-shiri tɔɣis o di yɛla.
en: Council members were shouting loudly. Some Pharisees who were legal experts stood up and insisted forcefully, We find nothing wrong with this man! What if a spirit or angel has spoken to him.

dag: ka Ɛlam daa pah anu ka Jɛhɔhanan pah ayɔbu, ka Ɛliɛhɔinai daa pah ayopɔin.
en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

dag: Kul niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm Yawɛ ni pii tin shɛl maa ni, ka doliya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You must then act according to the ruling they announced to you from that location, the one the LORD selects. You must follow very carefully everything they instruct you to do.

dag: amaa n nya zaligu shɛli n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni ka di mini n tɛha ni zaligu tuhiri taba n-zaŋ ma leeg alahichi din be n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni maa dabili.
en: But I see a different law at work in my body—a law that fights against the law which my mind approves of. It makes me a prisoner to the law of sin which is at work in my body.

dag: Ka m mɔŋ ya saa saha shɛli yi bindira ni bɔri saa pam. N chɛ ka saa miri tin shɛlinima, ka bi miri tin shɛlinima; ka chɛ ka saa miri pu shɛl ni, ka chɛ ka o bi miri pu shɛl ni ka di bindira kpira.
en: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan damdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim tiŋa.
en: Abraham bowed before the Hittites.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa wuh o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, amaa man ni ʒili ya ʒi tibisa gari lala. M ba daa malila barazim saɣisiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi saɣisiri ya.
en: He did what his friends told him to do and said, My father forced you to work hard, but I will make you work much harder! My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with whips that have sharp metal tips.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n suhu piɛla, ka m paɣiri Naawuni pam. Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, n niŋgbuŋ gba mali tahima;.
en: And so I am filled with gladness, and my words are full of joy. And I, mortal though I am, will rest assured in hope.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi niŋ kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ o yiŋnim kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti be nimaani yuma ayopɔin.
en: So the woman did what the man of God said. She went with her family to stay in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin bidibisi daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Ashibɛl ni Gɛra ni Naaman ni Ɛhi ni Rɔshi ni Mupim ni Hupim ni Arid.
en: Benjamin's sons were Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba nti kpari duu ni biɛɣ neei, dama di daa nyɛla zaawun yuŋ.
en: The Jewish leaders arrested Peter and John and put them in jail. It was already night, so they kept them in jail until the next day.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛl o, N nyala tiwal moma ni be piɛ shɛl ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim biɛɣu yipa neeya. N ku lan chɛ ba.
en: He said to me, Amos, what do you see? I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then the Lord said to me, The end has come to my people Israel. I will not ignore their sins anymore.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka a min a yidan naai noli ni yi zahim ti Duuma Shia Kasi? Nyama, bɛn zaŋ a yidan yi nti sɔɣi n-na be soli kanna ŋɔ; bɛ ni zaŋ a gba yi.
en: Peter said to her, Why did you and your husband agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! Do you hear those footsteps? The men who buried your husband are at the door. They will carry you out in the same way.

dag: ni Jɛturi ni Nafish ni Kɛdɛma. Ishimail bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bala.
en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

dag: Di teeri ya binshɛŋa din daa niŋ ka di yuui yɛla bee n-lihiri binshɛŋa din daa pun niŋ kurimbuni ha la.
en: So dont remember what happened in earlier times. Dont think about what happened a long time ago.

dag: Dama zuliya shɛli yi nuzaa polo na ti lir o. Bɛ ni ti chɛ ka o tiŋgbani maa leei dabari, ka so ku lan be nimaani. Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa ni ti yi nimaani zo.
en: A nation from the north will attack Babylon. That nation will make Babylon like an empty desert. No one will live there. Both men and animals will run away.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Ashaara niŋbu din doli taba, nyama, dina n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: One disaster after another is coming on you.

dag: O daa yihi ti ti dimnim nuu ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God rescued us from our enemies— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Yisifu daa baŋ o biɛyanim maa, amaa ka bɛn lee bi baŋ o.
en: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.

dag: Nakpahi pia puuni wain tihi wala ni ti yihi wain palila lita anii kɔŋko, ka kawaan bira din ni pali lita kɔbiga ni pihinii daatam ni ti palila lita pisaayika.
en: The grapevines growing on five acres of land will yield only five gallons of wine. Ten bushels of seed will produce only one bushel of grain.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayi ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, bɛ ni lan booni shɛli Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o;.
en: It was now two days before the Festival of Passover and Unleavened Bread. The chief priests and the teachers of the Law were looking for a way to arrest Jesus secretly and put him to death.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla; ka o yurilim maŋli kul beni sahakam.
en: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya malaika so ka o yi wulimpuhili polo na m-mali Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bintabindili; ka daa kuhi pam bahi malaikanima anahi shɛba Naawuni ni daa niŋ yiko ni bɛ saɣim dunia ŋɔ mini teeku la.
en: I saw another angel coming up from the east, holding the seal of the living God. He cried out with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given the power to damage the earth and sea.

dag: mini nɛma balibu kam ni pali yiya shɛŋa, ka di pala yinima n-zaŋ li niŋ di ni ni kɔbil shɛŋa din gbi n-doya, ka di pala yinima n-gbi li ni wain tihi mini olivi tihi puri, ka di pala yinima n-sa li, ka yi yi ti di n-tiɣi.
en: The houses will be full of good things which you did not put in them, and there will be wells that you did not dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you did not plant. When the Lord brings you into this land and you have all you want to eat.

dag: N ni yɛl a o naba min o bɔɣiri ni o yaa ni o biɛhigu ni viɛl shɛm yɛla.
en: I will tell you about Leviathans legs, his strength, and his graceful shape.

dag: Amiram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Jokɛbɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi ni daa dɔɣi bipuɣin so Ijipti la. Ka Jokɛbɛd daa dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Miriam Amiram yiŋa.
en: who was married to Levi's daughter Jochebed, who was born in Egypt. She bore Amram two sons, Aaron and Moses, and a daughter, Miriam.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn daa kpalim maa n-nyɛ: Filistia nanima anu mini Keenannim zaa ni Sidɔnnim ni Hivinim bɛn be Lɛbanɔn Zoli zuɣu n-zaŋ Baalihɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu hal ti paai Lɛbohamat dunoli shee la.
en: the five rulers of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, Sidonians, and Hivites who lived in the highlands of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo kul niŋdila bɛ suhuri ni yu ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti gbahi ba kɔri la; bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ ni bi baŋ yɛl shɛŋa gbinni. Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman biŋkɔbiri la.
en: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.

dag: ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ Akasia fɔŋ ni. Amaa n ni fiɛb bɛ zaa.
en: You have done many evil things, so I will punish you all.

dag: Ka Huram daa lan mali kɔniŋdi bini, ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli ka di naŋgbanyɛra yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ yini yɛliŋ nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka booli din daa gili di sunsuuni wɔɣilim mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla.
en: Huram made a round tank of bronze, 1⁄2 feet deep, feet in diameter, and feet in circumference.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bɔhi baŋ Ziɔn soli, ka zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri kpa nimaani polo, ka bɛ mini Yawɛ ti laɣim lo alikauli din kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam ka ku yiɣisi, ka bɛ ku lan tam di yɛla.
en: They will ask how to go to Zion. They will start to go in that direction. They will say, Come, let us join ourselves to the Lord . Lets make an agreement that will last forever. Lets make an agreement that we will never forget.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: Many are invited, but only a few are chosen.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jahaziɛl zuɣu na niriba maa ni. Jahaziɛl daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka Zakaria nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia, ka Bɛnaaya nyɛ Jɛiɛl bia, ka Jɛiɛl mi nyɛ Matania ŋun daa yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Asaf daŋ ni nir la bia.
en: the Lord 's Spirit suddenly spoke to Jahaziel, a Levite from the Asaph clan.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la. O ni daa yɛli ba shɛm ka niŋ alibarika shɛŋa din simdi bɛ zaa yinoyino niŋ bɛ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is how Jacob gave each of them their proper blessings.

dag: ni Matiu mini Tomas ni Jeemsi Alifius bia mini Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Matthew, Thomas, James, the son of Alphaeus, Simon, called the Zealot.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha bɔh o, N shia di ka a sani saha shɛli doo la ni di yi o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-kana ti tuh a sol la? Pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla saha shɛli di ni simdi ni a deeri liɣiri mini binyɛra ni olivi tihi ni tihi puri ni piɛri ni niɣi ni dabidɔbba ni dabipaɣiba?.
en: But Elisha said, Wasn't I there in spirit when the man got out of his chariot to meet you? This is no time to accept money and clothes, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and cattle, or servants!.

dag: O ni nya dansi, ka kɔŋ jilima, ka o filiŋ maa ku lan naai;.
en: You will be beaten and forever disgraced.

dag: Amaa so ni bɔhi, Ka wula ka kpiimba lee yɛn tooi neei kum ni? Ka niŋgbun bɔ ka bɛ lee yɛn mali.
en: But someone may ask, How are the dead raised? What kind of body will they have.

dag: O ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gili yili maa ka bi tooi dam li la, dama di daa me n-tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: Its like a person building a house by digging deep and laying the foundation on bedrock. When the flood came, the rising water smashed against that house, but the water couldnt shake the house because it was well built.

dag: Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira, ka tibiri barinima;.
en: Jesus called his twelve apostles together. He gave them power to heal sicknesses and power to force demons out of people.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be tooni ŋɔ ha ka n ti yihi waazu nimaani gba; dama di zuɣu ka n kana.
en: But Jesus answered, We must go on to the other villages around here. I have to preach in them also, because that is why I came.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa kpuɣi Inok ka o bi kpi, ka so daa bi lan nya o, Naawuni ni daa kpuɣ o maa zuɣu. Naawuni Kundi di shɛhira yɛli ni Naawuni ni daa na bi kpuɣi Inok saha shɛli, o daa nyɛla Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so.
en: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.

dag: Ka Rut daa kul be o kayiha maa ni hal ka zaawuni ti paai, ka o daa zaŋ o ni nya shɛm tariga m-bu li yɛli ka di niŋ kilɔgiram pia.
en: Ruth worked in the fields until evening. Then she separated the grain from the chaff. There was about one-half bushel of barley.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi ti nya zahimbu balibu kam, yin maliya suhupiɛlli di puuni.
en: My friends, consider yourselves fortunate when all kinds of trials come your way.

dag: Bihi banim mini bihi manim nya filiŋ a ni. Ka bɛ fari saamba bɛn be bɛ sani nɛma, ka niŋdi kpibisi mini pakoya din bi tuhi.
en: And the people in Jerusalem dont respect their parents. There in the city, they abuse the foreigners. They cheat orphans and widows in that place.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba! Di yi pa lala, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna nti zaŋ n nol ni takɔb la tuhi bɛn niŋdi lala maa tɔbu.
en: So change your hearts and lives. If you dont, I am coming to you soon, and I will make war on them with the sword that comes from my mouth.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka m ma daa gbani dɔɣi ma? Bee bɔzuɣu ka o daa mɔɣisi ma bihim?.
en: Why did my mother hold me on her knees? Why did she feed me at her breast?.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa bɔhi Ilaija, Wɛi, n dima, a nya ma? Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a tum tuun biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka n nya a maa.
en: So Elijah went to Ahab. When Ahab saw him, he said, Well, my enemy has found me again! Elijah answered, Yes, I found you, because you have again sold yourself out to do what the Lord says is evil.

dag: Yawɛ tiligir o daba nyɛviya; ka bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani so ku nya tibidarigibo.
en: The Lord saves his servants. All who go to him for protection will escape punishment.

dag: Ka di simdi ni cheechi buɣisi ba pɔi, ka bɛ biɛhigu yi wuhi ni bɛ ka galimi, ka cheechi naanyi chɛ ka bɛ tum cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma.
en: You should test them first. Then, if you find that they have done nothing wrong, they can be special servants.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam mini noonsi ni biŋgbamda ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be teeku ni nyɛla ninsal ni ni tooi maai shɛb nina hal ka pun maai li gba.
en: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.

dag: Ti bi yo ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; yinima n-naɣ yo yi suhuri zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: Our feelings of love for you have not stopped. It is you who have stopped your feelings of love for us.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ buŋ nyaampara pa buŋa, ka o yɛl o tumtumda, Niŋm buŋ maa ka o chani yomyom, ka di chɛ ka o baligi chandi naɣila mani nti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o baligi chandi.
en: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, Let's go. And don't slow down unless I tell you to.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti baŋ ni Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛligu nam dunia ŋɔ; dinzuɣu Naawuni daa zaŋla ti nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa n-nam ti nina ni nyari binshɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: Faith helps us understand that God created the whole world by his command. This means that the things we see were made by something that cannot be seen.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yɛlimaŋli, yoli ka n daa kul guli doo ŋɔ binyara ŋɔ mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ka bi chɛ ka o binshɛli bɔrigi ŋɔ, ka ŋun ti zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma samli.
en: David had just been saying, I surely wasted my time guarding Nabal's things in the desert and keeping them from being stolen! I was good to him, and now he pays me back with insults.

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun su buɣim fukumsi gba daa yi bimbini gbin na n-duh o yee pam yɛli malaika so ŋun gbib gɔr dirili maa, Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala, dama di wala maa mooya zaa.
en: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.

dag: Kpahimmiya Izraɛlnim ni niŋdi shɛm: Bɛn diri sara maligu bindira la nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni mali dolintabitali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu tuma ni.
en: And think about what the people of Israel do. When they eat the sacrifices, they are united by sharing what was offered on the altar.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari alaka Naawuni yubu tumbu zuɣu mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Happy are people whose lives are harassed because they are righteous, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt ni daa wum Mariama puhigu maa ka ŋun Ɛlizabɛt bia dam o pul ni, ka Shia Kasi daa pali Ɛlizabɛt.
en: When Elizabeth heard Marys greeting, the unborn baby inside her jumped, and she was filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu maa yi malaika ŋun daa ʒe Naawuni tooni maa nuu ni n-kpuɣ du zuɣusaa.
en: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.

dag: A kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma bahi kpaŋa, a suhu ni yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: because of your anger and wrath, because you picked me up and threw me away.

dag: Naawuni ni daa ti yɛn tim o Bikpɛm la dunia ŋɔ ni na o daa yɛlimi: Naawuni malaikanim zaa, jɛmmiy o.
en: But when God was about to send his first-born Son into the world, he said, All of God's angels must worship him.

dag: N kuhi pam boli Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o be o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu ka garigi ma.
en: I cry out loud to the LORD, and he answers me from his holy mountain. Selah.

dag: ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi wuhi paɣisara ka bɛ yuri bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi.
en: That way they can mentor young women to love their husbands and children.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du nti guhiri mɔɣu ni hal ka yi ti tim na ti yɛli ma lahibali din beni.
en: I will be waiting near the places where people cross the river into the desert. I will wait there until I hear from you.

dag: N yi tam a yɛla, bee n yi bi lihi nyin Jɛrusalɛm ka a gari shɛlikam m bebu ni, n zilinli din leemi zilin tabinli.
en: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I dont remember you, if I dont make Jerusalem my greatest joy.

dag: Yinim bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋɔ, paɣimiy o! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, timiy o jilima! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura.
en: Praise him, you servants of the Lord ! Honor him, you descendants of Jacob! Worship him, you people of Israel!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be bɛ sani. Ka bɛn Izraɛlnim nyɛ n niriba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and they, the house of Israel, are my people. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni dahin shɛli yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Yiko Zaa Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: Jesus answered him, So you say. But I tell all of you: from this time on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of the Almighty and coming on the clouds of heaven.

dag: Amaa nyin kul dol a ni daa bɔhim yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa yɛla ka niŋ li yɛda la viɛnyɛliŋga. A mi a karimbanim ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: But you must continue with the things you have learned and found convincing. You know who taught you.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun vihiri ninsalinim suhuri mi din be o Shia Kasi tɛha ni, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-deeri suhiri tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda kaman Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The one who searches hearts knows how the Spirit thinks, because he pleads for the saints, consistent with Gods will.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Nyamiya, n saɣi yi ni daa yɛli ma shɛlikam zaa la, ka pii naa tin ya.
en: Then Samuel said to the people of Israel, I have done what you asked me to do. I have given you a king to rule you.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that King Ahaz did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Di saha naa maa daa tɔɣisirila Gɛhaazi ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir maa sɔŋda la yɛtɔɣa n-yɛr o, Yɛlim ma Ilaisha ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: The king was speaking to Gehazi, the man of Gods servant, asking him, Tell me about all the great things Elisha has done.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋun niŋ alibarika kam din nyɛ alizanda ni alibarika niŋ ti ni Masia zuɣu ŋɔ!.
en: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. In Christ, God has given us every spiritual blessing in heaven.

dag: N ni darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Samarianim mini Ɛhab daŋ niriba tibili shɛm la. N ni kpimsi Jɛrusalɛm niriba birili, ka chɛ ka di puuni neei kaman nir ni yi paɣi laa n-nyahi neei di puuni ka zaŋ li pili shɛm la.
en: I will punish Jerusalem as I did Samaria, as I did King Ahab of Israel and his descendants. I will wipe Jerusalem clean of its people, as clean as a plate that has been wiped and turned upside down.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ chiri pinaayi saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa ti du n-tam o nam yili din daa be Babilɔn la dufahirili zuɣusaa n-chani gindi.
en: Twelve months later, he was walking on the roof of the royal palace in Babylon.

dag: Ŋun daa pah awɛi n-su chira awɛi ni n-daa nyɛ Abiɛza ŋun daa yi Anatɔt na ka nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer of Annathoth from the Benjaminites. His division numbered .

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaanii ni kɔbisinu ni pihinii.
en: The total number was .

dag: Ka Firawuna Nɛko daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Ɛliakim n-leei naa zal o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim. Ka o daa zaŋ Jɛhɔahaz n-kuli Ijipti, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim, Josiahs son, king after his father Josiah. Neco changed Eliakims name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Jehoahaz away; he later died in Egypt.

dag: O ni ti yihi biŋkɔb yino yi biŋkɔbiri pia kam puuni ka yi ti leeg o daba.
en: He will take one-tenth of your flocks. And you yourselves will become slaves of this king.

dag: Ka di tintariga daa ŋmaligi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtidagɔn m-mali hal ti paai Zɛbulɔn mini Ifitahɛl Vinvamli din be Bɛtimɛk mini Nɛyɛl soli nuzaa polo la, ka kul zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo maa hal ti paai Kabul.
en: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-tahi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ duu na. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbaligu bihim duɣi bɛ bihi.
en: Bring the best of the early produce of your farmland to the LORD your Gods temple. Dont boil a young goat in its mothers milk.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Zɛrɛd vinvamli ni.
en: From there they marched and camped in the Zered ravine.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa, amaa ʒiŋmariba ʒiri ni zani tariga.
en: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔri ni o bahi Yisa, dinzuɣu ka o daa lan lab tɔɣisi ba di yɛla maa;.
en: Pilate addressed them again because he wanted to release Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Aai, a paɣ Zara ni dɔɣi bidibiga ti a, ka a bol o yuli Yisahaku. Ka n ni lo a min o zuliya alikauli shɛli din ni be sahakam.
en: God said, No, I said that your wife Sarah will have a son. You will name him Isaac. I will make my agreement with him that will continue forever with all his descendants.

dag: n ni teei n ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa alikauli shɛli maa yɛla; ka kom mi ku lan niŋ kokpɛɣu n-di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: I will remember the covenant between me and you and every living being among all the creatures. Floodwaters will never again destroy all creatures.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnana bee n-zaŋ dari kpe biŋŋmahima bee n-sa daantalisi bee n-zaŋ kuɣa biŋŋmahima sa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi li, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must not make any idols, and do not set up any divine image or sacred pillar. You must not place any carved stone in your land, bowing down to it, because I am the LORD your God.

dag: N yi chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari m-bahi yoli bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: The people have done many terrible things, so I will make that place an empty wasteland. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni nini ni tiɣi ŋun jɛmdi Masia lala, ka ninsalinim gba ni di o shɛhira suŋ.
en: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; Naawuni, kpuɣim a nuu zuɣusaa, di tam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu yɛla.
en: Lord , get up and do something. Punish those who are wicked, God. Dont forget those who are poor and helpless.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ o bia Yisahaku mali sara bimbini zuɣu la, pa o tuma tumbu zuɣu ka o daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani?.
en: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ maŋdahimbu mali nyɔri shɛli di ni, amaa wuntia soli puuni maŋdahimbu malila nyɔri shɛlikam ni, dama di lo ti nyɛvili alikauli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili saha din ka bahigu puuni.
en: Physical exercise has some value, but spiritual exercise is valuable in every way, because it promises life both for the present and for the future.

dag: M biyurisi, pa zaligu palli ka n sabiri tiri ya, amaa di nyɛla zaligu kur shɛli yi ni daa pun mali piligu ni ha la. Zaligu kurili maa nyɛla yi ni daa pun wum yɛligu shɛl la yɛla.
en: My dear friends, I am not writing a new command to you. It is the same command you have had since the beginning. This command is the teaching you have already heard.

dag: Dama so yi nyɛla ŋun wumdila yɛligu maa kɔŋko, ka pa ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, o ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi diɣi ni n-nya o ninni m-baŋ omaŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Hearing Gods teaching and doing nothing is like looking at your face in the mirror.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul mi wuntizɔriba soli ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bahi yoli.
en: The Lord shows his people how to live, but the wicked have lost their way.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Saimɔn, yi gbihirimi? Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: Then he went back to his followers and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, Simon, why are you sleeping? Could you not stay awake with me for one hour?.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li gahigahi Yawɛ tooni din ni chɛ ka o deei ya. Di simdi ka maligumaana maa zaŋ li gahila Vuhim Dabisili di n-kaai biɛɣu.
en: The priest will lift up the bundle before the LORD so that it will be acceptable on your behalf. The priest will do this on the day after the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa pahi buyi yɛli.
en: Then the Lord said.

dag: ka din pahi pisaayika daa gbaai Hanani min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the eighteenth to Hanani, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la daa yi Bahurim kana yomyom ti pahi Judanim maa zuɣu ni bɛ tuhi Naa Dauda soli.
en: At the same time the Benjaminite Shimei son of Gera from Bahurim hurried to the Jordan to meet King David.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam lihi paɣa kɔre lihigu pun niŋ zina ni paɣ maa o suhu ni.
en: But I tell you if you look at another woman and want her, you are already unfaithful in your thoughts.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋ o nuu duhi zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim nyarila yaa n-tuhiri nyandi Amalɛknim maa, o mi daa yi ti zaŋ o nuu siɣisi tiŋa, Amalɛknim maa nyarila yaa n-tuhir nyɛndi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: The Israelites out-fought the Amalekites as long as Moses held up his arms, but they started losing whenever he lowered them.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya n-zaŋ o ti ti Amɔn ŋun nyɛ tiŋ ŋɔ Gomna la mini nabia Jɔash.
en: Then King Ahab ordered one of his officers, Arrest Micaiah and take him to Amon, the governor of the city, and to Prince Joash.

dag: Amaa ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Hazaɛl niŋ kom mahigi bɔdua n-zaŋ pa naa maa ninni hal ka o ti leei Naawuni dini. Ka Hazaɛl daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: But the next day he took a blanket, soaked it in water, and put it over Ben-hadads face until he died. Hazael succeeded him as king.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: False messiahs and false prophets will come and do miracles and wonders, trying to fool the people God has chosen, if that is possible.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, ka n nya suhupiɛlli pɔi ka naanyi chaŋ n chandi shee n-leei ŋun ku lan beni yaha.
en: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔ ka a lee nya maa? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala gbaŋ ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: The angel asked me, What do you see? I said, I see a flying scroll that is feet long and feet wide.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni. Dina n-nyɛ: Ɛlitɛke mini Gibɛtɔn.
en: From the tribe of Dan: Elteke and its pastures, Gibbethon and its pastures.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be a jɛmbu duu puuni? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be Ziɔn a daboli din be kasi la zuɣu?.
en: Lord , who may enter your Temple? Who may worship on Zion, your sacred hill?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni bi wumdi kuhigu din ka buchi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa baɣa ka di ni.
en: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers.

dag: Di saha ka salo maa zaa daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa be Rimɔn tampiŋ gbin la sani nti yɛli ba ni bɛ ku bɛ mini ba zabili la.
en: Then the whole assembly sent word to the Benjaminites who were at Rimmon Rock and offered to end the war.

dag: Bɛ ni bi nyari saɣisigu zuɣu ka bɛ kpira, ka bɛ jɛrilim din galisi zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zuɣuri kpi.
en: Evil people will die because they refuse to be disciplined. They will be trapped by their own desires.

dag: O ni doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o lan yɛn doli labi; o ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: As surely as I am the Lord , he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka wuntaŋ lu wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka yuŋ zibi wuntaŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord GOD also said, At that time I will make the sun set at noon and make the land dark on a clear day.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. Chɛ ka a suhu doya, a ku kpi.
en: But the Lord told him, Peace. Don't be afraid. You will not die.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi bidibbina be maligumaaniba bɛn daa piɛbiri kikahi maa tooni, ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn lan gbibi bidibbina doli bɛ nyaaŋa, ka bɛ kul piɛbiri kikahi maa.
en: The initial group of soldiers was going in front of the priests who were blowing the trumpets. The rear guard was coming behind the chest, with trumpets blowing continuously.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɔhim anabi maa ka o yɛli shɛli, di wuhiya ni man Yawɛ n-yɔhim anabi maa, ka n ni teei n nuu n-jɛnd o n-ku o n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
en: And if a prophet is foolish enough to give his own answer, I, the Lord , will show him how foolish he is! I will use my power against him. I will destroy him and remove him from among my people, Israel.

dag: Ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛli yɛli, Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab Naa la n-zaŋ ma Siria wulimpuhili polo zoya ni tiŋ la ni na nti yɛli ma: Kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu ti ma. Wuhim ni Izraɛlnim simdi tibidarigibo.
en: Then he raised his voice and made his address: From Aram Balak led me, the king of Moab, from the eastern mountains. Come, curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.

dag: O daa yɛli Dan zuliya: Dan zuliya ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun yiɣi yi Bashan na.
en: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.

dag: Sokam ni mali niriba ŋɔ ansarisi, ka salindi salima maani ba ansarisi yɛra, Mbusim be yinim bɛn laɣisi binshɛŋa din pa yi dini duhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Yi yɛn deeri binyara yi sandiriba sani sɔŋdi yi sani hal ti paai bɔ saha.
en: The conquered people will taunt their conquerors and show their scorn for them. They will say, You take what isn't yours, but you are doomed! How long will you go on getting rich by forcing your debtors to pay up.

dag: Puri dola zaɣ nɛya; ka tiŋgbani fabinda, dama bindira saɣimya zaa, ka wain naai, ka kpam gba lan kani.
en: The fields are bare; the ground mourns because the grain is destroyed, the grapes are dried up, and the olive trees are withered.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dilan nyɛla ŋun nya o ba zaɣim, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.

dag: O ni daa karim gbaŋ maa naai ka o bɔhi ni luɣ dini ka Pool lee yina. O ni daa wum ni o yila Kilikia na.
en: The governor read the letter and asked Paul, What country are you from? The governor learned that Paul was from Cilicia.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan zaŋ n vuhim dabisa ti ba ka di leei shihirili m mini ba sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-maani ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: I made the keeping of the Sabbath a sign of the agreement between us, to remind them that I, the Lord , make them holy.

dag: A zaɣisila Judanim zaa? A suhu lan je Ziɔnnima? Wula ka a ŋme ti luhi ka so ku tooi lan tibi ti yaha? Ti yuuni bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ti bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, ka yuuni bɔri faako saha, amaa ka naɣ nyarila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Have you completely rejected Judah? Do you hate Zion? Why then have you mortally wounded us? We look for peace, but nothing good comes of it; for a time of healing, only to be terrorized.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri pa o pumpɔŋɔ yɛra, N daa bi nya paɣipalitali shihirili yi bia maa sani. Amaa n-nyɛ m bipuɣiŋga maa paɣipalitali shihira. Di saha ka bɛ zaŋ tani yɛrigi sɔŋ tiŋ maa kpamba maa tooni.
en: This man accused my daughter of doing wrong and said, I did not find the proof that your daughter is a virgin. But here is the proof that my daughter was a virgin. Then they should show the cloth to the town leaders.

dag: Pa lala ka yi daa bɔhim Masia yɛla.
en: That was not what you learned about Christ!.

dag: Ninsalinim suhuyiɣisili ni ŋmaligi paɣ a, a yi ti chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din bahindi nyaaŋa la biɛla gil a.
en: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba; ka yɔbahi ŋub ba.
en: They will be killed in battle, and their bodies eaten by wolves.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ takɔbi maa ti ni bɛ nyɛhi li ka di neei, ka bɛ zaŋ li gbibi nuu ni. Bɛ sahi takɔbi maa, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei ni bɛ zaŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun kuri niriba nuu ni.
en: He appoints it for polishing, to seize in the hand. The sword is sharpened, it is polished; it is ready for the destroyers hand.

dag: Yi tuuli yabidoo daa tum alahichi, ka yi yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisiriba tum alahichi n sani.
en: Your first ancestor sinned, and your officials rebelled against me.

dag: Baŋmi ni yɛm gba nyɛla din nyaɣis a suhu ni. A yi nya yɛm, a ni nya dahin shɛli biɛhigu, ka a tahima ku zani soli.
en: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright.

dag: Sokam fom baalim Yawɛ tooni, dama o yiɣisi zani luɣ kasi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Be silent, everyone, in the presence of the Lord , for he is coming from his holy dwelling place.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk bia Abiata ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la, Zaŋmi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la ti ma na. Ka Abiata daa zaŋ tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa na ti ti Dauda.
en: David said to the priest Abiathar, Ahimelechs son, Bring the priestly vest to me. So Abiathar brought it to David.

dag: N ni bɔri shɛli zaa nyɛla ni m baŋ Masia, ka baŋ o kum ni neebu yiko yɛla, ka pah o zuɣu di wahala, ka be kaman ŋuna o kum puuni.
en: All I want is to know Christ and to experience the power of his resurrection, to share in his sufferings and become like him in his death.

dag: Dunianima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o jilima min o kpiɔŋ.
en: Praise the Lord , all people of every nation; praise the Lord s glory and power!.

dag: Lumiya bɛn zuɣuri paligi sizuura, ka timiya ninkura jilima, ka zomiya yi Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must rise in the presence of an old person and respect the elderly. You must fear your God; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Ti yaannim Naawuni m-piig a ni a baŋ o yubu ka nya ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana n-wum o nol ni yɛligu;.
en: He said, The God of our ancestors has selected you to know his will, to see the righteous one, and to hear his voice.

dag: Ka so yi do m-baɣ o ka ti kpi n-libig o, ka di chɛ ka o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa bi lan be kasi, dindina ŋun pinim o zuɣu maa o ni ti yɛn yi daɣiri ni dahin shɛli. O pinim li daba ayopɔin dali.
en: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee la ka bɛ daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi maa gba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ yino sa Yisa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi sa o nuzaa polo.
en: When they arrived at the place called The Skull, they crucified him, along with the criminals, one on his right and the other on his left.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba, saha shɛli n yi ti kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: And I will make this agreement with those people when I take away their sins. Isaiah :-; :.

dag: Hal bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni tuma zuɣulaannim mini gomnanim ni kpambaliba ni bɛnkam zaa daa ʒe nam fukumsi zaashee daa sɔŋla Yɛhudianim maa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Mɔdɛkai.
en: The leaders of the provinces, the rulers, the governors, and the court officials were afraid of Mordecai and took sides with the Jews.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa yɛli naa, Nyini n dan naa ni kul lab yiŋ na ni alaafee ŋɔ, chɛ ka o zaŋ di zaa.
en: Let Ziba have it all, Mephibosheth answered. It's enough for me that Your Majesty has come home safely.

dag: A daa ko pini zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka mali binshɛŋa din dundu zali niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam. A daa bi be kaman pagɔrili la, dama a je liɣiri.
en: On every street you built places to worship idols and practice prostitution. But you are not out for money like a common prostitute.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla n kpamdi sokam jaande ni bɛ suhimi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu, ka kul suhimi Naawuni din simdi ba gba zuɣu, ka timmi sandaani niŋmi Naawuni tiri niriba; ka paɣimi Naawuni sokam zaa zuɣu.
en: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.

dag: Nira ni tooi kabigi kurigu mini tahiʒiɛɣu din gabi taba, ka nyɛ din yi nuzaa polo na?.
en: Jeremiah, you know that no one can shatter a piece of iron. I mean the kind of iron that is from the north. And no one can shatter a piece of bronze either.

dag: Man Nɛbukadnɛza daa ʒila n yiŋ baalim, ka n nyamma kul pahira n nam yili maa puuni.
en: While I, Nebuchadnezzar, was safe in my house, content in my palace.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli sokam din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa mini kuruchunim maa.
en: Those who had seen what Jesus did told the others what happened to the man who had the demons living in him. And they also told about the pigs.

dag: Kum chɛ ka bɛ lan ka yaa, ka barina do n-gu ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ tuui.
en: Their offspring hunger; calamity is ready for their spouses.

dag: Miriya ka yi chaŋ hal ka yi naba ti fuɣi bee n-chɛ ka kɔnyuri kuui yi lɔna. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti bɔrila saamba, saamba ka ti kul ni jɛmda.
en: Israel, don't wear your feet out, or let your throat become dry from chasing after other gods. But you say, No! I can't turn back. I have loved foreign gods and will go after them.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma kaman Yawɛ ni daa tim o ka o ti tum tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-jɛndi Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa la.
en: No other prophet has ever done miracles and wonders like those that the Lord sent Moses to perform against the king of Egypt, his officials, and the entire country.

dag: Bɛ bihi kul bela barina ni, ka bɛ mɔŋ ba nasara dunɔdali shee, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi.
en: There was no one to help his children. No one defended them in court.

dag: Bina anahi m-be dunia ni ka nyɛ bɛn pɔra, amaa ka lee mali yɛm pam.
en: There are four animals in the world that are small, but very, very clever:.

dag: Nyin ŋun chɛ ka n nya wahala pam mini naŋgbantom ŋɔ ni lan yiɣisi ma zali yaha; a ni yihi ma tiŋgbani puuni na.
en: You, who have shown me many troubles and calamities, will revive me once more. From the depths of the earth, you will raise me up one more time.

dag: Nolɔɣu kukoli saha ka Samuɛl daa ti boli Sool pii maa zuɣu yɛl o, Yiɣisim ka m biɛl a zali soli. Ka Sool yiɣisi ka o mini Samuɛl daa lu soli.
en: and he slept there. At dawn Samuel called to Saul on the roof, Get up, and I will send you on your way. Saul got up, and he and Samuel went out to the street together.

dag: Di saha ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zahim paɣiri la daa dii yi o nina ni luna, ka o nina maa dii neei. Ka o daa yiɣisi deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kubiɛlima n-kuri takɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi su kara mi kuri kpana. Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ gbarima gba yɛli, Ti nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba.
en: Beat the iron tips of your plows into swords and your pruning tools into spears; let the weakling say, I am mighty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa pa bimbiha zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: on top of the breasts of the animals and carried it all to the altar. He burned the fat on the altar.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri diri ma shɛhira biɛri, ka wuhi ni n tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa, ka n ʒi di yɛla.
en: Violent witnesses stand up. They question me about things I know nothing about.

dag: Ŋun su amiliya n-nyɛ aŋgo; amaa aŋgo zo so ŋun be o sani wumd o yɛtɔɣa nyari suhupiɛlli pam di zuɣu; lala zuɣu ka n suhupiɛlli galisi pam maa.
en: The groom is the one who is getting married. The friend of the groom stands close by and, when he hears him, is overjoyed at the grooms voice. Therefore, my joy is now complete.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o bia paɣ dɔni, bɛn kum bɛ niriba ayi maa, bɛ tumla taali bɛ ni nyɛ dɔɣiri yini zuɣu, bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒila bɛ zuɣu.
en: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra.
en: But Joshua, Nuns son, and Caleb, Jephunnehs son, from those who had explored the land, tore their clothes.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛlimuɣisira polo, n tɛhiya ni nir yi kpalim be kaman o ni pun be shɛm, di so.
en: This is a time of trouble. So I think it is good for you to stay the way you are.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋa n-lu tiŋ sa, dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli, ka bɛ gbib a. Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: and said to him, If you are God's Son, throw yourself down, for the scripture says, God will give orders to his angels about you; they will hold you up with their hands, so that not even your feet will be hurt on the stones.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa ti tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ka ti ku kpi; dama ti bo naa ti timaŋa n-lan tum alahichi pahi ti ni pun tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: All the people said to Samuel, Pray to the Lord your God for us, your servants. Dont let us die! We have sinned many times. And now we have added to these sins—we have asked for a king.

dag: ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya n jilima mini n ni pun tum alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Ijipti mini mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka zahim ma paai siɣimsiɣim pia, ka zaɣisi n noli ŋɔ.
en: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.

dag: Nyama, mbusim din pah ayi gariya; ka din pah ata yɛn doli di nyaaŋ na pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The second terror is now past. The third terror is coming soon.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yɛli Jɛrimia m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: Bɔ saha ka ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋum niŋ ma? N wum ŋumaŋuma shɛli Izraɛlnim maa ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma maa.
en: How long will this wicked community complain against me? Ive heard the Israelites dissent as they continue to complain against me.

dag: Dauda daa laɣimla Izraɛl kpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima zaa.
en: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn gbib o daalikauli, ka dol o zaligunima.
en: to those who are faithful to his agreement and who remember to obey his commands.

dag: Akasia dari ka o daa zaŋ mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: Then he used acacia wood to make the poles and covered them with bronze.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ŋmari ʒiri, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din pa yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu, n suhu yiɣisimi bahi yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa zaŋ Babilɔnnim mini Kutanim ni Avanim ni Hamatinim ni Sɛfarivaimnim na nti ʒili Samaria fɔntinsi ni ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Ka niriba maa daa deei Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ m-be di fɔntinsi ni.
en: The emperor of Assyria took people from the cities of Babylon, Cuth, Ivvah, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and settled them in the cities of Samaria in place of the exiled Israelites. They took possession of these cities and lived there.

dag: Kootaali tandɔri n-daa kul yɛrigi Siddim vinvamli maa ni; ka Sɔdom mini Gomɔra nanim la daa ŋmaligi guuri ka bɛ ni shɛb faai lu kootaali tandɔri maa ni, ka bɛn kpalim mi zo nti du zoli.
en: was full of tar pits, and when the troops from Sodom and Gomorrah started running away, some of them fell into the pits. Others escaped to the hill country.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ li na; ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: They gave Jesus a coin and he asked, Whose picture is on the coin? And whose name is written on it? They answered, It is Caesars picture and Caesars name.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A nyɛla ŋun gbib ma wahala ni, ka chɛ ka faako yila gili ma.
en: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi alahichi, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu.
en: If good people stop doing good and begin to sin, they will die because of their sins.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: But Ahimaaz son of Zadok begged Joab again, No matter what happens, please let me also run after the Ethiopian! Joab said, Son, why do you want to carry the news? You will not get any reward for the news you bring.

dag: Amaa man ni yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣ a, ka mali sara jɛm a; ka pali n ni lo alikauli shɛli a sani. Tiliginsim yirila nyin Yawɛ sanna.
en: I will give sacrifices to you, and I will praise and thank you. I will make special promises to you, and I will do what I promise. Salvation only comes from the Lord !.

dag: Musa ni daa ti kul kana ti miri suɣa maa gbini n-nya naɣibila maa, ka nya bɛ ni wari waa maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaŋ bimparilana din daa be o nuu ni maa bahi zoli maa gbini ka di ŋma.
en: When Moses came near the camp, he saw the golden calf and the people dancing. He became very angry, and he threw the stone tablets on the ground. The stones broke into several pieces at the bottom of the mountain.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi salima mini anzinfa ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili, ka gbahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Samaria ti leei daba.
en: Then Jehoash took all the gold and silver and all the dishes in the Lord s Temple and in the treasuries of the kings palace. Jehoash also took people to be his prisoners. Then he went back to Samaria.

dag: Bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa ni daa su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi la n-daa daŋ tooni. Ka Bɛnhadad daa tim o naazɔnim ni bɛ yina ti nya, ka bɛ daa yina ti nya ka lab ti yɛl o, Niriba n-yi Samaria kanna.
en: The young helpers went out first. King Ben-Hadads men told him that some soldiers had come out of Samaria.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a pala ŋun pun nyɛ ti naa la, ka lan niŋ ti kaman ti pun pala a niriba la.
en: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.

dag: Ka gbaai naɣila kpabili na ti kɔrigi ka ti ŋubi, ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma;.
en: And bring our best calf and kill it so that we can celebrate with plenty to eat.

dag: Dolimi naa nyɛvili; ka chɛ ka o kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni!.
en: Add days to the kings life! Let his years extend for many generations!.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka maligumaaniba daa kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka Kasi maa buɣi.
en: When all of Israels elders had arrived, the priests picked up the chest.

dag: Ka so yi ti bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya a nyɔɣu ni dansi ŋɔ? O ni garigi yɛli, N zo yiŋ ka n nya dansi maa.
en: Someone will say to him, What are these wounds between your hands? And he will say, These happened when I was hit in my friends home.

dag: Nyamiya, m piligimi ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai n tiŋ maa nima, ka wula ka yi ni tooi yi tibidarigibo maa ni? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu, dama n lɔrila tɔbu ni n tuhi dunianim zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will begin my work of destruction in my own city. Do they think they will go unpunished? No, they will be punished, for I am going to send war on all the people on earth. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Bɛ bi tɛhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋuna n-chɛ ka siɣili saa mini sheen saa mira bɛ mibu saha. Ŋuna n-zaani ti puri atam kpuɣibu saha tiri ti.
en: You never thought to honor me, even though I send the autumn rains and the spring rains and give you the harvest season each year.

dag: Dinzuɣu pom Yawɛ ni a ti ku ku n zuliya n kalinsi nyaaŋa bee n-kpihim n daŋ birili.
en: Now make a promise to me with an oath using the Lord s name. Promise that you will not kill my descendants, even after I die. Promise me that you will not erase my name from my fathers family.

dag: Bɛn daa be n sani daa nya neesim maa, amaa ka lee bi wum kukoli maa ni yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: My traveling companions saw the light, but they didnt hear the voice of the one who spoke to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛl yɛlli ŋɔ ka gbaaya yimaŋ ni Yisa tuumba maa, dama bɛ wuhibu ŋɔ mini bɛ tuma ŋɔ yi nyɛla salinim dini, di ni zan tariga;.
en: And so now I tell you, stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If their plan is something they thought up, it will fail.

dag: N chɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali sania mini ʒiri kpalaŋa n-zahind o nɛma?.
en: Can I approve wicked scales and a bag of false weights.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa nyɛla bɛn be o maligumaaniba kalinli ni. Samuɛl gba daa nyɛla ŋun be bɛn jɛmd o kalinli ni. Bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei bɛ suhigu.
en: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord , answered their prayers.

dag: Tinzunnim ni guli yi biŋkɔbbaligu tin ya, ka ko yi puri tin ya, ka guli yi tihi puri tin ya.
en: My people, foreigners will serve you. They will take care of your flocks And farm your land and tend your vineyards.

dag: O daa lan wuhi ma shɛli. Nyama, n daa nyami ka n Duuma ʒe bɛ ni zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu buɣisi m-me goon shɛli gbini; ka bimbuɣisirigu maa be o nuu ni.
en: This is what the LORD showed me: The LORD was standing by a wall, with a plumb line in his hand.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, ti di nasara yaɣi Masia ŋun yuri ti la zuɣu.
en: But in all these things we win a sweeping victory through the one who loved us.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia ni sabi gban shɛli Jɛrusalɛm n-ti kpamba bɛn daa kpalim mini maligumaaniba ni anabinim ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la puuni yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The prophet Jeremiah sent a letter from Jerusalem to the few surviving elders among the exiles, to the priests and the prophets, and to all the people Nebuchadnezzar had taken to Babylon from Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim galisim ni ti ŋmanila teeku duli bihigu din ku tooi buɣisi ka mi ku tooi kali ŋɔ. Ka luɣ shɛli di ni yɛli ba, Yi pala n niriba ŋɔ, di ni ti lan boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bidibisi.
en: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called Not My People, but in the future they will be called Children of the Living God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum ka o tɔɣisiri ba Hiburuli ni maa ka bɛ maan fo baalim; di saha ka o yɛli.
en: When they heard him speaking to them in Hebrew, they became even quieter; and Paul went on:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, n yi zaŋ n nuhi tum taali.
en: Lord my God, I have done nothing wrong.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni mali tumdi tuma Luɣ kasi shee la n-guri chinchin sabilitim ni, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li n-zaŋ li niŋ amaŋka maa ni.
en: They will take all the service equipment used in the sanctuary, place it in a blue cloth, and cover it with fine leather. Then they will place it on the carrying frame.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ nyan ya ka ni darigi yi tibili. Yi chɛ ka Firawuna min o kpamba nyee nyɔni ti nyooni biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi niŋ bɛ nuu ni ni bɛ ku ti.
en: The supervisors said to them, Let the LORD see and judge what youve done! Youve made us stink in the opinion of Pharaoh and his servants. Youve given them a reason to kill us.

dag: A mi ni a nyɛla zoomba sowuhira mini bɛn be zibisim ni firila.
en: if you have persuaded yourself that you are: a guide for the blind; a light to those who are in darkness.

dag: Jɛhɔram ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba, ka bo bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: During Jehorams rule, Edom rebelled against Judahs power and appointed its own king.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a shɛm polo, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli, bɛ daa bi ŋmaag a nyuɣu; bɛ daa bi su a kom n-yihi a biɛri ni bee n-niŋ kpam ʒe a bee n-zaŋ chinchini pil a.
en: When you were born, no one cut your umbilical cord or washed you or rubbed you with salt or wrapped you in cloths.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn be kaman paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ, n ni lan mali ya zali, ka yi zani viɛnyɛliŋga. Yi ni lan zaŋ yi guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa m-pahi bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zuɣu n-wari waa.
en: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yɛhi tahi pampam m-po pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka piɛbi kikahi mini binyila.
en: They swore this to the LORD with a loud voice, shouts of joy, and blasts from trumpets and horns.

dag: Ŋunkam deei saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun doli so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee, amaa ŋun zaɣisi zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla ŋun kpe yɔɣu.
en: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.

dag: O yiko ka o zaŋ su nam sahakam, ka pa o nina lihiri zuliya kam. Duŋtaariba miri ka bɛ taai duŋ niŋ o.
en: He rules forever by his might and keeps his eyes on the nations. Let no rebels rise against him.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli Naa Sool Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la daa lihi nya ka Filistianim maa pam yiɣisi zɔri yiriŋ.
en: Sauls guards at Gibeah in the land of Benjamin saw the Philistine soldiers running away in different ways.

dag: ka doli Naawuni ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnim la kaya mini Izraɛl nanim ni daa zaŋ ka shɛŋa wuhi ba la.
en: followed the customs of the people whom the Lord had driven out as his people advanced, and adopted customs introduced by the kings of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na ʒi n-yɛli noli ti Yisa, ka so mi ku tooi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla o Duuma, ka pa ni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: I want you to know that no one who is led by God's Spirit can say A curse on Jesus! and no one can confess Jesus is Lord, without being guided by the Holy Spirit.

dag: M banima, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun mi ŋun daa be piligu ni ha la zuɣu. Nachimbihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun nyaŋ Tuumbiɛrilan la zuɣu.
en: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mi a yuli zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋla a ni; ka a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi nyin Yawɛ.
en: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.

dag: Bɛ ni niriba anu daa nyɛla yɛnnima, ka niriba anu la mi nyɛ jɛra.
en: Five of them were foolish, and the other five were wise.

dag: Di saha ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni bɛ zuɣulan Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ nya suhupiɛlli o ni daa nyaŋ bɛ dimnim ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: Jehoshaphat led the crowd back to Jerusalem. And as they marched, they played harps and blew trumpets. They were very happy because the Lord had given them victory over their enemies, so when they reached the city, they went straight to the temple.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N yi chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zaa chaŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ be yi sani? Zaɣ biɛɣu ka yi lo maa.
en: The king said, I swear by the Lord that I will never let you take your women and children! It is clear that you are plotting to revolt.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli bee n-doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, dindina noli dibu ŋɔ zaa ni lu yi zuɣu din ya.
en: But if you dont obey the LORD your Gods voice by carefully doing all his commandments and his regulations that I am commanding you right now, all these curses will come upon you and find you.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa din ni niŋ pa binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la zuɣu mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.

dag: n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ paag a maa. A ni tum pagɔrisigu tuma ni zuliya shɛba, ka jɛm bɛ buɣa saɣim amaŋa la zuɣu.
en: You did those bad things when you left me to chase after the other nations. You did those bad things when you began to worship their filthy idols.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa .
en: Come, follow me, he said, and Ill show you how to fish for people.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn daa nya Yisa ka o kpari o polo na ka o yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbila ŋun kpihindi dunianim daalahichi la.
en: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim anabinim kaman kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, N cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee n di chaŋ? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: Ahab sent for about prophets and asked, Should I attack the Syrians at Ramoth? Yes! the prophets answered. The Lord will help you defeat them.

dag: N suhu kul tɔrila pampam ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai, ka n nina niŋ liti.
en: My heart is pounding, my strength is gone, and my eyes have lost their brightness.

dag: Bɛ kul tɔŋdimi bɛ soya ni sahakam. Bɛ ku tooi baŋ a ni kariti saria shɛm. Bɛ kul maanila bɛ dimnim ansarisi.
en: The wicked succeed in everything. They cannot understand God's judgments; they sneer at their enemies.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋun pɔra ni ŋun nyɛ tarima daŋ ni yɛligi n-leei zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Di saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka di niŋ lala yomyom. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ!.
en: The least will become a thousand, and the smallest a powerful people. I am the LORD; at the right moment, I will hurry it along.

dag: M min ya, ka lan mi ni yi bi yuri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: but I do know that none of you love God.

dag: Wummi n suhigu maa, ka garigi ma. N suhu bi doya ka n kul jiɣinda n fabila maa zuɣu.
en: Please listen and answer me. Let me speak to you and tell you what upsets me.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: You know the commandments: Dont commit adultery. Dont murder. Dont steal. Dont give false testimony. Honor your father and mother. .

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-wurim ba, o baɣa lan ka bɛ ni. Maligumaaniba lan ka jilima, ka niriba bi lan niŋdi kpamba nirilim.
en: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan boli Samuɛl yaha m-pahi buta, ka o lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Di saha ka Ɛli daa baŋ ni Yawɛ m-booni bia maa.
en: The Lord called Samuel the third time. Again Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, Here I am. You called me. Finally, Eli understood that the Lord was calling the boy.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka boli bibil na nti zaŋ o zali baɣil omaŋa.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he had a child stand there beside him.

dag: Nyam tumo ŋun mali lahiba suŋ mini suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-zɔri duri zoya kanna ŋɔ naba ni viɛli pam shɛm! O moonila tiliginsim molo yɛri Ziɔnnima, Yi Naawuni nyɛla naa.
en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of a messenger who proclaims peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, Your God rules.

dag: Ŋun daa pahi pia n-su chir pia ni n-daa nyɛ Maharai ŋun daa yi Nɛtɔfa na ka nyɛ Zɛra daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The tenth commander, for the tenth month, was Maharai from Netophah and from Zerahs family. There were , men in Maharais group.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ka Sool sanna nti pilig o tuma tumbu, ka Sool daa yu o pam, ka o zaŋ o leeg o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira.
en: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much and chose him as the man to carry his weapons.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Biɛɣuni. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Di ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka yi baŋ ni Naawuni so lan kani ŋ-ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Do it tomorrow! the king replied. As you wish, Moses agreed. Then everyone will discover that there is no god like the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka daa kari alizin biɛri niriba pam zuɣu bahi, ka bi saɣi ni alizin biɛri maa yɛli shɛli, dama bɛ daa mi o ni nyɛ so.
en: Jesus healed many of those who had different kinds of sicknesses. He also forced many demons out of people. But he would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who he was.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi n yɛligu, ka ʒe n dunɔdali gbini dabisili kam, ka ʒe n dunoli ni guhiri mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Happy are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorposts.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni tim o ni o ti yɛli Aduna shɛm yɛl o, ka wuh o o ni yɛl o ni o tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa.
en: Then Moses told Aaron everything that the Lord had said when he told him to return to Egypt; he also told him about the miracles which the Lord had ordered him to perform.

dag: A niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni sahakam; a chɛ ka o mali suhupiɛlli din yi a sanna.
en: You grant him blessings forever; you make him happy with the joy of your presence.

dag: Bɛ yi kar o saria, bɛn wuhimi ni o mali taali, ka chɛ ka o wunsuhigu leei alahichi.
en: May he be tried and found guilty; may even his prayer be considered a crime!.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni be a sani ka ni chɛ ka a nya nasara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu ni kaman o ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: David also said, Now, son, may the Lord be with you. May you be successful and build the Temple for the Lord your God, as he said you would.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Din ku tooi nani ninsalinim sani nyɛla din ni tooi nani Naawuni ŋun sani.
en: Jesus answered, God can do things that are not possible for people to do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je man Yawɛ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni ka dabiɛm mali ba, ka bɛ tibidarigibo ti ku mali tariga.
en: Those who hate me would bow in fear before me; their punishment would last forever.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣis o kpim maa sani n-chaŋ ti yɛli Hitinima.
en: he went to the Hittites and said.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yɛlimaŋli, yoli ka n daa kul guli doo ŋɔ binyara ŋɔ mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ka bi chɛ ka o binshɛli bɔrigi ŋɔ, ka ŋun ti zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma samli.
en: David had just been saying, What a waste of time—guarding all this mans stuff in the wilderness so that nothing of his went missing! He has repaid me evil instead of good!.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna, ka Balaam daa yɛl o, M me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaa zuɣu.
en: and God met him. Balaam said to him, I have built the seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each.

dag: N ku kpi, amaa n ni be, ka moli Yawɛ tuma yɛla.
en: I will not die; instead, I will live and proclaim what the Lord has done.

dag: ni Jarimut ni Ɛnganim ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Jarmuth, and En Gannim. In all, Issachar gave them four towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya ka o ba zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim zuɣu ni maa, di daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o daa gbaag o ba nuu ni o paai li Ifriim zuɣu ni n-zaŋ li pa Manaasa zuɣu ni;.
en: Joseph did not like it when he saw his father place his right hand on the head of the younger son. So he tried to move his father's right hand from Ephraim's head and place it on Manasseh.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Naɣila yi ni yɛn be Babilɔn yuun pisopɔin la saha ti gari, ka n naanyi ka yi sanna nti chɛ ka n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali, ka n zaŋ ya labisi kpe na.
en: The LORD proclaims: When Babylons seventy years are up, I will come and fulfill my gracious promise to bring you back to this place.

dag: ka tɛh o suhu ni ni o dii zaŋ kpani maa to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi li buyi zaa.
en: but Saul had a spear in his hand. He thought, Ill pin David to the wall. Saul threw the spear twice, but David jumped out of the way both times.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, yinim Ibrahimma zuliya mini yinim bɛn pa ti zuliya ka be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri Naawuni, tinim ka Naawuni daa tahi tiliginsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ na ti ti.
en: Brothers, children of Abrahams family, and you Gentile God-worshippers, the message about this salvation has been sent to us.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu maa yɛla ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni.
en: People whose lives are based on selfishness think about selfish things, but people whose lives are based on the Spirit think about things that are related to the Spirit.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ibram daa vuɣ o tanti suɣili n-chaŋ ti kpa Mamri oki ti shɛŋa din be Hiburɔn la gbini; ka daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ.
en: So Abram moved his tents. He went to live near the big trees of Mamre. This was near the city of Hebron. There he built an altar to honor the Lord .

dag: N nintam n-kul nyɛ m bindirigu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka niriba kul bɔhiri ma sahakam, A Naawuni maa lee be ya.
en: Instead of food, I have only tears day and night, as my enemies laugh at me and say, Where is your God.

dag: Ti wahala dibu din pɔri ka ku yuui ŋɔ nyɛla din niŋdi shili ni di tahi ti jilima din ka kpee na, ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: And this small and temporary trouble we suffer will bring us a tremendous and eternal glory, much greater than the trouble.

dag: Ti ni daa deei Musa noli shɛlikam ni shɛm, lala ka ti yɛn deeg a noli, amaa ti lee suhirimi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ be a sani kaman o ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la!.
en: We will obey whatever you say, just as we obeyed Moses. We only ask that the Lord your God be with you just as he was with Moses.

dag: Amaa man ni yili yila n-yɛl a kpiɔŋ yɛla; n ni duhi n yee n-yili yila asiba n-yɛl a yurilim maŋli yɛla. Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha.
en: But me? I will sing of your strength! In the morning I will shout out loud about your faithful love because you have been my stronghold, my shelter when I was distraught.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa baŋ ni Aduna kpiya, ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ biɛɣ pihita n-kum o kuli.
en: The whole community learned that Aaron had died, and they all mourned for him for thirty days.

dag: Ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ o chandi.
en: And so Paul left the meeting.

dag: ni n ku zaŋ a gali bee a namdili mia bee a ni su binshɛlikam, ka a ti yɛli, Mani n-chɛ ka Ibram leei bundana.
en: that I won't keep anything of yours, not even a sandal strap or a piece of thread. Then you can never say that you are the one who made me rich.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl tuun shɛb bɛn kana maa, Yi yi kuli yin yɛlimiya Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga maa nima, Biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ sa ti yɛn bii, yi ni nya faako. Tuumba maa ni daa lab kuli ti yɛli Jabɛshinim lala, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: They said to the messengers from Jabesh, Tell your people that before noon tomorrow they will be rescued. When the people of Jabesh received the message, they were overjoyed.

dag: N ni ti gbib a ni ʒiɛyimtali, ka a baŋ man Yawɛ.
en: I will make you my faithful bride. Then you will really know the Lord .

dag: Amaa bɛ zuɣu n ni teei n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na zuliya pam ninni nti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: For them, I will remember the agreement with their ancestors. I brought their ancestors out of the land of Egypt so that I could become their God. The other nations saw these things. I am the Lord .

dag: Ti loya ni ti ku niŋ din ni chɛ ka so galim ti yurilim pina din galisi ŋɔ taribu ni.
en: We are being careful not to stir up any complaints about the way we handle this generous gift.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni yɛn nam zuɣusaa zaɣ palli shɛli mini dunia palli shɛl la ni yɛn yuui shɛm, lala ka yi zuliya ni yi yuli yɛn yuui.
