en: As the new heavens and the new earth that Im making will endure before me, says the LORD, so your descendants and your name will endure.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu n-yɛli ba, M pina din nyɛ bindir shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma ka di nyom niŋdi ma nyaɣisim la, zaŋmiya li tim ma di tibu saha.
en: Command the Israelites and say to them: Make sure to offer to me my offering, my food, my food gift as a soothing smell to me at its appointed time.

dag: ka kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ ko viɛlli din be yaɣiri duɣu ni.
en: He will slaughter one bird over fresh water in a pottery jar.

dag: Viri ni ti te bɛ tɛri nimaani n-nye gala wɔɣi, ka dihiri bɛ bihi maa nimaani. Juri gba ni ti laɣindi nimaani.
en: Snakes will make their homes there and lay their eggs. The eggs will open, and small snakes will crawl from the dark places. Birds that eat dead things will gather there like women visiting their friends.

dag: O daa kamina ti nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim. O daa nyo yil karili kam buɣim.
en: Nebuzaradan burned the Lord s Temple, the kings palace, and all the houses in Jerusalem. He destroyed even the largest houses.

dag: Dilana nyɛla tɛhaayilana ka ku tooi ʒe yim.
en: They are double-minded, unstable in all their ways.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yɛli ni alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But the Pharisees said, The ruler of demons is the one that gives him power to force demons out.

dag: ka yi yi ti doli n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka dol o soya sahakam, dindina yi ni tooi pii fɔntins ata pahi tins ata maa zuɣu.
en: then you are to select three more cities.

dag: Pa shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa n-nyɛ tuuli, amaa dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ la n-nyɛ tuuli, ka shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa naanyi paya.
en: It is not the spiritual that comes first, but the physical, and then the spiritual.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu; nyini n-chɛ ka n dimnim lu n naba ni.
en: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: They buried him within the border of his own legacy, in Timnath-serah in the highlands of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn biri yuun shɛli din pahir anii ni, yi ni ti dirila bindir kura, ka yi ti kul ni dirila bindir kura maa hal ni yuun shɛli din pahir awɛi, ka bindir pala ti naanyi niŋ.
en: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.

dag: Wula ka ninvuɣ yino ni tooi kari doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka niriba ayi mi tuhi nyaŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka pa ni bɛ Tampiŋ n-kɔhi ba? Ka pa ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni?.
en: Can one person chase away men? Can two men cause , men to run away? It will happen only if the Lord gives them to their enemy. This will happen only if their Rock sells them like slaves.

dag: Aduna bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: O bituuli Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron had four sons. Nadab was the firstborn son. Then there were Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Ŋun wurindi niriba la kana ti liri ya. Guliya yi ni zaani gooni zuɣu luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu la. Lihimiya soli zuɣu, lomiya kpara. Laɣimmiya yi tɔbbi kpɛma zaa.
en: Nineveh, you are under attack! The power that will shatter you has come. Prepare the defenses! Guard the road! Prepare for battle! .

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza vali ma. O kabisi ma; o chɛ ka n kpalimla zaɣ vuɣu. O vali ma mi kaman wahu ni vaani bini shɛm la. O vali m bin viɛla tiɣi, ka tuhi ma bahi.
en: Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar has eaten us alive; hes drained us of strength; hes left us for dead. Hes gobbled us up like a great sea monster; hes filled his belly with our treasures; and hes spit us out.

dag: Di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, dama muɣisigu be yoma, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ma.
en: Please dont be far from me, because trouble is near and theres no one to help.

dag: Ka Midian nanima ayi bɛn nyɛ: Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa guui, ka Gidiɔn kari doli ti gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zaa suhuri chihi.
en: The two Midianite kings, Zebah and Zalmunna, ran away, but he pursued them and captured them, and caused their whole army to panic.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M ma mini n tizɔbihi nyɛla bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dol li.
en: Jesus answered, My mother and my brothers are those people who hear and obey God's message.

dag: Chɛ ka ti bidibisi zoori kaman tipola din zoori ni kpiɔŋ la, ka ti bipuɣinsi mi be kaman nayili zɔŋ daantalisi la.
en: so that our sons can grow up fully, in their youth, like plants; so that our daughters can be like pillars carved to decorate a palace.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanania daa paai naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kabigi li.
en: Jeremiah was wearing a yoke around his neck. The prophet Hananiah took the yoke from Jeremiahs neck and broke it.

dag: ka Jɛrimia daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ni o kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni nti deeg o tarili nimaani niriba maa sani.
en: So I started to leave Jerusalem and go to the territory of Benjamin to take possession of my share of the family property.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, m mi n ni lɔn ya nia shɛŋa. Di nyɛla nia shɛŋa n ni lo zaŋ chaŋ yi zaɣ viɛlli polo ka pa ni yi zaɣ biɛɣu polo. N ni chɛ ka yi kul mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima.
en: I alone know the plans I have for you, plans to bring you prosperity and not disaster, plans to bring about the future you hope for.

dag: Ka Sool ba Kish bunsi daa ti bɔrigi dahin shɛli ka o yɛl o bia Sool, Zaŋmi tumtumdiba ŋɔ ni yino pah amaŋ zuɣu ka yi chaŋ ti bo bunsi maa shee.
en: One day Kishs donkeys got lost. So he said to his son Saul, Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali nti paai jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋa, ka o nya ka salo be nimaani yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri, ka kumdi ka fabinda.
en: They arrived at Jairus' house, where Jesus saw the confusion and heard all the loud crying and wailing.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ n yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, m paɣir a ka tir a jilima. A ni ti ma yɛm mini kpiɔŋ; ka kahigi ti ni suh a shɛl la wuhi ma, ka wuhi ti ni a deei ti suhigu, ka lan wuhi ti ti ni yɛn yɛli naa shɛm la zuɣu.
en: God of my ancestors, I thank you and praise you. You gave me wisdom and power. You told us what we asked for. You told us about the kings dream.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Bia m-bɔŋɔ, n ni pii so m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: A voice said from the cloud, This is my Son, whom I have chosen—listen to him.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa baŋ ni bɛ leei Dauda dimnim maa, ka bɛ daa chaŋ Sirianim tinsi ni Bɛtirɛhɔb mini Zɔba nti da Sirianim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn nyɛ tinchandiba tuhi pisi, ka Maaka naa daa yina ni tɔbbihi tuhili, ka Tɔbinim gba daa yina ni tɔbbihi tuhi pinaayi.
en: The Ammonites realized that they had made David their enemy, so they hired twenty thousand Syrian soldiers from Bethrehob and Zobah, twelve thousand men from Tob, and the king of Maacah with a thousand men.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ biɛri vuui; hal a yi lihi viɛnyɛliŋga m-bo ba, bɛ ku beni.
en: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found.

dag: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab daa zal o zuliya ni bɛ di nyu wain, ka bɛ na ʒi n-nyu wain hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dama bɛ dolila bɛ yabidoo ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli. Amaa mmaŋmaŋ kul tɔɣisiri ya la yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka yi bi deeri n noli.
en: Jonadab's descendants have obeyed his command not to drink wine, and to this very day none of them drink any. But I have kept on speaking to you, and you have not obeyed me.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yoya yɔhim ya, dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhu kul yiɣisiri bahiri bɛn bi deer o noli zuɣu.
en: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni mal alibarika.
en: Look! Im coming soon. Favored is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy contained in this scroll.

dag: Bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidib dɔɣirisi shɛb chaŋ ka bɛ ti leei namɔɣilisi be Babilɔn naa yiŋa.
en: Some of your sons, your own descendants whom you fathered, will be taken to become eunuchs in the king of Babylons palace.

dag: O ni ti tibigi ma, dama n yɛla ka o ti yɛn zaŋ wuhi ya.
en: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.

dag: ni di taɣi Sintani bahi ka o ku nyaŋ ti, dama ti bi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ o yikombiɛri tuma la polo.
en: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ malaika maa sani nti yɛl o ni o zaŋm litaafi bila maa ti ma. Ka o yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ŋubi; di ni malis a nol ni kaman shir la, amaa ka lee to a puuni.
en: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, Take the scroll and eat it. It will be sour in your stomach, but in your mouth it will be sweet like honey.

dag: Ka o lan yɛl o tumo maa, Yim doli pala mini puri soya n-dari niriba pahi na hal ka n yil ŋɔ ti pali niriba.
en: His master then told him, Go out along the back roads and make people come in, so my house will be full.

dag: Ti zaa ba pala ba yino? Pa Naawuni yino n-nam ti? Ka wula ka ti bi ʒe tab yim, ka saɣindi Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛli maa?.
en: We all have the same father. The same God made every one of us. So why do people cheat one another? They show that they dont respect the agreement. They dont respect the agreement that our ancestors made with God.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Pa mani n-nyɛ ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnima, amaa a min a daŋ niriba n-nahindi Izraɛlnima. Dama yinima n-zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka jɛmdila Baal buɣa.
en: Elijah answered: You're the troublemaker—not me! You and your family have disobeyed the Lord 's commands by worshiping Baal.

dag: Musa daa zalila Lɛvinim bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zaligu yɛli.
en: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:.

dag: Ziɔnnima, di zɔriya dabiɛm! Nyamiya! Yi naa bari bumbil kani yi sanna.
en: People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.

dag: Hiram daa lan me duɣuri, ka mali soobuya mini taha pahi. Lala ka Hiram daa niŋ tum Naa Sulemaana ni daa puh o Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuun shɛŋa maa zaa naai.
en: Huram made shovels, sprinkling bowls, and pans for hot ashes. Here is a list of the other furnishings he made for God's temple:.

dag: Zaŋm a nudirigu di nasara, ka deei ti suhigu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a fa a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bahi.
en: Save us by your might; answer my prayer, so that the people you love may be rescued.

dag: Di saha maa n daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Yi mini sɔŋdiba zaa kpalimmi gbɛm Jɛrusalɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ guli ti yuŋ ka tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni.
en: During this time I told the men in charge that they and all their helpers had to stay in Jerusalem at night, so that we could guard the city at night as well as work in the daytime.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yiɣisi chaŋ vinvamli maa ni, ka Yawɛ jilima ʒe nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya jilima shɛli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord 's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ka galimi.
en: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.

dag: Bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ lihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini luɣ kasi shee maa, ka lan sɔŋdi bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni tuma ni.
en: In this way they were to observe the instructions for the meeting tent, the instructions for the sanctuary, and the instructions for Aarons family and relatives about serving in the LORDs temple.

dag: Sulemaana daa di nam m-be Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa la yuun pihinahi.
en: After he had ruled years from Jerusalem.

dag: Dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam hal ka nir ni tooi ʒe luɣ kasi shee din be Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa tooni la ka lihi nya di zuɣuri mini di nyoya, amaa nir yi be samban ni, o ku tooi nya li, ka dapuhi maa na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The ends of the poles could be seen by anyone standing directly in front of the Most Holy Place, but from nowhere else.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ; dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord .

dag: So yi zaŋ o yili ti Yawɛ ka di leei zaɣ kasi, maligumaana n-ni zali di daa ni nyɛ shɛm, maligumaana maa ni zali di daa ka di doli di ni viɛl shɛm bee di ni bi viɛl shɛm, ka maligumaana maa ni zali di daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: When any of you dedicate your house to the Lord , the priest shall set the price according to its good or bad points, and the price will be final.

dag: Zab piɛla nyɛla jilima nam zuɣupiligu, Wuntizɔbo biɛhigu puuni ka di yirina.
en: Long life is the reward of the righteous; gray hair is a glorious crown.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛri maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka duɣi sara maligu kasi biŋkɔbiri nimdi mi duɣuri ni mini ankɔraŋmahi ni ni taha ni n-zaŋ li yomyom ti tari niriba maa zaa.
en: The Levites roasted the Passover sacrifices over the fire in the way they were commanded. And they boiled the holy offerings in pots, kettles, and pans. Then they quickly gave the meat to the people.

dag: Di saha ka yɛri bɛ taba, Ti nyɛla bɛn be kasi; miligimiya ka chɛ ti. M mini niriba bɛn be lala ku tooi kpe. N suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani ŋmanila buɣim din bi kpiri dabisili puuni zaa.
en: And then they say to others, Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God. Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛli ma, ka n yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa. Amaa nyin ŋuna, n ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi n-niŋ zuliya titali.
en: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.

dag: Dinzuɣu doo maa ni daa yɛli Bɔaz ni o dam li maa, o daa pirigila o namdili ti Bɔaz.
en: Then the redeemer said to Boaz, Buy it for yourself, and he took off his sandal.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛl o, Samsin, Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a! Ka o yirigi neei ka yɛli, N yaai ni yi n-chaŋ kaman n ni yi pun chani shɛm la, ka dam mmaŋa ka shɛli ku gu ma soli. O daa bi baŋ ni Yawɛ lan ka o sani.
en: Then she shouted, Samson! The Philistines are coming! He woke up and thought, I'll get loose and go free, as always. He did not know that the Lord had left him.

dag: Bɛ pahimi yi zuɣu ka yi tummi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma mini bɛ tuun shɛŋa din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni zaa; ka ninvuɣ zino miri ka o zaŋ omaŋ bali yi ni.
en: They will assist you and they will perform the duties of the meeting tent with regard to all the work of the tent. But no outsider may accompany you.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ yɛda. Bɛ ni daa wum ni Yawɛ baɣa be Izraɛlnim ni ka nya bɛ wahala maa, ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: The people believed. When they heard that the LORD had paid attention to the Israelites and had seen their oppression, they bowed down and worshipped.

dag: Gbilisim a tibili wum sarikanim ŋuhibu, ka tiligi bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la a yiko din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: Listen to the sad cries of the prisoners! Use your great power to free those who are sentenced to die.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Liya suhigu ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah anu ti Yaakubu.
en: God answered Leah's prayer, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn kpalim, wummiya! Mani n-daa gbibi ya yi manim puuni zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Listen to me, house of Jacob, all that remains from the house of Israel who have been borne by me since pregnancy, whom I carried from the womb.

dag: So na ʒi n-zaɣis omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o dihiri li mi ka maani li kaman Masia ni niŋdi cheechi shɛm la.
en: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church.

dag: Ka bɛ mabihi maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la daa nyɛ bɛn maani bɔrɔbɔro kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani sara Vuhim Dabisili dali kam la.
en: Also some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the stacks of bread for each Sabbath.

dag: Naawuni, a daa chɛ ka saa mi pam luɣilikam; a chɛ ka a tiŋgbani din gbarigi la neei.
en: God, you sent the rain to make a tired, old land strong again.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma sani, paɣ ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ doo, ka doo gba ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ paɣa;.
en: However, woman isnt independent from man, and man isnt independent from woman in the Lord.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣ shɛli yi ni mali yɔri farigu zuɣu maa na ka n nya. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ laɣifu na ti ti o.
en: Show me the coin used to pay the tax. And they brought him a denarion.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa taɣ o biɛhigu bɛ sani n-niŋdi kaman o nyɛla yinyaa la, ka bo bini n-chihiri dunɔdali punu chiha, ka chɛ ka o nintɔri zɔri dolisir o teeŋkɔbiri.
en: So he changed the way he acted with them, pretending to be insane while he was with them. He scratched marks on the doors of the city gates and let spit run down his chin.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbɛbil fiɛb ma; ka lab ma kuɣa yim. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n ŋariŋ saɣim teeku puuni; ka m be teeku puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: I was beaten with rods three times. I was stoned once. I was shipwrecked three times. I spent a day and a night on the open sea.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaanu daa gbaai Jɛrɛmɔt min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the fifteenth to Jerimoth, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Paɣiba bɛn zaa be naa nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima. Bɛ ni yɛli, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa tim ti boli Napaɣ Vashiti ni o kana ka o zaɣisi.
en: This is the reason: News of what the queen did will reach all women, making them look down on their husbands. They will say, King Ahasuerus ordered servants to bring Queen Vashti before him, but she refused to come.

dag: Dama Sadusiinim daa wuhiri niriba ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani, ka lan yɛri ni malaikanim bee shihi gba kani, amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wuhiri ni di zaa beni.
en: For the Sadducees say that people will not rise from death and that there are no angels or spirits; but the Pharisees believe in all three.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ li chaŋ a niriba bɛn be tinzun tinsi ni la sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi wum li bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: Then go to the exiles, to your peoples children. Whether they listen or not, speak to them and say: The LORD God proclaims!.

dag: Bɛ niŋdi yomyom chani ni bɛ ti ku niriba.
en: These people quickly become violent.

dag: ka ŋun Yaakubu kɔŋko daa kpalim be nyaaŋa. Di saha ka do so daa kana ka o min o ti kpe val ni n-va hal ka biɛɣ ti neerina.
en: Afterwards, Jacob went back and spent the rest of the night alone. A man came and fought with Jacob until just before daybreak.

dag: Wummi saɣisigu ka deei wuhibu din ni chɛ ka a ti mali yɛm dahin shɛli.
en: If you listen to advice and are willing to learn, one day you will be wise.

dag: Ka bɛ ti mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: who will make fun of him, spit on him, whip him, and kill him; but three days later he will rise to life.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ tumtumdiba maa ni tuumbaŋdiba zaa daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa; ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi.
en: All the skilled workers made the dwelling out of ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and deep red yarns, with figures of winged heavenly creatures worked into their design.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ laɣim o tɔbbihi min o kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi la zaa na, ka bɛ daa yi Harɔshɛtihagɔim n-chaŋ Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni.
en: he called out his nine hundred iron chariots and all his men, and sent them from Harosheth-of-the-Gentiles to the Kishon River.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N wuhibu maa pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla ŋun tim ma na la dini.
en: Jesus answered, What I teach is not my own. My teaching comes from the one who sent me.

dag: Kuɣ viɛla balibu kam ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi tiŋ maa gooni maa gbinni nachiinsi, ka di kɔtomsi daa be kɔŋkɔba. Kuɣ viɛla maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla jasipa, ka din pah ayi nyɛ safaya, ka din pah ata nyɛ agɛt, ka din pah anahi nyɛ ɛmɛrald.
en: The city walls foundations were decorated with every kind of jewel. The first foundation was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was chalcedony, and the fourth was emerald.

dag: mini Jatir ni Ɛshitɛmɔa.
en: Jattir and its pastures; Eshtemoa and its pastures.

dag: Amaa ka o ma daa bi saɣi ka yɛli ba, Bolimiy o la Jɔn.
en: But his mother said, No! His name is to be John.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yi yi ku wum n ni yɛli shɛm, Naawuni ni chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ tinzun yɛtɔɣa wuhi ya.
en: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.

dag: N ni niŋ di tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ di polo la ka di nyɛ n ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi zuliya kam zaa, ka di sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni la.
en: I will unleash upon that land everything I decreed, all that is written in this scroll, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan lihi nya do so ka o gbib bimbuɣisirigu o nuu ni.
en: In another vision I saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n fabili niŋ a ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a tib ma.
en: I cried to you for help, O Lord my God, and you healed me;.

dag: Aduna ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisiri Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi tiŋgban nɛli polo n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima yi zahira sagban ni.
en: As Aaron spoke to the whole community, they turned toward the desert, and suddenly the dazzling light of the Lord appeared in a cloud.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab maa daa ti yɛl o, Ti nya ti Duuma. Amaa ka o yɛli ba, Ka pa ni man ti nya o nuhi ni kpahi bɔba la, ka zaŋ n nubil bɔbili kpahi maa bɔba maa ni, ka zaŋ n nuu tim o puluɣili la bɔbili la ni, n ku niŋ yɛda.
en: The other disciples told him, Weve seen the Lord! But he replied, Unless I see the nail marks in his hands, put my finger in the wounds left by the nails, and put my hand into his side, I wont believe.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛri ni tin shɛli nyɛla dabari, ka ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu lan ka di ni la, Juda fɔntinsi mini Jɛrusalɛm pal dahi din leei dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbigu lan ka di ni ŋɔ, bɛ ni ti lan wum.
en: The LORD proclaims: You have said about this place, It is a wasteland, without humans or animals. Yet in the ravaged and uninhabited towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem.

dag: n karitimi dol o hal ti ŋme n-fa piɛbila maa o nol ni; ka o yi lɛbigi doli ma na, n gbaarila o nyiŋgol ni ŋme n-ku o.
en: I would go after it, strike it, and rescue the animal from its mouth. If it turned on me, I would grab it at its jaw, strike it, and kill it.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bɔri ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni bɛ suhuri zaa la daa yi Izraɛl bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa n-doli Lɛvinim kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la.
en: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Jɔshua ni daa pun wuhi niriba maa shɛm la zuɣu, maligumaaniba ayopɔin bɛn gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la n-daa gari tooni chani ka piɛbiri kikahi maa, ka bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa doli ba.
en: So, just as Joshua had ordered, an advance guard started out ahead of the priests who were blowing trumpets; behind these came the priests who were carrying the Covenant Box, followed by a rear guard. All this time the trumpets were sounding.

dag: Yi ni ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, amaa di ti chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: You are going to hear the noise of battles close by and the news of battles far away; but do not be troubled. Such things must happen, but they do not mean that the end has come.

dag: N ni darigi bɛn be Ijipti maa tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili ka chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: I will punish those who live in Egypt, just as I punished Jerusalem—with war, starvation, and disease.

dag: ka o daa kuli ti yɛl o ba min o ma, N nyala Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga Timna, dinzuɣu bomiy o ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: When he got back home, he told his parents, I saw a Philistine woman in Timnah, and I want to marry her. Get her for me.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ daa ʒila Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni. Dinzuɣu kuɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri yɛlli ŋɔ yɛla sahakam.
en: Then you will tell them that the water of the Jordan was cut off before the LORDs covenant chest. When it crossed over the Jordan, the water of the Jordan was cut off. These stones will be an enduring memorial for the Israelites.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib daa ʒe nimaani kul fiɣisir o ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: The leading priests and teachers of the law were standing there shouting things against Jesus.

dag: Ka Hamat din mini Hadirak di tintarisi la gba nyɛla o ni su shɛli zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn hal bɛ ni mali baŋsim la zaa yoli.
en: This message is also against the city of Hamath near Damascus. And this message is against Tyre and Sidon, even though those people have been so wise and skillful.

dag: dama ŋunkam nya vuhim Naawuni sani chɛ o tuma ka vuhirimi kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ omaŋmaŋ tuma ka vuhi shɛm la.
en: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.

dag: Jintɔriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka suli ku ba pam, ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku Yisa tuumba maa.
en: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ammɔnnim naa daa ti kpi ka o bia Hanun daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Some time later, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.

dag: Nachimbil maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: But when the young man heard Jesus tell him to give away his money, he was sad. He didnt want to do this, because he was very rich. So he left.

dag: ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi wuntitali soya dolibu ka dolila zibisim soya la.
en: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.

dag: di yi pa lala a ni daa yihi ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na maa nim ni yɛli, Yawɛ ni kɔŋ ba zaŋ tahi o ni daa lo ba alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la zuɣu min o ni je ba zuɣu ka o yihi ba tahi tiŋgban nɛl ni ni o ti chɛ ka bɛ kpi.
en: If you punish your people, the Egyptians might say, The Lord was not able to take his people into the land he promised them. And he hated them. So he took them into the desert to kill them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ba yi di nyɛ Naawuni yi naan yuri ma, dama o sani ka n yina; pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka n kana, amaa ŋun Naawuni n-tim ma na.
en: Jesus replied, If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God. Here I am. I havent come on my own. God sent me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kliɔpas la bɔh o, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ sana Jɛrusalɛm ŋun na bi wum yɛl shɛŋa din yol niŋ nimaani daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni la.
en: Then the one named Cleopas asked Jesus, Are you the only person from Jerusalem who didn't know what was happening there these last few days.

dag: Pa sokam zaa n-daa nya o, naɣila Naawuni ni daa pii tinim shɛb leei shɛhiranim maa n-daa nya o, ka ti min o laɣim di ka nyu o ni daa neei kum ni maa nyaaŋa.
en: not to everyone, but only to the witnesses that God had already chosen, that is, to us who ate and drank with him after he rose from death.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ kul ku miligi ka chɛn ya hal ka di ti naai yi balibu zaa yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa.
en: The Lord will send you terrible diseases until you no longer exist, until you are completely gone from the land.

dag: N daa lari niŋdi ba saha shɛli bɛ daa yi ti lan ka yɛda, ka n suhupiɛlli lihigu kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri.
en: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Zipɔr bia Balak ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka binshɛli gu a soli ka a bi ka n sanna.
en: They went to Balaam and said, This is what Balak son of Zippor says to you: Please dont let anything stop you from coming.

dag: ka Hɔshaya bia Azaria mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni ninvuɣ yoya la zaa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, A ŋmala ʒiri, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi tim a na ni a ti yɛli ti, Di chaŋya Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani.
en: Then Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the other arrogant men said to me, You are lying. The Lord our God did not send you to tell us not to go and live in Egypt.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam doli nam fukumsinim yɛligu; dama nam fukumsi nir kani ka pa ni Naawuni n-zal o, ka nam fukumsi din beni nyɛla Naawuni ni zali shɛli.
en: All of you must obey the government rulers. Everyone who rules was given the power to rule by God. And all those who rule now were given that power by God.

dag: N ŋmanila tikpiralana, m bi tooi wumda, ka ŋmani birigu ŋun ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: But I am like a deaf man and cannot hear. I am like someone who cannot speak.

dag: dama ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi yi alahichi dabitim ni.
en: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela zuliya kam ni maani shɛb ansarisi; ka leei niriba ni lari shɛba.
en: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka bɛ yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo. Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la di tumtumsa ni.
en: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners. Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does.

dag: Dunia ni ti laani kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam kuli, ka viini kaman suɣili la. Di tuumbiɛri tibisim nti yɛn marigi li ka di lu, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bala. Naawuni ni zaŋ tarili shɛli zali ba m-bala.
en: This is the fate of wicked people, the fate that God assigns to them.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba, hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: and whose strong hand is a strong hand of deception!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi tɛhiya ni n tahila puli niŋbu na ka ku tahi di dɔɣibu na?.
en: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga. Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Still other seed landed on good soil. When it grew, it produced one hundred times more grain than was scattered. As he said this, he called out, Everyone who has ears should pay attention.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ bi zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bee n-zo n-yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ni bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, amaa ka nyin tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: If you do warn the wicked and they dont turn from their wickedness or their wicked ways, they will die because of their guilt, but you will save your life.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Therefore, prophesy against them, human one, prophesy!.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery; do not commit murder; do not steal; do not accuse anyone falsely; respect your father and your mother.

dag: Shafan bia Ɛlasa mini Hilikia bia Gɛmaria bɛn daa nyɛ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim shɛba Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza san la n-daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa mali chaŋ. Di daa yɛlimi.
en: I gave the letter to Elasah son of Shaphan and to Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. It said:.

dag: nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o pahi bilikɔɣinim ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: He will cut them in pieces and put them in a place with the hypocrites. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.

dag: O ni zaŋ tɔbutuhira piɛma din noya diri mini sɔɣu tia sala buɣim darigi yi tibili.
en: Just this: a warriors sharpened arrows, coupled with burning coals from a wood fire!.

dag: di saha n tahima maa lee be ya? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn nya n tahima maa?.
en: But what kind of hope is that?.

dag: Bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o ninni nyaɣisiri kaman wuntaŋ la, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: He was transformed in front of them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as light.

dag: Miri ka a lo a ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka niŋ a naani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont plan to harm your neighbor who trusts and lives near you.

dag: n-fa o o wahala zaa ni bahi, ka ti o baŋsim, ka chɛ ka o nya jilima Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la sani. Ka Firawuna daa leeg o nam, ka chɛ ka o guli ŋun Firawuna yili zaŋ tabili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: and brought him safely through all his troubles. When Joseph appeared before the king of Egypt, God gave him a pleasing manner and wisdom, and the king made Joseph governor over the country and the royal household.

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Jaakan. Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Uzi mini Aran.
en: Ezers family: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishans family: Uz and Aran.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda mini bɛn zaa be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Amaa mbusim be dunia mini teeku zuɣu! Dama Sintani siɣi yi sanna ni sujee zaɣ titali o ni mi ni o saha bi lan wɔɣa zuɣu.
en: So rejoice, you heavens and all who live there! But it will be terrible for the earth and sea, because the devil has gone down to you. He is filled with anger. He knows he doesnt have much time.

dag: O daa nyɛla Pɛrɛz yaaŋa, ka daa nyɛ ŋun su tɔbbi kpamba zaa fukumsi goli tuuli maa ni.
en: Jashobeam, one of Perezs descendants, was leader of all the army officers for the first month.

dag: Dama yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa bi be kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na la, nimaani yi daa yi biri yi bimbira, yi chanila yi naba zuɣu ti ŋɔŋ kom na ti yɔɣi li kaman ʒiɛvari puu la.
en: The land you are about to enter and possess is definitely not like the land of Egypt, where you came from, where you sowed your seed and irrigated it by hand like a vegetable garden.

dag: Yi ni so di bɔh o kpee biɛri, amaa niŋmiya ania n-kul niŋmi yi taba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa din viɛla.
en: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ biɛri ku yi tibidarigibo ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn ni yi.
en: The evil person will surely not go unpunished, but the children of the righteous will escape.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka niŋmiya nirilim, ka zomiya tab nambɔɣu.
en: Long ago I gave these commands to my people: You must see that justice is done, and must show kindness and mercy to one another.

dag: Lala ka o yɛn bɔri piɛri mini chi ni kpam asiba kam ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pari taba.
en: the lamb, the flour, and the olive oil will be offered to me every morning for all time.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n lo nia ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ kaman ŋun Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli m ba Dauda, N ni ti yɛn zaŋ a bi so leei naa zal a zaashee n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma.
en: The Lord made a promise to my father David. He said, I will make your son king after you, and he will build a temple to honor me. Now, I plan to build that temple to honor the Lord my God.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi a suhu ni ni a gba tur a tab pam.
en: After all, you know that youve often cursed others yourself!.

dag: O ni daa deei litaafi maa naai, ka binnɛma anahi la mini kpamba pisinaanahi la gbani Piɛbil maa tooni. Bɛ zaa daa malila mɔɣilɔnim mini salima lahi, ka tulaale zim din nyɛ Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu pal lahi maa.
en: As he did so, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each had a harp and gold bowls filled with incense, which are the prayers of God's people.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ Kɛdɛmɔt mini Mɛfaat ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: Kedemoth, and Mephaath.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Naa Sool, A tum jɛrilim tuma. Dama a bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛli. Pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ naan chɛ ka a min a zuliya diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: How stupid of you to have broken the commands the LORD your God gave you! Samuel told Saul. The LORD would have established your rule over Israel forever.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm; ka Naawuni daa yo Nuhu niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: All these animals went into the boat in groups of two, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord closed the door behind Noah.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei nanim maa tinsi maa zaa, ka gbahi bɛ nanim gba zaa; ka daa zaŋ takɔb ku sokam zaa kaman Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: Joshua captured all these cities and their kings, putting everyone to death, just as Moses, the Lord 's servant, had commanded.

dag: Bee o yi shihi daadam daɣiri, din dee yi kul nyɛ daɣ shɛlikam din chɛ ka ninsal bi be kasi ka bi baŋ li, o yi ti baŋ li o mali taali.
en: You might touch any of the many things that can make a person unclean. You might touch something unclean, but not know about it. When you learn that you have touched something unclean, you must pay a fine.

dag: Amaa shɛb daa bi saɣi Musa yɛligu maa, ka zaŋ shɛli zali hal ni asiba, ka di daa nyɔni wɔɣi zunzuya. Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: But some of them did not listen to Moses and saved part of it. The next morning it was full of worms and smelled rotten, and Moses was angry with them.

dag: Kpambaliba yi wum ni n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka kana ti yɛl a, Kul yɛlim ti a ni yɛli naa shɛm, di sɔɣi ti shɛli, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a. Wula ka naa lee yɛl a.
en: If the officials find out that we met, and they come and say to you, Tell us what you said to the king. Dont hide anything from us; otherwise, well kill you. So what did the king say to you.

dag: Yi yi wali wala viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka m Ba nya jilima pam, di mi n-ni lan wuhi ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba.
en: My Father is glorified when you produce much fruit and in this way prove that you are my disciples.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lan labi pahi naba ayi ka Yisifu daa kahig omaŋ n-wuh o biɛyanim maa ka bɛ baŋ o, ka Firawuna gba daa baŋ ŋun Yisifu biɛyanim maa.
en: During their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Josephs family.

dag: A ni mali yɛm pam zaŋ chaŋ daabiligu polo maa zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a buni nabi pahi, ka a mali karimbaani a buni maa zuɣu.
en: You're a clever businessman and are extremely wealthy, but your wealth has led to arrogance!.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali gali sabilifaa bee gali ʒiɛkpeein bee gali ʒiɛkpain bee tan piɛl viɛlli bee buhi kɔbiri bee bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛ gban shɛŋa bee teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana daa zaŋ li na.
en: Everyone who had fine linen; blue, purple, or red wool; cloth of goats' hair; rams' skin dyed red; or fine leather, brought it.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-pa o buŋ nyaampara, ka zaŋ o nachimba ayi min o bia Yisahaku pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bo dari pahi ni o ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-daa yi n-chaŋ katiŋa Naawuni ni daa wuh o luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Early the next morning Abraham cut some wood for the sacrifice, loaded his donkey, and took Isaac and two servants with him. They started out for the place that God had told him about.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kul tia, din wula chaŋ ti kpe kɔzɔrim ni, wuuni yi ti du, di baɣa kani, ka di vari kul nyɛ va maha sahakam. Ka sanzali yuuni puuni, di baɣa kani, ka wala kul bi kɔŋdi di zuɣu.
en: He is like a tree growing near a stream and sending out roots to the water. It is not afraid when hot weather comes, because its leaves stay green; it has no worries when there is no rain; it keeps on bearing fruit.

dag: Ka n daa nya tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm palli, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina, ka malimali m-be kaman amiliya ni yi mal omaŋa n-gu o daaŋgo shɛm la.
en: And I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared and ready, like a bride dressed to meet her husband.

dag: N niriba bahi yoli bɛ ʒilinsi zuɣu. Yi ni zaɣisi baŋsim zuɣu n gba zaɣisi ya, yi lan pala m maligumaaniba. Ka yi ni tam n zaligu yɛla zuɣu, n gba ni tam yi bihi yɛla.
en: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.

dag: Zɛra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zimiri mini Ɛtan ni Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Dara, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: Zerah had five sons. They were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya ba ka bɛ gbaai Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab shɛba n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani ka kuhiri yɛra, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɛbigiri dunia pindi tiŋ la paai ti ya ŋɔ gba na.
en: When they didnt find them, they dragged Jason and some believers before the city officials. They were shouting, These people who have been disturbing the peace throughout the empire have also come here.

dag: Ti nyɛla do yino bidibisi pinaayi; ka ti ni yino daa kani, ka ŋun nyɛ ti zaa biasani be ti ba maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: We were twelve brothers in all, sons of the same father. One brother is dead, and the youngest is still in Canaan with our father.

dag: N ni ti gbaag a pahi zuliya shɛb ni n-zaŋ a chaŋ a ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka di muɣisi niriba pam.
en: Many nations will be troubled when I spread the news of your destruction through countries you never heard of.

dag: Ka luɣa ni duri maa dunoya daa yoori bahiri pal shɛli din daa kpalim polo. Duno yini daa kpala nuzaa polo, ka duno din la mi kpa nudirigu polo. Ka pal shɛli din daa guui yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili.
en: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms.

dag: Yi ni daa ŋme n-nyaŋ zuliya pam ka di bɛ nɛma la zuɣu, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim gba ni ti ŋmɛn ya ka di yi nɛma, yi ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb mini yi ni daa chɛ ka damli shɛli dam dunia ni fɔntinsi ni n-tabili bɛnkam zaa be di ni la zuɣu.
en: Since you yourself have plundered many nations, all the rest of the peoples will plunder you because of the human bloodshed and the violence done to the earth, to every village, and to all its inhabitants.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi dii pali ma, ka n nya ka nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni ka so ʒi nimaani.
en: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.

dag: O ni ti niŋ ninvuɣ titali, ka bɛ ni ti boon o la Zallakudura Naa Bia, ka ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o yab Naa Dauda nam ti o.
en: He will be great. People will call him the Son of the Most High God, and the Lord God will make him king like his ancestor David.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Mani n-nyɛ Firawuna, so ku tooi kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa bee n-vuug o napɔŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni, ka pa ni nyini m-bah o noli.
en: The king told Joseph, Although I'm king, no one in Egypt is to do anything without your permission.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku ba hal ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi guui. Dauda daa kula Siria chɛchɛbumbariba kɔbisiyopɔin, ka ku wɔribariba mi tuhi pihinahi, ka daa ti Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ kamɔna kpɛm maa daŋa, ka o kpi nimaani.
en: but David defeated them, and they ran from the Israelites. David killed chariot drivers and , horse soldiers as well as Shobach, the captain of the Aramean army.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di zaŋ Izraɛl zuliya shɛli fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli n-tom ti Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli nima; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim zaa kul gbibila bɛ yaannim daŋ fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: so that the inheritance of the Israelites doesnt transfer from one tribe to another. The Israelites will each retain the tribal inheritance of his ancestral tribe.

dag: ka yihi nanim bɛ nama ni, ka tibigi tarimba.
en: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi fa Naawuni? Amaa yinim fari ma mi. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee fa a? Yi binyara pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim tibu mini yi sara pina tibu puuni.
en: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, How are we robbing you? You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali, ka di nyɛla din yɛligir o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: The priest shall examine you again on the seventh day, and if it is spreading, it is a dreaded skin disease, and the priest shall pronounce you unclean.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbu saha shɛli, ka o daa lan kpuɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bipuɣiŋga n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Sɛgub.
en: Later, Hezron had sexual relations with the daughter of Machir, Gileads father, whom he married when he was years old, and she gave birth to Segub for him.

dag: N daa kul nyarila jilima, ka n kpiɔŋ kul be kaman tɔb palli la.
en: my honor newly with me, my bow ever successful in my hand.

dag: Tinsi maa yɛn nyɛla nir ni yɛn zo n-kuli shɛli n-yi ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri nuu ni, ka lala chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ku kpi hal ti zani salo ni ka bɛ kar o saria.
en: That person will be safe from anyone from the dead mans family who wants to punish the killer until that person is judged in court.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛl taba, Ti ku nya ti ni yɛn zaŋ yɛl shɛli fiɣisi Daniɛl, naɣila zaŋ chaŋ o Naawuni jɛma la polo.
en: So these men said, We wont find any fault in Daniel, unless we can find something to use against him from his religious practice.

dag: A nyɛla do viɛlli dɔbba puuni; a zilinkom viɛla. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni sahakam.
en: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.

dag: Ka Iso daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka n ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa daliri lee nyɛla dini? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N zaŋ ba mi na ni n ti ti a m-maai nyini n dan suhu.
en: Esau said, Who were all those people I saw while I was coming here? And what were all those animals for? Jacob answered, These are my gifts to you so that you might accept me.

dag: Dama niriba ayi bee ata yi laɣim luɣ shɛli n yuli zuɣu, n ni be bɛ sani.
en: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you.

dag: Ka o daa pir o tɔbbihi ʒii buta zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ mɔɣu maa ni ti sɔɣi do n-gu ba. Ka Abimilɛk daa ti lihi nya ba ka bɛ yi tiŋ maa ni kanna, ka o yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: he took his men, divided them into three companies, and set an ambush in the fields. As soon as he saw the men coming from the city, he sprang upon them and attacked them.

dag: Naawuni zomi ya nambɔɣu, ka tin ya suhudoo mini yurilim din kul zoori pahira!.
en: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love!.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tɛha nyɛla din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu nyɛla yɔhiŋ.
en: Good people are honest and fair in all they do, but those who are evil lie and cannot be trusted.

dag: Babilɔnnim ni daa kul teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa chibi tiŋ maa gooni voli, ka Naa Zɛdɛkia min o tɔbbihi zaa daa doli voli maa yi goma ayi sunsuuni. Naa puu polo ka bɛ daa doli yi yuŋ n-zɔri kpari Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili polo.
en: Then the enemy broke into the city. All the soldiers fled by night using the gate between the two walls near the Kings Garden. The Chaldeans were surrounding the city, so the soldiers ran toward the desert plain.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni naɣila o Bi gaŋ ŋun ʒi n-dalim o Ba Naawuni nyɔɣu la kɔŋko. Ŋuna n-wuhi ti Naawuni ni nyɛ so.
en: No one has ever seen God. God the only Son, who is at the Fathers side, has made God known.

dag: Di saha Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni ti chaŋ ti kuhi niŋ bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi wun shɛŋa maa, amaa bɛ kul ku tooi tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha.
en: The people in the towns of Judah and in the city of Jerusalem will go and pray to their idols for help. They burn incense to those idols. But their idols will not be able to help the people of Judah when that terrible disaster comes.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ni daa kul timd o daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna la zaa yoli, yi daa zaɣisiya ni yi ku gbilisi tibili wum.
en: The Lord has sent his servants, the prophets, to you over and over again. But you have not listened to them. You have not paid any attention to them.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ma na, ka n ŋubi m bia mɔɣu ni nimdi, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni. Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li ti o ka o di, ka o zaŋ wain pah o ka o nyu.
en: Isaac said, Bring some food here and let me eat some of my sons game so I can bless you. Jacob put it before him and he ate, and he brought him wine and he drank.

dag: O ni daa kpe yili maa ni ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kumdi ka fabindi lala? Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: He went in and said to them, Whats all this commotion and crying about? The child isnt dead. Shes only sleeping.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o Izraɛl nanim Silisi la ni. Ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: King Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ ni di wuhi ni n kɔŋla shɛli, dama m bɔhim ni n chɛ ka n nini tiɣi n ni mali shɛli.
en: And I am not saying this because I feel neglected, for I have learned to be satisfied with what I have.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goondaa la luhi, ka nyo nayili zaa buɣim, ka saɣim duɣuri mini la viɛl shɛŋa din daa be nayili maa zaa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar and his army burned the Temple. They broke down Jerusalems wall and burned all the houses that belonged to the king and his officials. They took or destroyed every valuable thing in Jerusalem.

dag: ka Okiran bia Pagiɛl daa nyɛ Asha zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Next came the tribe of Asher. Pagiel son of Ocran was the commander of that group.

dag: N ni daa kul lihiri yila maa, ka n ti nya yilibila ka di daai yil ata shɛŋa din daa pun saya la n-vuɣ li bahi, ka puhi yina. Yilibil maa daa malila nina ka di be kaman ninsal nina la, ka mali noli ka di tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa bi garig o. Ka o nyaandoliba balim o yɛli, Karim paɣ maa, dama o kuhiri doli ti.
en: But Jesus did not answer her. So the followers came to him and said, Tell her to go away. She keeps crying out and will not leave us alone.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi nya bula shɛb zaa bɛn duri buhi ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri, dama n nya Leeban ni niŋd a shɛm.
en: He said, Look up and watch all the striped, speckled, and spotted male goats mounting the flock. Ive seen everything that Laban is doing to you.

dag: n-yɛri niriba maa, Yi yi ti kul nya ka maligumaaniba kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la ʒi n-chana, yin yiɣisimiya yi dooshee ŋɔ doli ba;.
en: They commanded the people, As soon as you see the LORD your Gods chest containing the covenant and the levitical priests carrying it, you are to march out from your places and follow it.

dag: Bɛ zaa kalinsi nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: Finally, the woman died.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Yawɛ yihi anabinim ti ti Babilɔn.
en: You people might say, But the Lord has given us prophets here in Babylon.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lan yɛl o ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu chɛ ka o lo ni pa Mɔdɛkai kɔŋko ka o ni ku. Dinzuɣu ka Haman daa bo soli ni o ku Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn nyɛ Mɔdɛkai zuliya m-be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam sulinsi maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: And when he found out that Mordecai was a Jew, he knew that killing only Mordecai was not enough. Every Jew in the whole kingdom had to be killed.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn guli piɛri mini niɣi, ka ʒi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi maa ni bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa na.
en: They are a family of shepherds. They have always kept sheep and cattle. They have brought all their animals and everything they own with them.

dag: Bɛ ni kpi kaman piɛri la, ka kum ni nyɛ bɛ gula. Bɛ ni faai siɣi gbala ni yomyom; ka bɛ niŋgbuna pooi kpiimba biɛhigu shee din yɛn nyɛ bɛ yinsi la.
en: Like sheep, theyre headed straight for the grave. Death will be their shepherd— but those who do right in their hearts will rule over them come morning!— their forms wasting away in the grave rather than having some dignified residence.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kalila Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir la bidibisi pahi Lɛvinim ni.
en: Moses was the man of God, and his sons were part of the tribe of Levi.

dag: Pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari niriba maa kaman bɛ yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Divide the land of Canaan among these tribes, according to the number of people in each one.

dag: n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka yi kaari ma; ka n daa ti be sarika ni, ka yi kani n sanna ti kaari ma.
en: and when I was naked, you gave me clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of me, and when I was in jail, you visited me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Hɔrihagidigad maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Jɔtibata.
en: They marched from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

dag: Ka bɛ tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti mi ni a nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛra ni ŋun wuhiri din tuhi ka bi gaŋdi so, amaa ka wuhiri Naawuni soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: These spies said to Jesus, Teacher, we know that what you say and teach is right. We know that you pay no attention to anyone's status, but teach the truth about God's will for people.

dag: Yi ni so miri ka o ti zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga nyo buɣim mali sara bee n-ŋmɛri bihigu bee m-buɣiri baɣa bee n-nyɛ bɔha bee bukpaha.
en: Don't sacrifice your children in the fires on your altars; and don't let your people practice divination or look for omens or use spells.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kuhi niŋ Musa; ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ka buɣim maa kpi.
en: The people cried out to Moses for help; he prayed to the Lord , and the fire died down.

dag: Binshɛɣukam tariga paabu saha miriya, dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu suhiri Naawuni.
en: The end of everything has come. Therefore, be self-controlled and clearheaded so you can pray.

dag: Aduna mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya Musa ka o ninni nyaɣisira maa ka bɛ zɔri ni bɛ mir o.
en: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.

dag: nyini ŋun deeri ti suhigu ŋɔ! Ninsalinim zaa ni ka a sanna.
en: Anyone can come to you, and you will listen to their prayers.

dag: Asha zuliya n-daa pah anu n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The lot went out fifth for the clans of the tribe of Asher.

dag: Kulla naa kɔŋko m-mali soli ni o ʒini di puuni n-di bindirigu Yawɛ tooni. O ni dolila dunɔdali maa polo zɔntua kpe, ka lan doli nimaani yi.
en: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: All this land is the land Moses gave the family groups of Gad. That land included all the towns that were listed. Moses gave that land to each family group.

dag: Ka bɛ shini. Ka Yisa daa chɛ ka doo maa kpaŋ, ka bah o ka o lab kul o yiŋa.
en: But they said nothing. Jesus took hold of the sick man, cured him, and then let him go.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti ku yi ni chani ni yi ti deei zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka chɛ ka yi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, yi yi ti deei li ʒini bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni yeei n nam nɛma ŋɔ ka taɣi nɛma ye n-chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam nɛma. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa taɣi nɛma ye, ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, As we go into battle, I will disguise myself, but you wear your royal garments. So the king of Israel went into battle in disguise.

dag: Absalom daa lan yɛli; Mani n-yi di nyɛ sariakarita Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ŋunkam yi di zaŋ o kpee tahi n sanna bee n-zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam na, n naan kari saria maa dɛde n-ti o nasara.
en: If only I were made a judge in the land, Absalom would continue, then anyone with a lawsuit could come to me, and I would give them justice.

dag: Ka yu shɛli sabi pa o binyɛrigu min o gbalipini zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: On his robe and on his thigh was written the name: King of kings and Lord of lords.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba yihi yi ni deei zaka binshɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim sani maa mi zaka ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ din nyɛ Yawɛ dini maa ti maligumaana Aduna.
en: as an offering to me. That amount must then be given to Aaron.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi bɛ kanimina ti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: Those evil men are like dogs that come into town in the evening, growling and roaming the streets.

dag: A chɛ ka n zɔnim mini n ʒiʒiinitab zaɣisi ma. Zibisim n-kpalim n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: Youve made my loved ones and companions distant. My only friend is darkness.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ti boli Izraɛl kpamba mini daŋ kam ni toondaannim zaa ni bɛ laɣim o sanna Jɛrusalɛm nti kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la Ziɔn, din daa nyɛ Dauda tiŋ la ni na.
en: Then Solomon assembled Israels elders, all the tribal leaders, and the chiefs of Israels clans at Jerusalem to bring up the chest containing the LORDs covenant from Davids City Zion.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yihi tinzunnim zaa bɛn be Izraɛlnim ni.
en: So when the Israelites heard that law, they obeyed it. They separated themselves from the people who were descendants of foreigners.

dag: Nir yi ku ninsala, ka ninvuɣ bɔbili di li shɛhira, bɛn kum ninvuɣ kura maa, amaa di bi tuhi ni bɛ ku so ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa ni zali ni bɛ zaŋ binshɛŋa maa zaa na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-miri ti zani Yawɛ tooni.
en: So all the people came to the Meeting Tent. They all brought the things that Moses had commanded. All the people stood before the Lord .

dag: Tuunkpɛmalana ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din tahiri nyamma pam na, amaa ŋunkam bɔri yomyom ni nyari shɛlikam poor o mi.
en: Plan carefully and you will have plenty; if you act too quickly, you will never have enough.

dag: ka yi ti yɛn bahi ka ŋuhira, ka yi niŋgbuna zaa sheei;.
en: You will lie groaning on your deathbed, your flesh and muscles being eaten away.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa du n-tam zo shɛli din yuli booni Zɛmaraim Zoli din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya ni la zuɣu ka yɛli, Nyin Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: The armies met in the hill country of Ephraim. King Abijah went up Mount Zemaraim and called out to Jeroboam and the Israelites: Listen to me! he said.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o binyɛr piɛlli ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-va buɣim mini di sara maligu maa ka chɛ tampiligim shɛli sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini maa luɣili zuɣu.
en: The priest will dress in his linen robe, with linen undergarments on his body. Because the fire will have devoured the entirely burned offering on the altar, he must remove the ashes and place them beside the altar.

dag: dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na sani mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di.
en: Send the people away, and let them go to the nearby farms and villages in order to buy themselves something to eat.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ! Ka niriba maa zaa daa kpuɣi bɛ nuhi zuɣusaa ka yɛra, Ami! Ami! Di saha ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting Amen! Amen! Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Dama di luhiya ti mini Naawuni Shia Kasi sani ni ti di ʒili ya ʒi tibisa n-naɣ pahila yɛl shɛŋa din simdi niŋbu ŋɔ.
en: The Holy Spirit has led us to the decision that no burden should be placed on you other than these essentials.

dag: Benya yɛm biɛhigu bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm.
en: Act wisely toward outsiders, making the most of the opportunity.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma!.
en: Listen, then, if you have ears!.

dag: m-pahi shiri mini bihikpam ni piɛri ni waagasi zuɣu na nti ti Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa ni bɛ di, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Ŋ-ŋɔ kum mini kɔnyuri wum niriba maa ka bɛ tarigi yɔɣu maa ni.
en: honey, curds, sheep, and cheese from the herd so that David and the troops who were with him could eat. They said, The troops have grown hungry, tired, and thirsty in the wilderness.

dag: Yi ti bi yɛn niŋdi kaman ti ni niŋdi shɛm kpe zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ti zaa kul niŋdila ti suhuri ni yu shɛm.
en: Dont act like weve been acting here lately—everyone doing what seems right to them.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim birigi n-tum alahichi pam gari Yawɛ ni daa ku zuliya shɛb ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani la ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa.
en: In this way Manasseh led Judah and the residents of Jerusalem into doing even more evil than the nations that the LORD had wiped out before the Israelites.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun kar shɛŋa tariga? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi puh o ka di saɣi?.
en: Who could possibly repeat all of the LORDs mighty acts or publicly recount all his praise?.

dag: Yi malila nina din bi nyara? Ka mali tiba din bi wumda? Ka yi bi lan teei yaha?.
en: Do you have eyes that cant see? Do you have ears that cant hear? Remember what I did before, when we did not have enough bread?.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yiɣisi zani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini gbini Izraɛlnim zaa ninni n-kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: Then in the presence of the people Solomon went and stood in front of the altar, where he raised his arms.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tikpiralan so ŋun tɔri birilim ka o sanna nti suh o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: While he was there, some people brought a man to him who was deaf and could not talk clearly. The people begged Jesus to put his hand on the man to heal him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti bɔri ni yi nya Daadam Bia saha ŋɔ dabisili zaɣ yini gba, ka ku nya li.
en: Then Jesus said to the disciples, The time will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Human One,and you wont see it.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpuɣi ti nuhi zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ ti suhuri ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ.
en: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to the God of heaven.

dag: Amaa n ni zo Juda zuliya nambɔɣu. Ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni fa ba bahi. M bi yɛn zaŋ tɔbiri bee takɔbi bee yuri bee wɔribariba fa ba bahi.
en: But I will have compassion on the house of Judah. I, the LORD their God, will save them; I will not save them by bow, or by sword, or by war, or by horses, or by horsemen.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bala ni Ɛzɛm.
en: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem.

dag: Amaa bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ sɔŋdi Aduna bidibisi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni, ka maani di dundɔŋ mini di duri, ka paɣiri neen shɛŋa din be kasi la zaa, ka tumdi tuun shɛlikam din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma.
en: and were assigned the following duties: to help the priests descended from Aaron with the Temple worship, to take care of its courtyards and its rooms, and to keep undefiled everything that is sacred;.

dag: Ka naa daa yiɣisi Jɛshurun, saha shɛli niriba zuɣulaannim ni daa laɣim, din nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya naŋgban yini laɣiŋgu la.
en: A king came to rule in Jeshurun, when the peoples leaders gathered together, when Israels tribes were one.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa niŋdi lala maa, bɛ daa nya ma ka m malila mmaŋa m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka salo bee duŋtaariba daa ka n sani hal ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la ti kana.
en: When they found me in the temple, I was ritually pure. There was no crowd and no disturbance.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara piɛbila maa mini kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim zuɣu maa gahigahi, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest shall take the lamb and the olive oil and present them as a special gift to the Lord for the priest.

dag: Piim dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la ni niriba.
en: Choose twelve men, one from each tribe.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat daa tim o tumtumda na m-pahi bunu ni o zilin yini maa. O daa sabila gbaŋ din bi kpabi ka o gbibi li o nuu ni na.
en: Then Sanballat sent one of his servants to me with a fifth message, this one in the form of an unsealed letter.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa, ka lan nya bɛ ni ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka o taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni daa lo ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa polo, ka daa shiri bi niŋ li.
en: God saw what they did; he saw that they had given up their wicked behavior. So he changed his mind and did not punish them as he had said he would.

dag: A daa ko pini zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka mali binshɛŋa din dundu zali niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam. A daa bi be kaman pagɔrili la, dama a je liɣiri.
en: But you werent like an ordinary prostitute! When you built your pavilion at the head of every street and made your platform in every square, you refused to be paid.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma mi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala salima firilatamdigu, ka laa tam di zuɣu; ka firilanima ayopɔin tam di zuɣu; ka firila kam mali mihi ayopɔin.
en: Then he said to me, What do you see? I said, I see a lampstand made entirely of gold. It has a bowl on top. The bowl has seven lamps on top and seven metal pipes for those lamps.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni kum ni lu pam dunia zaa ni; ka di daa ti shiri niŋ pali Naa Klɔdius nam dibu saha.
en: One of them, Agabus, stood up and, inspired by the Spirit, predicted that a severe famine would overtake the entire Roman world.

dag: o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi ni o yaansi bɛn nyɛ bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa kuli Ijipti.
en: his sons, his grandsons, his daughters, and his granddaughters.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ jilima baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: But the land will be full of the knowledge of the LORDs glory, just as water covers the sea.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam nim zaa ni ti teei, ka ŋmaligi lab Yawɛ sanna, ka zuliya kam niriba zaa ni ti jɛm o.
en: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord . People all over the world will turn and worship you.

dag: Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl Jɛziriil tintariga, ka so ku sɔɣ o. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka anab maa daa yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi.
en: The dogs will eat Jezebel in the area of Jezreel, and she will not be buried. Then the young prophet opened the door and ran away.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba m-bala kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: and Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi.

dag: Amaa o yi yiɣisi ni o guui, o larila wɔribara min o wɔhu.
en: But when the ostrich gets up to run, she laughs at the horse and its rider, because she can run faster than any horse.

dag: Ka o yi zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, nyin zaŋm li yɛli cheechi, ka o yi kul zaɣisi cheechi gba yɛligu wumbu, nyin lihim o kaman chɛfira bee lampɔdeera.
en: If they refuse to listen to them, tell the church. And if they refuse to listen to the church, treat them as you would treat someone who does not know God or who is a tax collector.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn bahiri yoli.
en: People who watch their mouths guard their lives, but those who open their lips are ruined.

dag: Din gari shɛlikam nyɛla, kul yumiya taba ni yɛlimaŋli, dama yurilim limsiri taali balibu pam.
en: Above everything, love one another earnestly, because love covers over many sins.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba kɔbisiyi ni pisi bɛn yaannim daa nyɛ Naa Dauda min o kpambaliba ni daa pii shɛb zali ni bɛ sɔŋdi Lɛvinim la. Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ zaa yinoyino yuya sɔŋ.
en: In addition, there were two hundred twenty temple servants whom David and the princes had appointed to serve the Levites. These were all recorded by name.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya la daa ti bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ tiŋgbani maa yaɣ yini polo din nyɛ din bi galisi ti ti? Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni zuɣu, ti galisiya pam.
en: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛn yɛli Zɛdɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then Jeremiah answered Pashhur and Zephaniah. He said, Tell King Zedekiah.

dag: ni Uri bia Gɛba ŋun daa be Giliad din nyɛ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka zuɣulaan yino daa be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: Geber son of Uri was governor of Gilead. There had been two kings in this area, King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan, but Solomon appointed only one governor for that district.

dag: N ni bo zuɣulaannim bɛn ni guli ba, ka bɛ ku lan zɔri dabiɛm bee n-gbarigi bee ka bɛ ni so ti bɔrigi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will place new shepherds over my sheep. They will take care of my sheep, and my sheep will never again feel afraid. None of my sheep will be lost. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ka o neei tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa zuɣu ka yɛli teeku maa, Fom baalim! Ka sanʒiɛɣu maa daa chɛ ʒɛbu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: Jesus got up and ordered the wind and the waves to be quiet. The wind stopped, and everything was calm.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni a mali taali, pa mani n-yɛli. Amaŋmaŋ naŋgbampiba n-di shɛhira jɛnd a.
en: There is no need for me to condemn you; you are condemned by every word you speak.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, dabiɛm mini bɔɣa ni tɔna dola yi tooni, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what the Lord says: People of Moab, fear, deep holes, and traps wait for you.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ Ribɛka yiŋ dabipaɣ la daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o oki ti shɛli din daa be Bɛtɛl tiŋli la gbini. Ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Kumsi tia.
en: While they were there, Rebekah's personal servant Deborah died. They buried her under an oak tree and called it Weeping Oak.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba na ti zaani tooni, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Juda zuliya.
en: Early the next morning Joshua brought Israel forward, tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was picked out.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlli ŋɔ puuni, so miri ka o tum o kpee din bi tuhi bee ŋ-ŋar o kpee. Ti daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka na kul kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ni ti Duuma ni darigi bɛn tumdi din bi tuhi ŋɔ tatabo tibili.
en: No one should mistreat or take advantage of their brother or sister in this issue. The Lord punishes people for all these things, as we told you before and sternly warned you.

dag: dama omaŋmaŋ daa pun yɛli ni anabi ka jilima omaŋmaŋ ya.
en: For he himself had said, Prophets are not respected in their own country.

dag: Ka yi mini Shiiba daabihi ni Raama daabihi daa niŋdi daabiligu ni taba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi tulaale viɛla balibu kam mini kuɣ viɛla ni salima na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: Merchants from Sheba and Raamah gave you excellent spices, precious stones, and gold in exchange for your products.

dag: O daa kul kahigila dimbɔŋɔ gbinni zaa viɛnyɛliŋga wuhi ba. Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni.
en: Jesus told them everything that would happen. He did not keep anything secret. Peter took Jesus away from the other followers to talk to him alone. Peter criticized him for saying these things.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam ʒi bini maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches anything that has been under such a person will be unclean until evening. Anyone who carries such items must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Maika mabia Ishia bidibisi ni, Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Zechariah, a descendant of Uzziel through Isshiah, Micah's brother;.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Biligimiya kuɣili maa bahi! Ka Maata ŋun tizɔdoo daa kpi maa yɛl o, N Duuma, ŋ-ŋɔ o pooya, dama o ni kpi maa daba anahi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He said, Move the stone away. Martha said, But, Lord, it has been four days since Lazarus died. There will be a bad smell. Martha was the sister of the dead man.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni m-pun nyɛ n naa kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ; ka tumdi tiliginsim tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiri ya, N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be yomayoma ka pa Naawuni ŋun be katiŋ gba.
en: I am everywhere— both near and far.

dag: Bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili. Di bi simdi ni yi ti ba binshɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili.
en: As for their inheritance, I am their inheritance. They wont be given family property in Israel; I am their family property.

dag: Ka yiliŋ kam ti ŋari, ka zoya mini daboya zaa ti nahi taba, ka luɣ shɛlikam din golim ti tuhi, ka soli kam din be gbirimagbirima ti niŋ polipoli.
en: Every valley must be filled up, every hill and mountain leveled off. The winding roads must be made straight, and the rough paths made smooth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii tiŋ shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ Juda mini Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti.
en: These are the names of the cities from the territories of Judah and Simeon which were given.

dag: N ni daŋ wuhi ya yin ni zo so: Zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi ku daadam ka mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ o shia niŋ buɣim ni ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zomiy o.
en: I will show you the one to fear. You should fear God, who has the power to kill you and also to throw you into hell. Yes, he is the one you should fear.

dag: Wamiya waa paɣ o yuli. Ŋmɛmiya biŋkumda mini guŋgombihi ni mɔɣilɔnim ni chaɣisa paɣ o.
en: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.

dag: A yi saɣi ni n tim a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari, n kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari, m bi yɛn birigi nudirigu bee nuzaa polo.
en: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.

dag: Amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tuma maa daa lan pahi, ka o lan teeg o bilim saha o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla.
en: She became more of a prostitute than ever, acting the way she did as a young woman, when she was a prostitute in Egypt.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, man ni zo n-kuli. Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Zom kuli. Di saha ka Ahimaaz daa ŋmaligi guui n-zo n-doli bɔpiɛligu polo nti gari Kush nir maa zuɣu.
en: I dont care what happens, I want to go, Ahimaaz said. So Joab said to him, Run off then! Ahimaaz ran off, going by way of the plain, and passed the Cushite.

dag: Yi ni ti yi n-chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli, ka ti lab kuli ni suhudoo. Zoya mini kunkuna ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka mɔɣu ni tihi mi ti kpahi di nuhi.
en: So you will go out from there with joy. You will be led out in peace. When you come to the mountains and hills, they will begin singing. All the trees in the fields will clap their hands.

dag: Dama o nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bɛn kuhi bol o bahira; ka fari nandaamba mini bɛn ka bɛn sɔŋdi ba bahira.
en: Our king helps the poor who cry out to him— those in need who have no one to help them.

dag: Jɔn saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛn suhuri ye alizanda nam ni kpɛbu zuɣu kul kabirimi chani ni bɛ ti zaŋ kpiɔŋ kpe di ni.
en: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.

dag: Ka ʒiri mi ka bɛ ni so nol ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka galimi hal baabiɛla.
en: No lie came from their mouths; they are blameless.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ bɔhi, Zom ni tooi vo o zoon kpee ka bɛ zaa ti ku lula bɔɣili ni?.
en: Jesus also told them a riddle. A blind person cant lead another blind person, right? Wont they both fall into a ditch?.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ taali sanyoo sara piɛlaa maa mali sara Yawɛ tooni o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: The priest will make him pure by offering the ram as a guilt offering before the Lord . The offering is for the mans sins, which will then be forgiven.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila, ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni dawulɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka piɛbiri kikahi n-wari waa ni bɛ yaa zaa Naawuni tooni.
en: while David and all the people danced with all their might to honor God. They sang and played musical instruments—harps, drums, cymbals, and trumpets.

dag: Bɛn daa pun nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa bi leei maligumaaniba maa la pɔri zuɣu, amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun daa leei maligumaana la Naawuni ni daa po pɔri yɛl o: Ti Duuma ku lan taɣ o tɛha ka po, A nyɛla maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: but this priest was affirmed with a solemn pledge by the one who said, The Lord has made a solemn pledge and will not change his mind: You are a priest forever. .

dag: Ka Iso daa ŋmaligi kuli Ɛdom dindali maa.
en: So that day Esau started on his trip back to Seir.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-naan chɛ ka n suhu maai. Di biɛrim yi di be ka bo, n naan mali suhupiɛlli; dama m bi zaɣisi ŋun be Kasi ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: If I knew he would, I would leap for joy, no matter how great my pain. I know that God is holy; I have never opposed what he commands.

dag: A na mi n-kpe bɛ ni zaŋ saa ŋun noli maai pam zali du shɛŋa ni, bee a na mi n-nya bɛ ni zaŋ sakuɣa zali du shɛŋa ni.
en: Have you gone to snows storehouses, seen the storehouses of hail.
