dag: N ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-kun ya bɔhi biɛri alikauli la zuɣu. Ka yi yi ti zo n-kuli yi fɔntinsi ni, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ yi dimnim nuu ni.
en: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.

dag: ka yɛli, Ti nuhi ka doo ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni bee n-di di shɛhira.
en: They will then solemnly state: Our hands did not shed this blood. Our eyes did not see it happen.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Duuma; n ka bin sun shɛli pahila nyini.
en: I say to the LORD, You are my Lord. Apart from you, I have nothing good.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal tiŋgbani yi damda, ka zoya vuuri ti luri teeku kɔbulli ni;.
en: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.

dag: Yinim bɛn be alizanda ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o o jilima min o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord !.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa mini bɛ fiilinima ni sipuɣisinim ni bɛ kpiŋkpama ni kalima maa zaa daa malila nina ti tuui.
en: Their bodies, backs, hands, wings, and wheels were covered with eyes.

dag: Asa mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel were always at war.

dag: O ni daa yɛli bia maa yɛla shɛm maa daa chɛ ka di gar o ba min o ma pam.
en: The child's father and mother were amazed at the things Simeon said about him.

dag: Tiligim amaŋa kaman waliga ni tiligi tɔha nuu ni shɛm la bee kaman nooŋa ni tiligi noongbahira nuu ni shɛm la.
en: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum zoli maa ka n sanna nti guhiri nimaani, ka n zaŋ n ni sabi n zaligunim niŋ kuɣ parilan shɛŋa ni niriba maa wuhibu zuɣu la ti a.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Come to me on the mountain. I have written my teachings and laws on two stone tablets. These teachings and laws are for the people. I will give these stone tablets to you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali kam sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi dabisili kam sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini di binnyura sara.
en: This burnt offering is to be offered every Sabbath in addition to the daily offering with its wine offering.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-saɣim yimaŋa, dama n ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb ka chɛri palo tiri ya ŋɔ zaŋla dimbɔŋɔnim saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves.

dag: Doo yi tum zina ni o kpee paɣa, bɛn kum o mini paɣ maa zaa.
en: If a man commits adultery with the wife of an Israelite, both he and the woman shall be put to death.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Bɛnkam doli di soli mali baŋsim viɛlli. O paɣibu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Fear of the LORD is where wisdom begins; sure knowledge is for all who keep Gods laws. Gods praise lasts forever!.

dag: O ni ti zani n-dih o biŋkɔbbaligu Yawɛ yiko ni, ka ni ti zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima ni. Ka bɛ ti be ni alaafee, dama pumpɔŋɔ o ni nyɛla ninvuɣ titali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: When he comes, he will rule his people with the strength that comes from the Lord and with the majesty of the Lord God himself. His people will live in safety because people all over the earth will acknowledge his greatness.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya; di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus touched the man. He said, I want to heal you. Be healed! Immediately the man was healed from his leprosy.

dag: Naawuni daa ti tim tuun so ŋun yuli booni Jɔn na.
en: God sent his messenger, a man named John.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni na yɛli, Man ni yɔhim o.
en: Then a spirit went and stood before the Lord and said, I will fool him! The Lord asked, How will you do it.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Ziba, Ka a dan bia la lee be ya polo? Ka Ziba garigi yɛli naa, Nyama, o kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, dama o yɛlimi, Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ n yab nam ŋɔ ti ma. .
en: And where is Mephibosheth? David asked. Ziba answered, He stayed in Jerusalem, because he thinks the people of Israel want him to rule the kingdom of his grandfather Saul.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a tir a kpee zalige bee bɔzuɣu ka a ʒiɛmd a kpee? Dama ti zaa ni ti zani Naawuni tooni ka o kari ti saria.
en: But why do you judge your brother or sister? Or why do you look down on your brother or sister? We all will stand in front of the judgment seat of God.

dag: Kuɣ duli ŋɔ mini kuɣ shɛli din yɛn teeri ti ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira din wuhiri ni n ku yaɣ kuɣ duli maa zuɣu ka a sanna ti niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a gba ku yaɣ kuɣ duli maa zuɣu ka n sanna ti niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: This pile of rocks and this one special rock both help us to remember our agreement. I will never go past these rocks to fight against you, and you must never go on my side of these rocks to fight against me.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Yi dimnim ni kana nti teei gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ n-saɣim yi ni zaŋ binshɛŋa taɣi yimaŋa, ka ʒe yi nayiya nɛma maa.
en: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka bɛ zab Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi na maa.
en: He knew very well that the Jewish authorities had handed Jesus over to him because they were jealous.

dag: N nya Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti sokam ni o tum.
en: I have observed the task that God has given human beings.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka di niŋ a alahiziba? N ni yɛl a paɣ maa min o ni bar biŋkɔb so ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia maa daashili yɛla.
en: Then the angel said to me, Why are you amazed? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and the seven-headed, ten-horned beast that carries her.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wum lala ka yɛli, Kulla alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: When the Pharisees heard this, they said, He forces out demons by the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Di nyɛla ʒiri. M bi yɛn zo n-doli Babilɔnnim maa chaŋ. Amaa ka Irija daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum o yɛligu maa, ka gbaai Jɛrimia n-zaŋ o ti ti kpambaliba.
en: I answered, That's not so! I'm not deserting. But Irijah would not listen to me. Instead, he arrested me and took me to the officials.

dag: N vuhim shee m-bɔŋɔ sahakam; kpe ka n yɛn be, dama n yuri li.
en: You said, This is my home! I will live here forever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni nyu a biɛli pipi shɛli din yɛlima ka zilim la ni binnyurigu. Bɛ ni ti la a, ka mal a ansarisi, dama di puuni bini galisiya pam.
en: I, the Lord God, gave your sister a large, deep cup filled with my anger. And when you drink from that cup, you will be mocked and insulted.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa zaŋ o tahi sapashin kpɛm maa sani ti yɛl o, Dansarika so ŋun yuli booni Pool la m-boli ma nti yɛli ma ni n zaŋ nachimbil ŋɔ tahi a sanna ni o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl a.
en: The officer took him, led him to the commander, and said, The prisoner Paul called me and asked me to bring this young man to you, because he has something to say to you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛl do so mini Midian paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Zimiri. O daa nyɛla Salu bia, ka lan nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya niriba dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The name of the slain Israelite man who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri the son of Salu, chief of Simeons household.

dag: Di saha Ɛli daa kurigiya pam ka wumd o bihi maa ni niŋdi Izraɛlnim shɛm maa zaa, hal ka mali paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni la doona.
en: Eli was very old, but he heard everything his sons were doing to the Israelites, and how they had sex with the women who served at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim paai Nɛbonima, di zani dabari. Kiriataimnim di vi, bɛ ŋme n-deei li. Bɛ daai di goondaa luhi n-dihi ba vi.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me to say to the nation of Moab: The town of Nebo is doomed; Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced, and even its fortress will be left in ruins.

dag: Zaŋmi nam mini tibiginsim ye kaman salima nɛma la, ka zaŋ nam dariza mini yaa ye kaman situra la.
en: If so, stand up in your honor and pride; clothe yourself with majesty and glory.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani gindi pihiri li na nti niɛmdi li nɛya zuɣu bee n-zaŋ li niŋdi toya ni tɔra, ka zaŋdi li niŋdi duɣuri ni duɣira, ka mal li maani maha; ka di nyaɣisim ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ kpam mali mahi shɛŋa.
en: The people gathered the manna. Then they used rocks to crush it and cooked it in a pot. Or they ground it into flour and made thin cakes with it. The cakes tasted like sweet cakes cooked with olive oil.

dag: Yaa n Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa, ka tumdi din tuhi a sani shɛm la yɛla. Ka Hɛzɛkia daa kum pam.
en: Remember, Lord , that I have served you faithfully and loyally and that I have always tried to do what you wanted me to. And he began to cry bitterly.

dag: Dama bɛ dɔɣi bia ti ti, bɛ ti ti bidibiga; o nyɛla ŋun su fukumsi; ka o yuli ni ti booni, Alahiziba mini Saɣisira ni Kpiɔŋlan Naawuni ni Saha din ka bahigu Ba ni Suhudoo Nabia.
en: A child is born to us! A son is given to us! And he will be our ruler. He will be called, Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Eternal Father, Prince of Peace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa daa laɣimna.
en: Those who arrested Jesus led him to the house of the high priest. All the leading priests, the older Jewish leaders, and the teachers of the law were gathered there.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni bitali maa mi bi yila ninsalinim ni dɔɣi ba la ni na bee n-yi ninsalinim yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni yubu ni ka di yina.
en: They did not become God's children by natural means, that is, by being born as the children of a human father; God himself was their Father.

dag: Zaligu tanzaa yi wurim, wula ka wuntizɔra yɛn niŋ?.
en: There is nothing a good person can do when everything falls apart.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa deeg o yɛligu maa deei kom baptaizibu pahi yɛdaniŋdib maa zuɣu dindali maa. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaata laasabu.
en: Then those who accepted what Peter said were baptized. On that day about people were added to the group of believers.

dag: N ni na be yi sani ŋɔ ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: I have told you these things while I am still with you.

dag: Amaa Naawuni chɛ ka o Shia Kasi kahigi li wuhi tinima; dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri binshɛɣukam hal zaŋ tabili Naawuni yɛla din gbinni zilima.
en: But it was to us that God made known his secret by means of his Spirit. The Spirit searches everything, even the hidden depths of God's purposes.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ m mini nanim ni dunia saawaranima, bɛn daa lan lab me tin shɛŋa din wurim zaa ti bɛmaŋ la.
en: with kings and earths advisors, who rebuild ruins for themselves.

dag: O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba, ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku noli la yiŋa.
en: He is staying with someone also named Simon, a leatherworker who has a house beside the sea.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piri tɔbbihi maa ʒii buta zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Jɔab su yim zuɣu, ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab tizo la su yim zuɣu, ka Itai Gaat nir la mi daa su bɛn kpalim la. Ka naa daa yɛli niriba maa, Mmaŋmaŋ gba ni yina pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: He separated the people into three groups and sent them out. Joab led a third of the men. Joabs brother, Abishai son of Zeruiah, led another third. And Ittai from Gath led the last third. King David said to the people, I will also go with you.

dag: Yuun pinaanahi nyaaŋa ka m mini Baanabas daa yɛn chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka n daa zaŋ Taitus m-pahi ka ti chaŋ.
en: After years I went back to Jerusalem with Barnabas and took Titus with me.

dag: Kulla dindali maa yuŋ ka bɛ daa ku Bɛlishaaza ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim naa maa.
en: That same night, the king was killed.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma ayopɔin goli dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa gbibi Dauda biŋkumda la, ka maligumaaniba mi daa gbibi kikahi.
en: instruments like those that King David had used. The priests also stood there with trumpets.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul bela luɣilikam, ka o yuuni ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma.
en: The Lord sees what happens everywhere. He watches everyone, good and evil.

dag: Tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa be nimaani, ka daba nya bɛmaŋ bɛ duumanim sani.
en: where captives and slaves are free at last.

dag: Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni?.
en: How can we sing a song to the Lord in a foreign land?.

dag: O daa yɛliya: Yawɛ daa yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na, ka yi Siɛr ka ti sanna; o daa yi Paran Zoli zuɣu n-niŋ neesim bahi ti na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi tuhi pia be o sani; ka omaŋmaŋ dini din galisi be o nudirigu polo.
en: The Lord came from Sinai, like a light shining at dawn over Seir, like a light shining from Mount Paran. He came with , holy ones. Gods mighty soldiers were by his side.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisi dali ka sagbani maa daa vuui alikauli biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa.
en: On the th day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites left Egypt, the cloud rose from above the Tent of the Agreement.

dag: Birapu tibu ŋmanila tim bɛn tiri li sani, bɛ yi kul chaŋ luɣilikam bɛ dirila nasara.
en: Some people think a bribe is like a lucky charm—it seems to work wherever they go.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim la kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: Then the priests carried the Covenant Box of the Lord into the Temple and put it in the Most Holy Place, beneath the winged creatures.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka n ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri.
en: and shouted, Come on! When I'm finished with you, I'll feed you to the birds and wild animals.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti ninvuɣ shɛba yi ninni, ka yi yuli ba soli ka yi nina ti fulim dindali maa zaa, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: Other people will be allowed to take your sons and your daughters. Day after day you will look for your children. You will look for them until your eyes become weak and blind—but you will not find them. And God will not help you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Asa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa pa omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti va kuɣ shɛŋa mini dakuɣ shɛŋa Naa Baasha ni daa mali mɛri Rama maa zaa n-chaŋ ti me Gɛba mini Mizipa.
en: Then King Asa had all Judah carry away the stone and timber that Baasha was using to build Ramah, and King Asa used it to build Geba and Mizpah.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n niŋ ya yiko din ni chɛ ka yi no tinvura mini nɔnsi, ka lan pahi ya yiko din ni tooi nyaŋ yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani ŋɔ min o nyaaŋa zaa; ka binshɛɣu ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: He is the enemy, but know that I have given you more power than he has. I have given you power to crush his snakes and scorpions under your feet. Nothing will hurt you.

dag: Wuntizɔriba zoorimi kaman abie tia la, ka zoori kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tia la.
en: Good people are like budding palm trees. They grow strong like the cedar trees of Lebanon.

dag: Yi yi du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zuɣu, wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari n dan sapashinnim ni ŋun pɔri gba.
en: How will you drive back even the least important official among my masters servants when you are relying on Egypt for chariots and riders?.

dag: Dama o zaɣisila Naawuni m-pah o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O bela ti sani m-maani Naawuni ansarisi, ka yɛr o zilima pahira.
en: He adds rebellion to his other sins. He sits there insulting us and arguing with God.

dag: N wum anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli ŋmari ʒiri yɛra, N zahimla zahindi, n zahimla zahindi.
en: I know what those prophets have said who speak lies in my name and claim that I have given them my messages in their dreams.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa fan ya bahi, dinzuɣu ka n zaani ya zaligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Remember how each of you was a slave in Egypt and how the LORD your God saved you. Thats why I am commanding you to do this right now. .

dag: Yawɛ soya zaa nyɛla yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali soya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib o daalikauli min o zaligunim sani.
en: All the LORDs paths are loving and faithful for those who keep his covenant and laws.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul gbaani ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mi nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ tooni.
en: I kneel in prayer to the Father.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. O chɛ ka o neesim paai ti. Ŋahimiya tihi vari ka ti di chuɣu puhibu dari n-chaŋ ti gili sara maligu bimbini.
en: The Lord is God, and he accepts us. Tie up the lamb for the sacrifice and carry it to the horns of the altar.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Smɛɛna Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu ka nyɛ ŋun daa kpi ka lan nee la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: This is the message from the one who is the first and the last, who died and lived again.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ka Yawɛ zali ya ni yi niŋ, ka ŋun Yawɛ jilima yi zahira yi sani.
en: Moses said, The LORD has ordered you to do this so that the LORDs glorious presence will appear to you.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka Naa Jɔash mini niriba lo Yawɛ alikauli ni bɛ ni nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ niriba; ka lan chɛ ka niriba maa mini naa gba lo tab alikauli.
en: The priest Jehoiada had King Joash and the people make a covenant with the Lord that they would be the Lord 's people; he also made a covenant between the king and the people.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka alɔbo din daa lu Ijiptinim zuɣu la tatabo lu yi zuɣu; ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi nachimba; ka gbahi yi yuri zaa chaŋ; ka chɛ ka yi sansan ni nyo luɣiluɣi kpɛri ya; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛ kurili, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni. O di lan zaŋ o niŋ duu yaha, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: it is a chronic skin disease. The priest shall pronounce you unclean; there is no need to isolate you, because you are obviously unclean.

dag: O yi je suli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? O suhi yi yiɣisi pam, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi beni? O suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka tampima wurind o zuɣu.
en: No one can stand against his great anger. No one can endure his terrible anger. His anger will burn like fire. The rocks will shatter when he comes.

dag: A ni daa gbibi duŋ kurugu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku Izraɛlnima saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nya yɛlibiɛɣu bɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa ni la zuɣu.
en: Because you nursed an ancient grudge, you handed the Israelites over to the sword in the time of their distress, during their final punishment.

dag: Yi yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligunima, ka dol o soli, ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn be kasi kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: If you follow the Lord your God and obey his commands, he will do what he promised. The Lord will make you his own special people.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Sandihir so n-daa be m-mal o sandaannima ayi; yino daa di o samli ka di paai tumtumda yuma ayi tuma yɔri, ka ŋun la mi di o samli ka di paai tumtumda chira ayi tuma yɔri.
en: Jesus said, There were two men. Both men owed money to the same banker. One man owed him silver coins. The other man owed him silver coins.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yiri muɣisigu ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn lee kpɛri di ni.
en: Good people escape from trouble, but the wicked come along and are trapped by it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guui li zali hal ni asiba kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka di daa bi saɣim bee n-wɔɣi zunzuya.
en: The people obeyed, and the next morning the food smelled fine and had no worms.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Yawɛ tooni na.
en: So Moses asked the Lord what he should do.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu; ka chɛ ka n nuhi mali yaa din ni tooi zaŋ daanya tɔb to.
en: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zaliya ni Jɔram kaabu maa n-yɛn nyɛ Ahazia bahigu. Dama o ni daa yi nimaani ka o mini Jɔram doli tab chana, ka bɛ daa chirigi Nimshi bia Jɛhu, Yawɛ ni daa zali so ni o kum Ɛhab daŋ ni niriba zaa la.
en: God used this visit to Joram to bring about Ahaziah's downfall. While Ahaziah was there, he and Joram were confronted by a man named Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had chosen to destroy the dynasty of Ahab.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa daŋ yibu asiba n-labi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ Jɛziriil.
en: David and his men got up early in the morning and headed back toward Philistia, while the Philistines left for Jezreel.

dag: Ka biisim ti kpe li ka di nyɛligi. Tulim yi ti kana, a ku lan nya li di biɛhigu maa shee.
en: but that stop flowing in dry times and vanish from their channels in heat.

dag: Binzusa maa yi be yi sani, yi ni lihiri li ka teeri Yawɛ zaligunim yɛla ka dol li, ka ku doli yi suhuyubu ni yi nini ni tiɣi shɛli.
en: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.

dag: Yinim bɛn kpiri kum pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti tiɣi. Yinim bɛn kumdi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti la.
en: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ chamiya ti bom mɔri yi n-ni nya li luɣ shɛli na, amaa yi tuma bi yɛn filim hal biɛla gba. .
en: He says that you must go and get it for yourselves wherever you can find it, but you must still make the same number of bricks.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya o ka baŋ ni o dɔni nimaani yuui maa ka o bɔh o, A bɔri ni a nya alaafee.
en: Jesus saw him lying there and knew that he had been sick for a very long time. So he asked him, Do you want to be well.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaai Sool zuɣu, ka yeeg o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, ka bahi bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa m-moli lahibali suŋ maa ti bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: They cut off Saul's head, stripped off his armor, and sent messengers with them throughout Philistia to tell the good news to their idols and to their people.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl. Kɔhat daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaata dunia yili.
en: Kohath lived to be ; his sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa boli dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi maa ni niriba, ka nyɛ o ni daa pun pii shɛb zuliya yini kam ni la na.
en: Then Joshua called the twelve men he had chosen.

dag: Ka zoomba ayi daa ʒi sokpaŋa ka ti wum ni Yisa n-gariti maa, ka bɛ kuhi yɛli, Ti Dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, Lord and Son of David, have pity on us.

dag: N suhir a, deemi n ni zaŋ pin shɛl na ti ti a maa, dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma nirilim ti ma n ni mali shɛlikam maa, ka m mi mali pam. Lala ka Yaakubu daa balim o hal ka o ti dee li.
en: Please accept this gift which I have brought for you; God has been kind to me and given me everything I need. Jacob kept on urging him until he accepted.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be muɣisigu ni mini sama ni daa doli shɛba ni bɛnkam nini daa bi lan tiɣi bɛ biɛhigu zaa daa zo n-chaŋ o sani ka o ti leei bɛ zuɣulana. Ka bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi.
en: Everyone who was in trouble, in debt, or in desperate circumstances gathered around David, and he became their leader. Approximately four hundred men joined him.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti mabia Apolɔs polo, m balim o pam ni o pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu ka yi sanna, ka o bi yu ni o ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ; amaa o yi ti nya dahima o ni bahi kana.
en: Concerning Apollos our brother: I strongly encouraged him to visit you with the brothers and sisters, but he didnt want to go now. Hell come when he has an opportunity.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa, ka di bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔb sabila ka di ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi ninvuɣ so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl anabinim yino ni o yɛlim o kpee, Ŋmɛm ma. Amaa ka o kpee maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku ŋme o.
en: At the Lord 's command a member of a group of prophets ordered a fellow prophet to hit him. But he refused.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim ayi la noya gɔhi bintaɣindisi la. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la tooni.
en: and fastened the other two ends of the cords to the two settings and in this way attached them in front to the shoulder straps of the ephod.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti yi mabihi maa vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo ba alikauli shɛm la, dinzuɣu labimiya kuli yi biɛhigu shee din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli polo, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun zaŋ luɣ shɛli tin ya la.
en: The LORD your God has now given rest to your fellow Israelites, exactly as he promised them. So turn around and go back home. Go to the land where you hold property, which Moses the LORDs servant gave you on the other side of the Jordan.

dag: Yi bi mi ni tizɔbo ni, tizɔriba zaa yi kul zɔra, ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko nti yɛn zo n-di? Dinzuɣu zomiya viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zo n-di.
en: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!.

dag: A zaŋ sagbani lims amaŋa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti suhigu bi lan paar a.
en: You wrapped yourself up in a cloud; prayers cant make it through!.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun daa lo ti nyɛvili shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni alikauli la yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: Greetings from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. I am an apostle because God wanted me to be. God sent me to tell people about the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus.

dag: dama yi ni kariti tab saria shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti kari yi gba saria, ka yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti buɣisi ti yi gba.
en: If you judge others, you will be judged the same way you judge them. God will treat you the same way you treat others.

dag: kpamba pisinaanahi maa gbaanila ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ka ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni la tooni m-piligi bɛ nam zuɣupila n-sɔŋ nam ʒiishee maa tooni, ka jɛmd o, ka yiini yila yɛra.
en: the twenty-four elders fall down before the one who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever. They throw their crowns down in front of the throne and say.

dag: Tinzunnim yi be zuliya shɛb sani, yin tim ba bɛ tarili nimaani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All foreign residents will receive their share with the people of the tribe among whom they are living. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim ni di saha ti paai ka yi teei ni n daa pun yɛli ya di yɛla. N daa bi pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnima piligu ni, ka di nyɛla n ni daa na be yi san la zuɣu.
en: But I have said these things to you so that when their time comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I didnt say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nabia la leei Sulemaana dima n-yiɣisi lu o zuɣu.
en: So the Lord caused Hadad, of the royal family of Edom, to turn against Solomon.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni kpihim ŋahali maa ka bɛ ku lan ŋahi li Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Amaa yɛlim ba ni dabisa maa miriya, ka ʒii kam ni niŋ pali.
en: Tell the people that the Lord GOD will end that saying. They will not say that about Israel anymore. Now they will quote this saying: Trouble will come soon; what is seen in visions will happen.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim kpiya dola bɛmaŋmaŋ gbala ni ni jilima;.
en: All the kings of the earth lie in their magnificent tombs.

dag: Bɛ laɣiŋgu maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka Yɛhudianim mini niriba pam bɛn daa doli Yɛhudianim daadiini soli kabiri doli Pool mini Baanabas. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ni bɛ kul kpalimmi be Naawuni daanfaani ni.
en: After the people had left the meeting, Paul and Barnabas were followed by many Jews and by many Gentiles who had been converted to Judaism. The apostles spoke to them and encouraged them to keep on living in the grace of God.

dag: Bɛ nina ni lihibu di ba shɛhira; bɛ tum alahichi palɔni ka bi sɔɣiri li kaman Sɔdomnima. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Dama bɛ bo yɛl biɛɣu ti bɛmaŋa.
en: Their bias in judgment gives them away; like Sodom, they display their sins in public. Doom to them, for they have done themselves in!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Din ku tooi nani ninsalinim sani nyɛla din ni tooi nani Naawuni ŋun sani.
en: Jesus replied, There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.

dag: Amaa ti bɔri ni ti bahi wum din be a sani, dama ti mi ni adiini so shɛli a ni doli ŋɔ, niriba kul tɔɣisiri galindi li mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.

dag: Amɔn ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The other things that Amon did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tikpiralan so ŋun tɔri birilim ka o sanna nti suh o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly speak, and they begged him to place his hand on the man for healing.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka bi deei li, ka niŋ tipawumli bɛ ni daa lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu, ka bɛ daa dolila bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm, ka lihirila bɛ nyaaŋa, ka bi lihiri bɛ tooni.
en: But they did not obey or pay any attention. Instead, they did whatever their stubborn and evil hearts told them to do, and they became worse instead of better.

dag: Lala ni daa niŋ maa ka nimaani ŋunkam mali dɔro ka Pool sanna ti nya bɛ dɔriti maa tib kpaŋ.
en: After this happened, all the other sick people on the island came to Paul, and he healed them too.

dag: Yɛlim bɛnkam suhuri zɔhiri la, Maliya kpiɔŋ ka di zɔriya dabiɛm! Yi Naawuni maa yɛn kamina ti bɔhi yi dimnim biɛri tin ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti nyɛla juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka so ti ku kari ba.
en: The corpses of this people will be food for birds and wild animals, with no one to drive them off.

dag: Amaa pin kasi shɛŋa din yi yi sanna mini yi ni po pɔri ni yi zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti dina, zaŋmiya li chaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli maa.
en: If you decide to give something special to God, you must go to the special place that the Lord your God will choose. And if you make a special promise, you must go to that place to give that gift to God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, So beni m-me yili palli ka na bi suhi Naawuni ka kpe di ni? O labimi kul o yili maa ni, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so ti suhi Naawuni ka kpe o yili maa ni.
en: Then the officers will address the men and say, Is there any man here who has just built a house, but has not yet dedicated it? If so, he is to go home. Otherwise, if he is killed in battle, someone else will dedicate his house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shini ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama naa daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ti Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ so ka o fa ba Sirianim maa nuu ni bahi; ka Izraɛlnim daa lan ʒi bɛ yinsi ni suhudoo kaman bɛ ni daa pun ʒiya shɛm.
en: The Lord sent Israel a leader, who freed them from the Syrians, and so the Israelites lived in peace, as before.

dag: N dabisa ŋmanila zaawuni shilinshia; n kuumi kaman mɔri la.
en: My days are like a shadow soon gone. Im dried up like dead grass.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali bɛ ni yɛn nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: Bezalel built an altar of acacia wood for offering sacrifices. It was . meters square and . meters high.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti zaŋ o tɔbbihi maa lu bɛ zuɣu. Dauda ni daa piɛl o tɔbbihi bahi Sirianim maa zuɣu maa, ka bɛ min o daa gbaai tab tuhibu.
en: David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops. Soon after the fighting began.

dag: Ka sapashin kpamba maa yi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa maa naai, sapashinnim bɛn leemi bɛn su tɔbbihi maa fukumsi.
en: Once the officials have completed their speech to the troops, the army commanders will assume leadership of the forces.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, man mini m mabihi ni n tumtumdiba zaŋla ti liɣiri mini chi m-paŋ ba. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chɛ ti ni bɔri ni bɛ labisi nyɔri shɛli n-yo ti la ti ba.
en: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.

dag: Amaa ŋun pa piɛgula ka mi bi su piɛri ka nyɛla bɛ ni bu so paa ka o guli ba yi ti nya kunduŋ ka o kanna, o chɛrila piɛri maa bahi ka zo, ka kunduŋ maa gbahi piɛri maa ni shɛba, ka wurim bɛn kpalim bahi.
en: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.

dag: Ka di buɣisibu chɛriga ni ti yi nyaaŋa chaŋ katiŋa n-tuhi hal ni Garɛb daboli gbini, di nyaaŋa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ Gɔa.
en: Its boundaries will extend to the Gareb Hill and around to Goah.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni la, n daa lo ba alikauli yɛli.
en: This is what the Lord , the God of the people of Israel, says: I brought your ancestors out of the land of Egypt, where they were slaves. When I did that, I made an agreement with them.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so ka o ku tooi nyaŋ o daɣiri ni yibu sara maligu zaligu m-bala.
en: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi, ka ti Duuma dabisi titali din mali jilima pam la naanyi kana.
en: The sun will be changed into darkness, and the moon will be as red as blood. Then the great and glorious day of the Lord will come.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, N ni be Hanun Nahash bia ŋɔ yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu kaman o ba ni daa be ma yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi Nahash kuli maa ti o. Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa ti paai Ammɔnnim maa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: David said, Nahash was kind to me, and I will be kind to his son. So he sent some officials to the country of Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died.

dag: Ka di pala Adam ka Sintani daa yɔhim, amaa Awa ka o daa yɔhim ka o leei ŋun saɣim Naawuni zaligu.
en: Also, Adam was not the one who was tricked. It was the woman who was tricked and became a sinner.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua maa daa boli maligumaaniba na nti yɛli ba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka la, ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests together and said to them, Carry the Holy Box of the Lord . Tell seven priests to carry the trumpets and march in front of it.

dag: Ka di ʒiɛmani maa niriba zaa gba daa ti kpi. Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din paya niriba daa yiɣisina. Bɛn daa bi mi Yawɛ bee m-mi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: After that whole generation died, the next generation grew up. This new generation did not know about the Lord or what he had done for the Israelites.

dag: Ka bipuɣimbil maa daa ti yɛli Naaman paɣa, N di bi zaɣisi ka n dana chaŋ anab so ŋun be Samaria ŋɔ sani! O naan tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Some time later the girl said, If your husband Naaman would go to the prophet in Samaria, he would be cured of his leprosy.

dag: Dinzuɣu a biɛhigu daa be di ko ka chɛ paɣ shɛb dini a pagɔrisigu tuma maa ni. Pa so m-puh a ni a tummi pagɔrisigu tuma. Pa bɛna n-daa yɔr a, amaa nyini n-daa lee yɔri ba, a biɛhigu daa shiri be di ko.
en: As a prostitute, you were more perverse than other women. No one approached you for sexual favors, but you yourself gave gifts instead of receiving them. You are perversion itself!.

dag: N nyɛla sana m-be yi sani, timiya ma luɣ shɛli ka n zaŋ li leei n kpiimba sɔɣibu shee n-zaŋ n kpim ŋɔ ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: I am an immigrant and a temporary resident with you. Give me some property for a burial plot among you so that I can bury my deceased wife near me.

dag: O gbib o yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga; o pala vinnyaɣilana.
en: She oversees the care of her house. She is never lazy.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa ti so yuli Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Jeemsi mini Jɔn ni Filip mini Baatolomiu.
en: Simon, whom he named Peter; his brother Andrew; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee kpalim n-nyɛ ŋun nini daa nya n jɛmbu du kurili la jilima ni daa be shɛm? Yi ni nya jɛmbu du dini ŋɔ maa, wula ka di lee be yi sani? Di pa shɛli di bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: How many of you people look at this Temple and try to compare it to the beautiful Temple that was destroyed? What do you think? Does this Temple seem like nothing when you compare it with the first Temple?.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa wum bɛ wuhibu maa niŋ yɛda. Dɔbba kɔŋko daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu laasabu.
en: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about , followers of the Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ʒeei gom, ka sanʒiɛɣu ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni n-ʒiɛri kom niŋdi bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka di ti yɛn tum ba barina.
en: While they were sailing, he fell asleep. Gale-force winds swept down on the lake. The boat was filling up with water and they were in danger.

dag: Ti mabihi maa daa zaŋla Piɛbil la ʒim mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu n-nyaŋ o, dama bɛ daa bi zaɣisi kum di puuni.
en: Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu.
en: Then God said to Noah.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga kpamba fomi ʒi tiŋgban ni. Bɛ kɔrila taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka so buri. Jɛrusalɛm paɣisara zaŋla bɛ zuɣuri fi tiŋa.
en: Daughter Zions elders sit on the ground and mourn. They throw dust on their heads; they put on mourning clothes. Jerusalems young women bow their heads all the way to the ground.

dag: N yi ti ŋari zuɣusaa kɔsoya ka saa bi lan mira bee toli yi ti ŋubiri yi bimbilima bee n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu n niriba maa zuɣu.
en: When I close the sky so that there is no rain, or command the locusts to destroy the land, or send sicknesses to my people.

dag: Ka yɛdaniŋdib bɛn daa be Bɛria daa dii chɛ ka Pool chaŋ teeku noli, amaa ka Silas mini Timoti bɛn daa kpalim nimaani.
en: The brothers and sisters sent Paul away to the seacoast at once, but Silas and Timothy remained at Beroea.

dag: Ka Pita daa lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam n-saɣisiri ba yɛra, Tiligimiya yimaŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Peter warned them with many other words; he begged them, Save yourselves from the evil of the people who live now.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha ka Asa daa leei Juda naa.
en: In the twentieth year of Israels King Jeroboam, Asa became king of Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, baŋmi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali taali, dama a nyɛla yɛndana; a mi a ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm chɛ ka o zuɣu piɛlli maa kpe gballi ni ni ʒim.
en: But you dont need to excuse him. You are wise and know what to do to him. Give him a violent death.

dag: Bɛ no n-taai nandaamba niŋ taŋkpaɣu ni, ka daai bɛn diri wahala bahi, ka doo min o ba laɣindi mali dabipaɣ yino. Lala ka bɛ niŋ saɣim n yuli din be kasi la.
en: They pushed their faces into the ground and walked on them. They stopped listening to suffering people. Fathers and sons had sexual relations with the same woman. They ruined my holy name.

dag: Man a dabili ŋɔ kul ni dolila nyini naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ n-chaŋ biɛla ha. Bɔzuɣu ka nyini naa ti yɛn yo ma san titali ŋɔ?.
en: I dont need any of the things that you want to give me. I will cross the Jordan River with you.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai tiŋkpan shɛli, ka paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maata zaŋ o ti kpɛh o yiŋa.
en: As Jesus and his disciples went on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha welcomed him in her home.

dag: Ka yi daa ti nya ka Nahash Ammɔnnim naa la daa lo tɔb kana ni o ti tuhi ya, ka yi yɛli ma, Aai, ti bɔri ni naa n-su ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ yi naa di saha maa.
en: Then you saw that King Nahash of Ammon was going to attack you. And even though the Lord your God is your king, you told me, This time it's different. We want a king to rule us.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya sochanda ka o ʒi tiŋ maa sokpaŋa; ka ninkurigu maa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Bee ya ka a lee chana.
en: The old man saw the traveler in the public square and asked, Where are you going? Where did you come from.

dag: Yi yi ti tuui ŋɔri yi bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli yin zaŋmiya di bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini ti pini kaman yi ni zaŋdi kabɔɣili ni chi tiri pini shɛm la.
en: You will gather grain and grind it into flour to make dough for bread. You must give the first bread from that flour as a gift to the Lord. It will be like the grain offering that comes from the threshing floor.

dag: Yisifu ni daa sɔɣ o ba maa nyaaŋa, ka o min o biɛyanim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa dol o chaŋ sɔɣibu maa shee maa daa lan lab Ijipti.
en: Then Joseph returned to Egypt, he, his brothers, and everyone who left with him to bury his father.

dag: Ka di tintariga daa ŋmaligi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtidagɔn m-mali hal ti paai Zɛbulɔn mini Ifitahɛl Vinvamli din be Bɛtimɛk mini Nɛyɛl soli nuzaa polo la, ka kul zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo maa hal ti paai Kabul.
en: Then the border turned to the east. It went to Beth Dagon. The border touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El. Then it went north of Beth Emek and Neiel. It passed north of Cabul.

dag: Zɛra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zimiri mini Ɛtan ni Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Dara, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn zaa be bɛ tiŋ maa ni laɣim yi n-kari doli Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi maa. Bɛ ni daa kariti doli Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ainim maa n-yi kpaŋ ka chɛ bɛ tin maa.
en: The people in the city began to shout and started to chase them. All the people left the city.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛl o dinkam niŋ o mini Haman ni daa yɛli ni o ni yo laɣ shɛli tariga ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ naa kpanjɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ ku Yɛhudianim zaa la yɛla.
en: Then Mordecai told Hathach everything that had happened to him. Mordecai told him about the exact amount of money Haman had promised to put into the kings treasury for killing Jews.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, Napaɣ Ɛsta, wula? Bɔ ka a bɔra? N ni ti a a ni bɔri shɛli maa, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: the king said, Esther, what brings you here? Just ask, and I will give you as much as half of my kingdom.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛra zaani zaashe kara ni, ka zaŋdi bundaannim zaani tarimba zaashee.
en: Fools are appointed to high posts, while the rich sit in lowly positions.

dag: Bin biɛri balibu kam ŋɔ zaa yirila ninsal suhu ni na, ka nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: All these evil things come from the inside and contaminate a person in Gods sight.

dag: Bɔhim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba maa mini maligumaaniba maa, Yi ni daa lɔri noli, ka fabindi gol so ŋun pah anu ni mini gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin ni zaŋ ti paai yuun pisopɔin la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi lala tiri maa?.
en: He said, Tell the people of the land and the priests that when they fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months during these seventy years, it was not in honor of me.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, N ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm na nti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu suhiri Naawuni saha shɛli.
en: After this I returned to Jerusalem and went to the temple to pray. There I had a vision.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Masia be yi suhuri ni yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi ba nyaɣa zani ka me yimaŋ tam yurilim zuɣu.
en: I pray that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. I pray that your life will be strong in love and be built on love.

dag: Yawɛ, a wumdi n suhigu asiba; asiba ka n suhir a, ka guhira.
en: Every morning, Lord , I lay my gifts before you and look to you for help. And every morning you hear my prayers.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm; salima tuumbaŋdib zaa buɣa dihi ba vi, dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binyara ka bi vuhira.
en: Everyone is too foolish to understand; every goldsmith is dishonored by his idols, for their images are shams; they arent alive.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nira, ka nyɛ namɔɣili be nayil la daa wum ni bɛ zaŋ Jɛrimia ti niŋ kɔbiliga maa puuni. Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka naa ʒi Bɛnjamin dunɔdal la gbini.
en: However, Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch who worked in the royal palace, heard that they had put me in the well. At that time the king was holding court at the Benjamin Gate.

dag: Dama a daba yuri di kuɣa pam, bɛ zɔri di taŋkpaɣu nambɔɣu.
en: Your servants love her, even though she is destroyed; they have pity on her, even though she is in ruins.

dag: A mi dunia ŋɔ yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm? A yi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa, nyin yɛlim ma!.
en: Have you surveyed earths expanses? Tell me if you know everything about it.

dag: Farisii maa daa kaɣimi ʒe o kɔŋko ha suhiri Naawuni yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, m paɣir a pam n ni bi be kaman ninvuɣ fariba bee zalinsi diriba bee zinaniŋdiba bee farigudeera ŋun ʒiɛya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Pharisee stood and prayed about himself with these words, God, I thank you that Im not like everyone else—crooks, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.

dag: dindina n ni chɛ ka a ʒi Izraɛl nam ʒiishee sahakam kaman n ni daa pun lo a ba Dauda alikauli yɛli, N kul ku chɛ ka ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kɔŋ o zuliya ni.
en: If you do, I will make sure that your family will always rule Israel, just as I promised your father David when I told him that Israel would always be ruled by one of his descendants.

dag: So ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili m-me dikili gɔŋbu shee, ka so mi ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili me tanzaa. A yɛn kpalimla dabari doya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will never remove a cornerstone or a foundation stone from you. You will be a wasteland forever, declares the LORD.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Nazarɛt bɛ ni daa wubis o tin shɛl ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la. Ka o daa ti yiɣisi zani ni o karim.
en: Jesus traveled to Nazareth, the town where he grew up. On the Sabbath day he went to the synagogue as he always did. He stood up to read.

dag: Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ni ti tarigi n-kpalim zani Hɛshibɔn, dama buɣim yi Hɛshibɔn na ka buɣim niɛm yi naa Sihɔn yiŋ na. Di di Mɔabnim ninvuɣ zuɣuri, ka di duŋtaariba zuɣuŋmana.
en: Helpless refugees try to find protection in Heshbon, the city that King Sihon once ruled, but it is in flames. Fire has burned up the frontiers and the mountain heights of the war-loving people of Moab.

dag: Ka kpamba maa daa yih o o ni daa be chɛchɛbun shɛli ni maa n-zaŋ o niŋ o chɛchɛbun shɛli din daa pahir ayi ni n-zaŋ o kuli Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni. Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kum o kuli.
en: They carried Josiah out of his chariot, then put him in the other chariot he had there and took him back to Jerusalem, where he soon died. He was buried beside his ancestors, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem mourned his death.

dag: Hal yi daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, Sinai Zoli gbini, ka o daa je suli n- yɛn kun ya.
en: Even at Mount Sinai you made the Lord angry—angry enough to destroy you.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn mali wumpaɣibo sara ti man Yawɛ, yin malimiya li din ni chɛ ka n deei li yi sani.
en: When you sacrifice a communal sacrifice of thanksgiving for the LORD, you must sacrifice it so that it will be acceptable on your behalf.

dag: Ka o daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, du shɛli yɛla Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la.
en: He built pagan altars in the Temple, the place that the Lord had said was where he should be worshiped.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-chɛ ka ti doli Masia o nasara dibu dari dibu chandi ni m-be kaman o ni ŋme tɔbu gbahi dab shɛba, ka chɛ ka ti moli Masia yɛla ka di be kaman tulaale nyom la gili luɣilikam.
en: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.

dag: N yi paɣi Naawuni n ni yɛn di bindir shɛli zuɣu, di chaŋ wula ka so ni galim ma n ni paɣi Naawuni bindir shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If I thank God for my food, why should anyone criticize me about food for which I give thanks.

dag: Ka Dauda niriba maa daa yɛl o, Zuŋɔ n-nyɛ dabisi shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl a, Nyama, n zaŋ a dim niŋ a nuu ni, niŋm o a ni bɔri shɛm la. Di saha ka Dauda daa puɣisi chaŋ ti sɔɣi ŋmaai Naa Sool kparibu naŋgbambili.
en: They said to him, This is your chance! The Lord has told you that he would put your enemy in your power and you could do to him whatever you wanted to. David crept over and cut off a piece of Saul's robe without Saul's knowing it.

dag: Ti mini nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa yi Siizaria na n-daa doli taba chaŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti tahi tuuli cheechi nyaandol so ŋun daa nyɛ Saipurus tiŋbia, ka o yuli booni Mneesin la yiŋa ni ti ti gbe nimaani.
en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us and took us to the house of the man we were going to stay with —Mnason, from Cyprus, who had been a believer since the early days.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ kurugu bidibbini, ka daanya piɛm ni to ba pili yi.
en: When they try to escape from an iron sword, a bronze bow will shoot them down.

dag: N ni daa mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka n daa daŋ lo nia ni n ka yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka yi nya suhupiɛlli buyi:.
en: Because I was sure of this, I wanted to visit you first so that you could have a second opportunity to see me.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi ti zaŋ bɛ nɛma bee kawana ni chi na Vuhim Dabisili dali ni bɛ ti kɔhi, ti ku da li Vuhim Dabisili dali bee dabisili kasi dali. Ti mi ku ko yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin puuni, ka ku ti sama zaa din dol ti taba.
en: If the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or any grain to sell on the Sabbath, we wont buy it from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we wont plant crops, and we will return anything held in debt.

dag: Musa mini Aduna maa n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: They were the men who told the king of Egypt to free the Israelites.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim bɛ zaa na mɔɣ shɛli din daa zɔri kuni fɔntin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Ahava la gbini. Ti daa laɣim dɔnila nimaani daba ata. Ka n daa nya niriba mini maligumaaniba, ka daa bi nya Lɛvinim zuliya ni so.
en: I assembled the entire group by the canal that runs to the town of Ahava, and we camped there three days. I found that there were priests in the group, but no Levites.

dag: N yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi zaa ha polo kul zoorimi pahira Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ami!.
en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus.

dag: Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi bɛn be o sani ŋɔ zuɣu. Dama ŋun be ti sani yiko gari ŋun be o sani yiko.
en: Be brave and be strong! Dont let the king of Assyria and all those warriors he brings with him scare you or cause you dismay, because our forces are greater than his.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa bi paligi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu, ka o daa darigi Izraɛlnim tibili.
en: God was offended by this census and punished Israel.

dag: Hal o daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa m mo alizanda Nabia ŋun lan nyɛ nimaani tɔbbihi zuɣulan la gba, ka daa kari dabisili kam sara maligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi na ti maan o; ka daag o jɛmbu duu luhi.
en: It even defied the Prince of the heavenly army, stopped the daily sacrifices offered to him, and ruined the Temple.

dag: Ka Yisa daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi chirimya, dama yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba.
en: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.

dag: Ka o ni ti ti yinim bɛn diri wahala ŋɔ zaŋ tabili ti gba vuhim. O ni ti niŋla lala saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o malaikanim yi ti yi palo zuɣusaa siɣirina o yiko mini buɣim din diri puuni.
en: and to pay back you who are having trouble with relief along with us. This payback will come when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels.

dag: Wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, ka Yawɛ zaligunim be ti sani? Zaligubaŋdib ʒirinim zaŋ li leei ʒiri.
en: How can you say, We are wise; we possess the LORDs Instruction, when the lying pen of the scribes has surely distorted it?.

dag: ni yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu ni Naawuni yiko ni ni wuntitali din nyɛ ti bidibbina m-be ti nudiriti mini ti nuzahi ni la puuni.
en: by speaking the truth, and by depending on Gods power. This right way of living has prepared us to defend ourselves against every kind of attack.

dag: Ka bɛ yi boli so na ni o ti di o nini ni nya shɛli bee o ni mi shɛli yɛla shɛhira, amaa ka o zaɣisi ka bi yɛli shɛli, o tum alahichi, ka o taali maa ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you sin: by not providing information after hearing a public solemn pledge even though you are a witness, knowing something, or having seen something so that you become liable to punishment.

dag: O daa bi bo sɔŋsim maa Yawɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ku o, ka zaŋ o nam maa ti Jɛsi bia Dauda.
en: instead of asking the Lord . That is why the Lord killed Saul and gave the kingdom to Jesses son David.

dag: Du bihi atata n-daa be wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali maa yaɣa ayi zaa. Du bihi atata maa zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di daantalisi din be di luɣa zuɣu zaa barilim nyɛ yim.
en: These guardrooms on each side of the passageway were all the same size, and the walls between them were all of the same thickness.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pal piɛr ayopɔin.
en: They ate until they were full. They collected seven baskets full of leftovers.

dag: Musa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishom mini Ɛliɛza.
en: Moses sons were Gershom and Eliezer.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa niŋ nia ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ yuli jilima, ka me omaŋmaŋ nam yili.
en: Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself.

dag: Miri ka a lo a ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka niŋ a naani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Don't plan anything that will hurt your neighbors; they live beside you, trusting you.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua mini Binnui ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛrɛbia ni Juda ni Matania ŋun min o tab daa su wumpaɣibo yila yilibu fukumsi la.
en: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise.

dag: Stiivin daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tipawumlinim yi suhuri ni; yi kul zaɣisirila Naawuni Shia Kasi. Yi yaannim biɛhigu maa ka yi gba kul doli.
en: Then Stephen said, You stubborn Jewish leaders! You refuse to give your hearts to God or even listen to him. You are always against what the Holy Spirit wants you to do. Thats how your ancestors were, and you are just like them!.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka maligumaana maa lan kana ti nya, dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: On the seventh day he shall return and examine it again. If the mildew has spread.

dag: Yi noli yi kuli yaa yɛli shɛli, yin palimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni kul yaai yi noli po pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani shɛm maa.
en: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord . After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti ni o ti ʒini nimaani n-niŋ daba ayi, dama kum maa daa miiya pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But there was a famine in Canaan, and it was so bad that Abram went farther south to Egypt, to live there for a while.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yiinila yila maani ma ansarisi, ka n leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi.
en: And now Im their song; Im their cliché!.

dag: Dama a ni kpuɣ a piɛma tiri ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: Because you will make them turn and run when you aim your bow straight at their faces!.

dag: Ka Asa daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Asa did the right things in the LORDs eyes, just like his father David.

dag: ti yɛl o, Ti dana, ti teeya ni ʒirilan la ni daa be o nyɛvil ni la, o daa yɛliya ni o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: and said, Sir, we remember that while that liar was still alive he said, I will be raised to life three days later.

dag: To, n yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ pali ka yi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: I have told you this now before it all happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, A tiŋgbani ku vuhira, ka maligim mi ku lur a tiŋgban ni.
en: Then Isaac said to him, You will not live on good land. You will not have much rain.

dag: dama yi yi ba n-zani yi biɛhigu ni ti Duuma zuɣu, di ni chɛ ka ti leei bɛn be.
en: For now we are alive if you are standing your ground in the Lord.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba, Yi yi ti zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa yi ni baŋ ni mani m-bala, ka lan baŋ ni m bi niŋdi shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ni wuhi ma shɛm, dina ka m mali tɔɣisira.
en: So he said to them, When you lift up the Son of Man, you will know that I Am Who I Am; then you will know that I do nothing on my own authority, but I say only what the Father has instructed me to say.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam!.
en: How terrible it will be at that time for women who are pregnant and for women who are nursing their children.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa nya bɛ ni tum ma taali shɛm, karimi n yɛla maa saria.
en: You saw them abuse me, Lord , so make things right.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka n niriba ni nya dan shɛli maa ni, ka naɣ yɛrimi, Suhudoo beni, suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani.
en: They treat the wound of my people as if it were nothing: All is well, all is well, they insist, when in fact nothing is well.

dag: Binnyura kɔre yi ti mali ba, n ni zaŋ bɛ binnyura zali ba ka bɛ nyu li hal ti buɣi, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka bɛ gbihi, ka ku lan neei sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna: N zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ sara maligu binshɛŋa ti ma, ka di nyɛ Izraɛlnim sara binshɛŋa din be kasi zaa ti a min a bidibisi ni di nyɛ yi maligumaaniba tarili sahakam.
en: Then the Lord said to Aaron, I myself gave you responsibility over all the special gifts people give to me. All the holy gifts that the Israelites give to me, I give to you. You and your sons can share in these gifts. They will always belong to you.

dag: Ka yi yi nyɛla Masia ni su shɛba, dindina yi nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi bɛn ni di o fali kaman Naawuni daalikauli la ni wuhi shɛm.
en: If you belong to Christ, then you are the descendants of Abraham and will receive what God has promised.

dag: dama o bipuɣimbil gaŋa ŋun daa nyɛ kaman yuun pinaayi bia n-daa tarigi n-yɛn kpi. Yisa ni daa chani maa ka niriba pam muɣ o sani n-kabiri dol o.
en: because his only daughter, a twelve-year-old, was dying. As Jesus moved forward, he faced smothering crowds.

dag: nyin di nyuri bara n-niŋdi tiwul shɛŋa o ni ŋmahi bahi maa. Ka a yi nyuri bara, nyin baŋmi ni pa nyini ŋun nyɛ tiwulli maa n-sɔŋdi tia maa nyaɣa, amaa di nyaya maa n-sɔŋd a.
en: then dont brag like youre better than the other branches. If you do brag, be careful: its not you that sustains the root, but its the root that sustains you.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanani daa ka Juda Naa Asa sanna ti yɛl o, A ni niŋla Siria naa naani ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ naani la zuɣu, Siria naa tɔbbihi maa ni ti zo ka chɛ a.
en: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and said to him, Asa, you depended on the king of Aram to help you and not the Lord your God. Thats why the kings army has escaped from you.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu Izraɛl fɔntinsi zuɣu n-daa tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni nɛma ni daa be fɔntin shɛŋa ni zaa Naftali tiŋgban ni.
en: Benhadad agreed to Asa's proposal and sent his commanding officers and their armies to attack the cities of Israel. They captured Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah, and all the cities of Naphtali where supplies were stored.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka kali ba.
en: The LORD said to Moses: Enroll all the oldest males of the Israelites over one month of age and record their names.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a yɛla gari niriba. Ka a yɛla ti gbaai bɛ nanim dabiɛm pam, ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. N yi ti ŋooi n takɔbi bɛ tooni, bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam niŋgbuna kul yɛn sɔhirimi sahakam bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu a lubu maa dali. .
en: They will be horrified, and when I flash my sword in victory on the day of your death, their kings will tremble in the fear of what could happen to them.

dag: Ka n nya ka wɔr ʒiɛɣu yina pahi, ka bɛ daa niŋ ŋun bar o maa yiko, ka ti o takɔb titali ni o yihi suhudoo dunia ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka daadamnim ku taba.
en: Another horse came out, a red one. Its rider was given the power to bring war on the earth, so that people should kill each other. He was given a large sword.

dag: Barina ni paai tin shɛli maa lumi dahim, ka yili kam zaa dunoya kpari, ka so ku tooi kpe di ni.
en: Total Confusion is a good name for this city. The city has been destroyed. People cannot enter the houses. The doors are blocked.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yi Jeemsi zuɣu, ka daa lan yi o tuumba la zaa gba zuɣu.
en: Then he appeared to James, and afterward to all the apostles.

dag: ni Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la ni Hiddai ŋun daa yi Gaash kulibɔŋ duli na la.
en: Benaiah from Pirathon; Hiddai from the Gaash ravines.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ fo ka bembe nti gbaai Naawuni paɣibu yɛra, Dindina Naawuni n-chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba niŋ tuuba ni bɛ nya nyɛvili.
en: When the Jewish believers heard this, they stopped arguing. They praised God and said, So God is also allowing even those who are not Jews to change their hearts so that they can have the life he gives.

dag: Yi ni ti lan niŋ lala goli maa daba ayopɔin dali n-ti ŋunkam tum alahichi o chirimbu puuni bee o ʒilinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka yi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: On the seventh day of the month you are to do the same thing on behalf of anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance. In this way you will keep the Temple holy.

dag: Cham maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia sani nti chɛ ka o mali dunɔguliba bɛn zaani Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni n-deeri laɣ shɛli niriba ni zaŋdi tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la laasabu.
en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest. Tell him that he must get the money that people brought to the Lord s Temple. The gatekeepers collected that money from the people.

dag: A ni ti nya suhupiɛlli ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, ka niriba pam gba suhuri ti paligi bia maa dɔɣibu zuɣu;.
en: How glad and happy you will be, and how happy many others will be when he is born!.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n zaŋla duu tanzaa kuɣili sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din viɛli ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka ni chɛ ka duu tanzaa mali yaa. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku zo dabiɛm.
en: This, now, is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am placing in Zion a foundation that is firm and strong. In it I am putting a solid cornerstone on which are written the words, Faith that is firm is also patient.

dag: Ka niriba bɔhira, Bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti? Ka yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ yɛl ti? Bihi bɛn ŋmaai bihili kɔŋko ka o yɛligu ni sɔŋ?.
en: To whom will God teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? To those just weaned from milk? To those who have hardly outgrown the breast?.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani palo daa zaŋla Mahanaim hal ti paai Bashan tiŋgbani zaa din daa nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa la ni Jair fɔntinsi zaa din be Bashan ka di kalinli nyɛ pihiyɔbu.
en: Their territory extended to Mahanaim and included all of Bashan—the whole kingdom of Og, the king of Bashan, as well as all sixty of the villages of Jair in Bashan.

dag: Sool daa bela zoli maa yaɣi yini polo, ka Dauda min o niriba mi be yaɣi din la polo, ka Dauda daa kpaŋ zɔri yomyom ni o yi Sool nuu ni saha shɛli Sool ni daa ti chɛ ŋun Dauda min o niriba maa kpe ni kpe ni o gbahi ba la.
en: Saul was going around one side of a hill there while David and his soldiers were going around the other. David was hurrying to get away from Saul while Saul and his troops were trying to surround David and his soldiers in order to capture them.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi. Yi yi ʒi yi yinsi puuni, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla, ka yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo bee yi yi ti dɔni bee yi yi ti yiɣisi, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla.
en: Teach these laws to your children. Talk about these things when you sit in your houses, when you walk along the road, when you lie down, and when you get up.

dag: Ka a kpamba ŋɔ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni yɛli ma, A min a niriba zaa bɛn dol a yimiya chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka n ni chaŋ. Ka o daa ŋmaligi Firawuna sani n-yi ni suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: Moses concluded by saying, All your officials will come to me and bow down before me, and they will beg me to take all my people and go away. After that, I will leave. Then in great anger Moses left the king.

dag: O luɣi bɛ tiba, ka wuhi ba, ka zali ba ni bɛ zom yi alahichi ni labi o sanna.
en: He opens their ears with discipline and commands them to turn from wrong.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana ni zali di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di doli yuun shɛŋa din na kpalim ni bɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa, ka yi ni tooi yihi shɛli yi daa maa ni.
en: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa darig a niriba maa tibili la, bɛ nandahima puuni, bɛ daa suh a pam.
en: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord .

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chaŋ ti doli bɛ naba hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-nya ka Sirianim maa situra mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zo ka chɛ m-bahi kul dɔndo sol ni. Ka tuumba maa daa labina ti yɛli naa.
en: So they went after the Arameans as far as the Jordan River. The road was filled the whole way with garments and equipment that the Arameans had thrown away in their rush. The messengers returned and reported this to the king.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu.
en: I am the bread of life.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya Jaza. Ka bɛ daa tuhi fa di tiŋkpansi, ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: and Moses sent men to find the best way to attack the city of Jazer. The Israelites captured it and its surrounding towns and drove out the Amorites living there.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ŋmaligi ni o chaŋ, ka Sool va n-gɔh o binyɛrigu tiŋli, ka di cheei.
en: As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the edge of Samuel's robe. It tore!.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli niriba maa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, ka be Jɛriko tooni polo la.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke to the people on the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.

dag: M bihi, miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa!.
en: So, dear children, keep yourselves away from false gods.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni dahin shɛli yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Yiko Zaa Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: That is what you say! Jesus answered. But I tell all of you, Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful and coming on the clouds of heaven. .

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Ɛziɔngɛba maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Zin mɔɣu ni .
en: They left Ezion Geber and camped at Kadesh, in the desert of Zin.

dag: Ka Ham ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan ba la daa nya o ba ni do o zaɣim maa, ka yi samban ni nti yɛl o mabih ayi la.
en: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw that his father was naked and told his brothers who were outside the tent.

dag: O ni wum ka n duhi n yee kuhi pam maa, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: When he heard me scream, he ran outside, leaving his robe beside me.

dag: Nyin zoli din do Zɛrubabɛl tooni ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee nyɛ a? A ni leei tintani. O ni me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa. Ka o yi ti zaŋ kuɣ shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa pa di zuɣu, di saha maa niriba ni ti kuhi yɛli, Naawuni nirilim galisiya, Naawuni nirilim galisiya. .
en: Obstacles as great as mountains will disappear before you. You will rebuild the Temple, and as you put the last stone in place, the people will shout, Beautiful, beautiful.

dag: Nyama, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli vinvamli ni la.
en: There I saw the glory of Israels God, exactly like what I had seen in the valley.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ansarisi maaniba ʒiɛla n sani, ka n lihiri bɛ ni kuri ma suli shɛm.
en: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: But I tell you that even Solomon, the great and rich king, was not dressed as beautifully as one of these flowers.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya daa sabi pa binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ tabili maa zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Hakalia bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la, mini Zɛdɛkia ni.
en: The first to sign was the governor, Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and then Zedekiah signed. The following also signed:.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda! Ka dii gbaag o jɛmbu.
en: I believe, Lord! the man said, and knelt down before Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣisi bɛ ni daa kɔhi kawana laɣ shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-zaŋ li tahi Firawuna yiŋa nti ti o.
en: People in the land bought more and more grain. Joseph saved the money and brought it to Pharaohs house.

dag: n-zaŋ li gari taba m-mali tulaale zim kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka niŋ yalim niŋ di ni din ni chɛ ka di be kasi ka ku mali daɣiri.
en: Use them to make incense, mixed like perfume. Add salt to keep it pure and holy.

dag: Ka o shi sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o.
en: Then the entirely burned offering will be skinned and cut up into pieces.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl niriba maa naa ni mali so shɛŋa min o talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka daa sab li niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bahi niriba maa zaa ka bɛ wurim, ka sokam kul o ya.
en: Samuel then explained to the people how the monarchy should operate and wrote it in a scroll and placed it in the LORDs presence. Then Samuel sent every person back to their homes.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka o chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: So King Solomon sent Benaiah, Jehoiadas son. He attacked Adonijah, and Adonijah died.

dag: Yi gba kpalimmiya gbe kpe kaman yi tab la ni daa niŋ shɛm la, ka n nya Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm pahi.
en: You are welcome to spend the night here, just as the others did. I will find out if the Lord has something else to say about this.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ doo min o paɣa polo ni zaŋ chaŋ doo min o bipuɣiŋga ŋun na be o ba yiŋa ka nyɛ paɣisarili polo m-bala.
en: These are the rules that the Lord gave Moses concerning vows made by an unmarried woman living in her father's house or by a married woman.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni chɛ ka bindirigu yi zuɣusaa luna, ka sokam chani ti pihir o dahin yini dibu tariga dabisili kam, ka n kpahim ba nya bɛ ni tooi doli n zaligu bee bɛ ku tooi dol li.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, I will cause food to fall from the sky. This food will be for you to eat. Every day the people should go out and gather the food they need that day. I will do this to see if they will do what I tell them.

dag: O daa nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim; o daa nyo yil titali kam buɣim.
en: He burned down the Temple, the palace, and the houses of all the important people in Jerusalem;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil ŋun daa be Maika yiŋ maa sanna nti bɔh o o daalaafee yɛla.
en: So they turned in there and went to the young Levites house in Micahs compound and greeted him.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa sani maa daa daai goon shɛŋa din zaa daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la luhi.
en: The entire Babylonian army and the commander of the guard destroyed the walls surrounding Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garig o bɔhigunim maa zaa, ka binshɛɣu daa kani din sɔɣi ka Sulemaana bi tooi kahigi li wuhi paɣ maa.
en: Solomon answered all the questions. None of her questions was too hard for him to explain.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ako bee bɛn be Sidɔn bee bɛn be Ahilab bee bɛn be Akizib bee bɛn be Hɛliba bee bɛn be Afik bee bɛn be Rɛhɔb.
en: The tribe of Asher did not drive out the people living in the cities of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphek, and Rehob.

dag: Amaa bomiya n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa tɔŋsim, ka suhimiya Yawɛ tim li, dama di tɔŋsim puuni ka yi gba ni tɔŋ.
en: Promote the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile. Pray to the LORD for it, because your future depends on its welfare.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma. Yawɛ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma.
en: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa n-tim dunia ni chɛ li.
en: So the one who was sitting on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth. And the earth was harvested.

dag: Dama bɛ chira tariga yi ti paai, bɛ baɣa bɔ n-lee lan be bɛ malibu ni, bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: When our lives are over, do we really care whether our children are happy?.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu din ŋmani jaaŋgbee ti ma ka yɛli ma: Yiɣisima m-buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di bimbini, ka kali bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni di ni.
en: An angel gave me a measuring stick and said: Measure around God's temple. Be sure to include the altar and everyone worshiping there.

dag: A shihira chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni katinsi lur a la sizuura, a ni wuhiri shihira shɛŋa zuɣu. A chɛ ka biɛɣ neebu mini yuŋ zibbu yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: Those who dwell on the far edges stand in awe of your acts. You make the gateways of morning and evening sing for joy.

dag: Yawɛ, n yur a jɛmbu duu din nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛli, ka a jilima be nimaani la.
en: I love the house where you live, O Lord , the place where your glory dwells.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgban ni tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti man Yawɛ, di nyɛla yi dini; ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: And the first part of the crops from their fields and vineyards also belongs to you. The people will offer this to me, then anyone in your family who is clean may have some of it.

dag: Yi gba kpalimmiya gbe kpe kaman yi tab la ni daa niŋ shɛm la, ka n nya Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm pahi.
en: But please spend the night, as the others did, so that I may learn whether or not the Lord has something else to tell me.

dag: O daa kurigimi zaa, ka daa ti kpi, ka o bidibisi, Iso mini Yaakubu sɔɣ o.
en: Then Isaac became weak and died and went to be with his people. He had lived a long and full life. His sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

dag: chɛ ka a pɔhim biɛɣu doli ba lala, ka chɛ ka a sanʒiɛ titali kpɛhi ba dabiɛm!.
en: pursue them with your storm, terrify them with your hurricane.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be Filistianim maa sani yuuni ni chira anahi.
en: David lived in Philistia for sixteen months.

dag: Ti mabihi maa daa zaŋla Piɛbil la ʒim mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu n-nyaŋ o, dama bɛ daa bi zaɣisi kum di puuni.
en: They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the truth which they proclaimed; and they were willing to give up their lives and die.

dag: Do so ŋun daa kpaŋ maa daa bi mi ŋun chɛ ka o kpaŋ maa ni nyɛ so, dama salo daa galisiya nimaani, ka Yisa mi pun yi ni chaŋ o chandi.
en: The man who had been cured didnt know who it was, because Jesus had slipped away from the crowd gathered there.

dag: Nyama, yinim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, zahimmiya yɛlli maa nya ka wuhi ti ni yɛn gbaai li shɛm.
en: You are the people of Israel, and you must decide today what to do about the men of Gibeah.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bɔŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi bɛ taba alaka ni deeri pin shɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nira n-deeri Naawuni yɛligu; amaa yinim ni pa Naawuni niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi deeri o yɛligu maa.
en: He who comes from God listens to God's words. You, however, are not from God, and that is why you will not listen.

dag: Naawuni ni daa duh o n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo maa ka o deei Shia Kasi so o Ba Naawuni ni daa zaŋ lo ti alikauli la n-ti ti na. Alikauli maa palibu shihira ka yi nya ka wum ŋɔ.
en: He has been raised to the right side of God, his Father, and has received from him the Holy Spirit, as he had promised. What you now see and hear is his gift that he has poured out on us.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ yihi buɣijɛmbo maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka zaŋ bɛ na kpima chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n kul be bɛ sani sahakam.
en: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka zaŋ o leei ti yɛm mini ti wuntia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali ti ka ti be kasi ni ŋun yihi ti alahichi ni.
en: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.

dag: A nyuɣu bela polipoli kaman pipi shɛli din puuni na ʒi n-kɔŋ wain shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ gab taba. A puli ŋmanila alikama mɔri din laɣisi puya, ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom ʒe n-gil li.
en: Your navel, cupped like the full moon— may it never lack spiced wine! Your belly is a mound of winnowed wheat edged with lilies.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani, dama ti mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam ka di dol o yubu, o deeri ti suhigu.
