en: We can come to God with no doubts. This means that when we ask God for things , God cares about what we say.

dag: O ti ku kuhi bee n-duh o yee bee n-chɛ ka so wum o kukoli damli solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa lab kuli, ka naa maa ti bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ŋmaligi labina.
en: When the messengers returned to Ahaziah, he asked, Why are you back so soon.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Kiriatariba mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti ba pahi. . Bɛ booni li la Hiburɔn pumpɔŋɔ, ka di be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni.
en: They gave them Kiriath-arba in the highlands of Judah and the pastures around it.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba maa, N nya ti Duuma! Ka yɛli ba Yisa ni daa yɛl o shɛm la zaa.
en: So Mary Magdalene went and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord and related to them what he had told her.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di nyɛla m mini yi pinaayi ŋɔ ni yino ŋun laɣim mali bɔrɔbɔro suɣiri ʒiɛri la yin ni ŋɔ.
en: He answered, It is one of you twelve men who is eating from this dish with me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yihi fɔntins ayi Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgban ni. Dina n-nyɛ: Taanak mini Gatirimɔn ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Half the tribe of Manasseh gave them Taanach and Gath Rimmon. In all, this half of Manasseh gave them two towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: amaa n yi tumdi li, hal yi yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, yin niŋmiya n tuma maa yɛda, ka di chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ ka niŋ yɛda ni m Ba be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, you should at least believe my deeds, in order that you may know once and for all that the Father is in me and that I am in the Father.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa ti paana yɛli naa, Bɛ zaa mal alaafee, Ka silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je nyini n dan naa niŋ ti nuu ni ŋɔ simdi paɣibu.
en: Ahimaaz called out to the king, Peace! then bowed low before the king, his nose to the ground. He said, Bless the LORD your God, who has delivered up the men who raised their hands against my master the king.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, A ni suhila yɛm ka bi suhi nyɛvil wɔɣinli bee azichi bee a dimnim nyaŋbu, amaa ka suhila yɛm din ni chɛ ka a baŋ din tuhi la zuɣu.
en: So God said to him, You did not ask for long life and riches for yourself. You did not ask for the death of your enemies. You asked for the wisdom to listen and make the right decisions.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ka nir chaŋchaŋ ti lan ŋmaligi gbamda. Ŋunkam niŋdi lala bi simdi Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Jesus answered, Anyone who starts plowing and keeps looking back isn't worth a thing to God's kingdom.

dag: Ka pukpara ŋun mi tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o daŋ bindir pala dibu.
en: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin kul nyɛla naa sahakam; ka a yuli kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But you, LORD, rule forever! Your fame lasts from one generation to the next!.

dag: O naan zaŋ o yiko din galisi ŋɔ zab ma? Aai, amaa o naan gbilisi tibili wum n yɛligu.
en: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanim maa daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni, ka piɛguliba maa yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti nya yɛl shɛli din niŋ ka ti Duuma yɛli ti ŋɔ.
en: When the angels went away from them back into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, Let's go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us.

dag: Bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni zaŋdi bɛ noya saɣindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, amaa baŋsim chɛ ka wuntizɔriba nyari faako.
en: The godless destroy their neighbors by their words, but the righteous are saved by their knowledge.

dag: Yawɛ tumtumsa galisiya pam, ka ŋunkam yuri li bɔhindi li mi.
en: How wonderful are the things the Lord does! All who are delighted with them want to understand them.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, Wuhim ti a yuli, ka a yɛligu maa ti niŋ pali ka ti ti a jilima.
en: Manoah said, Tell us your name, so we can honor you after our son is born.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi taba, Ya polo ka o lee yɛn chaŋ ka ti ku lan nya o? O yɛn chaŋla Yɛhudianim ni wurim chaŋ nti be Giriikinim tin shɛŋa la ni ti wuhiri Giriikinim maa yɔɣɔ.
en: The Jewish authorities said among themselves, Where is he about to go so that we shall not find him? Will he go to the Greek cities where our people live, and teach the Greeks?.

dag: Yim ka bɛ ti wum vu shɛli damli, ka di yi zuɣusaa na kaman pɔhim tital la nti pali bɛ ni daa ʒi du shɛli ni maa zaa.
en: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.

dag: Amaa alizanda ni Jɛrusalɛm la nyɛla bilichina. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ma.
en: But the heavenly Jerusalem is free, and she is our mother.

dag: binnɛɔŋ kam naan laɣim kpi, ka daadam di labi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: then everyone living would die and turn into dust again.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa chani gindi alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni m-be kaman tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o be la. Ka o mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn daa ti yɛn di alikauli maa fal la daa kul bela tantinim ni.
en: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli: Yawɛ, a yɛliya ni a ni bela zibisim tital ni.
en: Then Solomon prayed: Our Lord , you said that you would live in a dark cloud.

dag: Ka do so yi ti zahim zahindi yuŋ mahig omaŋa, dindina ŋun yim sansani maa ni, ka di lan kpe sansani maa ni na.
en: If an individual in the camp becomes polluted due to a nighttime emission, he must exit the camp area and not reenter.

dag: Di lan chaŋya ti chɛ mɔri na ti ti ba ka bɛ ŋma bilichiisi maa. Chɛliya ka bɛ maŋmaŋ chani ti chɛri mɔri maa na.
en: Don't give the slaves any more straw to put in their bricks. Force them to find their own straw wherever they can.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-su yurilim maŋli. Dama nyini n-tiri sokam zaa o tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: and faithful love comes from you, my Lord— and that you will repay everyone according to their deeds.

dag: m bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam. Amaa bɛ bi tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: All my life enemies have attacked me, but they have never defeated me.

dag: Amaa Yisa ni daa nya lala maa ka di ku o suli, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: Jesus saw what happened. He did not like his followers telling the children not to come. So he said to them, Let the little children come to me. Dont stop them, because Gods kingdom belongs to people who are like these little children.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ kɔŋko nti di bindir shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara bɛ maligumaaniba leebu saha maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun pa maligumaana ti di li, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: They shall eat what was used in the ritual of forgiveness at their ordination. Only priests may eat this food, because it is sacred.

dag: Naawuni n-nam zuɣusaa n-teei li pa. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Ŋuna n-ti ninsalinim zaa nyɛvili ni vuhim. Ka pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa yɛl o dabili.
en: The Lord , the true God, said these things.

dag: N ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, n daa dari tɔhila m binyɛra, ka dari sibi n zabiri mini n teeŋa ka teei ʒini tiŋa, ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni.
en: When I heard this, I tore my clothes and cloak, pulled out hair from my head and beard, and sat down in shock.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la yi ni kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: But watch yourself! Make sure you dont offer up your entirely burned offerings in just any place you see.

dag: Bɔhimi Midiannim biɛri ti Izraɛlnima. Di nyaaŋa n ni deeg a nyɛvili.
en: Take just reparations for the Israelites from the Midianites. Afterward you will join your ancestors.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o boli; ka o ni boli shɛb maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani; ka o ni chɛ ka shɛb yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya o jilima.
en: God planned for them to be like his Son. He chose them and made them right with him. And after he made them right, he gave them his glory.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni me wuni bee n-kpe binnani zali ka di pa din mal o buchi?.
en: Who would form a god or cast an idol that does no good?.

dag: Kalim Gɛrishɔn gba zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Find out how many men between the ages of and are in the two Levite clans of Gershon. Count only those who are able to work at the sacred tent.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, niriba maa na kul galisiya. Zaŋm ba chaŋ kuliga ni ka n ti buɣisi ba nimaani ti a; ka n yi yɛl a ni so ni dol a chaŋ, dilana n-ni dol a chaŋ; ka m mi yi ti yɛl a ni so ku dol a chaŋ, dilan shiri ku dol a chaŋ.
en: Then the Lord said to Gideon, You still have too many men. Take them down to the water, and I will separate them for you there. If I tell you a man should go with you, he will go. If I tell you a man should not go with you, he will not go.

dag: ka zaŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla n-tuɣili di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili buɣim di ba, ka n labisi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima mini diɣi buɣisi li bee nir ti zaŋ li taɣi salima din viɛli yɛri.
en: Neither gold nor glass can compare with it; she cant be acquired with gold jewelry.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri binshɛɣukam nyɛvili ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun daa zani Gomna Pɔntius Pailɛt tooni n-niŋ shɛhira suŋ la zuɣu, n zal a.
en: I command you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and Christ Jesus, who made the good confession when testifying before Pontius Pilate.

dag: Wuntizɔra noli nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini. Amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni.
en: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ ma Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni nti tam zo titali din du pam zuɣu n-wuhi ma tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina.
en: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛba ayiyi bɛn mali nyɛvili daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu.
en: Noah took a male and a female of every living creature with him.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali din daa ye binyɛr piɛlli mini ago ni mulifu, ka salima ni waya ni kuɣ viɛla bina nyaɣim di luɣilikam la!.
en: Oh, the horror! The great city that wore fine linen, purple, and scarlet, who glittered with gold, jewels, and pearls.

dag: Ka Musa daa sabi Yawɛ yɛligu maa zaa sɔŋ, ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asiba me sara maligu bimbini zali zoli maa gbini, ka sa bin wɔɣila pinaayi ka di zani Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la zaani.
en: So Moses wrote down all the commands of the Lord . The next morning he got up and built an altar near the bottom of the mountain. And he set up twelve stones—one for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ŋunkam miri Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ yi ni kpi, dindina ti zaa kul kpimi maa.
en: If anyone who even comes near the Tent must die, then we are all as good as dead.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa ka bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ti cham ba takɔbiri.
en: When those around him recognized what was about to happen, they said, Lord, should we fight with our swords.

dag: N ni tiligi m biŋkɔbiri maa, ka so ku lan nahim ba. Ka n ti woligi binshɛli din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni.
en: But I will rescue my sheep and not let them be mistreated any more. I will judge each of my sheep and separate the good from the bad.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti bi saɣim timaŋa, ti na ʒi n-jɛm Baalinima? Lihimiya yi biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm vinvamli ni, nyamiya yi ni daa tum shɛm. Yi daa ŋmanila laakum nyaŋ ŋun bɔri dubu ka faai zɔra ginda.
en: How can you say, Im not dirty; I havent gone after Baals. Look what you have done in the valley; consider what you have done there. You are like a frenzied young camel, racing around.

dag: Di saha maa ha yi daa dolila dunia ŋɔ tuumbiɛri soli, ka deei Sintani ŋun su sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na yiko la noli. Ŋuna n-nyɛ shi biɛ so ŋun su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Naawuni nol la.
en: Yes, in the past your lives were full of those sins. You lived the way the world lives, following the ruler of the evil powers that are above the earth. That same spirit is now working in those who refuse to obey God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ninivenim daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda ka yɛli ni sokam lom noli, ka wɔɣira zaŋ tabili tarimba zaa daa so buri.
en: The people of Nineveh believed God's message. So they decided that everyone should fast, and all the people, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth to show that they had repented.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa tim boli anabinim kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, Ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: So Israels king gathered four hundred prophets and asked them, Should we go to war with Ramoth-gilead or not? Attack! the prophets answered. God will hand it over to the king.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba Izraɛlnima. O daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ su li.
en: Then he gave their land to Israel, his people.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ yɛndaan so daa be tiŋ maa ni ka kuhi yɛl ba na, Wummiya! Wummiya! Yɛlimiya Jɔab ni o kana ka n ti yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: A wise woman shouted from the top of the wall, Listen to me! Listen to me! I have to talk to Joab! Tell him to come here.

dag: Di chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la nyaŋ ma, ka di dari niŋ ma; a mi di chɛ ka bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri la chani n-kaɣiri bɛ nina lihiri ma.
en: Don't let my enemies, those liars, gloat over my defeat. Don't let those who hate me for no reason smirk with delight over my sorrow.

dag: M mi ni Ijipti naa maa ku chɛ ka yi chaŋ, naɣila n zaŋla kiŋkansi niŋ o.
en: However, I know that Egypts king wont let you go unless hes forced to do it.

dag: Ka Pita min o nyaandolitab piniyin la daa yiɣisi zani ka Pita duh o yee pam yɛli, Yinim Judianim mini yi zaa bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ ka baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni.
en: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!.

dag: Ŋun maŋmaŋa n-lan nyɛ sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi, ka o pala ti kɔŋko daalahichi sara maligu, amaa o nyɛla dunianim zaa daalahichi sara maligu.
en: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.

dag: Ka a ni wuhi Izraɛlnim zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ka o mi zaŋ ti ba la.
en: You must teach the people of Israel all the laws which I have given to you through Moses.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn tumla tuun pala. Di niŋdi pumpɔŋɔ gba; yi bi nya li? N yɛn ŋmɛla soli sɔŋ mɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣiriba daa wum lala, ka kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o, dama niriba daa yɛliya ni o zuɣu n-lɛbigi.
en: When Jesus' family heard what he was doing, they thought he was crazy and went to get him under control.

dag: Ka o daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yuŋ maa ti yɛli ba, Yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yiɣisimiya n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka chɛ n niriba ŋɔ; chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Then Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron that night and said, Get up! Get away from my people, both you and the Israelites! Go! Worship the LORD, as you said!.

dag: Pita noli daa na bi lu tiŋa ka sagban piɛlli dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: While Peter was talking, a bright cloud came over them. A voice came from the cloud and said, This is my Son, the one I love. I am very pleased with him. Obey him.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt ni daa wum Mariama puhigu maa ka ŋun Ɛlizabɛt bia dam o pul ni, ka Shia Kasi daa pali Ɛlizabɛt.
en: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby moved within her. Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A nina maa neema. A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa.
en: Jesus said to him, You can see now. You are healed because you believed.

dag: M bia, a yi mali yɛm, n suhu ni piɛla.
en: My child, if you become wise, I will be very happy.

dag: A bi tiri di ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyura, ka mɔŋdi kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu.
en: denied water to the thirsty, withheld bread from the starving. .

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka n ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri.
en: He said to David, Come here, and Ill feed your body to the birds and wild animals.

dag: dama n nyɛla tarim dɔɣirili, amaa o bi chɛ ma piibu di zuɣu. Ka zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, ʒiɛmani kam nim ni boli ma alibarika paɣa;.
en: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.

dag: nti kurim lihi di ni nya ka bimpiɛlli doya, amaa ka o lee bi kpe di ni.
en: He bent over and saw the linen cloths, but he did not go in.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, bɛ tahima lee nyɛ dini saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti chɛ ba bahi, saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti deei bɛ nyɛviya?.
en: What hope do people without God have when it is time to die, when God takes their life away?.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti n yuli jilima, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam zani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋ, ka bɛ nina ku nya shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri mi ku baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ labi n sanna, ka n tib ba.
en: God has blinded their eyes and closed their minds, so that their eyes would not see, and their minds would not understand, and they would not turn to me, says God, for me to heal them.

dag: O bela o biɛhigu shee ka lihiri zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: he has to come down to even see heaven and earth!.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. N daa pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha, ka wuhi li? Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. N ʒi Naawuni so ŋun mali yiko pam yɛla yaha. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock.

dag: Nyin gba mir o, dama o daa chihi ti yɛligu pam.
en: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.

dag: ka Rubin bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi.
en: and Reuben's sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o kukoli yi zuɣusaa na ka yi wum li ni di chɛ ka o wuhi ya. O daa wuhi ya o buɣim titali dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yi daa wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni.
en: He let you hear his voice from heaven so that he could instruct you; and here on earth he let you see his holy fire, and he spoke to you from it.

dag: N zaŋ n kayeeni ŋmani n-yɛli ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ dunɔdaya ni. N chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bɛ niriba. M bahi n niriba maa yoli. Bɛ ni bi chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.

dag: Dama niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili bela ʒim puuni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tin ya ni di yo yi nyɛviya tiliginsim samli. Dama ʒim n-nyɛ din yɔri alahichi samli, di ni nyɛ nyɛvili la zuɣu.
en: A creatures life is in the blood. I have provided you the blood to make reconciliation for your lives on the altar, because the blood reconciles by means of the life.

dag: Nyini n-zali zoya a kpiɔŋ puuni. A mali yiko pam.
en: You made the mountains. We see your power all around us.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔh o, Naawuni maligumaaniba zuɣulana ka a tu lala maa.
en: The men standing near Paul said to him, Are you sure you want to insult Gods high priest like that.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu: Bɛ ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku nya shɛli. Ka wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ bɛ ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Dama bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani, ka o chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba. .
en: I do this so that They will look and look but never really see; they will listen and listen but never understand. If they saw and understood, they might change and be forgiven. Isaiah :-.

dag: Ka bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli yi puri ni, yin di ti kpuɣiya di daatam, ka yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni ka di wali wala, yin di pɔhiya li, di ni ti nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni.
en: You must not harvest the secondary growth of your produce or gather the grapes of your freely growing vines. It will be a year of special rest for the land.

dag: N ni tooi chɛ ka sagbana sabigi libilibi kaman di kumdila so kuli la.
en: I can make the sky turn dark, as if it were in mourning for the dead.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Shɛkɛm saɣim o bipuɣiŋga Daina, amaa ka o daa di suɣilo shini hal ka o bidibisi bɛn daa mali niɣi be mɔɣu ni la ti kuna.
en: Jacob learned that Shechem had done this very bad thing to his daughter. But all his sons were out in the fields with the cattle. So he did nothing until they came home.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti dana, a daba kala bindira dabu na.
en: They said to him, No, Master. Your servants have just come to buy food.

dag: Naawuni bi lihi ti ka ti be ti ko ka chɛ ba; dama bɛ gba yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: He made no difference between us and them; he forgave their sins because they believed.

dag: Ka pɔhim daa muɣisi ti ka ti kul chani biɛlabiɛla n-niŋ dabisa shɛm hal ti miri Kɛnaidus, ka ti ni daa tuhi pɔhim zuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ doli Kriit teeku noli polo n-chaŋ ti baɣisi Salimɔne gari.
en: We sailed slowly for many days. It was hard for us to reach the city of Cnidus because the wind was blowing against us. We could not go any farther that way, so we sailed by the south side of the island of Crete near Salmone.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi kambɔna mini yi tuma zaa ni; o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.

dag: Jɔn ni daa ti mirit o tuma naabu o daa bɔhi niriba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka lan ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M pala yi ni yuuni so sol la. Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna, hal man pɔri ni n ti damd o tooni n-gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi gba. .
en: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.

dag: Niŋmi li la ashilɔni, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni ŋɔ ti a di laara.
en: so that you may give to the poor in secret. Your Father who sees what you do in secret will reward you.

dag: Vihiriba maa yi ti gindi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti nya ninsal kɔba luɣ shɛli, ŋun bom bini dalim nimaani hal ka kasiɣiriba ti kana ti zaŋ li sɔɣi Hamɔngɔg.
en: As the travelers cross through the land, when they see a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it until the gravediggers bury it in Hamon-gog Valley.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ni, amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni pii ma, ka ti ma soli ni n zaŋ lahibal suŋ din nyɛ Masia daazichi din ka buɣisibu la yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, pahimiya o niriba zuɣu paɣ o. Dama o ni bɔhi biɛri o daba ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka bɔhi o dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je o tibili ka mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di viɛl ti o niriba.
en: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord , because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zaligunim maa zaa dolibu, ka nyɛligi binyara malila naɣibih ayi kɔtomsi zali; ka lan mali Ashɛra binnana zali, ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi mini Baal.
en: The people stopped following the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves. They made Asherah poles. They worshiped all the stars of heaven and served Baal.

dag: Di saha Lɛvinim ni ti duhi bɛ yee yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa:.
en: And the Levites will say to all the Israelites in a loud voice:.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida mini sipirɛs ni ɛligum dakuɣiri ti ma na. N ni chɛ ka n niriba kana ti pah a niriba zuɣu, dama m mi ni a niriba maa mi Lɛbanɔn dakuɣiri maa ŋmabu pam.
en: Also send me wood from cedar trees, pine trees, and algum trees from the country of Lebanon. I know your servants are experienced at cutting down trees from Lebanon. My servants will help your servants.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Hilikia maa mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Maika bia Abidɔn ni Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni naa kpambala Asaaya.
en: Then the king gave a command to Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah the servant.

dag: Yawɛ, n tarigimi, zom ma nambɔɣu. Yawɛ, n kɔba ni zaa chɔɣisimi dabiɛm zuɣu, tibimi ma.
en: Have mercy on me, LORD, because Im frail. Heal me, LORD, because my bones are shaking in terror!.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kuli m ba sani ti yɛl o, A bia Yisifu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana, dinzuɣu niŋmi yomyom yiɣisi kuli n sanna.
en: Now hurry back to my father and tell him that this is what his son Joseph says: God has made me ruler of all Egypt; come to me without delay.

dag: A daa fa ba bɛn je ba nuu ni bahi; ka tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: God saved them from hostile powers; he redeemed them from the power of the enemy.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza daa lan va Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa kuli Babilɔn ti zal o nam yili ni Babilɔn maa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar also took some equipment from the LORDs temple to Babylon and placed them in his own temple there.

dag: Baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo mali ma alahiziba pam. Di galisiya yaɣi ka n ku tooi baŋ li.
en: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.

dag: Nyini n-daa wuhi shihira mini alahiziba tuma Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka na kul wuhiri li hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini daadamnim zaa sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a zali yuli hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You have been doing powerful miracles in the land of Egypt until now, in Israel and elsewhere. You are the one who made yourself as famous as you are today.

dag: Ka gɔhi mini tutu shɛŋa din mali gɔhi ni bili tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; ka a ni diri tiŋgban ni tihi wala.
en: The ground will grow thorns and weeds for you. And you will have to eat the plants that grow wild in the fields.

dag: Dama nyama, Ijiptinim ni ti laɣim ba, ka Mɛmfisinim sɔɣi ba, ka lan deei bɛ daazinfa neen viɛla la, ka gɔhi bili bɛ yinsi.
en: Even if they escape destruction, Egypt will gather them, Memphis will bury them. Briars will possess their precious things of silver; thorns will be in their tents.

dag: Bɛ daa yil la buɣilimbuɣilimbila ni pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi ka lan yili buɣilimbuɣilimbila ni pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi m-mali lala hal ti tuui alichɛbba shɛli bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi tuma maa tiŋli kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Around the bottom edge of the robe there were bells and pomegranates. There was a bell following each pomegranate. This robe was for the priest to wear when he served the Lord. It was made just as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛb ti mmaŋa, ka bɛ kul ni yiini yila paɣiri ma.
en: They are the people I made for myself, and they will sing my praises.

dag: mini Bɛndɛka ŋun daa be Makaz la ni Shaalibim ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni Ɛlɔnbɛtihanan.
en: Ben-deker in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elon-bethhanan.

dag: M Ba ni su binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla n dini; dina n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni o ni ti zaŋ n yɛla wuhi ya maa.
en: Everything that the Father has is mine. Thats why I said that the Spirit takes what is mine and will proclaim it to you.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ: Katat mini Nahalal ni Shimrɔn ni Idala ni Bɛtilihɛm: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: It included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: A ni ti bahi yɛmbahiga, dama tahima beni; Naawuni ni ti gul a, ka a vuhiri ka barina kani.
en: You will feel safe because there is hope. God will protect you and give you rest.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-chaŋ ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali yaa gari ya fɔntin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili hal ka di ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Listen, Israel! Today you will cross the Jordan River to enter and take possession of nations larger and more powerful than you, along with huge cities with fortifications that reach to the sky.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shih o bindoo, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whoever touches her bed must wash their clothes and bathe in water. They will be unclean until evening.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, bɛ kul chanimi gindi tiŋ maa goma, ka tuumbiɛri mini nyaanyibo be di ni.
en: Day and night, in every neighborhood, the city is filled with evil and trouble.

dag: Isaka zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Azan bia Palitiɛl.
en: from the tribe of Issachar—Paltiel son of Azzan;.

dag: Ka sariakaritiba maa ti vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, shɛhira maa yi nyɛla ʒiri shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ o kpee maa polo.
en: The judges will look into the situation very carefully. If it turns out that the witness is a liar—that the witness has given false testimony against his fellow Israelite.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Nahash ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim naa la daa kpi, ka o bia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Some time later King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.

dag: ka o daa tim Tɛkɔa nti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun mali yɛm na ti yɛl o, Niŋmi kaman a nira n-kpi ka a kumd o zuɣu la. Zaŋmi kuyili situra niŋ amaŋa ka di ʒe kpam, amaa kul niŋmi kaman paɣ so ŋun nir kpi ka o kumd o zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ la.
en: So Joab sent messengers to Tekoa to bring a wise woman from there. Joab said to this wise woman, Please pretend to be very sad. Put on sackcloth. Dont dress up. Act like a woman who has been crying many days for someone who died.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baɣa kul be ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi tab suhuri ni, ka di chɛ ka ti wuhiri ti yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm ka tumdi tuun suma.
en: Let us be concerned for one another, to help one another to show love and to do good.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o zuu ŋun ti yɛn di nam zan o zaani mali maligu gooni zuɣu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim. Ka suli daa gbaai Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab bɛ ya ka chɛ o.
en: He then grabbed his oldest son who was to be the next king and sacrificed him as an offering on the city wall. The Israelite troops were so horrified that they left the city and went back home.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa zaŋ kpa piɛla so n ni daa nya ka o ʒe mɔɣili nol la polo n-daa kab chaŋ o sani ni o kpiɔŋ zaa ti bibig o.
en: The goat came to the ram with the two horns. The goat was very angry and ran at the ram.

dag: Dama Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka nuhi tuumbaŋda daa mal li. Di pala Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti wurim Samaria naɣibil maa.
en: The calf is from Israel, a person made it; it is not God. The calf of Samaria will be smashed.

dag: Iso bia Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso paɣ Basɛmat yaansi.
en: Esaus son Reuel was the father of these families: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. All these families came from Esaus wife Basemath.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be o biɛhigu shee din be kasi la nyɛla kpibisi ba, ka nyɛ ŋun gbibi pakoya.
en: God, who lives in his sacred Temple, cares for orphans and protects widows.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu paai Gazanima, ka Ashikɛlɔnnim fo. Yinim Anaki zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ binyara zaŋ ŋmahiri yimaŋa?.
en: Mourning will come upon Gaza; silence will cover Ashkelon, the few left in their valley. How long will you gash yourselves in grief?.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Elihu said:.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk daa nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Shavisha daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara.
en: Zadok and Abimelech were the priests. Zadok was Ahitubs son, and Abimelech was Abiathars son. Shavsha was the scribe.

dag: bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn ye binyɛr sabilifaa la ni. Bɛ shɛb daa nyɛla Gomnanima, ka shɛb nyɛ sapashinnima. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba.
en: They were soldiers in uniforms of purple, noblemen and high-ranking officers; all of them were handsome young cavalry officers.

dag: N ŋmanila sana n dɔɣiriba sani; ka ŋmani tinzun nira m ma puuni bihi sani.
en: My own brothers treat me like a stranger. They act as if I came from a foreign land.

dag: Di saha piɛri ni ti ŋubiri mɔri nimaani kaman bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka piɛbihi mini bubihi ti ŋubiri mɔri dabari maa ni.
en: Then sheep will be able to go wherever they want and graze on the land that rich people once owned.

dag: N ni daa kana saha shɛl la, bɛ daa nyɛla biɛla; ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yipa nabimi pam, ka n yi kul ŋmaligi kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo, Yawɛ niŋdila alibarika niŋ a ni. Amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ, bɔ saha ka man lee yɛn zaŋ wolim gbaai ti n yiŋnim gba.
en: The little you had before I came has grown enormously, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I went. Now it is time for me to look out for my own interests.

dag: Ka salo pam daa doli Yisa nyaaŋa, ka paɣ shɛb daa be bɛ ni n-kuhiri ka fabind o zuɣu.
en: A large crowd was following Jesus, and in the crowd a lot of women were crying and weeping for him.

dag: Ka sagbana mi yi ti mɔhi ka sabigi asiba, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi zuŋɔ. Yi baŋdi sagbana shihira, ka lee bi tooi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ shihira.
en: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.

dag: ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋɔri maha shɛŋa din ka dabindi ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka bɛ niŋ kpam pa di zuɣu. Zaŋmi alikama zim viɛlli mali di zaa.
en: Then use fine wheat flour without yeast to make bread. And use the same things to make cakes mixed with olive oil. Make small thin cakes spread with oil.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni m pun nya dimbɔŋɔnima bee ni n nyɛla ŋun be tibi, amaa n na kul kpaŋdila mmaŋ chani tooni ni n nya Masia ni gbaai ma kpɛhi nuu ni ni n nya shɛl la.
en: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ! Ŋun Naawuni nambɔzɔbo din galisi la puuni ka ti nya nyɛvili palli o ni daa neei Yisa Masia kum ni la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka ti mali tahima nɛɔŋ.
en: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God has great mercy, and because of his mercy he gave us a new life. This new life brings us a living hope through Jesus Christs resurrection from death.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan nya ka Yɛhudianim kpuɣila Ashidɔdnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Mɔabnim bipuɣinsi n-niŋ bɛ paɣiba.
en: Also in those days I saw Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

dag: ni yi mali biɛhigu shɛli din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun boli ya kpɛh o nam ni min o jilima ni la nini.
en: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.

dag: N ni tir a jilima dabisili kam, ka kul ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: Every day I will thank you; I will praise you forever and ever.

dag: O daa lan me Baalat mini ŋun Sulemaana nɛma ni daa be tin shɛŋa ni zaa, ni o wɔribariba chɛchɛbunsi min o ni daa be tin shɛŋa ni. O daa lan me ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛŋa zaa Jɛrusalɛm mini Lɛbanɔn ni o ni daa su tin shɛŋa zaa la ni.
en: the city of Baalath, all the cities where he stored supplies, and the cities where his horses and chariots were stationed. He carried out all his plans for building in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and throughout the territory that he ruled over.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil ŋun daa be Maika yiŋ maa sanna nti bɔh o o daalaafee yɛla.
en: So they went into Micah's house, where the young Levite lived, and asked the Levite how he was getting along.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni palila ʒiŋmabo. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu. Naawuni ni ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ maligu bimbina maa, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila maa.
en: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.

dag: Zuɣulaannim kul nahindi ma mi ka di ka soli, amaa n kul lurila a yɛligu sizuura n suhu ni.
en: Rulers oppress me without cause, but my heart honors what youve said.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nya ti ni be yɛlimuɣisir shɛl ni. Jɛrusalɛm lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di n-saɣim di dunɔdaya. Dinzuɣu kamiyana ka ti lan lab me di gooni maa din ni chɛ ka ti yi vi shɛl ni ti ni be maa.
en: So I said to them, You see the trouble that were in: Jerusalem is in ruins, and its gates are destroyed by fire! Come, lets rebuild the wall of Jerusalem so that we wont continue to be in disgrace.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ zoma n-lan paai n dabili bee n-nyɛ tikpiralana n-lan paai n tumo so n ni tim? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ zoma m-paai n ni pii so, bee n-nyɛ zoma paai Yawɛ dabili?.
en: Is anyone more blind than my servant, more deaf than the messenger I send?.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal n ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya la, di daa pala ŋun tum taali la zuɣu bee o ni daa tum so taali la zuɣu, amaa di daa nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka yi baɣa ni be ti ni shɛm la yi palo Naawuni sani.
en: So although I wrote to you, it wasnt for the sake of the one who did wrong, or for the sake of the one who was wronged, but to show you your own enthusiasm for us in the sight of God.

dag: do so ŋun zaŋ o dɔni maa ŋun bom anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu ti paɣisarili maa ba, ka paɣisarili maa leeg o paɣa, o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔni o maa zuɣu, o ka soli ni o yih o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: he must pay the girls father ounces of silver. And the girl will become the mans wife, because he used her for sexual sin. He cannot divorce her all his life.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa be dunia ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti kpuɣi binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili bin la zuɣusaa zoya zuɣu, yin lihimiya! Bɛ yi ti piɛb kikaa, yin gbilisimiya tibili wum.
en: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.

dag: O daa tum tuun kara Juda fɔntinsi ni. O daa zaŋ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ti ʒili Jɛrusalɛm.
en: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n yipa leela yi dima n ni yɛli ya yɛlimaŋli zuɣu?.
en: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?.

dag: Naawuni, a yuli nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana. Chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Show your greatness in the sky, O God, and your glory over all the earth.

dag: N ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani zuɣu, n ni deeg o suhuyiɣisili hal ka o ti lan zani n nyaaŋa n-kari ma saria, ka ti ma yɛlimaŋli. O ni zaŋ ma yihi neesim ni ka n ti nya o wuntitali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I must bear the raging of the LORD, for I have sinned against him, until he decides my case and provides justice for me. He will bring me out into the light; I will see by means of his righteousness.

dag: Naa, a daa nya binnan titali. Binnani maa daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka kul nyɛlisira, ka mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Your Majesty, you were looking, and there, rising before you, was a single, massive statue. This statue was huge, shining with dazzling light, and was awesome to see.

dag: ka Yaakubu kɔbiliga daa do nimaani. Di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ na ka di ti wum o, ka o chaŋ ti ʒini kɔbiliga maa gbini ni o vuhi.
en: Jacob's well was there, and Jesus, tired out by the trip, sat down by the well. It was about noon.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu lala zaŋ nachiinsi nɛma din nyɛ tibikpara mini nintuhi ni bansi ni salima nɛma zaa na. Sokam daa zaŋla salima na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Both men and women came forward. Everyone who was eager to participate brought pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces, all sorts of gold objects. Everyone raised an uplifted offering of gold to the LORD.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni Alikauli Adaka la tooni, n ni kani a sanna luɣ shɛl la.
en: Then you will place them in the meeting tent in front of the chest containing the covenant, where I meet you.

dag: Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa kul palila zinaniŋdiba. Noli yɛlibu la zuɣu, tiŋgbɔŋ maa kumdimi ka biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee kuui. Bɛ tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ tuma pala din tuhi.
en: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts.

dag: A chɛ ka a niriba di wahala pam; a ti ti la wain ka ti nyu, ka di chɛ ka ti chani jeena.
en: Youve made your people suffer hardship; youve given us wine and we stagger.

dag: Dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni daa be Gɛshur Aram tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa lo alikauli yɛli, Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka n labi Jɛrusalɛm, n ni jɛm o Hiburɔn. .
en: when I was living with the Arameans in Geshur. I promised that if the Lord would bring me back to live in Jerusalem, I would worship him in Hebron.

dag: Hal Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda, amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Farisiinim zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ yihi li palo, ka Farisiinim maa ti kari ba bɛ jɛmbu duu;.
en: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.

dag: Ka do so daa nya o ka yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, n nyala Absalom ka o yili oki tia zuɣu.
en: One of the men saw this and reported to Joab, I just saw Absalom hanging from an oak tree.

dag: ni Ira mini Garɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Jatir niriba la.
en: Ira from Ither; Gareb from Ither.

dag: ka yi ni niŋ di mini di naa kaman yi ni daa niŋ Jɛriko mini di naa shɛm la. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ni dina, dimiya tiŋ maa nɛma zaŋ tabili di biŋkɔbiri. Chamiya ti sɔɣi dɔni tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa polo.
en: You are to do to Ai and its king what you did to Jericho and its king, but this time you may keep its goods and livestock for yourselves. Prepare to attack the city by surprise from the rear.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Ahija, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na. Dama din dali maa Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali chaŋ.
en: Saul said to Ahijah, Bring Gods Holy Box.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal n ni daa kul zaŋ ba tahi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa yoli, mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha biɛla shɛli bɛ ni daa be tinsi maa ni maa.
en: Therefore, say, The LORD God proclaims: Even though I made them go far away among the nations and caused them to scatter throughout the earth, Ive provided some sanctuary for them in the countries to which theyve gone.

dag: Gbaamiya saawara, amaa di ku ku buchi. Tɔɣisimiya gbaai yi ni lo shɛm, amaa di ku zani, dama Naawuni be ti sani.
en: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti guli bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ gbarima ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman Dauda la. Ka Dauda zuliya maa ni ti gari tooni m-be kaman Yawɛ malaika la bee Naawuni maŋmaŋ la m-mali ba chana.
en: On that day the LORD will protect the inhabitants of Jerusalem. Anyone among them who stumbles on that day will become like David, and Davids house will become like God, like the LORDs messenger in front of them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Miunnim shɛb daa ti lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: Later, the Moabites, the Ammonites, and some Meunites came to start a war with Jehoshaphat.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bindira pam pal a kambɔna, ka wain pal a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: Then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will burst with wine.

dag: N ni ŋuhiri pampam zuɣu, n kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a sɔɣi ka zilinli fiɛbiga ku paag a, ka saɣiŋgu yi ti paag a, a ku zɔri li.
en: You will be hidden from the tongues sting, and you wont fear destruction when it comes.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Izraɛl anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, yɛlim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! .
en: Son of man, you must speak to the prophets of Israel for me. They are only saying what they want to say. You must speak to them. Tell them this: Listen to this message from the Lord !.

dag: M bia, zom Yawɛ ka zom naa, ka miri ka a zaɣisi bɛ so noli;.
en: Have reverence for the Lord , my child, and honor the king. Have nothing to do with people who rebel against them;.

dag: Shihir shɛŋa Naawuni ni wuhiri ti mal alahiziba! Alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa o ni tumdi mali yiko pam. Naawuni nam nyɛla nam din ka bahigu, ka o kul ni nyɛ Naa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: God has done amazing miracles! He has done powerful miracles! His kingdom continues forever; his rule will continue for all generations.

dag: Kulla Yisa ka ti naɣ nya! Naawuni daa chɛ ka o pooi malaikanim saha biɛla puuni ni ŋun Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu chɛ ka o kpi sokam zaa zuɣu. Ka ti nya ka o mali jiri mini jilima pumpɔŋɔ o ni daa di wahala kpi kum shɛl la zuɣu.
en: But we do see Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels, so that through God's grace he should die for everyone. We see him now crowned with glory and honor because of the death he suffered.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa dɔɣi Manaasa mini Ifriim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Pɔtifɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga Asɛnat la ni daa dɔɣi shɛb ti o m-bala.
en: To Joseph, in the land of Egypt, were born Manasseh and Ephraim. Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of Heliopolis, bore them to him.

dag: Ka yu shɛli sabi pa o binyɛrigu min o gbalipini zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: He has a name written on his robe and on his thigh: King of kings and Lord of lords.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ni kpi, amaa ŋun gbilisi tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga ni di shɛhira viɛlli.
en: Witnesses who lie will be caught and punished. A careful listener will always be there to speak up.

dag: ka kaɣ yi kpaŋ ha kaman nir ni ni tooi to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti lu luɣ shɛli tariga ti ʒini, ka yɛli, N je ni n nini nya bia ŋɔ bahibu. O ni daa kaɣ yi kpaŋa nti ʒiya ka chɛ o maa, ka duh o yee kuhi.
en: Then she walked a short distance away and sat down. She thought her son would die because there was no water. She did not want to watch him die. She sat there and began to cry.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa saɣi, ka zahim Ɛfurɔn ni daa yɛli anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisinahi shɛli Hitinim maa ninni maa ti Ɛfurɔn; ka di nyɛ kaman kɔhigɔriba ni daa zahindi li shɛm.
en: Abraham understood that Ephron was telling him the price of the land. So Abraham paid him for the land. He weighed out ten pounds of silver for Ephron and gave it to the merchant.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra, ka Mɛmfisi nabihi nyɛ bɛn yɔhindi niriba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri birigi Ijiptinima.
en: The leaders of Zoan and Memphis are fools. They were supposed to lead the nation, but they have misled it.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla man ŋuna, mani m-be yi nuu ni maa. Niŋmiya ma kaman yi ni kul nya ka shɛli viɛla ka tuhi yi sani.
en: But me? Im in your hands. Do whatever you would like to me.

dag: Aai! N yɛri ya mi ni shee yi niŋ tuuba, di yi pa lala yi zaa gba ni ti bahi yoli.
en: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani; Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our place of safety. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Yulimiya bo n-nya ŋun tooi ŋmɛri mɔɣilo viɛnyɛliŋga ti ma na.
en: Saul ordered them, Find me a man who plays well and bring him to me.

dag: Amaa ka farigudeera maa ʒe o ko ha, ka bi saɣi ni o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka naɣ kul malila o nuhi bur o nyɔɣu ka yɛra, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, zom man alahichilan ŋɔ nambɔɣu.
en: The tax collector stood off at a distance and did not think he was good enough even to look up toward heaven. He was so sorry for what he had done that he pounded his chest and prayed, God, have pity on me! I am such a sinner.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiɛm wuhibu ni bo bahiyoli ti bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn tiri zaligu jilima ni nya laara.
en: Trouble will come on those who despise a word, but those who respect the commandment will be rewarded.

dag: do so ŋun zaŋ o dɔni maa ŋun bom anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu ti paɣisarili maa ba, ka paɣisarili maa leeg o paɣa, o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔni o maa zuɣu, o ka soli ni o yih o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: He is to pay her father the bride price of fifty pieces of silver, and she is to become his wife, because he forced her to have intercourse with him. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi ni noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋ zaa bɛba ayiyi, zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: A male and a female of every kind of animal and bird, whether ritually clean or unclean.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi kana nti yɛl o, N dana, n-nyɛ a pɔŋli la. N daa zaŋ li gbinila binchɛra ni sɔɣi.
en: Then another servant came in and said to the king, Sir, here is your bag of money. I wrapped it in a piece of cloth and hid it.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti ʒe Gɛnɛsarɛt Teeku noli, ka niriba pam kpaɣiri chan o sani ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Jesus was standing on the shore of Lake Gennesaret, teaching the people as they crowded around him to hear God's message.

dag: nti lihi Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni vinvamli la zaa polo n-nya ka nyɔhi din ŋmani mɔɣu din galisi pam buɣim nyɔhi la kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: and looked out over Sodom and Gomorrah and over all the land of the valley. He saw the smoke from the land rise like the smoke from a kiln.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayɔbu saha, ka Baasha bia Ɛla daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuma ayi.
en: Elah son of Baasha became king during the th year that Asa was the king of Judah. He ruled in Tirzah for two years.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ni chɛ ka yi kpe daɣiri ni m-bɔŋɔ, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛlikam ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o dabili zooi kaman bimbilin shɛli din jila ba tiŋa tiŋkuŋ ni. Ti ni daa nya o, o daa ka dariza bee viɛlim. Shɛli daa ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu lihibu ni din ni chɛ ka ti bɔr o.
en: He grew up like a young plant before us, like a root from dry ground. He possessed no splendid form for us to see, no desirable appearance.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Nyama, n ni kana kaman tayiɣ la! Ŋum bi gbihiri ka mal o binyɛra zali ni o di ti chaŋ o zaɣim n-dih omaŋ vi mal alibarika.
en: Remember Christ says, When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.

dag: ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ku bɛ ni bɛn mali kpiɔŋ. O daa booi Izraɛl nachimbihi gahinda kalinli.
en: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Jokimiam mini Bɛtihɔrɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: Jokmeam with its pasturelands, Beth-horon with its pasturelands.

dag: Wuntizɔriba solɔɣu nyɛla din lɔɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛmaŋ bɛ soli ni nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya.
en: The road of those who do right turns away from evil; those who protect their path guard their lives.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Di nyɛla ʒiri. M bi yɛn zo n-doli Babilɔnnim maa chaŋ. Amaa ka Irija daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum o yɛligu maa, ka gbaai Jɛrimia n-zaŋ o ti ti kpambaliba.
en: I'm not trying to join them! I answered. But Irijah wouldn't listen, and he took me to the king's officials.

dag: ka chɛ ka o su binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi. Di yɛliya ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ninsala n-leei ŋun su binshɛɣukam fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni shɛli kani ka Naawuni bi wuhi ni ninsal su li, amaa ti bi nya ka ninsal su binshɛɣukam zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: You put everything under their control. When he puts everything under their control, he doesnt leave anything out of control. But right now, we dont see everything under their control yet.

dag: Dandiɛɣu n-daa mali o bipuɣinsi ayi, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Tim ti, tim ti. Bina pam beni n-nyɛ din bi tiɣira. Di puuni diba anahi din kpɛm pam n-nyɛ:.
en: The leech has two daughters: Give, give! There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, Enough.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka tɔbu mini kum ku ba maa bahi Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu, so ti ku beni ŋun ni sɔɣi bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi. Dama n ni ti zaŋ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba.
en: And the people they spoke to will be thrown into the streets. The people will die from hunger and war. I will punish them, and no one will be there to bury them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ! Ka niriba maa zaa daa kpuɣi bɛ nuhi zuɣusaa ka yɛra, Ami! Ami! Di saha ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God, and all of the people answered, Amen! Amen! while raising their hands. Then they bowed down and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa gindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yihiri waazu, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka shihir shɛŋa din wuhiri ni lahibal suŋ maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli niŋda.
en: But they went out and proclaimed the message everywhere. The Lord worked with them, confirming the word by the signs associated with them.

dag: Naawuni daa tɔɣisiri ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa la anabinim noya ni siɣimsiɣim bu shɛm soya balibu pam ni;.
en: In the past God spoke to our people through the prophets. He spoke to them many times and in many different ways.

dag: O dimnima n-leei bɛn su o; o dimnim maa kul tɔŋdimi, dama Yawɛ chɛ ka o nya wahala. O biriginsim din galisi zuɣu; o dimnim gbah o bihi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Her enemies succeeded; they hold her in their power. The Lord has made her suffer for all her many sins; Her children have been captured and taken away.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na chana, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna nti tiriti wuhir o Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duri.
en: Jesus left and was going away from the Temple when his disciples came to him to call his attention to its buildings.

dag: ka nyɛ Keenannim ni daa su tiŋgban shɛl la zaa mini Miara din nyɛ Sidɔnnim ni daa su luɣ shɛl la zaŋ ti paai Afɛk ni zaŋ hal ti paai Amɔrinim tintariga la.
en: in the south. The whole land of the Canaanites, along with Mearah, which belongs to the Sidonians, as far as Aphek and as far as the Amorite border.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila jɛr so ŋun daa me o yili zali bihigu ni.
en: Whoever hears these teachings of mine and does not obey them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

dag: Yisa nyaandol so daa be Damaskus maa ka o yuli booni Ananias. Ka o daa ti nya ʒii, ka ti Duuma bol o di ni, Ananias! Ka o saɣi n-yɛli, N-nyɛ ma, n Duuma.
en: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, Lord, here I am.

dag: Yi lihirila binyara niŋgbuŋkom. So be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla Masia nira? Di simdi ni dilan teeg omaŋa ni ti gba nyɛla Masia niriba kaman o ni nyɛ Masia nir shɛm.
en: Look at what is right in front of you! If anyone is sure about belonging to Christ, that person should think again. We belong to Christ just like that person.

dag: Doo yi goli biŋkɔbigu, bɛn kum o, ka ku biŋkɔbigu maa gba.
en: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.

dag: Ka Gomna maa daa lan bɔhi ba pahi, Niriba ayi maa ni, ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Barabas.
en: The governor said, Which of the two do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, they replied.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kpuɣim tɔbu mini piɛma; ka o kpuɣi tɔbu mini piɛma maa.
en: Grab a bow and some arrows, Elisha told him, and hold them in your hand. Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand.

dag: O yi ti paana yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli n-nya ba lala, bɛ ni nya alibarika.
en: Those servants might have to wait until midnight or later for their master. But they will be glad they did when he comes in and finds them still waiting.

dag: Bɛn daa fiɣis o maa ni daa yiɣisi zani bɛ daa bi zaŋ yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni zaŋ o tɔɣisi.
en: The Jews stood up and accused him. But they did not accuse him of the kind of crimes I thought they would.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi ni o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu ka lala daa niŋ maa.
en: This happened because Jeroboam aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by the sins that he committed and that he caused Israel to commit.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ Jeemsi mini Jɔn.
en: Now when the other ten disciples heard about this, they became angry with James and John.

dag: Amaa ka Nabɔt yɛli Ɛhab, Yawɛ di wuhi gba, ka n zaŋ n yaannim fali ti a.
en: Naboth answered, By the Lord , I will never give my land to you. This land belongs to my family.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu nimaani ka o yɛli ma, Yiɣisim zani n-chaŋ vinvamli ni ka n ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: The Lord s power came to me. He said to me, Get up and go to the valley. I will speak to you in that place.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, neemiya, neemiya! Yiɣisimiya zani. Yi nyu Yawɛ ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo binnyur shɛl la buɣi. Yi nyu li, ka di chɛ ka yi chani laana.
en: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord 's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima n-nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn daŋ gbahi shɛb kuli tinduya ni, ka yi churi puhibu mini yi suhuyubu maa zani tariga.
en: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ti gba, ti ni daa nyɛ bihi ka na bi zooi wuntia soli dolibu ni la, ti daa nyɛla bɛn be dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni.
en: It is the same for us. We were once like children, slaves to the useless rules of this world.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: The vultures gather wherever theres a dead body.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bu jɛrigu ŋun gariti paa bee m-bu ŋun nyu dam kuli paa ŋmanila peentɔra ŋun tɔri sokam piɛma tiri ba dansi.
en: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb tinzun tiŋ ni maa ni ti yɛli ya, Ti ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ pɔra; bomiya palo pahi ti ka ti ʒini.
en: You were sad for the children you lost, but they will tell you, This place is too small! Give us a bigger place to live.

dag: Di saɣiya Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm maa. Dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Kamiyana ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ma din ni chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino tooi di omaŋmaŋ tiwala min o fiig tia wala, ka nyu omaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga ni kom.
en: Don't listen to Hezekiah! The emperor of Assyria commands you to come out of the city and surrender. You will all be allowed to eat grapes from your own vines and figs from your own trees, and to drink water from your own wells—.

dag: faashee n ni daa ti chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka n naanyi baŋ bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa min o gbaŋ ni o nimdi ni o bindi dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: But the rest of the bull, including its hide, its flesh, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp just as the LORD had commanded him.

dag: Zaŋmi dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba; ka kpammi ba jaande, ka kpahimi bɛn wumd a wuhibu zuɣu ni a fukumsi zaa subu puuni. Di chɛ ka so ʒiɛm a.
en: Talk about these things. Encourage and correct with complete authority. Dont let anyone disrespect you.

dag: Mbaye, ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm! N na mi m-be kaman tiŋgban nɛl la Izraɛlnim sani? Bee n na mi m-be kaman zibisim titali ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni shɛm la? Ka wula ka yi yɛra, Ti sula timaŋa, ti ku lan lab a sanna.
en: People of this generation, listen closely to the LORDs word: Have I been a wasteland to Israel or a land of dense darkness? Why then do my people say, We have wandered far away; well come to you no longer?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yinim Judanim zaa mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Wummiya; Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di zɔriya dabiɛm, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri salo pam zuɣu, dama tɔb maa pala yi dini, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni dini.
en: Jahaziel said, Your Majesty and all you people of Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you must not be discouraged or be afraid to face this large army. The battle depends on God, not on you.

dag: Amaa nir yi daag o kpee luhi, ka di pala o dima n-nyɛ o bee n-zaŋ binshɛli lab o kpee ka di pala o dɔnimi gu o.
en: But suppose you accidentally kill someone you do not hate, whether by pushing him down or by throwing something at him.

dag: O daa deei liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba sani anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu, ka di nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga la.
en: and it amounted to , pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli zali maa zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili gili. Dina n-nyɛ luɣ kasi shee zaŋ tabili tiŋ maa tiŋgban la.
en: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal bɛ ni ti fa tɔbbihi daba, ka fa na biɛɣu ni di neen shɛŋa. N ni tuhi yi mini bɛn tuhira, ka fa yi bihi bahi.
en: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha waɣa? Kurimbuni ha ka m pun lo lala, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ maa. Dina n-nyɛ: Ni a saɣim fɔntin kara, ka di leei dabari.
en: That is what you said, but havent you heard what I said? I planned it long ago; from ancient times I planned it. And now I have made it happen. I let you tear down the strong cities and change them into piles of rocks.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani kuli. Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda bɛ ni niŋ tuumba maa shɛm, ka o daa tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka Naa daa yɛli tuumba maa, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti lan bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: When this was reported to David, he sent messengers to the men because they were completely ashamed. The king said, Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown. Then you can come back.

dag: So ku lan wum girigiri yɛla yi tiŋgban ni. Ka so mi ku lan saɣim yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yaha. N ni be kaman gooni la n-taɣi ya ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu; ka yi paɣi ma n ni tiligi ya zuɣu.
en: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. Victory will be the name you give to your walls; Praise will be the name you give to your gates.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ leei Naawuni zaligu karimbanima, amaa ka lee bi baŋdi bɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-tɔɣisiri maa gbinni bee m-mi bɛ ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ka tɔɣisiri di yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.

dag: O daa ʒe yim ŋun piig o maa sani kaman Anabi Musa ni daa ʒe yim o tuma ni Naawuni niriba sani shɛm la.
en: Jesus was faithful to the one who appointed him just like Moses was faithful in Gods house.

dag: Di zaa yoli ka Firawuna daa na kul niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm la.
en: The king, however, remained stubborn and, just as the Lord had said, the king would not listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yi ŋmanila mɔɣu ni buŋa ŋun be tiŋgban nɛli ni. O yi ti kpabigi, o ʒiɛmi taɣiri ʒiɛɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yih o kɔre maa ni? Bɛnkam bɔr o bi lan yɛn nahim bɛmaŋa, o bɔbu goli yi zani, bɛ ni nya o.
en: a wild donkey in the wilderness, lustfully sniffing the wind. Who can restrain such passion? Those who desire her need not give up; with little effort they will find her in heat.

dag: O daa va malaika n-nyaŋ o, ka kuhi niŋ o n-suh o bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka o daa ti nya Naawuni Bɛtɛl, ka Naawuni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: he fought against an angel and won. He wept and asked for a blessing. And at Bethel God came to our ancestor Jacob and spoke with him.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋun yɛn wurim Mɔabnim fɔntinsi ka ku bɛ nachimbihi viɛla la kana.
en: But I am the Lord , the all-powerful King, and I promise that enemies will overpower your towns. Even your best warriors will die in the battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Asiria na, ka o niriba bɛn kpalim maa dol li kaman o ni daa mali soli ti Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na la.
en: Then there will be a highway from Assyria for the survivors of Gods people who are left from Assyria, just as there was for Israel on the day they went up from the land of Egypt.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, Ka a luɣ shɛli ka galimi.
en: My darling, you are lovely in every way.

dag: Di saha man gba ni saɣi ni amaŋmaŋ nudirigu ni tooi ti a nasara.
en: Then I will be the first to praise you and admit that you won the victory yourself.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛriko la ni daa nya Ilaisha ka o miri ba na ka bɛ yɛli, Ilaija shia la shiri be Ilaisha ni. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa.
en: The fifty prophets from Jericho saw him and said, The power of Elijah is on Elisha! They went to meet him, bowed down before him.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N ku chaŋ; n ni labi n dɔɣiriba sani ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: No, I won't go, Hobab answered. I'm returning home to be with my own people.

dag: Ti mi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, dama Naawuni Bia la n-gbib o ka ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: We know that no children of God keep on sinning, for the Son of God keeps them safe, and the Evil One cannot harm them.

dag: dama bɛ bari ma la zana, ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ ni bɛ di n nyɛvili, ka di ka daliri.
en: Without any reason they laid a trap for me and dug a deep hole to catch me.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bimparilan shɛli din pari gbɛɣu zuɣu ka di nyɛ din be kasi, ka sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni mali nintu shɛli dalinli dihiri tabindi binyara zuɣu la. Sabbu maa n-daa nyɛ: O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: The words Dedicated to the Lord were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni mali ba, ka bɛ neei kaman machɛli ni maani kurugu shɛm la, ka buɣisi ba nya. Dama wula ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ n niriba bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ?.
en: Therefore, the LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Im going to refine and test them, for what else can I do with my people?.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dauda daa yɛli, Ŋunkam bɔr ni o ku Jɛbusinim ŋɔ ŋun yim na nti doli ko bɔbili ŋɔ chaŋ ti ku zoomba mini gbariti ŋɔ, dama man Dauda suhu je bɛ yɛlli zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli ni zoomba mini gbariti ku tooi kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu la.
en: On that day, David said, whoever attacks the Jebusites should strike the windpipe because David hates the lame and the blind. That is why people say, The blind and the lame will not enter the temple.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu deeri birapu ashilɔni ni di chɛ ka o taɣi zaligu soya.
en: The wicked take secret bribes to twist the way of justice.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa tim ti boli Jɔab ni o kana ka o tim o naa sani, amaa ka Jɔab daa zaɣisi kandina. Ka o lan tim pahi buyi, amaa ka Jɔab kul bahi zaɣisi kandina.
en: Absalom called for Joab in order to send Joab to the king, but Joab refused to come. Absalom called for Joab a second time, but he still wouldnt come.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛrɔta ni Sibiraim . N-zaŋ hal ni Hazɛrihatikɔn fɔntiŋ din be Hauran tintariga la.
en: Berothah, and Sibraim, which is on the border between the two kingdoms of Damascus and Hamath. The border will end at Hazer-Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.

dag: Yawɛ yuli nyɛla din du pam ka mali yaa, ka wuntizɔriba zɔri kpɛri di ni tiligira.
en: The name of the Lord is like a strong tower. Those who do what is right can run to him for protection.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi, ka o chaŋ Ɛhab sani Samaria. Ka Ɛhab daa kɔri piɛri mini niɣi pam n-niŋ o mini bɛn daa kana saani, ka daa balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima.
en: A few years later, while Jehoshaphat was visiting Ahab in Samaria, Ahab slaughtered many sheep and oxen for Jehoshaphat and those who were with him in order to persuade him to attack Ramoth-gilead.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Ti Duuma n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni.
en: You can eat it, because the earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.

dag: Bɛ yi darigi ansarisimaana tibili, bɛn bi mi leerila yɛnnima, bɛ yi wuhi yɛnnim shɛli, bɛ baŋsim pahirimi.
en: When a mocker is punished, the naive person gains wisdom; when insight comes to the wise, knowledge increases.

dag: Ka sapashinnim bɛn daa su chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi maa ni daa nya ka di pala Izraɛl naa maa ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ o.
en: When the chariot officers realized that he wasnt Israels king, they stopped chasing him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di n-tiɣi zaa, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ laɣisim bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi din guui maa zaa ka di shɛli ku bahi yoli.
en: When they were all full, he said to his disciples, Gather the pieces left over; let us not waste a bit.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-su ti nyɔtaɣirigu, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-su ti naa.
en: You, O Lord , chose our protector; you, the Holy God of Israel, gave us our king.

dag: Ka laakuma kalinli nyɛ kɔbisinahi ni pihitanaanu. Ka bunsi mi kalinli nyɛ tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisi.
en: camels, and , donkeys.

dag: Lahibali suŋ din yi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni katiŋ na ŋmanila kɔnyuri ni yi wum nir ka o ti nya komahili la.
en: Good news from a distant land is like cold water for a weary person.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Jɔshua ti zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini salo maa zaa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord . Moses told Joshua to stand before Eleazar the priest and all the Israelites.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ŋmalig o sani n-chaŋ shɛb sani nti lan yɛli lala yaha; ka niriba maa gba garigi yɛl o kaman bɛn la ni pun yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: He turned to some other people and asked them the same questions. They gave him the same answers as before.

dag: Malim a tuma shili samban ni, ka tum a pu tuma naai, di nyaaŋa ka a naanyi me a yili.
en: First get your fields ready, next plant your crops, and then build your house.

dag: Ka yi mali gɔpiɛliga dapuhi, ka niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Make carrying poles of acacia wood, cover them with bronze.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, o gba ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi ŋɔ, hal ka ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa din gari dimbɔŋɔnima, dama n chanila m Ba maa sani.
en: I assure you that whoever believes in me will do the works that I do. They will do even greater works than these because I am going to the Father.

dag: Izraɛlnim nyɛla daba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛb niŋ dabitim ni? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka niriba fari ba?.
en: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Alushi maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Rɛfidim, ka kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu.
en: Next was Rephidim, where there was no water for them to drink.

dag: amaa a yi ku chɛ ka o dol ti chaŋ, ti ku chaŋ, dama doo maa daa yɛl ti, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yi ti ku nya n ninni. .
en: But if you refuse to send Benjamin, we will not go. The man warned us to not come back without him.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ piim tiliginsim tinsi kaman n ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: Say to the Israelites, Set up refuge cities for yourselves. I spoke to you about these through Moses.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni maa biɛɣu pinaanahi dali, yin ti puhimiya Yaɣigari chuɣu, ka sokam ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the fourteenth day of the first month you will begin the celebration of the Passover Festival. For seven days everyone will eat bread made without yeast.

dag: dama a yi dee li niŋ a kɔbili ni, ka di zaa be a noli ni, di viɛla.
en: It will be pleasant if you keep the words in you, if you have them ready on your lips.

dag: Miri ka a doli ninvuɣ biɛri soli. Miri ka a doli tuumbiɛtumdiba soli.
en: Dont go on the way of the wicked; dont walk on the path of evil people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu yi yi bi chɛri yi mabihi taali paŋdi ba yi suhuri ni, lala ka m Ba Naawuni gba ti yɛn niŋ yi zaa yinoyino.
en: And Jesus concluded, That is how my Father in heaven will treat every one of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.

dag: Timiya o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima. Chɛliya ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmdi Yawɛ mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la yɛli, Ami! Ka kpamba la mi daa gban tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: The four living creatures answered, Amen! And the elders fell down and worshiped.

dag: M bɔri ni a baŋ ni n ni be a sani, ka gbib a luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ, ka ni ti zaŋ a labisi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni na. Dama n kul ku chɛ a hal ti niŋ n ni lo a alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm maa.
en: Remember, I will be with you and protect you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done all that I have promised you.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so daa ti nya Pita ni ʒi buɣim maa neesim ni n-lihir o ka ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ gba yi be Yisa sani.
en: A servant girl saw him sitting there. She could see because of the light from the fire. She looked closely at Peters face. Then she said, This man was also with Jesus.

dag: Ka Matitia ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yino ka nyɛ Shallum ŋun daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ nir la bituuli la daa su mahi parilana malibu fukumsi.
en: A Levite named Mattithiah, oldest son of Shallum, of the clan of Korah, was responsible for preparing the baked offerings.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini jilima n-nyɛ o situra, o suhu bi zɔhiri saha shɛŋa din kanna zuɣu.
en: Strength and honor are her clothing; she is confident about the future.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Zikiri bia Amasia ŋun daa saɣi n-zaŋ omaŋ niŋ Yawɛ tuma ni la. O mi daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisiyi.
en: and third was Amasiah son of Zichri, with .

dag: Amaa Naawuni Kundi wuhiya ni sokam zaa bela alahichi sulinsi ni ni di chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu puuni la tooi paai bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka shihir shɛli daa lan puhi zani alizanda ni yaha. Waɣ ʒiɛ biɛ titali ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin mini yila pia, ka nam zuɣupilis ayopɔin pil o zuɣuri maa daa yina ʒiɛya.
en: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.

dag: N saɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛlli ŋɔ puuni m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ zaɣ suŋ nyabu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi naai yi ni daa piligi niŋdi shɛli yuuni la ha. Di pa ni yi daa daŋmi piligi li kɔŋko, amaa yi daa daŋmi yu ni yi niŋ li.
en: Im giving you my opinion about this. Its to your advantage to do this, since you not only started to do it last year but you wanted to do it too.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛl o mi, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yɛlim Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa n ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa.
en: the LORD said to him, I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh, Egypts king, everything that Ive said to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku shini n noli, N ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni biɛrim pam n shia ni. N ni fabili ni naŋgbantom n suhu ni.
en: So I will not be quiet! I will let my suffering spirit speak! I will let my bitter soul complain!.

dag: Ka Jabɛshi kpamba daa yɛl o, Tim ti daba ayopɔin ka ti tim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ti yɛl ba, ka so yi kani ŋun ni fa ti bahi, di saha ti ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a.
en: The town leaders said, Give us seven days so we can send messengers everywhere in Israel to ask for help. If no one comes here to save us, we will surrender to you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, a wuhiri ba ni a gba bela kasi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, a wuhiri ba a ninkuunsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You are pure to those who are pure, but hostile to those who are wicked.

dag: Bɛ lan labimi ti tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bɛ yaannim bɛn daa zaɣisi n nol la ni daa tumdi kurimbuni ha la. Bɛ jɛmdila wuna. Izraɛlnim mini Judanim saɣim n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli maa.
en: They have gone back to the sins of their ancestors, who refused to do what I said; they have worshiped other gods. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant that I made with their ancestors.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum n yɛla, bɛ daa paɣi ma mi, ka bɛn nina daa nya ma mi di ma shɛhira.
en: All who heard me said good things about me. Those who saw what I did praised me.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa ni piɛbihi la zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Offer with them all the other offerings required for the first day.

dag: Kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛr mia barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka lan be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la, ka di daa kpɛrila kom litanim tuhi pihinahi.
en: The Sea was as thick as the width of a hand. Its rim was shaped like a cup or an open lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣiri ŋmanila gbal yari. Bɛ zaa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Its weapons are deadly; its warriors are many.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, ti di nasara yaɣi Masia ŋun yuri ti la zuɣu.
en: But in all these troubles we have complete victory through God, who has shown his love for us.

dag: Nir yi ku ninsala, ka ninvuɣ bɔbili di li shɛhira, bɛn kum ninvuɣ kura maa, amaa di bi tuhi ni bɛ ku so ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: Those accused of murder may be found guilty and put to death only on the evidence of two or more witnesses; the evidence of one witness is not sufficient to support an accusation of murder.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani.
en: A little while before morning, Jesus came walking on the water toward his disciples.
