dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba daŋ bɛn daa kuli yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Ziha mini Hasufa ni Tabayɔt ni.
en: The family of Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth.

dag: Jɛrimia daa sabila yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn lu Babilɔnnim zuɣu mini yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa sabi zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo la.
en: Jeremiah wrote down in a single scroll all the disasters that would happen to Babylon—all these things concerning Babylon.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣir a; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: Lord , you are worthy of praise! Teach me your laws.

dag: Ka ti niŋ yɛda ka mi ni nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: We believe and know that you are Gods holy one.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma. Yawɛ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma.
en: Please, Lord , rescue me! Lord , hurry and help me!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ me bimbini tam Ɛbal Zol zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua built an altar for the Lord , the God of Israel. He built the altar on Mount Ebal.

dag: Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Yisa.
en: You will become pregnant and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Naa Dauda daa bol o o Duuma? O daa yɛliya:.
en: Jesus said to them, Then why did David call him Lord? David was speaking by the power of the Spirit. He said.

dag: Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa ʒini tuhi Yisifu. Ŋun nyɛ bɛ kpɛma n-daa daŋ ʒinibu, ka bɛn paya ʒini tuɣi hal ti paai bɛ biasani, ka di daa gari niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba.
en: They were seated in front of him from the oldest to the youngest in their exact birth order, and the men looked at each other with amazement.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi nini tiɣi yi yɛm pam, ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla yɛnnima.
en: You are doomed! You think you are wise, so very clever.

dag: bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: What could you give to get back your soul?.

dag: O yi yɛli, Di viɛla, binshɛli ku lan niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; o mi suhu yi yiɣisi, dindina nyin baŋmi ni o lo zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: If your father says, Fine, then I am safe. But if your father becomes angry, you will know that he wants to hurt me.

dag: A yurilim maŋli nyɛla din du m-paai zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mali hal ti paai sagbana.
en: because your faithful love is as high as heaven; your faithfulness reaches the clouds.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni kaman a ni niŋ bɛ ba shɛm maa, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma, ka kpam booi bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni maa ni ti ba soli ka bɛ kul nyɛ maligumaaniba sahakam bɛ ʒiɛman ni.
en: Anoint them like you anointed their father so that they may serve me as priests. Their anointing is to the priesthood for all time in every generation.

dag: nti zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu maa m-booi di ni kpam bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa; ka yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi, ka di niŋ zinchili.
en: Take the jug of oil and pour it on his head. Then say, This is what the LORD has said: I anoint you king of Israel. Then open the door, and run out of there without stopping.

dag: A yi ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ suhuri zɔhirimi. A yi deei bɛ vuhim, bɛ kpirimi n-lab taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: When you turn away, they are afraid; when you take away your breath, they die and go back to the dust from which they came.

dag: dindina yi ni zɔri tɔb shɛli maa ni liri ya nimaani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka yi ni zɔri kum shɛl la ni doli ya kpe Ijipti, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: then the war you fear will seize you in the land of Egypt; and the famine you dread will hunt you down in Egypt, and there you will die.

dag: ka lan fari pakoya yinsi, ka suhiri Naawuni yuuri ni niriba tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam.
en: who take advantage of widows and rob them of their homes, and then make a show of saying long prayers! Their punishment will be all the worse.

dag: di zaa yoli, a ni zaŋ ma bahi daɣiri ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ situra gba zaɣisi ma.
en: then youll hurl me into a slimy pit so that my clothes detest me.

dag: Timoti yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli, dama o tumdila ti Duuma tuma kaman n ni tumdi shɛm.
en: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa ŋmalig o sani o ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa n-lab alizanda ni.
en: After God had gone.

dag: Lala ka Zara daa be; o daa deei ti yab Ibrahimma noli, hal ka boon o la o duuma. Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi yi tumdi din viɛla ka bi chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri shɛli zuɣu, dina n-ni wuhi ni yi nyɛla Zara yaansi.
en: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.

dag: N vu n tiliginsim mirina, ka di shee bi wɔɣa. N tiliginsim maa kandina ku yuui. N ni tiligi Jɛrusalɛm, ka di ti Izraɛlnim jilima.
en: Im bringing my victory near—it isnt far, and my salvation—it wont delay. I will establish salvation in Zion and grant my splendor to Israel.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli naa N ni daa be n ya ka wum a tuma min a yɛm yɛla shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n nya n ni suhiri bɔri shɛli ŋɔ, m bi zaɣisi ka Naawuni ti ma n suhu ni bɔri shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Oh, that what Ive requested would come and God grant my hope.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n jɛrigiya pam ni bɛ boli ma daadam. N ka daadam tɛhi zilima.
en: I am far too stupid to be considered human.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi dim bindirigu n-nya kpiɔŋ, dama yi ni so zabigu zaɣ yini ku bɔrigi.
en: I urge you to take some food. Your health depends on it. None of you will lose a single hair from his head.

dag: Hal yinim Izraɛlnim ni tum bi ʒe yim tuma maa zaa yoli, di bi simdi ni di zuɣu chɛ ka Judanim gba kpe taali ni. Di kpɛnya Giligal tiŋ puuni bee n-kpɛnya Bɛtavɛn, ka miriya ka yi po n-yɛli Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Israel, just because you act like a prostitute doesnt mean that Judah should feel guilty too. People, dont go to Gilgal or Beth Aven. Dont use the Lords name to make promises. Dont say, As the Lord lives ....

dag: Ka naa maa daa tim ti boli Haman na yomyom ni bɛ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ Ɛsta sani ni bɛ ti di ka nyu binnyura maa.
en: Hurry, get Haman, the king ordered, so we can do what Esther says. So the king and Haman came to the feast that Esther had prepared.

dag: Dindali maa, yɛlimiya yi bihi Yawɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa tin ya shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la, di zuɣu ka yi puhiri di chuɣu maa.
en: When the festival begins, explain to your sons that you do all this because of what the Lord did for you when you left Egypt.

dag: ka tim a ba min a ma jilima; ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.

dag: ni Amam ni Shɛma ni Molada.
en: Amam, Shema, Moladah.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba n-tum kaman Ɛhab min o daŋ ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o paɣ daa nyɛla Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel.

dag: Ka biɛhigu ti ku niŋ asama tin ya zuliyanim maa sani, ka yi ti ku nya luɣ shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ yi napɔŋ zali vuhi. Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira nimaani, ka ninsabiga mali ya, ka nandahima ti mali ya yi suhuri ni.
en: You will be restless—always longing for home, but never able to return.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga zaani yu suma, ka tooi mali suhukpeeni n-tɔɣisiri bɛ ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda shɛm yɛla palɔni.
en: Those who do well as special servants are making an honorable place for themselves. And they will feel very sure of their faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Maata saɣi, Iin n Duuma, n niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-nyɛ Masia, Naawuni Bi so bɛ ni daa yɛli ni o ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la.
en: Yes, Lord! she replied. I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.

dag: Gbuɣinli chɛ ŋumbu, gbuɣindaa kukoli foya, ka gbuɣimpola nyina kabisi.
en: They were like roaring lions, like growling lions with broken teeth—.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri ni o saɣim o yuli yɛra, N daa kpuɣila paɣ ŋɔ, amaa ka m min o ti dɔni, ka m bi nya o paɣipalitali shihira.
en: He might accuse her of doing wrong and say, I married this woman, but when we had sexual relations, I found she was not a virgin. By saying this against her, people might think bad things about her.

dag: Nyama, m piila Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la pah o zuɣu, ka lan ti tuumbaŋdiba zaa yiko ni bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa n ni zal a ni a mali, dina n-nyɛ:.
en: I have also selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, to work with him. I have also given great ability to all the other skilled workers, so that they can make everything I have commanded to be made:.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣ o zɔnim dini, yurilim shɛl lan kani gari li.
en: The greatest love people can show is to die for their friends.

dag: Bɛna n-daa lan su daantal shɛŋa din daa gili di dundɔŋ la zaa mini di binzahi ni di kpahi din kpara ni di mihi fukumsi.
en: They were also responsible for the posts, bases, pegs, and ropes for the outer court.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti bɔhi naa, Wula ka ti mabihi Judanim ŋɔ lee sɔɣi zaŋ a min a malibu ni a niriba ŋɔ zaa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili na.
en: Then all the Israelites went to the king and said to him, Your Majesty, why did our brothers, the men of Judah, think they had the right to take you away and escort you, your family, and your men across the Jordan.

dag: Ka o ni daa tum yiko mini kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa zaŋ tabil o ni daa duhi Mɔdɛkai n-zaŋ o zali zaashe tital ni la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Pɛriʒia mini Miidia nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: And all the great things Xerxes did are written in the Book of History of the Kings of Media and Persia . Also written in those history books are all the things Mordecai did. The king made Mordecai a great man.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam wum n yɛligu ka niŋ ŋun tim ma na maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka bɛ ti ku lan kar o saria, dama o pun yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni.
en: I assure you that whoever hears my word and believes in the one who sent me has eternal life and wont come under judgment but has passed from death into life.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa tintariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nuzaa polo, di ti yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli n-doli Hɛtilɔn nti gari Lɛbɔhamat n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛdad.
en: The northern boundary runs eastward from the Mediterranean Sea to the city of Hethlon, to Hamath Pass, to the city of Zedad.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara maligu pam dindali maa, ka niriba maa suhuri paligi pam, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. Ka paɣiba mini bihi gba daa mali suhupiɛlli. Katiŋnim daa wum Jɛrusalɛmnim suhupiɛlli maa damli.
en: So on that special day, the priests offered many sacrifices. Everyone was very happy because God had made them happy. Even the women and children were excited and happy. People far away could hear the happy sounds coming from Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela n sani kaman tɔbbia ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm la. Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka maa ni tuui lu. Bɛ ku nyaŋ ma. Bɛ ni di vi kara, dama bɛ ku di nasara. Bɛ ni nya filiŋ sahakam, ka di yɛla ka tambu.
en: But the Lord is with me. He is like a strong soldier. So those who are chasing me will fall. They will not defeat me. They will fail. They will be disappointed. They will be ashamed, and they will never forget that shame.

dag: anabi Jɛrimia sani ti yɛl o, Niŋmi ania wummi ti fabila ŋɔ ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti. Suhim o ti tinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa, dama ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ gbaliŋ, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, kulla ti niriba biɛla ŋɔ n-kpalim kaman a nini ni nya ti shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, We have something to ask you: Please pray to the LORD your God for us, this small group, for as you can see we were once many but now are very few.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa yi kul yirila Sool sani n-kun o ba sani Bɛtilihɛm ti gul o piɛri saha saha ka labira.
en: but David went back and forth from Sauls side to shepherd his fathers flock in Bethlehem.

dag: Leeban daa zaŋla o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Liya ni o sɔŋd o.
en: Laban had given his servant Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her servant.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ kana ka kikaa na bi daai. Yubulus mini Pudɛns ni Linus ni Klɔdia zaŋ tabili ti mabihi bɛn kpalim la zaa puhir a.
en: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.

dag: Paɣiba, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Chɛliya ka o nol ni yɛligu kpe yi tiba ni. Wuhimiya yi bipuɣinsi kuyila, ka sokam wuh o ʒiʒiinikpee fabila.
en: I said, Listen to the Lord , you women, and pay attention to his words. Teach your daughters how to mourn, and your friends how to sing a funeral song.

dag: O ni ti niŋ ninvuɣ titali, ka bɛ ni ti boon o la Zallakudura Naa Bia, ka ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o yab Naa Dauda nam ti o.
en: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli Pita, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! A nyɛla tigbirigu n soli zuɣu, dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: Jesus turned to Peter and said, Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.

dag: ka zooi kaman tia ni zoori shɛm. A daa zooya niŋ wɔɣilim m-bi paɣa. A daa yi biha, ka a tooni bili kɔbiri, amaa a daa na bela a zaɣim.
en: I helped you to flourish like a young plant in the field, and you grew tall and became wonderfully endowed. Your breasts were firm, your hair beautifully thick. And you were completely naked.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti lu teeku ni ha, ka bi biɛhim o suhu ni, amaa ka niŋ yɛda ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa ni niŋ pali, o ni nya ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: If you have faith in God and don't doubt, you can tell this mountain to get up and jump into the sea, and it will.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni zaŋ a mini Izraɛlnim niŋ Filistianim nuu ni, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni a min a bidibisi sa ni be n sani, dama Yawɛ ni zaŋ Izraɛl tɔbbihi niŋ Filistianim nuu ni.
en: He will give you and Israel over to the Philistines. Tomorrow you and your sons will join me, and the Lord will also give the army of Israel over to the Philistines.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka o niŋ a nyɔri bee m-pah a binshɛli, amaa zom a Naawuni, ka chɛ ka a mabia maa kul be a sani.
en: Do not charge Israelites any interest, but obey God and let them live near you.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa ti yɛli Dauda, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ di ti shɛhira, biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bee dali, n yi daa bɔhi m ba ka o bi lan lo ni o niŋ nyin Dauda zaɣ biɛɣu, n ku tim na ti yɛl a?.
en: and Jonathan said to David, May the Lord God of Israel be our witness! At this time tomorrow and on the following day I will question my father. If his attitude toward you is good, I will send you word.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua tuumba ayi maa daa yi zoya maa polo labina chaŋ ti du mɔɣili n-labi Nan bia Jɔshua sani n-daa ti yɛl o dinkam zaa niŋ ba.
en: Then the two men went back to Joshua. They left the hills and crossed the river. They went to Joshua and told him everything that they had learned.

dag: Di zaŋ ma ti n dimnima, dama ʒiri shɛhira diriba yiɣisimi lu n zuɣu, bɛ suhuri kul yɛla gadama niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o suhu paligirila o zuɣu gari piɛ kɔbigayinika bɛn bi bɔrigi la.
en: If he finds it, I assure you that he is happier about having that one sheep than about the ninety-nine who didnt wander off.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda tɔbbihi mini Jɔab daa yi ŋmɛnditoli yɔɣu paana ni nɛma pam. Amaa di saha maa Abinɛr daa lan ka Dauda sani Hiburɔn. Dauda daa pun chɛbis o mi ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: Joab and Davids officers came back from battle. They had many valuable things that they had taken from the enemy. David had just let Abner leave in peace. So Abner was not there in Hebron with David.

dag: Ka n daa lo nia ni n niŋ din ni ti ma nyaɣisim. Amaa ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I said to myself, Have fun and enjoy yourself! But this didn't make sense.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa yeeg o sarika binyɛra sɔŋ, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi diri bindirigu sahakam hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: So Jehoiachin took his prison clothes off. For the rest of his life, he ate regularly at the kings table.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka n niriba ni nya dan shɛli maa ni, ka naɣ yɛrimi, Suhudoo beni, suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani.
en: They act as if my people's wounds were only scratches. All is well, they say, when all is not well.

dag: N yura n-su ma, ka o kɔre be n ni.
en: I belong to my lover, and he wants me.

dag: Taɣimi gban shɛli n-sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa kul be tuuli gban shɛli Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa nyo buɣim la puuni la niŋ di ni.
en: to take another scroll and write on it everything that had been on the first one.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaanii ni kɔbisiyɔbu, ka bɛ daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni.
en: The total number of males one month old or older that were enrolled was .

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini din ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: Respect for the Lord gives true life and will save you from deaths trap.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛhab min o daŋ zaa polo la shɛli ku yiɣisi. Yawɛ niŋmi kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija yɛli shɛm la.
en: This proves that everything that the Lord said about the descendants of Ahab will come true. The Lord has done what he promised through his prophet Elijah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o yihi ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni suhuyiɣisili tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord became furiously angry, and in his great anger he uprooted them from their land and threw them into a foreign land, and there they are today.

dag: Ka Naaman daa zaŋ o yuri min o chɛchɛbuŋa ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ ti zani Ilaisha yiŋ dunol ni.
en: So Naaman came with his horses and chariots to Elishas house and stood outside the door.

dag: dama ti Duuma ni niŋ kaman o ni zali ni o ni niŋ shɛm o sariakaribo puuni dunianim zaa sani ŋ-ŋmaai li jia.
en: because the Lord does what he says completely and quickly. .

dag: di saha ka o daa nya yɛm ka kahigi li, ka zal li, ka bo n-yihi li na.
en: then he observed it, spoke of it, established it, searched it out.

dag: N daa kul dolila o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi zaa, ka bi birig o zaligunim maa shɛli.
en: I keep your laws in mind and never turn away from your teachings.

dag: Di daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo maa hal ti paai Akirabim n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Zin n-kul zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo maa hal ni Kadɛshibarinia n-zaŋ ti gari Hɛzirɔn m-mali ti paai Adda ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ Karika.
en: went southward from the Akrabbim Pass and on to Zin. It ran south of Kadesh Barnea, past Hezron and up to Addar, turned toward Karka.

dag: O tab ni daa nya lala maa ka di niŋ ba yoli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli naa doo maa ŋun ni niŋ shɛm.
en: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were very upset and went to the king and told him everything.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o chaŋ Zɔfim mɔɣu ni Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka kɔrigi naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaɣ yini kam zuɣu.
en: He took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Mount Pisgah. There also he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each of them.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Judanim ni ti nya tiliginsim, ka Izraɛlnim mi be ni alaafee. O yuli ti yɛn boonila, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia. .
en: When he is king, the people of Judah will be safe, and the people of Israel will live in peace. He will be called The Lord Our Salvation.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi deei n noli bee n-wum n yɛligu. Sokam daa niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi tuumbiɛri kaman bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka tibidarigibo shɛŋa zaa yɛla n ni daa yɛli n daalikauli lɔbu puuni la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.

dag: Di di dii bi simdi ni n lan sabi gbaŋ tin ya zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la yɛla polo;.
en: I really dont need to write to you about this help for Gods people.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim niŋ ya nirilim din ni chɛ ka yi ku yi nimaani chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: After I punish the Egyptians, they will be so afraid of you that they will give you anything you want. You are my people, and I will let you take many things with you when you leave the land of Egypt.

dag: Di bi wumdi bɛ ni so, bɛ so mi bi tuura. Gom bi gbaari ba bee ka bɛ ti gbihi. Bɛ ni so shɛlɔrigu bi wɔɣisi bee bɛ namdili ti chihi.
en: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni a ni leei naa, ka Izraɛl nam ti nya zaashee zani a kɔbili ni.
en: Now, I know that you will become the new king. You will rule the kingdom of Israel.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi ni, Uriɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: Uriel, the leader of Kohaths family, and of his relatives.

dag: Miligim ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ, ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ! Ka bɛ daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all. They immediately bowed down and prayed.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o dolila adiini soli ka bi gbib o zilinli, o yɔhindila omaŋa o suhu ni, ka o daadiini soli dolibu nyɛla yoli.
en: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni niŋ n dan maa din tuhi ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, yin yɛlim ma, ka yi yi ku niŋ o, yin lan yɛlim ma. Ka n zaŋ kpa n nudirigu polo bee n nuzaa polo.
en: Now, if you intend to fulfill your responsibility toward my master and treat him fairly, please tell me; if not, say so, and I will decide what to do.

dag: ka di yi nyɛla niriba sɔŋbu, chɛliya ka ti sɔŋm ba. Ka ŋun nyɛ karimba, ŋun wuhima;.
en: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.

dag: Ti mabihi la zaa puhiri ya. Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ.
en: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.

dag: Bɛ ba n-daa wuhiri bɛ zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu biŋkumda din daa nyɛ: guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisanim mini mɔɣilɔnim ni goonjɛnima Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm. Naa n-daa wuhiri Asaf mini Jɛdutun ni Hɛman bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; ka kum wum o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ piligi kabisiri chi ŋubiri chana.
en: At that time Jesus went through the wheat fields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry so they were picking heads of wheat and eating them.

dag: Ka tibimiya barinima, ka neemiya kpiimba, ka chɛliya ka kɔnsi kpaŋda, ka karimiya alizin biɛri bahira. Yi dee li la yoli, yi gba timiya li yoli.
en: Heal the sick. Bring the dead back to life. Heal the people who have leprosy. And force demons out of people. I give you these powers freely, so help others freely.

dag: Dama pa paɣ ni ka doo yina, amaa doo ni ka paɣ ŋun yina.
en: Man did not come from woman. Woman came from man.

dag: Yi yi doli n noli, ka gbibi n zaligunima ka tumdi di tuma.
en: Faithfully obey my laws.

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: If theres no resurrection of the dead, then Christ hasnt been raised either.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ n-daa yɛli ma.
en: So I said to them, The Lord spoke to me and told me.

dag: Zɔnim shɛb zaŋla zɔtali yɛla niŋ asahi, amaa zɔ maŋli so beni gari nir mabia gba.
en: Some friendships do not last, but some friends are more loyal than brothers.

dag: Binnamda zaa kul guhirimi ka bɛ suhuri kul ye saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn yih o bihi palɔni la zuɣu;.
en: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.

dag: Dama o ʒiɛm Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum birig o zaligu, ka di simdi ni bɛ shiri ku dilana, ka o daalahichi ʒi o zuɣu.
en: because they have rejected what the Lord said and have deliberately broken one of his commands. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Bɛ malila ka shɛŋa din bi simdi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ Romnim ŋɔ doli n-wuhiri niriba.
en: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.

dag: Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun kpihim ninsalinim daalahichi ka mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka o min o ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi maa zaa laɣim mali Ba yino. Dina n-chɛ ka vi bi mal o ni o bol ba o mabihi.
en: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk daa nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Shavisha daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara.
en: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ zaa mi ni n daa kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni nti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ a yɛda m-bu ba ka kpɛhi ba duu.
en: I responded, Lord, these people know I used to go from one synagogue to the next, beating those who believe in you and throwing them into prison.

dag: Di chɛ ka n yɛla gbaag a dabiɛm, m bi yɛn nahim a pam.
en: So you have no reason to fear me; I will not overpower you.

dag: Yuuni kam Ɛlikana daa yi yirila o ya n-chani Shilo ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka maani sara nimaani. Ɛli bihi ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Hofini ni Finɛhas la n-daa nyɛ Yawɛ maligumaaniba nimaani.
en: Every year Elkanah left his town of Ramah and went up to Shiloh. He worshiped the Lord All-Powerful at Shiloh and offered sacrifices to the Lord there. Shiloh was where Elis sons, Hophni and Phinehas, served as priests of the Lord .

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-yi Hazaɛl takɔbi kubu ni, Jɛhu ŋun kum o; ka ŋun ti zo n-yi Jɛhu takɔbi kubu ni, Ilaisha mi ŋun kum o.
en: Jehu will kill anyone who escapes Hazaels sword, and Elisha will kill anyone who escapes from Jehus sword.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Kpamiya zoya ŋɔ polo, ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ku chirigi ya; kul sɔɣimiya be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ti labina pɔi ka yi naanyi yiɣisi kuli.
en: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayi ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, bɛ ni lan booni shɛli Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o;.
en: It was two days before Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread. The chief priests and legal experts through cunning tricks were searching for a way to arrest Jesus and kill him.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Sidɔn polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the city of Sidon.

dag: Pɛrɛz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Perezs sons were Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Ka zuliya gari ni kana ti be Ashidɔd. Ka n siɣisi Filistianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la.
en: The people in Ashdod will not even know who their real fathers are. The Lord says, I will completely destroy the proud Philistines.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Giliad maa ti Manaasa bia Makiri ka o ʒini nimaani.
en: So Moses gave Gilead to Machir, Manassehs son, and he lived there.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu yubu mini Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu yubu nyɛla din tuhiri tab tɔbu; dama di nyɛla din chihi taba ka guri ya soli n-chɛ ka yi bi niŋdi yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛm.
en: A persons selfish desires are set against the Spirit, and the Spirit is set against ones selfish desires. They are opposed to each other, so you shouldnt do whatever you want to do.

dag: N wuntia biɛhigu laara ka Yawɛ daa ti ma maa; n ni ka galimi la samli ka o yo ma maa.
en: The Lord rewarded me for doing what is right. He was good to me because I am innocent.

dag: Amaa nyama, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn tibi Izraɛlnima, Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri yirila palo, ka Samarianim ninvuɣ biɛtali yi zahira; dama bɛ ŋmari ʒiri, ka tayiɣisi kabiri yiya n-kpɛri ti zura, ka ninvuɣ fariba mi be samban ni fara.
en: Whenever I want to heal my people Israel and make them prosperous again, all I can see is their wickedness and the evil they do. They cheat one another; they break into houses and steal; they rob people in the streets.

dag: Ka bɛn ti zo n-tiligi ni ti bela zoya zuɣu kaman vinvamli ni ŋmana la. Ka bɛ zaa ti fabindi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Some will escape to the mountains like doves frightened from the valleys. All of them will moan over their sins.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhuri kpe lala paɣ maa ni. Miriya ka yi birigi dol o soli.
en: Do not let such a woman win your heart; don't go wandering after her.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.

dag: O daa bi nya ka di nyɛ shɛli ni o tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la tatabo. O daa kpuɣila Sidɔn Naa Ɛtibaal bipuɣiŋga Jɛzibɛl n-niŋ o paɣa, ka daa jɛmdi buɣili Baal.
en: Ahab found it easy to walk in the sins of Jeroboam, Nebats son. He married Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal, who was the king of the Sidonians. He served and worshipped Baal.

dag: Di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sabi o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will die, as the Scriptures say. But it's going to be terrible for the one who betrays me! That man would be better off if he had never been born.

dag: ka pii mah shɛŋa din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini mini bɔrɔbɔro din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini piɛ shɛli din ʒe Yawɛ tooni la puuni n-zaŋ li pa biŋkpam la mini nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili la zuɣu.
en: From the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one loaf of unleavened flatbread, one loaf of flatbread made with oil, and one unleavened wafer, and he placed these on the fat pieces and on the right thigh.

dag: Naa ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-yihiri ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋdi kaburi dari buri ba.
en: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinim la. O pii shɛb leela tuumba, ka pii shɛb leeg anabinima, ka pii shɛb leei Masia lahibal suŋ molomooniba, ka pii shɛb leei pastanima, ka pii shɛb mi leei karimbanima.
en: It was he who gave gifts to people; he appointed some to be apostles, others to be prophets, others to be evangelists, others to be pastors and teachers.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhiri pampam n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ni yɛlimaŋlilana ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka a yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ku ti ka na be dunia ni ŋɔ saria m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti ti.
en: They cried out with a loud voice, Holy and true Master, how long will you wait before you pass judgment? How long before you require justice for our blood, which was shed by those who live on earth.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool Zanimi ka n yɛl a Yawɛ ni sa yɛli ma shɛm yuŋ la. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Samuel then said to Saul, Enough! Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night. Tell me, Saul replied.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yihila n Duuma, ka m bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: The angels asked Mary, Woman, why are you crying? Mary answered, They took away the body of my Lord, and I dont know where they put him.

dag: N dol a zaligunim min a wuhibu, dama a mi n soya zaa.
en: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaanu daa gbaai Jɛrɛmɔt min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Fifteenth, there were men chosen from Jeremoths sons and relatives.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti dɔni ti vi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti filiŋ pili timaŋa. Dama ti mini ti yaannim tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ, ka bi saɣi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa noli.
en: Lets lie down in our shame. Let our dishonor cover us, for we have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our ancestors, from our youth to this very day. We have disobeyed the voice of the LORD our God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord also said to Moses.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zahima maa n-chɛ ka n niriba tam n yɛla saha shɛli bɛ ni tɔɣisiri tab di yɛla maa, kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa tam n yɛla ka jɛmdi Baal shɛm la.
en: They scheme to make my people forget me by their dreams that people tell each other, just as their ancestors forgot me because of Baal.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundɔŋ, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi n-yili di nudirigu polo.
en: Then he made a wall of curtains around the courtyard. On the south side, he made a wall of curtains cubits long. The curtains were made from fine linen.

dag: M bela bina ayi maa sunsuuni: N suhu kul yɛmi ni n kpi n-chaŋ ti be Masia sani, dama dina n-so shɛlikam;.
en: It would be a hard choice. Sometimes I want to leave this life and be with Christ. That would be much better for me;.

dag: Ti nyɛla saamba bɛn go n-chani gind a tooni kaman ti yaannim la. Ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu ŋmanila shilinshia, ka tahima kani.
en: We are only strangers traveling through this world like our ancestors. Our time on earth is like a passing shadow, and we cannot stop it.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe, di simdi ni bɛ mini naa kpe, ka bɛ yi ti lan yɛn yi, di simdi ni bɛ min o yi.
en: The prince should accompany them: when they come in, he comes in, and when they go out, he goes out.

dag: A yi tarigi yɛl biɛɣu nyabu dali, a yaa m-pun bi galisi.
en: If you show yourself weak on a day of distress, your strength is too small.

dag: N lan nya ka bɛ mi n-sɔɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa kpɛri luɣ kasi shee ka yira; amaa ka niriba paɣiri ba tin shɛl ni bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zuɣu. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Then I saw the wicked brought to their graves, with people processing from a holy place, while those who had lived honestly were neglected in the city. This too is pointless.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yurilim niŋ dɛde ti ni ni di chɛ ka ti ti tooi mali suhukpeeni saria karibu dali, dama o ni be shɛm, lala ka ti gba biɛhigu be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: If Gods love is made perfect in us, we can be without fear on the day when God judges the world. We will be without fear, because in this world we are like Jesus.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira, ka yi Bahurim na la gba beni. O daa tu ma tu biɛri dahin shɛli n ni daa chaŋ Mahanaim la, amaa o ni daa kana nti tuhi ma soli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la, n daa po Yawɛ yɛl o, N ku zaŋ takɔb ku a.
en: There is also Shimei son of Gera, from the town of Bahurim in Benjamin. He cursed me bitterly the day I went to Mahanaim, but when he met me at the Jordan River, I gave him my solemn promise in the name of the Lord that I would not have him killed.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a tam ti yɛla zaa? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ti bahi dabisi gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa?.
en: Why have you forgotten us for so long?.

dag: Ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa yɛli, Nyama, m mali binshɛɣukam zaa ka di niŋ zaɣ pala! Ka lan yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nira ni ni niŋ shɛli naani, ka lan nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: The one who was sitting on the throne said, Look, I am making everything new! Then he said, Write this, because these words are true and can be trusted.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa ti tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti yih o na ka o deeg o. Ka naa maa daa bɔh o ashilɔni o yiŋ maa ni, Yawɛ yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli? Ka Jɛrimia garigi yɛli, O yɛli shɛli. Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Bɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni.
en: Later on King Zedekiah sent for me, and there in the palace he asked me privately, Is there any message from the Lord ? There is, I answered, and added, You will be handed over to the king of Babylonia.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zali ni bɛ ni mol li gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ni Dan ni sokam kana ka bɛ ti puhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ daa na bi laɣim pam puhi li kaman di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.

dag: Ka di simdi ni yi yipa ŋmaligi chɛ m-paŋ o ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama di yi pa lala suhugarigu pam zuɣu ni chɛ ka o lu.
en: Now, however, you should forgive him and encourage him, in order to keep him from becoming so sad as to give up completely.

dag: Amaa yɛm din yiri alizanda ni na nyɛla alali, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri suhudoo mini biɛribaalimtali, ka nyɛ din deeri wuhibu, ka lan nyɛ din pali nambɔzɔbo mini tuun suma, ka mali ʒiɛyimtali ka ka bilikɔnsi baabiɛla.
en: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Kpa ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ yomyom ʒini n-taɣi sab pihinu.
en: A hundred barrels of olive oil, the man answered. So the manager said, Take your bill and sit down and quickly write . .

dag: A ni ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, ka lihir a ninni la suhudo maŋli, bɛ ni niŋ a naani zuɣu.
en: You, Lord , give perfect peace to those who keep their purpose firm and put their trust in you.

dag: nti zaŋ yi ba mini yi malibu kuli n sanna ka n ti tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka yi ti diri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira yi yubu.
en: Get your father and your households and come back to me. Let me provide you with good things from the land of Egypt so that you may eat the lands best food.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ Naa Dauda kpana la min o nyɔtaɣiri kara ni zaɣibihi zaa din daa be Naawuni duu la ni n-ti sapashin kpamba bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga maa.
en: Then the priest Jehoiada gave the unit commanders King Davids spears and large and small shields that were kept in Gods temple.

dag: Ahazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun yini. O ma yuli n-daa booni Atalia, o daa nyɛla Omri bia.
en: Ahaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for one year in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Athaliah; she was the granddaughter of Omri.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni bi sab gbaŋ yɛl ti a yɛla, ka ti mabi shɛb bɛn mi ka ya ŋɔ na bi tɔɣisi a zaɣ biɛ shɛli yɛla ti sani.
en: The leaders replied, No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa malibu tuma zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ mi daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa maani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ zaŋ li mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: They handed it over to the supervisors in charge of the LORDs temple, who in turn paid it to those working on, repairing, and restoring the LORDs temple.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ yi ti yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ ni yɛli paɣ ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ teer o yɛla.
en: You may be sure that wherever the good news is told all over the world, people will remember what she has done. And they will tell others.

dag: Ka o dii suug o koyuli maa o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu na ti ma ka yɛli, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ shɛli ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu. Ka n di nyu ka chɛ ka o ŋɔŋ na ti ti n laakumnim maa gba ka bɛ nyu.
en: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels. So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni di chɛ ka yi ku lan nyɛ bɛ daba, n kabi yi nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi la, ka chɛ ka yi tooi chana ka yi zuɣuri ʒe tibi.
en: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high.

dag: O ti o niriba faako. O lo o daalikauli ni di kul ʒiɛya sahakam. O yuli be kasi ka mali dabiɛm.
en: He set his people free and made an eternal covenant with them. Holy and mighty is he!.

dag: Ŋarimiya yiliŋ kam, ka gbi zoya mini kuŋkuna ka di siɣi n-leei tintani, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli.
en: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni mini Anabi Musa daa tɔɣisi taba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ti bi mi doo maa ŋun ni yi shɛl na.
en: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we dont know where this man is from.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, ka bi deei n yɛligu mali sariakarita. Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni pun tɔɣisi la nti yɛn kar o saria zaadali.
en: Whoever rejects me and doesnt receive my words will be judged at the last day by the word I have spoken.

dag: Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn la bɛn daa pun deei bɛ tarili. Yawɛ dabili Musa n-daa pun pirigi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: As for the other half of the tribe of Manasseh, the Reubenites and Gadites together with it had already taken their legacy that Moses had given them on the east side of the Jordan. It was exactly what Moses the LORDs servant had given them.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ bir o puu ni, ka di zooi niŋ tia hal ka noonsi ti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu la.
en: It is like this. A man takes a mustard seed and plants it in his field. The plant grows and becomes a tree, and the birds make their nests in its branches.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛl o maa, A shiri nya o? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a di bi chɛ o sua luhi tiŋ na nimaani? N suhu naan paligi ka n ti a anzinfa laɣibaligu pia mini gbaŋ din lɔr sheeni.
en: Joab answered, If you saw him, why didn't you kill him on the spot? I myself would have given you ten pieces of silver and a belt.

dag: N yɛm puuni ka n zaŋ baŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa. N daa yɛliya, N ni niŋ yɛndana, amaa ka m mini di shee ti wɔɣa.
en: I tested all of this by wisdom. I thought, I will be wise, but it eluded me.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi yɔɣili maa zuɣu? Ka Jona garigi yɛli, Di simdi ni n suhu yiɣisi, hal ka m bi zaɣisi ni n kpi gba.
en: But the Lord asked, Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine? Yes, I do, he answered, and I'm angry enough to die.

dag: Di saha n suhu ni ti paligi Yawɛ zuɣu, ka m mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: Then I will be glad because of the Lord ; I will be happy because he saved me.

dag: Amaa di niŋ kamaata ni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu yihi ti zuliya kam pɔi.
en: But before the end comes, the gospel must be preached to all peoples.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yiɣisima n-chaŋ ti tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa suhumahili yɛtɔɣa; dama m po Yawɛ, a yi bi chaŋ, so ku kpalim a sani yuŋ ŋɔ, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa ni bie n-gari zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din pun niŋ a a nachimbilim ni zaŋ na hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Now get up! Go out and encourage your followers! I swear to the LORD that if you dont go out there, not one man will stick with you tonight—and that will be more trouble for you than all the trouble that youve faced from your youth until now.

dag: Ka Yisa gba daa ti yɛli do so, Doli ma! Ka dilan yɛli, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Then Jesus said to someone else, Follow me. He replied, Lord, first let me go and bury my father.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Firawuna tumtumdib shɛb bɛn min o daa be duu o dan yiŋ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi mali suhugarigu lihigu zuŋɔ.
en: and he asked, Why are you so worried today.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi ni n nuu yi yi zaa nyɛviya bahi yoli taali ni.
en: Therefore, today I testify to you that Im not responsible for anyones fate.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa di bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa di bi nyara.
en: They have mouths, but they cant speak. They have eyes, but they cant see.

dag: Dama bɛ ku Yaakubu zuliya, ka wurim bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Those nations killed Jacobs family and destroyed their land.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdali gbini. Ka bɛ daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, naa ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdal la gbini. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa tooni na. Di saha maa Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino daa pun zomi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: David got up and went to the town gate and sat down. When the people heard that he was sitting there, they came to see him. After Israel's soldiers had all returned home.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n gari yɛli, N nyala fiig tiwala din viɛl pam, ka nya fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: And the LORD asked me: What do you see, Jeremiah? I replied: Figs! Some good ones and others very bad—so bad that they cant be eaten.

dag: Tayiɣ bi kanna ka pa ni o yɛn zumi bee n-ku bee n-saɣim bahi. Amaa man kamina ni niriba ti nya nyɛvili n-kul nya li la pam.
en: The thief enters only to steal, kill, and destroy. I came so that they could have life—indeed, so that they could live life to the fullest.

dag: lala ka a gba bi yi a pagɔrisigu tuma daɣiri ni. A ku lan yi a daɣiri maa ni hal ka n ti tum a n suhuyiɣisili tuma.
en: How your betrayals defile you! I cleansed you, but you didnt come clean from your impurities. You wont be clean again until I have exhausted my anger against you.

dag: Naa ni daa wum zaligu kundi yɛtɔɣa maa, o daa darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: When Josiah heard what was in The Book of God's Law , he tore his clothes in sorrow.

dag: Dunia nanima mini zuliya kam zaa ni nabihi ni tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, kings and all peoples, princes and all other rulers;.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ malimiya tɔroko palli, ka bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣira, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ʒi n-zaŋ dapuhi ga shɛba nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, amaa ka taɣiya bɛ bihi kuli yiŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: So get a new cart ready along with two nursing cows that have never been yoked before. Harness the cows to the cart, but take any of their calves that are following back home.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, ŋubimi n ni zaŋ gban shɛli ti a ŋɔ pali a puli. Di saha ka n daa ŋub li, ka di nyaɣisi n noli ni kaman shiri la.
en: Then God said, Son of man, I am giving you this scroll. Swallow it! Let that scroll fill your body. So I ate the scroll. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

dag: Sokam zaa kul lihir a mi, ka a tiri ba bindirigu bɛ ni bɔri li saha shɛli.
en: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.

dag: O ni daa deei litaafi maa naai, ka binnɛma anahi la mini kpamba pisinaanahi la gbani Piɛbil maa tooni. Bɛ zaa daa malila mɔɣilɔnim mini salima lahi, ka tulaale zim din nyɛ Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu pal lahi maa.
en: After he had taken it, the four living creatures and the elders knelt down before him. Each of them had a harp and a gold bowl full of incense, which are the prayers of God's people.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Yisa ka o be katiŋa, ka o guui ti damd o tooni.
en: While Jesus was still far away, the man saw him. He ran to Jesus and bowed down before him.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa ti yɛl o, Yi mini yi bihi chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ, amaa chɛliya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi bɛna.
en: Again Pharaoh called for Moses. He said, Go and worship the Lord ! You can take your children with you. But you must leave your sheep and cattle here.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli nti paai sariga maa sɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ o pako chinchina maa so.
en: Then Tamar went home, took off her veil that covered her face, and again put on the special clothes that showed she was a widow.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa zaŋ alikama biɛlim suma bir o puu ni;.
en: Jesus then told them this story: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a farmer scattered good seed in a field.

dag: N ni ti ti ba tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ ku lan kpi kum tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yaha. Ka zuliya shɛb ku lan tu ba yaha.
en: I will give them fertile fields and put an end to hunger in the land. The other nations will not sneer at them any more.

dag: Ti Duuma yoomi yi suhuri ka yi baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka yi mali ʒiɛyimtali din nyɛ Masia dini.
en: We pray that the Lord will cause you to feel Gods love and remember Christs patient endurance.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a tir a kpee zalige bee bɔzuɣu ka a ʒiɛmd a kpee? Dama ti zaa ni ti zani Naawuni tooni ka o kari ti saria.
en: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, a nyɛla binzɔrigu! A suhu yi yiɣisi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani a tooni?.
en: You! You are awesome! Who can stand before you when you are angry?.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam yirila o sanna; ka binshɛɣukam bela o zuɣu; ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla o ni su shɛli. Ŋuna n-simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Yes, God made all things. And everything continues through him and for him. To God be the glory forever! Amen.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim siɣi doli ba chaŋ ka di biɛhind a suhu ni, dama mani n-tim ba a sanna.
en: Go downstairs. Dont ask questions; just go with them because I have sent them.

dag: Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa yi ti niŋ a nyin niŋm a nuu ni ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: When these things happen, do whatever God leads you to do.

dag: Nyamiya, biŋkura la zaa gariya; pumpɔŋɔ bimpala yɛla ka n yɛra. N yɛn daŋmi yɛli ya di yɛla pɔi, ka di naanyi kana.
en: The things I predicted have now come true. Now I will tell you of new things even before they begin to happen.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Jesus spoke to the chief priests, the temple police, and the leaders who had come to arrest him. He said, Why do you come out with swords and clubs and treat me like a criminal?.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbihi padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam ti o na.
en: Later, it was time for the grapes to be picked. So the man sent his servants to the farmers to get his share of the grapes.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali Izraɛl zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sɔŋm o bia Sulemaana, ka lan yɛli ba.
en: David commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.

dag: Di lan sab yaha: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa, paɣimiya ti Duuma, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa paɣ o.
en: The Scriptures also say, Praise the Lord all you people of other nations; all people should praise the Lord. Psalm :.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti lan da yiya mini puri ni wain tihi puri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaha. .
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: the Lord said to us.

dag: Yawɛ n-su tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni.
en: The earth and everything on it belong to the Lord . The world and all its people belong to him.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam wum n yɛligu ka niŋ ŋun tim ma na maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka bɛ ti ku lan kar o saria, dama o pun yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni.
en: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.

dag: Sagbani maa ni daa kul vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa saha shɛli, nyama, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu dii gbaai Miriam, ka o niŋgbuŋ paligi zaa kaman gumbɔrigu la. Ka Aduna daa ŋmaligi lihi Miriam polo n-nya ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-gbaag o.
en: When the cloud went away from over the tent, Miriam suddenly developed a skin disease flaky like snow. Aaron turned toward Miriam and saw her skin disease.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ bukɔbiri wuɣi tani n-zaŋ pili m biɛhigu shee maa. Wuɣimiya li tan tolima piniyini.
en: Make another tent that will cover the Holy Tent. Use eleven curtains to make this tent. Make these curtains from goat hair.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛbisi ba, ka bɛ mali ti paai Antiɔk n-laɣim yɛdaniŋdiba n-zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ba.
en: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli, Yɛlimiya noli ti Mɛrɔz, yɛlimiya no biɛɣu ti di niriba, bɛ ni bi kana ti sɔŋ Yawɛ n-tuhi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ sɔŋ o la zuɣu.
en: Put a curse on Meroz, says the angel of the Lord , a curse, a curse on those who live there. They did not come to help the Lord , come as soldiers to fight for him.

dag: Di zaa yoli Lɛvinim bɛn tinsi dina, yiya shɛŋa din be bɛ ni su fɔntin shɛŋa ni, bɛn Lɛvinim maa ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛlikam.
en: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.

dag: Adɔnija ni Biɣivai ni Adin ni.
en: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛl o, Zɔri, m bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Peter responded, Man, I dont know what you are talking about! At that very moment, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: And now you want me to go and tell him that you are here?.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli ni n zaŋ mmaŋa mini n ni mali shɛlikam saɣim yi zuɣu. N ni yuri ya pam la zuɣu, yinima ni yuri ma la biɛla?.
en: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Isaiah.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa darig a niriba maa tibili la, bɛ nandahima puuni, bɛ daa suh a pam.
en: Lord , people remember you when they are in trouble. So because of your punishment, we called out to you.

dag: M bɔhirila bɔhigu ŋɔ: Bɛ daa bi wum? Bɛ daa wumya ni yɛlimaŋli; dama di sabiya: Bɛ kukoya damli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa; ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ tarisi zaa.
en: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.

dag: Niriba maa kanimina, ka bɛ chandi vuri ŋmani kom pam vuri, amaa o ni tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ katiŋa. Bɛ ni zo kaman zoya zuɣu wurigu ni taŋkpa shɛli pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe m-bahi.
en: And like the waves, they will rush away when God speaks harshly to them. They will be like chaff blown away by the wind. They will be like weeds chased by a storm.

dag: Ka din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yurilim din lɔri binshɛɣukam laɣindi taba ka di leeri zaɣ yin la pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Together with these things, the most important part of your new life is to love each other. Love is what holds everything together in perfect unity.

dag: Gɛbalnima ni Ammɔnnima ni Amalɛknima ni Filistianima mini Taainima.
en: Gebal, Ammon, Amalek, Philistia along with the citizens of Tyre.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ti fali ti saamba, ka zaŋ ti yiya ti tinzunnima.
en: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.

dag: zaŋ tabili Kɛnnim mini Kɛnizinim ni Kadimɔninim.
en: They will possess the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: and that anyone who does not bow down and worship it is to be thrown into a blazing furnace.

dag: Ka Baasha daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Tiriza; ka o bia Ɛla daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah. His son Elah became the new king after him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa bo chɛchɛbuŋ mini yuri ka zaŋ ninvuɣ pihinu bah o tooni.
en: Some time later, Absalom got a chariot and horses for his own use, along with fifty men to run ahead of him.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti damdi li tiŋa bee n-jɛm li; dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli, n darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma bihi tiba bɛ banima taali zuɣu hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir ata mini din pahir anahi ni.
en: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu yubu mini Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu yubu nyɛla din tuhiri tab tɔbu; dama di nyɛla din chihi taba ka guri ya soli n-chɛ ka yi bi niŋdi yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛm.
en: The sinful self wants what is against the Spirit, and the Spirit wants what is against the sinful self. They are always fighting against each other, so that you dont do what you really want to do.

dag: Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara o zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaɣ yini kam polo, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. Ka din kpalim nyɛ maligumaaniba dini kaman chi bee kawana sara yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: In this way the priest shall offer the sacrifice for your sin, and you will be forgiven. The rest of the flour belongs to the priest, just as in the case of a grain offering.

dag: Kurigu n-sahiri di kpee, ka ninsalinim gba nyari baŋsim tab sani.
en: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.

dag: Naawuni daa lola Ibrahimma min o yaaŋa alikaulinima. Naawuni daa bi yɛli Ibrahimma, N lo a min a yaansi alikaulinima, ka di wuhiri ni bɛ ninvuɣ bɔbili. Amaa o daa yɛl o mi, N lo a min a yaaŋa alikaulinima, ka di wuhirila ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Masia la.
en: Now, God made his promises to Abraham and to his descendant. The scripture does not use the plural descendants, meaning many people, but the singular descendant, meaning one person only, namely, Christ.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛba bɛn birigi n niriba la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti nya n-di saha shɛli, bɛ kuhirimi yɛra, Suhudoo beni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ti ba ka bɛ di, bɛ yɛrimi ni bɛ ni tuhi ba.
en: The LORD proclaims concerning the prophets, those who lead my people astray, those who chew with their teeth and then proclaim Peace! but stir up war against the one who puts nothing in their mouths.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ma, N ku chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ taali hal ka bɛ ti yi dunia yili. Mani yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But the LORD of heavenly forces has revealed in my hearing: This iniquity wont be forgiven you until you die, says the LORD God of heavenly forces.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛlnim Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ yɛliya: To, n ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi yinim bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɔhi ya biɛri.
en: Therefore, says the LORD God of heavenly forces, the mighty one of Israel: Doom! I will vent my anger against my foes; I will take it out on my enemies.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tuhi lu di saha maa, ka Judanim di nasara, dama bɛ daa niŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la naani.
en: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yuri Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn pam.
en: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti tim ti yɛli Jɛsi, Chɛ ka Dauda kpalim n yili ŋɔ n-tumdi n tuma; dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: Saul sent a message to Jesse. Let David stay and serve me. I like him very much.

dag: Zahimbu na ʒi m-paai ya ka di pala din tatabo pun zahindi niriba; amaa Naawuni kul ʒiɛla yim, ka ku saɣi chɛ ka yi nya zahimbu din yaɣi yi kpiɔŋ tariga; ka yi zahimbu nyabu puuni, o ni mali soli tin ya ka yi nya yaa n-yi di ni ka ku lu.
en: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.

dag: daa su ʒiʒiriba fukumsi, ka wuhiri bɛnkam daa tumdi tuma balibu kam bɛ ni yɛn tumdi li shɛm. Ka Lɛvinim maa shɛb daa nyɛ gbansabiriba, ka shɛb nyɛ kpamba, ka shɛb mi nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: Other Levites were in charge of transporting materials and supervising the workers on various jobs, and others kept records or served as guards.

dag: N ni yihi ba Ijipti mini Asiria labisina ti ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni zaŋ ba ʒili Giliad mini Lɛbanɔn, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ti pali niriba hal ka palo ti ku lan beni.
en: From Egypt and Assyria I will bring them home and settle them in their own country. I will settle them in Gilead and Lebanon also; the whole land will be filled with people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa n-chaŋ ti tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu, ka sagbani maa daa pali duu maa puuni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa pali dundɔŋ maa.
en: Then the Glory of the Lord rose up off the Cherub angels near the threshold of the door of the Temple. Then the cloud filled the Temple, and the bright light from the Glory of the Lord filled the whole courtyard.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses did what he was told.

dag: Bihi bɛn nyɛ jɛra tirila bɛ banim suhugarigu, ka tiri bɛ ma ŋun dɔɣi ba biɛrim.
en: A foolish son is irritating to his father and bitter to her who gave birth to him.

dag: Huram daa lan zaŋ daanya mali binzahi pia, ka di zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: Hiram made ten movable bronze stands, each one over a meter high, almost two meters long, and almost two meters wide.

dag: Zaŋm a bindirigu bahi kom ni, dama di yi niŋ daba ayi, di ni lan lab a sanna yaha.
en: Invest your money in foreign trade, and one of these days you will make a profit.

dag: hal n ni nyɛla ŋun daa yɛr o zilima ka niŋd o alaka ka tur o la zaa yoli. Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu, dama n daa niŋ li la ʒilinsi ni n ni daa na bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: even though in the past I spoke evil of him and persecuted and insulted him. But God was merciful to me because I did not yet have faith and so did not know what I was doing.

dag: Asha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣa Sɛra.
en: Ashers sons were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Their sister was named Serah.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim, ka gbib alikauli ni yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim sani zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani tuhili niriba.
en: Know now then that the LORD your God is the only true God! He is the faithful God, who keeps the covenant and proves loyal to everyone who loves him and keeps his commands—even to the thousandth generation!.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin la piɛb o kikaa, ka kukol kara kul kuhiri pampam alizanda ni yɛra, Dunia nam leela ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia dini hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa, tɛha ni ti kpe a suhu ni, ka a bo zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu soya.
en: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni maar a suhu shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din pɔr a sani, bee zilimballi yɛtɔɣa maa m-pa shɛli a sani?.
en: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yalim be yi yɛtɔɣa ni ka di viɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi mi yi ni yɛn garigi sokam shɛm.
en: Your speech should always be pleasant and interesting, and you should know how to give the right answer to everyone.

dag: Doo yi dɔni o do kpee kaman paɣ la, bɛ niriba ayi maa tum din chihira, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual relations with another man as with a woman, they have committed a terrible sin. They must be put to death. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Dama Musa daa pun piri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbɔŋ la tari zuliya ayi ni pirigili la. Amaa o daa bi pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: Moses had already assigned the land east of the Jordan to the other two and one-half tribes. However, Moses gave the Levites no portion of the territory. Instead, they received cities to live in, with fields for their cattle and flocks.

dag: Ʒiŋmabo nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa bɛn ʒe yim nyɛla o suhu ni piɛli shɛb zuɣu.
en: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma din ni chɛ ka n tooi tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu n-kahigiri di gbinni wuhiri kaman di ni simdi ni n kahigiri li wuhiri shɛm.
en: Pray, then, that I may speak, as I should, in such a way as to make it clear.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ suma n-kul pali n suhu ni saha shɛli n ni ŋma yilli ŋɔ ni n-yili jɛm naa. N zilinli ŋmanila gbansabir so ŋun mi yila sabbu daalikalimi.
en: Beautiful thoughts fill my mind as I speak these lines for the king. These words come from my tongue as from the pen of a skilled writer.

dag: Ka Naa Hiram ŋariŋ shɛli din daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima la na daa lan ʒi alimug dari pam mini kuɣ viɛla gba n-yi Ofiri maa na.
en: Hirams fleet went to Ophir and brought back gold, much almug wood, and precious stones.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o di nyɛvili ŋɔ nyaɣisim ka nya dabisi suma, ŋun gbaam o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu, ka mi di chɛ ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa yir o nol ni na.
en: For those who want to love life and see good days should keep their tongue from evil speaking and their lips from speaking lies. .

dag: Biɛɣu daa yi neei, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka sagban daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-wuhiri ba soli, yuŋ mi daa yi ti zibi, o chɛrimi ka buɣim daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-ne ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ chani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: The LORD went in front of them during the day in a column of cloud to guide them and at night in a column of lightning to give them light. This way they could travel during the day and at night.

dag: Ka Pool yɛl o, N dana, m bi kpɛla yinyari, amaa nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa mini yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛra.
en: But Paul replied, Im not mad, most honorable Festus! Im speaking what is sound and true.

dag: M bɔri ni Izraɛlnim nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Yawɛ yi chɛ ka o niriba lan tɔŋ, di ni niŋ Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim nyaɣisim, ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: How I pray that victory will come to Israel from Zion. How happy the people of Israel will be when the Lord makes them prosperous again!.

dag: ni bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛlahi gban shɛŋa ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: tanned ram skin or fine leather; acacia wood;.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm di biŋkpam zaa mali sara, di zuli ni kpam mini kpam din pili namanama.
en: The priest must offer all the fat from the guilt offering. He must offer the fat tail and the fat that covers the inner parts.

dag: Firilatamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni firilanima ni firila kpam.
en: the lampstand for light with its equipment and its lamps, the oil for the light.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. N ni lan chɛ ka yi be suɣa ni yaha kaman yi ni daa pun be di ni shɛm yi chuɣu puhibu dabisa saha la.
en: But I, the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt, I will make you live in tents again, as you did when I came to you in the desert.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, dilana nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka ŋunkam yuri ba so ŋun dɔɣi bia ni yur o bia maa gba.
en: The people who believe that Jesus is the Messiah are Gods children. Anyone who loves the Father also loves the Fathers children.

dag: Pita daa kul gɔrimi gindi luɣilikam kaari Yisa nyaandoliba, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Lida la gba sani.
en: Peter traveled everywhere, and on one occasion he went to visit God's people who lived in Lydda.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan gbaai chandi n-kana ti ti o suɣa zali Ɛda pii tooni.
en: Jacob, also known as Israel, traveled to the south of Eder Tower, where he set up camp.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi saɣi, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna; ka n yi ti kana, n ni baŋ bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ maa ni mali shɛli, ka di pala bɛ ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko, amaa bɛ yiko gba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But I will come to you very soon, the Lord willing. Then I will see if these proud talkers have the power to do anything more than talk.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni di tiŋkpansi shɛm la, lala ka so ti ku lan be nimaani gba bee n-ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: God completely destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them. In the same way no one will live in Babylon, and no one will ever go to live there. This is what the Lord says.

dag: Amaa mani n-daa wuhi Ifriimnim chandi. Mani n-daa kpuɣi ba gbibi n nuhi ni. Amaa bɛ daa bi baŋ ni mani n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ maa.
en: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka paɣiba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ shiri bi nya o.
en: Some of our group went to the tomb and found it exactly as the women had said, but they did not see him.

dag: Shɛb daa zaŋla ŋariŋ kara n-kpe teeku puuni nti tumdi daabiligu tuma ko titali maa ni.
en: Some of the redeemed had gone out on the ocean in ships, making their living on the high seas.

dag: n-yɛli, So miri ka o shihi n ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ. Di niŋya n daanabinim ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: He said, Dont hurt my chosen people. Dont hurt my prophets.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa ka a sanna suhuri paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Yawɛ galisiya.
en: May all who come to you be glad and joyful. May all who are thankful for your salvation always say, How great is the Lord .

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n lo ni n kul teeri ya dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, hal yi ni pun mi li ka ba n-zani yɛlimaŋ shɛli yi ni pun dee la ni zaa yoli.
en: You already know these things. You are very strong in the truth you have. But I am always going to help you remember them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli kul ka ti sani hal biɛla gba, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu nyɛla ŋun be barina ni. Ka Yawɛ daa nya yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni kani maa, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: Loyalty is gone, and people who try to do good are robbed. The Lord looked and saw there was no justice. He did not like what he saw.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus min o kpamba ni daa niŋ tab saawara naai ka o yɛli Pool, A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani. Dindina Naa Siiza sani ka a shiri ni bahi chaŋ.
en: After Festus conferred with his advisors, he responded, You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you will go.

dag: ka a ni tooi zaŋ li zali di tuma shee ka mi so shɛŋa din kuni di yiŋa?.
en: Can you take them back to where they belong? Do you know how to get there?.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ binʒim maa kpaai vie Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni la, ka zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim ka di nyɛ din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li.
en: Make a solemn pledge, daughters of Jerusalem, never to rouse, never to arouse love until it desires.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛya, ka naa ŋmalig o nini bahi bɛ polo n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ bɛ zaa ni.
en: Then King Solomon turned toward all the Israelites who were standing there and asked God to bless them.

dag: nyin di nyuri bara n-niŋdi tiwul shɛŋa o ni ŋmahi bahi maa. Ka a yi nyuri bara, nyin baŋmi ni pa nyini ŋun nyɛ tiwulli maa n-sɔŋdi tia maa nyaɣa, amaa di nyaya maa n-sɔŋd a.
en: So then, you must not despise those who were broken off like branches. How can you be proud? You are just a branch; you don't support the roots—the roots support you.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ti gbahi tab zuɣuri, ka zaŋ takɔbiri kuhi tab puluɣa ni, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu n-kpi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Hɛlikatihazurim, ka di be Gibiɔn.
en: Each man grabbed his opponent by the head and stuck his sword into his opponents side so that they both fell dead together. Thats why that place is called The Field of Daggers, which is located in Gibeon.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-voog a yihi nuzaa polo maa katiŋ na n-kar a tahi Izraɛl zoya ni.
en: I will capture you and bring you back. I will bring you from the far north. I will bring you to fight against the mountains of Israel.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dauda daa tuui zaŋ wumpaɣibo yilli ŋɔ ti Asaf min o mabihi maa ni bɛ yili paɣi Yawɛ.
en: This was when David first gave Asaph and his brothers the job of singing praises to the Lord .

dag: m-mali maligu zaŋ li nyo buɣim, ka zaŋ chi mali maligu di zuɣu; ka booi binnyura mali sara di zuɣu; ka lan kɔrig o suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu n-yih o ʒim bahi bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: burning his entirely burned offering and grain offering, pouring out his drink offering, and sprinkling the blood of his well-being sacrifices on the altar.

dag: Jɛhoyakim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim zaa ni daa tum shɛm.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as all his ancestors had done.

dag: A daa zaŋ a situra maa shɛli n-dih a buɣa jɛmbu shee nachiinsi n-dɔni di zuɣu n-tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: You used some of your clothes to decorate your places of worship, and just like a prostitute, you gave yourself to everyone.

dag: Amaa ŋun mi n ni doli so shɛli, o yi vihi ma o ni nya ka n viɛlimi kaman salima la.
en: Surely he knows my way; when he tests me, I will emerge as gold.

dag: A daa zaŋ nam tiŋgbana mini niriba ti ba, ka daa zaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei Hɛshibɔn din daa nyɛ Naa Sihɔn tiŋgbɔŋ la mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ la su.
en: You let them conquer nations and kingdoms, lands that bordered their own. They conquered the land of Heshbon, where Sihon ruled, and the land of Bashan, where Og was king.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam! A viɛlim maa yaɣimi gba! A nina bemi kaman ŋmana la a sariga ni. A zabiri kul yɛbisirimi kaman bu bɔbigu ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli shɛm la.
en: My darling, you are so beautiful! Oh, you are beautiful! Your eyes are like doves under your veil. Your hair is long and flowing, like little goats dancing down the slopes of Mount Gilead.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, o ni be? O ku be, o ni tum binshɛŋa din chihiri ŋɔ zaa zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani o ni kpi. Ka o kum maa taali ni ʒi omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: and lends money for profit. Will he live? No, he will not. He has done all these disgusting things, and so he will die. He will be to blame for his own death.

dag: di saha ka naa daa yɛli anab Neetan, Nyama, m bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ dim be suɣili ni.
en: Then the king said to the prophet Nathan, Here I am living in a house built of cedar, but God's Covenant Box is kept in a tent.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa yiɣisi Giligal lu soli n-gbaai chandi yuŋ hal ti kab ti liri ba libigi ba.
en: Joshua and his army marched all night to Gibeon, so it was a complete surprise when he attacked them.

dag: Musa mini Aduna maa n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Aaron and Moses are the men who talked to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and told him to let the Israelites leave Egypt.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni zuɣulaannim daa bi mi n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n ni niŋ shɛli. N daa na bi yɛli Yɛhudianim mini maligumaaniba ni kpamba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yɛn tum tuma maa ni so shɛli.
en: The officials and important Israelites didnt know where I had gone. They didnt know what I was doing. I had not yet said anything to the Jews, the priests, the kings family, the officials, or any of the other people who would be doing the work.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ tum tuma maa zaa.
en: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.

dag: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi maa daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm, ka bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba tusaata.
en: The Levites did as Moses commanded. About three thousand people were killed that day.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli tɔŋbu saha, ka yɛla mi yi ti paag a, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n-tahiri suhupiɛlli mini yɛlimuɣisira maa zaa na. Dinzuɣu ninsalinim ku tooi baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: When times are good, enjoy the good; when times are bad, consider: God has made the former as well as the latter so that people cant discover anything that will come to be after them.

dag: Ka bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli yi puri ni, yin di ti kpuɣiya di daatam, ka yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni ka di wali wala, yin di pɔhiya li, di ni ti nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni.
en: Do not even harvest the grain that grows by itself without being planted, and do not gather the grapes from your unpruned vines; it is a year of complete rest for the land.

dag: N ni yaai n noli ni suhupiɛlli saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn yili yila paɣ a. N shia din nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛl la gba ni yili yila paɣ a.
en: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.

dag: Waazuyihira maa pala yɛndana kɔŋko, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhi niriba baŋsim, ka bɔhim, ka kpahim yɛla baŋ li, ka ŋahi ŋaha pam.
en: Additionally: Because the Teacher was wise, he constantly taught the people knowledge. He listened and investigated. He composed many proverbs.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la pahi maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa tim salo pam shɛba ka bɛ nyaɣiri takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi la dii paana.
en: Jesus was still speaking when Judas, one of the twelve disciples, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs and sent by the chief priests and the elders.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka niriba paɣ a, chɛ ka niriba zaa paɣ a!.
en: May the people praise you, God! May all people praise you.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ ti ti, dama sakuɣa ŋɔ mini satahinsi ŋɔ saɣiya lala. N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, n ku lan chɛ ka yi be kpe yaha.
en: We have had enough of this hail and thunder! Ask the Lord to stop the storm, and I will let you go. You dont have to stay here.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa chɛ ka tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima ka doli Yɛhudianim daadiini sol la taai duŋ n-daa niŋ Pool mini Baanabas alaka, ka kari ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: However, the Jews provoked the prominent women among the Gentile God-worshippers, as well as the citys leaders. They instigated others to harass Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their district.

dag: Di saha n suhu ni ti paligi Yawɛ zuɣu, ka m mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord , have saved me.
