dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I assure you that on the Judgment Day God will show more mercy to Sodom than to that town!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim kul nyɛla din wuhiri bindira mini binnyura ni Yɛhudianim adiini kaya balibu kam din nyɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zaligunim din yɛn beni hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti lan yɛn taɣi mali binshɛlikam zal la.
en: These gifts and sacrifices are only about food and drink and special washings. They are only rules about the body. God gave them for his people to follow until the time of his new way.

dag: Kalidianim kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi ba, ka chɛ ka n suhu ni yiɣisi ka n ku ninvuɣ shɛb ti galisi pam pali yiya maa zaa. Dama n zaŋla n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ tiŋ ŋɔ nima bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali la zaa zuɣu.
en: of the invading Babylonians. They will be filled with the corpses of those slain in my fierce anger. I hid my face from the people of this city because of all their evil deeds.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu yɛli, Fom a noli ka wara! Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa bɛ sunsuuni, ka chaŋ ka chɛ o, ka bi ti o daŋa.
en: Jesus ordered the evil spirit to be quiet and come out. The demon threw the man to the ground in front of everyone and left without harming him.

dag: Man Jud ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni Jeemsi mabia la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni ni boli ka bɛ nyɛ ŋun ti Ba Naawuni ni yuri shɛba, ka lan nyɛ Yisa Masia ni gbib shɛb la:.
en: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.

dag: Yawɛ yɛn zaŋla buɣim min o takɔbi n-darigi dunia ŋɔ niriba bɛn zaa mali taali tibili. O ni ti chɛ ka niriba pam kpi.
en: The Lord will judge the people and will punish them with fire and his sword. There will be many people killed by the Lord .

dag: Dama Man Yawɛ bi taɣira. Dinzuɣu ka yinim Yaakubu zuliya bi bahi yoli.
en: I am the Lord , and I dont change. You are Jacobs children, and you have not been completely destroyed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul doya gil tiŋ maa m-mali hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini saha.
en: and kept it under siege until Zedekiah's eleventh year.

dag: O wuhiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa din tuhi, ka wuhiri ba o soli.
en: He teaches his ways to humble people. He leads them with fairness.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni m biɛhigu nyaɣisim saha maa, n yɛn yila dunia yili chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka ku paai n saha.
en: I thought I would live a full life. But now, in the middle of my life, the time has come for me to die.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yuri mini chɛchɛbumbariba ni tɔbutuhiriba ni tɔbbihi balibu kam n yiŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: At my table they will eat all they can hold of horses and their riders and of soldiers and fighting men. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli wuhibu daa be o nol ni, ka galimi yɛtɔɣa daa ka o nol ni. O daa kul doli ma mi ni nimmaŋtali mini biɛrisuntali, ka daa yihi niriba pam tuumbiɛri tumbu ni.
en: They taught what was right, not what was wrong. They lived in harmony with me; they not only did what was right themselves, but they also helped many others to stop doing evil.

dag: Yinim Gilibɔa zoya, maligim bee saa ku lan lu yi zuɣu na bee bimbilima ti lan bili yi zolɔna ni. Dama nimaani ka kpiɔŋlaannim bidibbina nya filiŋ. Ka Sool nyɔtaɣirigu bi lan nya kpam ʒe.
en: May no rain or dew fall on you, mountains of Gilboa. May there be no offerings coming from your fields. The shields of the heroes rusted there. Sauls shield was not rubbed with oil.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya li lala ka di niŋ ba alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka fiig tia maa dii zani yim kuui lala.
en: When the disciples saw it, they were amazed. How did the fig tree dry up so fast? they asked.

dag: Bimɔɣiriga ni ti be gariŋga voli gbini diɛmda, ka bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni ti zaŋ o nuu tim bahiga voli ni.
en: Even a baby will not be harmed if it plays near a poisonous snake.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: Your ancestors doubted and tested me, even after they saw what I could do!.

dag: Sool ni daa su ti saha shɛl la, nyini n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi fa Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa yɛl a, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti guli n niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ, ka ti nyɛ ŋun ni su Izraɛl. .
en: Even when Saul was king, you led our nation in battle. And the Lord promised that someday you would rule Israel and take care of us like a shepherd.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka nuchee ŋɔ puhi yina ti sab sabbu ŋɔ.
en: That's why he sent the hand to write this message on the wall.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari. Lɛvi daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Levi lived years. His sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Naawuni daa nya Sɔdom mini Gomɔra tinsi la nim taali, ka daa zaŋ buɣim bahi ba yoli wuliwuli, ka di wuhi din ti yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura.
en: God condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, destroying them with fire, and made them an example of what will happen to the godless.

dag: Amaa ka ti Duuma malaika daa chaŋ dindali yuŋ nti yooi duu maa dunoya ka yihi ba na yɛli ba.
en: But during the night, an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail. The angel led the apostles outside and said.

dag: Di saha Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛla bɛ alichɛbbanim ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi kabɔɣili din daa be Samaria dunɔdali gbin la ni ka anabinim maa zaa daa ʒe bɛ tooni n-tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: At that time the two kings were sitting on their thrones, with their royal robes on, at the judgment place near the gates of Samaria. All the prophets were standing before them, prophesying.

dag: Paɣipuulan ti ku zaŋ bahi, ka paɣiŋoo mi ti ku be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni tin ya nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: In your land no woman will have a miscarriage or be without children. I will give you long lives.

dag: Suhu m-mi biɛrim shɛli din be di ni, ka di mini zino ku tooi laɣim mali di suhupiɛlli.
en: Your joy is your own; your bitterness is your own. No one can share them with you.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the cities of our God. I pray that the Lord will do whatever pleases him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suɣilo tumdi din tuhi ka bɔri jilima mini paɣibu ni niŋgbuŋ din ku pooi la, Naawuni ni ti ti ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu;.
en: Some people keep on doing good, and seek glory, honor, and immortal life; to them God will give eternal life.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ ni yino, ka nyɛ ŋun daa pun chaŋ Yisa san la bɔhi ba.
en: Nicodemus, who was one of them and had come to Jesus earlier, said.

dag: Ka o daa lan chaŋ Manaasa mini Ifriim ni Simiɔn zuliya tinsi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Naftali zuliya tinsi ni nti gili bɛ dabari la ni zaa.
en: He did the same thing in the cities and the devastated areas of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, and as far north as Naphtali.

dag: Solɔɣu ni ti be nimaani ka di yuli booni Soli din be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be daɣiri ni ti ku doli soli maa; ka sochanda ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu gba ti ku yirigi soli maa zuɣu.
en: A good road will be there, and it will be named God's Sacred Highway. It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Farisiinim zuɣu! Dama yi yuri kpamba ʒiishee ʒinibu yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka lan yuri puhigu dahi ni.
en: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa yiɣisi labi Balak sani ti yɛl o, Balaam zaɣisiya ni o ku dol ti kana.
en: So they returned to Balak and told him that Balaam had refused to come with them.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni ka o daa chɛ di zaa, ka zaŋ omaŋa leei dabili. Ka daa leei daadam m-mali daadam niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu.
en: But he emptied himself by taking the form of a slave and by becoming like human beings. When he found himself in the form of a human.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-gbiri binyara ŋubira.
en: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni; dama yi puu biɛri n zuɣu.
en: Saul answered, May the Lord bless you for being so kind to me!.

dag: Di yi di nyɛ lala, dindina o naan kul dirila wahala tum dunia piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ; amaa din beni nyɛla, saha ni daa ti paai, o daa kana yim nti zaŋ omaŋa m-mali sara kpihim niriba daalahichi.
en: for then he would have had to suffer many times ever since the creation of the world. Instead, now when all ages of time are nearing the end, he has appeared once and for all, to remove sin through the sacrifice of himself.

dag: Dama wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n niriba ka mbusim ŋɔ tatabo paai ba? Bee wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n dɔɣiriba ka bɛ kuri ba.
en: How can I bear to watch the terrible evil about to sweep over my people? And how can I bear to watch others destroy my own family.

dag: A bilim ni ha mi ka a pun mi Naawuni Sabbu Kasi din ni tooi wuh a tiliginsim soli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la.
en: You have known the Holy Scriptures since you were a child. These Scriptures are able to make you wise. And that wisdom leads to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: N yur a, n ni zaŋ a ŋmahindila Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi wɔridibiga.
en: You, my love, excite men as a mare excites the stallions of Pharaoh's chariots.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ ŋun be Ziɔn ŋɔ! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla!.
en: You rule from Zion, Lord , and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.

dag: A mabia Sɔdom taali m-bɔŋɔ: O min o bipuɣinsi daa malila karimbaani. Bɛ daa mali bindira pam, ka bɛ nyamma galisi, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔŋdi nandaamba mini bɛn ka.
en: This is the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were proud, had plenty to eat, and enjoyed peace and prosperity; but she didnt help the poor and the needy.

dag: Bɛ daa bi mi ni Yisifu wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa, dama so n-daa deeri yɛtɔɣa maa lɛbigiri tiri ba.
en: Joseph understood what they said, but they did not know it, because they had been speaking to him through an interpreter.

dag: Ka saa nyaɣisibu mini saa tahibu ni kukoya vuri pam yiri nam ʒiishee maa gbin na; ka buɣim mokpala ayopɔin din nyɛ Naawuni shih ayopɔin la sa nam ʒiishee maa tooni dira.
en: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni gbib ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga sahakam, ka gul ti.
en: You, LORD, will keep us, protecting us from this generation forever.

dag: O ba ŋun ni daa ŋariti niriba, ka fari o mabihi, ka tumdi din bi viɛla o niriba sani la zuɣu, o ni kpi o tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: His father, on the other hand, cheated and robbed and always did evil to everyone. And so he died because of the sins he himself had committed.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Naawuni ni bi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu? Bee wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli ni Naawuni ni wuhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bi simdi tibidarigibo simdi ni bɛ nya tibidarigibo?.
en: But I can't go against God! He did not curse or condemn Israel. *.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ; o saria karibu la bela dunia ni zaa.
en: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.

dag: nti chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni nimaani ka o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka yi piɛb kikaa ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: There Zadok the priest and the prophet Nathan will anoint him king over Israel. Blow the rams horn and say, Long live King Solomon.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe niriba maa, ka sokam ni ti gbaag o kpee nuu ni ka bɛ ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: At that time the Lord will make them so confused and afraid that everyone will seize the man next to him and attack him.

dag: Gbuɣimbihi yi bɔri bindirigu Naawuni sani, bɛ chanimi ŋumdi ginda.
en: Lions roar as they attack, as if they are asking God for the food he gives them.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa; ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin maa niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li tari salo maa zaa.
en: After Jesus told the crowd to sit down, he took the seven loaves and gave thanks. He then broke the loaves and handed them to his disciples, who passed them out to the crowd.

dag: O ni daa yɛri ma yɛla maa, ka n daa lu n-dɔni tiŋ tarigi. Amaa ka o daa gbaai ma n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu.
en: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ di mini bindir pala bɔrɔbɔro ni piɛbihi ayi n-gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara Yawɛ sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ zaŋ ti maligumaana maa.
en: The priest will lift them up with the bread from the first harvest to show they were offered with the two lambs before the Lord . They are holy to the Lord . They will belong to the priest.

dag: Wula ka bipala lee yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ soya be kasi? A yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka bɛ ni doli n-chɛ ka di be kasi.
en: How can young people keep their lives pure? By obeying your commands.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, yin deem o binyɛrigu sɔŋ, deemiy o ni zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli maa, ka di leei saamba talima bini.
en: Anyone stupid enough to promise to be responsible for a stranger's debts ought to have their own property held to guarantee payment.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa tin ya, yihimiya Yawɛ dini ni nyɛ shɛli zaa di puuni. Din nyɛ din viɛli gari di zaa ka yi yɛn zaŋ ti o.
en: Give it from the best that you receive.

dag: N niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ, pilimiya buri, ka niŋ tampiligim buɣi yimaŋa n-kum kaman nira bi gaŋa ni yi kpi ka o kumdi shɛm la. Fabilimiya pam, dama bɛn kuri niriba maa ni libigi ti.
en: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.

dag: O ni ti fa yi puri mini yi wain tihi ni yi Olivi tihi puri zaa din mali vuhim n-zaŋ ti o tumtumdiba.
en: A king will take your best fields, vineyards, and olive groves. He will take them from you and give them to his officers.

dag: Di simdi ka a wuhi ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ni yɛn be shɛm mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm zaa.
en: Explain the regulations and instructions to them. Let them know the way they are supposed to go and the things they are supposed to do.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, vihim ma m-baŋ n suhu biɛhigu. Buɣisim ma baŋ n tɛha.
en: God, examine me and know my mind. Test me and know all my worries.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti kpaŋ ka o zaŋ o tahi ti ti nabipuɣiŋga maa, ka o zaŋ o leeg o bia, ka bol o yuli Musa, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kom ni ka n yih o na.
en: And when he was old enough, she took him to the king's daughter, who adopted him. She named him Moses because she said, I pulled him out of the water.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Dindina niŋmiya zim ti ma na. Ka o daa zaŋ zim maa yuɣisi ʒiɛri maa ni ka yɛli ba, Toomiya li ti niriba maa ka bɛ piɛbi. Ka barina shɛli daa lan ka di ni yaha.
en: But Elisha said, Bring some flour. He threw the flour into the pot. Then he said, Pour the soup for the people so that they can eat. And there was nothing wrong with the soup.

dag: Ka Yisifu dan maa daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o ti niŋ sarika ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ naa sarikanim niŋ, ka o daa be sarika maa ni.
en: Josephs master took him and threw him in jail, the place where the kings prisoners were held. While he was in jail.

dag: Malaika yi di be bɛ sani, ŋun nyɛ sandaantimda, ka nyɛ malaikanim tuhili ni yino, n-wuhi ni daadam nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi.
en: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.

dag: Adiini alali din nyɛ din ka galimi ti Ba Naawuni sani nyɛla kpibisi mini pakoya lihibu bɛ wahala ni mini maŋgbaabu zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gabisiri niriba la polo.
en: The worship that God wants is this: caring for orphans or widows who need help and keeping yourself free from the worlds evil influence. This is the kind of worship that God accepts as pure and good.

dag: Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil mabia la bidibisi m-bɔŋɔ: Masha ŋun daa nyɛ Zif ba la n-daa nyɛ o bituuli. Marɛsha bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Hiburɔn.
en: The oldest son of Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, was named Mesha. Mesha was the father of Ziph, who was the father of Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili zani. Zaŋmiya yɛlimaŋli leei shɛlɔriti lo yi shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ wuntitali leei yi nyɔtaɣirisi;.
en: So stand ready, with truth as a belt tight around your waist, with righteousness as your breastplate.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Di pala yɛlimaŋli, yɛlim ti o ni yɛli shɛm. Ka o yɛli ba, O yɛli ma mi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa. .
en: No we don't! they replied. Tell us what he said! He told me that the Lord proclaims: I anoint you king of Israel.

dag: Ka Aripakishad daa nyɛ Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla mi nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, who was the father of Eber.

dag: N di mmaŋ shɛhira, ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba di ma shɛhira pahi.
en: I am one witness concerning myself, and the Father who sent me is the other.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi Amasa, M mabia, a mal alaafee? Ka daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Amasa teeŋa n-niŋ kaman o yɛn mɔɣisila o kpariŋ la.
en: Joab said, Amasa, my cousin, how are you? Then Joab took hold of Amasa's beard with his right hand, so that he could greet him with a kiss.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Judanima, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi zo n-kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Israel defeated Judah. Every man of Judah ran home.

dag: n-chɛ ka bɛ laɣim niriba maa zaa na gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali, ka bɛ mini bɛ zuliya ti sab bɛ yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gari lala.
en: and they assembled the entire community on the first day of the second month. They registered them by their clans and their households, recording the name of each male years old and above.

dag: Di saha ka Juda zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb daa ka Jɔshua sanna Giligal; ka Jɛfune ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ ni yino la ti yɛli Jɔshua, A mi Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la m min a yɛla shɛm Kadɛshibarinia la.
en: In Gilgal, the people of Judah approached Joshua. Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, You know what the LORD said to Moses, man of God, about you and me when we were in Kadesh-barnea.

dag: Yi mi ni Stɛfanas yiŋnima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui niŋ Yisa yɛda Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu tuma ni. M mabihi, n suhiri ya.
en: Brothers and sisters, I encourage you to do something else. You know that the people in Stephanas household were the first crop of the harvest to come from the mission to Achaia. They have dedicated themselves to the service of Gods people.

dag: Sokam fom baalim Yawɛ tooni, dama o yiɣisi zani luɣ kasi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Be silent, everyone, in the LORDs presence, because he has moved from his holy habitation!.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lee kul ŋahiri ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo? Bihi laamba n-di mimima, ka di zaŋ nyamdi bihi nyina ni.
en: What do you mean by this proverb of yours about the land of Israel: When parents eat unripe grapes, the childrens teeth suffer?.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima ni bɛn ka yɛda ni bɛn bi deeri Yawɛ wuhibu.
en: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching.

dag: Ka sapashinnim bɛn daa su chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi maa ni daa nya ka di pala Izraɛl naa maa ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ o.
en: they realized that he was not the king of Israel, and they stopped their attack.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn kum o.
en: Do your work for six days. But the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest that is holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day will be put to death.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhir a, teemi n yɛla, ka lan ti ma kpiɔŋ yim kɔŋko pahi, yaa n Duuma Naawuni, ka m bɔhi Filistianim ŋɔ biɛri labisi n nina ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then Samson prayed, Sovereign Lord , please remember me; please, God, give me my strength just this one time more, so that with this one blow I can get even with the Philistines for putting out my two eyes.

dag: Nyin Sulemaana n-su anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili maa, ka pukpariba maa mi su anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyiyi. Man malila mmaŋmaŋ dahalali wain tihi puu.
en: Solomon is welcome to his thousand coins, and the farmers to two hundred as their share; I have a vineyard of my own!.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni chɛ ka a dɔɣi bihi, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam. Ka n ti chɛ ka zuliya gbaliŋ yi a zuliya maa ni na, ka n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam. .
en: He said to me, I will make you a great family. I will give you many children and you will be a great people. Your family will own this land forever.

dag: Di malila dabiɛm yuŋ, amaa zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ asiba, ka di zo. Lala n-yɛn niŋ bɛnkam kana ni bɛ ti ʒe ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: At evening they cause terror, but by morning they are gone. That is the fate of everyone who plunders our land.

dag: Bɛn daŋ niriba galisi, nyin pirigim pal titali ti ba, ka bɛn mi daŋ niriba pɔra, nyin pirigim palo din pɔri ti ba. Tim daŋ kam niriba bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli kaman bɛ ni sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: To a large clan you will give a large inheritance, and to a small clan you will give a small inheritance. Each will be given its inheritance according to the number of its enrollment.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali, dama n zani m ba Dauda zaani n-di nam ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: Now the Lord has kept his promise: I have succeeded my father as king of Israel, and I have built a temple for the worship of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bimbiɛlli ti biri kulim shee. Di daa nyɛla bimbilli din ʒe m-baɣi kom pam. O daa biri li mi kaman tia din zoora yomyom la.
en: Then he took a young plant from the land of Israel and planted it in a fertile field, where there was always water to make it grow.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛligu bi lan yɛn yuui. Amaa n yi kul tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ni niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ kaman a yurilim maŋli la ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Treat me according to your constant love, and teach me your commands.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa kurigu gbaɣino tuɣibu shee, ka ŋun to li maa bi mi; dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛl o chɛchɛbun duhira, N nya daŋa, ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: By chance, however, a Syrian soldier shot an arrow which struck King Ahab between the joints of his armor. I'm wounded! he cried out to his chariot driver. Turn around and pull out of the battle.

dag: Ka Atai daa nyɛ Neetan ba, ka Neetan mi daa nyɛ Zabad ba.
en: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb tuumbiɛri taali paŋ ba min o ni kpihim shɛb daalahichi mal alibarika.
en: What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ba gbilligbilli n-zaŋ ba niŋ o tumtumdiba nuu ni, ka bɛ taɣiri ba gbilligbilli dol taba ka o yɛli ba, Garimiya n tooni chani ka chɛ ka larigim be yi sunsuuni.
en: He separated these herds and gave them to his servants. He said to them, Go ahead of me and put some distance between each of the herds.

dag: A yi zahim n suhu, a yi ka n sanna yuŋ ti buɣisi ma viɛnyɛliŋga, a ni nya ka ninvuɣ biɛtali ka n ni; ka m mi noli bi tumd alahichi.
en: You were with me all night and looked deep into my heart. You questioned me and found that I did not say or do anything wrong.

dag: Amaa shɛb daa bi saɣi Musa yɛligu maa, ka zaŋ shɛli zali hal ni asiba, ka di daa nyɔni wɔɣi zunzuya. Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Some of them disobeyed, but the next morning what they kept was stinking and full of worms, and Moses was angry.

dag: ni yi chirimya pam. Dama yimaŋmaŋ n-daa tim ma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani yɛra, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yi yɛli shɛli, nyin yɛlimi ti ka ti niŋ li.
en: that you are making a fatal mistake. You asked me to pray to the Lord our God for you, and you promised that you would do everything that he commands.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a mi Sool ni niŋ shɛm, o kari bukpahinim mini jinwariba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka wula ka a ti kana ti bari n nyɛvili tɔŋ ni a chɛ ka n kpi.
en: The woman said, Why are you trying to trick me and get me killed? You know King Saul has killed everyone who talks to the spirits of the dead.

dag: Di saha chɛrubinim maa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nudirigu polo, doo maa ni daa chaŋ ti kpe di ni saha shɛli maa. Ka sagbani daa pali di puuni dundɔŋ la ni.
en: The creatures were standing to the south of the Temple when he went in, and a cloud filled the inner courtyard.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya luɣilikam, ka yi wurim, ka sokam kpa o kpabu polo, ka so ku lan beni ŋun ni laɣim kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba luɣ yini.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send neighboring nations to strike you with terror. You will be scattered, with no one to care for your refugees.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa zani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini tooni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni n-teeg o nuhi.
en: Solomon stood before the LORDs altar in front of the entire Israelite assembly and spread out his hands.

dag: Bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina din so maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka n ni lan wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli gari shɛlikam.
en: Set your hearts, then, on the more important gifts. Best of all, however, is the following way.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suui bɛ noli maa naai ka Yisa bɔhi Saimɔn Pita, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma gari bɛmbɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛbihi.
en: After they had eaten, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon son of John, do you love me more than these others do? Yes, Lord, he answered, you know that I love you. Jesus said to him, Take care of my lambs.

dag: dindina n ni tin ya sakom saa mibu saha, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bindira niŋ pam, ka yi puri ni tihi wali wala.
en: I will give you rain at the proper time, the land will produce its yield, and the trees of the field will produce their fruit.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka nyɛ duŋtaariba, bɛ lɛbi bɛ nini biri ma, ka zo ka chɛ ma.
en: And yet the people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they turn and go their own way.

dag: Ka o ni tum so taali maa dɔɣiri so yi kani ka o ni zaŋ taali tumbu samli maa yo o, ŋun zaŋm li ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti maligumaana m-pahi piɛla so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara ŋun tum taali maa zuɣu la.
en: If the person has no close relative to whom the payment can be made, then the compensation payment will go to the LORD for the priest. This is in addition to the ram of reconciliation by which the guilty party himself is reconciled.

dag: Wɔhu simdila fiɛbiga, ka buŋ simdi langami, ka jɛra yaansi zuɣu mi simdi fiɛbiga.
en: You have to whip a horse, you have to put a bridle on a mule, and you have to beat a fool.

dag: Dama yi mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi lo tab alikauli, ka bɛ ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, ka mal li, bɛ ni boli ya ka yi ti di di maligu bindira.
en: Dont make a covenant with those who live in the land. When they prostitute themselves with their gods and sacrifice to their gods, they may invite you and you may end up eating some of the sacrifice.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: Moses gave God's laws and teachings to the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Sɔdomnim maa yɛl o, Miligim ka ti ti palo. A nyɛla sana kpe, ka bɔri ni a wuhi ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm? A yi bi baŋ ti ni niŋ a din bie n-gari ti ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm. Ka bɛ daa kul dihiri Lɔt na hal ti paai dunoli m-bɔri ni bɛ ŋme n-kab li.
en: But they said, Get out of our way, you foreigner! Who are you to tell us what to do? Out of our way, or we will treat you worse than them. They pushed Lot back and moved up to break down the door.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli. N ni yɛli ni yi yɛla be n suhu ni la nyɛla din yi Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ suhu ni na.
en: God is my witness that I feel affection for all of you with the compassion of Christ Jesus.

dag: Yi ni tooi bɔhi yimaŋa, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bi yɛli.
en: Now, you might be wondering, How will we know which word God hasnt spoken?.

dag: O mɛla gooni gili ma ni di chɛ ka n ku tooi zo. O zaŋla zoligo titaŋa lo ma.
en: He has bound me in chains; I am a prisoner with no hope of escape.

dag: O bi zaŋdi bini din ni saɣim siŋkaafa buri li. O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ naɣikɔra tɔroko kpe di ni no li ka di biɛlim ku bɔɣi.
en: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.

dag: Hal Naa Asa daa yihila Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ o yabipaɣ la Napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me buɣili Ashɛra ŋmahinli zal la zuɣu. Ka Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ daai o ni me ŋmahinli shɛli zali maa luhi n-wurim li ka zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: Asa the king even removed his grandmother Maacah from the position of queen mother because she had made an image of Asherah. Asa cut down her image, pulverized it, and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

dag: Kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm, lala ka ti nini nya li. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tiŋa din nyɛ ti Naawuni tiŋ la ni, ŋun Naawuni ni daa zali shɛli ni di beni sahakam la.
en: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.

dag: Dabisili shɛli din pahir ayi dali, yi ni ti zaŋla bulaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara. Ka sara maligu bimbini maa yi daɣiri ni kaman naɣilaa la ni daa chɛ ka di yi daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: On the second day you will offer a male goat that has nothing wrong with it. It will be for a sin offering. The priests will make the altar pure the same way they made it pure with the bull.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Di nyɛla ʒiri. M bi yɛn zo n-doli Babilɔnnim maa chaŋ. Amaa ka Irija daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum o yɛligu maa, ka gbaai Jɛrimia n-zaŋ o ti ti kpambaliba.
en: Thats a lie, Jeremiah replied. Im not deserting to the Babylonians. But Irijah wouldnt listen to him. He arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa nam puu niŋ Idɛn din be wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ o ni nam ninsal so maa niŋ nimaani.
en: The LORD God planted a garden in Eden in the east and put there the human he had formed.

dag: Yi bi ka la din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa naan ku tooi shihi shɛl la gbin na, dina n-nyɛ: Zo shɛli buɣim ni diri mini zibisim ni sagbana zibigibu ni sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛbu.
en: You have not come to a place that can be seen and touched, like the mountain the people of Israel saw, which was burning with fire and covered with darkness, gloom, and storms.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka yi tinzun tinsi balibu kam ni na la daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.

dag: Hal a ni daa mali shɛm piligu ni la, a ni ti mali gari lala dahin shɛli.
en: Although your former state was ordinary, your future will be extraordinary.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, n-nyɛ yi ni pii na so maa, dama yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔri so maa ka Yawɛ zaŋ leei naa n-tin ya maa.
en: So now, here is the king you chose, the one you asked for. Yes, the LORD has put a king over you!.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔyakim ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti teei gil li.
en: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem and surrounded the city.

dag: Ka Tiyaawumya daa yi Filistianim maa sanna, o yuli n-daa booni Goliat ka o yi tiŋ shɛli din yuli booni Gaat na. O wɔɣilim daa nyɛla kaman mita ata laasabu.
en: A man named Goliath, from the city of Gath, came out from the Philistine camp to challenge the Israelites. He was over nine feet tall.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ gari ti ni suhi shɛm tariga mini ti ni tɛhi shɛm zuɣu la yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma ti ni la zuɣu.
en: Glory to God, who is able to do far beyond all that we could ask or imagine by his power at work within us.

dag: Niriba ni ti yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba mali laara. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ŋun kariti dunianim saria shiri beni.
en: Then it will be said: Yes, there is a reward for the righteous! Yes, there is a God who judges people on the earth.

dag: Firawuna ni yɛli Izraɛlnim yɛla, Bɛ bela tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni dari ginda, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo, ka tiŋgban nɛli taɣi ba zali.
en: The king will think that the Israelites are wandering around in the country and are closed in by the desert.

dag: Di nyɛla ti ni pun wum binshɛŋa yɛla ka mi li. Di nyɛla ti yaannim ni daa pun yɛli ti shɛli yɛla.
en: ones that weve heard and learned about, ones that our ancestors told us.

dag: Shɛshan daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi kɔŋko, o daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa o daa mal o dabili ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nira, ka o yuli booni Jariha.
en: Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na ka tiŋ maa nim dii baŋ o.
en: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa ti so yuli Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Jeemsi mini Jɔn ni Filip mini Baatolomiu.
en: One was Simon, and Jesus named him Peter. Another was Andrew, Peter's brother. There were also James, John, Philip, Bartholomew.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa n-leei tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, ka zaŋ maligumaana Zadok mi n-zali Abiata zaani.
en: Solomon then made Benaiah son of Jehoiada the commander of the army in Joabs place. Solomon also made Zadok the new high priest in Abiathars place.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni. Ka o yɛligu maa daa gari ba pam.
en: Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar and to God what belongs to God. His reply left them overcome with wonder.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa dɔɣi Kɛnan maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pinaanu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Kenan was born, Enosh lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti be bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, n ti ku ʒiɛm ba bee n zaɣisi ba din ni chɛ ka n ku bɛ zaa ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl la, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: But even then, when they are still in the land of their enemies, I will not completely abandon them or destroy them. That would put an end to my covenant with them, and I am the Lord their God.

dag: ni tiŋgban ni pin suma mini di binshɛɣukam ni ŋun daa be tutuɣu din diri buɣim ŋɔ yurilim. Chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim siɣi Yisifu zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka di siɣi ŋun ŋun nyɛ nabia o mabihi sunsuuni ŋɔ ningbaɣu kɔbiri zuɣu na.
en: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.

dag: Dinzuɣu n kul ni yiini yila paɣir a yuli, n yi ti zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ binshɛli n-tir a dabisili kam la na ti ti a.
en: Then I will praise your name forever. Every day I will do what I promised.

dag: Bɛ kul tɔŋdimi bɛ soya ni sahakam. Bɛ ku tooi baŋ a ni kariti saria shɛm. Bɛ kul maanila bɛ dimnim ansarisi.
en: Their ways are always twisted. Your rules are too lofty for them. They snort at all their foes.

dag: ka Jɛrimia daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ni o kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni nti deeg o tarili nimaani niriba maa sani.
en: Jeremiah wanted to travel from Jerusalem to the land of Benjamin. He wanted to be there for a division of some property that belonged to his family.

dag: Ka Barak yɛli Dɛbɔra, A yi ni doli ma chaŋ, n ni chaŋ; amaa a yi ku doli ma chaŋ, dindina n gba ku chaŋ.
en: Then Barak replied, I will go if you go with me, but if you don't go with me, I won't go either.

dag: Maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni pam, di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bɛ zuɣu, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani; o ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛn ya bahi.
en: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.

dag: Mishima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamuɛl mini Zakur ni Shimɛi.
en: Then from Mishma the line descended through Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yi Paran mɔɣu ni chaŋ. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: So Moses obeyed the Lord s command and sent out the Israelite leaders while the people were camped in the desert of Paran.

dag: Ifriimnim daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, niriba niŋgbuna sɔhirimi, bɛ daa tibigi ba pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti jɛmdi Baal, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, N yi ti nya wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Then Abraham said, Lord, please dont be angry with me, but let me ask you this. If only thirty good people are in the city, will you destroy it? The Lord said, If I find thirty good people there, I will not destroy the city.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋun sani ka ti yɛn chaŋ? Nyini m-mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, where would we go? You have the words that give eternal life.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka lari mini suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu naai, ka lan chɛ ka aŋgo mini amiliya kukoya vuri naai kpe yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.

dag: Yi mi lan kala Yisa ŋun nyɛ sandaantimdi so ŋun zali alikauli palli min o ʒi shɛli din mihibu wuhiri ti yɛl shɛŋa din sɔ Ɛbɛl maŋmaŋ ʒim la sanna.
en: to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks better than Abels blood.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan me omaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi zali. O daa mali niɣi mini piɛri pam, dama Naawuni daa ti o buni pam.
en: God made Hezekiah extremely rich, so he bought even more sheep, goats, and cattle. And he built towns where he could keep all these animals.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she zabba ka niŋ bimbomaboma niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she bantabiga ka she shɛlɔrigu n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu.
en: Weave the tunic out of fine linen. Make the turban out of fine linen. Make a sash decorated with needlework.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Sool daa yihi Dauda o sani n-zaŋ o leei tɔbbihi tuhili zuɣulana, ka o daa zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ka labirina.
en: So Saul sent him away and put him in command of a thousand men. David led his men in battle.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima mali duu maa puuni tiŋa n-tabili di puuni duri mini di samban polo duri tiŋgban ni.
en: The floor of both rooms was covered with gold.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be samban ni, o ni ku ma sol ni.
en: Don't be so lazy that you say, If I go to work, a lion will eat me.

dag: Babilɔnnim daa mɛla Sukɔtibɛnɔt buɣili zali, ka Kutinim me Nɛrigal buɣili zali, ka Hamatinim me Ashima buɣili zali.
en: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;.

dag: Amaa yi lee nyɛla bɛn duhiri yimaŋa ka nyuri bara. Ka barinyubo ŋɔ tatabo zaa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: But now you are proud and boast about yourself. All such boasting is wrong.

dag: Manaasa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Makiri daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Makirinima. Makiri bia n-daa nyɛ Giliad; ka Giliad daŋ niriba nyɛ Giliadnima.
en: Manassehs descendants: from Machir, the Machirite clan. Machir fathered Gilead. From Gilead, the Gileadite clan.

dag: N ni labi laŋ piri ba saha shɛli bɛ ni chani maa. N ni siɣisi ba tiŋ na kaman noombihi la. N ni fiɛb ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: As they go, I will spread my net over them; like birds in the sky, I will bring them down; I will judge them according to the report made to their assembly.

dag: ni Hɔrinim bɛn be Ɛdom zoya ni la n-doli ba hal ni Ɛliparan din be mɔɣu ni tintariga la shee.
en: They also defeated the Horites in the hill country of Edom, as far as El-Paran, near the desert.

dag: Ka sapashini maa ni daa yɛl o ni Yisa shiri kpiya maa, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ni Yisifu zaŋm Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: After the officer told him, Pilate let Joseph have Jesus' body.

dag: A yurilim din ka bahigu puuni ka a daa zaŋ a ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa chaŋ. A yiko ka a daa zaŋ wuhi ba soli ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ kasi la ni.
en: With your great loyalty you led the people you rescued; with your power you guided them to your sanctuary.

dag: Biliɛɣu ku lan kpi nimaani bee ka ninkurigu ti kpi ka o saha na bi paai; dama nir yi ti niŋ yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni o nyɛla bipolli, ka so mi yi bi paai yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli n-di o.
en: Babies will no longer die in infancy, and all people will live out their life span. Those who live to be a hundred will be considered young. To die before that would be a sign that I had punished them.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Nuhu min o bidibisi la ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, Have many children. Fill the earth with your people.

dag: Di saha ka tumo daa kana ti yɛli Sool, Kulimina yomyom, dama Filistianim kana ti liri ti.
en: Just then a messenger arrived and said to Saul, Come back at once! The Philistines are invading the country.

dag: O yɛliya, Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya, dama o ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: This is what the king says: Dont let Hezekiah fool you! He cannot save you from my power.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram bidibisi ni, Shubaɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shubaɛl bidibisi ni, Jɛdɛiya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: These are the names of the rest of Levis descendants: Shubael was a descendant of Amram. Jehdeiah was a descendant of Shubael.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa zaa daa kul bi bahi doli taba.
en: But their testimonies didnt agree even on this point.

dag: Amaa ka o nyaandolitab la bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni n-du duli ka vɔri laŋ din daa pali zahim maa na, dama bɛ mini duli daa bi lan wɔɣa. Di daa kul nyɛla kaman mita kɔbiga zuɣu.
en: The other followers went to shore in the boat. They pulled the net full of fish. They were not very far from shore, only about yards.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa bɔhi ma, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ninni ti lihiri suhugarigu lihigu lala? A mi bi biɛra, di nyɛla a suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira suhugarigu. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam.
en: so he asked, Why are you looking so sad? You aren't sick, so it must be that you're unhappy. I was startled.

dag: Ka o daa vihi li. O daa daŋla bɛ kpɛm dini vihibu m-mali lala hal ti paai bɛ biasani dini; ka daa nya pipia maa Bɛnjamin kpalaŋa ni.
en: Joseph's servant started searching the sacks, beginning with the one that belonged to the oldest brother. When he came to Benjamin's sack, he found the cup.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa, ka nam niɣi balibu kam zaa, ka nam binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa balibu kam zaa. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: God made every one of them. Then he looked at what he had done, and it was good.

dag: O zaŋ liɣiri pam mali chaŋ. O ku kuna, naɣila goli muni.
en: He took plenty of money with him and won't be back for two weeks.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni lo ti vuhim nyabu alikauli shɛl la ni na kul ʒiɛya zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zo dabiɛm ka yi ni so ti ku kɔŋ vuhim maa shee paabu.
en: Therefore, since the promise that we can enter into rest is still open, lets be careful so that none of you will appear to miss it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni wuhi ya shihirili. Nyamiya, paɣisari so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl.
en: Therefore, the Lord will give you a sign. The young woman is pregnant and is about to give birth to a son, and she will name him Immanuel.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli, A nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma shihirili din wuhiri ni nyin Yawɛ n-tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then Gideon said to him, If Ive gained your approval, please show me a sign that its really you speaking with me.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ko yi gbansɔri yuma ayɔbu n-kpuɣi di daatam.
en: For six years you should plant crops on your land and gather in its produce.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Saha yipa paaya ni Daadam Bia nya jilima.
en: Jesus replied, The time has come for the Human One to be glorified.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm ka yɛdaniŋdiba mini Yisa tuumba maa ni cheechi kpamba maa daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam yɛla.
en: When they arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, the apostles, and the elders, to whom they told all that God had done through them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi kpe ŋɔ mini ninsalinim ni biŋkɔbiri ni puri ni tihi ni tiŋgbani atam zuɣu. N suhuyiɣisili maa ni bemi kaman buɣim la, ka so ku tooi kpihi li.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD God says: Im going to pour out my fierce anger on this place, on humans and beasts, on the trees of the field and the crops of the fertile land. It will burn and not go out.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnani zali bee m-mali binshɛli ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom puuni.
en: Do not make for yourselves images of anything in heaven or on earth or in the water under the earth.

dag: Zaŋm nɛkaŋa n-niɛm zim. Paam a sariga sɔŋ, ka kahi a mukuru ka chɛ a biɛhi n-siɣi mɔɣa kom ni du.
en: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli, N tum taali, m bia Dauda, labimina, n ku lan niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu yaha, dama a lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; nyama, n tum jɛrilim ka birigi pam.
en: David, you had the chance to kill me today. But you didn't. I was very wrong about you. It was a terrible mistake for me to try to kill you. I've acted like a fool, but I'll never try to harm you again. You're like a son to me, so please come back.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim taali maa galisiya pam. Bɛ kul kurila niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli tiŋ maa ni. Dama bɛ yɛra, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. Yawɛ bi nyara.
en: He said to me: Judah and the house of Israel are very, very guilty. The land is filled with blood, and the city is full of injustice. They have said, The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD sees nothing.

dag: Hal yi ni to tɛte ni yi di kpibisi, ka yi mini niriba tɔɣisi gbaai yi zɔsimo daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!.

dag: Amaa o daa bi wurim buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul maani maligu nimaani, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu, nyini daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi kul wum yɛtɔɣ shɛli n noli ni saha shɛlikam, nyin zaŋmi li kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: Ezekiel, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.

dag: Ka o yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiy o fali maa ti o ba mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he has no brothers, his father's brothers are to inherit it.

dag: N Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tahima a sani di vi n zuɣu. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd a ŋɔ nya filiŋ n zuɣu.
en: LORD God of heavenly forces!— dont let those who hope in you be put to shame because of me. God of Israel!— dont let those who seek you be disgraced because of me.

dag: M bi suhir a ni a yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa n suhir a mi ni a gbib ba ka Sintani ku paai ba.
en: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Do kura mini paɣ kpamba bɛn dihiri jaaŋgbɛhi ni lan ʒiini Jɛrusalɛm puuni sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, Old men and women will again be seen in the public places in Jerusalem. People will live so long that they will need their walking sticks.

dag: Naa Ahaz kum yuuni ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa kana:.
en: This is a message that was proclaimed in the year that King Ahaz died.

dag: M Ba ni zaŋ shɛb zaa ti ma ni ka n sanna, ka ŋunkam mi ka n sanna, n ku zaɣis o.
en: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.

dag: Amaa o fari nandaamba bɛ noya ni bahira, ka fara ba kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira.
en: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mɛri wuna pa shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri ni yuri binshɛŋa bi kuri ba buchi. Bɛ shɛhiranim ku tooi nya shɛli bee m-baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni di vi.
en: Some people make idols, but they are worthless. They love their statues, which are useless. Those who serve as witnesses for these statues cannot even see. They dont know enough to be ashamed.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣ silig shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni la, ka bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo siliga maa noli.
en: He bought a linen cloth, took Jesus down from the cross, wrapped him in the cloth, and laid him in a tomb that had been carved out of rock. He rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.

dag: Di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam nti yaɣi ka bɛ yɛra, O niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, hal o chɛ ka tikpiranim wumda, ka chɛ ka biriti gba tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: People were overcome with wonder, saying, He does everything well! He even makes the deaf to hear and gives speech to those who cant speak.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu, miriya ka yi doli zaligusaɣindiba ŋɔ biriginsim soli maa ka kɔŋ yimaŋmaŋ ʒiɛyimtali zaashee la ni zanibu.
en: But you, my friends, already know this. Be on your guard, then, so that you will not be led away by the errors of lawless people and fall from your safe position.

dag: Ka n ni ti be yi sani, ka ku lan zaɣisi ya.
en: Also, I will place my Holy Tent among you. I will not turn away from you.

dag: O chɛ ka di niŋda, di yi nyɛla tibidarigibo zuɣu bee o yurilim zuɣu.
en: God sends rain to water the earth; he may send it to punish us, or to show us his favor.

dag: Amaa nyini ka n naɣ ni lo alikauli. Zaŋm a paɣ min a bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba n-kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: But I will set up my covenant with you. You will go into the ark together with your sons, your wife, and your sons wives.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba daa ŋmaligi Abishai tooni guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yi Ammɔnnim maa tuhibu yɔɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonites saw the Syrians running away, they fled from Abishai and retreated into the city. Then Joab turned back from fighting the Ammonites and went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka niriba ni ʒini nimaani ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri ku lan zɔhiri mbusim shɛli ti paai ba m-bahi ba yoli zuɣu.
en: People will move to Jerusalem because it will be a safe place to live. It will never again be destroyed.

dag: Ka o ti kɔrigi taali sanyoo sara piɛbila maa, ka maligumaana maa zaŋ taali sanyoo sara maa ʒim shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tib nyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.
en: He shall kill the lamb and take some of the blood and put it on the lobe of your right ear, on the thumb of your right hand, and on the big toe of your right foot.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa dol o zaligunim maa be o ni, ka o mi be bɛ ni. O ni zaŋ o Shi so ti ti la n-chɛ ka ti baŋ ni o be ti ni.
en: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm yi nyɛla ʒiri amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni yɛlimaŋli zani ka o nya jilima, dindina wula ka o ni lan kari ma saria kaman alahichilana?.
en: But if Gods truth is demonstrated by my lie and it increases his glory, why am I still judged as a sinner?.

dag: Baŋmi ni yɛm gba nyɛla din nyaɣis a suhu ni. A yi nya yɛm, a ni nya dahin shɛli biɛhigu, ka a tahima ku zani soli.
en: you may be sure that wisdom is good for the soul. Get wisdom and you have a bright future.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa paag o nuu bɛ zuɣu ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ daa jɛmdila saŋmarisi kaman anabinim ni daa sab li shɛm bɛ litaafinim ni yɛli, Izraɛlnima, man Naawuni ka yi daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara tiri mɔɣu ni m-mali hal ti paai yuun pihinahi la?.
en: So God turned away from them and handed them over to worship the stars in the sky, just as it is written in the scroll of the Prophets: Did you bring sacrifices and offerings to me for forty years in the wilderness, house of Israel? .

dag: O daa mɛla buɣili Baal maligu bimbini zali o ni daa me Baal jɛmbu du shɛli zali Samaria la puuni.
en: He built a temple to Baal in Samaria, made an altar for him, and put it in the temple.

dag: Niriba ayi noya yi bi pa taba, bɛ ni tooi laɣim doli?.
en: Will two people walk together unless they have agreed to do so?.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sida dapaɣa kpahi duu maa nyaaŋa polo hal ti gbaai yɔɣira, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ kpahi di puuni gba lala ni di leei di puuni luɣ kasi shee, ka niŋ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi.
en: An inner room, called the Most Holy Place, was built in the rear of the Temple. It was feet long and was partitioned off by cedar boards reaching from the floor to the ceiling.

dag: A mali pal yɛlinli ti n naba, ka m bi sarigi.
en: Youve let me walk fast and safe, without even twisting an ankle.

dag: A daa tahi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu zuɣu ka di kom vuui; ka chɛ ka bɛ no tiŋkuŋ zuɣu kaman tiŋgban nɛl la du.
en: He gave the command, and the Red Sea became dry. He led them through the deep sea on land as dry as the desert.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba pinyaayi maa bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm naai, o daa yiɣisimi n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din miri nimaani nti wuhiri niriba ka yihiri ba waazu.
en: When Jesus finished these instructions for his twelve followers, he left there. He went to the towns in Galilee to teach the people and tell them Gods message.

dag: Biliha ŋun daa nyɛ Leeban ni daa zaŋ so ti o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb ti Yaakubu m-bala; ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel. She bore these to Jacob, a total of persons.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa tumdi tuma ka di fukumsi ʒi tibisa ʒi yi zuɣu, kamiya n sanna, ka n ti tin ya vuhim.
en: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.

dag: Yi karitila nimmira saria, amaa man bi kariti so saria.
en: You judge me the way people judge other people. I dont judge anyone.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, dama n ni niŋ a nirilim a ba Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yab Sool ni daa su tiŋgban shɛli zaa ti a, ka lan chɛ ka m min a laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam.
en: Don't be afraid, David replied. I will be kind to you for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will give you back all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always be welcome at my table.

dag: Shimɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amnɔn mini Rina ni Bɛnhanan ni Tilɔn. Ishi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔhɛt mini Bɛnzɔhɛt.
en: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.

dag: Dindali maa ka n daa po pɔri ni n ni yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni pun bo n-zali ba ka di nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa.
en: On that day I swore that I would lead them out of the land of Egypt to a land that I would show them, a land full of milk and honey, the most splendid of all lands.

dag: Yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa yi ti kuna nya o ni lala, o ni nya suhupiɛlli.
en: When the master comes and finds him doing the work he gave him, it will be a day of blessing for that servant!.

dag: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la, n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: The stone rejected by the builders is now the main foundation stone!.

dag: Bɔ ka Yɛhudianim lee zaŋ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim? Bee gunibu buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: So whats the advantage of being a Jew? Or whats the benefit of circumcision?.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Ɛfɛsus ka nyɛ bɛn ʒe yim Yisa Masia san la.
en: From Paul, who by God's will is an apostle of Christ Jesus— To God's people in Ephesus, who are faithful in their life in union with Christ Jesus:.

dag: A situra tulimi, pɔhim tulli ni ʒiɛri zuɣu.
en: you whose clothes are hot when earth is calmed by the south wind?.

dag: Zaŋmiya biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yini naŋgbambili, ka lan zaŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pahi ayi la gba naŋgbambili.
en: Make loops down the edge of the end curtain of one group. Do the same for the end curtain of the other group.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asiba ka Jɔnatan zaŋ bia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni kaman o mini Dauda ni daa pun tɔɣisi shɛm la.
en: The following morning Jonathan went to the fields to meet David, as they had agreed. He took a young boy with him.

dag: M bi baŋ mmaŋmaŋ yɛla gba, dama m bi tumdi mmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri ni n tum shɛli, amaa n ni je shɛl la, dina ka n tumda.
en: I do not understand what I do; for I don't do what I would like to do, but instead I do what I hate.

dag: Di saha ka o daa teeg omaŋ pa bia maa zuɣu napɔŋ buta, ka suhi Yawɛ, yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka bia ŋɔ nyɛvili lab o ni na yaha.
en: Then Elijah stretched himself out on the boy three times and prayed, O Lord my God, restore this child to life.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi sizuura lubu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ na titali. Ŋuna n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: The Lord , the Most High, is to be feared; he is a great king, ruling over all the world.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛdɛkia Chɛnaana bia la daa chaŋ ti lab Mikaya tapaɣa, ka bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ shia niŋ yi n ni kana ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Zedekiah, Chenaanahs son, approached Micaiah and slapped him on the cheek. Just how did the LORDs spirit leave me to speak to you? he asked.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Judanim ku tooi zabi bɛmaŋ zuɣu. Dindali maa, yi daa chaŋla tibɔŋ ni bidibbina duu la ni nti yihi bidibbina.
en: Then the cover protecting Judah was removed, and the people turned to the weapons they kept at the Forest Palace.

dag: ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim guli Sur Dunɔdal la, ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim be dunɔdali din be guliba nyaaŋa la zaa n-guli nayili.
en: a second third will be at the Sur Gate, and the final third will be at the gate behind the guards. You will take turns guarding the temple.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn daa guli naa la sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba tahi Babilɔn naa sani Ribila.
en: Nebuzaradan took them to the king of Babylonia, who was in the city of Riblah.

dag: Amaa a yi nya a wuna maa so sani, bɛn kum o. Lihimi n nɛma ŋɔ ni nya, a bini yi be di ni, nyin yihim li ti dɔɣiriba ŋɔ zaa ninni. Yaakubu daa bi mi ni Reechɛl n-zu n-kpuɣi wuna maa.
en: Whomever you find with your divine images wont live. Identify whatever I have that is yours, in front of your brothers, and take it. Jacob didnt know that Rachel had stolen them.

dag: Ka Naa Azaria daa me Ɛlat n-labisi li ti Judanima, o ba kum maa nyaaŋa.
en: So King Amaziah died and was buried with his ancestors. Then Azariah rebuilt Elath and got it back for Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: Therefore, you also should be prepared, because the Human One will come at a time you dont know.

dag: Ŋunkam doli zaligu, zaɣ biɛɣu ku paag o, ka yɛndana mi o ni yɛn niŋ lala saha shɛli.
en: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.

dag: Dapaɣili kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Each frame was cubits long and / cubits wide.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia Yisa ŋun daa chaŋ ti be Naawuni san la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti daadiini ŋɔ kirikiri.
en: Also, lets hold on to the confession since we have a great high priest who passed through the heavens, who is Jesus, Gods Son.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiya ni o tɔɣisi zab omaŋ zuɣu. O zaniya ni o kari o niriba saria.
en: The LORD arises to accuse; he stands to judge the peoples.

dag: dindina yin zomiya takɔbi dabiɛm, dama suhuyiɣisili tahiri tibidarigibo din nyɛ takɔbi na ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni sariakaribo din tuhi beni.
en: But you need to worry about your own punishment. God might use the sword against you! Then you will know there is a time for judgment.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli ba, Firawuna yɛliya, N ku lan tin ya mɔri.
en: So the Egyptian slave masters and the Hebrew foremen went to the Israelites and said, Pharaoh has decided that he will not give you straw for your bricks.

dag: Ka gbaŋŋmara maa daa yɛl lala n-naai ka yɛli salo maa ni bɛ wurimma.
en: After saying this, he dismissed the meeting.

dag: Ka Sool mini Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa chani gindi mali Yisa yuli yihiri waazu ni suhukpeeni.
en: After this, Saul moved freely among the disciples in Jerusalem and was speaking with confidence in the name of the Lord.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni ka galindi niriba. Bɛ dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri soli, ka nyuri bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ni be di niriba zuɣu nyɔri.
en: These people are always grumbling and blaming others; they follow their own evil desires; they brag about themselves and flatter others in order to get their own way.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi. Di simdi ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam bɛ mini bɛ zuliya sani bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: They must wash their hands and their feet so that they dont die. This will be a permanent regulation for them, for Aaron and his descendants in every generation.

dag: Ka a zaŋ firanki tulaale zim alali pahi kul yini kam zuɣu, ka yi ti zaŋ li pahi bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di leei shɛhira.
en: Put pure frankincense on each stack, as a token portion for the bread; it is a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Bɛ nyarila tibiginsim saha biɛla, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni suui lu n-kuui kaman vari la; ka bɛ ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri kaman ka zuɣuri la.
en: They are exalted for a short time, but no longer. They are humbled then gathered in like everyone else; cut off like heads of grain.

dag: A yi di nyɛla jɛrigu ŋun duhir amaŋa bee a yi di lɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu, nyin zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli;.
en: If you have been foolish enough to become proud and make plans against other people, stop and think about what you are doing.

dag: Ti Duuma dabisili dali ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa ti pali ma, ka n wum kukol shɛli n nyaaŋa polo ka di tahiri kaman kikaa vur la.
en: I was in a Spirit-inspired trance on the Lords day, and I heard behind me a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa ka o sanna, amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o sani paabu.
en: Jesus' mother and brothers went to see him, but because of the crowd they could not get near him.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yi shihi di nimdi maa di gba ni leei din be kasi. Ka di ʒim yi tɔɣ vie binyɛrigu, di simdi ka yi paɣi di ni tɔɣ vie binyɛr shɛli maa luɣ kasi shee.
en: Touching the meat of the sin offering makes a person or a thing holy. If any of the sprinkled blood falls on a persons clothes, you must wash the clothes in a holy place.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yili yilli ŋɔ: Yilimiya yila yɛli di yɛla; Kɔbiliga, chɛ ka kom yi a ni na;.
en: Then the Israelites sang this song: Well, flow up! Sing about it!.

dag: Ka o daa lɔrigi malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛn daa pun mali shili gu di saha maa ni di dabisili maa ni di goli maa ni di yuuni maa ni bɛ ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la.
en: The four angels were released; for this very hour of this very day of this very month and year they had been kept ready to kill a third of all the human race.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ je suli ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale maa lala?.
en: The disciples saw this and became angry. Why all this waste? they asked.

dag: Di bo yomyom yaag a noli bee n-jiɣ a suhu ni n-yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli Naawuni tooni, dama Naawuni bela alizanda ni, ka a mi be dunia ŋɔ ni; dinzuɣu chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa pɔra.
en: Be careful when you make promises to God. Be careful about what you say to him. Dont let your feelings cause you to speak too soon. God is in heaven, and you are on the earth. So you need to say only a few things to him. This saying is true:.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka naa mali suhupiɛlli; a sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o mali suhupiɛlli pam maa.
en: Lord , your strength makes the king happy. He is so happy when you give him victory.

dag: Nadab bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sɛlɛd mini Apaim. Amaa Sɛlɛd ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;.

dag: Ŋuna m-pii ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ti, din nyɛ Yaakubu so o ni yuri la ni nyuri bara shɛli zuɣu la.
en: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpɛhi Naawuni nini, ka lo kpara ni bɛ tuhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa;.
en: That is the fate of those who shake their fists at God and defy the Almighty.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi n-tab Yisa maa bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa.
en: That follower leaned closer to Jesus and asked, Lord, who is it.

dag: Dama o zaligunim zaa kul dola n tooni, ka n na ʒi n-zaɣis o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la gba.
en: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.

dag: Ti daa ʒiɛm o ka zaɣis o. O daa nyɛla ŋun mili suhugarigu mini wahala dibu. O daa ŋmanila niriba ni ŋmaligiri bɛ nina bahiri kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ so. Ti daa ʒiɛm o, ka bi lih o ka o nyɛ shɛli.
en: People made fun of him, and even his friends left him. He was a man who suffered a lot of pain and sickness. We treated him like someone of no importance, like someone people will not even look at but turn away from in disgust.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yo yi puri atam pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim naai yuuni din pahir ata, ka nyɛ yuun shɛli puuni yi ni yɔri pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim tiri Lɛvinim mini saamba ni kpibisi ni pakoya ni bɛ gba di n-tiɣi yi tinsi ni la.
en: Every third year give the tithe—a tenth of your crops—to the Levites, the foreigners, the orphans, and the widows, so that in every community they will have all they need to eat. When you have done this.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ san la, ka di leei alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: He will press his hand on the goats head. It will be slaughtered at the place where an entirely burned offering would be slaughtered before the LORD. It is a purification offering.

dag: O daa zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei niriba maa ni su shɛlikam zaa su.
en: God gave them the lands of other nations; they inherited the wealth of many peoples.

dag: Ka zuliya pam ti tim ya ŋɔ tiŋ puuni garita ka bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ ti darigi tin titali ŋɔ nim tibili lala? .
en: Afterward many foreigners will pass by and ask one another why I, the Lord , have done such a thing to this great city.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ba so shɛli din kuni tiŋ maa ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba maa daa kpe tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima. Amaa ka daa chɛ do so ŋun wuhi ba tiŋ maa soli maa min o malibu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The man showed them, and the two Israelite tribes attacked Bethel, killing everyone except the man and his family. The two tribes made the man and his family leave.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn zaŋ kuɣa me sara maligu bimbini ti ma, yin di zaŋya kuɣ kpɛra me li, dama yi yi zaŋ chiriga shihi kuɣ shɛli, di ni leei kuɣ shɛli din mali daɣiri.
en: But if you use stones to make an altar, then dont use stones that were cut with an iron tool. If you do that, it will make the altar unacceptable.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ daa zaŋla Gɛba mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Alɛmɛt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Anatɔt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba. Bɛ ni daa su tin shɛŋa bɛ daŋ maa zaa ni daa nyɛla tinsi pinaata.
en: In the territory of Benjamin they were assigned the following towns with their pasture lands: Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth. This made a total of thirteen towns for all their families to live in.

dag: O daa pilila daanya zuɣupiligu ka ye kurigu gbaɣino din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihinu ni ayopɔin.
en: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore bronze scale-armor weighing one hundred twenty-five pounds.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛli Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Nyama, a mini Abiata zaŋmiya yi bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ a bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan n-labi tiŋ maa puuni ni suhudoo.
en: The king said to Zadok the priest, You are a seer. Go back to the city in peace. Take your son Ahimaaz and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

dag: A mini niriba maa kul yɛn gbarigimi zaa. Tuma maa yaɣ a kɔŋko tuma, a kɔŋko ku tooi tumdi li.
en: You and the people who come to you will soon be worn out. The job is too much for one person; you can't do it alone.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nya daliri jɛndi ma, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: Notice that he invents arguments against me; he considers me his enemy.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ li sɔɣi ti bihi, ti ni zaŋ Yawɛ jilima tuma min o tuun kara ni o daalahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum la yɛla yɛli ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba.
en: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord .

dag: Dama, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini m-pii ba dunia ŋɔ ninsalinim zaa ni ni a su ba kaman a ni daa chɛ ka a dabili Musa yɛl ba shɛm saha shɛli a ni daa yihi ti yaannim maa Ijipti na la.
en: You have chosen them from all the peoples of the earth to be your own special people. Lord GOD, you promised to do that for us. You used your servant Moses to make that promise when you brought our ancestors out of Egypt.

dag: ka o yidan maa wum li ka bi yɛl o shɛli, ka mi bi galim li, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o ni niŋ shɛli maa ni zani.
en: she must do everything that she vowed or promised unless her husband raises an objection when he hears about it.

dag: Kulibɔn shɛŋa din kom nyuui mini tiŋgbani voya ni ni tampima voya ni n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: They had to live in caves, in holes dug in the sides of cliffs.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, M mi ni bɛ ni booni so Masia la ni kana; ka o yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ti binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The woman said, I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ maligumaana maa suhupiɛlli, ka o kpuɣi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa mini binnan bihi ni dari binnani maa n-kpe m-be niriba maa sunsuuni ka bɛ chana.
en: This made the Levite happy. So he took the ephod, the household idols, and the idol. He went with the men from the tribe of Dan.

dag: Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba zaa n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Ka ya polo ka doo ŋɔ lee bɔhim yɛla ŋɔ zaa.
en: Don't his sisters still live here in our town? How can he do all this.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa chaŋ Farisiinim sani ti yɛli ba Yisa ni tum shɛm maa.
en: But some of them returned to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kpa duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni; luɣ shɛli a ni daa yɛli, N yuli ni be nimaani la. Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ n nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deemi n suhigu.
en: In the past you said, I will be honored there. So please watch over this Temple, night and day. And please listen to my prayer as I turn toward this Temple and pray to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam nyuri bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: So, as the Scriptures say, Whoever boasts should boast only about the Lord.

dag: Dama yi mi ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli pa talima n-tiligi ya biɛr yo shɛli yi ni daa deei yi yaannim san la ni pala din nyɛ binshɛŋa din saɣindi kaman anzinfa bee salima.
en: Live in this way, knowing that you were not liberated by perishable things like silver or gold from the empty lifestyle you inherited from your ancestors.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Jɔnatan, biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi. Ka n yi bi niŋ a lala, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma gari n ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm gba.
en: May God deal harshly with me and worse still if you dont die today! Saul swore.

dag: Mia pi tiŋgban ni guli ba, ka tɔŋ do sol ni guli ba.
en: On the ground a snare is hidden; a trap has been set in their path.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtishɛmɛshinim maa daa yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tooni? Ka o yi yi ti sani, banim sani ka o lee yɛn chaŋ.
en: They said, Where is a priest who can care for the Holy Box? Where should the Box go from here.

dag: N suhu yɛliya, Kamina ti jɛm o. Yawɛ, nyini ka n shiri ni jɛm;.
en: When you said, Come worship me, I answered, I will come, Lord .

dag: Ka Abija daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o ba zaani. Asa ʒiɛmani maa ni, bɛ mini so daa bi tuhi tɔbu hal ni yuun pia.
en: When Abijah died, they buried him in the City of David. Abijahs son Asa became the new king after him. There was peace in the country for ten years in Asas time.

dag: Ka Pool mi daa pii Silas pah omaŋ zuɣu ka yɛdaniŋdiba daa zaŋ ba niŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni, ka bɛ mi naanyi chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: while Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the care of the Lord's grace.

dag: Pool ni daa ti gbaai dunɔdura dubu, tɔbbihi maa daa kpuɣ o mi buɣi salo maa ni daa na kul bi chɛ o zuɣu.
en: They got as far as the steps with him, and then the soldiers had to carry him because the mob was so wild.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A tuhi tɔbu pam, ka ku niriba pam, di bi simdi ka a me jɛmbu duu n-ti ma jilima, dama a ku niriba pam dunia ŋɔ ni n ninni.
en: But the Lord told me that I had killed too many people and fought too many wars. And so, because of all the bloodshed I have caused, he would not let me build a temple for him.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri be teeku kom zuɣu; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ n-tahiri maa, Yawɛ m-be ko titali maa zuɣu maa.
en: The LORDs voice is over the waters; the glorious God thunders; the LORD is over the mighty waters.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, naa mini kpambaliba ti ku lan mali suhukpeeni. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi maligumaaniba, ka di niŋ anabinim alahiziba.
en: On that day, declares the LORD, the courage of the king and his princes will fail, the priests will be stunned, and the prophets will be shocked.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti kpɛna n-gbaai salo maa yulibu nti nya do so ka o bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa binyɛrigu.
en: When the king came in to meet the guests, he saw a man there who was not dressed in the right clothes for a wedding.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, A kula nira, ka lan deeg o ni su shɛli? Ka lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ni lan yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahi ni lɛli Nabɔt ʒim luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka bahi yɛn lɛl a gba ʒim. .
en: Say the following to him: This is what the LORD says: So, youve murdered and are now taking ownership, are you? Then tell him: This is what the LORD says: In the same place where the dogs licked up Naboths blood, they will lick up your own blood.

dag: Ka dilan yi yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim pɔi, ka a naanyi ŋmaag a ni bɔri shɛm tariga. O yɛrimi, Aai, ŋmaam ti ma pumpɔŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni zaŋ kiŋkansi ŋmaai li.
en: If anyone said, Let the fat be burned off first, as usual, then take whatever you like for yourself, the assistant would reply, No, hand it over now. If not, Ill take it by force.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bundaannima bɛ gom saha, amaa bɛ yi ti neei, bɛ ku lan mali shɛli.
en: They might be rich when they go to bed, but when they open their eyes, all their riches will be gone.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi, faashee yi wuntizɔbo zooi gari Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim dini, di yi pa lala yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni abada.
en: I tell you, then, that you will be able to enter the Kingdom of heaven only if you are more faithful than the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees in doing what God requires.

dag: Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl Jɛziriil tintariga, ka so ku sɔɣ o. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka anab maa daa yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi.
en: Jezebel will not be buried; her body will be eaten by dogs in the territory of Jezreel. After saying this, the young prophet left the room and fled.

dag: Timoti ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee la puhiri ya; ka Lusius mini Jeesɔn ni Sɔsipata bɛn nyɛ n zuliya la gba puhiri ya.
en: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you his greetings; and so do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, fellow Jews.

dag: Di piligu dali ti nyɛla laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di ti tumiya yi dabisili kam tuma dindali maa.
en: The first day is a holy occasion. You must not do any job-related work.

dag: Yawɛ yɛri Izraɛlnima, Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya.
en: The Lord says this to the nation of Israel: Come looking for me and live.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, di daa birim o pam; dama ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛliya ni Jɔn Baptaizira n-neei kum ni na maa. Luk .-.
en: Herod the ruler heard about all that was happening, and he was worried. Some people were saying John the Baptist had come back to life. Lk .-.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya kumdi ka fabindi la ni Yisa neei kum ni.
en: She went and reported to the ones who had been with him, who were mourning and weeping.

dag: dama yi mi ni buɣisibu shɛli din buɣisiri yi yɛda niŋbu chɛmi ka yi niŋdi ania.
en: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti zaŋ Dauda na, ka paɣ maa yɛli ba, O biɛrimi.
en: Saul sent messengers to arrest David, but she said, Hes sick.

dag: A bɔɣu nyɛla din mali kpiɔŋ; a nuu maa shiri mali kpiɔŋ, di bamdi a nudirigu.
en: You have the power! Your power is great! Victory is yours!.

dag: Zaŋmiya daanya mali kurupooti, ka zaŋ daanya mali bans anahi niŋ di tarisi bunahi zuɣu.
en: Make a bronze grating and put four bronze carrying rings on its corners.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya mini Nɛtania ni Zɛbadia ni Asahɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhɔnatan ni Adɔnija ni Tɔbija ni Tɔbadɔnija m-pahi Maligumaaniba Ɛlishama mini Jɛhɔram.
