en: They were accompanied by nine Levites and two priests. The Levites were Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah; and the priests were Elishama and Jehoram.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ŋmaligi nya ba, ka zaŋ Yawɛ yuli yɛli ba noli. Ka gbuɣin nyama ayi daa yi tibɔŋ ni na nti dim ku bidibbihi pihinahinaayi.
en: Elisha turned around and stared at the boys. Then he cursed them in the name of the Lord . At once two bears ran out of the woods and ripped to pieces of the boys.

dag: n-kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya, ka zaŋ ya na ti zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya, ka yi su li kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: When you moved forward, he forced out nations that were greater and more powerful than you. And he led you into their land. He gave you their land to live in, as he is still doing today.

dag: Dama sɔtim ku tooi gbaai Yaakubu zuliya, ka so mi ku tooi wa Izraɛlnim bukpahigu. Niriba ni ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu mini Izraɛlnim yɛla ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni ni tum shɛm.
en: There is no omen against Jacob, no divination against Israel. Instantly it is told to Jacob, and to Israel, what God performs.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o ku o nimaani sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa luɣili ni o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.

dag: Pa kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ka ti daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa Masia yiko min o kandina yɛla, amaa ti nyɛla shɛhiranim bɛn nini daa nya o jilima.
en: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.

dag: amaa di yi yila Naawuni sanna, dindina yi ku tooi nyaŋ ba; hal yi yi dol li gba, di pa shɛli yi ni ti nya ka di nyɛla Naawuni ka yi tuhiri maa. Ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa.
en: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You might even be fighting against God himself! The Jewish leaders agreed with what Gamaliel said.

dag: Ka Musa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ ni daa be putɔɣu dabitim bandi shɛli ni maa zuɣu.
en: Moses told this to the Israelites, but they would not listen to him, because their spirit had been broken by their cruel slavery.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee kum pam a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka dɔni tampiligim ni bilim.
en: They all mourn bitterly for you, Throwing dust on their heads and rolling in ashes.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Absalom, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din bi viɛla.
en: Hushai said to Absalom, Ahithophels advice is not good this time.

dag: Ka tibili yi yɛli ni di pala nini, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni, lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: If the ear says, Im not part of the body because Im not an eye, does that mean its not part of the body?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa fiig tia o puu ni, ka di walibu saha ti paai ka o chaŋ ti bɔri wala di zuɣu ka bi nya.
en: Then Jesus told them this parable: There was once a man who had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. He went looking for figs on it but found none.

dag: Dama nyini n Duuma n-nyɛ n tahima. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Lord GOD, you are my hope. I have trusted you since I was a young boy.

dag: Amɔs daa yɛliya, Bɛ wum Yawɛ damli Ziɔn zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli tahigu yi Jɛrusalɛm na. Biŋkɔbiri mɔŋubira kuuya, ka Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu kuui.
en: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan daa bɔhi Stiivin, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri paliya.
en: The high priest said to Stephen, Is all this true.

dag: Ka Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua daa piligi n-lab mɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa Jɛrusalɛm, ka Naawuni daanabinim daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: When Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak heard their messages, they began to rebuild the Temple in Jerusalem, and the two prophets helped them.

dag: Paɣimiya Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni, dama o kana ti kaag o niriba ka tiligi ba.
en: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be kurimbuni ha la, so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla. Lala n-nyɛ li ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn yi dunia palo ŋɔ ni na nyaaŋa ti ku teei bɛ gba yɛla.
en: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too.

dag: Aristakus ŋun be sarika ni pahi n zuɣu ŋɔ mini Maak ŋun nyɛ Baanabas ŋahiŋga la puhiri ya. Yi pun wum di ni simd ni yi niŋ o shɛm; ka o yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o.
en: Aristarchus, the one here in prison with me, sends you his greetings. Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, also sends his greetings.

dag: Ka nabihi mini gomnanim ni sapashinnim ni kpambaliba bɛn daa laɣim maa na zaa kana ti nya niriba ata maa, ka buɣim maa bi tooi niŋ ba shɛli. Bɛ zabiri daa bi di; ka buɣim daa bi shihi bɛ situra gba, hal bɛ niŋgbuna daa bi nyo nyɔhi.
en: and the king's high officials, governors, and advisors all crowded around them. The men were not burned, their hair wasn't scorched, and their clothes didn't even smell like smoke.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bo kuɣili sa Mizipa mini Jɛshana sunsuuni, ka bol li Ɛbɛnɛza, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kpe ka Yawɛ sɔŋ ti.
en: After this Samuel set up a special stone to help people remember what God did. Samuel put the stone between Mizpah and Shen and named the stone Stone of Help. Samuel said, The Lord helped us all the way to this place.

dag: Wuntaŋ kul puhirimina n-chani ti lura, ka lan zɔri yomyom labiri o ni puhiri shɛli polo.
en: The sun rises, the sun sets; it returns panting to the place where it dawns.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma mini bɛn yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ma la laara.
en: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Labimiya yaɣ yini polo, ka m mini m bia Jɔnatan mi labi yaɣ yini polo. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Sool, A ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, nyin niŋmi li.
en: Then Saul said to them, All of you stand over there, and Jonathan and I will stand over here. Do whatever you think best, they answered.

dag: Shɛlini so shɛli ni tooi beni ŋmani din viɛla, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛ kum soli.
en: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, M Ba kul tumdimi, ka n gba tumda.
en: Jesus replied, My Father is still working, and I am working too.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani kpa shɛli din boori bahiri niriba zuɣu mini tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa daa daŋ tooni na la daa nyɛla tayiɣisi ni ŋmɛnditoya, ka piɛri maa daa bi wum ti ba.
en: All who came before me were thieves and outlaws, but the sheep didnt listen to them.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa bo mi pala lo o, ka kuhi yɛl o, Samsin Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣi do n-gu o maa be yil maa ni du shɛl ni. Ka Samsin daa darigi chihi mihi maa kaman gal la.
en: So Delilah took some new ropes and tied up Samson. Some men were hiding in the next room. Then Delilah called out to him, Samson, the Philistine men are going to capture you! But he broke the ropes easily as if they were threads.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun shihi lala bini maa ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ku di binyɛr kasinim la, faashee o su kom.
en: If he touches any of these things, he will become unclean until evening. He must not eat any of the holy food. Even if he washes with water, he cannot eat the holy food.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Baalipɛrazim nti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa nimaani ka yɛli, Yawɛ kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baal Pɛrazim maa.
en: David attacked the Philistines and defeated them. Then he said, I watched the Lord break through my enemies like a mighty flood. So he named the place The Lord Broke Through.

dag: Di saha ka o daa teeg omaŋ pa bia maa zuɣu napɔŋ buta, ka suhi Yawɛ, yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka bia ŋɔ nyɛvili lab o ni na yaha.
en: Then he stretched himself over the boy three times and cried out to the LORD, LORD my God, please give this boys life back to him.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhuri kpe lala paɣ maa ni. Miriya ka yi birigi dol o soli.
en: Dont turn your heart to her ways; dont wander down her paths.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ lala paai dabisa shɛm, ka Pool nyee ti nyɔni ka o ŋmaligi tahi kpilikpariga ŋun daa sɔŋdi bipuɣiŋga maa ka o buɣiri baɣiri maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu, zom ka chɛ o! Ka kpilikpariga maa daa shiri zo ka chɛ o di saha maa.
en: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone! At once the evil spirit left her.

dag: Naa ti ku lan beni n-su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka nabihi zaa ti ku lan beni.
en: No Kingdom There, they will call it, and all its princes will disappear.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pita, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: But Jesus said, Peter, before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say you dont know me. You will say this three times.

dag: N ni be a sani yuun pisi shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zaa, a piɛri min a buhi ni zaɣ yino gba na ʒi m-mali baɣili nti zaŋ li bahi, ka m mi na ʒi n-gbaag a piɛlaa kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: For these twenty years Ive been with you, your female sheep and goats havent miscarried, and I havent eaten your flocks rams.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ni yino wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka yɛl o, Dindina ŋun ti yɛn ʒini Naawuni nam ni di bindirigu ni ti nya alibarika.
en: When one of the dinner guests heard Jesus remarks, he said to Jesus, Happy are those who will feast in Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ti yaag o noli yɛli ni Yisa Masia nyɛla Duuma, ka di chɛ ka o Ba Naawuni nya jilima.
en: and all will openly proclaim that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ yɛligu ka m paɣira, nyin Naawuni yɛligu ka m paɣira.
en: God: whose word I praise. The LORD: whose word I praise.

dag: Naa Bɛlishaaza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka man Daniɛl daa nya ʒii din pah ayi.
en: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision.

dag: Ka yɛl o nyaandola maa mi, N-nyɛ a ma! Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka nyaandola maa daa zaŋ Yisa ma maa mali kul o yiŋa.
en: Then he said to the follower, Here is your mother. So after that, this follower took Jesus mother to live in his home.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ zaa daa dii pirigi bɛ binyɛra n-yɛrigi sɔŋ dunɔdura zuɣu ni o no li gari, ka piɛb kikaa ka kuhi yɛli, Jɛhu n-nyɛ naa.
en: At once Jehu's fellow officers spread their cloaks at the top of the steps for Jehu to stand on, blew trumpets, and shouted, Jehu is king.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tum din nyɛ Naawuni tuma.
en: They asked, What must we do in order to accomplish what God requires.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Itiɔpia kirisolait la buɣisi li, ka nir mi ku tooi zaŋ salima alali buɣisi li.
en: Cushite topaz wont compare with her; she cant be set alongside pure gold.

dag: Izraɛl anab shɛb tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo, ka nyari ʒiinima zaŋ chaŋ di suhudoo polo, ka suhudoo mi kani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala ma.
en: those prophets who assured Jerusalem that all was well, when all was not well! The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: A ni daa na bi kɔhi li la, pa nyini n-daa su li? Ka a ni kɔhi li maa, pa nyini n-na kul su di liɣiri maa? Ka bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tɛha ŋɔ tatabo kpɛh a suhu ni? Ka yɛl o, Pa ninsalinim ka a ŋma ʒiri maa, amaa Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a daa tiligi ba a yuli zuɣu, ni lala chɛ ka a wuh a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.

dag: ni salima sara maligu bimbin ni bɛ ni yɛn boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini suɣili maa dunoli.
en: the gold altar, the anointing oil, and the sweet-smelling incense, the screen for the tents entrance.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka paɣ so be salo maa ni kuhi yɛli, A ni daa yi pu shɛl ni na min a ni daa mɔɣ bihi shɛŋa mal alibarika.
en: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman with the people there called out to him, Blessings from God belong to the woman who gave birth to you and fed you.

dag: Di yi ti nyɛ asiba, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla zaawuni. Ka zaawuni yi ti paai, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla asiba. Dabiɛm din ti yɛn be yi suhuri ni mini yi nina ni ti yɛn nya binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, I wish it were night! But at night you will be terrified and say, I wish it were day.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila ninsalinim kaya mini bɛ wuhibu ni na, ka nir yi dol li di ni ti kpalim yoli.
en: All these things cease to exist when they are used. Such rules are human commandments and teachings.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi chaŋ jinwariba sani bee bukpahinim sani nti doli ba, n ni pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: I will be against anyone who goes to mediums and wizards for advice. Whoever does this is being unfaithful to me. So I will separate them from their people.

dag: Ka di lan be kaman wulimpuhili polo pɔhim n-ʒiɛri Speen teeku ni ŋarima ka di saɣindi la.
en: God, with a strong east wind, you wrecked their big ships.

dag: Bɛ mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pisinaayi. Jɛrɔham bia Adaya daa nyɛla Pɛlalia yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Amizi mini Zakaria so mi ni Pashihur ni Malikija.
en: In all, members of this clan served in the Temple. Adaiah, the son of Jeroham and grandson of Pelaliah. His ancestors included Amzi, Zechariah, Pashhur, and Malchijah.

dag: Dim a bindira ni suhupiɛlli, ka nyum a wain ni suhupiɛlli, dama Naawuni pun saɣi ti a ni niŋdi shɛm maa ka di waɣa.
en: Go, eat your food joyfully and drink your wine happily because God has already accepted what you do.

dag: din galisi neei Masia kum ni n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo alizanda ni la nyɛla yim.
en: which he used when he raised Christ from death and seated him at his right side in the heavenly world.

dag: So yi mali dunia ŋɔ buni, ka nya o mabia ŋun simdi sɔŋbu ka yih o suhu o ni, wula ka Naawuni yurilim ni tooi be nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: If we are rich and see others in need, yet close our hearts against them, how can we claim that we love God?.

dag: M Ba ni yuri ma shɛm, lala ka n gba yuri ya. Benya n yurilim ni.
en: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka o zaŋ bin suma pali bɛ yinsi. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli ka n je.
en: And it was God who filled their houses with good things. No, I would never follow the advice of evil people.

dag: N yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la yimaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, ka pa ni m bɔrimi ni n zali ya din ni gun ya soli, amaa m bɔrimi ni yi doli din tuhi mini din viɛla n-jɛmdi Naawuni ni suhu yini.
en: I am saying this because I want to help you. I am not trying to put restrictions on you. Instead, I want you to do what is right and proper, and to give yourselves completely to the Lord's service without any reservation.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba ti chani gindina nti nya ma, ka m bɔhi ba, Yi nya n yura la.
en: The guards patrolling the city found me. I asked them, Have you seen the man I love.

dag: Ka Filistia nanim anu maa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ lab kul Ɛkurɔn dindali maa.
en: The five Philistine kings watched them do this and then went back to Ekron that same day.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla pɔhim shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari lala. Mani n-kari ba saria pumpɔŋɔ maa.
en: This wind is too devastating for that. Now I, even I, will pronounce my sentence against them.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa tɛhi ni di luhiya ni n tum shɛlikam chihi Yisa Nazarɛt nira yuli.
en: I really thought that I ought to oppose the name of Jesus the Nazarene in every way possible.

dag: Ŋunkam doli zaligu, zaɣ biɛɣu ku paag o, ka yɛndana mi o ni yɛn niŋ lala saha shɛli.
en: Whoever keeps a command will meet no harm, and the wise heart knows the right time and the right way.

dag: O neen ʒira maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi.
en: The young man saw that Saul was dead, so he too threw himself on his sword and died.

dag: Bɛ ŋari n soli, ka luhi ma, ka bi bɔri so sɔŋsim.
en: They cut off my escape and try to destroy me; and there is no one to stop them.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ kpalimmi be yi zaa sani. Ami!.
en: May God, our source of peace, be with all of you. Amen.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa wum Naawuni zaligu kundi maa ni yɛli shɛm, o daa darigimi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: When the king heard the book being read, he tore his clothes in dismay.

dag: N ni ti nyo Damaskus gooni la buɣim, ka di di Bɛnhadad kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la.
en: I will set the walls of Damascus on fire. The fire will completely burn up the strong forts of Ben-Hadad. .

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka kom maa daa nyuui tiŋgban ni, ka Nuhu daa piligi binshɛli din pili ŋariŋ maa, ka lihi nya ka tiŋgbani ŋme pɔhim.
en: In Noahs six hundred first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters dried up from the earth. Noah removed the arks hatch and saw that the surface of the fertile land had dried up.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o zaligunima, ka jɛmd o ni bɛ suhuri zaa mali alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who follow his rules! They seek him with all their heart.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim maa vie bɛ dunɔpaɣira mini bɛ dunoya zuɣusahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋubi nimdi maa.
en: You must collect the blood from these animals and put it on the top and sides of the doorframe of every house where the people eat this meal.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli paɣ maa, N ni chɛ ka a nya biɛrim pam bihi dɔɣibu ni; a shiri ni nya biɛrim bihi dɔɣibu ni; amaa di zaa yoli, a kɔre kul ni be a yidan ni, ka o ni su a.
en: Then the Lord God said to the woman, You will suffer terribly when you give birth. But you will still desire your husband, and he will rule over you.

dag: hal ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi bi kɔŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli yi ni guhiri saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.

dag: dama Naawuni yɛligu mini wunsuhigu nyɛla din chɛ ka di leeri din be kasi Naawuni sani.
en: because the word of God and the prayer make it acceptable to God.

dag: Keenan bihi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan fathered Sidon his oldest son, and Heth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Nyama, biɛɣuni sa nyɛla goli palli dabisili, ka di simdi ni m mini naa sa laɣim ʒini di bindirigu; amaa chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi mɔɣu ni hal ti paai daba ata dali zaawuni.
en: David answered: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, and I'm supposed to eat dinner with your father. But instead, I'll hide in a field until the evening of the next day.

dag: Yi pala shɛli, ka yi tuma gba pa shɛli. Ŋunkam pii ya tum din chihira.
en: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.

dag: Di saha ka peentɔriba daa tam gooni zuɣu ka tɔri ti piɛma na. Bɛ daa ku naa tɔbbihi maa shɛba, hal naa tɔbbia Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba kpiya.
en: Then they shot arrows at us from the wall, and some of Your Majesty's officers were killed; your officer Uriah was also killed.

dag: Ka Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be o ko la bemi kaman tihi puu ni suɣili bee puu ni sampaa la; ka be kaman be ni teei gili tin shɛli.
en: The city of Jerusalem is now like an empty shed left in a vineyard. It is like an old straw hut abandoned in a field of cucumbers or like a city surrounded by enemies.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni lo ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o o niriba zaa sani.
en: In the assembly of all your people, in the sanctuary of your Temple in Jerusalem, I will give you what I have promised. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni niŋ a ni lo ma alikauli ni a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti ma. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam. Di zaŋ a nuhi tuma bahi.
en: Lord , I know you will do what you have promised. Lord , your faithful love will last forever. You are the one who made us, so dont leave us!.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani ŋɔ kalinli nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu, ka a yɛli, N ni ti ba nimdi ka bɛ ŋubi gol muni zaa?.
en: Moses replied, At least , grown men are here with me. How can you say there will be enough meat to feed them and their families for a whole month?.

dag: Amaa di chaŋya Bɛrishiiba ni yi ti jɛm ma bee n-chaŋ Bɛtɛl ni yi ti nya ma, dama Bɛtɛl ni kpalim yoli. Yi mi di chaŋya Giligal, dama bɛ ni gbahi Giligalnim kuli tinduli ni.
en: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga nudirigu polo, yi tiŋgbani maa tintariga yɛn pilila Tama zaŋ hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi kulibɔŋ ni n-zaŋ nimaani doli Ijipti tintariga hal ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: Along the boundary of Gad to the southern border, the boundary will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh and from there to the border of Egypt and to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nyuri wain dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi maa dali, ka naa lan bɔhi Ɛsta, Napaɣ Ɛsta, bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? Bee bɔ ka a yɛn suhi ma? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: for a second time. Over the wine the king asked her again, Now, Queen Esther, what do you want? Tell me and you shall have it. I'll even give you half the empire.

dag: Ka Haman daa zaŋ kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa chaŋ ti zaŋ kpariti maa yɛli Mɔdɛkai ka chɛ ka o ba wɔhu maa, ka ŋun Haman gari tooni zaŋ o doli tiŋ puuni solɔri, ka kuhiri yɛra, Nyamiya naa ni niŋ o ni yu ni o duhi ninvuɣ so shɛm.
en: So Haman got the robe and the horse. Then he put the robe on Mordecai and led him on horseback through the city streets. Haman announced ahead of Mordecai, This is done for the man the king wants to honor.

dag: Yawɛ ku saɣi zaŋ o niriba bah o yuli din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, dama ŋuna n-daa yu ka pii ya leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: The Lord has made a solemn promise, and he will not abandon you, for he has decided to make you his own people.

dag: Azɛl daa malila bidibis ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hanan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Azɛl bidibisi.
en: Azel had six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.

dag: Naawuni kul tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa sahakam, amaa ka ninsalinim bi baŋdi li.
en: God speaks in one way, in two ways, but no one perceives it.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛli din nyuri sakom din luri di zuɣu waawaayili ka bindira zoori di ni n-leeri din mali buchi bɛ ni biri li shɛb zuɣu la sani, Naawuni niŋdi alibarika niŋdi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: God blesses the soil which drinks in the rain that often falls on it and which grows plants that are useful to those for whom it is cultivated.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim yi be yi ni galisi pam, di ni chɛ ka yi nyɛla bɛn tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ bɛn mali buchi baŋbu shɛli din yiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni na la puuni.
en: If all these are yours and they are growing in you, theyll keep you from becoming inactive and unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli malaika maa ka o labis o takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni.
en: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put his sword back into its sheath.

dag: Ulam bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Bɛdan. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Giliad bihi, ka Giliad nyɛ Makiri bia, ka Makiri mi nyɛ Manaasa bia.
en: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.

dag: N yila m Ba sani n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na; ka lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni labi m Ba maa sani.
en: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.

dag: Teemiya kurimbuni ha yɛla. Tɛhimiya yuun gbaliŋ din gari la yɛla. Bɔhimiya yi ba, o ni wuhi ya, ka bɔhi yi dɔɣirikpamba, bɛ ni yɛli ya.
en: Think of the past, of the time long ago; ask your parents to tell you what happened, ask the old people to tell of the past.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa suhi alibarika niŋ Kalɛb ni; ka zaŋ Hiburɔn ti ŋun Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la ni o su li.
en: Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him the city of Hebron as his possession.

dag: Dama ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni ti yi zuɣusaa n-siɣina ni tahigu mini malaikanim zuɣulan kukoli ni Naawuni kikaa kumsi. Ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la ni ti daŋ kum ni neebu;.
en: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni zaa hal ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba; ka daa nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: They put everyone there to death; no one was left alive, and the city was burned.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya biɛɣu mini mɔɣilo paɣ o.
en: Praise him with trumpets and horns! Praise him with harps and lyres!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ o suɣili maa ni nti shiri nya ka di pi tiŋa ka anzinfa maa be di gbinni.
en: So Joshua sent some men, who ran to the tent and found that the condemned things really were buried there, with the silver at the bottom.

dag: O lan ka kpe; o neei kum ni kaman o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kamiyana ti nya o ni daa do luɣ shɛli.
en: He isnt here, because hes been raised from the dead, just as he said. Come, see the place where they laid him.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Filistianim poli pɔi ka Firawuna daa naanyi ti liri Gazanima m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The LORDs word to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh conquered Gaza.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi tiligira; labimiya n sanna. Dama n vuui yi tuumbiɛri mini yi daalahichi bahi kaman sagbani bee paɣili ni vuuri shɛm la.
en: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds.

dag: Yuun shɛli din nyɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa puuni, sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su binshɛɣukam.
en: Each of you must return to your family property in this year of Jubilee.

dag: Yi tɔbbihi tuui lu, ka yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti labi timaŋmaŋ niriba sani ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, takɔbi shɛl din kuri ti ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: They will stumble again and again. They will fall over each other. They will say, Get up; lets go back to our own people. Let us go back to our homeland. Our enemy is defeating us. We must get away.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Jehoram succeeded him as king.

dag: N nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti gbaai kom, ka maligim kul luri n wula zuɣu yuŋ zaa.
en: I was like a healthy plant with roots that have plenty of water and branches that are wet with dew.

dag: Di daa sabila Hiburuli ni mini Latinli ni ni Giriikili ni. Ka Yɛhudianim pam daa karim di ni sab shɛm maa, dama bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa daa mirila tiŋ maa.
en: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city and it was written in Aramaic, Latin, and Greek.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, dahin shɛli kanna ka n ni ti pali n ni daa lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli shɛl la.
en: This message is from the Lord : I made a special promise to the people of Israel and Judah. The time is coming when I will do what I promised.

dag: Ka binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa shiri bili. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: The earth grew grass and plants that made grain. And it grew trees that made fruit with seeds in it. Every plant made its own kind of seeds. And God saw that this was good.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Jona bahi kom maa ni maa, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka ziŋ karili zaŋ o vali, ka o daa be ziŋ maa puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa daba ata.
en: When Jonah fell into the sea, the Lord chose a very big fish to swallow Jonah. He was in the stomach of the fish for three days and three nights.

dag: zaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb Naa Ashuribanipal ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la ni daa yiɣisina nti ʒili Samaria tiŋ puuni mini luɣ shɛŋa din pahi m-be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la nim sanna.
en: and from the other people who the great and powerful Ashurbanipal moved to the city of Samaria and other places in the country west of the Euphrates River.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni zaŋla bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu maa sɔŋ gu bɛ bihi; chɛ ka o zaŋ li labisi yo ba ka bɛ baŋ li.
en: You say, God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners. But I say, Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.

dag: Ka tiŋgban bihi din zaa be teeku sunsuuni daa vuui, ka zoya zaa gba vuui;.
en: Every island fled, and the mountains disappeared.

dag: Dama n nyari ba zoya zuɣu, ka nyari ba daboya zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ ko; ka bi tɛhi ni bɛ mini zuliya shɛli nyɛla yim. Bɛ wuhiya ni bɛ be bɛ ko ka chɛ zuliya kam.
en: I see these people from the mountain. I see them from the high hills. They live alone. They are not part of another nation.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyini ka ti niŋ naani, zom ti nambɔɣu. Guli ti dabisili kam. Tiligim ti ti muɣisigu nyabu saha.
en: Lord , have mercy on us. We have put our hope in you. Protect us day by day and save us in times of trouble.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka toli yina nti ŋubi bimbil shɛŋa zaa sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord told Moses, Stretch your arm toward Egypt. Swarms of locusts will come and eat everything left by the hail.

dag: A paɣibu yɛla kul bela n nol ni, ka n yɛr a tibiginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa.
en: My mouth is filled with your praise, glorifying you all day long.

dag: A ni ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, ka lihir a ninni la suhudo maŋli, bɛ ni niŋ a naani zuɣu.
en: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.

dag: Amaa vi tuma maa nyɛla din di ti yaannim ni daa tum tuma bo binshɛlikam zaa zali ti ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ la, dina n-nyɛ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: That terrible false god Baal has eaten everything our fathers owned. This has happened since we were children. That terrible false god took our fathers sheep and cattle and their sons and daughters.

dag: Bɛ mali yiko din ni tooi chɛ ka saa ku mi bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu maa saha, ka mali yiko din ni tooi chɛ ka koma lɛbigi ʒim, ka ni tooi chɛ ka alɔbo balibu kam lu dunia ni kaman bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: They have the power to close up the sky so that no rain will fall for as long as they prophesy. They also have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with any plague, as often as they wish.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ yoya ŋmanila takɔbi n-kuhiri niriba, amaa yɛndana yɛtɔɣa tahirila tibbuna.
en: Thoughtless words can wound as deeply as any sword, but wisely spoken words can heal.

dag: N ni daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ n daalahichi polo, n kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka n kul ŋuhiri hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.

dag: Yɛm piligu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bom yɛm, ka a ni yɛn bo shɛli pahi nyɛla tɛhi zilima.
en: Getting wisdom is the most important thing you can do. Whatever else you get, get insight.

dag: Dama naa maa niŋla Yawɛ naani; ka Zallakudura Naa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu chɛ ka binshɛli ku tooi vuug o.
en: The king trusts in the Lord Almighty; and because of the Lord 's constant love he will always be secure.

dag: Di yi nyɛla Pool bee Apolɔs bee Pita bee dunia ŋɔ bee nyɛvili bee kum bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ bee dahin shɛli ha yɛla, di zaa ha nyɛla yi dini;.
en: Paul, Apollos, Peter, the world, life, death, the present, and the future—all these are yours.

dag: Dunɔdali maa tooni zaŋ hal ti paai zɔntua puuni dunoli maa ni, di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu.
en: Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was meters.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa lihirila a ninni ni a ti ba bɛ bindirigu di tibu saha.
en: All of them depend on you to give them food when they need it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, a kum dabisa miriya, bolimi Jɔshua ka yi ka man Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni na ka n ti zaŋ tuma maa ti o. Ka Musa mini Jɔshua daa chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: The Lord told Moses, You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel. Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali oniɣisi kuɣa n-zaŋ li tam salima bintaɣindisi ni, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la.
en: The workers put the onyx stones for the ephod in gold settings. They wrote the names of the sons of Israel on these stones.

dag: Dama Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka nuhi tuumbaŋda daa mal li. Di pala Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti wurim Samaria naɣibil maa.
en: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.

dag: So mi n-nyɛ bundana, ka mali suhudoo ka binshɛli yɛla bi muɣis o, ka o ti kpi.
en: Someone dies in wonderful health, completely comfortable and well.

dag: Zomiya kɔr biɛri tuma! ŋun tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma tumdi li dalindirila omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa ninsal ni tumd alahichi balibu shɛŋa zaa pahi pala din dalind o niŋgbuŋ.
en: So run away from sexual sin. It involves the body in a way that no other sin does. So if you commit sexual sin, you are sinning against your own body.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi kalinli ti ku lan galisi Yawɛ ni yɛn kari ya bahi zuliya shɛb ni maa.
en: The Lord will scatter you among the nations. And only a few of you will be left alive to go to the countries where the Lord will send you.

dag: Teemiya bin shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ piligu ni ha la yɛla; dama mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani ŋmani ma.
en: Remember the prior things—from long ago; I am God, and theres no other. I am God! Theres none like me.

dag: Dauda daa di nam su Izraɛlnim la yuun pihinahi. O daa diya ʒini Hiburɔn la yuma ayopɔin, ka daa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm mi yuun pihitanaata.
en: David ruled Israel years. He ruled seven years in Hebron and years in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Neetan bia Azaria nyɛ tuma kpamba zuɣulana. Ka Neetan bia Zabud nyɛ maligumaana ni naa zɔsimo.
en: Azariah son of Nathan was in charge of the district governors; Zabud son of Nathan was a priest and an advisor to King Solomon;.

dag: Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa. Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa.
en: The skies were made by the LORDs word, all their starry multitude by the breath of his mouth.

dag: N zaŋdi buni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ma, ka chɛ ka bɛ daazichi duri paana.
en: I give riches to those who love me, and I fill their houses with treasures.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, Naawuni n-ni nyaŋ o, pa daadam.
en: How can you claim you have discovered wisdom? God must answer Job, for you have failed.

dag: Juda, a mabihi ni ti paɣ a. A ni ti zaŋ a nuu gbaag a dimnim nyiŋgoya ni. A ba bidibisi ni ti damd a tooni.
en: Judah, you are the one your brothers will honor; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your fathers sons will bow down to you.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zani naŋgban yini yɛli, Ti ni so ku lab kul o tanti ni bee o yiŋa.
en: At this, all the people stood as one to say, Not a single one of us is going home or returning to our house!.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa zaɣisi ka yɛl o dan paɣ maa, Nyama, n ni be n dan sani ŋɔ, o baɣa lan ka shɛl ni yil ŋɔ. O zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam niŋla n nuu ni.
en: He refused and said to her, Look, my master does not have to concern himself with anything in the house, because I am here. He has put me in charge of everything he has.

dag: Yɛndana nyarila baŋsim pahira. Amaa jɛrigu yɛtɔɣ yoya tahirila saɣiŋgu na.
en: The wise get all the knowledge they can, but when fools speak, trouble is not far off.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka n yi m ba yiŋa n-chani gindi ŋɔ puuni, ka n yɛl o, A ni yɛn niŋ ma nirilim shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti paai luɣ shɛlikam, nyin yɛlimi ni n nyɛla a tizɔdoo. .
en: When God led me away from my fathers household, I said to her, This is the loyalty I expect from you: in each place we visit, tell them, He is my brother.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi zani, dama nandaamba nyari nahiŋgu, ka faranim mi kul ŋuhira. N ni ti ba faako shɛli bɛ suhuri ni bɔri maa.
en: They took advantage of the poor and stole what little they had. But the Lord knows what they did, and he says, I will rescue those who are poor and helpless, and I will punish those who hurt them.

dag: Jɛfita daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayɔbu. Ka ŋun Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ya Giliad maa.
en: Jephthah led Israel for six years. Then he died and was buried in his hometown in Gilead.

dag: Aduna bidibis ayi la ni daa chaŋ miri Yawɛ ka kpi la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: Two of Aarons sons died while offering incense to the Lord . After that time, the Lord spoke to Moses.

dag: Yiɣisim kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni ka bɛ ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Get up now and go into the city. Someone there will tell you what you must do.

dag: amaa ti ni niŋdi shɛlikam puuni, ti kpaŋdila timaŋa ni ti wuhi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba. Ti wuhiri li ania niŋbu pam puuni mini nahiŋgu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni wahala dibu puuni.
en: But in every way we show that we are servants of God. We never give up, even though we face troubles, difficulties, and problems of every kind.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi Milikom zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka nya ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi, ka kuɣ viɛla be di ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda, ka o daa va bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam kuli.
en: David took the crown from their kings head. That gold crown weighed about pounds and there were valuable stones in it. The crown was put on Davids head. Then David had a great many valuable things brought out of the city of Rabbah.

dag: O daa bi tum tuun kara pam nimaani, bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Because they did not have faith, he did not perform many miracles there.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: One of the bystanders drew a sword and struck the high priests slave and cut off his ear.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee maa zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋme tampiŋ maa buyi, ka kom pam daa yi di ni na, ka niriba maa mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa daa nyu.
en: Then Moses raised the stick and struck the rock twice with it, and a great stream of water gushed out, and all the people and animals drank.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛla tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa sunsuuni, ka ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni n-teeg o nuu maa tiri Jɛrusalɛm. Di saha ka Dauda min o kpamba daa chibi kpalansi ye n-lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: David looked up and saw the Lord s angel in the sky. The angel was holding his sword over the city of Jerusalem. Then David and the elders bowed with their faces touching the ground. They were wearing the special clothes to show their sadness.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ku lɔrig o nahu bee o buŋa n-taɣ o chaŋ kuliga ka o ti nyu kom Vuhim Dabisili dali?.
en: The Lord replied, Are you trying to fool someone? Won't any one of you untie your ox or donkey and lead it out to drink on a Sabbath?.

dag: Amaa Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, di zaa yoli, a nini na kul bi tiɣi li, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, a lan yɛli man a dabili ŋɔ n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha yɛla, ka wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: I am nothing but a servant, but Lord GOD, you have also said these kind things about my future family. Lord GOD, you dont always talk like this to people, do you?.

dag: n-ti bahi ku Amalɛknim bɛn daa zo n-tiligi la, ka ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.

dag: Ka n daa wum di yɛla, ka n ni sɔhira, ka n naŋgbampiba ŋmɛri tab di vuri zuɣu, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi ka n naba sɔhira. N kul yɛn shinimi ka guhiri dahin shɛli mbusim ni ti yɛn lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kana ti liri ti maa zuɣu.
en: I hear all this, and I tremble; my lips quiver with fear. My body goes limp, and my feet stumble beneath me. I will quietly wait for the time to come when God will punish those who attack us.

dag: Ka di daa ku ba suli pam ti yaɣi, ka bɛ piligi tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ Yisa shɛm.
en: They were filled with rage and began to discuss among themselves what they could do to Jesus.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka Farisii so yɛl o ni o bɔri ni o ka ŋun Farisii maa yiŋ na ka o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu. Ka o daa chaŋ ka bɛ ti ʒini ni bɛ di;.
en: After Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee asked Jesus to eat with him. So he went and took a place at the table.

dag: So yi niŋ lala, o yi ti yi daɣiri maa ni, bɛn zalim o daba ayopɔin.
en: After he has become clean again, he must wait seven days.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ti ku mali bia ŋun ni ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee. Bɛ ni ku o labi, ka wuntaŋ tulim kpe o wuntaŋ ni, ka maligim mi ti lu o zuɣu yuŋ.
en: So now, I, the Lord , say to you, King Jehoiakim, that no descendant of yours will ever rule over David's kingdom. Your corpse will be thrown out where it will be exposed to the sun during the day and to the frost at night.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba mini wawariba zaa yɛra, N kɔbilinina zaa bela a ni.
en: They dance and sing, In Zion is the source of all our blessings.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila yuri Ijipti mini tiŋgban shɛŋa din pahi zaa ni na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: Solomons horses were imported from Egypt and every land.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ; ka paɣimiy o yuli; yɛlimiya o tiliginsim lahibali suŋ yɛla dabisili kam.
en: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, The Lord has saved us.

dag: Ti daa chaŋmi ti ŋme Nɛgɛb din nyɛ Chɛrɛtinim tiŋ ka be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka di bɛ nɛma. Ka ti daa lan chaŋ ti ŋme Nɛgɛb shɛli din nyɛ Kalɛb daŋ niriba tiŋ la gba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka nyo Zikilag yiya zaa buɣim.
en: We had raided the territory of the Cherethites in the southern part of Judah and the territory of the clan of Caleb, and we burned down Ziklag.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira nti zaŋ ŋme paɣ puulana, ka paɣ puulan maa zaŋ bahi, amaa ka mali alaafee, di simdi ka bɛ zali ŋun ŋme o maa samli kaman paɣ maa yidan ni bɔr shɛm, ka o yo li kaman sariakaritiba ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Suppose a pregnant woman suffers a miscarriage as the result of an injury caused by someone who is fighting. If she isn't badly hurt, the one who injured her must pay whatever fine her husband demands and the judges approve.

dag: Ka niriba bɔhira, Bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti? Ka yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ yɛl ti? Bihi bɛn ŋmaai bihili kɔŋko ka o yɛligu ni sɔŋ?.
en: They complain about me. They say, Who does that man think he's teaching? Who needs his message? It's only good for babies that have just stopped nursing!.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa niŋ binshɛŋa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, anabi Aizaia ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔz bia la daa sab li.
en: The rest of Uzziahs deeds, from beginning to end, were written down by the prophet Isaiah, Amozs son.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba; ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni. Leem bɛ gula, ka lihiri ba sahakam kaman piɛgul ni lihir o piɛri shɛm la.
en: Save your people, God! Bless your possession! Shepherd them and carry them for all time!.

dag: Daabihi ni saɣi di o daa? Bɛ ni saɣi pirig o ti kɔhigɔriba?.
en: Will fishermen bargain over him? Will merchants cut him up to sell?.

dag: Naawuni, a pun buɣisi ti nya. A nyahi ti zaa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi anzinfa shɛri buɣim ni m-maani li shɛm la.
en: You have put us to the test, God; as silver is purified by fire, so you have tested us.

dag: Ti ni daa kul wum li; ti suhuri zaa daa dii fuŋmi, ka suhukpeeni lan ka ti ni so suhu ni yi zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Naawuni.
en: When we heard about this, we were very afraid. And now, not one of our men is brave enough to fight you, because the Lord your God rules the heavens above and the earth below!.

dag: Dam yɛlimaŋli mini yɛm ni wuhibu ni baŋsim, ka miri ka a zaŋ li kɔhi.
en: Buy truth and dont sell it; buy wisdom, instruction, and understanding.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa tumbu, ka doli n zaligunima zaa, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira, ka do yino paɣa kana ni o ti fa o yidana ŋun bur o maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o nuu gbaag o tooni.
en: Two men might be fighting against each other. One mans wife might come to help her husband, but she must not grab the other mans private parts.

dag: Judanim pam daa pola pɔri n-zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabil o, o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Ara bia Shɛkania ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu. O bia Jɛhɔhanan daa kpuɣila Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam bipuɣiŋga.
en: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani zo n-chaŋ Adulam vokabili ni, ka o biɛyanim min o ba yiŋnim zaa daa ti wum o yɛla nimaani ka kahi chaŋ o sani.
en: David left Gath and escaped to Adullams fortress. When Davids siblings and all his extended family learned of this, they went to join him there.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Pa doo n-nya a? A kpee be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi ʒiɛya gul a dan naa? Dama ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti ku a dan naa maa.
en: David answered, Abner, aren't you the greatest man in Israel? So why aren't you protecting your master, the king? Just now someone entered the camp to kill your master.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdali yi n-gili samban ni n-chaŋ samban ni dunɔdali din kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini, ka kom maa zɔri yiri nudirigu polo na.
en: The man led me out through the north gate and then around the outside to the outer gate on the east side. The water was flowing out on the south side of the gate.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yɛli ŋun su bɛ kpariti biɛhigu shee fukumsi, Zaŋm kpariti na nti ti Baal jɛmdiba maa zaa. Ka o daa zaŋ kpariti maa na nti ti ba.
en: Then Jehu said to the person in charge of the vestments, Bring out the special clothes for all Baals worshippers. So he brought out robes for them.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n wuhi n kpiɔŋ mini n kasitali ka zuliya pam nya li, ka baŋ ma. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So I will display my greatness, show my holiness, and make myself known in the sight of many nations. And they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu daa zaŋ bɛ baŋsim n-zaŋ buhi kɔbiri mi gali.
en: They also made thread of goats' hair.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ yɛndaan so daa be tiŋ maa ni ka kuhi yɛl ba na, Wummiya! Wummiya! Yɛlimiya Jɔab ni o kana ka n ti yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Then a wise woman called from the city, Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come over here, so I can talk to him.

dag: Ti loya ni ti ku niŋ din ni chɛ ka so galim ti yurilim pina din galisi ŋɔ taribu ni.
en: We are trying to avoid being blamed by anyone for the way we take care of this large amount of money.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛ ka din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ a sani leei niriba ni galindi shɛli.
en: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni yihi ya Ijiptinim dabitim maa ni. N ni teei n nuu tum tuun kara n-darigi bɛ tibili ka tiligi ya.
en: Therefore, say to the Israelites, I am the LORD. Ill bring you out from Egyptian forced labor. Ill rescue you from your slavery to them. Ill set you free with great power and with momentous events of justice.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka Samaria wurim n-leei mɔɣu ni, ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn sari wain tihi. Ka n ni ti va di kuɣa zaa ti bahi vinvamli ni, ka chɛ ka di tanzahi la yi n-do palo ni.
en: So the Lord says, I will make Samaria a pile of ruins in the open country, a place for planting grapevines. I will pour the rubble of the city down into the valley, and will lay bare the city's foundations.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri alizanda nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus traveled throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues. He announced the good news of the kingdom and healed every disease and sickness among the people.

dag: ka n yi suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam, n kul suhirimi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.

dag: O pun yɛli nyin daadam binshɛli din viɛla. Ka bɔ ka Yawɛ lee bɔri ni a niŋ? O bɔri ni a doli din tuhi, ka yuri nirilim niŋbu, ka jɛmd a Naawuni ni siɣisimaŋtali.
en: He has told you, human one, what is good and what the LORD requires from you: to do justice, embrace faithful love, and walk humbly with your God.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni chɛ ka tinvura bɛn nyɛ garinsi lu yi zuɣu n-dimdi ya, ka yi ku tooi niŋ ba tim.
en: People of Judah, I am sending poisonous snakes to attack you. These snakes cannot be controlled. They will bite you. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa na bi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni faashee o ni daa ti lab o jilima shee la nyaaŋa, ka bɛ naanyi teei ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa pun sabimi zan o zuɣu, ka di mi shiri niŋ o lala.
en: His disciples did not understand this at the time; but when Jesus had been raised to glory, they remembered that the scripture said this about him and that they had done this for him.

dag: n-daa puhi zani o sani ni jilima, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛlikam Jɛrusalɛm ka naanyi kpi la yɛla.
en: They appeared in heavenly glory and talked about all that Jesus' death in Jerusalem would mean.

dag: nti nya ka di nyɛla bɛ zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka bɛ daa fiɣis o, amaa ka o mi bi tum taal shɛli din simdi ni bɛ ku o bee n-kpɛh o duu.
en: This is what I learned: The Jews said this man did some things that were wrong. But these charges were about their own Jewish laws, and there was nothing worthy of jail or death.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab sabbu shɛli Giriikili ni mini Latinli ni ni Hiburuli ni n-tabili o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka bɛ daa sab li: Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Above his head was a notice of the formal charge against him. It read This is the king of the Jews.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa yi kul chaŋ napɔŋ yaabu buyɔbu zuɣu, o chɛrimi ka bɛ zani ka o kɔrigi naɣilaa mini naɣilalantabili mali sara.
en: After the men carrying the Covenant Box had gone six steps, David had them stop while he offered the Lord a sacrifice of a bull and a fattened calf.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, mbusim be a zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Now I, the Lord God, say you are doomed! Not only did you do these evil things.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a baɣa be n ni ka garigi ma. Tim ma yaa yaha, di yi pa lala n ni kpi.
en: Look at me, O Lord my God, and answer me. Restore my strength; don't let me die.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya ka neesim maa viɛla, ka o woligi neesim maa ka chɛ zibisim.
en: God was pleased with what he saw. Then he separated the light from the darkness.

dag: Zahimmiya yimaŋa n-nya yi shiri doli yi yɛda niŋbu soli. Buɣisimiya yimaŋa! Yi bi mi ni Masia be yi ni? Di yi pa lala yi daa naɣ bi nyaŋla yimaŋ buɣisibu la.
en: Put yourselves to the test and judge yourselves, to find out whether you are living in faith. Surely you know that Christ Jesus is in you?—unless you have completely failed.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti paai Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Saika la. Tiŋ maa daa mirila pu shɛli Yaakubu ni daa zaŋ ti o bia Yisifu la.
en: In Samaria Jesus came to the town called Sychar, which is near the field that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

dag: Amaa dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam, ka so daa yi ʒe luɣ kasi shee maa ka lihi, o ni tooi nya di nyoya ni. Amaa so daa yi zani samban ni, o ku tooi nya li. Di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The carrying poles were so long that their tips could be seen from the holy place in front of the inner sanctuary, though they werent visible from outside. They are still there today.

dag: N yur a zaligunim soli maa pam kaman n ni yuri azichi balibu kam shɛm.
en: I delight in following your commands more than in having great wealth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka anabinim daa kana ti saɣisi ba. Ka n zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa ku ba, n saria karibu kul nɛmi kaman neesim la.
en: That is why I have sent my prophets to you with my message of judgment and destruction. What I want from you is plain and clear:.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha dabili.
en: Whoever wants to be first must serve the rest of you like a slave.

dag: Pagɔr bia bi simdi ni o be Yawɛ niriba ni, hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, di bi simdi ni bɛ chɛ ka o bia kpe Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No one born out of wedlock or any descendant of such a person, even in the tenth generation, may be included among the Lord 's people.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be vinvamli ni ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim ŋmaligimi guui, ka Sool min o bidibisi kpi, ka bɛ daa yi bɛ tinsi ni zo. Ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ti be di ni.
en: When all the Israelites who were in the valley saw that the army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. So the Philistines came to live in them.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu; yi nyɛla wain nyur wɔɣira, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm ni yi zaŋ binnyura gari taba.
en: You are doomed! Heroes of the wine bottle! Brave and fearless when it comes to mixing drinks!.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ti tooi biŋkuma sara maligu maa zim viɛlli nukurigu pali mini di kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim din be biŋkuma sara maligu maa ni nti nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu n-yihi di chihili maa, ka di leei din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest will remove a handful of the choice flour and oil from the grain offering, and all of the frankincense that is on it, and burn this token portion completely on the altar as a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Naawuni, kul niŋmi alibarika niŋmi ti ni. Niriba bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa jɛmm a.
en: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.

dag: Yawɛ, m bi duhi mmaŋa, m mi bi nyuri bara. M bi zaŋ binyara din galisi pam mini din viɛli pam yɛla muɣisi mmaŋa.
en: I am not conceited, Lord , and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.

dag: Miri ka a lo a ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka niŋ a naani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.

dag: Dama yi mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi yi dimnim maa, ka o chɛ ka yi di nasara.
en: because the LORD your God is going with you to fight your enemies for you and to save you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua tuumba maa daa kpa zoya maa polo nti be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn daa biɛhi bɛ naba la ti lab kuli; dama bɛ daa vihimi m-bo ba sol ni zaa ka bi nya ba.
en: The men left her house and went into the hills. They stayed there for three days. The kings men looked all along the road. After three days, they stopped looking and went back to the city.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa mini Nɛbushaziban ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpem la ni Nɛrigalisharɛza ni Babilɔn naa sapashin kpamba zaa.
en: So Nebuzaradan, the commander of the kings special guards, Nebushazban, a chief officer in the army of Babylon, Nergal-Sharezer, a high official, and all the other officers of the army of Babylon sent for Jeremiah.

dag: Niŋmiya suɣilo biɛla ka n wuhi ya, dama n na malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n zani Naawuni zaani yɛli.
en: Be patient with me a little longer. God has a few more words that he wants me to say.

dag: Gɛra pisi n-yɛn nyɛ shɛkal yini. Shɛkal pihiyɔbu n-yɛn nyɛ mina zaɣ yini yi sani.
en: Your weights are to be as follows: gerahs = shekel shekels = mina.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ zaa la Firawuna ninni, amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Moses and Aaron performed all these miracles before the king, but the Lord made him stubborn, and he would not let the Israelites leave his country.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n saɣ a ni bɔri shɛm maa, cham ti zaŋ Absalom na.
en: Later on the king said to Joab, I have decided to do what you want. Go and get the young man Absalom and bring him back here.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa lan lab Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni chani ginda, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: Jesus and his followers went again to Jerusalem. Jesus was walking in the Temple area. The leading priests, the teachers of the law, and the older Jewish leaders came to him.

dag: O daa yɛli ba mi, Wummiya n ni sa zahim zahindi shɛli ŋɔ:.
en: He said to them, Listen to this dream I had.

dag: O tim a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli, ka chɛ ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa pali.
en: May he give you what you desire and make all your plans succeed.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Makɛda n-gari chaŋ Libina ti liri Libinanima.
en: Then Joshua along with all Israel moved on from Makkedah to Libnah. They attacked Libnah.

dag: Zaliguzaana ni sariakarita yino kɔŋko ŋun ni tooi tiligi niriba ka ni tooi bahi ba yoli m-beni. Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a mi ka a karit a daadamkpee saria?.
en: God is the only lawgiver and judge. He alone can save and destroy. Who do you think you are, to judge someone else?.

dag: Dama Musa ni daa mali Yawɛ biɛhigu shee du shɛli tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa nyɔri sara maligunim la daa bela jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn la di saha maa.
en: The LORDs dwelling that Moses had made in the desert and the altar for entirely burned offerings were then at the shrine in Gibeon.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dɔbba, ka ku yi tɔbutuhiriba tɔbu ni.
en: The men of the city, yes, even the strongest men, will be killed in war.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu yo n-zaŋ li zali luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.

dag: Musa ni daa piri tiŋgbani maa tari Mɔab bɔpiɛligu la ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la shɛm m-bala.
en: Moses assigned these territories when he was in the Moab plains on the other side of the Jordan, east of Jericho.

dag: N daa nya a luɣ kasi shee la; N daa nya a yiko min a jilima la.
en: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la mini bɛnkam zaa je ma la nuu ni bahi; dama bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari ma.
en: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tir nir nyɛvili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di yi be nir kɔbili ni, o ni mali alaafee, ka barina shɛli ku paag o.
en: The fear of the LORD leads to life; then one rests content, untouched by harm.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tim ti boli Pool na ka Tɛɛtulus gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, N dan Filiksi, a zuɣu ka ti ʒiya ni alaafee, ka a tumdi tuun suma tiri ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then Paul was called in, and Tertullus began to make his accusation, as follows: Your Excellency! Your wise leadership has brought us a long period of peace, and many necessary reforms are being made for the good of our country.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi n-lo tɔbu; bɛ daa laɣimla Soko din be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka ti bɛ suɣa Soko maa mini Azɛka tiŋ shɛli din be Ɛfɛsidammim tiŋgban ni la sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines gathered their armies together for war. They met at Socoh in Judah. Their camp was between Socoh and Azekah, at a town called Ephes Dammim.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛri pampam, Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku ŋɔ simdi ni o mali yiko mini azichi ni yɛm ni kpiɔŋ, ka nya tibiginsim mini jilima ni alibarika.
en: They said in a loud voice, Worthy is the slaughtered Lamb to receive power, wealth, wisdom, and might, and honor, glory, and blessing.

dag: Nandahimalana n-nyɛ ma! Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ma n ninsalitali biɛhigu din tahiri ma kum ni ŋɔ bahi?.
en: Im a miserable human being. Who will deliver me from this dead corpse?.

dag: Ŋmɛnditoya kana ti bela tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zoya zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ tɔbu n-lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam; ka so ku tiligi.
en: Over all the desert roads destroyers march; for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the land to the other; no one is safe.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ lɛbihi mini matarikanima n-saɣim bɛ ni kpe dari mali binshɛŋa la zaa.
en: And then all its carvings they hacked down with hatchet and pick.

dag: Dama nimaani ka saria karibu ʒiishɛhi be, saria karibu ʒiishɛhi din nyɛ Dauda zuliya dini.
en: The kings from Davids family put their thrones here. They set up their thrones to judge the people.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Ɛkan, M bia, paɣimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka ti o jilima, ka yɛli ma a ni tum tuun shɛli, ka di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: Then Joshua said to Achan, Son, you must honor the Lord , the God of Israel. Praise him and confess your sins to him. Tell me what you did, and dont try to hide anything from me.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bin yini ka m bɔri ni n suh a; a mi di mɔŋ ma li.
en: But now I have one thing to ask you. Please dont refuse me. Bathsheba answered, What do you want.

dag: Dunɔdali daa be dundombil ni nudirigu polo. Ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti kpa dunɔdali din be nudirigu polo, ka di nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: A gate was on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured from the gate on the inner wall to the gate on the outer wall . It was cubits from gate to gate.

dag: Shɛb yi nya azichi, nyin di chɛ ka di yɛla muɣis a, hal bɛ yinsi daazichi maa yi kul zoori pahiri gba.
en: Dont be overly impressed when someone becomes rich, their house swelling to fantastic proportions.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛl o niriba maa, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Sool. Ka Sool daa ti yiɣisi voli maa ni yina chaŋ o chandi.
en: David said these things to stop his men. He would not let his men hurt Saul. Saul left the cave and went on his way.

dag: Samiya Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa gol tuuli dahin yini dali.
en: On the first day of the first month, set up the Holy Tent, that is, the Meeting Tent.

dag: O yuri takarifiɛma mini o chɛchɛbunsi gbaya vuri ni ti chɛ ka bihi banim ku lan bɔhi bɛ bihi yɛla, bɛ bɔɣiri ti kul yɛn zalizalimi.
en: When you hear the thunder of horses and chariots, your courage will vanish, and parents will even abandon their own children.

dag: ka su Hɛrimɔn Zoli mini Salɛka ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga ni Giliad pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn tintariga la.
en: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.

dag: Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ. Masia cheechinim zaa puhiri ya.
en: Give each other the special greeting of Gods people. All the churches that belong to Christ send their greetings to you.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Pɛriʒia mini Miidia paɣiba yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm maa, bɛ ni zaŋ di yɛla yɛri naa kpambaliba. Ka paɣiba ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima, ka bɛ yidaannim maa suhuri ni yiɣisi pam bahi paɣiba maa zuɣu.
en: This very day, the important women of Persia and Media who hear about the queen will tell the royal officials the same thing. There will be no end of put-downs and arguments.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka mi bi lan niŋ di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ. Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa wum ninsal ni yɛli shɛm, dama Yawɛ daa tuhi ti Izraɛlnima.
en: There hasnt been a day like it before or since, when the LORD responded to a human voice. The LORD fought for Israel.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Sulemaana tuma fukumsi m-bɔŋɔ, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinu ni pihinu bɛn lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumd o tuma.
en: These were the chief officers over Solomons work: five hundred fifty had charge of the people who did the work.

dag: Naawuni kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinim dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: God looks down from heaven to see if there is anyone who is wise, anyone who looks to him for help.

dag: Zaŋmiya sania maŋa mini kuruwa maŋa ni taha din nyɛ zaɣ maŋa n-zahindi binyara.
en: Everyone must use honest weights and measures:.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n lo nia ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ kaman ŋun Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli m ba Dauda, N ni ti yɛn zaŋ a bi so leei naa zal a zaashee n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma.
en: So Im planning to build a temple for the name of the LORD my God, just as the LORD indicated to my father David, I will give you a son to follow you on your throne. He will build the temple for my name.

dag: O ni yih a muɣisigu ni, ka barina shɛli ku shih a saha shɛlikam.
en: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.

dag: Ka di varanda wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita awɛi, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di mini jɛmbu duu maa puuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛla yim, ka di dubu mi daa nyɛ mita pihinunaanahi, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima alali pa di puuni dukpina zuɣu.
en: The entrance room was the full width of the Temple, feet, and was feet high. The inside of the room was overlaid with pure gold.

dag: N ni daa paai Troas ni n ti yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu, n Duuma daa mali soli ti ma.
en: When I came to Troas to preach Christs gospel, the Lord gave me an opportunity to preach.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni lɔri ya alikauli shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: N zaŋ n Shia mini n wuhibu tin ya ni di be yi suhuri ni sahakam, ka yi zaŋ li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi ka di be bɛ gba suhuri ni pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says: My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma kom; n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi;.
en: It is yours because when I was hungry, you gave me food to eat. When I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I had no place to stay, you welcomed me into your home.

dag: N ni yih a a tuma ni, ka yih a a zaashee maa. .
en: I will thrust you from your monument; you will be pulled down from your platform.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi yɛli, Alaafee. N dana n-tim ma na ni nti yɛl a ni nachimbih ayi bɛn nyɛ anabinima n-yi Ifriim zoya tiŋ ni kana; ni o suhir a ni a ti ba anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra na.
en: No, Gehazi answered. But my master sent me to tell you that just now two members of the group of prophets in the hill country of Ephraim arrived, and he would like you to give them three thousand pieces of silver and two changes of fine clothes.

dag: Amaa o daa timdi anabinim bɛ sani ni bɛ ti chɛ ka bɛ labi ŋun Yawɛ sanna. Ka anabinim maa daa saɣisi ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: and though God sent prophets to them to bring them back to the LORD and to warn them, they refused to listen.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn bia Abimilɛk la daa ti chaŋ Shɛkɛm o ŋahinim min o ma daŋ niriba zaa sani ti yɛli ba.
en: Abimelech, Jerubbaals son, went to his mothers brothers in Shechem. He spoke to them and to the entire clan of the household to which his mother belonged.

dag: Amaa n ni ti woligi Izraɛlnim bɛn biŋkɔbiri ka chɛ Ijiptinim biŋkɔbiri, ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn so biŋkɔbigu ti ku kpi. .
en: I will make a distinction between the animals of the Israelites and those of the Egyptians, and no animal that belongs to the Israelites will die.

dag: n karitimi dol o hal ti ŋme n-fa piɛbila maa o nol ni; ka o yi lɛbigi doli ma na, n gbaarila o nyiŋgol ni ŋme n-ku o.
en: I chased that wild animal, attacked it, and took the sheep from its mouth. The wild animal jumped on me, but I caught it by the fur under its mouth. And I hit it and killed it.

dag: M bi yi alizanda ni na ni n ti tumla mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka n kana ni n ti tum.
en: I came down from heaven to do what God wants, not what I want.

dag: Ka niriba ni be tin shɛŋa ni zaa ni ti kpalim tiŋ kuma. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: The inhabited cities will be laid waste, the land left desolate, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: ka zaŋ o nudirigu nubila n-tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin.
en: Next, the priest will sprinkle some of the oil seven times before the LORD using his right finger.

dag: Jafilɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pasak mini Bimhal ni Ashivat. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt bidibisi.
en: Japhlet also had three sons: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali saŋmarisi kalinli ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka mi bɛ yuya.
en: He counts the stars and knows each of them by name.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, a bahiyoli paag a, di saha paaya, di biɛɣu neeya, di ti yɛn nyɛla suhusaɣiŋgu dabisili, ka pa ni suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu zoya zuɣu.
en: You who live on the earth, you are finally caught in your own trap! The time has come; the day draws near. On the hills panic, not glory.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli yi yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: You are hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he spoke for God about you:.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti yɛli Jɔab, Naa yɛliya ni a yim na. Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Aai, n ni kpi kpe. Ka Bɛnaaya daa lab naa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔab ni yɛli shɛm, ka garigi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Benaiah came to the LORDs tent and said to Joab, The king says, Come out! Joab said, No! Id rather die here. Benaiah sent a report back to the king: This is what Joab said and how he answered me.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa ni yino daa yɛli, A ba pola pɔri yɛli niriba, Ŋunkam di bindirigu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Niriba maa daa kul gbarigimi zaa.
en: But one of the men told him, We are all weak from hunger, but your father threatened us and said, A curse be on anyone who eats any food today.

dag: Ŋunkam doli wuntitali soli ni be, amaa ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri ni kpi.
en: People who do what is right are on their way to life, but those who always want to do wrong are on their way to death.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa dii chaŋ naa sani nti suh o ni o tim o saha pahi ka o wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: Daniel went and asked the king to give him some time so he could explain the dreams meaning to him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yo Yaakubu zuliya samli, ka tiligi ba bɛn mali yaa gari ba nuu ni.
en: I will rescue them from enemies who could overpower them.

dag: Naa Sulemaana n-daa diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: King Solomon became king of all Israel.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ olivi tih ayi mini firilatamdis ayi din ʒe dunia tiŋgbani Duuma tooni la.
en: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

dag: bahim ba yoli a suhuyiɣisili puuni; bahim ba yoli zaa. Ka dunianim zaa baŋ ni Naawuni n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: finish them off in anger; finish them off until they are gone! Then let it be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ taŋkpaɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam tuuli Adam; ka Adam ŋun pah ayi maa mi nyɛ ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.

dag: ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim, ka di dunoya kabisikabisi.
en: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya, di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus reached out and touched him. I do want to, he answered. Be clean! At once the disease left the man.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yila dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa man yila alizanda ni na; yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, amaa man pala dunia ŋɔ nira.
en: But Jesus said to them, You people are from here below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I dont belong to this world.

dag: O daa kurigimi zaa ka naanyi kpi m-pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: Abraham took his last breath and died after a good long life, a content old man, and he was placed with his ancestors.

dag: Ʒiɛyimtali ni tɔhi yi tiŋgban ni na, ka wuntitali mi be sagbana ni ka lihirina.
en: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛl o, A yuli ku lan booni Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ni boonila Izraɛl, dama a mini Naawuni ni ninsalinim vaya ka a di nasara.
en: The man said, From now on, your name will no longer be Jacob. You will be called Israel, because you have wrestled with God and with men, and you have won.

dag: Naɣikɔra yi ka luɣ shɛli, bindirigu gba kani, naɣikɔra yaa puuni ka bindirigu pam yirina.
en: Without any oxen to pull the plow your barn will be empty, but with them it will be full of grain.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A yi ti zaŋ firilanim ayopɔin la zali, nyin chɛ ka di ne firilatamdigu la tooni. .
en: Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps in the place I showed you. These lamps will light the area in front of the lampstand.

dag: So kani n-nyɛ ŋun mi, so mi kani n-nyɛ ŋun bɔri Naawuni.
en: no one who is wise or who worships God.

dag: o ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim bɛ sani, ka be kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka wuntaŋ puhi na asiba ka o neesim be shɛm la; ka be kaman saa ni yi mi ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni yina shɛm la.
en: is like the sunrise on a cloudless day, or like rain that sparkles on the grass.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli.
en: Jesus used stories to teach them many things. One of his lessons included this story:.

dag: ka guhiri ti tahima din mal alibarika dabisi shɛli dali ti Naawuni Natitamlana ŋun nyɛ tiligira Yisa Masia la jilima palo yibu saha.
en: as we wait for the blessed Day we hope for, when the glory of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ will appear.

dag: Di saha ka nolɔɣu dii kum pahi buyi, ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni nolɔɣu ti yɛn kum buyi o ni chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa la yɛla. Ka di daa niŋ Pita suhugarigu ka o kum pam.
en: Just then a rooster crowed a second time, and Peter remembered how Jesus had said to him, Before the rooster crows two times, you will say three times that you do not know me. And he broke down and cried.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni anabinim mini nanim pam daa bɔri ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ, ka bi nya li; ka daa lan bɔri ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ, ka daa bi wum li.
en: I tell you, many prophets and kings wanted to see what you now see, but they could not. And they wanted to hear what you now hear, but they could not.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ a gula. O nyɛla a nudirigu polo mahim.
en: The Lord will guard you; he is by your side to protect you.

dag: ni Bɛnhɛsɛd tiŋgbɔŋ zaa la.
en: Ben-hesed in Arubboth, who had Socoh and all the land of Hepher.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yinim bɛn yiɣisiri asiba n-gbaai dam nyubu la, yi kul niŋdila lala hal ni yuŋ n-nyu li buɣi.
en: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ mini bɛ bidibisi n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoli maa fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: So they and their descendants were the gatekeepers guarding the LORDs house, that is, the tent.

dag: zaŋ Nɛgɛb mini bɔpiɛligu din nyɛ Jɛriko vinvamli, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din mali dɔbino tihi la hal ni Zɔa.
en: the southern part of Judah; and the plain that reaches from Zoar to Jericho, the city of palm trees.

dag: Ka Yisa chɛbis o ni o kulima ka yɛl o, Di lan lab tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus said to him, You may return home now, but don't go into the village.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o sara maligu shee din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Naawuni daa sɔŋ o ka o tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Guribaal la ni Miunnima.
en: God helped Uzziah fight the Philistines, the Arabs living in the town of Gur Baal, and the Meunites.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o ni bi yiɣisiri o suhu darigiri niriba tibili, ka mi bi doli bɛ ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Job thinks that God does not punish evil and that he pays no attention to sin.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi zo yomyom ti nya Mariama mini Yisifu, ka nya biliɛɣu maa ka o do wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: So they went running and found Mary and Joseph. And there was the baby, lying in the feeding box.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan gbaag o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu mini ʒiŋmabo.
en: Then avoid saying anything hurtful, and never let a lie come out of your mouth.

dag: Izraɛlnim ti ku lan nya suligunyinyaɣu bee goo bɛ ʒiʒiinitab bɛn daa maani ba ansarisi la zaa so sani, ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: The Lord said, None of the surrounding nations that treated Israel with scorn will ever again be like thorns and briers to hurt Israel. And they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

dag: Sokam zaa ni daa pun niŋdi tiliginsim nyabu tahima maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra, Amii Masia la m-bala bee so mi.
en: People's hopes began to rise, and they began to wonder whether John perhaps might be the Messiah.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ayi: yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , ka o mabia yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: Eber had two sons; one was named Peleg, because during his time the people of the world were divided, and the other was named Joktan.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi leeg o tulaalɛmaaniba min o bindir duɣiriba ni o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba.
en: A king will take your daughters and force some of them to make perfume for him and some to cook and bake for him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi nyɛla n ni dihiri m piɛ shɛba, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You, my sheep, the flock that I feed, are my people, and I am your God, says the Sovereign Lord .

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza daa lan va Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa kuli Babilɔn ti zal o nam yili ni Babilɔn maa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar carried off some of the treasures of the Temple and put them in his palace in Babylon.

dag: Ka naa daa fabili Abinɛr zuɣu yɛli, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Abinɛr ti kpi kaman jɛrigu la?.
en: David sang this lament for Abner: Why did Abner have to die like a fool?.

dag: ni Parua bia Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa be Isaka tiŋgban ni la.
en: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah: the territory of Issachar.

dag: O ni daa lihi ʒiɛm o ni po pɔri shɛŋa, ka saɣim alikauli maa, ka lan zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi tuun shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zuɣu, o ku tiligi.
en: He scorned the solemn pledge and overturned the agreement! Even though he made a promise, he did all these things, and he wont escape capture.

dag: Daadam Bia kamina ni o ti tiligi nyɛviya, ka pa ni o ti di nyɛviya. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi taɣi tiŋkpan shɛli.
