en: Then Jesus and his disciples went on to another village.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai min o kpamba maa, Nyamiya, mmaŋmaŋ bia m-bɔri ni o ku ma la, di ni ti be ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir ŋɔ? Chɛliy o ka o tu ma, dama Yawɛ n-zal o lala.
en: David also said to Abishai and all his servants, Look, my very own son is trying to kill me, so why shouldnt this man from the tribe of Benjamin want to do the same? Leave him alone. Let him continue to curse me. The Lord told him to do this.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n shia siɣi Izraɛlnim zuɣu na, ka n ku lan ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will pour out my spirit on the people of Israel and never again turn away from them. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: o biɛhigu shee mini di suɣili ni din yɛn pil li ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: the Holy Tent, its outer tent, and its covering; the hooks, boards, braces, posts, and bases;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: They started discussing among themselves, He says this because we didn't bring any bread.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Mɔabnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi tiligi.
en: and before the fighting was over, they killed about , Moabite warriors—not one escaped alive.

dag: Ŋunkam lo nia ni o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni bol o barinatumda.
en: If you start planning ways to do wrong, people will learn that you are a troublemaker.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kpi m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu. Bɛ zaŋ Ijiptinim tila takɔbi ni bɛ gbahi bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: You cannot escape! The enemy's sword is ready to slaughter every one of you.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tiri ma kpiɔŋ, ka mali n soli ka di tuhi.
en: God is the one who gives me strength. He clears the path I need to take.

dag: dama o zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim pam daa chɛ bɛ zuɣulaannima ka niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: Because of him, many Jews were leaving them and believing in Jesus. That is why they wanted to kill Lazarus too.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino ŋmanila luɣ shɛli nira ni ni zo nti sɔɣi tiligi pɔhim bee sanʒiɛɣu. Bɛ ŋmanila kɔzɔrim din zo n-tiɛli tiŋgban nɛli, ka ŋmani mahim din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tampin titali lɔŋni.
en: each like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from a storm, like streams of water in a wasteland, like the shade of a massive cliff in a worn-out land.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yi ti kpe yi ni, yi ni nya yiko ka leei n shɛhiranima Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ tabili Judia mini Samaria tiŋgbana ni hal ti kpa dunia tarisi zaa.
en: But when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, you will be filled with power, and you will be witnesses for me in Jerusalem, in all of Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

dag: Daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tusaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: There were leaders over the soldiers.

dag: Miriya ka yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama bɛ ni boori Yawɛ kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la be yi ni. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: Do not leave the entrance of the Tent or you will die, because you have been consecrated by the anointing oil of the Lord . So they did as Moses said.

dag: Bɛnjamin bihi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Ashibɛl ŋun daa pa o zuɣu ni Ahara ŋun daa pah ata.
en: Benjamin was Belas father. Bela was Benjamins first son. Ashbel was Benjamins second son. Aharah was Benjamins third son.

dag: Firawuna yi ti yɛli ya ni yi tummi alahiziba tuuni din wuhiri ni mani n-shiri tim ya na, nyin yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee bahi tiŋa Firawuna tooni ka di leei wahu.
en: If the king demands that you prove yourselves by performing a miracle, tell Aaron to take his walking stick and throw it down in front of the king, and it will turn into a snake.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa laɣim Musa sanna ka o ti zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o zaligu shɛŋa yɛla Sinai Zoli zuɣu maa ti ba.
en: After that, all the people of Israel gathered around him, and Moses gave them all the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

dag: Gbaridɔɣirili so daa be Listra. Bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dahin shɛli hal ti paag o ninkurilim ni o daa na ʒi n-yiɣisi zani chaŋ.
en: In Lystra there was a certain man who lacked strength in his legs. He had been crippled since birth and had never walked. Sitting there, he.

dag: Ka Uzia daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nanim gbala ni m-baɣil o yaannima, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi ni o nyɛla kɔŋlana. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Since Uzziah had leprosy, he could not be buried in the royal tombs. Instead, he was buried in a nearby cemetery that the kings owned. His son Jotham then became king.

dag: Bɛ kabi kana kaman tɔbbihi n-doli gooni voli ni kpɛna la; binshɛɣukam ni daa luri saha shɛl la, ka bɛ daa kul kabirina.
en: They pour through the holes in my defenses and come crashing down on top of me;.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti ŋubi biŋkpam bee binʒim yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: No Israelite may eat any fat or any blood; this is a rule to be kept forever by all Israelites wherever they live.

dag: Nyin ka ti yaannim daa niŋ naani; ka bɛ ni daa niŋ a naani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka a tiligi ba.
en: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kom puhigi zɔri tiŋgban nɛl ni, ka chɛ ka kom puhiri yiri tiŋgban kuŋ ni na.
en: He changed the desert into a land with pools of water. He caused springs to flow from dry ground.

dag: Amaa ka Itai daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini n dan naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n dan ni yɛn kpe luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla kum shee bee nyɛvili shee, nimaani ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛn kpe.
en: But Ittai answered, Your Majesty, I swear to you in the Lord 's name that I will always go with you wherever you go, even if it means death.

dag: Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo gili Ninive zaa yɛli, Naa min o kpambaliba ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛliya ka ninsalinim bee niɣi ni piɛri ni buhi zaa di binshɛli bee n-nyu kom.
en: He sent out a proclamation to the people of Nineveh: This is an order from the king and his officials: No one is to eat anything; all persons, cattle, and sheep are forbidden to eat or drink.

dag: Yuuni maa ni daa ti gari, ka bɛ daa lan lab o sanna yuuni din paya ni ti yɛl o, N dana, ti ku sɔɣ a, ti di ti liɣiri zaa; ka ti niɣi zaa nyɛla nyin n dan dini; ti lan ka binshɛɣu nyin n dan tooni m-pahila ti niŋgbuna ŋɔ mini ti puri.
en: When that year was over, they came to him the next year and said to him, We cant hide from my master that the silver is spent and that weve given the livestock to my master. All thats left for my master is our corpses and our farmland.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ni nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm, ka ninvuɣ suma nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: Evil people will be paid back for the wrong they do, and good people will be rewarded for the good they do.

dag: Amaa man kul tumdila din tuhi. Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: But me? I walk with integrity. Save me! Have mercy on me!.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi tahi sara sara malibu shee ka ti teei ni a mali taali a kpe so sani.
en: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli palli n ʒim ni. Kul nyumiya li waawaayili teemi n yɛla.
en: In the same way, after they ate, Jesus took the cup of wine. He said, This cup represents the new agreement from God, which begins with my blood sacrifice. When you drink this, do it to remember me.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa tim Shɛlɛmia bia Jɛhukal mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la anabi Jɛrimia sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Jaande, suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti.
en: Nevertheless, King Zedekiah sent Jehucal, Shelemiahs son, and the priest Zephaniah, Maaseiahs son, to Jeremiah the prophet with this plea: Please pray for us to the LORD our God. .

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ pihinahi dali, ka Nuhu daa yooi ŋariŋ maa takɔr shɛli o ni daa chib la.
en: After forty days, Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni pun yɛli, N tin ya vuhim mini suhudoo, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku wum ti ma.
en: In the past he spoke to them and said, Here is a resting place. Let those who are tired come and rest. This is the place of peace. But they would not listen to him.

dag: Nir yi pii yu suŋ di gari buni pam, ka jilima mi gari anzinfa bee salima.
en: A good reputation is better than much wealth; high esteem is better than silver and gold.

dag: bee so ti yɛli, Nyamiya, di be kpe! Bee n-yɛli, Di be kpe ha! Dama Naawuni nam maa be yi sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: No one will say, Look, here it is! or, There it is!; because the Kingdom of God is within you.

dag: N ni vo zoomba doli bɛ ni na ʒi n-doli so shɛŋa, ka wuhi ba bɛ ni ʒi so shɛŋa. N ni chɛ ka zibisim din be bɛ tooni leei neesim, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli. Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ n ni yɛn niŋ shɛli, ka m mi ku bahi ba.
en: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.

dag: M bolila do so ni o yi wulimpuhili polo kana. O yɛn kabimina kaman suligu la nti niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli. Mani n yɛli maa, ka di mi shiri ni niŋ lala.
en: I call a bird of prey from the east, a man from a distant land for my plan. As surely as I have spoken, Ill make it happen; I have planned, and yes, Ill do it.

dag: Bɛ daa yi tuhi tɔbu ka di nɛma shɛŋa, bɛ piirila di ni shɛli n-zaŋ li mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.

dag: Ka Mɛnahɛm daa ti kani, ka o bia Pɛkahia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king.

dag: Di saha ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, Ka n yi chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yi yaannim Naawuni n-tim ma yi sanna. Ka bɛ bɔhi ma, O yuli lee booni bɔ? Man yɛlim ba wula.
en: Then Moses said to God, But if I go to the Israelites and say to them, The God of your ancestors sent me, then the people will ask, What is his name? What should I tell them.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ kuliga ni nti kpaai yalim maa bahi kom maa ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, n chɛ ka kom maa leei ko viɛlli; ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di ku lan ku so bee n-chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: Elisha then went out and threw salt into the spring. He said, This is what the LORD has said: I have purified this water. It will no longer cause death and miscarriage.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka maligumaani so doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ gari ka chɛ o.
en: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ o naba ni. Amaa di ni sab yɛli ni o zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni maa, di bi wuhi ni ŋun Naawuni pah o ni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛli sɔŋ o naba ni maa zuɣu.
en: As the Scriptures say, God put everything under his control. When it says that everything is put under him, it is clear that this does not include God himself. God is the one putting everything under Christs control.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ yi alahichi ni, ka paɣi bɛ binyɛra, ka Aduna daa zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la zali Yawɛ tooni, ka mali sara ti ba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu m-mali ba kasi.
en: The Levites washed themselves and their clothes. Then Aaron gave them to the Lord as special offerings. Aaron gave the offerings that covered their sins and made them pure.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti ti bidibisi.
en: We won't let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.

dag: Ka so yi tum Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la ni shɛli n-tum alahichi, hal o yi kul bi mi gba, o mali taali, ka di taali maa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you sin by breaking any of the LORDs commands, but without realizing it, doing something that shouldnt be done, and then become guilty and liable to punishment.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba na nti zali jintɔriba maa tooni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa gbaai ba vihibu ka yɛli ba.
en: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa yɛl o, M ba, a yi pun yaag a noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, nyin niŋm ma kaman a ni pun yɛli shɛm maa, Yawɛ ŋun dee ni bɔh a dimnim Ammɔnnim biɛri ti a ŋɔ.
en: Father, she said, you made a sacred promise to the Lord , and he let you defeat the Ammonites. Now, you must do what you promised, even if it means I must die.

dag: Firawuna yi ti nya ba, o suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa polo. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord God says: When your king of Egypt sees all of these graves, he and his soldiers will be glad they are not the only ones suffering.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, yi suɣa viɛli pam. Izraɛlnima, yi doo viɛli pam!.
en: How beautiful are your tents, Jacob, your camps, Israel!.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpaɣim li, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti kpe Naawuni nam ni, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: If your eye makes you sin, take it out. It is better for you to have only one eye and enter Gods kingdom than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.

dag: Saŋmariga maa yuli daa boonila Yabiga. Ka kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei kɔtɔɣu yabiga maa zuɣu, ka niriba pam daa nyu li ka kpi, kom maa ni daa to maa zuɣu.
en: The stars name is Wormwood, and a third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the water, because it became so bitter.

dag: Ka o daa lee shini, ka ŋmaligi baalim kul o yiŋa nti tim bol o zɔnim na, ka bol o paɣa Zɛrɛshi na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: but he did not say a thing. When Haman got home, he called together his friends and his wife Zeresh.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi ka dɔro maa bi yɛligi situra maa ni bee kpalua ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ mali shɛli maa ni.
en: But if, when he examines it, the priest finds that the mildew has not spread on the object.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka yɛdaniŋdib maa daa chɛ ka Pool mini Silas dii yi nimaani yuŋ chaŋ Bɛria. Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Bɛria, bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: As soon as it was dark, the brothers and sisters sent Paul and Silas on to Beroea. When they arrived, they went to the Jewish synagogue.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka toli yina nti ŋubi bimbil shɛŋa zaa sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses: Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt so that the locusts will swarm over the land of Egypt and eat all of the lands grain and everything that the hail left.

dag: amaa di daa sabila ti gba zuɣu. Naawuni ni zaŋ tinim bɛn niŋ ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni yɛda ŋɔ gba zali wuntia zaani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.

dag: O tɔbbihi mali kalinli? Ka ŋuni ka o neesim lee bi paara?.
en: Can anyone count the angels who serve him? Is there any place where God's light does not shine?.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ku ma; n lan ka tahima yaha. Amaa n ni zabi n soli zuɣu hal ni o tooni.
en: He will slay me; Im without hope; I will surely prove my way to his face.

dag: Niriba gaŋbu bi viɛla, amaa bindirigu biɛla zuɣu ni tooi chɛ ka nir tum gala.
en: Those who show favoritism arent good; people do wrong for a crust of bread.

dag: Di simdi ka yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka lumiy o kɔŋko sizuura, ka dol o zaligunima, ka deeg o noli, ka jɛmiy o, ka ʒe o yim.
en: You must follow the LORD your God alone! Revere him! Follow his commandments! Obey his voice! Worship him! Cling to him—no other!.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa wum yɛlli maa, ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim Shilo na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: All the Israelites became very angry with these three tribes. They met together and decided to fight against them.

dag: ni Magidiɛl ni Iram. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Ɛdom nanima.
en: Magdiel, and Iram.

dag: Yɛhudianim bi be bɛ ko ka chɛ bɛn pa Yɛhudianima; kulla Duuma yino n-nyɛ bɛ zaa Duuma, ka o niŋdi alibarika din galisi n-niŋdi bɛnkam kuhiri boon o ni.
en: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.

dag: Miriya ka yi lo tab zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. Yi mi miriya ka yi pɔri pɔri n-diri ʒiri shɛhira. N je dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Do not plan ways of harming one another. Do not give false testimony under oath. I hate lying, injustice, and violence.

dag: A nyɛla jilimalana, ka mali dariza gari zo shɛŋa din zuɣu pali mɔɣu ni nimdi.
en: How glorious you are, O God! How majestic, as you return from the mountains where you defeated your foes.

dag: Ka so yi paŋ biŋkɔbigu o kpee sani, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa, ka bindana maa kani, di simdi ka ŋun paŋ o maa yo o samli zaa;.
en: If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor, and the animal is hurt or dies, then the neighbor must pay the owner for the animal. The neighbor is responsible, because the owner was not there himself.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli, kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya, amaa ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma, hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi; ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: John replied to them all, I baptize you with water, but the one who is more powerful than me is coming. Im not worthy to loosen the strap of his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni yɛn ti a bi shɛba, ka paɣisarili ŋɔ dɔɣi ba ti a ni nyɛla bɛn ni ti chɛ ka a zuliya bemi kaman Pɛrɛz, Tama ni dɔɣ so ti Juda la.
en: May the children you have by this young woman make your family as famous as the family of Perez, the son of Tamar and Judah.

dag: Bɛ ni laɣindi piriŋkpana nyɔri buɣim shɛm la, lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali.
en: The weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire. It will be the same at the end of time.

dag: ni Hanania ni Ɛlam ni Antɔtija.
en: Hananiah, Omri, Elam, Anthothijah.

dag: Uzi n-daa nyɛ o bi kpɛma, ka o mabihi nyɛ Buz mini Kɛmuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Aram ba la.
en: The first son is Uz. The second son is Buz. The third son is Kemuel, the father of Aram.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o ba maa, Nyama, man ŋun kul be a sani nahindi yuun bɔbili ŋɔ zaa ka na ʒi n-zaɣis a noli ŋɔ, a na ʒi n-gbaai hal bubil gba ti ma ni n kɔrigi ka m mini n zɔnim laɣim di ka diɛm.
en: But he spoke back to his father, Look, all these years I have worked for you like a slave, and I have never disobeyed your orders. What have you given me? Not even a goat for me to have a feast with my friends!.

dag: Dauda ni daa tuhi Amalɛknim maa ka labina Naa Sool kum maa nyaaŋa, o daa kpalimla Zikilag daba ayi.
en: After Sauls death, when David had returned from defeating the Amalekites, he stayed in Ziklag two days.

dag: Lala zuɣu bɛn bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm la ni wuhi ni yinim bɛn guni ka mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din sabi doya ka yi bi dol li ŋɔ mali taali.
en: You have the written law and circumcision, but you break the law. So those who are not circumcised in their bodies, but still obey the law, will show that you are guilty.

dag: A yi kpahi ninvuɣ so ŋun tahiri woligibu na zuɣu ni yim nti lan pahi buyi ka o bi taɣi, nyin di lan kal o pahi yi kalinli ni.
en: Give a warning to all those who cause arguments. If they continue to cause trouble after a second warning, then dont associate with them.

dag: Din daa pun beni na kul ni beni. Ka din daa pun niŋ mi na kul ni niŋda. Binshɛli kani n-nyɛ bin palli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.

dag: Ŋun daa pah awɛi n-su chira awɛi ni n-daa nyɛ Abiɛza ŋun daa yi Anatɔt na ka nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The ninth commander, for the ninth month, was Abiezer from the town of Anathoth and the tribe of Benjamin. There were , men in Abiezers group.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka tia kam din lihibu viɛla ka simdi dibu bili yi tiŋgban ni na. Ka nyɛvili tia mini tia din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu gba daa be puu maa sunsuuni.
en: In the fertile land, the LORD God grew every beautiful tree with edible fruit, and also he grew the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa min o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni zaa.
en: Nathan told David about the vision and everything God had said.

dag: Nyin ŋun lihiri daadamnim ŋɔ, n yi tumla alahichi, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum a? Bɔ n-chɛ ka a kul zaŋ dolila mani? Ka a kul liritila mani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka n yɛla muɣis a?.
en: If I sinned, what did I do to you, guardian of people? Why have you made me your target so that Im a burden to myself?.

dag: Ka binshɛɣukam din mali daɣiri ti ku kpe tiŋ maa ni bee ŋunkam tumdi din chihiri bee ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri, amaa kulla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya sab Piɛbil maa nyɛvili litaafi la ni kɔŋko nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: Nothing unclean will ever enter the city. No one who does shameful things or tells lies will ever enter the city. Only those whose names are written in the Lambs book of life will enter the city.

dag: Hal kabiɛlli bee wain din ni zaŋ ti mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu duu gba kani. Maligumaaniba fabindimi, ka Yawɛ tumtumdiba gba fabinda.
en: There is no grain or wine to offer in the Temple; the priests mourn because they have no offerings for the Lord .

dag: Timiya sokam zaa jilima. Yumiya mabihili. Lumiya Naawuni sizuura. Timiya Nazuɣu jilima.
en: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor.

dag: Maika mabia Ishia bidibisi ni, Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.

dag: Niŋmiya lala pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara zuɣu n-zaŋ di mini di binnyura sara mali sara. Di bi simdi ni bɛ mali dansi.
en: The animals must have nothing wrong with them and are to be sacrificed along with the regular daily sacrifices.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla din bari ti suhuri zaana. Dina n-nyɛ din chɛ ka ti gariti chinchini la zuɣu kpɛri du kasi shɛl ni.
en: This hope, which is a safe and secure anchor for our whole being, enters the sanctuary behind the curtain.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Karimba, m pun dolila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: The man answered, Teacher, I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti nya sagani sagbana ni, n ni teei alikauli shɛli din be man Yawɛ mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni, ka nyɛ din ku yiɣisi la yɛla.
en: When I look and see the rainbow in the clouds, I will remember the agreement that continues forever. I will remember the agreement between me and every living thing on the earth.

dag: N niriba bɛn suhiri ma, ka wurim be Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya la ni ti zaŋ pina na ti ti ma.
en: People will come all the way from the other side of the river in Ethiopia. My scattered people will come to me. My worshipers will come and bring their gifts to me.

dag: N daa fabindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zuɣu, ka m puu biɛri nandaamba zuɣu.
en: if I didnt weep for those who have a difficult day or my soul grieve for the needy.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta zuɣusaa daboli din nyɛ zaɣ nɛli zuɣu. Kuhimiya yɛli tɔbbihi, ka kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa wuhi ni yi cham ti liri tin shɛli din niriba mali karimbaani la.
en: On a bare mountain raise a signal; cry aloud to them; wave a hand; let them enter the officials gates.

dag: amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni daba ata dali ka chɛ ka o yi palo.
en: But God raised him from death three days later and caused him to appear.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai yiŋa, ka o yidan ma bɔh o, M bia, ka di nyɛ wula zaŋ chaŋ a polo? Ka Rut daa yɛl o Bɔaz ni yɛl o shɛlikam zaa.
en: Naomi asked her what had happened, and Ruth told her everything.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim zaa daa naanyi gbi la kɔbilisi gili Nail Mɔɣili maa ni bɛ nya kɔnyurim, dama bɛ daa naan ku tooi lan nyu Nail Mɔɣili kom maa yaha.
en: The Egyptians could not drink the water from the river, so they dug wells around the river for water to drink.

dag: Bɛ ni lo barina tumbu nia shɛli ŋmaligiri lurila bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ duŋtaabo ŋmaligiri luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: The trouble they cause will come back on their own heads; the violence they commit will come down on their own skulls.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sabi ŋɔ: N ni yo a li. Hal n ni tooi yɛli ni n samli dol a zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ nyɛvili polo.
en: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla pɔhim shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari lala. Mani n-kari ba saria pumpɔŋɔ maa.
en: It is a stronger wind than that, and it comes from me. Now I will announce my judgment against the people of Judah.

dag: ka Aminadab dɔɣi Nashɔn, ka Nashɔn dɔɣi Salimɔn.
en: Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Salmon.

dag: Jɛhu daa dila Izraɛl nam maa ʒini Samaria yuun pihitaayika.
en: Jehu ruled over Israel in Samaria for years.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli yuŋ la ni, n daa nya so ka o ŋmanila ninsala n-yi zuɣusaa be sagbana ni sirigiri na n-daa ka ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la sanna, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o wuh o.
en: During this vision in the night, I saw what looked like a human being. He was approaching me, surrounded by clouds, and he went to the one who had been living forever and was presented to him.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba mi daa gari chaŋ tiŋ puuni ni bɛ ti da bindirigu na. Ka Samaria paɣ so daa kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom; ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋm kom ti ma ka n nyu.
en: A Samaritan woman came to the well to draw water. Jesus said to her, Give me some water to drink.

dag: Yinim dee kul zomiyala Yawɛ, ka jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa, dama zahimmiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa tin ya la.
en: Obey the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart. Remember the great things he has done for you.

dag: Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: Everyone was amazed. What kind of man is this? they said. Even the winds and the waves obey him.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi ka sabbu be di yaɣa ayi. Di daa sab niŋla di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa.
en: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.

dag: dama Jɔn daa yɛlila Naa Hɛrɔd ni di chihiri ni o fa o niŋ o paɣa.
en: For some time John the Baptist had told Herod, It isn't right for you to be married to Herodias.

dag: Amaa o di ti miri sariga la gbinna bee n-ka sara maligu bimbini la gbinna, dama o nyɛla ŋun mali dalinli, ka lala chɛ ka o ku dihi n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ vi; dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: but since he has an imperfection, he cannot enter toward the inner curtain or officiate at the altar, making these parts of my sanctuary impure by doing so. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi tahima ni na beni saha shɛl la, ka di yu ni bɛ bahi yoli.
en: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di kana, di niŋya. Dabisili ŋɔ yɛla ka n daa yɛl la.
en: That time is coming! It will happen! This is what the Lord GOD said. That is the day I am talking about.

dag: Malimi soli ti takɔbi maa ka di ka Raba din nyɛ Ammɔnnim tiŋ la ni na bee n-ka Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli la ni na.
en: and point out the way for the sword to come: To Rabbah of the Ammonites or To Judah in its stronghold Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa kul tuhi chani tooni shia ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo. Bɛ daa kul chanimi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: Each creature faced all four directions, and so the group could go wherever they wished, without having to turn.

dag: Yinim bɛn mi din tuhi ŋɔ, wummiya! Yinim bɛn gbibi n wuhibu yi suhuri ni ŋɔ, di zɔriya niriba ni maani ya ansarisi shɛli. Ka bɛ yi turi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di muɣisi ya.
en: Listen to me, you who know what is right, people who carry my teaching in your heart: Dont fear human scorn, and dont be upset when they abuse you.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Malaki ni o yɛli Izraɛlnima.
en: This is a message from the Lord to Israel. God used Malachi to tell this message to the people.

dag: Wuhim bihi so shɛli din tuhi, ka bɛ yi ti zooi niŋ ninkura, bɛ ku ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: Teach children how they should live, and they will remember it all their life.

dag: Dama di sab o yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: For the scripture says, You will be a priest forever, in the priestly order of Melchizedek.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli, Yawɛ n-tim ma na ni n ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mini tiŋ ŋɔ yi ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Then I said, The Lord sent me to proclaim everything that you heard me say against this Temple and against this city.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n sabigimi, amaa ka viɛli pam. N sabigimi kaman tiŋgban nɛl ni Kɛdar tanti suɣa la, amaa ka viɛli pam kaman Naa Sulemaana pateesanima.
en: Daughters of Jerusalem, I am dark and beautiful, as black as the tents of Kedar and Salma.

dag: Ka o daa lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ duna tariga. Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ shee tariga.
en: He measured another cubits. Then he told me to walk through the water at that place. There the water came up to my knees. Then he measured another cubits and told me to walk through the water at that place. There the water was waist deep.

dag: Ka so yi ti tum o kpee taali, ka bɛ yɛli ni o poma, ka o kana ti zani duu ŋɔ ni a sara maligu bimbini gbini po.
en: Those who wrong others will be brought to this altar. If they are not guilty, they will make an oath and promise that they are innocent.

dag: ka leei ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ka di pala o yila maligumaaniba zuliya ni na kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu, amaa ka nyɛla maligumaana nyɛvil shɛli din ku bahi yol la yiko zuɣu.
en: He was made a priest, but not because he met the requirement of being born into the right family. He became a priest by the power of a life that will never end.

dag: Nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din mali yaa! Amaa ka bɔzuɣu ka yi galindi ma?.
en: Honest words are convincing, but you are talking nonsense.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, ka mmaŋmaŋ gba bɔhi baŋ dinkam daa niŋ maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɛhi ni di simdi ni n gba sab di yɛla ti a.
en: And so, Your Excellency, because I have carefully studied all these matters from their beginning, I thought it would be good to write an orderly account for you.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa ŋun tim ma na ni n ti baptaizi niriba kom ni maa n-daa yɛli ma, A yi ti nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi siɣina ti tam so zuɣu, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi baptaizi niriba la.
en: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Di ku yuui ka nyɔŋ puuni leei kɔbu shee kɔbu shee mi leei nyɔŋ.
en: In just a little while wont Lebanon become farmland once again, and the farmland be considered a forest?.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi tɔŋ pam yi bihi dɔɣibu ni mini yi biŋkɔbiri dɔɣibu ni ni yi puri atam ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: The Lord will give you many children, many cattle, and abundant crops in the land that he promised your ancestors to give you.

dag: bee o bapir bee o bapir bia ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nir ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o yi ti nya buni o ni tooi yo ka deeg omaŋa.
en: Or their uncle, their cousin, or one of their close relatives from their family can buy him back. Or if they get enough money, they can pay the money themselves and become free again.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nyɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna la zuɣu, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun kɔhiri bindira maa tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa zuɣu. Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa kana ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa.
en: Joseph was the governor of Egypt at the time. He was the one who checked the sale of grain to people who came to Egypt to buy it. Josephs brothers came to him and bowed before him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka n ni zaŋ n yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suh o suhigu shɛli mini n ni suhi binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yɛla be o suhu ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa; ka zo mani ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ min o niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: I pray that the Lord our God will remember my prayer day and night. May he help everyone in Israel each day, in whatever way we need it.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yili ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa din be n nɛma duri puuni wuhi ba.
en: What did they see in the palace? They saw everything. There is nothing in the storerooms that I didn't show them.

dag: Teeku, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa zo? Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa ŋmaligi lab a nyaaŋa?.
en: What happened, Sea, to make you run away? And you, O Jordan, why did you stop flowing?.

dag: ka olivi tih ayi ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu maa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo.
en: There are two olive trees by the bowl, one on the right side and one on the left side. These trees produce the oil for the lamps. .

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa naai, o dii yiɣisimi yi; di daa nyɛla yuŋ.
en: Judas ate the bread Jesus gave him. Then he immediately went out. It was night.

dag: ti nyari alaka, amaa ti na ʒi n-kpalim ti ko; bɛ ŋmɛri ti luhira, amaa ti bi kpira.
en: We are harassed, but we arent abandoned. We are knocked down, but we arent knocked out.

dag: A na mi n-siɣi teeku kɔbilnin ni bee n-tam teeku bulli ni tiŋgbani zuɣu chaŋ?.
en: Have you been to the springs in the depths of the sea? Have you walked on the floor of the ocean?.

dag: ka di gari Farisii maa, o ni daa nya ka Yisa bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣ o nuhi ka ʒini ni o di maa zuɣu.
en: The Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus had not washed before eating.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun yɛl o li maa, Wula ka a lee niŋ baŋ ni Sool min o bia Jɔnatan lu tɔb maa ni.
en: How do you know that Saul and Jonathan are dead? David asked him.

dag: Di saha o min o bihi ni yi a sani n-lab o dɔɣiriba sani ti ʒin o yaannim tiŋgban ni.
en: At that time they and their children shall leave you and return to their family and to the property of their ancestors.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni kɔŋko ka ti mali tahima Masia ni, dindina ti nyɛla nambɔ niriba gari sokam zaa.
en: If we have a hope in Christ only in this life, then we deserve to be pitied more than anyone else.

dag: Niɣi daa nyɛla naɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu. Ka Yawɛ zaka niɣi kalinli daa nyɛ naɣ pisopɔinnaayi.
en: The oxen were . of which the LORDs tribute was .

dag: Man Naa Atazɛrikisɛs zali laɣiguliba zaa bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili la zaligu ni bɛ tim nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la a ni kul bɔri shɛlikam bɛ sani kaliŋkaliŋ.
en: I, King Artaxerxes, decree to all of the treasurers in the province Beyond the River: Whatever Ezra the priest and scribe of the Instruction from the God of heaven requires of you, it must be provided precisely.

dag: Ka n ti wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka n daa moli molo Ahava Mɔɣili duli ni ti siɣisi timaŋ ti Naawuni sani, ka suh o ni o tim ti mini ti bihi ni ti ni su shɛlikam zaa napɔŋ suŋ ti chandi ni.
en: There near the Ahava River, I announced that we all should fast. We should fast to make ourselves humble before our God. We wanted to ask God for a safe trip for ourselves, our children, and for everything we owned.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima.
en: Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ni suhudoo, man dee min a ni daa pun lo tab alikauli Yawɛ yuli ni, ka yɛli ni Yawɛ be ti sani, ka ni ti lan be ti bihi gba sani sahakam ŋɔ saɣiya. Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ, ka Jɔnatan mi lab kuli.
en: Then Jonathan said to David, God be with you. The Lord will make sure that you and I, and your descendants and mine, will forever keep the sacred promise we have made to each other. Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini ka bi garigi shɛli. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa lan bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Alibarikalan Bia la.
en: But Jesus kept quiet and would not say a word. Again the High Priest questioned him, Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed God.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba! Chɛ ka zuliya kam baŋ ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima.
en: Make them afraid, O Lord ; make them know that they are only mortal beings.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi ka n sanna, yi daa bi je ma mi ka kari ma yi ya.
en: When they arrived, Isaac asked, Why are you here? Didn't you send me away because you hated me.

dag: Ka Yisa ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka zom maa yɛl o, Karimba, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Jesus asked him, What do you want me to do for you? The blind man said, Teacher, I want to see.

dag: Yi gba kpalimmiya gbe kpe kaman yi tab la ni daa niŋ shɛm la, ka n nya Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm pahi.
en: But you can stay here tonight like the other men did, and during the night I will learn what the Lord wants to tell me.

dag: Amiram bihi n-daa nyɛ: Aduna mini Musa ni Miriam. Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Amrams children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aarons sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ deeg o suhigu, dama o daa nya nahiŋgu shɛli Siria naa ni nahindi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz.

dag: Di daanabinim zanila bɛ zaani n-zaŋ piɛnta piɛlli paligi bɛmaŋa, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka buɣiri ba ʒiri baɣiri yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Amaa ka Yawɛ bi yɛli shɛli.
en: Her prophets have whitewashed everything for them, seeing false visions and making wrong predictions for them, saying, This is what the LORD God says, when the LORD hasnt spoken.

dag: Ka Mikal daa zaŋ biŋŋmahindili na ti sɔŋ garo zuɣu n-zaŋ bukɔbiri difiɛli sɔŋ zaŋ di zuɣu kuɣ li, ka zaŋ chinchini pil li.
en: Michal took the household god, put clothes on it, and put goats hair on its head. Then she put the statue in the bed.

dag: kpamba pisinaanahi maa gbaanila ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ka ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni la tooni m-piligi bɛ nam zuɣupila n-sɔŋ nam ʒiishee maa tooni, ka jɛmd o, ka yiini yila yɛra.
en: the twenty-four elders fall before the one seated on the throne. They worship the one who lives forever and always. They throw down their crowns before the throne and say.

dag: A niŋ amaŋ naani a tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka tɛhi ni so bi nya a. A yɛm min a baŋsim m-birig a, ka a yɛri a suhu ni, Mani, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, No one can see me! You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: At the resurrection, when they all rise up, whose wife will she be? All seven were married to her.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me Nam ʒiishee zɔŋ, din nyɛ o ni yɛn kariti saria luɣ shɛli. Zɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ sariadibo shee. Sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali di tiŋ hal ti gbaai di yɔɣira.
en: The Throne Room, also called the Hall of Judgment, where Solomon decided cases, had cedar panels from the floor to the rafters.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, o daa gbahila Judanim ninvuɣ tusaata ni pisinaata.
en: This is how many people Nebuchadnezzar carried into captivity: In Nebuchadnezzars th year as king of Babylon, people were taken from Judah.

dag: Ka o daa nya ŋarima ayi ka di ʒe duli; kulipalinima n-daa chɛ li zali ka chaŋ ti paɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: Near the shore he saw two boats left there by some fishermen who had gone to wash their nets.

dag: Ka o daa deei salima maa n-zaŋ li nyɛligi mali salima naɣilabila. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He collected them and tied them up in a cloth. Then he made a metal image of a bull calf, and the people declared, These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa zaŋ tulaale laa maa m-mooi bimbini maa zuɣu buɣim m-pal li n-zaŋ kpaai bahi dunia ni, ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ni tahibu, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda.
en: Then the angel filled the incense holder with fire from the altar and threw it down on the earth. Then there were flashes of lightning, thunder and other noises, and an earthquake.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka n shɛhiranima ayi pil buri, ka n niŋ ba yiko ka bɛ tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu.
en: I will send my two witnesses dressed in sackcloth, and they will proclaim God's message during those , days.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pita, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: I tell you, Peter, Jesus said, the rooster will not crow tonight until you have said three times that you do not know me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni Babilɔn zuɣu shɛm, lala ka di simdi ni Babilɔnnim gba kpi bɛ ni ku lzraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: Babylon must fall for the dead in Israel, as the dead of all the earth have fallen to Babylon.

dag: Di nahindiya yimaŋ bindir shɛli din ni saɣim zuɣu, amaa bomiyala bindir shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Dina n-nyɛ Daadam Bia ni mali shɛli tiri ya la, dama ŋuna ka ti Ba Naawuni zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili.
en: But earthly food spoils and ruins. So dont work to get that kind of food. But work to get the food that stays good and gives you eternal life. The Son of Man will give you that food. He is the only one qualified by God the Father to give it to you.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbɛbil fiɛb ma; ka lab ma kuɣa yim. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n ŋariŋ saɣim teeku puuni; ka m be teeku puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: three times I was whipped by the Romans; and once I was stoned. I have been in three shipwrecks, and once I spent twenty-four hours in the water.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani ka o yɛli ba, Suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: When he arrived at the place, he said to them, Pray that you will not fall into temptation.

dag: Yawɛ n-teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai di nanima, ka zali ni bɛ saɣimmi Keenan birininima.
en: The Lord has stretched out his hand over the sea and overthrown kingdoms. He has commanded that the Phoenician centers of commerce be destroyed.

dag: A ni bɔr a ba yiŋ la zuɣu ka a yiɣisi zɔri maa, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a zu n-kpuɣi n wuna.
en: I can understand why you were eager to return to your father, but why did you have to steal my idols?.

dag: Yawɛ ku saɣi chɛ bɛ taali, dama Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili nyɔhi ni lu bɛ zuɣu. Noli yɛlibu zaa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ni di ba, ka Yawɛ kpihim bɛ yuli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law , and you will be forgotten forever.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, zuliya kam ni ti nya a nasara dibu, ka nanim zaa ti nya a jilima. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ yu palli shɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti a la bol a.
en: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.

dag: Yi yi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o shiri ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, amaa yi yi bi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o daalahichi maa na kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.

dag: Naawuni, sara shɛli a ni deeri nyɛla siɣisimaŋtali; a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ so ŋun siɣis omaŋ niŋ tuuba o suhu ni.
en: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.

dag: O bi ŋme ba luhi kaman o ni daa ŋme bɛn ŋme ba luhi la shɛm la. O mi bi ku ba kaman o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku ba la shɛm la.
en: Israel was not hurt as badly as the enemy who tried to hurt it. Not as many of its people were killed as those who tried to kill them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the Lord told Moses to go to Pharaoh and tell him: The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says, Let my people go to worship me.

dag: Nir yi zɔri Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu. N je karimbaani mini maŋduhibu ni zaɣ biɛɣu ni ʒiŋmabo yɛtɔɣa.
en: If you respect the Lord , you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, Di yi nyɛla lala, hal n ni mali soli ni n da tiŋgbani maa la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ di dabu, dama di wuhiya ni mmaŋmaŋ bihi ti ku di li fali. Nyin dam li, man ku da li.
en: The close relative answered, Then I cannot buy the land. If I do, I might lose my own land. So I cannot do it. You buy the land.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti suh a, nyin gbilisim tibili wum, ka sɔŋ ma yomyom.
en: I cry out to you, LORD: Come to me—quickly! Listen to my voice when I cry out to you!.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yisa, o ni daa yɛli ni o nyɛla bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na la zuɣu.
en: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.

dag: Gbib a tima min a tabibi tima maa. A bilim ni ha ka a pun mal li tumdi tuma. Di pa shɛli di ni sɔŋ a bee di pa shɛli di ni kpɛh a dimnim dabiɛm.
en: You worked hard all your life learning magic and spells. So start using that magic. Maybe those spells will help you. Maybe you will be able to frighten someone.

dag: Ka Ziɔnnim wum li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka Juda fɔntinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ, a ni kariti saria shɛm zuɣu.
en: The people of Zion are glad, and the cities of Judah rejoice because of your judgments, O Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa;.
en: He told the crowd to sit on the ground.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti zaɣisi anab maa ni yɛn zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa wumbu, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti kari dilan saria.
en: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.

dag: Miri ka a bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yuun shɛŋa din gari la so pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ? Dama lala bɔhigu pala yɛm bɔhigu.
en: It isn't wise to ask, Why is everything worse than it used to be.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Mariama, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama a mali zuɣusuŋ pam Naawuni sani.
en: The angel said to her, Dont be afraid, Mary, because God is very pleased with you.

dag: O ni daa woligi Izraɛlnim bahi ka chɛ Juda zuliya saha shɛli maa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam leei bɛ naa. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yihi Izraɛlnim Yawɛ jɛmbu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi pam.
en: He tore them from the family of David, and they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam pulled the Israelites away from following the Lord . He caused them to commit a great sin.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daai Taai goma luhi, ka wurim di binwɔɣila, ka n ti yihi di taŋkpaɣu ka chɛ ka di kpalim tampin nɛli doya.
en: They will tear down your city walls and defense towers. I will sweep away the ruins until all that's left of you is a bare rock.

dag: Ka Maika maa daa ti yɛl o ma, A daanzinfa kpila tuhili ni kɔbiga shɛli bɛ ni daa zu ka a yɛli noli ti ŋun zu li, ka yɛli ma di yɛla la, nyama, di be n sani, mani n-daa kpuɣ li. Ka o ma yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ m bia ŋɔ ni.
en: Micah said to his mother, Do you remember that someone stole pounds of silver from you? I heard you say a curse about that. Well, I have the silver. I took it. His mother said, The Lord bless you, my son.

dag: Gbuɣinli yi ŋum, ŋuni ka dabiɛm lee ku gbaai? Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yi zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ li tɔɣisi niriba.
en: When a lion roars, people are frightened. When the Lord GOD speaks, a prophet must prophesy.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi wuntampuhili saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early on Sunday morning, just as the sun was coming up, they went to the tomb.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa ni bɛ doo kam mini paɣ kam suhim o ʒiʒiinikpee anzinfa mini salima nɛma.
en: You must give this message to the Israelites: Men and women, you must ask your neighbors to give you things made of silver and gold.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.

dag: ka bɛ mini Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal ni Shiina Naa Amirafɛl ni Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ti gbaai tab tuhibu. Nanima anahi mini nanima anu n-daa lu tab zuɣu maa.
en: They fought against King Kedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. So there were four kings fighting against five.

dag: Ka salo pam bɛn daa yi Galili mini Tinsi Pia tiŋgbana ni na mini bɛn yi Jɛrusalɛm ni Judia zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kabiri dol o.
en: Large crowds followed him from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from the areas beyond the Jordan River.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa ŋme n-wurim daanya daantalisi mini tɔrokɔnim daanya ni daanya kɔniŋdi bin titali din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, ka kpuɣi daanya maa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonians broke in pieces the bronze columns and the carts that were in the Temple, together with the large bronze tank, and they took all the bronze to Babylon.

dag: Yisa so bɛ ni lan booni Justus la gba puhiri ya. Niriba ata ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Naawuni nam zuɣu; bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpaŋsiri n suhu pam.
en: Jesus, called Justus, also says hello. These are my only fellow workers for Gods kingdom who are Jewish converts. They have been an encouragement to me.

dag: Nɛzia ni Hatifa.
en: Neziah, and Hatipha.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli din beni nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Masia daa shiri neei kum ni, ka leei bɛn gbihiri kum ni la toondana.
en: But the truth is that Christ has been raised from death, as the guarantee that those who sleep in death will also be raised.

dag: Miri ka a tam ka bi paɣi Naawuni o tuma zuɣu, dama niriba pun yiinila wumpaɣibo yila zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Remember to praise him for what he has done, as many others have done in song.

dag: Daba ni lihiri ŋun su ba ninni shɛm la, dab paɣa ni lihiri ŋun su o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ti kul lihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ninni, hal ni o ti zo ti nambɔɣu.
en: A slave looks to his master to provide what he needs, and a servant girl depends on the woman she serves. So we depend on the Lord our God, waiting for him to have mercy on us.

dag: Ka yi ni duɣ li yaɣiri duɣ shɛl ni maa, di simdi ka yi ŋma li. Ka di yi nyɛ kurigu duɣu, di simdi ka yi nan li, ka niŋ kom suui li.
en: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.

dag: bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: bɛ daa maani maligu ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi ka yi gba bi mi li.
en: because their people had done evil and had made me angry. They offered sacrifices to other gods and served gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors ever worshiped.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anahi daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi wuntaŋ zuɣu, ka ti o yiko ni o tulim be kaman buɣim la n-wɔb daadamnima;.
en: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri moli nolɔbo molo, ka zaŋ Nabɔt ʒili jilima ʒiishee niriba maa ni.
en: They told the people that it was a day to go without eating, and when they all came together, they seated Naboth at the front.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, To, di pa taali! Amaa Yawɛ yi zaŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna niŋ n nuu ni, n ni zaŋ ya pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n du n-tam yi zuɣu nɔn ya.
en: Just wait! Gideon said. After the Lord helps me defeat them, I'm coming back here. I'll make a whip out of thorns and rip the flesh from your bones.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku saɣi guni kaman ti ni yɛli shɛm maa, dindina ti ni zaŋ ti bipuɣiŋga maa yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: But if you dont listen to us and become circumcised, we will take our daughter and leave.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But they did not understand his answer.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa paɣ maa dɔɣir so ni ti di nam. Ka lala naa maa ni ti chaŋ ti liri Siria naa min o tɔbbihi n-kab kpe bɛ sansan ni nti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: But someone from her family will come to take the southern kings place. He will attack the armies of the northern king. He will go into that kings strong fort. He will fight and win.

dag: Bɛ kul teemi gili ma luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They were around me on every side; but I destroyed them by the power of the Lord !.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka yi yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo.
en: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a kahigi wuhi ma a ni niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli shɛm, ka bi ku ma saha shɛli Yawɛ ni di zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: You yourself said it when you told me about the good things you did. The Lord put my life in your hands, but you did not kill me.

dag: Ka n ti bahi yi fɔntinsi yoli, ka chɛ ka yi jɛmbu shɛhi leei dabari, ka m baɣa ku lan be yi binyɛra din nyom viɛl ni.
en: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli. Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ nti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: Then Jesus used stories to teach them many things. He told them this story: A farmer went out to sow seed.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi be; ka di mi ka buchi so sani.
en: The longer you argue, the more useless it is, and you are no better off.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa gbinni; di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi baŋ di gbinni maa.
en: The apostles tried to understand this, but they could not; the meaning was hidden from them.

dag: Bɛ daa zab Musa nyuli bɛ sansan ni, ka zab Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ kasi la gba nyuli.
en: The people became jealous of Moses. They became jealous of Aaron, the Lord s holy priest.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, labisim doo maa paɣa ti o; dama o nyɛla anabi, ka o suhi Naawuni ti a ka a be. Amaa a yi bi labis o ti o, nyin baŋmi ni biɛhiŋ kani a min a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni kpi.
en: Now return the mans wife. Hes a prophet; he will pray for you so you may live. But if you dont return her, know that you and everyone with you will die.

dag: Ŋun pah anu n-daa nyɛ Abital bia Shɛfatia. Ŋun pah ayɔbu n-daa nyɛ Itiriam o paɣ Ɛgila bia.
en: the fifth Shephatiah, with Abital; the sixth Ithream, with his wife Eglah.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, yuma ayopɔin din yɛn dolina puuni, kum ni ti lu, ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, kum maa ni ti dam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim pam.
en: but that will be followed by seven years when there won't be enough. The good years of plenty will be forgotten, and everywhere in Egypt people will be starving.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb ni nyɛla ninkuunsinima mini halikpɛmanima ni munaafichinima ni bɛn bi gbaari bɛmaŋa ni ninvuɣ yarisi ni bɛn je zaɣ suŋ.
en: unloving, contrary, and critical. They will be without self-control and brutal, and they wont love what is good.

dag: Malimiya dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo dapaɣa pisi.
en: Make frames for the south side of the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pirigi maligumaaniba zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi, ka pirigi Lɛvinima zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi ni bɛ tumdi Naawuni tuma Jɛrusalɛm kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la.
en: They also organized the priests and the Levites for the Temple services in Jerusalem, according to the instructions contained in the book of Moses.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi taba, O ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla maa gbinni lee nyɛla wula? Ti bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: What does he mean by soon? We dont understand what hes talking about.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di luɣilikam zaa ni di binyila la, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered the top, all the sides, and the horns with pure gold. Then he put gold trim around the altar.

dag: o tuma ni ti yi palɔni. Di dabisili ni ti kahigi li wuhi, dama buɣim nti yɛn kahigi li wuhi, ka buɣim maa ni ti buɣisi sokam tuma n-kahigi di ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi.
en: each ones work will be clearly shown. The day will make it clear, because it will be revealed with fire—the fire will test the quality of each ones work.

dag: Nir yi niŋdi nandaamba alaka ni o nya buni pahi ni ŋun tiri bundaamba pini, bɛ zaa ni leei nandaamba.
en: Oppressing the poor to get rich and giving to the wealthy lead only to poverty.

dag: N yɛliya, Timiya ma pini? Bee Piimiya yi buni shɛli m-pa talima ti ma?.
en: Have I asked you to give me a gift or to bribe someone on my behalf.

dag: Musa daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses said to all the people of Israel, This is what the Lord has commanded:.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi mɔɣa mini kɔbilisirima ni, ka di leei ʒim.
en: Then the third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and the springs of water, and they turned into blood.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛl o niriba maa, Mani n-daa wurim ya bahi ka yi chaŋ ti be luɣ shɛlikam, dinzuɣu yinim bɛn be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa, Zomiya yi Babilɔn n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Hurry! Leave the land in the North in a hurry. Yes, it is true that I scattered your people in every direction.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaanahi daa gbaai Matitia min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl kpamba daa darigi chɛhi bɛ binyɛra, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri n-doya ni suhugarigu hal ni zaawuni.
en: Joshua ripped open his clothes. He, along with the elders of Israel, lay flat on their faces before the LORDs chest until evening. They put dust on their heads.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma anii; ka daa ti kpi ka di bi niŋ so nandahima. Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o nanim silisi la ni.
en: Jehoram was years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.

dag: O zaŋ ma luhi baɣiri ni, ka m be kaman taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim la.
en: He hurls me into mud; Im a cliché, like dust and ashes.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa laɣimna nti muɣi dunoli.
en: In fact, the whole town gathered around the door of the house.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri li billi kaman o ni bɔri shɛm; o tiri bimbiɛlli kam la dimaŋmaŋ billi.
en: God provides that seed with the body he wishes; he gives each seed its own proper body.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Ikabɔd biɛli Ahitub bia la daa mali tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la lɔr o shee ni. Ahitub daa nyɛla Finɛhas bia ka nyɛ Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ maligumaana Shilo la yaaŋa. Ka niriba maa so daa bi baŋ ni Jɔnatan chaŋya.
en: including Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, who was Ichabods brother and the son of Phinehas the son of Eli, who was the LORDs priest at Shiloh. He was wearing a priestly vest. None of the troops knew that Jonathan had gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Labimiya n sanna, ka n gba lab yi sanna.
en: But you must say to the people, The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Return to me, says the LORD of heavenly forces, and I will return to you, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee taɣi teeku kom zali saha shɛli di ni daa tahi yi tiŋgbani puuni la na?.
en: Who closed the gates to hold back the sea when it burst from the womb of the earth?.

dag: Dunɔdali maa tooni zaŋ hal ti paai zɔntua puuni dunoli maa ni, di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu.
en: From the inside edge of the outer gate to the far end of the porch was cubits.

dag: M puhiri Ampiliatus n ni yuri so ti Duuma ni la.
en: My greetings to Ampliatus, my dear friend in the fellowship of the Lord.

dag: ka o zaŋ omaŋ wuhi bɛn daa dol o yi Galili chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm la dabisi gbaliŋ. Bɛna n-nyɛ o shɛhiranim niriba sani pumpɔŋɔ.
en: and for many days he appeared to those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now witnesses for him to the people of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ kurugu tahipɔŋ zali, ka di leei kurugu gooni a mini tiŋ maa sunsuuni. Ka a zaŋ a ninni kpa li, ka chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni teei gili shɛli, ka di nyɛ nyini n-teei gil li. Ka dimbɔŋɔ maa leei shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: Take an iron pan and set it up like a wall between you and the city. Face the city. It is under siege, and you are the one besieging it. This will be a sign to the nation of Israel.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be kaman yɛndana? Ka ŋuni n-lee baŋdi yɛla gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm? Yɛm chɛmi ka nir ninni ne zaa, ka chɛ ka o ninni lihibu biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa. Yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni mi ni ti buɣisi tin ya hal di ni ti gari lala gba.
en: Listen carefully to what you hear! The way you treat others will be the way you will be treated—and even worse.

dag: Shia Kasi maa n-nyɛ Shi so o ni daa zaŋ niŋ ti ni pam Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la zuɣu.
en: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.

dag: A ni da binshɛli a kpee sani ka di dolila chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa yuma kalinli yaakaza tariga. Ka o mi kɔhi li ti a ka di dol a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam yuma shɛm tariga.
en: You will buy from your fellow citizen according to the number of years since the Jubilee; he will sell to you according to the number of years left for harvests.

dag: Iso ni daa wum o ba ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka o kum suhusaɣiŋgu kumsi pam ka yɛl o ba, M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni.
en: When Esau heard this, he cried out loudly and bitterly and said, Give me your blessing also, father.

dag: Dama Yawɛ sagbani maa daa kul bela o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa wuntaŋ ni, yuŋ mi ka buɣim be sagbani maa puuni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni bɛ chandi maa zaa ni.
en: During all their wanderings they could see the cloud of the Lord 's presence over the Tent during the day and a fire burning above it during the night.

dag: ni yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu ni Naawuni yiko ni ni wuntitali din nyɛ ti bidibbina m-be ti nudiriti mini ti nuzahi ni la puuni.
en: by our message of truth, and by the power of God. We have righteousness as our weapon, both to attack and to defend ourselves.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di ka nyu.
en: Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yuya ni pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la kuli dɔbba dɔɣi bihi n-ʒi bɛ yinsi gbib ba, ka di chɛ ka ti dimnim ku nya soli n-yɛli ti din bie;.
en: So I want the younger widows to marry, have children, and take care of their homes. If they do this, our enemy will not have any reason to criticize them.

dag: ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni kum ni daa yɛn lu la piligi kaman Yisifu ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kum maa daa lula luɣilikam zaa tiŋgbɔna ni; amaa ka bindira daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ din zaa ni.
en: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. The famine struck every country, but the entire land of Egypt had bread.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a labi tiŋgban ni; palɔni ka n ti yɛn zaŋ a bahi, ka chɛ ka noonsi zaa kana ti lu a zuɣu, ka dunia zaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dari tɔh a ŋubi.
en: Then I will drop you on the dry ground. I will throw you down in the field. I will let all the birds come and eat you. I will let wild animals from every place come and eat you until they are full.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa wuhi ma, ka m baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa wuhi ma bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: The Lord showed me that the men of Anathoth were making plans against me. He showed me what they were doing, so I knew they were against me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti nya ka liɣiri din be adaka maa ni zooi, naa gbaŋsabira mini maligumaaniba zuɣulana kanimina nti kal li, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nya laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-niŋ kpalansi ni lo.
en: Whenever there was a large amount of money in the box, the royal secretary and the High Priest would come, melt down the silver, and weigh it.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu kaman n ni daa zali ya shɛm la. Ŋubimiya bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin Abib goli puuni, dama goli maa ni ka yi daa yi Ijipti na. Di bi simdi ni so ka n sanna ni nu zaŋa.
en: Observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread, as I commanded you. Eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, because it was in that month that you came out of Egypt. No one should appear before me empty-handed.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura, ka dol o soli mali alibarika.
en: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.

dag: ka lan zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi la. Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ li niŋ salima bintabindisi la ni.
en: and in the fourth row, a beryl, a carnelian, and a jasper. These are to be mounted in gold settings.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri kuri ba solɔri zuɣu, ka dabiɛm pam ti be duri puuni. Di ni paai nachimbihi mini paɣipiɛlisi ni bimɔɣirisi ni ninkura bɛn zuɣuri paligi.
en: In the streets, soldiers will kill them. In their houses, terrible things will happen. Soldiers will kill young men and women. They will kill babies and old people.

dag: Naawuni vuhim ni ku ba, ka o suhuyiɣisili pɔhim di ba.
en: When God breathes deeply, they perish; by a breath of his nostril they are annihilated.

dag: Lihimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibi li hal ti zahim li maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba tooni Jɛrusalɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la puuni duri ni.
en: Guard them carefully until you reach the Temple. There in the priests' rooms weigh them and turn them over to the leaders of the priests and of the Levites, and to the leaders of the people of Israel in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n yi daa nyu bara yi zuɣu o sani, dindina vi bi mali ma di zuɣu, amaa kaman ti ni daa pun yɛli ya binshɛɣukam ni daa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛm la, lala ka ti barinyubo yi zuɣu Taitus sani gba wuhi palɔni ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.

dag: N ni niŋ n daalibarika niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu maa ni din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yuma ata bindira.
en: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.

dag: Ka kum daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na. Ka kɔnyuri daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba kom din yi tampiŋ ni na. Ka a daa yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni zaŋ ti ba fali la su.
en: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *.

dag: Ka ti daa ku bɛ zaa, ka ku tiŋ kam nima dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi zaa kaman ti ni daa niŋ Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn shɛm la.
en: We destroyed all the towns and put to death all the men, women, and children, just as we did in the towns that belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon.

dag: Bɛ sɔŋmi bɛ mabihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni ka bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma, amaa ka lee di lan zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo di tuun shɛli. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ Lɛvinim maa n-wuhi ba bɛ tuma.
en: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a mɔgɔr nɛma min a tɔbu ni a lɔɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti ku mɔɣu ni valiga na.
en: Take your bow and arrows, go out into the country, and kill an animal for me.

dag: Yi mi ni Masia daa kana ni o ti kpihimla ninsalinim daalahichi, ka alahichi ka o ni.
en: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa n-leei tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, ka zaŋ maligumaana Zadok mi n-zali Abiata zaani.
en: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa dol o nyaaŋa paana ti kpe siliga maa ni n-nya ka bimpiɛlli maa doya.
en: Then Simon Peter finally reached the tomb and went in. He saw the pieces of linen lying there.

dag: yimaŋmaŋ di ʒiɛnya nimaani, amaa yinim karimiya doli yi dimnim maa nyaaŋa nti liri ba, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ zo m-paai bɛ ya, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: But dont stay there yourselves. Continue chasing the enemy and attacking them from behind. Dont let the enemy get back to their cities. The Lord your God has given you the victory over them.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa mini Firawuna yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba zaa ni o tɔbbihi zaa daa doli Izraɛlnim maa ti paai ba, ka bɛ dola teeku noli luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Pihahirɔt din daa be Baalizɛfɔn tooni polo la.
en: The Egyptian army had many horse soldiers and chariots. They chased the Israelites and caught up with them while they were camped near the Red Sea at Pi Hahiroth, east of Baal Zephon.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti woligi ba bɛ ko Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa ni n-chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba kaman noli yɛlibu zaa din be alikauli puuni, ka sabi be zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni la.
en: Out of all Israels tribes, the LORD will single them out for disaster in compliance with all the covenant curses that are written in this Instruction scroll.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pinaayi, ka bɛ min o chaŋ Yaɣigari Chuɣu ni kaman bɛ daadiini kali soli ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: When he was years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to their custom.

dag: Yawɛ, a nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You are merciful, Lord ! Please do the right thing and save my life.

dag: Ka n teei n nuu jɛndi ba n-saɣim tiŋgbani ka di bahi yoli, bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ti paai Ribila. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Yes, I will reach out and destroy their country. I will make it a wasteland from the southern desert to the city of Riblah in the north, not sparing any place where the Israelites live. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Mmaŋmaŋ kpiɔŋ puuni ka n niŋ lala. M mali yɛm, ka mali baŋsim. N daai tiŋgbana tintarisi nahi taba, ka va bɛ nɛma. N niŋmi kaman naɣilaa la n-ʒe n-yiɣisi nanima bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi.
en: The emperor of Assyria boasts, I have done it all myself. I am strong and wise and clever. I wiped out the boundaries between nations and took the supplies they had stored. Like a bull I have trampled the people who live there.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Ŋmaligim zani kpaŋ kpe. Ka o daa ŋmaligi zani kpaŋa.
en: Then the king said, Step over here and wait. Ahimaaz went there and stood waiting.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be du shɛl ni ka kpari di dunoya, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima. Ka Yisa ti puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yisa, ti teemi n yɛla a nam ni.
en: Then he said, Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa ti chaŋmi ti liri Judanima, ka me Rama zali ni o chɛ ka so ku lan tooi yi Juda Naa Asa sani chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n-yi shɛli polo ka o sanna.
en: Baasha invaded Judah and started to fortify Ramah in order to cut off all traffic in and out of Judah.

dag: Bɛ zaliya ni bɛ gbahimi tiŋ maa nim chaŋ. Bɛ gbahi di dabipaɣiba chaŋ, ka bɛ fabindi kaman ŋmana la, ka buri bɛ nyɔri.
en: It is decreed: She is sent into exile, carried away, while her female servants moan like doves, beating their breasts.

dag: Yinim bɛn be Rom gba be Naawuni ni boli shɛba ni bɛ leei Yisa Masia niriba maa kalinli ni.
en: This also includes you who are in Rome, whom God has called to belong to Jesus Christ.

dag: N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛha buyiyi, amaa n yur a zaligu dina.
en: I hate those who are not completely loyal to you, but I love your law.

dag: A ni tooi tahi sagbani zuɣu n-chɛ ka kom kpe n-lim a?.
en: Can you shout orders to the clouds and make them drench you with rain?.

dag: O daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub sara maligu bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li ti ti bɛn daa be o sani maa.
en: David went into Gods house. He took the bread that was offered to God and ate it. And he gave some of the bread to the people with him. This was against the Law of Moses, which says that only the priests can eat that bread.

dag: Bɛ piɛbi kikaa, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, amaa so ku chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu, dama n suhuyiɣisili maa ni lu bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: They will blow the trumpet to warn the people. The people will get ready for battle, but they will not go out to fight because I will show the whole crowd how angry I am.

dag: O ni daa yi zahira tumd o pagɔrisigu tuma, ka yihir omaŋ fini shɛm maa daa chɛ ka n ŋmalig o sani ni suhuyiɣisili kaman n ni daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o biɛli shɛm la.
en: Oholibah let everyone see that she was unfaithful. She let so many men enjoy her naked body that I became disgusted with her—just as I had become disgusted with her sister.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka so zali ya zaligunima zaŋ chaŋ yi ni ni di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli polo bee zaŋ chaŋ dabisi kasi shɛŋa mini gol palli chuɣu puhibu ni Vuhim Dabisili kaya dolibu polo.
en: So dont let anyone judge you about eating or drinking or about a festival, a new moon observance, or sabbaths.

dag: Dama o daa teeg o daalikauli kasi la min o dabili Ibrahimma yɛla.
en: He remembered his sacred promise to Abraham his servant.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum Yawɛ yɛligu, ka zaɣis o zaligu dolibu, dindina ŋun Yawɛ ni darigi yi tibili.
en: If you're stubborn and refuse to obey the Lord , he will turn against you and your king.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal biɛri din bie pam ka so ku tooi di li la ni be shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Juda naa Zɛdɛkia min o kpambaliba ni Jɛrusalɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni mini bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: And just like the rotten figs that are so bad that they cant be eaten, the LORD says, I will do to Judahs King Zedekiah and his officials, as well as the remaining few in Jerusalem and those who are living in Egypt.

dag: Do shɛb bɛn na bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba ni pakoya la mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Bɛ yi ni kpalim be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, di viɛla.
en: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti min o mali dolintabitali ka be zibisim ni, dindina ti ŋmarila ʒiri ti yɛtɔɣa ni mini ti tuma puuni.
en: If we claim, We have fellowship with him, and live in the darkness, we are lying and do not act truthfully.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna ka yi ti ku lan po n-yɛli Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu. .
en: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: So Peter and John left. Everything happened the way Jesus said. So they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Zanimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa zaani n-tɔɣisi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ti ba. Zabimi bɛn ka yaa yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa dɔɣi Yisifu nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, Bahim ma ka n kuli n ya ni n yiŋa.
en: After Joseph was born, Jacob said to Laban, Release me from our agreement and let me return to my own country.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛla wuntizɔbo yɛtɔɣa, di shɛli pala ʒiri bee n-nyɛ din gɔŋ.
en: Everything I say is right; there is nothing false or crooked about it.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa guli ni o yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di yuŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni gbibi shɛli, ka di nyɛ Yawɛ guhibu yuŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: On that night the Lord kept watch for them, and on this same night each year Israel will always keep watch in honor of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn tumdi din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But all have turned away. Everyone is corrupt. No one does good— not even one person!.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pia.
en: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli wuhibu daa be o nol ni, ka galimi yɛtɔɣa daa ka o nol ni. O daa kul doli ma mi ni nimmaŋtali mini biɛrisuntali, ka daa yihi niriba pam tuumbiɛri tumbu ni.
en: He taught the true teachings and didnt teach lies. Levi was honest, and he loved peace. He followed me and saved many people from being punished for the evil things they did.

dag: ni Areebia nanim zaa ni zuliya gari bɛn be tiŋgban nɛli ni la nanim zaa.
en: all the kings of Arabia and the nomadic tribes.

dag: ka yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun yu n dan maa yurilim maŋli din ka kpee, ka ʒe o yim ŋɔ. Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi polo, Yawɛ kul zaŋ ma mi na ti kpɛhi n dan maa dɔɣiriba yiŋa.
en: I thank you, Lord God of my master Abraham! You have led me to his relatives and kept your promise to him.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ biɛri ka yɛlibiɛri paara? Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri n-nyari ashaara?.
en: He sends disaster and ruin to those who do wrong.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa pirigi ʒii buyi: Bɛ shɛb daa dolila Yɛhudianim maa; ka bɛn la mi doli Yisa tuumba maa.
