en: The people of the city were divided—some siding with the Jews, others with the Lords messengers.

dag: N ni ti gbib a ni ʒiɛyimtali, ka a baŋ man Yawɛ.
en: I will take you for my wife in faithfulness; and you will know the LORD.

dag: Dama daba ayɔbu ka man Yawɛ daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, ka daa vuhi daba ayopɔin dali. Lala zuɣu man Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili kasi.
en: That is because the Lord worked six days and made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them. And on the seventh day, he rested. In this way the Lord blessed the Sabbath—the day of rest. He made that a very special day.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya binshɛɣukam zaa ni, dama dina n-tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: Children, obey your parents in everything. This pleases the Lord.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Naa Dauda yaaŋa n-ni bala yɔɣɔ.
en: The crowds were so amazed they asked, Could Jesus be the Son of David.

dag: Hal ka di lan ka buchi ni nir zaŋ li niŋ kulim gba n-zaŋ bah o puu ni n-naɣ pahila bɛ kpaa li mi bahi. Ka daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: It is worth nothing. You cant even use it as dirt or dung. People just throw it away. You people who hear me, listen.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli. Dama n nya ka girigiri niŋbu mini duŋ taabu be tiŋ puuni.
en: Baffle them, my Lord! Confuse their language because I see violence and conflict in the city.

dag: Di saha ka a chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa zani Aduna min o bidibisi la tooni, ka a zaŋ ba ti Yawɛ kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la.
en: Dedicate the Levites as a special gift to me, and put Aaron and his sons in charge of them.

dag: Zaŋmi jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni mali chaŋ, dina ka a ti yɛn mali tumdi alahiziba tumtumsa maa.
en: Now take this walking stick and use it to perform miracles.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam n-niŋ nam maa ni la yuun pisinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili; ka o bia Nadab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam ruled as king for years. Then he died and was buried with his ancestors. His son Nadab became the new king after him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tu o la, o daa bi tu so labisi; o ni daa di wahala la, o daa bi tɛhi biɛri bɔhibu yɛla, amaa o daa chɛla shɛlikam niŋ ŋun kariti saria dɛde la nuu ni.
en: When he was insulted, he did not reply with insults. When he suffered, he did not threaten revenge. Instead, he entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.

dag: Miri ka a lihi ni a mali yɛm, zom Yawɛ, ka zo n-yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Dont consider yourself wise. Fear the LORD and turn away from evil.

dag: Yinim ninsalinima, saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi kul yɛn dihiri ma vi? Saha yuusim wula puuni, ka yi kul yɛn yuri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka doli din nyɛ ʒiri?.
en: Men, how long will you try to dishonor me? Do you enjoy wasting your time searching for new lies against me? Selah.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni lihi yum maa ka yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, yum nyɛla daɣiri, dama di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: The priest shall examine you again, and if he sees an open sore, he shall pronounce you unclean. An open sore means a dreaded skin disease, and you are unclean.

dag: Mbaye Sidɔn, a di vi, dama teeku birini yɛliya, N na ʒi n-wolisi bee n-dɔɣi. M mi na ʒi n-wumsi nachimpola bee paɣipiɛlisi.
en: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba; ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni. Leem bɛ gula, ka lihiri ba sahakam kaman piɛgul ni lihir o piɛri shɛm la.
en: Save your people. Bless those who belong to you. Lead them and honor them forever.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so n-ti yɛn me jɛmbu duu maa ti n yuli jilima.
en: but you cannot build the Temple. Your son will build the Temple for my name.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Galili maa, ka Galilinim maa deeg o ni suhupiɛlli bɛ nini ni daa pun nya o ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa chuɣu puhibu ni Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu, dama bɛ gba daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni.
en: When he arrived in Galilee, the people there welcomed him. They had been at the Passover festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he did there.

dag: Chɛ ka zuɣusaanim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka dunianim mali suhupiɛlli. Yɛlimiya zuliya kam ni, Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa.
en: Be glad, earth and sky! Tell the nations that the Lord is king.

dag: Amaa ka Juda daa yɛl o, Doo maa daa kpahi ti zuɣu ni yɛli, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yin di chɛ ka n ninni nyan ya.
en: Judah said to him, The man sternly warned us that we would not be admitted to his presence unless we had our brother with us.

dag: Amaa n di yuya ni Naawuni yaag o noli n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: I wish God would answer you and tell you that you are wrong.

dag: Zaligu shɛŋa yi ni yɛn doli viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini di ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be dunia yili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the regulations and the case laws that you must carefully keep in the fertile land the LORD, your ancestors God, has given to you to possess for as long as you live on that land.

dag: Di saha ka Ishibibɛnɔb ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumya zuliya, ka o kpani tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata ni pirigili, ka takɔb palli lo o sheeni la daa tɛhi ni o ni tooi ku Dauda.
en: A giant named Ishbibenob, who was carrying a bronze spear that weighed about seven and a half pounds and who was wearing a new sword, thought he could kill David.

dag: ka ŋme gbuɣima mini naɣilahi ni chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa dapaɣ shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ kpɛhikpɛhi firimnim la ni zuɣu. Ka pɔripɔri daanya niŋ firimnim maa mini gbuɣima ni naɣilahi maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ tiŋli.
en: with the figures of lions, bulls, and winged creatures on the panels; and on the frames, above and underneath the lions and bulls, there were spiral figures in relief.

dag: yo yaɣimɛr palo zuɣu kaman n Duuma Naawuni ni daa pun wuhi ma shɛm.
en: and used the money to buy the potter's field, as the Lord had commanded me.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka nasara dibu yirina, niŋm alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: Victory comes from the Lord — may he bless his people.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali mali di buɣim saligbabirisi mini di buɣim moorisi.
en: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.

dag: Dabisili din pah anii dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: On the eighth day gather for worship and do no work.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti tuhi deei Hamatizɔba.
en: Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and seized it.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb bɛn zooi gari o ni tuui tim shɛb maa, ka bɛ ti niŋ bɛ gba lala.
en: He then sent more servants than he did the first time. But the renters treated them in the same way.

dag: ka hal teeku kɔgbana yi vuri ka ŋmuɣinda, ka hal di vubu maa yi chɛ ka zoya sɔhira, ti ku zɔri dabiɛm.
en: when its waters roar and rage, when the mountains shake because of its surging waves. Selah.

dag: Dama ŋunkam niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima nyɛla Yawɛ ni bi bɔri so, binyɛra din chihiri ŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daŋ kariti ba maa.
en: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun mi ni yi ni ŋahi ma ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Timlana, tibim amaŋa! Ka ni lan yɛli ma, Niŋmi ti ni daa wum ni a niŋ shɛm Kapɛrinium la amaŋmaŋ ya ŋɔ! .
en: He said to them, I am sure that you will quote this proverb to me, Doctor, heal yourself. You will also tell me to do here in my hometown the same things you heard were done in Capernaum.

dag: Hal bɛ ni booni binshɛŋa buɣa la yi bela zuɣusaa bee dunia ŋɔ ni, dama buɣa pam mini duumanim pam shiri beni.
en: Granted, there are so-called gods, in heaven and on the earth, as there are many gods and many lords.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa yi yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ ka doli tab gbilligbilli chani shɛm m-bala.
en: This, then, was the order of march, company by company, whenever the Israelites broke camp and set out.

dag: Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: They talked this over and said to each other, We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.

dag: Ka yi ti chaŋ maligumaana ŋun tumdi tuma di saha maa sani ti yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni m paai ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
en: Go to the priest in charge at that time and say to him, I now acknowledge to the Lord my God that I have entered the land that he promised our ancestors to give us.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi duɣu n-doori anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim titali n-doori salima shɛm, lala ka bɛ buɣisiri ninsal gba o paɣibu ni.
en: A crucible is for silver and a furnace for gold; so are people in the presence of someone who praises them.

dag: Malimiya yi binyɛra zaa mini yi binshɛŋa din nyɛ biŋkɔbiri gbana ni buhi kɔbiri binyara zaa ni dari binyara zaa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: Then wash your clothes and anything made from animal skin, goat's hair, or wood.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam lihi paɣa kɔre lihigu pun niŋ zina ni paɣ maa o suhu ni.
en: But now I tell you: anyone who looks at a woman and wants to possess her is guilty of committing adultery with her in his heart.

dag: N Duuma, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ ka n lee lan guhira? Kulla a sani ka m mali tahima.
en: So, Lord, what hope do I have? You are my hope!.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kuri yi liɣiri binshɛli din pa bindirigu zuɣu, ka tumdi tuma din ku tiɣi ya zuɣu? Wummiya n yɛligu viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dinya din viɛla ni bindir suma ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Why waste your money on something that is not real food? Why should you work for something that does not really satisfy you? Listen closely to me and you will eat what is good. You will enjoy the food that satisfies your soul.

dag: N kul ku nyari n niriba maa taali bee n yiɣisiri n suhu bahiri bɛ zuɣu sahakam, dama di yi nyɛ lala n ni ti bɛn ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛvili maa ni kpi.
en: I wont always accuse, nor will I be enraged forever. It is my own doing that their spirit is exhausted— I gave them breath!.

dag: Kul zahimmiya binyɛra sania zuɣu ka di paara ni yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋmiya kuruwa maŋli zahindi yi binyɛra ka di paana din ni chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: You must use weights and measures that are correct and accurate. Then you will live a long time in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Zaŋm Aduna min o bia Ɛliɛza du Hɔr Zoli zuɣu na;.
en: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar, and bring them up Mount Hor.

dag: Amaa ka wahu maa yɛli paɣ maa, Yi ku kpi.
en: No, you won't! the snake replied.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni yihi ba yi ni daa zaŋ ba kɔhi luɣ shɛŋa maa ni na. N ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa lab lu yi zuɣu.
en: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.

dag: N suhir a, ni a di chaŋ, ka m bo pin na ti ti a. Ka o yɛl o, N ni guh a hal ka a ti labina.
en: And wait here until I bring you an offering. All right, I'll wait, the Lord answered.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buyi, Saimɔn Jɔn bia a yuri ma? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: Jesus asked a second time, Simon son of John, do you love me? Simon replied, Yes, Lord, you know I love you. Jesus said to him, Take care of my sheep.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, amaa o ni kari o ni yɛli noli ti ninvuɣ shɛb la bahi.
en: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka bɛ ti zaŋ Sool n-leei naa Yawɛ tooni Giligal ka mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni nimaani. Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: Everyone went to the place of worship at Gilgal, where they agreed that Saul would be their king. Saul and the people sacrificed animals to ask for the Lord 's blessing, and they had a big celebration.

dag: Giliad zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Iiza daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Iizanima, ka Hɛlɛki daŋ niriba nyɛ Hɛlɛkinima.
en: The family groups from Gilead were Iezer—the Iezerite family group; Helek—the Helekite family group;.

dag: amaa di buɣisi di dundɔŋ la dina, dama bɛ zaŋ li tila bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ ni ti no n-gili tiŋ kasi la puuni chir pihinahinaayi.
en: But dont measure the court outside the temple. Leave that out, because it has been given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city underfoot for forty-two months.

dag: ti yɛli ma, Pool, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. A ni bahi paai Naa Siiza tooni. Nyama, Naawuni ni tilig a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɛ ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni nyɛviya a zuɣu.
en: The angel said, Dont be afraid, Paul! You must stand before Caesar! Indeed, God has also graciously given you everyone sailing with you.

dag: Yi yi mi ni o nyɛla wuntialana, yin baŋmiya ni ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: You know that Christ is righteous; you should know, then, that everyone who does what is right is God's child.

dag: ka yɛl o, Aai! Ti ni dol a kul a niriba sani.
en: and said, We want to go with you and live among your people.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tuhi bɛn be tiŋ maa puuni hal ti luhi wuntaŋa n-daa ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, ka ku niriba bɛn be di ni, ka niŋ yalim bahi tiŋ maa tiŋgbani zaa zuɣu.
en: The fighting continued all day long. Abimelech captured the city, killed its people, tore it down, and covered the ground with salt.

dag: A yi ni tooi garigi ma, nyin garigim ma; malimi a yɛtɔɣa shili n-zani n tooni.
en: Listen to me and answer if you can. Get your arguments ready to face me.

dag: o yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka bi niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka bi zaŋdi o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tuma ni, ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli m-maani niriba bɛn zabi yɛtɔɣa.
en: He doesn't lend money for profit. He refuses to do evil and gives an honest decision in any dispute.

dag: Amaa dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam, ka dabiɛm maa tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Dama man Naawuni ni to n-wurim ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba. Bɛ ni di vi, dama man Naawuni zaɣisi ba.
en: But then they will become terrified, as they have never been before, for God will scatter the bones of the enemies of his people. God has rejected them, and so Israel will totally defeat them.

dag: Dama yi mi ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika ni nyɛ shɛm: O daa nyɛla bundana, amaa yi zuɣu ka o leei nandana ni yi leei bundaannima o nandaantali maa zuɣu.
en: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.

dag: Obadia daa nyɛla Shɛmaya bia, ka Shɛmaya nyɛ Galal bia, ka Galal nyɛ Jɛdutun bia, ka Jɛdutun nyɛ Bɛrɛkia bia, ka Bɛrɛkia nyɛ Asa bia, ka Asa nyɛ Ɛlikana ŋun daa ʒi Nɛtɔfanim tiŋkpaŋ la bia.
en: Obadiah was Shemaiahs son. Shemaiah was Galals son. Galal was Jeduthuns son. Berekiah was Asas son. Asa was Elkanahs son. Berekiah lived in the small towns near the people of Netophah.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: Later they brought together the leaders of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyo a yiya buɣim, ka kar a saria paɣiba pam ninni. N ni chɛ ka a ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka a gba ku lan ti so pina.
en: They will burn your house. They will punish you so that all the other women can see. I will stop you from living like a prostitute. I will stop you from paying money to your lovers.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi Pita. Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla.
en: Then the Lord turned and looked into Peters eyes. And Peter remembered what the Lord had said, Before the rooster crows in the morning, you will say three times that you dont know me.

dag: N ku chɛn ya, n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm saha shɛli yi ni tum din chihiri shɛli maa ni na be yi kɔbili ni maa. Di saha yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun darigiri niriba tibili.
en: I will not spare you or show you any mercy. I am going to punish you for the disgusting things you have done, so that you will know that I am the Lord and that I am the one who punishes you.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni ti kum ka fabili. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun pirig o zaɣim ka ʒi tiŋa.
en: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti kpalim ka zuliya pam gili ba ni ti bemi kaman gbuɣinli m-be mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri san la. Bɛ ni ti bemi kaman gbuɣin polli n-yi piɛri zuɣu n-tim bɛ ni n-no ba sɔŋ ka dari tɔhi ba, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi la.
en: Then the few remaining in Jacob will be among the nations, amid many peoples, like a lion among the creatures of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which when it passes by, tramples and tears to pieces with no one to deliver.

dag: O ni daa suhiri Naawuni maa, ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ti taɣi, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became shining white.

dag: Daadam, a bela duŋtaariba sunsuuni, bɛn mali nina din ni nya, amaa ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba din ni wum, amaa ka bi wumda, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Mortal man, he said, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but they see nothing; they have ears, but they hear nothing, because they are rebellious.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini ba lo alikauli bee n-lo bɛ buɣa la alikauli.
en: Do not make any agreement with them or with their gods.

dag: Dama ŋun be nam ʒiishee maa sunsuuni ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ gula, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yɛn zaŋdi ba tahiri nyɛvili kɔbilisirim shee. Ka Naawuni ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi.
en: because the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them. He will lead them to the springs of life-giving water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni ti wɔɣa, ka di nyoli chaŋ ti be sagbana ni, ka di ni mali karimbaani maa zuɣu.
en: King of Egypt, now listen to what I, the Lord God, am saying about that tree: The tree grew so tall that it reached the sky and became very proud and arrogant.

dag: Di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni, amaa yihim ti zaɣ biɛɣu ni. Dama nyini n-su nam mini yiko ni jilima hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami.
en: And dont lead us into temptation, but rescue us from the evil one.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul wuhi shihira pam niriba maa sani maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: Even though he had performed all these miracles in their presence, they did not believe in him.

dag: N tum din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi. Di chɛ ma ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ma.
en: I have done what is right and good; don't abandon me to my enemies!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka bɔ n-lee bala.
en: They were all surprised and bewildered. Some asked each other, What does this mean.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni ti zaŋmi yɛda niŋbu maa saɣim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Ti lee ʒiɛla di nyaaŋa.
en: Do we then cancel the Law through this faith? Absolutely not! Instead, we confirm the Law.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka shiri zaŋ Keenannim maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni; ka bɛ daa ku ba ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Hɔrima.
en: The Lord listened to the Israelites and helped them defeat the Canaanites. They completely destroyed the Canaanites and their cities. So that place was named Hormah.

dag: Bɛ daa bela nimaani kaman yuun pia, ka Malɔn mini Kiliɔn gba daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi ka o kpalim o kɔŋko ka lan ka yidana bee bihi.
en: Mahlon and Chilion also died. Now Naomi had no husband or sons.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛman ni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yɛri din viɛli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la m-mali binnana din chihira ka nyɛ n ni je binshɛŋa la. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka di leei binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: They used their beautiful jewelry and made an idol. They were proud of that statue. They made their terrible statues. They made those filthy things, so I will throw them away like a dirty rag.

dag: O zaŋ o lɔɣu ni piɛm to n suhu.
en: straight through my heart.

dag: Binnɛma zaa niŋgbuŋ bela kɔŋkɔbakɔŋkɔba: Ninsalinim niŋgbuŋ bela di ko, ka biŋkɔbiri niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka noonsi niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka zahim niŋgbuŋ mi be di ko.
en: All flesh isnt alike. Humans have one kind of flesh, animals have another kind of flesh, birds have another kind of flesh, and fish have another kind.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa tuhi tɔbu shɛm ni o ni daa di nam shɛm zaa yɛla sab niŋ Izraɛl nanim Litaafi ni.
en: The rest of what King Jeroboam did is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel . It includes the wars he fought and the way he ruled.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ saawaralana n-nya o ka wum o yɛligu? Ŋuni n-lee wum o yɛligu ka nyɛ ŋun ni tooi mol li?.
en: But I, the Lord , tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.

dag: Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn ba la daa bela Gibiɔn, ka o paɣa yuli daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel, Gibeons father, lived in Gibeon. His wifes name was Maacah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la yi taali ni.
en: There is no condemnation now for those who live in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Hilikia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Anatɔt la maligumaaniba ni yino la bia Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the words of Jeremiah, Hilkiahs son, who was one of the priests from Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

dag: O ni tooi sɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari zahimbu pumpɔŋɔ, dama omaŋmaŋ daa nya zahimbu ka di wahala.
en: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya ni suhudoo. Yawɛ nuu pa yi zuɣu yi chandi maa ni.
en: The priest replied to them, Go in peace. The LORD is watching over you on this trip youve taken.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa kuli Nabal sani nti nya ka o puhirila chuɣu o yiŋa, ka di ŋmanila naa m-puhiri chuɣu. Ka ŋun Nabal daa kul mali suhupiɛlli, dama o daa nyula dam buɣi. Ka o paɣ maa daa bi yɛl o shɛli dindali maa hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Abigail went back to Nabal, who was at home having a feast fit for a king. He was drunk and in a good mood, so she did not tell him anything until the next morning.

dag: Yɛm yɛla nyɛla din kpɛm pam ŋun ka yɛm sani. O yi be dunɔdali shee o bi yaar o noli.
en: Wisdom is beyond foolish people. They dont open their mouths in the gate.

dag: Nyamya, n ni tim anabi Ilaija yi sanna pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm maa dali naanyi paai.
en: But before the great and terrible day of the Lord comes, I will send you the prophet Elijah.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o kpe salo maa ni, amaa ka nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba daa bi saɣi.
en: Paul wanted to go in and talk to the people, but the Lords followers did not let him go.

dag: bomiya kom na ti ti kɔnyuri ni mali shɛba. Yinim Tɛma tiŋgbɔŋnima, bomiya bindira ti kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba.
en: meet the thirsty with water; inhabitants of the land of Tema greet the refugees with bread.

dag: Nyamiya, m bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo mini doo maa mam m-bɔŋɔ; chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na pumpɔŋɔ; ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm, amaa di tumiya doo ŋɔ ŋun vi tuun shɛli.
en: Look! Here is his concubine and my own virgin daughter. I'll bring them out now, and you can have them. Do whatever you want to with them. But don't do such an awful thing to this man.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ mini yaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun mali yaa tɔbu ni maa.
en: Who is this great king? He is the Lord , strong and mighty, the Lord , victorious in battle.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, bidibiga ka a dɔɣi maa. Ka o bi garigi shɛli.
en: As she was about to die, the women standing by helping her said, Dont be afraid. Youve given birth to a son! But she didnt answer or pay them any attention.

dag: A bemi kaman tampiŋ la ka n sɔɣir a sani. Nyini n-nyɛ m birini din mali kpiɔŋ ni a tiligi ma; dama nyini n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini.
en: Be my Rock, my place of safety. Be my fortress, and protect me! You are my Rock and my protection.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa va nti bɔb gbaag o ba n-kumdi ka mɔɣisir o kpariŋ.
en: Joseph threw himself on his father, crying and kissing his face.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba tahi naa sanna.
en: Nebuchadnezzar became very angry. He called for Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. So they were brought to him.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni nya yi daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I write to you, dear children, because your sins are forgiven through Christ.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛdom naa daa lab ŋme n-deei Ɛlat n-ti Ɛdomnima, ka daa kari Judanim yihi Ɛlat maa; ka Ɛdomnim maa daa kana ti be Ɛlat hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: At that time King Rezin of Aram took back Elath for Aram. Rezin took all the people of Judah who were living in Elath. The Arameans settled in Elath, and they still live there today.

dag: Ka shi so daa gari n ninni baalim, ka n niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri yirigi.
en: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.

dag: Ibram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihiniinaayɔbu saha shɛli Haga ni daa dɔɣi Ishimail ti o maa.
en: Abram was eighty-six years old at the time.

dag: Bɛ daa kpahi ŋmɛnditoya ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu; yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo.
en: Two criminals were nailed to crosses beside Jesus—one on the right and the other on the left.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-pa chɛrubinima ayi maa luɣilikam zaa zuɣu.
en: The two winged creatures were covered with gold.

dag: Bin yini ka n suhiri Yawɛ sani, ka n suhu kul ye di zuɣu: dina n-nyɛ ni m be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga, ka n nya Yawɛ viɛlim, ka jɛmd o o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: I have asked one thing from the LORD— its all I seek: to live in the LORDs house all the days of my life, seeing the LORDs beauty and constantly adoring his temple.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka o yi n-chaŋ ti zani ka yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi ka taali. Mani n-daa lo nia biɛɣu n-ku n dana, amaa ka ŋun mi n-lee ku bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: In the morning he went out to the gate and said to the people who were there, I was the one who plotted against King Joram and killed him; you are not responsible for that. But who killed all these?.

dag: Ka nira yi vuɣi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee, di nyaaŋa bɛ biɛhigu shee maa ni zaɣisi ba ka yɛli, Man na ʒi n-nyan ya.
en: If its uprooted from its place, it lies, saying, I cant see you.

dag: Naawuni mi daa bi ŋmaai di tiŋgbɔŋ maa hal napɔŋ yaabu yim zuɣu ti o, amaa ka daa lee lo alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o, ka o yaansi ti di di fali o kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa na ka bia gba.
en: God didnt give him an inheritance here, not even a square foot of land. However, God did promise to give the land as his possession to him and to his descendants, even though Abraham had no child.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also offer male goat. This must be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul gbaai nyuubu zaŋ hal ti paai gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali, ka zoya zuɣusaa daa nyili.
en: The water kept going down, and the mountain tops could be seen on the first day of the tenth month.

dag: Aai, yɛligu maa kul bela yi sani, di bela yi noya ni mini yi suhuri ni ni yi dol li.
en: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!.

dag: Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔ yɛla ka man Dauda lee lan yɛn yɛl a yaha? Dama a mi man a dabili Dauda.
en: What more can David say to you? You know your servant, LORD God.

dag: Sool ni daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ yɛlli maa ni nyɛ shɛm, Yawɛ daa bi garig o zahindi puuni bee Urim puuni bee n-chɛ ka anab so yɛl o shɛli.
en: and so he asked the Lord what to do. But the Lord did not answer him at all, either by dreams or by the use of Urim and Thummim or by prophets.

dag: Ka Pool daa be yil shɛl ni o ni daa haayi duu la yuun muna ayi. Ka o daa kul tiri sokam bɛn kan o sanna soli ka bɛ nyar o.
en: Paul lived in his own rented quarters for two full years and welcomed everyone who came to see him.

dag: ka nyɛ Keenannim ni daa su tiŋgban shɛl la zaa mini Miara din nyɛ Sidɔnnim ni daa su luɣ shɛl la zaŋ ti paai Afɛk ni zaŋ hal ti paai Amɔrinim tintariga la.
en: who live south of the Canaanite land. And you must still go north to take Mearah, which the Sidonians control. From there you must still go as far as Aphek on the Amorite border.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama a niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli pam.
en: Then I will sing to the Lord because he was so good to me.

dag: Ka zoya daa sɔhigi nyin Yawɛ tooni, nyin ŋun daa yi zahira Sinai Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ, nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni tooni ka di daa sɔhigi maa.
en: rain poured from the sky, the earth trembled, and mountains shook.

dag: Piɛguliba ni ti zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu kana ti lu o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ti bɛ suɣa gil o. Bɛ ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam mɔri.
en: Enemy shepherds will surround you with all their flocks. They will set up their tents all around you, and each one will let his sheep eat the grass.

dag: Naawuni, wuhimi n ni ka taali shɛm, ka zabi n zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri sani, ka fa ma ʒiŋmariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu soli nuu ni bahi.
en: Establish justice for me, God! Argue my case against ungodly people! Rescue me from the dishonest and unjust!.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zuri bɛ tab nyaaŋa mini bɛn fari tuumbiɛtumdiba bahira saria karibu ni ni bɛn ŋmari ʒiri m-mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli la.
en: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o, o niriba zaa sani.
en: In the assembly of all his people I will give him what I have promised.

dag: Amaa yi yi gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum o yɛligu ka niŋ n ni yɛli ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dindina n ni zaŋ yi dimnim leei n dimnima, ka tuhi bɛn tuhiri ya.
en: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka chɛ a daba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ taali ka deei bɛ suhigu; ka wuhi ba di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so viɛl shɛli; ka chɛ ka saa mi a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti a niriba maa ka bɛ di li fali ŋɔ ni.
en: So please listen in heaven to their prayer. Then forgive us for our sins. Teach the people to live right. Then, Lord, please send rain to the land you gave them.

dag: Ka m mi nya ka o bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum; amaa omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ni o bɔri ni o zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani zuɣu ka n gba lɔri nia ni n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tah o sani.
en: But I could not find that he had done anything for which he deserved the death sentence. And since he himself made an appeal to the Emperor, I have decided to send him.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa paɣir o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ.
en: With all my heart I praise the Lord , and with all that I am I praise his holy name!.

dag: O wuhi ma yili palli, di nyɛla yil shɛli din nyɛ ti Naawuni paɣibu yilli. Niriba pam ni nya ka lu Yawɛ sizuura, ka niŋ o naani.
en: He taught me to sing a new song, a song of praise to our God. Many who see this will take warning and will put their trust in the Lord .

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋbu saha? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: Tell us when these things will happen. And what will show us it is time for them to happen.

dag: Ka Hamat din mini Hadirak di tintarisi la gba nyɛla o ni su shɛli zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn hal bɛ ni mali baŋsim la zaa yoli.
en: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.

dag: Yawɛ, n wum a yuli ni du shɛm yɛla. Yawɛ, ka a tuma chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Tummi li ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yaha, ka chɛ ka ti baŋ li ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni; a suhuyiɣisili saha, teemi nambɔzɔbo yɛla.
en: O Lord , I have heard of what you have done, and I am filled with awe. Now do again in our times the great deeds you used to do. Be merciful, even when you are angry.

dag: Ifriimnim ŋmanila ŋmani. Bɛ jɛrigiya zaa, ka ka yɛm. Bɛ boonila Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba, ka lan booni Asirianim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba.
en: Israel flits around like a silly pigeon; first her people call on Egypt for help, and then they run to Assyria!.

dag: Di simdi ka yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you.

dag: Dama o ni ti ti sokam o tuma ni simdi shɛli:.
en: God will repay everyone based on their works .

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyamiya, n yoola dunoli n-tin ya, ka so ku tooi daa li yo. M mi ni yi yiko bi yaɣ lala, amaa di zaa yoli yi kul gbibi n yɛligu ka bi chihi n yuli.
en: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri yi nyɛla din wuhiri ni Naawuni niŋdi din tuhi, dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni yi darigi ti tibili o bi niŋ din tuhi? Ninsal tɛha yɛtɔɣa ka n tɔɣisi maa.
en: But what if our doing wrong serves to show up more clearly God's doing right? Can we say that God does wrong when he punishes us?.

dag: O ni daa pii ninvuɣ pinaayi shɛb maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa pa so yupaa Pita la.
en: These are the twelve he chose: Simon ;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zali saha shɛl o ni yɛn niŋ li maa ka yɛli, Biɛɣuni ka man Yawɛ sa yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: I, the Lord , have set tomorrow as the time when I will do this.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi Sarid n-zaŋ kpa di wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Chisilɔtabo n-zaŋ gari hal ni Dabɛrat n-chaŋ hal ti paai Jafia.
en: It reversed from Sarid eastward toward the east to the border of Chisloth-tabor. It went to Daberath and then up to Japhia.

dag: Ka Asa daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Asa died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City, and his son Jehoshaphat succeeded him as king.

dag: Di saha n ni tooi nya garigibu din ni garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi la, dama n niŋ a yɛligu naani.
en: Then I will have an answer for those who make fun of me for trusting what you say.

dag: dabisi shɛli din kanna ni di ti di Filistianim zaa ka mɔŋ Taainim mini Sidɔnnim sɔŋsim shɛŋa din kpalim la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ yɛn kula Filistianim bɛn kpalim be Kriit teeku duli la.
en: Because the time is coming for the Philistines destruction, for cutting off from Tyre and Sidon anyone who might try to save Gaza, because the LORD will destroy the Philistines, the few left from the island of Caphtor.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bimparilan shɛli din pari gbɛɣu zuɣu ka di nyɛ din be kasi, ka sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni mali nintu shɛli dalinli dihiri tabindi binyara zuɣu la. Sabbu maa n-daa nyɛ: O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Then they made a strip of pure gold for the holy crown. They carved these words into the gold like the writing on a seal: holy to the lord .

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan gbaai niriba maa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ neesim; ka ŋunkam doli ma ku be zibisim ni, amaa o ni malila nyɛvili neesim.
en: Later, Jesus talked to the people again. He said, I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never live in darkness. They will have the light that gives life.

dag: Jɛrigu yi ŋahi ŋahili, di ŋmanila nir ni nyu dam kuli ka bɔri ni o ŋooi goo o nuu ni la.
en: A fool quoting a wise saying reminds you of a drunk trying to pick a thorn out of his hand.

dag: Ka Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm tuma maa zaa min o ni daa me yil shɛl la.
en: The queen of Sheba saw that Solomon was very wise. She also saw the beautiful palace he had built.

dag: Yi bipuɣinsi yi gɔri pagɔrisigu, m bi yɛn darigi bɛ tibili bee n-darigi yi bihi paɣiba tibili bɛ yi niŋ zina. Dama yi dɔbba maŋmaŋ gba chana ka bɛ mini buɣa ni pagɔra ti doona kaman buɣa maligu la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛm bahi yoli.
en: Yet I will not punish them for this, because you yourselves go off with temple prostitutes, and together with them you offer pagan sacrifices. As the proverb says, A people without sense will be ruined.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla galimi n-yo ma yurilim samli, amaa ka man suhiri Naawuni tiri ba.
en: They oppose me, even though I love them and have prayed for them.

dag: Ka o dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni. Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Immediately the paralyzed man stood up. He picked up his mat and walked out of the room. Everyone could see him. They were amazed and praised God. They said, This is the most amazing thing we have ever seen.

dag: Ka Pita ŋun daa kpalim ʒe samban dunol ni. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol so maa daa yi nti suhi soli yili maa ni bipuɣin so ŋun daa guli dunoli la sani n-zaŋ Pita kpe.
en: However, Peter stood outside near the gate. Then the other disciple came out and spoke to the woman stationed at the gate, and she brought Peter in.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli pal shɛli din yuli booni Dɛde la nti bɔhi ka bɛ wuh a Judas yiŋa, ka a bɔhi Sool ŋun nyɛ Taasus nir la yɛla. Nyama, o be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: The Lord said to him, Get up and go to the street called Straight Street. Find the house of Judas and ask for a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. He is there now, praying.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mani m-bɔŋɔ; di pun sabi n yɛla Kundi ni.
en: So I said, Here I am, ready to do what was written about me in the book.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri. O nyɛla ŋun zaŋ ʒiri ni o tum faranim barina, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka nandaamba kɔŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: They use evil like a tool and plan ways to steal from the poor. They tell lies about the poor and keep them from being judged fairly.

dag: Bɛ ni so ti ku lan wuh o kpee bee n-yɛl o kpee, Baŋmi Yawɛ. Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ zaa ni ti baŋ ma, bibihi zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa. Dama n ni kpihim bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: None of them will have to teach a neighbor to know the Lord , because all will know me, from the least to the greatest. I will forgive their sins and I will no longer remember their wrongs. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di niŋ zina, a nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zina? Nyin ŋun je buɣa, a nyɛla ŋun zuri buɣa jɛmbu duu nɛma?.
en: If you say, No adultery, do you commit adultery? If you hate idols, do you rob temples?.

dag: Yisa daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba biɛɣukam, amaa ka daa lee duri Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu ti gbɛri yuŋ kam.
en: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, but he spent each night on the Mount of Olives.

dag: Wula ka nir lee yɛn garigi yɛli Filistianim tuumba? Yawɛ m-me Ziɔn zali, ka o niriba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ni nya biɛhigu shee nimaani.
en: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.

dag: Bɛ daa yi ŋmɛrila mɔɣilɔnim jɛmd a, amaa pumpɔŋɔ nyini m-be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ŋɔ. Binneen yiɣira bɛn ŋmani zunzuya n-nyɛ a bindoo, ka zunzuya nyɛ a chinchini ka a zaŋ pili.
en: Your majesty has been brought down to the underworld, along with the sound of your harps. Under you is a bed of maggots, and worms are your blanket.

dag: chaŋ Hiburɔn ti zaŋ li ti Naa Dauda ka yɛl o, Naa, a dim Sool ŋun daa kul dol a ni o ku a la bia Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ m-bɔhi Sool min o bihi biɛri n-ti n dan naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ maa.
en: When they arrived at Hebron, they gave Ish Bosheths head to David. Recab and Baanah said to King David, Here is the head of your enemy, Ish Bosheth son of Saul. He tried to kill you, but the Lord has punished Saul and his family for you today.

dag: Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ tim ninsal kam laara o wuntitali min o ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka man lee bi saɣi teegi n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi nyin ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: Remember: The LORD rewards every person for their righteousness and loyalty, and I wasnt willing to lift a hand against the LORDs anointed, even though the LORD handed you over to me today.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: Those who try to keep the life they have will lose it. But those who give up their life for me will find true life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka Aduna kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee fiɛb taŋkpaɣu, ka pɔri daa yi n-lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zuɣu, taŋkpaɣu maa zaa daa leela pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: They did this. Aaron raised the stick in his hand and hit the dust on the ground, and everywhere in Egypt the dust became lice. The lice got on the animals and the people.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb sani maa, luɣ shɛlikam zaa bɛ ni daa be, bɛ daa saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛri ba, Yawɛ niriba m-bɔŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ yi o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli buŋ maa, A ni dihi ma vi zuɣu. N yi di gbibi takɔbi n nuu ni, n naan ku a pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Balaam answered the donkey, You have made me look foolish. If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni me wuni bee n-kpe binnani zali ka di pa din mal o buchi?.
en: It does no good to make a metal image to worship as a god!.

dag: Amaa nyin yihirila Naawuni zɔbo a kɔbili ni. Ka guri Naawuni jɛmbo soli.
en: If you had your way, no one would fear God; no one would pray to him.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla bɛ ni zɔri so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni, o nyɛla ŋun galisi ni ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm gari bɛnkam zaa gil o.
en: God is respected in the council of the holy ones; God is awesome and revered more than all those around him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ chinchin ʒee pil li, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They will spread on them a red cloth, cover it with fine leather, and set its poles in place.

dag: Ti Naawuni daalibarika nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Shɛrɛbia ŋun yi Mahili ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi bia ni Izraɛl yaaŋa zuliya ni na la ti ti. O min o dɔɣiriba ni o bidibisi kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Because God was with us, they sent Sherebiah, a skilled man from the descendants of Mahli They also sent his sons and brothers, men in all.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Ɛbɛl kubu zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria kubu saha, bɛ ni daa ku so Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la, Naawuni shiri ni ti zaŋ di taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba!.
en: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.

dag: Ka ti daa ti nya ti nyaandolitab nimaani, ka bɛ yɛli ti ni ti kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayopɔin. Ka ti daa ti yi nimaani chani Rom.
en: There we found brothers and sisters who urged us to stay with them for a week. In this way we came to Rome.

dag: Pa a Naawuni zɔbo zuɣu n-chɛ ka a niŋ o naani? Pa a nimmaŋtali zuɣu n-chɛ ka a mali tahima?.
en: You worshiped God, and your life was blameless; and so you should have confidence and hope.

dag: A yi chana, di ni wuh a soli, a yi gbihira, di ni gul a, a yi ti neei, di ni dir a alizama.
en: Let this teaching lead you wherever you go. It will watch over you while you sleep. And when you wake up, it will give you good advice.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli pam daa be Jɛrusalɛm; dama Naa Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman nyaaŋa, bɛ daa bi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu maa tatabo Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: There was great joy in Jerusalem. Nothing like this had taken place in Jerusalem since the days of Israels King Solomon, Davids son.

dag: Ka yi ni daa galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ la, yi kalinli ni ti kpalimla biɛla yi ni bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nol la zuɣu.
en: You might have as many people as the stars in the sky. But only a few of you will be left, because you did not listen to the Lord your God.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi sani, din kariya, ka n chɛ Yawɛ suhi tin ya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. N ni wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli ka tuhi.
en: I would be disobeying the Lord if I stopped praying for you! I will always teach you how to live right.

dag: Tummiya yi dabitali tuma ni suhupiɛlli ka di be kaman yi tumdi li tirila ti Duuma la, ka pa ni ninsalinima;.
en: Serve your owners enthusiastically, as though you were serving the Lord and not human beings.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti lab bɛ yilikpɛrili na ka bɛ bɔh o yɛtɔɣ yini maa gbinni yaha.
en: When Jesus and his disciples were back in the house, they asked him about what he had said.

dag: Ŋunkam nini nya ma ku lan nya ma yaha. A nina kul yɛn lihiri ma mi, ka n chaŋ.
en: You see me now, but never again. If you look for me, I'll be gone.

dag: Ɛfa ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Haran mini Mɔza ni Gazɛz, ka Haran daa nyɛ Gazɛz ba.
en: Calebs slave woman was named Ephah. Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was Gazezs father.

dag: Amaa ka Pita na kul ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara, ka bɛ daa kana ti yooi dunoli maa nya o, ka di gari ba pam.
en: But Peter continued to knock. When the believers opened the door, they saw him. They were amazed.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa ŋmanila buɣim diri zoli maa zuɣu Izraɛlnim sani.
en: The Israelites could see the Glory of the Lord . It was like a fire burning on top of the mountain.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ ni be kaman gbuɣinli la n-gbaai ma vu n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli ŋun ni fa ma bahi ni kani nti dari tɔhitɔhi ma.
en: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.

dag: Nɛbo daŋ ni: Jɛiɛl mini Matitia ni Zabad so yaha ni Zɛbina ni Jadai ni Joɛl ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.

dag: Yawɛ galim Judanima. O ni darigi Yaakubu tibili ka di dol o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yo o o tuma samli.
en: The Lord has an accusation to bring against the people of Judah; he is also going to punish Israel for the way her people act. He will pay them back for what they have done.

dag: N ni tum jɛrilim zuɣu chɛ ka n dansi maa yuma niŋla yu biɛri, ka nyo pam.
en: My wounds reek; they are all infected because of my stupidity.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe pam pali dunia hal ka zoya din du pam zaa ti lim.
en: The waters rose even higher over the earth; they covered all of the highest mountains under the sky.

dag: dindina a ni lan nya suhupiɛlli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, ka kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi ŋun Naawuni.
en: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.

dag: M mabihi, teemiya yi ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛba ka Naawuni boli ya la yɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛla polo, yi ni pam daa pala yɛnnima bee yikolaannima bee nam zuliyanima.
en: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa yihi Izraɛlnim zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gbilligbilli.
en: On that same day the Lord led all the Israelites out of the country of Egypt. The people left in groups.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba zaa daa mali suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ tiŋ maa daa maai bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku Atalia nayili puuni maa nyaaŋa.
en: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was at peace now that Athaliah had been executed at the palace.

dag: Ka Rabishake daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia ni Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la bɔhiya, Bɔ ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni mini bɛn doli nyaaŋa zaa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: Some of them were walking ahead of Jesus. Others were walking behind him. Everyone shouted, Praise Him! Welcome! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Psalm :-.

dag: Ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Ʒimiy o ka n sanna ka n ti nya o.
en: Sir, you told us to bring him here, so that you could see him.

dag: Ti bi zaŋ binshɛli sɔŋ gu so soli ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka so ku tooi nya ti taali ti tuma puuni.
en: We do not want anyone to find fault with our work, so we try not to put obstacles in anyone's way.

dag: O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni. Teemiya o ni daa na be Galili ka yɛli ya.
en: He isnt here, but has been raised. Remember what he told you while he was still in Galilee.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, di kuhiriya n zuɣu, amaa kuhimiyala yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: But Jesus turned and said to the women, Women of Jerusalem, dont cry for me. Cry for yourselves and for your children too.

dag: Ka Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta daa lan chaŋ ti teei dɔni naa naba ni n-kuhiri ka suhir o ni o yiɣisim Haman ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la.
en: Then Esther spoke to the king again. She fell at the kings feet and began crying. She begged the king to cancel the evil plan of Haman the Agagite. Haman had thought up the plan to hurt the Jews.

dag: n-yɛli, Yi ma daa ŋmanila gbuɣinnyaŋ gahindili gbuɣima sunsuuni. O daa dola gbuɣim pola sunsuuni n-wumisir o bihi.
en: Your mother is like a female lion, lying there with the male lions. She went to lie down with the young male lions and had many babies.

dag: Di yi kpe n-gari kpe m-be kaman munaafichilana a niriba sunsuuni, ka miri ka a yi n-zani a kpee nyɛvili yihibu zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.

dag: ni Kain ni Gibia ni Timna: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pia m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah. In all, there were ten towns and all the fields around them.

dag: N dihi dimbɔŋɔ tabili, dinzuɣu m mi ni n na ni be. M mini ya zaa na ni be ka n sɔŋ chɛ ka yi tooni chandi mini yi suhupiɛlli zooi pahi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni.
en: Im sure of this: I will stay alive and remain with all of you to help your progress and the joy of your faith.

dag: A yi ti chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu, bɛn suɣa be wulimpuhili polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi.
en: When short blasts are sounded, the tribes camped on the east will move out.

dag: amaa di yi ti bilina, di zoorimi gari tutuɣ kam n-niŋ wul kara hal ka noonsi ni tooi te bɛ tɛri di wula maa zuɣu.
en: After a while it grows up and becomes the biggest of all plants. It puts out such large branches that the birds come and make their nests in its shade.

dag: Absalom daa zaŋla Amasa leeg o tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani. Amasa daa nyɛla do so ŋun yuli booni Itira, ka o nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la dapala. Itira maa daa kpuɣila Jɔab ma Zɛruya tizo Abigeel Nahash bipuɣiŋga.
en: Absalom put Amasa in Joab's place as commander of the army. Amasa's father was Ithra from the family of Ishmael, and his mother was Abigal, the daughter of Nahash and the sister of Joab's mother Zeruiah.

dag: Nyini n-shiri nyɛ n tampiŋ mini m birini; a yuli zuɣu, be n tooni, ka wuhiri ma.
en: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.

dag: A ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be a biɛhigu shee mal alibarika! Ti nini ni tiɣi a jɛmbu du kasi maa puuni bin suma.
en: Happy are those whom you choose, whom you bring to live in your sanctuary. We shall be satisfied with the good things of your house, the blessings of your sacred Temple.

dag: UFARISIN gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni pirigi a nam maa n-ti Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianima.
en: divisions, your kingdom is divided up and given to the Medes and Persians.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn namla zuɣusaa zaɣ palli mini dunia palli, ka so ku lan teei binshɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla.
en: Look! Im creating a new heaven and a new earth: past events wont be remembered; they wont come to mind.

dag: N naan shiri yiɣi chaŋ katiŋa nti be mɔɣu ni.
en: I would go far into the desert and stay there. Selah.

dag: Buɣim niɛm mokpala n-yir o noli ni na n-tahiri yiɣiri ka buɣim yirina.
en: Shafts of fire shoot from his mouth; like fiery sparks they fly out.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daba ayopɔin tum Aduna min o bidibisi maligumaaniba leebu tuma kaman n ni zal a shɛm maa.
en: Perform the rites of ordination for Aaron and his sons for seven days exactly as I have commanded you.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni.
en: Jairus, one of the synagogue leaders, came forward. When he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.

dag: Yi ni nya kpahimbu shɛŋa pam la zaa kpalimla yoli? Di yi shiri nyɛla yoli, m bɔri ni m baŋ.
en: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan kuhi yɛli, Haliluya! Tin titali maa buɣim dibu nyɔhi kul ni tuɣiri hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the crowd shouted, Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.

dag: dama yi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ pala din tiri Yisa nyaandoliba din simdi ba kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla din chɛ ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu pam di zuɣu.
en: For this service you perform not only meets the needs of God's people, but also produces an outpouring of gratitude to God.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka paɣ maa nyu Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mini bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba Yisa dolibu zuɣu la ʒim n-kuli. N ni daa nya o lala maa, ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: And I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God's people and the blood of those who were killed because they had been loyal to Jesus. When I saw her, I was completely amazed.

dag: Naawuni daazichi min o yɛm ni o baŋsim galisiya pam! Naawuni ni maani yɛla shɛm to ni baŋbu, ka o soya yɛla gariti sokam!.
en: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn kul deeri yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi.
en: But you are trusting lies that are worthless.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan kari niriba maa tin ya. Bɛ ni leei yi dimnima; ka bɛ wuna leei zana gbahi ya.
en: So I tell you now that I will not drive these people out as you advance. They will be your enemies, and you will be trapped by the worship of their gods.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi n nini ka chɛ ba ka bɛ ta n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ daɣiri. Ŋmɛnditoya ni ti kpe di ni nti ta li daɣiri.
en: When I hide my face from my people, foreigners will defile my treasured place. Violent intruders will invade it; they will defile it!.

dag: Dama ti yi daa nyɛ Naawuni dimnima, amaa ka simdi yipa kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni o Bia la kum zuɣu, dindina din gari lala nyɛla, simdi ni kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ maa zuɣu, ti ni tilig o bia maa nyɛvili zuɣu.
en: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piripiri dunɔgulibo tuma maa Kɔra daŋ niriba mini Mɛrari daŋ niriba maa sunsuuni shɛm m-bala.
en: These were the groups of the gatekeepers from the families of Korah and Merari.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi yaag o noli? Dabiɛm n kul be o nyina ni ti gili.
en: Who can make him open his jaws, ringed with those terrifying teeth?.

dag: Tiligim ma n daalahichi zaa ni, ka di chɛ ka jɛra mali ma ansarisi.
en: Deliver me from all my sins; dont make me some foolish persons joke.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa ka a sanna suhuri paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Yawɛ galisiya.
en: Our Lord , let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, The Lord is wonderful.

dag: Duumanima, yi gba niŋmiya yi daba lala, ka chɛ ba dabiɛm kpɛhibu, dama yi mi ni yi mini ba zaa Duuma be alizanda ni, ka o mi bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: As for masters, treat your slaves in the same way. Stop threatening them, because you know that both you and your slaves have a master in heaven. He doesnt distinguish between people on the basis of status.

dag: Naawuni n-daa kahigi wuhi ma ni n chaŋ. Ka n daa ti kahigi n ni yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu tiri bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛm yɛla n-yɛli cheechi zuɣulaannim la ashilɔni, dama n daa bi bɔri ni n ni daa pun tum shɛm mini n ni na kul tumdi shɛm kpalim yoli.
en: I went because God revealed to me that I should go. In a private meeting with the leaders I explained the gospel message that I preach to the Gentiles. I did not want my work in the past or in the present to be a failure.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ baɣisi mini zinaniŋdiba ni pagɔra bihi ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na.
en: Come here, you children of witches. Your father committed adultery, and your mother was unfaithful.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o yila nimaani n-kpe fɔntin shɛli ni, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa ni bo gabisi yina nti vo tiŋ maa ti bahi zolɔŋni hal ka nir ti ku lan nya di kuɣibil nimaani gba.
en: But if David escapes into a city, all the Israelites can bring ropes to that city and pull its walls down into the valley. Not even a small stone will be left in that city.

dag: Miriya ka yi chaŋ hal ka yi naba ti fuɣi bee n-chɛ ka kɔnyuri kuui yi lɔna. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti bɔrila saamba, saamba ka ti kul ni jɛmda.
en: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. Stop! I shouted, but you replied, No! I love those gods too much.

dag: Jɔab n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya la mi daa su Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim fukumsi.
en: Joab was the commander of Israel's entire army. Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was in command of David's bodyguard.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim maa ni maani a ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; ka jɛra gba ʒiɛm a yuli.
en: But remember, O Lord , that your enemies laugh at you, that they are godless and despise you.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa.
en: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu ka zuliya kam kul jiɣindi biɛɣukam, amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ mi ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Your Father in heaven knows that you need all these things.

dag: Amaa saŋkpambil maa yi kul kpalim bela luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi, di nyɛla bintɔrili maa wuliɛɣu m-bala, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if it remains unchanged and does not spread, it is only the scar left from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce you ritually clean.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ zuɣuri chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi pɔbi bɛ noya.
en: The leaders of the people stopped talking and put their hands over their mouths.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa lab ti yɛli Naawuni daanab maa. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ kpam maa kɔhi n-yo yi samli maa, ka chɛ din kpalim ka a min a bidibisi maa dira.
en: When she told the man of God what had happened, Elisha said to her, Go, sell the oil and pay your debt. You and your sons can live on the money that is left.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ti bela yi nuu ni; niŋmiya ti yi ni nya ka di simdi ni yi niŋ ti shɛm.
en: Now we are in your power; do with us what you think is right.

dag: Inok ŋun daa nyɛ ʒiɛmani din pah ayopɔin din daa doli Adam saha nyaaŋa la nir la daa pun tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba ŋɔ polo. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya! Ti Duuma min o malaikanim tusatusa shɛm bɛn be kasi kanna.
en: Enoch, who lived seven generations after Adam, prophesied about these people when he said, See, the Lord comes with his countless holy ones.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaŋ do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa tahi Farisiinim sani.
en: Then they led the man who had been born blind to the Pharisees.

dag: M bia, di kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, ka di chɛ ka a wum wuhibu.
en: My child, when you stop learning, you will soon neglect what you already know.

dag: Tab jɛlinsi nyɛla din tahiri zabili na, amaa yurilim limsiri taali balibu kam.
en: Hatred causes arguments, but love overlooks all wrongs.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: These are the ones enrolled as Israelites: .

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Sool daa ʒi o yiŋa n-gbibi kpani o nuu ni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu yaa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka Dauda ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o.
en: Then an evil spirit from the LORD came over Saul. He was sitting in his house with his spear in hand while David was playing music.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛra n-dar chahi li, ka bɛnkam daa be o sani gba daa niŋ lala.
en: David tore his clothes in sorrow, and all his men did the same.

dag: Niriba maa ni da n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa puuni ni tahima kalinsi, ka kum wum ba. Kum din yɛn wum ba maa mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa puuni, bɛ ni tu bɛ naa mini bɛ wuni. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa.
en: When the enemy comes, there will be hard times and hunger. And when he becomes hungry, he will become angry. He will say curses in the name of his king and his gods. Then he will lift his head upwards like a roaring lion .

dag: Ka tihi puu maa lana daa yɛli, Ka wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N ni timla mmaŋmaŋ biyurigu ŋɔ; di pa shɛli bɛ ni ti ti ŋun jilima.
en: Then the owner of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my own dear son; surely they will respect him.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa chaŋ Kɛila nti tuhi Filistianim maa n-ku ba pam, ka fa bɛ niɣi. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ fa Kɛilanim maa bahi.
en: So David and his men went to Keilah and attacked the Philistines; they killed many of them and took their livestock. And so it was that David saved the town.

dag: Yi ni ti lan ko yi wain tihi puri Samaria zoya zuɣu. Ka bɛn ti sa tihi maa ni ti di di wala.
en: Again, you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; farmers will plant and then enjoy the harvests.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba; ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni. Leem bɛ gula, ka lihiri ba sahakam kaman piɛgul ni lihir o piɛri shɛm la.
en: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.

dag: Musa ni daa ti bi doo, ka o daa ti yi n-chaŋ o niriba sani nti nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa, ka daa ti nya Ijipti do so ni buri o niriba Hiburunim maa ni yino.
en: One day after Moses had become an adult, he went out among his people and he saw their forced labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni mi, bɛ daa yihila Mashal mini Abidɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasturelands, Abdon with its pasturelands, and.

dag: N ni daa bi baŋ n ni yɛn gbaai yɛlli maa shɛm zuɣu ka n daa bɔhi Pool ni o bɔri ni o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar o saria nimaani.
en: Since I had no idea how to investigate these matters, I asked if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem to stand trial there on these issues.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa zaŋ kpa piɛla so n ni daa nya ka o ʒe mɔɣili nol la polo n-daa kab chaŋ o sani ni o kpiɔŋ zaa ti bibig o.
en: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.

dag: Bɛ daa daai ma la pam ka n yɛn lu, amaa ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ma.
en: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Bɛrɔtibɛnɛjaakan n-chaŋ Mɔsɛra. Nimaani ka Aduna daa kpi, ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o nimaani, ka o bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa leei maligumaana zan o zaani.
en: The Israelites set out from the wells that belonged to the people of Jaakan, and went to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar succeeded him as priest.

dag: Ka o daa ti bɔhi Yawɛ n-nya o yɛla ti o, ka ti o bindirigu, ka lan zaŋ Goliat Filistia doo la takɔb la ti o.
en: Ahimelech talked to the Lord for him, then gave him food and the sword that had belonged to Goliath the Philistine.

dag: Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa mali ti paai Mahanaim, ka Nahash bia Shɔbi ŋun daa yi Raba din be Ammɔn tiŋgban ni la na mini Makiri Amiɛl bia ŋun daa yi Lɔdɛba na la ni Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nira ka yi Rɔgɛlim na la.
en: After David came to the town of Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash came from Rabbah in Ammon, Machir the son of Ammiel came from Lo-Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite came from Rogelim.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi wɔɣira nimdi, ka nyu dunia ŋɔ nanim ʒim mini piɛlahi ʒim ni piɛnyama ʒim ni buhi ʒim ni naɣilahi ʒim, bɛ zaa nyɛla Bashan biŋkɔb kpaba.
en: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba kaman Masia ni yuri cheechi maa ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima di zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Husbands, love your wives just as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam bɛn ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.

dag: N ni lo ni n tum din viɛli zuɣu, n dimnim zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma din viɛli niŋbu samli.
en: Those who pay back evil for good are against me because I try to do right.

dag: Noli ŋɔ zaa ni ti doli ya n-din ya hal ti kun ya, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: All these disasters will come on you, and they will be with you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the Lord your God and keep all the laws that he gave you.

dag: Naawuni, ti paɣir a, ti paɣir a; dama a miri ti. Sokam yɛr a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.

dag: Ti Duuma zuɣu, doliya dunia ŋɔ fukumsinim zaa yɛligu, di yi nyɛla nazuɣu ŋun su fukumsi.
en: For the sake of the Lord submit yourselves to every human authority: to the Emperor, who is the supreme authority.

dag: Joɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɛmaya mini Gɔg ni Shimɛi.
en: These are the names of Joels descendants: Shemaiah was Joels son. Gog was Shemaiahs son. Shimei was Gogs son.

dag: Dama bɛ daa bi tooi puhi li di puhibu saha, maligumaaniba bɛn daa mali bɛmaŋ be kasi kalinli ni daa bi paai, ka niriba mi daa bi laɣim Jɛrusalɛm na la zuɣu.
en: They had been unable to celebrate it at the usual time because the priests had failed to make themselves holy in sufficient numbers, and the people hadnt gathered at Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, M pun bi yɛl a ni Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm ka n yɛn niŋ.
en: But Balaam answered and said to Balak, Didnt I say to you, Ill do whatever the LORD tells me to.

dag: Yi mɔŋdi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli, ka fari yɛlimaŋli n niriba bɛn nyari nahiŋgu la sani, ka fari pakoya mini kpibisi nɛma.
en: They are not fair to the poor. They take away the rights of the poor and allow people to steal from widows and orphans.

dag: A daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna gari tooni n-zaŋ a niriba bɛn ŋmani piɛri la chaŋ.
en: You led your people like a shepherd, with Moses and Aaron in charge.

dag: Ka sapashinnim maa daa niŋ kaman maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ bɛ niriba bɛn bi yɛn be tuma ni mini bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali n-ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada sanna.
en: The commanders followed Jehoiada's orders. Each one called together his guards—those coming on duty and those going off duty.

dag: Di maliya karimbaani ti yaɣi bee n-tɔɣisiri kapirichi yɛtɔɣa.
en: Dont be so sure that you will win. Dont boast that victory is yours.

dag: Di chɛliya ka sam shɛli doli ya n-naɣ pahila tab yubu samli, dama ŋunkam yur o ʒiʒiinikpee nyɛla ŋun pali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: You should owe nothing to anyone, except that you will always owe love to each other. The person who loves others has done all that the law commands.

dag: M mabiyurisi, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ. Di simdi ni sokam wumdi yomyom, ka gbaam omaŋa o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni, ka mi di jɛri suli yomyom.
en: Know this, my dear brothers and sisters: everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to grow angry.

dag: ka o niriba ti baŋ tiliginsim ni nyɛ shɛli bɛ taali chɛ m-paŋ puuni.
en: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.

dag: Bɔhimiya pumpɔŋɔ n-nya doo ni tooi dɔɣi bia? Ka bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka doo kam zaŋ o nuhi tab o saɣiŋga ni kaman paɣa n-wolisiri la? Bɔ n-niŋ ka sokam saɣim o ninni?.
en: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe sagbani maa ni n-du zoli maa zuɣu. Musa daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi.
en: Moses went on up the mountain into the cloud. There he stayed for forty days and nights.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, bɛn daa nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛr o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maa.
en: Then I said to all the men and the women who had answered me in this way.

dag: A yi ti jɛrigu jilima, di ŋmanila a ni lo kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni la.
en: Like tying a stone in a sling, so is giving respect to a fool.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama a niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli pam.
en: You have been good to me, Lord , and I will sing about you.

dag: Anabinim bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni yi ka yi sanna ti wuhi ya shihirili bee alahiziba tuun shɛli.
en: Now if a prophet or a dream interpreter appears among you and performs a sign or wonder for you.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim ninʒeensinim ŋɔ, tɛhimiya ka naanyi bahi yoli, dama n tum tuun karili yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, tuun kar shɛli so ni yɛli ya di yɛla ka yi ku niŋ yɛda. .
en: Look, you scoffers , marvel and die . Im going to do work in your day — a work you wont believe even if someone told you .

dag: Zaŋm Aduna min o bia Ɛliɛza du Hɔr Zoli zuɣu na;.
en: Now, bring Aaron and his son Eleazar up to Mount Hor.

dag: Dinzuɣu Filistianima, bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la, di yi pa lala, yi ni leei Hiburunim maa daba kaman bɛ ni yi nyɛ yi daba shɛm la; bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la n-tuhi ba.
en: Be brave, Philistines! Fight like men, or we will become slaves to the Hebrews, just as they were our slaves. So fight like men.

dag: Manaasa zuliya ni niriba pirigili la daa bolila ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika yuya n-tim ba na ni bɛ ti zaŋ Dauda leei naa.
en: from half the tribe of Manasseh, . designated by name to come and make David king.

dag: Dama man bi yu ni yi so kpi. Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I most certainly dont want anyone to die! This is what the LORD God says. Change your ways, and live!.

dag: Ka o lan tim so pah ata, ka bɛ ti bu n-ti o daŋa, ka kar o bahi.
en: He sent a third servant. They wounded this servant and threw him out.

dag: A mini bɛn laɣim tum tuma a bilim ni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni yɛn tooi niŋ shɛli ti a zaa m-bala. Bɛ zaa ni chɛ a ka zaŋ kpa bɛ ni chani shɛli polo, ka bɛ so ku tooi tilig a.
en: Thats what will happen to those you have worked with, the people you did business with all your life. They will all go their own way. There will be no one left to save you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti zuliya awɛi la mini Manaasa zuliya pirigili la, ka di leei bɛ dini.
en: Now then, divide this land among the other nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh, for them to possess as their own.

dag: Daba anii dali, di simdi ni o bo piɛlah ayi bɛn ka dansi mini piɛsaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛl ni kilɔgiram ata ni kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim zuɣu.
en: On the eighth day you shall bring two male lambs and one female lamb a year old that are without any defects, five pounds of flour mixed with olive oil, and half a pint of olive oil.

dag: A mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl daŋ kam dunoli dɔɣirikpamba niŋmi bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa din nyɛ ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri maa na laasabu.
en: You, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the communitys households must take an inventory of the valuable property and the captives, both human and animals.

dag: ni Judas Jeemsi so bia mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti leei nyaanyira la.
en: Jude, who was the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadam kam ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna nti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: with its beautiful leaves and its abundant fruit, and that had enough food for everyone, with wild animals living under it and birds nesting in its branches.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chana, ka n wum bɛ kpiŋkpama maa vuri ka di be kaman kokpɛɣu vuri la; di daa ŋmanila Kpiɔŋlan Naa kukoli, ka di vuri ŋmani tɔbbihi pam vuri. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: I heard the noise their wings made in flight; it sounded like the roar of the sea, like the noise of a huge army, like the voice of Almighty God. When they stopped flying, they folded their wings.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n yipa leela yi dima n ni yɛli ya yɛlimaŋli zuɣu?.
en: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guhi ka di yuui ha, amaa ka o kul bi yoori zɔntua maa dunoya maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ saafɛbia yooi li nya ka bɛ naa maa kpimi do tiŋa.
en: They waited so long that they were embarrassed, but he never opened the doors of the room. Then they used the key to open them, and there was their master lying dead on the ground!.

dag: Mɔab wurimya, ka Mɔabnim kuhira, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ni vi. Dinzuɣu Mɔabnim leela bɛ ni yɛn maani shɛb ansarisi, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa dabiɛm.
en: Moab has been shattered! Cry out! Moab has been disgraced. It is in ruins, and all the surrounding nations make fun of it. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ham bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Kush mini Ijipti ni Put ni Keenan.
en: Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o mali buɣim shɛli din yɛn di Asiria naa sɔŋ ka di waɣa. Buɣim maa dari kul pumi, ka doya yɛlim ka zilim pam. Yawɛ ni vuhi o vuhim din ŋmani chilibi bahi di zuɣu, ka di taai buɣim.
en: Topheth has been made ready for a long time. It is ready for the king. It was made very deep and wide. There is a very big pile of wood and fire there, and the Lord s breath will come like a stream of burning sulfur to start the fire.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti laɣim Galili na ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia n-niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: When the disciples all came together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of Man is about to be handed over to those.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Aduna maligumaana leebu piɛlaa nyɔɣu polo n-gahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka di leeg a tarili.
en: Then take the breast from the ram. Hold the breast of the ram before the Lord as a special offering. Then take it back and keep it. This part of the animal will be for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi bee n sɔŋdiba bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ guliba bɛn doli ma la ni so daa bi yeei ti situra. Ti zaɣ yino kam daa kul gbibila o bidibbini o nudirigu ni.
en: So none of us took off our clothes—not me, not my brothers, not my men, and not the guards. Each of us had our weapon ready at all times, even when we went to get water.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana bi nyar o suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa, amaa ŋun tumdi tuun kpɛma ŋun nyar o suhu ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa.
en: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Mɔab. O yaansi n-nyɛ Mɔabnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nirilim yɛla, ka kuhi yɛl a wuntia yɛla.
en: They will tell about all your goodness and sing about your kindness.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka piɛ yino ti bɔrigi ka o ku chɛ piɛri kɔbigayinika la bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu hal ti nya o?.
en: Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them—what do you do? You leave the other ninety-nine sheep in the pasture and go looking for the one that got lost until you find it.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o mi o ka bi dol o zaligunima, o ŋmarila ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ka o ni.
en: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa ti wum ni bɛ leei Sulemaana nam n-zal o ba zaashee, ka o daa tim tuumba Naa Sulemaana sani, dama Naa Hiram daa yuri Dauda pam.
en: Hiram was the king of Tyre. He had always been Davids friend. So when Hiram heard that Solomon had become the new king after David, he sent his servants to Solomon.

dag: Lɛbana ni Hagaba ni Akub ni.
en: Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di?.
en: It is worth nothing for you to have the whole world if you yourself are destroyed or lost.

dag: So nahu yi ʒe n-ti o kpee nahu daŋa ka o kpi, bɛn kɔhimi naɣ nɛɔŋ maa m-pirigi liɣiri maa ti taba, ka lan pirigi naɣ kpiŋ maa gba ti taba.
en: If someone's bull kills someone else's bull, the two of them shall sell the live bull and divide the money; they shall also divide up the meat from the dead animal.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ti lihi tiŋ na nya li.
en: until the LORD looks down from the heavens and notices.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka n sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa ŋma la ni m-pa di zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Cut two stone tablets like the first ones. Ill write on these tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke into pieces.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai di puuni palo din nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di leei Naawuni jɛmbu duu palo, ka di yaɣili kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu. Ka yi ŋmaai palo din yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu gili di zaa.
en: A square area that is cubits long on each side will be for the Temple. There will be an open space around the Temple that is cubits wide.

dag: O gbibila gummua o nuu ni, ka mali o nubihi wahiri jɛni.
en: She spins her own thread and weaves her own cloth.

dag: Ka Ozini daŋ niriba nyɛ Ozininima; ka Ɛri daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛrinima;.
en: Ozni—the Oznite family group; Eri—the Erite family group;.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim mali galimi o sani. Ʒiɛyimtali lan kani, ka nirilim lan kani, ka so bi lan mi Naawuni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.

dag: Ka Balak daa kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri duɣi tahi ti ti Balaam mini kpamba bɛn daa be o sani.
en: where Balak slaughtered cattle and sheep and gave some of the meat to Balaam and the leaders who were with him.

dag: O daa pun wum Yisa yɛla, ka daa gil o nyaaŋa nti ŋaɣisi kpe salo maa ni nti shihi o binyɛrigu.
en: The woman had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him in the crowd and barely touched his clothes.
