dag: Di chɛ ka a nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpɛh a alahichi ni. A mi miri ka a ti yɛli adiini karimba ni pa lala ka a di yɛli. Di chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu a yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka a tuma bahi yoli.
en: Don't let your own words lead you into sin, so that you have to tell God's priest that you didn't mean it. Why make God angry with you? Why let him destroy what you have worked for?.

dag: Ka Harihaya bia Uziɛl ŋun daa nyɛ machɛli ŋun doori salima la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ tulaale maana la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa lab mali Jɛrusalɛm hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: Uzziel, Harhaiahs son, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs next to them; and Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs next to him. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

dag: Piɛbimiya gbɛri Gibia tiŋ puuni, ka piɛbiya kikahi Rama tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛmiya tɔb chiriga Bɛtavɛn tiŋ puuni. Bɛnjamin zuliya, lumiya abirima.
en: Blow a horn in Gibeah; blow a trumpet in Ramah. Sound the warning at Beth-aven: Look behind you, Benjamin.

dag: Niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti du n-tam Ziɔn Zol la zuɣu, ka deei Iso Zoli su. Ka di ti leei Yawɛ nam.
en: The victorious men of Jerusalem will attack Edom and rule over it. And the Lord himself will be king.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa saɣisi miri buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ha ka boli, Shadirak! Mɛshak! Abɛdnɛgo! Yinim Zallakudura Naa daba ŋɔ, yimiyana ka kpe na! Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa dii yi buɣim maa ni na.
en: So Nebuchadnezzar went up to the door of the blazing furnace and called out, Shadrach! Meshach! Abednego! Servants of the Supreme God! Come out! And they came out at once.

dag: Ka yi ni bɛn ti kpalim ni ti bahi yoli yi dimnim tiŋgbɔna ni bɛ mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛ yaannim maa.
en: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ʒim yihibu maa taali yɛn labina ti ʒini ŋun Jɔab min o nyaaŋa zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa Dauda min o nyaaŋa ni o yiŋnim ni o nam ʒiishee ni mali suhudoo din yi Yawɛ sanna sahakam.
en: The punishment for their murders will fall on Joab and on his descendants forever. But the Lord will always give success to David's descendants who sit on his throne.

dag: Dama Sadusiinim daa wuhiri niriba ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani, ka lan yɛri ni malaikanim bee shihi gba kani, amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wuhiri ni di zaa beni.
en: The Sadducees do not believe in angels or spirits or that the dead will rise to life. But the Pharisees believe in all of these.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-ni be nimaani. Ka viri mini taatahi kpe m-be bɛ yinsi; ka mɔɣu ni buhi be nimaani n-yiɣiri jamda.
en: The only animals living there will be wild animals from the desert. People will not be living in their houses in Babylon. The houses will be full of owls and large birds. Wild goats will play in the houses.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni bee n-to piɛm di ni bee n-zaŋ nyɔtaɣira ka di ni na bee n-kana ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gil li.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD says about Assyrias king: He wont enter this city. He wont shoot a single arrow there. He wont come near the city with a shield. He wont build a ramp to besiege it.

dag: Ka Adam min o paɣ daa lan laɣim ka o dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Sɛt, dama O daa yɛlimi, Naawuni zaŋla bidib so ti ma ka o zani Ɛbɛl zaani, Keen ni daa ku Ɛbɛl la zuɣu.
en: Adam knew his wife intimately again, and she gave birth to a son. She named him Seth because God has given me another child in place of Abel, whom Cain killed.

dag: Ka a baŋsim maa zuɣu ni chɛ ka Masia ni daa kpi a mabi so ŋun ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: The weak brother or sister for whom Christ died is destroyed by your knowledge.

dag: N ni niŋ Ɛhab yiŋnim kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim mini Ahija bia Baasha yiŋnim shɛm la.
en: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.

dag: Ka yi gba daa tumdila lala yi ni daa siɣi ʒe di puuni saha shɛl la.
en: At one time you yourselves used to live according to such desires, when your life was dominated by them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Apolɔs? Bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Pool? Ti kul nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn sɔŋ ya ka yi niŋ yɛda kaman ti Duuma ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm.
en: After all, who is Apollos? And who is Paul? We are simply God's servants, by whom you were led to believe. Each one of us does the work which the Lord gave him to do:.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya maa n-tahi ti ti tiŋ ŋɔ ni gomna Amɔn mini naa bia Jɔash.
en: Then King Ahab ordered one of his officers to arrest Micaiah. Ahab said, Arrest him and take him to Amon the governor of the city and prince Joash.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa ʒiya kariti saria maa ka o paɣ timna ti yɛl o, Yihim a nuu wuntizɔra ŋɔ yɛla ni, dama yuŋ la n sa nya muɣisigu pam zahindi ni o zuɣu.
en: While he was serving as judge, his wife sent this message to him, Leave that righteous man alone. Ive suffered much today in a dream because of him.

dag: Bɛ zaliya ni bɛ gbahimi tiŋ maa nim chaŋ. Bɛ gbahi di dabipaɣiba chaŋ, ka bɛ fabindi kaman ŋmana la, ka buri bɛ nyɔri.
en: The enemy takes away the queen, and her slave girls moan sadly like doves. They beat their breasts to show their sadness.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, N dana, a daa po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani yɛli, A bia Sulemaana ni ti di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: Bathsheba answered: Your Majesty, you promised me in the name of the Lord your God that my son Solomon would be the next king.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-daa zali ni Izraɛlnim zaŋm li tiri ba dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni la. Di nyɛla zaligu din kul yɛn beni bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The LORD commanded that these things be given to the priests by the Israelites, following their anointment. It is their permanent portion throughout their future generations.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neeg asiba ka dam maa yi o ninni, ka o paɣ maa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka o suhu kabi, ka o be kaman kuɣili la.
en: The next morning, Nabal was sober, so his wife told him everything. He had a heart attack and became as stiff as a rock.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa yɛli naa maa, Mal a pina maa bee zaŋmi li ti so. Amaa n ni karim sabbu maa, ka wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: Daniel replied, Keep your gifts for yourself or give them to someone else. I will read for Your Majesty what has been written and tell you what it means.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ti laɣim taba, ka bɛ ni ti malila zuɣulaan yino, ka bɛ biɛhigu ti chaŋ tooni tiŋgbani maa ni, dama Jɛziriil dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali.
en: Then the people of Judah and the people of Israel will be gathered together. They will choose one ruler for themselves, and their nation will be too large for the land. Jezreels day will be great!.

dag: So kani m-be kasi kaman nyin Yawɛ, so lan kani m-pah a zuɣu. Tampin shɛli mi kani m-be kaman nyin Yawɛ.
en: No one is holy like the LORD— no, no one except you! There is no rock like our God!.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak daa nya Izraɛlnim ni niŋ Amɔrinim shɛlikam zaa.
en: When the king of Moab, Balak son of Zippor, heard what the Israelites had done to the Amorites and how many Israelites there were.

dag: Bɛ lo ba yolisim nyabu alikauli, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛ bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ leei bahiyotali tuun shɛŋa bɛ ni tum ka di mili ba la daba, dama ninsal nyɛla binshɛɣukam din nyaŋ o dabili.
en: These false teachers promise freedom, but they themselves are slaves of immorality; whatever overpowers you, enslaves you.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa tɔɣisirila Lazarɔs kum yɛla, ka o nyaandoliba maa bɛn tɛhi ni o tɔɣisirila o daalaafee gom yɛla.
en: Jesus meant that Lazarus had died, but they thought he meant natural sleep.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima a sani, nyin di chɛ ka o tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: If anyone from your own country becomes so poor that they must sell themselves to you, dont make them work like slaves.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛdaya — kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: These are the priests: the descendants of Jedaiah through the family of Jeshua:.

dag: Dama Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ti o niriba suhudoo, ka ni kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: David said, Since the LORD, Israels God, has given his people peace and has made his home in Jerusalem forever.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu. Ŋuna n-tiligiri bɛn ʒe dɛde bɛ suhuri ni.
en: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.

dag: O mi o tuma ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuh o.
en: Our God is using this to teach you a lesson. This example shows us that God is fair when he punishes his people.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ galisiya pam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba, ka yi bɔri ni bɛ chɛ tuun kpema tumbu bebɔ.
en: You people have become more numerous than the Egyptians. And now you want to stop working.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli Izraɛlnim ni labisiri nɛma tiri tab la saha yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm bɛ tarili maa pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni, ka bɛ tarili maa ku lan be ti yaannim tarili ni.
en: At the Israelite Jubilee, their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they married. Then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our ancestral tribe.

dag: N daa zaŋ liiga viɛlli yɛl a, ka zaŋ gban duɣira namda pir a, ka zaŋ bɔb piɛlli bɔb a, ka zaŋ chinchin nyɛlisira sol a.
en: I gave you the finest clothes and the most expensive robes, as well as sandals made from the best leather.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl niriba maa naa ni mali so shɛŋa min o talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka daa sab li niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bahi niriba maa zaa ka bɛ wurim, ka sokam kul o ya.
en: Samuel explained to the people the rights and duties of a king, and then wrote them in a book, which he deposited in a holy place. Then he sent everyone home.

dag: Mɛmiya tinsi ti yi bihi ka me piɛri buzɔna ti yi piɛri mini yi buhi, ka niŋ kaman yi ni lo alikauli ni yi ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tooi wumda, di zuɣu ka n ku tooi garigi yɛli shɛli.
en: I am like those who cannot hear what people are saying about them. I cannot answer to prove my enemies wrong.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa maan o ansarisi ka ŋmɛr o.
en: The men guarding Jesus made fun of him and beat him.

dag: Ŋuna n-tuhi nyaŋ sokam zaa, ka chɛ ka ti su zuliya kam zaa.
en: God has put every nation under our power.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz leei naa zal o ba zaani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The people of the land took Jehoahaz, Josiahs son, and made him the next king in Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Tell the people this: You will cross the Jordan River and go into the land of Canaan.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Ayuba n-nyuri ansarisi malibo kaman kom la?.
en: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!.

dag: Dinzuɣu pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti zuliya awɛi la mini Manaasa zuliya pirigili la, ka di leei bɛ dini.
en: Now divide the land among the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus answered, I have just one question to ask you. If you answer it, I will tell you where I got the right to do these things.

dag: Ka Musa daa kana ti yɛli niriba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm min o ni zali shɛm zaa, ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li.
en: Moses gave the Lord 's instructions to the people, and they all promised, We will do everything the Lord has commanded.

dag: Di simdi ni yi lihi ti kaman Masia tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ o daashili yɛlimaŋa fukumsi niŋ shɛb nuu ni.
en: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.

dag: Ka yi ni ti zaŋ o ʒim shɛli niŋ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila anahi la, ka niŋniŋ di tariga kɔnanim anahi la zuɣu, ka niŋniŋ di baŋa din kɔɣili li gil la. Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi, ka yi zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: You will take some of the bulls blood and put it on the altars four horns, on the four corners of the ledge, and on the rim around it. In this way you will make the altar pure.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd n-daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira n-lo o mihi kpɛhi duu ŋun Hɛrɔd tizo Filip paɣa Hɛrɔdias zuɣu.
en: Before this time, Herod had arrested John. He had him chained and put in prison. He arrested John because of Herodias, the wife of Philip, Herods brother.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni so ti ku yɛli ni o biɛra. Ka Naawuni ni ti chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani daalahichi zaa taali.
en: No one living there will say, I am sick, because everyone living there has had their guilt removed.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa teeg o nuu tiri Ijipti koma zaa, ka poloya daa yina n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt. The frogs crawled up and covered the land of Egypt.

dag: Musa ni daa wum li, o daa teemi dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli:.
en: With the commanders permission, Paul stood on the steps and gestured to the people. When they were quiet, he addressed them in Aramaic.

dag: Teemiya bin shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ piligu ni ha la yɛla; dama mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani ŋmani ma.
en: Remember what happened long ago; acknowledge that I alone am God and that there is no one else like me.

dag: Amaa nyini daadam, wummi n ni yɛl a shɛm maa, ka miri ka a niŋ duŋtaara kaman duŋtaariba maa. Yaam a noli n-di n ni zaŋ binshɛli tir a ŋɔ.
en: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.

dag: Ka ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ka Masia daa yi o zuɣu nyɛla man ŋun kpalim nyaaŋa dɔɣim palli nyabu ni ŋɔ;.
en: Last of all, he appeared to me. I was different, like a baby born before the normal time.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka o mini niriba maa zaa ni naa lo alikauli ni bɛn yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ niriba.
en: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord . They agreed.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa yi tɔb maa ni na ka nyɛ bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: Moses became angry with the army commanders.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ gahindili shɛli Naawuni ni pii ka lihi li ka di mali buchi. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: Thus it is written in scripture, Look! I am laying a cornerstone in Zion, chosen, valuable. The person who believes in him will never be shamed. .

dag: ni ʒiri shɛhira lana ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tuɣindi nir min o yiŋnima.
en: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.

dag: Zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Tie them on your hands and wear them on your foreheads to help you remember my teachings.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven is my brother, sister, and mother.

dag: Yi galim ma yimyim bupia zuɣu, yi ni miligi n suhu shɛm maa vi bi mali ya?.
en: These ten times youve humiliated me; shamelessly you insult me.

dag: Musa ni daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai.
en: When Moses had finished giving God's teachings to the people.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana ka o daa bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: and from then on he started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus.

dag: Ka yi ti chaŋ maligumaana ŋun tumdi tuma di saha maa sani ti yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni m paai ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
en: Go to the priest who is serving at that time. Tell him, The Lord promised our ancestors that he would give us some land. Today I come to announce to the Lord your God that I have come to that land.

dag: Di saha ka ŋarin shɛŋa din daa yi Taibɛrias na kana ti zani miri luɣ shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni sa paɣi Naawuni bɔrɔbɔro zuɣu ka zaŋ li ti niriba ka bɛ ŋub la.
en: But then some boats from Tiberias came and landed near the place where the people had eaten the day before. This was where they had eaten the bread after the Lord gave thanks.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɛhimiya, ka boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi fabila ka bɛ kana; ka tim boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi kuyila ka bɛ kana.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Pay attention! Summon the women who mourn, let them come; send for those best trained, let them come.

dag: So na ʒi n-chaŋ alizanda ni naɣila Daadam Bia ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: The only one who has ever gone up to heaven is the one who came down from heaven—the Son of Man.

dag: Hal shinshingoorɔnim mi bɛ yiŋ labbu saha. Ka ŋmanʒee mini sakpaleeŋa ni noombihi bɛn daari doli taba zaa gba mi bɛ kandina saha. Amaa n niriba bɛn bi mi Yawɛ zaligunima.
en: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni bo binshɛŋa zaa ni bɛ me du kasi maa, n lan mali mmaŋmaŋ daazichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa, ka n ni zaŋ n zaŋsim zaa niŋ n Naawuni duu ŋɔ mɛbu ni maa zuɣu, n zaŋ li ti ni bɛ tum n Naawuni duu maa tuma.
en: Over and above all this that I have provided, I have given silver and gold from my personal property because of my love for God's Temple.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a mi ma; a nyari ma, ka buɣisiri ma, ka n suhu bela a ni. Vom ba yihina kaman piɛri ka bɛ vɔri ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la. Woligim ba zali gu kɔrigibu dali.
en: Yet you, LORD, you know me. You see me. You can tell that I love you. So drag them away and butcher them like sheep. Prepare them for the slaughterhouse.

dag: Nyama, n yaai n noli, ka n zilinli din be n nol ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: I am ready to speak.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi chaŋ zoya ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti paai Ɛshikol Vinvamli ni m-puɣisi chaŋ ti kaai li.
en: These set out and went up into the hills, going as far as the Cluster ravine. They walked all around that area.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N wuhi ya tuun suma pam din yi m Ba maa sanna, ka di ni dini zuɣu ka yi lee yɛn lab ma kuɣa ŋɔ.
en: But he said to them, The many wonderful things you have seen me do are from the Father. Which of these good things are you killing me for.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Gaza goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: So I will start a fire at the wall of Gaza that will destroy the high towers in Gaza.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: Peter and John left. They found everything just as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: N kul ni paɣir a, dama a wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: I will burst into songs of praise, because you have taught me your laws.

dag: Di ti Sintani soli hal biɛla!.
en: Don't give the Devil a chance.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul zɔri kpari booli polo ni di chɛ ka n nya Naawuni ni boli ti boligu shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: The goal I pursue is the prize of Gods upward call in Christ Jesus.

dag: Obɛdɛdom daa mali bidibisi: Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ o bituuli n-zaŋ Jɛhɔzabad pa, ka Jɔa pah ata, ka Sakar pah anahi, ka Nɛtanɛl pah anu.
en: Obed Edom had sons. His oldest son was Shemaiah. Jehozabad was his second son. Joah was his third son. Sacar was his fourth son. Nethanel was his fifth son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika, ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Eighteen thousand of the best Benjaminite soldiers were killed.

dag: Ti ni so bi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti ni so mi bi kpiri omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: We dont live or die just for ourselves.

dag: Dama n zaŋ n nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka po pɔri ni mani ŋun be sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka bimmɔrim biɛri mɔri yi duna mini yi biɛhi, ka yi ku tooi tibi li. Di ni ti zaŋ yi napɔnvari ni hal ni yi zuɣutalisi ni.
en: The LORD will strike you with horrible inflammation in your knees and legs, from the sole of your foot to the top of your head. You will be untreatable.

dag: Ninvuɣ so sa di dol a duna, miri ka a chɛ ka ninvuɣ so sa be zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Miri ka a sa chɛ ka biŋkɔbbaligu bee niɣi ŋub mɔri zoli maa gbini.
en: No one else can come up with you. Dont allow anyone even to be seen anywhere on the mountain. Dont even let sheep and cattle graze in front of the mountain.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba napɔna vubu balisam tihi maa zuɣu, di saha nyin lirim ba, dama man Naawuni n-daŋ a tooni ni n ti nyaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa.
en: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Gibia ka anab bɔbili shiri tuh o soli ka Naawuni shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na pam, ka o pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Saul and the boy got to Gibeah, there was a group of prophets coming to meet him. Gods spirit came over Saul, and he was caught up in a prophetic frenzy right along with them.

dag: Putɔɣunim muɣisigu lan ka nimaani; ka di ni wum shɛb la nya vuhim.
en: In the grave wicked people stop their evil, and tired workers find rest at last.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna daa duh o bɔɣiri zuɣusaa kpa niriba maa polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka daa yi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni suhudoo sara malibu shee maa siɣina.
en: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them. After he finished offering the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the fellowship offerings, he came down from the altar.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka tiligi Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku m bia Jɔnatan, hal Naawuni ni kul chɛ ka ti nya tiliginsim ŋun Jɔnatan kɔbili ni maa zaa yoli. Amaa ka niriba maa zaa so daa bi garig o.
en: I swear by the Lord who saves Israel, that even if my own son Jonathan sinned, he must die. None of the people said a word.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ gbuɣinli ŋun nyɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ka bi zɔri so dabiɛm ŋɔ.
en: lions, strongest of all animals and afraid of none;.

dag: hal nimaani gba n yɛn bela a nuu ni, ka a nudirigu gbib ma kirikiri.
en: even there you will take my hand and lead me. Your strong right hand will protect me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi wuhir o nyaandoliba maa yɛra, Faashee Daadam Bia nya wahala pam, ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa ti zaɣis o, ka chɛ ka bɛ ku o, amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: Then Jesus began to teach his disciples: The Human One must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and the legal experts, and be killed, and then, after three days, rise from the dead.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba ti chani gindina nti nya ma, ka m bɔhi ba, Yi nya n yura la.
en: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, Have you seen the one I love so much.

dag: Ka n daa lan yɛli ba n Naawuni nuu ni pa n zuɣu shɛm mini naa ni daa yɛli ma shɛm yɛla. Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, Chɛliya ka ti yiɣisi piligi di mɛbu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kpalanzuya gbini taba.
en: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, Let's start building now! So they got everything ready.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia chɛ ka suhudoo mini yurilim ni yɛda be ti mabihi la zaa ni.
en: May God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give to all Christians peace and love with faith.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunoli daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu mini daanya sara maligu bimbini ni di daanya kurupooti la ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma.
en: And it was used to make the stands for the entrance to the tent, the altar and its grating, the equipment for the altar.

dag: N yi di daa bi kana ti wuhi ba, bɛ naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ku tooi lan chihi yi bɛ taali maa ni.
en: If I had not come and spoken to the people of the world, they would not be guilty of sin. But now I have spoken to them. So they have no excuse for their sin.

dag: Bɛ daa sabirila maligumaaniba mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ bibihi ni bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa yuya, dama bɛna n-daa ʒe yim ka mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: The official genealogy included all their small children, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—the entire congregation—for they had faithfully made themselves holy.

dag: Ka gbaai naɣila kpabili na ti kɔrigi ka ti ŋubi, ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma;.
en: Then go and get the prize calf and kill it, and let us celebrate with a feast!.

dag: Yuma ata kam puuni, zaŋmiya yi puri atam pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim sɔŋ yi tinsi ni.
en: Every third year you must bring the tenth part of your produce from that year and leave it at your city gates.

dag: M bi baŋ mmaŋmaŋ yɛla gba, dama m bi tumdi mmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri ni n tum shɛli, amaa n ni je shɛl la, dina ka n tumda.
en: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti ku ku a, ti kul yɛn zaŋ a mi ti ti ba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi pala ayi lo o n-zaŋ o tampiŋ lɔŋ maa ni na ti ti ba.
en: The men from Judah said, We agree. We will just tie you up and give you to the Philistines. We promise that we will not kill you. So they tied Samson with two new ropes and led him up from the cave in the rock.

dag: Ti Naawuni a ku darigi bɛ tibili ti ti? Dama ti ka yiko din ni tooi tuhi salo pam bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi ti ŋɔ. Ti bi mi ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, amaa nyini ka ti kul lihira.
en: You are our God! Punish them, for we are helpless in the face of this large army that is attacking us. We do not know what to do, but we look to you for help.

dag: Ka sana yi be yi sani ka bɔri ni o puhiri Yaɣigari chuɣu ŋɔ tiri Yawɛ jilima, yin chɛliya ka o gun o yiŋ bidibisi zaa, di saha o ni leei Izraɛl tiŋbia, ka ni tooi puhiri Yaɣigari chuɣu maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun bi guni di li.
en: If anyone who isn't an Israelite wants to celebrate Passover with you, every man and boy in that family must first be circumcised. Then they may join in the meal, just like native Israelites. No uncircumcised man or boy may eat the Passover meal!.

dag: So yi mali buɣim ka di looi mɔɣu n-chaŋ ti di bɛ ni chɛ bindir shɛŋa sɔŋ bee bɛ ni na bi chɛ bindir shɛŋa bee n-di so puu zaa, di simdi ni ŋun mali buɣim maa yo di zuɣu zaa.
en: If you carelessly let a fire spread from your property to someone else's, you must pay the owner for any crops or fields destroyed by the fire.

dag: Naa daa ʒinila o ʒiishee din tab dukpini kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka Jɔnatan ʒiɛya, ka Abinɛr mi ʒini baɣili Sool, amaa ka Dauda ŋun ʒiishee daa nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ.
en: He took his customary seat by the wall. Jonathan sat opposite him while Abner sat beside Saul. Davids seat was empty.

dag: Amaa tarimba ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka tɔŋ pam, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Humble people will get the land God promised, and they will enjoy peace.

dag: So ni ti yɛli, n nyɛla Yawɛ nira, ka so zaŋ Yaakubu yuli bol omaŋa, ka so mi sab pa o nuu zuɣu yɛli, Yawɛ nira, ka zaŋ Izraɛl leeg o yuli.
en: This one will say, I am the LORDs, and that one will be named after Jacob. Another will write on his hand, The LORDs and will take the name Israel.

dag: Alɔbɔnim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti yɛn chɛ ka di di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ti yɛn nɛmi ka bɛ niŋgbuna piligi poobu; ka bɛ nina ti be bɛ nimbɔɣa ni ka piligi poobu; ka bɛ zilima gba ti be bɛ noya ni ka piligi poobu.
en: The Lord will bring a terrible disease on all the nations that make war on Jerusalem. Their flesh will rot away while they are still alive; their eyes and their tongues will rot away.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samuɛl daa ti boli niriba ni bɛ laɣim Yawɛ sanna Mizipa.
en: Samuel called the people together for a religious gathering at Mizpah.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ tusa bɛn yuri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima, n wuhiri n yurilim maŋli bɛ sani.
en: But I show my love to thousands of generations of those who love me and obey my laws.

dag: Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nin kara zaa daa puhigi, ka zuɣusaa sagbana kɔsoya gba yooi.
en: The water under the earth started gushing out everywhere, the sky opened like windows, and rain poured down for days and nights. All this began on the seventeenth day of the second month of the year.

dag: ka salo ŋɔ zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋdila takɔbi bee kpani n-tiligir o niriba, dama tɔb ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ tɔbu, ka o mi ni zaŋ ya niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: and everyone here will see that the Lord does not need swords or spears to save his people. He is victorious in battle, and he will put all of you in our power.

dag: N Naawuni maa tim o malaika na ka o ti mum gbuɣima maa noya, ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ ma shɛli. Naa, o niŋla lala, dama n ka taali o sani, ka ka taali a gba sani; ka m mi bi tum a taal shɛli.
en: God sent his angel to shut the mouths of the lions so that they would not hurt me. He did this because he knew that I was innocent and because I have not wronged you, Your Majesty.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi be kaman nɛl la. N ni chɛ ka yi nyina nyɛ zaɣ pala ka dira. Yi ni niɛm zoya n-wurim li, ka niŋ daboya kaman wurigu la.
en: I will make you like a threshing board, with spikes that are new and sharp. You will thresh mountains and destroy them; hills will crumble into dust.

dag: Ka o daa baŋ li ka yɛli, M bia maa binyɛrigu m-bala; mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o maa. Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ o kul dari tɔhitɔhila Yisifu zaa.
en: He recognized it and said, Its my sons robe! A wild animal has devoured him. Joseph must have been torn to pieces.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Absalom ti bahi bɔɣ zilinli ni mɔɣu maa ni, ka kahi kuɣa na ti pa o zuɣu, ka di du pam. Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa yinoyino daa zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: Then Joabs men took Absaloms body and threw it into a large hole in the forest and covered it with stones. All the Israelites ran away and went home.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa dɔɣi Nahɔr maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wurim buɣa, ka saɣim Mɛmfisi binnana la naai. Naa ti ku lan be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu n ni ti zaŋ dabiɛm niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, I will destroy the idols and the false gods in Memphis. There will be no one to rule Egypt, and I will terrify all the people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi zaŋ din buɣisiri maa m-buɣisi nuzaa polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side; each side had the same length, feet.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o tumtumda maa, Ti yi chaŋ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn ti o? Dama ti lan ka bindirigu ti koligu ŋɔ ni bee bɔ ka ti lee mali? Ti ka pin shɛli din ni ti Naawuni nir maa.
en: If we go to him, what can we give him? Saul asked. There is no food left in our packs, and we don't have a thing to give him, do we.

dag: N ni ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro zaɣa, ka paɣiba pia ni ti mali yi bɔrɔbɔro dubil yini puuni, ka ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro maa tibisim, ka yi ti ŋub li ka bi tiɣi.
en: When I destroy your food supply, ten women will bake bread in a single oven, and they will ration out bread by weight. You will eat but will never get full.

dag: A zaligunim maa nyɛla n fali sahakam. Dina n-tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: The rules you have given me to follow will be mine forever. They give me great joy.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Ka daɣila Kɛilanim ŋɔ ni zaŋ m mini n niriba ŋɔ niŋ ŋun Sool nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ ya niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Next David asked, Will the citizens of Keilah hand me and my soldiers over to Saul? Yes, they will hand you over, the LORD replied.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-zaŋ Vuhim Dabisili maa tin ya, lala zuɣu ka n tiri ya daba ayi bindirigu daba ayɔbu dali maa din ni chɛ ka sokam be o yiŋa, ka ku yi n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: Look, the Lord has made the Sabbath a day of rest for you. So on Friday he will give you enough food for two days. Then, on the Sabbath, each of you should sit down and relax. Stay where you are.

dag: Timiya ba tuun kpɛma pam ka bɛ tumda din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan gbilisi tibili wum yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Make them work harder and keep them busy, so that they won't have time to listen to a pack of lies.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a bi niŋ tulaale niŋ n zuɣu, amaa paɣ ŋɔ ŋun zaŋ tulaale niŋ n naba.
en: You did not honor me with oil for my head, but she rubbed my feet with her sweet-smelling oil.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa ka pii maa gbinna ni o ti tuhi ba, ka chaŋ ti miri di dunol ni ni o niŋ buɣim nyo li.
en: Abimelech came to the tower to storm it. But when he approached the towers entrance to set it on fire.

dag: Di simdi ka yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Be sure that you obey all the laws that he has given you.

dag: Yi kul yɛra, Ti nyee nyɔniya, ka naɣiri yi nyɛhi niŋdi ma. Yi zaŋdi yi ni fa biŋkɔb shɛb bee biŋkɔb gbariti bee biŋkɔb barinim na ti maani sara tiri ma, yi tɛhiya ni n ni dee li yi sani? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You say, How tired we are of all this! and you turn up your nose at me. As your offering to me you bring a stolen animal or one that is lame or sick. Do you think I will accept that from you?.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ya. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi biɛhigu shɛli o ni boli ya ni yi ti mali la. Naawuni sɔŋmi ya n-chɛ ka yi nya yi ni bɔri zaɣ suŋ shɛlikam ka naai yi yɛda tuma la tin ya o yiko ni.
en: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.

dag: Ka niriba ayi maa gba daa yɛli ba binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ sol ni mini bɛ ni daa lan baŋ o shɛm o bɔrɔbɔro ŋmahibu ni la yɛla.
en: The two then explained to them what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized the Lord when he broke the bread.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai sinsabiga maa gbin na n-kpalim zani lihi di zuɣu ka yɛli, Zakius, siɣimina yomyom, dama di kpala talahi ni n kpe a yiŋ zuŋɔ.
en: When Jesus came to that place, he looked up and said to Zacchaeus, Hurry down, Zacchaeus, because I must stay in your house today.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn daa bɔri taali ni yibu din ni yi zaligu dolibu ni Naawuni san la daa bi nya li zaligu maa dolibu puuni.
en: But though Israel was striving for a Law of righteousness, they didnt arrive.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Jɛrimia m-pahi buyi saha shɛli bɛ ni daa na kul kpar o duu duguliba dundɔŋ ni la.
en: While he was still confined to the prison quarters, the LORDs word came to Jeremiah a second time.

dag: Ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba, ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri ye n-chaŋ Amɔz bia anab Aizaia sani.
en: He sent Eliakim, the official in charge of the palace, Shebna, the court secretary, and the senior priests to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz. They also were wearing sackcloth.

dag: Ɛli ni daa wum kuhigu maa, ka o bɔhi, Ka bo vuri n-lee bala? Ka doo maa daa zɔna yomyom ti yɛli Ɛli di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He was years old and blind, but he could hear everyone crying, and he asked, What's all that noise? The soldier hurried over and told Eli.

dag: Ka jɛra la daa yɛli bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim la, Niŋmiya yi kpam ŋɔ shɛli ti ti, dama tinim firilanim maa kpirimi.
en: But the foolish girls said to the wise girls, Give us some of your oil. The oil in our lamps is all gone.

dag: N ku zaŋ n nuu kpɛhi bɛ yɛla ni. M mi ku be bɛ laɣiŋgu ni; dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ kuri niriba, ka chɛri chihiri naɣilahi jila ni di ti ba suhupiɛlli.
en: May I myself never enter their council. May my honor never be linked to their group; for when they were angry, they killed men, and whenever they wished, they maimed oxen.

dag: A ni mali sida dari pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a nyɛ naa maa? A ba daa pala ŋun diri ka nyura, ka niŋdi din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli? Dinzuɣu ka shɛlikam daa niŋ viɛnyɛla o sani.
en: Jehoiakim, having a lot of cedar in your house does not make you a great king. Your father Josiah was satisfied to have food and drink. He did what was right and fair, so everything went well for him.

dag: Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ leei Juda naa n-zali Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin zaani.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia made Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah in the place of Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, ka yi zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, dinzuɣu n ku lan fan ya bahi yaha.
en: But I'm not going to rescue you any more! You've left me and gone off to worship other gods. If you're in such big trouble, go and cry to them for help!.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su maa ni, ka n ti zaŋ dɔr biɛɣu niŋ so yil ni yi ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni fabili aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.

dag: Yaa n Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa, ka tumdi din tuhi a sani shɛm la yɛla. Ka Hɛzɛkia daa kum pam.
en: Lord , remember that I have sincerely served you with all my heart. I have done what you say is good. Then Hezekiah cried very hard.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ binshɛɣukam kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ maa.
en: Moses did everything exactly as the LORD had commanded him.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi zaŋ viɛlim ŋɔ tatabo ti mɔri din be mɔɣu ni zuŋɔ n-kaai biɛɣu ka buɣim diri li ŋɔ, di chaŋ wula ka o ku ti yinim situra? Laabira, yi yɛda shiri pɔra!.
en: If God dresses grass in the field so beautifully, even though its alive today and tomorrow its thrown into the furnace, wont God do much more for you, you people of weak faith?.

dag: Amaa ka Pita na kul ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara, ka bɛ daa kana ti yooi dunoli maa nya o, ka di gari ba pam.
en: Meanwhile, Peter remained outside, knocking at the gate. They finally opened the gate and saw him there, and they were astounded.

dag: Zilim balli maari suhuyiɣisili, amaa yɛtɔɣ yoli yiɣisirila nir suhu.
en: A gentle answer makes anger disappear, but a rough answer makes it grow.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ puhim Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: Moses instructed the Israelites to keep the Passover.

dag: ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa tiri ya ka di nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu ti yi bihi din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: he said, Be sure to obey all these commands that I have given you today. Repeat them to your children, so that they may faithfully obey all of God's teachings.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira nyɛla din gbarigiri nira, amaa yɛtɔɣ viɛlli nyɛla din kpaŋsiri nira.
en: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii niriba ayi zali; bɛna n-nyɛ: Yisifu so bɛ ni daa booni Barisabas mini Mataias.
en: So they nominated two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also known as Justus, and Matthias.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi daalahichi tumbu mini yi ni pa bɛn doli gunibu kali sol la zuɣu. Amaa ka Naawuni neei yi mini Masia kum ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka chɛ ti daalahichi zaa paŋ ti.
en: You were at one time spiritually dead because of your sins and because you were Gentiles without the Law. But God has now brought you to life with Christ. God forgave us all our sins;.

dag: ni Baalat ni Tama din be Juda tiŋgban ni mɔɣu ni la.
en: Baalath, and Tamar in the wilderness.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi ba, Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ ti paag o lua saha pala awa pinaayi? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam chani wuntaŋ ni bi tuura, ka di nyɛla o ni nyari dunia ŋɔ neesim la zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, Arent there twelve hours in the day? Whoever walks in the day doesnt stumble because they see the light of the world.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Everyone who has something will be given more. But people who don't have anything will lose what little they have.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mali taali. Yi ŋmanila goon wɔɣinli din tahi bɔɣi, di ku yuui ka di lu n-libigi niriba.
en: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble.

dag: Ŋuna n-yiɣisiri tarimba taŋkpaɣu ni, ka kpuɣiri nandaamba tampuli zuɣu ni o chɛ ka bɛ mini nabihi laɣim ʒini n-di kuɣ din mali jilima fali. Dama Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ daantalisi, ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ n-tam di zuɣu.
en: He lifts the poor from the dust and raises the needy from their misery. He makes them companions of princes and puts them in places of honor. The foundations of the earth belong to the Lord ; on them he has built the world.

dag: Tahimi pam, ka di shini! Duhim a kukoli kaman kikaa kumsi la n-yɛli n niriba Izraɛlnima bɛ tipawumli mini bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: Shout as loud as you can and dont stop. Shout like a trumpet! Tell the people what they did wrong. Tell the family of Jacob about their sins.

dag: Yɛnnim wuhibu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbiliga, di ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a person away from deathtraps.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha. Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla, ka bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a nyɛla Galili tiŋbia.
en: But Peter denied it again. A little while later the bystanders accused Peter again, You can't deny that you are one of them, because you, too, are from Galilee.

dag: Ka Ibizan daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Bɛtilihɛm.
en: then he died and was buried at Bethlehem.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa ti pahiri yuun pinaanahi ni, ka Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋd o daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Rɛfaim din be Ashitɛrɔtikarinaim tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Zuzim din be Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Ɛmim din be Shavɛkiriataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and his allies came with their armies and defeated the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in the plain of Kiriathaim.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: He will show you a large room upstairs already furnished. Prepare for us there.

dag: Amaa a yi lɔri noli, nyin paɣim a ninni, ka niŋ kpam ʒe a zuɣu.
en: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.

dag: O daa lan zali Lɛvinim maa shɛba ni bɛ nyɛ bɛn yɛn su Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa tuma, ka suhiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka puhir o ka paɣir o.
en: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Mani n-daa zaŋ sagbana pil li, ka zaŋ zibisim titali vil li.
en: It was I who covered the sea with clouds and wrapped it in darkness.

dag: Yawɛ, ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari hal ni bɔ saha? Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari maa hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa lab kuli, ka naa maa ti bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ŋmaligi labina.
en: and the messengers returned to the king. Why have you come back? he asked.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim polo nyɛla, di simdi ni yi zaa mali naŋgban yini, ka chɛ ka yi baɣa be nandahima ni paai shɛb yɛla ni, ka yumiya mabihili, ka maliya suhuballi, ka siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani.
en: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.

dag: n-doli Izraɛl doo maa ti kpe o duu puuni n-zaŋ kpani maa kuhi Izraɛl doo maa mini paɣ maa zaa puya ni ku ba. Ka alɔbo din daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu maa daa zani tariga.
en: and followed the man into his tent, where he ran the spear through the man and into the woman's stomach. The Lord immediately stopped punishing Israel with a deadly disease.

dag: Dama di luhiya ti mini Naawuni Shia Kasi sani ni ti di ʒili ya ʒi tibisa n-naɣ pahila yɛl shɛŋa din simdi niŋbu ŋɔ.
en: The Holy Spirit and we have agreed not to put any other burden on you besides these necessary rules:.

dag: Dama di ni yuui ka Izraɛlnim ku lan mali naa bee zuɣulana, ka ku lan mali maligu, ka binwɔɣila ku lan be bɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan mali wuni bee baɣibihi.
en: In the same way the people of Israel will continue many days without a king or a leader. They will be without a sacrifice or a memorial stone. They will be without an ephod or a household god.

dag: N yi yɛn kal li, di galisi gari bihigu. N yi gbihi nti neei, n kul bela a sani.
en: If I could count them, they would be more than all the grains of sand. But when I finished, I would have just begun.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ɛhud daa yi zɔntua maa ni na ka vooi di dunoya yo n-kpari li pa o zuɣu.
en: Ehud slipped out to the porch, and closed and locked the doors of the second-story room behind him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔhi daanya shɛli tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi ni pisinaanu.
en: The bronze which was dedicated to the Lord amounted to , pounds.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ doo maa yi tiŋ maa tariga nti pihi kuɣa lab ku o kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: So the whole community took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the Lord had commanded.

dag: A yi kpahi ninvuɣ so ŋun tahiri woligibu na zuɣu ni yim nti lan pahi buyi ka o bi taɣi, nyin di lan kal o pahi yi kalinli ni.
en: After a first and second warning, have nothing more to do with a person who causes conflict.

dag: Ka napɔŋ yi yɛli ni di pala nuu, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni; lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: The foot might say, I am not a hand, so I dont belong to the body. But saying this would not stop the foot from being a part of the body.

dag: Ka Ashikɛlɔnnim nya li, ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka Gazanim gba nya li, ka di zab ba pam. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛkurɔnnim gba, ka bɛ tahima zaa ni bɔrigi. Gaza ni kɔŋ naa, ka Ashikɛlɔn kpalim zan dabari.
en: Ashkelon will look and be afraid. Gaza will writhe in agony, and also Ekron, because her hope has dried up. The king will perish from Gaza; Ashkelon wont be inhabited.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lan yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash, Kpuɣim piɛma; ka o kpuɣ li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋm li fiɛb tiŋa; ka o zaŋ li fiɛb tiŋ buta ka chɛ lala.
en: Then Elisha told the king to take the other arrows and strike the ground with them. The king struck the ground three times, and then stopped.

dag: Di saha ka Asa daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini nayil la n-tim ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Naa Bɛnhadad ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa, ka be Damaskus la ka yɛl o.
en: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord 's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; Naawuni, kpuɣim a nuu zuɣusaa, di tam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu yɛla.
en: O Lord , punish those wicked people! Remember those who are suffering!.

dag: Kum yi mal a dimnima, nyin tim ba bindirigu ka bɛ di, ka kɔnyuri yi mali ba, nyin tim ba kom ka bɛ nyu;.
en: If your enemies are starving, feed them some bread; if they are thirsty, give them water to drink.

dag: Tinsi maa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ luɣ shɛŋa ti Lɛvinim maa yɛn zaŋla tinsi maa goma gbini n-chaŋ ti paai mita kɔbisinahi ni pihinu tariga n-gili tinsi maa.
en: The pastures of the cities that you must give to the Levites will extend from the wall of the city outward for one thousand five hundred feet in all directions.

dag: A daa zaɣisi a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la! Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ malila laasabuniŋdiba bɛn yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka mali baɣisi kaman Filisitianim la, ka zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai tinzunnima.
en: You have abandoned your people, house of Jacob. They are full of sorcerers from the east and fortune-tellers like the Philistines; they hold hands with foreigners children.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani ŋun tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ m-bala.
en: Jesus said to her, I Am—the one who speaks with you.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti miri Jɔpa, di saha ka Pita mi daa du jirambisa zuɣusaa ni o ti suhi Naawuni. Di daa nyɛla agbaa saha.
en: The next day, as they were on their way and coming near Joppa, Peter went up on the roof of the house about noon in order to pray.

dag: ka minya ni ninsal ni tum tuun suŋ shɛlikam, o ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, o yi nyɛla dabili bee bilichina.
en: Remember that the Lord will give everyone a reward for doing good. Everyone, slave or free, will get a reward for the good things they do.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiri shɛli yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina di lan pala alikauli lɔbu zuɣu; amaa Naawuni daa zaŋ li tila ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: If the inheritance were based upon the Law, it would no longer be from the promise. But God has given it graciously to Abraham through a promise.

dag: Di yi kpe n-gari kpe m-be kaman munaafichilana a niriba sunsuuni, ka miri ka a yi n-zani a kpee nyɛvili yihibu zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not go around spreading false stories against other people. Dont do anything that would put your neighbors life in danger. I am the Lord .

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi, ka niŋ tipawumli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. .
en: But if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword. The LORD has said this.

dag: Nyin Sulemaana n-su anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili maa, ka pukpariba maa mi su anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyiyi. Man malila mmaŋmaŋ dahalali wain tihi puu.
en: My vineyard, my very own, is before me. You can have the thousand, Solomon— with two hundred for those who tend the fruit!.

dag: Bom mɔɣu ni nimdi na ti duɣi n ni yuri bindir shɛli, ka n di ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni Yawɛ tooni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Your father said, Kill an animal for me to eat. Prepare the food for me, and I will eat it. Then, with the Lord as witness, I will bless you before I die.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi ninvuɣ so daadamnim puuni? Bee bɛ daa dɔɣ a mi pɔi ka daboya naanyi pili?.
en: Do you think you were the first person ever to be born? Were you born before the hills?.

dag: A ni daa na bi nam zoya bee a ni daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini dunia ŋɔ, nyini n-daa nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni.
en: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.

dag: N ni chɛ ka daadamnim nyabu ti niŋ tom kaman salima din viɛla nyabu ni to shɛm la, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyabu niŋ tom kaman Ofiri salima nyabu ni to shɛm la.
en: I will make humans scarcer than fine gold; people rarer than the gold of Ophir.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni daa yɛli ni n ni niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛl la, n daa bi diɛmdimi maa.
en: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim, ka tɛhi ni shɛli bi mali ya la, yiɣisimiya wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: You women who live an easy life, free from worries, listen to what I am saying.

dag: Nyama, n daa zaŋ o leela shɛhira niriba sani. Ka lan zaŋ o leei niriba toondana ni tɔbbihi zuɣulana.
en: I made him a leader and commander of nations, and through him I showed them my power.

dag: Bɛ malila bindirigu dibu shili, ka yɛrigi kpahisi sɔŋ nimaani, ka bɛ ʒini di ka nyu. Ka sapashin kpamba yiɣisi niŋ kpam mali bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: In the vision a banquet is ready; rugs are spread for the guests to sit on. They are eating and drinking. Suddenly the command rings out: Officers! Prepare your shields.

dag: Dindali maa, yɛlimiya yi bihi Yawɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa tin ya shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la, di zuɣu ka yi puhiri di chuɣu maa.
en: You should explain to your child on that day, Its because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N ka laɣifu din ni ti a, amaa n ni mali shɛli, dina ka n yɛn ti a: Yisa Masia Nazarɛt nir yuli zuɣu, yiɣisim zani n-leei ŋun chana.
en: Peter said, I dont have any money, but I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, rise up and walk.

dag: Bɛ ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la. Bɛ ŋumdimi, ka gbahiri bɛ ni yɛn gbahi biŋkɔb shɛba m-mali ba chana ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.

dag: Alikauli kurili maa yi di daa be dɛde, di di bi lan kpa talahi ni din pah ayi kana.
en: If the first covenant had been without fault, it wouldnt have made sense to expect a second.

dag: Dindali maa ka n daa po pɔri ni n ni yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni pun bo n-zali ba ka di nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa.
en: I swore that I would rescue them from Egypt and lead them to a land I had already chosen. This land was rich with milk and honey and was the most splendid land of all.

dag: Sool chandi maa dazɔhigu dali, Yawɛ daa pun daŋ kahigi wuhi Samuɛl yɛli.
en: Now on the previous day the Lord had told Samuel.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn teei do wɔbinyina gariti zuɣu, ka zaŋdi piɛla kara mini yi naɣikpahi ni naɣila kara n-kɔriti puhiri churi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Dauda, Nyama, Filistianim tuhirila Kɛilanima, ka fari bɛ bindira bɛ puri ni.
en: David heard that the Philistines were attacking the town of Keilah and were stealing the newly harvested grain.

dag: Bɛ yi wum ka jɛmd o, bɛ ni mali buni ni suhudoo hal ni bɛ nyɛvili tariga.
en: If they obey God and serve him, they live out their lives in peace and prosperity.

dag: Ka niriba tusaanahi niŋ dunɔguliba; ka niriba tusaanahi la mi zaŋdi n ni daa mali wumpaɣibo biŋkumdi shɛŋa la paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: four thousand to do guard duty, and four thousand to praise the Lord , using the musical instruments provided by the king for this purpose.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Rom ka bɛ chɛ ka Pool bo o dahalali duu beni, ka bɛ daa bo tɔbbi so nti zali nimaani ka o gul o.
en: When we entered Rome, Paul was permitted to live by himself, with a soldier guarding him.

dag: Duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa. Ŋuni n-lee nam saŋmarisi? Ŋuna ŋun zali ba zaɣ bɔbili maa mi bɛ kalinli, ka mi bɛ zaa yuya. O yaa ni o yiko ni galisi zuɣu, o na ʒi n-kali pooi bɛ ni so.
en: Look up at the sky! Who created the stars you see? The one who leads them out like an army, he knows how many there are and calls each one by name! His power is so great— not one of them is ever missing!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu n-da Samaria daboli Shɛmɛr sani m-me tiŋ tam di zuɣu, ka boli di yuli Samaria ŋ-ŋmahindi Shɛmɛr ŋun daa su daboli maa yuli.
en: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two kikkars of silver. He fortified the hill and named the town that he built there after Shemer, the previous owner of the hill of Samaria.

dag: Din gari shɛlikam nyɛla, kul yumiya taba ni yɛlimaŋli, dama yurilim limsiri taali balibu pam.
en: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.

dag: N zahindi maa puuni, n daa lan nya ka kawana ayopɔin nyaɣi tam kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu n-kul ŋmɛlim baribara;.
en: I also dreamed that I saw seven heads of grain growing on one stalk. The heads were full and ripe.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti, ka yihi ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim luɣ yini, ka ti paɣ a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka ti a jilima ti paɣibu maa puuni.
en: Lord our God, save us! Bring us back together from those nations. Then we will give thanks to your holy name and joyfully praise you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ suhuri ni ye Shia Kasi pina bɔbu zuɣu shɛm, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye din ni kpaŋsi cheechi ni niriba gba zuɣu lala.
en: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.

dag: M puhiri Akuila mini Prisila bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Yisa Masia ni la.
en: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila, who have worked together with me for Christ Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣira ata maa daa chaŋ ti tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm samban ni dunɔdali shee kɔbiliga maa ni ti tooi kom maa na ti ti Dauda ni o nyu. Amaa ka o daa bi nyu li, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: So the three warriors broke through the Philistine camp and drew water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it and poured it out to the LORD.

dag: ni n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi mini teeku noli bihigu la. Ka a zuliya maa ni ti deei bɛ dimnim tinsi su;.
en: I will bless you richly and I will give you countless descendants, as many as the stars in the sky and as the grains of sand on the seashore. They will conquer their enemies cities.

dag: ni Chɛsɛd ni Hazo ni Pilidash ni Jidilaf ni Bɛtuɛl.
en: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɛla zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni di bɛ tuma nyɔri.
en: Tell the good people who do what is right that good things will happen to them. They will receive a reward for what they do.

dag: Ka o daa lihi bɛn ʒi o sani maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he looked at the people sitting around him and said, Here are my mother and my brothers.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tahiri yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka bɛn la mi yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; dama salo daa kul tahirila yiriŋ, hal bɛ shɛb daa bi mi din chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna.
en: Meanwhile the whole meeting was in an uproar: some people were shouting one thing, others were shouting something else, because most of them did not even know why they had come together.

dag: Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim jɛmbu.
en: After King Ahab died, Moab broke away from Israels rule.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba n-tum kaman Ɛhab min o daŋ ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o paɣ daa nyɛla Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: But Jehoram lived as the kings of Israel and did what the Lord saw as evil. He lived as the people from Ahabs family, because his wife was Ahabs daughter.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mini saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The same regulations apply to native-born Israelites and to foreigners who settle among you.

dag: Niriba ayi bee niriba ata yi di shɛhira yin kumiy o. Miriya ka yi ku nira ninvuɣ yino kɔŋkɔ shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: However, they may be put to death only if two or more witnesses testify against them; they are not to be put to death if there is only one witness.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda Naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba tɔbu ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: But Amaziah refused to listen, so King Jehoash marched out with his men and fought against him at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka zuɣusaa paɣ a daalahiziba tuma, ka chɛ ka a ʒiɛyimtali kul be a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Heaven thanks you for your wondrous acts, LORD— for your faithfulness too— in the assembly of the holy ones.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya sokam talahi tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ninkura mini bihi ni karimbanim ni karimbihi zaa.
en: To determine the assignment of duties they all drew lots, whether they were young or old, experts or beginners.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli nachimbil maa, Miri ka a yɛli so ni a kana ti yɛli ma yɛlli maa. Ka daa chɛ ka o yi n-kuli.
en: The commander sent the young man away, telling him, Dont tell anyone that you have told me about their plan.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali Bia maa mali nyɛvili; ka ŋunkam mi ka Naawuni Bia maa ka nyɛvili.
en: Whoever has the Son has this life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vooi li kpɛhi di puuni; ka bo mihi lo ŋarin titali maa gba kiŋkiŋ. Bɛ ni daa zɔri ni bɛ ti chaŋ ti firi Libia kulinol bihigu ni zuɣu ka bɛ daa sirigi tanti din sɔŋdi ŋariŋ maa ka di chanila lo tiŋli, ka pɔhim daa ʒiɛri ti chana.
en: but finally we got it where it belonged. Then the sailors wrapped ropes around the ship to hold it together. They lowered the sail and let the ship drift along, because they were afraid it might hit the sandbanks in the gulf of Syrtis.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi alahichi, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu.
en: If good people start doing evil, they will be put to death, because they have sinned.

dag: Ka chɛchɛbun duhiriba mini wɔribariba daa pahi dol o chaŋ. Niriba maa daa galisiya pam.
en: Men in chariots and men on horseback also went with him; it was a huge group.

dag: Ka biasan la gba daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Bɛnammi. O yaansi n-nyɛ Ammɔnnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son. She named him Ben-Ammi. Ben-Ammi is the ancestor of all the Ammonites living today.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked at them and said, This is something that people cannot do. But God can do anything.

dag: Anabinim mini karimbanim daa be Antiɔk cheechi ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ Baanabas mini Simiɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Naija la ni Lusius ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini tiŋbia la mini Manaɛn, bɛ ni daa laɣim wumsi so mini Naa Hɛrɔd la m-pahi Sool.
en: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini teeku kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: Why are you so frightened? Jesus answered. What little faith you have! Then he got up and ordered the winds and the waves to stop, and there was a great calm.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa yɛl o, A ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: Jethro replied: That isn't the best way to do it.

dag: N sabi n zaligunim paai ʒiibutuhili ti ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi li, ka tɛhi ni di nyɛla zaɣ pala.
en: I write down countless teachings for the people, but they reject them as strange and foreign.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Musa, Ti kpe yɔɣu, ti zaa ni kpi.
en: The people of Israel said to Moses, Then that's the end of us!.

dag: O tim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlana ŋun yi o dabili Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: He has raised up a mighty savior for us in his servant Davids house.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛli, M bia maa ku doli ya chaŋ, dama o biɛli kpiya, ka o kɔŋko n-kpalim. Shɛli yi niŋ o yi ni yɛn chaŋ chandi shɛli ŋɔ ni, yi ni chɛ ka n dɔni kabiri puuni ni n kɔb piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: But Jacob said, I will not let Benjamin go with you. His brother is dead, and he is the only son left from my wife Rachel. It would kill me if anything happened to him during the trip to Egypt. You would send me to the grave a very sad, old man.

dag: Amaa n dabili Kalɛb ni mali tɛhi shɛl la min o ni doli ma ni o suhu zaa la zuɣu, n ni zaŋ o kulis o ni daa chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka o zuliya ti su li.
en: But Ill bring my servant Caleb into the land that he explored, and his descendants will possess it because he has a different spirit, and he has remained true to me.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o bɔri ni yi nabi ka tɔŋ la, lala ka di ni lan niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o chɛ ka yi lu m-bahi yoli zaa, ka bɛ ti yihi ya yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti deei li su maa ni.
en: And just as before, the LORD enjoyed doing good things for you and increasing your numbers, now the LORD will enjoy annihilating and destroying you. You will be torn off the very fertile land you are entering to possess.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga yɛn nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli. Yi wulinluhili polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: Your western border will be the Mediterranean Sea. This will be your western border.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi niŋ ania din ni chɛ ka yi tum Naawuni yubu, ka nya o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la palibu.
en: You must be patient. After you have done what God wants, you will get what he promised you.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garigi paɣ maa ni bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa zaa; ka shɛli daa kani ka naa kɔŋ li kahigi wuh o.
en: He answered them all; there was nothing too difficult for him to explain.

dag: Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni ka gbib ya;.
en: May the Lord bless you and keep you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu ni bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba bahi yoli.
en: in the same way your Father in heaven does not want any of these little children to be lost.

dag: Naawuni bi zali ti ni o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ti di ti, amaa o zali ti ni ti nyala tiliginsim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: God did not choose us to suffer his anger. God chose us to have salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ banim paɣiba doon a ni. Bɛ muɣisiri paɣ shɛb bɛn nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai m-mali ba doon a ni.
en: Men have sex with their father's wife or with women who are having their monthly period.

dag: N ni ti ti ba tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ ku lan kpi kum tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yaha. Ka zuliya shɛb ku lan tu ba yaha.
en: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.

dag: Bɛn guuri pam ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka tɔbbihi ku tooi zo n-tiligi, Bɛ tuuya lu Yufretiiz Mɔɣili nuzaa polo.
en: Fast men cannot run away. Strong soldiers cannot escape. They will all stumble and fall. This will happen in the north, by the Euphrates River.

dag: N ni ti ba nyɛvil wɔɣinli; ka wuhi ba n tiliginsim.
en: I will give my followers a long life and show them my power to save.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o pukpar kpɛma, Nyama, zuŋɔ yuma ata m-bɔŋɔ ka n kul kanna ti bɔri tia ŋɔ wala ka bi nyara; dinzuɣu ŋmaam li bahi! Bɔzuɣu ka nir ni chɛ li zali ka di kul nyuri tam yoli.
en: He said to his gardener, Look, Ive come looking for fruit on this fig tree for the past three years, and Ive never found any. Cut it down! Why should it continue depleting the soils nutrients.

dag: ka kɔŋlan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: A man with a skin disease came, kneeled before him, and said, Lord, if you want, you can make me clean.

dag: N ni yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni na, ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni laɣim taba n-zaŋ ba tahi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni ti dihiri ba Izraɛl zoya zuɣu mini kom ni be luɣ shɛŋa ni ni niriba ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: I will take them out of foreign countries, gather them together, and bring them back to their own land. I will lead them back to the mountains and the streams of Israel and will feed them in pleasant pastures.

dag: Bɛnjamin bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Jɛdiayɛl, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Benjamin had three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.

dag: Saha shɛli Samuɛl ni daa be Ɛli sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma maa, Yawɛ daa bi lan tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka niriba daa bi lan nyari ʒiinim waawaayili.
en: Now the boy Samuel was serving the LORD under Eli. The LORDs word was rare at that time, and visions werent widely known.

dag: Bɛ ka zuɣulana bee sapashin kpɛma.
en: Ants don't have leaders.

dag: amaa ti ni niŋdi shɛlikam puuni, ti kpaŋdila timaŋa ni ti wuhi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba. Ti wuhiri li ania niŋbu pam puuni mini nahiŋgu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni wahala dibu puuni.
en: Instead, we commend ourselves as ministers of God in every way. We did this with our great endurance through problems, disasters, and stressful situations.

dag: dama o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima Masia tuma zuɣu hal ti kpi. O daa niŋ lala ni o ti ma la sɔŋsim shɛli yi ni daa naan ku tooi ti ma.
en: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.

dag: N kul nɛla yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka m bɔhim a daalikaulinim yɛla.
en: All night long I lie awake, to meditate on your instructions.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhilituhili bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na maa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa gbibi Naawuni jɛmbu shee lahi mini kikahi din ni piɛbi boli niriba o nuu ni la chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses sent these , men to war. He sent Phinehas son of Eleazar with them as the priest. Phinehas took the holy things and the horns and trumpets with him.

dag: Ka bɛn be ŋariŋ maa ni daa jɛm o ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni Bia n-shiri nyɛ a.
en: The men in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, You really are the Son of God.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd n-daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira n-lo o mihi kpɛhi duu ŋun Hɛrɔd tizo Filip paɣa Hɛrɔdias zuɣu.
en: Herod had earlier arrested John and had him chained and put in prison. He did this because John had told him, It isn't right for you to take Herodias, the wife of your brother Philip.

dag: Ŋuna n-yihiri teeku bulli puuni zibisim, ka chɛ ka neesim neeri zibisim titali ni.
en: He sends light to places dark as death.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ni nyɛ daba ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni zaa daa zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: that their enemies had pity on them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa piɛbi kikahi; ka niriba maa tahira. Niriba maa ni daa kul wum kikahi maa kumsi; bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee tahiri pampam, ka tiŋ maa goondaa maa dii kabi ti lu tiŋa; ka niriba maa dii zɔri tuhi bɛ tooni dɛde n-kab kpe tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li.
en: So the priests blew the trumpets. As soon as the people heard it, they gave a loud shout, and the walls collapsed. Then all the army went straight up the hill into the city and captured it.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wuhirila n ʒiɛyimtali n suhu ni, ka n ni mi shɛli dina, ka n yɛn yɛli ni n suhu zaa.
en: All my words are sincere, and I am speaking the truth.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni tuɣili Ijiptinima, ka bɛ tuhi taba. Nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee ni tuhi taba, ka tins ayinim tuhi taba, ka nanim tuhi taba.
en: The Lord says, I will stir up civil war in Egypt and turn brother against brother and neighbor against neighbor. Rival cities will fight each other, and rival kings will struggle for power.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti mini Pool chaŋ ti puhi Jeemsi, ka cheechi kpamba la zaa gba daa be o sani.
en: The next day Paul went with us to visit James, and all the elders were there.

dag: A ni ti du n-tam gbuɣima mini tinvura zuɣu; a ni du n-tam gbuɣim polli mini wɔɣimaha zuɣu n-no ba.
en: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa guhi hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman Samuɛl ni daa zal o shɛm, amaa ka Samuɛl daa na bi ka Giligal na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sool sani maa ti zɔri ka chɛr o.
en: He waited seven days for Samuel, as Samuel had instructed him to do, but Samuel still had not come to Gilgal. The people began to desert Saul.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini ni ŋun fari ma bahira.
en: Our Lord and our God, you are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector.

dag: N suhu yɛliya, Kamina ti jɛm o. Yawɛ, nyini ka n shiri ni jɛm;.
en: My heart told me to come to you, Lord , so I am coming to ask for your help.

dag: Ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui daa mali me yaɣ shɛli m-pan o zuɣu. O daa kpuɣi li la Azaria yiŋ hal ti paai gooni maa gɔŋbu shee.
en: After him, Binnui, Henadads son, repaired another section from the house of Azariah to the Angle and to the corner.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti niŋ lala, dama ti ni yɛn mali sara shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa nyɛla din chihiri Ijiptinim sani. Ka ti yi mali sara shɛli din chihiri bɛ sani bɛ ninni, bɛ ni lab ti kuɣa ku ti.
en: But Moses said, It would not be right to do that. The Egyptians think it is terrible to kill animals as sacrifices for the Lord our God. If we do this here, the Egyptians will see us and throw stones at us and kill us.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Naawuni daa ka Naa Sulemaana sanna ti yɛl o, Suhimi ma a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: That night God came to Solomon and said, Ask me for whatever you want me to give you.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, ka ti zaa ti ŋma dari na nti me duri pahi beni. Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Chamiya.
en: Lets go to the Jordan River and cut some wood. Each of us will get a log and we will build us a place to live there. Elisha answered, Go and do it.

dag: N ni baŋ ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: All the time that I have known you, you have refused to obey the Lord .

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani bɔh o, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ?.
en: The High Priest stood up and said to Jesus, Have you no answer to give to this accusation against you.

dag: Yi tamla Naawuni ni zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ omaŋmaŋ bihi la yɛla? O yɛliya: M bia, a Duuma yi saɣis a, nyin wumma; ka o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu miligi.
en: and you have forgotten the encouragement that addresses you as sons and daughters: My child, dont make light of the Lords discipline or give up when you are corrected by him, .

dag: A ni tooi gbahi binnɛma ti gbuɣinli bee n-dihi gbuɣimbihi ka bɛ tiɣi.
en: Can you hunt prey for the lion or fill the cravings of lion cubs?.

dag: Ŋuna n-simdi yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To him be the power forever! Amen.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ni yɛn zo n-kuli luɣ shɛli tiligi. So yi bi yuri ka ku o kpee ka di mi pala dimdi pun bela bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni.
en: This is the rule for someone who kills another person and runs to one of these three cities for safety: It must be someone who killed another person accidentally, not out of hatred.

dag: Di ku paai yuuni ka yinim bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ ni sɔhigi. Wain tihi ku wali, ka di daatam kpuɣibu ku beni.
en: You feel safe now, but after one year you will be troubled. That is because you will not gather grapes next year—there will be no grapes to gather.

dag: Naa Zɛdɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni moli faako tibu molo la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: King Zedekiah had made an agreement with all the people in Jerusalem to give freedom to all the Hebrew slaves. A message from the Lord came to Jeremiah after Zedekiah had made that agreement.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa ti mali salima binnani, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li zali palo ni Babilɔn luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Dura.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar had a gold idol made that was cubits high and cubits wide. Then he set the idol up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba, ka yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: One day Jesus was in the Temple area teaching the people. He was telling them the Good News. The leading priests, teachers of the law, and older Jewish leaders came to talk to Jesus.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋgbuna zaa kul biɛrimi, ka n daalahichi mi zuɣu chɛ ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: You punished me severely, so my whole body is sore. I sinned, and now all my bones hurt.

dag: O chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali di saha; ka din pahi nyɛla, o chɛ ka ti mi din pun niŋ, din saha gari mini din na yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla. Amaa ka ti lee ku tooi baŋ ŋun Naawuni ni pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha ni o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm di bahigu ni.
en: God has made everything fitting in its time, but has also placed eternity in their hearts, without enabling them to discover what God has done from beginning to end.

dag: Dama n daa bi dee li la ninsal sani; pa so mi n-daa zaŋ li wuhi ma, amaa di yila Yisa Masia ŋun daa kahigi li wuhi ma la sanna.
en: I did not receive it from any human being, nor did anyone teach it to me. It was Jesus Christ himself who revealed it to me.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul yɛla binshɛŋa din be nimaani zuɣu, ka pa ni binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni zuɣu.
en: Think about the things above and not things on earth.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul bɔrila duŋtaabo, amaa bɛ ni tim tumo ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana ka o lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira Sintani yiko ni, ka mali yiko pam din ni tum alahiziba tuma balibu kam ka wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa din nyɛ yɔhiŋgu.
en: When that Man of Evil comes, it will be the work of Satan. He will come with great power, and he will do all kinds of false miracles, signs, and wonders.

dag: Di saha Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni ti chaŋ ti kuhi niŋ bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi wun shɛŋa maa, amaa bɛ kul ku tooi tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha.
en: Then the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem will call upon the gods they worship, but they wont save them when disaster strikes.

dag: Ka yiɣisi guui chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, M bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni. Ka o daa labi ti dɔni.
en: Samuel thought Eli was calling him, so he ran to Eli and said, Here I am. You called me. But Eli said, I didnt call you. Go back to bed. So Samuel went back to bed.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ vinnyaɣilana o duu yɔɣira gɔŋdimi, ka o baɣa yi ka di ni, o duu maa ti yindimi.
en: When you are too lazy to repair your roof, it will leak, and the house will fall in.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa zaa m-pahi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: They took all the people and animals.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni tumtumdiba, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn tumd o yubu ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ.
en: All you heavenly forces, bless the LORD! All you who serve him and do his will, bless him!.

dag: Ijipti naa, a yɛnnim la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yɛl a Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm.
en: Egypt, where are your wise men? They should learn what the Lord All-Powerful has planned for Egypt. They should be the ones to tell you what will happen.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Mani m-bala.
en: Don't be afraid, Jesus told them, it is I.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o nuu pa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa zuɣu, ka niriba maa daa lan nab pahi ka niŋ yaa.
en: God was good to the two women because they truly respected him, and he blessed them with children of their own. The Hebrews kept increasing.

dag: N ni yirigi n zana pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni; amaa o nini ti ku nya li, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: But I will spread out my net and trap him in it. Then I will take him to the city of Babylon, where he will die without having seen it.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kuri yi liɣiri binshɛli din pa bindirigu zuɣu, ka tumdi tuma din ku tiɣi ya zuɣu? Wummiya n yɛligu viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dinya din viɛla ni bindir suma ni yɛlimaŋli.
