en: Why spend money for what isnt food, and your earnings for what doesnt satisfy? Listen carefully to me and eat what is good; enjoy the richest of feasts.

dag: Amaa bɛ gul maa yi nya ka tɔbu kanna, ka o bi piɛbi kikaa maa, ka niriba maa bi baŋ ka tɔbu maa di ba, bɛ daalahichi zuɣu ka tɔbu maa di ba maa, amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ kum maa taali ʒilila bɛ gula maa.
en: If, however, the lookout sees the enemy coming and does not sound the alarm, the enemy will come and kill those sinners, but I will hold the lookout responsible for their death.

dag: Yihimiya li bɛ tarili maa ni n-zaŋ ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza ka o zaŋ mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Give them to Eleazar the priest as a special contribution to the Lord .

dag: Deemiya tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ʒin di ni, dama mani n-zaŋ li tin ya ni yi su li.
en: Occupy the land and settle in it, because I am giving it to you.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka do so daa ti yi Baalishalisha n-ʒi bindir pala din nyɛ kapala bɔrɔbɔro kpil pisi mini kawaan maha o kpalaŋ ni na nti ti Naawuni nir maa. Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm li ti niriba maa ka bɛ ŋubi.
en: Another time, a man came from Baal Shalishah, bringing Elisha twenty loaves of bread made from the first barley harvested that year, and some freshly-cut heads of grain. Elisha told his servant to feed the group of prophets with this.

dag: amaa ka ŋmani maa daa yiɣi chaŋ ti bi nya o ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu, dama kom maa daa na kul tɛlila tiŋgbani luɣilikam zaa. Ka o daa lab o sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka o ti zaŋ o nuu tiri takɔro maa ni n-gbaag o kpɛh o sani ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: but since the water still covered all the land, the dove did not find a place to light. It flew back to the boat, and Noah reached out and took it in.

dag: N yɛli noli tin ya, dama yi zuliya maa zaa fari ma mi.
en: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Jɔshua sani; ka o yuli daa du pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.

dag: So tuma yi ti kpalim be o ni zaŋ shɛli me n-tam duu gbinni tanzaa maa zuɣu, o ni deei di laara.
en: If anyones work survives, theyll get a reward.

dag: N yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la yimaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, ka pa ni m bɔrimi ni n zali ya din ni gun ya soli, amaa m bɔrimi ni yi doli din tuhi mini din viɛla n-jɛmdi Naawuni ni suhu yini.
en: Im saying this for your own advantage. Its not to restrict you but rather to promote effective and consistent service to the Lord without distraction.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu: Bɛ ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku nya shɛli. Ka wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ bɛ ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Dama bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani, ka o chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba. .
en: This is so that they can look and see but have no insight, and they can hear but not understand. Otherwise, they might turn their lives around and be forgiven.

dag: N lihila a daalikauli soli hal ka n nina ti fulim; ka m bɔhira, Ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: My eyes are tired from watching for what you promised, while I ask, When will you help me.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa chɛ ka tuumba ʒi sida dakuɣiri chaŋ ti ti Dauda. O daa bola tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ ti me Dauda yili ti o.
en: Tyres King Hiram sent messengers to David with cedar logs, bricklayers, and carpenters to build David a palace.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin mini zahim maa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, gave thanks to God, broke them, and gave them to the disciples; and the disciples gave them to the people.

dag: Ka di simdi ni ŋun nyo li maa paɣ o situra ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni na.
en: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and take a bath before he returns to camp.

dag: Ka sagbana mini sakuɣa ni sala buɣim daa puhi yi neesim din be o tooni maa ni na.
en: Hailstones and flashes of fire came from the lightning before him and broke through the dark clouds.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbihi, ka maligumaaniba maa daa taɣi bɛ ʒim n-zaŋ li mihi sara maligu bimbini maa, ka Lɛvinim mi shiri biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: The Passover lambs were killed. Then the Levites skinned the animals and gave the blood to the priests. The priests sprinkled the blood on the altar.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and its towns around it will be put to the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Kiriatijiarim mini Chɛfira ni Bɛrɔt — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaata.
en: of Kiriatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛ ʒiʒiinitab maa zaa, ka yɛlli ŋɔ daa moli gili Judia zoya zuɣu tinsi zaa.
en: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.

dag: Ka o paɣ Zipɔra daa bo kuɣili din dira n-gun o bidibiga, ka zaŋ di ʒim ʒe Musa naba ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ, a nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: Then Zipporah, his wife, took a sharp stone, cut off the foreskin of her son, and touched Moses' feet with it. Because of the rite of circumcision she said to Moses, You are a husband of blood to me. And so the Lord spared Moses' life.

dag: dama binnamda zaa leela binchɔɣima, ka di pala binnamda maa yubu zuɣu. Naawuni ni yu ni di niŋ shɛm m-bala, amaa ka o lee ti binnamda maa tahima.
en: Everything God made was allowed to become like something that cannot fulfill its purpose. That was not its choice, but God made it happen with this hope in view:.

dag: Lala ka n ti yɛn yiɣisi n suhu bahi gooni maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ya, Gooni maa lan kani, ka bɛn daa zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa gba lan kani.
en: I will finish showing my anger against the wall and those who put plaster on it. Then I will say, There is no wall, and there are no workers to put plaster on it.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Gɛhaazi, Malim shili kpuɣi n jaaŋgbee ŋɔ chaŋ. A yi ti nya so sol ni, nyin di puh o; ka so yi puh a, nyin di saɣi. A yi ti paai, nyin zaŋmi n jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni.
en: Then Elisha said to Gehazi, Get ready to go. Take my walking stick and go! If you meet anyone along the way, dont even stop to say hello to him. If anyone says hello to you, dont answer. Put my walking stick on the childs face.

dag: N kul bela filiŋ ni dabisili kam; ka vi kul mali ma;.
en: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.

dag: Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo; m bi kamina ni n ti ti suhudoo, amaa takɔbi ka n tahina.
en: Do not think that I have come to bring peace to the world. No, I did not come to bring peace, but a sword.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa mali Shɛkɛm din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni la me m-be nimaani; ka daa ti lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti me Pɛnuɛl.
en: King Jeroboam of Israel fortified the town of Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there for a while. Then he left and fortified the town of Penuel.

dag: Wuntizɔriba firilanim kul nɛmi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri firilanim kpira.
en: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa kul muɣisiri ba ka yɛra, Tummiya yi tuma naari dabisili kam kaman bɛ ni yi tiri ya mɔri ka yi tumdi li shɛm maa.
en: The slave masters forced the people to work even harder. They forced the people to make as many bricks as before.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa zaa naai, ka o daa zaŋ o ba Naa Dauda ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nɛma zaashee.
en: When all of Solomons work on the LORDs temple was finished, he brought the silver, gold, and all the objects his father David had dedicated and put them in the treasuries of Gods temple.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Saimɔn n-chaŋ Yisa sani. Ka Yisa daa ti yul o ka yɛl o, Nyini n-nyɛ Saimɔn, Jɔn bia la. Ka lan yɛl o, Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a yuli m-booni Siifas. Yuli ŋɔ mini Pita nyɛla zaɣ yini. Di gbinni nyɛla Kuɣili.
en: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas. This name can be translated as Peter.

dag: A ni tooi tim saanyaɣisibu ka di chaŋ ka labina ti yɛl a, Mani m-bɔŋɔ?.
en: And if you command the lightning to flash, will it come to you and say, At your service?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpahimiya yi nuhi, ka zaŋ yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yɛra: Mbaye! Izraɛlnim ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛli din chihiri la zuɣu. Dama bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ shɛba, ka kum ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka alɔbo mi ti di bɛ shɛba.
en: Then the Lord GOD said to me, Clap your hands and stamp your feet. Speak against all the terrible things that the people of Israel have done. Warn them that they will be killed by disease and hunger. Tell them they will be killed in war.

dag: M pun nyaŋ Kalino mini Karikɛmish, ka nyaŋ Hamat mini Aripad, ka nyaŋ Samaria mini Damaskus.
en: The city of Calno is no better than the city of Carchemish. Arpad is like Hamath, and Samaria is like Damascus.

dag: Farigudeeriba mini alahichinim zaa daa kul laɣindila Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti wum o wuhibu;.
en: Tax collectors and sinners were all crowding around to listen to Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini n-zaŋ doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo ni bɛ lɔɣi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ maa gari. Ka niriba maa suhuri daa ti yiɣisi pam soli maa ni.
en: They marched from Mount Hor on the Reed Sea road around the land of Edom. The people became impatient on the road.

dag: Sool bidibisi daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Ishivi ni Malikishua; ka o bipuɣins ayi mi yuya daa booni Mɛrab, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bipuɣin kpɛma, ka biasani mi yuli booni Mikal.
en: Saul's sons were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua. His older daughter was named Merab, and the younger one Michal.

dag: Ka Jɛbusi tiŋbihi maa daa yɛli Dauda, A ku kuli ya ŋɔ na. Amaa ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: The people who lived in Jebus told David, Youll never get in here! But David captured the mountain fortress of Zion, which became Davids City.

dag: Nyin daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi ni yɛri shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti biriginsim mini ti daalahichi tibisim marigi ti mi ka ti tarigi. Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ be.
en: You, human one, say to the house of Israel: This is what all of you are saying: How our transgressions and our sins weigh on us! We waste away because of them. How can we live.

dag: Di saha ka zuliya bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn gili ya la zaa ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali luɣ shɛŋa din daa wurim maa me, ka labi biri luɣ shɛŋa din daa leei tiŋgban nɛl la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka ni niŋ li.
en: The surviving nations around you will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was torn down and have planted what was made desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.

dag: ni kikahi kumsi ni kukoli yɛtɔɣa vubu din mali dabiɛm hal ka bɛn daa wum li suhi Naawuni ni o di lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yaha la.
en: the blast of a trumpet, and the sound of a voice. When the people heard the voice, they begged not to hear another word.

dag: Bɛ daa mali bɛ ni shɛb ansarisi ka fiɛb ba, ka daa ga shɛb zoligɔnima n-zaŋ ba kpɛhi duu.
en: Some were mocked and whipped, and others were put in chains and taken off to prison.

dag: Ka niriba maa ti labi ba kuɣa, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba. Bɛ ni ti ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka nyo bɛ yiya buɣim.
en: They will stone you to death and cut you to pieces; they will kill your children and burn down your houses.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti yi o nyaandoliba piniyini bɛn daa kpalim la zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒimi diri bindirigu. Ka o daa galim ba bɛ ni nyɛ suhutunanim mini bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la yɛligu yɛda.
en: Last of all, Jesus appeared to the eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them, because they did not have faith and because they were too stubborn to believe those who had seen him alive.

dag: Bɛ kul mɛrila buɣili Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Vinvamli ni la jɛmbu shee ni bɛ zaŋdi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyɔri buɣim, ka di pala n ni zali shɛli, ka mi pala din yi n tɛha ni na.
en: In Hinnom Valley they have built an altar called Topheth, so that they can sacrifice their sons and daughters in the fire. I did not command them to do this—it did not even enter my mind.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nina ti ku ne, ka bɛ ti ku mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛŋa zo n-tiligi, ka bɛ tahima ti yɛn nyɛla bɛ vuhim ŋmaabu.
en: But the wicked will look around in despair and find that there is no way to escape. Their one hope is that death will come.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisa ni daa ti paai kaman yuun pihita, ka o daa piligi o tuma, ka niriba daa tɛhi ni o nyɛla Yisifu bia. Yisifu daa nyɛla Hɛli bia.
en: When Jesus began his work, he was about thirty years old. He was the son, so people thought, of Joseph, who was the son of Heli.

dag: Bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ lihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini luɣ kasi shee maa, ka lan sɔŋdi bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni tuma ni.
en: They were given the responsibility of taking care of the Tent of the Lord 's presence and the Temple, and of assisting their relatives, the priests descended from Aaron, in the Temple worship.

dag: ka Hɔri bia Shafat daa yi Simiɔn zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat, Horis son.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, A niriba maa galisiya pam ni n zaŋ Midiannim niŋ bɛ nuu ni. Di yi niŋ lala Izraɛlnim ni nyu bara niŋ ma ka yɛli, Tinima n-tuhi fa timaŋa.
en: The Lord said, Gideon, your army is too big. I can't let you win with this many soldiers. The Israelites would think that they had won the battle all by themselves and that I didn't have anything to do with it.

dag: Ka so yi tum taali zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli polo, di simdi ni o zani yim zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum taal shɛli maa polo.
en: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: He made the poles of acacia wood and covered them with gold.

dag: Shaharaim daa dɔɣi bidibisi Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa kar o paɣiba bɛn yuya daa booni Hushim mini Baara la nyaaŋa.
en: Shaharaim divorced two wives, Hushim and Baara. Later, when he lived in the country of Moab, he married Hodesh and had seven sons: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul tam luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani zuɣu, n ni zaŋ li tin ya kaman n ni daa pun lo Musa alikauli yɛli shɛm la.
en: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.

dag: Ŋun yɛn da kul yɛrimi, Di mali shaara, di mali shaara, di nyaaŋa ka o chaŋ ha ti nyuri bara.
en: The customer always complains that the price is too high, but then he goes off and brags about the bargain he got.

dag: ka chɛ ka sochandiba ku yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni! Ti suhir alibarika tiri ya Yawɛ yuli zuɣu.
en: May no one walking by those wicked people ever say, May the Lord bless you! We bless you in the name of the Lord .

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chaŋ alizanda ni nti be Naawuni nudirigu polo n-su malaikanim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni bɛn nyɛ yikolaannim la.
en: who has gone to heaven and is at the right side of God, ruling over all angels and heavenly authorities and powers.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa na be n sani, ka m bihi na be n san la.
en: Almighty God was with me then, and I was surrounded by all my children.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛl o malaika tab bɛn ʒe o tooni, Yeemiya doo maa ni ye binyɛr daɣ shɛŋa maa. Di saha maa ka o daa yɛli Jɔshua, N yihila a daalahichi, ka yɛn zaŋ binyɛr suma yɛl a.
en: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu, miriya ka yi doli zaligusaɣindiba ŋɔ biriginsim soli maa ka kɔŋ yimaŋmaŋ ʒiɛyimtali zaashee la ni zanibu.
en: Dear friends, you already know about this. So be careful. Dont let these evil people lead you away by the wrong they do. Be careful that you do not fall from your strong faith.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim, ka di pa dari zuɣu m-be sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: Aarons sons will completely burn all of this on the altar—along with the entirely burned offering on the wood that is on the altar fire—as a food gift of soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Jɛrimia daa sabila yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn lu Babilɔnnim zuɣu mini yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa sabi zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo la.
en: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri lu bɛ fɔntinsinim zuɣu ŋ-ŋme n-kabisi kur shɛŋa din kpari bɛ dunɔdaya la, ka ku ba bɛ birininim ni.
en: The sword will strike wildly in their cities; it will consume the bars of their gates and will take everything because of their schemes.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa balim o yɛli, Karimba, dim bindirigu.
en: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, Teacher, please eat something.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Shɛm ni; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: I ask the Lord my God to bless Shem and make Canaan his slave.

dag: Dama yi yi taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma ka be yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ tab sani.
en: If you change your lives and do good things, I will let you live in this place. You must be fair to each other.

dag: O daa lan dɔɣi bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters.

dag: Aduna bihi n-daa nyɛ Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron had four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla m mini n niriba kɔhi ni bɛ ku ti kpihim ti birili. Di yi di nyɛla bɛ zaŋla ti dɔbba mini paɣiba kɔhi ni ti leei daba, n naan shini ka ku zaŋ di yɛla muɣis a, dama nir ku tooi zaŋ ti ni yɛn di wahala shɛli buɣisi nyin naa ni yɛn kɔŋ shɛli.
en: My people and I have been sold for slaughter. If it were nothing more serious than being sold into slavery, I would have kept quiet and not bothered you about it; but we are about to be destroyed—exterminated.

dag: Ʒim bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia mini maha ni shi luɣuluɣu n-chaŋ o sani, o ni ti yɛl a din yɛn niŋ bia maa.
en: Give the prophet ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey. Then ask him what will happen to our son, and he will tell you.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia ni daa zaɣisi ni tɔbutuhiriba shɛb di dol o chaŋ tɔb maa ni ka kari ba ni bɛ kulim maa daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa, zaŋ Samaria hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn n-daa ku niriba tusaata ka di nɛma pam.
en: Meanwhile, the Israelite troops that Amaziah had sent home, raided the towns in Judah between Samaria and Beth-Horon. They killed , people and carried off their possessions.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N lihiri bɔrila m biɛyanima, ka yɛli, N suhir a, wuhim ma bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa be luɣ shɛli polo ka bɛ ŋubiri mɔri maa.
en: I am looking for my brothers, who are taking care of their flock, he answered. Can you tell me where they are.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinu.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Gad was .

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Faashee ka a po. Ka Iso daa shiri po, ka zaŋ o kpamdi maa ti Yaakubu.
en: But Jacob said, First, promise me that you will give them to me. So Esau made an oath to him and sold his rights as the firstborn son to Jacob.

dag: Di bemi kaman yi ni daa nyɛ nɔzaɣisiriba Naawuni sani, amaa ka yipa nya nambɔzɔbo pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim nɔzaɣisibo maa zuɣu la.
en: At one time you refused to obey God. But now you have received mercy, because the Jews refused to obey.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla din wuhiri Naawuni jilima! Ka sagbana wuhir o nuhi tuma!.
en: Heaven is declaring Gods glory; the sky is proclaiming his handiwork.

dag: ka m min o laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini. M bi lan mali mmaŋmaŋ wuntia, hal m bi lan mali wuntia din yi zaligunim dolibu ni na gba. Wunti shɛli n ni yipa mali pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ nyɛla din yi Masia yɛda niŋbu ni na. Di nyɛla wuntia din yi Naawuni sanna yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: and be found in him. In Christ I have a righteousness that is not my own and that does not come from the Law but rather from the faithfulness of Christ. It is the righteousness of God that is based on faith.

dag: O ni daa nya Yisa ka o chahi pam ka kana nti damd o tooni kuhi bɔh o, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a, di nahim ma.
en: When he saw Jesus, he shrieked and fell down before him. Then he shouted, What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, dont torture me.

dag: N wahala ŋɔ mini n ni ka kpɛhili shee ŋɔ yɛla tɛha tomi kaman binsom la.
en: The memory of my suffering and homelessness is bitterness and poison.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛrusha, o daa nyɛla Zadok bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. Jerushah his mother was the daughter of Zadok.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋumdi ti kparima ni kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka malaika ŋun su kum fukumsi daa bahi ba yol la.
en: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi naai ka Jeemsi mi yɛli, M mabihi, wummiya n gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa tim ti gbaai Jɔn na ti kpɛhi duu, ŋun Hɛrɔd ni daa fa omaŋmaŋ tizo Filip paɣ Hɛrɔdias niŋ o paɣa la zuɣu.
en: Herod had earlier married Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip. But John had told him, It isn't right for you to take your brother's wife! So, in order to please Herodias, Herod arrested John and put him in prison.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la shiri niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni Naawuni yɛliya: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: So they show that what Isaiah said about them is true: You people will listen and listen, but you will not understand. You will look and look, but you will not really see.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili. Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nia biɛri ŋmaligi di ba. Karim ba a sani, bɛ daalahichi din galisi pam la zuɣu; dama bɛ bi zan tuh a.
en: Condemn and punish them, O God; may their own plots cause their ruin. Drive them out of your presence because of their many sins and their rebellion against you.

dag: Miri ka a fiɣisi dabili o dan sani, di yi niŋ lala dabili maa ni tu a, ka a leei ŋun mali taali.
en: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.

dag: dindina ŋun ku nir maa ya kpamba bɛn timmi tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ o na ti ti ŋun yɛn bɔh o biɛri, ka bɛ ku o.
en: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, a yi ku niriba ŋɔ zaa yim, di saha zuliya shɛb bɛn pun wum a yuli dubu la ni yɛli.
en: If you kill these people, every last one of them, the nations who heard about you will say.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani.
en: Between three and six o'clock in the morning Jesus came to the disciples, walking on the water.

dag: Ka zuliya kam nim maa ti baŋ ni Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ maa, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe yim n sani, dinzuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ zaa.
en: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile because of their guilt. Because they rebelled against me, I hid my face from them. When I handed them over to their enemies, all of them fell by the sword.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka kali ba.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa ba yi zaɣisi zaa ni o ku zaŋ o bia maa ti doo maa, di simdi ka doo maa yo paɣipiɛliga bɔbu liɣiri ti paɣ maa ba.
en: But if her father refuses to let him marry her, he must pay the father a sum of money equal to the bride price for a virgin.

dag: A bapir Shallum bia Hanamɛl ni ka a sanna ti yɛl a, Dam m puu din be Anatɔt la, dama nyini m-mali soli ni a da li.
en: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.

dag: O daa yɛli Dan zuliya: Dan zuliya ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun yiɣi yi Bashan na.
en: Then he told Dan: Dan is a lion cub. He jumps up from Bashan.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ Bɛrishiiba.
en: Then he went up from Gerar to Beer-sheba.

dag: Tikub ku tooi gbibi ashili, dinzuɣu miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋlana.
en: You cannot trust someone who would talk about things told in private. So dont be friends with someone who talks too much.

dag: Bɛ daa me duu maa naala gol so bɛ ni daa booni Ada la daba ata dali, yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayɔbu la ni.
en: The Temple was finished on the third day of the month of Adar. That was in the sixth year of the rule of King Darius.

dag: Tizɔra ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka yaalana ti kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka kpiɔŋlana ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: No one will escape, not even the fastest runner. Strong men will not be strong enough. Soldiers will not be able to save themselves.

dag: Yoomiya tiŋ maa dunoya, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛli din niriba nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka ʒe yim ŋɔ gari kpe.
en: Open the gates and let a righteous nation enter, a nation that keeps faith.

dag: O daa ti bɛ ni yino la pɔŋ tusaanu, ka ti yino pɔŋ tusaayi, ka ti ŋun kpalim la mi pɔŋ tuhili. O daa ti bɛ zaa la kaman bɛ yaa tariga ni nyɛ shɛm ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: The man knew what each servant could do. So he handed , coins to the first servant, , to the second, and , to the third. Then he left the country.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi Juda Naa Amazia shɛm la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Joashs deeds and his powerful acts—how he fought against Judahs King Amaziah—arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: So yi ti o kpee dalinli, bɛn niŋm o gba o ni niŋ shɛm maa labisi.
en: If any of you injure another person, whatever you have done shall be done to you.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Anabi Musa daa bahi noli ni so yi yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ ka yih o.
en: The Pharisees asked Jesus, Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa chaŋ nti gari Amfipolis mini Apolɔnia m-mali ti paai Tɛsalɔnaika, ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu daa be nimaani.
en: Paul and Silas traveled on through Amphipolis and Apollonia and came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma yaha, A na ni nya bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa pam gari lala.
en: Then the Lord said to me, You are going to see them do even more disgusting things than that.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni nya tibigibu yi sani, ka yi gba nya tibigibu o sani ti Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika zuɣu.
en: Then the name of our Lord Jesus will be honored by you, and you will be honored by him, consistent with the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Kpahimmiya kahiŋkɔri: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna bee kunchuna; amaa Naawuni n-dihiri ba. Yi mali bukaata pam gari noonsi.
en: Look at the birds. They dont plant, harvest, or save food in houses or barns, but God feeds them. And you are worth much more than crows.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa ʒi ma n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka n ti nya paɣ so ka o ʒi biŋkɔb ʒiɛɣu zuɣu, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya nyaɣim biŋkɔbigu maa luɣilikam, ka o mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia.
en: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a tam ti yɛla zaa? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ti bahi dabisi gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa?.
en: You seem to have forgotten us forever. You seem to have left us alone for such a long time.

dag: Asina ni Miunim ni Nɛfisim ni.
en: Asnah, Meunim, Nephussim.

dag: Naa zaligu lahibali maa ni daa paai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni, Yɛhudianim daa kul kuhirila fabila kuhigu pampam. Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa lo noli n-kum ka fabili, ka bɛ ni niriba pam daa pili buri n-teei do tampiligim ni.
en: In every province where the kings command had come, there was much crying and sadness among the Jews. They were fasting and crying loudly. Many Jews were lying on the ground dressed in sackcloth with ashes on their heads.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya sara maligu bimbini ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: He also made a bronze altar thirty feet long, thirty feet wide, and fifteen feet high.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛl kpamba ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi daa chaŋ Obɛdɛdom yiŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then David, along with Israels elders and the captains of the thousands, went with rejoicing to bring up the chest containing the LORDs covenant from Obed-edoms house.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Miriya ka yi tumdi yi wuntia tuma ni niriba nyari ya m-paɣiri ya di zuɣu; yi yi niŋdi lala, yi ku nya laara yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.

dag: O dimnim ku tooi nyaŋ o; putɔɣunim mi ku tooi filim o.
en: No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Izraɛlnima, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la deebu niŋ yi baɣaka hal ni wayo?.
en: Joshua said to the Israelites, How long will you avoid going to take over the land that the LORD, the God of your ancestors, has given you?.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini kpamba maa daa zali Lɛvinim maa ni bɛ zaŋm Dauda mini anabi Asaf yɛtɔɣa la yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa yili wumpaɣibo yila maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Then King Hezekiah and the leaders ordered the Levites to praise the LORD by using the words of David and the seer Asaph. They did so joyously; then they bowed down in worship too.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni, kuhimi pampam niŋ ti Duuma. Chɛ ka a nintam zɔri yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni kaman kɔpaliga la. Miri ka a ti amaŋ vuhim, di chɛ ka a nina vuhi.
en: Cry out with all your heart to the Lord! Jerusalem, let tears roll down your walls. Let your tears flow like a stream day and night. Dont stop crying or let your eyes dry.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bara maa, M bia, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, Child, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Nakpahi pia puuni wain tihi wala ni ti yihi wain palila lita anii kɔŋko, ka kawaan bira din ni pali lita kɔbiga ni pihinii daatam ni ti palila lita pisaayika.
en: Four hectares of grapevines will produce only liters of juice, and liters of seed will produce merely liters of grain.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka zɔhi mini nanviri waɣi pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.

dag: Nir yi daŋ tooni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa o malila yɛlimaŋli, faashee o mini ŋun mali taba maa ti kana ti bɔh o bɔhigunima.
en: The first person to speak always seems right until someone comes and asks the right questions.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi alibarika niŋ o ni mali shɛli ni, ka chɛ ka a nini tiɣi o nuhi tuma. Kum o dimnim bɛn je ba la zuliya, ka bɛ ku lan neei yaha.
en: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ mi bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ku ma. Di chɛ bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi a sani. Chɛ ka bɛ lu a tooni, ka a darigi bɛ tibili a suhuyiɣisili ŋɔ saha.
en: You know they plan to kill me. So get angry and punish them! Don't ever forgive their terrible crimes.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti yi, ka alibarika ti lan be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti lab kpɛna.
en: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna naanyi kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti yeeg o ni ye neempiɛl shɛŋa kpe luɣ kasi shee maa sɔŋ nimaani.
en: Then Aaron will enter the Meeting Tent. He will take off the linen clothes that he put on when he went into the Holy Place. He will leave these clothes there.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, di yi nyɛla nyini m-bala, nyin chɛ ka n tam kom ŋɔ zuɣu ka a sanna.
en: Peter replied, Lord, if it really is you, tell me to come to you on the water.

dag: Ka yiɣisi guui chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, M bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni. Ka o daa labi ti dɔni.
en: Then he ran to Eli and said, Here I am. What do you want? I didn't call you, Eli answered. Go back to bed. Samuel went back.

dag: Chɛli n tibili darigibu lala! A ni zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma maa chɛmi ka n gbarigi.
en: Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sanna. O saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ yɛm zaalana.
en: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Yi mali so shɛŋa din ni doli zaɣisi Naawuni zaligunima, ka doli yimaŋmaŋ kaya!.
en: You are good at rejecting God's commands so that you can follow your own teachings!.

dag: Amaa kumiya ba. Yinima n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni be tooni bɛ kubu maa ni, ka sokam zaa naanyi kana ti pahi.
en: Kill them! Be the first to stone them, and then let everyone else stone them too.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, bɛ bi zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab nambɔɣu.
en: Evil people always want to do more evil, and they show no mercy to people around them.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N daa tɛhimi ni so ka kpe n-zɔri Naawuni, ka tɛhi ni bɛ ni ku ma m paɣ maa zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka n niŋ lala maa.
en: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti sɔɣ dɔni gili Gibia.
en: The Israelites surrounded Gibeah, but stayed where they could not be seen.

dag: Niŋmiya shɛlikam zaa ni yurilim!.
en: Do everything in love.

dag: Jɔshua yi di daa chɛ ka Naawuni niriba nya vuhim Naawuni sani, dindina ŋun Naawuni daa naan ku lan tɔɣisi dabisi shɛli yɛla yaha.
en: We know that Joshua did not lead the people into the place of rest that God promised. We know this because God spoke later about another day for rest.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni ti kpihim kum birili, ka nyahi sokam zaa nintam, ka vuui o niriba ni nyari filiŋ shɛl la dunia ŋɔ ni zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But death will be destroyed forever. And the Lord GOD will wipe away every tear from every face. In the past, all of his people were sad, but God will take away that sadness from the earth. All of this will happen because the Lord said it would.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa balim ba pam; ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi dol o kpe o yiŋa; ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi, ka o zaŋ li niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di.
en: He kept on urging them, and finally they went with him to his house. Lot ordered his servants to bake some bread and prepare a fine meal for the guests. When it was ready, they ate it.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee kpahimi bɛ zuɣu ni, ka wuhi ba na so ŋun ti yɛn su ba biɛhigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ sani.
en: Do everything they ask, but warn them and tell them how a king will treat them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa boli nachimba maa ni yino na nti yɛl o, Cham ti ku o. Ka o daa ŋme n-ku o.
en: Then David called for one of the young servants. Come here! he said. Strike him down! So the servant struck the Amalekite down, and he died.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o yuli; malimiya soli ti ŋuna ŋun be sagbana ni n-chani maa. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ, maliya suhupiɛlli o sani!.
en: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Prepare the way for the one who rides on the clouds. His name is YAH. Worship before him with joy.

dag: Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin dihi niriba tusaanahi la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi di gba pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: And what about the seven loaves for the four thousand men? How many baskets did you fill?.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba.
en: Therefore, you will know them by their fruit.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya ma naani ka labina nti nya kpiɔŋ ka tiligi. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi.
en: The Sovereign Lord , the Holy One of Israel, says to the people, Come back and quietly trust in me. Then you will be strong and secure. But you refuse to do it.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga kam ŋun mali tarili Izraɛlnim daŋ shɛli puuni, di simdi ni o kulila o yaannim daŋ ni doo, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛl nir kam kul su o yaannim fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: And if a woman gets her fathers land, she must marry someone from her own tribe. That way everyone will keep the land that belonged to his ancestors.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum waɣigbahiriba kukoya, bee n-wum waɣigbahiriba yila.
en: that does not listen to the music of the snake charmers, no matter how well they play.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum. Yawɛ, neem a nina nya; ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tim na nti yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-mali nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm.
en: But just look how Sennacherib has insulted you, the living God.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-gbibi m biriginsim ashilɔni kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm, din nyɛ n zaŋ n tuumbiɛri sɔɣi n jɔɣu ni.
en: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.

dag: Ka Sool gba daa kul o ya Gibia, ka dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni, ka Naawuni yɛligu maa kpe bɛ suhuri ni daa pahi dol o kuli.
en: Saul also went back to his home in Gibeah. Along with him went courageous men whose hearts God had touched.

dag: Di pala o daa yurila nandaamba zuɣu ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ tayiɣ la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibila, ka zuri piiri liɣiri maa.
en: He said this, not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. He carried the money bag and would help himself from it.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be sapashin kpɛm maa sani daa daai goon shɛŋa din daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la zaa luhi.
en: and his soldiers tore down the city walls.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋ biɛhigu pal shɛli Naawuni ni daa nam ka di ŋmani ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ biɛhigu ka nyɛ din tuhi ka be kasi n-ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: Be that new person who was made to be like God, truly good and pleasing to him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord Almighty gave this message to Zechariah:.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti miri kum saha shɛli, ka o daa saɣis o bia Sulemaana yɛli.
en: Not long before David died, he told Solomon:.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim daa dii yiɣisi kuhi bahi Filistianim maa zuɣu, n-kari dol ba hal ti paai Gaat mini Ɛkurɔn dunoya ni, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛb bɛn nya dansi kul luri soli ni, zaŋ Shaaraim hal ti paai Gaat mini Ɛkurɔn.
en: The men of Israel and Judah shouted and ran after them, pursuing them all the way to Gath and to the gates of Ekron. The Philistines fell wounded all along the road that leads to Shaaraim, as far as Gath and Ekron.

dag: O yiɣis o suhu bahi n zuɣu, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: God is angry and rages against me; he treats me like his worst enemy.

dag: Judanim ni ŋmanila tɔbbi shɛb bɛn di nasara ka no bɛ dimnim firi soli zuɣu baɣiri ni; dama Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Bɛ ni tuhi nyaŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri wɔribariba la.
en: The people of Judah will be victorious like soldiers who trample their enemies in the mud of the streets. They will fight because the Lord is with them, and they will defeat even the enemy cavalry.

dag: Ninsal ni tumdi tuma ka niŋdi wahala dunia ŋɔ ni m-bɔri ni o nya shɛli maa buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?.

dag: Dabisa ŋɔ yi ti gari, di nyaaŋa daba anii zaŋ chana maligumaaniba ni tooi mali yi sara shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini yi suhudoo saranim di zuɣu, ka n deei ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On the eighth day, and every day after that, the priests must offer your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo, o ʒiɛm a, ka mal a ansarisi; Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga be a nyaaŋa polo n-gbaɣisir o zuɣu niŋd a.
en: This is the Lord s message against Sennacherib: The virgin daughter Zion does not think you are important. She makes fun of you. Daughter Jerusalem shakes her head at you and laughs behind your back.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani yinima n-nyɛ niriba maa, ka yi yi kpi, yɛm ni kpi.
en: Im sure you think you are the only wise people left. You think that when you die, wisdom will be gone with you.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ashpɛnaz ni daa zaŋ o min o tab niriba ata la niŋ so nuu ni ni o lihiri ba la sani ti yɛl o.
en: So Daniel spoke to the guard whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

dag: Ka sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ tahilaa chim shɛli, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni, ka dabindi ka di ni.
en: If your offering is grain prepared on a griddle, it must be of choice flour mixed with oil and it must be unleavened.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Kpahim a nuhi, ka chɛ ka takɔbi din ni ku niriba lu buyi bee buta. Di nyɛla takɔbi din kura, ka nyɛ takɔbi din ni ku niriba pam. Di gili ba mi niŋ sunsuuni.
en: And you, human one, prophesy! Strike hand to hand. Let the sword strike twice, three times! Its a deadly sword, a great deadly sword. It whirls around them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yɛda mali shɛhira ŋɔ o suhu ni. Ka ŋunkam mi bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda zaŋ o leela ʒirilana, o ni bi niŋ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛl la yɛda zuɣu.
en: So those who believe in the Son of God have this testimony in their own heart; but those who do not believe God, have made a liar of him, because they have not believed what God has said about his Son.

dag: Naawuni bi dih o malaikanim tabili, ka sagbana pala din be kasi o sani.
en: Why, God does not trust even his angels; even they are not pure in his sight.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ suma n-kul pali n suhu ni saha shɛli n ni ŋma yilli ŋɔ ni n-yili jɛm naa. N zilinli ŋmanila gbansabir so ŋun mi yila sabbu daalikalimi.
en: A marvelous word has stirred my heart as I mention my works to the king. My tongue is the pen of a skillful scribe.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba mini bɛ mabia Simiɔn zuliya niriba daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Keenannim bɛn be Zɛfat la n-ku ba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Hɔrima.
en: Judah's army helped Simeon's army attack the Canaanites who lived at Zephath. They completely destroyed the town and renamed it Hormah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima niŋ binyɛribila maa naŋgbambiya.
en: They made two shoulder straps for the ephod and attached them to its sides, so that it could be fastened.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni daa zahim nya ka di be kaman n yɛn kɔŋ la n nyɛvili maa, ka n daa teeg a yɛla ka suh a, ka a be a jɛmbu du kasi la ni ka wum n suhigu.
en: My soul gave up all hope, but then I remembered the Lord . I prayed to you, and you heard my prayers in your holy Temple.

dag: Di zaa yoli Lɛvinim bɛn tinsi dina, yiya shɛŋa din be bɛ ni su fɔntin shɛŋa ni, bɛn Lɛvinim maa ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛlikam.
en: Levites will always have the right to buy back homes in the levitical cities that are part of their family property.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sɛrɛd daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Sɛrɛdnima; ka Ɛlɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛlɔnnima; ka Jaaliil daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaaliilnima.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Zebulun were Sered—the Seredite family group; Elon—the Elonite family group; Jahleel—the Jahleelite family group.

dag: Kɔra, a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Tomorrow morning you and your followers take fire pans, put live coals and incense on them, and take them to the altar. Then we will see which of us the Lord has chosen. You Levites are the ones who have gone too far.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ lee nyɛ dini, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali zaashee ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: Then King David went in and sat in front of the Lord . David said, Lord GOD, why am I so important to you? Why is my family important? Why have you made me so important?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim mali laara, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali putɔɣu tumdila bɛmaŋ barina.
en: People who are kind will be rewarded for their kindness, but cruel people will be rewarded with trouble.

dag: Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka alizin biɛ so ʒi Sool zuɣu maa daa yi ti kul lan siɣina saha shɛlikam, Dauda zaŋdila mɔɣilo maa ŋmɛra, ka alizin biɛɣu maa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka o ni maai, ka o nya omaŋa.
en: Whenever the evil spirit from God bothered Saul, David would play his harp. Saul would relax and feel better, and the evil spirit would go away.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti kabisi Izraɛlnim bidibbina zaa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: And at that time I will break Israels bow at Jezreel Valley.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o soya, ka bi tum taali gba mali alibarika.
en: They never do wrong; they walk in the Lord 's ways.

dag: Ka o dii boli bɛ gba, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ ba Zɛbidii min o tumtumdiba ŋariŋ maa ni ka dol o.
en: At once Jesus asked them to come with him. They left their father in the boat with the hired workers and went with him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli alɔbo shɛŋa zaa yɛla la lu tiŋ ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi zaa zuɣu bɛ ni niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu maa zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel says: I said I would bring many disasters to Jerusalem and the villages around it. I will soon make this happen because the people are very stubborn. They refuse to listen and obey me.

dag: Nɛbo daŋ ni: Jɛiɛl mini Matitia ni Zabad so yaha ni Zɛbina ni Jadai ni Joɛl ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Of the family of Nebu: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, O yi di pala ŋun tum taali, ti naan ku tah o a sanna.
en: They answered, If he had done nothing wrong, we wouldnt have handed him over to you.

dag: Tampiŋ yini daa dola nuzaa polo zaŋ labi Mikimash tooni poli, ka yini mi do nudirigu poli zaŋ labi Gɛba tooni polo.
en: One outcropping was on the north side, in front of Michmash, and the other was on the south side, in front of Geba.

dag: Man Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn wurim kpe tinzun tinsi ni m-be Pɔntus mini Galɛshia ni Kapadɔsia ni Ɛsha ni Bitinia.
en: From Peter, apostle of Jesus Christ— To God's chosen people who live as refugees scattered throughout the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

dag: N ku niŋ n suhu ni yiɣisi ka n yɛn niŋ shɛm maa. N ku lan ku Ifriimnim yaha, dama m pala daadam, n nyɛla Naawuni. Mani ŋun be kasi ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, ka n ku kana ni n ti ku niriba.
en: I wont act on the heat of my anger; I wont return to destroy Ephraim; for I am God and not a human being, the holy one in your midst; I wont come in harsh judgment.

dag: Hal bihi tuma ni ka niriba baŋdi bɛ ni nyɛ shɛba, bɛ tuma yi nyɛla din viɛl ka tuhi.
en: Even young people are known by their actions, whether their conduct is pure and upright.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa laɣim ŋari kɔbilisi, ka taɣi kulibɔna din kom daa zɔri yiri tiŋgban maa ni zaa kom zali ka yɛra, Ti ku chɛ ka Asiria nanim maa ti kana ti nya kom pam.
en: A large force gathered to stop up all the springs and the streams that flowed through the land. Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water? they asked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tinzun tiŋ wuna din be bɛ sani zaa mini bɛ ni daa kpa tibikpar shɛŋa ti Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li sɔɣi ti shɛli din nyɛ oki tia din miri Shɛkɛm la gbini.
en: So everyone gave Jacob their idols and their earrings, and he buried them under the oak tree near Shechem.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yi, bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma ka bɛ kpi n-doya, ka zunzuya bɛn yɛn di ba bi kpira; ka buɣim din yɛn di ba gba bi kpira. Ka bɛ dooshee maa ni mali dabiɛm pam sokam zaa sani.
en: They will go out and see the corpses of the people who rebelled against me, where their worm never dies, where their fire is never extinguished. They will be a horror to everyone.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma dabisili la dali ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni chani shɛm la; di saha maa zuɣusaa ni ti vuui ni vuɣɔbu pam, ka buɣim ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa nyɛligi; ka buɣim ti di dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binyara din be di zuɣu.
en: But the day when the Lord comes again will surprise everyone like the coming of a thief. The sky will disappear with a loud noise. Everything in the sky will be destroyed with fire. And the earth and everything in it will be burned up.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi, ka nyɛ yi tiligira la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zuɣu, n ni tim Babilɔn nti ŋme n-kab bɛ dunoya zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ niriba tahigu leei kumsi.
en: The Lord , the Holy One of Israel, saves you, and he says, I will send armies to Babylon for you. Many people will be captured. Those Chaldeans will be taken away in their own boats.

dag: Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai.
en: On the th day of the ninth month in the second year Darius was king of Persia, this message from the Lord came to Haggai the prophet:.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa boli kpeen so na ti yɛl o, Cham yomyom ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya na.
en: So King Ahab told one of his officers to go and find Micaiah.

dag: Pahimiya n zuɣu ka ti tibigi Yawɛ, ka chɛliya ka ti laɣim duh o.
en: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.

dag: dama binnamda zaa leela binchɔɣima, ka di pala binnamda maa yubu zuɣu. Naawuni ni yu ni di niŋ shɛm m-bala, amaa ka o lee ti binnamda maa tahima.
en: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope.

dag: Amaa ni malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin ni ti yɛn piɛb o kikaa dahin shɛl la ka Naawuni daashili yɛl shɛŋa o ni daa yɛl o daanabinim la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: In the days when the seventh angel is ready to blow his trumpet, Gods secret plan will be completed—the Good News that God told to his servants, the prophets.

dag: Ti yiɣisibu dali ni daa ti paai ka ti yiɣisi ni ti chaŋ; ka bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi zaa daa biɛl ti ti yi tiŋ maa tariga, ka ti gbani teeku noli n-suhi Naawuni.
en: But when our time with them was over, we left and went on our way. All of them, together with their wives and children, went with us out of the city to the beach, where we all knelt and prayed.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa deeg o yɛligu maa deei kom baptaizibu pahi yɛdaniŋdib maa zuɣu dindali maa. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaata laasabu.
en: Many of them believed his message and were baptized, and about three thousand people were added to the group that day.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n daa zaŋla n nuu kpɛh a biɛhigu ni zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, mani n-daa piɛl a dimnim maa bah a zuɣu a wahala saha min a nandahima saha.
en: Surely, Lord , I have served you well. In times of disaster and trouble, I prayed to you about my enemies.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sanna nti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba zaa ʒila o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini.
en: When Balaam returned, he found Balak and his officials standing beside the offerings.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa din pala man tibu; amaa m Ba Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: You will indeed drink from my cup, Jesus told them, but I do not have the right to choose who will sit at my right and my left. These places belong to those for whom my Father has prepared them.

dag: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la daa lan mali bidib shɛba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Haroi ŋun zuliya nyɛ Mɛnuhɔtinim pirigili la.
en: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka zibisim titali zibigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka sokam ti kpalim bɔbinda.
en: The Lord then said to Moses, Raise your hand toward the sky, and a darkness thick enough to be felt will cover the land of Egypt.

dag: Di simdi ka tan tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi, di simdi ka tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu nyɛ yim.
en: Make each piece the same size, yards long and yards wide.

dag: Yɛlim bɛnkam suhuri zɔhiri la, Maliya kpiɔŋ ka di zɔriya dabiɛm! Yi Naawuni maa yɛn kamina ti bɔhi yi dimnim biɛri tin ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: Tell everyone who is discouraged, Be strong and don't be afraid! God is coming to your rescue, coming to punish your enemies.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A ku garigi ma? A bi mi ni m mali yiko din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpah a tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka lan mali yiko din ni tooi tilig a.
en: So Pilate said, You wont speak to me? Dont you know that I have authority to release you and also to crucify you.

dag: Ibinɛya daa nyɛla Jɛrɔham bia, ka Ɛla daa nyɛ Uzi bia, ka Uzi daa nyɛ Mikiri bia, ka Mɛshulam daa nyɛ Shɛfatia bia, ka Shɛfatia daa nyɛ Riuɛl bia, ka Riuɛl nyɛ Ibinija bia.
en: Ibneiah was Jerohams son. Elah was Uzzis son. Uzzi was Micris son. And Meshullam was Shephatiahs son. Shephatiah was Reuels son. Reuel was Ibnijahs son.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuun kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.

dag: M mi noonsi zaa, ka biŋkɔbiri zaa bɛn gɔri ginda nyɛla n dini.
en: I know every mountain bird; even the insects in the fields are mine.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When Lamech was one , he had a son.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa gbani zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka suhi alibarika niŋ naa ni ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋya ni nyini n dan naa baɣa be n ni, a ni saɣi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni bɔri shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Joab fell facedown, bowing low out of respect, and he blessed the king. Today your servant knows that you think well of me, my master and king, Joab said, because the king has followed up on his servants recommendation.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara din gari ninsal yɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.

dag: Yi wuntaŋ mini yi goli ku lan lu, dama Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam; ka yi fabila dabisa la zani tariga.
en: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord , will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinima.
en: Canaan was also the ancestor of the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and Arkites, the Sinites, the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.

dag: Ka binshɛŋa din pahi nyɛla, n suhu kul zɔhirila cheechinim zaa zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: And not to mention other things, every day I am under the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Nahash ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim naa la daa kpi, ka o bia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Nahash was king of the Ammonites. When Nahash died, his son became the new king.

dag: zaawuni yuŋ lihaliha saha ni yuŋ zibisim saha.
en: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.

dag: Bee a kul zaɣisi ti mi zaa, ka a suhuyiɣisili maa lan ka maabu?.
en: Or have you rejected us forever? Is there no limit to your anger?.

dag: Ti daa bi deei shɛli so sani ka bi yo di zuɣu, amaa ti daa kul tumdila wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku ʒi yi ni so zuɣu.
en: We never accepted food from anyone without paying for it. We worked and worked so that we would not be a burden to any of you. We worked night and day.

dag: N daa tum tuun maŋli shihira wuhibu tuma yi sani ni suɣilo dibu zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: shihira wuhibu mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni yiko tuma.
en: When I was with you, I patiently did the things that prove I am an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles.

dag: ni Arivadnim ni Zɛmarinim ni Hamatinima.
en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.

dag: ka Amɔn nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔsia nyɛ o bia.
en: his son Amon, and his son Josiah.

dag: Hal yi yi yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la, ka yi tɛri be saŋmarisi biɛhigu shee, n ni siɣisi ya tiŋ na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even though you make your home as high as an eagle's nest, so that it seems to be among the stars, yet I will pull you down.

dag: ka n yi suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam, n kul suhirimi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And I always pray for all of you with joy.

dag: A kari pakoya bahi ni nuzaŋa, ka kabisi kpibisi bɔɣiri.
en: But maybe you sent widows away without giving them anything. And maybe you took advantage of orphans.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni piligi niŋdi shɛli maa leei bɛ kali kaman Mɔdɛkai ni daa sab yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: They followed Mordecai's instructions and set aside these two days every year as a time of celebration.

dag: Bɛ ni mi ni Naawuni zaligu wuhiya ni bɛn tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim simdi kum maa zaa yoli, bɛmaŋmaŋ gba kul tumdi li mi hal ka ʒe bɛn gba tumdi li nyaaŋa.
en: They know that God's law says that people who live in this way deserve death. Yet, not only do they continue to do these very things, but they even approve of others who do them.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yihiri waazu yɛri niriba ni bɛ niŋmi tuuba.
en: The apostles left and started telling everyone to turn to God.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa kani n-lo o suhu ni n-tum zaɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani n-lan paai Ɛhab ŋun paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpaŋs o ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: There was no one else who had devoted himself so completely to doing wrong in the Lord 's sight as Ahab—all at the urging of his wife Jezebel.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, Di nyɛla din ni dini? Ka Yisa yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma;.
en: What commandments? he asked. Jesus answered, Do not commit murder; do not commit adultery; do not steal; do not accuse anyone falsely;.

dag: Naawuni, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu ŋɔ; di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa daa nyɛla ti gula hal ka Masia ti kana ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi Pita. Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla.
en: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered that the Lord had said, Before a rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you don't know me.

dag: Kpuɣimiya paɣiba n-dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bomiya paɣiba ti yi bidibisi, ka zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti dɔbba; nabimiya pahi nimaani, ka di filimya.
en: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.

dag: Dama Ɛzra daa zaŋ o suhu n-niŋla Yawɛ zaligu bɔhimbu ni, ka daa dol li, ka mali zaligu shɛŋa mini biɛhigu soya zaligunim wuhiri Izraɛlnima.
en: Ezra had determined to study and perform the LORDs Instruction, and to teach law and justice in Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ yi ti yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ ni yɛli paɣ ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ teer o yɛla.
en: I tell you the truth that wherever in the whole world this good news is announced, what shes done will also be told in memory of her.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn da ba ku ba mi bi nya tibidarigibo; ka bɛn kɔhi bɛ nimdi mi yɛli, Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ti leei bundaannima. Hal piɛri maa maŋmaŋ piɛguliba maa daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, Praise the Lord ! I'm rich. Not even their shepherds have pity on them.

dag: ni n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi mini teeku noli bihigu la. Ka a zuliya maa ni ti deei bɛ dimnim tinsi su;.
en: I promise that I will give you as many descendants as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore. Your descendants will conquer their enemies.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa pii ma zali hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma, ka boli ma o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: But God had special plans for me even before I was born. So he chose me through his grace.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa pii Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili vinvamli polo maa n-daa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo. Bɛ ni daa woligi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Lot chose to live in the Jordan Valley. The two men separated, and Lot began traveling east.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ o tiŋgban nɛl la ni, ka daa saɣim o suhu pam!.
en: How often they rebelled against God in the wilderness and distressed him in the desert!.

dag: O nam dibu yuma ata saha ka o daa laɣim o kpambaliba min o tuma zuɣulaannim na ni bɛ ti puhi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu. Pɛriʒia mini Miidia tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim gba daa beni nti pahi gomnanim mini tiŋgbana maa nabihi.
en: In the third year of Xerxes rule, he gave a party for his officers and leaders. The army leaders and important leaders from all of Persia and Media were there.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ ba na ti ʒil amaŋmaŋ zoli zuɣu, nyini Yawɛ ni pii luɣ shɛli n-leeg a biɛhigu shee la. Nyin Yawɛ ni zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nuhi me a jɛmbu du shɛl la ni.
en: You brought them in and planted them on your own mountain, the place, LORD, that you made your home, the sanctuary, LORD, that your hand created.

dag: A zuɣu, n ni tooi nyaŋ n dimnima. N Naawuni maa zuɣu, n ni tooi yiɣi yaɣi gooni.
en: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali Bia maa mali nyɛvili; ka ŋunkam mi ka Naawuni Bia maa ka nyɛvili.
en: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ nudirigu gbali ti maligumaana, ka di leeg o tarili a suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: You must also give the right thigh from the fellowship offering as a gift to the priest.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa vooi dunoli yo ka yi bɛ sani nti yɛli ba.
en: Lot went out toward the entrance, closed the door behind him.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka gom gbaarila nira, ka ŋun je ni o ni bii ni gbe kum.
en: Laziness brings on deep sleep; a slacker goes hungry.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa deeg o yɛligu maa deei kom baptaizibu pahi yɛdaniŋdib maa zuɣu dindali maa. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaata laasabu.
en: Those who accepted Peters message were baptized. God brought about three thousand people into the community on that day.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi Jona bahi teeku maa ni, ka teeku maa daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti bɔh o, N daa bi chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ka n kpah a zuɣu ni yɛli ni a yi ti yi kpe chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani? Ka a daa yɛli ma, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla, n ni dol a noli.
en: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?.

dag: Baptaizibu shɛli n-na ʒe n-guli ma; di mi nyɛla din chɛ ka n suhu bi doya shee di ti niŋ naai.
en: There is a kind of baptism that I must suffer through. I feel very troubled until it is finished.

dag: Yi yi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o shiri ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, amaa yi yi bi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o daalahichi maa na kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you forgive people's sins, they are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani Ijipti ti bɔri sɔŋsim zuɣu. Bɛ niŋla Ijipti tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam la kpiɔŋ mini bɛ wɔribariba ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi yɛda; amaa ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yɛda bee n-suh o ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: Those who go to Egypt for help are doomed! They are relying on Egypt's vast military strength—horses, chariots, and soldiers. But they do not rely on the Lord , the holy God of Israel, or ask him for help.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli o shee ni zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ka di be kaman daanya din nyaɣisira la, ka be kaman buɣim n-gili o luɣilikam zaa la. Ka n daa nya o shee tiŋli polo ka di ŋmanila buɣim. Ka neesim din ne pam daa ne n-gili o.
en: I looked at him from his waist up. He looked like hot metal with fire all around him. I looked at him from his waist down. It looked like fire with a glow that was shining all around him.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa maan mooi bɛ nini bɔri ni bɛ ku o, dama bɛ daa zaŋ zali ni o bi saɣim la Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu kɔŋko, amaa ni o yɛliya ni Naawuni n-nyɛ o Ba, ka di wuhi ni o zaŋ omaŋ maɣisi Naawuni.
en: This saying made the Jewish authorities all the more determined to kill him; not only had he broken the Sabbath law, but he had said that God was his own Father and in this way had made himself equal with God.

dag: Ŋuna n-yiɣisiri tarimba taŋkpaɣu ni, ka kpuɣiri nandaamba tampuli zuɣu ni o chɛ ka bɛ mini nabihi laɣim ʒini n-di kuɣ din mali jilima fali. Dama Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ daantalisi, ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ n-tam di zuɣu.
en: God raises the poor from the dust, lifts up the needy from the garbage pile. God sits them with officials, gives them the seat of honor! The pillars of the earth belong to the LORD; he set the world on top of them!.

dag: ka Shimia nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Baasɛya bia, ka Baasɛya nyɛ Malikija bia.
en: Shimea was Michaels son. Michael was Baaseiahs son. Baaseiah was Malkijahs son.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli Naawuni, A daa wuh a yurilim din galisi ka ka tariga ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m ba Dauda sani, ka zaŋ ma leei naa zal o zaani.
en: Solomon answered, You always showed great love for my father David, and now you have let me succeed him as king.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ niriba maa chaŋ kuliga ni, ka Yawɛ ti yɛli Gidiɔn, Ŋunkam mal o zilinli nyuri kom kaman baa la, nyin woligim o zal o ko; ka ŋunkam mi ti gban tiŋ nyura, nyin woligim o gba zal o ko.
en: When Gideon led his army down to the spring, the Lord told him, Watch how each man gets a drink of water. Then divide them into two groups—those who lap the water like a dog and those who kneel down to drink.

dag: Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Kul yim chaŋ, dama n yɛn tim a la katiŋ ha bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani. .
en: But the Lord told me to go, and he promised to send me far away to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi lihi paɣ maa ka bɔhi Saimɔn, A nya paɣ ŋɔ? N ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na, a bi ti ma kom ni m paɣi n naba; amaa paɣ ŋɔ zaŋ o nintam paɣi n naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhi li.
en: Then he turned to the woman and said to Simon, Do you see this woman? I came into your home, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.

dag: A bia paɣ maa yur a, ka tum din gari bidibis ayopɔin tuma ti a. O dɔɣi yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga ti a, ka o ni ti nyɛla ŋun ni kpaŋsir a ni ŋun ni ti gbib a a kuriginsim saha.
en: He will make you alive again and care for you in your old age. Your daughter-in-law made it happen because she bore this child for you. She loves you, and she is better for you than seven sons.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni be a sani, ka chɛ ka a ŋme n-ku Midiannim kaman ninvuɣ yino n-nyɛ ba la.
en: The Lord answered, You can do it because I will help you. You will crush the Midianites as easily as if they were only one man.

dag: Amaa dabiɛm daa bi gbaai naa min o kpambaliba bɛn daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ni so bee n-niŋ ba suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Neither the king nor any of his attendants who heard all these words were alarmed or tore their clothes.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ tɔrili ŋun yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini tinvurigu ni chani shɛm tampiŋ zuɣu, ni ŋariŋ din be teeku bulli ni biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni doo mini paɣa tab laɣimbu yɛla.
en: an eagle flying in the sky, a snake moving on a rock, a ship moving across the ocean, and a man in love with a woman.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, Take this and eat it. This is my body.

dag: Shɛkɛm ni daa dihi Yaakubu bidibisi maa tizɔpaɣ Daina vi maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa garigi Shɛkɛm min o ba Hamɔr yɔhiŋgu garigibu.
en: Because Shechem had disgraced their sister Dinah, Jacob's sons answered Shechem and his father Hamor in a deceitful way.

dag: Kukoli maa ni daa tɔɣisi naai ka bɛ nya ka Yisa kɔŋko n-kpalim. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa shini ka bi yɛli so bɛ ni daa nya shɛli maa yɛla di saha maa.
en: When the voice stopped, only Jesus was there. Peter, John, and James said nothing. And for a long time after that, they told no one about what they had seen.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ sanna ti di bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini biŋkpam la zaa sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu; niriba maa zaa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ tahi ka lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Fire came out from the Lord and burned the burnt offering and fat on the altar. When all the people saw this, they shouted with joy and then bowed to the ground to show their respect.

dag: Wula ka a be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun bi lan mi o yɛla nini, bee kaman tɔbutuhiri biiŋa ŋun ku tooi sɔŋ so maa? Amaa nyini Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be ti sani. Ti nyɛla a niriba, di zaŋ ti bahi.
en: Why are you like one taken by surprise, like a warrior unable to act? Yet you are in our midst, LORD; we are called by your name. Dont give up on us.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka nandaamba kumdi niŋd o, ka o wum bɛ ni niŋdi shɛb alaka kuhigu.
en: They hurt the poor and made them cry to God for help. And he hears their cry!.

dag: Tummiya yi dabitali tuma ni suhupiɛlli ka di be kaman yi tumdi li tirila ti Duuma la, ka pa ni ninsalinima;.
en: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.

dag: Amaa bɛn ti yɛn be tiŋ maa kpaŋa ti yɛn nyɛla bahi mini baɣisi ni zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba ni buɣijɛmdiba ni bɛnkam yuri ʒiri, ka lan nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la.
en: Outside the city are all those who live like dogs—those who do evil magic, those who sin sexually, those who murder, those who worship idols, and those who love to lie and pretend to be good.

dag: Di saha hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la suhuri ni fuŋ dabiɛm zuɣu, dama Izraɛlnim zaa mi ni a ba mali kpiɔŋ. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani maa nyɛla bɛn mali suhukpeeni.
en: Then even those who are as brave as a lion will lose their courage. All Israel knows what a great warrior your father is and what brave soldiers he has.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba ni nya li ka zo dabiɛm, di saha ka bɛ ni la a ka yɛli.
en: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yi tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun wuhiri ya din ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli, ka lan wuhiri ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: The holy God of Israel, the Lord who saves you, says: I am the Lord your God, the one who wants to teach you for your own good and direct you in the way you should go.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kumiya doo maa. Zaŋmiy o yi tiŋ tariga, ka niriba maa zaa ti pihi kuɣa lab o.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, The man must be put to death; the whole community is to stone him to death outside the camp.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba bɛn daa leei bundaannim paɣ maa zuɣu la ni ti kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋa o ni nya nahiŋgu shɛli din mali dabiɛm maa zuɣu, ka kuhiri ka fabindi.
en: The merchants, who became rich from doing business in that city, will stand a long way off, because they are afraid of sharing in her suffering. They will cry and mourn.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ wuɣi tan ʒiɛkpeein mini tan sabilifaa ni zaɣ ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli, ka mali chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ li yili dunoli maa.
en: A curtain was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with designs of winged creatures.

dag: Lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali. Malaikanim ni ti kana nti gahim ninvuɣ suma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: That's how it will be at the end of time. Angels will come and separate the evil people from the ones who have done right.

dag: Ŋunkam paɣir o ʒiʒiinikpee ti yaɣi nyɛla ŋun bariti o ʒiʒiinikpee maa zana.
en: If you flatter your friends, you set a trap for yourself.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yi Tɔfɛt din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o chaŋ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa labina, o daa zanila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni yɛli niriba.
en: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o min o mabihi ni o ma ni o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Kapɛrinium n-daa ti niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: After this, he went with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples to the town of Capernaum, where they stayed for a few days.

dag: N yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa ku nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: If I testify on my own behalf, what I say is not to be accepted as real proof.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni sokam zaa kpi yim, ka saria karibu lee be di nyaaŋa.
en: People are destined to die once and then face judgment.

dag: Ka bikpɛm maa daa je suli zaɣisi duu kpɛbu; ka o ba daa yina ti balim o.
en: The older brother was so angry that he would not go into the house; so his father came out and begged him to come in.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna yɛra, Yinima n-ku Yawɛ niriba maa.
en: The next day the whole community complained against Moses and Aaron and said, You have killed some of the Lord 's people.

dag: Bɛ ninani ni daa be shɛm m-bala. Bɛ kpiŋkpama daa yirigila zuɣusaa. Binneen yino kam daa malila kpiŋkpama ayiyi, ka di zaɣ yini chaŋ ti shih o kpee dini. Ka kpiŋkpama ayi din la pɔbi bɛ niŋgbuna.
en: Two wings of each creature were raised so that they touched the tips of the wings of the creatures next to it, and their other two wings were folded against their bodies.

dag: Amaa yinim ŋmaligimiya labi yi nyaaŋa kpe tiŋgban nɛl ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: But you all must now turn around. Head back toward the wilderness along the route of the Reed Sea.

dag: Ka fɔntiŋ maa kpamba zaŋ naɣisaa maa chaŋ vinvamli ni kulibɔŋ shɛli din kom zɔr ni, ka so na ʒi n-ko nimaani bee m-biri binshɛli nimaani nti kabi naɣisaa maa nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni.
en: and those elders will take the cow down to a ravine with a flowing stream—one that has not been plowed or planted—and they will break the cows neck right there in the river valley.

dag: N zaŋ a yɛligu ti ba, ka dunianim zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni lan pa dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I gave your word to them and the world hated them, because they dont belong to this world, just as I dont belong to this world.

dag: Amaa biha maa mini nudirigu gbalipuɣa dina Aduna daa zaŋ li mi gahigahi Yawɛ tooni ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi kaman Musa ni daa zali shɛm.
en: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord . This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

dag: kaman di ni daa sab ti Duuma zaligu ni shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ zaŋmi bidib tuuli kam ti ti Duuma Naawuni.
en: Its written in the Law of the Lord, Every firstborn male will be dedicated to the Lord.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa zaŋ sarikanim bɛn zaa be sarika maa ni niŋ Yisifu nuu ni, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa nimaani.
en: He put Joseph in charge of all the other prisoners and made him responsible for everything that was done in the prison.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni vil o bahi o bindoo zuɣu, ka o mini bɛnkam niŋ o zina ni nya wahala pam naɣila bɛ niŋla tuuba bɛ ni tum shɛm o sani maa zuɣu.
en: So I will throw her on a bed of suffering. And all those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly. I will do this now if they dont turn away from the things she does.

dag: Vinvamli ni taŋkpaɣu niŋdi ba la nyaɣisim, ka sokam ni doli bɛ nyaaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun daŋ tooni ka kalinli.
en: So even the soil in the valley will be pleasant for them, and thousands of people will join their funeral procession.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya yɛlli ŋɔ: Di simdi ni paɣ suhuri Naawuni ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu?.
en: Judge for yourselves: Is it appropriate for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?.

dag: bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba shɛb bɛn daa gbibi kikahi la daa pa bɛ zuɣu. Ka Jɔnatan bia Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛmaya yaaŋa la pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: And some of the priests with trumpets also followed them up to the wall. Zechariah also followed them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim daa bɔhi Judanim biɛri ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpe taali ni bɛ ni bɔhi ba biɛri maa zuɣu.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, The people of Edom took cruel revenge on Judah, and that revenge has brought lasting guilt on Edom.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa kul yɛrigila zoya zuɣu m-be kaman piɛ shɛb bɛn ka gula. Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ka zuɣulana; chɛ ka bɛ zaa yinoyino lab kuli ni suhudoo. .
en: He answered, In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers walking around in the hills like sheep without a shepherd to guide them. The Lord said, This army has no leader. They should go home and not fight. .

dag: Ka a daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, m bela a sani, ka nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a, ka duh a yuli kaman dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ kara yuya ni du shɛm.
en: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.

dag: O teem a pina zaa yɛla, ka chɛ ka o nini tiɣ a sar shɛŋa zaa a ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim.
en: May he accept all your offerings and be pleased with all your sacrifices.

dag: Zaŋm biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi la zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi la zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: From every clean animal, take seven pairs, a male and his mate; and from every unclean animal, take one pair, a male and his mate.

dag: Timiya pini, ka Naawuni ti yi gba; ka yi ni yɛn deei shɛli maa ni pali yi nuhi hal ti puuri bahira; dama yi ni zahindi binyara shɛm tiri yi taba, lala ka Naawuni ni ti zahim ti yi gba.
