en: Give, and it will be given to you. A good portion—packed down, firmly shaken, and overflowing—will fall into your lap. The portion you give will determine the portion you receive in return.

dag: Ka kikaa ni ti tahi pam, ka o ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: He will use a loud trumpet to send his angels all around the earth. They will gather his chosen people from every part of the earth.

dag: Ka daa siɣis omaŋ doli nɔdeebo soli ti paai kum, hal kum din nyɛ dapulli zuɣu kum gba.
en: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.

dag: Zaŋm a nuhi shih o, ka tɛhi a min o ni yɛn va shɛm, a ku lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ka n sanna nti zani baɣili ma ka yɛli, M mabia Sool, a nina maa neema! Ka n nina naa daa dii neei di saha maa, ka n nya o.
en: He came and stood beside me. Brother Saul, receive your sight! he said. Instantly, I regained my sight and I could see him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ lala n-yihi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: The Israelites obeyed the Lord 's instructions.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba, N kamina ni n ti niŋ buɣim juui dunia ŋɔ, ka n di bi zaɣisi ka di pun taai dira.
en: I came to cast fire upon the earth. How I wish that it was already ablaze!.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛligu din daa kul maan chanila tooni pahira.
en: Gods word continued to grow and increase.

dag: Di saha ka salo maa zaa daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa be Rimɔn tampiŋ gbin la sani nti yɛli ba ni bɛ ku bɛ mini ba zabili la.
en: Then the Israelites sent a message to the men of Benjamin. They offered to make peace with the men of Benjamin. The men of Benjamin were at the place named the Rock of Rimmon.

dag: O zuɣu ka yi niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neeg o kum ni ka ti o jilima la naani ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi tahima niŋbu zaa bela Naawuni ni.
en: who through Christ are faithful to the God who raised him from the dead and gave him glory. So now, your faith and hope should rest in God.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Alɔbo ni yi nuzaa polo na ti lu tiŋgbani maa ni niriba zaa zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to me, Something terrible will come from the north. It will happen to all the people who live in this country.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mi dol ti chana? Labimiya ka yi mini naa maa ti be, dama yinim nyɛla tinzunnima, ka lan nyɛ yi yanim ni kari shɛb bahi na.
en: The king said to Ittai from Gath, Why are you also going with us? You are a foreigner; this is not your homeland. Go back and stay with the new king.

dag: N ni chaŋ wɔɣira sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la. Amaa hal bɛ gba nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ fukumsi ka bi deeg o noli.
en: So I will go to the leaders of Judah. I will talk to them. Surely the leaders know the way of the Lord . Surely they know the law of their God. But the leaders had all joined together to break away from serving God.

dag: Yisifu ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala, ka nyɛ din ʒe n-tab kulibɔŋ, ka di wula zooi yaɣi kuligbiriŋ zuɣu.
en: Joseph is like a wild donkey by a spring, A wild colt on a hillside.

dag: Di daa sabila Hiburuli ni mini Latinli ni ni Giriikili ni. Ka Yɛhudianim pam daa karim di ni sab shɛm maa, dama bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa daa mirila tiŋ maa.
en: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.

dag: O sani, jaambɔna ŋmanila kaɣa. Bɛ yi to kpani ka o wum di damli, o lari li mi.
en: He treats a club like straw; he laughs at the lances rattle.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti vulim vuliŋga m-boli Ijiptinim ka bɛ yi Nail Mɔɣili polo kana kaman zɔhi la, ka Asirianim gba ti kana kaman shihi la.
en: On that day, the LORD will whistle for the flies from the remotest streams of Egypt and for the bees that are in the land of Assyria.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni wuhi ya shihirili. Nyamiya, paɣisari so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl.
en: But the Lord will still show you this sign: The young woman is pregnant and will give birth to a son. She will name him Immanuel.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti niŋ bɔɣili ni. Kom daa ka bɔɣili maa ni, di daa nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ.
en: Then they threw him into an empty well that was dry.

dag: Chɛ ka Naawuni yiɣisi, chɛ ka o dimnim wurim; chɛ ka bɛnkam je o ŋmalig o tooni guui.
en: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa ʒe binfalafala maa lɔŋni, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama teei tuhi, ka yino kpiŋkpaŋ kpa o kpee polo. Ka binnɛma maa zaɣ yino kam daa zaŋ o kpiŋkpama ayi pɔbi omaŋa.
en: Under this bowl, each living being had wings reaching out to the one next to it. Two wings spread out one way and two wings spread out the other way, covering its body.

dag: Ka a ti she zabbanim mini shɛlɔriti ni zuɣupila n-ti Aduna bidibisi. Di simdi ka a mal li ka di nyɛla bɛ jilima mini bɛ nachiinsi situra.
en: Make shirts, sashes, and caps for Aaron's sons, to provide them with dignity and beauty.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa fa Amɔrinim maa fɔntinsi zaa n-ʒini Hɛshibɔn zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: So the people of Israel captured all the Amorite cities, including Heshbon and all the surrounding towns, and settled in them.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: So Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the Israelites.

dag: Kul guhimiya Yawɛ, ka dol o soli, ka o duhi ya n-chɛ ka yi su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka yi nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɛn bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Hope in the LORD and keep his way! He will lift you up so you can possess the land. When the wicked are eliminated, you will see it for yourself!.

dag: Gooni din ti yɛn gili fɔntiŋ maa zaa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita awɛi. Ka fɔntiŋ maa yuli ni ti boonila, Yawɛ Beni.
en: and so the total length of the wall will be ten kilometers. The new name of the city will be The- Lord -Is-Here.

dag: dama bɛ ka dahin shɛli bini; ninvuɣ biɛri firila ni kpi.
en: A wicked person has no future—nothing to look forward to.

dag: Mani n-daa yi piiri bɛ ni bɔri shɛli tiri ba. Mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. N daa bemi kaman naa m-be o tɔbbihi san la, ka be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun maari bɛn fabindi suhuri la.
en: I took charge and made the decisions; I led them as a king leads his troops, and gave them comfort in their despair.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei salima binshɛŋa sapashin kpamba mini sapashin bihi shɛb bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga sani maa tibisim daa miri kilɔgiram kɔbisiyi.
en: and its total weight was over kilograms.

dag: Di daba ayi nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ Galili;.
en: After spending two days there, Jesus left and went to Galilee.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi mi din niŋ kamaata, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn mi li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Evil people dont understand justice, but those who seek the LORD understand everything.

dag: Do so niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi mali bimmɔriŋ bee yum bee dalinli, ka di ti leei niŋgbuŋ dɔro o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina bɛn zaŋm o tahi Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la sani bee o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ni yino sani.
en: When a person has a swelling, a scab, or a shiny spot on their skin, and it becomes an infection of skin disease on their skin, they will be brought to the priests, either to Aaron or one of his sons.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa maa o gbaɣino min o nyɔtaɣirigu tuɣibu shee, di saha ka o daa yɛli tɔbbi so ŋun daa duhir o chɛchɛbuŋ maa, Ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni, dama n nya daŋa. .
en: Someone, however, randomly shot an arrow that struck Israels king between the joints in his armor. Turn around and get me out of the battle, the king told his chariot driver. Ive been hit.

dag: Naawuni, bambua suhu ni ye kulibɔŋ ni kɔzɔrim zuɣu shɛm la, lala ka n gba suhu kul ye a zuɣu.
en: Like a deer drinking from a stream, I reach out to you, my God.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn daa mali kikah ayopɔin la niŋ shili ni bɛ piɛb bɛ kikahi maa.
en: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.

dag: N dabili Musa kpiya, dinzuɣu a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa yiɣisim pumpɔŋɔ n-chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yinim Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni.
en: My servant Moses is dead. Now get ready to cross over the Jordan with this entire people to the land that I am going to give to the Israelites.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa tooi baai du Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ n-nyɛ li la; amaa ka Ijiptinim daa kana ti tɔɣisi ba niŋ lala ka kom di ba.
en: And Gods people all walked through the Red Sea as if it were dry land. They were able to do this because they had faith. But when the Egyptians tried to follow them, they were drowned.

dag: bee n-niŋdi shiriku bee n-nyɛ dɔdihira bee kpilikparisilana.
en: or spell caster; who converses with ghosts or spirits or communicates with the dead.

dag: Bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la ni daa wum di gbinni ka di viɛl maa, ka o daa yɛli Yisifu, N gba sa zahimla zahindi. Bɔrɔbɔro piɛr ata n-sa tam n zuɣu ni.
en: The baker saw that the other servants dream was good, so he said to Joseph, I also had a dream. I dreamed there were three baskets of bread on my head.

dag: Bɛ bi lan tiri ti mɔri, amaa ka na kul yɛra, Ŋmamiya bilichiisi maa! Nyam bɛ ni buri a tumtumdiba shɛm, amaŋmaŋ niriba maa tum din bi tuhi.
en: We are given no straw, but we are still ordered to make bricks! And now we are being beaten. It is your people that are at fault.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun daa birita, ka Apolɔs mi nyɛ ŋun daa mihiri li kom, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka di zoora.
en: I planted the seed and Apollos watered it. But God is the one who made the seed grow.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya sochanda ka o ʒi tiŋ maa sokpaŋa; ka ninkurigu maa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Bee ya ka a lee chana.
en: The old man noticed the traveler in the city square and asked him, Where do you come from? Where are you going.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinina ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li sani, amaa jɛrilim nyɛla din darigiri jɛra tibili.
en: Good sense is a spring of fresh water to those who have it, but fools can offer only foolishness.

dag: Cham niriba ŋɔ sani ti yɛli ba: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: Go to this people and tell them: You will listen and you will hear, but you will not understand. You will look and you will see, but you will not understand what you see.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, bɛ daa zu ma la Hiburu tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka kpe gba, m bi tum taal shɛli ka di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ ma kpɛhi sarika.
en: I was kidnapped and taken from the land of my people, the Hebrews. I have done nothing wrong! I should not be in prison.

dag: Di lan sab yaha: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa, paɣimiya ti Duuma, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa paɣ o.
en: And again, Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and all the people should sing his praises .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka a ti timdi ni bɛ cham ti bɔhi Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la nya a ni kpaŋ bee a ku kpaŋ? Dinzuɣu a ku yiɣis a bariŋ bindo shɛli zuɣu a ni doya ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi.
en: When Elijah arrived, he told Ahaziah, The Lord wants to know why you sent messengers to Ekron to ask Baalzebub about your injury. Don't you believe there's a God in Israel? Ahaziah, because you did that, the Lord says you will die.

dag: Ka olivi tiwula ayi shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi salima bimmulima ayi shɛŋa ni bɛ ni boori olivi kpam la mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: I also said to him, I saw two olive branches by the gold tubes with gold colored oil flowing from them. What do these things mean.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yuya pun bi sabi niŋ Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku la nyɛvili litaafi la ni tun dunia piligu ni la ha ni ti jɛm biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: All people living on earth will worship it, except those whose names were written before the creation of the world in the book of the living which belongs to the Lamb that was killed.

dag: Miri ka a di shɛhira jɛnd a kpee ka di ka daliri, ka miri ka a yɔhim so.
en: Dont speak against someone without a good reason, or you will appear foolish.

dag: Amaa ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba maa zaa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa bɛn daa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn yi bɛ ni daa kari ba tahi tin shɛŋa ni zaa n-labina ni bɛ ti ʒini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: So Johanan and the officers led us away toward Egypt. The group that left Judah included those who had been scattered in other countries and who had then come back to live in Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɔhim anabi maa ka o yɛli shɛli, di wuhiya ni man Yawɛ n-yɔhim anabi maa, ka n ni teei n nuu n-jɛnd o n-ku o n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
en: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people.

dag: Tiŋ maa daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa nyɛ yim; ka o daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa buɣisi tiŋ maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi; ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni di dubu zaa nyɛ yim.
en: The city was perfectly square, as wide as it was long. The angel measured the city with his measuring stick: it was fifteen hundred miles long and was as wide and as high as it was long.

dag: Ka bɛ lar o, bɛ ni daa mi ni o kpiya zuɣu.
en: They laughed at him because they knew she was dead.

dag: Sool saha la bɛna n-daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinima n-nyaŋ ba, ka ʒini bɛ tinsi maa ni Giliad wulimpuhili polo maa ni zaa la.
en: In Sauls days they waged war on the Hagrites, whom they defeated. So they lived in their tents throughout the entire region east of Gilead.

dag: Ka o daa kuli n-daa ti chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti moli Yisa ni daa tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla zaa gili; ka di daa niŋ sokam zaa alahiziba.
en: So the man left and told the people in the Ten Towns about the great things Jesus did for him. Everyone was amazed.

dag: Naa Sulemaana yilli din nyɛ yila puuni yili viɛlli.
en: The most beautiful of songs, by Solomon.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri nɛma yihiri.
en: Jesus went into the Temple area. He began to throw out the people who were selling things there.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yi ŋmahi puu ni olivi tiwul shɛŋa bahi, ka zaŋ nyin ŋun nyɛ mɔɣu ni olivi tia na nti tuɣ li ni a nyu puu ni olivi tia maa sum.
en: Some of the branches of the cultivated olive tree have been broken off, and a branch of a wild olive tree has been joined to it. You Gentiles are like that wild olive tree, and now you share the strong spiritual life of the Jews.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n zaŋ n ni daa zaŋ n takɔb mini n tɔbu tuhi Amɔrinim ka fa bɛ tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ Shɛkɛm la ti a, ka a mabihi la nuu ka di ni.
en: Im giving you one portion more than to your brothers, a portion that I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ yi mini yi ni pii yi na so ka o sun ya maa n-tahi yi mini yi yaannim ni daa bi mi zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa.
en: The LORD will send you and the king that you appoint over you far away to a nation that neither you nor your ancestors have known. There you will worship other gods made of wood and stone.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: All of you praise me with your words, but you never really think about me.

dag: Di niŋ zuɣulaannim naani, a mi di niŋ daadamnim bɛn ka sɔŋsim ŋɔ naani.
en: Dont trust leaders; dont trust any human beings— theres no saving help with them!.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛ ni daa gbahi shɛba chaŋ Tɛlabib, ka bɛ be Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la sani. Ka n daa ʒini bɛ sani nimaani daba ayopɔin.
en: and I came to the exiles who lived beside the Chebar River at Tel-abib. I stayed there among them for seven desolate days.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: King Solomon made two hundred body-sized shields of hammered gold, using fifteen pounds of hammered gold in each shield.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ tariga ka m be ka kuhiri boon a n nandahima saha maa. Zaŋm ma tahi kuɣ shɛli din du n-gari ma gbini.
en: When my heart is weak, I cry out to you from the very ends of the earth. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I am.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Izraɛl zuɣulana hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Samuel ruled Israel as long as he lived.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binyar shɛŋa sɔŋ gbilligbilli maa polo.
en: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee kpahimi bɛ zuɣu ni, ka wuhi ba na so ŋun ti yɛn su ba biɛhigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ sani.
en: So comply with their request, but give them a clear warning, telling them how the king will rule over them.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn chɛ yi taali? Yi bihi zaɣisi ma, ka jɛmdila binshɛŋa din pa Naawuni. N yi dihi ba ka bɛ tiɣi, bɛ tumdila zina, ka chani pagɔra yinsi.
en: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛligu Pɛɛga naai bɛ daa gari chaŋla Atalia.
en: They told people the message of God in the city of Perga, and then they went down to the city of Attalia.

dag: Ka Maika bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔhi ma ni bɔ n-chɛ ka n zaŋ niriba ŋɔ pa mmaŋ zuɣu na? Yi kpuɣila n wuna, ka zaŋ m maligumaana pahi, ka bɔ ka yi lee chɛ n-ti mani.
en: Micah answered, You men from Dan took my idols. I made them for myself. You have also taken my priest. What do I have left now? How can you ask me, Whats the problem.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti niŋ Naa Ɛhab naŋgban malisim ka o chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad ka bɛ ti ku o? Ka ŋumbɔŋɔ yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The Lord asked, Who will deceive Ahab so that he will go and get killed at Ramoth? Some of the angels said one thing, and others said something else.

dag: Yawɛ shia ni ti siɣ o zuɣu na nti ti o yɛm mini baŋsim, ka ti o yiko mini saɣisigu ni baŋsim mini Naawuni zɔbo.
en: The LORDs spirit will rest upon him, a spirit of wisdom and understanding, a spirit of planning and strength, a spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia A min a bia Shiajashub cham Ahaz sani. O be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ la polo kpaluhi solɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Isaiah, Take your son Shear Jashub, and go to meet King Ahaz. You will find him on the road where the cloth makers work, at the end of the ditch that brings water from the upper pool.

dag: Amaa wula ka n yɛn yɛli? Dama o pun yɛli ma ni omaŋmaŋa n-niŋ li. Ka n suhu saɣim pam, ka n kɔŋ gom.
en: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.

dag: Gbib amaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lihim a wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga. Kul niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima, dama a yi niŋdi lala, a ni tilig amaŋa zaŋ tabili bɛn wumd a wuhibu.
en: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.

dag: yɛra, Sabimi a ni yɛn nya shɛli maa niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ tim ti ti cheechinima ayopɔin la. Di tinsi n-nyɛ: Ɛfɛsus mini Smɛɛna ni Pɛɛgamum ni Taiatira ni Saadis ni Filadɛlfia ni Laodisia.
en: It said, Write down in a book what you see, and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi jɛrigu nya yɛla; jɛrigu ba ka suhupiɛlli.
en: There is nothing but sadness and sorrow for parents whose children do foolish things.

dag: Ka Hanna daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, Naawuni ti ma suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka n nya kpiɔŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani. N larila n dimnima, dama m mali suhupiɛlli n nasara dibu puuni.
en: Hannah prayed: The Lord has filled my heart with joy; how happy I am because of what he has done! I laugh at my enemies; how joyful I am because God has helped me!.

dag: Di saha niriba ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu.
en: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord , but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement.

dag: Bɛ yi di mali yɛm, bɛ naan baŋ dimbɔŋɔ. Bɛ naan baŋ di bahigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: If they were wise, they would understand; they would know what would happen to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn niŋ yɛda la sani, amaa anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn bi niŋ yɛda la sani.
en: So then, the gift of speaking in strange tongues is proof for unbelievers, not for believers, while the gift of proclaiming God's message is proof for believers, not for unbelievers.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka bɛ mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Bɛ daa kɔrila naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛlahi tuhili ni piɛbihi pola tuhili, m-pahi bɛ binnyura pina zuɣu m-mali sara pam Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: On the very next day they offered sacrifices and entirely burned offerings to the LORD—a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, along with their drink offerings—and many other sacrifices for all Israels sake.

dag: Amaa ka o ba min o ma bɔh o, Paɣa n-ka a dɔɣiriba bipuɣinsi ni bee ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ni ka a ni bɔ, ka ti chaŋ ti bɔrila Filistianim bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ni a niŋ a paɣa? Amaa ka Samsin yɛl o ba, Bom o ti ma, dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: His parents answered, There are a lot of women in our clan and even more in the rest of Israel. Those Philistines are pagans. Why would you want to marry one of their women? She looks good to me, Samson answered. Get her for me.

dag: Kalim Lɛvinima kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm dɔbba bɛn nyɛ kaman gol yini zaŋ chana.
en: Count all the families and family groups in the tribe of Levi. Count every man or boy who is one month old or older.

dag: ka o daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o yiŋ maa na nti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, o ni zaŋ Hiburu nir maa na ka o ti lihi ʒiɛm ti shɛm, o kpɛmina ni o ti zaŋ ma dɔni, ka n kuhi pam.
en: she summoned the men of her house and said to them, Look, my husband brought us a Hebrew to ridicule us. He came to me to lie down with me, but I screamed.

dag: ka din pah ata gbaai Harim, ka din pah anahi gbaai Siɔrim.
en: The third was Harims group. The fourth was Seorims group.

dag: Bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o bela bɛ sochandi tab sani, ka daa chaŋ dabisi muni chandi zaa ka naanyi ti gbaag o bɔbu bɛ dɔɣiriba mini bɛ nimmiriba sani.
en: they thought that he was with the group, so they traveled a whole day and then started looking for him among their relatives and friends.

dag: Hal Saimɔn maŋmaŋ gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu; di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ tabili Filip n-nyari shihira mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa din daa niŋdi maa, ka di gar o pam.
en: Even Simon himself came to believe and was baptized. Afterward, he became one of Philips supporters. As he saw firsthand the signs and great miracles that were happening, he was astonished.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti bi tumdi tuumbiɛri ni di tahi zaɣ viɛlli na? Lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb zuri nyaaŋa yɛri ni lala ka n shiri wuhiri niriba. Bɛn yɛl lala maa simdi tibidarigibo.
en: Why not say, Lets do evil things so that good things will come out of it?.

dag: hal n ni kul yɛli ni biɛhiŋ kani wuntizɔriba ni be maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi niŋ bɛ wuntitali maa naani ka tum alahichi, n ku lan teei bɛ wuntitali tuun shɛli yɛla. Amaa bɛ ni kpi bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa puuni.
en: Even if Ive told the righteous they will live, none of their righteous deeds will be remembered if they trust in their righteousness and do wrong. They will die because of their evil deeds.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmɛlimmi yi kparima, ka kpam niŋ bɛ shɛhi ni.
en: He might be rich and fat.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o ba maa, Nyama, man ŋun kul be a sani nahindi yuun bɔbili ŋɔ zaa ka na ʒi n-zaɣis a noli ŋɔ, a na ʒi n-gbaai hal bubil gba ti ma ni n kɔrigi ka m mini n zɔnim laɣim di ka diɛm.
en: But he said to his father, For years I have worked for you like a slave and have always obeyed you. But you have never even given me a little goat, so that I could give a dinner for my friends.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai tiŋgbɔna nam kam zaa dabiɛm, bɛ ni daa wum Yawɛ ni tuhi Izraɛlnim dimnim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Every nation that heard how the Lord had defeated Israel's enemies was terrified.

dag: Ka Ɛhab bɔh o, Ka banima n-lee yɛn gari tooni chaŋ ti liri ba? Ka anab maa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi la n-yɛn gari tooni. Ka Ɛhab lan bɔh o, Ka ŋuni nti lee yɛn piligi tɔb maa? Ka o yɛl o, Nyini.
en: Ahab said, Who will do it? The prophet answered, This is what the LORD says: The servants of the district officials will do it. Who should start the battle? Ahab asked. You should, the prophet replied.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be, ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ mali alibarika, Tibigimiya n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ.
en: You are the living Lord ! I will praise you! You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.

dag: Din yɛn niŋ maa shihirili m-bɔŋɔ: Yuuni ŋɔ mini yuuni din pahir ayi puuni, dimiya bindir shɛŋa din niŋ di toli be mɔɣu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi ko m-biri ka sa wain tihi yuuni din pah ata puuni n-kpuɣi di daatam di.
en: Then Isaiah said to King Hezekiah, Here is a sign of what will happen. This year and next you will have only wild grain to eat, but the following year you will be able to plant grain and harvest it, and plant vines and eat grapes.

dag: Nir ni tooi di bindir shɛli din be piti ka pa ni yalim be di ni? Bee nyaɣisim bɔ n-lee be no gal piɛlli ni?.
en: Food without salt does not taste good, and the white of an egg has no taste.

dag: Lala ka Naa Sulemaana daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ o ba Dauda ni daa pun bo neen shɛŋa din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni duɣuri ni la shɛŋa ti Naawuni la n-kpɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma duri la ni.
en: After the Lord 's temple was finished, Solomon put into its storage rooms everything that his father David had dedicated to the Lord , including the gold and the silver.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma kul maani ma la ansarisi. Bɛ yi nya ma, bɛ viinila bɛ zuɣuri.
en: When people see me, they laugh at me; they shake their heads in scorn.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yeeg o binyɛra maa ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ tampiligim maa yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.

dag: Man Yawɛ lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-zaŋ wain tiwal viɛla labi, amaa o naɣ zaŋdi li mi dooi wain. Dinzuɣu n gba ku bahi n niriba zaa yoli, n ni tiligi bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord says, No one destroys good grapes; instead, they make wine with them. Neither will I destroy all my people—I will save those who serve me.

dag: dama bɛ tiligira nyɛla ŋun mali yaa. O ni zab bɛ zuɣu.
en: for their redeemer is strong. He will bring charges against you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jarimiya yi kɔbiti din bi jari ŋɔ, ka miriya ka yi biriti yi bimbira niŋdi gɔhi ni.
en: This is what the LORD says to the people of Judah and to the residents of Jerusalem: Break up your hard rocky soil; dont plant among the thorns.

dag: Nahiŋgu mini biɛrim pam m-mali ba dabiɛm. Di lula bɛ zuɣu kaman naa ni mali shili ni o chaŋ tɔb tuhibu shɛm la.
en: He lives in fear, with worry and suffering threatening him like a king ready to attack.

dag: Dama din daa bi yɛn yuu la yi daa kana ni jilima, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ jilima gari lala.
en: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa luɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: You should also make acacia-wood bars: five for the boards on one side of the dwelling.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋ biɛhigu pal shɛli Naawuni ni daa nam ka di ŋmani ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ biɛhigu ka nyɛ din tuhi ka be kasi n-ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy.

dag: A yi ni chɛ ka ti tizo maa dol ti chaŋ, ti ni chaŋ ti da bindira maa na ti a;.
en: If you are willing to send our brother with us, we will go and buy food for you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ nachimbil maa kuli ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri daa maai pam.
en: They took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna. Niriba maa zaa daa yɛlimi, Ti yi di daa kpi Ijipti, di di so! Bee ti yi di kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, di di so!.
en: All the Israelites criticized Moses and Aaron. The entire community said to them, If only we had died in the land of Egypt or if only we had died in this desert!.

dag: hal niriba ata ŋɔ yi be nimaani, hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibisi bee bɛ bipuɣinsi, bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko n-naan tiligi. Amaa tiŋgbani maa naan kpalim zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.

dag: Di nyaaŋa n ni ku paɣ maa bihi, ka cheechinim zaa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri baŋdi din be salinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni, ka nyɛ ŋun ni ti yi zaa yinoyino yi tuma ni simdi shɛm laara.
en: I will also kill her followers, and then all the churches will know that I am the one who knows everyone's thoughts and wishes. I will repay each of you according to what you have done.

dag: ka zibisim din ni chɛ ka a ku tooi nya mini kɔgbana lim a maa.
en: That is why it is so dark you cannot see, and why a flood of water covers you.

dag: Ka n nya ka vuhim daa yi Naawuni sanna nti kpe bɛ ni di daba ata ni pirigili maa dali ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi zani, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi bɛnkam nya ba.
en: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.

dag: Di nyɛla yaɣ kɔŋkɔba, amaa ka nyɛ niŋgbun yini.
en: But as it is, there are many parts but one body.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋa bee o nahu ni lu n-do sol ni ka a baɣa kani, di simdi ni a sɔŋ yiɣis o zali.
en: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa gbaai ma Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la.
en: Because of this, some Jews seized me in the temple and tried to murder me.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka shiri na kpalim be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee.

dag: Lala ka di daa kul be, sagbani maa daa kul pil li mi wuntaŋ ni, ka be kaman buɣim la yuŋ.
en: The cloud stayed over the Holy Tent all the time. And at night the cloud looked like fire.

dag: Ka n daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka yi gbɛri gooni maa gbini? Yi yi lan pahi lala, n ni gbahi ya. Ka di saha maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa bi lan labina Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha.
en: But I warned them, If you do this again, I'll have you arrested. From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya ʒii yuŋ ka ti Duuma yɛl o di ni, Di zɔri dabiɛm; kul yihim waazu maa ka di shini!.
en: During the night, Paul had a vision. The Lord said to him, Dont be afraid, and dont stop talking to people.

dag: N yi dɔni tiŋa m bɔhirimi, Bɔ saha ka n lee yɛn yiɣisi? Amaa ka biɛɣu neebu wɔɣa. Ka n kul mali mmaŋ wolisiri hal ka biɛɣu ti miri neebu.
en: When I lie down, I think, How long before its time to get up? The night drags on. I toss and turn until the sun comes up.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla halibiɛrinima, amaa man yur a zaligunim pam.
en: Their hearts are unfeeling, like blubber, but I rejoice in your Instruction.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina yi tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka biɛhiŋ kani, yi daalahichi maa ku chɛn ya.
en: But if you dont do this, youve sinned against the LORD. Know that your sin will find you.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bindirigu mini kom tuhi Izraɛlnim soli na nti ti ba saha shɛli bɛ ni daa be soli chani la zuɣu. Amaa ka bɛ daa naɣ bula Balaam paa ni o yɛli nol ti Izraɛlnima, amaa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nol yɛlibu maa ŋmaligi leela alibarika.
en: This was because the people of Ammon and Moab did not give food and water to the Israelites on their way out of Egypt. Instead, they paid money to Balaam to curse Israel, but our God turned the curse into a blessing.

dag: niriba ayi n-daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni; bɛ ni yino daa nyɛla Farisii, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ farigudeera.
en: Two people went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

dag: Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka m be, dama n suhu yu a zaligunim maa pam.
en: Let your compassion come to me so I can live again, because your Instruction is my joy!.

dag: Bɛ nyarila ʒiinim din nyɛ ʒiri tir a, bɛ buɣirila ʒiri baɣiri tir a. Bɛ zaŋ a mi pa ninvuɣ yoya mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyiŋgoya zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dabisili pali, ka nyɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha.
en: The visions that you see are false, and the predictions you make are lies. You are wicked and evil, and your day is coming, the day of your final punishment. The sword is going to fall on your necks.

dag: O daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa a ba ni daa ʒili ti la? .
en: He asked, What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier.

dag: Amaa tinim daa niŋ tahima ni ŋuna n-yɛn tiligi Izraɛlnima; ka din pahi ŋɔ zaa ha zuɣu nyɛla, di ni niŋ maa zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: And we had hoped that he would be the one who was going to set Israel free! Besides all that, this is now the third day since it happened.

dag: Ka o daa ti miriti Jɛrusalɛm n-siɣiri Olivi Tihi zolɔŋni ha, ka salo bɛn nyɛ o nyaandoliba suhuri paligi pam, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛri pampam m-paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa nya alahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: When he came near Jerusalem, at the place where the road went down the Mount of Olives, the large crowd of his disciples began to thank God and praise him in loud voices for all the great things that they had seen:.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ zaa ni gbilisi tibili wum, ka taɣi bɛ biɛhigu din bi viɛl maa, ka n gba taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ n ni lo ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu la polo.
en: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from their evil ways. If they do, I will relent and not carry out the harm I have in mind for them because of the wrong they have done.

dag: dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka alikauli maa daa yɛli, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: For God's promise was made in these words: At the right time I will come back, and Sarah will have a son.

dag: Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n kul bɔr a. N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa kul bɔr a mi. Di bemi kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din chaɣisi ka kom ka nimaani la.
en: O God, you are my God, and I long for you. My whole being desires you; like a dry, worn-out, and waterless land, my soul is thirsty for you.

dag: Ka Pita daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, N Duuma, bula ka m mabia lee yɛn tum ma taali ka n kul chɛri paŋd o? N chɛli paŋ o hal ti paai ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, Lord, when someone wont stop doing wrong to me, how many times must I forgive them? Seven times.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn bia Abimilɛk la daa ti chaŋ Shɛkɛm o ŋahinim min o ma daŋ niriba zaa sani ti yɛli ba.
en: Gideon's son Abimelech went to the town of Shechem, where all his mother's relatives lived, and told them.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam, ka a ti ku lan beni. Hal bɛ yi ti bo a shee, bɛ ku lan nya a yaha. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Other people will be afraid about what happened to you. You will be finished. People will look for you, but they will never find you again. That is what the Lord GOD says.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim Mizipa n-tooi kom booi bahi Yawɛ tooni nimaani ka lo noli dindali maa ka yɛli, Ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ka Samuɛl daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana Mizipa maa.
en: So they all gathered at Mizpah. They drew some water and poured it out as an offering to the Lord and fasted that whole day. They said, We have sinned against the Lord .

dag: Ka Ahaz daa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu lahi mini di nɛma zaa na nti ŋmaŋŋma Naawuni duu nɛma maa, ka kpari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka me maligu bimbina zali Jɛrusalɛm lɔrigi kam ni.
en: Ahaz gathered the objects from Gods temple, cut them up, shut the doors of the LORDs temple, and made himself altars on every corner in Jerusalem.

dag: ka o ti yɛl o din ni tilig o min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: He will speak to you, and what he tells you will save you and everyone living in your house.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti du Hɔr Zoli maa niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord s command. Moses, Aaron, and Eleazar went up on Mount Hor. All the Israelites watched them go.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun cham ti nya, ka dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu n-lu yili maa ni maa, yili maa nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Then the priest must come in and check the house. If the infection has spread in the house, it is a disease that spreads quickly to other places. So the house is unclean.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina, ka Pool balim niriba maa zaa ni bɛ dim bindirigu ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ pahirila biɛɣ pinaanahi ka nandahima mali ya ka yi bi di bindirigu.
en: Just before dawn Paul began persuading all the people to eat something. He said, For the past two weeks you have been waiting and watching. You have not eaten for days.

dag: Tol la ni daa ŋubi binshɛŋa zaa la, n ni labisi li tin ya kaman di yuma kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm; dama mani n daa tim toli bɛn daa yiɣira mini bɛn daa saɣinda ni bɛn daa ŋmahiri la na. Bɛ daa nyɛla n tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa, ka n tim ba yi sanna.
en: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi mini bɛ sapashini ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba daa gbaai Yisa n-lo o mihi.
en: Then the Roman soldiers with their commanding officer and the Jewish guards arrested Jesus, tied him up.

dag: Leeban daa chaŋla o piɛri kɔbiri chɛbu, ka Reechɛl daa zu n-kpuɣ o ba wuna.
en: Now, while Laban was out shearing his sheep, Rachel stole the households divine images that belonged to her father.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba maa yi kamina ni bɛ ti bol a, nyin yiɣisim doli ba chaŋ; amaa kul niŋmila n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: That night, God came to Balaam. God said, These men have come again to ask you to go with them. So you can go with them. But do only what I tell you to do.

dag: Bɛ daa kul karitimi doli ti hal ka ti ti kɔŋ ti soya dolibu. Ti bahigu saha miriya; bɛ pun kali ti dabisa. Ti bahigu saha paaya.
en: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.

dag: Ka o daa lan leei nyɛvililana n-dii yiɣisi zani; ka Yisa daa yɛli ni bɛ tim bipuɣiŋga maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: Her life returned, and she got up at once, and Jesus ordered them to give her something to eat.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa ŋme binshɛɣukam din daa be palo ni luhi tiŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa. Ka daa lu n-fiɛri puri ni bimbilima zaa, ka da tihi luhi.
en: People, animals, and crops were pounded by the hailstones, and bark was stripped from trees.

dag: Di saha ka Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ dabili maa daa kpi nimaani Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa.
en: Then Moses, the LORDs servant, died—right there in the land of Moab, according to the LORDs command.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim beni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ sani, di pa shɛli ka yi tɛhi ni yɛlli ŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa man sani, di ni tooi nani.
en: This may seem impossible to those of the nation who are now left, but it's not impossible for me.

dag: Ba maa ni neeri kpiimba kum ni ka tiri ba nyɛvili shɛm, lala ka Bia maa gba tiri o ni bɔri so nyɛvili.
en: As the Father raises the dead and gives life, so too does the Son give life to whomever he wishes.

dag: Hashum daŋ — kɔbisiyi ni pisinaata.
en: of Hashum.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirig o o zaɣim, ka fa o bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku o. Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka o leei paɣiba ni maani so ansarisi.
en: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi naɣibila bee piɛbila bee bubila, di simdi ka o be o ma sani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin, ka daba anii zaŋ chana, yi yi zaŋ o nyo buɣim mali sara ti man Yawɛ, n ni deei li.
en: When an ox or sheep or goat is born, it must remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on it will be acceptable as an offering, a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa du zuɣusaa n-yi tiŋ maa sunsuuni chaŋ ti zani zo shɛli din be tiŋ maa wulimpuhili polo la zuɣu.
en: Then the dazzling light left the city and moved to the mountain east of it.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni daa neei so kum ni maa ŋun daa bi pooi.
en: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn be n sani n wahala dibu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: You are the ones who have continued with me in my trials.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yi ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ polo, dahin shɛli kanna ka di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Do you see these stones? The time is coming when not one of them will be left in place. They will all be knocked down.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili kul paari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ŋun Naawuni noli.
en: The wrath of God is coming upon disobedient people because of these things.

dag: Bɛ zaliya ni bɛ gbahimi tiŋ maa nim chaŋ. Bɛ gbahi di dabipaɣiba chaŋ, ka bɛ fabindi kaman ŋmana la, ka buri bɛ nyɔri.
en: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.

dag: Di saha ka o paɣ daa bɔh o, A na kul gbibila a galimi kalinsi maa kirikiri? Tum Naawuni ka kpi.
en: Jobs wife said to him, Are you still clinging to your integrity? Curse God, and die.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Yawɛ kul lari ba. A nyɛla ŋun maani zuliya kam zaa ansarisi.
en: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You mock all the nations.

dag: Mani m-piig a dɔɣiriba Lɛvinima Izraɛlnim ni; bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni su shɛba; ka o zaŋ ba ti a ni bɛ tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma.
en: I alone chose the Levites from all the other tribes to belong to me, and I have given them to you as your helpers.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi ŋuna n-yɛn kpi. Bia ku di wahala o ba daalahichi zuɣu. Ka bialan ku di wahala o bia daalahichi zuɣu. Wuntizɔra wuntia tuma yɛn nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ko dini, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu mi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ko dini.
en: Only those who sin will be put to death. Children won't suffer for the sins of their parents, and parents won't suffer for the sins of their children. Good people will be rewarded for what they do, and evil people will be punished for what they do.

dag: Dama pagɔrili samli yɔri nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, amaa so paɣ bɔbu nyɛla din diri nir nyɛvili.
en: A prostitute might cost a loaf of bread, but the wife of another man could cost you your life.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: When they finished mocking him, they stripped him of the purple robe and put his own clothes back on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n wuntia ŋɔ, n yi suh a, nyin garigim ma. N daa be muɣisigu ni ka a ti ma faako. Niŋm ma nirilim ka deei n suhigu.
en: Answer me when I cry out, my righteous God! Set me free from my troubles! Have mercy on me! Listen to my prayer!.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka piɛ yino ti bɔrigi ka o ku chɛ piɛri kɔbigayinika la bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu hal ti nya o?.
en: Suppose one of you has sheep, but one of them gets lost. What will you do? You will leave the other sheep there in the field and go out and look for the lost sheep. You will continue to search for it until you find it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Filistianim mini Ammɔnnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: The Lord was angry with Israel and decided to let Philistia and Ammon conquer them.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam neesim kara ayi n-chɛ ka din galisi pam la ne wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka din pa di zuɣu mi ne yuŋ; ka daa nam saŋmarisi gba.
en: So God made the two large lights. He made the larger light to rule during the day and the smaller light to rule during the night. He also made the stars.

dag: N kul ni puhir a sahakam, a ni tum shɛm zuɣu. N ni duh a yuli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim sani, dama a yuli maa viɛla.
en: I will always thank you, God, for what you have done; in the presence of your people I will proclaim that you are good.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa daa zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din daa be di ni maa ti Ibrahimma, ka di leeg o dini, ka o zaŋ li leeg o kpiimba sɔɣibu shee.
en: So the field which had belonged to the Hittites, and the cave in it, became the property of Abraham for a burial ground.

dag: Yi mi di zaŋya yimaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni la bee m-boli bɛ buɣa la yuya bee m-po ba bee n-jɛm ba bee n-damdi di tooni.
en: and then you will not associate with these peoples left among you or speak the names of their gods or use those names in taking vows or worship those gods or bow down to them.

dag: Di chira ata nyaaŋa ka ti daa ti kpe Alikizandria ŋariŋ shɛli din dalinli daa nyɛ bɛ buɣijahi ŋmahinli la. Di daa kpalim ʒe nimaani la kikaa saha zaa.
en: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as The Twin Gods.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpe m-pali Pita ka o yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini kpamba ŋɔ.
en: Then Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and said to them, Rulers of the people and you older leaders.

dag: Ka yɛm yi pooi yi ni so, ŋun suhimi Naawuni ka o ti o li; dama Naawuni nyɛla ŋun tiri sokam ka di galisira, ka bi nyari so taali di puuni.
en: But if any of you lack wisdom, you should pray to God, who will give it to you; because God gives generously and graciously to all.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka n lili kpe zibisim ni, ka zibisim titali limsi n ninni.
en: What has happened to me is like a dark cloud over my face. But the darkness will not keep me quiet.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tuhi nyaŋ Judanim maa, ka sokam zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: the Judean army was defeated, and the soldiers fled to their homes.

dag: N yi ti do m bindoo zuɣu n teerila a yɛla; ka kul tɛhir a yɛla yuntisuɣu saha;.
en: As I lie in bed, I remember you; all night long I think of you.

dag: Ka Firawuna kpamba daa yɛl o Bɔ saha ka doo ŋɔ yɛn chɛ ti zana baribu? Chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa, a na kul bi baŋ ni Ijipti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Then the officials asked Pharaoh, How long will we be trapped by these people? Let the men go to worship the Lord their God. If you dont let them go, before you know it, Egypt will be destroyed.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko pam mini jilima.
en: Then the Son of Man will be seen coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: The Lord says, The time is coming when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.

dag: O ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma ata saha shɛli, ka o daa tim o kpambaliba, Bɛnheel mini Obadia ni Zakaria ni Nɛtanɛl ni Mikaya ni bɛ chaŋ Juda fɔntinsi ni ti wuhi niriba.
en: In the third year of his reign he sent out the following officials to teach in the cities of Judah: Benhail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla yuun pisi m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini ŋun Sulemaana nam yili.
en: It took years for King Solomon to build the Lord s Temple and the kings palace.

dag: Masia daa yihi ti dabitim ni, ka ti leei bilichinnima. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di lan niŋya nti leei daba yaha.
en: Christ has set us free for freedom. Therefore, stand firm and dont submit to the bondage of slavery again.

dag: Ka o daa zom dabisi muna ata, ka bi di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: For three days he was blind and neither ate nor drank anything.

dag: N yaa nyɛ dini ka n yɛn guhira? Ka m bahigu lee nyɛ dini ka n ni di suɣilo?.
en: What is my strength, that I should hope; my end, that my life should drag on?.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa daŋ tooni na maa yɛli malaika so ŋun doli nyaaŋa na maa, Guui chaŋ ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun mali bimbuɣisirigu maa ni niriba pam mini niɣi pam n-yɛn be Jɛrusalɛm; ka di be kaman tiŋkpansi din ka goma la.
en: The first one said to the other, Run and tell that young man with the measuring line that there are going to be so many people and so much livestock in Jerusalem that it will be too big to have walls.

dag: A nuu ni bo n-nya a dimnim zaa. A nudirigu ni bo n-nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je a.
en: The king will capture all his enemies; he will capture everyone who hates him.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, o lan bom wain din nyɛ binnyura sara la lita yini pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu bee piɛbil kam sara zuɣu.
en: You will also offer one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering with either the entirely burned offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla Iso bidibisi , bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ nanima.
en: They were all sons of Esau and leaders of the family groups of Edom.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa wum yɛlli maa, ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim Shilo na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: the Israelite men met at Shiloh to get ready to attack the two and a half tribes.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabihi pinaata mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi.
en: On the first day, you must rest from your work and come together for worship. Bring to the altar bulls, full-grown rams, and rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Dinzuɣu bomiya nya o ni sɔɣiri luɣ shɛŋa zaa ka labina ti yɛli ma yɛlimaŋli, ka m mini ya chaŋ; ŋun dee yi be tiŋgbani maa ni, n ni bɔ o shee Judanim zaa niriba tusatusa puuni.
en: Find out every hiding place he uses there and come back to me when you know for certain. I will then go with you. If David is in the area, I will hunt him down among any of Judahs clans.

dag: Saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka yi ni ti wurim zo n-kuli yi yinsi ka chɛ ma n ko, amaa m pala n ko, dama m Ba maa be n sani.
en: Look! A time is coming—and is here!—when each of you will be scattered to your own homes and you will leave me alone. Im not really alone, for the Father is with me.

dag: Naɣilahi pam n-teei gili ma. Bashan naɣilahi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-kul teei gili ma.
en: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.

dag: A ku chɛ ka sula a wuni Chɛmɔshi ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti a ni a su la? Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa zaa ti ti la, ka ti mi su li.
en: If Chemosh your god takes over a country and gives it to you, don't you have a right to it? And if the Lord takes over a country and gives it to us, the land is ours!.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, N ni bɔri shɛli mini n ni yɛn suh a shɛli nyɛla:.
en: Esther answered, This is what I want to ask for:.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabili ŋun suhu ye mahim zuɣu, ka ŋmani tumtumdiba bɛn guhiri bɛ yɔri.
en: like a slave longing for cool shade; like a worker waiting to be paid.

dag: A chɛ ka daadamnim vuura kaman zahindi la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila mɔri din puhiri yirina asibaasi.
en: You sweep humans away like a dream, like grass that is renewed in the morning.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya suhudoo.
en: But the Lord also said, There is no peace for evil people.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisa nyɛla maligumaani tital so ŋun tumdi din sɔŋdi ti ni yɛlimaŋli. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi ka ka galimi, ka alahichi mi ka o ni; Naawuni n-wolig o ka o be o ko ka chɛ alahichinima, ka duh o gari sokam zaa bɛn be alizanda ni.
en: Its appropriate for us to have this kind of high priest: holy, innocent, incorrupt, separate from sinners, and raised high above the heavens.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi alizanda ni na, ka o jilima neesim daa neei dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam.
en: After this I saw another angel coming down out of heaven. He had great authority, and his splendor brightened the whole earth.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya shɛb bɔhira, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be.
en: Why should the nations ask us, Where is your God.

dag: A ni yu zaɣ viɛlli la zuɣu, niŋm Ziɔn zaɣ viɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm goma zali yaha.
en: God, please be good to Zion. Rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa teeg o nuu zuɣusaa ha n-tirina gbaai ma n-vooi ma yihi kom pam puuni na.
en: The Lord reached down from above and took hold of me; he pulled me out of the deep waters.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Nyama, n ni kari Amɔrinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima, ka chɛ palo tin ya.
en: Obey what I command you today, and I will force your enemies to leave your land. I will force out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari. A shiri nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari ni kɔbil nini din ŋari.
en: My darling, my bride, you are pure like a locked garden. You are like a locked pool, a closed fountain.

dag: Tinzunnim ni kana ti me yi goma tin ya, ka bɛ nanim jɛm ya. N daa yiɣisila n suhu bahi yi zuɣu n-darigi yi tibili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: Children from other lands will rebuild your walls. Their kings will serve you. When I was angry, I hurt you, but now I want to be kind to you. So I will comfort you.

dag: ka yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti ni chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni m-puɣisi nya li maa tiŋgbani viɛli pam.
en: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.

dag: M bɔri ni n yɛli ya n ni mɔri mɔ shɛli yi mini Laodisianim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi ma ni nini la zuɣu yɛla.
en: I want you to know how much I struggle for you, for those in Laodicea, and for all who havent known me personally.

dag: Yi ni daa fa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya nɛma, ka ku ba la zuɣu, yi ni di vi, ka n kpihim yi birili hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Because you robbed and killed your relatives, the descendants of Jacob, you will be destroyed and dishonored forever.

dag: Ka niriba maa yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka saa bi mira, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na n-kuhi bol a yuli ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa ka suh a.
en: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they turn toward this temple and pray in your name and stop sinning.

dag: Izraɛlnima n-tum alahichi; bɛ zaɣisila n ni zali ba zaligu shɛl la dolibu; ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Man Yawɛ la. Bɛ zu n-kpuɣ li pahi bɛ nɛma ni, ka ŋma ʒiri.
en: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.

dag: Baŋsim puuni ka bɛ zaŋdi neen viɛla mini azichi nɛma paani duri.
en: Where there is knowledge, the rooms are furnished with valuable, beautiful things.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni vili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba labi. N ni chɛ ka nandahima gbaai ba hal ka bɛ ni ti mii.
en: The Lord is going to throw you out of this land; he is going to crush you until not one of you is left. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Yi niriba ŋmanila zana ni gbahi kparibu shɛba. Bɛ kul gbarigimi do sochira kam zuɣu. Bɛ nyula Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili mini Naawuni tibidarigibo buɣi.
en: At the corner of every street your people collapse from weakness; they are like deer caught in a hunter's net. They have felt the force of God's anger.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni zaŋ a mini Izraɛlnim niŋ Filistianim nuu ni, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni a min a bidibisi sa ni be n sani, dama Yawɛ ni zaŋ Izraɛl tɔbbihi niŋ Filistianim nuu ni.
en: Tomorrow the Lord will let the Philistines defeat Israel's army, then you and your sons will join me down here in the world of the dead.

dag: Di zaliya yi daazichi dunia ŋɔ ni, dama dunia ŋɔ ni di zahindimi, ka lɛla saɣindi li, ka tayiɣisi kabiri kpɛri zuri li.
en: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, pa nyini n-daa kari tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka zaŋ li ti a zo Ibrahimma zuliya sahakam la?.
en: You are our God. When your people Israel moved into this land, you drove out the people who were living here and gave the land to the descendants of Abraham, your friend, to be theirs forever.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga.
en: My father is Bethuel son of Nahor and Milcah, she answered.

dag: M mabihi, di maliya yɛtɔɣ bihibihi ni yi taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti kari ya saria. Nyamiya, sariakarita maa ʒiɛla dunoli ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, dont complain against each other. If you dont stop complaining, you will be judged guilty. And the Judge is ready to come!.

dag: Ka o dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni. Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ tatabo.
en: The man got right up. He picked up his mat and went out while everyone watched in amazement. They praised God and said, We have never seen anything like this.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba ti chani gindina nti nya ma, ka m bɔhi ba, Yi nya n yura la.
en: The guards found me, those who make their rounds in the city. The one whom I love with all my heart— have you seen him.

dag: dama hal bɛn guni gba maŋmaŋ bi doli fukumsi zaligu, amaa din chɛ ka bɛ bɔri ni yi guni nyɛla ni bɛ tooi nyu bara yi niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti yi paɣ maa zuɣu yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi, amaa a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: The Lord 's angel appeared to her and said, You have never been able to have children, but you will soon be pregnant and have a son.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa yi kul yirila Sool sani n-kun o ba sani Bɛtilihɛm ti gul o piɛri saha saha ka labira.
en: but David left Saul from time to time to take care of his fathers sheep at Bethlehem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka bɔh o, Paɣa, ka bɛ be ya? Bɛ ni so bi lan yɛli ni a simdi kubu.
en: Jesus stood up and asked her, Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you.

dag: Tɔbu lu di yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn be sunsuuni zaa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei paɣiba. Tɔbu lu bɛ daazichi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di li.
en: Destroy its horses and chariots! Death to its hired soldiers— how weak they are! Destroy its treasures; plunder and loot.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Damaskusnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Giliadnima nahindi biɛɣu.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish the people of Damascus for the many crimes they did. They crushed the people of Gilead with iron threshing tools.

dag: Nimdi mini gbaŋ dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa ti nyo li buɣim.
en: But he burned the meat and the skin outside the camp.

dag: Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino ni Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa la.
en: Simon, the Zealot, Judas Iscariot .

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Naawuni o jɛmbu duu. Paɣimiy o zuɣusaa din nyɛ o yiko ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Praise the Lord ! Praise God in his Temple! Praise his strength in heaven!.

dag: Yawɛ, hal a ni kul be zuɣusaa ha maa zaa yoli, a baɣa be tarimba ni, amaa a be katiŋ ka chɛ karimbaannima.
en: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.

dag: Bɛ yɛla mali dabiɛm pam, bɛ karimbaani zuɣu bɛ zalila bɛmaŋmaŋ zaligunima.
en: The Babylonians will scare the other people. They will do what they want to do and go where they want to go.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni n-chani Firawuna sani nti yihiri Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Moses said to God, I am nobody. How can I go to the king and bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa lan bɔhi Balaam, Pa a bun so a ni bari sahakam zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-nyɛ ma? Ka n na mi n-niŋ a lala? Ka o garigi yɛli, Aai.
en: The donkey said to Balaam, Am I not your donkey, on whom youve often ridden to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you? Balaam said, No.

dag: A ni pahi ma jilima; ka maai n suhu yaha.
en: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt, Di sabi ni Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ, amaa sabimila, Doo ŋɔ yɛliya ni o nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa. .
en: The leading Jewish priests said to Pilate, Dont write, The King of the Jews. But write, This man said, I am the King of the Jews.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni, Sallu daa nyɛla Mɛshulam bia, ka Hɔdavia nyɛ Hasɛnua bia.
en: From Benjamins family: Sallu son of Meshullam son of Hodaviah son of Senaah.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka o laɣis o kpamba min o sapashinnima ni Galili ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa na ni bɛ ti puhi di chuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Hɛrɔdias katari.
en: Finally Herodias got her chance. It was on Herod's birthday, when he gave a feast for all the top government officials, the military chiefs, and the leading citizens of Galilee.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa mini Izraɛlnima n-daa tuhi nyaŋ nanim maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ dabili Musa daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana n-ti Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili ni bɛ su li.
en: These two kings were defeated by Moses and the people of Israel. Moses, the Lord 's servant, gave their land to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and to half the tribe of Manasseh, to be their possession.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋmaligim na tiligi ma; fam ma bahi a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu.
en: Lord , come back and make me strong again. Save me because you are so loyal and kind.

dag: Bɛn pa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhuyiɣisili; hal o yi lo ba mihi gba, bɛ bi suhir o bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: People who dont care about God are always bitter. Even when he punishes them, they refuse to pray to him for help.

dag: Ti ni so bi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti ni so mi bi kpiri omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: We dont live for ourselves and we dont die for ourselves.

dag: Dama a suui ʒitibisi shɛli din wum ba la; ka kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli bɛ ni mali fiɛbiri bɛ bɔɣusapima la. A nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nahind a niriba kaman a ni daa nyaŋ Midian tɔbbihi shɛm la.
en: For you have broken the yoke that burdened them and the rod that beat their shoulders. You have defeated the nation that oppressed and exploited your people, just as you defeated the army of Midian long ago.

dag: Niŋmiya kaman n ni niŋdi shɛm. N kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n tiɣi sokam nini n ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla niriba pam sɔŋsim zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: I do the same thing. I try to please everyone in every way. I am not trying to do what is good for me. I am trying to do what is good for the most people so that they can be saved.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka bɛ ni bi zaŋdi so taali zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari jilima.
en: Insightful people restrain their anger; their glory is to ignore an offense.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋ jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: Anyone who refuses will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Daniɛl daa ti kana. O nyɛla wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia ni be so ni, ka n daa yɛl o n zahindi maa. N daa yɛl o mi:.
en: Then Daniel came in. The spirit of the holy gods is in him, so I told him what I had dreamed. I said to him:.

dag: N kɔre lan ka di zaa ni, di nyɛla bindir shɛŋa din bi luhi n kpaɣa.
en: I refuse to touch them; they resemble food for the sick.

dag: Lihimiya ma ka chɛ ka di gari ya, ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi pɔb yi noya.
en: Look at me and be shocked. Put your hand over your mouth, and stare at me in shock!.

dag: Saimɔn Pita pun wuhi ti Naawuni ni daa tuui pii bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ leeg o niriba shɛm yɛla.
en: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.

dag: Bɛ ku zaŋ a pahi bɛ zuɣu sɔɣi, dama a daa saɣim a tiŋgbɔŋ, ka ku a niriba. So ku teei a zuliya bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la ni so yɛla.
en: Other kings have their own graves, but you will not join them, because you ruined your own country and killed your own people. So your wicked descendants will be stopped.

dag: Ka o daa teeg o nuu zuɣusaa ha n-tirina gbaai ma n-vooi ma yihi kom pam puuni na.
en: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.

dag: Ka naa yi bi yura ka tum birigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi kpe taali ni.
en: A ruler might sin without meaning to and break one of the commands of the Lord . He might do something that his God said must not be done.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o boli; ka o ni boli shɛb maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani; ka o ni chɛ ka shɛb yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya o jilima.
en: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ n ni daa tim ba ka bɛ yi Kadɛshibarinia chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: That is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land.

dag: Di yi pa lala ŋuni n-lee ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ʒirilana, ka wuhi ni n ni yɛli shɛm maa kani.
en: I swear these things are true! Who can prove that I lied? Who can show that I am wrong.

dag: Ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n dan maa ni pam ka o leei bundana. O ti o piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni anzinfa mini salima ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: The LORD has richly blessed my master, has made him a great man, and has given him flocks, cattle, silver, gold, men servants, women servants, camels, and donkeys.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la yuli duya pam. Ti pun wum o yɛla; ka wum o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa Ijipti la yɛla;.
en: Then they told him this story: We have come from a very distant land, sir, because we have heard of the Lord your God. We have heard about everything that he did in Egypt.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dooni bɛ gom shee n-lɔri nia biɛri. Bɛ bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ zali so viɛlli zuɣu; bɛ mi bi zaɣisiri din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: They make evil plans as they lie in bed; nothing they do is good, and they never reject anything evil.

dag: Ti mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti ka o chɛ ka ti Duuma yɛligu yɛligi yomyom ka di nasara kaman di ni daa di nasara yi sani shɛm la.
en: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us so that the Lords message will spread quickly and be honored, just like it happened with you.

dag: ka ŋun mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli m-buɣi doli ma gba bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma, hal ka tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma ti yaɣi.
en: Some people are so proud of themselves, and they look down on everyone else.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Naftali zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Naphtali was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed by name with their families and family groups.

dag: Amaa bɔhimi biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ wuh a; ka bɔhi noonsi ka bɛ yɛl a;.
en: Even birds and animals have much they could teach you;.

dag: O daa zaŋla tɔrokɔnim ayi mini naɣilah anahi ti Gɛrishɔn bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the Gershonites.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛl o niriba maa, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Sool Ka Sool daa ti yiɣisi voli maa ni yina chaŋ o chandi.
en: So David convinced his men that they should not attack Saul. Saul got up, left the cave, and started away.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti tabili Pɛɔr tiŋgbɔŋ ni Baal, ka diri kpiimba maligu nimdi.
en: At Baal Peor they joined in worshiping Baal and ate sacrifices to honor the dead.

dag: Jɔtam daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa tum shɛm; ŋun daa lee bi ŋmɛla nyɔɣu kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Amaa niriba maa daa na kul tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: Jotham obeyed the Lord and did right. He followed the example of his father Uzziah, except he never burned incense in the temple as his father had done. But the people of Judah kept sinning against the Lord .

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa baŋ Naawuni bee Naawuni yipa baŋ ya, ka di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛn lab dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gbarigi ka ka yaa ŋɔ dabitim ni yaha? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan bɔri ni yi labi di sulinsi ni yaha?.
en: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?.

dag: Ka o daa siɣim pam ka yɛli, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim bɔri shihirili? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ku nya shihirili hal baabiɛla.
en: Jesus sighed deeply and said, Why do you people ask to see a miracle as a sign? I want you to know that no miracle will be done to prove anything to you.

dag: Paɣ maa nini ni daa ti nya Samuɛl, o daa ŋmɛla kuŋ pam ka bɔhi Sool, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma? Nyini n-nyɛ Sool.
en: When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed at Saul, Why have you tricked me? You are Saul.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka niŋdi n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka doli n zaligunim zaa.
en: As for you, if you will walk before me just as your father David did, doing all that I have commanded you and keeping my regulations and case laws.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti yiri Jɛriko ka salo pam dol o.
en: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.

dag: Di saha bɛ mini Sool ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa daa bela Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-tuhiri Filistianima.
en: They're with Saul's army, fighting the Philistines in Elah Valley.

dag: Di saha maa Abiata bia Jɔnatan mini Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa sɔɣila Ɛnrɔgɛl, ka bipuɣimbil so chani ti yɛri ba dinkam beni, ka bɛ mi zaŋdi li chani ti yɛri Naa Dauda, dama bɛ daa bi bɔr ni bɛ kpe tiŋ puuni ka so nya ba.
en: The priests sons, Jonathan and Ahimaaz, did not want to be seen going into the town, so they waited at En Rogel. A servant girl went out to them and gave them the message. Then Jonathan and Ahimaaz carried the message to King David.

dag: Ka Ɛdom mɔɣa leei kootaali, ka di tiŋgbani leei chilibi, ka di tiŋgbani maa taai buɣim di kaman kootaali la.
en: The rivers of Edom will turn into tar, and the soil will turn into sulfur. The whole country will burn like tar.

dag: Bɛ nol ni yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, o ni chɛ ka bɛ bahi ba yoli zaa, ka bɛnkam zaa nya ba, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: The LORD will make them trip over their own tongues; everyone who sees them will just shake their heads.

dag: Zaŋm salima mali kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni.
en: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold.

dag: M malaika maa yi ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ya tahi Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Keenannim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n ti ku ba ka chɛ ka yi ʒini nimaani.
en: My angel will lead you through the land. He will lead you against many different people—the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites. But I will defeat all of them.

dag: A yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni tooi chɛ ka niriba fo bɛ noya? Ka a yi maani niriba ansarisi so ŋun di dih a vi?.
en: Job, do you think we can't answer you? That your mocking words will leave us speechless?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Gibiɔnnim maa, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn niŋ tin ya? Bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yɔn ya ti ni daa tum ya taal shɛli maa samli, ka yi suhi alibarika niŋ Yawɛ ni su shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: David said to the Gibeonites, What can I do for you? What can I do to take away Israels sin, so that you can bless the Lord s people.

dag: Bɛ daa me li tamla bimbin kurili la tanzaa zuɣu, hal bɛ ni daa kul zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab dabiɛm la zaa yoli. Ka bɛ daa maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu tiri Yawɛ asiba ni zaawuni.
en: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord .

dag: ni Kibizaim ni Bɛtihɔrɔn mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Kibzaim and its pastures; and Beth-horon and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: Amaa ka naa maa daa bɔh o, Siɣimsiɣim bula ka n kul yɛr a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: But Ahab replied, When you speak to me in the name of the Lord , tell the truth! How many times do I have to tell you that.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, so di lan muɣisiri ma, dama m mali wulɛ shɛŋa din be n niŋgbuŋ ni n-wuhiri ni n nyɛla Yisa ni su so.
en: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yi nyɛ suhutunanima, amaa chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋ yɛda ka mali suɣilo la biɛhigu, ka di chɛ ka yi nya Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la palibu.
en: This is so you wont be lazy but follow the example of the ones who inherit the promises through faith and patience.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima, ka nyɛ n ni pii n dab shɛba ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ka niŋ ma yɛda. Ka lan baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. Naawuni so ka n tooni, ka so mi ka n nyaaŋa.
en: People of Israel, you are my witnesses; I chose you to be my servant, so that you would know me and believe in me and understand that I am the only God. Besides me there is no other god; there never was and never will be.

dag: N lo a alikauli, a ni niŋ zuliya pam yaba.
en: But me, my covenant is with you; you will be the ancestor of many nations.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la polo, m bɔri ni yi gba niŋ li kaman n ni daa wuhi cheechinim din be Galɛshia tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm la.
en: Now, about the collection of money for Gods people: Do the same as I told the Galatian churches to do.

dag: Di saha ka nu shɛli daa gbaai ma n-kpuɣi ma gbani n duna zuɣu ka n nuhi dihi tiŋa, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: Then a hand took hold of me and raised me to my hands and knees; I was still trembling.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi binfalafala din daa be chɛrubinim zuɣuri zuɣusaa la, ka binshɛli daa be bɛ zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani safaya kuɣili, di kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee.
en: I looked at the dome over the heads of the living creatures and above them was something that seemed to be a throne made of sapphire.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din daa nyɛ kuɣ kara ka mali shaara, ka di shɛŋa wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili, ka shɛŋa mi nyɛ mita anahinahi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali duri maa tanzahi.
en: The foundations were made with large, expensive stones. Some of the stones were cubits long and the others were cubits long.

dag: Yɛm kuhiri pampam solɔri zuɣu, o duhir o yee niriba laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Listen! Wisdom is shouting in the streets. She is crying out in the marketplace.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm mali Aduna min o bidibisi ka bɛ tooi tum maligumaaniba tuma ti ma m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi naɣila polli mini piɛlah ayi bɛn ka galimi.
en: Now I will tell you what you must do to show that Aaron and his sons serve me in a special way as priests. Find one young bull and two rams that have nothing wrong with them.

dag: ka nyo bɛ buɣa buɣim; dama buɣa maa pala Naawuni; amaa di nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛli, ka di nyɛ dari mini kuɣa, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa saɣim li maa.
en: and burned up their gods—which were no gods at all, only images of wood and stone made by human hands.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o suli min o sujee ni o suhuyiɣisili ni nandahima paai ba, ka di ŋmanila malaika bɔbili bɛn kuri niriba.
en: He showed the Egyptians his anger. He sent his destroying angels against them.

dag: Tuhimi yɛda tɔbu la tuhiri suŋ; gbib nyɛvili din ka bahigu shɛli zuɣu Naawuni ni daa bol a, ka a niŋ shɛhira suŋ ka kahigi di yɛla wuhi shɛhiranim pam san la.
en: Run your best in the race of faith, and win eternal life for yourself; for it was to this life that God called you when you firmly professed your faith before many witnesses.

dag: Bɛ gɔŋla bɛ zilima ka di be kaman tɔbiri la; bɛ mali yaa pam tiŋgbani maa ni zaŋ chaŋ ʒiri ŋmabu polo, ka pa ni yɛlimaŋli polo. Dama bɛ kul tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka bi mi ma, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They use their tongues like a bow; lies fly from their mouths like arrows. Lies, not truth, have grown strong in this land. They go from one sin to another. They dont know me. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be tiŋkpansi zaŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali leei suhupiɛlli vuhim mini chuɣu puhibu dabisili, ka daa niŋ bindira tari taba.
en: This is why the Jews in the villages now celebrate on the fourteenth day of the month. It is a joyful holiday that they celebrate by feasting and sending gifts of food to each other.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo naɣ muni maa zaa o ninni, dina n-nyɛ o gbaŋ min o nimdi ni o ʒim ni o puuni binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Then he will burn the cow in front of him, its skin, flesh, and blood, with its dung.

dag: Ammɔnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba ŋmaligi Jɔab mabia Abishai sani guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni, ka chɛ Abishai Jɔab mabia maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonite army saw that the Aramean army was running away, they also ran away. They ran away from Abishai and his army. The Ammonites went back to their city, and Joab went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa, ka lan mali suhukpeeni pam, ka daa chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni hal ka o saha ti paai, ka o naanyi yih omaŋ palo Izraɛlnim sani.
en: The child grew and developed in body and spirit. He lived in the desert until the day when he appeared publicly to the people of Israel.

dag: Di lan sabi: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, maliya suhupiɛlli pah o niriba zuɣu.
en: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, Come and celebrate with God's people.
