dag: kaman Daadam Bia gba ni be shɛm la; o bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o, amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: Do as I did: The Son of Man did not come for people to serve him. He came to serve others and to give his life to save many people.

dag: M bi zaŋ mmaŋ dalimla ninsal shɛhira, amaa n yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔ yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu ka n daa bi zaɣisi Naawuni ni wuhi ma shɛli ʒii maa puuni la.
en: And so, King Agrippa, I did not disobey the vision I had from heaven.

dag: Ka Pita teei ka yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, nyam fiig ti shɛli a ni sa yɛli noli ti la ni kuui zaa shɛm.
en: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, Rabbi, look how the fig tree you cursed has dried up.

dag: Iso bia Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso paɣ Basɛmat yaansi.
en: The clans that descended from Esau and Basemath's son Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, benya kaman mani, dama n gba bemi kaman yinima. Yi bi tum ma taali.
en: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me.

dag: Bom mɔɣu ni nimdi na ti duɣi n ni yuri bindir shɛli, ka n di ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni Yawɛ tooni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Bring me an animal and cook it for me. After I have eaten it, I will give you my blessing in the presence of the Lord before I die.

dag: Ibihar ni Ɛlishua ni Nɛfɛg ni Jafia ni.
en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia.

dag: Ka Ifriim min o paɣ maa daa lan dɔni ka o niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Bɛraya, zaɣ biɛɣu din daa niŋ o yiŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: Ephraim had sex with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because misfortune had come to his house.

dag: amaa ka malaika maa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Dama lahibal suŋ din mali suhupiɛlli pam ka nyɛ sokam zaa dini ka n ʒina ni n ti yɛli ya.
en: But the angel said, Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.

dag: Ka dansarika gula maa daa yɛli Pool ni sariakaritib maa tim na ti yɛl o ni o yoom ba bahi ka bɛ chaŋ; dinzuɣu ni bɛ yim n-chaŋ ni suhuʒia.
en: So the jailer reported this to Paul, informing him, The authorities sent word that you both are to be released. You can leave now. Go in peace.

dag: Ka Rut daa chaŋ kabɔɣili maa ni nti shiri niŋ kaman o yidan ma maa ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So Ruth went to the threshing place and did just what her mother-in-law had told her.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa ni piɛbihi la zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You must also give the right amount of grain and drink offerings with the bull, ram, and lambs.

dag: Aai, tuumbiɛri tumbu m-be yi suhuri ni, ka yi kul tumdila duŋtaabo tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: No: in your hearts you plan injustice; your hands do violence on the earth.

dag: N nyee nyɔni n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam zaa dunia ŋɔ ni, dama m mi ni n yɛn chɛ li zalila na shɛb bɛn yɛn doli n nyaaŋa.
en: Nothing that I had worked for and earned meant a thing to me, because I knew that I would have to leave it to my successor.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii zuɣulaannim ti ba; ka zuɣulaannim maa daa tiligi ba ŋmɛnditoya maa nuu ni.
en: From time to time, the Lord would choose special leaders known as judges. These judges would lead the Israelites into battle and defeat the enemies that made raids on them.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa kpe suɣili maa ni nti nya ka Aduna jaaŋgbee din daa nyɛ Lɛvinim din la puhila vari, ka daai pum n-wali alimɔnd wal moma.
en: The next day when Moses went into the tent, flowers and almonds were already growing on Aaron's stick.

dag: Mɔabnim suhuri kul ʒimi bɛ piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ wain shɛli le duɣu ni, ka bi kpaari li loori duɣu shɛl ni; ka so mi na bi gbahi ba daba chaŋ luɣ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ na kul mali binshɛlikam, ka bɛ binshɛli bi saɣim maa.
en: Moab, you are like wine left to settle undisturbed, never poured from jar to jar. And so, your nation continues to prosper and improve.

dag: Ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi tarimba shɛba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zo n-labi Babilɔn naa polo la ni nuhi tuumbaŋdiba bɛn daa kpalim la n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: Commander Nebuzaradan took the people who were still in Jerusalem and those who had surrendered earlier and made them captives. He took them and the skilled craftsmen who were left in Jerusalem as captives to Babylon.

dag: Ka o daa lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ duna tariga. Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ shee tariga.
en: Then he measured another yards, and the water came up to my knees. Another yards farther down, the water was up to my waist.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu Yawɛ sani. Di simdi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be tibi paɣir o.
en: You are the Lord 's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.

dag: n-chaŋ ti moli o nasara dibu molo shihi bɛn be sarika ni la sani.
en: And it was by the Spirit that he went to preach to the spirits in prison.

dag: Bihi maa ni daa ti zooi, Iso daa niŋla tɔha biiŋa ŋun daa kul be mɔɣu ni; ka Yaakubu mi be baalim m-be yiŋa.
en: As Jacob and Esau grew older, Esau liked the outdoors and became a good hunter, while Jacob lived the quiet life of a shepherd.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka dɔro din nyuuri niriba lu bɛn di n-tiɣ la zuɣu. Buɣim ni ti taai bɛ jilima n di li zaa.
en: Therefore, the LORD God of heavenly forces will make the well-fed people waste away; and among his officials, a blaze will burn like scorching fire.

dag: ni n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi mini teeku noli bihigu la. Ka a zuliya maa ni ti deei bɛ dimnim tinsi su;.
en: I will surely bless you and give you as many descendants as the stars in the sky. There will be as many people as sand on the seashore. And your people will live in cities that they will take from their enemies.

dag: ka tinzunnim vuri ŋmani tiŋgban kuŋ ni tulim la, a daa chɛ ka sagbana limsi li n-ku di tulim maa, ka putɔɣunim maa chɛ yila yilibu.
en: like drought in a dry land. But you, Lord , have silenced our enemies; you silence the shouts of cruel people, as a cloud cools a hot day.

dag: Bɛ kul bela nimaani n-yaari bɛ noya kumda, ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri bɛ noya ni na. Bɛ tɛhiya, Ŋuni n-lee ni wum ti ni yɛli shɛm.
en: See what they belch out with their mouths: swords are between their lips! Who can listen to them?.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu bi dalimla yɛda niŋbu, dama di sabiya: Ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: But the Law has nothing to do with faith. Instead, as the scripture says, Whoever does everything the Law requires will live.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinunaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hɛfiziba.
en: Manasseh was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother was Hephzibah.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa suhuri daa paligi ka bɛ yiini yila yɛri taba, Sool kula tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia.
en: They sang: Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand!.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan ka tuun shɛli yaɣa ŋɔ ni, ka n suhu mi pun ye yi sani kandina zuɣu yuma pam puuni la zuɣu.
en: Now I have finished my work in these areas. And for many years I have wanted to visit you.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N nyɛla n ni daa pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so piligu ni la.
en: Who are you? they asked him. Jesus answered, What I have told you from the very beginning.

dag: ka Ɛbɛl mi daa zaŋ o buzɔŋ ni piɛbil tuuli ni o kpam na nti mali sara, ka Yawɛ Naawuni nini daa tiɣi Ɛbɛl min o sara maa.
en: while Abel presented his flocks oldest offspring with their fat. The LORD looked favorably on Abel and his sacrifice.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake daa yiɣisi zani n-kuhi pam yɛli Judanim yɛligu ni, Wummiya na titali ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa la ni yɛli shɛm! O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then the commander, shouting loudly in Hebrew, gave this warning to them all: Hear this message from the great king, the king of Assyria!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni yi ti shɛb azichi mini nɛma, ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tarili n-di bɛ tuma nyaɣisim, Naawuni pini m-bala.
en: If God gives us wealth and property and lets us enjoy them, we should be grateful and enjoy what we have worked for. It is a gift from God.

dag: Piɛguliba pam saɣim n wain tihi puu, bɛ no n ni su shɛli sɔŋ tiŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka n tiŋgbɔn shɛli din viɛli pam la leei dabari ni tiŋgban nɛli.
en: Many shepherds have ruined my vineyard. They have trampled the plants in my field. They have made my beautiful field a desert.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ san la nya taali chɛ m-paŋ, niriba maa zaa nuu ni be chirimbu maa ni la zuɣu.
en: Then the whole community of Israel and any foreigners among them will be forgiven for the mistake.

dag: Isaka zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaanahi ni kɔbisita.
en: These were the family groups from the tribe of Issachar. The total number of men was .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni.
en: Afterward I went to places in Syria and Cilicia.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: So what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, John is a prophet. But I tell you, he is more than that.

dag: O niŋgbuŋ kul kpɛla tab ni, di kpɛmmi kirikiri, ka so ku tooi dam li.
en: There is not a weak spot in his skin; it is as hard and unyielding as iron.

dag: Ka Jɔsia daa nyɛ Jɛkɔnia min o tizɔbihi ba, bɛ ni daa gbahi ba chaŋ Babilɔn saha shɛl la.
en: Josiah was the grandfather of Jehoiachin and his brothers, who lived during the time that the people were taken away to Babylon.

dag: M piila ʒiɛyimtali soli. N zaŋla a zaligunim zali n tooni.
en: Ive chosen the way of faithfulness; Im set on your rules.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundombila ti maligumaaniba, ka lan mali dundɔn titali, ka mali pundi niŋ li, ka dooi daanya pa di pundi maa zuɣu.
en: They made an inner courtyard for the priests, and also an outer courtyard. The doors in the gates between the courtyards were covered with bronze.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka niriba ti ku lan deeri wuhibu maŋli, amaa ka ni dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre soli n-kul bɔrila karimbanim bɛn ni wuhiri wuhibu shɛŋa din niŋdi ba nyaɣisim pahira.
en: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.

dag: Shɛkɛm ni daa dihi Yaakubu bidibisi maa tizɔpaɣ Daina vi maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa garigi Shɛkɛm min o ba Hamɔr yɔhiŋgu garigibu.
en: Jacob's sons wanted to get even with Shechem and his father because of what had happened to their sister.

dag: Dama ti pun wum yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom pirigi buyi m-mali soli tin ya la yɛla; ka lan wum yi ni daa niŋ Amɔri nanim ayi bɛn yuya booni Sihɔn mini Ogi la gba shɛm ku ba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la yɛla.
en: We have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Reed Sea in front of you when you left Egypt. We have also heard what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites on the other side of the Jordan. You utterly wiped them out.

dag: Yi tɔbbia kam yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du Yawɛ ninni chaŋ ti lu o dimnim maa zuɣu hal ka o ti kari ba.
en: All your fighting men are to cross the Jordan and under the command of the Lord they are to attack our enemies until the Lord defeats them.

dag: Ti daa tum alahichi, ka daa tum tuumbiɛri mini tuun shɛŋa din bi tuhi. Ti daa zaɣis a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛli, ka daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ a ni wuhi ti din tuhi shɛli tumbu.
en: We have sinned and done wrong. We have brought guilt on ourselves and rebelled, ignoring your commands and your laws.

dag: Di saha Ɛli daa kurigiya pam ka wumd o bihi maa ni niŋdi Izraɛlnim shɛm maa zaa, hal ka mali paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni la doona.
en: Eli was very old. He heard about the bad things his sons were doing to the Israelites at Shiloh and how his sons were having sexual relations with the women who served at the door of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka Sool bia Jɔnatan daa yiɣisi chaŋ Dauda sani Hɔrɛshi maa nti zaŋ Naawuni yuli kpaŋs o suhu.
en: But Jonathan went to see David, and God helped him encourage David.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A yɛn jɛla suli niŋ ʒiɛmani kam nima?.
en: Will you always be angry with us and our families?.

dag: Pa bɛ takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa; pa bɛ mi maŋmaŋ yiko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi di nasara maa; amaa di daa nyɛla a yiko min a kpiɔŋ ni a ni daa be bɛ sani la zuɣu, dama a nini daa tiɣi ba.
en: No, not by their own swords did they take possession of the land— their own arms didnt save them. No, it was your strong hand, your arm, and the light of your face because you were pleased with them.

dag: N ni boli n niriba n-laɣim ba. N ni fa ba bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kalinli zooi kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: I will whistle for them and call them all together. I really will save them. There will be many people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim ni daa mali zali naai maa, ka maligumaaniba daa kul kpɛri tanti duu din daŋ tooni la ni nti tumdi bɛ maligumaanitali tuma dabisili kam;.
en: When these things have been prepared in this way, priests enter the first tent all the time as they perform their service.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, Ilaisha, n suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɛriko. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Jɛriko.
en: Then Elijah said to Elisha, Now stay here; the Lord has ordered me to go to Jericho. But Elisha answered, I swear by my loyalty to the living Lord and to you that I will not leave you. So they went on to Jericho.

dag: Ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam, n ni niŋ li ka m Ba nya jilima n zuɣu.
en: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ liɣiri paŋ so, bɛ bi yɛri dilana ni o niŋm ba nyɔri di yɔbu ni. Bɛ mi bi diri birapu ka diri ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndiri ŋun ka taali. Bɛnkam tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim kul ku vuui bɛ zaashee.
en: They make loans without charging interest and cannot be bribed to testify against the innocent. Whoever does these things will always be secure.

dag: Ka anabinim bɛn daa be Jɛriko maa daa chaŋ Ilaisha sani ti bɔh o, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: The group of prophets from Jericho approached Elisha and said to him, Do you know that the LORD is going to take your master away from you today? He said, Yes, I know. Dont talk about it.

dag: Dinzuɣu taɣimiya biɛhigu yi suhuri ni, ka di lan nyɛnya tipawumlinima.
en: So then, from now on be obedient to the Lord and stop being stubborn.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam ti Duuma zuɣu, dama di ni yuui pam la nyaaŋa yi lan wuhi ni yi baɣa be n ni. M bi yɛlimi ni yi chɛ ma la lihibu, amaa yi yi bi nyala soli din ni doli niŋ li.
en: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.

dag: Gol tuuli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni, di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pisiniyini dali zaawuni.
en: From the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month to the evening of the twenty-first day, you must not eat any bread made with yeast.

dag: ni di chɛ ka nyuli gbaai Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ mmaŋmaŋ zuliya la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni shɛb tiligi.
en: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a boli ma ninvuɣ suŋ? Ninvuɣ suŋ kani n-naɣ pahila Naawuni.
en: Why do you call me good? Jesus asked him. No one is good except God alone.

dag: Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla, ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: and Peter remembered that Jesus had said, Before a rooster crows, you will say three times you don't know me. Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun mi ni yi ni ŋahi ma ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Timlana, tibim amaŋa! Ka ni lan yɛli ma, Niŋmi ti ni daa wum ni a niŋ shɛm Kapɛrinium la amaŋmaŋ ya ŋɔ! .
en: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, Doctor, first make yourself well. You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a dimnim zaa kpi lala, amaa ka chɛ ka a zɔnim mi ne kaman wuntaŋ ni puhirina ni yaa n-ne shɛm la. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: May all your enemies die like this, Lord ! But may all those who love you be as strong as the rising sun! And there was peace in the land for years.

dag: yɛra, Ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋun be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, ti paɣir a a ni deeg a yiko din galisi n-diri nam zuɣu.
en: They said, We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, who is and was, for you have taken your great power and enforced your rule.

dag: Ka Inok daa dɔɣi Irad; ka Irad daa nyɛ Mɛhujaɛl ba, ka Mɛhujaɛl nyɛ Mɛtushaɛl ba, ka Mɛtushaɛl mi nyɛ Lamɛk ba.
en: Then Enoch had a son named Irad, who had a son named Mehujael, who had a son named Methushael, who had a son named Lamech.

dag: Ka Musa daa siɣina, ka boli Izraɛl kpamba na nti yɛli ba Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o yɛli ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: So Moses came down, called together the peoples elders, and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa gbaag o n-kpaɣ o nina, ka zaŋ o tahi Gaza ti zaŋ daanya bandi baŋ o, ka chɛ ka o niɛmdi chi sarika ni.
en: The Philistines captured him and put his eyes out. They took him to Gaza, chained him with bronze chains, and put him to work grinding at the mill in the prison.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini niriba laɣiŋgu shee. Di saha ka Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mir o la kana ni o ti gari nimaani, ka Bɔaz bol o, Zɔri, kamina kpe ti ʒini. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini.
en: Meanwhile, Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Just then, the redeemer about whom Boaz had spoken was passing by. He said, Sir, come over here and sit down. So he turned aside and sat down.

dag: Ʒimiya tab ʒiya, ka di chɛ ka Masia zaligu niŋ pali.
en: Help each other with your troubles. When you do this, you are obeying the law of Christ.

dag: Yi yi chaŋ, yi ni nya ka niriba maa nyɛla bɛn ka zilisigu. Di nyɛla tiŋgban titali, ka nir ni bɔri binshɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni be di ni; yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni mi zaŋ li tin ya.
en: When you get there, you will find that the people don't suspect a thing. It is a big country; it has everything a person could want, and God has given it to you.

dag: Ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi tarimba shɛba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zo n-labi Babilɔn naa polo la ni nuhi tuumbaŋdiba bɛn daa kpalim la n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: Then Nebuzaradan took away to Babylonia the people who were left in the city, the remaining skilled workers, and those who had deserted to the Babylonians.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, so daa yi mali sara, ka na bi yihi biŋkpam nyo buɣim, maligumaana yiŋbia kanimina ti yɛl o, Ŋmaam nim kahili ti ma ka n ti ti maligumaana ka o she, dama o ku deei nin duɣirili a sani, naɣila nim kahili.
en: In addition, even before the fat was taken off and burned, the priest's servant would come and say to the one offering the sacrifice, Give me some meat for the priest to roast; he won't accept boiled meat from you, only raw meat.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmaligiya ka chɛ o dolibu, ka bɛ baɣa lan ka o soya ni.
en: because they have stopped following him and ignored all his commands.

dag: Di saha maa man Daniɛl daa kul bela fabila ni zaŋ hal ti paai bakɔi muna ata.
en: At that time I, Daniel, was very sad for three weeks.

dag: Di ni sɔhigi kaman buɣim ni chɛ ka kom din tam di zuɣu kpeeri shɛm la. Kamina ti wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm a dimnim sani, ka zuliya kam zaa ni sɔhig a tooni.
en: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.

dag: Dunia ni ti laani kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam kuli, ka viini kaman suɣili la. Di tuumbiɛri tibisim nti yɛn marigi li ka di lu, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: The earth trembles like a drunk and shudders like a hut; its rebellion weighs heavy upon it; it will fall, no more to rise.

dag: Di chɛ ka o be kaman bɛ ni yi dɔɣi bikpiin so bahina ka o yaɣ yini saɣim la.
en: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead.

dag: Nir yi ku ninsala, ka ninvuɣ bɔbili di li shɛhira, bɛn kum ninvuɣ kura maa, amaa di bi tuhi ni bɛ ku so ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: A killer should be put to death as a murderer only if there are witnesses. No one can be put to death if there is only one witness.

dag: Bidib bil so n-naɣ be kpe m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi, amaa ka bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ salo ŋɔ zaa.
en: There is a boy here who has five loaves of barley bread and two fish. But they will certainly not be enough for all these people.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa daa bɔri ni o paɣ omaŋa ka bɔhi Yisa, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: But the teacher of the Law wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, Who is my neighbor.

dag: Yaakubu daa niŋla yuun pinaayopɔin Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni; ka o yuma kalinli daa yiɣisi yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi ni ayopɔin.
en: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, until he was a hundred and forty-seven years old.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Wula ka n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛl ni lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya, ka n ku lihiri suhugarigu lihigu.
en: But even though I was afraid, I said to the king, May the king live forever! I am sad because the city where my ancestors are buried lies in ruins, and the gates of that city have been destroyed by fire.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa ni o biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Jothams deeds, including all his wars and accomplishments, are written in the official records of Israels and Judahs kings.

dag: Judanim bɛn daa be Mɔab mini bɛn daa be Ammɔnnim sani ni bɛn daa be Ɛdom ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni la zaa ni daa wum ni Babilɔn naa chɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim niŋ Juda, ka zaŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa la leei bɛ Gomna maa.
en: Meanwhile, all the Israelites who were in Moab, Ammon, Edom, and other countries, heard that the king of Babylonia had allowed some Israelites to stay on in Judah and that he had made Gedaliah their governor.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ dabisili maa dali shiri kanna. Di ti yɛn nyɛla o sujee min o suhuyiɣisili ni o putɔɣu niŋbu dali. O ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ kpalimla tiŋgban nɛli, ka ku alahichinim bɛn be di ni zaa.
en: Look, the Lord s special day is coming! It will be a terrible day. God will be very angry. He will destroy the country and wipe out the sinful people who live there.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka n nya wɔr piɛli. Ŋun daa ʒi o zuɣu yuli daa boonila Ʒiɛyim mini Yɛlimaŋli. Ka o daa mali wuntitali n-kariti saria ka tuhiri tɔbu.
en: Then I saw heaven open, and there was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True; it is with justice that he judges and fights his battles.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi lir o ka tiligi? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ lala dunia zaa ni?.
en: Who can attack him and still be safe? No one in all the world can do it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim maa zaa zaŋ Shihɔr din daa be Ijipti la hal ti kpa garibu shee din be Lɛbohamat la ni bɛ chaŋ Kiriatijiarim ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: So David assembled all Israel, from the border of Egypt to Lebo-hamath in order to bring up Gods chest from Kiriath-jearim.

dag: Ti mi ni timaŋmaŋ biɛr kurili daa pahila o zuɣu ka bɛ kpahi ti tabili dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daalahichi biɛr kurili maa kpi, ka ti ku lan nyɛ alahichi daba.
en: And we know that our old being has been put to death with Christ on his cross, in order that the power of the sinful self might be destroyed, so that we should no longer be the slaves of sin.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ shɛb ni tumdi shɛm polo, n nyɛla ŋun dol a zaligu, m mi bi zaŋ mmaŋ bali duŋtaariba ni.
en: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi kum shɛli Pita ni daa ti yɛn kpi, ka di ti Naawuni jilima la. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli Pita, Doli ma.
en: He said this to show the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. After saying this, Jesus said to Peter, Follow me.

dag: Yinima n-kpuɣi n daanzinfa mini n salima; ka ʒi n daazichi nɛma nti niŋ yi wuna jɛmbu duri ni.
en: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira kpɛhi duu saha shɛl la nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ka Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: After John was arrested, Jesus went to Galilee and told the good news that comes from God.

dag: Ka ninkurigu maa daa yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka yi suhuri doya. N ni tin ya yi ni bɔri shɛlikam, amaa lee di gbɛnya palo ŋɔ ni.
en: The old man answered, Youre welcome to stay with me, but let me take care of all your needs. Just dont spend the night in the square.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan su saha mini saha taɣibu; o vuuri nanima ka zaani nanima; ŋuna n-tiri yɛnnim yɛm, ka tiri baŋdiba baŋsim.
en: He changes the times and seasons. He gives power to kings, and he takes their power away. He gives wisdom to people, so they become wise. He lets people learn things and become wise.

dag: Amaa o bihi maa bɛn daa bi dol o naba, ka zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim niŋla bun ni, ka deeri birapu niriba sani, ka bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli maani bɛ yɛla.
en: But they were not like their father. They were dishonest and accepted bribes to give unfair decisions.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa vuɣi li ni suhuyiɣisili n-daai li luhi tiŋa. Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim daa ʒe li ka di kuui. Ka di wala zaa daa suui, ka di mundili din mali yaa la daa kuui, ka buɣim di li.
en: But in anger, I pulled her up by the roots and threw her to the ground, where the scorching desert wind dried out her fruit. Her strong branches wilted and burned up.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kalila Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir la bidibisi pahi Lɛvinim ni.
en: But the sons of Moses, the man of God, were included among the Levites.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ kali tinzunnim bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman o ba Dauda ni daa chɛ ka bɛ kali ba shɛm la. Ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi niriba tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: King Solomon took a census of all the foreigners living in the land of Israel, similar to the census his father David had taken. There were , resident foreigners.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a nya alibarika, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ a lala labisi. Amaa ka a lee ti nya laara wuntizɔriba kum ni neebu dali.
en: And you will be blessed because they cant repay you. Instead, you will be repaid when the just are resurrected.

dag: Ka o ti bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti ti maligumaana din nyɛ o taali sanyoo Yawɛ sani, ka a zahim o daa ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ taali sanyoo polo.
en: You must also bring a ram to the Lord that has nothing wrong with it to the priest.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia ka di ʒe sokpaŋa; ka o chaŋ di gbini nti bi nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu n-naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko. Ka Yisa daa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga a ku lan wali wala hal abada! Ka tia maa daa dii zani yim kuui.
en: He saw a fig tree beside the road and went to get a fig from it. But there were no figs on the tree. There were only leaves. So Jesus said to the tree, You will never again produce fruit! The tree immediately dried up and died.

dag: Ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun daa sabiri bina yɛla zaani la daa ka sapashin kpɛm maa sanna.
en: Hilkiahs son Eliakim, who was the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Asaphs son Joah the recorder went out to them.

dag: N ni ti zani a tooni Sinai Zoli tampiŋ zuɣu, ka a ti zaŋ a jaaŋgbee maa fiɛbi tampiŋ maa, ka kom yi di ni na ka niriba maa nyu. Ka Musa daa niŋ lala Izraɛl kpamba maa ninni.
en: Ill be standing there in front of you on the rock at Horeb. Hit the rock. Water will come out of it, and the people will be able to drink. Moses did so while Israels elders watched.

dag: O yɛliya, Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya, dama o ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: He warns you not to let Hezekiah deceive you. Hezekiah can't save you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ fo ka bembe nti gbaai Naawuni paɣibu yɛra, Dindina Naawuni n-chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba niŋ tuuba ni bɛ nya nyɛvili.
en: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla shihirili ni alahiziba yɛlli yi mini yi zuliya sani sahakam.
en: They will be the evidence of God's judgment on you and your descendants forever.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, Naawuni darigi a tibili naai a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ku lan chɛ ka a be tinzun tiŋ ni. Amaa nyini Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga, a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ni darig a tibili. O ni yih a daalahichi maa palo.
en: Your punishment is complete, Zion. You will not go into captivity again. But the Lord will punish your sins, people of Edom. He will uncover your sins.

dag: ni yɛli Yawɛ, A sani n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee, ni m birini; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani ŋɔ.
en: can say to him, You are my defender and protector. You are my God; in you I trust.

dag: Wahu daa nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana n-gari Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb zaa. Ka wahu daa ti bɔhi paɣ maa, Naawuni yɛliya ni yi miri ka yi di puu ŋɔ ni ti shɛli wala.
en: The snake was sneakier than any of the other wild animals that the Lord God had made. One day it came to the woman and asked, Did God tell you not to eat fruit from any tree in the garden.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛl o, Vuri maa pala niriba ni di nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, di mi pala niriba ni kɔŋ nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, amaa n wumla yila yilibu vuri.
en: Moses answered, It is not the noise of an army shouting for victory. And it is not the noise of an army crying from defeat. The noise I hear is the sound of music. .

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ti yaannim zaa daa bela sagbani tiŋli, ka bɛ zaa daa lan doli soli kpe teeku ni gari.
en: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.

dag: n gba ni lan ya yi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu saha, ka mali ya ansarisi yi dabiɛm saha.
en: So when you are struck by some terrible disaster.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti nya o la Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka o ʒi Yɛhudia adiini karimbanim sunsuuni wumdi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhiri ba bɔhigunima.
en: After three days they found him. Jesus was sitting in the Temple area with the religious teachers, listening and asking them questions.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam zuɣu.
en: Then he said, This wine is my blood, which will be poured out for many to begin the new agreement from God to his people.

dag: ni Iddo bia Ahinadab ŋun daa be Mahanaim la.
en: Ahinadab son of Iddo: the district of Mahanaim.

dag: N ku gbihi bee n-ʒeei gom.
en: I will not rest or sleep.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum paɣ maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o darigi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka doli gooni maa zuɣu garita. Ka niriba nya o ka o yɛla buɣu ka di be o binyɛrigu tiŋli.
en: The king tore off his clothes in sorrow, and since he was on top of the city wall, the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth underneath.

dag: Naawuni daa lan yɛl o ni o zuliya ni ti be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim ti zaŋ ba leei daba n-niŋ ba wahala yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: This is what God said to him: Your descendants will live in another country. They will be strangers. The people there will make them slaves and mistreat them for years.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gɔri gindi ka nyɛ bɛn gba kariti alizin biɛri daa zaŋ ti Duuma Yisa yuli n-yɛri alizin biɛri bɛn ʒi niriba zuɣu, Pool ni yihiri Yisa so waazu la yuli zuɣu, wariya ka chɛ ba.
en: Some Jews who traveled around and drove out evil spirits also tried to use the name of the Lord Jesus to do this. They said to the evil spirits, I command you in the name of Jesus, whom Paul preaches.

dag: Bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ lihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini luɣ kasi shee maa, ka lan sɔŋdi bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni tuma ni.
en: So the Levites did everything that they were supposed to do. They took care of the Holy Tent and the Holy Place. And they helped their relatives, the priests, Aarons descendants, with the services at the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa guui yomyom chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, do so ŋun daa ka n sanna la lan yi n zuɣu.
en: so she ran at once and told him, Look! The man who came to me the other day has appeared to me again.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu dunɔguliba . Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinuayika.
en: The descendants of gatekeepers: of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, and Shobai.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ni zali zaligu, ka yiya kara ŋma n-lu, ka yiya bihi mi lu m-burisiburisi.
en: When the Lord gives the command, houses large and small will be smashed to pieces.

dag: Bɛ chani gindila zoya zuɣu bɔri mɔri, ka chani bɔri momaha kam.
en: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm; ka Naawuni daa yo Nuhu niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: just as God had told him to do. And when they were all in the boat, the Lord closed the door.

dag: A ni tooi tim saanyaɣisibu ka di chaŋ ka labina ti yɛl a, Mani m-bɔŋɔ?.
en: Can you send lightning so that it goes and then says to you, Im here?.

dag: Kum yuma maa daa ti yɛn kana, ka Yisifu pun zaŋ Asɛnat ŋun daa nyɛ Pɔtifɛra ŋun nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga la dɔɣila bidibis ayi.
en: Joseph and his wife had two sons before the famine began.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti kpalim Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: That is because a few people will come out of Jerusalem alive. There will be survivors coming from Mount Zion. The strong love of the Lord All-Powerful will do this.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku bɔh o bia maa, M bia, ka wula ka a lee niŋ nya li yomyom lala? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ n-ti ma di nasara maa.
en: Isaac asked, My son, how did you find an animal so quickly? The Lord your God was kind to me, Jacob answered.

dag: Bɛ daa yi bela Naawuni biɛhigu shee tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yiini yila hal ka Sulemaana daa ti naanyi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm la. Bɛ daa kul tumdila bɛ tuma maa n-doli di soli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: They took regular turns of duty at the Tent of the Lord 's presence during the time before King Solomon built the Temple.

dag: Amaa Siria naa ŋɔ bihi ni ti laɣim tɔbbihi pam lo tɔbu. Bɛ ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam chaŋ kaman kokpɛɣu la n-tuhi tɔb maa hal ti paai bɛ dimnim sansan ni.
en: The northern kings sons will prepare for war. They will get a large army together. It will move through the land very quickly, like a powerful flood. That army will fight all the way to the strong fort of the southern king.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti timanim gba daa tum bɛ tabibi tuma n-gba daa niŋ lala. Ka di daa kpaŋsi Firawuna suhu, ka o daa bi wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The magicians used their magic to do the same thing. So Pharaoh refused to listen to Moses and Aaron. This happened just as the Lord said.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba ŋɔ zaa daa malila shili doli taba kaman bɛ ni chani tɔb tuhibu shɛm n-ka Hiburɔn na ni suhuyini, ka bɛ nia daa nyɛla bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa; lala ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa yu ni bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei bɛ naa.
en: All these men of war, armed for battle, came to Hebron determined to make David king over all Israel, and all the rest of Israel were fully agreed to make David king.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛli Sairus; A nyɛla m piɛgula, ka ni niŋ n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛli. A ni yɛli ka bɛ lan me Jɛrusalɛm zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. .
en: I say to Cyrus, You are the one who will rule for me; you will do what I want you to do: you will order that Jerusalem be rebuilt and that the foundations of the Temple be laid.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bo bindirigu, ka niŋ kom niŋ kom koligu ni n-zaŋ li nyaɣili Haga, ka zaŋ bia maa pah o n-chɛ ka o chaŋ. Ka Haga daa chaŋ ti be Bɛrishiiba yɔɣu ni dari ginda.
en: Abraham got up early in the morning, took some bread and a flask of water, and gave it to Hagar. He put the boy in her shoulder sling and sent her away. She left and wandered through the desert near Beer-sheba.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n gbarigi zaa; n kul malila nandahima m biɛhigu puuni. Ka n ni be nandahima shɛŋa ni maa zuɣu chɛ ka n gbarigi zaa ka n kɔba ni zaa kul chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: Because of my sin, my life is ending in grief; my years are passing away in sighs of pain. My life is ending in weakness. My strength is draining away.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kɔri naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin mali sara, Naawuni ni daa sɔŋ ba maa zuɣu.
en: They sacrificed seven bulls and seven sheep, to make sure that God would help the Levites who were carrying the Covenant Box.

dag: M mi na kul malila yaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ kaman n ni daa mali yaa shɛm saha shɛli Musa ni daa tim ma maa. Ka n na kul mali yaa din ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: I am still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. I am as ready to fight as I was then.

dag: chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo ti suhuri ni niŋ yɛda, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paɣi neei ka ti yi taali ni ti suhuri ni tɛha puuni, ka su ti niŋgbuna mi ko viɛlli, ka vu m-miri Naawuni.
en: Therefore, lets draw near with a genuine heart with the certainty that our faith gives us, since our hearts are sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies are washed with pure water.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Sool ni be luɣ shɛli maa ti nya o ni do luɣ shɛli polo, ka Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi zuɣulan la do o sani. Sool daa dola suɣa maa sunsuuni, ka tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: So David got up and went to the place where Saul camped, and saw the place where Saul and Abner, Ners son and Sauls general, were sleeping. Saul was sleeping inside the camp with the troops camped all around him.

dag: Yawɛ, zanimi n nyaaŋa ni n ka taali; dama galimi ka m biɛhigu ni. N niŋ Yawɛ naani ka bi tiriti gbini.
en: Establish justice for me, LORD, because I have walked with integrity. Ive trusted the LORD without wavering.

dag: Ibram ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun pia nyaaŋa, ka Ibram paɣ Zarai daa zaŋ o dabili Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti bipuɣiŋga la n-ti o yidana Ibram ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So after living ten years in the land of Canaan, Sarai gave her Egyptian slave to Abram as a second wife.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo ŋun gbaya kpi maa, N yɛr a mi, yiɣisima n-zaŋ a daamaŋka kuli.
en: But so that you will know that the Human Onehas authority on the earth to forgive sins—Jesus now spoke to the man who was paralyzed,I say to you, get up, take your cot, and go home.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo tintariga ni ti zaŋla Damaskus mini Hauran sunsuuni la m-baɣisi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili n-tim Giliad mini Izraɛl tiŋgbana sunsuuni gari n-zaŋ hal ni wulimpuhili polo teeku ni n-zaŋ hal ti paai Tama. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ wulimpuhili polo yaɣili.
en: The eastern border will begin on the border between the two kingdoms of Hauran and Damascus. It will run south along the Jordan River, which separates the territories of Gilead and Israel, and it will end at the Dead Sea near the town of Tamar.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ wain tihi pum ti yɛn kpahi lu ka di wala moori saha shɛli, Itiɔpianim dimnim ni kana ti ku ba ka di bi to. Bɛ ni ti niŋ ba kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sua ŋ-ŋmahiri wain tiwula din teei shɛm la.
en: Then something terrible will happen. Earlier in the year, the flowers bloomed and the new grapes formed buds and began to grow. But before the crop is harvested, the enemy will come and cut the plants. They will break the vines and throw them away.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim nyɛla bɛn fari niriba mini ŋmɛnditoya. Bɛ muɣisiri faranim mini nandaamba, ka fari saamba nɛma, ka bi labisiri li tiri ba.
en: The wealthy cheat and rob. They mistreat the poor and take advantage of foreigners.

dag: Di puuni ninvuɣ zuɣuri tim bɛ tumtumdiba ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka bɛ chaŋ kɔbilisi ni nti bi nya kom, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ bɛ kɔŋɔŋdi biŋkuma labi kuli. Vi gbahi ba ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: The rich people send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water; they come back with their jars empty. Discouraged and confused, they hide their faces.

dag: Wuntizɔra wuhir o zɔnim din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri soli kpɛhirila nir yɔɣu.
en: The righteous offer guidance to their neighbors, but the path of the wicked makes them wander.

dag: Tirimiya wuhi soli din kuni Ziɔn. Zomiya yomyom tiligi, ka di niŋya zinchili, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi nuzaa polo na. Ka di ni ti di niriba pam.
en: Point the way to Zion! Run for safety! Don't delay! The Lord is bringing disaster and great destruction from the north.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni zo Rɛzin mini Pɛka dabiɛm ka zaɣisi Shilɔa kulibɔŋ kom din doya baalim la zuɣu.
en: He said, These people refuse to accept the slow-moving waters of Shiloah. They prefer Rezin and Remaliahs son.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa boli Nɛria bia Baruk na nti yɛl o Yawɛ ni yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka Baruk daa sabi li niŋ gbaŋ ni.
en: So I called Baruch son of Neriah and dictated to him everything that the Lord had said to me. And Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.

dag: Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim mi daa laɣim lo tɔbu chaŋ ti ti bɛ suɣa Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-doya ni bɛ tuhi Filistianim maa.
en: Saul and the Israelite army assembled and camped in the Elah Valley, where they got organized to fight the Philistines.

dag: O yi di milig o jaaŋgbee ka chɛ ma, ka bi chɛ ka o yɛla kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm.
en: Stop punishing me, God! Keep your terrors away!.

dag: Pool ni daa paana ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana la zani gil o m-mali yɛl biɛ shɛŋa pam bɛmaŋmaŋ ni ku tooi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli fiɣisir o.
en: When Paul arrived, the Jews who had come from Jerusalem stood around him and started making many serious charges against him, which they were not able to prove.

dag: Daadam, ŋah bɔ ka yi leei ŋahira zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo din yɛra, Dabisa maa yuuya, ka ʒii kam kpalim yoli.
en: Mortal man, he said, why do the people of Israel repeat this proverb: Time goes by, and predictions come to nothing?.

dag: Ninvuɣ tuhili ni ti lu n-do a luɣili polo, ka tuhi pia lu n-do a nudirigu polo, amaa di ti ku miri nyin na.
en: A thousand people may fall dead at your side or ten thousand right beside you, but nothing bad will happen to you!.

dag: Di chɛ ka o be kaman bɛ ni yi dɔɣi bikpiin so bahina ka o yaɣ yini saɣim la.
en: Please dont let her be like the stillborn, whose flesh is half eaten as it comes out of the mothers womb.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn pii zaɣ suŋ ka zaɣisi zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ nanima ayi shɛb bɛn kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm ŋɔ tiŋgbana maa.
en: But before he is old enough to make that choice, the land of the two kings you fear will be empty.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun birigi ka chɛ yɛm soli ni chaŋ ti pahi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a niŋ yuun pinaanu pahi. N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will add years to your life. I will save you and this city from the king of Assyria. I will protect this city. I will do this for myself and because of the promise I made to my servant David.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn Baptaizira ti kana; di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛ kul mooni Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ, ka ŋunkam suhu ye di zuɣu kul zaŋdila kpiɔŋ ni o ti kpe di ni.
en: Until the time of John the Baptist, people had to obey the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets. But since God's kingdom has been preached, everyone is trying hard to get in.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni ti kahigi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi, ka dunia zaa ti yiɣisi jɛndi ba.
en: Heaven will prove that he is guilty. The earth will be a witness against him.

dag: Ka ti daa lan bɔhi ba bɛ yuya ni di chɛ ka ti sabi bɛ yuya, ka wuh a bɛn nyɛ tuma maa zuɣulaannima.
en: We also asked for their names. We wanted to write down the names of their leaders so that you would know who they are.

dag: Duhimaŋtali lihigu mini karimbaani suhu nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri firila, ka nyɛ alahichi.
en: Wicked people are controlled by their conceit and arrogance, and this is sinful.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Filistianim mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Itiɔpianim polo la suhiri yiɣisi bahi Naa Jɛhɔram zuɣu.
en: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Nɔb nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la sani. Ka Ahimɛlɛk daa kana ti tuhi Dauda soli ka o niŋ sɔhira; ka o bɔhi Dauda, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ka kpe na, ka so bi dol a na.
en: David came to Nob where Ahimelech was priest. Ahimelech was shaking in fear when he met David. Why are you alone? Why is no one with you? he asked.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim polo shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Uzia mini Jɔtam ni Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni n-daa bala.
en: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah:.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa dibu polo, di bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni yɛli ni buɣili kam ʒiɛla binshɛɣu din ka dunia ŋɔ ni zaani la, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pahila Naawuni yino ŋɔ ko.
en: So then, about eating the food offered to idols: we know that an idol stands for something that does not really exist; we know that there is only the one God.

dag: ka Abija daa laɣim dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni din ni tuhi tɔbu ka lan nyɛ bɛn mi tɔb tuhibu ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam mi daa laɣim tɔbutuhiri biinsi bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii ni bɛ tuhi taba.
en: Abijah went to fight with an army of four hundred thousand select troops against Jeroboams select forces numbering eight hundred thousand, who were arrayed in battle formation.

dag: Man Jɔn n-nyɛ ŋun daa wum yɛla ŋɔ, ka nya dimbɔŋɔnima. N ni daa wum li ka nya li maa, ka n daa gbani malaika so ŋun wuhi ma binyara maa tooni ni n jɛm o;.
en: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown them to me.

dag: Yɛlimiy o ni n wumya ni o chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri ni o piɛguliba maa mi yi kul bela ti sani, ka ti bi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛli, bɛ mi binshɛli daa bi bɔrigi bɛ ni daa be ti sani Kamɛl saha shɛli maa.
en: He heard that you were shearing your sheep, and he wants you to know that your shepherds have been with us and we did not harm them. Nothing that belonged to them was stolen all the time they were at Carmel.

dag: N ni yiɣisi pumpɔŋɔ n-doli tiŋ puuni solɔri mini lɔrisi ni. M bo n suhu ni yuri so pam maa shee. M bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: I will rise now and go all around the city, through the streets and the squares. I will look for the one whom I love with all my heart. I looked for him but couldnt find him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya n niriba bɛn be Ijipti la muɣisigu, ka wum bɛ fabila zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim ni niŋdi ba fitiina shɛŋa la polo. M mi bɛ wahalanim maa zaa.
en: Then the Lord said, I have seen the troubles my people have suffered in Egypt, and I have heard their cries when the Egyptians hurt them. I know about their pain.

dag: bɛ na ʒi n-di ka guui binshɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daazichi ku zani yuui.
en: Nothing remained of their food, so their riches will not endure.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn tumla tuun pala. Di niŋdi pumpɔŋɔ gba; yi bi nya li? N yɛn ŋmɛla soli sɔŋ mɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: Look! Im doing a new thing; now it sprouts up; dont you recognize it? Im making a way in the desert, paths in the wilderness.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa maa zaa yoli, n kɔba ni chɔɣisimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Zɛruya bihi maa nyɛla ninvuɣ yarisi. Yawɛ ni yo tuumbiɛrilana san shɛli din simd o putɔɣu tuma.
en: I am the chosen king, but Joab and Abishai have more power than I do. So God will have to pay them back for the evil thing they did.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa guui, ka bɛ kari dol o ti gbaag o ŋ-ŋmah o nubihilɔri min o napombihilɔri bahi.
en: The king tried to escape, but soldiers from Judah caught him. They cut off his thumbs and big toes.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa labi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni na. Ka Judanim maa daa ka Giligal na ni bɛ ti tuh o soli n-zaŋ o du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: So the king came back and arrived at the Jordan River. Judah came to Gilgal to meet the king and bring him across the Jordan.

dag: Ka Reechɛl dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayi ti Yaakubu.
en: When Bilhah and Jacob had a second son.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa paai Sinai tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: The Israelites reached the desert of Sinai in the third month of their trip from Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbini la kpɛhi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali pateesa la tooni.
en: He put the gold altar in the Tent, in front of the curtain.

dag: Ka naa daa ti yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi dan kpambaliba m-pahi yimaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ba mmaŋmaŋ buntaaŋa la, ka yi zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: Then the king said to them, Take my officers with you. Put my son Solomon on my mule and take him to Gihon Spring.

dag: ni Ɛla bia Shimɛi ŋun daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni.
en: Shimei, Elas son, in Benjamin.

dag: Dama yi ni yɛn kari zuliya shɛb maa nyɛla bɛn doli baɣisi mini bihiŋmɛriba yɛligu, amaa yinim bɛna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi saɣi ni yi niŋ lala.
en: You will force the other nations out of your land. They listen to people who use magic and try to tell the future. But the Lord your God will not let you do these things.

dag: ka yɛra, A yi shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa, nyin tiligim amaŋa.
en: They said, If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.

dag: Ti yi di chɛ nyin ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣa.
en: If we had stopped worshiping our God and prayed to a foreign god.

dag: Dinzuɣu n zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. O nyɛla Yawɛ ni yɛn su so hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o daa chɛ o ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: Now I am giving him to the Lord , and he will be the Lord 's servant for as long as he lives. Elkanah worshiped the Lord there at Shiloh, and.

dag: A nini daa nya ma n nambu saha. N dabisa zaa daa pun sabila a litaafi ni pɔi ka di naanyi piligi.
en: Your eyes saw my embryo, and on your scroll every day was written that was being formed for me, before any one of them had yet happened.

dag: N ni bɔri nolɔbo shɛli n-nyɛ: Yi lɔrigi yi ni nahindi shɛb la mihi, ka suui yi ni mɔŋ shɛb yɛlimaŋli ka ʒili ba ʒi tibisa la ʒiya; ka bahi yi ni nahindi shɛb la.
en: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord . Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!.

dag: Tola kum nyaaŋa, ka Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la gba daa leei Izraɛlnim sariakarita yuun pisinaayi.
en: After Tola, Jair from Gilead arose, and he led Israel for twenty-two years.

dag: Amaa mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun kpihindi yi daalahichi. Mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka n niŋdi lala maa. N ku lan teei yi daalahichi maa yɛla.
en: I, I am the one who wipes away all your sins. I do this to please myself. I will not remember your sins.

dag: Ka n daa lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya ka yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni tinvura ni yiŋ biŋgbamda ni noonsi m-be di ni.
en: and I looked inside. I saw all kinds of animals, including wild ones, as well as reptiles and birds.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman mɔpilli zuɣu mɔri, din ni kpi ka na bi zooi.
en: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya, ŋuna n-nyɛ yi naa, ka m mi kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi zaa, ka m bidibisi be yi sani. N nachimbilim ni mi ka n kul be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Now you have a king to lead you. I am old and gray, but my sons are here with you. I have been your leader since I was young.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan bi kɔri kɔbu saha, ka puri atam kpuɣibu saha yi ti paai o bi nyari shɛli.
en: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ o ba sani ti bol o, M ba! Ka o saɣi ka bɔh o, Ka m bi ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: Jacob went to his father and said, Father. His father answered, Yes, son. Who are you.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba naba vuri tulaale tihi maa zuɣu, nyin lirim ba, dama di saha maa man Yawɛ daŋla a tooni ni n ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa ti a maa.
en: Wait until you hear a sound in the treetops like marching troops. Then attack quickly! That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman giŋgalanyɔri ni yi chaŋ gari ka bɛ jolijoli doya shɛm la; ka chɛ ka bɛ be kaman bɛ ni zaŋ bi so bahi ka o nini bi nya wuntaŋ la.
en: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o lee naa maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani.
en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. He sinned against the Lord his God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Jona bahi kom maa ni maa, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka ziŋ karili zaŋ o vali, ka o daa be ziŋ maa puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa daba ata.
en: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa daŋ tooni na la o daa yihirila waazu yɛri Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ niŋm tuuba ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Before Jesus began his work, John preached to all the people of Israel that they should turn from their sins and be baptized.

dag: Ka so daa ka alizanda ni bee dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia tiŋgbani puuni ŋun ni tooi bɔɣi litaafi maa bee nti tooi lihi di puuni.
en: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.

dag: a yi be kasi ka a biɛhigu be tibi zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni ka a sanna nti labisi din simd a ti a.
en: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu ni ka yɛli: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku ni daa jɛm so ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bihi ŋɔ ni! Naawuni ŋun gbib ma hal ti paai zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni!.
en: And Israel blessed Joseph and said, My ancestors, Abraham and Isaac, worshiped our God, and that God has led me all my life.

dag: Ka Maata tizo so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la daa chaŋ ti ʒini Yisa tooni wumd o yɛtɔɣa;.
en: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down at the feet of the Lord and listened to his teaching.

dag: Amaa zaawuni yi ti paai, ŋun sum kom, ka wuntaŋ yi ti lu, o ni tooi lan labi sansani maa ni na.
en: Then, when evening comes, the man must bathe himself in water. And when the sun goes down, he may come into the camp again.

dag: Ti yaannim daa tum alahichi, bɛ lan kani, ka ti diri wahala bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Our fathers have sinned and are gone, but we are burdened with their iniquities.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dii yi Mizipa na n-kar doli Filistianim maa n-kuri ba hal ti miri Bɛtikar.
en: The men of Israel left Mizpah and went after them as far as the hillside below Beth-Car, killing every enemy soldier they caught.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ sani.
en: Moses set all of this in Aarons and his sons hands, then lifted them as an uplifted offering before the LORD.

dag: Asiria naa maa daa timla Rabishake, ka o yi Lakishi n-zaŋ tɔbbihi pam pa omaŋ zuɣu ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm. O daa zanila kɔso titali din be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ solɔɣu din labiri kpaluhi ʒiishee polo la.
en: except Jerusalem. The Assyrian king ordered his army commander to leave the city of Lachish and to take a large army to Jerusalem. The commander went there and stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la bɛn dee li sani.
en: Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what its followers do.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi daa ŋmanila biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bear la, ka o yiɣisi n-gbiligi ʒiɛya; ka sapir kɔba ata gbab o noli. Ka kuko shɛli daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim ŋubi nimdi pam.
en: Then I saw another beast, a second one, like a bear. It was raised on one side. It had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told: Get up! Devour much flesh.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zadok ti zaŋ kpam yiligu din daa be suɣili ni nimaani m-booi kpam maa bahi Sulemaana zuɣu ni. Di saha ka bɛ daa piɛb kikaa, ka niriba maa zaa dii kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: Zadok the priest carried the oil from the Holy Tent and poured it on Solomons head to show that he was the new king. They blew the trumpet and all the people shouted, Long live King Solomon.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tim ma nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka niŋ n dan Ibrahimma nirilim maŋli.
en: He said, LORD, God of my master Abraham, make something good happen for me today and be loyal to my master Abraham.

dag: Yawɛ, kari doli ba ni suhuyiɣisili nti kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Angrily hunt them down; wipe them out from under the LORDs heaven.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka m mali mmaŋa m-be kasi ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi a yɛlimaŋli maa puuni.
en: I am making myself completely ready to serve you. I do this for them, so that they also might be fully qualified for your service.

dag: Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o, amaa o ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: He protects everyone who loves him, but he will destroy the wicked.

dag: ka Vɔfisi bia Nabi daa yi Naftali zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Naphtali—Nahbi son of Vophsi;.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli, Paɣ ŋɔ nyɛla tuumbiɛri kɔtomsi. Ka o daa dihi paɣ maa ʒili piɛɣu maa ni ka zaŋ di liŋ maa pil li.
en: This woman represents evil, the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.

dag: Ka din niŋ ba maa wuhiya ni yɛliŋahili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ŋahili maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Baa labi dir o tiri, ka bɛ ni su kuruchu so kom mi lan ŋmaligi labi ti bilindi baɣiri ni yaha.
en: They demonstrate the truth of the proverb: A dog returns to its own vomit, and a washed sow wallows in the mud.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛm la. O daa lan ka bidibisi yaha, amaa Rɛhabia ŋun bidibisi daa galisiya pam.
en: Eliezer had only one son, Rehabiah, but Rehabiah had many descendants.

dag: O bela nimaani lihiri bɔr o ni yɛn gbaai binshɛli di, di yi be haliya o nina ni nya li.
en: From there they search for food; their eyes notice it from afar.

dag: O neesim bemi kaman wuntaŋa, ka neesim bɔba yiri o nuhi ni na, nimaani ka o yiko sɔɣiya.
en: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chani Jɛriko nti sirigiri zolɔŋni ka ŋmɛnditoya lir o soli maa ni m-pirig o, ka bu o hal ka o ti tarigi, ka bɛ fa o nɛma zo ka chɛ o.
en: Jesus answered, There was once a man who was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho when robbers attacked him, stripped him, and beat him up, leaving him half dead.

dag: ka n yɛli, n di bi zaɣisi ka m mali kpiŋkpama kaman ŋmani la. N naan yiɣi chaŋ ka vuhi.
en: I wish I had wings like a dove. I would fly away and find rest.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: But the Lord told the prophet Shemaiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka ka kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbibi n nuu ni du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So I built a chest out of acacia wood and carved two stone tablets just like the first ones. Then I hiked up the mountain holding the two tablets in my hands.

dag: luɣ shɛli zunzuya ni bi kpira, ka buɣim mi bi kpiri ni.
en: The worms that eat the people in hell never die. The fire there is never stopped.

dag: Yi na ʒi n-wum di yɛla bee m-mi li. Piligu ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ tipawumlinima. Dama m mi ni yi ni tum yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, ka lan mi ni yi bilim ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ duŋtaariba.
en: But even in the past you didnt listen. You didnt learn anything. You never listen to what I say. I have always known that you would turn against me. You have rebelled against me from the time you were born.

dag: Di saha ka yi ni baŋ ni m be Izraɛlnim sani, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka so lan kani. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: Then, Israel, you will know that I am among you and that I, the Lord , am your God and there is no other. My people will never be despised again.

dag: Nir yi daŋ tooni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa o malila yɛlimaŋli, faashee o mini ŋun mali taba maa ti kana ti bɔh o bɔhigunima.
en: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi di ni chihiri ni Yɛhudia nira mini zuliya shɛb laɣim shɛm bee ka bɛ ti kpe zuliya shɛb yinsi yɛla; amaa Naawuni wuhi ma ni n di lihi so yoli bee n-siŋ so.
en: Peter said to the people, You understand that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit anyone who is not a Jew. But God has shown me that I should not consider anyone unfit or say they are not pure.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyari bindirigu diri tiɣira, amaa ka kum mali ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana.
en: The following children were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.

dag: Bɛ daa kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi niŋ bɛ paɣiba, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi; ka jɛmdi bɛ wuna.
en: The Israelites began to marry the daughters of those people. They allowed their own daughters to marry the sons of those people. The Israelites also began to worship their gods.

dag: Bɛ ba daa ti ba pina pam din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni anfaani binyara, ka daa zaŋ bɛ ni me goondahi gili Juda tin shɛŋa la ti ba pahi, amaa o daa zaŋ o nam maa tila Jɛhɔram, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bituuli.
en: Jehoshaphat gave his sons many gifts of silver, gold, and precious things. He also gave them strong fortresses in Judah. But Jehoshaphat gave the kingdom to Jehoram because he was his oldest son.

dag: Chɛ ka Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu nim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka Juda tinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, a saria karibu zuɣu.
en: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.

dag: Tuuli, n daa wumya ni yi yi mali cheechi laɣiŋgu, woligibu be yi sunsuuni, ka n tɛhiri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa deei Naawuni noli o ni daa yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ti o la ni; ka o daa yiɣisi omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbaai chandi, hal ka ʒi o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa.
en: God called Abraham to travel to another place that he promised to give him. Abraham did not know where that other place was. But he obeyed God and started traveling because he had faith.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, so kanna m-be kaman Tabo zoli ni be shɛm zoya ni la, ka be kaman Kamɛl zoli ni ʒe m-baɣi teeku shɛm la.
en: This message is from the King. The King is the Lord All-Powerful. I promise, as surely as I live, a powerful leader will come. He will be like Mount Tabor or Mount Carmel among smaller mountains.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni wuhiri ba bɛ galimi ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ ninni? Ka ŋuni n-lee yɔri ba bɛ tuma samli?.
en: No one criticizes them to their faces for how they lived. No one punishes them for the evil they have done.

dag: Hilikia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Anatɔt la maligumaaniba ni yino la bia Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the messages of Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah. Jeremiah belonged to the family of priests who lived in the town of Anathoth. That town is in the land that belongs to the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Naawuni daa kahig o daanfaani wuhi palɔni ni di chɛ ka sokam tooi nya tiliginsim.
en: That is the way we should live, because Gods grace has come. That grace can save everyone.

dag: O vuhibu pɔhim din be kaman kokpɛɣu din ʒiri binshɛɣukam chani la be o tooni n-kuri zuliya shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaani tariga.
en: His breath is like a raging river that reaches up to the neck, to shake the nations with a sieve of destruction, and to put a misleading rein on the peoples jaws.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi tiŋgbani maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka noli din yɛla zaa sab be kundi ŋɔ ni di li maa.
en: That is why the Lord became very angry with the people of this land. So he brought to them all the curses that are written in this book.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti miri tiŋkpan shɛli bɛ ni kuni maa, ka o ŋmani ŋun bɔri ni o garila tooni.
en: When they came to Emmaus, he acted as if he was going on ahead.

dag: Bɛ kpuɣiri li tamdila bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu chana. Bɛ yi ti zaŋ li zali luɣ shɛli, di kul kpalim ʒiɛla nimaani; di ku tooi vuui chaŋ shɛli. Ka so yi suhi li, di ku tooi yɛli shɛli bee n-yihi dilana o muɣisigu ni.
en: they carry the idol on their shoulders and support it; they set it down, and it stands still, unable to move from its place. If one cries out to it, it doesnt answer. It cant save people from their distress.

dag: Lala ka o daa me buɣa jɛmbu shee ti o tinzun paɣiba la zaa, ka bɛ daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani bɛ buɣa maa, ka tuɣindi li tulaale zim.
en: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

dag: Yɛhudianim mali soya balibu pam din chɛ ka bɛ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, Naawuni daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa niŋla Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: Plenty in every way. First of all, the Jews were trusted with Gods revelations.

dag: Ka bɛn daa kpalim la mi zaŋ daparilana mini ŋariŋ dapaɣ shɛŋa pa kom maa zuɣu n-gba du duli. Ka ti zaa daa duɣi du duli tiligi.
en: He ordered the rest to grab hold of planks or debris from the ship. In this way, everyone reached land safely.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa zaŋ kpa piɛla so n ni daa nya ka o ʒe mɔɣili nol la polo n-daa kab chaŋ o sani ni o kpiɔŋ zaa ti bibig o.
en: He came toward the ram, which I had seen standing beside the river, and rushed at him with all his force.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka bɛ ni mali binshɛli sabira be kolibil ni baɣi o luɣili la daa ti labina ti yɛli, N tum a ni zali ma ni n tum shɛli maa.
en: Then the man wearing linen clothes and a scribes pen and ink set spoke up. He said, I have done what you commanded.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be sol ni, gbuɣinli be solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: Don't be lazy and keep saying, There's a lion outside.

dag: Ka so yi ti tum o kpee taali, ka bɛ yɛli ni o poma, ka o kana ti zani duu ŋɔ ni a sara maligu bimbini gbini po.
en: If someone wrongs another and must make a solemn pledge asserting innocence before your altar in this temple.

dag: To, ka yi yi ti nya ka Daadam Bia labiri o ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la, wula ka di lee ni ti ben ya?.
en: Then what will you think when you see the Son of Man going up to where he came from?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Molada ni Hazarishual.
en: Down to the time of King David the descendants of Simeon lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual.

dag: Ka Ɛlizabɛt dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka o dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When it was time for Elizabeth to give birth, she had a boy.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dunia zaa ni yɛn mali suhupiɛlli saha shɛli ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: All the earth will be happy when I destroy you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul bɔrila din tuhi, ka mi kul ku chɛ o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim. O kul ni gul ba sahakam, amaa o ni kari ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bihi bahi.
en: for the Lord loves what is right and does not abandon his faithful people. He protects them forever, but the descendants of the wicked will be driven out.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya bi biɛ yoli ŋɔ ti bahi kpaŋ ha, zibisim ni be shɛl la. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: As for this useless servant—throw him outside in the darkness; there he will cry and gnash his teeth.

dag: A ni lari saɣiŋgu mini kum, ka ti ku zɔri dunia ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dabiɛm.
en: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—.

dag: ka bi di bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛm Izraɛlnim buɣa la, ka bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni.
en: He doesnt eat on the mountains or pay attention to the idols of the house of Israel. He doesnt defile his neighbors wife.

dag: Amaa pa Yisa maŋmaŋa n-daa baptaiziri ba, o nyaandoliba n-daa baptaiziri ba.
en: although Jesus disciples were baptizing, not Jesus himself.

dag: N Duuma, n nyɛla faralana ni nandana; amaa a bi tam n yɛla. N Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira. Niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: I am weak and poor, O Lord, but you have not forgotten me. You are my savior and my God— hurry to my aid!.

dag: Ka bol o dan maa sandiriba zaa yinoyino na ti bɔhi ŋun daŋ tooni, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a.
en: So he called in all the people who were in debt to his master. He asked the first one, How much do you owe my master.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yuri ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu. Maranaata! Ti Duuma, kamina!.
en: A curse on anyone who doesnt love the Lord. Come, Lord!.

dag: Nir ni tooi dɔɣi bihi kɔbiga, ka beni n-yuui pam, hal o yi yuui ti yaɣi gba, amaa ka bi di dunia ŋɔ binyara nyaɣisim, ka ti bi nya sɔɣiri viɛlli, dindina man ni yɛli shɛm nyɛla, Zaŋbahi so o.
en: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.

dag: N Duuma, a pal a ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi dunia ni ni suhudoo;.
en: Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.

dag: Ka m mali biɛhigu shee nimaani ni n zaŋ Yawɛ daalikauli ni be Adaka shɛl ni la zali. O ni daa yihi ti yaannim Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka o daa lo ba alikauli maa.
en: I have also provided a place in the Temple for the Covenant Box containing the stone tablets of the covenant which the Lord made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt.

dag: A yuli daa duya zuliya kam zaa ni a viɛlim maa zuɣu. Dama n ni daa ti a jilima shɛli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka a niŋ viɛlim zaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Among the nations you were famous for your beauty. It was perfect because of the splendor that I had given you. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Bɛ nahindila paɣ so ŋun bi dɔɣi bihi, ka bi niŋdi pakoli zaɣi viɛlli.
en: They prey on the barren, the childless, do nothing good for the widow.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Nyamiya, n saɣi yi ni daa yɛli ma shɛlikam zaa la, ka pii naa tin ya.
en: Samuel told the Israelites: I have given you a king, just as you asked.

dag: A daa ku ba Ɛndo, ka bɛ niŋgbuna dɔni tiŋgban ni ti pooi.
en: You defeated them at Endor, and their bodies rotted on the ground.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa yɛn niŋ la saha daa ti paai, ka bindira maa daa shiri niŋ pam.
en: For seven years there were big harvests of grain.

dag: Piɛm ku tooi kar o ka o guui, ka kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa ŋmani wurigu o sani.
en: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Ijipti daanya na, ka chɛ ka Itiɔpianim mi kpuɣi bɛ nuhi duhi zuɣusaa jɛm Naawuni.
en: Let ambassadors come from Egypt; let Cush stretch out its hands to God.

dag: Ka pɔhim daa muɣisi ti ka ti kul chani biɛlabiɛla n-niŋ dabisa shɛm hal ti miri Kɛnaidus, ka ti ni daa tuhi pɔhim zuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ doli Kriit teeku noli polo n-chaŋ ti baɣisi Salimɔne gari.
en: We sailed slowly for several days and with great difficulty finally arrived off the town of Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed down the sheltered side of the island of Crete, passing by Cape Salmone.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Then if someone says to you, Look, heres the Christ, or There he is, dont believe it.

dag: Zaŋmi m paɣiba mini m bi shɛb zuɣu n ni jɛm a ŋɔ ti ma ka n kuli, dama a mi n ni tum tuun shɛli ti a.
en: Give me my wives and children whom Ive worked for, and I will go. You know the work Ive done for you.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ŋun labina maa, Yiɣisim chaŋ a chandi; a yɛda niŋbu zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ.
en: And Jesus said to him, Get up and go; your faith has made you well.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔn naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum Jɛfita ni tim na ti yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: The king of the Ammonites refused to listen to this message from Jephthah.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha. Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla, ka bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a nyɛla Galili tiŋbia.
en: Again Peter said it was not true. A short time later, the people standing there said, We know you are one of them, because you are from Galilee.

dag: O daa zaŋla omaŋ tabil o ka bɛ be Ɛziɔngɛba m-maani ŋarima ni bɛ zaŋdi li chani Speen.
en: Jehoshaphat joined with Ahaziah to make ships to go to the town of Tarshish. They built some ships at Ezion Geber.

dag: ka bɛ suhuri ti lɛbigi bɛ ni gbahi ba daba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba ka fabili niŋ a bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, ka birigi, ka tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: if they change their heart in whatever land they are held captive, turning back and begging for your mercy, saying, We have sinned, we have done wrong, and we have acted wickedly.

dag: dama saha shɛli Tiudas ni daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ omaŋ leei wɔɣirili ka niriba paai kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi daa dol o la, bɛ daa ti ku o, ka bɛn dol o maa zaa wurim, ka o tuma maa gba daa zan tariga.
en: Not long ago Theudas claimed to be someone important, and about men joined him. But he was killed, and all his followers were scattered. That was the end of that.

dag: Di sabi Yisa maa yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Kuɣ shɛli yinim tammɛriba ŋɔ ni daa zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: Jesus is the one of whom the scripture says, The stone that you the builders despised turned out to be the most important of all.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuu shihi bɛ nina ka yɛli, Yi yɛda niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmiya lala.
en: Then Jesus touched their eyes and said, It will happen for you just as you have believed.

dag: Biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka zibisim zo la, n yura, nyin ŋmaligim niŋ kaman molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ la n-zo n-yi Bɛtɛr zoya zuɣu na.
en: while the day breathes its last breath and the shadows run away. Turn, my lover, be like a gazelle or a young deer on the cleft mountains!.

dag: N ni chɛ ka pɔhim yi zuɣusaa yaɣa anahi ŋɔ na ti ʒe Ɛlamnima, ka n chɛ ka pɔhim maa ʒe ba bahi luɣilikam, ka Ɛlam kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ti zo n-kuli zuliya kam ni.
en: I will make winds blow against Elam from all directions, and I will scatter her people everywhere, until there is no country where her refugees have not gone.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. M mi yi yurilim mini yi yɛda niŋbu ni yi ni tumdi shɛlikam n zuɣu zaŋ tabili yi daania niŋbu yɛla, ka lan mi yi pumpɔŋɔ tuma ni gari yi tuuli tuma shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: I know what you do. I know your love, your faithfulness, your service, and your patience. I know that you are doing more now than you did at first.

dag: N daa kuhi boli n zɔnima, amaa ka bɛ yɔhim ma. M maligumaaniba mini n kpamba daa kpila tiŋ maa ni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bɔri bindirigu ni bɛ di n-nya yaa la.
en: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiri ka ti ku yi zahira, ka binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ku baŋ di yɛla ka di yi palo.
en: Nothing is hidden that wont be exposed. Nor is anything concealed that wont be made known and brought to the light.

dag: Di bi simdi ka naa ti deei niriba maa tiŋgbani ka kari ba di ni. O ti zaŋmi omaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgban shɛli ti o bidibisi din ni chɛ ka n niriba ni so ti ku kɔŋ o tiŋgbani.
en: The prince wont take the peoples inheritance by evicting them from their family property. He will bequeath only his own property to his sons, lest any of my people be deprived of their rightful property.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Gbuɣinli la mini saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Jɛŋgbini la, ni saŋmaribihi shɛba bɛ ni booni Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi bɛn nyɛ nudirigu polo saŋmarisi la.
en: God made the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades. He made the planets that cross the southern sky.

dag: Ka na so bee zuliya shɛb yi lo ni bɛ yiɣisi zaligu ŋɔ ka saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa, ŋun Naawuni ŋun pii nimaani n-leeg o jɛmbu shee ŋɔ ŋun vuum ba bahi. Man Naa Darius n-zali zaligu ŋɔ. Ka di kpa talahi ni sokam dol li.
en: May the God who has established his name there overthrow any king or people who try to change this order or to destroy Gods house in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have decreed it; let it be done with all diligence.

dag: N daa lan nya nahiŋgu shɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. N daa nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu maa ni kumdi shɛm, ka ka ŋun goori ba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahindi ba maa daa mali yiko pam, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ka ŋun ni gooi ba maa.
en: Again I saw that many people are treated badly. I saw their tears, and I saw that there was no one to comfort them. I saw that cruel people had all the power, and I saw that there was no one to comfort the people they hurt.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ li yɛl a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba, ka chɛ ka bɛ be kasi din ni chɛ ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Put the clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons. Then pour the special oil on them to make them priests. This will make them holy, and they will serve me as priests.
