dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so ti Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn ku so, so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, bɛ kul ni ku o mi.
en: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do bɛ lan laa gbini diri bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: That's true, sir, she answered, but even the dogs eat the leftovers that fall from their masters' table.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninsalinim ni tooi nya alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: I assure you that human beings will be forgiven for everything, for all sins and insults of every kind.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi yuntisuɣu n-kpuɣi man a dab paɣ ŋɔ bia ŋun do m-baɣi maa nti sɔŋ o tooni, ka zaŋ o bi kpiŋ maa na nti sɔŋ n tooni saha shɛli n ni daa gbihira.
en: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.

dag: Yi ku tooi nyu ti Duuma pipia ni binnyurigu, ka lan nyu alizin biɛri pipia ni binnyurigu. Yi mi ku tooi di ti Duuma bindirigu, ka lan di alizin biɛri bindirigu.
en: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and then go drink a cup that honors demons. You cannot share a meal at the Lords table and then go share a meal that honors demons.

dag: ka yɛra, Timiya ma yiko ŋɔ, ka n gba zaŋdi n nuhi pari niriba zuɣu ka bɛ deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: He said, Give me this power so that when I lay my hands on someone, they will receive the Holy Spirit.

dag: Bipolli, mali suhupiɛlli a bipolitali saha. Chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a bipolitali saha. Dol a suhu ni bɔri shɛm, ka niŋm a ni bɔri shɛm. Amaa lee baŋmi ni Naawuni ni ti kar a saria di zaa maa zuɣu.
en: Rejoice, young person, while you are young! Your heart should make you happy in your prime. Follow your hearts inclinations and whatever your eyes see, but know this: God will call you to account for all of these things.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa pahi buyi yɛli.
en: Then the Lord spoke to me again and said.

dag: N daa ka galimi o sani, dama n daa bi tum taal shɛli.
en: He knows that I am faultless, that I have kept myself from doing wrong.

dag: Bɛ ni daa vihi ma bɛ daa loya ni bɛ bahi ma, dama bɛ daa bi nya ka n tum taal shɛli din simdi kum.
en: who intended to release me after they examined me, because they couldnt find any reason for putting me to death.

dag: Sara maligu yini ŋɔ zuɣu ka Masia chɛ ka Naawuni ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la be dɛde hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: because he perfected the people who are being made holy with one offering for all time.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti paai ya saha shɛli yi nandahima maa ni, yi ni ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani nti deeg o yɛligu.
en: In your distress, when all these things happen to you in the future, you will return to the LORD your God and you will obey his voice.

dag: Onam bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shammai mini Jada. Shammai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abishur.
en: Onam had two sons, Shammai and Jada, and Shammai also had two sons, Nadab and Abishur.

dag: O daa zaŋ sagbana niŋ bɛ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka buɣim tiri neesim yuŋ.
en: The Lord spread out his cloud like a blanket. He used his column of fire to give his people light at night.

dag: N suhir a, kul tim ti la tarim bindirigu mini kom ka ti diri ka nyuri zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu pia, ka a zahim ti nya.
en: Why not test your servants for ten days? You could give us a diet of vegetables to eat and water to drink.

dag: Ka yi ti bu chi hal ni wain tihi wala pɔhibu saha, ka pɔhi wain tihi wala hal ni biribu saha. Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka yɛl shɛli kani.
en: Your harvest of grain and grapes will be so abundant, that you won't know what to do with it all. You will eat and be satisfied, and you will live in safety.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ Gibianim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka chaŋ ti liri ba.
en: This is what we will do: we will draw lots and choose some men to attack Gibeah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛlikana daa lab kul o ya Rama, ka bia maa daa be Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma.
en: Elkanah and Hannah went back home to Ramah, but the boy Samuel stayed to help Eli serve the Lord .

dag: ni Ɛluzai ni Jɛrimɔt ni Biilia ni Shɛmaria ni Shɛfatia ŋun daa nyɛ Harufi nir la.
en: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite.

dag: Banima n-lee ni tooi du n-tam Yawɛ dabol la zuɣu? Bee banima n-lee ni tooi zan o luɣ kasi la shee?.
en: Who can go up on the Lord s mountain ? Who can stand in his holy Temple?.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nini daa kul kpa Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ daa bi tooi chɛ ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu hal ka di lahibali daa ti ti nti to Darius ka o daa sab o zilinkom gbaŋ ti na.
en: But their God looked after the elders of the Jews, and they didnt stop them until a report reached Darius and a letter with his response had arrived.

dag: Daadam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be Izraɛl tiŋgban shɛŋa din bahi yoli la puuni na kul yɛrimi, Ibrahimma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yino, amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o ni o su. Amaa tinim galisiya, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ zaŋla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti ni ti su li.
en: Human one, those who live among those ruins in Israels fertile land are saying, Abraham was just one man, and he inherited the land. We are many, so certainly the land has been given to us as an inheritance.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛhu, A ni tum din tuhi n sani, ka niŋ Ɛhab daŋ niriba kaman n suhu ni daa yu shɛm zaa la zuɣu, a daŋ ni bidibisi kul ni diri Izraɛl nam hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni.
en: The Lord said to Jehu, You have done to Ahab's descendants everything I wanted you to do. So I promise you that your descendants, down to the fourth generation, will be kings of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ m-paɣir a, dama nyini n-yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka chɛ ka n dimnim bi di dari niŋ ma.
en: I exalt you, LORD, because you pulled me up; you didnt let my enemies celebrate over me.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ jintɔriba la daa laɣim n-zaŋ Yisa tahi bɛ jina tɔbu shee ti yɛl o.
en: As morning came, the elders of the people, both chief priests and legal experts, came together, and Jesus was brought before their council.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda naa ni Ɛdom naa daa laɣim chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai daba ayopɔin chandi tariga ka kom pooi ba, hal ka shɛli kani ka bɛ tɔbbihi mini bɛ ni daa ʒiri biŋkɔb shɛb chani ni nyu.
en: So Israels and Judahs kings set out with the king of Edom. They marched around for seven days until there was no water left for the army or for the animals with them.

dag: Ti ka soli ni bɛ ti ti bindirigu mini kom?.
en: Don't I have the right to be given food and drink for my work?.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Naawuni, Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab naa la n-tim ba na ti yɛli ma.
en: Balaam said to God, The king of Moab, Balak son of Zippor, sent them to give me a message.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ ni ka yaa yɛla pam ni zuɣu, o ni tooi di suɣilo o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ʒilinsi ni mini bɛn chirindi polo.
en: The high priest has his own weaknesses. So he is able to be gentle with those who do wrong out of ignorance.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kpa duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni; luɣ shɛli a ni daa yɛli, N yuli ni be nimaani la. Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ n nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deemi n suhigu.
en: Constantly watch over this temple, the place about which you said, My name will be there, and listen to the prayer that your servant is praying toward this place.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Zɛnan mini Hadasha ni Migidaligad.
en: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi nyaɣa kpe o ni m-ba n-zani kaman tia la. Ka me yimaŋ tam o zuɣu, ka ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga yi yɛda niŋbu puuni kaman bɛ ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la. Ka chɛliya ka wumpaɣibo pali yi suhuri hal nti puuri bahira.
en: You must depend on Christ only, drawing life and strength from him. Just as you were taught the truth, continue to grow stronger in your understanding of it. And never stop giving thanks to God.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɔɣu din chaɣisira n-nyaɣil o, ka zaŋ kpan titali din nyaɣisira mini banchiriga n-nyaɣil o pahi.
en: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.

dag: Chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana dol a fukumsi zaligunim min a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa, ka tumdi di tuma din ni chɛ ka o tooi me a jɛmbu du shɛli n ni pun bo nɛma zali ni di me ŋɔ.
en: Give my son Solomon a wholehearted desire to obey everything that you command and to build the Temple for which I have made these preparations.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Misia tintariga shee m-bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Bitinia, amaa ka Yisa Shia daa bi saɣi;.
en: When they reached the border of Mysia, they tried to go on into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not let them go there.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔhi Gaad mini Rubin zuliya maa, Yi mabihi maa cham ti tuhi tɔbu ka yinim kpalim be kpe?.
en: Moses replied, Do you want to stay here while the other Israelites go to war?.

dag: Ka o daa nya ka ŋariŋ maa duhibu muɣisiri ba, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim. Ka di daa ti niŋ kaman nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani nti niŋ ka o yɛn garila bɛ zuɣu la.
en: He saw that his disciples were straining at the oars, because they were rowing against the wind; so sometime between three and six o'clock in the morning, he came to them, walking on the water. He was going to pass them by.

dag: ni Dilian ni Mizipa ni Jokitiɛl.
en: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel.

dag: di nyaaŋa bimpiɛlli bee din mooi ka piɛla yi ti be wuliɛɣu maa ni, dindina bɛn zaŋm li wuhi maligumaana.
en: and if afterward a white swelling or a reddish-white spot appears where the boil was, you shall go to the priest.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu ka di simdi ni n na be n nyɛvil ni.
en: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa ni daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee kum.
en: The Israelites started crying loudly.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Nyama, n zaŋ Jɛriko mini di naa ni di tɔbbi biinsi niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: The Lord said to Joshua: With my help, you and your army will defeat the king of Jericho and his army, and you will capture the town. Here is how to do it: March slowly around Jericho once a day for six days.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu mini Reechɛl zuliya. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaanahi.
en: These fourteen are the descendants of Jacob by Rachel.

dag: Miri ka a sɔɣi doya ni a liri wuntizɔra yiŋa kaman ninvuɣ biɛɣu la. Miri ka a liri wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: Dont be like a criminal who makes plans to rob those who are good or take away their homes.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka Babilɔn naa bɔɣiri niŋ kpiɔŋ, ka n zaŋ n takɔbi niŋ o nuu ni. Amaa n ni kabisi Firawuna bɔɣiri, ka o ti be o tooni ŋuhira kaman ŋun nya daŋa din yɛn ku o la.
en: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and I will put my sword into his hand. When I break the arms of Pharaoh, he will groan like a dying man in his presence.

dag: Jɔsia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka daa dol o yab Dauda naba o tuma ni ka bi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: Josiah did what the Lord said was right. He followed God like his ancestor David. Josiah obeyed Gods teachings—he did exactly what God wanted.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn polo ni o ni yɛn niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla ti gbaai bɛ tiŋ maa nim dabiɛm.
en: Listen to what the Lord has planned to do to Babylon. Listen to what he has decided to do to the Babylonians. I promise that an enemy will drag away the young kids of Babylons flock, and Babylon will become an empty pasture.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛli Mɔabnim yɛtɔɣ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ar zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi. Kɛɛr zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi.
en: This is a message about Moab. The cities of Ar and Kir are destroyed in a single night, and silence covers the land of Moab.

dag: Miriya ka yi leei buɣijɛmdiba kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm la; dama di sabiya, Niriba daa ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka bembe nti yiɣisi diɛmda.
en: nor to worship idols, as some of them did. As the scripture says, The people sat down to a feast which turned into an orgy of drinking and sex.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani. Ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: Show a gentle attitude toward everyone. The Lord is coming soon.

dag: Teemiya yi ni daa wum shɛli mini yi ni daa deei shɛl la yɛla, ka niŋya tuuba ka gbib li. Yi yi ku neei, n ni ka yi sanna kaman tayiɣa la, ka yi ku baŋ n kandina saha.
en: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.

dag: Ka tanyibiga yɛli ba, Yi yi shiri bɔri ni n leei yi naa ni yɛlimaŋli, yin kamiyana ti ʒini m mahim, ka yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina, n ni chɛ ka buɣim yi n ni na ti di Lɛbanɔn sida tihi.
en: The thorn bush answered, If you really want to make me your king, then come and take shelter in my shade. If you don't, fire will blaze out of my thorny branches and burn up the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee niŋ ti Mɔdɛkai din ni ti o jilima? Ka o naazɔnim bɛn be o sani yɛl o, Ti bi niŋ shɛl ti o.
en: Then the king asked, What honor and good things have been given to Mordecai for this? The servants answered the king, Nothing has been done for Mordecai.

dag: Ti ni lo kpara du Yawɛ ninni n-chaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti yɛn su li maa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli ŋɔ na.
en: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.

dag: amaa pumpɔŋɔ ti gbarigimi, ka binshɛli kani n-naɣ pahila manna shɛli ti ni kul lihiri ŋɔ.
en: But now we have lost our strength. We never eat anything—only this manna.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya pam ka diri ti shɛhira biɛɣu a sani; ti tumdi tuumbiɛri, ka mi ti daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yiɣisi kpɛri dunoli maa zuɣusaa duu puuni ka kumda. O ni daa chani ni o ti kpe maa o daa yɛrimi, Mbaye, m bia Absalom, m bia, m bia Absalom! Mani n-yi di kpi ka chɛ a ŋɔ, di di so. Mbaye, Absalom. M bia, m bia.
en: David started trembling. Then he went up to the room above the city gate to cry. As he went, he kept saying, My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I could have died instead of you! Absalom, my son, my son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa boli baŋdiba maa ashilɔni na nti vihi ba viɛnyɛliŋga ni o baŋ saha shɛli saŋmariga maa ni daa puhi.
en: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.

dag: Yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni guli ya o yiko puuni n-gu tiliginsim shɛli din mali shili gu ni di ti kahigi wuhi palo ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni la.
en: Through his faithfulness, you are guarded by Gods power so that you can receive the salvation he is ready to reveal in the last time.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la ni? Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma Ɛdom?.
en: I wish someone would bring me to a fortified city! I wish someone would lead me to Edom.

dag: O dimnim fa o bin viɛla zaa. Hal o nya zuliya shɛba ni kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu la puuni; a ni daa zali ni di chihiri ni zuliya shɛb kpe a niriba laɣiŋgu ni la.
en: The enemy grabbed all her treasures. She watched nations enter her sanctuary— nations that you, God, commanded: They must not enter your assembly.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ti Izraɛlnima. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanu ni kɔbiga dindali maa; ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: The LORD wiped out the Benjaminites before Israel. The Israelites slaughtered twenty-five thousand one hundred Benjaminite men that day, all of them armed with swords.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Deem piɛsah ayopɔin ŋɔ n nuu ni, ka di wuhi ni a di ma shɛhira ni mani n-daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ.
en: Abraham answered, When you accept these lambs from me, it will be proof that I dug this well.

dag: din ni chɛ ka a mali a filiŋ min a vi a ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka di ti ba suhumahili maa zuɣu.
en: You will be ashamed of yourself, and your disgrace will show your sisters how well-off they are.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam bia Sallu ŋun daa nyɛ Joɛd yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Pɛdaya mini Kolaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Itiɛl ni Jɛshaya.
en: From the family of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam son of Joed son of Pedaiah son of Kolaiah son of Maaseiah son of Ithiel son of Jeshaiah.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti kul mali suhukpeeni. Ti mi ni ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni, ti na ka ti Duuma yiŋa m-bala.
en: So we are always confident, because we know that while we are living in the body, we are away from our home with the Lord.

dag: Malimiya zoligo! Dama ninvuɣ kubo kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka damli dambu pali tiŋ puuni.
en: Make a chain! The earth is full of perverted justice, the city full of violence.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ bi kɔhirila jahinjɛya anu kɔbo? Naawuni mi bi tamdi bɛ ni yino yɛla.
en: When birds are sold, five small birds cost only two pennies. But God does not forget any of them.

dag: Anfaani maa wuhiri ti ni ti zaɣisim din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini dunia ŋɔ kɔr biɛri, amaa ka lee gbibi timaŋa ka mali bebu din tuhi, ka mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: It educates us so that we can live sensible, ethical, and godly lives right now by rejecting ungodly lives and the desires of this world.

dag: Dinzuɣu tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn niŋ yɛda la sani, amaa anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn bi niŋ yɛda la sani.
en: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-daa zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka leei bɛ Naawuni.
en: You established your people Israel as your own people forever, and you, LORD, became their God.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa boli ba, ka Aduna mini bɛ laɣiŋgu zuɣulaannim zaa daa ka o sanna, ka o ti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses called to them. So Aaron and all the leaders of the people went to him. Moses talked with them.

dag: O ni daa ti wum ni Yisa Nazarɛt nira n-gariti maa ka o dii gbaai kuhiri yɛra, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: He heard that Jesus from Nazareth was walking by. So he began shouting, Jesus, Son of David, please help me.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Amaa dabisa din ti yɛn doli wahala ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla.
en: In those days, right after this time of suffering, The sun will become dark, and the moon will no longer shine.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa kaman o ni daa zali ma shɛm maa, ka vuhim daa kana ti kpe bɛ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima n-yiɣisi zani bɛ naba zuɣu. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: So I spoke to the wind for the Lord , as he said, and the breath came into the dead bodies. They came to life and stood up. There were many men—a very large army!.

dag: Aduna ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisiri Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi tiŋgban nɛli polo n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima yi zahira sagban ni.
en: So Aaron spoke to all the Israelites. While he was talking, the people turned and looked into the desert. And they saw the Glory of the Lord appear in a cloud.

dag: Yawɛ tumtumsa galisiya pam, ka ŋunkam yuri li bɔhindi li mi.
en: The Lord does wonderful things, more than anyone could ask for.

dag: Tɔbbi so ŋun mali yɛm ni tooi nyaŋ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi nyaŋ ŋun mali yaa;.
en: Being wise is better than being strong; yes, knowledge is more important than strength.

dag: Sokam birigiya, bɛ zaa laɣim dolila biriginsim soli; so kani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: They have all turned away from him, and now they are of no use to anyone. There is no one who does good, not even one. Psalm :-.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ni ti ŋmanila buɣim; ka Yisifu zuliya mi ŋmani buɣimniɛm. Iso zuliya ni ti ŋmanila kaɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ buɣim nyo ka di di zaa; ka Iso zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ yino gba ku tiligi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The people of Jacob and of Joseph will be like fire; they will destroy the people of Esau as fire burns stubble. No descendant of Esau will survive. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ zoma n-lan paai n dabili bee n-nyɛ tikpiralana n-lan paai n tumo so n ni tim? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ zoma m-paai n ni pii so, bee n-nyɛ zoma paai Yawɛ dabili?.
en: No one is as blind or deaf as his messenger, his chosen servant.

dag: N ni be Izraɛlnim sani kaman maligim la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom la. Bɛ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman nyoo la.
en: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ n-yiɣisi be kaman Nail mɔɣili la, ka be kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pal la?.
en: Who is this that rises like the Nile, whose banks overflow?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi ni a chɛli bɛ taali, ka a yi ku chɛ bɛ taali maa, dindina nyin kpihimmi n yuli a ni sab li niŋ litaafi shɛl ni la.
en: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.

dag: Ka niriba ni daa lihi bɛ ni shɛb zuɣulaannim la bi pahiri ma shɛli, man dee baɣa ka bɛ ni daa nyɛ shɛb ni, dama Naawuni bi gaŋdi so; ka n na kul yɛrimi ni niriba ni lihi shɛb zuɣulaannim maa bi pahiri ma shɛli.
en: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.

dag: Amaa di liɣisibu maa yi kul kpalim be luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi gil o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, amaa ka sabigi, di nyɛla bimmɔriŋ din yi buɣim yum maa ni na, ka di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla buɣim wuliɛɣu.
en: But if the spot remains unchanged and does not spread and is light in color, it is not a dreaded skin disease. The priest shall pronounce you ritually clean, because it is only a scar from the burn.

dag: Kaman kom ni nyuui biaŋ ni, ka kulibɔŋ kom nyuui ka di kuui shɛm la.
en: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri yuri Yawɛ zaligu, ka bɔhindi li ka tɛhiri di yɛla wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: Instead of doing those things, these persons love the LORDs Instruction, and they recite Gods Instruction day and night!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ m mali suhupiɛlli n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu ŋɔ puuni; dama n ni diri wahala shɛŋa maa nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ naai wahala shɛŋa din kpalim ka nyɛ Masia ni daa diri shɛl o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ cheechi la zuɣu la.
en: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.

dag: Shimilan bɔri ni o nyala buni yomyom, ka bi mi ni ashaara nyɛla din yɛn kana ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: Selfish people only want to get rich. They do not realize that they are very close to being poor.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn darigiri gbabigiri kpibisi bɛ manim biha ni, ka deeri nandaamba biliɛri talima.
en: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.

dag: Ka maligumaana so bipuɣiŋga yi ti gɔri pagɔrisigu n-dih omaŋ vi, o ba ka o dihi vi maa, bɛn nyom o buɣim.
en: If the daughter of a priest defiles herself by being promiscuous, she defiles her father. She must be burned with fire.

dag: Ka o yɛli Yisa, N dana, wuhim ma o ni nyɛ so, ka n niŋ o yɛda.
en: The man said, Tell me who he is, sir, so I can believe in him.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhi ba soli birigi ba, ka bɛ ni birigi ninvuɣ shɛb maa birim.
en: Their guides are leading them the wrong way, so those who follow them will be destroyed.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni bari ma tɔn shɛli gbaai ma, a mi di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba ni bari ma zana shɛli gbaai ma.
en: Those evil people are trying to trap me. Dont let me fall into their traps.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ bolim o na. Ka bɛ daa bol zom maa ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma! Yiɣisima, o boon a.
en: Jesus stopped and said, Call him. So they called the blind man. Cheer up! they said. Get up, he is calling you.

dag: dama yi dibu ni, sokam kpaɣirimi dira, ka kum mali shɛba ka shɛb mi nyu m-buɣi.
en: Each of you goes ahead and eats a private meal. One person goes hungry while another is drunk.

dag: Pa ŋun daa nam ma niŋ m ma puli ni n-daa nam bɛ gba? Pa ŋuna n-daa nam ti zaa niŋ ti manim puya ni?.
en: The one who made me in my mothers womb also made them. God shaped us all inside our mothers.

dag: Naawuni daa kahigi ashili nia shɛl o ni daa lo la wuhi ma. M pun sab di yɛla biɛla gbaŋ ŋɔ ni tin ya.
en: God showed me his secret plan in a revelation, as I mentioned briefly before .

dag: Ŋɔŋmiya kom m-mali shili gu bɛn yɛn teei gili ya. Pahimiya yi birininim yaa. Nomiya yaɣiri, nomiya tandi, ka zaŋya bilichiisi ŋmarigu niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!.

dag: O ni yi nyam, ka o ni sɔhira, o varila tiŋa. Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikaa, o bi tooi zaani luɣ yini.
en: Trembling with excitement, the horses race ahead; when the trumpet blows, they can't stand still.

dag: Ka yi mini Giriisinim ni Tubalnim ni Mɛshɛkinim daa lan niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi ninsalinim mini daanya nɛma na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: The people of Greece, Tubal, and Meshech traded slaves and things made of bronze.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa zaŋ ti mɔɣilɔnim yili tihi.
en: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.

dag: Nir yi chɛ ka o nini tiɣ o ni mali shɛli, di so ni o mali kɔre biɛri. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: It is useless; it is like chasing the wind. It is better to be satisfied with what you have than to be always wanting something else.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya mali binyɛra.
en: for planning skillful designs and working them in gold, silver, and bronze;.

dag: M mabihi bɛn mali be kasi ka saɣi alizanda ni boligu ŋɔ, tɛhimiya Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti daadiini tumo ni maligumaani tital la yɛla.
en: So, my brothers and sisters, those chosen by God to be his holy people, think about Jesus. He is the one we believe God sent to save us and to be our high priest.

dag: M puhir a a ni deei n suhigu ka leei n tiligira ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I praise you, Lord , because you heard me, because you have given me victory.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛri ni ti laɣim doya, ka jɛŋgbina mini bubihi ti laɣim doya, ka naɣibihi mini gbuɣimbihi ni gbuɣim pola ti laɣim doya, ka bihi ti vɔri ba chana.
en: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.

dag: Yi bi ka la din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa naan ku tooi shihi shɛl la gbin na, dina n-nyɛ: Zo shɛli buɣim ni diri mini zibisim ni sagbana zibigibu ni sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛbu.
en: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ nyan ya ka ni darigi yi tibili. Yi chɛ ka Firawuna min o kpamba nyee nyɔni ti nyooni biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi niŋ bɛ nuu ni ni bɛ ku ti.
en: So they said to Moses and Aaron, May the Lord judge and punish you for what you did! You made Pharaoh and his rulers hate us. You have given them an excuse to kill us.

dag: N suhir o ni o neei yi tɛha ka yi nya o neesim, ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ o ni boli ya tahima shɛli zuɣu min o ni lo o niriba alahiziba alibarika shɛŋa alikaulinim la.
en: I pray that God will open your minds to see his truth. Then you will know the hope that he has chosen us to have. You will know that the blessings God has promised his holy people are rich and glorious.

dag: A ni yiɣisi zo Ziɔn nambɔɣu, dama saha paaya ni a niŋ li nirilim; di saha maa mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: You will rise up and comfort Zion. The time has come for you to be kind to Zion.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛl o yiŋ nachin kpɛm ŋun su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ n gbalipina lɔŋni.
en: He said to his oldest servant, who was in charge of all that he had, Place your hand between my thighs and make a vow.

dag: Ka sokam daa kul omaŋmaŋ ya ni bɛ ti sab o yuli.
en: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛri maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka duɣi sara maligu kasi biŋkɔbiri nimdi mi duɣuri ni mini ankɔraŋmahi ni ni taha ni n-zaŋ li yomyom ti tari niriba maa zaa.
en: They roasted the Passover lambs in the fire as instructed, cooked the holy offerings in pots, kettles, and pans, and brought them quickly to all the laypeople.

dag: Tihi pum puma mɔɣu ni. Noonsi kumbu saha paaya, ka ti wumdi ŋmambihi kumsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Blossoms have appeared in the land; the season of singing has arrived, and the sound of the turtledove is heard in our land.

dag: Yinim bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, niŋmiy o naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Trust in the Lord , all you that worship him. He helps you and protects you.

dag: Ka Sɔdom naa maa daa yɛli Ibram, Zaŋm niriba ŋɔ ti ma, amaa ka mali nɛma ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then the king of Sodom told Abram, Give me my people who were captured. But you can keep everything else.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn filim bɛmaŋ la lan pala o bihi. Bɛ bela ʒiri biɛhigu o sani. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanim bɛn biɛhigu bi tuhi.
en: And you are not really his children. You are completely unfaithful to him. You are crooked liars.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn maa yuun pisaayika.
en: So the Israelites served Moabs King Eglon eighteen years.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na bi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu, niriba daa maani sara la maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: Unfortunately, the people were sacrificing at the shrines because a temple hadnt yet been built for the LORDs name in those days.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ku bɛ nachimba zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So its young men will be killed in the city streets, and all its soldiers will be destroyed on that day. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ chama, ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔni bɛ sɔɣibu shee din daa be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Ai wulinluhili polo la; amaa ka Jɔshua ŋun daa kpalim gbe niriba maa sani.
en: Joshua sent them off, and they went to set the ambush. They stayed between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai. Joshua spent that night among the people.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni niŋ yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini yi daazichi naani la zuɣu, bɛ ni ti gbahi yi gba chaŋ ka gbaai Chɛmɔshi min o maligumaaniba, ni o kpambaliba la daba chaŋ.
en: Because you have relied on your own strength and treasures, you also will be captured. Chemosh will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

dag: ka yi yi gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-nyɛ yi ni tiligi shɛli zuɣu, ka naɣila yi daa naɣ niŋla yɛda yoli.
en: That is the gospel, the message that I preached to you. You are saved by the gospel if you hold firmly to it—unless it was for nothing that you believed.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ baŋ ni n ni ti su li.
en: But Abram said, Lord GOD, how can I be sure that I will get this land.

dag: Jɔn daa di shɛhira n-lan yɛli, N nya Naawuni Shia Kasi ka o yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.

dag: Nyama, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli vinvamli ni la.
en: There I saw the dazzling light that shows the presence of Israel's God, just as I had seen it when I was by the Chebar River.

dag: ka malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Ti ni yɛn woligi tab ŋɔ, n suhiri Yawɛ ni o gul ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa lan boli nimaani yuli Mizipa.
en: Laban also said, This pile of rocks means that the Lord will watch us both while we are apart from each other. So the place was also named Mizpah.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛriko la ni daa nya Ilaisha ka o miri ba na ka bɛ yɛli, Ilaija shia la shiri be Ilaisha ni. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa.
en: When the group of prophets at Jericho saw Elisha, they said, Elijahs spirit is now on Elisha! They came to meet Elisha. They bowed very low to the ground before him.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi ba naai ka o chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni.
en: After saying good-bye to them, Jesus went up onto a mountain to pray.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka liɣiri yɔhim a, a mi di chɛ ka birapu pam dibu kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Job, dont let your anger fill you with doubt about God. And dont let the price of forgiveness turn you away.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa baŋ ni Aduna kpiya, ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ biɛɣ pihita n-kum o kuli.
en: the people knew that Aaron had died, and they mourned his death for days.

dag: Paɣa bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o yidana n-su li; lala mi n-nyɛ li, doo gba bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o paɣa n-su li.
en: The wife doesnt have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise, the husband doesnt have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

dag: Paɣisara maa ni daa laɣimna m-pahi buyi saha shɛli, Mɔdɛkai daa ʒila nayili dunol ni.
en: When they gathered the young women to the second womens house, Mordecai was working for the king at the Kings Gate.

dag: Ka nyini Daadam, zaŋmi takɔbi shɛli din dira n-leei wanzam piliŋ n-zaŋ li pini a zabiri min a teeŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ sania zahim li m-pirigi li.
en: You, human one, take a sharp sword. Use it like a razor and shave your head and beard. Then use scales to divide the hair.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: From Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy. To the Thessalonians church that is in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace and peace to all of you.

dag: Ka a daazichi min a nɛma ni a daguya ni a kpatoonsi ni a ŋariŋduhiriba ni a ŋariŋmaaniba ni a dagudariba ni a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa be a ni ni a min a niriba zaa bɛn be a sani shim teeku bulli ni a wurimbu dali.
en: All your wealth of merchandise, All the sailors in your crew, Your ship's carpenters and your merchants, Every soldier on board the ship— All, all were lost at sea When your ship was wrecked.

dag: Pahatimɔab daŋ — tusaayi ni kɔbisinii ni pinaayi.
en: of Pahath-moab, namely the family of Jeshua and Joab .

dag: Ka anab ʒirinim pam ni ti yi palo m-birigi niriba pam.
en: Many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa chɛbis o deemba maa, ka o lab o ya.
en: After a short time Moses said goodbye to his father-in-law Jethro, and Jethro went back to his own home.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa neei Balaam nina ka o nya Yawɛ malaika maa ni ʒe soli ni ŋ-ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni shɛm maa, ka o silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Then the Lord let Balaam see the angel standing there with his sword; and Balaam threw himself face downward on the ground.

dag: Pa tin shɛli din yi mali jilima, ka binshɛli bi muɣisiri li, ka di yɛra, Mani n-kul beni, ka so lan kani pahi n zuɣu. la m-bala? Di leela dabari doya, ka leei mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri biɛhigu shee. Ka ŋunkam gariti di gbini, di ni gar o ka o viini o zuɣu.
en: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, I am the only one! Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.

dag: Bɛ bari ma la zana n soli zuɣu. N nandahima maa yaɣiya. Bɛ gbila bɔɣili sɔŋ n soli zuɣu, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee lan ŋmaligi lu di ni.
en: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.

dag: A dim ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ maŋa ti a, amaa ka di lee nyɛla yɔhiŋ o suhu ni.
en: A hypocrite hides hate behind flattering words.

dag: A ni di a tuma nyɔri. A ni tɔŋ ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your work will provide for your needs; you will be happy and prosperous.

dag: O ni daa nya ba maa ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti zaŋ yimaŋ wuhi maligumaaniba. Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Jesus looked at them and said, Go show yourselves to the priests. On their way they were healed.

dag: ka ni be kasitali mini wuntitali ni o sani hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: in holiness and righteousness in Gods eyes, for as long as we live.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka Yawɛ daa wum ti kuhigu maa, ka nya ti wahala mini ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ti muɣisigu maa.
en: So we cried out for help to the LORD, our ancestors God. The LORD heard our call. God saw our misery, our trouble, and our oppression.

dag: yi yi bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo n-doli jɛmdi wuna ka chɛ n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But you must not reject any of his laws and teachings or worship other gods.

dag: Dama o nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bɛn kuhi bol o bahira; ka fari nandaamba mini bɛn ka bɛn sɔŋdi ba bahira.
en: He rescues the poor who call to him, and those who are needy and neglected.

dag: Naawuni ni yiɣisi zani ni o kari saria tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni la zuɣu.
en: when you rose up to pronounce judgment, to save all the oppressed on earth.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yɛhudianim maa daa to jina yɛli ni bɛ kum Sool.
en: After many days had gone by, the Jews met together and made plans to kill Saul.

dag: Mɔabnim suhuri kul ʒimi bɛ piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ wain shɛli le duɣu ni, ka bi kpaari li loori duɣu shɛl ni; ka so mi na bi gbahi ba daba chaŋ luɣ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ na kul mali binshɛlikam, ka bɛ binshɛli bi saɣim maa.
en: From early on Moab has been at ease, like wine left to settle on its sediment. It hasnt been poured into jars; nor has Moab been taken into exile. Therefore, its taste is still pleasant, and its aroma is the same.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa n-yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛrishiiba nti mali sara o ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Jacob packed up all he had and went to Beersheba, where he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

dag: ka o chɛ ka manna lu bɛ sanna ni bɛ di, ka o daa ti ba zuɣusaa bindirigu.
en: he gave them grain from heaven, by sending down manna for them to eat.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din gba lan pahi n-daa nyɛ: Halihul mini Bɛtizur ni Gɛdɔr.
en: There were Halhul, Bethzur, Gedor.

dag: O gba daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, amaa ka kul dolila di soli maa.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes. He didnt deviate from all the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit, but he walked in them!.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: The people who have some understanding will receive more. But those who do not have much will lose even the small amount they have.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa kul mɔhiri vuri yɛra, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But they shouted again, Kill him! Kill him on a cross.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Gɛdalia Ahikam bia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la n-leei gomna ka o su o ni daa chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la fukumsi.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon left some people in the land of Judah. There was a man named Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan. Nebuchadnezzar made Gedaliah governor over the people in Judah.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni chani ginda.
en: Jesus was in the Temple area at Solomons Porch.

dag: Miriya ka yi damdi binyɛra maa tooni bee n-jɛm binyɛra maa, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli, ka darigiri bihi tibili bɛ banim mini bɛ manim bɛn je ma taali zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili bɛ yaantibichɛhi gba.
en: Do not bow down to them or worship them, because I, the LORD your God, am a passionate God. I punish children for their parents sins even to the third and fourth generations of those who hate me.

dag: Kamiyana ka yi mini n dan Asiria naa maa puli. Yi yi ni tooi nya wɔribariba, n ni tin ya yuri tusaayi.
en: I will make a bargain with you in the name of the emperor. I will give you two thousand horses if you can find that many riders.

dag: Maika daa malila binnana jɛmbu duu; ka daa she mukuru laasabu din nyɛ bɛ ni daa lihiri shɛli ni buɣiri baɣa niŋ di ni, ka daa zaŋ o bidib yino leeg o maligumaana.
en: This man Micah had his own sanctuary. He made a priestly vest and divine images and appointed one of his sons to be his personal priest.

dag: ni Ɛlitolad ni Chɛsil ni Hɔrima.
en: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah.

dag: Tim a ba mini a ma jilima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a shɛm din ni chɛ ka a mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ ni.
en: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmaligiya ka chɛ o dolibu, ka bɛ baɣa lan ka o soya ni.
en: and refused to obey him.

dag: M bɔhiri ya, Masia pirigimi ʒii bu shɛm? Pool ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli yi zuɣu la? Bee Pool yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya?.
en: Has Christ been divided? Was Paul crucified for you, or were you baptized in Pauls name?.

dag: Kaman tampiŋ sabinli ni kpɛm gari chɛribo kuɣili shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Di zɔri ba bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Ive made your forehead like a diamond, harder than stone. Dont be afraid of them or shrink away from them, because they are a household of rebels.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ yɔhim o? Ka shia maa garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti leei ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Cham ti niŋ lala n-yɔhim o; a ni di nasara.
en: How? the Lord asked. The spirit replied, I will go and make all of Ahab's prophets tell lies. The Lord said, Go and deceive him. You will succeed.

dag: Di saha ka tihi maa zaa daa chaŋ ti yɛli tanyibiga, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Finally, they went to the thornbush and asked, Will you be our king.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ bindira leei tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ churi puhibu leei zana gbahi ba.
en: May their banquets cause their ruin; may their sacred feasts cause their downfall.

dag: Nyama, ka niriba daa gariti nya ka o do sol ni, ka gbuɣinli ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka bɛ daa ka anabi kurili maa ni be tin shɛli maa ni na nti yɛli bɛ ni nya shɛm.
en: Some men passed by and saw the body on the road, with the lion standing near by. They went on into Bethel and reported what they had seen.

dag: A ni yu zaɣ viɛlli la zuɣu, niŋm Ziɔn zaɣ viɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm goma zali yaha.
en: Do good things for Zion by your favor. Rebuild Jerusalems walls.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua daŋ niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Kadimiɛl yiŋnim mini Hɔdɛva yiŋnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanahi.
en: These are the people from the tribe of Levi: the descendants of Jeshua through Kadmiel through the family of Hodeiah :.

dag: Sulemaana daa diri n-sula na shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli zaŋ hal ti paai Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ti kpa Ijiptinim tiŋgbɔŋ tariga; ka bɛ daa yɔri farigu o sani ka jɛmd o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines. His kingdom went as far as the border of Egypt. These countries sent gifts to Solomon, and they obeyed him all of his life.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai tiŋkpan shɛli, ka paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maata zaŋ o ti kpɛh o yiŋa.
en: While Jesus and his disciples were traveling, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed him as a guest.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: and they had , men and boys at least one month old.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Eleazar followed the Lord 's instructions.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa chɛ ka tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa yi Ifriim tiŋgban ni na maa lab kuli. Ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam bahi Judanim zuɣu ka bɛ je suli pam lab kuli.
en: So Amaziah sent the Israelite army back home to Ephraim. These men were very angry with the king and the people of Judah. They went back home very angry.

dag: Ka chɛ ti taali paŋ ti kaman ti gba ni chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali shɛm la.
en: Forgive us for the ways we have wronged you, just as we also forgive those who have wronged us.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mali kpiɔŋ, ka bɛ fɔntinsi nyɛ tiŋ kara, ka bɛ me goma gil li, ka din pahi nyɛla, ti nya Anaki zuliya nimaani.
en: But the people who live there are powerful, and their cities are very large and well fortified. Even worse, we saw the descendants of the giants there.

dag: So daa naan ku tooi woligi suhupiɛlli tahigu vuri ka chɛ kuhigu vuri maa, dama niriba maa daa kul tahirila pampam, ka di vuri maa daa chaŋ katiŋ pam.
en: No one could distinguish between the joyful shouts and the crying, because the noise they made was so loud that it could be heard for miles.

dag: Ka Shɛlɛmia bia Hanania mini Hanun ŋun daa nyɛ Zalaf bia ŋun pah ayɔbu la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam daa mali me o ni daa be luɣ shɛli la tooni.
en: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.

dag: Nir yi zu nahu bee piɛɣu nti kɔhi bee nti kɔrigi, di simdi ka o yo niɣ anu naɣ yino maa zuɣu, ka yo piɛr anahi piɛ yino maa zuɣu. Di simdi ka o yo di samli maa, ka o yi ka binshɛli din ni yo samli maa, dindina bɛn kɔhim o n-yo o zubu maa samli.
en: If you steal an ox and slaughter or sell it, you must replace it with five oxen; if you steal a sheep and slaughter it or sell it, you must replace it with four sheep.

dag: Piim a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi Izraɛlnim ni, n-chɛ ka bɛ yi n ka a sanna ti leei m maligumaaniba, n-tumdi n tuma; Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn yuya booni Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Tell your brother Aaron and his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to come to you from the Israelites. These men will serve me as priests.

dag: ni Baalat ni Tama din be Juda tiŋgban ni mɔɣu ni la.
en: Baalath, and Tamar in the desert of Judah.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ zaɣ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la; ka maligumaana maa mali sanyoo sara yo daɣ shɛli din daa yi o ni maa samli Yawɛ sani ti o.
en: Then the priest must offer one bird for a sin offering and the other bird for a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make her pure before the Lord .

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋ na nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka di sabi ni faashee Daadam Bia bahi di wahala balibu kam ka bɛ lan ʒiɛm o?.
en: Jesus answered, They are right to say that Elijah must come first. Elijah makes all things the way they should be. But why do the Scriptures say that the Son of Man will suffer much and that people will think he is worth nothing?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛli Firawuna, Tinim a daba ŋɔ kamina ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dama kum maa miiya pam Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti biŋkɔbiri bi nyari mɔri ŋubira; ka pumpɔŋɔ ti suhir a mi ni a chɛ ka ti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni.
en: We have come to live in this country, because in the land of Canaan the famine is so severe that there is no pasture for our flocks. Please give us permission to live in the region of Goshen.

dag: Dunia shiri ni ti dahimdahim doya, ka bɛ ʒe di zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ba, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka guliya Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ ya leei Naawuni piɛ shɛb guliba la, ka dihiri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni Cheechi shɛli o ni daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Bia ʒim fa m-bahi la.
en: Be careful for yourselves and for all the people God has given you. The Holy Spirit gave you the work of caring for this flock. You must be shepherds to the church of God, the people he bought with his own blood.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛra.
en: He taught them, saying.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali shɛm la.
en: Three days later, Jeroboam and all the people came back as Rehoboam had said.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o je suli, ka o ninni biɛhigu taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo polo, ka yɛl o niriba ni bɛ malim buɣim maa n-chɛ ka di bii ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-gari di ni yi pun biiri shɛm.
en: Nebuchadnezzar was filled with rage, and his face twisted beyond recognition because of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. In response he commanded that the furnace be heated to seven times its normal heat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Simiɔn zuliya yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, doo kam ŋun paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ ŋunkam ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Simeon was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Lɔdɛba Ammiɛl bia Makiri maa yiŋ ti zaŋ o na.
en: David sent some servants to bring Jonathan's son from Lo-Debar. His name was Mephibosheth, and he was the grandson of Saul. He came to David and knelt down. David asked, Are you Mephibosheth? Yes, I am, Your Majesty.

dag: Tinzunnim luri ma la sizuura; ka man dee yi kul yɛli shɛlikam ka bɛ wum, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: Foreigners bow before me; when they hear me, they obey.

dag: Man Jeemsi ŋun nyɛ Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabili la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri yinim bɛn nyɛ ti zuliya pinaayi bɛn wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam la m-puhiri ya.
en: Greetings from James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ. To Gods people who are scattered all over the world.

dag: Sara maligu yini ŋɔ zuɣu ka Masia chɛ ka Naawuni ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la be dɛde hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri pun birigi ka na bela bɛ manim puya ni. Bɛ dɔɣibu saha ka bɛ pun birigi; ka nyɛ ʒiŋmariba.
en: The wicked backslide from the womb; liars go astray from birth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛhu, A ni tum din tuhi n sani, ka niŋ Ɛhab daŋ niriba kaman n suhu ni daa yu shɛm zaa la zuɣu, a daŋ ni bidibisi kul ni diri Izraɛl nam hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni.
en: The Lord said to Jehu, You have done well. You have done what I say is good. You destroyed Ahabs family the way I wanted you to, so your descendants will rule Israel for four generations.

dag: ka daa ʒini pakolim ni mi hal ka o yuma ti paai pihiniinaanahi. O daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam jɛmdi Naawuni ni nolɔbo mini wunsuhigu.
en: before he died and left her alone. She was now years old. Anna was always at the Temple; she never left. She worshiped God by fasting and praying day and night.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpe Dauda suhu ni pam, ka dabiɛm gbaag o zaŋ chaŋ Gaat Naa Akishi maa polo.
en: David paid close attention to what they said. He was afraid of King Achish of Gath.

dag: Ka a ti baŋ ni barina shɛli ka a yiŋa. Ka a yi ti kaag a piɛri, a ni nya ka bɛ zaa beni.
en: You will know that your tent is secure. You will examine your home and miss nothing.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yihiri waazu yɛri niriba ni bɛ niŋmi tuuba.
en: So they went out and proclaimed that people should change their hearts and lives.

dag: ka Shɛfufam daŋ niriba nyɛ Shufamnima; ka Hufam daŋ niriba nyɛ Hufamnima.
en: Shupham—the Shuphamite family group; Hupham—the Huphamite family group;.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa yinoyino saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Niŋmiya tuuba, ka zo n-yi yi tuumbiɛri zaa tumbu ni, di yi pa lala tuumbiɛri tumbu maa ni chɛ ka yi bahi yoli.
en: I will judge each of you for what you've done. So stop sinning, or else you will certainly be punished.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa nti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na. O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku nol la yiŋa.
en: So send some men to the city of Joppa and tell Simon Peter to come. He is staying with another man named Simon, a leatherworker who has a house beside the sea.

dag: Chɛ ka n dol a zaligunim soli, dama n suhu yuri li pam.
en: Help me follow your commands, because that makes me happy.

dag: Naawuni tim a sakom din mal alibarika, ka chɛ ka a tiŋgbani vuhira. Naawuni tim a kawana mini wain pam.
en: May God give you plenty of rain, good crops, and wine.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, bɔhim Naawuni nya ti ni di nasara ti chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: So they said to him, Please ask God if our search for a place to live will be successful.

dag: Amaa wula ka n yɛn yɛli? Dama o pun yɛli ma ni omaŋmaŋa n-niŋ li. Ka n suhu saɣim pam, ka n kɔŋ gom.
en: What can I say? He told me what would happen, and he will make it happen. I have had these troubles in my soul, so now I will be humble all my life.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. Ka fukumsi zaligu shɛl lan kani kpɛm gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: The second most important commandment is this: Love your neighbor as you love yourself. There is no other commandment more important than these two.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, bɛ kul chanimi gindi tiŋ maa goma, ka tuumbiɛri mini nyaanyibo be di ni.
en: Day and night they make their rounds on its walls, and evil and misery live inside it.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia ba Naawuni ŋun kul simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ mi ni m bi ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ bali Yisa nyaandoliba ni, ka bɛ daa zɔr o, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ yɛda ni o shiri nyɛla Yisa nyaandola.
en: Saul went to Jerusalem and tried to join the disciples. But they would not believe that he was a disciple, and they were all afraid of him.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Yi zaa nyumiya li.
en: Then he took a cup of wine, thanked God for it, and gave it to them. He said, Each one of you drink some of it.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ni bari ma zana shɛl la ni; dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Get me out of this net thats been set for me because you are my protective fortress.

dag: Ka n nya ka vuhim daa yi Naawuni sanna nti kpe bɛ ni di daba ata ni pirigili maa dali ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi zani, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi bɛnkam nya ba.
en: But after three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear came over those who saw them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul bɔrila zabili, ka tikuba mi woligir nir min o zɔsimo.
en: Gossip is spread by wicked people; they stir up trouble and break up friendships.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yi bihi yi ti bɔhi bɛ banim dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: He said to the Israelites, In the future your children will ask their parents, What about these stones.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni bɛ laɣimmi Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa na ka bɛ ti wuhi ma zahindi maa gbinni.
en: So I gave an order that all the wise men of Babylon be brought to me to tell me what my dream meant.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni daa di n-tiɣi naai ka bɛ pii ŋariŋ maa ni alikama kpalan shɛŋa bahi teeku maa ni ni ŋariŋ maa tibisim filim.
en: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ? Ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhimiya.
en: Jesus said to Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, My heart is so heavy with grief, I feel as if I am dying. Wait here and stay awake with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋ bɛ nɛma pam n-zɔri ni bɛ du kulitihi kulibɔŋ tiligi.
en: So the people gather up everything they own and cross the border at Arabah stream.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa kpuɣ kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa, ka o ŋoli yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: So they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and left the temple.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi deebu zaa.
en: This is a true saying, to be completely accepted and believed.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinima, ka nyɛ yi ni yɛn puhiri shɛŋa o ni zal li saha shɛli m-bala.
en: These are the LORDs appointed times, holy occasions, which you will celebrate at their appointed times.

dag: Yi yaannim bɛn daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti la daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin, ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: When your ancestors went to Egypt, there were only seventy of them. But now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

dag: Shɛli bi to Yawɛ sani. N shiri ni ti labina yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, ka Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? When I return to you about this time next year, Sarah will have a son.

dag: N sabila yɛla ŋɔ ti yinim bɛn niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yuli yɛda la ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni yi mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I write these things to you who believe in the name of Gods Son so that you can know that you have eternal life.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun tuhiri tɔbu. O yuli n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The LORD is a warrior; the LORD is his name.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka o yi n-chaŋ ti zani ka yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi ka taali. Mani n-daa lo nia biɛɣu n-ku n dana, amaa ka ŋun mi n-lee ku bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo ŋun gbaya kpi maa, N yɛr a mi, yiɣisima n-zaŋ a daamaŋka kuli.
en: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth. Jesus then said to the man, Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.

dag: Yi ni so yi zaŋ o mabia tahi ʒiishee, yi dihila yimaŋ vi maa. Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ku dihi yɛla sɔŋ yi suhuri ni? Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ni so yi din ya zalinsi ka yi ku chɛ di yɛla bahi?.
en: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.

dag: A zo nyɛla ŋun yur a sahakam, ka mabihi mi nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛba ni bɛ sɔŋdi taba ashaara saha.
en: A friend loves you all the time, but a brother was born to help in times of trouble.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be yaɣ shɛŋa din pahi la ni gba daa laɣimmi tuhi fa bɛmaŋa. Bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn je ba maa n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaanu. Amaa bɛ daa bi di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Jews in the provinces also organized and defended themselves. They rid themselves of their enemies by killing seventy-five thousand people who hated them. But they did no looting.

dag: ka yɛl o, Di ni nyɛ a suhuyubu ni ka a zaɣis a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛl la mini n ni daa zal a zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu zuɣu, n ni deeg a nam maa n-zaŋ li ti a kpambal so.
en: The LORD said to Solomon, Because you have done all this instead of keeping my covenant and my laws that I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom from you and give it to your servant.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa kpi, bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi shɛba bɛ kpiɔŋ saha.
en: God struck down all the oldest sons throughout their land; struck down their very pride and joy.

dag: Kaman kom ni chɛ ka nir nyar o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ninsal suhu nyari di kpee.
en: It is your own face that you see reflected in the water and it is your own self that you see in your heart.

dag: Amaa ka Hadad daa be Ijipti maa ka ti wum ni Dauda min o sapashin kpɛm Jɔab zaa kpiya, ka o daa yɛli Firawuna, Tim ma soli ka n lab kuli n ya.
en: When the news reached Hadad in Egypt that David had died and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to the king, Let me go back to my own country.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu nyaaŋa nyɛla vi dibu, amaa bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm.
en: Proud and boastful people will be shamed, but wisdom stays with those who are modest and humble.

dag: A viɛli pam, ka a viɛlim maa mali kɔre, n yura ŋun nyɛ paɣ viɛlli.
en: You are very beautiful, so desirable!.

dag: Ŋuna n-filim kurimbuni ha wuna la, ka o nuhi din ka bahigu ŋɔ gbibi ya. O ni kari yi dimnim bɛn be yi tooni la bahi ka yɛli, Kumiya ba.
en: God lives forever. He is your place of safety. His power continues forever! He is protecting you. He will force your enemies to leave your land. He will say, Destroy the enemy.

dag: Ka teeku daa yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka o daa zaŋ bɛ zaa ni tum tuun shɛŋa n-kari ba saria.
en: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin m-puhi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi chuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. O ni daa lɛbigi Asiria naa suhu ti ba ka o sɔŋ ba Izraɛl Naawuni jɛmbu duu mɛbu tuma ni la.
en: They celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread with much joy for seven days. The Lord made them very happy because he had changed the attitude of the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria had helped them do the work on Gods Temple.

dag: Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa wum Filistia doo maa yɛtɔɣa maa, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba pam.
en: Saul and his men heard what Goliath said, but they were so frightened of Goliath that they couldn't do a thing.

dag: Ka Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni tooi niŋ alibarika din galisi pam niŋ yi ni, ka di chɛ ka yi kul mali binshɛɣukam ka di saɣiri ya, ka chɛ ka yi tooi mali pam din ni zaŋ tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: God has the power to provide you with more than enough of every kind of grace. That way, you will have everything you need always and in everything to provide more than enough for every kind of good work.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun wuhir a tab ŋɔ, a ku wuh amaŋa? Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di zu, a nyɛla ŋun zura?.
en: You teach others—why don't you teach yourself? You preach, Do not steal—but do you yourself steal?.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa yɛli, Ŋun be tooni zɔrina maa ŋmanila Zadok bia Ahimaaz. Ka naa daa yɛli, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, dinzuɣu lahibali suŋ ka o ʒirina maa.
en: The lookout said, I can see that the first man runs like Ahimaaz. He's a good man, the king said, and he is bringing good news.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sool min o bidibis ata ni o gbaɣinɔʒira ni o niriba zaa ni daa laɣim kpi dahin yini shɛm m-bala.
en: Saul was dead, his three sons were dead, and the soldier who carried his weapons was dead. They and all his soldiers died on that same day.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya mini Nɛtania ni Zɛbadia ni Asahɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhɔnatan ni Adɔnija ni Tɔbija ni Tɔbadɔnija m-pahi Maligumaaniba Ɛlishama mini Jɛhɔram.
en: They were accompanied by the Levites Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, and by the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

dag: yin piimiya yi dan bidibisi maa ni ŋun be viɛnyɛla ka simdi ni o niŋ naa n-zaŋ o ʒil o ba nam ʒiishee; ka tuhi sɔŋ yi naa maa daŋ niriba.
en: look for the best and most capable of your masters sons. Place him on his fathers throne. Then fight for your masters family.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul maanila sara buɣa jɛmbu shee maa, amaa bɛ daa maani li n-tirila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa.
en: Although the people continued to offer sacrifices at other places of worship, they offered them only to the Lord .

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya yɛli, Yawɛ ni tiligi ti. Zuliya shɛb wuna na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni?.
en: Dont let Hezekiah fool you by saying, The LORD will rescue us. Did any of the other gods of the nations save their lands from the power of Assyrias king?.

dag: suhir a n ni leei bi so ba sarika ŋɔ ni la zuɣu. Bia maa n-nyɛ Onɛsimus.
en: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.

dag: Dɔro ni daa mali do so yuun pihinahaayika gba daa do nimaani.
en: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for years.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-nyɛ ti ni pun be so sani ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: O Lord, you have always been our home.

dag: Ti zaa daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn bɔrigi, ka sokam dol o suhuyubu soli. Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ti zaa daalahichi ʒil o.
en: All of us were like sheep that were lost, each of us going his own way. But the Lord made the punishment fall on him, the punishment all of us deserved.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara din gari ninsal yɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: He does things too marvelous for people to understand. He does too many miracles to count!.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi di daa maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o dini.
en: But if you decide to buy it back, you must pay an additional percent.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yihi tinzunnim zaa bɛn be Izraɛlnim ni.
en: Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda nimaani.
en: Many believed in Jesus there.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi nya soli kpe ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Masia nam din ka bahigu la ni.
en: In this way you will be given the full right to enter the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

dag: Masia ni daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima ti zuɣu la puuni ka ti baŋ yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli, ka di simdi ni ti gba zaŋ ti nyɛviya pa talima ti mabihi zuɣu.
en: This is how we know what love is: Christ gave his life for us. We too, then, ought to give our lives for others!.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla nini, wula ka di di yɛn niŋ wum? Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla tibili, wula ka di di yɛn wum nyom?.
en: If the whole body were an eye, what would happen to the hearing? And if the whole body were an ear, what would happen to the sense of smell?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya Pita mini Jɔn suhukpeeni, ka mi ni bɛ nyɛla tarimba ni zuɣusabila maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛ mini Yisa n-daa be.
en: The Jewish leaders understood that Peter and John had no special training or education. But they also saw that they were not afraid to speak. So the leaders were amazed. They also realized that Peter and John had been with Jesus.

dag: Niriba tusatusa m-be Saria Karibu Vinvamli maa ni. Dama Yawɛ dabisili la miriya Saria Karibu Vinvamli la ni.
en: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa din pahi ni o yɛm tuma la yɛla sab be Sulemaana tuma litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Solomons deeds, including all that he did and all his wisdom, arent they written in the official records of Solomon?.

dag: Ka maligumaana Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba bɛn daa pah o zuɣu maa ni daa wum Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam.
en: Phinehas the priest, the leaders of the community, and the heads of the military units of Israel who were with him heard the words that the people of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh spoke and approved them.

dag: timiya binshɛɣukam din viɛla, ka yi tooi tum o yubu; ka lan chɛ ka yi tum din ni tiɣ o nini yi bebu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami.
en: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa ti be mɔɣu ni Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la ka o daa yihiri waazu yɛra.
en: When it was the right time, John the Baptizer began telling people a message from God. This was out in the desert area of Judea.

dag: n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ka yɛli, N niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu m-bala. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ teemi n yɛla.
en: After giving thanks, he broke it and said, This is my body, which is for you; do this to remember me.

dag: A mali pal yɛlinli ti n naba, ka m bi sarigi.
en: You have kept me from being captured, and I have never fallen.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, N gba bɔri ni n wum doo maa yɛtɔɣa. Ka Fɛstus yɛl o, A sa ni wum li biɛɣuni.
en: Agrippa said to Festus, I would like to hear this man myself. You will hear him tomorrow, Festus answered.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu dazɔhigu dali kaman agbaa saha, ka o yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, N-nyɛ yi Naa maa.
en: It was now almost noon on Preparation day of Passover week. Pilate said to the Jews, Here is your king.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka di mini li laɣim zooi ka gɔhi maa girimgirim li.
en: Some other seed fell among thorny weeds. This seed grew, but later the weeds stopped the plants from growing.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Kɛnnima, Yimiya chaŋ ka chɛ Amalɛknim ŋɔ, di so ni n ti ku ba tabili ya; dama yi daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa nirilim pam saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Di saha ka Kɛnnim maa daa yi ka chɛ Amalɛknim maa.
en: He sent a warning to the Kenites, a people whose ancestors had been kind to the Israelites when they came from Egypt: Go away and leave the Amalekites, so that I won't kill you along with them. So the Kenites left.

dag: Dina ka ti mali paɣiri ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la, ka lan mal li turi ninsalinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni nam shɛba ŋ-ŋmahind omaŋ la.
en: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.

dag: O min o biɛyanim maa ni daa na mali alizama saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim tiyaawumya ŋun yuli booni Goliat ka o nyɛ Gaat nir la daa yi Filistianim maa sanna nti lan yɛr o ni daa pun yɛri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la. Ka Dauda daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Right when David was speaking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, came forward from the Philistine ranks and said the same things he had said before. David listened.

dag: Judanim ni ŋmanila tɔbbi shɛb bɛn di nasara ka no bɛ dimnim firi soli zuɣu baɣiri ni; dama Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Bɛ ni tuhi nyaŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri wɔribariba la.
en: Judah will be like warriors, trampling through the muddy streets during battle. They will do battle because the LORD is with them. All the cavalry will be ashamed.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ puuni, bɔ ka bɛ lee nyari di ni?.
en: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?.

dag: Ka niriba anahi daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o ka Yisa sanna.
en: some people brought a paralyzed man to see him. He was being carried by four of them.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa din daa be zolɔna ni n-nyɛ: Ɛshitaol mini Zɔra ni Ashina.
en: The tribe of Judah also got these towns in the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah.

dag: N Duuma, a nyɛla Naawun suŋ, ka chɛri niriba taali, ka a yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛnkam zaa suhir a sani.
en: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa ti yɛl o, Yi mini yi bihi chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ, amaa chɛliya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi bɛna.
en: Then Pharaoh called Moses and said, Go! Worship the LORD! Only your flocks and herds need to stay behind. Even your children can go with you.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛl o pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: The voice spoke to him again, Do not consider anything unclean that God has declared clean.

dag: Amaa yi zuɣu ka n daa ku Amɔrinima daa wɔɣawɔɣa kaman sida tihi, ka mali yaa kaman oki tihi la. N daa ku bɛ mini bɛ bihi zaa.
en: But it was I who destroyed the Amorites before them. They were as tall as cedar trees and as strong as oaks, but I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiya n dan naa ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla pali, mmaŋmaŋ zaŋ tabili n ni mali shɛlikam nyɛla o dini.
en: Israels king answered, Whatever you say, my master, great king. I am yours and so is everything I have.

dag: Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli Ibram, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa yih a Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a ka a su li.
en: The Lord said to Abram, I brought you here from Ur in Chaldea, and I gave you this land.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili m mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: For if you want to save your own life, you will lose it; but if you lose your life for me and for the gospel, you will save it.

dag: N ku bɔri ni n yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ninsal na mi m-bɔri ni binshɛli val o?.
en: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?.

dag: Ka ŋunkam be Masia ni, o bi tumd alahichi; ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi, dindina o na bi nya o bee m-mi o.
en: So whoever lives in Christ does not continue to sin. If they continue to sin, they have never really understood Christ and have never known him.

dag: ka yɛli Musa, Amaŋmaŋ tɔɣisim ti yɛtɔɣa ka ti wumda, amaa di lan chɛ ka Naawuni tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa, di yi nyɛ lala ti ni kpi.
en: They said to Moses, If you speak to us, we will listen; but we are afraid that if God speaks to us, we will die.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa dari tɔhila o binyɛra, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: When King Hezekiah listened to their message, he tore his clothes to show he was upset. Then he put on sackcloth and went to the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ti yiɣisibu dali ni daa ti paai ka ti yiɣisi ni ti chaŋ; ka bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi zaa daa biɛl ti ti yi tiŋ maa tariga, ka ti gbani teeku noli n-suhi Naawuni.
en: But when our time there was up, we returned to the ship to continue our trip. All the followers, even the women and children, came with us to the seashore. We all knelt down on the beach, prayed.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ kpaluhi alahiziba, ka bɛnkam zaa tumdi tuma deeri yɔri ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Those who weave cloth will be broken, and those who work for money will be depressed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Bɛ nya nanima anu la ka bɛ sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: Someone found them, and Joshua was told where they were hiding.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi ba n-zani dabisi biɛɣu dali, ka yi yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, yi shiri ni ba n-zani.
en: So put on God's armor now! Then when the evil day comes, you will be able to resist the enemy's attacks; and after fighting to the end, you will still hold your ground.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o lan yi o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn daa be sol ni kuni bɛ ya zuɣu.
en: Later, Jesus appeared to two followers while they were walking in the country. But Jesus did not look the same as before he was killed.

dag: Pirigim a ni mali shɛlikam ʒii buyopɔin bee bunii zuɣu, dama a ku tooi baŋ barina shɛli din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Invest what you have in several different things. You dont know what bad things might happen on earth.

dag: Ka Iso daa je Yaakubu yɛlli, o ba ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ o ni la zuɣu. Ka Iso daa yɛli, Di ku lan yuui ka ti ba kpi, di saha n ni ku n tizo Yaakubu.
en: After that Esau hated Jacob because of this blessing. Esau said to himself, My father will soon die, and after we are finished with that, I will kill Jacob.

dag: Ka kpiin shɛb bɛn kpalim bɛn bi neei kum ni hal ti paai yuun tuhili maa tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kum ni neebu din daŋ tooni la.
en: The rest of the dead didnt come to life until the thousand years were over. This is the first resurrection.

dag: Musa daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi chɛla paɣiba ŋɔ zaa ka bi ku ba?.
en: Moses said to them, Why did you let the women live?.

dag: Bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la ka bɛ daa zaŋ me gooni maa, ka tiŋ maa maŋmaŋ nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛb ni. Ifriimnim nyɛla bɛn dɔni yaɣ yini tabili, ka bɛ lɛbigi.
en: Ephraim mixes with the nations. Ephraim is like a cake that was not cooked on both sides.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka n ni yɛn chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli paai Jɛrusalɛm maa niŋ a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni ka a nini nya li. N ni chɛ ka a ti yi dunia yili ni suhudoo. Ka tuumba maa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa lab ti yɛli Naa Jɔsia.
en: Thats why I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will go to your grave in peace. You wont experience the disaster I am about to bring on this place.

dag: Bɛ na mi m-be kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri mɔ shɛŋa ka be kaman wurigu ka pɔhim ʒe n-chaŋ la?.
en: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, o daa nyɛla Dɔdo bia, ka Dɔdo mi nyɛ Aho bia. Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani saha shɛli bɛ ni daa filim Filistianim bɛn lo tɔbu n-laɣim nimaani na, ka Izraɛlnim nya ba ka tiri gbin la.
en: Next in command was Eleazar, Dodos son and Ahohis grandson. He was among the three warriors with David when they insulted the Philistines who had gathered there for battle. The Israelites retreated.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila di yubu polo, ka a wumdi di damli, amaa ka bi mi di ni yiri shɛli polo na bee di ni kpari shɛli polo; lala mi ka Naawuni Shia ni dɔɣ sokam be.
en: The wind blows wherever it wants to. You hear it, but you dont know where it is coming from or where it is going. It is the same with everyone who is born from the Spirit.

dag: Ka bintɔra daa tɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi kpi mi, ka tiŋ maa nim daa kum pam.
en: The people who didnt die were struck with tumors, and the screams of the city went all the way up to heaven.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o bia maa ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to themselves, This is the owner's son. Come on, let's kill him, and we will get his property.

dag: Nɛbo — pihinunaayi.
en: from the town of Nebo:.

dag: Mani yi Duuma Naawuni yɛliya, n ni ku Ashidɔdnima, ka ku Ashikɛlɔn naa. N ni darigi Ɛkurɔn tibili, ka chɛ ka Filistianim bɛn kpalim zaa kpi.
en: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord , have spoken!.
