dag: Bɛ bi yɛli nyini n dana Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la ka n niŋ shɛm? N daa zaŋla anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka niŋdi bindirigu mini kom ti tiri ba.
en: Haven't you heard that when Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord I hid a hundred of them in caves, in two groups of fifty, and supplied them with food and water?.

dag: M min o gbɛri kparila taba, ka n tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ka di do palɔni, ka pa ni ŋaha puuni; ka o nyari man Yawɛ kɔtomsi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi bi zo dabiɛm ni yi galim n dabili Musa maa.
en: I speak with him face-to-face, visibly, not in riddles. He sees the LORDs form. So why arent you afraid to criticize my servant Moses.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Lakishinim niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme n-deei li dabisi shɛli din pah ayi dali, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Libinanim shɛm la.
en: and the next day the Lord let them capture the town. They killed everyone, as they had done at Libnah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ nyan ya ka ni darigi yi tibili. Yi chɛ ka Firawuna min o kpamba nyee nyɔni ti nyooni biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi niŋ bɛ nuu ni ni bɛ ku ti.
en: Then the men said, We hope the Lord will punish both of you for making the king and his officials hate us. Now they even have an excuse to kill us.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ yi biɛhigu shee bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ zim kuruwa ayi malina, ka bɛ ti zaŋ gahi. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka yi ti niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, ka di leei bindir tuuli shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: Each family is to bring two loaves of bread and present them to the Lord as a special gift. Each loaf shall be made of four pounds of flour baked with yeast and shall be presented to the Lord as an offering of the first grain to be harvested.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ? O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni.
en: What, then, will the owner of the vineyard do? asked Jesus. He will come and kill those tenants and turn the vineyard over to others.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Gaad ni o yɛlim Dauda ni o cham ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Aruna ŋun nyɛ Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili ni.
en: The angel of the Lord told Gad to command David to go and build an altar to the Lord at Araunah's threshing place.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ma, Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kɔba maa, Yinim kɔb kuma ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Then he said to me, Speak to these bones for me. Tell them, Dry bones, listen to the word of the Lord !.

dag: O daa yɛlila yɛtɔɣa, ka koma din be zuɣusaa gbaai vubu. Ka o daa chɛ ka paɣili yi tiŋgban ni luɣilikam na, ka chɛ ka saanyaɣisibu be saa ni; ŋuna n-daa yihi pɔhim di biɛhigu shee na.
en: The waters in the heavens roar at his command. He makes clouds appear; he sends the wind from his storehouse and makes lightning flash in the rain.

dag: Dama n yi be, Masia n-nyɛ n nyɛvili, ka m mi yi kpi, di nyɛla din so.
en: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.

dag: ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: He did this to give full meaning to what the prophet Isaiah said:.

dag: Dama n daa zɔrila wahala din yɛn yi Naawuni sanna dabiɛm, ka n daa naan ku tooi zan o jilima tooni.
en: But I didnt do any of these bad things. I fear Gods punishment too much. His majesty scares me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa kum o kuli maa ni daa ti gari, ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna yiŋnima, N suhiri ya, yi nini yi tiɣi ma, yin yɛlimiya Firawuna.
en: After the time of sadness was finished, Joseph spoke to Pharaohs officers and said, Please tell this to Pharaoh:.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ n tizɔbihi.
en: He replied, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers.

dag: Ka o daa lee shini, ka ŋmaligi baalim kul o yiŋa nti tim bol o zɔnim na, ka bol o paɣa Zɛrɛshi na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: But he controlled himself and went on home. Then he invited his friends to his house and asked his wife Zeresh to join them.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun ti o niriba Izraɛlnim vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la; ka o yɛtɔɣ yini gba bi kɔŋ palibu kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o dabili Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: May the LORD be blessed! He has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. He hasnt neglected any part of the good promise he made through his servant Moses.

dag: Paɣ ŋɔ niŋ ma o kpiɔŋ tariga, dama o zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma n-gula n sɔɣibu.
en: This woman did the only thing she could do for me. She poured perfume on my body before I die to prepare it for burial.

dag: Di saha ka Napaɣ Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi ni a shiri ni ti ma n ni bɔri shɛli a sani, dindina n ni bɔri shɛli nyɛla, tiligimi n nyɛvili, ka tiligi n niriba gba nyɛviya pahi.
en: Esther answered, Your Majesty, if you really care for me and are willing to help, you can save me and my people. That's what I really want.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ daba.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! You are his servants, so praise his name.

dag: Di kpala talahi ni ti zaa kpi; ti ŋmanila kom din kpaai bahi tiŋa ka nir ku lan tooi va li la. Amaa Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yih o bia ŋun zo n-kpe yɔɣu o daŋ ni.
en: We each must die and disappear like water poured out on the ground. But God doesn't take our lives. Instead, he figures out ways of bringing us back when we run away.

dag: Ka binshɛli yi sɔɣi, di sɔɣimi ni di ti yi zahira, ka binshɛli din mi be ashilɔni, di be ashilɔni maa ni di ti yila palo.
en: Everything that is hidden will be made clear. Every secret thing will be made known.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinina ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li sani, amaa jɛrilim nyɛla din darigiri jɛra tibili.
en: One who has insight is a fountain of life, but the instruction of the foolish is folly.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: The total number of men in these family groups from the tribe of Simeon was .

dag: ni Hukok mini Rɛhɔb ni di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba.
en: Helkath with its pasturelands and Rehob with its pasturelands.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn kabisila Ɛlamnim tɔbiri din nyɛ bɛ yaa la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I will break Elams bow very soon. It is Elams strongest weapon.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Yisifu. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia tin shɛli din yuli booni Arimatia la nira, ka daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jintɔriba ni yino ŋun nyɛ bilichina ni wundabili.
en: There was a man named Joseph from Arimathea, a town in Judea. He was a good and honorable man, who was waiting for the coming of the Kingdom of God. Although he was a member of the Council, he had not agreed with their decision and action.

dag: Ŋun yur o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋun mi je o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti mal li hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Whoever loves the life they have now will lose it. But whoever is willing to give up their life in this world will keep it. They will have eternal life.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judianim zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kab chaŋ o sani.
en: People came to him from Jerusalem, from the whole province of Judea, and from all over the country near the Jordan River.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri bɛ tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni nya bindirigu pam, amaa bɛn doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Those who work their land will have plenty to eat, but those who engage in empty pursuits have no sense.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣ do n-gu m-bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun sɔɣi doya.
en: They are like lions, waiting for me, wanting to tear me to pieces.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni ŋun be tibi. Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: The Lord is merciful and good; our God is compassionate.

dag: N nyuli zabbu mini n suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Dindali maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti dam pam.
en: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani ka boli ba na ti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, What do you want me to do for you.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba maa mini Keenannim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbani maa ni la kul laɣim be, bɛ ni daa bi kari ba maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Asher lived with the local Canaanites, since they had not been driven out.

dag: Ka o daa dihiri Izraɛlnim vi, ka Dauda mabia Shimɛi bia Jɔnatan mi daa ku o.
en: But when he made fun of Israel, David's nephew Jonathan killed him. Jonathan was the son of David's brother Shimei.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sulemaana daa kari maligumaana Abiata Yawɛ maligumaanitali tuma ni, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli yiŋnim polo Shilo la niŋ pali.
en: So Solomon told Abiathar that he could not continue to serve as a priest of the Lord . This happened as the Lord said it would when he told Eli the priest what would happen to him and his family.

dag: Dinzuɣu man kpahimbu puuni, di ni simdi ni ninsalinim niŋ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla bɛ kul diri ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama suhupiɛlli mini bɛ tuma n-kul yɛn doli taba Naawuni ni ti ba nyɛvili shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ puuni.
en: So I am convinced that we should enjoy ourselves, because the only pleasure we have in this life is eating and drinking and enjoying ourselves. We can at least do this as we labor during the life that God has given us in this world.

dag: Naawuni Bia maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam labisi omaŋmaŋ sani. Naawuni deeri sandaani la o Bia maa ʒim din daa yi dapulli zuɣu la zuɣu, ka zaŋdi binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni mini din be alizanda ni n-labisiri omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: Through the Son, then, God decided to bring the whole universe back to himself. God made peace through his Son's blood on the cross and so brought back to himself all things, both on earth and in heaven.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Bɛnkam doli di soli mali baŋsim viɛlli. O paɣibu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The way to become wise is to honor the Lord ; he gives sound judgment to all who obey his commands. He is to be praised forever.

dag: A yi ni doli Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga, a biɛhigu ni tɔŋ. Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, Di zɔri dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Molada ni Hazarishual.
en: Shimeis descendants lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shual.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka la mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu ni di pateesa la.
en: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni be a sani, ka chɛ ka a ŋme n-ku Midiannim kaman ninvuɣ yino n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Gideon, the Lord answered, you can rescue Israel because I am going to help you! Defeating the Midianites will be as easy as beating up one man.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Yinima n-tum birigi chaŋ ti kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim taali galisi.
en: Ezra the priest stood up and spoke to them. He said, You have been faithless and have brought guilt on Israel by marrying foreign women.

dag: Naawuni shia n-nam ma, ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ti ma nyɛvili.
en: God's spirit made me and gave me life.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti lan yɛli Hiburunim maa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba bɛn yuya daa booni Shifira mini Pua.
en: There were two Hebrew nurses who helped the Israelite women give birth. They were named Shiphrah and Puah. The king of Egypt said to the nurses.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat ni tum shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka teei Nɔadia ŋun nyɛ anab paɣ la mini anab shɛb bɛn zaa pahi m-bɔri ni bɛ kpɛhi ma dabiɛm la gba yɛla.
en: I prayed, God, remember what Tobiah and Sanballat have done and punish them. Remember that woman Noadiah and all the other prophets who tried to frighten me.

dag: Ka shɛb yi mali naŋgbankpeeni, bɛ kanimina ka n ti woligiri li tiri ba, ka wuhiri ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When two people have a dispute, they come to me, and I decide which one of them is right, and I tell them God's commands and laws.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi ti ba pin shɛli noo ti gba ni daa niŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛda ka o ti ti la, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ma ka n ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni.
en: It is clear that God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ; who was I, then, to try to stop God.

dag: Ka Aduna zuliya ni bidibiga kam ni tooi di li kaman di ni zali shɛm yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka binshɛɣukam din shihi li ni niŋ kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: For all time to come any of the male descendants of Aaron may eat it as their continuing share of the food offered to the Lord . Anyone else who touches a food offering will be harmed by the power of its holiness.

dag: A mini Damaskusnim daa niŋdi daabiligu a nɛma pam min a daazichi ni daa galisi la zuɣu, dina n-nyɛ: Hɛlibɔn wain mini gumdi.
en: The people of Damascus bought your merchandise and your products, paying for them with wine from Helbon and wool from Sahar. They traded wrought iron and spices for your goods.

dag: Ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei ti min o kum ni ni ti min o laɣim ʒin o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni.
en: In our union with Christ Jesus he raised us up with him to rule with him in the heavenly world.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim suhuri daa yiɣisi ka bɛ ŋmɛr o ni yɛli shɛm maa naŋgbankpeeni ka bɔhiri taba, Wula ka doo ŋɔ ni tooi zaŋ o niŋgbuŋ ti ti ka ti ŋubi.
en: They started arguing with each other and asked, How can he give us his flesh to eat.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zo o nambɔɣu. Amaa yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Dont feel sorry for him. He is guilty of killing an innocent person, and you must remove that guilt from Israel. Then everything will go well for you.

dag: Yuuni kam Ɛlikana daa yi yirila o ya n-chani Shilo ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka maani sara nimaani. Ɛli bihi ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Hofini ni Finɛhas la n-daa nyɛ Yawɛ maligumaaniba nimaani.
en: Every year this man would leave his town to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of heavenly forces in Shiloh, where Elis two sons Hophni and Phinehas were the LORDs priests.

dag: Bɛ lɔri ʒi tibisa din ʒibu to ʒiini niriba, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ bɛ nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: They tie onto people's backs loads that are heavy and hard to carry, yet they aren't willing even to lift a finger to help them carry those loads.

dag: A yi ti naai li, nyin lan dɔnim pahi buyi, amaa a nudirigu zuɣu ka a ti yɛn dɔni n-ʒi Judanim gba tibidarigibo. N zal a la biɛɣu pihinahi. Dabisili kam yɛn zanila yuuni zaani.
en: Then turn over and lie on your right side more days. That will be a sign of Judah's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering.

dag: Tiŋ maa gooni maa daa me n-tamla di gbinni kuɣa pinaayi zuɣu, ka Piɛbil la tuumba pinaayi la yuya sab pa kuɣa pinaayi maa zuɣu.
en: The city's wall was built on twelve foundation stones, on which were written the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

dag: Di nahindiya pakoya mini kpibisi ni tinzunnim bɛn be yi ni zaŋ tabili nandaamba. Yi mi di lɔnya yi kpee zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. .
en: Dont oppress the widow, the orphan, the stranger, and the poor; dont plan evil against each other!.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yi Olivi Tihi Zoli maa zuɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm. Olivi Tihi Zoli maa mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: Then the apostles went back to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is about half a mile away from the city.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa wum yɛla ŋɔ zaa o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam.
en: When King David heard what had happened, he was furious.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka bɛ daa doli ka tiri bɛ suɣa doona, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu yiɣisiri chana. Bɛ daa dolila Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Musa zali ba zaligu shɛli n-tumdi Yawɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: They obeyed the Lord 's commands and went wherever he directed Moses.

dag: Dama bɛ kumdila pampam duri Luhit zoli, ka wum biɛrim mini nandahima kuhigu Hɔrɔnaim zolɔŋni.
en: On the way up to Luhith, there is uncontrollable weeping. On the way down to Horonaim, they hear sobs of anguish.

dag: Ka so mi beni, o ka suhupiɛlli, ka ti kpi ni suhugarigu.
en: Another dies in bitter spirit, never having tasted the good things.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa ka anabi kurili ŋun bol anab ŋuni maa labisina maa sanna.
en: As they were sitting at the table, the word of the Lord came to the old prophet.

dag: Yi tiŋ dunoli ti ku yo n-kpari yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa, dama tinzun nanim ni gari tooni n-zaŋ bɛ niriba ka bɛ ʒi bɛ daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: Your gates will always be open. They will not be closed, day or night. Nations and kings will bring their wealth to you.

dag: Ka n daa yiɣisi ni n yoog o ka o gari. N ni daa zaŋ n nuu gbaai bɛ ni gbaari binshɛli yoori dunoli ni n yooi, n nuhi daa puɣila mɛɛr zim, ka n nubihi daa tɔɣiri mɛɛr kom.
en: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ bin suma ti bɛn suhir o li?.
en: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.

dag: A ni zaŋ ti yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni na ni a ti ku ti yɔɣu ŋɔ ni la nyɛla yɛlibila, ka a ti lan bɔri ni a zaŋ amaŋ leei naa su ti?.
en: Isnt it enough that youve brought us up from a land full of milk and honey to kill us in the desert so that youd also dominate us?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mi a yuli zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋla a ni; ka a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi nyin Yawɛ.
en: Lord , those who know your name come to you for protection. And when they come, you do not leave them without help.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka anabi yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti gbib ba.
en: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa mi n-kpalim zani zaawuni hal ni asiba, ka sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui asiba saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi bee di daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya wuntan yini bee yuŋ yini, di yi ti kul vuui, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.
en: Sometimes the cloud would settle only overnight, and they would march when the cloud ascended in the morning. Whether it was day or night, they would march when the cloud ascended.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, Ilaisha, n suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɛriko. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Jɛriko.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, Please stay here, because the Lord told me to go to Jericho. But Elisha said, I promise, as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you! So the two men went to Jericho.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee bɔri nyɛvili, ka bɔri ni o mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli, n-di din viɛli nyaɣisim?.
en: Would you like to enjoy life? Do you want long life and happiness?.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ gbuɣinli ŋun nyɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ka bi zɔri so dabiɛm ŋɔ.
en: a lion, a warrior among beasts, which doesnt back down at anything.

dag: Ka Ribɛka tizɔdoo maa min o ma daa yɛli, Chɛ ka paɣisarili maa na kpalim be ti sani daba ayi kaman biɛɣu pia pahi ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: But Rebecca's brother and her mother said, Let her stay with us a week or ten days, and then she may go.

dag: Ka bɛn la mi bi yihiri Masia yɛla waazu ni tɛhi suma, amaa ka niŋdi li mi ni nyuli zabbu tɛha, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yi niŋdi lala di ni chɛ ka n wahaladibo maan pahi n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: the others preach Christ because of their selfish ambition. They are insincere, hoping to cause me more pain while Im in prison.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim ka Shunɛm na nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani; ka Sool gba daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ mi ti bɛ suɣa do Gilibɔa.
en: The Philistines went to Shunem and set up camp. Saul called the army of Israel together, and they set up their camp in Gilboa.

dag: ka ninvuɣ yino bee a niriba Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino yi ti baŋ din muɣis o o suhu ni, ka teeg o nuu tiri duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: Listen when anyone in Israel truly feels sorry and sincerely prays with arms lifted toward your temple.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: About this time some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses came from Jerusalem. They asked Jesus.

dag: amaa ka daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama sokam zaa zaɣa daa kul bela o wuhibu maa ni.
en: However, they couldnt find a way to do it because all the people were enthralled with what they heard.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo, yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim ka yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka a sabi yɛli gbaŋ maa puuni ni Babilɔn naa shiri ni kana ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri di ni? .
en: Also tell King Jehoiakim of Judah that this is what the Lord says: Jehoiakim, you burned that scroll. You said, Why did Jeremiah write that the king of Babylon will surely come and destroy this land and kill all the people and animals in it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A ba mi ni a yuri ma, ka tɛhi ni di bi simdi ni a baŋ di yɛla, dama a yi baŋ di yɛla, di ni saɣim a suhu pam. Amaa yɛlimaŋli, hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu ni nyin ŋumbɔŋɔ gba zuɣu, m mini kum kul chɛla tab kpe ni kpe.
en: Jonathan, I swear it's true! But your father knows how much you like me, and he didn't want to break your heart. That's why he didn't tell you. I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I'm only one step ahead of death.

dag: O ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee, dama bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa leei dabari tɔb biɛ shɛli din lu di ni la min o suhuyiɣisili pam la zuɣu.
en: The Lord has abandoned his people like a lion that leaves its cave. The horrors of war and the Lord 's fierce anger have turned the country into a desert.

dag: Keenan nir ŋun daa nyɛ Arad naa m-be Nɛgɛb ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim dolila Atarim polo kanna, ka o daa chaŋ ti ŋme ba tɔbu, ka gbahi bɛ shɛba ti leei daba.
en: When the Canaanite king of Arad in the southern part of Canaan heard that the Israelites were coming by way of Atharim, he attacked them and captured some of them.

dag: din ni gu a ka a ku bo paɣ yoli, ka yih a paɣ zinalan naŋgbam malisim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛli, Di ku niŋ lala. Nyin dee kul deemila Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni zaŋ yɛr a ŋɔ, ka di niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani, ka bɛ ku ku a.
en: That wont happen, Jeremiah replied, if you obey the LORD, whose message I bring. You will survive, and all will go well for you.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋgbani ti dam pam hal ka duu maa gbinni ti sɔhira, ka sarika duu maa dunoya zaa dii yooi, ka sokam bandi baai.
en: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: But the one who endures to the end will be delivered.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ʒini yi sani. Guliya ti ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ti maa ku paai ti. Ŋun nahindi ti maa yi ti lan kani, saɣiŋgu maa ni zani tariga; ka ninvuɣ kuriba maa gba ku lan be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Let us stay in your land. Protect us from those who want to destroy us. Oppression and destruction will end, and those who are devastating the country will be gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bi simdi ni ti gbihiri kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti ne n-ʒiya ka gbibi ti maŋa.
en: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.

dag: Wummiya zoya zuɣu vuri, salo vuri n-nyɛ li. Wummiya nama balibu mini zuliya balibu niriba tab laɣimbu vuri. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-laɣindi tɔbbihi ni o tuhi tɔbu.
en: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa karim yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam din daa be zaligu kundi la ni. O daa karim alibarika mini noli yɛlibu yɛla kaman di zaa ni daa sabi zaligu kundi maa ni shɛm.
en: Afterward, Joshua read aloud all the words of the Instruction, both blessing and curse, in agreement with everything written in the Instruction scroll.

dag: A ni ti kurigi zaa ka naanyi dɔn a gballi ni kaman bɛ ni yi chɛ siŋkaafa ti sɔŋ siŋkaafabɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: You will come to your grave in old age as bundles of grain stacked up at harvesttime.

dag: Luk kɔŋko n-kul kpalim be n sani. Zaŋm Maak m-pah amaŋ zuɣu kana, dama o nyɛla ŋun tooi sɔŋdi ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark, and bring him with you. He has been a big help to me in the ministry.

dag: Di saha ka Sool lan yɛli ba, Vihimiya m mini m bia Jɔnatan sunsuuni nya.! Ka di daa gbaala Jɔnatan.
en: Then Saul said, Decide between my son Jonathan and me. And Jonathan was indicated.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔŋ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni kpɛbu sagbani maa ni daa sirigina ti pil li maa mini Yawɛ jilima ni daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣu.
en: Because of this, Moses could not go into the Tent.

dag: dama bɛ zaa daa nya o ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam. Ka o dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! Mani m-bala.
en: Seeing him was terrifying to all of them. Just then he spoke to them, Be encouraged! Its me. Dont be afraid.

dag: Ka Nahɔr daa nyɛ Sɛrug bia ka Sɛrug nyɛ Riu bia, ka Riu nyɛ Pɛlɛg bia, ka Pɛlɛg nyɛ Ɛba bia, ka Ɛba mi nyɛ Shɛla bia.
en: son of Serug son of Reu son of Peleg son of Eber son of Shelah.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Judanim ku tooi zabi bɛmaŋ zuɣu. Dindali maa, yi daa chaŋla tibɔŋ ni bidibbina duu la ni nti yihi bidibbina.
en: All of Judah's defenses crumbled. When that happened, you brought weapons out of the arsenal.

dag: Ka ŋun vo bua la tahi Azazɛl sani la, di simdi ka o paɣ o nɛma ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: The man who drove the goat into the desert to Azazel must wash his clothes and take a bath before he comes back into camp.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpambaliba nini daa tiɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The king and his officials approved this plan.

dag: Ka zuliya gari la zaa mini Uzi tiŋgbɔŋ ni nanim zaa ni Filistia nanim zaa bɛn be Ashikɛlɔn mini Gaza ni Ɛkurɔn ni Ashidɔd bɛn kpalim la.
en: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.

dag: Amaa o yi yiɣisi ni o guui, o larila wɔribara min o wɔhu.
en: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse.

dag: Atɛnsinim mini saamba bɛn daa be nimaani daa bi tumdi tuun shɛli pahila yɛtɔɣ pala tɔɣisibu mini yɛl pala wumbu zuɣu.
en: For all the citizens of Athens and the foreigners who lived there liked to spend all their time telling and hearing the latest new thing.

dag: Ka o gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni, ka takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi yir o nol ni na, ka o ninni ne kaman wuntaŋ ni yi neei ni o kpiɔŋ zaa shɛm la.
en: He held seven stars in his right hand, and from his mouth came a sharp, two-edged sword. His appearance was like the sun shining with all its power.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi be di ni maa ni.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land where you will live, which I am giving you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gɔb, ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Saf ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni nir la.
en: Some time later, another battle with the Philistines took place at Gob. Then Sibbecai from Hushah killed Saph, a descendant of the Raphah.

dag: Ka tia maa daa kul zoori n-niŋdi zaɣ titali hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: The tree grew large and strong. The top of the tree touched the sky. It could be seen from anywhere on earth.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Jɛhɔzabad, o mi daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinu bɛn daa gbibi bidibbina m-mali shili gu tɔbu.
en: His second in command was Jehozabad with , men, well-equipped for battle.

dag: Ka yi mi yi suhi li, yi bi nyari li, dama yi tɛha bi tuhi lala niŋbu ni; yi suhirila binshɛŋa yi ni yɛn zaŋ tum yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim tuma.
en: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛri pampam, Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku ŋɔ simdi ni o mali yiko mini azichi ni yɛm ni kpiɔŋ, ka nya tibiginsim mini jilima ni alibarika.
en: and sang in a loud voice: The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, wealth, wisdom, and strength, honor, glory, and praise.

dag: ni Jɛuz ni Sakia ni Mirima. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ o bidibisi ka daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba.
en: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of households.

dag: Maligumaaniba kɔŋko puri ka Yisifu daa bi da. Dama Firawuna daa tirila maligumaaniba maa laɣidira, dina ka bɛ daa mali dira, dinzuɣu ka bɛn daa bi kɔhi bɛ puri maa.
en: The only land Joseph didnt buy was the land that the priests owned. The priests didnt need to sell their land because Pharaoh paid them for their work. So they used this money to buy food to eat.

dag: amaa bɛnkam daa deeg o ka niŋ o yuli yɛda, bɛna ka o niŋ yiko ni bɛ leei Naawuni bidɔɣirisi.
en: Yet some people accepted him and put their faith in him. So he gave them the right to be the children of God.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli daa maan du pam chaŋ haliya, ka salo pam daa laɣimna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛtɔɣa, ka nya bɛ dɔriti tib kpaŋ.
en: But the news about Jesus spread all the more widely, and crowds of people came to hear him and be healed from their diseases.

dag: Dinzuɣu sum kom n-niŋ tulaale niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ a situr suma so n-chaŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli yeeni o chi maa. Amaa di chɛ ka o baŋ ni a be nimaani hal ka o ti di ka nyu n-naai.
en: Now take a bath and put on some perfume, then dress in your best clothes. Go where he is working, but don't let him see you until he has finished eating and drinking.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, amaa bɛ ku wum a yɛligu. A ni boli ba, amaa bɛ ku garig a.
en: Jeremiah, you will tell these things to the people of Judah. But they will not listen to you. You call to them, but they will not answer you.

dag: Di nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana, ka bɔ ka a lee ni tooi niŋ? Di nyɛla din zilim gari kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka bɔ ka yɛn tooi baŋ?.
en: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little.

dag: Di saha ka Pita mini Jɔn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti yɛl a, A ku wuhi ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni.
en: And when your people ask you what this means.

dag: Yɛm mini kpiɔŋ zaa bela Naawuni sani, ŋuna m-mali ninkurilim mini baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: But wisdom and power belong to God. Good advice and understanding are his.

dag: ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din viɛl la ni bi bɔra. Amaa Naawuni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ tuɣi taba, ka pahiri yaɣ shɛŋa din pooi viɛlim la jilima pam.
en: The parts of our body that are presentable dont need this. But God has put the body together, giving greater honor to the part with less honor.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣu ŋmanila wahu lɔɣu. Bɛ ŋaritila bɛ tiba kaman sapaɣu ŋun ŋar o tiba.
en: Their venom is like a snakes venom— like a deaf cobras—one that shuts its ears.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli ma ni n doli ba chaŋ ka di chɛ ka n suhu zɔhira. Ka m mabih ayɔbu ŋɔ gba daa doli ma chaŋ, ka ti daa mali ti kpe doo maa yiŋa.
en: The Spirit told me to go with them even though they were Gentiles. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered that mans house.

dag: Ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ kuriti mali binyila ka yɛli, Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Binyila ŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe Sirianim ŋɔ hal ti naai bɛ balibu. .
en: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out.

dag: Jɛfita ni daa ti labiri kuni yiŋ na Mizipa, o bipuɣiŋga n-daa daŋ o soli tuhibu na n-gbib chaɣisa chaɣisiri ka wari waa. O kɔŋko mi n-daa kul nyɛ o bia. O daa lan ka bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga pah o zuɣu.
en: When Jephthah went back home to Mizpah, there was his daughter coming out to meet him, dancing and playing the tambourine. She was his only child.

dag: A ni ku bɛ zuliya bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yihi bɛ bihi ninsalinim ni.
en: You will destroy their offspring from the land; destroy their descendants from the human race.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M bindirigu nyɛla n tum ŋun tim ma na yubu, ka naag o tuma.
en: Jesus said to them, I am fed by doing the will of the one who sent me and by completing his work.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihir shɛli Yisa ni daa wuhi pahi buyi, o ni daa yi Judia ka Galili na la.
en: This was the second miraculous sign Jesus did while going from Judea to Galilee.

dag: Ifriim zuliya tintariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Rubin zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Ephraim from the eastern border to the western border: Reuben, one portion.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mali yurilim maŋli sahakam zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani, ka chɛ ka o wuntitali yiri zahira bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi sani ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But the LORDs faithful love is from forever ago to forever from now for those who honor him. And Gods righteousness reaches to the grandchildren.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka wuntizɔriba zaa suh a bɛ muɣisigu saha, ka kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ ku paai ba.
en: That is why your loyal followers pray to you while there is still time. Then when trouble rises like a flood, it will not reach them.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim maa daa yiɣis asibaasi, ka wuntaŋ nyeei kpe kom maa, ka bɛ nya ka di do bɛ tooni ha m-mɔhi kaman ʒim la.
en: They got up early in the morning as the suns rays shone on the water. The Moabites saw the water from a distance. It looked as red as blood.

dag: Dama hal mmaŋmaŋ ni kul ka yi sani maa zaa yoli, n suhu din be yi sani, ka m mali suhupiɛlli yi biɛrisuŋ mini yi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi ni niŋ Masia yɛda shɛm la polo.
en: For even though I am absent in body, yet I am with you in spirit, and I am glad as I see the resolute firmness with which you stand together in your faith in Christ.

dag: N daa tum tuun maŋli shihira wuhibu tuma yi sani ni suɣilo dibu zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: shihira wuhibu mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni yiko tuma.
en: The many miracles and wonders that prove that I am an apostle were performed among you with much patience.

dag: yin di wumya anabinim maa bee bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni maa yɛtɔɣa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zahindi ya maa ni o nya yi shiri yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhu zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: you must not listen to that prophets or dream interpreters words, because the LORD your God is testing you to see if you love the LORD your God with all your mind and all your being.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila, dama n kanimina ni n ti be yi sani.
en: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Zion, because I am about to come and dwell among you, says the LORD.

dag: Ka n daa na kul suhiri Naawuni, ka kahigiri m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka balindi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni o chɛ ka o Jɛmbu du kasi la lan me n-zali yaha.
en: I was praying to the Lord my God about his holy mountain and telling about my sins and the sins of the people of Israel.

dag: Balinte a ti yɛli ni a bi nyar o; amaa yɛla maa kpalimla o sani, kul guhim o.
en: Although you say that you dont see him, the case is before him; so wait anxiously for him.

dag: O daa nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim; o daa nyo yil titali kam buɣim.
en: and he burned down the Lord 's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.

dag: N niriba bɔhiri dari binyara ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi wuhiri ba binyara din ti yɛn niŋ. Dama zina niŋbu n-vo ba kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka bɛ chɛ Naawuni ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.

dag: Ka n daa labisi n garigibu zilinkom ti o ha yɛli: A ni yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli pa yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-kul ʒini tɛhi n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I sent him this reply: Nothing that you say has happened. You are simply inventing this.

dag: Do so daa be Jɛrusalɛm ka o yuli booni Simiɔn; o daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ ka zɔri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa be o ni, ka o daa yuuni Izraɛlnim Tiligira kandina soli.
en: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti neei bɛ nina, ka gbilisi bɛ tiba wum niriba yɛlimuɣisira.
en: Then people would actually see what they look at. They would actually listen to what they hear.

dag: Ka salo bɛn be o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: The crowds walking in front of Jesus and those walking behind began to shout, Praise to David's Son! God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord! Praise be to God.

dag: Parɔsh daŋ — tusaayi ni kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: The family of Parosh .

dag: Ka shi so daa gari n ninni baalim, ka n niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri yirigi.
en: A light breeze touched my face, and my skin crawled with fright.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: A voice from heaven said, You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.

dag: Salima kpahi tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram giram kɔbisinu ni pisopɔin ni biɛla. Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa di zuɣusaa duri la dukpina zaa zuɣu.
en: The gold nails weighed / pounds. He covered the upper rooms with gold.

dag: Ka Dauda daa je suli Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu; ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: David got angry with God for killing Uzzah. He named that place Bursting Out Against Uzzah, and that's what it's still called.

dag: Naawuni, n suhu kul ʒiɛla yim. N ni yili yila ni kukoli viɛlli. N shia, neema!.
en: God, I am ready, heart and soul, to sing songs of praise. Wake up, my soul!.

dag: Yawɛ, zahimmi ma, ka buɣisi ma nya; buɣisim n suhu mini n tɛha.
en: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.

dag: Naa Jɔsia daa nyɛla na so ŋun ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani ni o suhu zaa ni o shia zaa ni o kpiɔŋ zaa kaman Musa zaligu puuni ni sab wuhi shɛm zaa. Ka na so daa ka na shɛb bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn zaa daa dol o nyaaŋa puuni m-be ka o ni be shɛm.
en: Theres never been a king like Josiah, whether before or after him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, all his being, and all his strength, in agreement with everything in the Instruction from Moses.

dag: Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ a sɔŋda ŋɔ n-naɣi ni ti kpe di ni. Kpaŋsim o, dama ŋuna n-yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim deei li su.
en: But your helper, Joshua son of Nun, will go into the land. Encourage Joshua, because he will lead the Israelites to take the land for their own.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya paɣ maa ka yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai.
en: When Jesus turned and saw her, he said, Be encouraged, daughter. Your faith has healed you. And the woman was healed from that time on.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ti ku lan beni, ka sagbana ti kpabikpabi kaman sɔŋ la; ka saŋmarisi ti luna kaman wain tia vari la bee kaman fiig tia wala ni suuri luri shɛm la.
en: The skies will be rolled shut like a scroll, and the stars will die and fall like leaves from a vine or a fig tree. All the stars in the sky will rot away.

dag: N daa zaŋ salima min anzinfa dih a paɣisarilim. Ka a mali tan viɛlli liiga mini tan nyɛlisirili chinchina ni bɛ ni wuɣi chinchin shɛli. A bindirigu daa nyɛla zim viɛla mini shiri ni kpam, ka a daa niŋ viɛlim pam, ka simdi ni a niŋ napaɣa.
en: You were beautiful in your gold and silver jewelry, and your linen, silk, and embroidered material. You ate the best foods. You were very, very beautiful, and you became the queen!.

dag: Amaa maligumaana yi zaŋ o liɣiri da dabili ka o leeg o ni su so, dabili maa ni tooi di li; ka bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb o yiŋ gba ni tooi di o bindirigu maa.
en: But if a priest purchases a servant, that person can eat it, and servants born into the priests household can also eat his food.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣiri bihi maa buɣira, ka zaŋd o nuhi pari bɛ zuɣu niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni.
en: Then Jesus took the children in his arms and blessed them by placing his hands on them.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa, wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani? Dama yi yɛri ni Biilzibul yiko ni ka n kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu m-mali biɛrisuŋ sara. Zua bia Nɛtanɛl sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel, Zuars son.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko nyɛla tɔbutuhiri baŋsim mini kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu? Bee ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka zaɣisi n noli maa?.
en: If you say, I trust in power and great battle plans, then that is useless. Now I ask you, who do you trust so much that you are willing to rebel against me?.

dag: Biɛrim shɛli din mali ba ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ŋmanila bi jɛrigu ŋun bi bɔri ni o yi o ma pul ni na.
en: His punishment will be like the pain of a woman giving birth. He will not be a wise son. The time will come for his birth, and he will not survive.

dag: Bɛ to tɛte di m binyɛrigu, ka piri n situra ti taba.
en: They divvy up my garments among themselves; they cast lots for my clothes.

dag: A mini Ɛdomnim daa niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni a nɛma din galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋdi tɛkɔisi mini binʒiɛhi ni bɛ ni wuɣi situr shɛŋa ni tampiɛl viɛla ni kɔral ni rubinim na ti taɣiri yi nɛma maa.
en: Edom traded emeralds, purple cloth, embroidery, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la ni ka di nyɛ kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali teeri Izraɛl bidibisi maa yɛla kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm.
en: They put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod to represent the twelve tribes of Israel, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: O ni daa niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni saha shɛli maa ka o daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni.
en: As he blessed them, he left them and was taken up to heaven.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a labi tiŋgban ni; palɔni ka n ti yɛn zaŋ a bahi, ka chɛ ka noonsi zaa kana ti lu a zuɣu, ka dunia zaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dari tɔh a ŋubi.
en: I will throw you into an open field, where birds and animals will come to feed on your flesh.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Zɛrɛd vinvamli ni.
en: Then they camped in Zered Valley.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N wum Mɔabnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla, ka wum Ammɔnnim turi yɛla. Bɛ maani n niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara ni bɛ ni fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be zilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Dont be like a stupid horse or mule that will not come to you unless you put a bit in its mouth and pull it with reins.

dag: Ka n lan zaŋ Dauda zuliya saafe ti o, ka o ti yooi, ka so ku tooi yo bee ka o ti yo, ka so ku tooi yooi.
en: I will put the key to Davids house around his neck. If he opens a door, no one will be able to close it. If he closes a door, no one will be able to open it.

dag: Nyini n-daa ŋme m-bɔri Lɛviatan zuɣuri ka zaŋ bɛ nimdi ti tiŋgban nɛli ni niriba.
en: Yes, you smashed the heads of Leviathan and left his body for animals to eat.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun doli yili maa dunoli yi, ka yo yili maa zali hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: he shall leave the house and lock it up for seven days.

dag: ka o puhirina m-be kaman aŋgo ŋun yi amiliya sampaa ni na bee kaman kpiɔŋlana ni yi yina n-zɔr o tia ni suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: it comes out in the morning like a happy bridegroom, like an athlete eager to run a race.

dag: A bi nya ka di nyɛla o yɛda niŋbu min o tuma tumbu n-daa laɣim tum lala maa? Ka o yɛda niŋbu daa niŋ dɛde la o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: So you see that Abrahams faith and what he did worked together. His faith was made perfect by what he did.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya wain pali wain duɣu kam. Bɛ ni bɔh a, A tɛhiya ni ti bi mi ni di simdi ni ti niŋ wain pali wain duɣu kam.
en: The Lord God said to me, Jeremiah, tell the people of Israel that every wine jar should be filled with wine. They will answer that they know every wine jar should be filled with wine.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Di lan yɛli yaha, Tumtumda kam simdi yɔri.
en: The scripture says, Dont put a muzzle on an ox while it treads grain , and Workers deserve their pay .

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o ba, Wɛi, n zuɣu n-yaara, n zuɣu n-yaara! Ka bia maa ba yɛl o tumtumdi so, Zaŋm bia maa kuli ti ti o ma.
en: Suddenly he shouted, My head hurts. It hurts a lot! Carry him back to his mother, the father said to his servant.

dag: Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A kɔŋko n-nyɛ n ni bɔri so dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Lord , I cry out to you for help: You are my place of safety. You are all I need in life.

dag: Zaŋmi salima mali bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di yaɣa anahi maa gbaya anahi la.
en: Then make four gold rings and put them on the four corners of the table, where the four legs are.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dol o chana. Ka salo daa muɣ o sani kabiri dol o.
en: Jesus went with Jairus. Many people followed along and kept crowding around.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi Amasa, M mabia, a mal alaafee? Ka daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Amasa teeŋa n-niŋ kaman o yɛn mɔɣisila o kpariŋ la.
en: Joab said to Amasa, How are you, my friend? and took hold of his beard with his right hand in order to kiss him.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, who by God's will is an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy—.

dag: Bɛ ni wuh a, ka yɛl a bɛ ni mi shɛlikam zaa.
en: Maybe the old people can tell you something. Maybe they will teach you what they learned.

dag: Pɛrɛz zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɛrɛz n-daa dɔɣi Hɛzirɔn, ka Hɛzirɔn dɔɣi Ram.
en: This is the family history of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba yuri o ni tim o Bi so na maa, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The Father loves the Son and has given him power over everything.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ shi so niŋ o ni, ka di chɛ ka o wum ŋumaŋuma yɛla ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. .
en: Im about to put a spirit in him, so when he hears a rumor, hell go back to his own country. Then Ill have him cut down by the sword in his own land.

dag: ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa ti ni tɛhiri ni di buchi bi yaɣ lala la nyɛla ti ni lihiri shɛŋa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din bi viɛl la, dina ka ti lee niŋdi din tu kamaata shɛli.
en: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts.

dag: O daa jɛm Naawuni Zakaria ŋun daa wuh o Naawuni jɛmbu sol la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa jɛmdi Yawɛ saha shɛli maa zaa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: As long as Zechariah, his religious adviser, was living, he served the Lord faithfully, and God blessed him.

dag: Naawuni ni deei binshɛlikam zaa ti ba sani maa nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini; dinzuɣu Naawuni ni yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm li.
en: All of the wealth God took from our father belongs to us and our children. Now, do everything God told you to do.

dag: Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ yino. Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: So they are no longer two, but one. No human being must separate, then, what God has joined together.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku shɛb tɔb ni la daa so kum ni daa ku shɛba la. Bɛ daa mɔŋ ba puri ni bindirigu, ka kum ʒi ba chaŋ.
en: Being killed with a sword is better than slowly starving to death.

dag: luɣ shɛli zunzuya ni bi kpira, ka buɣim mi bi kpiri ni.
en: There the worms that eat them never die, and the fire that burns them is never put out.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Biɛɣuni. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Di ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka yi baŋ ni Naawuni so lan kani ŋ-ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The king answered, Pray for me tomorrow. Moses said, I will do as you ask, and then you will know that there is no other god like the Lord , our God.

dag: O daa yɛli Gaad zuliya: Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛligi Gaad tiŋgbani ŋɔ mali alibarika. Gaad zuliya niriba ŋmanila gbuɣinli. O darigiri tɔhigiri bɔɣu, ka darigiri fuɣiri zuɣugbana.
en: Moses said this about Gad: Praise God who gave Gad more land! Gad is like a lion that lies down and waits. Then he attacks and tears the animal in pieces.

dag: Kaman anzinfa ni nyɛligiri binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara puuni shɛm la, lala ka yi ni ti nyɛligi di puuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu maa.
en: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted in it. You will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my rage on you.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di lan yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ polo yaha. M pun zali ni a mini Ziba pirigim tiŋgbani maa ti taba.
en: The king said to Mephibosheth, Dont say anything more about your problems. This is what I have decided: You and Ziba will divide the land.

dag: amaa ka bɛ zaŋ nyini bahila katiŋ kaman bimpɔŋ la ka chɛ a gballi; ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb pa a zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi kuɣa bɔɣili ni kaman niriba ni nɔri kpiin shɛb garita.
en: But you were thrown out of your grave like a branch cut from a tree and thrown away. You are like a dead man who fell in battle, trampled under the feet of other soldiers. Now you look like any other dead man wrapped in burial clothes.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ m-bɔhi.
en: Then Jesus told them this story:.

dag: Tiligim ma takɔb kum ni, fam n nyɛvili baa nuu ni bahi.
en: Deliver me from the sword. Deliver my life from the power of the dog.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna daa kul nyɛlisiri la ŋubi. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei.
en: The terrible-looking, scrawny cows devoured the seven healthy-looking, fattened cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.

dag: Miriya ka yi leei buɣijɛmdiba kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm la; dama di sabiya, Niriba daa ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka bembe nti yiɣisi diɛmda.
en: Dont worship idols as some of them did. As the Scriptures say, The people sat down to eat and drink and then got up to have a wild party.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi niriba ayi shɛba Juda naa ni tim n sanna ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be n sani ŋɔ, yi ni ti yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Firawuna tɔbbihi bɛn yina ni bɛ ti sɔŋ a ŋɔ ni labi kuli Ijipti bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: to say to Zedekiah, The Egyptian army is on its way to help you, but it will return home.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim kari ninvuɣ biɛri zibisim bahi, ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ bɔɣu shɛli duhi zuɣusaa kabi.
en: Evil people dont like the daylight. When it shines bright, it keeps them from doing the bad things they do.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a nam jaaŋgbee yi Ziɔn na, ka a di nam a dimnim sunsuuni.
en: May the LORD make your mighty scepter reach far from Zion! Rule over your enemies!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paɣ o chɛchɛbuŋ maa sɔŋ miri Samaria biaŋ, ka bahi daa kana ti lɛl o ʒim; ka pagɔra gba kana nti su di kom kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: His chariot was cleaned up at the pool of Samaria, where dogs licked up his blood and prostitutes washed themselves, as the Lord had said would happen.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jɔshɛbashɛbɛt Tachɛmɔn nira ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la naa, ŋun daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisinii zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa tɔb tuhibu yim puuni la.
en: These are the names of David's warriors: Ishbosheth the son of Hachmon was the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle, he killed men with his spear.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn nyɛ azichilaannim la, kummiya ka fabilimiya nandahima din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu.
en: Pay attention, you wealthy people! Weep and moan over the miseries coming upon you.

dag: Amaa man sani, di viɛli ni n vu m-miri Naawuni. N zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ leei n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n zaŋ a tuma zaa yɛla moli gili!.
en: As for me, all I need is to be close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my place of safety. And, God, I will tell about all that you have done.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa mini daŋ kam ni kpamba Jɛrusalɛm na ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la Dauda tiŋ din nyɛ Ziɔn la ni na.
en: Then Solomon assembled Israels elders, all the tribal leaders, and the clan chieftains of Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the chest containing the LORDs covenant from Zion, Davids City.

dag: maligumaaniba deemi li bɛn zaŋdi li tahirina maa sani m-mal li maani Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛŋa din bɔri malibu la.
en: Each priest was to be responsible for the money brought by those he served, and the money was to be used to repair the Temple, as needed.

dag: Ŋunkam lo nia ni o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni bol o barinatumda.
en: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.

dag: amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda hal ti kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Nyama, hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm bi paai di pirigili gba. A yɛm min a tɔŋbu yɛla gari n ni wum di yɛla shɛm.
en: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are wiser and richer than I was told.

dag: Naa, ka n daa ti deei yiko maligumaaniba kpamba sani m-be soli chani Damaskus;.
en: King Agrippa, one day I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and permission of the chief priests.

dag: Malimiya pipih anahi din ŋmani alimɔnd pum ka mali bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: In addition, on the lampstand itself there will be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with its flower and petals.

dag: Ka o daa kuli n-daa ti chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti moli Yisa ni daa tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla zaa gili; ka di daa niŋ sokam zaa alahiziba.
en: The man went away into the region near the ten cities known as Decapolis and began telling everyone how much Jesus had done for him. Everyone who heard what had happened was amazed.

dag: Yisa ni pun chaŋ ti kpe ti zuɣu la, dama o daa leei maligumaani titali ŋun tuma be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Jesus has already entered there and opened the way for us. He has become the high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.

dag: O tiri biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka tiri kahiŋko bihi bindira bɛ yi ti kuhira.
en: He gives animals their food and feeds the young ravens when they call.

dag: Pa Zallakudura Naa n-zaani zaɣ viɛlli mini zaɣ biɛɣu ka di niŋda?.
en: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya la mi, kalim ba kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Lord told Moses to take a census of the Levite clan of Merari by subclans and families.

dag: ka Mɛshulam daa nyɛ Ɛzra daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Jɛhɔhanan daa nyɛ Amaria daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Ezras family was Meshullam. The leader of Amariahs family was Jehohanan.

dag: Yi nini yi nya tayiɣ kam, yi laɣir o la zɔri, ka lan chɛ ka yi mini zinaniŋdiba be.
en: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣ min o bia leeg o paɣiba di nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka di simdi ka bɛ nyo doo maa min o paɣiba maa buɣim din ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ku lan be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tuumba maa mini yɛdaniŋdib bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa wum ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.

dag: Ifriimnim bela muɣisigu ni, ka diri wahala saria karibu ni, bɛ ni lo ni bɛ dolila binshɛŋa din ka buchi zuɣu.
en: Ephraim is under pressure from its enemies; Ephraims rights arent protected. This is because Ephraim chose to pursue worthless things.

dag: Di ti ku ŋmani n ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Yi Duuma lan yɛli, Bɛ daa bi gbibi alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo ba la, dinzuɣu ka m mi baɣa daa ka bɛ ni.
en: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirig o o zaɣim, ka fa o bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku o. Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka o leei paɣiba ni maani so ansarisi.
en: They raped her. They took her children and killed her. They punished her, and women still talk about her.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia ka di ti chɛ biɛla ni o kpi, ka o daa suhu Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu maa, ka wuh o shihirili.
en: It was in those days that Hezekiah became very sick and near death. He prayed to the Lord , and he spoke to Hezekiah and gave him a sign.

dag: a ti ku mali suhugarigu a ni daa ku so ka di ka daliri zuɣu bee amaŋmaŋ ni daa bɔhi biɛri zuɣu. N dana, ka Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a sani, nyin di ti tam mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: So dont do anything that would make you guilty of killing innocent people. Please dont fall into that trap. Please remember me when the Lord blesses you.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr biɛri ni alahiziba dɔriti din ku naai lu yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: he will send on you and on your descendants incurable diseases and horrible epidemics that can never be stopped.

dag: O ni daa kul wuhi ti di gbinni shɛm, di daa ti shiri niŋla pali; a daa labisi ma n tuma ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la mi ti yili tia.
en: Things turned out just as he said: you restored me to my position, but you executed the baker.

dag: dindina yi ni tooi saɣim n ni daa lo n dabili Dauda alikauli shɛl la gba din ni chɛ ka o ku lan mali bidibiga ŋun ni ʒin o nam ʒiishee mini n ni daa lo n tumtumdiba Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la.
en: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣ o, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o. Molimiy o daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: Sing praises to the Lord ! Tell about his miracles.

dag: bɛ kul durila tab dari maa gbini, ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa ti dɔɣi bi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim.
en: When the flock mated in front of the branches, they gave birth to striped, speckled, and spotted young.

dag: Dama pa malaikanim yɛla m-muɣis o, amaa ti yab Ibrahimma yaansi yɛla m-muɣis o.
en: Of course, he isnt trying to help angels, but rather hes helping Abrahams descendants.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama yiɣi n ninni. Bɛ ni daa yiɣi maa, ka kalima maa doli ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: They spread their wings and flew up from the earth while I was watching, and the wheels went with them. They paused at the east gate of the Temple, and the dazzling light was over them.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa bi kari Keenannim bɛn be Gɛza, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: There were Canaanites living in Gezer. And the Ephraimites did not make all the Canaanites leave their land. So they continued to live in Gezer with the Ephraimites.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din lu dahim ŋɔ, yilimi suhupiɛlli yila! Dama Yawɛ tilig o tiŋa, ka maag o niriba suhuri.
en: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.

dag: Di saha maa man Daniɛl daa kul bela fabila ni zaŋ hal ti paai bakɔi muna ata.
en: During that time, I, Daniel, had been mourning for three weeks.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: Now, on the day when the dead rise to life, whose wife will she be? All seven of them had married her.

dag: Ka Musa daa chani nti paai luɣ shɛli gbe nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti bɔri ni o ku o.
en: At a camping place on the way to Egypt, the Lord met Moses and tried to kill him.

dag: Bɛ puhim chuɣu maa ka di di bindirigu mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaanahi dali.
en: They will keep it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They will eat the Passover lamb with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Di chɛ ka a bia maa min a dab paɣ maa yɛla muɣis a. Zara ni kul yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm o ni yɛl a shɛm maa, dama Yisahaku zuɣu ka a zuliya yɛn yɛligi.
en: But God said to Abraham, Dont worry about the boy and the slave woman. Do what Sarah wants. Your descendants will be those who come through Isaac.

dag: Zuliya kam wummi dimbɔŋɔ! Salinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Listen to this, all you people! Listen closely, all you citizens of the world.

dag: Ka yiliŋ kam ti ŋari, ka zoya mini daboya zaa ti nahi taba, ka luɣ shɛlikam din golim ti tuhi, ka soli kam din be gbirimagbirima ti niŋ polipoli.
en: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be made flat. Crooked roads will be made straight, and rough roads will be made smooth.

dag: Chɛ ka di biɛŋmarisi leei zibisim, ka chɛ ka di niŋ neesim tahima, amaa ka bi nya li. Di chɛ ka asiba neesim lan neei di ni.
en: May its evening stars stay dark; may it wait in vain for light; may it not see dawns gleam.

dag: Jɔn daa lan wuhi niriba maa yɛla pam pah o lahibal suŋ waazu maa puuni.
en: John said many other things like this to encourage the people to change, and he told them the Good News.

dag: O yɛliya, Maamiya yi ni ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun yuli du zuliya kam sani, ka nyɛ ŋun yuli du dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Thats enough! Now know that I am God! I am exalted among all nations; I am exalted throughout the world.

dag: Yawɛ shia ni ti siɣ o zuɣu na nti ti o yɛm mini baŋsim, ka ti o yiko mini saɣisigu ni baŋsim mini Naawuni zɔbo.
en: The Lord s Spirit will always be with that new king to give him wisdom, understanding, guidance, and power. The Spirit will help him know and respect the Lord .

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan bindoo maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.

dag: Bɛ kpiya ka ku lan be yaha. Bɛ shihi ku lan yiɣisi, dama a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi; so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: Now they are dead and will not live again; their ghosts will not rise, for you have punished them and destroyed them. No one remembers them any more.

dag: Anabi shɛb bɛn daa daŋ m min a tooni na kurimbuni ha la daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri tɔbu tuhibu mini kum ni alɔbo yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndiri tiŋgbɔna mini nam shɛŋa din niriba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbaai bɛ naa ka o guui, ka o kpamba gba ti zaŋ bɛ tuutanim bahi ka guui dabiɛm zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun buɣim diri Ziɔn, ka o sara maligu buɣim shee be Jɛrusalɛm la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their emperor will run away in terror, and the officers will be so frightened that they will abandon their battle flags. The Lord has spoken—the Lord who is worshiped in Jerusalem and whose fire burns there for sacrifices.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N suhu zaa kul yɛmi ni m mini ya laɣim di Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ bindirigu ka n naanyi di wahala.
en: Jesus said to them, I wanted very much to eat this Passover meal with you before I die.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ŋmaai palo shɛli din dolisi luɣ kasi yaɣili la ti Izraɛlnima ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntiŋa. Di wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili. Di ni ti nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni su shɛli.
en: And you will give the city an area that is cubits wide and , cubits long. It will be along the side of the holy area. It will be for all the family of Israel.

dag: O daa saɣim bɛ wain tihi mini bɛ fiig tihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa kab lu.
en: He destroyed their vines and fig trees. He destroyed every tree in their country.

dag: Ka fiig tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wal viɛla din nyaɣisi la wolibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the fig tree answered, In order to govern you, I would have to stop producing my good sweet fruit.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa daa tirila bɛ suɣa Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: The Gershonite family groups were told to camp in the west. They made their camp behind the Holy Tent.

dag: O daa piila kuɣa pinaayi n-saɣisi Yaakubu so Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, A yuli n-nyɛ Izraɛl la bidibisi kalinli.
en: Elijah found twelve stones. There was one stone for each of the twelve tribes. These twelve tribes were named for the twelve sons of Jacob, the man who the Lord had named Israel.

dag: M mabia Failimɔn, n yi ti suhiri Naawuni tir a, n kul paɣir o mi sahakam.
en: Brother Philemon, every time I pray, I mention you and give thanks to my God.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli; Aai, di simdi ni n da li kaman di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, dama n ku zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli n-nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka Dauda daa da kabɔɣili maa mini naɣikɔra maa anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: But David answered, No! I have to pay you what they're worth. I can't offer the Lord my God a sacrifice that cost me nothing. So David bought the threshing place and the oxen for pieces of silver.

dag: Ŋuna ka dunɔgula yoori dunoli tira; ka o boon o piɛri maa yuya ka be bɛ tooni, ka piɛri maa wumd o boligu ka dol o.
en: The man who guards the gate opens the gate for the shepherd. And the sheep listen to the voice of the shepherd. He calls his own sheep, using their names, and he leads them out.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka kom maa daa nyuui tiŋgban ni, ka Nuhu daa piligi binshɛli din pili ŋariŋ maa, ka lihi nya ka tiŋgbani ŋme pɔhim.
en: Noah was now years old. And by the first day of that year, almost all the water had gone away. Noah made an opening in the roof of the boat and saw that the ground was getting dry.

dag: Bɛ daa wɔbirila giŋgaɣiri mini tuturi vari ni sɔɣu jila ŋ-ŋubira.
en: They pull up salt plants in the desert and eat the roots from the broom tree.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunoli daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu mini daanya sara maligu bimbini ni di daanya kurupooti la ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma.
en: He used it to make the bases for the meeting tents entrance, the copper altar, its copper grate, and all the altars equipment.

dag: Kamiyana, chɛliya ka ti teei dɔni ti puya zuɣu n-jɛm o; chɛliya ka ti gbani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti namda ŋɔ tooni!.
en: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!.

dag: Bɛ mali yiko din ni tooi chɛ ka saa ku mi bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu maa saha, ka mali yiko din ni tooi chɛ ka koma lɛbigi ʒim, ka ni tooi chɛ ka alɔbo balibu kam lu dunia ni kaman bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.

dag: Di bi simdi ka dabindi be yi yinsi daba ayopɔin maa ni. Ka ŋunkam di binshɛli din mali dabindi, dilan ni yi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu ni, dilan yi nyɛla sana bee tiŋbia.
en: For seven days no yeast must be found in your houses, for if anyone, native-born or foreign, eats bread made with yeast, he shall no longer be considered one of my people.

dag: ka a ni tooi zaŋ li zali di tuma shee ka mi so shɛŋa din kuni di yiŋa?.
en: Can you show them how far to go, or send them back again?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni!.
en: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!.

dag: ka a daa wum n ni fabindi niŋd a maa. Di ŋar a tiba ka bi wum n ni kuhiri niŋd a ni a sɔŋ ma ŋɔ.
en: You heard my voice. You didnt close your ears. You didnt refuse to rescue me.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kambɔna pali bindira balibu kam. Chɛ ka ti biŋkɔbbaligu bɛn be mɔɣu ni la nabi n-niŋ tuhilituhili ni tuhi piapia.
en: May our barns be filled with crops of every kind. May the sheep in our fields bear young by the tens of thousands.

dag: Timmi bɛ ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa chaŋ maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Shɛmaya ŋun nyɛ Nɛhilam nir la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Shɛmaya ni tɔɣisi ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-chɛ ka yi niŋ ʒiri yɛda ka di pala mani n-tim o na la zuɣu.
en: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord , have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.

dag: N daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri n ni daa tim shɛb yi sanna la ni?.
en: I havent taken advantage of you through any of the people I sent to you, have I?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim kul nyɛla din wuhiri bindira mini binnyura ni Yɛhudianim adiini kaya balibu kam din nyɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zaligunim din yɛn beni hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti lan yɛn taɣi mali binshɛlikam zal la.
en: since they have to do only with food, drink, and various purification ceremonies. These are all outward rules, which apply only until the time when God will establish the new order.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila di yubu polo, ka a wumdi di damli, amaa ka bi mi di ni yiri shɛli polo na bee di ni kpari shɛli polo; lala mi ka Naawuni Shia ni dɔɣ sokam be.
en: The wind blows wherever it wishes; you hear the sound it makes, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. It is like that with everyone who is born of the Spirit.

dag: ka daa ti yi Matana maa chaŋ Nahaliɛl n-daa ti lan yiɣisi Nahaliɛl maa chaŋ Bamɔt.
en: then at Nahaliel, and then at Bamoth.

dag: Cham ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puri ni n-saɣim li, amaa di saɣim di zaa. Ŋmahimi di wula zaa bahi, dama di pala man Yawɛ ni su shɛli.
en: I will tell their enemies, Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.

dag: Di saha ka Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la daa zaŋ bɛ tulaale zim tuɣindi bina m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ buɣim din bi be kasi mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di pa o ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: Aaron's sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his fire pan, put live coals in it, added incense, and presented it to the Lord . But this fire was not holy, because the Lord had not commanded them to present it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Rubin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Bɛza mini Jahaz.
en: From the territory of Reuben they received four cities: Bezer, Jahaz.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Ahitɔfɛl gba pahila Absalom zuɣu. Ka Dauda yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛn wuhi yikombiɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa leei jɛrilim.
en: Someone told David, Ahithophel is one who joined in Absaloms plot against you. Then David prayed, Lord , I ask you to make Ahithophel give only foolish advice.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur, Shedeurs son.

dag: Ka Liya dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: Then Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

dag: Yi yi ti lo noli n-nahim yimaŋa, lala nolɔbo ka n zali? Di nyɛla yi silim yi zuɣuri tiŋa kaman gbiŋgbama la, ka pili buri n-teei do tampiligim ni? Dina ka yi booni nolɔbo? Yi tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ni saɣi deei di dabisili maa?.
en: When you fast, you make yourselves suffer; you bow your heads low like a blade of grass and spread out sackcloth and ashes to lie on. Is that what you call fasting? Do you think I will be pleased with that?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, m bela yi polo, ka ni ŋmaligi kpa yi polo na, ka yi ko m-biri.
en: Look, Im here for you, and I will turn toward you, and you will be farmed and sown.

dag: Yi yi chɛ o dolibu, o ni lan chɛ niriba ŋɔ bahi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka yinima n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: If you stop following the Lord, he will make Israel stay even longer in the desert. Then you will destroy all these people.

dag: Yawɛ, a yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam. Di nyɛla din kul ba n-ʒe alizanda ni sahakam.
en: Our Lord , you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali yi mabihi ansarisi bɛ nandahima dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali suhupiɛlli Judanim zuɣu bɛ kpimsibu dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi nyu bara n-niŋ ba bɛ wahala dibu dabisili dali.
en: You should not have laughed at your brothers trouble. You should not have been happy when they destroyed Judah. You should not have bragged at the time of their trouble.

dag: Yi ni daa sab gban shɛli ti ma zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa la polo yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Doo yi bi kpuɣ paɣa, di viɛla.
en: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, Is it best for people not to marry.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb zaa ka va anzinfa mini salim shɛŋa la pahi di zuɣu ti Yawɛ.
en: King David dedicated them for use in worship, along with the silver and gold he took from the nations he had conquered—.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a dɔni a kabiri ni ni suhudoo, ka n chɛ ka a paag a yaannim tooni pɔi. A nini ku nya n ni ti yɛn chɛ ka zaɣibiɛ shɛli zaa lu Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba zuɣu maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ labi ti yɛli naa.
en: I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will go to your grave in peace. You wont experience the disaster I am about to bring on this place and its citizens. When they reported Huldahs words to the king.

dag: Gɔhi mini zana m-be ninvuɣ biɛri sol zuɣu; yɛnnim bɛn ni laligi ka chɛ li.
en: If you love your life, stay away from the traps that catch the wicked along the way.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa zaŋ Musa paɣ min o bidibis ayi maa n-ka o sanna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa be Naawuni zoli maa gbini luɣ shɛli maa.
en: So Jethro went to Moses while Moses was camped in the desert near the mountain of God. Moses wife and his two sons were with Jethro.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a zaŋsim be mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ ni, ka wum n kuhigu mini n suhigu shɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Lord my God, I am your servant. Listen to my prayer, and grant the requests I make to you today.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi dimnim kana ka yi ti jɛmdi ba, ka kum mini kɔnyuri mali ya, ka gbinfini gba mali ya, ka yi kɔŋ binshɛlikam. O ni ti zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua din nyɛ kurugu pa yi nyiŋgoya zuɣu hal ti kun ya.
en: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.

dag: A shihira chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni katinsi lur a la sizuura, a ni wuhiri shihira shɛŋa zuɣu. A chɛ ka biɛɣ neebu mini yuŋ zibbu yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: People all around the world are amazed at the wonderful things you do. You make all people, east and west, sing with joy.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli ba, Nyama, n zaŋ binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni zaa ka mali biɛlim mini tia kam din wala mali kpila n-tin ya ni yi dira;.
en: God said, I am giving you all the grain bearing plants and all the fruit trees. These trees make fruit with seeds in it. This grain and fruit will be your food.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa zaŋ ti mɔɣilɔnim yili tihi.
en: We hung our harps nearby, there on the willow trees.

dag: Samarianim naa ni ti bahi yoli kaman tipɔɣu din pa kom zuɣu la.
en: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, N ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni n ti karila saria ka di chɛ ka bɛn bi nyari nya, ka bɛn nyari mi leei zoomba.
en: Jesus said, I came into this world so that the world could be judged. I came so that people who are blind could see. And I came so that people who think they see would become blind.

dag: Bɛ muɣisigu maa saha, bɛ ni ti nya sɔŋsim biɛla, hal ka niriba pam ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali bɛ ni la yɔhiŋgu zuɣu.
en: When they fall, they will receive a little help, but many will join them with deceitful plans.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku piɛguliba mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku pukpariba mini bɛ naɣikɔra. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku gomnanim mini bɛ wulaannima.
en: shepherds and their flocks, farmers and their oxen, and governors and leaders.

dag: M biyurigu, n suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka shɛlikam be viɛnyɛla a sani, ka a lan mal alaafee a niŋgbuŋ ni gba kaman n ni mi ni a shia mal alaafee shɛm.
en: My dear friend, I pray that everything may go well with you and that you may be in good health—as I know you are well in spirit.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ biɛri ka yɛlibiɛri paara? Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri n-nyari ashaara?.
en: Isnt it disaster for the wicked, destruction for workers of iniquity?.

dag: Di simdi ni a ti kɔrigiri naɣilaa dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara. Di lan simdi ka a maani alahichi kpihimbu sara maligu bimbini maa kasitali zuɣu; ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi.
en: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.

dag: Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka di nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli n ni ku lan tooi du, dama kom maa daa pahimi, di ziliŋ daa saɣiya ni nira duɣi li, di daa nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli nira ni ku tooi siɣi gari.
en: When he measured off another fifteen hundred feet, it had become a river that I couldnt cross. The water was high, deep enough for swimming but too high to cross.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o ŋmaligi yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ti zo Lazarɔs gbihirimi, amaa n chanimi ni n ti neeg o o gom maa ni.
en: Then Jesus said, Our friend Lazarus is now sleeping, but I am going there to wake him.

dag: Miri ka a doli niriba maa ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa maa, a mi di zɔri bɛ ni zɔri shɛli dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: Do not join in the schemes of the people and do not be afraid of the things that they fear.
