dag: Ka a lan zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn nya Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam la ni pin shɛŋa niriba maa mini maligumaaniba ni ti ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni di zaŋ tum bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la tuma gba mali chaŋ.
en: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.

dag: M puhiri Mariama ŋun tum tuma pam yi ni la.
en: Greetings to Mary, who has worked so hard for you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nɛmi kaman wuntaŋa ka be kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la. Ŋuna n-niŋdi ti nirilim ka chɛ ka niriba tiri ti jilima. Yawɛ bi mɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi binsuma.
en: The LORD is a sun and shield; God is favor and glory. The LORD gives—doesnt withhold!—good things to those who walk with integrity.

dag: Di saha maa o bikpɛm sani la ŋun daa na bela puu polo nti kun na miri yiŋ na wum diɛma biŋkumda kumsi.
en: The older son had been out in the field. But when he came near the house, he heard the music and dancing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa bo chɛchɛbuŋ mini yuri ka zaŋ ninvuɣ pihinu bah o tooni.
en: After this, Absalom got a chariot and horses for himself. He had men run in front of him while he drove the chariot.

dag: O lan yɛli ni a lɔri nia ni a chɛ ka anabinim moli gili Jɛrusalɛm puuni zaŋ chaŋ a polo n-yɛri ni a nyɛla Juda naa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Pɛriʒia naa. Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni a chirigim ma ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla maa.
en: and that you have arranged for some prophets to proclaim in Jerusalem that you are the king of Judah. His Majesty is certain to hear about this, so I suggest that you and I meet to talk the situation over.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn pun kpi la ni ti neei kum ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka shɛb mi ti di vi din ka bahigu.
en: Many of those who sleep in the dusty land will wake up—some to eternal life, others to shame and eternal disgrace.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni chɛ ka yi tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ n sani, dama yi yi ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, di ni leei tɔna gbahi ya.
en: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri pam, ka darigi bɛ tibili ni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga. N yi bɔhi ba biɛri, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will act against them with great vengeance and with wrathful punishments. When I execute my vengeance against them, they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli maai n suhu.
en: Listen carefully to my remarks and let that comfort you.

dag: Bihi bɛn nyɛ jɛra tirila bɛ banim suhugarigu, ka tiri bɛ ma ŋun dɔɣi ba biɛrim.
en: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.

dag: Hal o nini ni bi nya wuntaŋa, ka o mi ʒi shɛli maa, o so ŋun pun beni maa.
en: It hasnt seen the sun or experienced anything. But it has more peace than those.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa kpi yuun shɛli ka n daa nya n Duuma ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee din du pam ka mali jilima; ka o binyɛrigu pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaa.
en: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord. He was sitting on his throne, high and exalted, and his robe filled the whole Temple.

dag: Naa Ahaz muɣisigu ŋɔ ni daa ti kɔŋ tim saha shɛli o daa maan kpɛla din bie nti yaɣi tumbu ni zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani.
en: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yinim Judanim zaa mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Wummiya; Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di zɔriya dabiɛm, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri salo pam zuɣu, dama tɔb maa pala yi dini, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni dini.
en: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!.

dag: Dabisili din pahi pinaayi dali, Inan bia Ahira ŋun daa nyɛ Naftali zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the twelfth day Naphtalis Chief Ahira, Enans son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti zali Naa Dauda ni daa ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni, ka daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara ti Naawuni.
en: They took the Covenant Box to the tent which David had prepared for it and put it inside. Then they offered sacrifices and fellowship offerings to God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni vihi bo m piɛri, n shiri ni bo bɛ shee.
en: The LORD God proclaims: I myself will search for my flock and seek them out.

dag: ni Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Baharum nir la ni Ɛliaba ŋun daa nyɛ Shaalibɔn nir la.
en: Azmaveth the Baharumite; Eliahba the Shaalbonite;.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Taitus suhu ye yi sɔŋbu zuɣu kaman ti gba la.
en: How we thank God for making Titus as eager as we are to help you!.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi tuun suma, ka di wuhi bɛn kpalim la din simdi niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛli binshɛɣukam puuni. Mali biɛri suŋ mini maŋgbibbu a wuhibu puuni.
en: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ ninsal maa niŋ Idɛn puu maa ni ni o kɔr li, ka yuuni li.
en: The Lord God put the man in the Garden of Eden to take care of it and to look after it.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim lala, dama yi tuumbiɛri galisiya pam. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛkaali, bɛ ni ti ku Izraɛlnim naa.
en: And this will happen to you at Bethel, because you did so many evil things. When that day begins, the king of Israel will be fully destroyed.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni ka tur o zuɣu chɛ ka o daa pihipihi o binyɛrigu taŋkpaɣu bahi ka yɛli ba, Yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya bahi yoli taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu! Man nuu yiya. Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni chaŋla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.

dag: Di kul tuɣituɣila taba kirikiri, ka so ku tooi woligi li.
en: The shields are joined to each other. They hold together so tightly that they cannot be pulled apart.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛra, Tiliginsim yila ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni mini Piɛbil ŋɔ sanna.
en: They called out in a loud voice: Salvation comes from our God, who sits on the throne, and from the Lamb.

dag: Kuɣili tibisa, ka bihigu tibisa, amaa jɛrigu ni tahiri suhuyiɣisili shɛl na tibisi gari di zaa.
en: A stone is heavy and sand weighs much, but the nuisance of fools is heavier than both.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have those who are poor with you. But you will not always have me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chani Jɛriko nti sirigiri zolɔŋni ka ŋmɛnditoya lir o soli maa ni m-pirig o, ka bu o hal ka o ti tarigi, ka bɛ fa o nɛma zo ka chɛ o.
en: Jesus replied, A man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho. He encountered thieves, who stripped him naked, beat him up, and left him near death.

dag: M maŋmaŋ ni bo shɛhiradiriba ayi shɛb n ni dihi tabili. Bɛna n-nyɛ maligumaana Yuria mini Zakaria ŋun nyɛ Jɛbɛrikia bia la.
en: I found some men who could be trusted to serve as witnesses: Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah. They watched me write those words.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: O daa yi ti chɛ ka bɛ kpira, bɛ ŋmaligirimi lab o sani ti niŋ tuuba, ka jɛmd o ni nimmoo.
en: Whenever he killed some of them, the rest would turn to him; they would repent and pray earnestly to him.

dag: Bɛ niriba anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn yi Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ zaa.
en: All four of these men were giants from Gath. They were killed by David and his men.

dag: Gbahim ŋɔri mini bɛ bihi bɛn saɣindi ti wain tihi puri la. Dama ti wain tihi maa daari pum.
en: Catch foxes for us— those little foxes that spoil vineyards, now that our vineyards are in bloom!.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa yiɣisi labi Balak sani ti yɛl o, Balaam zaɣisiya ni o ku dol ti kana.
en: So the leaders of Moab went back to Balak and told him this. They said, Balaam refused to come with us.

dag: Daadam, paɣiba ayi n-daa beni, bɛ daa nyɛla paɣ yino bihi.
en: Human one, there were two women, daughters of one woman.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ; kulimi ni suhudoo, a yipa kpaŋya zaa.
en: He said to her, Dear woman, you are made well because you believed. Go in peace. You will not suffer anymore.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zal o daa ka di dol o ni viɛl shɛm bee o ni bi viɛl shɛm. Kaman ŋun maligumaana ni zal o daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: The priest will assign it a value, whether high or low. Its value will be what the priest says.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun cham ti nya, ka dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu n-lu yili maa ni maa, yili maa nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: the priest will come and say, This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.

dag: ka bɛ ʒin ya chaŋ kaman wurigu la pɔi ka Yawɛ suhu naanyi yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya tab saawara ka laɣimmiya pɔi ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali dabisili la naanyi paai ya.
en: before you are driven away like chaff blown by the wind, before the burning anger of the Lord comes upon you, before the day when he shows his fury.

dag: N ni yuri shɛba, bɛna ka n saɣisiri ka darigiri bɛ tiba; dinzuɣu moomiya yi nini niŋ tuuba.
en: I correct and punish the people I love. So show that nothing is more important to you than living right. Change your hearts and lives.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kal ti pahi niɣi ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a lihi ti jɛra?.
en: Why are we considered beasts, ignorant in your sight?.

dag: A chɛ ka n nini kɔŋ pɔbbu, ka di muɣisi ma pam hal ka n ti kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: He keeps me awake all night; I am so worried that I cannot speak.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bidibis ata daa be nimaani, bɛna n-nyɛ Jɔab mini Abishai ni Asahɛl. Asahɛl daa guurimi kaman molifu la.
en: Now Zeruiahs three sons were present at the battle: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as fast as a gazelle in an open field.

dag: Ka n ni ti be yi sani, ka ku lan zaɣisi ya.
en: I will live among you in my sacred Tent, and I will never turn away from you.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Smɛɛna Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu ka nyɛ ŋun daa kpi ka lan nee la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: Here is a message from the one who is the First and the Last, the one who died and came to life again.

dag: Chɛ ka zuɣusaanim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka dunianim mali suhupiɛlli. Yɛlimiya zuliya kam ni, Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa.
en: Let heaven celebrate! Let the earth rejoice! Let the nations say, The LORD rules.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn tumdi din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But they have all turned away; they are all equally bad. Not one of them does what is right, not a single one.

dag: Ka naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa nini daa tiɣi o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naa maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Mɛmukan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The king and his officials liked this idea, and the king did what Memucan suggested.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni;.
en: But God raised him up from death!.

dag: ka tinim bɛn mali nyɛviya be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ mini ba ti laɣim chaŋ ti kpe sagban ni n-tuhi ti Duuma soli sagbani maa ni; ka ti ni ti kpalim be ti Duuma maa sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then, we who are living and still around will be taken up together with them in the clouds to meet with the Lord in the air. That way we will always be with the Lord.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, N ni gbaai m buzɔŋ ni bubil polli ti a. Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, Ka bimbɔ ka a yɛn zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira hal ka a ti zaŋ bua maa ti ma na.
en: Judah answered, I will send you a young goat from my flock. She answered, I agree to that. But first you must give me something to keep until you send me the goat.

dag: Ti mi ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri Naawuni ka nyɛ o ni daŋ pii shɛb o nia lɔbu ni la sani, ŋun Naawuni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋdila bɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: We know that in all things God works for good with those who love him, those whom he has called according to his purpose.

dag: Ka Manaasa bia Jair daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei tiŋkpan shɛŋa, ka bol li Havɔtijairi.
en: Manassehs son Jair went and captured their villages and named them Havvoth-jair.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba ayi shɛba o ni daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai Jɛriko la, Chamiya pagɔrili la yiŋa nti yih o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ na kaman yi ni daa pun po ni yi ni niŋ shɛm la.
en: Joshua talked to the two spies. He said, You made a promise to the prostitute. So go to her house and bring her out and all those who are with her.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ma maa ŋun chaŋ, ka a gbahi zaɣ bihi maa kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: You may take the young birds, but you must let the mother bird go, so that you will live a long and prosperous life.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa lan nya alahiziba shihir titali alizanda ni. Malaikanima ayopɔin n-daa mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din kpalim nyaaŋa, dina n-daa nyɛ Naawuni suhuyiɣisili alɔbɔnim din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: Then I saw another great and awe-inspiring sign in heaven. There were seven angels with seven plagues—and these are the last, for with them Gods anger is brought to an end.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili mini tɔŋsim ni kum mini ashaara n-zali yi tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Look here! Today Ive set before you life and whats good versus death and whats wrong.

dag: Juda min o mabihi maa ni daa paai Yisifu yiŋa, o daa na be yiŋa, ka bɛ daa damd o tooni.
en: When Judah and his brothers went back to Josephs house, Joseph was still there. The brothers fell to the ground and bowed down before him.

dag: Ka Barakɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Buz daŋ ni nir la bia Ɛlihu maa daa garigi yɛli, Man nyɛla bia, ka yi mi nyɛ ninkura, dinzuɣu ka n di zɔri dabiɛm ka shini, ka bi yɛli ya din be n suhu ni maa.
en: So heres what Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said: I am only a young man, and you are all older. That is why I was afraid to tell you what I think.

dag: Yawɛ n-nam tibili din wumda mini nini din nyari ŋɔ zaa.
en: It was the Lord who gave us eyes for seeing and ears for hearing.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani, dama ti mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam ka di dol o yubu, o deeri ti suhigu.
en: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.

dag: O yɛliya, Maamiya yi ni ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun yuli du zuliya kam sani, ka nyɛ ŋun yuli du dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Stop fighting, he says, and know that I am God, supreme among the nations, supreme over the world.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a tiligira la yɛliya, N suhu n-daa yiɣisi pam saha biɛla puuni, ka n chɛ a bahi. Amaa n yurilim din bi naari la zuɣu, n ni zo a nambɔɣu.
en: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord , make this promise.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi chuɣu yila yilibu mal alibarika. Yawɛ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tooni neesim ni mal alibarika.
en: Lord , your loyal followers are happy. They live in the light of your kindness.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever curses his father or his mother is to be put to death.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa ti tim tuumba ashilɔni nti yɛli Izraɛl zuliya zaa, Yi yi ti kul wum kikaa kumsi yin yɛlimiya, Absalom leei naa Hiburɔn.
en: But he also sent spies to all the tribes of Israel. They told the people, When you hear the trumpet, say, Absalom is king in Hebron.

dag: Ti Duuma ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka a zom, ka di ni niŋ daba ayi ka a ku lan nya wuntaŋa. Ka paɣili mini zibisim dii kana ti to o, ka o go m-bɔhindi gindi bɔri so ni o vo o.
en: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while. Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ zim viɛlli mali bɔrɔbɔro kpil pinaayi. Zaŋm zim kilɔgiram yini m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpilli kam.
en: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, Bɛ mal li kunila Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti me di duu zali nimaani. Bɛ yi ti me di duu maa naai, bɛ ni zaŋ piɛɣu maa zali di ni.
en: To Babylonia, he answered, where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.

dag: Mani n-yi di nyɛ niriba ŋɔ toondana, n naan kpimsi Abimilɛk birili zaa. N naan yɛl o, Bom tɔbbihi pam pahi kana. .
en: I wish I were leading this people! I would get rid of Abimelech! I would tell him, Reinforce your army, come on out and fight.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baal mini Ashitarɔt din nyɛ Sirianim mini Sidɔnnim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim buɣa la, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka chɛ o jɛmbu.
en: Before long, the Israelites began disobeying the Lord by worshiping Baal, Astarte, and gods from Syria, Sidon, Moab, Ammon, and Philistia.

dag: Naawuni zaŋd o kukoli din nyɛ satahiŋga ŋɔ tumdi alahiziba tuma; o tumdi tuun kara din gari ti yɛm.
en: Gods thundering voice is amazing! He does great things that we cannot understand.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi Filistia doo maa zuɣu maa n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, amaa ka daa lee zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma ti niŋ ŋun Dauda maŋmaŋ suɣili ni.
en: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put the Philistines weapons in his own tent.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate answered, But what crime has he done? Nail him to a cross! they yelled even louder.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpiri nyo wurigu mi.
en: The shovel he uses to sift the wheat from the husks is in his hands. He will clean out his threshing area and bring the wheat into his barn. But he will burn the husks with a fire that cant be put out.

dag: N yi tumdi li la mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina n simdi yɔri yɔbu; amaa di yi pala mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm m-bala.
en: If I do this voluntarily, I get rewarded for it. But if Im forced to do it, then Ive been charged with a responsibility.

dag: Ka n garigi yɛl o, N dana, m bi mi. Wuhim ma! Ka o yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla bɛn yi wahala titali dibu ni na ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ Piɛbil la ʒim paɣ shɛb binyɛra ka di paligi zaa la.
en: Sir, I answered, you must know. Then he told me: These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.

dag: Ka a yihi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi din be piɛɣu puuni n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la zaɣ kpil yini mini maha din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini.
en: From the basket of bread which has been offered to me, take one loaf of each kind: one loaf made with olive oil and one made without it and one thin cake.

dag: nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Nyama, n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim tɛha, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni puuni so ku ŋman a, ka so mi ti ku yiɣis a kalinsi nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman a.
en: So I'll make you wiser than anyone who has ever lived or ever will live.

dag: Ka Zara daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Ibrahimma o ninkurilim ni, saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o la.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Abraham when he was old, at the very time God had told him.

dag: Dama daba ayɔbu ka man Yawɛ daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, ka daa vuhi daba ayopɔin dali. Lala zuɣu man Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili kasi.
en: In six days I, the Lord , made the earth, the sky, the seas, and everything in them, but on the seventh day I rested. That is why I, the Lord , blessed the Sabbath and made it holy.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayi ni ka niriba pam daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.

dag: Di saha zuliya kam ni ti booni ya la suhupiɛllinima, dama nyaɣisim ni ti be yi tiŋgban ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Wuhim ti ŋahili la gbinni.
en: Peter spoke up, Explain this saying to us.

dag: Ka pako so daa be tiŋ maa ni n-kul ʒe n-kan o sanna waawaayili nti yɛr o, Karimi ti saria ŋɔ ti ma nasara, ka chɛ n dim ŋɔ.
en: In that same town there was a woman whose husband had died. She came many times to this judge and said, There is a man who is doing bad things to me. Give me my rights.

dag: Amaa a yi birigi n-chɛ ka do so zaŋ a dɔni, ka a ta amaŋ daɣiri a ni be a yidan fukumsi ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: But if you have sinned against your husband—if you had sexual relations with a man who is not your husband—then you are not pure.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Wula ka yinim bɛn bi bɔri jilima Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani, amaa ka bɔri jilima la yi tab sani ŋɔ lee yɛn tooi niŋ yɛda?.
en: You like to have praise from each other. But you never try to get the praise that comes from the only God. So how can you believe?.

dag: Baa ni yi gbuɣi, ka lan labi ti dir li shɛm la, lala ka jɛrigu labir o jɛrilim tuma ni.
en: A fool doing some stupid thing a second time is like a dog going back to its vomit.

dag: Di nyuriya dam kuuna, dama di nyubu puuni ka ninvuɣ yotali yirina, amaa lee chɛliya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pali yi suhuri ni.
en: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.

dag: Ka di lan nyɛla kom din daa nyɛ kokpɛɣu la ka Naawuni daa zaŋ saɣim tuuli dunia la.
en: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.

dag: ka naanyi di bindirigu n-lan nya kpiɔŋ. Ka Sool daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Damaskus sani n-niŋ daba ayi;.
en: After eating, he regained his strength. He stayed with the disciples in Damascus for several days.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o.
en: As for the family of Ahab, whoever dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and whoever dies in the fields will be eaten by birds.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ daadamnim sariakarita. Yawɛ, karim ma saria ka di doli n wuntitali mini n galimi kalinsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You are the judge of all people. Judge in my favor, O Lord ; you know that I am innocent.

dag: So yi niŋ lala, o yi ti yi daɣiri maa ni, bɛn zalim o daba ayopɔin.
en: If a priest touches a dead body, he is unclean and must go through a ceremony to make himself clean. Then seven days later.

dag: Bɛna bɛn zaa nyɛ n niriba maa, mani n-daa nam ba n jilima zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛba.
en: They are my own people, and I created them to bring me glory.

dag: Yawɛ nambɔzɔbo min o nirilim galisiya. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm mini maligumaaniba daa wum lala ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ bi mi yɛlli maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: When the chief priests and the officer in charge of the Temple guards heard this, they wondered what had happened to the apostles.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far away from me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti be o ni ka o gba be ti ni. Dina n-nyɛ: O ni zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Shia ti ti la zuɣu.
en: We know that we live in God and God lives in us. We know this because he gave us his Spirit.

dag: Yaakubu daa zo n-kuli Mɛsopoteemia, nimaani ka o daa tum tuma paɣ zuɣu; o daa gulila biŋkɔbiri ni di yo o paɣ kpuɣibu samli.
en: Our ancestor Jacob had to flee to Mesopotamia, where, in order to get a wife, he worked for another man and took care of his sheep.

dag: Yuuni kam Ɛlikana daa yi yirila o ya n-chani Shilo ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka maani sara nimaani. Ɛli bihi ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Hofini ni Finɛhas la n-daa nyɛ Yawɛ maligumaaniba nimaani.
en: Once a year Elkanah traveled from his hometown to Shiloh, where he worshiped the Lord All-Powerful and offered sacrifices. Eli was the Lord 's priest there, and his two sons Hophni and Phinehas served with him as priests.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zuɣu. Chɛliya ka dunia zaa baŋ di yɛla.
en: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni nya suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli maa paai ma la n sɔŋsim zuɣu. A tiligi n nyɛvili barina kam ni; ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli foliŋga maa Zuɣusaa. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayi.
en: God named the dome Sky. There was evening and there was morning: the second day.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni nini daa ti bi tiɣi bɛ zaa; kulla bɛ ni biɛla kɔŋko ka o nini daa tiɣi, ka daa chɛ ka bɛn kpalim la zaa bahi yoli mɔɣu ni luɣ kɔŋkɔba shee.
en: But even then God was not pleased with most of them, and so their dead bodies were scattered over the desert.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anii puuni ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Bɛrɛkia bia Anabi Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la yɛli.
en: Zechariah son of Berekiah received a message from the Lord . This was in the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king in Persia. This is that message:.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbir anahi daa yi teeku maa ni na, bɛ zaa mi daa bela kɔŋkɔba.
en: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.

dag: Ka o daa leei ŋun be naa sani gbib o. Paɣisarili maa daa viɛli pam; amaa naa daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali.
en: She was very beautiful. She cared for the king and served him, but the king didnt have sex with her.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi yɔɣili maa zuɣu? Ka Jona garigi yɛli, Di simdi ni n suhu yiɣisi, hal ka m bi zaɣisi ni n kpi gba.
en: But God said to him, What right do you have to be angry about the plant? Jonah replied, I have every right to be angry—angry enough to die.

dag: Teemiya kurimbuni ha yɛla. Tɛhimiya yuun gbaliŋ din gari la yɛla. Bɔhimiya yi ba, o ni wuhi ya, ka bɔhi yi dɔɣirikpamba, bɛ ni yɛli ya.
en: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Bɛtani Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ kɔŋlan la yiŋa.
en: Jesus was in the town of Bethany, eating at the home of Simon, who had leprosy.

dag: Timiya ni yi suhu zaa, ka yi yi yɛn niŋ li yin di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma mini yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: So be sure to give to the poor. Dont hesitate to give to them, because the Lord your God will bless you for doing this good thing. He will bless you in all your work and in everything you do.

dag: Ka di yi yɛligi o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu.
en: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, You are unclean because you have a disease.

dag: Bɛ mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni biŋgbamda balibu kam ni noonsi balibu kam ni binyiɣira zaa n-daa kpe di ni.
en: They and every kind of animal—every kind of livestock, every kind that crawls on the ground, every kind of bird.

dag: Ka aŋgo zo maa vooi ko shɛli din leei wain maa ka bi baŋ di ni yi shɛli na, amaa yili maa ni bihi bɛn daa tooi kom maa bɛn daa mi. Ka o daa boli aŋgo na.
en: Then the man in charge tasted it, but the water had become wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants who brought the water knew. He called the bridegroom.

dag: ni binnamda maa maŋmaŋ ti yi poobu dabitim ni kpe Naawuni ni zaŋ yolisim shɛli din mali jilima n-ti o bihi la ni.
en: that the creation itself will be set free from slavery to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of Gods children.

dag: Yurilim saha beni, ka jɛlinsi saha beni. Tɔbu tuhibu saha beni, ka tɔbu tuhibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: He sets the time for love and the time for hate, the time for war and the time for peace.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ o Bia maa zali zaashe tital ni gari malaikanima kaman o ni daa ti o yuli din gari bɛ yuya shɛm la.
en: The Son was made greater than the angels, just as the name that God gave him is greater than theirs.

dag: N lan bɔri ni paɣiba gba zaŋdi situra din veeni ba ka ku mali galimi ka nyɛ din simdi m-maani bɛmaŋa, ka pa ni zuɣuri pambu mini salima ni waya yɛri yɛbu ni binyara din mali shaara zaŋ niŋ bɛmaŋa;.
en: I also want the women to be modest and sensible about their clothes and to dress properly; not with fancy hair styles or with gold ornaments or pearls or expensive dresses.

dag: Amaa o suhu yi na kul yumi ni o niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka m bi kana ti yɛl a ka a zo n-tiligi ni alaafee, Yawɛ ŋun niŋmi mani Jɔnatan zaɣ biɛɣu n-gari m ba ni yɛn niŋ a shɛm maa, Yawɛ ni be a sani kaman o ni be m ba sani shɛm la.
en: But if my father intends to harm you, then may the LORD deal harshly with me, Jonathan, and worse still if I dont tell you right away so that you can escape safely. May the LORD be with you as he once was with my father.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia tuma min a tiliginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa hal n ni ku tooi baŋ di kalinli maa zaa yoli.
en: My mouth will repeat your righteous acts and your saving deeds all day long. I dont even know how many of those there are!.

dag: Yihim daɣiri din be anzinfa ni, ka machɛli zaŋ li mali duɣu.
en: Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel will come out for the refiner.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu ni tɛha bi kpɛma yi nya nyin ŋun mali baŋsim ŋɔ ka a ʒi buɣili maligu shee diri bindirigu, di ku kpaŋsi dilan maa suhu ka o di bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa?.
en: You understand that its all right to eat anything, so you can eat even in an idols temple. But someone who has doubts might see you eating there, and this might encourage them to eat meat sacrificed to idols too. But they really think it is wrong.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim maa sansan ni nti ku ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu, ka biɛɣu daa neei ka kpiimba kul yɛrigi luɣilikam.
en: The LORDs messenger went out and struck down one hundred eighty-five thousand soldiers in the Assyrian camp. When people got up the next morning, there were dead bodies everywhere.

dag: Di sabiya yaha, Ŋunkam yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ.
en: It was said, Whoever divorces his wife must give her a divorce certificate.

dag: dama pa yinima nti yɛn tɔɣisi, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni Shia n-yɛn be yi ni tɔɣisira.
en: You arent doing the talking, but the Spirit of my Father is doing the talking through you.

dag: O daa lan lab me Naa Hiram ni daa zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa ti o la, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani.
en: Then Solomon rebuilt the towns that Hiram gave him and then moved Israelites into those towns to live there.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa kuli Nabal sani nti nya ka o puhirila chuɣu o yiŋa, ka di ŋmanila naa m-puhiri chuɣu. Ka ŋun Nabal daa kul mali suhupiɛlli, dama o daa nyula dam buɣi. Ka o paɣ maa daa bi yɛl o shɛli dindali maa hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: When Abigail got back home to Nabal, he was throwing a party fit for a king in his house. Nabal was in a great mood and very drunk, so Abigail didnt tell him anything until daybreak.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa kuli nti yɛl o taba Hanania mini Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Daniel returned home and told his three friends.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛl o, A yuli ku lan booni Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ni boonila Izraɛl, dama a mini Naawuni ni ninsalinim vaya ka a di nasara.
en: The man said, Your name will no longer be Jacob. You have struggled with God and with men, and you have won; so your name will be Israel.

dag: N nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti gbaai kom, ka maligim kul luri n wula zuɣu yuŋ zaa.
en: my roots opening to water, dew lingering on my branches.

dag: Joɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɛmaya mini Gɔg ni Shimɛi.
en: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.

dag: Zaŋmiya binnɛma balibu kam bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa n-yina, ka bɛ ti dɔɣi pam nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Let out the birds, animals, and reptiles, so they can mate and live all over the earth.

dag: Miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmani bahi ka nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la, ka miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpaŋsiri niŋgbuŋ ŋmaabu yɛla la.
en: Watch out for the dogs. Watch out for people who do evil things. Watch out for those who insist on circumcision, which is really mutilation.

dag: N lola noli hal ka n duna ti gbarigi, ka n niŋgbuna ti kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa malaikanim ni daa tɔɣisi la kahigi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka ŋunkam daa bi dol li bee n-deei di noli yi daa nya tibidarigibo din simd o.
en: The teaching that God spoke through angels was shown to be true. And every time his people did something against that teaching, they were punished for what they did. They were punished when they did not obey that teaching.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi fiɛb o bupihinahi, amaa di bi simdi ni di gari lala. Bɛ yi fiɛb o gari lala dindina yi ʒiʒiinikpee maa ni nya filiŋ yi ninni.
en: He may be given as many as forty lashes, but no more; more than that would humiliate him publicly.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na n-zɔri chani tiŋgban nɛli zuɣu kaman mɔɣili la.
en: God opened the rock and out gushed water— flowing like a river through the desert!.

dag: Chamiya ti du zoya zuɣu ŋ-ŋma dari na ti me n jɛmbu duu maa; ka n suhu paligi di zuɣu, ka lan nya jilima di ni.
en: Go up to the mountains, get the wood, and build the Temple. Then I will be pleased with the Temple, and I will be honored. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Gbaamiya saawara, amaa di ku ku buchi. Tɔɣisimiya gbaai yi ni lo shɛm, amaa di ku zani, dama Naawuni be ti sani.
en: Make your plans for the fight. Your plans will be defeated. Give orders to your armies, but your orders will be useless, because God is with us!.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa chaŋ yaɣimɛra maa yiŋa ka o ti bela yaɣiri mɛbu ni.
en: So I went there and saw the potter working at his wheel.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn be n sani n wahala dibu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: You men have stayed with me through many struggles.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman ti yil o ni daa sa gar da shɛŋa ni o zaŋ M.
en: So Haman was hanged on the gallows that he had built for Mordecai. Then the king's anger cooled down.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba daa yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni n-chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ kana ti muɣisir a maa.
en: Sauls servants said to him, Look, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri. O nyɛla ŋun zaŋ ʒiri ni o tum faranim barina, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka nandaamba kɔŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o suli min o sujee ni o suhuyiɣisili ni nandahima paai ba, ka di ŋmanila malaika bɔbili bɛn kuri niriba.
en: He caused them great distress by pouring out his anger and fierce rage, which came as messengers of death.

dag: Ka o nina maa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chani ka paɣiri Naawuni. Salo maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ gba daa gbaai Naawuni paɣibu.
en: At once the man could see, and he went with Jesus and started thanking God. When the crowds saw what happened, they praised God.

dag: Ɛdom yɛla ni ti mali dabiɛm. Ŋunkam ti gari nimaani dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka di gar o yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn niŋ nimaani la zuɣu.
en: The Lord said, The destruction that will come on Edom will be so terrible that everyone who passes by will be shocked and terrified.

dag: Dinzuɣu tintariga maa yɛn zaŋla teeku tariga hal ni Hazɛrɛnɔn din be Damaskus tintariga nuzaa polo, ka chɛ Hamat tintariga bahi nuzaa polo. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ nuzaa polo maa yaɣili.
en: So the northern border will run between the Mediterranean Sea and Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between Damascus and Hamath.

dag: Bɛ yi di nyɛla n saawaranima, dindina bɛ naan moli n yɛligu maa n niriba sani; bɛ naan yihi ba bɛ biɛriyoli ni, ka yihi ba bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: If they had known my secret thoughts, then they could have proclaimed my message to my people and could have made them give up the evil lives they live and the wicked things they do.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaam amaŋa ni bi pala kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-mali biɛr kasi mini yɛda ni yurilim ni suhudoo, ka di chɛ ka a pahi bɛn doli ti Duuma ka bɛ suhuri ka daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: Stay away from the evil things a young person like you typically wants to do. Do your best to live right and to have faith, love, and peace, together with others who trust in the Lord with pure hearts.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ man zaŋ a leela bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli, ka zaŋ a leei kurugu daantaliga mini daanya gooni n-jɛndi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa; ka lan zaŋ a jɛndi Juda nanim mini di kpamba ni di maligumaaniba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa.
en: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.

dag: ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Ibram ni!.
en: and said to Abram: I bless you in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bin yini ka m bɔri ni n suh a; a mi di mɔŋ ma li.
en: And now I have one request to make; please do not refuse me. What is it? Bathsheba asked.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni naai ma zaa, o ku m mini bɛn be zaa.
en: You have worn me out, God; you have let my family be killed.

dag: Bee nir ni tooi no buɣimsal nɛɔŋ ka di ku nyoog o napɔŋ?.
en: If a man walks on hot coals, dont his feet get burned?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Ka Sool daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: Samuel left Gilgal and went on his way. The rest of the people followed Saul as he went to join his soldiers. They went from Gilgal to Gibeah in the territory of Benjamin. Saul inspected his troops, about six hundred men.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni ka Pool ti kpaŋsiri yɛdaniŋdiba suhuri.
en: They traveled through Syria and Cilicia, encouraging the churches.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti zaŋm tumtumda chira anii yɔri chaŋ ti da bindirigu na ti ti ba.
en: He replied, You give them something to eat. But they said to him, Should we go off and buy bread worth almost eight months pay and give it to them to eat.

dag: Yi yi ti tuui ŋɔri yi bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli yin zaŋmiya di bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini ti pini kaman yi ni zaŋdi kabɔɣili ni chi tiri pini shɛm la.
en: You will present a gift offering from the first bread you bake just like you present a gift offering from the threshing floor.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Kiburɔtihataava, bɛ ni daa sɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiri kɔre pam nimaani la zuɣu.
en: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place Graves for the Greedy.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ti a dabili ŋɔ, tiligim a dab bipuɣiŋga bia ŋɔ.
en: Show that you hear me and be kind to me. I am your servant, so give me strength. I am your slave, as my mother was, so save me!.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima ka wolindi dira, di so ni a wuhi ni a nyɛla wɔɣirili ka kum kur a.
en: It is better to appear unimportant and have a servant than to pretend to be important and have no food.

dag: Hadɔram mini Uzal ni Dikila.
en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni piɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa zuɣu? Bɛ ni suhiri Naawuni sahakam?.
en: will they delight in the Almighty, call God at any time?.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li sɔɣi, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a bowl; instead, it is put on the lampstand, so that people may see the light as they come in.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ pini maa daŋ o tooni, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpalim gbe suɣa maa shee dindali maa yuŋ.
en: So Jacob sent the gifts to Esau, but he stayed that night in the camp.

dag: Amaa hal ni zuŋɔ Yawɛ na bi tin ya tɛha din ni baŋ bee nina din ni nya bee tiba din ni wum.
en: But until this very moment, the LORD hasnt given you insight to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.

dag: ka booi kom niŋ tahili ni n-gbaag o nyaandoliba maa naba paɣibu, ka mali bɔdu shɛli din mil o shee ni maa nyɛhiri bɛ naba maa.
en: Then he poured water into a bowl and began to wash the followers feet. He dried their feet with the towel that was wrapped around his waist.

dag: Ka Sool daa laɣim ba luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Bɛzɛk la. Izraɛlnim kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita. Ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ tuhi pihita.
en: When Saul counted them at Bezek, the soldiers from Israel totaled three hundred thousand and those from Judah thirty thousand.

dag: nini la nini, nyini la nyini, nuu la nuu, gbali la gbali.
en: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

dag: Bom sipirɛs dari din mali kpiɔŋ mali ŋariŋ, ka niŋ duri niŋ di ni, ka bo diɣiri n-tabilitabili di puuni mini di nyaaŋa.
en: Use cypress wood and build a boat for yourself. Make rooms in the boat and cover it with tar inside and out.

dag: dama m bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛli; n kahigi Naawuni yɛlli kam wuhi ya.
en: I havent avoided proclaiming the entire plan of God to you.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ ti nya Shafat bia Ilaisha maa ka o malila naɣikɔra siɣimsiɣim bupinaayi zuɣu ka bɛ be o tooni kɔra; omaŋmaŋ n-daa mali bɛn pahiri bupinaayi maa kɔra. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti gar o sani ka pirig o binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: So Elijah departed from there and found Elisha, Shaphats son. He was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him. Elisha was with the twelfth yoke. Elijah met up with him and threw his coat on him.

dag: A ni ti wum bɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Ka di nyaaŋa a ni nya kpiɔŋ chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka o min o tumtumda Pura daa chaŋ ti zani miri bɛ dimnim maa tɔbbi shɛb bɛn lo kpara do sansan maa tariga.
en: When you hear what the Midianites are saying, you'll be brave enough to attack. Gideon and Purah worked their way to the edge of the enemy camp, where soldiers were on guard duty.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa lan yi Libina n-gari chaŋ Lakishi ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna ku wum a yɛligu maa, ka di chɛ ka n daalahiziba tuma maa galisi pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord had said to Moses, The king will continue to refuse to listen to you, in order that I may do more of my miracles in Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Yihimila Barabas bahi, ka ku doo ŋɔ.
en: But they all shouted, Kill him! Let Barabbas go free.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa fiɛbi Midiannim Orɛb tampiŋ gbini shɛm la. N ni ti kpuɣi n fiɛbiga maa teeku kom puuni n-fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord Almighty, will beat them with my whip as I did the people of Midian at Oreb Rock. I will punish Assyria as I punished Egypt.

dag: amaa bɛ daa bi tooi tɔɣisi luh o, dama o daa tɔɣisirimi ni yɛm mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko.
en: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Bɛlishaaza daa ti laɣim o kpambaliba tuhili na ni bɛ ti puhi chu titali ka nyu wain.
en: King Belshazzar threw a huge party for a thousand of his princes, and he drank a lot of wine in front of them.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒi m-baɣi kom pam ka mali buni pam ŋɔ, yi bahigu saha paaya. Yi shihi siɣiya.
en: Babylon, you live near much water. You are rich with treasures, but your end as a nation has come. It is time for you to be destroyed.

dag: Nazari nir ŋun po pɔri zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Nazari nir ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli ti Yawɛ simdi ka di dolila o pɔri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di be di ko ka chɛ o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli ka di dol o ni wolig omaŋ ti Naawuni la zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: These are the regulations for you nazirites; but if you promise an offering beyond what your vow requires you to give, you must fulfill exactly the promise you made.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim zaa daa wum Filistianim maa ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa zaa.
en: All the people living in the town of Jabesh Gilead heard everything that the Philistines had done to Saul.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ti nya do so ka o kabiri dari Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sanʒiɛɣu ni yi nuzaa polo kanna, ka sagban titali daa beni, ka neesim gil li, ka buɣim daa kul nyaɣisira, ka binshɛli daa be buɣim maa sunsuuni kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: I was watching a big storm come in from the north. It was a big cloud with a strong wind, and there was fire flashing from it. Light was shining out all around it. It looked like hot metal glowing in a fire.

dag: Yuun pinaanahi nyaaŋa ka m mini Baanabas daa yɛn chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka n daa zaŋ Taitus m-pahi ka ti chaŋ.
en: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma ni di n-tiɣi ka nyu, amaa ka kum ni kɔnyuri mali yinima. Bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli, amaa ka yinim di vi.
en: And so I tell you that those who worship and obey me will have plenty to eat and drink, but you will be hungry and thirsty. They will be happy, but you will be disgraced.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka m mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nyu di zaɣ palli m Ba Naawuni nam ni.
en: From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.

dag: Amaa lɛhu ni tooi wuhi ni di gari ŋun mal li tumdi tuma? Sua gari ŋun mal li ŋmari binyara? Jaaŋgbee bi kpuɣiri ninsal gbibi, amaa ninsala n-kpuɣiri jaaŋgbee gbibi.
en: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti. Ka din pahi nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa suhuri fuŋmi ti zuɣu.
en: They said to Joshua, The LORD has definitely given the entire land into our power. In addition, all of the lands population has melted down in fear because of us.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ nyaaŋa, n ni kabis o bɔɣiri din mali yaa mini din pun kabi la, ka chɛ ka takɔbi yi o nuu ni lu.
en: So tell him that I am now his worst enemy. I will break both his arms—the good one and the broken one! His sword will drop from his hand forever.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa yi nti mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: But they went out and spread the word about him throughout that whole region.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Naawuni, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Cham ti liri ba, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked God for advice: Should I attack the Philistines, and will you hand them over to me? The LORD answered, Attack them, and Ill definitely hand them over to you.

dag: Nahiŋgu mini biɛrim pam m-mali ba dabiɛm. Di lula bɛ zuɣu kaman naa ni mali shili ni o chaŋ tɔb tuhibu shɛm la.
en: Adversity and stress scare them, master them like a king ready to strike.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Di zaŋ binshɛɣu n-tabili limsi anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, dama saha miriya.
en: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.

dag: ka yɛli, N zaɣim ka m ma daa dɔɣi ma, n zaɣim ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ yi dunia ni. Yawɛ n-daa ti ma, Yawɛ n-lan deei. Yawɛ yuli simdi paɣibu.
en: and said, When I was born into this world, I was naked and had nothing. When I die and leave this world, I will be naked and have nothing. The Lord gives, and the Lord takes away. Praise the name of the Lord .

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ ni daa niŋ saha shɛli maa, n daa ka Jɛrusalɛm, dama di daa nyɛla Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa yuun pihitanaayi saha ka n daa lab o sani. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lan suhi naa soli n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: I was not in Jerusalem while all of this was happening. I had gone back to the king of Babylon. I went back to Babylon in the nd year that Artaxerxes was king of Babylon. Later, I asked the king for permission to go back to Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zuri bɛ tab nyaaŋa mini bɛn fari tuumbiɛtumdiba bahira saria karibu ni ni bɛn ŋmari ʒiri m-mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli la.
en: God will destroy those who slander others, those who prevent the punishment of criminals, and those who tell lies to keep honest people from getting justice.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ so daa tuhir o soli na. O daa yɛla nɛma kaman pagɔrili la, ka o lihibu mali kɔre ni kukolimahim.
en: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.

dag: Musa daa woligi pirigili shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili ka chɛ tɔbbihi la dini.
en: Then Moses counted the peoples half. This was their share that Moses had taken from the soldiers who had gone to war.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi kana nti yɛl o, N dana, n-nyɛ a pɔŋli la. N daa zaŋ li gbinila binchɛra ni sɔɣi.
en: Another servant came and said, Sir, here is your gold coin; I kept it hidden in a handkerchief.

dag: Yɛhudianim daa mal adiini jɛmbu du shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Bilichinnim jɛmbu duu. Di ni niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-yi Sairiini mini Alikizandria ni bɛn daa yi Kilikia ni Ɛsha na n-daa laɣim ŋmɛri Stiivin naŋgbankpeeni;.
en: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves Free Men. They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.

dag: Wain kurili mini wain palli niriba yɛm.
en: false religious practices. Wine and new wine destroy understanding.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi tiligi o kandina dabisili maa dali? Ka o yi ti yi palo, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? Dama o ni ŋmanila saviɣu ni buɣim, ka ŋmani chibo din paɣiri yiri zaa.
en: No one can prepare for that time or stand against him when he comes. He will be like a burning fire. He will be like the strong soap people use to make things clean.

dag: ni Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Azaz bia la, ka Azaz daa nyɛ Shɛma bia, ka Shɛma daa nyɛ Joɛl bia, Joɛl maa min o niriba n-daa ʒini Aroa zaŋ hal ni Nɛbo mini Baalimiɔn la.
en: and Bela, the son of Azaz and grandson of Shema, of the clan of Joel. This clan lived in Aroer and in the territory from there north to Nebo and Baal Meon.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la yuli duya pam. Ti pun wum o yɛla; ka wum o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa Ijipti la yɛla;.
en: They said to him, Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the reputation of the LORD your God. We have heard a report about him and everything he did in Egypt.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka a ni du m-ba a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli ni o ku zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni.
en: He told them, Tell King Hezekiah of Judah these things: Dont be fooled by the god you trust when he says Jerusalem will not be defeated by the king of Assyria.

dag: Dama nyini n-daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n no n dimnim firi tiŋa.
en: You equipped me with strength for war; you brought my adversaries down underneath me.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa lan yɛl o ba, Bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suh a. Dina n-nyɛ: chɛl ma ka n niŋ chira ayi pahi, ka n chɛ ka m mini n tab du zoya zuɣu n-fabili n ni yɛn kpi ni m paɣipiɛlital ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then Jephthahs daughter said to her father, But do this one thing for me first. Let me be alone for two months. Let me go to the mountains. I will not marry and have children, so let me and my friends go and cry together.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu pina na; ka niriba maa daa ʒini tiŋa ni bɛ di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi diɛmdi kɔr biɛri mini vi diɛma.
en: The people woke up very early the next morning. They killed animals and offered them as burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. They sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up and had a wild party.

dag: Amaa ka n daa yɛli, Ka mani ŋɔ tatabo zo? Mani ŋɔ tatabo ni zo nti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni n tiligi? N ku niŋ lala.
en: I answered, Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go.

dag: Amaa ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba maa zaa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa bɛn daa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn yi bɛ ni daa kari ba tahi tin shɛŋa ni zaa n-labina ni bɛ ti ʒini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: But Johanan, son of Kareah, and the army officers did not obey this command. Instead, they took the survivors from Judah to Egypt. In the past the enemy had taken the survivors to other countries, but they had come back to Judah.

dag: Bɛ tirila pagɔra zaa liɣiri, amaa nyini n-lee tiri a mamanim zaa pina ni bɛ yi luɣilikam zaa kana a pagɔrisigu tuma maa zuɣu.
en: Prostitutes accept money for having sex, but you bribe men from everywhere to have sex with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-wuhiri yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli: Di pala tinima n-daa yuri Naawuni, amaa ŋuna n-daa yuri ti ka tim o Bia na ni o ti leei sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi.
en: True love is Gods love for us, not our love for God. He sent his Son as the way to take away our sins.

dag: N daa tum tuun kara. N daa me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri.
en: Then I began doing great things. I built houses, and I planted vineyards for myself.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi lir o ka tiligi? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ lala dunia zaa ni?.
en: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim ya ka yi ŋmaligi doli wuna jɛmdi li, dama di saha.
en: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord . And if you worship other gods.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni gba daa niŋ. O daa bɔri ni o wuhila o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm ka chɛ ka o yiko yi palɔni; dinzuɣu ka o daa di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi din kur o suli ka simdi ni o bahi ba yol la suɣilo.
en: What if God very patiently puts up with pots made for wrath that were designed for destruction, because he wanted to show his wrath and to make his power known?.

dag: Jɔn daa di o shɛhira kuhi yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni daa yɛli so yɛla ni ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: John spoke about him. He cried out, This is the one I was talking about when I said, He comes after me, but he is greater than I am, because he existed before I was born.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zo dabiɛm n-kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha o nahimbu biɛrim nyabu maa zuɣu ka yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye! Nyin tin titali ŋɔ, nyin Babilɔn ŋun nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ, awa yini puuni ka a zani lu n-dahim zaa.
en: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, Zuɣusuŋ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Gaad.
en: Leah said, I am lucky. So she named the son Gad.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yi ti mabihi gari kɔbisinu zuɣu yim, ka bɛ ni pam na be bɛ nyɛviya ni hal ni pɔŋɔ, ka bɛ ni biɛla mi gbihiri kum ni.
en: Then he appeared to more than five hundred of his followers at once, most of whom are still alive, although some have died.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; dama m bela nandahima ni, deemi n suhigu yomyom.
en: Don't hide yourself from your servant; I am in great trouble—answer me now!.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: So, Ezekiel, condemn them.

dag: Di nyuriya dam kuuna, dama di nyubu puuni ka ninvuɣ yotali yirina, amaa lee chɛliya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pali yi suhuri ni.
en: Do not get drunk with wine, which will only ruin you; instead, be filled with the Spirit.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔhi malaika maa, Ka bɔ ka olivi tih ayi din ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu la yaɣa ayi la mi lee wuhira?.
en: I responded to him, What are these two olive trees on the right and left sides of the lampstand.

dag: ni suligu ni baŋtooŋa balibu kam zaa.
en: the red kite, the black kite, and any kind of bird of prey.

dag: Isaka ŋmanila bun so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ piɛri sunsuuni.
en: Issachar is a sturdy donkey, bedding down beside the village hearths.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ yi ti puhina, bɛ zɔrimi ti kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: When the sun rises, they gather together and lie down in their dens.

dag: Bumiya tɔbu zambu bahi bɛ zuɣu luɣilikam. Bɛ gbaɣisi tɔbu; bini din taɣi ba luya. Bɛ daai di goma luhi. Dama Yawɛ m-bɔhi ba biɛri maa. Bɔhimiya ba biɛri. Niŋmiya ba kaman bɛ gba ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: Raise the war cry all around the city! Now Babylon has surrendered. Its walls have been broken through and torn down. I am taking my revenge on the Babylonians. So take your revenge on them, and treat them as they have treated others.

dag: N ni yili yilli paɣi Naawuni yuli; ka zaŋ wumpaɣibo tibig o.
en: I will praise God with a song; I will proclaim his greatness by giving him thanks.

dag: Amaa n ŋmanila zunzuli, ka pa ni ninsala; ka n tab ʒiɛm ma, ka niriba maani ma ansarisi!.
en: But I am no longer a human being; I am a worm, despised and scorned by everyone!.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa neei gom ni ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ bela kpe ka m bi mi.
en: When Jacob woke from his sleep, he thought to himself, The LORD is definitely in this place, but I didnt know it.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani ni o ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve disciples. He went to the chief priests and offered to help them arrest Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ di tam o ba tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka di kpihim o ma daalahichi.
en: Let his fathers wrongdoing be remembered before the LORD; let his mothers sin never be wiped out.

dag: n-ti bahi ku Amalɛknim bɛn daa zo n-tiligi la, ka ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: There were only a few Amalekites still living, and these Simeonites killed them. Since that time until now, the Simeonites have lived in Seir.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daanya mali paɣibu tahili, ka mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Make a bronze bowl and put it on a bronze base. You will use this for washing. Put the bowl between the Meeting Tent and the altar. Fill the bowl with water.

dag: Yɛligu maa ni ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛvili daa yina, ka nyɛvili maa daa nyɛ neesim ninsalinim sani.
en: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.

dag: Amaa yi ni yi alahichi dabitim ni pumpɔŋɔ n-yipa leela Naawuni daba ŋɔ, yi ni nya nyɔ shɛli di ni nyɛla biɛr kasi, ka di bahigu nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: But now you have been set free from sin and are the slaves of God. Your gain is a life fully dedicated to him, and the result is eternal life.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ mi ni n nya yi taali, dama m pun yɛli ya ni yi yɛla be ti suhuri ni, ka ti mini ya nyɛla zaɣ yini, di yi nyɛ nyɛvil ni bee kum puuni.
en: I do not say this to condemn you; for, as I have said before, you are so dear to us that we are always together, whether we live or die.

dag: Amaa yi kpalim jɛmdila yi wuni din nyɛ yi naa ka yi booni li Sakut la mini yi saŋmariga wuni din yuli booni Kaiwan la binnana.
en: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Lɛvinim ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ʒi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka pa ni shɛb yaha, dama bɛna ka Yawɛ daa pii ni bɛ ʒiri li, ka tumd o jɛma tuma sahakam.
en: Then he said, Only the Levites are permitted to carry Gods Holy Box. The Lord chose them to carry it and to serve him forever.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Anabi Musa daa bahi noli ni so yi yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ ka yih o.
en: The Pharisees said to him, Then why did Moses command us to give a divorce certificate and divorce her? .

dag: O tiligiri niriba, ka lan fari niriba bahira; o wuhiri shihira, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa alizanda ni mini dunia ŋɔ ni. O fa Daniɛl gbuɣima nuu ni bahi.
en: He is rescuer and savior; God performs signs and miracles in heaven and on earth. Heres the proof: He rescued Daniel from the lions power.

dag: Ti ni daa bi tooi yih o di ni maa ka ti chɛ o ka yɛli, Ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmi lala.
en: Since we couldnt talk him out of it, the only thing we could say was, The Lords will be done.

dag: Di saha maa ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim zaa daa laɣim kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ bɛ tantinim ti kpa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: Then all the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the desert tribes assembled, crossed the Jordan River, and camped in Jezreel Valley.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti lab nyaaŋa, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima, dama niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: So those who are last now will be first in the future. And those who are first now will be last in the future.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labirila ŋun daa tim ma na maa sani, ka yi ni so mi bi bɔhi ma, Ya ka a chana.
en: Now I am going back to the one who sent me. And none of you asks me, Where are you going.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Abimilɛk o tumtumdiba ni daa fa ŋun Ibrahimma kɔbil shɛl la yɛla.
en: Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well which the servants of Abimelech had seized.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o chaŋ ti tabili gooni n-zaŋ Balaam napɔnvaɣu sooi gooni maa; ka o daa lan fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: When the donkey saw the LORDs messenger, it leaned against the wall and squeezed Balaams foot against the wall, so he continued to beat it.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be alizanda ni la daa yooi ka o Daalikauli Adaka la be di puuni; ka saa daa nyaɣisiri ka tahira, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda, ka sakuɣ kara luri na.
en: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.

dag: Ka maligumaana Pashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Imɛr bia, ka nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu kpɛm la daa wum Jɛrimia anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ binyara ŋɔ polo.
en: When the priest Pashhur, Immers son, the officer in charge of the LORDs temple, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.

dag: Naawuni, Fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi. Fam ma ninkuunsinim mini bɛn bi doli zaligu la nuu ni bahi.
en: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o saawaralana Ahuzat ni o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yi Gɛra chaŋ Yisahaku sani.
en: But Abimelech set out toward him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his ally and Phicol the commander of his forces.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul be lala dunia ŋɔ ni hal ti paai biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu.
en: The waters rose over the earth for one hundred fifty days.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Gɔg yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: You, human one, prophesy about Gog and say, The LORD God proclaims: I challenge you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal!.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi yolisim maa leei kuɣituurili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la sani.
en: But be careful with your freedom. Your freedom to eat anything may make those who have doubts about what they can eat fall into sin.

dag: Yawɛ ni gul a, a yibu min a lab kpe ni; pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The LORD will protect you on your journeys— whether going or coming— from now until forever from now.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ ni daa niŋ ania la zuɣu, ti booni ba la bɛn mal alibarika. Yi pun wum Ayuba ania niŋbu yɛla, ka nya ti Duuma daliri ni daa nyɛ shɛm di puuni, ka lan nya ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo zaŋ chaŋ o polo min o baɣa ni daa be o ni shɛm.
en: And we say that those who accepted their troubles with patience now have Gods blessing. You have heard about Jobs patience. You know that after all his troubles, the Lord helped him. This shows that the Lord is full of mercy and is kind.

dag: Ka kom gili ma niŋ sunsuuni ka teeku maa kom kul lim ma zaa. Ka teeku kɔtiŋ mɔri vilivili n zuɣu.
en: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl kpamba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana? Yi yɛn bɔhi ma mi baŋ binshɛli? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku bɔhi ma baŋ binshɛli.
en: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel. Tell them This is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to ask me what you should do? I, the Lord GOD, tell you that, as surely as I live, I will not listen to you.

dag: Bɛ daa teeri ni Naawuni n-nyɛ bɛ Tampiŋ Kpiɔŋ ŋun tiligiri ba, ka lan teeri ni Zallakudura Naa n-nyɛ ŋun fari ba bahira.
en: They would remember that God was their rock, that the Most High was their redeemer.

dag: Bɛ mali nuhi, amaa di bi tabisiri shɛli. Bɛ mali naba, amaa di bi chana. Bɛ ku tooi zaŋ bɛ kukoya yɛli shɛli.
en: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.

dag: So yi daa tum din tiri suhusaɣiŋgu, pa mani ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu, ka m mi bi bɔri ni n tibigi li, dama nir yi lihi di puuni, di nyɛla yi zaa ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu maa.
en: Now, if anyone has made somebody sad, he has not done it to me but to all of you—in part, at least.

dag: Ka Matania mini Bakibukia ni Obadia ni Mɛshulam ni Talimɔn ni Akub bɛn nyɛ dunɔguliba la daa ʒe n-guli nɛma du shɛŋa din daa be dunɔdaya shee la.
en: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.

dag: Ba maa bi kariti so saria, amaa o zaŋ saria karibu yɛla zaa niŋla o Bia maa nuu ni.
en: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.

dag: Dunianim zaa ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋla Yawɛ yuli booni ya, ka bɛ ti zɔri ya.
en: Then all the people in that land will see that you are called to be the Lord s people, and they will be afraid of you.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ malila omaŋmaŋ amaŋka, Lɛbanɔn tihi dapaɣa ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.

dag: Alɔbo ni lu yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu bee ka kum ku ba yi sani. Ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu yi sani. Ka n wurim yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu mi dolisi pɔhim; ka ŋooi takɔbi kari doli ba.
en: A third of your people will die from sickness and hunger in the city; a third will be cut down by swords outside the city; and I will scatter the last third to the winds and pursue them with a sword.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛlikam ʒibu na polo, dama Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ luɣ viɛlli shee ka bɛ yɛn ʒini. .
en: They are not to worry about leaving their possessions behind; the best in the whole land of Egypt will be theirs.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr piɛlli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi tɔbu, ka bɛ ti o nam zuɣupiligu, ka o chani gindi n-tuhiri diri nasara.
en: So I looked, and there was a white horse. Its rider held a bow and was given a crown. And he went forth from victory to victory.

dag: amaa di yi yila Naawuni sanna, dindina yi ku tooi nyaŋ ba; hal yi yi dol li gba, di pa shɛli yi ni ti nya ka di nyɛla Naawuni ka yi tuhiri maa. Ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa.
en: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said.

dag: Yi nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb o ni yu ka pii leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba. Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi zaŋ nambɔzɔbo mini nirilim niŋbu ni maŋsiɣisibutali ni tarimtali ni suɣilɔdibo kpɛhi yi tɛr ni.
en: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kpihim yi birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord your God is always with you, and he hates for his people to worship other gods! So if you follow those other gods, the Lord will become very angry with you. He will destroy you from the face of the earth.

dag: Daŋ kam piimi bɛ daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim ka mali yu suŋ ka bɛ leei yi zuɣulaannima.
en: Each tribe must choose some experienced men who are known for their wisdom and understanding, and I will make those men the official leaders of their tribes.

dag: Dinzuɣu Vuhim Dabisili na kul ʒiɛmi guli Naawuni niriba ni bɛ vuhi;.
en: As it is, however, there still remains for God's people a rest like God's resting on the seventh day.

dag: Zaŋmiya di zaɣ kuŋ tam sala buɣim zuɣu ka di bii, ka di tahiʒiɛɣu mooi, ka di daɣiri zaa nyɛligi niŋ di puuni, ka din zahimzahim la zaa di buɣim.
en: Now set the empty bronze pot on the coals and let it get red-hot. Then the pot will be ritually pure again after the corrosion is burned off.

dag: Ka ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa zaŋ o ti, ka bɛ di o saria n-yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Our chief priests and rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and he was crucified.

dag: Tɔɣisimiya Jɛrusalɛmnim suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa. Yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ di wahala saɣi lala. N darigi bɛ tibili ka di saɣi, ka yipa chɛ bɛ daalahichi taali zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and tell her, Your time of service is finished. You have paid the price for your sins. I, the Lord , have punished you twice for every sin you committed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: When these followers heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: ŋun di kpihim man Jɔnatan yuli nyin Dauda daŋ ni. Yawɛ bɔhimi nyin Dauda dimnim biɛri ti a.
en: if Jonathans name is also eliminated, then the LORD will seek retribution from David.

dag: ka n ti labiri kuni yiŋ na, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti kul yi n yiŋa n-daŋ ma soli tuhibu na, dilana ni leei nyin Yawɛ dini, ka n zaŋ o mali sara n-nyo o buɣim ti a.
en: I will burn as an offering the first person that comes out of my house to meet me, when I come back from the victory. I will offer that person to you as a sacrifice.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka n lili kpe zibisim ni, ka zibisim titali limsi n ninni.
en: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bɔrila dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba, yi ni tooi da dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya sani.
en: About your men and women slaves: You may get men and women slaves from the other nations around you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa boli bindirigu maa Manna, di daa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din nyɛ zaɣ piɛla, ka nyaɣisi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ shiri mali karikaasi shɛŋa.
en: The people of Israel called the food manna. It was like a small white seed, and tasted like thin cakes made with honey.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm n-niŋ yuun pihinunaayi. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛkolia.
en: He was only years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem, which was also the hometown of his mother Jecoliah.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli n soya mini n zaligunima ni n fukumsi zalikpana la kaman a ba Dauda ni daa dol li shɛm la, dindina n ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: And if you obey me and keep my laws and commands, as your father David did, I will give you a long life.

dag: ka zo n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim niŋ amaŋkanim ni ʒiri chani bɛ ni daa wum ni o be luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: and ran around that whole region bringing sick people on their mats to wherever they heard he was.

dag: nti gbaag o nuu ka yɛl o, Talita kumi! Di gbinni nyɛla, Bipuɣiŋga, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: Taking her hand, he said to her, Talitha koum , which means, Young woman, get up.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o dolila adiini soli ka bi gbib o zilinli, o yɔhindila omaŋa o suhu ni, ka o daadiini soli dolibu nyɛla yoli.
en: If those who claim devotion to God dont control what they say, they mislead themselves. Their devotion is worthless.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka anab maa dola sol ni, ka buŋ la mini gbuɣinli maa ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka gbuɣinli maa bi ŋub o bee n-ku buŋ maa.
en: and he went and found the body thrown down on the road. The donkey and the lion were still standing beside the body. The lion hadnt eaten the body, nor had it torn the donkey apart.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan.

dag: Bɛ ni di nasara bɛ tuma ni, ka alɔbo ku di bɛ bihi. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: Never again will a woman suffer childbirth and have her baby die. Women will not fear childbirth. I, the Lord , will bless all my people and their children.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti chirigi Firawuna saha shɛl o ni chani mɔɣili ni la n-yɛl o ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Get up in the morning and go to Pharaoh. He will go out to the river. Tell him that the Lord says, Let my people go and worship me!.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ʒini yi sani. Guliya ti ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ti maa ku paai ti. Ŋun nahindi ti maa yi ti lan kani, saɣiŋgu maa ni zani tariga; ka ninvuɣ kuriba maa gba ku lan be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: People from Moab were forced to leave their homes. So let them live in your land. Hide them from their enemies. The robbing will stop. The enemy will be defeated. The men who hurt the people will be gone from the land.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni Naawuni yɛligu kɔŋla palibu, dama pa bɛn zaa yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Izraɛl yaan maŋa.
en: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ŋariŋ maa tumtumdiba ka bɛ zaa yinoyino gbaai bɛ wuna kabu, ka kpuɣiri ŋarin titali maa ni nɛma bahiri kom ni ni di chɛ ka ŋarin titali maa tibisim filim. Amaa ka Jona ŋun daa kpɛla ŋarin titali maa puuni ha nti doya gbihira.
en: The sailors were terrified, and each one cried out to his god. They hurled the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to make it lighter. Now Jonah had gone down into the hold of the vessel to lie down and was deep in sleep.

dag: Dauda yɛligu din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim zaa bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana.
en: Davids last instructions for the Israelites were to count the descendants from the tribe of Levi. They counted the Levite men who were years old and older.

dag: Di ti ŋubiya niŋkaha bee n-duɣ li, amaa ti shɛmiya binzuɣuri ni biɛhi zaa n-tabili puuni nɛma zaa.
en: Dont eat any of it raw or boiled in water, but roasted over fire with its head, legs, and internal organs.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa saɣim o suhu pam ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: When the man heard Jesus say this, he went away gloomy and sad because he was very rich.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli Ziɔn, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi dama di nyɛla tin shɛli Zallakudura Naa ni daa zali.
en: But about Zion he says, I know each and every person born there. It is the city built by God Most High.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Gɛhaazi na ti yɛl o, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa na. Ka o bol o. Ka paɣ maa kana, ka o ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a bia.
en: Elisha called for Gehazi and said, Call the Shunammite woman. Gehazi called her, and she came to Elisha. He told her, Pick up your son.

dag: Amaa so ni yɛli, A malila yɛda, ka m mi mali tuma. N gba ni yɛli, Wuhim ma a yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma maa, ka m mi wuh a n yɛda niŋbu n tuma tumbu puuni.
en: Suppose someone disagrees and says, It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds. I would answer, Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.

dag: Puhimiya yi ni biri bindir shɛŋa din daŋ niŋbu kpuɣibu chuɣu. Yuuni yi ti giligi ka yi kpuɣi yi puri atam zaa naai, yin puhimiya yi puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: Celebrate the Harvest Festival when you begin to harvest your crops. Celebrate the Festival of Shelters in the autumn, when you gather the fruit from your vineyards and orchards.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa luri Naawuni sizuura ŋɔ, kamiyana ka n ti yɛli ya o ni tum shɛli ti ma ka yi wum.
en: Come close and listen, all you who honor God; I will tell you what God has done for me.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pa nyini n-yɛn me yili ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: Go to my servant David and tell him, This is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build the temple for me to live in.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ku a dabili Stiivin la, n gba daa be bɛ ni ka yu o kubu maa, ka daa gbib bɛn ku o maa binyɛra.
en: When Stephen your witness was being killed, I stood there giving my approval, even watching the clothes that belonged to those who were killing him.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan yɛli, Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina. Ka ŋun kani maa na mi chandi ŋmanila Jɛhu, Nimshi yaaŋa la, dama o chandi maa ŋmanila yinyaa.
en: Once more the guard reported that the messenger had reached the group but was not returning. And he added, The leader of the group is driving his chariot like a madman, just like Jehu.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa wum di yɛla, ka bɔri ni o ku Musa. Amaa ka Musa daa zo Firawuna sani n-kuli Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti ʒi kɔbiliga gbini.
en: When the king heard what Moses had done, he wanted to kill him. But Moses escaped and went to the land of Midian. One day, when Moses was sitting by a well.

dag: Yawɛ n-tim ba ni bɛ cham gili kaai dunia ŋɔ nya.
en: Then the man standing among the myrtle bushes said, The Lord sent these horses to go here and there on earth.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n ni pili n-chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam niriba zɔn ya dabiɛm, bɛ yi wum yi yɛla dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira ka biɛrim pam mali ba.
en: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa ka su li n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Naaran din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Gɛza din daa be wulinluhili polo la mini di tiŋkpansi ni Aya mini di tiŋkpansi.
