en: The territory which they took and settled included Bethel and the towns around it, as far east as Naaran and as far west as Gezer and the towns around it. It also included the cities of Shechem and Ayyah, and the towns around them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha nti liri ba, saha shɛli Bɛnhadad mini nanim pihitanaayi bɛn daa sɔŋd o la ni daa nyu dam buɣi be bɛ suɣa ni.
en: King Ahab began his attack at noon, while King Ben-Hadad and the kings were drinking and getting drunk in their tents.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir o ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini ni, Bul goli ŋun nyɛ gol so ŋun pahir anii la ni ka bɛ daa me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka mali di binshɛɣukam kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi shɛm naai. Yuma ayopɔin ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: Seven years later the workers finished building it during Bul, the eighth month of the year. It was built exactly as it had been planned.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam saɣi deeg o yɛligu maa ni dihi tabili ni Naawuni nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: Whoever accepts what he says has given proof that God speaks the truth.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dab so Naawuni ni pii ka boli ni n leei tumo m-moli ŋun Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sanna.
en: Greetings from Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle and gave me the work of telling his Good News.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli tiŋgbani din bɔri kom, ka chɛ ka kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani din kuui. N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ a zuliya ni, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a bihi ni.
en: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun daa lo ti nyɛvili shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni alikauli la yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, sent to proclaim the promised life which we have in union with Christ Jesus—.

dag: Yɛlimiya m ba n ni nya jilima shɛli zaa Ijipti ŋɔ mini yimaŋmaŋ nini ni nya shɛlikam zaa. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti zaŋ m ba kuli kpe na.
en: So tell my father about the honor I have received here in Egypt. Tell him about everything you have seen here. Now hurry, go bring my father back to me.

dag: ni Bɛsai daŋ niriba ni Miunim daŋ niriba ni Nɛfushɛsim daŋ niriba.
en: Besai, Meunim, Nephushesim.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima mini diɣi buɣisi li bee nir ti zaŋ li taɣi salima din viɛli yɛri.
en: Wisdom is worth more than gold or crystal. It cannot be bought with expensive jewels set in gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Keenan Naa Jabin.
en: That day God gave the Israelites victory over Jabin, the Canaanite king.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Ɛgilɔn gari chaŋ Hiburɔn ti liri ba.
en: Then Joshua and all the Israelites traveled from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

dag: ni bɛ niŋm binzusa niŋ bɛ binyɛra luɣa ni bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka niŋ mi sabilitim niŋ binzusa kam din be bɛ luɣa ni maa.
en: to say to the people of Israel: Make tassels on the corners of your garments and put a blue cord on each tassel. You are to do this for all time to come.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun bɔhi biɛri ti ma; ka nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be n sulinsi ni ti ma.
en: He gives me victory over my enemies; he subdues the nations under me.

dag: A ni ti dɔni, ka so ku lan kpɛh a dabiɛm, ka niriba pam ti bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim.
en: You will lie down without anyone to scare you; many will beg for your favor.

dag: Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la ti ma suhumahili kaman a ni lo mani a dabili ŋɔ alikauli shɛm la.
en: Now comfort me with your faithful love, as you promised.

dag: Naa Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa ti wum ni o bia Ahazia kpiya, ka o dii yiɣisi gbaai nabihi kubu.
en: When Athaliah, Ahaziahs mother, learned of her sons death, she immediately destroyed the entire royal family.

dag: Ka siliga guliba maa daa deei liɣiri maa, ka chaŋ ti shiri niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm maa, ka Yɛhudianim daa deei yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ yɛlimaŋli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: The guards took the money and did what they were told to do. And so that is the report spread around by the Jews to this very day.

dag: Ka pukpara ŋun mi tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o daŋ bindir pala dibu.
en: A hardworking farmer should get the first share of the crop.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Iso daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ɛdom zoya tiŋ ni. Iso ka bɛ lan booni Ɛdom la.
en: That's why Esau made his home in the hill country of Seir.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so ti ku wuhi o kpee bee o mabia yɛra, Baŋmi ti Duuma! Sokam zaa ni ti mi ma, hal bɛn nyɛ tarimba zaŋ tabili wɔɣira.
en: None of them will have to teach their friends or tell their neighbors, Know the Lord. For they will all know me, from the least to the greatest.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kamiyana ka ti labi Yawɛ sani ka o ti tibi ti, dama ŋuna n-daa darigi tooi ti. Ŋuna n-daa ti daŋa, o ni niŋ tim niŋ ti daŋ maa.
en: The people say, Let's return to the Lord ! He has hurt us, but he will be sure to heal us; he has wounded us, but he will bandage our wounds, won't he?.

dag: Jaande, ŋmaligimiya, ka di tumiya taali. Ŋmaligimiya pumpɔŋɔ, yi zilisi n nimmaŋtali.
en: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya daazichi ti ba, ka zo Izraɛlnim zaa nambɔɣu. Ka n ni ti zabi nyuli n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will bring the family of Jacob back from captivity. I will have mercy on the whole family of Israel. I will show my strong feelings for my holy name.

dag: Wumm a ba ŋun dɔɣ a yɛligu. Miri ka a ʒiɛm a ma o yi ti kurigi.
en: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Taainim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋ muni niriba zaa n-tahi Ɛdom, ka bi gbib bɛ mini ba ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.

dag: Bɛ yi daa yɛn ku niriba ayopɔin n-yo Keen kubu samli, so yi ku mani, yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka bɛ yɛn ku n-yo man kubu samli.
en: If seven lives are taken to pay for killing Cain, Seventy-seven will be taken if anyone kills me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tiligi bɛn vu m-miri Naawuni o zuɣu la sahakam, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul be ni o timdi sandaani tiri ba Naawuni sani.
en: This is why he can completely save those who are approaching God through him, because he always lives to speak with God for them.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa laɣim sokam zaa na nti yɛli ba, Ɛhab daa jɛm Baal la biɛla, amaa man yɛn jɛm o la pam.
en: Jehu called the people of Samaria together and said, King Ahab served the god Baal a little, but I will serve him much more.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi.
en: He answered her with this saying: It is not right to take the childrens bread and give it to the dogs.

dag: ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ yiɣina ti lu bɛ sansani maa ni n-gili bɛ biɛhigu maa shee zaa.
en: they fell in the middle of the camp all around the tents.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi li, ka dalima din be o niŋgbuŋ ni maa yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛl tim, dindina di kul nyɛla saŋkpambihi n-niŋ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu maa, o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: the priest shall examine you. If the spots are dull white, it is only a blemish that has broken out on the skin; you are ritually clean.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu, ka bɔhira, Ya polo ka di lee be? Bɛ mi ni zibisim dabisili shee bi lan waɣa.
en: and vultures are waiting to eat their corpses. They know their future is dark;.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na ti ti o ma; ka o ma daa zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli o ba ni yuri pam.
en: So he went to get them and brought them to her, and she cooked the kind of food that his father liked.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Shallum ŋun daa di nam zan o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni gbaai so kpe n-zaŋ o chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku lan labi kpe na yaha.
en: The Lord says concerning Josiah's son Joahaz, who succeeded his father as king of Judah, He has gone away from here, never to return.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya mi daa su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi daa nyɛ nayili tuma kpamba.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of David's bodyguards; and King David's sons held high positions in his service.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti nya sagani sagbana ni, n ni teei alikauli shɛli din be man Yawɛ mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni, ka nyɛ din ku yiɣisi la yɛla.
en: When the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between me and all living beings on earth.

dag: Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil mabia la bidibisi m-bɔŋɔ: Masha ŋun daa nyɛ Zif ba la n-daa nyɛ o bituuli. Marɛsha bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Hiburɔn.
en: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron.

dag: Puu atam kpuɣibu saha naaya, ka wuuni du, ka ti na bi tiligi.
en: The harvest is past, the summer has ended, yet we arent saved.

dag: bee o tizɔpaɣ ŋun na ʒi doo, .
en: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.

dag: Ti mabihi, yimaŋmaŋ mi ni ti ni daa ka yi sanna la pala din kpalim yoli.
en: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.

dag: A yi ti yɛn kali Izraɛlnim maa, nyin chɛ ka sokam yo shɛli ti man Yawɛ bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka alɔbo ku lu bɛ zuɣu saha shɛli a yi ti kaani ba.
en: When you take a census of the people of Israel, each man is to pay me a price for his life, so that no disaster will come on him while the census is being taken.

dag: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura, ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli ka kom kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: Everybody kept on eating and drinking, and men and women married, up to the very day Noah went into the boat and the flood came and killed them all.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa bɔhi Lɔt, A mali ninvuɣ shɛb yaŋɔ pahi? A bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a deennim bee a dɔɣiriba shɛb yi be yaŋɔ, nyin cham ti zaŋ ba yi yaŋɔ.
en: The two men said to Lot, If you have anyone else here—sons, daughters, sons-in-law, or any other relatives living in the city—get them out of here.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba paai sariakaritib sani ti yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianima, ka saɣindi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: They brought Paul and Silas before the Roman officials and said, These men are Jews, and they are making trouble in our city.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ naa daanab maa bidibisi, ka di daa doli Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni tibig o la. Dama Naawuni daa ti o la bidibisi pinaanahi ni bipuɣins ata.
en: God gave to Heman, the king's prophet, these fourteen sons and also three daughters, as he had promised, in order to give power to Heman.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnima ka bi diri tiɣiri la. Zuɣulaannim ŋɔ gba ka baŋsim. Bɛ zaa dolila bɛ suhuyubu soli, ka kul niŋdila din ni sɔŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko.
en: They are like greedy dogs that never get enough. These leaders have no understanding. They each do as they please and seek their own advantage.

dag: Amaa ka o ŋari ma. O taɣi n yɔri la siɣimsiɣim bupia, amaa Naawuni bi saɣi ka o niŋ ma shɛli.
en: But your father cheated me and changed my payment ten times. Yet God didnt let him harm me.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa dam, ka salo kabi chaŋ ti gbaai Gaiɔs mini Aristakus bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na ka nyɛ Pool dolintab la n-dari ba tahi tiŋ maa nim laɣiŋgu shee.
en: The city was thrown into turmoil. They rushed as one into the theater. They seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Pauls traveling companions from the province of Macedonia.

dag: Bɛn tɛha bi zilima bɛn kul niŋdila binshɛɣukam yɛda, amaa yɛnnim bɛn kpahindila yɛla ni chani shɛm.
en: The naive believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! n-yɛwaa! la gba di vi, ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: May those who make fun of me be too embarrassed to speak.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi zaa naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛgulibo ni na ni a ti leegi n niriba Izraɛlnim toondana n-su ba.
en: David, this is what I, the Lord All-Powerful, say to you. I brought you in from the fields where you took care of sheep, and I made you the leader of my people.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya taba kaman Masia ni daa deei ti shɛm Naawuni paɣibu zuɣu la.
en: Accept one another, then, for the glory of God, as Christ has accepted you.

dag: ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani, bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini niɣi ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be yi sani, ka doli ya yi ŋariŋ maa ni na alikauli.
en: and with every living being with you—with the birds, with the large animals, and with all the animals of the earth, leaving the ark with you.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa garigi yɛli, Biɛɣu ni neei, amaa yuŋ ni lan zibi yaha. A yi bɔri ni a bɔhi, nyin lan labimina ti bɔhi.
en: From my guard post, I answered, Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.

dag: Goma bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Difat ni Tɔgarima.
en: Gomers family: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti doli soya ŋɔ n-jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Dont act like they did toward the LORD your God!.

dag: Yi mi ti ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm mini ti ni daa tim zuliya gbaliŋ ni garina shɛm.
en: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N yi bi ŋma Shafat bia Ilaisha la zuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma din gari lala.
en: He exclaimed, May God strike me dead if Elisha is not beheaded before the day is over.

dag: O daa darig o niriba maa tibili n-chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni. O suhuyiɣisili puuni, o daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kana ti ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: By frightening Jerusalem, by sending her away, you contended with her, expelling with a fierce blast on the day of the east wind.

dag: Ka Nahɔr mam ŋun yuli daa booni Riuma la mi daa dɔɣi Tɛba mini Gaham ni Tahash ni Maaka.
en: His secondary wifes name was Reumah, and she gave birth to Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ mini di kore nyɛla din garita, amaa ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: And the world and its cravings are passing away, but the person who does the will of God remains forever.

dag: O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni. Teemiya o ni daa na be Galili ka yɛli ya.
en: Jesus is not here. He has risen from death. Do you remember what he said in Galilee?.

dag: Ŋunkam vuɣi o kpee palo tariga kpaa, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who moves a neighbors landmark ! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Anɛr mini Biliam ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti Kɔhat ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim la mi.
en: And from half the tribe of Manasseh, the Israelites gave the towns of Aner and Bileam to the Kohath families. The Kohath families also got fields with those towns.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima n-ku ba pam; dindali maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ka bɛ daa ku.
en: The Israelites were defeated by David's men; it was a terrible defeat, with twenty thousand men killed that day.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yo Babilɔn mini di niriba zaa bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la samli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.

dag: Ka niriba zaa wum di yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan niŋ tipawumli yaha.
en: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko yɛla ka bi bɔri ni bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, amaa ka dolila tuumbiɛtali soli la, Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o suli min o suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛ tibili.
en: But others are selfish and refuse to follow truth. They follow evil. God will show his anger and punish them.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, n yur a pam.
en: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.

dag: Hal o ni daa bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli, ka ʒiri daa ka o nol ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa gbi o gballi garila tuumbiɛrinim gbala ni; ka daa sɔɣ o pahi bundan zuɣu.
en: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.

dag: Ka do so daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o chani ni bɛ ti sɔɣi, ka nya Mɔab ŋmɛnditoya ka zaŋ kpim maa bahi Ilaisha siliga ni ka zo. Kpim maa ni daa kul lu siliga maa ni ha n-shihi Ilaisha kɔba, o dii neemi yiɣisi zani.
en: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣi yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛ bɔrila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ni nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ dini.
en: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋahili ŋɔ bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim, amaa ka daa lee zɔri salo maa ka chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: The Jewish leaders tried to arrest Jesus, because they knew that he had told this parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd, so they left him and went away.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini niriba maa daa lo alikauli dindali maa; ka o daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn doli Shɛkɛm.
en: Joshua helped Israel make an agreement with the Lord that day at Shechem. Joshua made laws for Israel.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: The Scriptures say the same thing about Abraham. Abraham believed God, and because of this faith he was accepted as one who is right with God.

dag: Di simdi ka yi lo biŋkɔbigu maa zali hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, dindali zaawuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni ti kɔri bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: You should keep close watch over it until the fourteenth day of this month. At twilight on that day, the whole assembled Israelite community should slaughter their lambs.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi nya di yiko, ka pa ni Naawuni n-ti a li; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni ŋɔ daalahichi galisi gar a dini.
en: Jesus replied, You would have no authority over me if it had not been given to you from above. Thats why the one who handed me over to you has the greater sin.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohaths sons by their clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: amaa tinim sani, Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni, ka binshɛɣukam yila o sanna, ka ti bela o zuɣu. Duuma yino ko mi m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam nambu ni yi so tuma ni na la, ka ti gba bela o zuɣu.
en: yet there is for us only one God, the Father, who is the Creator of all things and for whom we live; and there is only one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things were created and through whom we live.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim deei nam maa ti o.
en: Rehoboam went back to Jerusalem and gathered together an army of , men from the families of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin. Rehoboam wanted to go fight against the Israelites and take back his kingdom.

dag: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun daŋ tooni ni ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ni ŋun lan nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi yɛli, N kpuɣila paɣa, dinzuɣu n ku tooi kana.
en: Still another guest said, I've just now married, and I can't be there.

dag: Amaa zom a Naawuni, ka di zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o.
en: Do not treat them harshly, but obey your God.

dag: Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa mini lɔndo din daa gili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: All the tent pegs for the dwelling and for the courtyard all around were made of copper.

dag: Chamiya Kaline nti nya; ka chaŋ Hamat din nyɛ tin tital la ni mini Gaat din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋ la ni nti nya. Tinsi maa gari Juda mini Izraɛl tinsi? Bee bɛ tiŋgbɔna galisimi gari yi tiŋgbɔŋ?.
en: Go and look at the city of Calneh. Then go on to the great city of Hamath and on down to the Philistine city of Gath. Were they any better than the kingdoms of Judah and Israel? Was their territory larger than yours?.

dag: Ŋunkam ti di binʒim kam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni. .
en: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.

dag: Dɔɣibu saha beni, ka kpibu saha beni. Biribu saha beni, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛli sib bahi saha beni.
en: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ zina.
en: You must not commit adultery.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa suhuri daa paligi ka bɛ yiini yila yɛri taba, Sool kula tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia.
en: The women sang in celebration: Saul has killed his thousands, but David has killed his tens of thousands.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban daa gahim bula shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ni sabilimsabilim mini bunyama bɛn zaa liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn zaa mali piɛlimpiɛlim ni piɛbihi shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ zaɣ sabila n-zaŋ ba ti o bihi ni bɛ guli ba.
en: But that day Laban removed the male goats that had stripes or spots and all the females that were speckled and spotted or which had white on them; he also removed all the black sheep. He put his sons in charge of them.

dag: Amaa nir yi lihi Naawuni zaligu din be tibi ka nyɛ din tiri daadamnim yolisim la ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka kul dol li dɛde ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni ŋun wumdi li mi kɔŋko, o ni nya alibarika Naawuni sani o ni tumdi shɛm maa puuni.
en: But there are those who study the perfect law, the law of freedom, and continue to do it. They dont listen and then forget, but they put it into practice in their lives. They will be blessed in whatever they do.

dag: o daa yɛli ma mi, Daadam, n timd a la Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn taai duŋ niŋ ma ŋɔ sani. Bɛ mini bɛ yaannim pun birigi n sani zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: He said to me: Human one, Im sending you to the Israelites, a traitorous and rebellious people. They and their ancestors have been rebelling against me to this very day.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: He told Jesus, I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.

dag: M min a ni chaŋ Ijipti, ka n ti lan zaŋ a labisi kpe na yaha; ka Yisifu maŋmaŋ nuu ni ti daag a nina pɔbi.
en: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I promise to bring you out again. Joseph will close your eyes when you die.

dag: zaawuni yuŋ lihaliha saha ni yuŋ zibisim saha.
en: The day was ending. The sun had set, and it was almost dark.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti tɔɣisiri kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Naawuni ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu la yɛla. Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Some people were talking about the temple, how it was decorated with beautiful stones and ornaments dedicated to God. Jesus said.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the God of heaven— Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o, o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Praise the Lord ! Sing a new song to the Lord ! Sing his praise in the assembly of his followers.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl. Kɔhat daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaata dunia yili.
en: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived years.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a mabia Sɔdom min o bipuɣinsi daa bi tum tuumbiɛri ka di paag a min a bipuɣinsi ni tum shɛm ŋɔ.
en: As surely as I live, says the LORD God, not even your sister Sodom and her daughters did what you and your daughters have done!.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia yɛli ba, Di viɛla, n ni suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛm maa. Ka o ni garigi yɛli shɛm, n ni yɛli ya. N ku sɔɣi ya shɛli.
en: Then Jeremiah the prophet answered, I understand what you want me to do. I will pray to the Lord your God, as you asked me to do. I will tell you everything the Lord says. I will not hide anything from you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti suui bɛ wain wal kaha bahi kaman wain tia la; ka suui bɛ puma bahi kaman olivi tia la.
en: like the vine, they will drop early grapes and cast off their blossoms like the olive.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga? Bɛ yɛn jɛmdila nanima ka pa ni tarimba.
en: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.

dag: ni bɛ ni je paɣ so yi kuli doo ni dab paɣisarili ŋun zan o lana ŋun nyɛ paɣa zaani.
en: a woman whose husband hated her but still married her, and a servant girl who becomes ruler over the woman she serves.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama Naawuni kamina ni o ti zahim ya, dina n-nyɛ ni o chɛ ka dabiɛm be yi suhuri ni ka yi ku tum alahichi.
en: Don't be afraid! Moses replied. God has come only to test you, so that by obeying him you won't sin.

dag: Ka bia maa ba maa baŋ ni di nyɛla saha shɛli Yisa ni sa yɛl o ni o bia maa ni gal la. Ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ yɛda.
en: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, Your son will live! So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ gili Ifriim zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya tiŋgban ni tinsi zaa n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni, amaa ka niriba maa daa lari ba, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: The messengers went to every city in the territory of the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh, and as far north as the tribe of Zebulun, but people laughed at them and made fun of them.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini fukumsi zaligu dolibu gbib o niriba zaa.
en: David ruled over all of Israel and made sure that his people were always treated fairly and justly.

dag: Chɛliya ka n yili yilli ŋɔ ka yi wum, di nyɛla n yura min o tihi puu yilli: N yura m-mal o tihi puu ka di be daboli din tiŋgbani vuhiri zuɣu.
en: Let me sing for my loved one a love song for his vineyard. My loved one had a vineyard on a fertile hillside.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa gun o bia Ishimail mini bɛ ni daa dɔɣi dab bidib shɛb o yiŋa bee o ni daa zaŋ o liɣiri da shɛba. Doo kam ŋun daa be Ibrahimma yiŋa, o daa guni ba dindali maa kaman Naawuni ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: On that same day Abraham obeyed God and circumcised his son Ishmael and all the other males in his household, including the slaves born in his home and those he had bought.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Ka bɛn ti nya a ni ti kpaai bɛ nina kpa a ka di gari ba ka bɛ bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-daa dam dunia zaa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe zuliya kam zaa la?.
en: Those who see you will stare at you; they will examine you closely: Is this the man who rattled the earth, who shook kingdoms.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, a bi zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ti bee n-zaŋ puri mini tihi puri ti ti ka di leei ti dini. Pumpɔŋɔ a bɔrimi ni a yɔhim ti. Ti ku kana.
en: You certainly have not brought us into a fertile land or given us fields and vineyards as our possession, and now you are trying to deceive us. We will not come.

dag: Ka bɛ mini so daa bi lan tuhi tɔbu hal ti paai Asa nam dibu maa yuun pihitanaanu saha.
en: There was no war until the thirty-fifth year of Asas rule.

dag: Bee miri ka a tum zina.
en: You must not commit the sin of adultery.

dag: Ka ti daa chaŋ ti baɣisi tiŋgban bil shɛli din be kom sunsuuni ka bɛ booni li Kauda la gari, ka di daa taɣi ti ka chɛ pɔhim maa. Ti wahala nyabu ŋɔ puuni ti daa kpaŋ timaŋa ni ti lo ŋarin bil din daa baɣi ŋarin titali maa tabili ka di ku lu.
en: We went along the island of Cauda on the side that was protected from the wind. We had a hard time holding the lifeboat in place.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ piri tiŋgbana maa tari Izraɛlnima ka bɛ su li.
en: The Lord chose these men to divide the land of Canaan among the Israelites.

dag: Chɛli ma ka n ku ba n-kpihim bɛ yuli dunia ni, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka galisi gari ba.
en: Let me destroy these people completely, so no one will even remember their names. Then I will make another nation from you that is stronger and greater than these people.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana mali biɛrisuŋ: di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino, ka nyɛ ŋun gbib omaŋa ni ŋun mali yɛm ni ŋun biɛhigu doli soli ni ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun ni tooi wuhi niriba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo kabiri laɣindina maa, ka o tah alizin birigu maa zuɣu yɛli, Nyin alizin tikpiralan birigu ŋɔ, n yɛr a mi, wari ka chɛ bia maa, ka di lan lab o sanna yaha.
en: Jesus noticed that the crowd was closing in on them, so he gave a command to the evil spirit. Deaf and dumb spirit, he said, I order you to come out of the boy and never go into him again.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi nya doo maa, dabiɛm gbaari ba mi pam ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: When the Israelites saw Goliath, they ran away in terror.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka a yɛla mali dabiɛm pam. A nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni a ni lo alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunim polo.
en: Then I prayed this prayer: Lord , God of heaven, you are the great and powerful God. You are the God who keeps his agreement of love with people who love you and obey your commands.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Avimnim bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi zaŋ hal ni Gaza la, Kafitɔrimnim bɛn daa yi Kafitɔr na la daa ku ba ka ʒini bɛ ʒiishee maa.
en: The Avvim, who had lived in settlements around Gaza, were completely destroyed by the Caphtorim, who had come from Caphtor. They replaced the Avvim there.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa kum nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nan bia Jɔshua, ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda la.
en: Moses, the Lord 's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa yi nti mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country.

dag: Di wumya bɛ yɛtɔɣa. Jɛmmiya Babilɔn Naa ka be. Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ zani dabari?.
en: Dont listen to them; serve the king of Babylon and live. Otherwise, this city will be reduced to ruin.

dag: A biɛli n-nyɛ Samaria ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nuzaa polo la, ka a tizo nyɛ Sɔdom ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nudirigu polo la.
en: Your older sister was Samaria, that city to your north with her nearby villages. Your younger sister was Sodom, that city to your south with her nearby villages.

dag: Ka Jɔab niriba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti zani Amasa sani ka yɛli, Ŋunkam bɔr Jɔab ka nyɛ ŋun be Naa Dauda polo, ŋun doli Jɔab.
en: One of Joab's men stood by Amasa's body and called out, Everyone who is for Joab and David follow Joab.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ ni daa niŋ saha shɛli maa, n daa ka Jɛrusalɛm, dama di daa nyɛla Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa yuun pihitanaayi saha ka n daa lab o sani. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lan suhi naa soli n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king.

dag: Ka Abishai daa yɛli Dauda, Naawuni zaŋ a dim maa niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ; dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n kul zaŋ kpani ŋɔ kuh o yim tabili tiŋa, m bi yɛn kuh o buyi.
en: Abishai said to David, Today God has given your enemy to you. Let me pin Saul to the ground with his spear. Ill only do it once.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti sɔŋdi niriba lala tatabo, ka di chɛ ka ti leei bɛn mini ba laɣindi tumdi yɛlimaŋli la puuni.
en: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini tuya ʒiɛri maa ti Iso ka o di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi chaŋ o chandi shee. Lala ka Iso daa niŋ ʒiɛm o kpamdi maa.
en: Then Jacob gave him some bread and some of the soup. He ate and drank and then got up and left. That was all Esau cared about his rights as the first-born son.

dag: N wum Naawuni ni yɛli siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni ŋun Naawuni n-su yiko.
en: God has spoken one thing— make it two things— that I myself have heard: that strength belongs to God.

dag: O ni daa siɣis omaŋ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa milig o zuɣu, ka o daa bi ku ba zaa, ka biɛhigu daa lan niŋ nyaɣisim viɛnyɛliŋga Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When Rehoboam submitted, the LORD was no longer angry with him, and total destruction was avoided. There were, after all, some good things still in Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ʒiishee la tooni n-jɛmd o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ o jɛmbu duu puuni maa; ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee mahim kul ni luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: So now these people are before the throne of God. They worship God day and night in his temple. And the one who sits on the throne will protect them.

dag: Shɛb daa nyɛla jɛra n-tum tuumbiɛri, ka daa di wahala bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Some were fools, suffering because of their sins and because of their evil;.

dag: Yihimiya tins ata zali Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli, ka yihi tins ata zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi.
en: You will establish three cities across the Jordan and three cities in the land of Canaan. They will be the refuge cities.

dag: Dama m bɔrila yurilim maŋli ka pa ni sara maligu. M paɣiya ni yi baŋ man Naawuni n-gari yi nyɔri binyara buɣim maani sara.
en: I want your constant love, not your animal sacrifices. I would rather have my people know me than burn offerings to me.

dag: N lan ka suhupiɛlli, suhusaɣiŋgu m-mali ma. Biɛrim be n suhu ni.
en: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a zaŋsim be mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ ni, ka wum n kuhigu mini n suhigu shɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: LORD my God, listen to your servants prayer and request, and hear the cry and prayer that your servant prays to you today.

dag: Di niŋdiya li la saha shɛli bɛ nini ni beni zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiyala din tiɣiri Naawuni nini ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nyɛ Masia daba la zuɣu.
en: Dont work to make yourself look good and try to flatter people, but act like slaves of Christ carrying out Gods will from the heart.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi be yi ni?.
en: You should know that you yourselves are Gods temple. Gods Spirit lives in you.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam, ka o lo tɔbu n-tuhi Siria naa hal ti gbah o tɔbbihi maa pam.
en: The southern king, in a bitter rage, will come out to battle the northern king. He will muster a huge army, but the army will be handed over to his enemy.

dag: ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.

dag: Filistianim ni daa zaŋ bintɔra kɔtomsi salima din nyɛ alahichi sanyoo pini m-pahi ti ti Yawɛ la zaɣ yini daa nyɛla Ashidɔdnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gazanim dini, ka yini nyɛ Ashikɛlɔnnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gaatinim dini, ka yini mi nyɛ Ɛkurɔn nim dini.
en: That is how the Philistines sent gifts to the Lord to make up for taking the sacred chest. They sent five gold sores, one each for their towns of Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.

dag: M bela Yawɛ tooni chani nyɛvilinim tiŋgban ni.
en: I will continue to serve the Lord in the land of the living.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: One of those with Jesus reached for his sword. Striking the high priests slave, he cut off his ear.

dag: N ni zaŋ nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam maa yihi ya yi ni wurim be zuliya shɛb sani tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa zaa ni na.
en: I will bring you out of these other nations. I scattered you among these nations, but I will gather you together and bring you back from these countries. But I will raise my powerful arm and punish you. I will show my anger against you!.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n noli paɣi Yawɛ pam; n ni paɣ o salo sunsuuni.
en: But I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth; among a great crowd I will praise God!.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka nyɛ tarimba be yi sani. Bɛ ni ti bo sɔŋsim man Yawɛ sani.
en: But I, the Lord , won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.

dag: Daadam Bia kandina ni ti ŋmanila do so ŋun daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋa, ka zaŋ o yili niŋ o yiŋbihi nuu ni ka ti sokam o tuma, ka yɛl o yiligula ni o gul o yili maa la.
en: It is like what happens when a man goes away for a while and places his servants in charge of everything. He tells each of them what to do, and he orders the guard to keep alert.

dag: dindina, n ni zaŋ jaaŋgbee bu ba n-darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ fiɛbiga n-fiɛbi ba darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: I will punish them severely for their sins and wrongs.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni ni bɛ yi kom maa dibu ni.
en: He and his wife, and his sons and their wives, went into the boat to escape the flood.

dag: Di saha, ti ku lan ŋmalig a sani zo yaha, tim ti nyɛvili, ka ti jɛmd a!.
en: We will never turn away from you again; keep us alive, and we will praise you.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayi maa daa mali ti paai Sɔdom zaawuni, ka Lɔt daa ʒi Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dunol ni. Lɔt ni daa nya ba, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli.
en: When the two angels came to Sodom that evening, Lot was sitting at the city gate. As soon as he saw them, he got up and went to meet them. He bowed down before them.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya ni o ni kari Yaakubu zuliya saria, ka di kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord sent a word against Jacob; it fell upon Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee daa kpuɣila Atarɔtada wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn Duli polo.
en: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon.

dag: N yi ti gbarigi saha shɛli, a mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ bari ma la tɔŋ n ni doli so shɛli zuɣu.
en: I am ready to give up. But you, Lord, know the path I am on, and you know that my enemies have set a trap for me.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din be tooni naŋgbambili, ka lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa gba naŋgbambili.
en: They put fifty loops on the edge of the last piece of one set and fifty loops on the edge of the other set.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-nyɛ: Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nadab.
en: and his oldest son, Abdon. His other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa ti ka o sanna ti bɔh o, A mi ni Farisiinim ni wum a ni yɛli shɛm la bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim bebɔ.
en: Then the disciples came and said to him, Do you know that the Pharisees were offended by what you just said.

dag: Wummiya, dama n yɛn tɔɣisila bintitaŋa yɛtɔɣ viɛla, ka din yɛn yi n noli ni na nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Listen to my excellent words; all I tell you is right.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya maa tin shɛli ni.
en: You must not sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that the Lord your God gives you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lo noli n-jɛmdi ti Duuma ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛli ba, Piimiya Baanabas mini Sool ti ma, ka n chɛ ka bɛ tum n ni yɛn ti ba tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: As they were worshipping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, Appoint Barnabas and Saul to the work I have called them to undertake.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Ŋunkam tu Naawuni, dilan daalahichi ni ʒin o zuɣu.
en: You must tell the Israelites: Anyone who curses their God must be punished.

dag: Ninsalinim yi yɛn po pɔri, bɛ pɔrila ŋun gari ba; ka naŋgbankpeeni kam puuni, pɔri n-nyɛ din ŋmaari li.
en: People pledge by something greater than themselves. A solemn pledge guarantees what they say and shuts down any argument.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ka nya jilima shɛli din nyɛ naa jilima n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee. Ka maligumaana ni ʒe m-baɣ o nam ʒiishee maa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa ni laɣim tumdi ni suhudoo ni naŋgban yini.
en: He is the one who will build it and receive the honor due a king, and he will rule his people. A priest will stand by his throne, and they will work together in peace and harmony.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Yawɛ duu maa gbini Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ puuni daŋ kam zuɣulaannim shɛb daa tila pina din yi bɛ suhuyubu ni na ni bɛ zaŋ li n-sɔŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: When the exiles arrived at the Lord 's Temple in Jerusalem, some of the leaders of the clans gave freewill offerings to help rebuild the Temple on its old site.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa mɛbu tuma, di daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla lala hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi saha.
en: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.

dag: A ti o dimnim nasara; a chɛ ka o dimnim zaa suhuri paligi.
en: You lifted high his foes strong hand. You gave all his enemies reason to celebrate.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Yawɛ yihi anabinim ti ti Babilɔn.
en: You say that the Lord has given you prophets in Babylonia.

dag: Ka Hɛli daa nyɛ Matat bia, ka Matat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi nyɛ Mɛlikai bia, ka Mɛlikai nyɛ Jannai bia, ka Jannai mi nyɛ Yisifu so bia.
en: son of Matthat son of Levi son of Melchi son of Jannai son of Joseph.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa yina kuli naai, ka naazɔnim daa kpe nti nya ka dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntua maa dunoya yomi kpari, ka bɛ tɛhi ni naa maa kpɛla zɔntua maa ni du bil ni ni o ti wɔɣis omaŋa.
en: and left. The servants came and saw that the doors were locked, but they only thought that the king was inside, relieving himself.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba shɛb mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba daa be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.

dag: n kul paɣirila Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam, ka kul teeri yi yɛla n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa zaŋ alikama biɛlim suma bir o puu ni;.
en: Jesus told them another parable: The kingdom of heaven is like someone who planted good seed in his field.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa saɣi, ka zahim Ɛfurɔn ni daa yɛli anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisinahi shɛli Hitinim maa ninni maa ti Ɛfurɔn; ka di nyɛ kaman kɔhigɔriba ni daa zahindi li shɛm.
en: Abraham accepted Ephrons offer and weighed out for Ephron the silver he requested publicly before the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver at the current rate of exchange.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ tuma zuɣulaantab la daa niŋ kaman Naa Darius ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Then Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their fellow officials did exactly as the emperor had commanded.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli, Naawuni bo lari ti ma, ka ŋunkam zaa wum di yɛla ni la n-sɔŋ ma.
en: Sarah said, God has made me happy, and everyone who hears about this will be happy with me.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ya ka a chana? Ka o garigi n-yɛl o, N ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, a ku tooi doli ma pumpɔŋɔ; amaa a ni ti doli ma saha shɛli.
en: Where are you going, Lord? Simon Peter asked him. You cannot follow me now where I am going, answered Jesus; but later you will follow me.

dag: Ka kul kpalimmiya be yil yin ni n-diri ka nyuri bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam, dama tumtumda kam simdi yɔri. Ka miriya ka yi lɔhiri yiya.
en: Stay in that same house, eating and drinking whatever they offer you, for workers should be given their pay. Don't move around from one house to another.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: But Jesus let out a loud cry and died.

dag: ni Bɛnhɛsɛd tiŋgbɔŋ zaa la.
en: Ben Hesed was governor of Arubboth, Socoh, and Hepher.

dag: amaa milinsi din pali la yi ti kana, milinsi din bi pali zaa ŋɔ ni vuui.
en: But when perfection comes, the things that are not complete will end.

dag: Bɛ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu. Ninni din nyɛ tuuli maa daa nyɛla chɛrubi ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buyi nyɛ ninsal ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buta nyɛ gbuɣinli ninni, ka ninni din pahi bunahi mi daa nyɛ tɔrili ninni.
en: Each creature had four faces. The first was the face of a bull, the second a human face, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

dag: ka o bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim ti o, ka o zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ʒe sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila la, ka kpaai binʒim maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: Then the sons of Aaron brought the blood to Aaron. Aaron put his finger in the blood and put it on the corners of the altar. Then he poured out the blood at the base of the altar.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bala? Dama bɛ daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli. Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli tin ya ni yi di m-bala.
en: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, What is it? They didnt know what it was. Moses said to them, This is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Bɛtani Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ kɔŋlan la yiŋa.
en: When Jesus was at Bethany visiting the house of Simon, who had a skin disease.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi nuhi tiri luɣ kasi shee la m-paɣi Yawɛ.
en: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord .

dag: ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Ɛdomnim tinsi din kpalim la mini tin shɛŋa din zaa daa pun nyɛ n tinsi la. Yawɛ ŋun yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ maa n-yɛli lala maa.
en: so that they may possess what is left of Edom, as well as all the nations who are called by my name, says the LORD who will do this.

dag: N yuri Yawɛ, dama o wumdi n ni yɛri shɛm; ka deeri n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: I love you, Lord ! You answered my prayers.

dag: Yurilim bi chɛ ka nir tumd o ʒiʒiinikpee zaɣ biɛɣu, dinzuɣu yurilim nyɛla din paani Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: If you love others, you will never do them wrong; to love, then, is to obey the whole Law.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa shiri zaŋ chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gibiatihaaralɔt la.
en: So Joshua did as the Lord had commanded, and he circumcised the Israelites at a place called Circumcision Hill.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa bo paɣiba ayi ti o ka o zaŋ ba dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi.
en: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.

dag: Ɛfurɔn maŋmaŋ daa ʒila o tab Hitinim maa sani; ka ŋun Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma o tab Hitinim bɛn zaa daa ʒi tiŋ maa dunoli shee maa sani.
en: Ephron himself was sitting with the other Hittites at the meeting place at the city gate; he answered in the hearing of everyone there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti vuui, amaa nyin kul ni kpalim be; di zaa ni kurigi kaman situra ni kurigiri shɛm la.
en: They will disappear, but you will remain; they will all wear out like clothes.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nyɛ n dimnim yi liri ma m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma, bɛ ni tuui lu.
en: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Bɛ dolila Keen biɛhigu soli. Liɣiri zuɣu ka bɛ doli Balaam biriginsim sol la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn taai duŋ kaman Kɔra ni daa taai duŋ shɛm la; bɛ ni bahi yoli kaman o ni daa bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia ni daa zaɣisi ni tɔbutuhiriba shɛb di dol o chaŋ tɔb maa ni ka kari ba ni bɛ kulim maa daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa, zaŋ Samaria hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn n-daa ku niriba tusaata ka di nɛma pam.
en: Meanwhile the Israelite soldiers that Amaziah had not allowed to go into battle with him attacked the Judean cities between Samaria and Beth Horon, killed three thousand men, and captured quantities of loot.

dag: N ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla saha shɛli maa, ka bula so daa yi wulinluhili polo na n-kul kpaŋ zɔri yomyom hal ka o naba bi shihiri tiŋ gba. Ka o daa mali yil gahindili ka di sa o nina ayi sunsuuni.
en: I was trying to understand this when suddenly a he-goat came from the west, crossing the entire earth but not touching the ground. Between this goats eyes was a horn that was a sight to see.

dag: Yawɛ shiri tum tuun kara ti ti, ka ti suhuri paligi pam.
en: Indeed he did great things for us; how happy we were!.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei gunibu maŋli, dama ti jɛmdila Naawuni o Shia Kasi zuɣu ka mali suhupiɛlli ti bebu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ti ka tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni.
en: It is we, not they, who have received the true circumcision, for we worship God by means of his Spirit and rejoice in our life in union with Christ Jesus. We do not put any trust in external ceremonies.

dag: Man Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi yi yaannim zuɣu.
en: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli Tiriza. O ni daa kul mali ti kpɛri bɛ yiŋ dunol ni, ka bia maa dii leei Naawuni dini.
en: Then Jeroboams wife left and went to Tirzah. When she stepped across the threshold of the house, the boy died.

dag: N ni nya ka shɛli viɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni ninsalinim diri ka nyura, ka di bɛ tuma zaa nyaɣisim dunia ŋɔ ni dabisa biɛla shɛli Naawuni ni ti ti ŋɔ puuni, dama ti tarili m-bala.
en: I have seen what is best for people to do on earth: They should eat, drink, and enjoy the work they have during their short time here. God has given them these few days, and that is all they have.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kul o ya Jɛrusalɛm ni alaafee.
en: King Jehoshaphat of Judah came back safely to his house in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Abinɛr yɛl o, Ŋmaligim a nudirigu bee a nuzaa polo n-gbaai nachimba ŋɔ ni yino n-fa o ni mali shɛli. Amaa ka Asahɛl bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: Stop chasing me! Abner said. Run after one of the soldiers and take what he has. But Asahel kept on chasing him.

dag: O ni ti tuhi sansana din mali kpiɔŋ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm wun so la sɔŋsim zuɣu. O ni ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe wuni ŋɔ nyaaŋa jilima, ka zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni, ka pirigi paliti ti ba ka di leei bɛ laara.
en: To defend his fortresses, he will use people who worship a foreign god. He will give great honor to those who accept him as ruler, put them into high offices, and give them land as a reward.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi Taai doli yi Sidɔn mini tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia la ni mali ti paai Galili Teeku ni.
en: Then Jesus left the area around Tyre and went through Sidon. On his way to Lake Galilee he went through the area of the Ten Towns.

dag: Ti mabihi, din pahi nyɛla yi pun bɔhim ti sani di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm n-tiɣi Naawuni nini yɛla. Hal lala ka yi kul be, ka ti suhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: So then, brothers and sisters, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to keep living the way you already are and even do better in how you live and please God—just as you learned from us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool ni Dauda zo n-kuli Gaat, ka o daa chɛ o shee bɔbu.
en: When Saul found out that David had run off to Gath, he stopped trying to catch him.

dag: Ti mi ni ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yil shɛl ni ŋɔ yi saɣim, ti mali yil shɛli Naawuni sani, ka di nyɛ din ni be alizanda ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka di mi pala ninsal nuhi ni me shɛli.
en: For we know that when this tent we live in—our body here on earth—is torn down, God will have a house in heaven for us to live in, a home he himself has made, which will last forever.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: David was angry that the LORD lashed out at Uzzah; and so that place is still called Perez-uzzah today.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya kam kpamba: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses spoke to the leaders of the tribes of the Israelites: This is what the LORD has commanded.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi bɛn guli naa sapashin kpɛm la daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulana Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: In addition, Nebuzaradan, the commanding officer, took away as prisoners Seraiah the High Priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank, and the three other important Temple officials.

dag: Yisa Masia puuni yi zaa nyɛla Naawuni bihi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: You were all baptized into Christ, and so you were all clothed with Christ. This shows that you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Deemiya saɣisigu kaman din yi yi ba sanna, dama di wuhiri ni Naawuni lihi ya la o bihi. Bi ŋuni n-lee beni ka o ba bi saɣisir o?.
en: Bear hardship for the sake of discipline. God is treating you like sons and daughters! What child isnt disciplined by his or her father?.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla. A ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o lee naa la yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, bɛ maan o la ansarisi.
en: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Filistianim mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Itiɔpianim polo la suhiri yiɣisi bahi Naa Jɛhɔram zuɣu.
en: Some Philistines and Arabs lived near where some Ethiopians had settled along the coast. The Lord caused them to go to war against Jehoram.

dag: Kish daŋ ni, Kish bia Jɛramiil n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Kishs son was Jerahmeel.

dag: O daa niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ naani, ka so daa ka Juda nanim zaa ni bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman o.
en: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel; Judah never had another king like him, either before or after his time.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛl kpamba.
en: Then Joshua gave orders to the peoples officers.

dag: ka yeeg o dabitim binyɛrigu, ka o niŋ a yiŋa goli muni n-kum o banim min o manim kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni tooi zaŋ o niŋ a paɣa, ka a leeg o yidana ka o mi leeg a paɣa.
en: remove her prisoners clothing, and live in your house, mourning her father and her mother for one month. After that, you may consummate the marriage. You will be her husband, and she will be your wife.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ salima alali m-mali di yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Then make a cover of pure gold, forty-five inches long and twenty-seven inches wide.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Naa Dauda tiŋ la ni nanim silisi ni, dama o daa tum tuun suma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lan tum tuun suma ti Naawuni min o jɛmbu duu.
en: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple.

dag: ni Rakalnima ni Jɛramiilnim tinsi ni Kɛnnim tinsi.
en: Racal, the towns of the Jerahmeelites, the towns of the Kenites.

dag: Ka Abija daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o ba zaani. Asa ʒiɛmani maa ni, bɛ mini so daa bi tuhi tɔbu hal ni yuun pia.
en: Abijah lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Davids City. His son Asa succeeded him as king. In Asas time, the land had peace for ten years.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa zaŋ tabili tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ.
en: Joshua and his army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Lɔdɛba Ammiɛl bia Makiri maa yiŋ ti zaŋ o na.
en: So King David sent for him.

dag: Ka bɛn ti zo n-tiligi ni ti bela zoya zuɣu kaman vinvamli ni ŋmana la. Ka bɛ zaa ti fabindi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti kani tin shɛli din yuli booni Kalɛb Ɛfirata la ni nyaaŋa ka o pakoli Abija daa dɔɣi Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa ba la.
en: After Hezron died in the town of Caleb Ephrathah, his wife Abijah had his son, who was named Ashhur. Ashhur was the father of Tekoa.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Karim dab paɣ ŋɔ min o bia ŋɔ, dama dab paɣ maa bia maa mini m bia Yisahaku ku laɣim di fali.
en: Sarah saw them and said to Abraham, Send this slave and her son away. The son of this woman must not get any part of your wealth, which my son Isaac should inherit.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti labina, salo maa zaa daa yiɣisimi m-puh o ni o paabuna, dama bɛ daa pun yuun o la soli.
en: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed him, for they had been waiting for him.

dag: Bɛ daa yi chana, di gba chanimi. Bɛ daa yi ti zani, di gba zaanimi. Bɛ daa yi wuɣi du zuɣusaa, kalima maa gba wuɣirimi du zuɣusaa doli ba, dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela kalima maa ni.
en: So every time the creatures moved or stopped or rose in the air, the wheels did exactly the same.

dag: Bɛ yih a niriba ʒim Jɛrusalɛm, ka di doya zɔri kaman kom la, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔɣi ba.
en: Blood flowed like water all over Jerusalem. No one is left to bury the bodies.

dag: O kɔr o biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ o wain gabi taba, ka mali bindira dibu shili zali.
en: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.

dag: Mɔab yili kam zuɣusaa mini di dahi ni, shɛli lan kani n-naɣi pahila fabila kɔŋko, dama n wurim Mɔab kaman so ni lan je duɣ shɛli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On every housetop of Moab and in all its streets, theres nothing but mourning. I have shattered Moab like a pottery vessel no one wants, declares the LORD.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka kɔbil nina puhigi zɔra; ka daa chɛ ka mɔɣa din kom kul zɔri sahakam la nyuui.
en: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihinahi, ka mali yaansi bɛn nyɛ bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ daa bari bunsi pisopɔin. Abidɔn daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma anii.
en: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons mounted on seventy donkeys. He led Israel for eight years.

dag: A mi zaligu shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa? A ni tooi zaŋ lala zaligunim zali dunia ŋɔ ni?.
en: Do you know the laws that control the sky? Can you put each star in its place above the earth?.

dag: Amaa yum yi na be o niŋgbuŋ ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: But as soon as raw flesh appears in the swelling, they will be unclean.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu saha kanna ka bɛ ti ku lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: So the time is coming, declares the LORD, when no one will say, As the LORD lives who brought up the Israelites from the land of Egypt.

dag: Ya ka n lee yɛn nya nimdi ti niriba ŋɔ zaa? Dama bɛ kumdimi niŋdi ma ka yɛra, Tim ti nimdi ka ti ŋubi.
en: I dont have enough meat for all these people! And they continue complaining to me. They say, Give us meat to eat.

dag: Damaskusnim lan ka yaa, ka ŋmaligi ni bɛ guui, ka dabiɛm kpe ba. Biɛrim mini suhugarigu mali ba mi kaman paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: The people of Damascus are weak and have fled in terror. They are in pain and misery like a woman in labor.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama tuun kar shɛŋa din daa tum yi tinsi maa ni la yi di daa tumla Sɔdom, di naan na kpalim ʒiɛya hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n neesim mini n tiliginsim; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra? Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɛvili birini; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra?.
en: The Lord is my light and my salvation; I will fear no one. The Lord protects me from all danger; I will never be afraid.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tiŋgbana pihinuayika din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinima.
en: This is the total of all the cities of the Levites within the property of the Israelites: forty-eight cities with their pastures.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika; ka o ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-leeg o niriba mali alibarika.
en: The nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom God has chosen as his possession, is truly happy!.

dag: O daa tɛhiya ni o mabihi maa baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o na ni o ti fa ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ lala.
en: He expected his own kin to understand that God was using him to rescue them, but they didnt.

dag: Dabiɛm ni kpe ba kaman kokpɛɣu la, ka pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ti ʒe ba chaŋ yuŋ.
en: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yili ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa din be n nɛma duri puuni wuhi ba.
en: What did you show them? I asked. Hezekiah answered, I showed them everything in my kingdom.

dag: Naa ŋun ʒini saria karibu shee, o nina nyari zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: A king who sits on his judgment throne sifts out all evil with his eyes.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: They replied, Its master needs it.

dag: Lala niriba n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmd o, bɛna n-lan nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: They try to follow God. They go to the God of Jacob for help. Selah.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Mariama sani m-maar o suhu la ni daa nya ka o yiɣisi yomyom yiri maa ka bɛ gba yiɣisi dol o, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o chanila gballi maa gbini ni o ti kum.
en: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.

dag: ka ŋun pahi pia nyɛ Jɛrimia, ka ŋun pahi piniyini nyɛ Makibanai.
en: Jeremiah was the tenth in command. Macbannai was the eleventh in command.

dag: Pa n nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: Did not I myself make all these things.

dag: Ka Kiriatijiarimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-kuli ti zaŋ li tahi do so ŋun yuli daa booni Abinadab ka o yili be daboli zuɣu la yiŋa. Ka bɛ daa piig o bia Ɛliɛza ni o yuuni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: The people of Kiriath-Jearim got the chest and took it to Abinadab's house, which was on a hill in their town. They chose his son Eleazar to take care of it.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa maa niriba maa ninni.
en: and Aaron told them what the Lord had sent Moses to say. Then Moses worked the miracles for the people.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi yila vuri la zo n sani. M mi ku wum yi biŋkumda kumsi.
en: Stop your noisy songs; I do not want to listen to your harps.

dag: Bɛn mali taali soli nyɛla so golima, amaa bɛn ka taali biɛhigu nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Criminals cause trouble wherever they go, but good people are honest and fair.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di daa kpala talahi ni o be kaman o mabihi ni be shɛm shɛlikam puuni, ka di chɛ ka o tooi leei maligumaani titali ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka niriba nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: This means that he had to become like his people in every way, in order to be their faithful and merciful High Priest in his service to God, so that the people's sins would be forgiven.

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa naai, o daa chaŋ ti dula daboli zuɣu.
en: When Saul finished his ecstatic dancing and shouting, he went to the altar on the hill.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaɣisi din viɛla, bɛ dimnim ni ti kari doli ba.
en: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu pam, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, N Duuma, mani? N Duuma, mani.
en: Deeply saddened, each one said to him, Im not the one, am I, Lord.

dag: Nir yi pii yu suŋ di gari buni pam, ka jilima mi gari anzinfa bee salima.
en: It is better to be respected than to be rich. A good name is worth more than silver or gold.

dag: Yɛlim ti a ni tɛhiri shɛm: Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: Tell us, then, what do you think? Is it against our Law to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor, or not.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa ŋmaligi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: So King Sennacherib of Assyria left and went back to Nineveh where he stayed.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ wuntizɔriba ka lihi ʒiɛm bɛ tab la ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni.
en: Jesus told a story to some people who thought they were better than others and who looked down on everyone else:.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni dini n-lee be asama ni nira yɛli: A yi yɛli so ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ.
en: Is it easier to say, Your sins are forgiven you, or to say, Get up and walk?.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ti ŋmanila yaɣiri a sani, ka a mi ŋmani yaɣimɛra. Ti zaa nyɛla a ni zaŋ a nuhi nam shɛba.
en: But, Lord , you are our father. We are like clay, and you are the potter. Your hands made us all.

dag: N ku niŋ n suhu ni yiɣisi ka n yɛn niŋ shɛm maa. N ku lan ku Ifriimnim yaha, dama m pala daadam, n nyɛla Naawuni. Mani ŋun be kasi ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, ka n ku kana ni n ti ku niriba.
en: I will not punish you in my anger; I will not destroy Israel again. For I am God and not a mere human being. I, the Holy One, am with you. I will not come to you in anger.

dag: nyini n-daa chɛ ka a dabili ti yab Naa Dauda yaag o noli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni yɛli: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim jɛri suli tahira, ka zuliya kam tɔri jin yoya?.
en: You are the one who spoke by the Holy Spirit through our ancestor David, your servant: Why did the Gentiles rage , and the peoples plot in vain? .

dag: n-yɛri malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu m-mali kikaa maa, Lɔrigim malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛ ni lo n-zali mɔɣ titali din yuli booni Yufretiiz ni la bahi.
en: It said to the sixth angel, who had the trumpet, Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti nyɛ o ni dihiri shɛba, ka nyɛ kaman piɛri be o nuu ni. Di di simdi ni yi wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: He is our God, and we are the people he cares for, his sheep that walk by his side. Listen to his voice today:.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be Damaskus daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Zobahs King Hadadezer, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Arameans.

dag: Daadamnim mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ni tooi be kasi? Bee bɛn nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi shɛb ŋɔ, wula ka bɛ yɛn tooi niŋ nyɛ wuntizɔriba?.
en: People cannot really be pure. They cannot be more right than God!.

dag: Ɛliɛza daa nyɛla Finɛhas ba, ka Finɛhas nyɛ Abishua ba.
en: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas of Abishua.

dag: n-zaŋ o binyɛr wɔɣinli din bɔɣiri wɔɣ maa nti ti bɛ ba ka yɛl o, Ti pihi li mi, lihim li nya, a bia binyɛrigu m-bala bee pa dina.
en: After this, they took the coat to their father and said, We found this! Look at it carefully and see if it belongs to your son.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu paag a sanna ka a tiligi ma kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Listen to my prayer. Save me, as you promised.

dag: O kul ku nyari nir taali sahakam, bee n-jɛri suli sahakam.
en: He does not always criticize. He does not stay angry with us forever.

dag: Chɛ ka di zambu ʒi Jɔab min o ba daŋ zuɣu. Chɛ ka Jɔab daŋ ni kul ku kɔŋ ʒim ni yiri ninvuɣ so ni bee niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali so bee do so ŋun miri gumdi bee bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee ninvuɣ so ŋun kpiri kum.
en: Joab and his family are the guilty ones. I pray that Joab's family will always be sick with sores and other skin diseases. May they all be cowards, and may they die in war or starve to death.

dag: Pashihur daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayopɔin.
en: the descendants of Pashhur:.

dag: Dinzuɣu Iso ni daa nya ka o ba Yisahaku nini bi tiɣi Keenan paɣiba maa.
en: Esau already had several wives, but he now realized how much his father hated the Canaanite women.

dag: N ni chɛ ka sida tihi mini akasia tihi ni mitil tihi ni olivi tihi ni sipirɛs ni oki tihi ni gahi ti galisi mɔɣu ni.
en: I will make trees grow in the desert. There will be cedar, acacias, olive trees, cypress, fir trees, and pines.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Hanna ni, ka o lan dɔɣi bidibis ata mini bipuɣins ayi. Ka Samuɛl daa kul be Yawɛ tooni hal ti zooi.
en: The Lord was kind to Hannah, and she had three more sons and two daughters. But Samuel grew up at the Lord 's house in Shiloh.

dag: Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa vuui daanya bimbin shɛli din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tooni la. O daa vuui li la omaŋmaŋ bimbin la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bimbin la sunsuuni n-zaŋ li zal omaŋmaŋ bimbini maa nuzaa polo.
en: As for the bronze altar that used to stand before the LORD, Ahaz moved it away from the front of the temple where it had stood between the main altar and the LORDs temple. He put it on the north side of the new altar.

dag: Di tuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi n-garigi, ka chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpe m-pali ba?.
en: If you were really wise, you would not answer with your worthless personal opinions! A wise man would not be so full of hot air.

dag: N niriba bɔhiri dari binyara ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi wuhiri ba binyara din ti yɛn niŋ. Dama zina niŋbu n-vo ba kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka bɛ chɛ Naawuni ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: They ask for revelations from a piece of wood! A stick tells them what they want to know! They have left me. Like a woman who becomes a prostitute, they have given themselves to other gods.

dag: N ni zaŋ alikama zaɣ suma dihi ya, ka zaŋ tampiŋ ni shiri tin ya ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: But I would feed you with the finest wheat and satisfy you with wild honey.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ti lomiya tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba; yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba wuntaŋ zuɣusaa dɛde. Mbusim paai ti, dama wuntaŋ luya, ka yuŋ zibira.
en: Get ready to fight against Jerusalem. Get up! We will attack the city at noon. But it is already getting late. The evening shadows are growing long.

dag: Nimaani ka tuumbiɛtumdiba la lu n-doya. Bɛ daai ba mi luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: Put this on their grave markers: Here fell the wicked. They were crushed. They will never stand up again.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli nabihi ni daa gbi. Kolibil shɛli niriba toondaannim ni daa gbi. Nam jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi yɔɣu maa ni chaŋ Matana.
en: With their royal scepters, our leaders pointed out where to dig the well. The Israelites left the desert and camped near the town of Mattanah.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu zaligu din wuhiri ni di nyɛla daɣiri bee di pala daɣiri.
en: in order to determine when it is unclean or clean. This concludes the Instruction concerning skin disease.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha na kul bi bahi tiɣi n nini, ka di daliri nyɛla n ni na kul nyari Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la ka o ʒiini nayili dunol ni la.
en: But none of this makes me happy, as long as I see that Jew Mordecai serving the king.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa; ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Othniel was the son of Calebs brother Kenaz. Othniel defeated that city, so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to Othniel to be his wife.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani ka o yɛli ba, Suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: When he arrived, he said to them, Pray that you wont give in to temptation.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri beni hal ti kurigi ka kul mali yiko pam?.
en: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?.

dag: Zuɣusaa, wumma, tiŋgbani, wumma! Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni wumsi bi shɛb zaɣisi ma.
en: The Lord said, Earth and sky, listen to what I am saying! The children I brought up have rebelled against me.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ. M Ba ni mi ma ka n gba mi m Ba shɛm, lala ka m mi m piɛri ka m piɛri maa gba mi ma; ka n zaŋdi n nyɛvili taɣiri m piɛri maa dini.
en: I am the shepherd who cares for the sheep. I know my sheep just as the Father knows me. And my sheep know me just as I know the Father. I give my life for these sheep.

dag: O nam sagbana niŋ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni na, ka chɛ ka mɔri zoori zoya zuɣu.
en: He fills the sky with clouds. He sends rain to the earth. He makes the grass grow on the mountains.

dag: o chanimi nti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani; ka dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam n-gari di ni daa pun be shɛm; lala nti yɛn niŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ nim gba.
en: Then the evil spirit goes out and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself. They all go and live there, and that person has even more trouble than before. It is the same way with the evil people who live today.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa zani Ariɔpagus jintɔriba maa sunsuuni yɛli, Yinim Atɛnsinim ŋɔ, n nyaya ka yi doli yi jɛmbu soli viɛnyɛliŋga shɛlikam puuni.
en: Paul stood up in the middle of the council on Mars Hill and said, People of Athens, I see that you are very religious in every way.

dag: n-daa tim ba Iddo ŋun daa nyɛ Kasifiya fɔŋ zuɣulan la sani ka yɛli ba bɛ ni ti yɛn yɛli Iddo min o tab bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba Kasifiya shɛm. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ tim ti tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: I sent them to Iddo, the leader at the place named Casiphia, telling them what to say to Iddo and his colleagues the temple servants at Casiphia, namely, to send us ministers for Gods house.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Dolintab biɛr biɛɣu dolibu saɣindi biɛrisuŋ.
en: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Bɛtani, ka o daa kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: He led them out as far as Bethany, where he lifted his hands and blessed them.

dag: O zaŋd o bumbil lɔri wain tia, ka zaŋd o bunsaa bia lɔri wain ti viɛlli. O zaŋdi wain paɣir o situra, ka zaŋdi wain wala kom paɣir o binyɛr titali.
en: He ties his male donkey to the vine, the colt of his female donkey to the vines branches. He washes his clothes in wine, his garments in the blood of grapes.

dag: Naa ni daa yi niŋdi shɛm nyɛla o bɔhi baŋdiba baŋ zaligu mini kaya ni nyɛ shɛm, dinzuɣu ka o daa tim ti bol o saawaranim bɛn ni tooi baŋ bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm na.
en: Now it was the king's custom to ask for expert opinion on questions of law and order, so he called for his advisers, who would know what should be done.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ teebul la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nuzaa polo pateesa la nyaaŋa.
en: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbir anahi daa yi teeku maa ni na, bɛ zaa mi daa bela kɔŋkɔba.
en: I saw four big animals and each one was different from the others. These four animals came up out of the sea.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Iin, lala n-nyɛ ma; ka yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: Yes, I am! Jesus answered. Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful, and coming with the clouds of heaven.

dag: N dol a zaligunim min a wuhibu, dama a mi n soya zaa.
en: I obey all your instructions and rules, because you know everything I do.

dag: Nyama, m bi ʒe yi nyaaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni nyo yi chɛchɛbunsi buɣim ka di gbili nyɔhi, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gbuɣim pola. N ni ti mɔŋ ya bindirigu, ka so ti ku lan wum yi tuumba kukoya.
en: I am your enemy! says the Lord Almighty. I will burn up your chariots. Your soldiers will be killed in war, and I will take away everything that you took from others. The demands of your envoys will no longer be heard.

dag: Kamiyana ka yi mini n dan Asiria naa maa puli. Yi yi ni tooi nya wɔribariba, n ni tin ya yuri tusaayi.
en: If you still want to fight, my master, the king of Assyria, will make this agreement with you. I promise that I will give you horses if you can find enough men to ride them into battle.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Naawuni ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di kari doli bɛ gbini, amaa ŋmam bɛ noli nti liri ba balisam tihi la tooni.
en: David again asked Gods advice, but God answered, Dont attack them directly. Circle around behind them and come at them from in front of the balsam trees.

dag: Kokpɛɣu, yom vuri kaman nuhi kpahibu vuri la. Kunkuna, laɣimmiya yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ tooni.
en: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.

dag: Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ti banima, ka gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: That is why our ancestors were killed in battle. Our sons, daughters, and wives were made prisoners.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa kar o yihi Idɛn puu maa ni ni o ti kɔr o ni daa yi tiŋgban shɛli ni na maa.
en: So the Lord God sent them out of the Garden of Eden, where they would have to work the ground from which the man had been made.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari doli Naa Sool min o bidibisi nti ku Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: But the Philistines caught up with them and killed three of Saul's sons, Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

dag: Saha paaya ni n nyɛvili leei sara maligu Naawuni sani; n dunia ŋɔ ni yibu saha miriya.
en: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.

dag: Duumanima, niŋmiya yi daba din niŋ kamaata, dama yi mi ni yi gba mali Duuma alizanda ni.
en: Masters, give what is good and fair to your servants. Remember that you have a Master in heaven.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu ni nahim tin shɛli, ka di bi nya sɔŋsim ŋɔ, n ni zaŋ kuɣ viɛla me a zali, ka zaŋ safaya kuɣa sɔŋ a tanzaa.
en: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord , will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.

dag: Bɛ saɣim ti wain tihi, ka ŋub ti fiig tihi. Bɛ ŋub puɣisi di tipaɣiri hal ka di wula zaa ti leela zaɣ piɛla.
en: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.

dag: Pool ni daa kul yɛn yaag o noli saha shɛli ka Gallio dii yɛli ba, Yinim Yɛhudianim ŋɔ, di yi di nyɛla tuun gala bee tuumbiɛ shɛli ka o tum ka yi tah o ŋɔ na, n naan wum yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Paul was ready to say something, but Gallio spoke to the Jews. He said, I would listen to you if your complaint was about a crime or other wrong.

dag: Di yi nyɛla lala, ti Naawuni so ti ni jɛmdi maa yi ni tooi yihi ti buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni, o ni yihi ti, ka ni lan yihi ti a gba nuu ni.
