en: If the God whom we serve is able to save us from the blazing furnace and from your power, then he will.

dag: Masia ni daa kpe tanti duu la puuni n-gari ti kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee yim ka di naai zaa la, pa buhi mini naɣibihi ʒim ka o daa zaŋ mali sara, amaa omaŋmaŋ ʒim ka o daa zaŋ mali sara n-deei tiliginsim din ka bahigu Naawuni sani ti ti.
en: He entered the holy of holies once for all by his own blood, not by the blood of goats or calves, securing our deliverance for all time.

dag: Bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni zaŋdi bɛ noya saɣindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, amaa baŋsim chɛ ka wuntizɔriba nyari faako.
en: With their words hypocrites can destroy their neighbors. But with what they know, good people can escape.

dag: Mɔabnim zaa ni daa wum ni nanim shɛb kana ni bɛ ti tuhi ba, bɛ daa laɣimla bipola zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa bɛn ni tooi ye gbaɣinɔnim na nti sɔŋ bɛ tintariga.
en: The Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them. So they gathered together all the men old enough to wear armor and waited at the border.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti lab nyaaŋa, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima, dama niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: And Jesus concluded, So those who are last will be first, and those who are first will be last.

dag: Ɛlihu daa guhirimi ni bɛ naai pɔi ka o naanyi tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa, dama bɛna n-daa nyɛ ninkura.
en: Elihu had waited while Job spoke, for they were older than he.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka vi gbahi o dimnim zaa; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa suhuri daa paligi tuun kar shɛŋa o ni tum maa zuɣu.
en: When he said these things, all his opponents were put to shame, but all those in the crowd rejoiced at all the extraordinary things he was doing.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri naŋgbankpeeni mini woligibu din chihiri wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa pun dee la nol la. Kaɣimiya ba!.
en: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to watch out for people who create divisions and problems against the teaching that you learned. Keep away from them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ti naai ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa Masia zuɣu la sanna, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni tuma niŋ ti gba nuu ni.
en: All this is done by God, who through Christ changed us from enemies into his friends and gave us the task of making others his friends also.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti ni yɛli? Ti tummi alahichi ti ni lan ka fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ka bela Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni maa zuɣu? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Balaam, Di doli ba chaŋ, a mi miri ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla alibarika ni be shɛb ni.
en: God said to Balaam, Do not go with them, and do not put a curse on the people of Israel, because they have my blessing.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka dabiɛm mali ba ka di gari ba pahi, ka bɛ daa ŋmanila tuturi mini mɔri ni mɔ shɛŋa din sa mɔpila zuɣu, ka mɔri dɔro gbaai li ka di kɔŋ zoobu.
en: The people in the cities had no power. They were afraid and confused. They were about to be cut down like grass and plants in the field. They were like grass growing on the housetops, dying before it grows tall.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam Balaam ni daa chani maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ ti zani sol ni n-gu o soli. Balaam daa barila buŋa, ka o tumtumdiba ayi be o sani.
en: Balaam was riding on his donkey. Two of his servants were with him. While Balaam was traveling, God became angry. So the Lord s angel stood in the road in front of Balaam to stop him.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Kom ŋɔ zɔri kparila wulimpuhili polo yaɣili n-zɔri chani Araba vinvamli ni. Ka di yi zo nti lu teeku kom din bi zɔri ŋɔ ni, teeku kom maa ni niŋ ko nyaɣisili.
en: He said to me, This water flows through the land to the east and down into the Jordan Valley and to the Dead Sea. When it flows into the Dead Sea, it replaces the salt water of that sea with fresh water.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka zuliya balibu kam nianim kpalindi yoli; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm zaani soli.
en: The Lord can ruin every decision the nations make. He can spoil all their plans.

dag: Ka n daa wum di yɛla, ka n ni sɔhira, ka n naŋgbampiba ŋmɛri tab di vuri zuɣu, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi ka n naba sɔhira. N kul yɛn shinimi ka guhiri dahin shɛli mbusim ni ti yɛn lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kana ti liri ti maa zuɣu.
en: My whole body shook when I heard the story. My lips trembled. I felt weak deep down in my bones and stood there shaking. But I will wait patiently for destruction to come to those who attack us.

dag: Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri ni o yi gbuɣinli gbaabu ni nti tuhi biŋkɔb so ŋun bie n-gari gbuɣinli soli bee nir yi kpe duu nti zaŋ o nuu dihi dukpini, ka wahu dim o la.
en: You will be like someone who escapes from a lion only to be attacked by a bear, or like someone who goes into the safety of his house, leans against the wall, and is bitten by a snake.

dag: Dama bɛ ma daa gɔrila pagɔrisigu; paɣ so ŋun daa tiɣi bɛ pua daa tumla vi tuma. Dama o daa yɛliya, N ni chaŋ m mamanim bɛn tiri ma bindirigu mini kom ni ago ni atampanima ni kpam ni dam ŋɔ sani.
en: Their mother has acted like a prostitute. She should be ashamed of what she did. She said, I will go to my lovers, who give me food and water, wool and linen, wine and olive oil.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di zɔr o; dama n zaŋ o min o niriba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niŋ a nuu ni, niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la shɛm la.
en: The LORD said to Moses: Dont be afraid of him, for I have handed over all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon the Amorite king who ruled in Heshbon.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yiinila yila maani ma ansarisi, ka n leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi.
en: Now they come and laugh at me; I am nothing but a joke to them.

dag: Dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyari bilila n niriba tiŋgban ni. Iin, kummiya suhupiɛlli ni daa be yil shɛŋa ni mini tin shɛl ni la zuɣu.
en: Cry for the land of my people. Cry because only thorns and weeds will grow there. Cry for the city and for all the houses that were once filled with joy.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu; yi nyɛla wain nyur wɔɣira, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm ni yi zaŋ binnyura gari taba.
en: Doom to the wine-swigging warriors, mighty at mixing drinks.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Laodisia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ Ami, ka be tibi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana ni ŋun daa tab Naawuni binshɛɣukam nambu ni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: This is the message from the Amen, the faithful and true witness, who is the origin of all that God has created.

dag: Bɛ di ti kpuɣi pakoli bee n-kpuɣi paɣ so ŋun yi doo yili. Amaa di simdi ni bɛ ti kpuɣila paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Izraɛlnim zuliya ni bee bɛ ni tooi kpuɣi maligumaana pakoli.
en: The priests must not marry a widow or a divorced woman. No, they must only marry a virgin from the family of Israel or a woman whose dead husband was a priest.

dag: O ni yɛn doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o ti lan yɛn ŋmaligi dol labi ka ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: As surely as I am the Lord , he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, saha yuusim wula ka yi kul bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi maa ni? Saha yuusim wula ka ansarisimaaniba kul yɛn be ansarisi malibu ni? Ka saha yuusim wula ka jɛra kul yɛn zaɣisiri yɛm?.
en: Fools, how long will you love being ignorant? How long will you make fun of wisdom? How long will you hate knowledge?.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ti ni ti kari malaikanim gba saria? Ka di yi nyɛ lala, dindina ti ni tooi kari ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu yɛla saria gari lala!.
en: You know that in the future we will judge angels. So surely we can judge lifes ordinary problems.

dag: Doliya yi ni bɔhim shɛli mini yi ni deei shɛli n san la zaŋ tabili n yɛtɔɣa mini n tuma; ka Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la ni be yi sani.
en: Practice these things: whatever you learned, received, heard, or saw in us. The God of peace will be with you.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa boli Ibrahimma na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a ka a ti chɛ ka m mini n nam ŋɔ tum alahichi titali ŋɔ? A niŋ ma di ni bi simdi ni nir niŋ o kpee shɛm.
en: Then Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, Why have you done this to us? What wrong did I do to you? Why did you lie and say that she was your sister? You brought great trouble to my kingdom. You should not have done this to me.

dag: Ka yi ni diri ka nyur la, pa yimaŋmaŋ kɔre ka yi niŋdi lala kura? .
en: And when you ate and drank, was that for me? No, it was for your own good.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋun niŋ alibarika kam din nyɛ alizanda ni alibarika niŋ ti ni Masia zuɣu ŋɔ!.
en: Let us give thanks to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! For in our union with Christ he has blessed us by giving us every spiritual blessing in the heavenly world.

dag: Ka salo maa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: The crowds asked him, What then should we do.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla ŋun paai yuma anu zaŋ hal ni yuun pisi, doo daa yɛn nyɛla bini pisi, ka paɣ mi nyɛ bini pia.
en: The price for a man from to years old is shekels. For a woman the price is shekels.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la. .
en: Two women will be together grinding wheat, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, ti ni so bi be o polo. Amaa anabi Ilaisha ŋun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-yɛri Izraɛl naa a ni be a duu tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam.
en: One of the officers of the king of Aram said, My lord and king, not one of us is a spy. Elisha, the prophet from Israel, can tell the king of Israel many secret things—even the words that you speak in your bedroom.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa yihi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya ni salima ni ŋun maŋmaŋ Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa zaŋ salima shɛli m-mali dunoya la pahi n-zaŋ ti Asiria naa maa.
en: That is when Hezekiah cut off the gold that he had put on the doors and doorposts of the Lord s Temple and gave it to the king of Assyria.

dag: O ni daa yɛli do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa ni o moomi buɣim maa kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni maa, ka o daa kpe di puuni ti zani baɣili kalinli yini.
en: God had given the man dressed in linen clothes a command. He had told him to go into the area between the wheels among the Cherub angels and get some hot coals. So the man went there and stood by the wheel.

dag: Di chɛliya ka peentɔra nya soli to piɛm, yi mi di chɛliya ka o nya soli ye kuriti gbaɣino. Di chɛnya o nachimba. Kummiya o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: Let the archers draw their bows; let them prepare their armor. Show no mercy to her young men; wipe out her entire company!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M ma mini n tizɔbihi nyɛla bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dol li.
en: He replied, My mother and brothers are those who listen to Gods word and do it.

dag: Di saha maa n ni ti yɛli ba, Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, m bi min ya. Wariya! .
en: Then I will tell those people clearly, Get away from me, you people who do wrong. I never knew you.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli naa, Cham ti niŋ a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛm, Yawɛ ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Nathan said to King David, Do whatever you want to do. The Lord will be with you.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba nyɛla Galili nira yɔɣɔ? Vihim Naawuni Kundi! A yi vihi li, a ni nya ka di bi wuhi ni anab so ni ti yi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: Well, they answered, are you also from Galilee? Study the Scriptures and you will learn that no prophet ever comes from Galilee.

dag: Di daa lan ŋmaligi kpala nuzaa polo n-chaŋ hal ti paai Ɛnshɛmɛsh n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ni Gɛlilɔt din be Adumim bimbini tooni la. Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini.
en: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ bi kɔŋ zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, dama Masia zaligu sulinsi ni ka m be, amaa n yi chaŋla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu sani, m bemi kaman ŋun bi doli fukumsi zaligu ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu maa.
en: In the same way, when working with Gentiles, I live like a Gentile, outside the Jewish Law, in order to win Gentiles. This does not mean that I don't obey God's law; I am really under Christ's law.

dag: Dama bɛ daa lan mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee mini binchunchuna zali, ka me buɣili Ashɛrim binnana n-tamtam zoli kam zuɣu; ka me shɛŋa mi zali timahili kam gbini.
en: They built places of worship for false gods and put up stone pillars and symbols of Asherah to worship on the hills and under shady trees.

dag: nyin be a alizanda ni; ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: listen to their prayers. Hear them in heaven and give them victory.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n nya a, ka ti nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi.
en: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.

dag: Apaim bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ishi, Ishi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛshan, Shɛshan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ahilai.
en: Appaim was the father of Ishi, Ishi was the father of Sheshan, and Sheshan the father of Ahlai.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa ysɛli Anabi Hosea litaafi ni: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa n niriba, n ni boli ba, N niriba. Ka zuliya shɛb n ni bi yura, n ni boli ba, N ninvuɣ yurisi.
en: This is what he says in the book of Hosea: The people who were not mine I will call My People. The nation that I did not love I will call My Beloved.

dag: Wuhim ma a nirilim shihirili, ka lala chɛ ka bɛnkam je ma la nya li ka di vi; dama nyini Yawɛ pun sɔŋ ma ka maai n suhu.
en: Show me proof of your goodness, Lord ; those who hate me will be ashamed when they see that you have given me comfort and help.

dag: Ka Ɛliab mi zuliya daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛl mini Datan ni Abiram. Datan mini Abiram daa nyɛla niriba ni daa pii shɛba. Bɛna n-daa pahi Kɔra min o nyaaŋa zuɣu n-taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka yɛli Musa mini Aduna finafina.
en: and his sons Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram who were chosen by the community. They defied Moses and Aaron and joined the followers of Korah when they rebelled against the Lord .

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya. Naawuni daa zaŋ ba leeg o bihi ka chɛ ka bɛ mal omaŋmaŋ jilima; ka daa lo ba alikauli ka zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunima ti ba; ka daa wuhi ba o jɛmbu soli ka lo ba alikaulinima.
en: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.

dag: O ni daa paai ni, o daa kuhila fabila kuhigu m-boli Daniɛl bɔh o, Daniɛl, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ dabili ŋɔ, a Naawuni so a ni jɛmdi viɛnyɛliŋga maa tooi fa a gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi.
en: When he got there, he called out anxiously, Daniel, servant of the living God! Was the God you serve so loyally able to save you from the lions.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas mini Pool bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba la daa wum lala ka dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka zo nti kpe salo maa ni kuhiri yɛra.
en: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti liri tiŋgbɔn shɛli nim bɛn bi me goma gili bɛ tiŋkpansi ŋɔ. N ni chaŋ ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim ni suhudoo, ka bɛ zaa so bi me goma gili bɛ tinsi, ka mi ka dunokparita bee dunoyɔriti ŋɔ.
en: You will say, I will go attack the country that has towns without walls. The people there live in peace and think they are safe. There are no walls around the cities to protect them. They dont have any locks on their gates—they dont even have gates!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool tahi bɛ jintɔriba laɣiŋgu shee din yuli daa booni Ariɔpagus la ti yɛl o, Ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti wuhiri pal shɛli a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, Tell us what your new teaching is all about.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, zaŋmiya yi dunia ŋɔ laɣ yoya ŋɔ bo simdi, ka di yi ti naai, yi ni tooi kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee.
en: I tell you, use the worldly things you have now to make friends for later. Then, when those things are gone, you will be welcomed into a home that lasts forever.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisa pam, amaa nyin filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee!.
en: They replied, This is what you should tell them: My little finger is thicker than my father's waist.

dag: ka tahima niŋbu mi zuɣu ku chɛ ka ti suhuri miligi, dama Naawuni zaŋ o yurilim niŋ ti suhuri ni o Shia Kasi so o ni zaŋ ti ti la zuɣu.
en: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.

dag: Nyama, ka Kush nir la gba daa ti paana nti yɛli, Lahibal suŋ ka n ʒina ni n ti ti nyini n dan naa, dama zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ fa a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: Then the Cushite arrived and said, My master the king: Listen to this good news! The LORD has vindicated you this day against the power of all who rose up against you.

dag: din nyɛ o ni daa po pɔ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma polo la yɛla.
en: the solemn pledge he made to our ancestor Abraham. He has granted.

dag: ni yi paɣiba ni yi bihi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani, ka nyɛ bɛn wɔriti yi dari bee bɛn ŋɔŋdi kom tiri ya.
en: women, and children, and the foreigners who live among you and cut wood and carry water for you.

dag: N lan bɔri ni paɣiba gba zaŋdi situra din veeni ba ka ku mali galimi ka nyɛ din simdi m-maani bɛmaŋa, ka pa ni zuɣuri pambu mini salima ni waya yɛri yɛbu ni binyara din mali shaara zaŋ niŋ bɛmaŋa;.
en: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.

dag: Bɛ yi duɣi nimdi maa, Maligumaana ŋun yihim piɛ bɔɣu, ka pii maha din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini piɛɣu ni, ka pii karikaasi din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li niŋ Nazari nir maa nuhi ni o ni zaŋ o zuɣu shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri pinibu nyaaŋa.
en: After the Nazirites have cut off their hair, the priest will give them a boiled shoulder from the ram and a large and a small cake from the basket. Both of these cakes are made without yeast.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛm mini wuhibu yɛla bɔhimbu din ni sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ ashili yɛtɔɣa baŋbu polo.
en: Their purpose is to teach wisdom and discipline, to help one understand wise sayings.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi, Daŋ shɛli beni ka di niriba bi ka Mizipa na Yawɛ sani laɣiŋgu ŋɔ ni? Dama bɛ daa pun pola pɔri yɛli ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ka Mizipa na Yawɛ sani laɣiŋgu maa ni, bɛn kum o.
en: Then they asked each other, Did any of the tribes of Israel fail to come to the place of worship? We made a sacred promise that anyone who didn't come to the meeting at Mizpah would be put to death.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa nyɛ Mɛtusɛla bia, ka Mɛtusɛla nyɛ Inok bia, ka Inok nyɛ Jarɛd bia, ka Jarɛd nyɛ Mahalalɛl bia, ka Mahalalɛl mi nyɛ Kɛnan so bia.
en: Lamech was the son of Methuselah. Methuselah was the son of Enoch. Enoch was the son of Jared. Jared was the son of Mahalaleel. Mahalaleel was the son of Cainan.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi la. N ni zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a zuliya maa, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: I will make your family as many as the stars of heaven, and I will give all these lands to your family. Through your descendants every nation on earth will be blessed.

dag: Nyin ŋun tɛha bi zilimmi ŋɔ, a bɔri ni so n-wuh a ni yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma nyɛla yɛda ŋoli?.
en: You fool! Faith that does nothing is worth nothing. Do you want me to prove this to you?.

dag: Soli maa yɛliŋ daa chaŋ ti gbaala dundɔntitali maa gooni la. Nudirigu polo zaŋ labi palo din daa doya la tooni, duri daa lan beni.
en: These chambers were entered from the outer courtyard at the end of the courtyard wall, because the entrance was at the end of the chambers at the east. South of the yard and the building, there were more chambers with a passage.

dag: Amaa dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam, ka dabiɛm maa tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Dama man Naawuni ni to n-wurim ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba. Bɛ ni di vi, dama man Naawuni zaɣisi ba.
en: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.

dag: Bee nir yi yaag o noli po yiriŋ ni o ni niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi po pɔri kam yiriŋ ka bi baŋ, o yi ti baŋ, o mali taali di puuni.
en: or by carelessly swearing to do something, whether bad or good—whatever one might swear carelessly—and the fact goes unknown, but you later learn of it and become guilty of sin concerning one of these things.

dag: Dama n tɛhiya ni Naawuni zaŋ tinim tuumba ŋɔ zalila zaashe shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni, ka ti be kaman bɛ ni bahi noli ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb palɔni, ka leei malaikanim mini ninsalinim ni lihiri shɛb ninliha dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: For it seems to me that God has given the very last place to us apostles, like people condemned to die in public as a spectacle for the whole world of angels and of human beings.

dag: Bɛ di ti zaŋ li kɔhi bee n-zaŋ li taɣi so dini. Bɛ di ti zaŋ tiŋgbani kasi maa taɣi ti so. Dama di nyɛla tiŋgban kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: The area dedicated to the Lord is the best part of all the land, and none of it may be sold or exchanged or transferred to anyone else. It is holy and belongs to the Lord .

dag: Yi wulimpuhili polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Hazarɛnan hal ni Shɛfam.
en: The eastern border will follow a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa yaha, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: God also said to Moses: I am the LORD.

dag: Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la n-daa su tɔbbihi Fukumsi, ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la daa nyɛ ŋun sabiri gbana sɔŋda.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani n-tuhi ninvuɣ biɛri ti ma? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani tuhi tuumbiɛtumdiba ti ma?.
en: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?.

dag: Amaa nyin kul dol a ni daa bɔhim yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa yɛla ka niŋ li yɛda la viɛnyɛliŋga. A mi a karimbanim ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: But as for you, continue in the truths that you were taught and firmly believe. You know who your teachers were.

dag: Ka Napaɣ Ɛsta ŋun daa nyɛ Abiheel bia la daa pahi Mɔdɛkai zuɣu ka bɛ sab gban shɛli din pah ayi zaŋ chaŋ Purim chuɣu puhibu maa yɛla polo.
en: Then Queen Esther, the daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai, also wrote a letter, putting her full authority behind the letter about Purim, which Mordecai had written earlier.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka tinim bɛn daa tuui mali tahima Masia ni la chɛ ka ti biɛhigu nyɛ din tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: We are called to be an honor to Gods glory because we were the first to hope in Christ.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana soli zuɣu kul zibigila gɔhi, amaa ŋun tumdi din tuhi soli nyɛla solɔɣu.
en: For lazy people, life is a path overgrown with thorns and thistles. For those who do what is right, it is a smooth highway.

dag: Ka Pita daa kpalim Jɔpa, Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ gbanzab la yiŋa n-niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: Peter stayed in Joppa for many days at the home of a man named Simon, who was a leatherworker.

dag: Yɛlim Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda gomna la ni di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: Go to Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah and tell him that I will shake heaven and earth.

dag: N dabeenzɔbo puuni n daa yɛliya, Bɛ kari ma a sani tahi katiŋa. Amaa ka n daa kuhi niŋ a bɔri sɔŋsim, ka a daa wum n ni kuhi niŋ a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu maa.
en: I was afraid and said, I am in a place where he cannot see me. But I prayed to you, and you heard my loud cries for help.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda ka bɔhira, Masia yi ti kana, o ni wuhi shihira n-lan gari doo ŋɔ ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: Many from that crowd believed in Jesus. They said, When the Christ comes, will he do more miraculous signs than this man does.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; miri ka a di zalinsi; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: And you know his commands: You must not murder anyone, you must not commit adultery, you must not steal, you must not lie, you must not cheat, you must respect your father and mother .... .

dag: Paɣ maa yi dɔɣila bipuɣiŋga, o ni be daɣiri ni biɛɣu pinaanahi kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la. Di nyaaŋa o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: For fourteen days after a woman gives birth to a daughter, she is ritually unclean, as she is during her monthly period. Then it will be sixty-six more days until she is ritually clean from her loss of blood.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣina ti pali bia maa ba Zakaria, ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra.
en: John's father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit, and he spoke God's message:.

dag: dama m mi ni di ku lan yuui ka n kani kaman ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni kahigi wuhi ma shɛm.
en: I know that I shall soon put off this mortal body, as our Lord Jesus Christ plainly told me.

dag: O ni daa nya salo maa, ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn nyari nahiŋgu ka bi nyari sɔŋsim; bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: As he saw the crowds, his heart was filled with pity for them, because they were worried and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum lala ka saɣi ti li.
en: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.

dag: Yisa daa na bi paai Bɛtani tiŋ puuni; o daa na kul bela Maata ni tuh o soli luɣ shɛli maa.
en: He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi kuhi boli bɛ ni bi niŋ so yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi niŋ bɛ ni na bi wum so yɛla yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi wum ka pa ni waazuyihira m-beni?.
en: But how can they call to him for help if they have not believed? And how can they believe if they have not heard the message? And how can they hear if the message is not proclaimed?.

dag: n yi ti sahi n takɔb shɛli din nyaɣisiri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ saria karibu niŋ n nuu ni, n ni bɔhi n dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je ma la tibili.
en: when I sharpen my blazing sword and my hand grabs hold of justice, Ill pay my enemies back; Ill punish in kind everyone who hates me.

dag: Zaligu tanzaa yi wurim, wula ka wuntizɔra yɛn niŋ?.
en: When the very bottom of things falls out, what can a righteous person possibly accomplish?.

dag: A chɛ ka n nini kɔŋ pɔbbu, ka di muɣisi ma pam hal ka n ti kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: You would not let me sleep. I tried to say something, but I was too upset.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya n ni lo nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo mini n ni yɛn niŋ Tɛmannim shɛm. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ niriba dabiɛm.
en: So listen to the plan that I have made against the people of Edom, and to what I intend to do to the people of the city of Teman. Even their children will be dragged off, and everyone will be horrified.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, ka mmaŋmaŋ gba bɔhi baŋ dinkam daa niŋ maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɛhi ni di simdi ni n gba sab di yɛla ti a.
en: So I made a careful study of everything and then decided to write and tell you exactly what took place. Honorable Theophilus.

dag: bɛ yi ti baŋ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛli maa saha shɛli, bɛ laɣiŋgu maa bɛn zaŋmi naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu. Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini na.
en: then as soon as the sin becomes known, the community shall bring a young bull as a sin offering. They shall bring it to the Tent of the Lord 's presence;.

dag: Doo yi na yoli niŋ amiliya, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka o doli tɔbbihi chaŋ tɔb ni bee n-chɛ ka o tum tuma lala tatabo, amaa di simdi ni bɛ chɛ o ka o be yiŋ yuun yini, ka o min o ni kpuɣi paɣ so maa laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: When a man is newly married, he is not to be drafted into military service or any other public duty; he is to be excused from duty for one year, so that he can stay at home and make his wife happy.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nambɔzɔbo kpe Ashpɛnaz suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: Now God had established faithful loyalty between Daniel and the chief official.

dag: Ka bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa zaa daa niŋ lala, ka chɛ bɛ firilanim gbib bɛ nuzahi ni, ka gbib kikahi mi bɛ nudiriti ni m-piɛbiri ka kuhiri yɛra, Yawɛ mini Gidiɔn takɔbi.
en: The rest of Gideon's soldiers blew the trumpets they were holding in their right hands. Then they smashed the jars and held the burning torches in their left hands. Everyone shouted, Fight with your swords for the Lord and for Gideon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Atad kabɔɣili din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la shee, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum nandahima kumsi nimaani; ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daba ayopɔin kum o ba kuli nimaani.
en: After crossing the Jordan River, Joseph stopped at Atad's threshing place, where they all mourned and wept seven days for Jacob.

dag: N wum a ni suhi ma suhigu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ishimail gba polo maa. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam. O ni ti nyɛla nanim pinaayi yaba, ka n chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: You mentioned Ishmael, and I heard you. I will bless him, and he will have many children. He will be the father of twelve great leaders. His family will become a great nation.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya, ka na ʒi n-leei so daba; ka di chaŋ wula ka a ti yɛli ni ti ni yi dabitim ni.
en: They answered, We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free.

dag: Ka pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Ribɛka ni daa zaŋ jahi pua ti yab Yisahaku sani.
en: Not only that, but also Rebecca conceived children with one man, our ancestor Isaac.

dag: Ti tiligimi kaman nooŋa n-tiligi tɔha tɔŋ gbaabu ni la. Tɔha tɔŋ kabiya ka ti tiligi.
en: We have escaped like a bird from a hunter's trap; the trap is broken, and we are free!.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛl o nachimba maa, Ʒiɛnya buŋ ŋɔ sani, ka m mini bia ŋɔ chaŋ kpe ha ti jɛm Naawuni ka labina.
en: Abraham said to his servants, Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will walk up there, worship, and then come back to you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o dɔɣiriba ni o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: But Jesus said, Prophets are honored by everyone, except the people of their hometown and their relatives and their own family.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa chaŋ ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali ti paai Samaria n-daa teei gil li hal ka di ti paai yuma ata.
en: The king of Assyria attacked many places in Israel. Then he came to Samaria and fought against it for three years.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a mi Sool ni niŋ shɛm, o kari bukpahinim mini jinwariba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka wula ka a ti kana ti bari n nyɛvili tɔŋ ni a chɛ ka n kpi.
en: Listen, the woman said to him, you know what Saul has done, how he has banned all mediums and diviners from the land. What are you doing? Trying to get me killed.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya o ninni, ka o yuli ni ti sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.

dag: N ni niŋ a daŋ niriba kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba mini Ahija bia Baasha daŋ niriba shɛm la, a ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi, ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu.
en: I will destroy your family just as I destroyed the families of King Jeroboam son of Nebat and King Baasha. I will do this to you because you have made me angry and you have caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli: N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor then motioned to Paul to speak, and Paul said, I know that you have been a judge over this nation for many years, and so I am happy to defend myself before you.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn naa Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia daa biɛra, amaa ka nya alaafee, ka o daa sab gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: At that time, Babylons King Merodach-baladan, Baladans son, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been ill and had recovered.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛli yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ o ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti na la:.
en: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisinahi.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti! Ti bi tum yi ni so taali; ti bi saɣim yi ni so; ti mi bi di yi ni so zalinsi.
en: Make room in your hearts for us. We didnt do anything wrong to anyone. We didnt ruin anyone. We didnt take advantage of anyone.

dag: Amaa ti ni bi bɔri ni ti miligi bɛ suhuri zuɣu, cham teeku ni nti zaŋ ziŋgoo bahi, ka di ni ti tuui gbaai zin so, a yi yaag o noli, a ni nya liɣiri di ni n-zaŋ ti tɔhi m min a zuɣu.
en: But just so we dont offend them, go to the lake, throw out a fishing line and hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a shekel coin. Take it and pay the tax for both of us.

dag: Dinzuɣu mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini kunduna ni taatahi n-ni ti be Babilɔn. Niriba ti ku lan be di ni yaha, ka so mi ku lan ʒini di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Babylon will never again be filled with people. Wild dogs, ostriches, and other desert animals will live there. But no one will live there ever again.

dag: Bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni; dama nir na ʒi m-pɔhi fiig tia wala goo zuɣu, ka so mi na ʒi m-pɔhi gaya pirinkpaŋ zuɣu.
en: Every tree is known by the kind of fruit it produces. You wont find figs on thorny weeds. And you cant pick grapes from thornbushes!.

dag: Ka ti mi yi yihi yɛli ni ti bi tum alahichi, dindina ti zaŋ Naawuni leela ʒirilana, ka o yɛligu ka ti ni.
en: If we say that we have not sinned, we are saying that God is a liar and that we dont accept his true teaching.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛm mini wuhibu yɛla bɔhimbu din ni sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ ashili yɛtɔɣa baŋbu polo.
en: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.

dag: Yi gba maŋmaŋ daa bela zibisim ni, amaa ti Duuma ni, yi yipa leela bɛn be neesim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu benya kaman neesim ni niriba.
en: In the past you were full of darkness, but now you are full of light in the Lord. So live like children who belong to the light.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Yisa daa lab Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daa mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Then Jesus returned to Galilee, and the power of the Holy Spirit was with him. The news about him spread throughout all that territory.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi suɣili maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ zaɣ yini.
en: The workers made bronze rings to join the two groups of curtains together to form one tent.

dag: Ka o daa bahi niriba maa dabisi shɛli din pahi daba anii dali. Ka bɛ daa paɣi naa, ka kuli bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛŋa niŋ o dabili Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: Then on the eighth day, he sent everyone home. They said goodbye and left, very happy, because of all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.

dag: A me a yili tamla zuɣusaa kom zuɣu, ka zaŋ sagbana leeg a chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ba pɔhim kpiŋkpama.
en: and built your home on the waters above. You use the clouds as your chariot and ride on the wings of the wind.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali kuɣ viɛla zaŋ li ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa daazichi ni be luɣ shɛli, ka Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya nir la daa gul li.
en: People who had valuable stones gave them to the Lord s Temple. Jehiel took care of the valuable stones. He was from the Gershon family.

dag: Bɛn tɛha bi zilima bɛn kul niŋdila binshɛɣukam yɛda, amaa yɛnnim bɛn kpahindila yɛla ni chani shɛm.
en: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, yin miriya ka yi ti tumdi zuliya shɛb bɛn be nimaani tuun shɛŋa din tumbu chihiri la.
en: When you come into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, don't follow the disgusting practices of the nations that are there.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Yawɛ ni bɛ tumd o tuma, ka yur o, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn zaa gbibi Vuhim Dabisili ka bi saɣindi di zaligunima, ka gbibi n daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: And the Lord says to those foreigners who become part of his people, who love him and serve him, who observe the Sabbath and faithfully keep his covenant:.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni jɛm a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ka tum din tuhi a sani shɛm yɛla; ka daa kum pam.
en: Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord . I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right. After this, he cried hard.

dag: Ka Leeban daa boli di yuli Jɛgarisahaduta; ka Yaakubu mi boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban named it Jegar Sahadutha, while Jacob named it Galeed.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa daa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa yɛli ba shɛm la, Labimiyana dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali.
en: Three days later, Jeroboam and all the people came back to Rehoboam, just as he had told them to do.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan nyɛ ŋun maari ti suhuri ti wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka ti gba tooi zaŋ suhumaabo shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni mali maari ti suhuri maa m-maari bɛn zaa nyari wahala balibu kam suhuri.
en: He comforts us every time we have trouble so that when others have trouble, we can comfort them with the same comfort God gives us.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ ŋun Yisa yɛda ni daa ti yɛn deela yɛla ka o daa yɛri ba maa; dama Naawuni daa na bi tim o Shia Kasi na, Yisa ni daa na bi nya jilima shɛli din doli o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la zuɣu.
en: Jesus said this concerning the Spirit. Those who believed in him would soon receive the Spirit, but they hadnt experienced the Spirit yet since Jesus hadnt yet been glorified.

dag: Sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu daaŋa ni ti nyɛla mita ayi, ka daaŋa maa zuɣu zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ti nyɛ mita ayi, ka mali binyila anahi.
en: The place for the fire on the altar was cubits high. The four corners were shaped like horns.

dag: So bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla dunia ni, ka bɛ yuya lan ka solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: Their fame is ended at home and abroad; no one remembers them any more.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niriba chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Nɛtania bia Ishimail. Bɛ daa ti paag o la Gibiɔn been tital la ni.
en: So Johanan and the army officers with him took their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught Ishmael near the big pool of water that is at the town of Gibeon.

dag: Chɛliya ka m bɔhi ya bin yini ŋɔ kɔŋko yɛla: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini di yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa?.
en: Tell me this one thing: How did you receive the Spirit? Did you receive the Spirit by following the law? No, you received the Spirit because you heard the message about Jesus and believed it.

dag: N ni yili yil palli paɣi nyin Naawuni. N ni ŋme mɔɣilo din mali mihi pia paɣ a.
en: I will sing you a new song, O God; I will play the harp and sing to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni liri ba kaman gbuɣinli ni liriti binyara shɛm la, n ni dɔni sol naŋgban kpaŋ gu ba kaman jɛŋgbini ni doya gu binyara shɛm la.
en: That is why I will be like a lion to them. I will be like a leopard waiting by the road.

dag: Nyini n-daa fa ma m mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zabiri nuu ni bahi. Nyini n-zaŋ ma leei zuliya bɔbili zuɣulana; ka n ni daa bi mi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa jɛmdi ma mi.
en: You delivered me from struggles with many people; you appointed me the leader of many nations. Strangers come to serve me.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bo tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbi wɔribariba pa n zuɣu, ka n daa lu soli m-mali hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo maa gomnanim sani n-daa zaŋ naa gbana maa ti ba.
en: So I went to the governors of the province Beyond the River and gave them the kings letters. The king had sent officers of the army and cavalry with me.

dag: Suhu ni zaɣ biɛɣu lɔbu, ni ŋun kul zɔri yomyom chani zaɣ biɛɣ tumbu.
en: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga, so ku lan di nyin wala hal abada. Ka o nyaandoliba daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So he said to it, No one will ever again eat your fruit! His disciples heard this.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilisi tibili wum n siɣimbu.
en: Listen to my words, O Lord , and hear my sighs.

dag: Di dabisi tuuli dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka miriya ka yi tum tuma.
en: On the first of these days you shall gather for worship and do none of your daily work.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi fiɛb o bupihinahi, amaa di bi simdi ni di gari lala. Bɛ yi fiɛb o gari lala dindina yi ʒiʒiinikpee maa ni nya filiŋ yi ninni.
en: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless.

dag: Ti zaa bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaayɔbu.
en: There was a total of of us on board.

dag: Ka paɣ so mi yi mali yidan ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda, ka doo maa yu ni o mal o, ŋun miri ka o yi o yiŋa.
en: If a woman has a husband who doesnt believe and he agrees to live with her, then she shouldnt divorce him.

dag: Dama dunia ŋɔ nanim lo tɔbu, ka nazuɣuri laɣim n-zaɣisi ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia.
en: The kings of the earth took their stand and the rulers gathered together as one against the Lord and against his Christ. .

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa chani gindi alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni m-be kaman tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o be la. Ka o mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn daa ti yɛn di alikauli maa fal la daa kul bela tantinim ni.
en: Abraham lived in the country that God promised to give him. He lived there like a visitor who did not belong. He did this because he had faith. He lived in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who also received the same promise from God.

dag: Ka n daa lan bo da shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali nyɔri sara maligu binyara buɣim la na di bɔbu saha; ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ tahiri tiwala din daŋ moobu na. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: I arranged for the wood used for burning the offerings to be brought at the proper times, and for the people to bring their offerings of the first grain and the first fruits that ripened. Remember all this, O God, and give me credit for it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun nyɛ yɛndana ni shini tuumbiɛri ŋɔ saha; dama tuumbiɛri saha n-shiri bala!.
en: And so, keeping quiet in such evil times is the smart thing to do!.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zani dabari ka yi suhuri paligi shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ yi gba; nyini Siɛr Zoli mini Ɛdom zaa ni zani dabari. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: just as you rejoiced at the devastation of Israel, my own possession. The mountains of Seir, yes, all the land of Edom, will be desolate. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika maa, N dana, bɔ ka binyara ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: I responded to the messenger speaking with me, What are these, sir.

dag: Bɛ zuliya ni mali kpiɔŋ bɛ tiŋgban ni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun be tibi zuliya ni mali alibarika.
en: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi pa wɔhu gali n-gu tɔbu tuhibu dali, amaa nasara dibu bela Yawɛ sani.
en: A horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory belongs to the LORD.

dag: Ka yɛra, M Ba, m Ba, binshɛɣukam nand a sani. Vuum pipia ŋɔ ka chɛ ma; amaa chɛ ka a yubu niŋ, pa n dini.
en: He said, Abba , Father! You can do all things. Dont make me drink from this cup. But do what you want, not what I want.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ be mɔɣu ni n-dari ginda m-mali ti paai yuun pihinahi hal ka ʒiɛmani maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tum din bie Yawɛ sani maa zaa ti kpi.
en: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for years. By that time everyone who had sinned against him had died.

dag: N ni ti ŋooi takɔb lu yi zuɣu wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari, ka chɛ ka yi fɔntinsi ti bahi yoli.
en: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.

dag: Ka Absalom min o niriba zaa ni Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm, ka Ahitɔfɛl gba daa be o sani.
en: By this time, Absalom, Ahithophel, and the others had reached Jerusalem.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Miriya ka yi ʒiɛm bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba, dama n yɛri ya mi ni bɛ malaikanim kul chola m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ninni. .
en: See that you don't despise any of these little ones. Their angels in heaven, I tell you, are always in the presence of my Father in heaven.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di pala doo ŋɔ daalahichi bee o laamba daalahichi zuɣu, amaa di niŋmi ni Naawuni tumtumsa yi palo o ni.
en: Jesus answered, His blindness has nothing to do with his sins or his parents' sins. He is blind so that God's power might be seen at work in him.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti liri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li, ka fa li leei timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ Tabiil bia la leei di naa. .
en: Lets go fight against Judah and divide it among ourselves. Then we will make Tabeels son the new king of Judah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ma la, chɛ ka bɛ noya ni yɛli yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa la lab ʒini bɛ zuɣu.
en: Let the heads of the people surrounding me be covered with the trouble their own lips caused!.

dag: Dama n ni ti zo ba nambɔɣu bɛ biriginsim puuni, ka ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla hal abada.
en: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.

dag: Haman ni daa nya ka Mɔdɛkai zaɣisi ni o ku ti o jilima bee n-damd o tiŋ maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Haman was furious when he realized that Mordecai was not going to kneel and bow to him.

dag: Pa omaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni Yisa ni ti kpi bɛ zuliya maa zuɣu;.
en: He didnt say this on his own. As high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would soon die for the nation.

dag: Ibram daa lan yɛli, Nyama, a ni bi ti ma bia maa zuɣu, bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so n yiŋ puuni la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: Abram said, You have given me no son, so a slave born in my house will get everything I have.

dag: Amaa Sool min o niriba maa daa bi ku Agag mini piɛ viɛla ni naɣ viɛla ni naɣibihi viɛla ni piɛbihi viɛla. Binshɛɣukam din daa viɛla, bɛ daa bi saɣim li, amaa binshɛɣukam din daa bi viɛla, bɛ daa saɣim di zaa.
en: But Saul and his men spared Agag's life and did not kill the best sheep and cattle, the best calves and lambs, or anything else that was good; they destroyed only what was useless or worthless.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun saɣisiri ma ŋɔ, ka n suhu ni tɛha mi wuhiri ma yuŋ.
en: I praise you, Lord , for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.

dag: Filistianim ni daa ti wum ni Dauda ka bɛ zaŋ leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka bɛ zaa daa yi n-gbaai Dauda shee bɔbu, amaa ka Dauda daa wum di yɛla ka chaŋ ti be birini la ni.
en: The Philistines were told that David had been made king of Israel, so their army set out to capture him. When David heard of it, he went down to a fortified place.

dag: Gunimiya bidibiga kam o dɔɣibu nyaaŋa daba anii dali yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni; di yi nyɛla yi yiŋa ka yi dɔɣ o bee yi yi zaŋla yi liɣiri n-da o tinzun nir sanna, ka o pala yimaŋmaŋ zuliya.
en: On the eighth day after birth, every male in every generation must be circumcised, including those who are not your own children: those born in your household and those purchased with silver from foreigners.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la. .
en: Two women will be grinding meal together: one will be taken away, the other will be left behind.

dag: Ka n yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, n ni daa po pɔri ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I bring you back to Israel, the land that I promised I would give to your ancestors, then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dindina, ka bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ buɣisi? So bi ŋman o.
en: To whom can the holy God be compared? Is there anyone else like him?.

dag: Yɛl yini n-kul paari sokam zaa. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl biɛɣu din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Din pahi nyɛla, zaɣ biɛɣu n-kul pali sokam zaa suhu ni. Yinyari biɛhigu n-kul be bɛ suhuri ni bɛ biɛhigu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ kpi.
en: One fate comes to all alike, and this is as wrong as anything that happens in this world. As long as people live, their minds are full of evil and madness, and suddenly they die.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tuma nyɔri labisi ti ka ku di li, bɛ ni wolim nya nyɔ shɛl la, bɛ ku di di nyaɣisim.
en: They will have to give up all they have worked for; they will have no chance to enjoy their wealth.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya saŋkpalima bee muli zaɣ nyama ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li, ka di saha na bi paai.
en: I place you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the wild deer: dont rouse, dont arouse love until it desires.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa darigi toola o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes to show he was upset. Then he put on sackcloth and went to the Lord s Temple.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a shɛm polo, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli, bɛ daa bi ŋmaag a nyuɣu; bɛ daa bi su a kom n-yihi a biɛri ni bee n-niŋ kpam ʒe a bee n-zaŋ chinchini pil a.
en: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni nini daa tiɣi kurimbuni ha niriba.
en: The elders in the past were approved because they showed faith.

dag: n-yɛra, Miriya ka yi nahim n ninvuɣ gahinda maa; ka miriya ka yi niŋ n daanabinim zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: He said, Dont hurt my chosen people. Dont harm my prophets.

dag: Ka di simdi ni cheechi buɣisi ba pɔi, ka bɛ biɛhigu yi wuhi ni bɛ ka galimi, ka cheechi naanyi chɛ ka bɛ tum cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma.
en: They should be tested first, and then, if they pass the test, they are to serve.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli nti zaŋ bɛ ŋariŋ lo n-zali teeku noli.
en: They crossed the lake and came to land at Gennesaret, where they tied up the boat.

dag: Yi yi ka n tooni na ni yi ti jɛm ma, ŋuni n-lee yɛli ya ni yi zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa na? Ŋuni n-lee puhi ya ni yi be n jɛmbu duu n-nɔri ginda?.
en: Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!.

dag: N yɛn yuuni bɔrila bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni bɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Juda ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, tɔbu mini kum ni ku ba hal ka bɛ ni yino ti ku kpalim.
en: I will see to it that you will not prosper, but will be destroyed. All of you will die, either in war or of disease, until not one of you is left.

dag: N dimnim kul yɛri ma la zilima dabisili kam puuni; ka bɛn maani ma ansarisi zaŋ n yuli leei turi.
en: All day long my enemies insult me; those who mock me use my name in cursing.

dag: Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira, ka tibiri barinima;.
en: Jesus called the twelve disciples together and gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases.

dag: Amaa din sabi niŋ di ni ŋɔ sabimi ni yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia, ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili o yuli zuɣu.
en: But these things are written so that you will believe that Jesus is the Christ, Gods Son, and that believing, you will have life in his name.

dag: Ninive ŋmanila biaŋ din kom zo n-yi ka chɛ li. Ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Zanimiya! Zanimiya! Amaa ka so bi ŋmaligi labina.
en: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of Stop! Don't go! can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba shɛb bɛn daa zo nti sɔɣi Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tinsi ni la gba ni daa wum ni Filistianim maa ŋmaligi guui n-zɔri ni bɛ tiligi maa, ka bɛ gba daa dii lo kpara zo n-doli tuhiri ba.
en: Similarly, when all the Israelites who had been hiding in the highlands of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they also joined the battle in hot pursuit of the Philistines.

dag: N zaŋmi m bɔrɔbɔro mini ko shɛli ni nim shɛli n ni ku n-zali bɛn chɛri m piɛri kɔbiri maa ti ninvuɣ shɛba n ni bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: I'm not going to take my bread and water, and the animals I have butchered for my sheepshearers, and give them to people who come from I don't know where.

dag: O bihi nyurila ʒim. Bɛ ni ku binyara luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka o be.
en: Around dead bodies the eagles gather, and the young eagles drink the blood.

dag: Ka Pita min o nyaandolitab piniyin la daa yiɣisi zani ka Pita duh o yee pam yɛli, Yinim Judianim mini yi zaa bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ ka baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni.
en: Peter stood with the other eleven apostles. He raised his voice and declared, Judeans and everyone living in Jerusalem! Know this! Listen carefully to my words!.

dag: N gbaala mmaŋ ni so biɛɣu kam dolibu, ni di chɛ ka n tooi gbib a yɛligu.
en: I have avoided all evil conduct, because I want to obey your word.

dag: Chɛ ka suhudoo be di puuni, ka alaafee be di nanim yinsi.
en: May there be peace inside your walls and safety in your palaces.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti piligi Aroa mini fɔn tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Gaad din be Jaza polo la.
en: They crossed the Jordan River and began from Aroer and from the town that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, then on to Jazer.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba naba vuri tulaale tihi maa zuɣu, nyin lirim ba, dama di saha maa man Yawɛ daŋla a tooni ni n ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa ti a maa.
en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the trees, then attack, for God has attacked in front of you to defeat the Philistine army.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya tahima Yawɛ sani! Dama yurilim maŋli be Yawɛ sani, ka o mali yiko pam din ni tiligi niriba.
en: Israel, trust in the Lord . The Lord is the one who is faithful and true. He saves us again and again.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, fam ma bahi. Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, sɔŋm ma yomyom.
en: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Yisa daa lab Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daa mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Jesus went back to Galilee with the power of the Spirit. Stories about him spread all over the area around Galilee.

dag: Amaa Kɔra zuliya bɛn daa bi kpi.
en: But the sons of Korah were not killed.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yuri mini chɛchɛbumbariba ni tɔbutuhiriba ni tɔbbihi balibu kam n yiŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛn Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani maa ni daa tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Manasseh disobeyed the Lord by following the disgusting customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi zo yomyom ti nya Mariama mini Yisifu, ka nya biliɛɣu maa ka o do wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: They went quickly and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi zaɣisi, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ kpi bɛmaŋmaŋ ʒilinsi zuɣu.
en: But if they refuse to obey him, they will be destroyed. They will die like fools.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba, Yumiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ karimbaandan tibili pam.
en: All who belong to the Lord , show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.

dag: Ti zaɣisi dinkam tahiri vi na mini yɔhiŋgu tuma; ka zaɣisi yɛmbimbiɛri tuma, ka mi bi zaŋdi yɔhiŋgu kpɛhiri Naawuni yɛligu ni. Amaa yɛlimaŋli wuhibu puuni ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi sokam bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ni ti dolila din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: We put aside all secret and shameful deeds; we do not act with deceit, nor do we falsify the word of God. In the full light of truth we live in God's sight and try to commend ourselves to everyone's good conscience.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri ti anzansi ka kpaŋsiri ti suhuri ŋɔ chɛ ka yi doli Yisa Masia ka mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: May the God of endurance and encouragement give you the same attitude toward each other, similar to Christ Jesus attitude.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti laɣim gbariti, ka laɣim n ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la mini n ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili la.
en: The time is coming, says the Lord , when I will gather together the people I punished, those who have suffered in exile.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka lari mini suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu naai, ka lan chɛ ka aŋgo mini amiliya kukoya vuri naai kpe yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel says: I will soon stop the sounds of people having fun. I will stop the happy sounds of people enjoying a wedding party. This will happen during your lifetime. I will do these things very soon.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ shiri yɛn niŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku doo ŋɔ.
en: The soldiers told David what the king would give the man who killed Goliath.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl kpamba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana? Yi yɛn bɔhi ma mi baŋ binshɛli? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku bɔhi ma baŋ binshɛli.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, these leaders have come to find out what I want them to do. As surely as I live, I will not give them an answer of any kind.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ biɛri ku yi tibidarigibo ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn ni yi.
en: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.

dag: Ka Hanani ŋun daa nyɛ m mabihi ni yino la mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti yi Juda na, ka m-bɔhi ba Yɛhudianim bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba la mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: Hanani, one of my brothers, came with some other men from Judah. I asked them about the Jews who had escaped and survived the captivity, and about Jerusalem.

dag: Saha shɛli Dauda ni daa di nam ʒi Hiburɔn n-su Judanim maa yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu.
en: and he ruled from Hebron for seven and a half years.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu Samaria; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam ʒin o nam ʒiishee.
en: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti boli tab na ka yi ti ʒini yi wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi gbini. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When that day comes, each of you will invite your neighbor to come and enjoy peace and security, surrounded by your vineyards and fig trees.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tɛhi ni yɛla maa ʒila Alikizanda zuɣu, Yɛhudianim ni daa daag o zali tooni la zuɣu; ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa ni o wuhi ba din niŋ.
en: Some Jews made a man named Alexander stand before the crowd, and they told him what to say. Alexander waved his hand, trying to explain things to the people.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛm, Nyin Ziɔn, di zɔri dabiɛm; di chɛ ka a baɣiri ni cheei kom.
en: The time is coming when they will say to Jerusalem, Do not be afraid, city of Zion! Do not let your hands hang limp!.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ni ninsal shia durila zuɣusaa, ka biŋkɔbigu shia siɣiri tiŋgban ni?.
en: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ti nambɔɣu. Kul zom ti nambɔɣu, dama bɛ dihi ti vi ti yaɣi.
en: Lord , be merciful to us, because we have been insulted much too long.

dag: Tuuli, o nam sulinsi tinsi n-daa nyɛ Babɛl mini Ɛrɛk ni Akad, ka di zaa daa bela Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: At first his kingdom included Babylon, Erech, and Accad, all three of them in Babylonia.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kpuɣi bihi maa o naba zuɣu, ka damdi n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph took them from Israels knees, and he bowed low with his face to the ground.

dag: Bɔ n-lee pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli nyabu. Naawuni ni daa pii niriba biɛla shɛb la n-naɣ nya li, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛn suhuri daa kpɛmmi.
en: So what? Israel didnt find what it was looking for. Those who were chosen found it, but the others were resistant.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di zaŋ Izraɛl zuliya shɛli fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli n-tom ti Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli nima; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim zaa kul gbibila bɛ yaannim daŋ fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: The property of every Israelite will remain attached to his tribe.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anu.
en: Evening came, then morning—that was the fifth day.

dag: Yi ni ti sa wain tihi ka mali di ni, amaa yi ti ku pɔhi di wala bee n-nyu di wain, dama zunzuya ni ti ŋubi di zaa.
en: You will plant vineyards and take care of them, but you will not gather their grapes or drink wine from them, because worms will eat the vines.

dag: Ka pirigili shɛli din daa nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn chaŋ tɔb maa ni tarili la piɛri mini buhi kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita ni tuhi pihitanaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: The half-share of those who had gone out to battle numbered , sheep.

dag: M paɣir a, dama a nam ma, ka n yɛla mali dabiɛm mini alahiziba. M mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni a tuma zaa mali alahiziba.
en: I give thanks to you that I was marvelously set apart. Your works are wonderful—I know that very well.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N yɛn leela ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A shiri ni tooi niŋ o naŋgban malisim, cham ti niŋ lala, a ni di nasara. .
en: I will be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets, he said. The LORD agreed: You will succeed in persuading him! Go ahead.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ leei naa n-ʒili m ba Dauda nam maa ʒiishee hal n ni na kul nyɛ bia ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka m mi bi mi n ni yɛn su niriba shɛm.
en: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali di firilanim ayopɔin mini di buɣim kpihiri bina ni di buɣim moori bina.
en: He made seven lamps for the lampstand, and he made its tongs and trays of pure gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma din ni chɛ ka n tooi tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu n-kahigiri di gbinni wuhiri kaman di ni simdi ni n kahigiri li wuhiri shɛm.
en: Pray that I will say what is necessary to make this truth clear to everyone.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Kitirɔn bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Nahalol, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu; amaa ka bɛ daa lee muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The Zebulun tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Kitron and Nahalol, and the Canaanites stayed there with Israelites around them. But the people of Zebulun did force the Canaanites into slave labor.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Nyin Saimɔn, Jona bia, a mal alibarika! Dama pa daadam ni o zabigu n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuh a, amaa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-kahigi li wuh a.
en: Jesus answered, You are blessed, Simon son of Jonah. No one taught you that. My Father in heaven showed you who I am.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe nti di ka nyu ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya noli ni di paɣ so maa ti sɔɣi; dama o nyɛla nabipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehu went into the house and ate and drank. Then he said, Now see about this cursed woman. Bury her, because she is a kings daughter.

dag: Ka Rut daa shiri doli Bɔaz kachɛriba maa n-yihiri kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ chi maa zaa naai. Ka Rut daa kul kpalim be o yidan ma maa sani.
en: So Ruth worked with them and gathered grain until all the barley and wheat had been harvested. And she continued to live with her mother-in-law.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is what the LORD said concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians through the prophet Jeremiah.

dag: dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Everyone who has something will be given more, and they will have more than enough. But everything will be taken from those who don't have anything.

dag: N ni daŋ wuhi ya yin ni zo so: Zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi ku daadam ka mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ o shia niŋ buɣim ni ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zomiy o.
en: Ill show you whom you should fear: fear the one who, after you have been killed, has the authority to throw you into hell. Indeed, I tell you, thats the one you should fear.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: Then he went back to his followers and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, Could you men not stay awake with me for one hour?.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na nti laɣim tab chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi deei binshɛli zali ninvuɣ kura ŋun simdi kubu zaani. Ninvuɣ kura simdi kubu.
en: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni. Bɛ ni tur a tu shɛŋa zaa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ku be barina ni, bɛ ni be ni alaafee ka ku zɔri dabiɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo.
en: But those who listen to me will live in safety and comfort. They will have nothing to fear.

dag: Amaa ka Kalɛb daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa fo baalim Musa tooni, ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ yomyom ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini; dama ti ni tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: Caleb told the people near Moses to be quiet. Then Caleb said, We should go up and take that land for ourselves. We can easily take that land.

dag: Di daa lan ŋmaligi kpala nuzaa polo n-chaŋ hal ti paai Ɛnshɛmɛsh n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ni Gɛlilɔt din be Adumim bimbini tooni la. Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini.
en: It turned northward. Then it went to En-shemesh and then to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the Stone of Bohan .

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni din niŋ ma la shiri sɔŋ chɛ ka lahibal suŋ la tuma chaŋ tooni.
en: I want you to know, my friends, that the things that have happened to me have really helped the progress of the gospel.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm min o ni daa me o yil shɛli maa.
en: The queen of Sheba saw that Solomon was very wise. She also saw the beautiful palace he had built.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, labimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, dama yi tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka yi daa tuui lu.
en: Return, Israel, to the LORD your God; you have stumbled because of your wickedness.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani miri Gibia.
en: The next morning the Israelite army moved its camp to a place near Gibeah.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla maa, ka ti Duuma malaika ka o sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Nyin Yisifu ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, di zɔri dabiɛm ni a chɛ ka bɛ kulisi Mariama a yiŋ na, dama o ni mali pu shɛli maa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na.
en: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.

dag: Wula ka a zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni ti bemi kaman Shilo la, ka tiŋ ŋɔ ti lee dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni? Ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim gili Jɛrimia Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Why do you prophesy in the LORDs name that this temple will become a ruin like Shiloh, and this city will be destroyed and left without inhabitant? Then all the people joined ranks against Jeremiah in the LORDs temple.

dag: Yinim Dibɔnnim bɛn ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ, yiɣisimiya jilima ʒiishee maa ti ʒini tiŋgban ni. Dama ŋun saɣindi Mɔab la kana ti liri ya. O saɣim yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli la.
en: Come down from your lofty place and sit in the dust, you inhabitants of Daughter Dibon; because Moabs destroyer has arrived to level your fortresses.

dag: Ka yi yi ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, yin nyomiya li buɣim kaman Naawuni ni zali ya shɛm. N ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: As soon as you seize the city, set it on fire. Act according to the LORDs word. Indeed, I have given you an order.

dag: M mabihi, Naawuni n-daa pii ya leei bilichinnima; amaa lee miriya ka yi zaŋ yi bilichinsi soli maa tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, naɣ zaŋmiyala yimaŋ leei tab daba yurilim zuɣu.
en: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli salo maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la ŋaha puuni, hal o daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Jesus used stories when he spoke to the people. In fact, he did not tell them anything without using stories.

dag: Ka o ni ti kpuɣi bɛ wuna mini bɛ binnana ni neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa mali n-zaŋ ti bɛ wuna la n-lab kuli Ijipti. Ka yuma biɛla din ti nyɛ suhudoo saha puuni.
en: He will carry back to Egypt the images of their gods and the articles of gold and silver dedicated to those gods. After several years of peace.

dag: A yi je suli, nyin miri ka a chɛ ka a sujee maa ti kpɛh a alahichi ni, ka a mi miri ka a je suli hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When you are angry, dont let that anger make you sin, and dont stay angry all day.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Nyamiya, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.

dag: O daa bela Paran mɔɣu ni, ka o ma daa ti bo Ijipti paɣ ti o.
en: His mother got an Egyptian wife for him.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha n ni zaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa zaa kpe n-kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: In two years I will restore to this place all of the temple equipment that Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar carted off to Babylon.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa kul bɔbimi ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi m-miri Samaria dunoli kabɔɣili shee ka anabinim maa zaa be bɛ tooni tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria. They were listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so bahi maa so, dama zibisim ni ka o ŋmaligi labi, ka so ʒi o yɛla.
en: It does that baby no good to be born; it disappears into darkness, where it is forgotten.

dag: Amaa yi ni da dab so ka gun o, o ni tooi di bindirigu maa o gunibu nyaaŋa.
en: However, any slave who has been bought may eat it after hes been circumcised.

dag: O bidibisi maa daa yi chanila tab yinsi ti puhiri churi sokam dabisili dali, ka daa yi timdi booni bɛ tizɔpaɣiba maa na ka bɛ mini ba ti diri ka nyura.
en: Each of his sons hosted a feast in his own house on his birthday. They invited their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

dag: N niŋ ya naani pam, ka nyuri bara pam yi zuɣu, ka lan mali suhudoo. Ti wahala dibu la zaa yoli, m mali suhupiɛlli hal ti yaɣi.
en: I feel that I can tell you anything. I am very proud of you. Even with all the troubles we have had, I am greatly encouraged and feel very happy.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: And you know his commands: You must not commit adultery, you must not murder anyone, you must not steal, you must not tell lies about others, you must respect your father and mother .... .

dag: Di lan simdi ka o bo ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli, ka bɛ ti zaŋ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.

dag: Ka sandira maa daa damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, N dana, na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: The servant fell on his knees before the king. Be patient with me, he begged, and I will pay you everything.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a kpuɣim a bindoo chaŋ maa.
en: They inquired, Who is this man who said to you, Pick it up and walk.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo na, ka bɛ mini Ibrahimma ni Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ti laɣim ʒini alizanda nam ni ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: Many people will come from the east and from the west. These people will sit and eat with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in Gods kingdom.

dag: Sulemaana daa diri n-sula na shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli zaŋ hal ti paai Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ti kpa Ijiptinim tiŋgbɔŋ tariga; ka bɛ daa yɔri farigu o sani ka jɛmd o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Solomon's kingdom included all the nations from the Euphrates River to Philistia and the Egyptian border. They paid him taxes and were subject to him all his life.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ tarili nyɛla o niriba. Yaakubu n-nyɛ o tarili.
en: The Lord chose his people to be his own. The people of Jacob belong to him.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi chɛ o yiya bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri n yuli zuɣu ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields for my sake, will receive a hundred times more and will be given eternal life.

dag: ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa kpihiri firilanima ni taha ni chɛrisi. O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali buɣim moori lahi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli pundi mini luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee dunoli pundi zaa daa nyɛla salima.
en: the lamp snuffers, the bowls, the dishes for incense, and the pans used for carrying live coals. All these objects were made of pure gold. The outer doors of the Temple and the doors to the Most Holy Place were overlaid with gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim kuli. A napɔŋ yi ti kul zani tiŋ puuni, bia maa ni leei Naawuni dini.
en: Then Ahijah said, Now, go home. Your son will die as soon as you enter the city.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da yaɣimɛr yaɣiri duɣu, ka zaŋ niriba kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba pahi amaŋ zuɣu.
en: The Lord told me to go and buy a clay jar. He also told me to take some of the elders of the people and some of the older priests.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai nti suhi Naawuni ti ba ni bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ naa min o nabihi kuli tinzun tiŋ ni, Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then their kings and leaders will be captured. They will all be taken together. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi n zuɣu na ka o yɛli ma, Yɛlima, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, yi ni tɛhi shɛm m-bala? M mi binshɛŋa din kpe yi tɛha ni.
en: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on me. He said to me, Tell them that this is what the Lord said: House of Israel, you are planning big things. But I know what you are thinking.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam, amaa ka di niŋdiya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm, dama bɛ wuhiri din tuhi, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee bi dol li.
en: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zuɣu a lan pala dabili, amaa a nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka a yi nyɛla Naawuni bia, dindina a nyɛla ŋun dir o bini.
en: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised.

dag: Ka nimaaninim daa nya o m-baŋ o, ka tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋkpan shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim zaa tahi o sanna.
en: Some men there saw Jesus and knew who he was. So they sent word to the other people throughout that area that Jesus had come. The people brought all their sick people to him.

dag: Yi daa lan nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbibi ya shɛm tiŋgban nɛl la ni kaman nira ni buɣiri bia shɛm la, ka yi chaŋ na hal ti paai kpe.
en: and in the desert. You saw how he brought you safely all the way to this place, just as a father would carry his son.

dag: M bi yi alizanda ni na ni n ti tumla mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka n kana ni n ti tum.
en: I have come down from heaven not to do my will, but the will of him who sent me.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam Naa ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ku lu a sizuura? Dama lala n-simd a. Zuliya kam yɛnnim mini bɛ nanim zaa so m-bi ŋman a.
en: Who would not honor you, the king of all nations? You deserve to be honored. There is no one like you among all the wise men of the nations or among any of their kings.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisima m-bu ba kaman chi la, dama n ni chɛ ka a yiligu leei kurigu, ka chɛ ka a takarifiɛma leei daanya, ka a ti bu n-chɛrisi niriba pam, ka zaŋ bɛ nyamma ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ bɛ daazichi ti dunia zaa Duuma.
en: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.

dag: bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li duhi, amaa ninvuɣ suma n-ni ye li, ka bɛn ka taali mi ti pirigi anzinfa maa ti taba.
en: they may amass, but the righteous will wear it; the innocent will divide the silver.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka n ni ti nyu di zaɣ palli Naawuni nam ni.
en: From now on I will not drink any wine, until I drink new wine in God's kingdom.

dag: hal nti paai dahin shɛli o ni daa ti o tuun shɛb o ni pii la zaligu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka lab alizanda ni la.
