en: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam saha miriya.
en: In the same way, when you see these things happening, you will know that the Kingdom of God is about to come.

dag: Di saha yi neesim ni neei kaman biɛkaali neesim la, ka yi nya alaafee yomyom, ka ŋun yɛn zabi yi zuɣu ni be yi tooni; ka Yawɛ jilima ni nyɛ yi gula m-be yi nyaaŋa polo.
en: If you do these things, your light will begin to shine like the light of dawn. Then your wounds will heal. Your Goodness will walk in front of you, and the Glory of the Lord will come following behind you.

dag: Jɔahaz daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his ancestors, he sinned against the Lord .

dag: O nam sagbana niŋ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni na, ka chɛ ka mɔri zoori zoya zuɣu.
en: He spreads clouds over the sky; he provides rain for the earth and makes grass grow on the hills.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti tim boli tindaannim mini laasabuniŋdiba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ Izraɛlnim Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ? Ka ti yi yɛn zaŋ li labisi di biɛhigu shee, bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ pahi di zuɣu labisi.
en: the people called the priests and the magicians and asked, What shall we do with the Covenant Box of the Lord ? If we send it back where it belongs, what shall we send with it.

dag: Giliad tizɔpaɣ Hamolɛkɛt n-daa dɔɣi Ishɔd mini Abiɛza ni Mahila.
en: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth had three sons: Ishod, Abiezer, and Mahlah. .

dag: Yɛm ŋɔ tatabo bi yirila alizanda ni na, amaa di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ mini daadamtali biɛhigu ni Sintani dini.
en: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la mini bɛnkam zaa je ma la nuu ni bahi; dama bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari ma.
en: He rescued me from my powerful enemies and from all those who hate me— they were too strong for me.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla piɛ polli ni o mali sara maa, dindina ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If you bring a lamb as an offering to the Lord .

dag: O ni daa kul wuhi ti di gbinni shɛm, di daa ti shiri niŋla pali; a daa labisi ma n tuma ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la mi ti yili tia.
en: and everything happened just as he said it would. I got my job back, and the cook was put to death.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni kahig o ni chɛ ka nir yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani shɛm yɛla wuhi palɔni, ka di pala fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu min anabinim yɛligu gba nyɛla din pun di dimbɔŋɔ shɛhira.
en: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n ni yɛn tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, chɛ ka di kpe a tiba ni, ka a deei li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: God continued, Mortal man, pay close attention and remember everything I tell you.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi lan labina, n ku nya yɛndana yi ni.
en: But you can bring all of them again, and I wont find a wise one among you.

dag: Bɛn ne mi ni bɛ ni kpi, amaa bɛn kpi bɛn lan ʒi shɛli yaha. Bɛ lan ka jina ni, hal ka niriba bi teeri bɛ yɛla.
en: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.

dag: Jɛhɔram ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba, ka bo bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: During Jehoram's reign Edom revolted against Judah and became an independent kingdom.

dag: O yi kul ko o kɔbu, o biritila o bimbira din nyɛ nili mini buŋgu, ka biri alikama doli vuɣisi, ka biri chi di biribu shee, ka biri binshɛŋa din pahi dolisi putarisi.
en: Once they have prepared the soil, they plant the seeds of herbs such as dill and cumin. They plant rows of wheat and barley, and at the edges of their fields they plant other grain.

dag: Ka so daa ti bɔh o, N Duuma, niriba biɛla kɔŋko n-yɛn tiligi? Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Someone asked him, Sir, will just a few people be saved? Jesus answered them.

dag: Doo bee paɣa yi mali dalima o niŋgbuŋ ni ka di nyɛ zaɣ piɛla.
en: If anyone has white spots on the skin.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ka guhira, ka suhimiya Naawuni, dama yi bi mi di saha.
en: Watch out! Stay alert! You dont know when the time is coming.

dag: A yi zab ti zuɣu, ka niriba wum zabili maa damli, bɛ zɔrimi.
en: When you fight for us, nations run away from the noise of battle.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri tuma nyɛla zana gbahiri ba, ka bɛ daalahichi tuma gbahiri ba.
en: The sins of the wicked will trap them. Those sins will be like ropes holding them back.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ŋɔ simdi paɣibu pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi lahibali maa na garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim vaami guui ka chɛ Filistianima; bɛ ku niriba pam, hal bɛ ku a bih ayi la Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la chaŋ.
en: Israel ran away from the Philistines, the soldier answered. Many of our people were killed, including your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas. But worst of all, the sacred chest was captured.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn naa ni ti zaŋ o takɔbi na ti lu a zuɣu.
en: The Sovereign Lord says to the king of Egypt, You will face the sword of the king of Babylonia.

dag: Bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla dɔb tusaanahi m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: There were about men there who ate. There were also some women and children.

dag: dama Naawuni yɛligu mini wunsuhigu nyɛla din chɛ ka di leeri din be kasi Naawuni sani.
en: These things are made holy by Gods word and prayer.

dag: Chɛ ka nanim zaa damd o tiŋa; ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa jɛm o.
en: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.

dag: Ka yi nimaani hal ti gari Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni zaŋ lab Jɛbusi nudirigu polo, Jɛrusalɛm m-bala n-lan kpuɣi nimaani hal ti du zo shɛli din do Hinnom Vinvamli wulinluhili polo la zaŋ lab Rɛfaim Vinvamli tariga nuzaa polo.
en: Then the border went through the Valley of Ben Hinnom beside the southern side of the Jebusite city . There the border went to the top of the hill on the west side of Hinnom Valley. This was at the northern end of Rephaim Valley.

dag: Miriya ka yi zahim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni daa zahim o shɛm Masa la.
en: Do not put the Lord your God to the test, as you did at Massah.

dag: Ka Keenannim Naa Arad ŋun daa be Nɛgɛb din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa wum Izraɛlnim kandina damli.
en: The Canaanite king of Arad, who ruled in the arid southern plain in the land of Canaan, heard of the Israelites coming.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni lo nia shɛŋa kpalim yoli kpe, ka n chɛ ka bɛ dimnima bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya la zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka n chɛ ka bɛ leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: In this place I will frustrate all the plans of the people of Judah and Jerusalem. I will let their enemies triumph over them and kill them in battle. I will give their corpses to the birds and the wild animals as food.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa tim tuumba ka bɛ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka Baal jɛmdiba zaa daa laɣimna, ka so daa bi kpalim ka bi kana. Ka bɛ daa kpe Baal duu maa ni hal ti pal li, ka di luɣilikam zaa ti nyɛla niriba.
en: Then Jehu sent a message through all the land of Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came. Not one stayed home. The Baal worshipers came into the temple of Baal. The temple was filled with people.

dag: Pa dahin yini ka yi yɛn ŋub li bee daba ayi bee daba anu bee biɛɣu pia bee biɛɣ pisi.
en: You will have to eat it not just for one or two days, or five, or ten, or even twenty days.

dag: M piɛri mi n kukoli, ka n gba mi ba, ka bɛ doli ma;.
en: My sheep listen to my voice. I know them, and they follow me.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ leei zaligu yi sani, ka yi mini yi bihi doli li sahakam.
en: You and your children must obey these rules forever.

dag: M mabihi, suhimiya sɔŋ yi ma, dama o lan pala m paɣa, m mi lan pala o yidana. Suhimiya ka o yihi pagɔrisigu o kɔbili ni ka yihi zina niŋbu o suhu ni.
en: My children, plead with your mother—though she is no longer a wife to me, and I am no longer her husband. Plead with her to stop her adultery and prostitution.

dag: Ti yi chɛ ka o niŋdi lala, sokam zaa ni niŋ o yɛda, ka Romnim kana ti saɣim ti Naawuni jɛmbu shee, ka bahi ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: If we let him continue doing these things, everyone will believe in him. Then the Romans will come and take away our Temple and our nation.

dag: Ka Obadia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab, ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti nya Ilaija.
en: So Obadiah went to King Ahab and told him where Elijah was. King Ahab went to meet Elijah.

dag: M biɛhigu nyɛla ŋmahinli niriba pam sani, amaa nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee din mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dundɔŋ maa. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ mita pihinu. Di daa nyɛla mɔɣumɔɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni.
en: The man measured the inner courtyard. The courtyard was a perfect square. It was cubits long and cubits wide. The altar was in front of the Temple.

dag: ka n ti lan labi m ba yiŋ yaha ni suhudoo, dindina Yawɛ n-ni nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: and I return safely to my fathers household, then the LORD will be my God.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ malila omaŋmaŋ amaŋka, Lɛbanɔn tihi dapaɣa ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: King Solomon made a canopied couch for himself from the trees of Lebanon.

dag: Yawɛ, a wumdi n suhigu asiba; asiba ka n suhir a, ka guhira.
en: you hear my voice in the morning; at sunrise I offer my prayer and wait for your answer.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said:.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn pii zaɣ suŋ ka zaɣisi zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ nanima ayi shɛb bɛn kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm ŋɔ tiŋgbana maa.
en: Before the boy learns to reject evil and choose good, the land of the two kings you dread will be abandoned.

dag: O daa bi saɣi n-chɛ ka so nahim ba. O daa kpahi nanim zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But God let no one oppress them; to protect them, he warned the kings:.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naa Hɛrɔd mini Pɔntius Pailɛt ni chɛfirinim zaŋ tabili Izraɛlnim zaa daa shiri laɣim ya n-zaɣisi a Wundab Suŋ Yisa, a ni daa zaŋ so leei Masia.
en: Thats what actually happened when Herod, Pontius Pilate, the other nations, and the people of Israel all came together against Jesus here in Jerusalem. He is your holy Servant, the one you made to be the Messiah.

dag: Uzi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Izirahia, ka Izirahia bidibisi daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Obadia ni Joɛl ni Ishia, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu; bɛ zaa daa nyɛla zuɣulaannima.
en: Uzzis family: Izrahiah; and Izrahiahs family—Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah—five in all, and all of them leaders.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o piɛma n-to n-wurim ba; ka chɛ ka o saa nyaɣisiri ginda.
en: God shot his arrows, scattering the enemy; he sent the lightning and threw them into confusion.

dag: ni Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kriitinima .
en: Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, the ancestor of the Philistines.

dag: Ka Naomi daa bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya di zaa lala? Ŋun puu ni ka a chaŋ ti yih a kayiha maa? Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi nya a maa ni! Di saha ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi ni do so ŋun yuli booni Bɔaz la puu ni ka o chaŋ ti yihi kayiha maa.
en: Her mother-in-law said to her, Where did you glean today? Where did you work? May the one who noticed you be blessed. She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked and said, The name of the man with whom I worked today is Boaz.

dag: A pun wum Asiria naa ni niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa shɛm ni o ni saɣim li zaa shɛm yɛla. A tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You yourself have heard what Assyrian kings do to other countries, wiping them out. Is it likely that you will be saved?.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli yiri Shiiba na maa buchi lee nyɛ dini n sani? Bee binnyoma din yi katiŋ na maa buchi lee nyɛ di ni n sani? N ku deei yi ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara la. M mi nini bi lan tiɣi yi sara maligunima.
en: What do I care about the incense they bring me from Sheba, or the spices from a distant land? I will not accept their offerings or be pleased with their sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zuliya bahila yoli zaŋ Hɛshibɔn hal ni Dibɔn, ka ti ŋmani saɣiri doya hal ka buɣim ti di m-paai Mɛdɛba.
en: Yet we have thrown them down, destroying them from Heshbon to Dibon. We brought ruin until Nophah, which is by Medeba.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa wum bɛ wuhibu maa niŋ yɛda. Dɔbba kɔŋko daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu laasabu.
en: But many of the people who heard the apostles believed what they said. There were now about men in the group of believers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Jɛrimia m-pahi buyi saha shɛli bɛ ni daa na kul kpar o duu duguliba dundɔŋ ni la.
en: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord , and I created the whole world.

dag: Naawuni Kundi bi yɛli ni Masia yɛn yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi Bɛtilihɛm din nyɛ Naa Dauda ya na la.
en: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of David. And they say that he will come from Bethlehem, the town where David lived.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees said, Why are you picking grain on the Sabbath? You're not supposed to do that.

dag: M paɣiri ya, dama yi teeri n yɛla binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka doli kal shɛŋa n ni zaŋ wuhi ya la.
en: I praise you because you remember all my instructions, and you hold on to the traditions exactly as I handed them on to you.

dag: Yawɛ malaika kul gulila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura; ka fari ba bahira.
en: On every side, the LORDs messenger protects those who honor God; and he delivers them.

dag: Bɛ ʒim mini bɛ kpam ni ti ŋam Yawɛ takɔb maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋ piɛ shɛb mini bu shɛb mali sara ʒim ni bɛ kpam la. Dama Yawɛ ni mali sara Bɔzira. O ni ku niriba pam Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.

dag: Karimbaani lihigu mini ʒiŋmabo ni bɛn ka taali kubu.
en: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Balak zaŋ Balaam du Bamɔtibaal din nyɛ luɣ shɛli din miri ka o ni tooi lihi nya Izraɛlnim maa viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: The next morning, Balak took Balaam to the town of Bamoth-Baal. From there, Balaam could see some of the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kul kpe Samaria puuni, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem niriba ŋɔ nina n-chɛ ka bɛ nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei bɛ nina maa, ka bɛ lihi nya ka bɛ bela Samaria puuni.
en: When they arrived in Samaria, Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these men so they can see. The LORD opened their eyes, and they saw that they were right in the middle of Samaria!.

dag: yɛli, Doo ŋɔ daa yɛliya ni o mali yiko din ni tooi wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka lan me li daba ata sunsuuni.
en: and said, This man claimed he could tear down God's temple and build it again in three days.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni gbiri binyara ŋubira;.
en: Over on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa garigi yɛli ba ni Pool be duu Siizaria, ka omaŋmaŋ mi lɔri nia ni o lab nimaani daba ayi sunsuuni.
en: But Festus answered, No, Paul will be kept in Caesarea. I will be going there soon myself.

dag: N yi tɛhi di yɛla, di gariti ma mi, ka dabiɛm mali ma, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: If I recall it, Im scared; shaking seizes my body.

dag: O puli zuɣu gbaŋ ŋmanila salichɛhi; o teer omaŋ dooni baɣiri ni kaman kaburi dɔɣu la.
en: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni Izraɛlnim kpe o tiŋgbani maa ni gari, ka daa laɣim o tɔbbihi na ti dɔni Jahaz n-tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: But King Sihon of the Amorites would not let the Israelites cross his borders. So Sihon gathered all of his people and made a camp at Jahaz. Then the Amorites fought with the Israelites.

dag: Di biɛrisuŋ mini di viɛlim ti ku mali kpee! Di kawana ni ti chɛ ka nachimbihi mali kpiɔŋ, ka di wain mi chɛ ka paɣisara ni nyeena.
en: How good and beautiful the land will be! The young people will grow strong on its grain and wine.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yɛla, dama o yuli daa duya pam. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛli, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-lan neei kum ni na, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: Herod the king heard about these things, because the name of Jesus had become well-known. Some were saying, John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and this is why miraculous powers are at work through him.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni, tɔbbihi bɛn daa mali tɔbutuhiri nɛma balibu kam, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu saha shɛlikam, ka daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Dauda ni suhuyini kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinu.
en: From the tribe of Zebulun there were , trained soldiers. They were trained to use all kinds of weapons and were very loyal to David.

dag: Naa Dauda maa zuliya ni ka Naawuni daa ti Izraɛlnim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ Yisa kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la.
en: It was Jesus, a descendant of David, whom God made the Savior of the people of Israel, as he had promised.

dag: Tiŋgbani daa bɔɣiya m-mum Datan, ka pi Abiram min o nyaandoliba.
en: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.

dag: Ka Matania mini Bakibukia ni Obadia ni Mɛshulam ni Talimɔn ni Akub bɛn nyɛ dunɔguliba la daa ʒe n-guli nɛma du shɛŋa din daa be dunɔdaya shee la.
en: The following Temple guards were in charge of guarding the storerooms by the gates to the Temple: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nyɛla n tizɔdoo ŋun daa mɔɣi m ma bihili! N yi di nya a samban ni, n naan mɔɣis a noli ka so ku galim ma.
en: I wish that you were my brother, that my mother had nursed you at her breast. Then, if I met you in the street, I could kiss you and no one would mind.

dag: ka zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛl la ni be adaka shɛl ni la niŋ di puuni.
en: I've also put the sacred chest in the temple. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he rescued them from Egypt.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Praise the Lord ! Give thanks to the Lord , because he is good; his love is eternal.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ vinnyaɣilana o duu yɔɣira gɔŋdimi, ka o baɣa yi ka di ni, o duu maa ti yindimi.
en: Through laziness, the roof sags; through idle hands, the house leaks.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka bi deei li, ka niŋ tipawumli bɛ ni daa lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu, ka bɛ daa dolila bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm, ka lihirila bɛ nyaaŋa, ka bi lihiri bɛ tooni.
en: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.

dag: Mushi daa dɔɣi la bidibisi ata, Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt.
en: Mushis sons were Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth. There were three sons in all.

dag: Yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-nyɛ alibarika maa.
en: You will get the blessing if you listen and obey the commands of the Lord your God that I have told you today.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Then if somebody says to you, Look, heres the Christ, or Hes over here, dont believe it.

dag: O larila dabiɛm, o bi zɔri dabiɛm, o bi tiriti gbini takɔbi zuɣu.
en: They do not know the meaning of fear, and no sword can turn them back.

dag: Di veeni ni nir kul maag o ni baalim guhiri Yawɛ tiliginsim.
en: It is good to wait quietly for the Lord to save them.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla n naba firila mini n soli neesim.
en: Your word is a lamp before my feet and a light for my journey.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o ku garigi ba; di saha maa, o ni ti lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: The time is coming when you will cry out to the Lord , but he will not answer you. He will not listen to your prayers, for you have done evil.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya daa sabi pa binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ tabili maa zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Hakalia bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la, mini Zɛdɛkia ni.
en: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o yɛn chaŋ, ka yihi liɣiri kaman tumtumda daba ayi yɔri ti o yilikpɛrilana, ka yɛl o ni o lihim bara maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka lan yɛli ni hal o yi ti di laɣ shɛli o ni ti o maa pooi ka di omaŋmaŋ liɣiri pahi, o yi ti labina o ni yo o.
en: The next day, the Samaritan took out two silver coins and gave them to the man who worked at the inn. He said, Take care of this hurt man. If you spend more money on him, I will pay it back to you when I come again.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa neei gom ni ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ bela kpe ka m bi mi.
en: Jacob woke up and said, The Lord is here! He is in this place, and I didn't know it.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa laɣim niriba maa tampiŋ maa gbini ka Musa ti yɛli ba, Yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ, wummiya pumpɔŋɔ, ti chɛ ka kom yi kuɣili ŋɔ ni na n-tin ya.
en: He and Aaron assembled the whole community in front of the rock, and Moses said, Listen, you rebels! Do we have to get water out of this rock for you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daantalisi maa sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdali luɣa zuɣu; yini daa sala nudirigu polo, ka din la mi sa nuzaa polo. Ka bɛ daa boli din sa nudirigu polo maa Jachin, ka boli din sa nuzaa polo maa mi Bɔaz.
en: Then he put the columns up in front of the Temple. One column stood on the right side. The other column stood on the left side. He named the column on the right side Jakin. And he named the column on the left side Boaz.

dag: Wummiya, kuhigu din yiri Babilɔn na! Ninvuɣ kubo pam lu Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka wum n dimnim ni yɛri shɛm.
en: Please, Lord , answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.

dag: Amaa o daa tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la tatabo. O daa bi lɔɣ li.
en: But he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to do.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa su bi nɛɔŋ maa puu daa biɛr o bia maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli naa, N dana, zaŋm bia maa ti o ka di ku o. Amaa ka paɣ ŋun la yɛli, Pirigim o buyi, ka o lan pa n dini bee o dini.
en: Please don't kill my son, the baby's mother screamed. Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him. The other woman shouted, Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.

dag: Bɛ yaala bɛ noya gu ma. Bɛ bemi kaman gbuɣinli ŋun bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma, ka ŋumdi la.
en: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.

dag: Ka mɔɣili dɔni bihigu tiŋgban tulli shee; ka tiŋgban kuŋ shee leei kɔbil nina. Ka mɔri zooi lim kunduna ni daa yi be luɣ shɛli.
en: Now people see mirages that look like water, but then there will be real pools of water. There will be wells in the dry land where water flows from the ground. Tall water plants will grow where wild animals once ruled.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa mini Lɛvinim daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni di puuni la shɛŋa din be kasi la zaa na.
en: and carried it to the Temple. The Levites and the priests also moved the Tent of the Lord 's presence and all its equipment to the Temple.

dag: Ŋunkam fiɣisir o ʒiʒiinikpee ashilɔni, n ni ku dilana. Ŋunkam nyuri bara ka mali karimbaani; m mini dilana ku kpe.
en: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.

dag: Amaa a yi labi tiŋ maa puuni nti yɛli Absalom, N dan naa, n ni leeg a kpambala. Kaman n ni yi kul nyɛ a ba kpambala shɛm, lala ka n yɛn nyɛ a gba kpambala, dina n-ni chɛ ka a nyaŋ Ahitɔfɛl yikombiɛlim maa ti ma.
en: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, King, I am your servant! Please spare my life! I was your fathers servant in the past, but now I am your servant, then you can help me by countering Ahithophels advice.

dag: Yi bo biŋkumda, ka ŋma yila kaman Dauda ni daa ŋma yila shɛm la n-yiini li.
en: who sing idle songs to the sound of the harp, and, like David, compose tunes on musical instruments.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha dabili m-be.
en: Whoever wants to be first among you will be your slave.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama m pun zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ ni so ku tooi zani yi tooni.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Dont be afraid of those armies. I will allow you to defeat them. None of them will be able to defeat you.

dag: Pa yinima m-pii ma, amaa mani m-pii ya, ka zali ya ni yi chaŋ ti pum puma n-wali ka yi wala maa ku kpihim; ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: You didnt choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you could go and produce fruit and so that your fruit could last. As a result, whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaayi Rubin mini Gaad ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba.
en: The clans that were descendants of Merari received towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

dag: Kul yumiya taba kaman yi nyɛla mabi yinsi la.
en: Keep on loving one another as Christians.

dag: Jintɔriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka suli ku ba pam, ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku Yisa tuumba maa.
en: When the members of the Council heard this, they were so furious that they wanted to have the apostles put to death.

dag: Yi zɔnim mini yi dɔɣiriba ni yi mabihi hal zaŋ tabili yi banim mini yi manim ni ti chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya n-ku yi ni shɛb gba.
en: You will be handed over by your parents, your brothers, your relatives, and your friends; and some of you will be put to death.

dag: Chɛli ma ka n ku ba n-kpihim bɛ yuli dunia ni, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka galisi gari ba.
en: Don't try to stop me. I intend to destroy them so that no one will remember them any longer. Then I will make you the father of a nation larger and more powerful than they are.

dag: Wulinluhili polo din ti yɛn nyɛ mita tusaayi ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la gba ni ti malila dunɔdaya ata. Gaad zuliya dunɔdali mini Asha zuliya dunɔdali ni Naftali zuliya dunɔdali.
en: The west side of the city will be cubits long. There will be three gates: Gads Gate, Ashers Gate, and Naphtalis Gate.

dag: N yi yi mɔɣ kpaŋa, n nyarila bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛb sɔŋ. Ka n yi kpe tiŋ puuni, n nyarila kum ni gbarigi shɛb sɔŋ. Ka anabinim mini maligumaaniba kul tumdi bɛ tuma tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni, ka bi mi ni binshɛli niŋda.
en: If I go into the fields, I see only the slain in battle. If I enter the city, I see only those suffering from famine. Even both prophet and priest wander about aimlessly in ignorance.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu maa naai, ka o zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni;.
en: When David finished offering the entirely burned offerings and the well-being sacrifices, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: N ni ti daai yi maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la. Ka n ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku yi ninvuɣ shɛba bahi yi buɣa maa tooni.
en: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Sool ni Dauda be Kɛila, ka Sool yɛli, Naawuni zaŋ o niŋ n nuu ni, dama o kpari omaŋa n-niŋ tin shɛli din dunoya mali pundi mini kur wɔɣila din kpariti dunoya.
en: People told Saul that David was now at Keilah. Saul said, God has given David to me. David trapped himself when he went into a city surrounded by a wall with gates and bars to lock them.

dag: Di saha zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛŋa din be di ni ni ti yo vuri, ka mali suhupiɛlli Babilɔn zuɣu, dama bɛn ti yɛn wurim li maa ni ti yila nuzaa polo na. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everything on earth and in the sky will shout for joy when Babylonia falls to the people who come from the north to destroy it.

dag: Bɛ gbila bɔɣili kpe tiŋgban ni katiŋa, ka di mini ninsalinim ni be shɛli waɣa, ka sochandiba bi mi bɛ yɛla. Bɛ yilila mihi zuɣu m-be katiŋa laana.
en: open a shaft away from any inhabitant, places forgotten by those on foot, apart from any human they hang and sway.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu n-vihir o ni o baŋ o nyaandoliba min o wuhibu yɛla.
en: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.

dag: Ka zuɣulan maa yɛl o, N Duuma, kamina paai m bia maa ka o na bi kpi.
en: The royal official said to him, Lord, come before my son dies.

dag: O kurimmi, ka dɔni kaman gbuɣindaa la. O ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yiɣis o? Ŋunkam niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, o ni nya alibarika; ka ŋunkam yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi yi zuɣu, yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu maa din dim o.
en: Like a lion you lie down, resting after an attack. Who would dare disturb you? Anyone who blesses you will be blessed; anyone who curses you will be cursed.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa suhuri daa paligi bɛ pɔri maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa pola pɔri maa ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka suhi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔr shɛli zaa, ka Naawuni daa deei bɛ suhigu maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ tɛhima, ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali na mi n-kpi? Bee ya polo ka bɛ mi n-zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun biɛhigu tuhi?.
en: Think back now. Name a single case where someone righteous met with disaster.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tum tuma ti yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, dama n suhu yiɣisiya, ka n dabi buɣim din kul ni diri sahakam.
en: I will make you serve your enemies in a land you dont know, for my anger blazes like a fire that wont go out.

dag: Ka Kɔniilius yɛl o, Daantal la kurig ata saha ka n daa suhiri Naawuni n yili ŋɔ nti nya ka do so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒe n tooni.
en: Cornelius said, Four days ago, I was praying in my house. It was at this same time—three oclock in the afternoon. Suddenly there was someone standing before me wearing bright, shiny clothes.

dag: Nyam n dimnim ni galisi shɛm; ka nya bɛ ni je ma pam shɛm.
en: Look at all the enemies I have. They hate me and want to hurt me.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o kpɛhi tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee ka bɛ ti fiɛb o n-vih o baŋ din chɛ ka niriba maa tahiri pampam o zuɣu maa.
en: The Roman commander ordered Paul to be taken into the fortress and beaten with a whip. He did this to find out why the people were screaming at Paul.

dag: Di saha maa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani yɛli Yisa Galilinim ni daa maani ʒim yihibu sara ka Gomna Pailɛt chaŋ ti ku bɛ ni shɛb la yɛla.
en: At that time some people were there who told Jesus about the Galileans whom Pilate had killed while they were offering sacrifices to God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dɔbba, ka ku yi tɔbutuhiriba tɔbu ni.
en: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.

dag: Ŋunkam bi yuri ma je ni o doli n yɛligu. Yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa dini.
en: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.

dag: Ka o daa tim o nyaandoliba ayi n-yɛli ba, Chamiya fɔŋ ni; yi yi ti chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o.
en: Then Jesus sent two of them with these instructions: Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm gbibbu fukumsi niŋ n tizo Hanani mini Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ birini guliba kpɛm la nuu ni, dama Hanania daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun zɔri Naawuni n-gari niriba pam.
en: Then I put my brother Hanani and Hananiah the commander of the fortress in charge of Jerusalem. Hananiah was a faithful man who revered God more than many.

dag: Ka so yi ti nya zahimbu, ŋun miri ka o yɛli ni Naawuni n-zahim o, dama zahimbu din ni chɛ ka nir tum zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi zahim Naawuni, ka ŋun Naawuni mi ku zahim so lala.
en: No one who is tested should say, God is tempting me! This is because God is not tempted by any form of evil, nor does he tempt anyone.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, yi ni yɛn puhiri chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinim yi sani, ka nyɛ man Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: the following regulations for the religious festivals, when the people of Israel are to gather for worship.

dag: N ni ti ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri bɛn be kulisi ni, ka ninsalinim naba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha, ka niɣi takarifiɛma gba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha.
en: There are many animals by the rivers in Egypt. I will also destroy all those animals. People will not make the waters muddy with their feet anymore. The hoofs of cattle will not make the water muddy anymore.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi gbaai biŋkɔbigu maa, di simdi ka o zaŋ o chɛra na ti wuhi shɛhira, ka di bi simdi ni o yo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so maa zuɣu.
en: If wild animals killed the animal, then the neighbor should bring the body as proof. The neighbor will not have to pay the owner for the animal that was killed.

dag: Amaa ka n niriba zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu; Izraɛlnim zaɣisiya ni bɛ kul ku deei n noli.
en: But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!.

dag: Ŋunkam mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, noli din dim o! Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who deprives foreigners, orphans, and widows of their rights. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, so baɣa kani bee m-baŋdi din tahi lala na. Amaa bɛ yi kpi, bɛ yila zaɣ biɛɣu ni kpe suhudoo ni.
en: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away.

dag: Amaa pa sokam zaa m-mali dimbɔŋɔ baŋsim, dama yɛdaniŋdib bɛn pun mili buɣa yi di bindirigu ŋɔ tatabo, bɛ tɛhirimi ni di nyɛla bɛ ni shiri zaŋ shɛli mali buɣili, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu chɛ ka di nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ lala, ka daa bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣiri na nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, ka zaŋ naɣibihi maa niŋ duu n-yo ba niŋ di ni.
en: They did what they were told: they took two cows and hitched them to the wagon, and shut the calves in the barn.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ku chaŋ. Amaa di nyaaŋa ka o suhu ti lɛbigi ka o chaŋ.
en: The son answered, I will not go. But later he decided he should go, and he went.

dag: Ka shia maa daa kpalim zani, amaa n daa bi tooi baŋ di ŋmahiŋgbana ni nyɛ shɛm. Kɔtomsi shɛli n-daa ʒe n tooni, ka vuri daa fo, di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli ni yɛli.
en: It stopped. I didnt recognize its visible form, although a figure was in front of my eyes. Silence! Then I heard a voice.

dag: Ka Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa biŋkumdiŋmɛriba zuɣulan la daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhiri bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri biŋkumda maa shɛm, dama ŋuna n-daa mi di ŋmɛbu.
en: The Levite leader Kenaniah was in charge of the singing. Kenaniah had this job because he was very skilled at singing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram ʒii nyabu puuni, Ibram, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, n ni gbib a ka chɛ ka a laara ti galisi pam.
en: After these events, the LORDs word came to Abram in a vision, Dont be afraid, Abram. I am your protector. Your reward will be very great.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yiɣisi zani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini gbini Izraɛlnim zaa ninni n-kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: Solomon stood facing the altar with everyone standing behind him. Then he lifted his arms toward heaven.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zaŋsim be jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni, ka n gbilisiri tibili wumdi bɛ ni yɛn suhiri suhigu shɛli kpe ŋɔ.
en: I will hear the prayers made in this temple.

dag: A mi Naawuni ni zali ba o zaligu shɛm n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisir o sagbana ni ŋɔ?.
en: Do you know how God gives the command and makes lightning flash from the clouds?.

dag: Tumo ŋun biɛ tahirila yɛla na, amaa tumo ŋun ʒe yim tahirila faako na.
en: Disaster will catch up to the wicked messenger, but a runner who can be trusted will bring peace.

dag: O ni chɛ ka bidibbihi nyɛ bɛ nanima, ka biliɛri su ba.
en: He will let children and babies become your rulers.

dag: Naawuni zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni; ka ŋmalig a nini lihi ti ni yurilim.
en: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Hal a ni bi mi ma maa zaa yoli, n ni ti a yaa.
en: I am the Lord , the only God. There is no other God except me. I put your clothes on you, but still you dont know me.

dag: A daa tahi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu zuɣu ka di kom vuui; ka chɛ ka bɛ no tiŋkuŋ zuɣu kaman tiŋgban nɛl la du.
en: God scolded the Reed Sea, and it dried right up; he led them through the deeps like they were a dry desert.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ doola anzinfa m-mali di dasara pa di dunɔpaɣisi zuɣu, ka dooi salima n-zaŋ mali di nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ mali di kuɣa, ka Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba zaŋ yurilim mali di puuni.
en: The poles were made from silver, and the supports were made from gold. The seat was covered with purple cloth. It was inlaid with love by the women of Jerusalem.

dag: Nia biɛri nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din viɛla.
en: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but he is pleased with friendly words.

dag: Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Di pahiya shɛli di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni.
en: Everything Im commanding you, you must do it with utmost care! Dont add anything to it or take anything away from it.

dag: Wula ka a yɛn tooi niŋ tuhi nyaŋ n dan sapashin bil yino gba, a yi du m-bala Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti a chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba?.
en: How will you drive back even the least important official among my masters servants when you are relying on Egypt for chariots and riders?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiɔŋ yir a sanna mal alibarika, bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri kul bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Ziɔn ti jɛm a.
en: Those who put their strength in you are truly happy; pilgrimage is in their hearts.

dag: Tuuli, n daa wumya ni yi yi mali cheechi laɣiŋgu, woligibu be yi sunsuuni, ka n tɛhiri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: In the first place, I have been told that there are opposing groups in your meetings; and this I believe is partly true. .

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala. Ka Ijiptinim maa biŋkɔbiri zaa daa kpi, amaa ka Izraɛlnim bɛn so biŋkɔbigu daa bi kpi.
en: It happened the next day—all of the animals belonging to the Egyptians died, but the Israelites did not lose even one.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N ku tooi zaŋ n ni tum shɛm buɣisi yi ni tum shɛm. Hal yinim Ifriim zuliya niriba ni tum biɛla shɛli maa gari tinim Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni tum shɛm zaa.
en: Gideon answered: Don't be upset! Even though you came later, you were able to do much more than I did. It's just like the grape harvest: The grapes your tribe doesn't even bother to pick are better than the best grapes my family can grow.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N daa tɛhimi ni so ka kpe n-zɔri Naawuni, ka tɛhi ni bɛ ni ku ma m paɣ maa zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka n niŋ lala maa.
en: Abraham answered, I thought that there would be no one here who has reverence for God and that they would kill me to get my wife.

dag: Niriba pam beni n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra: Yawɛ, niŋm alibarika niŋ ti ni! Niŋm ti nirilim.
en: There are some who ask, Who will be good to us? Let your kindness, Lord , shine brightly on us.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma, Molimi molo pahi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka n tinsi maa lan tɔŋ, ka lan sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di wuhi ni mani n-su li.
en: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion.

dag: Ka daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa n-labir o ba maa sani. O ni daa ti na be katiŋ ha kanna ka o ba maa nya o ka nambɔɣu gbaag o pam; ka o yiɣisi zo nti tuh o soli m-bɔbi gbaag o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The younger son got up and started back to his father. But when he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt sorry for him. He ran to his son and hugged and kissed him.

dag: O darigi deei m binyɛrigu, o ʒe n-dila m binyɛrigu nyiŋgoli mali.
en: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ti yɛn kana la shilinshia, amaa din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli m-be Masia ni la yipa paana.
en: In the past these things were like a shadow that showed what was coming. But the new things that were coming are found in Christ.

dag: A daa nya ti yaannim ni diri wahala shɛm Ijipti; ka daa wum bɛ fabila Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: You saw our ancestors suffering in Egypt and heard them call for help by the Red Sea.

dag: Dabisili din pahi pia dali, Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Dan zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the tenth day Dans Chief Ahiezer, Ammishaddais son.

dag: Ka o nyintaa daa yi kur o suli pam n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisira, Yawɛ ni daa bi ti o bia maa zuɣu.
en: And because the LORD had kept Hannah from conceiving, her rival would make fun of her mercilessly, just to bother her.

dag: Ka di ti pa Aduna gbɛɣu zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka Aduna ti deei taali shɛli din ni be Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bɛ pin kasi shɛŋa zaa na ni bɛ ti mali sara kasi maa ni ʒi. Di simdi ka di kul pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ ba nirilim.
en: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.

dag: N yiko din galisi puuni ka n daa teei n nuu nam dunia mini ninsalinima ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni, ka zaŋdi li tiri n nini ni tiɣi so.
en: By my great power and outstretched arm, I have made the earth and the people and animals that are on it. I can give it to anyone I please.

dag: Ka laɣiŋgu maa ni kpamba ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni maa.
en: The elders of the people must put their hands on the bulls head in front of the Lord . Then they must kill the bull in front of the Lord .

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu; wummi n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to my words!.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ dansarika n ni tumdi n Duuma tuma la zuɣu kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali biɛhigu din doli Naawuni ni daa zali ya biɛhigu so shɛl o ni daa boli ya boligu shɛl la puuni.
en: Therefore, as a prisoner for the Lord, I encourage you to live as people worthy of the call you received from God.

dag: Dama yi yi diri wahala din tuhi tumbu zuɣu ka di nyɛla Naawuni yubu m-bala, di so ni yi di wahala din bi tuhi tumbu zuɣu.
en: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yɛli ni alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But the Pharisees said, It is the chief of the demons who gives Jesus the power to drive out demons.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa min o ba malibu maa zaa, N ni chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, M ba min o malibu ni m biɛyanim bɛn be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kuli n sanna.
en: Then Joseph said to his brothers and the rest of his father's family, I must go and tell the king that my brothers and all my father's family, who were living in Canaan, have come to me.

dag: Ka din pahi piniyini gbaai Ɛliashib, ka din pahi pinaayi gbaai Jakim.
en: The eleventh was Eliashibs group. The twelfth was Jakims group.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni jɛm a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ka tum din tuhi a sani shɛm yɛla; ka daa kum pam.
en: Please, LORD, remember how Ive walked before you in truth and sincerity. Ive done what you consider to be good. Then Hezekiah cried and cried.

dag: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi, dapaɣili kam diba ayi.
en: and their forty silver bases, two bases under the first board, two bases under the next board, and so on.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said:.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Kalidia din nyɛ kɔhigɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ la ni, hal ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi dimbɔŋɔ gba.
en: So you prostituted yourself with the Babylonians, the land of traders, but again you werent satisfied.

dag: Sulemaana daa yi nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuuni kam puuni.
en: Solomon received almost tons of gold each year.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛl ti ni ti chɛ ka ti bebu doli zaligu shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim la, amaa ka ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum ti a.
en: We didnt listen to the voice of the LORD our God by following the teachings he gave us through his servants, the prophets.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ku yi tibidarigibo ni, ka ʒirilan mi ni kpi.
en: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.

dag: Di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi ku o shia; amaa zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi zaŋ daadam niŋgbuŋ min o shia zaa niŋ buɣim ni la.
en: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather be afraid of God, who can destroy both body and soul in hell.

dag: Ka Javan bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Dɔdanim.
en: The descendants of Javan were the people of Elishah, Spain, Cyprus, and Rhodes;.

dag: Yurilim bi mali suhupiɛlli taali tumbu ni, amaa di naɣ mali suhupiɛlli la yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.

dag: Yi ni di bindira, amaa ka ku tiɣi, ka kum na kul ni mali ya. Yi ni ti zaŋ yi binyara sɔɣi, amaa ka di ku tiligi. Ka yi yi ti zali binshɛŋa, n ni chɛ ka tɔbu di li.
en: You will eat, but you will not become full. You will still be hungry and empty. You will try to bring people to safety, but people with swords will kill the people you rescued.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ suhigu mini bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni suh a bɔri shɛli maa ti ba, ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum birig a maa taali.
en: then listen to their prayers. In your home in heaven hear them and be merciful to them and forgive all the sins of your people.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: So I beg you to be like me.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui ka bɛ gun o, ka bol o yuli Yisa, din nyɛ yu shɛli malaika ni daa pun ti o ka Mariama naanyi zal o puu la.
en: A week later, when the time came for the baby to be circumcised, he was named Jesus, the name which the angel had given him before he had been conceived.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Shia Kasi n-tahiri ma Jɛrusalɛm, ka m mi bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ ma nimaani.
en: I don't know what will happen to me in Jerusalem, but I must obey God's Spirit and go there.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna nti yɛli ba, Suhimiya Yawɛ ka o yihi poloya maa ka chɛ m mini n niriba ŋɔ, ka n chɛ ka yi niriba maa chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: The king sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, If you ask the Lord to take these frogs away from me and my people, I will let your people go and offer sacrifices to him.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus said to them, You have read what David did when he and those with him were hungry.

dag: Ka Krispus ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda ka Kɔrintinim pam bɛn daa wum Pool yɛligu maa gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his entire household came to believe in the Lord. Many Corinthians believed and were baptized after listening to Paul.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi bɛba ayopɔin daa doli bɛ nyaaŋa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na nti zani naɣ bɛmbala maa sani Nail Mɔɣili maa duli.
en: Then seven ugly, skinny cows came up out of the river and.

dag: N tiŋgbani yi di kuhi jɛndi ma, ka m puu ni pimpama di laɣim kum.
en: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Amasa, Cham ti boli Judanim zaa ka bɛ laɣim n sanna daba ata sunsuuni, ka a gba beni pahi.
en: Then the king said to Amasa, Call everyone in Judah here to me three days from now. You should be here too.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman wain pipia la, ka zuliya kam bɛn gil li nyu li n-jeeni kaman danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣ la. Ka bɛ yi ti teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni teei gili Juda tinsi la gba.
en: I am about to make Jerusalem a cup that will stagger all the surrounding nations. There will be a siege against Judah and against Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋun zaŋ omaŋ tabili tayiɣa je omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili; o yi wumdi niriba ni yɛri zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn niŋ tayiɣ maa, amaa ka o bi viir o gbini.
en: A thief's partner is his own worst enemy. He will be punished if he tells the truth in court, and God will curse him if he doesn't.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli soli din tuhi nyɛla bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛriyoli ʒiɛmd o mi.
en: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord ; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Jɔn gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pɔri Naawuni nam ni galisi gar o.
en: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.

dag: Dama a tiligi ma kum ni, ka chɛ ka m bi lu ni di chɛ ka m be a tooni n-chani nyɛvili neesim puuni.
en: You saved me from death. You kept me from being defeated. So I will serve you in the light that only the living can see.

dag: Ka n yi na be n nyɛvil ni ka ni tooi tum tuun shɛli din mali buchi, dindina m bi jɛndi mi n ni yɛn pii shɛli bina ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.

dag: Miri ka a zabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli bee m-bɔri ni a mini ba be.
en: Dont be jealous of evil people. Have no desire to be around them.

dag: Pa dahin yini ka yi yɛn ŋub li bee daba ayi bee daba anu bee biɛɣu pia bee biɛɣ pisi.
en: In fact, they will have meat day after day for a whole month—not just a few days, or even or . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.

dag: ka wɔr piɛla vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ata, ka wɔr fufuhisi vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah anahi mi.
en: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.

dag: Naawuni yi saɣi ti ni kpaŋ timaŋ chaŋla tooni.
en: Were going to press on, if God allows it.

dag: ka Yisa mabihi yɛl o, Yim kpe chaŋ Judia ka di chɛ ka a nyaandoliba nya tuun shɛŋa a ni tumdi ŋɔ.
en: so Jesus' brothers said to him, Leave this place and go to Judea, so that your followers will see the things that you are doing.

dag: nti yɛli ba, M mi ni Yawɛ zaŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka dabiɛm pun gbahi ti pam yi zuɣu; ka bɛnkam zaa be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni suhuri fuŋmi.
en: She said to the men, I know that the LORD has given you the land. Terror over you has overwhelmed us. The entire population of the land has melted down in fear because of you.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi yɛtɔɣa nyɔni Yawɛ nyee. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee chɛ ka o nyee nyɔni? Yi ni yɛra, Ŋunkam tum zaɣ biɛɣu, di nyɛla din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ o ni bɔri shɛl la. Bee yi ni bɔhira, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan maa lee be ya la.
en: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, How did we do that? You did it by saying, The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali suhupiɛlli n zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ n san la nya filiŋ ka di vi.
en: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, You are nothing.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti kpe alibarika shɛl ni ti ni be ŋɔ, ka mali suhupiɛlli ti tahima shɛli ti ni mali zaŋ chaŋ ti mini Naawuni ni laɣim nya jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini tiŋa o sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛl o shɛli, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka o be biɛrim pam ni.
en: Then they sat on the ground with Job for seven days and seven nights. They didnt say a word, because they saw he was in so much pain.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a nam jaaŋgbee yi Ziɔn na, ka a di nam a dimnim sunsuuni.
en: The Lord will cause your kingdom to grow, beginning at Zion, until you rule the lands of your enemies!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na ti zali di zaashee Dauda ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni. Ka Dauda daa mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: They brought the Box and put it in its place in the Tent that David had set up for it. Then he offered sacrifices and fellowship offerings to the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi dindali maa n-zo Sool sani kuli Gaat Naa Akishi sani.
en: So David got up and continued running from Saul. He went to Achish, Gaths king.

dag: Wummiya! Baansi bɛn be kɔbilisi gbini yɛri Yawɛ nasara dibu yɛla nimaani, nasara din nyɛ Izraɛl kpariba nasara! Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ niriba daa chaŋ dari dibu chandi yi bɛ tinsi ni na.
en: Listen! The noisy crowds around the wells are telling of the Lord 's victories, the victories of Israel's people! Then the Lord 's people marched down from their cities.

dag: Bɛ ni be yi sani yi sunsuuni tin shɛli bɛ ni pii yi tinsi maa ni ka di nyɛ din viɛl bɛ sani. Miriya ka yi ti muɣisi ba.
en: They can stay with you: in your own community or in any place they select from one of your cities, whatever seems good to them. Dont oppress them.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka dam ŋɔ yɛn yi a ninni? Ka yɛl o, Chɛli wain nyubu.
en: How long are you going to stay drunk? he asked. Sober up.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha ti ku o.
en: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

dag: Yi ni daa ŋme n-nyaŋ zuliya pam ka di bɛ nɛma la zuɣu, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim gba ni ti ŋmɛn ya ka di yi nɛma, yi ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb mini yi ni daa chɛ ka damli shɛli dam dunia ni fɔntinsi ni n-tabili bɛnkam zaa be di ni la zuɣu.
en: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa ni lɔris anahi ni daa malila dundombihi, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaanu. Diba anahi maa zaa daa saɣila taba.
en: At each corner I saw a smaller courtyard, meters long and meters wide.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla bundaannima, amaa ka ka shɛli, ka shɛb mi niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla faranima, amaa ka mali buni pam.
en: Some pretend to be rich but have nothing, while others pretend to be poor, but have great riches.

dag: O puli zuɣu gbaŋ ŋmanila salichɛhi; o teer omaŋ dooni baɣiri ni kaman kaburi dɔɣu la.
en: The scales on his belly are like jagged pieces of pottery; they tear up the muddy ground like a threshing sledge.

dag: Ka bɛ daa go n-gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa n-daa mali ti paai tin shɛli din yuli booni Pafɔs. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chirigi do so ŋun nyɛ bukpaha ka o yuli booni Baajiisɛs. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia nira ŋun nyɛ anab ʒirilana.
en: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.

dag: Zalim ba dimbɔŋɔ lala, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku mali galimi.
en: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.

dag: Ka o bidibiga Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam n-zan o zaani, ka daa mali shili gu Izraɛlnima.
en: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo dunoli maa, niriba ayɔbuyɔbu n-daa yi gul li dabisili kam, ka niriba anahinahi daa yi guli nuzaa polo dunoya la dabisili kam, ka niriba ayiyi mi daa guli nɛma duu la dabisili kam.
en: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms.

dag: Ninkur teempiɛla be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn kurigi gar a ba.
en: Both the graybeard and the aged are with us; those much older than your father.

dag: Nimaani ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa yi wulimpuhili polo kanna, di vuri daa ŋmanila kom din mali yaa vuri, ka o jilima daa neei tiŋgban ni.
en: There the Glory of the God of Israel came from the east. Gods voice was loud like the sound of the sea. The ground was bright with the light from the Glory of God.

dag: Daba bɛn yi n-zo bɛ laamba sani n-ka yi sanna, yin di lan zaŋ ba labisi ti bɛ laamba maa.
en: If slaves run away from their owners and come to you for protection, do not send them back.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni daa bɔri ni o kahigi wuhi bɛn ti yɛn nya o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la palibu, ka lan wuhi ni o ku taɣ o ni lo shɛm la zuɣu, ka o daa po pɔri pah o daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: When God wanted to further demonstrate to the heirs of the promise that his purpose doesnt change, he guaranteed it with a solemn pledge.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Ŋun daa zo o nambɔɣu la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A gba cham ti niŋmi lala.
en: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, The one who showed pity. Jesus said, Go and do the same.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pirigi maligumaaniba zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi, ka pirigi Lɛvinima zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi ni bɛ tumdi Naawuni tuma Jɛrusalɛm kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la.
en: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their sections for the service of God in Jerusalem, as it is written in the scroll from Moses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka o daa kpam Otiniɛl jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na, ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: On the wedding day Othniel urged her to ask her father for a field. She got down from her donkey, and Caleb asked her what she wanted.

dag: Dama bɛ yihi ba la Izraɛlnim puuni n-zaŋ ba ti ma zaa ka n deei ba leei n ni su shɛba, ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba.
en: They are given over to me from the Israelites in place of all the newborn, the oldest of all the Israelites. I take them for myself.

dag: Mani n-ni ti nyɛ o ba ka o mi nyɛ m bia, ka o yi ti tum taali, n ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb o n-saɣis o kaman ninsalinim ni saɣisiri bɛ bihi shɛm.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him as a father punishes his son.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza sapashin kpamba ni daa mali salima nyɔtaɣiri shɛŋa n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David captured the gold shields carried by Hadadezer's officials and took them to Jerusalem.

dag: Naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin bɛn daa yina n-kul gaŋsigaŋsi la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din daa nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛl la gba gbinni nyɛla kum lubu yuma ayopɔin.
en: The seven skinny, ugly cows that came up later also stand for seven years, as do the seven bad heads of grain that were scorched by the desert wind. The dreams mean there will be seven years when there won't be enough grain.

dag: ni Bɛtipɛɔr ni Pisiga zolɔŋni ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt.
en: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kul lihiri tooni, ka a kul lihir a tooni tibi.
en: Keep your eyes on the path, and look straight ahead.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli nyariba, Di lan nyan ya, ka yɛli anabinima, Di yɛliya ti din tuhi; naɣ yɛlimiya ti la ti suhu ni yu shɛli ni binshɛŋa din bi tuhi yɛla.
en: who say to the seers, Dont foresee, and to the visionaries, Dont report truthful visions; tell us flattering things; envision deceptions.

dag: Lɛvinima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, Yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Yawɛ, paɣimiy o!.
en: House of Levi, bless the LORD! You who honor the LORD, bless the LORD!.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ zaa din nyɛ yi ni be tiŋgban shɛli puuni n-nyɛ saamba ŋɔ n-ti a min a zuliya maa, ka yi su li sahakam, ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: And I will give this land to you and to all your descendants. I will give you the land you are traveling through—the land of Canaan. I will give you this land forever, and I will be your God.

dag: amaa ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi ni nya jilima mini paɣibu ni suhudoo, Yɛhudianima n-lan daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa lan yɛli, Wummiya sariakarita bilikɔɣindan maa ni daa yɛli shɛm.
en: The Lord said, Listen to what the unjust judge says.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini tuya ʒiɛri maa ti Iso ka o di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi chaŋ o chandi shee. Lala ka Iso daa niŋ ʒiɛm o kpamdi maa.
en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil soup. Esau ate the food, had something to drink, and then left. So Esau showed that he did not care about his rights as the firstborn son.

dag: Nir yi lo wahu kabire o dimbu nyaaŋa, di ku ku ŋun lo o kabire maa buchi.
en: Someone might know how to control snakes. But that skill is useless if a snake bites when that person is not around.

dag: N daa wuhi ba n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi. Ka ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right.

dag: Yinim Iso zuliya, bɛ ni ʒiɛn ya n-zaŋ yi daazichi chaŋ.
en: How Esau has been looted, his treasures taken away!.

dag: Kawana bee chi sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ti zaŋ li mali sara Yawɛ sani sara maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: This is the law for the grain offering: The sons of Aaron will bring it to the front of the altar as an offering to the Lord .

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o daa chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: After God finished talking with Abraham, God went up into heaven.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Samsin chaŋ ni o ti puh o paɣ maa alikama chɛbu saha, ka ʒi bubil polli mali ni o ti ti o paɣ maa. Ka Samsin daa ti yɛl o paɣ maa ba, N ni kpe m paɣ sani. Amaa ka o paɣ ba maa bi saɣi;.
en: Some time later Samson went to visit his wife during the wheat harvest and took her a young goat. He told her father, I want to go to my wife's room. But he wouldn't let him go in.

dag: Bɛ daa lihiya, amaa ka so daa kani ŋun ni tiligi ba. Bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o daa bi garigi ba.
en: They looked around, but there was no one to save them. They looked to the LORD, but he wouldnt answer them.

dag: nyini n-daa chɛ ka a dabili ti yab Naa Dauda yaag o noli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni yɛli: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim jɛri suli tahira, ka zuliya kam tɔri jin yoya?.
en: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?.

dag: Amaa nyama, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn tibi Izraɛlnima, Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri yirila palo, ka Samarianim ninvuɣ biɛtali yi zahira; dama bɛ ŋmari ʒiri, ka tayiɣisi kabiri yiya n-kpɛri ti zura, ka ninvuɣ fariba mi be samban ni fara.
en: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi; di chɛ ka n di vi. A wuntitali puuni, tiligim ma!.
en: I come to you, Lord , for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a daba niŋgbuna ti juri bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ bɛn ʒe a yim niŋgbuna ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be tiŋgban ni.
en: Theyve left your servants bodies as food for the birds; theyve left the flesh of your faithful to the wild animals of the earth.

dag: Ya polo ka Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva buɣa la lee be? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: When I destroyed the cities of Hamath and Arpad, where were their gods? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were any gods able to save Samaria from my power?.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa kpe bɛ sunsuuni ka bɛ woligi taba di zuɣu; ka Baanabas daa zaŋ Maak pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus.
en: Paul and Barnabas had a big argument about this. It was so bad that they separated and went different ways. Barnabas sailed to Cyprus and took Mark with him.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ chaŋ ha nti lan gili Baala wulinluhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛdom zoya ni n-zaŋ chaŋ hal ti baɣisi Jiarim Zoli nuzaa polo gari bee din nyɛ Chɛsalɔn la, ka di lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-gari chaŋ ti baɣisi Timna gari.
en: At Baalah the border turned west and went to the hill country of Seir. The border continued along the north side of Mount Jearim and continued down to Beth Shemesh. From there the border went past Timnah.

dag: Naawuni ni ti lu tiŋ maa zuɣu m-me bindura tabili di gooni gili.
en: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.

dag: Ka ŋun daŋ tooni daa yina m-mɔha, ka o niŋgbuŋ zaa mali kɔbiri m-be kaman biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri siturili la; ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Iso.
en: The first came out red all over, clothed with hair, and she named him Esau.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daantalisi sa zɔŋ, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka kazala din mali daantalisi daa be di tooni, ka pateesa yili di tooni.
en: He made a porch with columns that was seventy-five feet long and forty-five feet wide. Another porch was in front of these with roofed columns in front of them.

dag: Di saha Ɛli nina daa bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o bi tooi nyara; dahin shɛli yuŋ ka o daa ti do o dooshee;.
en: Elis eyes were getting so weak that he was almost blind. One night he went to his room to go to bed.

dag: Dinzuɣu do yino ŋun niŋgbuŋ daa gbarigi zaa la daa leei ŋun dɔɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi kaman saŋmarisi bee kaman teeku noli bihigu din ka kalinli ŋɔ.
en: Though Abraham was practically dead, from this one man came as many descendants as there are stars in the sky, as many as the numberless grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: Dama ŋuna m-bɔhiri biɛri niriba ʒim yihibu zuɣu. O bi tamdi bɛn nyari nahiŋgu kumsi yɛla.
en: God remembers those who suffer; he does not forget their cry, and he punishes those who wrong them.

dag: N ni yɛli Naawuni, Di wuhi ni m mali taali. Chɛ ka m baŋ a ni tuhiri ma daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: I will say to God, Dont just say I am guilty! Tell me what you have against me.

dag: O zaŋdi wahala n-fari bɛn be wahala ni bahira, ka zaŋdi nandahima n-yoori bɛ tiba.
en: He saves the weak in their affliction, opens their ears through oppression.

dag: Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tiligim ti! Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tim ti nasara!.
en: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana ti kpaag o kaman bɛ ni kpaari wain di duɣuri ni shɛm la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duɣuri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what the Lord says: But I will soon send men to pour you from your jars. Then they will empty the jars and smash them to pieces.

dag: Yihim ninvuɣ biɛri naa kɔbili ni, ka o nam maa leei wuntitali nam.
en: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.

dag: Di chɛ ka di yi a sani, gbibi li a suhu ni.
en: Never let them get away from you. Remember them and keep them in your heart.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛsi daa bol o bidibiga Abinadab na nti chɛ ka o gari Samuɛl tooni. Ka Samuɛl yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Then Jesse called his son Abinadab and brought him to Samuel. But Samuel said, No, the Lord hasn't chosen him either.

dag: Bashan Zoli din galisi, Bashan Zoli din mali chunchuna pam.
en: Mount Bashan is a great mountain with many high peaks.

dag: Naa Lɛmuɛl yɛtɔɣa, din nyɛ o ma ni daa wuh o anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: The words of King Lemuel of Massa, which his mother taught him.

dag: ka din pah ayopɔin gbaai Hakɔz, ka din pah anii gbaai Abija.
en: The seventh was Hakkozs group. The eighth was Abijahs group.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya dawule paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya dawule pampam paɣ o.
en: Praise him with cymbals. Praise him with loud cymbals.

dag: Karimbaannim kul ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma, amaa n dolila a zaligunim ni n suhu zaa.
en: The arrogant cover me with their lies, but I guard your precepts with all my heart.

dag: A nuhi ka a zaŋ me ma, ka lan ŋmaligi kuri ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Your hands formed and shaped me, and now those same hands destroy me.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa puuni ka din viɛl yirina ka bɛ dira, amaa bibiɛhi suhuri yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nirilim yɛla, ka kuhi yɛl a wuntia yɛla.
en: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.

dag: Amaa ti mabihi, yinim bi be zibisim ni ka dindali maa ni ti libigi ya kaman tayiɣa ni libigiri niriba shɛm la.
en: But you arent in darkness, brothers and sisters, so the day wont catch you by surprise like a thief.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-tiligi amaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: dama a kpe a ʒiʒiinikpee maa nuu ni, cham yomyom ti balim a ʒiʒiinikpee maa.
en: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.

dag: Ka Iso yɛli, Buyi ka o ŋari ma maa. O yuli Yaakubu maa shiri ŋman o. O daa fa n kpamdi, ka lan fa n daalibarika. Di saha ka o daa bɔh o ba, Ka daɣila a bi chɛ alibarika shɛli zali ma.
en: Esau said, Isnt this why hes called Jacob? Hes taken me twice now: he took my birthright, and now hes taken my blessing. He continued, Havent you saved a blessing for me.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Miriam shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt.

dag: Ka Makiri daa bo paɣiba ti Hupim mini Shupim. O tizɔpaɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka. O bidib so ŋun daa pahi ayi n-daa nyɛ Zɛlɔfɛhad, ŋun daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi noli.
en: Makir married a woman from the Huppites and Shuppites. Makirs sister was named Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad, who had only daughters.

dag: N ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni, ka yihi ba bɛ dimnim tiŋgbana ni na nti chɛ ka n kasitali yi palo bɛ zuɣu ka zuliya kam nya li la.
en: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, I will be made holy through them in the sight of the many nations.

dag: N daa ti o dahima ni o niŋ tuuba o zina niŋbu maa zuɣu, amaa ka o zaɣisi tuuba maa niŋbu.
en: I have given her time to change her heart and turn away from her sin, but she does not want to change.

dag: Tuun kpɛma tumbu tiri nir yiko, amaa vinnyaɣili chɛ ka nir leerila dabili.
en: A hard worker is in charge, while a lazy one will be sentenced to hard labor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Asha zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Asher, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni a dol ti chaŋ. Dama tinim yi ŋmaligi guui bɛ baɣa ku be ti ni, ka ti pirigili yi kpi, bɛ baɣa ku be ti ni, a kɔŋko saɣi ti niriba tuhi pia, dinzuɣu di simdi ka a kpalim yiŋ ŋɔ, ka lee tir ti sɔŋsim na.
en: But the soldiers said, No, don't go into battle with us! It won't matter to our enemies if they make us all run away, or even if they kill half of us. But you are worth , of us. It would be better for you to stay in town and send help if we need it.

dag: Ijipti naa Firawuna daa pun chaŋ ti tuhi deela Gɛza ka ku Keenannim bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka nyo li buɣim; ka zaŋ li ti o bipuɣin so Sulemaana ni daa kpuɣila ka di leeg o daamiliya lɔbu pini;.
en: Earlier, the king of Egypt had captured the town of Gezer; he burned it to the ground and killed the Canaanite people living there. Then he gave it to his daughter as a wedding present when she married Solomon.

dag: Kaɣili ni tooi zooi luɣ shɛli ka pa ni baa ni? Kaɣili ni tooi zooi viɛnyɛliŋga ka pa ni kom ni be luɣ shɛli?.
en: Reeds can't grow where there is no water; they are never found outside a swamp.

dag: A ni zaŋ o bidibisi maa gba na ti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba.
en: Bring his sons and put the shirts on them.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa din daa be bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-nyɛ: Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol ni Irishɛmɛsh.
en: Its area included Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya Masidɔnia do so ʒii yuŋ ka o ʒiɛya m-balindi ŋun Pool yɛra, Kam Masidɔnia na ti sɔŋ ti.
en: That night Paul had a vision in which he saw a Macedonian standing and begging him, Come over to Macedonia and help us.

dag: Ka dindali maa ni daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yisa sɔɣi di ni, dama siliga maa shee daa bi wɔɣ ni nimaani.
en: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir maa daa wum Izraɛl naa ni darigi toog o binyɛrigu shɛm maa yɛla, ka tim ti bɔhi naa maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a darigi toog a binyɛrigu? Chɛ ka doo maa ka n sanna nti baŋ ni anabi be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: When Elisha the man of God heard that Israels king had ripped his clothes, he sent word to the king: Why did you rip your clothes? Let the man come to me. Then hell know that theres a prophet in Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ŋmanila ŋahili shɛli din wuhi: Bindoo bi waɣa ka nir ni tooi teeg omaŋ dɔni di zuɣu, ka chinchini gba bi yɛlima, ka nir ni tooi zaŋ li pil omaŋa.
en: Your bed is too short, your blanket too skimpy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya paya. Bɛnjamin niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Gidiɔni bia Abidan.
en: The tribe of Benjamin will also camp next to Ephraims family. The leader of the tribe of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti lan labina nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N daa timna ti yɛl a ni a zaŋ a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣiba ni a bihi ti ma na.
en: Then the messengers came back to Ahab. They said, Ben-Hadad says, I told you before that all of your silver and gold and your wives and children belong to me. So give them to me!.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililan nyɛla ŋun tahiri zabili na, ka suhuyiɣisili pam tahiri biriginsim pam na.
en: An angry person causes arguments, and someone who is quick-tempered is guilty of many sins.

dag: Ka o lan zaŋ ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni kul ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli na ti mali sara.
en: The person will then offer one of the turtledoves or pigeons, whatever they can afford.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga? Bɛ yɛn jɛmdila nanima ka pa ni tarimba.
en: Skilled workers will always serve kings. They will never have to work for less important people.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi ma polo, n ni sabi Ijiptinim mini Babilɔnnim yuya, ka sabi Filistianim gba mini Taainim ni Itiɔpianim yuya ka yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim gba leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: I will include Egypt and Babylonia when I list the nations that obey me; the people of Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia I will number among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

dag: Faralan bi tuuli ni di, ka nandan dɔni ni alaafee, amaa n ni chɛ ka kum ku yi bihi, ka ku yi puuni bɛn kpalim.
en: The oldest offspring of the poor will graze; their needy will lie down secure. But he will starve your offspring to death, and murder all who remain.

dag: Gallimnima, tahimiya! Laishanima, Wummiya! Anatɔtnima, garigimiya!.
en: Cry aloud, Daughter Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Answer her, Anathoth!.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Ikabɔd biɛli Ahitub bia la daa mali tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la lɔr o shee ni. Ahitub daa nyɛla Finɛhas bia ka nyɛ Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ maligumaana Shilo la yaaŋa. Ka niriba maa so daa bi baŋ ni Jɔnatan chaŋya.
en: The men did not know that Jonathan had left.

dag: N suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu; ka yihi ma n dabeenzɔbo zaa ni.
en: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani; dinzuɣu ka n chɛ o niŋ sarika ni hal ni saha shɛli n ni ni ti tooi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Siiza sani.
en: But Paul asked to be kept in Caesarea. He wants a decision from the emperor. So I ordered that he be held until I could send him to Caesar in Rome.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yiriŋyiriŋ, dama Yawɛ ku chɛ ŋunkam boon o yuli yiriŋyiriŋ taali.
en: Do not use the LORD your Gods name as if it were of no significance; the LORD wont forgive anyone who uses his name that way.

dag: Ti tiligimi kaman nooŋa n-tiligi tɔha tɔŋ gbaabu ni la. Tɔha tɔŋ kabiya ka ti tiligi.
en: We escaped like a bird from the net of a hunter. The net broke, and we escaped!.

dag: Ka salo bɛn be o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: Some people walked ahead of Jesus and others followed behind. They were all shouting, Hooray for the Son of David! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord. Hooray for God in heaven above.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa ti paai yuun pihitayinika saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Tɛra.
en: When Nahor was years old, he became the father of Terah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ ti teei gili Samaria.
en: Now it happened later that Arams King Ben-hadad gathered all his forces and went up to attack Samaria.

dag: Ka o daa lan tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti nya Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni liɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: Jesus walked on and soon saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat, mending their nets.

dag: ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la, amaa di yi ti zooi, di galisirimi gari tutuɣ kam m-mal ti leei tia, hal ka noonsi kanna nti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: It is the smallest of all seeds, but when it grows up, it is the biggest of all plants. It becomes a tree, so that birds come and make their nests in its branches.

dag: Dama Naawuni jɛrilim nyɛla yɛm gari ninsalinim yɛm, ka Naawuni chɔɣinsi mi nyɛ kpiɔŋ gari ninsalinim kpiɔŋ.
en: This is because the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

dag: Ka salo daa baŋ ka kar o naba; ka o daa ti puhi ba ni bɛ paabuna, ka tɔɣisi ba Naawuni nam yɛla, ka tib barinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: But a lot of people found out about this and followed him. Jesus welcomed them. He spoke about God's kingdom and healed everyone who was sick.

dag: Ka zuliya pam ti tim ya ŋɔ tiŋ puuni garita ka bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ ti darigi tin titali ŋɔ nim tibili lala? .
en: People from different nations will pass by and ask, Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija saha sanzali ni daa zani yuma ata ni chira ayɔbu ka kum lu luɣilikam, ka pakoya daa yam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel.

dag: Galimi yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi n nol ni na? N ku tooi baŋla nia biɛɣu ni nyɛ shɛli?.
en: I am not lying. I know right from wrong.

dag: Amaa ti mabihi, yinim bi be zibisim ni ka dindali maa ni ti libigi ya kaman tayiɣa ni libigiri niriba shɛm la.
en: But you, brothers and sisters, are not living in darkness. And so that day will not surprise you like a thief.
