dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima dooi naɣibil kɔtomsi zali, ka kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mal li; ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi pam bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: Thats when they made an idol in the shape of a calf, offered a sacrifice to it, and began to celebrate what they had made with their own hands.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yo Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ dunoya, ka kpihi di puuni firilanima, ka daa bi lan tuɣindi tulaale zim bee m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la luɣ kasi shee la tiri Izraɛlnim Naawuni.
en: They closed the doors of the Temple, let the lamps go out, and failed to burn incense or offer burnt offerings in the Temple of the God of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo ni a me jɛmbu duu ti n yuli jilima maa, di viɛla.
en: the Lord said, It's good that you want to build a temple where I can be worshiped.

dag: Naawuni yi be ti sani, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-yɛn du n-tam ti dimnim zuɣu.
en: Only God can make us strong. Only God can defeat our enemies!.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: These are the Judahite clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa yɔri farigu Naa Uzia sani, ka o yuli daa du hal ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ nim ti wum o yɛla, dama o daa niŋ yaa pam.
en: The Ammonites paid tribute to Uzziah, and he became so powerful that his fame spread even to Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi tiŋgbani maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka noli din yɛla zaa sab be kundi ŋɔ ni di li maa.
en: And so the Lord became angry with his people and brought on their land all the disasters written in this book.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi jintɔriba maa sani n-yi ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni ni kali ba pahi bɛn simdi ni bɛ di vi Yisa yuli zuɣu kalinli ni maa zuɣu.
en: The apostles left the council rejoicing because they had been regarded as worthy to suffer disgrace for the sake of the name.

dag: Shɛb daa zaŋla ŋariŋ kara n-kpe teeku puuni nti tumdi daabiligu tuma ko titali maa ni.
en: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea.

dag: Di tiriya nimmira yɛlimaŋli, amaa doliyala yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.

dag: Amaa Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, di zaa yoli, a nini na kul bi tiɣi li, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, a lan yɛli man a dabili ŋɔ n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha yɛla, ka wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: Yet now you are doing even more, Sovereign Lord ; you have made promises about my descendants in the years to come. And you let a man see this, Sovereign Lord !.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu bahi Pɛlusium din nyɛ Ijiptinim tɔbu tuhibu yaa shee la zuɣu, ka saɣim Tɛbisinim daazichi.
en: I will let the city of Pelusium, Egypt's great fortress, feel my fury. I will destroy the wealth of Thebes.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o kɔrigi nahu maa, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ binʒim maa ti ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ li mihi gili Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.

dag: N yi di daa bi tum daadam ni na ʒi n-tum tuun shɛli bɛ sani, bɛ naan ku mali taali; amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nya n ni tum shɛlikam maa, ka yaɣ di zuɣu zaɣisi m mini m Ba zaa.
en: If I hadnt done works among them that no one else had done, they wouldnt be sinners. But now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: The man replied, Ever since I was young, I have obeyed all these commandments.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba ni ti nya tibidarigibo, ka jɛra mi yaansi zuɣu ti nya fiɛbiga.
en: A conceited fool is sure to get a beating.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dahin shɛli n yi ti lan kpihim yi daalahichi, n ni ti lan chɛ ka niriba be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: The LORD God proclaims: On the day that I cleanse you of all your guilt, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya, di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus put his hand on him and said, I want to! Now you are well. At once the man's leprosy disappeared.

dag: M-pahi Bɛɔr bia Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ baɣa, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔb ku o pahi bɛ ni daa pun ku shɛb zuɣu la.
en: The Israelites defeated Balaam son of Beor. The Israelites killed many people during the fighting.

dag: amaa ka di bi ba jila o suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala nira niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paag o Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, o dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: But they do not let the teaching go deep into their lives. They keep it only a short time. As soon as trouble or persecution comes because of the teaching they accepted, they give up.

dag: Yi bi lan yuuni n sara din be kasi la zuɣu. Amaa yi bola tinzunnima n-chɛ ka bɛ zani yi zaani n-yuuni di zuɣu n jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: You didnt keep charge of my holy things. On the contrary, you appointed them to keep charge in my sanctuary for you.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun zali ni Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni ni lu. O daa buɣisi li mi. O daa bi chɛ li wurimbu. O chɛ ka pihi mini goma fabili; di zaa bahila yoli.
en: The Lord planned to destroy the wall of Daughter Zion. He marked the wall with a measuring line. He didnt stop himself from destroying it. He made all the walls cry out in sadness. Together they wasted away.

dag: N ni niŋ jila niŋ ya, ka niŋ niŋgbuna niŋ ya, ka zaŋ gbaŋ pɔbi ya, ka niŋ vuhim niŋ ya ka yi niŋ nyɛvili; ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will give you sinews and muscles, and cover you with skin. I will put breath into you and bring you back to life. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kul be Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim maa ni.
en: The Israelites lived with the Canaanites, Hittites, the Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

dag: Masia zuɣu n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri. Ka n suhu ni tɛha diri ma shɛhira Naawuni Shia Kasi sani.
en: I am speaking the truth; I belong to Christ and I do not lie. My conscience, ruled by the Holy Spirit, also assures me that I am not lying.

dag: Mushi daa dɔɣi la bidibisi ata, Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt.
en: Mushis family: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three in all.

dag: Di saha ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A ni nyɛ n dɔɣira maa zuɣu, a yɛn tumla tuma ti ma yoli? Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n yo a shɛm.
en: One day Laban said to Jacob, You are a relative of mine. It is not right for you to continue working for me without pay. What should I pay you.

dag: Dama tɔbbihi bɛn kana namdanim zaa mini bɛ binyɛra din ŋam ʒim zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: Because every boot of the thundering warriors, and every garment rolled in blood will be burned, fuel for the fire.

dag: N yi nya jilima Firawuna min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ŋɔ zuɣu, di saha ka Ijiptinim maa ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD, when I gain honor at the expense of Pharaoh, his chariots, and his cavalry.

dag: Daadam yi kpi o ni lan tooi be? Amaa n kul ni guhi n ni tumdi tuma dabisi shɛŋa ŋɔ ni zaa hal ti nya faako.
en: If people die, will they live again? All the days of my service I would wait until my restoration took place.

dag: Wɔr ʒiɛhi n-daa vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din daŋ tooni, ka wɔr sabila vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi.
en: The first chariot had red horses, and the second chariot had black horses.

dag: zaŋ tabili bɛn tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba ni bɛn zaŋdi muɣisigu gbahiri niriba ni ʒiŋmariba ni bɛn zaa niŋdi din chihiri wuhibu maŋa la zuɣu.
en: It is for those who commit sexual sins, homosexuals, those who sell slaves, those who tell lies, those who dont tell the truth under oath, and those who are against the true teaching of God.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N tum alahichi; dama m birigi Yawɛ zaligu, ka lan zaɣis a noli. N daa zɔrila niriba maa dabiɛm ka saɣi bɛ noli.
en: I have sinned, Saul admitted. I disobeyed both you and the Lord . I was afraid of the army, and I listened to them instead.

dag: Dama yi suhuri yi ye di niŋbu zuɣu, Naawuni ni dee li kaman yi ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga zuɣu ka mi ku galim ya yi ni ka shɛli zuɣu.
en: If you are eager to give, God will accept your gift on the basis of what you have to give, not on what you don't have.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Miriya ka yi ʒiɛm bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba, dama n yɛri ya mi ni bɛ malaikanim kul chola m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ninni. .
en: Be careful. Dont think these little children are not important. I tell you that these children have angels in heaven. And those angels are always with my Father in heaven.

dag: N yi siɣisi mmaŋa n-lo noli, bɛ turi ma la n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: I humble myself by fasting, and people insult me;.

dag: nti yɛl o, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kali ti ni su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi n-nya ka ti zaa beni.
en: They told Moses, We, your servants, have counted our soldiers. We have not missed any of them.

dag: Ka Harumaf bia Jɛdaya daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hashabinɛya bia Hatush mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired the next section of the wall. Jedaiah repaired the wall next to his own house. Hattush son of Hashabneiah repaired the next section.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: Consider the experience of Abraham; as the scripture says, He believed God, and because of his faith God accepted him as righteous.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni tooi lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Aŋgo ni na be bɛ sani maa, bɛ ku tooi lo noli.
en: Jesus answered, Do you expect the guests at a wedding party to go without food? Of course not! As long as the bridegroom is with them, they will not do that.

dag: Yɛndana tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, jɛra bɛn tɛha puuni pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.

dag: Ka saɣiŋgu kul be di puuni, ka nahiŋgu mini ŋarili kul be di ni.
en: There is so much crime in the streets. People who hurt and cheat others are everywhere.

dag: Teemi ni n nyɛvili nyɛla vuhim kɔŋko, n nini ku lan nya din viɛla.
en: Remember, O God, my life is only a breath; my happiness has already ended.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ piɛla yino n-chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Choose one of the rams, and have Aaron and his sons lay their hands on the rams head.

dag: Filistia doo maa ni daa yiɣisi vu m-miri Dauda ni o ti tuh o saha shɛli, ka Dauda gba daa dii guui yi tɔb gɔɣu maa ni ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: When Goliath started forward, David ran toward him.

dag: Ka a baŋsim maa zuɣu ni chɛ ka Masia ni daa kpi a mabi so ŋun ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: So this weak brother or sister—someone Christ died for—is lost because of your better understanding.

dag: Ka yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala.
en: Treat people in the same way that you want them to treat you.

dag: Kum yi mali tayiɣisi ka bɛ zu bindirigu di, niriba ku lihi ʒiɛm ba di zuɣu.
en: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛl o, Zaŋm a bigaŋ Yisahaku so a ni yuri pam la n-chaŋ Mɔria tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la nimaani n ni ti yɛn wuh a zo shɛli zuɣu.
en: God said, Take your son, your only son whom you love, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him up as an entirely burned offering there on one of the mountains that I will show you.

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa zaŋ Babilɔnnim mini Kutanim ni Avanim ni Hamatinim ni Sɛfarivaimnim na nti ʒili Samaria fɔntinsi ni ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Ka niriba maa daa deei Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ m-be di fɔntinsi ni.
en: The king of Assyria took the Israelites out of Samaria and brought in other people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim. They took over Samaria and lived in the cities around it.

dag: N nina kul zɔrila nintam kaman kulibɔŋ kom la, bɛ ni bahi n niriba yoli zaa maa zuɣu.
en: My eyes flow with rivers of tears at the destruction of my people.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa tuhi deei Jɛrusalɛm, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di niriba, ka nyo li buɣim bahi.
en: The men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They used their swords to kill the people of Jerusalem. Then they burned the city.

dag: ka labina ti yɛli Jɔshua, Ainim bi yaɣ lala. Lala zuɣu di chɛ ka tɔbbihi maa zaa chaŋ, amaa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaayi bee tusaata laasabu chaŋ.
en: Later, the men came back to Joshua. They said, Ai is a weak area. We will not need all of our people to defeat them. Send or men to fight there. There is no need to use the whole army. There are only a few men there to fight against us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ n dimnima ka daliri shɛli kani la, daa yimi teei bɔri ma kaman n nyɛla noombil la.
en: For no reason, my enemies hunted me like a bird.

dag: Bɛ daa ti tahi alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi zoom bir so zuɣu Yisa sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ zaa, ka o nina maa gba neei, hal ka o lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira.
en: They brought to Jesus a demon-possessed man who was blind and unable to speak. Jesus healed him so that he could both speak and see.

dag: M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini. .
en: He said, Father, if its your will, take this cup of suffering away from me. However, not my will but your will must be done.

dag: Yi yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, yin malimiya li ka di nyɛ din ni chɛ ka o deei yi sara maa.
en: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool, Yawɛ n-daa tim ma na ka n ti booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leeg o niriba naa; dinzuɣu wummi ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: One day Samuel said to Saul, The Lord sent me to anoint you king over his people Israel. Now listen to his message.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔhi zom maa yaha, O ni neeg a nina maa, a lee tɛhiya ni o nyɛla ŋuni? Ka o yɛli ba, O nyɛla anabi.
en: Some of the Pharisees questioned the man who had been born blind again: What do you have to say about him, since he healed your eyes? He replied, Hes a prophet.

dag: Ti wahala dibu din pɔri ka ku yuui ŋɔ nyɛla din niŋdi shili ni di tahi ti jilima din ka kpee na, ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Our temporary minor problems are producing an eternal stockpile of glory for us that is beyond all comparison.

dag: Yisa ni daa deei baptaizibu naai ka puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, di saha ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi, ka o nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.

dag: Bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni yihi bɛ paɣiba maa, ka daa zaŋ piɛlaa m-mali sara bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: All of them promised to divorce their wives. And then each one of them offered a ram from the flock for a guilt offering. They did that because of their guilt.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa, ka n zaŋ o niŋ m-paɣa? Dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a paɣa! Zaŋm o chaŋ.
en: Why did you say that she was your sister, and let me take her as my wife? Here is your wife; take her and get out.

dag: Dama bɛ kumdila pampam duri Luhit zoli, ka wum biɛrim mini nandahima kuhigu Hɔrɔnaim zolɔŋni.
en: Moabs people go up the path to Luhith. They are crying bitterly as they go. On the road down to the town of Horonaim, cries of pain and suffering can be heard.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai zuɣulan maa yiŋa n-nya ka yupiɛbiriba mini salo pam beni n-yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri.
en: When Jesus went into the rulers house, he saw the flute players and the distressed crowd.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ ŋun taɣi Gihɔn zuɣusaa polo kulibɔŋ la kom zali ka ŋmaligi li ka di zɔri chani Dauda tiŋ la wulinluhili polo. Hɛzɛkia daa di nasara o tuuni kam puuni.
en: It was King Hezekiah who blocked the outlet for Gihon Spring and channeled the water to flow through a tunnel to a point inside the walls of Jerusalem. Hezekiah succeeded in everything he did.

dag: Turi tubu zuɣu ka bɛn bi wumdi yɛlimaŋli zabira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm nyɛla bɛn deeri saɣisigu.
en: The empty-headed cause conflict out of pride; those who take advice are wise.

dag: Ka ti Duuma garigi yɛli, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlan zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?.

dag: Dama Ɛhab daŋ niriba zaa ni kpi. N ni ku Ɛhab daŋ ni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: So all Ahabs family will die. I will not let any male child in Ahabs family live. It doesnt matter if that male child is a slave or a free person in Israel.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla shihirili ni alahiziba yɛlli yi mini yi zuliya sani sahakam.
en: These things will be a sign and a wonder on you and your descendants forever.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi ne ka niŋ ma yɛda ku lan kpi hal abada. Ka bɔhi Maata, A niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yɛda.
en: Everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.

dag: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ n-yihi ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali yi sunsuuni. Dama di simdi ni yi niŋ din tuhi Yawɛ sani.
en: But you must remove innocent bloodshed from your community; do only what is right in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na bi di bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa tiɣi; bindirigu maa ni daa na kul be bɛ noya ni saha shɛli maa.
en: But before they had swallowed the last bite.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Gidiɔni bia Abidan sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan, Gideonis son.

dag: Kum daa ti lan lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di daa nyɛla kum din pahi din daa pun lu Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la zuɣu. Ka Yisahaku daa chaŋ Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk sani Gɛra.
en: When a famine gripped the land, a different one from the first famine that occurred in Abrahams time, Isaac set out toward Gerar and toward King Abimelech of the Philistines.

dag: Ka so ni daa kani simdi ni o bɔɣi litaafi maa n-lihi di puuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka n kum pam.
en: I cried bitterly because no one could be found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.

dag: Di saha maa ka gadama daa piligi Ɛfɛsus Yisa soli dolibu zuɣu.
en: It was at this time that there was serious trouble in Ephesus because of the Way of the Lord.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Bilichin tital so n-daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha nti di nam labina;.
en: He said, A certain man who was born into royalty went to a distant land to receive his kingdom and then return.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda!.
en: Jesus answered, Have faith in God.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi gbahi ba, bɛ ni yo bɛ ni zu shɛli maa zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka bɛ fa bɛ yinsi nɛma zaa.
en: yet if he is caught, he must pay back seven times more—he must give up everything he has.

dag: Ka Sool daa tɛh o suhu ni, N ni zaŋ o ti Dauda ka o leei tɔŋ gbaag o, ka Filistianim ku o. Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa lan yɛli Dauda pahi buyi, Pumpɔŋɔ a yi pa ni leei n deemba.
en: He thought, I will use Michal to trap David. I will let Michal marry David, and then I will let the Philistines kill him. So Saul said to David a second time, You can marry my daughter today.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka zuliya shɛli niriba yi katiŋa dunia ŋɔ tariga n-kabina ti lu yi zuɣu kaman tɔrili la, bɛ ni ti nyɛla yi ni bi wumdi zuliya shɛb yɛtɔɣa.
en: The LORD will bring a distant nation—one from the far ends of the earth—against you as fast as the eagle flies: a nation that speaks a language you cant understand.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya yɛm mini yɛla baŋbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Happy is anyone who becomes wise—who comes to have understanding.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa chuɣu, dama dindali maa ka n daa yihi yi zuliya maa gbilligbilli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi gbibi dabisili maa yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam.
en: You must remember the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because on this day I took all of your people out of Egypt in groups. All of your descendants must remember this day. This is a law that will last forever.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi, Daŋ shɛli beni ka di niriba bi ka Mizipa na Yawɛ sani laɣiŋgu ŋɔ ni? Dama bɛ daa pun pola pɔri yɛli ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ka Mizipa na Yawɛ sani laɣiŋgu maa ni, bɛn kum o.
en: Then the Israelites asked, Were there any out of all the tribes of Israel who didnt march up to the assembly before the LORD? Indeed, they had made a solemn pledge that anyone who didnt march up before the LORD at Mizpah would be put to death.

dag: Lihimiya nya bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa nyɛla din viɛl bee din bie, ka nya bɛ ni be fɔntin shɛŋa ni lee nyɛla tin yari bee di nyɛla bɛ ni me goma gili shɛŋa.
en: Is the land in which they live good or bad? Are the towns in which they live camps or fortresses?.

dag: Amaa n nahindila n niŋgbuŋ ni n nyaŋ li su, dama di yi pa lala, n ni yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti niriba ŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naawuni ni ti daai ma baɣili kpaŋa.
en: Rather, Im landing punches on my own body and subduing it like a slave. I do this to be sure that I myself wont be disqualified after preaching to others.

dag: Ka Hushai daa garigi yɛli Absalom, Aai Yawɛ min o niriba ŋɔ ni Izraɛlnim ni pii ninvuɣ so, o sani ka n yɛn be ka o su ma.
en: Hushai answered, How could I? I am for the one chosen by the Lord , by these people, and by all the Israelites. I will stay with you.

dag: Nyin Farisii ŋun nyɛ zom ŋɔ, daŋm paɣila pipia mini laa puuni, ka naanyi chɛ ka di nyaaŋa gba neei.
en: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup so that the outside of the cup will be clean too.

dag: N ni ti lo a alikauli ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will renew my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Nyama, m piila Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la pah o zuɣu, ka lan ti tuumbaŋdiba zaa yiko ni bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa n ni zal a ni a mali, dina n-nyɛ:.
en: I have also chosen Oholiab to work with him. Oholiab is the son of Ahisamach from the tribe of Dan. And I have given skills to all the other workers so that they can make everything that I have commanded you:.

dag: Mɔab Naa Mɛsha daa wumsirila piɛri, ka di daa kpala talahi ni o tahiri piɛbihi polo tuhi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi tuhi kɔbiga kɔbiri yuuni kam nti tiri Izraɛl naa.
en: Now Moabs King Mesha kept sheep. He would pay Israels king one hundred thousand lambs and the wool from one hundred thousand rams.

dag: Ka so daa ti bɔh o, N Duuma, niriba biɛla kɔŋko n-yɛn tiligi? Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Someone asked him, Lord, are only a few people going to be saved? Jesus answered:.

dag: Bɛ daa bi baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba yɛla ka o tɔɣisiri ba maa.
en: They did not understand that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia ba Naawuni ŋun kul simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ mi ni m bi ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, the one who is blessed forever, knows that Im not lying.

dag: Bɛna n-daa su Alikauli Adaka la mini teebuli ni firilatamdigu ni sara maligu bimbina ni la shɛŋa maligumaaniba ni daa zaŋdi tumdi tuma la zaŋ tabili Pateesa la ni di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: They were responsible for the chest, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the equipment of the sanctuary with which they would minister, and the screen—all these furnishings.

dag: O yidan niŋ o naani o suhu ni, ka shɛli ku poog o yidana maa.
en: Her husband puts his confidence in her, and he will never be poor.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir ŋun yi Zɛrɛda na, ka nyɛ Sulemaana kpambala, ka o ma nyɛ pako so ŋun yuli daa booni Zɛrua la gba daa leei naa dima.
en: Jeroboam was from the town of Zeredah in Ephraim. His father Nebat had died, but his mother Zeruah was still alive. Jeroboam was one of Solomon's officials, but even he rebelled against Solomon.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti piɛbi kika titali, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yirigi be Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini bɛ ni daa kari shɛb kulisi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kana ti jɛm Yawɛ Jɛrusalɛm zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: When that day comes, a trumpet will be blown to call back from Assyria and Egypt all the Israelites who are in exile there. They will come and worship the Lord in Jerusalem, on his sacred hill.

dag: Nira yi wum alizanda nam yɛla ka bi baŋ di gbinni, Sintani kanimina nti to n-yihi din biri o suhu ni la. Dina n-nyɛ bimbir shɛŋa din lu sol zuɣu maa.
en: Those who hear the message about the Kingdom but do not understand it are like the seeds that fell along the path. The Evil One comes and snatches away what was sown in them.

dag: Teem o yɛla pɔi ka anzinfa mia la naanyi yihi, ka salima laa la ŋma; ka koyul la ŋma kɔbiliga ni bee ka kalinli la kabi kɔbiliga ni.
en: before the silver cord snaps and the gold bowl shatters; the jar is broken at the spring and the wheel is crushed at the pit.

dag: Dama Sulemaana ŋarima daa yi zaŋdila Hiram tumtumdiba n-chani Tarishish. Ŋarima maa daa yi yiri Tarishish labirina yim yuma ata puuni bɛ ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: He had a fleet of ocean-going ships sailing with King Hiram's fleet. Every three years his fleet would return, bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and monkeys.

dag: Yi jɛmdila yi ni ʒi so, amaa tinim jɛmdila ti ni mi so, dama Yɛhudianim zuliya ni ka tiliginsim yina;.
en: You and your people worship what you dont know; we worship what we know because salvation is from the Jews.

dag: Nyin paɣa, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a yidana? Ka nyin doo mi, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a paɣa?.
en: How can you be sure, Christian wife, that you will not save your husband? Or how can you be sure, Christian husband, that you will not save your wife?.

dag: Yi zuɣuri ni zaŋ ti siɣi yi naba ni zaa ka alaafee. Amaa dansi mini yuma din kabiri ʒim m-beni; di bi paɣi bee m-pɔbi, kpam mi bi niŋ bɔbili li ka di maha.
en: From head to foot there is not a healthy spot on your body. You are covered with bruises and sores and open wounds. Your wounds have not been cleaned or bandaged. No medicine has been put on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ zuɣu sahakam, ka suhimiya Naawuni din ni chɛ ka yi nya kpiɔŋ nti tiligi din ti yɛn niŋ maa ni, ka ti zani Daadam Bia tooni.
en: So be ready all the time. Pray that you will be able to get through all these things that will happen and stand safe before the Son of Man.

dag: Chɛ ka n dimnim be kaman ninvuɣ biɛri la, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ma be kaman bɛn pa wuntizɔriba la.
en: Let my enemy be like the wicked, my opposition like the vicious.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Then Jonathan said, Come, lets go out into the field. So Jonathan and David went together into the field.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaligu kundi la n-gili Juda fɔntinsi ni zaa wuhi niriba.
en: These leaders, Levites, and priests taught the people in Judah. They had the Book of the Law of the Lord with them. They went through all the towns of Judah and taught the people.

dag: n-kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya, ka zaŋ ya na ti zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya, ka yi su li kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.

dag: Chɛ ka so m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin yaag a noli paɣ amaŋa; chɛ ka sana m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin paɣ amaŋa.
en: Let other people praise you—even strangers; never do it yourself.

dag: Di chɛliya ka zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma zaa be yi ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpɛri binyara ni, dama di bi simdi ni dimbɔŋɔnim be Yisa nyaandoliba biɛhigu ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Sexual immorality, and any kind of impurity or greed, shouldnt even be mentioned among you, which is right for holy persons.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: So the word of the Lord came to me again. He said.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan yɛli Jɔnatan, Ka a ba suhu yi ti yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɛli ma.
en: David then asked, Who will let me know if your father answers you angrily.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ ti Naawuni ni ti Tiligira ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu mini nam jilima ni yiko ni fukumsi subu, dunia ŋɔ ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la mini pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: to the only God our savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, belong glory, majesty, power, and authority, before all time, now and forever. Amen.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda ka o yuli booni Ziba la daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa bol o ti Naa Dauda ka o ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Ziba? Ka o garigi yɛli, Naa, mani.
en: David called in Ziba, one of the servants of Saul's family. David said, So you are Ziba. Yes, Your Majesty, I am.

dag: Ka n ŋubirila naɣilahi nimdi bee n nyurila buhi ʒim?.
en: I dont eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.

dag: Yi jɛmdila yi ni ʒi so, amaa tinim jɛmdila ti ni mi so, dama Yɛhudianim zuliya ni ka tiliginsim yina;.
en: You Samaritans do not really know whom you worship; but we Jews know whom we worship, because it is from the Jews that salvation comes.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya, ŋuna n-nyɛ yi naa, ka m mi kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi zaa, ka m bidibisi be yi sani. N nachimbilim ni mi ka n kul be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The king will lead you now. I am old and gray, though my sons are still with you, and Ive been your leader since I was young until now.

dag: Sara maligu bimbini maa ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣumɔɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu.
en: The top of the altar was a square, feet on each side.

dag: Wuhimiya ma yi paɣ bɔbo puhigu liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yi yi ni saɣi ka n kpuɣ o, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni n tin ya shɛm zaa.
en: I will give you any gift you want if you will only allow me to marry Dinah. I will give you anything you ask, but let me marry her.

dag: Bɛ lan labimi ti tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bɛ yaannim bɛn daa zaɣisi n nol la ni daa tumdi kurimbuni ha la. Bɛ jɛmdila wuna. Izraɛlnim mini Judanim saɣim n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli maa.
en: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors who refused to obey my words. They too are following other gods and serving them. The people of Israel and the people of Judah have broken my covenant that I made with their ancestors.

dag: Ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nina mini sagbana ni kɔsoya daa ŋari; ka saa chɛ mibu.
en: Rain stopped falling from the sky, and water stopped flowing from under the earth.

dag: Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi. Ka o daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-daa ku bɛ zaa, ka gba daa zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Joabs brother, Abishai, was the leader of the Three Heroes. Abishai used his spear against enemies and killed them. He was as famous as the Three Heroes.

dag: Ka naa kpamba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, tinim bɛn nyɛ a kpamba ŋɔ mali shili ni ti niŋ nyini n dan naa ni lo shɛli.
en: The kings servants said to him, Your servants are ready to do whatever our master the king decides.

dag: Firilanim pam daa be jirambisa du shɛl ni ti ni daa laɣim maa.
en: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we had gathered.

dag: dama bɛ daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin n-zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ daba ayopɔin mi m-puhi chuɣu, ka daa laɣim dabisi shɛli din pah anii dali jɛm Naawuni.
en: They had spent seven days for the dedication of the altar and then seven more days for the festival. On the last day they had a closing celebration.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Asha zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Asher was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi m-bo chi pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti pa sara maligu tampiŋ bimbini zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma ŋɔ.
en: So Manoah took a young goat over to a large rock he had chosen for an altar, and he built a fire on the rock. Then he killed the goat, and offered it with some grain as a sacrifice to the Lord . But then an amazing thing happened.

dag: ni a ku niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu kaman ti gba ni daa bi shih a bee n-niŋ a shɛli, amaa ka naɣ niŋ a la zaɣ viɛlli hal ti chɛ ka a yi n-chaŋ ni alaafee la. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: that you will not harm us, just as we did not harm you. We were kind to you and let you go peacefully. Now it is clear that the Lord has blessed you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan chɛ ka bɛ pii kuɣ pinaayi n-sɔŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni luɣ shɛli maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒiɛya la. Ka kuɣa maa na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin daa mali ti gari, Yawɛ ni daa fiɛbi Nail Mɔɣili maa nyaaŋa.
en: Seven days went by after the LORD had struck the Nile River.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sara maligu bimbini zaligunim m-bɔŋɔ: dahin shɛli di yi ti naai, ka yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu, ka zaŋ ʒim vie li.
en: Then the man said to me, Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: These are the rules for the altar: At the time you build the altar, use these rules to offer burnt offerings and to sprinkle blood on it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum ka o tahi pam yɛli, Yinim bɛn yɛn darigi tiŋ ŋɔ tibili, vumiya mirina. Sokam zaŋm o bidibbini gbib o nuu ni.
en: Then I heard God shout, Come here, you men who are going to punish the city. Bring your weapons with you.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia ni sabi gban shɛli Jɛrusalɛm n-ti kpamba bɛn daa kpalim mini maligumaaniba ni anabinim ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la puuni yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders of the people, and to all the others whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken away as prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylonia.

dag: A yi kpahi ansarisimaana zuɣu ni, o ni leei ŋun je a. A yi kpahi ŋun mali yɛm zuɣu ni, o ni yur a.
en: Dont correct such people, or they will hate you. But correct those who are wise, and they will love you.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell this to anyone.

dag: Miri ka a niŋ a kpee fitiina bee n-fa o. A yi bu so paa ka o tum a tuma, nyin di chɛ ka o liɣiri gbe a sani.
en: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.

dag: Dama bɛ ku tooi gbihi ka pa ni bɛ tumla din bi tuhi; bɛ yi bi chɛ ka so tuui, di niŋdi ba la gɔgaliga.
en: Wicked people cannot sleep unless they have done something wrong. They lie awake unless they have hurt someone.

dag: Lala ka di daa niŋ ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata m-mali hal ti paai ŋun pah ayopɔin maa.
en: Then the second brother also died. The same thing happened to the third brother and all the other brothers.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni Masia daa leei Yɛhudianim dapala ni o wuhi ni Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni chɛ ka o ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali.
en: Im saying that Christ became a servant of those who are circumcised for the sake of Gods truth, in order to confirm the promises given to the ancestors.

dag: Ka o ʒim maa yi na yir o, ka o dɔni bindo shɛlikam zuɣu, di ni bemi kaman o ni yi pun nyari sɔrilim ka dooni bindo shɛli zuɣu ka di nyɛ shɛm la. Ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim la.
en: Any bed on which she lies and anything on which she sits during this time is unclean.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yiri muɣisigu ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn lee kpɛri di ni.
en: The righteous are saved from distress, and the wicked take their place.

dag: Niŋm ania zaŋ amaŋ wuhi ni a nyɛla tumtumdi so Naawuni ni di shɛhira, ka a ku di vi a tuma ni, ka ni nyɛla ŋun wuhiri Naawuni yɛligu yɛlimaŋtali dɛde.
en: Make an effort to present yourself to God as a tried-and-true worker, who doesnt need to be ashamed but is one who interprets the message of truth correctly.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka lan nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ piligu, mani n-lan nyɛ bahigu. Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: The Lord , who rules and protects Israel, the Lord Almighty, has this to say: I am the first, the last, the only God; there is no other god but me.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa viɛla, amaa di mi ku sɔŋ ya.
en: You think that what you do is right, but I will expose your conduct, and your idols will not be able to help you.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na. O yɛri bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!.

dag: Yɛlimiya Naawuni, A tuma mali dabiɛm pam. A yiko ni galisi zuɣu chɛ ka a dimnim gbaanila a tooni.
en: Tell God, Your works are wonderful! Your great power makes your enemies bow down in fear before you.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun darigiri zuliya kam tibili. Ŋuna ŋun zaŋdi baŋsim wuhiri daadamnima ŋɔ pala ŋun darigiri niriba tibili?.
en: The one who disciplines nations will surely correct you. He is the one who teaches us everything.

dag: O ni dih o piɛri kaman piɛgul ni dihir o piɛri shɛm la. O laɣisi piɛbihi niŋ o bɔɣiri ni, ka zaŋ ba buɣi o nyɔɣu zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ manim baalim kuli.
en: Like a good shepherd, he takes care of his people. He gathers them like lambs in his arms. He holds them close, while their mothers walk beside him.

dag: Zaŋm salima mali kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni.
en: Use fine gold to hold the stones on the ephod.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be zibisim ni yipa nya neesim titali. Bɛn daa be zibisim tital ni, neesim neei paai ba.
en: Those people lived in darkness, but they will see a great light. They lived in a place as dark as death, but a great light will shine on them.

dag: Bɛ daa je bindirigu kam; di daa chɛ biɛla ka bɛ kpi.
en: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.

dag: Zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ bɛ dɔɣi yi tiligira ŋun nyɛ Masia ni yi Duuma la Naa Dauda ya Bɛtilihɛm.
en: This very day in David's town your Savior was born—Christ the Lord!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti laɣim be vol ni sarika ni, ka o yo ba niŋ di ni zali gu bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: God will crowd kings together like prisoners in a pit. He will shut them in prison until the time of their punishment comes.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛ kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ nahim Yisa tuumba maa, hal ka bɔri ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa.
en: Then some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to mistreat the apostles and stone them.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu, dama Naawuni n-daa niŋ lala ni o zaŋ ba niŋ Jɛhɔash nuu ni bɛ ni daa jɛmdi Ɛdomnim buɣa la zuɣu.
en: But Amaziah refused to listen. It was God's will for Amaziah to be defeated, because he had worshiped the Edomite idols.

dag: Yawɛ zaɣisi n tɔbbihi zaa bɛn be n sani. O zali ma saha shɛl o ni yɛn ku n nachimba. N Duuma no Juda paɣisarili ŋun nyɛ paɣipiɛliga sɔŋ kaman bɛ ni nɔri wain di bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord rejected all my powerful men who were inside the city. Then he brought a group of people against me. He brought them to kill my young soldiers. The Lord has trampled his dearest city like grapes in a winepress.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N suhu ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yiɣisi maa? Pa bɛmaŋmaŋ ka bɛ niŋ lala ni di ŋmaligi di ba maa.
en: But am I the one they are really offending? declares the LORD. Arent they in fact humiliating themselves?.

dag: Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Alikizandria tiŋbia ka o yuli booni Apolɔs daa ti ka Ɛfɛsus na. O daa nyɛla zilinvaliŋgalana, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mi Naawuni Kundi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: At that time a Jew named Apollos, who had been born in Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was an eloquent speaker and had a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.

dag: Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Juda Naa Ahaz bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam.
en: In the third year of the reign of Hoshea son of Elah as king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz became king of Judah.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔriba mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka sɔɣ o sani. Bɛnkam zaa bebu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni tibigim o.
en: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD; let them take refuge in him; let everyone whose heart is in the right place give praise!.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ Bia maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka ŋunkam mi bi deei Bia maa noli ku nya nyɛvili, amaa ka Naawuni suhu kul ni yiɣisiri bahir o zuɣu.
en: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.

dag: Fɔntiŋ maa dunoya ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nuzaa polo din buɣisibu ti yɛn nyɛ kilomita ayi ni mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la ni ti mali.
en: These are the gates of the city. The gates will be named for the tribes of Israel. The north side of the city will be cubits long.

dag: Dindali maa n shiri ni ti ŋmaligi n nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa din nyɛ bɛ ni jɛmdi wuna la zuɣu.
en: But I will hide my face at that time because of the many wrong things they have done, because they have turned to other gods!.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi bi lan mali suhupiɛlli kaman yi ni daa pun mali shɛm la? N din ya shɛhira ni di yi di daa naan nani, yi daa naan kpaɣi yimaŋmaŋ nina ti ma.
en: Where then is the great attitude that you had? I swear that, if possible, you would have dug out your eyes and given them to me.

dag: A zaŋ a yiko nuu tilig a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu mini Yisifu zuliya la.
en: By your power you saved your people, the descendants of Jacob and of Joseph.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn paɣir a dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka nyɛ bɛn tibigir a wuntitali.
en: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan niŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuhi me bimbin shɛŋa la yɛda. Bɛ mi ti ku lihi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa din nyɛ dari mini bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim Ashɛrim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: They will have no regard for altars, the work of their hands, or look to what their fingers made: sacred poles and incense stands.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la, Yi gba ni chɛ ma dolibu.
en: Jesus asked the twelve apostles, Do you want to leave too.

dag: Ɛliasa daa nyɛla Sisimai ba, ka Sisimai nyɛ Shallum ba.
en: Sismai, Shallum.

dag: N ni sabiri shɛli ŋɔ puuni, n niŋ naani ni a ni niŋ n ni suh a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ hal n-niŋ li yaɣi lala zuɣu gba.
en: I write this letter knowing that you will do what I ask, and even more than I ask.

dag: N daa chɛ a Kriit ni a niŋla binshɛŋa din simdi niŋbu la, ka pii cheechi toondaannima n-zali tiŋ kam ni kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm la.
en: I left you in Crete, so that you could put in order the things that still needed doing and appoint church elders in every town. Remember my instructions:.

dag: Ka Jɛsi lan chɛ ka Shamma kana ti gari, ka o lan yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: So Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, No, the LORD hasnt chosen this one.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ garig o, bee n nya yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o?.
en: So I cannot argue with God. I would not know what to say to him.

dag: Ijiptinim ni ti di vi, bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo na nuu ni. .
en: The people of Egypt are put to shame; they are conquered by the people of the north. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni ka di nyɛ din bi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa sani. Ka bɛ daa lan me buɣijɛmbo shee zali bɛ fɔntinsi zaa ni mini tiŋkpan bihi ni ni bɛ ni me birini gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni;.
en: The Israelites secretly did things against the Lord their God, and those things were wrong! The Israelites built high places in all their cities—from the smallest town to the largest city.

dag: kaman bɛ ni daa nya li di piligu ni shɛm, ka moli di lahibal la.
en: They wrote what we have been told by those who saw these things from the beginning and who proclaimed the message.

dag: Nyama, o ni daa kul yɛri maa o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nabihi maa dii kpɛna nti duhi bɛ yee kumda, ka naa min o kpamba zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: No sooner had he said it, than David's sons came in. They were weeping out loud, and David and all his officials cried just as loudly.

dag: gol so ŋun daa pahir ayɔbu biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali, Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi la saha.
en: So they began this work on the th day of the sixth month in the second year Darius was the king.

dag: Di saha ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim zaa mini na shɛb bɛn ʒi Dauda ʒiishee la ni maligumaaniba ni anabinima ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nyu dam kuli.
en: Then you should say to them: The LORD proclaims: Im going to fill everyone who lives in this country with wine that makes them drunk, including the kings on Davids throne, the priests, the prophets, and all those living in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa dɔɣirikpamba zaa daa laɣimna ti pahi Naawuni niriba laɣiŋgu maa ni, ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ tinchandiba ka gbibi takɔbiri kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: The leaders of all the tribes of Israel were present at this gathering of God's people, and there were , foot soldiers.

dag: Yaakubu daa kul bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni din nyɛ o ba ni daa be luɣ shɛl la.
en: Jacob stayed and lived in the land of Canaan. This is the same land where his father had lived.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa deei nyuli zabbu sara chi zim maa paɣ maa nuu ni n-zaŋ li gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu;.
en: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord . Then he will place it on my altar.

dag: A kari pakoya bahi ni nuzaŋa, ka kabisi kpibisi bɔɣiri.
en: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Lɛvi bidibisi maa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yi mali yimaŋa m-be kasi ni yi tumdi Yawɛ tuma, yi zaa yinoyino bidibisi mini yi mabihi kubu ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya alibarika zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then Moses said, Take your role today as special servants of the Lord because you were willing to fight against even your own sons and brothers. You will receive a blessing for this.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa suhi Naawuni shɛm ni anab shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yuli tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa la zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Manasseh did, the prayer he made to his God, and the messages of the prophets who spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, are all recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Wuntaŋ daa kul wɔbiri ma mi dabisili kam, ka wari mi kpɛri ma yuŋ, ka n gaani gom.
en: The dry heat consumed me during the day, and the frost at night; I couldnt sleep.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama ti yɛl o Sool ni niŋ o shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka o mini Samuɛl daa chaŋ ti be Naiɔt.
en: David escaped and ran away to Samuel at Ramah. He told Samuel everything that Saul had done to him. Then David and Samuel went to the camps where the prophets stayed. David stayed there.

dag: Dunɔguliba zuɣulaannim anahi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni du shɛŋa mini neen shɛŋa din mali bukaata fukumsi.
en: There were four gatekeepers who were the leaders of all the gatekeepers. They were Levites. They had the job of caring for the rooms and treasures in Gods Temple.

dag: Nyin zoli din do Zɛrubabɛl tooni ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee nyɛ a? A ni leei tintani. O ni me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa. Ka o yi ti zaŋ kuɣ shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa pa di zuɣu, di saha maa niriba ni ti kuhi yɛli, Naawuni nirilim galisiya, Naawuni nirilim galisiya. .
en: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. He will present the capstone to shouts of great gratitude.

dag: ni Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Azaz bia la, ka Azaz daa nyɛ Shɛma bia, ka Shɛma daa nyɛ Joɛl bia, Joɛl maa min o niriba n-daa ʒini Aroa zaŋ hal ni Nɛbo mini Baalimiɔn la.
en: and Bela. Bela was Azazs son. Azaz was Shemas son. Shema was Joels son. They lived in the area of Aroer all the way to Nebo and Baal Meon.

dag: Kpiimba bi paɣiri Yawɛ, ka bɛn chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba bi paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: The dead dont praise him. Those in the grave dont praise the Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa tim ni bɛ kuli ti yɛli Dauda tɔb maa lahibali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Joab sent a report to David telling him about the battle.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa nya ka Leeban bi lan bɔr o yɛla kaman o ni daa pun bɔr o yɛla shɛm la.
en: Then Jacob noticed that Laban was not as friendly as he had been in the past.

dag: ni Lɛbana daŋ niriba ni Hagaba daŋ niriba ni Shalimai daŋ niriba.
en: Lebanah, Hagabah, Shalmai.

dag: Nyama, ti ni daa nya laɣ shɛli ti kpalansi noya ni la, ti daa ʒi li yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni labina ti ti a, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti ni ti zu anzinfa bee salima a dan yiŋa?.
en: You know that we brought back to you from the land of Canaan the money we found in the top of our sacks. Why then should we steal silver or gold from your master's house?.

dag: Nyini n-ti wɔhu yaa? Nyini n-zaŋ gbɛm tam o nyiŋgoli zuɣu?.
en: Did you give strength to the horse, clothe his neck with a mane.

dag: ni Maasɛya so mi mini Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛza ni Uzi ni Jɛhɔhanan ni Malikija ni Ɛlam ni Ɛzɛr. Ka Jɛzirahia daa gari tooni zaŋ yiliyiiniba ka bɛ yili yila.
en: and they were followed by Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers, led by Jezrahiah, sang at the top of their voices.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni booni tab yɛra, Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: They are like children sitting in the marketplace. One group shouts to the other, We played wedding music for you, but you wouldn't dance! We sang funeral songs, but you wouldn't cry.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu bara ni o ni ti pini ka bi ti li ŋmanila saa ni yi ku ka bi mi la.
en: People who promise things that they never give are like clouds and wind that bring no rain.

dag: Yisifu saha ka o daa zali zaligu maa, saha shɛl o ni daa liri Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ la. N wumla n ni ʒi kukol shɛli, ka di yɛra:.
en: God made this agreement with Josephs people, when he led them out of Egypt. In a language we didnt understand, God said.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli nti zaŋ bɛ ŋariŋ lo n-zali teeku noli.
en: When Jesus and his disciples had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret, anchored the boat.

dag: Ka kpiimba mini tampiligim vinvamli ni zaa ni pu shɛŋa din be Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli zaa ni Wɔhu Dunɔdali din be gooŋgɔŋ shee zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo la ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan wurim li bee n-saɣim li yaha.
en: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku bɔh o bia maa, M bia, ka wula ka a lee niŋ nya li yomyom lala? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ n-ti ma di nasara maa.
en: Isaac said, How did you find it so quickly, son? Jacob answered, The Lord your God helped me find it.

dag: Bɛ yi kul saɣisiri nira, ka o kul niŋdi tipawumli, o ni ti kabisi yim ka ku lan tooi tib kpaŋ.
en: If you get more stubborn every time you are corrected, one day you will be crushed and never recover.

dag: M mi kɔŋsim biɛhigu, ka mi malibu gba biɛhigu. M pun bɔhim baŋ ashili ŋɔ: N ni be luɣ shɛlikam mini saha shɛlikam zaa puuni, n yi nya n-di bee n yi gbe kum, ka n yi mali pam bee n yi malila biɛla n nini tiɣiri li mi.
en: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi n-daa nyɛ; Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: Noah; Noahs family: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin shɛli dihi niriba tusaanahi la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛr ayopɔin.
en: And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand people, asked Jesus, how many baskets full of leftover pieces did you take up? Seven, they answered.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bi niŋ yɛda suhupiɛlli zuɣu ka biɛhindi maa ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mali bindir shɛli kpe ka n ni di.
en: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, Do you have something to eat.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ man zaŋ a leela bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli, ka zaŋ a leei kurugu daantaliga mini daanya gooni n-jɛndi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa; ka lan zaŋ a jɛndi Juda nanim mini di kpamba ni di maligumaaniba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa.
en: Today I have made you an armed city, an iron pillar, and a bronze wall against the entire land—the kings of Judah, its princes, its priests, and all its people.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka niriba maa kul be yiriŋ maa.
en: Moses saw that Aaron had let the people get out of control and make fools of themselves in front of their enemies.

dag: Lala ka Jɛhu daa niŋ kpihim Baal birili zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Jehu destroyed Baal worship in Israel.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yi ku nya pɔhim bee saa, amaa kom ni tɛli baa ŋɔ ni ka yi mini yi niɣi ni yi biŋkɔbiri nyu. .
en: Yes, this is what the Lord says: You will not see wind or rain, but that valley will be filled with water. Then you and your cattle and other animals will have water to drink.

dag: Ka naa mini Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi la ka bɛ bo tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan bo bɛn mi kuriti mini daanya tuma ni bɛ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The king and Jehoiada would give it to those in charge of the work on the LORDs temple who in turn hired masons and carpenters to renovate the LORDs temple, as well as metalworkers for the iron and bronze to repair the LORDs temple.

dag: Dɔro di bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa, kum bituuli di bɛ nuhi min bɛ naba.
en: A deadly disease spreads over their bodies and causes their arms and legs to rot.

dag: Bom mɔɣu ni nimdi na ti duɣi n ni yuri bindir shɛli, ka n di ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni Yawɛ tooni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: to kill a wild animal and cook some tasty food for him before he dies. Your father said this because he wants to bless your brother with the Lord as his witness.

dag: Ka bia maa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui, ka bɛ laɣimna ni bɛ ti gun o. Bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla o ba yuli Zakaria la ti o.
en: On the eighth day, it came time to circumcise the child. They wanted to name him Zechariah because that was his fathers name.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ ti kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: Jesus went from there to their synagogue.

dag: Malimiya nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ bihi mini zaɣ kara n-chaŋ tɔb tuhibu.
en: Grab your shields and prepare for war!.

dag: Di simdi ni yi tumdi din tuhi mini din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: Do what the Lord says is right and good, and all will go well with you. You will be able to take possession of the fertile land that the Lord promised your ancestors.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ti ni saɣi zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ya, ka ti gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi, ka kpalim be yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti mini ya leei ninvuɣ yinsi.
en: Then we will agree to intermarriage. We will settle among you and become one people with you.

dag: Tim ti ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu;.
en: Give us each day the food we need.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat mini Gɛshɛm daa tim na ti yɛli ma ni n chirigim ba tiŋkpan shɛli din be Ono Bɔpiɛligu ni la. Amaa bɛ daa lomi ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: So Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: Come, Nehemiah, lets meet together. We can meet in the town of Kephirim on the plain of Ono. But they were planning to hurt me.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ʒiri pina kani Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiri Yawɛ, ka tiri Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia neen viɛla ka di daa chɛ ka zuliya kam tibig o di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: People brought offerings to Jerusalem for the Lord and expensive gifts for Hezekiah, and from that day on, every nation on earth respected Hezekiah.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini, di nyɛla zaligu shɛli din kul yɛn be yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Yi mini tinzunnim zaa yɛn nyɛla yim Yawɛ sani.
en: For all time to come, the same rules are binding on you and on the foreigners who live among you. You and they are alike in the Lord 's sight;.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ bɔh o shɛm ka bɔhi ba, N ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma maa gbinni ka yi bɔhiri taba ni yi baŋ maa?.
en: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba! Chɛ ka zuliya kam baŋ ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima.
en: Teach them a lesson, Lord . Let them know they are only human. Selah.

dag: Gɛbalnima ni Ammɔnnima ni Amalɛknima ni Filistianima mini Taainima.
en: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.

dag: So yi tahir a ʒiishee ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa yom, di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: Be sure to make friends quickly with your opponents while you are with them on the way to court. Otherwise, they will haul you before the judge, the judge will turn you over to the officer of the court, and you will be thrown into prison.

dag: Ka Zilla mi daa dɔɣi Tubalikeen ŋun daa nyɛ ŋun zaŋ daanya mini kuriti m-mali tuma nɛma balibu kam zaa la. Ka Tubalikeen tizɔpaɣ daa nyɛ Naama.
en: Zillah gave birth to Tubal Cain, who made all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. The sister of Tubal Cain was Naamah.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka bɛ laɣim yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa din kanna ŋɔ ni bindira din yɛn niŋ pam maa zaa zali, ka di nyɛ a ni zaŋ bindir shɛli niŋ fukumsi fɔntinsi ni ka bɛ gbib li.
en: Order them to collect all the food during the good years that are coming, and give them authority to store up grain in the cities and guard it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa beni ka barina shɛli kani. Yaakubu zuliya kɔŋko n-daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bindira mini wain; ni luɣ shɛli maligim ni yiri zuɣusaa luri tiŋ na.
en: So Israel will live in safety. Jacobs well belongs to them. They will get a land of grain and wine. And that land will get plenty of rain.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhudoo din yaɣi ninsal milinsi zuɣu la ni gbibi yi suhuri mini yi tɛha Yisa Masia ni.
en: And because you belong to Christ Jesus, Gods peace will stand guard over all your thoughts and feelings. His peace can do this far better than our human minds.

dag: Dama a tiligi ma kum ni, ka chɛ ka m bi lu ni di chɛ ka m be a tooni n-chani nyɛvili neesim puuni.
en: because you have saved my life from death, saved my feet from stumbling so that I can walk before God in the light of life.

dag: Amaa ka Sihɔn daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di kpe o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari. O daa laɣimla o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ Jahaz din daa be yɔɣu maa ni la nti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: But King Sihon would not allow the Israelites to travel through his country. He gathered together his army and marched out to the desert to fight against the Israelites. The kings army fought against the Israelites at Jahaz.

dag: O bela o biɛhigu shee ka lihiri zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: but he bends down to see the heavens and the earth.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa teei di ni daa sab yɛli shɛm la yɛla. Di ni daa sab shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni.
en: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, My love for your house burns in me like a fire.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa tuuli la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi la gba naŋgbambili, ka di zaa doya tuhi taba.
en: There must be loops on the end curtain of the first group. And there must be loops on the end curtain of the other group. These loops must be opposite each other.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam Ziɔn; bɛ duh o gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: The Lord is mighty in Zion; he is supreme over all the nations.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yuri ya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka a lee yuri ti? Yawɛ yɛliya, Iso daa pala Yaakubu mabia? Di zaa yoli, n daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: I have loved you, says the LORD; but you say, How have you loved us? Wasnt Esau Jacobs brother? says the LORD. I loved Jacob.

dag: Ti sa bela puu ni lɔri kabɔba, yim ka n ti nya ka n kabɔbili yiɣisi zani, ka yi kabɔba laɣimna ti gili n kabɔbili maa n-damdi li tiŋa.
en: We were out in the field, tying up bundles of wheat. Suddenly my bundle stood up, and your bundles gathered around and bowed down to it.

dag: Ka Pita kpuɣ o nuhi gahi wuhi ni bɛ foma, ka o daa kahigi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm yih o duu maa ni wuhi ba; ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim Jeemsi mini yɛdaniŋdiba zaa di yɛla. Ka daa yi nimaani chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: He gestured with his hand to quiet them down, then recounted how the Lord led him out of prison. He said, Tell this to James and the brothers and sisters. Then he left for another place.

dag: Sahimiya piɛma pali lɔɣiri. Yawɛ piɛlila Miidia nanim bahina, dama o nia nyɛla o wurim Babilɔn. Dama Yawɛ n-yɛn bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu la zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord , want Babylon destroyed, because its army destroyed my temple. So, you kings of Media, sharpen your arrows and pick up your shields.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ gba ti leei din bi kpira.
en: This body that ruins must clothe itself with something that will never ruin. And this body that dies must clothe itself with something that will never die.

dag: Amaa o yi yiɣisi ni o guui, o larila wɔribara min o wɔhu.
en: But when she begins to run, she can laugh at any horse and rider.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tinsi maa ni nɛma zaa tabili di niɣi. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tinsi maa ni zaa; ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba.
en: The Israelites took all the valuable things from those cities and the cattle as plunder for themselves. But they struck down every person without mercy until they had wiped them out. They didnt let anything that breathed survive.

dag: Ti yi yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, kum be di ni, ka ti ni kpi; ka ti mi yi ʒi kpe, ti ni kpi. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Sirianim sansani ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti chɛ ti, ti ni be; ka bɛ yi ti ku ti, ka ti dii kpi.
en: There's nothing to eat in the city, so we would starve if we went inside. But if we stay out here, we will die for sure. Let's sneak over to the Syrian army camp and surrender. They might kill us, but they might not.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ gili Ifriim zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya tiŋgban ni tinsi zaa n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni, amaa ka niriba maa daa lari ba, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: The messengers went to every town in Ephraim and West Manasseh as far north as the territory of Zebulun, but people laughed and insulted them.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a ni a niŋ alibarika niŋ man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni din ni chɛ ka n daŋ kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni nyin Naawuni sani; dama nyini Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka a daalibarika kul ni be man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Please bless my descendants and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already promised, and I'm sure that you will bless my family forever.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti kul kpɛri ha m-be dunol ni, ka Ahija wum o naba vubu ka yɛli, Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa, kpɛmina; bɔ n-niŋ ka a taɣ a biɛhigu ni a be kaman paɣ so la. M mali yɛtɔɣ kpɛma ni n yɛl a.
en: But when Ahijah heard her walking up to the door, he said: Come in! I know you're Jeroboam's wife—why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a suhu kpɛh a yɔɣu, ka bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka a nini mooi.
en: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha, ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim.
en: Why, I ask myself, are you so depressed? Why are you so upset inside? Hope in God! Because I will again give him thanks, my saving presence and my God.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa maa puuni, timiya ba tins ayɔbu din yɛn nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku ninsala ka zo n-kuli di ni tiligi, ka ti ba tinsi pihinahinaayi pahi.
en: You are to give the Levites six cities of refuge to which any of you can escape if you kill someone accidentally. In addition, give them forty-two other cities.

dag: Asaf bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani ka o wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-daa nyɛ: Zakur mini Yisifu ni Nɛtania ni Asharɛla. Naa n-daa wuhiri ba luɣ shɛŋa ni saha shɛli di ni simdi ni bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.

dag: Ka o daa mooni molo yɛra, Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n ti damd o tooni gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi.
en: This is what John told the people: There is someone coming later who is able to do more than I can. I am not good enough to be the slave who stoops down to untie his sandals.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn kpa shɛli polo ni ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Pray that the Lord our God will show us the way we should go and what we should do.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi tuhi nintɔri ka di shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka daɣiri, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If the man with the discharge spits on anyone who is ritually clean, that person must wash his clothes and take a bath, and he remains unclean until evening.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabia, n suhir a, Niŋm ma nirilim ŋɔ ti Duuma zuɣu. Kpaŋsimi n suhu Masia ni.
en: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.

dag: O daa lan zali Obɛdɛdom min o mabihi ninvuɣ pisopɔinayika la gba; ka Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛdutun bia la mini Hɔsa mi daa nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: Obed Edom son of Jeduthun and sixty-eight men of his clan were to assist them. Hosah and Obed Edom were in charge of guarding the gates.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali din be dundɔn titali ni zaŋ labi nuzaa polo la ziliŋ mini di yɛliŋ.
en: Then the man measured the gateway on the north side that led into the outer courtyard.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ba yihi tin ya, yin di yɛliya yi suhuri ni, Ti wuntitali zuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Di nyɛla niriba maa ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu ka Yawɛ kari ba tin ya maa.
en: The Lord your God will force those nations out for you. But dont say to yourselves, The Lord brought us to live in this land because we are such good people. No, the Lord forced those nations out because they were evil, not because you were good.

dag: Kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni fɔntin shɛŋa din baɣi li ni daa wurim shɛm la, lala ka di gba ni wurim; ka so ti ku lan be nimaani, ka so mi ti ku lan ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: as bad as the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah and towns nearby. The towns of Edom will be empty.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛl do so mini Midian paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Zimiri. O daa nyɛla Salu bia, ka lan nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya niriba dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the head of a family in the tribe of Simeon.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli, ka nyɛ luɣ gahindili luɣ kasi shee tiŋgbani maa ni. Di ni ti nyɛla luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee n-tuɣi Lɛvinim tiŋgbani.
en: So they are to have a special area next to the area belonging to the Levites, and it will be the holiest of all.

dag: ni Hushai bia Baana ŋun daa be Asha mini Biilɔt yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana son of Hushai was governor of Asher and Aloth.

dag: Ti daa fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ li ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili.
en: took their land, and divided it among the tribes of Reuben and Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun na yoli niŋ tuuba; di yi nyɛ lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti niŋ karimbaani duh omaŋa, ka saria karibu di o kaman di ni daa di Sintani shɛm la.
en: He must be mature in the faith, so that he will not swell up with pride and be condemned, as the Devil was.

dag: N daa mali suhupiɛlli o dunia din pali binnɛma ŋɔ zuɣu, ka mali suhupiɛlli ninsalinim zuɣu.
en: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Kpa ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ yomyom ʒini n-taɣi sab pihinu.
en: He answered, I owe him jars of olive oil. The manager said to him, Here is your bill. Hurry! Sit down and make the bill less. Write jars.

dag: N ni bɔri nolɔbo shɛli n-nyɛ: Yi lɔrigi yi ni nahindi shɛb la mihi, ka suui yi ni mɔŋ shɛb yɛlimaŋli ka ʒili ba ʒi tibisa la ʒiya; ka bahi yi ni nahindi shɛb la.
en: Isnt this the fast I choose: releasing wicked restraints, untying the ropes of a yoke, setting free the mistreated, and breaking every yoke?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka yɛdaniŋdib maa daa chɛ ka Pool mini Silas dii yi nimaani yuŋ chaŋ Bɛria. Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Bɛria, bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ni tɔŋda, ka bɛ bihi ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: They will enjoy good things, and their children will get the land God promised.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma.
en: Balaam said, Build seven altars here. Then prepare seven bulls and seven rams for the altars.

dag: Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa na kul be o nyɛvil ni ka mal alaafee. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: They answered, Your humble servant, our father, is still alive and well. And they knelt and bowed down before him.

dag: amaa ti ni niŋdi shɛlikam puuni, ti kpaŋdila timaŋa ni ti wuhi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba. Ti wuhiri li ania niŋbu pam puuni mini nahiŋgu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni wahala dibu puuni.
en: Instead, in everything we do we show that we are God's servants by patiently enduring troubles, hardships, and difficulties.

dag: ka tinim bɛn mali nyɛviya be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ mini ba ti laɣim chaŋ ti kpe sagban ni n-tuhi ti Duuma soli sagbani maa ni; ka ti ni ti kpalim be ti Duuma maa sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: After that we who are still alive at that time will be gathered up with those who have died. We will be taken up in the clouds and meet the Lord in the air. And we will be with the Lord forever.

dag: dama a tahi yɛl pal shɛŋa ti ni na ʒi n-wum di yɛla na. Dinzuɣu ti bɔri ni ti baŋ yɛla maa gbinni.
en: Some of the things we hear you say sound strange to us, and we would like to know what they mean. .

dag: Yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zaa zuɣu, n ni niŋ ya n ni na ʒi n-niŋ ya shɛm, ka mi ku lan niŋ di kpee yaha.
en: Because of all the things you do that I hate, I will punish Jerusalem as I have never done before and will never do again.

dag: Bɛ lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a niriba polo; ka niŋdi tab saawara zaŋ chaŋ a ni guli a ninvuɣ shɛb la polo.
en: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.

dag: Nyam bɛ ni lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu shɛm, ka lo barina tumbu nia, ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: The minds of the wicked are full of evil; they are pregnant with wicked plans, which give birth to lies.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo tintariga ni ti zaŋla Damaskus mini Hauran sunsuuni la m-baɣisi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili n-tim Giliad mini Izraɛl tiŋgbana sunsuuni gari n-zaŋ hal ni wulimpuhili polo teeku ni n-zaŋ hal ti paai Tama. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ wulimpuhili polo yaɣili.
en: For the eastern limit, you will measure continuously between Hauran and Damascus and between Gilead and the land of Israel, along the Jordan River as far as the Dead Sea. This is the eastern limit.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ tiwala tihi puu ni, ni n ti nya vinvamli ni tipuma, ka nya wain tihi puma, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi puma.
en: I have come down among the almond trees to see the young plants in the valley, to see the new leaves on the vines and the blossoms on the pomegranate trees.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Ɛfɛsus, ka Pool chɛ Akuila mini Prisila ka chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛla.
en: Then they went to the city of Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. While Paul was in Ephesus, he went into the synagogue and talked with the Jews.

dag: Miriya ka yi chaŋ hal ka yi naba ti fuɣi bee n-chɛ ka kɔnyuri kuui yi lɔna. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti bɔrila saamba, saamba ka ti kul ni jɛmda.
en: Dont run about until your feet are blistered and your throat is parched. But you say, Whats the use? I have fallen in love with foreign gods, and I must pursue them.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka di simdi ka yi ti lo noli; di yɛn nyɛla zaligu sahakam.
en: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.

dag: Kum doli ti takɔriti ni kpe na. Di kpe ti nanim yinsi ni di ku bihi solɔri zuɣu ka ku nachimba mi zama laɣiŋgu shee.
en: We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti sɔɣi ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni o zuɣu salo maa ni: Shɛb daa yɛrimi, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ. Ka shɛb mi yɛra, Aai! O nyɛla ŋun birigiri niriba.
en: The crowds were murmuring about him. Hes a good man, some said, but others were saying, No, he tricks the people.

dag: Haman ni daa nya ka Mɔdɛkai zaɣisi ni o ku ti o jilima bee n-damd o tiŋ maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: When Haman saw that Mordecai refused to bow down to him or give him honor, he was very angry.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yihi yɛli ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu ka wumdi tirila shi biɛri bɛn yɔhindi niriba la ka ni dolila alizin biɛri wuhibu.
en: The Spirit clearly says that in the last times some will turn away from what we believe. They will obey spirits that tell lies. And they will follow the teachings of demons.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa sɔɣi Ibrahimma min o paɣ Zara ni Yisahaku min o paɣ Ribɛka; ka n gba daa sɔɣi Liya nimaani.
en: That is where Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, and where Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and where I buried Leah.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti yiɣis o garo zuɣu wuntaŋ ŋmalli saha n-du n-tam nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa chana nti lihi nya paɣ so ni suri kom, paɣ maa daa viɛli pam.
en: One day, late in the afternoon, David got up from his nap and went to the palace roof. As he walked around up there, he saw a woman taking a bath in her house. She was very beautiful.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na nti pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ pinaayi m-boli ba tuumba.
en: At daybreak, he called together his disciples. He chose twelve of them whom he called apostles.

dag: Ka bɛn ti yɛn bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu nyɛla Isaka zuliya. Isaka niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Zua bia Nɛtanɛl.
en: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its , troops.

dag: Bɛn daa ŋubi bɛ sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ka nyu bɛ sara maligu wain la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ya, chɛ ka bɛ guli ya.
en: You fed them the fat of your sacrifices and offered them wine to drink. Let them come and help you now; let them run to your rescue.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam zaa niŋ Yisifu nuu ni. Yisifu ni daa be o sani maa zuɣu, o baɣa daa lan ka shɛl ni n-naɣ pahila bindir shɛl o ni daa diri ni. Yisifu daa yi nachimbil viɛlli pam, ka o lihibu viɛla.
en: So Potiphar allowed Joseph to take responsibility for everything in the house. Potiphar didnt have to worry about anything except deciding what to eat. Joseph was a very handsome, good-looking man.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai.
en: So Solomon's workers finished building the temple.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa mɔɣisi Barizillai kpariŋ, ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni, ka Barizillai daa labi kul o yiŋa, ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa du.
en: The king kissed Barzillai and blessed him. Barzillai went back home, and the king and all the people went across the river.

dag: Yi lan wum ka di pun sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a yi a pɔri nyaaŋa, amaa niŋmila a ni pɔ pɔri ni a niŋ shɛli maa ti ti Duuma.
en: Again you have heard that it was said to those who lived long ago: Dont make a false solemn pledge, but you should follow through on what you have pledged to the Lord.

dag: Bɛ daa kulila Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya daŋ ni dɔbba, ka bɛ fali tarili daa kpalim bɛ yaannim daŋ puuni.
en: They married within the clans of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their property remained in their father's tribe.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Ɛhab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab became king.

dag: Shimilan bɔri ni o nyala buni yomyom, ka bi mi ni ashaara nyɛla din yɛn kana ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaanu la zaŋ pɔŋ tusaanu pahi di zuɣu na ti yɛl o yiŋlan maa, N dana, pɔŋ tusaanu ka a daa zaŋ ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaanu nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: The servant who got five bags brought that amount and five more bags of money to the master. The servant said, Master, you trusted me to care for five bags of money. So I used them to earn five more.

dag: ka tinzunnim vuri ŋmani tiŋgban kuŋ ni tulim la, a daa chɛ ka sagbana limsi li n-ku di tulim maa, ka putɔɣunim maa chɛ yila yilibu.
en: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim daa yɛli Midian kpamba, Salo ni gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni naai binshɛlikam din gili ti zaa kaman naɣilaa ni ŋubiri mɔri mɔɣu ni shɛm la. Zipɔr bia Balak n-daa nyɛ Mɔab naa di saha maa.
en: The Moabites said to the elders of Midian, Now this assembly will devour everything around us, as an ox eats up the grass in the field. Balak, Zippors son, was king of Moab at that time.

dag: Bɛ yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa zali tanza kpeeni n-gu dahin shɛli; ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi vili n-gbib nyɛvili din nyɛ nyɛvili maŋli la.
en: When they do these things, they will save a treasure for themselves that is a good foundation for the future. That way they can take hold of what is truly life.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, ti naba ʒiɛla a dunoya ni.
en: Here we are, standing at the gates of Jerusalem.
