dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa nya o ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ yɛri ni alizini m-bala, ka kuhi dabiɛm kuhigu.
en: When they saw him, they thought he was a ghost. They were terrified and started screaming.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ni o yihim ti tɛhibiɛrinim mini ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, dama pa sokam zaa n-nyɛ bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.

dag: Dindali n ni ti tim tuumba ka bɛ yi n sani kpe ŋarima chaŋ ti kpɛhi Itiɔpianim bɛn bi mi bɛ yɛla ŋɔ dabiɛm pam. Biɛrim ni ti paai ba Ijiptinim mbusim dabisili maa dali, dama di kanna.
en: messengers in ships will go out from me to startle the complacent Cushites. Anguish will overcome them on Egypts day. Its certainly coming.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ʒiri chi mini wɔrimɔri na nti tiri yuri mini tɔb wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam nayili maa kaman bɛ ni daa zali bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o niŋm shɛm.
en: The district governors also gave the king enough straw and barley for the chariot horses and the riding horses. Everyone brought this grain to the necessary places.

dag: Siria naa mi ni ti kana ti liri Ijiptinima, amaa o ni ti kɔŋ nasara ka ŋmaligi lab kul o ya.
en: Then the northern king will attack the kingdom of the southern king, but will return to his own land.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi jilima yi tab sani, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu kun ya ŋmaai yi yuma jia.
en: If you do, others will gain the respect that you once had, and you will die young at the hands of merciless people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: Joshua was buried on his own land at Timnath Serah, in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

dag: Sɔɣim ma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa ashilɔni zaŋ chaŋ m polo la, ka sɔɣi ma ka chɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba ni lɔri yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Protect me from the plots of the wicked, from mobs of evil people.

dag: Zaŋmi dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba; ka kpammi ba jaande, ka kpahimi bɛn wumd a wuhibu zuɣu ni a fukumsi zaa subu puuni. Di chɛ ka so ʒiɛm a.
en: Teach these things and use your full authority as you encourage and rebuke your hearers. Let none of them look down on you.

dag: Ka Sool tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la daa zaŋ Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt n-zo chaŋ Mahanaim.
en: Abner son of Ner was the captain of Sauls army. Abner took Ish Bosheth son of Saul to Mahanaim.

dag: Ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal maa daa bi dɔɣi bia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Michal, Saul's daughter, never had any children.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti kaman o ni lo shɛm o suhu ni, ka pa ni yolitim bee muɣisigu zuɣu, dama Naawuni yurila ŋun tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Everyone should give whatever they have decided in their heart. They shouldnt give with hesitation or because of pressure. God loves a cheerful giver.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu kaman di ni daa sabi shɛm; ka daa maani sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Maligunim maa kalinli daa dolila zaligu ni wuhi ni bɛ maani li dabisili kam shɛm.
en: They celebrated the Festival of Shelters according to the regulations; each day they offered the sacrifices required for that day;.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Izraɛl tampiŋ la yɛli ma: So yi doli yɛlimaŋli soli n-su o niriba, ka su ba ni Naawuni zɔbo.
en: Israels God has spoken, Israels rock said to me: Whoever rules rightly over people, whoever rules in the fear of God.

dag: Ka lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni. Ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has handed all things over to me. No one knows the Son except the Father. And nobody knows the Father except the Son and anyone to whom the Son wants to reveal him.

dag: lala ka n yɛligu shɛli din yiri n nol ni na gba ku labi n sanna yoli. Di ni tum n ni lo ni di tum shɛli. Ka di nasara n ni tim li ni di ti tum shɛm puuni.
en: So also will be the word that I speak— it will not fail to do what I plan for it; it will do everything I send it to do.

dag: hal ka daa mi ni Naawuni pun yɛli ŋun ti yab Ibrahimma, Yisahaku ni ka a zuliya ni zani.
en: God had said to him, It is through Isaac that you will have the descendants I promised.

dag: Nyama, a yɛri ni a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka duh amaŋa nyuri bara. Ʒi a yiŋ baalim. Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn bo yɛla ti amaŋ tabili Judanima.
en: Now Amaziah, you boast that you have defeated the Edomites, but I advise you to stay at home. Why stir up trouble that will only bring disaster on you and your people.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri mahigiri tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka di mali kulim pam. Nyin Naawuni mɔɣili palila kom, nyini n-tiri niriba bindira. A ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: You take care of the land. You water it and make it fertile. Your streams are always filled with water. Thats how you make the crops grow.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa deei bɛ bindira maa shɛli di, ka bi suhi Yawɛ n-niŋ o saawara di zuɣu.
en: The Israelites accepted some food from them, but did not consult the Lord about it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiɔŋ yir a sanna mal alibarika, bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri kul bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Ziɔn ti jɛm a.
en: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya taba kaman Masia ni daa deei ti shɛm Naawuni paɣibu zuɣu la.
en: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.

dag: Ka Firawuna tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa buri bɛ mi ni daa pii Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ lihiri bɛ tab maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ŋma bilichiisi sɔhila mini zuŋɔ kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm dabisili kam la.
en: The Egyptian slave drivers beat the Israelite foremen, whom they had put in charge of the work. They demanded, Why aren't you people making the same number of bricks that you made before.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi a sani, dama ti chɛ nyini ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka jɛmdila buɣa Baalnima.
en: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, Weve sinned against you, for we went away from our God and served the Baals.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya maa, tuuli dini daa gbaala Jɛhoyarib, ka din pah ayi gbaai Jɛdaya.
en: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zani yim saɣi deei ti ninvuɣ biɛtali din nyɛ ti yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la, dama ti tum alahichi a sani.
en: Lord , we know that we are wicked. We know that our ancestors did evil things. Yes, we sinned against you.

dag: Yawɛ ni ka o niriba sanna; o ni to o piɛma ka di be kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ni ti piɛb kikaa; ka ni ti be nudirigu polo pɔhim ni kanna.
en: The Lord will appear to them, and he will shoot his arrows like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and the army will rush forward like a desert dust storm.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi kul nya ka shɛli viɛli yi sani, dina ka n ni niŋ. Ka naa daa kana ti ʒe tiŋ maa dunoli naŋgbanyee ka tɔbbihi maa zaa daa doli tab yirina kɔbigakɔbiga ni tuhilituhili.
en: The king said to them, I will do what you think is best. Then the king stood by the gate as the army went out in groups of and .

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa du n-tam zo shɛli din yuli booni Zɛmaraim Zoli din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya ni la zuɣu ka yɛli, Nyin Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim in the hill country of Ephraim and said, Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!.

dag: N ku saɣim n ni lo o alikauli shɛli, bee n-taɣi n ni yaai n noli yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: I will not break my covenant with him or take back even one promise I made him.

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dunol ni na Yawɛ tooni nti zaŋ o nuu pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi naɣilaa maa Yawɛ tooni.
en: The anointed priest must bring the bull to the entrance of the Meeting Tent in front of the Lord . He must put his hand on the bulls head and kill the bull in front of the Lord .

dag: Ka di yi ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: Meet for worship on the seventh day and do no work.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim suhuri daa paligi pam, bɛ ni daa yi n-chaŋ maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa kpalim zɔri ba mi.
en: The Egyptians were afraid of them and were glad when they left.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ, ka di nyom viɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will offer burnt offerings. Their smell will please the Lord . You must offer bull, ram, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Amaa bɛ nimdi nyɛla yi dini kaman bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu nyɔɣu polo mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli gahiri zuɣusaa mini nudirigu gbalipaɣa ni nyɛ yi dini shɛm la.
en: You are allowed to eat the meat of those animals, just as you can eat the choice ribs and the right hind leg of the special sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu Dimitirius min o tumtumditab maa yi zaŋla so taali, saria karibu duu beni ka sariakaritiba be di ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn zaŋm taba tahi ni.
en: If Demetrius and his workers have an accusation against anyone, we have the authorities and the regular days for court; charges can be made there.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee gbi kɔsoli n-ti sa titali bee m-mali soli ti sakpani?.
en: Who dug ditches in the sky for the heavy rain? Who made a path for the thunderstorm?.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa laɣim sokam zaa na nti yɛli ba, Ɛhab daa jɛm Baal la biɛla, amaa man yɛn jɛm o la pam.
en: Then Jehu gathered all the people together and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve Baal much.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma kom; n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi;.
en: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka kom yi tampima ni na zɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi chɛbili kuɣili ni na.
en: who changes rocks into pools of water and solid cliffs into flowing springs.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi liɣiri pam ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba.
en: It could be sold for a lot of money, and the money could be given to those who are poor.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma ni yɛlimaŋli ni ʒiɛyimtali a suhu ni kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpana la ni n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zaa.
en: You must serve me with a pure and honest heart, just as your father David did. You must obey my laws and do everything that I commanded you.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli polo niriba bɛn labina. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb kuli Babilɔn la zuliya. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ zaa ti kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni.
en: These were the people of the province who went up from there—from among those captive exiles whom Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar had deported to Babylonia. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, all to their own towns.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Tamiya duu maa daɣiri, ka ku niriba sɔŋ dundɔna ni, chamiya! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti ku niriba.
en: Then the Lord said, Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy! They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa ti paai yuun pihiwɛi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Kɛnan.
en: When Enosh was , he had a son, Kenan.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri a ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ. Teem a ni daa mali yurilim maŋli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda san la yɛla.
en: LORD God, dont reject your anointed one. Remember your faithful loyalty to your servant David.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Chidɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣ shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa gbibi.
en: When they came to Chidons threshing floor, Uzzah reached out to the chest and grabbed it because the oxen had stumbled.

dag: Amaa Rɛhɔbɔam daa sula Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tinsi ni la kɔŋko.
en: and Rehoboam ruled over only the Israelites who lived in the cities of Judah.

dag: Hal Naa Dauda kpambaliba zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni daa be o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo maa zaa yoli, doo maa daa pihila kuɣa labiri Dauda mini ba zaa.
en: He threw stones at David, at his soldiers, and at everyone else, including the bodyguards who walked on each side of David.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani, ka nyuri bara bɛ daazichi din galisi pam zuɣu la.
en: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.

dag: ka lihi zuɣusaa, ka siɣim ka yɛli tikpiralan maa, Efata! Di gbinni nyɛla, Yooma.
en: Jesus looked up to the sky and with a loud sigh he said, Ephphatha.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ n-tirila Taitus ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zo a nambɔɣu ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Titus, my true child in a common faith. Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our savior.

dag: Ka Matitia ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yino ka nyɛ Shallum ŋun daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ nir la bituuli la daa su mahi parilana malibu fukumsi.
en: and Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the oldest son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the flat cakes.

dag: O ni daa yɛli bia maa yɛla shɛm maa daa chɛ ka di gar o ba min o ma pam.
en: Jesus father and mother were amazed at what Simeon said about him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ na so ŋun ʒi Dauda nam ʒiishee la polo mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be tiŋ puuni ka nyɛ yi dɔɣiriba shɛb bɛ ni daa bi gbahi pahi yi zuɣu chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Listen to what the Lord says about the king who rules the kingdom that David ruled and about the people of this city, that is, your relatives who were not taken away as prisoners with you.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa pii kuɣili sa nimaani ni di nyɛ din teeri ba.
en: After Jacob had set up a large rock.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: They were in trouble, so they called to the Lord for help, and he saved them from their troubles.

dag: Iso ni daa nya ka Yisahaku niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni ka chɛ ka o kuli Mɛsopoteemia ni o ti kpuɣi paɣ nimaani maa, ka lan baŋ ni o ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni maa o daa yɛl o mi, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Esau understood that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to marry a woman from there. He recognized that, when Isaac blessed Jacob, he had ordered him, Dont marry a Canaanite woman.

dag: Nir yi zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, di tahirila yɛla na, amaa o yi zaɣisi lala niŋbu, o ni yi yɛla ni.
en: Guaranteeing the debt of a stranger brings big trouble, but the one who refuses to shake hands will be secure.

dag: Yɛlim Ammɔnnim maa, Wummiya ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: N jɛmbu duu ni daa saɣim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli la mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni kpalim dabari ni bɛ ni daa gbahi Judanim chaŋ ka yi mali suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: and tell them: You celebrated when my temple was destroyed, when Israel was defeated, and when my people were taken away as prisoners.

dag: Dan ni ti nyɛla o niriba naa kaman Izraɛl zuliyanim ni yino.
en: Dan will settle disputes for his people, as one of Israels tribes.

dag: Sɛt ni daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni ayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After the birth of Enosh, Seth lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ paag a maa. A ni tum pagɔrisigu tuma ni zuliya shɛba, ka jɛm bɛ buɣa saɣim amaŋa la zuɣu.
en: This will be done to you because you sold yourself to the nations and became defiled by their idols.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu ka di simdi ni n na be n nyɛvil ni.
en: however, you people need me here alive.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N yɛrila yinim bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, yumiya yi dimnima, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: But I tell you who hear me: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-kul niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim tiri daadamnim sahakam.
en: God does all these things for people again and again.

dag: Yinim Galɛshianim bɛn tum jɛrilim ŋɔ, timalaan ŋuni n-lee birim ya? Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla daa kahigi wuhi palɔni yimaŋmaŋ ninni.
en: You foolish Galatians! Who put a spell on you? Before your very eyes you had a clear description of the death of Jesus Christ on the cross!.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman yinim putɔɣunim ti chaŋ ti liri ŋun ka taali o yiŋa n-ku o o gom shee pa o bindoo zuɣu, ka n ku bɔhi ya o ʒim yihibu maa biɛri ka kun ya dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You evil men have done something much worse than he did. You've killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed. I'll make you pay for that. I'll wipe you from the face of the earth!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi gbaai bɛ tuuli chandi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba shɛm.
en: This was the first time the people moved their camp. They moved it the way the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Ka doo maa dii nya alaafee, ka kpuɣ o bindoo chaŋ o chandi. Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Immediately the man was well. He picked up his mat and started walking. The day all this happened was a Sabbath day.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa kari nanim nimaani, o daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu na.
en: God All-Powerful scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.

dag: Turi mini putɔɣu m-pali bɛ noya ni.
en: and they say nothing but bitter curses.

dag: Bɛn ne mi ni bɛ ni kpi, amaa bɛn kpi bɛn lan ʒi shɛli yaha. Bɛ lan ka jina ni, hal ka niriba bi teeri bɛ yɛla.
en: because the living know that they will die. But the dead know nothing at all. There is no more reward for them; even the memory of them is lost.

dag: dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun kul tumdi lala yi ni ni o chɛ ka yi saɣ o yubu, ka tin ya yiko ka yi tooi tum o ni yu shɛm.
en: God is the one who enables you both to want and to actually live out his good purposes.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa mali hal ti kurigi ka naanyi kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o ba Jɔash siliga ni Abiɛza daŋ niriba ya Ofira.
en: Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash, at Ophrah, the town of the clan of Abiezer.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o yi bɛ biɛhigu shee maa kpaŋa nti lih o, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi naai dilan ni.
en: he will go outside the camp. If the priest sees that the person afflicted with skin disease has been healed of the infection.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun daa bɔhi biɛri ti ma, ka zaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, zanimiya baalim nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tiliginsim tuun shɛli tin ya zuŋɔ; dama yi ni nya Ijipti ninvuɣ shɛb zuŋɔ ŋɔ, yi nini ku lan nya ba yaha.
en: But Moses said to the people, Dont be afraid. Stand your ground, and watch the LORD rescue you today. The Egyptians you see today you will never ever see again.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm dahin shɛli n ni daa tuui ka Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na nti be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: When they arrived, he said to them, You know how I lived among you the whole time I was with you, beginning with the first day I arrived in the province of Asia.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛdomnim daa yɛl o, Yi ku kpe ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari, yi yi niŋ lala, ti ni ŋmɛn ya tɔbu.
en: But the king of Edom answered, You may not travel through our land. If you try to travel through our land, we will come and fight you with swords.

dag: Keenan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan was the father of Sidon his oldest son, Heth.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a ma ŋun dɔɣ a labi bɛ ni daa bi dɔɣi ya tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: I am going to force you and your mother into exile. You will go to a country where neither of you was born, and both of you will die there.

dag: Ŋun daa pah ayopɔin n-su chira ayopɔin ni n-daa nyɛ Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛlɔn nira ka yi Ifriim zuliya ni na la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The seventh commander, for the seventh month, was Helez from the Pelonites and a descendant of Ephraim. There were , men in Helezs group.

dag: Faranim mabihi zaa yi je ba, di ni niŋ wula ka bɛ zɔnima ku zo ka chɛ ba? Hal bɛ yi kul kpaŋ bɛmaŋ kabo ni bɛ boli ba labisina, bɛ ku lan nya ba.
en: Even the relatives of a poor person have no use for him; no wonder he has no friends. No matter how hard he tries, he cannot win any.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo, bɛ daa piila Bɛza din be Rubin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la mini Ramɔt din be Giliad Gaad zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la ni Golan din be Bashan Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: On the other side of the Jordan east of Jericho, they set up Bezer in the wasteland on the plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Ka di tintariga bɔbili maa daa lan zaŋ nimaani n-kpa shɛli polo yaha nti ŋmaligi wulinluhili polo zoli gbini n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo hal ti paai Kiriatibaal .
en: At the hill south of Beth Horon, the border turned south and went along the west side of the hill. The border went to Kiriath Baal . This town belonged to the people of Judah. This was the western border.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisirila ti zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu.
en: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?.

dag: Deemiya tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ʒin di ni, dama mani n-zaŋ li tin ya ni yi su li.
en: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋumdi ti kparima ni kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka malaika ŋun su kum fukumsi daa bahi ba yol la.
en: And dont complain as some of them did. Because they complained, they were killed by the angel that destroys.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni nira yi yi tin shɛl ni o ni pun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ka Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli na .
en: Any Levite who wants to may come from any town in Israel to the one place of worship.

dag: Yimiya luɣilikam na ti liri ba. Yɔhimiya bɛ kambɔna. Laɣimmiya ba duhi kaman bɛ ni kpaai kawana duhi shɛm la n ku bɛ zaa. Di chɛliya ka binshɛli lan kpalim nimaani.
en: Attack it from every side and break open the places where its grain is stored! Pile up the loot like piles of grain! Destroy the country! Leave nothing at all!.

dag: Bɛ nina ku nya kulibɔna, kulibɔn shɛŋa din zɔri shiri mini bihim.
en: He will never again enjoy so much wealth— rivers flowing with honey and cream.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord said, Moses, when the king asks you and Aaron to perform a miracle, command Aaron to throw his walking stick down in front of the king, and it will turn into a snake.

dag: Ka Zifinim daa ti ka Sool sanna Gibia nti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela Hachila Zoli din mini Jɛshimɔn nin tuhi tab la zuɣu.
en: The Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah. David is hiding on Hachilahs hill, which faces Jeshimon, they said.

dag: Dama saha shɛl o ni daa nya tibiginsim mini jilima o Ba Naawuni sani la ka kukoli daa yi Zallakudura Naa Jilima Biɛhigu Shee na n-di o shɛhira yɛli, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala.
en: Jesus heard the voice of the great and glorious God. That was when he received honor and glory from God the Father. The voice said, This is my Son, the one I love. I am very pleased with him.

dag: Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni chɛ ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sakuɣa lala na ʒi n-lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: This time tomorrow I will cause a heavy hailstorm, such as Egypt has never known in all its history.

dag: N yi yɛli, N ni tam n fabila maa yɛla, ka yihi suhugarigu ŋɔ n suhu ni, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining.

dag: Chɛ ka m be din ni chɛ ka m paɣir a, ka chɛ ka a zaligunim sɔŋ ma.
en: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.

dag: O ni wuhi ba alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, bɛ ni bi niŋ ma yɛda zuɣu.
en: He will prove that they are guilty of sin, because they dont believe in me.

dag: Amaa dabiɛm daa bi gbaai naa min o kpambaliba bɛn daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ni so bee n-niŋ ba suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: But neither the king nor any of his officials who heard all this was afraid or showed any sign of sorrow.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Di lihir o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu bee o wɔɣilim, man pun zaɣis o, dama Yawɛ ŋun bi lihiri kaman ninsal ni lihiri shɛm, ninsal ŋun lihirila niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu, amaa Yawɛ ŋun lihirila suhu ni.
en: But the Lord said to him, Pay no attention to how tall and handsome he is. I have rejected him, because I do not judge as people judge. They look at the outward appearance, but I look at the heart.

dag: Yurilim mini ʒiɛyimtali n-nyɛ din gbibi naa, ka wuntitali mi nyɛ din chɛ ka o nam ʒiɛya.
en: Kindness and faithfulness protect the king; he supports his throne by kindness.

dag: Saa mini sakuɣa ni yiri zuɣusaa lurina, ka bi lan labiri zuɣusaa amaa ka mahigiri tiŋgbani n-chɛ ka bindira bimbira tɔri yirina n-zoori niŋdi bindira tiri bindiridiriba, ka niŋdi bimbira tiri bɛn biriti shɛm la.
en: Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.

dag: Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la chira ayopɔin.
en: The LORDs chest was in Philistine territory for seven months.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Ka daɣila a nyɛla naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma dunia ŋɔ ni ni n dila yɛlimaŋli shɛhira. Ka ŋunkam suhu ye yɛlimaŋli zuɣu wumdi n yɛligu.
en: Pilate said, So you are a king. Jesus answered, You are right to say that I am a king. I was born for this: to tell people about the truth. That is why I came into the world. And everyone who belongs to the truth listens to me.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam kuhi yɛli, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la luya! Di leela alizin biɛri biɛhigu shee ka leei tabizahim shia kam zaŋ tabili noom biɛɣ kam bɛn mali daɣiri biɛhigu shee.
en: He called out with a loud voice, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a home for demons and a lair for every unclean spirit. She is a lair for every unclean bird, and a lair for every unclean and disgusting beast.

dag: ka yi zani Vuhim Dabisili dali neei biɛɣu maa n-kali hal ni biɛɣ pihinu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ chi mini kawaan pala na ti mali chi mini kawana sara ti Yawɛ.
en: On the Sunday following the seventh week , you will bring a new grain offering to the Lord .

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Kaman n ni daa kul chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ titaŋa paai niriba ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka n lan yɛn chɛ ka n ni lo ba zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa alikauli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ paai ba.
en: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti suhuri piɛla, ka ti duh o ka tibig o, dama Piɛbil la amiliya lɔbu saha paaya, ka o daamiliya paɣ maa pun mali shili.
en: Let us rejoice and celebrate, and give him the glory, for the wedding day of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, wain booriba kpɛm la daa tam Yisifu yɛla ka bi teeg o yɛla.
en: But the wine steward never gave Joseph another thought—he forgot all about him.

dag: Bidɔɣirisurigu tam bɛ yɛla, ka zunzuya di ba ka bɛ nyaɣisa; ka so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛtali lurimi kaman tia la.
en: The womb forgets them; the worm consumes them; they arent remembered, and so wickedness is shattered like a tree.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul jiɣindimi biɛɣu kam ni o nya pam pahi, ka wuntizɔra mi kul tiri pini ka bi vil o ni su shɛli gbini.
en: Some people are greedy and never have enough. Good people are generous and have plenty.

dag: Mɛshɛzabɛl ni Zadok ni Jadua ni.
en: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua.

dag: Ka napɔŋ yi yɛli ni di pala nuu, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni; lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: If the foot says, Im not part of the body because Im not a hand, does that mean its not part of the body?.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Kundi wuhiya ni sokam zaa bela alahichi sulinsi ni ni di chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu puuni la tooi paai bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: But scripture locked up all things under sin, so that the promise based on the faithfulness of Jesus Christ might be given to those who have faith.

dag: Pashihur daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Maasɛya so mi yaha ni Ishimail ni Nɛtanɛl ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlasa.
en: From the descendants of Pashhur, these men: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

dag: A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, a ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ ku chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Strike them with a rod, and you will save their lives from the grave.

dag: Ti yom li bee ti di yo? Amaa ka Yisa baŋ bɛ bilikɔɣintali maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ niŋ ka yi zahindi ma? Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya.
en: But Jesus knew that these men were really trying to trick him. He said, Why are you trying to catch me saying something wrong? Bring me a silver coin. Let me see it.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Ŋun nyɛ kasi ŋɔ baŋbu tahiri tɛhi zilima na.
en: Wisdom begins with fear and respect for the Lord . Knowledge of the Holy One leads to understanding.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi zaa daa bela Dan zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their surrounding areas are the legacy for the clans of the Danite tribe.

dag: dama yɛm soli ka a ni tooi doli tuh a tɔbu, ka saawaranim pam mi chɛ ka nir diri nasara.
en: After all, you must make careful plans before you fight a battle, and the more good advice you get, the more likely you are to win.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bu jɛrigu ŋun gariti paa bee m-bu ŋun nyu dam kuli paa ŋmanila peentɔra ŋun tɔri sokam piɛma tiri ba dansi.
en: An employer who hires any fool that comes along is only hurting everybody concerned.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Someone may say, Here is the Messiah! or There he is! But don't believe it.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni gahi nuu boli zuliya kam, ka wuhi niriba shihirili; bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi maa ŋmab bɛ bɔɣuri ni na ti tin ya; ka zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi tuɣi na ti tin ya.
en: The Lord God says: I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa dabisili din pah ayi dali.
en: They marched against the army of Benjamin a second time.

dag: Tarimtali mini Yawɛ zɔbo laara nyɛla buni mini jilima ni nyɛvili.
en: Respect the Lord and be humble. Then you will have wealth, honor, and true life.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda, Yuria bi kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yuria, Pa gɔrim yɔɣu ka a yina maa? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kuli yiŋa.
en: Someone told David that Uriah had not gone home. So the next morning David asked him, Why didn't you go home? Haven't you been away for a long time.

dag: Ka di mi pala bɛn zaa yi ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaan maŋa. Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Yisahaku zuliya n-yɛn nyɛ a yaan maŋa.
en: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised.

dag: Ti mini nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa yi Siizaria na n-daa doli taba chaŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti tahi tuuli cheechi nyaandol so ŋun daa nyɛ Saipurus tiŋbia, ka o yuli booni Mneesin la yiŋa ni ti ti gbe nimaani.
en: Some of the followers from Caesarea went with us and took us to stay in the home of Mnason. He was from Cyprus and had been a follower from the beginning.

dag: Fɔntiŋ maa dunoya ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nuzaa polo din buɣisibu ti yɛn nyɛ kilomita ayi ni mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la ni ti mali.
en: These are the city exits. The north side is measured at . miles.

dag: Ka yi daa lan zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-kɔhi Giriikinim zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒi ba chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks. That way you could take them far from their land.

dag: N ku lan tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa pam, dama dunia ŋɔ naa kanna, amaa o ka n yiko.
en: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.

dag: Yawɛ n-zali ni ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka ti yo yi daalahichi samli.
en: The Lord commanded us to do what we have done today, in order to take away your sin.

dag: Ka a yihi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi din be piɛɣu puuni n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la zaɣ kpil yini mini maha din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini.
en: Take one loaf of each kind of bread from the basket.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka di gari ya; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa Nazarɛt do so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la. O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni; nyamiya bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: But the man said, Dont be afraid. You are looking for Jesus from Nazareth, the one who was killed on a cross. He has risen from death! He is not here. Look, here is the place they put him when he was dead.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa zaŋ o gɔbiga tim o nudirigu gbalipini maa polo darigi ŋoog o sua maa n-zaŋ kuhi naa maa puli;.
en: Ehud pulled out the dagger with his left hand and shoved it so far into Eglon's stomach.

dag: dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. Nyini n-nyɛ binwɔɣinli shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari a dimnima.
en: You are my place of safety, a strong tower that protects me from my enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔn sani ti yɛl o, Karimba, ŋun daa be a sani Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili yaɣili ka a di o shɛhira la baptaizirila niriba pumpɔŋɔ, ka sokam zaa kabiri chani o sani.
en: They went to John and said, Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bi niŋ yɛda suhupiɛlli zuɣu ka biɛhindi maa ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mali bindir shɛli kpe ka n ni di.
en: They still could not believe, they were so full of joy and wonder; so he asked them, Do you have anything here to eat.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi m piɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa n ni kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa na nti zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ dɔɣi bihi ka nabi.
en: I will gather the rest of my people from the countries where I have scattered them, and I will bring them back to their homeland. They will have many children and increase in number.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa bi zaɣisi ni omaŋmaŋ Bia kpi, amaa ka daa zaŋ o ti ti zaa ŋɔ, o ku zaŋ binshɛɣukam din kpalim zaa gba pah o zuɣu ti ti?.
en: He didnt spare his own Son but gave him up for us all. Wont he also freely give us all things with him?.

dag: Dama bɛ bi nyari biɛrim; ka bɛ niŋgbuna mal alaafee, ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: They are healthy. They dont have to struggle to survive.

dag: N daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka n lee bi baŋ di gbinni. Di zuɣu ka n daa bɔh o, Ndana, ka wula ka di zaa ti yɛn bahindi.
en: I heard it, but I didnt understand it. My lord, I said, what will happen after all this.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋbihi ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Pita ni daa chɛ n-shɛligi so tibili la dɔɣim bɔh o, N di bi nya a o sani tihi puu la ni.
en: One of the servants of the high priest was there. He was a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off. The servant said, I think I saw you with him in the garden.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, N ni daa be yi sani ka yɛri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la m-bɔŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim ni ni Yila litaafi ni zaŋ chaŋ n polo la daa kpami ni di zaa ha niŋ pali.
en: Then he said to them, These are the very things I told you about while I was still with you: everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the writings of the prophets, and the Psalms had to come true.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Jɔshua sani Makɛda sansan la ni ni alaafee. Ka so daa bi tooi yaar o noli yɛri shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim maa polo.
en: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.

dag: Nuhu yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbisiyɔbu saha shɛli kom ni daa di dunia maa.
en: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood came on the earth.

dag: Wain kola ŋɔ daa nyɛla zaɣ pala ka ti yi yiŋ na, ka nyam di ni chahi shɛm. Ka ti binyɛra ŋɔ mini ti namda ŋɔ gba chahila so wɔɣinli maa chandi ni.
en: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.

dag: Niriba daa tahirila bɛ zuɣu, Wariya, daɣirinim ŋɔ. Wariya, wariya, di shihiya ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa leei kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn dari ginda. Ka zuliya shɛb daa yɛri taba, Bɛ ku lan be kpe yaha.
en: Go away! Unclean! was shouted at them, Go away! Away! Dont touch! So they fled and wandered around. The nations said, They cant stay here anymore.

dag: amaa pumpɔŋɔ ti gbarigimi, ka binshɛli kani n-naɣ pahila manna shɛli ti ni kul lihiri ŋɔ.
en: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.

dag: Ka Sool daa yi kul tim Dauda luɣ shɛlikam zaa, o ti nyarila nasara, lala zuɣu ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda leei tɔbbihi zuɣulana, ka lala daa tiɣi niriba zaa nini, ka lan tiɣi Sool tumtumdiba zaa nini.
en: David went to fight wherever Saul sent him. He was very successful, so Saul put him in charge of the soldiers. This pleased everyone, even Sauls officers.

dag: Amaa nir yi yuri ka ku o kpee, yin zaŋmiya dilana sara maligu bimbini gbini n-yi kpaŋ ti ku o.
en: But if someone plots and kills another person on purpose, you should remove the killer from my altar and put him to death.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa be mɔɣu ni la bɛ daa malila Naawuni shɛhira tanti kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa wuhi Anabi Musa ni o malim li kaman o ni daa nya li ka di be shɛm la.
en: The Holy Tent was with our ancestors in the desert. God told Moses how to make this tent. He made it like the plan that God showed him.

dag: N yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la yimaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, ka pa ni m bɔrimi ni n zali ya din ni gun ya soli, amaa m bɔrimi ni yi doli din tuhi mini din viɛla n-jɛmdi Naawuni ni suhu yini.
en: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni bɛ gbaam bɛmaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bin kasi shɛŋa na ti ti ma la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: to tell Aaron and his sons, You must not bring disgrace on my holy name, so treat with respect the sacred offerings that the people of Israel dedicate to me. I am the Lord .

dag: N daa lo mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni n ni yɛn kana ti kaai ya kaari shɛl la ku nyɛla din ni tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.

dag: Yawɛ tim a a ni tum shɛm maa laara. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni so baɣiri ni a ni kana ni a ti sɔɣ ŋɔ ni ti a laara din galisi.
en: I pray that the Lord God of Israel will reward you for what you have done. And now that you have come to him for protection, I pray that he will bless you.

dag: N ni niŋ di tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ di polo la ka di nyɛ n ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi zuliya kam zaa, ka di sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni la.
en: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ŋ-ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni, Ibrahimma Naawuni ni Yisahaku Naawuni ni Yaakubu Naawuni la n-tim ma yi sanna. N yuli m-bala sahakam. Ʒiɛmani kam nim ni yɛn booni ma shɛm m-bala.
en: And God said, Tell the Israelites that you were sent by YAHWEH, the God of your ancestors—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob. This will always be my name. It is how I want the people to remember me from now on.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa tiɣi Naawuni nin la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa ka daa na bi nya Naawuni ni daa lo ba binshɛŋa alikauli la;.
en: All these people didnt receive what was promised, though they were given approval for their faith.

dag: So shɛli beni ŋ-ŋmani din tuhi nir sani, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛla kum.
en: There is a path that may seem straight to someone, but in the end it is a path to death.

dag: Dinzuɣu benya tibi kaman yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni be tibi shɛm.
en: You must be perfect—just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔni mirila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, Bɛtijɛshimɔt zaŋ hal ni Ɛbɛlishitim din be Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni la.
en: They camped by the Jordan River in the Jordan Valley in Moab. Their camp went from Beth Jeshimoth to Acacia Field.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la ni yino daa zaŋ salima lah ayopɔin din pali Naawuni ŋun be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili n-ti malaikanima ayopɔin maa.
en: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.

dag: Bɛ yi darigi ansarisimaana tibili, bɛn bi mi leerila yɛnnima, bɛ yi wuhi yɛnnim shɛli, bɛ baŋsim pahirimi.
en: When you punish a proud person who laughs at what is right, even fools will learn something. But a little instruction is enough for the wise to learn what they should.

dag: A ni daa na bi darigi n tibili la, n daa birigiya; amaa pumpɔŋɔ n dol a yɛligu.
en: Before you punished me, I used to go wrong, but now I obey your word.

dag: Babilɔn naa wum bɛ yɛla, ka o bɔɣiri ni cheei kom. Ka biɛrim gbaag o; biɛrim shɛli din be kaman paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: The king of Babylonia hears the news, and his hands hang limp. He is seized by anguish, by pain like a woman in labor.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ nimaani daanya sara maligu bimbini din daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti kɔri biŋkɔbiri tuhili m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu.
en: Solomon went there to the bronze altar in the LORDs presence at the meeting tent and offered a thousand entirely burned offerings upon it.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa kana ti nya shigbaŋ maa, shikpam daa kul tɔɣirimi, amaa so daa bi niŋ li kpar o nol ni; dama niriba maa daa zɔrila pɔri la.
en: But even when they came across the honeycomb with the honey still flowing, no one ate any of it because the troops were afraid of the solemn pledge.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim shɛb zaa bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ kali ba kaman sokam ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm la, bɛ dɔbba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaayi.
en: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was .

dag: Uzia daa lan me du wɔɣila zali Jɛrusalɛm goon gɔŋ dunɔdal la polo mini vinvamli dunɔdali ni malaika dunɔdal la polo zaa, ka mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: Uzziah strengthened the fortifications of Jerusalem by building towers at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate, and where the wall turned.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ka o daa zaŋ kpihim Yɛhudianim zaligunim mini bɛ daadiini soli kaya ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba min omaŋmaŋ naai taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti sunsuuni.
en: He canceled the detailed rules of the Law so that he could create one new person out of the two groups, making peace.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛli, Di ku niŋ lala. Nyin dee kul deemila Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni zaŋ yɛr a ŋɔ, ka di niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani, ka bɛ ku ku a.
en: But Jeremiah answered, The soldiers will not give you to the men of Judah. King Zedekiah, obey the Lord by doing what I tell you. Then things will go well for you, and your life will be saved.

dag: Dama tɔbbihi bɛn kana namdanim zaa mini bɛ binyɛra din ŋam ʒim zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: The boots of the invading army and all their bloodstained clothing will be destroyed by fire.

dag: dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na sani mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di.
en: Send them away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy something to eat for themselves.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi ba, ka o min o nyaandoliba dii kpe ŋariŋ m-baai du teeku duli chaŋ Dalimanuta tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and at once got into a boat with his disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.

dag: O daa zaŋla bɛ min o binshɛɣukam zaa duhi mɔɣili maa duli;.
en: After he sent his family across the river, he sent across everything he had.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri yi ti nya o, ŋun kum o.
en: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revenge for his relative's death as soon as he finds you.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu ku tɔŋ, amaa ŋunkam yihi li palɔni, ka zaɣisi li ni nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Those who hide their sins wont succeed, but those who confess and give them up will receive mercy.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi yaannim daa lan mo ma bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la puuni.
en: Now then, mortal man, tell the Israelites what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to them. This is another way their ancestors insulted me by their unfaithfulness.

dag: Lɛvinima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, Yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Yawɛ, paɣimiy o!.
en: Levis family, praise the Lord ! All you who worship the Lord , praise the Lord !.

dag: Dama molo yi Dan tiŋgbani polo na n-yɛra ni alɔbo yi Ifriim tiŋgbani zoli polo na.
en: A voice declares from Dan; someone proclaims disaster from the highlands of Ephraim.

dag: Asiria beni, ka di tɔbbihi zaa gbala gil li, takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa.
en: Assyria is there, with the graves of her soldiers all around. They were all killed in battle.

dag: Midian mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura zuliya.
en: Midian had five sons: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun mi din be salinim suhuri ni daa di ba shɛhira n-ti ba Shia Kasi kaman o ni daa ti ti gba shɛm la.
en: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɔnatan daa ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, Kamina ka ti chaŋ Filistia tɔbbi shɛb bɛn be yaɣili ŋɔ polo ha nim sani. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba.
en: One day Jonathan, Sauls son, said to his young armor-bearer, Come on! Lets go over to the Philistine fort on the opposite side. But he didnt tell his father.

dag: O daa zaŋla daanya mali sara maligu bimbini maa kurupooti n-zaŋ li zali di naŋgbaŋkuɣila lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai di pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: About halfway up the altar he built a ledge around it and covered the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman giŋgalanyɔri ni yi chaŋ gari ka bɛ jolijoli doya shɛm la; ka chɛ ka bɛ be kaman bɛ ni zaŋ bi so bahi ka o nini bi nya wuntaŋ la.
en: May they be like snails melting away as they move. May they be like a baby born dead, who never saw the light of day.

dag: Ka Yisa daa do ŋariŋ maa nyol ni difiɛli zuɣu gbihira; ka bɛ neeg o m-bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ n-niŋ ka kom diri ti ka a baɣa kani.
en: Jesus was inside the boat, sleeping with his head on a pillow. The followers went and woke him. They said, Teacher, dont you care about us? We are going to drown.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ yi gba me n-tamla Yisa Masia tuumba min anabinim ni daa zali tanza shɛli din gbinni kuɣ gahindili nyɛ Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ la zuɣu.
en: As Gods household, you are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone.

dag: Ka Baalihanan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛda nir la daa lihiri sinsabisi mini olivi tihi din daa be Shɛfɛla la, ka Jɔash daa su kpam ni be du shɛŋa ni fukumsi.
en: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam bɛ zaa suhuri, ka mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: He created every persons mind, and he knows what each one is doing.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, deemi n suhigu. Yawɛ, dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Because your love is constant, hear me, O Lord ; show your mercy, and preserve my life!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi.
en: You don't know what you are asking for, Jesus answered the sons. Can you drink the cup of suffering that I am about to drink? We can, they answered.

dag: Ka sokam ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-shiri ŋooi n takɔbi maa di tɔɣu ni ka ku lan labisi li su di tɔɣu maa ni yaha.
en: Everyone will know that I, the Lord , have drawn my sword and that I will not put it away.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din gari la puuni, Naawuni daa bi kahigi ashili ŋɔ wuhi ninsalinima, amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni yipa kahigi li o Shia Kasi zuɣu n-wuh o tuumba min o daanabinim bɛn be kasi la.
en: People who lived in other times were not told that secret truth. But now, through the Spirit, God has made it known to his holy apostles and prophets.

dag: O ni daa di bindirigu maa ka nyu kom naai nyaaŋa ka o daa pa buŋ nyaampara ti o ni daa bol a anab so labisina maa.
en: After the meal the old prophet got a donkey ready.

dag: Wɔr fufuhisi la ni daa ti yina, bɛ ni daa kul ŋmɛrimi ni bɛ kaai gili dunia ŋɔ. Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya kaai gili dunia ŋɔ, ka bɛ daa chaŋ.
en: As the dappled horses came out, they were impatient to go and inspect the earth. The angel said, Go and inspect the earth!—and they did.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi niŋ Yawɛ ni ti ti binshɛŋa maa lala, dama ŋuna n-daa gul ti ka zaŋ ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa kana ti liri ti maa niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: Brothers! David said. Dont act that way with the things the LORD has given us. He has protected us and handed over to us the raiding party that had attacked us.

dag: Bɛ daa wum n ni ŋuhiri shɛm, ka so kani ŋun ni maai n suhu. N dimnim zaa daa wum m muɣisigu maa yɛla. A ni niŋ shɛm maa mali ba la suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli dabisi shɛli yɛla la paana, ka chɛ ka bɛ gba be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Listen to my groans; there is no one to comfort me. My enemies are glad that you brought disaster on me. Bring the day you promised; make my enemies suffer as I do.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛli n taali, ka chɛ ka m min a labi, ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Now I beg you, forgive me for doing this sin. Come back with me, so I may worship the Lord .

dag: Dunia zaa ni kul be ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la sulinsi ni la zaa yoli, tinim mi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: We know we are from God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bahi noli ni bɛ cham ti gbaai Daniɛl na nti niŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa ni. Naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, A ni jɛmd a Naawuni so viɛnyɛliŋga maa ni fa a bahi.
en: So the king gave the order, and they brought Daniel and hurled him into the pit of lions. The king said to Daniel: Your God—the one you serve so consistently—will rescue you.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Izraɛl anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, yɛlim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! .
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce the prophets of Israel who make up their own prophecies. Tell them to listen to the word of the Lord .

dag: Lala ka naa maa daa kpi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kuli Samaria ti sɔɣi.
en: And that is how King Ahab died. Some men carried his body to Samaria and buried him there.

dag: ka kul suhiri Naawuni ni di yi nyɛ o yubu, ŋun malim soli ti ma ka m bahi ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ;.
en: in all my prayers. Im always asking that somehow, by Gods will, I might succeed in visiting you at last.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zali pateesa shɛli din yili Alikauli Adaka tooni la mi tooni. Alikauli Adaka maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuh a.
en: Place the incense altar in front of the veil that hangs before the chest containing the covenant, in front of the cover that is on top of the covenant document where I will meet with you.

dag: O ni daa kul suhiri Yawɛ maa, ka Ɛli lihir o noli.
en: Hannah prayed silently to the Lord for a long time. But her lips were moving, and Eli thought she was drunk.

dag: O daa bi chɛ ka so niŋ ba fitiina, o daa daŋ kpahi nannim zuɣuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers.

dag: O darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili. Yawɛ ku niŋ zinchili zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili darigibu polo.
en: But if you turn against the Lord , he will quickly destroy you.

dag: Ka Sool yaaŋa Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia maa daa ka Naa Dauda sanna nti lu n-gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura. Ka Dauda bol o, Mɛfibɔshɛt. Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: Jonathans son Mephibosheth came to David and bowed with his face low to the floor. David said, Mephibosheth? Mephibosheth said, Yes sir, it is I, your servant Mephibosheth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda, Yuria bi kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yuria, Pa gɔrim yɔɣu ka a yina maa? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kuli yiŋa.
en: The servants told David, Uriah did not go home. Then David said to Uriah, You came from a long trip. Why did you not go home.

dag: Yinim Samaria paɣiba bɛn ŋmɛlim be kaman Bashan naɣ shɛb bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga la, wummiya, yi nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba, ka yɛri yi yidaannima, Timiya ti wain ka ti nyu.
en: Listen to me, you cows of Bashan on Samarias mountain. You hurt the poor and crush those in need. You tell your husbands, Bring us something to drink.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣa me binwɔɣinli zali, dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni ni je shɛŋa.
en: You must not set up special stones for worshiping false gods. The Lord your God hates them.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be adaka maa luɣa ni la ni n-kpuɣiri li.
en: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.

dag: nti bi nya Yisa siliga maa ni; ka labina ti yɛli ti ni bɛ naɣ nyala malaikanim ʒii, ka malaikanim maa yɛli ba ni o neei kum ni.
en: but did not find the body of Jesus. They came back, saying they had seen a vision of angels who told them that he is alive.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli soya m-bala, ka bɛ yi yi dunia yili, shɛb ni kana ti zani bɛ zaani.
en: Everything might have been going well, but another vine will take its place.

dag: Ka nir yi yuri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa min o tɛha zaa ni o kpiɔŋ tariga, ka yur o ʒiʒiinikpee kaman omaŋmaŋ la, di gari sara malibu balibu kam.
en: And you must love God with all your heart, all your mind, and all your strength. And you must love others the same as you love yourself. These commands are more important than all the animals and sacrifices we offer to God.

dag: Bɛ yihi yɛli ni bɛ mi Naawuni, amaa ka bɛ tuma lee bi wuhi ni bɛ mi o. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim mini tipawumlinima ka ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suŋ kam tumbu polo.
en: They claim that they know God, but their actions deny it. They are hateful and disobedient, not fit to do anything good.

dag: Inhii, n suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga bela Asirianim nuu ni.
en: The Lord says, I will use Assyria like a stick. In my anger I will use Assyria to punish Israel.

dag: Di saha Dauda daa bela bɛ ni me birini gili luɣ shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa shɛb daa be Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Another time David was in the fortress, and a group of Philistine soldiers was stationed in Bethlehem.

dag: Zaŋmiya binnɛma balibu kam bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa n-yina, ka bɛ ti dɔɣi pam nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Bring every living animal out of the boat with you—all the birds, animals, and everything that crawls on the earth. These animals will make many more animals, and they will fill the earth again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai Yisa.
en: The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-yɛra, ka booni dunianim zaa bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo.
en: The Almighty God, the Lord , speaks; he calls to the whole earth from east to west.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la daa chaŋ Galili zo shɛli zuɣu Yisa ni daa wuhi ba la.
en: The eleven followers went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus told them to go.

dag: Di galisim mini di wula wɔɣilim zuɣu daa chɛ ka di viɛla, dama di nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti kpe kom pam ni.
en: It had beautiful, long branches, and its roots found water deep in the soil.

dag: Dama yi mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi yi dimnim maa, ka o chɛ ka yi di nasara.
en: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni, ka n ŋme a luhi, ka ŋmaag a zuɣu, ka zaŋ Filistia tɔbbi kpima pam niŋgbuna ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri. Ka dunia zaa baŋ ni Naawuni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni;.
en: This very day the Lord will put you in my power; I will defeat you and cut off your head. And I will give the bodies of the Philistine soldiers to the birds and animals to eat. Then the whole world will know that Israel has a God.

dag: Naawuni ni boli ba bihi, ka bɛ mali niŋgbuna mini ʒim zuɣu ka Yisa daa leei bɛ tatabo ka bɛ min o laɣim mali niŋgbun yini. O daa niŋla lala ni o kum zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim Sintani ŋun mali kum yiko la.
en: Since the children, as he calls them, are people of flesh and blood, Jesus himself became like them and shared their human nature. He did this so that through his death he might destroy the Devil, who has the power over death.

dag: N dol a zaligunim min a wuhibu, dama a mi n soya zaa.
en: I obey your commands and your instructions; you see everything I do.

dag: Buni mini azichi ni be bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam.
en: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni ŋɔ ni shɛba, amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba maa mali m-be kasi. Lala mi ka di yɛn be hal ti paai di tariga kaman Naawuni ni zali di saha shɛm.
en: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɛn yihi yili maa daɣiri ni, ŋun zaŋmi noombihi tintiins ayi mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro.
en: To cleanse the house, the priest will take two birds, cedarwood, crimson yarn, and hyssop.

dag: Naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb kɔŋko n-ni nya li, ka n ni ti zaŋ o napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ti o min o bihi, o ni ʒe Yawɛ yim ni o suhu zaa zuɣu.
en: Only Caleb son of Jephunneh will enter it. He has remained faithful to me, and I will give him and his descendants the land that he has explored.

dag: Di bi simdi ka jɛrigu mali buni pam, di mi bi simdi ni dabili su nabihi.
en: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi kana ti lihi yili maa, ka dɔro maa bi lan yɛligi pahi yili maa ni bɛ ni lab ta li maa nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun wuhimi ni yili maa nyɛla din ka daɣiri ni, dama dɔro maa naaya.
en: If, when the priest comes to look, the mildew has not reappeared after the house has been replastered, he shall pronounce the house ritually clean, because the mildew has been completely removed.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni Yawɛ bi mi bee n-teeri yi mini yi yaannim ni yi nanim ni yi kpamba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim ni daa mali maligu shɛŋa Juda fɔndi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm solɔri zuɣu la yɛla?.
en: As for the sacrifices which you and your ancestors, your kings and your leaders, and the people of the land offered in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem—do you think that the Lord did not know about them or that he forgot them?.

dag: Dama yi tam yi Naawuni ŋun tiligi ya, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe n-taɣi ya kaman tampiŋ din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛla. Dinzuɣu ka yi sa tihi ni yi jɛmdi tinzun wuna.
en: Israel, you have forgotten the God who rescues you and protects you like a mighty rock. Instead, you plant sacred gardens in order to worship a foreign god.

dag: Amaa n ni be, ka chɛ ka man Yawɛ jilima pali dunia ŋɔ zaa la zuɣu.
en: But I tell you the truth. As surely as I live and as surely as the Glory of the Lord fills the whole earth, I make you this promise:.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ammɔnnim na so ŋun yuli daa booni Nahash la daa ti lo tɔb na nti teei gili Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga la nima. Ka Jabɛshi dɔbba zaa daa yɛli naa Nahash, Chɛ ka ti min a tɔɣisi ka a zali ti zaligu ka ti jɛmd a.
en: About this time, King Nahash of Ammon came with his army and surrounded the town of Jabesh in Gilead. The people who lived there told Nahash, If you will sign a peace treaty with us, you can be our ruler, and we will pay taxes to you.

dag: Ka Naa Azaria daa me Ɛlat n-labisi li ti Judanima, o ba kum maa nyaaŋa.
en: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath.

dag: Anabi Musa zaligu daa zalila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be tibi ni bɛ nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima, amaa Naawuni pɔri din daa doli fukumsi zaligu nyaaŋa la daa zalila ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ Bia ŋun be tibi hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: The Law appoints people who are prone to weakness as high priests, but the content of the solemn pledge, which came after the Law, appointed a Son who has been made perfect forever.

dag: ka yi gba nyɛ Masia dini, ka Masia mi nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: but you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.

dag: ka mi bi simdi ni o ka Yisa sanna. Amaa ni o kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛn yɛli ka o dabili maa kpaŋ.
en: And I am certainly not worthy to come to you. Just say the word, and my servant will get well.

dag: Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: The war which had begun between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued throughout Abijah's lifetime.

dag: Ka dim pahi nyɛla: Bɛ daa lan ta n jɛmbu duu la daɣiri dindali maa, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa.
en: They came into my temple that same day, and that made it unfit as a place to worship me. They have even stopped respecting the Sabbath.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani kuli. Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda bɛ ni niŋ tuumba maa shɛm, ka o daa tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka Naa daa yɛli tuumba maa, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti lan bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: They were too ashamed to return home. When David heard what had happened, he sent word for them to stay in Jericho and not return until their beards had grown again.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Rɛkabinim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa deei yi yab Jɔnadab ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka dol o zaligunim zaa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa la zuɣu.
en: Then Jeremiah said to the Recabite family, This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: You have obeyed the commands of your ancestor Jonadab. You have followed all of his teachings. You have done everything he commanded.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali luɣ shɛli yi sansani maa kpaŋa n-chani nimaani ti damdiri yɔɣuni.
en: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.

dag: Yinim yi mali kpiɔŋ ka tinim gbarigi, ti mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka ti ni suhiri Naawuni shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni yi nya kpaŋsibu.
en: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir anahi ni, di wala zaa ni nyɛla wal suma ka ni nyɛla wumpaɣibo sara pina Yawɛ sani.
en: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Mbo mfaaŋa, bi suŋ! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ tinsi pia fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: That's fine, my good servant! the king said. Since you have shown that you can be trusted with a small amount, you will be given ten cities to rule.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa chaŋ ti lu Tapua zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ bɛnkam zaa be di ni zaŋ tabili di tintarisi tinsinima. O daa kpuɣila Tiriza zaŋ chaŋ, bɛ ni daa bi taɣ deeg o zuɣu. Ka o daa nyaŋ bɛ zaa, ka kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya.
en: Menahem then moved from Tirzah and attacked Tiphsah, all its citizens, and its neighboring areas. Because they wouldnt surrender, he attacked and ripped open all its pregnant women.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa din daa be bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-nyɛ: Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol ni Irishɛmɛsh.
en: This is the land that was given to them: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh.

dag: Di pala yinim bɛn ʒe ti sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni ŋɔ kɔŋko ka m po pɔri lɔri alikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord is making this agreement with its promises with you people, but not only with you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi lu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ ni daa nya binneen shɛb zaa; ka daa niŋ buɣim nyo fɔntin shɛŋa din daa kpalim zaa.
en: The Israelites turned back against the rest of the Benjaminites and killed them all—men, women, and children, and animals as well. They burned every town in the area.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ dari kpe chɛrubinima, n-dooi salima pa bɛ zuɣu, ka o zaŋ ba zali luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa.
en: Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made to put in the most holy place, and he covered them with gold.

dag: Ka n ni lan ti a a ni bi suhi ma shɛli gba pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni ti a azichi mini jilima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ na so m-buɣis a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ Hadadɛza ni su fɔn shɛŋa din nyɛ Tibihat mini Kun la ni nti va daanya pam nimaani. Dina ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ mali daanya ko niŋdi bini la mini daantalisi ni daanya taha la.
en: He also took a lot of bronze from the cities of Tibhath and Cun, which had belonged to Hadadezer. Later, Solomon used this bronze to make the large bowl called the Sea, and to make the pillars and other furnishings for the temple.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Izraɛl zoya polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Mortal man, he said, look toward the mountains of Israel and give them my message.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tɛha nyɛla din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu nyɛla yɔhiŋ.
en: Honest people will treat you fairly; the wicked only want to deceive you.

dag: Ka o kpee maa garigi yɛl o, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Jɔash bia Gidiɔn ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nir la takɔbi. Naawuni pun zaŋ Midiannim mini bɛ tɔbbihi ŋɔ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: His friend replied, It's the sword of the Israelite, Gideon son of Joash! It can't mean anything else! God has given him victory over Midian and our whole army.

dag: Ka Yuzaia daa nyɛ Jɔtam ba, ka Jɔtam nyɛ Ahaz ba, ka Ahaz mi nyɛ Hɛzɛkia ba.
en: Uzziah was the father of Jotham. Jotham was the father of Ahaz. Ahaz was the father of Hezekiah.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya guŋgombihi n-wa waa paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi yuhi paɣ o.
en: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.

dag: Bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi Masia tuma, ka bi deei sɔŋsim shɛli bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdib la sani.
en: For they set out on their trip in the service of Christ without accepting any help from unbelievers.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan bɔri ni o zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa ka daa zaŋ li ŋmaligi tahi la Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la yiŋa.
en: So David didnt take the chest away with him to Davids City. Instead, he had it put in the house of Obed-edom, who was from Gath.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A yuma ala.
en: Then Pharaoh said to him, How old are you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini maligumaana Abiata n-leeg o saawaranima, ka bɛ dol o n-sɔŋd o.
en: Adonijah met with Joab the son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest and asked them if they would help him become king. Both of them agreed to help.

dag: Ka buɣim daa taai bɛ salo maa sunsuuni n-di ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun garigi bɔhigu ni yɛlimaŋli nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zɔsimdi.
en: An honest answer is as pleasing as a kiss on the lips.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nɔrila tandi, ka ŋmari bilichiisi, ka tumdi bɛ puri ni tuma zaa, ka lan muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma ni di chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋ ba tom.
en: They made life hard for the Israelites. They forced the Israelites to work hard at making bricks and mortar and to work hard in the fields. The Egyptians showed no mercy in all the hard work they made the Israelites do!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋgbani ni maa puuni, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whoever touches their dead bodies will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shihi zaa;.
en: They made a covenant in which they agreed to worship the Lord , the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and soul.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi bina chɛrisichɛrisi bɛ ninni, ka ʒe bɛ yinsi nɛma, ka bili bɛ paɣiba.
en: While they look on helplessly, their babies will be battered to death, their houses will be looted, and their wives will be raped.

dag: Hal goli bi piɛli o sani gba; ka saŋmarisi mi pa bɛn ka daɣiri o sani.
en: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka o lu n-kpi nimaani Naawuni tooni, o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: But the LORD became angry with Uzzah and struck him because he had placed his hand on the chest. He died right there before God.

dag: Di simdi ka a wuhi ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ni yɛn be shɛm mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm zaa.
en: and you should teach them God's laws and show them what they must do to live right.

dag: Paɣimiya yi nuhi maa ka di yi. Chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka n nini nyari maa tumbu. Chɛliya tuumbiɛri maa tumbu.
en: Wash yourselves clean. Stop all this evil that I see you doing. Yes, stop doing evil.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yɛligu din kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yɛligu maa nyɛla lahibal suŋ molomooniba ni tahi shɛl na ti tin ya.
en: but the Lords word endures forever. This is the word that was proclaimed to you as good news.

dag: Ka Nagai daa nyɛ Maat bia, ka Maat nyɛ Matatias so bia, ka Matatias maa nyɛ Sɛmɛin bia ka Sɛmɛin nyɛ Josɛk bia, ka Josɛk mi nyɛ Jɔda bia.
en: son of Maath son of Mattathias son of Semein son of Josech son of Joda.

dag: ni a doli zaligu biɛr kasi puuni, ka ku mali galimi di ni hal ti paai ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: Obey this order without fault or failure until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔri maa daa zaŋ kawaan kara ayopɔin maa vali. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei n-nya ka di nyɛla zahindi.
en: and the scrawny ears swallowed up the full and well-formed ears. Then Pharaoh woke up and realized it was a dream.

dag: nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o pahi bilikɔɣinim ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: Then the master will punish that servant. He will send him away to be with the hypocrites, where people will cry and grind their teeth with pain.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na ti yɛli ba, Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni wuhiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bɔhimmiya li ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Moses called together all the people of Israel and said to them, People of Israel, listen to all the laws that I am giving you today. Learn them and be sure that you obey them.

dag: Yɛm shɛli yɛla n ni mali tɔɣisiri maa nyɛla Naawuni daashili yɛmsɔɣirili shɛli o ni daa zali ti jilima nyabu zuɣu hal ka na bi nam dunia ŋɔ la.
en: But we speak Gods secret wisdom that has been hidden from everyone until now. God planned this wisdom for our glory. He planned it before the world began.

dag: Piimiya zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zuliya kam puuni niriba atata ti ma, ka n tim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti chaŋchaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-buɣisi li nya, ka sab wuhi di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ su yaɣ shɛŋa yɛla zaa na ti ti ma.
en: So each of your tribes should choose three men. I will send them out to study the land. They will describe that land, and then they will come back to me.

dag: Sokam zaa kul lihir a mi, ka a tiri ba bindirigu bɛ ni bɔri li saha shɛli.
en: All living things look hopefully to you, and you give them food when they need it.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: But the LORD made Pharaoh stubborn, and Pharaoh wouldnt listen to them, just as the LORD had said to Moses.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Nyama, a yi ti paai Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, nyin tummi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa n ni niŋ a yiko ni a tum maa Firawuna tooni, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ pam, ka o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: Again the Lord said to Moses, Now that you are going back to Egypt, be sure to perform before the king all the miracles which I have given you the power to do. But I will make the king stubborn, and he will not let the people go.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Filistianima, ka ti suɣa n-do luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Ɛbɛnɛza la, ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Afɛk.
en: Then Samuel would speak to the whole nation of Israel. One day the Israelites went out to fight the Philistines. They set up camp near Ebenezer, and the Philistines camped at Aphek.

dag: Amaa ka o daa nya bɛ nandahima maa, ka wum bɛ fabila.
en: Yet the Lord heard them when they cried out, and he took notice of their distress.

dag: Paɣ yi birigi n-tum daɣiri tuma saha shɛl o ni be o yidan sulinsi ni, ka o yidan maa zilis o.
en: This is the law in cases where a man is jealous and becomes suspicious that his wife has committed adultery. The woman shall be made to stand in front of the altar, and the priest shall perform this ritual.

dag: Ka yi ti ŋmahiŋmahi li ka booi kpam niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: Crumble it into pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

dag: So di bɔr omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko sɔŋsim nyabu, amaa o bom o tab gba sɔŋsim nyabu.
en: None of you should be looking out for your own interests, but for the interests of others.

dag: Amaa miri ka a lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Bɛtɛl ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla naa sara maligu bimbini shee, ka nyɛ o nam sulinsi jɛmbu shee.
en: Don't prophesy here at Bethel any more. This is the king's place of worship, the national temple.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi yi lɔri noli, yin di zaɣiriya yi ninani kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ zaɣirila bɛ ninani ni niriba nya ba m-baŋ ni bɛ lɔri noli. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: And when you fast, dont put on a sad face like the hypocrites. They distort their faces so people will know they are fasting. I assure you that they have their reward.

dag: Ka di daa gari Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka doo ŋɔ lee niŋ mi yɛla ŋɔ, ka pa ŋun nya bɔhimbu.
en: The Jewish leaders were amazed and said, How did this man learn so much? He never had the kind of teaching we had.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zaŋ a leei zuliya pam yaba. Dinzuɣu alikauli maa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa niŋ Naawuni so yɛda maa sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa din kani be.
en: as the scripture says, I have made you father of many nations. So the promise is good in the sight of God, in whom Abraham believed—the God who brings the dead to life and whose command brings into being what did not exist.

dag: Kaman n ni kul lihiri ba ka bɔri ni n darigi tɔhi ba, ka wurim ba bahi, ka daai ba luhi, ka ku ba, ka chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba la, lala ka n ni ti guli ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ beni, ka n ti ba yaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And just as I took care to uproot, to pull down, to overthrow, to destroy, and to demolish them, so I will take care to plant them and to build them up.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Zaŋm a kpamdi ti ma pɔi.
en: Jacob said, Sell me your birthright today.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ninsalinim zaa Naawuni, ka binshɛli m-beni n-kpɛm nyaŋ ma.
en: Jeremiah, I am the Lord . I am the God of every person on the earth. You know that nothing is impossible for me.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa tim tumo ni o yim na ti yɛli Naaman ni o cham Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti mim di ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni ka o nya alaafee.
en: Elisha sent a messenger to Naaman who said, Go and wash in the Jordan River seven times. Then your skin will be healed, and you will be pure and clean.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ni o zabi omaŋ zuɣu yɛli, M bi tum birigi Yɛhudianim zaligu shɛli bee n-tum taal shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu; m mi bi tum Naa Siiza taali hal baabiɛla.
en: But Paul defended himself: I have done nothing wrong against the Law of the Jews or against the Temple or against the Roman Emperor.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin maa daa zaŋ kawaan kar ayopɔin maa vali. Ka n zaŋ li yɛli timanima, amaa ka bɛ ni so bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: and the thin heads of grain swallowed the full ones. I told the dreams to the magicians, but none of them could explain them to me.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe nti di ka nyu ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya noli ni di paɣ so maa ti sɔɣi; dama o nyɛla nabipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehu then went in to eat and drink. He said, Deal with this cursed woman and bury her. She was, after all, a kings daughter.

dag: n-zaŋ ba zali tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu suhi Naawuni ti ba.
en: The group presented them to the apostles, who prayed and placed their hands on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisili kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan boli kpe Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Niriba Kubu Vinvamli.
en: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!.

dag: Amaa n di yuya ni Naawuni yaag o noli n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: But oh, that God would speak, open his lips against you.

dag: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ shɛli din pahir ayi m-be nuzaa polo la gba simdi ka di mali dapaɣa pisi.
en: For the dwellings other side on the north, make twenty boards.

dag: Aduna bidib shɛb bɛ ni daa pii ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni ni bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi tuma maligumaana tuma duu yuya m-bala.
en: They were anointed and ordained as priests.

dag: M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini. .
en: Father, he said, if you will, take this cup of suffering away from me. Not my will, however, but your will be done.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daanfaani din nyɛ pin la n-chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.

dag: Ka Yisa daa saɣisi ba yɛli ni bɛ di chɛ ka so wum li; ka yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma ni bɛ tim bia maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: But Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell anyone, and he said, Give her something to eat.

dag: Ka Shɛla daa nyɛ Kainan bia, ka Kainan nyɛ Arifazad bia, ka Arifazad nyɛ Shɛm bia, ka Shɛm nyɛ Nuhu bia, ka Nuhu mi nyɛ Lamɛk bia.
en: son of Cainan son of Arphaxad son of Shem son of Noah son of Lamech.

dag: Amaa n ni ti deei nam maa o bia nuu ni n-zaŋ li ti nyin ŋun su zuliya pia ŋɔ.
en: I will take the kingdom from the hand of Solomons son, and I will give you ten tribes.
