dag: Ka Dauda daa bol o na ka o min o ti di ka nyu, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka o nyu dam kuli, ka di daa ti niŋ yuŋ ka o yi samban ni nayili guliba maa sani nti dɔni o bindoo zuɣu, ka daa bi kul o yiŋa.
en: David called for him, and he ate and drank, and David got him drunk. In the evening Uriah went out to sleep in the same place, alongside his masters servants, but he did not go down to his own home.

dag: Amaa bumbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi bidib tuuli kam, ka so miri ka o ti ka n sanna ni nu zaŋa.
en: But a donkeys oldest offspring you may ransom with a sheep. Or if you dont ransom it, you must break its neck. You should ransom all of your oldest sons. No one should appear before me empty-handed.

dag: Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya ha ka ti wum binyiɣira kpiŋkpama vubu damli.
en: Beyond the rivers of Ethiopia there is a land where the sound of wings is heard.

dag: ka Josɛf bia Igal daa yi Isaka zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal, Josephs son.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee m-pirig o kparibu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ bɔdua mil o shee ni.
en: So he rose from the table, took off his outer garment, and tied a towel around his waist.

dag: Tinsi maa yɛn nyɛla nir ni yɛn zo n-kuli shɛli n-yi ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri nuu ni, ka lala chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ku kpi hal ti zani salo ni ka bɛ kar o saria.
en: There you will be safe from the dead person's relative who seeks revenge. No one accused of manslaughter is to be put to death without a public trial.

dag: O daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa o ba ni daa tum la, ka o suhu daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la yim kaman o yab Dauda suhu ni daa ʒiɛya shɛm la.
en: He committed the same sins as his father and was not completely loyal to the Lord his God, as his great-grandfather David had been.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ mi ni n nya yi taali, dama m pun yɛli ya ni yi yɛla be ti suhuri ni, ka ti mini ya nyɛla zaɣ yini, di yi nyɛ nyɛvil ni bee kum puuni.
en: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaɣis o ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: So the LORDs anger burned against his people; he despised his own possession.

dag: Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm. Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka sokam yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: You heard his blasphemy. What is your decision? They all voted against him: he was guilty and should be put to death.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din pahir anahi dali ka bɛ daa laɣim Bɛraka Vinvamli ni, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣi Yawɛ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Bɛraka Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: On the fourth day they assembled in Blessing Valley, where they blessed the LORD. Thats why it is called Blessing Valley to this day.

dag: Obadia ni daa gbaai chandi, o nini nyabu yim ka o ti nya Ilaija m-baŋ o, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, N dan Ilaija, nyini m-bala.
en: As Obadiah was on his way, he suddenly met Elijah. He recognized him, bowed low before him, and asked, Is it really you, sir.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli Zarai Nyama, o nyɛla a dabili, ka a su o fukumsi; niŋm o a ni yu shɛm. Ka Zarai daa yihi Haga halibiɛɣu ka o zo.
en: But Abram said to Sarai, She is your slave. You can do anything you want to her. So Sarai was cruel to Hagar, and Hagar ran away.

dag: Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ, dama o tum alahiziba tuma. O nudirigu min o bɔɣu dim be kasi ŋɔ ti o nasara.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord , because he has done amazing things! His powerful and holy right arm has brought him another victory.

dag: Zakaria ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Zechariah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi lan ʒe piɛguliba maa nyaaŋa. N ni deei m piɛri bɛ sani, ka bɛ ku lan dihi piɛri maa, ka piɛguliba maa ku lan dihi bɛmaŋa yaha. N ni fa m piɛri bɛ noya ni, ka bɛ ku lan nyɛ bɛ bindirigu. .
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , declare that I am your enemy. I will take my sheep away from you and never again let you be their shepherds; never again will I let you take care only of yourselves. I will rescue my sheep from you and not let you eat them.

dag: O lihi ti la tinzunnima. O zaŋ ti mi kɔhi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋ laɣ shɛli yo ti zuɣu maa dira.
en: He treated us like strangers. He sold us to you, and then he spent all the money that should have been ours.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mini zuliya kam ni ti bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ lee niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ? Bɔ n-daa lee chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam lala.
en: People from other nations will ask, Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious.

dag: Dama di sabiya, Yinim Yɛhudianim zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kul ʒiɛmdi Naawuni yuli.
en: As it is written: The name of God is discredited by the Gentiles because of you .

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa duhi Jɔshua Izraɛlnim zaa ninni, ka bɛ daa lu Jɔshua sizuura kaman bɛ ni daa yi luri Musa sizuura shɛm la hal ni Jɔshua nyɛvili tariga.
en: That day the Lord made Joshua a great man to all the Israelites. From that time on, they respected Joshua just as they had Moses.

dag: Ka Yisa boli ba na ti bɔhi ba; Wula ka Sintani ni tooi kari Sintani? Ka ŋahi ba ŋaha yɛli.
en: Jesus told the people to gather around him. Then he spoke to them in riddles and said: How can Satan force himself out?.

dag: Naa ŋun ʒini saria karibu shee, o nina nyari zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Raba gooni n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa. Di saha tɔbu tuhibu tahigu ni ti tahiri dindali maa, ka zabili ti be kaman sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: So I will start a fire at the wall of Rabbah; the fire will devour its palaces, with a war cry on the day of battle, with strong wind on the day of the storm.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ti niŋ Yawɛ liɣiri pɔŋ ni. Bɛ ni daa zali n daa shɛm m-bala. Ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita maa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni.
en: Then the Lord told me, So thats how much they think Im worth. Throw that large amount of money into the Temple treasury. So I took the pieces of silver and threw them into the treasury at the Lord s Temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi gbibi n zaligunima ka dol li: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Lord said, Obey my commands; I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ninani biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛba anahi maa daa malila ninsal ninni bɛ tooni polo, ka gbuɣinli ninni be bɛ nudiriti polo, ka naɣilaa ninni be bɛ nuzaa polo, ka lan mali tɔrili ninni bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: As for the form of their faces: each of the four had a human face, with a lions face on the right and a bulls face on the left, and also an eagles face.

dag: Naawuni, labisim ti a sanna, Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛli, wuhim a kpiɔŋ kaman a ni pun niŋdi shɛm ti zuɣu la.
en: Show your power, O God, the power you have used on our behalf.

dag: Ti bɔri ni ti lan lab yi sanna. Hal man Pool maŋmaŋ kpaŋ mmaŋ gari yimyim bushɛm ni n kana, amaa ka Sintani kul guri ti soli.
en: Yes, we wanted to come to you. I, Paul, tried more than once to come, but Satan stopped us.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda pahila ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa niŋ yɛda maa zuɣu nya alibarika.
en: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni ti Yisa jilima yu shɛli maa zuɣu la ni chɛ ka sokam bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛn be tiŋgbani puuni ha ni ti gbani o tooni.
en: God did this so that every person will bow down to honor the name of Jesus. Everyone in heaven, on earth, and under the earth will bow.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa zo Dauda sani n-chaŋ ti doli Shiiba Bikiri bia maa, amaa ka Judanim daa doli bɛ naa maa ni ʒiɛyimtali n-yi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So all the Israelites left David and followed Sheba son of Bicri. But the people from Judah stayed with their king all the way from the Jordan River to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n ku lan niŋ yinim bɛ kpalim ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ kurimbuni ha niriba maa shɛm maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But now I am treating the survivors of this nation differently.

dag: Bɛ daa kpaŋsi n suhu kaman bɛ ni daa kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri shɛm; ka bɛn niŋdi lala maa simdi paɣibu.
en: Indeed theyve provided my spirit and yours with a much-needed rest. Therefore, give them proper recognition.

dag: O kul tiri ma la dansi, o karitimi doli ma kaman tɔbbia la.
en: He wounds me again and again; he attacks like a soldier gone mad with hate.

dag: Di saha ka nachimba maa daa zaŋ pini maa mini liɣiri ʒiibuyi zuɣu ni Bɛnjamin n-yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti Yisifu sani.
en: So the brothers took the gifts and twice as much money, and set out for Egypt with Benjamin. There they presented themselves to Joseph.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Darius ka ti sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tira. Naawuni ti ma suhudoo zaa!.
en: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yo Yaakubu zuliya samli, ka tiligi ba bɛn mali yaa gari ba nuu ni.
en: I have set Israel's people free and have saved them from a mighty nation.

dag: Ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: In front of him, seven healthy-looking, fattened cows climbed up out of the Nile and grazed on the reeds.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku anab shɛb zaa, tum dunia piligu ni la ha taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba.
en: So you people who live now will be punished for the deaths of all the prophets who were killed since the beginning of the world.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinima, o ni ti siɣisi ba; ka ŋunkam mi mali karimbaani ni ti nya filiŋ; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: Peoples pride will be brought down and human arrogance humiliated. The LORD alone will be exalted on that day.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia nyɛla ŋun nyandi dunia ŋɔ. Ti yɛda niŋbu mi n-nyɛ din nyandi dunia ŋɔ.
en: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa pundi dari mini kur wɔɣila ni dasara ni daantalisi ni di binzahi ni di neen kparisi zaa zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: The Merarites were assigned responsibility for the frames of the dwelling, its bars, pillars, bases, and all its equipment—all these items.

dag: Dama di naan tibisi gari teeku bihigu. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri yiriŋ maa.
en: they would weigh more than the sands of the sea, so my wild words should not surprise you.

dag: ka bɛ dii chɛ bɛ ba mini ŋariŋ maa ka dol o.
en: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-voog a yihi nuzaa polo maa katiŋ na n-kar a tahi Izraɛl zoya ni.
en: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.

dag: Kpammi bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ binyara bundaannim la jaande ni bɛ di mali karimbaani, ka mi di zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ buni din nyɛ din kul ku be sahakam ŋɔ ni, amaa ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ tahima niŋla Naawuni ŋun tiri ti binshɛɣukam ni ti mali maani ti bukaata ŋɔ ni.
en: Tell people who are rich at this time not to become egotistical and not to place their hope on their finances, which are uncertain. Instead, they need to hope in God, who richly provides everything for our enjoyment.

dag: saha shɛli n ni daa pii zuɣulaannim zali ka bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim maa la. N ni chɛ ka a nya nyee vuhi a dimnim zaa sani. M-pahi, man Yawɛ lan yɛl a ni n ni me yili ti a.
en: when I appointed leaders over my people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies. And the LORD declares to you that the LORD will make a dynasty for you.

dag: Lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali. Malaikanim ni ti kana nti gahim ninvuɣ suma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: It will be like this at the end of the age: the angels will go out and gather up the evil people from among the good.

dag: nti zaŋ li da yi suhu ni bɔri shɛli; yi ni tooi da niɣi bee piɛri bee wain bee dam din mali kpiɔŋ bee yi suhu ni kul bɔri shɛli, ka yi mini yi yinsinim ti di li nimaani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Spend it on whatever you want—beef, lamb, wine, beer—and there, in the presence of the Lord your God, you and your families are to eat and enjoy yourselves.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, dilan ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa bi gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gil li ka di dii lu zaa, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: But those who dont put into practice what they hear are like a person who built a house without a foundation. The floodwater smashed against it and it collapsed instantly. It was completely destroyed.

dag: Amaa ka tɔbbihi maa ni yino daa zaŋ kpani kuhi Yisa luɣili, ka ʒim mini kom dii zɔri yirina.
en: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.

dag: Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ka bukaata, ka Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ mi leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din bahi yoli, bɛ ni daa liri Judanima n-ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zuɣu.
en: Egypt will become desolate and Edom a desolate wilderness. This is because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they have shed innocent blood.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ ba jila yi suhuri ni, ka yi ti ku zani ni yi tɛhi pɔi ka naanyi garigi;.
en: Decide now not to worry about what you will say.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu n-ku bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: Israel will conquer her enemies and destroy them all.

dag: Di zaŋ pako so ŋun na bi paai yuun pihiyɔbu yuli pahi pakoya kalinli ni. Ka din pahi nyɛla, di simdi ni ŋun yuli ni tooi pahi bɛ kalinli ni nyɛla ŋun daa pun kulila do yino kɔŋko;.
en: To be added to your list of widows, a woman must be years old or older. She must have been faithful to her husband.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa doli ti mini Pool kuhiri yɛra, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Zallakudura Naa daba bɛn wuhiri ya tiliginsim soli.
en: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.

dag: N ni vo zoomba doli bɛ ni na ʒi n-doli so shɛŋa, ka wuhi ba bɛ ni ʒi so shɛŋa. N ni chɛ ka zibisim din be bɛ tooni leei neesim, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli. Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ n ni yɛn niŋ shɛli, ka m mi ku bahi ba.
en: I will lead my blind people by roads they have never traveled. I will turn their darkness into light and make rough country smooth before them. These are my promises, and I will keep them without fail.

dag: Ka Absalom sapashinnim daa kana yili maa ni nti bɔhi paɣ maa, Ahimaaz mini Jɔnatan be ya? Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛli ba, Bɛ du kulibɔŋ ŋɔ ha. Ka bɛ lihilihi ka bi nya ba, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Absalom's officials came to the house and asked the woman, Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan? They crossed the river, she answered. The men looked for them but could not find them, and so they returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ ni tiligi ma, ka ti zaŋ goonjɛnim ŋme m-paɣ o. Ti kul ni paɣir o o jɛmbu duu hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: The LORD has truly saved me, and we will make music at the LORDs house all the days of our lives.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; miri ka a di zalinsi; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: You know the commandments. Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others. Do not cheat. Respect your father and mother. .

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba kana ti mali Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ mali neen shɛŋa zaa;.
en: All the skilled workers among you are to come and make everything that the Lord commanded:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu ka lihi nya Ishimail zuliya sochandiba, ka bɛ yi Giliad n-taɣiri bɛ laakumnim bɛn ʒiri taansuri mini kpam ni mɛɛr, bɛ ni zaŋdi shɛŋa maani tima kuni Ijipti.
en: When they sat down to eat, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with camels carrying sweet resin, medicinal resin, and fragrant resin on their way down to Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, a ni kariti ma shɛm ŋɔ n-lee bie n-gari a ni niŋ ma shɛm maa gba. Amaa ka Amnɔn daa zaɣis o yɛligu maa wumbu;.
en: No, she answered. To send me away like this is a greater crime than what you just did! But Amnon would not listen to her;.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir anahi puuni Ziv gol ni ka bɛ daa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa.
en: The foundation of the Temple was laid in the second month, the month of Ziv, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: These are the responsibilities of the Merari clan in their service in the Tent; they shall carry them out under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

dag: Yawɛ Shia tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n sani, ka o yɛligu be n zilinli zuɣu.
en: The Spirit of the Lord has told me what to say.

dag: N goonje kumsi leela fabila, ka n yua kumsi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kumdi kukoya.
en: Where once I heard joyful music, now I hear only mourning and weeping.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Nyamiya, kuɣili ŋɔ n-yɛn di ti shɛhira. Dama di wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni tɔɣisi ti maa, dinzuɣu yi yi bi ʒe yi Naawuni maa yim, dina n-yɛn din ya shɛhira.
en: and told the people, Look at this stone. It has heard everything that the Lord has said to us. Our God can call this stone as a witness if we ever reject him.

dag: Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo, ti dimnim ni daa liri ti la.
en: What would have happened to us if the Lord had not been on our side when people attacked us?.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn kpalim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ba yuri Yisifu pam gari bɛn nyɛ o biɛyanim maa zaa maa, ka bɛ daa je Yisifu di zuɣu, ka bi tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ni suhumahili.
en: When his brothers saw that their father loved Joseph more than he loved them, they hated their brother so much that they would not speak to him in a friendly manner.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ŋunkam niŋ a naani mal alibarika!.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu dazɔhigu dali kaman agbaa saha, ka o yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, N-nyɛ yi Naa maa.
en: It was then almost noon of the day before the Passover. Pilate said to the people, Here is your king.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri be teeku kom zuɣu; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ n-tahiri maa, Yawɛ m-be ko titali maa zuɣu maa.
en: The voice of the Lord is heard on the seas; the glorious God thunders, and his voice echoes over the ocean.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli:.
en: Hezekiah turned toward the wall that faced the Temple and began praying to the Lord .

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi liɣiri pam ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba.
en: This perfume could have been sold for a lot of money and given to the poor.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zaligu sulinsi ʒiɛman ni, kul gbaai yihi bina biɛla kɔŋko, ʒim n-daa yi maani binshɛɣukam din kpalim ka di be kasi; ka ʒim yi bi yi, alahichi chɛ m-paŋ kani.
en: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti a biɛli Adɔnija ka o n-niŋ o paɣa.
en: She answered, Let your brother Adonijah have Abishag as his wife.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, yi suɣa viɛli pam. Izraɛlnima, yi doo viɛli pam!.
en: People of Israel, your camp is lovely.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul bi niŋ tuuba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun darigi bɛ tibili maa sani bee ŋ-ŋmaligi lab o sanna.
en: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.

dag: Ka naa Ivilmɛrɔdak daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣ dira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: At the kings command, a regular food allowance was given to him every day for the rest of his life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti nya ka liɣiri din be adaka maa ni zooi, naa gbaŋsabira mini maligumaaniba zuɣulana kanimina nti kal li, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nya laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-niŋ kpalansi ni lo.
en: As soon as they saw that a large amount of money was in the box, the royal scribe and the high priest would come, count the money that was in the temple, and put it in a bag.

dag: Dama o zaligunim zaa kul dola n tooni, ka n na ʒi n-zaɣis o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la gba.
en: I have observed all his laws; I have not disobeyed his commands.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Ŋun daa zo o nambɔɣu la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A gba cham ti niŋmi lala.
en: Then the legal expert said, The one who demonstrated mercy toward him. Jesus told him, Go and do likewise.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pia.
en: Menahem, Gadis son, became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Judahs King Azariah. He ruled for ten years in Samaria.

dag: Biɛŋmarisi ni daa laɣim yili yila, ka alizanda ni malaikanim zaa yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri la, a daa beni?.
en: while the morning stars sang in unison and all the divine beings shouted?.

dag: M paɣir a, dama a nam ma, ka n yɛla mali dabiɛm mini alahiziba. M mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni a tuma zaa mali alahiziba.
en: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.

dag: O ni ti mali luɣ kasi shee maa, ka mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka yo maligumaaniba mini niriba maa zaa daalahichi samli.
en: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.

dag: Amaa yi ni naɣ niŋdi zaɣ viɛl shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Yi je Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba tuma kaman man gba ni je li shɛm.
en: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ deebu la daa dii zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa wolim nya nyɔri ka di min o laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: The servant who had received five thousand coins went at once and invested his money and earned another five thousand.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛlana bee m-be kaman Iso ŋun baɣa daa ka Naawuni yɛla ni ka zaŋ o kpamdi taɣi saɣiŋmani yin la.
en: Make sure that no one becomes sexually immoral or ungodly like Esau. He sold his inheritance as the oldest son for one meal.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒe teeku duli lan piligi wuhiri niriba. Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni teeku maa ni, ka salo maa zaa daa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: Another time Jesus began teaching by the lake, and a large crowd gathered around him. He got into a boat so that he could sit and teach from the lake. All the people stayed on the shore near the water.

dag: Ka tuumba ayi maa yɛli Reehab, Biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni niŋ a ni chɛ ka ti po ni ti niŋ shɛli maa.
en: The men said to her, We wont be responsible for this pledge you made us swear.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka o sapashin so ŋun gul o la n-ʒe n-guli dunɔdali, ka niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm saha shɛli naa ni daa ka o sanna la.
en: It so happened that the king of Israel had put the city gate under the command of the officer who was his personal attendant. The officer was trampled to death there by the people and died, as Elisha had predicted when the king went to see him.

dag: Izraɛlnim tipawumli ŋmanila naɣisaa tipawumli. Yawɛ ni tooi lan dihi ba kaman piɛbil ni be mɔri pam shee shɛm la?.
en: The people of Israel are as stubborn as mules. How can I feed them like lambs in a meadow?.

dag: Di simdi ni a nya tibidarigibo a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli mini din chihiri shɛl la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You must pay for all the vulgar and disgusting things you have done. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Teemiya Vuhim Dabisili yɛla, ka chɛ ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi.
en: Remember the Sabbath day and treat it as holy.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpɛhili shee yili; ka yihiri sarikanim mi kpɛhiri yolisim suhupiɛlli ni. Amaa duŋtaariba bɛn ni bela tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.

dag: Di chɛ ka a dabili nyari saɣisibu, ka di dolibu mali laara pam.
en: His teachings warn his servants, and good things come to those who obey them.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa ti paana n-yi biɛɣu n daa bi niŋ zinchili, ka chaŋ ti ʒini n sariadibo ʒiishee ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool na.
en: So when they came here with me, I wasted no time. On the very next day I took my place on the judge's bench and ordered him to be brought in.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ binnyɔɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa mini maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa gbalipuɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: In the future, when anyone from Israel offers the ribs and a hind leg of a ram either to ordain a priest or to ask for my blessing, the meat belongs to me, but it may be eaten by the priests. This law will never change.

dag: Niriba pam beni n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra: Yawɛ, niŋm alibarika niŋ ti ni! Niŋm ti nirilim.
en: There are many who pray: Give us more blessings, O Lord . Look on us with kindness.

dag: Naawuni, kom ni daa nya a, kom maa ni daa shiri nya a, dabiɛm daa gbaai li mi, ka kɔbulli ni daa sɔhira.
en: God, the water saw you and became afraid. The deep water shook with fear.

dag: Yi nyuri piɛri maa bihim, ka yɛri bɛ ni zaŋ piɛri kɔbiri wuɣi situr shɛŋa, ka kɔriti biŋkɔb pola bɛn mali kpam. Amaa yi bi dihiri piɛri.
en: You drink the milk, you wear the wool, and you slaughter the fat animals, but you dont tend the flock.

dag: N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni zoya sunsuuni tiŋgban kuŋ ni, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina yooi vinvama ni. N ni chɛ ka kom puhigi mɔɣu ni zɔra, ka chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgban kuŋ ni na zɔra.
en: I will make rivers flow among barren hills and springs of water run in the valleys. I will turn the desert into pools of water and the dry land into flowing springs.

dag: Bɛ daa lab bɛ shɛb kuɣa ku ba, ka daa zaŋ sua m-pirigi bɛ shɛb buyiyi; ka daa zahim bɛ shɛba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba. Bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛrila piɛri mini buhi gbana chani ginda. Bɛ daa nyɛla nandaamba ni bɛn nyari muɣisigu mini nahiŋgu.
en: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ nab pam, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri filim.
en: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.

dag: Baŋmiya yi suhuri ni ni nir ni saɣisir o bidibiga shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ gba saɣisiri ya.
en: Know then in your heart that the LORD your God has been disciplining you just as a father disciplines his children.

dag: Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira.
en: I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and now they have nothing to eat.

dag: Dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumda, ka yi mi nyɛ Naawuni puu. Yi lan nyɛla Naawuni duu.
en: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building.

dag: Wula ka a be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun bi lan mi o yɛla nini, bee kaman tɔbutuhiri biiŋa ŋun ku tooi sɔŋ so maa? Amaa nyini Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be ti sani. Ti nyɛla a niriba, di zaŋ ti bahi.
en: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us!.

dag: ka Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suhi Naawuni maa nti fo ka bɛ laɣiŋgu maa shee ti gbaai dambu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kpe m-pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: After the believers prayed, the place where they were meeting shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they continued to speak Gods message without fear.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni kuhiri kuyila yili shɛli ni bee n-fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kum bɛ zuɣu, dama man yihi n suhudoo mini n yurilim din bi taɣira ni n nambɔzɔbo niriba ŋɔ ni.
en: This is what the LORD says: Dont enter a house where there is mourning; dont grieve or lament for them, for I have taken away my blessing, kindness, and mercy from this people, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii m-piri la.
en: Jesus told them still another parable: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. A woman takes some yeast and mixes it with a bushel of flour until the whole batch of dough rises.

dag: N tim ba la ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi Naawuni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi pam sani. N tim ba mi ni bɛ ti di bɛ nɛma, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba kaman soli zuɣu taŋkpaɣu la.
en: I will send Assyria to fight against the people who do evil. I am angry with them, and I will command Assyria to fight against them. Assyria will defeat them and take their wealth. Israel will be like dirt for Assyria to walk on in the streets.

dag: ka Bɔaz daa nyɛ Obɛd ba, ka Obɛd mi daa nyɛ Jɛsi ba.
en: Obed, and Jesse.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali buŋa bee nahu ka o ti lu biliga ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku chaŋ ti yaag o yomyom.
en: Then he said to them, If any one of you had a child or an ox that happened to fall in a well on a Sabbath, would you not pull it out at once on the Sabbath itself.

dag: Dama nir yi bɔri ni o yuli yi palo, o ku tumd o tuma ashilɔni. A yi tumdi tuma ŋɔ tatabo, nyin yihim amaŋ palɔni ka sokam baŋ a.
en: Those who want to be known publicly dont do things secretly. Since you can do these things, show yourself to the world.

dag: Ka a niŋgbuŋ zaa yi nɛmi hal ka zibisim biɛla ka di ni, dindina di ni nɛmi zaa kaman firila ni ne a shɛm la.
en: If you are full of light, and there is no part of you that is dark, then you will be all bright, as though you have the light of a lamp shining on you.

dag: Kamiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kuɣ nɛɔŋ shɛli ninsalinim ni zaɣisi ka lih o ka o ka buchi, amaa ka Naawuni ŋun piig o ka lih o ka o mali buchi la sanna.
en: Come to the Lord, the living stone rejected by people as worthless but chosen by God as valuable.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kumiya doo maa. Zaŋmiy o yi tiŋ tariga, ka niriba maa zaa ti pihi kuɣa lab o.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, The man must die. All the people must throw stones at him outside the camp.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ni bɛ ti boli Naa Hɛzɛkia na. Ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun mi daa su bɛ ni sab gban shɛŋa sɔŋ tuma la daa yi bɛ sanna.
en: Then they sent for King Hezekiah, and three of his officials went out to meet them: Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace; Shebna, the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, who was in charge of the records.

dag: Ka shɛb gba daa ʒi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋkpaŋ kɔɣilikɔɣili kana, ka bɛ zaa daa ti nya alaafee.
en: Even large numbers of persons from towns around Jerusalem would gather, bringing the sick and those harassed by unclean spirits. Everyone was healed.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ ka yi niŋ yɛda ni mani n-shiri nyɛ n ni yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la.
en: I am telling you this now before it happens. Then when it happens, you will believe that I AM.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni n ni wurim ba bahi katiŋa, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla;.
en: I would have destroyed them completely, so that no one would remember them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa nti ti Izraɛl naa. O ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yi paag a, nyin baŋmi ni mani n-chɛ ka Naaman ŋun nyɛ n tumtumda ŋɔ ka a sanna ni a ti tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Naaman took the letter from the king of Aram to the king of Israel. The letter said: Now this letter is to show that I am sending my servant Naaman to you. Cure his leprosy.

dag: Abija ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛrɔbɔam daa bi lan nya yaa, ka Yawɛ daa ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: Jeroboam never became strong again while Abijah lived. The Lord killed Jeroboam.

dag: N ni tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa. N suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din mali baŋsim.
en: My thoughts will be clear; I will speak words of wisdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa ni leei saɣiri maa zuɣu, n ni laɣim ya sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ sunsuuni.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: All of you have become like worthless waste. So I will gather you into Jerusalem.

dag: Du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: The length of the facade at the north entrance was one hundred fifty feet, its depth seventy-five feet.

dag: Yi wuntaŋ mini yi goli ku lan lu, dama Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam; ka yi fabila dabisa la zani tariga.
en: Your days of grief will come to an end. I, the Lord , will be your eternal light, More lasting than the sun and moon.

dag: N yiɣisirila nolɔɣu kukoli saha n kumdi niŋd a, n zaŋ n tahima niŋla a yɛligu ni.
en: Before sunrise I call to you for help; I place my hope in your promise.

dag: M bi yi alizanda ni na ni n ti tumla mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka n kana ni n ti tum.
en: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me.

dag: Goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali nyɛla chuɣu, yi yɛn ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the fifteenth day a religious festival begins which lasts seven days, during which only bread prepared without yeast is to be eaten.

dag: o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi ni o yaansi bɛn nyɛ bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa kuli Ijipti.
en: With him were his sons and his grandsons, his daughters and his granddaughters. All of his family went with him.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? Ka Naa Sool garigi yɛl o, A ni daa zali dabisi shɛli maa ni paai ka n nya ka a bi kanna, ka Filistianim mi lo tɔbu n-do Mikimash ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani maa wurindi ka chɛri ma.
en: But Samuel said, What have you done? I saw that my troops were deserting, Saul replied. You hadnt arrived by the appointed time, and the Philistines were gathering at Michmash.

dag: Baŋsim puuni ka bɛ zaŋdi neen viɛla mini azichi nɛma paani duri.
en: Knowledge fills the rooms with rare and beautiful treasures.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛ kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ nahim Yisa tuumba maa, hal ka bɔri ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa.
en: Then some Gentiles and Jews, including their leaders, hatched a plot to mistreat and stone Paul and Barnabas.

dag: Dinzuɣu, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn yɔhila yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ n-zaŋ ya labisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So tell them, I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa, ka bɛ daa kum pam.
en: When Moses told the Israelites this, they were very sad.

dag: N ni yɛli m mabi dɔbba ni paɣiba a yɛla; N ni paɣ a a jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni;.
en: I will tell my people what you have done; I will praise you in their assembly:.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Judia mini Galili ni Samaria zaa daa naanyi nya nyee vuhi ka bɛ yiko maan pahi, ka bɛ daa zɔri ti Duuma ka dol o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kalinli kul pahira, Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋsim puuni.
en: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace. God strengthened the church, and its life was marked by reverence for the Lord. Encouraged by the Holy Spirit, the church continued to grow in numbers.

dag: Ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mali yiko pam. O baŋsim galisiya yaɣi.
en: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.

dag: Ka Absalom daa bɔhi Hushai, A ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ a zo maa sani ni bahindi shɛm m-bala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi dol a zo maa chaŋ.
en: What has happened to your loyalty to your friend David? Absalom asked him. Why didn't you go with him.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi mi ni pa naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ka ti daa zaŋ ka yi sanna; Naawuni mi n-nyɛ ti shɛhiralana ni ti pala diribarilimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa limsi diribarilim maa.
en: As you know, we never used flattery, and God is our witness that we didnt have greedy motives.

dag: Binshɛli din ka buchi lan niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-nyɛ: bɛ zaŋdila bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri n-niŋdi ninvuɣ suma, ka zaŋdi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli niŋ ninvuɣ suma n-niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri. N yɛliya ni dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: Heres another thing that happens on earth that is pointless: the righteous get what the wicked deserve, and the wicked get what the righteous deserve. I say that this too is pointless.

dag: Amaa daliri shɛli zuɣu n ni chɛ a maa nyɛla m bɔrimi ni n wuh a n yiko ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia ni zaa.
en: But I have put you here for a reason. I have put you here so that I could show you my power. Then people all over the world will learn about me!.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee bo paɣa ka bɛ na bi kulis o na? Dilan labimi kuli yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so kpuɣ o paɣ maa.
en: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.

dag: Saha paaya, dabisili maa vu m-miri, ŋun dari miri ka o mali suhupiɛlli, ka ŋun kɔhiri miri ka o fabinda, dama suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn lula bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: The time of punishment has come. The day is here. Those who buy things will not be happy, and those who sell things will not feel bad about selling them because that terrible punishment will happen to everyone.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli ka dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri so shɛli ni bɛ yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani sol la dolibu ni.
en: They dont submit to Gods righteousness because they dont understand his righteousness, and they try to establish their own righteousness.

dag: Niŋmiya saani ka kparima ni ŋumbu ka di puuni.
en: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.

dag: Zɛbadia mini Mɛshulam ni Hiziki ni Hɛbɛr.
en: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Naawuni, N tum alahichi pam n ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛl mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali, dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: Then David said to God, I have done something very foolish. I have committed a terrible sin by counting the Israelites. Now, I beg you to take the sin away from me, your servant.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ bɛ tab niriba ayi maa.
en: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n niŋ ya yiko din ni chɛ ka yi no tinvura mini nɔnsi, ka lan pahi ya yiko din ni tooi nyaŋ yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani ŋɔ min o nyaaŋa zaa; ka binshɛɣu ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: Look, I have given you authority to crush snakes and scorpions underfoot. I have given you authority over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.

dag: Bɛ nyuri dam kuuna n-chani tumdi yolimyolim. Bɛ paɣila vidibo gari jilima nyabu.
en: After drinking much wine, they delight in their prostitution, preferring disgrace to honor.

dag: N ku saɣi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be m biɛhigu ni. N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn birigi tuma. M mini ba ku mali jina.
en: and will never tolerate evil. I hate the actions of those who turn away from God; I will have nothing to do with them.

dag: Ka o suhu daa gbaai Daina Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa pam, ka o daa tɔɣis o yurilim mini suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: But he found the young woman so attractive that he fell in love with her and tried to win her affection.

dag: n-daa ti yi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ kuli Antiɔk, luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni ni bɛ tum bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛli naai maa la.
en: And from there they sailed away to Antioch in Syria. This is the city where the believers had put them into Gods care and sent them to do this work. Now they had finished it.

dag: Ŋun wuhiri shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni bɔrila omaŋmaŋ jilima nyabu, amaa ŋun bɔri ŋun tim o na jilima nyabu nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka ʒiri ka o nol ni.
en: If I taught my own ideas, I would just be trying to get honor for myself. But if I am trying to bring honor to the one who sent me, I can be trusted. Anyone doing that is not going to lie.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka lɔri alikauli, ka pɔri pɔri din ka buchi, dinzuɣu saria karibu tɔhi zanna kaman mɔ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɔchaa ni bili puu ni shɛm la.
en: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ wain tihi, ka chɛ ka maligim din leeri sakuɣa luna saɣim bɛ fiig tihi wala zaa.
en: He destroyed their vines with hail and their trees with sleet.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali kuɣ viɛla zaŋ li ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa daazichi ni be luɣ shɛli, ka Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya nir la daa gul li.
en: Those who had precious stones gave them to the Temple treasury, which was administered by Jehiel of the Levite clan of Gershon.

dag: Daadam, Taainim ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba maa dunɔdaya kabisiya n-yooi yali ti ti pumpɔŋɔ. Mbo! di ni wurim doya ŋɔ zuɣu, ti ni tɔŋ.
en: Son of man, Tyre said bad things about Jerusalem: Hurray! The city gate protecting the people is destroyed! The city gate is open for me. The city of Jerusalem is ruined, so I can get plenty of valuable things out of it.

dag: N wumla galimi shɛli din tu ma, m milinsi puuni ka n nya garigibu.
en: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: But the leader said, I have obeyed all these commands since I was a boy.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa be mɔɣu ni la bɛ daa malila Naawuni shɛhira tanti kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa wuhi Anabi Musa ni o malim li kaman o ni daa nya li ka di be shɛm la.
en: Our ancestors had the Tent of God's presence with them in the desert. It had been made as God had told Moses to make it, according to the pattern that Moses had been shown.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni zaŋ o piɛma to ba; bɛ ni nya dansi ka di libigi ba.
en: But suddenly, God will shoot his arrows, and those wicked people will be hit.

dag: N nya bɛ tuma, amaa n ni tib ba. N ni wuhi ba soli, ka sɔŋ ba, ka maai bɛn be fabila ni suhuri.
en: I have seen their way of life, but I will heal them. I will guide and comfort them and those who mourn for them.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni naa yɛliya, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ kpɛhi duu ka tir o bindirigu biɛlabiɛla mini kom biɛlabiɛla hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them, The king says: Put this man in prison and feed him minimum rations of bread and water until I return safely.

dag: Ŋmahimiya gɔpiɛliga daantalis anu n-niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi n-gɔhigɔhi pateesa maa n-zaŋ li yili daantalisi maa, ka zaŋ daanya mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba anu.
en: Make gold hooks for this curtain. Make five posts using acacia wood covered with gold and make five bronze bases for the five posts.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ bindira leei tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ churi puhibu leei zana gbahi ba.
en: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla ŋmanila shigbaŋ, di nyaɣisi niriba sani ka nyɛ din tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: Pleasant words are flowing honey, sweet to the taste and healing to the bones.

dag: ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi wuhi paɣisara ka bɛ yuri bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi.
en: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.

dag: Niriba ni ti laɣim be Juda tiŋgbɔn ni mini di fɔntinsi zaa ni. Ka pukpariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu ti beni.
en: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.

dag: Bɛ chaŋ Ijipti nti bɔri sɔŋsim, ka bi niŋ ma saawara. Bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Firawuna yuli ni bɛ nya sɔɣibu shee Ijipti.
en: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zali yuma ata shɛŋa la saha daa ti paai, ka Ashpɛnaz zaŋ nachimbihi maa zaa tahi ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza sani.
en: When the time came to review the young men as the king had ordered, the chief official brought them before Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: O ni daa ti piligi maani di laasabu maa ka bɛ zaŋ do so ŋun daa di naa maa laɣ gbaliŋ samli na.
en: When he began to settle accounts, they brought to him a servant who owed him ten thousand bags of gold.

dag: Di ni sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni yɛligu mir a; hal di be a nol ni min a suhu ni. .
en: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart .

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his father, he did what was pleasing to the Lord .

dag: O ti bom yuun yini piɛbila ŋun ka daŋa m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ dabisili kam, o niŋmi li asiba kam.
en: The Lord says, Every morning a one-year-old lamb without any defects is to be burned whole as an offering to the Lord . This offering must be made every day.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ Naawuni ka pa ni nyini Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ tampiŋ ka pa ni ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: There is no God except the Lord . There is no Rock except our God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let all who worship him say, His love is eternal.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: These were Calebs descendants. The family of Hur, Ephrathahs oldest son: Shobal, Kiriath-jearims father.

dag: Mikilɔt daa nyɛla Shimiam ba. Bɛmbɔŋɔ mini bɛ malibu daa ʒimi miri bɛ dɔɣiriba Jɛrusalɛm.
en: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa bi zali saria karibu saha? Ka bɔzuɣu ka bɛn mi o na ʒi n-nya o ni zali saha dabisa shɛŋa ni?.
en: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o yiko yɛla, ka tam o ni daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni dahin shɛl la yɛla;.
en: They didnt remember Gods power— the day when he saved them from the enemy.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila ninsalinim kaya mini bɛ wuhibu ni na, ka nir yi dol li di ni ti kpalim yoli.
en: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?.

dag: O daa lan kpuɣi Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka ka o daa dɔɣi Abija mini Atai ni Ziza ni Shɛlomit.
en: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdiba, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; di bi simdi ka yi kɔhi ba kaman daba la.
en: The people of Israel are the Lord 's slaves, and he brought them out of Egypt; they must not be sold into slavery.

dag: O ni gah o nuu boli zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋa, ka vulim vuliŋga boli dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam niriba, ka bɛ zɔri yomyom kanna!.
en: Look! God is giving a sign to the nations far away. He is raising a flag and whistling for them to come. Now the enemy is coming from a faraway land and will soon enter the country. They are moving very quickly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka timaŋmaŋ kul nyuri bara yi zuɣu Naawuni cheechinim ni. Ti niŋdila lala yi ni mali ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛda niŋbu yi daalaka nyabu mini yi wahala dibu puuni la zuɣu.
en: So we tell the other churches of God how proud we are of you. We tell them how you patiently continue to be strong and have faith, even though you are being persecuted and are suffering many troubles.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka zɔri salo, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni Yisa nyɛla anabi.
en: They wanted to find a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to do anything, because the people believed that Jesus was a prophet.

dag: Di daa nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi ni, ka naa daa ʒi o kikaa saha yili ni, ka buɣim be kurupooti ni ʒe o tooni.
en: Now it was the ninth month, and the king was staying in the winterized part of the palace with the firepot burning near him.

dag: Niriba bɛn daa ʒi zibisim ni la yipa nya neesim titali; ka bɛn daa ʒi kum zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli polo la gba nya ka neesim maa neei m-paai ba.
en: Although your people live in darkness, they will see a bright light. Although they live in the shadow of death, a light will shine on them.

dag: Ka di daa gar o pam bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chani gindi tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba.
en: He was greatly surprised, because the people did not have faith. Then Jesus went to the villages around there, teaching the people.

dag: O yi mali bidibiga ka o nyɛ biyariga, ka kuri niriba.
en: But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins.

dag: Guli ma, ka fa ma bahi; di chɛ ka n di vi, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: Protect me! Save me from them! I come to you for protection, so dont let me be disappointed.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti nya a biɛyanim maa mini biŋkɔbiri maa mal alaafee, ka labina ti yɛli ma. Di saha ka o daa tim o ka o yi Hiburɔn vinvamli ni chaŋ Shɛkɛm.
en: His father said, Go and find out how your brothers and the sheep are doing. Then come back and let me know. So he sent him from Hebron Valley. Joseph was near Shechem.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Yisa daa lab Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daa mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit to Galilee, and news about him spread throughout the whole countryside.

dag: O daa kul muɣisirila sokam. Wɔɣira mini tarimba ni bundaannim mini faranim ni bilichinnim mini daba ni o dalim ba bɛ nudiriti ni bee bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: The second beast also forced all people, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to have a mark put on their right hand or on their forehead.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wuhi ma di gbinni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la wuhirila nam din pah anahi nti yɛn yiɣisi zani. Di ni ti be di ko ni nama zaa. Di ni ti dari chahi dunia ŋɔ zaa chɛrachɛra, ka no li sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: Then I was told by the one standing there: The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.

dag: Jilima mini nam yiko n-gil o; kpiɔŋ mini viɛlim be o biɛhigu shee.
en: Give honor and praise to the Lord , whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.

dag: n ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka paɣisar so yi ti kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom, ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, niŋm a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ti ma ka n nyu.
en: Here I am at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I will ask her to give me a drink of water from her jar.

dag: Kumiya o bihi bɛ ba taali zuɣu. Di chɛliya ka bɛ so ti yiɣisina ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ bee m-me tinsi zali dunia ŋɔ ni yaha.
en: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.

dag: ka zuliya kam ti laɣim zan o tooni, ka o woligi ba kaman piɛgul ni woligiri piɛri mini buhi shɛm la.
en: The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Di chɛ ka so baŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, di yi pa lala a ni kpi.
en: Zedekiah said, Jeremiah, if you tell anyone what we have talked about, you might lose your life.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya n saɣisigu; Izraɛlnima, n di yuya ni yi wum n yɛligu!.
en: Listen, my people, Im warning you! If only you would listen to me, Israel.

dag: Bɛ bela zibisim ni wuntaŋ ni, ka bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman yuŋ la.
en: They encounter darkness during the day, and at noon they fumble about as at night.

dag: dama bɛ ka dahin shɛli bini; ninvuɣ biɛri firila ni kpi.
en: Indeed, there is no future for the evil; the lamp of the wicked will be put out.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilahi pinaata maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛlah ayi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu;.
en: Offer the proper grain offering of flour mixed with olive oil: pounds of flour with each bull, pounds with each ram.

dag: amaa ka di bi ba jila o suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala nira niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paag o Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, o dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: But it does not sink deep into them, and they don't last long. So when trouble or persecution comes because of the message, they give up at once.

dag: A nuu ni bo n-nya a dimnim zaa. A nudirigu ni bo n-nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je a.
en: Lord, you will show all your enemies that you are strong. Your power will defeat those who hate you.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ gba nyɛla nɔzaɣisiriba pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka bɛ nya nambɔzɔbo kaman yi ni nya nambɔzɔbo shɛm.
en: In the same way, because of the mercy that you have received, the Jews now disobey God, in order that they also may now receive God's mercy.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Hal Musa mini Samuɛl yi di ʒe n tooni, n naan ku ŋmaligi n suhu kpa niriba ŋɔ polo. Zaŋmi ba miligi n sani n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to me, Jeremiah, even if Moses and Samuel were here to pray for the people of Judah, I would not feel sorry for them. Send the people of Judah away from me! Tell them to go!.

dag: Miri ka a vili tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba mini faranim yɔri gbibi. Bɛ yi nyɛla a Izraɛl taba bee bɛ yi nyɛla saamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi tinsi maa tin shɛl ni.
en: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.

dag: o yi bi diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛmdi Izraɛlnim buɣa, ka mi bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni bee m-bo paɣ so ŋun nya puuni ka di na bi naai.
en: He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period.

dag: Nyamiya, n timla n tumo ni o ti mali soli ti ma. Ka yi ni yuuni bɔri yi Duuma so maa ni ti ka o jɛmbu duu na libigi ya. Alikauli tumo ŋun nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa shiri kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Look, I am sending my messenger who will clear the path before me; suddenly the LORD whom you are seeking will come to his temple. The messenger of the covenant in whom you take delight is coming, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun nyɛ Babilɔn naa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa nazuɣu ŋɔ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba ni tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa n-yi nuzaa polo na ti liri Taainima.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia is the world's most powerful king, and I will send him to attack you. He will march from the north with a powerful army, including horses and chariots and cavalry troops.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins ata Naftali zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Kɛdɛshi din be Galili, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tiligiri la mini Hamɔtidɔr ni Karitan m-pahi di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu.
en: The tribe of Naphtali gave them Kedesh in Galilee. Naphtali also gave them Hammoth Dor and Kartan. In all, Naphtali gave them three towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale din ni mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and spices for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: dama ŋun nyɛ yikolana ka o yuli nyɛ kasi ŋɔ tum ma tuun kara.
en: because of the great things the Mighty God has done for me. His name is holy;.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa nahim ba pam, ka zaŋ bɛ yiko su ba.
en: Their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their power.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋun pɔra ni ŋun nyɛ tarima daŋ ni yɛligi n-leei zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Di saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka di niŋ lala yomyom. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ!.
en: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord , and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.

dag: Bɛ di ti zaŋ li kɔhi bee n-zaŋ li taɣi so dini. Bɛ di ti zaŋ tiŋgbani kasi maa taɣi ti so. Dama di nyɛla tiŋgban kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: None of it will be sold, exchanged, or transferred. It is the choicest land, because it is holy to the LORD.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa mali buni ka lan mali jilima pam, ka o daa ti bɔri paɣa Ɛhab sani ni o ti o daŋ ni so.
en: Jehoshaphat was now very rich and famous. He signed a treaty with King Ahab of Israel by arranging the marriage of his son and Ahab's daughter.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili, mani n-lan su kum ni neebu yiko; ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, hal o yi kpi gba, o ni lan neei yaha.
en: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me will live, even though they die;.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi nya yaa, biriginsim pahirimi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni nya bɛ lubu.
en: When evil people are in power, crime increases. But the righteous will live to see the downfall of such people.

dag: A ti o dimnim nasara; a chɛ ka o dimnim zaa suhuri paligi.
en: You have given the victory to his enemies; you have made them all happy.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi dimnim kana ka yi ti jɛmdi ba, ka kum mini kɔnyuri mali ya, ka gbinfini gba mali ya, ka yi kɔŋ binshɛlikam. O ni ti zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua din nyɛ kurugu pa yi nyiŋgoya zuɣu hal ti kun ya.
en: So then, you will serve the enemies that the Lord is going to send against you. You will be hungry, thirsty, and naked—in need of everything. The Lord will oppress you harshly until you are destroyed.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa daa ti yina ti zani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka Abimilɛk min o niriba maa yiɣisi bɛ sɔɣibu shee maa yina.
en: When Abimelech and his men saw Gaal come out and stand at the city gate, they got up from their hiding places.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛdɔr tooni Vinvamli wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: they spread out westward almost to Gerar and pastured their sheep on the eastern side of the valley in which that city is located.

dag: Ka bɛ zaani zuɣusaa asiba mini zaawuni kam m-paɣiri ka tibigiri Yawɛ.
en: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.

dag: n ni mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani. N ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ sani.
en: I will rejoice in the LORD. I will rejoice in the God of my deliverance.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa bah o, ka o yi Rama chaŋ la nyaaŋa. Bɛ daa lo o la zoligɔnima m-pahi bɛ ni daa gbahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-zaŋ ba kuni Babilɔn la zuɣu.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word after Nebuzaradan the captain of the special guard had released him from Ramah. He had been bound in chains there along with all the other detainees from Jerusalem and Judah who were being sent off to Babylon.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛli ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni o ka taali, dilan nyɛla niriba ni yɛn turi so, ka zuliya kam zaɣis o;.
en: Those who say to the guilty, You are innocent— the people will curse them. Nations will condemn them.

dag: Di bi tu ka maligumaana Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun mali dalinli ti mirina ni o ti zaŋ Yawɛ pina maa nyo buɣim mali sara; o ni mali dalinli zuɣu, di bi simdi ni o mirina ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any physical defects may present the food offering to me.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni nti kpihim Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima bee anabinim yɛligu; m bi kamina ni nti kpihim di shɛli, amaa n kamina ni n ti chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: Do not think that I have come to do away with the Law of Moses and the teachings of the prophets. I have not come to do away with them, but to make their teachings come true.

dag: Bɛ ni booni ba la, Bɛ ni zaɣisi anzinfa shɛli, Dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ba.
en: They are called rejected silver, for the LORD has rejected them.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa sheei lu, ka nir ku lan tooi nya li, ka bɛ kɔba din daa bi tooi nyarila yina.
en: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka n lee kul yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi Naawuni nam?.
en: Again Jesus asked, What shall I compare the Kingdom of God with?.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa ni yi yaa zaa.
en: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.

dag: N ni yɛri shɛm zabiri mmaŋ zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When people question me, I tell them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum Musa kuli Mɔabnim bɔpiɛligu maa ni hal ni biɛɣu pihita, di nyaaŋa ka Musa kuli maa kumbu daa naai.
en: The people of Israel mourned for him for thirty days in the plains of Moab.

dag: Chɛ ka o zabi niriba bɛn nyɛ tarimba zuɣu; ka fa nandaamba bahi ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ba tibili.
en: Let the king bring justice to people who are poor; let him save the children of those who are needy, but let him crush oppressors!.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti bii na, ka Naawuni chɛ ka pɔhim tulli yi wulimpuhili polo ʒiɛna, n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ kpe Jona hal ka o ti yɛn pabigi. Ka Jona daa bɔri ni o kpi, ka yɛli, N kum so o bebu.
en: After the sun was high in the sky, God caused a hot east wind to blow. The sun became very hot on Jonahs head, and he became very weak. He asked God to let him die. He said, It is better for me to die than to live.

dag: Timoti yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli, dama o tumdila ti Duuma tuma kaman n ni tumdi shɛm.
en: If Timothy comes to you, be sure that he has no reason to be afraid while hes with you, because he does the work of the Lord just like I do.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ lee nyɛ dini, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali zaashee ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: Then King David went and sat in the LORDs presence. He asked: Who am I, LORD God, and of what significance is my family that you have brought me this far?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa daa laɣimna.
en: Jesus was led off to the high priest. Then the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses all met together.

dag: Hal o ba bee o ma bee o biɛli bee o tizɔpaɣa yi kpi gba, ŋun di saɣim omaŋa; dama o ni wolig omaŋ ti Naawuni maa yɛla bela o zuɣu ni.
en: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.

dag: O kul malila Naawuni biɛhigu sahakam, amaa o daa bi tɛhi ni di simdi ni o duh omaŋa n-wuhi ni o mini Naawuni saɣiya.
en: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti nyo di biŋkpam zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman suhudoo sara maligu la din ni chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo alahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Nir yi yuri ma, o ni doli n yɛligu, ka m Ba ni yur o, ka ti ni ka dilan sanna ka ti min o ti laɣim be.
en: Jesus answered, All who love me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them. My Father and I will come to them and live with them.

dag: Saha shɛli o ni daa zali pɔhim di tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka buɣisi kom tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm la.
en: When God gave the wind its power And determined the size of the sea;.

dag: Ka bɔh o, A tɛhiya ni di bi simdi ni n zaŋ n ni su binshɛli niŋ n yubu ni nyɛ shɛm bee yi zabiri ma la nyuli n nirilim niŋbu zuɣu.
en: I can do what I want with my own money. Why would you be jealous because I am generous.

dag: Ka dansarika gula daa neei gom ni n-nya ka dunoya maa zaa yoomi, ka o ŋoog o takɔbi ni o kuhi ku omaŋa, dama o daa tɛhiya ni dansarikanim maa zaa yimi zo.
en: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.

dag: Wɔr sabila ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la daa zaŋ kpala nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la, ka wɔr piɛla ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka wɔr fufuhisi ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la mi zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: The one with the black horses is going to the north country; the white ones are going to the west; and the spotted ones are going south.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni yeei n nam nɛma ŋɔ ka taɣi nɛma ye n-chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam nɛma. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa taɣi nɛma ye, ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe. Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni bɛ bo mɔri na.
en: So the people went all over Egypt looking for straw.

dag: ka daa zaŋ a dan maa yili ti a, ka zaŋ o paɣiba ti a, ka zaŋ Izraɛl mini Juda ti a pahi. Ka dimbɔŋɔ yi di pɔra, n naan ti a din gari lala pahi.
en: I let you take his family and his wives, and I made you king of Israel and Judah. As if that had not been enough, I would have given you more and more.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bia ka kpi;.
en: Now there were seven brothers. The first man married a woman and then died childless.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, dindina o ni tooi yo yi ni zal o da shɛli, ka yo o daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bee o yi bi yo ka deeg o, dindina yin kɔhimiy o yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: but the first-born of an unclean animal may be bought back at the standard price plus an additional percent. If it is not bought back, it may be sold to someone else at the standard price.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi wuntizɔriba ni bɛ di tum alahichi, ka bɛ bi tum alahichi maa, bɛ shiri ni be bɛ ni deei saɣisigu maa zuɣu, ka a mi tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: But if you warn good people and tell them to stop sinning, and they listen to your warning and stop sinning, they will not die. In that way you will have saved your own life.

dag: Ka wula ka a bɔhi ma lala? Bɔhimila bɛn wum n wuhibu maa m-baŋ n ni yɛli ba shɛm, dama bɛ mi n ni yi yɛri ba shɛm.
en: So why do you question me? Ask the people who heard my teaching. They know what I said.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa duhi Sulemaana pam Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka lan chɛ ka o nam mali dariza pam gari na shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ o tooni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa.
en: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon.

dag: Di chɛ ka di yi a sani, gbibi li a suhu ni.
en: Dont let them out of your sight. Never stop thinking about them.

dag: Amaa bɛn ti yɛn be tiŋ maa kpaŋa ti yɛn nyɛla bahi mini baɣisi ni zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba ni buɣijɛmdiba ni bɛnkam yuri ʒiri, ka lan nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la.
en: Outside are the dogs, the drug users and spell-casters, those who commit sexual immorality, the murderers, the idolaters, and all who love and practice deception.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa be yiliguliba dundɔŋ la ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o.
en: While the guards were watching Jeremiah in the courtyard of the guardhouse, a message from the Lord came to him. This was the message:.

dag: Yi ni daa niŋ Lɛbanɔn zaɣ biɛ shɛl la ni labi lu yi zuɣu. Biŋkɔbiri kubu la ni gbaai ya dabiɛm, yi ni daa ku ninsalinima mini yi ni daa tahi damli shɛli na dunia ni ni tinsi ni ni bɛnkam be di ni la zuɣu.
en: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ n nyɛvili bebu ni zaa. N ni yili yila paɣi n Naawuni hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.

dag: A mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni; zaŋmi n nintam niŋ a luɣuluɣu ni. Bee di yɛla bi sab be a litaafi ni?.
en: You know I am very upset. You know how much I have cried. Surely you have kept an account of all my tears.

dag: Amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o zaŋ kpe Yisa sani; ka daa dula duu zuɣusaa ti chib voli n-zaŋ o min amaŋka maa tiri voli maa ni siɣisi li ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.

dag: Ka Matan bia Shɛfatia mini Pushihur bia Gɛdalia ni Shɛlɛmia bia Jukal ni Malikia bia Pushihur daa wum ni Jɛrimia yɛrila niriba maa zaa.
en: Some of the royal officials heard what Jeremiah was saying. They were Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jehucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malkijah. Jeremiah was telling all the people this message:.

dag: Naawuni zuɣu, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ puuni!.
en: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.

dag: Hur n-daa nyɛ Uri ba, ka Uri mi daa nyɛ Bɛzalɛl ba.
en: Hur's son was Uri, and his grandson was Bezalel.

dag: Chɛ ka n gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti nya zoya ni tiŋgban viɛlli din be duli maa mini Lɛbanɔn.
en: Please let me go across the Jordan River and see the good land on the other side. Let me see the beautiful hill country and Lebanon.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti liri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li, ka fa li leei timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ Tabiil bia la leei di naa. .
en: Lets march up against Judah, tear it apart, capture it for ourselves, and install Tabeels son as its king.

dag: ka o niŋgbuna ni ti do tiŋa Jɛziriil tintariga kaman saɣiri la; ka so ti ku tooi yɛli, Jɛzibɛl m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: Her remains will be scattered there like dung, so that no one will be able to identify them.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o tɔbu n-darigi li ni o kpiɔŋ zaa n-to Jɔram bɔɣusapima sunsuuni, ka piɛm maa chaŋ ti gbaag o suhu, ka o lɛb lu o chɛchɛbuŋ puuni.
en: Jehu took his bow and shot Joram in the back. The arrow went through his heart, and he fell down in his chariot.

dag: Bɛ yi darigi ansarisimaana tibili, bɛn bi mi leerila yɛnnima, bɛ yi wuhi yɛnnim shɛli, bɛ baŋsim pahirimi.
en: When someone who is conceited gets his punishment, even an unthinking person learns a lesson. One who is wise will learn from what he is taught.

dag: Naawuni, n nyɛla ŋun ka yaa ni nandana. Kam n sanna yomyom. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira, di yuui.
en: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam n sani, hal di nyaɣisi n nol ni pam gari shiri!.
en: How sweet is the taste of your instructions— sweeter even than honey!.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim nya yiko m-baŋ Masia yurilim yɛliŋ mini di wɔɣilim ni di dubu ni di ziliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.

dag: N ni yaai n noli yɛli a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na zaa yɛla.
en: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.

dag: Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa ni a kpiɔŋ tariga.
en: and you must love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your being, with all your mind, and with all your strength.

dag: ka n yɛli, n di bi zaɣisi ka m mali kpiŋkpama kaman ŋmani la. N naan yiɣi chaŋ ka vuhi.
en: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.

dag: Dama alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yɔhim ma ku ma di zuɣu.
en: Sin found a way to fool me by using the command to make me die.

dag: Yinim bɛn no n-taai nandaamba, ka nahindi tiŋgbani ŋɔ tarimba ŋɔ, wummiya.
en: Listen to me, you who trample on helpless people. You are trying to destroy the poor of this country.

dag: Bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be bɛ sani. Ka bɛn Izraɛlnim nyɛ n niriba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then they will know that I am the Lord their God. The family of Israel will know that I am with them and that they are my people. This is what the Lord GOD said!.

dag: N Naawuni maa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o ni ka n sanna; n Naawuni maa ni chɛ ka n nyaŋ n dimnima.
en: My loving God will come to meet me. God will allow me to look down on my enemies.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku lan nyɛ yi neesim wuntaŋ ni. Ka goli gba ku lan nyɛ yi neesim yuŋ. Man Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam, ka mani ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima neesim ni nɛn ya.
en: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina ti teei zani bɛ tiŋ maa tooni, ka na shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba maa mi ʒe mɔɣu ni palo ni bɛ ko.
en: The Ammonites marched out and formed a battle line at the entrance to the city, while the kings who had come remained in the countryside.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb sani maa, luɣ shɛlikam zaa bɛ ni daa be, bɛ daa saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛri ba, Yawɛ niriba m-bɔŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ yi o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Wherever they went, they brought disgrace on my holy name, because people would say, These are the people of the Lord , but they had to leave his land.

dag: Ka Siria naa ŋun liri ba n-teei gili ba maa ni niŋ ba o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka bɛ ku tooi niŋ shɛli. O ni ti chaŋ ti zani Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la ni n-deei li omaŋmaŋ yiko ni n-su zaa.
en: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.

dag: yin doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: be sure to obey all the laws that I am giving you today.

dag: Amaa hal yi yi di wahala wuntia zuɣu, yi mal alibarika. Di zɔriya ninsalinima bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.

dag: Tiliginsim mi lan ka so sani yaha, dama Naawuni bi lan zaŋ so yuli ti ti dunia ŋɔ ni ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.

dag: Nyamiya, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka n zaŋ sɔŋ yi tooni maa, kpɛmiya di ni ti deei n ni daa po pɔri zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni bɛ zuliya la.
en: All of this is the land which I, the Lord , promised to give to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants. Go and occupy it.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? A na ni nya din chihiri pam gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: God said to me, Son of man, do you see these terrible things? Come with me and you will see things that are even worse than this.

dag: M bolila nuzaa polo ninvuɣ so ka o kana. O yila wulimpuhili polo na ka nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi ma. O ni du n-tam nanim zuɣu n-no ba kaman tandi la bee kaman yaɣimɛr ni nɔri yaɣiri shɛm la.
en: I have chosen a man who lives in the east; I will bring him to attack from the north. He tramples on rulers as if they were mud, like a potter trampling clay.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛri ni bɛ jɛmdila mani, amaa ka bɛ ni yɛri shɛm ka gbinni, dama bɛ suhuri bela katiŋ ka chɛ ma. Ninsalinim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya soli ka bɛ doli jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord says: Since these people turn toward me with their mouths, and honor me with lip service while their heart is distant from me, and their fear of me is just a human command that has been memorized.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma ka n sabi li shɛm. O daa kahigi tuma maa zaa ni yɛn tum shɛm wuhi ma.
en: All of this the LORD made clear to David directly in a document, including the plan for all of the work.

dag: Amaa ka Shafan bia Ahikam daa zaŋ o zaŋsim niŋ Jɛrimia ni, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi zaŋ o ti niriba ni bɛ ku o.
en: But Ahikam, Shaphans son, protected Jeremiah and wouldnt let the people execute him.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti niŋdi ti putɔɣu, ka muɣisiri ti n-chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: The Egyptians treated us harshly and forced us to work as slaves.

dag: A yɛligu ka n zaŋ sɔɣi n suhu ni, ni di chɛ ka n ku tum alahichi a sani.
en: I keep your word close, in my heart, so that I wont sin against you.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kul wum ni Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa kpiya maa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti deeg o puu maa su.
en: At once Ahab went to the vineyard to take possession of it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kari ya bɛ jɛmbu duri ni. Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka ŋunkam ti kun ya ni tɛhi ni o tumla Naawuni yubu.
en: People will tell you to leave their synagogues and never come back. In fact, the time will come when they will think that killing you would be doing service for God.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma ni di n-tiɣi ka nyu, amaa ka kum ni kɔnyuri mali yinima. Bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli, amaa ka yinim di vi.
en: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu yi zuɣu, ka bɛ be yi sani n-gbahi yi bihi mini yi niɣi n-chɛ ka yi kalinli filim, ka yi soya bili mɔri.
en: I will send wild animals against you, and they will kill your children and destroy your livestock. They will make you so few in number that your roads will seem deserted.

dag: Jɛrigu n-yihiri suhuyiɣisili palo ni. Amaa yɛndan ŋun kul gbib li la baalim.
en: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ niriba lee nyɛ banima bee m ba zuliya mi lee nyɛ banim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n ti yɛn leei naa deemba.
en: But David said, I am not an important man from an important family. I cant marry the kings daughter.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n sa ni ku bɛ zaa ti Izraɛlnima; ka yi sa chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri napɔn jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi buɣim.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Dont be afraid of that army, because I will allow you to defeat them. By this time tomorrow, you will have killed them all. You will cut the legs of the horses and burn all their chariots.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla nini, wula ka di di yɛn niŋ wum? Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla tibili, wula ka di di yɛn wum nyom?.
en: If the whole body were just an eye, how could it hear? And if it were only an ear, how could it smell?.

dag: Nir yi be mɔpilli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli, di so ni o min o paɣa so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yili ni.
en: It is better to live in a small corner on the roof than to share the house with a woman who is always arguing.

dag: Bɔhimiya Shɛkɛmnim zaa, yi lee yuya ni Gidiɔn bidibisi pisopɔin la zaa n-sun ya bee yi paɣiya ni o bidib yino n-sun ya? Teemiya ni n nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ni yi ʒim.
en: to ask the men of Shechem, Which would you prefer? To have all seventy of Gideon's sons govern you or to have just one man? Remember that Abimelech is your own flesh and blood.
