dag: Naawuni ʒiinim maa puuni ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ nimaani nti tam zoli din du pam zuɣu, ka binshɛli daa ʒe zoli maa zuɣu nudirigu polo m-be kaman fɔntiŋ la.
en: In a vision God took me to the land of Israel and put me on a high mountain. I saw in front of me a group of buildings that looked like a city.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o bia maa, ka di chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya kul diri nam Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli leei n jɛmbu shee la.
en: I will give his son a single tribe so that my servant David will always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city that I chose for myself to place my name.

dag: Nooŋa ni siɣi zana ni ka bɛ bi bari li? Ka tɔŋ ni tooi tɔhi ka pa ni bɛ bari li mi ka binshɛɣu no li?.
en: Does a bird get caught in a trap if the trap has not been baited? Does a trap spring unless something sets it off?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be tiŋgbani maa ni ni alaafee, ka so lan kani ŋun ni kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, bɛ ni tam bɛ vi mini bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la yɛla.
en: When they are once more living in safety in their own land, with no one to threaten them, they will be able to forget how they were disgraced for having betrayed me.

dag: O ni ŋma ba luhi kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi kpaŋa ŋ-ŋmari tibɔŋ ni tihi luhiri shɛm la, ka di lu kaman Lɛbanɔn ti suma ni luri shɛm la.
en: The Lord will cut them down as trees in the heart of the forest are cut down with an ax, as even the finest trees of Lebanon fall!.

dag: Amaa n dana, o bi boli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini maligumaana Zadok ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni a bia Sulemaana.
en: But he didn't invite me or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or Solomon.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim bɔhi Ɛdomnim biɛri ti ma. Bɛ ni ti niŋ Ɛdomnim maa kaman n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ baŋ m biɛri bɔhibu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will execute my vengeance in Edom through my people Israels power. They will act in Edom according to my anger and fury, and they will know my vengeance. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka bɛnkam wum pɔri ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka tɛhi ni bɛ mali alibarika ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Ti tiligiya, hal ti ni kul doli ti tipawumli soya ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ashaara lu ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zuɣu.
en: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord 's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.

dag: Zaŋm ninvuɣ so ŋun tu ma maa yihi sansani maa kpaŋa nti chɛ ka bɛn zaa wum o ni tu ma shɛm maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa lab o kuɣa.
en: Take the one who cursed outside the camp. All who heard him will press their hands on his head. Then the whole community will stone him.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la biɛr yoli n-daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: Following the disgusting practices of the nations whom the Lord had driven out of the land as his people advanced, Manasseh sinned against the Lord .

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka o daa yɛli zaŋ kpa Juda zuliya polo, Yawɛ, deemi Juda zuliya suhigu, ka zaŋ ba laɣim bɛ niriba ni, ka ti ba kpiɔŋ, ka sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: Moses said this about Judah: Lord , listen to the leader from Judah when he calls for help. Bring him to his people. Make him strong, and help him defeat his enemies.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: Jesus said to them, Haven't you ever read what the Scriptures say? The stone which the builders rejected as worthless turned out to be the most important of all. This was done by the Lord; what a wonderful sight it is.

dag: ni Azarɛl ni Shɛlɛmia so mi ni Shɛmaria so yaha.
en: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la zuɣu; o kɔbili ni ka di yina. O nyɛla Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu toondana ni di chɛ ka o nyɛ ŋun gari binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi nyɛla n ni dihiri m piɛ shɛba, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You are my flock, the flock of my pasture. You are human, and I am your God. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ti mabihi, yimaŋmaŋ mi ni ti ni daa ka yi sanna la pala din kpalim yoli.
en: As you yourselves know, brothers and sisters, our visit with you wasnt a waste of time.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli. Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla alikauli diba ayi: Yino yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na n-dɔɣiri bihi bɛn nyɛ daba. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Haga.
en: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: King Zedekiah sinned against the Lord , just as King Jehoiakim had done.

dag: Yɛlimiya Naawuni, A tuma mali dabiɛm pam. A yiko ni galisi zuɣu chɛ ka a dimnim gbaanila a tooni.
en: Say to God, Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Yisifu niriba bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛb Ifriim zuliya la yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: From Josephs descendants there were the descendants of Ephraim, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: Amazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛhɔadan. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Amaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem, the hometown of his mother Jehoaddin.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: Nations and kings will care for you As a mother nurses her child. You will know that I, the Lord , have saved you, That the mighty God of Israel sets you free.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi bi tum daɣiri tuma, ka nyɛla ŋun ka taali, dindina di ku niŋ o shɛli, o ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: But if she is innocent, she will not be harmed and will be able to bear children.

dag: O yirimina kaman tipum la, ka lan kpi, o vuurila yomyom kaman shilinshia la, o bi yuura.
en: Our life is like a flower that grows quickly and then dies away. Our life is like a shadow that is here for a short time and then is gone.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka o gba vuhi, faashee ka o me Jɛrusalɛm zali, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa paɣi li.
en: They must give him no rest until he restores Jerusalem And makes it a city the whole world praises.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa be Yisifu sani ka niŋ o nirilim, ka chɛ ka dansarika gul maa suhu yu o.
en: the LORD was with Joseph and remained loyal to him. He caused the jails commander to think highly of Joseph.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu a yi saɣi nyin zalim zaligu ni nyin naa mini Vashiti ku lan kpe yaha; ka chɛ ka bɛ sab li pahi Pɛriʒianim mini Miidianim zaligunim ni, ka di leei din ku lan taɣi yaha. Ka a zaŋ o zaashee maa ti paɣ so ŋun so o.
en: Your Majesty, if you agree, you should write for the Medes and Persians a law that can never be changed. This law would keep Queen Vashti from ever seeing you again. Then you could let someone who respects you be queen in her place.

dag: Ka Absalom daa zo nti be Gɛshur maa yuma ata.
en: But Absalom, after fleeing to Geshur, stayed there for three years.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti ku zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa lo nia ni bɛ liri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: At that time I will destroy every nation that tries to attack Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu ka n nyɛ n ni nyɛ so ŋɔ, ka o daalibarika zaŋ chaŋ m polo pala yoli, dama n tumiya gari bɛ zaa, amaa pa mani n-tum li, Naawuni daalibarika din be n ni maa n-tum li.
en: But by God's grace I am what I am, and the grace that he gave me was not without effect. On the contrary, I have worked harder than any of the other apostles, although it was not really my own doing, but God's grace working with me.

dag: hal ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ti niŋ pali; ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa wuhi ni o ka taali.
en: Joseph was a slave until what he said had really happened. The Lord s message proved that Joseph was right.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Ijipti baŋdiba mini bukpahinim bɛn nyɛ timanim na, ka bɛ gba daa ti tum bɛ tabibi tuma niŋ lala.
en: Then the king called in the wise men and the magicians, who used their secret powers to do the same thing—.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani. Ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: Let your gentleness show in your treatment of all people. The Lord is near.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka m po pɔri ka o yɛli ma, Miri ka a kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa;.
en: My master made me give him my word: Dont choose a wife for my son from the Canaanite women, in whose land Im living.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni wɔɣ ni tab shɛm, lala ka n soya be di ko ka chɛ yi soya, ka n tɛha gba be di ko ka chɛ yi tɛha.
en: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa lee be ya? Wuhim ti a yura maa ni kpa shɛli polo ka ti bo o sɔŋ a.
en: Which way did your lover go, you who are the most beautiful of women? Which way did your lover turn, that we may look for him along with you?.

dag: M-pahi, Uzia daa lan mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu, ka bɛ piripiri ba ka bɛ kalinli dolila Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpɛm la ni daa wuhi Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la mini Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpamba ni yino la shɛm.
en: Uzziah had an army of trained soldiers. They were put in groups by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer. Hananiah was their leader. Jeiel and Maaseiah counted the soldiers and put them into groups. Hananiah was one of the kings officers.

dag: Samsin ba min o ma daa bi mi ni Yawɛ n-wuhi Samsin lala, dama Yawɛ daa bɔrila so shɛli o ni yɛn doli tuhi Filistianima. Di saha maa, Filistianima n-daa su Izraɛlnima.
en: At that time, the Philistines were in control of Israel, and the Lord wanted to stir up trouble for them. That's why he made Samson desire that woman.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka buchi, ka so bi mi bɛ yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ ni daa fiɛbi ninvuɣ shɛb yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: children of fools and the nameless, whipped out of the land.

dag: M pun saɣim Samaria mini di wuna, ka ni saɣim Jɛrusalɛm mini di binnana din be di ni gba lala.
en: I have destroyed Samaria and all its idols, and I will do the same to Jerusalem and the images that are worshiped there.

dag: dama o yuri ti zuliya ŋɔ hal ka me jɛmbu duu ti ti.
en: He loves our nation and even built us a synagogue.

dag: N yurinima, di bɔhiya biɛri yi toli, amaa chɛliya biɛri bɔhibu tila Naawuni ŋun su tibidarigibo yɛla ŋɔ, dama di sabiya ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi.
en: Never take revenge, my friends, but instead let God's anger do it. For the scripture says, I will take revenge, I will pay back, says the Lord.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a boli ma ninvuɣ suŋ? Ninvuɣ suŋ kani n-naɣ pahila Naawuni.
en: Jesus said, Why do you call me good? Only God is good.

dag: Asiba kurig awɛi saha ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu maa.
en: It was about nine o'clock in the morning when they nailed him to the cross.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni tooi lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Aŋgo ni na be bɛ sani maa, bɛ ku tooi lo noli.
en: Jesus said, The wedding guests cant fast while the groom is with them, can they? As long as they have the groom with them, they cant fast.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya shɛli di ka di yuui zuɣu ka Pool daa ti yiɣisi zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli, N yilikpɛrilaannima, yi yi di daa wum n yɛligu la ka chɛ ka ti kpalim Kriit, ti naan ku nya gamu shɛli mini ashaara shɛli ti ni nya ŋɔ.
en: Since none of us had eaten anything for a long time, Paul stood up and told the men: You should have listened to me! If you had stayed on in Crete, you would not have had this damage and loss.

dag: Ka Pool ŋahiŋga daa wum bɛ ni to jina gbaai shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti kpe tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee maa nti zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Pool.
en: But Pauls nephew heard about this plan. He went to the army building and told Paul.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni di chɛ ka n suhupiɛlli be yi ni, ka yi suhupiɛlli maa yaɣi.
en: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.

dag: Amaa hal yi ni sari li ka di daari pum dindali, ka neeri biɛɣu zoori la zaa yoli, di ku wali ka yi pɔhi li; di kul yɛn tin ya la nandahima ni biɛrim.
en: make them grow the day you plant them, and make them bloom the morning you start them. But the harvest will disappear on a day of sickness and incurable pain.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, baŋmi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali taali, dama a nyɛla yɛndana; a mi a ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm chɛ ka o zuɣu piɛlli maa kpe gballi ni ni ʒim.
en: But you must not let him go unpunished. You know what to do, and you must see to it that he is put to death.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n chaŋ tin shɛŋa gba ni ti yihi ba Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, dama di zuɣu ka Naawuni tim ma na.
en: But he said to them, I must preach the good news of Gods kingdom in other cities too, for this is why I was sent.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni, kuhimi pampam niŋ ti Duuma. Chɛ ka a nintam zɔri yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni kaman kɔpaliga la. Miri ka a ti amaŋ vuhim, di chɛ ka a nina vuhi.
en: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.

dag: N daa kul dolila o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi zaa, ka bi birig o zaligunim maa shɛli.
en: All his rules are right in front of me; I havent turned away from any of his laws.

dag: luɣ shɛli o ni daa be n-lihir o piɛ shɛb bɛn mali bihi la ni o ti leei ŋun su Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim la.
en: He took him away from the job of caring for sheep and gave him the job of caring for the descendants of Jacob—Israel, his chosen people.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti jɛm Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, saa ku mi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If any nation refuses to go and worship the Lord Almighty as king, then rain will not fall on their land.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛm saɣisigu, di ŋmanila salima nintua bee salima yɛri.
en: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni deei n noli ka gbibi n daalikauli, n ni zaŋ ya leei n dahalali niriba zuliya kam sunsuuni, dama mani n-su dunia zaa.
en: Now, if you will obey me and keep my covenant, you will be my own people. The whole earth is mine, but you will be my chosen people.

dag: Zaŋmiya gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi naŋgbambili gba lala.
en: Make loops of blue cloth on the edge of the outside piece in each set.

dag: Yi yi chɛ o dolibu, o ni lan chɛ niriba ŋɔ bahi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka yinima n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: If you reject the Lord , he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn pa a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka yi tinshee katiŋ kana a yuli din galisi ŋɔ min a yiko tuma ni a ni kul tumdi shɛlikam zuɣu, bɛ yi ti zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ zaligu yɛla. O yɛli ma, A nyɛla m bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n dɔɣ a.
en: I will announce, says the king, what the Lord has declared. He said to me: You are my son; today I have become your father.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ pala binshɛli din ka buchi yi sani, amaa di nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ nyɛvili. Di puuni ka yi ni ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli su maa ni.
en: These teachings are not empty words; they are your very life. Obey them and you will live long in that land across the Jordan that you are about to occupy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛl ni: A ku chɛ ka a ninvuɣ gahindili niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: As indeed he says in another passage, You will not allow your faithful servant to rot in the grave.

dag: N ni daa kul ŋmaligi bɛ sani, di daa bi yuui ka n nya n suhu ni yuri so pam maa. Ka n daa gbaag o mali, ka bi saɣi bah o ka o chaŋ. Ka n daa zaŋ o kuli m ma yiŋa nti zaŋ o kpe ŋun daa zali m pua duu.
en: I had just left the guards when I found the man I love! I held him and would not let him go, while I took him to my mothers house, to the room of one who bore me.

dag: ni kpa shɛli din yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni yi ni yɛn zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛl tuɣindi luɣ kasi shee la. Di simdi ka bɛ tum n ni zal a ni a tum shɛlikam zaa.
en: the anointing oil, and the sweet-smelling incense for the Holy Place. In making all these things, they are to do exactly as I have commanded you.

dag: Cham ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni, Ibrahimma Naawuni ni Yisahaku Naawuni ni Yaakubu Naawuni n-yi n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, N nini nyan ya, ka nya yi ni diri wahala shɛŋa zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Go and gather the leaders of Israel together and tell them that I, the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, appeared to you. Tell them that I have come to them and have seen what the Egyptians are doing to them.

dag: Nabɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la daa mal o wain tihi puu Jɛziriil, ka di miri Samaria Naa Ɛhab yiŋa.
en: Naboth owned a vineyard in Jezreel near King Ahab's palace.

dag: Poloya maa ni ti lir a min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa. .
en: They will jump up on you, your people, and all your officials.

dag: m-balind o yɛra, M bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi yɛn kpi. Kamina nti zaŋ a nuhi pa o zuɣu ka o kpaŋ n-lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: and started begging him for help. He said, My little daughter is about to die! Please come and touch her, so she will get well and live.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the word of the Lord came to me.

dag: O daa nya o la tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka lan nya o tiŋgban nɛli din ka buchi ni. O leei bintaɣirigu taɣ o. O gul o mi kaman o nimbil biɛlim la.
en: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.

dag: Amaa ka Naomi yɛli ba, M bihi, labimiya kuli. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔri ni yi doli ma kuli? Yi tɛhiya ni n ni lan tooi dɔɣi bidibisi yaha ka yi kuli ba?.
en: Naomi replied, Turn back, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Will there again be sons in my womb, that they would be husbands for you?.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa be nimaani ka di niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk daa ti lihi takɔro ni nya ka Yisahaku diɛmd o paɣ Ribɛka.
en: When Isaac had been there for some time, King Abimelech looked down from his window and saw Isaac and Rebecca making love.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋ o mam maa yihi ti ti ba; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o goli yuŋ maa zaa hal ti neei biɛɣu. Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ zaŋ o bahi ka o chaŋ.
en: The men refused to listen, so the Levite grabbed his wife and shoved her outside. The men raped her and abused her all night long. Finally, they let her go just before sunrise.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa chɛbis o deemba maa, ka o lab o ya.
en: Then Moses said good-bye to his father-in-law, and Jethro went back to his own country.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zooi yomyom kaman kuliga ni mɔri la, ka lan zooi yomyom kaman mo shɛŋa din ʒe baa din kom zɔri ni la.
en: They will sprout like grass in the spring and grow like trees by streams of water.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o zali ka yɛl o, Yiɣisima! Man gba kul nyɛla ninsala kaman nyin la.
en: But Peter made him rise. Stand up, he said, I myself am only a man.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti lab bɛ yilikpɛrili na ka bɛ bɔh o yɛtɔɣ yini maa gbinni yaha.
en: Inside the house, the disciples asked him again about this.

dag: A chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi n sani guui, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m piɛri leela biŋgbahira ni gbahiri shɛba, ka leei mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu, piɛgul ni kani zuɣu. M piɛguliba maa bi bo m piɛri maa shee, amaa ka lee dihirila bɛmaŋa ka bi dihiri m piɛri maa.
en: This is what the LORD God says: As surely as I live, without a shepherd, my flock became prey. My flock became food for all the wild animals. My shepherds didnt seek out my flock. They tended themselves, but they didnt tend my flock.

dag: Amaa nir yi di wahala la o ni nyɛ Kristiɛn zuɣu, ŋun di chɛ ka vi mal o, amaa ŋun naɣ paɣimila Naawuni bɛ ni zaŋ Masia yuli pa o yupaa la zuɣu.
en: But if you suffer because you are a Christ-follower, dont be ashamed. You should praise God for that name.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi li bɛ nuhi ni n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei Maligumaana leebu sara maligu din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: Next Moses took this out of their hands and completely burned it on the altar, along with the entirely burned offering. This was an ordination offering for a soothing smell; it was a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Ka a yi lan ko puu tiŋgbani maa ni, di bindira ku lan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. A ni leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: When you try to farm the land, it won't produce anything for you. From now on, you'll be without a home, and you'll spend the rest of your life wandering from place to place.

dag: dama yi mi ni buɣisibu shɛli din buɣisiri yi yɛda niŋbu chɛmi ka yi niŋdi ania.
en: After all, you know that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya nyaŋ ti, amaa ka a chɛ li paŋ ti.
en: When our sins become too heavy for us, you wipe them away.

dag: ka yɛli, Nyin Sintani bia ŋɔ, nyin ŋun nyɛ wuntia tuuni kam dima, ka yɔhiŋgu mini bilikɔnsi tuma pal a kɔbili ni ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun kul kpaŋd amaŋ ni a zaŋ ti Duuma yɛlimaŋli soya leei ʒiri.
en: said, You are a deceiver and trickster! You devil! You attack anything that is right! Will you never stop twisting the straight ways of the Lord into crooked paths?.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, N zahindi maa puuni, n daa ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli;.
en: The king said, I dreamed that I was standing on the bank of the Nile.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini ba lo alikauli bee n-lo bɛ buɣa la alikauli.
en: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni alikauli suɣili maa ni.
en: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord 's sacred tent.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naftali zuliya paya. Naftali niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛnan bia Ahira.
en: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its , troops.

dag: Bɛna nti yɛn be laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tooni n-tumdi tuma tir o mini niriba maa zaa ka tumdi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la gba tuma.
en: The Levites will help him when he serves at the Meeting Tent. And they will help all the Israelites when they come to worship at the Holy Tent.

dag: Gooni maa ni daa me n-naai, ka m mali pununima n-kpɛhi di dunoya la zaa saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa pii dunɔguliba mini yiliyiiniba ni Lɛvinim n-ti ba bɛ tuma ni.
en: After the wall had been rebuilt and the gates hung, then the temple guards, the singers, and the other Levites were assigned their work.

dag: Yi yi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, o ni niŋ alibarikanim ŋɔ zaa niŋ yi ni.
en: If you will obey the Lord your God, all these blessings will come to you and be yours:.

dag: Nabipuɣiŋga, a naba viɛli namda ni pam! A gbalipina bela polipoli kaman nyiŋgokor shɛli tuumbaŋda ni mali.
en: Princess, your feet are beautiful in those sandals. The curves of your thighs are like jewelry made by an artist.

dag: Ti yi kul tumd alahichi milinsi puuni, ti ni baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛl la nyaaŋa, sara maligu shɛli lan kani din ni kpihim ti daalahichi.
en: If we make the decision to sin after we receive the knowledge of the truth, there isnt a sacrifice for sins left any longer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ gili Mɔab tintarisi; ka fabila yɛtɔɣa daa tin ti to Ɛgilaimnim mini Bɛrilimnima.
en: Everywhere at Moab's borders the sound of crying is heard. It is heard at the towns of Eglaim and Beerelim.

dag: A chɛ ka n fabila leei waa. A piligi buɣu n zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: You have changed my sadness into a joyful dance; you have taken away my sorrow and surrounded me with joy.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o paɣa bee o mabi dɔbba bee o ba min o mabihi Naawuni nam zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, You can be sure that anyone who gives up home or wife or brothers or family or children because of God's kingdom.

dag: Kpihimmi alahichinim birili dunia ni, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: May sinners be destroyed from the earth; may the wicked be no more. Praise the Lord , my soul! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni.
en: Because we have this hope, we are very bold.

dag: Ŋuna n-kuri nabihi, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zɔri dabiɛm.
en: he humbles proud princes and terrifies great kings.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ zali ŋun ka taali samli bee ka bɛ fiɛbi kpambaliba bɛ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: It is wrong to punish an innocent person or attack leaders for doing what is right.

dag: ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa tam di zuɣu; ka Ahio daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: Uzzah was beside Gods chest while Ahio was walking in front of it.

dag: ka ku lan doli Yɛhudianim kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli la mini ninsalinim zaligunima din nyɛ bɛn zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli ni zali shɛl la.
en: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa lan yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl sapashin kpamba ka n ta daɣiri ŋɔ. Bomiya do so na ka m min o ti tuhi.
en: Here and now I challenge Israel's whole army! Choose someone to fight me!.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ o daŋ niriba mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi zaa ʒili nyaɣil o m-pahi lahi balibu kam, din nyɛ pipihi zaŋ tabili lahi ni duɣ bihi zaa.
en: All the honored and important things of his fathers house will hang on him. All the adults and little children will depend on him. They will be like little dishes and big water bottles hanging on him.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Baɣisimiya fiig tia wala na nti ʒe o bintɔrigu maa ka o nya alaafee.
en: Then Isaiah said to the king's servants, Bring some mashed figs and place them on the king's open sore. He will then get well.

dag: Lala n-nyɛn ya. Yi ŋmanila wuntizɔriba niriba sani, amaa ka bilikɔnsi mini tuumbiɛri lee pali yi suhuri ni.
en: In the same way, on the outside you appear good to everybody, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and sins.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa yɛn niŋ la saha daa ti paai, ka bindira maa daa shiri niŋ pam.
en: During the seven years of abundance, the land produced plentifully.

dag: Yi yi baŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ka dol li, yi ni nya alibarika.
en: If you know these things, great blessings will be yours if you do them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: The total number of Israelite men listed was .

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛman ni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word during the rule of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son.

dag: Di saha ka Ishibibɛnɔb ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumya zuliya, ka o kpani tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata ni pirigili, ka takɔb palli lo o sheeni la daa tɛhi ni o ni tooi ku Dauda.
en: Ishbi-Benob was one of the giants. His spear weighed over pounds. He put on new armor and thought he would be able to kill David.

dag: Ka yi niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni bi baptaizi yi ni so maa zuɣu, naɣ gbaai yihila Krispus mini Gaiɔs kɔŋko.
en: I am thankful that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.

dag: Ka o daa bahi niriba maa dabisi shɛli din pahi daba anii dali. Ka bɛ daa paɣi naa, ka kuli bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛŋa niŋ o dabili Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: The next day Solomon told the people to go home. All the people thanked the king, said goodbye, and went home. They were happy because of all the good things that the Lord had done for David his servant and for his people Israel.

dag: Ŋunkam di ʒiri shɛhira ni nya tibidarigibo, ka ʒirilan ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: A witness who lies will be punished; that liar will not escape.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake, Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judahili ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu ŋɔ wumda.
en: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.

dag: Dama a yihi ma muɣisigu kam ni, ka chɛ ka n nini nya n dimnim nasara kɔŋbu.
en: and because God has delivered me from every distress. My eyes have seen my enemies defeat.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ chɛ ka Naawuni yɛligu bi tumdi di tuma yi ni, yi yaannim kal shɛŋa yi ni mali wuhiri niriba la zuɣu. Ka yi lan tumdi tuun shɛŋa din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnim pam.
en: So you are teaching that it is not important to do what God said. You think it is more important to follow those traditions you have, which you pass on to others. And you do many things like that.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ ni dabisi shɛli din paya dali zaa n-gbahi kɔrinsi maa; ŋun daa bi gbahi ba pam ni daa gbahi shɛb tibisim daa bi pooi kilɔgiram ayi ni biɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔŋ yɛrigi gili suɣa maa shee zaa.
en: They went out and gathered quail all that day and all that night. And they gathered quail all the next day too! The smallest amount anyone gathered was bushels. Then the people spread the quail meat all around the camp to dry in the sun.

dag: Pa sokam zaa n-daa nya o, naɣila Naawuni ni daa pii tinim shɛb leei shɛhiranim maa n-daa nya o, ka ti min o laɣim di ka nyu o ni daa neei kum ni maa nyaaŋa.
en: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka nir lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: His disciples asked him, Where in this desert can anyone find enough food to feed all these people.

dag: Mahalalɛl daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Mahalalel lived years, and he died.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, A tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri zaa lu n-kpi n-doya.
en: When you threatened them, O God of Jacob, the horses and their riders fell dead.

dag: Yi mi di zaŋya yimaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni la bee m-boli bɛ buɣa la yuya bee m-po ba bee n-jɛm ba bee n-damdi di tooni.
en: Thats why you must not make friends with the people of other nations who still live among you. You must not serve or worship their gods. Dont even mention the names of their gods when you pray or make an oath.

dag: dama bɛn nyuri dam kuuna mini pulaannim ni leei faranima; ka bɛ gɔ gbihibo nyɛ din ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ gbinfini.
en: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya o katiŋa, bɛ daa bi baŋ o, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum pam; ka dari chahi bɛ binyɛra, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu chɛri zuɣusaa ka di puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri.
en: But his friends didnt even recognize him when they first saw him in the distance! They began to cry loudly. They tore their clothes and threw dirt in the air over their heads to show how sad they were.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpuɣi ba zuɣusaa bɛ yinsi n-ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: The east wind will carry them away, and they will be gone. The storm will sweep them out of their homes.

dag: Bɛ daa dolila bɛ kɔribiɛri soli mɔɣu maa ni, ka daa buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: They became hungry in the desert, and they tested him in the wilderness.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka bɛ gbaai yibu yinoyino. Ninkura n-daa daŋ yibu; ka di ti kpalimla Yisa kɔŋko, ka paɣ maa ʒe o tooni.
en: Those who heard him went away, one by one, beginning with the elders. Finally, only Jesus and the woman were left in the middle of the crowd.

dag: ka daa lan nyɛ bɛn dari gindi tinsi, n-kpe zuliya shɛli ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe zuliya shɛli ni ni n-kpe na so tiŋ ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe na so tiŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: They wandered from country to country, from one kingdom to another.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ bindira nyo buɣim mali sara daba ayopɔin. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani. Niŋmiya li pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di binnyura zuɣu.
en: In this way, each day for seven days, you must bring the food that is offered by fire. The smell of these offerings will please the Lord . You must give these offerings in addition to the daily burnt offering and the drink offering that goes with it.

dag: Jɛkɔnia so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shialtiɛl mini.
en: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel.

dag: M bɔhirila n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tam n yɛla? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: I will say to God, my solid rock, Why have you forgotten me? Why do I have to walk around, sad, oppressed by enemies.

dag: Naawuni tim a suhudoo! A zɔnim la zaa puhir a. Puhimi ti zɔnim la zaa ti ma.
en: Peace be with you. All your friends send greetings. Greet all our friends personally.

dag: Yihim ma yɔhiŋgu ni, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Keep me from going the wrong way, and in your goodness teach me your law.

dag: Lala ka Jɛhu daa niŋ kpihim Baal birili zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: That's how Jehu stopped the worship of Baal in Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Bildad from Shuah answered:.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri wuntia ŋɔ, wummiya! Nyamiya bɛ ni daa ŋma kuɣ shɛli yihi ya na mini bɛ ni daa gbi tampin shɛŋa yihi ya na.
en: Listen to me, you who look for righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry where you were dug.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu. Naawuni, ka bɔ saha ka n yɛn kana ti nya a ninni?.
en: I thirst for you, the living God. When can I go and worship in your presence?.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti chaŋ ti be azaaba din ka bahigu ni; amaa ka wuntizɔriba la bɛn ti kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu ni.
en: Then Jesus said, Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.

dag: Ka o daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntinsi, vuhim ni daa be tiŋgbani maa ni saha shɛli, dama o mini so daa bi zabira. O daa bi tuhi tɔbu di yuma maa ni, dama Yawɛ daa ti o vuhim.
en: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.

dag: Dan zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shuham daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shuhamnima. Dan zuliya niriba m-bala.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Dan; they were all from the clan of Shuham.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku ni daa dii sɔhiri ka o bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee pun go mɔɣu ku nimdi n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n ŋub di zaa, ka pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni pɔi ka a naanyi kana ŋɔ? O mi shiri nya alibarika.
en: Isaac began to tremble and shake all over, and he asked, Who was it, then, who killed an animal and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came. I gave him my final blessing, and so it is his forever.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tiŋ maa ni nɛma, ka gbahi niɣi pahi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Jɔshua shɛm.
en: The Israelites kept the animals and other things from the city for themselves. This is what the Lord said they could do when he gave Joshua the commands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mali o ni su binshɛlikam maa zaa yiko, amaa lee miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shih o. Di saha ka Sintani daa yi Yawɛ sani chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to Satan, All right, do whatever you want with anything that he has, but dont hurt Job himself. Then Satan left the meeting.

dag: Ka naa daa yiɣisi Jɛshurun, saha shɛli niriba zuɣulaannim ni daa laɣim, din nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya naŋgban yini laɣiŋgu la.
en: At that time the Israelites and their leaders met together, and the Lord became Jeshuruns king!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri galisiya gari n zabiri. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ ku ma galisiya pam, ka n dimnim ŋmari ʒiri pari ma. Bɛ chɛ ka n yola n ni bi zu neen shɛŋa samli.
en: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?.

dag: amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ ma niŋ piɛɣu ni n-kpuɣ ma tiri tiŋ maa gooni vol ni n-siɣisi tiŋ ha ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: but I got away from him by being lowered in a basket through a window in the city wall.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kana ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋa anu.
en: The second one came and said, Sir, with the money you gave me, I have earned five times as much.

dag: Mani m-piig a dɔɣiriba Lɛvinima Izraɛlnim ni; bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni su shɛba; ka o zaŋ ba ti a ni bɛ tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma.
en: I have taken your brothers, the Levites, from the Israelites. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service of the meeting tent.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni zuɣu, n kpamdi yi zaa jaande ni yi ni so di tɛhi ni omaŋmaŋ bebu gari o bebu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa lee tɛhimiyala nimmoo tɛha, ka zahimmiya yimaŋa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Naawuni ni ti sokam yɛda shɛm.
en: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Naawuni ka bɔhi, Naawuni ni tooi ti ti bindirigu tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni?.
en: They challenged God by saying, Can God provide food out here in the desert?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa, ka bɛ daa bi lan buɣisi ni bɛ liri ba bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni yaha, ka Yawɛ daa kul darigiri Filistianim maa tibili Samuɛl ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: So the Philistines were defeated, and the Lord prevented them from invading Israel's territory as long as Samuel lived.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: He made the poles of acacia wood and covered them with gold.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma;.
en: Someone who is on the roof of a house must not take the time to go down and get any belongings from the house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: They thought it over and said to each other, We can't say that God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, zaɣ biɛɣu kul lurila zuliya, zuliya zuɣu kanna, ka sanʒiɛ titali yiɣisi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛŋa polo katiŋ na.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Disasters will soon spread from country to country. They will come like a powerful storm to all the faraway places on earth.

dag: Zahima pam zahimbu mini yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka buchi, amaa zomiyala Naawuni.
en: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa tumdi tuma ka di fukumsi ʒi tibisa ʒi yi zuɣu, kamiya n sanna, ka n ti tin ya vuhim.
en: Come to me all of you who are tired from the heavy burden you have been forced to carry. I will give you rest.

dag: Musa ni daa kpi saha shɛli maa, o yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi. O nina daa na kul nɛmi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o niŋgbuŋ ni yaa daa bi filim.
en: Moses was years old when he died. His eyesight wasnt impaired, and his vigor hadnt diminished a bit.

dag: Ka salo maa kpamba daa yɛli, Ti mi pun ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba paɣiba zaa. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: So the leaders of the gathering said, There are no more women in the tribe of Benjamin. What shall we do to provide wives for the men who are left?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa nya o m-bol o na ti yɛl o, A yipa nya amaŋa a dɔro ŋɔ ni.
en: When Jesus saw her, he called out to her, Woman, you are free from your sickness.

dag: dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Those who have much will receive more, and they will have more than they need. But as for those who dont have much, even the little bit they have will be taken away from them.

dag: nyaanzuriba ni bɛn je Naawuni ni ninʒeensinima ni karimbaannima ni barinyuriba ni tuumbiɛri so pala bɔriba ni bɛn bi deeri bɛ laamba noli.
en: and speak evil of one another; they are hateful to God, insolent, proud, and boastful; they think of more ways to do evil; they disobey their parents;.

dag: A daa nam o ka o jilima pooi malaikanim jilima saha biɛla puuni; a daa chɛ ka o mali jiri mini jilima.
en: For a while you made them lower than angels. You crowned human beings with glory and honor. .

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o niriba maa chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti jɛm o. Amaa ka a na kul bi saɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Then say to the king, The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, sent me to tell you to let his people go, so that they can worship him in the desert. But until now you have not listened.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni. Bɛ ni daa ti yi suɣili maa ni na, bɛ daa suhila alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni; ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi zahira niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Moses and Aaron went into the Meeting Tent. They came out and blessed the people. Then the Glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, suhupiɛlli pam ni be alizanda ni o zuɣu gari wuntizɔriba kɔbigayinika bɛn bi lan simdi ni bɛ niŋ tuuba la.
en: In the same way, I tell you, heaven is a happy place when one sinner decides to change. There is more joy for that one sinner than for good people who dont need to change.

dag: Dindali maa di simdi ka yi moli molo, ka laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu ʒiɛmani kam ni yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: On that very same day you must make a proclamation; it will be a holy occasion for you. You must not do any job-related work. This is a permanent rule wherever you live throughout your future generations.

dag: Ka sokam zaa nya li ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-niŋ li. Bɛ ni baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di niŋ maa.
en: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, dabiɛm yi ti mali ma, nyini ka n ni niŋ naani.
en: When I am afraid, O Lord Almighty, I put my trust in you.

dag: Ka o daa tim Abimilɛk sani Aruma nti yɛl o, Nyama, Ɛbɛd bia Gaal la min o dɔɣiriba kala Shɛkɛm na nti wuhiri Shɛkɛmnim yikombiɛlim soya zaŋ kpa a polo.
en: He sent messengers to Abimelech at Arumah to say, Watch out! Gaal, Ebeds son, and his relatives have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam zaa tumdi din tuhi chanila neesim ni ni sokam ti nya o tuma ka baŋ ni o zɔri Naawuni.
en: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Aai, a paɣ Zara ni dɔɣi bidibiga ti a, ka a bol o yuli Yisahaku. Ka n ni lo a min o zuliya alikauli shɛli din ni be sahakam.
en: But God answered: No! You and Sarah will have a son. His name will be Isaac, and I will make an everlasting promise to him and his descendants.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu ti ku nya nambɔzɔbo saria karibu puuni; amaa ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ti di nasara saria karibu puuni.
en: Yes, you must show mercy to others. If you do not show mercy, then God will not show mercy to you when he judges you. But the one who shows mercy can stand without fear before the Judge.

dag: Ka yɛda niŋbu wunsuhigu ni tiligi bara maa, ka ti Duuma ni yiɣis o; ka o yi tumla alahichi gba, o ni nya di chɛ m-paŋ.
en: If such a prayer is offered in faith, it will heal anyone who is sick. The Lord will heal them. And if they have sinned, he will forgive them.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ ʒim maa mihi niriba maa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la ʒim, di nyɛla din doli o ni yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.

dag: kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm kurimbuni la.
en: just as he said through the mouths of his holy prophets long ago.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ŋma li n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa, ka o daa zaŋ li nti ti o ma.
en: The head was brought in on a plate and given to the girl, who took it to her mother.

dag: Amaa azichi ŋɔ m-be tinim bɛn ŋmani yaɣiri duɣiri ŋɔ ni ni di wuhi ni di yiko din galisi nyɛla Naawuni dini, ka pa ni ti dini.
en: Yet we who have this spiritual treasure are like common clay pots, in order to show that the supreme power belongs to God, not to us.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda ya la, amaa ka ŋmaligi zaŋ li tahila Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Giiti nir la yiŋa.
en: So David didnt take the chest away with him to Davids City. Instead, he had it put in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋdi buhi mini naɣilahi ʒim ni naɣisa so bɛ ni daa zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la tampiligim mihiri niriba niŋgbuna ni di chɛ ka bɛ mali be kasi, ka yi bɛ daadiini kaya dolibu taali ni.
en: If the blood of goats and bulls and the sprinkled ashes of cows made spiritually contaminated people holy and clean.

dag: Di saha maa, do so daa beni n-nyɛ ŋun yi Zɔra na, ka o yuli booni Manɔa. O daa nyɛla Dan zuliya ni nira, ka o paɣ nyɛ paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi.
en: Manoah from the tribe of Dan lived in the town of Zorah. His wife was not able to have children.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda nayili polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ŋmanila Giliad n sani, ka ŋmani Lɛbanɔn zoya, amaa m poya ni n ni zaŋ a leei tiŋgban nɛli, ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli.
en: This is what the Lord says about the palace where the king of Judah lives: The palace is tall like the forests of Gilead, like the mountains of Lebanon. But I will make it like a desert, as empty as a city where no one lives.

dag: bee gurugulana bee diɣili bee do so ŋun nina bi ne viɛnyɛla bee ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri niŋgbuŋ ni bee ŋun mali yu kaɣima bee bɛ ni yihi do so lana.
en: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.

dag: N lo n suhu ni ni n ni dol a zaligunim maa sahakam.
en: I have decided to keep your statutes forever, every last one.

dag: Ka shɛb yi mali naŋgbankpeeni, bɛ kanimina ka n ti woligiri li tiri ba, ka wuhiri ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When a conflict arises between them, they come to me and I judge between the two of them. I also teach them Gods regulations and instructions.

dag: Dama pa paɣ ni ka doo yina, amaa doo ni ka paɣ ŋun yina.
en: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.

dag: Amaa ka bɛn daa ti biɛra, ka man yɛla buɣu ka lo noli n-zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋ suhiri Naawuni;.
en: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them.

dag: ka ŋun maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yili luɣ kasi shee la tooni.
en: The priest will dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, toward the sanctuarys inner curtain.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan maa mini anzinfa ni binyɛrigu maa ni salin kpilli maa ni o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi ni o niɣi ni o bunsi ni o piɛri ni o suɣili ni o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa n-chaŋ Akɔr Vinvamli ni.
en: Then Joshua seized Achan, Zerahs son, along with the silver, the robe, the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, flocks, tent, and everything that belonged to him. All Israel joined Joshua. They brought them up to Achor Valley.

dag: Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa na kul be o nyɛvil ni ka mal alaafee. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: The brothers answered, Yes, sir, our father is still alive. And they again bowed before Joseph.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Mɛriba kom, luɣ shɛli Izraɛlnim mini Yawɛ ni daa yɛl tab finafina ni luɣ shɛli o ni daa wuhi ni o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites confronted the LORD with controversy and he showed his holiness to them.

dag: Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ti banima, ka gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.

dag: Teeku n-nyɛ ma bee binneen titali ŋun be teeku ni n-nyɛ ma, ka a chɛ ka bɛ guli ma?.
en: Why do you keep me under guard? Do you think I am a sea monster?.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Zaŋm a yiko tiligi ti; zaŋm a yiko maa niŋ kaman a ni daa pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahi teeku ni biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni Rahab la.
en: Wake up! Do something, Lord . Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔna do n-gil a, ka dabiɛm lu a zuɣu libig a.
en: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ. Ibram daa nyɛla yuun pisopɔinnaanu nira saha shɛl o ni daa yiɣisi Haran maa.
en: Abram was years old when the Lord told him to leave the city of Haran. He obeyed and left with his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the possessions and slaves they had acquired while in Haran. When they came to the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka o daa lan saɣim Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni la ni di chɛ ka so ku lan zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga m-mali buɣili Molɛk.
en: King Josiah also desecrated Topheth, the pagan place of worship in Hinnom Valley, so that no one could sacrifice his son or daughter as a burnt offering to the god Molech.

dag: Bɔhimmiya zaɣ viɛlli tumbu. Niŋmiya din tuhi, ka sɔŋdi bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka niŋdi kpibisi di ni simdi ni yi niŋ ba shɛm, ka sɔŋmiya pakoya.
en: learn to do good. Seek justice: help the oppressed; defend the orphan; plead for the widow.

dag: N ŋmanila dabili ŋun ʒe o dan tooni. Wula ka n ni tooi tɔɣisi n dan yɛtɔɣa? Ya buriginli bee vuhim lan ka n ni.
en: Sir, I am Daniel your servant. How can I talk with you? My strength is gone and it is hard for me to breathe.

dag: Ti zaa daa bela lala, ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, ka tumdi dinkam tiɣiri timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini ti tɛha nini. Ka ti zaa daa nyɛla bɛn ti yɛn di Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo wahala shɛli sokam ni ti yɛn di la.
en: In the past all of us lived like that, trying to please our sinful selves. We did all the things our bodies and minds wanted. Like everyone else in the world, we deserved to suffer Gods anger just because of the way we were.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni n-gbiri binyara ŋubira; ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni. Ka o daa bahi ba noli.
en: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and Jesus let them go.

dag: Ka a daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa m bela a sani n-nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a. N ni chɛ ka a yuli du kaman dunia ŋɔ ni wɔɣira yuya ni daa du shɛm la.
en: I have been with you everywhere you went. I went ahead of you and I killed your enemies. Now I will make you one of the most famous men on earth.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa ti paai Kapɛrinium nti kpe duu ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi di lee ŋmɛri sol ni la.
en: Jesus and his followers went to Capernaum. They went into a house, and Jesus said to them, I heard you arguing on the way here today. What were you arguing about.

dag: A nyari paɣibu bibihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni a dimnim zuɣu. A chɛ ka a dima mini ŋun nyɛ biɛribɔhira fo bɛ noya.
en: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.

dag: O daa yɛli ma, Izraɛl nyɛla n dabili, a sani ka n yɛn nya jilima.
en: He told me, Israel, you are my servant. I will do wonderful things with you.

dag: Yisa daa yiɣisi bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni yi n-chaŋ ti kpɛla Saimɔn yiŋa; ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii pam, ka bɛ balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: After leaving the synagogue, Jesus went home with Simon. Simons mother-in-law was sick with a high fever, and the family asked Jesus to help her.

dag: N daa wum a yɛligu, ka dee li, ka a yɛligu maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka ti ma suhupiɛlli, dama nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n su ma.
en: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka ti daa bi wum ti ba hal baabiɛla ni di chɛ ka ti ba yɛlimaŋli din be lahibal suŋ maa ni zali tin ya.
en: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.

dag: O zaŋla noli yɛlibu ye kaman binyɛrigu la. Chɛ ka di tabil o niŋgbuna kaman kom la, ka chɛ ka di be kaman kpam la n-nyɛligi kpe o kɔba ni.
en: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.

dag: Sulemaana daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zahim nɛma maa m-baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm; dama di daa zooya pam. Bɛ daa bi baŋ daanya maa tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomon did not have these bronze objects weighed, because there were too many of them, and so their weight was never determined.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Be careful, then, to love the Lord your God.

dag: Ka Haga daa boli Yawɛ ŋun tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa maa yuli, Naawuni ŋun nyara; dama o daa yɛlimi, Ka daɣila n shiri nyala Naawuni ka na be n nyɛvil ni n ni nya o maa nyaaŋa.
en: Hagar asked herself, Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it? So she called the Lord , who had spoken to her, A God Who Sees.

dag: O ni daa yɛl o lala bahi ka kpe yili maa ni, o nya ka niriba pam m-pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam.
en: I will make my covenant with you and give you many descendants.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ zina, ka ku niriba. Bɛ niŋ zina bɛ buɣa sani, ka zaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣi m bi shɛb la ku n-ti ba ni bɛ ŋubi.
en: They committed the sin of adultery. They are guilty of murder. They acted like prostitutes—they left me to be with their filthy idols. They had my children, but they forced them to pass through fire. They did this to give food to their filthy idols.

dag: Daba ayɔbu ka yi ni zaŋ tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili titali, ka nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di bi simdi ni yi tum tuma dindali, di nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; ka kum wum o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ piligi kabisiri chi ŋubiri chana.
en: About that same time, Jesus was walking through the fields of grain on a Sabbath day. His followers were with him, and they were hungry. So they began to pick the grain and eat it.

dag: amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela zibisim ni. Dama din di naan nyɛ a neesim yi niŋ liti, dindina nyin baŋmi ni di zibisim maa ku mali kpee.
en: But if you look at people in a selfish way, you will be full of darkness. And if the only light you have is really darkness, you have the worst kind of darkness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yi tooni guui, ka kari ba ka bɛ zo ka chɛn ya. Ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbana maa su kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: The LORD your God will force them out before you and remove them from you. Then you will take over their land, exactly as the LORD your God has promised you.

dag: Yi lan pihiri nimaani nyolinsi n-leeri buɣa jɛmdi li; ka boori binyɛra mini zimbuli bahiri di zuɣu. Yi tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ni chɛ ka n suhu piɛla?.
en: You belong with the smooth talkers in the valley; they, they are your lot. For them you poured out a drink offering, and presented a grain offering. Should I condone these things?.

dag: Di pa shɛli Onɛsimus daa yi a sani n-zomi ni o yi kpaŋ biɛla, ka ti lan lab a sanna n-yipa ti beni sahakam.
en: Onesimus was separated from you for a short time. Maybe that happened so that you could have him back forever.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mini wɔɣira zaa nti pahi Naa Dauda bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim la zaa daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni doli Naa Sulemaana.
en: and all the commanders and warriors, as well as all of King Davids sons, submitted to King Solomons authority.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Jɛrusalɛm shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A piligu shee mini bɛ ni dɔɣ a luɣ shɛli nyɛla Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A ba daa nyɛla Amɔri nira, ka a ma mi nyɛ Hiti nira.
en: Say, The LORD God proclaims to Jerusalem: By origin and birth you are from the land of Canaan. Your father was an Amorite, your mother a Hittite.

dag: Hal ŋun nyɛ n zo simo, ka n niŋ o yɛda, ka m min o laɣindi diri la gba yila n nyaaŋa.
en: Even my best friend, the one I trusted most, the one who shared my food, has turned against me.

dag: Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ yino. Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: So they are no longer two, but one. God has joined them together, so no one should separate them.

dag: dindina n ni pa n nina lihiri doo maa min o yiŋnima, ka ku o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol o jɛmdi Molɛk maa.
en: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi salo maa naai ka o kɔŋko chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o kɔŋko na kul be nimaani.
en: When he sent them away, he went up onto a mountain by himself to pray. Evening came and he was alone.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa deei Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa ka Yisa Masia mi tahi anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli na.
en: as the Law was given through Moses, so grace and truth came into being through Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni, o daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka o nubihi min o napombihi zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na.
en: At another war in Gath there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in all, who was also descended from Raphah.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Nyamiya, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, Will you sleep and rest all night? Look, the time has come for the Human One to be betrayed into the hands of sinners.

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Azaria ni Raamia ni Nahamani ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipɛrɛt ni Biɣivai ni Nɛhum ni Baana n-daa doli kuna.
en: Their leaders were Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ o niŋ o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim shɛb o ni daa niŋ kɔre maa nuu ni.
en: Therefore, I handed her over to her lovers, to the Assyrians for whom she lusted.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli din varim daɣiri, ka saɣim dimaŋa, ka nahindi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jerusalem is doomed, that corrupt, rebellious city that oppresses its own people.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu ni ka yɛli: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku ni daa jɛm so ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bihi ŋɔ ni! Naawuni ŋun gbib ma hal ti paai zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni!.
en: He blessed them and said, May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, may the God who was my shepherd from the beginning until this day.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri yuri Yawɛ zaligu, ka bɔhindi li ka tɛhiri di yɛla wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord , and they think about it day and night.

dag: Miri ka a bo yomyom n-zaŋ a nuhi pa so zuɣu m-piig o ni o tum ti Duuma tuma; a mi miri ka a chɛ ka a nuu be so daalahichi tumbu ni. Gbib amaŋa m-be kasi.
en: Be in no hurry to lay hands on people to dedicate them to the Lord's service. Take no part in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.

dag: Ka o daa lu soli n-kariti anab maa naba nti nya o ka o ʒila oki tia gbini, ka o bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ anab so ŋun yi Juda na la? Ka o garigi yɛli Iin, mani.
en: The old prophet went after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked him, Are you the man of God who just came from Judah? The man of God answered, Yes, I am.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋ o tɔbbi kpɛma zaa chaŋ bɛ tuhibu.
en: David heard about this, so he sent Joab and the whole army of powerful men.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa bahi Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa noli yɛli Zaŋmi niriba ata kpe m-pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti yihi anabi Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ka o ku kpi.
en: Then King Zedekiah gave a command to Ebed Melech, the Ethiopian. This was the command: Ebed Melech, take three men from the palace with you, and go get Jeremiah out of the cistern before he dies.

dag: A zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. To, ti ni wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: That was your dream. Now we will tell the king what it means.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti n yuli jilima, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam zani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: He will build a house for my name, and I will make his kingdom strong forever.

dag: ka Lɛvinim bɛn ka tarili bee fali yi sani la mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi tinsi ni gba di n-tiɣi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.
en: Then the Levites, who have no designated inheritance like you do, along with the immigrants, orphans, and widows who live in your cities, will come and feast until they are full. Do this so that the LORD your God might bless you in everything you do.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, a nyɛla Yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa ti nyɛla bɛn tiligi ka kpalim kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. Tinima n-ʒe a tooni ni ti taali maa hal so ni ku tooi zani a tooni lala maa zaa yoli.
en: LORD, God of Israel, you are righteous, for we have survived and a few remain until now. Here we are before you in our guilt, though no one can face you because of this guilt.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya n kpe m puu maa ni. N laɣim n tulaalɛnim mini mɛɛr. N di n shigbana shiri. N nyu n wain ni m bihim. Zɔrinima, dimiya ka nyu, n yurinima, nyumiya yurilim hal ti buɣi.
en: My darling my bride, I have entered my garden. I have gathered my myrrh and spice. I have eaten my honey and honeycomb. I have drunk my wine and milk. Dearest friends, eat, drink! Be drunk with love!.

dag: Ka suhudoo daa be Naa Jɛhɔshafat ʒiɛmani maa ni, dama o Naawuni daa ti o vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: As a result, Jehoshaphats rule was peaceful because his God gave him rest on all sides.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Yulimiya bo n-nya ŋun tooi ŋmɛri mɔɣilo viɛnyɛliŋga ti ma na.
en: All right, Saul answered. Find me someone who is good at playing the harp and bring him here.

dag: A ni tooi sɔŋ o yɛrigi sagbana ka di kpɛm kaman bɛ ni dooi diɣi la?.
en: Can you form the sky with him, hard like a mirror made of metal?.

dag: So kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya. Tim kani din ni tibi yi daŋ maa. Yi ku nya tibbu.
en: There is no one to take care of you, no remedy for your sores, no hope of healing for you.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ ŋmaligi labi bɛ nyaaŋa nti dɔni Pihahirɔt tooni polo, Migidol mini teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din miri Baalizɛfɔn la; dɔnimiya miri teeku maa noli.
en: Tell the Israelites to turn back and set up camp in front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea in front of Baal-zephon. You should set up camp in front of it by the sea.

dag: Ka tɔb shɛli daa ti lan lu bɛ sunsuuni Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni. O daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka di zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim maa zuliya ni na.
en: There was another war, this time in Gath. One of the enemy soldiers was a descendant of the Rephaim. He was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Bundaan so n-daa mali tumtumdi kpɛma, ka bɛ ti nyih o ni o tumtumdi kpɛm maa bahir o buni maa yoli.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, There was once a rich man who had a servant who managed his property. The rich man was told that the manager was wasting his master's money.

dag: dindina o ba min o ma maa bɛn gbaam o n-zaŋ o tahi bɛ ya kpamba sani nti zaŋ o zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali ni.
en: the father and mother will take the son before the elders of that city at its gates.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ Ijiptinim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa tibidarigibo.
en: This will be the punishment that will fall on Egypt and on all the other nations if they do not celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Jɛhɔshafat, ka o niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ, ka moli molo ni sokam lom noli Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa.
en: Jehoshaphat became afraid, and he decided to ask the Lord what to do. He announced a time of fasting for everyone in Judah.

dag: N niŋ yɛda ni n ni be hal ti nya Yawɛ ni yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o niriba ni shɛm.
en: But I have sure faith that I will experience the LORDs goodness in the land of the living!.

dag: A na mi n-kpe bɛ ni zaŋ saa ŋun noli maai pam zali du shɛŋa ni, bee a na mi n-nya bɛ ni zaŋ sakuɣa zali du shɛŋa ni.
en: Have you ever visited the storerooms, where I keep the snow and the hail?.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛlaa maa kul mal o yila maa n-ʒiɛri kpari wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo. Ka biŋkɔb so daa kani n-ni tooi taɣ o zali bee n-zo n-yi o nuu ni tiligi. Piɛlaa maa daa kul tumdila o suhuyubu, ka duhir omaŋa.
en: I watched the ram butting with his horns to the west, the north, and the south. No animal could stop him or escape his power. He did as he pleased and grew arrogant.

dag: kaman chuɣu dal la. N ni vuui barina ka chɛn ya, ka yi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: as joyful as people at a festival. The Lord says, I have ended the threat of doom and taken away your disgrace.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ nabia maa na nti zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ nam fukumsi litaafi ti o, ka bɛ leeg o nam. Ka Jɛhɔiada min o bidibisi daa booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni. Ka sokam daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: Then Jehoiada led Joash out, placed the crown on his head, and gave him a copy of the laws governing kingship. And so he was made king. Jehoiada the priest and his sons anointed Joash, and everyone shouted, Long live the king.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋ maa yiya pia kam puuni zaɣ yini lu, ka ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin daa kpi tiŋgbani dambu maa ni, ka dabiɛm gbahi bɛn kpalim, ka bɛ ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: At that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed by the earthquake, and the rest were afraid and gave glory to the God of heaven.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa puuni, ka lan zali tɔbbihi Juda tiŋgban ni min o ba Asa ni daa tuhi deei tin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la puuni.
en: by stationing troops in the fortified cities of Judah and placing soldiers throughout the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

dag: N ni ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka ku noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini teeku ni zahim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuui; n ni ku ninsalinim zaa dunia yili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: all human beings and animals, birds and fish. I will bring about the downfall of the wicked. I will destroy everyone, and no survivors will be left. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ paɣ so ŋun sɔrilim na bi naai dɔni m-pirig o zaɣim, o yihila paɣ maa ʒi soya zahira, ka paɣ maa gba yih omaŋmaŋ ʒi soya zahira, di simdi ka bɛ yihi bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa bɛ daŋ ni.
en: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have the poor among you, but you wont always have me.

dag: Di wuhi ni a nyɛla wuntizɔra ti yaɣi, a mi di wuhi ni a nyɛla yɛndan ti yaɣi. Di niŋ lala ku amaŋa.
en: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Doli yɛlimaŋli soli ka tummi din tuhi, dama di ku yuui ka n tiligi ya.
en: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ bee anabi bee maligumaana yi ti bɔh a, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna lee nyɛ dini?, nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya: Yinima n-nyɛ yɛlimuɣisirili maa. N ni kari ya bahi. .
en: The people of Judah, or a prophet, or a priest may ask you, Jeremiah, what is the announcement of the Lord ? You will answer them and say, You are a heavy load , and I will throw down this heavy load. This message is from the Lord .

dag: So ku lan be nimaani saha shɛlikam yaha. Laribunim ku lan ti bɛ suɣa zali nimaani. Piɛguliba mi ku lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛri dɔni nimaani.
en: But Babylon will not continue to be beautiful. People will not continue to live there in the future. Arabs will not put their tents there. Shepherds will not bring their sheep to let them eat there.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai o daa chaŋla Kapɛrinium.
en: Jesus finished saying all these things to the people. Then he went into Capernaum.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ o tumtumdiba ninvuɣ pia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa zɔrila o yiŋnim min o yanim ni o niŋ li wuntaŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa niŋ li la yuŋ.
en: Gideon chose ten of his servants to help him, and they did everything God had said. But since Gideon was afraid of his family and the other people in Ophrah, he did it all at night.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka naa maa paag o sanna ti yɛl o, Ti muɣisigu ŋɔ yila Yawɛ sanna! Ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan yɛn guhi ŋun Yawɛ yaha.
en: While Elisha was still speaking with them, the messenger arrived and said, Look, this disaster is the LORDs doing. Why should I trust the LORD any longer.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim yi yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ maŋli lan kani. Bɛ zaa domi gu ni bɛ ku niriba, ka zaŋ lansi gbahiri taba.
en: There is not an honest person left in the land, no one loyal to God. Everyone is waiting for a chance to commit murder. Everyone hunts down their own people.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa maa daa tim ni bɛ chaŋ ti boli timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni baɣisi ni Kalidianim na ka bɛ ti wuh o o zahindi maa gbinni. Ka bɛ daa kana ti ʒini naa maa tooni.
en: So he called in his counselors, advisors, magicians, and wise men.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi Pɛɛga maa chaŋ Antiɔk din be Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ti ʒini.
en: They went on from Perga and arrived in Antioch in Pisidia, and on the Sabbath they went into the synagogue and sat down.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee yili ni. Miriya ka yi mi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee paɣa ni bee o tumtumdi dɔbba bee o tumtumdi paɣiba ni bee o naɣilalantabili ni bee o buŋ ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee binshɛli ni.
en: Do not desire to possess anything that belongs to another person—not a house, a wife, a husband, a slave, an ox, a donkey, or anything else.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa yi n-kpe yɔɣu ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima. Bɛ daa tuhi tab la Ifriim tiŋgban ni yɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: David's army went out into the countryside and fought the Israelites in Ephraim Forest.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ doo min o paɣa polo ni zaŋ chaŋ doo min o bipuɣiŋga ŋun na be o ba yiŋa ka nyɛ paɣisarili polo m-bala.
en: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom, ka Ɛdomnim zaa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba. Dauda daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa lahibali moli gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini tin shɛŋa din gili nimaani zaa.
en: News about Jesus spread all over Judea and everywhere else in that part of the country.

dag: Ka yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala.
en: Treat others just as you want to be treated.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman mɔpilli zuɣu mɔri, din ni kpi ka na bi zooi.
en: Let them be like grass on a roof that dies before it can be pulled up.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaayi Rubin mini Gaad ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba.
en: The people from the Merari family were given towns. These towns came from the areas that belonged to Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

dag: dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa bi tooi chɛ ka binshɛli niŋ dɛde; amaa din lee beni nyɛla, tahima suŋ din gari li yipa kana, ka ti ni tooi miri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: For the Law of Moses could not make anything perfect. And now a better hope has been provided through which we come near to God.

dag: Ka kɔnyuri daa gbaai Samsin pam, ka o suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Nyini n-chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ di nasara ŋɔ, ka kɔnyuri ti yɛn ku ma, ka n lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Now Samson was very thirsty, so he called out to the LORD, You are the one who allowed this great victory to be accomplished by your servants hands. Am I now going to die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised.

dag: Ka nyin Firawuna ni nya zahindi maa buyi la wuhiya ni Naawuni n-zal li, ka ni chɛ ka di ku yuui, ka di niŋ.
en: The dream occurred to Pharaoh twice because God has determined to do it, and God will make it happen soon.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ yiko min o jilima nyɛla din yi katiŋ kanna. O suhuyiɣisili shihirili nyɛla nyɔhi ni buɣim; ka o nol ni yɛtɔɣa ŋmani buɣim din dira.
en: Look! The Lord is coming from far away. His anger is like a fire with thick clouds of smoke. His mouth is filled with anger, and his tongue is like a burning fire.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi kpamba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: The next day we went to Caesarea and stayed with Philip, the preacher. He was one of the seven men who helped the apostles.

dag: Ka bimbini maa gba daa shiri wurim, ka tampiligim maa kpaai bahi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun wuhi ni Yawɛ yɛliya ni o ni chɛ ka di niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The altar broke apart, and the ashes spilled out from the altar, just like the sign that the man of God gave by the LORDs word.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋ yur anu bɛn kpalim ŋɔ chaŋ, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni gba kul bela barina ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti tim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya.
en: One of the kings officers said, Let some men take five of the horses that are still left in the city. The horses will soon die anyway, just as all the Israelites who are still left in the city. Lets send these men to see what happened.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam hal ka o ti kari ba o sani. Zɛdɛkia daa nyɛla ŋun zaɣisi Babilɔn naa noli.
en: and it was Zedekiah who finally rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar. The people of Judah and Jerusalem had made the Lord so angry that he finally turned his back on them. That's why horrible things were happening there.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bindirigu mini kom tuhi Izraɛlnim soli na nti ti ba saha shɛli bɛ ni daa be soli chani la zuɣu. Amaa ka bɛ daa naɣ bula Balaam paa ni o yɛli nol ti Izraɛlnima, amaa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nol yɛlibu maa ŋmaligi leela alibarika.
en: This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka di shiri niŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti yi nya li so sani, dilan ni leei n dabili, ka yinim bɛn kpalim ku mali taali.
en: He said, Fine. Well do just as youve said. Whoever is found with it will be my slave, and the rest of you will go free.

dag: ka yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: after saying to him, Listen, don't tell anyone about this. But go straight to the priest and let him examine you; then in order to prove to everyone that you are cured, offer the sacrifice that Moses ordered.

dag: O ni daa nya Yisa ka o chahi pam ka kana nti damd o tooni kuhi bɔh o, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a, di nahim ma.
en: The man saw Jesus and screamed. He knelt down in front of him and shouted, Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want with me? I beg you not to torture me.

dag: Ninsal yi tum o ninsal kpee taali, Yawɛ ni tim di sandaani. Amaa ninsal yi tum Yawɛ taali, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tim di sandaani? Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ ba yɛligu maa wumbu, dama Yawɛ daa pun lo ni o ni ku ba.
en: If someone sins against someone else, God can intercede; but if someone sins against the LORD, who will intercede then? But they wouldnt obey their father because the LORD wanted to kill them.
