dag: Ti yi nya wahala, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo mini yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu; ka ti yi nya suhumaabo, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo shɛli yi ni nyari yi ni niŋdi suɣilo n-diri wahala shɛŋa ti gba ni diri la zuɣu.
en: If we suffer, it is for your help and salvation; if we are helped, then you too are helped and given the strength to endure with patience the same sufferings that we also endure.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ o niŋ o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim shɛb o ni daa niŋ kɔre maa nuu ni.
en: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan yi nti yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ o mi yina nti wuhi ya ka yi baŋ ni m bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.

dag: Niŋmiya kaman n ni niŋdi shɛm. N kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n tiɣi sokam nini n ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla niriba pam sɔŋsim zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: This is the same thing that I do. I please everyone in everything I do. I dont look out for my own advantage, but I look out for many people so that they can be saved.

dag: Ka Musa daa yeei Aduna kpariti maa n-zaŋ li yɛli o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna daa shiri kpi zoli maa zuɣu. Ka Musa mini Ɛliɛza daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina.
en: Moses then took the priestly robe from Aaron and placed it on Eleazar. Aaron died there. When Moses and Eleazar came down.

dag: Di saha ka n daa pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima: Shɛrɛbia mini Hashabia ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ninvuɣ pia m-pahi.
en: From among the leading priests I chose Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten others.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli Ziɔn, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi dama di nyɛla tin shɛli Zallakudura Naa ni daa zali.
en: And of Zion it is said: Each person was born in it, but the one who will establish it is the Most High.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa shiri di o ʒiri shɛhira, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi nya o galimi. Di nyaaŋa ka niriba ayi daa tɔhi zanna.
en: They didnt find anything they could use from the many false witnesses who were willing to come forward. But finally they found two.

dag: ni m mini ya ti laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee n-diri ka nyura, ka yi ti ʒini nam kuɣisi zuɣu n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: You will eat and drink at my table in that kingdom. You will sit on thrones and judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Lɛbanɔn, yoom a dunoya ka buɣim tooi di a sida tihi luhi.
en: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire can burn down your cedar trees!.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala.
en: The old prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey, and when it was ready.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ nimaani daba ayi, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-chani gindi Galɛshia mini Firijia tiŋgbana ni n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa suhuri.
en: After spending some time there, he left and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the believers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa be Ijipti n-tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma. Bɛ bilim ni ka bɛ daa kul tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma maa. Nimaani ka bɛ daa tabisi bɛ biha, ka zaŋ ba saɣim.
en: While they were young and living in Egypt, they became prostitutes.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli Izraɛlnim ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ka saɣim n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti n niriba Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su li la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn vuɣi ba la bɛ tiŋgban ni, ka yihi Judanim bɛ sunsuuni.
en: The LORD proclaims: The evil nations have seized the land that I gave my people Israel. Im going to dig them up from their own lands, and I will dig up the people of Judah from among them.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande: Kpahimiya gbinyaɣinim zuɣu ni; ka kpaŋsimiya bɛn suhuri miligi la suhuri; ka sɔŋmiya bɛn gbarigi la; ka maliya suɣilo ni sokam.
en: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.

dag: dindina o ba min o ma maa bɛn gbaam o n-zaŋ o tahi bɛ ya kpamba sani nti zaŋ o zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali ni.
en: His parents are to take him before the leaders of the town where he lives and make him stand trial.

dag: Wummiya! Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: Listen! Once there was a man who went out to sow grain.

dag: Ti Duuma be a nudirigu polo. O ni ti nyaŋ nanima o suhuyiɣisili dali.
en: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.

dag: Jafilɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pasak mini Bimhal ni Ashivat. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt bidibisi.
en: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn dindali maa yuŋ, Gbaam a ba naɣilaa, ka bo naɣila so ŋun pah ayi ka nyɛ yuma ayopɔin ka daag a ba ni me Baal bimbin shɛl la luhi, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi;.
en: That night the Lord told Gideon, Take your father's bull and another bull seven years old, tear down your father's altar to Baal, and cut down the symbol of the goddess Asherah, which is beside it.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania, Hanania, wumma, pa Yawɛ n-tim a na ka a ti chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ ʒiri yɛda maa.
en: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.

dag: Nir yi ŋma ʒiri nya bindirigu di nyaɣisa, amaa di nyaaŋa taŋkuɣa n-yɛn pal o noli.
en: It may seem to be a good thing to get something by cheating, but in the end, it will be worth nothing.

dag: ka taɣi ma ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ liri ma la ku paa ma. Bɛna n-nyɛ n dimnim bɛn gili ma niŋ sunsuuni m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la;.
en: away from the wicked who are out to get me, away from my deadly enemies who are all around me!.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna yɛra, Yinima n-ku Yawɛ niriba maa.
en: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, The two of you killed some of the Lord 's people.

dag: Sanbalat ni daa wum ni ti lan piligi mɛri gooni maa, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o puuni zaa diri buɣim ka o piligi maani Yɛhudianim ansarisi.
en: When Sanballat heard that we were building the wall of Jerusalem, he was very angry and upset. He started making fun of the Jews.

dag: N ni tiligi m biŋkɔbiri maa, ka so ku lan nahim ba. Ka n ti woligi binshɛli din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni.
en: But I will rescue my flock so that they will never again be prey. I will even judge between the sheep!.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔbiri ŋmani paɣiba zabiri, ka bɛ nyina be kaman gbuɣinli nyina la.
en: their hair was like womens hair, and their teeth were like lions teeth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti o na ka o zaŋ o dɔni, Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa.
en: David sent messengers to get her; they brought her to him and he made love to her. Then she went back home.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ malimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma niŋbu duri; ka bɛ daa mal li.
en: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed.

dag: Zaŋm amaŋa n-niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka niŋ o naani ka o tum di ni simdi ni o tum shɛm.
en: Commit your way to the LORD! Trust him! He will act.

dag: Di zaɣisi zaɣ viɛlli niŋ ti di ni simdi ni a niŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛba, a yi mali yiko din ni niŋ li.
en: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Jesus' disciples picked up twelve large baskets of leftover bread and fish.

dag: Di saha maa n daa yɛliya, N kɔŋko ku tooi gbib ya.
en: At that same time, I told you: I cant handle all of you by myself.

dag: A ni bi lan teeg a bilim ni yɛla, amaa ka niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni labis a tuma maa ʒil a. Pa pagɔrisigu tuma ka a daa tum gar a ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa la zaa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Because you didnt remember your youthful days, and infuriated me with all these things, I will hold you accountable for what youve done. This is what the LORD God says. Have you not added bad reputation to all your detestable acts?.

dag: Daadam Bia mi kamina ni o ti bo n-nya bɛn bɔrigi la n-tiligi ba.
en: The Human Onecame to seek and save the lost.

dag: Dauda daa lan zali Lɛvi kpamba maa ni bɛ bom bɛ daŋ maa ni baansi mini biŋkumdiŋmɛriba bɛn ni tooi ŋme biŋkumda pampam, kaman mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa din ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli biŋkumda beni.
en: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a sɔɣi ka zilinli fiɛbiga ku paag a, ka saɣiŋgu yi ti paag a, a ku zɔri li.
en: God will rescue you from slander; he will save you when destruction comes.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnim hal ti gbahi ba; n daa bi chɛ ba dolibu hal ti ku bɛ zaa ha.
en: I pursue my enemies and catch them; I do not stop until I destroy them.

dag: Ka naa maa mini ba zaa daa ti di alizama, ka o nya ka Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla n-kpe o nyaɣisim gari bɛ tab la zaa. Ka bɛ daa leei bɛn ʒiini naa tooni nayili.
en: The king talked to them and found that none of the young men were as good as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So these four young men became the kings servants.

dag: Amaa o suhu yi na kul yumi ni o niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka m bi kana ti yɛl a ka a zo n-tiligi ni alaafee, Yawɛ ŋun niŋmi mani Jɔnatan zaɣ biɛɣu n-gari m ba ni yɛn niŋ a shɛm maa, Yawɛ ni be a sani kaman o ni be m ba sani shɛm la.
en: If my father wants to hurt you, I will let you know. I will let you leave in safety. May the Lord punish me if I dont do this. May the Lord be with you as he has been with my father.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nim suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: So there was great joy in that city.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn darigiri gbabigiri kpibisi bɛ manim biha ni, ka deeri nandaamba biliɛri talima.
en: Evil people make slaves of fatherless infants and take the children of the poor in payment for debts.

dag: Ya ka n lee yɛn nya nimdi ti niriba ŋɔ zaa? Dama bɛ kumdimi niŋdi ma ka yɛra, Tim ti nimdi ka ti ŋubi.
en: Where am I to get meat for all these people? They are crying before me and saying, Give us meat, so we can eat.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ti yi n-zani ni o zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii maligumaana so bee sariakarita so zali nimaani yɛligu maa, bɛn kum dilana. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Anyone who dares to disobey either the judge or the priest on duty is to be put to death; in this way you will remove this evil from Israel.

dag: Ka Makiri daa bo paɣiba ti Hupim mini Shupim. O tizɔpaɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka. O bidib so ŋun daa pahi ayi n-daa nyɛ Zɛlɔfɛhad, ŋun daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi noli.
en: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.

dag: ka yihi bɛn daa be dabitim ni bɛ bebu puuni zaa kum dabiɛm zuɣu la bahi.
en: Jesus became like these people and died so that he could free them. They were like slaves all their lives because of their fear of death.

dag: ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o, ka o neei kum ni daba ata dali kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa ti Izraɛlnim vuhim ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gili ba niŋ sunsuuni bi tooi niŋ ba shɛli ka di yuui pam la nyaaŋa, Jɔshua gba daa kurigiya pam di saha maa.
en: A long time passed. The LORD had given rest to Israel from all their surrounding enemies, and Joshua had grown very old.

dag: Ŋun daa pahi piniyini n-su chir piniyini ni n-daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya ŋun daa yi Piratɔn na ka nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The eleventh for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite from Ephraims family. His division numbered .

dag: O ni daa yɛli do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa ni o moomi buɣim maa kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni maa, ka o daa kpe di puuni ti zani baɣili kalinli yini.
en: The man in the robe was now standing beside a wheel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab Ɛnmishipat bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Kadɛshi la. Ka bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛk tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Amɔrinim bɛn daa be Hazazɔntarima la zaa.
en: Then King Kedorlaomer turned back, went to En Mishpat , and defeated the Amalekites. He also defeated the Amorites living in Hazezon Tamar.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yo Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ dunoya, ka kpihi di puuni firilanima, ka daa bi lan tuɣindi tulaale zim bee m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la luɣ kasi shee la tiri Izraɛlnim Naawuni.
en: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun zali ni Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni ni lu. O daa buɣisi li mi. O daa bi chɛ li wurimbu. O chɛ ka pihi mini goma fabili; di zaa bahila yoli.
en: The Lord was determined that the walls of Zion should fall; He measured them off to make sure of total destruction. The towers and walls now lie in ruins together.

dag: N teeri yi yɛla zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu.
en: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zuliya bɔbili sunsuuni; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: And so I praise you among the nations; I sing praises to you.

dag: Ka n suhi a nyaandoliba ŋɔ ni bɛ kari alizin biɛɣu maa, ka bɛ bi tooi.
en: I begged your disciples to force out the demon, but they couldn't do it.

dag: Chinchin tibisi shɛli daa yili di puuni, ka bɛ booni tanti du shɛli din be chinchini maa nyaaŋa mi Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee.
en: There was a tent behind the second curtain called the holy of holies.

dag: M mabihi, Klɔi yiŋnim shɛb daa yɛli ma ni naŋgbankpeeni kpe yi sunsuuni.
en: My brothers and sisters, Chloes people gave me some information about you, that youre fighting with each other.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔhi salima ka di gari tɔn kɔbiga ni pisopɔin, ka tɔhi anzinfa tɔn kɔbisita ni pihinahi, ka tɔhi daanya kaman tɔn kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisi ka tɔhi kuriti gari tɔn tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li tum Naawuni duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: for the temple. These gifts included more than tons of gold, over tons of silver, tons of bronze, and more than , tons of iron.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ jilima ni yi zahira ka sokam zaa nya li. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala.
en: Then the Glory of the Lord will be shown to everyone. Together, all people will see it. Yes, this is what the Lord himself said.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, man Naawuni maa ni kul yɛli ni n yɛli shɛli, dina ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: But Micaiah answered, By the living Lord I will say what my God tells me to.

dag: Chɛ ka n wunsuhigu be kaman tulaale zim la a sani, ka chɛ ka n nuhi zuɣusaa kpuɣibu be kaman zaawuni sara maligu la.
en: Let my prayer stand before you like incense; let my uplifted hands be like the evening offering.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Maika yiŋ maa, ka bɛ nya nachimbil ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir maa m-baŋ o o yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee tah a kpe na? Ka bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe? Bee tuun bɔ ka a lee tumdi kpe.
en: because they heard the young Levite talking, and they knew from his accent that he was from the south. They asked him, What are you doing here? Who brought you here.

dag: Ka o ma daa wuh o o ni yɛn suhi shɛli; ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛli Naa Hɛrɔd, Ŋmam Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu n-niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti ma.
en: But the girl's mother told her to say, Here on a serving plate I want the head of John the Baptist.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla yuŋ leei biɛkaali. Bɛ yɛliya, Neesim maa mirila zibisim.
en: They turn night into day; light is near because of the darkness.

dag: Ka o daa lan me luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee, ka di wɔɣilim mini duu maa yɛliŋ nyɛ yim. Di daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ gba daa nyɛ mita awɛi. Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima alali, din tibisim gari mɛtiriki tɔn pisi n-dooi pa di zuɣu.
en: The most holy place was nine meters square, and its walls were covered with over tons of fine gold.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, A yi doli ma, a yɛla ni ti muɣisi ma.
en: David said to Hushai, If you go with me, you will be just one more person to care for.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku nyini Ahimɛlɛk min a daŋ zaa.
en: Ahimelech, Saul said, you and your whole family are going to die.

dag: Ka din pahi pisinaanahi mi daa gbaai Romamtiɛza min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ gba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Twenty-fourth, there were men chosen from Romamti Ezers sons and relatives.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni zaŋ n suhuyubu pini mali sara ti a. Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a yuli, dama a nyɛla ŋun viɛla.
en: Lord , I will give freewill offerings to you. I will praise your good name.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: He was years old at the time, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. Ahaz wasn't like his ancestor David. Instead, he disobeyed the Lord.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa yi suhiri alibarika niŋdi Ɛlikana min o paɣ maa ni ka yɛri Ɛlikana, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a paɣ ŋɔ dɔɣi bihi ti a ka bɛ zan o ni zaŋ bi so ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋɔ zaani. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan lab kuli bɛ ya.
en: Then Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say to Elkanah, May the Lord give you other children by this woman to take the place of the one you dedicated to him. After that they would go back home.

dag: O daa yɛli Naftali zuliya: Yinim Naftalinima, yi nya yurilim tiɣi, ka Yawɛ daalibarika pali yi ni. Yinima n-su wulinluhili mini nudirigu polo.
en: Moses said this about Naphtali: Naphtali, you will get all you want. The Lord will really bless you. You will get the land by Lake Galilee.

dag: ni Parua bia Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa be Isaka tiŋgban ni la.
en: Jehoshaphat, Paruahs son, in Issachar.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba ni nyaanzuriba. Bɛ ŋmanila tahiʒiɛɣu mini kurigu. Bɛ zaa tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: My people have turned against me, and they are very stubborn. They say bad things about people. They are like bronze and iron that are covered with rust and tarnish.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim maa taali, ka lan zaŋ ba labisi a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim la ni na.
en: then listen from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel. Return them to the land you gave to them and their ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya n niriba bɛn be Ijipti la muɣisigu, ka wum bɛ fabila zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim ni niŋdi ba fitiina shɛŋa la polo. M mi bɛ wahalanim maa zaa.
en: Then the LORD said, Ive clearly seen my people oppressed in Egypt. Ive heard their cry of injustice because of their slave masters. I know about their pain.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa kari doli ba nti fa bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi, ka ku Sirianim maa pam.
en: King Ahab took to the field, captured the horses and chariots, and inflicted a severe defeat on the Syrians.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpaɣim li, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti kpe Naawuni nam ni, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Ahaz was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. Ahaz was nothing like his ancestor David. Ahaz disobeyed the Lord.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli alɔbo shɛŋa zaa yɛla la lu tiŋ ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi zaa zuɣu bɛ ni niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu maa zuɣu.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: I am about to bring upon this city and its surrounding towns every disaster that I have pronounced against them, because they have been stubborn and wouldnt obey my words.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Bɛ ni ti niŋ zina, amaa ka ku dɔɣi bihi, dama bɛ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: They will eat but not be satisfied; they will have sex like prostitutes, but they will not have children, because they have rejected the LORD to devote themselves to.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ tiliginsim liɣiri maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ka zal o shɛm.
en: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: ka su Hɛrimɔn Zoli mini Salɛka ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga ni Giliad pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn tintariga la.
en: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, and all of Bashan as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half of Gilead down to the border of Heshbons King Sihon.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa su tɔbbihi fukumsi ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la nyɛ gbansabira wulana.
en: Zeruiahs son Joab was in command of the army; Ahiluds son Jehoshaphat was recorder.

dag: ka di pa ni yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli kaman bɛn bi doli Naawuni zaligu ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: not with a lustful desire, like the heathen who do not know God.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga shɛɣuni kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛl o ni o ni dɔɣi saha shɛli maa.
en: But the woman conceived and gave birth to a son at about the same time the next year. This was what Elisha had promised her.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda mini niriba kɔbisinahi daa kul be niriba maa naba biɛhibu ni. Ka niriba kɔbisiyi la bɛn daa gbarigi pam, ka kɔŋ Bɛso kulibɔŋ maa dubu.
en: David and four hundred men continued the pursuit, while two hundred men stayed there, too exhausted to cross the Besor ravine.

dag: Ka anabinim shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl daa yina ti bɔhi Ilaisha, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: A group of prophets who lived there asked Elisha, Do you know that today the Lord is going to take away your master? Yes, I do, Elisha answered. But don't remind me of it.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili maa puuni ka n daa no m-bɔribɔri zuliya kam niriba, ka bɛ ʒim yi n-do tiŋgban ni.
en: I trampled down nations in my anger and made them drunk on my wrath; I spilled their blood on the ground.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti kpaŋ ka o zaŋ o tahi ti ti nabipuɣiŋga maa, ka o zaŋ o leeg o bia, ka bol o yuli Musa, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kom ni ka n yih o na.
en: Later, when the child was old enough, she took him to the king's daughter, who adopted him as her own son. She said to herself, I pulled him out of the water, and so I name him Moses.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisili, di kul kpɛrila ninsal niŋgbuna puuni.
en: The words of gossips are like choice snacks; they go down to the inmost parts.

dag: So yi be yi ni n-nyɛ ŋun ka, ka nyɛ yi ʒilɛl ni nira m-be yi tin shɛl ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin di kuuya yi nini niŋ o bee n-kpibi yi nuu zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ka maa polo.
en: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.

dag: Biŋkɔb shɛb zaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la daa nyɛla naɣilahi pinaayi mini piɛlahi pinaayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaayi m-pahi bɛ chi sara zuɣu ni bulahi pinaayi shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: The total number of animals for the burnt offering was bulls, rams, and one-year-old male lambs. There were also the grain offerings that must be given with these offerings. And there were male goats to be used for a sin offering.

dag: Di yɔhimya yimaŋa; Naawuni pala bɛ ni maani so ansarisi, dama ninsal ni biri binshɛli, dina ka o ni ti chɛ.
en: If you think you can fool God, you are only fooling yourselves. You will harvest what you plant.

dag: Amaa nir yi lihi Naawuni zaligu din be tibi ka nyɛ din tiri daadamnim yolisim la ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka kul dol li dɛde ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni ŋun wumdi li mi kɔŋko, o ni nya alibarika Naawuni sani o ni tumdi shɛm maa puuni.
en: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.

dag: N-kaai biɛɣu ka bɛ paai Siizaria, ka Kɔniilius pun laɣim o dɔɣiriba min o zo suma na ka bɛ ti ʒiya guli ba.
en: The next day they came to the city of Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them and had already gathered his relatives and close friends at his house.

dag: Ka a yi yaag a noli yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla a Duuma, ka niŋ yɛda a suhu ni ni Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni, a ni tiligi.
en: Because if you confess with your mouth Jesus is Lord and in your heart you have faith that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli leeg o jɛmbu shee maa mini yi ya yi waɣa pam, ka yi kɔrigi yi niɣi bee yi biŋkɔbbaligu shɛb Yawɛ ni tin ya maa kaman n ni zali ya shɛm, dindina yi ni tooi ŋub li saha shɛli yi ni bɔra.
en: If the one place of worship is too far away, then, whenever you wish, you may kill any of the cattle or sheep that the Lord has given you, and you may eat the meat at home, as I have told you.

dag: Dauda daa bela Zif mɔɣu ni Hɔrɛshi maa. Di saha ka o daa wum ni Sool kana ni o ti ku o.
en: One time, David was at Horesh in Ziph Desert. He was afraid because Saul had come to the area to kill him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani ŋun laɣim Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be yɔɣu la na ni laɣim zuliya shɛb na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord , promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka bɛ ni mali binshɛli sabira be kolibil ni baɣi o luɣili la daa ti labina ti yɛli, N tum a ni zali ma ni n tum shɛli maa.
en: Then the man wearing linen clothes returned and reported to the Lord , I have carried out your orders.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ni niŋ lala, dindina yin lomiya kpara Yawɛ nini ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses said to them, Do this and fight before the LORD in war.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ suŋ la pun tin ya Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa baŋ din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: But you have an anointing from the holy one, and all of you know the truth.

dag: N daa kul fomi baalim ka bi yɛli shɛli, hal n daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ din viɛli gba polo! Amaa ka n wahala daa lee kul pahira;.
en: So I was completely quiet, silent. I kept my peace, but it did no good. My pain got worse.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lan yɛli, Yi ku gari. Ka Ɛdom naa maa daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam bɛn gbib bidibbina pam kana ti gu ba soli.
en: But again the king of Edom answered, We will not allow you to come through our country. Then the king of Edom gathered a large and powerful army and went out to fight against the Israelites.

dag: Ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Kum o! Kum o! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, N kpahimi yi Naa maa tabili dapulli zuɣu? Ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ka naa pahila Naa Siiza.
en: They shouted, Take him away! Take him away! Kill him on a cross! Pilate asked them, Do you want me to kill your king on a cross? The leading priests answered, The only king we have is Caesar.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: A yi ni doli n zaligunima ka tumdi n ni zal a tuun shɛŋa ni a tum, n ni chɛ ka a su n jɛmbu duu tuma, ka ti a zaashee bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.

dag: Yawɛ, zaŋm ti labis a sani, ka chɛ ka ti lan lab a sanna. Chɛ ka ti lan labi ti biɛr kurili la ni.
en: Bring us back to you, Lord . We will gladly come back to you. Make our lives as they were before.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabihi pinaata mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi.
en: On this first day offer a food offering to the Lord , an odor pleasing to him: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya azichi mini mɔ viɛla. Ka tiŋgbani maa lan galisi ka vuri kani ka suhudoo beni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be nimaani daa nyɛla Hamnima.
en: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites.

dag: ni Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa diri ʒi Hɛshibɔn la tin kara zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Ammɔnim tintariga.
en: It included all the cities of the Amorites King Sihon, who ruled in Heshbon, as far as the Ammonite border.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yoli, di daa muɣisi ba ni bɛ tooi gooi niriba maa ka bɛ ku mali ba maligu maa.
en: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.

dag: Daŋ kam piimi bɛ daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim ka mali yu suŋ ka bɛ leei yi zuɣulaannima.
en: Now, for each of your tribes, choose wise, discerning, and well-regarded individuals. I will appoint them as your leaders.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn tiri yimaŋ yɛlimaŋli niriba san la, amaa Naawuni mi din be yi suhuri ni. Ninsalinim ni tibigiri binshɛli pam nyɛla Naawuni ni chihiri shɛli.
en: But Jesus told them: You are always making yourselves look good, but God sees what is in your heart. The things that most people think are important are worthless as far as God is concerned.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa daa niŋmi ni ti Duuma ni daa chɛ ka anab so yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: All this happened to make clear the full meaning of what the Lord said through the prophet:.

dag: ti kuli do so.
en: Later she married another man.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka vuhim kpe yi ni ka yi niŋ nyɛviyanima.
en: The LORD God proclaims to these bones: I am about to put breath in you, and you will live again.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi di nasara, niriba malila suhupiɛlli pam, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba sɔɣirimi.
en: When good people come to power, everybody celebrates, but when bad people rule, people stay in hiding.

dag: Dama nyini n-galisi, ka tumd alahiziba tuma; a ko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: You are mighty and do wonderful things; you alone are God.

dag: N ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu ŋɔ wuhiri ni lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ashiya din be ninsalinim suhuri ni saria Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: All this will happen on the day when God will judge peoples secret thoughts through Jesus Christ. This is part of the Good News that I tell everyone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yabidoo Dan ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia la yuli m-boli tiŋ maa. Amaa tiŋ maa yuli daa tuui boonila Laishi.
en: They renamed the city Dan, after their ancestor Dan who had been one of Israels sons; but in fact, the original name of the city was Laish.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli: Zipɔr bia Balak, yiɣisima. Luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Then Balaam raised his voice and made his address: Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me out, Zippors son.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ daa kanna ti yɔri bɛ farigu liɣiri maa niŋdi adaka maa ni hal ti naai dindali maa.
en: This so pleased all the leaders and all the people that they gladly dropped their money in the box until it was full.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let those who honor the LORD say it: Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira nti zaŋ ŋme paɣ puulana, ka paɣ puulan maa zaŋ bahi, amaa ka mali alaafee, di simdi ka bɛ zali ŋun ŋme o maa samli kaman paɣ maa yidan ni bɔr shɛm, ka o yo li kaman sariakaritiba ni wuhi shɛm.
en: If some men are fighting and hurt a pregnant woman so that she loses her child, but she is not injured in any other way, the one who hurt her is to be fined whatever amount the woman's husband demands, subject to the approval of the judges.

dag: ka Shɛmɛr nyɛ Mahili bia, ka Mahili nyɛ Mushi bia, ka Mushi nyɛ Mɛrari bia, ka Mɛrari mi nyɛ Lɛvi bia.
en: Mahli, Mushi, Merari, Levi.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bia Jɔnatan min o tumtumdiba zaa ni bɛ kum Dauda. Amaa o bia Jɔnatan daa yuri Dauda yɛla pam.
en: One day, Saul told his son Jonathan and his officers to kill David. But Jonathan and David were best friends.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan mabia n-nyɛ bukaata saɣinda.
en: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu nya o tizo Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ o ma puuni bia la, ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni daa yɛli ma yi tizɔbil so yɛla la m-bɔŋɔ? Di saha ka o daa yɛli, M bia, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni! .
en: Then Joseph saw his brother Benjamin. Joseph said, Is this your youngest brother that you told me about? Then Joseph said to Benjamin, God bless you, my son.

dag: ka fiɛb o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: They will beat him with whips and then kill him. But on the third day after his death, he will rise to life again.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi m-bɔhira, Bɔ ka ti yɛn di bee n-nyu bee bɔ ka ti yɛn ye.
en: Don't worry and ask yourselves, Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam maa ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛlin shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri o puu ni;.
en: He told another parable to them: The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that someone took and planted in his field.

dag: Kpahimmi Naawuni tuma; o yi niŋ shɛli ka di gbiligi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi mal li zali dɛde?.
en: Consider Gods work! Who can straighten what God has made crooked?.

dag: Ka Jɔsifia bia Shɛlomit daa nyɛ Bani daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbiga ni pihiyɔbu daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Bani, Shelomith, Josiphiahs son and with him men.

dag: Ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tusaanii Yalim Vinvamli ni.
en: Abishai son of Zeruiah killed , Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

dag: Bɛ zoorimi kaman momaha la asibaasi; zaawuni ka bɛ ti zaɣi kpi.
en: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.

dag: Dama Naawuni n-zaani saha shɛl o ni bɔri ni daadamnim kan o sanna ka o ti kariti ba saria.
en: God does not need to set a time for people to come before him and be judged.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb mi Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shimia mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi, o paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua, ka o nyɛ Ammiɛl bipuɣiŋga la bihi.
en: and many sons were born to him there. His wife Bathsheba, daughter of Ammiel, bore him four sons: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yawɛ daa yɛli nyini n dan Musa ni a pihim kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari Izraɛlnima. Yawɛ daa lan yɛli nyini n dana ni a zaŋm ti mabia Zɛlɔfɛhad tarili ti o bipuɣinsi.
en: They said, The LORD commanded my master to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the Israelites. But my master was also commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yi ni so miri ka o ti chɛ ka o min o dɔɣira dɔni.
en: You must never have sexual relations with your close relatives. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ leei naa n-ʒili m ba Dauda nam maa ʒiishee hal n ni na kul nyɛ bia ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka m mi bi mi n ni yɛn su niriba shɛm.
en: O Lord God, you have let me succeed my father as king, even though I am very young and don't know how to rule.

dag: Chɛ ka zoya zuɣu niŋ bindira ka di niŋ niriba anfaani pam, ka chɛ ka wuntitali mi yi zahira daboya zuɣu.
en: May the land enjoy prosperity; may it experience righteousness.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko pam nam zuɣusaa mini dunia. Binshɛli kani din kpɛm nyaŋ a.
en: LORD God, you created heaven and earth by your great power and outstretched arm; nothing is too hard for you!.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ me dubihi shɛŋa n-tuɣi duu maa ti tuui, ka di zaa yiniyini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ sida dari tuɣ tab ti gɔhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Then he finished building the rooms around the Temple. Each story was cubits tall. The cedar beams in these rooms rested on a ledge of the Temple wall.

dag: Din chɛ ka bɛ ni bu so paa zɔri maa nyɛla o ni guli ba la liɣiri zuɣu maa n-chɛ ka o baɣa dii ka bɛ ni.
en: The man runs away because he is only a paid worker. He does not really care for the sheep.

dag: N chɛ ka baɣisi leei jɛra, ka chɛ ka baŋdiba bɛn yɛri binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla birinda; ka chɛ ka yɛnnim baŋsim leei jɛrilim.
en: I make fools of fortunetellers and frustrate the predictions of astrologers. The words of the wise I refute and show that their wisdom is foolishness.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini niɣi ni biŋgbamda ni binyiɣira zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: all animals, tame and wild, reptiles and birds.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan dɔɣ o tizo Ɛbɛl gba. Ɛbɛl daa nyɛla piɛgula, ka Keen mi nyɛ pukpara.
en: Later she gave birth to another son, Abel. Abel became a shepherd, but Cain was a farmer.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ Daadam Bia gba dabisili dali.
en: As it was in the time of Noah so shall it be in the days of the Son of Man.

dag: Kaman yinyaa ni zaŋdi buɣim datɛhi labiri ka tɔri piɛma din mali lɔɣu shɛm la.
en: Like a crazy person shooting deadly flaming arrows.

dag: Ka Shamshɛrai mini Shɛharia ni Atalia.
en: Jerohams family: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah.

dag: ka wuhiri ba ni bɛ doli n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la. Nyamiya, n kul ni be yi sani sahakam hal ti paai dunia yiɣisibu dali.
en: and teach them to do everything I have told you. I will be with you always, even until the end of the world.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na ti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: So Jesus called the followers together. He said, You know that the rulers of the non-Jewish people love to show their power over the people. And their important leaders love to use all their authority over the people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni sɔŋdi ma zuɣu, n ku di vi. Dinzuɣu ka n zuɣu ʒe ya. M mi ni n ku di vi.
en: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni nti zaŋ ma gari dundɔŋ lɔrisi anahi la ni, ka dundɔŋ maa ni lɔriga kam ti mali dundɔŋ.
en: Then he led me to the outer courtyard and showed me that in each of its four corners there was a smaller courtyard, feet long and feet wide.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu min o mabihi maa ni bɛ ʒiɛman ni niriba zaa daa ti kpi.
en: In the course of time Joseph, his brothers, and all the rest of that generation died.

dag: Ŋunkam goli biŋkɔbigu kam, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who has sexual relations with an animal. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: ni Uri bia Gɛba ŋun daa be Giliad din nyɛ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka zuɣulaan yino daa be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: Geber, Uris son, in the land of Gilead, the land of the Amorite king Sihon and of King Og of Bashan; and there was a single officer who was in the land of Judah.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna nti ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni m-bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: The Pharisees came to Jesus and asked him questions. They wanted to test him. So they asked him to do a miracle as a sign from God.

dag: O tim buɣim ka di yi zuɣusaa na, ka di nyooi ma hal ti kpe n kɔba ni. O bari zana, ka di gbaai n naba. O kari ma labisi. O chɛ ka bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka n tarigi doya dabisili kam zaa puuni.
en: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiri shɛli yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina di lan pala alikauli lɔbu zuɣu; amaa Naawuni daa zaŋ li tila ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.

dag: Dama n ni ti yihi Baalnim yuya o nol ni, ka o ku lan boli bɛ yuya yaha.
en: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called Master.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: King Rehoboam replaced them with bronze shields and assigned them to the officers of the guard who protected the entrance to the royal palace. .

dag: Bee m-bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣi tiŋgban ni? .
en: Neither will they ask, Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒe teeku duli lan piligi wuhiri niriba. Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni teeku maa ni, ka salo maa zaa daa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: Again Jesus began to teach beside Lake Galilee. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it. The boat was out in the water, and the crowd stood on the shore at the water's edge.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, yɔhiŋgu mini faɣiri dibu kul palila di ni, ka nɛma ʒiɛbu ku naai.
en: It will be very bad for that city of murderers. Nineveh is a city full of lies. It is filled with things taken from other countries. It is filled with plenty of people that it hunted and killed.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam kpalim bo ti Duuma, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn zaa kpe n yuli gba bo ma.
en: so that the rest of humanity will seek the Lord, even all the Gentiles who belong to me. The Lord says this, the one who does these things .

dag: dama nyuli zabbu chɛ ka yidan suhu yiɣisir pam, ka o yi yɛn bɔhi biɛri, o ku lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.

dag: Amaa ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, a ni kariti ma shɛm ŋɔ n-lee bie n-gari a ni niŋ ma shɛm maa gba. Amaa ka Amnɔn daa zaɣis o yɛligu maa wumbu;.
en: No, my brother! she said. Sending me away would be worse than the wrong youve already done. But Amnon wouldnt listen to her.

dag: Hal yi naɣikɔra mini bunsi bɛn kɔri yi puri ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ soobul mini soobul jɛba yɛli bindir shɛli.
en: The oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will eat the finest and best fodder.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba yi di be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga. Bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko nyɛviya ka bɛ naan tiligi bɛ wuntitali zuɣu.
en: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord , promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.

dag: A niriba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a kpambaliba bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni sahakam n-wumd a yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa gba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your people and these servants who continually serve you and get to listen to your wisdom are truly happy!.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered.

dag: Kɛnan daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pia ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Amaa Naawuni nyɛla yino, ka o mi bi bɔri sandaantimda ŋun Naawuni yino maa zuɣu.
en: But a go-between is not needed when only one person is involved; and God is one.

dag: O mini Ammɔn naa min o niriba daa tuhiya ka o daa nyaŋ ba. Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa ti o anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili ni chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili, ka bɛ daa ti o li lala yuma ata.
en: During his rule he attacked and defeated the Ammonites. Then every year for the next three years, he forced them to pay . tons of silver, , tons of wheat, and , tons of barley.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Mbo, ti suhuyubu niŋya! A mi di chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o.
en: Dont let them think, Aha! We got what we wanted! Dont let them say, We destroyed him.

dag: N ni vo zoomba doli bɛ ni na ʒi n-doli so shɛŋa, ka wuhi ba bɛ ni ʒi so shɛŋa. N ni chɛ ka zibisim din be bɛ tooni leei neesim, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli. Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ n ni yɛn niŋ shɛli, ka m mi ku bahi ba.
en: I will make the blind walk a road they dont know, and I will guide them in paths they dont know. But I will make darkness before them into light and rough places into level ground. These things I will do; I wont abandon them.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Dauda Jɔab ni daa yɛl o ni o ti yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: The messenger went in and told David everything Joab told him to say.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka kayeeniba kpe Babilɔn nti yɛl li. Bɛ ni ti yi luɣilikam na nti naai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali.
en: I will send foreigners to winnow Babylon, and they will take everything from the city. Armies will surround the city, and there will be terrible destruction.

dag: Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni la zaa daa ka Gɛdalia sanna Mizipa.
en: Johanan son of Kareah and all the officers of the army of Judah who were still in the open country came to Gedaliah. Gedaliah was at the town of Mizpah.

dag: Ka bɔh o, A tɛhiya ni di bi simdi ni n zaŋ n ni su binshɛli niŋ n yubu ni nyɛ shɛm bee yi zabiri ma la nyuli n nirilim niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Don't I have the right to do as I wish with my own money? Or are you jealous because I am generous.

dag: Niriba pam kul yɛri ma mi, Naawuni ku sɔŋ a.
en: They say to themselves, God will not rescue him! Selah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: The woman was the last to die.

dag: Yinim Izraɛl bipuɣinsi, kummiya Sool zuɣu. Ŋuna n-zaŋ mulifu viɛlli soli ya. Ŋuna n-zaŋ salima yɛri yɛli ya.
en: Women of Israel, cry for Saul. He brought you fine red cloth and jewelry made of gold.

dag: Ŋunkam mali yɛm, ŋun wummi dimbɔŋɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tɛhi Yawɛ yurilim maŋli ŋɔ yɛla.
en: May those who are wise think about these things; may they consider the Lord 's constant love.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin puuni o ku mali ninsal tɛha, amaa ka ni malila biŋkɔbigu tɛha.
en: Its human mind is to be changed: it will be given the mind of an animal. Seven periods of time will pass over it.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya o ni be luɣ shɛli ka n tim ka bɛ ti gbaag o na. Ka bɛ daa ti yɛl o, O be Dɔtan.
en: The king of Aram said, Find Elisha, and I will send men to catch him. The servants told the king of Aram, Elisha is in Dothan.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa tumdi tuumbiɛri je neesim ka mi ku saɣi chaŋ neesim ni, o tuumbiɛri maa ti yi palo zuɣu.
en: All who do wicked things hate the light and dont come to the light for fear that their actions will be exposed to the light.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpuɣi ti nuhi zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ ti suhuri ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ.
en: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say.

dag: Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: They discussed among themselves, If we say, Its of heavenly origin, hell say, Why didnt you believe him.

dag: Bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni yihi bɛ paɣiba maa, ka daa zaŋ piɛlaa m-mali sara bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: They promised to send their wives away, and their compensation offering was a ram of the flock for their guilt.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m paɣa duɣi dihi do so, ka chɛ ka do so dɔn o.
en: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima n-shiri nyɛ ti barinyubo mini ti suhupiɛlli!.
en: You bring us honor and joy.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ba lala maa, ka zaŋ o nuhi min o puluɣili wuhi ba, ka di niŋ o nyaandoliba maa suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa nya bɛ Duuma maa zuɣu.
en: After saying this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples were filled with joy at seeing the Lord.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ doola anzinfa m-mali di dasara pa di dunɔpaɣisi zuɣu, ka dooi salima n-zaŋ mali di nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ mali di kuɣa, ka Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba zaŋ yurilim mali di puuni.
en: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.

dag: Masia yɛlimaŋli din be n ni la zuɣu, binshɛli kani din ni tooi yihi barinyubo shɛli din be n ni ŋɔ Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinsi ni.
en: By Christ's truth in me, I promise that this boast of mine will not be silenced anywhere in all of Achaia.

dag: Ka o daa yi Nɛgɛb n-chaŋ hal ti paai Bɛtɛl luɣ shɛli o ni daa tuui kpa o tanti suɣili zali piligu ni, ka di be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni la.
en: Abram continued traveling around. He left the Negev and went back to Bethel. He went to the place between the city of Bethel and Ai, where he and his family had camped before.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti teei yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛhigu din daa bi viɛl la yɛla, ka ku lan bɔri yi ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa la.
en: You will remember your evil conduct and the wrongs that you committed, and you will be disgusted with yourselves because of your sins and your iniquities.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri din gari lala n-jɛndi ti Duuma NAAWUNI min o dabili Hɛzɛkia.
en: The Assyrian kings servants continued to make fun of the LORD God and his servant Hezekiah.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Job answered.

dag: Yisa ni daa pun mi binshɛɣukam zaa din yɛn niŋ o maa zuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra.
en: Jesus already knew everything that would happen to him. So he went out and asked them, Who are you looking for.

dag: Dama di sab Yila litaafi ni yɛli: Chɛ ka o yili zani dabɔɣu, ka so ku kpe di ni; ka Chɛ ka so zani o zaani n-deeg o ni chɛ tuun shɛli maa.
en: It is written in the Psalms scroll, Let his home become deserted and let there be no one living in it; and Give his position of leadership to another. .

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bah o niriba noli, ka bɛ zaŋ Ibram min o paɣa ni o ni mali binshɛlikam zaa yihi soli.
en: The king gave orders to his men, so they took Abram and put him out of the country, together with his wife and everything he owned.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Zin mɔɣu ni m-baɣisi Ɛdom tintariga chaŋ, ka yi tintariga piligu shee yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ wulimpuhili polo.
en: The southern border will extend from the wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. It will begin on the east at the southern end of the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka ti daa kul be gooni maa mɛbu ni, ka gooni maa zaa daa me n-tuɣi taba hal ti paai di dubu pirigili, dama niriba maa suhuri daa be tuma maa ni.
en: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, ti ni so bi be o polo. Amaa anabi Ilaisha ŋun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-yɛri Izraɛl naa a ni be a duu tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam.
en: One of his officers said, No one, Your Majesty! Its Elisha the Israelite prophet who tells Israels king the words that you speak in the privacy of your bedroom.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim zaa daa naanyi gbi la kɔbilisi gili Nail Mɔɣili maa ni bɛ nya kɔnyurim, dama bɛ daa naan ku tooi lan nyu Nail Mɔɣili kom maa yaha.
en: Meanwhile, all the Egyptians had to dig for drinking water along the banks of the Nile River, because they couldnt drink the water of the Nile itself.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Miriam yihi kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, ka niriba maa daa bi yiɣisi chaŋ hal ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ Miriam labina.
en: Miriam was shut out of the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought back in.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye wuntia zuɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: God blesses those people who want to obey him more than to eat or drink. They will be given what they want!.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn be a tooni, o ni be a sani, o ku chɛ ka a kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛ a bahi. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: The Lord will lead you. He himself is with you. He will not fail you or leave you. Dont worry. Dont be afraid.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa yihi kom baptaizibu yɛla waazu la nyaaŋa ka yɛligu ŋɔ daa pili Galili m-mol gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pali a min a niriba ni Ijiptinim zaa yinsi. Ka yi banim bee yi yaannim daa na ʒi n-nya lala tatabo bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ba saha shɛli zaŋ kana zuŋɔ. Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa ŋmaligi Firawuna sani yi.
en: They will fill your palaces and the houses of all your officials and all your people. They will be worse than anything your ancestors ever saw. Then Moses turned and left.

dag: N sabi yɛtɔɣa biɛla din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tin ya la Silvanus ŋun nyɛ n ni lihi so m mabia ŋun ʒe yim la sɔŋsim ni. M bɔri ni n kpaŋsila yi suhuri, ka lan yɛli ya ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daanfaani maŋli yɛla. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya di ni dɛde.
en: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.

dag: Ka o daa lan wuhi ba yɛra, Di yi niŋ ka yi ni so mali o zo ka ti chaŋ o sani yuntisuɣu ti yɛl o, Zɔri, paŋm ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila ata.
en: He also said to them, Imagine that one of you has a friend and you go to that friend in the middle of the night. Imagine saying, Friend, loan me three loaves of bread.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi bɛ kanimina ti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: They come back every evening, growling like dogs, prowling around the city.

dag: Saa malila ba? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣi maligim din tɔɣiri luri ŋɔ?.
en: Does the rain have a father? Who produces the drops of dew?.

dag: N ni zaŋ alibarika shɛli mini noli yɛlibu shɛli zali yi tooni ŋɔ yi ti niŋdi ya, ka yi teeri di yɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn kari ya tahi zuliya shɛba zaa ni ŋɔ sani.
en: Everything that I have mentioned will happen to you—both the blessings and the curses. And you will remember these words when the Lord your God sends you away to other nations.

dag: Baŋmiya ni mani n-su nyɛviya zaa. Mani n-su bihi laamba nyɛviya, mani n-lan su bia nyɛvili. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi kɔŋko n-ni kpi.
en: All lives are mine; the life of the parent and the life of the child belong to me. Only the one who sins will die.

dag: Pool daa bɔri ni o baɣisila Ɛfɛsus gari, dama o daa bi bɔri ni sangal shɛli ti taɣ o zali Ɛsha. O daa niŋdila yomyom ni di yi ni tooi nani ka o paai Jɛrusalɛm Pɛntikɔst dali.
en: Paul had decided to sail on past Ephesus, because he did not want to spend too much time in Asia. He was in a hurry and wanted to be in Jerusalem in time for Pentecost.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ daa chɛ ka Asa suhu yiɣisi bahi anab maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o kpɛhi duu nti ga o zoligɔnim zali, dama yɛlli maa daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi anabi maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Asa daa gbaai niriba maa shɛb nahimbu.
en: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people.

dag: Doo maa yi di pala Naawuni nira, o naan ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: Unless this man came from God, he would not be able to do a thing.

dag: Judas ni daa ti paana o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: As soon as Judas arrived, he went up to Jesus and said, Teacher! and kissed him.

dag: Timiya ni yi suhu zaa, ka yi yi yɛn niŋ li yin di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma mini yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: Give to them freely and unselfishly, and the Lord will bless you in everything you do.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni daa yihi sapir kɔb shɛli maa nam paɣa n-zaŋ o ti doo maa.
en: He formed a woman out of the rib and brought her to him.

dag: Amaa saŋkpambil maa yi kul kpalim bela luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi, di nyɛla bintɔrili maa wuliɛɣu m-bala, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if the bright spot stays in its place and does not spread, it is only the scar from the old boil. The priest must announce that the person is clean.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana soli zuɣu kul zibigila gɔhi, amaa ŋun tumdi din tuhi soli nyɛla solɔɣu.
en: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nambɔzɔbo kpe Ashpɛnaz suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: God caused Ashpenaz, the man in charge of the officials, to be kind and loyal to Daniel.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka bɛ laɣim yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa din kanna ŋɔ ni bindira din yɛn niŋ pam maa zaa zali, ka di nyɛ a ni zaŋ bindir shɛli niŋ fukumsi fɔntinsi ni ka bɛ gbib li.
en: During the good years that are coming, they should collect all such food and store the grain under Pharaohs control, protecting the food in the cities.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di ka nyu.
en: So Isaac gave a party for them. They all ate and drank.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tɛhi ni yɛla maa ʒila Alikizanda zuɣu, Yɛhudianim ni daa daag o zali tooni la zuɣu; ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa ni o wuhi ba din niŋ.
en: Some of the people concluded that Alexander was responsible, since the Jews made him go up to the front. Then Alexander motioned with his hand for the people to be silent, and he tried to make a speech of defense.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ o ni ŋme tɔb maa di neen shɛŋa n-lab kul o ya, ka ni ti lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ni ti tum o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka naanyi lab o ya.
en: The king of Syria will return home with all the loot he has captured, determined to destroy the religion of God's people. He will do as he pleases and then return to his own land.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka vi mali ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu! Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yɛndan shiri ka yi ni ŋun ni tooi kari yi mabihili puuni yɛla saria?.
en: Shame on you! Surely there is at least one wise person in your fellowship who can settle a dispute between fellow Christians.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara. Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph, Deuels son.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla ŋun tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa bi tum li ni o suhu zaa.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes but not with all his heart.

dag: ka daa tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yihi Naawuni nam waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋda.
en: Then he sent them out to preach the Kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din bi tuhi ni yi nahim niriba.
en: Doom to those who pronounce wicked decrees, and keep writing harmful laws.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa lu solɔɣu chana, ka Shimɛi daa be zolɔŋni m-baɣisir o luɣili polo dol o chani tur o, ka labir o kuɣa, ka toori taŋkpaɣu chɛr o.
en: So David and his men went on their way down the road. Shimei kept following David. He walked on the other side of the road by the side of the hill. He kept cursing David on his way. Shimei also threw stones and dirt at David.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, nyama, n-nyɛ takɔbir ayi! Ka o yɛli ba, Di ni saɣi.
en: The disciples said, Lord, here are two swords! Enough of that! Jesus replied.

dag: Ka mihi daa kul lo Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo hal ka bɛ ti lu buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: So these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell, bound, into the furnace of flaming fire.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhim wuntizɔriba kpɛhi zaɣ biɛɣu ni ni ti lu bɛmaŋmaŋ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛŋa ni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni ti nya laara din viɛla.
en: If you trick an honest person into doing evil, you will fall into your own trap. The innocent will be well rewarded.

dag: Kuɣ viɛla balibu kam ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi tiŋ maa gooni maa gbinni nachiinsi, ka di kɔtomsi daa be kɔŋkɔba. Kuɣ viɛla maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla jasipa, ka din pah ayi nyɛ safaya, ka din pah ata nyɛ agɛt, ka din pah anahi nyɛ ɛmɛrald.
en: The foundation stones of the city wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation stone was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald.

dag: Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deeri la mani; ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma, pa mani ka o deera, amaa ŋun tim ma na ka o deera.
en: Whoever welcomes in my name one of these children, welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me, welcomes not only me but also the one who sent me.

dag: Yi daa yɛliya, Tim ti naa mini kpambaliba. Yi naa maa lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ n-ni tooi tiligi ya? Yi kpambaliba maa lee be ya n-ni tooi zabi yi zuɣu?.
en: Where is your king? Can he save you in any of your cities? Where are your judges? You asked for them, saying, Give me a king and leaders.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhoyakim min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o nabihi zaa daa wum li, ka naa daa bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka Yuria daa wum o yɛtɔɣa maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o daa zo n-kuli Ijipti.
en: When King Jehoiakim and all his warriors and officials heard his words, the king sought to kill him. Uriah heard of this and fled in fear to Egypt.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan niŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuhi me bimbin shɛŋa la yɛda. Bɛ mi ti ku lihi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa din nyɛ dari mini bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim Ashɛrim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.

dag: Ŋuna n-tuhi nyaŋ sokam zaa, ka chɛ ka ti su zuliya kam zaa.
en: He subdues the nations under us, subdues all people beneath our feet.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Dama Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba. .
en: The Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath day.

dag: Barabas daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ tiŋ maa ni yino, ka daa lan nyɛ ŋun ku nir ka bɛ kpɛh o duu di zuɣu.
en: Barabbas had been put in prison for a riot that had taken place in the city, and for murder.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zani yim saɣi deei ti ninvuɣ biɛtali din nyɛ ti yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la, dama ti tum alahichi a sani.
en: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.

dag: ka o ti yɛl o din ni tilig o min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: He will tell you how you and your entire household can be saved.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛl Anabi Hagai ni o bɔhim o niriba maa ŋ-ŋɔ:.
en: The Lord then gave this message to the people through the prophet Haggai:.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? A nyɛla Anabi Ilaija? Ka o yɛli ba, M pa o. Ka bɛ lan bɔh o, Bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la n-nyɛ a? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Aai.
en: They asked him, Then who are you? Are you Elijah? He answered, No, I am not Elijah. They asked, Are you the Prophet ? He answered, No, I am not the Prophet.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbia mini ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ tinzun nira m-be bɛ sani zaa, zaligu yini maa ka a yɛn zali bɛ ni ŋun chirim.
en: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.

dag: Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. .
en: You won't see me again until you say, Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛl o, Biɛɣu neera, chɛ ka n chaŋ. Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N ku chɛ ka a chaŋ, faashee ka a niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: The man said, Let me go because the dawn is breaking. But Jacob said, I wont let you go until you bless me.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili salima sara maligu bimbin la, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.

dag: n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be Jɛrusalɛm; ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka n zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini wuntitali su ba.
en: I will bring them back here, and they will live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their good and faithful God.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka tiligira so lan kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I alone am the Lord ; only I can rescue you.

dag: ka nyo bɛ naawuna buɣim, bɛn dee pala naawun maŋa, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpe da shɛŋa ni kuɣ shɛŋa, dina n-chɛ ka o daa saɣim ba maa.
en: They did throw the gods of those nations into the fire, but they were not real gods. They were only wood and stone—statues that people made. That is why the kings of Assyria could destroy them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bala. Naawuni ni zaŋ tarili shɛli zali ba m-bala.
en: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.

dag: Di piligirila zuɣusaa yaɣ shɛli tariga, n-zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la tariga. Ka binshɛli ku tooi sɔɣi ka di biisim ku paa li.
en: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ kpam chim li mahilaa ni zaɣ bihi, ka a gar li viɛnyɛliŋga n-zaŋ li mali sara shɛli din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: It must be prepared on a griddle with oil. You must bring it thoroughly mixed up and must present it as a grain offering of crumbled pieces as a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Yisa daa bi be kaman o wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naɣ yɛlila Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda.
en: Jesus paid no attention to what they said, but told him, Don't be afraid, only believe.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti kana ti kpuɣi binshɛɣukam zaa din be a yili ŋɔ min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n-kuli Babilɔn; ka di shɛli ku guui, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The time is coming when everything in your palace and everything your ancestors have saved until today will be carried away to Babylon. Nothing will be left! The Lord said this.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya ti Duuma zuɣu, dama dina n-tuhi.
en: As for children, obey your parents in the Lord, because it is right.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, yi yi nya ka di simdi, yin yomiya ma n tuma yɔri. Ka yi yi ku yo ma, yin maliya li. Ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita yo ma.
en: And I said to them, If it appears good to you, give me my wages; but if not, then stop. So they weighed out my wages, thirty shekels of silver.

dag: M biyurigu, n suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka shɛlikam be viɛnyɛla a sani, ka a lan mal alaafee a niŋgbuŋ ni gba kaman n ni mi ni a shia mal alaafee shɛm.
en: Dear friend, Im praying that all is well with you and that you enjoy good health in the same way that you prosper spiritually.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ŋɔ daa jɛmdi la Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛ buɣa; ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi na kul niŋdimi kaman bɛ yaannim maa ni daa niŋdi shɛm maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: They did worship the Lord , but they also worshiped their own idols. Their descendants did the same thing.

dag: Yawɛ nam binshɛlikam la ni di daliri, hal ninvuɣ biɛri benila bɛ wahala nyabu dali zuɣu.
en: Everything the Lord has made has its destiny; and the destiny of the wicked is destruction.

dag: Sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa pah ata n-su gol so ŋun pah ata ni n-daa nyɛ maligumaana Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya, o daa nyɛla kpɛma. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The third army commander for the third month was Benaiah the chief priest Jehoiadas son. His division numbered .

dag: N ni zaŋ ya leei n niriba, ka leei yi Naawuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yihi ya Ijiptinim ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: I will accept you as my people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I was the one who rescued you from the Egyptians.

dag: N ni labi laŋ pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn ti kar o saria nimaani, o ni taai duŋ niŋ ma la zuɣu.
en: I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my trap. I will bring him to Babylon, and I myself will enter into judgment with him there for rebelling against me.

dag: Amaa bɛ ti ku lan labi bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ labi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni na ŋɔ.
en: longing to return home.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti piɛbi kika titali, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yirigi be Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini bɛ ni daa kari shɛb kulisi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kana ti jɛm Yawɛ Jɛrusalɛm zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: In addition, Nebuzaradan, the commanding officer, took away as prisoners Seraiah the High Priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank, and the three other important Temple officials.

dag: O gba daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, amaa ka kul dolila di soli maa.
en: He too sinned against the Lord and followed the evil example of King Jeroboam, who had led Israel into sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka niriba ŋmaligi paɣiri ba, ka bi nya bɛ taali.
en: so that even God's people turn to them and eagerly believe whatever they say.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi la zaa mabihili puhigu ti ti.
en: Greet all the believers with the kiss of peace.

dag: ka lan fari pakoya yinsi, ka suhiri Naawuni yuuri ni niriba tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam.
en: They take advantage of widows and rob them of their homes, and then make a show of saying long prayers. Their punishment will be all the worse.

dag: A yi ka binshɛli din ni zaŋ yo, bɛ ni kpuɣi a bindoo chaŋ ka chɛ a.
en: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed.

dag: Yi karitila nimmira saria, amaa man bi kariti so saria.
en: You make judgments in a purely human way; I pass judgment on no one.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Yuun pihinahinaayɔbu ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duu ŋɔ, ka nyin ti yɛli ni a ni labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: The leaders replied, It took years to build this temple. What makes you think you can rebuild it in three days.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka di nyɛla Liya. Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi Leeban, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Reechɛl zuɣu ka n tum tuma ti a, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma.
en: In the morning Jacob saw that it was Leah he had slept with, and he said to Laban, You have tricked me. I worked hard for you so that I could marry Rachel. Why did you trick me.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ kpi. Zaŋm ba zaɣ nɛma nti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama zaɣ biɛɣu m-be bɛ yinsi puuni mini bɛ suhuri ni.
en: Let death devastate my enemies; let them go to the grave alive because evil lives with them— even inside them!.

dag: O ni ti ʒini kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun paɣiri neeri anzinfa la; o ni ti paɣi neei Lɛvi zuliya kaman bɛ ni paɣiri neeri salima mini anzinfa shɛm la, hal ka bɛ ti zaŋ pina din tuhi ti Yawɛ.
en: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord .

dag: N ni mali n yuli din galisi maa ka di niŋ kasi, n yu shɛli zuliya shɛb ni daa saɣim ka yi gba daa saɣim li bɛ sani la. Ka n yi kahigi n kasitali yi sani bɛ ninni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I demonstrate to the nations the holiness of my great name—the name you disgraced among them—then they will know that I am the Lord . I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken. I will use you to show the nations that I am holy.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi salo maa naai ka o kɔŋko chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o kɔŋko na kul be nimaani.
en: After sending the people away, he went up a hill by himself to pray. When evening came, Jesus was there alone;.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa bɔhi Amnɔn, Nabia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim mali suhugarigu biɛɣukam lala? Yɛlim ma din muɣis a. Ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, N kɔre n-kpe m mabia Absalom tizɔpaɣ Tama ni.
en: and he said to Amnon, What's the matter? You're the king's son! You shouldn't have to go around feeling sorry for yourself every morning. Amnon said, I'm in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi ni damdi tiŋa n-jɛm ma, n ni zaŋ di zaa ha ti a.
en: All this I will give you, the Devil said, if you kneel down and worship me.

dag: Niriba anu maa ni daa lab Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol bɛ mabihi maa sani, bɛ daa bɔhi ba mi, Ka lahibal bɔ ka yi lee ʒina.
en: The five men went back to the cities of Zorah and Eshtaol. Their relatives asked them, What did you learn.

dag: Ka a lan pii di shɛli niŋ buɣim ni n-nyo li. Ka buɣim maa yi nimaani na nti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: From that hair, take yet another batch and throw it into the fire and burn it up. From there, fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.

dag: Amaa naa ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani, ka bɛnkam zaa zaŋ Naawuni yuli m-po pɔri ni mali suhupiɛlli dama ʒiŋmariba ni fo bɛ noya.
en: Because God gives him victory, the king will rejoice. Those who make promises in God's name will praise him, but the mouths of liars will be shut.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli Firawuna, Pa mani n-wuhiri di gbinni maa, amaa Naawuni ni wuhi nyin Firawuna di gbinni ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: Joseph answered Pharaoh, Its not me. God will give Pharaoh a favorable response.

dag: Timoti daa mali yu suŋ Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Listra mini Aikɔnium la sani.
en: The brothers and sisters in Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa dam, ka salo kabi chaŋ ti gbaai Gaiɔs mini Aristakus bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na ka nyɛ Pool dolintab la n-dari ba tahi tiŋ maa nim laɣiŋgu shee.
en: The uproar spread throughout the whole city. The mob grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, two Macedonians who were traveling with Paul, and rushed with them to the theater.

dag: Zaawuni sara maligu maa saha ka n daa yiɣisi n nolɔbo maa puuni ni m binyɛr tɔhima la. Ka n daa gbani n-teei n nuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: When the time came for the evening sacrifice, I got up from where I had been grieving, and still wearing my torn clothes, I knelt in prayer and stretched out my hands to the Lord my God.

dag: Giliadnim yi tum alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni bahi yoli. Giligal tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ maanila maligu tiri naɣilahi. Lala zuɣu bɛ maligu bimbina maa ni ti ŋmanila kuɣa ka bɛ laɣisi duhi puu ni.
en: Yet idols are worshiped in Gilead, and those who worship them will die. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal, and the altars there will become piles of stone in the open fields.

dag: Amaa n zaŋla Lɛvinim maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bikpamba zaa.
en: I am now taking the Levites instead of all the first-born of the Israelites.

dag: N niriba maa ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn bɔrigi, bɛn guli ba taɣi ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋ-ŋmaligiri ba gindi zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu, ka bɛ tam bɛ biɛhigu shee yɛla.
en: My people have been like lost sheep. Their shepherds led them the wrong way and caused them to wander away into the mountains and hills. They forgot where their resting place was.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ nim kul kuri ma la suli ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisira saha shɛli bɛ ni daa me li hal ni zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu n ni wurim li;.
en: This city has enraged me from the day it was built to this very day, and so it must be removed from my sight.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni la ha kul kpalim be yi suhuri ni. Yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni maa ha yi kul kpalim be yi ni, dindina yi gba ni be Bia maa min o Ba Naawuni ni.
en: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya ayopɔin daa kpalim ka na bi deei bɛ tiŋgbana tarili.
en: There were still seven tribes without any land.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni daa pii ti yaannima n-chɛ ka bɛ nab pam hal saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nyɛ tinzunnima m-be Ijipti la. Ka o daa ti yihi ba nimaani o yiko ni.
en: The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors and made the people a great nation during the time they lived as foreigners in Egypt. God brought them out of Egypt by his great power.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yuui, ka Pita ti yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni mani ka Naawuni daa daŋ pii ni n chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim wum lahibal suŋ maa n nol ni ka niŋ yɛda.
en: After much debate, Peter stood and addressed them, Fellow believers, you know that, early on, God chose me from among you as the one through whom the Gentiles would hear the word of the gospel and come to believe.

dag: Chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni viɛnyɛliŋga: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: Pay close attention to what I am telling you! The Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti Duuma ni bɔri ni yi be shɛm, ka kul tumdi din tiɣir o nini. Ka lan chɛ ka yi bebu ni tooi mali wala kaman tia la tuun suŋ balibu kam ni, ka yi kul ni zoori pahiri Naawuni baŋbu puuni.
en: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛl anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa, Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni zaɣis o noli, ka bi doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah: The LORD says this: You rebelled against the LORDs word! You didnt keep the command that the LORD your God gave you!.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka a nini kpɛma n-gari bɛ nini ni kpɛm shɛm, ka chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma n-gari bɛ suhuri ni kpɛm shɛm.
en: But I will make you just as stubborn as they are, and your head just as hard.

dag: Ti yi bi ʒe yim, ŋun kul ni ʒe yim, dama o ku tooi yi omaŋ nyaaŋa.
en: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka gbaai mal o ka o ba.
en: Then they led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back and helped Jesus get on.

dag: A min a paɣa ni a bidibisi la ni bɛ paɣiba yim ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: You, your wife, your sons, and your daughters-in-law may now leave the boat.

dag: Isaka zuliya n-daa pah anahi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The fourth part of the land was given to the tribe of Issachar. Each family in that tribe got its part of the land.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gili Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa niŋ sunsuuni n-kari doli ba kuri ba n-zaŋ Nɔha hal ti paai Gibia wulimpuhili polo.
en: who were having to fight on all sides. The Israelite soldiers never let up their attack. They chased and killed the warriors of Benjamin as far as a place directly east of Gibeah.

dag: Amazia daa lan ku Ɛdom tɔbbihi tuhi pia Yalim Vinvamli ni, ka tuhi fa Sɛla m-boli di yuli Joktiɛl, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Next Amaziah struck down ten thousand Edomites in the Salt Valley and captured Sela in battle. He renamed it Jokthe-el, which is what it is still called today.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n kul dol a zaligunim maa zaa. N je ʒiri soli kam.
en: I carefully obey all your commands. So I hate anything that leads people the wrong way.

dag: ni nyaanyiriba ni bɛn baɣa ka shɛl ni ni maŋduhiriba ni bɛn yuri niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim gari Naawuni.
en: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.

dag: kaman Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la mini Mɔabnim bɛn be Ar la ni daa niŋ ma shɛm hal ka n ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
