en: Let us go through your land until we go across the Jordan River into the land that the Lord our God is giving us. Other people have let us go through their land—the people of Esau living in Seir and the Moabites living in Ar.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu biɛyanim ninvuɣ pia la daa chaŋ Ijipti ni bɛ ti da kawana.
en: So ten of Josephs brothers went to Egypt to buy grain.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa lee be ya? Wuhim ti a yura maa ni kpa shɛli polo ka ti bo o sɔŋ a.
en: Beautiful woman, where has your lover gone? Which way did your lover go? Tell us so that we can help you look for him.

dag: dama Yawɛ je tuumbiɛrinima, amaa wuntizɔriba nyɛla o zɔsimnima.
en: Devious people are detestable to the LORD, but the virtuous are his close friends.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa deei da shɛŋa o ni daa bo ni o ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ʒil o bia Yisahaku; ka omaŋmaŋ mi kpuɣi buɣim mini sua n-gbib o nuu ni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli tab chana.
en: Abraham made Isaac carry the wood for the sacrifice, and he himself carried a knife and live coals for starting the fire. As they walked along together.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, gbilisimiya tibili wum n noli ni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Now then, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to what I say.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa ʒii nyabu ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ bini dihi litaafi shɛli noli tabili puuni yɛtɔɣa, ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ku tooi karim li, bini ka bɛ zaŋ dihi di noli tabili.
en: The meaning of every prophetic vision will be hidden from you; it will be like a sealed scroll. If you take it to someone who knows how to read and ask him to read it to you, he will say he can't because it is sealed.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋla sida dapaɣa n-kpahi tabili duu maa puuni dukpina gbinni zaŋ hal ti gbaai siiliŋ yɔɣira, ka zaŋ dari mali di puuni; ka zaŋ sipirɛs dapaɣa mi m-mali di puuni tiŋa.
en: He built the walls within the temple with cedar planks, paneled from the floor to the ceiling. He overlaid the floor of the temple with pine planks.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa.
en: I said to all the people of Judah and of Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa yɛli Amɔs, Anabi, zom kuli Juda tiŋgban ni nti tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka nyari diri nimaani.
en: Then Amaziah told me, Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋun pɔra ni ŋun nyɛ tarima daŋ ni yɛligi n-leei zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Di saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka di niŋ lala yomyom. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ!.
en: Even your smallest and humblest family Will become as great as a powerful nation. When the right time comes, I will make this happen quickly. I am the Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn doli chaŋ ti tuhi ba? Ka Jɛhɔram garigi yɛl o, Ti yɛn dolila Ɛdom yɔɣu polo chaŋ.
en: Which road should we take? Joram asked. Jehoshaphat responded, The road that goes through the Edomite wilderness.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan yɛli Yisifu, N daa bi tɛhi ni n ni lan nya a ni n nini, amaa ka Naawuni mi ti chɛ ka n nya a bihi gba.
en: Then Israel said to Joseph, I never thought I would see your face again. But look! God has let me see you and your children.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Nyin Sintani, man Yawɛ kpahir a zuɣu ni! Man Yawɛ ŋun pii Jɛrusalɛm la kpahir a zuɣu ni! Doo ŋɔ ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni.
en: And the LORD said to the Adversary: The LORD rebukes you, Adversary. The LORD, the one choosing Jerusalem, rebukes you. Is this one not a log snatched from the fire.

dag: Amaa zuɣulan maa daa yi ti kpi, bɛ lan ŋmaligirimi tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din bie n-gari bɛ yaannim dini. Bɛ daa kul jɛmdila wuna ka damdir li tiŋa. Bɛ daa bi saɣi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa shɛli bee n-chɛ bɛ tipawumli soya la dolibu.
en: But when each judge died, the Israelites again sinned and started worshiping the false gods. They acted worse than their ancestors did. The Israelites were very stubborn and refused to change their evil ways.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ mali maligu ti Naawuni la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti beni.
en: The governor ordered them not to eat of the most holy food until a priest arose who could consult Urim and Thummim.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram ʒii nyabu puuni, Ibram, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, n ni gbib a ka chɛ ka a laara ti galisi pam.
en: Later the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision, Abram, don't be afraid! I will protect you and reward you greatly.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana bi nyar o suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa, amaa ŋun tumdi tuun kpɛma ŋun nyar o suhu ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa.
en: The lazy have strong desires but receive nothing; the appetite of the diligent is satisfied.

dag: yin piimiya yi dan bidibisi maa ni ŋun be viɛnyɛla ka simdi ni o niŋ naa n-zaŋ o ʒil o ba nam ʒiishee; ka tuhi sɔŋ yi naa maa daŋ niriba.
en: you are to choose the best qualified of the king's descendants, make him king, and fight to defend him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli ba, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Jesus looked around at his disciples and said to them, How hard it will be for rich people to enter the Kingdom of God.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ ni Yisa baŋya ni ŋuna n-shih o maa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni salo maa zaa ninni, n-kahigi wuhi daliri din chɛ ka o shih o ka dii nya alaafee maa.
en: The woman knew that she could not hide, so she came trembling and knelt down in front of Jesus. She told everyone why she had touched him and that she had been healed at once.

dag: Amaa ka o daa fɔh o nuu maa kpɛhi, ka o mabia maa daŋ o yibuna; ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda maa yɛli, A niŋla kpaɣikpaɣi nya soli yina maa! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Pɛrɛz.
en: But that baby pulled his hand back in, so the other baby was born first. So the nurse said, You were able to break out first! So they named him Perez.

dag: O ni yihi ma zaɣ biɛɣukam ni, ka ni gbib ma hal nti paag o daalizanda nam ni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Dama nyin daa niŋ li la ashilɔni, amaa man yɛn niŋ li la palɔni wuntaŋ ni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni. .
en: You did what you did secretly, but I will do what I am doing before all Israel in the light of day.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yaakubu leei bundana ka mali biŋkɔbiri pam, ka mali daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: In this way Jacob became very wealthy. He had many flocks, slaves, camels, and donkeys.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla ka mali hal ti baai du teeku yaɣili.
en: When the disciples arrived on the other side of the lake, they had forgotten to bring bread.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered, You surely have read what David did when he and his followers were hungry.

dag: Ka Sɔdom naa maa daa yɛli Ibram, Zaŋm niriba ŋɔ ti ma, amaa ka mali nɛma ŋɔ zaa.
en: The king of Sodom said to Abram, Keep the loot, but give me back all my people.

dag: Di viɛl ni ti paɣi nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa, ka yili yila paɣ a yuli;.
en: How good it is to give thanks to you, O Lord , to sing in your honor, O Most High God.

dag: ka Bɔaz daa nyɛ Obɛd ba, ka Obɛd mi daa nyɛ Jɛsi ba.
en: Boaz was Obeds father. Obed was Jesses father.

dag: M pun zaŋ n naa maa ʒili Ziɔn din nyɛ n zo kasi la zuɣu.
en: I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.

dag: Ka Zakaria yɛli malaika maa, N kurigiya, ka m paɣ gba kurigi pam. Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Zechariah said to the angel, How can I know that what you say is true? I am an old man, and my wife is also old.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kpani lu ninvuɣ kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku ba ka zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Now Zeruiahs son Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Thirty. He raised his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and made a name for himself along with the Three.

dag: A min a bidibisi yi yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni, yin di nyu wain bee binnyɔr kpiɔŋ, yi yi niŋ lala yi ni kpi; di nyɛla zaligu din kul ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam.
en: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.

dag: Amaa o ba yi bi saɣ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa shɛli ku zani; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali o ba ni bi saɣi maa zuɣu.
en: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Bɛ ni ti me gooni gili ya niŋ, ka me bimbina taɣi li, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi taɣi bɛmaŋa.
en: The towns around you he will destroy with the sword. Then he will build towers against you, erect siege ramps against you, and set up shields.

dag: Saha shɛli Samuɛl ni daa be Ɛli sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma maa, Yawɛ daa bi lan tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka niriba daa bi lan nyari ʒiinim waawaayili.
en: In those days, when the boy Samuel was serving the Lord under the direction of Eli, there were very few messages from the Lord , and visions from him were quite rare.

dag: Kɔhigɔriba bɛn be niriba maa ni ni mal a ansarisi. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie, ka a ku lan beni yaha.
en: The merchants for the peoples hiss because of you. You have become a terror; from now on you are nothing.

dag: A yi tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa, di ni niŋ ma nyaɣisim.
en: and if you are truthful, I will really be glad.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ ya doli tiŋgban nɛli ni so wɔɣinli yuun pihinahi ni o chɛ ka yi leei tarimba, ka o zahim ya nya yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpana la bee yi ku dol li la yɛla.
en: Remember the long road on which the LORD your God led you during these forty years in the desert so he could humble you, testing you to find out what was in your heart: whether you would keep his commandments or not.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua tuumba ayi maa daa yi zoya maa polo labina chaŋ ti du mɔɣili n-labi Nan bia Jɔshua sani n-daa ti yɛl o dinkam zaa niŋ ba.
en: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.

dag: Ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa Bɛtihɔrɔn polo, ka yim zuɣu la mi daa zaŋ kpa tintariga luɣ shɛli nir ni ni zani lihi bahi tin shɛli din yuli booni Zɛbɔiim la zolɔŋ din be mɔɣu ni la polo.
en: The second group went southeast on the road to Beth Horon, and the third group went east on the road to the border. That road looks over the Valley of Zeboim toward the desert.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam mi chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni zaŋ o bahi teeku ni di naan so o zuɣu.
en: If one of these little children believes in me, and someone causes that child to sin, it will be very bad for that person. It would be better for them to have a millstone tied around their neck and be drowned in the sea.

dag: ka bɛn mi nuu be dunia ŋɔ dibu yɛla ni be kaman bɛn nuu ka di ni. Dama dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu garitimi maa.
en: those who deal in material goods, as though they were not fully occupied with them. For this world, as it is now, will not last much longer.

dag: Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa vuui daanya bimbin shɛli din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tooni la. O daa vuui li la omaŋmaŋ bimbin la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bimbin la sunsuuni n-zaŋ li zal omaŋmaŋ bimbini maa nuzaa polo.
en: The bronze altar dedicated to the Lord was between the new altar and the Temple, so Ahaz moved it to the north side of his new altar.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba zaa ka nimaani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpe ŋarima maa n-chaŋ Kapɛrinium ni bɛ ti bo Yisa shee.
en: The people saw that Jesus and his followers were not there now. So they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to find Jesus.

dag: Yi ni shɛb booni tinim la ninvuɣ gbarima, ka hal di ni dihi ma vi la zaa yoli, n saɣi lala! N tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu n-nyɛ ma la. Ka so yi bɔri ni o nyu bara binshɛli zuɣu, n gba ni tooi nyu bara lala:.
en: I am ashamed to admit that we were too timid to do those things! But if anyone dares to boast about something—I am talking like a fool—I will be just as daring.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n yur a zaligunim maa gari salima din viɛlli pam.
en: I love your commands more than gold, more than the finest gold.

dag: Ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini Dauda tɔbbihi mi daa yi n-chaŋ ti paai ba Gibiɔn biaŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ yini polo ka bɛn la mi chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ din la polo.
en: Meanwhile, Joab the son of Zeruiah was leading David's soldiers, and the two groups met at the pool in Gibeon. Abner and his men sat down on one side of the pool, while Joab and his men sat on the other side.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Nira ŋun bɔbi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nyamiya, bɛn bɔbiri bela nanim yinsi.
en: What did you go out to see? A man dressed up in refined clothes? Look, those who wear refined clothes are in royal palaces.

dag: N Duuma, dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka niriba be, din nim zaa zuɣu ka n nyɛvili be. Tim ma alaafee, ka n lan be!.
en: Lord, use this hard time to make my spirit live again. Help my spirit become strong and healthy. Help me become well! Help me live again!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni di wahala pam, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani, o yurilim maŋli ni be bɛ sani.
en: Many pains will come to the wicked, but the Lord s faithful love will surround those who trust in him.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri mini alɔbo dɔriti ni daa mali shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka kari alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahi, ka neei zoomba pam gba nina.
en: At that very time Jesus healed many people from their sicknesses, diseases, and evil spirits, and gave sight to many blind people.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti dɔni ti vi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti filiŋ pili timaŋa. Dama ti mini ti yaannim tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ, ka bi saɣi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa noli.
en: Let us lie down in our shame. Let our shame cover us like a blanket. We have sinned against the Lord our God. We and our fathers have sinned. We have not obeyed the Lord our God from the time we were children.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa mi gumdi mibu daa mi gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli.
en: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa shiri bi neei kum ni, dindina yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla yoli, ka yi na kul kpalim be yi daalahichi ni;.
en: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli salo maa, Di zabiriya so nyuli o buni zuɣu, dama ninsal nyɛvili bi dolila o ni mali shɛli.
en: And he went on to say to them all, Watch out and guard yourselves from every kind of greed; because your true life is not made up of the things you own, no matter how rich you may be.

dag: Bihi, wummiya yi ba wuhibu, wummiya li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi nya tɛhi zilima.
en: Hear, children, fatherly instruction; pay attention to gain understanding.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya ma naani ka labina nti nya kpiɔŋ ka tiligi. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi.
en: The Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, says, If you come back to me you will be saved. Only by remaining calm and trusting in me can you be strong. But you dont want to do that.

dag: Daadamnim saɣim dunia, dama bɛ birigi Naawuni zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli ni di kul beni sahakam la.
en: The earth lies polluted under its inhabitants, for they have disobeyed instruction, swept aside law, and broken the ancient covenant.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ka mali tahima saha shɛli di ni daa to ni o niŋ tahima ni o ni leei zuliya pam yaba kaman Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli yɛli, A zuliya ni ti galisi pam la.
en: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.

dag: Nyam ti bɔrɔbɔro, di daa na kul tulimi ka ti zaŋ li yi yiŋ na ti ni daa yiɣisina dahin shɛli ni ti ti diri sol ni, amaa nyam di ni kuui ka kpe yue shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi tiri man Yawɛ la, n zaŋ li ti Lɛvinim ni di nyɛ bɛ tarili. Dinzuɣu ka m pun yɛli ni bɛ ku mali tiŋgbani Izraɛlnim sani.
en: because Ive given the Israelites one-tenth portion, which they have raised to the LORD as a gift offering, as an inheritance to the Levites. Therefore, Ive said to them, They wont inherit land among the Israelites.

dag: Dama a nyɛla tarimba ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be nandahima ni ni sɔɣiri so sani. A sani ka bɛ ni be ka sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli, ka wuntaŋ tulim gba ku paai ba. Putɔɣunim ni daa liriti niriba kaman kikaa saha sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.

dag: Nia biɛri nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din viɛla.
en: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ti niŋ Yawɛ liɣiri pɔŋ ni. Bɛ ni daa zali n daa shɛm m-bala. Ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita maa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni.
en: The Lord said to me, Put them in the Temple treasury. So I took the thirty pieces of silver—the magnificent sum they thought I was worth—and put them in the Temple treasury.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu kul yɛmi ni n chɛ ka o lab kuli yi sanna, ka yi ti nya o ka yi suhuri paligi yaha, ka man gba nandahima vuui.
en: I am all the more eager, then, to send him to you, so that you will be glad again when you see him, and my own sorrow will disappear.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalikaulinim zaa niŋdi palila o ni. Dina n-chɛ ka ti yɛri Ami, ka paɣiri Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: The yes to all of Gods promises is in Christ. And that is why we say Amen through Christ to the glory of God.

dag: Di saha ka yi dol o na ka o ti ʒini n nam ʒiishee, dama ŋuna ka m pii ni o zani n zaani n-di nam su Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: Bring him back here, and he will take my place as king. He is the one I have chosen to rule Israel and Judah.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi ni damdi tiŋa n-jɛm ma, n ni zaŋ di zaa ha ti a.
en: He said, Ill give you all these if you bow down and worship me.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla yaɣimɛriba m-be Nɛtaim mini Gɛdɛra, Bɛ daa bela naa sani nimaani n-tumd o tuma.
en: They were the potters who lived in Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king in his service.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ŋahiba paɣ dɔni, o ŋahiba maa zaɣim ka o nya maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ku dɔɣi bia hal ti kpi.
en: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A pun nya o, hal ŋuna n-dir a alizama ŋɔ.
en: Jesus said, You have seen him. In fact, he is the one speaking with you.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o. Mɔabnim daa kul chanila Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛɣuni nti fari bɛ bindira yuuni kam.
en: Elisha died, and the people buried him. One time in the spring a group of Moabite soldiers came to fight against Israel.

dag: Ba maa bi kariti so saria, amaa o zaŋ saria karibu yɛla zaa niŋla o Bia maa nuu ni.
en: Nor does the Father himself judge anyone. He has given his Son the full right to judge.

dag: Ka zuliya bɔbili ti kana ti yɛli, Kamiyana ka ti du Yawɛ zoli zuɣu n-chaŋ Yaakubu Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka o ti wuhi ti o soya, ka ti dol o soya maa. Dama wuhibu ni ti yi Ziɔn na, ka Yawɛ yɛligu yi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Many nations will go and say: Come, lets go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of Jacobs God, so that he may teach us his ways and we may walk in Gods paths! Instruction will come from Zion and the LORDs word from Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi gba bi mi yi Duuma ni yɛn labina dahin shɛli.
en: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.

dag: Ka Zilla mi daa dɔɣi Tubalikeen ŋun daa nyɛ ŋun zaŋ daanya mini kuriti m-mali tuma nɛma balibu kam zaa la. Ka Tubalikeen tizɔpaɣ daa nyɛ Naama.
en: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal-cain, the ancestor of blacksmiths and all artisans of bronze and iron. Tubal-cains sister was Naamah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n wum Izraɛlnim maa fabila zaŋ chaŋ Ijiptinim ni zaŋ ba leei daba maa polo, ka teei n ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Now, I have heard their painful cries. I know that they are slaves in Egypt. And I remember my agreement.

dag: Nyini n-ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu; ka a sɔŋsim chɛ ka n lee wɔɣirili.
en: You alone are my shield, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti niŋ bindirigu ti o nimaani, ka Maata kpuɣ bindirigu maa na ti zali, ka Lazarɔs gba daa be bɛn ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa ni.
en: They prepared a dinner for him there, which Martha helped serve; Lazarus was one of those who were sitting at the table with Jesus.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan bidibiga daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal, ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathans son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

dag: Bɛ daa bela mɔɣu ni kuhiri kaman bunsi la, ka laɣim do gɔhi tihi gbinni.
en: Among shrubs, they make sounds like donkeys; they are huddled together under a bush.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ŋun daa bo vuri maa daag o bahi ha ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti toondana mini ti sariakarita?.
en: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, Who made you our ruler and judge?.

dag: N yi ti wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

dag: Dama gɔgbihiriba gbihirila yuŋ, ka danyuriba gba nyuri kuuni yuŋ.
en: People who sleep, sleep at night. People who drink too much, drink at night.

dag: Manaasa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Makiri daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Makirinima. Makiri bia n-daa nyɛ Giliad; ka Giliad daŋ niriba nyɛ Giliadnima.
en: Manassehs family groups were Makir—the Makirite family groups. Gilead—the Gileadite family groups.

dag: Yi ni nya ka so ku tooi chihi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa zuɣu di simdi ni yi gbaai yimaŋa ka di niŋ shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you must calm down. Dont be reckless.

dag: Di saha maa man Daniɛl daa kul bela fabila ni zaŋ hal ti paai bakɔi muna ata.
en: At that time I was mourning for three weeks.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lan yɛl o ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu chɛ ka o lo ni pa Mɔdɛkai kɔŋko ka o ni ku. Dinzuɣu ka Haman daa bo soli ni o ku Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn nyɛ Mɔdɛkai zuliya m-be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam sulinsi maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: and when he learned that Mordecai was a Jew, he decided to do more than punish Mordecai alone. He made plans to kill every Jew in the whole Persian Empire.

dag: Naa maa yi ti yɛn kpe, ŋun doli zɔntua din be dunɔdal la ni kpe, ka ti lan doli nimaani yi.
en: When the ruler goes in, he must enter at the porch of the east gate—and he must leave that same way.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Izraɛlnim sansan ni, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka Mɔabnim maa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba ŋ-ŋmɛri kuri ba chana.
en: The Moabites came to the Israelite camp, but the Israelites came out and attacked the Moabite army. The Moabites ran away from the Israelites. The Israelites followed them into Moab to fight them.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-dɔni ninkurigu maa yiŋ dunol ni Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni daa kpe shɛl la biɛkaali saha n-do nimaani hal ka di ti neei.
en: At dawn, the woman came back to the house where her master was staying. She fell down at the front door and lay there until it was daylight.

dag: Ka Naftali bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jaziil mini Guni ni Jɛza ni Shilɛm.
en: Naphtalis sons were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li; amaa ka Yisa do di ni gbihira.
en: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun mi din be salinim suhuri ni daa di ba shɛhira n-ti ba Shia Kasi kaman o ni daa ti ti gba shɛm la.
en: God knows everyone, even their thoughts, and he accepted these non-Jewish people. He showed this to us by giving them the Holy Spirit the same as he did to us.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut yidan ma Naomi daa ti yɛl o, Di simdi ni m bo soli n-sɔŋ a ka a nya doo kuli, ka di chɛ ka a gba mal a dintoli biɛhigu shee.
en: Some time later Naomi said to Ruth, I must find a husband for you, so that you will have a home of your own.

dag: Di saha ka yi dol o na ka o ti ʒini n nam ʒiishee, dama ŋuna ka m pii ni o zani n zaani n-di nam su Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: Then come back here with him. Solomon will sit on my throne and be the new king in my place. I have chosen him to be the ruler of Israel and Judah.

dag: Ka o daa ti ba bɛ ni suhi shɛli, amaa ka daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri gbahi ba.
en: He gave them what they asked for, but he also gave them a terrible disease.

dag: N lan nya binshɛli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam dunia ŋɔ ni. Niriba bɔri nyari liɣiri m-mal li sɔŋda, ka di mali ba barina.
en: Here is a terrible thing that I have seen in this world: people save up their money for a time when they may need it.

dag: Ka o daa ŋme chɛrubinim mini gbuɣima ni abie tihi kɔtomsi pa di bintaɣirisi mini di dapaɣa zuɣu kaman di zaɣ yini kam ni ni tooi deei palo shɛm tariga, ka mali biŋgolima gil li.
en: On the surfaces of the supports and panels he carved winged otherworldly creatures, lions, and palm trees with wreaths everywhere.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti shiri niŋ o ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.

dag: Piɛgul shɛb daa be tiŋ maa ni mɔɣu ni gul bɛ piɛri yuŋ.
en: That night, some shepherds were out in the fields near Bethlehem watching their sheep.

dag: Lahibal suŋ daa kala ti sanna kaman di ni daa chaŋ bɛ sani shɛm; ka bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa daa bi ku ba buchi, dama bɛn daa wum li maa daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: For we have heard the Good News, just as they did. They heard the message, but it did them no good, because when they heard it, they did not accept it with faith.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣi Ijipti naa Firawuna zɔri o bipuɣiŋga kpuɣibu zuɣu. Ka Sulemaana daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa n-zaŋ o na ti niŋ Dauda tiŋ la ni hal ka bɛ ti me omaŋmaŋ yiŋ mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm naai.
en: Solomon signed a treaty with the king of Egypt and married his daughter. She lived in the older part of Jerusalem until the palace, the Lord 's temple, and the wall around Jerusalem were completed.

dag: Bɛ nina kul kpala paɣiba bɛn nyɛ zinaniŋdiba, ka bɛ nina na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛli alahichi tumbu puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana ni bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, ka nyɛ bɛn bɔhim baŋ diribarilim tuma yɛla. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu!.
en: Every time they look at a woman, they want her. They are always sinning this way. And they lead weaker people into the trap of sin. They have taught themselves well to be greedy. They are under a curse.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi bihi ayopɔin tarigiya, o tarigiya lu. Wuntaŋ na bi lu ka yuŋ pun zib o sani. O di vi ka nya filiŋ. N ni chɛ ka bɛn kpalim lu tɔbu ni bɛ dimnim tooni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The mother who lost her seven children has fainted, gasping for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness; she is disgraced and sick at heart. I will let your enemies kill those of you who are still alive. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: N niriba maa kul kpɛrila yɔɣu ka chɛri ma, dinzuɣu ka n zali ba ni bɛ ʒi ʒi tibisa maa, ka so ku tooi yihi li.
en: My people expect me to come back. They will call to God above, but he will not help them.

dag: ka di ti nyɛ shihirili yi sani. Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Someday your children will ask, Why are these rocks here? Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.

dag: Niriba ata maa daa bi lan garigi Ayuba o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali maa zuɣu.
en: These three men stopped answering Job because he thought he was righteous.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ n ti yɛn kana, kpaŋm amaŋ karimmi Naawuni Kundi niriba ni, ka yihimi waazu, ka wuhimi niriba.
en: Continue to read the Scriptures to the people, encourage them, and teach them. Do this until I come.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim ni daa tuui lu la, di wuhiri ni bɛ daa lumi zaa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Amaa bɛ biriginsim zuɣu ka tiliginsim paai bɛn pa Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zab nyuli.
en: So Im asking you: They havent stumbled so that theyve fallen permanently, have they? Absolutely not! But salvation has come to the Gentiles by their failure, in order to make Israel jealous.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha ka Asa daa leei Juda naa.
en: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's rule in Israel.

dag: Di saha maa ha yi daa dolila dunia ŋɔ tuumbiɛri soli, ka deei Sintani ŋun su sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na yiko la noli. Ŋuna n-nyɛ shi biɛ so ŋun su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Naawuni nol la.
en: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.

dag: Ka Barakɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Buz daŋ ni nir la bia Ɛlihu maa daa garigi yɛli, Man nyɛla bia, ka yi mi nyɛ ninkura, dinzuɣu ka n di zɔri dabiɛm ka shini, ka bi yɛli ya din be n suhu ni maa.
en: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ taɣimiya yi biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi binshɛɣukam zaa din be mɔɣu ni kulisi yiŋa, dama daadam bee biŋkɔbigu ŋun be mɔɣu ni ka bi kuli yiŋa, sakuɣa maa ni lu n-ku ba. .
en: So bring under shelter your livestock and all that belongs to you that is out in the open. Every person or animal that is out in the open field and isnt brought inside will die when the hail rains down on them.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sɛrɛd daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Sɛrɛdnima; ka Ɛlɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛlɔnnima; ka Jaaliil daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaaliilnima.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Zebulun; they were from the clans of Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

dag: Di saha maa Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la daa gbibila bɛ tɔbutuhiri bidibbina ʒe dunol ni.
en: Meanwhile the six hundred Danite soldiers, ready for battle, were standing at the gate.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti lan lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Dauda daa pah o tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti tuhi hal ka di ti gbarigi Dauda.
en: There was another war between the Philistines and Israel, and David and his men went and fought the Philistines. During one of the battles David grew tired.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bi niŋ yɛlimaŋli la yɛda, amaa ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla alahichi tumbu nyaɣisim zuɣu la ni ti nya saria karibu.
en: They will all be condemned because they did not believe the truth and because they enjoyed doing evil.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo a dabili Dauda alikauli shɛli maa niŋ pali.
en: Again, Lord , God of Israel, I ask you to keep the promise you made to your servant, my father David.

dag: Amaa ti mi ku tooi zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti ba. Dama tinim Izraɛlnim pun po n-yɛli ni ti ni so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga n-ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, noli din dim o.
en: But we cannot allow our daughters to marry the men of Benjamin. We have made this promise: Bad things will happen to anyone who gives a wife to a man of Benjamin.

dag: Yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zaa zuɣu, n ni niŋ ya n ni na ʒi n-niŋ ya shɛm, ka mi ku lan niŋ di kpee yaha.
en: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.

dag: O daa tim o yɛligu na ti tib ba, ka daa yihi ba kum ni.
en: He gave the command and healed them, so they were saved from the grave.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi nya a ni darigi so tibili maa. Di luhiya ni paɣiba ŋubiri bɛ bihi? Bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba? Di luhiya ni bɛ ku maligumaaniba mini anabinim ti Duuma jɛmbu duu?.
en: Think about it, Lord ! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?.

dag: Binnamda zaa kul guhirimi ka bɛ suhuri kul ye saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn yih o bihi palɔni la zuɣu;.
en: The whole creation waits breathless with anticipation for the revelation of Gods sons and daughters.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a niriba ni, ka yili yila paɣ a zuliya kam ni.
en: I will praise you, Lord , for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn daa bi kpalim ʒe bɛ zaashee, ka daa chɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee la, Naawuni zaŋ saha din ka bahigu zoligɔnim lo ba zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali din nyɛ dabisi titali dal la.
en: And remember the angels who lost their authority to rule. They left their proper home. So the Lord has kept them in darkness, bound with everlasting chains, to be judged on the great day.

dag: Paɣimiya ti Duuma ŋun kul gbib ti dabisili kam ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ti tiliginsim.
en: Praise the Lord, who carries our burdens day after day; he is the God who saves us.

dag: Ka n teei ti Duuma ni daa yɛli ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinima ni dee la Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu la yɛla.
en: I remembered that the Lord had said, John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka maligumaani so doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ gari ka chɛ o.
en: Now it just so happened that a priest was also going down the same road. When he saw the injured man, he crossed over to the other side of the road and went on his way.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi di nya soli n-tuhi fa bindir shɛŋa bɛ dimnim ŋɔ sani di naan so, dama bɛ dii bi ku Filistianim maa pam zuŋɔ.
en: It would have been even better if the troops had eaten some of their enemies plunder today when they found it! But now the Philistine defeat isnt as thorough as it might have been.

dag: O yɛliya, N niriba, gbilisimiya tibili ka n yɛli ya ka yi wum. Izraɛlnima, n ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya. Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la.
en: God says, My people, listen to me! People of Israel, I will show my evidence against you. I am God, your God.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmd a suhuri paligi, ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Naawuni galisiya.
en: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, God is wonderful.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrimia bia Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Habazinia yaaŋa la min o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni o bidibisi zaa ni Rɛkab daŋ niriba zaa na.
en: So I took Jaazaniah, Jeremiahs son and Habazziniahs grandson, and his brothers and all his sons, and the whole Rechabite family.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa yi tɔɣisi viɛnyɛliŋga, di ŋmanila salima zaɣ kpil shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ kpɛh anzinfa binyara ni.
en: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.

dag: Tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa be nimaani, ka daba nya bɛmaŋ bɛ duumanim sani.
en: Both small and great are there; a servant is free from his masters.

dag: Dama o ʒiɛla nandaamba nudirigu polo ni o tiligi ba bɛn yɛn wuhi ni bɛ simdi kum la nuu ni.
en: He stands by the helpless and saves them from those who try to put them to death.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Kundi wuhiya ni sokam zaa bela alahichi sulinsi ni ni di chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu puuni la tooi paai bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: But the scripture says that the whole world is under the power of sin; and so the gift which is promised on the basis of faith in Jesus Christ is given to those who believe.

dag: Na kul yum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la, ka ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la polo.
en: Continue to love those who really know you, and do good to those who are true to you.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi dol o gbin na yɛra, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali din daa muɣisi zuliya kam ka bɛ nyu di kɔr biɛri wain la luya.
en: A second angel followed and said, The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.

dag: Paɣ maa yi dɔɣila bipuɣiŋga, o ni be daɣiri ni biɛɣu pinaanahi kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la. Di nyaaŋa o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: But if she gives birth to a girl, the mother will be unclean for days, just as she is during her monthly time of bleeding. Because of the blood from childbirth, another days must pass before she becomes clean.

dag: Amaa yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa saria n-doli yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But Israel, you say that what I do isn't right. I am going to judge you by what you do.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia ka di ti chɛ biɛla ni o kpi, ka o daa suhu Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu maa, ka wuh o shihirili.
en: About this time King Hezekiah became sick and almost died. He prayed, and the Lord gave him a sign that he would recover.

dag: Amaa o zuɣu palo maa ni bee gbɛ palo maa ni yi mali dɔr biɛɣu bimmɔriŋ zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu m-piligir o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni maa.
en: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai zom maa nuu ni vo o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti tuhi nintɔri ta o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi shih o ka bɔh o, A nya shɛli.
en: Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. After spitting on the man's eyes, Jesus placed his hands on him and asked him, Can you see anything.

dag: A mini niriba maa kul yɛn gbarigimi zaa. Tuma maa yaɣ a kɔŋko tuma, a kɔŋko ku tooi tumdi li.
en: You will wear yourself out and these people as well. This is too much for you to do alone.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhu yini, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun mali suhu yini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinima, a nyɛla ŋun nyandi ba.
en: You are pure toward the pure, but toward the crooked, you are tricky.

dag: Nadab bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sɛlɛd mini Apaim. Amaa Sɛlɛd ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Abishur's brother Nadab had two sons, Seled and Appaim, but Seled died without having any sons.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali bans anahi tam daanya kurupooti maa naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu din yɛn gbibi di dapuhi.
en: He made four rings for each of the four corners of the copper grate to house the poles.

dag: Ka sapashin so dabiyurigu daa biɛra n-tarigi.
en: A centurion had a servant who was very important to him, but the servant was ill and about to die.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira maa ni bɛn ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba, di ŋubiya laakum, dama o gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa o ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, o nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: but you must not eat camels, rock badgers, or rabbits. These must be considered unclean; they chew the cud, but do not have divided hoofs.

dag: Labisim li su di tɔɣu ni. N yɛn kari ya la saria n ni daa nam ya luɣ shɛl la, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yi piligu shee la ni ka n yɛn kari ya saria.
en: Put the sword back in its sheath. Babylon, I will judge you in the place where you were created, in the land where you were born.

dag: Paɣisarili maa daa viɛl pam, ka lan nyɛ paɣipiɛliga ŋun mini doo na bi dɔni. Ka o daa chaŋ kɔbiliga maa ni nti ŋɔŋ kom du na.
en: The young woman was very beautiful, old enough to be married, and hadnt known a man intimately. She went down to the spring, filled her water jar, and came back up.

dag: Yi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu puuni, yi mali yi suhu ni bɔri binshɛɣukam ka diri nyaɣisim pam. Yi dihi yimaŋa ŋ-ŋmɛlim kaman biŋkɔbiri bɛn ʒe n-guli bɛ kɔrigibu dali.
en: Your life on earth was full of rich living. You pleased yourselves with everything you wanted. You made yourselves fat, like an animal ready for the day of slaughter.

dag: Di pa shɛli a shiri paɣirila Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa di pala din ni kpaŋsi so suhu.
en: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.

dag: n zaliya ni Izraɛlnim zaa bee bɛ maligumaaniba bee bɛ Lɛvinim bɛn be n nam sulinsi ni ka bɛ suhu yu ni bɛ kuli Jɛrusalɛm, bɛn dol a kuli.
en: I decree that any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom who volunteer to go to Jerusalem with you may go.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Isaka zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Kishiɔn mini Dɛbɛrat.
en: From the tribe of Issachar: Kishion and its pastures, Daberath and its pastures.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli n dana, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti zaŋ a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: What the LORD says to my master: Sit right beside me until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.

dag: Di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisiri yomyom, dama jɛra suhuri ni ka suhuyiɣisili be.
en: Dont become angry quickly, because anger is foolish.

dag: N yi yɛn kal li, di galisi gari bihigu. N yi gbihi nti neei, n kul bela a sani.
en: If I counted them, they would be more than the grains of sand. When I awake, I am still with you.

dag: Hal o ni daa ŋme tampiŋ ka kom tɔhi yi di ni na zɔri maa, o ni tooi ti bindira gba bee n-ti o niriba nimdi.
en: Yes, he struck the rock and a flood of water came out. But can he give us bread and meat.

dag: Ka Musa daa yihi biŋkpam din daa be namanama ni zaa mini binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina mini di biŋkpam n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Moses removed all the fat that was around the insides, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and he completely burned it on the altar.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti suh o, o ni deei yi suhigu, ka yi yi ti ŋme kuŋa m-bɔri sɔŋsim, o ni yɛli, M be kpe ni n sɔŋ ya. Yi yi ni ti yi ni nahindi shɛb la vuhim, ka chɛ niriba ansarisi malibu ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu;.
en: When you pray, I will answer you. When you call to me, I will respond. If you put an end to oppression, to every gesture of contempt, and to every evil word;.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi Jɛsi, A bidibisi maa zaa m-be kpe ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Di kpalimla biasani, amaa ŋun gulila piɛri. Ka Samuɛl yɛli Jɛsi, Timmi ti zaŋ o na, dama ti ku ʒini ka pa ni o paala kpe na.
en: Then he asked Jesse, Are these all the sons you have? Jesse answered, No, I have another son—my youngest, but he is out taking care of the sheep. Samuel said, Send for him. Bring him here. We wont sit down to eat until he arrives.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni kari saria wuhi din be piɛ titali mini piɛ kɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: So now, I, the Sovereign Lord , tell you that I will judge between you strong sheep and the weak sheep.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, o yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: This was the Lord God Almighty—the Lord is the name by which he is to be worshiped.

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi ti po pɔri din nyɛ Nazari pɔri ni o wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite.

dag: O zuɣu ka yi niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neeg o kum ni ka ti o jilima la naani ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi tahima niŋbu zaa bela Naawuni ni.
en: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.

dag: Manna maa daa ŋmanila tiwal shɛli din biɛlim pɔripɔra, ka di kɔtomsi nyɛ zaɣ piɛlifaa kaman dɔzim la.
en: The manna was like small whitish seeds.

dag: saha shɛli taŋkpagbiligu yi ti laɣim niŋ tampuɣa ka tampuɣa maa tabili taba?.
en: on the dry, lumpy soil?.

dag: Deemi ti suhigu, ka zaŋ a kpiɔŋ la n-ti ti nasara, ka lala chɛ ka a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la tiligi.
en: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa luhi, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: It rained hard, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house. And it fell with a loud crash.

dag: Iso ni daa nya ka Yisahaku niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni ka chɛ ka o kuli Mɛsopoteemia ni o ti kpuɣi paɣ nimaani maa, ka lan baŋ ni o ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni maa o daa yɛl o mi, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Esau found out that his father Isaac had blessed Jacob and had warned him not to marry any of the Canaanite women. He also learned that Jacob had been sent to find a wife in northern Syria.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, N fabilimi niŋ naa ni o di lan zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ ka n ti kpi nimaani. .
en: Just tell them you were begging me not to send you back to prison to die there.

dag: Alikauli maa zuɣu ka ti zuliya pinaayi jɛmdi Naawuni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka mali tahima ni ti ti nya di palibu. Naa, tahima maa zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim ŋmari ma tiŋŋmaŋ maa.
en: Day and night our twelve tribes have earnestly served God, waiting for his promised blessings. King Agrippa, because of this hope, some of our leaders have brought charges against me.

dag: Ka a ti yihi kpa shɛli din zaa be naɣilaa maa binnyɔri ni mini binsaba ni yaannina mini kpam din be di ni n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Next, take all the fat which covers the internal organs, the best part of the liver, and the two kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar as an offering to me.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mal li ka di be kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: See to it that you make them according to the blueprint for them that you were shown on the mountain.

dag: Ti tum alahichi ka birigi, ka a bi chɛ ti taali.
en: Let us say to him, We have sinned and have been stubborn. Because of this, you have not forgiven us.

dag: Judas ŋun daa yi o nyaaŋa la daa mi tihi puu maa ni, dama Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yi kul chanila nimaani waawaayili.
en: Judas, the traitor, knew where it was, because many times Jesus had met there with his disciples.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka mi bi lan niŋ di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ. Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa wum ninsal ni yɛli shɛm, dama Yawɛ daa tuhi ti Izraɛlnima.
en: Never before, and never since, has there been a day like it, when the Lord obeyed a human being. The Lord fought on Israel's side!.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni yɛla polo taɣi ʒiri, ka doli binnamda n-jɛmdi li ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa namda ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: They traded the truth of God for a lie. They bowed down and worshiped the things God made instead of worshiping the God who made those things. He is the one who should be praised forever. Amen.

dag: Dama nyini n Duuma n-nyɛ n tahima. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Sovereign Lord , I put my hope in you; I have trusted in you since I was young.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o paɣ min o bidibisi balisi buŋa n-labi Ijipti, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee la gbib o nuu ni.
en: So Moses put his wife and sons on donkeys and headed for Egypt, holding the walking stick that had the power of God.

dag: A chɛ ka a mini Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ a ʒiʒiinitaba, ka nyɛ kɔribiɛrinim la tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam, ni a chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: You let your lustful neighbors, the Egyptians, go to bed with you, and you used your prostitution to make me angry.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi maligumaaniba maa yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka Lɛvinim mi bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, bɛ yuya ka bɛ daa sabira kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni kaman bɛ ni daa piripiri ba shɛm.
en: The priests were listed in the official records by clans, and the Levites years old and older were listed by their duties.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be nimaani maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di saha maa, ka puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi chuɣu daba ayopɔin.
en: The worshipers then celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread for the next seven days.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi gbibi alikauli.
en: that I, the Lord God of Israel, have placed a curse on everyone who does not obey the terms of this covenant.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba la ti kpi Lɛvinim ni.
en: Be careful! Dont let these Kohathite men be destroyed.

dag: Mani, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti guli m piɛri maa, ka n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ dɔni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I promise to take care of them and keep them safe.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi niriba ŋaha yɛli.
en: Jesus responded by speaking again in parables.

dag: dama Naawuni nyɛla yino ka ni chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn guni yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka mi ni lan chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka bi guni la gba yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Since God is one, then the one who makes the circumcised righteous by faith will also make the one who isnt circumcised righteous through faith.

dag: ni n Naawuni. N suhu kul saɣindimi. Dinzuɣu ka n teer a yɛla Jɔɔdɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Mizar Zoli zuɣu.
en: My whole being is depressed. Thats why I remember you from the land of Jordan and Hermon, from Mount Mizar.

dag: O bidib kpɛm sani yuli daa boonila Joɛl, ka ŋun paya mi yuli booni Abija; Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba zuɣulaannima.
en: The older son was named Joel and the younger one Abijah; they were judges in Beersheba.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Tama, Cham a tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti o.
en: David sent messengers to Tamars house. They told her, Go to your brother Amnons house and make some food for him.

dag: Zaɣisimiya zaɣ biɛɣu ka yu zaɣ viɛlli, ka doliya din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Di pa shɛli yi yi niŋ lala, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni zo Yisifu zuliya bɛn kpalim la nambɔɣu.
en: Hate what is evil, love what is right, and see that justice prevails in the courts. Perhaps the Lord will be merciful to the people of this nation who are still left alive.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o paɣ maa, N yɛlila Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la, Zaŋm a wain tihi puu ŋɔ n-kɔhi n zuɣu bee a yi bɔra, n ni taɣ a wain tihi pu shɛli, ka o yɛli ma, N ku zaŋ n wain tihi ti a. .
en: Ahab answered, I asked Naboth from Jezreel to give me his vineyard. I told him that I would pay him the full price. Or, if he preferred, I would give him another vineyard. But he refused to give it to me.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka sɔhigi; ka zoya gbina ni gba sɔhigi ka dam, o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: The earth shook and shivered. The foundations of the mountains trembled. They shook because he was angry.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa min o gbaŋ ni o nimdi ni o bindi dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: He took the rest of the bull, including its skin, flesh, and intestines, and burned it outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ .
en: I am the God who appeared to you at Bethel, where you dedicated a stone as a memorial by pouring olive oil on it and where you made a vow to me. Now get ready and go back to the land where you were born.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bu jɛrigu ŋun gariti paa bee m-bu ŋun nyu dam kuli paa ŋmanila peentɔra ŋun tɔri sokam piɛma tiri ba dansi.
en: Hiring a fool or a stranger who is just passing by is dangerous—you dont know who might get hurt.

dag: Hal shinshingoorɔnim mi bɛ yiŋ labbu saha. Ka ŋmanʒee mini sakpaleeŋa ni noombihi bɛn daari doli taba zaa gba mi bɛ kandina saha. Amaa n niriba bɛn bi mi Yawɛ zaligunima.
en: Even the birds in the sky know the right time to do things. The storks, doves, swifts, and thrushes know when it is time to fly to a new home. But my people dont know what the Lord wants them to do.

dag: Di simdi ni yi kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: Instead, you must be perfect before the LORD your God.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani ninvuɣ so yi go piɛli gbaai biŋkɔbigu bee nooŋa ŋun ŋubbu bi chihira, dilan ŋun kɔrigim bini maa ʒim bahi tiŋa, ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu pa di zuɣu.
en: If any of you, whether Israelite or foreigner living among you, goes hunting and kills a wild animal or bird that you are allowed to eat, you must pour the blood of that animal on the ground and cover it with dirt.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m mi ni n ni gili yihi Naawuni nam waazu yi ninvuɣ shɛb sani zaa ŋɔ ku lan nya ma ni yi nini yaha.
en: And now listen to me. I know that none of you will ever see me again. All the time I was with you, I told you the Good News about Gods kingdom.

dag: bee so binshɛli yi bɔrigi ka o pihi li ka ŋma ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ di polo bee m-pɔri ʒiri pɔri zaŋ chaŋ niriba ni tumdi binshɛŋa zaa ka di nyɛ alahichi polo.
en: or, though youve found lost property, you lie about it; or by swearing falsely about anything that someone might do and so sin.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti diri wahala ka tumdi ti yaa tariga, dama ti zaŋ ti tahima zaa niŋla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Tiligira, di bahi bamdi bɛn niŋ o yɛda la.
en: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.

dag: Bɛ naa daa nyɛla bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la malaika ŋun Hiburu yuli booni Abadɔn, ka o Giriiki yuli mi booni Apoliɔn la. Di gbinni nyɛla, Saɣinda.
en: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.

dag: Nir yi chɛ ka o nini tiɣ o ni mali shɛli, di so ni o mali kɔre biɛri. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-ka Hɛlam na. Ka Sirianim maa daa niŋ shili yina ti liri Dauda ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba.
en: When this was reported to David he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, and went to Helam. The Arameans formed battle lines against David and fought with him.

dag: Man Jɔn n-nyɛ ŋun daa wum yɛla ŋɔ, ka nya dimbɔŋɔnima. N ni daa wum li ka nya li maa, ka n daa gbani malaika so ŋun wuhi ma binyara maa tooni ni n jɛm o;.
en: I am John. I am the one who heard and saw these things. After I heard and saw them, I bowed down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli, ka zaŋya daba ayopɔin puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Gather for worship on the fifteenth day of the seventh month. Celebrate this festival in honor of the Lord for seven days and do no work.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: But that very night the LORDs word came to Nathan.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ bia maa nti ti o ma; ka o zaŋ o ʒil o naba zuɣu n-gbib o hal ti paai wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: The servant took the boy to his mother. The boy sat on his mothers lap until noon. Then he died.

dag: lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana ti balim ba ni bɛ niŋm suɣilo, ka daa naanyi yihi ba bahi, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋ maa ni.
en: So they went and apologized to them; then they led them out of the prison and asked them to leave the city.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛlnim sani, ka nyɛ bɛn bi guni bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ niŋgbuna ni la bi simdi ni bɛ kpe n jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Foreigners who are spiritually and physically uncircumcised must not enter my sanctuary; that is, all foreigners among the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyini ŋun yuri nyaɣisim pam ni nyini ŋun tɛhi ni shɛli ku niŋ a la, wumma! A tɛhiya ni a galisimi m-be kaman Naawuni la, ka so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A bi tɛhi ni a ni leei pakoli bee n-kɔŋ bihi.
en: So now listen, you who love only pleasure! Feeling so safe, you tell yourself, I alone am important, and no one else matters. I will never be a widow or lose my children.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yinim laɣila kum zɔri, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee lo tab alikauli. Yi niŋ yɛda ni alɔbo yi lu, di ku din ya, dama yi tɛhiya ni ʒiri mini yɔhiŋgu ni tiligi ya.
en: You said, Weve cut a deal with death; with the underworld we made a pact. When the overflowing flood passes through, it wont reach us; for we have made lies our hiding place, and in falsehood we take shelter.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha ni bɛ zaŋm tɔrokɔnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni m-mali kuli ti zaŋ bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bibihi ni yi ba n-kuli kpe na.
en: Give them these instructions too: Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your children and wives, and pick up your father and come back.

dag: Hal ti tuumbiɛri ni kul di shɛhira jɛndi ti maa zaa yoli, Yawɛ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli zuɣu. Ti zoya ka chɛ a siɣimsiɣim bushɛm, ka tum alahichi pam a sani.
en: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord , everyone will see how great you are.

dag: Nina neesim chɛ ka nir suhu piɛla, ka lahibali viɛlli tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: Smiling faces make you happy, and good news makes you feel better.

dag: Di saha maa ka anab shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: About that time, some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

dag: Lumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka jɛmiy o kɔŋko, ka zaŋya yimaŋ ti o, ka zaŋd o yuli pɔri pɔri.
en: Revere the LORD your God, serve him, cling to him, swear by his name alone!.

dag: Zɛbadia mini Mɛshulam ni Hiziki ni Hɛbɛr.
en: Elpaals sons were Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Zikiri bia Amasia ŋun daa saɣi n-zaŋ omaŋ niŋ Yawɛ tuma ni la. O mi daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisiyi.
en: Amasiah was the general of , soldiers. Amasiah was Zicris son. Amasiah was happy to give himself to serve the Lord .

dag: Ka o bihi maa daalahichi daa ti galisi pam Yawɛ sani, dama bɛ daa bi tiri Yawɛ sara maligu pina maa jilima.
en: This sin of the sons of Eli was extremely serious in the Lord 's sight, because they treated the offerings to the Lord with such disrespect.

dag: Di saha maa ha yi daa dolila dunia ŋɔ tuumbiɛri soli, ka deei Sintani ŋun su sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na yiko la noli. Ŋuna n-nyɛ shi biɛ so ŋun su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Naawuni nol la.
en: At that time you followed the world's evil way; you obeyed the ruler of the spiritual powers in space, the spirit who now controls the people who disobey God.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Judanim ni ti nya tiliginsim, ka Izraɛlnim mi be ni alaafee. O yuli ti yɛn boonila, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia. .
en: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be The Lord Gives Justice.

dag: Yi ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli mali yimaŋa ka yi biɛhigu be kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi yuri yi mabihi yurilim maŋli ni la zuɣu, kul yumiya taba yi suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: As you set yourselves apart by your obedience to the truth so that you might have genuine affection for your fellow believers, love each other deeply and earnestly.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi kuhi boli bɛ ni bi niŋ so yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi niŋ bɛ ni na bi wum so yɛla yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi wum ka pa ni waazuyihira m-beni?.
en: So how can they call on someone they dont have faith in? And how can they have faith in someone they havent heard of? And how can they hear without a preacher?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ gbaai tab bɔhibu, Ka ŋuni n-lee ti yɛn biligi kuɣ shɛli din yo siliga maa nol la ti ti?.
en: On their way, they were asking one another, Who will roll the stone away from the entrance for us.

dag: Ka Dauda daa po lala pɔri maa Sool sani. Di saha ka Sool daa kuli, ka Dauda min o niriba maa mi labi bɛ sɔɣisili maa shee.
en: David made a solemn pledge to Saul. Then Saul went back home, but David and his soldiers went up to the fortress.

dag: Naa, a daa nya binnan titali. Binnani maa daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka kul nyɛlisira, ka mali dabiɛm pam.
en: King, in your dream you saw a large statue in front of you that was very large and shiny. It was very impressive.

dag: Ka Pita daa zaŋ ba kpe duu ka o mini ba ti gbe. N-yi biɛɣu ka Pita yiɣisi ni o mini Kɔniilius tuumba maa chaŋ, ka Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔpa pahi Pita zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Peter invited them into the house as his guests. The next day he got up and went with them, together with some of the believers from Joppa.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha, ka wuntaŋ daa bi lan ne. Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu la cheei di sunsuuni m-pirigi buyi.
en: It was about twelve o'clock when the sun stopped shining and darkness covered the whole country until three o'clock; and the curtain hanging in the Temple was torn in two.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ pun niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuma zaa puuni. O mi yi ni be tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ŋɔ ni chani ŋɔ yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul bela yi sani yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa, ka binshɛli bi pooi ya.
en: No doubt about it: the LORD your God has blessed you in all that you have done. He watched over your journey through that vast desert. Throughout these forty years the LORD your God has been with you. You havent needed a thing.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma jilima. N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi leei m bia, ka n chɛ ka o nam mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam.
en: He will build a temple for me. He will be my son, and I will be his father. His dynasty will rule Israel forever.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, di yi nyɛla nyini m-bala, nyin chɛ ka n tam kom ŋɔ zuɣu ka a sanna.
en: Then Peter spoke up. Lord, if it is really you, order me to come out on the water to you.

dag: Dama di sab o yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: This is confirmed: You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek. .

dag: N yura ŋmanila tipum din yirigi Ɛngɛdi wain tihi puu ni.
en: My lover is like a bunch of henna flowers near the vineyards of En Gedi.

dag: Zuɣulaan so ŋun daa pah anu n-su gol so ŋun pahi anu ni n-daa nyɛ Shamhut, o daa nyɛla Izira nira. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The fifth commander, for the fifth month, was Shamhuth from Zerahs family. There were , men in Shamhuths group.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka labina.
en: The men explored that country for days, and then they went back to the camp.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla din bari ti suhuri zaana. Dina n-nyɛ din chɛ ka ti gariti chinchini la zuɣu kpɛri du kasi shɛl ni.
en: This hope is like an anchor for us. It is strong and sure and keeps us safe. It goes behind the curtain.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko nyɛla ŋun kul niŋd o ni bɔri shɛli, ka o nini bi tiɣiri shɛb ni tumdi din tuhi ka di viɛli shɛm.
en: People who do not get along with others are interested only in themselves; they will disagree with what everyone else knows is right.

dag: A yɛliya, N ka taali, m bi tum birigi shɛli, n kul bela kasi, ka taali shɛli ka n kɔbili ni.
en: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti boli paɣisarili maa na nti bɔh o nya.
en: They answered, Let's call her and find out what she has to say.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn bahiri yoli.
en: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.

dag: O ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naai, o daa zaŋ ma mi doli duno shɛli din be wulimpuhili polo la yi nti buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa palo zaa gili.
en: When the man had finished measuring inside the Temple area, he took me out through the east gate and then measured the outside of the area.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kum o kuli, ka zaŋ o ti sɔɣi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Ahija yɛli shɛm la.
en: All Israel buried him and mourned him in agreement with the LORDs word spoken through his servant the prophet Ahijah.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tooi daaŋa ni tampiligim chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni, ka Musa daa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma, ka di daa tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: So they took a few handfuls of ashes and went to the king. Moses threw them into the air, and sores immediately broke out on the Egyptians and their animals.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn namdi tuumbiɛri tumbu, ka wuhiri niriba yikombiɛlim tuma tiŋ maa ni.
en: God said to me, Mortal man, these men make evil plans and give bad advice in this city.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Aai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, n na ʒi n-saɣim mmaŋa. M bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi ŋ-ŋubi biŋkɔb kpiŋ bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku biŋkɔb so. Ka nimdi din pooi mi na ʒi n-lu n noli ni.
en: I said, Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi shɛb tabili dapula m-pahi Yisa zuɣu maa ni yino daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi Yisa zuɣu m-bɔhir o, A pala Masia? Tiligim amaŋa, ka tiligi ti pahi.
en: One of the criminals hanging next to Jesus insulted him: Arent you the Christ? Save yourself and us.

dag: Yaa be o nyiŋgoli ni, ka dabiɛmnim ʒe o tooni ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles.

dag: Hiram daa lan yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa ni dunia, ka nyɛ ŋun ti Naa Dauda bi so ŋun mali baŋsim mini yɛm, ka lan mi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga, din ni me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka lan me omaŋmaŋ nam yili ŋɔ.
en: Hiram also said, Praise the Lord , the God of Israel! He made heaven and earth. He gave a wise son to King David. Solomon, you have wisdom and understanding. You are building a Temple for the Lord . You are also building a palace for yourself.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: Then he will show you a large upstairs room, fixed up and furnished, where you will get everything ready for us.

dag: Anab maa daa lan tɔɣisi shihirili shɛli yɛla dindali maa yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shihirili shɛli yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, bimbini ŋɔ, a ni ti wurim, ka tampiligim din pa a zuɣu kpaai bahi.
en: You will know that the Lord has said these things when the altar splits in half, and the ashes on it fall to the ground.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu yo n-zaŋ li zali luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Place the gold cover on the chest containing the covenant in the holiest space.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi ti kul biri bimbirili kam, Midiannim maa mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim kanimina ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Whenever the Israelites would plant their crops, the Midianites would come with the Amalekites and the desert tribes and attack them.

dag: O bi zaŋdi bini din ni saɣim siŋkaafa buri li. O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ naɣikɔra tɔroko kpe di ni no li ka di biɛlim ku bɔɣi.
en: People grind grain to make flour, but they dont grind it forever. As God does in punishing people, a worker might drive his wagon over the grain to remove the hulls, but he does not allow the horses to crush it.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛli ma, Di bi simdi ni a me yili ti ma, dama a nyɛla tɔbbia ŋun ku niriba pam.
en: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.

dag: M puhiri Akuila mini Prisila bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Yisa Masia ni la.
en: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛmaŋa n-doli tab chani buɣa maligu shee mini bɛn ŋubiri kuruchunim ni jɛŋgbarisi, ka diri bindiri yoya la bahigu saha miriya.
en: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord , will destroy you for this.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpi, ka bɛ niŋ tim ʒe o niŋgbuŋ n-zaŋ o niŋ kum adaka ni Ijipti. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: Joseph died when he was years old. They embalmed him and placed him in a coffin in Egypt.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dauda daa tuui zaŋ wumpaɣibo yilli ŋɔ ti Asaf min o mabihi maa ni bɛ yili paɣi Yawɛ.
en: On the same day, for the first time, David ordered Asaph and his relatives to give thanks to the LORD.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-she binyɛr shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la viɛnyɛliŋga, ka daa lan she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti Aduna kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: With the blue, purple, and red wool they made the magnificent garments which the priests were to wear when they served in the Holy Place. They made the priestly garments for Aaron, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, ʒiɛnya dɛde ka di damdiya. Kul tummiya ti Duuma tuma ni yi kpiɔŋ zaa, yi ni mi ni yi tuma ku kpalim yoli ti Duuma ni la zuɣu.
en: So then, my dear friends, stand firm and steady. Keep busy always in your work for the Lord, since you know that nothing you do in the Lord's service is ever useless.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba pam daa kul niŋdi ti Duuma yɛda pahira.
en: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.

dag: Ka so yi muɣis a ni a ʒi o ʒili n-tah o tin shɛli din pa a ya zuɣu kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm tariga, nyin ʒim li yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: When they force you to go one mile, go with them two.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani din vuhiri leei wubilim tiŋgbani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: fruitful land into unproductive dirt, when its inhabitants are wicked.

dag: Yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm, lala ka yi ni ti ŋub ba, bɛn ka kasi mini bɛn be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub li.
en: You may eat this meat the same as you would eat gazelle or deer meat. Anyone can do this—people who are clean and people who are unclean.

dag: wulimpuhili polo daa malila dunoya ata, nuzaa polo diba ata, nudirigu polo diba ata, wulinluhili polo mi diba ata.
en: There were three gates on each side: three on the east, three on the south, three on the north, and three on the west.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣ asiba, ka bɛ nya ka Dagɔn lan lumi n-do o puli zuɣu Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka o zuɣu min o nuhi ŋmahi do dunɔbia zuɣu, ka o zaɣ mundili kɔŋko n-kpalim.
en: But when they got up early the next morning, there was Dagon again, fallen facedown on the ground before the LORDs chest—and this time Dagons head along with both his hands were cut off and lying on the doorstep! Only Dagons body was left intact.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ŋub o suhudoo sara maligu maa nimdi daba ata maa dali, dilan sara maligu maa ku lan gbaai, ka bɛ ku kal li kpɛhi sara maligu ni, di ni ti nyɛla din bi be kasi, ka ŋun ti ŋub li ni ti ʒi di zambu.
en: If any of it is eaten on the third day, God will not accept your offering. The offering will not be counted to your credit but will be considered unclean, and whoever eats it will suffer the consequences.

dag: Ti yi yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, kum be di ni, ka ti ni kpi; ka ti mi yi ʒi kpe, ti ni kpi. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Sirianim sansani ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti chɛ ti, ti ni be; ka bɛ yi ti ku ti, ka ti dii kpi.
en: There is no food in Samaria. If we go into the city, we will die there. If we stay here, we will also die. So lets go to the Aramean camp. If they let us live, we will live. If they kill us, we will just die.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yɛn saɣim la yimaŋa kaman yi yaannim ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋ shɛm maa, ka gba birigi jɛmdi n ni je bɛ binshɛŋa maa?.
en: Now tell the Israelites what I am saying: Why must you commit the same sins your ancestors did and go running after their idols?.

dag: A bi mi ni kurimbuni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ daadam niŋ dunia ni la.
en: Surely you know that from ancient times, when we humans were first placed on earth.

dag: Anabi Musa daa sab taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli din yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na yɛla n-wuhi ni ŋunkam doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa ni nya nyɛvili di zuɣu.
en: Moses writes about the righteousness that comes from the Law: The person who does these things will live by them. .

dag: Buri din tiri daŋa nyɛla din yihiri zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋmɛri nyɛ din maani ninsal niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: A beating can remove evil and make you completely clean.

dag: Yisa daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba biɛɣukam, amaa ka daa lee duri Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu ti gbɛri yuŋ kam.
en: During the day Jesus taught the people in the Temple area. At night he went out of the city and stayed all night on the Mount of Olives.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi ku dunia ŋɔ ni kɔr biɛri din be yi ni la. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni tɛhi biɛri ni binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu la. Binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: So put everything evil out of your life: sexual sin, doing anything immoral, letting sinful thoughts control you, and wanting things that are wrong. And dont keep wanting more and more for yourself, which is the same as worshiping a false god.

dag: Dama chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama n-lim Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa, dinzuɣu chɛrubinim maa n-daa nyɛ bimpindigu din pili Adaka maa mini di dapuhi la.
en: The winged creatures spread their wings over the place where the chest rested, covering the chest and its carrying poles.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka m bɔhi biɛri. N chɛ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim pa tampiŋ maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: In order to arouse wrath, to guarantee vengeance, I will spread her blood on a bare rock, never to be covered.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛbisi ba, ka bɛ mali ti paai Antiɔk n-laɣim yɛdaniŋdiba n-zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ba.
en: When Barnabas, Paul, and the delegates were sent on their way, they went down to Antioch. They gathered the believers and delivered the letter.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli ma ni n doli ba chaŋ ka di chɛ ka n suhu zɔhira. Ka m mabih ayɔbu ŋɔ gba daa doli ma chaŋ, ka ti daa mali ti kpe doo maa yiŋa.
en: The Spirit told me to go with them without hesitation. These six fellow believers from Joppa accompanied me to Caesarea, and we all went into the house of Cornelius.

dag: Gbuɣinli yi ŋum, ŋuni ka dabiɛm lee ku gbaai? Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yi zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ li tɔɣisi niriba.
en: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks.

dag: Zuɣulaannim kul nahindi ma mi ka di ka soli, amaa n kul lurila a yɛligu sizuura n suhu ni.
en: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words.

dag: Ka bua maa ni deei bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa ʒi n-chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka o ti zaŋ bua maa bahi mɔɣu maa ni.
en: The goat will carry on itself all their offenses to a desolate region, then the goat will be released into the wild.

dag: Hal lari puuni suhugarigu beni, ka suhupiɛlli bahigu mi nyɛ suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Laughter may hide sadness. When happiness is gone, sorrow is always there.

dag: Madimɛnanim mini Gɛbimnim zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi.
en: The people of Madmenah are running away. The people of Gebim are hiding.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o wain booriba kpɛm la labis o tuma ni, ka o lan zaŋdi ŋun Firawuna binnyura pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o.
en: He put the personal servant back in his old job.

dag: Ŋun be tibi n-lihiri nyari din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi; ŋuna n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lura m-bahiri yoli.
en: God, the righteous one, knows what goes on in the homes of the wicked, and he will bring the wicked down to ruin.

dag: Di lan chɛliya ka so biri bimbira bee ka so kpuɣi atam di kpuɣibu saha Babilɔn. Bɛ zaa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba sani tɔb shɛli din yɛn di ba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ zaa ti zo n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Do not let seeds be planted in that country nor let a harvest be gathered. Every foreigner living there will be afraid of the attacking army and will go back home.

dag: Ka yi ti kpi tinzunnim maa sunsuuni, ka yi dimnim maa tiŋgbani ti vali ya.
en: You will die in exile, swallowed up by the land of your enemies.

dag: Jɛfita ni daa ti labiri kuni yiŋ na Mizipa, o bipuɣiŋga n-daa daŋ o soli tuhibu na n-gbib chaɣisa chaɣisiri ka wari waa. O kɔŋko mi n-daa kul nyɛ o bia. O daa lan ka bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga pah o zuɣu.
en: Jephthah went back to Mizpah. He went to his house, and his daughter came out to meet him. She was playing a tambourine and dancing. She was his only daughter, and Jephthah loved her very much. He did not have any other sons or daughters.

dag: Nyini daadam, wuhimi Izraɛlnim maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ buɣisi di biɛhigu maa, ka chɛ ka vi gbahi ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Now, son of man, tell the family of Israel about the Temple. Then, when they learn about the plans for the Temple, they will be ashamed of their sins.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa kul jiɣindi sahakam; amaa yi Ba Naawuni mi ni di zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Thats what all those people who dont know God are always thinking about. But your Father knows that you need these things.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ yɛli Baruk, Yɛlim ti a ni niŋ shɛm sabi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa. Jɛrimia n-daa yɛr a yɛtɔɣa maa ka a sabira.
en: Did someone tell you what to write on this scroll.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma nimmaŋtali n-wuhiri ba soli, amaa bilikɔɣinim bilikɔnsi bahiri ba la yoli.
en: Good people are guided by their honesty, but crooks who lie and cheat will ruin themselves.

dag: Ninive ŋmanila biaŋ din kom zo n-yi ka chɛ li. Ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Zanimiya! Zanimiya! Amaa ka so bi ŋmaligi labina.
en: Nineveh has been like a pool of water. Such are its waters, and others are fleeing. Stop, stop!—but no one can turn them back.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni kum ni lu pam dunia zaa ni; ka di daa ti shiri niŋ pali Naa Klɔdius nam dibu saha.
en: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔnnim naa Nahash daa yɛl ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n fɔɣi yi nudiriti polo nimbihi zaa din ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa nya filiŋ, n ni chɛ ka m mini ya tɔɣisi.
en: I will make a treaty with you on one condition: that everyones right eye be gouged out! Nahash the Ammonite said to them. Thats how I bring humiliation on all Israel.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale zim pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa, ka tulaale zim shɛli daa kani n-viɛl paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Naa Sulemaana maa.
