en: Then the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon / tons of gold, a huge amount of spices, and precious stones. She gave Solomon more spices than anyone has ever brought into Israel.

dag: O daa bi chɛ ka so niŋ ba fitiina, o daa daŋ kpahi nannim zuɣuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But God let no one oppress them; to protect them, he warned the kings:.

dag: Ka Mariama daa ti paai Yisa sani n-gban o tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi.
en: Mary went to the place where Jesus was. When she saw him, she bowed at his feet and said, Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

dag: Dama nyamiya, Yawɛ yɛn yila o biɛhigu shee na. O ni ti siɣina ti tam dunia ni daboya zuɣu chana.
en: The Lord is coming from his holy place; he will come down and walk on the tops of the mountains.

dag: Bɛ chib bɔɣili n-gbi li sɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli maa ni.
en: They make a pit, dig it all out, and then fall right into the hole that theyve made!.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dahin shɛli chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin bomiya kuɣ kara n-niŋ tari ta li.
en: On the day you cross the Jordan River and enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you are to set up some large stones, cover them with plaster.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu tuuli alikauli la daa naan ku tooi zani, ka pa ni ʒim n-yi.
en: That is why even the first covenant went into effect only with the use of blood.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba mini bɛn zaa daa be nimaani maa, Yi zaa di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n da Ɛlimɛlɛk min o bidibis ayi Kiliɔn ni Malɔn ni su binshɛɣukam zaa Naomi sani.
en: Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, Today you are witnesses that Ive bought from the hand of Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech and all that belonged to Chilion and Mahlon.

dag: Yi ni ti mali olivi tihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, amaa yi ti ku ʒe di kpam, dama di wala zaa ni ti wɔbi lu.
en: You will have olive trees everywhere on your land. But you will not have any of the oil to use, because the olives will drop to the ground and rot.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bia maa ŋun yi yihi ya dabitim ni, yi shiri yiya ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: If the Son sets you free, then you will be really free.

dag: Ninkura yiɣisi dunɔdali gbini, ka nachimba chɛ bɛ biŋkumda ŋmɛbu.
en: The old people no longer sit at the city gate, and the young people no longer make music.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli tɔŋbu saha, ka yɛla mi yi ti paag a, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n-tahiri suhupiɛlli mini yɛlimuɣisira maa zaa na. Dinzuɣu ninsalinim ku tooi baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: When life is good, enjoy it. But when life is hard, remember that God gives us good times and hard times. And no one knows what will happen in the future.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi; dunianim zaa lumiy o sizuura.
en: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord , majestic and holy.

dag: N ni dɔni gbihi ni suhudoo; dama nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-chɛ ka n dooni ni alaafee.
en: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord , will keep me safe.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ʒi karimbu.
en: Others say, We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ ni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni kul o sani.
en: The priests and the Levites from every region throughout all Israel sided with Rehoboam.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni alikauli suɣili maa ni.
en: Moses put the walking sticks before the Lord in the Tent of the Agreement.

dag: Dama n ni bɔri ni n tum zaɣ sun shɛli, m bi tumdi li; amaa zaɣ biɛ shɛli n ni je ni n tum la, dina ka n kul tumda.
en: I dont do the good that I want to do, but I do the evil that I dont want to do.

dag: Doo yi chɛ ka o dɔbilim yina, ŋun sum o niŋgbuŋ zaa kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N wumla a damli puu ŋɔ ni ka dabiɛm gbaai ma, dama m bela n zaɣim, dina n-chɛ ka n sɔɣi maa.
en: The man said, I heard you walking in the garden, and I was afraid. I was naked, so I hid.

dag: Buɣim ni di li wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa sahakam. Ka di tiŋgbani ni leei tiŋgban nɛli doya ʒiɛmani kam ni; ka so ku lan ka di ni na.
en: Night and day wont be extinguished; its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation it will lie waste; no one will ever pass through it again.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa shiri niŋ lala dindali maa yuŋ. O daa chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kummi, amaa ka chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani din gil li zaa.
en: And God did so that night. Only the fleece was dry, but there was dew on all the ground.

dag: Ka n yi bi mi tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli gbinni, dindina n nyɛla tinzun nira ŋun tɔɣisiri li maa sani, ka o gba nyɛ tinzun nira n sani.
en: So if I dont know the meaning of the language, then I will be like a foreigner to those who speak it, and they will be like foreigners to me.

dag: Amaa ka o daŋ ni nir maa ni ti kuhi yɛli dindali maa, N ku tooi leei yi tibira. N ka bindirigu bee binyɛrigu n yiŋa; yi ku zaŋ ma leei niriba zuɣulana.
en: Someone else will cry out on that day, Im no healer! I have neither food nor clothing in my house! Dont make me the leader of the people.

dag: Sool ni daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka kpi shɛm m-bala. O daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka bi doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka daa lan chaŋ ti buɣi baɣa m-bɔr sɔŋsim.
en: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the Lord . He disobeyed the Lord 's commands; he tried to find guidance by consulting the spirits of the dead.

dag: N ni lan zaŋ Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Juda n-zaŋ ba kul Babilɔn la labisi kpe na; dama n ni kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will also restore to this place Judahs King Jeconiah, Jehoiakims son, along with all the exiles from Judah who were deported to Babylon, for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon, declares the LORD.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni di timaha gbinni; ka zaŋdi yi bihi maani maligu vinvama mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: All you want is to worship false gods under every green tree. You kill children by every stream and sacrifice them in the rocky places.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka naanyi ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: He placed his hands on them and then went away.

dag: Ka Bɛtitɔgarimanim daa zaŋdi yuri mini tɔbutuhiri yuri ni buntaansi na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: You sold your goods for workhorses, war-horses, and mules from Beth Togarmah.

dag: Amaa di lee bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛl la: Ti Duuma Naawuni, ninsal lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhir o yɛla bee daadam bia lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be o ni?.
en: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam o dirila nasara; dama Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: David was successful in everything he did because the LORD was with him.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa bɔhi Napaɣ Ɛsta, Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee buɣisi lala niŋbu maa? Ya ka lala nir maa lee be.
en: Then King Xerxes asked Queen Esther, Who dares to do such a thing? Where is this man.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord told Moses:.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa niŋ yomyom kpe o tanti suɣili ni Zara sani nti yɛl o, Toom a zim viɛlli la lita pisinaayi ŋ-ŋɔri li mali maha yomyom.
en: Abraham hurried to the tent. He said to Sarah, Quickly, prepare enough flour for three loaves of bread.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na ka tiŋ maa nim dii baŋ o.
en: When they were out of the boat, the people there saw Jesus. They knew who he was.

dag: O daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa a ba ni daa ʒili ti la? .
en: Rehoboam said, The people said, Give us easier work than your father gave us. How do you think I should answer them? What should I tell them.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli, M ba zaŋ muɣisigu zali tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima, nyamiya n ni di shiri biɛla ŋɔ ka nya yaa shɛm.
en: Jonathan said, My father has brought trouble to the land. Look how my eyes lit up when I tasted just a bit of that honey!.

dag: Kopaliga zaŋ ba guui yomyom, ka noli di bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛli, ka so napɔŋ bi lan no bɛ wain tihi puri ni yaha.
en: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.

dag: Zaɣisimiya zaɣ biɛɣu ka yu zaɣ viɛlli, ka doliya din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Di pa shɛli yi yi niŋ lala, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni zo Yisifu zuliya bɛn kpalim la nambɔɣu.
en: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice at the city gate. Perhaps the LORD God of heavenly forces will be gracious to what is left of Joseph.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Musa, Mmaŋmaŋ n yɛn dol a chaŋ, ka ti a vuhim.
en: The LORD replied, Ill go myself, and Ill help you.

dag: Nachimbil maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: But when the young man heard this, he went away saddened, because he had many possessions.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered, You have read about what David did when he and the people with him were hungry.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka o zabi nyuli tinzun wuna zuɣu, ka daa lan niŋ binshɛŋa din chihira n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul nyurila bara bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri zuɣu; ka bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim mi kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ ka tur o.
en: Those greedy people brag about the things they want to get. They curse the Lord and show that they hate him.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti ni yɛli? Ti tummi alahichi ti ni lan ka fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ka bela Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni maa zuɣu? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: What, then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law but under God's grace? By no means!.

dag: Yulimiya zuliya shɛba n-nya alahiziba, ka di gari ya. Dama n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli yi ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni, ka yi yi wum li yi ku niŋ li yɛda.
en: Look at the other nations! Watch them, and you will be amazed. I will do something in your lifetime that will amaze you. You would not believe it even if you were told about it.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Libianim daa mali tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba, amaa a ni daa niŋ Yawɛ naani la zuɣu, o daa zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Did you forget what happened with the Ethiopians and the Libyans who also had a powerful army with many chariots and horse soldiers? That time you depended on the Lord to help you, and he let you defeat them.

dag: Yɛm me o yili, ka sa daantalisi ayopɔin.
en: Wisdom built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.

dag: Lala ka bɛ zaŋ chira din ka binshɛli ti ma, ka zaŋ yuŋ shɛŋa din mali wahala ti ma.
en: Month after month I have nothing to live for; night after night brings me grief.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti kpa di naba dali yaha, ka o nyaandoliba maa lan laɣim be duu puuni, ka Tomas gba beni. Duu maa dunoya daa kparimi, ka Yisa daa ti lan puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: After eight days his disciples were again in a house and Thomas was with them. Even though the doors were locked, Jesus entered and stood among them. He said, Peace be with you.

dag: A tiligiri tarimba, ka pa nina lihiri karimbaannima ni a filim ba.
en: You are the one who saves people who suffer, but your eyes are against the proud. You bring them down!.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la, Yi gba ni chɛ ma dolibu.
en: Jesus asked the Twelve, Do you also want to leave.

dag: N ni zaŋ bɛ ni shɛb leei maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will select some of them as priests and Levites, says the LORD.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, Izraɛlnim yi ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ka ti dimnim nya ti kpaya, wula ka n lee lan yɛn yɛli?.
en: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.

dag: A puli ni fahiri ka a puuni biɛri waawaayili la zuɣu, di lan nyuri kom kɔŋko, amaa nyum wain biɛlabiɛla pahira.
en: Do not drink water only, but take a little wine to help your digestion, since you are sick so often.

dag: Yɔnahu ni saɣi tum a tuma? O ni saɣi gbe a naɣikpahi ni yuŋ?.
en: Will the wild ox agree to be your slave, or will it spend the night in your crib?.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, yi yi ti laɣim ni yi di ti Duuma Bindirigu maa, yin guhimiya taba.
en: So then, my friends, when you gather together to eat the Lord's Supper, wait for one another.

dag: Doliy o dunoya kpe ni wumpaɣibo, ka kpe o dundɔŋ ni ni paɣibu! Puhimiy o, ka paɣ o yuli!.
en: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli kul ka ti sani hal biɛla gba, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu nyɛla ŋun be barina ni. Ka Yawɛ daa nya yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni kani maa, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: Truth is missing; anyone turning from evil is plundered. The LORD looked and was upset at the absence of justice.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni mali yiko wuhiri shihir shɛŋa tuuli biŋkɔbigu la tooni maa n-yɔhindi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni; ka zali niriba ni bɛ malimi binnani ŋ-ŋmahindi biŋkɔb so ŋun daa mali takɔb daŋa ka tib kpaŋ la.
en: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.

dag: Dunia ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la, ka Naawuni daa pun pii ti leeg o niriba Masia zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi ka ka galimi ŋun Naawuni sani. Naawuni yurilim zuɣu.
en: In Christ, he chose us before the world was made. He chose us in love to be his holy people—people who could stand before him without any fault.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa piligi n-gbahiri cheechi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-niŋdi ba alaka;.
en: About that time King Herod began to harass some who belonged to the church.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti darigi bɛnkam zaa kpahi yaɣi dunɔbia zuɣu mini bɛnkam zaŋ damli dambu ni ŋarili soya bo nɛma pali bɛ dan yiŋ la tibili.
en: I will punish all who worship like pagans and who steal and kill in order to fill their master's house with loot.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Jahat ni Zimma.
en: These are the descendants of Gershon from generation to generation: Libni, Jahath, Zimmah.

dag: Di ti tumiya tuma, amaa lee ti malimiyala bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: You must not do any job-related work, and you must offer a food gift to the LORD.

dag: O mi bi kpe di ni mi ni o ti zaŋd omaŋ maani maligu yuuni kam kaman maligumaaniba zuɣulana ni daa yi zaŋdi biŋkɔbigu ʒi shɛli din pa ŋun maŋmaŋ ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee nti maani maligu shɛm la.
en: The Jewish high priest goes into the Most Holy Place every year with the blood of an animal. But Christ did not go in to offer himself many times.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti pii din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, chɛliya ka ti maŋmaŋ lihi n-nya din viɛla.
en: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.

dag: Gumiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka chɛ niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka di ku lu yi zuɣu. Doliya Lɛvi maligumaaniba la ni wuhiri ya shɛlikam la viɛnyɛliŋga kaman n ni zali ba shɛm.
en: Be on guard against outbreaks of skin disease by being very careful about what you do. You must carefully do everything the levitical priests teach you, just as I have commanded them.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi tɛhiri ni m mi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa gili ba niŋla sunsuuni, ka bɛ ʒe n tooni.
en: It never enters their heads that I will remember all this evil; but their sins surround them, and I cannot avoid seeing them.

dag: ka ti Duuma daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari tiliginsim kul pahiri bɛ ni biɛɣukam.
en: The believers praised God and were respected by all the people. More and more people were being saved every day, and the Lord was adding them to their group.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ ŋman yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, o ni shihi kpima n-tum alahichi shɛl la zuɣu. Ka o lan mal o zuɣu maa ka di be kasi dindali maa.
en: The priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to perform the ritual of purification for you because of your contact with a corpse. On the same day you shall reconsecrate your hair.

dag: amaa n ni di kul duhi n yee kuhi pam saha shɛli, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu ŋɔ bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: But when I screamed for help, he left his coat and ran out of the house.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛriko naa maa daa tim ti yɛli Reehab, Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe a yili ŋɔ na la yina; dama bɛ kamina ni bɛ ti puɣisi baŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa daashili.
en: So the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab: Send out the men who came to you, the ones who came to your house, because they have come to spy on the entire land.

dag: Ka ti daa kpe Adiramitium ŋarin shɛli din daa yɛn yiɣisi doli yi Ɛsha tinsi din ʒi m-baɣi teeku nol la polo; ka Masidɔnia do so ŋun daa yi Tɛsalɔnaika na ka o yuli booni Aristakus la daa biɛl ti.
en: We got on a ship from the city of Adramyttium that was ready to sail to different places in Asia. Aristarchus, a man from Thessalonica in Macedonia, went with us.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛnkam daa yi mi a. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie pam, ka a ku lan beni yaha. .
en: and the people of other nations are shocked. Your punishment was horrible, and you are gone forever.

dag: Ka Biliha daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: and they had a son.

dag: Juda naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaata saha shɛli ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa, ka n gba kul mal li tɔɣisiri ya di zuŋɔ yuun pisinaata, amaa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu.
en: For twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year that Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah until this very day, the Lord has spoken to me, and I have never failed to tell you what he said. But you have paid no attention.

dag: dama ŋunkam bi galindi ti bela ti polo.
en: Whoever isnt against us is for us.

dag: O ni daa paai Rom na, o daa bo n shee ni nimmoo hal ti nya ma.
en: After I arrived in Rome, he quickly looked for me and found me.

dag: N yi darigi yi tibili ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi bi labi n sanna ka na kul kpɛrila yɔɣu.
en: If you dont learn your lesson after all this, and if you still turn against me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a teei doya zaŋ a nina kpa tiŋa? Yiɣisima!.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, Get up! Why do you lie flat on your face like this?.

dag: Asiria naa Sarigɔn ni daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi zuɣulana chaŋ ti liri Ashidɔdnima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba yuun shɛl la.
en: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka n lee nya ka di do tooni ŋɔ ha? Ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl o, Naawuni daanabi ŋun daa yi Juda na nti yɛl a ni niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbini ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla siliga m-bala.
en: and he asked, Whose grave is that? Some people who lived nearby answered, It belongs to the prophet from Judah who told what would happen to this altar.

dag: ka daa doli Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri n-yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: Soon he began to go to the synagogues and tell people about Jesus. He told the people, Jesus is the Son of God.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛŋa mini kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛla.
en: spices and oil for light and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa du nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa nti ti suɣili zali Absalom, ka Absalom daa mal o ba mamanim maa dooni nimaani Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: So they set up a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he had sex with his fathers secondary wives in plain sight before all Israel. .

dag: Amaa Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani. N ni pirigi n namda pa Ɛdom zuɣu; ka tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim mi.
en: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o tɔbbihi zaa Tɛlaim na nti kali ba, ka bɛ tinchandiba kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyi, ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Saul called his forces together and inspected them at Telem: there were , soldiers from Israel and , from Judah.

dag: Dunɔguliba: Akub mini Talimɔn ni bɛ taba bɛn daa guli dunoya la zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their associates who guarded the gates totaled .

dag: Dama ti yaannim daa bi ʒe yim, ka tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Bɛ daa zaɣis o, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ o biɛhigu shee, ka lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa biri ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ.
en: Our ancestors were unfaithful and did what was evil in the LORD our Gods eyes. They abandoned him, they ignored the LORDs dwelling, and they defied him.

dag: Nyamiya, yi tiŋguliba laɣim yili suhupiɛlli yila! Dama bɛ nini nya Yawɛ ni labisi Ziɔn zali di zaashee shɛm.
en: Listen! Your lookouts lift their voice; they sing out together! Right before their eyes they see the LORD returning to Zion.

dag: Amaa ka Sool ŋun yiko daa kul pahirimi, ka o kahigiri wuhiri ni Yisa nyɛla Masia; ka o yɛligu maa daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Damaskus maa birim.
en: But Saul's preaching became even more powerful, and his proofs that Jesus was the Messiah were so convincing that the Jews who lived in Damascus could not answer him.

dag: Zaŋmi jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni mali chaŋ, dina ka a ti yɛn mali tumdi alahiziba tumtumsa maa.
en: Take this shepherds rod with you too so that you can do the signs.

dag: Ka kpamba maa daa lan yɛli ba, Chɛliya ba, amaa ka bɛ lee kabiri dari ka ŋɔŋdi kom tiri Izraɛlnim zaa. Kpamba maa ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bala.
en: The leaders went on to say to them, Let them live. So they became woodcutters and water haulers for the whole community, exactly as the leaders had intended for them.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: If anyone asks, Why are you untying it? just say, Its master needs it.

dag: Yi daanabinim ŋmanila ŋɔri m-be Izraɛl dikilijina ni.
en: People of Israel, your prophets are as useless as foxes living among the ruins of a city.

dag: Wuntia tuma mini din tuhi tumbu nyɛla Yawɛ ni deeri shɛli gari sara maligu.
en: Do what is right and fair; that pleases the Lord more than bringing him sacrifices.

dag: Ka pirigibu buyi zuɣu bɛn bi kanna tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali la mi ni guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: The two groups that go off duty on the Sabbath are to stand guard at the Temple to protect the king.

dag: Di mi mali dabiɛm ni nir kpe Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ nuu ni!.
en: Its scary to fall into the hands of the living God!.

dag: Ba maa ni neeri kpiimba kum ni ka tiri ba nyɛvili shɛm, lala ka Bia maa gba tiri o ni bɔri so nyɛvili.
en: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.

dag: ka di chɛ ka nir kul ni beni sahakam, ka ku kpi.
en: You will never have enough to buy the right to live forever and keep your body out of the grave.

dag: Dama o soli nyɛla din kuni kum shee, ka o soya kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Her house sinks down to death, and her paths go down to the shadowy dead.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni ka a lee bɔri ni n chɛ ka o yina? Ka o yɛl o, M bɔri ni a chɛ ka Samuɛl n-yina.
en: Whom shall I call up for you? the woman asked. Samuel, he answered.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛl shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Dinzuɣu kpahimi bɛ zuɣu ni ni nimmoo ka di chɛ ka bɛ ba n-zani wuhibu maŋli maa ni.
en: The words that prophet said are true. So tell those people that they are wrong. You must be strict with them. Then they will become strong in the faith.

dag: ni Yuria ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la ni Zabad ŋun daa nyɛ Ahilai bia la.
en: Uriah the Hittite; Zabad, Ahlais son.

dag: O zuɣu nyɛla salima alali. O zabikpila kul gahirimi, ka sabigi kaman kahiŋkɔɣu la.
en: His head is finest gold; his wavy hair, black as a raven.

dag: nti gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ birigirila ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa, ka yɛri ni ti di yo farigu Naa Siiza sani, ka lan yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia ni naa.
en: They started accusing him and said, We caught this man trying to get our people to riot and to stop paying taxes to the Emperor. He also claims that he is the Messiah, our king.

dag: Ka Giliadnim daa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli. Ka bɔ n-chɛ ka Dan zuliya niriba la mi daa kpalim be bɛ ŋarima gbini? Asha zuliya niriba gba daa kpalim be teeku duli. Bɛ daa kpalim ʒinila teeku duli maa.
en: The people of Gilead stayed in their camps on the other side of the Jordan River. As for you, people of Dan, why did you stay by your ships? The people of Asher remained by the sea, camped near their safe harbors.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla n kpamdi sokam jaande ni bɛ suhimi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu, ka kul suhimi Naawuni din simdi ba gba zuɣu, ka timmi sandaani niŋmi Naawuni tiri niriba; ka paɣimi Naawuni sokam zaa zuɣu.
en: First of all, then, I ask that requests, prayers, petitions, and thanksgiving be made for all people.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi niriba maa sani n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni ti gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei bɛ sani.
en: Moses and Aaron moved away from the people and stood at the entrance of the Tent. They bowed down with their faces to the ground, and the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence appeared to them.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa deei da shɛŋa o ni daa bo ni o ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ʒil o bia Yisahaku; ka omaŋmaŋ mi kpuɣi buɣim mini sua n-gbib o nuu ni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli tab chana.
en: Abraham took the wood for the sacrifice and put it on his sons shoulder. Abraham took the special knife and fire. Then both he and his son went together to the place for worship.

dag: Bɛ nuhi mi tuumbiɛri tumbu pam; kpambaliba mini bɛ sariakaritiba diri birapu. Yikolaannim zaŋdi bɛ suhuyubu zaana, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ naari noli lɔri nia biɛri.
en: People are good at doing bad things with both hands. Officials ask for bribes. Judges take money to change their decisions in court. Important leaders do whatever they want to do.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ku zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara ti Yawɛ, dindina doo maa ŋun zaŋm biŋkɔbigu maa chaŋ maligumaana sani.
en: But if your vow concerns a ritually unclean animal, which is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord , you shall take the animal to the priest.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi tinzun buɣa maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka Izraɛlnim nandahima yɛlli maa daa muɣis o pam.
en: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD. And the LORD could no longer stand to see Israel suffer.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba maa sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: They stayed with the disciples a long time.

dag: Ka paɣiba daa yɛli Naomi, Paɣimi Yawɛ! O ti a yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni o ti gbib a. Yawɛ chɛ ka bia maa yuli ti du pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni!.
en: The women there said to Naomi, Praise the Lord who gave you this child. May he become famous in Israel.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa yɛli naa, Nyama, nabihi maa kunna kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni pun yɛl a shɛm la.
en: Jonadab told the king, Look, the princes are coming, just as I, your servant, said they would.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na. O yɛri bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Whoever needs instruction, come. She invites all the simple people and says.

dag: Ka yi ni so miri ka o nyɛ ŋun kuri niriba bee tayiɣa bee tuumbiɛ tumda bee ŋun kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-nyari wahala di zuɣu.
en: If you suffer, it must not be because you are a murderer or a thief or a criminal or a meddler in other people's affairs.

dag: Di zaŋ a ŋmani nyɛvili niŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛr la nuu ni; di tam a tarimba nyɛviya yɛla sahakam!.
en: Don't abandon your helpless people to their cruel enemies; don't forget your persecuted people!.

dag: Ka n wurim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa kpɛhi luɣilikam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋd o min o tɔbbihi zaa, ka ŋooi takɔbi doli ba.
en: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa zuɣu ka ku kpihim bɛ taali maa. Dama Man Yawɛ bela Ziɔn.
en: Those people killed my people, so I really will punish them! The Lord God will live in Zion!.

dag: Ka yi ti boori li mihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni mini Alikauli Adaka la zuɣu.
en: Use it to anoint the meeting tent, the chest containing the covenant.

dag: Nyamiya, n paɣimi neei ya zaa. Pa bɛ ni paɣiri anzinfa shɛm la, amaa wahala ka n zaŋ buɣisi ya.
en: I have tested you in the fire of suffering, as silver is refined in a furnace. But I have found that you are worthless.

dag: A zaŋ a ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi niŋ bɛ nuu ni:.
en: You appointed them rulers over everything you made; you placed them over all creation:.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka Naawuni nir bebu mali m-be viɛnyɛliŋga zaa, ka o mali din ni chɛ ka o tooi tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: so that the person who belongs to God can be equipped to do everything that is good.

dag: Dama mɔɣu ni ka o daa nya o, ka bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti doo maa daa naan tooi kuhi ni bɛ sɔŋ o, amaa so daa kani ŋun ni fa o bahi.
en: The man raped the engaged woman in the countryside, and although she cried for help, there was no one to help her.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ma ni Zɛbidii bihi ma la gba daa be bɛ ni.
en: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of James and John were there.

dag: Ti mi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, dama Naawuni Bia la n-gbib o ka ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: We know that everyone born from God does not sin, but the ones born from God guard themselves, and the evil one cannot touch them.

dag: ka chɛ ka o yo paɣisarili maa ba anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga, o ni saɣim Izraɛl paɣa ŋun nyɛ paɣipali yuli maa zuɣu. O na kul ni nyɛla o paɣa, ka di bi simdi ni o zaɣis o saha shɛl o ni be o nyɛvili ni.
en: They will fine him one hundred silver shekels, giving that to the young womans father, because that husband gave one of Israels virgin daughters a bad reputation. Moreover, she must remain his wife; he is never allowed to divorce her.

dag: Nanim ŋɔ zaa daa naala noli n-laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi ti do Siddim vinvamli ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Teeku Kpiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: These latter kings formed an alliance in the Siddim Valley .

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ daba, paɣimiy o; paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: Praise the Lord ! You servants of the Lord , praise his name!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o ni bi yiɣisiri o suhu darigiri niriba tibili, ka mi bi doli bɛ ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.

dag: Di simdi ni yi mini yi yinsinim ti zaŋdi ba chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa nti kɔriti ba ŋubiri Yawɛ tooni yuuni kam.
en: Every year you must take these animals to the place the Lord your God will choose. There with the Lord , you and your family will eat these animals.

dag: Naawuni ni boli ba bihi, ka bɛ mali niŋgbuna mini ʒim zuɣu ka Yisa daa leei bɛ tatabo ka bɛ min o laɣim mali niŋgbun yini. O daa niŋla lala ni o kum zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim Sintani ŋun mali kum yiko la.
en: These children are people with physical bodies. So Jesus himself became like them and had the same experiences they have. Jesus did this so that, by dying, he could destroy the one who has the power of death—the devil.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti nya a, bɛ ni yɛli, O paɣa m-bala, ka ku ma ka chɛ a.
en: When the Egyptians see you, they will murder me because I am your husband. But they won't kill you.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini n naɣ beni ka ti ni bɔri ni yi niŋ li pɔi ka ti naanyi saɣi, dina n-nyɛ: yi chɛ ka yi dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman tinima.
en: We can agree only on the condition that you become like us by circumcising all your males.

dag: di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: then those in Judea must escape to the mountains.

dag: Bɛ ni ti fabili a zuɣu, ka yɛl a: Nyin tin shɛli din yuli daa du ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a lan ka teeku ni? Tin shɛli din min a niriba daa mali yaa teeku ni ŋɔ, nyini ŋun daa zal a kpiɔŋ a tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa sani ŋɔ!.
en: They will sing this funeral song for you: The famous city is destroyed! Her ships have been swept from the seas. The people of this city ruled the seas And terrified all who lived on the coast.

dag: Azɛl ba. Azɛl daa malila bidibisi ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hana. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Azɛl bidibisi maa.
en: Azel had six sons whose names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. This was Azels family.

dag: Di yi pa lala n ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o shɛm. N ni niŋ o kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din tam chaai la, ka chɛ ka kɔnyuri ku o.
en: or else I will strip her naked and expose her as on the day she was born. I will make her like a desert, and turn her into a dry land, and make her die of thirst.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Makihilɔt maa bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Tahat.
en: They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti kurigi saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka tiŋgban shɛli yi ni na yɛn deei mi na galisi pam.
en: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.

dag: M biyurisi, di niŋya ŋunkam yɛli ni o mali Naawuni Shia yɛda, amaa buɣisimiya ba nya bɛ ni mali shi so maa yila Naawuni sanna; dama anab ʒirinim pam yiɣisiya m-be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku ba sɔŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka shɛb mi diɛhi dansi do di solɔri zuɣu.
en: Babylons soldiers will be killed in the land of the Chaldeans. They will be badly wounded in the streets of Babylon.

dag: Ka di daa bi yuui ka biasani maa laɣis o ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha. Nimaani ka o daa ti zaŋ o buni maa zaa tum yoliyoli.
en: Not long after that, the younger son packed up everything he owned and left for a foreign country, where he wasted all his money in wild living.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣisi bɛ ni daa kɔhi kawana laɣ shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-zaŋ li tahi Firawuna yiŋa nti ti o.
en: Joseph collected all of the silver to be found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan for the grain, which people came to buy, and he deposited it in Pharaohs treasury.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka bimmɔrim biɛri mɔri yi duna mini yi biɛhi, ka yi ku tooi tibi li. Di ni ti zaŋ yi napɔnvari ni hal ni yi zuɣutalisi ni.
en: The Lord will cover your legs with incurable, painful sores; boils will cover you from head to foot.

dag: Di saha maa ka Gidiɔn daa baŋ ni Yawɛ malaika m-bala; ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, dama n nini nya Yawɛ malaika.
en: Gideon realized that he had seen one of the Lord 's angels. Oh! he moaned. Now I'm going to die.

dag: Liya ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb min o bipuɣiŋga Daina ti Yaakubu Mɛsopoteemia la m-bala. O mini Liya zuliya bɛn nyɛ bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihitanaata.
en: These are the sons that Leah had borne to Jacob in Mesopotamia, besides his daughter Dinah. In all, his descendants by Leah numbered thirty-three.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o dab paɣa ti do so, ka bɛ na bi yo o zuɣu bee ka dab paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni, ka o dan maa lan zaŋ o dɔni, di simdi ka bɛ vihi yɛlli maa. Di bi simdi ka bɛ ku ba, dama paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni.
en: If a slave woman is the recognized concubine of a man and she has not been paid for and freed, then if another man has sexual relations with her, they will be punished, but not put to death, since she is a slave.

dag: Izraɛl anab shɛb tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo, ka nyari ʒiinima zaŋ chaŋ di suhudoo polo, ka suhudoo mi kani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala ma.
en: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and envisioned peace when there was no peace? This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: O daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma mini nayili nɛma zaa, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma salima la shɛŋa zaa Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm.
en: and carried off to Babylon all the treasures in the Temple and the palace. As the Lord had foretold, Nebuchadnezzar broke up all the gold utensils which King Solomon had made for use in the Temple.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa daa bɔri ni o paɣ omaŋa ka bɔhi Yisa, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, Who are my neighbors.

dag: Amaa dalinli maa yi piɛl o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, ka bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔbiri din be dalinli maa ni bi paligi, maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi dɔro maa lana niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.

dag: Ka Asiria naa Tiligatipilinɛza daa lee ti kana ti lir o mi n-nahim o, ka bi sɔŋ o.
en: So Tiglath Pileser came to Judah, but instead of helping, he made things worse.

dag: Di to ni ninvuɣ so saɣi kpi wuntizɔra zuɣu, amaa di pa shɛli so ni saɣi kpi ninvuɣ sun so zuɣu.
en: It isnt often that someone will die for a righteous person, though maybe someone might dare to die for a good person.

dag: O ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni maa, ka o daa naanyi bo sɔŋsim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka siɣis omaŋ pam o yaannim Naawuni sani.
en: During his distress, Manasseh made peace with the LORD his God, truly submitting himself to the God of his ancestors.

dag: dama nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda, ka n kul be a kpiŋkpama mahim ni n-yiini suhupiɛlli yila.
en: That is because you are the one who helps me. It makes me happy to be under your protection!.

dag: N dimnim kul sɔɣirimi yɛri ŋumaŋuma n-jɛndiri ma, ka lɔri ma nia biɛri dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: All day long they talk about me and make their plans.

dag: Chɛliya ka amiliya lɔbu mali jilima sokam sani, ka chɛliya ka yidan min o paɣa ʒe tab yim bɛ daamiliya lɔbu puuni; dama Naawuni ni kari niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛnim mini bɛn niŋdi zina saria.
en: Marriage should be honored by everyone. And every marriage should be kept pure between husband and wife. God will judge guilty those who commit sexual sins and adultery.

dag: Bɔhimi Midiannim biɛri ti Izraɛlnima. Di nyaaŋa n ni deeg a nyɛvili.
en: Moses, tell the Israelites this: Go and attack the Midianites, and do to them what they did to you. After that Moses, you will die.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni daa kuhi boli ba ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu shɛm, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli ma ka n gba zaɣisi ba garigibu.
en: So the Lord All-Powerful said, I called to them, and they did not answer. So now, if they call to me, I will not answer.

dag: Amaa bɛ nimdi nyɛla yi dini kaman bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu nyɔɣu polo mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli gahiri zuɣusaa mini nudirigu gbalipaɣa ni nyɛ yi dini shɛm la.
en: But their meat is yours. It will be yours just as the breast of the uplifted offering and the right thigh are yours.

dag: M mi a ni ʒiini shɛm ni a ni yiɣisiri shɛm, ka mi a ni yiri chani ka labirina shɛm. N lan mi a ni je suli niŋ ma shɛm.
en: I know where you are, how you go out and come in, and how you rage against me.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin shɛli dihi niriba tusaanahi la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛr ayopɔin.
en: And when I broke seven loaves of bread for those four thousand people, how many baskets full of leftovers did you gather? They answered, Seven.

dag: Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri pam kaman bɛ ni daa be Gibia la. Naawuni ni ti teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: The Israelites have gone deep into ruin as in the time of Gibeah. God will remember the Israelites sins, and he will punish them.

dag: Zaŋm a nuu chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ ma, ka di lan chɛ ka a yɛla mali ma dabiɛm.
en: Stop punishing me, and dont frighten me with your terrors.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahim a la ni ka a sanna. Bɛ ni kana ti damdi tiŋ lu a sizuura. Bɛnkam zaa daa ʒiɛm a la ni kana ti jɛm a. Bɛ bol a Yawɛ tiŋa; ka lan bol a Ziɔn din nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la tin titali.
en: The children of your tormenters will come bending low to you; all who despised you will bow down at your feet. They will call you The LORDs City, Zion, of the holy one of Israel.

dag: Kokpɛɣu, yom vuri kaman nuhi kpahibu vuri la. Kunkuna, laɣimmiya yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ tooni.
en: Let all the rivers clap their hands; let the mountains rejoice out loud altogether.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma nyɛvili soli, ka suhupiɛl maŋli kul be a sani; ka nyaɣisim kul be a nudirigu ni sahakam.
en: You will teach me the right way to live. Just being with you will bring complete happiness. Being at your right side will make me happy forever.

dag: Ka so yi mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa, bɛn zaŋm o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: Whoever has leprosy must be brought to the priest.

dag: N daa bi bɔhim yɛm bee m-mi ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni nyɛ so.
en: I havent learned wisdom, nor do I have knowledge of the holy one.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya! Ka Na so ŋun mali jilima ŋɔ gari kpɛna.
en: Gates, proudly lift your heads! Open, ancient doors, and the glorious King will come in.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sɔdom naa mini Gomɔra naa ni Adima naa ni Zɛbɔiim naa ni Bɛla naa bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Zɔa la daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ Siddim vinvamli ni.
en: Then the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela drew up their armies for battle in Siddim Valley and fought.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam bɛn daa nyɛ bukpahinim laɣisi bɛ tabibi tumbu kundinim na nti nyɔri buɣim niriba maa ninni; ka bɛ daa mali di liɣiri laasabu ka di paai kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu dahin yini tuma yɔri.
en: This included a number of people who practiced sorcery. They collected their sorcery texts and burned them publicly. The value of those materials was calculated at more than someone might make if they worked for one hundred sixty-five years.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yi yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla: Iin bee Aai, dama shɛli yi lan pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di nyɛla biriginsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Say only yes if you mean yes, and say only no if you mean no. If you say more than that, it is from the Evil One.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So all the Israelites obeyed the commands that the Lord gave to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; dama n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: You will look for me, but you will not find me, because you cannot go where I will be.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan bi kɔri kɔbu saha, ka puri atam kpuɣibu saha yi ti paai o bi nyari shɛli.
en: The lazy dont plow during winter; at harvest they look but find nothing.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Deem piɛsah ayopɔin ŋɔ n nuu ni, ka di wuhi ni a di ma shɛhira ni mani n-daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ.
en: Abraham replied, I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.

dag: O kul tiri ma la dansi, o karitimi doli ma kaman tɔbbia la.
en: God never stops attacking.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee bi mi ni Naawuni nuu n-tum tuuni ŋɔ?.
en: Everyone knows that the Lord made these things.

dag: Di simdi ni yi baŋ ni yi gba daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa teeg o yiko nuu yihi ya nimaani na. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa.
en: Dont forget that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. The Lord your God brought you out of Egypt with his great power and made you free. That is why the Lord your God commands you to always make the Sabbath a special day.

dag: ka zaŋ o zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini niriba maa zaa tooni n-zaŋ o leei bɛ toondana bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Place him before Eleazar the priest and the entire community and commission him before them.

dag: Di yi ti wum o ka o suhu zɔhira saha shɛli, ka n dii lir o n-kpɛh o dabiɛm ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa zo ka chɛ o, ka n ku ŋun naa maa kɔŋko.
en: while he is tired and discouraged. He will panic, and everyone with him will run away. I won't kill anyone except David.

dag: nyaanzuriba ni bɛn je Naawuni ni ninʒeensinima ni karimbaannima ni barinyuriba ni tuumbiɛri so pala bɔriba ni bɛn bi deeri bɛ laamba noli.
en: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi chana.
en: On the Sabbath day, Jesus and his followers were walking through some grain fields. The followers picked some grain to eat.

dag: Ti tum alahichi ka birigi, ka a bi chɛ ti taali.
en: We have sinned and rebelled, and you, O Lord , have not forgiven us.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: But the Lord made the king stubborn and, just as the Lord had said, the king would not listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Amaa Yaakubu daa bi chɛ ka Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ Yisifu tizo la dol o biɛyanim maa chaŋ, dama o daa zɔrimi ni binshɛli ti niŋ o.
en: but Jacob did not send Joseph's full brother Benjamin with them, because he was afraid that something might happen to him.

dag: ni binnamda maa maŋmaŋ ti yi poobu dabitim ni kpe Naawuni ni zaŋ yolisim shɛli din mali jilima n-ti o bihi la ni.
en: that creation itself would one day be set free from its slavery to decay and would share the glorious freedom of the children of God.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa gari ka chɛ ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya m-be Ɛdom maa, ka daa chɛ Araba soli bahi nyaaŋa, ka lan chɛ Ɛlat mini Ɛziɔngɛba bahi nyaaŋa. Ti ni daa ŋmaligi n-zaŋ kpa Mɔab yɔɣu polo.
en: So we passed by our relatives, the people of Esau living there in Seir. We left the road that leads from the Jordan Valley to the towns of Elath and Ezion Geber. We turned onto the road that goes to the desert in Moab.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa ti chaŋmi ti liri Judanima, ka me Rama zali ni o chɛ ka so ku lan tooi yi Juda Naa Asa sani chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n-yi shɛli polo ka o sanna.
en: One time, Baasha invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, so he could put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a tim ma na?.
en: Then Moses turned to the LORD and said, My Lord, why have you abused this people? Why did you send me for this?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi Naiɔt din be Rama tiŋgban ni maa n-chaŋ Jɔnatan sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? N taali nyɛ dini? Ka tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee dii tum a ba, ka o bɔri ni o ku ma.
en: David ran away from the camps at Ramah and went to Jonathan and asked him, What have I done wrong? What is my crime? Why is your father trying to kill me.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni kɔzɔrim kom ni.
en: Then the priest must order one bird to be killed in a clay bowl over running water.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya o ka bɔh o, Asahɛl, nyini m-bala? Ka o yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: Abner looked back and asked, Is that you, Asahel? Asahel said, Yes, its me.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ti teei zani ni bɛ zaŋ nya taba.
en: Israel and the Philistines took up their battle formations opposite each other.

dag: Yuma ata kam puuni, zaŋmiya yi puri atam pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim sɔŋ yi tinsi ni.
en: At the end of every third year bring the tithe of all your crops and store it in your towns.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: N lan mali salin shɛli nuhi tuun baŋsimnim ni ti yɛn zaŋ tum salima tuma mini anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋ tum anzinfa tuma. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ omaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka ti binshɛli ka di nyɛla o suhuyubu zuɣu.
en: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?.

dag: Ka na shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Hadadɛza sulinsi ni nya Izraɛlnim ni tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Izraɛlnim maa ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti ba. Di saha zaŋ chana ka Sirianim maa daa zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ lan sɔŋ Ammɔnnim yaha.
en: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had beaten them, they made peace with Israel and accepted David as their ruler. The Arameans were afraid to help Ammon any more.

dag: Chɛrili nyɛla bɛn ka yaa, amaa bɛ nyari bindirigu diri siɣili saha.
en: Ants as creatures arent strong, but they store away their food in the summer.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa gari ka chɛ ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya m-be Ɛdom maa, ka daa chɛ Araba soli bahi nyaaŋa, ka lan chɛ Ɛlat mini Ɛziɔngɛba bahi nyaaŋa. Ti ni daa ŋmaligi n-zaŋ kpa Mɔab yɔɣu polo.
en: So we moved on and left the road that goes from the towns of Elath and Eziongeber to the Dead Sea, and we turned northeast toward Moab.

dag: Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam, ka bɛ yɛli, Nyama, nanima ayi bi tooi nyaŋ o, ka wula ka tinim ni tooi nyaŋ o.
en: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.

dag: Ka a ti chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl nyɛla m bidib kpɛma.
en: Then you should say to Pharaoh, This is what the Lord says: Israel is my firstborn son.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtishɛmɛshinim maa daa yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tooni? Ka o yi yi ti sani, banim sani ka o lee yɛn chaŋ.
en: and they started saying, No other God is like the Lord ! Who can go near him and stay alive? We'll have to send the chest away from here. But where can we send it.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o paɣ min o bidibisi balisi buŋa n-labi Ijipti, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee la gbib o nuu ni.
en: So Moses put his wife and children on the donkey and returned to Egypt. He carried his walking stick with him—the walking stick with the power of God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Judanima, Wuhimiya ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Benya kaman ti shɛli din chɛ ka di mahim luri ti zuɣu wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha. Ti nyɛla bɛn zona ti kpɛn ya ni ti tiligi, zaŋmiya ti sɔɣi.
en: They say, Help us! Tell us what to do. Protect us from our enemies as shade protects us from the noon sun. We are running from our enemies. Hide us! Dont give us to our enemies.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima.
en: Egypt was the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim.

dag: Ninsal soya zaa ni tooi nyɛla din viɛl o sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi ninsal suhu.
en: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni gbibi ya hal ni di bahigu ni, ka yi ti ku mali galimi ŋun ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabisili maa dali.
en: He will also confirm your testimony about Christ until the end so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmanila yɛm tuma din kpaŋsiri jɛmbu muɣisigu puuni mini ʒiri maŋsiɣisibutali ni niŋgbuŋ nahimbu, amaa di zaa yoli, di bi kuri buchi zaŋ chaŋ maŋgbaabu niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma tumbu puuni.
en: Of course such rules appear to be based on wisdom in their forced worship of angels, and false humility, and severe treatment of the body; but they have no real value in controlling physical passions.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ yurilim maŋli la yɛla. O ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti ti la zuɣu, n ni paɣ o. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Izraɛlnim ni.
en: I will remember the kind things the Lord has done, and I will remember to praise him. The Lord has given many good things to the family of Israel. He has been very kind to us. He has shown us mercy.

dag: Ka tiŋgban bihi din zaa be teeku sunsuuni daa vuui, ka zoya zaa gba vuui;.
en: All the islands disappeared, all the mountains vanished.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa lan nyɛ Rɛfa mini Rɛshɛf ni Tɛla ni Tahan.
en: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n yihi Ijipti vi shɛli yi ni diri la ka chɛn ya. Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Giligal, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, You were slaves in Egypt, and this made you ashamed. But today I have taken away that shame. So Joshua named that place Gilgal. And that place is still named Gilgal today.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika maa, N dana, bɔ ka binyara ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: But, sir, what do these mean.

dag: Bɛ mi daa bi niŋ tuuba bɛ ninvuɣ kubo bee bɛ baɣibuɣibo bee bɛ zina niŋbu bee bɛ tayiɣisigu zuɣu.
en: They did not change their hearts and turn away from killing other people or from their evil magic, their sexual sins, and their stealing.

dag: ka kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ ko viɛlli din be yaɣiri duɣu ni.
en: He shall kill one of the birds over a clay bowl containing fresh spring water.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka lihi bɛmaŋ suhupiɛlli niriba, ka bɛ paɣiri ba bɛ nasara dibu zuɣu la.
en: Even if someone is satisfied with this life and is praised because he is successful.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Lɔdɛba Ammiɛl bia Makiri maa yiŋ ti zaŋ o na.
en: So King David had him brought from the house of Ammiels son Machir at Lo-debar.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka m bi biɛhim ka ka yi sanna yomyom maa, dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma yi ni boli ma na shɛli zuɣu.
en: Thats why I didnt argue when your men asked me to come here. Now, please tell me why you sent for me.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin lo ma, di ni chɛ ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Samson answered, Someone would have to tie me up with seven fresh, new bowstrings. If someone did that, I would be as weak as any other man.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi kpe n niriba dunɔdaya ni bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali ba ansarisi bɛ wahala dibu mini bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Ka di mi daa bi simdi ni yi fa bɛ daazichi bɛ daashaara nyabu dali.
en: You should not have entered the city of my people to gloat over their suffering and to seize their riches on the day of their disaster.

dag: Sagbana mini zibisim zaa gil o mi; wuntitali mini zaligu soli n-nyɛ o nam ʒiishee tanzaa.
en: Thick, dark clouds surround him. Goodness and justice make his kingdom strong.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti zaŋm tumtumda chira anii yɔri chaŋ ti da bindirigu na ti ti ba.
en: You yourselves give them something to eat, Jesus answered. They asked, Do you want us to go and spend two hundred silver coins on bread in order to feed them.

dag: O daa zali Judanim ni bɛ jɛmmila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la kɔŋko, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli yili wumpaɣibo yila.
en: Sing for joy to the Lord , all the earth; praise him with songs and shouts of joy!.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: But I tell you that not even King Solomon with all his wealth had clothes as beautiful as one of these flowers.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tintariga kpaa din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha bee n-fa kpibisi palo.
en: Never move an old property line, and dont take land that belongs to orphans.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nɔrila tandi, ka ŋmari bilichiisi, ka tumdi bɛ puri ni tuma zaa, ka lan muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma ni di chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋ ba tom.
en: They made their lives miserable with hard labor, making mortar and bricks, doing field work, and by forcing them to do all kinds of other cruel work.

dag: Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni paɣ a, dama bɛ wum a yɛtɔɣa.
en: All the kings in the world will praise you, Lord , because they have heard your promises.

dag: Ŋunkam gariti ʒiɛrila o nɛma; ka o leeg o ʒiʒiinitab ni maani so ansarisi.
en: All who pass by steal his belongings; all his neighbors laugh at him.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni zali duri maa tooni zaŋ labi dundɔntitali polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: A stone wall ran parallel to the chambers facing the outer courtyard. It was seventy-five feet long.

dag: Yi ma daa ŋmanila wain tia m-be wain tihi puu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sa m-baɣili kom. Ka kom pam maa daa chɛ ka o teei wula n-wali wala pam.
en: Your mother is like a grapevine planted near the water. She had plenty of water, so she grew many strong vines.

dag: Yinima ninsalinim ka m boona. Bɛnkam be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka m booni maa.
en: I cry out to you, people; my voice goes out to all of humanity.

dag: Ti yi niŋ ninsalinim shɛhiradibo yɛda, Naawuni shɛhiradibo n-dii gari, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛli.
en: We believe people when they say something is true. But what God says is more important. And this is what God told us: He told us the truth about his own Son.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa pii maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas m-pahi bɛ daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba pia zuɣu n-tim ba Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then the Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, pumpɔŋɔ ŋmaligim a nina kpa ti polo na ka gbilisi tibili wum ti suhigu kpe ŋɔ.
en: Now, O my God, look on us and listen to the prayers offered in this place.

dag: Di saha ka dansarika gula maa kuhi yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm firila na, ka o daa guui kpe ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o ni sɔhira, ka o damdi Pool mini Silas tooni.
en: The jailer called for some lights, rushed in, and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

dag: Amaa Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nima, ka ti daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, ti ni daa zɔri Babilɔn tɔbbihi mini Siria tɔbbihi dabiɛm maa zuɣu. Lala zuɣu ka ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: But when Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar invaded the country, we said, We better go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies. Thats why were here in Jerusalem.

dag: Dama di yi niŋ daba ayi n ni doli soli chaŋ ka ku lan labina.
en: My years are passing now, and I walk the road of no return.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli yaha, Goli palli kam chuɣu dali mini Vuhim Dabisili dali kam di simdi ni zuliya kam zaa kana ti jɛm ma.
en: From month to month and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all humanity will come to worship me, says the LORD.

dag: Amaa nyini Bɛtilihɛm din be Ɛfirata, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din pɔri Juda tinsi puuni ŋɔ, a ni ka n ninvuɣ so ŋun ni su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ti yina. O piligu yila kurimbuni na.
en: The Lord says, Bethlehem Ephrathah, you are one of the smallest towns in Judah, but out of you I will bring a ruler for Israel, whose family line goes back to ancient times.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ kasi, ka mali niriba maa ka bɛ niŋ kasi; ka lan mali dunɔdaya mini gooni maa ka di gba niŋ kasi.
en: After the priests and the Levites purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka nir lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: Jesus followers answered, But we are far away from any towns. Where can we get enough bread to feed all these people.

dag: N ni di bɛ nɛma ʒi li chaŋ, ka liri luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yoli, ka niriba be di ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi zuliya shɛb ni na, ka mali niɣi mini nɛma, ka nyɛ bɛn be tiŋgbani maa ni ŋɔ.
en: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.

dag: Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daa galisimi kaman teeku duli bihigu la, ka bɛ daa diri ka nyuri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: There were so many people living in Judah and Israel while Solomon was king that they seemed like grains of sand on a beach. Everyone had enough to eat and drink, and they were happy.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni nam ŋmahindi bee ŋahi dini ka ti lee yɛn ŋahi zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: Finally, Jesus said: What is God's kingdom like? What story can I use to explain it?.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a galisiya pam. A zaŋla jilima mini nam yiko ye kaman situra la.
en: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes.

dag: ti daa ti zahimla zahindi yuŋ dahin yini, ka ti zaa yino kam zahindi daa mali di gbinni.
en: Then one night he and I had a dream. Each dream had a different meaning.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla binshɛŋa din niŋbu chihira n-zali n jɛmbu duu n-ta li daɣiri.
en: They even placed their disgusting idols in the Temple built for my worship, and they have defiled it.

dag: O daa me Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yili; ka di wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka bɛ daa me li tamla sida dari kulis ata mini di dapuhi zuɣu.
en: The Hall of the Forest of Lebanon was feet long, feet wide, and feet high. It had three rows of cedar pillars, in each row, with cedar beams resting on them. The ceiling was of cedar, extending over storerooms, which were supported by the pillars.

dag: Bɛn mali taali soli nyɛla so golima, amaa bɛn ka taali biɛhigu nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Guilty people walk a crooked path; the innocent do what is right.

dag: Amaa o yi zaɣisi wumbu, nyin bom ninvuɣ yino bee niriba ayi pah amaŋ zuɣu lab o sani, ka niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira dibu zuɣu ti chɛ ka yɛtɔɣili kam mali nyaanzaana.
en: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.

dag: Doli dimbɔŋɔnima, ka zaŋ amaŋ ti li, ka di chɛ ka sokam nya a tooni chandi a tuma puuni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Continue to do these things. Give your life to doing them. Then everyone can see that your work is progressing.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi sandiriba maa ni ti yiɣisi libigi ya, ka bɛn ni chɛ ka yi ni sɔhigi yiɣisi? Di saha ka yi leei bɛ ni yɛn ʒe ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Strong man, you have taken money from people. One day they will wake up and realize what is happening, and they will stand against you. Then they will take things from you, and you will be very afraid.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa duu maa ni, ka kpe naa dundɔŋ ni nti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa zaa yɛli naa.
en: Then the royal officials put the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. They went to King Jehoiakim and told him all about the scroll.

dag: Ka bɛ yi bi gbaai tayiɣ maa, dindina di simdi ka yili maa lana chaŋ Naawuni sani nti wuhi kaman o nuu tim o kpee maa daazichi maa ni bee di bi tim.
en: If the thief isnt caught, the owner of the house should be brought before God to determine whether or not the owner stole the others property.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Filistianim mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Itiɔpianim polo la suhiri yiɣisi bahi Naa Jɛhɔram zuɣu.
en: The Lord caused the Philistines and the Arabs living near the Ethiopians to be angry with Jehoram.

dag: Dabisili din pah anu dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah awɛi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: Di saha yɛlimaŋtali ni ti be tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka wuntitali mi ti be tiŋgban shɛli din vuhir ni.
en: Everywhere in the land righteousness and justice will be done.

dag: Bɛ wurim n suɣili, ka chihi di mihi zaa. M bihi chaŋya ka chɛ ma; bɛ lan kani, ka so kani ŋun ni lan ti n suɣili maa yaha, ka zaŋ m pateesanim yili di ni.
en: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa zaɣisi a Naawuni zaligunim maa dolibu bee n-zaɣisi naa zaligunim dolibu, bɛn darigim bɛ tibili pam. Di yi simdi ni bɛ ku ba bee n-kari ba yihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee n-fa bɛ nɛma zaa bee n-kpɛhi ba duu yin niŋmiya lala.
en: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa niŋ nia ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ yuli jilima, ka me omaŋmaŋ nam yili.
en: Solomon planned to build a Temple to give honor to the Lord s name. He also planned to build a palace for himself.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yi ni ti nya ti yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni anabinim zaa ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ni, amaa ka Naawuni ti kari yinim di ni bahi. Yinim ni ti fabili ka dim yi nyina.
en: How you will cry and gnash your teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets in the Kingdom of God, while you are thrown out!.

dag: O tiri binnɛɔŋ kam bindirigu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He gives food to every living creature; his love is eternal.

dag: ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, Doo ŋɔ kul chɛri ka alahichinim kanila o sanna hal ka o mini ba ti laɣindi dira.
en: Then the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to complain, Look, this man welcomes sinners and even eats with them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la kuna. Ka Jɔab daa chɛ ka Yuria kuli Dauda sani.
en: Then David sent a message to Joab: Send me Uriah the Hittite. So Joab sent Uriah to David.

dag: Ka Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua daa piligi n-lab mɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa Jɛrusalɛm, ka Naawuni daanabinim daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: Subsequently, Zerubbabel, Shealtiels son, and Jeshua, Jozadaks son, began to rebuild Gods house in Jerusalem. Gods prophets were with them, helping them.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm o na.
en: Jesus answered, You faithless and crooked generation, how long will I be with you? How long will I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmd a suhuri paligi, ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Naawuni galisiya.
en: May all who come to you be glad and joyful. May all who are thankful for your salvation always say, How great is God.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a kɔre kpe o viɛlim ni a suhu ni, ka miri ka a chɛ ka o gbaag a o nina ni lihiri shɛm puuni.
en: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.

dag: Tinim mi pala bɛn tiri gbini bahi yoli; amaa ti nyɛla bɛn lee niŋ yɛda ka tiligi.
en: But we are not those who turn back and are lost. No, we are the people who have faith and are saved.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri miligi n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu la zuɣu; di nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ ya kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of what is happening to me. My sufferings are for your benefit—for your honor and glory.

dag: Ka malaika so daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-duh o yee kuhiri yɛri ŋun ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa, Dunia atam biya zaa ka di chɛbu saha paai. Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-tim di ni chɛ.
en: Then another angel came out of the temple. This angel called to the one who was sitting on the cloud, Take your sickle and gather from the earth. The time to harvest has come, and the fruit on the earth is ripe.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl kpamba daa darigi chɛhi bɛ binyɛra, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri n-doya ni suhugarigu hal ni zaawuni.
en: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.

dag: Tim ba suhusaɣiŋgu; chɛ ka a noli di ba.
en: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Isaka zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Kishiɔn mini Dɛbɛrat.
en: The tribe of Issachar gave them Kishion, Daberath.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi yɔɣili maa zuɣu? Ka Jona garigi yɛli, Di simdi ni n suhu yiɣisi, hal ka m bi zaɣisi ni n kpi gba.
en: But God said to Jonah, Do you think it is right for you to be angry just because this plant died? Jonah answered, Yes, it is right for me to be angry! I am angry enough to die.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ ba zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana ti niŋ yalim bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: Then you will offer them before the Lord . The priests will sprinkle salt on them. Then they will offer the bull and ram up as a burnt offering to the Lord .

dag: Ka yi kul ni mali pam din ni chɛ ka yi tiri nirilim niŋbu pina, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni nya paɣibu ti ni niŋdi shɛm puuni;.
en: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la shiri niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni Naawuni yɛliya: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: What Isaiah prophesied has become completely true for them: You will hear, to be sure, but never understand; and you will certainly see but never recognize what you are seeing .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, M bi tim ba yi sanna, amaa bɛ zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisirila ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka n kari ya bahi ka yi mini bɛna anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa ti kpi. .
en: I didnt send them, says the Lord . They are telling lies and saying that the message is from me. So I will send you people of Judah away. You will die, and the prophets who spoke to you will die also.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia A ni zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli maa viɛla. O daa tɛhimi ni suhudoo ni alaafee ni be o ʒiɛman ni.
en: Then Hezekiah told Isaiah, This message from the Lord is good.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi m be duu, amaa suɣili ni ka n kul be ka yi mali ma ginda.
en: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti nya Naawuni.
en: Happy are people who have pure hearts, because they will see God.

dag: N yi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, n ka bara nyubu di ni; dama di nyɛla n talahi tuuni, ka mbusim be n zuɣu n yi bi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu maa!.
en: If I preach the gospel, I have no reason to brag, since Im obligated to do it. Im in trouble if I dont preach the gospel.

dag: Yi pun mi bɛ ni daa fiɛb ti ka dihi ti vi Filipai shɛm pɔi ka ti daa naanyi ti ka yi sanna la yɛla, amaa ti Naawuni daa bahi ti ti suhukpeeni ka ti yihi lahibal suŋ waazu din yi o sanna la n-tin ya hal sɔguriba ni daa kul zooi la zaa yoli.
en: On the contrary, we had the courage through God to speak Gods good news in spite of a lot of opposition, although we had already suffered and were publicly insulted in Philippi, as you know.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ; chɛliya ka niriba wum o paɣibu maa yɛla.
en: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.

dag: Ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika n-kuri chɛrubinim ayi n-zaŋ ba tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: Then make two Cherub angels and put them on each end of the mercy-cover. Hammer gold to make these angels.

dag: O daa wuh o ni bɛ zaŋmi salima din nyɛ alali m-mali dirijaba mini taha ni pipihi, o daa lan wuhi salima laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka lan wuhi anzinfa laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: He also gave instructions as to how much pure gold was to be used in making forks, bowls, and jars, how much silver and gold in making dishes.

dag: N sabi n zaligunim paai ʒiibutuhili ti ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi li, ka tɛhi ni di nyɛla zaɣ pala.
en: Even if I wrote , laws for Ephraim, he would treat them as if they were for some stranger.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋa n-leei yi zaa ha bia.
en: Whoever serves you like a servant is the greatest among you.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni niŋ buɣim dabi yi yɔɣu maa, ka buɣim maa di binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: But I will punish you for what you have done. I will set your palace on fire, and the fire will burn down everything around it. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul guhirila a tiliginsim, ka dol a zaligunima.
en: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord , and I do all you command.

dag: nti zaŋ yi ba mini yi malibu kuli n sanna ka n ti tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka yi ti diri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira yi yubu.
en: Tell them to bring their father and their families here. I will give them the best land in Egypt, and they can eat and enjoy everything that grows there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi bela n sani ka n zaŋ bini dihi tabili li sɔŋ?.
en: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.

dag: N niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ, n niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ! Biɛrim mali ma, ka n lɛbiri ginda. Mbaye, n suhu ni, n suhu kul tɔrila pampam. N ku tooi shini, dama n wumla kikahi kumsi, di nyɛla tɔbuchiriga.
en: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.

dag: Ka o daa tim ŋmaai shikpam maa niŋ o nuu ni diri chana; ka daa zaŋ di shɛli nti ti o ba min o ma, ka bɛ di. Amaa ka Samsin daa bi yɛli ba ni gbuɣin kpiɔŋ ni ka o yihi shiri maa na.
en: He scraped the honey out into his hands and ate it as he walked along. Then he went to his father and mother and gave them some. They ate it, but Samson did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the dead body of a lion.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi chɛ ba bahi mɔɣu maa ni. Sagban shɛli din daa wuhiri ba sol la daa bi vuui ka chɛ ba wuntaŋ ni, ka buɣim din daa ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba soli la gba daa bi chɛ ba.
en: But you did not abandon them there in the desert, for your mercy is great. You did not take away the cloud or the fire that showed them the path by day and night.

dag: Dama ti Duuma n-daa chɛ ka Siria tɔbbihi maa wum tɔbbihi pam chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri kandina vuri ka bɛ yɛli taba, Izraɛl naa dala Hiti nanim mini Ijipti nanim bahi ti na.
en: The Lord had made the Syrians hear what sounded like the advance of a large army with horses and chariots, and the Syrians thought that the king of Israel had hired Hittite and Egyptian kings and their armies to attack them.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli o kɔŋko suhiri Naawuni ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: When Jesus was alone praying, his disciples came to him, and he asked them, What do people say about me.

dag: O daa mali salima bans anahi n-zaŋ li ga teebuli maa luɣ anahi zuɣu naba la.
en: He made four carrying rings of gold for it and put them at the four corners, where the legs were.

dag: Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili! Naawuni chɛ ka bɛ ʒi salima yi Shiiba na ti ti o. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni tir o sahakam. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni daalibarika niŋd o ni dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Long live the king! Let him receive gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king. Ask God to bless him every day.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa buɣisi n-kpe ka di mali shaara mini sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duri maa zuɣusaa.
en: Above them were high-quality stones cut to measure, as well as cedar.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan chɛ ka tɔɣisigu niŋ o mini Izraɛl naa sunsuuni.
en: Jehoshaphat made a peace agreement with the king of Israel.

dag: Miri ka a lihi ni a mali yɛm, zom Yawɛ, ka zo n-yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.

dag: Di nabihi daa be kasi gari sakuɣa, ka piɛli gari bihim. Bɛ niŋgbuna daa mali alaafee. Bɛ zabiri viɛlim daa ŋmanila safaya kuɣa viɛlim.
en: Her nazirites were purer than snow; they were more dazzling than milk. Their limbs were redder than coral; their bodies were sapphire.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka man Pool nyɛ Yisa Masia dansarika yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zuɣu.
en: So I, Paul, am a prisoner because I serve Christ Jesus for you who are not Jews.

dag: Malimiya dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo dapaɣa pisi.
en: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put of these frames along the south side and more along the north.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la pali zoya zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb la ti lu a daboya zuɣu min a vinvama ni ni a kɔsoya ni.
en: Dead bodies will cover your mountains and fill up your valleys.

dag: O daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒiɛri zuɣusaa. O yiko puuni ka o daa chɛ ka nudirigu polo pɔhim ʒɛna;.
en: He sent a strong wind from the east, and by his power he made the south wind blow.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban yɛl o, Chɛ ka n yɛl a, n vihiya nya ka di nyɛla a zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni;.
en: Laban said to him, Let me say this: I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you.

dag: Chɛ ka n galimi kalinsi mini m biɛhigu din tuhi gbib ma, dama nyini ka n niŋ naani.
en: May my goodness and honesty preserve me, because I trust in you.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣ min o bia leeg o paɣiba di nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka di simdi ka bɛ nyo doo maa min o paɣiba maa buɣim din ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ku lan be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: If a man marries a woman and her mother as well, it is shameful. They will be burned with fire—the man and the two women—so that no such shameful thing will be found among you.

dag: Ti ni daa na be yi san la, ti daa pun yɛli ya ni ti ni nya alaka, ka yi zaa mi ni lala n-shiri niŋ.
en: Even when we were with you, we told you that we would all have to suffer. And you know that it happened just as we said.

dag: Nyamiya o ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ titali shɛm! Hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛlikam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o.
en: You see, then, how great he was. Abraham, our famous ancestor, gave him one tenth of all he got in the battle.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba bɔhi, Paɣ ŋuni n-lee ni mal anzinfa laɣibaligu pia, ka di zaɣ yini ti bɔrigi, ka o ku nyo firila kolikol o yiŋ zaa m-bo li ni nimmoo hal ti nya li?.
