en: Suppose a woman has ten silver coins, but she loses one of them. She will take a light and clean the house. She will look carefully for the coin until she finds it.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi, bɛ kanimina nti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: My enemies come back in the evening, snarling like dogs as they go about the city.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn chaŋ, bɛ ni tooi chaŋ luɣa anahi maa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi. Amaa tooni kalinli maa daa yi kul kpa shɛli polo, kalima maa zaa doli li mi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: When the creatures moved, they could go in any direction without turning. They all moved together in the direction they wanted to go, without having to turn around.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani.
en: Very early in the morning he came to his disciples, walking on the lake.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni ti zaŋ n ni zaŋ n yɛligu shɛli ti a la yɛli ba.
en: He said, Go to Nineveh, that great city, and proclaim to the people the message I have given you.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa ku o mini ŋun nyɔɣu yo taba. Ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba, amaa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ba wɔhu pahi wɔribariba ni n-zo n-tiligi.
en: and each of them attacked and killed an enemy soldier. The rest of the Syrian army turned and ran, and the Israelites went after them. Benhadad and some others escaped on horses.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti kpa di naba dali yaha, ka o nyaandoliba maa lan laɣim be duu puuni, ka Tomas gba beni. Duu maa dunoya daa kparimi, ka Yisa daa ti lan puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: A week later the followers were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. The doors were locked, but Jesus came and stood among them. He said, Peace be with you.

dag: Ti Duuma ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka a zom, ka di ni niŋ daba ayi ka a ku lan nya wuntaŋa. Ka paɣili mini zibisim dii kana ti to o, ka o go m-bɔhindi gindi bɔri so ni o vo o.
en: Listen! The Lords power is set against you. You will be blind for a while, unable even to see the daylight. At once, Bar-Jesus eyes were darkened, and he began to grope about for someone to lead him around by the hand.

dag: Nyamiya, ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ kanimina ni o ti zaŋ yiko pam di nam. O ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani; o laara gba be o sani.
en: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.

dag: Ka Dilaila yɛl o, A boli ma la jɛrigu, ka ŋma ma ʒiri. Niŋm ania, yɛlim ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi.
en: Delilah told Samson, Look, you've been making a fool of me and not telling me the truth. Please tell me how someone could tie you up.

dag: Amaa Dauda zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni daa ti Abijam firila Jɛrusalɛm n-chɛ ka o bia di nam zan o zaani gbib Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Even so, on account of David, the LORD his God gave Abijam a lamp in Jerusalem by supporting his son who succeeded him and by preserving Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu bomiya nya o ni sɔɣiri luɣ shɛŋa zaa ka labina ti yɛli ma yɛlimaŋli, ka m mini ya chaŋ; ŋun dee yi be tiŋgbani maa ni, n ni bɔ o shee Judanim zaa niriba tusatusa puuni.
en: Find out where all his hiding places are and come back when you're sure. Then I'll go with you. If he is still in the area, or anywhere among the clans of Judah, I'll find him.

dag: Ka di pala Adam ka Sintani daa yɔhim, amaa Awa ka o daa yɔhim ka o leei ŋun saɣim Naawuni zaligu.
en: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.

dag: Ka yi ti pirigi li ka di saɣisi taba. N daa poya ni n ni zaŋ li ti yi yaannima, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti leei yi dini ni yi fali.
en: I solemnly promised your ancestors that I would give them possession of this land; now divide it equally among you.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la daa lo ni bɛ ku dansarikanim maa, dama ni di yi pa lala bɛ ni duɣi kom maa du n-zo n-tiligi.
en: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Mbo n-faaŋa, bi suŋ ni n yɛdalana ŋun ʒe ma yim! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ a leei bin din zooi pam zuɣulana; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli kaman n suhu ni piɛli shɛm ŋɔ.
en: The master answered, You did right. You are a good servant who can be trusted. You did well with a small amount of money. So I will let you care for much greater things. Come and share my happiness with me.

dag: Ka di zaa ha yi di nyɛla yaɣ yini, ya ka niŋgbuŋ naan be?.
en: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.

dag: Nyini n-zali tɔrili ni o yiɣimi du zuɣusaa katiŋa ka tɛr o tiɛɣu luɣ shɛli din du pam la?.
en: Did you train eagles to build.

dag: Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa mali ti paai Mahanaim, ka Nahash bia Shɔbi ŋun daa yi Raba din be Ammɔn tiŋgban ni la na mini Makiri Amiɛl bia ŋun daa yi Lɔdɛba na la ni Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nira ka yi Rɔgɛlim na la.
en: When David arrived at Mahanaim, he was met by Shobi son of Nahash, from the city of Rabbah in Ammon, and by Machir son of Ammiel, from Lodebar, and by Barzillai, from Rogelim in Gilead.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam o ni yɛn leei naa deemba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ni zali saha shɛli maa daa ti yɛn paai.
en: When the servants reported this to David, he was happy to become the kings son-in-law. Even before the allotted time had expired.

dag: Amaa m bi mi n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm ti n dan Naa Siiza. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o ka yi sanna, di bahi bamdi nyin Naa Agiripa. Ti yi vih o naai, di pa shɛli n ni baŋ n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm;.
en: I have nothing definite to write to our lord emperor. Therefore, Ive brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this investigation, I might have something to write.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan yih a wahala ni n-zaŋ a tahi palo ni be luɣ shɛli ka muɣisigu kani, ka nim kpaba daa pali a ŋman ni.
en: Surely he draws you up from the brink of trouble to a wide place without distress; your table is set with rich food.

dag: Amaa ka Ayuba garigi yɛl o, A yɛtɔɣa maa ŋmanila paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra la yɛtɔɣa. Ti deemi din viɛli Naawuni nuu ni, ka ku deei din bie dina? Yɛla ŋɔ zaa ni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi o noli yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: Job said to her, Youre talking like a foolish woman. Will we receive good from God but not also receive bad? In all this, Job didnt sin with his lips.

dag: Bɛ yi nahindi sarikanim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord knows when our spirits are crushed in prison;.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa di din kpalim maa; bɛ ti dim li luɣ kasi shee, ka di niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dundɔŋ ni ka bɛ ni ti ŋub li.
en: Aaron and his sons will use the rest of that grain to make bread without yeast. This must be eaten in a holy place—in the courtyard around the Meeting Tent.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o daa zaŋ buɣim lu Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu; ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: When the LORD heard this, he became furious. A fire was ignited against Jacob; wrath also burned against Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni leei ti sariakarita, o ni woligi ti m min a. O ni lihi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka zani n nyaaŋa n-fa ma a nuu ni bahi.
en: I pray that the Lord will help me escape and show that I am in the right.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa wum ni o neei kum ni, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la nya o maa, bɛ daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: But even after they heard the news, they didnt believe that Jesus was alive and that Mary had seen him.

dag: Ka so yi dolina ni o ti ku o yo samli, bɛn di zaŋ o ti o, o ni ku o kpee maa ka di nyɛla sarati zuɣu, ka pa ni o min o pun malila taali la zuɣu.
en: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni n-chani Firawuna sani nti yihiri Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Moses said to God, Who am I to go to Pharaoh and to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Ka o mabia Ɛshɛk mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ulam n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛushi, ka Ɛlifɛlɛt mi daa pah ata.
en: His brother Esheks family: Ulam his oldest, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

dag: Jɛhu daa dila Izraɛl nam maa ʒini Samaria yuun pihitaayika.
en: Jehu had ruled in Samaria as king of Israel for twenty-eight years.

dag: Chɛrubinim ayi maa kpiŋkpama zaŋ tuɣi taba wɔɣilim daa nyɛla kaman mita awɛi, ka bɛ daa ʒe bɛ naba zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa dunoli.
en: So the wings of the two Cherub angels together reached across the room—a total of cubits. The Cherub angels stood facing the Holy Place.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa. Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa.
en: Lord , the earth is full of your constant love; teach me your commandments.

dag: M bi bɔri mmaŋ jilima tibu, amaa yino n-naɣ beni m-bɔri ni n nya jilima, ŋun mi n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: I am not trying to get honor for myself. There is one who wants this honor for me. He is the judge.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka yi tɔŋ yi tuma zaa ni, ka yi bihi nabi, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nabi, ka yi puri atam gba nabi. Dama Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka o zaɣa be yi ni, ka yi tɔŋ kaman o zaɣa ni daa be yi yaannim ni ka bɛ tɔŋ shɛm la.
en: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, chibimi gooni maa voli. N ni daa chibi gooni maa ka di niŋ voli.
en: God said to me, Son of man, make a hole in the wall. So I made a hole in the wall, and there I saw a door.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun doli wuntitali soli o tuma zaa ni, ka zɔri nambɔɣu o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: The Lord is righteous in all he does, merciful in all his acts.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ bi lan bɔri bindirigu, ka bɛ kɔre lan ka bindir viɛlli ni gba.
en: They feel so bad they cannot eat. Even the best food makes them sick.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛhab min o daŋ zaa polo la shɛli ku yiɣisi. Yawɛ niŋmi kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija yɛli shɛm la.
en: Know this: Nothing that the LORD has said against Ahabs dynasty will fail to come true. The LORD has done what he said he would do, speaking through his servant Elijah.

dag: ni taataa ni gbarizam ni laɣipiɛliga ni wubiga min o balibu zaa.
en: ostriches, nighthawks, sea gulls, all kinds of hawks.

dag: Ti ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la, lala ka n na kul yɛri ya yaha: So yi yihiri lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ yi ni daa pun deei shɛl la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa ni daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee kum.
en: When the LORDs messenger spoke these words to all the Israelites, they raised their voices and cried out loud.

dag: Ti yi dol o zaligunima, dina n-ni chɛ ka ti baŋ ni ti mi o.
en: If we obey God's commands, then we are sure that we know him.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ la saha shɛl o ni daa wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Kapɛrinium la.
en: Jesus said these things while he was teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Here is the message which God gave to Isaiah son of Amoz about Judah and Jerusalem:.

dag: Ka bɛ fo, dama bɛ daa ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: But the followers did not answer, because their argument on the road was about which one of them was the greatest.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Mani n-nyɛ buzɔŋ dunoli.
en: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.

dag: Tan yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Tan tolima piniyini maa zaa buɣisibu daa nyɛla yim.
en: Each curtain was forty-five feet long and each curtain six feet wide. All eleven curtains were the same size.

dag: Hal Yisa mabihi gba daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: His brothers said this because even they didnt believe in him.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi lan wuhimiy o yi yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: And so I beg you to let him know that you really do love him.

dag: Hiburu paɣ yi lan yɛn dɔɣi ka yi chaŋ ni yi ti deei bia, ka nya ka bia maa nyɛla bidibiga, yin kumiy o, amaa di yi nyɛ bipuɣiŋga, yin chɛliy o.
en: When you are helping the Hebrew women give birth and you see the baby being born, if its a boy, kill him. But if its a girl, you can let her live.

dag: N kpɛla yɔɣu kaman piɛ so ŋun bɔrigi la. Bom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ shee, dama m bi tam a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: Ive wandered off like a sheep, lost. Find your servant because I havent forgotten your commandments!.

dag: Dabili ŋun mali yɛm ni ti su bidɔɣiro ŋun tumdi vi tuma, ka ni ti di fali kaman daŋ ni nir la.
en: An insightful servant rules over a disgraceful son and will divide an inheritance with the brothers.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna. Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, accept us again. Smile down on us and save us!.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun daa kahigi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha piligu ni wuhi la n-yɛl lala.
en: So says the Lord, who made this known long ago.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pahi;.
en: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni ni tooi neei Yisahaku kum ni; ka di bemi kaman lala n-daa shiri niŋ, dama ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun sani, Yisahaku daa bemi kaman ŋun shiri neei kum ni na.
en: Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise Isaac from death—and, so to speak, Abraham did receive Isaac back from death.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, a nyɛla binzɔrigu! A suhu yi yiɣisi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani a tooni?.
en: But you, Lord , are feared by all. No one can stand in your presence when you are angry.

dag: ni Zɛla ni Hailɛf ni Jɛbusi; ni Gibia ni Kiriatijiarim: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaanahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus , Gibeah, and Kiriath Jearim: fourteen cities, along with the towns around them. This is the land which the families of the tribe of Benjamin received as their possession.

dag: A bi nya ka di nyɛla o yɛda niŋbu min o tuma tumbu n-daa laɣim tum lala maa? Ka o yɛda niŋbu daa niŋ dɛde la o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.

dag: dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni ka n yih a na; ka bol a ka a yi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam ni katiŋ na, ka n yɛl a, A nyɛla n dabili. Mani m-piig a ka bi zaɣis a.
en: you whom I took from the ends of the earth and called from its farthest corners, saying to you, You are my servant; I chose you and didnt reject you.

dag: Ka malaika maa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti siɣ a zuɣu na, ka Zallakudura Naa yiko mahim ti gil a; dinzuɣu a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bi so maa, bɛ ni ti boon o la bi suŋ ni Naawuni Bia.
en: The angel replied, The Holy Spirit will come over you and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore, the one who is to be born will be holy. He will be called Gods Son.

dag: Lala ka Jɔshua daa niŋ tiligi Gibiɔnnim maa Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ bi ku ba.
en: So this is what Joshua did: he protected them and did not allow the people of Israel to kill them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bimbiɛlli ti biri kulim shee. Di daa nyɛla bimbilli din ʒe m-baɣi kom pam. O daa biri li mi kaman tia din zoora yomyom la.
en: The eagle also took a seed from Israel and planted it in a fertile field with plenty of water, like a willow tree beside a stream.

dag: ka bɔhira, O labbuna alikauli lɔbu palibu la lee be ya? Dama ti banim kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ni pɔŋɔ, binshɛɣukam na kul bemi kaman di ni daa be shɛm dunia nambu saha la.
en: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? After all, nothing has changed—not since the beginning of creation, nor even since the ancestors died.

dag: n yi ti sahi n takɔb shɛli din nyaɣisiri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ saria karibu niŋ n nuu ni, n ni bɔhi n dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je ma la tibili.
en: that I will sharpen my flashing sword and see that justice is done. I will take revenge on my enemies and punish those who hate me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Nuzaa polo maa daa tim ti boli Jɛrɔbɔam na. Ka o mini Izraɛlnim maa daa kana ti yɛli Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: The people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa zaŋ Musa paɣ min o bidibis ayi maa n-ka o sanna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa be Naawuni zoli maa gbini luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Jethro came with Moses' wife and her two sons into the desert where Moses was camped at the holy mountain.

dag: Amaa n ni daa tɛhi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni, n daa nyaya ka di nyɛla tuun shɛli din to n sani.
en: I tried to think this problem through, but it was too difficult for me.

dag: Niriba maa kul bela nimaani kuhira, amaa ka o bi garigi ba, bɛ karimbaani mini bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. M bɔri ni a kpaŋsi yɛla ŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka bɛn niŋ Naawuni yɛda tooi zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma. Dimbɔŋɔnim viɛla, ka mali buchi ninsalinim sani.
en: This is a true saying. I want you to give special emphasis to these matters, so that those who believe in God may be concerned with giving their time to doing good deeds, which are good and useful for everyone.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be teeku puuni daa sɔhigimi a ni daa lu dahin shɛli maa, ka di gari ba a ni daa naai shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Now, on the day it has fallen, The islands are trembling, And their people are shocked at such destruction.

dag: Ka m mi nya ka o bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum; amaa omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ni o bɔri ni o zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani zuɣu ka n gba lɔri nia ni n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tah o sani.
en: When I judged him, I did not find him guilty of any crime worthy of death. But he asked to be judged by Caesar, so I decided to send him to Rome.

dag: Ka Gaal daa ti ŋmaligi guui, ka Abimilɛk kari dol o. Ka niriba pam daa nya dansi zaŋ lala hal ti paai tiŋ maa gooni dunoli shee.
en: Abimelech routed him, and he ran away. Many fell wounded, all the way up to the entrance of the gate.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi ni jɛm ma, di zaa ni leeg a dini.
en: I will give it all to you, if you will only worship me.

dag: Di ni sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni yɛligu mir a; hal di be a nol ni min a suhu ni. .
en: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, The message is as near as your mouth or your heart. And this is the same message we preach about faith.

dag: O daa yi ʒiinila Dɛbɔra dɔbino tia din be Rama mini Bɛtɛl sunsuuni Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ la ni gbini, ka Izraɛlnim chan o sani ka o ti kariti bɛ yɛla saria tiri ba.
en: She would sit under Deborahs palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the Ephraim highlands, and the Israelites would come to her to settle disputes.

dag: ni o guhiri hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ o dimnim leeg o napɔntamdigu.
en: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni daa tahi laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa na m-mali anzinfa taha mini firilakpihindi bina ni lahi ni kikahi bee salima bee anzinfa lahi n-zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: But the money that was brought to the LORDs temple was not used to make silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or any gold or silver object for the LORDs temple.

dag: Naawuni Kundi daa pun daŋ tiri wuhi ni Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka daa daŋ yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti Ibrahimma yɛli: A zuɣu ka zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika.
en: The scripture predicted that God would put the Gentiles right with himself through faith. And so the scripture announced the Good News to Abraham: Through you God will bless all people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Nahash ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim naa la daa kpi, ka o bia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.

dag: Biliɛɣu ku lan kpi nimaani bee ka ninkurigu ti kpi ka o saha na bi paai; dama nir yi ti niŋ yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni o nyɛla bipolli, ka so mi yi bi paai yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli n-di o.
en: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.

dag: A daa ku m bihi nyo buɣim mali buɣa maa.
en: You slaughtered my sons and placed them in the fire for them!.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ni ti mali ba ansarisi, ka sabisi ba bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: It will make a sound like clapping hands as they run away. It will whistle at them as they run from their homes.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Make these poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lan zaŋ Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa niŋ ti nuu ni, ka ti daa ku ba hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: So the Lord also placed King Og and his people in our power, and we slaughtered them all.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli Tomas, Zaŋm a nubil bɔbili n nuhi ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a nuu tim m puluɣili bɔbili ŋɔ ni, ka niŋ yɛda.
en: and said to Thomas, Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na nti laɣim tab chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: Some Pharisees and several teachers of the Law of Moses from Jerusalem came and gathered around Jesus.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Yi yi ti nya binshɛli din chihiri Naawuni sani la, ka di ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu Luɣ Kasi Shee, kaman Anabi Daniɛl ni daa pun yɛli di yɛla la, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm!.
en: When you see the disgusting and destructive thing that Daniel talked about standing in the holy place.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl daa bo Damaskus binshɛɣukam n-ʒili laakumnim pihinahi chaŋ ni o ti puhi Naawuni nir maa. Ka Hazaɛl daa paai ti zani Ilaisha tooni ka yɛl o, A bia Siria Naa Bɛnhadad n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti bɔh a nya o ni kpaŋ o barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: So Hazael loaded forty camels with all kinds of the finest products of Damascus and went to Elisha. When Hazael met him, he said, Your servant King Benhadad has sent me to ask you whether or not he will recover from his sickness.

dag: Yisa Masia ni sa be shɛm sɔhila, lala ka o be zuŋɔ, ka kul ni be lala hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever!.

dag: M mabihi, n ni daa ka yi sanna la, pa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din to ni baŋbu bee yɛm yɛtɔɣa din yi bɔhimbu pam puuni na ka n daa zaŋ Naawuni daashili yɛlimaŋli yɛla la kahigiri wuhiri ya.
en: When I came to you, brothers and sisters, I didnt come preaching Gods secrets to you like I was an expert in speech or wisdom.

dag: mini Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi ni o tizo Jɔn, o ni daa pa shɛb mi yupaa Bɔanɛjiiz la.
en: James and his brother John, the sons of Zebedee .

dag: O ni daa mali bia maa chani Yisa sani ka alizin biɛɣu maa yiɣis o n-darig o. Ka Yisa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bia maa kpaŋ, ka o zaŋ o labisi ti o ba maa.
en: As the boy was coming, the demon knocked him to the ground and threw him into a fit. Jesus gave a command to the evil spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

dag: Ka yi ni gahi yi bimbɔba dahin shɛli maa, zaŋmiya piɛlaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dindali.
en: On the day the bundle is lifted up for you, you must offer a flawless one-year-old lamb as an entirely burned offering to the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi Hadirak tiŋgbɔŋnim mini Damaskusnim tibili. Pa Izraɛlnim zuliya kɔŋko ka Yawɛ su, amaa ŋuna n-su Siria tiŋgbɔŋ gba.
en: This is a message from the Lord : His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa chɛ ka Dauda lan lo o yurilim alikauli yaha, dama o daa yur o mi kaman omaŋmaŋ la.
en: So Jonathan again made a pledge to David because he loved David as much as himself.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni gbahi jɛŋgbini bihi ka o suhu yiɣisi shɛm la, lala ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu. N ni dari tɔhi ba, ka ŋub ba kaman gbuɣinli la, kaman mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ŋ-ŋub ba la.
en: I will attack you like a bear that has lost her cubs, and I will tear you open. Like a lion I will devour you on the spot, and will tear you to pieces like a wild animal.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ me gooni gili ya, ka teei gili ya. Bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbee fiɛbi Izraɛl naa tapaɣa.
en: Now muster your troops, Daughter Troop! They have laid siege against us; with a rod they will strike the cheek of the judge of Israel.

dag: Yi gba mali suhusaɣiŋgu pumpɔŋɔ, amaa n ni ti lan nyan ya yaha, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli, ka so ti ku tooi yihi yi suhupiɛlli maa yi suhuri ni.
en: That is how it is with you: now you are sad, but I will see you again, and your hearts will be filled with gladness, the kind of gladness that no one can take away from you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o piɛma n-to n-wurim ba; ka chɛ ka o saa nyaɣisiri ginda.
en: He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies; with flashes of lightning he sent them running.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla doo ŋun paai yuun pihinu zaŋ chana, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pinaanu, ka paɣ mi nyɛ bini pia.
en: If the age of the person is years or more, the value is fifteen shekels if the person is male, ten shekels for a female.

dag: Dabiɛm daa kul gbahila tinzunnim maa, ka bɛ yiri bɛ birininim ni zɔrina ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ laɣimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la na nti tuhi deei tiŋ maa amaŋmaŋa, di yi pa lala n yi tuhi deei tiŋ maa, bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli bol li.
en: Now bring the rest of the army together and attack Rabbah. Capture this city before I do, or else it will be called by my name.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: You must have no other gods before me.

dag: Bina anahi n-nyɛ bɛn gamdi giŋgaani bɛ biɛhigu ni.
en: Three or four creatures really strut around:.

dag: Kpahim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be gbiŋgbaŋ ni la zuɣu ni; ka kpahi zuliya kam naɣilahi mini bɛ naɣibihi la zuɣu ni. Nom taai ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yu farigu deebu pam la. Wurimmi zuliya shɛb bɛn yuri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla pam la.
en: Rebuke the wild animals of the marshland, the herd of bulls among the calves of the peoples. Trample those who delight in money; scatter the peoples who take pleasure in battles.

dag: Nuhu bidibis ata maa zuliya m-pali dunia ŋɔ zaa ŋɔ.
en: These three men were Noahs sons. And all the people on earth came from these three sons.

dag: Nyama, n lɔr a la mihi, ka a ku tooi lan lɛbigi yaɣ yini polo dɔni yaɣ din la hal ka a ti naai a teei gili dabisa maa.
en: I will tie you up so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until the siege is over.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yinim bɛn mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi ŋɔ, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ:.
en: Listen, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but dont see and ears but dont hear.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Wula ka n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛl ni lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya, ka n ku lihiri suhugarigu lihigu.
en: and answered, May Your Majesty live forever! How can I keep from looking sad when the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins and its gates have been destroyed by fire.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka bɛ be Mɔab naa maa sani saha shɛli zaa ŋun Dauda ni daa be vokabili maa ni maa.
en: So David left his parents with the king of Moab. They stayed with the king of Moab as long as David was at the fort.

dag: Man Jeemsi ŋun nyɛ Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabili la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri yinim bɛn nyɛ ti zuliya pinaayi bɛn wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam la m-puhiri ya.
en: From James, a slave of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ. To the twelve tribes who are scattered outside the land of Israel. Greetings!.

dag: Nyamiya, m bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo mini doo maa mam m-bɔŋɔ; chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na pumpɔŋɔ; ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm, amaa di tumiya doo ŋɔ ŋun vi tuun shɛli.
en: Look, here is my daughter. She has never had sex before. I will bring her out to you now. This man also has a slave woman. You can use them any way you want, but dont do such a terrible sin against this man.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala ti ninsalitali biɛhigu la sandiriba ni ti doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu maa yubu ni wuhiri ti shɛm;.
en: So then, my friends, we have an obligation, but it is not to live as our human nature wants us to.

dag: Yi ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa bemi kaman gariŋga gala la. Nir yi ŋma di gal yini wahu n-yiri di ni na. Amaa yi nia biɛri maa ku kun ya buchi. Di nyɛla din ka buchi kaman kpatinari zana chinchini la, di bi galisi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ni tooi zaŋ li pili.
en: The evil plots you make are as deadly as the eggs of a poisonous snake. Crush an egg, out comes a snake! But your plots will do you no good—they are as useless as clothing made of cobwebs!.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbir anahi daa yi teeku maa ni na, bɛ zaa mi daa bela kɔŋkɔba.
en: Four giant beasts emerged from the sea, each different from the others.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee chi ni chana, a ni tooi zaŋ a nuu ŋmɛm kazuɣuri maa ŋubi, amaa miri ka a zaŋ sua ŋ-ŋmah a kpee chi.
en: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam tin ya la, yi di ba zalinsi n-zaɣisi ba yɔbu. Wummiya bɛ fabila! Tumtumdiba maa kuhigu chaŋ ti lu ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa tibili ni.
en: People worked in your fields, but you did not pay them. They are crying out against you. They harvested your crops. Now the Lord All-Powerful has heard their cries.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm ti Duuma Yisa yɛda, ka a min a yiŋnim zaa tiligi.
en: They replied, Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your entire household.

dag: Ka Yisifu min o ba yiŋnim daa kul be Ijipti. Yisifu daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pia dunia yili ŋɔ.
en: Joseph lived in Egypt with his brothers until he died at the age of .

dag: Ka Maata yɛl o, M mi ni o ni ti neei kum ni zaadali.
en: Martha answered, I know that he will rise to live again at the time of the resurrection on the last day.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A biɛyanim zaŋ biŋkɔbiri chaŋ Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri. Kamina ka n tim a bɛ sani. Ka o yɛli, To.
en: Israel said to Joseph, Arent your brothers tending the sheep near Shechem? Come, Ill send you to them. And he said, Im ready.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka niriba bɛn daa kpalim duli din la polo kpahim baŋ ni ŋariŋ yini kɔŋko n-sa ʒe nimaani, ka lan mi ni Yisa sa bi kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu, amaa kulla bɛ kɔŋko n-sa kpe li chaŋ.
en: The next day came. Some people had stayed on the other side of the lake. They knew that Jesus did not go with his followers in the boat. They knew that the followers had left in the boat alone. And they knew it was the only boat that was there.

dag: Ka Rut daa kul be o kayiha maa ni hal ka zaawuni ti paai, ka o daa zaŋ o ni nya shɛm tariga m-bu li yɛli ka di niŋ kilɔgiram pia.
en: So she gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed what she had gleaned; it was about an ephah of barley.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee buɣisi di tariga, bee n-teei mii sɔŋ buɣisi li? Biɛhiŋ kani, a mi di zaa!.
en: And who decided how big the earth should be? Who measured it with a measuring line?.

dag: N wum Naawuni ni yɛli siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni ŋun Naawuni n-su yiko.
en: God says there is one thing you can really depend on, and I believe it: Strength comes from God.

dag: Ka o daa mali nti kpe yil shɛli, ka zoomba maa dol o kpe; ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi niŋ yɛda ni n ni tooi niŋ yi ni bɔri shɛli maa? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: When he came into the house, the blind men approached him. Jesus said to them, Do you believe I can do this? Yes, Lord, they replied.

dag: dindina bɛ niriba ayi bɛn mali yɛtɔɣa maa bɛn cham Yawɛ tooni maligumaaniba mini sariakaritiba bɛn be tuma ni di saha maa sani.
en: the two persons who have a legal suit must stand before the LORD, before the priests, and before the judges that are in office at that time.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ni o ti nya ninsalinim ni me tin shɛli ka me pii tam di zuɣu maa.
en: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the humans built.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol a zaligunim maa zo.
en: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.

dag: n-yi a biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo katiŋ kana. A mini niriba bɛn be a sani zaa nyɛla wɔribariba, ka nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa ka galisi pam.
en: You will come from your place out of the far north, and you will bring many people with you. All of them will ride on horses. You will be a large and a powerful army.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi darigiri bɛ bihi tibili je ba mi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri bɛ bihi saɣisiri ba mi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: If you dont correct your children, you dont love them. If you love them, you will be quick to discipline them.

dag: Yi mini yi tɔbbihi ni yi niriba pam bɛn be yi sani ni ti kana kaman sanʒiɛɣu, ka be kaman sagbani din limsi tiŋgban la.
en: But you will come to attack them. You will come like a storm. You will come like a thundercloud covering the land. You and all your groups of soldiers from many nations will come to attack them.

dag: Bɛ tibirila n niriba maa daŋa bɛ baɣa ka tibbu ka yɛra, Di mali soochi, di mali soochi. Ka soochi mi kani.
en: They should bandage the wounds my people have suffered, but they treat their wounds like small scratches. They say, Its all right, everything is all right. But it is not all right!.

dag: Yawɛ daa be alizanda ni ka tahi bahina, ka bɛ daa wum Zallakudura Naa kukoli.
en: Then the Lord thundered from the sky, and the voice of Almighty God was heard.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nya ti ni be yɛlimuɣisir shɛl ni. Jɛrusalɛm lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di n-saɣim di dunɔdaya. Dinzuɣu kamiyana ka ti lan lab me di gooni maa din ni chɛ ka ti yi vi shɛl ni ti ni be maa.
en: Then I said to them, You can see the trouble we have here: Jerusalem is a pile of ruins, and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, lets rebuild the wall of Jerusalem. Then we will not be ashamed anymore.

dag: O doli zaligu soli kariti saria tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba bindirigu. Yawɛ yoori bɛn be sarika ni bahira.
en: He does what is right for those who have been hurt. He gives food to the hungry. The Lord frees people locked up in prison.

dag: Yuŋ zahima yɛla tɛhibu puuni, saha shɛli niriba ni gbihi maai la.
en: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;.

dag: Amaa n dana, o bi boli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini maligumaana Zadok ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni a bia Sulemaana.
en: But he did not invite me, or Zadok the priest, or Benaiah son of Jehoiada, or your son Solomon.

dag: hal ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ti niŋ pali; ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa wuhi ni o ka taali.
en: until what he had predicted came true. The word of the Lord proved him right.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ suhuyini n-gbib ba, ka daa doli yɛm soli wuhi ba din tuhi.
en: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti wum ni bɛ nya Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o san la. Di saha maa ŋun Sool daa ʒila ti shɛli din yuli booni tamarisik la gbini Gibia Zoli zuɣu, ka o kpani be o nuu ni ka o sapashin kpamba zaa ʒe n-gil o.
en: Saul was sitting under a small tree on top of the hill at Gibeah when he heard that David and his men had been located. Saul was holding his spear, and his officers were standing in front of him.

dag: Ka daɣila di daa bi simdi ni Masia nya wahala ŋɔ zaa ka naanyi nya jilima.
en: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti mali zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni o simdi kum, o ni yɛli ni o nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu.
en: The Jewish leaders answered, We have a law that says he must die, because he said he is the Son of God.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya leei n niriba, ka leei yi Naawuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yihi ya Ijiptinim ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: Ill take you as my people, and Ill be your God. You will know that I, the LORD, am your God, who has freed you from Egyptian forced labor.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda ka bɔhira, Masia yi ti kana, o ni wuhi shihira n-lan gari doo ŋɔ ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: But many in the crowd believed in him and said, When the Messiah comes, will he perform more miracles than this man has.

dag: ka ʒiɛm n zaligunim ka zaɣisi li yi suhu ni, ka bi niŋ n zaligunim maa zaa ni yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm, amaa ka saɣim n daalikauli.
en: If you refuse to obey my laws and commands, you have broken my agreement.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu ka taari duŋ, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha dii paami maa.
en: Don't be afraid when you hear of wars and revolutions; such things must happen first, but they do not mean that the end is near.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa; di gbibiya jaaŋgbɛhi bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima bee bindira bee liɣiri; yi mi di ʒin ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: after saying to them, Take nothing with you for the trip: no walking stick, no beggar's bag, no food, no money, not even an extra shirt.

dag: Yɛlimiya yi bihi di yɛla; ka bɛ mi ti zaŋ di yɛla maa n-yɛli bɛ bihi, ka bɛ gba ti zaŋ di yɛla n-yɛli ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna niriba.
en: Tell your children about it; they will tell their children, who in turn will tell the next generation.

dag: Ka Pool daa mihigi gariŋga maa bahi buɣim maa ni, ka bi wum biɛrim damli.
en: Paul shook the snake into the fire and suffered no harm.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pinaanu dali chuɣu maa puhibu daba ayopɔin puuni, di simdi ka o lan bo lala bina maa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni chi mini kawana ni kpam sara.
en: He must do the same thing for the seven days of the Festival of Shelters . This festival begins on the th day of the seventh month. These offerings will be the sin offering, the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the oil offering.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried with his ancestors in his ancestor Davids City. His son Jehoram succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Ŋmaligim zani kpaŋ kpe. Ka o daa ŋmaligi zani kpaŋa.
en: Step aside and stand right here, the king said. So Ahimaaz stepped aside and waited.

dag: N gbaala mmaŋ ni so biɛɣu kam dolibu, ni di chɛ ka n tooi gbib a yɛligu.
en: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa laɣim Musa sanna ka o ti zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o zaligu shɛŋa yɛla Sinai Zoli zuɣu maa ti ba.
en: After that all the Israelites came near Moses, and he gave them the commands that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

dag: Ka bɛ ti lo tɔbu n-tuhi Piɛbil la, amaa ka Piɛbil maa ni ti nyaŋ ba, dama o nyɛla duumanim zaa Duuma ni nanim zaa Naa, ka bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb o ni boli min o ni pii ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe o yim.
en: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhiri booni tab yɛra, Kasi, kasi, kasi! N-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. O jilima palila dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They shouted to each other, saying: Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of heavenly forces! All the earth is filled with Gods glory.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ shi so niŋ o ni, ka di chɛ ka o wum ŋumaŋuma yɛla ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. .
en: The Lord will cause the emperor to hear a rumor that will make him go back to his own country, and the Lord will have him killed there.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ chibi sil shɛli ka di be Dauda tiŋ la ni la puuni. Bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔŋla garibil zuɣu, ka daa chɛ ka tulaale duɣiriba zaŋ tulaale mih o, ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣi, ka mali buɣim titali sɔŋ ti o kuli maa jilima.
en: and was buried in the rock tomb which he had carved out for himself in David's City. They used spices and perfumed oils to prepare his body for burial, and they built a huge bonfire to mourn his death.

dag: Ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni pun kari dunia ŋɔ naa saria.
en: and they are wrong about judgment, because the ruler of this world has already been judged.

dag: N ni bahi nyu bara. Di naɣ kala buchi, amaa n na kul ni tɔɣisi ʒiinim mini kahigibunim shɛŋa ti Duuma ni daa zaŋ ti ma la yɛla.
en: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Deemi suhuyiɣisili wain pipia ŋɔ n nuu ni n-chɛ ka n ni yɛn tim a zuliya shɛb sani ŋɔ zaa nyu li.
en: This is what the LORD, God of Israel, said to me: Take this seething cup of wine from my hand and make all the nations gulp it down where Im sending you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa mini daŋ kam ni kpamba Jɛrusalɛm na ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la Dauda tiŋ din nyɛ Ziɔn la ni na.
en: Then King Solomon summoned all the leaders of the tribes and clans of Israel to assemble in Jerusalem, in order to take the Lord 's Covenant Box from Zion, David's City, to the Temple.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ba Yaakubu sani.
en: So the brothers left Egypt and went to their father in the land of Canaan.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ tiri ya maa, ka yi yihi ba, ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni n-kpe m-be bɛ yiya ni.
en: The Lord your God is giving you land that belongs to other nations. The Lord your God will destroy those nations. You will live where these people lived. You will take their cities and their houses. When that happens.

dag: Bɛtɛlnima n-daa tim Sharɛza mini Rɛgɛmmɛlɛk m-pahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu ni bɛ chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer, Regem-Melech, and his men to ask the Lord a question.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi ni yi yaansi ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi nyɛvili ni zaa, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaŋ wuhiri ya ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: You and your descendants must respect the Lord your God as long as you live. You must obey all his laws and commands that I give you. If you do this, you will have a long life in that new land.

dag: amaa tinim sani, Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni, ka binshɛɣukam yila o sanna, ka ti bela o zuɣu. Duuma yino ko mi m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam nambu ni yi so tuma ni na la, ka ti gba bela o zuɣu.
en: For us there is only one God, and he is our Father. All things came from him, and we live for him. And there is only one Lord, Jesus Christ. All things were made through him, and we also have life through him.

dag: amaa ka o nini daa bi tiɣi Keen ŋun min o sara maa. Dinzuɣu ka Keen suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zuŋ o ninni.
en: but didnt look favorably on Cain and his sacrifice. Cain became very angry and looked resentful.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa, Gbahimiya Baal daanabinim maa, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ ni so zo n-tiligi. Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba, ka Ilaija zaŋ ba sirigi Kishɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti ku ba nimaani.
en: Elijah said to them, Seize Baals prophets! Dont let any escape! The people seized the prophets, and Elijah brought them to the Kishon Brook and killed them there.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko sani ka wuntia ni kpiɔŋ be. Amaa ŋunkam zaa je ma ni di vi.
en: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.

dag: Amaa o naɣ ni yɛlimi, M pala anabi, n nyɛla pukpara. Tiŋgbani zuɣu ka man kul kuriya nahindi m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Instead, they will say, I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim mi nyɛ o ni pii zuliya shɛli. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: But God, who is Jacobs Portion, is not like those worthless statues. People didnt make God; God made his people. He made everything. His name is the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, nir yi doli n yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: I am telling you the truth: whoever obeys my teaching will never die.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim a la ni zo, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn me a kana ti me a zali.
en: Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed — those who attacked it will retreat and leave.

dag: Di saha ka Mariama yɛli malaika maa, N na ʒi doo. Ka wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: Mary said to the angel, How will this happen? I am still a virgin.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Let those who seek my life be ashamed and humiliated! Let them fall back and be disgraced— those people who delight in my downfall!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, yim kpe siɣi tiŋ yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la tum tuumbiɛɣu, bɛ ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛli maa; ka doola binnani zali bɛmaŋa.
en: Then the LORD said to me, Get going! Get down from here quickly because your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have ruined everything! They couldnt wait to turn from the path I commanded them! Theyve made themselves an idol out of cast metal.

dag: O zaŋ ma luhi baɣiri ni, ka m be kaman taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim la.
en: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.

dag: Ka Ibram min o paɣa daa zaŋ bɛ ni su binshɛlikam zaa n-yi Ijipti chaŋ Nɛgɛb, ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ.
en: Abram went up from Egypt toward the arid southern plain with his wife, with everything he had, and with Lot.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ tuumba ayi maa sɔɣi ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, do shɛb di kpe n yili ŋɔ na, amaa m bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: Rahab had hidden the two men, but she said, They did come here, but I didnt know where they came from.

dag: ka Azaria nyɛ Sɛraya ba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ Jɛhɔzadak ba.
en: Seraiah, Jehozadak.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ o kpiya, ka bɔ zuɣu ka n lee lan yɛn lo noli yaha? N ni tooi lan chɛ ka o labina? Mani n-naɣi ni ti chaŋ o sani, amaa ŋun ku lan labi n sanna. .
en: But he is dead now. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? No. I am going where he is, but he wont come back to me.

dag: Hal yi ni to tɛte ni yi di kpibisi, ka yi mini niriba tɔɣisi gbaai yi zɔsimo daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Are you the kind of people who would gamble for orphans and sell out your own friends?.

dag: Dindali maa, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yiri Jɛrusalɛm na. Di pirigili ti yɛn zɔri ti lurila wulimpuhili polo teeku ni, ka di pirigili din kpalim mi zɔri ti luri wulinluhili polo teeku ni. Ka di kul ni zɔri lala wuuni kaman di ni zɔri shɛm shɛɣuni.
en: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ dabisa biɛla o sani ka Gomna Fɛstus daa ti pii Pool yɛla maa n-yɛli Naa Agiripa. O daa yɛl o mi, Gomna Filiksi daa chɛ do so niŋ sarika ni ya ŋɔ;.
en: Since they were staying there for many days, Festus discussed the case against Paul with the king. He said, There is a man whom Felix left in prison.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ liɣiri paŋ so, bɛ bi yɛri dilana ni o niŋm ba nyɔri di yɔbu ni. Bɛ mi bi diri birapu ka diri ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndiri ŋun ka taali. Bɛnkam tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim kul ku vuui bɛ zaashee.
en: someone who doesnt lend money with interest, who wont accept a bribe against any innocent person. Whoever does these things will never stumble.

dag: N ŋmaligi pola mmaŋa, n yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli; di bi taɣira. Sokam ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni ʒe ma yim.
en: I have sworn a solemn pledge; a word has left my mouth; it is reliable and wont fail. Surely every knee will bow and every tongue will confess.

dag: ni Ɛlɔn ni Timna ni Ɛkurɔn.
en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nyɛ anabi zuɣu ka o daa mi ni Naawuni pun lo o alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ o zuliya ni ninvuɣ so leei naa ka o zani o zaani.
en: He was a prophet and knew something that God had said. God had promised David that someone from his own family would sit on Davids throne as king.

dag: N daa zaŋla nirilim mihi vo ba chaŋ. N daa zaŋla yurilim mihi niŋ ba, ka leei ŋun yihi bin tibisi shɛŋa din ga bɛ noya la, ka silim tiŋa n-dihi ba bindirigu.
en: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimiya doli solɔri m-boli yi ni kul nya shɛb zaa ka bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ ni na.
en: Go out to the street corners and tell everyone you meet to come to the banquet.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni n teeg a Naawuni ni daa ti a pin shɛli ka di be a ni n ni daa zaŋ n nuhi pa a zuɣu saha shɛl la yɛla. Tiɣisim li niŋ kaman nir ni tiɣisiri buɣim ka di taari diri shɛm la;.
en: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.

dag: N yi pala tumo zaŋ chaŋ shɛb sani, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n nyɛla tumo yinim sani, dama yinima n-nyɛ n tumɔtali shihirili ti Duuma sani.
en: Even if others do not accept me as an apostle, surely you do! Because of your life in union with the Lord you yourselves are proof of the fact that I am an apostle.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa doya hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o yiɣisi yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya, ka zɔr dabiɛm ni o yɛli Ɛli o ni nya ʒii shɛli maa yɛla.
en: The next morning, Samuel got up and opened the doors to the Lord 's house. He was afraid to tell Eli what the Lord had said.

dag: Naawuni, a yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli! Ninsalinim zaa ni tooi sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim.
en: Nothing is more precious than your loving kindness. All people can find protection close to you.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya Izraɛlnim zaa Mizipa ka n ti suhi Yawɛ tin ya.
en: Samuel said, All Israel must meet at Mizpah. I will pray to the Lord for you.

dag: Yisahaku daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihinii dunia yili.
en: At the age of years.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma maa yɛl o, Niŋm a suhu ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, dama m be a sani, ka a suhu ni kul be shɛm, lala ka n gba suhu be.
en: The young man answered, Whatever you want to do, I'm with you.

dag: Di pala din be zuɣusaa ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du zuɣusaa nti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, How can we obey the Lord 's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.

dag: Dama di dabisa maa ni mini di saha maa n yi ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lan tɔŋ.
en: Truly, in those days and in that time, I will bring back to Judah and Jerusalem those who were sent away.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul laɣi zuliya shɛba zɔri maa zaa yoli, n ni laɣim bɛ zaa luɣ yini, ka di ku yuui ka bɛ piligi diri wahala bɛ nanim mini bɛ kpambaliba nuu ni.
en: Though they have bargained with the nations, I will now gather them up. They will soon be diminished due to the burden of kings and princes.

dag: Amaa a yi lɔri noli, nyin paɣim a ninni, ka niŋ kpam ʒe a zuɣu.
en: When you go without food, wash your face and comb your hair.

dag: N ni ti a niriba bɛn yɛn ŋma dakuɣiri maa alikama biɛlim din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi ni wain lita tuhi kɔbisinahi ni olivi kpam lita tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: As provisions for your lumbermen, I will send you , bushels of wheat, , bushels of barley, , gallons of wine, and , gallons of olive oil.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinima, o ni ti siɣisi ba; ka ŋunkam mi mali karimbaani ni ti nya filiŋ; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: At that time those proud people will fall. They will bow low to the ground, and only the Lord will stand high.

dag: Poloya maa ni ti lir a min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa. .
en: Frogs will be crawling on everyone—the king, his officials, and every citizen of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Dama di chɛ biɛla ka bɛ lab ma kuɣa.
en: So Moses cried to the Lord , What can I do with these people? They are ready to kill me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura mini bɛn mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ o yurilim maŋli ŋɔ polo.
en: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.

dag: M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ chandi maa bɛn daa chɛ ka dabiɛm kpɛla Izraɛlnima, amaa ka man daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: The other men who went with me told the people things that made them afraid. But I really believed that the Lord would allow us to take that land.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ishimail ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba Mizipa maa zaa daa ŋmaligi zo n-labi Karia bia Jɔhanan sani.
en: Then all the captives who Ishmael had taken from the town of Mizpah ran to Johanan son of Kareah.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu, N lo nia ni n kpihim ninsalinim zaa birili, dama bɛna n-chɛ ka tuumbiɛri pali dunia ŋɔ ni. Nyama, n ni kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: God said to Noah, I have decided to put an end to all people. I will destroy them completely, because the world is full of their violent deeds.

dag: Di zaŋ yɛm bahi, yɛm ni gbib a. Yum yɛm, ka yɛm gul a.
en: Do not abandon wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will keep you safe.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bindiri viɛla dihiri ba. Izraɛl zoya zuɣu nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee. Nimaani ka bɛ ni ti do momah viɛla tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mo viɛla Izraɛl zoya zuɣu.
en: I will feed them in good pasture, and their sheepfold will be there, on Israels lofty highlands. On Israels highlands, they will lie down in a secure fold and feed on green pastures.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a mabia nahu bee o piɛɣu ni chaŋ yirigi ka a baɣa ka o ni; di simdi ka a taɣ o labisi ti ti o lana.
en: If you see that your neighbors ox or sheep is loose, you must not ignore it. Be sure to take it back to its owner.

dag: Tɔbbihi bɛn daa doya maa ni daa wum li, bɛ yɛlimi, Zimiri lo nia biɛɣu n-ku naa. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Omri ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la n-leei Izraɛl naa sansani maa ni dindali maa.
en: They heard the news: Zimri has plotted against the king and killed him. Right then, in the camp, the whole Israelite army made their general Omri king of Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: After they finished eating, the followers filled twelve baskets with the pieces of bread and fish that were left.

dag: Di saha bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya; ka bɛn ti be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, bɛn ti yim di ni, ka tiŋkpannim mi di ti ka di ni na.
en: The people in Judea at that time should run away to the mountains. The people in Jerusalem must leave quickly. If you are near the city, dont go in!.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli maai n suhu.
en: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.

dag: Nyini n-daa fa ma m mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zabiri nuu ni bahi. Nyini n-zaŋ ma leei zuliya bɔbili zuɣulana; ka n ni daa bi mi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa jɛmdi ma mi.
en: You rescued me from my stubborn people and made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.

dag: Dama niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili bela ʒim puuni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tin ya ni di yo yi nyɛviya tiliginsim samli. Dama ʒim n-nyɛ din yɔri alahichi samli, di ni nyɛ nyɛvili la zuɣu.
en: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr biɛri ni alahiziba dɔriti din ku naai lu yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: the LORD will overwhelm you and your descendants with severe and chronic afflictions, and with terrible and untreatable sicknesses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛligu Pɛɛga naai bɛ daa gari chaŋla Atalia.
en: They proclaimed the word in Perga, then went down to Attalia.

dag: Ka yi tintariga maa ni ŋmaligi nudirigu polo n-zaŋ ti paai Akirabim kunkuni n-zaŋ ti gari Zin, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Kadɛshibarinia nudirigu polo; ka zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hazarada n-gari hal ni Azimɔn.
en: It will cross south of Scorpion Pass. It will go through the town of Zin to Kadesh Barnea and then to Hazar Addar, and then it will pass through Azmon.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi nya soli kpe ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Masia nam din ka bahigu la ni.
en: And you will be given a very great welcome into the kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, a kingdom that never ends.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi tinsi pinaata Isaka zuliya mini Asha zuliya ni Naftali zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni n-zaŋ tari Gɛrishomnima kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The tribes that were the descendants of Gershon got cities. They got the cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the part of Manasseh living in the area of Bashan.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa to o piɛm ti o daŋa.
en: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.

dag: Di saha ka nachimba maa daa zaŋ pini maa mini liɣiri ʒiibuyi zuɣu ni Bɛnjamin n-yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti Yisifu sani.
en: So the men took this gift. They took twice as much silver with them, together with Benjamin. They left, traveled down to Egypt, and received an audience with Joseph.

dag: N daa bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ashilɔni bee bumbɔn ni. N daa bi yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom ma luɣ shɛli din ka nyam shee. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, ka wuhiri din tuhi.
en: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says.

dag: O vooi ma yihi barina bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka firigi ma baɣiri ni. O zaŋ ma tam tampiŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: He pulled me out of a dangerous pit, out of the deadly quicksand. He set me safely on a rock and made me secure.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yɛli zali, ka di ti niŋ. Tinzun wun so na ʒi n-niŋ lala. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: I announced, I saved, I proclaimed, not some stranger among you. You are my witnesses, says the LORD, and I am God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka wɔɣ shɛb bɛn mal lɔɣu pam yina ti dimdi Izraɛlnima ka bɛ pam daa kpi.
en: So the LORD sent poisonous snakes among the people and they bit the people. Many of the Israelites died.

dag: Niriba ni ti laɣim be Juda tiŋgbɔn ni mini di fɔntinsi zaa ni. Ka pukpariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu ti beni.
en: People will live in Judah and in all its towns, and there will be farmers, and shepherds with their flocks.

dag: Izar daŋ ni Shɛlomɔt n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shɛlomɔt bidibisi ni, Jahat n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: from the Izharites: Shelomoth; from Shelomoths family: Jahath.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni yulilaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Pubilius ka o puri do m-miri nimaani la n-daa deei ti kpɛhi o yiŋa n-niŋ ti saani dabisi muna ata.
en: Publius, the islands most prominent person, owned a large estate in that area. He welcomed us warmly into his home as his guests for three days.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin puuni o ku mali ninsal tɛha, amaa ka ni malila biŋkɔbigu tɛha.
en: He will not think like a man any longer. He will have the mind of an animal. Seven seasons will pass while he is like this.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋ kam ka bɛ deei ya, yin dimiya bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam;.
en: If the people of a town welcome you, eat whatever they offer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Zipɔr bia Balak ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka binshɛli gu a soli ka a bi ka n sanna.
en: They came to Balaam and said to him, This is what Balak, Zippors son, says: Please let nothing hold you back from coming to me.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm bɛn daa be duu maa daa ti zahim zahima dahin shɛli yuŋ. Sokam zahindi daa bela di ko, ka mali di gbinni.
en: One night both of the prisoners had a dream. The baker and the wine server each had his own dream, and each dream had its own meaning.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa kana ti kpe duu maa ni n-nya ka biŋŋmahindili maa do garo zuɣu, ka di zuɣu kuɣi bukɔbiri difiɛli.
en: When the guards went in, all they found in the bed was the statue with the goat hair on its head.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ zaɣ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la; ka maligumaana maa mali sanyoo sara yo daɣ shɛli din daa yi o ni maa samli Yawɛ sani ti o.
en: The priest shall offer one of them as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and in this way he will perform the ritual of purification for her.

dag: Ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa ŋun be, ka daa pun be, ka ni ti kana la yɛliya: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega. Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, the one who is and was and is coming, the Almighty.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Gidiɔn zuɣu na, ka o zaŋ kikaa piɛb boli Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni bɛ kana ti dol o.
en: The Spirit of the Lord filled Gideon. So Gideon blew a trumpet to call the family of Abiezer to follow him.

dag: Ka yuma din kpalim maa yi na galisi, ŋun yom o ni daa deei laɣ shɛli yuma maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ o ni yo laɣ shɛli ni o deeg omaŋa.
en: They must refund a part of the purchase price according to the number of years left.

dag: Ilaisha ni daa nya lala maa, ka o kuhi yɛli, M ba, m ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi mini di wɔribariba. Ka o daa bi lan nya Ilaija yaha. Di saha ka o daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu darigi tooi li buyi.
en: Elisha saw it and cried out to Elijah, My father, my father! Mighty defender of Israel! You are gone! And he never saw Elijah again. In grief Elisha tore his cloak in two.

dag: O ni daa kuni maa, ka o yiŋbihi tuh o sol na ti yɛl o, A bia la kpaŋya.
en: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, Your son is better.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat daa tim o tumtumda na m-pahi bunu ni o zilin yini maa. O daa sabila gbaŋ din bi kpabi ka o gbibi li o nuu ni na.
en: But the fifth time, Sanballat sent his servant to me in the same way, except that now he carried an open letter.

dag: Alizanda ni nima, yilimiya yila! Dunianima, maliya suhupiɛlli! Zoya, yilimiya yila! Dama Yawɛ ni kpaŋs o niriba suhuri. O ni zo o niriba bɛn be muɣisigu ni nambɔɣu.
en: Sing, heavens! Rejoice, earth! Break out, mountains, with a song. The LORD has comforted his people, and taken pity on those who suffer.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa po pɔri yɛli, Naawuni yi ni be n sani, ka gbib ma n ni chani luɣ shɛli ŋɔ, ka ti ma bindirigu ka n di, ka ti ma situra ka n ye.
en: Then Jacob made a promise. He said, If God will be with me, and if he will protect me on this trip, and if he gives me food to eat and clothes to wear.

dag: Ka Shilɔnim bipuɣinsi yi ti yina ni bɛ ti wa wahi, yin yimiya wain tihi puri maa ni na, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti gbaag o paɣ ni yɛn nyɛ so Shilɔnim bipuɣinsi maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni.
en: and watch. At the moment the women of Shiloh come out to participate in the dances, rush out from the vineyards. Each one of you, capture a wife for yourself from the women of Shiloh and go back to the land of Benjamin.

dag: Tin shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari dunia zaa lu n-dahim. Babilɔn leela tin shɛli din yɛla mali zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: How the hammer of the whole earth has been broken and shattered into pieces! How Babylon has become a wasteland among the nations!.

dag: Ka yi yi bɔhi Ti yi bi biri bee ti yi bi kpuɣi puri atam yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, bɔ ka ti ti yɛn dira.
en: But maybe you will say, If we dont plant seeds or gather our crops, we will not have anything to eat during the seventh year.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n yi ni tooi? A bi mi ni binshɛɣukam zaa nandi ŋun niŋ yɛda sani.
en: Yes, said Jesus, if you yourself can! Everything is possible for the person who has faith.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa din gili zoli maa zuɣusaa nyɛla din be kasi zaa. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bala.
en: This is the law of the Temple: The whole area surrounding it on the top of the mountain is most holy. This is the law of the Temple.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla yuŋ leei biɛkaali. Bɛ yɛliya, Neesim maa mirila zibisim.
en: But my friends say night is daylight; they say that light is near, but I know I remain in darkness.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba pirigibu balibu buyi bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni maa zaa daa mali hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka zuɣulaannim pirigili daa be n sani.
en: where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: Everyone will hate you because of my name.

dag: Yawɛ bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyari ninsalinim zaa.
en: The LORD looks down from heaven; he sees every human being.

dag: Taɣimiya Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ yuli m bol o, Vuyɔra ŋun zaŋ o daalɔbo bahi.
en: Give the king of Egypt this new name, Talks-Big-Does-Nothing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: n ni niŋ binshɛli din ni teer o yɛla zali n jɛmbu duu ni n niriba sunsuuni, ka ti o yuli din gari bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. N ni ti o yu shɛli din kul ni beni sahakam ka ku kpi.
en: In my temple and courts, I will give them a monument and a name better than sons and daughters. I will give to them an enduring name that wont be removed.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla ʒiŋmabo gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim mi zaŋ yɔhiŋ gili ma. Amaa Naawuni na mi Judanim yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe Ŋun be Kasi la yim.
en: Ephraim surrounded me with false gods. The people of Israel turned against me. But Judah still walks with God and is true to the Holy One. .

dag: O daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka teeku kɔgbana daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: He calmed the raging storm, and the waves became quiet.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni nya tibiginsim din tuhi niŋbu ni, ka Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ wuh o kasitali maa wuntitali puuni.
en: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.

dag: Naa Sulemaana yilli din nyɛ yila puuni yili viɛlli.
en: This is Solomon's most beautiful song.

dag: Ninsalinim mi lee nyɛla bɔ, ka a tibigi ba pam, ka zaŋ a zaŋsim niŋ bɛ ni.
en: What makes you so concerned about us humans?.

dag: N zanila n Duuma zaani ni n yɛli dimbɔŋɔ kpahi yi zuɣu ni, di lan maliya bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ka bɛ tɛha nyɛ tɛhi yoya la biɛhigu.
en: I have something from the Lord to tell you. I warn you: Dont continue living like those who dont believe. Their thoughts are worth nothing.

dag: dama di saha maa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: The Holy Spirit will tell you at that very moment what you must say.

dag: Di saha ka solɔri zuɣu dunoya yo, ka nɛya niɛmbu vuri bi lan wumda, ka nooŋa kumsi vuri neeri nir gom ni, ka nir bi lan wumdi paɣiba bɛn nyɛ baansi zaa yila.
en: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: You must press your hand on its head and slaughter it before the meeting tent. Aarons sons will toss its blood against every side of the altar.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ti naai ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa Masia zuɣu la sanna, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni tuma niŋ ti gba nuu ni.
en: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.

dag: Amaa m mali yɛm kaman yi gba ni mali yɛm shɛm maa. M pala ŋun biɛhigu pooi yi biɛhigu; ka ŋuni n-lee bi mi dimbɔŋɔnima?.
en: But I have as much sense as you have; I am in no way inferior to you; everyone knows all that you have said.

dag: Ka Yawɛ zaka piɛri mini buhi kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: of which the LORDs tribute was .

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa yɛli Samuɛl, Tim ti naa ka o su ti maa, di daa bi palig o suhu; ka o daa suhi Yawɛ.
en: So the elders asked for a king to lead them. Samuel thought this was a bad idea, so he prayed to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ lan ka yɛmbahiga bɛ chandi ni, ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa luhi ba.
en: Their strong strides slow down; their plans trip themselves.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ammɔnnim polo tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: Son of man, look toward the people of Ammon and speak against them for me.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yuri ti m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni daa nyɛ alahichinim saha shɛl la ka Masia daa kpi ti zuɣu.
en: But God has shown us how much he loves us—it was while we were still sinners that Christ died for us!.

dag: Dama di dabisa maa ni mini di saha maa n yi ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lan tɔŋ.
en: Yes, at that time I will bring back the people of Judah and Jerusalem from captivity.

dag: A mini Damaskusnim daa niŋdi daabiligu a nɛma pam min a daazichi ni daa galisi la zuɣu, dina n-nyɛ: Hɛlibɔn wain mini gumdi.
en: The people of Damascus saw what you had to offer and brought you wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ni la daanya diɣisi mali tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: He made the bronze basin and its bronze base out of the mirrors belonging to the women who served at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ bi kɔhirila jahinjɛya anu kɔbo? Naawuni mi bi tamdi bɛ ni yino yɛla.
en: Aren't five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one sparrow is forgotten by God.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku doo mini paɣa. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku do kurugu mini bidibbila. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku nachimbil mini paɣisaribila.
en: as well as men and women, young and old.

dag: To, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ sunsuuni, a tɛhiya ni ŋuni n-lee lihi ŋmɛnditoya ni daa liri do so maa kaman o ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: And Jesus concluded, In your opinion, which one of these three acted like a neighbor toward the man attacked by the robbers.

dag: Ka Matitia ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yino ka nyɛ Shallum ŋun daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ nir la bituuli la daa su mahi parilana malibu fukumsi.
en: There was a Levite named Mattithiah who had the job of baking the bread used for the offerings. Mattithiah was Shallums oldest son. Shallum was from the Korah family.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ nya ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: An argument broke out among the disciples over which one of them should be regarded as the greatest.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɔmam. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.

dag: Bɛ kala a sanna kaman niriba ni kanna shɛm, ka ʒini a tooni kaman n niriba n-nyɛ ba la, ka wum a yɛligu, amaa bɛ ku deei li. Bɛ nyɛla naŋgbammalisimnima, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee bela bɛ bomma ni.
en: So they all come and listen to you, but they refuse to do what you tell them. They claim to be faithful, but they are forever trying to cheat others out of their money.

dag: Yi yi chɛ yi chi ka tam kabɔbili sɔŋ yi puuni, yin di lan labiya ti zaŋ li; di ni leela sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli dini, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.
en: When you gather your crops and fail to bring in some of the grain that you have cut, do not go back for it; it is to be left for the foreigners, orphans, and widows, so that the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa miri ba daa wum bɛ kuhigu ka guui; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Tiŋgbani ni vali ti gba.
en: All the people of Israel who were there fled when they heard their cry. They shouted, Run! The earth might swallow us too.

dag: Suhudoo tirila ninsal niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili, amaa kɔr yoya chɔɣisirila nir kɔba ni.
en: A peaceful mind gives life to the body, but jealousy rots the bones.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm a yɛm tuma puuni, amaa lee di chɛ ka o zuɣu ti paligi ka o kpi ni suhudoo.
en: Use your wisdom, but dont let him die peacefully of old age.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ Pita niŋ duu, amaa ka cheechi daa kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo o zuɣu.
en: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him.

dag: Ti zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ Masia ŋun ka alahichi la n-zali alahichi zaani ni di chɛ ka ti leei wuntizɔriba ŋun Naawuni sani o zuɣu.
en: Christ was without sin, but for our sake God made him share our sin in order that in union with him we might share the righteousness of God.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni. Yiɣisim darigi zuliya kam zaa tibili. Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino gba tiligi.
en: You are the LORD God of heavenly forces, the God of Israel! Wake up and punish all the nations! Grant no mercy to any wicked traitor! Selah.

dag: Ka Maika daa bɔh o, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira, ka yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. N chani bɔrila luɣ shɛli ni n ʒini.
en: Micah asked him, Where do you come from? He answered, I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah. I am looking for a place to live.

dag: Ninsal tɛha n-wuhir o soli, amaa Yawɛ n-wuhir o o ni yɛn chani shɛm.
en: People can plan what they want to do, but it is the Lord who guides their steps.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali ka bɛ laɣim tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o daa pii kuɣikpɛriba ni bɛ kpe kuɣa ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: King David gave orders for all the foreigners living in the land of Israel to assemble, and he put them to work. Some of them prepared stone blocks for building the Temple.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔriti ŋmana ni.
en: He will bless your baskets and pans and fill them with food.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tiri ma kpiɔŋ, ka mali n soli ka di tuhi.
en: Only God! The God who equips me with strength and makes my way perfect.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ o kpiya, ka bɔ zuɣu ka n lee lan yɛn lo noli yaha? N ni tooi lan chɛ ka o labina? Mani n-naɣi ni ti chaŋ o sani, amaa ŋun ku lan labi n sanna. .
en: But now that he's dead, why should I go without eating? I can't bring him back! Someday I will join him in death, but he can't return to me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ ti teei gili Samaria.
en: Some time later King Benhadad of Syria led his entire army against Israel and laid siege to the city of Samaria.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni mali tahima so sani. Bɛnkam zaɣis a ni di vi. Bɛnkam zo ka chɛ a, bɛ ni sabi bɛ yuya niŋ tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ.
en: Lord , you are Israel's hope; all who abandon you will be put to shame. They will disappear like names written in the dust, because they have abandoned you, the Lord , the spring of fresh water.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, yimiya yi fɔntinsi ni chaŋ ti be tampima ni. Benya kaman ŋman so ŋun te o tiɛɣu vokabili noli ni la.
en: Leave your towns, head for the cliffs, you people of Moab. Hide like a dove that nests in the mouth of a cave.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ siɣi dapulli ŋɔ zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti nya ka niŋ o yɛda. Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi shɛb tabili dapula m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: Let the Christ, the king of Israel, come down from the cross. Then well see and believe. Even those who had been crucified with Jesus insulted him.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul tam luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani zuɣu, n ni zaŋ li tin ya kaman n ni daa pun lo Musa alikauli yɛli shɛm la.
en: I promised Moses that I would give you this land, so I will give you all the land wherever you go.

dag: Musa daa sabi bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini yuya sɔŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: At the command of the Lord , Moses wrote down the name of the place each time they set up camp.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu shili zaa dindali maa. Bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu kaman Naa Jɔsia ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: So everything was done that day for the worship of the Lord as King Josiah commanded. The Passover was celebrated and the burnt offerings were offered on the Lord s altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ labimi kuli ni suhudoo, ka miri ka a chɛ ka Filistia nanim suhuri ti miligi a zuɣu.
en: So go back home in peace, and don't do anything that would displease them.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi pam takɔbi n-yɛn ku bɛ zaa, ka bɛ bihi ka bindirigu din ni di n-tiɣi.
en: They may have many children, but all of them will be killed in war. Or their children will not have enough to eat.

dag: dama n niŋ li mi ni yi nya ka mi niŋdi taba kaman n ni niŋ ya shɛm maa.
en: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.

dag: ni Hilɛn mini di momaha tiŋgbani ni Dɛbir mini di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: Hilen, Debir.

dag: Di kpala talahi ni ti zaa kpi; ti ŋmanila kom din kpaai bahi tiŋa ka nir ku lan tooi va li la. Amaa Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yih o bia ŋun zo n-kpe yɔɣu o daŋ ni.
en: We all have to die—were like water spilled out on the ground that cant be gathered up again. But God doesnt take life away; instead, he makes plans so those banished from him dont stay that way.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni daa nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-kuli Ijipti. Yaakubu daa zaŋla o daŋ zaa bɛn nyɛ.
en: They took their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan and went to Egypt. Jacob took all his descendants with him:.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab yɛli so yɛla ni Naawuni yɛliya, N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: He is the one of whom it is written: Look, Im sending my messenger before you, who will prepare your way before you .

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni wum o yɛligu ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ? M bi mi Yawɛ maa, dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: Who is this Lord and why should I obey him? the king replied. I refuse to let you and your people go.

dag: Bɛ ni nya alibarika Yawɛ sani, ka yi taali ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiliginsim ŋɔ sani.
en: Good people ask the Lord to bless others. They ask God, their Savior, to do good things.
