dag: Biɛrim chɛ ka n nimbihi bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋmanila shilinshia.
en: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.

dag: Bee Tiligimiya ma n dim nuu ni? Bee Famiya ma bɛn nahindi ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi?.
en: No, and I never said, Save me from my enemies! or Save me from those who are cruel.

dag: Malimi tɔbbihi ni teei gili shɛm kɔtomsi tabili li, ka booi tɔbbihi ni me bindura tabili gooni shɛm gil li, ka mali goma din sirigina tabili li, ka lan mali tɔbutuhiriba bimbina baɣilibaɣili li gili ti tuui.
en: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria Gomnanim mini sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi bɛn zaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ bɛmaŋa ni bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kɔre. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla.
en: She too was full of lust for the Assyrian noblemen and officers—soldiers in bright uniforms—and for the cavalry officers, all of those handsome young men.

dag: Ka o ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam, dama o yɛtɔɣa maa daa nyɛla din mali yiko.
en: They were amazed by his teaching because he delivered his message with authority.

dag: A mi kparibuhi ni dɔɣiri saha shɛli? A na mi n-nya saŋkpaliŋ ni dɔɣiri shɛm?.
en: Do you know when mountain goats give birth; do you observe the birthing of does?.

dag: Dinzuɣu tuma ŋɔ fukumsi ni ʒi ti zuɣu Naawuni nambɔzɔbo puuni ŋɔ zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi gbarigira.
en: God, with his mercy, gave us this work to do, so we dont give up.

dag: Ka yi ʒiɛmannim ti baŋ ni n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, n daa chɛ ka bɛ bela suɣa ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: so that your descendants may know that the Lord made the people of Israel live in simple shelters when he led them out of Egypt. He is the Lord your God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Hɛzɛkia suhigu maa, ka chɛ niriba maa taali, ka bi ku ba.
en: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.

dag: Ka molomoona daa ti kuhi pam yɛli, Bɛ zaliya ni niriba mini zuliya kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim.
en: Then the man who makes announcements for the king spoke in a loud voice, All you people from many nations and language groups, listen to me. This is what you are commanded to do:.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi, amaa duhimiya n yuli Izraɛlnim sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: Show respect for my holy name. I must be very special to the Israelites. I, the Lord , have made you my special people.

dag: O daa bi biɛhim Naawuni daalikauli hal baabiɛla. O ni daa kul tibigiri Naawuni maa puuni ka o yɛda daa kul niŋdi kpiɔŋ pahira.
en: He didnt hesitate with a lack of faith in Gods promise, but he grew strong in faith and gave glory to God.

dag: ka yɛli sariakaritiba maa, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi saria karibu ni, dama pa ninsalinim ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira, amaa Yawɛ ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira. O be yi sani yi saria karibu ni.
en: and instructed them: Be careful in pronouncing judgment; you are not acting on human authority, but on the authority of the Lord , and he is with you when you pass sentence.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti damdi li tiŋa bee n-jɛm li; dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli, n darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma bihi tiba bɛ banima taali zuɣu hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir ata mini din pahir anahi ni.
en: Do not bow down to them or worship them because I, the LORD your God, am a passionate God. I punish children for their parents sins—even to the third and fourth generations of those who hate me.

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: If the dead arent raised, then Christ hasnt been raised either.

dag: Tuuli alikauli la daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu soli zaligunim mini luɣ shɛli ninsalinim ni daa mali zali Naawuni jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: So then the first covenant had regulations for the priests service and the holy place on earth.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti tiligira. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: My people say, God saves us. His name is the Lord All-Powerful, the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pɔr la n daa yuri ba. N daa boli ba yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na kaman m bidibisi la.
en: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.

dag: Ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni lo ni n niŋ ba shɛm.
en: I showed you what I would do—and I will do that to you.

dag: N ni daa nya binneen shɛba ka bɛ be Izraɛl Naawuni naba tiŋli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la m-bala. Ka n daa baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla chɛrubinima.
en: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord 's glory near the Chebar River.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Izraɛl anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, yɛlim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! .
en: Human one, prophesy to Israels prophets who prophesy from their own imaginations. Say, Hear the LORDs word!.

dag: Di saha ka omaŋmaŋ daa yiɣisi chaŋ Rama nti chaŋ kɔbil titali din be Sɛku la gbini ti bɔhi, Ya ka Samuɛl mini Dauda lee be la? Ka so yɛl o, Nyama bɛ be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: At that point, Saul went to Ramah himself. He came to the well at the threshing floor that was on the bare hill there and asked, Where are Samuel and David? In the camps at Ramah, he was told.

dag: Ka bia maa yɛl o, A tizɔbil la n-kuna, ka a ba chɛ ka ti kɔrigi naɣila kpabili, o ni labina ni alaafee maa zuɣu.
en: Your brother has come back home, the servant answered, and your father has killed the prize calf, because he got him back safe and sound.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma NAAWUNI na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka bi kahigi li wuh o daba bɛn nyɛ o daanabinima.
en: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.

dag: M bi bɔri jilima ninsalinim sani.
en: I dont accept praise from people.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zaa nyɛla a niriba, dinzuɣu, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi hal ti yaɣi. A mi di gbibi ti taali sahakam.
en: Lord , dont continue to be angry with us! Dont remember our sins forever! Please, look at us! We are all your people.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul be ti sani kpe.
en: The followers answered, But we have only five loaves of bread and two fish.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa ti gari.
en: Egypt's seven years of plenty came to an end.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Anabinim maa malila n yuli ŋmari ʒiri. Man bi tim ba bee n-zali ba shɛli bee n-tɔɣisi bɛ ni so yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒii din nyɛ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Di nyɛla baɣibuɣibo din ka buchi, ka nyɛ bɛ maŋmaŋ suhu ni yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bidibbila ka na pɔra m-be m ba sani, ka nyɛ m ma ni daa yuri so pam.
en: When I was only a little boy, my parents' only son.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa guui chaŋ ti yɛli Musa, Ɛldad mini Mɛdad be yiŋa n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: A young man ran and told Moses, Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.

dag: A daa bi dolila bɛ naba n-tum bɛ ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa kɔŋko, amaa saha biɛla ka a daa zaŋ tum din bie n-gari bɛ dini a soya zaa ni.
en: You did all the terrible things they did, but you also did much worse!.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun niŋdi sokam zaa zaɣ viɛlli, ka zɔri o ni nam binshɛɣukam zaa nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord is good to everyone. He shows his mercy to everything he made.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa boli naa n-yɛl o. Ka naa daa yɛli, Di yi nyɛ o kɔŋko n-zɔrina maa dindina o ʒirila lahibali na. Ka o daa ti zo m-mirina.
en: and shouted down to tell David. David answered, If he's alone, he must have some news. The runner was getting closer.

dag: M pola pɔri ka ʒe di nyaaŋa ni n dol a wuntia zaligunim la.
en: Your laws are good and fair. I have promised to obey them, and I will keep my promise.

dag: Saha shɛli naa ni daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka Lɛvi zuliya do so daa zaŋ o mam ŋun yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee din be katiŋa.
en: In those days when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living as an immigrant in the far corners of the Ephraim highlands. He married a secondary wife from Bethlehem in Judah.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi daɣiri ni m-bala, di yi pa lala bɛ ni saɣim m biɛhigu shee din be bɛ sunsuuni ŋɔ ka kpi ni bɛ daɣiri.
en: So you must warn the Israelites about being unclean. If you dont warn the people, they might make my Holy Tent unclean. And then they would have to die.

dag: ni di chɛ ka o yihi ba kpaŋa, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka yihi ba karimbaani ni.
en: to turn them from a deed and to smother human pride.

dag: Yawɛ n-zali ni ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka ti yo yi daalahichi samli.
en: Everything we did today was what the Lord commanded us to do in order to make you pure.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: But that night the Lord said to Nathan.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yeeg omaŋmaŋ kparibu shɛli o ni ye n-ti Dauda, ka zaŋ o gbaɣino ti o, hal ka zaŋ o takɔbi min o tɔbu ni o gban shɛli o ni mali lɔr o shee ni ti o pahi.
en: Jonathan took off the coat he was wearing and gave it to David. In fact, Jonathan gave David his whole uniform—including his sword, his bow, and even his belt.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa Naawuni ʒii nyabu maa puuni n-zaŋ ma chaŋ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani. Di saha ka n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli maa daa chɛ ma.
en: Then in my vision, the Lord 's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Filistianim maa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei bɛ ni ku shɛb maa nɛma, ka daa nya ka Sool min o bidibis ata maa lu n-dola Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni lo shɛm ni niŋ, ka n ni zali shɛm ni niŋ pali.
en: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Ɛlim maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni miri Teeku Ʒiɛɣu.
en: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun me o dufahira zali zuɣusaa, ka zali di tanzahi dunia ni ŋɔ; ŋuna n-zaŋdi teeku kom n-kpaari li bahiri tiŋgban ni na. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: It is the LORD who builds his upper rooms in the heavens and establishes his residence upon the earth; who summons the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth— the LORD is his name.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duna n-yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nti nya ka bɔrɔbɔro doya, ka nya sala buɣim ka zahim pa di zuɣu.
en: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ zaa nyu.
en: Then he took a cup of wine, thanked God for it, and gave it to them. They all drank from the cup.

dag: N ni saɣim kikaa saha yiya, ka saɣim woligu saha yiya, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali yiya shɛŋa lu n-dahim, ka chɛ ka yiya din nyɛ zaɣ kara wum. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will tear down the winter house as well as the summer house; the houses of ivory will perish; the great houses will be swept away, says the LORD.

dag: Ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be yinim bundaannim ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi pun di yi nyaɣisim.
en: But how terrible for you who are rich, because you have already received your comfort.

dag: Yi zuliya mini yi bihi galisim naan ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka n naan ku chɛ ka bɛ birili kpihim hal baabiɛla gba.
en: If you had obeyed me, you would have had as many children as there are grains of sand. And they would always have been mine and would never have been destroyed.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu.
en: And now your temple will be deserted.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino mi ti yɛl o, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Another of Jesus followers said to him, Lord, I will follow you too, but let me go and bury my father first.

dag: Amaa ninsal mali buchi pam gari piɛɣu! Dinzuɣu di tuhiya ni nir tum tuun suŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: And a human being is worth much more than a sheep! So then, our Law does allow us to help someone on the Sabbath.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni cheechi din be Kɔrinti mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by Gods will, and Timothy our brother. To Gods church that is in Corinth, along with all of Gods people throughout Achaia.

dag: Pini nyɛla din maani soli tiri nira, di nyɛla din chɛ ka nir tooi nyari ninvuɣ wɔɣira.
en: A gift will get you in to see anyone.

dag: m-bɔh o, Zarai dabili Haga, ya ka a lee yina bee ya ka a lee chana? Ka o yɛli, N yila n lan Zarai sani zɔra.
en: and said, Hagar! Sarais servant! Where did you come from and where are you going? She said, From Sarai my mistress. Im running away.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ni ŋmahiŋmahi nim shɛŋa maa mini binzuɣu ni biŋkpam nti pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: They will lay the pieces of the animal, including the head and fat, on top of the burning wood.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ bolim o na. Ka bɛ daa bol zom maa ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma! Yiɣisima, o boon a.
en: Jesus stopped and said, Tell him to come here. So they called the blind man and said, You can be happy now. Stand up! Jesus is calling you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm gbaŋ maa ni m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs, a bihi bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ ti a.
en: This is the text of the letter: To Emperor Artaxerxes from his servants who live in West-of-Euphrates.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Na so ŋun ti yɛn sun ya biɛhigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yi sani m-bɔŋɔ, o ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi niŋ chɛchɛbumbariba mini wɔribariba, ka bɛ be o chɛchɛbuŋ tooni.
en: This is how your king will treat you, Samuel explained. He will make soldiers of your sons; some of them will serve in his war chariots, others in his cavalry, and others will run before his chariots.

dag: N shini ka di yuui, N kul gbaala mmaŋ ka fo. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuhi pam kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi. N ni vuhi parim.
en: For a long time, I, the Lord , have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The LORD is merciful and compassionate, very patient, and full of faithful love.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Nyamiya, Yawɛ bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: Moses said to the Israelites, The Lord has chosen Bezalel, the son of Uri and grandson of Hur from the tribe of Judah.

dag: A yiko ni ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima. A yuli zuɣu ka ti no n-taai bɛn kana ti lir ti la.
en: We need your help to push our enemies back. Only in your name can we trample those who attacked us.

dag: A wuntitali ŋmanila zoya din du pam; ka a saria karibu ŋmani teeku bulli din zilim pam. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri ninsalinim zaŋ tabili binnɛma.
en: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la gba daa maan o ansarisi, ka zaŋ komihigu ti o ni o nyu.
en: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim shɛb daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti la shihirili.
en: At that time some of the legal experts and the Pharisees requested of Jesus, Teacher, we would like to see a sign from you.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa lee baŋya ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu fukumsi niŋ n nuu ni ni n yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kaman o ni zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu fukumsi niŋ Pita nuu ni ni o yihi li ti Yɛhudianim shɛm.
en: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani ka boli ba na ti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: Jesus stopped in his tracks and called to them. What do you want me to do for you? he asked.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Nyama, a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ noli zuɣu, a yi ŋmaligi n sani chana, di ku yuui ka gbuɣinli gbaag a ku. Ka o ni daa kul ŋmalig o sani, ka gbuɣinli shiri chirig o gbaag o ku.
en: So the first prophet said, You did not obey the Lord s command. So a lion will kill you when you leave this place. When the second prophet left, a lion killed him.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa ba yi zaɣisi zaa ni o ku zaŋ o bia maa ti doo maa, di simdi ka doo maa yo paɣipiɛliga bɔbu liɣiri ti paɣ maa ba.
en: If the father refuses to allow his daughter to marry him, then the man must still pay the full amount for her.

dag: Bɛ daa koya m-biri bimbira ka sa tihi, ka di daa niŋ, ka tihi maa gba daa wali pam.
en: They planted seeds in their fields and grapes in their vineyards, and they had a good harvest.

dag: Ibizan kalinsi nyaaŋa, Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. O daa niŋ bɛ zuɣulan la yuun pia.
en: After Ibzan, a man named Elon was a judge for the Israelites. Elon was from the tribe of Zebulun. He was a judge for the Israelites for ten years.

dag: Yili kam nyɛla ninvuɣ so ni me shɛli, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun me binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Every house is built by someone, but God built everything.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba niŋ zuliya shɛb nuu ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ba su ba.
en: He abandoned them to the power of the heathen, and their enemies ruled over them.

dag: Ka bɛn yɛn ti bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya. Simiɔn niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl.
en: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to the tribe of Reuben. The leader of the tribe of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, ka mmaŋmaŋ gba bɔhi baŋ dinkam daa niŋ maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɛhi ni di simdi ni n gba sab di yɛla ti a.
en: I studied it all carefully from the beginning. Then I decided to write it down for you in an organized way.

dag: Kaman bɛ nina ni biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Bɛ nina maa ni daa kul bemi kaman n ni daa nya shɛba Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la nina ni. Ka bɛ zaa yinoyino daa kul tuhi chana.
en: The faces of the Cherub angels were the same as the four faces on the living beings in the vision by the Kebar Canal. They all looked straight ahead in the direction they were going.

dag: A me dunia tamla di tanzaa zuɣu, ka shɛli kul ku tooi dam li sahakam.
en: You established the earth on its foundations so that it will never ever fall.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi yihiri waazu yɛri ni Masia daa neei kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka yi ni shɛb yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani?.
en: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?.

dag: N ni tim malaika na ka o ti be yi tooni n-guli ya yi chandi maa ni hal ti zaŋ ya paai n ni mali luɣ shɛli zali ya la ni.
en: I will send an angel ahead of you to protect you as you travel and to bring you to the place which I have prepared.

dag: Ɛlipaal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛba mini Misham ni Shɛmɛd ŋun daa me Ono mini Lɔd ni di tiŋkpansi la.
en: Elpaal had three sons: Eber, Misham, and Shemed. It was Shemed who built the cities of Ono and Lod and the surrounding villages.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn zaŋ alikauli shɛli ti a ŋɔ niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: Put the covenant document that I will give you into the chest.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka m min a ni a zuliya mali alikauli din ni ʒiɛya sahakam bɛ ʒiɛmana ni. Ka n ni nyɛ a min a zuliya maa Naawuni.
en: I will set up my covenant with you and your descendants after you in every generation as an enduring covenant. I will be your God and your descendants God after you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara, ka zaŋ li da yaɣimɛr so palo ni bɛ mali saamba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: After reaching an agreement about it, they used the money to buy Potter's Field, as a cemetery for foreigners.

dag: Amaa n niriba Izraɛlnim bɛna, baa bi yɛn ŋuhi bɛ biŋkɔbigu gba bee daadam din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ woligi Izraɛlnim ka chɛ Ijiptinima.
en: But not even a dog will bark at the Israelites or their animals. Then you will know that I, the Lord , make a distinction between the Egyptians and the Israelites.

dag: A mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni tooi mali jina? A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ din pa yɛlimaŋli leei din tuhi ni tooi mali jina?.
en: You have nothing to do with corrupt judges, who make injustice legal.

dag: Yi yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, yin malimiya li ka di nyɛ din ni chɛ ka o deei yi sara maa.
en: When you sacrifice a communal sacrifice of well-being to the LORD, offer it so that it will be accepted on your account.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti jɛm Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, saa ku mi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: And if people from any of the families on earth dont go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, no rain will fall on their land.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm zo saha shɛli Firawuna tɔbbihi ni daa kanna la.
en: Now when the Babylonian army had withdrawn from Jerusalem due to Pharaohs advance.

dag: O lan nyɛla bɛn guni gba yaba, ka di pala bɛ ni guni maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ka di lee nyɛla bɛ gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni ka niŋ yɛda shɛm la zuɣu.
en: And Abraham is also the father of those who have been circumcised. But it is not their circumcision that makes him their father. He is their father only if they live following the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi ni mali karimbaan shɛli nyuri bara maa, ka chɛ ka yi sagbana mi be kaman kurigu la.
en: And I will also destroy the great cities that make you proud. The skies will not give rain, and the earth will not produce crops.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nini na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: For the trouble at that time will be far more terrible than any there has ever been, from the beginning of the world to this very day. Nor will there ever be anything like it again.

dag: Bɛ ni daa garigi yɛli ti shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun su zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ daba, ka lab mɛri du shɛli Izraɛl na so ŋun mali yiko pam ni daa pun me n-naai zali yuun gbaliŋ din gari la ni ha.
en: They answered, We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the Temple which was originally built and equipped many years ago by a powerful king of Israel.

dag: Bɛ pahimi yi zuɣu ka yi tummi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma mini bɛ tuun shɛŋa din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni zaa; ka ninvuɣ zino miri ka o zaŋ omaŋ bali yi ni.
en: No one else is allowed to take care of the sacred tent or do anything connected with it.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, sokam ni ti gbani n tooni, ka sokam ti yaag o noli m-paɣi man Naawuni.
en: In the Scriptures God says, I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa kuhiri yɛra, Naawuni kukoli m-bɔŋɔ, pa ninsal dini.
en: Those assembled kept shouting, over and over, This is a gods voice, not the voice of a mere human.

dag: Di ni sab zani so zuɣu ni o niŋ dabili ni bahi leei dabili; ka ŋunkam mali takɔbi kur o taba, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku o gba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mal ania ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Whoever is to be a prisoner, will be a prisoner. Whoever is to be killed with a sword, will be killed with a sword. This means that Gods holy people must have patience and faith.

dag: Chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa nyin Naawuni sani sahakam. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali kul gul o.
en: Let him rule in your presence forever. Protect him with your faithful love.

dag: amaa n zɔrila bɛ dimnim ni yɛn kuri ma sul shɛli, dama bɛ dimnim maa ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ka ni yɛli, Ti nuhi n-ti ti nasara, pa Yawɛ n-daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: But I could not let their enemies boast that they had defeated my people, when it was I myself who had crushed them.

dag: Ka tanyibiga yɛli ba, Yi yi shiri bɔri ni n leei yi naa ni yɛlimaŋli, yin kamiyana ti ʒini m mahim, ka yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina, n ni chɛ ka buɣim yi n ni na ti di Lɛbanɔn sida tihi.
en: But the thornbush said to the trees, If you really want to make me king over you, come and find shelter in my shade. But if you dont want to do this, let fire come out of the thornbush. Let the fire burn even the cedar trees of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ lala n-yihi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: The Israelites obeyed and expelled them all from the camp.

dag: O daa tɔɣis o nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o nam din du n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn maa nama.
en: Awil-merodach treated Jehoiachin kindly and gave him a throne higher than those of the other kings with him in Babylon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mbusim be piɛgul shɛb bɛn ku m piɛri, ka wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: How terrible will be the Lord 's judgment on those rulers who destroy and scatter his people!.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa zaŋ buɣim ni daa di ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni daa zaŋ daanya tulaale tuɣindi labihi shɛŋa ti Naawuni maa n-kuri gbiŋgbarinlinsi pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers presented by those who had been consumed by fire and hammered them into a covering for the altar.

dag: Dama m mini n saawaranim ayopɔin n-timd a ni a chaŋ ti vihi nya Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda yɛla kaman a Naawuni zaligu din be a nuu ni ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I, together with my seven counselors, send you to investigate the conditions in Jerusalem and Judah in order to see how well the Law of your God, which has been entrusted to you, is being obeyed.

dag: Bɛ wain nyɛla tinvura lɔɣu. Di nyɛla sapaɣu lɔɣu din bie pam.
en: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.

dag: n-daa ti kpɛri tiŋkpan shɛl ni ka kɔnsi pia chirig o sol ni n-kaɣ ti ʒe katiŋ ha.
en: As he was going into a village, ten men with leprosy came toward him. They stood at a distance.

dag: Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu piligu saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ma.
en: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:.

dag: Nyin Naa n-zali zaligu ni biŋkumda la yi ti piligi kumsi, sokam ŋun damdim tiŋa n-jɛm salima binnan la.
en: Your Majesty has issued an order that as soon as the music starts, everyone is to bow down and worship the gold statue.

dag: Ka Firawuna pipia daa be n nuu ni, ka m pɔhi wain tiwala maa kahim di kom niŋ Firawuna pipia maa ni n-zaŋ li ti ti ŋun Firawuna.
en: I was holding the king's cup; so I took the grapes and squeezed them into the cup and gave it to him.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira.
en: The Lord s voice cuts the air with flashes of lightning.

dag: Bɛ daa ba o bandi n-ti o naba biɛrim, ka zaŋ kuriti ga o nyiŋgol ni.
en: His feet were kept in chains, and an iron collar was around his neck.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ninsalitali yubu ku tooi tiɣi Naawuni nini.
en: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.

dag: Ka Gaal lan yɛl o yaha, Nyama, niriba n-yi zoya maa sunsuuni siɣirina ŋɔ, ka shɛb mi yi baɣisi oki tia la polo kanna.
en: Gaal said again, Look! There are men coming down the crest of the mountain and one group is coming along the road from the oak tree of the fortunetellers.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zuliya nabi.
en: May the LORD add to your numbers— both you and your children.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ninvuɣ kubo.
en: Its from the inside, from the human heart, that evil thoughts come: sexual sins, thefts, murders.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga dɔni, dama di nyɛla vi tuuni.
en: Do not have intercourse with your granddaughter; that would be a disgrace to you.

dag: O nyɛla Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni be, ka dunianim ku tooi deeg o, dama bɛ bi nyar o, bɛ mi bi mi o; amaa yinim mi o, dama o be yi sani ka ni ti be yi ni.
en: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.

dag: n-zaŋ ti tahi kpe na nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli la ni ti mali jilima n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboli kam. Zuliya kam ni ti zo n-ka di gbinna.
en: In the days to come the mountain of the LORDs house will be the highest of the mountains. It will be lifted above the hills; peoples will stream to it.

dag: N tiligim ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee chandi? N tiligim ba kum ni? Nyin kum, a daalɔbɔnim la lee be ya? Nyin kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a bahiyol la lee be ya? N nini bi lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: I will save them from the grave. I will rescue them from death. Death, where are your diseases? Grave, where is your power? I am not looking for revenge.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara malibu dabisili.
en: On the fourteenth day of the first month there will be a Passover offering to the LORD.

dag: Amaa ya polo ka nir lee yɛn bɔ n-nya yɛm? Ka luɣ dini ka baŋsim be?.
en: But where can anyone find wisdom? Where can we get understanding?.

dag: N niriba, kpɛmiya yi duri ka yo yi dunoya. Sɔɣimiya ka di tooi biɛla ha, ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa saha gari.
en: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry.

dag: N ni ti ŋooi takɔb lu yi zuɣu wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari, ka chɛ ka yi fɔntinsi ti bahi yoli.
en: I will bring war on you and scatter you in foreign lands. Your land will be deserted, and your cities left in ruins.

dag: Yurilim bi mali suhupiɛlli taali tumbu ni, amaa di naɣ mali suhupiɛlli la yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: Love is never happy when others do wrong, but it is always happy with the truth.

dag: Ka o daa yul o luɣa ni ka bi nya so, ka daa ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa n-zaŋ o pi bihigu ni.
en: He looked around to make sure no one else was there. Then he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

dag: Ka takɔb dirili yir o nol ni na, ka o zaŋ li n-zabi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba; ka siɣi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka puuni nɔri ginda.
en: From his mouth comes a sharp sword that he will use to strike down the nations. He is the one who will rule them with an iron rod. And he is the one who will trample the winepress of the Almighty Gods passionate anger.

dag: Yawɛ, n yur a jɛmbu duu din nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛli, ka a jilima be nimaani la.
en: I love the beauty of your house, LORD; I love the place where your glory resides.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa ʒii buta, ka zaŋ kikahi mini firilanim ni be duɣubihi shɛŋa ni ti bɛ zaa.
en: Then Gideon divided the men into three groups. He gave each man a trumpet and an empty jar with a burning torch inside it.

dag: Di yuuni maa ni gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali, ka bindirigu daa lan ka tiŋ maa ni, ka kum lu niriba maa zuɣu.
en: On the ninth day of the fourth month of that same year, when the famine was so bad that the people had nothing left to eat.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli nyɛla din mali yiko; o kukoli mali jilima pam.
en: The LORDs voice is strong; the LORDs voice is majestic.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ni vuri yɔbu mini bana piɛbbu.
en: He and everyone else were celebrating by shouting and blowing horns while the chest was being carried along.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig awɛi saha ka o daa lan yi n-chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb ʒi daa ni yoli.
en: Then he went out around nine in the morning and saw others standing around the marketplace doing nothing.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a chɛ ka neesim din be a ni ti leei zibisim.
en: So be careful! Dont let the light in you become darkness.

dag: M bihi, kamiyana nti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ; n yɛn wuhi ya la Yawɛ sizuura lubu.
en: Children, come and listen to me; I will teach you to respect the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yi ti paai goli yini, nyin zalim ba ka bɛ yo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu, ka bɛ daa zali ba kaman Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri zahimbu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Children shall be bought back at the age of one month for the fixed price of five pieces of silver, according to the official standard.

dag: Kush bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Raama bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Ka Gɛra biŋkɔbiguliba daa kana ti niŋ Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa naŋgbankpeeni yɛli, Ti kom m-bala. Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Ɛsɛk, bɛ ni daa niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni maa zuɣu.
en: But the shepherds of Gerar Valley quarreled with Isaac's shepherds and claimed the water belonged to them. So this well was named Quarrel, because they had quarreled with Isaac.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ni Yisa tɔɣisi luhi Sadusiinim maa, ka bɛ daa laɣim tab ka o sanna.
en: When the Pharisees heard that Jesus had left the Sadducees speechless, they met together.

dag: A ni nyɛ Yisa Masia tɔbbia ŋun ʒe yim la zuɣu, pahimi ti zuɣu di wahala.
en: Take your part in suffering, as a loyal soldier of Christ Jesus.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o bia Yisahaku maa.
en: Abraham was years old when Isaac was born.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣisi bɛ ni daa kɔhi kawana laɣ shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-zaŋ li tahi Firawuna yiŋa nti ti o.
en: So Joseph sold them the grain that had been stored up, and he put the money in the king's treasury.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a daa deei bɛ suhigu. A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun daa chɛ bɛ taali, amaa a nyɛla ŋun daa darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: LORD our God, you answered them. To them you were a God who forgives but also the one who avenged their wrong deeds.

dag: Yi ni chɛ so taali paŋ o, n gba chɛ m-paŋ dilana. N yi pun chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, ka di yi shiri nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni n chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, yi zuɣu ka n chɛ li paŋ o zaŋ chaŋ Masia sani.
en: When you forgive people for what they have done, I forgive them too. For when I forgive—if, indeed, I need to forgive anything—I do it in Christ's presence because of you.

dag: dama Naa Hɛrɔd daa zɔri Jɔn pam ka gul o viɛnyɛliŋga, o ni daa mi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋli ni wuntizɔra la zuɣu. Jɔn Baptaizira yɛligu daa yi chihiri Naa Hɛrɔd suhu pam, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa yi wumdi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Herod was afraid of John because he knew that John was a good and holy man, and so he kept him safe. He liked to listen to him, even though he became greatly disturbed every time he heard him.

dag: man Yawɛ ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a biŋkɔbiri bɛn be mɔɣu ni min a yuri ni a bunsi ni laakuma ni a niɣi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu zaa zuɣu.
en: I will punish you by sending a terrible disease on all your animals—your horses, donkeys, camels, cattle, sheep, and goats.

dag: Fitiina pam maa zuɣu, niriba kul kuhirimi, wɔɣira ni muɣisiri ba shɛm zuɣu, bɛ bɔrila sɔŋsim.
en: When people are oppressed, they groan; they cry for someone to save them.

dag: Hal o daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa m mo alizanda Nabia ŋun lan nyɛ nimaani tɔbbihi zuɣulan la gba, ka daa kari dabisili kam sara maligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi na ti maan o; ka daag o jɛmbu duu luhi.
en: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.

dag: Naawuni n-daa kahigi wuhi ma ni n chaŋ. Ka n daa ti kahigi n ni yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu tiri bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛm yɛla n-yɛli cheechi zuɣulaannim la ashilɔni, dama n daa bi bɔri ni n ni daa pun tum shɛm mini n ni na kul tumdi shɛm kpalim yoli.
en: I went there because of a revelation, and I laid out the gospel that I preach to the Gentiles for them. But I did it privately with the influential leaders to make sure that I wouldnt be working or that I hadnt worked for nothing.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Ifriim n-zaŋ o zali tuhi Izraɛl nuzaa, ka zaŋ o nuzaa gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ o mi zali tuhi Izraɛl nudirigu n-zaŋ ba na ti chɛ ka bɛ damd o tooni.
en: Joseph took both of them, Ephraim in his right hand at Israels left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand at Israels right hand, and brought them close to him.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhiri pampam n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ni yɛlimaŋlilana ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka a yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ku ti ka na be dunia ni ŋɔ saria m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti ti.
en: They shouted in a loud voice, Almighty Lord, holy and true! How long will it be until you judge the people on earth and punish them for killing us.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, A nyaya viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n lihirimi ni n nya ka n yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: The LORD then said, You are right, for Im watching over my word until it is fulfilled.

dag: Piimiya zuliya kam ni toondaan yino ka bɛ pahi piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: One leader from each tribe will help them.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, nyini n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi n niriba ŋɔ na, a mi daa bi chɛ ka m baŋ a ni yɛn tim so na ka m min o ti chaŋ, amaa di zaa yoli ka a yɛli ma, M mi a viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n nini lan tiɣ a.
en: Moses said to the Lord , It is true that you have told me to lead these people to that land, but you did not tell me whom you would send with me. You have said that you know me well and are pleased with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, n ni daa be yi sani ka yi deeri n noli shɛm la, hal n ni ka yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, di niŋ kamaata ni yi na kul deeri n noli lala. Kul tummiya ni dabiɛm zɔbu mini ni sɔhibu nti nya yi tiliginsim tuma naabu.
en: So then, dear friends, as you always obeyed me when I was with you, it is even more important that you obey me now while I am away from you. Keep on working with fear and trembling to complete your salvation.

dag: bɔhira, Kpe ka Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la kpɛra.
en: Calling out, they inquired whether the Simon known as Peter was a guest there.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o wum n suhigu maa.
en: When I am in trouble, I pray.

dag: Dama bɛn mali niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋuni n-na mi n-wum Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni kaman ti ni wum shɛm ŋɔ, ka na be o nyɛvili ni?.
en: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ ninsalinim naani.
en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ a bibihi fiɛbi tampima ni ti mali alibarika!.
en: A blessing on the one who seizes your children and smashes them against the rock!.

dag: Dindina n naan lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ; n naan filim bɛ dimnim maa zaa ti ba.
en: Then I would subdue their enemies in a second; I would turn my hand against their foes.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi Sukɔt kpamba n-zaŋ ba pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba. O daa niŋla lala ni o wuhi Sukɔtinim maa yɛm.
en: Gideon took the elders of the city of Succoth and beat them with thorns and briers from the desert.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ naa ni daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ shɛlikam polo bee zaŋ chaŋ nɛma duri polo la.
en: The instructions which David had given the priests and the Levites concerning the storehouses and other matters were carried out in detail.

dag: So yi kɔhi yili bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni, o ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuun muni nyaaŋa, dama di yi paai yuun muni o mali soli ni o yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have the right to buy it back during the first full year from the date of sale.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋ kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: The priest said to David, I dont have any ordinary bread here, but I do have some of the holy bread. Your officers can eat it if they have not had sexual relations with any women.

dag: Yawɛ yɛlila noli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi, amaa o niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: The Lord curses a wicked family, but he blesses the homes of those who live right.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, yomiya suhupiɛlli vuri paɣi Naawuni.
en: Shout joyfully to God, all the earth!.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi ni jɛm niriba maa zuŋɔ, ka zaŋ zilin balli yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: If you will be a servant to this people by answering them and speaking good words today, they replied, then they will be your servants forever.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka di kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadamnim mini binnɛma zaa ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna ti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu, ka vuhirigu kam diri di wala.
en: Its leaves were beautiful, and it was loaded down with fruit—enough for the whole world to eat. Wild animals rested in its shade, birds built nests in its branches, and every kind of living being ate its fruit.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl.
en: When Kenan was years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yuli dubu yɛla.
en: About that time, Herod, the ruler of Galilee, heard what the people were saying about Jesus.

dag: Ka salo maa kpamba daa yɛli, Ti mi pun ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba paɣiba zaa. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: The elders of the Israelites said, The women of the tribe of Benjamin have been killed. Where can we get wives for the men of Benjamin who are still alive?.

dag: Dama o soli nyɛla din kuni kum shee, ka o soya kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: If you go to her house, you are traveling the road to death. To go there is to approach the world of the dead.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa suhi Naawuni ka Naawuni tibi Abimilɛk min o paɣa ni o dabipaɣiba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: Meanwhile, God had kept Abimelech's wife and slaves from having children. But Abraham prayed, and God let them start having children again.

dag: O daa chɛ ka poloya waɣi pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kpe m-pali bɛ nanim dugbɛra ni.
en: Their country was filled with frogs, even in the kings bedroom.

dag: ni Anatɔt ni Nɔb ni Anania.
en: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah.

dag: Ka zoomba ayi daa ʒi sokpaŋa ka ti wum ni Yisa n-gariti maa, ka bɛ kuhi yɛli, Ti Dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: Two blind men who were sitting by the road heard that Jesus was passing by, so they began to shout, Son of David! Have mercy on us, sir.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni nir maa daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka di lu? Ka o wuh o di shee, ka Ilaisha ŋmaai daɣu n-zaŋ bahi nimaani n-chɛ ka lɛbiɛlim maa puhi pan na.
en: The man of God said, Where did it fall? The man showed Elisha the place where the ax head fell. Then Elisha cut a stick and threw the stick into the water. The stick made the iron ax head float.

dag: Dama yi mi ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika ni nyɛ shɛm: O daa nyɛla bundana, amaa yi zuɣu ka o leei nandana ni yi leei bundaannima o nandaantali maa zuɣu.
en: You know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. You know that he gave up his heavenly riches for you. He gave up everything so that you could be richly blessed.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa dol o tab maa gbin na duh o yee pam yɛra, Ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛm biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ka deeg o dalinli la pa o gbiɛɣu zuɣu bee o nuu ni.
en: A third angel followed the first two, saying in a loud voice, Those who worship the beast and its image and receive the mark on their forehead or on their hand.

dag: Di kali ma pah alahichinim ni. Di ku ma kaman ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: Dont gather me up with the sinners, taking my life along with violent people.

dag: ni jɛra ni bɛn bi ʒe yim ni ninkuunsinima ni bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: they are foolish, they dont keep their promises, and they show no kindness or mercy to others.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei salima binshɛŋa sapashin kpamba mini sapashin bihi shɛb bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga sani maa tibisim daa miri kilɔgiram kɔbisiyi.
en: All the gold for the gift offering that was presented to the LORD from the officers of thousands and the officers of hundreds was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

dag: Ka ŋun diri binshɛɣukam miri ka o ʒiɛm ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni di dibu, ka ŋun gbaar omaŋ maa mi miri ka o ti ŋun diri shɛlikam zalige; dama Naawuni deei dilana gba.
en: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.

dag: Zuliya kam buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima, ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: The nations idols are just silver and gold— things made by human hands.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ min a maligumaanitab bɛn ʒiin a tooni ka nyɛ binsuma din ti yɛn kana shihirili la, wummiya: N ni yihi n dab so bɛ ni booni Tiwul polli la palo.
en: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka Ijipti zani dabari, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa zaa din daa be di ni vuui, n yi ti ku binshɛɣukam din be di ni, di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I turn the land of Egypt into a wasteland and the land is deprived of all that fills it, and when I strike down those who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka yi yi tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka doli wun shɛŋa n-tumdi bɛ ni bɔri shɛm ka jɛmdi li, nimmoo ka n yɛri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi.
en: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli pahi, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli yaha, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee ka je a dima.
en: You have heard that it was said, Love your friends, hate your enemies.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n yi ni tooi? A bi mi ni binshɛɣukam zaa nandi ŋun niŋ yɛda sani.
en: Jesus said to the father, Why did you say if you can? All things are possible for the one who believes.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa dɔɣi Lamɛk maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiniinaayi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Methuselah had more children.

dag: Dama yi yi shiri ni doli yɛligu ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm, dindina na shɛb bɛn ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee ka nyɛ bɛn kpɛri chɛchɛbunsi ka bari yuri mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ niriba ni ti doli yili ŋɔ dunɔdaya ŋɔ ni kpe.
en: If you really do as I have commanded, then David's descendants will continue to be kings. And they, together with their officials and their people, will continue to pass through the gates of this palace in chariots and on horses.

dag: Ka paɣ yino yɛli, N dana, m mini paɣ ŋɔ n-laɣim be yil yini, ka n daa ti dɔɣi, ka o kul bela yili maa ni.
en: One of them said, Please, Your Majesty, listen: This woman and I have been living in the same house. I gave birth while she was there.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba, ka daa tumdi kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa tumdi shɛm, dama Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ o paɣa. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: He lived the same way the kings of Israel lived. He lived the same way Ahabs family lived. This was because Jehoram married Ahabs daughter. And Jehoram did evil in the Lord s sight.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi ni zaŋ doo ŋɔ tahi n sanna nti yɛli ni o birigirila yi zuliya la, n vih o yi zaa ha ninni, amaa ka bi nya o taali ni yi ni fiɣis o shɛlikam zaa zuɣu maa.
en: He said to them, You brought this man to me. You said he was trying to change the people. But I judged him before you all and have not found him guilty of the things you say he has done.

dag: M bela bina ayi maa sunsuuni: N suhu kul yɛmi ni n kpi n-chaŋ ti be Masia sani, dama dina n-so shɛlikam;.
en: But I dont know what I prefer. Im torn between the two because I want to leave this life and be with Christ, which is far better.

dag: Yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma m-bo yɛlli ŋɔ tin ya. Di mali ya. Di biɛri pam! Di nyooi yi suhuri.
en: Your own conduct, your own deeds have done this to you. This is your payment and how bitter it is, piercing into the depths of your heart.

dag: So ni tooi mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei Naawuni Shia Kasi kaman ti gba ni daa deei shɛm la kom baptaizibu.
en: How can anyone object to these people being baptized in water? They have received the Holy Spirit the same as we did.

dag: N saha yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni; tiligim ma n dimnim mini bɛn niŋdi ma alaka nuu ni.
en: I am always in your care; save me from my enemies, from those who persecute me.

dag: Kpuɣim jaaŋgbee, ka a min a biɛli Aduna laɣim niriba maa na, ka a ti yɛli tampiŋ ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka kom yi di ni na bɛ zaa ninni. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ yihi kom tampiŋ maa ni na ti ba; ka bɛ mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri nyu.
en: Get the special walking stick. Take your brother Aaron and the crowd of people and go to that rock. Speak to the rock in front of the people. Then water will flow from the rock, and you can give that water to the people and to their animals.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. Hal a ni niŋ nirilim shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gar a ni pun niŋ a yidan ma nirilim shɛl la. A naan tooi chaŋ ti bo nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ bundana bee faralana, amaa a bi niŋ lala.
en: Boaz replied: The Lord bless you! This shows how truly loyal you are to your family. You could have looked for a younger man, either rich or poor, but you didn't.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋlan ŋun fari ma bahira. A zaŋ bini pili n zuɣu tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: My Sovereign Lord , my strong defender, you have protected me in battle.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka o chaŋ ti kpe yili shɛli, ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: After Jesus and his disciples had left the crowd and gone into the house, they asked him what these sayings meant.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka buɣim di Magɔg mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi teeku noli ni alaafee la, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will send fire against Magog and those people living along the coast. They think they are safe, but they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Filistianim ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa, bɛ daa zaŋ li yi Ɛbɛnɛza n-tahila Ashidɔd.
en: After the Philistines captured the Covenant Box, they carried it from Ebenezer to their city of Ashdod.

dag: yin di wumya anabinim maa bee bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni maa yɛtɔɣa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zahindi ya maa ni o nya yi shiri yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhu zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.

dag: Yi kul tɛhirimi ni ti zabirila timaŋ zuɣu yi sani? M mabiyurisi, Naawuni sani, Masia zuɣu ka ti kul tɔɣisira, ka di zaa nyɛla yi kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.

dag: Amaa ka Sihɔn daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di kpe o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari. O daa laɣimla o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ Jahaz din daa be yɔɣu maa ni la nti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: But Sihon refused to let Israel travel through his land. Instead, he called together his entire army and marched into the desert to attack Israel near the town of Jahaz.

dag: A nam nyɛla saha din ka bahigu nam, ka a su binshɛɣukam zaa ʒiɛmani kam ni. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim o yɛtɔɣa zaa ni, ka nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma zaa ni.
en: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. The Lord can be trusted in all that he says. He is loyal in all that he does.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa din pahi ni o yɛm tuma la yɛla sab be Sulemaana tuma litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Solomon did, his career, and his wisdom, are all recorded in The History of Solomon .

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ti yaannim zaa daa bela sagbani tiŋli, ka bɛ zaa daa lan doli soli kpe teeku ni gari.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know what happened to our ancestors who were with Moses. They were all under the cloud, and they all walked through the sea.

dag: Bihi nyɛla pini din yi Yawɛ sanna. Bihi nyɛla bidɔɣibo laara din yi Yawɛ sanna.
en: Children are a gift from the Lord ; they are a real blessing.

dag: Sirianim daa ti chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka gbaai bipuɣimbil so kuli ka o ti tumdi tuma sɔŋdi Naaman paɣa.
en: In one of their raids against Israel, the Syrians had carried off a little Israelite girl, who became a servant of Naaman's wife.

dag: Ka o daa ti maani Izraɛlnima ansarisi, ka Dauda Mabia Shimia bia Jɔnatan daa ku o.
en: He defied the Israelites, and Jonathan, the son of David's brother Shammah, killed him.

dag: n-zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri maa bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: Then those evil people will be thrown into a flaming furnace, where they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.

dag: A mi yuli ku lan booni Ibram, amaa a yuli ni boonila Ibrahimma; dama n zaŋ a leela zuliya pam yaba.
en: Your name will no longer be Abram, but Abraham, because I am making you the ancestor of many nations.

dag: N daa ʒila niriba pam yi kpe chaŋ, amaa ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka n labimina ni nuzaŋa. Ŋun Yawɛ n-chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa paai ma, ka wula ka yi lan booni ma Naomi.
en: I had everything I wanted when I left, but now, the Lord brings me home with nothing. The Lord has made me sad, so why should you call me Happy ? God All-Powerful has given much trouble to me.

dag: Ka Zabai bia Baruk daa niŋ nimmoo mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee yaɣ shɛli hal ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulana Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli shee m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;.

dag: Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din daa gili Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa nanim zaa dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa bi buɣisi ni bɛ lo tɔbu n-tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: The Lord made all the surrounding kingdoms afraid to go to war against King Jehoshaphat.

dag: Dama nyini n-galisi, ka tumd alahiziba tuma; a ko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.

dag: O daa me li la goonda kpɛma, ka zali sapashin kpamba tinsi maa ni, ka daa me bindira kambɔna mini kpam ni wain ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni tinsi maa ni.
en: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa saɣim a zaligunima, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm. Ti tum alahichi a sani, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a chɛ ka nopoli yɛtɔɣa din sab a dabili Musa zaligu ni la di ti.
en: All Israel broke your Instruction and turned away, ignoring your voice. Then the curse that was sworn long ago—the one written in the Instruction from Moses, Gods servant—swept over us because we sinned against God.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda mabia Shamma dapala Jɔnadab daa yɛli, N dana, di tɛhi ni bɛ ku nabihi maa zaa, Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi. Absalom n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla o ni pun lo shɛli dahin shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔn o tizɔpaɣa Tama la zuɣu.
en: But Jonadab, the son of David's brother Shammah, said, Your Majesty, they haven't killed all your sons. Only Amnon is dead. You could tell by looking at Absalom that he had made up his mind to do this from the time that Amnon raped his sister Tamar.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana.
en: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us. So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbihi daa woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnima n-zani kahigi bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi wuhi.
en: After the Israelites separated themselves from all of the foreigners, they stood to confess their sins and the terrible behavior of their ancestors.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ammɔnnim mini bɛ vi tuma polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlima, Takɔbi, bɛ ŋooi takɔbi ni bɛ ku niriba! Bɛ nyɛhimi neei li ni di ku niriba, ka di nyaɣisiri kaman saa la.
en: Mortal man, prophesy. Announce what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to the Ammonites, who are insulting Israel. Say to them: A sword is ready to destroy; It is polished to kill, to flash like lightning.

dag: Amaa ka o sɔŋda maa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ tari ninvuɣ kɔbiga? Ka Ilaisha daa lan garigi yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ba ka bɛ ŋubi, dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ŋub li tiɣi ka guui. .
en: Elishas servant said, What? There are men here. How can I give this food to all those men? But Elisha said, Give the food to the people to eat. The Lord says, They will eat and there will still be food left over.

dag: Ka Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta daa lan chaŋ ti teei dɔni naa naba ni n-kuhiri ka suhir o ni o yiɣisim Haman ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la.
en: Then Esther spoke to the king again, throwing herself at his feet and crying. She begged him to do something to stop the evil plot that Haman, the descendant of Agag, had made against the Jews.

dag: ka Jeesɔn deei ba kpɛh o yiŋa. Bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn saɣindi Naa Siiza zaligunima, ka yɛri ni na so lan beni m-pahi Naa Siiza zuɣu ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa.
en: and Jason has kept them in his house. They are all breaking the laws of the Emperor, saying that there is another king, whose name is Jesus.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ chɛ ka Naawuni yɛligu bi tumdi di tuma yi ni, yi yaannim kal shɛŋa yi ni mali wuhiri niriba la zuɣu. Ka yi lan tumdi tuun shɛŋa din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnim pam.
en: In this way the teaching you pass on to others cancels out the word of God. And there are many other things like this that you do.

dag: Yawɛ, m bela muɣisigu pam ni ka kumdi niŋd a.
en: I cry out to you from the depths, LORD.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa kul bɔbimi ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi m-miri Samaria dunoli kabɔɣili shee ka anabinim maa zaa be bɛ tooni tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Now Israels king and Judahs King Jehoshaphat were sitting on their thrones, dressed in their royal robes at the threshing floor beside the entrance to the gate of Samaria. All the prophets were prophesying in front of them.

dag: Zaadali paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ naa n-yi nudirigu polo la na ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama o daa yi katiŋa n-kana ni o ti wum Sulemaana yɛm yɛtɔɣa; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Sulemaana be kpe.
en: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.

dag: So yi yuri Naawuni, ŋuna ka Naawuni mi.
en: But God has no doubts about who loves him.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba; ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum ti luri pam; amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: Nations and kingdoms will fight against each other, and there will be earthquakes and famines in all sorts of places. These things are just the beginning of the sufferings associated with the end.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o mini ba zaa gban tiŋa ka o suhi Naawuni.
en: After he said these things, he knelt down with all of them to pray.

dag: saha shɛl o firila ni daa ne n zuɣusaa, ka n dol o firila maa neesim gari zibisim ni la.
en: God was always with me then and gave me light as I walked through the darkness.

dag: Dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, molimiy o tiliginsim molo dabisili kam.
en: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Share the news of his saving work every single day!.

dag: O yi taɣi saa zali, binshɛɣukam kuurimi; o yi bahi saa, kom din puhigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: If he holds back the rain, the earth will dry up. If he lets the rain loose, it will flood the land.

dag: Naawuni di saɣi ka n nyɛ sana m-be Mɛshɛk. O mi di saɣi ka m be Kɛdar suɣa ni.
en: Oh, Im doomed because I have been an immigrant in Meshech, because Ive made my home among Kedars tents.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka di zanila dabari, ka di nyɛ dabari n-fabindi niŋdi ma. Tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zanila dabari, amaa ka so baɣa kani.
en: They have turned it into an empty desert. It is dry and dead. The whole land has been ruined, and no one is left to care for it.

dag: ka lan fari pakoya yinsi, ka suhiri Naawuni yuuri ni niriba tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam.
en: But they cheat widows out of their homes and pray long prayers just to show off. They will be punished most of all.

dag: Ka naa daa yi ti kul chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli nayili dunoli maa kpuɣirila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, ka ti lan zaŋ li ti niŋ bɛ duu yaha.
en: Whenever the king entered the LORDs temple, the guards would carry the shields and then return them to the guardroom.

dag: ka bo wain lita yini ni pirigili din nyɛ binnyura sara shɛli din ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: You will also present one-third of a hin of wine for a drink offering as a soothing smell for the LORD.

dag: bee binyara din be zuɣusaa bee binyara din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛŋa din be binnamda puuni zaa shɛli ku tooi yihi ti Naawuni yurilim din be ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la ni.
en: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!.

dag: Tuumba ayi maa ni daa ti yɛn dɔni gbihi saha shɛli, ka Reehab du bɛ sani dufahirili maa zuɣusaa.
en: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo ti niŋ Izraɛlnim ni? Di chaŋ wula ka daŋ yini niriba ti ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni.
en: and prayed, Our Lord , you are the God of Israel. Why did you let this happen? Now one of our tribes is almost gone.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o binnamda zaa, ka be o nam sulinsi ni zaa ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni.
en: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord ! With all my heart I praise the Lord !.

dag: n-chɛ ka o suhu ni daashiya zaa yi zahira. Ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka o gban tiŋ jɛm Naawuni, ka yihi yɛli ni Naawuni shiri be yi sani.
en: The secrets of their hearts are brought to light. When that happens, they will fall on their faces and worship God, proclaiming out loud that truly God is among you!.

dag: Ka Gaal lan yɛl o yaha, Nyama, niriba n-yi zoya maa sunsuuni siɣirina ŋɔ, ka shɛb mi yi baɣisi oki tia la polo kanna.
en: But again Gaal said, Look, there are some people coming down from that place over there by Lands Navel. And there! I saw someones head over by Magicians Tree. .

dag: Ka baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni la ni ti nyɛlisira, ka ne kaman sagban piɛla la. Ka bɛn mi nyɛ bɛn daa wuhi niriba pam din tuhi la ti ne kaman saŋmarisi la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The wise people will shine as bright as the sky. Those who teach others to live right will shine like stars forever and ever.

dag: Dindina n naan lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ; n naan filim bɛ dimnim maa zaa ti ba.
en: I, the Lord , would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni yubu n-su yi dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu, ka pa ni daadamtali kɔr biɛri.
en: From now on, then, you must live the rest of your earthly lives controlled by God's will and not by human desires.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kamina ti zani baɣili ma n-ku ma, dama n nya daŋ pam, ka m mi shia na bi siɣi.
en: Then he said, Kill me! I'm dying, and I'm in terrible pain.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi dol o lab kul o yiŋa nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom.
en: So the man of God went to the old prophets house and ate and drank with him.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ni ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: Those who eat my body and drink my blood have eternal life. I will raise them up on the last day.

dag: Bɛ kul ku tam nandaamba yɛla sahakam; ka faranim tahima niŋbu mi kul ku kpalim yoli sahakam.
en: Because the poor wont be forgotten forever, the hope of those who suffer wont be lost for all time.

dag: Amaa n daa zo ba nambɔɣu, ka daa bi ku ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bee n-kpihim bɛ birili.
en: But I felt sorry for them, so I did not destroy them. I did not completely destroy them in the desert.

dag: Tikuba kul chani moonila ashili yɛtɔɣa, amaa niriba ni dihi so tabili ŋun gbibila ashili.
en: A slanderer walks around revealing secrets, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Filistianim poli pɔi ka Firawuna daa naanyi ti liri Gazanima m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Before the king of Egypt attacked the town of Gaza, the Lord told me to say to the Philistines:.

dag: Wummiya! Baansi bɛn be kɔbilisi gbini yɛri Yawɛ nasara dibu yɛla nimaani, nasara din nyɛ Izraɛl kpariba nasara! Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ niriba daa chaŋ dari dibu chandi yi bɛ tinsi ni na.
en: Even those who carry water to the animals will tell you, The Lord has won victories, and so has Israel. Then the Lord 's people marched down to the town gates.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm ka yɛdaniŋdiba mini Yisa tuumba maa ni cheechi kpamba maa daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam yɛla.
en: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.

dag: Ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali dirimi kaman buɣim din diri suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ka diri neeri yɔɣu zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa la.
en: Wickedness burned like fire, devouring thorn and thistle. It kindled the thickets of the forest; they swirled in rising smoke.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi niŋ hal ko mahim biɛla ti n nyaandoliba ni yino, hal ŋun pɔri bɛ ni gba, o ni nyɛ n nyaandol zuɣu, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi ti nya zahimbu balibu kam, yin maliya suhupiɛlli di puuni.
en: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.

dag: ka zaŋya n vuhim dabisa la leei dabisa kasi, ka di leei shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Show that my days of rest are important to you. Remember, they are a special sign between us. I am the Lord , and these days show you that I am your God.

dag: Ka Liya daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Rubin. Dama o daa yɛliya, Yawɛ nya m muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli; Yɛlimaŋli, n yidan ni yu ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Leah gave birth to a son and named him Reuben. Then she said, The Lord has taken away my sorrow. Now my husband will love me more than he does Rachel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa kpalim be Gɛra. Ka nimaani nim ni daa ti bɔh o bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ polo.
en: Isaac moved to Gerar.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum waɣigbahiriba kukoya, bee n-wum waɣigbahiriba yila.
en: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.

dag: Ibrahimma Naawuni mini Nahɔr Naawuni ni bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti ti. Ka Yaakubu daa po o ba Yisahaku ni jɛmdi Naawuni so maa.
en: My father Nahor, your grandfather Abraham, and their ancestors all worshiped the same God, and he will make sure that we each keep the agreement. Then Jacob made a promise in the name of the fearsome God his father Isaac had worshiped.

dag: Ka bimbini maa gba daa shiri wurim, ka tampiligim maa kpaai bahi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun wuhi ni Yawɛ yɛliya ni o ni chɛ ka di niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The altar suddenly fell apart and the ashes spilled to the ground, as the prophet had predicted in the name of the Lord .

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ni bari ma zana shɛl la ni; dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka di daa muɣisi Dauda pam, o ni daa ŋmaai Sool binyɛrigu maa zuɣu.
en: But immediately David felt horrible that he had cut off a corner of Sauls robe.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ ka o zaŋ su niriba; o tiri ba bindirigu pam.
en: for by water he judges peoples and gives food in abundance.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpiɔŋ hal ti liri la zuɣusaa tɔbbihi, bɛna n-nyɛ saŋmarisi n-daa vooi bɛ shɛb bahi tiŋ na n-du tam bɛ zuɣu nɔra.
en: It grew strong enough to attack the army of heaven, the stars themselves, and it threw some of them to the ground and trampled on them.

dag: Pagɔrili noli ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli; Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu n-yɛn lu di puuni.
en: The sin of adultery is a trap, and the Lord gets very angry with those who fall into it.

dag: Ka Yisa gba daa ti yɛli do so, Doli ma! Ka dilan yɛli, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: He said to another man, Follow me. But that man said, Sir, first let me go back and bury my father.

dag: N ni zaŋ nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam maa yihi ya yi ni wurim be zuliya shɛb sani tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa zaa ni na.
en: I will show you my power and my anger when I gather you together and bring you back from all the countries where you have been scattered.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni ti chɛ o niriba bahi hal ka paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi maa ti dɔɣi. Di saha Izraɛlnim bɛn na kpalim be dabitim ni la ni ti labi bɛ mabihi sanna.
en: The Lord will let his people be defeated until the woman gives birth to her child, the promised king. Then the rest of his brothers will come back to join the people of Israel.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du ni bɛ ti tuhi Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka nandahima daa mal Izraɛlnim pam.
en: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to make raids into Judah, Benjamin, and the households of Ephraim. So Israel was greatly distressed.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu n-nyɛ: piɛbihi ayi bɛn paai yuuni dabisili kam, ka kul niŋdi lala sahakam.
en: Every day you must make an offering on the altar. You must kill two lambs that are one year old.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa ka dol o soya ka zɔr o.
en: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.

dag: Ka sokam daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: So the people rested on the Sabbath.

dag: Zaŋmiya nim viɛla zaa niŋ di ni, dina n-nyɛ: gbalipuɣa mini gaba, ka zaŋya boligo kɔba gba niŋ di ni.
en: Throw in the legs and shoulders of your finest sheep and put in the juicy bones.

dag: Doo maa ni daa na kul ʒe n sani maa, ka n daa wum ka so tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni na.
en: The man stood beside me there, and I heard the Lord speak to me out of the Temple:.

dag: A wuhiya ni chɛfirinim mali taali, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bahi yoli; ka a kpihim bɛ yuya zaa zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You told the nations how wrong they were. You destroyed those evil people. You erased their names from our memory forever and ever.

dag: Bɛ zuliya ni mali kpiɔŋ bɛ tiŋgban ni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun be tibi zuliya ni mali alibarika.
en: Their descendants will be strong throughout the land. The offspring of those who do right will be blessed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus din nyɛ Sirianim tiŋ la ni. Ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani. Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: Then he set up military camps in their territory, and they became his subjects and paid taxes to him. The Lord made David victorious everywhere.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi tum a taal shɛli, amaa nyini n-lee tum ma taali a ni lo tɔbu na ni a ti tuhi ma maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ sariakarita ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti Izraɛlnim mini Ammɔnnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: I havent sinned against you, but youre doing me wrong by making war against me. Let the LORD, who is the judge, decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa laɣim doli kuli Nazarɛt, ka o daa deeri bɛ noli. Ka o ma daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: So Jesus went back with them to Nazareth, where he was obedient to them. His mother treasured all these things in her heart.

dag: Bɛna n-daa laɣim naai noli ni bɛ tuhi Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnima.
en: They all came together and joined forces to fight against Joshua and the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ku saɣi doli sana, amaa bɛ ni zomi ka chɛ o, dama bɛ bi mi saamba kukoya.
en: But sheep will never follow someone they dont know. They will run away from him, because they dont know his voice.

dag: Stiivin daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tipawumlinim yi suhuri ni; yi kul zaɣisirila Naawuni Shia Kasi. Yi yaannim biɛhigu maa ka yi gba kul doli.
en: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm la, dama o ba kum nyaaŋa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o saawaranim bɛn luh o.
en: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.

dag: M bi daai Naawuni daalibarika baɣili, dama taali ni yibu Naawuni sani yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina Masia kum la ka daliri.
en: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.

dag: Ka anabinim maa pihinu daa doli ba chaŋ ti kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ ha ka chɛ ba.
en: Fifty members from the group of prophets also went along, but they stood at a distance. Both Elijah and Elisha stood beside the Jordan River.

dag: Ka Jona daa deei Yawɛ noli, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Ninive. Ninive daa nyɛla tin titali. Daba ata ka nir daa naan zaŋ chaŋ kpe di ni gari.
en: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Saimɔn, m mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, yɛlim ma.
en: Jesus spoke up and said to him, Simon, I have something to tell you. Yes, Teacher, he said, tell me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaata laasabu n-yi bɛ ni chaŋ; ka bɛn daa chaŋ maa ti ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Ainim maa.
en: So about three thousand men from the people went up in that direction. But they fled from the men of Ai.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa kpi, bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi shɛba bɛ kpiɔŋ saha.
en: Then God took the life of every first-born son.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, doo bee paɣ yi bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka tum o kpee taali, dilan maa leei ŋun tum alahichi.
en: Tell this to the Israelites: You might do something wrong to another person. When you do that, you are really sinning against God. So you are guilty of doing wrong.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabi zali ni faashee Masia di wahala, ka lan neei kum ni daba ata dali;.
en: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ mi ni daa nyu tibidarigibo binnyur shɛli zoli din be kasi zuɣu shɛm la, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya la zaa gba ni nyu li. Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti chani jeena, ka leei bɛn be kaman bɛn kani.
en: Just as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so will all the nations around you drink; they will drink and swallow quickly, and they will be like theyve never been before.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, Yawɛ chu shɛli bɛ ni puhiri yuuni kam la beni, ka bɛ ni puhi li Shilo din be Bɛtɛl nuzaa polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo solɔɣu din yi Bɛtɛl kuni Shɛkɛm, ka be Lɛbɔna nudirigu polo la.
en: We have an idea! This is the time for the festival of the Lord at the city of Shiloh. This festival is celebrated every year there.

dag: ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni;.
en: These men love to have the places of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka chɛchɛbuŋ maa zani; ka o mini Filip zaa yi n-chaŋ ti siɣi kom maa ni, ka Filip baptaiz o.
en: The official ordered the carriage to stop, and both Philip and the official went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka dabiɛm mali ba? Bɛ tirila gbini. Bɛ ŋme bɛ tɔbutuhiriba luhi, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui yomyom. Bɛ bi kaɣiri lihiri bɛ nyaaŋa, dabiɛm n-kul be luɣilikam! Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I can see the battle now— you are defeated and running away, never once looking back. Terror is all around.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli mɔɣili maa duli labi.
en: He said to me, Mortal man, note all this carefully. Then the man took me back to the riverbank.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu tuma yi zahira. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni kɔr biɛri balibu kam.
en: What human nature does is quite plain. It shows itself in immoral, filthy, and indecent actions;.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri nɛma yihiri.
en: Then Jesus went into the Temple and began to drive out the merchants.

dag: Dinzuɣu bin ata ŋɔ m-beni, dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda mini tahima ni yurilim, ka din gari di zaa nyɛla yurilim.
en: Now faith, hope, and love remain—these three things—and the greatest of these is love.

dag: Amaa a nyara, hal a nya muɣisigu mini wahala shɛŋa bɛ ni dira, chɛ ka yɛla maa be a nuu ni. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri sɔŋsim zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋla a nuu ni; a mi pun nyɛla kpibisi sɔŋda.
en: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.

dag: Bɛ ni daa garigi yɛli ti shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun su zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ daba, ka lab mɛri du shɛli Izraɛl na so ŋun mali yiko pam ni daa pun me n-naai zali yuun gbaliŋ din gari la ni ha.
en: This was their reply to us: We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth. We are rebuilding the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli Manɔa, A yi gooi ma ʒili, n ku di yi bindirigu maa; amaa yi yi niŋ shili ni yi zaŋ li mali sara nyo buɣim, yin zaŋmiya li na ti ti Yawɛ. .
en: The angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Even if you keep me from leaving, I will not eat your food. But if you want to prepare something, offer a burnt offering to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, yi ni ti wum kuŋa Zahim Dunɔdal la gbini, ka wum fabila yiya pala la ni, ka wum vuri pam daboya zuɣu.
en: The Lord also said, At that time people will be calling for help at Fish Gate in Jerusalem and mourning in the new part of town. They will hear the sound of destruction in the hills around the city.

dag: A ni saɣi diɛmd o kaman noombil la bee n-lo o zal a tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi?.
en: Can you play with him like a bird, put a leash on him for your girls?.
