dag: N ni fo baalim, ka ku yɛli shɛli, dama nyini n-niŋ lala.
en: I am completely silent; I wont open my mouth because you have acted.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim, saha shɛli zaa yi ni ti yɛn be yi dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka di leei dabari maa, di saha maa di ni vuhi, ka di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim.
en: Then the land will enjoy the years of complete rest that you would not give it; it will lie abandoned and get its rest while you are in exile in the land of your enemies.

dag: Di niŋ a zo yɛda, a mi di niŋ a ni yuri so naani. Gbaam a noli yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ paɣa so ŋun do m-baɣa sani.
en: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.

dag: Ti ni ŋma a ni bɔri Lɛbanɔn dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa ti a, ka lo li n-zaŋ niŋ teeku ni n-dolisi kom tahi Jɔpa na, ka yi kana ti kpuɣi li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I will tell them to start cutting down trees in Lebanon. They will cut as many as you need, then tie them together into rafts, and float them down along the coast to Joppa. Your workers can take them to Jerusalem from there.

dag: Ti mabihi, di bi kpa talahi ni ti lan sab dabisa mini saha yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli polo;.
en: There is no need to write you, friends, about the times and occasions when these things will happen.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o niriba daa yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ ti piri tab ʒii bunahi zuɣu n-dɔni gili Shɛkɛm.
en: So one night, Abimelech led his soldiers to Shechem. He divided them into four groups, and they all hid near the town.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei Jɛhu gbaŋ maa, ka bɛ gbahi naa bidibisi pisopɔin maa n-ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri niŋ piɛri ni n-zaŋ li tahi Jɛziriil ti ti o.
en: When Jehu's letter was received, the leaders of Samaria killed all seventy of Ahab's descendants, put their heads in baskets, and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ko n-dolisi kulibɔŋ bindira ni niŋ pam, ka bɛ suhiri paligi, ka niɣi mini bunsi gba nya mɔ suma ŋubi.
en: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.

dag: Bɛ ni kul galisi pam shɛm, lala ka bɛ tumdi alahichi pam n sani. N ni chɛ ka bɛ jilima nyabu leei vi.
en: The more of you priests there are, the more you sin against me, and so I will turn your honor into disgrace.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi suhuri ni zɔhiri shɛlikam zuɣu yɛla niŋ o nuu ni, dama o baɣa be yi ni.
en: Throw all your anxiety onto him, because he cares about you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda nachimba maa ŋmaligi labi ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: David's men went back to him and told him what Nabal had said.

dag: Yil yidan yi ti yiɣisi kpari dunoli maa ka yi kana ti ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara yɛra, Ti Duuma, yoom ti ka ti gari, o ni ti garigi yɛli ya, N ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na.
en: Once the owner of the house gets up and locks the door, you will be left standing outside. You will knock on the door and say, Sir, open the door for us! But the owner will answer, I don't know a thing about you.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Pa Bɛnjamin zuliya din pɔri gari Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa la ni nira n-nyɛ ma? Pa n yiŋnim m-pɔri gari sokam Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni? Ka wula ka a ti tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Saul answered, But I am a member of the tribe of Benjamin. It is the smallest tribe in Israel. And my family is the smallest in the tribe of Benjamin. Why do you say Israel wants me.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni bee bɛ yi ti yɛn chaŋ miri sara maligu bimbini maa ti tum tuma bee m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di simdi ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛmaŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: Every time they enter the Meeting Tent, they must wash with that water so that they will not die. They must also wash every time they come near the altar to burn incense or to offer gifts to the Lord .

dag: Bɛn guli Izraɛlnim zaa nyɛla zoomba, bɛ ka baŋsim. Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn doya gbihiri ka bi wahira. Bɛ kul domi gbihiri ka zahindi zahima.
en: The watchmen are all blind. They dont know what they are doing. They are like dogs that will not bark. They lie on the ground and sleep. Oh, they love to sleep.

dag: N dana, daŋmi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ tooni, ka m mali biŋkɔbiri maa mini bihi maa chani biɛlabiɛla na hal ti paag a Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Please go on ahead of me, and I will follow slowly, going as fast as I can with the livestock and the children until I catch up with you in Edom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti zaŋ o tam bɛ tiŋ maa ni daa me n-tam zo shɛli zuɣu naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ ni bɛ daag o luhi zoli maa lɔŋni sa ka o kpi.
en: They rose up and ran him out of town. They led him to the crest of the hill on which their town had been built so that they could throw him off the cliff.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ninsalitali yubu ku tooi tiɣi Naawuni nini.
en: Those who are ruled by their sinful selves cannot please God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim Farisiinim mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaanib shɛb Yisa sani ni bɛ ti puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Some Pharisees and some members of Herod's party were sent to Jesus to trap him with questions.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli niriba yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum, dindina n ni vuɣi di zuliya maa zaa n-ku ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But if they dont listen, I will dig up that nation; yes, I will dig up and destroy, declares the LORD.

dag: Yisa daa ti lan wuhiri niriba dahin shɛli, ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi m-mir o; bɛ daa yila Jɛrusalɛm mini Galili ni Judia tiŋkpansi na. Ka ti Duuma yiko din daa chɛ ka Yisa tibiri barinim maa daa be ŋun Yisa sani.
en: One day when Jesus was teaching, Pharisees and legal experts were sitting nearby. They had come from every village in Galilee and Judea, and from Jerusalem. Now the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A ba ka alaafee; ka o daa zaŋ o bidibis ayi la, Manaasa mini Ifriim chaŋ o sani.
en: Joseph was told that his father Jacob had become very sick. So Joseph went to see him and took along his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri, ka bɛ jilima zaa ŋmanila mɔpuma. Mɔri kpira, ka di puma kpahiri lura.
en: The Scriptures say, Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o gbaɣino maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣili Ashitarɔt jɛmbu duu, ka zaŋ o chaŋ Bɛtishan nti lo o tabili gooni.
en: They put Sauls armor in the temple of Ashtoreth. The Philistines also hung Sauls body on the wall of Beth Shan.

dag: man Yawɛ daa yi katiŋa n-ka bɛ sanna. N kul yuri ya mi sahakam, dinzuɣu ka n kul gbibi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: I appeared to them from far away. People of Israel, I have always loved you, so I continue to show you my constant love.

dag: Tihi din vari kul sabigi sahakam, fabilimiya, dama sida tihi luya; ti suma la zaa bahi yoli! Bashan oki tihi, fabilimiya, dama bɛ ŋma nyɔŋ tihi la zaa luhi!.
en: Scream, cypress, for the cedar has fallen; those majestic ones have been devastated. Scream, oaks of Bashan, for the deep forest has fallen.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n yɛligu yɛli ba, bɛ yi ni wum li bee bɛ yi ni zaɣisi li wumbu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: You must tell them what I say, whether they listen or not. They are people who usually refuse to listen!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋsim yiri Yaakubu Naawuni sanna mal alibarika. Bɛ tahima bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: It is a great blessing for people to have the God of Jacob to help them. They depend on the Lord their God.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Baasha daŋ ni nir yi kpi yiŋa, bahi n-yɛn ŋub o; ka ŋun mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri n-yɛn di o.
en: Dogs will eat any of Baashas family who die in town. Birds will eat any who die in the country.

dag: N yi tum alahichi, a nyari ma mi, ka ku chɛ n-taali.
en: If I sin and you observe me, you wont consider me innocent of wrongdoing.

dag: Nyama, bɛ yi kul ʒini luɣ shɛli bee bɛ yi kul yiɣisi luɣ shɛli, mani ka bɛ yiini yila tura.
en: when they sit down and when they stand up. Look how they make fun of me!.

dag: Ka sapashini ŋun pa o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Jɛhɔhanan. O daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinii.
en: next to him was Commander Jehohanan with two hundred eighty thousand soldiers.

dag: Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla piɛ gbaŋ sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni, maligim yi lula piɛ gbaŋ maa kɔŋko zuɣu, ka bi lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gil li, dindina m baŋya ni a shiri ni chɛ ka n fa Izraɛlnim bahi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Im now putting a wool fleece on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the fleece but all the ground is dry, then Ill know that you are going to rescue Israel through me, as you have declared.

dag: Ka Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir maa daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Aijalɔn Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni.
en: Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

dag: N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo sara ti Yawɛ, ka jɛm o.
en: I will give you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and offer my prayer to you.

dag: O tab ni daa nya lala maa ka di niŋ ba yoli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli naa doo maa ŋun ni niŋ shɛm.
en: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara piɛbila maa mini kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim zuɣu maa gahigahi, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest will take the lamb for the guilt offering and the oil, and he will lift them up to show they were offered before the Lord .

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ hal ti paai o lubu saha, kul paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: May the Lord s name be praised from where the sun rises to where it goes down.

dag: amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ ma niŋ piɛɣu ni n-kpuɣ ma tiri tiŋ maa gooni vol ni n-siɣisi tiŋ ha ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: But some friends put me in a basket. Then they put the basket through a hole in the wall and lowered me down. So I escaped from the governor.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛra, Tiliginsim yila ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni mini Piɛbil ŋɔ sanna.
en: They shouted loudly, Victory belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka o mini niriba maa zaa ni naa lo alikauli ni bɛn yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ niriba.
en: Jehoiada then made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they would be the LORDs people.

dag: O daa zali Yaakubu zuliya zaligu, ka zali zaligu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla o ni daa zali ti yaannim zaligu shɛli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: He gave laws to the people of Israel and commandments to the descendants of Jacob. He instructed our ancestors to teach his laws to their children.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ o ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna nti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu, ka tɔɣi o ʒim bahi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ o nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar.

dag: Lɛbanɔn, yoom a dunoya ka buɣim tooi di a sida tihi luhi.
en: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire will devour your cedars.

dag: Yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zaa la yoli, m bɔri ni n teei ya ni Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi Izraɛlnima n-yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di nyaaŋa o daa ti bahi bɛ ni bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda la yoli.
en: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.

dag: Ka buɣim maa buɣim niɛm daa kpuɣi bimbini maa zuɣu du zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ malaika maa yiɣi kpe di ni n-dol li du zuɣusaa, ka Manɔa min o paɣ daa nya lala ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Manoah and his wife were watching what happened. As the flames went up to the sky from the altar, the angel of the Lord went up to heaven in the fire. When Manoah and his wife saw that, they bowed down with their faces to the ground.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ziɔn paɣiba nyɛla karimbaannima, bɛ duhila bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa chani lihiri kɔre lihigu. Bɛ yaarila bɛ naba n-nɔri nyamnyam sarisiri chana.
en: The LORD says: Because Zions daughters applaud themselves, walking with their chins in the air, flirting with their eyes, tiptoeing as they walk, feet jingling.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni boli shɛb Izraɛlnima, ka yi yi Juda zuliya ni na la, wummiya! Yawɛ yuli ka yi mali pɔri pɔri, ka yɛri ni yi jɛmdila Izraɛl Naawuni, amaa ka lee bi jɛmd o ni yɛlimaŋli ni wuntia.
en: Family of Jacob, listen to me! You people call yourself Israel, but you are from Judahs family. When you take an oath, I, the Lord , the God of Israel, am the one whose name you use, but you are not honest and sincere.

dag: nti zaŋ li shihi n noli ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ni shihi a noli maa, di yih a galimi, ka kpihim a daalahichi.
en: He touched my mouth and said, See, this has touched your lips. Your guilt has departed, and your sin is removed.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di ni kɔbiri bi piɛla, ka di mi bi kpe puuni, amaa ka sabigi, maligumaana maa ŋun kparim o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the hairs in it have not turned white and it is not deeper than the surrounding skin, but is light in color, the priest shall isolate you for seven days.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛri n-nahindi ti yaannim maa ka muɣisiri ba ka bɛ zaŋdi bɛ biliɛri bahira ni bɛ zuliya maa kpihim.
en: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them, forcing them to put their babies out of their homes, so that they would die.

dag: Naawuni daa bi zaŋ dunia shɛli din ti yɛn kana ka nyɛ ti ni tɔɣisiri shɛli yɛla ŋɔ subu fukumsi niŋ malaikanim nuu ni.
en: God did not choose angels to be the rulers over the new world that was coming. That future world is the world we have been talking about.

dag: Ka bɛ gbaag o zilima yɛlibu yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ o nyaandola, amaa tinim nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: At this they shouted insults at him and said, You are his follower, not us! We are followers of Moses.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila Dauda pii shɛli bɛ ni daa me di kulisi tam tab zuɣu ka nyɔtaɣirisi yiliyil li la. Di zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.

dag: Suhubɔhibo yi mali nira, di chɛrimi ka o zahindi zahima. Ka jɛrigu mi mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: Remember: Dreams come with many cares, and the voice of fools with many words.

dag: O bi darigiri ti tibili kaman ti daalahichi ni simdi shɛm bee n-yɔri ti ti tuumbiɛri samli.
en: He doesnt deal with us according to our sin or repay us according to our wrongdoing.

dag: Yɛndan lee bela ya? Ka zaligubaŋda lee bela ya? Ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛlibuɣisira lee bela ya? Pa Naawuni m-pun wuhi ni dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim?.
en: So then, where does that leave the wise? or the scholars? or the skillful debaters of this world? God has shown that this world's wisdom is foolishness!.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanima, yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya yila paɣi ti Duuma.
en: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa nyɛ anab maa daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: So this young man, the prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni na.
en: to command the priests carrying the Covenant Box to come up out of the Jordan.

dag: Timiya ba tuun kpɛma pam ka bɛ tumda din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan gbilisi tibili wum yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Make the mens work so hard that its all they can do, and they cant focus on these empty lies.

dag: Yinim Filistianim zaa, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya pam. Yi tiŋ mini di dunoya kuhima! Dama taŋkpagbiligu ni yi nuzaa polo na, di nyɛla tɔbbihi bɛn kanna ka dabiɛmlana ka bɛ ni.
en: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.

dag: Nabɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la daa mal o wain tihi puu Jɛziriil, ka di miri Samaria Naa Ɛhab yiŋa.
en: There was a vineyard near King Ahabs palace in Samaria. A man from Jezreel named Naboth owned it.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim galisim ni ti ŋmanila teeku duli bihigu din ku tooi buɣisi ka mi ku tooi kali ŋɔ. Ka luɣ shɛli di ni yɛli ba, Yi pala n niriba ŋɔ, di ni ti lan boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bidibisi.
en: The people of Israel will become like the sand of the sea, more than can be counted or measured. Now God says to them, You are not my people, but the day is coming when he will say to them, You are the children of the living God.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zahimmi yɛlli maa ka baŋ a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm; dama dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi tahi zaɣ biɛɣu ti kpɛm maa sanna n-tabil o yiŋnim zaa, ka o mi yɛla kpɛm pam ka nir ku tooi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Nabal was foolish to say what he did. Terrible trouble is coming to our master and all his family. You need to think of something to do.

dag: M pun yɛli ya di yɛla zali ka di wɔɣa pɔi ka di naanyi ti niŋ maa ni di chɛ ka yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi wuna bee yi dari binnana mini anzinfa binnana n-niŋ li.
en: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, The idols we worship did this.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka yi shɛb kpimi kaman n ni daa chɛ ka Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim kpi shɛm la; ka yi ni shɛb mi daa tiligi ka di ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni. Di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I destroyed you as I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. And those cities were completely destroyed. You were like a burned stick pulled from a fire, but still you didnt come back to me for help. This is what the Lord says.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa mali sara maligunim Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then Solomon and all the people offered sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu. Ninni din nyɛ tuuli maa daa nyɛla chɛrubi ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buyi nyɛ ninsal ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buta nyɛ gbuɣinli ninni, ka ninni din pahi bunahi mi daa nyɛ tɔrili ninni.
en: Each Cherub angel had four faces. The first was the face of a Cherub, the second was the face of a man, the third was a lions face, and the fourth was an eagles face. Then the Cherub angels rose into the air.

dag: O ni daa ba n-chana, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni.
en: As Jesus rode along, they spread their clothes on the road.

dag: Ka Sintani daa yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣili ŋɔ leei bindirigu.
en: The devil said to him, Since you are Gods Son, command this stone to become a loaf of bread.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa tiligi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: Then in their trouble they called to the Lord , and he saved them from their distress.

dag: Obadia ni daa gbaai chandi, o nini nyabu yim ka o ti nya Ilaija m-baŋ o, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, N dan Ilaija, nyini m-bala.
en: As Obadiah was walking along the road by himself, he looked up, and there was Elijah. Obadiah recognized him and bowed down to show his respect. He said, Elijah? Is it really you, master.

dag: ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali. Ka di daa niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: They will kill him. But he will be raised on the third day. And they were heartbroken.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka nasara dibu yirina, niŋm alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: because you protect and bless your people.

dag: M bia, zaŋm a suhu ti ma, ka kpahim m biɛhigu;.
en: Pay close attention, son, and let my life be your example.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a teei doya zaŋ a nina kpa tiŋa? Yiɣisima!.
en: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali tipuma kɔtomsi mini firilanima ni gbabɔnima.
en: the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of pure gold.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ ni di nyɛla talahi ni Masia di wahala n-leei ŋun tuui neei kum ni, ka moli tiliginsim lahibal suŋ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani n-neei bɛ nina.
en: that the Christ would suffer and that, as the first to rise from the dead, he would proclaim light both to my people and to the Gentiles.

dag: ni Afɛk naa ni Laasharɔn naa.
en: Aphek, Lasharon.

dag: bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba ni azichilaannim ni faranim zaa, wummiya!.
en: great and small alike, rich and poor together.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋ na nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka di sabi ni faashee Daadam Bia bahi di wahala balibu kam ka bɛ lan ʒiɛm o?.
en: He answered, Elijah does come first to restore all things. Why was it written that the Human One would suffer many things and be rejected?.

dag: O daa sabila gbaŋ maa yɛli Jɔab, Zaŋmi Yuria zali tooni tɔb maa ni mali kpiɔŋ luɣ shɛli polo, ka miligi ka chɛ o ka bɛ ku o.
en: In the letter David wrote: Put Uriah on the front lines where the fighting is the hardest. Then leave him there alone, and let him be killed in battle.

dag: O daa pun daŋ timla ninvuɣ so ka o daŋ bɛ tooni. Dilana n-daa nyɛ Yisifu so bɛ ni daa zaŋ kɔhi ka o leei dabili la.
en: But he sent a man named Joseph to go ahead of them. Joseph was sold like a slave.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabia, n suhir a, Niŋm ma nirilim ŋɔ ti Duuma zuɣu. Kpaŋsimi n suhu Masia ni.
en: So, my brother, as a follower of the Lord please do this favor for me. It would be such a great encouragement to me as your brother in Christ.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye Jɛrusalɛmnima, zuŋɔ yi yi di baŋ din di naan tin ya suhudoo di di so; amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi bela zibisim ni zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: He said, If only you knew on this of all days the things that lead to peace. But now they are hidden from your eyes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi n-chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said.

dag: amaa ŋunkam chihi dimbɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Yisa polo pala ŋun mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna. Ka shia ŋɔ nyɛla shi so ŋun yi Masiachihira sanna, ka yi mi pun wum ni o ni ti kana, ka hal o pun be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Another spirit refuses to say this about Jesus. That spirit is not from God. This is the spirit of the enemy of Christ. You have heard that the enemy of Christ is coming, and now he is already in the world.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anu, ka n nya bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni yɛligu mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu zuɣu la shihi bimbini gbini.
en: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Sintani, wara! Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus said to him, Get away from me, Satan! The Scriptures say, You must worship the Lord your God. Serve only him! Deuteronomy :.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ɛdom zoli polo, n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Edom.

dag: ka Izraɛlnim zaa gba naanyi tiligi kaman di ni sab yɛli Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Tiligira ni ti yi Ziɔn na; o ni ti yihi Yaakubu zuliya tuumbiɛri zaa bahi.
en: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhiranima m-pahi Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋdi tiri bɛn deeri ŋun Naawuni nol la.
en: We saw all these things happen, and we can say that they are true. The Holy Spirit also shows that these things are true. God has given this Spirit to all those who obey him.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Filip, m min a ni be ka di yuui ŋ-ŋɔ ka a na bi mi ma? Ŋun nya ma, o nya m Ba; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n wuhimi ya m Ba maa.
en: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?.

dag: Ka sapashin so dabiyurigu daa biɛra n-tarigi.
en: In Capernaum there was an army officer. He had a servant who was very sick; he was near death. The officer loved the servant very much.

dag: Di saha ka malaika bɔbili daa dii yi alizanda ni na nti pahi malaika yino maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa yɛl o paɣiba, Ada mini Zilla, wummiya: Yinim Lamɛk paɣiba, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ: N kula do so ŋun ti ma daŋa. N kula nachimbil so ŋun ŋme ma.
en: Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, listen to my voice; wives of Lamech, pay attention to my words: I killed a man for wounding me, a boy for striking me.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maami tab suhuri.
en: Encourage each other with these words.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu n-nyɛ: piɛbihi ayi bɛn paai yuuni dabisili kam, ka kul niŋdi lala sahakam.
en: Now this is what you should offer on the altar: two one-year-old lambs regularly every day.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ Shia o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli bee n-saɣis o?.
en: Who directed the LORDs spirit and acted as Gods advisor?.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn bi zɔri vi ŋɔ, laɣimmiya taba.
en: You disgraceful nation, gather around.

dag: ni Giliad ni Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tiŋgban la ni Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ ti paai Salɛka.
en: Also the town of Gilead was in that land. And the area where the people of Geshur and Maacah lived was in that land. All of Mount Hermon and all of Bashan as far as Salecah was in that land.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Rɛkabinim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa deei yi yab Jɔnadab ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka dol o zaligunim zaa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa la zuɣu.
en: Then I told the Rechabite clan that the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, had said, You have obeyed the command that your ancestor Jonadab gave you; you have followed all his instructions, and you have done everything he commanded you.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi yɛli, N kpuɣila paɣa, dinzuɣu n ku tooi kana.
en: Another said, I just got married, so I cant come.

dag: Din lan nyɛ yi dini m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni yihi shɛlikam pin shɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la puuni, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi ni di nyɛ yi tarili, ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa, ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: The Israelites will bring special gifts that you will lift up to me. I give these gifts to you and your sons and daughters. That is your share. Everyone in your family who is clean will be able to eat it.

dag: Iso daa kpuɣila Keenan paɣiba. Bɛ yuya n-nyɛ: Ada ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛlɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir bipuɣiŋga la mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn ŋun nyɛ Hivi nir bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Esau married women from the land of Canaan. His wives were Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the son of Zibeon the Hivite, and.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa garigi yɛli paɣ maa, N yi bɔh a bɔhigu nyin di sɔɣi ma shɛli. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dan naa, bɔhim ma.
en: King David answered the woman, You must answer the question I will ask you. The woman said, My lord and king, please ask your question.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi sani ka Naawuni yɛligu yina? Bee yi kɔŋko sani ka di kana?.
en: Gods teaching did not come from you, and you are not the only ones who have received it.

dag: ka n ti tir a bindira nimaani, dama kum maa yuma na kpalim yuma anu, di yi pa lala kum maa ni ti miig a min a yiŋnim ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: I will support you there, so you, your household, and everyone with you wont starve, since the famine will still last five years.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti ŋum bahi ba na kaman teeku kom ni vuri shɛm la. Ka so yi ti lihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, zibisim mini nandahima n-yɛn beni; ka sagbana zibigi fa neesim.
en: When that day comes, they will roar over Israel as loudly as the sea. Look at this country! Darkness and distress! The light is swallowed by darkness.

dag: Ninsal soya zaa ni tooi nyɛla din viɛl o sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi ninsal suhu.
en: You may think everything you do is right, but the Lord judges your motives.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Then the followers went back home.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ tibig a yuli ʒiɛmani kam ni ka yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka a chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaashee zani a tooni.
en: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, The Lord God All-Powerful rules Israel, and David's descendants are his chosen kings.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lab kpe saria karibu shee maa ka boli Yisa na ti bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Then Pilate went back inside the palace. He called for Jesus and asked him, Are you the king of the Jews.

dag: Molimiy o jilima molo zuliya kam ni, ka yɛl o daalahizib tuma yɛla niriba zaa sani.
en: Declare Gods glory among the nations; declare his wondrous works among all people.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o, o ni tu o ba bee o ma maa zuɣu, o ʒim yihibu maa taali ʒila o zuɣu.
en: Whoever curses their father or mother must be put to death. They cursed their father or mother, so they are responsible for their own death!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa o zuɣu dɛde. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Above his head they put a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a daŋ min a nam n-kul ni ʒiɛya, n sani ka a nam kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam. .
en: Your family of kings will continue—you can depend on that! For you, your kingdom will continue forever! Your throne will stand forever.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ o kpiya, ka bɔ zuɣu ka n lee lan yɛn lo noli yaha? N ni tooi lan chɛ ka o labina? Mani n-naɣi ni ti chaŋ o sani, amaa ŋun ku lan labi n sanna. .
en: But now the baby is dead, so why should I refuse to eat? Can I bring the baby back to life? No. Some day I will go to him, but he cannot come back to me.

dag: mini Ɛburɔn ni Rɛhɔb ni Hamɔn ni Kana m-mali hal ti paai Sidɔn din nyɛ tin tital la.
en: Then the border went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah. It continued to the Greater Sidon area.

dag: dama yɛm soli ka a ni tooi doli tuh a tɔbu, ka saawaranim pam mi chɛ ka nir diri nasara.
en: Get good advice before you start a war. To win, you must have many good advisors.

dag: Di dinya buɣa maligu nimdi mini binʒim ni jifa; yi mi di niŋya zina. Yi yi gbaai yimaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. Naawuni sɔŋmi ya.
en: Dont eat food that has been given to idols. Dont eat meat from animals that have been strangled or any meat that still has the blood in it. Dont be involved in sexual sin. If you stay away from these, you will do well. We say goodbye now.

dag: ka yi nini daa nya zahimbu kara mini shihir kara ni alahiziba tuun kara la.
en: the great trials your eyes witnessed, those awesome signs and wonders!.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini turi ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani ŋ-ŋuhiri dɔɣiri ba.
en: This is the message which he told them to give to Isaiah: Today is a day of suffering; we are being punished and are in disgrace. We are like a woman who is ready to give birth, but is too weak to do it.

dag: Ŋuna n-su teeku, dama ŋuna n-daa nam li; ŋuna n-su tiŋgbani din nyɛ o nuhi tuma la.
en: The ocean is his—he created it. He made the dry land with his own hands.

dag: Ka maligumaana so bipuɣiŋga yi ti gɔri pagɔrisigu n-dih omaŋ vi, o ba ka o dihi vi maa, bɛn nyom o buɣim.
en: If a priests daughter becomes a prostitute, she ruins her reputation and brings shame to her father. She must be burned to death in the fire!.

dag: N zaŋ n yɛligu niŋ a nol ni, ka zaŋ a niŋ n nuu mahim ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa, ka nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. N yɛli Ziɔnnima, Yi nyɛla n niriba.
en: I put my words in your mouth and hid you in the shadow of my hand, stretching out the heavens, founding the earth, and saying to Zion, You are my people.

dag: dindina o dana maa ŋun zaŋm o chaŋ Naawuni sani nti zaŋ o zali baɣili dunoli bee duno paɣirili, ka zaŋ peenkpaa chib o tibili voli, ka o leeg o dabili hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Then he must stand beside either the door or the doorpost at the place of worship, while his owner punches a small hole through one of his ears with a sharp metal rod. This makes him a slave for life.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu Masia ni daa yɛn ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, o daa yɛli Naawuni: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara malibu balibu kam, amaa ninsal niŋgbuŋ ka a zaŋ ti ma.
en: Therefore, when he comes into the world he says, You didnt want a sacrifice or an offering, but you prepared a body for me; .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o min o mabihi ni o ma ni o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Kapɛrinium n-daa ti niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: After this, Jesus and his mother, brothers, and disciples went to Capernaum and stayed there a few days.

dag: Kuɣa pihi sɔŋ lihi nya nyɛla din ŋmaari naŋgbankpeeni, ka lan nyɛ din maani wɔɣira ayi bɛn mali taba yɛla.
en: If two powerful people are opposing each other in court, casting lots can settle the issue.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa bɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ tusaata bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi n-chaŋ ni o ti bɔ Dauda min o niriba maa shee Yɔbuhi Tampima tooni polo.
en: So Saul took three thousand men selected from all Israel and went to look for David and his soldiers near the rocks of the wild goats.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gɔhi din gabi taba, ka ŋmani danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣi; buɣim ni di ba kaman mokuma la.
en: Like tangled thorns and dry straw you drunkards will be burned up!.

dag: Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni, ka zaŋ o leei cheechi zuɣu ni o su cheechi binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: God put everything under Christs feet and made him head of everything in the church.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Di saha maa tinzun tiŋ kam niriba pia ni ti kana nti ʒe n-gbaai Yɛhudia nira binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Chɛ ka ti dol a kul a ya, dama ti wumya ni Naawuni be yi sani.
en: In those days ten foreigners will come to one Jew and say, We want to share in your destiny, because we have heard that God is with you.

dag: Nuhu gba ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbisinu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: After Noah was years old, he had three sons and named them Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: ka di be kaman taŋkpa balli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: The ashes will blow across the land of Egypt, causing sores to break out on people and animals.

dag: din nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zali ya alizanda ni, ka di nyɛ din ku tooi pooi bee n-saɣim bee n-kpaai la.
en: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋgbuna zaa kul biɛrimi, ka n daalahichi mi zuɣu chɛ ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: Because of your anger, I am in great pain; my whole body is diseased because of my sins.

dag: Dinzuɣu kulim a ya pumpɔŋɔ. N daa yɛliya ni n ni ti a pin titali, amaa Yawɛ chɛ ka a kɔŋ pini maa.
en: Now get out of here and go home. I told you Id greatly honor you, but the LORD has denied you any honor.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Gomna Pailɛt maŋmaŋ daa yina ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni tahi do so ŋɔ na taali lee nyɛla dini.
en: So Pilate went outside to them and asked, What do you say this man has done wrong.

dag: Dama bɛ kul bɔr o mi kaman dɔbba ni bɔri pagɔrili shɛm la. Lala ka bɛ daa bɔri Ohola mini Oholiba bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri dɔbba pam maa.
en: In fact, the men had sex over and over with Oholah and Oholibah, the two sinful sisters.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka sokam zahim omaŋ pɔi ka naanyi ŋub bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyu pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ.
en: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na ti yɛli ba, Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni wuhiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bɔhimmiya li ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Moses called together all the Israelites and said to them, Israelites, listen to the laws and rules that I tell you today. Learn these laws and be sure to obey them.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino daa teeg o nuu chɛrubinim maa sanna n-tim buɣim shɛli din daa be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni la ni m-mooi di shɛli n-zaŋ li niŋ do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa nuu ni, ka o zaŋ li yi.
en: Then one of the winged creatures stretched a hand between the winged creatures into the fire that was between them, and he drew out some of it and set it in the palm of the one clothed in linen. He took it and went out.

dag: Niɣi mi bɛ lana, ka bunsi mi bɛ lan ni dihiri ba luɣ shɛli. Amaa Izraɛlnim bi mi lala, n niriba maa bi baŋ.
en: Cattle know who owns them, and donkeys know where their master feeds them. But that is more than my people Israel know. They don't understand at all.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni kpihim ŋahali maa ka bɛ ku lan ŋahi li Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Amaa yɛlim ba ni dabisa maa miriya, ka ʒii kam ni niŋ pali.
en: Therefore, say to them, The LORD God proclaims: Ill put an end to this proverb! It will never again be uttered in Israel. Tell them instead: The days are coming soon for the fulfillment of every vision.

dag: O kuhi boli zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni di di o shɛhira, ka o kar o niriba saria.
en: He tells the sky and the earth to be witnesses as he judges his people.

dag: Nyini n-nyandi ba sahakam, ka bɛ kpira, ka a taɣi bɛ ninni biɛhigu ka kari ba bahi.
en: You overpower us and send us away forever; our faces are twisted in death.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii Lɛvi zuliya niriba zali ni bɛ ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa, ka zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka zaŋd o yuli niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-bala.
en: . So they will purify the land.

dag: ka bɛ laɣimbu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbia ni o ti yɛl o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaa ni bɛ kana ni binshɛɣukam shili biya.
en: When the banquet was ready, he sent a servant to tell the guests, Everything is ready! Please come.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kum dɔro n-gbaag o maa. O ku lan yiɣisi o dooshee maa yaha.
en: Some horrible thing has been poured into him; the next time he lies down, he wont get up.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛba n-yi Ijipti na, bɛ kul yɛrigila luɣ shɛlikam; kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma; di pa shɛli ka n tooi tuhi nyaŋ ba ka kari ba. .
en: A people has come out of Egypt and covered the land. Now come and curse them for me. Perhaps Ill be able to fight against them and drive them out.

dag: Timoti daa mali yu suŋ Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Listra mini Aikɔnium la sani.
en: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa yoli, bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ʒiri mabihi maa daa bi labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa ka naɣ ŋmarila ʒiri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And worst of all, the people of Judah pretended to come back to me.

dag: Ziɔnnima, dumiya zoya zuɣu nti moli lahiba suŋ molo. Jɛrusalɛmnima, duhimiya yi yee moli lahiba suŋ molo. Duhimiya yi kukoya pam yɛli Juda fɔntinsi ni nima, Yi Naawuni kanna! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: Zion, you have good news to tell. Go up on a high mountain and shout the good news. Jerusalem, you have good news to tell. Dont be afraid; speak loudly. Tell this news to all the cities of Judah: Look, here is your God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa daa gbaai Firawuna kpamba maa shɛb dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zo n-kuli yiŋ yomyom.
en: Some of the king's officials were frightened by what the Lord had said, and they hurried off to make sure their slaves and animals were safe.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli polo niriba bɛn labina. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb kuli Babilɔn la zuliya. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ zaa ti kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni.
en: Many of the exiles left the province of Babylon and returned to Jerusalem and Judah, all to their own hometowns. Their families had been living in exile in Babylonia ever since King Nebuchadnezzar had taken them there as prisoners.

dag: n-daa yi gbala maa ni na Yisa kum ni neebu nyaaŋa n-chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni tiŋ kasi la puuni, ka niriba pam daa nya ba ni bɛ nini.
en: They left the graves, and after Jesus rose from death, they went into the Holy City, where many people saw them.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din be naa noli ni, ka o ka alahichi saria karibu ni.
en: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi gba di li shɛhira ti sani. Tuuli o daa yɛlimi:.
en: The Holy Spirit also tells us about this. First he says.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ mini di kore nyɛla din garita, amaa ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever.

dag: Ka Gaal daa ti ŋmaligi guui, ka Abimilɛk kari dol o. Ka niriba pam daa nya dansi zaŋ lala hal ti paai tiŋ maa gooni dunoli shee.
en: Soon the people of Shechem turned and ran back into the town. However, Abimelech and his troops were close behind and killed many of them along the way.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinima, ka nyɛ yi ni yɛn puhiri shɛŋa o ni zal li saha shɛli m-bala.
en: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa bo mi pala lo o, ka kuhi yɛl o, Samsin Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣi do n-gu o maa be yil maa ni du shɛl ni. Ka Samsin daa darigi chihi mihi maa kaman gal la.
en: Delilah got new ropes, and again some Philistines hid in the room. Then she tied up Samson's arms and shouted, Samson, the Philistines are attacking! Samson snapped the ropes as if they were threads.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali: Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu; din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li? Ka bɛ daa fo.
en: Then he said to them, Is it legal on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill? But they said nothing.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum n yɛla, bɛ daa paɣi ma mi, ka bɛn nina daa nya ma mi di ma shɛhira.
en: Everyone who saw me or heard of me had good things to say about what I had done.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya ti ti bɛ suɣa zali gbilligbilli wulinluhili polo. Ifriim niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ammihud bia Ɛlishama.
en: On the west will be the banner of Ephraims camp with its military units. The chief of the people of Ephraim is Elishama, Ammihuds son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ boli Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn nyɛ Naftali mini Asha ni Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa, ka bɛ kana ti doli Midiannim maa.
en: The Israelites from Naphtali, Asher, and all of Manasseh were called out, and they chased after the Midianites.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbɛbil fiɛb ma; ka lab ma kuɣa yim. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n ŋariŋ saɣim teeku puuni; ka m be teeku puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: Three different times I was beaten with rods. One time I was almost killed with rocks. Three times I was in ships that were wrecked, and one of those times I spent the night and the next day in the sea.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa n lee bi bɔri ni n zaŋ tadabo sab li pa gbaŋ zuɣu tin ya. M mali tahima ni n ni kana ti kaai ya, ka m mini ya nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi, ka di chɛ ka ti nya suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o ni daa zaŋ o nubil sabi sabbu shɛli pa kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa zuɣu la ti ma, ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa buɣim sunsuuni zoli la gbini laɣiŋgu dal la sabi pa di zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord gave me the two stone tablets on which he had written with his own hand what he had said to you from the fire on the day that you were gathered there at the mountain.

dag: N daa zaŋ ya bela tiŋgban nɛl ni yuun pihinahi, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba ni namda gba daa bi chahi.
en: Ive led you in the wilderness forty years now; neither the clothes on your back nor the sandals on your feet have worn out.

dag: Firilatamdigu maa daa malila jaba ayɔbu: jaba ata daa bela yaɣ yini polo, ka jaba ata be yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: It had six branches growing out from its sides, three branches on one side of the lampstand and three branches on the other side of the lampstand.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me bimbin shɛŋa tabili jɛmbu duu maa dukpina mini di puuni dubila zaŋ tabili luɣ kasi shee la. Ka lan me dubihi ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla tabili di luɣa ni ti gili.
en: Against the outside walls, on the sides and the back of the Temple, a three-storied annex was built, each story 1⁄2 feet high.

dag: Yi mɔŋdi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli, ka fari yɛlimaŋli n niriba bɛn nyari nahiŋgu la sani, ka fari pakoya mini kpibisi nɛma.
en: that let you cheat the poor and needy and rob widows and orphans.

dag: ka yi gba nyɛ Masia dini, ka Masia mi nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: And you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.

dag: Di saha Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim pina ni lan tiɣiri Yawɛ nini kaman di ni daa pun tiɣir o nini shɛm kurimbuni ha mini yuun shɛŋa din gari ni la.
en: Then the offerings which the people of Judah and Jerusalem bring to the Lord will be pleasing to him, as they used to be in the past.

dag: A ni yɛn kpi shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma. N yi chɛ ka binshɛli woligi m min a ka pa ni kum, Yawɛ ŋun darigim n tibili.
en: I will die where you die and be buried beside you. May the Lord punish me if we are ever separated, even by death.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili yi sani din wuhiri ni n ni darigi yi tibili kpe ka yi baŋ ni n ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ya la shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: And here is how you will know that I will keep my threats to punish you in Egypt.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla Yisa Masia zuɣu m paɣiri Naawuni yi zaa zuɣu, dama yi yɛda niŋbu moli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: First of all, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because the news about your faithfulness is being spread throughout the whole world.

dag: Ka Shiiba daa chaŋ yaɣi Izraɛl tinsi zaa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti kpe Ɛbɛl fɔŋ din be Bɛtimaaka la ni. Ka Bikiri daŋ ni niriba zaa daa laɣim dol o kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: Sheba son of Bicri passed through all the tribes of Israel on his way to Abel Beth Maacah. All the Berites joined together and followed Sheba.

dag: Tuuli binnɛɔŋ daa ŋmanila gbuɣinli, ka ŋun pah ayi ŋmani naɣilaa, ka ŋun pah ata ninni mi ŋmani ninsal ninni, ka ŋun pah anahi mi ŋmani tɔrili ŋun yiɣira.
en: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

dag: Ka yi ni ti no ninvuɣ biɛri maa sɔŋ tiŋa, dama bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tampiligim n-do yi naba ni dahin shɛli n yi ti tum n tuma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On the day when I act, you will overcome the wicked, and they will be like dust under your feet.

dag: N daa darigi deei nam maa la Dauda daŋ ni ti a, amaa ka a ti bi be kaman n dabili Dauda ŋun daa doli n zalikpana, ka doli ma ni o suhu zaa ka tumdi din tuhi n san la.
en: I tore the kingdom from Davids house and gave it to you. But you havent been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart by doing only what is right in my eyes.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ m mali suhupiɛlli n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu ŋɔ puuni; dama n ni diri wahala shɛŋa maa nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ naai wahala shɛŋa din kpalim ka nyɛ Masia ni daa diri shɛl o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ cheechi la zuɣu la.
en: I am happy in my sufferings for you. There is much that Christ must still suffer. And I gladly accept my part of those sufferings in my body for the good of his body, the church.

dag: kumiya bɛ zaa, Hitinim mini Amɔrinim ni Keenannim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: Completely destroy all the people: the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, as the Lord ordered you to do.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana n-daa ti me jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni.
en: But Solomon was the one who built the Temple.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli:.
en: The commander gave him permission, so Paul stood on the steps and motioned with his hand for the people to be silent. When they were quiet, Paul spoke to them in Hebrew:.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti ŋmaligi chaŋ bɛ namda ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani.
en: On that day, people will have regard for their maker, and their eyes will look to the holy one of Israel.

dag: M bɔri ni n yɛli ya n ni mɔri mɔ shɛli yi mini Laodisianim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi ma ni nini la zuɣu yɛla.
en: I want you to know that I am trying very hard to help you. And I am trying to help those in Laodicea and others who have never seen me.

dag: ni bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ alahichinim nuu ni ka bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu, amaa ni di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni la.
en: He said the Son of Man must be handed over to the control of sinful men, be killed on a cross, and rise from death on the third day.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kurigi, bɛ na kul ni wandi wala; ka mali sum, ka bɛ vari kul nyɛ vamaha.
en: They will bear fruit even when old and gray; they will remain lush and fresh.

dag: O ni darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. O suhu ni yiɣisi bah o dimnim zuɣu pam, ka o bɔhi ba biɛri. Hal o ni bɔhi bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ gba biɛri kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He will give his enemies the punishment they deserve. They will feel his anger. He will punish all his enemies. People along the coast will get the punishment they deserve.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri. O nyɛla ŋun zaŋ ʒiri ni o tum faranim barina, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka nandaamba kɔŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: As for the villain, his villainies are evil. He plans schemes to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speak justly.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anabi Zakaria, gol so ŋun pah awɛi la daba anahi dali.
en: Zechariah received a message from the Lord in the fourth year that Darius was the king of Persia. This was on the fourth day of the ninth month .

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Malimiya soli ti n niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ labi n sanna. Vuɣimiya tigbirigu kam din be bɛ soli zuɣu.
en: It will be said: Survey, survey; build a road! Remove barriers from my peoples road.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni; amaa ka yɛl o, Ti mabia, a nya Yɛhudianim tusatusa ni niŋdi yɛda ka na kul kumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu shɛm bebɔ?.
en: Everyone who heard this praised God and said to Paul: My friend, you can see how many tens of thousands of our people have become followers! And all of them are eager to obey the Law of Moses.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla bɛn lihiri Naa Dauda daazichi.
en: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep. All these men were the leaders who took care of King Davids property.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya li kɔhi deei liɣiri n-zaŋ liɣiri maa mali chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa.
en: Sell your produce and take the money with you to the one place of worship.

dag: A kari ma saria ka di doli soli; a ʒini nam ʒiishee n-kari ma saria, ka nya ka m-mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: You are fair and honest in your judgments, and you have judged in my favor.

dag: Na so ŋun ka tɛhi zilima nyɛla putɔɣulana ŋun niŋdi niriba fitiina, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun je zalinsi bini ni mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: A ruler without good sense will be a cruel tyrant. One who hates dishonesty will rule a long time.

dag: amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: But all these things are just the beginning of the sufferings associated with the end.

dag: Amaa m mali yɛm kaman yi gba ni mali yɛm shɛm maa. M pala ŋun biɛhigu pooi yi biɛhigu; ka ŋuni n-lee bi mi dimbɔŋɔnima?.
en: But my mind is as good as yours. You arent any smarter than I am. You havent said anything that people dont already know.

dag: Amaa ka yi yi bi niŋ o ni daa sab shɛm maa yɛda, wula ka yi lee ni niŋ n yɛligu yɛda.
en: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?.

dag: Naawuni, n ni zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ shɛli ti a la ti a. N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo pini ti a.
en: O God, I will offer you what I have promised; I will give you my offering of thanksgiving.

dag: hal o yi kul sɔɣ o jɛlinsi maa o bilikɔnsi yɛtɔɣa ni, dim maa ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bahi yi palo niriba ni.
en: He may disguise his hatred, but everyone will see the evil things he does.

dag: Dabisili din pahir ayi dali ka niriba maa zaa dunoya dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim daa laɣim chaŋ Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ zaligubaŋda la sani ni bɛ ti bɔhim baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu maa ni.
en: The next day the heads of the clans, together with the priests and the Levites, went to Ezra to study the teachings of the Law.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun shihi lala bini maa ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ku di binyɛr kasinim la, faashee o su kom.
en: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.

dag: M paɣir a, dama a nam ma, ka n yɛla mali dabiɛm mini alahiziba. M mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni a tuma zaa mali alahiziba.
en: I praise you because you made me in such a wonderful way. I know how amazing that was!.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpilli n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka ŋmahiŋmahi li tari ba.
en: He sat down to eat with them, took the bread, and said the blessing; then he broke the bread and gave it to them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuɣiri situr piɛla ni ti yihi tahima, ka bɛn ʒi kpalu dari ni ninni biɛhigu ti taɣi.
en: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila nudirigu polo n-chaŋ gili hal ti paai nuzaa polo n-kul chani gindi hal ti paai di piligu shee yaha.
en: The wind blows to the south, and the wind blows to the north. The wind blows around and around. Then it turns and blows back to the place it began.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa ti wum ni bɛ leei Sulemaana nam n-zal o ba zaashee, ka o daa tim tuumba Naa Sulemaana sani, dama Naa Hiram daa yuri Dauda pam.
en: Because King Hiram of Tyre was loyal to David throughout his rule, Hiram sent his servants to Solomon when he heard that Solomon had become king after his father.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin di dabisa maa ni. Di bi simdi ka yi chɛ ka so nya dabindi bɔrɔbɔro yi sani yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: For seven days you must not eat any bread made with yeast; there must be no yeast or leavened bread anywhere in your land.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa tim tumo ni o yim na ti yɛli Naaman ni o cham Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti mim di ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni ka o nya alaafee.
en: Elisha sent someone outside to say to him, Go wash seven times in the Jordan River. Then you'll be completely cured.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she pateesa, ka chɛ ka tuumbaŋda wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: They used fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn to make the special curtain for the entrance to the Most Holy Place. And they sewed pictures of Cherub angels into the curtain.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: For the entrance of the Tent they made a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and decorated with embroidery.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Wula ka n lee ni tooi baŋ di gbinni, ka pa ni so n-dolisi ma? Ka daa yɛli Filip ni o kpɛm o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa ni na ti ʒin o sani.
en: The official answered, How can I understand unless someone helps me? He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.

dag: N sabi Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri sɔŋ, n zaŋ bɛ daalahichi maa niŋ sɔɣisili shee.
en: Ephraims wickedness is bound up; his sin is kept in store.

dag: N ni yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni na, ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni laɣim taba n-zaŋ ba tahi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni ti dihiri ba Izraɛl zoya zuɣu mini kom ni be luɣ shɛŋa ni ni niriba ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa, O zaŋla jilima ye. Yawɛ yɛla kparibu, ka zaŋ kpiɔŋ leei shɛlɔrigu lo o shee ni. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ zali, ka di kul ku vuui.
en: Our Lord , you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.

dag: Dama nir yi kpi, o ku lan teeg a yɛla; ka ŋuni n-ni tooi paɣ a gballi ni?.
en: If I am dead, I cannot sing about you. Those in the grave dont praise you.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb bɛn zooi gari o ni tuui tim shɛb maa, ka bɛ ti niŋ bɛ gba lala.
en: So the man sent some other servants to the farmers. He sent more servants than he sent the first time. But the farmers did the same thing to them that they did the first time.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa zahim nya ka o ku tooi yihi ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa ni, ka nya ka bɛ maan piligirila duŋ taabu maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ kom paɣ o nuhi salo maa ninni ka yɛli, N nuu ka doo ŋun ka taali ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni. Yi yɛla m-bala.
en: Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere and that a riot was starting. So he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. Im innocent of this mans blood, he said. Its your problem.

dag: Gibiɔn ba Jɛiɛl daa bela Gibiɔn. O paɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel, Gibeons father, lived in Gibeon. His wifes name was Maacah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a wuntitali biɛhigu la zuɣu, karimi saria n-ti ma nasara; di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma.
en: Lord my God, judge me with your fairness. Dont let those people laugh at me.

dag: amaa ka bahi yi nyaaŋa! Niriba ŋɔ tatabo ti ku lan nya soli doli niŋ tuuba, dama bɛmaŋmaŋ lan labisi Naawuni Bia kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka dih o vi palɔni m-bala.
en: And then they abandoned their faith! It is impossible to bring them back to repent again, because they are again crucifying the Son of God and exposing him to public shame.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu n-sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lie down and rest.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa ni yino daa yɛli, A ba pola pɔri yɛli niriba, Ŋunkam di bindirigu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Niriba maa daa kul gbarigimi zaa.
en: One of the soldiers told Jonathan, Your father forced the soldiers to make a special promise. He said that any man who eats today will be under a curse. So the men have not eaten anything. Thats why they are weak.

dag: Amaa bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ sɔŋdi Aduna bidibisi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni, ka maani di dundɔŋ mini di duri, ka paɣiri neen shɛŋa din be kasi la zaa, ka tumdi tuun shɛlikam din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma.
en: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.

dag: Ŋunkam je o mabia nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, ka yi mi ni ninvuɣ kura ka nyɛvili din ka bahigu o ni.
en: Anyone who hates a fellow believer is a murderer. And you know that no murderer has eternal life.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi. Yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , dama o saha ka tiŋgbani daa pirigi la; ka o tizo mi yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: Eber had two sons: one was named Peleg, because during his time the people of the world were divided; and the other was named Joktan.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ nimaani daba ayi, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-chani gindi Galɛshia mini Firijia tiŋgbana ni n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa suhuri.
en: After staying there for a while, he left and visited several places in Galatia and Phrygia. He helped the followers there to become stronger in their faith.

dag: Laɛl bia Ɛliasaf n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The chief of the household of the Gershonites was Eliasaph, Laels son.

dag: Di saha maa ka gadama daa piligi Ɛfɛsus Yisa soli dolibu zuɣu.
en: At that time a great disturbance erupted about the Way.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa maan mooi bɛ nini bɔri ni bɛ ku o, dama bɛ daa zaŋ zali ni o bi saɣim la Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu kɔŋko, amaa ni o yɛliya ni Naawuni n-nyɛ o Ba, ka di wuhi ni o zaŋ omaŋ maɣisi Naawuni.
en: For this reason the Jewish leaders wanted even more to kill him—not only because he was doing away with the Sabbath but also because he called God his own Father, thereby making himself equal with God.

dag: Ka bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa zaa daa niŋ lala, ka chɛ bɛ firilanim gbib bɛ nuzahi ni, ka gbib kikahi mi bɛ nudiriti ni m-piɛbiri ka kuhiri yɛra, Yawɛ mini Gidiɔn takɔbi.
en: and the other two groups did the same. They all held the torches in their left hands, the trumpets in their right, and shouted, A sword for the Lord and for Gideon.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa lo daantalisi din gili dundɔŋ maa zaa ti nyɛla anzinfa ka di bansi ti nyɛ anzinfa, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: Make the curtains that surround the courtyard . meters high and hang them from the bronze posts with silver hooks and rods.

dag: Ijipti naa, a yɛnnim la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yɛl a Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm.
en: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.

dag: Ka molomoona daa ti kuhi pam yɛli, Bɛ zaliya ni niriba mini zuliya kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim.
en: a herald announced in a loud voice, People of all nations, races, and languages!.

dag: Yɛnnim chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋdi balima yɛtɔɣa niŋdi bɛ noya ni pahira.
en: The mind of the wise makes their speech insightful and enhances the teaching of their lips.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya filiŋ pam Midiannim maa zuɣu, ka daa naɣ ti kummi niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: The Israelites became very poor because of the Midianites. So the Israelites cried to the Lord for help.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa, bilimiya. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: God said, Let the earth grow plant life: plants yielding seeds and fruit trees bearing fruit with seeds inside it, each according to its kind throughout the earth. And thats what happened.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa ʒe bimbini maa gbini ni o tuɣili tulaale zim maa saha shɛli ka anab so daa yi Juda n-zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu ka Bɛtɛl na.
en: The Lord commanded a man of God from Judah to go to the city of Bethel. King Jeroboam was standing at the altar offering incense when the man of God arrived.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaayi la yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, a daa zaŋla pɔŋ tusaayi ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaayi nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: Then the servant who had been given two thousand coins came in and said, You gave me two thousand coins, sir. Look! Here are another two thousand that I have earned.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyari daadamnim tuma zaa, ka mi bɛ soya zaa.
en: The Lord sees everything you do. Wherever you go, he is watching.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana, ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti chɛ ka Napaɣ Vashiti zaŋ o napaɣ nam zuɣupiligu pili, ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Napaɣ maa daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli, ka naa maa daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o viɛlim maa wuh o tuma zuɣulaannim min o saamba maa zaa.
en: He ordered them to bring in Queen Vashti, wearing her royal crown. The queen was a beautiful woman, and the king wanted to show off her beauty to the officials and all his guests.

dag: Wain kurili mini wain palli niriba yɛm.
en: Sexual sins, strong drink, and new wine ruin a persons ability to think straight.

dag: O daa zaŋla din buɣisiri maa buɣisi wulimpuhili polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He measured the east side with the ruler. It was cubits long.

dag: Amaa so beni ŋun diri ma shɛhira, ka m mi ni o ni diri ma shɛhira shɛli maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: But there is someone else who testifies on my behalf, and I know that what he says about me is true.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ naɣilaa la na nti mal o min o yiŋnim daalahichi sanyoo sara, ka o ti kɔrigi naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: Aaron will offer the bull for his purification offering to make reconciliation for himself and his household. He will slaughter the bull for his purification offering.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, Zuɣusuŋ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Gaad.
en: and Leah said, What good luck! So she named him Gad.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ; Niŋmiya tuuba, ka chɛ yi buɣa ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka zo n-yi din chihiri la tumbu ni.
en: So tell the family of Israel, This is what the Lord GOD says: Come back to me and leave your filthy idols. Turn away from those terrible, false gods.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa piɛb o kikaa, ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zo titali ka buɣim diri di zuɣu la yiɣ ti lu teeku ni.
en: The second angel blew his trumpet. Then something that looked like a big mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. And a third of the sea became blood.

dag: Ti mabi shɛb ni daa ti paana nti yɛl a ni doli yɛlimaŋli shɛm min a ni shiri kul be yɛlimaŋli maa ni sahakam shɛm, di daa niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam.
en: I was overjoyed when the brothers and sisters arrived and spoke highly of your faithfulness to the truth, shown by how you live according to the truth.

dag: Tɛkɔa paɣ maa ni daa ti paai naa tooni, o daa lumi gbani zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naa, fam ma bahi.
en: When the woman from Tekoa came to the king, she fell facedown, bowing low out of respect. King, help me! she said.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chani ka Naawuni malaikanim chirig o sol ni;.
en: Jacob also left that place. While he was traveling, he saw Gods angels.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: So Pilate handed Jesus over to them to be killed on a cross. The soldiers took Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi niriba maa sani nti zaŋ li yɛli ba.
en: After Moses had gone back down, he told the people what the Lord had said.

dag: Nir yi bi tuɣ ma, o ŋmanila wul shɛli bɛ ni wooi bahi ka di kuui, ka bɛ laɣisi di dari niŋ buɣim ni ka di di li.
en: If you dont remain in me, you will be like a branch that is thrown out and dries up. Those branches are gathered up, thrown into a fire, and burned.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa chɛ kumsi, ka bɛ yɛli ba, Fomiya ka di chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla dabisili kasi.
en: The Levites also calmed all of the people, saying, Be quiet, for this day is holy. Dont be sad.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa baŋ nɛma maa ka yɛli, Paɣ maa nyɛla wuntizɔra n-gari ma, n ni bi zaŋ o ti m bia Shɛla la zuɣu. Ka o daa bi saɣi ka o mini paɣ maa lan dɔni yaha.
en: Judah recognized them and said, She is in the right. I have failed in my obligation to her—I should have given her to my son Shelah in marriage. And Judah never had intercourse with her again.

dag: Tim ma baŋsim, ka n gbib a zaligu, ka dol li ni n suhu zaa.
en: Help me understand your teachings, and I will follow them. Obeying them will be my greatest desire.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wurim buɣa, ka saɣim Mɛmfisi binnana la naai. Naa ti ku lan be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu n ni ti zaŋ dabiɛm niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will also destroy the idols in Egypt. I will take the statues away from Memphis. There will no longer be a leader in the land of Egypt. I will put fear there instead.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko n-tum shihira mini alahiziba tuma din mali dabiɛm n-yih a niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: You used powerful miracles and brought your people Israel out of Egypt. You used your own powerful hand to do this. Your power was amazing!.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi wɔribariba noli, ka bɛ ba nayili yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zaŋ gbana maa tahi yomyom. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm moli Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa puuni.
en: The riders mounted on royal horses left Susa, spurred on by the kings order, and the law also became public in the fortified part of Susa.

dag: Yilimiya yila ka ŋmɛm guŋgombihi, ka ŋmɛm goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnim din kumsi nyaɣisa.
en: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.

dag: Ka niriba daa wum di yɛla ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi Filistianima.
en: The nations have heard, and they tremble with fear; the Philistines are seized with terror.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ din guli ba, ka faranim fara bahiri ba yoli.
en: Wealth protects the rich, but poverty destroys the poor.

dag: bee gomnanim bɛn nyɛ o ni tim shɛb ni be ti darigi bɛn tumdi taali tibili, ka paɣi bɛn tumdi tuun suma la.
en: And obey the leaders who are sent by the king. They are sent to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do good.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali maa daa moli bahi ha, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li yɛli nayilinima.
en: The gatekeepers shouted out the news, and it was reported within the palace.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba min o chɛchɛbunsi zaa chaŋ yuŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnim bɛn daa gil o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim niŋ sunsuuni la.
en: So Jehoram went to Edom with all his commanders and chariots. The Edomite army surrounded Jehoram and his chariot commanders. But Jehoram fought his way out at night.

dag: Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la be nimaani. Dinzuɣu a yi ti kul wum shɛlikam nayili maa, nyin yɛlim Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa.
en: Zadok and Abiathar the priests will be there with you, and you can tell them everything you hear in the palace.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: There were men and boys over one month old in these two family groups.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka o yi n-chaŋ ti zani ka yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi ka taali. Mani n-daa lo nia biɛɣu n-ku n dana, amaa ka ŋun mi n-lee ku bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: In the morning Jehu went out and stood before the people. He said to them, You are innocent. Look, I made plans against my master. I killed him. But who killed all these sons of Ahab? You killed them.

dag: Bɛ nuhi zaa ni ti gbarigi, ka bɛ duna ni chɔɣisi.
en: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa mi a ni nya la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni laɣim je pagɔrili maa, bɛ ni bah o yoli zaa hal ka o ti kpalim o zaɣim. Bɛ ni ti dari tɔh o ŋ-ŋubi ka chɛ din kpalim n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: As for the ten horns that you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute. They will destroy her and strip her bare. They will devour her flesh and burn her with fire.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ka yiko. Dabiɛm kpe ba, ka di niŋ ba alahiziba. Bɛ ŋmanila mɔri din be mɔɣu ni bee mɔ shɛŋa din bili mɔpilli zuɣu ka na bi zooi ka wuntaŋ ŋme n-ku li.
en: Their citizens have lost their power; they are frightened and dismayed. Theyve become like plants in a field, tender green shoots, the grass on rooftops, blasted by the east wind.

dag: Nyini n-su wuntaŋ ni, ka lan su yuŋ gba; nyini n-zali wuntaŋ mini goli.
en: You created the day and the night; you set the sun and the moon in their places;.

dag: Di bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee ŋun nyɛ vubɔra, amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun be baalim, ka pa ni ŋun ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu nti yaɣi.
en: They shouldnt be addicted to alcohol or be a bully. Instead, they should be gentle, peaceable, and not greedy.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya lee yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiy o na.
en: Jesus said to them, How unbelieving you people are! How long must I stay with you? How long do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.

dag: O ni daa nya ba maa ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti zaŋ yimaŋ wuhi maligumaaniba. Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus saw the men, he said, Go and show yourselves to the priests. While the ten men were going to the priests, they were healed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul kpuɣ bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa, bɛ bi lan nya so n-naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka Naa Hɛrɔd ti kpi. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n yihi m Bia maa na.
en: He stayed there until Herod died. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: I have called my son out of Egypt .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa karim yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam din daa be zaligu kundi la ni. O daa karim alibarika mini noli yɛlibu yɛla kaman di zaa ni daa sabi zaligu kundi maa ni shɛm.
en: Joshua then read aloud the whole Law, including the blessings and the curses, just as they are written in the book of the Law.

dag: Ti teei ti ni daa yi ŋubiri zahim shɛli yoli Ijipti la mini kukombanim ni watamilo ni gabo ni alibarisa ni tafarinom la yɛla;.
en: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt for free, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.

dag: ka o yɛligu mi ka yi suhuri ni, dama yi bi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: and you do not keep his message in your hearts, for you do not believe in the one whom he sent.

dag: O daa maani maligunima ka tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: At the pagan places of worship, on the hills, and under every shady tree Ahaz offered sacrifices and burned incense.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli buŋ maa, A ni dihi ma vi zuɣu. N yi di gbibi takɔbi n nuu ni, n naan ku a pumpɔŋɔ.
en: You made me look stupid! Balaam answered. If I had a sword, I'd kill you here and now.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni la Shia yi be yi ni, ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni maa ni zaŋ nyɛvili niŋ yi gba niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni, o Shia ŋun be yi ni la zuɣu.
en: God raised Jesus from death. And if Gods Spirit lives in you, he will also give life to your bodies that die. Yes, God is the one who raised Christ from death, and he will raise you to life through his Spirit living in you.

dag: Yɛm yɛla nyɛla din kpɛm pam ŋun ka yɛm sani. O yi be dunɔdali shee o bi yaar o noli.
en: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good.

dag: Yi mi ni Stɛfanas yiŋnima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui niŋ Yisa yɛda Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu tuma ni. M mabihi, n suhiri ya.
en: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Jokimiam mini Bɛtihɔrɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: Jokmeam, Beth Horon.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa taɣ omaŋ biɛhigu, ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ niriba ayi pa omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ paɣ maa sani yuŋ, ka o ti yɛl o, Vihim nya n-ti ma, ka chɛ ka n ni yɛn boli ninvuɣ so yuli ŋɔ shia yina.
en: That night, Saul put on different clothing so nobody would recognize him. Then he and two of his men went to the woman, and asked, Will you bring up the ghost of someone for us.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋa m-baŋ Yawɛ, o kandina ka biɛhiŋ kaman biɛɣu neebu ni ka biɛhiŋ shɛm la. O ni ka ti sanna kaman sayuɣiyuɣi ni miri shɛm la. Kaman siɣili saa ni miri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yɛn ka ti sanna.
en: Let us try to know the Lord . He will come to us as surely as the day dawns, as surely as the spring rains fall upon the earth.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta zuɣusaa daboli din nyɛ zaɣ nɛli zuɣu. Kuhimiya yɛli tɔbbihi, ka kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa wuhi ni yi cham ti liri tin shɛli din niriba mali karimbaani la.
en: Raise a flag on that mountain where nothing grows. Call out to the men. Wave your arms to let them know they should enter through the gates for important leaders.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Chɛliya ka bɛn gbib bidibbina be Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni ka yi chaŋ gili tiŋ maa.
en: He said to the people, Go forward. Circle the city. Let the armed soldiers go in front of the LORDs chest.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa kul kpaŋsiri Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yomyom, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Di yi pa lala tinim gba kul kpimi maa.
en: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the land because they thought, Well all be dead.

dag: Di saha ka Sɛrafinim maa ni yino ŋun daa gbib buɣim sal nɛɔŋ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ gbabo gbabi yihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu daaŋa ni n-yiɣi ka n sanna.
en: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n zalila tiŋguliba a goma zuɣu. Bɛ di shini wuntaŋ ni zaŋ tabili yuŋ zaa. Yinim bɛn kul teeri Yawɛ ŋɔ, di bɔriya ni yi vuhi.
en: On your walls, Jerusalem, I have placed sentries; They must never be silent day or night. They must remind the Lord of his promises And never let him forget them.

dag: N kuhi niŋ a m-bɔri sɔŋsim ka a bi garigi ma, ka n ʒiɛya ka a baɣa ka n ni.
en: I cry to you, and you dont answer; I stand up, but you just look at me.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia ni bɛ di n nyɛvil la ni chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Those who are trying to kill me will go down into the world of the dead.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣili maa daa gar o nyaandoliba maa pam. Ka o lan yɛli ba, M bihi, nyamiya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu ni to shɛm bɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ daazichi naani sani!.
en: The disciples were shocked at these words, but Jesus went on to say, My children, how hard it is to enter the Kingdom of God!.

dag: Ka ti daa lan nya Nɛfilimnima ; ka tinim ŋmanila sakɔri bɛ sani. Lala n-shiri nyɛ ti bɛ sani.
en: and we even saw giants there, the descendants of Anak. We felt as small as grasshoppers, and that is how we must have looked to them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya n niriba bɛn be Ijipti la muɣisigu, ka wum bɛ fabila zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim ni niŋdi ba fitiina shɛŋa la polo. M mi bɛ wahalanim maa zaa.
en: Then the Lord said, I have seen how cruelly my people are being treated in Egypt; I have heard them cry out to be rescued from their slave drivers. I know all about their sufferings.

dag: Bɛ lo ba yolisim nyabu alikauli, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛ bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ leei bahiyotali tuun shɛŋa bɛ ni tum ka di mili ba la daba, dama ninsal nyɛla binshɛɣukam din nyaŋ o dabili.
en: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka zɔhi mini nanviri waɣi pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: God spoke, and the insects came— gnats throughout their whole country!.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, bɛ kul chanimi gindi tiŋ maa goma, ka tuumbiɛri mini nyaanyibo be di ni.
