en: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil.

dag: Di maan kahigi yɛla ŋɔ wuhi ni maligumaani so ni ti yiɣisi ŋmani Mɛlikizɛdɛk.
en: The matter becomes even plainer; a different priest has appeared, who is like Melchizedek.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni! A chɛ ka a jilima yi zahira zuɣusaa.
en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name throughout the earth! You made your glory higher than heaven!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ɛdomnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri n-kari doli bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim ka nambɔɣu zɔbu kani. Bɛ sujee maa kɔŋla tim, ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili mi kɔŋ tariga zanibu.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish the people of Edom for their many crimes. Edom chased his brother with the sword, and he showed no mercy. His anger never stopped. He kept tearing and tearing at Israel like a wild animal.

dag: Lala ka Absalom daa yi niŋdi Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa kani naa sanna ni o ti kari bɛ yɛtɔɣa saria ti ba, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigi ŋun Absalom polo.
en: This is how Absalom treated every Israelite who came to the king seeking justice. This is how Absalom stole the hearts of the Israelites.

dag: N ni zaŋ n jaaŋgbee taɣi ya, ka lɔn ya alikauli.
en: I will take firm control of you and make you obey my covenant.

dag: Damli dambu zooya n-leei ninvuɣ biɛtali jaaŋgbee. Bɛ ni so ku kpalim, bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa mini bɛ daazichi ni bɛ jilima ku kpalim.
en: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.

dag: Di saha maa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani yɛli Yisa Galilinim ni daa maani ʒim yihibu sara ka Gomna Pailɛt chaŋ ti ku bɛ ni shɛb la yɛla.
en: Some people there with Jesus at that time told him about what had happened to some worshipers from Galilee. Pilate had them killed. Their blood was mixed with the blood of the animals they had brought for sacrificing.

dag: dama bɛ suhutuntali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ bɔrɔbɔro la alahiziba tuuni la gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: because they had not understood the real meaning of the feeding of the five thousand; their minds could not grasp it.

dag: Wuntitali ni daŋ o tooni nti mali soli zal o.
en: Goodness will go before the Lord and prepare the way for him.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda!.
en: Jesus told his disciples: Have faith in God!.

dag: A chɛ a suhuyiɣisili la zaa, ka chɛ a sujee din kpɛm pam la.
en: Youve stopped being furious; youve turned away from your burning anger.

dag: nti lihi Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni vinvamli la zaa polo n-nya ka nyɔhi din ŋmani mɔɣu din galisi pam buɣim nyɔhi la kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: He looked down at Sodom and Gomorrah and the whole valley and saw smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a huge furnace.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai niriba wuhibu biɛɣukam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o;.
en: Each day, Jesus kept on teaching in the temple. So the chief priests, the teachers of the Law of Moses, and some other important people tried to have him killed.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa chaŋ na sɔasɔa ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni dindali maa kaman tɔbbi shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi guui tɔbu ni n-kuli ti kpɛri bɛ ya ni vi la.
en: So that day the troops crept back into the city like soldiers creep back ashamed after theyve fled from battle.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, bɔɣilɔ titali n-do ti mini ya sunsuuni, ka so ku tooi yi ti sani m-baai yaɣ li ka yi sanna; ka so mi ku tooi yi yi sani ka ti sanna.
en: And besides, there is a deep ditch between us, and no one from either side can cross over.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti a tɛhi zilima mini baŋsim, ka o yi ti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni, a ni doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: May the LORD be sure to give you insight and understanding so that when he appoints you over Israel, you will observe the Instruction from the LORD your God.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? A na ni nya din chihiri pam gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: God asked me, Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri, n mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Yes, Jesus said to them, and I tell you that those who leave home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and for the gospel.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, n kamina ni n ti ti a yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Jɔshua, Ti nyɛla a daba. Ka Jɔshua bɔhi ba, Banima n-lee nyɛn ya? Ka ya ka yi lee yina.
en: The Hivite men said to Joshua, We are your servants. But Joshua asked, Who are you? Where do you come from.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ niriba maa kuli Yisifu yiŋa kaman o ni daa wuh o shɛm maa.
en: The servant did as he was told and took the brothers to Joseph's house.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin.
en: Then Jesus asked them, How many loaves of bread do you have? They answered, We have seven loaves of bread.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa, ka gba bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi; ka ŋun pah ata gba lala;.
en: The second brother married his brother's widow, and he also died without having children. The same thing happened to the third brother.

dag: Gidiɔn maŋmaŋ bidibisi daa nyɛla pisopɔin, dama o daa malila paɣ bɔbili.
en: Gideon had many wives and sons.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Jɛziriil, ka Jɛzibɛl wum o yɛla, o daa bal la chilo, ka mal o zuɣu n-vɔbisi lihiri takɔro ni.
en: Jehu arrived in Jezreel. Jezebel, having heard what had happened, put on eye shadow, arranged her hair, and stood looking down at the street from a window in the palace.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yiko daa be bɛ sani, ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋmaligi jɛmdi ti Duuma.
en: The Lord's power was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa kpila Yawɛ tooni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ buɣim shɛli din bi simdi n-nyo sara maligu Sinai Zoli gbini mɔɣu ni la zuɣu. Bɛ daa ka bihi, dinzuɣu Ɛliɛza mini Itama n-daa tumdi maligumaana tuma n-sɔŋdi bɛ ba Aduna o ʒiɛman ni.
en: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord . And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla faralana, nyin di chɛ ka o chinchin shɛli a ni deei sɔŋ maa gbe a sani.
en: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niŋ wain n-ti ti ba maa ka o nyu, ka ti chɛ ka o zaŋ ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: Come on, lets give our father wine to drink, lie down with him, and well have children from our father.

dag: Yɛlim nachimbihi la gba ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa.
en: In the same way urge the young men to be self-controlled.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi tiligira. Mani n-daa nam ya. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa. N kɔŋko n-daa nam zuɣusaa. Mani n-daa lan nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ.
en: The one who rescued you is the Lord , the one who formed you in your mothers womb. He says, I, the Lord , made everything. I put the skies there myself. I spread out the earth before me.

dag: Di simdi ni yi teei anab suma ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-zal la mini ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira zaligu shɛl o ni zaŋ ti yi tuumba la ni be zaŋ yɛli ya la yɛla.
en: I want you to remember the words that the holy prophets spoke in the past. And remember the command that our Lord and Savior gave us. He gave us that command through your apostles.

dag: Yisifu ni daa sɔɣ o ba maa nyaaŋa, ka o min o biɛyanim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa dol o chaŋ sɔɣibu maa shee maa daa lan lab Ijipti.
en: After the funeral, Joseph, his brothers, and everyone else returned to Egypt.

dag: ka bahi noli ni niriba maa ni yu shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: Finally, Pilate gave in.

dag: tiri Timoti ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Timothy, a true son to me in the faith we share. Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Yawɛ, a wumdi n suhigu asiba; asiba ka n suhir a, ka guhira.
en: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.

dag: Aripakishad daa nyɛla Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah. Shelah was the father of Eber.

dag: Yawɛ di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa, amaa lee saami kpan shɛli din sa o zuɣusaa ŋɔ ka kpuɣ o ko gaɣili ŋɔ ka ti chaŋ.
en: The Lord forbid that I should try to harm the one whom the Lord has made king! Let's take his spear and his water jar, and go.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti ma, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam kul ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Your son will build a house for me. I will make your sons family rule forever.

dag: Naawuni di wuhi gba! Wula ka tinim bɛn kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo ŋɔ na kul ni kpalim be di tumbu ni?.
en: Of course not! Our old sinful life ended. Its dead. So how can we continue living in sin?.

dag: N ni chɛ n niriba bɛn kpalim la bahi, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba ka di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nɛma zaa.
en: There will still be a few of my people left, but I will leave them. I will give them to their enemies. Their enemies will take them as prisoners—they will be like the valuable things soldiers take in war.

dag: Ka dindali maa ni daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yisa sɔɣi di ni, dama siliga maa shee daa bi wɔɣ ni nimaani.
en: Since it was the day before the Sabbath and because the tomb was close by, they placed Jesus' body there.

dag: Di saha maa, naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu sokam zaa daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: In those days the Israelites did not have a king, so everyone did whatever they thought was right.

dag: Ti Naawuni, wumma, bɛ ʒiɛm ti; chɛ ka bɛ daansarisi maa ŋmaligi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔn shɛli kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: I prayed, Hear how they make fun of us, O God! Let their ridicule fall on their own heads. Let them be robbed of everything they have, and let them be taken as prisoners to a foreign land.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi nya yaa, biriginsim pahirimi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni nya bɛ lubu.
en: When the wicked become numerous, so do crimes; the righteous will see their downfall.

dag: Dinzuɣu nir yi nya biɛla diri ka mali suhudoo, di so ni o niŋ wahala nya pam. Di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: But better is resting with one handful than working hard for two fistfuls and chasing after wind.

dag: Ka hal bɛ dimnim yi gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya ka bɛ ti nyɛ daba, n ni chɛ ka be zaŋ takɔbi ku ba nimaani. N ni pa n nini lihiri ba n-niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni zaɣ suŋ.
en: If they are taken away into captivity by their enemies, I will order them to be put to death. I am determined to destroy them, not to help them.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Naawuni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla yi dini.
en: Everything that is devoted to the LORD in Israel will be yours.

dag: N kamina ni n ti tuɣili bidibiga min o ba ni bipuɣiŋga min o ma ni paɣa min o yidana ma;.
en: Ive come to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law .

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o tuhi nintɔri bahi tiŋa n-niŋ taŋkpaɣu garigari di ni n-zaŋ ʒe zom maa nina;.
en: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.

dag: Amaa hal o yi bi yihi ti, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni ti ku jɛm a wuna ŋɔ min a ni mali salima binnan shɛli zali maa.
en: But even if he doesn't, we still won't worship your gods and the gold statue you have set up.

dag: Ka nyin daadam, bɛ ni ti niŋ mihi niŋ a n-zaŋ li lo a, ka a ku lan tooi yina niriba ni.
en: Son of man, people will come with ropes and tie you up. They will not let you go out among the people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Banima n-lee ni tooi sɔɣi ashilɔni luɣ shɛli ka n ku tooi nya ba? M bi bela zuɣusaa mini dunia ni zaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.

dag: Yi yi ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dindina n ni lan chɛ ka yi nya yaa, ka n ku lan daai ya luhi. N ni zaŋ ya sa, ka ku lan vuɣi ya, dama n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa, di lan niŋ ma yoli pam. .
en: If you will stay in Judah, I will make you strong—I will not destroy you. I will plant you, and I will not pull you up. I will do this because I am sad about the terrible things that I made happen to you.

dag: Niriba daa tahirila bɛ zuɣu, Wariya, daɣirinim ŋɔ. Wariya, wariya, di shihiya ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa leei kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn dari ginda. Ka zuliya shɛb daa yɛri taba, Bɛ ku lan be kpe yaha.
en: Get away! people shouted. You're defiled! Don't touch me! So they wandered from nation to nation, welcomed by no one.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ teeku dulinim ŋɔ, fomiya ka wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Di simdi ni zuliya kam labi neei bɛ kpiɔŋ. Bɛ zaŋm bɛ yɛtɔɣa kana ti tɔɣisi. Chɛliya ka ti laɣim saria karibu shee.
en: God says, Be silent and listen to me, you distant lands! Get ready to present your case in court; you will have your chance to speak. Let us come together to decide who is right.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai tinsi maa ni nti zaŋ Yisa tuumba maa mini Jɛrusalɛm cheechi kpamba ni daa tɔɣisi gbaai yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la wuhi ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: As they went through the towns, they delivered to the believers the rules decided upon by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem, and they told them to obey those rules.

dag: Bɛ wuhibu ŋmanila yumaha din diri ninsal niŋgbuŋ la. Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Filɛtus.
en: and their ideas will spread like an infection. This includes Hymenaeus and Philetus.

dag: nini la nini, nyini la nyini, nuu la nuu, gbali la gbali.
en: You must trade an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot.

dag: Di saha ka Barakɛl bia Ɛlihu suhu daa yiɣisi. O daa nyɛla Buz daŋ ni nira, ka yi Ram malibu ni na. O suhu daa yiɣisimi bahi Ayuba zuɣu, o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali, amaa ni Naawuni m-mali taali la zuɣu.
en: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.

dag: Amaa zoli nyɛla din luri wurinda, ka tampiŋ vuɣiri di dooshee.
en: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;.

dag: Biɛrim yi ti paai ba, bɛ ni bɔri suhudoo, amaa ka ku nya li.
en: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛn je suli niŋ a niriba wunsuhigu hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?.

dag: ka n leei Yisa Masia tumo bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani ni n zaŋ Naawuni lahibal suŋ tum di tuma kaman maligumaana la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni deei bɛn pa Yɛhudianima kaman sara maligu shɛli din mali be kasi Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: of being a servant of Christ Jesus to work for the Gentiles. I serve like a priest in preaching the Good News from God, in order that the Gentiles may be an offering acceptable to God, dedicated to him by the Holy Spirit.

dag: Saŋmarisi bɛn laɣim gbilligbilli be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ti ku ne; ka wuntaŋ ti ku ne o puhibu na saha, ka goli ti ku piɛla.
en: Every star and every constellation will stop shining, the sun will be dark when it rises, and the moon will give no light.

dag: Dinzuɣu lzraɛlnima, baŋmiya ni Yisa so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu maa ka Naawuni zaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ nim zaa Duuma ni bɛ Masia.
en: All the people of Israel, then, are to know for sure that this Jesus, whom you crucified, is the one that God has made Lord and Messiah.

dag: dama tuma so titali ka n nya kpe, ka sɔguriba pam mi lee beni.
en: I will stay here, because a good opportunity for a great and growing work has been given to me now. And there are many people working against it.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔriti taŋkpaɣu m-puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri, ka kumdi ka fabindi kuhiri yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali ŋɔ daazichi zuɣu ka bɛn mali ŋarima mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa leei bundaannim la, ka di ti zani awa yini puuni n-lu n-dahim zaa.
en: They threw dust on their heads, and they cried out, weeping and mourning. They said, Oh, the horror! The great city, where all who have ships at sea became so rich by her prosperity—in just one hour she was destroyed.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim ni daa ti di bɛ liɣiri zaa naai saha shɛli, ka Ijiptinim zaa daa ka Yisifu sanna ti yɛl o, Tim ti bindirigu, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn lihiri ti ka ti kpi? Dama ti liɣiri zaa naaya.
en: When all the money in Egypt and Canaan was spent, the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, Give us food! Don't let us die. Do something! Our money is all gone.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛli polo? Ka di simdi ni n zaŋ Masia niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli leei pagɔrili dini? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: You know that your bodies are parts of the body of Christ. Shall I take a part of Christ's body and make it part of the body of a prostitute? Impossible!.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni bi deeri alahichilan suhigu, amaa so yi jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni ka tumd o yubu, o deeri dilan suhigu.
en: We all know that God does not listen to sinners, but he will listen to anyone who worships and obeys him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Rimɔnpɛrɛz maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Libina.
en: They left Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.

dag: Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o, amaa o ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ toomiya li ti ti aŋgo zo. Ka bɛ tooi li ti ti o.
en: Then he told them, Now draw some from them and take it to the headwaiter, and they did.

dag: Ka ti daa wum kukoli din yi alizanda ni na di o shɛhira maa, dama ti daa be o sani zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: We ourselves heard this voice coming from heaven, when we were with him on the holy mountain.

dag: Ifriim zuliya maa tinzuɣu nyɛla Samaria, ka Samarianim zuɣulana nyɛ Rɛmalia bia la. Yi yi bi niŋ yɛda viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ku di nasara.
en: Israel is no stronger than Samaria, its capital city, and Samaria is no stronger than King Pekah. If your faith is not enduring, you will not endure.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi sani, din kariya, ka n chɛ Yawɛ suhi tin ya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. N ni wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli ka tuhi.
en: But me? I would never sin against the LORD by failing to pray for you. I will teach you what is good and right.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka kom yi tampima ni na zɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi chɛbili kuɣili ni na.
en: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.

dag: A daalikaulinim nyɛla alikauli maŋa! Ka mani a dabili ŋɔ yuri li.
en: I love your word. Time and again it has been proven true.

dag: Bɛ daa lan chɛ ka Hashabia mini Jɛshaya bɛn daa yi Mɛrari daŋ ni na la ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ni bɛ bidibisi ninvuɣ pisi gba kana.
en: They also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah of the clan of Merari, with twenty of their relatives.

dag: Di ti maliya buɣim yi biɛhigu shee zaa Vuhim Dabisili maa dali.
en: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli mini laasabuniŋdiba zaa ni ti di vi, ka tabi bɛ noya, dama Naawuni ti ku garigi ba.
en: You prophets and fortunetellers will all be disgraced, with no message from me.

dag: N daa kabisi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina ka chɛ ka bɛ ni daa ŋubiri shɛb la yi n-luna.
en: I destroyed the power of cruel men and rescued their victims.

dag: Ka Jɛshua bia Ɛzɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Mizipa naa la daa mali me gooni din be bɛ ni duri luɣ shɛli chani tɔb nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli gooni maa gɔŋbu shee tooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Ezer son of Jeshua repaired the next section. Ezer was governor of Mizpah. He repaired the section of wall from the room for weapons to the corner of the wall.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa yaha, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: My name is the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama m bela muɣisigu ni. N kummi hal ka n nina ti biɛra, ka n niŋgbuŋ gba gbarigi.
en: Have mercy on me, LORD, because Im depressed. My vision fails because of my grief, as do my spirit and my body.

dag: yin yɛlimiy o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ yaannim nyɛla biŋkɔbiguliba, ka ti gba nyɛ bɛn guli biŋkɔbiri ti bilim ni hal ni wayo, din ni chɛ ka o chɛ ka yi ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni, dama Ijiptinim je piɛguliba yɛlli.
en: be sure to tell him that you have taken care of livestock all your lives, just as your ancestors did. In this way he will let you live in the region of Goshen. Joseph said this because Egyptians will have nothing to do with shepherds.

dag: So ni ti yɛli, n nyɛla Yawɛ nira, ka so zaŋ Yaakubu yuli bol omaŋa, ka so mi sab pa o nuu zuɣu yɛli, Yawɛ nira, ka zaŋ Izraɛl leeg o yuli.
en: One by one, people will say, I am the Lord 's. They will come to join the people of Israel. They each will mark the name of the Lord on their arms and call themselves one of God's people.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka chɛ ka bɛ kuli.
en: Then Joshua said goodbye to them, and they left and went home.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din gba daa be yɔɣu ni la n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtaraba mini Midin ni Sɛkaka.
en: In the desert there were Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah.

dag: Di daa lan ŋmaligi kpala nuzaa polo n-chaŋ hal ti paai Ɛnshɛmɛsh n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ni Gɛlilɔt din be Adumim bimbini tooni la. Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini.
en: It then turned north to Enshemesh and then on to Geliloth, opposite Adummim Pass. The border then went down to the Stone of Bohan.

dag: n-gari chaŋ hal ni Azimɔn n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ m-mali hal ti paai di tariga teeku ni. Yi nudirigu polo tiŋgbani tariga n-yɛn bala.
en: The border continued to Azmon, the brook of Egypt, and then to the Mediterranean Sea. All that land was on their southern border.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla yi situra varimla nandaamba bɛn ka taali ʒim, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa zaa yoli. Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa puuni.
en: Your clothes are stained with the blood of the poor and innocent, not with the blood of burglars. But in spite of all this.

dag: Dama m bɔrila yurilim maŋli ka pa ni sara maligu. M paɣiya ni yi baŋ man Naawuni n-gari yi nyɔri binyara buɣim maani sara.
en: I desire faithful love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God instead of entirely burned offerings.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a ʒe katiŋa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a sɔɣ amaŋ yɛlimuɣisira saha?.
en: Why are you far away, Lord ? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?.

dag: Yi lihi ʒiɛm m binshɛŋa din be kasi la, ka bi tiri n vuhim dabisa jilima.
en: You show no respect for my sacred places and treat the Sabbath just like any other day.

dag: Ka Judanim shɛb bɛn kpalim ni lan zooi m-be kaman ti shɛli din nyaɣa ba tiŋa nti wali wala la;.
en: The people from the family of Judah who have escaped and are left alive will be like plants that send their roots deep into the ground and produce fruit above the ground.

dag: Niriba ni daa nya Pool ni niŋ shɛm maa ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee kuhi yɛli pam Laikɔnia yɛligu ni, Ti buɣa n-leei ninsalinim ka ti sanna ŋɔ.
en: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a, ka a garigi ma.
en: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ninsalinima n-tuhiri taba, amaa ti mini alizinnim bɛn be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na mini bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima ni bɛn su fukumsi mini dunia ŋɔ yikolaannim bɛn be zibisim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni la n-tuhiri taba.
en: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Onan.
en: Later, she gave birth to another son and named him Onan.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa, Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la zaa.
en: Then give this message to all the people of Israel who refused to obey me. Tell them, This is what the Lord GOD said: Family of Israel, I have had enough of the terrible things you have done!.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N di pun bi yɛl a ni a yi niŋ yɛda a ni nya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Jesus said to her, Remember what I told you? I said that if you believed, you would see Gods divine greatness.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Nyama, luɣ shɛli be n sani kpe ka a ni tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: The LORD said, Here is a place near me where you will stand beside the rock.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu, o yi ti chɛ ka di biɛɣ maa neesim neei yi alizanda ni na.
en: Because of our Gods deep compassion, the dawn from heaven will break upon us.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn be n sani n wahala dibu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: You have stayed with me in all my troubles.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai tiŋ maa ni n-nya ka bɛ nyo li la buɣim, ka gbahi bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: When David and his men came to Ziklag, they found the city burning. Their wives, sons, and daughters were all gone. The Amalekites had taken them.

dag: Miri ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka miri ka a zaŋ ʒiŋmabo kpɛh a kɔbili ni.
en: Have nothing to do with a corrupt mouth; keep devious lips far from you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn diri wahala ka di nyɛ Naawuni yubu la kul tumdi din tuhi, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya niŋ bɛ Namda ŋun kul ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa la nuu ni.
en: So if God wants you to suffer, you should trust your lives to him. He is the one who made you, and you can trust him. So continue to do good.

dag: Duɣu ka bɛ mali buɣisiri anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim pam buɣisiri salima, amaa Yawɛ m-buɣisiri ninsal suhu.
en: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord .

dag: Zaadali paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ naa n-yi nudirigu polo la na ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama o daa yi katiŋa n-kana ni o ti wum Sulemaana yɛm yɛtɔɣa; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Sulemaana be kpe.
en: On the Judgment Day the Queen of Sheba will stand up and accuse the people of today, because she traveled all the way from her country to listen to King Solomon's wise teaching; and there is something here, I tell you, greater than Solomon.

dag: Ti nyari duhibu, ka lan nyari filiŋ; ti nyari ʒiɛmbu, ka lan nyari tibiginsim. Bɛ niŋdi ti mi kaman ʒirinima, amaa ka ti lee nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinima.
en: We were treated with honor and dishonor and with verbal abuse and good evaluation. We were seen as both fake and real.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhiri n niriba maa binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa ti wum ni kawana be Ijipti, ka o bɔh o bihi, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri taba.
en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, Why don't you do something?.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, hal Anabi Musa daa wuhi di yɛla o ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni n-yɛli shɛm la puuni. O daa boli ti Duuma la, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: And Moses clearly proves that the dead are raised to life. In the passage about the burning bush he speaks of the Lord as the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya kpiɔŋ Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ ni ti n yuli jilima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Di saha ka yi mini kum zɔri la saɣim, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee alikauli la yiɣisi. Di nyaaŋa alɔbo yi ti lu, di ni din ya.
en: The treaty you have made with death will be abolished, and your agreement with the world of the dead will be canceled. When disaster sweeps down, you will be overcome.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba zuɣu yi chɛ ka simdi kpe o mini dunianim sunsuuni, o yi lan deei ba, wula ka di lee ni be? Di ni ŋmanila kpiimba n-neei kum ni.
en: For when they were rejected, all other people were changed from God's enemies into his friends. What will it be, then, when they are accepted? It will be life for the dead!.

dag: ka nya ka do so ŋun yuli booni Ananias kpe o sanna nti zaŋ o nuu pa o zuɣu ni o nina neei.
en: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Nyamiya, o boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: Some of the people there heard him and said, Listen, he is calling for Elijah.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Zaŋmi duɣu n-zahim manna maa lita ayi n-kpaai niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka di be nimaani yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: So Moses told Aaron, Take a jar and fill it with a full basket of manna. Save this manna to put before the Lord . Save it for our descendants.

dag: Ka Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ni ti yihi gili dunia ŋɔ zaa n-lee shɛhira zuliya kam sani pɔi ka dunia yiɣisibu saha naanyi paai.
en: This gospel of the kingdom will be proclaimed throughout the world as a testimony to all the nations. Then the end will come.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiya ba Izraɛlnim ni daa chaŋ taŋkpa kuŋ zuɣu Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni n-du li shɛm yɛla.
en: Tell them, These rocks help us remember the way the people of Israel crossed the Jordan River on dry land.

dag: Lɛmuɛl, wumma, di bi simdi ni nanim nyuri wain bee ka nanim chɛ ka bɛ kɔre be dam din kpɛm nyubu ni.
en: Listen, Lemuel. Kings should not drink wine or have a craving for alcohol.

dag: ka di yi ti bi, o dii piinila di chɛbu, di chɛbu saha ni paai zuɣu.
en: Whenever the crop is ready, the farmer goes out to cut the grain because its harvesttime.

dag: Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna ni bɛ su li. Pina sara shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi mali nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la n-daa nyɛ bɛ tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka daa ku Filistianim maa Gɛba hal ti paai Gɛza.
en: David did what the Lord commanded him to do, and he defeated the Philistines. He chased them from Geba to Gezer, killing them all along the way.

dag: Bɛ boonila niriba duri zoya zuɣu; nimaani ka bɛ maani sara din tuhi. Dama teeku puuni ka bɛ nyari bɛ daazichi, ka nyari azichi sɔɣira bihigu ni.
en: They call all sorts of people to the mountain, where they offer right sacrifices. Its true: Theyre nourished on the seas abundance; they are nourished on buried treasures in the sand.

dag: Amaa o bela o kɔŋko, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi taɣ o? O ni bɔri shɛli, dina ka o niŋda.
en: But God never changes, and who can stand against him? He does anything he wants.

dag: Naawuni ku chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maai; o nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi Reehab la.
en: God will not hold back his anger. Even Rahabs helpers are afraid of him.

dag: Dindina, bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋmahindi bee bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ o buɣisi?.
en: To whom can God be compared? How can you describe what he is like?.

dag: Ka pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Ribɛka ni daa zaŋ jahi pua ti yab Yisahaku sani.
en: And that is not all. Rebecca also had sons, and they had the same father. He is our father Isaac.

dag: Ninkura yiɣisi dunɔdali gbini, ka nachimba chɛ bɛ biŋkumda ŋmɛbu.
en: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa karibu yɛla, ka daa ti bo n-nya o bɔh o, A niŋ Daadam Bia la yɛda.
en: Jesus heard they had expelled the man born blind. Finding him, Jesus said, Do you believe in the Human One.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum lala ka saɣi ti li.
en: When Moses heard that, he approved.

dag: Biɛɣuni sa siɣimiya ti tuhi ba. Bɛ sa yɛn dolila Ziz polo duna. Yi sa ni tuhi ba soli vinvamli maa tariga Jɛruɛl tiŋgban nɛl la ni.
en: March out against them tomorrow. Since they will be coming through the Ziz pass, meet them at the end of the valley that opens into the Jeruel wilderness.

dag: Musa daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:.

dag: A ni tooi vihi baŋ ni di bi gari biɛɣ pinaayi zuŋɔ ka n daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti jɛm Naawuni.
en: As you can find out for yourself, it was no more than twelve days ago that I went to Jerusalem to worship.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Amaa dabisa din ti yɛn doli wahala ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla.
en: During the days following that time of trouble, The sun will become dark, and the moon will not give light.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ ti ni daa nya wahala shɛli Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla; di daa nyɛla wahala din ka buɣisibu, hal ka ti daa yihi bebu tahima gba.
en: Brothers and sisters, we dont want you to be unaware of the troubles that we went through in Asia. We were weighed down with a load of suffering that was so far beyond our strength that we were afraid we might not survive.

dag: Bɛ nyarila ʒiinim din nyɛ ʒiri tir a, bɛ buɣirila ʒiri baɣiri tir a. Bɛ zaŋ a mi pa ninvuɣ yoya mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyiŋgoya zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dabisili pali, ka nyɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha.
en: Your visions are useless. Your magic will not help you. It is only a bunch of lies. The sword is now at the throats of evil men. They will soon be only dead bodies. Their time has come. The time has come for their evil to end.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Ibrahimma daa ti lihi nya o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ka di be katiŋ ha.
en: After they traveled three days, Abraham looked up, and in the distance he saw the place where they were going.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pia ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: This is the total of all cities for the clans of the remaining descendants of Kohath: ten cities with their pastures.

dag: ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ Akasia fɔŋ ni. Amaa n ni fiɛb bɛ zaa.
en: a deep pit at Acacia City, and I will punish all of you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, m bi mi n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛm, dama n na nyɛla bia.
en: I replied, I'm not a good speaker, Lord , and I'm too young.

dag: Yawɛ, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka a ni yɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ n zuliya polo ŋɔ niŋ pali sahakam. Niŋmi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Lord God, please do what you promised me and my descendants.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fiɛb ba pam ka zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu, ka yɛli dansarika gula ni o guli ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: After a severe beating, they were thrown into jail, and the jailer was ordered to lock them up tight.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ni o bɔri shɛli ka di shiri niŋ, ka di pala ti Duuma n-zal li?.
en: No one can say something and make it happen, unless the Lord orders it.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi bɛ daalaafee yɛla; ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi ba do kur so yɛla yi ni daa yɛli ma la na be o nyɛvil ni? O mal alaafee.
en: He asked about their health and then said, You told me about your old father—how is he? Is he still alive and well.

dag: Maligumaana Aduna bidibisi mi n-yɛn piɛbiri kikahi maa. Kikahi maa n-yɛn nyɛ yi kali soli bini yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Only Aarons sons, the priests, should blow the trumpets. This is a law for you that will continue forever, for generations to come.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhirimi ni n taɣirila n ni daa lo ni n niŋ shɛm? Bee n lɔri n nia mi kaman ŋun doli dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ni lɔri nia shɛm yɛra, Iin, Iin mini Aai, Aai zaa yim?.
en: So I wasnt unreliable when I planned to do this, was I? Or do I make decisions with a substandard human process so that I say Yes, yes and No, no at the same time?.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi Samuɛl, Banima n-daa lee yɛli ni Sool ku tooi niŋ ti naa la? Chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba na ka ti ku ba.
en: Then people asked Samuel, Who was it who said, Will Saul rule over us? Give us those people; well kill them.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee ŋɔ, n suhir a ni a sɔŋmi paɣiba maa, dama m mini ba zaŋ tabili Klɛmɛnt ni n tumtumditaba bɛn yuya sabi nyɛvili litaafi ni la n-daa laɣim tumdi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma.
en: And you too, my faithful partner, I want you to help these women; for they have worked hard with me to spread the gospel, together with Clement and all my other fellow workers, whose names are in God's book of the living.

dag: A ni ti nyu m-buɣi, ka nya suhugarigu. A biɛli Samaria pipia maa nyɛla bahiyoli mini dabiɛm pipia.
en: You will end up drunk and devastated, because that cup is filled with horror and ruin.

dag: Ka o daa to piɛma n-wurim ba bahi; ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi niŋ ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli Naa Sool Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la daa lihi nya ka Filistianim maa pam yiɣisi zɔri yiriŋ.
en: Now Sauls lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the Philistine camp running all over the place.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Bɛtisaida, ka bɛ zaŋ zoon so tah o sanna nti balim o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Jesus and his disciples came to Bethsaida. Some people brought a blind man to Jesus and begged him to touch and heal him.

dag: Yihim ninvuɣ biɛri naa kɔbili ni, ka o nam maa leei wuntitali nam.
en: Keep evil advisers away from the king and his government will be known for its justice.

dag: Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, m bi mi n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛm, dama n na nyɛla bia.
en: Then I said, But, Lord GOD, I dont know how to speak. I am only a boy.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti bi saɣim timaŋa, ti na ʒi n-jɛm Baalinima? Lihimiya yi biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm vinvamli ni, nyamiya yi ni daa tum shɛm. Yi daa ŋmanila laakum nyaŋ ŋun bɔri dubu ka faai zɔra ginda.
en: You deny your sins and say, We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal. But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi jɛmdi buɣa bo wahala pam ti bɛmaŋa. N ku pahi bɛ ni n-kɔrigi binyara ʒim vie buɣa maa; m mi kul ku yaai n noli boli di yuya.
en: But those who worship other gods will have many troubles. I will not share in the gifts of blood they offer to their idols. I will not even say their names.

dag: Di niŋdiya li la saha shɛli bɛ nini ni beni zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiyala din tiɣiri Naawuni nini ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nyɛ Masia daba la zuɣu.
en: You must do this not just to please your masters while they are watching, but all the time. Since you are really slaves of Christ, you must do with all your heart what God wants.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba alaka nyɛla bɛn turi ŋun nam ba, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba nirilim tir o la jilima.
en: Those who exploit the powerless anger their maker, while those who are kind to the poor honor God.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi nya ka so tum alahichi, di niŋ kamaata ni yinim bɛn mali Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ŋɔ zaŋ tarimtali biɛhigu yiɣis o zali. Ka lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, dama di pa shɛli ka yi gba ti nya zahimbu.
en: Brothers and sisters, if a person is caught doing something wrong, you who are spiritual should restore someone like this with a spirit of gentleness. Watch out for yourselves so you wont be tempted too.

dag: Nyamiya, Sintani jɛmdiba bɛn yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianima amaa ka pa Yɛhudianim la nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. N ni chɛ ka bɛ kana nti gbani yi tooni m-baŋ ni n yuri ya.
en: Listen! There is a group that belongs to Satan. They say they are Jews, but they are liars. They are not true Jews. I will make them come before you and bow at your feet. They will know that you are the people I have loved.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa ti gari.
en: The seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt came to an end.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa nyɛla Salɛm Naa mini Naawuni Zallakudura Naa maligumaana. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa chaŋ ti tuhi nanim tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ka labirina la, Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋɔ n-daa tuh o soli niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.

dag: Bɛ yi di mali yɛm, bɛ naan baŋ dimbɔŋɔ. Bɛ naan baŋ di bahigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: If they had any wisdom, they would understand this; they would discern what will become of them.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka o niŋ a nyɔri bee m-pah a binshɛli, amaa zom a Naawuni, ka chɛ ka a mabia maa kul be a sani.
en: Do not take interest from them, or any kind of profit from interest, but fear your God so that your fellow Israelite can survive among you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dunia zaa ni yɛn mali suhupiɛlli saha shɛli ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: The LORD God proclaims: As the whole world rejoices, I will turn you into a desolation.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ alikauli la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ dapuhi la niŋ adaka maa, ka zaŋ adaka maa yɔrigu yo li.
en: He took the covenant document and placed it inside the chest. He put the poles on the chest, and he set the cover on top of the chest.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni mani n-zali ya zaligu ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛl la zani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and you will know that I have sent this command to you so that my covenant with Levi can continue to exist, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri yi palo a sani, ka a niŋ ba kaman a ni niŋ ma shɛm n tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu ŋɔ. Dama n ŋuhibu maa yaɣiya; ka n suhu saɣim.
en: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ ka Naawuni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ti mini tiŋ ŋɔ la. Amaa ka yi lan tari Vuhim Dabisili maa daɣiri ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni suhu lan yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: This is just what your ancestors did, and God brought all this evil upon us and upon this city. And now you are bringing more wrath upon Israel by making the Sabbath impure.

dag: Filip daa mali bipuɣins anahi bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba, ka nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: and he had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

dag: Ka ti Duuma ŋun ʒi alizanda ni la lara, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Chɛ ka m bihi ŋɔ ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ti ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: Jesus said, What do you want? She said, Promise that one of my sons will sit at your right side in your kingdom and the other at your left.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba maa yi nyɛla pihinahinaanu, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa niriba anu maa ni pooi maa zuɣu? Ka o yɛli, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinahinaanu tiŋ maa ni, n ku saɣim li.
en: But perhaps there will be only forty-five innocent people instead of fifty. Will you destroy the whole city because there are five too few? The Lord answered, I will not destroy the city if I find forty-five innocent people.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wum kukoli maa zibisim maa sunsuuni ka buɣim dir zoli maa, yi zuliya zuɣulaannim mini yi kpamba daa vumi miri ma na.
en: Now once you heard the voice from the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, you came to me—more specifically, all the chiefs of your tribes and your elders came.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba ni nyaanzuriba. Bɛ ŋmanila tahiʒiɛɣu mini kurigu. Bɛ zaa tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: They are tin and iron; they are headstrong and rebellious. They live to slander. They act corruptly—every last one!.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n neesim mini n tiliginsim; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra? Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɛvili birini; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra?.
en: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Should I fear anyone? The LORD is a fortress protecting my life. Should I be frightened of anything?.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, nayili yila ni ti leei fabila kuhigu. Niriba ni ti kpi n-do luɣ shɛlikam. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba labi ka fo baalim.
en: On that day the songs in the palace will become cries of mourning. There will be dead bodies everywhere. They will be cast out in silence.

dag: Kum maa ni daa mii pam maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bindira ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim gbarigi zaa.
en: The famine got worse; there was no food anywhere in the land. Egypt and Canaan became very poor because of this bad time.

dag: Ɛlihu daa guhirimi ni bɛ naai pɔi ka o naanyi tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa, dama bɛna n-daa nyɛ ninkura.
en: Because Elihu was the youngest one there, he had waited until everyone finished speaking.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛli saha shɛli Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa ni dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa be o sulinsi ni ni o niriba ni daa tuhiri Jɛrusalɛmnim mini di fɔntinsi la m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n gari yɛli, N nyala fiig tiwala din viɛl pam, ka nya fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Jeremiah, what do you see? I answered, Figs. The good ones are very good, and the bad ones are very bad, too bad to eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi cheechinima, ka lan kahigi wuhi ni ti ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu ti mabihi maa sani shɛm la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.

dag: Ka o neei tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa zuɣu ka yɛli teeku maa, Fom baalim! Ka sanʒiɛɣu maa daa chɛ ʒɛbu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: Jesus stood up and commanded the wind, Be quiet! and he said to the waves, Be still! The wind died down, and there was a great calm.

dag: Molimi molo Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛli: Piɛbimi kikaa gili tiŋgbani maa ni, ka tahiri pampam yɛra, Laɣimmiya taba ka ti chaŋ ti kpe bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni.
en: Announce in Judah, in Jerusalem proclaim, sound the alarm throughout the land, cry out and say, Gather together! Lets flee to the fortified towns.

dag: Nyamya, n ni tim anabi Ilaija yi sanna pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm maa dali naanyi paai.
en: Look, I am sending Elijah the prophet to you, before the great and terrifying day of the LORD arrives.

dag: O niŋdila o yidana din viɛla o biɛhigu ni zaa, ka pa ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: As long as she lives, she does him good and never harm.

dag: Judanim pam daa pola pɔri n-zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabil o, o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Ara bia Shɛkania ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu. O bia Jɛhɔhanan daa kpuɣila Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam bipuɣiŋga.
en: Many in Judah were bound to him by solemn pledge because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah, Arahs son, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam, Berechiahs son.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa daa ti lan ŋmaligi ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni ka yɛri taba, Dauda daa tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi ti Filistianim nuu ni; ka o ti yiɣisi kpe pumpɔŋɔ n-zo Absalom zuɣu.
en: All over the country they started quarreling among themselves. King David saved us from our enemies, they said to one another. He rescued us from the Philistines, but now he has fled from Absalom and left the country.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yoomiya vol maa yihi nanima anu la ti ma na.
en: Then Joshua said, Open the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings out to me.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ ni be kaman gbuɣinli la n-gbaai ma vu n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli ŋun ni fa ma bahi ni kani nti dari tɔhitɔhi ma.
en: or else like a lion they will carry me off where no one can save me, and there they will tear me to pieces.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi lab me goon shɛli din daa lu n-dahim la zali. Yi ni me li tam di tanza kura zuɣu. Ka niriba ti wuhi ni yinima n-nyɛ bɛn lab me goma maa mini yiya shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la.
en: Your people will rebuild what has long been in ruins, building again on the old foundations. You will be known as the people who rebuilt the walls, who restored the ruined houses.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: Then some Sadducees came to Jesus. They asked him a question:.

dag: Ka kpim maa dii neei kum ni n-yiɣisi ʒini gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka Yisa zaŋ o ti o ma maa.
en: The boy sat up and began to speak. Jesus then gave him back to his mother.

dag: Sokam diri Dimitirius shɛhira suŋ, hal yɛlimaŋli maŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira suŋ. Ka timaŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira pahi; ka a mi ni ti ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm kaman di ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm la.
en: I can assure you that Elijah has already come. And people treated him just as they wanted to, as the Scriptures say they would.

dag: ka minya ni ninsal ni tum tuun suŋ shɛlikam, o ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, o yi nyɛla dabili bee bilichina.
en: Remember that the Lord will reward each of us, whether slave or free, for the good work we do.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpaŋ shɛŋa zaa din daa gili bɛ fɔntinsi maa n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya zali.
en: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.

dag: Ka nachimbihi maa ni yino garigi yɛli, Nyama, n daa nya Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala, ka o mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu pam, ka nyɛ do so ŋun mali suhukpeeni, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu; o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lan nyɛ ŋun viɛla, ka Yawɛ be o sani.
en: One of the servants responded, I know that one of Jesses sons from Bethlehem is a good musician. Hes a strong man and heroic, a warrior who speaks well and is good-looking too. The LORD is with him.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ ni zaŋ fukumsi niŋ ninvuɣ so nuu ni nyɛla ŋun ni ʒe o duuma yim.
en: The one thing required of such servants is that they be faithful to their master.

dag: di saha ka o luɣiri ninsalinim tiba, ka kpahiri bɛ zuɣuri ni ka dabiɛm mali ba.
en: to give us warnings.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ ninsalinim yɛm mini yɛtɔɣ yoya din yi ninsalinim kaya yɛla ni na, ka pa Masia din la yɔhim ya n-zaŋ ya leei alizinnim bɛn su dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda fukumsi la daba.
en: See to it, then, that no one enslaves you by means of the worthless deceit of human wisdom, which comes from the teachings handed down by human beings and from the ruling spirits of the universe, and not from Christ.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni di simdi ni yi ku sama.
en: At the end of every seventh year you are to cancel the debts of those who owe you money.

dag: Ka yi tintariga maa ni ŋmaligi nudirigu polo n-zaŋ ti paai Akirabim kunkuni n-zaŋ ti gari Zin, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Kadɛshibarinia nudirigu polo; ka zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hazarada n-gari hal ni Azimɔn.
en: Then it will turn southward toward Akrabbim Pass and continue on through Zin as far south as Kadesh Barnea. Then it will turn northwest to Hazar Addar and on to Azmon.

dag: Bɛn daa zaŋla lɔɣu ni be bindir shɛli ni ti ma ni n di; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka bɛ zaŋ yabiga kom ti ma ni n nyu.
en: When I was hungry, they gave me poison; when I was thirsty, they offered me vinegar.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni kpuɣi yi mini n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim ŋɔ zuɣusaa n sani n-zaŋ labi katiŋa.
en: I will certainly pick them up and throw them far away from me, both them and the city that I gave to them and their ancestors.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka tiligi Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku m bia Jɔnatan, hal Naawuni ni kul chɛ ka ti nya tiliginsim ŋun Jɔnatan kɔbili ni maa zaa yoli. Amaa ka niriba maa zaa so daa bi garig o.
en: I swear by the living Lord that whoever sinned must die, even if it turns out to be my own son Jonathan. No one said a word.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi puu atam di kpuɣibu saha nyɛla yɛndana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun doya gbihiri atam kpuɣibu saha nyɛla vi dira.
en: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.

dag: Ŋunkam be nyam niŋm li mihi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam daba ata dali ni daba ayopɔin dali. O niŋm lala yihi ba daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin dali, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ paɣi bɛ binyɛra ka su kom, zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ka bɛ leei bɛn be nyam.
en: On the third day and the seventh day the clean person will sprinkle it on the unclean, so that he will have purified him on the seventh day. He will then wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be clean at evening.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ yihi buɣijɛmbo maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka zaŋ bɛ na kpima chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n kul be bɛ sani sahakam.
en: Now they must stop worshiping other gods and remove the corpses of their kings. If they do, I will live among them forever.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, yin vuhimiya. Hal di yi nyɛla kɔbu saha mini puri atam kpuɣibu saha, yin vuhimiya.
en: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.

dag: Dama n fabila n-leei m bindirigu, ka n ŋuhibu galisi kaman kɔzɔrim la.
en: When it is time to eat, all I can do is sigh with sadness, not joy. My groans pour out like water.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti bee bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ti yin gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma.
en: Take them alive! Benhadad ordered. I don't care if they have come out to fight or to surrender.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni;.
en: But God raised him from death!.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi Bɛtani chana, ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: The next day, as they were coming back from Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka n yihi ya yi dimnim zaa nuu ni.
en: You shall obey me, the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from your enemies.

dag: A jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka nanim ʒiri pina na ti tir a.
en: from your temple above Jerusalem, where kings bring you gifts.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: And Jesus concluded, Many are invited, but few are chosen.

dag: Bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba. Yi na mi n-nya ka goo wali gaya bee ka pirinkpaŋ wali fiig tia wala?.
en: You will know these people because of what they do. Good things dont come from people who are bad, just as grapes dont come from thornbushes, and figs dont come from thorny weeds.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, Kpahimiya yi nuhi, duhimiya yi yɛhi yili suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: Clap your hands, all you people! Shout joyfully to God with a joyous shout!.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ niŋmi lala, dama di daa nyɛla din tiɣi niriba maa zaa nini.
en: So all the Israelites agreed with David. They all thought it was the right thing to do.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ŋub li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Somiya yi kpalansi, ka piri yi namda, ka kpuɣiya yi jaaŋgbɛhi gbibi, ka ŋub li yomyom, dama di nyɛla Yawɛ yaɣigari.
en: When you eat the meal, be dressed and ready to travel. Have your sandals on, carry your walking stick in your hand, and eat quickly. This is the Passover Festival in honor of me, your Lord .

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan kɔri binyɛra mali alizinnim bɛn ŋmani buhi la, bɛ ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋa shɛb sani la. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn nyɛla zaligu bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Israelites must no longer sacrifice their communal sacrifices to the goat demons that they follow so faithlessly. This will be a permanent rule for them throughout their future generations.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa kaman Naa Ahaz ni daa be Damaskus ka tim ti wuh o shɛm zaa la. Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa naai pɔi ka Naa Ahaz naanyi yi Damaskus kuna.
en: Uriah built the altar, following the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus; he had it finished before King Ahaz returned from Damascus.

dag: Di ti piniya yi tapaɣisi kɔbiri bee n-kɔrisi taɣi yi teeŋkɔbiri.
en: You must not round off the hair that grows on the side of your face. You must not cut your beard that grows on the side of your face.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa maa niriba maa ninni.
en: Then Aaron spoke to the people and told them everything the Lord had told Moses. Then Moses did the miracles for all the people to see.

dag: Ka Kɔra ŋun daa nyɛ Izar bia ka nyɛ Kɔhat ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir yaaŋa la mini Ɛliab bihi Datan mini Abiram ni Pɛlɛt bia On.
en: Korah, Dathan, Abiram, and On turned against Moses.

dag: Nam ʒiishee maa daa malila dura diba ayɔbu, ka napɔna tambu shee din daa tuɣi nam ʒiishee maa nyɛ salima. Nam ʒiishee maa yaɣili kam daa malila nuhi pabu shee, ka bɛ daa mali gbuɣima ayi kɔtomsi n-zali baɣili nuhi pabu shee maa.
en: Six steps led up to the throne, which had a gold footrest attached. Two lions stood beside the armrests on both sides of the throne.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kul kuhiri boona, di chɛ ka n di vi. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri di vi; chɛ ka bɛ fo baalim n-chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.

dag: A takɔb zuɣu ka a yɛn dira, ka jɛmd a tizo maa. Amaa a yi zaɣis amaŋ zuɣu, a ni yi o sulinsi ni.
en: You will live by the power of your sword and be your brother's slave. But when you decide to be free, you will break loose.

dag: Hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba; amaa lihim ma kaman a padiriba ŋɔ ni yino.
en: I no longer deserve to be called your son. Take me on as one of your hired hands.

dag: ka lan bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla m bia Iso? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: Isaac said, Are you really my son Esau? And he said, I am.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ malaikanim mi polo: Naawuni chɛ ka o malaikanim be kaman pɔhim; ka chɛ ka o tuumba be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: This is what God said about the angels: He changes his angels into winds and his servants into flaming fire. Psalm :.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi deei Naawuni nam kaman bia ni deeri li shɛm ti ku kpe di ni.
en: I assure you that whoever doesnt welcome Gods kingdom like a child will never enter it.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Yisifu. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia tin shɛli din yuli booni Arimatia la nira, ka daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jintɔriba ni yino ŋun nyɛ bilichina ni wundabili.
en: Now there was a man named Joseph who was a member of the council. He was a good and righteous man.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni a mali taali, pa mani n-yɛli. Amaŋmaŋ naŋgbampiba n-di shɛhira jɛnd a.
en: Your mouth condemns you, not I; your lips argue against you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-zahindi wuntizɔriba, nyini n-nyari din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn bɔhi ba biɛri shɛm, dama n zaŋ n yɛla maa niŋla a nuu ni.
en: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.

dag: Naawuni shia n-nam ma, ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ti ma nyɛvili.
en: Gods spirit made me; the Almightys breath enlivens me.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ŋun mali binyɛra ayi, ŋun piimi zaɣ yini ti o kpe so ŋun ka; ka ŋun mi malila bindirigu, ŋun niŋmi lala.
en: He answered, Whoever has two shirts must share with the one who has none, and whoever has food must do the same.

dag: Ninni zaɣ yini daa nyɛla ninsal ninni, ka di ŋmaligi kpa abie tia maa ni be shɛli polo. Ka ninni din la mi nyɛ gbuɣim polli ninni, ka ŋmaligi kpa abie tia din la polo. Bɛ daa ŋme ba pala Naawuni jɛmbu duu dukpina zuɣu zaa gili.
en: a human face that was turned toward the palm tree on one side, and a lion's face that was turned toward the tree on the other side. It was like this all around the wall.

dag: Yi ŋmanila firila dunia ŋɔ ni. Tin shɛli din me n-tam zoli zuɣu mi bi sɔɣira.
en: You are the light of the world. A city on top of a hill cant be hidden.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul mihirila bɛ nina ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛ soya yɛla.
en: The wicked person appears brash, but the virtuous think about the path ahead.

dag: Ka Yisahaku tumtumdiba daa ka o sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o bɛ ni gbi kɔbil shɛli yɛla, ka yɛli, Ti nya kom.
en: On that day Isaacs servants came and told him about the well they had dug. The servants said, We found water in that well.

dag: Ɛliɛza daa nyɛla Finɛhas ba, ka Finɛhas nyɛ Abishua ba.
en: The descendants of Eleazar from generation to generation are as follows: Phinehas, Abishua.

dag: Ka o daa kpab litaafi maa zaŋ li labisi ti jɛmbu duu maa sɔŋda so ŋun ʒe nimaani ka naanyi ʒini. Ka bɛnkam daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni kpaai bɛ nina kpa o.
en: Jesus closed the book, gave it back to the helper, and sat down. As everyone in the synagogue watched him closely.

dag: Yawɛ, n nya wahala pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la.
en: I have been suffering so much— LORD, make me live again according to your promise.

dag: Shɛhira diba ata m-be alizanda ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini bɛ ni booni so Yɛligu la ni Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka bɛba ata ŋɔ nyɛla yino. Ka shɛhira diba ata be dunia ŋɔ ni:.
en: There are three witnesses:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord also told Moses.

dag: Dauda ni daa kurigi ka o dabisa ti pali, o daa zaŋla o bia Sulemaana leei Izraɛlnim naa.
en: David became an old man, so he made his son Solomon the new king of Israel.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu soli ni daa na bi kana, ti daa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ni di gbibi ti hal ti paai yɛda niŋbu soli maa palo yibu saha.
en: But before the time for faith came, the Law kept us all locked up as prisoners until this coming faith should be revealed.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan zaŋ ʒim mihi tanti Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mini binshɛlikam bɛ ni daa mali tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma.
en: In the same way, Moses sprinkled the blood on the Holy Tent. He sprinkled the blood over everything used in worship.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayi ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, bɛ ni lan booni shɛli Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o;.
en: It was now only two days before the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread. The leading priests and teachers of the law were trying to find a way to arrest Jesus without the people seeing it. Then they could kill him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Ɛlim n-chaŋ ti kpe Sin tiŋgban nɛli din daa be Ɛlim mini Sinai sunsuuni la ni gol so ŋun daa pahir ayi bɛ Ijipti yibu maa nyaaŋa biɛɣ pinaanu dali.
en: On the fifteenth day of the second month after the Israelites had escaped from Egypt, they left Elim and started through the western edge of the Sinai Desert in the direction of Mount Sinai.

dag: Amaa m mali piɛ shɛba ka bɛ ka buzɔŋ ŋɔ ni, faashee m bahi zaŋ ba na ka bɛ gba ti baŋ n kukoli, ka di chɛ ka piɛgul yino mini buzɔn yini kɔŋko beni.
en: I have other sheep that dont belong to this sheep pen. I must lead them too. They will listen to my voice and there will be one flock, with one shepherd.

dag: bɛ ni ti mali bihim pam ka o ŋubiri waagasi; dama ŋunkam ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni ti diri waagasi mini shiri.
en: and will eat butter because of the abundance of milk, for all who remain in the land will eat butter and honey.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee ŋun mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, di simdi ni o saɣi ni n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ nyɛla ti Duuma zaligu.
en: If anyone supposes he is God's messenger or has a spiritual gift, he must realize that what I am writing to you is the Lord's command.

dag: A daa fa ba bɛn je ba nuu ni bahi; ka tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: You saved all of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, naa kumdimi ka fabindi Absalom zuɣu.
en: Joab was told that the king was crying and mourning Absalom.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: I call to the Lord , and he saves me from my enemies. Praise the Lord !.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari n-dahim doya, ka bɛ ni daa mali yiko shɛli nyuri bara maa zani tariga; ka Izraɛl zoya zaa ti kpalim zaɣ nɛya hal ka so ku lan gari di gbini.
en: I will make the land an uninhabitable waste. Its proud strength will come to an end, and Israels highlands will become so deserted that no one will cross through them.

dag: Bɛ nina ku nya kulibɔna, kulibɔn shɛŋa din zɔri shiri mini bihim.
en: They wont experience streams, rivers of honey, and brooks of cream.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya m biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni daa zaŋ leei n jɛmbu shee la nti nya n ni daa niŋ li shɛm n niriba Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: You people of Judah, go now to the town of Shiloh. Go to the place where I first made a house for my name. The people of Israel also did evil things. Go and see what I did to that place because of the evil they did.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zunzuya kana ti ŋub bɛ bindira, ka chɛ ka toli kana ti saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: He gave their crops to grasshoppers and their other plants to locusts.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni nyɛ bɛn yi Naawuni ni na maa zuɣu, di bi simdi ni ti tɛhi ni Naawuni ŋmanila buɣ shɛŋa tuumbaŋdiba ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni kuɣa maani bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm puuni la.
en: Thats right. We all come from God. So we must not think that he is like something people imagine or make. He is not made of gold, silver, or stone.

dag: Di kul simdi ni ti chaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi nti mali sara maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa kaman o ni zali ti shɛm maa.
en: We must travel three days into the desert to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, just as he commanded us.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ ka n kuhiri niŋda. Di zaɣisi n kuhigu maa wumbu! Dama a yi shini ma, n ni ŋmanila kpiimba bɛn do gbala ni la.
en: Lord , you are my Rock. I am calling to you for help. Dont close your ears to my prayers. If you dont answer me, I will be counted among the dead.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ bindirigu din mali nyɛvili n-yi alizanda ni na maa. Ka ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; bindiri shɛli mi n ni yɛn zaŋ ti dunianima ka bɛ nya nyɛvili di zuɣu maa nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ.
en: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If you eat this bread, you will live forever. The bread that I will give you is my flesh, which I give so that the world may live.

dag: Ka nimmoo tɔb daa bili dindali maa, ka Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Abinɛr mini Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Then everyone started fighting. Both sides fought very hard, but David's soldiers defeated Abner and the soldiers of Israel.

dag: O yi yɛli, Bu shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ka n yɛn zaŋ yo a, buhi maa zaa ti dɔɣirila bubihi shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi; ka o yi lan yɛli, Bu shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ka n yɛn zaŋ yo a, buhi maa zaa ti dɔɣirila bubihi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma.
en: When your father said the speckled sheep would be my wages, all of them were speckled. And when he said the spotted ones would be mine, all of them were spotted.

dag: O nyari binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa, o nyɛla biŋkɔbiri zaa naa.
en: He looks on all the proud; he is king over all proud beasts.

dag: Yawɛ soya zaa nyɛla yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali soya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib o daalikauli min o zaligunim sani.
en: The Lord is kind and true to those who obey what he said in his agreement.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa chaŋ Tɛbiz ti teei gil li ŋ-ŋme n-deei li.
en: After destroying Shechem, Abimelech went to Thebez. He surrounded the town and captured it.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni n-zaŋ bɛ naba siɣi di kom ni saha shɛli, .
en: When the priests who were carrying the chest came to the Jordan, their feet touched the edge of the water. The Jordan had overflowed its banks completely, the way it does during the entire harvest season.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Kuhimiya bol o yuli ka o sɔŋ ya! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun shɛŋa! Yɛlimiya ba ni o galisiya pam!.
en: At that time you will say, Our Lord , we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ o tumtumdiba ninvuɣ pia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa zɔrila o yiŋnim min o yanim ni o niŋ li wuntaŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa niŋ li la yuŋ.
en: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did what the Lord had told him to do. But Gideon was afraid that his family and the men of the city might see what he was doing, so he did it all at night, not in the daytime.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyari paɣibu a kpiɔŋ zuɣu! Ti ni yili yila paɣ a yiko maa.
en: We praise you, Lord , for your great strength! We will sing and praise your power.

dag: Di saha a mini Lɛvinim ni saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani zaa ni puhi chuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a min a yiŋnim binshɛŋa zaa o nirilim puuni maa zuɣu.
en: Then celebrate all the good things the LORD your God has done for you and your family—each one of you along with the Levites and the immigrants who are among you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa pii fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni ti Lɛvinima kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: So the Israelites gave the Levites the following cities and their pasturelands out of their own legacy. This was in agreement with the LORDs command.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka n dimnim kari doli ma hal ti gbaai ma n-no ma sɔŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ ma pi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: If that is not the truth, then punish me. Let an enemy chase me, catch me, and kill me. Let him grind me into the dirt and put me in my grave. Selah.

dag: Yi chɛ Naawuni zaligunima, ka dolila salinim kaya.
en: You ignore Gods commandment while holding on to rules created by humans and handed down to you.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa bi deei lahibal suŋ maa. Anabi Aizaia bɔhiya, Ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ o ni wum shɛli ti sani maa yɛda.
en: But not all the people accepted that good news. Isaiah said, Lord, who believed what we told them.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi tiri so yiko ka o tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka so mi tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa Shi yino maa yiko ni.
en: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jɔshɛbashɛbɛt Tachɛmɔn nira ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la naa, ŋun daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisinii zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa tɔb tuhibu yim puuni la.
en: These are the names of David's famous soldiers: the first was Josheb Basshebeth from Tachemon, who was the leader of The Three; he fought with his spear against eight hundred men and killed them all in one battle.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti kuhimi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: You, Lord , have made us cry out, as a woman in labor cries out in pain.

dag: Kawana bee chi sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ti zaŋ li mali sara Yawɛ sani sara maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: The following are the regulations for grain offerings. An Aaronite priest shall present the grain offering to the Lord in front of the altar.

dag: Yawɛ ni sabi niriba maa yuya sɔŋ. O ni sabi, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: The LORD makes a record as he registers the peoples: Each one was born there. Selah.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa paligi Sulemaana ni suhi binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.

dag: M bɔhirila n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tam n yɛla? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?.

dag: Dama ti yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa daa kpiya ka lan neei yaha, ti lan niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn gbihiri kum ni la ti doli ti Duuma Yisa labina.
en: We believe that Jesus died, but we also believe that he rose again. So we believe that God will raise to life through Jesus any who have died and bring them together with him when he comes.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Yaakubu, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini Bɛtɛl, ka me sara maligu bimbini zali man Naawuni ŋun daa yi a zuɣu saha shɛli a ni daa yi a biɛli Iso sani zɔri la.
en: God said to Jacob, Get up, go to Bethel, and live there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you ran away from your brother Esau.

dag: O saa nyaɣisibu neesim neeri dunia ŋɔ ni; ka dunianim nyari li ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: His lightning flashes in the sky. The earth sees it and trembles with fear.

dag: Amaa a zuɣu, bɛ kul kuri ti mi dabisili kam, ka niŋdi ti kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: But it is on your account that we are being killed all the time, that we are treated like sheep to be slaughtered.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa la o ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni liɣiri tɔhibu shee la; amaa ka so daa bi gbaag o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: Jesus said all this as he taught in the Temple, in the room where the offering boxes were placed. And no one arrested him, because his hour had not come.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa yi kul chaŋ napɔŋ yaabu buyɔbu zuɣu, o chɛrimi ka bɛ zani ka o kɔrigi naɣilaa mini naɣilalantabili mali sara.
en: Whenever those bearing the chest advanced six steps, David sacrificed an ox and a fatling calf.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka tarimba mali tahima, ka putɔɣunim fo bɛ noya.
en: so the poor have hope and violence shuts its mouth.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣisi mir o ba Yisahaku, ka o shih o ka yɛli, Kukoli ŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu kukoli, amaa nuhi ŋɔ nyɛla Iso nuhi.
en: So Jacob approached his father Isaac, and Isaac touched him and said, The voice is Jacobs voice, but the arms are Esaus arms.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka lan nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ piligu, mani n-lan nyɛ bahigu. Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: The Lord is the king of Israel. The Lord All-Powerful is the one who will set Israel free. And he says, I am the only God. There are no other gods. I am the Beginning and the End.

dag: Filistia nanim mini bɛ niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi tuhilituhili ni daa ti garita, ka Dauda min o niriba pahi Akishi n-doli nyaaŋa na.
en: The five Philistine kings marched out with their units of a hundred and of a thousand men; David and his men marched in the rear with King Achish.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ n taba kaman bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm. N ni niŋ ba yo bɛ ni niŋ shɛm samli.
en: Dont say, Ill do to them what they did to me. Ill pay them back for their actions.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku be kaman bɛ yaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tipawumlinim mini duŋtaariba ʒiɛmani niriba la. Bɛ daa nyɛla ʒiɛman shɛli niriba bɛn bi ʒe yim bɛ suhuri ni. Bɛ daa lan nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim.
en: and so that they wont become like their ancestors: a rebellious, stubborn generation, a generation whose heart wasnt set firm and whose spirit wasnt faithful to God.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa baŋ ni yɛlli ka bɛ nya maa, bɛ ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kul ŋmam bilichiisi maa kaman bɛ ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga dabisili kam la zuɣu.
en: The foremen realized that they were in trouble when they were told that they had to make the same number of bricks every day as they had made before.

dag: N ni kana ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tipawumli nim ŋɔ n-fiɛb ba. Ka n yi ti fiɛb ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri buyi maa zuɣu, zuliya shɛb ni laɣisi tab na ti liri ba.
en: I will come and punish them; nations will be gathered against them when they are punished for their double crime.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima, ka a tahima maa ni niŋ pali.
en: then you will have a future, and your hope wont be cut off.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o zilinli ti anab Neetan ka o kana m-mi ti boli bia maa yuli Jɛdidia; di gbinni nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri so.
en: and sent Nathan the prophet to tell David, The Lord will call him Jedidiah.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ni sokam zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, amaa Naawuni tiri sokam la pin kɔŋkɔba ka di saɣisirila o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm; ka so dini be di ko ka chɛ o kpee dini.
en: I wish all people were like me, but each has a particular gift from God: one has this gift, and another has that one.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Kulimi ni suhudoo.
en: Jesus said to the woman, You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace.

dag: A ni ti zaŋla ninsal bindi mali buɣim n-she chi bɔrɔbɔro maa ŋ-ŋub li bɛ ninni.
en: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti nahiŋgu mini ti wahala dibu puuni, ti nya suhukpaŋsibo yi zuɣu. Yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri ti.
en: So, brothers and sisters, we are encouraged about you because of your faith. We have much trouble and suffering, but still we are encouraged.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dapuhi maa n-tuntu ban shɛŋa din daa be sara maligu bimbini maa luɣa zuɣu la ni, ka bɛ mal li kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa. O daa zaŋla taabo dari mal li, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu.
en: He put the poles through the rings so that the poles were on the two sides of the altar when it was carried. He made the altar with planks but hollow inside.

dag: ka yɛli ni di simdi ka bɛ wuhi Judanima ni di sabi Jashar litaafi puuni yɛli.
en: and ordered it to be taught to the people of Judah.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna. Zaŋm a tulaale tuɣindi labila m-mooi buɣim bimbini zuɣu niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ li chaŋ niriba maa sani yomyom ti mali sara ti ba, dama Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka alɔbo pun piligi.
en: and Moses said to Aaron, Take the censer, put fire from the altar on it, place incense on it, go quickly to the community, and seek reconciliation for them. Indeed, the LORDs anger has gone out. The plague has begun.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisinahi.
en: There are , men in his division.

dag: A zaŋ pɔhim leeg a tuumba, ka zaŋ buɣim mini buɣim niɛm leeg a tumtumdiba.
en: You make the winds your messengers; you make fire and flame your ministers.

dag: M bɔhiri ya, Masia pirigimi ʒii bu shɛm? Pool ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli yi zuɣu la? Bee Pool yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya?.
en: Christ has been divided into groups! Was it Paul who died on the cross for you? Were you baptized as Paul's disciples?.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Chɛ ka di niŋ lala pumpɔŋɔ, dama di simdi ni ti tum din ni chɛ ka Naawuni ni zali shɛm zaa niŋ pali. Di saha ka Jɔn daa saɣi ka baptaiz o.
en: Jesus answered, For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do. Then John agreed.

dag: Ŋuna n-simdi yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: All power is his forever. Amen.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim din zaa kpalim min anabinim yɛligu zaa tamla zaligunima ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: All the Law and the Prophets depend on these two commands.
