dag: Mɔab wurimya, ka Mɔabnim kuhira, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ni vi. Dinzuɣu Mɔabnim leela bɛ ni yɛn maani shɛb ansarisi, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa dabiɛm.
en: Moab lies broken! Listen to its people cry as they turn away in shame. Other nations are horrified at what happened, but still they mock her.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti chɛ ka dimdi kpe Abimilɛk mini Shɛkɛmnim sunsuuni, ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa.
en: Abimelech had killed Gideons sons—and they were his own brothers. The leaders of Shechem had supported him in doing this evil thing. So God caused trouble between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem. And they began planning ways to hurt Abimelech.

dag: Miriya ka yi muɣisi sana, dama yi mi sana suhu ni be shɛm, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: You must never do wrong things to a foreigner. Remember, you know what it is like to be a foreigner because at one time you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Alizin birigu maa ni daa nya Yisa ka o dii yiɣisi bia maa, ka o lu m-bilinda, ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋar o noli.
en: They brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a fit. He fell on the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

dag: A yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, nyin zaŋmi li lo n-tabili kuɣili n-zaŋ li ti bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili sunsuuni.
en: After you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates River.

dag: man Yawɛ ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a biŋkɔbiri bɛn be mɔɣu ni min a yuri ni a bunsi ni laakuma ni a niɣi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu zaa zuɣu.
en: then the Lord will use his power against your animals in the fields. He will cause all of your horses, donkeys, camels, cattle, and sheep to get sick with a terrible disease.

dag: Dama a nyɛla tarimba ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be nandahima ni ni sɔɣiri so sani. A sani ka bɛ ni be ka sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli, ka wuntaŋ tulim gba ku paai ba. Putɔɣunim ni daa liriti niriba kaman kikaa saha sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in distress, a hiding place from the storm, a shade from the heat. When the breath of tyrants is like a winter storm.

dag: Amaa ka wuntizɔriba bɛn kul gbibi be wuntizɔbo soli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi viɛla kul nyari yaa pahira.
en: The innocent clings to his way; the one whose hands are clean grows stronger.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi niriba ŋaha yɛli.
en: Jesus used some more stories to teach the people. He said.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawuni, ka kɔrinsi kana ti lu bɛ suɣa maa gbini luɣ shɛlikam zaa. N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka maligim lu suɣa maa shee.
en: That evening, flocks of quail came and filled the camp, and in the morning dew lay on the ground all around it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chamiya gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yihi tiliginsim lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti sokam.
en: He said to them, Go into the whole world and proclaim the good news to every creature.

dag: Ka Samaria paɣ maa bɔh o, Di chaŋ wula ka nyin Yɛhudia nir ti suhiri man Samaria paɣ kom? Dama Yɛhudianim bi saɣiri ka bɛ mini Samarianim laɣindi timdi dira.
en: The woman answered, I am surprised that you ask me for a drink! You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman.

dag: ka kuhi pam kaman gbuɣinli ni yi ŋum shɛm la. O ni daa kuhi maa, ka satahins ayopɔin tahi.
en: He shouted loudly like the roaring of a lion. After he shouted, the voices of seven thunders spoke.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Jɔshua, Amaŋmaŋ nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ nanim ayi ŋɔ shɛm zaa, lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn garina shɛb tinsi ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: It was at that same time that I commanded Joshua: You saw everything that the LORD your God did to these two kings. That is exactly what the LORD will do to all the kingdoms where youre going!.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala ti ninsalitali biɛhigu la sandiriba ni ti doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu maa yubu ni wuhiri ti shɛm;.
en: So, my brothers and sisters, we must not be ruled by our sinful selves. We must not live the way our sinful selves want.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a wuntitali biɛhigu la zuɣu, karimi saria n-ti ma nasara; di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma.
en: Establish justice for me according to your righteousness, LORD, my God. Dont let them celebrate over me.

dag: Ka do so yi bi yuri ka di bin kasi maa, ŋun bom di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ bin kasi maa ti ti maligumaana.
en: If any people who are not members of a priestly family eat any of the sacred offerings without intending to, they must repay the priest its full value plus an additional percent.

dag: Ka yi yi ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, yin nyomiya li buɣim kaman Naawuni ni zali ya shɛm. N ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Then set it on fire, as the Lord has told us to do. Those are your orders.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini, ka zaŋ Olivi tihi kpam din viɛli lita yini ŋ-ŋmiri li mali chi sara.
en: each with a grain offering of pounds of flour, mixed with pints of the best olive oil.

dag: Bɛ kul tuhirila bɛ karimbaan yɛtɔɣa bahira, tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul nyurila bara.
en: All of those cruel people strut and boast.

dag: Ka kum yi ti lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee alɔbo bee bimbilima dɔriti yi ti lu bee toli bee zunzuya yi ti saɣindi bindira, ka bɛ dimnim yi ti kana ti teei gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tin shɛli nima bee muɣisigu shɛlikam bee dɔro balibu kam yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu;.
en: When there is famine in the land or an epidemic or the crops are destroyed by scorching winds or swarms of locusts, or when your people are attacked by their enemies, or when there is disease or sickness among them.

dag: Wuntia soli dolibu shiri nyɛla azichi din galisi, nir ŋun dee nini yi tiɣi o ni mali shɛli;.
en: Actually, godliness is a great source of profit when it is combined with being happy with what you already have.

dag: Amaa di lee nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din ŋmani bin chɔɣima la nyɛla din ku tooi kɔŋ niŋgbuŋ ni;.
en: No, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are actually very important.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam dindali maa ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli n yiŋa.
en: David became afraid of the Lord that day, and he said, How can I bring Gods Holy Box here now.

dag: ka Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya zuɣulana.
en: Eliab, Helons son, commanded the military of the tribe of Zebulun.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha nti ku o. Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ ba?.
en: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. Jesus asked, What do you think the owner of the vineyard will do?.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, ŋubimi n ni zaŋ gban shɛli ti a ŋɔ pali a puli. Di saha ka n daa ŋub li, ka di nyaɣisi n noli ni kaman shiri la.
en: He said to me: Human one, feed your belly and fill your stomach with this scroll that I give you. So I ate it, and in my mouth it became as sweet as honey.

dag: amaa lee niŋmiya lala la biɛribaalimtali mini sizuura lubu puuni. Kul chɛliya ka yi suhuri ni tɛha ku mali galimi, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi ya ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri yi biɛrisuntali yi ni doli Masia la zuɣu di vi.
en: but do it with gentleness and respect. Keep your conscience clear, so that when you are insulted, those who speak evil of your good conduct as followers of Christ will become ashamed of what they say.

dag: A daa zaŋ nam tiŋgbana mini niriba ti ba, ka daa zaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei Hɛshibɔn din daa nyɛ Naa Sihɔn tiŋgbɔŋ la mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ la su.
en: You gave them kingdoms and peoples, and assigned to them every side. They took possession of the land of King Sihon of Heshbon and the land of King Og of Bashan.

dag: Mbusim be yinim gba zuɣu sokam yi ti paɣiri ya saha shɛli, dama lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anab ʒirinim la.
en: How bad it is when everyone says nothing but good about you. Just look at the false prophets. Their ancestors always said good things about them.

dag: ka zaŋ a nubil suɣi naɣilaa maa ʒim n-zaŋ niŋ sara maligu bimbini binyila la; ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la lɔŋni.
en: Then take some of the bulls blood and go to the altar. Use your finger to put some blood on the horns of the altar. Pour out all the blood that is left at the bottom of the altar.

dag: O ti zaŋm ba na ti ti maligumaana, ka o ti daŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maa malibu. O ti ŋmɛlimi kabi ŋmani maa nyiŋgoli, amaa o di ti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu.
en: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head.

dag: m-mali Naawuni jilima, ka nyɛlisiri kaman bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la, ka lan ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The city was shining with the glory of God. It was shining bright like a very expensive jewel, like a jasper. It was clear as crystal.

dag: ni Hɛfɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛkɛra nir la ni Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ pɛlɔn nir la.
en: Hepher the Mekerathite; Ahijah the Pelonite;.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun ni nyu Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain shɛli o ni booi niŋ o suhuyiɣisili pipia ni ka binshɛli bi pilisi di ni la. Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ chilibi buɣim n-nahim dilana malaika kasinim mini Piɛbil la tooni.
en: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ gɔhi n-wuɣi zuɣupiligu zaŋ pili Yisa, ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di yɛra, N na nyɛla bia, dama a ni chaŋ n ni tim a ni a chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa sani nti yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛlim ba shɛlikam.
en: The LORD responded, Dont say, Im only a child. Where I send you, you must go; what I tell you, you must say.

dag: Ninsalinim mi lee nyɛla bɔ, ka a tibigi ba pam, ka zaŋ a zaŋsim niŋ bɛ ni.
en: God, why are people so important to you? Why do you even notice them?.

dag: Pool mini niriba anahi maa ni daa mali bɛmaŋa ka di ti miri daba ayopɔin paabu saha shɛli ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na nya Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-gbaag o n-chɛ ka niriba suhuri yiɣisi bahi o zuɣu.
en: When the seven days of purification were almost over, the Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul in the temple. Grabbing him, they threw the whole crowd into confusion by shouting.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi sokam vi, ka siɣisi karimbaannima.
en: Everyone will be disgraced, and all who are proud will be humbled.

dag: Amaa kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi nya ma ni yi nini, amaa ka bi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ do shɛb bɛn bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn bi kuli dɔb la yɛla polo, n ka zaligu shɛli din yi ti Duuma sanna, amaa n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so bɛ ni ni niŋ naani ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo puuni la zuɣu, n ni yɛli ya n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I dont have a command from the Lord about people who have never been married, but Ill give you my opinion as someone you can trust because of the Lords mercy.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ŋun zuɣu ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ lee paai ti ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka di gbaala Jona.
en: Then the men said to each other, We should throw lots to find out why this is happening to us. So the men threw lots. The lots showed that the troubles came to them because of Jonah.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛfɛr mini Ishi ni Ɛliɛl ni Aziriɛl ni Jɛrimia ni Hɔdavia ni Jadiɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛn yuya du, ka bɛ daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba.
en: These were the family leaders from half the tribe of Manasseh: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were all strong, brave, and famous men, and they were leaders in their families.

dag: amaa ka dolila Izraɛl nanim naba n-chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim bi lan ʒe yim kaman Ɛhab ni daa niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bi lan ʒe Naawuni yim la, m-pah a ni daa lan ku a tizɔbihi bɛn so a ka nyɛ a ba bihi la.
en: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord , just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.

dag: Yi ni daa bi jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni suhupiɛlli yi ni mali binshɛɣukam pam la zuɣu.
en: The Lord your God gave you many blessings. But you did not serve him with joy and a glad heart.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun zali ni Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni ni lu. O daa buɣisi li mi. O daa bi chɛ li wurimbu. O chɛ ka pihi mini goma fabili; di zaa bahila yoli.
en: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.

dag: Amaa dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi lan yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ maa ni o daɣiri ni yibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, You are unclean.

dag: Lala ka di daa niŋ ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata m-mali hal ti paai ŋun pah ayopɔin maa.
en: The same thing happened to the second brother, to the third, and finally to all seven.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, amaa o nirilim ŋmanila maligim din lu mɔri zuɣu.
en: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa ŋun tim ma na ni n ti baptaizi niriba kom ni maa n-daa yɛli ma, A yi ti nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi siɣina ti tam so zuɣu, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi baptaizi niriba la.
en: Even I didnt recognize him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water said to me, The one on whom you see the Spirit coming down and resting is the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Bɛ daa birila alikama, ka ti chɛla gɔhi. Bɛ tum tuma ka di wum ba, amaa ka bi nya shɛli. Bɛ yi ti kpuɣi bɛ puri atam, vi ni gbahi ba, Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: My people planted wheat, but gathered weeds; they have worked hard, but got nothing for it. Because of my fierce anger their crops have failed.

dag: ni Nɛbo ni Baalimiɔn ni Sibima; ka bɛ daa ti bɛ ni me tin shɛŋa maa yu pala.
en: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti zaa ni ti kahigi ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi Naawuni.
en: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi piim fɔntins ata maa.
en: This is why I am commanding you as follows: Designate three cities for your use.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn pun tiɣi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama kum ni ti wum ya. Mbusim be yinim bɛn lari pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi ni ti kum ka fabili.
en: How terrible for you who have plenty now, because you will be hungry. How terrible for you who laugh now, because you will mourn and weep.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa, M bɔhiri ya mi, tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali? Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu? Din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li.
en: Then Jesus said to them, I ask you: What does our Law allow us to do on the Sabbath? To help or to harm? To save someone's life or destroy it.

dag: Ka zaŋ ti m-buɣisi ti nachintab bɛn diri nayili bindirigu ka nyuri di binnyura la n-nya ti bebu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ka a yi kpahim ti nya, nyin niŋm tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kaman a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm.
en: Then compare us with the young men who are eating the food of the royal court, and base your decision on how we look.

dag: dindina yi ni nya suhupiɛlli man Yawɛ sani, ka n chɛ ka yi nya jilima dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa; ka chɛ ka yi di n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yab Yaakubu la daanfaani. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: then you will take delight in the LORD. I will let you ride on the heights of the earth; I will sustain you with the heritage of your ancestor Jacob. The mouth of the LORD has spoken.

dag: N zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini la ti Lɛvinima ni di nyɛ bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri.
en: The Lord said, I have given to the Levites every tithe that the people of Israel present to me. This is in payment for their service in taking care of the Tent of my presence.

dag: Bɛ daa shɛla biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yin ni ka lan she biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa din la gba ni. Biŋgolinsi maa daa domi tuhi taba.
en: They put fifty loops on the first piece of the first set and fifty loops matching them on the last piece of the second set.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa lan lab gbi kɔbil shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun gbi o ba Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la, dama Filistianim n-daa ŋar li Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ yu shɛŋa bol kɔbilisi maa la n-lan bol li.
en: Isaac dug out again the wells that were dug during the lifetime of his father Abraham. The Philistines had closed them up after Abrahams death. Isaac gave them the same names his father had given them.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa galisi pam Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi pam kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi dari la.
en: In Jerusalem, the king made silver as common as stones and cedar as common as sycamore trees that grow in the foothills.

dag: amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba ŋub maa, so daa naan ku tooi baŋ ni bɛ zaŋ ba ŋubi, dama bɛ daa na kul gaŋsigaŋsimi, ka be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa yirigi neei.
en: But you couldn't tell it, because these skinny cows were just as skinny as they were before. At once, I woke up.

dag: N kpamd a jaande ni a kul kpalimmi be Ɛfɛsus kaman n ni daa gariti chani Masidɔnia ka yɛl a shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka a kpahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhiri ʒiri wuhibu la zuɣu ni ka bɛ chɛ li.
en: I want you to stay in Ephesus, just as I urged you when I was on my way to Macedonia. Some people there are teaching false doctrines, and you must order them to stop.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛli kumsi, ka nyɛhi nintam a ninni, dama a tuma mali laara. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni labina.
en: The LORD proclaims: Keep your voice from crying and your eyes from weeping, because your endurance will be rewarded, declares the LORD. They will return from the land of their enemy!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Daniɛl ka naa sanna ka naa maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ʒi dab shɛba yi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na yino, ka a yuli booni Daniɛl la?.
en: Daniel was brought at once into the king's presence, and the king said to him, Are you Daniel, that Jewish exile whom my father the king brought here from Judah?.

dag: O nyari binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa, o nyɛla biŋkɔbiri zaa naa.
en: He looks down on even the proudest animals; he is king of all wild beasts.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni kari saria wuhi din be piɛ titali mini piɛ kɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: So the LORD God proclaims to them: I will judge between the fat and the lean sheep.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa yi saha mini zibisim yiko saha m-paai.
en: I was with you every day in the Temple area. Why didnt you try to arrest me there? But this is your time—the time when darkness rules.

dag: Di saha m ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: And Solomon continued, My father David planned to build a temple for the worship of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana, ka bɛ daa yi yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama ni bɛ yiɣi tiŋgban ni du zuɣusaa, kalima din be bɛ luɣili zuɣu maa daa bi ŋmaligira.
en: When the winged creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them. When the winged creatures lifted their wings to ascend above the earth, the wheels remained beside them without swerving.

dag: Dama Dauda mini Asaf saha la kurimbuni maa ni ha, yiliyiiniba toondana daa beni, ka wumpaɣibo mini Naawuni puhigu yila daa beni.
en: From the time of King David and the musician Asaph long ago, the musicians have led songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

dag: Amaa do so ŋun gbib omaŋa ka di bi muɣis o ni o lo amiliya, ka o lo omaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni o ku lo bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti o amiliya, o niŋ din viɛla.
en: But if a man stands firm in his decision, and doesnt feel the pressure, but has his own will under control, he does right if he decides in his own heart not to marry the woman.

dag: N yi yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri, Yinima ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi, ka a bi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri maa ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ninvuɣ biɛri maa ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, amaa bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila a zuɣu.
en: If I announce that an evil person is going to die but you do not warn him to change his ways so that he can save his life, then he will die, still a sinner, and I will hold you responsible for his death.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun nya gballi ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o suhu paligi?.
en: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.

dag: bee kpalua ni bahi mi shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan piɛl shɛli ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi ago shɛli ni bee biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ mali binshɛlikam ni.
en: or on any piece of linen or wool cloth or on leather or anything made of leather.

dag: Ka Mariama daa yɛli, N tibigiri n Duuma n suhu ni.
en: Mary said, With all my heart I glorify the Lord!.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba leei zuliya yini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Izraɛl zoli zuɣu, ka na yino ti nyɛ bɛ zaa naa. Bɛ ti ku lan nyɛ zuliya diba ayi, bɛ mi ti ku lan pirigi n-nyɛ nam buyi.
en: I will make them into a single nation in the land on Israels highlands. There will be just one king for all of them. They will no longer be two nations, and they will no longer be divided into two kingdoms.

dag: ka tim a ba min a ma jilima; ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: respect your father and your mother; and love your neighbor as you love yourself.

dag: N niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ alahichinima ka yɛra, Zaɣ biɛɣu ku niŋ ti shɛli bee m-paai ti la, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: Sinners among my people say, Nothing bad will happen to us. But all of them will be killed with swords.

dag: N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka guli tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: I will rescue you and this city of Jerusalem from the emperor of Assyria, and I will continue to protect the city.

dag: ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa bi kpuɣi li kuli Babilɔn saha shɛl o ni daa gbaai Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin ŋun daa nyɛ Juda Naa la min o kpambaliba zaa ni Jɛrusalɛm kpambaliba zaa kuli Babilɔn la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: He didnt take them away when he took Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah away as a prisoner. Nebuchadnezzar also took other important people away from Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o tuun suma, bɛ sab li niŋla Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli ka di be Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi puuni la.
en: The rest of Hezekiahs deeds, including his faithfulness, are written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah, Amozs son, in the records of Israels and Judahs kings.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n wumpaɣibo pini ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunim la.
en: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.

dag: o chanimi ti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie n-gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani. Di saha dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam gari di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself. They go in and make their home there. That person is worse off at the end than at the beginning.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ya ka a chana? Ka o garigi n-yɛl o, N ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, a ku tooi doli ma pumpɔŋɔ; amaa a ni ti doli ma saha shɛli.
en: Simon Peter asked, Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, You can't go with me now, but later on you will.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N ni du abie tia maa, n-gbaai di wula gbibi. N suhigu nyɛla a biha kul be kaman wain wala yila la, ka a vuhim ʒiɛɣu ŋmani apil nyom.
en: I will climb that tree and cling to its branches. I will discover that your breasts are clusters of grapes, and that your breath is the aroma of apples.

dag: Ti ni daa nya so ka wum o yɛla maa yɛla ka ti yɛri ya maa ni di chɛ ka ti mini ya mali dolintabitali, ka ti mi dolintabitali maa bela ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia Yisa Masia sani.
en: We are telling you about what we have seen and heard because we want you to have fellowship with us. The fellowship we share together is with God the Father and his Son Jesus Christ.

dag: Bee wula ka a ni tooi yɛl a mabia ni o chɛ ka a yihi bimburigin shɛli din be o ninni ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni?.
en: How can you say to your brother or sister, Let me take the splinter out of your eye, when theres a log in your eye?.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli, M pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: Abram answered: The Lord God Most High made the heavens and the earth. And I have promised him.

dag: A nam nyɛla saha din ka bahigu nam, ka a su binshɛɣukam zaa ʒiɛmani kam ni. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim o yɛtɔɣa zaa ni, ka nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma zaa ni.
en: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord , you keep your word and do everything you say.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi; dunianim zaa lumiy o sizuura.
en: Worship the Lord in all his holy beauty. Everyone on earth should tremble before him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini bɛ zaa teensi pirigilipirigili bahi ka chɛ pirigilipirigili, ka daa lan ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu bahi ka chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So Hanun seized Davids servants and shaved off their beards, cut off half their garments, from their buttocks down, and sent them off.

dag: Anab maa daa lan tɔɣisi shihirili shɛli yɛla dindali maa yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shihirili shɛli yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, bimbini ŋɔ, a ni ti wurim, ka tampiligim din pa a zuɣu kpaai bahi.
en: And the prophet went on to say, This altar will fall apart, and the ashes on it will be scattered. Then you will know that the Lord has spoken through me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya, alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa, ninsalinim ni tooi nya di taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani, amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: I tell you any sinful thing you do or say can be forgiven. Even if you speak against the Son of Man, you can be forgiven. But if you speak against the Holy Spirit, you can never be forgiven, either in this life or in the life to come.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, bomiya yɛm. Yinim bɛn ka fahim ŋɔ, bomiya li.
en: Understand skill, you who are naive. Take this to heart, you fools.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana ka yuri wuntia tuma. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi n-nyɛ bɛn ni tooi nya o ni bɛ nini.
en: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.

dag: Dama yi suhuri yi ye di niŋbu zuɣu, Naawuni ni dee li kaman yi ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga zuɣu ka mi ku galim ya yi ni ka shɛli zuɣu.
en: A gift is appreciated because of what a person can afford, not because of what that person cant afford, if its apparent that its done willingly.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa nyɛla wuntizɔriba, ka daa doli ti Duuma Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim mini adiini soli kaya zaa ka ka galimi shɛli.
en: Zechariah and Elizabeth were both good people who pleased God. They did everything the Lord commanded, always following his instructions completely.

dag: Yi yɛm bi yaɣi lala? Yinim bɛn daa piligi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ŋɔ, yi yɛn zaŋla yimaŋmaŋ yiko naai?.
en: How can you be so foolish! You began by God's Spirit; do you now want to finish by your own power?.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka wuntitali be di ni, di so ni nir mali pam ka di bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.

dag: Di saha ka Pool min o tab la daa kpe ŋariŋ yiɣisi Pafɔs n-chaŋ Pɛɛga Pamfilia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Jɔn Maak daa ti zani nimaani ŋ-ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ka chɛ ba.
en: Paul and his companions sailed from Paphos and came to Perga, a city in Pamphylia, where John Mark left them and went back to Jerusalem.

dag: A mabia Sɔdom taali m-bɔŋɔ: O min o bipuɣinsi daa malila karimbaani. Bɛ daa mali bindira pam, ka bɛ nyamma galisi, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔŋdi nandaamba mini bɛn ka.
en: Your sister Sodom and her daughters were proud. They had too much to eat and too much time on their hands, and they did not help poor, helpless people.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana, ka mali laara na ni n ti ti sokam kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm!.
en: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba, ka Sool nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Alizanda nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka dunia ŋɔ nyɛ n naba zaashee. Ka yili bɔ ka yi yɛn me n-ti ma? Ka bee luɣ dini n-lee yɛn nyɛ n vuhibu shee?.
en: The Lord says, Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house, then, could you build for me, what kind of place for me to live in?.

dag: M malaika maa yi ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ya tahi Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Keenannim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n ti ku ba ka chɛ ka yi ʒini nimaani.
en: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.

dag: So yi yuri Naawuni, ŋuna ka Naawuni mi.
en: But if someone loves God, then they are known by God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Samuel.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali tɛhi yini mini yurilim yini, ka mali suhu yini tɛhi yini puuni, ka di chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa.
en: complete my joy by thinking the same way, having the same love, being united, and agreeing with each other.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni bɛ ni kpi mɔɣu maa ni. Bɛ ni so daa bi kpalim, naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun. The Lord had said that everyone else would die there in the desert.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni alizini ka bɛ nya maa.
en: This surprised the followers. They were afraid. They thought they were seeing a ghost.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, N jilima naaya. N ni daa niŋdi binshɛŋa zaa tahima Yawɛ san la naaya.
en: I said to myself, I no longer have any hope that the Lord will help me.

dag: Yuun pisi ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min o nam yil la.
en: It took twenty years for Solomon to build the two structures, the LORDs temple and the royal palace.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tiri ma kpiɔŋ, ka mali n soli ka di tuhi.
en: You give me strength and guide me right.

dag: M mabihi, n suhiri ya, di tumiya tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ.
en: Then he said, Friends, please don't do such a terrible thing!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla o yiko yaɣ shɛli polo, ka ti ni wumd o yɛla shɛm pɔra pam. Amaa o yiko din galisi ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li.
en: But these are only hints of his power, only the whispers that we have heard. Who can know how truly great God is?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa duh o yee bɔhi tɔbbihi maa mini Nɛr bia Abinɛr la, Abinɛr, a ku garigi ma? Ka Abinɛr garigi bɔhi, Nyin ŋuni n-lee booni naa maa.
en: and shouted to Saul's troops and to Abner, Abner! Can you hear me? Who is that shouting and waking up the king? Abner asked.

dag: Ka ti daa ti nya ti nyaandolitab nimaani, ka bɛ yɛli ti ni ti kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayopɔin. Ka ti daa ti yi nimaani chani Rom.
en: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Vuri mɔni Rama, di nyɛla fabila mini kuhigu pam. Reechɛl n-kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni so di maag o suhu o bihi maa zuɣu, dama bɛ lan kani.
en: The Lord says, A sound is heard in Ramah, the sound of bitter weeping. Rachel is crying for her children; they are gone, and she refuses to be comforted.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o pukpar kpɛma, Nyama, zuŋɔ yuma ata m-bɔŋɔ ka n kul kanna ti bɔri tia ŋɔ wala ka bi nyara; dinzuɣu ŋmaam li bahi! Bɔzuɣu ka nir ni chɛ li zali ka di kul nyuri tam yoli.
en: So he said to the gardener, For three years I have come looking for figs on this tree, and I haven't found any yet. Chop it down! Why should it take up space.

dag: Ka Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Rama nir la daa nyɛ ŋun lihiri wain tihi puri, ka Zabidi ŋun daa nyɛ Shifam nir la daa lihiri wain ni be du shɛŋa ni.
en: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ siɣili saha, saha shɛli nanim ni daa chani tɔb la, ka Jɔab daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti saɣim Ammɔnim tiŋgbɔŋ, ka daa chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm. Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ ti lu Raba zuɣu n-wurim li.
en: In the spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out with the army, destroyed the land of the Ammonites, and besieged Rabbah. David stayed in Jerusalem while Joab attacked Rabbah and overthrew it.

dag: O daa lan mali binzahi pia, ka mali taha pia tamtam di zuɣu.
en: ten movable stands; ten small bowls for the stands;.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo mi di daa chaŋmi ti ŋmaligi kpa Hannatɔn polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Ɛfitahɛl Vinvamli ni.
en: The border turned north of Hannathon and ended at the Iphtah-el Valley.

dag: Ninsalinim ni daa ti piligi nabbu dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bipuɣinsi.
en: When the number of people started to increase throughout the fertile land, daughters were born to them.

dag: Yawɛ po o nudirigu din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛli: N ku lan zaŋ yi chi ti yi dimnim ka bɛ di. M mi ku lan chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ yi ni di wahala tɔɣi yi wain shɛli nyu.
en: The LORD has promised with raised hand and strong arm: I will never again give your grain as food for your enemies. Foreigners wont drink your wine for which you labored.

dag: o naan zo dilan nambɔɣu ka yɛli, Famiy o bahi, ka o ku siɣi gballi ni; dama n nya soli ni n fa o bahi.
en: so that God has compassion on that person and says, Rescue this one from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli ka na bi niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni n-niŋ bɛ bɔrɔbɔro shɛr lahi ni n-guri adiikunim ni n-zaŋ pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: The Israelites did not have time to put the yeast in their bread. They just wrapped the bowls of dough with cloth and carried them on their shoulders.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Hɛzɛkia suhigu maa, ka chɛ niriba maa taali, ka bi ku ba.
en: The LORD heard Hezekiah and healed the people.

dag: Di saha ka Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi daa lo tɔbu kana ti do Giliad. Ka Izraɛlnim gba daa laɣim ti do Mizipa.
en: Then the Ammonite army prepared for battle and camped in Gilead. The people of Israel came together and camped at Mizpah in Gilead.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila zuɣupil shɛli din mali jilima be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka lan be kaman nam zuɣupiligu la be a Naawuni nuu ni.
en: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.

dag: Ti zaŋ Naa Ahaz ni daa bi lan ʒe Naawuni yim ka kahi neen shɛŋa zaa la labisi nti mali di zaa ka di niŋ kasi. Nyama di ʒe Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini la tooni.
en: During the time that Ahaz was king, he rebelled against God. He threw away many of the things that were in the Temple. But we repaired all those things and made them ready for their special use. They are now in front of the Lord s altar.

dag: Din ni chɛ ka n tooi nyaŋ niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul tumdi ka mɔra, yiko shɛli Masia ni ti ma ka di tumdi di tuma pam n ni la zuɣu.
en: To do this, I work and struggle using the great strength that Christ gives me. That strength is working in my life.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka suhi Yawɛ yɛli.
en: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn kpa shɛli polo ni ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: May the LORD your God show us where we should go and what we should do.

dag: Di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni ti yɛn di bindirigu tiɣi, ka binshɛli ku pooi ya. Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kuɣa nyɛ kuriti, ka yi ni ti gbiri tahiʒiɛɣu di daboya zuɣu.
en: There you will never go hungry or ever be in need. Its rocks have iron in them, and from its hills you can mine copper.

dag: Sapashinnim maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat bɛ daa yɛlimi, Biɛhiŋ kani, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuh o; ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kuhi pam.
en: As soon as the chariot officers saw Jehoshaphat, they assumed that he must be Israels king, so they turned to attack him. But Jehoshaphat cried out for help.

dag: Fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: These are the commands that the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

dag: A chɛ ka n dabisa bi yaɣ lala. N nyɛvili yuusim pa shɛli a sani. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal kam biɛhigu ŋmanila vuhim.
en: You gave me only a short life. Compared to you, my whole life is nothing. The life of every human is like a cloud that quickly disappears. Selah.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɛ alahichi daba saha shɛl la, wuntia daa bi su yi fukumsi.
en: When you were slaves of sin, you were free from the control of righteousness.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya Naawuni daalibarika tuma, di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o kpam bɛ zaa jaande ni bɛ kul ʒe yim Naawuni sani, ka di birigi.
en: When he arrived and saw evidence of Gods grace, he was overjoyed and encouraged everyone to remain fully committed to the Lord.

dag: ka tam o ni daa wuhi shihir shɛŋa Ijipti la mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni daa tum Zɔan mɔɣu ni la gba yɛla.
en: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.

dag: Nyama, m min a zaa nyɛla yim Naawuni sani. Taŋkpaɣu ka o daa zaŋ nam man gba.
en: You and I are the same in God's sight, both of us were formed from clay.

dag: O pun baai du mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti gbe Gɛba; ka dabiɛm gbaai Ramanima; ka Sool ya Gibianim yi n-zo.
en: They have crossed the pass and are spending the night at Geba! The people in the town of Ramah are terrified, and the people in King Saul's hometown of Gibeah have run away.

dag: Baŋdiba maa ni daa kuli maa ka ti Duuma malaika la ka Yisifu sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ biliɛɣu maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti ʒini nimaani hal ka n ti lan ti a zilinli, dama Naa Hɛrɔd bɔri ni o bola bia maa shee ku o.
en: After they had left, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph and said, Herod will be looking for the child in order to kill him. So get up, take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt, and stay there until I tell you to leave.

dag: N dana, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, n zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din be di ni maa zaa ti a n niriba ŋɔ ninni ni a sɔɣ a kpim maa nimaani.
en: No, sir. Listen, I will give you the field, and I will give you the cave in it. In front of my peoples witnesses, I will give it to you. Bury your dead.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba daa yi Galili n-chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni ni Jɔn ti baptaiz o.
en: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River. He came to John, wanting John to baptize him.

dag: Gaal ni daa nya niriba maa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli Zɛbul, Nyama, niriba n-yiri zoya ŋɔ zuɣu sigirina! Ka Zɛbul garigi yɛl o, Pa niriba m-bala. Zoya maa shilinshihi ka a nya ka di ŋmani ninsalinim maa.
en: and Gaal saw them. Zebul was standing there with Gaal, and Gaal remarked, Zebul, that looks like a crowd of people coming down from the mountaintops. No, Zebul answered, it's just the shadows of the mountains. It only looks like people moving.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so ti Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn ku so, so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, bɛ kul ni ku o mi.
en: If this gift is a person, that person cannot be bought back. That person must be killed.

dag: Ishimail bidibisi yuya kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ ba pa tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛbaiɔt ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Kɛdar ni Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: These are the names of Ishmaels sons: The first son was Nebaioth; then Kedar was born, then Adbeel, Mibsam.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu maa mini alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmanila taba. Di zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini. Maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: The compensation offering is like the purification offering—they share the same Instruction: It belongs to the priest who makes reconciliation with it.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni pam di zuɣu. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa bo niriba pahi Pool mini Baanabas zuɣu n-tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ Yisa tuumba la mini cheechi kpamba bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la sani nti nya ba yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: Paul and Barnabas were against this teaching and argued with these men about it. So the group decided to send Paul, Barnabas, and some others to Jerusalem to talk more about this with the apostles and elders.

dag: Ka nanim daa kana Taanak Mɛgido kulibɔŋ la ni ti tuhi tɔbu. Ka Keenan nanim daa tuhi, amaa ka bi di nɛma din nyɛ anzinfa.
en: Canaanite kings fought us at Taanach by the stream near Megiddo — but they couldn't rob us of our silver.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛm mini wuhibu yɛla bɔhimbu din ni sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ ashili yɛtɔɣa baŋbu polo.
en: They will help you learn to be wise, to accept correction, and to understand wise sayings.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be kasi sani, binshɛɣukam nyɛla din be kasi; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu bi be kasi ka nyɛ bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, binshɛli kani n-nyɛ din be kasi, dama bɛ suhuri ni tɛha malila daɣiri.
en: Everything is pure to those who are themselves pure; but nothing is pure to those who are defiled and unbelieving, for their minds and consciences have been defiled.

dag: Ka o daa ti laɣim o tumtumdiba mini bɛn mini ba tuma nyɛ tuun yinsi na nti yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni ti nyarila liɣiri ti tuma ŋɔ ni.
en: So he called them all together with others whose work was like theirs and said to them, Men, you know that our prosperity comes from this work.

dag: ni Danna ni Kiriatisɛfa.
en: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah.

dag: Gbansabiriba zuliya bɛn daa ʒi Jabɛz n-daa nyɛ: Tiratinim mini Shimiatinim ni Sukatinima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Kɛnnim bɛn daa yi Hammat na, ka bɛ yabidoo daa nyɛ Rɛkab la.
en: and the families of scribes who lived at Jabez, Tirath, Shimeath, and Sucah. These scribes are the Kenites who came from Hammath. Hammath was the founder of Beth Recab.

dag: Di daa tuhiya ni Naawuni ŋun nam shɛlikam ka nyɛ ŋun gbib binshɛɣukam ŋɔ chɛ ka Yisa be tibi o wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ Naawuni bihi pam ka bɛ min o ti laɣim nya jilima; dama Yisa n-nyɛ bɛ toondana ŋun tahiri ba tiliginsim shee.
en: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, ka yi yi bɔri ba din viɛli niŋbu, yi ni tooi niŋ ba saha shɛlikam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have the poor with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.

dag: Ka Tomas bɔh o, N Duuma, ti bi mi a ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka wula ka ti ni tooi baŋ di soli.
en: Thomas said, Lord, we dont know where you are going, so how can we know the way.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi. O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino jɛm o ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: No servant can be the slave of two masters; such a slave will hate one and love the other or will be loyal to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A nyɛla ŋun gbib ma wahala ni, ka chɛ ka faako yila gili ma.
en: You are my secret hideout! You protect me from trouble. You surround me with songs of rescue! Selah.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛl o yɛla shɛm la niŋ pali, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Omaŋmaŋ n-daa deei ti niŋgbun biisim mini ti dɔriti zaa ʒi.
en: So Jesus made clear the full meaning of what Isaiah the prophet said: He took away our diseases and carried away our sicknesses. Isaiah :.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa o ni ʒina ka di nyɛ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa. Ka so n-daa bi ti Naa Sulemaana tulaale ka di galisi paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa ti o tulaale shɛli maa.
en: The queen gave the king one hundred twenty kikkars of gold, a great quantity of spice, and precious stones. Never again has so much spice come to Israel as when the queen of Sheba gave this gift to King Solomon.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun miligi naa suhu, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: An angry king is like a roaring lion. If you make him angry, you could lose your life.

dag: bɔzuɣu ka nyini zo shɛli dim mali chunchuna ŋɔ lihiri Naawuni ni bɔri ni zo shɛli nyɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ nyuli zabbu lihigu? Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bɔri ni o be sahakam.
en: But, Bashan, why are you jealous of Mount Zion? That is where God has chosen to live. The Lord will live there forever.

dag: Apil tia ni be nyɔŋ tihi sunsuuni shɛm la, lala ka n yura be nachimba sunsuuni. N yur o mahim ʒinibu ka o wala nyaɣisi pam n sani.
en: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my dearest compared to other men. I love to sit in its shadow, and its fruit is sweet to my taste.

dag: Dama alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yɔhim ma ku ma di zuɣu.
en: Sin found its chance, and by means of the commandment it deceived me and killed me.

dag: Ka Iso daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka n ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa daliri lee nyɛla dini? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N zaŋ ba mi na ni n ti ti a m-maai nyini n dan suhu.
en: Esau said, Whats the meaning of this entire group of animals that I met? Jacob said, To ask for my masters kindness.

dag: Dama n niriba ŋɔ tibidarigibo maa galisi gari Sɔdomnim tibidarigibo la, din daa wurim nini pɔbbu ni neebu ka so nuu daa bi shihi li la.
en: The sin of the daughter of my people was very great. Their sin was greater than the sins of Sodom and Gomorrah. Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed suddenly. No human hand caused their destruction.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka saa miri ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli mini tiŋgban nɛli ni din nyɛ daadamnim ni ka luɣ shɛli?.
en: to bring water to uninhabited land, a desert with no human.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan lihi nya do so ka o gbib bimbuɣisirigu o nuu ni.
en: Then I looked up and saw a man holding a rope for measuring things.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔŋ ni, duri daa be nimaani ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali gili di dundɔŋ maa zaa. Duri pihita n-daa be bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali luɣ shɛli maa tooni.
en: Then the man led me into the outer courtyard. I saw thirty rooms and a pavement that went all the way around the courtyard. The rooms were along the wall and faced in toward the pavement.

dag: Ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o yiŋa kana ti zan o sani ni bɛ kpuɣ o yiɣisi, amaa ka o bi saɣi bee n-chɛ ka o mini ba laɣim ʒini di bindirigu.
en: His court officials went to him and tried to make him get up, but he refused and would not eat anything with them.

dag: Sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa pah ata n-su gol so ŋun pah ata ni n-daa nyɛ maligumaana Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya, o daa nyɛla kpɛma. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The third commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the leading priest. There were , men in Benaiahs group.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa ti giri zaŋ chaŋ Amnɔn kum maa polo, o ni daa nya ka o lan kani maa zuɣu, ka o suhu lan yu ni o kari Absalom naba.
en: Then the kings desire to go out after Absalom faded away because he had gotten over Amnons death.

dag: Ka Ibram daa be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Lɔt mi be vinvamli maa ni fɔntinsi ni, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-zaŋ o tanti suɣili chaŋ ti kpa Sɔdom.
en: Abram settled in the land of Canaan, and Lot settled near the cities of the valley and pitched his tent close to Sodom.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya salo maa, ka o du zoli zuɣu ti ʒini, ka o nyaandoliba laɣim gil o.
en: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he went up a mountain. He sat down and his disciples came to him.

dag: O chɛ ka goli mini saŋmarisi su yuŋ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He made the moon and stars to rule the night. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni chɛ ka bɛ zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: If I promise to make a nation strong.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yi vihiri ti mi ni yi baŋ tuun sun shɛli din sa tum ti gbarigu ŋɔ ka o kpaŋ maa.
en: are you questioning us today about what we did to help this crippled man? Are you asking us what made him well?.

dag: Ti ni mali salima mini anzinfa yɛri ti a.
en: But we will make for you a chain of gold with ornaments of silver.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara n-yo o min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli.
en: Aaron will offer the bull as a purification offering to make reconciliation for himself and his household.

dag: saha shɛl o firila ni daa ne n zuɣusaa, ka n dol o firila maa neesim gari zibisim ni la.
en: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu ni wuhiri shɛm m-bala.
en: Do for others what you want them to do for you: this is the meaning of the Law of Moses and of the teachings of the prophets.

dag: Ka o daa ʒiya n-wumdi Pool waazu, ka Pool ti mirig o nina kpa o n-nya ka o mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: He was sitting and listening to Paul speak. Paul looked straight at him and saw that the man believed God could heal him.

dag: Ka Judanim daa yɛli, Ʒiʒiriba gbarigiya; ka saɣiri pam mi beni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti kɔŋ gooni maa mɛbu.
en: But in Judah it was said, The carriers strength is failing, for there is too much rubble. We are unable to rebuild the wall.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Tishibi nir la, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti tuhi Samaria naa tuumba ŋɔ soli m-bɔhi ba, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka yi ti chanila Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la sani ni a ti bɔh o nya.
en: But the Lord s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, King Ahaziah has sent some messengers from Samaria. Go meet those men and ask them, There is a God in Israel, so why are you men going to ask questions of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu mini buŋa n-tabili taba ni bɛ ko.
en: Dont plow with an ox and a donkey together.

dag: n-kpe Zakaria yiŋ ti puhi Ɛlizabɛt.
en: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa bi paligi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu, ka o daa darigi Izraɛlnim tibili.
en: God was displeased with what had been done, so he punished Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka timaŋmaŋ kul nyuri bara yi zuɣu Naawuni cheechinim ni. Ti niŋdila lala yi ni mali ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛda niŋbu yi daalaka nyabu mini yi wahala dibu puuni la zuɣu.
en: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa wuɣi du zuɣusaa. N ni daa nya binneen shɛba Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la m-bala.
en: When the creatures rose in the air.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm dahin shɛli n ni daa tuui ka Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na nti be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: When they got there, he said: You know everything I did during the time I was with you when I first came to Asia.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani, dama mani n-chɛ ka o min o kpambaliba zaa suhuri kpɛma ni di chɛ ka n tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ bɛ sani.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Go to Pharaoh. Ive made him and his officials stubborn so that I can show them my signs.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirim ma na.
en: Jesus said to the man with the crippled hand, Stand up here so that everyone can see you.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaanahi daa gbaai Matitia min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Fourteenth, there were men chosen from Mattithiahs sons and relatives.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoon jɛra ŋɔ, bina ayi ŋɔ dini n-lee gari di kpee: Salima maa bee Naawuni jɛmbu duu din chɛ ka salima maa be kasi maa?.
en: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka bɛ daa bi sɔɣi ma kaman bɛ ni dɔɣi bi so zaɣ kpiŋ la, bee kaman biliɛ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-nya neesim la?.
en: or sleeping like a stillborn child.

dag: Nooŋa ni yiɣiri gind o tiɛɣu shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni guli Jɛrusalɛm. O ni fa li bahi, ka gul li.
en: Like birds flying aloft, so the LORD of heavenly forces will shield Jerusalem: shielding and saving, sparing and rescuing.

dag: O chɛ ka buɣim sal nɛma mini chilibi buɣim kul luri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu; ka zaŋdi pɔhim tulli darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.

dag: Nyini n-tiri nanim nasara, ka fa a dabili Dauda bahi.
en: to you—the one who gives saving help to rulers, and who rescues his servant David from the evil sword.

dag: A tinsi din be kasi la mini Ziɔn leela dabari. Ka Jɛrusalɛm leei bɛ ni zo ka chɛ tin shɛli.
en: Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a wasteland.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya kam ni dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa nimaani, yi mini yi yaannim ni daa pun bi mi buɣ shɛŋa.
en: The LORD will scatter you among every nation, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will serve other gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known—gods of wood and stone.

dag: Ka o daa be zuɣusaa ha, ka tirina gbaai ma n-voo ma yihi ko tital ni na.
en: He reached down from above and grabbed me. He pulled me from the deep water.

dag: N ni yaai n noli ni suhupiɛlli saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn yili yila paɣ a. N shia din nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛl la gba ni yili yila paɣ a.
en: I will shout for joy as I play for you; with my whole being I will sing because you have saved me.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mani m-bɔŋɔ; di pun sabi n yɛla Kundi ni.
en: And so, I said, I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says.

dag: Di saha maa n ni ti yɛli ba, Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, m bi min ya. Wariya! .
en: Then Ill tell them, Ive never known you. Get away from me, you people who do wrong.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa lu Jɔash suhu ni ni o lan malimali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: After he had been king for a while, Joash decided to have the Temple repaired.

dag: O zuliya daa bela Havila mini Shur luɣ shɛli din daa tuhi Ijipti dɛde zaŋ labi Asiria polo la. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti be ka chɛ Ibrahimma zuliya bɛn zaa kpalim la.
en: His descendants settled throughout the desert area from Havilah to Shur. This area begins near Egypt and goes toward Assyria. Ishmaels people were often at war with the other descendants of Abraham.

dag: Ti Duuma yi di bi filim di dabisa maa, so naan ti ku tiligi; amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn nyɛ o ni pii shɛb la zuɣu, o filim di dabisa maa.
en: But the Lord has decided to make that terrible time short. If it were not made short, no one could survive. But the Lord will make that time short to help the special people he has chosen.

dag: Ka a lan zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn nya Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam la ni pin shɛŋa niriba maa mini maligumaaniba ni ti ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni di zaŋ tum bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la tuma gba mali chaŋ.
en: You are also to take all the silver and gold which you collect throughout the province of Babylon and the offerings which the Israelite people and their priests give for the Temple of their God in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Bɛrɛkia mini Ɛlikana daa nyɛ Alikauli Adaka duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the chest.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi yɛli teeku ni di nyuuma. N ni chɛ ka yi mɔɣa kom nyuui.
en: With a word of command I dry up the ocean.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi n dan maa, Ka paɣ yi ti bi saɣi n-doli ma na.
en: I said to my master, What if the woman wont come back with me.

dag: ka yɛli ba, N yi ti paai sansani maa shee, yin lihimiya ma ka niŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Gideon said, When we get to the enemy camp, spread out and surround it. Then wait for me to blow a signal on my trumpet. As soon as you hear it, blow your trumpets and shout, Fight for the Lord ! Fight for Gideon! .

dag: Dindali maa ka yi ni ti baŋ ni n shiri be m Ba ni, ka yi mi be n ni, ka n gba be yi ni.
en: On that day you will know that I am in the Father. You will know that you are in me and I am in you.

dag: ni Hazɔrihadata ni Kiriɔtihɛzirɔn.
en: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron .

dag: Ɛlam daŋ ni: Matania mini Zakaria ni Jɛhiɛl ni Abidi ni Jɛrɛmɔt ni Ɛlia.
en: Of the family of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka o nyu n-naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan yɛl o, N ni ŋɔŋ kom ti a laakumnim ŋɔ ka bɛ gba nyu hal ti tiɣi.
en: After he had finished, she said, Now I'll give your camels all the water they want. She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.

dag: Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna ni bɛ su li. Pina sara shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi mali nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la n-daa nyɛ bɛ tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: It was only to the tribe of Levi that he gave no legacy. Their legacy consists of the fire offerings for the LORD, the God of Israel, exactly as he had promised them.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka tiŋ maa niriba zaŋ suhi din mali nyina mini kuriti kuya ni kuriti lɛri n-tumd o tuma, ka ŋmar o bilichiisi; lala ka o daa niŋ Ammɔnnim tinsi maa zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda min o niriba maa zaa daa lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He brought out the people who were in the city and put them to work making bricks. David demolished the city with saws, iron picks, and axes; he did this to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all the troops returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Yawɛ tooni na.
en: Moses brought their case before the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria nanim pun saɣim zuliya pam tiŋgbɔna.
en: Its true, LORD, that the Assyrian kings have destroyed many nations and their lands.

dag: Di bemi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm o litaafi ni la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi.
en: As it is written in the book of the prophet Isaiah: Someone is shouting in the desert: Get the road ready for the Lord; make a straight path for him to travel!.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti o Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a binshɛŋa zaa la ni shɛli. A ni tooi piig a biŋkɔbbaligu ti o bee a puu atam bee a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain ti o ni a suhu zaa.
en: Instead, provide for them fully from your flock, food, and wine. You must give to them from that with which the LORD your God has blessed you.

dag: O ni ti nyu bara o nasara dibu maa min o ni gbahi tɔbbihi pam ku ba zuɣu, amaa o kul ku nyɛ ŋun diri nasara sahakam.
en: The northern army will be defeated, and those soldiers will be carried away. The southern king will be very proud, and he will kill thousands of soldiers from the northern army. But he will not continue to be successful.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi dari chah o binyɛra, ka teei dɔni tiŋgban ni ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o sani gba dari chahi bɛ binyɛra.
en: The king stood up, tore his clothes in sorrow, and threw himself to the ground. The servants who were there with him tore their clothes also.

dag: bahim ba yoli a suhuyiɣisili puuni; bahim ba yoli zaa. Ka dunianim zaa baŋ ni Naawuni n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Destroy them in your anger. Destroy them completely! Then people all over the world will know that God rules over the people of Jacob. Selah.

dag: Amaa ka Sool ŋun yiko daa kul pahirimi, ka o kahigiri wuhiri ni Yisa nyɛla Masia; ka o yɛligu maa daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Damaskus maa birim.
en: But Saul grew stronger and stronger. He confused the Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yidaampaɣ maŋli? O gari salima.
en: How hard it is to find a capable wife! She is worth far more than jewels!.

dag: ka di puuni zahim zaa kpi n-niŋ di kom maa ni ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim kɔŋ li nyubu. .
en: The fish will die, the river will stink, and none of you Egyptians will be able to drink the water.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Diblaim bipuɣiŋga Goma ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So Hosea went and took Gomer, Diblaims daughter, and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

dag: Ka n zaŋ o tah a nyaandoliba ŋɔ sanna, ka bɛ bi tooi tib o.
en: I brought him to your followers, but they could not heal him.

dag: A ni mi shɛli, n gba mi li. M pala ŋun pooi daadam a sani.
en: I know as much as you do. I am as smart as you are.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ Ziɔn, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Bless the LORD from Zion— bless the one who lives in Jerusalem! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kul o ya Jɛrusalɛm ni alaafee.
en: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Yisa nyaandoliba maa ansarisi yɛra, Bɛ nyula dam kuli.
en: But others were laughing at the apostles, saying they were drunk from too much wine.

dag: Doo miri ka o kpuɣ o ba paɣa n-filim o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o nya o ba zaɣim.
en: No man is to disgrace his father by having intercourse with any of his father's wives.

dag: Ka n nya ka wɔr ʒiɛɣu yina pahi, ka bɛ daa niŋ ŋun bar o maa yiko, ka ti o takɔb titali ni o yihi suhudoo dunia ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka daadamnim ku taba.
en: Then another horse came out, a red one. The rider on the horse was given power to take away peace from the earth so that people would kill each other. He was given a big sword.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti chaŋ tɔbu ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka a chɛ ka bɛ be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa a ni pii tiŋ shɛli ka m me a duu zali ti a yuli jilima ŋɔ polo na n-suh a.
en: When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you may send them, and they pray to you toward this city that you have chosen and concerning this temple that I have built for your name.

dag: Naawuni shia n-nam ma, ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ti ma nyɛvili.
en: Gods Spirit made me. My life comes from God All-Powerful.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Duɣu shɛli din zahim, ka di zahimbu maa bi yi. Yaami nimdi maa di puuni yiniyini, ka miri ka a gahinda.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: The city of murderers is doomed! It is like a corroded pot that is never cleaned. Piece after piece of meat is taken out, and not one is left.

dag: Ka naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa nini daa tiɣi o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naa maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Mɛmukan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The king liked the plan, as did the other men, and he did just what Memucan said.

dag: Ka paɣiri ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mali ya ka yi simdi ni yi nya tarili ŋun Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zal o ninvuɣ gahinda o neesim nam ni la.
en: and by giving thanks with joy to the Father. He made it so you could take part in the inheritance, in light granted to Gods holy people.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ: Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni tintani din zaa daa baɣi Mɛdɛba la.
en: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yiko niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kana ti tum tuma maa zaa na.
en: Moses called Bezalel, Oholiab, and all the other skilled men to whom the Lord had given ability and who were willing to help, and Moses told them to start working.

dag: Hal n ni kul ka taali maa zaa yoli n ku tooi garig o. N naɣ ni suhila ŋun zaŋ ma taali maa, ka o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I am innocent, but I cannot give him an answer. All I can do is beg my Judge for mercy.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, N suhir a, wuhim ma a yuli. Amaa ka doo maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a baŋ n yuli? Di nyaaŋa ka doo maa daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni nimaani.
en: Then Jacob asked him, Please tell me your name. But the man said, Why do you ask my name? Then the man blessed Jacob at that place.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, Mani ŋun nyɛ taŋkpaɣu ni tampiligim ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni tɔɣisiri n Duuma yɛtɔɣa.
en: Abraham answered, I am nothing more than the dust of the earth. Please forgive me, Lord , for daring to speak to you like this.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be tiŋgbani maa ni ni alaafee, ka so lan kani ŋun ni kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, bɛ ni tam bɛ vi mini bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la yɛla.
en: They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me.

dag: Hal bɛ yi gbi gbala n-kpe di ni, n ni zaŋ n nuu tim di ni yihi ba na. Ka bɛ yi dula zuɣusaa, n ni siɣisi ba na.
en: If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.

dag: O niŋ o mini Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la yiko ni bɛ wuhi niriba.
en: and have the ability to teach others. Both he and Oholiab, Ahisamachs son from the tribe of Dan.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Kɔnyuri m-mali ma. N suhir a, tim ma kom biɛla ka n nyu. Ka paɣ maa daa yooi bihim koligu m-booi bihim ti o ka o nyu, ka o lan zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: Sisera said to her, Please give me a little water to drink. Im thirsty. So she opened a jug of milk, gave him a drink, and hid him again.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a jilima kul be sahakam. Yawɛ, chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a tuma zuɣu.
en: Let the LORDs glory last forever! Let the LORD rejoice in all he has made!.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka daadam ku tooi nyu bara Naawuni sani.
en: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa mɔɣisi Barizillai kpariŋ, ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni, ka Barizillai daa labi kul o yiŋa, ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa du.
en: David's soldiers went on across the river, while he stayed behind to tell Barzillai goodbye and to wish him well. Barzillai returned home, but.

dag: Yawɛ, so lan kani ŋ-ŋman a, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pah a zuɣu kaman ti tiba ni wum shɛm.
en: Lord , there is none like you; we have always known that you alone are God.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim chaŋ a vuhim shee, a min a kpiɔŋ alikauli adaka maa.
en: Come to your new home, Lord , you and the sacred chest with all its power.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa kpamba mini bɛn pahi daa yɛli, Iin, ti nyɛla di shɛhiranima. Ka lan yɛli, Yawɛ chɛ ka a paɣ maa be kaman Reechɛl mini Liya bɛn daa dɔɣi bihi pam ti Izraɛl la. Naawuni chɛ ka a tɔŋ Ɛfirat zuliya ni, ka chɛ ka a yuli du Bɛtilihɛm ŋɔ.
en: The leaders and the others said, Yes, we are witnesses. May the Lord make your wife become like Rachel and Leah, who bore many children to Jacob. May you become rich in the clan of Ephrath and famous in Bethlehem.

dag: Ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa tim na ti bol a ka a bi kana? A bi tɛhi ni n ni tooi ti a pin titali.
en: Balak said to Balaam, Didnt I send urgently and summon you? Why didnt you come to me? Am I really not able to honor you.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Firawuna tumtumdib shɛb bɛn min o daa be duu o dan yiŋ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi mali suhugarigu lihigu zuŋɔ.
en: He asked them, Why do you look so worried today.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: the Temple servants and the descendants of Solomons servants:.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa na kul kpalim bela teeku maa sunsuuni, ka Yisa kɔŋko mi kpalim be duli.
en: Later in the evening he was still there by himself, and the boat was somewhere in the middle of the lake.

dag: Lazarɔs tizɔpaɣ Mariama maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ tulaale ʒe ti Duuma Yisa ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛh o naba la.
en: Marys brother was Lazarus, the man who was now sick.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli, Yinim Zɛruya bihi ŋɔ, wula ka n yɛn niŋ ya? Di yi nyɛla Yawɛ n-yɛl o, Tum Dauda, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi lala.
en: This is none of your business, the king said to Abishai and his brother Joab. If he curses me because the Lord told him to, who has the right to ask why he does it.

dag: N naan wum o ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm, ka baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm.
en: know the words with which he would answer, understand what he would say to me.

dag: Mahila mini Tiriza ni Hɔgila ni Milika ni Nɔa bɛn daa nyɛ Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa daa kulila bɛ ba tizɔbihi bidibisi.
en: Zelophehads daughters—Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah—married their cousins on their fathers side of the family.

dag: O ŋmanila jɛŋgbini n-doya gu ma, ka ŋmani gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣi doya gu.
en: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;.

dag: Di saha ka tihi maa zaa daa chaŋ ti yɛli tanyibiga, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Finally, all the trees said to the thornbush, You come and be king over us.

dag: Tab jɛlinsi nyɛla din tahiri zabili na, amaa yurilim limsiri taali balibu kam.
en: Hate stirs up conflict, but love covers all offenses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di bindirigu ka nyu n-naai Shilo maa nyaaŋa, ka Hanna suhu daa saɣim pam ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ tooni ti suh o, ka kum pam. Di saha Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daa ʒila kuɣ zuɣu Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tab dunoli.
en: One time, after they had finished their meal in the house of the Lord at Shiloh, Hannah got up. She was deeply distressed, and she cried bitterly as she prayed to the Lord . Meanwhile, Eli the priest was sitting in his place by the door.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bɔri ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni bɛ suhuri zaa la daa yi Izraɛl bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa n-doli Lɛvinim kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la.
en: From all the tribes of Israel people who sincerely wanted to worship the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem, so that they could offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

dag: Chɛ ka o doli wuntia soli kariti a niriba saria, ka doli zaligu kariti a tarimba saria.
en: Help the king judge your people fairly. Help him make wise decisions for your poor people.

dag: Ti daa yulila sɔŋsim soli hal ka ti nini ti sabi, ti daa yuunila zuliya shɛb soli ni bɛ tiligi ti, ka bɛ daa bi tooi tiligi ti.
en: Our eyes continually failed, looking for some help, but for nothing. From our watchtower we watched for a nation that doesnt save.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chɛ ka so guli piɛri maa, ka o zaŋ bindira maa chaŋ kaman o ba Jɛsi ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. O daa paai sansani maa shee la saha shɛli bɛ ni daa maani shili ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣ ni, ka buri zambu.
en: So David got up early in the morning, left someone in charge of the flock, and loaded up and left, just as his father Jesse had instructed him. He reached the camp right when the army was taking up their battle formations and shouting the war cry.

dag: N suhir a yɛra, Di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma, a mi di chɛ ka bɛ di dari niŋ ma n napɔŋ sarigibu zuɣu.
en: Don't let my enemies gloat over my distress; don't let them boast about my downfall!.

dag: O kuri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ, ka saɣindi bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa.
en: He brings destruction on the mighty and their strongholds.

dag: A ni ti ma suhupiɛl shɛli n suhu ni gari bɛ ni yi ŋahi kawana pam, ka tɔɣi wain pam, ka mali suhupiɛl shɛl la.
en: But you have filled my heart with more joy than when their wheat and wine are everywhere!.

dag: Ka salo maa ni so daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, yɛlimi m biɛli ni o chɛ ka ti pirigi ti ba fali ti taba.
en: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Nuzaa polo maa daa tim ti boli Jɛrɔbɔam na. Ka o mini Izraɛlnim maa daa kana ti yɛli Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: The people of the northern tribes sent for him, and they all went together to Rehoboam and said to him.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani, o pun zaŋ li ti Naawuni, ka di bi lan kpa ni o lu o ba sizuura gba.
en: But you say, If you tell your father or mother,Everything Im expected to contribute to you Im giving to God as a gift,then you dont have to honor your father.

dag: A daa pirigi teeku buyi ka chɛ ka a niriba doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du, amaa ka a daai bɛn daa doli ba maa niŋ teeku maa bulli ni, kaman kuɣili ni lu kɔtitali ni shɛm la.
en: You split the Red Sea in front of them, and they walked through on dry land. The Egyptian soldiers were chasing them, but you threw that enemy into the sea. And they sank like a rock into the sea.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pɔr la n daa yuri ba. N daa boli ba yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na kaman m bidibisi la.
en: The Lord said, I loved Israel when he was a child, and I called my son out of Egypt.

dag: ka chɛ ka Speen ŋariŋ titaŋa zaa mini ŋariŋ viɛla zaa shim.
en: against all the ships of Tarshish; against all the wonderful boats.

dag: Daba ata maa dali asiba, ka saa daa gbaai tahibu, ka nyaɣisira, ka sagban tibisili daa be zoli maa zuɣu, ka kika titali din yo vuri pam kum, ka niriba bɛn daa be sansani maa ni zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: On the morning of the third day, a thick cloud came down onto the mountain. There was thunder and lightning and a very loud sound from a trumpet. All the people in the camp were frightened.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Taainim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋ muni niriba zaa n-tahi Ɛdom, ka bi gbib bɛ mini ba ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: The Lord says, The people of Tyre have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They carried off a whole nation into exile in the land of Edom, and did not keep the treaty of friendship they had made.

dag: Naa daa ʒinila o ʒiishee din tab dukpini kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka Jɔnatan ʒiɛya, ka Abinɛr mi ʒini baɣili Sool, amaa ka Dauda ŋun ʒiishee daa nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ.
en: He sat next to the wall where he usually sat, and Jonathan sat across from him. Abner sat next to Saul, but Davids place was empty.

dag: Mbusim din be kaman kokpɛɣu la vuri niŋdi ma, ka a kɔgbana zaa min a kopaliga kana ti du ma gari.
en: I hear the roar of the water coming from deep within the earth. It shouts to the water below as it tumbles down the waterfall. God, your waves come one after another, crashing all around and over me.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o ba paɣa, noli din dim o, o ni ta o ba bindoo daɣiri zuɣu. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who has sex with his fathers wife, because that exposes his fathers private matters. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: O daa zaŋla din buɣisiri maa buɣisi wulimpuhili polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He used the same measuring rod on all four sides. He measured the east side, seven hundred fifty feet.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba la ti miri binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi la, ka ku kpi m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna min o bidibisi la kpɛm ti wuhi bɛ zaa yinoyino o tuma bee o ʒili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: be killed by coming near these most sacred objects. To prevent this from happening, Aaron and his sons shall go in and assign each man his task and tell him what to carry.

dag: A daa nyɛla dabili ka ti Duuma bol a? Di chɛ ka di muɣis a. Amaa a yi ni tooi nya yolisim, nyin bom li.
en: If you were a slave when you were called, dont let it bother you. But if you are actually able to be free, take advantage of the opportunity.

dag: Di zɔri yɛlibiɛ libigirili dabiɛm bee sanʒiɛɣu din ʒiɛri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: You have no reason to fear a sudden disaster or the destruction that comes to the wicked.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni dɔɣiri bidib shɛb mini bipuɣin shɛb kpe mini bɛ manim ni bɛ banim bɛn dɔɣi ba polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.

dag: Dama ʒiri ʒiinim ti ku lan beni, ka ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa gba ti ku lan be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Among the people of Israel there will be no more false visions or misleading prophecies.

dag: N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Ijipti, ka Pɛlusiumnim ti nya suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka sanʒiɛɣu ti ʒe Tɛbis n-da di goma luhi, ka Mɛmfisinim dimnim ti liri ba wuntaŋ ni.
en: I will set Egypt on fire; Pelusium will writhe in travail, Thebes will be split open, Memphis assaulted in broad daylight.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul yɛra, Ti ku be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli.
en: But if you say, We wont live in this land, you will disobey the LORD your God.

dag: ka di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛlimaŋli zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni pun yɛl a shɛlikam la polo.
en: I do this so that you will know the full truth about everything which you have been taught.

dag: Yi yi niŋ lala, yi tum alahichi yi mabihi sani ka gbarigi bɛ suhuri ni tɛha din ka kpiɔŋ la, ka lala niŋbu nyɛla alahichi tumbu Masia sani.
en: You sin against Christ if you sin against your brothers and sisters and hurt their weak consciences this way.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka o chaŋ ti kpe yili shɛli, ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: Then Jesus left the people and went into the house. The followers asked Jesus about what he had told the people.

dag: hal ka bɛ ni so ti ku kpalim. Dama Anatɔtnim tibidarigibo yuuni yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: No one will be left because I will bring disaster upon the men of Anathoth when their time comes.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanani daa ka Juda Naa Asa sanna ti yɛl o, A ni niŋla Siria naa naani ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ naani la zuɣu, Siria naa tɔbbihi maa ni ti zo ka chɛ a.
en: At that time Hanani the seer came to Judahs King Asa and said to him, Because you relied on Arams king and not on the LORD your God, the army of Arams king has slipped out of your grasp.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ biasan la zuliya m-be tooni, ka Juda zuliya kpamba paya, ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya kpamba doli nyaaŋa.
en: Theres Benjamin leading them, though hes little; then the princes of Judah, their speaker; then the princes of Zebulun and the princes of Naphtali.

dag: dama o zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim pam daa chɛ bɛ zuɣulaannima ka niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: because on his account many Jews were rejecting them and believing in Jesus.

dag: Ka Mikaya lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu wummi Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. N daa nyala Yawɛ ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo;.
en: Then Micaiah said, Listen now to the LORDs word: I saw the LORD enthroned with all the heavenly forces stationed beside him, at his right and at his left.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili maa dali ti yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku beni. Dindali maa ti shiri yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku be di ni.
en: Isnt the day of the LORD darkness, not light; all dark with no brightness in it?.

dag: Dama bɛ daa ku o suli bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni, ka daa chɛ ka nyuli gbaag o bɛ binnana jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
