dag: Ŋunkam mali ansarisimaana n-zali dɛde, o kpa turi. Ŋunkam kpahi ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ni ni nya daŋa.
en: Criticize a person who is rude and shows no respect, and you will only get insults. Correct the wicked, and you will only get hurt.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni chɛ ka kokpɛɣu kpe dunia ŋɔ ni n-di vuhirigu kam zaa ŋun mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka binshɛɣukam zaa din be dunia ŋɔ ni kpi.
en: Understand what I am telling you. I will bring a great flood of water on the earth. I will destroy all living things that live under heaven. Everything on the earth will die.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka o paɣ Ɛlizabɛt daa niŋ pua, ka sɔɣir omaŋa hal ti paai chira anu ka yɛra.
en: Some time later his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and did not leave the house for five months.

dag: Nyamiya n ni zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu n-sab bachibihi kar shɛŋa tin ya!.
en: This is my own handwriting. You can see how big the letters are.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ niŋ a niriba fitiina, ka nahim a ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: Lord , they hurt your people and make them suffer.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ paɣa n-tin ya, amaa ka do so zaŋ o dɔni, yi ni ti me yi yili ka bi kpe di ni. Yi ni ti sa yi wain tihi, ka ku di di wala.
en: You might get engaged to a woman, but another man will have sex with her. You might build a house, but you wont get to live in it. You might plant a vineyard, but you wont enjoy it.

dag: Bɛ yihi yɛli ni bɛ mi Naawuni, amaa ka bɛ tuma lee bi wuhi ni bɛ mi o. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim mini tipawumlinima ka ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suŋ kam tumbu polo.
en: They say they know God, but the evil things they do show that they dont accept him. They are disgusting. They refuse to obey God and are not capable of doing anything good.

dag: A daa tɛhiya ni nyini n-kul yɛn su nam sahakam, ka bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni di nyɛla shɛli bee n-tɛhi di zaa ni ti yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.

dag: O daa mali salima bans anahi n-zaŋ li ga teebuli maa luɣ anahi zuɣu naba la.
en: Then he made four gold rings and put them at the four corners of the table, where the four legs were.

dag: Ka ŋunkam siɣis omaŋ leei kaman bibil ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: The greatest person in Gods kingdom is the one who makes himself humble like this child.

dag: ni Basɛmat ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ka nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt tizɔpaɣ la.
en: and Basemath, the daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

dag: Dama n doli Yawɛ zaligu; ka na ʒi m-birigi zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni maa sani.
en: The Lord did this because I have obeyed him. I have not turned against my God.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli niriba maa, Miligimiya ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ suɣa shee, ka di shihiya bɛ binshɛɣu, di yi pa lala bɛ daalahichi maa zaa ni ʒin ya chaŋ.
en: Then Moses warned the people, Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni bee ti yi ka di ni, ti nia lɔbu nyɛla ni ti tiɣi o nini.
en: More than anything else, however, we want to please him, whether in our home here or there.

dag: N kɔŋko ku tooi gbibi niriba ŋɔ zaa, dama bɛ galisi nyaŋ ma.
en: I cant bear this people on my own. Theyre too heavy for me.

dag: Ti daa tum alahichi, ka daa tum tuumbiɛri mini tuun shɛŋa din bi tuhi. Ti daa zaɣis a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛli, ka daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ a ni wuhi ti din tuhi shɛli tumbu.
en: But we have sinned. We have done wrong. We have done evil things. We turned against you. We turned away from your commands and good decisions.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o tilig o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili ni ti lan nya li.
en: Whoever tries to keep the life they have will lose it. But whoever gives up their life will save it.

dag: amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni daba ata dali ka chɛ ka o yi palo.
en: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.

dag: A zo nyɛla ŋun yur a sahakam, ka mabihi mi nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛba ni bɛ sɔŋdi taba ashaara saha.
en: Friends always show their love. What are relatives for if not to share trouble?.

dag: Ka Pita daa lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam n-saɣisiri ba yɛra, Tiligimiya yimaŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: With many other words he testified to them and encouraged them, saying, Be saved from this perverse generation.

dag: Juda Naa Ahazia bia Naa Jɔash ni daa di Juda nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaata saha, ka Jɛhu bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di Izraɛl nam n-ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayopɔin.
en: In the twenty-third year of the reign of Joash son of Ahaziah as king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for seventeen years.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣis o, ka nahim o, amaa ka o bi yaag o noli. Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi chaŋ kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛbil chani kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛɣu kɔbiri ka o fo shɛm la. O daa bi yaag o noli.
en: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.

dag: ka o daa kuli ti yɛl o ba min o ma, N nyala Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga Timna, dinzuɣu bomiy o ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: He went back home and told his father and mother, There is a Philistine woman down at Timnah who caught my attention. Get her for me; I want to marry her.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi wumbu, n ni kum ashilɔni yi karimbaani maa zuɣu. N ni kum pam hal ka nintam ti zɔri n nina ni, bɛ ni gbahi Yawɛ niriba leei daba maa zuɣu.
en: If you are too proud to listen, I will go off alone and cry my eyes out. I will weep uncontrollably because the LORDs flock will be dragged off into exile.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi Jona bahi teeku maa ni, ka teeku maa daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: Then they picked up Jonah and hurled him into the sea, and the sea ceased its raging.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔsis ma Mariama daa nya bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body of Jesus was placed.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo? Aai, n yɛri ya mi ni ninvuɣ tuɣilibo ka n tahina.
en: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ bɛ tab niriba ayi maa.
en: The other ten followers heard this and were angry with the two brothers.

dag: Yawɛ yɛri Izraɛlnima, Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya.
en: The Lord keeps saying, Israel, turn back to me and you will live!.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu, dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋkpansi nti da bindira di.
en: That evening the disciples came to Jesus and said, This place is like a desert, and it's already late. Let the crowds leave, so they can go to the villages and buy some food.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka saa maa mini sakuɣa ni satahinsi maa zaa naai maa, ka o daa lan gbaai taali tumbu yaha, o min o kpamba maa daa lan niŋ tipawumli.
en: When the king saw what had happened, he sinned again. He and his officials remained as stubborn as ever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yuli ni ka ti sɔŋsim yirina.
en: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi yɔhim yimaŋ yɛra, Babilɔnnim maa shiri zoya ka chɛ ti, dama bɛ ku zo ka chɛn ya.
en: Don't fool yourselves into thinking that the Babylonians will leave as they did before.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab ni daa ti baŋ ni Naa Dauda suhu lu Absalom ni.
en: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that King David missed Absalom very much.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla alizin biɛri n-chani dunia nanim zaa sani nti wuhiri shihira ni bɛ laɣim ba lo tɔbu gu Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ dabisi tital la dali.
en: These evil spirits are the spirits of demons. They have power to do miracles. They go out to the rulers of the whole world to gather them for battle on the great day of God All-Powerful.

dag: Chɛ ka di nyɛla a kɔŋko dini, ka miri ka a niŋdi li tiri saamba.
en: Keep it for yourself, and dont share it with strangers.

dag: M bɔhim din be a zaligunim puuni ka di wɔɣa, ni a zal li mi ni di kul be sahakam.
en: Long ago I learned about your instructions; you made them to last forever.

dag: Bɛ zilima ŋmanila piɛm din mali lɔɣu, di tɔɣisirila ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ zaa tɔɣisirila zɔsimdi yɛtɔɣa bɛ ʒiʒiinitab sani, amaa bɛ suhuri ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn sɔɣi dɔni gu ni bɛ tum barina.
en: The people of Judah have tongues as sharp as arrows. Their mouths speak lies. They all speak kindly to their neighbors, but they are secretly planning ways to attack them.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣ asibaasi sara maligu saha, ka kom daa yi Ɛdom polo n-zo na ti tɛli tiŋgbani zaa.
en: The next morning, at the time to offer the grain offering, water came flowing from the direction of Edom. The land filled up with water.

dag: Zuliya kam, yi zaa wummiya! Dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, wummiya! Chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ka be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ŋɔ ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Hear this, all you nations; listen to this, all who live on earth! The Sovereign Lord will testify against you. Listen! He speaks from his heavenly temple.

dag: O tiri binnɛɔŋ kam bindirigu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Naawuni zuɣu, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ puuni!.
en: God knows there is nothing untrue in any of this.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa wum di yɛla, ka boli tiŋgbani maa yuli Akɛlidama.
en: This became known to everyone living in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Hakeldama, or Field of Blood.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛli ma, Di bi simdi ni a me yili ti ma, dama a nyɛla tɔbbia ŋun ku niriba pam.
en: But God said to me, No David, you must not build a house for my name. You must not do that because you are a soldier, and you have killed many men.

dag: Zaŋm gɔpiɛliga dari mali yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbi shɛli zuɣu.
en: Make an acacia-wood altar for burning incense.

dag: Ka n daa kul mali lala hal ti paai Kɔbilinini Dunɔdal la mini Naa Kosubo bɔɣili la polo. Ka n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so maa daa bi tooi nya soli gari.
en: Then I rode on toward the Fountain Gate and the Kings Pool. As I got close, I could see there was not enough room for my horse to get through.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N wumla a damli puu ŋɔ ni ka dabiɛm gbaai ma, dama m bela n zaɣim, dina n-chɛ ka n sɔɣi maa.
en: The man answered, I was naked, and when I heard you walking through the garden, I was frightened and hid.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina saha shɛli ka Yisa kana ti ʒe teeku duli, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa na bi baŋ ni ŋun Yisa m-bala.
en: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore. But the followers did not know it was Jesus.

dag: Dama nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa biɛr palli malibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a mi ma; a nyari ma, ka buɣisiri ma, ka n suhu bela a ni. Vom ba yihina kaman piɛri ka bɛ vɔri ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la. Woligim ba zali gu kɔrigibu dali.
en: But you know my heart, Lord . You see me and test my mind. Drag the evil people away like sheep to be killed. Choose them for the day of slaughter.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam yɛla pala yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla yiko yɛla.
en: Gods kingdom is not seen in talk but in power.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ suhimiya Naawuni ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka niŋ ti nirilim. Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali taali. O ni niŋ yi so nirilim? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa zaa daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiniinaayopɔin bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya doli bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of , warriors.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa kana ti kpe duu maa ni n-nya ka biŋŋmahindili maa do garo zuɣu, ka di zuɣu kuɣi bukɔbiri difiɛli.
en: The messengers went to Davids house. They went inside to get him, but they saw it was only a statue and that its hair was only goats hair.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa kpuɣi Putiɛl bipuɣinsi ni yino n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Finɛhas. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Eleazar, Aaron's son, married one of Putiel's daughters, who bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the families and the clans of the tribe of Levi.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ teeku dulinim ŋɔ, fomiya ka wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Di simdi ni zuliya kam labi neei bɛ kpiɔŋ. Bɛ zaŋm bɛ yɛtɔɣa kana ti tɔɣisi. Chɛliya ka ti laɣim saria karibu shee.
en: Be quiet before me, coastlands. Let the nations renew their strength. Let them approach and speak. Lets draw near for a judgment.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka yi daa guni gunibu shɛli din pa ninsal ni niŋ shɛli, amaa ka nyɛla Masia maŋmaŋ ni niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛ o ni yihi ya niŋgbuŋ din tumd alahichi ŋɔ alahichi maa yiko dabitim puuni la zuɣu.
en: In union with Christ you were circumcised, not with the circumcision that is made by human beings, but with the circumcision made by Christ, which consists of being freed from the power of this sinful self.

dag: Bɛ kul dolila bɛ nia biɛri maa soli n-gbaari nia ni bɛ bari zana ashilɔni; ka tɛhira, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya ti?.
en: They encourage each other to do wrong. They talk about setting traps and say, No one will see them here!.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka a mini Haman kana yuŋ ŋɔ nti di bindira ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni pun niŋ zali nyin naa ŋɔ.
en: Esther answered, If the king wishes, please come today with Haman for the feast that I have prepared for him.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa buɣiri kpana, ka gbibi nyɔtaɣira kalinli daa nyɛla tɔbbihi tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisinii.
en: From the tribe of Judah there were men ready for war. They carried shields and spears.

dag: Jashub daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jashubnima; ka Shimrɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Shimirɔnnima.
en: Jashub, and Shimron.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ayuba.
en: Job, you challenged Almighty God; will you give up now, or will you answer?.

dag: Ka yi zaa daa ka n sanna ti yɛli, Chɛ ka ti tim niriba ka bɛ daŋ ti tooni chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti, ka ʒi lahibali labina ti yɛli ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa ni ti ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: Then all of you approached me, saying, Lets send spies ahead of us—they can check out the land for us. Then they can return with word about the route we should use and bring a report about the cities that well be entering.

dag: Yisifu ni daa ti kuna, ka bɛ zaŋ pin shɛli din be bɛ sani maa kpɛhi ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: When Joseph got home, they took the gifts into the house to him and bowed down to the ground before him.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country. I, the Lord , have spoken and will not change my mind.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, Amaa n ni daa ti be soli chana nti miriti Damaskus kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka neesim titali daa ti dii yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili ma.
en: But something happened to me on my way to Damascus. It was about noon when I came close to Damascus. Suddenly a bright light from heaven shined all around me.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee yɛli ba, Bin shɛli ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suhi ya, Yi zaa piim tibikpara yi ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa la ni ti ma. .
en: But he went on to say, Let me ask one thing of you. Every one of you give me the earrings you took.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, M bia Dauda, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. A ni ti tum tuma pam, ka di nasara di tumbu ni. Ka Dauda daa chaŋ o chandi, ka Sool mi ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Then Saul said to David, Bless you, David, my son! You will accomplish much and will certainly succeed. Then David went on his way, but Saul went back home.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko yɛla ka bi bɔri ni bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, amaa ka dolila tuumbiɛtali soli la, Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o suli min o suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛ tibili.
en: But on the other hand, there will be wrath and anger for those who obey wickedness instead of the truth because they are acting out of selfishness and disobedience.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum yi ni yɛli ma yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, ka yɛli ma, N wum niriba maa ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, bɛ mali yɛlimaŋli bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni.
en: When the Lord heard this, he said to me, I have heard what these people said, and they are right.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpɛhi bɛ yuri dabiɛm, ka kpɛhi bɛn bari ba mi yinyari. Amaa n ni ti guli Judanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yuri zom.
en: But at that time I will scare the horse, and the soldier riding it will panic. I will make all the enemy horses blind, but my eyes will be open—and I will be watching over Judahs family.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum ʒiɛyimtali tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanima n-teei gili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntiŋ shɛŋa la, ka tɛhiri ni o ni di nasara ka zaŋ ba leeg o niriba.
en: After these events, in which King Hezekiah served the Lord faithfully, Sennacherib, the emperor of Assyria, invaded Judah. He besieged the fortified cities and gave orders for his army to break their way through the walls.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka biriginsim yiko kpe bɛ ni birigi ba, ka bɛ doli ʒiri soli.
en: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Anabi Ilaija m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, O ŋmanila anab kura la ni yino.
en: Other people said, He is Elijah. And others said, He is a prophet. He is like the prophets who lived long ago.

dag: Yɛm ka Ayuba ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa ni, o yɛtɔɣa maa ka gbinni.
en: Job speaks without knowledge; his words arent astute.

dag: Ka saa nyaɣisibu mini saa tahibu ni kukoya vuri pam yiri nam ʒiishee maa gbin na; ka buɣim mokpala ayopɔin din nyɛ Naawuni shih ayopɔin la sa nam ʒiishee maa tooni dira.
en: From the throne came lightning, voices, and thunder. In front of the throne were seven flaming torches, which are the seven spirits of God.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛlabihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: Ti mabihi, din pahi nyɛla yi pun bɔhim ti sani di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm n-tiɣi Naawuni nini yɛla. Hal lala ka yi kul be, ka ti suhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: Finally, our friends, you learned from us how you should live in order to please God. This is, of course, the way you have been living. And now we beg and urge you in the name of the Lord Jesus to do even more.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: Then he made the poles for carrying the Box. He used acacia wood and covered the poles with pure gold.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla alikauli palibu sara maligu bee o suhuyubu sara maligu, bɛ ni tooi ŋubi di nimdi maa o ni mali sara maa dahin shɛli maa, ka shɛli yi guui zani neei biɛɣu bɛ ni tooi ŋub li;.
en: If you bring a fellowship offering as fulfillment of a vow or as your own freewill offering, not all of it has to be eaten on the day it is offered, but any that is left over may be eaten on the following day.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ dabisili dali kanna ka bɛ ni ti pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ti taba yi ninni.
en: A day is coming that belongs to the LORD, when that which has been plundered from you will be divided among you.

dag: Ka o daa kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la biŋkɔbigu, ka Aduna bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim n-zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: He killed the animal which was for his own burnt offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he threw it on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino mali sara pa bimbini kam zuɣu.
en: Balak did as he was told, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa gbaai Yisifu binyɛrigu gbib ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Amaa ka Yisifu daa fuɣ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ paɣ maa nuu ni, ka guui yi yili maa ni.
en: She grabbed his garment, saying, Lie down with me. But he left his garment in her hands and ran outside.

dag: zaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb Naa Ashuribanipal ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la ni daa yiɣisina nti ʒili Samaria tiŋ puuni mini luɣ shɛŋa din pahi m-be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la nim sanna.
en: and the rest of the nations whom the great and famous Osnappar deported and settled in the cities of Samaria and in the rest of the province Beyond the River. .

dag: Ka di lan nyɛla kom din daa nyɛ kokpɛɣu la ka Naawuni daa zaŋ saɣim tuuli dunia la.
en: Then the world was flooded and destroyed with water.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira balibu kam, ka dabiɛm daa kpe sokam.
en: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.

dag: Naawuni, ti yaannim daa pun yɛli ti ka ti wum a ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa bɛ ʒiɛman ni kurimbuni ha la yɛla.
en: With our own ears we have heard it, O God— our ancestors have told us about it, about the great things you did in their time, in the days of long ago:.

dag: Di niŋ a zo yɛda, a mi di niŋ a ni yuri so naani. Gbaam a noli yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ paɣa so ŋun do m-baɣa sani.
en: Don't believe your neighbor or trust your friend. Be careful what you say even to your husband or wife.

dag: Ka Mariama paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dali daa ti paai kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm. Ka bɛ zaŋ bia maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ti ti Duuma.
en: When the time came for their ritual cleansing, in accordance with the Law from Moses, they brought Jesus up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord. .

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: The apostles returned to Jesus and told him everything they had done and taught.

dag: Miriya ka yi saɣim yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa, dama ninvuɣ kubo nyɛla din saɣindi tiŋgbani. Binshɛli kani ka yi ni tooi zaŋ mali tiŋgbani maa naɣila ninvuɣ so ŋun ku nir maa ʒim.
en: You may not pollute the land in which you live, for the blood pollutes the land. There can be no recovery for the land from the blood that is shed in it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

dag: A ni varisi pɔhim ni ʒe n-tɔhigi va shɛli bahi, ka kari doli wurigu din kuui?.
en: Are you trying to frighten me? I'm nothing but a leaf; you are attacking a piece of dry straw.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ boli Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn nyɛ Naftali mini Asha ni Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa, ka bɛ kana ti doli Midiannim maa.
en: Then soldiers from the tribes of Naphtali, Asher, and all of Manasseh were told to chase the Midianites.

dag: A nam nyɛla saha din ka bahigu nam, ka a su binshɛɣukam zaa ʒiɛmani kam ni. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim o yɛtɔɣa zaa ni, ka nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma zaa ni.
en: Your rule is eternal, and you are king forever. The Lord is faithful to his promises; he is merciful in all his acts.

dag: Pashihur daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Maasɛya so mi yaha ni Ishimail ni Nɛtanɛl ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlasa.
en: Of the family of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

dag: M-pahi bɛ ni daa nya ka do so ŋun kpaŋ maa ʒe bɛ sani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: They saw the crippled man standing there beside the apostles. They saw that he was healed, so they could say nothing against the apostles.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa nya ma kul maani ma la ansarisi; ka mɛrigiri bɛ noya niŋdi ma, ka viini bɛ zuɣuri niŋdi ma ka yɛra.
en: All who see me make fun of me— they gape, shaking their heads.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna, di saha ti ni du n-chaŋ, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ ti nuu ni. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ shihirili ti sani.
en: But if they tell us to go to them, then we will, because that will be the sign that the Lord has given us victory over them.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi zaŋ chaŋ o sani, ka kul taari duŋ niŋdi Zallakudura Naa mɔɣu maa ni.
en: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.

dag: Yidaampaɣ suŋ nyɛla o yidan nam zuɣupiligu, amaa paɣ so ŋun dihir o yidan vi ŋmanila dɔro o yidan kɔbili ni.
en: A good wife is like a crown to her husband, but a shameful wife is like a cancer.

dag: Biɛɣ ti yɛn neei ka zibisim vuui. N ni zo yomyom du mɛɛr ni nyo zo shɛli zuɣu, ka zo n-du firanki tulaale zim ni nyo dabo shɛli zuɣu.
en: I will stay on the hill of myrrh, the hill of incense, until the morning breezes blow and the darkness disappears.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim maa daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni shɛm ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: The legal experts and Pharisees began to mutter among themselves, Who is this who insults God? Only God can forgive sins.

dag: A yi yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu, nyin lum o sizuura. A yi vu m-miri ti wum, di so jɛra ni maani sara shɛli, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu.
en: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.

dag: dindina n ni teei n ni daa lo Yaakubu mini Yisahaku ni Ibrahimma alikauli shɛŋa la yɛla, ka lan teei tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: If they do, I will remember my agreement with Jacob. I will remember my agreement with Isaac. I will remember my agreement with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

dag: N yura ŋmanila molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ polli. Nyama, ŋuna n-ʒe ti gooni nyaaŋa n-vɔbisiri lihiri ti takɔriti ni, ka lihiri dari din puli gabi tab voya ni ŋɔ.
en: My lover is like a gazelle or a young deer. Look at him standing behind our wall, staring out the window, looking through the lattice.

dag: Yɛndan lee bela ya? Ka zaligubaŋda lee bela ya? Ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛlibuɣisira lee bela ya? Pa Naawuni m-pun wuhi ni dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim?.
en: Where are the wise? Where are the legal experts? Where are todays debaters? Hasnt God made the wisdom of the world foolish?.

dag: Ŋuna n-tiri dansi, ŋuna n-lan lɔri dansi maa yuma. Ŋuna n-ŋmɛri tiri dansi, amaa ka o nuu tibiri dansi maa.
en: God bandages the wounds he makes; his hand hurts you, and his hand heals.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chani ka lihiri Sɔdom polo; ka Ibrahimma daa chani doli ba ni o zali ba soli.
en: When the three men got ready to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked part of the way with them.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na. Miriya ka yi zaŋ bubil bee piɛbil ma bihim duɣ o.
en: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.

dag: Di ni gu a ka chɛ pagɔrili, ka gu a ka chɛ paɣ zinalan naŋgbammalisim.
en: so she might guard you against the mysterious woman, from the foreign woman who flatters you.

dag: Amaa ka o tab maa yɛli, Guhim pɔi! Chɛ ka ti nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana ti tilig o bee o ku kana.
en: But the others said, Dont bother him. We want to see if Elijah will come to save him.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda garigi yɛli, Bolimiya Batishiiba ti ma. Ka o daa kpe naa sanna nti zan o tooni.
en: Then King David said, Tell Bathsheba to come in! So she came in and stood before the king.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ Naa ŋun ka bahigu. O suhu yi yiɣisi, tiŋgbani sɔhigirimi, ka zuliya shɛli ku tooi zan o suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: But the Lord is the only true God. He is the only God who is alive. He is the King who rules forever. The earth shakes when he is angry. The people of the nations cannot stop his anger.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa mini Nɛbushaziban ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpem la ni Nɛrigalisharɛza ni Babilɔn naa sapashin kpamba zaa.
en: So Nebuzaradan, together with the high officials Nebushazban and Nergal Sharezer and all the other officers of the king of Babylonia.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Ayuba ni dabisa shɛŋa din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni n-gari o ni daa pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm piligu ni la. O daa malila piɛri tuhi pinaanahi mini laakumnim tusaayɔbu ni naɣilahi tusaayi ni bunnyama tuhili.
en: The Lord blessed Job with even more than he had in the beginning. Job got , sheep, camels, oxen, and female donkeys.

dag: ka zaŋ sida dari maa mini taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee la m-pahi noombil nɛɔŋ la zuɣu tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so maa ʒim mini ko viɛlli maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi yili maa buyopɔin.
en: Then he will take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the piece of red cloth, and the living bird and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed over running water. Then he will sprinkle that blood on the house seven times.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ŋuni ka a bɔra? Mariama daa tɛhiya ni puu maa lana m-bala ka yɛl o, N dana, nyini n-yi yih o, nyin wuhim ma a ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: Jesus said to her, Woman, why are you crying? Who are you looking for? Thinking he was the gardener, she replied, Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him and I will get him.

dag: Ilaisha ni daa nya lala maa, ka o kuhi yɛli, M ba, m ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi mini di wɔribariba. Ka o daa bi lan nya Ilaija yaha. Di saha ka o daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu darigi tooi li buyi.
en: Elisha saw this and shouted, Israel's cavalry and chariots have taken my master away! After Elijah had gone, Elisha tore his clothes in sorrow.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shutɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shutɛlanima; ka Bɛcha daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛchanima; ka Tahan mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Tahannima.
en: The tribe of Ephraim: the clans of Shuthelah, Becher, and Tahan.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ ni daa kul moli gili, Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla bɛ puri atam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpam ni shiri pam ni bɛ puri ni bindira zaa na. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ binshɛɣukam pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu pam na.
en: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.

dag: Dauda bia Absalom daa mali tizɔpaɣ viɛlli ka o yuli booni Tama. Dahin shɛli ka Dauda bia Amnɔn kɔre daa ti kpe o ni.
en: David had a son named Absalom. Absalom had a very beautiful sister named Tamar. Another one of Davids sons, Amnon, was in love with Tamar.

dag: Biŋkpila maa daa tamla daantalis ayi la zuɣu, ka be duu maa gɔŋbu shee zuɣusaa lansi luɣili ni, ka pumpɔrinchihi kɔbisiyi kulis ayi gili biŋkpil yini, ka lan gili biŋkpil din la gba lala.
en: The capitals were on top of the columns, above the bowl-shaped net. There were pomegranates in rows all around the capitals.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu ka yi garigi ma.
en: Jesus answered them, Now let me ask you a question. Tell me.

dag: N kul yɛn kariti ba la biɛlabiɛla hal ka yi daadam biɛligu ti nabi n-su tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: So I will force them out of your land very slowly. I will do this as you grow and eventually take the land to be your own.

dag: Ka o sɔrilim maa yi na bi naai ka o dɔni binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, o yi lan ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu, di gba ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Anything on which she lies or sits during her menstruation will be unclean.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul dari gindila luɣ shɛlikam, ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu kul be daadamnim biɛhigu ni.
en: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ saa tahigu daa be zuɣusaa; ka Zallakudura Naa daa chɛ ka o kukoli yɛra.
en: The LORD thundered in heaven; the Most High made his voice heard with hail and coals of fire.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? A na ni nya din chihiri pam gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: He said to me: Human one, do you see? Yet you will see even more detestable practices than these.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Makihilɔt maa bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Tahat.
en: They marched from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

dag: Amaa Yisa nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o mali jilima pam gari Anabi Musa kaman ŋun me yili ni mali jilima gari o ni me yil shɛli maa shɛm la.
en: When someone builds a house, people will honor the builder more than the house. It is the same with Jesus. He should have more honor than Moses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lɔrigiri buŋ maa ka bɛn su o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o.
en: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, Why are you untying it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti fabili a zuɣu, ka yɛl a: Nyin tin shɛli din yuli daa du ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a lan ka teeku ni? Tin shɛli din min a niriba daa mali yaa teeku ni ŋɔ, nyini ŋun daa zal a kpiɔŋ a tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa sani ŋɔ!.
en: and sing this funeral song: The great city beside the sea is destroyed! Its people once ruled the coast and terrified everyone there.

dag: Bɛ gbibila tɔbiri mini kpana; bɛ nyɛla putɔɣunima, ka bi zɔri nambɔɣu. Bɛ chandi vuri ŋmanila teeku vuri. Bɛ barila yuri, ka lo kpara kaman tɔbutuhira n-chani tɔbu tuhibu n-kanna ni bɛ ti liri nyini Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga.
en: Equipped with bow and spear, they are cruel; they show no mercy. Their horsemen sound like the roaring sea, arrayed in battle formation against you, Daughter Zion.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya Amalɛknim naa Agag maa n-ti ma na. Ka Agag daa yi o sanna ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, kum biɛrim vuuya. .
en: Bring King Agag here to me, Samuel ordered. Agag came to him, trembling with fear, thinking to himself, What a bitter thing it is to die.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai Sirakus n-zani nimaani niŋ daba ata.
en: We landed in Syracuse where we stayed three days.

dag: Amaa ka Jona suhu daa miligi pam, ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: Jonah was really upset and angry.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla nyin Yawɛ ni ti ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni atam din daŋ niŋbu na ti ti a. Ka a zaŋ li zali tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka kurim tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Now, Lord , I bring you the first harvest from the land that you gave me. Then you must put the harvest down before the Lord your God and bow down to worship him.

dag: Kaman kom ni nyuui biaŋ ni, ka kulibɔŋ kom nyuui ka di kuui shɛm la.
en: Like rivers that stop running, and lakes that go dry.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Then Jesus went to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, where he taught the people on the Sabbath.

dag: Yi nyari suhukpaŋsibo yi ni be Masia ni la zuɣu? Yi nyari suhumaabo o yurilim zuɣu? Yi mini Naawuni Shia Kasi mali simdi ni taba? Yi niŋdi tab nirilim ka zɔri tab nambɔɣu?.
en: Therefore, if there is any encouragement in Christ, any comfort in love, any sharing in the Spirit, any sympathy.

dag: Dama, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini m-pii ba dunia ŋɔ ninsalinim zaa ni ni a su ba kaman a ni daa chɛ ka a dabili Musa yɛl ba shɛm saha shɛli a ni daa yihi ti yaannim maa Ijipti na la.
en: You set them apart from all the earths peoples as your own inheritance, LORD, just as you promised through your servant Moses when you brought our ancestors out of Egypt.

dag: O wuhiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa din tuhi, ka wuhiri ba o soli.
en: He leads the humble in the right way and teaches them his will.

dag: Nir ni dɔɣi bi shɛb o bipolitali ni ŋmanila piɛma din be tɔbutuhira nuu ni.
en: A young mans sons are like the arrows in a soldiers hand.

dag: Bɛ ni ti deei Ɛdomnim tiŋgbɔŋ su. Siɛrinim dimnim ni ti deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: He will conquer his enemies in Edom And make their land his property, While Israel continues victorious.

dag: N niriba, wummiya, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm: N ni zaŋ n wuhibu wuhi niriba, n zaligunim ni ti zuliya kam zaa neesim.
en: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.

dag: N ni yɛli sarikanima, N tin ya yolisim! Ka yɛli bɛn be zibisim ni, Kamiya neesim ni na! Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn be zoya zuɣu tiŋgban nɛl ni ŋubiri mɔri la.
en: saying to the prisoners, Come out, and to those in darkness, Show yourselves. Along the roads animals will graze; their pasture will be on every treeless hilltop.

dag: Niriba anahi bɛn daa nyɛ kɔnsi daa do Samaria sambani polo dunol shee. Ka bɛ daa ti bɔhi taba, Bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ʒi kpe hal ti kpi?.
en: About the same time, four men with leprosy were just outside the gate of Samaria. They said to each other, Why should we sit here, waiting to die?.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni ku bɛ naa min o kpambaliba, ka zali n nam ʒiishee Ɛlam.
en: I will establish my rule in Elam and dispose of its king and officials, declares the LORD.

dag: N ni ti nyo Damaskus gooni la buɣim, ka di di Bɛnhadad kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la.
en: I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will burn up the fortresses of Ben-hadad.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka yi niŋ, ka n shini, ka yi tɛhi ni m bemi kaman yinim la. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n wuhi ya yi taali, ka galim ya.
en: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, God is just like us! But now I will accuse you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Mɔdɛkai Ɛsta ni yɛli shɛm.
en: When Mordecai received Esther's message.

dag: Amaa m bihi, yi nyɛla Naawuni niriba ka pun nyaŋ anab ʒirinim maa, dama Shi so ŋun be yi ni maa mali yiko gari shi so ŋun be dunianim ni.
en: But you belong to God, my children, and have defeated the false prophets, because the Spirit who is in you is more powerful than the spirit in those who belong to the world.

dag: Piimi n wuhibu ŋɔ ka chɛ anzinfa. Piimi baŋsim ka chɛ salima din viɛla.
en: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Din kariya, n yi di mi ni m ba lo a zaɣ biɛɣu n naan ku yɛl a.
en: Jonathan answered, No, never! If I learn that my father plans to hurt you, I will warn you.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka n sɔɣi. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti yɛri ma, Yiɣimi kaman nooŋa la n-chaŋ zoya zuɣu?.
en: I trust in the Lord , so why did you tell me to run and hide? Why did you say, Fly like a bird to your mountain.

dag: M bi sɔɣi a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla n suhu ni, n kul yɛr a ʒiɛyimtali min a sɔŋsim maa yɛla. M bi sɔɣ a ʒiɛyimtali min a yurilim maŋli yɛla niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni.
en: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.

dag: Pita ni daa nya o maa ka o bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula.
en: When Peter saw him, he asked Jesus, Lord, what about this man.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ dunoli, ka so yi doli ma kpe, o ni tiligi. O ni doli ma kpɛri ka yira, ka nyari dihili.
en: I am the gate. Whoever enters through me will be saved. They will be able to come in and go out. They will find everything they need.

dag: Timiya sokam zaa jilima. Yumiya mabihili. Lumiya Naawuni sizuura. Timiya Nazuɣu jilima.
en: Show respect for all people. Love your brothers and sisters in Gods family. Respect God, and honor the king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama ti yɛl o Sool ni niŋ o shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka o mini Samuɛl daa chaŋ ti be Naiɔt.
en: Meanwhile, David went to Samuel at Ramah and told him what Saul had done. Then Samuel and David went to Prophets Village and stayed there.

dag: ni Libina naa ni Adulam naa.
en: Libnah, Adullam.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa kuhi yɛli ma, Nyama, wɔr shɛb bɛn zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la nyɛla bɛn chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu maai.
en: Then he called out and said to me, Look, the ones going north have provided rest for my spirit in the north.

dag: Ka Pool daa yaa chaŋ bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Vuhim Dabisa buta pa taba, ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla.
en: Paul went into the synagogue to see the Jews as he always did. The next three weeks, on each Sabbath day, he discussed the Scriptures with them.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ di ku ba, amaa ni bɛ nahimmi ba mi chira anu, ka bɛ mi yi dim nira, di biɛrim ŋmanila nɔŋ dimbu biɛrim.
en: They were not given the power to kill them but only to cause them pain for five months—pain like a person feels when stung by a scorpion.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijiptinim mini Firawuna nuu ni maa.
en: Jethro said, Bless the LORD who rescued you from the Egyptians power and from Pharaohs power, who rescued the people from Egypts oppressive power.

dag: Ninvuɣ tuhili ni ti lu n-do a luɣili polo, ka tuhi pia lu n-do a nudirigu polo, amaa di ti ku miri nyin na.
en: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.

dag: ka su wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ, ka woligi neesim ka chɛ zibisim. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. God saw how good it was.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi ya yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa, ka laɣim ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa na nti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya.
en: Therefore, say, The LORD God proclaims: I will gather you from the nations, assemble you from the countries where you were scattered, and I will give you Israels fertile land.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: They started to argue among themselves: What shall we say? If we answer, From God, he will say, Why, then, did you not believe John.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali shee zɔntua, ka di nyɛ mita anahi.
en: Then he measured the porch.

dag: Dama n fabila n-leei m bindirigu, ka n ŋuhibu galisi kaman kɔzɔrim la.
en: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi ti deei piɛɣu maa yi nuu ni n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: The priest will take the basket from you and place it before the altar of the Lord your God.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba bɛn be kasi. Yawɛ n-daa pii ya dunia ŋɔ zuliya pam sunsuuni n-leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: You belong to the Lord your God; he has chosen you to be his own people from among all the peoples who live on earth.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa loya ni a ni darigi ti tibili, ka mi shiri niŋ lala. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a kul tumdila din tuhi, dama tinima n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu.
en: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya leei n niriba, ka leei yi Naawuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yihi ya Ijiptinim ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: You will be my people and I will be your God. I am the Lord your God, and you will know that I made you free from Egypt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti bol o bia Sulemaana na ti yɛl o ni o mɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: David sent for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a temple for the LORD, the God of Israel.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ saa salan saa mibu saha. Yawɛ n-chɛ ka saa sagbana zaani mira, ka di chɛ ka sokam puri bindira niŋda.
en: I, the Lord , am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Sana n-nyɛ ma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Gɛrishom.
en: who bore him a son. Moses said to himself, I am a foreigner in this land, and so I name him Gershom.

dag: Ka Naa daa zan o zaashee n-lo alikauli Yawɛ tooni ni o ni jɛmd o, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa ni o shia zaa, ka niŋ kaman alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi kundi maa puuni ni wuhi shɛm.
en: He stood by the royal column and made a covenant with the Lord to obey him, to keep his laws and commands with all his heart and soul, and to put into practice the demands attached to the covenant, as written in the book.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N daa yihila liɣiri pam da Rom tiŋbitali. Ka Pool yɛl o, Bɛ kul dɔɣila mani Rom tiŋbia.
en: The commander replied, It cost me a lot of money to buy my citizenship. Paul said, Im a citizen by birth.

dag: Ka a yi ka shɛli, nyin wumma; foma, ka n wuh a yɛm.
en: Otherwise, listen in silence to my wisdom.

dag: Ka nahu kam mini piɛɣu kam ŋun pahiri pia ka nyɛ biŋkɔbigul ni guli so nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: The priests will take every tenth animal from a persons cattle or sheep. Every tenth animal will belong to the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka bɛ gbibi n zaligunima, di yi pa lala bɛ yi birigi li, bɛ ni kpe alahichi ni di zuɣu ka kpi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: All priests shall observe the regulations that I have given. Otherwise, they will become guilty and die, because they have disobeyed the sacred regulations. I am the Lord and I make them holy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mali o ni su binshɛlikam maa zaa yiko, amaa lee miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shih o. Di saha ka Sintani daa yi Yawɛ sani chaŋ.
en: All right, the Lord said to Satan, everything he has is in your power, but you must not hurt Job himself. So Satan left.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Yi yi ti nya binshɛli din chihiri Naawuni sani la, ka di ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu Luɣ Kasi Shee, kaman Anabi Daniɛl ni daa pun yɛli di yɛla la, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm!.
en: Someday you will see that Horrible Thing in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!.

dag: Miriya ka yi tum alahichi yi sujee puuni, tɛhimiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli yi yi ti do yi gom shee, ka shini.
en: Tremble with fear, and stop sinning. Think about this when you go to bed, and calm down. Selah.

dag: Dama bɛ ni na be bɛ nyɛvili ni ŋɔ, ŋun kɔhi maa ku lan nya o ni kɔhi shɛli maa, dama ʒii maa yɛrila bɛ zaa yɛla, ka di mi ku vuui, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, bɛ ti ku lan mali bɛ nyɛviya.
en: No merchants will live long enough to get back what they have lost, because God's anger is on everyone. Those who are evil cannot survive.

dag: Pa dunia ŋɔ shia ka ti deei, amaa Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna ka ti deei ni ti tooi baŋ pin shɛŋa Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ti.
en: We have not received this world's spirit; instead, we have received the Spirit sent by God, so that we may know all that God has given us.

dag: O daa zaŋla omaŋ tabil o ka bɛ be Ɛziɔngɛba m-maani ŋarima ni bɛ zaŋdi li chani Speen.
en: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chɛ bɛ lansi maa ka dol o.
en: Right away, they left their nets and followed him.

dag: ka bindira balibu kam din nyɛ bɛ ni daa she shɛli ti Firawuna be piɛ shɛli din tam zuɣusaa ni, amaa ka noombihi lee kana ti diri li n zuɣu ni piɛri maa ni.
en: In the top basket there were all kinds of baked food for the king, but birds were eating this food.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana ti kpaag o kaman bɛ ni kpaari wain di duɣuri ni shɛm la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duɣuri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But now, I will send enemies to pour out the wine and smash the jars!.

dag: Mbusim be yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi wuhiri ni nir yi po Naawuni jɛmbu duu di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po salima din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: How terrible it will be for you blind guides who say, If people swear by the temple, its nothing. But if people swear by the gold in the temple, they are obligated to do what they swore.

dag: O daa fa li la Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknim sani, ni o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza Rɛhɔb bia ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la ka di neen shɛŋa la zaa.
en: Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek, including the plunder of Zobahs King Hadadezer, Rehobs son.

dag: Yurilim bi mali dimaŋ kuuna bee n-ʒiɛmdi so. Yurilim bi zabiri dimaŋ yubu zuɣu; di bi mali suhuyiɣisili; di mi bi zaŋdi yɛla niŋdi suhu ni.
en: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.

dag: Yi yihi n niriba paɣiba bɛ yiya din viɛl ni, ka yihi n daalibarika bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord .

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn Baptaizira ti kana; di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛ kul mooni Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ, ka ŋunkam suhu ye di zuɣu kul zaŋdila kpiɔŋ ni o ti kpe di ni.
en: Before John the Baptizer came, people were taught the Law of Moses and the writings of the prophets. But since the time of John, the Good News about Gods kingdom is being told. And everyone is trying hard to get into it.

dag: N daa bela yi sani ni chɔɣinsi mini dabeenzɔbo ni ni sɔhibu.
en: So when I came to you, I was weak and trembled all over with fear.

dag: Ka Jɛzibɛl daa tim ti yɛli Ilaija, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n yi sa bi ku a kaman a ni ku anabinim ŋɔ shɛm maa, n wuna bɛn kum ma.
en: She sent a message to Elijah: You killed my prophets. Now I'm going to kill you! I pray that the gods will punish me even more severely if I don't do it by this time tomorrow.

dag: dama di ŋmanila buɣim sala ka a zaŋ pa bɛ zuɣuri ni maa. Ka Yawɛ ni ti a di laara.
en: This will make them feel the burning pain of shame, and the Lord will reward you for being good to them.

dag: Dindali maa n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli min o yiŋnim polo la ni ti niŋ pali, di piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: On that day I will carry out all my threats against Eli's family, from beginning to end.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa gɔb chinchin piɛlli kɔŋko doli Yisa, ka bɛ daa yɛn gbaag o gba.
en: One young man, a disciple, was wearing nothing but a linen cloth. They grabbed him.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sanʒiɛɣu ni yi nuzaa polo kanna, ka sagban titali daa beni, ka neesim gil li, ka buɣim daa kul nyaɣisira, ka binshɛli daa be buɣim maa sunsuuni kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: As I watched, suddenly a driving storm came out of the north, a great cloud flashing fire, with brightness all around. At its center, in the middle of the fire, there was something like gleaming amber.

dag: Ka so mi beni, o ka suhupiɛlli, ka ti kpi ni suhugarigu.
en: But another person dies after a hard life that has made them bitter, never having enjoyed anything good.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ gbantolima lo Pool naai ka o bɔhi sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani, Di luhiya ni yi fiɛbi Rom tiŋbia ka na bi kar o saria ŋ-ŋmaag o yɛtɔɣa.
en: As they were stretching him out and tying him down with straps, Paul said to the centurion standing there, Can you legally whip a Roman citizen who hasnt been found guilty in court.

dag: Ka Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia nira, ka nyɛ yuun pihiyɔbunaayi nir la daa deei nam maa di.
en: and Darius the Mede, who was then sixty-two years old, seized the royal power.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ gulila m ba piɛri, ka gbuɣinli bee kunduŋ daa yi ti kana ti gbaai piɛbila guui;.
en: But David told him: Your Majesty, I take care of my father's sheep. And when one of them is dragged off by a lion or a bear.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi di bi lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli, ka zali zuɣusaa mini dunia zaligunima.
en: The Lord says, If my agreement with day and night does not continue, and if I had not made the laws for the sky and earth, maybe I would leave those people.

dag: Bɛ yihi ba neesim ni m-bahi zibisim ni, ka kari ba yihi dunia yili.
en: They will be forced from light into darkness. They will be chased out of this world.

dag: N chɛ ka baɣisi leei jɛra, ka chɛ ka baŋdiba bɛn yɛri binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla birinda; ka chɛ ka yɛnnim baŋsim leei jɛrilim.
en: who frustrates the omens of diviners and makes a mockery of magicians, who turns back the wise and turns their knowledge into folly.

dag: Naa Sulemaana n-daa diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: King Solomon ruled over all Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa o karimbaani maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa bi lu bɛ zuɣu Hɛzɛkia ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: However, Hezekiah and the citizens of Jerusalem humbled themselves in their pride, and so they didnt experience the LORDs anger for the rest of Hezekiahs reign.

dag: Ka pirinsi maa daa lab ti yɛli sariakaritib maa Pool ni yɛli shɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba bɛ ni daa wum ni Pool mini Silas nyɛla Rom tiŋbihi maa zuɣu;.
en: The police reported this to the legal authorities, who were alarmed to learn that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Hazɛrɔt saha shɛli maa ka Miriam mini Aduna daa galim Musa o ni daa kpuɣi Itiɔpia paɣ so la zuɣu, dama o daa kpuɣila Itiɔpia zuliya ni paɣa.
en: Moses had married a Cushite woman, and Miriam and Aaron criticized him for it.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi tirisi tooni nti lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka so daa bi lan niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yaha; dinzuɣu ka o daa boli di mi yuli Rɛhɔbɔt ka yɛra, Yawɛ yipa ti ti luɣ shɛli din mali palo pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti ni tɔŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Isaac moved from there and dug another well. No one came to argue about this well. So Isaac named it Rehoboth. He said, Now the Lord has found a place for us. We will grow and be successful in this place.

dag: Ka bɛ daa me goon ŋmaa zali du bila kam tooni, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu, ka di barilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu di yaɣa zaa, ka dubihi buɣisibu nyɛ mita atata di yaɣa zaa.
en: There was a low wall in front of each room. That wall was cubit tall and cubit thick. The rooms were square. Each wall was cubits long.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-niŋ ya alaka, ka kun ya; ka zuliya kam ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: They will arrest you, abuse you, and they will kill you. All nations will hate you on account of my name.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko n-daa wuh o soli, ka tinzun buɣili daa ka o sani.
en: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, A ni nya ka salo daar a ŋ-ŋɔ, ka a ti bɔhi ni ŋuni n-lee shih a.
en: His disciples answered, You see how the people are crowding you; why do you ask who touched you.

dag: Naa suhu nyɛla kɔzɔrim m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o ŋmaligiri li kpari o ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi zani, dama nandaamba nyari nahiŋgu, ka faranim mi kul ŋuhira. N ni ti ba faako shɛli bɛ suhuri ni bɔri maa.
en: But now I will come, says the Lord , because the needy are oppressed and the persecuted groan in pain. I will give them the security they long for.

dag: Anabi Ilaisha saha la kɔnsi pam daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa bɛ so daa bi nya tibbu; Siria do so ŋun yuli daa booni Neeman la kɔŋko n-daa nya tibbu.
en: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.

dag: A nini yi nya shɛli, nyin di bo yomyom zaŋ li tahi kootu ni, dama a kpee yi ti dih a vi, di nyaaŋa wula ka a yɛn niŋ?.
en: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba bɛn laɣim maa zaa, M bia Sulemaana n-nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so, ka o mi na nyɛ bi polli, ka bi mi tuma looloochi, ka tuma maa mi zooi; dama pa ninsal duu ka ti yɛn me, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ka ti yɛn me maa.
en: Then King David said to the whole assembly: My son Solomon, the one whom God chose, is too inexperienced for this great task, since this temple wont be for humans but for the LORD God.

dag: Di saha ka o naanyi kahigi yɛli ba, Lazarɔs kpimi;.
en: Jesus told them plainly, Lazarus has died.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim Juda ni o daŋmi tooni ti yɛli Yisifu ka o wuhi ba soli din kuni Goshɛn; ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jacob sent Judah ahead to ask Joseph to meet them in Goshen. When they arrived.

dag: Daabi so ŋun mali ʒiri kuruwa nyɛla ŋun bɔri niriba ŋaribu.
en: The Lord says, The people of Israel are as dishonest as the Canaanites; they love to cheat their customers with false scales.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa zaŋ Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa yiŋa n-ti Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta. Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli naa ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla o dɔɣim. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Mɔdɛkai nya soli kpɛri naa sani.
en: Before the end of the day, King Xerxes gave Esther everything that had belonged to Haman, the enemy of the Jews. Esther told the king that Mordecai was her cousin. So the king made Mordecai one of his highest officials.

dag: Wuntaŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka goli viɛlim be di ko, ka saŋmar so viɛlim be di ko ka chɛ saŋmar so mi viɛlim.
en: The sun has one kind of beauty, the moon has another kind, and the stars have another. And each star is different in its beauty.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara mini kawana ni chi sara maligu ni alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ni taali sanyoo sara maligu ni maligumaana leebu sara maligu ni suhudoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the laws about burnt offerings, grain offerings, sin offerings, guilt offerings, fellowship offerings, and offerings for when the priests are appointed.

dag: Yi kul nahindi yimaŋa n-chani bɔri buɣa shee ni yi jɛm li, ka bi yɛri ni di ka buchi. Yi tɛhiya ni dina n-tiri ya kpiɔŋ, ka yi bi gbarigira.
en: All of them made you tired, but you never gave up. You found new strength, because you enjoyed them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ba yihi tin ya, yin di yɛliya yi suhuri ni, Ti wuntitali zuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Di nyɛla niriba maa ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu ka Yawɛ kari ba tin ya maa.
en: After the Lord your God has driven them out for you, do not say to yourselves that he brought you in to possess this land because you deserved it. No, the Lord is going to drive these people out for you because they are wicked.

dag: Ham bidibisi mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ tinsi ni bɛ zuliyazuliya yɛtɔɣ kɔŋkɔba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the descendants of Ham, living in their different tribes and countries, each group speaking its own language.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli Zɛrubabɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Pa a kpiɔŋ bee a yiko zuɣu, amaa n Shia yiko zuɣu.
en: He answered me: This is the LORDs word to Zerubbabel: Neither by power, nor by strength, but by my spirit, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Yi mi ni di bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo Keenannim bɛn be Araba la tiŋgban ni. Tiŋgbani din be Giligal tooni polo m-baɣi Mɔre oki tia la.
en: These two mountains are west of the Jordan River in the territory of the Canaanites who live in the Jordan Valley. They are toward the west, not far from the sacred trees of Moreh near the town of Gilgal.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yuli n-daa booni Gɛrishom, dama o daa yɛlimi, N nyɛla sana m-be saan tiŋa.
en: and Gershom and Eliezer, her two sons. Moses had said, I have been a foreigner in a strange land; so he had named one son Gershom.

dag: Ti zaŋdi galigɛnima n-lɛri yuri ni bɛ tum ti yubu, ka ti ŋmaligiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa kpari ti ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: When we bridle horses and put bits in their mouths to lead them wherever we want, we can control their whole bodies.

dag: Di nahindiya pakoya mini kpibisi ni tinzunnim bɛn be yi ni zaŋ tabili nandaamba. Yi mi di lɔnya yi kpee zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. .
en: Dont hurt widows and orphans, strangers, or poor people. Dont even think of doing bad things to each other.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa Naawuni ʒii nyabu maa puuni n-zaŋ ma chaŋ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani. Di saha ka n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli maa daa chɛ ma.
en: In the vision the spirit of God lifted me up and brought me back to the exiles in Babylonia. Then the vision faded.

dag: N niŋdi lala ni di chɛ ka bɛ malila suhukpeeni ka laɣim zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili taba yurilim puuni, ka lan mali yɛlimaŋli baŋsim din tahiri tahima zaa din ŋmani azichi na. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ baŋ Naawuni ashili din nyɛ Masia maŋmaŋ la.
en: I do this in order that they may be filled with courage and may be drawn together in love, and so have the full wealth of assurance which true understanding brings. In this way they will know God's secret, which is Christ himself.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni bi niŋ din tuhi? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!.

dag: Ti mi ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri Naawuni ka nyɛ o ni daŋ pii shɛb o nia lɔbu ni la sani, ŋun Naawuni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋdila bɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: We know that God works all things together for good for the ones who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Di bi to ni mahim chaŋ tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia, dinzuɣu chɛ ka di labila nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Hezekiah answered, It is an easy thing for the shadow to go down ten steps. No, make the shadow go back ten steps.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni n kul lɔri nia ni n ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ yi ni shɛb ka bɛ niŋ Yisa yɛda kaman n ni pun niŋ shɛm bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb san la; amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa kul guri ma soli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.

dag: O chɛ ka ti tahi a nasara dibu suhupiɛlli tahigu, ka sa ti tuutanim ti Naawuni yuli zuɣu. Yawɛ deem a suhigu zaa.
en: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!.

dag: Di saha maa, n shiri ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ yi dab bidibisi mini yi dab bipuɣinsi ni.
en: In those days, I will also pour out my spirit on the male and female slaves.

dag: Ka naa kpamba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, tinim bɛn nyɛ a kpamba ŋɔ mali shili ni ti niŋ nyini n dan naa ni lo shɛli.
en: Yes, Your Majesty, they answered. We are ready to do whatever you say.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni, ka paɣi ni ti yi ti niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ ti be ti Duuma sani.
en: So I say that we have confidence. And we really want to be away from this body and be at home with the Lord.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei paɣ shɛb niriba bɛn daa kpi kum ni ti ba. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaɣisi yolisim shɛli din nyɛ daadamnim dini, ka nya azaaba hal ti kpi di puuni ni bɛ ti neei kum ni m-mali nyɛvili din so.
en: Through faith women received their dead relatives raised back to life. Others, refusing to accept freedom, died under torture in order to be raised to a better life.

dag: Yɛm bi bela ninkura sani, ka baŋsim mi bi bela nir yuusim ni?.
en: In old age is wisdom; understanding in a long life.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti kpimsi Ɛdom yɛnnima; ka kpimsi Iso Zoli zuɣunim baŋsim.
en: Wont I on that day, says the LORD, destroy the wise from Edom and understanding from Mount Esau?.

dag: nti kul be Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.

dag: Niŋmiya shɛlikam zaa ni yurilim!.
en: Everything should be done in love.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani buɣim sal nɛma, ka ŋmani buɣim mokpala chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa binnɛma maa sunsuuni. Buɣim maa daa ne pam, ka saa nyaɣisibu daa yiri buɣim maa ni na.
en: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛ yino ka o ti lu bɔɣ zilinli ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku yaag o di ni?.
en: Jesus answered, If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a ditch on the Sabbath day, you will take the sheep and help it out of the ditch.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pia dali, yin lomiya noli ka laɣim jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: Gather for worship on the tenth day of the seventh month; eat no food and do no work.

dag: O daa gbaag o bia mali maligu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka daa buɣiri baɣisi, ka chani bukpahinim mini takatibinim ni jinwariba sani. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Naawuni sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He sacrificed his son as a burnt offering. He practiced divination and magic and consulted fortunetellers and mediums. He sinned greatly against the Lord and stirred up his anger.

dag: Nyini n-su zuɣusaa, ka su tiŋgbani gba; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, nyini n-daa nam li.
en: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them.

dag: Ka Jɔsia daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa Izraɛl nanim ni daa me n-zali Samaria n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi la zaa kaman o ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbina la shɛm la.
en: Some of the Israelite kings had made the Lord angry by building pagan shrines all over Israel. So Josiah sent troops to destroy these shrines just as he had done to the one in Bethel.

dag: Ka Sool daa yiɣisi zani n-neeg o nina ka bi lan ne; ka bɛ daa gbaag o nuu ni n-vo o hal ni Damaskus.
en: After they picked Saul up from the ground, he opened his eyes but he couldnt see. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

dag: Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ tuumba? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ anabinima? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ karimbanima? Bɛ zaa n-tumd alahiziba tumtumsa?.
en: All arent apostles, are they? All arent prophets, are they? All arent teachers, are they? All dont perform miracles, do they?.

dag: Wuna maa ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋa. Bɛ gbahi ba kaman daba la chaŋ. Babilɔn wuna maa bahigu m-bala!.
en: The idols cannot save themselves; they are captured and carried away. This is the end for Babylon's gods!.

dag: Ka o ni yɛli shɛm maa min anabinim yɛligu doli taba kaman di ni sab yɛli shɛm la:.
en: This agrees with what the prophets wrote.

dag: ka kuhiri yɛri zoya maa mini tampima maa, Lumiya ti zuɣu na n-lim ti ka ti sɔɣi yi ni, ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni nini ku lan nya ti, ka Piɛbil ŋɔ mi suhuyiɣisili yɛlli ŋɔ ku paai ti.
en: They called out to the mountains and to the rocks, Fall on us and hide us from the eyes of the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb!.

dag: Bɛ gɔŋla bɛ zilima ka di be kaman tɔbiri la; bɛ mali yaa pam tiŋgbani maa ni zaŋ chaŋ ʒiri ŋmabu polo, ka pa ni yɛlimaŋli polo. Dama bɛ kul tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka bi mi ma, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They bend their tongues like bows to spew out lies; they are renowned in the land, but not for truth. They go from bad to worse. They dont know me! declares the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa lih o yurilim lihigu ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a: Cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: Jesus looked closely at the man. He liked him and said, There's one thing you still need to do. Go sell everything you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come with me.

dag: Naawuni daanfaani maa zuɣu ka yi tiligi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Ka di bi yila yi kɔbili ni na, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: I mean that you have been saved by grace because you believed. You did not save yourselves; it was a gift from God.

dag: O daa gbaag o bia mali maligu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka daa buɣiri baɣisi, ka chani bukpahinim mini takatibinim ni jinwariba sani. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Naawuni sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He burned his own son alive, consulted sign readers and fortune-tellers, and used mediums and diviners. He did much evil in the LORDs eyes and made him angry.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya takɔbi ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb na nti ti naa.
en: Get me a sword! They brought a sword to the king.

dag: Yisifu daa piila o biɛyanim maa ni niriba anu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti wuhi Firawuna.
en: Joseph chose five of his brothers to be with him before the Pharaoh.

dag: Ka Sisɛra ma daa vɔbisiri lihiri takɔro ni. O daa kul vɔbisiri lihirila takɔro maa voya ni ka bɔhira, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ti yuui kundina lala? Bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka di yuui ka ti kul bi wumd o yuri napɔn chinchiba damli.
en: Sisera's mother looked out of the window; she gazed from behind the lattice. Why is his chariot so late in coming? she asked. Why are his horses so slow to return.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli naa maa, Daniɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda daba la ni yino la bi lihi nya a bee n-dol a ni zali zaligu shɛli maa. O kul suhirila o Naawuni siɣimsiɣim butata dahin yini puuni.
en: Then they said to the king, Daniel, one of the exiles from Judah, does not respect Your Majesty or obey the order you issued. He prays regularly three times a day.

dag: ka o lihi n-nya Yisa ni chani ha ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbil la ha.
en: when he saw Jesus walking by. There is the Lamb of God! he said.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa zaŋ buɣim ni daa di ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni daa zaŋ daanya tulaale tuɣindi labihi shɛŋa ti Naawuni maa n-kuri gbiŋgbarinlinsi pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar.

dag: O zaŋla o nuzaa gbaai n zuɣu mali, ka zaŋ o nudirigu bɔbindi ma.
en: My lovers left arm is under my head, and his right arm holds me.

dag: Hal o bi dih o tumtumdib tabili, o nyar o malaikanim chirimbu.
en: If he doesnt trust his servants and levels a charge against his messengers.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini.
en: Can worry make you live longer?.

dag: Ka ŋun Firawuna daa pirig o nuu ni nintu shɛli o ni mali dalindi binyara n-zaŋ li piri Yisifu, ka zaŋ bimpiɛl viɛlli kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ salima dolibi yɛl o;.
en: The king removed from his finger the ring engraved with the royal seal and put it on Joseph's finger. He put a fine linen robe on him, and placed a gold chain around his neck.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi bɛn be Laodisia mini paɣ so ŋun yuli booni Nimfa la ni yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ti ma.
en: Give our best wishes to the believers in Laodicea and to Nympha and the church that meets in her house.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla naa ni yu shɛli, ka o yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: and like honesty and truth.

dag: ka n chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni a ku kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga n-ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Now I want you to make a promise to me. Promise to me before the Lord , the God of heaven and earth, that you will not allow my son to marry a girl from Canaan. We live among these people, but dont let him marry a Canaanite girl.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli zali maa zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili gili. Dina n-nyɛ luɣ kasi shee zaŋ tabili tiŋ maa tiŋgban la.
en: The entire portion that you will set aside is . miles by . miles, a square; it includes the holy portion in addition to the city property.

dag: N fabili yi zuɣu gari n ni fabindi Jazanim zuɣu shɛm. Yinim Sibimanima, yi ŋmanila wain tia din wula baai du teeku n-zo hal ti paai Jaza. Ŋun saɣindi la lu yi siɣili saha tiwala mini yi wain tiwala zuɣu.
en: People of Sibmah, you were like a vineyard heavy with grapes, and with branches reaching north to the town of Jazer and west to the Dead Sea. But you have been destroyed, and so I will weep for you, as the people of Jazer weep for the vineyards.

dag: A bia maa ni ti bemi kaman mɔɣu ni buŋ la. O ti ku bɔri so yɛla, ka so gba ti ku bɔr o yɛla; ka o min o dɔɣiriba zaa ti ku tooi laɣim be.
en: But your son will live far from his relatives; he will be like a wild donkey, fighting everyone, and everyone fighting him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ gbantolima lo Pool naai ka o bɔhi sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani, Di luhiya ni yi fiɛbi Rom tiŋbia ka na bi kar o saria ŋ-ŋmaag o yɛtɔɣa.
en: So the soldiers were tying Paul, preparing to beat him. But he said to an army officer there, Do you have the right to beat a Roman citizen who has not been proven guilty.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni tintariga daa zaŋla Mɛsha hal ti paai Sɛfar din be wulimpuhili polo zoya ni la.
en: They lived in the area between Mesha and the hill country in the East. Mesha was toward the country of Sephar.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya yi daɣiri zaa ni, ka chɛ ka yi bindira niŋ pam ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu.
en: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.

dag: N yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ mi ni yi di chɛ ka so zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa yɔhim ya.
en: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.

dag: mɔɣu ni mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Tihi din be nyɔŋ puuni zaa, yi gba yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila.
en: be glad, fields, and everything in you! The trees in the woods will shout for joy.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbibi n jɛmbu duu maa, ka tumdi di puuni tuun shɛli zaa din simdi tumbu.
en: But I will let them take care of the Temple. They will work in the Temple and do the things that must be done in it.

dag: Bɛnjamin daŋ ni; Ɛliada ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn nyɛ peentɔriba ka gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi la.
en: From Benjamin came a valiant warrior: Eliada, together with two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntia tuma sahakam mali alibarika.
en: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋdi yi ni tuui ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini tiri Yawɛ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: You will give a gift offering from the first bread you bake for all time.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi ni laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: I repeat: it is much harder for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God than for a camel to go through the eye of a needle.

dag: chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bidibis ayopɔin ti ti ka ti zaŋ ba chaŋ Gibiɔn nti ku ba Yawɛ zol la zuɣu ŋun Yawɛ tooni. Ka naa daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ ba tin ya.
en: So hand over seven of his male descendants, and we will hang them before the Lord at Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, the Lord 's chosen king. I will hand them over, the king answered.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim maa sunsuuni; ka yi daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa vuri, amaa ka lee bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, kukoli kɔŋko n-daa kul beni.
en: The LORD spoke to you out of the very fire itself. You heard the sound of words, but you didnt see any form. There was only a voice.

dag: N di yuya ni n niriba maa wum n yɛligu; n di yuya ni Izraɛlnim doli n soya!.
en: If my people would listen to me and would live the way I want.

dag: ka a zuliya ni ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka yi ni yɛligi kpa wulinluhili polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a min a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: Your descendants will become like the dust of the earth; you will spread out to the west, east, north, and south. Every family of earth will be blessed because of you and your descendants.

dag: Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buyi. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buyi. Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buta. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buta.
en: Then he said, Fill four jars with water. Pour the water on the pieces of meat and on the wood. Then Elijah said, Do it again. Then he said, Do it a third time.

dag: O ni daa kul kpuɣ o nuu maa tiri saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la dii vaai yiɣisi bɛ dooshee ti kpe tiŋ maa ni n-deei li ka niŋ buɣim nyo li yomyom bahi.
en: The ambush quickly rose from its place. As soon as he reached out his hand, it charged. They entered the city and captured it. They set the city on fire at once.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: But Peter answered, I will never say I dont know you! I will even die with you! And all the other followers said the same thing.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na ni ti kɔri bɛ puri nimaani.
en: The city workers from all the tribes of Israel will farm this land.

dag: M-pahi Bɛɔr bia Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ baɣa, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔb ku o pahi bɛ ni daa pun ku shɛb zuɣu la.
en: Among those whom the people of Israel killed was the fortune teller Balaam son of Beor.

dag: O daa bi gbaag omaŋa o sujee ni, o mi daa bi tiligi bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ka daa chɛ ka alɔbo di ba.
en: He found a way to show his anger. He did not spare their lives. He let them die with a deadly disease.

dag: Yawɛ tim a a ni tum shɛm maa laara. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni so baɣiri ni a ni kana ni a ti sɔɣ ŋɔ ni ti a laara din galisi.
en: May the LORD reward you for your deed. May you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings youve come to seek refuge.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darig a tibili kaman a ni daa niŋ shɛm maa, nyin ŋun bi lihi nya pɔri, ka saɣim alikauli ŋɔ.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, I will treat you the way you deserve, because you ignored your promises and broke the covenant.

dag: Saha shɛli o ni daa zali pɔhim di tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka buɣisi kom tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm la.
en: In order to weigh the wind, to prepare a measure for waters.

dag: Dama o ni ŋubiri mɔ shɛŋa bela zoya ni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ni diɛmda.
en: He eats the grass that grows on the hills where the wild animals play.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ titali nyɛla ŋun tumdi din doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa.
en: But an honorable person plans honorable things and stands up for what is honorable.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri nyɛla n ʒim. Ka Yaakubu daa be o sani goli yini.
en: Laban said, Yes, indeed, you are my own flesh and blood. Jacob stayed there a whole month.

dag: Kaman sala buɣim ni tahiri biisim na, ka dari chɛ ka buɣim diri shɛm, lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili chɛ ka zabili neera.
en: Charcoal keeps the coals glowing, wood keeps the fire burning, and troublemakers keep arguments alive.

dag: Ka Leeban mini Bɛtuɛl daa yɛl o, Yɛlli ŋɔ ni yila Yawɛ sani ŋɔ na, dindina ti ku tooi yɛl a din bie bee din viɛl zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Laban and Bethuel both responded, This is all the LORDs doing. We have nothing to say about it.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm yi nya ka barina kanna bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa bɛn ka yɛm bɛn ni chaŋ ti kpe di ni n-di wahala.
en: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.

dag: Musa daa zaŋla o paɣa Zipɔra labisi ka o deemba Jɛtro daa deeg.
en: So he came to Moses, bringing with him Moses' wife Zipporah, who had been left behind.

dag: Yi ni ti booi kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-bahi Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini di puuni nɛma zaa zuɣu, ka malimali di mini di puuni binyɛra zaa, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Then dedicate the Tent and all its equipment by anointing it with the sacred oil, and it will be holy.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: M Ba, a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma la, m bi chɛ ka bɛ ni yino bɔrigi.
en: Then everything will happen, just as I said, I did not lose anyone you gave me. .
