dag: Ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani, ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ nya Yisa taali ka fiɣis o. Ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nira chɛ ka so kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: where there was a man whose hand was paralyzed. Some Pharisees wanted to accuse Jesus of doing something wrong, so they asked him, Is it right to heal someone on the Sabbath.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira, ka do yino paɣa kana ni o ti fa o yidana ŋun bur o maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o nuu gbaag o tooni.
en: If two men are having a fight and the wife of one tries to help her husband by grabbing hold of the other man's genitals.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N chɛ ka biisim ku yi bindira, ka chɛ ka toli saɣim yi puri mini yi tihi puri ni yi fiig tihi ni yi olivi tihi, di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I sent a scorching wind to dry up your crops. The locusts ate up all your gardens and vineyards, your fig trees and olive trees. Still you did not come back to me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yɛrigi nuzaa polo sagbana limsi vau, ka daa bi zaŋ dunia ŋɔ yili binshɛli.
en: God stretched out the northern sky and hung the earth in empty space.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi puhina m-bii ni tulim n-kpe mɔri, di puma kpahirimi lu ka di viɛlim gba kpaai. Lala ka azichilana gba ni ti kpaai o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: The sun rises with its blazing heat and burns the plant; its flower falls off, and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way the rich will be destroyed while they go about their business.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ Naawuni ka pa ni nyini Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ tampiŋ ka pa ni ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: The Lord alone is God; God alone is our defense.

dag: A ni ti kahi a nɛma yina wuntaŋ ni bɛ ninni kaman nira ni yɛn zo kuŋkɔɣim ka kahi o nɛma shɛm la, ka a ti yi bɛ ninni zaawuni kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la.
en: During the day, take your bags outside so that the people can see you. Then in the evening, pretend you are going away. Act as if you are a prisoner going to a faraway country.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka di zaa laɣim bi, ka chɛbu saha ti paai ka n yɛli bɛn yɛn chɛ li: Daŋmiya piriŋkpana la chɛbu n-laɣim li lo bɔba n-nyo buɣim, amaa ka chɛ alikama la zaa n-laɣimna nti niŋ n kambɔŋ ni. .
en: Let the weeds and the wheat grow together until the harvest time. At the harvest time I will tell the workers this: First, gather the weeds and tie them together to be burned. Then gather the wheat and bring it to my barn.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti laɣimna ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: One day, when the angels had gathered around the Lord , and Satan was there with them.

dag: Gɔhi mini zana m-be ninvuɣ biɛri sol zuɣu; yɛnnim bɛn ni laligi ka chɛ li.
en: Thorns and nets are in the path of the crooked; those who guard their lives keep their distance.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bantab viɛlli vil o zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bantab viɛlli maa vil o zuɣu maa, ka zaŋ binyɛr suŋ yɛl o; ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛya.
en: Then I said, Put a clean turban on his head. So they put the clean turban on him and also put clean clothes on him while the Lord s angel stood there.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa daa vaai yiɣisi tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm kɔbil shɛli din daa do di dunol shee maa nti tooi di kom na ti ti Dauda. Amaa ka o zaɣisi li nyubu, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Naawuni.
en: The Three Warriors sneaked into the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. But after they brought the water back to David, he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as a sacrifice.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ku zaɣis o niriba; o ku chɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda bahi.
en: The Lord will not abandon his people; he will not desert those who belong to him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ di kɔhigu nɛma mini di liɣiri ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ti ku zaŋ di shɛli sɔŋ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ di liɣiri maa da bindira pam ni situr shɛŋa di ni simdi ni bɛ mali.
en: Her profits and wages will be sacred to the LORD. They wont be stored or saved. Her profits will go to those living before the LORD, for plentiful food and elegant clothes.

dag: Nandaamba mini faranima ni ti lan nya suhupiɛl shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tiri la.
en: The Lord will make poor people happy. The poorest people will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Daliri din ni chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋa n-yaɣi n ni daa nya kahigibunim pam shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka go shɛli din be kaman Sintani tumo la kuhi ma n-kpalim be n niŋgbuŋ ni ni di muɣisi ma n-chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋ yaɣi.
en: But I must not be too proud of the wonderful things that were shown to me. So a painful problem was given to me—an angel from Satan, sent to make me suffer, so that I would not think that I am better than anyone else.

dag: Yawɛ, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, n sɔŋda, kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ma.
en: Lord , dont leave me! You are my strength—hurry and help me!.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Lihimiya, yi yi ti nya ka Amnɔn nyu wain kuli ka n yɛli ya, Kumiya Amnɔn, yin kumiy o. Di zɔriya dabiɛm, mani m-puhi ya. Maliya suhukpeeni ka tum bidibilim tuma.
en: Absalom commanded his servants, Be on the lookout! When Amnon is happy with wine and I tell you to strike Amnon down, then kill him! Dont be afraid, because I myself am giving you the order. Be brave and strong men.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛl ti di yɛla piligu ni ha ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ li, ka ŋuni n-daŋ yɛli di yɛla, ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni o mali yɛlimaŋli? So daa pun bi yɛli di yɛla, ka so bi zaŋ li moli; so mi pun bi wum yi yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Who announced this from the start so that we would know; from an earlier time so we would say, Thats right? Truly, no one announced it, no one proclaimed it, and no one heard your words.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi ka di daa lu o suhu ni ni o lab ti kaag o zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim la.
en: When Moses was about years old, he decided to visit his own people, the people of Israel.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sida dapaɣa kpahi duu maa nyaaŋa polo hal ti gbaai yɔɣira, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ kpahi di puuni gba lala ni di leei di puuni luɣ kasi shee, ka niŋ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi.
en: The most holy place was in the back of the temple, and it was nine meters square. Cedar boards standing from floor to ceiling separated it from the rest of the temple.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya, Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner said to Joab, Let's have some of the young men from each side fight an armed contest. All right, Joab answered.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Ilaija, ka o yiɣisi zo ni o tilig o nyɛvili. O daa zaŋla o tumo la n-zo n-kuli Bɛrishiiba din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti chɛ o nimaani.
en: Elijah was terrified. He got up and ran for his life. He arrived at Beer-sheba in Judah and left his assistant there.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii piri la.
en: It is like yeast that a woman mixes into a big bowl of flour to make bread. The yeast makes all the dough rise.

dag: Doo min o bia noya ni ti woli taba ka bɛ zaɣisi taba; ka paɣ min o bipuɣiŋga ti zaɣisi taba; ka paɣ ni ti zaɣis o bia paɣa, ka paɣ gba ti zaɣis o yidana ma.
en: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other.

dag: Amaa n ti ku yihi n suhu o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n suhu Sool ŋun daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: But I will not withdraw my support from him as I did from Saul, whom I removed so that you could be king.

dag: A chɛ ka nintam leei bɛ bindirigu, ka zaŋ nintam leei binnyurigu ti ba ka bɛ nyu pam.
en: You have given us sorrow to eat, a large cup of tears to drink.

dag: Paɣiba pam gba daa be nimaani n-kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni din niŋ maa. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn doli Yisa yi Galili na, ka nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o la.
en: Many women were standing away from the cross, watching. These were the women who had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for him.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa bɔri ni o ku Jɔn, amaa ka zɔri niriba, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni o nyɛla anabi.
en: Herod wanted to kill him, but he was afraid of the people. They believed that John was a prophet.

dag: M bia, wummi n yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka luɣi a tiba wum m baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Bend your ear to what I know.

dag: A wuntitali nyɛla wuntitali din bi naara, ka a zaligunim nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.

dag: di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Amɔz bia Aizaia, Pirigim a buɣu ŋɔ min a namda ŋɔ, ka o daa niŋ lala, ka chani o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa.
en: At that time the LORD had spoken through Isaiah, Amozs son, Go, take off the mourning clothes from your waist, and remove the shoes from your feet. And Isaiah did this, walking naked and barefoot.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Everyone ate and had enough. Then the disciples took up twelve baskets full of what was left over.

dag: O ni ti tibigi ma, dama n yɛla ka o ti yɛn zaŋ wuhi ya.
en: He will give me glory, because he will take what I say and tell it to you.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ba lala maa, ka zaŋ o nuhi min o puluɣili wuhi ba, ka di niŋ o nyaandoliba maa suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa nya bɛ Duuma maa zuɣu.
en: After he said this, he showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they were filled with joy.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kul lihiri tooni, ka a kul lihir a tooni tibi.
en: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n ni zaŋdi fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So you must be careful to obey the commands, laws, and rules that I give you today.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi tiŋgban ni n-chaŋ ti su kom ka ʒe kpam, ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛm o. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yi n-kuli yiŋa nti bɔhi bindirigu yɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di.
en: Then David got up from the floor. He washed himself. He changed his clothes and got dressed. Then he went into the Lord s house to worship. After that he went home and asked for something to eat. His servants gave him some food, and he ate.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Niriba maa zaŋ nɛma maa na pam n-gari ti ni bɔri shɛm tariga ni ti zaŋ tum Yawɛ ni zali ti ni ti tum tuun shɛli maa.
en: and say to Moses, The people are contributing way too much material for doing the work that the LORD has commanded us to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka m pun piligi kuri ya ni m bahi ya yoli yi daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.

dag: N ni guhi Yawɛ ŋun lɛb o nyaaŋa biri Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, ka niŋ o naani.
en: I will wait for the LORD, who has hidden his face from the house of Jacob, and I will hope in God.

dag: Dama ti Duuma ni boli so yi daa nyɛla dabili, o yipa nya yolisim ti Duuma sani. Lala n-nyɛ ŋun pun nyɛ bilichina ka ti Duuma bol o, dilan mi leela Masia dabili.
en: Anyone who was a slave when they were called by the Lord has the status of being the Lords free person. In the same way, anyone who was a free person when they were called is Christs slave.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya li lala ka di niŋ ba alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka fiig tia maa dii zani yim kuui lala.
en: The disciples saw this and were astounded. How did the fig tree dry up so quickly? they asked.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla kurugu alikalimi sabi Judanim daalahichi, ka zaŋ daimɔnd chiriga n-chirigi li pa bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ sara maligu bimbina binyila zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, People of Judah, your sin is written with an iron pen; it is engraved on your hearts with a diamond point and carved on the corners of your altars.

dag: N yiko din galisi puuni ka n daa teei n nuu nam dunia mini ninsalinima ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni, ka zaŋdi li tiri n nini ni tiɣi so.
en: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth.

dag: Lɔt daa ti yɛn paai Zɔa, ka wuntaŋ pun puhimi.
en: The sun was coming up as Lot reached the town of Zoar.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa mirig o nina kpa Hazaɛl n-kul lihir o hal ka vi ti gbaag o. Ka Ilaisha kumda.
en: Elisha stared straight at Hazael until he felt uneasy. Then the man of God began to cry.

dag: M mabihi n yi ka yi sanna ti tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa, buchi bɔ ka di yɛn kun ya, ka pa ni n zaŋla yɛla kahigibu bee baŋsim yɛtɔɣa bee anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee wuhibu yɛla tɔɣisi ya.
en: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, cham Izraɛlnim sani nti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ba.
en: Then God said, Mortal man, go to the people of Israel and say to them whatever I tell you to say.

dag: Yi ʒiɛri kpam, ka niŋdi tulaale pam niŋdi yimaŋ chani ti jɛmdi Molɛk. Buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu, yi timdi tuumba katinsi hal ka timdi ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti mali sara maligu shɛli ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi la; di daa nyɛla ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi.
en: The law of the Lord also says that people must give a sacrifice: You must sacrifice two doves or two young pigeons. So Joseph and Mary went to Jerusalem to do this.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi, dama so kani m-be ka nyini, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani m-pah a zuɣu kaman ti ni wum shɛm ti tiba ni.
en: Lord All-Powerful, you are greater than all others. No one is like you, and you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija saha sanzali ni daa zani yuma ata ni chira ayɔbu ka kum lu luɣilikam, ka pakoya daa yam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: And I can assure you that there were many widows in Israel during Elijahs time, when it didnt rain for three and a half years and there was a great food shortage in the land.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Musa dindali maa.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses that same day. He said.

dag: dama yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni kanna yuŋ shɛm la.
en: For you yourselves know very well that the Day of the Lord will come as a thief comes at night.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Jɛrimia m-pahi buyi saha shɛli bɛ ni daa na kul kpar o duu duguliba dundɔŋ ni la.
en: While Jeremiah was still locked up in the courtyard of the guardhouse, the message from the Lord came to him a second time:.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm daa yɛl o ba Hamɔr, Bom paɣisarili ŋɔ ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: He told his father, Please get this girl for me so that I can marry her.

dag: ka ti mabia ŋun mi nyɛ azichilana ka Naawuni siɣis o, di simdi ni o gba mali suhupiɛlli, dama azichilana ni ti vuui kaman mɔpuma ni kpahiri luri shɛm la.
en: and the rich Christians must be glad when God brings them down. For the rich will pass away like the flower of a wild plant.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa karibu yɛla, ka daa ti bo n-nya o bɔh o, A niŋ Daadam Bia la yɛda.
en: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, Do you have faith in the Son of Man.

dag: Musa daa ti tim tuumba Ɛdom naa sani, ka bɛ yi Kadɛshi chaŋ ti yɛl o, A mabihi Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A mi wahala shɛli ti ni pun nya zaa yɛla.
en: While Moses was at Kadesh, he sent some men with a message to the king of Edom. The message said, This is what your brothers, the Israelites, say to you: You know about all the troubles we have had.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa kpɛhi Juda zuliya niriba maa dabiɛm, ka gbarigi ba zaŋ chaŋ mɛbu maa polo.
en: So the enemies began to discourage them and tried to frighten them in order to stop them from building the Temple.

dag: Ka a zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ti o, n ni ti be a min o zaa noya ni, ka wuhi ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: I will tell you what to say. Then you will tell Aaron, and I will help him say it well. I will tell both of you what to do.

dag: ka a ti yeei Aduna kpariti n-zaŋ li yɛl o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna kpi nimaani n-chaŋ o yaannim sani.
en: Strip Aaron of his clothes and put them on Eleazar his son. Then Aaron will die there.

dag: Ka Ɛdom mɔɣa leei kootaali, ka di tiŋgbani leei chilibi, ka di tiŋgbani maa taai buɣim di kaman kootaali la.
en: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.

dag: Daadam ŋun nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi so ŋɔ dabisa bi yaɣi lala, ka wahala n-kul pali di ni.
en: We are all born weak and helpless. All lead the same short, troubled life.

dag: Yi ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa bemi kaman gariŋga gala la. Nir yi ŋma di gal yini wahu n-yiri di ni na. Amaa yi nia biɛri maa ku kun ya buchi. Di nyɛla din ka buchi kaman kpatinari zana chinchini la, di bi galisi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ni tooi zaŋ li pili.
en: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a zuɣu n ni tooi nyaŋ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ. N Naawuni zuɣu, n ni tooi kpahi yaɣi gooni.
en: You give me strength to attack my enemies and power to overcome their defenses.

dag: ka a kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Kill that ram and save the blood. Throw the blood against the altar on all four sides.

dag: Ka kom zo n-tiɛli n zuɣu, ka n yɛli, N ku be.
en: Water came up over my head. I said to myself, I am finished.

dag: Jɛra yi bɔhi jɛrilim bɔhigu, nyin di garigi ba jɛrilim garigibu, di yi pa lala a gba ni leei jɛrigu.
en: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.

dag: Zɛbulɔn tiŋgbani mini Naftali tiŋgbani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi teeku polo, ka nyɛ tiŋgban shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Galili chɛfirinim tinsi la.
en: Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, alongside the sea, across the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.

dag: O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba tuhi pihiyɔbu. Ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi Ijipti mini Libia ni Sukiim ni Itiɔpia n-dol o daa ka kalinli.
en: Shishak attacked with his army of , chariots and , cavalry troops, as well as countless Egyptian soldiers from Libya, Sukkoth, and Ethiopia.

dag: Ahaz daa nyɛla Jɛhɔada ba, ka Jɛhɔada nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba; Zimiri mi daa nyɛla Mɔza ba;.
en: Ahaz was Jehoaddahs father. Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was Mozas father.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini, hal o daa bi garigi bɛ ni fiɣis o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa zaɣ yini gba. Ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But Jesus refused to answer a single word, with the result that the Governor was greatly surprised.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa o ni ʒina ka di nyɛ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa. Ka so n-daa bi ti Naa Sulemaana tulaale ka di galisi paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa ti o tulaale shɛli maa.
en: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, many jewels, and more spices than anyone had ever brought into Israel.

dag: A yi tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa, di ni niŋ ma nyaɣisim.
en: It makes me feel good inside when you say the right things.

dag: O tiri bɛn gbarigi yaa, ka tiri bɛn ka yaa yiko.
en: He strengthens those who are weak and tired.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi tooi kom maa m-mali bɛ zilima nyur li kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisita, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa daa gbanila tiŋ nyura.
en: The number of men who lapped was three hundred, and all the rest of the people bent down on their knees to drink water, with their hands to their mouths.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu gbaag o zuli, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu gbaag o zuli maa, ka di lan leei jaaŋgbee o nuu ni.
en: Pick it up by the tail! the Lord told him. And when Moses did this, the snake turned back into a walking stick.

dag: Varanda shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo la, niriba anahi n-daa ʒe di palli zuɣu, ka niriba ayi mi ʒe di samban ni gul li.
en: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Din kariya ka ti chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna.
en: The people answered: We could never worship other gods or stop worshiping the Lord .

dag: Kum yi mal a dimnima, nyin tim ba bindirigu ka bɛ di, ka kɔnyuri yi mali ba, nyin tim ba kom ka bɛ nyu;.
en: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. If they are thirsty, give them some water.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ o dabili Ibrahimma zuliya mini Yaakubu bihi bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: You belong to the family of his servant Abraham. You are descendants of Jacob, the people God chose.

dag: Yi yi me yil palli, yin niŋm bini kɔɣili yi mɔpilli ti tuui, di yi pa lala so yi yi di zuɣu luna kpi o ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi yili maa zuɣu.
en: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi Bɛtani chana, ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: The next day, after leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ bɔhi, Zom ni tooi vo o zoon kpee ka bɛ zaa ti ku lula bɔɣili ni?.
en: And Jesus told them this parable: One blind man cannot lead another one; if he does, both will fall into a ditch.

dag: Yinim teeku noli tinsinim mini Sidɔnnima, maamiya yi ni. Yi daabihi bela teeku ni bɔri azichi tiri ya.
en: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.

dag: m-pahi fɔn shɛŋa mini tiŋkpan shɛŋa din daa be Manaasa min o zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ daa lee zaŋ li n-ti Ifriim min o zuliya niriba maa la.
en: along with some towns and villages that were within the borders of Manasseh, but given to the Ephraimites.

dag: Ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ bom ŋariŋ zal o, salo maa ti muɣi m-miris o pam zuɣu;.
en: Jesus saw how many people there were, so he told his followers to get a small boat and make it ready for him. He wanted the boat so that the crowds of people could not push against him.

dag: Doo yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani bee m-po pɔri lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli, ŋun miri ka o yi o yɛligu maa nyaaŋa; amaa o niŋm o ni yaag o noli yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: When a man makes a solemn promise to the LORD or swears a solemn pledge of binding obligation for himself, he cannot break his word. He must do everything he said.

dag: Amaa yi lee nyɛla bɛn duhiri yimaŋa ka nyuri bara. Ka barinyubo ŋɔ tatabo zaa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: But now you are proud, and you boast; all such boasting is wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Giliad mini Bashan ni di fɔntinsi ni zaa ni Sharɔn tiŋgban ni luɣ shɛŋa din daa mali biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zaa.
en: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: Nicodemus asked, How is all this possible.

dag: Dauda daa lan bo kuriti pam ni bɛ mali kpahi din ni kpahi dunɔdaya pundi mini chɛulɔnima. O daa lan bo daanya pam, hal nir daa naan ku tooi zaŋ li pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: David got iron for making nails and hinges for the gate doors. He also got more bronze than could be weighed.

dag: Dama m bɔrila yurilim maŋli ka pa ni sara maligu. M paɣiya ni yi baŋ man Naawuni n-gari yi nyɔri binyara buɣim maani sara.
en: This is because I want faithful love, not sacrifice. I want people to know God, not to bring burnt offerings.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa paag o nuu bɛ zuɣu ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ daa jɛmdila saŋmarisi kaman anabinim ni daa sab li shɛm bɛ litaafinim ni yɛli, Izraɛlnima, man Naawuni ka yi daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara tiri mɔɣu ni m-mali hal ti paai yuun pihinahi la?.
en: So God turned away from them and gave them over to worship the stars of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: People of Israel! It was not to me that you slaughtered and sacrificed animals for forty years in the desert.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi: Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: So I tell you, continue to ask, and God will give to you. Continue to search, and you will find. Continue to knock, and the door will open for you.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana min o nyaaŋa bɛn nyɛ Sadusiinim la daa zab Yisa tuumba maa nyuli.
en: Then the High Priest and all his companions, members of the local party of the Sadducees, became extremely jealous of the apostles; so they decided to take action.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti lan yi Samuɛl zuɣu Shilo, dama Yawɛ daa kahig omaŋa wuhi Samuɛl Shilo ŋun Yawɛ yɛligu ni. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa gbilisiri tibili wumdi Samuɛl yɛligu.
en: And the Lord continued to appear to Samuel at Shiloh. There he told Samuel what he wanted.

dag: Ka yi daa lan zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-kɔhi Giriikinim zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒi ba chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, removing them far from their own border.

dag: Zaŋm gɔpiɛliga dari mali yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbi shɛli zuɣu.
en: Make an altar out of acacia wood, for burning incense.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Sairus daa ti zali zaligu o nam dibu yuun yini saha ni bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali.
en: Then in the first year of the reign of King Cyrus as emperor of Babylonia, Cyrus issued orders for the Temple to be rebuilt.

dag: A zaŋ sagbani lims amaŋa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti suhigu bi lan paar a.
en: By a cloud of fury too thick for our prayers to get through.

dag: O kari doli ba chani ni alaafee, ka di bi ŋman o naba shihiri tiŋa.
en: He follows in pursuit and marches safely on, so fast that he hardly touches the ground!.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Doɛg, Nyin lum maligumaaniba maa zuɣu n-ku ba. Ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nir maa daa lu maligumaaniba maa zuɣu. Dindali maa o daa kula bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn so tan piɛla din be kaman mukuriti la ninvuɣ pihiniinaanu.
en: So the king gave the order to Doeg. Saul said, Doeg, you go kill the priests. So Doeg the Edomite went and killed the priests. That day he killed men who were priests.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnkam ʒe Ijipti nyaaŋa ni ti lu, ka di ni mali yaa shɛli nyuri bara la naai. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All of your allies will be killed, and your proud strength will crumble. People will die from Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhudoo din yaɣi ninsal milinsi zuɣu la ni gbibi yi suhuri mini yi tɛha Yisa Masia ni.
en: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.

dag: Kiriatijiarimnim mini Kɛfira ni Bɛrɔt niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaata.
en: of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli mɔɣili maa duli labi.
en: The man said, Ezekiel, son of man, pay attention to what you've seen. We walked to the riverbank.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi ni ŋun mal liɣiri kolibila, ŋun kpuɣim li; lala n-nyɛ ŋun mal adiiku gba. Ka ŋun mi ka takɔbi, ŋun zaŋm o binyɛrigu kɔhi da li.
en: Jesus said to them, But now if you have money or a bag, carry that with you. If you dont have a sword, sell your coat and buy one.

dag: dama nyuli zabbu chɛ ka yidan suhu yiɣisir pam, ka o yi yɛn bɔhi biɛri, o ku lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: A husband is never angrier than when he is jealous; his revenge knows no limits.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee yili ni. Miriya ka yi mi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee paɣa ni bee o tumtumdi dɔbba bee o tumtumdi paɣiba ni bee o naɣilalantabili ni bee o buŋ ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee binshɛli ni.
en: Do not desire another man's house; do not desire his wife, his slaves, his cattle, his donkeys, or anything else that he owns.

dag: ka daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya so ka o ye binyɛr piɛlli din mali shaara, ka lo salima din nyɛ alali shɛlɔrigu.
en: I looked up and saw someone who was wearing linen clothes and a belt of fine gold.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Tishibi nir la, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti tuhi Samaria naa tuumba ŋɔ soli m-bɔhi ba, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka yi ti chanila Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la sani ni a ti bɔh o nya.
en: But the LORDs messenger said to Elijah from Tishbe, Go, intercept the messengers of Samarias king, and ask them, Is it because theres no God in Israel that you are going to question Ekrons god Baal-zebub?.

dag: Amaa m-mali shɛhira din gari Jɔn shɛhira maa; dama tuun shɛŋa m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum, dina ka n tumda; ka tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi maa mi diri ma shɛhira ni m Ba n-shiri tim ma na.
en: But I have a proof about myself that is greater than anything John said. The things I do are my proof. These are what my Father gave me to do. They show that the Father sent me.

dag: Ka Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira bini ti mini ya sunsuuni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka bɛ daa boli sara maligu bimbini maa yuli, Shɛhira.
en: The people of Reuben and Gad referred to the altar in this way: It is a witness between us that the LORD is God.

dag: Dinzuɣu Masia daa kana nti yihi suhudoo lahibal suŋ waazu tila yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka daa be katiŋ ni Naawuni la mini Yɛhudianim bɛn daa mir o la.
en: So Christ came and preached the Good News of peace to all—to you Gentiles, who were far away from God, and to the Jews, who were near to him.

dag: ka daadamnim ni ti tarigi binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋdi dunia ni maa dabiɛm zuɣu, dama yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam.
en: The planets and other heavenly bodies will be shaken, causing people to faint from fear and foreboding of what is coming upon the world.

dag: amaa ŋun doli dunoli kpɛra, ŋuna n-nyɛ piɛgula.
en: But the man who takes care of the sheep enters through the gate. He is the shepherd.

dag: Di saha yiliguliba ni ni ti sɔhira, ka kpiɔŋlaannim pɔri gɔɣi, ka paɣiba bɛn niɛmdi chɛ niɛmbu, bɛ ni bi lan galisi zuɣu, ka din lihiri takɔriti ni niŋ liti.
en: Your body will grow feeble, your teeth will decay, and your eyesight fail.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan nya ka do so zɔrina ka o boli dunɔgula n-yɛl o, Nyama, do so lan zɔrina o kɔŋko. Ka naa yɛli, o gba ʒirila lahibali na.
en: when the soldier saw someone else running. He shouted down to the gate, Look! There's another runner! David said, He must have some news too.

dag: Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ Aduna daŋ ni toondan la min o nyaaŋa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaata ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: Jehoiada was in that group. He was a leader from Aarons family. There were men with Jehoiada.

dag: Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do laa gbini diri bihi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: But she answered, Lord, even the dogs under the table eat the childrens crumbs.

dag: n daa ŋmanila jɛrigu ni ŋun ʒi shɛli; ka be kaman biŋkɔbigu la a sani.
en: I was stupid and ignorant. I acted like nothing but an animal toward you.

dag: O nol daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka kuko shɛli yi zuɣusaa na yɛli, Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N deeg a nam yiko a sani.
en: But before I could finish speaking, a voice from heaven interrupted: King Nebuchadnezzar, this kingdom is no longer yours.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Dauda, Nyama, Filistianim tuhirila Kɛilanima, ka fari bɛ bindira bɛ puri ni.
en: People told David, Look, the Philistines are fighting against the city of Keilah. They are robbing grain from the threshing floors.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam saha miriya.
en: So, when you see these things happening, you know that God's kingdom will soon be here.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa chɛ kumsi, ka bɛ yɛli ba, Fomiya ka di chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla dabisili kasi.
en: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Wula ka n lee ni tooi baŋ di gbinni, ka pa ni so n-dolisi ma? Ka daa yɛli Filip ni o kpɛm o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa ni na ti ʒin o sani.
en: The official replied, How can I understand unless someone explains it to me? And he invited Philip to climb up and sit in the carriage with him.

dag: Ka n daa lan lo ni m baŋ yila pii din tam o zuɣu ni la mini yilibil din daa doli nyaaŋa na nti daai vuɣi yila ata la bahi la yɛla. Yilibil maa daa malila nina mini noli din tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa, ka di lihibu daa mali dabiɛm gari di tab maa zaa.
en: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.

dag: N yi nya din daa niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni paɣisara la, di biɛri ma mi.
en: My heart is grieved when I see what has happened to the women of the city.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tiligi Izraɛlnim Ijiptinim nuu ni dindali maa shɛm m-bala. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya Ijiptinim ni kpi n-do teeku duli shɛm.
en: The LORD rescued Israel from the Egyptians that day. Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

dag: Ti bi mali timaŋa ŋ-ŋmahindi bee m-buɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣiri bɛmaŋ la. Bɛ yi mali bɛmaŋ maɣisiri taba, ka mali bɛmaŋ buɣisiri taba, bɛ bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: We wont dare to place ourselves in the same league or to compare ourselves with some of those who are promoting themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves, and compare themselves with themselves, they have no understanding.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tahiri kum na, amaa ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tiligiri ba.
en: The words of the wicked are murderous, but the words of the righteous rescue those who are threatened.

dag: Di saha ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa chaŋ Shɛkɛm, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim ni bɛ leeg o nam.
en: Rehoboam went to Shechem where everyone was waiting to crown him king.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni yini ni kɔbisinu.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Naomi min o bia paɣ Rut ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab paɣ la ni daa yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Bɛtilihɛm na shɛm m-bala. Chi mi chɛbu piligibu saha ka bɛ daa paai Bɛtilihɛm maa.
en: So Naomi and her daughter-in-law Ruth, the Moabite, came back from the hill country of Moab. These two women came to Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.

dag: N dimnim zaa maani ma la ansarisi, ka n ʒiʒiinitab kaɣiri ma, ka n leei binzɔrigu bɛnkam mi ma sani; ka bɛnkam mi nya ma sol ni guurimi ka chɛri ma.
en: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.

dag: Ka Dauda mini sapashin kpamba daa pii Asaf mini Hɛman ni Jɛdutun bidibisi ni shɛba ni bɛ zaŋdi mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ŋ-ŋmɛri ka yiini anabitali yila. Bɛn daa tum tuma maa kalinli mini bɛ tuma n-daa bɔŋɔ.
en: David and the army officers set apart Asaphs family, Heman and Jeduthun, for service to prophesy accompanied by lyres, harps, and cymbals. This is the list of those who performed this special service.

dag: Chɛ ka o bihi chanimi gindi maani bara, ka bɛ kari ba yihi bɛ yili chɛra ni.
en: May his children be homeless beggars; may they be driven from the ruins they live in!.

dag: Amaa ka o tab maa yɛli, Guhim pɔi! Chɛ ka ti nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana ti tilig o bee o ku kana.
en: Others said, Wait! Let's see if Elijah will come and save him.

dag: Bɛ ku leei bundaannima, ka bɛ nyamma pala din ni zani yuui; ka bɛ daazichi mi ku yɛligi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They wont get rich; their wealth wont last; their property wont extend over the earth.

dag: Ka Absalom daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, Naa nyama, a dabili yɛn chɛla o piɛri kɔbiri, ka bɔri ni naa min o kpamba zaa kana.
en: Absalom went to the king and said, I have some men coming to cut the wool from my sheep. Please come with your servants and watch.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka doo sabirila amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ pɔi ka naanyi yih o paɣa.
en: They answered, Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.

dag: Ti ni niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika zuɣu ka ti tiligi shɛm, lala n-nyɛ bɛ gba.
en: On the contrary, we believe that we and they are saved in the same way, by the grace of the Lord Jesus.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizɔbil maa ti ma na, dina n-ni chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi pala puɣisiriba, amaa ka nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, ka n naanyi zaŋ yi mabia maa tin ya ka yi gɔri kɔhigu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but honest men; I will give your brother back to you, and you can stay here and trade.

dag: N ni ku bɛ naa, ka ku bɛ nabihi zaa pah o zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I will bring an end to the kings of Moab, and I will kill all the leaders of Moab. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ ŋmaligi labi bɛ nyaaŋa nti dɔni Pihahirɔt tooni polo, Migidol mini teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din miri Baalizɛfɔn la; dɔnimiya miri teeku maa noli.
en: Tell the Israelites to turn back and camp in front of Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the Red Sea, near Baal Zephon.

dag: Amaa niriba maa n-daa va ti ni tuhi di binshɛŋa maa zaa na, piɛri mini naɣilahi ni di ni daa simdi ni bɛ saɣim bin viɛl shɛŋa zaa, bɛ daa zaŋ li mi na ni bɛ ti mali sara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani Giligal.
en: And the soldiers took the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the Lord your God at Gilgal.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Cham ti bol a yidan na.
en: Go and call your husband, Jesus told her, and come back.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-laɣim tɔbbihi pahi Izraɛlnim kpamba zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ Ai.
en: Early the next morning Joshua gathered the men together. Then Joshua and the leaders of Israel led the men to Ai.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A yɛla ka n daa chɛ ka n daba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl anabinim yɛli kurimbuni ha la, bɛn daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa di dabisa maa ni yuma pam puuni n-yɛli ni o ni ti chɛ ka a kana ti liri ba la. .
en: You are the one I was talking about long ago, when I announced through my servants, the prophets of Israel, that in days to come I would bring someone to attack Israel. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a kɔsoya ni zahim maa labi tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka a ti lu palɔni, ka bɛ ti ku nya a sɔɣi. N ni ti zaŋ a ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini juri ka bɛ di.
en: I will fling you out into the desert, and also all the fish from the Niles canals. You will fall on the open ground, and wont be gathered or retrieved. Ive given you to the beasts of the earth and the birds in the sky for food.

dag: Yɛndan tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, amaa jɛrilim n-yiri jɛra noya ni na.
en: Listening to wise people increases your knowledge, but only nonsense comes from the mouths of fools.

dag: O daa pilila daanya zuɣupiligu ka ye kurigu gbaɣino din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihinu ni ayopɔin.
en: He had a bronze helmet on his head. He wore a coat of armor that was made like the scales on a fish. This armor was made of bronze and weighed about pounds.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sool min o bidibis ata ni o gbaɣinɔʒira ni o niriba zaa ni daa laɣim kpi dahin yini shɛm m-bala.
en: So Saul, his three sons, and the boy who carried his armor all died together that day.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka ti mali tahima. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti sɔŋsim mini ti nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: We put our hope in the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa kul turi ba ka yɛra, Wara, wara, nyin ninvuɣ kur ŋɔ, nyin ninvuɣ yoli ŋɔ.
en: Shimei cursed David. He said, Get out, get out, you no-good murderer !.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Sinai mɔɣu ni n-doli tab gbilligbilli chana; ka sagbani maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: The Israelites set out on their march from the Sinai desert, and the cloud settled in the Paran desert.

dag: Ka n yura maa daa zaŋ o nuu daai dunoli, ka n suhu dii kpe o ni.
en: But my lover put his hand through the opening, and I felt sorry for him.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bidibisi, ka Abiheel daa nyɛ Huri bia, ka Huri nyɛ Jarɔa bia, ka Jarɔa nyɛ Giliad bia, ka Giliad nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Jɛshishai bia, ka Jɛshishai nyɛ Jado bia, ka Jado mi nyɛ Buz bia;.
en: This was the family of Abihail son of Huri son of Jaroah son of Gilead son of Michael son of Jeshishai son of Jahdo son of Buz.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni daŋ tila Judanim nasara, din ni chɛ ka Naa Dauda zuliya mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni yɛn nya jilima shɛli ku gari Judanim dini.
en: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali di firilanim ayopɔin mini di buɣim kpihiri bina ni di buɣim moori bina.
en: He made seven lamps for this lampstand. Then he made lamp snuffers and trays from pure gold.

dag: Azɛl ba. Azɛl daa malila bidibisi ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hana. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Azɛl bidibisi maa.
en: Azel had six sons. Their names were Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. They were Azels children.

dag: O niŋgbuŋ kul kpɛla tab ni, di kpɛmmi kirikiri, ka so ku tooi dam li.
en: There is no soft spot in his skin. It is as hard as iron.

dag: Binshɛɣukam mali saha, ka yɛl shɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni malila di niŋbu saha.
en: Theres a season for everything and a time for every matter under the heavens.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim lan ka yɛm yɔɣo? Yɛnnim la bi lan tiri niriba yɛm saɣisigu? Bɛ yɛm maa naami?.
en: This message is about Edom. This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Is there no more wisdom in Teman? Are the wise men of Edom not able to give good advice? Have they lost their wisdom?.

dag: Bɛ bihi kul bela barina ni, ka bɛ mɔŋ ba nasara dunɔdali shee, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi.
en: and leaving their children helpless in court.

dag: N gbilisi tibili ni n wum, amaa ka bɛ bi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ ninvuɣ so bi niŋ tuuba o tuumbiɛri zuɣu yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka n niŋ lala? Bɛ zaa kparila bɛ kpabu kaman wɔhu ni sibigi ʒi n-kpɛri tɔb gɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: I listened carefully, but you did not speak the truth. Not one of you has been sorry for your wickedness; not one of you has asked, What have I done wrong? Each of you keep on going your own way, like a horse rushing into battle.

dag: Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim.
en: A kingdom that fights against itself will not survive.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa kul yɛrigila zoya zuɣu m-be kaman piɛ shɛb bɛn ka gula. Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ka zuɣulana; chɛ ka bɛ zaa yinoyino lab kuli ni suhudoo. .
en: Micaiah answered, I can see the army of Israel scattered over the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the Lord said, These men have no leader; let them go home in peace.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin dabisi shɛli din daŋ tooni dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli. Dindali maa, piɛbimiya kikahi.
en: On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets.

dag: Yi daa kam ni dolila jɛmbu duu sania. Gɛra bini pisi n-ni nyɛ anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini.
en: All prices shall be set according to the official standard.

dag: N daa bi zaɣisi ka m mali ŋun ni wum n yɛtɔɣa. M bi zaɣisi ka n dim maa di sabi o ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ma ŋɔ sɔŋ.
en: How I wish someone would listen to me! I will sign my name to all I have said. Now let God All-Powerful answer me. Let him make a list of what he thinks I did wrong.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ piɛlaa maa kpam min o zuli ni kpam ni o nyɔri kpam ni o saba ni o yaannina ayi ni di kpam ni o nudirigu gbalipuɣili, dama o nyɛla maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa.
en: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.

dag: ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku Yisa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba.
en: The leading priests and teachers of the law wanted to kill Jesus. But they were trying to find a quiet way to do it, because they were afraid of what the people would do.

dag: Bundana n-su faralana, ka sandira mi nyɛ sandan dabili.
en: The rich rule over the poor. The one who borrows is a slave to the one who lends.

dag: Yi bi niŋ tuuba bee n-lu ma sizuura hal ni zuŋɔ, yi mi bi doli n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim la.
en: But to this day you have not humbled yourselves. You have not honored me or lived according to all the laws that I gave you and your ancestors.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ŋun nyɛ na titali la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la m-puhir a. Ka pumpɔŋɔ.
en: From Emperor Artaxerxes to the priest Ezra, scholar in the Law of the God of Heaven.

dag: Zaligu lola paɣa tabil o yidana hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, amaa o yidan maa yi ti kpi, o nya yolisim din ni tooi kuli do so o suhu ni bɔra; di mi simdi ni o kul la ŋun doli ti Duuma.
en: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.

dag: dama bɛ yi kul lu buyopɔin, bɛ ni lan yiɣisi; amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The righteous may fall seven times but still get up, but the wicked will stumble into trouble.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ teebul la na ti mal li zali di zaashee di puuni; ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la na nti zaŋ di firilanim la tam di zuɣu.
en: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.

dag: Naawuni kul tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa sahakam, amaa ka ninsalinim bi baŋdi li.
en: Although God speaks again and again, no one pays attention to what he says.

dag: O malaikanim zaa, paɣimiy o! O tɔbbihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, all his angels, all his heavenly armies.

dag: Amaa so ni bɔhi, Ka wula ka kpiimba lee yɛn tooi neei kum ni? Ka niŋgbun bɔ ka bɛ lee yɛn mali.
en: Some of you have asked, How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli Gidiɔn, Ti ni zaŋ li ti a ni ti suhuri zaa. Ka bɛ daa teei binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka sokam zaa zaŋd o ni ŋme n-di tibikpar shɛŋa na ti pari di zuɣu.
en: Well gladly give them, they replied. And they spread out a piece of cloth, and everyone pitched in the earrings from their loot.

dag: Di dabisa maa saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka wuntizɔr so yi Dauda zuliya ni na, ŋuna n-ni ti doli zaligu mini wuntia soli n-su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: At that time I will choose as king a righteous descendant of David. That king will do what is right and just throughout the land.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li. Yi gba yi niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa yin yɛlimiya, Ti bi simdi paɣibu, dama ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti tum maa. .
en: In the same way, when you have done everything required of you, you should say, We servants deserve no special praise. We have only done our duty.

dag: M mali Ofiri salima din gari tɔn kɔbiga mini anzinfa din nyɛ alali tɔn kɔbisiyi ni pihinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li dooi pa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dukpina zuɣu.
en: I have given tons of pure gold from Ophir. I have given tons of pure silver. The silver is for covering the walls of the buildings in the Temple.

dag: Ninsal niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa ka mali yaɣ bɔbili ka di zaa tuma bi nyɛ yim la.
en: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa ʒi ma n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka n ti nya paɣ so ka o ʒi biŋkɔb ʒiɛɣu zuɣu, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya nyaɣim biŋkɔbigu maa luɣilikam, ka o mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia.
en: Then the angel carried me away by the Spirit to the desert. There I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with evil names. It had seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Ka n tin ya suhudoo yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka yi ti dɔni tiŋa, ka so ku varisi ya. N ni ti yihi biŋkɔb biɛri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti ku lo tɔbu n-kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I will grant peace in the land so that you can lie down without anyone frightening you. I will remove dangerous animals from the land, and no sword will pass through it.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ banim paɣiba doon a ni. Bɛ muɣisiri paɣ shɛb bɛn nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai m-mali ba doon a ni.
en: There men commit sexual sins with their fathers wife. There the men rape women—even during their monthly time of bleeding.

dag: Yi ni ti biri, amaa ka ku kpuɣi atam. Yi ni ti kahim olivi kpam, amaa ka ku zaŋ kpam maa ʒe yimaŋa. Yi ni ti tɔɣi wain, amaa ka ku nyu wain maa.
en: You will plant your seeds, but you will not gather food. You will try to squeeze oil from your olives, but you will not get any oil. You will crush your grapes, but you will not get enough juice to have wine to drink.

dag: Do so ŋun daa kpaŋ maa daa bi mi ŋun chɛ ka o kpaŋ maa ni nyɛ so, dama salo daa galisiya nimaani, ka Yisa mi pun yi ni chaŋ o chandi.
en: But the man who had been healed did not know who Jesus was, for there was a crowd in that place, and Jesus had slipped away.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛ ka Asaf min o mabihi maa be Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa gbini ni bɛ tumdi di tuma sahakam kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun nyo n firila. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-chɛ ka neesim neei n zibisim ni.
en: You are the one who lights my lamp— the LORD my God illumines my darkness.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli yili maa ni bihi maa, Niŋmiya kom pali sinsi ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kom pali di zaa ha nti paai di naŋgbanyɛra tarisi.
en: Jesus said to the servants, Fill the jars with water, and they filled them to the brim.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Baruk bɛ nini maa ni.
en: I charged Baruch before all of them.

dag: Naawuni, Fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi. Fam ma ninkuunsinim mini bɛn bi doli zaligu la nuu ni bahi.
en: My God, rescue me from the power of the wicked; rescue me from the grip of the wrongdoer and the oppressor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɔhiri taba kum ni neebu maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So they kept it to themselves, wondering, Whats this rising from the dead.

dag: So ku tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa o nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi. Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: How can anyone break into the house of a strong man and steal his things, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can take everything.

dag: Fitiina pam maa zuɣu, niriba kul kuhirimi, wɔɣira ni muɣisiri ba shɛm zuɣu, bɛ bɔrila sɔŋsim.
en: If people are being hurt, they cry out and beg for protection from those who hurt them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ m-bɔhi.
en: Jesus told them this parable.

dag: Ka salo maa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: The people asked him, What are we to do, then.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba fabila mini bɛ kuhigu; bɛ kɔŋ bɛ jilima! Wummiya gbuɣima kuhigu; dama nyɔŋ din dolisi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili la saɣimya!.
en: The sound of screaming appears among the shepherds because their majesty has been devastated. The sound of roaring can be heard among the young lions because the pride of the Jordan has been devastated.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa balim o yɛli, Karimba, dim bindirigu.
en: While the woman was in town, Jesus followers were begging him, Teacher, eat something.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du n-kpe tiŋ maa ni. Bɛ ni daa kpɛri tiŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya Samuɛl ka o yiri ni o chaŋ sara maligu daboli maa zuɣu.
en: So Saul and his servant went on to the town, and as they were going in, they saw Samuel coming out toward them on his way to the place of worship.

dag: ni Afɛk naa ni Laasharɔn naa.
en: the king of Aphek one.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi nab pam pahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ŋɔ ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord , and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana mali biɛrisuŋ: di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino, ka nyɛ ŋun gbib omaŋa ni ŋun mali yɛm ni ŋun biɛhigu doli soli ni ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun ni tooi wuhi niriba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So the churchs supervisor must be without fault. They should be faithful to their spouse, sober, modest, and honest. They should show hospitality and be skilled at teaching.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Kaman n ni daa kul chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ titaŋa paai niriba ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka n lan yɛn chɛ ka n ni lo ba zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa alikauli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ paai ba.
en: Just as I have brought this disaster on these people, so I am going to give them all the good things that I have promised.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, so daa yi mali sara, ka na bi yihi biŋkpam nyo buɣim, maligumaana yiŋbia kanimina ti yɛl o, Ŋmaam nim kahili ti ma ka n ti ti maligumaana ka o she, dama o ku deei nin duɣirili a sani, naɣila nim kahili.
en: But with Elis sons, even before the fat was burned, the priests assistant would come and say to the person offering the sacrifice, Give the priest some meat to roast. He wont accept boiled meat from you.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni guhiri dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ mali biɛr kasi ka ku mali galimi Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka suhudoo be yi min o sunsuuni.
en: Therefore, dear friends, while you are waiting for these things to happen, make every effort to be found by him in peace—pure and faultless.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni sahakam, ka bɛ zuliya kul ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord protects pure people all their life. Their reward will continue forever.

dag: Kum n-yi di mali ma, n naan ku yɛli ya, dama mani n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: If I were hungry, I would not ask you for food, for the world and everything in it is mine.

dag: Ŋun yur o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋun mi je o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti mal li hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Those who love their own life will lose it; those who hate their own life in this world will keep it for life eternal.

dag: Amaa Jɔab daa bi kali Lɛvi zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya bɛna, dama naa zaligu maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: He didnt include Levi and Benjamin among them, because Joab disagreed with the kings order.

dag: Tinzunnim deei bɛ yaa zaa, ka bɛ bi baŋ lala. Bɛ bi mi ni bɛ kum saha bi lan waɣa.
en: and do not realize that this reliance on foreigners has robbed them of their strength. Their days are numbered, but they don't even know it.

dag: ka ŋme gbuɣima mini naɣilahi ni chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa dapaɣ shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ kpɛhikpɛhi firimnim la ni zuɣu. Ka pɔripɔri daanya niŋ firimnim maa mini gbuɣima ni naɣilahi maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ tiŋli.
en: Lions, bulls, and winged otherworldly creatures appeared on the panels between the legs. On the legs above and below the lions and bulls were wreaths on panels hanging off the stands.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa kpuɣi paɣiba ayi, ka yino yuli booni Ada, ka yino mi yuli booni Zilla.
en: Lamech married Adah, then Zillah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni gari yi tooni n-zaŋ ya du li. O ni ku zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ, ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su. Jɔshua gba ni gari yi tooni n-zaŋ ya du kaman Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm maa.
en: But the Lord your God will lead your people into that land. He will destroy these nations for you. You will take their land away from them. The Lord said that Joshua must lead you.

dag: Ka o yi ka bipuɣiŋga, yin zaŋmiy o fali ti o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he has no daughter, his brothers are to inherit it.

dag: O yee daa kpɛm pam ka o bi zɔri vi. O daa bi ʒiini yiŋa.
en: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa shini, ka kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋ ni bɛ kpiɔŋ zaa ni bɛ zaŋ ŋarin titali maa lab du duli. Amaa ka teeku maa dambu kpiɔŋ daa kul maan pahirimi, ka bɛ kɔŋ chandi.
en: Instead, the sailors tried to get the ship to shore, rowing with all their might. But the storm was becoming worse and worse, and they got nowhere.

dag: ka yi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Yi yi zaŋ li ti ti maligumaana, o mi ni zaŋ li chaŋ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: You will bring the grain offering made in one of these ways to the LORD, presenting it to the priest, who will then bring it to the altar.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa ni daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee kum.
en: After the angel gave the Israelites this message from the Lord , the people cried loudly.

dag: Yisa daa pun mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa, dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni yino maa.
en: Jesus already knew who was going to betray him; that is why he said, All of you, except one, are clean.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni kahig o ni chɛ ka nir yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani shɛm yɛla wuhi palɔni, ka di pala fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu min anabinim yɛligu gba nyɛla din pun di dimbɔŋɔ shɛhira.
en: But God has a way to make people right, and it has nothing to do with the law. He has now shown us that new way, which the law and the prophets told us about.

dag: Dabiɛm kpe Ziɔn alahichinim ka bɛ ni sɔhira. Ka bɛ yɛra, Naawuni saria karibo ŋmanila buɣim din diri sahakam. Ka ti ni ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi buɣim maa ni.
en: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn chɛmi ka sanʒiɛ biɛɣu ʒe Babilɔn mini di niriba.
en: The LORD proclaims: Im stirring up a violent wind against Babylon and those who live in Leb-qamai.

dag: Dama Naa mi yɛla ŋɔ zaa, di zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri li bahiri mmaŋa o sani maa; yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli bi sɔɣi o sani, dama di daa bi niŋla ashilɔni.
en: King Agrippa knows about these things, and I have been speaking openly to him. Im certain that none of these things have escaped his attention. This didnt happen secretly or in some out-of-the-way place.

dag: Di ni lu yi zuɣu n-din ya; di ni lu yi zuɣu asiba n-gari yim, ka lu yi zuɣu wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ. Ka yɛl biɛɣu kam ni chɛ ka yi baŋ Naawuni yɛligu gbinni!.
en: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:.

dag: A yi ni jɛm Naawuni, ka suhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa.
en: If you will search eagerly for God, plead with the Almighty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me again.

dag: Hal ka n kuhi pam bɔri sɔŋsim ka o zaɣisi n suhigu deebu.
en: Even though I call out and cry for help, he silences my prayer.

dag: ka n naɣikɔra dapua yɛbu bi to, ka n ʒili mi bi tibisa.
en: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.

dag: Miri ka a bɔh a kpee biɛri bee n-je suli niŋ o, amaa yum a kpee kaman amaŋ la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Forget about the wrong things people do to you. Dont try to get even. Love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti boli paɣisarili maa na nti bɔh o nya.
en: Rebekahs brother and mother said, We will call Rebekah and ask her what she wants to do.

dag: Nimaani ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa yi wulimpuhili polo kanna, di vuri daa ŋmanila kom din mali yaa vuri, ka o jilima daa neei tiŋgban ni.
en: and there I saw coming from the east the dazzling light of the presence of the God of Israel. God's voice sounded like the roar of the sea, and the earth shone with the dazzling light.

dag: ni n yi yuui kandina, di ni chɛ ka a mi a ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm Naawuni niriba bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ cheechi la ni, ka nyɛ daantaliga mini tanzaa Naawuni yɛlimaŋli ni tam shɛli zuɣu la.
en: so that, even if I cannot come soon, you will know how people should live in the family of God. That family is the church of the living God. And Gods church is the support and foundation of the truth.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni nam ŋmahindi bee ŋahi dini ka ti lee yɛn ŋahi zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: What shall we say the Kingdom of God is like? asked Jesus. What parable shall we use to explain it?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ sida dapaɣa n-siili li hal ti gari du shɛŋa din daa tam pilanim pihinahinaanu zuɣu la zuɣusaa. Kuliga kam daa malila pilanim pinaanu.
en: The palaces cedar roof stood above forty-five beams resting on the columns, fifteen beams to each row.

dag: Bɛnkam suhuri ye buni zuɣu, ka zaŋ kiŋkansi bɔrili bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Di dirila bɛn su li nyɛviya.
en: Robbery always claims the life of the robber—this is what happens to anyone who lives by violence.

dag: N niriba ŋmanila wubiga ka tɔra laɣim gili ni bɛ di o. Cham ti laɣim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa, n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti ŋub o.
en: My inheritance has become like a bird of prey, surrounded and attacked. Go, gather all the wild animals for the feast.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ be mɔɣu ni n-dari ginda m-mali ti paai yuun pihinahi hal ka ʒiɛmani maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tum din bie Yawɛ sani maa zaa ti kpi.
en: The LORD became angry with the Israelites and made them wander in the desert for forty years until the entire generation had died, which had done evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohaths family: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Ka Simiɔn zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ shɛba daa ti chaŋ Ɛdom zoli zuɣu, kaman niriba kɔbisinu laasabu. Bɛ daa malila bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ Pɛlatia mini Niaria ni Rɛfaya ni Uziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ Ishi bidibisi la.
en: Some time later, men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi.

dag: Dinzuɣu Masia daa kana nti yihi suhudoo lahibal suŋ waazu tila yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka daa be katiŋ ni Naawuni la mini Yɛhudianim bɛn daa mir o la.
en: When he came, he announced the good news of peace to you who were far away from God and to those who were near.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka bɛ sanna sagban wɔɣinli puuni. Sagban wɔɣinli maa daa zanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa bɔhi ba, Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yi shiri zaɣisi n wun la mini n ni mali salima binnan shɛli zal la jɛmbu?.
en: He said to them, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, is it true that you refuse to worship my god and to bow down to the gold statue I have set up?.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o zilinli ti anab Neetan ka o kana m-mi ti boli bia maa yuli Jɛdidia; di gbinni nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri so.
en: and sent word for Nathan the prophet to give Solomon the name Jedidiah. So Nathan did this for the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan kpuɣi Ahinɔam ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la pahi, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa leeg o paɣiba.
en: David also married Ahinoam from Jezreel, so both of them were his wives.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba chaŋ Ribila nti ti Babilɔn naa.
en: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

dag: Ka dɔrolan maa garigi yɛl o, N Duuma, kom maa yi ti dam, n ka so ŋun ni zaŋ ma siɣi di ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ yi chani ni n ti siɣi, so daŋdi ma la di ni siɣibu.
en: The sick man answered him, Sir, I dont have anyone who can put me in the water when it is stirred up. When Im trying to get to it, someone else has gotten in ahead of me.

dag: Ka a pii Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ba ti Aduna min o bidibisi, ka bɛ nyɛ o ni su shɛb fukumsi zaa.
en: The only responsibility the Levites have is to serve Aaron and his sons.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali ni nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka di ni ti nyɛla yi laɣiŋgu kasi saha, ka di simdi ni yi ti lo noli, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti taai duŋ niŋ Ijipti naa. Ka nyin Daniɛl zuliya ni ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb gba ni ti taai duŋ pahi ni di chɛ ka ʒii la ni yɛla la niŋ pali, amaa bɛ ni ti kɔŋ nasara.
en: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.

dag: O boli o sapashin kpamba, ka bɛ kanna ka tuura, bɛ zo yomyom chaŋ gooni gbini, bɛ zaŋ nyɔtaɣirigu zali.
en: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.

dag: . Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli n ni zali ya, Yumiya taba! .
en: I give you these commandments so that you can love each other.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ puuni, bɔ ka bɛ lee nyari di ni?.
en: What do people gain from all the hard work that they work so hard at under the sun?.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses killed it and threw the blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Mbusim din daŋ tooni pun gari; amaa ka mbusim diba ayi na doli di nyaaŋa na.
en: The first horror has passed. Look! Two horrors are still coming after this.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zadok ti zaŋ kpam yiligu din daa be suɣili ni nimaani m-booi kpam maa bahi Sulemaana zuɣu ni. Di saha ka bɛ daa piɛb kikaa, ka niriba maa zaa dii kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. They blew the rams horn, and all the people said, Long live King Solomon.

dag: O daa kul dolila Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o, ka kul dol o zaligu kpan shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la.
en: He was faithful to the Lord and never disobeyed him, but carefully kept all the commands that the Lord had given Moses.

dag: Dina n-ni ti chɛ ka yi niŋ n shɛhiranima.
en: But this will give you an opportunity to tell about me.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ saa salan saa mibu saha. Yawɛ n-chɛ ka saa sagbana zaani mira, ka di chɛ ka sokam puri bindira niŋda.
en: Pray to the Lord for rain in the springtime. The Lord will send the lightning and the rain will fall, and he will make the plants grow in each persons field.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake maa. Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judanim yɛtɔɣa ni ka niriba bɛn be gooni zuɣu ŋɔ wumdi li.
en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah told the official, Speak Aramaic to us. We understand it. Don't speak Hebrew; all the people on the wall are listening.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ olivi tih ayi mini firilatamdis ayi din ʒe dunia tiŋgbani Duuma tooni la.
en: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zuliya bɔbili laɣimla taba ni bɛ lir a ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ta o daɣiri, chɛliya ka ti mooi ti nini bahi Ziɔn zuɣu.
en: Many nations have gathered to attack you. They say, Jerusalem must be destroyed! We will see this city in ruins.

dag: Paɣ shɛb gba daa ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni Yisa; Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsibila ni Jɔsis ma Mariama ni Salomi daa be bɛ ni.
en: Some women were there, looking on from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of the younger James and of Joseph, and Salome.

dag: Ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee zuɣusaa ha n-daa nam li, ka ninsalinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila salinsahi. O teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman sɔŋ la bee kaman tanti shɛl ni nir ni yɛn kpe m-beni.
en: It is the Lord who sits above the circle of the earth. And compared to him, people are like grasshoppers. He rolled open the skies like a piece of cloth. He stretched out the skies like a tent to sit under.

dag: Wummi n suhigu, dama bɛ filim ma. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni, dama bɛ mali yaa gari ma.
en: Help! They are chasing me, and they are too strong.

dag: Izraɛlnim ŋmanila gbuɣima ni kari doli piɛ shɛba n-wurim ba bahi. Tuuli, Asiria naa n-daa liri ba, ka pumpɔŋɔ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mi bahi naai ba.
en: Israel is like a flock of sheep that was scattered all over the country. Israel is like sheep that were chased away by lions. The first lion to attack was the king of Assyria. The last lion to crush Israels bones was King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

dag: Ka o yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash, Malim shili n-vooi tɔb maa to; ka o vooi li. Ka Ilaisha zaŋ o nuhi pa naa maa nuhi zuɣu;.
en: Elisha then said to Israels king, Put your hand on the bow. So Joash put his hand on the bow. Elisha then put his hands over the kings hands.

dag: O no n-gur o tɔbu kaman o nyɛla ti dima, ka zaŋ o nudirigu tiri ti kaman ti dim la. O ku ti ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyuri bara Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga tanti suɣili puuni la. O chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili yina kaman buɣim la.
en: He bent his bow like an enemy. He held his sword in his right hand. He killed all the good-looking men of Judah. He killed them as if they were the enemy. He poured out his anger like a fire on the tents of Zion.

dag: ni Maarat ni Bɛtanɔt ni Ɛlitɛkɔn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara ayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Maarath, Bethanoth, and Eltekon: six cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni. Doliya n zalikpana la, ka gbibiya n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I am the Lord your God. Obey my laws and my commands.

dag: M ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o ni me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: My father David wanted to build a temple for the name of the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ di kahigi wuhi ni so ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama di sabiya: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, The people God accepts because of their faith will live.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi wumbu. Ka o ni daa mali yaa gari Tama maa zuɣu, ka o zaŋ kpeengarigu dɔn o.
en: But he would not listen to her; and since he was stronger than she was, he overpowered her and raped her.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn daa yi Damaskus na ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: When troops from the Aramean kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed , of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Asiria na, ka o niriba bɛn kpalim maa dol li kaman o ni daa mali soli ti Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na la.
en: There will be a highway out of Assyria for those of his people Israel who have survived there, just as there was for their ancestors when they left Egypt.

dag: Nyama, o garitila n sani, ka m bi nyar o; o chana, amaa ka m bi mi ni o beni.
en: God passes by, but I cannot see him.

dag: Bɛ mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: They have no fear or respect for God. Psalm :.

dag: O zaŋm o ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Ibrahimma ni la niŋ a min a zuliya bɛn be a san ni, ka yi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Ibrahimma, ka yi be di ni ŋɔ su.
en: May he bless you and your descendants as he blessed Abraham, and may you take possession of this land, in which you have lived and which God gave to Abraham.

dag: Bɛ bi dɔni pahi tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa lu tɔb ni kurimbuni ha ka zaŋ bɛ bidibbina mali chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu, bɛn takɔbiri daa kuɣi bɛ zuɣuri, ka nyɔtaɣirisi pa bɛ kɔba zuɣu la. Dama tɔbutuhiriba dabiɛm daa be nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But now they are lying down by the powerful men who died long, long ago! They were buried with their weapons of war. Their swords will be laid under their heads. But their sins are on their bones, because when they were alive, they scared people.

dag: Pa so n-yɛn yihi n nyɛvili maa, amaa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n yɛn zaŋ li sɔŋ. M mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ li sɔŋ, ka lan mali yiko din ni ti lan kpuɣ li yaha. M Ba ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: No one takes my life away from me. I give my own life freely. I have the right to give my life, and I have the right to get it back again. This is what the Father told me.

dag: Tɔbaya ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la daa ʒiɛmi tab o, ka gba daa yɛli, Kuɣa goon shɛli bɛ ni mɛri maa, hal ŋɔɣu yi du n-tam di zuɣu, o ni daai li luhi.
en: Tobiah was standing there beside him, and he added, What kind of wall could they ever build? Even a fox could knock it down.

dag: Ka so ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga. N ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la. N ku chɛ ka a ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, m mi ku chɛ a.
en: Just as I was with Moses, I will be with you. No one will be able to stop you all your life. I will not abandon you. I will never leave you.

dag: Bɛ daa niŋ naani, ka naani goo ti kuhi ba. Ka bɛ daa ti paai, ka bɛ laasabu parigi.
en: thought they would find water. But they were disappointed.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ: Katat mini Nahalal ni Shimrɔn ni Idala ni Bɛtilihɛm: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Inside this border were the cities of Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. In all, there were twelve towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Ka o daa sab gbaŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo pahi ba. O ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: He wrote the following letter.

dag: Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa wurim bɛ nahiŋgu din daa doli Stiivin kubu nyaaŋa la zuɣu daa chaŋ hal ni Fɔnisia mini Saipurus ni Antiɔk. Bɛ daa mali Naawuni yɛligu n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim kɔŋko.
en: Some of the believers who were scattered by the persecution which took place when Stephen was killed went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, telling the message to Jews only.

dag: Amaa Rubin ni daa wum li, ka o fa o bɛ nuu ni ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka ti di o nyɛvili.
en: But Reuben wanted to save Joseph. He said, Lets not kill him.

dag: Nabipuɣiŋga, a naba viɛli namda ni pam! A gbalipina bela polipoli kaman nyiŋgokor shɛli tuumbaŋda ni mali.
en: How graceful are your sandaled feet, willing woman! The smooth curves of your thighs—like fine jewelry, the work of an artists hands!.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa ʒiya kariti saria maa ka o paɣ timna ti yɛl o, Yihim a nuu wuntizɔra ŋɔ yɛla ni, dama yuŋ la n sa nya muɣisigu pam zahindi ni o zuɣu.
en: While Pilate was judging the case, his wife sent him a message. It said, Don't have anything to do with that innocent man. I have had nightmares because of him.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni suhukpeeni yɛli, Di di simdi ni Naawuni yɛligu ŋɔ daŋ tɔɣisila yi sani, amaa yi ni daa li bahi ka tɛhi ni yi bi simdi nyɛvili din ka bahigu zuɣu, nyamiya, ti ni chɛn ya ka chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm zuɣulaannim zaa bɛn daa be pii la ni wum lala, ka zo nti kpe Ɛlibɛrit jɛmbu duu ti sɔɣi.
en: When all the leading men in the fort at Shechem heard about this, they sought safety in the stronghold of the temple of Baal-of-the-Covenant.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bapira Uziɛl bidibisi la na n ti yɛli ba, Mirimiya na ti kpuɣi yi mabihi maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ yi ti biɛhigu shee ŋɔ kpaŋa.
en: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel, Aaron's uncle, and said to them, Come here and carry your cousins' bodies away from the sacred Tent and put them outside the camp.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim mini Kalidianim zaa ni Pɛkɔdnima ni Shɔanima ni Kɔanima ni Asirianim zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla, ka gomnanim mini sapashin kpamba ni sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi ni ti be bɛ ni. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla wɔribariba.
en: Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the Assyrians with them, the most handsome young men, all of them governors and officers, career officers and conscripts, all of them on horseback.

dag: Dauda tɔbutuhiri biinsi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jashɔbiam ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔn nira, ka daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la kpɛma. Ŋuna n-daa ti zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa saha yin la.
en: First was Jashobeam of the clan of Hachmon, the leader of The Three. He fought with his spear against three hundred men and killed them all in one battle.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali gadama ni bɛ ba, ka kariti bɛ ma bahira nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tahiri vi mini turi na.
en: Only a shameful, disgraceful person would mistreat his father or turn his mother away from his home.

dag: Dama yi mi ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika ni nyɛ shɛm: O daa nyɛla bundana, amaa yi zuɣu ka o leei nandana ni yi leei bundaannima o nandaantali maa zuɣu.
en: You know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. Although he was rich, he became poor for your sakes, so that you could become rich through his poverty.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Anabi Musa ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni yɛli shɛm la yɛla? O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: You surely know about people being raised to life. You know that in the story about Moses and the burning bush, God said, I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni Sinai Zoli gbin la, yi daa bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So watch your conduct closely, because you didnt see any form on the day the LORD spoke to you at Horeb out of the very fire itself.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yi ni yo Yawɛ sam shɛli m-bala? Pa ŋuna n-nyɛ yi ba ŋun nam ya? Pa ŋuna n-nam ya, ka zali ya?.
en: Is this the way you repay the Lord for all he has done for you? You are stupid, foolish people. He is your Father and your Creator. He made you, and he supports you.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni ti zaŋ n ni zaŋ n yɛligu shɛli ti a la yɛli ba.
en: Go to that big city Nineveh, and say what I tell you.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa tooi baai du Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ n-nyɛ li la; amaa ka Ijiptinim daa kana ti tɔɣisi ba niŋ lala ka kom di ba.
en: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka kul dolila bɛ kal kura la.
en: But they wouldnt listen. Instead, they continued doing their former religious practices.

dag: di yi nyɛla bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni n-tum alahichi maa, ka di taali meei niriba maa, di saha ŋun zaŋmi naɣilabil polli ŋun ka dalinli m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara ti Yawɛ.
en: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Lan yɛlimiya, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira ŋɔ, fam ti. Yihim ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim ti na nti tiligi ti, ka ti paɣir a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka paɣir a ni jilima.
en: Say to him, Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman m bihi n-nyɛn ya la. Niŋmiya ti kaman ti ni niŋ ya shɛm; yi gba yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti!.
