en: I speak to you as if you were my children. Do the same as we have done—open your hearts also.

dag: ka wuɣi gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ kaɣili gbibil o nudirigu ni; ka damdir o tooni maan o ansarisi yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Then they made a crown from thorny branches and put it on his head, and they put a stick in his right hand. Then they bowed before him, making fun of him. They said, We salute you, king of the Jews.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: They took Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛba ayiyi bɛn mali nyɛvili daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu.
en: they came to Noah and entered the ark, two of every creature that breathes.

dag: Ka a niriba yi bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ lee niŋ ti dimbɔŋɔnim zaa? Nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi ni daa zaɣisi ma, ka jɛmdi tinzun wuna yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, lala ka yi yɛn jɛm saamba tiŋgbɔn shɛli din pa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. .
en: And the people who survive will ask, Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us? Then tell them: I am the Lord , but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-zaŋ ziŋgɔhi ga a yɛno n-vo a min a tɔbbihi zaa ni a yuri ni a wɔribariba bɛn zaa ye gbaɣinɔnima, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam ka gbibi nyɔtaɣiri kara mini nyɔtaɣiri bihi ni takɔbiri ŋɔ zaa yina.
en: I will turn you about, set hooks in your jaws, and lead you out, you and all your army, horses and riders, handsomely dressed, all of them, a great assembly, with buckler and shield, all of them wielding swords.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛligu, o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii, o luya, amaa ka o nina bi pɔbi.
en: The oracle of one who hears Gods speech, who perceives the Almightys visions, who falls down with eyes uncovered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bol o yaha, Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka o yɛl o, M bia, m bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni.
en: Again the LORD called Samuel, so Samuel got up, went to Eli, and said, Im here. You called me? I didnt call, my son, Eli replied. Go and lie down. .

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka fara gbaari nira, amaa ka tuma tumbu viɛnyɛliŋga mi chɛ ka nir leeri bundana.
en: Lazy hands will make you poor; hard-working hands will make you rich.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛli m ba, A paɣa dɔɣi bidibiga ka o suhu paligi la zuɣu.
en: Put a curse on the man who told my father, Good news! You have a son.

dag: Sokam zaa pin shɛŋa din be kasi nyɛla o ni su shɛli, ka so yi zaŋ binshɛli na ti ti maligumaana, di nyɛla ŋun maligumaana maa dini.
en: The sacred donations belong to each person alone; whatever anyone gives to the priest will be his.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So na ʒi n-tooi binyɛr palli tani n-liɣi binyɛr kurili; dama o yi niŋ lala o cheei binyɛr palli maa, ka tam palli din liɣi binyɛr kurili maa mi ku ŋman li.
en: Jesus told them this story: No one takes cloth off a new coat to cover a hole in an old coat. That would ruin the new coat, and the cloth from the new coat would not be the same as the old cloth.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma anii; ka daa ti kpi ka di bi niŋ so nandahima. Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o nanim silisi la ni.
en: Jehoram was years old when he became king. He ruled eight years in Jerusalem. No one was sad when he died. The people buried Jehoram in the City of David, but not in the graves where the kings are buried.

dag: Ka Yisa daa deei komihigu maa ka yɛli, Di naaya! Ka silim o zuɣu tiŋa n-dii bahi.
en: When he tasted the wine, he said, It is finished. Then he bowed his head and died.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa lu o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa yirigi zana pil o n-gbaag o bɛ ni daa gbi bɔɣ shɛli sɔŋ ni.
en: the nations from the surrounding regions allied against him. They cast their nets over him and caught him in their trap.

dag: So yi liri ya, di pala n yɛda ni ka o niŋ lala. Ka ŋunkam liri ya, o ku di nasara.
en: If anyone attacks you, its none of my doing. Whoever attacks you will fall because of you.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma pam. Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n ni guhiri shɛm yɛn zan tariga?.
en: I am trembling all over. Lord , how long until you heal me?.

dag: Doo maa zuɣu ka n ni nyu bara, amaa n ku nyu bara maŋmaŋ zuɣu dina; n naɣ ni nyula bara mmaŋmaŋ chɔɣinsi zuɣu.
en: So I will boast about this man—but I will not boast about myself, except the things that show how weak I am.

dag: Dama n ʒi naŋgban malisim niŋbu, di yi nyɛ lala ŋun nam ma ŋɔ ŋun chɛ ka m bahi pumpɔŋɔ.
en: I cannot treat one person better than another. If I did, God my Maker would punish me!.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili dahin shɛli ka tum tuun shɛŋa m-mali hal ti me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa naai zaa shɛm m-bala.
en: Everything Solomon had planned to do was now finished—from the laying of the temple's foundation to its completion.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n timdi m biyurigu Timoti ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma dolibu ni la yi sanna ni o ti teei ya n ni doli so shɛŋa Masia dolibu ni, ka wuhiri li shɛm luɣ shɛlikam cheechinim ni la.
en: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.

dag: Chɛ ka chɛrubi yino be di yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ yini polo, ka yino la mi be di tariga yaɣ din la polo. Chɛrubinim mini yɔrigu maa ni ti nyɛla bin yini di yaɣa maa zaa.
en: Put one winged heavenly creature at one end and one winged heavenly creature at the other. Place the winged heavenly creatures at the covers two ends.

dag: Kpiimba shihi sɔhirimi, ka bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee sɔhira.
en: The dead writhe, the inhabitants beneath the waters as well.

dag: Dindina wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yi lo ni yi chaŋla Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani.
en: If you say that, listen to this message from the Lord , you survivors from Judah. This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says: If you decide to go and live in Egypt, this will happen:.

dag: Ka Neetan daa garigi yɛli Dauda, Niŋm a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: Nathan answered, Do whatever you have in mind, because God is with you.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔhi malaika maa, Ka bɔ ka olivi tih ayi din ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu la yaɣa ayi la mi lee wuhira?.
en: Then I asked the angel, What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?.

dag: O daa zaŋ o zali tiŋgbani luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu; ka daa zaŋ puri ni bindira dihir o. O daa zaŋ tampima voya ni shiri mini chɛribo kuɣa voya ni kpam dih o.
en: The Lord helped them take control of the hill country. They took the harvest in the fields. He gave them honey from the cliffs and olive oil from the rocky ground.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaayi dali ka ti daa yiɣisi Ahava Mɔɣili maa gbini n-kuni Jɛrusalɛm, ka ti Naawuni maa nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka o tiligi ti ti dimnim mini sɔguriba nuu ni ti chandi maa ni.
en: It was on the twelfth day of the first month that we left the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem. Our God was with us and protected us from enemy attacks and from ambush as we traveled.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anii puuni ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Bɛrɛkia bia Anabi Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la yɛli.
en: In the eighth month in the second year of Darius, the LORDs word came to Zechariah the prophet, Berechiahs son and Iddos grandson.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, dindina yi mi ni ti ma silinchi kpar suma pihita mini binyɛr sun shɛŋa din nyɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra Ka bɛ yɛl o, yɛlim ti a ŋahili maa ka ti wum.
en: But if you cannot find the answer, you must give me linen shirts and changes of clothes. So the men said, Tell us your riddle, we want to hear it.

dag: Dama saha shɛli Dauda ni daa be Ɛdom la, ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm la daa chaŋ nimaani ni o ti sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: When David was fighting against Edom, Joab the general had gone up to bury the Israelite dead, and he had killed every male in Edom.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala ti ninsalitali biɛhigu la sandiriba ni ti doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu maa yubu ni wuhiri ti shɛm;.
en: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti gari dunoya ayi shɛŋa dunɔguliba ni daa ʒiɛya guli maa zuɣu, bɛ daa mali ti paala kurigu dunoli din yiri kpɛri tiŋ maa puuni. Ka di daa yooi di toli, ka bɛ yi n-doli solɔɣu chaŋ ha ka malaika maa ti dii chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.

dag: Ka Hur bia Rɛfaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Next to them Rephaiah, Hurs son, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labiri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and went back to Israel.

dag: Jɛshua daa nyɛla Joyakim ba; ka Joyakim nyɛ Ɛliashib ba, ka Ɛliashib nyɛ Joyada ba;.
en: Joshua was the father of Joiakim; Joiakim was the father of Eliashib; Eliashib was the father of Joiada;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi nya ma ka m mini so ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni bee ka n tuɣindi niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bee Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni bee tiŋ maa puuni.
en: They didnt find me arguing with anyone in the temple or stirring up a crowd, whether in the synagogue or anywhere else in the city.

dag: Yawɛ po o nudirigu din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛli: N ku lan zaŋ yi chi ti yi dimnim ka bɛ di. M mi ku lan chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ yi ni di wahala tɔɣi yi wain shɛli nyu.
en: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira gba daa bela Ɛnɔn tin shɛli din miri Salim la m-baptaiziri niriba, dama kom daa be nimaani pam; ka niriba chani o sani ka o ti baptaiziri ba.
en: John was baptizing at Aenon near Salem because there was a lot of water there, and people were coming to him and being baptized. .

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la kɔŋ nasara, ka di vi! Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo la birim ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Some people are trying to kill me. Disappoint them and make them ashamed. Make them turn and run away. They are planning to hurt me. Defeat and embarrass them.

dag: Ka Ishipan mini Ɛba ni Ɛliɛl.
en: Shashaks sons were Ishpan, Eber, Eliel.

dag: Amaa o suhu yi na kul yumi ni o niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka m bi kana ti yɛl a ka a zo n-tiligi ni alaafee, Yawɛ ŋun niŋmi mani Jɔnatan zaɣ biɛɣu n-gari m ba ni yɛn niŋ a shɛm maa, Yawɛ ni be a sani kaman o ni be m ba sani shɛm la.
en: If he intends to harm you, may the Lord strike me dead if I don't let you know about it and get you safely away. May the Lord be with you as he was with my father!.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ di vi, ka dabiɛm mali ba sahakam; ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi ni vi.
en: May they be defeated and terrified forever; may they die in complete disgrace.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn pun niŋ yɛda la paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani. Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani. Naawuni daa yɛli dimbɔŋɔ la hal saha shɛl o ni daa pun nam dunia naai la nyaaŋa;.
en: We who have faith are entering the rest. As God said, And because of my anger I swore: They will never enter into my rest! And yet Gods works were completed at the foundation of the world.

dag: O daa ku Ijipti ninsalinim bikpamba zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba.
en: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛri taba, Yi nya do so ŋun yina ŋɔ? O yaa yimina ni o ti mo Izraɛlnima, ka ninvuɣ so yi ku o, naa ni ti dilan buni pam, ka zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti o pahi, ka lan chɛ ka dilan daŋ zaa niŋdi bɛ yubu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Look at him! they said to each other. Listen to his challenge! King Saul has promised to give a big reward to the man who kills him; the king will also give him his daughter to marry and will not require his father's family to pay taxes.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa tim ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini anabinim maa na Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: Ahab got everyone together, then they went to meet Elijah on Mount Carmel.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋuni maa garigi yɛli: Di ni niŋ biɛɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisita. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lan lab mali zani di zaashee.
en: He said to me, For two thousand three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be restored.

dag: Jɔn saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛn suhuri ye alizanda nam ni kpɛbu zuɣu kul kabirimi chani ni bɛ ti zaŋ kpiɔŋ kpe di ni.
en: From the time John preached his message until this very day the Kingdom of heaven has suffered violent attacks, and violent men try to seize it.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o zɔri ninvuɣ so o ni bɔri nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka o ni bɔri ninvuɣ so mi suhu kul kpɛma.
en: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina nti teei zani tiŋ maa dunol ni, ka Siria tɔbbihi bɛn daa yi Zɔba mini Rɛhɔb ni Tɔb ni Maaka na la mi laɣim ʒe mɔɣu ni mɔɣu ni.
en: The Ammonites marched out and took up their position at the entrance to Rabbah, their capital city, while the others, both the Syrians and the men from Tob and Maacah, took up their position in the open countryside.

dag: Ti valim ba zaɣ nɛma kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni niŋdi shɛm la. Ti ni vali ba zaɣ muna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe gballi ni.
en: They may be alive and well when we find them, but they'll be dead when we're through with them!.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli nti zaŋ bɛ ŋariŋ lo n-zali teeku noli.
en: Jesus and his followers went across the lake and came to shore at Gennesaret. They tied the boat there.

dag: Ka di daa ti paai biɛɣu pia maa, ka bɛ nina ni kul nɛmi zaa kasi, ka bɛ lan ŋmɛlim gari bɛ tab bɛn zaa daa diri nayili bindirigu maa.
en: When the time was up, they looked healthier and stronger than all those who had been eating the royal food.

dag: Ka timpani yi bi kum tɔb chiriga kumsi ŋuni n-lee ni mali shili chaŋ tɔb tuhibu?.
en: And if a trumpet call is unrecognizable, then who will prepare for battle?.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa mini bɛ kpamba bɛn daa lo alikauli maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ni bahi bɛ daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka ku lan zaŋ ba niŋ daba yaha. Ka bɛ daa saɣi ka bahi ba.
en: So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed to free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage; they obeyed the kings command and let them go.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo daa kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu ni bɛ naai ba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa na kul bi chɛ; o daa na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Syria on the east and Philistia on the west have opened their mouths to devour Israel. Yet even so the Lord 's anger is not ended; his hand is still stretched out to punish.

dag: Ka n daa chɛ ka tabilakpihi lu bɛ zuɣu n-dim kari Amɔrinim nanima ayi la bahi; ka di daa pala yi takɔbiri bee yi tɔbiri zuɣu.
en: As you advanced, I threw them into panic in order to drive out the two Amorite kings. Your swords and bows had nothing to do with it.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo li buɣim.
en: The Philistines left their divine images behind, and David ordered them burned.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: Then Jesus cried out loudly and died.

dag: n-zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri maa bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: They will throw the evil people into the place of fire. There the people will cry and grind their teeth with pain.

dag: Giliad nyɛla n dini, ka Manaasa nyɛ n dini; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurugu zuɣupiligu; ka Juda nyɛ n nam jaaŋgbee.
en: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi bɛba ayopɔin daa doli bɛ nyaaŋa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na nti zani naɣ bɛmbala maa sani Nail Mɔɣili maa duli.
en: Then seven more cows came out of the river and stood on the bank of the river by the healthy cows. But these cows were thin and looked sick.

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim zuɣu wuhim ma a wuntia soli; malim a soli maa ka di tuhi ti ma.
en: Lord , I have so many enemies! Lead me to do your will; make your way plain for me to follow.

dag: Mɔab wurimya, ka Mɔabnim kuhira, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ni vi. Dinzuɣu Mɔabnim leela bɛ ni yɛn maani shɛb ansarisi, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa dabiɛm.
en: How its shattered! Go wail! How Moab turns away! What shame! Moab has become the butt of every joke, horrific to all its neighbors.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya biŋkɔb so ka o yi tiŋgban ni na. O daa malila yila ayi kaman piɛbil yila la, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o lɔŋ ŋmani waɣ biɛ tital la lɔŋ.
en: Then I saw another beast, which came up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb's horns, and it spoke like a dragon.

dag: ka ŋun saɣisiri niriba, ŋun saɣisim ba; ka ŋun tɔhiri tɔto, ŋun tɔhimi ni o suhu zaa; ka ŋun ʒe fukumsi zaashee, ŋun tummi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋun mi niŋdi nirilim, ŋun niŋmi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully.

dag: So yi tahir a sariakarita sani ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa; di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita maa sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: Suppose someone is suing you, and you are both going to court. Try hard to settle it on the way. If you dont settle it, you may have to go before the judge. And the judge will hand you over to the officer, who will throw you into jail.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli yili maa ni bihi maa, Niŋmiya kom pali sinsi ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kom pali di zaa ha nti paai di naŋgbanyɛra tarisi.
en: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka wum n dimnim ni yɛri shɛm.
en: Pay attention to me, LORD; listen to what my enemies are saying.

dag: ni Arivadnim ni Zɛmarinim ni Hamatinima.
en: Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa po pɔri yɛli, Naawuni yi ni be n sani, ka gbib ma n ni chani luɣ shɛli ŋɔ, ka ti ma bindirigu ka n di, ka ti ma situra ka n ye.
en: Jacob solemnly promised God, If you go with me and watch over me as I travel, and if you give me food and clothes.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee bɔri nyɛvili, ka bɔri ni o mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli, n-di din viɛli nyaɣisim?.
en: Do you want to enjoy life? Do you want to have many happy days?.

dag: Yawɛ, n gbib a zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka n di vi.
en: I follow your rules, Lord . Don't let me be ashamed.

dag: Ka paɣiba daa yɛli Naomi, Paɣimi Yawɛ! O ti a yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni o ti gbib a. Yawɛ chɛ ka bia maa yuli ti du pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni!.
en: The women said to Naomi, May the LORD be blessed, who today hasnt left you without a redeemer. May his name be proclaimed in Israel.

dag: amaa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla waazu ka tinim yihira. Yɛhudianim sani di nyɛla kuɣituurili, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi sani di nyɛla jɛrilim;.
en: but we preach Christ crucified, which is a scandal to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles.

dag: Hal Ɛlnatan mini Dɛlaiya ni Gɛmaria ni daa kpam naa jaande ni o di nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim maa zaa yoli, o daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah begged the king not to burn the scroll, but he wouldnt listen to them.

dag: Bɛn ti be katiŋa, alɔbo ni di ba, bɛn be yoma, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, bɛn mi ti kpalim, kum ni ku ba. Lala ka n ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: People far away will die from disease. People near this place will be killed with swords, and those who are left in the city will starve to death. Only then will I stop being angry.

dag: O yi ti paana yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli n-nya ba lala, bɛ ni nya alibarika.
en: Happy are those whom he finds alert, even if he comes at midnight or just before dawn.

dag: Lala ka Naa Dauda gba wuhi alibarika shɛli din be ninvuɣ so ni Naawuni ni lihi wuntizɔra, ka di pala o tuma zuɣu. O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: In the same way, David also pronounces a blessing on the person to whom God credits righteousness apart from actions.

dag: Yi ni daa paai kpe na, Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi daa kana ti liri ti n-tuhi ti, amaa ka ti daa nyaŋ ba.
en: And when we came to this place, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan came out to fight against us. But we defeated them.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa daa saɣi ni o ni be Maika sani m-be kaman o bidibisi ni yino.
en: The young Levite agreed to live with Micah. He became like one of Micahs own sons.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi gɔriti dama atam kpuɣibu saha paaya. Kamiyana ti siɣi no, dama wain bɔɣili paliya. Wain ni tɔɣiri niŋdi binshɛŋa ni maa palimi hal ti puuri bahira; dama bɛ tuumbiɛri galisiya pam.
en: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.

dag: Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: We played wedding music for you, but you wouldn't dance! We sang funeral songs, but you wouldn't cry.

dag: Dama hal a min a mabihi bɛn be dundɔn yin ni nyɛla bɛn lo a zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ kul yimi zani a zuɣu; hal bɛ yi kul paɣir a gba nyin di niŋ ba yɛda.
en: Even your relatives, your very family, are planning to trap you. They are out to get you. So dont trust them, even if they appear to be on your side.

dag: O bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Shiira. Ŋuna n-daa me Bɛtihɔrɔn tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa polo ni Uzɛnishiira la.
en: Ephraims daughter was Sheerah. Sheerah built Lower Beth Horon and Upper Beth Horon and Lower Uzzen Sheerah and Upper Uzzen Sheerah.

dag: N daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, so ku lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di nyaaŋa, dama n yɛtɔɣa daa yi kpɛri ba pam.
en: After my speech, they didnt respond. My words fell gently on them.

dag: Ka mihi daa kul lo Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo hal ka bɛ ti lu buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, still tied up, fell into the heart of the blazing fire.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm, ka bɛ bidibbina bahi yoli!.
en: Look how the mighty warriors have fallen! Look how the weapons of war have been destroyed!.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrimia Libina nir bia ka o yuli booni Hamutal.
en: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for three months. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from the city of Libnah.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri karimbaani puuni bɛ niŋdi nandaamba alaka. Chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: Meanwhile, the wicked are proudly in hot pursuit of those who suffer. Let them get caught in the very same schemes theyve thought up!.

dag: Ka bɛn be ŋariŋ maa ni daa jɛm o ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni Bia n-shiri nyɛ a.
en: Then those in the boat worshipped Jesus and said, You must be Gods Son.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ daadamnim sariakarita. Yawɛ, karim ma saria ka di doli n wuntitali mini n galimi kalinsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Lord , judge the people. Lord , judge me. Prove that I am right and that I am innocent.

dag: Babilɔn ni ti leela daboli doya, ka leei yɔbahi biɛhigu shee; di ni ti leela dabiɛm zɔbu mini ansarisi malibu tiŋa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Babylon will be a pile of rubble where only jackals live, and everyone will be afraid to walk among the ruins.

dag: Mɔab wurimya, ka Mɔabnim kuhira, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ni vi. Dinzuɣu Mɔabnim leela bɛ ni yɛn maani shɛb ansarisi, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa dabiɛm.
en: Moab is shattered. The people are crying. Moab surrendered. Now Moab is ashamed. People make fun of Moab, but what happened fills them with fear.

dag: wulikpani nyoli ni ŋ-ŋmaai di zaɣ maani n-zaŋ li chaŋ daabiligu tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti zaŋ li sa kɔhigɔriba tiŋ ni.
en: which he carried to a land of commerce and placed in a city of merchants.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Di chaŋ wula ka yi baŋdi dunia ŋɔ mini sagbana shihira, ka lee bi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ din shihira.
en: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.

dag: Yi daa zaŋ wuntizɔra taali n-ku o, amaa o bi zaɣisi ya.
en: You showed no mercy to good people. They were not against you, but you killed them.

dag: Ka binshɛli yi sɔɣi, di sɔɣimi ni di ti yi zahira, ka binshɛli din mi be ashilɔni, di be ashilɔni maa ni di ti yila palo.
en: Whatever is hidden away will be brought out into the open, and whatever is covered up will be uncovered.

dag: Dunia salinim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ!.
en: Sing to the Lord , all the world!.

dag: Duri pam be m Ba yiŋa. N chanimi ni n ti mali biɛhigu shee zali ya. Di yi di pa lala n naan ku yɛli ya di yɛla.
en: There are many rooms in my Fathers house. I would not tell you this if it were not true. I am going there to prepare a place for you.

dag: Benya ni suhu yini ni taba; di lihiya ʒiɛm so, amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tabili tarimba; di kuuniya yi baŋsim.
en: Live together in peace with each other. Dont be proud, but be willing to be friends with people who are not important to others. Dont think of yourself as smarter than everyone else.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a kpiɔŋ zaa ni a tɛha zaa, ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. .
en: The man answered, Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and Love your neighbor as you love yourself.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti du Hɔr Zoli maa niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the entire community.

dag: Amaa n Duuma, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ŋun niŋdi nirilim, a bi jɛri suli yom, ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali mi galisi pam.
en: But you, O Lord, are a merciful and loving God, always patient, always kind and faithful.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Apolɔs? Bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Pool? Ti kul nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn sɔŋ ya ka yi niŋ yɛda kaman ti Duuma ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm.
en: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter spoke up and said to Jesus, I will never leave you, even though all the rest do.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o noli naai tinduyanima ni o yɔhim ba, ka o kpiɔŋ ni ti zoori pahira, hal o ni kul nyɛla ŋun yɛn di n-su la niriba biɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.

dag: amaa di buɣisi di dundɔŋ la dina, dama bɛ zaŋ li tila bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ ni ti no n-gili tiŋ kasi la puuni chir pihinahinaayi.
en: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for months.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka a nini kpɛma n-gari bɛ nini ni kpɛm shɛm, ka chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma n-gari bɛ suhuri ni kpɛm shɛm.
en: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.

dag: Tiŋ kam daa malila di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ka di gil li. Lala n-daa nyɛ di tinsi maa zaa.
en: Each of these towns had some land in it for their animals. That was true for every town.

dag: N yi chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari m-bahi yoli bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: When I punish the people for their sins and make the country a wasteland, then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi duri tusaanahi. O daa malila yuri tuhi pinaayi, ka daa piripiri ba niŋ chɛchɛbunsi ni be tin shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be ŋun naa sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: King Solomon also had four thousand stalls for his chariots and horses, and had twelve thousand cavalry horses. Some of them he kept in Jerusalem and the rest he stationed in various other cities.

dag: Nir nyamma yi pahi, bɛn diri li gba pahirimi. Ka di nyɔri nyɛ dini ŋun su li sani m-pahila o nini n-kul yɛn nya li?.
en: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.

dag: Ka a yi ti chɛ ka a niriba ŋɔ doli so shɛlikam n-lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tin shɛli a ni pii ŋɔ mini n ni me a jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: Sometimes you will command your people to go and fight against their enemies. Then your people will turn toward the city that you have chosen and the Temple that I built in your honor, and they will pray to you, Lord .

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, M mabihi n-daa bala. M mini ba zaa nyɛla ma pu yin ni bihi. Yawɛ zuɣu, yi yi di daa chɛ ba, n naan ku kun ya.
en: They were my brothers, Gideon said, my own mothers sons. As surely as the LORD lives, I promise that if you had let them live, I wouldnt kill you.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛtali ni nyaɣisi bɛ noya ni, ka bɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi bɛ zilima lɔna ni;.
en: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu bee piɛɣu ŋun mali daŋ mini binshɛɣukam din bi niŋ kamaata mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din chihiri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted!.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jotham died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City, and his son Ahaz succeeded him as king.

dag: Dama bɛ yihi ba la Izraɛlnim puuni n-zaŋ ba ti ma zaa ka n deei ba leei n ni su shɛba, ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba.
en: I have claimed them in the place of all the first-born sons of the Israelites, and they belong to me alone.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ka n naɣ zaŋ niŋ n suhu ni, dinzuɣu ka m mali tahima:.
en: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ omaŋ dalim kpatinariga yili di ni lu, ka so yi gbaa li di ku tooi zani.
en: He leans on its web, and it doesnt stand; grasps it, and it cant remain in place.

dag: Di saha ka o paɣ daa bɔh o, A na kul gbibila a galimi kalinsi maa kirikiri? Tum Naawuni ka kpi.
en: His wife said to him, Are you still holding on to your faith? Why dont you just curse God and die.

dag: Ham bidibisi mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ tinsi ni bɛ zuliyazuliya yɛtɔɣ kɔŋkɔba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: These are Hams sons according to their clans, their languages, their lands, and their nations.

dag: Nir karimbaani n-tahir o filiŋ na, amaa ŋun siɣisir omaŋ ni nya jilima.
en: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti zani Niriba Dunɔdal la ni, Juda nanim ni doli shɛli yira, ka lan dol li kpɛri la, ka lan chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya zaa ni.
en: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord , so pay attention.

dag: O daa malila paɣiba kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ nabipuɣinsi, ka mali mamanim mi kɔbisita; ka o paɣiba maa daa ti chɛ ka o birigi.
en: Solomon married seven hundred princesses and also had three hundred concubines. They made him turn away from God.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛ ka Asaf min o mabihi maa be Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa gbini ni bɛ tumdi di tuma sahakam kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: Then David placed Asaph and his relatives, together with Obed-edom and sixty-eight of his relatives, to minister there continually before the chest containing the LORDs covenant, following the routines required on each day.

dag: Ka o bapir maa daa yɛl o, N suhir a mi, yɛlim ma Samuɛl ni yɛl a shɛm.
en: Sauls uncle said, Please tell me, what did Samuel say to you.

dag: Ka ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ka Masia daa yi o zuɣu nyɛla man ŋun kpalim nyaaŋa dɔɣim palli nyabu ni ŋɔ;.
en: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti kul zaɣisi alahiziba tuma ayi ŋɔ dihi tabili bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a yɛligu, nyin toomi Nail Mɔɣili la kom kpaai bahi tiŋkuŋ zuɣu ka di leei ʒim tiŋkuŋ maa zuɣu.
en: If they wont believe even these two signs or pay attention to you, then take some water from the Nile River and pour it out on dry ground. The water that you take from the Nile will turn into blood on the dry ground.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti nya Yisa duli din maa polo bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ saha ka a ka kpe na.
en: The people found Jesus on the other side of the lake. They asked him, Teacher, when did you come here.

dag: Sool ni daa su ti saha shɛl la, nyini n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi fa Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa yɛl a, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti guli n niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ, ka ti nyɛ ŋun ni su Izraɛl. .
en: Even when Saul was our king, you were the one who led us into battle. And you were the one who brought Israel back home from war. The Lord himself said to you, You will be the shepherd of my people, the Israelites. You will be the ruler over Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di yi buni, ka ʒe yi daguya. Bɛ ni ti daai yi goma luhi, ka wurim yi yil viɛla la. Bɛ ni ti va yi kuɣa mini yi taabɔdari ni yi taŋkpazim ti bahi kom ni.
en: Your enemies will help themselves to your wealth and merchandise. They will pull down your walls and shatter your luxurious houses. They will take the stones and wood and all the rubble, and dump them into the sea.

dag: Bidɔɣirisurigu tam bɛ yɛla, ka zunzuya di ba ka bɛ nyaɣisa; ka so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛtali lurimi kaman tia la.
en: Their own mothers will forget them. Only the worms will want them. No one will remember them. They will be broken like a rotten stick!.

dag: N ni ti niŋdi ba din viɛla ni suhupiɛlli, ka zaŋ ba ʒili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ni n shia zaa.
en: They will make me happy. I will enjoy doing good to them. And I will surely plant them in this land and make them grow. I will do this with all my heart and soul.

dag: Naftali tiŋgban ni bɛ daa yihila Kɛdɛshi din be Galili la mini Hamɔn ni Kiriataim ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The Gershon families also got the towns of Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim from the tribe of Naphtali. They also got the fields near those towns.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa ti paai Kapɛrinium nti kpe duu ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi di lee ŋmɛri sol ni la.
en: Jesus and his disciples went to his home in Capernaum. After they were inside the house, Jesus asked them, What were you arguing about along the way.

dag: amaa ka di chɛ ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ti kpe nti lihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi maa hal biɛla gba, di yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni kpi.
en: If you dont do this, the Kohathite men might go in and look at the holy things. If they look at these things, even for a moment, they must die.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka bɛ nini baligi ka o deei Mɛtɛgama bɛ nuu ni.
en: Later David defeated the Philistines and took control of a large area of land around Gath.

dag: ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: and Balaam said: I am the son of Beor, and my words are true, so listen to my message!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Zakaria: Yɛlim ba.
en: This is the Lord s message to Zechariah:.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, amaa o daa deei zaka ti yab Ibrahimma sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋuna ŋun daa deei Naawuni daalikaulinim la ni.
en: Melchizedek was not descended from Levi, but he collected one tenth from Abraham and blessed him, the man who received God's promises.

dag: Hal goli bi piɛli o sani gba; ka saŋmarisi mi pa bɛn ka daɣiri o sani.
en: In his eyes even the moon is not bright, or the stars pure.

dag: A yi zaŋ n ni wuh a shɛli ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la, a ni niŋ Yisa Masia tumtumdi suŋ, a ni zaŋ yɛda niŋbu yɛtɔɣa mini wuhibu suŋ shɛli a ni pun dol la n-dih amaŋ la zuɣu.
en: If you give these instructions to the believers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, as you feed yourself spiritually on the words of faith and of the true teaching which you have followed.

dag: Nir yi nya yɛm, di so salima, ka nir yi pii tɛhi zilima, di so anzinfa.
en: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ leei suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: As it is written, God gave them a dull spirit, so that their eyes would not see and their ears not hear, right up until the present day. .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka o lo ti alikauli kara din mali buchi ni di chɛ ka ti yi dunia ŋɔ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri din saɣindi ninsalinim la ni, ka ti min o laɣim mali Naawunitali biɛhigu.
en: In this way he has given us the very great and precious gifts he promised, so that by means of these gifts you may escape from the destructive lust that is in the world, and may come to share the divine nature.

dag: O ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa pa omaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka di ti yɛn yina. O ni ti saɣim binyara saɣindi biɛɣu, ka ni ti di nasara o ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni. O ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yiko mini wuntizɔriba zaa yoli.
en: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.

dag: Ka yilibila daa bili yina tam yila anahi maa zaɣ yini zuɣu. Ka di yiko daa yɛligi kpa nudirigu polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la polo.
en: Out of one of these four horns grew a little horn, whose power extended toward the south and the east and toward the Promised Land.

dag: Di nyuriya dam kuuna, dama di nyubu puuni ka ninvuɣ yotali yirina, amaa lee chɛliya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pali yi suhuri ni.
en: Dont be drunk with wine, which will ruin your life, but be filled with the Spirit.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa tim tuumba nti yɛli Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl Naa Jɛhu yaaŋa la, Kamina ka ti ti zaŋ ti gbɛri kpa taba.
en: Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, son of King Jehu of Israel. Amaziahs message said, Come on, lets meet together face to face and fight.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya salo maa, ka o du zoli zuɣu ti ʒini, ka o nyaandoliba laɣim gil o.
en: Jesus saw the crowds and went up a hill, where he sat down. His disciples gathered around him.

dag: Yi ku tooi nyu ti Duuma pipia ni binnyurigu, ka lan nyu alizin biɛri pipia ni binnyurigu. Yi mi ku tooi di ti Duuma bindirigu, ka lan di alizin biɛri bindirigu.
en: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.

dag: Biɛri bɔhibu mini sanyoo nyɛla n dini, saha shɛli bɛ napɔna yi ti sarigi; dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha kanna yomyom.
en: I will punish them for the bad things they did. But I am saving that punishment for when they slip and do bad things. Their time of trouble is near. Their punishment will come quickly.

dag: din nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zali ya alizanda ni, ka di nyɛ din ku tooi pooi bee n-saɣim bee n-kpaai la.
en: Now we wait to receive the blessings God has for his children. These blessings are kept for you in heaven. They cannot be ruined or be destroyed or lose their beauty.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi maa ha ka bɛ yɛli taba, Doo maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum bee sarika kpɛhibu.
en: and left the room. They were talking to each other. They said, This man has done nothing worthy of being put to death or even put in jail.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Di lihir o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu bee o wɔɣilim, man pun zaɣis o, dama Yawɛ ŋun bi lihiri kaman ninsal ni lihiri shɛm, ninsal ŋun lihirila niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu, amaa Yawɛ ŋun lihirila suhu ni.
en: But the LORD said to Samuel, Have no regard for his appearance or stature, because I havent selected him. God doesnt look at things like humans do. Humans see only what is visible to the eyes, but the LORD sees into the heart.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani Ijipti ti bɔri sɔŋsim zuɣu. Bɛ niŋla Ijipti tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam la kpiɔŋ mini bɛ wɔribariba ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi yɛda; amaa ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yɛda bee n-suh o ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: Look at the people going down to Egypt for help. They think the horses they get will save them. They hope the many chariots and powerful soldiers will protect them. But the people dont trust the Holy One of Israel. They didnt ask the Lord for help.

dag: yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima ka saɣim tiŋ maa zaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni hal ka zaŋ takɔb ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: then kill all the people in that town and all their livestock too. Destroy that town completely.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, m bi bɔri yi naɣikpahi ni naɣilahi bee yi buzɔna ni buhi.
en: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba. Lala zuɣu ka yi chirim maa.
en: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ku niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: They did not kill the heathen, as the Lord had commanded them to do.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Cham ti bo tiŋgul zali, ka yɛl o ni o nini yi nya shɛlikam, ŋun yɛlima.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Go and post a sentry, and tell him to report what he sees.

dag: Ka n daa lan yɛli ba n Naawuni nuu ni pa n zuɣu shɛm mini naa ni daa yɛli ma shɛm yɛla. Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, Chɛliya ka ti yiɣisi piligi di mɛbu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kpalanzuya gbini taba.
en: And I told them how God had been with me and helped me, and what the emperor had said to me. They responded, Let's start rebuilding! And they got ready to start the work.

dag: dindina n ni zo ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ darigi yi tibili buyopɔin yi daalahichinim maa zuɣu.
en: then in my anger I will turn on you and again make your punishment seven times worse than before.

dag: Luk . Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anab kura la ni yino ŋun neei kum ni na.
en: Lk . Some say that you are John the Baptist, they answered. Others say that you are Elijah, while others say that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ so ŋunkam mali salima yihi li na. Ka bɛ daa yihi li na ti ti ma, ka n zaŋ li bahi buɣim ni, ka naɣibil ŋɔ yina.
en: I asked them to bring me their gold ornaments, and those who had any took them off and gave them to me. I threw the ornaments into the fire and out came this bull-calf.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bo bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi sil shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni ka na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni la.
en: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yili Naawuni paɣibu yilli naai, ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu.
en: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama n niŋ ya naani zaa.
en: I am so happy that I can trust you fully.

dag: ka sua maa mini di sukpali zaa kpe nti lim. Ka o puli maa kpam mum li niŋ, dama o daa bi darigi ŋooi sua maa o puli maa ni, ka o puuni daɣiri daa zɔri yirina.
en: The whole sword went in, handle and all, and the fat covered it up. Ehud did not pull it out of the king's belly, and it stuck out behind, between his legs.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya sani. Wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm ka kana ti tiligi ti!.
en: reveal yourself to the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Show us your strength; come and save us!.

dag: Yinim bɛn daa ʒe n niriba ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi suhuri paligi, ka yi ŋumda kaman naɣisaa n-nɔri buri chi la bee n-kuhiri kaman yuri la.
en: The Lord says, People of Babylonia, you plundered my nation. You are happy and glad, going about like a cow threshing grain or like a neighing horse.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛbis o biɛyanim maa. Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ, ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ŋme tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni.
en: He sent his brothers off and as they left, he said to them, Don't quarrel on the way.

dag: Musa ni daa ti bi doo, ka o daa ti yi n-chaŋ o niriba sani nti nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa, ka daa ti nya Ijipti do so ni buri o niriba Hiburunim maa ni yino.
en: After Moses had grown up, he went out to where his own people were hard at work, and he saw an Egyptian beating one of them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋmanila mɔri din zoori wuntaŋ nyeebu ni, ka bɛ nyaɣa teei ʒiɛvari puu ni.
en: Such people are like a vine that gets plenty of water and sunshine, and its branches spread throughout the garden.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Gbibiya n jɛmbu dabisili la, dama dina n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali ya ka yi be kasi.
en: Tell the Israelites this: You must follow the rules about my special days of rest. You must do this because they will be a sign between you and me for all generations. This will show you that I, the Lord , have made you my special people.

dag: M bi saɣi ni paɣiba nyɛ karimbanima bee n-su dɔbba fukumsi; di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ shini baalim.
en: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Leeban ni Yaakubu yiɣisiya zo.
en: Three days later Laban learned that Jacob had run away.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka o daa yɛli zaŋ kpa Juda zuliya polo, Yawɛ, deemi Juda zuliya suhigu, ka zaŋ ba laɣim bɛ niriba ni, ka ti ba kpiɔŋ, ka sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.

dag: Di piligu dali ti nyɛla laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di ti tumiya yi dabisili kam tuma dindali maa.
en: There will be a holy meeting on the first day. You must not do any work.

dag: Ŋuna n-simdi yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To him be power forever and always. Amen.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n na ʒi n-zaɣisi nandaamba sɔŋbu, bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Surely no one would attack a man who is already ruined, when he is hurt and crying for help.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa boli Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba na.
en: Joshua held a meeting with the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, and he told them:.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza ni o yihim tulaale tuɣindi labihi maa buɣim niɛm maa ni n-kpaai di buɣim bahi katiŋa, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred.

dag: Di saha ka zuɣulaannima ayi la mini kpambaliba la daa lo nia m-bɔri ni bɛ nya Daniɛl taali o ni tumdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tuma shɛm puuni, amaa ka bi tooi. Dama Daniɛl daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim o suhu ni, ka bi tumdi din nyɛ chirimbu bee bilikɔnsi tuma.
en: Then the other supervisors and the governors tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel administered the empire, but they couldn't, because Daniel was reliable and did not do anything wrong or dishonest.

dag: Bɛ daanzinfa bee bɛ salima ti ku tooi tiligi ba Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali. O suhuyiɣisili buɣim ni ti di dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dama o ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam naai naari biɛɣu.
en: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord , am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.

dag: Dama yi mi wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa ni zali ti shɛm puuni la yɛla.
en: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti o yiko ni o su daadam kam fukumsi, ka niŋ o yiko ni o ti ninvuɣ shɛb zaa a ni zaŋ ti o nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: For you gave him authority over all people, so that he might give eternal life to all those you gave him.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋuni n-lee ku zo a ka tibig a yuli? Dama a ko m-be kasi. Zuliya kam ni kana nti jɛm a, dama a wuntia saria karibu yi palo.
en: All people will fear you, O Lord. All people will praise your name. Only you are holy. All people will come and worship before you, because it is clear that you do what is right.

dag: Zaligu tanzaa yi wurim, wula ka wuntizɔra yɛn niŋ?.
en: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla suhuyiɣisili dabisili; di ni ti nyɛla nandahima mini biɛrim dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla saɣiŋgu mini dabari zalibu dabisili, ka ni ti nyɛla zibisim mini bumbɔni dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla sagbana mini zibisim titali dabisili.
en: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan kari niriba maa tin ya. Bɛ ni leei yi dimnima; ka bɛ wuna leei zana gbahi ya.
en: So now I tell you, I wont drive them out before you, but theyll be a problem for you, and their gods will be a trap for you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di to ni bundana kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: Jesus then said to his disciples, I assure you: it will be very hard for rich people to enter the Kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin m-pahi zim bihi biɛla.
en: Jesus said, How much bread do you have? They responded, Seven loaves and a few fish.

dag: Timiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam jɛmdi Yawɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Be proud of his holy name. You followers of the Lord , be happy!.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli: Zipɔr bia Balak, yiɣisima. Luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: and Balaam uttered this prophecy: Come, Balak son of Zippor, And listen to what I have to say.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba pahi Yisa zuɣu ni bɛ ti ku ba.
en: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.

dag: amaa chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu nyɛla binshɛli din be yi suhuri ni, ka pa ni din saɣinda. Dina n-nyɛ tarimtali mini suhumahili, dama dimbɔŋɔnima m-mali buchi pam Naawuni sani.
en: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.

dag: Yi ku niriba pam yi tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, ka zaŋ yi ni ku shɛb maa pali di solɔri zuɣu.
en: You continue to commit murder in this city, and you fill its streets with the slain.

dag: Di ni kpamba kul ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka di sariakaritiba be kaman zaawuni kunduna bɛn bi guuri binshɛli zaana hal ni asiba la.
en: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kumiya bidibbihi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: Now, kill all the Midianite boys, and kill all the Midianite women who have had sexual relations with a man.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Wuhim ti ŋahili la gbinni.
en: Peter said, Explain to us what you said earlier to the people.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili ŋɔ ni maa, ti kul ŋuhirimi ni suhubɔhibo; ka di pala ti bɔrimi ni ti yee li sɔŋ, amaa ti bɔri ni ti yɛla alizanda ni din la pa di zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka nyɛvili tooi vali din kpira.
en: While we live in this tent, we have burdens and so we complain. I dont mean that we want to remove this tent, but we want to be clothed with our heavenly home. Then this body that dies will be covered with life.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayɔbu daba anu dali ka n daa ʒi n yiŋa, ka Juda kpamba daa ʒi n tooni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yiko daa siɣi n zuɣu na nimaani.
en: One day I, Ezekiel, was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting there in front of me. This was on the fifth day of the sixth month of the sixth year of exile. Suddenly, the power of the Lord GOD came on me.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa yi zaani Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa la dabisa biɛla, ka bɛ daa doli Yawɛ zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kpalim doya, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti lan doli Yawɛ zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ dundɔŋ gili di zaa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunɔdali.
en: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.

dag: ka di nyɛla n daa zɔrila zama dabiɛm zuɣu bee n-zɔri ni niriba ti lihi ʒiɛm ma zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n fo n noli ka bi yi samban ni na.
en: because I feared the large crowd; the clans contempt frightened me; I was quiet and didnt venture outside.

dag: Bɛ guurimi kaman tɔbutuhiriba la; ka duri goma kaman tɔbbihi la. Bɛ zaa mi kul dolila bɛ soya, ka bɛ taɣiri bɔba.
en: They attack like warriors; they climb the walls like soldiers. They all keep marching straight ahead and do not change direction.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali binshɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ binzahindigu zahim li, ka daa sabi binshɛɣukam tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ di saha maa.
en: Everything was counted, weighed, and recorded.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa wum naa ni kari saria maa ŋ-ŋmaai li shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa lu naa maa sizuura, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni Naawuni yɛm be o ni, ka o ni kariti saria ka di doli zaligu soli.
en: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.

dag: Lala n-nyɛn ya. Yi ŋmanila wuntizɔriba niriba sani, amaa ka bilikɔnsi mini tuumbiɛri lee pali yi suhuri ni.
en: It is the same with you. People look at you and think you are godly. But on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and evil.

dag: Ka Aduna daa miri sara maligu bimbini maa nti kɔrigi omaŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo naɣila polli maa.
en: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.

dag: Ka Lɔt min o bipuɣins ayi la daa ti yiɣisi Zɔa n-chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-kpe m-be vokabili ni, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o be Zɔa.
en: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli ba, Pa yi ni chani tin shɛli maa soli m-bɔŋɔ; pa yi mi ni chani tin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ. Doliya ma ka n zaŋ ya tahi yi ni bɔri so maa sani. Ka o daa zaŋ ba tahi Samaria.
en: Elisha said to them, This isnt the right road or the right city. Follow me, and Ill lead you to the man you are looking for. But he took them to Samaria!.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun nya gballi ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o suhu paligi?.
en: who rejoice excitedly, who are thrilled when they find a grave?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni yubu n-su yi dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu, ka pa ni daadamtali kɔr biɛri.
en: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti nyu wain; chɛliya ka ti nyu binnyuri kpɛma. Biɛɣuni sa ni be kaman zuŋɔ, hal di sa ni gari lala gba.
en: You say to each other, Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa yi bɛ sansani maa ni na chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli.
en: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the chiefs of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bolila zuliya shɛb bɛn be nuzaa polo ŋɔ nanima, ka bɛ zaa kana ti kpa bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya gbini. Bɛ ni ti teei gili di goondahi din gil li la mini Juda fɔntinsi zaa.
en: Im calling for all the tribes of great nations from the north, says the LORD, and they will set up their rulers by the entrances of Jerusalem, on its walls, and in every city of Judah.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu, ka pɔbisi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim bahi yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ putɔɣunim bɛn mi niriba kubu looloochi nuu ni.
en: I will pour out my anger against you. My anger will burn you like a hot wind. I will hand you over to cruel men. Those men are skilled at killing people.

dag: N suhu kul bɔrila binshɛli nyabu, amaa ka na bi nya li. N nya do yino niriba tuhili puuni, amaa ka bi nya paɣ yino niriba tuhili maa puuni.
en: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋdila bɛn niŋdi ya viɛnyɛliŋga zaɣ viɛlli, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba niŋdila lala.
en: If you are kind only to someone who is kind to you, will God be pleased with you for that? Even sinners are kind to people who are kind to them.

dag: Bɛ ŋari n soli, ka luhi ma, ka bi bɔri so sɔŋsim.
en: destroy my road, profit from my fall, with no help.

dag: Yi yi doli Naawuni nam zaligu kaman di ni wuhi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la, yi niŋ din tuhi. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: One law rules over all other laws. This royal law is found in the Scriptures: Love your neighbor the same as you love yourself. If you obey this law, you are doing right.

dag: Timaŋmaŋ kom ka ti lan ŋmaligi dari nyura, ka lan ŋmaligi yɔri timaŋmaŋ dari zuɣu.
en: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba, ka guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdaya. Bɛ ni ti kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb nyɔri buɣim maani sara la mini niriba ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti mali sara la. Bɛ ni ti tumdi tuma tiri niriba maa.
en: They will keep charge in my sanctuary, and they will oversee the temple gates and keep charge of the temple. They will slaughter the entirely burned offerings and the sacrifices for the people, and they will stand before them to minister to them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi Ibrahimma, Bɔzuɣu ka Zara la ka yɛli, N ni kurigi shɛm ŋɔ, n ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: Then the Lord asked Abraham, Why did Sarah laugh and say, Can I really have a child when I am so old.

dag: Yawɛ, zaŋm ti labis a sani, ka chɛ ka ti lan lab a sanna. Chɛ ka ti lan labi ti biɛr kurili la ni.
en: Return us, LORD, to yourself. Please let us return! Give us new days, like those long ago.

dag: Niriba kul paɣir a mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka a yuli du pam dunia ŋɔ zaa ni; ka a doli yɛlimaŋli soli su nam.
en: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai Yisa.
en: and the men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

dag: Hal bɛ daa timla tuumba katinsi ni bɛ ti boli dɔbba ti ba, ka bɛ daa shiri kana. Bɛ zuɣu ka a su kom, ka bali chilo, ka zaŋ yɛ viɛla ye.
en: Again and again they sent messengers to invite men to come from a great distance, and the men came. The two sisters would bathe and put on eye shadow and jewelry.

dag: Ka Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Ti dim maa n-nyɛ Haman ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ. Di saha maa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Haman naa mini Ɛsta tooni.
en: Esther answered, Our enemy, our persecutor, is this evil man Haman! Haman faced the king and queen with terror.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni bee ka paɣ zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu ka o min o dɔni; di nyɛla biriginsim.
en: You will not have sexual relations with any animal, becoming unclean by it. Nor will a woman present herself before an animal to mate with it; it is a perversion.

dag: N ni tooi chɛ ka sagbana sabigi libilibi kaman di kumdila so kuli la.
en: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o ni nimmoo, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: But Peter was so sure of himself that he said, Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you! All the others said the same thing.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yibu asibaasi n-liri ba n-tuhi ba hal ni zaawuni, ka do so daa bi zo n-tiligi naɣila nachimba kɔbisinahi n-daa ba laakumnim zo n-tiligi.
en: At dawn the next day David attacked them and fought until evening. Except for four hundred young men who mounted camels and got away, none of them escaped.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga yin doliya zaligu ŋɔ.
en: This same law must be followed if the bull kills someones son or daughter.

dag: dama o daa wuhirila o nyaandoliba yɛri ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni ka bɛ ti ku o; amaa bɛ yi ti ku o, o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: because he was teaching his disciples: The Son of Man will be handed over to those who will kill him. Three days later, however, he will rise to life.

dag: Ka gbaŋŋmara maa daa yɛl lala n-naai ka yɛli salo maa ni bɛ wurimma.
en: After saying this, he told the people to leave.

dag: Neesim neeri zibisim ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi mini bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ni nambɔzɔriba ni wuntizɔriba.
en: A light shines in the dark for those who are good, for those who are merciful, kind, and fair.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la daa bi sabi zalila ti yab Ibrahimma kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: The words he was accepted as righteous were not written for him alone.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli ka duh a. Zallakudura Naa, n ni yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: I will celebrate and rejoice in you; I will sing praises to your name, Most High.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni nini daa tiɣi kurimbuni ha niriba.
en: It was by their faith that people of ancient times won God's approval.

dag: ka o daa niŋ omaŋmaŋ ni pun lo shɛm, ka kahigi ashili nia shɛli o ni pun lo ni o pal li Masia zuɣu la wuhi ti.
en: God revealed his hidden design to us, which is according to his goodwill and the plan that he intended to accomplish through his Son.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi ninvuɣ bɔbigu zuɣu tum tuumbiɛɣu bee m-pahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ʒiri shɛhira dibu ni.
en: Dont do something just because everyone else is doing it. If you see a group of people doing wrong, dont join them. You must not let them persuade you to do wrong things—you must do what is right and fair.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi baŋ n ni niŋdi ya shɛli ŋɔ gbinni pumpɔŋɔ, amaa saha shɛli ka a ni ti baŋ di gbinni.
en: Jesus replied, You dont understand what Im doing now, but you will understand later.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb me bɛ tiŋ ʒini nimaani.
en: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o wain booriba kpɛm la labis o tuma ni, ka o lan zaŋdi ŋun Firawuna binnyura pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o.
en: He freed the wine server and gave him his job back, and once again the wine server put a cup of wine in Pharaohs hand.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: Because of me, you will be hated by everyone.

dag: Ti tum a taali pam, ka bi dol a ni zali ti zaligu shɛl la zaŋ tabili zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ a ni daa zaŋ shɛŋa ti a dabili Musa la.
en: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa va nti bɔb gbaag o ba n-kumdi ka mɔɣisir o kpariŋ.
en: When Israel died, Joseph was very sad. He hugged his father and cried over him and kissed him.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ lee niŋ ka yimaŋmaŋ bi baŋdi din tuhi?.
en: Why cant you decide for yourselves what is right?.

dag: Bɛ daa lan niŋ o yiko ni o lo tɔbu tuhi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nyaŋ ba. Ka lan niŋ o yiko ni o su dɔɣim kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima.
en: It was given power to make war against Gods holy people and to defeat them. It was given power over every tribe, race of people, language, and nation.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ti naba bari zaana, o nini yi tiɣi ti soli;.
en: A persons steps are made secure by the LORD when they delight in his way.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be tiŋgbani maa ni ni alaafee, ka so lan kani ŋun ni kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, bɛ ni tam bɛ vi mini bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la yɛla.
en: They will forget their humiliation and all their rebellions against me when they live securely on their fertile land with no one to frighten them.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kari doli ma kaman yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni maa? N niŋgbuŋ ni be shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko bi saɣi lala yi sani?.
en: Why do you persecute me as God does? Dont you get tired of hurting me?.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ka n naɣ zaŋ niŋ n suhu ni, dinzuɣu ka m mali tahima:.
en: Yet hope returns when I remember this one thing:.

dag: Niŋm bɛ zuɣulaannim kaman a ni daa niŋ Orɛb mini Ziib shɛm la; ka niŋ bɛ nanim kaman a ni daa niŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna shɛm la.
en: Do to their leaders what you did to Oreb and Zeeb; defeat all their rulers as you did Zebah and Zalmunna.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti sahi o takɔbi maa naai alizanda ni, o ni zaŋ li lu Ɛdomnim bɛn nyɛ o ni zali ni o ku shɛb la zuɣu.
en: When my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, it will descend upon Edom for judgment, upon a people I have doomed for destruction.

dag: Ka Keen min o paɣ daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Inok. Ka Keen daa me o tiŋa n-zaŋ o bia Inok maa yuli m-bol li Inok.
en: Cain knew his wife intimately. She became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain built a city and named the city after his son Enoch.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suhi Naawuni maa nti fo ka bɛ laɣiŋgu maa shee ti gbaai dambu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kpe m-pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: After they prayed, the place where they were gathered was shaken. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking Gods word with confidence.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yiri tiŋ maa tariga, ka Samuɛl yɛli Sool, Yɛlim a tumtumda maa ni o cham ti tooni, o yi chaŋ naai nyin zanim kpe biɛla, ka n yɛl a Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm.
en: As they were nearing the edge of town Samuel said, Tell the boy to go on ahead of us but you stop for a bit so I can tell you Gods word.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa tim ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ba Yaakubu min o daŋ zaa na; bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Then Joseph sent some men to tell Jacob, his father, to come to Egypt. He also invited all his relatives, a total of people.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni di nyɛla yi fa m-bahi zuɣu ka n daa chɛ Kɔrinti kandina.
en: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.

dag: Ka wula ka ninsal lee ni tooi be kasi Naawuni tooni? Wula ka paɣ ni dɔɣi so lee ni tooi be ka ka daɣiri?.
en: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni m biɛhigu nyaɣisim saha maa, n yɛn yila dunia yili chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka ku paai n saha.
en: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni ka tur o zuɣu chɛ ka o daa pihipihi o binyɛrigu taŋkpaɣu bahi ka yɛli ba, Yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya bahi yoli taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu! Man nuu yiya. Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni chaŋla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: When they opposed him and said evil things about him, he protested by shaking the dust from his clothes and saying to them, If you are lost, you yourselves must take the blame for it! I am not responsible. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.

dag: M mi ni a ni tooi niŋ binshɛɣukam, ka so ku tooi yiɣisi a ni lo ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa yi kul chanimi nti be luɣ shɛli din miri napaɣiba yili maa dundɔŋ dabisili kam. O daa chanimi gindi ni o baŋ Ɛsta nimaani benibu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm ni din yɛn niŋ o.
en: Each day found Mordecai pacing back and forth along the wall in front of the womens house to learn how Esther was doing and what they were doing with her.

dag: Gadamanim yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba n-zaŋdi ba doli so shɛli din bi viɛla.
en: Cruel people trick their neighbors and make them do wrong.

dag: A daanzinfa saɣimya, ka kom gari a wain ni.
en: Your silver has become impure; your beer is diluted with water.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi shihi yaɣiri laa kam, bɛn ŋmam li, ka di yi nyɛ dari bini, bɛn paɣimi li kom.
en: Any clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini.
en: Who among you by worrying can add a single moment to your life?.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛhudia nira n-nyɛ ma? Amaŋmaŋ niriba mini maligumaaniba kpamba n-zaŋ a tahi n sanna! Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka a lee tum.
en: Pilate responded, Im not a Jew, am I? Your nation and its chief priests handed you over to me. What have you done.

dag: Ti chandi maa daa muɣisi ti, amaa ka ti kul mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Fɛɛhavɛns, ka di miri Lasia la.
en: We kept close to the coast and with great difficulty came to a place called Safe Harbors, not far from the town of Lasea.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali n-yɛli ba, Ti chaŋla Sirianim sansan la ni nti bi nya so bee n-wum so damli, amaa ka bɛ tanti suɣa la beni; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ bunsi gba loya pahi.
en: So they left the Syrian camp, went back to Samaria, and called out to the guards at the gates: We went to the Syrian camp and didn't see or hear anybody; the horses and donkeys have not been untied, and the tents are just as the Syrians left them.

dag: Amaa ka Sukɔt kpamba daa bɔh o, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu.
en: The town leaders of Succoth answered, Why should we feed your army? We don't know if you really will defeat Zebah and Zalmunna.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, M Ba kul tumdimi, ka n gba tumda.
en: But Jesus said, My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi bia maa ba, Bɔ saha ka di piligi niŋd o lala? Ka o yɛl o, O bilim ni.
en: Jesus asked the boy's father, How long has he been like this? The man answered, Ever since he was a child.

dag: Ka yi yaannim maa be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka anabinim maa mi, bɛ gba na kul beni?.
en: Your ancestors and those prophets are no longer alive.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa gbaai Yisifu binyɛrigu gbib ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Amaa ka Yisifu daa fuɣ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ paɣ maa nuu ni, ka guui yi yili maa ni.
en: She caught him by his robe and said, Come to bed with me. But he escaped and ran outside, leaving his robe in her hand.

dag: N ni yiini yila paɣiri Yawɛ hal ni n nyɛvili tariga; n ni kul be ŋɔ, n ni yiini yila paɣiri n Naawuni.
en: I will sing to the Lord for the rest of my life. I will sing praises to my God as long as I live.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ daa bi deei Yawɛ noli. Ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Tapanhɛs.
en: These people didnt listen to the Lord . So they all went to Egypt to the town of Tahpanhes.

dag: Ka di simdi ni yi yipa ŋmaligi chɛ m-paŋ o ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama di yi pa lala suhugarigu pam zuɣu ni chɛ ka o lu.
en: But now you should forgive him and encourage him. This will keep him from having too much sadness and giving up completely.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa gariti ŋɔ, yi baɣa kani? Lihimiya nya, so suhugarigu na mi m-paai n suhugarigu ŋɔ? Suhugarigu shɛli din paai ma, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛli ti ma o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam dahin shɛl la.
en: Is this nothing to all you who pass by? Look around: Is there any suffering like the suffering inflicted on me, the grief that the LORD caused on the day of his fierce anger?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Dinzuɣu tihi puu maa lana yi ti kana, wula ka o lee yɛn niŋ padiriba maa.
en: So what will the owner of the vineyard do to these farmers when he comes.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o zo n-chaŋ tampima zo shɛli din daa be Maɔn yɔɣu ni la zuɣu. Ka Sool daa wum lala ka kari Dauda naba Maɔn yɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul and his men set out to look for David, but he heard about it and went to a rocky hill in the wilderness of Maon and stayed there. When Saul heard about this, he went after David.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani baabiɛla gba.
en: When they called Peter and John back, they demanded that they stop all speaking and teaching in the name of Jesus.

dag: Amaa zoli nyɛla din luri wurinda, ka tampiŋ vuɣiri di dooshee.
en: There comes a time when mountains fall and solid cliffs are moved away.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Ishimail ŋun nyɛ Haga, Zara dab paɣa ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ ni daa dɔɣ so la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the descendants of Ishmael, Abrahams son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarahs servant, bore for Abraham.

dag: Yawɛ yuri Jɛrusalɛm gari tin shɛŋa din zaa be Izraɛl.
en: He loves the gates of Zion more than any other place in Israel.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, so kanna m-be kaman Tabo zoli ni be shɛm zoya ni la, ka be kaman Kamɛl zoli ni ʒe m-baɣi teeku shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord Almighty, am king. I am the living God. As Mount Tabor towers above the mountains and Mount Carmel stands high above the sea, so will be the strength of the one who attacks you.

dag: Yawɛ zal o nam ʒiishee la alizanda ni. O nyɛla naa ŋun su sokam zaa.
en: The LORD has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be! M paɣiri ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ maa! N kul ni tibigiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim maa.
en: The Lord lives! I praise my Rock, the God who saves me. How great he is!.

dag: Di saha ka o naanyi kahigi yɛli ba, Lazarɔs kpimi;.
en: So then Jesus said plainly, Lazarus is dead.

dag: gol so ŋun daa pahir ayɔbu biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali, Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi la saha.
en: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius the king.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa kaman Naa Ahaz ni daa be Damaskus ka tim ti wuh o shɛm zaa la. Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa naai pɔi ka Naa Ahaz naanyi yi Damaskus kuna.
en: So Uriah built an altar just like it and finished it before Ahaz returned.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana.
en: These are the names of Davids children born in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni yi Shɛfam maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ribila din be Ain wulimpuhili polo la, ka tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku din be wulimpuhili polo la naɣiliŋga ni.
en: It will then go south to Harbel, east of Ain, and on to the hills on the eastern shore of Lake Galilee.

dag: Hal Naa Hɛrɔd gba bi nya o taali, dama o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o lab ti sanna. Nyamiya, o bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum.
en: Neither did Herod, because Herod returned him to us. Hes done nothing that deserves death.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim be bɛ sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ wum di yɛligu ka saɣisi bɛmaŋa.
en: But Abraham said, They have the Law of Moses and the writings of the prophets to read; let them learn from that.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni saɣim yɛnnim yɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali fahim fahim ŋari.
en: As the Scriptures say, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will confuse the understanding of the intelligent. Isaiah :.

dag: Buɣim ni ti di n-kabi zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni nyɔri kɔba ka di leeri tampiligim shɛm la, ka lan be kaman bɛ ni ŋma go shɛŋa sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.

dag: Ka Yaakubu mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani la daa ka Luz din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: Finally, they reached Bethel, also known as Luz.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa bɔh o Hanna, bɔ n-niŋ ka a mali suhugarigu, ka kumdi hal ti zaɣisi bindirigu? M bi gari bihi pia a sani.
en: Her husband Elkanah would ask her, Hannah, why are you crying? Why won't you eat? Why are you always so sad? Don't I mean more to you than ten sons.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima, dama ninsal sɔŋsim nyɛla yoli.
en: Help us against the enemy; human help is worthless.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ninsalitab naani, ka zaŋ bɛ ninsalitab maa leei bɛ kpiɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri ka chɛ man Yawɛ la.
en: I, the Lord , have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, pumpɔŋɔ ŋmaligim a nina kpa ti polo na ka gbilisi tibili wum ti suhigu kpe ŋɔ.
en: Now, my God, I ask you, open your eyes and your ears. Listen and pay attention to the prayers we are praying in this place.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa lan yɛli paɣ maa, Cham ni suhudoo; a yɛda niŋbu n-tilig a.
en: But Jesus said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaŋ a na ti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bɔɣ zilinli ni.
en: But instead, you have been brought down to the deepest part of the world of the dead.

dag: N kpamdi Yuɔdia mini Sintike jaande ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ noya naai taba ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to come to an agreement in the Lord.

dag: Amaa n daa ŋmanila piɛ tarim so bɛ ni zaŋ chaŋ ni bɛ ti kɔrigi. N daa bi baŋ ni mani ka bɛ lɔri nia biɛɣu maa yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ŋmaai tia maa mini di wala luhi. Chɛliya ka ti yih o dunia ni, ka so ku lan teeg o yuli yɛla.
en: I was like a young lamb led to the slaughter; I didnt realize that they were planning their schemes against me: Lets destroy the tree with its fruit; lets cut him off from the land of the living so that even any knowledge of him will be wiped out.

dag: O wurindi wɔɣira ka bi vihiri ba, ka zaŋdi shɛb zaani bɛ zaani.
en: He does not need an investigation to remove leaders and replace them with others.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu. Dama alizin biɛ bɔbigu n-daa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: Jesus asked him, What is your name? My name is Mob, he answered—because many demons had gone into him.

dag: Alɔbo maa lubu nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza.
en: After the plaguethe LORD said to Moses and Eleazar, Aaron the priests son.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ: Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni tintani din zaa daa baɣi Mɛdɛba la.
en: Their territory extended to Aroer and the city in the middle of that valley and included all the plateau around Medeba.

dag: Dama biɛri bɔhibu saha mini binshɛɣukam zaa din daa sab zalila palibu saha nti yɛn bala.
en: These are the days of punishment, when everything written will find its fulfillment.

dag: Fitiina pam maa zuɣu, niriba kul kuhirimi, wɔɣira ni muɣisiri ba shɛm zuɣu, bɛ bɔrila sɔŋsim.
en: People cry out because of heavy oppression; shout under the power of the mighty.

dag: O daa buɣisi li la di luɣa anahi zuɣu. Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gil li, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di woligi din be kasi ka chɛ din bi be kasi.
