en: He measured the four walls that went all the way around the Temple. The wall was cubits long and cubits wide. It separated the holy area from the area that is not holy.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi daa nyɛla bɛba ata, Shɛlomɔt mini Haziɛl ni Haran. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Leedan daŋ niriba kpamba.
en: Shimeis sons were Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran. These three sons were leaders in Ladans families.

dag: Daadam Bia dabisili ti yɛn ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi di pilibu shee m-mali ti ba di naabu shee shɛm la.
en: When the Son of Man comes again, you will know it. On that day he will shine like lightning flashes across the sky.

dag: ka kula ŋun tiri nyɛvili; amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni. Tinima n-nyɛ di shɛhiranima.
en: You killed the one who leads to life, but God raised him from death—and we are witnesses to this.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi ka kuui kaman mɔri la, ka n kɔre ka bindirigu ni gba.
en: My strength is gone— I am like dry, dying grass. I even forget to eat.

dag: O daa lan ti o niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni bihim ni waagasi ni piɛri mini piɛlahi kpam ni Bashan naɣilahi mini buhi ni alikama viɛlli. Yi daa nyu wain tiwala wain viɛlli.
en: curds from the herd, milk from the flock, along with the best of lambs, rams from Bashan, he-goats too, along with the finest wheat— and for drink, wine from the juiciest grapes!.

dag: N lan ka suhupiɛlli, suhusaɣiŋgu m-mali ma. Biɛrim be n suhu ni.
en: God, I am very sad and afraid.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi mali yurilim yi bebu ni kaman Masia ni daa yu ti ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti zuɣu, ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl ŋun Naawuni san la.
en: Your life must be controlled by love, just as Christ loved us and gave his life for us as a sweet-smelling offering and sacrifice that pleases God.

dag: Mbusim be yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi wuhiri ni nir yi po Naawuni jɛmbu duu di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po salima din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: How terrible for you, blind guides! You teach, If someone swears by the Temple, he isn't bound by his vow; but if he swears by the gold in the Temple, he is bound.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri pini nyarimi pahira, ka ŋun tiri kom gba nyari kom.
en: Generous persons will prosper; those who refresh others will themselves be refreshed.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: Then he told them, Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa maa daa gbaai ma dabiɛm, ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: The visions I saw alarmed me, and I was deeply disturbed.

dag: ka di nyɛla ŋun Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli din so n-ti ti la zuɣu. Di daliri nyɛla, bɛ ku tooi mali be dɛde, ka pa ni Naawuni zaŋ ti mi pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: God provided something better for us so they wouldnt be made perfect without us.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiri ni ti yɛda niŋbu ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri: Yi yɛda ni kpaŋsi n suhu, ka n gba yɛda kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri.
en: What I mean is that both you and I will be helped at the same time, you by my faith and I by yours.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima nanima, niŋmiya yɛm, yinim dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannima, deemiya saɣisigu ŋɔ.
en: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, so baɣa kani bee m-baŋdi din tahi lala na. Amaa bɛ yi kpi, bɛ yila zaɣ biɛɣu ni kpe suhudoo ni.
en: Good people die, and no one understands or even cares. But when they die, no calamity can hurt them.

dag: Dama n yi kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n ti kuhirimi ka tahi yɛli, Duŋtaabo mini saɣiŋgu! Dama nyin Yawɛ yɛligu maa leela turi mini ansarisi bini n sani asiba hal ni yuŋ.
en: Every time I speak, I shout. I am always shouting about violence and destruction. I tell the people about the message that I received from the Lord . But they only insult me and make fun of me.

dag: ka yɛli, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan naa ti kani man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ sanna? Ka Dauda yɛl o, N yɛn dala a kabɔɣili ŋɔ m-me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, ka di chɛ ka o vuug alɔbo ŋɔ ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: and said, Your Majesty! Why have you come to see me? David answered, I've come to buy your threshing place. I have to build the Lord an altar here, so this disease will stop killing the people.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam doli nam fukumsinim yɛligu; dama nam fukumsi nir kani ka pa ni Naawuni n-zal o, ka nam fukumsi din beni nyɛla Naawuni ni zali shɛli.
en: Everyone must obey state authorities, because no authority exists without God's permission, and the existing authorities have been put there by God.

dag: Lɔd mini Hadid ni Ono — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisinaanu.
en: from the towns of Lod, Hadid, and Ono:.

dag: Dindali maa, di simdi ka naa ti bo naɣila polli m-mali sara o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: At that time the ruler will offer a bull for himself and for all the people of Israel. The bull will be for a sin offering.

dag: Dama mani m-piig o ni o wuh o bihi min o yiŋnim zaa ka bɛ doli man Yawɛ soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma ni din tuhi; ka di zuɣu chɛ ka man Yawɛ zaŋ n ni lo Ibrahimma binshɛli alikauli la ti o.
en: I have chosen him in order that he may command his sons and his descendants to obey me and to do what is right and just. If they do, I will do everything for him that I have promised.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu Ijiptinim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ku niriba Ijipti ka va bɛ daazichi chaŋ, ka daai di tanzahi luhi. Biɛrim pam ni ti be Itiɔpia.
en: Your own nation of Egypt will be attacked, and Ethiopia will suffer. You will be killed in battle, and your land will be robbed and left in ruins.

dag: Ti ni yɛri shɛli maa yɛlikpani m-bɔŋɔ: Ti mali maligumaani titali ŋɔ tatabo ka o ʒi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa nam ʒiishee nudirigu polo alizanda ni.
en: Here is the point of what we are saying: We have a high priest like that, who sits on the right side of Gods throne in heaven.

dag: Ka o daa mali Ɛlat me n-ti Judanima, Naa Amazia kalinsi maa nyaaŋa.
en: It was after the death of Amaziah that Uzziah recaptured Elath and rebuilt the city.

dag: Di saha Jɛrimia daa kul gɔrila o yubu niriba maa sani, dama bɛ daa na bi kpɛh o duu.
en: Now Jeremiah hadnt been imprisoned yet, so he was free to come and go among the people.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim a suhuyiɣisili puuni, lum n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu la zuɣu; n Naawuni, malimi shili, a zali saria karibu saha.
en: Rise in your anger, O Lord ! Stand up against the fury of my enemies; rouse yourself and help me! Justice is what you demand.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl kalinsi nyaaŋa Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia la mini Abiata n-daa zan o zaani. Ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ naa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma.
en: After Ahithophel came Benaiahs son Jehoiada, and Abiathar. Joab was commander of the kings army.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim shɛb bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: Some Sadducees, who deny that theres a resurrection, came to Jesus and asked.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n-dol a ni doli so shɛli kana. .
en: because the Lord has commanded me not to eat or drink a thing, and not to return home the same way I came.

dag: ka zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛl la ni be adaka shɛl ni la niŋ di puuni.
en: I have placed in the Temple the Covenant Box, which contains the stone tablets of the covenant which the Lord made with the people of Israel.

dag: N nyɛla a ni su so. Tiligim ma, dama n loya ni n dol a zaligunim maa.
en: Im yours—save me because Ive pursued your precepts!.

dag: Di saha ka tihi maa zaa daa chaŋ ti yɛli tanyibiga, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: So then all the trees said to the thorn bush, You come and be our king.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-chaŋ Jɛziriil, dama nimaani ka Jɔram daa biɛri be. Ka Juda Naa Ahazia daa kana ni o ti kaag o.
en: Then he got into his chariot and set off for Jezreel. Joram had still not recovered, and King Ahaziah of Judah was there, visiting him.

dag: ka Ibram daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Shɛkɛm ti ʒini Mɔre oki tia gbini. Keenannima n-daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni di saha maa.
en: Abram traveled through the land as far as the town of Shechem and then to the big tree at Moreh. The Canaanites were living in the land at that time.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam mini Balak daa doli chaŋ ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Huzɔt la.
en: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.

dag: Ka o yɛli, O tɔhira. O ni daa paai yiŋ na ka Yisa daŋ o di yɛla tɔɣisibu ka bɔh o, Saimɔn, wula ka a lee tɛhiri di yɛla? Ka lan bɔh o pahi, Banim sani ka dunia ŋɔ nanim lee deeri farigu: Bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋbihi sani bee saamba sani.
en: Yes, he does, Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners.

dag: Yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi nyaŋ Sintani yɛŋkiŋkabina soya zaa.
en: Put on Gods armor so that you can make a stand against the tricks of the devil.

dag: Ka o ti ŋmahiŋmahi biŋkɔbigu maa n-tabil o zuɣu min o biŋkpam, ka maligumaana zaŋ li pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Once it has been cut into pieces, including the head and the fat, the priest will arrange these out on the wood that is on the altar fire.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ bi simdi ni di gari ti, dama Sintani gba lɛbigir omaŋa m-be kaman neesim malaika n-nyɛ o la.
en: And no wonder! Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi m-bɔhira, Bɔ ka ti yɛn di bee n-nyu bee bɔ ka ti yɛn ye.
en: So do not start worrying: Where will my food come from? or my drink? or my clothes.

dag: Amaa daadamnim bɛn yi kpi, bɛ lan ka yaa. Daadamnim yi bahi, ya ka bɛ lee lan be?.
en: But we die, and that is the end of us; we die, and where are we then?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tum tuma yuma ayopɔin Reechɛl zuɣu, amaa ka di daa ŋmanila dabisa biɛla o sani, o ni daa yuri Reechɛl maa zuɣu.
en: So Jacob stayed and worked for Laban for seven years. But it seemed like a very short time because he loved Rachel very much.

dag: yin miriya ka yi tam Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: But be careful! Dont forget the Lord . You were slaves in Egypt, but he brought you out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba, ka kum mini tiŋgbani dambu ti be bɔb shɛŋa polo.
en: Nations will fight against other nations. Kingdoms will fight against other kingdoms. There will be times when there is no food for people to eat. And there will be earthquakes in different places.

dag: Gibiɔn ba Jɛiɛl daa bela Gibiɔn. O paɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel founded the city of Gibeon and settled there. His wife was named Maacah.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ karimbaani, ka bi wuh o wumpaɣibo ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni daa niŋ shɛm ti o maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o mini Judanim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu.
en: But Hezekiah was too proud to show gratitude for what the Lord had done for him, and Judah and Jerusalem suffered for it.

dag: Piɛm ku tooi kar o ka o guui, ka kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa ŋmani wurigu o sani.
en: Arrows dont make him run away. Rocks thrown at him seem as light as chaff.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi kana ti lihi yili maa, ka dɔro maa bi lan yɛligi pahi yili maa ni bɛ ni lab ta li maa nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun wuhimi ni yili maa nyɛla din ka daɣiri ni, dama dɔro maa naaya.
en: But if the priest arrives and finds that the infection has not spread after the house was replastered, the priest will declare the house clean because the infection has been healed.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n saɣ a ni bɔri shɛm maa, cham ti zaŋ Absalom na.
en: David turned to Joab and said, It seems that I have already given my decision. Go and bring Absalom back.

dag: So ku tooi baŋ yɛl biɛɣu ni yɛn paag o saha shɛli. Ziŋgbahiri laŋ din mali putɔɣu ni gbahiri zahim shɛm ni zana ni gbahiri noombihi shɛm la, lala ka yɛl biɛɣu gba libigiri daadamnim gbahiri ba.
en: You never know when hard times will come. Like fish in a net or birds in a snare, people are often trapped by some disaster that suddenly falls on them.

dag: Naawuni daa bi ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri maa, ka bɛ daa nya o, ka di ka nyu.
en: All the leaders of Israel saw God, but God did not destroy them. They all ate and drank together.

dag: ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa ti Bia maa jilima kaman bɛ ni tir o Ba maa jilima shɛm. Ŋunkam bi tiri Bia maa jilima bi tirila o Ba ŋun tim o maa na jilima.
en: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.

dag: Bɛ teei gili ba kaman puguliba ni niŋdi shɛm la, bɛ ni taai duŋ zaɣisi ma la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The enemy has surrounded Jerusalem like men guarding a field. Judah, you turned against me, so the enemy is coming against you. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Tiwula ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph said, This is what it means: the three branches are three days.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka kayeeniba kpe Babilɔn nti yɛl li. Bɛ ni ti yi luɣilikam na nti naai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali.
en: Foreign soldiers will come from every direction, and when the disaster is over, Babylonia will be empty and worthless.

dag: N di yuya ni n niriba maa wum n yɛligu; n di yuya ni Izraɛlnim doli n soya!.
en: My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba maa sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: And they stayed a long time there with the believers.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣisaribila n-zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa, di nyaaŋa ka o lan je o.
en: Suppose a man marries a young woman and later he decides he doesn't want her.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bia paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o bia paɣa, di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam tiŋgbani pa kom zuɣu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He spread the land over the sea. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa yiɣisi bo tɔbutuhiri biinsi niriba tusaata Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Zif mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee Zif mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul went at once with three thousand of the best soldiers in Israel to the wilderness of Ziph to look for David.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa be yili maa ni kuhiri ka fabindi kpim maa zuɣu yɔri vuri. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di kuhiriya, dama bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: They were all crying and mourning for her, but Jesus said, Dont cry. She isnt dead. Shes only sleeping.

dag: A shihira chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni katinsi lur a la sizuura, a ni wuhiri shihira shɛŋa zuɣu. A chɛ ka biɛɣ neebu mini yuŋ zibbu yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, dama n ni niŋ a nirilim a ba Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yab Sool ni daa su tiŋgban shɛli zaa ti a, ka lan chɛ ka m min a laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam.
en: Dont be afraid, David told him, because I will certainly show you faithful love for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the fields of your grandfather Saul, and you will eat at my table always.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛ nuhi gbaag a, a bɔɣirimi ŋ-ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣusapima. Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛmaŋ jɛm a, a kabigirimi ka chɛ ka bɛ naba kɔŋ zanibu.
en: when they took you in hand, you would splinter and make their shoulders sore; when they leaned on you, you would break, bringing them to their knees.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi ka po pɔri yɛli, Man ʒi doo maa.
en: With a solemn pledge, he denied it again, saying, I dont know the man.

dag: Ka Absalom min o niriba zaa ni Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm, ka Ahitɔfɛl gba daa be o sani.
en: Meanwhile, Absalom, Ahithophel, and all the Israelites came to Jerusalem.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna Pailɛt yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: During Passover, Pilate always freed one prisoner chosen by the people.

dag: Yawɛ yiko puuni, o daa kpahi n zuɣu ni ni n di doli niriba maa naba. O daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.

dag: N sɔŋsim yirila Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ sanna.
en: It will come from the Lord , who created heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi. Yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , dama o saha ka tiŋgbani daa pirigi la; ka o tizo mi yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: To Eber were born two sons: The first was named Peleg, because during his lifetime the earth was divided. His brothers name was Joktan.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya dawule paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya dawule pampam paɣ o.
en: Praise God with loud cymbals! Praise God with clashing cymbals!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n yur a zaligunim maa gari salima din viɛlli pam.
en: But I love your commandments more than gold, even more than pure gold.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya kul diri nam sahakam, ka chɛ ka a nam kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni. .
en: A descendant of yours will always be king; I will preserve your dynasty forever.

dag: A yi mali Lɛvinim maa kasi, ka zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni tooi kpe laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni ti tum tuma.
en: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.

dag: Kunduna ni ti tam bɛ pihi zuɣu kumda, ka yɔbahi be bɛ nayili viɛla puuni kumda. Babilɔn saha miriya, ka di dabisili ku lan tirisi tooni.
en: Hyenas will howl in its strongholds, and jackals in its luxurious palaces. Babylons time is coming soon; its days wont drag on.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ leei binshɛli din bie, ka mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa sani, ka nya filiŋ mini ansarisi malibo ni turi, ka noli ni di ba n ni kari ba tahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: I will punish them. Their punishment will shock all the people on earth. People will make fun of those people from Judah. People will tell jokes about them and curse them in all the places where I scatter them.

dag: Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa do Giligal bɔpiɛligu ni Jɛriko maa, ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni.
en: While the Israelites were camping at Gilgal on the plain near Jericho, they observed Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month.

dag: Amaa Jɔab daa bi kali Lɛvi zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya bɛna, dama naa zaligu maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: Joab did not count the tribes of Levi and Benjamin because he did not like King Davids order.

dag: Kpalimmiya be ti sani. Yi ni tooi be yi suhuri ni bɔri ni yi be luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka gɔri kɔhigu yi yubu, ka su tiŋgbani maa luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: Live with us. The land is available to you: settle down, travel through it, and buy property in it.

dag: A yi chana, di ni wuh a soli, a yi gbihira, di ni gul a, a yi ti neei, di ni dir a alizama.
en: When you walk around, they will lead you; when you lie down, they will protect you; when you awake, they will occupy your attention.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛl o niriba maa, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Sool. Ka Sool daa ti yiɣisi voli maa ni yina chaŋ o chandi.
en: So David convinced his men that they should not attack Saul. Saul got up, left the cave, and started away.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Ɛbɛl kubu zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria kubu saha, bɛ ni daa ku so Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la, Naawuni shiri ni ti zaŋ di taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba!.
en: You will be punished for the killing of Abel. And you will be punished for the killing of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the Temple. Yes, I tell you that you people will be punished for them all.

dag: Buɣim be bɛ tooni dira ka buɣim zilima be bɛ nyaaŋa polo dira, ka tiŋgbani din be bɛ tooni be kaman Idɛn puu la, amaa ka bɛ nyaaŋa polo ŋmani tiŋgban nɛli, ka binshɛli kani n-ni tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: Like fire they eat up the plants. In front of them the land is like the Garden of Eden, but behind them it is a barren desert. Nothing escapes them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Ka Pita daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la doli ba. Nyaandol maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒi n-tab Yisa bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu ka bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi a nyaaŋ la.
en: Peter turned around and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. This was the one who had leaned against Jesus at the meal and asked him, Lord, who is going to betray you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tahima na be a biɛhigu ni. A bihi maa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: So don't lose hope. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ti ni zaŋ alikama din bi viɛli kɔhi shaara, ka zaŋ liɣiri da tarimba, ka zaŋ namda diba ayiyi n-taɣi nandaamba.
en: in order to buy the needy for silver and the helpless for sandals, and sell garbage as grain.

dag: N daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, so ku lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di nyaaŋa, dama n yɛtɔɣa daa yi kpɛri ba pam.
en: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa kpi dindali maa kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaanu. Ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: On that day , men of the army of Benjamin were killed. All of them fought bravely with their swords.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ti yaag o noli yɛli ni Yisa Masia nyɛla Duuma, ka di chɛ ka o Ba Naawuni nya jilima.
en: They will all confess, Jesus Christ is Lord, and this will bring glory to God the Father.

dag: Zuliya shɛb Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ni o zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn zaa nini daa bi nya tɔb shɛŋa din tuhi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the nations that the LORD left to test all those Israelites who had no firsthand knowledge of the wars of Canaan.

dag: Dɛbɔra, yiɣisima, yiɣisima. Yiɣisima, yiɣisima, Yilimi yilli! Barak Abinɔam bia, yiɣisim zaŋ a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba la kuli!.
en: Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, sing a song! Arise, Barak! Capture your prisoners, Abinoams son.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa.
en: He replied, You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your being, and with all your mind.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa su nanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti sunsuuni nanim zaa zaŋ tabili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: He was supreme ruler of all the kings in the territory from the Euphrates River to Philistia and the Egyptian border.

dag: N yi baŋ a wuntia zaligunim maa, n ni paɣ a ni suhu yini.
en: The more I understand how fair your laws are, the more sincerely I will praise you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul yɛr o lala saha shɛli maa, ka nayili namɔɣilisi paana nti zaŋ Haman yomyom chaŋ Ɛsta ni daa pun duɣi bindir shɛŋa la dibu.
en: While they were still talking, the palace eunuchs arrived in a hurry to take Haman to Esther's banquet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ koli binshɛɣukam gari kaman pɔhim la. Bɛ birigiya ka leei bɛn mali taali, bɛmaŋmaŋ yaa n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then they will leave like the wind and go on to fight against other places. The only thing the Babylonians worship is their own strength.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɛli ya, Biɛhiŋ kani Yawɛ ni fa ti bahi, ka ku zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni, ka yi shiri niŋ Yawɛ naani di zuɣu.
en: And don't let him persuade you to rely on the Lord . Don't think that the Lord will save you and that he will stop our Assyrian army from capturing your city.

dag: Ʒiɛyimtali ni tɔhi yi tiŋgban ni na, ka wuntitali mi be sagbana ni ka lihirina.
en: Human loyalty will reach up from the earth, and God's righteousness will look down from heaven.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti sɔɣi ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni o zuɣu salo maa ni: Shɛb daa yɛrimi, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ. Ka shɛb mi yɛra, Aai! O nyɛla ŋun birigiri niriba.
en: There was much whispering about him in the crowd. He is a good man, some people said. No, others said, he fools the people.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna, di saha ti ni du n-chaŋ, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ ti nuu ni. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ shihirili ti sani.
en: But if they say, Come on up, then well go up because that will be the sign that the LORD has handed them over to us.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaligu maa lan ka yaa, ka saria karibu gba bi lan tumdi tuma. Dama ninvuɣ biɛri gilila wuntizɔriba, dinzuɣu ka saria karibu bi lan tumdi tuma.
en: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi zaa n-yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ Zairi, ka o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim ti lu Ɛdomnim bɛn daa teei gil o zuɣu n-niŋ ba buɣim; amaa ka o tɔbbihi daa zo n-kuli.
en: So Jehoram set out with all his chariots to Zair, where the Edomite army surrounded them. During the night he and his chariot commanders managed to break out and escape, and his soldiers scattered to their homes.

dag: M mabihi, di maliya yɛtɔɣ bihibihi ni yi taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti kari ya saria. Nyamiya, sariakarita maa ʒiɛla dunoli ni.
en: Do not complain against one another, my friends, so that God will not judge you. The Judge is near, ready to appear.

dag: Kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, kpahimmi wuntizɔriba nya; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhudoo, bɛ ni mali zuliya bɛn dol bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Be pure and honest. Peace-loving people will have many descendants.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa lo ni o ni kun ya la, n daa teemi dɔni m puli zuɣu Yawɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: So I bowed down before the Lord days and nights, because the Lord said he would destroy you.

dag: Bɛtɛl mini Ai niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisinaata.
en: from the towns of Bethel and Ai:.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ daanya mali wahu maa n-zaŋ li tabili da wɔɣinli zuɣusaa; ka wahu daa yi dim so, ka o lihi li, o tiligirimi.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord . And all of those who looked at the bronze snake lived, even though they had been bitten by the poisonous snakes.

dag: Dinzuɣu n kumdila Sibima mini Jaza wain tihi zuɣu. N kumdila Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim zuɣu, dama bɛ bi kpuɣi puu atam din ni chɛ ka bɛ suhuri piɛla.
en: Therefore, I will weep with Jazers weeping for the vines of Sibmah. I will drench you with my tears, Heshbon and Elealeh. Cheers have fallen silent concerning your summer fruit and your grain harvest.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niŋ wain n-ti ti ba maa ka o nyu, ka ti chɛ ka o zaŋ ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: So lets get our father drunk with wine. Then we can have sex with him. That way we can use our father to keep our family alive.

dag: Yi ni ti mali alibarika gari zuliya kam. Ka dɔɣibu kalinsi ti ku be yi ni bee yi biŋkɔbiri ni.
en: You will be blessed more than all people. Every husband and wife will be able to have children. Your cows will be able to have calves.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni di leei yi fali shɛli yi ni yɛn su la ni, ka yi deei li su n-ʒini di ni.
en: Once you have entered the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and are settled there.

dag: Ninsal tɛha n-wuhir o soli, amaa Yawɛ n-wuhir o o ni yɛn chani shɛm.
en: You may make your plans, but God directs your actions.

dag: Ʒii shɛli gbinni bɛ ni daa kahigi wuh a zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni min asiba sara maligu shɛŋa yɛla polo la nyɛla din ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli. Amaa lee gbib li ashilɔni, dama di ni yɛn niŋ pali saha shɛli maa na wɔɣ pam.
en: Now this vision of evening and morning, which has been announced, is true. But you must seal it up, because it is for days far in the future.

dag: Ka nanim daa kana Taanak Mɛgido kulibɔŋ la ni ti tuhi tɔbu. Ka Keenan nanim daa tuhi, amaa ka bi di nɛma din nyɛ anzinfa.
en: The kings of Canaan came to fight, but they didnt carry any treasures home. They fought at the city of Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ku tooi zaŋ mmaŋ zali Naawuni zaani.
en: But Joseph said to them, Dont be afraid. Am I God?.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu ŋ-ŋman li mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: The second most important commandment is like it: Love your neighbor as you love yourself.

dag: Din beni nyɛla: Zaligu kurili la leela din daai baɣili kpaŋa di gbariginsim mini di ni ka buchi zuɣu.
en: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside.

dag: Goli palli dabisili dali, o ni ti bo naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa mini piɛbihi pola ayɔbu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi.
en: At the New Moon Festival he will offer a young bull, six lambs, and a ram, all without any defects.

dag: Ka a daazichi min a nɛma ni a daguya ni a kpatoonsi ni a ŋariŋduhiriba ni a ŋariŋmaaniba ni a dagudariba ni a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa be a ni ni a min a niriba zaa bɛn be a sani shim teeku bulli ni a wurimbu dali.
en: Your goods, your wares, your wealth, your sailors, your helmsmen, those patching your leaks, your merchants, all your warriors in you, and all the company that is with you— they also sank into the seas depth on the day of your demise.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ ka gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga ni nya alibarika. Ŋunkam gbibi Vuhim Dabisili viɛnyɛliŋga ka bi saɣim li, ka mi bi tumdi din bie ni nya alibarika.
en: Happy is the one who does this, the person who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath, not making it impure, and avoids doing any evil.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: Pilate asked him, Don't you hear what crimes they say you have done.

dag: Amaa Jɔnatan ŋun daa bi wum o ba ni po pɔri yɛli niriba maa shɛm maa, dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni tu shigbaŋ maa n-zaŋ o nuu nyɛhi li ti kpar o nol ni, ka o nini neei zaa.
en: But Jonathan had not heard his father threaten the people with a curse; so he reached out with the stick he was carrying, dipped it in a honeycomb, and ate some honey. At once he felt much better.

dag: Pa Dauda so yɛla bɛ ni wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku niriba tuhi piapia la m-bala? .
en: After all, this is the same David people sing about in their dances, Saul has killed his thousands, but David has killed his tens of thousands.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi bɛn Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim maa nɛma mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ.
en: Their enemies took everything of value from Sodom and Gomorrah, including their food supplies.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, yum maa yi paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, o shiri nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: who will examine you again. If the sore has turned white, you are ritually clean, and the priest shall pronounce you clean.

dag: Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan boli ya n daba, dama dabili bi mi o duuma daashili; amaa n ni boli ya la n zɔnima, dama n ni wum shɛlikam zaa m Ba sani, n zaŋ li wuhi ya.
en: I do not call you servants any longer, because servants do not know what their master is doing. Instead, I call you friends, because I have told you everything I heard from my Father.

dag: amaa ŋun doli dunoli kpɛra, ŋuna n-nyɛ piɛgula.
en: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.

dag: Absalom dii yɛrila dilana, Nyama, a yɛtɔɣa viɛla ka tuhi, amaa naa bi bo so zal o zaani ni o wum a ni mali shɛli.
en: Then Absalom would say, Look, you are right, but King David will not listen to you.

dag: M piila ʒiɛyimtali soli. N zaŋla a zaligunim zali n tooni.
en: I have chosen to be loyal to you. I respect your laws.

dag: Amaa hal Taitus ŋun daa be n san la ni daa kul nyɛ Giriiki maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi muɣis o ni o guni.
en: My companion Titus, even though he is Greek, was not forced to be circumcised.

dag: Amaa o daa jɛmdila o ba Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima, ka daa bi be kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa be shɛm la.
en: He looked for the God his ancestors followed. He followed Gods commands and did not live the same way the Israelites lived.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wumbu, m poya, yili ŋɔ ni leei dabɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: But if you ignore these words, I swear by myself, declares the LORD, that this palace will become a ruin.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim lan ka yɛm yɔɣo? Yɛnnim la bi lan tiri niriba yɛm saɣisigu? Bɛ yɛm maa naami?.
en: This is what the Lord Almighty said about Edom: Have the people of Edom lost their good judgment? Can their advisers no longer tell them what to do? Has all their wisdom disappeared?.

dag: N yi ti zaŋ bindiripooli din nyɛ m peenzala la to a, piɛma din kuri niriba ka n yɛn zaŋ to a ku a, ka chɛ ka bindiripooli kul luri a zuɣu mɔŋ a bindirigu.
en: When I launch my deadly arrows of famine against you, I have released them for your destruction! I will add to your famine and completely cut off your food supply.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Ti tɔŋya; ti nyɛla azichilaannima ka bi lan bɔri shɛli. Amaa ka bi mi ni yi nyɛla nandahimanim mini nambɔ niriba ni faranima ni zoomba ni bɛn chani bɛ zaɣim.
en: You say, I am rich and well off; I have all I need. But you do not know how miserable and pitiful you are! You are poor, naked, and blind.

dag: Du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: This building was feet long and feet wide.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa, dama ŋunkam be ya ŋɔ mi ni a nyɛla paɣ so ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ.
en: Now, young woman, dont be afraid. I will do what you ask. All the people in our town know that you are a very good woman.

dag: Ka Zɛdɛkia ŋun daa nyɛ Chɛnaana bia la daa zaŋ kuriti kuri binyila kɔtomsi ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Dimbɔŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe n-ku Sirianim maa zaa. .
en: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out.

dag: Amaa yinim ŋmaligimiya labi yi nyaaŋa kpe tiŋgban nɛl ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: But as for you people, turn around and go back into the desert on the road to the Gulf of Aqaba.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Abija daa di nam n-zan o zaani.
en: Rehoboam lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Davids City. His son Abijah succeeded him as king.

dag: Suhu ni nia lɔbu nyɛla daadamnim dini, amaa zilinli ni yɛn garigi shɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: To people belong the plans of the heart, but the answer of the tongue comes from the LORD.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m mi ni n ni gili yihi Naawuni nam waazu yi ninvuɣ shɛb sani zaa ŋɔ ku lan nya ma ni yi nini yaha.
en: I have gone from place to place, preaching to you about God's kingdom, but now I know that none of you will ever see me again.

dag: Ka Musa daa saɣi m-be bɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Zipɔra ti Musa.
en: Moses agreed to stay on with Jethro, who later let his daughter Zipporah marry Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti doli din ni chɛ ka naŋgban yini be ti sunsuuni mini din ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri.
en: So lets strive for the things that bring peace and the things that build each other up.

dag: Di daba anu nyaaŋa ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Ananias daa zaŋ kpeen shɛba mini bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira ŋun yuli daa booni Tɛɛtulus la pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Siizaria. Bɛ daa chaŋmi ti zaŋ bɛ mini Pool yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Gomna Filiksi.
en: Five days later the High Priest Ananias went to Caesarea with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus. They appeared before Governor Felix and made their charges against Paul.

dag: nti tim nimdi maa ni be ʒɛduɣ shɛli ni maa n-kuhi nimdi maa, ka nim shɛli din doli dirigu maa yina, maligumaana maa n-su li. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋdi Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa yi chani Shilo nti maani sara.
en: The servant would stick the fork into the cooking pot, and whatever meat came out on the fork was taken back to Eli's two sons. That was how they treated every Israelite who came to offer sacrifices in Shiloh.

dag: Teemiya Amalɛknim ni daa niŋ ya shɛm yi ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali gadama ni bɛ ba, ka kariti bɛ ma bahira nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tahiri vi mini turi na.
en: Those who would steal from their father and chase away their mother are disgusting, shameful people.

dag: n zaliya ni Izraɛlnim zaa bee bɛ maligumaaniba bee bɛ Lɛvinim bɛn be n nam sulinsi ni ka bɛ suhu yu ni bɛ kuli Jɛrusalɛm, bɛn dol a kuli.
en: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.

dag: O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, kom din be sagbana ni damdimi. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka paɣili kpɛri dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zaŋ li niŋ luɣ shɛli na.
en: At the sound of his voice, the heavenly waters roar. He raises the clouds from the ends of the earth. He sends the lightning with the rain, the wind from his treasuries.

dag: saha shɛli yi ni guhiri Naawuni dabisili dali ka yi suhuri kul ye di kandina zuɣu ŋɔ. Dindali maa buɣim ni ti taai zuɣusaa di li zaa, ka buɣim maa ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa maa nyɛligi.
en: as you wait for the Day of God and do your best to make it come soon—the Day when the heavens will burn up and be destroyed, and the heavenly bodies will be melted by the heat.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli Jona pahi buyi.
en: The LORDs word came to Jonah a second time.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya ba ka bɛ gbaai Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab shɛba n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani ka kuhiri yɛra, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɛbigiri dunia pindi tiŋ la paai ti ya ŋɔ gba na.
en: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Ka sɔŋsim bɔ ka a leei bɔra? Ka n daa suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: Then the king said to me, What do you want me to do? Before I answered, I prayed to the God of heaven.

dag: Nyin ka n kuhiri niŋda. Tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: I cry out to you, Save me so I can keep your laws.

dag: Iso zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ nanima m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso bituuli Ɛlifaz bidibisi. Bɛn daa nyɛ nanim maa n-nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfo ni Kɛnaz.
en: These are the tribes descended from Esau. Esau's first son Eliphaz was the ancestor of the following tribes: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili. A wuntitali zuɣu, yihim ma n wahala ŋɔ ni.
en: Make me live again, LORD, for your names sake. Bring me out of distress because of your righteousness.

dag: N nyar alibarika a zaligunim maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: This has been my practice because I guard your precepts.

dag: Nyam n ni yur a zaligunim maa shɛm. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili.
en: See how much I love your instructions! Lord , I know your love is true, so let me live.

dag: ka o yɛl o, Dindina bɛn fiɣis a maa n-ni kana ka n naanyi wum a nol ni. Ka daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd yiŋa n-gul o.
en: The governor said, I will hear your case when the Jews who are accusing you come here too. Then the governor gave orders for Paul to be kept in the palace built by Herod.

dag: Amaa ka wain tia maa bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wain shɛli din tiri wuna mini ninsalinim suhupiɛlli la tɔɣibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the vine answered, My wine makes men and kings happy. Should I stop making my wine just to go and sway over the trees.

dag: dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa bi tooi chɛ ka binshɛli niŋ dɛde; amaa din lee beni nyɛla, tahima suŋ din gari li yipa kana, ka ti ni tooi miri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: . On the other hand, a better hope is introduced, through which we draw near to God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Reehab, Ti yɛn zaŋla ti nyɛviya n-taɣ a dini. A yi bi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla yɛli so, ka Yawɛ ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, ti ni niŋ a nirilim.
en: Rahab, the spies answered, if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛn Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani maa ni daa tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, imitating the detestable practices of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa zɔri Sulemaana, ka yiɣisi chaŋ ti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Adonijah himself was afraid of what Solomon might do to him, so he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.

dag: Di pa shɛli o turi ŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka Yawɛ lihi n wahala ŋɔ ka niŋ ma din viɛli zuŋɔ.
en: Perhaps the LORD will see my distress; perhaps the LORD will repay me with good for this cursing today.

dag: Di chɛliya ka wuhibu balibubalibu mini wuhibu kɔŋkɔba din be di ko la birigi ya; di niŋ kamaata ni ti nya suhukpaŋsibo la Naawuni daanfaani puuni, ka pa ni bindira chihibu din bi sɔŋdi bɛn doli di wuhibu sol la.
en: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.

dag: Ka yi yi ti duɣi li ŋubi luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii maa n-yi biɛɣu asiba, yin labimiya yi suɣa ni.
en: Boil the meat and eat it at the one place of worship; and the next morning return home.

dag: Toli maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila yuri bɛn mali shili gu tɔbu tuhibu, ka binshɛŋa din be kaman salima nam zuɣupila la pil bɛ zuɣuri, ka bɛ ninani ŋmani daadam ninni.
en: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na zo ma nambɔɣu kaman a ni pun niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli shɛm la.
en: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yi yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla: Iin bee Aai, dama shɛli yi lan pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di nyɛla biriginsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: When you make a promise, say only Yes or No. Anything else comes from the devil.

dag: O yi yiɣisi zani, dabiɛm gbahirila wuna, ka bɛ zɔri dabiɛm ka labi nyaaŋa.
en: When he rises up, even the strongest are frightened; they are helpless with fear.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Haman, Niriba maa mini bɛ liɣiri maa zaa nyɛla a dini, niŋm bɛ min li a ni yu shɛm.
en: Then the king said to Haman, Keep the money. Do what you want with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu tuma ŋɔ fukumsi ni ʒi ti zuɣu Naawuni nambɔzɔbo puuni ŋɔ zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi gbarigira.
en: God in his mercy has given us this work to do, and so we do not become discouraged.

dag: ka yɛli Samsin, Man daa tɛhiya ni a lan je o mi, ka zaŋ o ti a daaŋgo zo la. O tizɔbil ŋɔ viɛli gar o, dinzuɣu jaande, zaŋm o tizɔbil maa ka chɛ o.
en: Her father said, I was so sure that you had completely rejected her that I gave her in marriage to one of your companions. Dont you think her younger sister is even better? Let her be your wife instead.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ? Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Yiɣisim bahi paai Damaskus tiŋ puuni, nimaani ka bɛ ni ti wuh a n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: I asked, What should I do, Lord? Get up, the Lord replied, and go into Damascus. There you will be told everything you have been appointed to do.

dag: Gbɛm kpe yuŋ ŋɔ, ka di sa neei ka ti nya dilan ni saɣi tum di tuma bee o ku saɣi. O yi saɣi ni o ni niŋ li, di viɛla, ka o yi bi saɣi, dindina m-po Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ ni n ni tum di tuma maa. Dinzuɣu dɔnimi ka biɛɣ neei.
en: Stay here until morning, then I will find out if he is willing to look after you. If he isn't, I promise by the living God to do it myself. Now go back to sleep until morning.

dag: Bɛ tirila pagɔra zaa liɣiri, amaa nyini n-lee tiri a mamanim zaa pina ni bɛ yi luɣilikam zaa kana a pagɔrisigu tuma maa zuɣu.
en: A prostitute is paid, but you gave presents to all your lovers and bribed them to come from everywhere to sleep with you.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, dindina o ni tooi yo yi ni zal o da shɛli, ka yo o daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bee o yi bi yo ka deeg o, dindina yin kɔhimiy o yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: If it is an unclean animal, it may be bought back at its value plus twenty percent. If it is not bought back, it will be sold at its set value.

dag: A dimnim yi lu, nyin di chɛ ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, bɛ yi tuui, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: Dont be happy when your enemy has troubles. Dont be glad when they fall.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti tabili Pɛɔr tiŋgbɔŋ ni Baal, ka diri kpiimba maligu nimdi.
en: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.

dag: Daadam, n kabi Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ bɔɣu, ka bɛ bi tar li moya bee n-lo li tani din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yaa, ka o zaŋ li gbaai takɔbi yaha.
en: Mortal man, he said, I have broken the arm of the king of Egypt. No one has bandaged it or put it in a sling so that it could heal and be strong enough to hold a sword again.

dag: A suhu yi ye bindirigu maa dibu zuɣu, nyin gbaam amaŋa.
en: If you have a big appetite, restrain yourself.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ banim paɣiba doon a ni. Bɛ muɣisiri paɣ shɛb bɛn nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai m-mali ba doon a ni.
en: Some of them sleep with their father's wife. Some force women to have intercourse with them during their period.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia yɛligu ba jila yi suhuri ni pam. Wuhimiya taba ka kpammiya tab jaande yɛm zaa puuni, ka zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila n-yiini paɣiri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: Christ's message in all its richness must live in your hearts. Teach and instruct one another with all wisdom. Sing psalms, hymns, and sacred songs; sing to God with thanksgiving in your hearts.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ tooni ha ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, Sit here while I go over there and pray.

dag: Ka Hadad daa ti kpi. O kalinsi nyaaŋa na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: When Hadad died, Edoms tribal chiefs were: Chief Timna, Chief Aliah, Chief Jetheth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba Jabɛshigiliadnim maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni yi ni daa wuhi yi ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi dan Naa Sool sani, ka sɔɣ o la zuɣu.
en: he sent some men there with the message: May the Lord bless you for showing your loyalty to your king by burying him.

dag: O ni zaŋ wuntia kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la ye, ka zaŋ tiliginsim kaman zuɣupiligu la pili. O ni zaŋ o suhu ni lo ni o mali binshɛɣukam zali dɛde shɛm, ka bɔhi biɛri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala la kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: putting on righteousness as armor and a helmet of salvation on his head, putting on garments of vengeance, and wrapping himself in a cloak of zeal.

dag: N ni wurim ba bɛ dimnim tooni bahi kaman pɔhim n-yi gbinni polo na ti ʒe ba chaŋ la. Bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali, n ni ti lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba ka pa ni n tooni.
en: Like a strong east wind, I will scatter them before their enemy. When disaster strikes them, I will show them my back, not my face.

dag: Ka o daa mali binyila tam di naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o daa niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: He made horns for it, one horn on each of its four corners. Its horns were attached to the altar, and he covered it with copper.

dag: Amaa a ba Dauda zuɣu, n ku niŋ li a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, n ni ti darigi deei nam maa la a bia nuu ni.
en: But because David was your father, you will remain king as long as you live. I will wait until your son becomes king, then I will take the kingdom from him.

dag: Ŋunkam daŋdi yiɣisibu asiba n-duhi o yee puhi o ʒiʒiinikpee, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli ka o yɛr maa.
en: You might as well curse your friends as wake them up early in the morning with a loud greeting.

dag: Di sabi yi zaligu ni ni niriba ayi shɛhiradibo n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Your own law says that when two witnesses say the same thing, you must accept what they say.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat bɔh o, Yawɛ anab so ka kpe ka ti ni bɔh o baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm? Di saha ka Izraɛl naa sapashinnim ni yino daa garigi yɛli, Shafat bia Ilaisha, ŋun daa nyɛ Ilaija sɔŋda la be kpe.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Surely one of the Lord s prophets is here. Lets ask the prophet what the Lord says we should do. One of the servants of the king of Israel said, Elisha son of Shaphat is here. Elisha was Elijahs servant. .

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, Chamiya ti sɔɣi do wain tihi pur la ni gu.
en: They told the Benjaminites, Go and hide in the vineyards.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛdom naa daa lab ŋme n-deei Ɛlat n-ti Ɛdomnima, ka daa kari Judanim yihi Ɛlat maa; ka Ɛdomnim maa daa kana ti be Ɛlat hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: At that time Arams King Rezin recovered Elath for the Arameans, driving the Judeans out of Elath. The Edomites came to Elath and settled there, and thats still the case now.

dag: N dan naa, niriba maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ anab Jɛrimia polo maa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ zaŋ o niŋla kɔbiliga ni ni kum ku o, dama bindirigu lan ka tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Your Majesty, what these men have done is wrong. They have put Jeremiah in the well, where he is sure to die of starvation, since there is no more food in the city.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbaai Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin chaŋ, di yuun pihitanaayopɔin gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi biɛɣu pisinaanu dali, ka Ivilmɛrɔdak ŋun daa di nam Babilɔn di yuuni maa la daa niŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim n-yih o sarika ni.
en: Jehoiachin was a prisoner in Babylon for years. Then Evil Merodach became king of Babylonia, and in the first year of his rule, on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month, he let Jehoiachin out of prison.

dag: Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahinahi, ka binshɛli din ŋmani ninsal nuhi be bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔna ni.
en: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ka tumdi din doli zaligu soli mini din tuhi, bɛ ni be di zuɣu.
en: And if evil people stop doing wrong and start living right and being fair, they will live.

dag: Ka duɣuri mini lahi din zaa ʒe zaɣiyari ka binshɛli bi pil li, di gba ni leei din bi be nyam.
en: Every jar and pot in the tent that has no lid on it also becomes unclean.

dag: ka o daa niŋ omaŋmaŋ ni pun lo shɛm, ka kahigi ashili nia shɛli o ni pun lo ni o pal li Masia zuɣu la wuhi ti.
en: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.

dag: Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka kpabi yim zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: The judgment pouch was folded in half to make a square pocket. It was span long and span wide.

dag: zaŋ Aroa din daa be Arinɔn vinvamli naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ la hal ti paai Siriɔn Zoli .
en: This land goes from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Valley all the way to Mount Sirion, that is, Mount Hermon.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n daa zaŋla n kpiɔŋ zaa niŋ gooni maa mɛbu tuma ni. Ka n tumtumdiba zaa daa laɣim nimaani tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma. N daa bi gbaai mmaŋmaŋ palo.
en: I worked hard at building the wall of Jerusalem. All my men gathered there to work on the wall. We didnt take any land from anyone.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, A ni suhila yɛm ka bi suhi nyɛvil wɔɣinli bee azichi bee a dimnim nyaŋbu, amaa ka suhila yɛm din ni chɛ ka a baŋ din tuhi la zuɣu.
en: and so he said to him, Because you have asked for the wisdom to rule justly, instead of long life for yourself or riches or the death of your enemies.

dag: Ti bi mali timaŋa ŋ-ŋmahindi bee m-buɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣiri bɛmaŋ la. Bɛ yi mali bɛmaŋ maɣisiri taba, ka mali bɛmaŋ buɣisiri taba, bɛ bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: Of course we would not dare classify ourselves or compare ourselves with those who rate themselves so highly. How stupid they are! They make up their own standards to measure themselves by, and they judge themselves by their own standards!.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Kush nir maa daa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka din niŋ nachimbil maa niŋ nyini n dan naa dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu ni bɛ niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: Is the young man Absalom all right? the king asked. The slave answered, I wish that what has happened to him would happen to all your enemies, sir, and to all who rebel against you.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni yi zuɣu.
en: In the same way, he gave them the cup after the supper, saying, This cup is God's new covenant sealed with my blood, which is poured out for you.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wumma, Yawɛ piig a ni a me o jɛmbu duu din nyɛ luɣ kasi shee. Mali yaa n-tum di tuma.
en: Solomon, you must understand that the Lord has chosen you to build his holy place—the Temple. Be strong and finish the job.

dag: Yisa ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o min o nyaandoliba daa yimi chaŋ ti du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli nti kpe tihi pu shɛli din daa do nimaani la ni.
en: When Jesus finished praying, he left with his followers and went across the Kidron Valley. He went into a garden there, his followers still with him.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayɔbu daba anu dali ka n daa ʒi n yiŋa, ka Juda kpamba daa ʒi n tooni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yiko daa siɣi n zuɣu na nimaani.
en: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and Judahs elders were sitting with me, when the LORD Gods power overcame me.

dag: Hal n yi nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni n nyu bara maa shɛm zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ fukumsi shɛli ti Duuma ni zaŋ niŋ ti nuu ni la polo, vi ku mali ma di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla fukumsi shɛli din yɛn mɛnya zali, ka pa ni din yɛn daai ya luhi.
en: Even if I went on to brag about our authority, I wouldnt be ashamed of it. The Lord gave us that authority to build you up and not to destroy you.

dag: Bɛ gbila bɔɣili kpe tiŋgban ni katiŋa, ka di mini ninsalinim ni be shɛli waɣa, ka sochandiba bi mi bɛ yɛla. Bɛ yilila mihi zuɣu m-be katiŋa laana.
en: They dig tunnels in distant, unknown places, where they dangle by ropes.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Kɔra, A min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni Aduna sa kam Yawɛ tooni na biɛɣuni.
en: Moses said to Korah, You and your entire community should appear before the LORD tomorrow, you, they, and Aaron.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ teebul la na ti mal li zali di zaashee di puuni; ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la na nti zaŋ di firilanim la tam di zuɣu.
en: Then bring in the table. Put the things on the table that should be there. Then put the lampstand in the Tent. Put the lamps on the lampstand in the right places.

dag: Di simdi ni tan tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Di simdi ka tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu ti nyɛ yim.
en: Each curtain should be forty-five feet long and each curtain six feet wide. The eleven curtains should all be the same size.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe sol ni; ka buŋ maa daa birigi kpe mɔɣu, ka Balaam fiɛb o ni o ŋmalig o lu soli.
en: The donkey saw the LORDs messenger standing in the road with his sword drawn in his hand, so the donkey turned from the road and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey in order to turn him back onto the road.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili azichi biɛhigu shee la n-tim ti ti Asiria naa pini.
en: Ahaz took the silver and gold from the Temple and the palace treasury, and sent it as a present to the emperor.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋ, ka bɛ nina ku nya shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri mi ku baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ labi n sanna, ka n tib ba.
en: He made their eyes blind and closed their minds so that they might not see with their eyes, understand with their minds, and turn their lives around— and I would heal them.

dag: M-pahi, ŋuni ka n lan yɛn jɛm ka pa ni n dan Dauda bia? N ni daa kul jɛmd a ba shɛm, lala ka n yɛn jɛm a gba.
en: After all, whom should I serve, if not my master's son? As I served your father, so now I will serve you.

dag: A nuu ni ka n zaŋ n shia niŋ; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ, nyini n-daa tiligi ma.
en: I entrust my spirit into your hands; you, LORD, God of faithfulness— you have saved me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛ ka binnɛma pam be kom ni, ka chɛ ka noonsi be zuɣusaa sagbana tiŋli yiɣiri gindi dunia ni.
en: God said, I command the ocean to be full of living creatures, and I command birds to fly above the earth.

dag: Di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So pa wuntizɔra, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: As the Scriptures say, There is no one doing what is right, not even one.

dag: Jɛra n-wuhiri bɛ suhuyiɣisili yomyom, amaa yɛnnim baɣa ka turi ni.
en: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yidana zaɣisir o min o paɣa laɣimbu; ka paɣ gba di zaɣisir o min o yidana laɣimbu.
en: A man should fulfill his duty as a husband, and a woman should fulfill her duty as a wife, and each should satisfy the other's needs.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya N je paɣ yihibo, n je ni so niŋ o paɣa kiŋkansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi nyɛ bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!.

dag: Nam ʒiishee maa daa malila dura diba ayɔbu, ka napɔna tambu shee din daa tuɣi nam ʒiishee maa nyɛ salima. Nam ʒiishee maa yaɣili kam daa malila nuhi pabu shee, ka bɛ daa mali gbuɣima ayi kɔtomsi n-zali baɣili nuhi pabu shee maa.
en: There were six steps leading up to the throne. The back of the throne was round at the top. There were armrests on both sides of the throne, and there were lions in the sides of the throne under the armrests.

dag: M mi Ifriim, ka Izraɛlnim pala bɛn ni sɔɣi ka n ku nya ba. Dama Ifriimnima, pumpɔŋɔ yi tum yolimyolim. Ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: I know Ephraim; Israel doesnt escape my eye; for now Ephraim you have acted like a prostitute; Israel is defiled.

dag: N daa lan bo tiŋguliba tin ya ka yɛli, Wummiya kikaa kumsi. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Ti ku wum.
en: I chose watchmen to watch over you. I told them, Listen for the sound of the war trumpet. But they said, We will not listen.

dag: Cheebu saha beni, ka shɛbu saha beni. Shinibu saha beni, ka tɔɣisibu saha beni.
en: for tearing and sewing, listening and speaking.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Mbo mfaaŋa, bi suŋ! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ tinsi pia fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Well done, he said; you are a good servant! Since you were faithful in small matters, I will put you in charge of ten cities.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yi Olivi Tihi Zoli maa zuɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm. Olivi Tihi Zoli maa mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: Then the apostles went back to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives. This mountain is about a half mile from Jerusalem.

dag: dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba m-pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: Pray to the owner of the harvest that he will send out workers to gather in his harvest.

dag: A ni ti boli ma, ka n saɣi. A kɔre ni ti be a nuhi tuma ni.
en: Then you will call, and I will answer, and you will be pleased with me, your creature.

dag: Zaŋm a yiko ŋɔ shɛli ti o, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa deer o noli.
en: Give him some of your own authority, so that the whole community of Israel will obey him.

dag: Ka hal binshɛli yi pili n-liri ti lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla, di pili n-liri li mi zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bahi yol la kɔŋko sani.
en: For if the gospel we preach is hidden, it is hidden only from those who are being lost.

dag: Ka Yisifu min o ba yiŋnim daa kul be Ijipti. Yisifu daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pia dunia yili ŋɔ.
en: Joseph continued to live in Egypt with his father's family; he was a hundred and ten years old when he died.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛli Mɔabnim yɛtɔɣ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ar zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi. Kɛɛr zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi.
en: An oracle about Moab. Ar was devastated in a night; Moab is ruined! Kir was devastated in a night; Moab is ruined!.

dag: Sulemaana ʒini nam ʒiishee.
en: Solomon is now the king.

dag: Di saha ka n daa galim Judanim zuɣulaannim la, ka bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tumdi Vuhim Dabisili dali n-tari li daɣiri maa?.
en: So I scolded the officials of Judah: What is this evil thing that you are doing? I asked. You are making the Sabbath impure!.

dag: Ka din kpalim leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni.
en: The rest of the offering belongs to the priests; it is very holy, since it is taken from the food offered to the Lord .

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina; ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣiyihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: Any man who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery; and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa doli Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu soli min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi shɛl la soli.
en: He did evil in the LORDs eyes by walking in Jeroboams ways and the sin he had caused Israel to commit.

dag: O daa zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: He put Joseph in charge of his house. Joseph took care of everything the king owned.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi zani n-chani doli ba hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka kul gbaai chandi ka yiɣiri jɛmdi ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: Jumping up, he began to walk around. He entered the temple with them, walking, leaping, and praising God.

dag: Yisa mini Pita ni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa ti paai Yisa nyaandol bɛn la sani nya ka salo pam n-laɣim gil ba, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib ŋmɛr o nyaandoliba maa naŋgbankpeeni.
en: When Jesus, Peter, James, and John approached the other disciples, they saw a large crowd surrounding them and legal experts arguing with them.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla alizanda tiŋbihi, ka ti suhuri kul yɛla tiligir so ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia m-be alizanda ni la labbuna zuɣu.
en: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋ Izraɛlnim maa zaa tooni.
en: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya n niriba bɛn be Ijipti la muɣisigu, ka wum bɛ fabila zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim ni niŋdi ba fitiina shɛŋa la polo. M mi bɛ wahalanim maa zaa.
en: The Lord said: I have seen how my people are suffering as slaves in Egypt, and I have heard them beg for my help because of the way they are being mistreated. I feel sorry for them.

dag: Di tuhiya ni a chɛ ka a kɔbilinina yam luɣilikam n-nyɛ kɔzɔrim be solɔri zuɣu?.
en: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha ka Jɔash daa di nam n-ʒi Jɛrusalɛm. O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi. O ma daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba paɣa, ka o yuli booni Zibia.
en: Joash began to rule during Jehus seventh year as king of Israel. Joash ruled years in Jerusalem. His mother was named Zibiah of Beersheba.

dag: O daa tiligi shɛba, ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa. O nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa. To, o siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti niŋ o yɛda.
en: They said, He saved others, but he cant save himself! People say he is the king of Israel. If he is the king, he should come down now from the cross. Then we will believe in him.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ ti ŋmanila Yisahaku; ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi o daalikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kul nyari yaa pahira, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: David grew stronger and stronger, because the Lord Almighty was with him.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tɔbiri mini bɛ piɛma n-to n-ku bipola. Bɛ ku zo biliɛri mini bibihi nambɔɣu.
en: Their bows will smash youths; they will be merciless to newborns, pitiless to children.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa mali shili n-kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni chaŋ Goshɛn ni o ti nya o ba Izraɛl. Bɛ ni daa ti nya taba, ka Yisifu chaŋ o sani nti zaŋ o nuhi m-bɔb gbaag o ba n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kum yuui.
en: Joseph learned that his father was coming. So he prepared his chariot and went out to meet his father, Israel, in Goshen. When Joseph saw his father, he hugged his neck and cried for a long time.

dag: dama dɔbba anu ka a pun kuli ka yi, ka hal a ni na be so yiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gba pala a yidana; dindina a shiri yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Youve had five husbands, and the man you are with now isnt your husband. Youve spoken the truth.

dag: Niŋm yomyom zo nti kpe di ni, dama ka pa ni a paala nimaani, ti ku tooi niŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Zɔa.
en: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you are safely there. The town was later called Zoar because Lot had said it was small.

dag: Kamiyana ti di m bindira ŋɔ, ka nyu n ni zaŋ wain shɛli gabi tab ŋɔ.
en: Come, eat my food, and drink the wine I have mixed.

dag: Niɣi daa nyɛla naɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu. Ka Yawɛ zaka niɣi kalinli daa nyɛ naɣ pisopɔinnaayi.
en: The soldiers got , cattle. They gave cattle to the Lord .

dag: Nyin Yawɛ kul ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord will rule forever and ever.

dag: ni Jɛrusalɛm naa ni Hiburɔn naa.
en: the king of Jerusalem one.

dag: Maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi kuli do so ŋun pa maligumaana, ŋun miri ka o lan di sara maligu kasinim maa.
en: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri wuntia ŋɔ, wummiya! Nyamiya bɛ ni daa ŋma kuɣ shɛli yihi ya na mini bɛ ni daa gbi tampin shɛŋa yihi ya na.
en: The Lord says, Listen to me, you that want to be saved, you that come to me for help. Think of the rock from which you came, the quarry from which you were cut.

dag: Ka salo maa kpamba daa yɛli, Ti mi pun ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba paɣiba zaa. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: the community elders said, What can we do to provide wives for the ones who are left, seeing that the Benjaminite women have been destroyed?.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o sani palli naŋgbanyee ti yɛl o, Kamina ti chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Dama o daa bi mi ni o bia pakoli maa m-bala. Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma ka chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: He went over to her at the side of the road and said, All right, how much do you charge? She said, What will you give me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Filistianim ni doli dimdi din bi naara mini nia biɛri din be bɛ suhuri ni n-ku niriba la zuɣu.
en: The Lord God said, The cruel Philistines have taken revenge on their enemies over and over and have tried to destroy them.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa sani karim; ka kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: King Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went to the Temple, placed the letter there in the presence of the Lord .

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa da tiŋgbani Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkɛm ba la bihi sani anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga n-ti o suɣa zali nimaani.
en: He bought that part of the field from the descendants of Hamor father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver.

dag: Dinzuɣu chama, n ni be a nol ni n-wuh a a ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Now, go! I will help you to speak, and I will tell you what to say.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, O yi di pala ŋun tum taali, ti naan ku tah o a sanna.
en: Their answer was, We would not have brought him to you if he had not committed a crime.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o ku lan tooi gbib omaŋa, nyin gbib o ka chɛ ka o be a sani kaman sana bee tinzun nir la.
en: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o zahindi maa ni, Iin, m mi ni a bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni a tum taali, amaa mani n-chɛ ka a bi tum alahichi n sani maa; di zuɣu ka m bi chɛ ka a shih o maa.
en: Then God said to Abimelech in a dream, Yes, I know that you are innocent and that you did not know what you were doing. I saved you. I did not allow you to sin against me. I was the one who did not allow you to sleep with her.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa siɣi tiŋgban kuŋ ni du, ka kom maa daa kul pirigi ʒiɛya kaman goma la bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: The Israelites, however, walked on dry ground through the sea. The waters formed a wall for them on their right hand and on their left.

dag: Biɛɣu pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ niŋ tim maa ʒe o niŋgbuŋ maa, dama bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi dabisi shɛŋa n-tumdi di tuma m-bala. Ka Ijiptinim daa zaŋ biɛɣ pisopɔin kum o kuli.
en: They mourned for him forty days because that is the period required for embalming. Then the Egyptians mourned him for seventy days.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmd a suhuri paligi, ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Naawuni galisiya.
en: But may those who come to you be happy and rejoice. May those who love being saved by you always be able to say, Praise God.

dag: N ni yu a zaligunim maa; n ku tam a yɛligu yɛla.
en: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.

dag: Di bi simdi ni tinzun nir ŋun niŋ Yawɛ yɛda ti yɛli, Yawɛ ku saɣi ka m pah o niriba ŋɔ ni. Di mi bi simdi ni namɔɣili ti yɛli, Man nyɛla ti kuŋ.
en: A foreigner who has joined the Lord 's people should not say, The Lord will not let me worship with his people. A man who has been castrated should never think that because he cannot have children, he can never be part of God's people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ba chaŋ Babilɔn maa nyaaŋa ka Jɛkɔnia daa dɔɣi Shialtiɛl, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl ba.
en: After the exile to Babylon: Jechoniah was the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the father of Zerubbabel.

dag: Damaskus yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Damaskus ku lan nyɛla tiŋa. Di ni kabi lu n-duhi doya.
en: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunima wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la.
en: Their worship of me is worthless. The things they teach are only human rules. Isaiah :.

dag: Bɛ ni ko tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ zaɣ nɛli la, ka di ku lan nyɛ zaɣ nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti nimaani sani.
en: Everyone who used to walk by your fields saw how overgrown and wild they were, but I will let you farm them again.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi zaŋ din buɣisiri maa buɣisi nudirigu polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He measured the south side. It was cubits long.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yaha, Naawuni nam ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun chaŋ o puu ni nti ko m-biri bimbira.
en: Then Jesus said, Gods kingdom is like a man who plants seed in the ground.

dag: Amaa Masia daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-fa ti fukumsi zaligu noli din daa doli ti la ni bahi, o ni daa zani ti zaani n-chɛ ka noli di o ti zuɣu la puuni, dama di sabiya: Noli di bɛ ni zaŋ sokam yili tia.
en: But by becoming a curse for us Christ has redeemed us from the curse that the Law brings; for the scripture says, Anyone who is hanged on a tree is under God's curse.

dag: Ka Kishɔn Mɔɣili kokpɛɣu daa ʒi ba chaŋ. Kishɔn kom din zɔri n-daa ʒi ba chaŋ. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi ni kpiɔŋ!.
en: The Kishon River swept them away; the advancing river, the Kishon River. March on, my life, with might!.

dag: Ka yi yi nyɛla Masia ni su shɛba, dindina yi nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi bɛn ni di o fali kaman Naawuni daalikauli la ni wuhi shɛm.
en: You belong to Christ, so you are Abrahams descendants. You get all of Gods blessings because of the promise that God made to Abraham.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, O nyɛla Masia la. Ka shɛb mi bɔhi, Di wuhiya ni Masia yɛn yila Galili na?.
en: Others said, He is the Messiah! But others said, The Messiah will not come from Galilee!.

dag: ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku Yisa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were looking for a way to get rid of Jesus, because they were afraid of what the people might do.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ san la nya taali chɛ m-paŋ, niriba maa zaa nuu ni be chirimbu maa ni la zuɣu.
en: The whole community of Israel and the foreigners living among them will be forgiven, because everyone was involved in the mistake.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaŋ do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa tahi Farisiinim sani.
en: Then the people brought the man to the Pharisees.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Asa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa pa omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti va kuɣ shɛŋa mini dakuɣ shɛŋa Naa Baasha ni daa mali mɛri Rama maa zaa n-chaŋ ti me Gɛba mini Mizipa.
en: Then King Asa gathered men from throughout Judah and had them carry off the stones and timbers that Baasha had been using at Ramah, and they used them to fortify the cities of Geba and Mizpah.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu palli bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na, dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: A good person brings good out of the treasure of good things in his heart; a bad person brings bad out of his treasure of bad things. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.

dag: Gul a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, a ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd a luɣ shɛl la din ni chɛ ka a gbilisiri tibili n-wumd a dabili suhigu saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ n nini kpa a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ na ka suhir a.
en: Constantly watch over this temple, the place where you promised to put your name, and listen to the prayer your servant is praying concerning this place.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa teei bɛ nuhi tirina n-vooi Lɔt kpɛhi duu bɛ sani, ka yo dunoli.
en: But the two angels in the house reached out and pulled Lot safely inside.

dag: Bee bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka a nyɛ sana, ka ti deeg a kpɛhi ti yinsi bee ka a chani gbinfini, ka ti ti a situra?.
en: When did we see you as a stranger and welcome you, or naked and give you clothes to wear?.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la min o tɔɣima la daa ʒiɛla kpaŋ ha tuhi siliga maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there, facing the tomb.

dag: ka fɔntin shɛli din ti miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba ni bo naɣisa so bɛ ni na ʒi n-zaŋ tum tuma bee n-zaŋ dapua pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: Then the leaders of the town nearest to where the body was found are to select a young cow that has never been used for work.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-yɛri noli tiri bɛ banima, ka bi paɣiri bɛ manima.
en: Some people curse their father and even their mother;.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni boli shɛb bɛn sani, bɛ yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, Masia yɛla nyɛla Naawuni yiko min o yɛm.
en: but for those whom God has called, both Jews and Gentiles, this message is Christ, who is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dahin shɛli n yi ti lan kpihim yi daalahichi, n ni ti lan chɛ ka niriba be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ ni yɛri Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim daalahichi yɛla shɛm galisiya.
en: Then the Lord said to Abraham, There are terrible accusations against Sodom and Gomorrah, and their sin is very great.

dag: Dama chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa baŋ ni pa Izraɛl naa maa m-bala maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: When the chariot officers realized that he wasnt Israels king, they stopped chasing him.

dag: Kuɣ viɛla balibu kam ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi tiŋ maa gooni maa gbinni nachiinsi, ka di kɔtomsi daa be kɔŋkɔba. Kuɣ viɛla maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla jasipa, ka din pah ayi nyɛ safaya, ka din pah ata nyɛ agɛt, ka din pah anahi nyɛ ɛmɛrald.
en: The foundation stones of the city walls had every kind of expensive jewels in them. The first foundation stone was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was chalcedony, the fourth was emerald.

dag: ni bɛ niŋ o kaman a ni daa pun lo shɛm a yiko ni min a milinsi ni la, dama di daa ʒe o la lala.
en: These people who came together against Jesus made your plan happen. It was done because of your power and your will.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ n nyɛvili bebu ni zaa. N ni yili yila paɣi n Naawuni hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I will praise the Lord all my life. I will sing praises to him as long as I live.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Brothers will turn against their own brothers and hand them over to be killed. Fathers will hand over their own children to be killed. Children will fight against their own parents and will have them killed.

dag: ka Gɛmalli bia Ammiɛl daa yi Dan zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel, Gemallis son.

dag: Izraɛl daa kul bela kasi Yawɛ sani. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o tiwala din daŋ moobu. Bɛnkam daa di li daa kpe taali ni, ka alɔbo daa lu bɛ zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel, you belonged to me alone; you were my sacred possession. I sent suffering and disaster on everyone who hurt you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di saha ka yi ni baŋ ni m be Izraɛlnim sani, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka so lan kani. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: You will know that I am with Israel. You will know that I am the Lord your God. There is no other God. My people will never be ashamed again.

dag: N ni garig a min a zɔnim bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: Job, I want to answer you and your friends here with you.

dag: kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm kurimbuni la.
en: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets.

dag: Ka naa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wum ba pam, ka o zani nimaani vuhi.
en: King David and all his people came to the Jordan River. They were tired, so they rested and refreshed themselves there.

dag: m-bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ yɛda maa, yi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Aai, ti na ʒi n-wum ni Naawuni Shia beni gba.
en: He asked them, Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed? These followers said to him, We have never even heard of a Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa Masia yi be yi ni, hal yi niŋgbuna yi ni kpi alahichi zuɣu gba, yi shihi lee ni ne yi ni yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu.
