en: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.

dag: O yi ti yiɣis o luɣ shɛlikam, o luhir o mi ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋarit o noli, ka o ŋubir o nyina ka kpaŋ dilinli; ka n suhi a nyaandoliba ŋɔ ni bɛ kari alizin birigu maa, ka bɛ bi tooi.
en: Whenever the demon attacks my son, it throws him to the ground and makes him foam at the mouth and grit his teeth in pain. Then he becomes stiff. I asked your disciples to force out the demon, but they couldn't do it.

dag: amaa ka n daa ti lan gariti nimaani ka bɛ kani; ka n lihi bo ba ka bi nya ba.
en: But when I came back, they were gone! I looked all over for them, but they couldnt be found!.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: They said, Allow one of us to sit on your right and the other on your left when you enter your glory.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa ka o labi alizanda ni nti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: After the Lord Jesus had talked with them, he was taken up to heaven and sat at the right side of God.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: He took Peter, James, and John along with him. He began to feel despair and was anxious.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya shɛli di ka di yuui zuɣu ka Pool daa ti yiɣisi zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli, N yilikpɛrilaannima, yi yi di daa wum n yɛligu la ka chɛ ka ti kpalim Kriit, ti naan ku nya gamu shɛli mini ashaara shɛli ti ni nya ŋɔ.
en: After everyone had gone a long time without food, Paul stood before them and said, You should have listened to me and not have sailed from Crete; then we would have avoided all this damage and loss.

dag: Sanzali lu bɛ kulisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka di koma nyuui. Dama di nyɛla binnana ni pali tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Ka bɛ suhuri zaa kul ye buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: Your rivers and canals will dry up. All of this will happen, because your land is full of idols, and they have made fools of you.

dag: ka daa mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi kɔbisinahi ni o zaŋ li niŋ o ni daa wuɣi binyar shɛŋa la. O daa zaŋ li mi pie tab kulis ayiyi n-gili o ni daa wuɣi binyar shɛŋa maa zaɣ yini kam ni o zaŋ pili biŋkpila ayi din daa tam daantalisi maa zuɣu la.
en: four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, with two rows of pomegranates for each network that adorned the two circular capitals on top of the columns.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam yi bi mali bɛmaŋ niŋ nyam ta Yawɛ sara maligu shee daɣiri, bɛ ni bi niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni mihi ba la zuɣu, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi ba Naawuni niriba ni.
en: If you are unclean and refuse to be made clean by washing with the water mixed with ashes, you will be guilty of making my sacred tent unclean, and you will no longer belong to the people of Israel.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi n-chani ti nya Hiburunim maa niriba ayi ni zabira, ka o daa yɛli bɛ ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmɛr a mabia maa.
en: The next day Moses saw two Hebrew men fighting each other. He saw that one man was wrong and said to him, Why are you hurting your neighbor.

dag: Dama di ku lan yuui, ka n ni yɛn darigi yi tibili zali shɛm tariga paai, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu m-bahi ba yoli.
en: But after a short time my anger will stop. I will be satisfied that Assyria has punished you enough.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni chɛ ka bindirigu yi zuɣusaa luna, ka sokam chani ti pihir o dahin yini dibu tariga dabisili kam, ka n kpahim ba nya bɛ ni tooi doli n zaligu bee bɛ ku tooi dol li.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Now I am going to cause food to rain down from the sky for all of you. The people must go out every day and gather enough for that day. In this way I can test them to find out if they will follow my instructions.

dag: Naawuni, a pun buɣisi ti nya. A nyahi ti zaa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi anzinfa shɛri buɣim ni m-maani li shɛm la.
en: God, you have tested us, as people test silver with fire.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya so sani fɔŋ ni ti yɛl o, Ti karimba n-tim ti na ni ti ti yɛl a ni o saha miriya; ka o bɔri ni o min o nyaandoliba puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ a yili ŋɔ. .
en: Jesus told them to go to a certain man in the city and tell him, Our teacher says, My time has come! I want to eat the Passover meal with my disciples in your home. .

dag: ka o puhirina m-be kaman aŋgo ŋun yi amiliya sampaa ni na bee kaman kpiɔŋlana ni yi yina n-zɔr o tia ni suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: The sun is like a groom coming out of his honeymoon suite; like a warrior, it thrills at running its course.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa laɣim niriba maa tampiŋ maa gbini ka Musa ti yɛli ba, Yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ, wummiya pumpɔŋɔ, ti chɛ ka kom yi kuɣili ŋɔ ni na n-tin ya.
en: Moses and Aaron told the people to meet together in front of the rock. Then Moses said, You people are always complaining. Now listen to me. I will cause water to flow from this rock.

dag: Ka nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ti paai Yisa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira n-tim ti a sanna ni ti ti bɔh a ni nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ni ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: When these messengers came to Jesus, they said, John the Baptist sent us to ask, Are you the one we should be looking for? Or are we supposed to wait for someone else? .

dag: Labisim li su di tɔɣu ni. N yɛn kari ya la saria n ni daa nam ya luɣ shɛl la, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yi piligu shee la ni ka n yɛn kari ya saria.
en: Put up the sword! I will judge you in the place where you were created, in the land where you were born.

dag: N ni daa deei shɛli n Duuma san la, dina ka m mali wuhiri ya ŋɔ: Dahin shɛli yuŋ bɛ ni daa yi ti Duuma nyaaŋa la, ka o daa kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro.
en: I received a tradition from the Lord, which I also handed on to you: on the night on which he was betrayed, the Lord Jesus took bread.

dag: A yi ŋmaligi labi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, o ni labis a zali a zaashe kurili ni. A yi yihi ninvuɣ biɛtali zaa a yiŋa.
en: If you return to God All-Powerful, you will be restored. But remove the evil from your house.

dag: O daa wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima tibisim shɛm tariga mali teebuli din nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro piɛri tab sɔŋdi shɛli zuɣu ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali anzinfa teebuli kam.
en: for the weight of gold for each table with the stacks of bread, and the silver for the silver tables.

dag: Kul zahimmiya binyɛra sania zuɣu ka di paara ni yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋmiya kuruwa maŋli zahindi yi binyɛra ka di paana din ni chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: Use true and honest weights and measures, so that you may live a long time in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yɛli Jɛrimia m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord , am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Salinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the Lord , all you nations. Praise him, all you people.

dag: ka guhiri ti tahima din mal alibarika dabisi shɛli dali ti Naawuni Natitamlana ŋun nyɛ tiligira Yisa Masia la jilima palo yibu saha.
en: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: They were shocked even more and said to each other, Then who can be saved.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi pam ka Ijiptinim ti wum o kuhigu maa, hal ka Firawuna yiŋnim gba ti wum o kuhigu maa.
en: Then he cried so loudly that the Egyptians heard him and told about it in the king's palace.

dag: Ka Jeemsi mini Jɔn, Zɛbidii bihi la, daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti di bɔri ni a niŋ ti la ti ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: James and John, Zebedees sons, came to Jesus and said, Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we ask.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti vuhi ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣ o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaashee.
en: Then Solomon lay down with his ancestors. He was buried in his father Davids City, and Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

dag: Ŋuna n-su dunia tiŋgbani puuni ziliŋ; ka su zo kara la gba.
en: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.

dag: Ka Yisa chɛbis o ni o kulima ka yɛl o, Di lan lab tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then Jesus sent him home, saying, Dont go into the village.

dag: bee zilisigu yi kpe doo suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ polo zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: o ni zaŋ paɣ maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana karim zaligu maa yɛla zaa bahi paɣ maa zuɣu.
en: Or if the man becomes jealous and thinks his wife has sinned against him, this is what the man should do. The priest must tell her to stand before the Lord . Then the priest will do all these things. This is the law.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahind o, ka tim niriba ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman bɛ nyɛla bɛn nini mooi yɛlimaŋli zuɣu la m-puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o niŋ gomnanti fukumsi ni.
en: Jesus' enemies kept watching him closely, because they wanted to hand him over to the Roman governor. So they sent some men who pretended to be good. But they were really spies trying to catch Jesus saying something wrong.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa labina, di saha maa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jabɛshigiliad paɣ shɛb bɛ ni daa bi kula ti ba. Amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi saɣi ba.
en: So the men of Benjamin came back from Rimmon Rock, and the Israelites let them marry the young women from Jabesh. But there weren't enough women.

dag: ka o chɛ ka di niŋ pali tinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaansi ŋɔ sani maa, dina n-nyɛ o ni daa neei Yisa kum ni kaman di ni sabi Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛli din pah ayi ni shɛm la, ni Naawuni yɛliya: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, You are my son because today I have become your Father.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti dalim siliga maa noli kuɣili la, ka zali tɔbbihi ka bɛ gul li.
en: Then they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ saawaralana n-nya o ka wum o yɛligu? Ŋuni n-lee wum o yɛligu ka nyɛ ŋun ni tooi mol li?.
en: I said, None of these prophets has ever known the Lord 's secret thoughts. None of them has ever heard or understood his message, or ever listened or paid attention to what he said.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣimna.
en: When it was evening, Jesus came with the twelve disciples.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: Don't you see what is happening to you?.

dag: Yawɛ nambɔzɔbo min o nirilim galisiya. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The Lord is merciful and loving, slow to become angry and full of constant love.

dag: Ka bɛn daa be sansani maa ni mini bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni ni niriba maa zaa suhuri dii fuŋ, ka tɔbbihi zaŋ tabili ŋmɛnditoya zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira ka tiŋgbani daa dam, ka bɛ yɛma ŋma pam.
en: Great fear spread among the Philistine soldiers—those in the field, in the camp, and at the fort. Even the bravest soldiers were afraid. The ground began to shake, and they were completely overcome with fear.

dag: lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana ti balim ba ni bɛ niŋm suɣilo, ka daa naanyi yihi ba bahi, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋ maa ni.
en: So they came and told them they were sorry. They led them out of the jail and asked them to leave the city.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ zaɣis a ka leeg a dima, ka wula a lan bɔhiri ma?.
en: Samuel said, Why do you call me when the Lord has abandoned you and become your enemy?.

dag: ka tiŋgbani mi ti saɣi ti kawana mini wain ni kpam, ka di mi ti saɣi ti Jɛziriil.
en: The earth will produce grain, wine, and oil, and they will meet Jezreels needs.

dag: Wain kalinsi zuɣu chɛ ka niriba doli soya kumda, ka suhupiɛlli kam naai, ka dunia ŋɔ suhupiɛlli zo;.
en: There is a cry for wine in the streets. All joy has reached its dusk; happiness is exiled from the earth.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ kawaan daŋda bee ka daŋda na ni yi ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, yin zaŋmiya zaɣ maha n-chim li niɛm zim.
en: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm, sɔɣirila o milinsi, amaa jɛra bɛn kul moonila bɛ jɛrilim.
en: Smart people keep quiet about what they know, but stupid people advertise their ignorance.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe Jɛrubaal malibu yim, o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la gba zuɣu.
en: Nor did they act loyally toward the household of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, in return for all the good that he had done on Israels behalf.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni yaai n noli ŋahi ŋaha, ka yɛli binshɛŋa din sɔɣi tum dunia piligu ni ha la yɛla.
en: This was to fulfill what the prophet spoke: Ill speak in parables; Ill declare what has been hidden since the beginning of the world.

dag: Ka yi lan niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim pahira. Yi kuhira, ka fabinda, ka yi nintam tɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini, o ni bi lan lihi nya yi sara bee n-deeri li yi nuu ni ni yurilim la zuɣu.
en: You can cry and cover the Lord s altar with tears, but the Lord will not accept your gifts. He will not be pleased with the things you bring to him.

dag: M mabihi, dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya.
en: So do not be surprised, my friends, if the people of the world hate you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi paɣiba mini yi bihi ni yi biŋkɔbiri ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni Musa ni daa zaŋ tin ya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili ŋɔ na. Amaa ka yi ni tɔbbihi bɛn lo kpara zaa pahi yi mabihi maa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba.
en: Your wives, your children, and your livestock will stay here, but your soldiers, armed for battle, will cross over ahead of the other Israelites in order to help them.

dag: Ka timpani yi bi kum tɔb chiriga kumsi ŋuni n-lee ni mali shili chaŋ tɔb tuhibu?.
en: And in a war, if the trumpet does not sound clearly, the soldiers will not know it is time to prepare for fighting.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ahija, Nyama, Naa Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ kanna ni o ti bɔh a nya din yɛn niŋ o bia ŋun ka alaafee. A ni ti yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O ni daa ti paai, o daa taɣila o biɛhigu ni o be kaman paɣ so la.
en: The Lord had told him that Jeroboam's wife was coming to ask him about her son, who was sick. And the Lord told Ahijah what to say. When Jeroboam's wife arrived, she pretended to be someone else.

dag: Ka Maika daa bɔh o, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira, ka yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. N chani bɔrila luɣ shɛli ni n ʒini.
en: Where are you from? Micah asked him. He replied, Im a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, and Im looking to settle as an immigrant anywhere I can find a place.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so dabidoo bee dabipaɣa, di simdi ka nahu maa lan yo dabili maa lana anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o.
en: If the ox gores a male or female slave, the owner will pay thirty silver shekels to the slaves owner, and the ox will be stoned to death.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee maa zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋme tampiŋ maa buyi, ka kom pam daa yi di ni na, ka niriba maa mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa daa nyu.
en: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock with his staff twice. Out flooded water so that the community and their animals could drink.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa ti lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o piɛli Dauda bahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛl o, Cham ti kali Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: The Lord was angry with Israel again. He caused David to turn against the Israelites. He told David, Go count the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: A gba ni ti nyu dam kuli, a ni ti zo n-sɔɣi. A ni ti bɔri sɔɣisili shee a dim sani.
en: Yes, even you will become drunk; you will have to hide! Even you will have to seek refuge from the enemy!.

dag: Doo bee paɣa yi mali dalima o niŋgbuŋ ni ka di nyɛ zaɣ piɛla.
en: When any of you, male or female, have white spots on the skin.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Di kpalim biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma yaha dama n labirila m Ba sani.
en: Jesus told his disciples, For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.

dag: dama Naawuni nyɛla yino ka ni chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn guni yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka mi ni lan chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka bi guni la gba yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: There is only one God. He will make Jews right with him by their faith, and he will also make non-Jews right with him through their faith.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka yi daa guni gunibu shɛli din pa ninsal ni niŋ shɛli, amaa ka nyɛla Masia maŋmaŋ ni niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛ o ni yihi ya niŋgbuŋ din tumd alahichi ŋɔ alahichi maa yiko dabitim puuni la zuɣu.
en: In Christ you had a different kind of circumcision, one that was not done by human hands. That is, you were made free from the power of your sinful self. That is the kind of circumcision Christ does.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bo bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi sil shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni ka na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni la.
en: Taking it down, he wrapped it in a linen cloth and laid it in a tomb carved out of the rock, in which no one had ever been buried.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu ŋun be bia maa ni zuɣu, ka o zo ka chɛ o, ka bia maa dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus gave a command to the demon, and it went out of the boy, and at that very moment he was healed.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Ahaz was years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem. Unlike his ancestor David, Ahaz did not do what the Lord said was right.

dag: Ka Liya daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayɔbu ti Yaakubu.
en: Leah became pregnant again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Sulemaana daa mali buni mini yɛm n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: King Solomon was richer and wiser than any other king in the world.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi ti paai ti, kaman tibidarigibo tɔbu bee alɔbo bee fifali, ka ti ka a duu ŋɔ gbin na nti zani a tooni n-fabili niŋ a ti muɣisigu saha a ni wum ti fabila maa ka tiligi ti dama a be duu ŋɔ ni. .
en: If calamity, sword, flood, plague, or famine comes upon us, we will stand before this temple, before you, because your name is in this temple. We will cry out to you in our distress, and you will hear us and save us.

dag: Zɛbadia mini Mɛshulam ni Hiziki ni Hɛbɛr.
en: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu maa yɛla ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni.
en: Those who live as their human nature tells them to, have their minds controlled by what human nature wants. Those who live as the Spirit tells them to, have their minds controlled by what the Spirit wants.

dag: Kaman yim bee buyi ka kɔhigɔriba mini bɛn kɔhiri nɛma balibu kam daa kana ti gbe Jɛrusalɛm gooni maa sambani polo.
en: Once or twice merchants who sold all kinds of goods spent Friday night outside the city walls.

dag: n-chaŋ omaŋmaŋ ya n-daa ti kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba, ka di daa gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ya ka doo ŋɔ lee nya yɛm ŋɔ mini tuun kara ŋɔ?.
en: He went to the town where he grew up. He taught the people in the synagogue, and they were amazed. They said, Where did this man get such wisdom and this power to do miracles?.

dag: Yisahaku daa yurila Iso, dama o daa yuri mɔɣu ni nimdi pam, ka Ribɛka mi daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: Isaac loved Esau. He liked to eat the animals Esau killed. But Rebekah loved Jacob.

dag: Di dubihi atata din be di yaɣa ayi la mini di pilanima ni di zɔntua zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: its three inner rooms on each side, its arches, and its porch. Its measurements were the same as the first gate: seventy-five feet long and thirty-seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Chɛ ka a min a ʒiʒiinikpee ʒini m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa, ka miri ka a zaŋ so daashili yɛla moli;.
en: If you want to tell your friends about your own problems, tell them. But dont discuss what someone told you in private.

dag: n yi yɛli gballi, M ba n-nyɛ a, ka yɛli zunzuli, M ma n-nyɛ a, bee, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a.
en: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, Hello, mother and sisters.

dag: Sa malimi shili biɛɣuni asiba n-du Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti zaŋ amaŋ ti ma zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kul chani Bɛrishiiba hal ni Ifriim zoya ni tinsi la zaa ni niriba sani nti lan labisi ba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ni yaha.
en: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he would go out among the people throughout Judah, from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim. He helped the people turn back to the Lord , the God their ancestors worshiped.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka di nyɛla Liya. Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi Leeban, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Reechɛl zuɣu ka n tum tuma ti a, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma.
en: In the morning, there she was—Leah! Jacob said to Laban, What have you done to me? Didnt I work for you to have Rachel? Why did you betray me.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ sana zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-niŋ o fitiina, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Remember, in the past you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. So you should not cheat or hurt anyone who is a foreigner in your land.

dag: Pɛrɛz zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɛrɛz n-daa dɔɣi Hɛzirɔn, ka Hɛzirɔn dɔɣi Ram.
en: This is the family line from Perez to David: Perez, Hezron, Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, Jesse, David.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu ŋooi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: Almighty God has destroyed my courage. It is God, not the dark, that makes me afraid— even though the darkness has made me blind.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa zaŋ sarikanim bɛn zaa be sarika maa ni niŋ Yisifu nuu ni, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa nimaani.
en: he put him in charge of the other prisoners and of everything that was done in the jail.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good. Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Zaawuni sara maligu maa saha ka n daa yiɣisi n nolɔbo maa puuni ni m binyɛr tɔhima la. Ka n daa gbani n-teei n nuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I ended my penitential acts. While still wearing my torn clothes and cloak, I fell upon my knees, spread out my hands to the LORD my God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ ninsal maa niŋ Idɛn puu maa ni ni o kɔr li, ka yuuni li.
en: Then the Lord God placed the man in the Garden of Eden to cultivate it and guard it.

dag: Naa suhu nyɛla kɔzɔrim m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o ŋmaligiri li kpari o ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: The Lord controls the mind of a king as easily as he directs the course of a stream.

dag: M bɔri ni yi yi yɛla muɣisigu puuni. Ŋun ka paɣa baɣa bela ti Duuma yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o nini;.
en: I want you to be free from worry. A man who is not married is busy with the Lords work. He is trying to please the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka buɣili Zius ŋun duu daa be tiŋ maa tooni la tindana daa bo naɣilahi mini vari n-ka tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni na ni o mini niriba maa ti kɔrigi mali ba.
en: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was located just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates. Along with the crowds, he wanted to offer sacrifices to them.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla mini Yisa so ŋun daa kpi ka Pool yɛli ni o ne la yɛla tɔɣisi.
en: All they had were some arguments with him about their own religion and about a man named Jesus, who has died; but Paul claims that he is alive.

dag: Ka anabinim maa pihinu daa doli ba chaŋ ti kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ ha ka chɛ ba.
en: and fifty of the prophets followed them to the Jordan. Elijah and Elisha stopped by the river, and the fifty prophets stood a short distance away.

dag: Ŋuna m-pii ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ti, din nyɛ Yaakubu so o ni yuri la ni nyuri bara shɛli zuɣu la.
en: He chose our land for us. He chose that wonderful land for Jacob, the one he loved. Selah.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛl shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Dinzuɣu kpahimi bɛ zuɣu ni ni nimmoo ka di chɛ ka bɛ ba n-zani wuhibu maŋli maa ni.
en: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nima bemi kaman Naawuni ni daa zaŋ taŋkpaɣu nam so la, ka bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni nim mi be kaman ŋun yi alizanda ni na la.
en: Those who belong to the earth are like the one who was made of earth; those who are of heaven are like the one who came from heaven.

dag: Dinzuɣu vuhim nyabu ni na kul ʒiɛya gul shɛb ni bɛ vuhi, hal ka bɛn daa tuui wum lahibal suŋ la daa bi paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka niriba pam yi tiŋkpansi n-daŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti doli bɛ kali soli m-mali bɛmaŋa ka Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa dali na bi paai.
en: It was almost time for the Jewish Passover festival. Many people from the country went to Jerusalem before the Passover. They went to do the special things to make themselves pure for the festival.

dag: ka a niriba nya biɛhigu shee nimaani. Naawuni, a ti nandaamba din simdi ba a nirilim niŋbu puuni.
en: and your creatures settled in it. In your goodness, God, you provided for the poor.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo din daa pahiri buyi la, bɛ daa malila dapaɣa pisi.
en: They also made frames for the other side of the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka dɔro daa ti gbaag o ka o kpi, ka bɛ suug o kom n-zaŋ o kpɛhi jirambisa zuɣusaa duu ti sɔŋ.
en: While Peter was in Lydda, Tabitha became sick and died. They washed her body and put it in an upstairs room.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ku ŋma ʒiri bee n-taɣ o ni pun yɛli shɛm, dama o pala ninsala ka ni yɛli shɛli ka lan taɣi.
en: Whats more, the enduring one of Israel doesnt take back what he says and doesnt change his mind. He is not a human being who would change his mind.

dag: Bansi maa daa baɣila di naŋgbaŋkuɣila din daa yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: The rings to hold the poles for carrying the table were placed near the rim.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni nira yi yi tin shɛl ni o ni pun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ka Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli na .
en: Now if a Levite leaves one of your cities or departs from any location in Israel where hes been living and, because he wants to, comes to the location the LORD selects.

dag: Juda nayilinim ni daa wum ni Aram mini Ifriim zuliya naai noli, Ahaz min o niriba ni daa sɔhirimi kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri tibɔŋ ni tihi ka di damdi shɛm la.
en: When the house of David was told that Aram had become allies with Ephraim, their hearts and the hearts of their people shook as the trees of a forest shake when there is a wind.

dag: O daa ku Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He defeated Sihon king of the Amorites. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha?.
en: At once the high priest ripped his robe apart and shouted, Why do we need more witnesses?.

dag: Ka bia maa ba maa baŋ ni di nyɛla saha shɛli Yisa ni sa yɛl o ni o bia maa ni gal la. Ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Then the father remembered that it was at that very hour when Jesus had told him, Your son will live. So he and all his family believed.

dag: O ni lan chɛ ka a lara, ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: So perhaps you might laugh again. Maybe shouts of joy will come from your lips.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli, o ni daa nam ninsala n-niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu; ka o suhu daa saɣim pam di zuɣu.
en: he was sorry that he had ever made them and put them on the earth. He was so filled with regret.

dag: Yim kpe n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti sɔɣi dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Leave this place and go east. Hide near Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be Naawuni Kundi ni yila Naawuni nol ni na, ka nyɛ din mali buchi pam zaŋ chaŋ wuhibu mini saɣisibu ni zuɣu ni kpahibu ni wuntia soli wuhibu polo.
en: All Scripture is inspired by God and is useful for teaching the truth, rebuking error, correcting faults, and giving instruction for right living.

dag: Amaa baŋmiya ni Yawɛ m-pii wuntizɔra ti omaŋa; ka n yi bol o, ŋun Yawɛ wumdi m boligu.
en: You can be sure that anyone who serves the Lord faithfully is special to him. The Lord listens when I pray to him.

dag: O kɔrila naɣilahi mini naɣ pol kpaba ni piɛri pam mali sara, ka boli nabihi zaa mini maligumaana Abiata ni tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Jɔab, amaa ka bi bol a bia Sulemaana ŋuna.
en: He sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. And he invited Abiathar the priest, Joab your army commander, and all your sons to be there, except Solomon, your loyal servant.

dag: O daa bi bo sɔŋsim maa Yawɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ku o, ka zaŋ o nam maa ti Jɛsi bia Dauda.
en: instead of asking the Lord . So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: All the people saw this and fell on their faces. The LORD is the real God! The LORD is the real God! they exclaimed.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi so zuɣu maa dii kahi nti kpe bɛ ni n-nyaŋ bɛ zaa m-bu n-ti ba dansi, ka bɛ zo ni bɛ zaɣim n-yi yili maa ni.
en: The man who had the evil spirit in him attacked them with such violence that he overpowered them all. They ran away from his house, wounded and with their clothes torn off.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa kpuɣi Dauda bia Jɛrimɔt bipuɣiŋga, Mahalat ŋun ma daa nyɛ Abiheel ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia Ɛliab bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Rehoboam married Mahalath. Her father was Jerimoth. Her mother was Abihail. Jerimoth was Davids son. Abihail was Eliabs daughter, and Eliab was Jesses son.

dag: Amaa ka so daa zaŋ Ribɛka bituuli Iso ni yɛli shɛm maa ti yɛli Ribɛka, ka o daa tim ti bol o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa na ti yɛl o, A biɛli Iso ni zaŋ shɛli maag omaŋ suhu nyɛla, o lɔrila nia ni o ku a.
en: Rebekah was told what her older son Esau was planning, so she summoned her younger son Jacob and said to him, Esau your brother is planning revenge. He plans to kill you.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ bɛ tab niriba ayi maa.
en: When the other ten disciples heard about this, they became angry with the two brothers.

dag: Ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam, dama yɛtɔɣa maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ tuhi piapia ti Dauda, ka zaŋla tuhilituhili ti m mi, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ka pa ni n nam ŋɔ ka o yɛn deei.
en: This song upset Saul and he became very angry. Saul thought, The women give David credit for killing tens of thousands of the enemy, and they give me credit for only thousands. A little more of this and they will give him the kingdom itself! .

dag: Yawɛ yuri Jɛrusalɛm gari tin shɛŋa din zaa be Izraɛl.
en: more than any other place in Israel he loves the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sintani daa kpe Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la suhu ni;.
en: One of Jesus twelve apostles was named Judas Iscariot. Satan entered him.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi nimaani n-chani Samaria n-daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Piɛguliba Dooshee la.
en: Next Jehu set out for Samaria. Beth-eked of the Shepherds was on his way.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi neesim maa ne sokam zaa sani, ka bɛ nyari yi tuun suma ka tiri yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: In the same way, let your light shine before people, so they can see the good things you do and praise your Father who is in heaven.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Ti ni niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: All the people spoke at the same time and said, We will obey everything the Lord says. Then Moses went back up the mountain and told the Lord that the people would obey him.

dag: dama n zo so m-paai n yiŋ na pumpɔŋɔ, ka n ka bindir shɛli din ni ti o ka o di.
en: because a friend of mine on a journey has arrived and I have nothing to set before him.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum o deemba yɛligu maa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zaa.
en: Moses took Jethro's advice.

dag: Bundaannim mini faranim zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun nam bɛ zaa.
en: The rich and the poor have this in common: the Lord made them both.

dag: Ka Liya daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayɔbu ti Yaakubu.
en: When Leah had another son.

dag: N ni yɛri shɛm zabiri mmaŋ zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is my defense against those who criticize me.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab naa la daa ti yiɣisi lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa tim ti boli Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni o ti yɛl noli tin ya.
en: Then the king of Moab, Balak son of Zippor, fought against you. He sent word to Balaam son of Beor and asked him to put a curse on you.

dag: N niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ, pilimiya buri, ka niŋ tampiligim buɣi yimaŋa n-kum kaman nira bi gaŋa ni yi kpi ka o kumdi shɛm la. Fabilimiya pam, dama bɛn kuri niriba maa ni libigi ti.
en: My people, put on sackcloth and roll in the ashes. Cry loudly for the dead. Cry as if you lost an only son. Do this because the destroyer will come against us very quickly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti niŋ naani ni ti ni tooi kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la Yisa ʒim zuɣu.
en: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place.

dag: Niriba maa zaa ni daa du duli naai saha shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa mi naanyi du duli na n-gari niriba maa tooni.
en: When they were all on the other side, the priests with the Lord 's Covenant Box went on ahead of the people.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba bɛn be kasi. Yawɛ n-daa pii ya dunia ŋɔ zuliya pam sunsuuni n-leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: because you are a people holy to the LORD your God. You are the ones whom the LORD selected to be his own, to be a treasured people out of all other people on earth.

dag: N ni fo baalim, ka ku yɛli shɛli, dama nyini n-niŋ lala.
en: I will keep quiet, I will not say a word, for you are the one who made me suffer like this.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa wum Yisa ŋaha ŋɔ, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛna ka o ŋahi li dalim maa.
en: The chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus' parables and knew that he was talking about them.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Aduna, Wula ka niriba maa lee niŋ a, ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to Aaron, What did these people do to you that would make you do this? Why did you lead them to do such a terrible sin.

dag: Hal a yɛn yɛlimi ni m mali galimi? A wuhimi ni m mali galimi din ni wuhi ni a mali yɛlimaŋli?.
en: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?.

dag: ni Kina ni Dimɔna ni Adada.
en: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah.

dag: O wuɣir omaŋmaŋ garo bimpara. O situra nyɛla tampiɛl viɛlli mini tan ʒiɛkpeein.
en: She makes bedspreads for herself; fine linen and purple are her clothing.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banim mi di yihiriya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka bɛ ti yihi tahima.
en: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.

dag: Juda nayilinim ni daa wum ni Aram mini Ifriim zuliya naai noli, Ahaz min o niriba ni daa sɔhirimi kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri tibɔŋ ni tihi ka di damdi shɛm la.
en: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.

dag: Ka Pool yɛl o, N dana, m bi kpɛla yinyari, amaa nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa mini yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛra.
en: Paul said, Most Honorable Festus, I am not crazy. What I am saying is true. It all makes perfect sense.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mini Yisa nyaandoliba ni so daa doli Yisa chaŋ. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol ŋuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka ŋun doli Yisa kpe maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni.
en: Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. That other disciple was well known to the High Priest, so he went with Jesus into the courtyard of the High Priest's house.

dag: O nina daa ŋmanila buɣim zilinli, ka nam zuɣupila pam pil o zuɣu ni; ka yu shɛli sabi tab o, ka so ʒi li pah o zuɣu.
en: His eyes were like a flame of fire, and he wore many crowns on his head. He had a name written on him, but no one except himself knows what it is.

dag: Ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila omaŋa, amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila cheechi ni niriba.
en: Those who speak in a different language are helping only themselves. But those who prophesy are helping the whole church.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi ŋmɛnditol shɛba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: And in the same way, the criminals on the crosses beside Jesus also insulted him.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi daalahichi tumbu mini yi ni pa bɛn doli gunibu kali sol la zuɣu. Amaa ka Naawuni neei yi mini Masia kum ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka chɛ ti daalahichi zaa paŋ ti.
en: You were spiritually dead because of your sins and because you were not free from the power of your sinful self. But God gave you new life together with Christ. He forgave all our sins.

dag: Yuma maa yi galisi, nyin pahimi liɣiri, ka yuma maa yi bi galisi, nyin filimmi liɣiri maa, dama a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam shɛm ka o kɔhiri tir a maa.
en: You will raise the price if there are more years, or lower the price if there are less years because it is the number of harvests that are being sold to you.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa wum yɛlli maa, ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim Shilo na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: When the Israelites heard this, the entire Israelite community assembled at Shiloh to go up to war against them.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni sakom leei taŋkpa zim ka duɣiduɣi kɔŋko yiri sagbana ni luri yi zuɣu na hal ti kun ya.
en: The LORD will turn the rain on your land into dust. Only dirt will fall down on you from the sky until you are completely wiped out.

dag: mini dundɔŋ ni duri la sunsuuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pia n-gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣilikam.
en: and the priests rooms. It was cubits wide and went all the way around the Temple.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi niriba maa, ka bɛ zaa lab kuli bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Then Joshua told the people to go home. So everyone went back to his own land.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: But Jesus answered, The scripture says, Human beings cannot live on bread alone.

dag: Obɛdɛdom daa mali bidibisi: Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ o bituuli n-zaŋ Jɛhɔzabad pa, ka Jɔa pah ata, ka Sakar pah anahi, ka Nɛtanɛl pah anu.
en: Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.

dag: Yinim zoya mini dunia ŋɔ tanza kurisi la, wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama Yawɛ min o niriba mali yɛtɔɣa; o mini Izraɛlnima m-mali yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord has a complaint against his people. Mountains, listen to the Lord s complaint. Foundations of the earth, hear the Lord. He will prove that Israel is wrong.

dag: Sagbana yi ti pali kom, saa lurimina, ka tia yi lu n-kpala nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, di ni lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka di yɛn doya.
en: No matter which direction a tree falls, it will lie where it fell. When the clouds are full, it rains.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o yiŋnim dɔbba yinoyino zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Karimi bia Ɛkan ŋun daa nyɛ Zabidi mini Zɛra yaaŋa ka yi Juda zuliya ni na la.
en: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord , and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-baai du teeku duli kul o ya.
en: Jesus got into the boat and went back across the lake to his own town.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, bɛn labimi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka di bi simdi ka so ŋubi nahu maa nimdi, ka nahu maa lana ku mali taali.
en: If a bull gores someone to death, it is to be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but its owner is not to be punished.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, yɛlim a tumtumdib zaa bɛn be a sani ŋɔ ni bɛ lihim nya ninvuɣ so ŋun mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga ti a, ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka alizin biɛ so kana ti muɣisir a maa yi ti lan siɣ a zuɣu na, ka dilan ŋme mɔɣilo maa, a ni nya amaŋa.
en: If our master just says the word, your servants will search for someone who knows how to play the lyre. The musician can play whenever the evil spirit from God is affecting you, and then youll feel better.

dag: N dana, palo maa liɣiri kul nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisinahi kɔŋko, ka dimbɔŋɔ lee nyɛ bɔ m min a sunsuuni? Zaŋm a kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: Sir, what is four hundred shekels of silver between me and you for the land so that you can bury your dead.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Itai, Dindina garim ka ti chaŋ. Di saha ka Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir maa min o niriba zaa ni bibihi bɛn daa be o sani zaa gari tooni.
en: David said to Ittai, Then come, lets go cross Kidron Brook. So Ittai from Gath and all of his people and their children crossed over Kidron Brook.

dag: Bɔ n-lee yi tiŋgban nɛli polo kanna kaman nyɔhi din kpuɣi du zuɣusaa ka mɛɛr mini firanki tulaale zim ni kɔhigɔriba ni mali tulaale zim shɛŋa zaa nyom be di ni ŋɔ?.
en: What is this coming from the desert like a column of smoke, fragrant with incense and myrrh, the incense sold by the traders?.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N wuhibu maa pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla ŋun tim ma na la dini.
en: Jesus responded, My teaching isnt mine but comes from the one who sent me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus din nyɛ Sirianim tiŋ la ni. Ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani. Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: Then David put fortresses in the city of Damascus in Aram. The Arameans became Davids servants and brought tribute to him. So the Lord gave victory to David everywhere he went.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tiri nir nyɛvili wɔɣinli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yuma ni nyɛla biɛla.
en: The fear of the LORD increases ones life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.

dag: ka o daa nya ba ka yɛli, Naawuni sansani m-bɔŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Mahanaim.
en: When he saw them, he said, This is Gods camp! So Jacob named that place Mahanaim.

dag: O daa bi tum alahichi, ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa mi daa ka o nol ni.
en: He never sinned, and he never told a lie. Isaiah :.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinunaayi ka ti daa zaŋ tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma zaa n-naai li gol so bɛ ni booni Ɛlul la biɛɣ pisinaanu dali.
en: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken days.

dag: Kpɛm sani yuli n-daa booni Ohola, ka o tizo maa mi yuli booni Oholiba. Ka n daa kpuɣi ba leei m paɣiba, ka bɛ dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bɛ yuya maa ni wuhi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ohola nyɛla Samaria, ka Oholiba mi nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The older daughter was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They became my wives, and we had children. I am using the name Oholah to mean Samaria and the name Oholibah to mean Jerusalem.

dag: Ka shɛb daa yiɣisi zani dir o shɛhira kpɛma yɛra.
en: Some stood to offer false witness against him, saying.

dag: Amaa n ni sabiri zaligu shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ bahi nyɛla zaligu palli, ka di yɛlimaŋtali yi palo Masia ni ni yi gba ni, dama zibisim kul vuurimi chana, ka neesim maŋli mi pum neei na.
en: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.

dag: Ka so yi ti bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya a nyɔɣu ni dansi ŋɔ? O ni garigi yɛli, N zo yiŋ ka n nya dansi maa.
en: But other people will say, Then what are these wounds in your hands? He will say, I was beaten in the house of my friends.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ti mi li, ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛb gba ti yiɣisina n-zaŋ li wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: This is so that the next generation and children not yet born will know these things, and so they can rise up and tell their children.

dag: Filistianim ni daa zaŋ bintɔra kɔtomsi salima din nyɛ alahichi sanyoo pini m-pahi ti ti Yawɛ la zaɣ yini daa nyɛla Ashidɔdnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gazanim dini, ka yini nyɛ Ashikɛlɔnnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gaatinim dini, ka yini mi nyɛ Ɛkurɔn nim dini.
en: In this way the Philistines sent golden models of tumors as gifts for their sins to the Lord . They sent one golden model of a tumor for each of the Philistine towns of Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli neesim maa wuntaŋ ni, ka boli zibisim maa mi yuŋ. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din daŋ tooni.
en: and he named the light Day and the darkness Night. Evening passed and morning came—that was the first day.

dag: Fɔŋ kara din daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin daŋ niriba tinsi n-nyɛ: Jɛriko mini Bɛtihɔgila ni Ɛmɛkɛziiz.
en: The cities of the clans of the Benjaminite tribe are Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz.

dag: Yɛli shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam niŋya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: A terrible and shocking thing has happened in the land of Judah.

dag: O yi ti kana, o ni wuhi dunianima alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: And when he comes, he will prove to the people of the world that they are wrong about sin and about what is right and about God's judgment.

dag: Zaŋ hal ni ʒiɛmani din pahiri buta ni, yi ni tooi deei bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: The children of the third generation born to the Edomites and Egyptians may join with the people of Israel to worship the Lord .

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim paɣila mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: Solomon made gold shields and used almost seven kilograms of gold for each one.

dag: Hɛman bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani n-daa nyɛ: Bukia mini Matania ni Uziɛl ni Shɛbuɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Hanania ni Hanani ni Ɛliata ni Gidalit ni Romamtiɛza ni Jɔshibɛkasha ni Mallɔti ni Hɔtir ni Mahaziɔt.
en: From Heman and his family: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

dag: Naa yi wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, o kpamba zaa yɛn nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials will be evil.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam zaa tumdi din tuhi chanila neesim ni ni sokam ti nya o tuma ka baŋ ni o zɔri Naawuni.
en: But anyone who follows the true way comes to the light. Then the light will show that whatever they have done was done through God.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la ni? Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma Ɛdom?.
en: Who, O God, will take me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika, ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: So , brave and strong fighters from the army of Benjamin were killed.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yuli ba ti tuui taba ni suli, ka o suhu daa lan saɣim pam bɛ ninkuunsi zuɣu, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o daa tee li ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Looking around at them with anger, deeply grieved at their unyielding hearts, he said to the man, Stretch out your hand. So he did, and his hand was made healthy.

dag: O daa nyaya ka so kani, ka di daa gar o pam o ni daa nya ka so kani ŋun ni mali yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yiko tiligi ba, ka di nasara.
en: Seeing that there was no one, and astonished that no one would intervene, Gods arm brought victory, upheld by righteousness.

dag: Dunianim ku tooi zaɣisi ya, amaa bɛ ni zaɣisi mani, n ni yɛri ni bɛ tuma bie la zuɣu.
en: The world cannot hate you. But the world hates me, because I tell the people in the world that they do evil things.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛl o, A yuli ku lan booni Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ni boonila Izraɛl, dama a mini Naawuni ni ninsalinim vaya ka a di nasara.
en: Then the man said, Your name will not be Jacob. Your name will now be Israel. I give you this name because you have fought with God and with men, and you have won.

dag: dama ti Ba Naawuni sani ti teeri yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi yurilim tuma ni yi tahima shɛli din ʒe yim ti Duuma Masia ni la yɛla.
en: This is because we remember your work that comes from faith, your effort that comes from love, and your perseverance that comes from hope in our Lord Jesus Christ in the presence of our God and Father.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhuri kpe lala paɣ maa ni. Miriya ka yi birigi dol o soli.
en: Dont let your heart lead you to an evil woman like that. Dont go where she wants to lead you.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara tila alizinnima, pa Naawuni, ka mali maliŋ ti wun shɛb bɛ ni pun bi mi. Bɛ daa lan mali wun pal shɛb bɛn na yoli yina ka nyɛ yi yaannim ni daa bi lu shɛb sizuura.
en: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to deities of which they had no knowledge— new gods only recently on the scene, ones about which your ancestors had never heard.

dag: Sagbani maa mini teeku maa ni ka bɛ zaa daa deei baptaizibu din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka zibisim titali daa zibi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni daba ata.
en: Moses raised his hand toward the sky, and there was total darkness throughout Egypt for three days.

dag: Juda ŋmanila gbuɣimbila. M bia, a ku a dima, ka ŋmaligi kpe a yiŋa. A teeg amaŋ dɔni kaman gbuɣinli la. A ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi dam a?.
en: Judah is like a lion, Killing his victim and returning to his den, Stretching out and lying down. No one dares disturb him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Zanimi piɛgul zaani n-gul piɛ shɛb bɛ ni yɛn ku ŋɔ.
en: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!.

dag: N kuhirila pampam niŋdi Yawɛ. N kul suhirila Yawɛ pampam ni o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I pray to you, Lord . I beg for mercy.

dag: Ka anabinim bɛn daa be Jɛriko maa daa chaŋ Ilaisha sani ti bɔh o, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: A group of prophets who lived there asked Elisha, Do you know that today the Lord is going to take away your master? Yes, I do, Elisha answered. But don't remind me of it.

dag: Ti Naawuni, wumma, bɛ ʒiɛm ti; chɛ ka bɛ daansarisi maa ŋmaligi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔn shɛli kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: Listen, God; we are despised! Turn their insults to us back on their heads and make them like plunder in a captive land.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali kuruwa balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ karili mini zaɣ bila yi yinsi puuni.
en: Dont have two different types of ephahs in your house, a large one and a small one.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ leei binshɛli din bie, ka mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa sani, ka nya filiŋ mini ansarisi malibo ni turi, ka noli ni di ba n ni kari ba tahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: I will bring such a disaster on them that all the nations of the world will be terrified. People will make fun of them, make jokes about them, ridicule them, and use their name as a curse everywhere I scatter them.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa gbaai mɔɣili du ni o ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ daa shiri zaŋ ba niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Then Jephthah went to the land of the Ammonites. He fought the Ammonites, and the Lord helped him defeat them.

dag: O saa nyaɣisibu neesim neeri dunia ŋɔ ni; ka dunianim nyari li ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees it and trembles!.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Di ŋubiya biŋkpam, nahu kpam bee piɛɣu kpam bee bua kpam.
en: Tell the Israelites: You must not eat the fat of an ox, sheep, or goat.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa di bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa di bi nyara.
en: They have mouths, but cannot speak, and eyes, but cannot see.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Kpiɔŋlan Naa mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ti jɛmd o? Ka ti yi suhir o, nyo bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya.
en: They think there is no need to serve God nor any advantage in praying to him.

dag: O ni daa lihi ʒiɛm o ni po pɔri shɛŋa, ka saɣim alikauli maa, ka lan zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi tuun shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zuɣu, o ku tiligi.
en: The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!.

dag: Nyini n-fa ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi. Yɛlimaŋli, a duhi ma ka n gari n dimnima; ka yihi ma duŋtaariba nuu ni.
en: and saves me from my foes. O Lord , you give me victory over my enemies and protect me from violent people.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti booi kpam maa bahi tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Then anoint the bowl and the base under it to make these things holy.

dag: Ka Aruna daa yɛli Dauda, N dana, zaŋmi li tum a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani. Naɣikɔra m-bɔŋɔ, a ni tooi kɔri ba nyo buɣim mali sara, bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi mini kaburi dari din ni mali buɣim mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Araunah said, Take whatever you want and offer your sacrifice. Here are some oxen for the sacrifice. You can use the threshing-boards and the wooden yokes for the fire.

dag: O nyari binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa, o nyɛla biŋkɔbiri zaa naa.
en: He looks down on the proudest of creatures. He is king over all the wild animals.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa tim tuumba luɣ shɛli polo Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli maa. Lala ka o daa yi pun daŋdi yɛr o n-chɛ ka o tilig omaŋ nimaani n-gari buyi.
en: Then Israels king sent word to the place the man of God had mentioned to him. Time after time, Elisha warned the king, and the king stayed on the alert.

dag: Amaa n ni niŋ a yurilim din galisi ŋɔ naani. M mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: I rely on your constant love; I will be glad, because you will rescue me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Naa Dauda tiŋ la ni nanim silisi ni, dama o daa tum tuun suma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lan tum tuun suma ti Naawuni min o jɛmbu duu.
en: He was buried among the kings in Davids City because of his exemplary service to Israel, God, and Gods temple.

dag: Chuɣu maa ni daa ti puhi yaɣi di puhibu pirigili saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba.
en: When the festival was about half finished, Jesus went to the Temple area and began to teach.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni.
en: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Naawuni zaŋ alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: Jesus drew near and said to them, I have been given all authority in heaven and on earth.

dag: Yi tamla yi yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la mini Juda nanim mini bɛ paɣiba ni yimaŋmaŋ mini yi paɣiba ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni la yɛla?.
en: Have you forgotten all the wicked things that have been done in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem by your ancestors, by the kings of Judah and their wives, and by you and your wives?.

dag: ka yipa zaŋla biɛr palli kpɛhi yi ni, Dina n-nyɛ: Biɛr pal shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ di namda la ni zaŋd omaŋmaŋ ŋmahinli n-kul lɛbigiri li zaɣ palli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ŋun Naawuni la.
en: and put on the new nature, which is renewed in knowledge by conforming to the image of the one who created it.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi ni zaŋ Abimilɛk n-leei yi naa la, yɛlimaŋli soli ka yi doli maa? Yi teei Gidiɔn yɛla, ka niŋ o malibu viɛnyɛla kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm?.
en: Now then, Jotham continued, were you really honest and sincere when you made Abimelech king? Did you respect Gideon's memory and treat his family properly, as his actions deserved?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Bɛnjamin zuliya yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Benjamin was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Yaakubu mini ba ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri saha shɛli maa, ka Reechɛl taɣ o ba piɛri paa na; dama ŋuna n-daa guli ba.
en: While he was still talking to them, Rachel came with her fathers flock since she was its shepherd.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpuɣi puri maa atam, yin pum li sɔŋ ʒiibunu n-vaai di yim zuɣu ti Firawuna, ka yi mi zaŋ di ʒiibunahi la ka yi mini yi yiŋnim ni yi bihi di, ka chɛ di shɛli zali nti biri.
en: When the crop comes in, you must give one-fifth to Pharaoh. You may keep four-fifths for yourselves, for planting fields, and for feeding yourselves, those in your households, and your children.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, O ba yi di tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni, vi naan ku gbaag o paai daba ayopɔin? Chɛ ka bɛ yih o kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ o labina.
en: The LORD said to Moses, If her father had spit in her face, would she not be shamed for seven days? Let her be shut out of the camp for seven days, and afterward she will be brought back.

dag: ka niriba daa ti gbihi maai ka o dim chaŋ ti zaŋ piriŋkpana biɛlim biri gari di ni ka chaŋ o chandi.
en: That night, while everyone was asleep, the mans enemy came and planted weeds among the wheat and then left.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi kul nya ka shɛli viɛli yi sani, dina ka n ni niŋ. Ka naa daa kana ti ʒe tiŋ maa dunoli naŋgbanyee ka tɔbbihi maa zaa daa doli tab yirina kɔbigakɔbiga ni tuhilituhili.
en: The king said to them, I will do whatever you think is best. So the king stood beside the gate as all the troops marched out by hundreds and thousands.

dag: A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Your cheeks under your veil are like slices of pomegranate.

dag: Ka daa lan zaŋ Giliad hal ni Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni n-ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba, ka kulibɔŋ maa sunsuuni nyɛ bɛ tintariga vulo zaŋ ti du Jabok, kulibɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tintariga.
en: And to the tribes of Reuben and Gad I assigned the territory from Gilead to the Arnon River. The middle of the river was their southern boundary, and their northern boundary was the Jabbok River, part of which formed the Ammonite border.

dag: Yihim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa yi biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ ku ta bɛ biɛhigu shee din nyɛ n ni be bɛ sani luɣ shɛli maa daɣiri.
en: Send all these ritually unclean people out, so that they will not defile the camp, where I live among my people.

dag: Alizanda ni nim mini dunia ni nim zaŋ tabili teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, paɣimiy o.
en: Let heaven and earth praise God, the oceans too, and all that moves within them!.

dag: O ni daa yiɣisi zani maa, ka o duh o yee suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa ni yɛli.
en: He stood up and blessed the whole Israelite assembly in a loud voice.

dag: Yi tɔbbihi tuui lu, ka yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti labi timaŋmaŋ niriba sani ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, takɔbi shɛl din kuri ti ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Your soldiers have stumbled and fallen; each one says to the other, Hurry! Let's go home to our people and escape the enemy's sword.

dag: A daa yi alizanda ni n-siɣi Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka ti ba zaligu maŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: Then you came down to Mount Sinai. You spoke to them from heaven. You gave them good laws. You gave them true teachings. You gave them laws and commands that were very good.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri yuri ku tooi ti nir nasara, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ din galisi pam la ku tooi tiligi so.
en: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zaŋ di tɛha niŋ yila pia maa suhuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun Naawuni ni pun lo shɛm. Lala zuɣu ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ yiko zaa ti biŋkɔbigu la hal ni ŋun Naawuni yɛligu ti niŋ pali.
en: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.

dag: Nandahima ni daa mali ma dahin shɛli, ka bɛ daa kana ti liri ma; amaa ka Yawɛ daa nyɛ ŋun guli ma.
en: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.

dag: Bɛn lihi ʒiɛm bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba nyɛla alahichinima, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ nandana nirilim mali alibarika.
en: Those who despise their neighbors are sinners, but happy are those who are kind to the needy.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn yɛra, Zuŋɔ bee biɛɣuni ti ni chaŋ tiŋ yaakaza nti be nimaani yuun muni n-wolindi nyari nyɔri la.
en: Pay attention, you who say, Today or tomorrow we will go to such-and-such a town. We will stay there a year, buying and selling, and making a profit.

dag: Bɛn daa pun nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa bi leei maligumaaniba maa la pɔri zuɣu, amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun daa leei maligumaana la Naawuni ni daa po pɔri yɛl o: Ti Duuma ku lan taɣ o tɛha ka po, A nyɛla maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: But Christ became a priest with Gods oath. God said to him, The Lord has made a promise with an oath and will not change his mind: You are a priest forever. Psalm :.

dag: Di zaɣisiriya tab laɣimbu naɣila yi yi ti naai noli ni yi lo noli suhi Naawuni saha shɛli, ka di nyaaŋa yin lan laɣimmiya taba, ka di chɛ ka Sintani ku tooi zahim ya yi kɔŋ maŋgbibbu puuni.
en: Dont refuse to meet each others needs unless you both agree for a short period of time to devote yourselves to prayer. Then come back together again so that Satan might not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

dag: O baŋsim puuni ka teeku daa yina, ka o daa chɛ ka saa yiri sagbana ni lurina.
en: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.

dag: Chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, ka fabilimiya, ka kuhimiya. Chɛliya ka yi lari leei kumsi, ka chɛ ka yi suhupiɛlli leei suhugarigu.
en: Be sad, be sorry, and cry! Change your laughter into crying. Change your joy into sadness.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa piligi ŋ-ŋmaari Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ bahira. Hazaɛl daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be bɛ tintarisi tinsi la ni zaa.
en: At that time the Lord began to cut away sections of Israel and give them to other nations. King Hazael of Aram defeated the Israelites on every border of Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn dol Naawuni zaligunima, ka ʒe Yisa yim la mal ania.
en: This calls for the endurance of the saints, who keep Gods commandments and keep faith with Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chibi tiŋ maa gooni voli, ka tɔbbihi zaa daa doli voli maa yi goma ayi sunsuuni yuŋ naa puu la polo hal Babilɔnnim ni daa teei gili tiŋ maa zaa la yoli. Bɛ daa zaŋ kpala Araba polo.
en: The enemy entered the city, and all the soldiers fled by night along the gate between the two walls by the royal gardens. So the Babylonians surrounded the city while the soldiers fled toward the desert plain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tibigi Naawuni n zuɣu.
en: And so they praised God because of me.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa wum ni Asiria naa yiɣisi Lakishi, ka o daa labi ti nya ka ŋun naa tuhirila Libinanima.
en: The commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish. He found him at Libnah, fighting against that city.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubiri la bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi la hal ni daba ayɔbu, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, di simdi ni yi ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di ti tumiya tuun shɛli dindali maa.
en: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord .

dag: Zaŋ kpa pal shɛli din daa do dundɔŋ ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pia la ni zaŋ kpa bɛ ni daa zaŋ kuɣa mali samban ni luɣ shɛli polo la, duri maa daa mɛmi tam taba buta zuɣu, ka yaɣ yini labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ din la tiŋli.
en: The building was three stories tall and had balconies. The -cubit inner courtyard was between the building and the Temple. On the other side, the rooms faced the pavement of the outer courtyard.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Ijipti mɔɣili la kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka pɔhim tulli ʒe na ti kpe Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka o ti pirigi li kulibombih ayopɔin m-mali soli ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋ du.
en: The LORD will split the tongue of the Egyptian sea. God will wave a hand over the Euphrates with a powerful wind and break it into seven streams so that it can be crossed in sandals.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, so ti ku lan be nimaani, amaa di ni ti kpalimla dabari. Ŋunkam ti gari Babilɔn di ni gar o, ka niŋ o alahiziba di ni wurim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: My anger will destroy Babylon, and no one will live there. Everyone who passes by will be shocked to see what has happened.

dag: Gbib a suhu n-gari binshɛɣukam, dama di ni ka nyɛvili bilisiri yirina.
en: More than anything you guard, protect your mind, for life flows from it.

dag: Amaa o ni daa zaŋ li yɛl o ba min o biɛyanim maa, o ba daa tahila o zuɣu ka bɔh o, Zahim bɔ ka a lee zahim maa? M min a ma ni a biɛyanim ŋɔ shiri ti yɛn damdila a tooni.
en: When he told his father about this dream, his father became angry and said, What's that supposed to mean? Are your mother and I and your brothers all going to come and bow down to you.

dag: ka lan laɣim nyu binnyur yini; dama Naawuni ni daa ti ba kuɣ shɛli ka di doli ba la kom ka bɛ daa nyura. Masia mi n-daa nyɛ kuɣili maa.
en: and they all drank the same spiritual drink. They drank from that spiritual rock that was with them, and that rock was Christ.

dag: Yi bi yɛli ni di kpalim chira anahi ni puu atam kpuɣibu? Amaa n yɛri ya mi, kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi puri ni, di daatam maa biya zaa, ka di kpalimla chɛbu.
en: Dont you have a saying, Four more months and then its time for harvest? Look, I tell you: open your eyes and notice that the fields are already ripe for the harvest.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi ku mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛli n-tum alahichi. Di maliya li ŋmahindi bin lɔɣu bee bin nyaŋ.
en: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani mini ti kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-kul be ti sani n-sɔŋdi ti ti muɣisigu saha.
en: God is our refuge and strength, a help always near in times of great trouble.

dag: Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka kanya n sanna. Wummiya n yɛligu, ka tiligi. N ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛli din ku yiɣisi, ka niŋ ya nirilim shɛli n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni niŋ Dauda la.
en: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Amnɔn daa kul lan je Tama yɛlli zaa, hal ka o ni daa je o shɛm maa gar o ni daa yur o shɛm la gba. Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim yi.
en: But then Amnon felt intense hatred for her. In fact, his hatred for her was greater than the love he had felt for her. So Amnon told her, Get out of here.

dag: Bɛn daa ŋubi bɛ sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ka nyu bɛ sara maligu wain la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ya, chɛ ka bɛ guli ya.
en: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?.

dag: M-pahi Bɛɔr bia Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ baɣa, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔb ku o pahi bɛ ni daa pun ku shɛb zuɣu la.
en: In addition to those others slain, the Israelites killed the fortune-teller Balaam, Beors son, with the sword.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa boli Dauda na ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka zaŋ o tahi Sool sani, ka Dauda ti lan be o sani kaman o ni daa yi pun be o sani shɛm la.
en: Jonathan went to David and told him what Saul had said. Then he brought David to Saul, and David served in Saul's army just as he had done before.

dag: O daa yɛli Asha zuliya mi: Asha bidibisi mali alibarika pam. Chɛ ka bɛ mabihi zaa yuri ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ naba siɣi kpam ni.
en: The Lord 's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil.

dag: Dama Yawɛ zali biɛri bɔhibu dabisili. O mi ni bɔhi biɛri maa ti Ziɔn.
en: This is the time when the Lord will rescue Zion and take vengeance on her enemies.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nyina ŋmanila takɔbiri, ka ŋmani suhi, bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku faranim dunia ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku nandaamba daadamnim sunsuuni.
en: others are so greedy that they gobble up the poor and homeless.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Faashee ka a po. Ka Iso daa shiri po, ka zaŋ o kpamdi maa ti Yaakubu.
en: But Jacob said, Promise me your birthrights, here and now! And that's what Esau did.

dag: Dindali maa, di simdi ka naa ti bo naɣila polli m-mali sara o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o nuu pa teeku zuɣu; ka chɛ ka o zaŋ o nudirigu pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: I will put him in charge of the sea. He will control the rivers.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, dama di gbaari ma! A zabiri yirigirimi kaman buhi ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Turn your eyes away from me; they are holding me captive. Your hair dances like a flock of goats bounding down the hills of Gilead.

dag: Dama so yi nyɛla ŋun wumdila yɛligu maa kɔŋko, ka pa ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, o ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi diɣi ni n-nya o ninni m-baŋ omaŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Those who hear but dont do the word are like those who look at their faces in a mirror.

dag: Sokam zaa pin shɛŋa din be kasi nyɛla o ni su shɛli, ka so yi zaŋ binshɛli na ti ti maligumaana, di nyɛla ŋun maligumaana maa dini.
en: Each priest may keep the gifts he receives. Every gift given to a priest belongs to that priest.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla nyini ŋun nyɛ n kpee ni m mini ŋun doli ni n zo simo.
en: But it is you, my companion, my colleague and close friend.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na nti yɛli ba, Yi daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa yi ninni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa niŋ Firawuna min o sapashinnim ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa shɛm.
en: Moses called together all the Israelites. He said to them, You saw everything the Lord did in the land of Egypt. You saw what he did to Pharaoh, to Pharaohs officers, and to his whole country.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Alɔbo ni yi nuzaa polo na ti lu tiŋgbani maa ni niriba zaa zuɣu.
en: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, A yi ku yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu hal baabiɛla, nyin di niŋ alibarika gba niŋ bɛ ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Balak shouted, If you're not going to curse Israel, then at least don't bless them.

dag: Tinzunnim ni kana ti me yi goma tin ya, ka bɛ nanim jɛm ya. N daa yiɣisila n suhu bahi yi zuɣu n-darigi yi tibili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in my rage I struck you down, in my favor I have consoled you.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nuu din mali jilima n-gbaai Musa nudirigu chana, ka daa chɛ ka kom din do bɛ tooni pirigi ni o zali yuli din ku kpi ti omaŋa.
en: He was by Moses side and led him with his wonderful hand. He divided the water, so that the people could walk through the sea. He made his name famous by doing those great things.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka di daa muɣisi Dauda pam, o ni daa ŋmaai Sool binyɛrigu maa zuɣu.
en: Later, David felt bad about what he did.

dag: Izar bidibisi ni, Shɛlomit n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Kohath's second son, Izhar, had a son, Shelomith, the head of the clan.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ gabisi maa vo Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni yihina. Ka Jɛrimia daa kpalim be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni.
en: The men pulled Jeremiah up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah stayed under guard in the courtyard of the guardhouse.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli ba, Pa yi ni chani tin shɛli maa soli m-bɔŋɔ; pa yi mi ni chani tin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ. Doliya ma ka n zaŋ ya tahi yi ni bɔri so maa sani. Ka o daa zaŋ ba tahi Samaria.
en: Then Elisha went to them and said, You are on the wrong road; this is not the town you are looking for. Follow me, and I will lead you to the man you are after. And he led them to Samaria.

dag: Di boliya so yi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, dama Naawuni yino ŋun bɛ alizanda ni ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ yi ba.
en: And you must not call anyone here on earth Father, because you have only the one Father in heaven.

dag: Amaa o daa dolila Izraɛl nanim biɛhigu. Hal o daa zaŋla kuriti m-mali Baal binnana zali.
en: and was as sinful as the kings of Israel. He made idols of the god Baal.

dag: Ka Ahishar nyɛ ŋun su nayili fukumsi. Ka Abida bia Adɔniram mi nyɛ bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma zuɣulana.
en: Ahishar, who was in charge of the palace; and Adoniram, Abdas son, who was supervisor of the work gangs.

dag: Ka daa yihi niriba maa ni bɔri do so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu o duŋ taabu min o ninvuɣ kubo zuɣu la bahi, ka zaŋ Yisa ti ba ni bɛ niŋ o bɛ ni bɔri shɛm.
en: He freed the man who was in jail for rioting and murder, because he was the one the crowd wanted to be set free. Then Pilate handed Jesus over for them to do what they wanted with him.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, A yi ti labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛlli ŋɔ. Ka daa lan yɛli, Sokam zaa, wummiya.
en: Micaiah said, If you do come back, I was wrong about what the Lord wanted me to say. Then he told the crowd, Don't forget what I said.

dag: Bɛ wahala maa puuni ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: Then they called to the Lord for help, and he saved them from their troubles.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi chana.
en: Jesus went through the wheat fields on the Sabbath. As the disciples made their way, they were picking the heads of wheat.

dag: Ka gooni maa yi ti lu, bɛ ni bɔhi ya, Yi ni daa zaŋ binshɛli paligi li la lee be ya? .
en: The wall will collapse, and everyone will ask you what good the whitewash did.

dag: Man Yawɛ m-bol a wuntitali puuni. Mani n-gbaag a nuu ni ka gbib a. N zaŋ a mi lo niriba alikauli, ni a nyɛ zuliya kam neesim.
en: I, the LORD, have called you for a good reason. I will grasp your hand and guard you, and give you as a covenant to the people, as a light to the nations.

dag: Dinzuɣu piimiya dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la ni niriba.
en: Now choose twelve men, one from each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ahazia daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi nira saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa; o daa di nam la maa yuun yini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Izraɛl Naa Omri yaaŋa, ka o yuli booni Atalia.
en: at the age of twenty-two, and he ruled in Jerusalem for one year. His mother was Athaliah, the daughter of King Ahab and granddaughter of King Omri of Israel.

dag: N lo n suhu ni ni n ni dol a zaligunim maa sahakam.
en: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, niriba yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kanna. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ka lo tɔbu n-yi katiŋ damdi dunia ŋɔ bɔba ni yaɣa ni.
en: The Lord said, Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.

dag: M biyurisi, pa zaligu palli ka n sabiri tiri ya, amaa di nyɛla zaligu kur shɛli yi ni daa pun mali piligu ni ha la. Zaligu kurili maa nyɛla yi ni daa pun wum yɛligu shɛl la yɛla.
en: My dear friends, this command I am writing you is not new; it is the old command, the one you have had from the very beginning. The old command is the message you have already heard.

dag: Suhu ni zaɣ biɛɣu lɔbu, ni ŋun kul zɔri yomyom chani zaɣ biɛɣ tumbu.
en: a heart set on wicked plans, feet that run quickly to evil.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim daa yɛli Midian kpamba, Salo ni gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni naai binshɛlikam din gili ti zaa kaman naɣilaa ni ŋubiri mɔri mɔɣu ni shɛm la. Zipɔr bia Balak n-daa nyɛ Mɔab naa di saha maa.
en: The king of Moab said to the leaders of Midian, This large group of people will destroy everything around us, the way an ox eats all the grass in a field. Balak son of Zippor was the king of Moab at this time.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, o gba ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi ŋɔ, hal ka ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa din gari dimbɔŋɔnima, dama n chanila m Ba maa sani.
en: I can assure you that whoever believes in me will do the same things I have done. And they will do even greater things than I have done, because I am going to the Father.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yir o nyɛvoya ni na, ka buɣimniɛm din diri binyɛra yir o nol ni na; ka sala buɣimniɛm yir o sanna.
en: Smoke went up from Gods nostrils; out of his mouth came a devouring fire; flaming coals blazed out in front of him!.

dag: Di daanabinim baɣa ka shɛli ni, ka nyɛ bɛn ka yɛda. Ka di maligumaaniba saɣim binshɛŋa din be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛn birigi zaligu.
en: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.

dag: Ka anabi Ilaija daa sabi gbaŋ ti o na yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A bi dol a ba Jɛhɔshafat soli bee n-doli Juda Naa Asa naba.
en: Jehoram received this message from Elijah the prophet: This is what the Lord , the God your father David followed, says, Jehoram, you have not lived the way your father Jehoshaphat lived. You have not lived the way King Asa of Judah lived.

dag: lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun yɔhim o kpee ka yɛli, N diɛmdimi.
en: are those who deceive their neighbor and say, Hey, I was only joking.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, Di nyɛla din ni dini? Ka Yisa yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma;.
en: Which ones? the man asked. Jesus answered, Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.

dag: Bɛ ni so nini ku nya li, naɣila Jɛfune ŋun nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua, dama bɛn doli man Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Only Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun really followed the Lord .

dag: Jɔshua ni daa kul zaŋ kpan la tiri Ai, o daa bi zaŋ o nuu siɣisi tiŋ hal ka bɛ ti ku Ainim maa zaa.
en: Joshua had held his spear toward Ai as a sign to his people to destroy the city. And he did not stop until all the people of Ai were destroyed.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri naa nam dibu yuma ayopɔin la ni gol so ŋun pahir anu ni ka o daa paai Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka po pɔri yɛli ma ni n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ, ni n ku kpe tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su la ni.
en: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ Daadam Bia gba dabisili dali.
en: When the Son of Man comes, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa ŋub maa zaɣ chɛhi pali piɛri pinaayi.
