en: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves that had been left over by those who had eaten.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa tuɣindi tulaale zim kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba la ni daa niŋdi shɛm la. Bɛ daa tum tuumbiɛri pam n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi;.
en: They burned incense there in all those places for worship. They did these things like the nations that the Lord forced out of the land before them. The Israelites did evil things that made the Lord angry.

dag: Ka o daa zani paɣ maa zuɣusaa n-tahi dɔro maa zuɣu, ka paɣ maa niŋgbun biisim maa maai, ka o dii yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: He stood very close to her and ordered the sickness to go away. The sickness left her, and she got up and began serving them.

dag: N kɔre lan ka di zaa ni, di nyɛla bindir shɛŋa din bi luhi n kpaɣa.
en: I have no appetite for food like that, and everything I eat makes me sick.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ti Izraɛlnima. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanu ni kɔbiga dindali maa; ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: The Lord gave Israel victory over the army of Benjamin. The Israelites killed , of the enemy that day.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul tɔŋdi pahiri Naa Darius nam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ tabili Naa Sairus ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia nir la gba nam ʒiɛman ni.
en: And so Daniel was made prosperous during the rule of Darius and during the rule of Cyrus the Persian.

dag: ni sabisigu ni yuɣu ni baandɔɣu ni bankalansilli ni gumachuɣu.
en: geckos, crocodiles, lizards, sand reptiles, and chameleons.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl bila Yawɛ sani. O ni lan zaŋ Mɔabnim niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: And Elisha continued, But this is an easy thing for the Lord to do; he will also give you victory over the Moabites.

dag: Wummi saɣisigu ka deei wuhibu din ni chɛ ka a ti mali yɛm dahin shɛli.
en: Listen to advice and accept discipline; then you, too, will become wise.

dag: Nyama, n nini nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka n tiba wum, ka m baŋ di gbinni.
en: I know and understand every bit of this.

dag: N tim ba la ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi Naawuni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi pam sani. N tim ba mi ni bɛ ti di bɛ nɛma, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba kaman soli zuɣu taŋkpaɣu la.
en: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kul kuhiri boona, di chɛ ka n di vi. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri di vi; chɛ ka bɛ fo baalim n-chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Lord , I am praying to you. Dont let me be disappointed. The wicked are the ones who should be disappointed. Let them go to the grave in silence.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka m bɔhi biɛri. N chɛ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim pa tampiŋ maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: I put her blood on the bare rock so that it would not be covered. I did this so that people would become angry and punish her for killing innocent people.

dag: Paɣiba bɛn zaa be naa nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima. Bɛ ni yɛli, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa tim ti boli Napaɣ Vashiti ni o kana ka o zaɣisi.
en: Every woman in the empire will start looking down on her husband as soon as she hears what the queen has done. They'll say, King Xerxes commanded Queen Vashti to come to him, and she refused.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla yim, dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, O kurila ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: Its all the same; therefore, I say God destroys the blameless and the sinners.

dag: Amaa yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa nyɛla zoya mini vinvama tiŋgbɔŋ, ka saa miri nimaani.
en: No, the land you are entering to possess is a land of hills and valleys, where your drinking water will be rain from heaven.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira, ka ti Duuma Yisa ni ti zaŋ o vuhim pɔhim din yir o nol ni na ku o ka bah o yoli, ŋun Yisa palo yibu dali o labbuna saha.
en: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.

dag: Di saha maa ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim zaa daa laɣim kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ bɛ tantinim ti kpa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: Some time later, all the Midianites, Amalekites, and other easterners joined together, came over, and set up camp in the Jezreel Valley.

dag: Miri ka a fiɣisi dabili o dan sani, di yi niŋ lala dabili maa ni tu a, ka a leei ŋun mali taali.
en: Dont slander a servant to his master; otherwise, the servant will curse you, and you will be guilty.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai o daa chaŋla Kapɛrinium.
en: After Jesus had finished teaching the people, he went to Capernaum.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, a zaɣis o, ka mal o ansarisi; a suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a ninvuɣ gahindili zuɣu.
en: But you are angry with your chosen king; you have deserted and rejected him.

dag: Ka o daa lihi bɛn ʒi o sani maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Looking around at those seated around him in a circle, he said, Look, here are my mother and my brothers.

dag: Yi goma mɛbu dabisili kanna. Dindali maa yi tintarisi ni ti yɛligi pam pahi.
en: The time will come when your walls will be rebuilt. At that time the country will grow.

dag: N ni saɣim o wain tihi min o fiig tihi pu shɛli o ni yɛra, M mamanim ni zaŋ shɛli yo ma samli m-bɔŋɔ la. N ni zaŋ li leei yɔɣuni, ka yɔɣuni biŋkɔbiri ŋubi di zaa.
en: I will destroy her grapevines and her fig trees, which she said her lovers gave her for serving them. I will turn her vineyards and orchards into a wilderness; wild animals will destroy them.

dag: Yuria paɣa Batishiiba ni daa wum ni o yidan kpiya, o daa kum o zuɣu.
en: Bathsheba heard that her husband Uriah had died, so she mourned for him.

dag: N ni daa deei shɛli n Duuma san la, dina ka m mali wuhiri ya ŋɔ: Dahin shɛli yuŋ bɛ ni daa yi ti Duuma nyaaŋa la, ka o daa kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro.
en: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.

dag: Dama Naawuni pala gutula ŋun ni lihi yaɣi yi tuma zuɣu bee n-lihi yaɣi yurilim shɛli yi ni wuhir o ka sɔŋdi ŋun Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda hal ka na kul niŋdi lala hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ li chaŋ a niriba bɛn be tinzun tinsi ni la sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi wum li bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: Then go to the people of your nation who are in exile and tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to them, whether they pay attention to you or not.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ninivenim daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda ka yɛli ni sokam lom noli, ka wɔɣira zaŋ tabili tarimba zaa daa so buri.
en: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka zuɣusaa ŋari ka saa bi lan mira, ka binshɛɣukam kɔŋ niŋbu.
en: Therefore, the skies above you have withheld the dew, and the earth has withheld its produce because of you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, A deemba Jɛtro min a paɣa ni a bidibis ayi la kanna.
en: Jethro sent a message to Moses that said, This is your father-in-law Jethro. I am bringing your wife and her two sons to you.

dag: Ka Barak yɛli Dɛbɔra, A yi ni doli ma chaŋ, n ni chaŋ; amaa a yi ku doli ma chaŋ, dindina n gba ku chaŋ.
en: Then Barak said to Deborah, I will go and do this if you will go with me. But if you will not go with me, I will not go.

dag: Yawɛ, Garigim ma, garigim ma din ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ baŋ ni nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri labis a sanna.
en: Answer me, LORD! Answer me so that this people will know that you, LORD, are the real God and that you can change their hearts.

dag: So ka pɔhim yiko din ni tooi gooi li, so mi ka kum dabisili yiko. So ku tooi lɔrigi kpara sɔŋ tɔbu tuhibu saha. Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma gba ku tooi tiligi ŋun tumdi li.
en: No one has the power to keep their spirit from leaving or to stop their death. During war, no soldier has the freedom to go wherever he wants. In the same way evil does not allow anyone who does wrong to go free.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛl o, ka o yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir yɛl la. O daa yɛliya, Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl niŋgbuŋ Jɛziriil tintariga;.
en: They went back and reported this to Jehu. He said, This is the LORDs word spoken through his servant Elijah from Tishbe: Dogs will devour Jezebels flesh in the area of Jezreel.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zaŋ a leei zuliya pam yaba. Dinzuɣu alikauli maa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa niŋ Naawuni so yɛda maa sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa din kani be.
en: As it is written: I have appointed you to be the father of many nations. So Abraham is our father in the eyes of God in whom he had faith, the God who gives life to the dead and calls things that dont exist into existence.

dag: Yi lihi ʒiɛm m binshɛŋa din be kasi la, ka bi tiri n vuhim dabisa jilima.
en: You hate all that I consider holy. You treat my special days of rest as if they are not important.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anabinim la ni yino.
en: The disciples answered, Some say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah. Others say you are one of the prophets.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu maa mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ tari salo maa.
en: He took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, blessed them, and broke them and gave them to the disciples to set before the crowd.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa pii Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili vinvamli polo maa n-daa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo. Bɛ ni daa woligi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself and moved away toward the east. That is how the two men parted.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba pirigibu balibu buyi bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni maa zaa daa mali hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka zuɣulaannim pirigili daa be n sani.
en: So both the groups that were giving thanks to God reached the Temple area. In addition to the leaders who were with me.

dag: Ka Lɔt ŋun daa doli Ibram maa gba daa mali biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni tantinima.
en: Lot, who was traveling with him, also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and slaves.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, wummi dimbɔŋɔ, zanimi tɛhi Naawuni daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: Hear this, Job; stop and ponder Gods mighty deeds.

dag: A mi ni a nyɛla zoomba sowuhira mini bɛn be zibisim ni firila.
en: You think you are a guide for people who dont know the right way, a light for those who are in the dark.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ya, Ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda ansarisi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri soli ni ti beni.
en: They told you, In the last times there will be people who laugh at God and do only what they want to do—things that are against God.

dag: N dabili Musa kpiya, dinzuɣu a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa yiɣisim pumpɔŋɔ n-chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yinim Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni.
en: My servant Moses is dead. Now you and all these people must go across the Jordan River. You must go into the land I am giving to the Israelites.

dag: Ka Uzia daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nanim gbala ni m-baɣil o yaannima, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi ni o nyɛla kɔŋlana. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Uzziah died and was buried with his ancestors in a field belonging to the kings, because people said, He had skin disease. His son Jotham succeeded him as king.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ ni so bee bɛ dɔɣiriba yi shihi kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi bee bɛ yi gomi chaŋ katiŋa, bɛ ni tooi puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: Tell the Israelites: When any of you or your descendants are unclean from contact with a corpse or are on a long trip, they may still keep the Passover to the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Yihimila Barabas bahi, ka ku doo ŋɔ.
en: But the whole crowd shouted, Kill Jesus! Give us Barabbas.

dag: Di zaɣisiriya tab laɣimbu naɣila yi yi ti naai noli ni yi lo noli suhi Naawuni saha shɛli, ka di nyaaŋa yin lan laɣimmiya taba, ka di chɛ ka Sintani ku tooi zahim ya yi kɔŋ maŋgbibbu puuni.
en: Dont refuse to give your bodies to each other. But you might both agree to stay away from sex for a while so that you can give your time to prayer. Then come together again so that Satan will not be able to tempt you in your weakness.

dag: O yaar o noli n-tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka nirilim niŋbu wuhibu be o noli ni.
en: She speaks with wisdom and teaches others to be loving and kind.

dag: Ŋun daa pah anii n-su chira anii ni n-daa nyɛ Sibɛkai ŋun daa yi Husha na ka nyɛ Zɛra daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The eighth for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite from the Zerahites. His division numbered .

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni tooi niŋ suhukpeeni yɛli: N Duuma nyɛla n sɔŋda; n ku zo dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma.
en: Let us be bold, then, and say, The Lord is my helper, I will not be afraid. What can anyone do to me.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n ni teei n nuu chɛ ka alɔbo lu a min a niriba zaa zuɣu n-naai yi balibu zaa dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: If I had raised my hand to strike you and your people with disease, you would have been completely destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya kam kpamba: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses spoke with all the leaders of the Israelite tribes and told them about these commands from the Lord :.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Libina mini Ɛta ni Ashan.
en: The people of Judah also got these towns: Libnah, Ether, Ashan.

dag: N sɔŋsim yirila Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ sanna.
en: My help will come from the Lord , who made heaven and earth.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni yi di ti birigi.
en: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.

dag: Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl Jɛziriil tintariga, ka so ku sɔɣ o. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka anab maa daa yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi.
en: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury. Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.

dag: O suhu kpɛmmi kaman kuɣili la, di kpɛmmi kaman nɛli la.
en: His heart is solid like a rock, hard like a lower millstone.

dag: Paɣipiɛl so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl. Di gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni be ti sani.
en: A virgin will become pregnant and have a son, and he will be called Immanuel .

dag: ni o ti darigi bɛn bi mi Naawuni mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ti Duuma Yisa lahibal suŋ wumbu la tibili.
en: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka neesim shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa zaa niŋ liɣa a zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zibigi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: As for the shining lights of the heavens, I will make them dark over you, and set darkness over your land. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Zaŋm daba ayopɔin mali alahichi sanyoo sara, sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini maa leei din be kasi zaa. Ka binshɛɣukam yi ti shihi sara maligu bimbini maa, di ni leei din be kasi.
en: You will make the altar pure and holy for seven days. At that time the altar will be most holy. Anything that touches the altar will also be holy.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya niriba ni o nyaandoliba n-kana ti zu n-yih o yuŋ saha shɛli yi ni daa ʒeei gom.
en: They told them, Say that Jesus disciples came at night and stole his body while you were sleeping.

dag: Ti leela ti ʒiʒiinitab ni maani shɛb ansarisi, ka leei bɛn gili ti ni maani shɛb ansarisi ka lari ti.
en: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.

dag: Din kariya, ka n yɛli ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli. Ka pa ni n kpimi, n kul ku bahi n nimmaŋtali maa.
en: You will never hear me say you men are right! Until the day I die I will not be untrue to myself.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma dakuɣiri maa pam ti ma, dama n ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi pam ka viɛla.
en: to prepare plenty of timber for me, because the temple that I am about to build will be magnificent and amazing.

dag: Luk ŋun nyɛ dɔɣite so ti ni yuri la mini Diimas gba puhiri ya.
en: Luke, the dearly loved physician, and Demas say hello.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni zab o niriba zuɣu. O ni zo o daba nambɔɣu.
en: The LORD gives justice to his people and has compassion on those who serve him.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na. .
en: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Naawuni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla yi dini.
en: Everything in Israel that has been unconditionally dedicated to me belongs to you.

dag: O niŋdila o yidana din viɛla o biɛhigu ni zaa, ka pa ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: She does good for her husband all her life. She never causes him trouble.

dag: di bahi bamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre daɣiri tuma soli ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu la. Karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ nyɛla suhukpeendaannima ni bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa. Bɛ bi zɔri ni bɛ tu bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la, amaa ka naɣ lee ʒiɛmdi ba mi.
en: This is especially true for those who follow after the corrupt cravings of the sinful nature and defy the Lords authority. These reckless, brash people arent afraid to insult the glorious ones.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋdi kaman yi ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ niŋdi shɛm la. Ka miriya ka yi ti niŋdi kaman n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kulisi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ŋɔ nim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Miriya ka yi ti niŋ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.

dag: Amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku ka n sanna ti nya nyɛvili.
en: Yet you are not willing to come to me in order to have life.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niŋ wain n-ti ti ba maa ka o nyu, ka ti chɛ ka o zaŋ ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: Come on, let's get our father drunk, so that we can sleep with him and have children by him.

dag: Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: It was almost time for the Passover Festival, so Jesus went to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o ni tooi be tiŋ maa ni hal ka bɛ ti kar o saria palɔni, ka o na kul ni be nimaani hal ni maligumaaniba zuɣulaan so ŋun beni ka o tum tuuni maa kum nyaaŋa, di saha ka o naanyi tooi lab o ya din nyɛ o ni daa zo luɣ shɛli maa ti beni.
en: The killer will live in that city until there can be a trial before the community or until the death of the one who is high priest at that time. Then the killer may return home, back to the city from which the flight began.

dag: Ti lan suhiri ti Duuma ni o chɛ ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab mini sokam zaa sani zooi pahi kaman ti gba yurilim ni galisi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani shɛm la.
en: May the Lord cause you to increase and enrich your love for each other and for everyone in the same way as we also love you.

dag: Yawɛ niŋ o ni daa lo ni o niŋ shɛl la; o niŋ o ni daa yɛli kurimbuni ha ni o ni niŋ shɛl la. O wurim a ka bi lan zo a nambɔɣu. O chɛ ka a dimnim mali suhupiɛlli a zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a dimnim maa nya yaa.
en: The Lord did what he planned to do. He did what he said he would do. He did what he commanded a long time ago. He destroyed, and he had no pity. He made your enemies happy because of what happened to you. He made your enemies strong.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, Ka a luɣ shɛli ka galimi.
en: My darling, you are beautiful all over. Every part of you is perfect.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni chɛ ka a dɔɣi bihi, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam. Ka n ti chɛ ka zuliya gbaliŋ yi a zuliya maa ni na, ka n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam. .
en: and promised, I will give you a large family with many descendants that will grow into a nation. And I am giving you this land that will belong to you and your family forever.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma. Bɛ daa tuui lu ka kɔŋ ŋun ni sɔŋ ba.
en: They were worn out from hard work; they would fall down, and no one would help.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni shɛb nyɛla bɛn doli yɛŋkiŋkabina soli n-kpɛri yiya ni ti liriti paɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhimbu bi to, ka lan nyɛ bɛn daalahichi taali muɣisiri ba ka kɔre balibu kam mali ba niŋdi di yubu la.
en: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ lala n-yiɣisi chaŋ Shilo nti chaŋ Ahija yiŋa. Di saha maa Ahija ni daa kurigi zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina niŋla liti ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Jeroboams wife did precisely this. She left and went to Shiloh and came to Ahijahs house. Now Ahijah had become blind in his old age.

dag: Ti mini ti yaannim zaa tum alahichi. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri, ka tum tuumbiɛri.
en: We have sinned—right along with our ancestors. Weve done what is wrong. Weve acted wickedly.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Miriya ka yi tumdi yi wuntia tuma ni niriba nyari ya m-paɣiri ya di zuɣu; yi yi niŋdi lala, yi ku nya laara yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: Be careful that you dont practice your religion in front of people to draw their attention. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo mini suhusaɣiŋgu ni birimbu lu yi zuɣu yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛlikam puuni hal ka yi ti kpi yomyom naai zaa yi tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, dama yi zaɣisi ma.
en: The LORD will send calamity, confusion, and frustration on you no matter what work you are doing until you are wiped out and until you disappear—itll be quick!—because of the evil acts by which you have abandoned him.

dag: Chɛ ka di zambu ʒi Jɔab min o ba daŋ zuɣu. Chɛ ka Jɔab daŋ ni kul ku kɔŋ ʒim ni yiri ninvuɣ so ni bee niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali so bee do so ŋun miri gumdi bee bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee ninvuɣ so ŋun kpiri kum.
en: May it fall upon the head of Joab and his entire family tree! May Joabs family never be without someone with a discharge or a skin disease, someone who uses a crutch, someone who dies by the sword, or someone who is hungry.

dag: N ni daa kul suhiri Naawuni maa, ka Gabirɛl ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pun nya do so tuuli ʒii la ni la daa yiɣi ka n ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa na. Zaawuni sara maligu saha n-daa nyɛ li.
en: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a ʒe katiŋa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a sɔɣ amaŋ yɛlimuɣisira saha?.
en: Why do you stand so far away, LORD, hiding yourself in troubling times?.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa lan kpuɣi daanya pam Bɛta mini Bɛrɔtai din daa nyɛ Hadadɛza ni su fɔntin shɛŋa la ni.
en: King David also took a large amount of bronze from Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer.

dag: Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya. Yi yi ku kana n ni kana kaman buɣim la nti lu Yisifu zuliya zuɣu. Ka buɣim maa ni di Bɛtɛlnima, ka so kani n-ni kpihi li.
en: Seek the LORD and live, or else God might rush like a fire against the house of Joseph. The fire will burn up Bethel, with no one to put it out.

dag: Ka n lan chɛ ka tins ayi bee tins ata niriba chani tin yin ni ni bɛ ti nya kom nyu, ka bɛ yi chaŋ, bɛ ti bi nyari nyuri ka di saɣiri ba; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Weak with thirst, the people of several cities went to a city where they hoped to find water, but there was not enough to drink. Still you did not come back to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlli ŋɔ puuni, so miri ka o tum o kpee din bi tuhi bee ŋ-ŋar o kpee. Ti daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka na kul kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ni ti Duuma ni darigi bɛn tumdi din bi tuhi ŋɔ tatabo tibili.
en: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.

dag: ka yɛli a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba, ka yɛli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla yuŋ.
en: to proclaim your loyal love in the morning, your faithfulness at nighttime.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ma, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu; di saha n suhu daa paligiya pam!.
en: I was happy when the people said, Let us go to the Lord s Temple.

dag: nti yɛl o paɣ Zɛrɛshi min o zɔnim la zaa dinkam niŋ o. Di saha ka o yɛndaannim la min o paɣ Zɛrɛshi yɛl o, A mini Mɔdɛkai so ŋun kpa tab ŋɔ ni nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu, o pilig a la luhibu maa. A kul ku tooi nyaŋ o, amaa ŋuna n-naɣ ni nyaŋ a.
en: Haman told his wife and friends what had happened. Then his wife and his advisors said, If Mordecai is a Jew, this is just the beginning of your troubles! You will end up a ruined man.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee na ti di ba ka bɛ kpi Yawɛ tooni.
en: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.

dag: A yi zaŋ n ni wuh a shɛli ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la, a ni niŋ Yisa Masia tumtumdi suŋ, a ni zaŋ yɛda niŋbu yɛtɔɣa mini wuhibu suŋ shɛli a ni pun dol la n-dih amaŋ la zuɣu.
en: Tell this to the brothers and sisters there. This will show that you are a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show that you are made strong by the words of faith and good teaching you have followed.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti yo ba li bɛ nyɛviya ni, ka bɛ wula ti ku maha.
en: Before their branch is formed, before it is green.

dag: Bɛ tɛhirila bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni tamiya. O ŋmaligila o nini bahi kpaŋa, o kul ku nya li sahakam.
en: The wicked think to themselves: God has forgotten. God has hidden his face. God never sees anything!.

dag: Zuɣusaa, gbilisim tibili wum ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani wum n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Heaven! Pay attention and I will speak; Earth! Listen to the words of my mouth.

dag: ka wuhiri ba ni bɛ doli n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la. Nyamiya, n kul ni be yi sani sahakam hal ti paai dunia yiɣisibu dali.
en: and teach them to obey everything I have commanded you. And I will be with you always, to the end of the age.

dag: Dindali maa, Izraɛlnim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka kɔɣisi yi fini zaa.
en: The Lord said, A day is coming when Israel's greatness will come to an end, and its wealth will be replaced by poverty.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ shɛɣuni, ka Bɛnhadad laɣim Siria tɔbbihi n-chaŋ Afɛk ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: The following spring he called up his men and marched with them to the city of Aphek to attack the Israelites.

dag: O ni daa kum o yidan kuli maa naai, ka Dauda daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o kul o yiŋ na ka o ti zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa ka Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: Then after the time for mourning was over, David sent someone to bring her to the palace. She became David's wife, and they had a son. The Lord was angry because of what David had done.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ni ti nya ka vi gbahi ba ka bɛ yaa zaa naai, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi tabi bɛ noya, ka bɛ tiba ti kpiri.
en: The nations will see those miracles, and they will be ashamed. They will see that their power is nothing compared to mine. They will be amazed and put their hands over their mouths. They will cover their ears and refuse to listen.

dag: Kul di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia chɛ ka yi zaŋ yimaŋ dalim Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yawɛ shiri ni fa ti bahi, ka Asiria naa ku tooi ŋme n-fa tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: Dont listen to him when he tells you to trust in the Lord . Dont believe him when he says, The Lord will save us. He will not let the king of Assyria defeat the city.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu siɣi Naa sol zuɣu na, ka o be o yiŋ tahira, ka Dauda daa yaa ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm dabisili kam la, ka Sool daa gbib o kpani o nuu ni;.
en: The next day an evil spirit from God came over Saul, and he acted like he was in a prophetic frenzy in his house. So David played the lyre as he usually did. Saul had a spear in his hand.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ kulipalinima bɛn labiri ziŋgɔhi mini bɛn mali yilima bee nɛri gbahiri zahim Nail Mɔɣili maa ni ni ti fabili.
en: Everyone who earns a living by fishing in the Nile will groan and cry; their hooks and their nets will be useless.

dag: Dama o daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ o sɔŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I sent him to terrify people all over the earth. But he and his army will be killed and buried alongside other godless soldiers in the world of the dead. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Nyama, n kpahi n nuhi bah a zuɣu a ni zaŋ zalinsi soya nya bun shɛŋa maa min a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb a ni la zuɣu.
en: I now strike my hands over your ill-gotten gain and blood thats been shed in you.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi yuntisuɣu n-kpuɣi man a dab paɣ ŋɔ bia ŋun do m-baɣi maa nti sɔŋ o tooni, ka zaŋ o bi kpiŋ maa na nti sɔŋ n tooni saha shɛli n ni daa gbihira.
en: That night while I was asleep, she took my son from my bed and carried him to her bed. Then she put the dead baby in my bed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaligu kundi la n-gili Juda fɔntinsi ni zaa wuhi niriba.
en: They taught throughout Judah. They brought with them the LORDs Instruction scroll as they made their rounds to all the cities of Judah, teaching the people.

dag: Sidɔnnim mini Arivadnim n-daa nyɛ a kpatoonsi. Ka Zɛmɛr yɛnnim nyɛ a ŋariŋ duhiriba.
en: Men from Sidon and Arvad did the rowing, and your own skilled workers were the captains.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni kahig o ni chɛ ka nir yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani shɛm yɛla wuhi palɔni, ka di pala fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu min anabinim yɛligu gba nyɛla din pun di dimbɔŋɔ shɛhira.
en: But now God's way of putting people right with himself has been revealed. It has nothing to do with law, even though the Law of Moses and the prophets gave their witness to it.

dag: Dama o daa maanila Damaskusnim bɛn daa tuhi nyaŋ o la buɣa, ka yɛli, Siria buɣa maa n-daa sɔŋ Siria nanim maa ka bɛ tuhi nyaŋ ma maa, n gba ni maani ba ka bɛ sɔŋ ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ daa lee tahila mbusim na ti luhi o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: He said to himself, The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me. That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.

dag: bee alɔbo din be zibisim ni bee mbusim din paarina wuntaŋ ni agbaa saha la.
en: or sickness that prowls in the dark, destruction that ravages at noontime.

dag: Di zaɣisi zaɣ viɛlli niŋ ti di ni simdi ni a niŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛba, a yi mali yiko din ni niŋ li.
en: Whenever you possibly can, do good to those who need it.

dag: Ka bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kulina maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm. Ka Ɛzra daa pii daŋ kam zuɣulaannim ni niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ sab bɛ yuya sɔŋ. Ka bɛ daa piligi yɛlli maa vihibu gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali.
en: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month.

dag: Kul kpalimmiya be Naawuni yurilim la puuni, ka guhimiya saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu la.
en: keep each other in the love of God, wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, who will give you eternal life.

dag: Yawɛ, saɣisim ma, amaa saɣisim ma kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni, di yi pa lala n ni bahi yoli.
en: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni su piɛ nyaan shɛb kom ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam mali jaa, ka bɛ ni so bi kɔŋ o bala.
en: Your teeth are white like ewes just coming from their bath. They all give birth to twins. Not one of them has lost a baby.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha maa, bɛ ni ti kurigi Juda nanima mini kpambaliba ni maligumaaniba ni anabinim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim kɔba bɛ gbala ni;.
en: At that time, declares the LORD, the bones of the kings of Judah and its officers, the bones of the priests and the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be taken from their graves.

dag: Tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa yi ti sɔhira, mani n-nyɛ ŋun gbib di daantalisi.
en: Though every living creature tremble and the earth itself be shaken, I will keep its foundations firm.

dag: Kurimbuni ha zaŋ na ni pumpɔŋɔ, so nini na ʒi n-nya bee n-wum ni Naawuni so beni pah a zuɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi tuun kara tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guhir o.
en: No one has ever seen or heard of a God like you, who does such deeds for those who put their hope in him.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ doo maa yi tiŋ maa tariga nti pihi kuɣa lab ku o kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: The entire community took him outside the camp and stoned him. He died as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Buɣili ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na, ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama lala na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: they were scared to death and said: The gods have come into their camp. Now we're in real trouble! Nothing like this has ever happened to us before.

dag: Dɔro ni daa mali do so yuun pihinahaayika gba daa do nimaani.
en: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-saɣim yimaŋa, dama n ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb ka chɛri palo tiri ya ŋɔ zaŋla dimbɔŋɔnim saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: Dont make yourself unclean by doing any of these wrong things! I am throwing nations off their land and giving it to you because they did those terrible sins.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam ŋmanila saa ŋun kul yɔrita ka bi baara.
en: The constant dripping on a rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

dag: Ahi daa nyɛla Abidiɛl bia, ka Abidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Guni bia la daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: Ahi, Abdiels son and Gunis grandson, was the head of their household.

dag: Naawuni daa yɛl o, A yuli Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ku lan boli Yaakubu; a yuli yɛn boonila Izraɛl. Dinzuɣu ka o yuli booni Izraɛl maa.
en: God said to him, Your name is Jacob, but from now on it will be Israel. So God named him Israel.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, amaa bimbihili maa din ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la dini.
en: The priest will burn the fat on the altar, but the breast of the animal will belong to Aaron and his sons.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kɔri naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin mali sara, Naawuni ni daa sɔŋ ba maa zuɣu.
en: Since God had helped the Levites who were carrying the chest containing the LORDs covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: Speen ŋariŋduhiriba, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama bɛ saɣim yi birininima.
en: Wail, ships of Tarshish, for your fortress is destroyed!.

dag: Ka Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi daa nyaɣi lɔɣiri ba yuri n-zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi kana. Ka Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi mi daa gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaɣisi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kpɛh o kpee maa duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o yo samli maa zaa.
en: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma ayopɔin goli dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the month. He said:.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa bi lan ʒiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa bee bɛ ni daa mali neen shɛŋa tumdi di tuma maa gindi yaha.
en: So there is no longer any need for the Levites to carry the Tent of the Lord 's presence and all the equipment used in worship.

dag: N yi yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri, Yinima ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi, ka a bi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri maa ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ninvuɣ biɛri maa ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, amaa bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila a zuɣu.
en: If I pronounce a death sentence on wicked people, and you dont warn them to turn from their way, they will die in their guilt, but I will hold you responsible for their blood.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi tiŋgban ni n-chaŋ ti su kom ka ʒe kpam, ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛm o. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yi n-kuli yiŋa nti bɔhi bindirigu yɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di.
en: Then David rose from the ground, bathed, anointed himself, and changed his clothes. He entered the LORDs house and bowed down. Then he entered his own house. He requested food, which was brought to him, and he ate.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n kul kumdi ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka di bi chɛra, dama bɛ ŋme n niriba bɛn be kaman m bipuɣiŋga ŋun ʒi doo maa kurili luhi, ka bɛ nya dan titali.
en: So deliver this word to them: My eyes well up with tears; I cant stop weeping—day and night, because my virgin daughter, my people, has suffered a crushing blow and is mortally wounded.

dag: Saha shɛli Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa la ni daa ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ kum Yisa, ka o daa galim omaŋa, ka zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita la labisi ti ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba.
en: When Judas, the traitor, learned that Jesus had been condemned, he repented and took back the thirty silver coins to the chief priests and the elders.

dag: ka a ku a dan Ɛhab daŋ niriba, ka di chɛ ka m bɔhi Jɛzibɛl biɛri o ni daa ku n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim mini n dab shɛb zaa bɛn pahi la zuɣu.
en: You will strike down your master Ahabs family. In this way I will take revenge for the violence done by Jezebel to my servants the prophets and to all the LORDs servants.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba n-yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Labimiya kuli yi ya, dama Yawɛ zaɣisiya ni n di doli ya chaŋ.
en: The next morning Balaam got up and said to leaders from Balak, Go back to your own country. The Lord will not let me go with you.

dag: Tola kum nyaaŋa, ka Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la gba daa leei Izraɛlnim sariakarita yuun pisinaayi.
en: After Tola died, God sent another judge. His name was Jair, and he lived in the area of Gilead. He was a judge for the Israelites for years.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Jɛzibɛl mi polo, Naawuni yɛliya, Bahi ni ŋub o Jɛziriil tiŋ puuni.
en: And as for Jezebel, dogs will eat her body there in Jezreel.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Jɔshua sani Makɛda sansan la ni ni alaafee. Ka so daa bi tooi yaar o noli yɛri shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim maa polo.
en: Then all of Joshua's men came back safe to him at the camp at Makkedah. No one in the land dared even to speak against the Israelites.

dag: Amaa o tɔbu ku kabi, ka ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o nuhi mali kpiɔŋ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim gula, ka yihiri ba barina ni ŋɔ yuli zuɣu.
en: But he won the fight with his mighty bow and his skillful arms. He gets power from the Mighty One of Jacob, from the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpaŋ shɛŋa zaa din daa gili bɛ fɔntinsi maa n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya zali.
en: as well as all their villages around these towns as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their own family records.

dag: Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔ yɛla ka man Dauda lee lan yɛn yɛl a yaha? Dama a mi man a dabili Dauda.
en: How can I continue talking to you? Lord GOD, you know that I am only a servant.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti ŋmaligi labi n sanna ka doli n zaligunima, ka tumdi di tuma, n ni lan labisi ya luɣ shɛli n ni pii zali ni di nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la na, hal yi yi kul wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ tarisi luɣ shɛlikam zaa ha.
en: But then if you turn back to me and do what I have commanded you, I will bring you back to the place where I have chosen to be worshiped, even though you are scattered to the ends of the earth.

dag: O dunɔdaya firi tiŋgban ni. Naawuni kabisi o dunokparita n-saɣim li. O naa mini nabihi bela tinzunnim sani. So bi lan wuhiri ba Naawuni yɛla, ka o daanabinim bi lan nyari ʒii Yawɛ sani.
en: The gates lie buried in rubble, their bars smashed to pieces. The king and the noblemen now are in exile. The Law is no longer taught, and the prophets have no visions from the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Nyamiya, kuɣili ŋɔ n-yɛn di ti shɛhira. Dama di wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni tɔɣisi ti maa, dinzuɣu yi yi bi ʒe yi Naawuni maa yim, dina n-yɛn din ya shɛhira.
en: He said to all the people, This stone will be our witness. It has heard all the words that the Lord has spoken to us. So it will be a witness against you, to keep you from rebelling against your God.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni yi gba mali suhupiɛlli, ka di chɛ ka n gba pahi yi zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: You should be glad about this in the same way. Be glad with me!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yɛhudianim maa daa to jina yɛli ni bɛ kum Sool.
en: After many days, some Jews made plans to kill Saul.

dag: dama yi yi ba n-zani yi biɛhigu ni ti Duuma zuɣu, di ni chɛ ka ti leei bɛn be.
en: Our life is really full if you stand strong in the Lord.

dag: Nyini, yilimi fabila yilli ŋɔ niŋ Izraɛl nanima.
en: The Lord told me to sing this song of sorrow for two princes of Israel:.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛla ba yaha, Dinzuɣu di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: Don't be afraid of anyone! Everything that is hidden will be found out, and every secret will be known.

dag: Ka o dɔbilim maa yi shihi situra kam mini biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ kam, bɛn paɣimi li, ka di ni nyɛ din be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.

dag: amaa ka bɛ zaŋ nyini bahila katiŋ kaman bimpɔŋ la ka chɛ a gballi; ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb pa a zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi kuɣa bɔɣili ni kaman niriba ni nɔri kpiin shɛb garita.
en: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Naawuni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla yi dini.
en: Anything in Israel that is a special gift to God is yours.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi goli palli dabisili maa nyaaŋa, ka Dauda ʒiishee maa na kul nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ. Di saha ka Sool daa bɔh o dapala Jɔnatan, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Jɛsi dapala ŋɔ bi kana bindirigu dibu shee ŋɔ sɔhila bee zuŋɔ.
en: On the following day, the day after the New Moon Festival, David's place was still empty, and Saul asked Jonathan, Why didn't David come to the meal either yesterday or today.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni chɛ ka a dɔɣi bihi, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam. Ka n ti chɛ ka zuliya gbaliŋ yi a zuliya maa ni na, ka n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam. .
en: and said to me, I am about to give you many children, to increase your numbers, and to make you a large group of peoples. I will give this land to your descendants following you as an enduring possession.

dag: Ka wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Karim dab paɣa min o bia bahi, dama dab paɣ bia mini bilichin paɣ bia ku laɣim di fali.
en: The Scriptures say, Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi Troas kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Samɔtirɛsi n-yi biɛɣu n-naanyi paai Niapolis.
en: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n zalila tiŋguliba a goma zuɣu. Bɛ di shini wuntaŋ ni zaŋ tabili yuŋ zaa. Yinim bɛn kul teeri Yawɛ ŋɔ, di bɔriya ni yi vuhi.
en: Jerusalem, I put guards on your walls. They will not be silent. They will keep praying day and night. Guards, keep praying to the Lord . Remind him of his promise. Dont ever stop praying.

dag: Sokam dirila tiŋgbani daatam, hal naa gba dirila tiŋgbani daatam anfaani.
en: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ baŋ ni n ni ti su li.
en: But Abram asked, Sovereign Lord , how can I know that it will be mine.

dag: Ka Jona daa deei Yawɛ noli, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Ninive. Ninive daa nyɛla tin titali. Daba ata ka nir daa naan zaŋ chaŋ kpe di ni gari.
en: And Jonah got up and went to Nineveh, according to the LORDs word.

dag: ka nya so ka o ʒe di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani daadam. O daa yɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din chaŋ ti lim o napɔnvari, ka salima nyolɔrigu lo o nyɔɣu.
en: I saw someone among the lampstands who looked like the Son of Man. He was dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash tied around his chest.

dag: Ka buŋ maa nya ma, ka birigi siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa. O yi di bi birigi, yɛlimaŋli, ŋ-ŋɔ n di pun ku a, ka chɛ o.
en: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If it hadnt turned away from me, I would just now have killed you and let it live.

dag: Pagɔr bia bi simdi ni o be Yawɛ niriba ni, hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, di bi simdi ni bɛ chɛ ka o bia kpe Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: If a mans parents were not legally married, that man may not join with the men of Israel to worship the Lord . And none of his descendants to the tenth generation—may join in that group.

dag: Teemiy o ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni kari saria shɛŋa la.
en: Remember the amazing things he has done. Remember his miracles and his fair decisions.

dag: Ka wula ka nir yɛn niŋ? Dama bɛ ni wum ni a kana.
en: What should we do? The Jewish believers here will learn that you have come.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannima bɛn mali yɛm, ka mali yu suma n-zaŋ ba leei yi zuɣulaannima. Ka bɛ su niriba tuhilituhili mini niriba kɔbigakɔbiga ni niriba pihinunu ni niriba piapia fukumsi, ka nyɛ yi daŋ kam ni kpamba.
en: So I took the wise, experienced men you chose from your tribes, and I made them your leaders. In this way I gave you leaders over people, over people, over people, and over people. I also gave you officers for each of your tribes.

dag: Bɛ ni tarigi lɛb lu, amaa tinim ni yiɣisimi ʒe tibi.
en: They will collapse and fall, but we will stand up straight and strong.

dag: amaa ka chɛbisi ba ka yɛli, Naawuni yi saɣi, n ni lan lab yi sanna yaha; ka daa yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ.
en: He told them goodbye and said, If God lets me, I will come back.

dag: Dama noli zaɣisibu mini baɣibuɣibo zaa alahichi nyɛla yim. Ka tipawumli mini buɣijɛmbo mi nyɛ alahichi yini. Ka a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu ŋɔ zuɣu, o gba zaɣisiya ni a ku lan nyɛ naa.
en: Refusing to obey is as bad as the sin of sorcery. Being stubborn and doing what you want is like the sin of worshiping idols. You refused to obey the Lord s command, so he now refuses to accept you as king.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalikaulinim zaa niŋdi palila o ni. Dina n-chɛ ka ti yɛri Ami, ka paɣiri Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: for it is he who is the Yes to all of God's promises. This is why through Jesus Christ our Amen is said to the glory of God.

dag: Niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti du n-tam Ziɔn Zol la zuɣu, ka deei Iso Zoli su. Ka di ti leei Yawɛ nam.
en: The winners will go up on Mount Zion to rule the people who live on Esaus mountain. And the kingdom will belong to the Lord .

dag: Ka naazɔnim maa daa yɛl o, Haman be kpe; o ʒe zɔŋ ni. Ka naa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiy o ni o kpɛmina.
en: The king's servants answered, Your Majesty, it is Haman. Tell him to come in, the king commanded.

dag: O daa yihi tinzun buɣa mini binnana zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka lan wurim o ni daa me bimbin shɛŋa zaa zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm la n-zaŋ li ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga.
en: He removed the foreign gods and the idol from the LORDs temple, as well as all the altars he had built on the hill of the LORDs temple and in Jerusalem, dumping them outside the city.

dag: Bɛ kabɔɣa mini bɛ wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ku dihi ba, ka bɛ ku nya wain palli.
en: But the grain from those threshing floors will not provide enough food for Israel. There will not be enough wine for Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ya ti ʒili yi yaannim ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli la ni, ka yi ti su li, ka o chɛ ka yi tɔŋ, ka yi kalinli galisi gari yi yaannim maa kalinli.
en: The Lord your God will bring you into the land your ancestors had, and the land will become yours. He will do good to you, and you will have more than your ancestors had. You will have more people in your nation than they ever had.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka Filistianim maa daa yɛli, Nyamiya, Hiburunim la yiri bɛ ni sɔɣi bɛmaŋ vo shɛŋa la ni na.
en: So Jonathan and his helper let the Philistines see them. The Philistine guards said, Look! The Hebrews are coming out of the holes they were hiding in.

dag: Jɔshua yi di daa chɛ ka Naawuni niriba nya vuhim Naawuni sani, dindina ŋun Naawuni daa naan ku lan tɔɣisi dabisi shɛli yɛla yaha.
en: If Joshua gave the Israelites rest, God wouldnt have spoken about another day later on.

dag: ni Bɛnhɛsɛd tiŋgbɔŋ zaa la.
en: Benhesed: the cities of Arubboth and Socoh and all the territory of Hepher.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Mbaye, n daa zaɣisi biɛrisuŋ, ka zaɣisi zuɣuni kpahibu.
en: and shout, I hated advice and correction!.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A bihi bɛn be a ʒiɛman ni zaa ŋun mali dalinli, ŋun miri ka o mirina ni o ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: to tell Aaron, None of your descendants who has any physical defects may present the food offering to me. This applies for all time to come.

dag: Amaa tinim ni lo kpara gari Izraɛlnim tooni chaŋ ti nya ʒiishee ti ba, ka ti bihi be bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zuɣu la ni.
en: Then we will be ready to go with the other Israelites into battle and lead the attack until we have settled them in the land that will be theirs. In the meantime, our dependents can live here in the fortified towns, safe from the people of this land.

dag: Di pa shɛli ti yi niŋ lala, Naawuni ni taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa polo; ka ku o suhuyiɣisili maa; ka chɛ ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: Who knows? Maybe God will stop being angry and change his mind, and we will not be punished.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Ahimaaz ba.
en: Ahitub was Zadoks father. Zadok was Ahimaazs father.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Taiatira Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni Naawuni Bia ŋun nina ŋmani buɣim zilinli ka o napɔnvari nyɛlisiri kaman daanya viɛlli la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam. O suhuyiɣisili din daa kɔŋ tim maa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ buɣim juui Ziɔn ka di di li zaa.
en: The Lord used all of his anger. He poured out all his anger. He made a fire in Zion that burned it down to the foundations.

dag: Labimiya kuli, dama n kurigiya pam ni doo kulibu. Ka hal n yi tɛhi ni tahima na ni beni, ka kul doo yuŋ ŋɔ gba n-dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: Turn back, my daughters. Go. I am too old for a husband. If I were to say that I have hope, even if I had a husband tonight, and even more, if I were to bear sons.

dag: Hal goli bi piɛli o sani gba; ka saŋmarisi mi pa bɛn ka daɣiri o sani.
en: If even the moon is not bright and the stars not pure in his eyes.

dag: Hiburɔn daŋ ni, Jɛrija n-daa nyɛ Hiburɔn daŋ maa zaa kpɛma.
en: From the Hebronites: Jerijah was the head of the Hebronites according to the family records of their households. In the fortieth year of Davids rule, a search was made and capable men were found among them in Jazer in Gilead.

dag: Ka Hanani bia Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ anabi la daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi Naa Jɛhɔshafat soli n-yɛl o, A tɛhiya ni di simdi ni a sɔŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri ka yuri bɛn je Yawɛ? A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a zuɣu.
en: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord . Now the Lord God is angry with you!.

dag: Dinzuɣu zalimiya zaligu n-yɛli ni niriba maa na chɛli bɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu, ka naɣila n ti lan zali zaligu yaha.
en: Therefore you are to issue orders that those men are to stop rebuilding the city until I give further commands.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nira daa chaŋ naa maa sani ti yɛl o, N dan naa, di chɛ ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi ŋɔ pahi dol a chaŋ, dama Yawɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ŋɔ zaa so sani.
en: But a man of God came to Amaziah and said, King, dont let the army of Israel go with you. The Lord is not with Israel or the people of Ephraim.

dag: Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa biɛ ŋ-kpaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa sabi sabbu ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: This is the letter from Hezekiah when he became well:.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dirila bɛ ni zaŋ chi mini kawaan shɛŋa na ti mali sara shɛli ni alahichi sanyoo sara binyara ni taali sanyoo sara binyara. Ka bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli zaa ti Yawɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: They will have the right to eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Also, anything in Israel that is a special gift to God will belong to them.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ti na kpalim ʒi kpe? Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa la ni nti kpi di ni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaliya ni ti ni kpi, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nti ti ni ti nyu, ti ni tum alahichi o sani zuɣu.
en: They will say, Why are we just sitting here? Come, lets run to the strong cities. If the Lord our God is going to make us die, then lets die there. We have sinned against the Lord , so he has given us poisoned water to drink.

dag: Yi ninni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim puuni zoli gbini la.
en: The Lord spoke with you face to face at that mountain. He spoke to you from the fire.

dag: ni Nan ni Jɔshua.
en: Nun, Joshua.

dag: Ka Balaam daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba ni ti bɛ suɣa doya gbilligbilli. Di saha ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na.
en: and saw the people of Israel camped tribe by tribe. The spirit of God took control of him.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn filim bɛmaŋ la lan pala o bihi. Bɛ bela ʒiri biɛhigu o sani. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanim bɛn biɛhigu bi tuhi.
en: But children who werent his own sinned against him with their defects; they are a twisted and perverse generation.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbilli kam din maha n-ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn mali nyɛvili zaŋ tabili noonsi balibu kam ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ni bɛ dira. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: To all wildlife, to all the birds in the sky, and to everything crawling on the ground—to everything that breathes—I give all the green grasses for food. And thats what happened.

dag: Bɛ yi di mali yɛm, bɛ naan baŋ dimbɔŋɔ. Bɛ naan baŋ di bahigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: They fail to see why they were defeated; they cannot understand what happened.

dag: Di saha ka Musa min o sɔŋda Jɔshua daa lu soli, ka Musa daa du Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Moses and his helper Joshua got ready, and Moses began to go up the holy mountain.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ammɔnnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ ni tuhiri ni bɛ deei tiŋgbani palo pahi la zuɣu, bɛ daa kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya Giliad.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish the Ammonites for the many crimes they did. They killed the pregnant women in Gilead. The Ammonites did this so that they could take that land and make their country larger.

dag: nti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yiliya la tooni.
en: dip his finger in it, and sprinkle it in front of the curtain seven times.

dag: amaa Naawuni yɛl ti, Miriya ka yi di ti shɛli din be puu ŋɔ sunsuuni ŋɔ wala bee n-shihi li gba, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: except the tree in the middle of it. God told us not to eat the fruit of that tree or even touch it; if we do, we will die.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba; dama Jabin daa malila kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi; ka daa zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Izraɛlnim pam yuun pisi.
en: Jabin had nine hundred iron chariots, and he ruled the people of Israel with cruelty and violence for twenty years. Then the people of Israel cried out to the Lord for help.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Nir yi yuri ma, o ni doli n yɛligu, ka m Ba ni yur o, ka ti ni ka dilan sanna ka ti min o ti laɣim be.
en: Jesus answered him, Those who love me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and my Father and I will come to them and live with them.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Come to see me as soon as you can.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Tiŋ Kasi la ni nti du n-tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha.
en: Then the Devil took Jesus to Jerusalem, the Holy City, set him on the highest point of the Temple.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba bɔhi, Paɣ ŋuni n-lee ni mal anzinfa laɣibaligu pia, ka di zaɣ yini ti bɔrigi, ka o ku nyo firila kolikol o yiŋ zaa m-bo li ni nimmoo hal ti nya li?.
en: Or what woman, if she owns ten silver coins and loses one of them, wont light a lamp and sweep the house, searching her home carefully until she finds it?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ alichɛbba maa tiŋli ti tuui.
en: Then they used fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn to make the cloth pomegranates. They hung these pomegranates around the bottom edge of the robe.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N ka yidana. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A ni yɛli ni a ka yidan maa di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli;.
en: The woman answered, I don't have a husband. That's right, Jesus replied, you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi Taai doli yi Sidɔn mini tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia la ni mali ti paai Galili Teeku ni.
en: After leaving the region of Tyre, Jesus went through Sidon toward the Galilee Sea through the region of the Ten Cities.

dag: Bɛ nyaɣa vilivilila kuɣ duli, ka bɛ be tampima ni.
en: Its roots spread among the rocks, searching for good soil.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam tiŋgbani pa kom zuɣu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who shaped the earth on the water— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Ishimail ŋun nyɛ Haga, Zara dab paɣa ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ ni daa dɔɣ so la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Ishmael, whom Hagar, the Egyptian slave of Sarah, bore to Abraham.

dag: N ni zaŋ rubis me a pihi, ka zaŋ kuɣ shɛŋa din nyɛlisiri me a dunoya, ka zaŋ kuɣ viɛla m-mal a gooni.
en: The stones on top of the wall will be made from rubies. I will use shiny jewels for the gates. I will use precious stones to build the walls around you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Banima n-lee ni tooi sɔɣi ashilɔni luɣ shɛli ka n ku tooi nya ba? M bi bela zuɣusaa mini dunia ni zaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: No one can hide where I cannot see them. Do you not know that I am everywhere in heaven and on earth?.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa bɔhi bɔhigu shɛlikam min o ni daa zaŋ yɛlimuɣisir shɛlikam na puuni, nachimbih anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn mi di yɛla paai siɣimsiɣim bu pii zuɣu n-gari timlan kam bee saŋmaribaŋda kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: No matter what question the king asked or what problem he raised, these four knew ten times more than any fortuneteller or magician in his whole kingdom.

dag: nti zaŋ yi ba mini yi malibu kuli n sanna ka n ti tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka yi ti diri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira yi yubu.
en: Tell them to bring your father and their families back here to me. I will give you the best land in Egypt to live on. And your family can eat the best food we have here.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi? Bee Kpiɔŋlan Naa nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi?.
en: Does God pervert justice, or does the Almighty distort what is right?.

dag: Yi bindiri pala din daŋ niŋbu dabisili din nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi kapala tiri Yawɛ yi dakulɔdakulo churi puhibu ni la dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya yi tuun shɛli.
en: On the first day of the Harvest Festival, you must rest from your work, come together for worship, and bring a sacrifice of new grain.

dag: Ka yi yi ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, yin nyomiya li buɣim kaman Naawuni ni zali ya shɛm. N ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: After you have taken the city, set it on fire, just as the Lord has commanded. These are your orders.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Obɔt.
en: The Israelites left that place and camped at Oboth.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Praise the Lord , because he is good! His faithful love will last forever!.

dag: N nya n dabili Dauda, m booi n kpam din be kasi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: I discovered my servant David. I anointed him with my holy oil.

dag: Lɛbanɔn sipirɛs mini sida tihi malila suhupiɛlli naa maa lubu maa zuɣu, ka yɛra, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni lu ŋɔ, so ku lan ŋma ti luhi yaha. .
en: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.

dag: Amaa o daa bi wurim buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul maani maligu nimaani, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: He did not destroy the high places. The people still sacrificed and burned incense at those places of worship.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya niriba maa daa tim ni bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai Bɛtɛl nya di ni be shɛm. .
en: They sent some spies to the city of Bethel .

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bi ku ba Izraɛl kpamba ni daa pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni n-niŋdi bɛ kpamba maa.
en: But the Israelites could not kill them, because their leaders had made a solemn promise to them in the name of the Lord , Israel's God. All the people complained to the leaders about this.

dag: Ka shihir shɛli daa lan puhi zani alizanda ni yaha. Waɣ ʒiɛ biɛ titali ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin mini yila pia, ka nam zuɣupilis ayopɔin pil o zuɣuri maa daa yina ʒiɛya.
en: Another mysterious sight appeared in the sky. There was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and a crown on each of his heads.

dag: Ka o daa kari alizin birigu maa doo maa zuɣu bahi, ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira; ka di daa niŋ salo maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya tuuni ŋɔ tatabo Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: When Jesus had thrown out the demon, the man who couldnt speak began to talk. The crowds were amazed and said, Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi maa n-wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tum din ni tiɣ o nini. Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnim bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la, ka lan woligi yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzun paɣiba.
en: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord , the God of your ancestors. You must obey his command. Separate yourselves from the people living around you and from your foreign wives.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ kul birigirila bɛ suhuri ni waawaayili, ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: And so I was angry with those people and said, They are always disloyal and refuse to obey my commands.

dag: Ninsalinim ni daa ti piligi nabbu dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bipuɣinsi.
en: When people had spread all over the world, and daughters were being born.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛlimaŋli maa lee nyɛla dini? Gomna Pailɛt ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan yi Yɛhudianim maa sani ti yɛli ba, M bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: Pilate said, What is truth? Then he went out to the Jewish leaders again and said to them, I can find nothing against this man.

dag: Binnyura kɔre yi ti mali ba, n ni zaŋ bɛ binnyura zali ba ka bɛ nyu li hal ti buɣi, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka bɛ gbihi, ka ku lan neei sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They are acting like powerful lions. I will give a party for them. I will make them drunk. They will laugh and have a good time, and then they will sleep forever. They will never wake up. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim kpi ka yi yi alizinnim bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni la, di chaŋ wula ka yi lan be kaman dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba? Bɔzuɣu ka yi doli zaligunim din yɛli:.
en: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as.

dag: Ka Sool daa nya Dauda ni diri nasara shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pam pahi.
en: Saul noticed David's success and became even more afraid of him.

dag: M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn chɛ ka paɣ so ku a zuɣu, ka a ti bɔbili paɣ zinalana biha?.
en: Why, my son, should you lose your senses with a mysterious woman and embrace the breasts of a foreign female?.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔɣisimiya ka niŋmiya kaman bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ o zaligu shɛli din tiri yolisim la kari shɛb saria.
en: In every way, then, speak and act as people who will be judged by the law of freedom.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ daa bi yu ni o bahi Judanim yoli o dabili Dauda zuɣu, dama o daa pun lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ firila ti o min o bidibisi.
en: But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa garigi yɛli bɛ ni yino, Zɔri, m bi din ya zalinsi. Ka bɔh o, Bee yi di bi saɣi ni yi ni deei tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: The owner answered one of them, Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba ŋɔ bɛn kpe yɔɣu ka bi lan labina? Bɛ dolila yɔhiŋ soli ka zaɣisi labbuna.
en: Why then does this people, rebellious Jerusalem, persistently turn away from me? They cling to deceit and refuse to return.

dag: A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣim gil a maa zaa niŋmiya shili gu ka a leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Be prepared. Yes, prepare yourself and the armies that have joined with you. You must watch and be ready.

dag: Ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka n kahi Tɔbaya nɛma m-bahi samban ni.
en: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ nimaani daba ayi, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-chani gindi Galɛshia mini Firijia tiŋgbana ni n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa suhuri.
en: After some time there he left and traveled from place to place in the region of Galatia and the district of Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must keep my sabbaths and respect my sanctuary; I am the LORD.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana, ka bɛ daa yi yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama ni bɛ yiɣi tiŋgban ni du zuɣusaa, kalima din be bɛ luɣili zuɣu maa daa bi ŋmaligira.
en: and the wheels rose with them. When the Cherub angels raised their wings and flew into the air, not even the wheels turned around.

dag: Bumiya yi nyɔri ni suhusaɣiŋgu yi tiŋgbani din vuhiri mini yi tiwala tihi din saɣim la zuɣu.
en: Beat your breasts in grief because the fertile fields and the vineyards have been destroyed.

dag: M mabia Failimɔn, n yi ti suhiri Naawuni tir a, n kul paɣir o mi sahakam.
en: Philemon, I thank my God every time I mention you in my prayers.

dag: Dama ti wum kuhigu damli Ziɔn. Ti bahi yoli. Ti di vi zaa! Di simdi ni ti yi ti tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ daai ti yinsi luhi.
en: The sound of loud crying is heard from Zion: We are really ruined! We are so ashamed! We must leave our land, because our houses have been destroyed. Now our houses are only piles of rock.

dag: Ka salo bɛn zaa daa laɣim ʒe nimaani ni bɛ lihi ninliha maa daa nya din niŋ maa. Ka ŋmaligi buri bɛ nyɔri kuna.
en: Many people had come out of the city to see all this. When they saw it, they felt very sorry and left.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi, shee bihi dimi tiɣi pɔi.
en: But Jesus answered, Let us first feed the children. It isn't right to take the children's food and throw it to the dogs.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yi lu, ŋun la ni yiɣis o zali. Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko zuɣu. O yi lu, o ka ŋun ni yiɣis o zali.
en: If either should fall, one can pick up the other. But how miserable are those who fall and dont have a companion to help them up!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Sukɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam tiŋgban nɛl naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: The people of Israel left Succoth and camped at Etham at the border of Egypt near the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisifu ni daa mali ti paag o biɛyanim maa sani, bɛ daa darigimi fuɣ o binyɛr shɛli o ni daa ye ka di nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣinli ka mali bɔɣ wɔɣila la;.
en: When Joseph reached his brothers, they stripped off Josephs long robe.

dag: Yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita maa naabu dali, ka Yawɛ niriba gbilligbilli maa zaa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: At the end of four hundred thirty years, on that precise day, all the LORDs people in military formation left the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yinim alahichinim ŋɔ yiɣisimi zani yi yaannim zaashee ni yi chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu!.
en: And now you are doing the same thing that your fathers did. You sinful people, do you want the Lord to be even more angry with his people?.

dag: ka ni be kasitali mini wuntitali ni o sani hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: so that we might be holy and righteous before him all the days of our life.

dag: Ti wum dinkam beni. Yɛlli maa naabu m-bɔŋɔ: Zom Naawuni, ka dol o zaligunima; di ni simdi ni sokam niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: So this is the end of the matter; all has been heard. Worship God and keep Gods commandments because this is what everyone must do.

dag: Iso ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdomnim bɛn daa be Siɛr zoya tiŋ maa ni yab la zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Esau is the father of the people of Edom. These are the names of Esaus family living in the hill country of Seir:.

dag: Kaman dam din miha ni to noli ni, ka nyɔhi biɛri nimbihi ni shɛm, lala ka vinnyaɣinim gba be bɛ tumalaannim sani.
en: Sending a lazy person to do anything is as irritating as vinegar on your teeth or smoke in your eyes.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn maa yuun pisaayika.
en: Then he ruled Israel for years and forced the Israelites to pay heavy taxes.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli Masia wuhibu, amaa ka kpahi yaɣi di zuɣu chana, dilana maa ka Naawuni; ka ŋunkam mi doli Masia wuhibu nyɛla ŋun mali ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia.
en: Everyone must continue to follow only the teaching about Christ. Whoever changes that teaching does not have God. But whoever continues to follow the teaching about Christ has both the Father and his Son.

dag: Bi so ŋun buɣisi ni o yɛli noli ti o ba bee o ma o firila ni kpi bumbɔn ni.
en: Those who curse their father or mother— their lamp will be snuffed out when it becomes dark.

dag: ka buɣim kulibɔŋ zɔri yiri di ni na. Ka niriba tusatusa shɛm tumdi tuma tir o, ka niriba tuhipii ʒiibu tuhipia ʒe o tooni. Ka saria karibu daa piligi, ka litaafinim bɔɣi doya.
en: and a stream of fire was pouring out from it. There were many thousands of people there to serve him, and millions of people stood before him. The court began its session, and the books were opened.

dag: Yi ni yɛn tiri Naawuni pina shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Alikama tahili kam puuni, yi ni yihi kuruwa pirigibu buyɔbu puuni yim zuɣu ti. Chi tahili kam puuni, yi ni yihi kuruwa pirigibu buyɔbu puuni yim zuɣu ti.
en: This is a special offering that you must give: / ephah of wheat for every homer of wheat; / ephah of barley for every homer of barley;.

dag: Yi tɔbbihi tuui lu, ka yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti labi timaŋmaŋ niriba sani ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, takɔbi shɛl din kuri ti ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Your soldiers stumble over each other and say, Get up! The enemy will kill us, unless we can escape to our own land.

dag: Ka bɛnkam pun mi o ni daa ti nya ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ yɛli taba, Ka bɔ n-lee siɣi Kish bia ŋɔ zuɣu na? Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: Some of the people who had known Saul before saw him prophesying with the prophets. So they asked each other, What has happened to Kishs son? Is Saul also one of the prophets.

dag: Ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni lo ni n niŋ ba shɛm.
en: If you do not drive them out, I will destroy you, as I planned to destroy them.

dag: Dama Naawuni n-zaani saha shɛl o ni bɔri ni daadamnim kan o sanna ka o ti kariti ba saria.
en: surely no time is set for a person to appear before God in judgment.

dag: Di saha n ni ti taɣi niriba yɛtɔɣa ka di leei alali yɛtɔɣa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaa ti laɣim booni Yawɛ yuli n-jɛmd o ni naŋgban yini.
en: Then I will change the people of the nations, and they will pray to me alone and not to other gods. They will all obey me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli tiŋgbani din bɔri kom, ka chɛ ka kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani din kuui. N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ a zuliya ni, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a bihi ni.
en: I will pour out water upon thirsty ground and streams upon dry land. I will pour out my spirit upon your descendants and my blessing upon your offspring.

dag: hal n ni bi tum taali, ka kul suhiri Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga maa zaa yoli.
en: but I am not guilty of any violence, and my prayer to God is sincere.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jahat mini Zina ni Jɛushi ni Bɛraya, bɛ niriba anahi maa n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi bidibisi.
en: Shimei had four sons. They were Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi tiŋgban ni n-chaŋ ti su kom ka ʒe kpam, ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛm o. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yi n-kuli yiŋa nti bɔhi bindirigu yɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di.
en: David got up off the floor; he took a bath, combed his hair, and dressed. He went into the Lord 's tent and worshiped, then he went back home. David asked for something to eat, and when his servants brought him some food, he ate it.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaɣisi lahibal suŋ la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni dimnima ni di chɛ ka yi wum lahibal suŋ maa; amaa zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni pii ba la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ yurisi bɛ yaannim zuɣu.
en: The Jews refuse to accept the Good News, so they are Gods enemies. This has happened to help you who are not Jews. But they are still Gods chosen people, and he loves them because of the promises he made to their ancestors.

dag: Yinim bɛn be alizanda ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o o jilima min o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: Praise the Lord , you heavenly beings; praise his glory and power.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka a daa zal a zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali zaa.
en: The rules you have given us are right. We can trust them completely.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka piɛguliba maa daa yi ni labiri kuna ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa wum ka nya shɛm maa zuɣu, dama di daa kul nyɛla kaman malaika la ni daa yɛli ba shɛm.
en: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.

dag: Pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari niriba maa kaman bɛ yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The land will be divided and given to these people. Each tribe will get enough land for all the people who were counted.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bɔrila dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba, yi ni tooi da dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya sani.
en: Regarding male or female slaves that you are allowed to have: You can buy a male or a female slave from the nations that are around you.

dag: ka boli yil maa ni bi so na nti bɔh o diɛma maa daliri.
en: So he called one of the servants and asked him, What's going on.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, A yi labina, n ni deeg a ka a lan be n sani yaha. A yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri, a ni leei ŋun ni tɔɣisiri n yɛtɔɣa. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti lab a sanna; pa nyini n-ni ti lab bɛ sani.
en: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *.

dag: Ka so yi muɣis a ni a ʒi o ʒili n-tah o tin shɛli din pa a ya zuɣu kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm tariga, nyin ʒim li yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: And if one of the occupation troops forces you to carry his pack one mile, carry it two miles.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim zuɣu. A wuntitali puuni, tim ma nyɛvili.
en: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi: O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino n-jɛm o, ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be loyal to the one and have contempt for the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.

dag: Ka Gomna maa daa lan bɔhi ba pahi, Niriba ayi maa ni, ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Barabas.
en: But Pilate asked the crowd, Which one of these two do you want me to set free for you? Barabbas! they answered.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka ti niŋ o shɛli, dama o nyɛla ti tizo ni timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ. Ka o mabihi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Let's sell him to these Ishmaelites. Then we won't have to hurt him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood. His brothers agreed.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Early in the rule of Judahs King Zedekiah, Josiahs son, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD.

dag: Sanzali mini biisim ni chɛ ka maligim kuuri shɛm, lala ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba darigiri deeri alahichinima.
en: As snow vanishes in heat and drought, so sinners vanish from the land of the living.

dag: Di zaŋ ma ti n dimnima, dama ʒiri shɛhira diriba yiɣisimi lu n zuɣu, bɛ suhuri kul yɛla gadama niŋbu zuɣu.
en: My enemies have attacked me. They have told lies about me and have tried to hurt me.

dag: Dama a yi ti yi ya ŋɔ n-chaŋ ti baai du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani, ka a ʒim yihibu taali kpalim ʒi amaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If you ever leave and go beyond Kidron Brook, you will certainly die—and you yourself will be to blame.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di ka nyu.
en: Isaac gave a big feast for them, and everyone ate and drank.

dag: O ŋmanila kɔhigɔriba ŋarima; o ʒir o bindirigu yirila katiŋ na.
en: She is like a ship from a faraway place. She brings home food from everywhere.

dag: Filip daa mali bipuɣins anahi bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba, ka nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: He had four unmarried daughters who proclaimed God's message.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni zibigi ka saŋmarisi gba ni zaɣisi peebu.
en: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.

dag: ka zaŋ nintua n-tu a nyee, ka zaŋ tibikpara kpa a tiba ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli pil a zuɣu.
en: I gave you a nose ring and earrings and a beautiful crown to wear.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt, Di sabi ni Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ, amaa sabimila, Doo ŋɔ yɛliya ni o nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa. .
en: Therefore, the Jewish chief priests complained to Pilate, Dont write, The king of the Jews but This man said, I am the king of the Jews.

dag: Di yɔhimya yimaŋa; Naawuni pala bɛ ni maani so ansarisi, dama ninsal ni biri binshɛli, dina ka o ni ti chɛ.
