en: Do not deceive yourselves; no one makes a fool of God. You will reap exactly what you plant.

dag: Yi tihi mini yi puri atam zaa ni ti leei toli bindirigu.
en: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.

dag: Bɛ daa je bindirigu kam; di daa chɛ biɛla ka bɛ kpi.
en: they couldn't stand the sight of food and were close to death.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi zaa la yi nti yɛli ba, Gbaamiy o tim tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni chaŋ, ka so yi dol o na, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dilana. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛliya, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: Jehoiada the priest brought out the army captains. He said to them, Take Athaliah outside among the army. Use your swords to kill anyone who follows her. Then the priest warned the soldiers, Dont kill Athaliah in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia gbarigimi n ni, ka n yihi tahima n suhu ni.
en: My spirit is weak inside me— inside, my mind is numb.

dag: Dama a ni kpuɣ a piɛma tiri ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: He will shoot his arrows at them and make them turn and run.

dag: N kahigi n ni tum shɛlikam wuh a, ka a deei n suhigu; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.

dag: Juda, a mabihi ni ti paɣ a. A ni ti zaŋ a nuu gbaag a dimnim nyiŋgoya ni. A ba bidibisi ni ti damd a tooni.
en: Judah, your brothers will praise you. You hold your enemies by the neck. Your brothers will bow down before you.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ yuuni ni pirigili nimaani n-wuhiri niriba Naawuni yɛligu.
en: So Paul stayed there for a year and a half, teaching the people the word of God.

dag: Ka Makiri zuliya ni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa bia daa chaŋ ti liri Giliadnima ŋ-ŋme n-deei li ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani la.
en: The clan of Machir son of Manasseh invaded the land of Gilead, occupied it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

dag: dama yi zaa ni tooi tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka ti taba, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi bɔhim shɛli, ka lan nya kpaŋsibu.
en: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.

dag: Lihimiya ŋarima gba: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ kara ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ ʒiɛri li n-chani la zaa yoli, dabihi shɛŋa din lo di nyoya ni n-nyɛ din ŋmaligiri li kpari ŋun duhiri li ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: It is the same with ships. A ship is very big, and it is pushed by strong winds. But a very small rudder controls that big ship. And the one who controls the rudder decides where the ship will go. It goes where he wants it to go.

dag: Gul a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, a ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd a luɣ shɛl la din ni chɛ ka a gbilisiri tibili n-wumd a dabili suhigu saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ n nini kpa a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ na ka suhir a.
en: In the past you said, I will be honored there. So please watch over this Temple, night and day. And listen to my prayer as I turn toward this Temple and pray to you.

dag: N nyari baŋsim a zaligunim maa puuni, dinzuɣu n je ʒiri soli kam.
en: I gain wisdom from your laws, and so I hate all bad conduct.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the things Jehoram did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: A dim ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ maŋa ti a, amaa ka di lee nyɛla yɔhiŋ o suhu ni.
en: Hateful people mislead with their lips, keeping their deception within.

dag: Yi pun mi bɛ ni daa fiɛb ti ka dihi ti vi Filipai shɛm pɔi ka ti daa naanyi ti ka yi sanna la yɛla, amaa ti Naawuni daa bahi ti ti suhukpeeni ka ti yihi lahibal suŋ waazu din yi o sanna la n-tin ya hal sɔguriba ni daa kul zooi la zaa yoli.
en: You know how we had already been mistreated and insulted in Philippi before we came to you in Thessalonica. And even though there was much opposition, our God gave us courage to tell you the Good News that comes from him.

dag: Ka Musa daa taɣi ʒim maa pirigili niŋ taha ni zali, ka zaŋ di pirigili din kpalim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses took half of the blood and put it in large bowls. The other half of the blood he threw against the altar.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: The Lord said to him, Take your sandals off, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli ŋɔ kul be ti sani, ti ni mali tahima a san la zuɣu.
en: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.

dag: Amaa ka Ziɔnnim yɛli, Yawɛ chɛ ti bahi! O tam ti yɛla.
en: But the people of Jerusalem said, The Lord has abandoned us! He has forgotten us.

dag: Amaa n niriba dimnim yi bɔri ni n tiligi ba, dindina bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma, Iin, bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma.
en: But if anyone comes to me for safety and wants to make peace with me, then let them come and make peace.

dag: A daa yina ni a ti tilig a niriba, ka daa yina ni a ti tilig a ninvuɣ gahindili. Nyini n-ŋme wurim ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili, ka wurim di mɔpilli hal ti tabili di tanzaa.
en: You came to save your people and to lead your chosen king to victory. You killed the leader in every evil family, from the least important person to the most important in the land. Selah.

dag: Miri ka a fiɣisi dabili o dan sani, di yi niŋ lala dabili maa ni tu a, ka a leei ŋun mali taali.
en: Never criticize servants to their master. You will be cursed and suffer for it.

dag: O ku chɛ ka a napɔŋ pihigi; ŋun gul a maa bi gbihira.
en: He will not let you fall. Your Protector will not fall asleep.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijiptinim mini Firawuna nuu ni maa.
en: He said, Praise the Lord ! He freed you from the power of Egypt. He saved you from Pharaoh.

dag: Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ tooni na ti gbani? N zaŋmi yuun yini naɣ bihi ka o tooni na nti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la?.
en: What must I bring when I come to meet with the Lord ? What must I do when I bow down to God above? Should I come to him with burnt offerings and a year-old calf?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yi Mɔab bɔpiɛligu maa ni n-du Nɛbo Zoli nti paai Pisiga Zo shɛli din be Jɛriko tooni polo la zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa wuh o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa, zaŋ Giliad hal ni Dan.
en: Moses climbed Mount Nebo. Moses went from the Jordan Valley in Moab to the top of Mount Pisgah. This was across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed Moses all the land from Gilead to Dan.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N suhir a, na di kuli, ka ti gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi niŋ bindirigu ti a.
en: Not knowing that it was the Lord 's angel, Manoah said to him, Please do not go yet. Let us cook a young goat for you. But the angel said, If I do stay, I will not eat your food. But if you want to prepare it, burn it as an offering to the Lord .

dag: Ka Samsin ba daa chaŋ paɣisarili maa yiŋa, ka Samsin ti chɛ ka bɛ puhi chuɣu nimaani; dama lala ka nachimba daa yi niŋda.
en: While Samson's father went to make the final arrangements with the bride and her family, Samson threw a big party, as grooms usually did.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, sokam ni ti gbani n tooni, ka sokam ti yaag o noli m-paɣi man Naawuni.
en: Yes, the Scriptures say, As surely as I live, says the Lord, Everyone will bow before me; everyone will say that I am God. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ ni zaŋ fukumsi niŋ ninvuɣ so nuu ni nyɛla ŋun ni ʒe o duuma yim.
en: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for.

dag: Amaa o ni zaŋ kokpɛɣu naag o dimnim zaa, ka kar o dimnim maa kpɛhi zibisim ni.
en: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so ti Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn ku so, so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, bɛ kul ni ku o mi.
en: Not even human beings who have been unconditionally dedicated may be bought back; they must be put to death.

dag: Ka taŋkpaɣu labi di ni daa yi shɛl na, ka shia mi labi Naawuni ŋun daa zaŋ li ti sani.
en: before dust returns to the earth as it was before and the life-breath returns to God who gave it.

dag: Bɛ yi bɔri ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, bɛn bɔhimi bɛ yidaannim yiŋa, dama di nyɛla vi ni paɣ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa cheechi ni.
en: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa zaa daa kul bi bahi doli taba.
en: But even then they did not agree on what they said.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zan o nyaaŋa n-yɛli ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The other Jews agreed and said it was all true.

dag: Yinim bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋɔ, paɣimiy o! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, timiy o jilima! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura.
en: Praise the Lord , all you who worship him! Honor him, you descendants of Jacob! Fear and respect him, all you people of Israel!.

dag: So yi bɔhi ya, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔri ba, ka o ni chɛ ka yi dii zaŋ ba na.
en: If anyone asks you why you are taking the donkeys, tell them, The Master needs them. He will send them back soon.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Naawuni ŋ-ŋman a, ka nyɛ ŋun chɛr o niriba bɛn kpalim taali, ka bi lan doli bɛ biriginsim tuma? A suhu yi yiɣisi, di lan maara; dama a yuri nambɔzɔbo.
en: There is no other god like you, O Lord ; you forgive the sins of your people who have survived. You do not stay angry forever, but you take pleasure in showing us your constant love.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba ni di pala Romnim kali ni bɛ kari so saria ka dilan maŋmaŋ kani n-ni zani ka o mini bɛn fiɣisir o maa gbiɛri kpa taba, ka o tɔɣisi chihi o noli bɛ ni fiɣisir o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa.
en: I told them it isn't the Roman custom to hand a man over to people who are bringing charges against him. He must first have the chance to meet them face to face and to defend himself against their charges.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima mali ni bɛ jɛmdi li la bahi nantarisi mini zɔna dindali maa.
en: At that time people will throw away their idols they made from gold and silver. They made these statues to worship, but they will throw them into holes in the ground where bats and moles live.

dag: Wuntizɔriba zoorimi kaman abie tia la, ka zoori kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tia la.
en: The righteous will flourish like palm trees; they will grow like the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: dama ti wum ka o yɛli ni Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ni wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka taɣi ka shɛŋa Anabi Musa ni daa zali ni ti dol la.
en: We heard him say that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change what Moses told us to do.

dag: Ka Matitia mini Ɛlifɛlɛhu ni Mikinɛya ni Obɛdɛdom ni Jɛiɛl ni Azazia mi daa nyɛ bɛn be tooni ŋmɛri goonjɛnim kaman Shɛminit ŋmɛbu la.
en: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah played the sheminith harps. This was their job forever.

dag: Ʒirilana nyɛla ŋun sɔɣiri jɛlinsi. Ka ŋunkam zuri niriba nyaaŋa nyɛ jɛrigu.
en: Anyone who hides hatred is a liar. Anyone who spreads gossip is a fool.

dag: Yinima n niriba Izraɛlnima, n ni lan zaŋ ya labisi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka yi ti be di ni n-su li yaha. Ka yi bihi ku lan kpi di ni.
en: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.

dag: Tibili bi wumdila yɛtɔɣa ka zahindi li kaman zilinli ni lamdi bindirigu shɛm la?.
en: Doesnt the ear test words and the palate taste food?.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ti paai Bahurim, ka Sool daŋ ni do so ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛra bia ka o yuli booni Shimɛi la daa yina ti turi ba.
en: As David came to Bahurim, a man from Sauls family, Shimei son of Gera, came out cursing David again and again.

dag: Yɛnnim ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla bɛ ni daa wum shɛli bɛ yaannim sani.
en: I will tell you what wise men would say, things they heard from their fathers and then freely passed on. They didnt hide any secrets from me.

dag: Yim ka bɛ ti wum vu shɛli damli, ka di yi zuɣusaa na kaman pɔhim tital la nti pali bɛ ni daa ʒi du shɛli ni maa zaa.
en: Suddenly a sound from heaven like the howling of a fierce wind filled the entire house where they were sitting.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ kpana pam to n-chib o gbaŋ bee n-zaŋ zahimgbahiri kpana to o zuɣu ni?.
en: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?.

dag: N ni ti ti maligumaaniba bindir suma, ka n niriba ti di m pina din galisi tiɣi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will fill the priests with the richest food and satisfy all the needs of my people. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka nimaaninim daa nya o m-baŋ o, ka tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋkpan shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim zaa tahi o sanna.
en: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.

dag: Yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm tariga m-bala. Dabiɛm daa kpe man Daniɛl pam, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi, amaa ka n daa lee zaŋ yɛla maa niŋ n suhu ni.
en: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.

dag: N ni labisi yi sariakaritiba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni, ka labisi yi saawarimaaniba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan boli tiŋ maa wuntitali mini ʒiɛyimtali tiŋa.
en: I will give you rulers and advisers like those you had long ago. Then Jerusalem will be called the righteous, faithful city.

dag: Amaa ka yi yi bi niŋ o ni daa sab shɛm maa yɛda, wula ka yi lee ni niŋ n yɛligu yɛda.
en: But you dont believe what he wrote, so you cant believe what I say.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ku yɛligu maa o suhu ni, ka di bi dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim.
en: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message. But they start worrying about the needs of this life and are fooled by the desire to get rich. So the message gets choked out, and they never produce anything.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn din nyɛ nir ni daa yi ku o kpee ka zo n-kuli tin shɛli n-tiligiri la mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daŋ niriba. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Libina.
en: To the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave: Hebron, the refuge city for a killer, and its pastures; Libnah and its pastures.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fabili fabila ŋɔ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: David sang a song in memory of Saul and Jonathan.

dag: Ka o yi bi tooi deeg omaŋ soya ŋɔ zaa puuni, dindina bɛn bahim o min o bihi nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: If the Israelite is not bought back in one of these ways, they and their children must be released in the Jubilee year.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya suhupiɛlli ŋun nyɛ yi namda ŋɔ zuɣu. Ziɔnnima, maliya suhupiɛlli yi Naa zuɣu.
en: Let Israel be happy with their Maker. Let the people of Zion rejoice with their King.

dag: Yisifu daa baŋ o biɛyanim maa, amaa ka bɛn lee bi baŋ o.
en: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didnt recognize him.

dag: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: putting out leaves, you know that summer will soon come.

dag: Di saha ka o kpamba maa daa bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ shɛm maa? Bia maa ni daa na ne, a daa lola noli ka kum o zuɣu pam, amaa ka o ti lee kpi ka a yiɣisi di bindirigu.
en: His officials said, What are you doing? You went without eating and cried for your son while he was alive! But now that he's dead, you're up and eating.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko; bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi.
en: Six days later Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain, where they were alone. As they looked on, a change came over Jesus.

dag: A yi ti naai li, nyin lan dɔnim pahi buyi, amaa a nudirigu zuɣu ka a ti yɛn dɔni n-ʒi Judanim gba tibidarigibo. N zal a la biɛɣu pihinahi. Dabisili kam yɛn zanila yuuni zaani.
en: After that time, you will lie on your right side for days. This time you will bear the guilt of Judah for days. One day equals one year. I am telling you how long Judah must be punished.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ti nya do so ka o kabiri dari Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: When the Israelites were in the desert, they found a man gathering wood on the Sabbath day.

dag: Amaa ka putɔɣulaannim mini ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa pahi doli Dauda chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti bi yɛn ti ba ti ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa ŋɔ shɛli, naɣila bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ka ti ni zaŋ ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ, dama bɛ daa bi dol ti chaŋ.
en: But some mean and worthless men who had gone with David said, They didn't go with us, and so we won't give them any of the loot. They can take their wives and children and go away.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa laɣim lu Musa mini Aduna zuɣu saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa polo nya ka sagbani pun sirigina ti pani di zuɣu, ka Yawɛ jilima neesim neei.
en: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi la.
en: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;.

dag: Bɛ zaa m-mali dɔriti tibbu pina? Bɛ zaa n-tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni? Bɛ zaa n-kahigiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa gbinni wuhira?.
en: Not all have gifts of healing. Not all speak in different kinds of languages. Not all interpret those languages.

dag: N daa lan nya nahiŋgu shɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. N daa nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu maa ni kumdi shɛm, ka ka ŋun goori ba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahindi ba maa daa mali yiko pam, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ka ŋun ni gooi ba maa.
en: When I next observed all the oppressions that take place under the sun, I saw the tears of the oppressed—and they have no one to comfort them. Their oppressors wield power—but they have no one to comfort them.

dag: Sɛt daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Di simdi ni a vili zaɣ yini gbibi, amaa ka di chɛ din la gba bahi; dama ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Naawuni ni tooi gbibi di bina ayi maa zaa.
en: Avoid both extremes. If you have reverence for God, you will be successful anyway.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Reehab, Ti yɛn zaŋla ti nyɛviya n-taɣ a dini. A yi bi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla yɛli so, ka Yawɛ ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, ti ni niŋ a nirilim.
en: The men said to her, We swear by our own lives to secure yours. If you dont reveal our mission, we will deal loyally and faithfully with you when the LORD gives us the land.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm o daalibarika ni zuɣu ka n niŋ tammɛr yɛndana ŋun zali duu gbinni tanzaa, ka so mɛri tamdi di zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam gba yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, ŋun mɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Using the gift that God gave me, I did the work of an expert builder and laid the foundation, and someone else is building on it. But each of you must be careful how you build.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pia dali, yin lomiya noli ka laɣim jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa ti sɔɣi Sool ba Kish siliga ni Zɛla Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni, ka daa niŋ naa ni daa zali ni bɛ niŋm shɛlikam zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa naanyi deei bɛ suhigu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the area of Benjamin, in one of the tunnels in the grave of Sauls father Kish, as the king commanded. After that God again listened to the prayers of the people in that land.

dag: M bia, Yawɛ yi saɣis a, nyin di lihi ʒiɛm li bee o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a nyee nyɔni.
en: My child, when the Lord corrects you, pay close attention and take it as a warning.

dag: N daa zaŋ wuntitali niŋ mmaŋa, ka di pili ma. N yɛlimaŋli tuma daa ŋmanila zabba mini baŋtabiga.
en: I put on justice, and it clothed me, righteousness as my coat and turban.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: Jesus shouted and then died.

dag: Jake bia Agur yɛtɔɣ kpɛma m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Doo maa ni daa yɛli Itiɛl mini Ukal shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni, n gbarigiya, Naawuni, n gbarigiya; wula ka n yɛn niŋ di nasara?.
en: The words of Agur, Jakehs son, from Massa. The man declares: Im tired, God; Im tired, God, and Im exhausted.

dag: Bɛ maŋmaŋ niŋgbuna biɛrim kɔŋko n-naɣi mali ba, ka bɛ kuhiri bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: They only feel the pain of their body, and they mourn for themselves.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛɣu birigiya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nia viɛla nyari jilima mini ʒiɛyimtali niriba sani.
en: Dont those who plan evil go astray? Those who plan good receive loyalty and faithfulness.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋɔŋ kom tiliginsim kɔbilisi puuni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: As fresh water brings joy to the thirsty, so God's people rejoice when he saves them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A tizɔdoo maa ni neei kum ni yaha.
en: Jesus told her, Your brother will live again.

dag: Nabipuɣinsi be a dundɔŋ ni paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima la ni, ka a paani ʒe a nudirigu polo n-ye salima din yi Ofiri na.
en: Here are ladies of honor, daughters of kings. Your bride stands at your right side, wearing a gown decorated with the finest gold.

dag: Karimbaani lihigu mini ʒiŋmabo ni bɛn ka taali kubu.
en: snobbish eyes, a lying tongue, hands that spill innocent blood.

dag: Buni mini azichi ni be bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Their family will be very rich, and their goodness will continue forever.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ʒini di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa ni ʒini binshɛli zuɣu, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you sit on anything that he sat on, you must wash your clothes and bathe in water. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ teebul la na ti mal li zali di zaashee di puuni; ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la na nti zaŋ di firilanim la tam di zuɣu.
en: Bring in the table and arrange its items. Bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

dag: Ka Mikaya yɛl o, A yi labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-wuhi ma n ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka lan yɛli, Yinim salo ŋɔ zaa, wummiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: If you ever return safely, Micaiah replied, then the LORD wasnt speaking through me. Then he added, Pay attention, every last one of you.

dag: N daa darigi bɛ tibili ka di dolila bɛ daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba.
en: Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni fabili Mɔabnim zuɣu. N ni kum Mɔabnim zaa zuɣu pam, ka fabili Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu.
en: And so I will weep for everyone in Moab and for the people of Kir Heres.

dag: M biyurigu, a ʒe yim a ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa tiri ti mabihi la puuni, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ saamba la.
en: My dear friend, you are so faithful in the work you do for other Christians, even when they are strangers.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa guui chaŋ ti yɛli Musa, Ɛldad mini Mɛdad be yiŋa n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: A young man ran out to tell Moses what Eldad and Medad were doing.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When Lamech was , he had a son.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kum dɔro n-gbaag o maa. O ku lan yiɣisi o dooshee maa yaha.
en: They say, He did something wrong. That is why he is sick. He will never get well.

dag: N daa niŋ bɛn doli soli ŋɔ alaka, hal ka chɛ ka bɛ ku bɛ shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lo bɛ shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba mihi kpɛhi duu.
en: I harassed those who followed this Way to their death, arresting and delivering both men and women into prison.

dag: din nyɛ o ni daa po pɔ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma polo la yɛla.
en: This was the promise he made to our father Abraham.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, n yi na kul yihiri gunibu yɛla waazu, di chaŋ wula ka n na kul nyari nahiŋgu? Di yi nyɛ lala, dapulli waazu yihibu yɛla din nyɛ kuɣituurili la naan vuui.
en: But as for me, my friends, if I continue to preach that circumcision is necessary, why am I still being persecuted? If that were true, then my preaching about the cross of Christ would cause no trouble.

dag: Amaa ka ti Duuma malaika daa chaŋ dindali yuŋ nti yooi duu maa dunoya ka yihi ba na yɛli ba.
en: An angel from the Lord opened the prison doors during the night and led them out. The angel told them.

dag: Amaa nyin Izraɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, nyin Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ n ni pii so, ka lan nyɛ n zo Ibrahimma zuliya ŋɔ;.
en: But you, Israel my servant, you are the people that I have chosen, the descendants of Abraham, my friend.

dag: Ŋun nam tibili ni nyɛ ŋun bi wumda? Ŋun nam nini ni nyɛ ŋun bi nyara?.
en: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan po pɔri tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ni wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: And I swore yet another solemn pledge in the desert, that I would disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the earth.

dag: ka o yɛligu mi ka yi suhuri ni, dama yi bi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: and you dont have his word dwelling with you because you dont believe the one whom he has sent.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu, dama Naawuni n-daa niŋ lala ni o zaŋ ba niŋ Jɛhɔash nuu ni bɛ ni daa jɛmdi Ɛdomnim buɣa la zuɣu.
en: But Amaziah wouldnt listen, because God intended to use this to destroy them since they had sought Edoms gods.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛl o, Ka doo mini paɣ yɛla yi nyɛla lala, dindina di bi simdi ni nir kpuɣi paɣa.
en: His disciples said to him, If this is how it is between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nya ma, o nya ŋun tim ma na maa.
en: Whoever sees me sees the one who sent me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu yuya ni n lola alikauli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maa miligi ti zuɣu.
en: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.

dag: Naawuni tim a sakom din mal alibarika, ka chɛ ka a tiŋgbani vuhira. Naawuni tim a kawana mini wain pam.
en: God will bless you, my son, with dew from heaven and with fertile fields, rich with grain and grapes.

dag: Ka kɔnyuri daa gbaai Samsin pam, ka o suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Nyini n-chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ di nasara ŋɔ, ka kɔnyuri ti yɛn ku ma, ka n lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Samson was so thirsty that he prayed, Our Lord , you helped me win a battle against a whole army. Please don't let me die of thirst now. Those heathen Philistines will carry off my dead body.

dag: Di saha ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛli ba ni bɛ labimi ti yɛli Ɛsta: Di tɛhiri ni a ni be nayili maa wuhiya ni a ni yi kum ni gari Yɛhudia nir kam.
en: he sent her this warning: Don't imagine that you are safer than any other Jew just because you are in the royal palace.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Huramabi ŋun nyɛ tuumbaŋda, ka mali yɛm pam la ka a sanna.
en: I am sending Huram Abi to you. He is wise and very skillful.

dag: Dama Yawɛ sagbani maa daa kul bela o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa wuntaŋ ni, yuŋ mi ka buɣim be sagbani maa puuni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni bɛ chandi maa zaa ni.
en: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.

dag: M mabiyurisi, n ni sabiri gban shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ pahirila diba ayi. Gbana maa zaa puuni, n loya ni n neela yi nimmoo tɛha la n-teei ya yɛla ŋɔ.
en: My dear friends, this is now the second letter I have written you. In both letters I have tried to arouse pure thoughts in your minds by reminding you of these things.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla, di daa chɛ ka alahichi tumbu galisi; amaa alahichi tumbu ni galisi shɛm maa Naawuni daalibarika galisiya gari lala.
en: The Law stepped in to amplify the failure, but where sin increased, grace multiplied even more.

dag: Yawɛ kpe o niriba kpamba mini bɛ nanim saria karibu ni. O yɛliya, Yinima n-ʒe tihi puri, ka di tarimba nɛma ti niŋ yi yinsi.
en: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.

dag: Ka yi ni so miri ka o nyɛ ŋun kuri niriba bee tayiɣa bee tuumbiɛ tumda bee ŋun kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-nyari wahala di zuɣu.
en: Now none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or evildoer or rebel.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni labisi o ni ʒiɛm m pɔri shɛl la min o ni saɣim alikauli shɛli la ʒil o.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: As surely as I live, it was my solemn pledge that he scorned and my agreement that he overturned, and I will hold him accountable.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tim o dabili Musa mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ o ni daa pii so la.
en: Then he sent his servant Moses, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

dag: Nyamiya, yi tiŋguliba laɣim yili suhupiɛlli yila! Dama bɛ nini nya Yawɛ ni labisi Ziɔn zali di zaashee shɛm.
en: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.

dag: Bɛ ni daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa neei biɛɣu, ka bɛ daa tuui di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu din nyɛ kawaan shɛra mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: The next day was the first time they ate food grown in Canaan: roasted grain and bread made without yeast.

dag: Yi ni daa chaŋ Ijipti la, nyo bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Nail Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu? Bee yi ni daa chaŋ Asiria la, bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Yufretiiz Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu?.
en: People of Judah, think about this: How did it help you to go to Egypt and drink from the Nile River? How did it help you to go to Assyria and drink from the Euphrates River?.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ni ti mali suhudoo. N ni ti ti o suhudoo o dimnim bɛn zaa gil o sani; dama o yuli nti yɛn booni Sulemaana. Ka n ni ti ti Izraɛlnim suhudoo, ka binshɛli ku lan dam ba o ʒiɛman ni.
en: A son has just been born to you. Hell be a man of peace, and Ill give him peace with all his surrounding enemies. In fact, his name will be Solomon, and Ill give Israel peace and quiet during his reign.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni daa tum shɛlikam Yɛhudianim tinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm maa zaa shɛhiranima. Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ o kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o;.
en: We are witnesses of everything that he did in the land of Israel and in Jerusalem. Then they put him to death by nailing him to a cross.

dag: Ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka o nya alaafee.
en: So Moses cried out to the Lord , O God, heal her.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti laɣim Galili na ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia n-niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: When the disciples came together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Human One is about to be delivered over into human hands.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Joab and his men advanced to attack, and the Syrians fled.

dag: Bɛ shihi vu m-miri gballi ni, ka bɛ nyɛviya miri bɛn tahiri kum na.
en: A life approaches the pit; its very being draws near the death dealers.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi pa di zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa bɛ ni ŋme binshɛŋa kɔtomsi maa zuɣu n-saɣisi taba.
en: Solomon carved winged creatures, palm trees, and blossoming flowers, and covered them with gold.

dag: Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pumpɔŋɔ, ka di pala yi suhuri ni daa saɣim maa zuɣu, amaa yi suhuri ni daa saɣim ka yi niŋ tuuba la zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun saɣi ka yi suhuri daa saɣim maa, dinzuɣu yi bi kɔŋ shɛli ti ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim nuu ni ka bɛ su ba yuun pihinahi.
en: Once again the Israelites started disobeying the Lord . So he let the Philistines take control of Israel for years.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui, ka sokam daa zo n-kul o yiŋa. Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama Izraɛlnim tɔbbi tinchandib tuhi pihita ka bɛ daa ku.
en: The Philistines did fight. They killed , Israelite soldiers, and all the rest ran off to their homes.

dag: Tɔbbi so ŋun mali yɛm ni tooi nyaŋ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi nyaŋ ŋun mali yaa;.
en: A wise person is mightier than a strong one; a knowledgeable person than a powerful one.

dag: Ka luɣ shɛli n ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ pala n niriba la, nimaani ka niriba ni boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bihi.
en: And, Where God said in the past, You are not my people— there they will be called children of the living God. Hosea :.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool, Yawɛ n-daa tim ma na ka n ti booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leeg o niriba naa; dinzuɣu wummi ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: One day, Samuel told Saul: The Lord told me to choose you to be king of his people, Israel. Now listen to this message from the Lord :.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa miri ba daa wum bɛ kuhigu ka guui; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Tiŋgbani ni vali ti gba.
en: All the Israelites who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, The earth may swallow us.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa tim Izraɛlnim maa sani ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka bɛn biŋkɔbigu zaɣ yino gba bi kpi. Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Pharaoh asked around and found out that not one of Israels livestock had died. But Pharaoh was stubborn, and he wouldnt let the people go.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa daa nyɛla ti gula hal ka Masia ti kana ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: And so the Law was in charge of us until Christ came, in order that we might then be put right with God through faith.

dag: Ifriimnim bela muɣisigu ni, ka diri wahala saria karibu ni, bɛ ni lo ni bɛ dolila binshɛŋa din ka buchi zuɣu.
en: Ephraim will be punished. He will be crushed and pressed like grapes, because he decided to follow filth.

dag: Zallakudura Naa ni daa ti zuliyanim bɛ tiŋgbana saha shɛl o ni daa woligi daadamnima, o daa zali zuliya kam tintarisi kaman Izraɛlnim kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them.

dag: A yɛliya, Mbusim be n zuɣu. Yawɛ zaŋ suhugarigu pahi m biɛrim zuɣu; n ŋuhirimi hal ti tarigi, ka bi nyari vuhim. .
en: You are moaning and blaming me, the Lord , for your troubles and sorrow, and for being so tired that you can't even rest.

dag: Niŋm ba kaman a ni daa niŋ Midiannim mini Sisɛra ni Jabin shɛm Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni la.
en: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek.

dag: O daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu nir saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa Jɛrusalɛm yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka o yuli booni Abija.
en: at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

dag: ni Mɛrayɔt ni Amaria ni Ahitub.
en: his son Meraioth, his son Amariah, his son Ahitub.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ lala, dama bɛ bi mi ma balle m-mi m Ba Naawuni.
en: They will do this because they have not known the Father, and they have not known me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa yɛli Samuɛl, Cham ti dɔni, o yi ti lan bol a, nyin yɛlima, Yawɛ, yɛlima, a dabili wumda. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa lan lab ti dɔni o dooshee maa.
en: So Eli said to Samuel, Go and lie down. If he calls you, say, Speak, LORD. Your servant is listening. So Samuel went and lay down where hed been.

dag: Ka Yisa daa nya o m-bol o na ti yɛl o, A yipa nya amaŋa a dɔro ŋɔ ni.
en: When Jesus saw her, he called to her, Woman, you have been made free from your sickness.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tibig o niriba laɣiŋgu ni, ka paɣ o kpamba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.

dag: Tahat ni Uriɛl ni Uzia ni Shaul.
en: Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, Shaul.

dag: n-yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo m-mali hal ti paai Mariɛl n-zaŋ ti to Dabɛshɛt n-gari chaŋ hal ti paai Jokiniam wulimpuhili polo kulibɔŋ la.
en: Their border went up westward to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and touched the ravine that is opposite Jokneam.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yil shɛl ni o ni daa yɛn be, ka di ʒe saria karibu zɔŋ nyaaŋa la, lala ka bɛ daa me di gba. Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me yil shɛli ka di be kaman o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ me zɔn shɛl la n-ti o ni daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣin so la.
en: The section of the palace where Solomon lived was behind Justice Hall and looked exactly like it. He had a similar place built for his wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, A ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: What do you want me to do? Jonathan said to David. Ill do it.

dag: Di saha ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A ni nyɛ n dɔɣira maa zuɣu, a yɛn tumla tuma ti ma yoli? Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n yo a shɛm.
en: Laban said to Jacob, You shouldnt have to work for free just because you are my relative. Tell me what you would like to be paid.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti biri bimbir shɛli gari yi wain tihi puu ni, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi ni biri binshɛli maa mini wain tihi maa wala zaa.
en: You must not plant seeds of grain in the same fields as your grapevines. Why? Because then they become useless —both the grapes and the grain produced by the seeds you planted.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ bu Jɛrimia, ka ba o bandi ʒili Bɛnjamin dunɔdali din daa be zuɣusaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu polo la.
en: he beat the prophet and detained him in confinement at the upper Benjamin Gate in the LORDs temple.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ a bihi tibili darigibu. A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, bɛ ku kpi.
en: Don't hesitate to discipline children. A good spanking won't kill them.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa kuhi yɛli, Molimi molo! Ka m bɔhi, M molimi molo bɔ? Ka o yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli ni ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri; bɛ bi yuuri gari tipum.
en: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, What should I shout? We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: It was during his reign that the Babylonian army, commanded by King Nebuchadnezzar's officers, marched against Jerusalem and besieged it.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goondaa la luhi, ka nyo nayili zaa buɣim, ka saɣim duɣuri mini la viɛl shɛŋa din daa be nayili maa zaa.
en: He burned down the Temple and the city, with all its palaces and its wealth, and broke down the city wall.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti yɛl o zuliya maa, N saɣi kpibu; amaa Naawuni ni ti ka yi sanna nti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya kulisi o ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: When Joseph was near death, he said to his brothers, My time to die is almost here. But I know that God will take care of you and lead you out of this country. God will lead you to the land he promised to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: N ni chɛ ba n-zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni doli man Yawɛ soli kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: and I'm going to let those enemies stay. I'll use them to test Israel, because then I can find out if Israel will worship and obey me as their ancestors did.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ya Yawɛ maligumaaniba, ka lan boli ya Naawuni tumtumdiba. Yi ni ti di zuliya shɛb azichi daanfaani, ka nyu bara di ni nyɛ yi dini maa zuɣu.
en: You will be called, The Lord s Priests, The Servants of our God. You will be proud of all the riches that have come to you from all the nations on earth.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, di luhiya ni yi yɛl lala? Yawɛ suɣilo maa naami? O niŋsim m-bala? N yɛtɔɣa bi niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuun suma zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: But people of Jacob, I must say these things. The Lord is losing his patience because of the bad things you did. If you lived right, I could say nice words to you.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim tuumba o biɛli Iso sani Siɛr Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daŋ o tooni.
en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau, toward the land of Seir, the open country of Edom.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka daai Gaat mini Jamnia ni Ashidɔd goondahi zaa luhi, ka me fɔntinsi miri Ashidɔd mini Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: He marched against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Then he rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ku yɛligu maa o suhu ni, ka di bi dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim.
en: As for the seed that was spread among thorny plants, this refers to those who hear the word, but the worries of this life and the false appeal of wealth choke the word, and it bears no fruit.

dag: Bɛ pahimi yi zuɣu ka yi tummi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma mini bɛ tuun shɛŋa din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni zaa; ka ninvuɣ zino miri ka o zaŋ omaŋ bali yi ni.
en: They are to work with you and fulfill their responsibilities for all the service in the Tent, but no unqualified person may work with you.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi la mini binnɛma anahi la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee la ka yɛra, Ami! Haliluya.
en: After this, the elders and the four living creatures all knelt before the throne of God and worshiped him. They said, Amen! Praise the Lord.

dag: ka Jɔnatan daa nyɛ Maluki daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ Shɛbania daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Malluch, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, N yi kul yi a sani chaŋ, n ni suhi Yawɛ ni o chɛ ka zɔhi pam ŋɔ zo nyin Firawuna min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa sani biɛɣuni ŋɔ. Amaa lee di lan yɔhim n-chɛ ka niriba maa bi chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Moses said, Look, I will leave and ask the Lord to remove the flies from you, your people, and your officials tomorrow. But you must not stop the people from offering sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Anabi Ilaija daa nyɛla ninsala kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka o daa ti suhi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa ni saa di mi, ka saa maa daa shiri bi tɔɣisi lu tiŋgbani zuɣu yuun muna ata ni pirigili.
en: Elijah was a person just like us. He prayed that it would not rain. And it did not rain on the land for three and a half years!.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Paɣa, niŋm ma yɛda ni saha kanna ka yi ti ku lan jɛm ti Ba Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu bee Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jesus said to her, Believe me, woman, the time is coming when you and your people will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

dag: So ni ti gbaag o daŋ puuni ninvuɣ so n-yɛl o, A mali binyɛrigu, leemi ti zuɣulana n-su binshɛɣukam din wurim doya ŋɔ.
en: A time will come when the members of a clan will choose one of their number and say to him, You at least have something to wear, so be our leader in this time of trouble.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la n daa saɣisi ba ni nimmoo, ka kul saɣisiri ba waawaayili hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-yɛra, Deemiya n noli.
en: I gave a warning to your ancestors at the time I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I have warned them again and again to this day. I told them to obey me.

dag: Yi niriba anu ni ti kar doli niriba kɔbiga, ka yi niriba kɔbiga ni ti kar doli niriba tuhi pia n-zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dimnim maa.
en: even if there are only of you and of them, or only of you and , of them.

dag: ni zuɣu nachintɛri ni bɔɣugbina bansi ni shɛlɔriti ni tulaale adakanima ni gurima.
en: and their hats; the magic charms they wear on their arms and at their waists;.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri yɛla muɣis a; a mi di zabiri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nyuli.
en: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.

dag: A bela n tooni ni n nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu.
en: You are all around me—in front of me and behind me. I feel your hand on my shoulder.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul larila ninvuɣ biɛri maa, dama o mi ni bɛ biɛɣu kanna.
en: But my Lord just laughs at them because he knows that their day is coming.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa n-chɛ ka n yiɣisi zani m ba Dauda zaani n-ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The LORD has kept his promise—I have succeeded my father David on Israels throne just as the LORD said, and I have built the temple for the name of the LORD, Israels God.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi daɣiri ni m-bala, di yi pa lala bɛ ni saɣim m biɛhigu shee din be bɛ sunsuuni ŋɔ ka kpi ni bɛ daɣiri.
en: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya; di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, I want to! Now you are well. At once the man's leprosy disappeared.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa yɛli sapashin la min o tɔbbihi, Niriba ŋɔ yi yi ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni; yi ku tiligi.
en: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi maani yɛla ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi zaŋdi yi yɛla tahiri cheechi ni bi dihi ninvuɣ shɛb bebu tabili sani?.
en: If such matters come up, are you going to take them to be settled by people who have no standing in the church?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi ti Masia yurilim ni? Muɣisigu bee wahala bee alaka bee fifali bee gbinfini bee barina bee takɔbi ni tooi yihi ti di ni?.
en: Can anything separate us from Christs love? Can trouble or problems or persecution separate us from his love? If we have no food or clothes or face danger or even death, will that separate us from his love?.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, N ni gbaai m buzɔŋ ni bubil polli ti a. Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, Ka bimbɔ ka a yɛn zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira hal ka a ti zaŋ bua maa ti ma na.
en: He answered, I will send you a young goat from my flock. She said, All right, if you will give me something to keep as a pledge until you send the goat.

dag: Bɛ malila shili n-kariti doli ma, ka di pala n taali zuɣu. Yiɣisim kana ti sɔŋ ma ka nya.
en: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.

dag: Yimiya Babilɔn; zomiya ka chɛ ba. Tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu n-yɛli di yɛla. Ka mol li ka dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nim wum li. Yɛlimiya, Yawɛ tilig o dabili Yaakubu zuliya.
en: Go out from Babylon, go free! Shout the news gladly; make it known everywhere: The Lord has saved his servant Israel.

dag: Yuuni kam o ma daa yi shɛrila binyɛr bila m-mali chani ti tir o saha shɛl o min o yidana daa yi ti chaŋ ni bɛ ti mali yuuniyuuni sara maa.
en: Every year Samuels mother made a robe for Samuel. She took the little robe to Samuel when she went up to Shiloh with her husband for the sacrifice every year.

dag: Ti ka soli ni ti kpuɣ paɣiba n-ʒiri ba kaman ti tuuntab mini ti Duuma tizɔbihi ni Pita ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: Dont we have the right to travel with a wife who believes like the rest of the apostles, the Lords brothers, and Cephas?.

dag: Ka Aduna zaŋ Lɛvinim maa zali Yawɛ tooni kaman Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahi zuɣusaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi tum Yawɛ tuma.
en: Aaron will present the Levites as an uplifted offering in the LORDs presence from the Israelites so that they may do the LORDs service.

dag: M mabihi, m bi tɛhi ni m pun nya li, amaa n ni niŋdi bin yini shɛli nyɛla n tamdila binshɛɣukam din be n nyaaŋa yɛla, ka kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m paala din be n tooni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I know that I still have a long way to go. But there is one thing I do: I forget what is in the past and try as hard as I can to reach the goal before me.

dag: Yawɛ, n teer a yuli yɛla yuŋ, ka dol a zaligu.
en: In the night I remember you, Lord , and I think about your law.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli Zɛrubabɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Pa a kpiɔŋ bee a yiko zuɣu, amaa n Shia yiko zuɣu.
en: The angel told me to give Zerubbabel this message from the Lord : You will succeed, not by military might or by your own strength, but by my spirit.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ kpe Pɛɔr buɣili Baal jɛmbu ni. Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Israel became attached to the Baal of Peor, and the LORD was angry at the Israelites.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa maag o paɣa Batishiiba suhu, ka o min o daa lan dɔni ka o dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Sulemaana. Ka Yawɛ daa yur o pam.
en: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba. He had intercourse with her, and she bore a son, whom David named Solomon. The Lord loved the boy.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni m-pun nyɛ n naa kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ; ka tumdi tiliginsim tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But you have been our king from the beginning, O God; you have saved us many times.

dag: O tiri bɛn zɔr o bindirigu; o bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla.
en: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam yɛla pala yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla yiko yɛla.
en: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.

dag: Shɛlomɔt ŋɔ min o mabihi n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naa Dauda min o dɔɣirikpamba ni sapashinnim bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni bɛn su kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi ni sapashin kpamba ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti maani sara la fukumsi.
en: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord . These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ka bɛ daa daŋ tiŋgbani tibu kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa dola Juda mini Yisifu zuliya niriba tiŋgbana sunsuuni.
en: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi yira, ka shɛb gba zaŋ alizin birigu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu tahi Yisa sanna.
en: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya saŋkpalima bee muli zaɣ nyama ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li, ka di saha na bi paai.
en: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: Make a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Embroider it with figures of winged creatures.

dag: Nyini n-galisi, ka su yiko mini jilima ni nasara ni nam dariza zaa, dama nyini n-su binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa ni tiŋa. Yawɛ, nyini n-nya duhibu gari sokam zaa.
en: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋgbani ti dam pam hal ka duu maa gbinni ti sɔhira, ka sarika duu maa dunoya zaa dii yooi, ka sokam bandi baai.
en: All at once there was such a violent earthquake that it shook the prisons foundations. The doors flew open and everyones chains came loose.

dag: Ka biɛhigu ti ku niŋ asama tin ya zuliyanim maa sani, ka yi ti ku nya luɣ shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ yi napɔŋ zali vuhi. Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira nimaani, ka ninsabiga mali ya, ka nandahima ti mali ya yi suhuri ni.
en: You will find no peace anywhere, no place to call your own; the Lord will overwhelm you with anxiety, hopelessness, and despair.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛri ŋun turi niriba taali paŋd o nyɛla ŋun bɔri zɔtali, amaa ŋunkam teeri zabili nyɛla ŋun saɣindi zɔtali.
en: If you want people to like you, forgive them when they wrong you. Remembering wrongs can break up a friendship.

dag: daa su ʒiʒiriba fukumsi, ka wuhiri bɛnkam daa tumdi tuma balibu kam bɛ ni yɛn tumdi li shɛm. Ka Lɛvinim maa shɛb daa nyɛ gbansabiriba, ka shɛb nyɛ kpamba, ka shɛb mi nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: were also in charge of the laborers and all the workers, no matter what their jobs, while some of the Levites served as scribes, officials, and guards.

dag: O daa kurigimi zaa, ka daa ti kpi, ka o bidibisi, Iso mini Yaakubu sɔɣ o.
en: Isaac took his last breath and died. He was buried with his ancestors after a long, satisfying life. His sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

dag: Dama yi bɔhira, Nabia maa yil la be ya? Ninvuɣ biɛɣu maa ni daa be yili shɛl ni la lee be ya.
en: You say, Where is the officials house? Where is the tent, the dwelling of the wicked.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa tɔbbihi nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme n-dee li.
en: The LORD proclaims: This city will certainly be handed over to the army of Babylons king, who will capture it.

dag: Ka padiriba maa daa gbahi o yiŋbihi maa n-fiɛb bɛ yino, ka ku yino, ka lab yino mi kuɣa.
en: The tenants grabbed his slaves, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

dag: O daa mali di gbaya maa ka di ŋmanila chɛchɛbuŋ gbaya. Di spindilinim mini di fiilinim ni di sipuɣisinim ni di duɣuri zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: The wheels were like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of bronze.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam dol o yɛligu, dilana n-nyɛ Naawuni yurilim ni niŋ dɛde so ni. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ ni ti be Naawuni ni.
en: But when we obey Gods teaching, his love is truly working in us. This is how we know that we are living in him.

dag: Bɛ dihi ti vi, dama bɛ turi ti. Ti lan ka jilima, dama tinzunnim kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee la.
en: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Yawɛ tooni n-kum niŋ o, ka lo noli hal ni zaawuni; ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Then all the people of Israel went up to Bethel and mourned. They sat there in the Lord 's presence and did not eat until evening. They offered fellowship sacrifices and burned some sacrifices whole—all in the presence of the Lord .

dag: N ni fo ka yi wuhi ma. Chɛliya ka m baŋ n ni tum gala shɛli.
en: All right, teach me; tell me my faults. I will be quiet and listen to you.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni m-pun nyɛ n naa kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ; ka tumdi tiliginsim tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Yet God has been my king from ancient days— God, who makes salvation happen in the heart of the earth!.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa mali biɛrisuŋ Naawuni sani, ka daa suh o ni o chɛ ka o me jɛmbu duu ti ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o yab Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: He won God's favor and asked God to allow him to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

dag: Ka a nudirigu nini yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini, di so ni bɛ ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ zaa kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: So if your right eye causes you to sin, take it out and throw it away! It is much better for you to lose a part of your body than to have your whole body thrown into hell.

dag: ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmani maa ʒim shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ʒi shɛli din kpalim yi m-bahi sara maligu bimbini maa gbini, di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: Then he will sprinkle some of the blood of the purification offering on the side of the altar. The rest of the blood will be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a purification offering.

dag: ka hal ti ni daa nyɛ bɛn kpi ti nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu la, o daa neei ti mini Masia kum ni. Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka yi tiligi.
en: We were spiritually dead because of all we had done against him. But he gave us new life together with Christ.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini ka n niŋ naani; n yɛliya, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: But my trust is in you, O Lord ; you are my God.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim, n suhigu paar a asiba.
en: Lord , I call to you for help; every morning I pray to you.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Mahili mini Mushi ni Jaazia n-daa nyɛ kpamba Mɛrari daŋ ni.
en: Meraris family: Mahli, Mushi and his son Jaaziahs family.

dag: Bɛ ni daa duri daboli n-kpɛri tiŋ maa ni, ka bɛ daa tuhi paɣisara soli ka bɛ chani kuliga, ka bɛ bɔhi ba, Ŋun nyari niriba yɛla la beni.
en: They were going up the hill to the town when they met some young women coming out to draw water. Is the seer here? they asked them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋme n-deei bɛ fɔntinsi mini bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. Dindali maa Mɔab tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka o suhu be shɛm la.
en: Your cities and fortresses will be captured, and your warriors as fearful as women giving birth.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi pina; di nyɛla jɛrilim o sani hal ka o ku tooi baŋ di yɛla, dama di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri yɛl shɛŋa.
en: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.

dag: Pita ni daa kul ʒiya tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛl o, Nyama, niriba ata kana ti bɔr a.
en: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, Listen, three men are looking for you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya malaika so ka o ʒe wuntaŋa n-kuhiri pampam booni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ha yɛra: Laɣimmiya na nti di Naawuni ni tin ya bindir shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun. In a loud voice the angel said to all the birds flying in the sky, Come together for the great supper of God.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Afɛk la, ka Izraɛlnim mi laɣim biliga din be Jɛziriil tiŋgban ni la gbini.
en: The Philistines assembled all their forces at Aphek, and the Israelites camped by the spring in Jezreel.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni niŋ zaŋ yi ba biŋkɔbiri ti ma.
en: God has taken flocks away from your father and given them to me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu ka lihi nya Ishimail zuliya sochandiba, ka bɛ yi Giliad n-taɣiri bɛ laakumnim bɛn ʒiri taansuri mini kpam ni mɛɛr, bɛ ni zaŋdi shɛŋa maani tima kuni Ijipti.
en: While they were eating, they suddenly saw a group of Ishmaelites traveling from Gilead to Egypt. Their camels were loaded with spices and resins.

dag: Ka salo maa tahi bɛ zuɣu ni bɛ foma; amaa ka bɛ maan kuhi pam yɛli, Ti dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: The people there criticized the blind men and told them to be quiet. But they shouted more and more, Lord, Son of David, please help us.

dag: Hal o ni ti chaŋ ti liri Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la gba n-ku niriba tuhi pii nimaani. Amaa kulla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Ɛdom mini Mɔab ni Ammɔn zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn kpalim kɔŋko n-ni ti yi o nuu ni.
en: He will even invade the Promised Land and kill tens of thousands, but the countries of Edom, Moab, and what is left of Ammon will escape.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ka tumdi n yubu hal nti paai di bahigu, n ni ti o yiko ka o su zuliya paai shɛm fukumsi.
en: To those who emerge victorious, keeping my practices until the end, I will give authority over the nations.

dag: N daa lan yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na m mali ya be mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi ni yi deei Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: I brought you out of Egypt, led you through the desert for forty years, and gave you the land of the Amorites to be your own.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl daa nyɛla naa Saawaralana, ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir la daa nyɛ naa zo sumo.
en: Ahithophel was the kings counselor, and Hushai the Archite was the kings political advisor.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni yi zuɣu.
en: After the meal he took another cup of wine in his hands. Then he said, This is my blood. It is poured out for you, and with it God makes his new agreement.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the purple robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.

dag: ni Shɛfatia daŋ niriba ni Hatil daŋ niriba ni Pokɛrɛt Hazɛbaim daŋ niriba ni Amɔn daŋ niriba.
en: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pokereth Hazzebaim, and Amon.

dag: Yihimiya yi biɛr kurili din chɛ ka yi be kaman yi ni daa pun be shɛm la bahi, dama yi biɛr kurili maa daa pun saɣim la kɔr biɛ shɛŋa din daa yɔhim ya la puuni.
en: You were taught to leave your old self. This means that you must stop living the evil way you lived before. That old self gets worse and worse, because people are fooled by the evil they want to do.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni yinim bɛn daa nyɛ alahichi daba la ni doli wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa deei ni yi suhuri zaa la zuɣu.
en: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.

dag: M bilim ni n daa bela mmaŋmaŋ tindɔɣirili ni mini Jɛrusalɛm; ka di saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ Yɛhudianim zaa mi m bebu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Every Jew knows the way of life I have followed since my youth because, from the beginning, I was among my people and in Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam neesim titaŋa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He made the great lights. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka Barakɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Buz daŋ ni nir la bia Ɛlihu maa daa garigi yɛli, Man nyɛla bia, ka yi mi nyɛ ninkura, dinzuɣu ka n di zɔri dabiɛm ka shini, ka bi yɛli ya din be n suhu ni maa.
en: and began to speak. I am young, and you are old, so I was afraid to tell you what I think.

dag: ni Shabɛtai mini Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu Samban ni tuma fukumsi la.
en: as well as Shabbethai and Jozabad, who were some of the leaders of the Levites in charge of the outside work on Gods house.

dag: Yi nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb o ni yu ka pii leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba. Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi zaŋ nambɔzɔbo mini nirilim niŋbu ni maŋsiɣisibutali ni tarimtali ni suɣilɔdibo kpɛhi yi tɛr ni.
en: You are the people of God; he loved you and chose you for his own. So then, you must clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be tibi ni ŋun niŋdi din viɛla, dinzuɣu ka o wuhiri alahichinima di soli maa.
en: The Lord is good and does what is right. He shows sinners the right way to live.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! N ni puhi Yawɛ ni n suhu zaa, o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Praise the LORD! I thank the LORD with all my heart in the company of those who do right, in the congregation.

dag: Kaman kuɣikpɛra ni zaŋdi chiriga n-chirigiri binyɛra pari kuɣa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a ti yɛn zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya, ka zaŋ li taɣili di salima bintaɣindisi ni.
en: Like a gem cutter who engraves official seals, you will engrave the two stones with the names of Israels sons. Mount them in gold settings.

dag: Man Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bala. To, nyin Bɛlitishaaza, wuhim ma di gbinni. Dama baŋdiba zaa bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni so kani n-ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa nyin ni tooi, dama wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni.
en: This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. So now Belteshazzar, tell me the meaning because all the sages in my kingdom were unable to interpret it for me. But you are able to do it because the breath of the holy gods is in you.

dag: Jɛhɔram daa mali tizɔbihi bɛn nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Azaria mini Jɛhiɛl ni Zakaria ni Azaria ni Maikil ni Shɛfatia. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa bidibisi.
en: King Jehoshaphat had seven sons: Jehoram, Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa tɔɣisi bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛl lala. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Cham Ramɔtigiliad nti tuhi di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: All the other prophets said the same thing. March against Ramoth and you will win, they said. The Lord will give you victory.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Elihu continued talking and said.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: Rehoboam and Jeroboam were always fighting against each other.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa yiɣisi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei la ka bɛ zaa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka bɛ yino bi kpalim ka bi du.
en: So David and his people crossed over the Jordan River. By sunrise, all of Davids people had crossed the Jordan River. No one was left behind.

dag: Ka tia maa daa kul zoori n-niŋdi zaɣ titali hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: It grew stronger and higher, until it reached to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni anabinim mini nanim pam daa bɔri ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ, ka bi nya li; ka daa lan bɔri ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ, ka daa bi wum li.
en: Many prophets and kings were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o.
en: Those who were walking by insulted Jesus, shaking their heads.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Niriba bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: These are the enlisted Israelites by their households. The total enlisted in the camps with their military units is .

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti gbahi ya niŋ ya alaka, ka tahi ya bɛ jɛmbu duri mini sarikanim ni, ka ti zaŋ ya tahi nazuɣuri mini gomnanim tooni n yuli zuɣu pɔi ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa naanyi niŋ.
en: Before all these things take place, however, you will be arrested and persecuted; you will be handed over to be tried in synagogues and be put in prison; you will be brought before kings and rulers for my sake.

dag: Man Jɔn kpahiri ŋunkam wum anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni zuɣu ni: Ŋunkam pahi shɛli di ni, Naawuni ni zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam din sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la m-pah o tibidarigibo zuɣu;.
en: I warn everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds anything to these, God will give that person the plagues written about in this book.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ hal ka yi ti ku ba naai.
en: The Lord will put your enemies in your power and make them panic until they are destroyed.

dag: Dama bɛ ma daa gɔrila pagɔrisigu; paɣ so ŋun daa tiɣi bɛ pua daa tumla vi tuma. Dama o daa yɛliya, N ni chaŋ m mamanim bɛn tiri ma bindirigu mini kom ni ago ni atampanima ni kpam ni dam ŋɔ sani.
en: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.

dag: A nyu bara yɛli ni a gbi kɔbilisi tinzun tinsi ni n-nyu di kom, ka a tɔbbihi siɣi Nail Mɔɣili ni n-no n-gili ka di kom nyuui.
en: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.

dag: Buni chɛ ka nir nyarila zɔnim pam, amaa faranim bɛn ka zɔnima.
en: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm ŋɔ; fom ka n yɛl a.
en: Listen, Job; hear me; be quiet, and I will speak.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa o biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Naawuni la.
en: you must put your hand on the animals head and kill it in front of the Meeting Tent. Then Aarons sons will splash the animals blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi: Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: And I tell you: Ask and you will receive. Seek and you will find. Knock and the door will be opened to you.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la, ka Yisa nyaandoliba bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the day the lambs for the Passover meal were killed, Jesus' disciples asked him, Where do you want us to go and get the Passover meal ready for you.

dag: N kul ni niŋdi n ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka bɛn yɛli ni ti mini ba dolila so yini n-tumdi la ku nya daliri nyu bara.
en: But Im going to continue to do what Im doing. I want to contradict the claims of the people who want to be treated like they are the same as us because of what they brag about.

dag: Dama nir yi kpi, o ku lan teeg a yɛla; ka ŋuni n-ni tooi paɣ a gballi ni?.
en: No one is going to praise you when they are dead. Who gives you thanks from the grave?.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛli ba, M pun lo n suhu ni ni n chɛ ka yinim n-yɛli ma zahindi maa, ka lan wuhi maa di gbinni. Yi yi ku tooi niŋ lala, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋmahiŋmahi ya chɛrachɛra, ka chɛ ka bɛ wurim yi yinsi.
en: The king answered the Chaldeans: My decision is final: If you cant tell me the dream and its meaning, you will be torn limb from limb, and your houses will be turned into trash dumps.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihitaniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛdida, o daa nyɛla Adaya, Bɔzikat nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Josiah was eight years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-one years. His mother was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah from the town of Bozkath.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ piɛla yino n-chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Then tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on the head of one of the rams.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anabinim maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla bintɔri dihi ba, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nyuhi ba. Dama tuumbiɛri maa yila Jɛrusalɛm anabinim maa sani n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord , promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, Nyama, dahin shɛli a ni ti yɛn zo nti sɔɣ a dudoonigu ni, ka a ni baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You will find out when you go into some back room to hide, Micaiah replied.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa tɔɣisi bɛ zuɣulaannim maa yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu maa hal ka yi ti me li naai.
en: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.

dag: Pita ni daa ti kul zaŋ o zuɣu tiriti dunol ni ka Kɔniilius dii yiɣisi nti gban o tooni jɛmd o.
en: As Peter was about to go in, Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and bowed down before him.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋuna, di simdi ni a mali suhukpeeni, di chɛ ka a kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama a nya a ni tum tuun shɛli maa laara.
en: But as for you, be brave and dont lose heart, because your work will be rewarded.

dag: Du shɛli din dunoya daa kpa Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani wulinluhili polo la yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihitanaanu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛla mita pihinahinaanu, ka di dikili barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili gili di zaa.
en: At the far end of the open space on the west side of the Temple there was a building feet long and feet wide; its walls were feet thick all around.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka bol o, Ibrahimma, Ibrahimma! Ka o saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But the angel of the Lord stopped him. The angel called from heaven and said, Abraham, Abraham! Abraham answered, Yes.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Mikal, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma lala n-chɛ ka n dim maa zo n-tiligi? Ka Mikal garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ; a yi bi chɛ ka n chaŋ n ni ku a. .
en: Saul said to Michal, Why did you trick me like this? You let my enemy escape, and now he is gone. Michal answered Saul, David told me he would kill me if I didnt help him escape.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba alaka nyɛla bɛn turi ŋun nam ba, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba nirilim tir o la jilima.
en: Whoever takes advantage of the poor insults their Maker, but whoever is kind to them honors him.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Dinzuɣu a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela neesim ni;.
en: Your eyes are a window for your body. When they are good, you have all the light you need.

dag: Ka o daa lan yihi Ashɛra binnani din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la na nti zaŋ li yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ tariga n-chaŋ Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti nyo li buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmɛnŋme m-burisi li n-va li ti bahi tiŋ maa gbala ni.
en: Josiah had the sacred pole for Asherah brought out of the temple and taken to Kidron Valley, where it was burned. He then had its ashes ground into dust and scattered over the public cemetery there.

dag: A bilim ni ha mi ka a pun mi Naawuni Sabbu Kasi din ni tooi wuh a tiliginsim soli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la.
en: and you remember that ever since you were a child, you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to give you the wisdom that leads to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni: Di saha maa alizanda nam ni ti ŋmanila paɣipiɛlisi pia bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ firilanim chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi amiliya aŋgo soli.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened one night when ten young women took their oil lamps and went to a wedding to meet the groom.

dag: Ka o ma yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn yɛl a no shɛli maa doli ma, nyin dee doli n ni wuh a shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti gbahi bubihi pola maa ti ma na.
en: So Rebekah said to him, I will accept the blame if there is trouble. Do what I said. Go get the goats for me.

dag: Ka o lan zaŋ ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni kul ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli na ti mali sara.
en: Then he shall offer one of the doves or pigeons.

dag: Yɛlim paɣ kura la gba ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura, ka pa ni munaafichinima bee bɛn nyɛ danyubo daba. Di simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn wuhiri din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Also, teach the older women to live the way those who serve the Lord should live. They should not go around saying bad things about others or be in the habit of drinking too much. They should teach what is good.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm daa ti tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinima ni bɛ ti bɔhi Jɔn ni o lee nyɛla ŋuni.
en: The Jewish authorities in Jerusalem sent some priests and Levites to John to ask him, Who are you.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, niŋmiya suɣilo n-deei n saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama yɛtɔɣa biɛla ka n zaŋ n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: I beg you, my friends, to listen patiently to this message of encouragement; for this letter I have written you is not very long.

dag: o ni daa niŋ Ijipti tɔbbihi mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shɛm la ni o ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu di ba shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kariti doli ya la. Yawɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi gbaag omaŋa ŋmanila bɛ ni kabi kpe gooni ni gili tin shɛli ni shɛm la.
en: If you cannot control your anger, you are as helpless as a city without walls, open to attack.

dag: Tiligim amaŋa kaman waliga ni tiligi tɔha nuu ni shɛm la bee kaman nooŋa ni tiligi noongbahira nuu ni shɛm la.
en: Get yourself free like a gazelle from a hunter, like a bird from the hand of a fowler.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti ni baai du n-chaŋ bɛ sani ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi ba.
en: Jonathan said, Lets go! Well cross the valley and go to the Philistine guards. Well let them see us.

dag: Dinzuɣu n lan zaŋ ya taali yaha, ka zaŋ yi yaansi gba taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini maligumaana Abiata n-leeg o saawaranima, ka bɛ dol o n-sɔŋd o.
en: Adonijah talked with Joab son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest. They decided to help make him the new king.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Jɛhɔshafat, ka o niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ, ka moli molo ni sokam lom noli Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa.
en: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.

dag: Yi ni daa paai kpe na, Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi daa kana ti liri ti n-tuhi ti, amaa ka ti daa nyaŋ ba.
en: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.

dag: Ka binshɛli din ŋmani buɣim zilima puhi yina nti tamtam bɛ zaa yinoyino zuɣu ni ti kpa.
en: They saw what seemed to be individual flames of fire alighting on each one of them.

dag: Ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ kuriti mali binyila ka yɛli, Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Binyila ŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe Sirianim ŋɔ hal ti naai bɛ balibu. .
en: One of them, Zedekiah son of Chenaanah, made iron horns and said to Ahab, This is what the Lord says, With these you will fight the Syrians and totally defeat them.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Yisifu zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Bɛnjamin zuliya ni mi tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Zebulun: , from the tribe of Joseph: , from the tribe of Benjamin: .

dag: Ka Kɛnan maa daa nyɛ Ɛnɔs bia, ka Ɛnɔs nyɛ Sɛt bia, ka Sɛt mi nyɛ Adam bia, ka Adam mi nyɛ Naawuni bia.
en: son of Enos son of Seth son of Adam son of God.

dag: Di saha ka Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar maa daa lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma. Di nyaaŋa ka Shafan daa karim li wuhi naa.
en: Then the secretary Shaphan told the king, The priest Hilkiah has given me a scroll, and he read it out loud before the king.

dag: nti chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni nimaani ka o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka yi piɛb kikaa ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: When you get there, Zadok and Nathan will pour olive oil over Solomon's head to show that he is the new king of Israel. Then order someone to blow a trumpet and tell everyone to shout, Long live King Solomon.

dag: A zaŋ a ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi niŋ bɛ nuu ni:.
en: You put them in charge of everything you made. You put everything under their control.

dag: Amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku ka n sanna ti nya nyɛvili.
en: But you refuse to come to me to have that life.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bala, biɛɣuni ni sa nyɛ vuhim dabisi tibisili ka nyɛ Yawɛ vuhim dabisi kasi la zuɣu. Shɛmiya yin ni tooi she shɛli zuŋɔ, ka duɣiya yin ni tooi duɣi shɛli zuŋɔ, ka din guui yin zaŋmiya li zali hal ni asiba.
en: and he said to them, The Lord has commanded that tomorrow is a holy day of rest, dedicated to him. Bake today what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Whatever is left should be put aside and kept for tomorrow.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N ni niŋ Naawuni naani. Ka daa lan yɛli yaha, M mini bi shɛba n Duuma Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ma la ni laɣim be.
en: He also said, I will trust God. Then he said, Here I am with the children God has given me.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Malaki ni o yɛli Izraɛlnima.
