en: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel.

dag: ni yɛli Yawɛ, A sani n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee, ni m birini; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani ŋɔ.
en: Then you will say to the Lord , You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Zadok bia, ka o yuli booni Jɛrusha.
en: at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. His mother was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

dag: Ka Balak daa kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri duɣi tahi ti ti Balaam mini kpamba bɛn daa be o sani.
en: Balak killed some cattle and some sheep as his sacrifice. He gave some of the meat to Balaam and some to the leaders who were with him.

dag: Ara daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinunaayi.
en: of Arah.

dag: O chanimi kahind o nimbihi ka mal o napɔna vuri tiŋa, ka mal o nubihi tirita.
en: They wink their eyes, gesture with their feet, and point with their fingers.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n suhira.
en: I offer you my heart, Lord God.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino mi yi ni yɛn doli kasitali biɛhigu mini jilima soli shɛm n-kpuɣ omaŋmaŋ paɣa.
en: Respect and honor your wife.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima ka di be kaman yi zaŋ yimaŋ tila ti Duuma la.
en: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands as to the Lord.

dag: Di simdi ni tinim bɛn zaa bi niriba malila tɛhi yini ŋɔ tatabo, ka yi ni shɛb yi mali tɛhi kɔŋkɔba, Naawuni ni kahigi di yɛla wuhi ya.
en: All of us who are spiritually mature should have this same attitude. But if some of you have a different attitude, God will make this clear to you.

dag: Hal kabiɛlli bee wain din ni zaŋ ti mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu duu gba kani. Maligumaaniba fabindimi, ka Yawɛ tumtumdiba gba fabinda.
en: Priests, servants of the Lord , cry because there will be no more grain and drink offerings in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi ti paai tiŋ shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya maa ni nti kpuɣi di tiŋgbani maa daatam, yin zaŋmiya yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli maa bindir tuuli kam bɔbili na ti ti maligumaana;.
en: Tell the Israelites: You will enter the land that I will give you and reap its harvest. At that time you must bring in the first sheaf of your harvest to the priest.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka neesim shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa zaa niŋ liɣa a zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zibigi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will put out all the lights of heaven and plunge your world into darkness. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: ni Humta ni Kiriatariba ni Ziɔr: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara awɛi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Humtah, Kiriath Arba , and Zior. There were nine towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Yi niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ la shɛb zaa, yin zaŋmiya ba ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Di zaŋya yi naɣilabihi tuulinim tum tuma, yi mi di chɛnya yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb kɔbiri.
en: All the first male animals born in your herd and flock are special. You must give them to the Lord . Dont use any of these animals for your work and dont cut wool from any of these sheep.

dag: Ti daa wolisirimi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu, amaa ka ti lee bi dɔɣi shɛli. Ti bi di nasara; ti mi bi dɔɣi so ni o zani ti zaani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But we struggled in pain for nothing. We gave birth only to wind. We did nothing to save the land. No one was born to live in the world.

dag: saha shɛl o ni daa zali saa ni yɛn miri shɛm, ka zali saa nyaɣisibu ni yɛn chani shɛm la.
en: When God decided where the rain would fall, And the path that the thunderclouds travel;.

dag: N daa tum tuun kara. N daa me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri.
en: I took on great projects: I built houses for myself, planted vineyards for myself.

dag: Buɣim yirila o sani n-chani ti diri o dimnim bɛn gil o luɣilikam zaa.
en: Fire proceeds before him, burning up his enemies on every side.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ sujee ni n suhuyiɣisili maa dali, n ni ti chɛ ka zuɣusaa dam, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam pam di biɛhigu shee.
en: I will rattle the heavens; the earth will shake loose from its place—because of the rage of the LORD of heavenly forces on the day his anger burns.

dag: ka tulim maa daa kpe daadamnim pam hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni ŋun su alɔbo balibu kam maa fukumsi la, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba n-ti o jilima.
en: The people were burned by intense heat, and they cursed the name of the God who had power over these plagues. But they didnt change their hearts and lives and give him glory.

dag: Niriba ayi noya yi bi pa taba, bɛ ni tooi laɣim doli?.
en: Do two people start traveling together without arranging to meet?.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di sabigi di paɣibu maa nyaaŋa, ŋun cheem di ni be situra maa ni luɣ shɛli maa bee gbaŋ maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bahi.
en: But if, after it is washed, the priest sees that the infection has faded, he will tear the infected part out of the cloth, the weaving, or the skin.

dag: Ka Ariok daa dii zaŋ Daniɛl n-kpɛhi Naa Nɛbukadnɛza sani ti yɛl o, Naa, n nya Juda daba la ni yino ŋun ni tooi wuh a a zahindi la gbinni.
en: Wasting no time, Arioch brought Daniel before the king, telling him, I have found someone from the Judean exiles who will tell the dreams meaning to the king.

dag: Aroa ka o daa piligi ba ŋmɛbu m-mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din daa baɣi Minnit la n-daa nyaŋ nimaani tinsi pisi zaa; ka daa lan zaŋ ba nimaani n-doli ba hal ni Ɛbɛlikɛramim n-daa ku ba kuri biɛɣu. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Ammɔnnim maa.
en: It was an exceptionally great defeat; he defeated twenty towns from Aroer to the area of Minnith, and on as far as Abel-keramim. So the Ammonites were brought down before the Israelites.

dag: Amaa yinim Taiatiranim bɛn kpalim ka bi doli wuhibu maa, ka mi na bi bɔhim bɛ ni shɛb ni booni shɛli Sintani ashili yɛl kara tuma la, n yɛri ya mi ni n ku zaŋ ʒi tibisi shɛli n-ʒili ya.
en: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the deep secrets of Satan. So I won't burden you down with any other commands.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, N di bi zaɣisi ka so chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di dunol shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: David had a craving and said, If only someone could give me a drink of water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem.

dag: Ka tɔbu daa yiɣisi alizanda ni. Malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil min o malaikanima n-daa tuhiri waɣ biɛ titali maa min o gba malaikanima.
en: Then there was a war in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon. The dragon and its angels fought back.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o kpe salo maa ni, amaa ka nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba daa bi saɣi.
en: Paul wanted to appear before the assembly, but the disciples wouldnt allow him.

dag: Ka Rut daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka bɔhi Bɔaz, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti niŋdi ma nirilim lala? Ka bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti lihi nya man ŋun nyɛ tinzun nir ŋɔ lala.
en: Ruth bowed down with her face touching the ground, and said to Boaz, Why should you be so concerned about me? Why should you be so kind to a foreigner.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la daa yi jɛmbu duu maa ni na. Bɛ daa yɛla binyɛra din paligi paratɛte kaman gol la, ka zaŋ salima nyolɔra lo bɛ nyɔri.
en: and the seven angels bringing the seven plagues came out. They were dressed in clean, shining linen cloth. They wore golden bands tied around their chests.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa yi Atɛnsi n-chaŋ Kɔrinti.
en: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa mii pam dindali maa, ka naa maa daa ʒiya dalim o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo. Ka o daŋ maa ʒim daa yi n-zo n-tiɛli chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa puuni zaa. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun mahili saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: While the battle raged all that day, the king stood propped up in the chariot facing the Arameans. But that evening he died after his blood had poured from his wound into the chariot.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa tumdi tuma ka di fukumsi ʒi tibisa ʒi yi zuɣu, kamiya n sanna, ka n ti tin ya vuhim.
en: Come to me, all you who are struggling hard and carrying heavy loads, and I will give you rest.

dag: n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa; ka bipuɣiŋga maa mi daa zaŋ li ti ti o ma.
en: then he brought it on a plate and gave it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.

dag: A ni suh o, ka o deeg a suhigu, ka a niŋ a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni niŋ binshɛŋa la.
en: You will pray to him, and he will hear you; you will fulfill your solemn promises.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyɛla Masia tuumba bɛn ʒe o zaani, ka Naawuni be ti ni n-kul booni niriba. Lala zuɣu ka ti kul ʒe Masia zaani n-suhiri ya yɛra, Zaŋmiya yimaŋa n-naai Naawuni.
en: So we have been sent to speak for Christ. It is like God is calling to people through us. We speak for Christ when we beg you to be at peace with God.

dag: Bɛ ni yo a a pagɔrisigu tuma maa samli, ka a nya yi buɣijɛmbo alahichi tibidarigibo, ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ a Duuma Yawɛ.
en: You will be punished for becoming prostitutes and for worshiping idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ka di ni ŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni ti lan be di fɔntinsi zaa ni ka piɛguliba ti lan guli bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu nimaani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, This place is empty now. There are no people or animals living here. But there will be people in all the towns of Judah. There will be shepherds, and there will be pastures where they will let their flocks rest.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛl o, Vuri maa pala niriba ni di nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, di mi pala niriba ni kɔŋ nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, amaa n wumla yila yilibu vuri.
en: But Moses replied, It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, yin miriya ka yi ti tumdi zuliya shɛb bɛn be nimaani tuun shɛŋa din tumbu chihiri la.
en: When you come into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, dont learn to do the terrible things the people of the other nations there do.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini yi ni chani ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa lo tab alikauli. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni leei tɔŋ yi sani.
en: Do not make any treaties with the people of the country into which you are going, because this could be a fatal trap for you.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi nyɛ Obɛd bia, ka Obɛd nyɛ Bɔaz bia, ka Bɔaz nyɛ Sala bia, ka Sala mi nyɛ Nashɔn bia.
en: David was the son of Jesse. Jesse was the son of Obed. Obed was the son of Boaz. Boaz was the son of Salmon. Salmon was the son of Nahshon.

dag: To, Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni be vinvama ni la zuɣu, biɛɣuni, sa ŋmaligimiya kpe mɔɣu n-doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam din be teekunim puuni bee kulibɔna ni ka ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, binneen shɛb bɛn duɣiri kom mini kom ni binnɛma zaa, bɛ nyɛla yi ni chihiri binshɛba.
en: But anything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales—whether it be any of the swarming creatures in the water or any of the other living creatures in the water—is detestable to you.

dag: n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim. N ni lan ti a buni mini azichi ni jilima, ka di galisi gari na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ a tooni la zaa dini, ka na shɛb bɛn ti yɛn dol a nyaaŋa na mi so dini ti ku paai li.
en: your request for wisdom and knowledge is granted. But I will also give you wealth, riches, and fame beyond that of any king before you or after you.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ma ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti lu n tibili ni shɛm zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo niŋ a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige le a ŋ-ŋmalig a ka a dol a ni daa doli so shɛli kana labi.
en: Because you rage against me and because your pride has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth. I will make you go back the same way you came.

dag: Nyini n-nam ba, ka bɛ beni, ka zooi n-dɔɣi bihi, ka a yɛla kul be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni nyini.
en: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.

dag: N ni daa nya o maa, ka n lu n-dɔni o tooni m-be kaman kpim la. Amaa ka o zaŋ o nudirigu m-pa n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; mani n-nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last.

dag: Tinim a daba ŋɔ zaa nyɛla do yino bihi, ti nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, ti pala puɣisiriba.
en: We are all brothers. We are not spies, sir, we are honest men.

dag: Chɛ ka din ni bahi ba yoli kana nti bahi ba yoli libigi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa la ŋmaligi gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lu di ni bahi yoli!.
en: Let disaster come to them when they dont suspect it. Let the net they hid catch them instead! Let them fall into it—to their disaster!.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bihi balisi laakumnima.
en: So Jacob got ready to go back to his father in the land of Canaan. He put his children and his wives on the camels, and drove all his flocks ahead of him, with everything that he had gotten in Mesopotamia.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Amaa dabisa din ti yɛn doli wahala ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla.
en: In the days after that time of trouble the sun will grow dark, the moon will no longer shine.

dag: O kabiri daanya dunoyɔriti ka kabiri kuriti dunokparitisi.
en: because God has shattered bronze doors and split iron bars in two!.

dag: Shaul bia n-daa nyɛ Shallum, o yaaŋa n-daa nyɛ Mibisam, ka o yaantibichee nyɛ Mishima.
en: his son Shallum, his son Mibsam, and his son Mishma.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them, Any country that divides itself into groups which fight each other will not last very long; a family divided against itself falls apart.

dag: Masia ŋun nyɛ ti nyɛvili la yi ti yi palo, yi gba ni yi palo m-pah o zuɣu nya jilima.
en: Yes, Christ is now your life, and when he comes again, you will share in his glory.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me yaɣ shɛli din daa be pia din du pam la tooni hal ti paai Ofɛl gooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: After them, the people of Tekoa repaired another section opposite the great projecting tower as far as the wall of Ophel.

dag: A yuli zuɣu, di tabigi ti bahi. Miri ka a filim a nam ʒiishee din mali jilima ŋɔ. Teema, ka miri ka a saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la.
en: For the good of your name, dont push us away. Dont take away the honor from your glorious throne. Remember your agreement with us and do not break it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ chinchin sabilitim yirigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: Then they will place a covering of fine leather on it. They will spread a whole cloth of blue over it, and they will set its poles in place.

dag: N zaŋ a leela ŋun ni be n niriba ni n-kpahindi ba ka yihiri ba daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ka kpahim bɛ soya.
en: Jeremiah, test my people, as you would test metal, and find out what they are like.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa gbaai ma Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la.
en: It was for this reason that these Jews seized me while I was in the Temple, and they tried to kill me.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli.
en: As for the seed that was spread on rocky ground, this refers to people who hear the word and immediately receive it joyfully.

dag: ni Hɔrima naa ni Arad naa.
en: Hormah, Arad.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni nya tibigibu yi sani, ka yi gba nya tibigibu o sani ti Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika zuɣu.
en: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.

dag: Niriba ayi yi do n-tab taba, bɛ ni ni tula, amaa nir yi do o ko, wula ka o yɛn niŋ ka o ni tula?.
en: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a kɔŋko ŋun yuli nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ, n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: May they know that you alone are the Lord , supreme ruler over all the earth.

dag: Gbaai yihila Goshɛn, Izraɛlnim ni daa be yaɣ shɛli polo maa, ka sakuɣa maa daa bi lu.
en: The only place that did not get hail was the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka deei kaɣili maa fiɛbir o zuɣu ni.
en: They spit on him. Then they took his stick and kept hitting him on the head with it.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, hal yi yi ti kurigi m-paligi gba, n ni gbib ya. Mani n-nam ya, ka ni gbib ya. N ni sɔŋ ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: I am your God and will take care of you until you are old and your hair is gray. I made you and will care for you; I will give you help and rescue you.

dag: O tiri bɛnkam zaa zɔr o bɛ ni bɔri shɛli. O lan deeri bɛn suhir o suhigu ka tiligiri ba.
en: He supplies the needs of those who honor him; he hears their cries and saves them.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmaligi dolila buɣa n-jɛmdi li. Di nyɛla buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun bi mi ni o ni daa bi zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa ti ba.
en: They followed other gods, serving them and worshipping them—other gods that they hadnt experienced before and that the Lord hadnt designated for them.

dag: O yi nyaŋ ma ku ma, dindina ti ni leei yi daba, amaa ka m mi yi nyaŋ o ku o, yi gba ni leei ti daba tumdi ti tuma.
en: If he can kill me, our people will be your slaves. But if I kill him, your people will be our slaves.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka n fabila paag a sanna. Tim ma baŋsim kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Lord , listen to my cry for help. Make me wise, as you promised.

dag: ka sua maa mini di sukpali zaa kpe nti lim. Ka o puli maa kpam mum li niŋ, dama o daa bi darigi ŋooi sua maa o puli maa ni, ka o puuni daɣiri daa zɔri yirina.
en: The sword went into Eglons belly so far that even the handle sank in and the fat closed around it. The point of the blade came out his back. Ehud left the sword inside Eglon.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa je ma sɔɣirimi yɛri taba n yɛla. Bɛ kul tɛhirila zaɣ biɛɣu tiri ma.
en: All who hate me whisper to each other about me, they imagine the worst about me.

dag: Di bi simdi ka dabindi be yi yinsi daba ayopɔin maa ni. Ka ŋunkam di binshɛli din mali dabindi, dilan ni yi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu ni, dilan yi nyɛla sana bee tiŋbia.
en: For seven days, there must not be any yeast in your houses. Anyone, either a citizen of Israel or a foreigner living among you, who eats yeast at this time must be separated from the rest of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa yi kul chaŋ napɔŋ yaabu buyɔbu zuɣu, o chɛrimi ka bɛ zani ka o kɔrigi naɣilaa mini naɣilalantabili mali sara.
en: The people carrying the chest walked six steps, then David sacrificed an ox and a choice cow.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti lan dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Shɛla. Chɛzib ka o daa be ka dɔɣ o.
en: Again she had a son and named him Shelah. Judah was at Achzib when the boy was born.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ku ma; n lan ka tahima yaha. Amaa n ni zabi n soli zuɣu hal ni o tooni.
en: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.

dag: Ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Yɛlim ma a ni mali shɛl a yiŋa. Ka o yɛl o, A dabipaɣa ka shɛli; kulla kpaŋman yini kɔŋko ka m mali.
en: Maybe there's something I can do to help, Elisha said. What do you have in your house? Sir, I have nothing but a small bottle of olive oil.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa. Di bi be kaman yi yaannim ni daa di shɛli ka kpi la, amaa ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ dina, dilan ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: This is the bread that came down from heaven. It isnt like the bread your ancestors ate, and then they died. Whoever eats this bread will live forever.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli; Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ na? A zaŋ ti mi na ni a ti ti Amɔrinim ka bɛ ku ti? Ti yi di daa chɛ ka ti nini tiɣi Jɔɔdɛn yaɣili wulimpuhili polo la ka kpalim nimaani di di so.
en: Joshua said, Lord GOD, you brought our people across the Jordan River. Why did you bring us this far and then allow the Amorites to destroy us? We should have been satisfied and stayed on the other side of the Jordan River.

dag: Bɛ vihiri mɔɣa piligu shee n-yihiri binshɛŋa din sɔɣiya palo ni.
en: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places.

dag: Di ni ti ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee yina; ŋun yɛn ku zuliya pam yi palo. O yi o biɛhigu shee na ni o bahi yi tiŋgbani yoli. Yi fɔntinsi ni wurim, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Like a lion coming from its hiding place, a destroyer of nations has set out. He is coming to destroy Judah. The cities of Judah will be left in ruins, and no one will live in them.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ tooni ka o sanna ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋ pia.
en: The first one came and said, Sir, I have earned ten gold coins with the one you gave me.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. Hamutal mi ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he began to rule. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba, amaa nyin cham ti moli Naawuni nam molo.
en: Jesus answered, Let the dead take care of the dead, while you go and tell about God's kingdom.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli Naawuni, A daa wuh a yurilim din galisi ka ka tariga ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m ba Dauda sani, ka zaŋ ma leei naa zal o zaani.
en: You showed so much kindness to my father David, Solomon replied to God, and you have made me king in his place.

dag: Bɛ daa kpiya ka bɛ saha na bi paai kaman kom ni ʒiri tanzaa chani shɛm la.
en: They were destroyed before it was their time to die. They were washed away by the flood.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter spoke up, Even if all the others reject you, I never will.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yiriŋ nyɛla ŋun mali baŋsim, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali suɣilo nyɛ ŋun mali tɛhi zilima.
en: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.

dag: Yi bi teei ni n ni daa be yi san la, n daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla?.
en: You remember that I used to tell you these things while I was with you, dont you?.

dag: Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla nimmoo saha ka di simdi ni yi neei gom ni, dama pumpɔŋɔ ka tiliginsim miri ti n-gari ti ni daa tuui niŋ yɛda saha shɛl la.
en: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.

dag: Di dubihi atata din be di yaɣa ayi la mini di pilanima ni di zɔntua zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway, the walls between them, and the entrance room all had the same measurements as those in the east gateway. The total length of the gateway was feet and the width feet.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni la pirigibu bɛn pahi buyi daa zaŋ kpa gooni maa zuɣu nuzaa polo, ka m mi zaŋ bɛ pirigili n-doli bɛ nyaaŋa gooni maa zuɣu Kpimkpimbihi Pia zuɣusaa polo m-mali hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: The second group went in procession to the left. I followed them with half of the people along the wall past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa na kul kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ maa, ka Musa daa chaŋ miri Naawuni ni daa be sagban sabili shɛli ni maa.
en: But when Moses went near the thick cloud where God was, the people stayed a long way off.

dag: Asahɛl bia Jɔnatan mini Tikiva bia Jazɛya n-daa zaɣisi yɛlli maa, ka Mɛshulam mini Shabɛtai ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir la daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Only Jonathan, Asahels son, and Jahzeiah, Tikvahs son, opposed this; Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levites supported them.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Bɛrishiiba n-zaŋ kpa Haran polo.
en: Jacob left Beersheba and started toward Haran.

dag: Dama lala ni chɛ ka yi bihi maa chɛ ma dolibu ka jɛmdi binnana, di saha Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kun ya yomyom.
en: because then they would lead your children away from the Lord to worship other gods. If that happens, the Lord will be angry with you and destroy you at once.

dag: Bɛ daa kana nti liri ma la n ni daa be muɣisigu ni dahin shɛli; amaa ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ dalim Yawɛ.
en: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu siɣi Naa sol zuɣu na, ka o be o yiŋ tahira, ka Dauda daa yaa ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm dabisili kam la, ka Sool daa gbib o kpani o nuu ni;.
en: The next day, an evil spirit from God took control of Saul and he went wild in his house. David played the harp to calm him as he usually did.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the twelfth month of the twelfth year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka liɣiri yɔhim a, a mi di chɛ ka birapu pam dibu kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Be careful not to let bribes deceive you, or riches lead you astray.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn kpalim, wummiya! Mani n-daa gbibi ya yi manim puuni zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Listen to me, descendants of Jacob, all who are left of my people. I have cared for you from the time you were born.

dag: Pɛriʒianim mini Itiɔpianim ni Putinim be bɛ sani. Bɛ zaa gbibila nyɔtaɣiri bihi, ka pili kuriti zuɣupila.
en: Your army includes soldiers from Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa n-tumdi din tuhi ni di chɛ ka n ku mali galimi n suhu tɛha ni Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: This is why I always try to do what I believe is right before God and before everyone.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm daa ti yɛli biasani, Ti ba kurigiya, ka dɔbba mi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni n-ni kpuɣi ti kaman bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni la.
en: The older daughter said to her sister, Our father is getting old, and there are no men in the whole world to marry us so that we can have children.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba pahi, Ka daɣila yi na kul bi baŋ.
en: Don't you know what I am talking about by now? Jesus asked.

dag: Nir yi tum din tuhi, di niŋdila wuntizɔriba suhupiɛlli, amaa ka lee tiri tuumbiɛtumdiba suhugarigu.
en: Acting justly is a joy to the righteous, but dreaded by those who do evil.

dag: M bi sabiri dimbɔŋɔ ni n dihi ya la vi, amaa n sab li mi ni n saɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ m biyurisi la zuɣu.
en: I am not trying to make you feel ashamed, but I am writing this to counsel you as my own dear children.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛri n-nahindi ti yaannim maa ka muɣisiri ba ka bɛ zaŋdi bɛ biliɛri bahira ni bɛ zuliya maa kpihim.
en: This king tricked our people. He treated them badly, making them leave their children outside to die.

dag: A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa pam. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ filim a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisi shɛŋa la ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father made our workload very heavy; if you will lessen the demands your father made of us and lighten the heavy workload he demanded from us, then we will serve you.

dag: Naawuni vuhim ni ku ba, ka o suhuyiɣisili pɔhim di ba.
en: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.

dag: Ziɔn zuɣu, n ku shini; Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu, n ku vuhi hal ka di ti di nasara, ka ne kaman biɛŋmariga la, ka di tiliginsim ne kaman buɣim mokpalli neesim la.
en: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa daa niŋ Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm nyaɣisim pam.
en: These terms seemed fair to Hamor and his son Shechem.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋgbani ni maa puuni, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.

dag: O mi bi be kaman daadam ŋun bɔri shɛl o daadamkpee nuu ni la, dama ŋun Naawuni n-tiri daadam nyɛvili m-pahi vuhim ni shɛlikam.
en: He is the one who gives people life, breath, and everything else they need. He does not need any help from them. He has everything he needs.

dag: Siria naa maa ni ti kpuɣi Ijipti azichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni bin suma shɛŋa din zaa pahi. O ni ti nyaŋ Libianim mini Itiɔpianima.
en: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Avimnim bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi zaŋ hal ni Gaza la, Kafitɔrimnim bɛn daa yi Kafitɔr na la daa ku ba ka ʒini bɛ ʒiishee maa.
en: God did the same thing for some people from Crete. The Avvites lived in the towns around Gaza, but the Cretans destroyed them, took the land, and live there now.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o ti nya Ɛliab ka yɛl o suhu ni, Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni pii so maa n-ʒe o tooni ŋɔ.
en: When they arrived, Samuel looked at Eliab and thought, That must be the LORDs anointed right in front.

dag: Ka niriba daa pili buri; ka shɛb du n-tam duri zuɣusaa, ka shɛb mi ʒe tiŋ puuni laɣiŋgu shee kumdi ka fabinda.
en: In its streets they wear mourning clothes; on its rooftops and in its plazas, everyone wails and falls down weeping.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N ni yɛl a ni n nya a fiig tia gbin la zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? A ni ti nya binshɛŋa din gari lala.
en: Jesus said, Do you believe just because I told you I saw you when you were under the fig tree? You will see much greater things than this.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa yiɣisi Giligal lu soli n-gbaai chandi yuŋ hal ti kab ti liri ba libigi ba.
en: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.

dag: O kuhi boli zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni di di o shɛhira, ka o kar o niriba saria.
en: He calls heaven and earth as witnesses to see him judge his people.

dag: O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba tuhi pihiyɔbu. Ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi Ijipti mini Libia ni Sukiim ni Itiɔpia n-dol o daa ka kalinli.
en: with an army of twelve hundred chariots, sixty thousand cavalry, and more soldiers than could be counted, including Libyan, Sukkite, and Ethiopian troops.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpamba ni Ijiptinim zaa daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa ka kuŋ mɔni Ijipti fɔŋ ni zaa, dama yili shɛli daa kani ka kum bi ku nimaani.
en: When Pharaoh, all his officials, and all the Egyptians got up that night, a terrible cry of agony rang out across Egypt because every house had someone in it who had died.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ saa salan saa mibu saha. Yawɛ n-chɛ ka saa sagbana zaani mira, ka di chɛ ka sokam puri bindira niŋda.
en: Ask the LORD for rain when it is time for the spring rain. The LORD is the one who makes the thunderstorms. He gives them rain showers. He gives vegetation in the field to each of them.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yi ni yo Yawɛ sam shɛli m-bala? Pa ŋuna n-nyɛ yi ba ŋun nam ya? Pa ŋuna n-nam ya, ka zali ya?.
en: Is this how you thank the LORD, you stupid, senseless people? Isnt he your father, your creator? Didnt he make you and establish you?.

dag: Ninive yɛla ŋɔ zaa ŋmanila pagɔr tuma din nyɛ kɔre kpɛhibu din ka kalinli; di ŋmanila paɣ timalana ŋun zaŋ kɔre kpɛhibu gbahi zuliya pam, ka zaŋ o tima maa yɔhim niriba pam la.
en: Nineveh the whore is being punished. Attractive and full of deadly charms, she enchanted nations and enslaved them.

dag: Nimaani ka o kabisi piɛma din nyɛlisiri mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni takɔbiri ni tɔbutuhiri bidibbina.
en: There he broke the arrows of the enemy, their shields and swords, yes, all their weapons.

dag: bee n-ni suh o zahim ka o gbaai wahu ti o?.
en: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N ni be a sani. Dimbɔŋɔ mi n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri ni mani n-tim a, a yi ti yihi niriba maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, yi ni ti jɛmdi man Naawuni zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: God replied, I will be with you. And you will know that I am the one who sent you, when you worship me on this mountain after you have led my people out of Egypt.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri bɔɣiri ni ti kabi. Amaa Yawɛ ni sɔŋ wuntizɔriba.
en: The arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD supports the righteous.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa damdi tiŋa n-jɛm Daniɛl, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm pina mini tulaale viɛlli na ti mal o maligu.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low to the ground and worshiped Daniel. Then he gave orders for incense to be burned and a sacrifice of grain to be offered in honor of Daniel.

dag: Rama mini Gɛba — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisiniyini.
en: of Ramah and Geba.

dag: Ka Ahitɔfɛl daa yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ a ba mamanim shɛb o ni chɛ n-niŋ nayili ni bɛ maani li la dɔni, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa baŋ ni a leeg a ba dataa, ka bɛnkam zaa be a polo ni kpaŋsi bɛmaŋa.
en: Have sex with your fathers secondary wives—the ones he left to take care of the palace, Ahithophel told Absalom. Then all Israel will hear that you have alienated yourself from your father, and everyone who supports you will be encouraged.

dag: Ɛlihu daa guhirimi ni bɛ naai pɔi ka o naanyi tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa, dama bɛna n-daa nyɛ ninkura.
en: Elihu was the youngest one there, so he had waited until everyone finished talking.

dag: dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi ni nabipuɣinsi ni Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaa be Ahikam bia Shafan san la chaŋ. Bɛ daa zaŋ anabi Jɛrimia mini Nɛria bia Baruk gba chaŋ.
en: the men, the women, the children, and the king's daughters. They took everyone whom Nebuzaradan the commanding officer had left under the care of Gedaliah, including Baruch and me.

dag: Yɛl biɛr ayi n-yɛn paai ya; ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili sɔŋ ya? Yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni wurim, ka kum lu yi zuɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn maai yi suhuri?.
en: Troubles came to you, Jerusalem, in pairs: Your land was destroyed and lies in ruins, and your people suffered from famine and war. But no one felt sorry for you or showed you mercy.

dag: Nyama, a tɔbbihi zaa ŋmanila paɣiba. A tiŋgbani maa dunɔdaya yɔhimi ti a dimnima. Ka buɣim di a dunɔdaya dapuhi.
en: Look, your people are women in your midst. The gates of your land have been flung wide open to your enemies. Fire consumes the bars of your gates.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim ka niŋ ba alaka pam di yuuni maa ni. Yuun pisaayika ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Amɔrinim tiŋgban shɛli din be Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: So the same year that Jair died, Israel's army was crushed by these two nations. For years, Ammon was cruel to the Israelites who lived in Gilead, the region east of the Jordan River that had once belonged to the Amorites.

dag: Ka o mini Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni, ka bɛ to jina m-bɔri soli ni bɛ ku o.
en: He got into debates with the Greek-speaking Jews as well, but they tried to kill him.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, zomiya buɣijɛmbo!.
en: So then, my dear friends, run away from the worship of false gods!.

dag: Piɛɣu maa daa malila liŋa. Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ti nya ka di liŋ maa wuɣi zuɣusaa, ka paɣa ʒi piɛɣu maa puuni.
en: A lid made of lead was lifted off the bucket, and there was a woman in the bucket.

dag: ka be yi tanti suɣa ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni yɛra, Yawɛ ni je ti maa zuɣu ka o daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni o ti zaŋ ti niŋ Amɔrinim ŋɔ nuu ni ka bɛ ku ti.
en: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.

dag: yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Izraɛlnima wummiya, yi vu m-miri ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi ni sɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: Men of Israel, listen! Today you are going into battle. Do not be afraid of your enemies or lose courage or panic.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa min o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni zaa.
en: Nathan told David everything that God had revealed to him.

dag: Ka Hasɛnaa bidibisi daa mali me Zahim Dunɔdal la ka zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: The children of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate; they laid its beams and set up its doors, bolts, and bars.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu di niŋ ma nyaɣisim n ni daa ka nimaani maa zuɣu, dama dina n-ni chɛ ka yi niŋ yɛda. Ka yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o sani.
en: For your sakes, Im glad I wasnt there so that you can believe. Lets go to him.

dag: Daadam Bia dabisili ti yɛn ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi di pilibu shee m-mali ti ba di naabu shee shɛm la.
en: The day of the Son of Man will be like lightning flashing across the sky.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa boli Ibrahimma na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a ka a ti chɛ ka m mini n nam ŋɔ tum alahichi titali ŋɔ? A niŋ ma di ni bi simdi ni nir niŋ o kpee shɛm.
en: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?.

dag: Izraɛlnima n-tum alahichi; bɛ zaɣisila n ni zali ba zaligu shɛl la dolibu; ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Man Yawɛ la. Bɛ zu n-kpuɣ li pahi bɛ nɛma ni, ka ŋma ʒiri.
en: Israel has sinned. They have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the things reserved for me and put them with their own things. They have stolen and kept it a secret.

dag: Lɛvinim tuma soli ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn nyɛ yuun pisinaanu zaŋ chana ni tooi piligi laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni tuma tumbu.
en: This is a special command for the Levites: Every Levite man who is years old or older must come and share in the work at the Meeting Tent.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa Jɔsia bia la ni daa di nam ti paai yuma anahi saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Judanim zaa polo.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, which was the first year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia, the Lord told me to speak to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. So I told them:.

dag: O daa lan bo sida dakuɣiri din ka kalinli, dama Sidɔnnim mini Taainim daa ʒi sida dakuɣiri maa pam na ti ti Dauda.
en: and more cedar logs than could be counted. The people from the cities of Sidon and Tyre brought many cedar logs to David.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi yaha, ka do so daa zɔna ti damd o tooni m-bɔh o, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: As Jesus continued down the road, a man ran up, knelt before him, and asked, Good Teacher, what must I do to obtain eternal life.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M bindirigu nyɛla n tum ŋun tim ma na yubu, ka naag o tuma.
en: My food, Jesus said to them, is to obey the will of the one who sent me and to finish the work he gave me to do.

dag: M bilim ni n daa bela mmaŋmaŋ tindɔɣirili ni mini Jɛrusalɛm; ka di saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ Yɛhudianim zaa mi m bebu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: All the Jews know how I have lived ever since I was young. They know how I have spent my whole life, at first in my own country and then in Jerusalem.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man niŋ naani.
en: You hate those who worship false gods, but I trust in you.

dag: Ka Giliadnim daa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli. Ka bɔ n-chɛ ka Dan zuliya niriba la mi daa kpalim be bɛ ŋarima gbini? Asha zuliya niriba gba daa kpalim be teeku duli. Bɛ daa kpalim ʒinila teeku duli maa.
en: The tribe of Gad stayed east of the Jordan, and the tribe of Dan remained by the ships. The tribe of Asher stayed by the seacoast; they remained along the shore.

dag: amaa ka malaika maa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Dama lahibal suŋ din mali suhupiɛlli pam ka nyɛ sokam zaa dini ka n ʒina ni n ti yɛli ya.
en: The angel said, Dont be afraid! Look! I bring good news to you—wonderful, joyous news for all people.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannim dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa. Ka bɛ daa kana ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa.
en: The men who had the work of caring for the pigs ran away. They ran to the town and to the farms and told everyone what happened. The people went out to see.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at a time when you dont expect him.

dag: Ashidɔdnim ni daa nya di ni be shɛm maa ka bɛ yɛli, Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ku lan be ti sani, dama o darigi ti tibili n-tabili ti buɣili Dagɔn.
en: When they saw what was happening, they said, The God of Israel is punishing us and our god Dagon. We can't let the Covenant Box stay here any longer.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhu yubu puuni bɛ tɔhiri kaman sokam ni o nyaŋbu tariga hal n-gari lala zuɣu gba.
en: I can assure you that they gave as much as they could, and even more than they could. Of their own free will.

dag: Ka a bia yi ti bɔh a daliri shɛli din chɛ ka a doli zaligu maa, nyin yɛlim o, Ti ni daa nyɛ daba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Yawɛ n-daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-yihi ti dabitim ni, lala zuɣu ka ti doli zaligu maa.
en: When in the future your child asks you, What does this mean? you should answer, The LORD brought us with great power out of Egypt, out of the place we were slaves.

dag: Bom binshɛli n-zaŋ pili ŋariŋ maa, ka chɛ ka di zuɣusaa dubu polo nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi; ka chibi di dunoli di luɣili ni, ka kpahi li tambu buta tam taba.
en: Build a roof on the boat and leave a space of about centimeters between the roof and the sides. Make the boat three stories high and put a door on one side.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai bɛ sansani maa ni, Izraɛlnim zaa daa yola vuri hal ka tiŋgbani ti damda.
en: When the chest containing the LORDs covenant entered the camp, all Israel let out such a loud shout that the ground shook.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli Izraɛlnim ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ka saɣim n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti n niriba Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su li la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn vuɣi ba la bɛ tiŋgban ni, ka yihi Judanim bɛ sunsuuni.
en: The Lord says, I have something to say about Israel's neighbors who have ruined the land I gave to my people Israel. I will take those wicked people away from their countries like an uprooted plant, and I will rescue Judah from them.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Sɛraya, A yi ti paai Babilɔn, nyin karimmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa.
en: I told Seraiah, When you get to Babylon, be sure to read aloud to the people everything that is written here.

dag: Kpambaliba yi wum ni n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka kana ti yɛl a, Kul yɛlim ti a ni yɛli naa shɛm, di sɔɣi ti shɛli, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a. Wula ka naa lee yɛl a.
en: If the officials find out that I talked to you, they will come to you and say, Jeremiah, tell us what you said to King Zedekiah and what he said to you. Be honest with us, and tell us everything, or we will kill you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni lo ti vuhim nyabu alikauli shɛl la ni na kul ʒiɛya zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zo dabiɛm ka yi ni so ti ku kɔŋ vuhim maa shee paabu.
en: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ dabisa shɛm ka ti nini bi nya wuntaŋa bee saŋmarisi ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul bi chɛ ti ʒiɛbu la zuɣu daa chɛ ka ti yihi ti nyɛviya tahima.
en: When neither the sun nor the moon appeared for many days and the raging storm continued to pound us, all hope of our being saved from this peril faded.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Panniriba, dama yi pala n niriba, m mi pala yi Naawuni.
en: Then the Lord said, Name him Lo-Ammi, because you are not my people, and I am not your God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa vihi ma bɛ daa loya ni bɛ bahi ma, dama bɛ daa bi nya ka n tum taal shɛli din simdi kum.
en: After questioning me, the Romans wanted to release me, because they found that I had done nothing for which I deserved to die.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, bɛn labimi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka di bi simdi ka so ŋubi nahu maa nimdi, ka nahu maa lana ku mali taali.
en: When an ox gores a man or a woman to death, the ox should be stoned to death, and the meat of the ox shouldnt be eaten. But the owner of the ox shouldnt be punished.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ yabiga gari wain shɛl ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o lam li ka zaɣisi li nyubu.
en: There the soldiers gave Jesus some wine mixed with gall. But when he tasted it, he refused to drink it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni niriba maa zaa daa bi deei Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ ʒinimi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa.
en: So Johanan, Kareahs son, and all the army officers and the rest of the people disobeyed the LORDs command to stay in the land of Judah.

dag: Amaa ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.

dag: Ti ni nya piɛri mini niɣi n-ku n-ti ba ka di saɣi ba? Bee ti yi gbahi teeku zahim zaa ti ba, di ni saɣi ba.
en: Can flocks and herds be found and slaughtered for them? Or can all the fish in the sea be found and caught for them.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛla yi zuɣu, ka bɛ suhiri Naawuni tiri ya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi pam yi ni la zuɣu.
en: And when they pray, they will wish they could be with you. They will feel this way because of the great grace that God gave you.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ o tiŋgban nɛl la ni, ka daa saɣim o suhu pam!.
en: Oh, they caused him so much trouble in the desert! They made him so sad.

dag: N chaŋmi kaman zaawuni shilinshia la. Bɛ pihigi ma mi bahi kaman sakɔɣu la.
en: Like an evening shadow I am about to vanish; I am blown away like an insect.

dag: Amɔri nanima anu la daa zo nti sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: Then those five kings fled and hid in the cave at Makkedah.

dag: Ɛba ni daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Eber had more children and died at the age of .

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Sukɔt nti me o yili ka ti o biŋkɔbiri suɣa zali. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Sukɔt.
en: But Jacob went to Sukkoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock. That is why the place was named Sukkoth.

dag: Yi daa bɔrigimi kaman piɛr la, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa ŋmaligi labila yi Piɛgula ŋun nyɛ ŋun gbibi ya la sanna.
en: Though you were like straying sheep, you have now returned to the shepherd and guardian of your lives.

dag: bɛ yi bi niŋdi niriba din tuhi Zallakudura Naa tooni.
en: He does not like anyone to be unfair to another person. Some people will do such things right in front of God Most High.

dag: Nyini n-nyandi ba sahakam, ka bɛ kpira, ka a taɣi bɛ ninni biɛhigu ka kari ba bahi.
en: You defeat them completely and then they are gone. You change the way they look and send them away forever to the place of death.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: Go in peace, the king said. So Absalom went to Hebron.

dag: O ni daa karim gbaŋ maa naai ka o bɔhi ni luɣ dini ka Pool lee yina. O ni daa wum ni o yila Kilikia na.
en: The governor read the letter and asked Paul what province he was from. When he found out that he was from Cilicia.

dag: Ŋuni n-leei beni ka ku kpi? Ka ŋuni n-leei ni tooi tiligi kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni?.
en: Is there anyone alive who will never die? Will anyone escape the grave? Selah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti ni me fɔntinsi kpe n-zaŋ ti bihi niŋ di ni, ka me buzɔna n-zaŋ ti piɛri mini ti buhi niŋ di ni.
en: But the people from the tribes of Reuben and Gad went to Moses. They said, We will build cities for our children and barns for our animals here.

dag: Amaa Lɔt ni daa ti yi Sɔdom dindahin shɛli, ka buɣim ni chilibi buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

dag: Ka wuhiri shihir kara pam, hal ka chɛ ka buɣim yiri zuɣusaa lurina niriba ninni;.
en: The second beast did great miracles. He even made fire come down from heaven to earth while people were watching.

dag: Bɛ yuri sara maligu pam. Bɛ zaŋdi nimdi maani sara ka ŋubiri li. Amaa Yawɛ ŋun baɣa ka di ni. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛ ni labi Ijipti.
en: The Israelites love sacrifices. They offer the meat and eat it. The Lord does not accept their sacrifices. He remembers their sins, and he will punish them. They will be carried away as prisoners to Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: So ka suhupiɛlli tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam maa ni. So bi tahiri bee n-yiini yila wain tihi puri maa ni. So mi bi nɔri wain tihi wala ni o yihi wain, ka so bi wumdi suhupiɛlli tahigu damli.
en: Joy and happiness have been harvested from the farmland, and in the vineyards no one sings, no one shouts. No treader crushes grapes in the wine vats; I have brought the cheers to an end.

dag: Yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Firawuna daa ti zahim zahindi n-nya ka o ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli.
en: After two years had passed, the king of Egypt dreamed that he was standing by the Nile River.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛn gbarigi tiɣi, ka chɛ ka bɛn tarigi la niŋgbuna maai.
en: I will give rest and strength to those who are weak and tired.

dag: Yawɛ n-sɔŋdi ba, ka fari ba bahira; ŋuna n-fari ba ka tiligiri ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; bɛ ni zɔrina nti sɔɣir o sani zuɣu.
en: The Lord helps good people and rescues them. They depend on him, so he rescues them from the wicked.

dag: N daa bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛŋa din ni sɔŋ ya, amaa ka daa zaŋ li wuhi ya niriba ni mini yili kam ni.
en: I always did what was best for you. I told you the Good News about Jesus in public before the people and also taught in your homes.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ wuna din pa Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka zaŋ bɛ buɣa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi. Lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka bɛn pa niriba niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi.
en: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia Tapanhɛs maa.
en: There the Lord said to me.

dag: Yinim bɛna, yi zaŋla ʒiri leei situra ye; yi zaa nyɛla timalaannim bɛn ka buchi.
en: You cover up your ignorance with lies; you are like doctors who can't heal anyone.

dag: Ka bɛ ti lo tɔbu n-tuhi Piɛbil la, amaa ka Piɛbil maa ni ti nyaŋ ba, dama o nyɛla duumanim zaa Duuma ni nanim zaa Naa, ka bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb o ni boli min o ni pii ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe o yim.
en: They will fight against the Lamb; but the Lamb, together with his called, chosen, and faithful followers, will defeat them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam la daa wum di yɛla, ka yi Ijipti maa kuna.
en: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he returned from Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia chɛ ka suhudoo mini yurilim ni yɛda be ti mabihi la zaa ni.
en: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace and love with faith to all the brothers and sisters there.

dag: Ka nyin Bɛlishaaza ŋun nyɛ o bia ŋɔ mi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla, amaa ka bi siɣis amaŋa.
en: King Belshazzar, you knew all of this, but you still refused to honor the Lord who rules from heaven.

dag: Pa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-chɛ ka niriba tumdi tuma ka buɣim diri li, ka niriba diri wahala yol la?.
en: The nations you conquered wore themselves out in useless labor, and all they have built goes up in flames. The Lord Almighty has done this.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ishimail bidibisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yuya m-boli bɛ tiŋkpansi mini bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannim pinaayi bɛ zuliyanim ni.
en: Each of Ishmael's sons was a tribal chief, and a village was named after each of them.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaayi.
en: the descendants of Elam:.

dag: Wuntizɔra ba ni mali suhupiɛlli pam; ŋunkam dɔɣi bi so ŋun mali yɛm ni mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: The father of a good person is very happy. A wise child brings him joy.

dag: Guhimi Yawɛ, niŋmi yaa ka mali suhukpeeni. Guhimi Yawɛ!.
en: Trust the Lord ! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord .

dag: Jarɛd ni daa dɔɣi Inok maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and then lived another years. He had other children.

dag: Mbaye, dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali, ka di kpee kani. Di nyɛla Yaakubu suhusaɣiŋgu saha, amaa bɛ ni tilig o di ni.
en: A terrible day is coming; no other day can compare with it— a time of distress for my people, but they will survive.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nol ni yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka o zaŋ yɛli zali zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni buɣim ti saɣim li ŋɔ. Di ʒiɛya gulila dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri ŋun Naawuni sizuura saria la.
en: But by the same word, heaven and earth are now held in reserve for fire, kept for the Judgment Day and destruction of ungodly people.

dag: Yɛm mɛrila o yili, amaa jɛrilim ŋun wurindila o yili.
en: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro maa na zuɣu? Yi nini na kul bi neei bee yi na kul bi baŋ? Yi nyɛla suhutunanima?.
en: Jesus knew that the followers were talking about this. So he asked them, Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are you not able to understand?.

dag: A halli zuɣu ka n daa zo a dabiɛm, dama a bɔri ni a nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri a ni bi biri binshɛli.
en: I was afraid of you because you are a stern man. You withdraw what you havent deposited and you harvest what you havent planted.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣa; ka chɛ ka a ni daa kabisi n kɔb shɛŋa la mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka Sintani dii kana nti yihi yɛligu shɛli din lu bɛ suhuri ni maa.
en: The seeds that fell along the road are the people who hear the message. But Satan soon comes and snatches it away from them.

dag: Hal Juda ni daa kul mali kpiɔŋ gar o mabihi maa zaa, ka nabia lan yi o zuliya ni na maa zaa yoli, Yisifu n-daa kul nyɛ dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: even though it was the Judah tribe that became the most powerful and produced a leader.

dag: Di saha man gba ni saɣi ni amaŋmaŋ nudirigu ni tooi ti a nasara.
en: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument.

dag: Tinzunnim ni guli yi biŋkɔbbaligu tin ya, ka ko yi puri tin ya, ka guli yi tihi puri tin ya.
en: Then your enemies will come to care for your sheep, and their children will work in your fields and in your gardens.

dag: O tiligi n shia ka di bi faai siɣi gballi ni, ka n nyɛvili ni lan nya neesim.
en: He kept me from going to the world of the dead, and I am still alive.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi daania niŋbu maa niŋ pali, ka di chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani shɛlikam zaa puuni, ka ku kɔŋ shɛli.
en: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.

dag: Ka tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi zoli maa zuɣu n-zaŋ hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔna n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ti paai tiŋ kar shɛŋa din ʒi Ɛfurɔn Zoli zuɣu la. Ka di daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ŋmaligi n-zaŋ hal ti paai Baala bee Kiriatijiarim.
en: From there the border went to the spring of water of Nephtoah. Then the border went to the cities near Mount Ephron. There the border turned and went to Baalah.

dag: Yɛndan yi tahi jɛra ʒiishee, vuri yɔbu mini ansarisi ku mali tariga.
en: When the wise make a legal charge against the foolish, the fools shout, they laugh—there is no calm.

dag: Bazilut ni Mɛhida ni Harisha ni.
en: Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ya, ka tumdi bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni; amaa bɛ di miri sara maligu shee lahi la bee sara maligu bimbini maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala, yi mini ba ni kpi.
en: These Levites will be under your control. They will do all the work that needs to be done in the Tent. But they must not go near the things in the Holy Place or the altar. If they do, they will die—and you also will die.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔh o, M mabia, tin bɔnim ka a lee zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tinsi maa yuli Keebal tiŋgbɔŋ hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: King Hiram said, What are these towns that you have given me, my brother? King Hiram named that land the Land of Cabul. And that area is still called Cabul today.

dag: Di yihi yɛlimaŋli n nol ni hal biɛla gba, dama n tahima bela a zaligunim ni.
en: Let me always say what is true. I depend on your judgment to be fair.

dag: Yisifu saha ka o daa zali zaligu maa, saha shɛl o ni daa liri Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ la. N wumla n ni ʒi kukol shɛli, ka di yɛra:.
en: He made it a decree for Joseph when he went out against the land of Egypt, when I heard a language I did not yet know.

dag: Ka Jɛfita yɛli ba, M mini n niriba ni Ammɔnnima n-daa mali naŋgbankpeen titali, ka n daa ŋme kuŋ boli ya, ka yi bi kana ti fa ma bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Jephthah replied to them, My people and I were in a great conflict with the Ammonites. But when I cried out to you, you didnt rescue me from their power.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka Samaria wurim n-leei mɔɣu ni, ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn sari wain tihi. Ka n ni ti va di kuɣa zaa ti bahi vinvamli ni, ka chɛ ka di tanzahi la yi n-do palo ni.
en: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.

dag: Amaa n lihiya nya ka so kani. So ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira, ka n ni bɔh o bɔhigu ka o garigi.
en: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.

dag: O daa lan yih o yabipaɣ Maaka napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me Ashɛra binnan shɛli din chihiri zal la zuɣu. Ka Asa daa ŋme n kab o binnani maa luhi n-zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni.
en: King Asa also took away the right of his mother Maacah to be queen mother. He did this because she had set up one of those awful Asherah poles. Asa cut down the pole and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti bo n-nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ jinwara ni be luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ o sani ti kari saria. Ka o tumtumdiba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, jinwara be Ɛndo.
en: Then Saul told his officers, Find me a woman who can talk to the spirits of the dead. I'll go to her and find out what's going to happen. His servants told him, There's a woman at Endor who can talk to spirits of the dead.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla binshɛli din yi o tooni na ka nyɛ daɣiri maa zaligu. O tooni yi yiɣisi bee di yi bi yiɣisi, di nyɛla daɣiri o sani.
en: whether the penis runs with it or is stopped up by it.

dag: Naa, ka di yi luhi a sani pumpɔŋɔ, nyin bahim noli ka bɛ vihi Babilɔn nam litaafinim ni n-nya Naa Sairus daa shiri bahi noli ni bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali Jɛrusalɛm, ka labisi a ni yu shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo zilinli ti ti na.
en: Now, if it please Your Majesty, have a search made in the royal records in Babylon to find whether or not Emperor Cyrus gave orders for this Temple in Jerusalem to be rebuilt, and then inform us what your will is in this matter.

dag: Ka Pool daa yiɣisi zani n-kpuɣ o nuu gahiri ka yɛri ba, Yinim Izraɛlnim mini yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Naawuni, wummiya!.
en: Paul stood up, raised his hand to get their attention, and said, People of Israel and all you others who worship the true God, please listen to me!.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: And its porch was at the end of the gateway next to the outer courtyard. Carvings of palm trees were on the walls on either side of the gateway . There were eight steps leading up to the gate.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba salo maa ni ka sokam wum.
en: In the presence of all the people, Jesus said to his disciples.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ teebul la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nuzaa polo pateesa la nyaaŋa.
en: He placed the table in the meeting tent, on the north side of the dwelling, outside the veil.

dag: Di saha ka Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la yɛl o nyaandolitab maa, Dindina chɛliya ka ti zaa dol o chaŋ ka ti min o ti laɣim kpi.
en: Then Thomas, the one called Twin, said to the other followers, We will go too. We will die there with Jesus.

dag: Bɛ daa yi ŋmɛrila mɔɣilɔnim jɛmd a, amaa pumpɔŋɔ nyini m-be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ŋɔ. Binneen yiɣira bɛn ŋmani zunzuya n-nyɛ a bindoo, ka zunzuya nyɛ a chinchini ka a zaŋ pili.
en: You used to be honored with the music of harps, but now here you are in the world of the dead. You lie on a bed of maggots and are covered with a blanket of worms.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka goli wuhiri saha, ka chɛ ka wuntaŋ mi o lubu saha.
en: You created the moon to mark the months; the sun knows the time to set.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kpe ni o ti mali maligu, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Jɛhu daa zaŋla ninvuɣ pihinii zali samban ni di saha maa ka yɛli ba, Ŋun chɛ ka n ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni ŋɔ ni so zo n-tiligi, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: Then they went in to offer sacrifices and entirely burned offerings. But Jehu had stationed eighty soldiers outside and told them, Im handing these people over to you. Whoever lets even one of them escape will pay for it with his life.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, a kum dabisa miriya, bolimi Jɔshua ka yi ka man Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni na ka n ti zaŋ tuma maa ti o. Ka Musa mini Jɔshua daa chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, You do not have much longer to live. Call Joshua and bring him to the Tent, so that I may give him his instructions. Moses and Joshua went to the Tent.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bi ʒe na so nyaaŋa ka chɛ so, bee n-lihi nya bundaamba ka chɛ nandaamba, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla o nuhi tuma.
en: He does not respect leaders more than other people. And he does not respect the rich more than the poor. God made everyone.

dag: Ŋunkam deei saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun doli so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee, amaa ŋun zaɣisi zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla ŋun kpe yɔɣu.
en: Those who heed instruction are on the way to life, but those who ignore correction lose their way.

dag: Daŋ kam puuni dunoya zuɣulaannim shɛb daa tɔhiya ni bɛ sɔŋ tuma maa. Gomna daa tila salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram anii ni taha pihinu ni maligumaaniba binyɛra kɔbisinu ni pihita.
en: Some of the family leaders gave money to support the work. The governor gave pounds of gold to the treasury. He also gave bowls and pieces of clothing for the priests.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, ti suŋ kam wandila wal suma, ka ti biɛɣukam mi wandi wal biɛri.
en: In the same way, every good tree produces good fruit, and every rotten tree produces bad fruit.

dag: O ni ti kana ti saɣim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ, ka chɛ ka alɔbo di di ni yɛn di shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb daba, ka chɛ ka tɔbu mi di di ni yɛn di shɛba.
en: He will attack Egypt and kill many of its people; others will die of disease or be dragged away as prisoners.

dag: Ŋunkam paɣir o ʒiʒiinikpee ti yaɣi nyɛla ŋun bariti o ʒiʒiinikpee maa zana.
en: People who flatter their friends spread out a net for their feet.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka chilibi buɣim yi o sani alizanda ni n-lu Sɔdom mini Gomɔra zuɣu na.
en: Suddenly the Lord rained burning sulfur on the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya kam lɔri duŋ taabo nia, ka zuliya kam lɔri nia biɛri din ka buchi?.
en: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ a min a mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ Lɛvinim la mir omaŋa. Di zaa yoli ka yi lan bɔri maligumaanitali tuma gba?.
en: He has let you and all the other Levites have this honor—and now you are trying to get the priesthood too!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ sani.
en: Then he put all of it in the hands of Aaron and his sons. Moses lifted these pieces to show he was offering them before the Lord .

dag: Kum yi ti lu, o ni tilig a ka a ku kpi; tɔb tuhibu ni, o ni tilig a takɔbi kum ni.
en: when famine comes, he will keep you alive, and in war protect you from death.

dag: Ka daŋ kam puuni dunoya zuɣulaannim shɛb gba daa ti salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pisopɔinayika ni anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: Some of the heads of families gave , darics of gold and , manehs of silver to the treasury for the work.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Saimɔn, Saimɔn, Sintani lo nia ni o kpɛhi ya nuu ni yɛli ya kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la.
en: Simon, Simon, look! Satan has asserted the right to sift you all like wheat.

dag: Ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: Jesus' disciples were even more amazed. They asked each other, How can anyone ever be saved.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di niŋ bɛn daa nyɛ yi tab la alahiziba, yi ni bi lan doli ba tumdi tuun yoya ŋɔ zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ saɣindi yi yuya.
en: They think its strange that you dont join in these activities with the same flood of unrestrained wickedness. So they slander you.

dag: N kul ni nyuri bara Yawɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu wum li ka mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Humble people, listen and be happy, while I brag about the Lord .

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛli niŋ bɛ baɣaka ʒiɛmdila bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn wum saɣisigu ni nya tɛhi zilima.
en: If you refuse to learn, you are hurting yourself. If you accept correction, you will become wiser.

dag: Dama yi yi bi pal alikauli zaŋ chaŋ laɣ yoya ŋɔ polo, ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi zaŋ azichi maŋli niŋ yi nuu ni?.
en: If, then, you have not been faithful in handling worldly wealth, how can you be trusted with true wealth?.

dag: Sujee nyɛla putɔɣu, ka suhuyiɣisili kɔŋ tim, amaa nyuli zabbu m-bie n-gari di zaa.
en: Anger is cruel and destructive, but it is nothing compared to jealousy.

dag: Kpahimmiya kahiŋkɔri: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna bee kunchuna; amaa Naawuni n-dihiri ba. Yi mali bukaata pam gari noonsi.
en: Look at the crows: they don't plant seeds or gather a harvest; they don't have storage rooms or barns; God feeds them! You are worth so much more than birds!.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, N yi yɛl a, a ni ku ma bee a ku ku ma? Ka n yi wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm a ku dee li.
en: I answered, If I tell you the truth, you will put me to death, and if I give you advice, you won't pay any attention.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ nasaridira ŋɔ yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka chɛ ka o diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam ŋɔ? O chɛ ka o nyaŋ nanim mini zuliya kam. O zaŋ o takɔbi tim bɛ ni n-niŋ ba kaman taŋkpaɣu la. Ka zaŋ o piɛma to n-wurim ba kaman wurigu la.
en: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa. N ni yili yila paɣ a wuna sani.
en: I thank you, Lord , with all my heart; I sing praise to you before the gods.

dag: Naftali bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jaziɛl mini Guni ni Jɛzar ni Shallum, bɛ daa nyɛla Biliha zuliya.
en: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.

dag: ka dɔbba gba chɛ paɣiba golibu ka ŋmaligi doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri n-gɔndila bɛ dɔtaba, ka bɛ kɔr biɛri tuma maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari tibidarigibo din simdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: In the same way, men stopped having natural sex with women and began wanting each other all the time. Men did shameful things with other men, and in their bodies they received the punishment for those wrongs.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Naa n-tim ma ni n ti niŋ shɛli ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka so baŋ timsim maa yɛla bee n ni tim a ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Amaa m mini nachimba bɛn chani maa, n wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn paai ma luɣ shɛli.
en: David answered him, The king gave me a special order. He told me, Dont let anyone know about this mission. No one must know what I told you to do. I told my men where to meet me.

dag: Ka ti dimnim maa daa yɛli, Bɛ ku baŋ bee n-nya binshɛli pɔi, ka ti kana ti liri ba ku ba, ka tuma maa zani tariga.
en: Our enemies thought we would not see them or know what was happening until they were already upon us, killing us and putting an end to our work.

dag: Yisifu biɛyanim ni daa nya ka bɛ ba kpi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Di pa shɛli ka Yisifu zaɣisi ti ka bɔhi ti biɛri ti ni daa niŋ o zaɣ biɛ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: When Josephs brothers realized that their father was now dead, they said, What if Joseph bears a grudge against us, and wants to pay us back seriously for all of the terrible things we did to him.

dag: O ni ti lan chɛ ka yi ni daa zɔri Ijipti dɔr shɛŋa la zaa labina ti gbahi ya n-kul be yi ni.
en: He will bring on you once again all the dreadful diseases you experienced in Egypt, and you will never recover.

dag: Amaa alahichinim bɛn ni ti bahi yoli zaa, ka ninvuɣ biɛri zuliya ti bahi yoli.
en: But wrongdoers will be destroyed all together; the future of the wicked will be cut short.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka Izraɛl nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Naawuni yi chɛ ka o niriba tɔŋ, Yaakubu zuliya ni mali suhupiɛlli; ka Izraɛlnim suhuri paligi.
en: Let Israels salvation come out of Zion! When God changes his peoples circumstances for the better, Jacob will rejoice; Israel will celebrate!.

dag: Yɛndana niŋdila binshɛɣukam ni yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun wuhirila jɛrilim palo ni.
en: Wise people always think before they do anything, but fools show how stupid they are by what they do.

dag: A zo nyɛla ŋun yur a sahakam, ka mabihi mi nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛba ni bɛ sɔŋdi taba ashaara saha.
en: Friends love all the time, and kinsfolk are born for times of trouble.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu Yawɛ sani. Di simdi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be tibi paɣir o.
en: All you that are righteous, shout for joy for what the Lord has done; praise him, all you that obey him.

dag: Di zaŋ ma pahi ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ni dari ma chaŋ, bɛn tɔɣisiri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab suhudoo yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka jɛlinsi be bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Dont drag me off with the wicked and those who do evil; the type who talk nice to their friends while evil thoughts are in their hearts!.

dag: Amaa so ni bɔhi, Ka wula ka kpiimba lee yɛn tooi neei kum ni? Ka niŋgbun bɔ ka bɛ lee yɛn mali.
en: But someone will say, How are the dead raised? What kind of body will they have when they come back.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti wum ka Filip yihi Naawuni nam mini Yisa Masia yuli waazu maa ka bɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.

dag: Yihimiya yi biɛr kurili din chɛ ka yi be kaman yi ni daa pun be shɛm la bahi, dama yi biɛr kurili maa daa pun saɣim la kɔr biɛ shɛŋa din daa yɔhim ya la puuni.
en: change the former way of life that was part of the person you once were, corrupted by deceitful desires.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, bɛ tahima lee nyɛ dini saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti chɛ ba bahi, saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti deei bɛ nyɛviya?.
en: For what hope has the godless when God cuts them off, when he takes them away.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul kpalim be nayili maa hal ti paai Naa Sairus nam dibu yuun tuuli saha.
en: Daniel remained at the royal court until Cyrus, the emperor of Persia, conquered Babylonia.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim maa sansan ni nti ku ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu, ka biɛɣu daa neei ka kpiimba kul yɛrigi luɣilikam.
en: The Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed , of them all in one night. The next morning, the camp was full of dead bodies.

dag: amaa bɛ daa bi tooi tɔɣisi luh o, dama o daa tɔɣisirimi ni yɛm mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko.
en: But the Spirit was helping him speak with wisdom. His words were so strong that these Jews could not argue with him.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi Daniɛl ʒii nyabu puuni yuŋ. Ka Daniɛl daa paɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: During the night, God explained the secret to Daniel in a vision. Then Daniel praised the God of heaven.

dag: Nakpahi pia puuni wain tihi wala ni ti yihi wain palila lita anii kɔŋko, ka kawaan bira din ni pali lita kɔbiga ni pihinii daatam ni ti palila lita pisaayika.
en: Ten acres of vineyard will produce just one bath, and a homer of seed will produce only an ephah.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nam binshɛɣukam ŋɔ yi shihi tiŋgbani, di tahirimi bɔɣira, ka bɛnkam be di ni fabinda, ka di kpuɣi zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la, ka lab lu kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: The Sovereign Lord Almighty touches the earth, and it quakes; all who live there mourn. The whole world rises and falls like the Nile River.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli suhuyiɣisili soli n-nahindi bɛ ni su zuliya shɛba, ka kul bi chɛri ba putɔɣu nahiŋgu maa.
en: who angrily oppressed the peoples and never stopped persecuting the nations they had conquered.

dag: Di chɛ ka ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛlimaŋli yi a kɔbili ni. Zaŋmi li lo a nyiŋgol ni, ka sab li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Dont ever let love and loyalty leave you. Tie them around your neck, and write them on your heart.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa darig a niriba maa tibili la, bɛ nandahima puuni, bɛ daa suh a pam.
en: You punished your people, Lord , and in anguish they prayed to you.

dag: Ka Rut daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka bɔhi Bɔaz, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti niŋdi ma nirilim lala? Ka bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti lihi nya man ŋun nyɛ tinzun nir ŋɔ lala.
en: Then Ruth bowed very low to the ground. She said to Boaz, I am a foreigner, so I am surprised you even noticed me.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni bi so ŋun nyɛ falidira yi na nyɛ bia, hal o ni kul su binshɛɣukam maa zaa yoli, o bi gari dabili.
en: But now to continue—the son who will receive his father's property is treated just like a slave while he is young, even though he really owns everything.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Saɣisimiya miri ma na. Ka bɛ daa saɣisi mir o. Ka o yɛli ba, Mani yi tizo Yisifu so yi ni daa zaŋ kɔhi Ijipti ŋɔ la m-bala.
en: Then Joseph said to them, Please come closer. They did, and he said, I am your brother Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: The LORD relented concerning this: This also wont take place, says the LORD God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bɔhir o lala maa zuɣu ka o yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Ŋun na ʒi n-tum alahichi yi ni, ŋun daŋm o kuɣili labbu.
en: As they stood there asking him questions, he straightened up and said to them, Whichever one of you has committed no sin may throw the first stone at her.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣirimi dooni tiŋkpansi n-guri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Bɛ kul lihirimi ni bɛ nya bɛn ku tooi sɔŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: They hide just outside the villages, waiting to kill innocent people, always looking for any helpless person they can hurt.

dag: Saɣiŋgu! Dabari zanibu! Saɣiŋgu! Niriba suhuri ŋooya, ka bɛ duna ŋmɛri taba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ nina mɔhi zaa.
en: Now Nineveh is empty. Everything is stolen. The city is ruined. People have lost their courage, their hearts melt with fear, their knees knock together, their bodies shake, and their faces turn pale.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Nail Mɔɣili kom nyuui, ka n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni. N ni ti chɛ ka tinzunnim saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will dry up the Nile canals; I will sell the land to evildoers. With the help of foreigners I will lay waste to the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: A ʒiɛyimtali kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni. Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka di mi kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Your faithfulness extends from one generation to the next! You set the earth firmly in place, and it is still there.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ kasi, ka mali niriba maa ka bɛ niŋ kasi; ka lan mali dunɔdaya mini gooni maa ka di gba niŋ kasi.
en: The priests and the Levites performed ritual purification for themselves, the people, the gates, and the city wall.

dag: Kaiafas maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛli Yɛhudianim ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu la.
en: He was also the one who had told the other Jewish leaders that it would be better if one man died for all the people.

dag: Timiya ma soli ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa naai, di nyaaŋa, yin malimiya ma ansarisi.
en: Give me a chance to speak and then, when I am through, sneer if you like.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nam kana, ka chɛ ka a yubu niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni ka di ni niŋdi alizanda ni shɛm la.
en: We pray that your kingdom will come— that what you want will be done here on earth, the same as in heaven.

dag: N ni be Izraɛlnim sani kaman maligim la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom la. Bɛ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman nyoo la.
en: I will be like the dew to Israel. Israel will blossom like the lily. He will grow like the cedar trees of Lebanon.

dag: Ŋunkam deei saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun doli so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee, amaa ŋun zaɣisi zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla ŋun kpe yɔɣu.
en: People who listen when they are corrected will live, but those who will not admit that they are wrong are in danger.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa yɛl o ma, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a suhirila Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili maa n-tiri Adɔnija? Dindina suhim ma nam ŋɔ gba ti o; dama o nyɛla m biɛli, ka maligumaana Abiata mini Zɛruya bia Jɔab la be o polo.
en: Why do you ask me to give Abishag to him? the king asked. You might as well ask me to give him the throne too. After all, he is my older brother, and Abiathar the priest and Joab are on his side.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Mɛrari daŋ niriba shɛb Musa mini Aduna ni daa kali kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: These are the enrolled of the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the LORDs command through Moses.

dag: ni Joɛl ni Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔshibia bia la, ka Jɔshibia daa nyɛ Sɛraya bia ka Sɛraya mi nyɛ Asiɛl bia.
en: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma anii; ka daa ti kpi ka di bi niŋ so nandahima. Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o nanim silisi la ni.
en: Jehoram had become king at the age of thirty-two and had ruled in Jerusalem for eight years. Nobody was sorry when he died. They buried him in David's City, but not in the royal tombs.
