dag: Yihim ma vi shɛli n ni zɔri ni, dama a zaligunim viɛla.
en: Remove the insults that I dread because your rules are good.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Musa, Yim n sani, Miri ka a lan chɛ ka n nya a yaha. N nini yi ti lan nya a, n ni ku a.
en: Then Pharaoh told Moses, Get out of here. I dont want you to come here again. The next time you come to see me, you will die.

dag: Ti ku lab ti yinsi faashee ka Izraɛlnim zaa ti nya bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana.
en: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lo ti alikauli Sinai zoli gbini.
en: At Mount Sinai the Lord our God made a covenant.

dag: N ni lan chɛ ka a zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ m mini n saawaranim maa ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun jɛmbu duu be Jɛrusalɛm maa ka di nyɛ ti suhuyubu pina la m-mali chaŋ.
en: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.

dag: Ti Duuma Shia Kasi be n zuɣu, dama o pii ma ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti tarimba. O tim ma na ni n ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ daba la yi dabitim ni, ka chɛ ka zoomba nina neei, ka fa bɛn be muɣisigu ni la bahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has chosen me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to set free the oppressed.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ piɛlaa maa kpam min o zuli ni kpam ni o nyɔri kpam ni o saba ni o yaannina ayi ni di kpam ni o nudirigu gbalipuɣili, dama o nyɛla maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa.
en: Take the fatty parts of the ram: the fat tail, the fat around the inner organs, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys with the fat around them, and the right thigh .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋmanila nyee ni pɔhim, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mi ka buchi. Nir yi zaŋ ba pa sania zuɣu, bɛ tibisim bi yaɣ lala; hal bɛ zaa tibisim yi laɣim, di bi paai nyee ni pɔhim tibisim gba.
en: Human beings are all like a puff of breath; great and small alike are worthless. Put them on the scales, and they weigh nothing; they are lighter than a mere breath.

dag: Dindali maa ka Firawuna daa zali bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa zaligu yɛli.
en: That same day the king gave orders to his Egyptian slave bosses and to the Israelite men directly in charge of the Israelite slaves. He told them:.

dag: ka a niriba nya biɛhigu shee nimaani. Naawuni, a ti nandaamba din simdi ba a nirilim niŋbu puuni.
en: Your people came back to live there, and you provided good things for the poor.

dag: Ziɔn nachimbihi daa ŋmanila salima ti sani. Nyam bɛ ni niŋ ba shɛm kaman yaɣiri duɣ shɛŋa yaɣimɛra ni zaŋ o nuhi me la.
en: Zion's young people were as precious to us as gold, but now they are treated like common clay pots.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi puuni, Naawuni daa yɛli Firawuna, N ni zal a daliri shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni n wuhi n yiko tuma a ni, ka di chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia zaa.
en: Scripture says to Pharaoh, I have put you in this position for this very thing: so I can show my power in you and so that my name can be spread through the entire earth. .

dag: Ka Yisa boli ba na ti bɔhi ba; Wula ka Sintani ni tooi kari Sintani? Ka ŋahi ba ŋaha yɛli.
en: When Jesus called them together he spoke to them in a parable: How can Satan throw Satan out?.

dag: Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo; m bi kamina ni n ti ti suhudoo, amaa takɔbi ka n tahina.
en: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi naɣibila bee piɛbila bee bubila, di simdi ka o be o ma sani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin, ka daba anii zaŋ chana, yi yi zaŋ o nyo buɣim mali sara ti man Yawɛ, n ni deei li.
en: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.

dag: O daa yɛlimi, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma m-pal o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli.
en: He prayed this long prayer to the Lord: The Lord , the God of Israel, is great. He has done what he promised my father David. He told my father.

dag: N yɛn gbib biɛrim n suhu ni ti paala bɔ saha? N yɛn malila suhugarigu dabisi muni puuni zaa? N dimnim kul yɛn nyandi ma ka di yuusim paala bɔ saha?.
en: How long will I be left to my own wits, agony filling my heart? Daily? How long will my enemy keep defeating me?.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa bɛ ku tooi wum; bɛ mi bi vuhira.
en: They have ears, but they cant listen. No, theres no breath in their lungs!.

dag: Yɛnnim yi nya ka barina kanna, bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa ka tarimba bɛn chaŋ ti di di wahala.
en: Sensible people will see trouble coming and avoid it, but an unthinking person will walk right into it and regret it later.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ka o sanna ti yɛra, Jɔn daa bi tum alahiziba tuun shɛli, amaa o ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ doo ŋɔ polo nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Many people came to him. John didnt do any miraculous signs, they said, but everything John said about this man was true.

dag: buɣim dibu la buɣim dibu, daŋ la daŋa, fiɛb bɔba la fiɛb bɔba la n-darigi dilan tibili.
en: a burn for a burn, a bruise for a bruise, a cut for a cut.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya ka a ba maa lee be? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi ma bee m Ba. Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba.
en: Where is your father? they asked him. You know neither me nor my Father, Jesus answered. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa paɣ o ninni ka yina nti maag o ni ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya bindirigu ti ti na.
en: After he had washed his face, he came out, and controlling himself, he ordered the meal to be served.

dag: Doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni wuhi yi yɛm mini yi baŋsim ni nyɛ shɛm niriba sani; bɛ yi ti wum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa yɛla bɛ ni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, zuliya titali ŋɔ niriba nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: Obey them faithfully, and this will show the people of other nations how wise you are. When they hear of all these laws, they will say, What wisdom and understanding this great nation has.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n daa zaŋla n nuu kpɛh a biɛhigu ni zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, mani n-daa piɛl a dimnim maa bah a zuɣu a wahala saha min a nandahima saha.
en: The LORD said: Havent I taken care of you? Havent I helped you with your enemies in time of trouble and distress?.

dag: A yi chana, binshɛli ku gabi a naba, ka a yi guui, a ku tuui.
en: As you walk on it, you will not step into a trap. Even if you run, you will not trip and fall.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni; yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Stay alert and pray so that you wont give in to temptation. The spirit is eager, but the flesh is weak.

dag: Hal bihi siŋdi ma mi, n yi yiɣisi, bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa jɛndiri ma.
en: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.

dag: nyin be a alizanda ni; ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: then listen from heaven to their prayer and request and do what is right for them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman ti yil o ni daa sa gar da shɛŋa ni o zaŋ M.
en: So they hanged Haman on the hanging post he had built for Mordecai. Then the king stopped being angry.

dag: M mini Masia kpimi o dapulli zuɣu, ka di pala mani n-lan be maa, amaa di nyɛla Masia ŋun be n ni la m-be maa; ka n ni mali biɛhigu shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, m mal li la Naawuni Bia ŋun daa yuri ma ka kpi n zuɣu maa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: No one knows when that day or time will be. The Son and the angels in heaven dont know when that day or time will be. Only the Father knows.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, yin vuhimiya. Hal di yi nyɛla kɔbu saha mini puri atam kpuɣibu saha, yin vuhimiya.
en: You should do your work for six days, but on the seventh day you should rest. Even during plowing or harvesttime you should rest.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi po pɔri, yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: If you dont make a promise, you are not sinning.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni o bi yɛri ba mi ni bɛ miri bɔrɔbɔro dabindi, amaa ni Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim wuhibu yɛla ka o yɛri maa.
en: Then they understood that he wasnt telling them to be on their guard for yeast used in making bread. No, he was telling them to watch out for the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: Chamiya Kaline nti nya; ka chaŋ Hamat din nyɛ tin tital la ni mini Gaat din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋ la ni nti nya. Tinsi maa gari Juda mini Izraɛl tinsi? Bee bɛ tiŋgbɔna galisimi gari yi tiŋgbɔŋ?.
en: Go look at Calneh. From there, go to the large city Hamath. Go to the Philistine city of Gath. Are you better than these kingdoms? Their countries are larger than yours.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti ni me fɔntinsi kpe n-zaŋ ti bihi niŋ di ni, ka me buzɔna n-zaŋ ti piɛri mini ti buhi niŋ di ni.
en: They approached Moses and said, First, allow us to build stone enclosures here for our sheep and fortified towns for our dependents.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri bɛ tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni nya bindirigu pam, amaa bɛn doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm.
en: A hard-working farmer has plenty to eat, but it is stupid to waste time on useless projects.

dag: Buɣim daa di n-ku bɛ nachimbihi, ka paɣisara daa kɔŋ amiliya lɔbu yila.
en: Fire devoured his young men, and his young women had no wedding songs.

dag: O daa lan bo bula yino so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: one male goat for a purification offering.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka bɛ gbiri yihiri kuriti, ka nyɛligiri tahiʒiɛɣu mi kuɣa ni.
en: We dig iron out of the ground And melt copper out of the stones.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ni daa ti paai Hiburɔn na, Jɔab daa zaŋ o la niriba sunsuuni yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini ni o ti tɔɣis o ashili yɛtɔɣa, ka daa ti zaŋ sua n-kuh o pul ni ka o kpi nimaani. O daa ku o mi n-yo o mabia Asahɛl kubu la samli.
en: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside next to the gate to speak with him in private. But instead Joab stabbed Abner in the stomach, and he died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joabs brother.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Zara daa nya yaa niŋ pua, hal o ni daa yaɣi dɔɣibu saha shɛl la, dama o daa niŋ ŋun lo o alikauli maa naani.
en: By faith even Sarah received the ability to have a child, though she herself was barren and past the age for having children, because she believed that the one who promised was faithful.

dag: A daanab shɛb bɛn daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛri ni Babilɔn naa ku kana ti tuh a bee n-tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim la lee be ya?.
en: Have you locked up the prophets who lied to you and said that the king of Babylonia would never attack Jerusalem?.

dag: Ti yi kul tumd alahichi milinsi puuni, ti ni baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛl la nyaaŋa, sara maligu shɛli lan kani din ni kpihim ti daalahichi.
en: If we decide to continue sinning after we have learned the truth, then there is no other sacrifice that will take away sins.

dag: Ʒiɛman biɛɣu ŋɔ nim ninvuɣ yino gba nini ku nya n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli ti yi yaannim maa.
en: Not one of you from this evil generation will enter the fertile land that I promised to give your ancestors.

dag: Zaŋmiya tampiɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia m-mali m biɛhigu shee, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain, n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: The Holy Tent should be made from ten curtains. These curtains must be made from fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn. A skilled worker should sew pictures of Cherub angels with wings into the curtains.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim, alɔbo ni di ba, ka bɛ pakoya ku kum bɛ kuya.
en: Those who survive will die from disease, and even their widows will not mourn their death.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Judanim tum alahichi n ninni. Bɛ zaŋ din chihiri kpe n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛl la ni n-ta li daɣiri.
en: Do this because I have seen the people of Judah doing evil things. This message is from the Lord . They have set up their idols, and I hate those idols. They have set up idols in the Temple that is called by my name. They have made my house dirty!.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa be n sani, o na ʒi n-chɛ ma n ko, dama n kul tumdila din tiɣir o nini sahakam.
en: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai palo shɛli din wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu n-ti Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la ka di nyɛ bɛ ni su shɛli, ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntinsi be di ni.
en: Another area, , cubits long and , cubits wide, will be for the Levites who serve in the Temple. This land will also become cities for the Levites.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nini ni nya ma zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? Amaa bɛn nini bi nya ma ka niŋ yɛda mal alibarika.
en: Jesus said, Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed.

dag: Ka so kani ŋun mali suhukpeeni din ni tooi niŋ o ka o suhu yiɣisi. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zan o tooni?.
en: When he is aroused, he is fierce; no one would dare to stand before him.

dag: Tumtumdiba yi di n-tiɣi bee bɛ yi bi di n-tiɣi, bɛ yi dɔni, bɛ gbihirimi pali bɛ nina, amaa bundana ŋun buni zuɣu chɛmi ka o gaani gom.
en: Those who work hard all day come home and sleep in peace. It is not important if they have little or much to eat. But the rich worry about their wealth and are not able to sleep.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mbo! A garigi viɛnyɛliŋga; niŋmi lala ka be.
en: Jesus said, You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim tam ŋun nam ba yɛla, ka mɛla nanim yiya. Ka Judanim me fɔntinsi pam, ka me goondahi gil li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka buɣim lu bɛ fɔntinsi maa zuɣu n-di bɛ sɔɣisili shɛhi zaa.
en: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni mini Anabi Musa daa tɔɣisi taba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ti bi mi doo maa ŋun ni yi shɛl na.
en: We know that God spoke to Moses. But we dont even know where this man comes from.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri ya, ka gbib o ni daa po yi yaannim pɔri shɛl la zuɣu ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n yihi ya dabitim ni, ka fan ya Ijipti naa Firawuna nuu ni bahi maa.
en: No, it is because the LORD loved you and because he kept the solemn pledge he swore to your ancestors that the LORD brought you out with a strong hand and saved you from the house of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh, Egypts king.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb leei daba n-ʒi n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la ni yino. Di saha maa, Jɛhoyachin n-daa nyɛ Juda naa.
en: Benjaminites had been taken into exile away from Jerusalem along with the group, which included Judahs King Jeconiah, whom Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar exiled to Babylon.

dag: Di zaliya yi daazichi dunia ŋɔ ni, dama dunia ŋɔ ni di zahindimi, ka lɛla saɣindi li, ka tayiɣisi kabiri kpɛri zuri li.
en: Do not store up riches for yourselves here on earth, where moths and rust destroy, and robbers break in and steal.

dag: Anabi ninkur so daa be Bɛtɛl di saha maa. Ka o bidibisi daa kuli ti yɛl o Naawuni nir maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa Bɛtɛl dindali maa yɛla; ka lan yɛl o o ni daa yɛli Naa Jɛrɔbɔam shɛlikam zaa la gba yɛla.
en: At that time an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons told him what the prophet from Judah had said and done.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi nam fukumsinim yɛligu dolibu zaɣisila Naawuni ni zali shɛli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala ni bo tibidarigibo ti bɛmaŋa.
en: So anyone who opposes the authority is standing against what God has established. People who take this kind of stand will get punished.

dag: N kpalimla yɔbahi mabia, ka nyɛ taatahi dolinikpee.
en: I have become a brother to jackals, a companion to young ostriches.

dag: Amaa n dimnim bɛn daa bi bɔri ni n su ba la, zaŋmiya ba na nti ku ba n nini ŋɔ ni.
en: Now bring me the enemies who didn't want me to be their king. Kill them while I watch.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka gɔhi bili m puu ni, ka pa ni alikama, ka chɛ ka yihim bili ka pa ni chi. Ayuba yɛtɔɣa tariga m-bala.
en: may briars grow instead of wheat, poisonous weeds instead of barley. Jobs words are complete.

dag: Ka shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni chɛ ka bɛ zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: On the other hand, if I say that I am going to plant or build up any nation or kingdom.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmɛri bɔɣiri tampiŋ sɔŋdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ kɔba bahi gballi nol ni.
en: Our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave, just like when the ground is broken up and plowed.

dag: Amaa a dabili maa yi yɛl a, N ku chaŋ ka chɛ a, ka di nyɛla o ni yur a mini a yiŋnima yi ni gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But your slave may not want to leave; he may love you and your family and be content to stay.

dag: O dolila wuntia soli kariti dunianim saria; o bi gaŋdi so o saria karibu ni.
en: He rules the world with righteousness; he judges the nations with justice.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: A ni suhi ma yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Then Isaiah, Amozs son, sent a message to Hezekiah: The LORD God of Israel says this: Since you prayed to me about Assyrias King Sennacherib.

dag: N ni chaŋ nimaani ti nya bɛ shiri tumdi bɛ ni yɛri ni bɛ tumdi shɛm maa zaa bee bɛ bi tumdi li.
en: I must go down to find out whether or not the accusations which I have heard are true.

dag: Zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣim o! Kom din be sagbana zuɣusaa ha, paɣim o.
en: Praise him, highest heavens, and the waters above the sky.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M bindirigu nyɛla n tum ŋun tim ma na yubu, ka naag o tuma.
en: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka biɛrim yiɣisi n niŋgbuna ni m-be kaman paɣa ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la, ka n ni daa wum ka nya ʒii shɛli maa puuni maa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: What I saw and heard in the vision has filled me with terror and pain, pain like that of a woman in labor.

dag: Nachimbili ni kpuɣiri paɣipiɛliga shɛm la, lala ka bɛn me a zali yɛn kpuɣ a. Aŋgo suhu ni piɛl o daamiliya zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a Naawuni suhu yɛn piɛl a zuɣu.
en: As a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you. With the joy of a bridegroom because of his bride, so your God will rejoice because of you.

dag: O yi vuhi, buɣim taarila sala, ka buɣim zibizibi yir o noli ni na.
en: His breath sets coals on fire, and flames shoot from his mouth.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Musa zali ya la. Dina n-nyɛ: Yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka tumm o yubu, ka dol o zaligunima, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, ka kul jɛmm o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa.
en: Moses taught you to love the Lord your God, to be faithful to him, and to worship and obey him with your whole heart and with all your strength. So be very careful to do everything Moses commanded.

dag: Ka n garigi yɛl o, N dana, m bi mi. Wuhim ma! Ka o yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla bɛn yi wahala titali dibu ni na ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ Piɛbil la ʒim paɣ shɛb binyɛra ka di paligi zaa la.
en: I answered, You know who they are, sir. And the elder said, These are the ones who have come out of the great suffering. They have washed their robes with the blood of the Lamb, and they are clean and white.

dag: Ka n daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka a chana? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, N Chanimi ni n ti buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm m-baŋ di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: and I asked, Where are you going? To measure Jerusalem, was the answer. To find out how wide and long it is.

dag: Di chɛ ka a dabili nyari saɣisibu, ka di dolibu mali laara pam.
en: No doubt about it: your servant is enlightened by them; there is great reward in keeping them.

dag: Bɛ puhim chuɣu maa ka di di bindirigu mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaanahi dali.
en: They must celebrate Passover just before dark on the th day of the second month. At that time they must eat the lamb, the bread made without yeast, and the bitter herbs.

dag: A ŋmaag o bipolitali saha dabisa jia, ka chɛ ka o di vi.
en: Youve shortened the prime of his life. Youve wrapped him up in shame. Selah.

dag: Zuliya ayi ni pirigili maa daa pun deei bɛ tarili ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo.
en: on the eastern side of the Jordan, opposite Jericho.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kariti saria luhiri so ka yiɣisiri so la sani ka di yirina.
en: it is God who is the judge, condemning some and acquitting others.

dag: Daba n-su ti, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ti bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Slaves have become our rulers. No one can save us from them.

dag: ka su kom luɣ kasi shee maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛra ye n-yina ti mal o sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini niriba sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-yo omaŋmaŋ daalahichi mini niriba maa daalahichi samli.
en: He must take a bath in a holy place and put on his own clothes. After that, he shall go out and offer the burnt offering to remove his own sins and those of the people.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni ti zaa ti zani Masia tooni ka o kari ti saria, ka sokam ti deeg o ni daa tum shɛm o niŋgbuŋ ni nyɔri, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: We all must appear before Christ in court so that each person can be paid back for the things that were done while in the body, whether they were good or bad.

dag: Ka Akishi daa niŋ Dauda naani pam ka yɛli, O chɛ ka o niriba Izraɛlnim bi lan bɔr o yɛlli zaa, dinzuɣu o kul ni nyɛ n tumtumda sahakam.
en: But Achish trusted David and thought, David's people must be furious with him. From now on he will have to take orders from me.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa yɛli sapashin la min o tɔbbihi, Niriba ŋɔ yi yi ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni; yi ku tiligi.
en: But Paul said to the army officer and soldiers, If the sailors don't stay on board, you have no hope of being saved.

dag: O tiligi n shia ka di bi faai siɣi gballi ni, ka n nyɛvili ni lan nya neesim.
en: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bi niŋ yɛda suhupiɛlli zuɣu ka biɛhindi maa ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mali bindir shɛli kpe ka n ni di.
en: Because they were wondering and questioning in the midst of their happiness, he said to them, Do you have anything to eat.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-nyɛ Duuma ŋun nyɛ Jilimalana. Ka yi ni doli yɛda niŋbu adiini so shɛli o ni zal la zuɣu, di yaaya so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: My dear brothers and sisters, you are believers in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ. So dont treat some people better than others.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu, nyini n-nyɛ n jilima, ka chɛ ka n zuɣu ʒe ya.
en: But you, LORD, are my shield! You are my glory! You are the one who restores me.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, o je m Ba gba.
en: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija.
en: Then the Lord said to Elijah.

dag: Ka o yi wurim binshɛli, so ku tooi lan me li zali. O yi kpɛhi so duu, so ku tooi yooi dilan bahi.
en: If he tears down, it cant be rebuilt; if he ties a person up, he cant be set free.

dag: O ʒila o nam ʒiishee, ka lihirina n-nyari ninsalinim zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.

dag: Di ŋubiya sibiga, dama o gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa o ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, o nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: the rock badger—though it rechews food, it does not have divided hoofs, so it is unclean for you.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a ʒe katiŋa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a sɔɣ amaŋ yɛlimuɣisira saha?.
en: Lord , why do you stay so far away? Why do you hide from people in times of trouble?.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi niŋ niriba maa nirilim, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini, ka zaŋ zilimballi yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: They answered, If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should be kind and promise to make their work easier.

dag: m mali zuɣusuŋ yi sani, ka yi niŋ ma nirilim pam tiligi n nyɛvili, amaa n ku tooi zo nti du zoya ŋɔ, dama di pa shɛli ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli ti paai ma nimaani ka n kpi.
en: You have done me a great favor and saved my life. But the hills are too far away; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die before I get there.

dag: Daadam, malimi soya ayi ka di zaa yi tiŋgbɔn yin ni na, ka Babilɔn naa dol li kana. Sabimi pa dapaɣa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sa sochira zuɣu wuhi so shɛli din kpɛri tiŋ puuni.
en: Son of man, draw two roads that the sword of the king of Babylon can use to come to Israel. Both roads will come from the same country. Then draw a sign at the head of the road to the city.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi galisim maa pahi ʒii tuhili zuɣu, ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: May the Lord , the God of your ancestors, give you times more people than you are now! May he bless you as he promised.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din be dukpina ni ni kuhi bahi ya na, ka dapua din be dari ni garigi saɣi.
en: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka zaŋ yi nuhi tum tuma n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi tum yimaŋ barina. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord , say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛli; ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla din chihiri n noli ni yibu na.
en: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.

dag: ka nyin Ayuba yaag a noli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka bi mi di gbinni maa.
en: It is useless for you to go on talking; it is clear you don't know what you are saying.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tɔbu lu Sirianim zuɣu. Tɔbu lu bɛn be Babilɔn zuɣu, ka lu bɛ kpambaliba mini bɛ yɛnnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, Death to Babylonia! Death to its people, to its rulers, to its people of wisdom.

dag: Dama n zuɣu ka a ni nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka a nyɛvili yuma pahi.
en: Wisdom will help you live longer; she will add years to your life.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali bɛ ni yɛn nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: Then Bezalel used acacia wood to build the altar. This was the altar used for burning offerings. The altar was square. It was cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high.

dag: Amaa tinim daa niŋ tahima ni ŋuna n-yɛn tiligi Izraɛlnima; ka din pahi ŋɔ zaa ha zuɣu nyɛla, di ni niŋ maa zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: We had hoped he was the one who would redeem Israel. All these things happened three days ago.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N suhu ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yiɣisi maa? Pa bɛmaŋmaŋ ka bɛ niŋ lala ni di ŋmaligi di ba maa.
en: But am I really the one they are hurting? No, they are hurting themselves and bringing shame on themselves.

dag: Di saha Zɛba mini Zalimuna ni bɛ tɔbbihi daa bela Karikɔr. Wulimpuhili polɔnim maa tɔbbihi bɛn daa kpalim kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pinaanu, dama bɛ daa pun ku bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi bɛn daa gbib takɔbiri la.
en: Zebah and Zalmunna were at Karkor with their army. Of the whole army of desert tribesmen, only about , were left; , soldiers had been killed.

dag: Ti mi zɔri niriba ni ti yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But we cant say from humans because were afraid of the crowd, since everyone thinks John was a prophet.

dag: Firawuna yi ti nya ba, o suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa polo. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When Pharaoh sees them, he will be sorry for all his hordes who are slain by the sword— Pharaoh and all his army. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti niŋ nyini n dana zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam zaa o ni yɛli ni o ni niŋ a la, ka chɛ ka a leei Izraɛl naa.
en: And when the Lord has done all the good things he has promised you and has made you king of Israel.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; amaa karimbia ŋun nya wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga, o baŋsim min o karimba baŋsim ti saɣirila taba.
en: Disciples arent greater than their teacher, but whoever is fully prepared will be like their teacher.

dag: O daa yɛli Gaad zuliya: Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛligi Gaad tiŋgbani ŋɔ mali alibarika. Gaad zuliya niriba ŋmanila gbuɣinli. O darigiri tɔhigiri bɔɣu, ka darigiri fuɣiri zuɣugbana.
en: Then he told Gad: May Gads broad lands be blessed! He lives like a lion: he rips an arm, even a head!.

dag: Ka bɛ biriginsim zuɣu yi chɛ ka dunianim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, ka bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli nyabu zuɣu mi yi chɛ ka bɛn pa Izraɛlnim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, dindina Izraɛlnim yi pahi bɛ zuɣu Naawuni daalibarika maa ni gari lala.
en: The sin of the Jews brought rich blessings to the world, and their spiritual poverty brought rich blessings to the Gentiles. Then, how much greater the blessings will be when the complete number of Jews is included!.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ʒini nimaani yuui, ka kul tɔɣisiri ti Duuma yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa daanfaani yɛl shɛŋa maa nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa.
en: The apostles stayed there for a long time, speaking boldly about the Lord, who proved that their message about his grace was true by giving them the power to perform miracles and wonders.

dag: So miri ka o kpuɣ o paɣ mabia pah o zuɣu saha shɛl o paɣ maa ni na be o nyɛvili ni maa.
en: Do not take your wife's sister as one of your wives, as long as your wife is living.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Alikizanda bɛn nyɛ n ni zaŋ shɛb niŋ Sintani nuu ni bɛmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni di bi simdi ni bɛ mo Naawuni la.
en: Hymenaeus and Alexander are men like that. I have given them to Satan so that they will learn not to speak against God.

dag: Di saha ka Sool lan yɛli ba, Vihimiya m mini m bia Jɔnatan sunsuuni nya.! Ka di daa gbaala Jɔnatan.
en: Saul told Ahijah, Now ask the Lord to decide between Jonathan and me. The answer came back that Jonathan had sinned.

dag: N ni ti nyo Damaskus gooni la buɣim, ka di di Bɛnhadad kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la.
en: I will set the walls of Damascus on fire and will burn down King Benhadad's palaces. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kuri niriba chihiri bɛn ka taali, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi.
en: If you always try to be honest, murderers will hate you, but those who do what is right will want you to be their friend.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa garigi yɛli Jɔab, Hal anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili yi kpe n nuu ni gba, n ku zaŋ n nuu shihi nabia maa, dama ti di wum naa ni yɛl a mini Abishai ni Itai, N zuɣu miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom maa shɛli.
en: The man said to Joab, I would not try to hurt the kings son even if you gave me pieces of silver. We heard the kings command to you, Abishai, and Ittai. The king said, Be careful not to hurt young Absalom.

dag: Ka hal binshɛli yi pili n-liri ti lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla, di pili n-liri li mi zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bahi yol la kɔŋko sani.
en: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.

dag: ka daa bahi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuliyanima ayopɔin yoli, ka chɛ ka ti yaannim maa di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa fali.
en: God destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to his people.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ chira ata saha ka so daa ti yɛli Juda, Tama ŋun nyɛ a bia pakol la gɔrila pagɔrisigu, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla, o niŋla pua o pagɔrisigu maa gɔbu ni. Ka Juda daa yɛli, Zaŋmiy o na ti niŋ buɣim nyo o.
en: About three months later someone told Judah, Your daughter-in-law Tamar has behaved like a prostitute, and now she's pregnant! Drag her out of town and burn her to death! Judah shouted.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Asha zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Mishal mini Abidɔn.
en: From the tribe of Asher: Mishal and its pastures, Abdon and its pastures.

dag: N daa ti o dahima ni o niŋ tuuba o zina niŋbu maa zuɣu, amaa ka o zaɣisi tuuba maa niŋbu.
en: I have given her time to repent of her sins, but she does not want to turn from her immorality.

dag: Ka takɔr kɔrikɔɣa mini abie tihi daa be zɔntua maa luɣa zuɣu dukpina zuɣu.
en: At the sides of this room there were windows, and the walls were decorated with palm trees.

dag: ni vikpiluɣu mini viɣu zaɣ titali ni kulinoo.
en: little owls, great owls, white owls.

dag: A ni ti nyu li zaa n-lɛlilɛli di puuni, ka dim cheei li ka zaŋ di ŋmama maa ŋme m-bɔɣ a biha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you must drink every drop! Then smash the cup and chew on its broken pieces. Use them to cut your breasts in sorrow. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim la zali Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.

dag: N yi ti yɛn darig a tibili dahin shɛli, a ni tooi mali suhukpeeni bee a nuhi ni tooi mali yaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka mi ni niŋ li.
en: Do you think you will have any courage left or have strength enough to lift your hand when I am finished with you? I, the Lord , have spoken, and I keep my word.

dag: Ka Hanani bia Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ anabi la daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi Naa Jɛhɔshafat soli n-yɛl o, A tɛhiya ni di simdi ni a sɔŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri ka yuri bɛn je Yawɛ? A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a zuɣu.
en: The prophet Jehu, son of Hanani, went out to meet the king. Jehu said to him, Why did you help those who are wicked? Why do you love those who hate the Lord ? Thats the reason the Lord is angry with you now.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa ŋme n-kpihim Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba dini. Di saha ka Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba maa daa yiɣisi naa sani yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti kali Izraɛlnim maa.
en: King David strongly commanded Joab and the other captains of the army to count the people. So they went out from the king to count the people of Israel.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti ŋmaligi chaŋ bɛ namda ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani.
en: When that day comes, people will turn for help to their Creator, the holy God of Israel.

dag: Nyamiya, Naawuni be ti sani, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zuɣulana, ka o maligumaaniba mi mali tɔbutuhiri kikahi ni bɛ piɛb niŋ ti ka ti tuhi ya. Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, miriya ka yi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, dama yi ku di nasara.
en: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord , the God your ancestors worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka Saimɔn Pita ŋun daa mali takɔb la ŋooi li n-chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi. Dabili maa yuli n-daa booni Malikus.
en: Simon Peter had a sword, which he pulled out. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ni malaika gahinda zuɣu, n zal a ni a gbib wuhibunim ŋɔ, ka di zo so vi dimbɔŋɔ ni bee n-yaai so yuri ka chɛ so a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: Before God and Jesus Christ and the chosen angels, I tell you to make these judgments without any prejudice. Treat every person the same.

dag: ka naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin shɛb bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi daa yina n-ka bɛ sanna, ka n nini daa na ʒi n-nya bɛ tatabo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Just then, seven other cows, weak and frail and thin, climbed up after them. Ive never seen such awful cows in all the land of Egypt.

dag: ka ku lan doli Yɛhudianim kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli la mini ninsalinim zaligunima din nyɛ bɛn zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli ni zali shɛl la.
en: and no longer hold on to Jewish legends and to human commandments which come from people who have rejected the truth.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n tɛhi ni di simdi ni n kpam m mabihi maa jaande ka bɛ daŋ n tooni na nti mali yi ni lo alikauli ni yi tɔhi tɔto shɛl la shili zali, ka di wuhi ni di pala muɣisigu zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla yi suhu yubu pini tibu zuɣu.
en: So I thought it was necessary to urge these believers to go to you ahead of me and get ready in advance the gift you promised to make. Then it will be ready when I arrive, and it will show that you give because you want to, not because you have to.

dag: Shihir shɛli yi ni ti yɛn nya ka baŋ nyɛla, yi ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋ chinchini pili biliɛɣu maa sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: This is a sign for you: you will find a newborn baby wrapped snugly and lying in a manger.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd n-daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira n-lo o mihi kpɛhi duu ŋun Hɛrɔd tizo Filip paɣa Hɛrɔdias zuɣu.
en: For Herod had earlier ordered John's arrest, and he had him tied up and put in prison. He had done this because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

dag: Kul guhimiya Yawɛ, ka dol o soli, ka o duhi ya n-chɛ ka yi su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka yi nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɛn bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Put your hope in the Lord and obey his commands; he will honor you by giving you the land, and you will see the wicked driven out.

dag: ka Buki nyɛ Abishua bia, ka Abishua nyɛ Finɛhas bia, ka Finɛhas nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza mi nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulana Aduna bia.
en: son of Abishua, son of Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bipola ni ninkura ni niɣi ni piɛri ni bunsi; ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Without mercy, they wiped out everything in the city as something reserved for God—man and woman, young and old, cattle, sheep, and donkeys.

dag: Amaa bɛn baɣa daa ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa ni bɛn daa chɛla bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri niŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: But other people ignored the Lord s message and lost all their slaves and animals that were in the fields.

dag: O daa lan wurim Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi ni zaa buɣa mini bɛ ni daa yi tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka suhudoo be o nam ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: He destroyed every local shrine and incense altar in Judah.

dag: Ka bidibbihi mini bipuɣimbihi ni doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri diɛmda.
en: The city will be full of boys and girls playing in its plazas.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim maa nyɛla din ʒe pɔhima anahi din yi Yawɛ ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa la sanna zaani.
en: The messenger answered and said to me, These are the four winds of heaven that are going out after presenting themselves to the LORD of all the earth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan laɣim Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: Once more David called together the best soldiers in Israel, a total of thirty thousand men.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-mali duu maa puuni zaa, ka mali salima zoligɔnima n-zaŋ lo du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee la tooni, ka dooi salima pa di gba zuɣu.
en: He covered the inside of the Temple with pure gold and wrapped gold chains around it.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yihi dɔro maa ni be kuɣ shɛŋa ni maa n-yihi tiŋ maa kpaŋa nti bahi tampuli zuɣu.
en: the priest will order the stones in which the infection is found to be pulled out and discarded outside the city in an unclean area.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niɣi kpe baɣa pam, ka di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi bahira. Di chɛ ka ti doli solɔri kuhiri nandahima kumsi.
en: May our cattle reproduce plentifully without miscarriage or loss. May there be no cries of distress in our streets.

dag: Amaa yinim birigimi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ soli, ka yi wuhibu chɛ ka niriba pam tuui, yi saɣim n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛli maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you have turned from the path. You have caused many to stumble by your instruction. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Di yɛli a ʒiʒiinikpee, Cham ka sa labina biɛɣuni ka n zaŋ li ti a, di yi be a sani.
en: Dont say to your neighbor, Go and come back; Ill give it to you tomorrow, when you have it.

dag: O ni ti nyu wain ka o nina mɔhi; ka nyu bihim ka o nyina paligi.
en: Your eyes are darker than wine, your teeth whiter than milk.

dag: amaa hal yi zabigu zaɣ yini gba ti ku bɔrigi.
en: But don't worry!.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim maa ni yu shɛm zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Pool, A bɔri ni a chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar a saria nimaani.
en: Festus wanted to please the leaders. So he asked Paul, Are you willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried by me on these charges.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o tim o tɔbbihi ni bɛ chaŋ ti ku ninvuɣ kuriba maa, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: The king was very angry; so he sent his soldiers, who killed those murderers and burned down their city.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu ŋun Naawuni sani; lala zuɣu di simdi ni ti maligumaana ŋɔ gba mali shɛli din ni zaŋ mali maligu.
en: Every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices. So its necessary for this high priest also to have something to offer.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka bɛ nyuri bara la bɛ ni baŋ ma, ka mi n ni nyɛ so la zuɣu. Bɛ baŋya ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka m mali yurilim din galisi mini zaligu soli ni nimmaŋtali tumdi tuma dunia ni. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m mali suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: No, those who boast should boast in this: that they understand and know me. I am the LORD who acts with kindness, justice, and righteousness in the world, and I delight in these things, declares the LORD.

dag: Bɛ daa tim na nti yɛli ma la zilin yini maa siɣimsiɣim bunahi, ka n gba daa labisi garigibu yini maa ti ba.
en: Sanballat and Geshem sent the same message to me four times, and I sent the same answer back to them each time.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, yɔhiŋgu mini faɣiri dibu kul palila di ni, ka nɛma ʒiɛbu ku naai.
en: Doom, city of bloodshed—all deceit, full of plunder: prey cannot get away.

dag: nyama, n ni chɛ ka tinzunnim kana ti lir a. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri lu a yɛm din viɛl ŋɔ zuɣu, ka saɣim a jilima la.
en: I will bring ruthless enemies to attack you. They will destroy all the beautiful things you have acquired by skill and wisdom.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ka guhira, ka suhimiya Naawuni, dama yi bi mi di saha.
en: So watch out and be ready! You don't know when the time will come.

dag: Bɔ n-chɛ ka bɛ daa kpalim bɛ piɛri sani ni bɛ wumdi piɛguliba ni piɛbiri yuhi booni piɛri shɛm? Iin, Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: Why did you stay back among the sheep pens, listening to the music for the flocks? For the clans of Reuben there was deep soul-searching.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn zaŋ alikauli shɛli ti a ŋɔ niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: When I give you the Ten Commandments written on two flat stones, put them inside the chest.

dag: N ni kul wuhi ba ka ti ba yaa maa zaa yoli, bɛ bo soya n-tum tuumbiɛri jɛndi ma.
en: I trained them and made their arms strong, but they made evil plans against me.

dag: Hal mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa kul kumdimi n-niŋd a, kulibɔna ni koma zaa ni nyuui, ka buɣim di mɔɣu ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: Even the fields wild animals cry to you because the streams have dried up; the fire has completely destroyed the meadows of the wilderness.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ o naba ni. Amaa di ni sab yɛli ni o zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni maa, di bi wuhi ni ŋun Naawuni pah o ni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛli sɔŋ o naba ni maa zuɣu.
en: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.

dag: hal ti paai palo din be dunoli zuɣusaa hal ni puuni duu la ni ni di samban ni. Ka bɛ ŋme binyara pa puuni duu maa dukpina zaa zuɣu mini di sunsuuni zaa ti gili.
en: Above the entrance, from the interior to the exterior of the temple, and on every interior and exterior wall.

dag: Nir yi bɔri ni o mali binshɛli n-zaŋ ti pini, o bɔrila da shɛli din bi dura n-zaŋ ti tuumbaŋda ka o mal li zali ka di ku lu.
en: Anyone who cannot afford silver or gold chooses wood that will not rot. He finds a skillful worker to make an image that won't fall down.

dag: O daa galim Naa Hɛrɔd ŋun Naa Hɛrɔd tizɔbil paɣa Hɛrɔdias yɛla zuɣu m-pah o ni daa tum tuun biɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: John criticized Herod the ruler for what he had done with Herodias, the wife of Herods brother, as well as for all the other bad things he had done.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la mini Zɛruya bia Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la, Ŋuni n-lee ni doli ma chaŋ Sool sansan ni? Ka Abishai daa yɛli, Man ni dol a chaŋ.
en: David talked to Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah. He asked them, Who would like to go down into the camp with me after Saul? Abishai answered, Ill go with you.

dag: Di malila dabiɛm yuŋ, amaa zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ asiba, ka di zo. Lala n-yɛn niŋ bɛnkam kana ni bɛ ti ʒe ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.

dag: Amaa sanʒiɛɣu n-lee ni ti ʒe ti ti bahi tiŋgban bil din be kom sunsuuni zuɣu.
en: However, we must run aground on some island.

dag: Ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba diri ma shɛhira. Yi na ʒi n-wum o kukoli bee n-nya o ni be shɛm ni yi nini;.
en: And the Father who sent me testifies about me. You have never even heard his voice or seen his form.

dag: O daa nya o la tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka lan nya o tiŋgban nɛli din ka buchi ni. O leei bintaɣirigu taɣ o. O gul o mi kaman o nimbil biɛlim la.
en: God found Israel in a wild land— in a howling desert wasteland— he protected him, cared for him, watched over him with his very own eye.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa, ka di bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔb sabila ka di ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi ninvuɣ so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: If the disease does not seem deeper than the skin, but there is no dark hair in it, the priest must separate that person for seven days.

dag: O daa yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya, Yawɛ ni yuri so, barina ku tooi paag o. Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be o luɣilikam dabisi muni puuni zaa. O ni yuri so ʒila o bɔɣusapima sunsuuni.
en: About the tribe of Benjamin he said: This is the tribe the Lord loves and protects; He guards them all the day long, And he dwells in their midst.

dag: Do so daa be Siizaria ka o yuli booni Kɔniilius. O daa nyɛla sapashini n-su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Italinim Bɔŋ la.
en: In the city of Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a Roman army officer in what was called the Italian Unit.

dag: Zilim balli nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din chɛ ka nir suhu saɣinda.
en: Kind words are like a life-giving tree, but lying words will crush your spirit.

dag: Bɛ daa kul sɔŋ la kuɣa maa dolisi dundɔŋ maa n-zaŋ hal ti paai dunɔdaya maa wɔɣilim tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛ ni sɔŋ kuɣ shɛŋa tiŋli.
en: and the pavement came up to the facades of the gates along their entire length. That was the lower pavement.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ teer a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni. Dinzuɣu niriba ni ti paɣir a sahakam.
en: I will perpetuate your name from one generation to the next so the peoples will praise you forever and always.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Eliphaz from Teman said: *.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalikaulinim zaa niŋdi palila o ni. Dina n-chɛ ka ti yɛri Ami, ka paɣiri Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: All of Gods promises have their yes in him. That is why we say Amen through him to the glory of God.

dag: ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ na kpalim ʒiɛya. Di saha maa ka dɔbba ayi bɛn daa ye binyɛr nyɛlisira dii puhi zani paɣiba maa sani.
en: They stood there puzzled about this, when suddenly two men in bright shining clothes stood by them.

dag: Zɔŋ maa ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di daa mali dunɔdura pia din kpɛri di ni. Ka daantalisi daa be di yaɣa ayi zuɣu m-pahi pilanim zuɣu.
en: The porch was thirty feet long and eighteen feet wide. Steps led up into the porch, and there were columns for the arches, one on each side.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni bɛ ti boli Yisa na.
en: His mother and brothers arrived. They stood outside and sent word to him, calling for him.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a yɛla gari niriba. Ka a yɛla ti gbaai bɛ nanim dabiɛm pam, ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. N yi ti ŋooi n takɔbi bɛ tooni, bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam niŋgbuna kul yɛn sɔhirimi sahakam bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu a lubu maa dali. .
en: I will make many people shocked about you. Their kings will be terrified of you, when I swing my sword before them. They will shake with fear on the day you fall. Each king will be afraid for his own life.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi jɛm wuna, dama man Yawɛ ŋun yuli booni Nyuli ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Bɛlanima; ka Ashibɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Ashibɛlnima; ka Ahiram daŋ niriba nyɛ Ahiramnima;.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Benjamin; they were from the clans of Bela, Ashbel, Ahiram, Shephupham, Hupham, as well as from Ard and Naaman, the two sons of Bela.

dag: Yɛli shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam niŋya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!.

dag: Dama di simdi ni ninvuɣ kura maa kul kpalim be tiliginsim tiŋ maa ni hal ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ti kpi, amaa maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa kum nyaaŋa, ninvuɣ kura maa ni tooi lab omaŋmaŋ ya.
en: Whoever accidentally killed someone must stay in their city of safety until the high priest dies. After the high priest dies, that person can go back to their own land.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, N ni va m biɛli val shɛli din kpɛm pam la zuɣu ka n di nasara ŋɔ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Naftali.
en: Rachel said, Ive competed fiercely with my sister, and now Ive won. So she named him Naphtali.

dag: dama di kɔŋko n-nyɛ o ni mali shɛli pinda, ka bɔ ka o ti yɛn zaŋ pili gbihi? O yi fabili niŋ ma, n ni wum o fabila maa, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli, N dana, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili. Ka lan yɛli, N dana, mani n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun daa ʒe a tooni kpe n-suhiri Yawɛ la.
en: Sir, Hannah said, a few years ago I stood here beside you and asked the Lord.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam mi chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni zaŋ o bahi teeku ni di naan so o zuɣu.
en: If anyone should cause one of these little ones to lose faith in me, it would be better for that person to have a large millstone tied around the neck and be thrown into the sea.

dag: Yaakubu daa yɔhim Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Aram nir maa, o ni daa bi yɛl o ŋun Yaakubu ni daa lo ni o yiɣisi nimaani la zuɣu.
en: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not sending word to him that he was leaving.

dag: Yino ni ti nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi chi sara zuɣu, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli Yawɛ sani.
en: as the sin offering and the other as the burnt offering with the grain offering. In this way the priest shall perform the ritual of purification.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi Judanim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaanu daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ. Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: In the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, he dispatched Nebuzaradan commander of the guard, who deported Judeans. Altogether, , were taken captive.

dag: Malimi soli ti takɔbi maa ka di ka Raba din nyɛ Ammɔnnim tiŋ la ni na bee n-ka Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli la ni na.
en: Use the sign to show which road the sword will use. One road leads to the Ammonite city of Rabbah. The other road leads to Judah, to the protected city, Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋunkam daŋdi yiɣisibu asiba n-duhi o yee puhi o ʒiʒiinikpee, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli ka o yɛr maa.
en: Dont wake up your neighbors early in the morning with a shout of Good morning! They will treat it like a curse, not a blessing.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya maa yiɣisi yomyom kab ti kpe Gibia puuni n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be tiŋ maa ni.
en: The men who were hiding rushed into the city of Gibeah. They spread out and killed everyone in the city with their swords.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yaakubu daa ti saɣi kum ka niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu bidibisi zaa yinoyino ni, o ni daa zaŋ omaŋ dalim o jaaŋgbee n-jɛmdi Naawuni saha shɛl la.
en: By faith Jacob blessed each of Josephs sons as he was dying and bowed in worship over the head of his staff. .

dag: A ni ti yɛn diri bindir shɛli tibisim ti yɛn nyɛla giram kɔbisiyi ni pihita dahin yini kam. A ni ti diri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a di li saha shɛli.
en: You will be allowed to use only cup of that flour each day to make bread. You will eat that bread from time to time throughout the day.

dag: Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani, pumpɔŋɔ kul mali we!.
en: Israel, trust in the Lord now and forever!.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa zaŋ o bia Ibram min o yaaŋa Lɔt ni Ibram paɣa Zarai m-pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ yi Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Haran n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot, who was the son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, Abram's wife, and with them he left the city of Ur in Babylonia to go to the land of Canaan. They went as far as Haran and settled there.

dag: Ŋunkam kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di nyaaŋa o ni nya yurilim dilan sani n-gari ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o.
en: Honest correction is appreciated more than flattery.

dag: ka tum birigi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka bi doli n zalikpana la.
en: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.

dag: dindina niriba bɛn zaŋm zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm kpe ninvuɣ kura maa mini ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kubo biɛri maa sunsuuni m-mal li.
en: In such cases the community shall judge in your favor and not in favor of the dead person's relative who is seeking revenge.

dag: Bɛ zoorimi kaman momaha la asibaasi; zaawuni ka bɛ ti zaɣi kpi.
en: True, in the morning it thrives, renewed, but come evening it withers, all dried up.

dag: O zuli kpɛmmi kaman sida tia la; ka o gbalipina ni jila kpɛnkpe tab ni.
en: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni mal alibarika.
en: Listen! says Jesus. I am coming soon! Happy are those who obey the prophetic words in this book.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fiɣisi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda? Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ni bɛ ka taali.
en: Who can accuse the people God has chosen? No one! God is the one who makes them right.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ zaa laɣim duhi bɛ yɛhi n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ.
en: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.

dag: Ka o daa lan tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti nya Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni liɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: After going a little farther, he saw James and John, Zebedees sons, in their boat repairing the fishing nets.

dag: Nachimba mini paɣisara ni ninkura ni bihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord !.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya; ka fiig tihi vari suui. Ka pumpɔrinchihi tihi mini kpikpal tihi ni apil tihi ni tihi balibu kam zaa kuui. Ka suhupiɛlli din be niriba sani naai.
en: The grapevines and fig trees have withered; all the fruit trees have wilted and died. The joy of the people is gone.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, A ni suhi shɛli maa yɛla kpɛma, di zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti kpuɣ ma a sani chani ka a nya ma, a ni nya a ni bɔri shɛli maa, amaa a yi ti bi nya ma, a ku nya li.
en: That is a difficult request to grant, Elijah replied. But you will receive it if you see me as I am being taken away from you; if you don't see me, you won't receive it.

dag: Jɛshua min o bidibisi ni o dɔɣiriba ni Kadimiɛl min o bidibisi ni Binnui mini Hɔdavia nti pahi Hɛnadad bidibisi ni Lɛvinim mini bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa laɣim su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tumtumdiba fukumsi.
en: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.

dag: Yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali ni tuhi taba soli; ka wuntitali mini suhudoo mi puhi taba.
en: Faithful love and truth have met; righteousness and peace have kissed.

dag: Ŋun yi zuɣusaa na gari sokam zaa; ŋun yi dunia ŋɔ ni na nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nira, ka tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla; amaa ŋun yi alizanda ni na gari sokam zaa.
en: The one who comes from above is greater than all others. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth. He talks about things that are on the earth. But the one who comes from heaven is greater than all others.

dag: N daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka di niŋ yuma pam; di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lab nimaani ni n ti zaŋ pina ti mmaŋmaŋ niriba ka mali sara.
en: After being away for several years, I returned here to bring gifts for the poor people of my nation and to offer sacrifices.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N wuhi ya tuun suma pam din yi m Ba maa sanna, ka di ni dini zuɣu ka yi lee yɛn lab ma kuɣa ŋɔ.
en: Jesus said to them, I have done many good deeds in your presence which the Father gave me to do; for which one of these do you want to stone me.

dag: Ba maa bi kariti so saria, amaa o zaŋ saria karibu yɛla zaa niŋla o Bia maa nuu ni.
en: Also, the Father judges no one. He has given the Son power to do all the judging.

dag: Dinzuɣu naa, kamina pumpɔŋɔ kaman a suhu ni yu dahin shɛli, di nyɛla ti talahi tuma ni ti gbaag o ti a.
en: Now, King, come down any time you want. It is our duty to give David to you.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi liɣiri yi naai, yin zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbiri na ti taɣi bindirigu.
en: Joseph said, Give me your livestock, and I will give you food for your livestock if the silver is gone.

dag: Bɛ yi wum ka jɛmd o, bɛ ni mali buni ni suhudoo hal ni bɛ nyɛvili tariga.
en: If they serve and obey him, he will make them successful and they will live a happy life.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then Pilate set Barabbas free. And he told some soldiers to beat Jesus with whips. Then he handed him over to the soldiers to be killed on a cross.

dag: Pa Dauda so yɛla bɛ ni wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku niriba tuhi piapia la m-bala? .
en: Isnt David the one the Israelites sing about? They dance and sing this song: Saul has killed thousands of enemies, but David has killed tens of thousands.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye Yawɛ zuɣu ka bɛ guh o ni nya ya palli. Bɛ ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔrili kpiŋkpama la. Bɛ ni guui ka di ku gbarigi ba. Bɛ ni chaŋ ka di ku wum ba.
en: but those who hope in the LORD will renew their strength; they will fly up on wings like eagles; they will run and not be tired; they will walk and not be weary.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom so yo o zuɣu, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever kills an animal shall replace it, but whoever kills a human being shall be put to death.

dag: Bɛ yurilim mini bɛ jɛlinsi ni bɛ nyuli zabbu zaa ku lan beni, ka bɛn nuu kul ku lan be yɛl shɛlikam zaa niŋbu ni dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Their love and their hate, as well as their zeal, are already long gone. They will never again have a stake in all that happens under the sun.

dag: Aai! N yɛri ya mi ni shee yi niŋ tuuba, di yi pa lala yi zaa gba ni ti bahi yoli.
en: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ni zal o shɛm maa n-nyaŋ Filistianim maa Gibiɔn hal ni Gɛza.
en: David did what God had commanded, and so he drove the Philistines back from Gibeon all the way to Gezer.

dag: Amaa baŋmi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi. Zomla ŋuna, ka chɛ ka a suhu zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihira, di ti ku be ka bɛ zaŋ li na ni nia biɛɣu.
en: The Lord hates it when wicked people offer him sacrifices, especially if they do it from evil motives.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zali ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaa di saha maa.
en: At that same time I also told you everything you must do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sulemaana daa kari maligumaana Abiata Yawɛ maligumaanitali tuma ni, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli yiŋnim polo Shilo la niŋ pali.
en: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true.

dag: n-daa zaŋ kuɣa maa me Yawɛ jɛmbu sara maligu bimbini maa zali, ka chɛ ka bɛ gaai bɔɣili gil li; ka bɔɣili maa ni tooi deei kom kaman lita pinaanahi laasabu.
en: He built the stones into an altar in the LORDs name, and he dug a trench around the altar big enough to hold two seahs of dry grain.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-she binyɛr shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la viɛnyɛliŋga, ka daa lan she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti Aduna kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: The workers used the blue, purple, and red yarn to make special clothes for the priests to wear when they served in the holy place. They also made the special clothes for Aaron as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: M bi ʒiini ninvuɣ yoya sani, bee ka m mini bilikɔɣinim ti mali jina ni taba.
en: I dont spend time with people up to no good; I dont keep company with liars.

dag: Ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani, ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ nya Yisa taali ka fiɣis o. Ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nira chɛ ka so kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: where there was a man who had a paralyzed hand. Some people were there who wanted to accuse Jesus of doing wrong, so they asked him, Is it against our Law to heal on the Sabbath.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim baŋ n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli din be kasi maa yaha. Ka zuliya kam ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi. .
en: And I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I will not let people ruin my holy name anymore. The nations will know that I am the Lord . They will know that I am the Holy One in Israel.

dag: n ni ti zaŋ li niŋ zuliya shɛb naa nuu ni, ka o ti niŋ li kaman di tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm. N ni ti yihi li bahi.
en: so I have rejected it and will let a foreign ruler have it. He will give that tree what it deserves for its wickedness.

dag: O ni daa nam zuɣusaa, n daa beni, o ni daa booi booli gili teeku zuɣu, n daa beni.
en: I was there when he set up the skies, when he drew a circle in the ocean to make a place for the land.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha, ka Omri bia Ɛhab daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya ʒinila Samaria n-su Izraɛlnim la yuun pisinaayi.
en: Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa's rule in Judah, and he ruled years from Samaria.

dag: ka Ira ŋun daa nyɛ Jair nir la mi daa nyɛ Dauda maligumaana.
en: and Ira from the town of Jair was also one of David's priests.

dag: dama o zali dabisili ni o ti chɛ ka o ni pii so la zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kari dunianim saria. Lala zuɣu ka o daa neeg o ni daa pii so maa kum ni ni di leei shɛhira sokam zaa sani.
en: For he has fixed a day in which he will judge the whole world with justice by means of a man he has chosen. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising that man from death.

dag: ka niriba daa ti gbihi maai ka o dim chaŋ ti zaŋ piriŋkpana biɛlim biri gari di ni ka chaŋ o chandi.
en: While people were sleeping, an enemy came and planted weeds among the wheat and went away.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni lo nia shɛŋa kpalim yoli kpe, ka n chɛ ka bɛ dimnima bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya la zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka n chɛ ka bɛ leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: At this place, I will ruin the plans of the people of Judah and Jerusalem. The enemy will chase them, and I will let the people of Judah be killed with swords in this place. I will make their dead bodies food for the birds and wild animals.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ti Sinai, Yi be zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka di yuui saɣi lala.
en: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.

dag: daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti o.
en: He came to Pilate and asked for Jesus body. Pilate gave him permission to take it.

dag: Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda ŋun nyɛ Ibrahimma yaaŋa la zuliya ni na dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jesus Christ came from the family of King David and also from the family of Abraham. And this is a list of his ancestors.

dag: dama yi daazichi ni be shɛli, nimaani ka yi suhuri gba ni be.
en: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be too.

dag: Yi tahiri tab ʒiishɛhi, amaa ka yɛlimaŋli ka yi polo. Yi dolila naŋgbankpeeni mini ʒiri soli ni yi di nasara, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri tiɣi pua n-dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: You go to court, but you do not have justice on your side. You depend on lies to win your case. You carry out your plans to hurt others.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ yɔhim o? Ka shia maa garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti leei ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Cham ti niŋ lala n-yɔhim o; a ni di nasara.
en: I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him. Good! the Lord replied. Now go and do it.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni maligumaaniba zuɣulan Annas mini Kaiafas nti pahi Jɔn mini Alikizanda ni bɛnkam daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan dɔɣiriba zaa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.

dag: O daa laɣisi m biriginsim zaa n-lo li kaman naɣikɔra dapua la. O nuhi ka o daa zaŋ lo li tabili taba n-zaŋ li pa n nyiŋgoli zuɣu, ka n yaa daa naai. N Duuma daa zaŋ ma tila n ni ku tooi zabi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.

dag: Zabimi n zuɣu n-tiligi ma. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.

dag: Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa kana ti yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a yɛtɔɣa n-viig a gbini.
en: After a little while the men standing there came to Peter. Of course you are one of them, they said. After all, the way you speak gives you away.

dag: Wuntizɔriba muɣisigu galisiya pam, amaa Yawɛ yihiri ba di zaa ni.
en: The Lord 's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔrili zaɣ titali kpiŋkpama ayi ti paɣ maa ni o yiɣi zo ka chɛ wahu maa n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti be luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn dihir o hal ti paai yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: But the woman was given the two wings of a great eagle. Then she could fly to the place that was prepared for her in the desert. There she would be taken care of for three and a half years. There she would be away from the dragon.

dag: O daa lan yɛli di yɛla yaha: Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: But again, in the passage above, God said, They will never enter my rest! .

dag: A chɛ ka ti lu zana ni, ka a zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒil ti.
en: trapped us in a net, laid burdens on our backs.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min o nam yil la, ka me o ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛlikam la naai nyaaŋa.
en: So Solomon finished building the Lord s Temple and his own palace. Solomon built everything that he wanted to build.

dag: A zaŋla a nini kpa lala nira? A zaŋ ma mi na ni a ti kari ma saria?.
en: Will you even look at me, God, or put me on trial and judge me?.

dag: Dauda ni daa chani Aruna sani ka Aruna nya o, o daa yila kabɔɣili maa ni chaŋ ti damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: David walked up the hill to Araunah. Araunah saw him and left the threshing floor. He walked to David and bowed with his face to the ground in front of him.

dag: N daa bela Jɔpa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka n nya binshɛli din kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la ʒii puuni, ka di yi zuɣusaa sirigiri n sanna.
en: While I was praying in the city of Joppa, I had a vision. I saw something coming down that looked like a large sheet being lowered by its four corners from heaven, and it stopped next to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nini tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm nyɛla jɛra, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛm soli ni yi barina ni.
en: Those who trust in their own reasoning are fools, but those who walk in wisdom will be kept safe.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka tin yin nim bee yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ tiŋ maa bee bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and so he said to them, Any country that divides itself into groups which fight each other will not last very long. And any town or family that divides itself into groups which fight each other will fall apart.

dag: di saha ka a chɛ ka zahima varisiri ma, ka chɛ ka ʒiinim nyabu kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm;.
en: You scare me with dreams, frighten me with visions.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn nyu shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo. Nyɛvili bi gari bindirigu ka niŋgbuŋ mi bi gari situra?.
en: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?.

dag: Bɛ kuhigu maa ni, bɛ ni ti yili kuyilli a zuɣu. Tin dini n-na mi n-wurim teeku sunsuuni kaman Taai ni wurim shɛm ŋɔ?.
en: And in their loud crying they will sing this sad song about you: No one is like Tyre! Tyre is destroyed, in the middle of the sea!.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yil yidan yi di mi saha shɛli tayiɣ ni yɛn kana, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi n-tab Yisa maa bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa.
en: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, Lord, which one of us are you talking about.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ gbantolima lo Pool naai ka o bɔhi sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani, Di luhiya ni yi fiɛbi Rom tiŋbia ka na bi kar o saria ŋ-ŋmaag o yɛtɔɣa.
en: But when they had tied him up to be whipped, Paul said to the officer standing there, Is it lawful for you to whip a Roman citizen who hasn't even been tried for any crime.

dag: Mɔab Naa Mɛsha daa wumsirila piɛri, ka di daa kpala talahi ni o tahiri piɛbihi polo tuhi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi tuhi kɔbiga kɔbiri yuuni kam nti tiri Izraɛl naa.
en: For many years the country of Moab had been controlled by Israel and was forced to pay taxes to the kings of Israel. King Mesha of Moab raised sheep, so he paid the king of Israel , lambs and the wool from , rams.

dag: Yisifu mini Mariama ni daa niŋ ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛlikam zaa naai maa, ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ ya Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Joseph and Mary finished doing all the things that the law of the Lord commanded. Then they went home to Nazareth, their own town in Galilee.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ pala din kpɛm pam yi sani bee din be katiŋ ha.
en: This command that I give you today is not too hard for you. It is not a secret hidden in some faraway land.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii m-piri la.
en: Then Jesus told them another story: Gods kingdom is like yeast that a woman mixes into a big bowl of flour to make bread. The yeast makes all the dough rise.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim Aduna bidibisi mini Lɛvi bidibisi na.
en: He called together these descendants of Aaron and the Levites:.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoash died and was buried in the royal tombs in Samaria, and his son Jeroboam II succeeded him as king.

dag: M Ba yuri ma, n ni zaŋ n nyɛvili sɔŋ ni n ti lan kpuɣ li la zuɣu.
en: The Father loves me because I am willing to give up my life, in order that I may receive it back again.

dag: N lan zali zaligu ni so yi taɣi zaligu ŋɔ, bɛn darigim ŋooi ŋun tum taali maa yiŋ yɔɣirili n-zaŋ li sa n-zaŋ o yil li, ka o yiŋ zani dabɔɣu.
en: Also, I give this order: If anyone changes this order, a wooden beam must be pulled from their house and pushed through their body. Then their house must be destroyed until it is only a pile of rocks.

dag: Man Jɔn kpahiri ŋunkam wum anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni zuɣu ni: Ŋunkam pahi shɛli di ni, Naawuni ni zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam din sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la m-pah o tibidarigibo zuɣu;.
en: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.

dag: ka zaŋ bubihi pola maa gbandi pɔb o nuchɛhi min o nyiŋgoli;.
en: She also covered the smooth part of his hands and neck with goatskins.

dag: Nyama, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n zaŋ a leei zuliya pam mini nanim zuɣulana, ni a vuɣi, ka daai luhi, ni a wurim ka ŋme m-paai, ni a me ka sa.
en: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayopɔin dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the seventh day offer seven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti bol a ka a chaŋ, nyin ʒinim tariŋ ʒiishee, ka ŋun bol a maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a, Zɔri, yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee ŋɔ ha! Di saha maa a ni nya jilima a mini bɛnkam laɣim ʒiya diri maa sani.
en: Instead, when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that your host will come to you and say, Come on up, my friend, to a better place. This will bring you honor in the presence of all the other guests.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o bia maa, ka di chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya kul diri nam Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli leei n jɛmbu shee la.
en: but I will let Solomon's son keep one tribe, so that I will always have a descendant of my servant David ruling in Jerusalem, the city I have chosen as the place where I am worshiped.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yeeg omaŋmaŋ kparibu shɛli o ni ye n-ti Dauda, ka zaŋ o gbaɣino ti o, hal ka zaŋ o takɔbi min o tɔbu ni o gban shɛli o ni mali lɔr o shee ni ti o pahi.
en: He took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, together with his armor and also his sword, bow, and belt.

dag: Yi mi ni di bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo Keenannim bɛn be Araba la tiŋgban ni. Tiŋgbani din be Giligal tooni polo m-baɣi Mɔre oki tia la.
en: Arent both of these mountains across the Jordan River, down along the western road in the region of the Canaanites who live in the desert plain, across from Gilgal, next to the Moreh Oak Grove.

dag: Yisifu bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ: Manaasa mini Ifriim.
en: The tribes of Joseph, who was the father of two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

dag: Yi yi du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zuɣu, wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari n dan sapashinnim ni ŋun pɔri gba.
en: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?.

dag: O mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayi. Azarɛl bia Amashisai daa nyɛla Ahizai yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Mɛshilɛmɔt mini Imɛr.
en: and men who were Adaiahs brothers , Amashsai son of Azarel .

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na. .
en: I am the Lord your God. I am the one who freed you from Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: Lɛvi do so daa ti kpuɣi Lɛvi zuliya ni paɣa.
en: There was a man from the family of Levi who decided to marry a woman from the tribe of Levi.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛl o, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: A voice told him, Get up, Peter! Kill and eat.

dag: Dama Masia n-chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ʒiɛmani zan tariga ni di chɛ ka ŋunkam niŋ yɛda yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: For Christ has brought the Law to an end, so that everyone who believes is put right with God.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Wummiya n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ: Anabinim yi be yi ni, man Yawɛ ni kahigi mmaŋ wuhi ba ʒii puuni, ka tɔɣis ba yɛtɔɣa zahindi ni.
en: He said, Listen to my words: If there is a prophet of the LORD among you, I make myself known to him in visions. I speak to him in dreams.

dag: Dinzuɣu di lan ŋmariya tab ʒiri! Sokam yɛlim o mabia yɛlimaŋli, dama ti zaa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: So you must stop telling lies. You must always speak the truth to each other, because we all belong to each other in the same body.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yi ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, bɛn kpalimmi zani di kom maa ni baalim.
en: You are to command the priests who carry the covenant chest, As soon as you come to the bank of the Jordan, stand still in the Jordan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Keenan Naa Jabin ŋun daa diri ʒi Hazɔr, ka o sapashin kpɛm nyɛ Sisɛra ŋun daa be Harɔshɛtihagɔim la nuu ni.
en: So the Lord let the Canaanite King Jabin of Hazor conquer Israel. Sisera, the commander of Jabin's army, lived in Harosheth-Ha-Goiim.

dag: Di daliri zuɣu chɛ ka nayili tɔbbihi zaa mini bɛn zaa kpalim be kpe ŋɔ baŋ ni m be sarika ŋɔ ni la Masia zuɣu.
en: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ni daa pun piligi niŋdi shɛm la o kul niŋmi lala n-naai yurilim tuuni ŋɔ yi gba sani.
en: So we asked Titus to help you finish this special work of giving. He is the one who started this work.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni wuhi ni o bɔri shɛlikam ni di zaŋ tum o jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin bom lala binyara maa ka di zaŋ tum di tuma maa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhu ku yiɣisi bahi m mini bɛn ti yɛn doli n nyaaŋa di nam zuɣu.
