en: You must be careful to provide everything which the God of Heaven requires for his Temple, and so make sure that he is never angry with me or with those who reign after me.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn saɣim Judanim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara pam la.
en: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: N ŋmanila bɛ ni chɛ kpiin shɛb bahi, ka ŋmani bɛ ni ku shɛb ka bɛ do gbala puuni, ka lan ŋman a ni bi lan teeri shɛb yɛla yaha, dama bɛ nyɛla a baɣa ni lan ka shɛb sɔŋsim ni.
en: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.

dag: Hal shinshingoorɔnim mi bɛ yiŋ labbu saha. Ka ŋmanʒee mini sakpaleeŋa ni noombihi bɛn daari doli taba zaa gba mi bɛ kandina saha. Amaa n niriba bɛn bi mi Yawɛ zaligunima.
en: Even the stork in the sky knows the seasons, and the dove, swallow, and crane return in due time. But my people dont know the LORDs ways.

dag: N ni chɛ ka di maligumaaniba zaŋ tiliginsim ye kaman situra la, ka chɛ ka di niriba bɛn ʒe yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.

dag: A tihi ŋmanila pumpɔrinchihi tihi puu din wandi wal suma din nyɛ hɛnna mini naad.
en: there the plants flourish. They grow like an orchard of pomegranate trees and bear the finest fruits. There is no lack of henna and nard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa to tɛte, ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la di, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgbani ti bɛ zuliya maa pirigili kaman daŋ kam ni yɛn deei shɛm, bɛ daa zaŋla fɔntinsi pia ti ba.
en: Ten towns in the territory of West Manasseh were assigned by lot to the rest of the clan of Kohath, family by family.

dag: Asa tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Amaa o ni daa ti kurigi, naba polo dɔro n-daa gbaag o.
en: All the other things about Asa—the great things he did and the cities he built—are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah . When Asa became old, his feet became infected.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya kɔŋko ka a ku kali, a mi di sab bɛ yuya pahi Izraɛlnim ni.
en: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.

dag: A yi yɛn deei nir binshɛli sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o binshɛlikam, nyin di dol o kpe o yiŋ puuni ti deei li.
en: When you give someone any kind of loan, you must not go into their house to get security.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ diba anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: Five curtains will be joined to each other as one set, while the other five curtains will be joined together as a second set.

dag: Ka nyin daadam, bɛ ni ti niŋ mihi niŋ a n-zaŋ li lo a, ka a ku lan tooi yina niriba ni.
en: You will be tied up to keep you inside.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba ni ti kari ba saria ka yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla sariakaritiba bɛn nyɛ bɛn niŋ zina ka ku niriba. Dama bɛ nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: But men who do the right thing will judge them, and they will be punished as adulterers and murderers, because they are in fact adulterers, and blood is on their hands.

dag: ka Susi bia Gaddi daa yi Josɛf zuliya ni na, ;.
en: from the tribe of Joseph: from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi, Susis son.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sida dapaɣa kpahi duu maa nyaaŋa polo hal ti gbaai yɔɣira, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ kpahi di puuni gba lala ni di leei di puuni luɣ kasi shee, ka niŋ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi.
en: They built an inner room cubits long in the back part of the Temple. This room was called the Most Holy Place. They covered the walls in this room with cedar boards, from floor to ceiling.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A nina maa neema. A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa.
en: Jesus replied, Look and you will see! Your eyes are healed because of your faith.

dag: dama pa yinima nti yɛn tɔɣisi, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni Shia n-yɛn be yi ni tɔɣisira.
en: For the words you will speak will not be yours; they will come from the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa ti ka o sanna ti bɔh o, A mi ni Farisiinim ni wum a ni yɛli shɛm la bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim bebɔ.
en: Then the disciples came to him and said, Do you know that the Pharisees had their feelings hurt by what you said.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli neesim maa n-daa yi palo dunia ni di saha maa ni o neei sokam zaa nina.
en: This was the real light—the light that comes into the world and shines on all people.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti niŋdi ti putɔɣu, ka muɣisiri ti n-chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: The Egyptians treated us badly. They made us slaves. They hurt us and forced us to work very hard.

dag: Lubu din mali dabiɛm pam mini chirachira be Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli ni, ka bɛ daai ti tiŋ goma luhi, ka ŋme sɔŋsim bɔbu kuŋ bahi zoya ni nima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-niŋ lala maa.
en: The LORD God of heavenly forces has a day of tumult and trampling and turmoil in the Valley of Vision, a breaking down of walls, a cry for help to the mountains.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ puhim Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: So Moses told the Israelites to celebrate Passover.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yini maa tɔɣis o yɛra, A ni zaŋ Hiburu dab so na ti gari ti ni la kpɛmina ni o ti lihi ʒiɛm ma;.
en: and she told him the same thing: The Hebrew slave whom you brought to us, to ridicule me, came to me.

dag: A chɛ ka n zɔnim mini n ʒiʒiinitab zaɣisi ma. Zibisim n-kpalim n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: You caused my friends and loved ones to leave me. Now darkness is my closest friend.

dag: Cham ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni, Ibrahimma Naawuni ni Yisahaku Naawuni ni Yaakubu Naawuni n-yi n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, N nini nyan ya, ka nya yi ni diri wahala shɛŋa zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Go and get Israels elders together and say to them, The LORD, the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me. The LORD said, Ive been paying close attention to you and to what has been done to you in Egypt.

dag: yi yi niŋdi lala, yi bi yaala so yuri ka chɛ so, ka lan leei bɛn doli tɛhi biɛri soli kariti saria?.
en: then you are guilty of creating distinctions among yourselves and of making judgments based on evil motives.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi yiɣisiri bɛ sani chani mɔɣu ni ti suhiri Naawuni.
en: But Jesus would withdraw to deserted places for prayer.

dag: Amaa Gibiɔnnim ni daa wum Jɔshua ni niŋ Jɛriko mini Ai shɛm la zuɣu.
en: In contrast, when the population of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.

dag: Inok ŋun daa nyɛ ʒiɛmani din pah ayopɔin din daa doli Adam saha nyaaŋa la nir la daa pun tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba ŋɔ polo. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya! Ti Duuma min o malaikanim tusatusa shɛm bɛn be kasi kanna.
en: Enoch, the seventh descendant from Adam, said this about these people: Look, the Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of his holy angels.

dag: O zaŋ o piɛm pa o tɔbu zuɣu n-darigi li kpa ma.
en: He made his bow ready. He made me the target for his arrows.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli shia din be daadam ni, ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ŋɔ n-chɛ ka daadam baŋdi binyara.
en: But the spirit in a person, the Almightys breath, gives understanding.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli Ɛli, Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yi tɔb maa tuhibu shee n-zo m-paai kpe na zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Ɛli bɔh o, M bia, tɔb maa be wula.
en: He said, I am the man who just came from the battle. I ran away from the battle today. Eli asked, What happened, son.

dag: Ka naa daa pirig o nintu shɛli zuɣu o dalinli ni daa dihi tabili, ka nyɛ o ni daa deei shɛli Haman san la ti Mɔdɛkai. Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ Haman yili maa ti Mɔdɛkai ni o su di fukumsi.
en: and gave him the royal ring that Haman had worn. Then Esther put Mordecai in charge of Haman's property.

dag: Ka o yɛli, O tɔhira. O ni daa paai yiŋ na ka Yisa daŋ o di yɛla tɔɣisibu ka bɔh o, Saimɔn, wula ka a lee tɛhiri di yɛla? Ka lan bɔh o pahi, Banim sani ka dunia ŋɔ nanim lee deeri farigu: Bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋbihi sani bee saamba sani.
en: Of course, Peter answered. When Peter went into the house, Jesus spoke up first, Simon, what is your opinion? Who pays duties or taxes to the kings of this world? The citizens of the country or the foreigners.

dag: O daa zaŋla chɛchɛbun gahinda kɔbisiyɔbu ni Ijipti chɛchɛbunsi zaa, ka tɔbbihi daa be di zaa ni.
en: He set out with all his chariots, including the six hundred finest, commanded by their officers.

dag: ni Dɛbir naa ni Gɛda naa.
en: the king of Debir one.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi bidibikpamba bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: one month old or older; the total was .

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni bee bɛ yi ti yɛn chaŋ miri sara maligu bimbini maa ti tum tuma bee m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di simdi ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛmaŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: before they go into the Tent or approach the altar to offer the food offering. Then they will not be killed.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a lee nyuri bara zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni? Naawuni nirilim niŋbu kul benimi sahakam. Dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Great warrior, why are you bragging about the evil you did? You are a disgrace to God.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ nina ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka yɛli, Yawɛ galisiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tinduya ni.
en: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, The Lord 's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba mini wawariba zaa yɛra, N kɔbilinina zaa bela a ni.
en: And while they dance, people sing: The source of my life comes from you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa to tɛte, ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la di, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgbani ti bɛ zuliya maa pirigili kaman daŋ kam ni yɛn deei shɛm, bɛ daa zaŋla fɔntinsi pia ti ba.
en: The remaining Kohathites were given ten towns by lot from the clan of half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, Naawuni n-ni nyaŋ o, pa daadam.
en: You shouldn't say, We know what's right! Let God punish him.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, N yi ti nya wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham said, Please don't be angry, Lord , if I ask you what you will do if there are only good people in the city. If I find , the Lord replied, I still won't destroy it.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka zuɣulaannim su bɛ niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam su niriba su ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Every honest leader rules with help from me.

dag: N ni kpihim bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa n sani, ka chɛ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa ka zaɣisi ma la taali.
en: I will cleanse them of all the wrongdoing they committed against me, and I will forgive them for all of their guilt and rebellion.

dag: Kahigim a daalikauli din nyɛ bɛn lur a sizuura dini la wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka n lu a sizuura.
en: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.

dag: Ka din lan pahi nyɛla, ninvuɣ biɛri yi zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, bɛ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: When someone evil stops sinning and does what is right and good, he saves his life.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi bɔh o.
en: Then Eliphaz, a native of Teman, responded.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga yaha, Nyama, a mali pua, a mi ti yɛn dɔɣila bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Ishimail, dama Yawɛ wum a nandahima kuhigu maa.
en: The LORDs messenger said to her, You are now pregnant and will give birth to a son. You will name him Ishmael because the LORD has heard about your harsh treatment.

dag: ka yɛli Dauda, A nyɛla wuntizɔra pam gari ma, dama a tum ma din viɛla, ka man zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo a samli.
en: telling David, You are more righteous than I am because you have treated me generously, but I have treated you terribly.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam. N nam yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nam, n niriba naan zabi n zuɣu ka so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni. Amaa n nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam.
en: Jesus answered, My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi chɛmi ka bɛ wurim bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani ti maani maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: However, the shrines were not removed. People kept sacrificing and burning incense at them.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛ yino ka o ti lu bɔɣ zilinli ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku yaag o di ni?.
en: Jesus replied, Who among you has a sheep that falls into a pit on the Sabbath and will not take hold of it and pull it out?.

dag: ni Mɛrayɔt ni Amaria ni Ahitub.
en: Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa; ka daa yihi zɔhi pam maa zaa Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o niriba sani, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: The LORD did as Moses asked and removed the swarms of insects from Pharaoh, from his officials, and from his people. Not one insect remained.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔ puuni jilima din galisi la zuɣu chɛ ka din gba daa mali jilima la jilima maa naai.
en: In fact, what was glorious isnt glorious now, because of the glory that is brighter.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti paai zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa yi jɛmdi Naawuni la, nyama, ka Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la daa chɛh omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu n-ka Naa Dauda sanna.
en: When David reached the top of the hill, where there was a place of worship, his trusted friend Hushai the Archite met him with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini niriba yinsi biɛɣukam nti wuhiri ba, ka yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: And every day in the Temple and in people's homes they continued to teach and preach the Good News about Jesus the Messiah.

dag: Dama di yi pa o zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya n-di bee n-di o tuma nyaɣisim?.
en: How else could you have anything to eat or enjoy yourself at all?.

dag: Yawɛ guli saamba, ka gbibi pakoya mini kpibisi. Amaa o saɣindi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo nia shɛŋa.
en: He protects the strangers who live in our land; he helps widows and orphans, but takes the wicked to their ruin.

dag: di saha yin miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: When that happens, you must be careful not to become proud. You must not forget the Lord your God. You were slaves in Egypt, but he made you free and brought you out of that land.

dag: Sulemaana daa me omaŋmaŋ yili. Yuun pinaata ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: Solomon's palace took years to build.

dag: Pɛrɛz zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɛrɛz n-daa dɔɣi Hɛzirɔn, ka Hɛzirɔn dɔɣi Ram.
en: These are the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron.

dag: Di saha ka n daa kpe di ni nti nya ka bɛ ŋmɛla biŋgbamda mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi zaa ni Izraɛl buɣa zaa kɔtomsi pa gooni maa zuɣu gili.
en: So I went in and looked, and I saw every form of loathsome beasts and creeping things and all the idols of the house of Israel engraved on the walls all around.

dag: Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ tuumba? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ anabinima? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ karimbanima? Bɛ zaa n-tumd alahiziba tumtumsa?.
en: Not all are apostles. Not all are prophets. Not all are teachers. Not all do miracles.

dag: O yi po pɔri yoli zaŋ chaŋ binshɛli polo; di simdi ka o niŋ di zaa, ka niŋ di pirigibu ʒiibunu zuɣu yim pahi ti ŋun su li, o yi ti baŋ ni o tum taali.
en: and pay the owner a fine of percent.

dag: Tuuni kam nyɛla din tuhi ŋun tum li sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi suhu.
en: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.

dag: Nir kul ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ka so ku garig o? Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ nyɛla din ni wuhi ni a ka galimi?.
en: Should all these words go unanswered or a wordy man be justified?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ di kɔhigu nɛma mini di liɣiri ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ti ku zaŋ di shɛli sɔŋ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ di liɣiri maa da bindira pam ni situr shɛŋa di ni simdi ni bɛ mali.
en: But Tyre will not keep the money she earns. The profit from her trade will be saved for the Lord . Tyre will give that money to the people who serve the Lord to buy good food and nice clothes.

dag: ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu biɛlabiɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu dali, ka kom maa daa filim.
en: The water that covered the earth began to go down. After days the water was low enough that the boat touched land again. The boat stopped on one of the mountains of Ararat. This was the th day of the seventh month.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam.
en: How terrible it will be at that time for women who are pregnant and for women who are nursing their children.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o biɛhigu shee; chɛliya ka ti jɛm o o napɔntamdigu shee.
en: Now, lets go to the Lords house. Lets worship at his throne.

dag: N daa zaŋ yɛ viɛla dih a paɣisarilim, ka zaŋ bansi pir a nuhi ni, ka zaŋ dolibi yɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: I gave you bracelets, a necklace.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa mɔɣis o biɛyanim maa zaa kparima ka kum pam, di nyaaŋa ka o biɛyanim maa daa naanyi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: He kissed all of his brothers and wept, embracing them. After that, his brothers were finally able to talk to him.

dag: A ni yɛn deei pin shɛŋa bɛ sani m-bɔŋɔ: Salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;.

dag: Shɛhira dira ŋun nyɛ nia biɛɣulana yi kana ti wuhi ni so tum tuumbiɛɣu.
en: A witness might try to hurt another person by lying and saying that this person did wrong.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kabi chaŋ buɣili Baal duu nti daai li luhi ka wurim di maligu bimbina la mini di binnana la n-chɛrisichɛrisi di zaa, ka ku Matan ŋun daa nyɛ Baal tindan la maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: Then all the people went to Baals temple and tore it down, smashing its altars and images into pieces. They executed Baals priest Mattan in front of the altars.

dag: O ni yo n dimnim bɛ tuumbiɛri samli. O ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu, o ni kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: May God use their own evil to punish my enemies. He will destroy them because he is faithful.

dag: Ka chaŋ ti shihi kpim maa daamaŋka, ka bɛn daa ʒir o maa kpalim zani. Ka o kuhi boli kpim maa, Nachimbila, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: Jesus went over and touched the stretcher on which the people were carrying the dead boy. They stopped, and Jesus said, Young man, get up.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, O be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, M bi mi.
en: They asked, Where is this man? He replied, I dont know.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabi zali ni faashee Masia di wahala, ka lan neei kum ni daba ata dali;.
en: and said to them, This is what is written: the Messiah must suffer and must rise from death three days later.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaani wuntaŋa ka o bi nyeera, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saŋmarisi bi peera.
en: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.

dag: Bɛ daa ʒiɛhira ka jeeni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyu dam kuli, ka bɛ yɛm zaa daa naai la.
en: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.

dag: ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani, bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini niɣi ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be yi sani, ka doli ya yi ŋariŋ maa ni na alikauli.
en: I make my promise to all the birds, and to all the cattle, and to all the animals that came out of the boat with you. I make my promise to every living thing on earth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Bɛ ni ti niŋ zina, amaa ka ku dɔɣi bihi, dama bɛ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: They will eat, but they will not be satisfied. They will commit sexual sins, but they will not have babies. This is because they left the Lord and became like prostitutes.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o ti nya Ɛliab ka yɛl o suhu ni, Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni pii so maa n-ʒe o tooni ŋɔ.
en: When Jesse and his sons arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, Surely this is the man who the Lord has chosen.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb yila katinsi na, dinzuɣu n yi chɛ ka bɛ kuli ni kum bɛ ni ti tarigi sol ni.
en: I should not send them home hungry. If they leave without eating, they will faint on the way home. Some of them live a long way from here.

dag: Ka shɛb yi mali naŋgbankpeeni, bɛ kanimina ka n ti woligiri li tiri ba, ka wuhiri ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If people have an argument, they come to me, and I decide which person is right. In this way I teach the people Gods laws and teachings.

dag: O daa gindila Bɛtɛl mini Giligal ni Mizipa yuuni kam nti maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani zaa.
en: Every year he would go around to the towns of Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah where he served as judge for the people.

dag: Amaa biha maa mini nudirigu gbalipuɣa dina Aduna daa zaŋ li mi gahigahi Yawɛ tooni ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi kaman Musa ni daa zali shɛm.
en: But Aaron lifted up the breasts and the right thigh as an uplifted offering before the LORD, just as Moses had commanded.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa nuu ni n-karim, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: King Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went to the Temple, placed the letter there in the presence of the Lord .

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ bia maa ti yɛn yaag o noli yɛli, M ba bee M ma, di saha Asiria naa ni ti kana ti zaŋ Damaskus azichi, ka di Samaria nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: Before the boy knows how to say my father and my mother, the wealth of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria will be carried away before the king of Assyria.

dag: Di saha maa ka ti Duuma daa niŋ anfaani din galisi pam niŋ n ni, ka ti ma yɛda mini yurilim din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: But our Lord gave me a full measure of his grace. And with that grace came the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔr shɛŋa lu zuliya shɛb zuɣu la lu bɛ gba zuɣu.
en: If the Egyptians refuse to celebrate the Festival of Shelters, then they will be struck by the same disease that the Lord will send on every nation that refuses to go.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bokim. Ka bɛ daa mali sara ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: So they named the place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Amaa n ni sabiri zaligu shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ bahi nyɛla zaligu palli, ka di yɛlimaŋtali yi palo Masia ni ni yi gba ni, dama zibisim kul vuurimi chana, ka neesim maŋli mi pum neei na.
en: On the other hand, I am writing a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

dag: Amaa lee daŋmiya m-bola Naawuni nam dubu min o wuntia, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: Instead, be concerned above everything else with the Kingdom of God and with what he requires of you, and he will provide you with all these other things.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigiri buŋ maa.
en: Some people were standing there and saw this. They asked, What are you doing? Why are you untying that donkey.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛb daa bɔhi, Pa doo ŋɔ ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku la?.
en: Some people from Jerusalem said, Isnt he the one they want to kill?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka boli bibil na nti zaŋ o zali baɣil omaŋa.
en: Aware of their deepest thoughts, Jesus took a little child and had the child stand beside him.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sabi luɣ shɛli polo shɛm la: Nyin gɔgbihira, yiɣisima n-neei kum ni! Ka Masia ti a neesim.
en: for anything that is clearly revealed becomes light. That is why it is said, Wake up, sleeper, and rise from death, and Christ will shine on you.

dag: Dama niriba ŋɔ leela suhutunanima: Bɛ ŋari bɛ tiba ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum. Bɛ pɔb bɛ nina ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku nya. Di yi pa lala, bɛ nina ni nya, ka bɛ tiba wum, ka bɛ baŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna ka n tib ba.
en: All of them have stubborn minds! They refuse to listen; they cover their eyes. They cannot see or hear or understand. If they could, they would turn to me, and I would heal them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuhiri yɛri lala maa ka bɛ mali bɛ binyɛra gahiri ka toori taŋkpaɣu yaɣindi zuɣusaa.
en: They kept on shouting, ripping off their clothes and throwing dust into the air.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa gari, ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu ti neerina, ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia la min o tɔɣima la daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya Yisa siliga maa.
en: After the Sabbath, as Sunday morning was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

dag: N suui ʒitibisi shɛŋa din yi tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu la; ka yihi ya piɛri ʒiya la ʒibu ni.
en: I lifted the burden off your shoulders; your hands are free of the brick basket!.

dag: Bɛ daa laɣimla Jɛrusalɛm Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu gol so ŋun pahir ata la ni.
en: Asa and these people gathered together in Jerusalem on the third month in the th year of Asas rule.

dag: Amaa ka bɛn daa ti biɛra, ka man yɛla buɣu ka lo noli n-zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋ suhiri Naawuni;.
en: But when they were sick, I wore clothes for grieving, and I kept a strict fast. When my prayer came back unanswered.

dag: Ka bɛ ba Yaakubu yɛli ba, Yi chɛ ka n kɔŋ m bihi. Yisifu lan kani, ka Simiɔn gba kani, ka yi yɛn zaŋ Bɛnjamin mi chaŋ pumpɔŋɔ, n zuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa ʒini.
en: Their father said to them, Do you want to make me lose all my children? Joseph is gone; Simeon is gone; and now you want to take away Benjamin. I am the one who suffers.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani ni a suhu zaa, ka miri ka a niŋ amaŋmaŋ milinsi naani.
en: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa puri zaa n-ti Firawuna; dama Ijiptinim zaa daa zaŋla bɛ puri kɔhi, kum maa ni daa mii ba pam maa zuɣu. Ka puri maa daa leei Firawuna dini.
en: So Joseph bought all of Egypts farmland for Pharaoh because every Egyptian sold his field when the famine worsened. So the land became Pharaohs.

dag: Miri ka a mali jɛlinsi a suhu ni ni a kpee, amaa chɛ ka a min a kpee maa tɔɣisi mali yi yɛtɔɣa, di yi pa lala a ni ti tum alahichi o zuɣu.
en: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.

dag: Ba ni zɔr o bihi nambɔɣu shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o la nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord is as kind to his followers as a father is to his children.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Kpahim a nuhi, ka chɛ ka takɔbi din ni ku niriba lu buyi bee buta. Di nyɛla takɔbi din kura, ka nyɛ takɔbi din ni ku niriba pam. Di gili ba mi niŋ sunsuuni.
en: Ezekiel, warn my people, then celebrate my victory by clapping your hands. My vicious sword will attack again and again, killing my people with every stroke.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a tiri ninvuɣ so dabili zalige? O zanibu bee o lubu nyɛla o duuma yɛla. Ka o shiri ni zani, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi chɛ ka o zani.
en: Who are you to judge the servants of someone else? It is their own Master who will decide whether they succeed or fail. And they will succeed, because the Lord is able to make them succeed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka bɛ chirigi Sairiini nira ŋun yuli booni Saimɔn, ka bɛ gbaag o ti muɣis o n-zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li.
en: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene named Simon, and the soldiers forced him to carry Jesus' cross.

dag: Rama tiŋ puuni ka bɛ wum vuri din nyɛ fabila mini kumsi ni nandahima yɛla pam. Reechɛl kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka bɛ balim o je, dama bɛ zaa lan kani.
en: A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and much grieving. Rachel weeping for her children, and she did not want to be comforted, because they were no more.

dag: So na ʒi n-chaŋ alizanda ni naɣila Daadam Bia ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: No one has gone up to heaven except the one who came down from heaven, the Human One.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli paɣ maa, Lab kuli, ka n lihi a yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: The king said to the woman, Return home, and I will issue an order in your behalf.

dag: N nya n dabili Dauda, m booi n kpam din be kasi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: I have found my servant David and anointed him as king with my special oil.

dag: Molimiya Naawuni yiko yɛla; ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa, ka o yiko be sagbana ni.
en: Proclaim God's power; his majesty is over Israel, his might is in the skies.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira Sintani yiko ni, ka mali yiko pam din ni tum alahiziba tuma balibu kam ka wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa din nyɛ yɔhiŋgu.
en: The Wicked One will come with the power of Satan and perform all kinds of false miracles and wonders.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, yiɣisim ka ti chaŋ. Amaa ka o bi garigi. Ka o daa kpuɣi paɣ maa pa o buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kul o ya.
en: The Levite said to her, Get up; lets go. But there was no answer. The Levite put her body on his donkey and went home.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, ka tumdi din tuhi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli ka di yiri bɛ suhuri ni na.
en: Those who obey God in everything and always do what is right, whose words are true and sincere.

dag: N yɛm maa yɛn yila katiŋ na, ka di wuhi ni ŋun nam ma nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: I will share my knowledge with everyone. I will prove that my Maker is right.

dag: Di piligimi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: It began as the prophet Isaiah had written: God said, I will send my messenger ahead of you to open the way for you.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tinsi zuɣu yuun pisopɔin m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. Ka bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Then the angel said, Almighty Lord , you have been angry with Jerusalem and the cities of Judah for seventy years now. How much longer will it be before you show them mercy.

dag: M biyurisi, di niŋya ŋunkam yɛli ni o mali Naawuni Shia yɛda, amaa buɣisimiya ba nya bɛ ni mali shi so maa yila Naawuni sanna; dama anab ʒirinim pam yiɣisiya m-be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam.
en: My dear friends, many false prophets are in the world now. So dont believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see if they are from God.

dag: Ka o mi ti yɛli ya yaha, N yɛri ya mi, n ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na. Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, wariya! .
en: But he will say, I really don't know who you are! Get away from me, you evil people.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na nti zaŋ li mali kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.

dag: Dama shɛlini so mi n-zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim ni tuumbaŋsim yɛm tum nya shɛli, ka ti chɛ li tila ŋun bi di di wahala ni o di di nyaɣisim. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: because sometimes those who have worked hard with wisdom, knowledge, and skill must leave the results of their hard work as a possession to those who havent worked hard for it. This too is pointless—its a terrible wrong.

dag: Amaa ka wuntizɔriba bɛn kul gbibi be wuntizɔbo soli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi viɛla kul nyari yaa pahira.
en: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wumdi yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ a suhu niŋ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.

dag: Ka o daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka darigu ʒe tiŋa ka di zuɣusaa chaŋ ti tɔri alizanda, ka o nya ka Naawuni malaikanim dol li duri ka siɣirina.
en: He dreamed that he saw a stairway reaching from earth to heaven, with angels going up and coming down on it.

dag: Di bi simdi ni doo zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dama o nyɛla Naawuni kɔtomsi min o jilima, ka paɣ mi nyɛ doo jilima.
en: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim pam daa ka Maata mini Mariama sanna ni bɛ ti maai bɛ suhuri bɛ tizɔdoo Lazarɔs kum maa zuɣu.
en: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.

dag: Ka Judanim daa kana ti booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni nimaani n-zaŋ o leei Judanim naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Jabɛshigiliadnima n-daa sɔɣi Sool.
en: The men of Judah came to Hebron and anointed David to be the king of Judah. Then they told David, The men of Jabesh Gilead buried Saul.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li.
en: Women of Jerusalem, promise me, dont awaken love, dont arouse love, until I am ready.

dag: Yin ni di biŋkɔb shɛba n-nyɛ niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi.
en: Heres a list of animals you are allowed to eat: ox, sheep, goat.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin la piɛb o kikaa, ka kukol kara kul kuhiri pampam alizanda ni yɛra, Dunia nam leela ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia dini hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, The power to rule over the world belongs now to our Lord and his Messiah, and he will rule forever and ever.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ anabi Shɛmaya mini anabi Iddo yɛlikura litaafinim ni. Di saha maa Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: The deeds of Rehoboam, from beginning to end, arent they written in the records of the prophet Shemaiah and the seer Iddo, including the genealogical records? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka o yɛl o, N dana, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: What do you want me to do for you? He said, Lord, I want to see.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnim yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnima, ka zaŋ biŋkumda kumsi paɣ o.
en: Sing praises to the Lord ! Play music on the harps!.

dag: Ti min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini mini ti ni niŋ o yɛda la zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ naani ti ni nya soli ni ti tooi chaŋ Naawuni sani la zuɣu.
en: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa yina tuhi Sisɛra soli yɛl o, N dana, ŋmaligim kpe kpe na, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa ŋmaligi kpe o sani tanti maa ni; ka paɣ maa ti zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: Jael saw him coming, so she went out to meet him and said, Sir, come into my tent. Come in. Dont be afraid. So Sisera went into Jaels tent, and she covered him with a blanket.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari m-mali dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.

dag: ni Mikilɔt . Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ niriba daa ʒini baɣilila bɛ dɔɣim maa Jɛrusalɛm fɔŋ ni.
en: Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. These sons also lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri ka guri bɛ tɔbiri ni bɛ nyaŋ faranim mini nandaamba, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: The wicked draw their swords and bend their bows to bring down the weak and the needy, to slaughter those whose way is right.

dag: Ka binshɛli yi sɔɣi, di sɔɣimi ni di ti yi zahira, ka binshɛli din mi be ashilɔni, di be ashilɔni maa ni di ti yila palo.
en: Everything hidden will be revealed, and everything secret will come out into the open.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: I tell you, he replied, that to those who have something, even more will be given; but those who have nothing, even the little that they have will be taken away from them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan yɛli Jɔnatan, Ka a ba suhu yi ti yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɛli ma.
en: Who will tell me if your father responds harshly? David asked Jonathan.

dag: Pita ni daa nya o maa ka o bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula.
en: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, Lord, what about him.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti kul kpalimmi be alahichi tumbu ni ka di chɛ ka Naawuni daalibarika zooi?.
en: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?.

dag: ni Ɛlifɛlɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Ahasibai Maaka nir la bia ni Iliam ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitɔfɛl Gilo nir la bia.
en: Eliphelet, Ahasbais son from Maacah; Eliam, Ahithophels son from Giloh.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli tumo maa, A ni yɛn chaŋ ti yɛli Jɔab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ kpaŋs o suhu, Di chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ muɣis a, dama takɔb bi chihiri so kubu, mali suhukpeeni ka liri tiŋ maa nim ni nimmoo n-nyaŋ ba. .
en: David replied, Tell Joab to cheer up and not to be upset about what happened. You never know who will be killed in a war. Tell him to strengthen his attack against the city and break through its walls.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛl o paɣa, Ti nini nya Naawuni, dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni kpi.
en: Manoah said to his wife, We are sure to die, because we have seen God.

dag: Bɛ ŋma ʒiri pa Yawɛ, ka yɛli, O ku niŋ shɛli. Zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti, tɔbu bee kum ku lu ti zuɣu.
en: They have lied about the LORD and said, Hell do nothing! Disaster wont come upon us; we wont see war or famine.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: They saluted him, Hey! King of the Jews.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Dauda na. Ka bɛ daa paai ti nya anab bɔbili, ka bɛ tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka Samuɛl nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣi Sool tuumba maa zuɣu na ka bɛ gba tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: so he sent some men to arrest him. They saw the group of prophets dancing and shouting, with Samuel as their leader. Then the spirit of God took control of Saul's men, and they also began to dance and shout.

dag: A daŋ maa nyɛla din ni ku nira, ka binshɛli din maari biɛrim mi kani. Bɛnkam zaa wum a yɛla, bɛ kpahirila bɛ nuhi. Dama bɛ ni ŋuni ka a lee bi niŋ a ninkuunsi din ka naabu ŋɔ?.
en: Nineveh, you have been hurt badly, and nothing can heal your wound. Everyone who hears the news of your destruction claps their hands. They are all happy, because they all felt the pain you caused again and again.

dag: Di saha n dima ni ti nya li, ka vi ti gbaai ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhiri ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni la lee bela ya? N nini ni ti nya o lubu, ka bɛ ti no o sɔŋ kaman palli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: Then our enemies will see this and be disgraced—the same enemies who taunted us by asking, Where is the Lord your God? We will see them defeated, trampled down like mud in the streets.

dag: A sujee naai ti mi zaa; ka a suhuyiɣisili nyaŋ ti zaa.
en: Your anger could destroy us. Your anger frightens us!.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui ka bɛ gun o, ka bol o yuli Yisa, din nyɛ yu shɛli malaika ni daa pun ti o ka Mariama naanyi zal o puu la.
en: When eight days had passed, Jesus parents circumcised him and gave him the name Jesus. This was the name given to him by the angel before he was conceived.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashee kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Many seek favor from rulers; everyone befriends a gift giver.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛmaŋ naani mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani.
en: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:.

dag: Ka pateesa shɛŋa din daa yili dunoli maa yaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: On each side of the entrance there were 1⁄2 yards of curtains, with three posts and three bases.

dag: ni suligu ni baŋtooŋa balibu kam zaa.
en: red kites, falcons, any kind of kite.

dag: N ku kpi, amaa n ni be, ka moli Yawɛ tuma yɛla.
en: I will live and not die, and I will tell what the Lord has done.

dag: Wula ka yi zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni, ka tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun be naŋgbantom ni nyɛvili?.
en: Why is light given to the hard worker, life to those bitter of soul.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la nyɛla din ka gbinni? Di ni yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni ni zaŋ shi so niŋ ti ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka o suhu kul ye ti zuɣu.
en: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us?.

dag: Labimiya ba kuɣa ku, dama bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ birigi ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka yihi ya dabitim ni na la sani.
en: Stone them until they are dead because they desired to lead you away from the LORD your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ n ni ʒi pin shɛli na ŋɔ n-ti nachimba bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: Please, sir, accept this present I have brought you, and give it to your men.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yɛli Kushi nir ŋun daa be o san la, Cham ti yɛli naa a nini ni nya shɛm. Ka Kush nir maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋ Jɔab tooni lu o sizuura ka ŋmaligi guui.
en: Then Joab said to a Cushite, Go tell the king what you have seen. The Cushite bowed low before Joab, then ran off.

dag: Yɛndan ni tɔɣisir yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa balimbalim wumbu so naa ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n-tahiri jɛra sani.
en: It is better to listen to the quiet words of someone wise than to the shouts of a ruler at a council of fools.

dag: ka fɔntin shɛli din ti miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba ni bo naɣisa so bɛ ni na ʒi n-zaŋ tum tuma bee n-zaŋ dapua pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: When you learn which town is nearest to the dead body, the leaders of that town must take a cow from their herds. It must be a cow that never had a calf and that has never been used for work.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi salo maa naai ka o kɔŋko chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o kɔŋko na kul be nimaani.
en: Then he went up on a mountain where he could be alone and pray. Later in the evening, he was still there.

dag: Kɔbiliga ni kul gbibi di kom shɛm, lala ka Jɛrusalɛm nim gbibi bɛ tuumbiɛri. Duŋtaabo mini ninvuɣ kubo yɛla ka n kul wumdi di puuni; dɔriti mini dansi ka n nini kul nyara.
en: As a well keeps its water fresh, so Jerusalem keeps its wickedness fresh. I hear about the robbing and violence in this city all the time. I see nothing but pain and sickness there all the time.

dag: Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia pala ŋun mi Naawuni, dama Naawuni nyɛla yurilim.
en: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.

dag: Di wuhir o ni daa di nam shɛm min o kpiɔŋ ni binshɛŋa din daa niŋ o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zaŋ tabili dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa yɛla.
en: including everything concerning his powerful rule, and what happened to him, to Israel, and to all the kingdoms in other lands.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be muɣisigu ni mini sama ni daa doli shɛba ni bɛnkam nini daa bi lan tiɣi bɛ biɛhigu zaa daa zo n-chaŋ o sani ka o ti leei bɛ zuɣulana. Ka bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi.
en: Many people joined David. There were men who were in some kind of trouble, men who owed a lot of money, and men who were just not satisfied with life. All kinds of people joined David, and he became their leader. He had about men with him.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn daa kpalim maa n-nyɛ: Filistia nanima anu mini Keenannim zaa ni Sidɔnnim ni Hivinim bɛn be Lɛbanɔn Zoli zuɣu n-zaŋ Baalihɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu hal ti paai Lɛbohamat dunoli shee la.
en: Those left in the land were the five Philistine cities, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in the Lebanon Mountains from Mount Baal Hermon as far as Hamath Pass.

dag: N lan zali zaligu ni so yi taɣi zaligu ŋɔ, bɛn darigim ŋooi ŋun tum taali maa yiŋ yɔɣirili n-zaŋ li sa n-zaŋ o yil li, ka o yiŋ zani dabɔɣu.
en: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.

dag: Ka Aduna daa miri sara maligu bimbini maa nti kɔrigi omaŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo naɣila polli maa.
en: Aaron went to the altar and slaughtered the young bull for his purification offering.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ya, Yi paai Amɔrinim zoya ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ti la ni.
en: I said to you: You have come to the hills of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving to us.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Filip, a bi niŋ yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba maa gba be n ni? Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni tɔɣisiri ya maa, m bi tɔɣisiri li la mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; amaa m Ba ŋun be n ni maa n tumdi o tuma maa.
en: Dont you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I have spoken to you I dont speak on my own. The Father who dwells in me does his works.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha ti ku o.
en: So the farmers took the son, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye naa bindir nyaɣisa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla yɔhiŋ bindira.
en: Dont long for the rulers delicacies; the food misleads.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yina naŋgban yini. Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaŋ tabili Giliad. Ka salo maa daa laɣim naŋgban yini Yawɛ tooni Mizipa.
en: All the people of Israel from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, as well as from the land of Gilead in the east, answered the call. They gathered in one body in the Lord 's presence at Mizpah.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti baŋ ni Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛligu nam dunia ŋɔ; dinzuɣu Naawuni daa zaŋla ti nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa n-nam ti nina ni nyari binshɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: It is by faith that we understand that the universe was created by God's word, so that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.

dag: N daa ŋme ba luhi n naba ni, ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: I struck them down, and they could not get up again. They fell under my feet.

dag: nyin be a alizanda ni; ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Please listen to their prayers from your home in heaven, and help them.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinim ayi maa daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛri ba, Dumiya kpe na! Ka bɛ daa kpe sagban ni n-du alizanda ni bɛ dimnim maa ninni.
en: Then the two witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven say, Come up here! And both of them went up into heaven in a cloud. Their enemies watched them go.

dag: A daanabinim nyala ʒiinim din pa yɛlimaŋli mini ʒiinim din nyɛ yɔhiŋ. Bɛ bi kahigir a daalahichi wuhir a din ni chɛ ka a yi dabitim ni. Amaa bɛ tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka di kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o yiko din be kasi la tum tuma. O ni tilig o niriba, ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa nya.
en: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God.

dag: O vooi ma yihi barina bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka firigi ma baɣiri ni. O zaŋ ma tam tampiŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm.

dag: Di saha ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni dindali maa ka yɛli, Izraɛlnim yi ti yɛn suhi alibarika, bɛ ni zaŋla yi yuya suhi li. Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Naawuni chɛ ka yi be kaman Ifriim mini Manaasa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-zaŋ Ifriim leei toondana ka chɛ Manaasa.
en: So Israel blessed them that day. He said, The Israelites will use your names whenever they bless someone. They will say, May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh. In this way Israel made Ephraim greater than Manasseh.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaanii ni kɔbisiyɔbu, ka bɛ daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni.
en: and they had , men and boys at least one month old.

dag: Yisa ni daa ka o nyaandoliba maa sanna saha shɛli maa o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ jaa, ka o yuli booni Tomas la daa ka o tab maa sani.
en: Thomas was one of the twelve, but he was not with the other followers when Jesus came.

dag: Ka Keenannim tintariga daa yi Sidɔn Gɛra polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Gaza zaŋ lab Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni Adima ni Zɛbɔiim zaŋ hal ti paai Lasha.
en: The Canaanite boundary extends from Sidon by way of Gerar to Gaza and by way of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim to Lasha.

dag: N ni ti yɛn chɛ a yiŋ ŋɔ ni do so ka o be n sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nya biɛrim o suhu ni, ka kum hal ka o nina ti fulim, ka niriba ti zaŋ takɔbi ku a yiŋnim zaa.
en: One of your descendants whom I dont eliminate from serving at my altar will cry his eyes out and be full of grief. Any descendants in your household will die by the sword.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee yili ni. Miriya ka yi mi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee paɣa ni bee o tumtumdi dɔbba bee o tumtumdi paɣiba ni bee o naɣilalantabili ni bee o buŋ ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee binshɛli ni.
en: Do not desire and try to take your neighbors house. Do not desire and try to take your neighbors wife, male or female servant, ox, donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbor.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla bundaannima, amaa ka ka shɛli, ka shɛb mi niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla faranima, amaa ka mali buni pam.
en: Some people pretend to be rich, but have nothing. Others pretend to be poor, but own a fortune.

dag: Amaa ka Iso yɛl o, M mabia, mal a bini; n gba bi kɔŋ.
en: Esau said, I already have plenty, my brother. Keep whats yours.

dag: O daa lan ti o niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni bihim ni waagasi ni piɛri mini piɛlahi kpam ni Bashan naɣilahi mini buhi ni alikama viɛlli. Yi daa nyu wain tiwala wain viɛlli.
en: Their cows and goats gave plenty of milk; they had the best sheep, goats, and cattle, the finest wheat, and the choicest wine.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka ti be barina ni sahakam?.
en: And why do we always risk our lives.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a mali yɛm, ka baŋsim yɛtɔɣa be a noli ni.
en: Remember to live wisely, and what you learn will keep your lips from saying the wrong thing.

dag: Zabidiɛl bia Jashɔbiam n-daa su bɛ ni tuui pirigi ninvuɣ shɛb la fukumsi gol tuuli puuni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: In charge of the first division for the first month was Jashobeam, Zabdiels son. His division numbered .

dag: Tɔɣisimiya Jɛrusalɛmnim suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa. Yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ di wahala saɣi lala. N darigi bɛ tibili ka di saɣi, ka yipa chɛ bɛ daalahichi taali zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Encourage the people of Jerusalem. Tell them they have suffered long enough and their sins are now forgiven. I have punished them in full for all their sins.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ka dindina tim ti bindirigu maa sahakam.
en: The people said, Sir, from now on give us bread like that.

dag: Bɛ nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, bɛ kpalim bela zuliyanim maa sani kaman duɣu kpiŋ din lan ka buchi la.
en: Israel was destroyed; its people are scattered among the nations, like some dish that was thrown away because no one wanted it.

dag: Di bi wumdi bɛ ni so, bɛ so mi bi tuura. Gom bi gbaari ba bee ka bɛ ti gbihi. Bɛ ni so shɛlɔrigu bi wɔɣisi bee bɛ namdili ti chihi.
en: The enemy soldiers never get tired and stumble. They never get sleepy and fall asleep. Their weapon belts are always ready. Their sandal straps never break.

dag: Mɔabnim dula bɛ buɣa zoya, ka chaŋ ti kpe bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri ni n-fabili niŋ ba je, ka di bi sɔŋ ba.
en: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti bol a ka a chaŋ, nyin ʒinim tariŋ ʒiishee, ka ŋun bol a maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a, Zɔri, yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee ŋɔ ha! Di saha maa a ni nya jilima a mini bɛnkam laɣim ʒiya diri maa sani.
en: So when someone invites you, go sit in the seat that is not important. Then they will come to you and say, Friend, move up here to this better place! What an honor this will be for you in front of all the other guests.

dag: Amaa yi yi nyɛla bɛn dimdi taba, ka vandi taba, yin miriya ka yi ti bahi tab yoli zaa.
en: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves.

dag: N ka galimi o sani; ka gbaai mmaŋa zaŋ chaŋ taali tumbu polo.
en: I obey you completely and guard against sin.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔri Yawɛ nia biɛɣu? O ni chɛ ka di zani tariga; o dim ku tooi mo o buyi.
en: What are you plotting against the Lord ? He will destroy you. No one opposes him more than once.

dag: Wuhibu maa bela lahibal sun shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalana mini alibarikalan ŋɔ ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni ni m mol li la puuni.
en: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me.

dag: O lan yɛli luɣ shɛli yaha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: And in another part of the Scriptures God says, You are a priest forever— the kind of priest Melchizedek was. Psalm :.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mi bi tumdi tuma, amaa ka niŋ ŋun chɛ ka alahichilana yiri taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda, Naawuni zaŋd o gba zaani wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: But those who depend on faith, not on deeds, and who believe in the God who declares the guilty to be innocent, it is this faith that God takes into account in order to put them right with himself.

dag: Ka yi ti ŋmahiŋmahi li ka booi kpam niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: You must break it into pieces and pour oil over it. It is a grain offering.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: During all this time Rehoboam and Jeroboam were constantly at war with each other.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Malimiya shili zaŋ chaŋ dali, so di chɛ ka o mini paɣa dɔni.
en: and Moses told them, Be ready by the day after tomorrow and don't have sexual intercourse in the meantime.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka Ɛhab bia Jɛhɔram daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi.
en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of King Jehoshaphat of Judah, Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for twelve years.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛli ka di kul zaɣizaɣimi to n-yina pahi di zuɣu.
en: Just then, seven hard and thin ears of grain, scorched by the east wind, sprouted after them.

dag: Yi yi bi birigi Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu, ka bi tumdi yi suhuyubu dindali maa, ka tiri li jilima, ka bi chani soya, ka bi tumdi tuma bee n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya dindali maa.
en: The Lord says, If you treat the Sabbath as sacred and do not pursue your own interests on that day; if you value my holy day and honor it by not traveling, working, or talking idly on that day.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa n-tim dunia ni chɛ li.
en: Then the one who sat on the cloud swung his sickle on the earth, and the earth's harvest was reaped.

dag: Lɔris anahi maa zaa puuni, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣa me goma, ka me daansi tabili goma maa m-pie taba ti gili.
en: Each one had a stone wall around it, with fireplaces built against the wall.

dag: Sana bee tinzun nir yi be yi sani ka ti leei bundana, ka yi mabia mi leei faralana, ka zaŋ omaŋa pa talima san maa bee tinzun nir maa bee san maa yiŋ ninvuɣ so sani.
en: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me bɛ yinsi n-kpe m-be di ni, ka sa tihi ka di wali ka bɛ di di wala maa.
en: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.

dag: Dama saa ŋmaaya, ka kikaa gba gari.
en: Here, the winter is past; the rains have come and gone.

dag: Amaa nir yi lihi Naawuni zaligu din be tibi ka nyɛ din tiri daadamnim yolisim la ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka kul dol li dɛde ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni ŋun wumdi li mi kɔŋko, o ni nya alibarika Naawuni sani o ni tumdi shɛm maa puuni.
en: But when you look into Gods perfect law that sets people free, pay attention to it. If you do what it says, you will have Gods blessing. Never just listen to his teaching and forget what you heard.

dag: Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin yɛlim ti. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi yɛli ya, yi ku niŋ yɛda;.
en: They said, If you are the Messiah, then tell us that you are. Jesus said to them, If I tell you I am the Messiah, you will not believe me.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu boli zaɣ viɛlli, ka zaŋ zaɣ viɛlli boli zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ zibisim leei neesim, ka zaŋ neesim leei zibisim, ka zaŋ bintɔɣu boli binnyaɣisili, ka zaŋ binnyaɣisili boli bintɔɣu.
en: You are doomed! You call evil good and call good evil. You turn darkness into light and light into darkness. You make what is bitter sweet, and what is sweet you make bitter.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi kari zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa yomyom, ka mi daa bi chɛ ka Jɔshua kari ba.
en: So the Lord allowed these nations to remain in the land; he did not give Joshua victory over them, nor did he drive them out soon after Joshua's death.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, ti mali ba ka o nyɛla ninkurili, ka mali tizo ŋun nyɛ ti ba maa ni daa dɔɣ so o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni. O biɛli daa kpimi ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko n-kul kpalim o mabihi ni; ka o ba maa yur o pam.
en: And we said to my master, Yes, we have an elderly father and a young brother, born when he was old. His brother is dead and hes his mothers only child. But his father loves him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi gbana ŋɔ, ti ni dihi ti dalinli tabili dabu gban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ mini gban shɛli din pahi ŋɔ nti niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni ka di ku saɣim yoma.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Take these documents—this sealed deed of purchase along with the unsealed one—and put them into a clay container so they will last a long time.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi chɛ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu so shɛli o ni daa doli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la dolibu. Dina n-nyɛ salima naɣibihi shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl mini Dan la jɛmbu.
en: But he imitated the sin of King Jeroboam, who led Israel into the sin of worshiping the gold bull-calves he set up in Bethel and in Dan.

dag: So ku tooi yo omaŋmaŋ talima samli bee n-yo Naawuni o nyɛvili samli.
en: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Anabi Musa ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni yɛli shɛm la yɛla? O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: Surely you have read what God said about people rising from death. In the book where Moses wrote about the burning bush, it says that God told Moses this: I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindi timaŋa, ka o be kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka bɛ su zahim mini noonsi ni niɣi ni dunia ŋɔ zaa ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi.
en: Then God said, Now lets make humans who will be like us. They will rule over all the fish in the sea and the birds in the air. They will rule over all the large animals and all the little things that crawl on the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ŋɔ kun ya lari. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni chɛ ka yi tiligibu niŋ tom. Dama n wum ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zali ka wuhi ni o ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa shɛm.
en: Don't laugh at the warning I am giving you! If you do, it will be even harder for you to escape. I have heard the Lord Almighty's decision to destroy the whole country.

dag: Ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni pun kari dunia ŋɔ naa saria.
en: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.

dag: Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: We played the flute for you and you didnt dance. We sang a funeral song and you didnt mourn.

dag: Bɛ mini Pool zaa tuma daa nyɛla tanti wuɣibu tuma, dinzuɣu ka Pool daa chaŋ ti be bɛ sani ni o mini ba laɣim wolindi dira.
en: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di mi lan sabi yɛli, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: Jesus answered, Its been said, Dont test the Lord your God. .

dag: N zɔnim ni m mini bɛn doli bi lan miriti ma n yuma maa zuɣu; hal n ʒiʒiinitab gba kaɣiri ma mi.
en: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Yi mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni gul li; chamiya ti niŋ yi ni ni niŋ shɛm gul li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Pilate said, Take some soldiers and go guard the tomb the best way you know.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Musa dindali maa.
en: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla dunia zaa daa kala Ijipti na Yisifu sani ni bɛ ti da kawana, dama kum maa daa miila dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: People came to Egypt from all over the world to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka kum lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din tiri bindirigu.
en: When God called for a famine in the land, destroying every source of food.

dag: Amaa n daa bi lan niŋ lala, dama n daa je ni n yuli saɣim lala zuliyanim maa sani. Dama bɛ ninni ka n da yihi ba na.
en: But I did not, since that would have brought dishonor to my name among the nations which had seen me bring Israel out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Chɛl paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Chɛ ka o niŋ li gu n sɔɣibu dali.
en: Jesus replied, Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn diri wahala Jɛrusalɛm, ka buɣi ka di pala wain ka yi nyu ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Therefore, hear this, suffering one, who is drunk, but not from wine.

dag: Dama n ni moli Yawɛ yuli. Yɛlimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ galisim yɛla!.
en: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.

dag: Bɛ yih a niriba ʒim Jɛrusalɛm, ka di doya zɔri kaman kom la, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔɣi ba.
en: They shed your people's blood like water; blood flowed like water all through Jerusalem, and no one was left to bury the dead.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa daa bɔri ni bɛ ka Sulemaana sanna nti wum Naawuni ni ti o yɛm shɛli maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: People from every nation wanted to hear the wisdom God had given him.

dag: Yi nahindi nandaamba ka fari bɛ chi. Dinzuɣu yi ku be yi ni zaŋ kuɣa me yi yiya shɛŋa la ni, yi mi ku nyu yi ni sa yi wain ti viɛl shɛŋa la wain.
en: Truly, because you crush the weak, and because you tax their grain, you have built houses of carved stone, but you wont live in them; you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you wont drink their wine.

dag: ni Gɛdɔr ni Ahio ni Zɛkɛr.
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher.

dag: Nimaani sarikanim laɣimmi be ni suhudoo; bɛ bi lan wumdi bɛ guliba tahigu.
en: Prisoners are entirely at ease; they dont hear a bosss voice.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ŋme ma, amaa m bi nya daŋa. Bɛ bu ma, amaa di bi biɛra. Bɔ saha ka n nini yɛn neei? N lan bɔrila wain ni n nyu.
en: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, When will morning come, so I can drink some more.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A ku garigi ma? A bi mi ni m mali yiko din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpah a tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka lan mali yiko din ni tooi tilig a.
en: Why won't you answer my question? Pilate asked. Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, nyini n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi n niriba ŋɔ na, a mi daa bi chɛ ka m baŋ a ni yɛn tim so na ka m min o ti chaŋ, amaa di zaa yoli ka a yɛli ma, M mi a viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n nini lan tiɣ a.
en: Moses said to the Lord , You told me to lead these people, but you did not say who you would send with me. You said to me, I know you very well, and I am pleased with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yuya ni pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la kuli dɔbba dɔɣi bihi n-ʒi bɛ yinsi gbib ba, ka di chɛ ka ti dimnim ku nya soli n-yɛli ti din bie;.
en: So I would prefer that the younger widows get married, have children, and take care of their homes, so as to give our enemies no chance of speaking evil of us.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na bi di bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa tiɣi; bindirigu maa ni daa na kul be bɛ noya ni saha shɛli maa.
en: But before they were fully satisfied, while the food was still in their mouths.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi wumbu. Ka o ni daa mali yaa gari Tama maa zuɣu, ka o zaŋ kpeengarigu dɔn o.
en: But Amnon refused to listen to Tamar. He was stronger than she was, so he forced her to have sexual relations with him.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ yi be ka soli wuhibu ka di ni, di lurimi, amaa saawarimaaniba ni galisi luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka niriba be ni alaafee.
en: A nation without wise leaders will fall. Many good advisors make a nation safe.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli ni n zaŋ mmaŋa mini n ni mali shɛlikam saɣim yi zuɣu. N ni yuri ya pam la zuɣu, yinima ni yuri ma la biɛla?.
en: I will be glad to spend all I have, and myself as well, in order to help you. Will you love me less because I love you so much?.

dag: Yimiya luɣilikam na ti liri ba. Yɔhimiya bɛ kambɔna. Laɣimmiya ba duhi kaman bɛ ni kpaai kawana duhi shɛm la n ku bɛ zaa. Di chɛliya ka binshɛli lan kpalim nimaani.
en: Come from far away, you enemies of Babylon! Pile up the grain from its storehouses, and destroy it completely, along with everything else.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛli daa bol o, M bia Samuɛl. Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But Eli told him, Samuel, my boy, come here! Yes, sir! Samuel answered.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bo niriba ashilɔni n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim ni bɛ wum ka Stiivin turi Anabi Musa ka mɔri Naawuni.
en: So they bribed some men to say, We heard him speaking against Moses and against God.

dag: M pun yɛl a, Chɛ ka m bia maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma, ka a zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka o chaŋ, dinzuɣu n ni ku a bidib kpɛma.
en: I said to you, Let my son go so he could worship me. But you refused to let him go. As a result, now Im going to kill your oldest son.

dag: Di ŋmariya ʒiri ka mali n yuli pɔri pɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi dihi yi Naawuni yuli vi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, Daadam Bia ni ti ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo.
en: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right side of Almighty God.

dag: A yi nya shiri, nyin dim li a kum tariga, a yi di li yaɣi, a ni ti li bahi.
en: Never eat more honey than you need; too much may make you vomit.

dag: Puhimiya dakulɔdakulo churi mini ka daŋda chɛbu chuɣu ni wuuni atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: You should observe the Festival of Weeks, for the early produce of the wheat harvest, and the Gathering Festival at the end of the year.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ku lan deei liɣiri niriba maa sani; ka lan saɣi ni bɛn maligumaaniba maa ku mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The priests agreed to stop taking money from the people, but they also decided not to repair the Temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni nyɛ naa n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dindali maa, Yawɛ yino nti yɛn be, ka o yuli gba nyɛ yu yini.
en: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa nyɛ Libini daŋ mini Shimɛi daŋ; Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa bala.
en: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be mɔɣu ni, yin di chaŋya; ka bɛ mi yi ti yɛli ya, O be duu puuni, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Or, if people should tell you, Look, he is out in the desert!—don't go there; or if they say, Look, he is hiding here!—don't believe it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma.
en: Some time later, the Lord said:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɛhimiya, ka boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi fabila ka bɛ kana; ka tim boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi kuyila ka bɛ kana.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Now think about these things! Call for the women who get paid to cry at funerals. Send for the people who are good at that job.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ kura maa yi ti chaŋ yaɣi o ni zo n-kuli tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa tiŋgbani tariga.
en: If you leave the city of refuge to which you have escaped.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi deeri din simdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, wula ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini alahichinim bɛn ku deeri din simdi ba?.
en: If good people are rewarded here on earth, then surely those who do evil will also get what they deserve.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Gɛdalia naai yi biɛɣu ka so na bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: The next day, the murders had still not been discovered.

dag: Gaad zuliya mini bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zɛfɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛfɔnnima; ka Hagi daŋ niriba nyɛ Haginima; ka Shuni daŋ niriba nyɛ Shuninima.
en: These are the family groups in the tribe of Gad: Zephon—the Zephonite family group; Haggi—the Haggite family group; Shuni—the Shunite family group;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛn me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun kpe di kpɛbu shee m-me li, ka di chɛ ka so daa bi wum matarika bee lɛhu bee kuribini vuri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ ni daa mɛri li maa.
en: The stones were completely finished before they were brought into the Temple area, so there was no noise of hammers, axes, or any other iron tools in the Temple.

dag: Nira ni tooi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Amaa bɛ gbi ma la zamba bɔɣili. Teemi n ni daa zani a tooni n-tɔɣisi bɛ zaɣ viɛlli yɛla shɛm ni di chɛ ka a miligi a suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la.
en: I have done only good to them. It is not right for them to pay me back with evil. But they are preparing a death trap for me! Remember that I prayed to you for them. I asked only good for them. I tried to keep you from punishing them in anger.

dag: Ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkpam la nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Then he will burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila mini bɛ suhigu alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: listen to their prayers. Hear them in heaven and give them victory.

dag: Lala n-nyɛn ya. Yi ŋmanila wuntizɔriba niriba sani, amaa ka bilikɔnsi mini tuumbiɛri lee pali yi suhuri ni.
en: In the same way you look righteous to people. But inside you are full of pretense and rebellion.

dag: Maligumaaniba maa ni daa yi Luɣ Kasi shee maa na, ka sagbani sirigina nti pali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Suddenly a cloud filled the temple as the priests were leaving the most holy place.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali firilatamdigu, ka zaŋ matarika kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili, ka di mini di lahi ni bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi zaa din be di ni ti nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ ŋubiri bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka bɛ zaa ti ŋubiri taba bɛ dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya ka teei gili ba la nahiŋgu zuɣu.
en: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti shiri nya ka buŋ maa lo so yiŋ samban ni sokpaŋa, ka bɛ lɔrig o.
en: The disciples left and found the donkey tied near a door that faced the street. While they were untying it.

dag: amaa bɛ daa bi tooi tɔɣisi luh o, dama o daa tɔɣisirimi ni yɛm mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko.
en: However, they couldnt resist the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pihinahi gol so ŋun pahiri piniyini dahin yini dali ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛm.
en: But it was years from the time the Israelites left Egypt until the time they came to this place. On the first day of the eleventh month of the th year, Moses spoke to the people and told them everything the Lord commanded.

dag: ŋun pah ata gba kpuɣ o; lala ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi.
en: and then the third brother married her. Eventually all seven married her, and they all died without leaving any children.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes. Throughout his life, he didnt deviate from the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit.

dag: Hiburɔn daŋ ni bɛ daa piila Hashabia min o mabihi niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ni bɛ lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la Yawɛ tuma zaa mini naa tuma.
en: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives, , capable men, were put in charge of Israel west of the Jordan concerning all of the LORDs affairs and the kings service.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni bɛ ku gbilisi tibili wum bee n-deei n wuhibu maa.
en: although they didnt listen or pay attention. They were stubborn and wouldnt obey or accept correction.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso paɣ Oholibama Ana bipuɣiŋga la ni daa dɔɣi na shɛba m-bala.
en: The clans that descended from Esau and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabili ŋun suhu ye mahim zuɣu, ka ŋmani tumtumdiba bɛn guhiri bɛ yɔri.
en: Like a slave we pant for a shadow, await our task like a hired worker.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti dan ti yɛl o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ? Naawuni di wuhi gba, ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ti tum tuuni ŋɔ tatabo!.
en: But they replied, Sir, why do you say such things? We would never do anything like that!.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya ti ti bɛ suɣa zali gbilligbilli wulinluhili polo. Ifriim niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ammihud bia Ɛlishama.
en: Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The , troops of the tribe of Ephraim will be arranged by divisions and led by Elishama son of Ammihud.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba doli soli din tuhi hal ti paai bɛ ni yɛn ʒini tin shɛl ni.
en: God led them straight to human habitation.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba Yaakubu chaŋ Firawuna sani, ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni.
en: Then Joseph called his father Jacob to come in to meet Pharaoh. Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

dag: Nyama, Na so ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni ti di nam, ka o kpambaliba nyɛ bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: Listen to what I say! A king should rule in a way that brings justice. Leaders should make fair decisions when they lead the people.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa jɛndi Ijiptinim maa, ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm, ka bɛ niŋ Yawɛ min o dabili Musa yɛda.
en: When the Israelites saw the great power with which the Lord had defeated the Egyptians, they stood in awe of the Lord ; and they had faith in the Lord and in his servant Moses.

dag: Nyama, m pɔri pam. Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi garig a? N ni zaŋ n nuhi pɔbi n noli.
en: Look, Im of little worth. What can I answer you? Ill put my hand over my mouth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Jɛziriil, dama di ku lan yuui, n ni darigi Jɛhu zuliya tibili o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Jɛziriil la ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Izraɛl nam zani tariga.
en: the Lord said to Hosea, Name him Jezreel, because it will not be long before I punish the king of Israel for the murders that his ancestor Jehu committed at Jezreel. I am going to put an end to Jehu's dynasty.

dag: Man kul ku lihi yaɣi bɛ so zuɣu bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ tuma maa ʒili ba.
en: So I will not show any mercy or feel sorry for them. They brought it on themselves. I am only giving them the punishment they deserve.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ Ɛziɔngɛba mini Ɛlat tin shɛŋa din daa be teeku noli Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber. This town is near Elath on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

dag: Bɛ sahirila bɛ zilima ka di be kaman takɔbiri la, ka mal li yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri din ŋmani piɛma.
en: who sharpen their tongues like swords. They aim their arrow—a cruel word.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi di binshɛli din mali dabindi, Di simdi ni yi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: During this festival you must not eat any yeast. You must eat bread without yeast wherever you live.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa chaŋ Damaskus ni o ti nya Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza, ka o daa nya bimbin shɛli Damaskus maa. Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa zaŋ bimbini maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni di yɛlli kam zaa n-tim ti ti maligumaana Yuria.
en: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.

dag: Amaa n ni daa tɛhi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni, n daa nyaya ka di nyɛla tuun shɛli din to n sani.
en: I tried hard to understand all this, but it was too hard for me.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi duu maa zaa ka chɛ ka di mɛri zoori hal ti leeri jɛmbu du kasi ti Duuma ni.
en: The whole building is joined together in him, and it grows up into a temple that is dedicated to the Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Naawuni, ti puhir a ka paɣir a yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ.
en: We thank you, our God, and praise you.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ niriba maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ suhuri yula yɔɣu kpɛbu, ka bɛ ku tooi gbaai bɛmaŋa, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ bi deei ba. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: n-yɛra, Di niŋya dunia bee teeku bee tihi shɛli hal ka ti ti zaŋ bintabinda tabili ti Naawuni jɛmdiba gbiɛri zuɣu naai pɔi.
en: Dont harm the land or the sea or the trees before we mark the foreheads of those who serve our God.

dag: dama yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti be, ka pa ni ti nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu.
en: For our life is a matter of faith, not of sight.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ka yi ti tɛhi ni yi ni mali niriba pam, ka lan mali salima naɣila shɛb Jɛrɔbɔam ni mali tin ya, ka bɛ nyɛ yi buɣa la zuɣu yi ni tooi tuhi Yawɛ nam shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ Dauda bihi nuu ni ŋɔ.
en: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You always have the poor with you, but you wont always have me.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yaɣili maa ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm, amaa Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba ni Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ la zaa daa bela bɛmaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi ni ni bɛmaŋmaŋ paliti ni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Some of the Israelites, priests, Levites, servants, and descendants of Solomons servants lived in the various towns throughout Judah. These all lived on property they owned in these towns. But the area leaders lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ dabisi titali la miriya. Di miriya, ka kanna yomyom. Ka Yawɛ dabisili maa kandina ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu pam, ka tɔbbihi ni ti ŋme tɔbuchiriga dindali maa.
en: The Lord s special day for judging is coming soon! It is near and coming fast. People will hear very sad sounds on the Lord s special day of judgment. Even strong soldiers will cry.
