dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi zuɣu ka o daa kari ba o sani bahi.
en: The Lord became so angry with Jerusalem and Judah that he threw them away. Zedekiah rebelled and refused to obey the king of Babylon.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chani baɣisi mini bukpahinim bɛn sɔɣiri yɛr la sani ni bɛ ti yɛl a a zuɣu ni yɛlli? Miri ka a wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛri shɛli maa. Ŋun ne ni tooi vihi baŋ o zuɣu ni yɛlli kpiimba sani? A bi bɔhir a Naawuni?.
en: If they say to you: Consult the ghosts and the spirits that chirp and mutter. Consult the dead on behalf of the living.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni so ti ku yɛli ni o biɛra. Ka Naawuni ni ti chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani daalahichi zaa taali.
en: No one who lives in our land will ever again complain of being sick, and all sins will be forgiven.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma, Molimi molo pahi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka n tinsi maa lan tɔŋ, ka lan sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di wuhi ni mani n-su li.
en: The angel also said, The Lord All-Powerful says, My towns will be rich again. I will comfort Zion. I will again choose Jerusalem to be my special city.

dag: Lala ka Ɛdomnim daa niŋ n-zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan su ba, o ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Duuma Naawuni jɛmbu la zuɣu.
en: So Edom has been independent of Judah to this day. Libnah rebelled against Jehorams rule at the same time because he had abandoned the LORD, the God of his ancestors.

dag: Chɛliya ba! Bɛ nyɛla zoomba bɛn vɔri bɛ taba, Ka zom yi vɔri zoma, bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ni ti lula bɔɣili ni.
en: Leave the Pharisees alone. They are blind people who are guides to blind people. But if a blind person leads another blind person, they will both fall into a ditch.

dag: N yi ti kpihim a birili, n ni chɛ ka zuɣusaa zibigi, ka saŋmarisi ku lan ne. N ni ti chɛ ka sagbana limsi wuntaŋa, ka goli ti ku lan paligi.
en: When I destroy you, I will cover the sky and blot out the stars. The sun will hide behind the clouds, and the moon will give no light.

dag: O ni daa ti paai ti Asɔs ka ti zaŋ o niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ Mitilin.
en: When he caught up with us at Assos, we took him on board, and we all sailed to Mitylene.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a yurilim kpe ma nyaɣisim pam. M bɔr a yurilim gari wain. A tulaale nyom viɛl gari tulaale kam nyom.
en: Your love is so beautiful, my darling, my bride! Your love is better than wine. The smell of your perfume is better than any kind of spice!.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni na yɛli, Man ni yɔhim o.
en: until one particular spirit approached the LORD and said, Ill persuade him. How? the LORD asked.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi ka di daa lu o suhu ni ni o lab ti kaag o zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim la.
en: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to find out how his fellow Israelites were being treated.

dag: Zɔn tital la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili di kazala la zaa mɛbu ni, bɛ daa yi zaŋla kuɣikpɛra m-me kulis ata, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: The palace court, the inner court of the Temple, and the entrance room of the Temple had walls with one layer of cedar beams for every three layers of cut stones.

dag: Ka bɛn daa lab kulina maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the Jews who came back from captivity celebrated the Passover.

dag: Bipolitali ni daa kul pali bɛ niŋgbuŋ shɛŋa ni maa; bɛ mini li ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: When he was young, his bones were strong, but, like the rest of his body, they will soon lie in the dirt.

dag: Di yi pa lala Masidɔnianim shɛb yi nyɛla bɛn doli ma kana nti nya ka yi bi mali shili, ti ni di vi zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋ ya naani shɛm la polo, amaa di bahi bamdi yinima.
en: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.

dag: Pakoli maa ni da kpɛri ni o ti tooi kom maa na, ka o lan bol o yɛli, Piim mahili mali ma na.
en: As she was going to get the water, Elijah said, Bring me a piece of bread too, please.

dag: Akasia dari ka o daa zaŋ mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: He covered two acacia wood poles with bronze and.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini chiyaama buɣim kul dola palɔni Yawɛ sani, ka wula ka ninsalinim suhuri ni yɛla ku do palo ni o sani.
en: Not even the world of the dead can keep the Lord from knowing what is there; how then can we hide our thoughts from God?.

dag: Sool chandi maa dazɔhigu dali, Yawɛ daa pun daŋ kahigi wuhi Samuɛl yɛli.
en: The day before Saul came, the Lord had told Samuel.

dag: Ka n yi ti kana, ka yi pii yi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-sab gbana ti ba, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yi pini maa tahi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then when I get there, Ill send whomever you approve to Jerusalem with letters of recommendation to bring your gift.

dag: Amaa nyini n tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ti la birim.
en: but you have saved us from our enemies and defeated those who hate us.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmɛri bɔɣiri tampiŋ sɔŋdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ kɔba bahi gballi nol ni.
en: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhiranima m-pahi Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋdi tiri bɛn deeri ŋun Naawuni nol la.
en: We are witnesses of such things, as is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.

dag: Tarim so ŋun nahind o tarim taba ŋmanila sa so ŋun mi n-ʒi bindira zaa chaŋ.
en: Poor people who oppress the needy are rain that washes away food.

dag: Yi ni so di bɔh o kpee biɛri, amaa niŋmiya ania n-kul niŋmi yi taba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa din viɛla.
en: See that no one pays back wrong for wrong, but at all times make it your aim to do good to one another and to all people.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi dabisa ti nabi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ ti yi yaannim la ni n-yuui nimaani kaman sagbana ni be tiŋgbani zuɣusaa shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Do all that so your days and your childrens days on the fertile land the LORD swore to give to your ancestors are many—indeed, as many as the number of days that the skys been over the earth!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun nini tiɣ a, ka zaŋ a ʒili Izraɛl nam ʒiishee ŋɔ simdi paɣibu. Yawɛ ni kul yuri Izraɛlnim saha shɛlikam la zuɣu ka o piig a leei bɛ naa ni a doli yɛlimaŋli mini wuntia soli su ba.
en: Bless the LORD your God because he was pleased to place you on Israels throne. Because the LORD loved Israel with an eternal love, the LORD made you king to uphold justice and righteousness.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lee kul ŋahiri ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo? Bihi laamba n-di mimima, ka di zaŋ nyamdi bihi nyina ni.
en: Ezekiel, I hear the people of Israel using the old saying, Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.

dag: Dabisa ŋɔ yi ti gari, di nyaaŋa daba anii zaŋ chana maligumaaniba ni tooi mali yi sara shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini yi suhudoo saranim di zuɣu, ka n deei ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When the week is over, the priests are to begin offering on the altar the burnt offerings and the fellowship offerings of the people. Then I will be pleased with all of you. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama n yi kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n ti kuhirimi ka tahi yɛli, Duŋtaabo mini saɣiŋgu! Dama nyin Yawɛ yɛligu maa leela turi mini ansarisi bini n sani asiba hal ni yuŋ.
en: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.

dag: Ka Asa daa chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. Ka bɛ zaa daa zani bɛ tɔb gɔri ni Zɛfata din daa be Marɛsha la vinvamli ni.
en: Asa marched against him, setting up for battle in a valley north of Mareshah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka Judanim zaa daa kanna ti tir o pina. Ka o daa mali buni pam, ka niriba tir o jilima.
en: The Lord made Jehoshaphat a strong king over Judah. All the people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat. So he had much wealth and honor.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Maika yiŋ maa, ka bɛ nya nachimbil ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir maa m-baŋ o o yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee tah a kpe na? Ka bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe? Bee tuun bɔ ka a lee tumdi kpe.
en: While they were there, they recognized the accent of the young Levite, so they went up to him and asked, What are you doing here? Who brought you here.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa ti leei Naawuni dini, ka bɛ sɔɣ pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Ahazia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoram died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Jehorams son Ahaziah became the new king.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anahi, ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah anahi yɛli, Kamina.
en: The Lamb opened the fourth seal. Then I heard the voice of the fourth living being say, Come.

dag: ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri maa ku o, ŋun bɔh o biɛri maa ku mali ninvuɣ kubo taali.
en: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni anabinim mini nanim pam daa bɔri ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ, ka bi nya li; ka daa lan bɔri ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ, ka daa bi wum li.
en: I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see, but they could not, and to hear what you hear, but they did not.

dag: Ka din gari di zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yɛda niŋbu leei bintaɣirisi din ni chɛ ka yi tooi tiligi Sintani piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la nyɔɣibu.
en: Above all, carry the shield of faith so that you can extinguish the flaming arrows of the evil one.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya bɛn daa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa zali ba ni bɛ deem zaka Izraɛlnim sani. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni bɛ deem li la bɛmaŋmaŋ mabihi sani, hal bɛ mabihi maa gba ni daa kul nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya la zaa yoli.
en: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.

dag: Karimbaannim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa, bɛ ni ti siɣisi ba; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.

dag: Yi yi mali yɛm, yin wummiya dimbɔŋɔ. Wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ.
en: If you men are wise, you will listen to what I say.

dag: Piligu ni ka Naawuni ni booni so Yɛligu la daa be. Yɛligu maa daa bela Naawuni sani. Yɛligu maa daa nyɛla Naawuni.
en: In the beginning was the Word and the Word was with God and the Word was God.

dag: Palo shɛli din kpalim ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili la ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa palo. Bɛ ni ti tooi me yiya nimaani bee n-chɛ ka di nyɛ palo doya, tiŋ maa ni ti be di sunsuuni.
en: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.

dag: ni Ana ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Hɔri nanima, ka nyɛ Siɛr bidibisi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ hal ka yi ti ku ba naai.
en: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti Naawuni. Zaɣisimiya Sintani, ka o zo ka chɛn ya.
en: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋun pun su kom bi lan bɔr o luɣ shɛli polo paɣibu n-naɣ pahila o naba, dama o ni zaa pun viɛlimi. Ka yɛli ba, Yi zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila yi ni yino.
en: Jesus said, Those who have taken a bath are completely clean and do not have to wash themselves, except for their feet. All of you are clean—all except one. .

dag: M bia, a yi mali yɛm, n suhu ni piɛla.
en: My children, if you show good sense, I will be happy.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, Ŋuni n-lee mali kpiɔŋ paai nyin Yawɛ? A ʒiɛyimtali kul gilila a luɣilikam zaa.
en: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.

dag: O daa yɛli ma mi, A bia Sulemaana n-ni ti me n yili maa mini n dundɔna, dama mani m-piig o leei m bia, ka m mi leeg o ba.
en: He said to me: Your son Solomon will build my temple and my courtyards, for Ive chosen him to become my son even as I myself will become his father.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yilimiya yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli ti Yaakubu, ka duhiya yi yee m-paɣi ŋuna ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam naa ŋɔ. Molimiya, ka paɣimiy o yɛra, Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: The Lord says, Sing with joy for Israel, the greatest of the nations. Sing your song of praise, The Lord has saved his people; he has rescued all who are left.

dag: Yuuni kam Yisa ba min o ma daa yi chanila Jɛrusalɛm ti puhiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu.
en: Each year his parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover Festival.

dag: ka yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Dont tell anyone about what I did for you. But go and let the priest look at you. And offer a gift to God because you have been healed. Offer the gift that Moses commanded. This will show everyone that you are healed.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa dɔɣi Tɛra maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisiyinika. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Terah was born, Nahor lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Nadab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The other things that Nadab did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi ni, Uriɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: There were people from the tribe of Kohath. Uriel was their leader.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ilaisha, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Bɛtɛl. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Bɛtɛl.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, Please stay here, because the Lord told me to go to Bethel. But Elisha said, I promise, as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you. So the two men went down to Bethel.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka n naba be kaman saŋkpaliŋ naba la, ka chɛ ka n du n-tam luɣ shɛŋa din du.
en: He makes my feet as steady as those of a deer. Even on steep mountains he keeps me from falling.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-sa tihi balibu kam, di wala ni ti nyɛla din dibu chihiri yi sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din chihiri dibu yi sani hal ni yuma ata, ka di bi simdi ni yi di li.
en: When you enter the land and plant any fruit tree, you must consider its fruit off-limits. For three years it will be off-limits to you; it must not be eaten.

dag: nyini ŋun deeri ti suhigu ŋɔ! Ninsalinim zaa ni ka a sanna.
en: because you answer prayers. People everywhere will come to you.

dag: yɛl o, Chɛl a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ka yiɣisi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-looi n ni yɛn wuh a tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: God told him, Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.

dag: N ni ti ba suhu shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni; dama bɛ ni ti labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti zaŋ naɣilaa ni yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la bee alikauli palibu sara bee suhudoo biɛrisuŋ sara ti Yawɛ.
en: When you offer a bull for an entirely burned offering, or a sacrifice to fulfill a solemn promise, or a well-being sacrifice to the LORD.

dag: Bɛtani mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣa ni taba; di nyɛla kaman mail ayi laasabu.
en: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Sinai mɔɣu ni n-doli tab gbilligbilli chana; ka sagbani maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: So the Israelites began their journey. They left the desert of Sinai and traveled until the cloud stopped in the desert of Paran.

dag: Ka Pita lan bɔh o, N Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka n ku tooi dol a pumpɔŋɔ? Hal n ni saɣi kpi a zuɣu.
en: Peter asked, Lord, why cant I follow you now? I am ready to die for you.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta mini Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir maa, Nyama, m pun chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Haman yili gar dari, o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la zuɣu, ka zaŋ o yiŋ ti Ɛsta.
en: King Xerxes then said to Esther and Mordecai, I have already ordered Haman to be hanged and his house given to Esther, because of his evil plans to kill the Jews.

dag: Mbaye n zɔnima, zomiya ma nambɔɣu, zomiya ma nambɔɣu! Dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma lala maa!.
en: Pity me. Pity me. Youre my friends. Gods hand has truly struck me.

dag: Amaa nyin tum alahichi n-gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni. A daai ma baɣil a nyaaŋa ka me buɣa, ka mali binnana zali n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.

dag: Nyin Lɛbanɔn nira ŋun me a yili zali sida tihi sunsuuni ŋɔ, biɛrim yi ti paag a, a ni ŋuhi pam kaman paɣa ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la.
en: You who live in Lebanon, nestled in cedar, who will pity you when you are overcome in pain, like that of childbirth?.

dag: Hamɛdata ŋun daa yi Agag zuliya ni na bia Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim la n-daa ti chɛ ka bɛ pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya, ka ku Yɛhudianima. O daa lomi ni o bahi ba yoli zaa.
en: Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite was the enemy of all the Jews. He had made an evil plan against the Jews to destroy them. And Haman had thrown the lot to choose a day to ruin and to destroy the Jews. At that time the lot was called a pur.

dag: Alikauli maa zuɣu ka ti zuliya pinaayi jɛmdi Naawuni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka mali tahima ni ti ti nya di palibu. Naa, tahima maa zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim ŋmari ma tiŋŋmaŋ maa.
en: the very thing that the twelve tribes of our people hope to receive, as they worship God day and night. And it is because of this hope, Your Majesty, that I am being accused by these Jews!.

dag: N dima, di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla n lubu zuɣu; dama n ni lan yiɣisi. N yi ʒini zibisim ni, Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ n neesim.
en: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.

dag: Wummiya! Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: Listen to this! A farmer went out to scatter seed.

dag: Yi tɔbbia kam yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du Yawɛ ninni chaŋ ti lu o dimnim maa zuɣu hal ka o ti kari ba.
en: All of you who are equipped for war, cross the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven his enemies out before him.

dag: Ka Naa daa zan o zaashee n-lo alikauli Yawɛ tooni ni o ni jɛmd o, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa ni o shia zaa, ka niŋ kaman alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi kundi maa puuni ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then the king stood up in his place. He made an agreement with the Lord . He agreed to follow the Lord and to obey his commands, laws, and rules. He agreed to obey with all his heart and soul the words of the agreement written in this book.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Ijipti mɔɣili la kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka pɔhim tulli ʒe na ti kpe Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka o ti pirigi li kulibombih ayopɔin m-mali soli ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋ du.
en: Just as the Lord divided the Red Sea near Egypt, he will raise his arm in anger over the Euphrates River and hit it. It will divide into seven small rivers. They will be so small that the people can walk across with their sandals on.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa ni na. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.

dag: Yawɛ yɛn zaŋla buɣim min o takɔbi n-darigi dunia ŋɔ niriba bɛn zaa mali taali tibili. O ni ti chɛ ka niriba pam kpi.
en: The Lord 's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Dinzuɣu a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela neesim ni;.
en: The only source of light for the body is the eye. If you look at people and want to help them, you will be full of light.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka bɛ be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim ŋɔ ni ka lur a sizuura hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: Then your people will worship and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.

dag: Binnui so mi daŋ ni: Shimɛi so yaha.
en: From the descendants of Binnui, these men: Shimei.

dag: Kum yi ti lu, o ni tilig a ka a ku kpi; tɔb tuhibu ni, o ni tilig a takɔbi kum ni.
en: God will save you from death when there is famine. He will protect you from the sword when there is war.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A min a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, yiɣisimiya chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po pɔri Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu sani yɛli, N ni zaŋ li ti yi zuliya la ni.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Go and leave this place, you and the people whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt. Go to the land I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, Ill give it to your descendants.

dag: Ka Reechɛl dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayi ti Yaakubu.
en: Bilhah became pregnant again and gave Jacob a second son.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili dali miriya. Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu na dabisi shɛli dali maa miriya. Fabilimiya!.
en: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Bia m-bɔŋɔ, n ni pii so m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: Then a voice from the cloud said, This is my Son, my chosen one. Listen to him.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli kpamba maa, Yinim kpalimmiya be kpe n-guhi ti hal ka ti ti lab yi sanna. Aduna mini Hur be yi sani, ka ŋunkam mali yɛl shɛli, ŋun cham bɛ sani.
en: Moses had said to the elders, Wait for us here until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur will be here with you. Whoever has a legal dispute may go to them.

dag: Nyama, n nini nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka n tiba wum, ka m baŋ di gbinni.
en: Look, my eye has seen it all; my ear has heard and understood it.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni kari zuliya shɛb zaa bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ bahi, ka yi ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya tinsi su.
en: then the LORD will clear out all these nations before you. You will inherit what belonged to nations that are larger and stronger than you are.

dag: Bɛ na mi n-vii kpiimba biɛhigu shee dunoya ka a nya, bee a na mi n-nya zibisim titali dunoya?.
en: Has anyone shown you the gates to the world of the dead? Have you ever seen those gates that lead to the dark place of death?.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti be sagbana ni kanna, ka sokam nina ni ti nya o, hal bɛn daa zaŋ kpani kuh o luɣili la gba ni ti nya o, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ti fabili bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛm zuɣu. Lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ. Ami.
en: Look, he is coming with the clouds! Every eye will see him, including those who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of him. This is so. Amen.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so maa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi baŋ ti chɔɣinsi yɛla ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa nya zahimbu kaman ti gba ni nyari zahimbu shɛm, amaa o daa bi tum alahichi di puuni.
en: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!.

dag: Bɛ yih a niriba ʒim Jɛrusalɛm, ka di doya zɔri kaman kom la, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔɣi ba.
en: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.

dag: ni o deei Judas ni daa tum birigi n-chaŋ o chandi shee ka chɛ tinim tuumba ŋɔ tuun shɛl la.
en: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla saha din ka bahigu naa. Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim ni bahi yoli o tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord is king forever and ever. Those who worship other gods will vanish from his land.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu. A yurilim maŋli min a nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, kpihimmi n daalahichi!.
en: Have mercy on me, God, according to your faithful love! Wipe away my wrongdoings according to your great compassion!.

dag: Naa Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa ti wum ni o bia Ahazia kpiya, ka o dii yiɣisi gbaai nabihi kubu.
en: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done that.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ku niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: Our Lord , they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm gbibbu fukumsi niŋ n tizo Hanani mini Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ birini guliba kpɛm la nuu ni, dama Hanania daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun zɔri Naawuni n-gari niriba pam.
en: I put two men in charge of governing the city of Jerusalem: my brother Hanani and Hananiah, commanding officer of the fortress. Hananiah was a reliable and God-fearing man without equal.

dag: Ti ni daa be bɛ sani n-guli ti piɛri ŋɔ saha shɛli maa zaa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ gooni gili ti yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: His men protected us night and day. They were like a wall around us—they protected us while we were with them caring for the sheep.

dag: O ni saɣim Lɛbanɔn sida tiwɔɣila zaa mini Bashan oki tihi zaa.
en: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka fɔŋ ni vuri ni, so mi bi mali ba tumdi tuma ka bɛ wumd o tahigu.
en: They are happy to be away from the noise of the city. They never have to listen to their drivers shouting at them.

dag: Zuliya kam kul taarila duŋ ka nam kam damda. O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, tiŋgbani nyɛligirimi.
en: Nations are terrified, kingdoms are shaken; God thunders, and the earth dissolves.

dag: Di saha ka n daa pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima: Shɛrɛbia mini Hashabia ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ninvuɣ pia m-pahi.
en: Then I selected twelve of the leading priests, Sherebiah and Hashabiah and ten of their relatives with them.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa daa zabir o nyuli di zuɣu, amaa ka o ba daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: Josephs brothers continued to be jealous of him, but his father thought about all these things and wondered what they could mean.

dag: Ti sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy.

dag: Yi Naawuni yɛliya, Maamiya n niriba suhuri, maamiya bɛ suhuri!.
en: Comfort, comfort my people! says your God.

dag: Bɛla ni daa ti kpi, Jɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛra bia, ka o ya nyɛ Bɔzira la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Bela died, Jobab, Zerahs son from Bozrah, succeeded him.

dag: Niɣi mi bɛ lana, ka bunsi mi bɛ lan ni dihiri ba luɣ shɛli. Amaa Izraɛlnim bi mi lala, n niriba maa bi baŋ.
en: A bull knows its master, and a donkey knows where its owner feeds it. But Israel does not know me. My people do not understand.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda Aiya bipuɣiŋga Rizipa ŋun daa nyɛ Sool mam la ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: When David was told what Aiahs daughter Rizpah, Sauls secondary wife, had done.

dag: Ti yi be, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti be; ka ti yi kpi, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpi; dinzuɣu ti yi bemi bee ti yi kpimi, ti Duuma n-su ti.
en: If we live, we are living for the Lord. And if we die, we are dying for the Lord. So living or dying, we belong to the Lord.

dag: Ka Amiram daa kpuɣ o piriba Jokɛbɛd n-zaŋ o dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa. Amiram daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Amram married Jochebed, his fathers sister. She gave birth to Aaron and Moses. Amram lived years.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa va nti bɔb gbaag o ba n-kumdi ka mɔɣisir o kpariŋ.
en: Joseph started crying, then leaned over to hug and kiss his father.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kaman o ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa. N ni daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, yim ka vuri ti mɔni karikari, ka kɔba maa daa tuɣi taba, ka kɔbili kam daa chaŋ ti tuɣi di kpee.
en: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!.

dag: Yawɛ, di yi nyɛla a dimnima, a dimnim maa ni ti kpi; ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa ti wurim.
en: Lord , all your enemies will be destroyed, and all who do evil will be scattered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Ibrahimma Mamri oki tihi la gbini, o ni daa ʒi o tanti suɣili dunol ni wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha la.
en: The Lord appeared to Abraham at the sacred trees of Mamre. As Abraham was sitting at the entrance of his tent during the hottest part of the day.

dag: Amaa Yisa maligumaanitali tuma nyɛla din gari bɛ maligumaanitali tuma kaman o ni mali alikauli shɛli Naawuni mini ninsalinim sunsuuni ni so alikauli kurili la shɛm, dama di tam la alikaulinim din so zuɣu.
en: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti namda, ka ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka o nam ti ni ti mali biɛhigu shɛli din ni tumdi tuun sun shɛŋa o ni daa pun zali ni ti tumdi la.
en: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Bɛ yi ti biɛra, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba, ka tib bɛ dɔriti zaa.
en: When they are sick in bed, the Lord will give them strength and make them well!.

dag: Niŋm ania zaŋ amaŋ wuhi ni a nyɛla tumtumdi so Naawuni ni di shɛhira, ka a ku di vi a tuma ni, ka ni nyɛla ŋun wuhiri Naawuni yɛligu yɛlimaŋtali dɛde.
en: Do your best to be the kind of person God will accept, and give yourself to him. Be a worker who has no reason to be ashamed of his work, one who applies the true teaching in the right way.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yihi salima nɛma din be bɛ ni zaa Sinai Zoli gbini, ka bi lan zaŋ li niŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: So after they left Mount Sinai, the people of Israel no longer wore jewelry.

dag: ni Ibram, .
en: and Abram .

dag: Dama n ni kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni; n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili, amaa yinim ni du li chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa su.
en: I will die here in this land. I wont cross the Jordan River. But you will, and you will take possession of that wonderful land.

dag: Yawɛ, m bela muɣisigu pam ni ka kumdi niŋd a.
en: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord .

dag: Di saha ka o daa neei bɛ nini ni bɛ baŋ Naawuni litaafinim maa gbinni.
en: Then Jesus helped the followers understand these Scriptures about him.

dag: Ashidɔd mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi ni Gaza mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ mini Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli tintariga la.
en: There were Ashdod and Gaza, with their towns and villages, reaching to the stream on the border of Egypt and the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka biisim ti kpe li ka di nyɛligi. Tulim yi ti kana, a ku lan nya li di biɛhigu maa shee.
en: but in the heat they disappear, and the stream beds lie bare and dry.

dag: Ŋun daa lan pahi n-nyɛ Baruk bia Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ Kolihɔze yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Hazaaya mini Adaya ni Joyarib ni Zakaria so mi bɛn daa nyɛ Shilo daŋ ni niriba la.
en: and Maaseiah son of Baruch .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n wuhi tuumbiɛrinima a soya, ka alahichinim ŋmaligi lab a sanna.
en: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a daŋ min a nam n-kul ni ʒiɛya, n sani ka a nam kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam. .
en: You will always have descendants, and I will make your kingdom last forever. Your dynasty will never end.

dag: Yi ni shɛb booni tinim la ninvuɣ gbarima, ka hal di ni dihi ma vi la zaa yoli, n saɣi lala! N tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu n-nyɛ ma la. Ka so yi bɔri ni o nyu bara binshɛli zuɣu, n gba ni tooi nyu bara lala:.
en: Im ashamed to say that we have been weak in comparison! But in whatever they challenge me, I challenge them .

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn nyɛ ansarisimaaniba, ka di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya man Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: You leaders in Jerusalem should listen to the Lord s message, but now you refuse to listen to him.

dag: Jɛrilim tuma tirila ŋun ka yɛm suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun mali tɛhi zilima ŋun tumdila din tuhi.
en: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.

dag: Ka naa maa daa pirig o nintu shɛli o ni daa yi mali dihiri zaligu gbana zuɣu ka di leeri naa ni zali zaligu shɛli ti Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: The king removed his royal ring from his finger and handed it to Haman, Hammedatha the Agagites son, enemy of the Jews.

dag: O daa sabila gbaŋ maa yɛli Jɔab, Zaŋmi Yuria zali tooni tɔb maa ni mali kpiɔŋ luɣ shɛli polo, ka miligi ka chɛ o ka bɛ ku o.
en: He wrote: Put Uriah in the front line, where the fighting is heaviest, then retreat and let him be killed.

dag: Ka Naawuni gba daa di o shɛhira yiko shihira wuhibu ni mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni ni alahiziba tuma balibu pam ni min o ni daa zaŋ o Shia Kasi pina ti niriba kaman o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: At the same time God added his witness to theirs by performing all kinds of miracles and wonders and by distributing the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to his will.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ nabihi bɛn daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo bɛ kpamba tuma.
en: The men of Tekoa built the next section, but the leading men of the town refused to do the manual labor assigned them by the supervisors.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tɔbu lu Sirianim zuɣu. Tɔbu lu bɛn be Babilɔn zuɣu, ka lu bɛ kpambaliba mini bɛ yɛnnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, Sword, kill the people living in Babylon. Sword, kill the kings officials and the wise men of Babylon.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, Di deei bɛ sara maligu. N na ʒi n-deei bɛ so buŋa, m mi na ʒi n-niŋ bɛ ni so zaɣ biɛ shɛli.
en: Moses became angry and said to the Lord , Do not accept any offerings these men bring. I have not wronged any of them; I have not even taken one of their donkeys.

dag: Dama saha kanna ka yi dimnim ni ti kana nti teei gili ya, ka lan me bimbin kara tabili yi gooni.
en: The time will come when your enemies will build fortifications around you, encircle you, and attack you from all sides.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o ni o niŋm shɛm maa. Ka ŋun Balak mini Balaam daa kɔrigi naɣila yino mini piɛla yino m-mali sara pa bimbin yini kam zuɣu.
en: After Balak had done this, they sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: N ni daa lo o alikauli shɛli daa nyɛla nyɛvili mini alaafee alikauli din nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti o ka di wuhiri jilima tibu, ka o daa tiri ma jilima ka luri n yuli sizuura la.
en: My covenant with him involved life and peace, which I gave him, and also fear so that he honored me. He was in awe of my name.

dag: Zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti taba yi ni luri Masia sizuura la zuɣu.
en: Be willing to serve each other out of respect for Christ.

dag: Yawɛ miri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri saɣim, ka tiligiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima.
en: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted; he saves those whose spirits are crushed.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa tum tuun shɛli zaa pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Azariah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ alikauli la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ dapuhi la niŋ adaka maa, ka zaŋ adaka maa yɔrigu yo li.
en: Then he took the two stone tablets and put them in the Covenant Box. He put the poles in the rings of the Box and put the lid on it.

dag: Bɛ wuhibu ŋmanila yumaha din diri ninsal niŋgbuŋ la. Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Filɛtus.
en: Their evil teaching will spread like a sickness inside the body. Hymenaeus and Philetus are men like that.

dag: N yur a zaligunim soli maa pam kaman n ni yuri azichi balibu kam shɛm.
en: I rejoice in the content of your laws as if I were rejoicing over great wealth.

dag: Ka Hagai lan bɔh o, Ka nir yi shihi kpima, ka kana ti shihi bindira maa, di ni chɛ ka bindira maa leei din pa kasi? Ka Maligumaana maa garigi yɛli, Iin.
en: Then Haggai asked, Suppose someone is defiled because he has touched a dead body. If he then touches any of these foods, will that make them defiled too? The priests answered, Yes.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛl o nachimba maa, Ʒiɛnya buŋ ŋɔ sani, ka m mini bia ŋɔ chaŋ kpe ha ti jɛm Naawuni ka labina.
en: Then he said to the servants, Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there and worship, and then we will come back to you.

dag: Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa ka di galisi pam, di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi zahim baŋ bɛ ni zaŋ daanya shɛm tariga mal li.
en: Solomon made so many of them that no one tried to weigh the bronze used.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le da kol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim.
en: Nobody pours new wine into old wineskins. If they did, the new wine would burst the wineskins, the wine would spill, and the wineskins would be ruined.

dag: Do so daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee ka o yuli booni Maika.
en: There was once a man named Micah, who lived in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Paɣa, niŋm ma yɛda ni saha kanna ka yi ti ku lan jɛm ti Ba Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu bee Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

dag: Jilima mini nam dariza bela o sani, ka kpiɔŋ ni suhupiɛlli be o biɛhigu shee.
en: He lives in the presence of glory and honor. His Temple is a place of power and joy.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ daba tim bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim la jilima, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yuli min o wuhibu ŋɔ.
en: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni o ti tuh o. Ka Hɔshia daa zaŋ omaŋ ti Asiria naa maa ka yɔr o farigu.
en: King Shalmaneser of Assyria came to fight against Hoshea and defeated him. So Hoshea paid tribute to Shalmaneser.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni yino daa kana nti wum ka Yisa garigi bɛn daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni maa bɔhigu viɛnyɛliŋga ka bɔh o, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: One of the teachers of the law came to Jesus. He heard Jesus arguing with the Sadducees and the Pharisees. He saw that Jesus gave good answers to their questions. So he asked him, Which of the commands is the most important.

dag: N dabisa ŋmanila zaawuni shilinshia; n kuumi kaman mɔri la.
en: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi zo, ka o yiŋ nim zaa daa yiɣisi dol o. Naa daa naɣ chɛla o mamanim pia niŋ nayili maa puuni ni bɛ maani li.
en: King David left with everyone in his family, except ten of his slave women. He left them to take care of the house.

dag: Dinzuɣu zalimiya zaligu n-yɛli ni niriba maa na chɛli bɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu, ka naɣila n ti lan zali zaligu yaha.
en: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.

dag: Yɛlimiya Aakipus ni di niŋ kamaata ni o tum ti Duuma ni ti o tuun shɛl la naai.
en: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anahi daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi wuntaŋ zuɣu, ka ti o yiko ni o tulim be kaman buɣim la n-wɔb daadamnima;.
en: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to burn people with its fiery heat.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla Naawuni niriba. Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni nir nyɛla ŋun wumdi tiri ti; ka ŋunkam mi pa Naawuni nir pala ŋun wumdi tiri ti. Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ Shi so ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli Shia, ka lan baŋ shi so ŋun nyɛ biriginsim shia.
en: We are from God. The person who knows God listens to us. Whoever is not from God doesnt listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli ŋɔɣu maa ni n yɛn karila alizin biɛri, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋ zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali n ni naai n tuma.
en: Jesus said to them, Go tell that fox, Today and tomorrow I am forcing demons out of people and finishing my work of healing. Then, the next day, the work will be finished.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣisi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb tintariga polo nti ʒini Kadɛshi mini Shur sunsuuni; ka daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ ti be Gɛra.
en: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the arid southern plain, and he settled as an immigrant in Gerar, between Kadesh and Shur.

dag: Ka o tizɔdoo Absalom daa nya o ka bɔh o, A tizɔdoo Amnɔn zaŋ a mi dɔni yɔɣu? Ka daa yɛl o, N tizɔpaɣa niŋmi suɣilo, a tizɔdoo m-bala, di chɛ ka di muɣis a. Di saha ka Tama daa leei bɛ ni ku lan bo paɣ so, ka o kpalim ʒi o tizɔdoo Absalom yiŋa.
en: When her brother Absalom saw her, he asked, Has Amnon molested you? Please, sister, don't let it upset you so much. He is your half brother, so don't tell anyone about it. So Tamar lived in Absalom's house, sad and lonely.

dag: Hiram ni daa wum Sulemaana ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o yɛli, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ m paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun ti Dauda bi yɛndana ni o su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Hiram was thrilled when he heard Solomons message. He said, Today the LORD is blessed because he has given David a wise son who is in charge of this great people.

dag: Bɛ gɔŋla bɛ zilima ka di be kaman tɔbiri la; bɛ mali yaa pam tiŋgbani maa ni zaŋ chaŋ ʒiri ŋmabu polo, ka pa ni yɛlimaŋli polo. Dama bɛ kul tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka bi mi ma, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Tɔrokɔnima ayɔbu mini naɣilahi pinaayi din daa nyɛ bɛ sara na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Zuɣulaannim ayi kam daa laɣim sula tɔroko yini, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam su naɣila yino. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili tooni.
en: with gifts for the Lord . They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Miri ka a chɛ ka so suhu saɣim doo ŋɔ zuɣu, mani a dabili ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: David said to Saul, People shouldnt let Goliath discourage them. I am your servant. I will go fight this Philistine.

dag: Kɔhimiya yi ni mali shɛli n-zaŋ ti nandaamba pini; bomiya liɣiri kolibihi shɛŋa din bi kurigira n-sɔŋ azichi shɛli din ti ku naai Naawuni yili, tayiɣ ni ti ku be shɛli bee lɛla ni ti ku saɣim li luɣ shɛli.
en: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n taali niŋ kpalaŋ ni lo li, ka a ti zaŋ bini limsi n tuumbiɛri.
en: You will forgive them and put them away; you will wipe out all the wrongs I have done.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan bɔhi, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said, Think about what you are doing.

dag: Dama yi bɔhira, Nabia maa yil la be ya? Ninvuɣ biɛɣu maa ni daa be yili shɛl ni la lee be ya.
en: You ask, Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Ka m mi lee nyɛla ŋuni ka n Duuma ma ti kani n sanna?.
en: Why should this great thing happen to me, that my Lord's mother comes to visit me?.

dag: Ka a niŋgbuŋ zaa yi nɛmi hal ka zibisim biɛla ka di ni, dindina di ni nɛmi zaa kaman firila ni ne a shɛm la.
en: If your whole body is full of light—with no part darkened—then it will be as full of light as when a lamp shines brightly on you.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi sokam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Anab titali ka dunia ŋɔ ni na nti be ti sani. Ka bɛ lan yɛli, Naawuni n-ka o niriba sani maa na.
en: Awestruck, everyone praised God. A great prophet has appeared among us, they said. God has come to help his people.

dag: Yɛlim Yaakubu zuliya dimbɔŋɔ, molimi li Juda:.
en: The Lord says, Tell the descendants of Jacob, tell the people of Judah:.

dag: ka lan me n-gili Bɛtizur mini Soko ni Adulam.
en: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam.

dag: Ka Husham daa ti kpi, ka Bɛdad ŋun daa nyaŋ Midiannim Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni la bidibiga Hadad daa di nam zan o zaani. O ya yuli n-daa booni Avit.
en: When Husham died, Hadad ruled that area. Hadad was the son of Bedad. Hadad was from the city of Avith.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ nyɛla, faashee ka bɛ ŋme n-wurisi chɛfirinim maligu malibu bimbina la buɣibuɣi kaman zim la; ka saɣim Ashɛra ŋmahinli binyara mini di tulaale tuɣilibu bimbina la zaa.
en: How will Jacobs guilt be forgiven? What will happen so his sins can be taken away? The rocks of the altar will be crushed to dust; the statues and altars for worshiping false gods will all be destroyed.

dag: Ka daɣila m piɛri maa yɛn ŋubila yi ni no mo shɛŋa sɔŋ maa, ka nyu yi ni zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli maa?.
en: But now my flock must feed on what your feet have trampled and drink water that your feet have muddied.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani m-mali suhudoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ daa wum bɛ ni suh o Izraɛl tiŋgbani maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka vuug alɔbo maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: Then he built an altar for the Lord . He offered sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask for his blessings. The Lord answered the prayers of the people, and no one else died from the terrible disease.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. A yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Izraɛlnima; ka lan yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Yisahaku zuliya.
en: And here you are, telling me not to preach!.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Onan.
en: She became pregnant again, gave birth to a son, and named him Onan.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan yɛli, Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina. Ka ŋun kani maa na mi chandi ŋmanila Jɛhu, Nimshi yaaŋa la, dama o chandi maa ŋmanila yinyaa.
en: The guard in the watchtower said, Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ taɣimiya yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma, ka deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka ŋun Yawɛ ni taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛn chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli paai ya maa polo.
en: So now transform your ways and actions. Obey the LORD your God, and the LORD may relent and not carry out the harm that hes pronounced against you.

dag: M mali n yɛtɔɣa shili, m mi ni bɛ ni wuhi ni n ka galimi.
en: I am ready to state my case, because I know I am in the right.

dag: ni Zadok ni Ahimaaz.
en: his son Zadok, and his son Ahimaaz.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi? Bee Kpiɔŋlan Naa nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi?.
en: God never twists justice; he never fails to do what is right.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya kpiɔŋ Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ ni ti n yuli jilima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and they will walk in his name, says the LORD.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ gbib niriba ŋɔ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Now give me wisdom and knowledge so that I can lead these people in the right way. No one could rule this great nation without your help.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Ti Duuma n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni.
en: The earth and all that is in it belong to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ zali zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo. Yi yuli ku lan beni. N ni wurim yi ni kpe binnan shɛŋa mini yi ni mali binnan shɛŋa zali yi buɣa duu puuni la. N ni gbi yi gbala, dama yi ka buchi.
en: The LORD has commanded concerning you: You will have no children to carry on your name. I will remove carved idol and cast image from the house of your gods; I will make your grave, for you are worthless.

dag: Doo maa ni daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi Yisifu yiŋa, ka ti ba kom ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka bo mɔri ti bɛ bunsi naai.
en: The servant took them into Joseph's house and gave them water to wash their feet. He also tended their donkeys.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata.
en: Jehoahaz was years old when he became king, and he ruled for three months in Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa kuli; ka salo daa lan laɣim o sani hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ bindirigu dibu.
en: Then Jesus went home. Again such a large crowd gathered that Jesus and his disciples had no time to eat.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba m-bɔŋɔ: Libini daŋ niriba mini Hiburɔn daŋ niriba ni Mahili daŋ niriba ni Mushi daŋ niriba ni Kɔra daŋ niriba. Amiram ba n-daa nyɛ Kɔhat.
en: Their descendants included the subclans of Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, and Korah. Kohath was the father of Amram.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani ŋun laɣim Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be yɔɣu la na ni laɣim zuliya shɛb na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: says the LORD God, who gathers Israels outcasts. I will gather still others to those I have already gathered.

dag: N yi chɛ a ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa maa taali, di ni chɛ ka a teei di yɛla ka di gar a, ka a ku lan yaag a noli a vi maa zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will forgive you, but you will think about your sins and be too ashamed to say a word. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti boli Yisifu n-zaŋ o sarika maa ni na yomyom; ka o daa pini o ninni ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-kpe Firawuna sani.
en: So Pharaoh summoned Joseph, and they quickly brought him from the dungeon. He shaved, changed clothes, and appeared before Pharaoh.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti kpɛri n jɛmbu duu, bɛna n-ni ti kani n sara maligu bimbini gbini na nti tumdi n tuma, ka doli n zaligunima.
en: They will enter my holy place and come near my table to serve me. They will take care of the things I gave them.

dag: Di viɛli gari salima, hal di viɛli gari salima alali; ka lan nyaɣisi gari shiri, ni shigbani din tɔɣiri shiri.
en: His teachings are worth more than pure gold. They are sweeter than the best honey dripping from the honeycomb.

dag: N ni bɔhim so shɛli din ka galimi yɛla. Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn ka n sanna? N ni mali biɛhigu din viɛla n suhu ni n yiŋa.
en: I will be careful to live a pure life. I will live in my house with complete honesty. When will you come to me?.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Zɔfai ni Nahat.
en: These are Ahimoth's descendants from generation to generation: Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kal ti pahi niɣi ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a lihi ti jɛra?.
en: Why do you think we are stupid, like dumb cows?.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Ka aŋgo zo maa vooi ko shɛli din leei wain maa ka bi baŋ di ni yi shɛli na, amaa yili maa ni bihi bɛn daa tooi kom maa bɛn daa mi. Ka o daa boli aŋgo na.
en: The headwaiter tasted the water that had become wine. He didnt know where it came from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. The headwaiter called the groom.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa wuna.
en: You must not follow other gods. You must not follow the gods of the people who live around you.

dag: Bakibukia mini Unno n-daa nyɛ bɛ tab bɛn ʒe n-tuhi ba laɣiŋgu maa ni.
en: The following formed the choir that sang the responses: Bakbukiah, Unno, and their fellow Levites.

dag: Yinim Lakishinima, zaŋmiya chɛchɛbunsi ga yuri, di daa nyɛla alahichi piligu Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga sani, dama a ni ka bɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim biriginsim.
en: You people living in Lachish, get the horses ready for your chariots. You are guilty of the same sins Israel committed, and you brought those sins to Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ nahim Izraɛlnim mini Judanima. Ka bɛn daa gbahi ba maa zaa kul gbib ba kirikiri, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: You Babylonians were cruel to Israel and Judah. You took them captive, and now you refuse to let them go.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sabimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛtɔɣa maa ka n zaŋ lo a mini Izraɛlnim alikauli.
en: The LORD said to Moses: Write down these words because by these words I hereby make a covenant with you and with Israel.

dag: Bɛ zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Ishimail bituuli n-daa nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt, bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-daa nyɛ: Kɛdar mini Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: These were their descendants. Ishmaels oldest son was Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa kul o yiŋa Samaria ni sujee ti fo n-ʒiya.
en: The king went back home to Samaria, worried and depressed.

dag: Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma yomyom! Leemi n ni sɔɣiri tampin shɛli gbini mini birini shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ din ni tiligi ma.
en: Listen closely to me! Deliver me quickly; be a rock that protects me; be a strong fortress that saves me!.

dag: Ka Musa daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: So Moses obeyed the Lord . He counted them all.

dag: Yi yi di be n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, n gba naan tooi yɛli kaman yi ni yɛri shɛm ŋɔ. N naan tooi yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa pam, ka vili n zuɣu niŋ ya.
en: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim maa bɛn tim bɛ suɣa gili alikauli suɣili maa n-gul li, ka Naawuni suhu ti ku yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: But the Levites will camp around the covenant dwelling so that Gods anger will not strike the Israelite community. The Levites will guard the covenant dwelling.

dag: Kɔhimiya yi ni mali shɛli n-zaŋ ti nandaamba pini; bomiya liɣiri kolibihi shɛŋa din bi kurigira n-sɔŋ azichi shɛli din ti ku naai Naawuni yili, tayiɣ ni ti ku be shɛli bee lɛla ni ti ku saɣim li luɣ shɛli.
en: Sell the things you have and give that money to those who need it. This is the only way you can keep your riches from being lost. You will be storing treasure in heaven that lasts forever. Thieves cant steal that treasure, and moths cant destroy it.

dag: Lihimi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba, ka bahi ninvuɣ biɛri yoli bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: all who are proud and evil.

dag: Yawɛ zal o nam ʒiishee la alizanda ni. O nyɛla naa ŋun su sokam zaa.
en: The Lord set his throne up in heaven, and he rules over everything.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɛsi daa ti yɛl o bia Dauda, Zaŋmi kawaan chimda kpalaŋ ŋɔ mini bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia ŋɔ chaŋ sansan maa ni yomyom ti ti a biɛyanima.
en: Jesse said to his son David, Please take your brothers an ephah of this roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread. Deliver them quickly to your brothers in the camp.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee kpalim ya.
en: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe Jɛrubaal malibu yim, o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la gba zuɣu.
en: The Israelites were not loyal to the family of Jerub-Baal , even though he had done many good things for them.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti leei shihirili be yi nuhi ni mini yi gbɛri zuɣu, dama Yawɛ daa zaŋla o yiko nuu yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: This ceremony will serve the same purpose as a sign on your hand or on your forehead to tell how the Lord 's mighty power rescued us from Egypt.

dag: M mali kpamdi zilinkom din viɛla mini yɛm maŋli. M mali tɛhi zilima, ka lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: I make plans and carry them out. I have understanding, and I am strong.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ daa kul timd anabinim bɛ sani waawaayili, dama o niriba maa mini ŋun Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la yɛla daa mal o nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord , the God of their ancestors, had continued to send prophets to warn his people, because he wanted to spare them and the Temple.

dag: Daba ni lihiri ŋun su ba ninni shɛm la, dab paɣa ni lihiri ŋun su o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ti kul lihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ninni, hal ni o ti zo ti nambɔɣu.
en: Just as the eyes of servants attend to their masters hand, just as the eyes of a female servant attend to her mistress hand— thats how our eyes attend to the LORD our God until he has mercy on us.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni yɛn kana ti tuhi Ijiptinim la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia came to attack Egypt, the Lord spoke to me. He said.

dag: Yisahaku daa yurila Iso, dama o daa yuri mɔɣu ni nimdi pam, ka Ribɛka mi daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: Esau would take the meat of wild animals to his father Isaac, so Isaac loved him more, but Jacob was his mother's favorite son.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Naawuni, N tum alahichi pam n ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛl mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali, dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: David said to God, I have committed a terrible sin in doing this! Please forgive me. I have acted foolishly.

dag: Miriya ka yi be kaman yi yaannim mini yi mabihi bɛn daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ yim, ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya naŋgbantom yi zaa ninni la.
en: Dont be like your fathers or your brothers. The Lord was their God, but they turned against him. So he made people hate them and speak evil about them. You can see with your own eyes that this is true.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, zaɣ biɛɣu kul lurila zuliya, zuliya zuɣu kanna, ka sanʒiɛ titali yiɣisi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛŋa polo katiŋ na.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, yimiya yi fɔntinsi ni chaŋ ti be tampima ni. Benya kaman ŋman so ŋun te o tiɛɣu vokabili noli ni la.
en: Now you must leave your towns and live like doves in the shelter of cliffs and canyons.

dag: Yinim bɛn tiligi tɔbu ni ŋɔ, chamiya, di lan guhiriya. Teemiya Yawɛ yɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ maa ni, ka chɛliya ka Jɛrusalɛm yɛla be yi suhuri ni.
en: You survivors of war, leave now; dont delay! Remember the LORD, from a faraway land. Keep Jerusalem alive in your hearts.

dag: Do so daa be Uzi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o yuli booni Ayuba. Doo maa daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Many years ago, a man named Job lived in the land of Uz. He was a truly good person, who respected God and refused to do evil.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures say, It is not just bread that keeps people alive. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Ka Asiria naa maa daa gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli Asiria nti zaŋ ba ʒili Hala mini Habɔr Mɔɣili duli din be Gɔzan yaɣili polo la ni Miidianim fɔntinsi ni.
en: The king of Assyria took the Israelites as prisoners to Assyria. He made them live in Halah, on the Habor , and in the cities of the Medes.

dag: Doo yi mali paɣiba ayi ka yuri yino ka bi yuri ŋun la, ka o ni yuri paɣ so maa min o ni bi yuri paɣ so maa zaa dɔɣ o bidibisi, ka o ni bi yuri paɣ so maa bidibiga n-nyɛ o bituuli.
en: Suppose a man has two wives and they both bear him sons, but the first son is not the child of his favorite wife.

dag: Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ tuumba? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ anabinima? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ karimbanima? Bɛ zaa n-tumd alahiziba tumtumsa?.
en: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.

dag: ka yɛl o suhu ni, Iso yi kana ti ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tooni ŋɔ, bɛn doli nyaaŋa la ni zo n-tiligi.
en: He thought, If Esau comes and attacks the first group, the other may be able to escape.

dag: di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛli ni m Ba ni pii man ninvuɣ so n-tim dunia ŋɔ ni na maa mɔri Naawuni, n ni yɛli ni n nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu?.
en: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.

dag: Yi daa lari Izraɛlnima, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba tayiɣisi ni maa zaa yoli, yi daa yi tɔɣisiri bɛ yɛla yi viinila yi zuɣuri.
en: You made fun of my people and treated them like criminals caught in the act.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ninvuɣ tusa ayopɔin bɛn zaa na bi gbani jɛm Baal bee n-zaŋ bɛ noya mɔɣis o kuɣa la Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But I have preserved those who remain in Israel, totaling seven thousand—all those whose knees havent bowed down to Baal and whose mouths havent kissed him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni ti zaŋmi yɛda niŋbu maa saɣim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Ti lee ʒiɛla di nyaaŋa.
en: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.

dag: Naawuni, bambua suhu ni ye kulibɔŋ ni kɔzɔrim zuɣu shɛm la, lala ka n gba suhu kul ye a zuɣu.
en: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.

dag: Nir yi bo n-nya azichi yomyom di dii bi nabira, amaa bɛn bɔri nyari li biɛlabiɛla, di nabirimi.
en: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni daa neei so kum ni maa ŋun daa bi pooi.
en: But this did not happen to the one whom God raised from death.

dag: Maɣipiash ni Mɛshulam so mi ni Hɛzir ni.
en: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir.

dag: ka o niriba ti baŋ tiliginsim ni nyɛ shɛli bɛ taali chɛ m-paŋ puuni.
en: to tell his people that they will be saved by having their sins forgiven.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kamina ka n ti a saɣisigu shɛli din ni chɛ ka a tooi tilig amaŋmaŋ min a bia Sulemaana nyɛviya.
en: You and your son Solomon are in danger, but I will tell you what to do to save yourself.

dag: Azuba ni daa ti kpi, Kalɛb daa kpuɣila Ɛfirat, ka o daa dɔɣi Hur.
en: After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who gave birth to Hur for him.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yihi waazu, ka pa ni bɛ tim ba mi? Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛn mali lahibal suŋ waazu na ni bɛ ti yihi ŋɔ paabuna tiri suhupiɛlli.
en: And how can the message be proclaimed if the messengers are not sent out? As the scripture says, How wonderful is the coming of messengers who bring good news.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ka galimi.
en: You deal faithfully with the faithful; you show integrity toward the one who has integrity.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba Jabɛshigiliadnim maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni yi ni daa wuhi yi ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi dan Naa Sool sani, ka sɔɣ o la zuɣu.
en: he sent messengers to the people of Jabesh-gilead. The LORD bless you, he said to them, for doing this loyal deed for your master Saul by burying him.

dag: O kul ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni saha shɛli zaa dɔro ŋɔ ni na be o ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni o yi kpaŋ ti be o ko.
en: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.

dag: dama Yawɛ zabiri bɛ zuɣu, ka ni ku bɛnkam bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: The Lord will argue their case for them and threaten the life of anyone who threatens theirs.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, m bi bɔri yi naɣikpahi ni naɣilahi bee yi buzɔna ni buhi.
en: I wont accept bulls from your house or goats from your corrals.

dag: Amaa bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ sɔŋdi Aduna bidibisi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni, ka maani di dundɔŋ mini di duri, ka paɣiri neen shɛŋa din be kasi la zaa, ka tumdi tuun shɛlikam din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma.
en: Their assignment was to be at the side of the Aaronites to serve in the LORDs temple, maintaining the courtyards and side rooms and cleansing all of the holy objects and doing whatever was needed in the service of Gods temple.

dag: ka o yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli baa din kuui ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Then Elisha said, This is what the Lord says: Dig holes in the valley.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: I assure you that all these things will happen while some of the people of this time are still living.

dag: Ka o daa lihi bɛn ʒi o sani maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he looked at the people sitting around him and said, These people are my mother and my brothers!.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi bebu be kaman dunia ŋɔ nim bebu, amaa chɛliya ka yi bebu zaa taɣi, yi tɛha ni leei tɛhi pala la zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ Naawuni yubu din nyɛ din viɛli mini din tiɣir o nini ni din be tibi la.
en: Dont be conformed to the patterns of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your minds so that you can figure out what Gods will is—what is good and pleasing and mature.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o saawaralana Ahuzat ni o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yi Gɛra chaŋ Yisahaku sani.
en: Abimelech came from Gerar with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army to see Isaac.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ninsal maa, Dim tihi din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: But the Lord told him, You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden.

dag: N ni ti ti maligumaaniba bindir suma, ka n niriba ti di m pina din galisi tiɣi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yihi wuntizɔriba bɛ zahimbu nyabu ni, ka lan mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka tuumbiɛrinim be tibidarigibo shee guli saria karibu dali.
en: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.

dag: Yi ni sab gbaŋ shɛli ti ma la, bɛ lɛbigi li karim wuhi ma.
en: The entire letter that you sent to us has been read in translation for me.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti mali zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni o simdi kum, o ni yɛli ni o nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu.
en: The crowd replied, He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei ka teeku maa kom maa lan nahi taba, ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛn zo n-yi dini, ka Yawɛ daai ba niŋ teeku maa bulli ni.
en: So just before daylight, Moses raised his hand over the sea. And the water rushed back to its proper level. The Egyptians were running as fast as they could from the water, but the Lord swept them away with the sea.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi zaa daa laɣimna. Bɛ tɔbbihi maa daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ galisim maa daa ti ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi gba daa galisi pam.
en: So the armies of all these kings came together. There were many fighting men and many horses and chariots. It was a very large army—it looked as if there were as many men as grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord , and he rescued you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul bɔrila din tuhi, ka mi kul ku chɛ o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim. O kul ni gul ba sahakam, amaa o ni kari ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bihi bahi.
en: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.

dag: dindina yin ŋmaam paɣa maa nuu, di zɔny o nambɔɣu.
en: show her no mercy; cut off her hand.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa yɛl o, Niŋm a ni tɛhi ni shɛli viɛl a sani, kul guhim hal ka bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili. Yawɛ chɛ ka o yɛligu niŋ pali. Ka Hanna daa kpalim yiŋa m-mal o bia maa hal ka o ti ŋmaai bihili.
en: Elkanah answered, All right, do whatever you think best; stay at home until you have weaned him. And may the Lord make your promise come true. So Hannah stayed at home and nursed her child.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinu saha ka Mɛnahɛm bia Pɛkahia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi.
en: In the fiftieth year of the reign of King Uzziah of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for two years.

dag: Ka bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔb tusaanu laasabu m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: There were about men there who ate. There were also women and children who ate.

dag: Ka a zaŋ binyɛra yɛli Aduna. Dina n-nyɛ: zabbanim mini alichɛbba ni binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni nyolɔrigu; ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛlɔrigu lo o.
en: Then dress Aaron in the priestly garments—the shirt, the robe that goes under the ephod, the ephod, the breastpiece, and the belt.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim Juda ni o daŋmi tooni ti yɛli Yisifu ka o wuhi ba soli din kuni Goshɛn; ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Israel had sent Judah ahead to Joseph so that Joseph could explain the way to Goshen. Then they arrived in the land of Goshen.

dag: Amaa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka bɛ daa lan puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Now at last, in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah, the Passover was celebrated in Jerusalem.

dag: O ni daa kul nya ba, ka o kɔre kpe bɛ ni, ka o tim tuumba bɛ sani Kalidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: As soon as she looked at them, she wanted to have sex with them. And so, she sent messengers to bring them to her.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched and dried up, because they did not have deep roots.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a nya ma ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.

dag: M mabihi ŋmarila ʒiri kaman kulibɔŋ kɔzɔrim la, bee kaman saa ni yi mi ka kom zɔri garita.
en: But you, my friends, you deceive me like streams that go dry when no rain comes.

dag: Ka Yawɛ kari niriba maa tahi katiŋa, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim zaɣ kuŋ.
en: The Lord will make the people go far away, and there will be large areas of empty land in the country.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira; ka m bi bɔri ni bɛ kuli ni kum, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti tarigi sol ni.
en: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.

dag: Di tuhiya ni a chɛ ka a kɔbilinina yam luɣilikam n-nyɛ kɔzɔrim be solɔri zuɣu?.
en: Children that you have by other women will do you no good.

dag: O gba daa zaŋ o puu kɔhi n-zaŋ di liɣiri ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: Joseph sold a field he owned. He brought the money and gave it to the apostles.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ʒini gbilligbilli: Shɛb kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi pihinunu.
en: They sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.

dag: Yi zuri yi mabihi nyaaŋa, ka zaŋdi yimaŋmaŋ mapuuni bihi taali.
en: You sit around, talking about your own siblings; you find fault with the children of your very own mother.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ti bahi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti? Bɛ ni gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bihi chaŋ; ti yi di lab Ijipti, di di bi so.
en: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ.
en: Then he asked, Whose picture is on the coin? And whose name is written on the coin.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba min o biɛyanim maa ʒili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmaai tiŋgban viɛlli Ramɛsis tiŋgban ni ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: Then Joseph settled his father and his brothers in Egypt, giving them property in the best of the land near the city of Rameses, as the king had commanded.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn naa Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia daa biɛra, amaa ka nya alaafee, ka o daa sab gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: At that time Merodach Baladan son of Baladan was king of Babylon. He sent some men with letters and a gift to Hezekiah when he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

dag: Yi pun mali din simdi ya zaa! Yi pun niŋ bundaannima! Yi di nam ka chɛ ti! N di bi zaɣisi ka yi shiri nyɛla nanima, ka ti di pahi yi zuɣu n-di yi nam maa!.
en: You think you have everything you need. You think you are rich. You think you have become kings without us. I wish you really were kings. Then we could rule together with you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn maa yuun pisaayika.
en: The Israelites were subject to Eglon for eighteen years.

dag: Amaa bɛn baɣa daa ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa ni bɛn daa chɛla bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri niŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Others, however, paid no attention to the Lord 's warning and left their slaves and animals out in the open.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka nuu teei tiri ma na, ka bɛ ni sabi gbaŋ shɛli kpabikpabi be di ni.
en: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.

dag: N yi zo n-du zuɣusaa, a be nimaani, ka n yi yɛrigi m bindoo sɔŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a be nimaani.
en: If I went up to heaven, you would be there. If I went down to the grave, you would be there too!.

dag: Niriba maa mini farigudeeriba ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni, dama bɛn daa pun deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani;.
en: Everyone who heard this, including the tax collectors, acknowledged Gods justice because they had been baptized by John.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi lee ŋmɛri maa.
en: Jesus asked them, What are you arguing about.

dag: ni bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ alahichinim nuu ni ka bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu, amaa ni di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni la.
en: The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life. .

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa bɔhi bɔhigu shɛlikam min o ni daa zaŋ yɛlimuɣisir shɛlikam na puuni, nachimbih anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn mi di yɛla paai siɣimsiɣim bu pii zuɣu n-gari timlan kam bee saŋmaribaŋda kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: Every time the king asked them about something important, they showed great wisdom and understanding. The king found they were ten times better than all the magicians and wise men in his kingdom.

dag: Iso bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlifaz mini Riuɛl ni Jɛushi ni Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: Esaus family: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Yi yɛda niŋbu bi yaɣi lala.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, Why are you frightened? Do you still have no faith.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti wumya ni Izraɛl nanim nyɛla nambɔzɔriba, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ buri so, ka zaŋ gabisi n-kaŋka n-vili ti zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl Naa maa sani, di pa shɛli ka o tilig a nyɛvili.
en: His officials went to him and said, We have heard that the Israelite kings are merciful. Give us permission to go to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our necks, and maybe he will spare your life.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ba ni bɛ deem kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa balim Pita ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: He directed that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they invited Peter to stay for several days.

dag: ni Shimia ni Hagia ni Asaaya.
en: his son Shimea, his son Haggiah, and his son Asaiah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti mali jɛma shili, di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zani bɛ zaashɛhi, ka Lɛvinim mi daa piripiri taba zani kaman naa ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: When everything was ready to celebrate Passover, the priests and the Levites stood where Josiah had told them.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla Iso bidibisi , bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ nanima.
en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their tribal chiefs.

dag: Ya ka zabili mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zaa lee yina nti be yi sunsuuni? Pa yi niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim bɔbu din be yi niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-zabiri la ni ka di yina?.
en: Do you know where your fights and arguments come from? They come from the selfish desires that make war inside you.

dag: Di nyɛnya gbinnyaɣinima, amaa lee tummiya ni yi suhuri zaa, ka jɛmmiya ti Duuma.
en: Dont hesitate to be enthusiastic—be on fire in the Spirit as you serve the Lord!.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ puuni ti viɛla din nyɛ paain mini junipa ni sipirɛs dari n-kana ti mali n jɛmbu duu ka di viɛla, ka ti chɛ ka n naba tambu shee mali jilima.
en: Lebanons glory will come upon you, cypress, elm, and pine, to glorify the site of my sanctuary, and I will honor my royal footstool.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Do so ŋun yɛl ti lala maa yɛla biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ gbaŋ lo o shee ni. Ka o yɛli, Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la m-bala.
en: He was wearing a cloak made of animal skins, tied with a leather belt, they answered. It's Elijah! the king exclaimed.

dag: Amaa yum yi na be o niŋgbuŋ ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: But if the skin is raw, that person is not clean.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n yɛn zaŋla nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam ka di nyɛ yi naa sun ya.
en: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger.

dag: Ka Jɔsia daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa Izraɛl nanim ni daa me n-zali Samaria n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi la zaa kaman o ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbina la shɛm la.
en: In every city of Israel King Josiah tore down all the pagan places of worship which had been built by the kings of Israel, who thereby aroused the Lord 's anger. He did to all those altars what he had done in Bethel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sabimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛtɔɣa maa ka n zaŋ lo a mini Izraɛlnim alikauli.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Write these words down, because it is on the basis of these words that I am making a covenant with you and with Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kul kpe Samaria puuni, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem niriba ŋɔ nina n-chɛ ka bɛ nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei bɛ nina maa, ka bɛ lihi nya ka bɛ bela Samaria puuni.
en: When they arrived at Samaria, Elisha said, Lord , open the eyes of these men so that they can see. Then the Lord opened their eyes, and the Aramean army saw they were in the city of Samaria!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa goog o yɛl o, Kpalimmi ya ŋɔ n-gbe ti sani, dama wuntaŋ luya ka yuŋ zibira. Ka o daa doli ba kpe bɛ yiŋa.
en: But they wanted him to stay. They begged him, Stay with us. Its almost night. Theres hardly any daylight left. So he went in to stay with them.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, yinima n-tum tuumbiɛri ŋɔ zaa, amaa di zaa yoli, di ŋmaligiya ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu, amaa kul jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: Don't be afraid, Samuel answered. Even though you have done such an evil thing, do not turn away from the Lord , but serve him with all your heart.

dag: ni Iddo bia Ahinadab ŋun daa be Mahanaim la.
en: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of the territory of Mahanaim.
