dag: Amaa ka sapashin la daa bɔri ni o tiligi Pool ka gɔŋ ba ni bɛ di niŋ lala, ka naɣ yɛli ba mi ni bɛn mi kɔduɣili, bɛn lum kom maa ni n-daŋ duɣi du.
en: But the army officer wanted to save Paul, so he stopped them from doing this. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump overboard first and swim ashore;.

dag: din yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni la: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn ni di chɛ ka niriba tuui li; di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Amaa ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: just as God says in the Scriptures, Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yuli ni ka ti sɔŋsim yirina.
en: Our help came from the Lord , the one who made heaven and earth!.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan gbaag o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu mini ʒiŋmabo.
en: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.

dag: Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once.

dag: Ka Asirianim gba pahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka Lɔt zuliya nya yaa.
en: Assyria too has joined them— they are the strong arm for Lots children. Selah.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Manɔa suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka Naawuni malaika maa lan lab paɣ maa sanna saha shɛl o ni daa yi mɔɣ kpaŋ ti ʒiya. Amaa o yidan Manɔa daa ka o sani.
en: God heard Manoahs prayer. The angel of God came to the woman again. She was sitting in a field and her husband Manoah was not with her.

dag: N zaligu maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yumiya taba kaman n ni yuri ya shɛm.
en: My commandment is this: love one another, just as I love you.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba ni ʒirinim maa kpi n-kpe gbala ni, ka bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni yuusim pirigili na bi paai gba. Amaa nyini ka man kul ni niŋ naani.
en: But you, O God, will bring those murderers and liars to their graves before half their life is over. As for me, I will trust in you.

dag: Naawuni ni deei binshɛlikam zaa ti ba sani maa nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini; dinzuɣu Naawuni ni yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm li.
en: All this wealth which God has taken from our father belongs to us and to our children. Do whatever God has told you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi yihiri waazu yɛri ni Masia daa neei kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka yi ni shɛb yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani?.
en: We tell everyone that Christ was raised from death. So why do some of you say that people will not be raised from death?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu n-da Samaria daboli Shɛmɛr sani m-me tiŋ tam di zuɣu, ka boli di yuli Samaria ŋ-ŋmahindi Shɛmɛr ŋun daa su daboli maa yuli.
en: and then he bought the hill of Samaria for six thousand pieces of silver from a man named Shemer. Omri fortified the hill, built a town there, and named it Samaria, after Shemer, the former owner of the hill.

dag: O daa zaɣis o biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ tanti du shɛl ni o ni daa be ninsalinim sunsuuni la.
en: He abandoned his tent in Shiloh, the home where he had lived among us.

dag: N ni zaŋ sara maligu shɛŋa ti ni mali nyɔri buɣim la n-ka a jɛmbu duu na; n ni zaŋ binshɛŋa n ni po pɔri ni n zaŋ ti a la ti a;.
en: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe, di simdi ni bɛ mini naa kpe, ka bɛ yi ti lan yɛn yi, di simdi ni bɛ min o yi.
en: Their ruler will come in at the same time they do and leave at the same time they leave.

dag: Zomiya yi ʒiri ŋmabu ni, yi mi miriya ka yi ku ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli ka nyɛ ŋun ka taali, dama m pala ŋun ni chɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tum taali.
en: Stay away from making a false charge. Dont put an innocent person who is in the right to death, because I will not consider innocent those who do such evil.

dag: Ka o nyintaa daa yi kur o suli pam n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisira, Yawɛ ni daa bi ti o bia maa zuɣu.
en: Peninnah liked to make Hannah feel miserable about not having any children.

dag: Bɛ chanila gbala ni yuŋ ti buɣiri kpiimba baɣiri, ka ŋubiri kuruchunim nimdi; ka piɛbiri buɣa maligu nimdi bim.
en: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti, dama ti niŋ yɛda ni ti ka galimi ti suhuri tɛha ni; ka di nyɛla ti ni bɔri ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka di tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm o na.
en: Jesus answered, You people today have no faith. Your lives are so wrong! How long must I stay with you? How long must I continue to be patient with you? Bring the boy here.

dag: N nya yɛl biɛ shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di nyɛ din ʒi daadamnim zuɣu.
en: I have seen another thing in this life that is not fair and is very hard to understand.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Yaakubu, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini Bɛtɛl, ka me sara maligu bimbini zali man Naawuni ŋun daa yi a zuɣu saha shɛli a ni daa yi a biɛli Iso sani zɔri la.
en: God said to Jacob, Go to the town of Bethel. That is where I appeared to you when you were running away from your brother Esau. Live there and make an altar to honor me as El, the God who appeared to you.

dag: Masia Naawunitali yiko chɛ ka ti nya binshɛɣukam zaa din simdi ni ti zaŋ mali nyɛvili mini biɛhigu din luri Naawuni sizuura, ŋuna ŋun bol ti o jilima min o zaɣisuntali baŋbu puuni la zuɣu.
en: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.

dag: A ni ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, ka lihir a ninni la suhudo maŋli, bɛ ni niŋ a naani zuɣu.
en: God, you give true peace to people who depend on you, to those who trust in you.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣisi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb tintariga polo nti ʒini Kadɛshi mini Shur sunsuuni; ka daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ ti be Gɛra.
en: Abraham left that place and traveled to the Negev. He settled in the city of Gerar, between Kadesh and Shur. While in Gerar.

dag: Niriba kul pɔrila pɔri, ka ŋmari ʒiri, ka kuri niriba, ka zura, ka niŋdi zina. Bɛ baɣa lan ka shɛlikam ni, kubu n-naɣ kul beni.
en: Swearing, lying, murder, together with stealing and adultery are common; bloody crime followed by bloody crime.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi zaɣis a zaligu dolibu di chɛrimi ka n suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: But Im seized with anger because of the wicked— because of those who abandon your Instruction.

dag: Ti yi be, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti be; ka ti yi kpi, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpi; dinzuɣu ti yi bemi bee ti yi kpimi, ti Duuma n-su ti.
en: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.

dag: Musa daa pun tila Manaasa zuliya pirigili daŋ niriba la tiŋgbani Bashan, ka Jɔshua mi daa ti bɛ mabihi bɛn kpalim la tiŋgbani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo la. Jɔshua ni daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka bahi ba ni bɛ kuli maa, ka o daa lan yɛli ba.
en: Moses had given the land of Bashan to half of the Manasseh tribe. Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan River to the other half of the Manasseh tribe. Joshua blessed them and sent them home.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yiko niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kana ti tum tuma maa zaa na.
en: Moses then called together Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had given skill and who was eager to come and do the work.

dag: ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo na la.
en: He gathered his people together from many different countries. He brought them from east and west, north and south.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbaai Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn zaɣisi ma bɛ buɣa zuɣu la suhuri.
en: This is because I want to touch their hearts. I want to show them that I love them, even though they left me for their filthy idols.

dag: ni bɛ ni je paɣ so yi kuli doo ni dab paɣisarili ŋun zan o lana ŋun nyɛ paɣa zaani.
en: at a detested woman when she gets married and a female servant when she replaces her mistress.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka naa zali zaligu kpeeni maa yomyom lala? Ka Ariok daa kahigi yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm yɛli Daniɛl.
en: he asked Arioch why the king had issued such a harsh order. So Arioch told Daniel what had happened.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya; ka fiig tihi vari suui. Ka pumpɔrinchihi tihi mini kpikpal tihi ni apil tihi ni tihi balibu kam zaa kuui. Ka suhupiɛlli din be niriba sani naai.
en: The grapevine is dried up; the fig tree withers. Pomegranate, palm, and apple— all the trees of the field are dried up. Joy fades away from the people.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bindila gɔhi mini mɔri din ka buchi, dindina Naawuni ni yɛli noli ti li, ka buɣim di li.
en: But if it produces thorns and thistles, its useless and close to being cursed. It ends up being burned.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu n-nam ninsala, ka vuhi nyɛvili vuhim niŋ o nyee ni; ka ninsal leei ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: Then the Lord God took some soil from the ground and formed a man out of it; he breathed life-giving breath into his nostrils and the man began to live.

dag: N daa ko ʒiɛri puri mini tihi puri, ka tiwala balibu kam tihi be di ni.
en: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab Galili tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna din nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kom leei wain la. Ka gomnanti tuma zuɣulan so bidibiga ŋun daa be Kapɛrinium biɛra.
en: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.

dag: Ka o daa mal litaafi bil shɛli ka di kpabigi be o nuu ni, ka o zaŋ o nudirigu napɔŋ zali teeku ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa napɔŋ mi zali duli.
en: He held an open scroll in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

dag: Di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋsim ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul lihirila tiŋgbɔŋ maa viɛnyɛliŋga yuuni piligu ni hal ni di naabu ni.
en: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: And you, too, must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you are not expecting him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri ya, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri daadam ŋun ni kpi ŋɔ dabiɛm? Daadam ŋmanila mɔri, o kul ku beni sahakam.
en: I, I am the one who comforts you. Why should you fear humans who will die, mortals who are treated like grass?.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kuhiri pampam yi ni nya dan shɛli maa zuɣu? Yi biɛrim maa ka tibbu. Yi taali ni galisi pam, ka yi daalahichi galisi yaɣi ka n niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu.
en: Israel and Judah, why are you still crying about your wound? There is no cure for it. I did this to you because of your great guilt. I did this because of your many sins.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri gba daa zo ka chɛ niriba pam ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia! Alizin biɛri maa daa mi ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia, dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa tahiri bɛ zuɣu ka bi tiri ba soli ni bɛ yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: Demons went out of many people and shouted, You are the Son of God! But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.

dag: Wain nyɛla ansarisimaana, ka dam din kpɛma mi nyɛ vuyɔra, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka di kpɛh o yɔɣu nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Wine and beer make people lose control; they get loud and stumble around. And that is foolish.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛndana saɣisigu, di so ni o wum jɛrigu yila.
en: It is better to be criticized by the wise than praised by the foolish.

dag: dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili paaya, ka ŋuni n-ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li.
en: The great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to stand.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa lan yɛli Izraɛl naa maa, Daŋ bɔhi baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm pɔi.
en: But, Jehoshaphat said to Israels king, first, lets see what the LORD has to say.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din bi tu kamaata yi saria karibu ni bee binyɛra wɔɣilim buɣisibu ni bee di tibisim zahimbu ni bee di galisim zahimbu ni.
en: Do not cheat anyone by using false measures of length, weight, or quantity.

dag: Bɛn daŋ niriba galisi, nyin pirigim pal titali ti ba, ka bɛn mi daŋ niriba pɔra, nyin pirigim palo din pɔri ti ba. Tim daŋ kam niriba bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli kaman bɛ ni sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: so the larger tribes have more land than the smaller ones.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Aai, n nyɛla Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, dina n-chɛ ka n kana maa. Ka Jɔshua daa lu n-gbani zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura ka bɔh o, N dana, ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ niŋ.
en: Neither, the man answered. I am here as the commander of the Lord 's army. Joshua threw himself on the ground in worship and said, I am your servant, sir. What do you want me to do.

dag: Ʒe tibi a ni doli so shɛli ni, ka a soya zaa ni mali viɛla.
en: Watch your feet on the way, and all your paths will be secure.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa daa kuhi pam yɛl li Judanim yɛligu ni bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim bɛn daa tam goondaa zuɣu la ha ni bɛ varisi ba kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, ka ŋme n-deei bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: Then they shouted loudly in Hebrew at the people of Jerusalem gathered on the wall, in an attempt to frighten and demoralize them, in order to capture the city.

dag: Dama nir niŋdila yɛda o suhu ni, ka yi taali ni Naawuni sani; ka yaag o noli kahigi wuhi palɔni, ka tiligi.
en: For it is by our faith that we are put right with God; it is by our confession that we are saved.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, A nyaya viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n lihirimi ni n nya ka n yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: The Lord said to me, You have seen very well, and I am watching to make sure that my message to you comes true.

dag: Ilaisha kum dɔro ni daa ti gbaag o saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ o sani nti ʒi o tooni kumdi yɛra, M ba! M ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi ni di wɔribariba.
en: Now Elisha became sick with the illness that would kill him. So Israels King Joash went down to see him. Joash cried over Elisha, saying, Oh, my father, my father! Israels chariots and its riders.

dag: Ka niriba maa mini bɛ malibu zaa daa yina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni kumda, ka Musa daa wum bɛ kumsi maa; ka Yawɛ suhi daa yiɣisi pam, ka di daa bi niŋ Musa nyaɣisim.
en: Moses heard all the people complaining as they stood around in groups at the entrances of their tents. He was distressed because the Lord had become angry with them.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti chaŋ ti be azaaba din ka bahigu ni; amaa ka wuntizɔriba la bɛn ti kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu ni.
en: Then these evil people will go away to be punished forever. But the godly people will go and enjoy eternal life.

dag: bee so yi tum alahichi ka baŋ ni o tum taali, di simdi ka o labis o ni zu shɛli bee o ni fa shɛli bee bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli puh o zalibu maa bee o ni pihi binshɛli.
en: When this happens, you must return what doesn't belong to you.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yɛli ŋun su bɛ kpariti biɛhigu shee fukumsi, Zaŋm kpariti na nti ti Baal jɛmdiba maa zaa. Ka o daa zaŋ kpariti maa na nti ti ba.
en: Then Jehu ordered the priest in charge of the sacred robes to bring the robes out and give them to the worshipers.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ya dabitim bandi ni.
en: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o bɔri ni yi nabi ka tɔŋ la, lala ka di ni lan niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o chɛ ka yi lu m-bahi yoli zaa, ka bɛ ti yihi ya yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti deei li su maa ni.
en: Just as the Lord took delight in making you prosper and in making you increase in number, so he will take delight in destroying you and in bringing ruin on you. You will be uprooted from the land that you are about to occupy.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul kpaai bɛ nina kpa zuɣusaa lihir o ni chani maa ha, ka bɛ nya ka niriba ayi ye binyɛr piɛla ʒe bɛ sani ka bɔhi ba.
en: While he was going away and as they were staring toward heaven, suddenly two men in white robes stood next to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam mi zaɣ suŋ tumbu ka bi tum li, di nyɛla alahichi o sani.
en: If you fail to do what you know is right, you are sinning.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ buhi kɔbiri wuɣi tana piniyini n-zaŋ li pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Then the workers made another tent to cover the Holy Tent. They used goat hair to make eleven curtains.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba maa yi kamina ni bɛ ti bol a, nyin yiɣisim doli ba chaŋ; amaa kul niŋmila n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: God came to Balaam in the night and said to him, If the men have come to summon you, arise and go with them. But you must do only what I tell you to do.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan laɣim ka Rɛfaim vinvamli maa ni na ti doya yaha.
en: Then the Philistines went back to Rephaim Valley and occupied it again.

dag: Masia yurilim n-gbibi ti, dama ti tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ yino yi daa kpi sokam zaa zuɣu, dindina sokam zaa kpimi m-bala.
en: The love of Christ controls us, because we know that one person died for everyone. So all have died.

dag: Shi yino maa n-lan tiri so yɛda niŋbu pini, ka tiri so dɔriti tibbu pina;.
en: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick.

dag: A kari ma saria ka di doli soli; a ʒini nam ʒiishee n-kari ma saria, ka nya ka m-mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba na ti yɛli ba, Saha shɛli din gari la puuni, yi daa kul bɔri ni Naa Dauda n-leei yi naa.
en: Abner then sent word to Israels elders. Youve wanted David to be your king for some time now, he said.

dag: Ti leela kpibisi bɛn ka banima; ti manim nyɛla pakoya.
en: We are like children whose mothers are widows.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.

dag: A ni ti yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Juda nanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu kpe ŋɔ, ka ŋunkam ti wum di yɛla tiba ni vura.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N sa zahimla zahindi ka di yɛla muɣisi ma pam ka m bɔri ni m baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: and said, I am disturbed by a dream that I don't understand, and I want you to explain it.

dag: ka zaŋ a nubil suɣi naɣilaa maa ʒim n-zaŋ niŋ sara maligu bimbini binyila la; ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la lɔŋni.
en: Take some of the bull's blood and with your finger put it on the projections of the altar. Then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Mɔabnim dindali maa, ka nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinii.
en: So on that day the Israelites began to rule over the Moabites, and there was peace in the land for years.

dag: Ti ni daa bi tooi yih o di ni maa ka ti chɛ o ka yɛli, Ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmi lala.
en: Since we could not get Paul to change his mind, we gave up and prayed, Lord, please make us willing to do what you want.

dag: Niŋmi ba kaman buɣim ni diri nyɔŋ shɛm la, bee kaman buɣim niɛm ni taari diri zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Be like a fire that destroys a forest or like a flame that sets the hills on fire.

dag: A yi niŋ Naawuni ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ, dindina a wumsim maa ni baligi. Ka niriba ŋɔ zaa ni lab bɛ biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: If you do this, as God commands, you will not wear yourself out, and all these people can go home with their disputes settled.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zalila niriba tɔto ka bɛ tɔhi, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma bɛ nuu ni m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min omaŋmaŋ nam yili ni Millo ni Jɛrusalɛm gooni, ni Hazɔr ni Mɛgido ni Gɛza.
en: After Solomon's workers had finished the temple and the palace, he ordered them to fill in the land on the east side of Jerusalem, to build a wall around the city, and to rebuild the towns of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni Naawuni yɛligu kɔŋla palibu, dama pa bɛn zaa yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Izraɛl yaan maŋa.
en: But its not as though Gods word has failed. Not all who are descended from Israel are part of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pah o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli Sinai Zoli gbin la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord made an agreement with the Israelites at Mount Horeb. In addition to that agreement, he also commanded Moses to make another agreement with them while they were in Moab. This is that agreement.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kul pahirila baŋsim mini zoosim, ka mali zuɣu pam Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.

dag: Ka ti ba maa daa ti lan yɛli ti, Labimiya ti da bindira biɛla ti ti na.
en: Our father told us, Go back and buy for us a little food.

dag: N ni puh a salo laɣiŋgu ni; n shiri ni paɣ a salo ni.
en: Then I will thank you in the great assembly; I will praise you in a huge crowd of people.

dag: Amaa ka timanim gba daa niŋ tabibi n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But the magicians used magic, and they also made frogs come up on the land.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli fukumsi zaligunim ni be, ka bɛn lihi ʒiɛm li ni kpi.
en: Those who keep the commandment preserve their lives; those who disregard their ways will die.

dag: Benya ni suhu yini ni taba; di lihiya ʒiɛm so, amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tabili tarimba; di kuuniya yi baŋsim.
en: Have the same concern for everyone. Do not be proud, but accept humble duties. Do not think of yourselves as wise.

dag: Ka Adɔram daa nyɛ ŋun su tumtumdiba fukumsi; ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat daa nyɛ ŋun su gbana sabbu fukumsi.
en: Adoram was in charge of the forced labor; Ahiluds son Jehoshaphat was the recorder.

dag: Ka daba ayɔbu dali bɛ ni tooi pihi daba ayi dibu tariga na ti duɣi.
en: On the sixth day, when they measure out what they have collected, it will be twice as much as they collected on other days.

dag: N daa lihi dunia ni n-nya ka di bahila yoli, ka binshɛli lan ka di ni, ka n lihi zuɣusaa, ka neesim kani.
en: I looked at the earth, and it was without shape or form; at the heavens and there was no light.

dag: Bɛ ni mali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu soli ti wuntizɔriba, ka ŋunkam zaa be tibi o suhu ni ni dol li.
en: Justice will again be found in the courts, and all righteous people will support it.

dag: Di simdi ni yi teei anab suma ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-zal la mini ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira zaligu shɛl o ni zaŋ ti yi tuumba la ni be zaŋ yɛli ya la yɛla.
en: I want you to remember the words that were spoken long ago by the holy prophets, and the command from the Lord and Savior which was given you by your apostles.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku piɛguliba mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku pukpariba mini bɛ naɣikɔra. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku gomnanim mini bɛ wulaannima.
en: I used you to smash shepherds and flocks. I used you to smash farmers and oxen. I used you to smash governors and important officials.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi liɣiri yi naai, yin zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbiri na ti taɣi bindirigu.
en: But Joseph answered, Give me your cattle, and I will give you food.

dag: Yi ni ŋubiri mo viɛla ŋɔ di bi saɣi? Ka wula ka yi lan nɔri mo shɛŋa din kpalim ŋɔ sɔŋdi tiŋa? Yi yi nyu ko viɛlli, di lan kpami ni yi zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli din kpalim?.
en: You can eat the grass growing on the good land. So why do you also crush the grass that other sheep want to eat? You can drink plenty of clear water. So why do you also stir the water that other sheep want to drink?.

dag: O yɛla ka Anabi Aizaia daa sabi yɛl la. O daa yɛlimi: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: John is the one Isaiah the prophet was talking about when he said, There is someone shouting in the desert: Prepare the way for the Lord. Make the road straight for him. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka bɛ yi bɔh a, Bɔzuɣu ka a ŋuhira? nyin yɛlim ba, Lahibali shɛli din kana ŋɔ zuɣu. Sokam suhu ni saɣim, ka bɛ bɔɣiri chɔɣisi, ka bɛ tarigi, ka bɛ duna ni chɔɣisi. Nyama di nyɛla din kanna, ka ni niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When they ask why you are groaning, tell them you have terrifying news that will make them faint and tremble in fear and lose all courage. These things will happen soon. I, the Lord God, make this promise!.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi alahichi, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu.
en: When the righteous turn from their righteousness to do wrong, they will die because of it.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa kpe di puuni nti bi nya ti Duuma Yisa niŋgbuŋ;.
en: They went in, but they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛmani maa ni ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka Jɛhoyakim daa zaŋ omaŋ ti o n-jɛm o yuma ata; di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti zaɣis o jɛmbu.
en: During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded and took control of Judah. Jehoiakim obeyed Nebuchadnezzar for three years, but then he rebelled.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum yi tuma zaa.
en: Work six days a week and do your job.

dag: Faralan bi tuuli ni di, ka nandan dɔni ni alaafee, amaa n ni chɛ ka kum ku yi bihi, ka ku yi puuni bɛn kpalim.
en: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum ʒiɛyimtali tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanima n-teei gili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntiŋ shɛŋa la, ka tɛhiri ni o ni di nasara ka zaŋ ba leeg o niriba.
en: After these things and these faithful acts, Assyrias King Sennacherib invaded Judah and attacked its fortified cities, intending to capture them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Naawuni, ti puhir a ka paɣir a yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ.
en: And now, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

dag: A yi tarigi yɛl biɛɣu nyabu dali, a yaa m-pun bi galisi.
en: If you are weak in times of trouble, that is real weakness.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi lihi nya ka bɛ ni she mahi kpil shɛli kuɣ tula zuɣu mini kɔgaɣili n-ʒe o zuɣu polo. Ka o daa di ka nyu, ka lan lab dɔni.
en: He looked around and saw a loaf of bread and a jar of water near his head. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka yihi Juda zuliya mini Simiɔn zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti ni boli tin shɛŋa yuya ŋɔ tinsi shɛŋa ti ba.
en: All the towns were chosen with the Lord 's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, dɔbba gba daa tumdila dagɔr tuma bɛ buɣa maa malibu shee. Judanim daa tum din chihiri shɛlikam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Yawɛ ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa kana ti ʒini maa ni daa tumdi la.
en: Moreover, the consecrated workers in the land did detestable things, just like those nations that the LORD had removed among the Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, N dana, di darigi ti tibili, ti ni tum jɛrilim ka tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: Then Aaron said to Moses, Oh, my master, please dont punish us for the sin that we foolishly committed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Gazanim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋgbɔn muni niriba chaŋ ti ti Ɛdomnima ka bɛ zaŋ ba leei daba.
en: The Lord says, The people of Gaza have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They carried off a whole nation and sold them as slaves to the people of Edom.

dag: Dama a pala Naawuni ŋun yu gala tumbu, a mi mini zaɣ biɛɣu bi kpɛra.
en: Because you arent a God who enjoys wickedness; evil doesnt live with you.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kari ninvuɣ biɛri bahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: The wicked will be destroyed, but those who call to the Lord for help will get the land he promised.

dag: O chɛ ka kɔbulli ni kom gbirigiri kaman duɣu ni ka di be la; o chɛ ka teeku bemi kaman kpaʒiɛrim m-be duɣu ni la.
en: He churns up the sea like boiling water and makes it bubble like a pot of oil.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ wɔɣirili ŋun be ninvuɣ pihita la ni, ka nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. O bia Amizabad n-daa nyɛ ŋun zan o zaani n-su o niriba maa fukumsi.
en: This Benaiah was a warrior of the Thirty and in command of the Thirty. In command of his division was his son Ammizabad.

dag: Di yi nyɛla Pool bee Apolɔs bee Pita bee dunia ŋɔ bee nyɛvili bee kum bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ bee dahin shɛli ha yɛla, di zaa ha nyɛla yi dini;.
en: Paul, Apollos, Cephas, the world, life, death, things in the present, things in the future—everything belongs to you.

dag: Yawɛ, zanimi n nyaaŋa ni n ka taali; dama galimi ka m biɛhigu ni. N niŋ Yawɛ naani ka bi tiriti gbini.
en: Show that I am right, Lord ! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl bituuli ŋun yuli daa booni Rubin la daa dɔɣi bidibis anahi; Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya ni kpamba.
en: Reuben, Jacob's first-born, had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; they were the ancestors of the clans that bear their names.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni yi Shɛfam maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ribila din be Ain wulimpuhili polo la, ka tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku din be wulimpuhili polo la naɣiliŋga ni.
en: The border will descend from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain. The border will go down and meet the eastern slope of the Galilee Sea.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yɛl o, Di yi kpe chaŋ ti liri ba, amaa gilim bɛ nyaaŋa chaŋ ti liri ba tulaale tihi la tooni polo.
en: David prayed to the Lord again and got this answer: Dont go up the valley. Go around them to the other side of their army. Attack them from the other side of the balsam trees.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Di pala yɛlimaŋli, yɛlim ti o ni yɛli shɛm. Ka o yɛli ba, O yɛli ma mi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa. .
en: Thats a lie! they said. Come on, tell us! Jehu replied, This is what he said to me: This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king of Israel.

dag: M pun pirigi n situra, n lan zaŋm li so yaha? M pun paɣi n naba, n lan niŋmi n-chɛ ka di daɣi?.
en: I have taken off my robe. I dont want to put it on again. I have washed my feet. I dont want to get them dirty again.

dag: Ka bɛn daa mali Pool tahiri maa daa zaŋ o hal ti paai Atɛnsi, ka Pool yɛli ba ni bɛ yi lab kuli bɛn yɛlimi Silas mini Timoti ni bɛ yi nya soli bɛn paam o na yomyom. Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: Those who went with Paul took him to the city of Athens. They returned with a message for Silas and Timothy to come and join him as soon as they could.

dag: Ka sana yi be yi ni, ka bɔri ni o puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, ŋun doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa kaya mini di zaligu soli puhi li. Yinim tiŋbihi mini saamba bɛn be yi ni zaa doliya zaligu yini.
en: If foreigners living among you want to keep the Passover, they must observe it according to all the rules and regulations. The same law applies to everyone, whether native or foreigner.

dag: M bi sabila yɛtɔɣa pihita ti a ni di ti a saɣisigu mini baŋsim.
en: I have written down thirty sayings for you. They contain knowledge and good advice.

dag: Ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ a yuli kana nti tɔɣisi ti nanim mini ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim zaŋ tabili ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa la yɛligu.
en: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.

dag: Ka o tiba maa dii yooi, ka o zilinli lɛbigi ka o dii gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: At once the man was able to hear, his speech impediment was removed, and he began to talk without any trouble.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, A tizo pun kana ti yɔhim ma deeg a daalibarika.
en: Isaac answered, Your brother tricked me and stole your blessing.

dag: Di saha ka kpambaliba maa daa yɛli Baruk, Cham ka a mini Jɛrimia ti sɔɣi, ka di chɛnya ka so baŋ yi ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: Then the royal officials said to Baruch, You and Jeremiah must go and hide. Dont tell anyone where you are hiding.

dag: Amaa o yi zaŋ omaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka di wuhi ni o ka daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ŋun lan cham maligumaana maa sani yaha.
en: But if the rash spreads over the skin after the person has shown himself to the priest to be made clean again, that person must come again to the priest.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi nyɛla Sintani nira, dama piligu ni ha ka Sintani pun tumd alahichi. Ka daliri din chɛ ka Naawuni Bia daa kana nyɛla ni o ti saɣim Sintani tuma.
en: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o tɔbbihi zaa Tɛlaim na nti kali ba, ka bɛ tinchandiba kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyi, ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Saul called out the troops and counted them at Telaim: two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand more troops from Judah.

dag: Man Klɔdius Lisias n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ m-puhiri n dan Gomna Filiksi.
en: Claudius Lysias, to the most honorable Governor Felix: Greetings.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o boli; ka o ni boli shɛb maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani; ka o ni chɛ ka shɛb yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya o jilima.
en: Those who God decided in advance would be conformed to his Son, he also called. Those whom he called, he also made righteous. Those whom he made righteous, he also glorified.

dag: Bɛ ni yino ni daa nya ka o kɔŋ maa naai maa ka o ŋmaligi labiri ka duhir o yee paɣiri Naawuni m-mal.
en: One of them, when he saw that he had been healed, returned and praised God with a loud voice.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu, nyini n-nyɛ n jilima, ka chɛ ka n zuɣu ʒe ya.
en: But you, Lord , protect me. You bring me honor; you give me hope.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi ba ni bɛ zabbanim yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee Kpaŋa kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: So they went forward and carried Nadab and Abihu out by their tunics to a place outside the camp, just as Moses had ordered.

dag: A chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi n sani guui, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You made my enemies turn and run away. I destroyed those who hated me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ziɔn paɣiba nyɛla karimbaannima, bɛ duhila bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa chani lihiri kɔre lihigu. Bɛ yaarila bɛ naba n-nɔri nyamnyam sarisiri chana.
en: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kahiri tandi nɛma n-tiri daa zaŋla bɛ nu yiniyini tumdi tuma, ka zaŋ nu yiniyini mi gbib bidibbina.
en: who were rebuilding the wall. Even those who carried building materials worked with one hand and kept a weapon in the other.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa bi tim o Bia maa dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti karila dunianim saria, amaa ni dunianim lee ti tiligi o zuɣu.
en: God sent his Son into the world. He did not send him to judge the world guilty, but to save the world through him.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na ti ti o ma; ka o ma daa zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli o ba ni yuri pam.
en: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and his mother made the delicious food that his father loved.

dag: ni Kɔra ni Gatam ni Amalɛk. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ɛlifaz bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Ada yaansi.
en: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. All these family groups came from Esaus wife Adah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛn puhi chu shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu Yoobu Chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, di daa nyɛla kikaa saha.
en: It was winter, and the Festival of the Dedication of the Temple was being celebrated in Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm a yɛm tuma puuni, amaa lee di chɛ ka o zuɣu ti paligi ka o kpi ni suhudoo.
en: So act wisely: Dont allow him to die a peaceful death.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu bela kasi. Ka so yi saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, Naawuni ni saɣim dilan gba.
en: If someone destroys Gods temple, God will destroy that person, because Gods temple is holy, which is what you are.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ bulah ayi maa ti zali Naawuni tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: Then Aaron will take the two goats and bring them before the Lord at the doorway of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soli nyɛla din be tibi. Yawɛ daalikauli niŋdi pali. O nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr kpɛr o yuli.
en: This God—how perfect are his deeds, how dependable his words! He is like a shield for all who seek his protection.

dag: Ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee zuɣusaa ha n-daa nam li, ka ninsalinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila salinsahi. O teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman sɔŋ la bee kaman tanti shɛl ni nir ni yɛn kpe m-beni.
en: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.

dag: Ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun kpuɣ a nɛma, nyin di lan bɔh o di yɛla.
en: Give to everyone who asks and dont demand your things back from those who take them.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Doo ŋun daa neei zom nina ŋɔ daa naan ku faai Lazarɔs gba bahi ka o ku kpi.
en: But some of them said, He gave sight to the blind man, didn't he? Could he not have kept Lazarus from dying.

dag: Ka Hamɔr daa yɛl o, M bia Shɛkɛm bɔr a bipuɣiŋga, n suhir a, zaŋm o ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Hamor said to him, My son Shechem has fallen in love with your daughter; please let him marry her.

dag: So beni n-ni tooi ŋme ma naŋgbankpeeni? Dindina n ni fo n noli, ka kpi.
en: Are you coming to accuse me, God? If you do, I am ready to be silent and die.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi doli n zalikpana maa, amaa ka zaɣisi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la dolibu, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nini kul moola bɛ yaannim buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu la.
en: because they didnt observe my case laws, they rejected my regulations, and they degraded my sabbaths while they kept looking to their parents idols.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛsi daa bol o bidibiga Abinadab na nti chɛ ka o gari Samuɛl tooni. Ka Samuɛl yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Jesse told his son Abinadab to go over to Samuel, but Samuel said, No, the Lord hasn't chosen him.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o suhu saɣim pam ka o yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: After he said these things, Jesus was deeply disturbed and testified, I assure you, one of you will betray me.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi, amaa duhimiya n yuli Izraɛlnim sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: Do not bring disgrace on my holy name; all the people of Israel must acknowledge me to be holy. I am the Lord and I make you holy;.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bo bulah ayi ti o ka o mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛla yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: The community of Israel shall give Aaron two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

dag: Ka niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa mini nudirigu polo na ti ʒini Naawuni nam ni n-diri ka nyura.
en: People will come from the east and the west, from the north and the south, and sit down at the feast in the Kingdom of God.

dag: Di saha ka Filistianim daa kana ti dɔni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti liri Lɛhinima.
en: The Philistines came and camped in Judah, and attacked the town of Lehi.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri alahichinim nyuli, amaa kul jɛmmila Yawɛ.
en: Don't be envious of sinful people; let reverence for the Lord be the concern of your life.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi Milikom zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka nya ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi, ka kuɣ viɛla be di ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda, ka o daa va bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam kuli.
en: David took Milcoms crown from his head. He found that it weighed one kikkar of gold and was set with a valuable stone. It was placed on Davids head. The amount of loot David took from the city was huge.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis a zaligunim dolibu. Bɛ yɔhiŋgu soya nyɛla yoli.
en: You reject everyone who disobeys your laws; their deceitful schemes are useless.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ. Ka o daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ kurigu pinaayi saha ni kurig ata saha ti nya shɛba n-lan yɛli bɛ gba lala.
en: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabinim mini wuntizɔriba pam suhuri daa yɛmi ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bi nya li; ka bɛ suhuri daa lan ye ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka daa bi wum li.
en: Many prophets and good people were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.

dag: Ti ni tooi paɣi Naawuni yi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ. Ti paɣir o ti ni mali suhupiɛl shɛli yi zuɣu ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?.

dag: Yi biɛhigu ni ti nyɛla biɛhiŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka dabiɛm mali ya ka yi nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: You will live with danger and always be afraid. You will be afraid night and day. You will never feel sure about your life.

dag: Kulla dindali maa ka bɛ daa yɛli naa bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb Susa puuni kalinli.
en: That day the king heard how many men had been killed in the capital city of Susa.

dag: ka yim zuɣu be nayili, ka yim zuɣu mi be tanzaa dunɔdal la gbini. Ka zama zaa mi kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: another third will be at the royal palace, and another third will be at the Foundation Gate. Meanwhile, all the people will be in the courtyards of the LORDs temple.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ liɣiri paŋ n niriba bɛn be yi ni ŋɔ nandaan so, yin di zaŋ yimaŋ leeg o sandihiriba, yi mi miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri di zuɣu.
en: If you lend money to any of my people who are poor, do not act like a moneylender and require him to pay interest.

dag: N kɔba zaa kul yimi paya. Bɛ kul kpaala bɛ nina kpa ma lihiri ma.
en: All my bones can be seen. My enemies look at me and stare.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu bara ni o ni ti pini ka bi ti li ŋmanila saa ni yi ku ka bi mi la.
en: People who promise to give gifts but never give them are like clouds and wind that bring no rain.

dag: Wumm a ba ŋun dɔɣ a yɛligu. Miri ka a ʒiɛm a ma o yi ti kurigi.
en: Listen to your father, who gave you life; dont despise your elderly mother.

dag: Nira ni tooi kabigi kurigu mini tahiʒiɛɣu din gabi taba, ka nyɛ din yi nuzaa polo na?.
en: No one can break iron, especially the iron from the north that is mixed with bronze.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ ti baŋya ni alizin biɛɣu n-shiri ʒi a zuɣu, dama ti yab Ibrahimma min anabinim zaa kpiya, ka nyin ti yɛli ni nir yi dol a yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: Then the people said, Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?.

dag: M mi yi tɛha mini yi ni lo nia shɛli na ni yi ti birigi ma.
en: Look, I know your thoughts; your plans harm me.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Suhudoo ka n zaŋ tin ya; mmaŋmaŋ suhudoo mi ka n zaŋ tin ya maa. Di pala dunianim ni tiri suhudoo shɛm la ka n tin ya maa. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yi o zuɣu mɔɣu ni kulibɔn shɛli din daa be Shur soli polo.
en: The angel of the Lord met Hagar at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur.

dag: A min a tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a sani zaa ni ti lu Izraɛl zoya maa ni. Ka n ti zaŋ ya ti juri balibu kam mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ di.
en: You will be killed on the mountains of Israel. You, your groups of soldiers, and all the other nations with you will be killed in the battle. I will give you as food to every kind of bird that eats meat and to all the wild animals.

dag: N ni yili yilli paɣi Naawuni yuli; ka zaŋ wumpaɣibo tibig o.
en: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli, Bilimmiya kuɣ kara ti ŋari voli maa noli, ka bo niriba zali di gbini ka bɛ gul li.
en: He said, Roll some big stones in front of the entrance to the cave. Place some guards there.

dag: ka bɔh o, Ka bindir bɔ ka a lee mali? Tim ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu bee a ni kul mali bindir shɛli kpe.
en: Now, then, what supplies do you have? Give me five loaves of bread or anything else you have.

dag: Binshɛli din gɔŋ ku tooi lan teei tuhi; ka nir mi ku tooi yɛli binshɛli din kani yɛla.
en: If something is crooked, you cannot say it is straight. And if something is missing, you cannot say it is there.

dag: N zaligu maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yumiya taba kaman n ni yuri ya shɛm.
en: This is my commandment: love each other just as I have loved you.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ti gbahi tab zuɣuri, ka zaŋ takɔbiri kuhi tab puluɣa ni, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu n-kpi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Hɛlikatihazurim, ka di be Gibiɔn.
en: Each of the men grabbed his opponents head and stabbed him in the side with his sword, and then they fell down together. That is why this place in Gibeon is called The Field of the Sharp Knives.

dag: ka zaŋ a nubil suɣi naɣilaa maa ʒim n-zaŋ niŋ sara maligu bimbini binyila la; ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la lɔŋni.
en: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.

dag: ka Samuɛl mi daa do Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ni daa be la, ka bɛ daa na bi kpihi Naawuni firila.
en: Samuel was sleeping in the sanctuary, where the sacred Covenant Box was. Before dawn, while the lamp was still burning.

dag: Dama Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la niriba daa pun deei bɛ tarili.
en: The tribes of Reuben and Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already taken their land.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni ka o daa chɛ di zaa, ka zaŋ omaŋa leei dabili. Ka daa leei daadam m-mali daadam niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu.
en: Instead of this, of his own free will he gave up all he had, and took the nature of a servant. He became like a human being and appeared in human likeness.

dag: Bansi maa daa baɣila di naŋgbaŋkuɣila din daa yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: He put the rings close to the frame. The rings were to hold the poles used to carry the table.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri, ŋun mi viɛnyɛliŋga be n sani.
en: Job, I am telling the truth. I know what I am talking about.

dag: Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun kpihim ninsalinim daalahichi ka mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka o min o ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi maa zaa laɣim mali Ba yino. Dina n-chɛ ka vi bi mal o ni o bol ba o mabihi.
en: He purifies people from their sins, and both he and those who are made pure all have the same Father. That is why Jesus is not ashamed to call them his family.

dag: Ka Siria naa ŋun liri ba n-teei gili ba maa ni niŋ ba o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka bɛ ku tooi niŋ shɛli. O ni ti chaŋ ti zani Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la ni n-deei li omaŋmaŋ yiko ni n-su zaa.
en: The Syrian invader will do with them as he pleases, without opposition. He will stand in the Promised Land and have it completely in his power.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa naɣila jaaŋgbɛhi kɔŋko; di ʒin ya bindira bee adiikunima; yi mi di zaŋya liɣiri niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: This is what he told them: Take nothing for your trip except a stick for walking. Take no bread, no bag, and no money.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa du zuɣusaa n-yi tiŋ maa sunsuuni chaŋ ti zani zo shɛli din be tiŋ maa wulimpuhili polo la zuɣu.
en: The Glory of the Lord rose into the air and left the city and stopped on the hill east of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi leei maligumaaniba ni zuliya kasi. A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bala.
en: You will be a kingdom of priests for me and a holy nation. These are the words you should say to the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu di di simdi ka bɛna m-be kpe n-zan a tooni wuhi bɛ ni nya ka n taali nyɛ shɛli.
en: But some Jews from Asia were there. They should be here, standing before you. If I have really done anything wrong, they are the ones who should accuse me. They were there!.

dag: O yi di be dunia ŋɔ ni, o naan ku nyɛla maligumaana hal baabiɛla, maligumaaniba bɛn zaŋdi pina maani maligu kaman Yɛhudianim zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni beni la zuɣu.
en: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, since there are priests who offer the gifts required by the Jewish Law.

dag: ni Itai ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ribai ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni nir la ni Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la ni.
en: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin; Benaiah the Pirathonite;.

dag: N suhu zaa kul bela Izraɛl sapashinnim bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu la ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: My heart is with the commanders of Israel. They volunteered to go to war. Praise the Lord !.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhimiya.
en: Then he said to them, Im very sad. Its as if Im dying. Stay here and keep alert with me.

dag: Musa daa zali ti zaligu, ka di nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ni su shɛli.
en: Moses gave us the law. These teachings are for Jacobs people.

dag: A ni kpab li kaman biŋŋmaa la, ka di ni taɣi m-be kaman situra la; amaa nyin kul ku taɣi, ka a mi kul ku kurigi.
en: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.

dag: N ni bo biɛhigu shee ti n niriba Izraɛlnima n-zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani, ka bɛ be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka so ku lan muɣisi ba, ka putɔɣunim ku lan liri ba kaman bɛ ni daa yi liriti ba shɛm.
en: Im going to provide a place for my people Israel, and plant them so that they may live there and no longer be disturbed. Cruel people will no longer trouble them as they did earlier.

dag: Di chɛ ka a nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpɛh a alahichi ni. A mi miri ka a ti yɛli adiini karimba ni pa lala ka a di yɛli. Di chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu a yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka a tuma bahi yoli.
en: So dont let your words cause you to sin. Dont say to the priest, I didnt mean what I said. If you do this, God might become angry with your words and destroy everything you have worked for.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti na maa ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yilli bɛ sani.
en: God, who brought them out of Egypt, is like a magnificent wild bull for him.

dag: Dum Abarim zoli din nyɛ Nɛbo zoli ka be Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ labi Jɛriko tooni polo la nti lihi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su maa.
en: Go to the Abarim Mountains. Go up on Mount Nebo in the land of Moab across from the city of Jericho. Then you can look at the land of Canaan that I am giving to the Israelites to live in.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa Masia wuh o suɣilɔdibo zaa ni nyɛ shɛm man ŋun nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam zaa ŋɔ sani; ka di leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn niŋ o yɛda n-nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la ni ni doli so shɛli.
en: but God was merciful to me in order that Christ Jesus might show his full patience in dealing with me, the worst of sinners, as an example for all those who would later believe in him and receive eternal life.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa yɛli Anabi Musa, N ni niŋ ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nirilim, ka zo ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.

dag: N shia, labim a vuhim shee na, dama Yawɛ niŋ a nirilim pam.
en: My soul, relax! The Lord is caring for you.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka baŋdiba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mali maʒin shɛŋa tamtam binwɔɣila zuɣu mini tiŋ maa gooni gɔŋbu shee kam, ka bɛ mal li tɔri piɛma, ka labiri kuɣ kara, ka o yuli daa du n-chaŋ katiŋa, dama o daa nya sɔŋsim pam hal ka o yaa ti kirisi.
en: He set up clever devices in Jerusalem on the towers and corners of the wall designed to shoot arrows and large stones. And so Uzziahs fame spread far and wide, because he had received wonderful help until he became powerful.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa, ka lan mali suhukpeeni pam, ka daa chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni hal ka o saha ti paai, ka o naanyi yih omaŋ palo Izraɛlnim sani.
en: And so the little boy John grew up and became stronger in spirit. Then he lived in areas away from other people until the time when he came out to tell Gods message to the people of Israel.

dag: n-yaai li mahilaa ni ti zal o tooni, ka o zaɣisi li ŋubbu, ka yɛl o, Karimi sokam ka bɛ yi ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ zaa daa yi.
en: Then she took the bread out of the pan and put it on his plate, but he refused to eat it. Amnon said, Send the servants out of the house. After they had gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini jintɔriba timmiya ti yɛli sapashin kpɛm maa ni o sa zaŋm Pool tahi yi sanna, ka di be kaman yi bɔrimi ni yi vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ti mali shili ni ti ti ku o ka o na bi paai yi sanna.
en: You and everyone in the council must go to the commander and pretend that you want to find out more about the charges against Paul. Ask for him to be brought before your court. Meanwhile, we will be waiting to kill him before he gets there.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-jiɣiri yi ni wum ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali pun gari la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli so n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee n-yihi waazu yɛl lala bee ŋ-ŋɔ so n-yɛli ni tinima n-sabi gbaŋ puuni yɛl lala.
en: not to be so easily confused in your thinking or upset by the claim that the Day of the Lord has come. Perhaps it is thought that we said this while prophesying or preaching, or that we wrote it in a letter.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n ti zaŋ ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be kaman yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli chi mini kawana ni wain ni bindira ni tihi puri ni be.
en: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi Kiburɔtihataava maa n-chaŋ Hazɛrɔt.
en: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people marched to Hazeroth.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa mini anabinim maa, Doo ŋɔ bi simdi ni ti ku o, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ka o zaŋ tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, This man doesnt deserve to die, for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

dag: Di saha ka Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la ni niriba maa zaa daa deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli ni Anabi Hagai yɛligu, ka saɣ ti o ni o nyɛla Naawuni tumo; ka lu Yawɛ sizuura ka zo o.
en: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord 's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord .

dag: Ɛliasa daa nyɛla Sisimai ba, ka Sisimai nyɛ Shallum ba.
en: Eleasah was Sismais father. Sismai was Shallums father.

dag: N na mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa yi na ku tooi deei li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.

dag: ka fiɛb o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: They will whip him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di Izraɛl nam ka di ti paai yuun pisaayika saha shɛli, ka Abija mi daa leei Juda naa.
en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of King Jeroboam of Israel, Abijah became king of Judah.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo faralan maa piɛr anahi, o ni tum shɛm maa min o ni bi zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: And because he didn't have pity on the poor man, he will have to pay four times what the lamb was worth.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam n-su Judanim shɛm m-bala. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pisinaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Azuba, o daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoshaphat was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. His mother was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

dag: N yiɣisirila nolɔɣu kukoli saha n kumdi niŋd a, n zaŋ n tahima niŋla a yɛligu ni.
en: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.

dag: O gbarigi n yaa m biɛhigu puuni, ka filim n dabisa.
en: The Lord has made me weak while I am still young; he has shortened my life.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋubi noombil kam ŋun be nyam.
en: You may eat any clean bird.

dag: Yi ni so shiri zaŋd o mabia tahiri sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani ni bɛ ti kari ba saria?.
en: But instead, does a brother or sister have a lawsuit against another brother or sister, and do they do this in front of unbelievers?.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun biri biɛla ni ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi biri pam ni ti kpuɣ atam pam.
en: Remember this saying, A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Bɛlishaaza nam dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa zahim zahindi n dooshee n-nya ʒii yuŋ, ka sabi zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ.
en: In the first year that Belshazzar was king of Babylonia, I had a dream and saw a vision in the night. I wrote the dream down, and this is the record.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl bihi, o yuli n-lan nyɛ Yaakubu: Rubin mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: Israels sons were Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa be Yisifu sani ka niŋ o nirilim, ka chɛ ka dansarika gul maa suhu yu o.
en: But the Lord was with Joseph and blessed him, so that the jailer was pleased with him.

dag: Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a, Yawɛ ni bɔh a biɛri ti ma, amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: I'll let the Lord decide which one of us has done right. I pray that the Lord will punish you for what you're doing to me, but I won't do anything to you.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa kum nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nan bia Jɔshua, ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda la.
en: After Moses the LORDs servant died, the LORD spoke to Joshua, Nuns son. He had been Moses helper.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya, ka Na so ŋun mali jilima maa gari kpɛna.
en: Gates, proudly lift your heads! Open, ancient doors, and the glorious King will come in.

dag: Di saha ka n daa moli molo Ahava Mɔɣili duli ni ti siɣisi timaŋ ti Naawuni sani, ka suh o ni o tim ti mini ti bihi ni ti ni su shɛlikam zaa napɔŋ suŋ ti chandi ni.
en: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.

dag: Ka Yisa daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi chirimya, dama yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba.
en: Jesus answered, You are so wrong! You dont know what the Scriptures say. And you dont know anything about Gods power.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu zalim zaligu maa, ka dih a nuu di gbɔŋ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka di tum tuma. Di mi nyɛla Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu, di bi taɣira.
en: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya galisi pam. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a yuli du pam, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will make of you a great nation and will bless you. I will make your name respected, and you will be a blessing.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi leei tampiŋ nɛli doya, ka bɛ zaŋdi ziŋgbahiri lansi yɛrigiri deeni yi zuɣu. Ka so ti ku lan me yi dabari maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will leave only a bare rock where fishermen can dry their nets. The city will never be rebuilt. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di puuni ninvuɣ zuɣuri tim bɛ tumtumdiba ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka bɛ chaŋ kɔbilisi ni nti bi nya kom, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ bɛ kɔŋɔŋdi biŋkuma labi kuli. Vi gbahi ba ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka bɛ be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim ŋɔ ni ka lur a sizuura hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: Do this so that your people will fear and respect you all the time that they live in this land that you gave to our ancestors.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpaŋsi Pool suhu ka o lo nia ni o ni doli Masidɔnia mini Akaia polo chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm; ka daa lan yɛli ni o yi paai Jɛrusalɛm, shee ka o gari Rom gba.
en: After these things had happened, Paul made up his mind to travel through Macedonia and Achaia and go on to Jerusalem. After I go there, he said, I must also see Rome.

dag: Kpahimi bɛn tumd alahichi la zuɣu ni palɔni din ni chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe bɛn kpalim la.
en: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.

dag: Ka yi yi nyɛla Masia ni su shɛba, dindina yi nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi bɛn ni di o fali kaman Naawuni daalikauli la ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Now if you belong to Christ, then indeed you are Abrahams descendants, heirs according to the promise.

dag: Kul be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka m be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a min a zuliya, ka chɛ ka n ni daa lo a ba Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la pali.
en: Stay in this land as an immigrant, and I will be with you and bless you because I will give all of these lands to you and your descendants. I will keep my word, which I gave to your father Abraham.

dag: Ŋunkam kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di nyaaŋa o ni nya yurilim dilan sani n-gari ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o.
en: Correct someone, and afterward he will appreciate it more than flattery.

dag: Dunia shiri ni ti dahimdahim doya, ka bɛ ʒe di zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The earth will be devastated, totally devastated; it will be destroyed, completely destroyed because the LORD has said it would be so.

dag: Yawɛ, a wumdi n suhigu asiba; asiba ka n suhir a, ka guhira.
en: LORD, in the morning you hear my voice. In the morning I lay it all out before you. Then I wait expectantly.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni kpe kuɣ shɛŋa m-me zɔŋ kulis ata tam taba, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi li kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: Then they built a wall around the inner yard. Each wall was made from three rows of cut stones and one row of cedar timbers.

dag: Di simdi ni yi lihi ti kaman Masia tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ o daashili yɛlimaŋa fukumsi niŋ shɛb nuu ni.
en: You should think of us as Christ's servants, who have been put in charge of God's secret truths.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Pa nyini n-yɛn ʒi lahibali maa kuli zuŋɔ, dahin shɛli ka a ni ti ʒi lahibali maa kuli, amaa zuŋɔ dina a ku ʒi lahibali maa kuli, dama nabia maa kpiya.
en: Joab answered, You're not the one to tell the king that his son is dead. You can take him a message some other time, but not today.

dag: O daa lan me Baalat mini ŋun Sulemaana nɛma ni daa be tin shɛŋa ni zaa, ni o wɔribariba chɛchɛbunsi min o ni daa be tin shɛŋa ni. O daa lan me ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛŋa zaa Jɛrusalɛm mini Lɛbanɔn ni o ni daa su tin shɛŋa zaa la ni.
en: Baalath; all the cities he used for storage; and all the cities used for chariots and cavalry—along with everything else he wanted to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout his kingdom.

dag: dama yi ni kariti tab saria shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti kari yi gba saria, ka yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti buɣisi ti yi gba.
en: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.

dag: Tiŋgbani damdila bɛ tooni; ka sagbana sɔhira. Ka wuntaŋ mini goli niŋ zim, ka saŋmarisi gba bi lan ne.
en: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi doli zaligunim ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, dinzuɣu doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka yi ni ti lo noli goli maa daba awɛi dali zaawuni. Yi ni ti gbibila yi Vuhim Dabisili maa zaawuni hal ti lan paai zaawuni.
en: It will be a special day of rest for you. You must not eat food. You will start this special day of rest on the evening following the ninth day of the month. This special day of rest continues from that evening until the next evening.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa ayi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa lɔris ayi la ni.
en: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom.

dag: Yawɛ yɛri Izraɛlnima, Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya.
en: The LORD proclaims to the house of Israel: Seek me and live.

dag: Dama Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia daa ti la niriba maa naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tusaayopɔin ni bɛ kɔri. Ka kpamba gba daa ti ba naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tuhi pia. Ka maligumaaniba pam daa mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi.
en: King Hezekiah contributed , bulls and , sheep for the people to kill and eat, and the officials gave them another , bulls and , sheep. A large number of priests went through the ritual of purification.

dag: O ni daa kul suhiri Yawɛ maa, ka Ɛli lihir o noli.
en: As she kept praying before the LORD, Eli watched her mouth.

dag: Dinzuɣu mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini kunduna ni taatahi n-ni ti be Babilɔn. Niriba ti ku lan be di ni yaha, ka so mi ku lan ʒini di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Never again will people live in your land— only desert animals, jackals, and unclean birds.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o je suli, ka o ninni biɛhigu taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo polo, ka yɛl o niriba ni bɛ malim buɣim maa n-chɛ ka di bii ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-gari di ni yi pun biiri shɛm.
en: Then Nebuchadnezzar lost his temper, and his face turned red with anger at Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. So he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.

dag: Ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛli kpamba maa, N daa zaŋla m bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti doo ŋɔ ka o niŋ o paɣa, amaa ka o ti bi lan bɔr o.
en: The girls father must say to the leaders, I gave my daughter to this man to be his wife, but now he does not want her.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ lab mali Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin la, ka o daa mali suhudoo mini wumpaɣibo sara di zuɣu, ka daa zali Judanima ni bɛ jɛmmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa.
en: Then he set up the Lord s altar and offered fellowship offerings and thank offerings on it. He gave a command for all the people of Judah to serve the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani; dinzuɣu ka n chɛ o niŋ sarika ni hal ni saha shɛli n ni ni ti tooi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Siiza sani.
en: But Paul appealed; he asked to be kept under guard and to let the Emperor decide his case. So I gave orders for him to be kept under guard until I could send him to the Emperor.

dag: Ŋuni ka o daa niŋ saawara ni o baŋ shɛli, ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o yɛlimaŋli soli. Ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o baŋsim bee n-wuh o o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm?.
en: Whom did he consult for enlightenment? Who taught him the path of justice and knowledge and explained to him the way of understanding?.

dag: Di saha ka shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi di biɛhigu shee, ka n daa wum vuri pam n nyaaŋa.
en: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.

dag: Wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la asiba, din ni chɛ ka ti yili suhupiɛlli yila, ka ti suhuri piɛli ti dabisa zaa ni.
en: Fill us full every morning with your faithful love so we can rejoice and celebrate our whole life long.

dag: Ka niriba zaa wum di yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan niŋ tipawumli yaha.
en: Then everyone will hear of it and be afraid, and no one else will dare to act in such a way.

dag: Yisa daa lola noli biɛɣ pihinahi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: After Jesus had fasted for forty days and forty nights, he was starving.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti lan da yiya mini puri ni wain tihi puri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaha. .
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, has said that houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.

dag: Yi pun wum ka n yɛli ya ni n ni chaŋ ka ti lan lab yi sanna yaha. Yi yi di yuri ma, yi naan mali suhupiɛlli n ni chani m Ba sani maa zuɣu, dama m Ba maa gari ma.
en: You have heard me tell you, Im going away and returning to you. If you loved me, you would be happy that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than me.

dag: Shɛlini so shɛli ni tooi beni ŋmani din viɛla, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛ kum soli.
en: There is a path that may seem straight to someone, but in the end it is the path of death.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ n-su di fukumsi; ka su teeku puuni zahim mini noonsi ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God gave them his blessing and said: Have a lot of children! Fill the earth with people and bring it under your control. Rule over the fish in the ocean, the birds in the sky, and every animal on the earth.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa, ŋuna n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: The Lord is king, and he rules the nations.

dag: Kpalimmi be n sani, ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o ku ma m-bɔri ni o ku a gba maa; a yi be n sani shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Stay with me and don't be afraid. Saul wants to kill both you and me, but you will be safe with me.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Tiŋ Kasi la ni nti du n-tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha.
en: After that the devil brought him into the holy city and stood him at the highest point of the temple. He said to him.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka sanzali zani tiŋgban ni mini di zoya zuɣu ni puri ni zaŋ tabili tihi puri ni ni olivi kpam tihi puri ni ni binshɛɣukam din yiri tiŋgban ni na; ka chɛ ka di miisim maa tabili ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ nuhi tuuni kam. .
en: I have called for drought on the earth, on the mountains, on the grain, on the wine, on the olive oil, on that which comes forth from the fertile ground, on humanity, on beasts, and upon everything that handles produce.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi gbana ŋɔ, ti ni dihi ti dalinli tabili dabu gban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ mini gban shɛli din pahi ŋɔ nti niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni ka di ku saɣim yoma.
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, has ordered you to take these deeds, both the sealed deed of purchase and the open copy, and to place them in a clay jar, so that they may be preserved for years to come.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma nyɛvili soli, ka suhupiɛl maŋli kul be a sani; ka nyaɣisim kul be a nudirigu ni sahakam.
en: You teach me the way of life. In your presence is total celebration. Beautiful things are always in your right hand.

dag: So bi jɛmd a, so mi bi bɔri sɔŋsim a sani. Dama a lɛbila a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ti niŋ ti daalahichi maa ni.
en: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o pam; dama Gibiɔn daa nyɛla tin titali kaman tin titali kam din mali naa. Di daa galisi gari Ai, ka di dɔbba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Adoni-zedek and his people were very afraid, because Gibeon was a large city, like one of the royal cities. It was larger than Ai. All its men were soldiers.

dag: Pa kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ka ti daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa Masia yiko min o kandina yɛla, amaa ti nyɛla shɛhiranim bɛn nini daa nya o jilima.
en: We have not depended on made-up stories in making known to you the mighty coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. With our own eyes we saw his greatness.

dag: Yi yi di daa pun doli n zaligunima, yi naan nya alibarika, ka di be kaman kɔzɔrim din bi ŋmaara. Ka yi nasara dibu mi be kaman teeku kɔgbana la.
en: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl bɔh o, Ya ka a dabili ŋun nyɛ baa ŋɔ yɛn nya yiko n-tum tuun karili ŋɔ! Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ kahigi wuhi ma ni a ni ti leei Siria naa.
en: How could I ever do anything like that? Hazael replied. I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power. Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔhi bɛ ni su shɛlikam zaa m-pirigipirigi ti taba kaman di ni daa simdi ni sokam deei shɛm tariga.
en: They would sell pieces of property and possessions and distribute the proceeds to everyone who needed them.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa siɣi ninvuɣ shɛb Kɔniilius ni daa timna maa sani ti yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee tahi ya na.
en: Peter went down and said to the men, I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana, dama mani n-sun ya. N ni yihi yi ninvuɣ yinoyino yi fɔntinsi ni na, ka yihi yi niriba ayiyi yi daŋ kam ni na n-zaŋ ya ka Ziɔn na.
en: Unfaithful people, come back; you belong to me. I will take one of you from each town and two from each clan, and I will bring you back to Mount Zion.

dag: A deeg o nam jaaŋgbee o nuu ni, ka daag o nam luhi.
en: You did not let him win. You threw his throne to the ground.

dag: Di malila dabiɛm yuŋ, amaa zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ asiba, ka di zo. Lala n-yɛn niŋ bɛnkam kana ni bɛ ti ʒe ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: In the evening, there is terror; but before morning it is gone. This is the fate of those who loot us, the destiny of those who rob us.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔhim ti ʒiʒiinitab biɛri siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin zuɣu, ansarisi shɛŋa bɛ ni maan a la zuɣu.
en: Pay back our neighbors seven times over, right where it hurts, for the insults they used on you, Lord.

dag: Ka Baasha ŋun daa nyɛ Ahija ŋun yi Isaka zuliya ni na bia la daa lo nia n-chaŋ ti liri Nadab n-ku o Gibɛtɔn din be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama Nadab mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa teei gilila Gibɛtɔn.
en: Baasha was the son of Ahijah. They were from the tribe of Issachar. Baasha made a plan to kill King Nadab. Nadab and all Israel were fighting against the Philistine town of Gibbethon. And that is where Baasha killed Nadab.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yɛhi tahi pampam m-po pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka piɛbi kikahi mini binyila.
en: Then Asa and the people made an oath to the Lord . They shouted it out loudly and blew their trumpets and rams horns.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Mahili mini Mushi ni Jaazia n-daa nyɛ kpamba Mɛrari daŋ ni.
en: Meraris descendants were Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah his son.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbuyinika ni kɔbisita.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Yaakubu daa di n-tiɣi. Jɛshurun daa ŋmɛlimya ka tiri gbini. A ŋmɛlimya piri m-muɣi lɔŋ. O daa zaɣisi Naawuni ŋun nam o, ka maani o tiliginsim tampiŋ ansarisi.
en: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti darigi yiko shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa tibili, ka darigi dunia ŋɔ nanim tibili.
en: At that time the Lord will judge the heavenly armies in heaven and the earthly kings on earth.

dag: Ka buɣim daa yi di mundili maa ni n-di di wula mini di wala. Ka di daa lan ka mundili din mali yaa din ni niŋ nam jaaŋgbee, ka bɛ zaŋ li su nam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla fabila yilli, ka di simdi ni bɛ yiini li fabila saha.
en: where her stem caught fire, and flames burned her branches and fruit. Not one strong branch is left; she is stripped bare. This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.

dag: Ka duu maa dunol ni kazala puuni ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili; ka di yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di mini jɛmbu duu maa maŋmaŋ yɛliŋ nyɛ yim.
en: The porch of the Temple was cubits long and cubits wide. The porch ran along the front of the main part of the Temple itself. Its length was equal to the width of the Temple.

dag: Yi goli kam piligu ni, bomiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: Present a burnt offering to the Lord at the beginning of each month: two young bulls, one ram, seven one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Gaatinima, ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa. Amaa Naa Hazaɛl ni daa chani ni o ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Hazael was the king of Aram. He went to fight against the city of Gath and defeated it. Then he made plans to go fight against Jerusalem.

dag: Yi kul lɔrila nia biɛri sahakam, ka jiɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu; ka niŋdi yomyom chani ti kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Yi yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, yi saɣindimi bahi.
en: You are always planning something evil, and you can hardly wait to do it. You never hesitate to murder innocent people. You leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni; bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: Our greatness cannot keep us from death; we will still die like the animals.

dag: Saha shɛli Musa ni daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la, ka o daa wum kukol shɛli Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu la zuɣusaa chɛrubinim ayi la sunsuuni ka di tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Moses went into the Tent to talk with the Lord , he heard the Lord speaking to him from above the lid on the Covenant Box, between the two winged creatures.

dag: Miri ka a bɔri ni yuŋ zibi din nyɛ din ʒiri niriba chani la.
en: Don't wish for night to come, the time when nations will perish.

dag: A bihi maa daa tumla alahichi o sani, bɛ daalahichi maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛ shɛm ka o niŋ ba maa.
en: If your children sinned against God, he punished them. They paid for their sins.

dag: Yaakubu mini ba ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri saha shɛli maa, ka Reechɛl taɣ o ba piɛri paa na; dama ŋuna n-daa guli ba.
en: While Jacob was talking with the shepherds, Rachel came with her fathers sheep.

en: So the boy led David to them, and he found them scattered all over the countryside, eating, drinking, and celebrating over the large amount of plunder they had taken from Philistine and Judean territory.

en: The same Spirit agrees with our spirit, that we are Gods children.

en: and they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.

en: So then, listen to them, but give them strict warnings and explain how their kings will treat them.
