en: You are the body of Christ and parts of each other.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni be a sani, ka chɛ ka a ŋme n-ku Midiannim kaman ninvuɣ yino n-nyɛ ba la.
en: The LORD replied, Because Im with you, youll defeat the Midianites as if they were just one person.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣ shɛli yi ni mali yɔri farigu zuɣu maa na ka n nya. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ laɣifu na ti ti o.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi nti tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: Then the Pharisees left and made plans to kill Jesus.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa yihi kom baptaizibu yɛla waazu la nyaaŋa ka yɛligu ŋɔ daa pili Galili m-mol gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, A yi kari ti, nyin chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: The demons begged Jesus, If you make us leave these men, please send us into that herd of pigs.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa yɛl o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi, M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa man maan yɛn pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa nɔnsi ka man yɛn zaŋ fiɛb ya.
en: He spoke bluntly and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested: My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-naan chɛ ka n suhu maai. Di biɛrim yi di be ka bo, n naan mali suhupiɛlli; dama m bi zaɣisi ŋun be Kasi ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: Then I would be comforted by this one thing: Even through all this pain, I never refused to obey the commands of the Holy One.

dag: Awa yini puuni ka di bun la zaa zani bahi yoli! Ka ŋariŋduhiriba zuɣulaannim mini ŋariŋkpɛriba ni ŋariŋduhiriba ni bɛn zaa wolima yiri teeku ni na kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared. Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa atam bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu, di yi nyɛla tiŋgban ni bindira bee tihi wala, di nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka nyɛ din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: All tenth-part gifts from the land, whether of seed from the ground or fruit from the trees, belong to the LORD; they are holy to the LORD.

dag: Shɛhira maa n-nyɛ ni Naawuni ti ti nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka nyɛvili maa mi bela o Bia maa ni.
en: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.

dag: So ni tooi wuhi Naawuni ŋun kariti wɔɣira saria ŋɔ yɛm?.
en: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *.

dag: Tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim malila so shɛli din so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim dini? Aai, ti bi mali so shɛli din so. Di bemi kaman n ni pun yɛli shɛm la, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, alahichi nyaŋ bɛ zaa.
en: So what are we saying? Are we better off? Not at all. We have already stated the charge: both Jews and Greeks are all under the power of sin.

dag: n-yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi mini biɛɣ pinaanu dabisa n-leei vuhim dabisa yuuni kam.
en: telling them to observe the fourteenth and fifteenth days of Adar as holidays every year.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan kpi yaha; bɛ biɛhigu mini malaikanim biɛhigu ti kul yɛn nyɛla yim. Bɛ ti yɛn nyɛla Naawuni bihi bɛ ni nyɛ kum ni neebu bihi maa zuɣu.

dag: dama bɛ tɛha zaa nyɛla duŋtaabo, ka bɛ noya tɔɣisiri barina yɛtɔɣa.

dag: N ni na be yi sani ŋɔ ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋubi noombil kam ŋun be nyam.

en: Preach the word. Be ready to do it whether it is convenient or inconvenient. Correct, confront, and encourage with patience and instruction.

dag: Ka Judanim bɛn kpalim be Ijipti maa so ti ku zo n-tiligi bee n-gali bee nti lan labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Hal bɛ ni daa kul bɔri ni bɛ lab ti be nimaani ka di yuui maa zaa yoli, bɛ ku labi, naɣila kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba shɛba n-ni labi.

dag: Daadam, kummi Ijipti tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa niŋ tiŋgban ni m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: Mortal man, he said, mourn for all the many people of Egypt. Send them down with the other powerful nations to the world of the dead.

dag: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la, n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.

dag: ka m mi yi bɔhi ya, yi ku garigi ma.

en: Then Israel, Assyria, and Egypt will join together and control the land. This will be a blessing for the land.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ jintɔriba la daa laɣim n-zaŋ Yisa tahi bɛ jina tɔbu shee ti yɛl o.
en: At daybreak the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses got together and brought Jesus before their council.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba maa daa ti paai Hachila zolɔŋni zaŋ labi Jɛshimɔn wulimpuhili polo nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani palli noli. Amaa Dauda daa na bela mɔɣu maa ni. O ni daa ti wum ni Sool kar o naba na mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul set up his camp by the road at Hakilah Hill, across from Jeshimon. David was out in the desert and saw that Saul had come out into the desert after him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat maa daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili Izraɛl Naa Ahazia ŋun daa tum tuumbiɛri pam la.
en: Sometime later, Judahs King Jehoshaphat formed an alliance with Israels King Ahaziah, which caused him to sin.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi bɛ taba, ka maani ba ansarisi la ti ku lan beni. Bɛ ni ti ku tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear.

dag: Amaa nir yi zaŋ kurigu ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, bɛn kum o.
en: If, however, any of you use a weapon of iron or stone or wood to kill someone, you are guilty of murder and are to be put to death.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Chɛliya ka bɛn gbib bidibbina be Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni ka yi chaŋ gili tiŋ maa.
en: Then he ordered the people to start marching around the city, with an advance guard going on ahead of the Lord 's Covenant Box.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe Kapɛrinium tiŋ puuni saha shɛli, ka Rom sapashin so daa ka o sanna nti balind o yɛra.
en: When Jesus entered Capernaum, a Roman officer met him and begged for help:.

dag: Di yi nyɛla lala, ti Naawuni so ti ni jɛmdi maa yi ni tooi yihi ti buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni, o ni yihi ti, ka ni lan yihi ti a gba nuu ni.
en: The God we worship can save us from you and your flaming furnace.

dag: Ijiptinim nyɛla ninsalinima ka pa Naawuni, ka bɛ yuri nyɛ biŋkɔbiri ka pa lahizibu binyara. Yawɛ yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu, bɛn nyɛ sɔŋdiba maa ni ti tuui, ka bɛ ni sɔŋdi shɛb maa lu, ka bɛ zaa laɣim bahi yoli.
en: Egypt is human and not divine; their horses are flesh and not spirit. The LORD will extend his hand; the helper will stumble, those helped will fall, and they will all die together.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa tɔɣisirila Lazarɔs kum yɛla, ka o nyaandoliba maa bɛn tɛhi ni o tɔɣisirila o daalaafee gom yɛla.
en: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Jɔn mabia Jeemsi.
en: He had James, the brother of John, put to death by the sword.

dag: Asirianim ku tooi tiligi ti, ti ku lan ba yuri yaha, ti mi ku lan boli ti ni zaŋ ti nuhi mali binshɛŋa la ti Naawuni. Yɛlimaŋli, kpibiga nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Assyria can never save us, and war horses cannot protect us. We will never again say to our idols that they are our God. O Lord , you show mercy to those who have no one else to turn to.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ daa ti kari bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bahi kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka bɛ na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, M bia, Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni ti ti piɛ so ti ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul dol tab chana.
en: Abraham answered, God himself is providing the lamb for the sacrifice, my son. So both Abraham and his son went together to that place.

dag: Ka o ni daa tum yiko mini kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa zaŋ tabil o ni daa duhi Mɔdɛkai n-zaŋ o zali zaashe tital ni la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Pɛriʒia mini Miidia nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: All the great and famous things that King Xerxes did are written in the record books of the kings of Media and Persia. These records also tell about the honors that the king gave to Mordecai.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu, yinim bɛn daa be katiŋ la yipa vu m-miri Naawuni Masia ʒim zuɣu.
en: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa suhi Naawuni ka Naawuni tibi Abimilɛk min o paɣa ni o dabipaɣiba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: Abraham prayed to God; and God restored Abimelech, his wife, and his women servants to health, and they were able to have children.

dag: Ka o tuma dabisa daa ti naai ka o kul o yiŋa.
en: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.

dag: Zaɣ biɛ shɛli ka n nya dunia ŋɔ ni, chirimbu titali maa mi yirila zuɣulaannim sanna.
en: Here is an injustice I have seen in the world—an injustice caused by rulers.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Ishibɔshɛt Sool bia maa polo na, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi mi yi Dauda tɔbbihi maa polo na.
en: So the men came forward and were counted as they passed by: twelve for Benjamin and Ishbosheth, Sauls son; and twelve of Davids soldiers.

dag: ka zaŋ diba anu n-niŋ luɣ din la mi polo dapaɣa, ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa wulinluhili polo dapaɣa.
en: five bars for the boards on the other side of the dwelling, and five bars for the boards on the back wall of the dwelling on the west.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Dan were .

dag: Ka Giliadnim daa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli. Ka bɔ n-chɛ ka Dan zuliya niriba la mi daa kpalim be bɛ ŋarima gbini? Asha zuliya niriba gba daa kpalim be teeku duli. Bɛ daa kpalim ʒinila teeku duli maa.
en: Gilead stayed on the other side of the Jordan, and Dan, why did he remain with the ships? Asher stayed by the seacoast, camping at his harbors.

dag: Ka yi ti ku Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni la zaa, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu. Miriya ka yi ti jɛm bɛ wuna, dama di ni ti leei zana yi sani.
en: You will destroy all the peoples that the LORD your God is handing over to you. Show them no pity. And dont serve their gods because that would be a trap for you.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ m piɛri ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti kari saria wuhi din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni, ka wuhi din be piɛlahi mini buhi sunsuuni.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: And you, my flock, I will judge between one sheep and another. I will judge between the male sheep and the male goats.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni m biɛhigu nyaɣisim saha maa, n yɛn yila dunia yili chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka ku paai n saha.
en: I thought, I must depart in the prime of my life; I have been relegated to the gates of the underworld for the rest of my life.

dag: o yi ti nya alaafee n-yiɣisi kpuɣi jaaŋgbee chana, di saha ŋun daa ŋme o maa lan ka taali, amaa di lee simdi ka ŋun daa ŋme o maa yo o ni saɣim o saha shɛli maa samli, ka lih o hal ka o ti kpaŋ zaa.
en: and later has to use a stick when walking outside, you must pay for the loss of time and do what you can to help until the injury is completely healed. That's your only responsibility.

dag: Yi pun wum ka n yɛli ya ni n ni chaŋ ka ti lan lab yi sanna yaha. Yi yi di yuri ma, yi naan mali suhupiɛlli n ni chani m Ba sani maa zuɣu, dama m Ba maa gari ma.
en: You heard me say to you, I am leaving, but I will come back to you. If you loved me, you would be happy that I am going back to the Father, because the Father is greater than I am.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli, dama o kɔŋko yuli tibisi gari yuli kam. O jilima galisiya dunia ni mini zuɣusaa.
en: Let them all praise the name of the Lord ! His name is greater than all others; his glory is above earth and heaven.

dag: ni Zadok ni Ahimaaz.
en: Zadok was Ahitubs son. Ahimaaz was Zadoks son.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Labimi Balak sani nti zaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm yɛl o.
en: So the Lord came to Balaam and told Balaam what to say. Then he told Balaam to go back to Balak and say these things.

dag: M bia, a yi deei n yɛligu, ka doli n zaligunim din be a suhu ni.
en: My son, pay attention to what I say. Remember my commands.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ŋun be kasi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn miri ma sani, ka chɛ ka sokam nya n jilima. Ka Aduna daa kul shini.
en: Then Moses said to Aaron, The Lord says, The priests who come near me must respect me. I must be holy to them and to all the people. So Aaron did not say anything about his sons dying.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala yɛnnima, amaa o daari bɛn bi ʒe yim yɛtɔɣa bahira.
en: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.

dag: Ka chɛ ti taali paŋ ti kaman ti gba ni chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali shɛm la.
en: Forgive us for doing wrong, as we forgive others.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa su tɔbbihi fukumsi ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la nyɛ gbansabira wulana.
en: Joab son of Zeruiah was the captain over the army. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the historian.

dag: Mbusim yi tahi kum libigirili na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali la nya wahala, o maani ba la ansarisi.
en: If calamity suddenly kills, he mocks at the slaying of innocents.

dag: Dama zuliya kam wuna zaa nyɛla binnana; amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: because all the gods of the nations are just idols, but it is the LORD who created heaven!.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba daa yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni n-chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ kana ti muɣisir a maa.
en: It's an evil spirit from God that's frightening you, Saul's officials told him.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa labi ti yɛl o dana maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Ka o daa je suli pam, ka yɛl o yiŋbia maa ni o yim yom doli solɔri mini sobihi m-boli nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni zoomba mini gbariti na.
en: The servant went back and told all this to his master. The master was furious and said to his servant, Hurry out to the streets and alleys of the town, and bring back the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa zo a tiŋgbɔŋ la nambɔɣu; ka daa chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya lan tɔŋ yaha.
en: Our Lord , you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.

dag: Amaa Yaakubu daa bi chɛ ka Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ Yisifu tizo la dol o biɛyanim maa chaŋ, dama o daa zɔrimi ni binshɛli ti niŋ o.
en: But Jacob did not send Joseph's younger brother Benjamin with them; he was afraid that something might happen to him.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana.
en: Then he told the priests to take the Covenant Box and go with it ahead of the people. They did as he said.

dag: Dama nir niŋdila yɛda o suhu ni, ka yi taali ni Naawuni sani; ka yaag o noli kahigi wuhi palɔni, ka tiligi.
en: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba min o chɛchɛbunsi zaa chaŋ yuŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnim bɛn daa gil o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim niŋ sunsuuni la.
en: Jehoram, along with all his chariots, crossed over to Zair. The Edomites, who had surrounded him, attacked at night, defeating him and his chariot officers.

dag: Ka di daa bi yuui ka biasani maa laɣis o ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha. Nimaani ka o daa ti zaŋ o buni maa zaa tum yoliyoli.
en: A few days later the younger son gathered up all that he had and left. He traveled far away to another country, and there he wasted his money living like a fool.

dag: Dama Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Didn't Moses command you to respect your father and mother? Didn't he tell you to put to death all who curse their parents?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu n-ku bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: Your hand will be lifted over your foes; all your enemies will be cut off.

dag: Nyama, yinim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, zahimmiya yɛlli maa nya ka wuhi ti ni yɛn gbaai li shɛm.
en: Now, all you men of Israel, speak up. Give your decision about what we should do.

dag: Nuhu daa nyɛla pukpara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun tuui biri wain tihi. O daa birila wain tihi.
en: Noah, who was a farmer, was the first man to plant a vineyard.

dag: M bela Yawɛ tooni chani nyɛvilinim tiŋgban ni.
en: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.

dag: ka anzinfa pa ŋmana kpiŋkpama zuɣu, ka salima alali pa bɛ kɔbiri zuɣu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ni shɛb daa kpalim be yiŋ buzɔna ni?.
en: Those who stayed home will share in the wealth— metal doves with wings covered in silver and feathers sparkling with gold.

dag: di saha ka naa daa yɛli anab Neetan, Nyama, m bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ dim be suɣili ni.
en: the king said to the prophet Nathan, Look! Im living in a cedar palace, but Gods chest is housed in a tent.

dag: Sapashinnim maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat bɛ daa yɛlimi, Biɛhiŋ kani, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuh o; ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kuhi pam.
en: When the commanders saw King Jehoshaphat, they thought he was the king of Israel, and so they went to kill him. Jehoshaphat started shouting.

dag: N lɔri nia ni n chaŋ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n yi ti chaŋ nimaani, di nyaaŋa n ni gari ka yi sanna.
en: I shall come to you after I have gone through Macedonia—for I have to go through Macedonia.

dag: Niriba yi ti neei kum ni, bɛ bi lan yɛn kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba; bɛ ti kul yɛn bemi kaman malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni la.
en: For when the dead rise to life, they will be like the angels in heaven and will not marry.

dag: Bɛ zaa kul tulimi kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu la, ka kuri bɛ nanima. Bɛ ku nanim zaa, ka bɛ so bi suhi ma ni n sɔŋ o.
en: They are all like hot ovens. They destroyed their rulers. All their kings fell. Not one of them called to me for help.

dag: Ka Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba maa mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋa ni bɛ kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: Then the priests and Levites made themselves holy so that they could carry the Holy Box of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Masia zuɣu n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri. Ka n suhu ni tɛha diri ma shɛhira Naawuni Shia Kasi sani.
en: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛli taba, Ti bi niŋ din tuhi. Zuŋɔ nyɛla lahiba suŋ dabisili. Ka ti yi zaŋ li shini hal ni biɛɣu ti neei, tibidarigibo shɛli ni ti paai ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti yɛli nayilinima.
en: Then they said to each other, We are doing wrong! Today we have good news, but we are silent. If we wait until the sun comes up, we will be punished. Now lets go and tell the people who live in the kings palace.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Zɛbulɔn zuliya: Yinim Zɛbulɔn zuliya, Maliya suhupiɛlli yi yibu ni. Yinim Isaka zuliya, bɛnya yi suɣa puuni.
en: About the tribes of Zebulun and Issachar he said: May Zebulun be prosperous in their trade on the sea, And may Issachar's wealth increase at home.

dag: n-wuhiri Naawuni ni daa ti Yisa Nazarɛt nira Shia Kasi yiko ka o gindi tumdi tuun suma, ka chɛ ka Sintani ni daa nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa kpaŋdi shɛm, dama Naawuni daa be o sani.
en: You know about Jesus from Nazareth. God made him the Messiah by giving him the Holy Spirit and power. Jesus went everywhere doing good for people. He healed those who were ruled by the devil, showing that God was with him.

dag: Bin yini mi kɔŋko n-simdi bɔbu. Mariama pii din viɛli maa, ka di mi ku lan yi o nuu ni.
en: One thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the better part. It wont be taken away from her.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika n-niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya li nyu ka ti taba.
en: After taking a cup and giving thanks, he said, Take this and share it among yourselves.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm daa ti yɛli biasani, Ti ba kurigiya, ka dɔbba mi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni n-ni kpuɣi ti kaman bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni la.
en: One day the older daughter said to the younger, Everywhere on the earth, men and women marry and have a family. But our father is old, and there are no men around here to give us children.

dag: A dimnim yi lu, nyin di chɛ ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, bɛ yi tuui, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.

dag: Samarianim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda paɣ la ni daa yɛli ni Yisa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa o ni pun niŋ la zuɣu.
en: Many of the Samaritan people in that town believed in Jesus. They believed because of what the woman had told them about him. She had told them, He told me everything I have ever done.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka zuɣulaannim su bɛ niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam su niriba su ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Every ruler on earth governs with my help, officials and nobles alike.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ bɔhi, Zom ni tooi vo o zoon kpee ka bɛ zaa ti ku lula bɔɣili ni?.
en: Jesus told them this story: Can a blind man lead another blind man? No. Both of them will fall into a ditch.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba shɛb bɛn daa zo nti sɔɣi Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tinsi ni la gba ni daa wum ni Filistianim maa ŋmaligi guui n-zɔri ni bɛ tiligi maa, ka bɛ gba daa dii lo kpara zo n-doli tuhiri ba.
en: All the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard the Philistine soldiers were running away. So these Israelites also joined in the battle and began chasing the Philistines.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim maa jilima la ni ti kpaai kaman fiig tihi walibu saha tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu ni yi luna ka bɛ pihi li, ka di nuu ni paabu n-to ka bɛ pun di li la.
en: That city sits on a hill with a rich valley around it. But that beautiful crown of flowers is just a dying plant. It will be like the first figs of summer. As soon as someone sees a ripe one, they pick it and eat it.

dag: nti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee yɛn ti ma ka n chɛ ka Yisa kpe yi nuu ni? Ka bɛ daa ti o anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihita.
en: and said, What will you give me if I turn Jesus over to you? They paid him thirty pieces of silver.

dag: amaa ti bi mi din chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, ti mi bi mi ŋun neeg o nina maa. O mi pala bia; bɔhimiy o; omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ya.
en: But we do not know how it is that he is now able to see, nor do we know who cured him of his blindness. Ask him; he is old enough, and he can answer for himself.

dag: ni Ɛla bia Shimɛi ŋun daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni.
en: Shimei son of Ela was governor of Benjamin.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun ka buchi ka saɣim, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu leeg o kom nyuri ŋɔ yɛla?.
en: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin.

dag: bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: What will people give in exchange for their lives?.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi ka n sanna, yi daa bi je ma mi ka kari ma yi ya.
en: So Isaac asked, Why have you now come to see me, when you were so unfriendly to me before and made me leave your country.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa di nam ʒila Pɛriʒianim tinzuɣu din yuli daa booni Susa la. O daa di nam maa n-sula tiŋgbana kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Ŋuna n-daa su India tiŋgbɔŋ zaŋ hal ni Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: This is what happened during the time when Xerxes was king. Xerxes ruled over the provinces from India to Ethiopia.

dag: O ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la, o daa pola pɔri pahi alikauli maa zuɣu ti Yisahaku.
en: which he made with Abraham, the solemn pledge he swore to Isaac.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; Naawuni, kpuɣim a nuu zuɣusaa, di tam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu yɛla.
en: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anabinim sabbu niŋ pali. Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But all these things have happened to show the full meaning of what the prophets wrote. Then all of Jesus followers left him and ran away.

dag: Amaa paɣisar shɛb bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la, chɛliya bɛna n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi paɣiba.
en: but keep alive for yourselves all the girls and all the women who are virgins.

dag: Ka bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa daa sɔŋ ba n-ti ba anzinfa nɛma mini salima ni nɛma ni biŋkɔbiri ni binshɛŋa din mali bukaata m-pahi niriba suhu ni daa yu ka bɛ ti binshɛlikam zaa.
en: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma a yuli zuɣu. Wuhim ni n ka taali a kpiɔŋ zuɣu!.
en: God, use your power and save me. Use your great power to set me free.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la, ka di zaŋ yaɣ yini hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: They made the middle bar, which was halfway up the boards, run from one end to the other.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a tim ma na?.
en: Moses left them and prayed, Our Lord , why have you brought so much trouble on your people? Is that why you sent me here?.

dag: Yi ni ti vili yi baŋtabisi, ka piri yi namda. Di ti fabiliya bee n-kum, amaa yi tuumbiɛri ni ti ʒin ya chaŋ, ka yi ti ŋuhira niŋdi taba.
en: You will wear your turbans and your sandals. You will not show your sadness publicly or cry publicly, but you will waste away with guilt and talk to each other quietly about your grief.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninsalinim ni tooi nya alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: I promise you that any of the sinful things you say or do can be forgiven, no matter how terrible those things are.

dag: Di saha ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yaba, n suhir a mi ni a tim Lazarɔs m ba yiŋa dunia ni.
en: But the rich man said, Abraham, then please send Lazarus to my father's home.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, yuma ayopɔin din yɛn dolina puuni, kum ni ti lu, ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, kum maa ni ti dam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim pam.
en: After them, seven years of famine will appear, and all of the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten. The famine will devastate the land.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yɛda niriba bɛn dir o nuu ni nti yɛn luh o; ka o tɔbbihi ti wurim, ka bɛ ku bɛ ni pam mi.
en: Those who eat the kings provisions will destroy him. His army will be overrun. Many will die.

dag: Zuɣulaannim kul nahindi ma mi ka di ka soli, amaa n kul lurila a yɛligu sizuura n suhu ni.
en: Powerful leaders attack me for no reason, but the only thing I fear is your command.

dag: Ka Pita min o tuuntab maa garigi yɛli ba, Di simdi ni ti deela Naawuni noli ka pa ni ninsalinim noli;.
en: Peter and the other apostles answered, We must obey God, not men.

dag: Ti mabihi, yimaŋmaŋ mi ni ti ni daa ka yi sanna la pala din kpalim yoli.
en: Our friends, you yourselves know that our visit to you was not a failure.

dag: Dama n ni moli Yawɛ yuli. Yɛlimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ galisim yɛla!.
en: because I proclaim the LORDs name: Give praise to our God!.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Inan bia Ahira sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira, Enans son.

dag: Jɛrigu ni lo shɛli nyɛla alahichi, ka ansarisimaana mi nyɛ sokam ni je ninvuɣ so.
en: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti o yiko ni o su daadam kam fukumsi, ka niŋ o yiko ni o ti ninvuɣ shɛb zaa a ni zaŋ ti o nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: You gave the Son power over all people so that he could give eternal life to all those you have given to him.

dag: Ka o daa ka naa Ɛhab sanna, ka naa bɔhi, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni nya nasara, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: When he appeared before King Ahab, the king asked him, Micaiah, should King Jehoshaphat and I go and attack Ramoth, or not? Attack! Micaiah answered. Of course you'll win. The Lord will give you victory.

dag: ni bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ alahichinim nuu ni ka bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu, amaa ni di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni la.
en: The Son of Man must be handed over to sinners, be crucified, and three days later rise to life.

dag: Bɛ yihi laɣ shɛli bɛ ni nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛ tumtumdiba maa.
en: They have collected the money from the temple and have given it to the men supervising the repairs.

dag: Bɛ balim ti ni nimmoo ni ti ti ba soli ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuu kpɛhi Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu ni.
en: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni n kul lɔri nia ni n ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ yi ni shɛb ka bɛ niŋ Yisa yɛda kaman n ni pun niŋ shɛm bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb san la; amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa kul guri ma soli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that I planned to visit you many times, although I have been prevented from coming until now. I want to harvest some fruit among you, just as I have done among the other Gentiles.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu niriba maa zuɣu bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Aduna mali naɣibil so la zuɣu.
en: Then the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they did with the bull calf that Aaron made.

dag: Ka naa maa daa mali saawara, ka zaŋ salima mali naɣilabih ayi zali; ka yɛli niriba maa, Yi chani Jɛrusalɛm ka di saha wɔɣa. Izraɛlnima, nyamiya yi buɣa bɛn daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: So the king asked his advisors what to do. They gave him their advice, and King Jeroboam made two golden calves. He said to the people, You dont have to go to Jerusalem to worship anymore. Israel, these are the gods that brought you out of Egypt. .

dag: Ka o daa leei ŋun be naa sani gbib o. Paɣisarili maa daa viɛli pam; amaa naa daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali.
en: She was very beautiful. She cared for the king and served him, but King David did not have sexual relations with her.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb tuumbiɛri taali paŋ ba min o ni kpihim shɛb daalahichi mal alibarika.
en: Happy are those whose wrongs are forgiven, whose sins are pardoned!.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ nabia alali, ka di zuɣulaannim diri di ni simdi ni bɛ diri saha shɛli ni bɛ nya kpiɔŋ ka pa ni bɛ nyu m-buɣi, di tiŋgbɔŋ maa mal alibarika.
en: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka n sɔɣi. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti yɛri ma, Yiɣimi kaman nooŋa la n-chaŋ zoya zuɣu?.
en: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, Escape like a bird to the mountains.

dag: Yi ni daa chaŋ Ijipti la, nyo bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Nail Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu? Bee yi ni daa chaŋ Asiria la, bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Yufretiiz Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu?.
en: What do you think you will gain by going to Egypt to drink water from the Nile? What do you think you will gain by going to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?.

dag: Ka Zɛdɛkia ŋun daa nyɛ Chɛnaana bia la daa zaŋ kuriti kuri binyila kɔtomsi ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Dimbɔŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe n-ku Sirianim maa zaa. .
en: One of them, Zedekiah son of Chenaanah, made iron horns and said to Ahab, This is what the Lord says: With these you will fight the Syrians and totally defeat them.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti paai zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa yi jɛmdi Naawuni la, nyama, ka Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la daa chɛh omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu n-ka Naa Dauda sanna.
en: When David got to the top of the mountain, he bowed down to worship God. Then David noticed Hushai the Arkite. Hushais coat was torn, and there was dust on his head.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛ nandaamba, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi nyɛ bundaannima. Ŋuna n-filindi nira, ŋuna n-lan duhiri nira.
en: The Lord makes some poor, and he makes others rich. He humbles some people, and he honors others.

dag: So ka ti sunsuuni ŋun ni tooi gooi ti.
en: But there is no one to step between us— no one to judge both God and me.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Nyin Ahitub bia ŋɔ wumma. Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, n wumda.
en: Saul told them, Listen to me, you son of Ahitub. Certainly, Your Majesty, Ahimelech answered.

dag: Bɛ nam maa ni ti gbarigi gari nam kam, ka bɛ ti ku lan duhi bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛba, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ kpalim biɛla din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan su zuliya shɛba yaha.
en: the weakest kingdom of all, and they will never again rule other nations. I will make them so unimportant that they will not be able to bend any other nation to their will.

dag: pa yi suhu ni tɛha yɛla ka n yɛri maa, amaa dilan maa suhu ni tɛha. So ni bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka so ni tooi zaŋ o suhu ni tɛha yɛla gu n ni mali yolisim shɛli soli?.
en: Now when I say conscience I dont mean yours but the other persons. Why should my freedom be judged by someone elses conscience?.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi liɣiri da puu maa ka bo shɛhiranima hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ Kalidianim nuu ni maa zaa yoli.
en: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians?.

dag: Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli vuri yi Jɛrusalɛm na; ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani sɔhira. Amaa Yawɛ sani n-nyɛ o niriba sɔɣibu shee; Izraɛlnim sɔɣibu viɛlli shee m-bala.
en: The Lord God will shout from Zion. He will shout from Jerusalem, and the sky and the earth will shake. But the Lord God will be a safe place for his people. He will be a place of safety for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli niriba maa, Miligimiya ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ suɣa shee, ka di shihiya bɛ binshɛɣu, di yi pa lala bɛ daalahichi maa zaa ni ʒin ya chaŋ.
en: He said to the people, Get away from the tents of these wicked men and don't touch anything that belongs to them. Otherwise, you will be wiped out with them for all their sins.

dag: ka so mi yi yihi shɛli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, Naawuni ni yih o tarili nyɛvili tia la mini tiŋ kasi shɛli din yɛla sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la ni.
en: If anyone takes away from the words of this scroll of prophecy, God will take away that persons share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this scroll.

dag: Yisa mabihi maa ni daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni nyaaŋa ka o gba daa ti yiɣisi chaŋ chuɣu maa ni ashilɔni.
en: After his brothers had gone to the festival, Jesus also went; however, he did not go openly, but secretly.

dag: Di di daa simdi ni a zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni, n ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: In that case, you should have turned my money over to the bankers so that when I returned, you could give me what belonged to me with interest.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Mbaye! Yawɛ zaŋla ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: We're done for! King Joram exclaimed. The Lord has put the three of us at the mercy of the king of Moab.

dag: N ni daa nya o maa, ka n lu n-dɔni o tooni m-be kaman kpim la. Amaa ka o zaŋ o nudirigu m-pa n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; mani n-nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: When I saw him, I fell down at his feet like a dead man. He placed his right hand on me and said, Don't be afraid! I am the first and the last.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli Gidiɔn, Ti ni zaŋ li ti a ni ti suhuri zaa. Ka bɛ daa teei binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka sokam zaa zaŋd o ni ŋme n-di tibikpar shɛŋa na ti pari di zuɣu.
en: The Israelites said to Gideon, We will gladly give you what you want. So they put a coat down on the ground, and each man threw an earring onto the coat.

dag: Ŋariŋ kara pala di kom zuɣu chana, ka Lɛviatan be di ni diɛmda.
en: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.

dag: ka gbaan o tooni, di yi pa lala, o suhu ni yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka yi bahi yoli soli ni, dama o suhu yiɣisiri yomyom. Bɛnkam zaa sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: Show that you are loyal to his son, or the Lord will be angry and destroy you. He is almost angry enough to do that now, but those who go to him for protection will be blessed.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa lihi paɣiba maa yɛligu maa kaman lahibal kpɛma, ka daa bi dihi li tabili. .
en: The apostles thought it was all nonsense, and they would not believe.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Wahu n-yɔhim ma ka n di li.
en: The LORD God said to the woman, What have you done?! And the woman said, The snake tricked me, and I ate.

dag: Ka Hilikia daa yɛli Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la, N nyala zaligu kundi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni; ka o daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan.
en: Hilkiah handed the book to Shaphan the official and said, Look what I found here in the temple— The Book of God's Law .

dag: Tin shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari dunia zaa lu n-dahim. Babilɔn leela tin shɛli din yɛla mali zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: Babylonia hammered the whole world to pieces, and now that hammer is shattered! All the nations are shocked at what has happened to that country.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtɛl maligumaana Amazia daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam, Amɔs yila a nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim sani. O yɛtɔɣa muɣila tiŋgbani maa.
en: Then Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, reported to Israels King Jeroboam, Amos has plotted against you within the house of Israel. The land isnt able to cope with everything that he is saying.

dag: Amaa wula ka n yɛn yɛli? Dama o pun yɛli ma ni omaŋmaŋa n-niŋ li. Ka n suhu saɣim pam, ka n kɔŋ gom.
en: What can I say? God has spoken to me; he himself has acted. I will wander my whole life with a bitter spirit.

dag: Bɛ teei gili ba kaman puguliba ni niŋdi shɛm la, bɛ ni taai duŋ zaɣisi ma la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and will surround Jerusalem like men guarding a field, because her people have rebelled against the Lord . The Lord has spoken.

dag: Asha zuliya tiŋgbani wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Naftali zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Asher from the eastern border to the western border: Naphtali, one portion.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yir o nyɛvoya ni na, ka buɣimniɛm din diri binyɛra yir o nol ni na; ka sala buɣimniɛm yir o sanna.
en: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.

dag: Amaa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Naa Amɔn nyaaŋa maa zaa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia leei naa zal o zaani.
en: The people of Judah killed Amon's assassins and made his son Josiah king.

dag: Tiŋbihi mini saamba zaa zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini; dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: This law applies to all of you, to Israelites and to foreigners living among you, because I am the Lord your God.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, chibimi gooni maa voli. N ni daa chibi gooni maa ka di niŋ voli.
en: He said to me: Human one, dig through the wall. So I dug through the wall, and I discovered a doorway.

dag: Ka m mi ni n yi ti ka yi sanna n ni ʒi Masia daalibarika din galisi pam na.
en: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.

dag: dama n niŋ li mi ni yi nya ka mi niŋdi taba kaman n ni niŋ ya shɛm maa.
en: I have given you an example: Just as I have done, you also must do.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi zo Firawuna suhuyiɣisili. O daa bi saɣi ni o lab o nyaaŋa; o daa bemi kaman o nini nyala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nir ni ku tooi nya so ŋɔ.
en: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.

dag: Ka yɛra, M Ba, m Ba, binshɛɣukam nand a sani. Vuum pipia ŋɔ ka chɛ ma; amaa chɛ ka a yubu niŋ, pa n dini.
en: He said, Abba, Father, for you all things are possible. Take this cup of suffering away from me. However—not what I want but what you want.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri tuma nyɛla zana gbahiri ba, ka bɛ daalahichi tuma gbahiri ba.
en: The sins of the wicked are a trap. They get caught in the net of their own sin.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni be kɔŋkɔba zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yisa leeg alikauli din so nyaanzaana.
en: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.

dag: O ni ti zan a zaani n-tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka a mi ti zani Naawuni zaani o sani.
en: He will be your spokesman and speak to the people for you. Then you will be like God, telling him what to say.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa din be kasi ti ma zaa, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi zaa ni di nyɛ yi dini sahakam. Di nyɛla yalim alikauli shɛli din yi man Yawɛ sanna ka n lo a min a zuliya maa sahakam.
en: I am giving to you, to your sons, and to your daughters, for all time to come, all the special contributions which the Israelites present to me. This is an unbreakable covenant that I have made with you and your descendants.

dag: Bɛn daa be o nuzaa polo n-daa nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi la, Ɛtan daa nyɛla Kish bia, ka Kish nyɛ Abidi bia, ka Abidi nyɛ Maluk bia.
en: Meraris descendants were the relatives of Heman and Asaph. They were the singing group on Hemans left side. Ethan was Kishis son. Kishi was Abdis son. Abdi was Malluchs son.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ bali Yisa nyaandoliba ni, ka bɛ daa zɔr o, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ yɛda ni o shiri nyɛla Yisa nyaandola.
en: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ matarika n-kuri salima chɛrubinim ayi tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yihi dɔro maa ni be kuɣ shɛŋa ni maa n-yihi tiŋ maa kpaŋa nti bahi tampuli zuɣu.
en: then he must order the people to tear out the stones with the mildew on them and throw them away. They must put these stones at a special unclean place outside the city.

dag: Amaa ka Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni ti gari, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o niŋ tipawumli maa ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni kaman o ni niŋ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But King Sihon would not let us pass through his country. The Lord your God had made him stubborn and rebellious, so that we could defeat him and take his territory, which we still occupy.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi m be duu, amaa suɣili ni ka n kul be ka yi mali ma ginda.
en: From the time I rescued the people of Israel from Egypt until now, I have never lived in a temple; I have traveled around living in a tent.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni bee bɛ yi ti yɛn chaŋ miri sara maligu bimbini maa ti tum tuma bee m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di simdi ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛmaŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: When they go into the meeting tent or approach the altar to minister and to offer a food gift to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they dont die.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa Arinɔn zaŋ ti paai Jabok n-lan zaŋ hal ni Ammɔnnim tintariga, dama Ammɔnnim daa gula bɛ tintariga viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Israelites struck him down with their swords and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the Ammonites, for the border of the Ammonites was fortified.

dag: Ti Duuma ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka a zom, ka di ni niŋ daba ayi ka a ku lan nya wuntaŋa. Ka paɣili mini zibisim dii kana ti to o, ka o go m-bɔhindi gindi bɔri so ni o vo o.
en: The Lord's hand will come down on you now; you will be blind and will not see the light of day for a time. At once Elymas felt a dark mist cover his eyes, and he walked around trying to find someone to lead him by the hand.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, din kariya ni n niŋ lala. N ni tooi nyu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima chaŋ ŋɔ ʒim? Dinzuɣu ka o daa bi nyu kom maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala.
en: and said, Lord , I could never drink this! It would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives! So he refused to drink it. Those were the brave deeds of the three famous soldiers.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-chaŋ ti kum; ka lan lab bɛ sanna nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Ka o daa gbaai Simiɔn n-chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi bɛ zaa ninni.
en: He stepped away from them and wept. When he returned, he spoke with them again. Then he took Simeon from them and tied him up in front of them.

dag: ni Dan ni Naftali ni Gaad ni Asha.
en: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya maa tiŋgbani tariga. Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Rubin zuliya maa ni bɛ su li.
en: The Jordan was the western border of the tribe of Reuben. These were the cities and towns given to the families of the tribe of Reuben as their possession.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kom leei ʒim, ka chɛ ka bɛ zahim kpi.
en: God turned their waters into blood and killed their fish.

dag: N daa ko ʒiɛri puri mini tihi puri, ka tiwala balibu kam tihi be di ni.
en: I planted gardens, and I made parks. I planted all kinds of fruit trees.

dag: Bɛn nyari nahiŋgu mini nandaamba ni be di ni chani gindi ka mali bɛ naba nɔri li.
en: Those who were oppressed walk over it now and trample it under their feet.

dag: O chɛ ka Lɛbanɔn zoya yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman naɣibil la; ka chɛ ka Siriɔn Zoli gba yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman yɔnaɣila bil la.
en: He makes Lebanon shake like a young calf dancing. Sirion trembles like a young bull jumping up and down.

dag: Naawuni ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili din zooi pam niŋ bɛ puya ni ka di pali, ka o chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu na kaman saa la, ka di leei bɛ bindirigu.
en: Let God fill their belly, unleash his burning anger on them, rain punishing blows on them.

dag: Di saha n ni ti yihi n nuu maa ka chɛ ka a nya n nyaaŋa polo. Amaa n ninni din bi nyara.
en: Then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back. But you will not see my face.

dag: Ya polo ka ti lee chana? Ti mabihi maa ni labina ti yɛli shɛm maa chɛ ka ti suhuri fuŋ. Bɛ yɛliya, Niriba maa mali yaa ka lan wɔɣiwɔɣ gari ti, ka bɛ fɔntinsi maa galisi, ka bɛ me goma gil li hal ti taɣi sagbana. Hal ti nyala Anakinim nimaani. .
en: Where can we go now? The men we sent have frightened us with their report. They said, The people there are bigger and taller than we are. The cities are big and have walls as high as the sky. And we saw giants there.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra yɛli, N ni dol a chaŋ, amaa pa nyini nti yɛn nya a chandi maa nasara dibu jilima, dama Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka paɣa n-nyaŋ Sisɛra. Ka Dɛbɔra daa yiɣisi doli Barak chaŋ Kɛdɛshi.
en: Deborah answered, Ill definitely go with you. However, the path youre taking wont bring honor to you, because the LORD will hand over Sisera to a woman. Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.

dag: Ka gɔtihi maa tir o mahim, ka kuligara gil o niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The lotus plants hide him in their shade. He lives under the willow trees that grow near the river.

dag: Yɛl biɛr ayi n-yɛn paai ya; ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili sɔŋ ya? Yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni wurim, ka kum lu yi zuɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn maai yi suhuri?.
en: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛm saɣisigu, di ŋmanila salima nintua bee salima yɛri.
en: Wise advice to a listening ear is like gold earrings or fine jewelry.

dag: Yi yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ n kul timdila n daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna dabisili kam.
en: From the moment your ancestors left the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent you all my servants the prophets—day after day.

dag: M biyurisi bɛn nyɛ n ni lan wolisiri shɛb zuɣu ni Masia be yi ni ŋɔ.
en: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.

dag: Mani n-su mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa mini naɣ shɛb bɛn be zoya tusatusa shɛm zuɣu la.
en: all the animals in the forest are mine and the cattle on thousands of hills.

dag: n-yo bidibikpamba bɛn kalinli pani maa zuɣu Aduna min o bidibisi sani.
en: and give this money to Aaron and his sons.

dag: dama bɛ wahala dibu zahimbu pam nyabu puuni mini bɛ ni kul nyɛ faranim la zaa yoli, bɛ suhupiɛlli din galisi pam zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tɔhiri tɔto ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: These believers have been tested by great troubles, and they are very poor. But their great joy caused them to be very generous in their giving.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ tooni ha ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Then Jesus went with his followers to a place called Gethsemane. He said to them, Sit here while I go there and pray.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kpe Ijipti teeku ni ni bɛ gari, n ni chɛ ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni, ka Nail Mɔɣili bulli la leei tiŋ kuŋ. Ka Asirianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la ti nya filiŋ, ka Ijiptinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ la mi kɔŋ yiko.
en: They will go through a sea of troubles, but the waves will be stopped. Even the deepest waters of the Nile River will dry up. I will destroy Assyrias pride and take away Egypts power.

dag: Ka do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias min o paɣ Safira bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni su shɛli kɔhi.
en: There was a man named Ananias. His wifes name was Sapphira. Ananias sold some land he had.

dag: bɛ muɣisigu zaa ni. Pa malaika ka o daa tim na, amaa ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-daa tiligi ba. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim zuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba. Ŋuna n-daa pun gbib ba piligu ni ha.
en: The people had many troubles, but he was not against them. He loved them and felt sorry for them, so he saved them. He sent his special angel to save them. He picked them up and carried them, just as he did long ago.

dag: Ka Akishi daa zaŋ Zikilag ti o dindali maa, dinzuɣu ka Juda nanim na kul su Zikilag hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Achish gave the town of Ziklag to David at that time. Thats why Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah until now.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: These are the Simeonite clans, .

dag: Neesim viɛla, ka nina yi nya wuntaŋa, di viɛla.
en: It is good to be alive. It is nice to see the light from the sun.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi nyala daŋa, dindina yin doliya zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: But if the woman was hurt badly, then the man who hurt her must be punished. The punishment must fit the crime. You must trade one life for another life.

dag: dɔbba bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. A mini Aduna sabimi bɛ yuya kaman bɛ daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: twenty years old or older who are fit for military service.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A ba mi ni a yuri ma, ka tɛhi ni di bi simdi ni a baŋ di yɛla, dama a yi baŋ di yɛla, di ni saɣim a suhu pam. Amaa yɛlimaŋli, hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu ni nyin ŋumbɔŋɔ gba zuɣu, m mini kum kul chɛla tab kpe ni kpe.
en: But David answered, Your father knows very well how much you like me, and he has decided not to let you know what he plans to do, because you would be deeply hurt. I swear to you by the living Lord that I am only a step away from death.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛl o, Zɔri, m bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Peter replied, I don't know what you are talking about! Right then, while Peter was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

dag: Cham niriba ŋɔ sani ti yɛli ba: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: to tell our ancestors, Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanim nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe ma yim baabiɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *.

dag: Zimiri ni daa kul di n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Baasha daŋ niriba zaa. O daa ku dɔbba bɛn nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba min o zɔnim zaa.
en: As soon as Zimri became king, he killed everyone in Baasha's family. Not one man or boy in his family was left alive—even his close friends were killed.

dag: N kukoli daa niŋla kukol bila ka bi kpɛma, ka n daa bamdi kaman ŋmani la. N daa lihila zuɣusaa hal ka n nina ti fulim. N Duuma, yihim ma muɣisigu ŋɔ ni.
en: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord . I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.

dag: Ka a nudirigu nini yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini, di so ni bɛ ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ zaa kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: If your right eye makes you sin, take it out and throw it away. It is better to lose one part of your body than to have your whole body thrown into hell.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti mooni Masia molo n-kpamdi sokam jaande, ka wuhiri sokam baŋsim zaa puuni ni di chɛ ka sokam zooi m-bi niriba Masia ni, ka ti zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino tahi Naawuni sani.
en: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.

dag: Chɛliya ka m bɔhi ya bin yini ŋɔ kɔŋko yɛla: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini di yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa?.
en: Tell me this one thing: did you receive God's Spirit by doing what the Law requires or by hearing the gospel and believing it?.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim paɣila mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: King Solomon made two hundred body-sized shields of hammered gold, using fifteen pounds of gold in each shield.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaayi la yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, a daa zaŋla pɔŋ tusaayi ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaayi nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: Then the servant who got two bags of money came to the master. The servant said, Master, you gave me two bags of money to care for. So I used your two bags to earn two more.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti yi Ramɛsis maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Sukɔt.
en: The Israelites left Rameses and traveled to Succoth.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa je a ka zaɣis a, ka so bi kpɛr a ni la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ ka a galisi ka mali jilima, ka lan chɛ ka a nyɛ luɣ shɛli suhupiɛlli ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: Some people brought their children to Jesus so he could bless them by placing his hands on them. But his disciples told the people to stop bothering him.

dag: Hal bɛmaŋmaŋ nam puuni min a ni niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli pam shɛl la puuni ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn tital shɛli din mali kulim ti ba la zaa yoli, bɛ daa zaɣis a jɛmbu, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: With your blessing, kings ruled your people when they lived in the broad, fertile land you gave them; but they failed to turn from sin and serve you.

dag: ka tahima niŋbu mi zuɣu ku chɛ ka ti suhuri miligi, dama Naawuni zaŋ o yurilim niŋ ti suhuri ni o Shia Kasi so o ni zaŋ ti ti la zuɣu.
en: This hope does not disappoint us, for God has poured out his love into our hearts by means of the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to us.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti liri Midiannim maa, dama n zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: That night the LORD said to him, Get up and attack the camp, because Ive handed it over to you.

dag: Ka n daa lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya chɛchɛbunsi anahi ka di yi daanya zoya ayi sunsuuni na.
en: I looked up again and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains; the mountains were made of bronze.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A ba mi ni a yuri ma, ka tɛhi ni di bi simdi ni a baŋ di yɛla, dama a yi baŋ di yɛla, di ni saɣim a suhu pam. Amaa yɛlimaŋli, hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu ni nyin ŋumbɔŋɔ gba zuɣu, m mini kum kul chɛla tab kpe ni kpe.
en: But David answered, Your father knows very well that I am your friend. Your father said to himself, Jonathan must not know about it. If he knows, he will tell David. But as surely as you and the Lord are alive, I am very close to death.

dag: A yi yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu, nyin lum o sizuura. A yi vu m-miri ti wum, di so jɛra ni maani sara shɛli, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu.
en: Be careful about going to the Temple. It is better to go there to learn than to offer sacrifices like foolish people who don't know right from wrong.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ kpalua ni wuɣi tan piɛl viɛl shɛli n-she zabbanim ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: They also made the tunics woven out of fine linen for Aaron and his sons.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim daa yɛli nabihi mini niriba maa zaa, Doo ŋɔ simdi kubu, dama o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi ya ŋɔ ka yi zaa wum li.
en: The priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people: This man deserves to die for prophesying against this city as you have all heard firsthand.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni, ka di bi simdi ni n tam o nirilim yɛla.
en: Let my whole being bless the LORD and never forget all his good deeds.

dag: A bia maa ni ti bemi kaman mɔɣu ni buŋ la. O ti ku bɔri so yɛla, ka so gba ti ku bɔr o yɛla; ka o min o dɔɣiriba zaa ti ku tooi laɣim be.
en: He will be a wild mule of a man; he will fight everyone, and they will fight him. He will live at odds with all his relatives.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa be faranim ni mal alibarika; bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba.
en: Those who pay close attention to the poor are truly happy! The LORD rescues them during troubling times.

dag: Wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka bi wandi wala, o ŋmari li mi bahi, amaa wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka wandi wala, o wahirila di wulli maa nyoya ni bahiri ni di maan wali pam pahi.
en: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Aduna min o bidibisi tarili bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba zali ni bɛ leei man Yawɛ maligumaaniba la, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ba.
en: This is what Aaron and his sons are allotted from the LORDs food gifts once they have been presented to serve the LORD as priests.

dag: Pool min o nyaaŋa maa ni daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka niriba maa daa balim ba ni bɛ lan labimina Vuhim Dabisili din kanna dali nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to come back the next Sabbath and tell them more about these things.

dag: Yisa daa yiɣisi bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni yi n-chaŋ ti kpɛla Saimɔn yiŋa; ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii pam, ka bɛ balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simons house. Simons mother-in-law was very sick. She had a high fever. They asked Jesus to do something to help her.

dag: Baalihanan ni daa ti kpi, Hadad n-daa di nam zan o zaani, o ya yuli n-daa booni Pai, o paɣ yuli n-daa booni Mɛhɛtabɛl, Mɛhɛtabɛl ma yuli n-daa booni Matirɛd, ka o yabipaɣa mi yuli daa booni Mɛzahab.
en: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.

dag: Naawuni, wuhimi n ni ka taali shɛm, ka zabi n zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri sani, ka fa ma ʒiŋmariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu soli nuu ni bahi.
en: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bua, ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If the offering is a goat, you must present it before the LORD.

dag: Malimiya shili kaman yi daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni daa piripiri ya kaman Izraɛl Naa Dauda ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la ni kaman o bia Sulemaana ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la.
en: Organize yourselves by families according to your divisions, as directed by Israels King David and his son Solomon.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: Your faithful people, Lord , will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka yihi Juda zuliya mini Simiɔn zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti ni boli tin shɛŋa yuya ŋɔ tinsi shɛŋa ti ba.
en: They gave these towns, which they designated by name, by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa garigi yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ ka di pooi bee n-niŋ ka di yaɣi.
en: But Balaam answered, Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not disobey the command of the Lord my God in even the smallest matter.

dag: M pun nya jɛra ni maani bɛ biɛhigu shee, amaa ka n yɛli noli niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee maa libigi ba.
en: I have seen fools who looked secure, but I called down a sudden curse on their homes.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha ka Juda Naa Jɔash bia Naa Amazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Amaziah son of King Joash of Judah became king in the second year that Jehoash son of Jehoahaz was king of Israel.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa ŋmaligi guui ka kuhi yɛli Ahazia, Nyaanyibo yɛtɔɣa m-bala.
en: Then Joram turned his chariot around and fled. He shouted to Ahaziah, Its a trap, Ahaziah.

dag: Yi daa nya n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la mini n ni daa zaŋ ya tam tɔra kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ sanna la.
en: You saw what I did to the Egyptians, and how I lifted you up on eagles wings and brought you to me.

dag: Nir yi daŋ tooni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa o malila yɛlimaŋli, faashee o mini ŋun mali taba maa ti kana ti bɔh o bɔhigunima.
en: The first person to speak in court always seems right until his opponent begins to question him.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu Abib goli ni, dama Abib goli maa ni yuŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Wait for the month of Abib, at which time you must perform the Passover for the LORD your God, because the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt at nighttime during the month of Abib.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya li ti ma na.
en: Jesus asked his disciples to bring the food to him.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Paɣiŋoo ŋun bi dɔɣi, mali suhupiɛlli! Nyin ŋun ʒi bia dɔɣibu wolisibu biɛrim ŋɔ, yaam a noli n-tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu! Dama bɛ ni chɛ paɣ so bahi mali bihi pam n-gari ŋun mali yidana.
en: Its written: Rejoice, barren woman, you who have not given birth . Break out with a shout, you who have not suffered labor pains; because the woman who has been deserted will have many more children than the woman who has a husband .

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A ni tɛhi ni a mali yɛm kaman wuni maa zuɣu.
en: Now then, this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: Because you think you are as wise as a god.

dag: M bi bɔri mmaŋ jilima tibu, amaa yino n-naɣ beni m-bɔri ni n nya jilima, ŋun mi n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: I don't want honor for myself. But there is one who wants me to be honored, and he is also the one who judges.

dag: Lala zuɣu bindir shɛli dibu yi nyɛla din ni luhi m mabia, dindina n kul ku ŋubi nimdi ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mabia lu.
en: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.

dag: Ka laɣiŋgu maa ni kpamba ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni maa.
en: the leaders of the community shall put their hands on its head, and it shall be killed there.

dag: Amazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛhɔadan. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Amaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.

dag: Di saɣimya Naawuni Shia Kasi suhu, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ so dalim ya n-wuhi ni dahin shɛli kanna ka o ni ti fan ya bahi zaa.
en: Dont make the Holy Spirit of God unhappy—you were sealed by him for the day of redemption.

dag: Ka o shi sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o.
en: Skin the bull and cut it up.

dag: Ka aŋgo zo maa vooi ko shɛli din leei wain maa ka bi baŋ di ni yi shɛli na, amaa yili maa ni bihi bɛn daa tooi kom maa bɛn daa mi. Ka o daa boli aŋgo na.
en: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over.

dag: Ka Dauda daa gbahi wɔribariba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pisi; ka daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa jila.
en: David took chariots, horse soldiers, and , foot soldiers from Hadadezer. He crippled all but of the chariot horses.

dag: Jɛhoyachin daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as all his ancestors had done.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn sɔŋ ya n-nyɛ: Rubin zuliya ni, Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: These are the names of the men who will assist you: from Reuben, Elizur, Shedeurs son.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti naai, n ni darigi Babilɔn naa maa min o niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tibili, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa kpalim zani dabari sahakam.
en: But when the years have passed, I will punish the king of Babylon. I will punish the nation of Babylon. This message is from the Lord . I will punish the land of the Babylonians for their sins. I will make that land a desert forever.

dag: Ka Iso bɔh o ba, M ba, ka daɣila alibarika zaɣ yini kɔŋko ka a kul mali? M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni. Ka Iso daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: Esau said to his father, Do you really have only one blessing, Father? Bless me too, my father! And Esau wept loudly.

dag: amaa ka daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama sokam zaa zaɣa daa kul bela o wuhibu maa ni.
en: But they did not know how they could do it, because everyone was listening to him. The people were very interested in what Jesus said.

dag: Ka o daa lu soli n-kariti anab maa naba nti nya o ka o ʒila oki tia gbini, ka o bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ anab so ŋun yi Juda na la? Ka o garigi yɛli Iin, mani.
en: He went after the man of God and found him sitting underneath a terebinth tree. He said to him, Are you the man of God who came from Judah? I am, he replied.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim Yawɛ ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Moses told the Israelites everything the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria, ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria; di zaŋdiya tab taali, ka Naawuni ti ku zaŋ yi gba taali; chɛliya yi tab taali paŋmi ba, ka Naawuni ti chɛ m-paŋ yi gba.
en: Do not judge others, and God will not judge you; do not condemn others, and God will not condemn you; forgive others, and God will forgive you.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: This is the work that the men of the Gershonite family group must do for the Meeting Tent. Ithamar son of Aaron the priest will be responsible for their work.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being? They thought it over and said to each other, We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Yisa ka bɔhiri taba, Yi lee zahimla wula? O ni ka Chuɣu ŋɔ ni na bee o ku kana.
en: They were looking for Jesus. As they spoke to each other in the temple, they said, What do you think? He wont come to the festival, will he.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti yili yila yɛl o ni yur o wain tihi pu shɛl la yɛla.
en: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu m-mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: Make the poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.

dag: Amaa ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa zɔri Naawuni ka bi niŋdi Ijipti naa ni daa yɛli ni bɛ niŋm shɛm maa, bɛ daa bi kuri bidibbihi maa.
en: But the two women were faithful to God and did not kill the boys, even though the king had told them to.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin maa dali di simdi ni maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa yaha; ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi bi yɛligi, ka kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim mi ka di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni.
en: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep.

dag: ka yɛli ma, Kɔniilius, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina shɛm la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: and said: Cornelius! God has heard your prayer and has taken notice of your works of charity.

dag: Ti tumdi din yiɣisiri ti Duuma suhu, ka o zabiri nyuli di zuɣu? Ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o?.
en: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina ti yɛli Yaakubu, Ti chaŋ a biɛli Iso sani, ka o zaŋ ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kanna ni o ti tuh a soli.
en: When the messengers came back to Jacob, they said, We went to your brother Esau, and he is already on his way to meet you. He has four hundred men with him.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: So suhu yi yɛya ni o leei cheechi toondana, o ni bɔri tuun shɛli maa nyɛla tuun suŋ.
en: This saying is reliable: if anyone has a goal to be a supervisor in the church, they want a good thing.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma kaman Yawɛ ni daa tim o ka o ti tum tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-jɛndi Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa la.
en: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.

dag: Yaakubu min o malibu yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Yisifu ŋun yuma daa nyɛ yuun pinaayopɔin la min o biɛyanim bɛn daa nyɛ o ba paɣiba Biliha mini Zilipa bihi la n-daa guli bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri. Ka Yisifu daa zaŋdi bɛ tuumbiɛri yɛtɔɣa na ti yɛri bɛ ba.
en: and this is the story of his family. When Jacob's son Joseph was years old, he took care of the sheep with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah. But he was always telling his father all sorts of bad things about his brothers.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Haman, Niriba maa mini bɛ liɣiri maa zaa nyɛla a dini, niŋm bɛ min li a ni yu shɛm.
en: The king told him, The people and their money are yours; do as you like with them.

dag: ni Jɛziriil ni Jokidiyam ni Zanɔa.
en: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu n ni kum ka fabili. N ni chaŋ napɔnzaŋa ni n zaɣim. N ni fabili kaman yɔbahi la, ka kum kaman taatahi la.
en: I will be very sad about what will happen. I will go without sandals and clothes. I will cry like a dog. I will mourn like a bird.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ kpa shɛli din be o nuu ni maa shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun niŋ alahichi sanyoo sara binʒim ʒe la.
en: The priest will then put some of the oil that is in his hand on the right earlobe, the right thumb, and the right big toe of the person needing purification—on top of the same places as the blood of the compensation offering.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini nimmaŋtali gbibi sokam zaa.
en: David ruled over all Israel and made sure that his people were always treated fairly and justly.

dag: Ka wula ka yi ni tooi zaŋ binshɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ maai n suhu? Yi lan ka yi ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm naɣila ʒiri kɔŋko.
en: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.

dag: O yuli n-daa du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa, ka o leei bɛ kpɛma. Amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya ʒii yuŋ ka ti Duuma yɛl o di ni, Di zɔri dabiɛm; kul yihim waazu maa ka di shini!.
en: One night the Lord said to Paul in a vision, Dont be afraid. Continue speaking. Dont be silent.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bol o na ti yɛl o, Nyin zaɣ yoli ŋɔ! A ni daa balim ma la, n daa bi ku a samli la zaa ti a?.
en: His master called the first servant and said, You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you appealed to me.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal bɛ ni kul mali kpiɔŋ ka lan galisi maa zaa yoli, n ni ku n-naa ba. Hal n ni daa chɛ ka yi di wahala la, n ku lan chɛ ka yi di wahala yaha.
en: But the Lord says, Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa lihirila a ninni ni a ti ba bɛ bindirigu di tibu saha.
en: Lord, all living things depend on you. You give them food at the right time.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti yuri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni bihi. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti yuri Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima.
en: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.

dag: Ka a ti lan mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbambiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: Attach two other gold rings to the lower inside corners next to the vest.

dag: Bundaannim di yo n-gari lala, faranim mi di yo ka di pooi laɣifu pirigili maa saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yo li yi nyɛviya zuɣu kaman sara maligu la Yawɛ sani.
en: When you bring this gift offering to the LORD to pay compensation for your lives, the rich shouldnt give more and the poor shouldnt give less than the half shekel.

dag: Ti daa ʒiɛm o ka zaɣis o. O daa nyɛla ŋun mili suhugarigu mini wahala dibu. O daa ŋmanila niriba ni ŋmaligiri bɛ nina bahiri kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ so. Ti daa ʒiɛm o, ka bi lih o ka o nyɛ shɛli.
en: He was despised and avoided by others; a man who suffered, who knew sickness well. Like someone from whom people hid their faces, he was despised, and we didnt think about him.

dag: ni Arivadnim ni Zɛmarinim ni Hamatinima.
en: Arvadites, Zemarites, and the people from Hamath.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Keenan Naa Jabin.
en: So on that day God brought down Canaans King Jabin before the Israelites.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ zaa daa dii pirigi bɛ binyɛra n-yɛrigi sɔŋ dunɔdura zuɣu ni o no li gari, ka piɛb kikaa ka kuhi yɛli, Jɛhu n-nyɛ naa.
en: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, Jehu is king.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Piimi dɔbba n-sa chaŋ ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Biɛɣuni n sa ni zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ n nuu ni n-chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli zuɣu.
en: Moses said to Joshua, Choose some men for us and go fight with Amalek. Tomorrow Ill stand on top of the hill with the shepherds rod of God in my hand.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika maa daa ti wum ni Pool yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu Bɛria ka chaŋ nimaani gba nti dimdi niriba maa tiba ni ni bɛ taai duŋ.
en: The Jews from Thessalonica learned that Paul also proclaimed Gods word in Beroea, so they went there too and were upsetting and disturbing the crowds.

dag: ni buɣijɛmbo ni baɣibuɣibo ni dimdi ni zabili ni nyuli zabbu ni suhuyiɣisili ni zunyuŋ ni naŋgbankpeeni ni tab woligibu.
en: idolatry, drug use and casting spells, hate, fighting, obsession, losing your temper, competitive opposition, conflict, selfishness, group rivalry.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord told Moses and Aaron.

dag: Amaa ka Diɔnisius ŋun daa nyɛ Ariɔpagus jintɔriba ni yino la mini paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Damaris m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛba daa niŋ yɛda, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool.
en: Some people joined him and came to believe, including Dionysius, a member of the council on Mars Hill, a woman named Damaris, and several others.

dag: Ka o zuɣuri la ni yini daa mali dan titali din ŋmani din yɛn ku o; amaa ka daa lee lan naai, ka di daa niŋ dunianim zaa alahiziba ka bɛ kab dol o.
en: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast.

dag: ni Shabɛtai mini Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu Samban ni tuma fukumsi la.
en: Shabbethai and Jozabad, prominent Levites in charge of the work outside the Temple.

dag: Bɛn daa po pɔri maa daa gari ninvuɣ pihinahi.
en: There were more than forty who planned this together.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o, dama o kɔŋko n-nyɛ Jɛrɔbɔam bi so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sɔɣi gballi ni; dama o kɔŋko ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ nini tiɣi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni.
en: All the people of Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He will be the only member of Jeroboam's family who will be properly buried, because he is the only one with whom the Lord , the God of Israel, is pleased.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Jɛhɔshafat, A ni saɣi pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka Jɛhɔshafat garigi yɛli Izraɛl naa, A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: And Ahab asked Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me to attack Ramoth? I am ready when you are, Jehoshaphat answered, and so are my soldiers and my cavalry.

dag: Dinzuɣu Samarianim maa ni daa paai Yisa sani bɛ daa balim o mi ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani; ka o daa kpalim niŋ dabisi muna ayi nimaani.
en: So when the Samaritans came to Jesus, they asked him to stay with them, and he stayed there two days.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti baŋ ni Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛligu nam dunia ŋɔ; dinzuɣu Naawuni daa zaŋla ti nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa n-nam ti nina ni nyari binshɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be ni ni alaafee, ka me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri. N yi ti kari bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn zaa lihi ʒiɛm ba la saria, bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will live there in safety. They will build houses and plant vineyards. I will punish all their neighbors who treated them with scorn, and Israel will be secure. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Sabbu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni nyɛla yɛl shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Yisa Masia ni o kahigi binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ wuh o daba. O daa timla o malaika o dabili Jɔn sani ka o ti kahigi li n-wuh o.
en: A revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. Christ made it known by sending it through his angel to his servant John.
