dag: M bilim ni zaa, n nyɛla nandahimalana ka miri kum. A ni kpɛhi ma dabiɛm shɛli chɛ ka n di wahala, ka n lan ka tahima.
en: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.

dag: Ka Judanim maa zaa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naa ni nyɛ ti daŋ ni nir zuɣu. Ka wula ka yi suhuri yiɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu? Yi nya ka ti dila naa binshɛli? Bee o ti ti la pini.
en: The men of Judah answered, We did it because the king is one of us. So why should this make you angry? He hasn't paid for our food nor has he given us anything.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim shɛb daa yi Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium na nti lɛbigi niriba maa suhuri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lab Pool kuɣa hal ti tɛhi ni o kpimi ka vu o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga.
en: Jews from Antioch and Iconium arrived and won the crowds over. They stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing he was dead.

dag: A ŋmanila abie tia, ka a biha be kaman di wala yila la.
en: Your stately form resembles a date palm, and your breasts are like clustered fruit.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa mi ni Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili soli mini kum soli sɔŋ ya.
en: This is what you should tell this people: The LORD says: Im setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋ yɛda ka suhi binshɛɣukam, yi ni nya li.
en: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa, Yimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni na.
en: Joshua did so.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa zani Ariɔpagus jintɔriba maa sunsuuni yɛli, Yinim Atɛnsinim ŋɔ, n nyaya ka yi doli yi jɛmbu soli viɛnyɛliŋga shɛlikam puuni.
en: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.

dag: Di saha n ni ti zaŋ firilanim lihi Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka shɛli ni ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Yawɛ ku niŋ din viɛla bee din bie la tibili.
en: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N dima n-niŋ ma lala maa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka daɣila a bɔri ni ti chaŋ ti sib li bahi.
en: An enemy has done this, he answered. The servants said to him, Do you want us to go and gather them.

dag: Yɛm shee wɔɣa, ka di biɛhigu shee zilim pam; ka di bo n-nya to pam.
en: All that happens is elusive and utterly unfathomable. Who can grasp it?.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka salo pam daa ti doli Yisa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli ba.
en: Many people were traveling with Jesus. He said to them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia pala ŋun mi Naawuni, dama Naawuni nyɛla yurilim.
en: Anyone who does not love does not know God, because God is love.

dag: Amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o zaŋ kpe Yisa sani; ka daa dula duu zuɣusaa ti chib voli n-zaŋ o min amaŋka maa tiri voli maa ni siɣisi li ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: Because of the crowd, however, they could find no way to take him in. So they carried him up on the roof, made an opening in the tiles, and let him down on his bed into the middle of the group in front of Jesus.

dag: Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka kanya n sanna. Wummiya n yɛligu, ka tiligi. N ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛli din ku yiɣisi, ka niŋ ya nirilim shɛli n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni niŋ Dauda la.
en: Listen now, my people, and come to me; come to me, and you will have life! I will make a lasting covenant with you and give you the blessings I promised to David.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Jɔn Baptaizira gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ŋun pɔri alizanda nam ni galisi gar o.
en: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.

dag: Yawɛ kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinima ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kaman biɛɣu pia dali, ka Yawɛ daa ku Nabal.
en: Ten days later, the Lord took his life.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali ka bɛ laɣim tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o daa pii kuɣikpɛriba ni bɛ kpe kuɣa ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: David gave an order for all foreigners living in Israel to be gathered together. He chose stonecutters from that group of foreigners. Their job was to cut stones ready to be used for building Gods Temple.

dag: N Duuma, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda dabisi muni zaa.
en: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.

dag: Ŋum mali Yawɛ yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka ti be ka puhiri ya maa.
en: The one who enters in the LORDs name is blessed; we bless all of you from the LORDs house.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka yi ni shɛb pam gbarigi ka ka alaafee, ka shɛb mi kpi.
en: That is why many of you are sick and weak, and several have died.

dag: Hal a ni daa mali shɛm piligu ni la, a ni ti mali gari lala dahin shɛli.
en: Your future will be brighter by far than your past.

dag: Di saɣi n-wum niriba ni fiɣisi toondana n-yɛli shɛm naɣila niriba ata bee ayi n-di li shɛhira.
en: Dont listen to someone who accuses an elder. You should listen to them only if there are two or three others who can say what the elder did wrong.

dag: ka din pahi anii gbaai Jɛshaya min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: Then they made the curtain to cover the entrance to the Tent. They used blue, purple, and red yarn and fine linen to make this curtain. And they wove pictures into it.

dag: Mɔri yi ti naai, ka mɔ pala bili, di saha ka bɛ chɛri zoya ni mɔri sɔŋda.
en: You cut the hay and then cut the grass on the hillsides while the next crop of hay is growing.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Izraɛl bidibisi maa yuya din sabi pa sariakaribo nyolɔrigu zuɣu la n-ye m-pa o nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee la, ka di nyɛ bɛ yɛla teebu shihirili Yawɛ sani sahakam.
en: When Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will wear this breastpiece engraved with the names of the tribes of Israel, so that I, the Lord , will always remember my people.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi ba n-zani dabisi biɛɣu dali, ka yi yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, yi shiri ni ba n-zani.
en: That is why you need to get Gods full armor. Then on the day of evil, you will be able to stand strong. And when you have finished the whole fight, you will still be standing.

dag: Dama Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: For Moses commanded, Respect your father and your mother, and, If you curse your father or your mother, you are to be put to death.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai and commanded him.

dag: Sokam ni tooi bir o bimbira ni suhudoo. Tihi din wandi wala ni wali, ka tiŋgban ni bindira niŋ, ka saa gba mi pam. N ni chɛ ka n ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ di binyara ŋɔ zaa daanfaani.
en: The seed is healthy: the vine will give its fruit. The land will give its produce; the heavens will give its dew. I will give the remnant of this people all these things.

dag: N yilikpɛrilaannima, n nya ka sarati ni paai ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni, ka di pala neen shɛŋa din be ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni bee ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ kɔŋko m-be barina ni, amaa timaŋmaŋ gba nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: Men, I see that our voyage will suffer damage and great loss, not only for the cargo and ship but also for our lives.

dag: ti lan zaɣisim a zaligunim maa yaha ka chaŋ ti kpuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din chihiri ŋɔ bipuɣinsi n-niŋ ti paɣiba? A ku je suli m-bahi ti yoli zaa kahikahi, ka chɛ ka ti ni so ku lan tiligi?.
en: Then how can we ignore your commandments again and intermarry with these wicked people? If we do, you will be so angry that you will destroy us completely and let no one survive.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli malaika maa ka o labis o takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni.
en: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.

dag: Ti chaŋya ka duu maa dunoya zaa kparimi kirikiri, ka dansarika guliba ʒe dunoya ni gu, amaa ka ti kparigi ka bi nya so duu maa ni.
en: We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.

dag: Ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, Doo maa yi di bi yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani, nir naan tooi zaŋ o bahi kpe.
en: Agrippa said to Festus, This man could have been released if he hadnt appealed to Caesar.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu, o ku chɛn ya bahi bee n-kun ya; o mi ku tam o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: He is a merciful God. He will not abandon you or destroy you, and he will not forget the covenant that he himself made with your ancestors.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura nyari alibarika.
en: A man who obeys the Lord will surely be blessed like this.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu saha, o bom naɣila pola ayopɔin mini piɛlahi ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dahin yini kam, ka lan bo bulaa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara dabisili kam.
en: On each of the seven days of the festival he is to sacrifice to the Lord seven bulls and seven rams without any defects and burn them whole. He is also to sacrifice a male goat each day as a sin offering.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛliya: N Duuma Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛ bindiriyubo leei zana mini tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ lu ka nya tibidarigibo.
en: And David says, May they be caught and trapped at their feasts; may they fall, may they be punished!.

dag: Ka Ahishar nyɛ ŋun su nayili fukumsi. Ka Abida bia Adɔniram mi nyɛ bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma zuɣulana.
en: In charge of the palace servants: Ahishar In charge of the forced labor: Adoniram son of Abda.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa shihir shɛŋa yi ni sa nya la zuɣu ka yi bɔri n shee maa, amaa yi ni sa ŋub bɔrɔbɔro la tiɣ la zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, I am telling you the truth: you are looking for me because you ate the bread and had all you wanted, not because you understood my miracles.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa ka o sanna, amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o sani paabu.
en: Jesus' mother and brothers came to him, but were unable to join him because of the crowd.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o di nyɛvili ŋɔ nyaɣisim ka nya dabisi suma, ŋun gbaam o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu, ka mi di chɛ ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa yir o nol ni na.
en: The Scriptures say, If you want to enjoy true life and have only good days, then avoid saying anything hurtful, and never let a lie come out of your mouth.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛdaya — kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: Here is a list of how many returned from each family of priests: descendants of Jeshua from the family of Jedaiah; , from the family of Immer; , from the family of Pashhur; and , from the family of Harim.

dag: A mi Naawuni ni zali ba o zaligu shɛm n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisir o sagbana ni ŋɔ?.
en: Do you realize that when God commands them, his clouds produce lightning?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Amaa Dauda ni daa nya ka o kpambaliba maa sɔɣiri yɛri tab maa ka o baŋ ni bia maa kpiya; ka bɔh o kpamba maa, Bia maa kpiya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O kpiya.
en: David saw his servants whispering and understood that the baby was dead. So David asked his servants, Is the baby dead? The servants answered, Yes, he is dead.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Bɛtilihɛm maa ka Mariama dɔɣibu saha paai.
en: While they were there, the time came for Mary to have her baby.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali: Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu; din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li? Ka bɛ daa fo.
en: Then Jesus asked the people, Which is the right thing to do on the Sabbath day: to do good or to do evil? Is it right to save a life or to destroy one? The people said nothing to answer him.

dag: ni lala chɛ ka bɛ dol o zalikpana, ka dol o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He did this so that his people would obey his laws and follow his teachings. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛliya ka lala niŋ; dama Yawɛ daa lo Naa Dauda alikauli yɛli, N dabili Dauda nuu ka n ti yɛn zaŋ fa n niriba Izraɛlnim Filistianim mini bɛ dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi. .
en: So do it! After all, God said he would use his servant David to rescue his people Israel from their enemies, especially from the Philistines.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ jaaŋgbee ŋme o dabipaɣ bee dabidoo ka o kpi o nuu ni, bɛn darigim o tibili.
en: Sometimes people beat their slaves. If the slave dies after being beaten, the killer must be punished.

dag: Dinzuɣu dahin yini ka alɔbo balibu paai shɛm ni ti lu o zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: Dɔro mini fabila ni kum. Ka buɣim ni ti di o, dama ŋun yɛn kar o saria lala maa n-nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.

dag: Nadab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Nadab did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka bɛ nahiŋgu maa buɣim nyɔhi ni kpuɣi du zuɣusaa hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ku mali vuhim yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu la min o binnani la ni bɛnkam deeg o yuli dalinli la.
en: The smoke of the fire that torments them goes up forever and ever. There is no relief day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, for anyone who has the mark of its name.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ yɛndan ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu Yisa Masia zuɣu! Ami!.
en: May the glory be to God, who alone is wise! May the glory be to him through Jesus Christ forever! Amen.

dag: N dabili Dauda ni ti nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ zaa ti mali piɛgul yino. Bɛ ni ti doli n zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: And my servant David will be the king over them. There will be only one shepherd over all of them. They will live by my rules and obey my laws. They will do the things I tell them.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti zaŋm tumtumda chira anii yɔri chaŋ ti da bindirigu na ti ti ba.
en: But Jesus answered, You give them some food to eat. They said to Jesus, We cant buy enough bread to feed all these people. We would all have to work a month to earn enough to buy that much bread.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Aduna ni o kpuɣim o jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa fiɛbi taŋkpaɣu, ka taŋkpaɣu maa leei pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Tell Aaron to raise his stick and hit the dust on the ground, and everywhere in Egypt dust will become lice.

dag: Dɔdai ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la n-daa su bɛ ni daa lan pirigi ninvuɣ shɛb la fukumsi gol so ŋun pahi ayi ni. Mikilɔt n daa su o yaɣili fukumsi. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the second month, Dodai the Ahohite, whose assistant was Mikloth;.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu ka n ti yɛn sa li. Ka di teei wula n-wali wala, ka leei sida ti titali. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti kana ti zaani di gbini. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti te bɛ tɛri di wula mahim ni.
en: I myself will plant it on a high mountain in Israel. That branch will grow into a tree. It will grow branches and make fruit and become a beautiful cedar tree. Many birds will sit on its branches and live in the shadows under its branches.

dag: Kom pam ku tooi kpihi yurilim, ka kokpɛɣu mi ku tooi di li. Nir yi zaŋ o yiŋ azichi zaa ni o da yurilim, bɛ ni mal o ansarisi.
en: Water cannot put it out; no flood can drown it. But if any tried to buy love with their wealth, contempt is all they would get.

dag: Alibarika be wuntizɔr ni, amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli ni.
en: Blessings cover the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

dag: Bahi n-kul gili ma; tuumbiɛtumdiba pam n-teei gili ma. Bɛ malila binyara kuhiri n nuhi mini n naba.
en: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔhi salima ka di gari tɔn kɔbiga ni pisopɔin, ka tɔhi anzinfa tɔn kɔbisita ni pihinahi, ka tɔhi daanya kaman tɔn kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisi ka tɔhi kuriti gari tɔn tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li tum Naawuni duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: These are the things they gave for Gods house: tons of gold; tons of silver; tons of bronze; and tons of iron.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima zaa niŋla buni nyaɣisim dibu ni, bɛ ni ti chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: Evil people enjoy success during their lives and then go to the grave without suffering.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ. O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: Praise the Lord God, the God of Israel! Only he can do such amazing things.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni laɣiŋgu titali ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim kɔbil nini ŋɔ!.
en: They come shouting, People of Israel, praise the Lord God.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yi shihi di nimdi maa di gba ni leei din be kasi. Ka di ʒim yi tɔɣ vie binyɛrigu, di simdi ka yi paɣi di ni tɔɣ vie binyɛr shɛli maa luɣ kasi shee.
en: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni bɔhim baŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni waawaayil la ni bɔri ni bɛ nya wuhibu, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Foolish people will learn to understand, and those who are always grumbling will be glad to be taught.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ʒii nyabu puuni, a daa yɛli a daba bɛn ʒe a yim: N zaŋ sɔŋsim ti ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ; n duhi n ni pii ninvuɣ so niriba puuni.
en: Once you spoke in a vision to your faithful servants: I placed a crown on a strong man. I raised up someone specially chosen from the people.

dag: Ka n yi na be n nyɛvil ni ka ni tooi tum tuun shɛli din mali buchi, dindina m bi jɛndi mi n ni yɛn pii shɛli bina ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: But if by continuing to live I can do more worthwhile work, then I am not sure which I should choose.

dag: Ka niriba ni daa lihi bɛ ni shɛb zuɣulaannim la bi pahiri ma shɛli, man dee baɣa ka bɛ ni daa nyɛ shɛb ni, dama Naawuni bi gaŋdi so; ka n na kul yɛrimi ni niriba ni lihi shɛb zuɣulaannim maa bi pahiri ma shɛli.
en: But those who seemed to be the leaders—I say this because it makes no difference to me what they were; God does not judge by outward appearances—those leaders, I say, made no new suggestions to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Naa Hɛziɛl yiŋa, ka chɛ ka buɣim di n-saɣim Naa Bɛnhadad ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.

dag: Di saha kopaliga din mali kpiɔŋ daa naan du ti gari.
en: the raging torrent would have drowned us.

dag: Kpɛmiya kuɣa voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni.
en: Go into the rocks, and hide yourself in the dust from the terror of the LORD, from the splendor of Gods majesty!.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Pɔɔshius Fɛstus daa kana ni o ti deei Gomna Filiksi, ka Gomna Filiksi ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim ni yu shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ Pool niŋ sarika ni.
en: Two years later Porcius Festus became governor in place of Felix. But since Felix wanted to do the Jewish leaders a favor, he kept Paul in jail.

dag: Ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi lihi bɛ luɣa zuɣu, ka bi lan nya so naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: At once the disciples looked around, but they saw only Jesus.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Ti Duuma n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni.
en: For, as the scripture says, The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianim bɛn guni gunibu shɛli bɛ ni niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ni la ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni. Teemiya yi bebu ni daa nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: So remember that once you were Gentiles by physical descent, who were called uncircumcised by Jews who are physically circumcised.

dag: Amaa Ashurinim ni ti gbahi yinim Kɛnnim ti leei daba, ka kun ya.
en: but they will be wiped out when Assyria conquers them.

dag: Ka o daa lan guhi daba ayopɔin pahi, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi n-chaŋ yaha, dindina, ka ŋmani maa daa bi lan labina.
en: Seven days later Noah sent the dove out again. But this time the dove didnt come back.

dag: M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini. .
en: Father, if you will, please don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.

dag: Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali, ka Vuhim Dabisili maa yɛn kpe.
en: It was Friday, and the Sabbath was about to begin.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii dunɔguliba ŋɔ ka di doli bɛ zuɣulaannim ni nyɛ shɛm maa, bɛ gba daa malila bɛ tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman bɛ dɔɣiriba maa ni daa tumdi shɛm maa.
en: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers with their leaders, who were responsible to minister in the LORDs temple, along with their relatives.

dag: Hal n yi bela kum vinvamli zibisim ni chana, n ku zo shɛli dabiɛm; dama a be n sani. A jaaŋgbee min a piɛgul jaaŋgbee la nyɛla din kpaŋsiri n suhu.
en: Even if I walk through a valley as dark as the grave, I will not be afraid of any danger, because you are with me. Your rod and staff comfort me.

dag: Abija ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛrɔbɔam daa bi lan nya yaa, ka Yawɛ daa ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.

dag: O di kpuɣi pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee pagɔrili, amaa o kpuɣim o zuliya ni paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: He must not marry a woman who has had sexual relations with any man. He must not marry a prostitute, a divorced woman, or a widow. The high priest must marry a virgin from his own people.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni nir maa daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka di lu? Ka o wuh o di shee, ka Ilaisha ŋmaai daɣu n-zaŋ bahi nimaani n-chɛ ka lɛbiɛlim maa puhi pan na.
en: Where did it fall in? Elisha asked. The prophet pointed to the place, and Elisha cut a stick and threw it into the water at that spot. The ax head floated to the top of the water.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yuli n-daa booni Gɛrishom, dama o daa yɛlimi, N nyɛla sana m-be saan tiŋa.
en: along with her two sons. One was named Gershom because he said, I have been an immigrant living in a foreign land.

dag: Dama Sulemaana daa ŋmaligi dolila Sidɔnnim buɣili Asitati din nyɛ paɣ la mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Milikom din nyɛ daɣiri la.
en: Solomon worshiped Ashtoreth, the goddess of Sidon, and Milcom, the horrible god of the Ammonites.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ dunianim zaa yipa vuhiya, ka nya suhudoo, ka sokam yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa wuhirila o Bia yɛla: Zaŋ chaŋ o daadamtali polo, bɛ daa dɔɣ o la Naa Dauda zuliya ni;.
en: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa polo n-nyɛ ni bɛ kulim bɛ suhuri ni yu dɔbba shɛba, amaa ni bɛ lee kulimila bɛmaŋmaŋ daŋ puuni dɔbba.
en: This is the word that the LORD commands to Zelophehads daughters: They may marry whomever seems best to them, but they may only marry into one of the clans of their ancestral tribe.

dag: Tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, ka tiŋgban kuŋ gba ti mali suhupiɛlli ka bimpuma ti yirigi di ni m-be kaman taaŋkɔro la.
en: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.

dag: N daa to ba la kpani ka di pili yi, ka bɛ lu n naba ni ka kɔŋ yiɣisibu, ka n ku bɛ zaa.
en: I ate them up! I struck them down! They couldnt get up; they fell under my feet.

dag: Amaa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba maa daa lee bi kari Keenannim bɛn daa be Gɛza, dina n-chɛ ka Keenannim mini Ifriim zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be hal ni zuŋɔ; amaa ka bɛ lee chɛ ka Keenannim maa tumdi dabitim tuma tiri ba.
en: But they didnt remove the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So today the Canaanites, who were used for forced labor, still live within Ephraim.

dag: Dama gɔgbihiriba gbihirila yuŋ, ka danyuriba gba nyuri kuuni yuŋ.
en: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.

dag: Ka Obadia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab, ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti nya Ilaija.
en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab. He told him what had happened. Then Ahab went to meet Elijah.

dag: Gbuɣimbihi yi bɔri bindirigu Naawuni sani, bɛ chanimi ŋumdi ginda.
en: The young lions roar while they hunt, looking for the food that God provides.

dag: Zimiri ni daa baŋ ni bɛ nyaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa nim maa, ka o daa du nayili birini nti niŋ buɣim nyo nayili maa, ka di di n-ku omaŋmaŋa.
en: When Zimri saw that the city was captured, he went into the fort of the royal palace and burned it down on top of himself. So he died.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Naa Hɛzɛkia sani ti yɛl o, Ti mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bimbini mini di lahi zaa; ni bɛ ni zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro kasi tamdi teebuli shɛli zuɣu la mini di lahi zaa.
en: Then they went before King Hezekiah. We have purified the LORDs entire temple, they said, and the altar for the entirely burned offering together with all its equipment, and the table for the stacks of bread together with all its equipment.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara malibu dabisili.
en: The Passover Festival in honor of the Lord is to be held on the fourteenth day of the first month.

dag: Amaa ka a bi so ŋun zaŋ a buni chaŋ ti nahi pagɔra ŋɔ lee ti kuna, ka a gbaari naɣila kpabili kɔrigir o zuɣu.
en: But this son of yours wasted all your property on prostitutes, and when he comes back home, you kill the prize calf for him.

dag: N naan zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa sɔŋ o tooni ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla.
en: I would present my case to him. I would make my arguments to show that I am innocent.

dag: Amiramnim mini Izarinim ni Hiburɔnnim ni Uziɛlinim ni:.
en: Duties were also assigned to the descendants of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba. Lala zuɣu ka yi chirim maa.
en: Jesus answered them, How wrong you are! And do you know why? It is because you don't know the Scriptures or God's power.

dag: O doonila gɔtihi gbin ni, ka baa ni kaɣili lims o.
en: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord also said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun gbibi tɔbu ti ku tooi zani, ka ŋun tooi zɔri pam ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa, ka wɔribara gba ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: Those who shoot the bow wont survive. Fast runners wont escape; those who ride horses wont save themselves.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n kul dol a zaligunim maa zaa. N je ʒiri soli kam.
en: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.

dag: Naawuni be lala tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka di kul ku vuui; Naawuni ni sɔŋ lala tiŋ maa biɛkaali saha.
en: God is in that city, and it will never be destroyed; at early dawn he will come to its aid.

dag: Di saha n ni ti darigi bɛn muɣisiri ya la tibili, ka tiligi gbariti, ka laɣim bɛ ni kari shɛb bahi la, ka chɛ ka bɛ vi leei jilima, ka bɛ yuli du dunia zaa ni.
en: Watch what I am about to do to all your oppressors at that time. I will deliver the lame; I will gather the outcast. I will change their shame into praise and fame throughout the earth.

dag: Bɛ daa laɣimla Jɛrusalɛm Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu gol so ŋun pahir ata la ni.
en: They assembled in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year that Asa was king.

dag: Ka o daa ti ba bɛ ni suhi shɛli, amaa ka daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri gbahi ba.
en: God gave them what they asked for; he sent food to satisfy their appetites.

dag: Ka o ni yɛli shɛm maa min anabinim yɛligu doli taba kaman di ni sab yɛli shɛm la:.
en: The words of the prophets agree with this too:.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, N daa pun yɛl a ni daa tim a tuun shɛb n sanna la.
en: Balaam answered, I told your messengers.

dag: Nir yi garigi bɔhigu viɛnyɛla di nyɛla suhupiɛlli nir kam sani. Ka nir yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di tɔɣisibu saha, di viɛla.
en: What a joy it is to find just the right word for the right occasion!.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi ni bɛ malibu.
en: The Gershonites: Libni and Shimei and their clans.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni ka taali be yi mini yi tab sunsuuni, yin chɛliya paŋ taba din ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ gba chɛ yi taali paŋ ya. .
en: Whenever you stand up to pray, you must forgive what others have done to you. Then your Father in heaven will forgive your sins.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala. Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Gidiɔn yiɣisi asiba, o daa kahim piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu maligim palila pipia.
en: And that is what happened. When he got up early the next morning and squeezed the fleece, he wrung out enough dew from the fleece to fill a bowl with water.

dag: O ni daa sɔɣ o maa nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, N yi ti kpi, yin zaŋmiya ma sɔɣi ti ni sɔɣi anabi ŋɔ gbal shɛli ni ŋɔ n-zaŋ n kɔba sɔŋ baɣil o kɔba.
en: So the old prophet buried the body. Then he said to his sons, When I die, bury me in this same grave. Put my bones next to his.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a ti ti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri mini ti ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa ti nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa.
en: But Moses said, You need to let us have sacrifices and entirely burned offerings to present to the LORD our God.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia tuma min a tiliginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa hal n ni ku tooi baŋ di kalinli maa zaa yoli.
en: I will tell of your goodness; all day long I will speak of your salvation, though it is more than I can understand.

dag: dama yi niriba ayi maa daa bi ʒe ma yim Izraɛlnim sunsuuni Mɛribatikadɛshi kom la gbini Zin tiŋgban nɛl la ni, yi ni daa bi gbibi m biɛrikasitali Izraɛlnim sunsuuni la zuɣu.
en: This is because you both sinned against me. You were at the waters of Meribah near Kadesh, in the desert of Zin. There, in front of the Israelites, you did not honor me and show that I am holy.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣa zaa, ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: Its porch faced the outer courtyard. Palm trees decorated its arches on both sides, and its stairway had eight steps.

dag: Ka o daa boli maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba na nti bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka bɛ daa lee yɛli ni bɛ ni ti dɔɣi Masia la.
en: He called together all the chief priests and the teachers of the Law and asked them, Where will the Messiah be born.

dag: Di saha ti Duuma ni ti bu wanzam ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa paa ka o yi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli n-kana ti pini yi zuɣuri mini yi teensi ni yi niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri.
en: When that time comes, the Lord will hire a barber from across the Euphrates—the emperor of Assyria!—and he will shave off your beards and the hair on your heads and your bodies.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni mini Anabi Musa daa tɔɣisi taba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ti bi mi doo maa ŋun ni yi shɛl na.
en: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ piɛla yino m-pahi kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim la zuɣu m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest will take one of the lambs and the oil as a guilt offering. He will lift them in front of the Lord to show they were presented to God.

dag: So ku lan wum girigiri yɛla yi tiŋgban ni. Ka so mi ku lan saɣim yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yaha. N ni be kaman gooni la n-taɣi ya ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu; ka yi paɣi ma n ni tiligi ya zuɣu.
en: Violence will no longer resound throughout your land, nor devastation or destruction within your borders. You will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali dahima, yin chɛliya ka ti tum sokam zaa tuun suma, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ mabi yinsi yɛda niŋbu puuni la.
en: So then, as often as we have the chance, we should do good to everyone, and especially to those who belong to our family in the faith.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tibi ŋɔ m-mali soli din be polipoli ti wuntizɔriba. Bɛ ni doli so shɛli nyɛla so viɛlli.
en: Honesty is the path good people follow. They follow the path that is straight and true. And God, you make that way smooth and easy to follow.

dag: Kom ni binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri n-nyɛ: Binshɛɣukam din be kom ni ka mali gɔhi mini paɣiri teekunim puuni bee kulibɔna ni, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: You may eat everything that lives in the sea or in a river that has fins and scales.

dag: O ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa din nyɛ o ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la zuɣu, ka o daa kpi lala maa. O daa dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli min o daalahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli.
en: This happened because of his sins against the Lord . Like his predecessor Jeroboam, he displeased the Lord by his own sins and by leading Israel into sin.

dag: maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ bo noombihi nɛma ayi bɛn ka daɣiri mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro na.
en: If they are healthy, the priest will tell them to do these things: They must bring two clean birds that are still alive, a piece of cedar wood, a piece of red cloth, and a hyssop plant.

dag: O yi tihim, buɣim n-nyaɣisira, ka o nina ŋmani wuntaŋ m-puhirina asiba la.
en: When Leviathan sneezes, it is like lightning flashing out. His eyes shine like the light of dawn.

dag: N yi chaŋ tooni ha, o ka nimaani bee n yi labi nyaaŋa, n ku tooi nya o.
en: Look, I go east; hes not there, west, and dont discover him.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa chaŋ Baala, di gbinni nyɛla Kiriatijiarim din daa be Juda tiŋgban ni la ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka shɛli zuɣu Naawuni yuli ni daa be, ka o nam ʒiishee tam chɛrubinim zuɣu la na.
en: Then David and all Israel went up toward Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the chest of God, the LORD, who sits enthroned on the winged creatures, where he is called by name.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, N dana, pɔŋ pia la pun be o sani.
en: But they said to him, Sir, he already has ten coins.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ jɛritali, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma leei zana bari ni bɛ gbahi bɛn na yoli yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be biriginsim puuni kalinli ni la.
en: With empty, self-important speech, they use sinful cravings and unrestrained immorality to ensnare people who have only just escaped life with those who have wandered from the truth.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi binnana la mini yi binwɔɣila din be yi san la, ka yi ku lan jɛm yi ni zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: I will destroy your statues of false gods. I will pull down your memorial stones. You will not worship what your hands have made.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yawɛ; nyini n-nam zuɣusaa mini zuɣusaa ha ni di tɔbbihi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni; ka nam teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni. Nyini n-ti di zaa nyɛvili, ka zuɣusaa tɔbbihi zaa jɛmd a.
en: And then the people of Israel prayed this prayer: You, Lord , you alone are Lord ; you made the heavens and the stars of the sky. You made land and sea and everything in them; you gave life to all. The heavenly powers bow down and worship you.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka pii ya leeg o niriba;.
en: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba tusa gari shɛm daa laɣimna hal ti nɔri tab naba bɛ galisim zuɣu, ka Yisa daa daŋ piligi saɣisir o nyaandoliba yɛra, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi din nyɛ bɛ bilikɔnsi la;.
en: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, N ni gbaai mmaŋ zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm polo din ni chɛ ka n zilinli ku tum alahichi. N ni gbib n noli saha shɛlikam ninvuɣ biɛri yi ti be n sani.
en: I said, I will be careful about what I say. I will not let my tongue cause me to sin. I will keep my mouth closed when I am around wicked people.

dag: Ka Barakɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Buz daŋ ni nir la bia Ɛlihu maa daa garigi yɛli, Man nyɛla bia, ka yi mi nyɛ ninkura, dinzuɣu ka n di zɔri dabiɛm ka shini, ka bi yɛli ya din be n suhu ni maa.
en: Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite said: Im young and youre old, so I held back, afraid to express my opinion to you.

dag: A ni ti kpi ni suhudoo. Bɛ ni daa tuɣili a yaannim bɛn daa daŋ a tooni n-nyɛ nanim la tulaale zim shɛm, lala ka bɛ ni ti tuɣili a gba tulaale zim, ka fabili a zuɣu yɛli, Mbaye ti dana. Dama mani n yɛli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will die in peace, and as people burned incense when they buried your ancestors, who were kings before you, in the same way they will burn incense for you. They will mourn over you and say, Our king is dead! I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Yuŋ ka yɔɣili maa daa zani bili zooi n-neei biɛɣu niŋ dahin yini ka lan ŋmaligi kpi yuŋ. A bi niŋ li shɛli; pa nyin mi n-chɛ ka di zooi, amaa ka a zɔri li nambɔɣu.
en: And the Lord said, You did nothing for that plant. You did not make it grow. It grew up in the night, and the next day it died. And now you are sad about it.

dag: Ka so yi ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ni yo ka deei li, dindina omaŋmaŋ yi nya liɣiri ka ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If the person doesnt have someone to buy it back, but then manages to afford buying it back.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: And a voice came from heaven, You are my own dear Son. I am pleased with you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ yi ti yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ ni yɛli paɣ ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ teer o yɛla.
en: The Good News will be told to people all over the world. And I can assure you that everywhere the Good News is told, the story of what this woman did will also be told, and people will remember her.

dag: Wumpaɣibo yila ni ti yiri di puuni na, ka bɛn puhiri chuɣu ni ti yɔri vuri di puuni. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ nabi, ka ku lan pɔra. N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima, ka so ku lan mali ba ansarisi.
en: The people who live there will sing praise; they will shout for joy. By my blessing they will increase in numbers; my blessing will bring them honor.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, Amaŋmaŋ n-kul bɔhi ma lala bee shɛba n-yɛl a n yɛla lala.
en: Jesus answered, Do you say this on your own or have others spoken to you about me.

dag: Kiriatibaal mini Raba gba daa beni: di daa nyɛla fɔntiŋ kara ayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Kiriath-baal and Rabbah. In total: two cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: N ni kpihim bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa n sani, ka chɛ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa ka zaɣisi ma la taali.
en: They sinned against me, but I will wash away that sin. They fought against me, but I will forgive them.

dag: Maligumaanitali tuma yi taɣi, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni zaligu gba taɣi.
en: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zali saha shɛli yi ti paai, n ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli kari saria.
en: God says, I have chosen a time for judgment, and I will judge fairly.

dag: Ti chamiya ʒiishee ka yi ti wuhi ma yi ni zaŋ ma taali shɛli zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi tɔɣisi wuhi ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli na.
en: Summon me, and lets go to trial together; you tell your story so that you may be vindicated!.

dag: Ka o daa mal ti paai yiŋa m-bo sua pa o mam maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋmah o niŋkpil pinaayi n-zaŋ o niŋkpil yini kam tim ti ti Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nim zaa.
en: When he got home, he picked up a knife, took his secondary wife, and chopped her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces. Then he sent them into all the areas of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tizɔpaɣ Ribɛka min o yiŋ dab paɣa doli Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o maa.
en: So they agreed to let Rebekah and an old family servant woman leave immediately with Abraham's servant and his men.

dag: Wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka bi wandi wala, o ŋmari li mi bahi, amaa wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka wandi wala, o wahirila di wulli maa nyoya ni bahiri ni di maan wali pam pahi.
en: He cuts off every branch of mine that does not produce fruit. He also trims every branch that produces fruit to prepare it to produce even more.

dag: Di niŋdiya pakoli kam bee kpibiga alaka.
en: Dont treat any widow or orphan badly.

dag: Ka yi ti sab li pa yi yinsi dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write these commands on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.

dag: Jɛhoyakin yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata ni biɛɣu pia. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for three months and ten days. He too sinned against the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan tirisi tooni ha nti nya Zɛbidii min o bih ayi: Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni n-liɣiri bɛ lansi. Ka Yisa daa boli bɛ gba;.
en: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n ni zaŋdi fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Now then, obey what you have been taught; obey all the laws that I have given you today.

dag: A yɛliya, N lo n ni pii ninvuɣ so alikauli, n daa poya yɛli n dabili Dauda;.
en: You said, David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa daŋ yiɣisi n-laɣisi tiŋ maa ni kpamba pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Without delay King Hezekiah assembled the leading men of the city, and together they went to the Temple.

dag: Yuma maa yi galisi, nyin pahimi liɣiri, ka yuma maa yi bi galisi, nyin filimmi liɣiri maa, dama a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam shɛm ka o kɔhiri tir a maa.
en: If there are many years, the price shall be higher, but if there are only a few years, the price shall be lower, because what is being sold is the number of crops the land can produce.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yɛli, Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ne nini gari Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm la. Dama Yawɛ daa zaliya ni Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm maa di nya nasara, ka di chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Absalom.
en: Absalom and all the Israelites said, Hushais advice is better than Ahithophels. Actually, Ahithophels advice was good, but they said this because the Lord had decided to make Ahithophels advice useless. He did this to punish Absalom.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim bɛn be vinvamli ni ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn be bɔpiɛligu ni ŋɔ, m mini ya mali zabili. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa. Yinim bɛn yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi siɣina ti liri ti? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kpe ti sɔɣisili shee ŋɔ na.
en: Jerusalem, I am against you. You sit on top of the mountain. You sit like a queen over this valley. You people of Jerusalem say, No one can attack us. No one can come into our strong city. This message is from the Lord .

dag: dindina a ni baŋ Yawɛ zɔbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka nya baŋsim din nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu sɔɣira, o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee muɣisigu saha.
en: Many people are suffering— crushed by the weight of their troubles. But the Lord is a refuge for them, a safe place they can run to.

dag: Dama n ni kul wum a puhigu maa, bia ŋun be m pul ni maa dii dammi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: For as soon as I heard your greeting, the baby within me jumped with gladness.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa sab sabbu shɛli tabili Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Pilate had a public notice written and posted on the cross. It read Jesus the Nazarene, the king of the Jews.

dag: Kum mini nyɛvili bela zilinli yiko ni, ka bɛn yuri li ni di di nyɔri.
en: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.

dag: O daa bi saɣi n-chɛ ka so nahim ba. O daa kpahi nanim zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: God didnt let anyone oppress them. God punished kings for their sake.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nyina ŋmanila takɔbiri, ka ŋmani suhi, bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku faranim dunia ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku nandaamba daadamnim sunsuuni.
en: There are those whose teeth are swords; their jaw is a butchers knife, ready to devour the needy from the earth, and the poor from humanity.

dag: O daa yɛli ma mi, A bia Sulemaana n-ni ti me n yili maa mini n dundɔna, dama mani m-piig o leei m bia, ka m mi leeg o ba.
en: He said to me, David, your son Solomon will build my Temple and the area around it, because I have chosen Solomon to be my son, and I will be his father.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli naa, N ni daa be n ya ka wum a yɛla ni a yɛm yɛla shɛm shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ pihita la puuni niriba ata daa ti chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni saha shɛli Filistia tɔbbihi ni daa lo tɔbu n-do Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni la.
en: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley.

dag: ka zaŋ noonsi gba zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni n-gbib ba ka bɛ birili ku kpihim dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Take also seven pairs of each kind of bird. Do this so that every kind of animal and bird will be kept alive to reproduce again on the earth.

dag: Di saha ka anabi ninkurili maa yɛl o, Man gba nyɛla anabi kaman a ni nyɛ anabi shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ chɛ ka malaika yɛli ma, Cham ti zaŋ anab maa n-lab a yiŋa ka o ti di bindirigu ka nyu kom. .
en: Then the old prophet from Bethel said to him, I, too, am a prophet just like you, and at the Lord 's command an angel told me to take you home with me and offer you my hospitality. But the old prophet was lying.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka o yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: So they told Jesus, We dont know the answer. Jesus said, Then I will not tell you who gave me the authority to do these things.

dag: Yaa biɛla gba lan ka n niŋgbuna ni m bariŋ maa zuɣu, ka di muɣisi ma n suhu ni, ka n kul ŋuhira.
en: Im worn out, completely crushed; I groan because of my miserable heart.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa shini, ka kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋ ni bɛ kpiɔŋ zaa ni bɛ zaŋ ŋarin titali maa lab du duli. Amaa ka teeku maa dambu kpiɔŋ daa kul maan pahirimi, ka bɛ kɔŋ chandi.
en: Instead, the men tried to row the ship back to the shore, but they couldnt do it. The wind and the waves of the sea were too strong—and they were becoming stronger and stronger.

dag: n-zaŋ ba bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: Then he will throw them into a flaming furnace, where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.

dag: Niŋmiya siɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinitaba polo, ka miriya ka yi niŋ yi mabia kam naani, dama mabihi zaa nyɛla yɔhindiba, ka ʒiʒiinikpee kam nyɛ ŋun chani saɣindi niriba yuya.
en: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim maa bɛn yuma paai pihita zaŋ chana, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahaayika.
en: When the Levites were counted, the head count of every male and older totaled .

dag: Nyama, dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi alizanda ni n-nya ka duno shɛli yooi yɛya, ka n wum n ni daa pun tuui wum kukol shɛl la ka di be kaman kikaa kumsi la yɛri ma na: Dum kpe na ka n ti wuh a din yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: At this point I had another vision and saw an open door in heaven. And the voice that sounded like a trumpet, which I had heard speaking to me before, said, Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this.

dag: Yawɛ nambɔzɔbo min o nirilim galisiya. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The Lord is kind and merciful. He is patient and full of love.

dag: ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni so sani yi ni tim ma ni n ti zaŋ yi fabila sɔŋ o tooni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: and told them that the Lord God of Israel had said: You asked Jeremiah to pray and find out what you should do.

dag: O tiligi n shia ka di bi faai siɣi gballi ni, ka n nyɛvili ni lan nya neesim.
en: God saved me from going down to the place of death. Now I can enjoy life again.

dag: Naawuni tim a suhudoo! A zɔnim la zaa puhir a. Puhimi ti zɔnim la zaa ti ma.
en: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.

dag: dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: because he was teaching them like someone with authority and not like their legal experts.

dag: N nya bɛ tuma, amaa n ni tib ba. N ni wuhi ba soli, ka sɔŋ ba, ka maai bɛn be fabila ni suhuri.
en: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning.

dag: Hal Naawuni yi chɛ ka n nyɛvili pahi yi yɛda niŋbu sara zuɣu n-leei sara maligu ŋun Naawuni sani, di ni niŋ ma suhupiɛlli, ka yi zaa gba pahi n zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your faith makes you give your lives as a sacrifice in serving God. Maybe I will have to offer my own life with your sacrifice. But if that happens, I will be glad, and I will share my joy with all of you.

dag: Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya ni nir la n-daa deei Arigɔb yaɣili din daa be Bashan maa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga, ka daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli boli Bashan, dina n-nyɛ Havɔtijairi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Jair, from the tribe of Manasseh, took the entire region of Argob, that is, Bashan, as far as the border of Geshur and Maacah. He named the villages after himself, and they are still known as the villages of Jair.

dag: ka Kallai daa nyɛ Sallai daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Ɛba daa nyɛ Amok daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Sallus family was Kallai. The leader of Amoks family was Eber.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul gbibiya yi ni pun mali shɛl la kirikiri hal ka n ti kana.
en: Just hold on to what you have until I come.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Jɔnatan, biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi. Ka n yi bi niŋ a lala, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma gari n ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm gba.
en: Saul said, I made an oath and asked God to punish me if I didnt keep it. Jonathan, you must die.

dag: Ka Pool yɛl o, N dana, m bi kpɛla yinyari, amaa nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa mini yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛra.
en: But Paul replied, Honorable Festus, I am not crazy. What I am saying is true, and it makes sense.

dag: Amaa nyini n-chɛ ka a shia kanna ti kpɛri bɛ ni, ka bɛ leeri a ni nam shɛba; ka a ti tiŋgbani nyɛvil palli.
en: But when you send out your life-giving breath, things come alive, and the world is like new again!.

dag: M bia, dol a ba zaligu, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: Obey the teaching of your parents—.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti zahim li, ŋun daa pihi pam dini shɛli daa bi guui, ka ŋun mi daa pihi biɛla dini shɛli daa bi poog o. Sokam daa kul pihila o dibu tariga.
en: But when they measured it out by the omer, the ones who had collected more had nothing left over, and the ones who had collected less had no shortage. Everyone collected just as much as they could eat.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaana kam kul ʒiɛmi tumd o sara maligu tuma dabisili kam n-kul maanila sara maligu yini maa napɔn bɔbili. Ka sara maligunim ŋɔ mi ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi;.
en: Every priest stands every day serving and offering the same sacrifices over and over, sacrifices that can never take away sins.

dag: Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa wurim bɛ nahiŋgu din daa doli Stiivin kubu nyaaŋa la zuɣu daa chaŋ hal ni Fɔnisia mini Saipurus ni Antiɔk. Bɛ daa mali Naawuni yɛligu n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim kɔŋko.
en: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.

dag: Ŋuna n-yihiri teeku bulli puuni zibisim, ka chɛ ka neesim neeri zibisim titali ni.
en: God turns darkness to light;.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn nyu shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo. Nyɛvili bi gari bindirigu ka niŋgbuŋ mi bi gari situra?.
en: This is why I tell you: do not be worried about the food and drink you need in order to stay alive, or about clothes for your body. After all, isn't life worth more than food? And isn't the body worth more than clothes?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa kanimina ni n ti liri ya n-kari ya saria zuliya kam ninni.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: I myself am now against you! I will impose the case law penalties on you in the sight of the nations.

dag: Bɛ daa tim na nti yɛli ma la zilin yini maa siɣimsiɣim bunahi, ka n gba daa labisi garigibu yini maa ti ba.
en: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.

dag: Ka n ti ka a sanna nimaani, chɛrubinim ayi bɛn be Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu la sunsuuni nti tɔɣis a n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti a ka a ti Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do.

dag: dama bɛ yi yɛl a, Dum zuɣusaa ŋɔ na, di so ni bɛ filim a ninvuɣ titali tooni.
en: because it is better that he say to you, Come up here, than to be demoted before a ruler. What your eyes see.

dag: Ka di daa ku ba suli pam ti yaɣi, ka bɛ piligi tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ Yisa shɛm.
en: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law got so mad they couldnt think straight. They talked to each other about what they could do to Jesus.

dag: Di niŋya tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Mɛriba mini bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Masa tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.

dag: Di saha ka Mariama yɛli malaika maa, N na ʒi doo. Ka wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: Mary asked the angel, How can this happen? I am not even married.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ o kɔhimma nyɔri ti yaɣi ni o nya buni pam, o bɔri li zaanila ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi nandaamba nirilim.
en: Those who become rich through high interest rates gather money for those who are generous to the poor.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛla bɛ noya jɛndi ma, ka yɛra, Iin, Iin, ti nini nya li.
en: They speak out against me, saying, Yes! Oh, yes! Weve seen it with our own eyes.

dag: Kubu saha beni, ka tibbu saha beni. Daai luhi saha beni, ka me n-zali saha beni.
en: for killing and healing, destroying and building.

dag: Ka shɛb daa yiɣisi zani dir o shɛhira kpɛma yɛra.
en: Then some others stood up and told more lies against Jesus. They said.

dag: ka zaŋ ʒiri shɛhiranim maa na ka bɛ ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ kul galindila Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛli din be kasi shee la mini Anabi Musa zaligu;.
en: Before the council, they presented false witnesses who testified, This man never stops speaking against this holy place and the Law.

dag: Ka bee a tɛhiya ni a gari la Mɔab Naa Balak Zipɔr bia la? O daa ŋme Izraɛlnim naŋgbankpeeni bee n-lo tɔbu ni o tuhi ba?.
en: Are you better than Balak the son of Zippor? He was the king of Moab, but he didn't quarrel with Israel or start a war with us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn naa ni ti zaŋ o takɔbi na ti lu a zuɣu.
en: The king of Babylonia is coming to attack you, king of Egypt!.

dag: Pa yinima m-pii ma, amaa mani m-pii ya, ka zali ya ni yi chaŋ ti pum puma n-wali ka yi wala maa ku kpihim; ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.

dag: Ŋunkam kahind o tab nini nyɛla ŋun tahiri yɛla na, amaa ŋunkam mali suhukpeeni kpahiri niriba zuɣuri ni nyɛla ŋun tahiri suhudoo na.
en: If you fail to speak the truth, trouble will follow. If you speak openly, peace will come.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n nyari zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu mini yɛlimuɣisira? Saɣiŋgu mini damli dambu kul bela n tooni; ka zabili mini suhuyiɣisili kul yiɣisira.
en: Why do you make me see such trouble? How can you stand to look on such wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are all around me, and there is fighting and quarreling everywhere.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛli naa maa, Ashili shɛli nyin naa ni bɔri ni a baŋ maa, baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni timanim ni laasabuniŋdiba ku tooi wuh a di gbinni.
en: Daniel replied, Your Majesty, there is no wizard, magician, fortuneteller, or astrologer who can tell you that.

dag: Yim ka Babilɔn dii lu n-wurim. Kummiya di zuɣu. Zaŋmiya kpam na ti bɔbili di daŋ maa, di pa shɛli di ni tibi kpaŋ.
en: But suddenly, Babylon will fall and be destroyed. I, the Lord , told the foreigners who lived there, Weep for the city! Get medicine for its wounds; maybe they will heal.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o yihi luɣ kasi shee maa daɣiri ni ni Izraɛlnim daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi la zaa zuɣu; ka di simdi ka o niŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili din be bɛ sani bɛ daɣiri tuma ni maa lala.
en: In this way Aaron will purify the Most Holy Place from all the uncleanness and sins of the Israelites. He will also purify the Meeting Tent, because it stands in the middle of people whose sins have made them unclean.

dag: ka Hɔri bia Shafat daa yi Simiɔn zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Simeon—Shaphat son of Hori;.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi kpaŋsi yi suhuri n ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla yɛtɔɣa la mini ashili yɛlimaŋli din daa sɔɣi kurimbuni ha.
en: May the glory be to God who can strengthen you with my good news and the message that I preach about Jesus Christ. He can strengthen you with the announcement of the secret that was kept quiet for a long time.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ku ma suli, ka n suhu yiɣisi la, n daa loya ni n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba; ka daa bi taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni pam di zuɣu. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa bo niriba pahi Pool mini Baanabas zuɣu n-tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ Yisa tuumba la mini cheechi kpamba bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la sani nti nya ba yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders.

dag: Amaa ka pii din mali kpiɔŋ daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa ni tiŋ maa ni nanim zaa daa zo nti kpe di ni, ka yo di dunoli n-kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ di ni. Ka du pii maa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ti beni.
en: But there was a tall fortress in the middle of the town, and the town leaders and everyone else went inside. Then they barred the gates and went up to the flat roof.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li gahigahi Yawɛ tooni din ni chɛ ka o deei ya. Di simdi ka maligumaana maa zaŋ li gahila Vuhim Dabisili di n-kaai biɛɣu.
en: The priest will lift the sheaf to show it was offered before the Lord . Then you will be accepted. The priest will present the sheaf on Sunday morning.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Go to the king and tell him that the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says, Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

dag: Ka ti suhiri Naawuni ni yi di tum birigi, ka di pala din wuhiri ni tinim nyaŋla timaŋ buɣisibu, amaa di lee nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi tum din tuhi hal di ni kul be kaman ti nyɛla bɛn bi nyaŋ timaŋ buɣisibu maa la.
en: We pray to God that you will do no wrong—not in order to show that we are a success, but so that you may do what is right, even though we may seem to be failures.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ o na, ka o ni daa kana nti zani niriba maa sani, o daa wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: The people ran and got Saul and brought him into the middle of the crowd. He was more than a head taller than anyone else.

dag: Yawɛ, wumma, zom ma nambɔɣu! Yawɛ, leemi ŋun sɔŋdi ma!.
en: Lord , hear my prayer, and be kind to me. Lord , help me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di n-tiɣi zaa, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ laɣisim bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi din guui maa zaa ka di shɛli ku bahi yoli.
en: They all had plenty to eat. When they finished, Jesus said to his followers, Gather the pieces of fish and bread that were not eaten. Dont waste anything.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ŋaha.
en: These are the proverbs of Solomon, the son of David and king of Israel.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka ʒiɛnya dɛde yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Benya kaman dɔbba! Maliya yaa!.
en: Be careful. Hold firmly to your faith. Have courage and be strong.

dag: Bɛn muɣisiri ya ni yi guni la nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ duhi bɛmaŋa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu puuni, ka di daliri kul nyɛla ni bɛ di nya nahiŋgu Masia dapulli yɛla zuɣu;.
en: Those men who are trying to force you to be circumcised are only doing it so that their people will accept them. They are afraid they will be persecuted if they follow only the cross of Christ.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana ni Shimɛi yila Jɛrusalɛm n-chaŋ Gaat ka labina.
en: When Solomon heard what Shimei had done.

dag: Filistia doo maa daa yi kul yirimina ti zaana asiba ni zaawuni n-kul niŋdi lala hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: Goliath challenged the Israelites every morning and evening for forty days.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn dindali maa yuŋ, Gbaam a ba naɣilaa, ka bo naɣila so ŋun pah ayi ka nyɛ yuma ayopɔin ka daag a ba ni me Baal bimbin shɛl la luhi, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi;.
en: That night the Lord spoke to Gideon again: Get your father's second-best bull, the one that's seven years old. Use it to pull down the altar where your father worships Baal and cut down the sacred pole next to the altar.

dag: N yura yɛli ma, N ni yuri so pam, ŋun viɛli pam n sani, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: My lover spoke and said to me, Rise up, my dearest, my fairest, and go.

dag: Shɛb yɛra, Pool gbana puuni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛl kpɛma ni din mali yiko, amaa o yi ti be ti sani o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ni, o nyɛla ninvuɣ gbariŋ ka o yɛtɔɣa bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: Some people say, Pauls letters are powerful and sound important, but when he is with us, he is weak and the worst speaker you have ever heard.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ zaa mi ni n daa kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni nti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ a yɛda m-bu ba ka kpɛhi ba duu.
en: Lord, I answered, they know very well that I went to the synagogues and arrested and beat those who believe in you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mbo! A garigi viɛnyɛliŋga; niŋmi lala ka be.
en: You are right, Jesus replied; do this and you will live.

dag: Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun biri biɛla ni ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi biri pam ni ti kpuɣ atam pam.
en: What I mean is this: the one who sows a small number of seeds will also reap a small crop, and the one who sows a generous amount of seeds will also reap a generous crop.

dag: Di chɛliya ka zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma zaa be yi ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpɛri binyara ni, dama di bi simdi ni dimbɔŋɔnim be Yisa nyaandoliba biɛhigu ni hal baabiɛla.
en: But there must be no sexual sin among you. There must not be any kind of evil or selfishly wanting more and more, because such things are not right for Gods holy people.

dag: Di daa kul malila takɔriti di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni kaman dimbalanim takɔriti ni daa be shɛm la. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: There were windows in the rooms of this gateway just as in the others. The total length of the gateway was feet and the width feet.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili kul paari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ŋun Naawuni noli.
en: God will show his anger against those who dont obey him, because they do these evil things.

dag: Lɛla ni ŋub ba kaman bɛ ni ŋubiri situra shɛm la. Zunzuya ni di ba kaman piɛkɔbiri la. Amaa n faako tibu mini n tiliginsim din nyɛ zuliya kam zaa dini la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: they will vanish like moth-eaten clothing! But the deliverance I bring will last forever; my victory will endure for all time.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa sani, m bemi kaman ŋun ka yaa ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn ka yaa maa gba. N chɛ ka m biɛhigu mini sokam biɛhigu taɣilila taba ni di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi shɛba.
en: To those who are weak, I became weak so that I could help save them. I have become all things to all people. I did this so that I could save people in any way possible.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kana ni o ti malimali firilanim maa asiba kam, ŋun tuɣilim tulaale zim din nyom viɛl sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: From now on, when Aaron takes care of the lamps each morning and evening, he must burn sweet-smelling incense to me on the altar.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla a dahalali niriba, ka nyɛ a ni daa teeg a bɔɣu ni yiko din galisi yihi shɛb na. .
en: But you, our Lord , chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.

dag: Dama zuliya tital dini n-lee beni m-mali wuni ka di wuni maa miri ba kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni miri ti shɛm saha shɛli ti yi ti suh o ŋɔ?.
en: The Lord our God is near when we ask him to help us. No other nation has a god like that!.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n chɛ ka ti mabia Ɛpafurɔditus ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee mini n tɔbbikpee, ka lan nyɛ yi tumo ŋun sɔŋ ma la lab kuli yi sanna.
en: I have thought it necessary to send to you our brother Epaphroditus, who has worked and fought by my side and who has served as your messenger in helping me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ cham ti ku Amalɛknim maa, ka saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa, di chɛ ka bɛ ni so kpalim, amaa kum dɔbba mini paɣiba ni biliɛri ni bimɔɣirisi n-tabili naɣilahi mini piɛri ni laakumnim ni bunsi zaa. .
en: So go! Attack the Amalekites; put everything that belongs to them under the ban. Spare no one. Kill men and women, children and infants, oxen and sheep, camels and donkeys.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisifu ni daa mali ti paag o biɛyanim maa sani, bɛ daa darigimi fuɣ o binyɛr shɛli o ni daa ye ka di nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣinli ka mali bɔɣ wɔɣila la;.
en: When Joseph came to his brothers, they attacked him and tore off his long and beautiful coat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani baabiɛla gba.
en: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.

dag: Ka o suhu daa yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba.
en: God delivered his people up to the sword; he was enraged at his own possession.

dag: Ti mabihi, yimaŋmaŋ mi ni ti ni daa ka yi sanna la pala din kpalim yoli.
en: Brothers and sisters, you know that our visit to you was not a failure.

dag: zaŋ tiŋ hal ti yaɣi dunoya zuɣusaa, chɛrubinim mini abie tihi kɔtomsi ka bɛ daa ŋme m-pa di dukpina zuɣu.
en: From the floor to the area above the door, Cherub angels and palm trees were carved on all walls of the Holy Place.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa su nanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti sunsuuni nanim zaa zaŋ tabili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Solomon was the king over all the kings from the Euphrates River all the way to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma? Nyama, n na ka bia, ka daɣila Ɛliɛza ŋun nyɛ Damaskus nir la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: But Abram said, Lord GOD, there is nothing you can give me that will make me happy, because I have no son. My slave Eliezer from Damascus will get everything I own after I die.

dag: O yidana Yisifu daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ suŋ pam, dinzuɣu ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yihi li palɔni n-dihi Mariama vi, amaa ka daa lee lo ni o ku lan kpuɣ o.
en: Joseph her husband was a righteous man. Because he didnt want to humiliate her, he decided to call off their engagement quietly.

dag: Dama niriba ayi bee ata yi laɣim luɣ shɛli n yuli zuɣu, n ni be bɛ sani.
en: Yes, if two or three people are together believing in me, I am there with them.

dag: M min o gbɛri kparila taba, ka n tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ka di do palɔni, ka pa ni ŋaha puuni; ka o nyari man Yawɛ kɔtomsi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi bi zo dabiɛm ni yi galim n dabili Musa maa.
en: So I speak to him face-to-face, clearly and not in riddles; he has even seen my form! How dare you speak against my servant Moses.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun nyɛ yaalan nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma bɛn je ma nuu ni, dama bɛ daa gari ma yaa.
en: He saved me from my powerful enemies, who hated me. They were too strong for me, so he saved me.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But he said, Why? What wrong has he done? They shouted even louder, Crucify him.

dag: Dinzuɣu cheechi zaa yi ti laɣim ka sokam tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka bɛn ka yi kalinli ni mini bɛn bi niŋ yɛda kpɛna, bɛ ku yɛli ni yi kpɛla yinyari?.
en: Suppose the whole church meets together and you all speak in different languages. If some people come in who are without understanding or dont believe, they will say you are crazy.

dag: Bɛ kuhirimi niŋdi bɛ manima, Bindirigu mini wain be ya? Bɛ tarigiri luri tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu kaman bɛ nyala dansi la, saha shɛli bɛ ni kpiri niŋdi bɛ manim nuhi ni la.
en: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ li yɛri saha shɛl o yi ti yɛn tum tuma, ka o yi ti kpɛri luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ tooni bee o yi ti yirina, di ni chaɣisiri ka bɛ wumdi di vuri din ni chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: Aaron will wear this robe when he serves as a priest. The bells will ring as Aaron goes into the Holy Place to stand before the Lord , and the bells will ring as he leaves the Holy Place. This way Aaron will not die.

dag: Ka Ananias yɛli, N Duuma, m pun wum doo maa yɛla niriba pam sani zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi a nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm alaka shɛm polo.
en: Ananias answered, Lord, many people have told me about this man and about all the terrible things he has done to your people in Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋɔŋmiya kom m-mali shili gu bɛn yɛn teei gili ya. Pahimiya yi birininim yaa. Nomiya yaɣiri, nomiya tandi, ka zaŋya bilichiisi ŋmarigu niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Get water and store it inside your city, because the enemy soldiers will surround your city. Make your defenses strong! Get clay to make more bricks and mix the mortar. Get the molds for making bricks.

dag: hal ka bɛ je ni bɛ zaŋ li bahi, ka zaŋ li gbabi bɛ noya maa zaa yoli.
en: and swallow it slowly.

dag: Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya ni niriba ni Manaasa zuliya ni niriba pirigili bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la tɔbbihi bɛn daa gbibi bidibbina balibu kam din ni tuhi tɔbu daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi.
en: From the east side of the Jordan River, there were , men from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh. They had all kinds of weapons.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣiri bihi maa buɣira, ka zaŋd o nuhi pari bɛ zuɣu niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni.
en: Then he hugged the children and blessed them.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim polo, bɛ saɣisiri ti ka ti luri ba sizuura. Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni ti deei ti Ba Naawuni saɣisigu ka be.
en: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?.

dag: Binneembihi kam zaa bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali bɛ naba anahi zaa chana nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: Any flying insect that walks on four feet is detestable to you.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli salo maa, Di zabiriya so nyuli o buni zuɣu, dama ninsal nyɛvili bi dolila o ni mali shɛli.
en: Then he said to the crowd, Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.

dag: A piɛma diri pam naa dimnim suhuri ni; ka niriba lur a tooni.
en: Let the peoples fall beneath you. May your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the kings enemies.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Yawɛ, tim naa maa nasara; ka garigi ti saha shɛli ti yi ti kuhi bol a.
en: Give victory to the king, O Lord ; answer us when we call.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya Masidɔnia do so ʒii yuŋ ka o ʒiɛya m-balindi ŋun Pool yɛra, Kam Masidɔnia na ti sɔŋ ti.
en: A vision of a man from Macedonia came to Paul during the night. He stood urging Paul, Come over to Macedonia and help us.

dag: Bɛ naa daa nyɛla bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la malaika ŋun Hiburu yuli booni Abadɔn, ka o Giriiki yuli mi booni Apoliɔn la. Di gbinni nyɛla, Saɣinda.
en: Their king is an angel from the abyss, whose Hebrew name is Abaddon, and whose Greek name is Apollyon.

dag: m ba daa wuhiri ma, ka yɛri ma, Chɛ ka n yɛligu kpe a suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga; gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli ka be.
en: said to me: If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.

dag: O nuu din mali kpiɔŋ min o bɔɣu ka o daa teei yihi ba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: With a strong hand and outstretched arm— Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate asked, But what crime has he done? Nail him to a cross! they yelled even louder.

dag: Wummiya! Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn zo n-tiligi yi Babilɔn kanna ni bɛ ti yɛli Ziɔnnima Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu zuɣu shɛm.
en: A voice of fugitives and refugees, from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the retribution of the LORD our God because of what has been done to his temple.

dag: Yuun pisinaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the first month of the twenty-seventh year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: N ni zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ barina shee, ka zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu ni.
en: I will be responsible for what happens to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpahimmiya yi ni be shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di benya kaman bɛn be ʒilinsi ni, amaa ka lee bemi kaman yɛnnima.
en: So be careful how you live. Don't live like ignorant people, but like wise people.

dag: N nintam kul zɔrimi, niriba ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: My tears pour down like a river, because people do not obey your law.

dag: Amaa o paɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la bihi bɛna, pina ka o daa ti ba, o ni daa na be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛli. Ka o daa chɛ ka o bihi bɛn kpalim maa chaŋ ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni wulimpuhili polo ka chɛ Yisahaku.
en: but while he was still alive, he gave presents to the sons his other wives had borne him. Then he sent these sons to the land of the East, away from his son Isaac.

dag: Pa bɛ takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa; pa bɛ mi maŋmaŋ yiko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi di nasara maa; amaa di daa nyɛla a yiko min a kpiɔŋ ni a ni daa be bɛ sani la zuɣu, dama a nini daa tiɣi ba.
en: It was not our fathers swords that took the land. It was not their strong arms that brought them victory. It was your power. It was because you accepted them and smiled down on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka a yi dunia ni. A ni kpi yuuni ŋɔ puuni a ni tɔɣisi duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Yawɛ maa zuɣu. .
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: Im going to send you somewhere—right off the face of the earth! Before the year ends, you will die since you have incited rebellion against the LORD.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti suhuri piɛla, ka ti duh o ka tibig o, dama Piɛbil la amiliya lɔbu saha paaya, ka o daamiliya paɣ maa pun mali shili.
en: Let us rejoice and be glad; let us praise his greatness! For the time has come for the wedding of the Lamb, and his bride has prepared herself for it.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: saying to them, Go into the village over there. As soon as you enter it, you will find tied up there a colt that no one has ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

dag: Yi ni tooi chɛ ka nandaamba birim bɛ nia lɔbu ni, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: You evildoers may humiliate the plans of those who suffer, but the LORD is their refuge.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o ku yɛli din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Then Israels king said to Jehoshaphat, Didnt I tell you? He never prophesies anything good about me, only bad.

dag: Ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. Ka nir yi ni tooi gbaag omaŋ o suhuyiɣisili saha, di so ŋun ŋme n-deei tin muni.
en: It is better to be patient than powerful. It is better to win control over yourself than over whole cities.

dag: Kummiya kaman paɣisar so ŋun so buɣu n-kumdi nachimbil so ŋun di yɛn lo o amiliya zuɣu la.
en: Lament like a woman dressed in funeral clothing, one who has lost the husband of her youth.

dag: Naawuni ni nam binshɛɣukam nyɛla din viɛla, ka di bi simdi ni ti siŋ li, tinim dee yi di li ni Naawuni paɣibu.
en: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.

dag: kaman bɛ yaannim la, bɛ daa bemi kaman tɔb shɛli din naɣilimnaɣilim.
en: They turned away, became faithless just like their ancestors; they twisted away like a defective bow.

dag: N ni zaŋ kuɣ yini shɛli din mali nina ayopɔin sɔŋ Jɔshua tooni; ka sab sabbu shɛli pa di zuɣu yɛli, Dahin yini puuni, n ni ti yihi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daalahichi bahi.
en: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.

dag: A yi ʒini tiŋa, a ku zɔri dabiɛm; ka a yi dɔni tiŋa, a ni gbihi go nyaɣisili.
en: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli nyin Baruk shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to you:.

dag: Miriya ka yi mini ba ti kpuɣiri taba, di zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi.
en: and don't let your sons and daughters marry any of them.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya Yila litaafi puuni: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: In the book of Psalms, David himself says, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side.
