dag: Ka din chɛ ka saria karibu beni maa nyɛla, neesim ni ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ka salinim ni yu tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bɔrila zibisim gari neesim maa la.
en: This is how the judgment works: the light has come into the world, but people love the darkness rather than the light, because their deeds are evil.

dag: Ɛlikana bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Amasai mini Ahimɔt.
en: Elkanahs family: Amasai and Ahimoth.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zani viɛnyɛliŋga ka yɔhi teeku ni kɔbilinina.
en: I was there when he put the clouds in the sky and made the deep springs flow.

dag: N yurinima, di bɔhiya biɛri yi toli, amaa chɛliya biɛri bɔhibu tila Naawuni ŋun su tibidarigibo yɛla ŋɔ, dama di sabiya ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi.
en: Dont try to get revenge for yourselves, my dear friends, but leave room for Gods wrath. It is written, Revenge belongs to me; I will pay it back, says the Lord .

dag: Ka Naa Ɛla ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Elah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka yi ni tumdi binshɛɣukam zaa tiri ba puuni, tummiya li ni yi suhuri zaa kaman ti Duuma ka yi tumdi li tiri la, ka pa ni ninsalinim ka yi tumdi li tira.
en: Whatever you do, do it from the heart for the Lord and not for people.

dag: ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la, amaa di yi ti zooi, di galisirimi gari tutuɣ kam m-mal ti leei tia, hal ka noonsi kanna nti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, it grows larger than any garden plant and becomes a tree. Birds even come and nest on its branches.

dag: Di buɣisibu wɔɣilim gari dunia ŋɔ wɔɣilim. Ka di yɛliŋ gari teeku.
en: It is greater than the earth and bigger than the seas.

dag: Ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni Wulimpuhili polo nim la zaa daa laɣim do vinvamli maa ni, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Bɛ laakumnim daa ka kalinli; bɛ galisim daa ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu.
en: The Midianites, Amalekites, and other easterners were spread across the valley like a swarm of locusts; their camels were too many to count, like the grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: Kom koligu maa ni kom ni daa ti naai, ka o zaŋ bia maa ti sɔŋ tutuɣu gbini.
en: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.

dag: Ka Rabishake daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia ni Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la bɔhiya, Bɔ ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: Then the field commander said to them, Say to Hezekiah: This is what Assyrias Great King says: Why do you feel so confident?.

dag: Kom maa kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la, ka teeku bulli ni kom zuɣusaa kilim.
en: which turn the waters to stone and freeze the face of the sea?.

dag: Niriba ayi yi do n-tab taba, bɛ ni ni tula, amaa nir yi do o ko, wula ka o yɛn niŋ ka o ni tula?.
en: Also, if two lie down together, they can stay warm. But how can anyone stay warm alone?.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul ku su tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ wuntizɔriba tiŋgbani, ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka wuntizɔriba maa tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: The wicked rod wont remain in the land given to the righteous so that they dont use their hands to do anything wrong.

dag: n ni ti lan labisi Ijipti zali di zaashee, ka zaŋ ba labisi Patrɔs din nyɛ bɛ virili shee la. Ka bɛ nam ti ku mali yaa nimaani.
en: I will improve their circumstances and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin. Egypt will be a lowly kingdom there.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka ti mali tahima. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti sɔŋsim mini ti nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: We depend on you, Lord , to help and protect us.

dag: O yɛla ka n daa yɛri ni o doli n nyaaŋ na ka nyɛ ŋun gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: This is the one I was talking about when I said, There is a man coming after me who is greater than I am, because he was living even before I was born.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa tuɣindi tulaale zim kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba la ni daa niŋdi shɛm la. Bɛ daa tum tuumbiɛri pam n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi;.
en: and they burned incense on all the pagan altars, following the practice of the people whom the Lord had driven out of the land. They aroused the Lord 's anger with all their wicked deeds.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi maani Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni yi ni kana ti ʒini ŋɔ wuna n-chɛ ka yi nuhi tuma chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu? Yi bɔri ni yi kpi ka leei dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni yɛn maani shɛba ansarisi ka turi shɛba?.
en: You have made me angry by worshiping idols and burning incense to other gods after you came here to Egypt. You will die such a disgusting death, that other nations will use the name of Judah as a curse word.

dag: Ka Zara daa la o suhu ni ka yɛli, N kurigiya, ka n yidan gba kurigi, ka n kɔre ni lan be doo ni.
en: So Sarah laughed to herself and said, Now that I am old and worn out, can I still enjoy sex? And besides, my husband is old too.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa sahakam, dama yi yɛn niŋdila din viɛl mini din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Carefully obey all the commands that I give you. When you do what is good and right—what pleases the Lord your God—then everything will go well for you and for your descendants forever.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu saha shɛli n ni daa wum yi ni niŋ ti Duuma yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm yɛla, di chɛ ka.
en: For this reason, ever since I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of God's people.

dag: O daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu nir saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa Jɛrusalɛm yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka o yuli booni Abija.
en: Hezekiah was years old when he began to rule. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Abi, the daughter of Zechariah.

dag: Ka yiŋbi so ŋun mi o duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛli ka bi mali shili bee n-tum kaman o duuma maa yubu ni nyɛ shɛm ni nya buri pam.
en: That servant knew what his master wanted him to do. But he did not make himself ready or try to do what his master wanted. So that servant will be punished very much!.

dag: Yi yi ti wum kikaa kumsi luɣ shɛli polo, yin laɣimmiya ti sanna. Ti Naawuni maa ni tuhi ti ti.
en: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei Jɛhu gbaŋ maa, ka bɛ gbahi naa bidibisi pisopɔin maa n-ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri niŋ piɛri ni n-zaŋ li tahi Jɛziriil ti ti o.
en: And when these people read Jehu's second letter, they called together all of Ahab's descendants. They killed them, put their heads in baskets, and sent them to Jezreel.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Lɛvinim ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ʒi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka pa ni shɛb yaha, dama bɛna ka Yawɛ daa pii ni bɛ ʒiri li, ka tumd o jɛma tuma sahakam.
en: Then he said, Only Levites should carry the Covenant Box, because they are the ones the Lord chose to carry it and to serve him forever.

dag: Bɛ ni ninvuɣ suŋ ŋmanila suligunyinyaɣu, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ maŋli mi ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ gɔ shɛŋa sa n-gili. Bɛ tibidarigibo dabisili la biɛɣu neeya, anabinim bɛn ŋmani tiŋguliba ni daa pun yɛli ba dabisi shɛli yɛla la. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ birimbu saha paaya.
en: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.

dag: Mɛriba kom la gbini bɛ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, ka yɛla daa paai Musa bɛ zuɣu.
en: But they angered God at Meribahs waters, and things went badly for Moses because of them.

dag: O nam sagbana niŋ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni na, ka chɛ ka mɔri zoori zoya zuɣu.
en: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka di ka nyu. Ka o daa bo difu ti bɛ bunsi la gba.
en: And he took him into his house. He mixed feed for the donkeys, and they washed their feet, ate, and drank.

dag: ka niriba dooi anzinfa mini salima pa di zuɣu, ka zaŋ kpahi mini matarika n-kpahi li zali, din ni chɛ ka di ku dam.
en: Its overlaid with silver and gold, and fastened securely with hammer and nails so it wont fall over.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, Naawuni zahimmi n yɛla nya, ka deei n suhigu ka ti ma bidibiga; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Dan.
en: Rachel said, God has judged in my favor. He has heard my prayer and has given me a son; so she named him Dan.

dag: Ti valim ba zaɣ nɛma kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni niŋdi shɛm la. Ti ni vali ba zaɣ muna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe gballi ni.
en: We will swallow them whole, as the grave swallows the dying.

dag: Ka Zilipa daa lan dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu pahi.
en: When they had another son.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, yi yi nya ka di simdi, yin yomiya ma n tuma yɔri. Ka yi yi ku yo ma, yin maliya li. Ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita yo ma.
en: Then I said, If you want to pay me, pay me. If not, dont! So they paid me pieces of silver.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Galili Teeku maa yaɣili tiŋgban shɛli din yuli booni Gɛrasa.
en: Jesus and his disciples sailed across Lake Galilee and came to shore near the town of Gerasa.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋubi yi naɣibihi, ka di yi puri atam zaa hal nti naai yi balibu, bɛ mi ti ku guui yi chi bee yi wain mini yi kpam ni yi naɣibihi ni biŋkɔbbaligu bihi hal ti kpihim yi birili.
en: They will take your animals and the food you grow. They will take everything until they destroy you. They will not leave you any grain, wine, oil, cattle, sheep, or goats. They will take everything, until they destroy you.

dag: N naan bo sɔɣibu shee yomyom, ka pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ku tooi paai ma.
en: I would hurry and find myself a shelter from the raging wind and the storm.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Bɛ pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha? Yi bi mi dunia ni daa nam shɛm?.
en: Dont you know? Havent you heard? Wasnt it announced to you from the beginning? Havent you understood since the earth was founded?.

dag: Yinim Yawɛ daba bɛn ʒe o jɛmbu duu yuŋ ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: All you who serve the LORD: bless the LORD right now! All you who minister in the LORDs house at night: bless God!.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu bela kasi. Ka so yi saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, Naawuni ni saɣim dilan gba.
en: God will destroy anyone who destroys God's temple. For God's temple is holy, and you yourselves are his temple.

dag: yin karimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa mini kuriti mali wun shɛŋa zaa, ka wurim bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: You will take the land from the people you find there. You must destroy all of their carved statues and idols. You must destroy all of their high places.

dag: Pɛnuɛl daa nyɛla Gɛdɔr ba, ka Ɛzɛr mi daa nyɛ Husha ba. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Hur bidibisi: o bituuli n-daa nyɛ Ɛfirat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛmnim yabidoo la.
en: Penuel was Gedors father, and Ezer was Hushahs father. These were Hurs sons. Hur was Ephrathahs first son, and Ephrathah was the founder of Bethlehem.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi tiri mmaŋ jilima, n jilima maa nyɛla yoli; m Ba so yi ni yɛli ni o nyɛla yi Naawuni la n-tiri ma jilima.
en: Jesus answered, If I give honor to myself, that honor is worth nothing. The one who gives me honor is my Father. And you say that he is your God.

dag: Jɛhoyachin yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisaayika saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa niŋla chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Nɛhushita. Ka Nɛhushita mi ba daa nyɛ Ɛlnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm nir la.
en: Jehoiachin was years old when he began to rule. He ruled three months in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ka galimi chɛmi ka bɛ soya tuhi, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri maŋmaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali n-nyɛ din luhiri ba.
en: Honesty makes a good person's life easier, but the wicked will cause their own downfall.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko maa:.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

dag: Ka Shafan daa lab Naa Jɔsia sanna nti yɛl o, A tumtumdiba yihi laɣ shɛli zaa din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa.
en: Then he went back to the king and reported: Your servants have taken the money that was in the Temple and have handed it over to the men in charge of the repairs.

dag: Bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo a jɛmbu duu maa, ka ta a ni be luɣ shɛl la daɣiri. Bɛ daai li luhi zaa.
en: They wrecked your Temple and set it on fire; they desecrated the place where you are worshiped.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋa, ka kɔŋ yɛligu.
en: While the man was talking to me, I bowed low with my face toward the ground. I could not speak.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa lan nya alahiziba shihir titali alizanda ni. Malaikanima ayopɔin n-daa mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din kpalim nyaaŋa, dina n-daa nyɛ Naawuni suhuyiɣisili alɔbɔnim din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.

dag: N ni yaai n noli yɛli a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na zaa yɛla.
en: I will repeat aloud all the laws you have given.

dag: Amaa di daa nyɛla Yawɛ yubu ni o chɛ ka o nya dansi ni biɛrim. O daa chɛ ka o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima alahichi zuɣu, ka o ni ti nya o zuliya, ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli. Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali o zuɣu.
en: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N Duuma Naawuni, bɛ ku a daanabinima, ka wurim a sara malibu bimbina, ka n kɔŋko n-kpalim ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yihi man gba nyɛvili.
en: Lord, they have killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only prophet still living, and they are trying to kill me now.

dag: Hal Siria tɔbbihi maa ni daa bi galisi maa zaa yoli, Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, dama tɔbbihi maa daa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa darigi Jɔash tibili.
en: Although the Aramean forces were relatively small, the LORD handed over to them a very large army, because the people of Judah had abandoned the LORD, their ancestors God. Jehoash was justly punished.

dag: Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa nyɛla bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni. Hal n jɛmbu duu puuni n nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This message is from the Lord : The prophets and even the priests are evil. I have seen them doing evil things in my own Temple.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord told Moses to get up early the next morning and say to the king: The Lord God of the Hebrews commands you to let his people go, so they can worship him!.

dag: Amaa ka pii din mali kpiɔŋ daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa ni tiŋ maa ni nanim zaa daa zo nti kpe di ni, ka yo di dunoli n-kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ di ni. Ka du pii maa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ti beni.
en: There was a strong tower there, and every man and woman in the city, including the leaders, ran to it. They locked themselves in and went up to the roof.

dag: Abimilɛk daa bela Aruma, ka Zɛbul daa kari Gaal min o dɔɣiriba maa ti bahi ka bɛ ku tooi lan be Shɛkɛm.
en: Abimelech stayed at Arumah, and Zebul forced Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.

dag: M bi suhir a tirila bɛmbɔŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa n suhir a tiri bɛn gba na yɛn niŋ ma yɛda bɛmbɔŋɔ yɛligu wumbu ni la.
en: I pray not only for these followers but also for those who will believe in me because of their teaching.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha bia;.
en: But thats not the way it will be with you. Whoever wants to be great among you will be your servant.

dag: Ka yilibila daa bili yina tam yila anahi maa zaɣ yini zuɣu. Ka di yiko daa yɛligi kpa nudirigu polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la polo.
en: Then a little horn grew from one of those four horns. It grew and became very big. It grew toward the southeast, toward the Beautiful Land.

dag: Ŋun mali tɛha yuuni bɔrila yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun kul lihirila dunia luɣilikam.
en: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa piɛb o kikaa, ka saŋmar titali ŋun ne kaman buɣim mokpalli la yi zuɣusaa n-lu mɔɣa ata kam zaɣ yin ni mini kɔbilisi ni.
en: Then the third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star, burning like a torch, fell from heaven. It fell on a third of the rivers and springs of water.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, ŋuhima; ŋuhimi ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini biɛrim pam bɛ ninni.
en: Ezekiel, groan in sorrow and despair so that everyone can hear you.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bɛrishiiba ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and the small towns around it.

dag: Ka yi ni yi alahichi tumbu dabitim ni la zuɣu chɛ ka yi yipa leela wuntia daba.
en: You were made free from sin, and now you are slaves to what is right.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia ba Naawuni ŋun kul simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ mi ni m bi ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: God knows that I am not lying. He is the God and Father of the Lord Jesus, and he is to be praised forever.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tum tuma ka o yuli du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa zaa ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana la, amaa o yuli daa lee bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: Abishai was as famous as the Three Heroes. He became their leader, even though he was not one of them.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ li yɛri saha shɛl o yi ti yɛn tum tuma, ka o yi ti kpɛri luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ tooni bee o yi ti yirina, di ni chaɣisiri ka bɛ wumdi di vuri din ni chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali di firilanim ayopɔin mini di buɣim kpihiri bina ni di buɣim moori bina.
en: He made its seven lamps and its tongs and its fire pans out of pure gold.

dag: Bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baal mini Ashitarɔt.
en: They stopped worshiping the Lord and served the Baals and the Astartes.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛri be. Bɛ kul nyarila buni pahiri ka di bi to.
en: Look at these wicked ones, always relaxed, piling up the wealth!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisa nyɛla maligumaani tital so ŋun tumdi din sɔŋdi ti ni yɛlimaŋli. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi ka ka galimi, ka alahichi mi ka o ni; Naawuni n-wolig o ka o be o ko ka chɛ alahichinima, ka duh o gari sokam zaa bɛn be alizanda ni.
en: Jesus, then, is the High Priest that meets our needs. He is holy; he has no fault or sin in him; he has been set apart from sinners and raised above the heavens.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni zɔri shɛli dina m-paari ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyarila bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: What the wicked dread will come on them, but what the righteous desire will be given to them.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. Nyin nyɛbiga ŋun bahibahi amaŋ be ko sunsuuni ka yɛra, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli. Mani n-daa gbi li.
en: Say, This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Pharaoh, king of Egypt. You are the great monster lying beside the Nile River. You say, This is my river! I made this river.

dag: Ka ninsalinim daa ti tumdi tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka duŋ taabo daa kul be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: God knew that everyone was terribly cruel and violent.

dag: Alɔbo maa lubu nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza.
en: After the Lord had stopped the deadly disease from killing the Israelites, he said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛl taba, Ti ku nya ti ni yɛn zaŋ yɛl shɛli fiɣisi Daniɛl, naɣila zaŋ chaŋ o Naawuni jɛma la polo.
en: Finally, they said, We will never find any reason to accuse Daniel of doing something wrong. So we must find something to complain about that is connected to the law of his God.

dag: ka nir yiŋnim ni nyɛla o dimnima.
en: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.

dag: Yinim Samarianima, n zaɣisi yi naɣibil maa. N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn tooi yi taali ni?.
en: He has refused your calf, Samaria. God says, I am very angry with the Israelites. The people of Israel will be punished for their sin. Some worker made those statues. They are not God. Samarias calf will be broken into pieces.

dag: Yaa tiŋgbani, miri ka a pi n ʒim; di chɛ ka n kuhigu zani soli.
en: O Earth, don't hide the wrongs done to me! Don't let my call for justice be silenced!.

dag: Naawuni mi daa bi ŋmaai di tiŋgbɔŋ maa hal napɔŋ yaabu yim zuɣu ti o, amaa ka daa lee lo alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o, ka o yaansi ti di di fali o kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa na ka bia gba.
en: But God did not give Abraham any of this land, not even a foot of it. But God promised that in the future he would give Abraham this land for himself and for his children. This was before Abraham had any children.

dag: Amaa a daa niŋ a viɛlim maa naani, ka gɔri pagɔrisigu a yudua maa zuɣu. A daa chɛ ka a mini ŋunkam gariti nimaani dɔni.
en: But you began to trust in your beauty. You used the good name you had and became unfaithful to me. You acted like a prostitute with every man who passed by. You gave yourself to them all!.

dag: Di saha ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Firawuna, N teegi n galimi ni nyɛ shɛli zuŋɔ.
en: The king's personal servant said: Now I remember what I was supposed to do.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri, di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; dama momaha niŋ mɔɣu ni; ka tihi wali, ka fiig tihi mini wain tihi wali pam.
en: Animals, don't be afraid. The pastures are green; the trees bear their fruit, and there are plenty of figs and grapes.

dag: ka daa zaŋ maha tari Izraɛl salo bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba maa zaa, ka sokam daa deei mahi yiniyini mini nim kpillikpilli ni bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa zaɣ yiniyini pahi. Di nyaaŋa ka sokam daa wurim kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: He distributed food among all the people of Israel—to the whole crowd, male and female—each receiving a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake. Then all the people went back to their homes.

dag: Lala zuɣu cheechi nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ cheechi zuɣu maa niŋgbuŋ; ka ŋun Masia nyɛ binshɛɣukam ni pali so ni, ka o mi nyɛ ŋun pali binshɛɣukam ni mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.

dag: Yawɛ yoog o bidibbina ni be luɣ shɛli n-yih o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina, dama ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ mali tuma ni o tum Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I've brought out my weapons, and with them I will put a curse on Babylonia.

dag: Shaharaim daa dɔɣi bidibisi Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa kar o paɣiba bɛn yuya daa booni Hushim mini Baara la nyaaŋa.
en: Shaharaim divorced his wives Hushim and Baara in Moab. After he did this he had some children with another wife.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni yi Shɛfam maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ribila din be Ain wulimpuhili polo la, ka tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku din be wulimpuhili polo la naɣiliŋga ni.
en: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee.

dag: Ka n daa lihi, n nya wɔr fufuhigu, ka ŋun bar o yuli booni Kum, ka Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee dol o nyaaŋa, ka Naawuni daa ti ba yiko ni bɛ tooi zaŋ takɔbiri mini kum ni alɔbo ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri n-ku daadamnim niriba anahi kam puuni ninvuɣ yino.
en: I looked, and there was a pale-colored horse. Its rider was named Death, and Hades followed close behind. They were given authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill by means of war, famine, disease, and wild animals.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli Masia ni zali ti. Dina n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yuri Naawuni, di simdi ni o yur o mabia gba.
en: The commandment that God has given us is: Love God and love each other.

dag: Puhimi Prisila mini Akuila ni Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnima.
en: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.

dag: Yi kul nahindi yimaŋa n-chani bɔri buɣa shee ni yi jɛm li, ka bi yɛri ni di ka buchi. Yi tɛhiya ni dina n-tiri ya kpiɔŋ, ka yi bi gbarigira.
en: Worn out by all your efforts, yet you wouldnt say, This is useless. You found new strength; therefore, you werent tired.

dag: Ka Zara daa la o suhu ni ka yɛli, N kurigiya, ka n yidan gba kurigi, ka n kɔre ni lan be doo ni.
en: So she laughed and said to herself, Now that I am worn out and my husband is old, will I really know such happiness.

dag: Ka o lan maa yi be katiŋa bee a yi bi mi o lana, dindina nyin taɣim o kul a yiŋa, ka o ti be a sani hal ka o lan maa ti bɔh o yɛla, ka a zaŋ o ti o.
en: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.

dag: Ka daa lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu niŋm tuuba a biɛribiɛtali ŋɔ zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni; di pa shɛli o ni chɛ a tɛhi biɛri din nyɛ alahichi maa paŋ a.
en: Repent, then, of this evil plan of yours, and pray to the Lord that he will forgive you for thinking such a thing as this.

dag: A mi n ʒinibu saha, ka mi n yiɣisibu saha. Hal n yi tɛhi ni m bela katiŋa, a mi n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You know everything I do; from far away you understand all my thoughts.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza daa lan va Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa kuli Babilɔn ti zal o nam yili ni Babilɔn maa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar also carried off many of the valuable things in the Lord 's temple, and he put them in his palace in Babylon.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Kpe ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ti yɛn be, ka Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn zaŋdi sara nyɔri buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu be kpe.
en: Then David said, This is where the LORD Gods temple will be, along with Israels altar for entirely burned offerings.

dag: Biɛɣ asiba ka Yawɛ daa be sagban buɣim daantaliga maa ni, ka lihi tiŋ na n-nya Ijipti tɔbbihi maa, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lu abirima.
en: As morning approached, the LORD looked down on the Egyptian camp from the column of lightning and cloud and threw the Egyptian camp into a panic.

dag: Di daa paai yuma ata ka Izraɛlnim mini Sirianim bi lan tuhi taba.
en: For three years there was no war between Aram and the Israelites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jahaziɛl zuɣu na niriba maa ni. Jahaziɛl daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka Zakaria nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia, ka Bɛnaaya nyɛ Jɛiɛl bia, ka Jɛiɛl mi nyɛ Matania ŋun daa yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Asaf daŋ ni nir la bia.
en: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jahaziel son of Zechariah. Jahaziel was a Levite from the family of Asaph. In the middle of the meeting.

dag: dama Jɔn daa yɛlila Naa Hɛrɔd ni di chihiri ni o fa o niŋ o paɣa.
en: John had told him, It is not right for you to be married to Herodias.

dag: Ka o daa kpaai kom maa n-niŋ laakumnim maa kɔnyuribin ni yomyom, ka lan guui lab kɔbiliga maa ni ni o ti ŋɔŋ na yaha n-daa ŋɔŋ kom ti o laakumnim maa zaa.
en: So Rebekah quickly poured all the water from her jar into the drinking trough for the camels. Then she ran to the well to get more water, and she gave water to all the camels.

dag: Ka Kiriatijiarimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-kuli ti zaŋ li tahi do so ŋun yuli daa booni Abinadab ka o yili be daboli zuɣu la yiŋa. Ka bɛ daa piig o bia Ɛliɛza ni o yuuni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: So the people of Kiriath-jearim came and took the LORDs chest. They brought it to Abinadabs house, which was on the hill. Then they dedicated Eleazar, Abinadabs son, to care for the LORDs chest.

dag: chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo ti suhuri ni niŋ yɛda, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paɣi neei ka ti yi taali ni ti suhuri ni tɛha puuni, ka su ti niŋgbuna mi ko viɛlli, ka vu m-miri Naawuni.
en: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.

dag: N ni kul di tiŋgban shɛli fali maa biɛhigu shee viɛla; n ni di fali shɛli maa viɛla.
en: My share is wonderful. My inheritance is very beautiful.

dag: Ka du shɛli din dunoli kpa nuzaa polo ŋɔ nyɛ maligumaana ŋun su sara maligu bimbini fukumsi duu. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yi Zadok zuliya ni na. Bɛ kɔŋko m-mali soli Lɛvi zuliya niriba sunsuuni ni bɛ miri Yawɛ sani nti tum o tuma.
en: and the room which faced north was for the priests who served at the altar. All the priests are descended from Zadok; they are the only members of the tribe of Levi who are permitted to go into the Lord 's presence to serve him.

dag: M bi yɛn pahi so zuɣu bee n-niŋ so naŋgban malisim.
en: I will not take sides in this debate; I am not going to flatter anyone.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛli Yaakubu, M bia, saɣisim mirina ka n shih a nya a shiri nyɛla m bia Iso bee a pa o.
en: My son, Isaac said, come closer, where I can touch you and find out if you really are Esau.

dag: Bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu la gbariginsim puuni, amaa ka o lan be Naawuni yiko zuɣu. Ti gba nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima o ni, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo ti min o ni ti laɣim be Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: Certainly he was crucified because of weakness, but he lives by the power of God. Certainly we also are weak in him, but we will live together with him, because of Gods power that is directed toward you.

dag: Bɛ saɣim ti wain tihi, ka ŋub ti fiig tihi. Bɛ ŋub puɣisi di tipaɣiri hal ka di wula zaa ti leela zaɣ piɛla.
en: They have destroyed our grapevines and chewed up our fig trees. They have stripped off the bark, till the branches are white.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni, ka ti yi yuri taba Naawuni ni be ti ni ka o yurilim ni niŋ dɛde ti ni.
en: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.

dag: Chamiya, amaa nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛbihi ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la.
en: Go! I am sending you like lambs among wolves.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya mi daa su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi daa nyɛ nayili tuma kpamba.
en: Jehoiadas son Benaiah was in command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and Davids sons were the kings chief personal advisors.

dag: Bɛ yi shiri nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa be bɛ sani, dindina bɛn suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni o di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ la shɛŋa din kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini Juda nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm la kuli Babilɔn.
en: If they are really prophets and if they have my message, let them ask me, the Lord Almighty, not to allow the treasures that remain in the Temple and in the royal palace to be taken to Babylonia. .

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima.
en: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being.

dag: Di daa nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi ni, ka naa daa ʒi o kikaa saha yili ni, ka buɣim be kurupooti ni ʒe o tooni.
en: The time this happened was in the ninth month, so King Jehoiakim was sitting in the part of the palace used for winter. There was a fire burning in a small fireplace in front of the king.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu. Yɛlimaŋli, hal n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu.
en: I am waiting for my Lord, like a guard waiting and waiting for the morning to come.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: And so I led them out of Egypt into the desert.

dag: Dɔb ŋɔ zaa daa kpuɣila tinzun paɣiba, ka bɛ daa kari bɛ paɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: All these men married foreign women, and some of them had children with these wives.

dag: M mi ni di ni simdi ni daadamnim niŋ shɛli nyɛla bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, ka di nyaɣisim hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: I know that theres nothing better for them but to enjoy themselves and do whats good while they live.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba la sani ti yɛl o, Di ku baŋdiba maa. Zaŋm ma tahi naa sani ka n ti wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: Then Daniel went to Arioch, the man who King Nebuchadnezzar had chosen to kill the wise men of Babylon. Daniel said to Arioch, Dont kill the wise men of Babylon. Take me to the king. I will tell him what his dream means.

dag: Dinzuɣu di di simdi ka bɛna m-be kpe n-zan a tooni wuhi bɛ ni nya ka n taali nyɛ shɛli.
en: But some Jews from the province of Asia were there; they themselves ought to come before you and make their accusations if they have anything against me.

dag: Ka n ni daa dɔɣi maa nyaaŋa, di daba ata dali, ka paɣ ŋɔ gba daa dɔɣi, m min o kɔŋko n-kul be yili maa ni, ka so ka ti sani n-kul pahila ti niriba ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: This woman gave birth three days after I did. We stayed together. Apart from the two of us, there was no one else in the house.

dag: Amaa man ni yɛlimi, Yawɛ, n tum alahichi a sani, zom ma nambɔɣu ka tib ma.
en: I prayed, Have pity, Lord ! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.

dag: Yɛlimiy o ni n wumya ni o chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri ni o piɛguliba maa mi yi kul bela ti sani, ka ti bi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛli, bɛ mi binshɛli daa bi bɔrigi bɛ ni daa be ti sani Kamɛl saha shɛli maa.
en: Ive heard that you are now shearing sheep. As you know, your shepherds were with us in the wilderness. We didnt mistreat them. Moreover, the whole time they were at Carmel, nothing of theirs went missing.

dag: Ti mabihi maa daa zaŋla Piɛbil la ʒim mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu n-nyaŋ o, dama bɛ daa bi zaɣisi kum di puuni.
en: They gained the victory over him on account of the blood of the Lamb and the word of their witness. Love for their own lives didnt make them afraid to die.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa tim anab so Izraɛlnim sanna ka o ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti na, ka yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: the LORD sent them a prophet, who said to them, The LORD, Israels God, proclaims: I myself brought you up from Egypt, and I led you out of the house of slavery.

dag: Di kɔŋkɔba bebu din pahi nyɛla, di daa simdi ni bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔbili bɛ ni daa kpiri ka bɛ tuma zaani tariga la zuɣu;.
en: The others who became priests are numerous because death prevented them from continuing to serve.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di miri kpe na, pirigim a namda maa, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee.
en: Then God said, Dont come any closer. Take off your sandals. You are standing on holy ground.

dag: Yi ni shɛb kpɛla yimaŋ duhibu ni, dama yi tɛhimi ni n ku lan ka yi sanna.
en: Some have become arrogant as if Im not coming to see you.

dag: Di saha Samuɛl daa na bi mi Yawɛ ka Yawɛ mi daa na ʒi n-kahig o yɛligu wuh o.
en: The Lord had not spoken to Samuel before, and Samuel did not recognize the voice.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayopɔin dali, Ammihud bia Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the seventh day Ephraims Chief Elishama, Ammihuds son.

dag: M Ba yuri ma, n ni zaŋ n nyɛvili sɔŋ ni n ti lan kpuɣ li la zuɣu.
en: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa duhi Jɔshua Izraɛlnim zaa ninni, ka bɛ daa lu Jɔshua sizuura kaman bɛ ni daa yi luri Musa sizuura shɛm la hal ni Jɔshua nyɛvili tariga.
en: What the Lord did that day made the people of Israel consider Joshua a great man. They honored him all his life, just as they had honored Moses.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari alaka Naawuni yubu tumbu zuɣu mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Happy are those who are persecuted because they do what God requires; the Kingdom of heaven belongs to them!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di chɛ ka paɣ so lan zali pua di yuŋ maa yaha. Di chɛ ka so lan wum suhupiɛlli vuri di ni yaha.
en: I wish that night had produced nothing and no happy shouts had been heard.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri kuri ba solɔri zuɣu, ka dabiɛm pam ti be duri puuni. Di ni paai nachimbihi mini paɣipiɛlisi ni bimɔɣirisi ni ninkura bɛn zuɣuri paligi.
en: War will bring death in the streets; terrors will strike in the homes. Young men and young women will die; neither babies nor old people will be spared.

dag: Di ti ku ŋmani n ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Yi Duuma lan yɛli, Bɛ daa bi gbibi alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo ba la, dinzuɣu ka m mi baɣa daa ka bɛ ni.
en: It will not be like the covenant that I made with their ancestors on the day I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They were not faithful to the covenant I made with them, and so I paid no attention to them.

dag: M mabiyurisi, ti ni mal alikaulinim ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti paɣ ti nuhi n-yi dinkam nyɛ din ni ta nir niŋgbuŋ min o shia daɣiri ni, ka chɛliya ka biɛrikasitali niŋ dɛde ti Naawuni zɔbu puuni.
en: Dear friends, we have these promises from God. So we should make ourselves pure—free from anything that makes our body or our soul unclean. Our respect for God should make us try to be completely holy in the way we live.

dag: ni Jɛshua ni Molada ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: They also lived in the cities of Jeshua, Moladah, Bethpelet.

dag: O sani ka dɔɣiri yini kam niriba bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa yu maŋli yina.
en: Every family in heaven and on earth gets its true name from him.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa wuhi ma, ka m baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa wuhi ma bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: The Lord informed me of the plots that my enemies were making against me.

dag: Ka o zuɣuri la ni yini daa mali dan titali din ŋmani din yɛn ku o; amaa ka daa lee lan naai, ka di daa niŋ dunianim zaa alahiziba ka bɛ kab dol o.
en: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have been fatally wounded, but the wound had healed. The whole earth was amazed and followed the beast.

dag: Dama bɛ maŋmaŋ naba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti kpɛhi zana ni, ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: Before they know it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yeeg o binyɛra maa ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ tampiligim maa yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: The priest will then take off his clothes, dress in a different set of clothes, and take the ashes outside the camp to a clean location.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: One of Jesus' followers pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa daŋ tooni na maa yɛli malaika so ŋun doli nyaaŋa na maa, Guui chaŋ ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun mali bimbuɣisirigu maa ni niriba pam mini niɣi pam n-yɛn be Jɛrusalɛm; ka di be kaman tiŋkpansi din ka goma la.
en: He said to him, Run and tell that young man this: Jerusalem will be a city without walls, because there will be too many people and animals living there.

dag: n-nya tarimba, ka n daa kpahim bipola n-nya nachimbil so ŋun ka yɛm bɛ ni.
en: some foolish young men.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la min o maligumaanitab la mi su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee din daa be Gibiɔn Jɛmbu shee la fukumsi.
en: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord 's sacred tent at Gibeon.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntitali be o ʒiɛman ni, ka chɛ ka suhudoo pam beni kaman goli ni beni ka o neesim be shɛm la sahakam.
en: Let goodness grow everywhere while he is king. Let peace continue as long as there is a moon.

dag: paɣimiy o cheechi ni.
en: To him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus for all time, forever and ever. Amen.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka kpiɔŋnim zaŋ takɔbiri na ti ku a tɔbbihi. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ ni ti saɣim Ijiptinim ni mali binshɛŋa nyuri bara la, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa.
en: I will make your hordes fall by the swords of mighty men, the most terrifying of the nations, all of them. They will bring an end to Egypts pride, and all of its hordes will be destroyed.

dag: Amaa ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa bi tooi kari tinsi maa nima; ka Keenannim maa daa kul kpalim be tinsi maa ni.
en: The people of Manasseh couldnt take over these cities, and the Canaanites were determined to live in this land.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-nyɛ bɛ zuɣupila, amaa jɛrilim n-nyɛ jɛra dolibi.
en: Wealth is the crown of the wise, and the folly of fools is folly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa da jinjɛŋŋmaa maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa n-zaŋ li so.
en: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.

dag: A zaligu din yi a nol ni na nyɛla bin viɛlli n sani gari salima mini anzinfa kpila tusa shɛm.
en: The Instruction youve given to me is better than thousands of pieces of gold and silver!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ti zaŋ kuɣ parilana maa niŋ n ni daa mali adaka shɛli maa puuni, ka di be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ma shɛm maa.
en: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ paɣi dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa, ka o lan kpari li niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: He must order the people to wash it. Then he must separate the clothing for seven more days.

dag: N shia faai siɣi, n dabisa naaya, gballi malila shili guli ma.
en: My spirit is broken, my days extinguished, the grave, mine.

dag: Bɛ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiri gba be di ni; ka bɛ je ni bɛ tum yɛm tuma ni din viɛla.
en: The words of their mouths are evil and dishonest. They have stopped being wise and stopped doing good.

dag: Bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be bɛ sani. Ka bɛn Izraɛlnim nyɛ n niriba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone will know that I protect Israel and that they are my people. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Karimbaannim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa, bɛ ni ti siɣisi ba; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: A day is coming when human pride will be ended and human arrogance destroyed. Then the Lord alone will be exalted.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: in the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;.

dag: Ka bia maa yɛl o, A tizɔbil la n-kuna, ka a ba chɛ ka ti kɔrigi naɣila kpabili, o ni labina ni alaafee maa zuɣu.
en: The servant replied, Your brother has arrived, and your father has slaughtered the fattened calf because he received his son back safe and sound.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi tɛha be kaman tɛhi shɛli din be Masia ni la:.
en: Adopt the attitude that was in Christ Jesus.

dag: wulikpani nyoli ni ŋ-ŋmaai di zaɣ maani n-zaŋ li chaŋ daabiligu tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti zaŋ li sa kɔhigɔriba tiŋ ni.
en: then carried it to a nation of merchants and left it in one of their cities.

dag: Judanim daa tum din bie Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa tum alahichi gari bɛ yaannim ni daa tum shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Judah did evil in the LORDs eyes. The sins they committed made the LORD angrier than anything their ancestors had done.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la daa yina ni o ti tuhi naa soli. Naa ni daa kul yi Jɛrusalɛm dahin shɛli maa Mɛfibɔshɛt daa bi lan paɣ o naba bee m-mal o teeŋa bee m-paɣ o situra hal ka o ti labina ni alaafee maa.
en: Sauls grandson, Mephibosheth, came down to meet King David. Mephibosheth had not cared for his feet, trimmed his mustache, or washed his clothes since the day the king left Jerusalem.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zali yiya tuɣi taba, ka gbahi paliti tuɣi taba hal ka so ti ku lan nya palo nimaani pahi yi zuɣu, ka yi kɔŋko n-kul be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: You are doomed! You buy more houses and fields to add to those you already have. Soon there will be no place for anyone else to live, and you alone will live in the land.

dag: o ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la; o ni daa po pɔri n-lo Yisahaku alikauli shɛli.
en: God made an eternal promise.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa; ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So Othniel son of Kenaz, Calebs brother, captured it, and Caleb gave him Achsah his daughter in marriage.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai bɛ ba Yaakubu sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ daa yɛl o la dinkam zaa niŋ ba, ka lan yɛl o.
en: When they got back to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they described to him everything that had happened to them.

dag: Ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ kpe kuɣ viɛla zaɣ kara ni bɛ zaŋ li me duu maa tanzaa m-pahi kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali ka di viɛla.
en: King Solomon commanded them to cut large, expensive stones for the foundation of the Temple.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Lomiy o nuhi min o naba n-zaŋ o ti bahi kpaŋ ha zibisim shee. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina. .
en: Then the king told the servants, Tie him up hand and foot, and throw him outside in the dark. There he will cry and gnash his teeth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai sokam ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka niriba mali ba ansarisi ka yimaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were.

dag: Ka a lan yɛli ba: Yi ni ti yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam tiri Yawɛ ka di nyɛ yi sahakam sara n-nyɛ yuun yini piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi.
en: Each day offer two rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. The animals must have nothing wrong with them;.

dag: Naawuni, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma; n Naawuni, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: Dont be far from me, God! My God, hurry to help me!.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla Yɛhudianim kɔŋko Naawuni? Bee o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni? Iin, o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni.
en: God is not only the God of the Jews. He is also the God of those who are not Jews.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ tusa bɛn yuri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima, n wuhiri n yurilim maŋli bɛ sani.
en: But I will be very kind to people who love me and obey my commands. I will be kind to their families for thousands of generations!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan chaŋ ti lu Keenannim bɛn be Hiburɔn la nim zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai.
en: After that, they attacked the Canaanites who lived at Hebron, defeating the three clans called Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. At that time, Hebron was called Kiriath-Arba.

dag: Gaad bihi n-daa ʒini bɛ nyaaŋa baɣili ba Bashan tiŋgban ni zaŋ lala hal ni Salɛka.
en: The tribe of Gad lived to the north of Reuben in the land of Bashan as far east as Salecah.

dag: N je ʒiri, ka zaɣisi li, amaa n yur a zaligu.
en: I hate and detest all lies, but I love your law.

dag: A tizɔpaɣ yurigu la bihi puhir a.
en: The children of your sister who was chosen by God send you their love.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira, ka do yino paɣa kana ni o ti fa o yidana ŋun bur o maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o nuu gbaag o tooni.
en: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Bildad from Shuah said:.

dag: O daa va salima mini anzinfa n-tabili Naawuni jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa din daa beni ka Obɛdɛdom bihi gul li la zaa, ka va nayili daazichi zaa, ka gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-lab kuli Samaria.
en: Joash took all the gold and silver, and all the objects he could find in Gods temple in the care of Obed-edom, and in the treasuries of the palace, along with some hostages. Then he returned to Samaria.

dag: Dama yi bɔhira, Nabia maa yil la be ya? Ninvuɣ biɛɣu maa ni daa be yili shɛl ni la lee be ya.
en: You ask, Where are the homes of great people now, those who practiced evil.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Yawɛ ni zali ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: he said, We are here to follow the Lord 's instructions.

dag: ka chɛ ka o yo paɣisarili maa ba anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga, o ni saɣim Izraɛl paɣa ŋun nyɛ paɣipali yuli maa zuɣu. O na kul ni nyɛla o paɣa, ka di bi simdi ni o zaɣis o saha shɛl o ni be o nyɛvili ni.
en: because he accused his bride of not being a virgin. He will have to pay her father pieces of silver and will never be allowed to divorce her.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zani, di gba zaanimi, ka bɛ daa yi yiɣi, di gba doli ba mi yiɣi, dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela di ni.
en: When the creatures stopped, the wheels stopped; and when the creatures flew, the wheels went with them, because the creatures controlled them.

dag: Yi ni daa fa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya nɛma, ka ku ba la zuɣu, yi ni di vi, ka n kpihim yi birili hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum lala maa ka o bɔhi ni Yisa nyɛla Galili nira?.
en: Hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.

dag: Bɛn kpalim mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ, pa ti Duuma n-yɛli dina: Yi ni so yi mali paɣa ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda ka paɣ maa yu ni o be o sani, ŋun miri ka o yih o.
en: To the others I say : if a Christian man has a wife who is an unbeliever and she agrees to go on living with him, he must not divorce her.

dag: Zuliya shɛb buɣili na mi n-fa o tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi?.
en: Did the gods of any other nations save their countries from the emperor of Assyria?.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun kul be, ka nyɛ ninsalinim nini ni ku tooi nya so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka simdi tibigibu mini jilima tibu ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Honor and glory to the King who rules forever. He cannot be destroyed and cannot be seen. Honor and glory forever and ever to the only God. Amen.

dag: Ka do so yi nyɛla faralana ka ku tooi yo yi ni zali da shɛli maa, dindina yin zaŋmi dilan chaŋ maligumaana sani, ka o ti zal o daa, maligumaana ni zal o daa maa ka di dolila ŋun po pɔri maa dahima ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidib shɛb bɛn kpalim daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni n-di nɛma bɛ tizɔpaɣ maa zuɣu.
en: Jacobs sons went to the city and stole everything that was there because of what Shechem had done to their sister.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya bɛ mini Bɛnjamin, o daa yɛlila o yiŋ tumtumda, Zaŋm niriba maa kuli yiŋa, ka gbaai biŋkɔbigu kɔrigi m-mal o duɣi bindirigu, dama m mini niriba maa n-yɛn laɣim di wuntaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the manager of his household, Bring the men to the house and slaughter an animal and prepare it because the men will have dinner with me at noon.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: May those who try to kill me be defeated and confused. May those who are happy because of my troubles be turned back and disgraced.

dag: ka Gidiɔni bia Abidan daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulana.
en: Then came the tribe of Benjamin. Abidan son of Gideoni was the commander of that group.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa kpuɣi Rut kul o yiŋa nti zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Rut ni ka o zali pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So Boaz took Ruth home as his wife. The Lord blessed her, and she became pregnant and had a son.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di daanya kurupooti la ni di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni di tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli ka na bi niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni n-niŋ bɛ bɔrɔbɔro shɛr lahi ni n-guri adiikunim ni n-zaŋ pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: So the Israelites quickly made some bread dough and put it in pans. But they did not mix any yeast in the dough to make it rise. They wrapped cloth around the pans and carried them on their shoulders.

dag: O tim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlana ŋun yi o dabili Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: He has provided for us a mighty Savior, a descendant of his servant David.

dag: ka din pahi pinaata gbaai Hupa, ka din pahi pinaanahi gbaai Jɛshɛbiab.
en: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab.

dag: Ti kul dolila ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun nyɛ Rɛkab bia maa ni daa zali ti zaligu shɛŋa maa, dina n-nyɛ ni ti mini ti paɣiba ni ti bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi di nyu wain ti biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: So we have obeyed everything our ancestor Jonadab commanded us. None of us ever drinks wine, and neither do our wives, sons, or daughters.

dag: Ka o bapir maa daa yɛl o, N suhir a mi, yɛlim ma Samuɛl ni yɛl a shɛm.
en: Please tell me what Samuel told you, Sauls uncle said.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba ka bɛ yɛri taba, Nyamiya, bɛn zaa tɔɣisiri ŋɔ pala Galilinima?.
en: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?.

dag: ka daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima sokam zaa zuɣu la. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din di Naawuni ni daa pun lo shɛm shɛhira, ka nyɛ din yi palo di saha dɛde.
en: who gave himself to redeem the whole human race. That was the proof at the right time that God wants everyone to be saved.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ biɛri firila kpiya ka bɛ buɣim bi lan ne.
en: Yes, the light of those who are evil will go out. Their fire will stop burning.

dag: Ka n daa nya shi biɛr ata bɛn ŋmani poloya, ka bɛ yiri waɣ biɛ tital la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni anabi ʒirilan la noya ni na.
en: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.

dag: Ka yi mini Shiiba daabihi ni Raama daabihi daa niŋdi daabiligu ni taba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi tulaale viɛla balibu kam mini kuɣ viɛla ni salima na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you. They traded all the best spices and every kind of precious stone and gold for your goods.

dag: A sani ka n ni paɣir a shɛm yirina a niriba laɣiŋgu tital ni; ka n ni mali n ni pun po pɔri ni m mali sara shɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura sani la.
en: In the full assembly I will praise you for what you have done; in the presence of those who worship you I will offer the sacrifices I promised.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima, yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din tuhi? Yi kariti niriba saria ka di doli soli?.
en: Do you rulers ever give a just decision? Do you judge everyone fairly?.

dag: Ka n lan chɛ ka tins ayi bee tins ata niriba chani tin yin ni ni bɛ ti nya kom nyu, ka bɛ yi chaŋ, bɛ ti bi nyari nyuri ka di saɣiri ba; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good, because his faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini kpamba maa daa zali Lɛvinim maa ni bɛ zaŋm Dauda mini anabi Asaf yɛtɔɣa la yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa yili wumpaɣibo yila maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to give praise to the Lord . They sang songs that David and Asaph the seer had written. They praised God and became happy. They all bowed and worshiped God.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, yin vuhimiya. Hal di yi nyɛla kɔbu saha mini puri atam kpuɣibu saha, yin vuhimiya.
en: You will work for six days, but on the seventh day you must rest. You must rest even during the times of planting and harvesting.

dag: Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni ka gbib ya;.
en: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila yuri Ijipti mini tiŋgban shɛŋa din pahi zaa ni na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: The people brought horses to Solomon from Egypt and from all the other countries.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka o daa yɛli zaŋ kpa Juda zuliya polo, Yawɛ, deemi Juda zuliya suhigu, ka zaŋ ba laɣim bɛ niriba ni, ka ti ba kpiɔŋ, ka sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: About the tribe of Judah he said: Lord , listen to their cry for help; Unite them again with the other tribes. Fight for them, Lord , And help them against their enemies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? A tizo maa ʒim kukoli kuhigu n-yi tiŋgban ni ka n sanna.
en: Then the Lord said, What have you done? You killed your brother and the ground opened up to take his blood from your hands. Now his blood is shouting to me from the ground. So you will be cursed from this ground.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara, dinzuɣu di leeya ninsalinim daba.
en: God paid a high price for you, so dont be slaves to anyone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim lan pala tinzunnim ni saamba yaha; yi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa yipa laɣim nyɛla tiŋbi yinsi ka nyɛ Naawuni yiŋnima.
en: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.

dag: ka piligi bur o taba, ka pahi danyuriba zuɣu diri ka nyura.
en: and he will begin to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapaɣa niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: Then they made acacia-wood boards to stand upright as a frame for the dwelling.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa chaŋ ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali ti paai Samaria n-daa teei gil li hal ka di ti paai yuma ata.
en: Then the Assyrian king invaded the whole country. He marched against Samaria and attacked it for three years.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, pahimiya o niriba zuɣu paɣ o. Dama o ni bɔhi biɛri o daba ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka bɔhi o dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je o tibili ka mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di viɛl ti o niriba.
en: Heavens: Rejoice with God! All you gods: bow down to the Lord! Because he will avenge his childrens blood; he will pay back his enemies; he will punish in kind those who hate him; he will cleanse his peoples land.

dag: Amaa niriba maa n-daa va ti ni tuhi di binshɛŋa maa zaa na, piɛri mini naɣilahi ni di ni daa simdi ni bɛ saɣim bin viɛl shɛŋa zaa, bɛ daa zaŋ li mi na ni bɛ ti mali sara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani Giligal.
en: Yes, the troops took sheep and cattle from the plunder—the very best items placed under the ban—but in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal.

dag: Yi mi ni dali nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia ti ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti ka alahichi, ti yɔhimla timaŋa ka yɛlimaŋli ka ti ni.
en: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.

dag: Man Saimɔn Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni o tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛda mali buchi kaman ti gba yɛda ni mali buchi shɛm ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia wuntitali puuni la.
en: From Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ— To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have been given a faith as precious as ours:.

dag: Rubin daa yɛli ba, Di yihiya o ʒim, zaŋmiy o niŋ bɔɣili ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka di niŋy o shɛli. O daa yɛlila lala ni o fa o bɛ nuu ni bahi n-zaŋ o kulisi ti ti bɛ ba.
en: We can put him into a well without hurting him. Reuben planned to save Joseph and send him back to his father.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣisi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb tintariga polo nti ʒini Kadɛshi mini Shur sunsuuni; ka daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ ti be Gɛra.
en: Abraham moved from Mamre to the southern part of Canaan and lived between Kadesh and Shur. Later, while he was living in Gerar.

dag: Sool mini Jɔnatan, n yurinima bɛn veeni yurilim. Bɛ daa bi woligi taba bɛ nyɛviya ni mini bɛ kum ni. Bɛ daa valim gari tɔrili. Bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari gbuɣima.
en: Saul and Jonathan—how dear they were to us! In life they loved being together, and even death did not separate them! They were faster than eagles and stronger than lions.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ salima jɛŋgbaris adaka mini alɔbo kɔtomsi la niŋ di ni.
en: They put the LORDs chest on the cart along with the box containing the gold mice and the images of their tumors.

dag: Ti daa wumya ka o yɛli ni o ni wurim bɛ ni daa zaŋ nuhi me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka me din pa nuhi mɛbu zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: We heard this man say, I will destroy this Temple built by human hands. And three days later, I will build another Temple not made by human hands.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka biriginsim yiko kpe bɛ ni birigi ba, ka bɛ doli ʒiri soli.
en: This is why God will send them an influence that will mislead them so that they will believe the lie.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Yisahaku, Yiɣisim ti sani, dama a mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, Leave our country. You have become more powerful than we are.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi gbaai ma, ka kum zana do n tooni.
en: The danger of death was around me, and the grave set its trap for me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Nyin Sintani, man Yawɛ kpahir a zuɣu ni! Man Yawɛ ŋun pii Jɛrusalɛm la kpahir a zuɣu ni! Doo ŋɔ ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni.
en: The angel of the Lord said to Satan, May the Lord condemn you, Satan! May the Lord , who loves Jerusalem, condemn you. This man is like a stick snatched from the fire.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dinzuɣu zaŋm a yɛlimaŋli maa m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Make them ready for your service through your truth. Your teaching is truth.

dag: So yi be yi ni n-nyɛ ŋun ka, ka nyɛ yi ʒilɛl ni nira m-be yi tin shɛl ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin di kuuya yi nini niŋ o bee n-kpibi yi nuu zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ka maa polo.
en: If in any of the towns in the land that the Lord your God is giving you there are Israelites in need, then do not be selfish and refuse to help them.

dag: Yurilim zuɣu ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim bɛn niŋdi lala maa, dama bɛ mi ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu zabbu tuma ti ma.
en: They are doing it out of love. They know that God gave me the work of defending the Good News.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Juda zuliya piligu shee daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Zin mɔɣu ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ɛdom tintariga.
en: The families of the tribe of Judah received a part of the land described as follows: The land reached south to the southernmost point of the wilderness of Zin, at the border of Edom.

dag: Yinim Jɛshurunnima, so kani ŋ-ŋmani yi Naawuni ŋun yi zuɣusaa na ni o ti sɔŋ ya ka nyɛ ŋun yi sagbana ni na ni jilima ŋɔ. Naawuni so ŋun ka bahigu ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi sɔɣisili shee.
en: People of Israel, no god is like your God, riding in splendor across the sky, riding through the clouds to come to your aid.

dag: A daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna gari tooni n-zaŋ a niriba bɛn ŋmani piɛri la chaŋ.
en: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.

dag: Duma yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Ka so daa boli ma Siɛr yɛra, Tiŋgula, bɔ saha ka biɛɣu yɛn neei? Yɛlim biɛɣu maa ni yɛn neei saha shɛli.
en: This is a message about Dumah : There is someone calling to me from Seir, Guard, how much of the night is left? How much longer will it be night.

dag: Ka Idɛn mini Miniamin ni Jɛshua ni Shɛmiya ni Amaria ni Shɛkania daa nyɛ bɛn pah o zuɣu n-sɔŋd o ni ʒiɛyimtali maligumaaniba tinsi ni m-pirigiri nɛma maa tiri bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa kaman bɛ ni daa piripiri ba shɛm.
en: In the other cities where priests lived, he was faithfully assisted in this by other Levites: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. They distributed the food equally to their fellow Levites according to what their duties were.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, dama n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n Naawuni.
en: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord ! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.

dag: Yi ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa pala ʒiri? Ka yi daanabitali nyɛ ʒiri. Hal n yi bi yɛli shɛli, yi yɛrimi, Yawɛ yɛliya. .
en: Didnt you see worthless visions? And didnt you report deceptive divinations and say, This is what the LORD says, even though I didnt speak?.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Ʒe dunoli maa ni. So yi ti kana ti bɔh a ni so be kpe, nyin yɛlim o ni so kani.
en: Then he said to her, Stand at the entrance to the tent. That way, if someone comes and asks you, Is there a man here? you can say, No.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa boli nimaani yuli, Yawɛ ni tahi na. Ka niriba na kul booni li lala hal ni zuŋɔ. Yawɛ zol la zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni tahi na.
en: Abraham named that place The Lord Will Provide. And even now people say, On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Lɛvinim ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ʒi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka pa ni shɛb yaha, dama bɛna ka Yawɛ daa pii ni bɛ ʒiri li, ka tumd o jɛma tuma sahakam.
en: David said, Only the Levites may carry Gods chest, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the LORDs chest and to minister to him forever.

dag: Ka Neetan daa garigi yɛli Dauda, Niŋm a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: Nathan answered David, You may do what you want to do. God is with you.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina mali nam ʒiishe titali, ka zaŋ salima alali dihi li nachiinsi.
en: The king also made a large ivory throne and covered it with pure gold.

dag: Yi mi n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, ka mi di soli.
en: You know the way that leads to the place where I am going.

dag: O ni vuui suhugarigu sagban shɛli din sirigina ti pili zuliya kam zaa maa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Here he will suddenly remove the cloud of sorrow that has been hanging over all the nations.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni bɛ di ŋubi mɔri bee bimbilli kam bee tihi vari, amaa ni bɛ nahimmila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka Naawuni bintabinda la bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu la.
en: They were told not to damage the fields of grass or any plant or tree. They were to hurt only those who did not have Gods mark on their foreheads.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi, ka tɔɣisim di yɛla yi yi be yiŋa ni yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo ni yi yi ti doya ni yi yi ti yiɣisi.
en: Teach them to your children. Repeat them when you are at home and when you are away, when you are resting and when you are working.

dag: Gumiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka chɛ niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka di ku lu yi zuɣu. Doliya Lɛvi maligumaaniba la ni wuhiri ya shɛlikam la viɛnyɛliŋga kaman n ni zali ba shɛm.
en: When you are suffering from a dreaded skin disease, be sure to do exactly what the levitical priests tell you; follow the instructions that I have given them.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ nandaamba yɛlimaŋli bɛ saria karibu ni.
en: Do not deny justice to a poor person when he appears in court.

dag: ka tahima niŋbu mi zuɣu ku chɛ ka ti suhuri miligi, dama Naawuni zaŋ o yurilim niŋ ti suhuri ni o Shia Kasi so o ni zaŋ ti ti la zuɣu.
en: This hope doesnt put us to shame, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a ka mi a zaligunim ka n sanna.
en: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.

dag: Di saha ka malaika bɔbili daa dii yi alizanda ni na nti pahi malaika yino maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Suddenly a great assembly of the heavenly forces was with the angel praising God. They said.

dag: Di biɛɣ pinaanahi dali yuŋ ti ni daa chani ka pɔhim kul ʒiɛri ti bahiri Adria teeku ni la, ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka kpatoonsi maa tɛhi ni ti mirila duli.
en: It was the fourteenth night, and we were being driven in the Mediterranean by the storm. About midnight the sailors suspected that we were getting close to land.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri mini bɛn dari nɛma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni yihira; ka daari laɣitaɣiriba teebuya mini ŋmaŋkɔhiriba kuɣisi luhira.
en: Jesus went into the temple and chased out everyone who was selling or buying. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and the benches of the ones who were selling doves.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla din bari ti suhuri zaana. Dina n-nyɛ din chɛ ka ti gariti chinchini la zuɣu kpɛri du kasi shɛl ni.
en: We have this hope as an anchor for our lives. It is safe and sure, and goes through the curtain of the heavenly temple into the inner sanctuary.

dag: Hal bɛ ku tooi kahigi yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni fiɣisi ma ŋɔ wuh a.
en: There is no way that they can prove these charges they are now bringing against me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti paai kɔbili shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Bɛr la. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi niriba maa na ka n ti ti ba kom.
en: From there they marched to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, Gather the people, and Ill give them water.

dag: dama yi pun baŋ ti Duuma nirilim nyaɣisim ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi n-chani ti nya Hiburunim maa niriba ayi ni zabira, ka o daa yɛli bɛ ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmɛr a mabia maa.
en: When Moses went out the next day, he saw two Hebrews fighting. So he went to the man who had started the fight and asked, Why are you beating up one of your own people.

dag: ni suhuyiɣisili, Yisa nyaandoliba ayi maa ni daa wuhiri niriba n-yɛri ni Yisa ni neei kum ni maa zuɣu kum ni neebu beni la zuɣu.
en: They were annoyed because the two apostles were teaching the people that Jesus had risen from death, which proved that the dead will rise to life.

dag: ka chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, dama ti gba chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali. Ka di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni. .
en: Forgive us our sins, for we forgive everyone who does us wrong. And do not bring us to hard testing.

dag: Ka Yisa nimmiriba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o yi Galili na daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched.

dag: Ka o yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiy o fali maa ti o ba mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: But if he has no brothers, his father's brothers will inherit the land.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee ŋɔ, n suhir a ni a sɔŋmi paɣiba maa, dama m mini ba zaŋ tabili Klɛmɛnt ni n tumtumditaba bɛn yuya sabi nyɛvili litaafi ni la n-daa laɣim tumdi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma.
en: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin maa daa ti gari, ka paɣ maa yi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-lab o ya nti chaŋ ni o ti yɛli naa ka o zaŋ o yili min o tiŋgbani labisi ti o.
en: Then she returned to Israel and immediately begged the king to give back her house and property.

dag: Biɛrim shɛli din mali ba ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ŋmanila bi jɛrigu ŋun bi bɔri ni o yi o ma pul ni na.
en: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Zɛbidii bih ayi la pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: When he took Peter and Zebedees two sons, he began to feel sad and anxious.

dag: ka minya ni ninsal ni tum tuun suŋ shɛlikam, o ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, o yi nyɛla dabili bee bilichina.
en: You know that the Lord will reward every person who does what is right, whether that person is a slave or a free person.

dag: N yi be a jɛmbu duu dahin yini, di so ni m be luɣ shɛli polo m-paai biɛɣ tuhili; m paɣiya ni n nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔgula n-gari m be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi.
en: One day in your Temple is better than a thousand days anywhere else. Serving as a guard at the gate of my Gods house is better than living in the homes of the wicked.

dag: Maata ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ o tizo Mariama sani nti sɔɣi yɛl o, Karimba kana, ka boon a.
en: After Martha said these things, she went back to her sister Mary. She talked to Mary alone and said, The Teacher is here. He is asking for you.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛn daa pun diri nam Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ka Izraɛlnim ti naanyi mali naa.
en: At that time there were kings in Edom. Edom had kings a long time before Israel did.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus answered, Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.

dag: A mini bɛn zɔri bɛ naba zuɣu yi zɔri ka di wum a, wula ka a mini yuri ni tooi kpaɣi zo? Ka a yi ku zani viɛnyɛliŋga palo ni, wula ka a lee yɛn tooi zani viɛnyɛliŋga Jɔɔdɛn nyɔŋ puuni?.
en: Jeremiah, if running in a race against men makes you tired, how will you race against horses? If you trip and fall in a safe place, what will you do in a dangerous place? What will you do in the thornbushes that grow along the Jordan River?.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa; chɛliya ka daadamnim zo dabiɛm! O ʒila o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu. Chɛliya ka tiŋgbani dam!.
en: The Lord is King, so let the nations shake with fear. He sits as King above the Cherub angels, so let the whole earth shake.

dag: A yi ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ suhuri zɔhirimi. A yi deei bɛ vuhim, bɛ kpirimi n-lab taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba wurindila tiŋa, amaa yɛnnim bɛn maarila niriba suhuri.
en: Proud people who laugh at what is right cause problems that divide whole cities, but people who are wise are able to calm those who are angry.

dag: A nɛma daa yi kul yi teeku ni na, niriba pam nyari li mi. A daa zaŋ a daazichi min a daguya sɔŋ dunia ŋɔ nanima ka bɛ nya azichi.
en: Your merchants sailed across the seas. You satisfied many people with your great wealth and the things you sold. You made the kings of the earth rich!.

dag: Niriba ni daa nya Pool ni niŋ shɛm maa ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee kuhi yɛli pam Laikɔnia yɛligu ni, Ti buɣa n-leei ninsalinim ka ti sanna ŋɔ.
en: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they started shouting in their own Lycaonian language, The gods have become like men and have come down to us.

dag: So kani n-nyɛ ŋun mi, so mi kani n-nyɛ ŋun bɔri Naawuni.
en: There is no one who understands. There is no one who looks for God. .

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bɔŋɔ? Wuhiri palli m-bala! Doo ŋɔ mali yiko mi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli.
en: The people were amazed. They asked each other, What is happening here? This man is teaching something new, and he teaches with authority! He even commands evil spirits, and they obey him.

dag: Ka Naomi daa ti wum ni Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋun Naawuni niriba ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ puri atam niŋ pam, ka o daa mali shili ni o min o bihi paɣiba la yiɣisi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kul o ya.
en: Then she arose along with her daughters-in-law to return from the field of Moab, because while in the territory of Moab she had heard that the LORD had paid attention to his people by providing food for them.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ ni zaŋ fukumsi niŋ ninvuɣ so nuu ni nyɛla ŋun ni ʒe o duuma yim.
en: Those who are trusted with such an important work must show that they are worthy of that trust.

dag: Ka zaŋ waagasi kpil pia ŋɔ mi ti ti bɛ yaɣili maa sapashin kpɛma, ka nya a biɛyanim maa daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ʒi shɛhirili bini bɛ sani mali kuna.
en: Also take these ten pieces of cheese for the officer who commands your brothers group of soldiers. See how your brothers are doing. Bring back something to show me your brothers are all right.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛli Musa, Mani n-nyɛ Mani. Ka lan yɛli yaha, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Mani n-tim ma yi sanna. .
en: God said to Moses, I Am Who I Am. So say to the Israelites, I Am has sent me to you.

dag: Yi nini yi nya tayiɣ kam, yi laɣir o la zɔri, ka lan chɛ ka yi mini zinaniŋdiba be.
en: You see a thief and run to join him. You jump into bed with those who commit adultery.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, n ni kana ti paɣ a a tuun kara zuɣu, ka yɛl a kɔŋko wuntital la yɛla.
en: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni maligumaaniba bɛn daa deeri zaka niriba san la daa nyɛla bɛn kpira, amaa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun gba daa deeri zaka la, ŋun daa nyɛla ŋun kul be nyɛvili ni kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Those priests get a tenth, but they are only men who live and then die. But Melchizedek, who got a tenth from Abraham, continues to live, as the Scriptures say.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Do kura mini paɣ kpamba bɛn dihiri jaaŋgbɛhi ni lan ʒiini Jɛrusalɛm puuni sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi.
en: Once again old men and women, so old that they use canes when they walk, will be sitting in the city squares.

dag: Dunia nanima mini zuliya kam zaa ni nabihi ni tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, kings of the earth and all nations, princes and all rulers on earth.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo maa na zuɣu ka bɛ kpi.
en: The men were responsible for spreading the trouble among the Israelites. So the Lord caused a sickness to kill all those men.

dag: Naŋgbankpeeni maa ni daa mali ti mooi nini saha shɛli ka sapashin kpɛm maa zɔri ni bɛ ti bu Pool n-chɛrisi o nimdi gari taŋkpaɣu ni zuɣu daa chɛ ka o yɛli tɔbbihi ni bɛ cham ti fa Pool bɛ sani n-zaŋ o tahi bɛn tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee.
en: The argument turned into a fight, and the commander was afraid that the Jews would tear Paul to pieces. So he told the soldiers to go down and take Paul away from these Jews and put him in the army building.

dag: Ka o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zaa daa kana ni bɛ ti maag o suhu, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ni kum m bia maa zuɣu hal ti paag o kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Lala ka o ba daa kum o zuɣu.
en: All of his sons and daughters got up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted, telling them, Ill go to my grave mourning for my son. And Josephs father wept for him.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ doola anzinfa m-mali di dasara pa di dunɔpaɣisi zuɣu, ka dooi salima n-zaŋ mali di nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ mali di kuɣa, ka Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba zaŋ yurilim mali di puuni.
en: Its posts are covered with silver; over it is cloth embroidered with gold. Its cushions are covered with purple cloth, lovingly woven by the women of Jerusalem.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba. Ti yab Ibrahimma ʒi ti, ka Yaakubu gba bi mi ti. Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti ba, ka a yuli nyɛ ti Tiligira kurimbuni ha.
en: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔhi ba pahi buta, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? M bi nya ka o tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi.
en: Pilate said to them the third time, But what crime has he committed? I cannot find anything he has done to deserve death! I will have him whipped and set him free.
