dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ka ti daadam nyɛvil la yɛliya.
en: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord ! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.

dag: Amaa ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni ti ma nasara shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka n lan kpalim be kpe, timiya ma soli ka n labi n dan sani.
en: But the servant said to them, Dont make me wait. The Lord has made my trip successful. Now let me go back to my master.

dag: Ka ŋun paya yɛli, N dala naɣikɔra pia, ka yɛn zaŋ ba chaŋ ti zahim bɛ tuma, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: Another guest said, I bought five teams of oxen, and I need to try them out. Please excuse me.

dag: Kaman n ni kul lihiri ba ka bɔri ni n darigi tɔhi ba, ka wurim ba bahi, ka daai ba luhi, ka ku ba, ka chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba la, lala ka n ni ti guli ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ beni, ka n ti ba yaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ŋɔ simdi paɣibu pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Glory to our God and Father forever and ever. Amen.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yi nimaani chaŋ Pɛnuɛl nti lan suhi bɛ gba bindirigu. Ka Pɛnuɛluɛlnim daa garigi yɛl o kaman Sukɔtinim ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Gideon went on to Penuel and made the same request of the people there, but the men of Penuel gave the same answer as the men of Sukkoth.

dag: Lihimi puu maa ni n-nyari bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam polo chɛra, ka kul doli ba. M pun yɛli n kachɛriba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba maa ni bɛ miri ka bɛ niŋ a shɛli. Ka kɔnyuri yi ti mal a, nyin cham ti tooi bɛ ni ŋɔŋ kom pali kɔduɣ shɛŋa zal la ni nyu.
en: and follow along behind them, as they gather up what the men have cut. I have warned the men not to bother you, and whenever you are thirsty, you can drink from their water jars.

dag: Di ku paai yuuni ka yinim bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ ni sɔhigi. Wain tihi ku wali, ka di daatam kpuɣibu ku beni.
en: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.

dag: Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla yɛliŋmahima din kpahiri ti zuɣu ni ni ti di yu tuumbiɛri tumbu kaman bɛ ni daa yu li shɛm.
en: And these things that happened are examples for us. These examples should stop us from wanting evil things like those people did.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni di n-su shɛb kalinli ku mali tariga, amaa bɛn doli nyaaŋa na nini ku tiɣ o. Yɛlimaŋli dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.

dag: bɛn chɛ yɛlimaŋli soli bahi, ka yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu la pun niŋ la. Lala ka bɛ niŋdi n-gbarigiri ninvuɣ shɛb yɛda.
en: They have left the true teaching. They say that the day when people will be raised from death has already come and gone. And they are destroying the faith of some people.

dag: Ninsalinim wurindi chɛribo kuɣa, ka lɛbiri zoya sɔŋda.
en: Miners dig the hardest rocks, Dig mountains away at their base.

dag: Dama a mini mɔɣu ni kuɣa ni ti lo tab alikauli. Ka a mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti be ni suhudoo.
en: It is as if you have a peace treaty with the wild animals and the rocks in the field.

dag: Nyama, m mini bi shɛb Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ nyɛla shihirili din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ sanna.
en: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Mɔabnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi tiligi.
en: This time, they defeated the Moabites, about ten thousand big and strong men, and no one escaped.

dag: O darigi deei m binyɛrigu, o ʒe n-dila m binyɛrigu nyiŋgoli mali.
en: God grabbed the collar of my coat and twisted my clothes out of shape.

dag: n-lan yi nimaani zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti du Bɛtaraba Zoli m-mali lala hal ti siɣi Araba.
en: It continued to the northern part of Beth Arabah. Then the border went down into the Jordan Valley.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛri gulibu ni na ni a ti leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: So then, say this to my servant David: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: I myself took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be leader over my people Israel.

dag: Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara o zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaɣ yini kam polo, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. Ka din kpalim nyɛ maligumaaniba dini kaman chi bee kawana sara yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for you for whichever one of the sins you committed, and you will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest like the grain offering.

dag: Nir ni tooi ba wɔhu n-kari kuɣa ni? Ka nir ni tooi zaŋ naɣikɔra n-ko teeku ni? Amaa yi zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei ʒiri, ka zaŋ din tuhi leei din bi tuhi.
en: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.

dag: N yi di yu alahichi n suhu ni, n Duuma naan ku deei n suhigu.
en: If I had cherished evil in my heart, my Lord would not have listened.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya salo maa, ka o du zoli zuɣu ti ʒini, ka o nyaandoliba laɣim gil o.
en: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Jesus' disciples gathered around him.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba Anabi Musa min anabinim zaa ha litaafinim ni daa yɛli ŋun Yisa yɛla shɛm.
en: Then he began to explain everything that had been written about himself in the Scriptures. He started with the books of Moses and then he talked about what the prophets had said about him.

dag: A nya bɛ ni bɔhi ma biɛri, ka lɔri ma nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa shɛm.
en: You have seen how my enemies have hurt me. You have seen all the evil plans that they made against me.

dag: ka zali di tariga, ka niŋ dunoya niŋ li n-kpari li zali.
en: I marked a boundary for the sea and kept it behind bolted gates.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha, Ŋunkam deeri ya deerila mani, ka ŋunkam deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na.
en: Those who receive you are also receiving me, and those who receive me are receiving the one who sent me.

dag: m-pahi paɣ shɛb o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ dɔriti naai min o ni daa kari alizin biɛri paɣ shɛb zuɣu bahi la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na ka nyɛ alizin biɛr ayopɔin ni daa ʒi so zuɣu la.
en: along with some women who had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses. Among them were Mary Magdalene.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti doli bɛ tuma, ka zana gbahi ya. Di ti bɔhiya bɛ wuna yɛla n-yɛra, Wula ka niriba ŋɔ daa lee jɛmdi bɛ wuna ŋɔ? Ti gba bɔri ni ti jɛm li.
en: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way.

dag: M paɣa nyee nyɔni ma, ka m mabihi gba nyee nyɔni ma.
en: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.

dag: N zaŋ ya tahi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bindira pam ni ni yi ti di di tiwala mini di bin viɛla. Amaa ka yi ni kpe di ni yi saɣimla n tiŋgbani maa, ka zaŋ m pini maa leei zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I brought them into a fertile land, to enjoy its harvests and its other good things. But instead they ruined my land; they defiled the country I had given them.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla ʒiŋmabo gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim mi zaŋ yɔhiŋ gili ma. Amaa Naawuni na mi Judanim yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe Ŋun be Kasi la yim.
en: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, the house of Israel with faithless acts; but Judah still walks with God, and is faithful to the holy one.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tia dari m-mali pund ayi n-zaŋ yo Luɣ Kasi shee din be puuni la ha dunoli, ka dapaɣili din pa dunoli maa zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira dasara daa mulisi ka mali yaɣ anu.
en: A double door made of olive wood was set in place at the entrance of the Most Holy Place; the top of the doorway was a pointed arch.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaanu la zaŋ pɔŋ tusaanu pahi di zuɣu na ti yɛl o yiŋlan maa, N dana, pɔŋ tusaanu ka a daa zaŋ ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaanu nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: The servant who had received five thousand coins came in and handed over the other five thousand. You gave me five thousand coins, sir, he said. Look! Here are another five thousand that I have earned.

dag: Nyin ŋun gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-daa yaag a noli yɛl li, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You made a promise to your servant, my father David, and you kept that promise. You made that promise with your own mouth, and with your own hands you made it come true today.

dag: O zaŋ o piɛm pa o tɔbu zuɣu n-darigi li kpa ma.
en: He drew back his bow, made me a shooting target for arrows.

dag: Ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Yisifu o zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm. O daa yɛl o mi, Zahindi maa ni n sa nyami ka wain tia ʒe n tooni.
en: So the wine steward said, In my dream there was a grapevine in front of me.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zaŋ o Shi so tin ya maa pala ŋun ni zaŋ ya leei daba n-lan kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm yaha, amaa Naawuni Shia maa lee chɛ ka yi leerila Naawuni bihi. Ka ti kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka gom gbaarila nira, ka ŋun je ni o ni bii ni gbe kum.
en: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab said to him, If you see that the Syrians are defeating me, come and help me, and if the Ammonites are defeating you, I will go and help you.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yisifu zuliya, o daa bi pii Ifriim zuliya.
en: God rejected the tent of Joseph and didnt choose the tribe of Ephraim.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛdaniŋdib shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Farisiinim la yiɣisi zani yɛli, Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka niŋ Yisa yɛda maa guni, ka lan niŋ kamaata ni ti yɛli ba ni bɛ doli Anabi Musa zaligu.
en: But some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, The Gentiles must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa be luɣ shɛli din miri Jɛriko maa, ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi nya do so ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe o tooni. Ka Jɔshua daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A lee bela ti polo bee a bela ti dimnim polo.
en: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, Are you on our side or on our enemies' side.

dag: Ka bɛ ni teeri nam zuɣupiligu maa yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya ni Jɔsia n-yɛn su di fukumsi.
en: The crown will be kept in my Temple, so that when people see it, they will remember Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the kindness of Zephaniahs son Josiah.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋma di nyɔŋ maa, hal nira ni ku tooi kpe di ni maa zaa yoli. Bɛ ni galisi gari toli maa zuɣu bɛ ka kalinli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and destroying a thick forest. Their soldiers are too many to count; they outnumber the locusts.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli wuntia soli, ka tɔɣisiri din tuhi, ka bi zaŋdi bɛ kpiɔŋ fari niriba, ka bi diri birapu, ka je ni bɛ wum ninvuɣ kubo yɛla, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nina ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu;.
en: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.

dag: So ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili m-me dikili gɔŋbu shee, ka so mi ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili me tanzaa. A yɛn kpalimla dabari doya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People will not take stones from Babylon to use as the foundation of a building. That is because they will not find any stones big enough for cornerstones. Your city will be a pile of broken rocks forever. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Daniɛl ka naa sanna ka naa maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ʒi dab shɛba yi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na yino, ka a yuli booni Daniɛl la?.
en: So they brought Daniel to the king and he asked, Is your name Daniel, one of the captives my father the king brought here from Judah?.

dag: Ka Naa Darius daa dih o nuu zaligu gbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Because of this, King Darius signed the document containing the law.

dag: Man Saimɔn Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni o tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛda mali buchi kaman ti gba yɛda ni mali buchi shɛm ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia wuntitali puuni la.
en: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa wurim kpe yɔɣu ʒiizaa, ka bɛ doli ba, ka bɛn daa kpi yɔɣu maa ni daa gari bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛba.
en: The battle spread throughout the country, but more men died in the forest than by the sword.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Mariama, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama a mali zuɣusuŋ pam Naawuni sani.
en: The angel said, Dont be afraid, Mary. God is honoring you.

dag: A nina be kasi ni di lihi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a ku tooi lihiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛda, ka shini ka ninvuɣ biɛri kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba gari ba?.
en: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba pam tooni ka n yɛn zaŋ laŋa n-labi pir a n-vo a n laŋ maa ni du na.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I have gathered many people together. Now I will throw my net over you. Then those people will pull you in.

dag: ni Mizipa ni Chɛfira ni Mɔza.
en: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah.

dag: N ni daa suh a dahin shɛli, a daa deei n suhigu, ka pahi ma kpiɔŋ.
en: You answered me when I called to you; with your strength you strengthened me.

dag: A niŋ amaŋ naani a tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka tɛhi ni so bi nya a. A yɛm min a baŋsim m-birig a, ka a yɛri a suhu ni, Mani, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: You felt secure in your evil; you said, No one sees me. Your wisdom and knowledge spun you around. You thought to yourself, I and no one else.

dag: Amaa a ni bi niŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm maa yɛda zuɣu, a ni leei birigu ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa faashee n yɛligu ŋɔ zaa ti niŋ pali; di mi ti kul yɛn niŋla pali saha shɛli Naawuni ni zal li maa.
en: Know this: What I have spoken will come true at the proper time. But because you didnt believe, you will remain silent, unable to speak until the day when these things happen.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni ti dee li su n-ʒini di ni ka yɛli, Ti ni bo naa ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam bɛn gil ti ŋɔ ni mali nanim shɛm.
en: Once you have entered the land the LORD your God is giving you and you have taken possession of it and settled down in it, you might say: Lets appoint a king over us, as all our neighboring nations have done.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa mii pam dindali maa, ka naa maa daa ʒiya dalim o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo. Ka o daŋ maa ʒim daa yi n-zo n-tiɛli chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa puuni zaa. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun mahili saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He bled so much that the bottom of the chariot was covered with blood, and by evening he was dead.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ a bihi tibili darigibu. A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, bɛ ku kpi.
en: Dont withhold instruction from children; if you strike them with a rod, they wont die.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi nyeei, so ku tooi lih o, ka pɔhim yi ʒe sagbana chaŋ ka chɛ o, o kul nyaɣisirimi.
en: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni.
en: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi yum maa, di yi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di ni kɔbiri niŋ zaɣ dɔzim ka balisibalisi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni; di nyɛla dɔr shɛli din loora, ka nyɛ zuɣu ni bee teeŋa ni dɔr biɛɣu.
en: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, This is leprosy—you are unclean.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ti bahi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti? Bɛ ni gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bihi chaŋ; ti yi di lab Ijipti, di di bi so.
en: Did the Lord bring us to this new land to be killed in war? The enemy will kill us and take our wives and children! It would be better for us to go back to Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Jɛhɔshafat, A ni saɣi pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka Jɛhɔshafat garigi yɛli Izraɛl naa, A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: So Ahab asked King Jehoshaphat, Will you join with us to go fight the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead? Jehoshaphat answered, Yes, you and I will be as one—my men and my horses will be as yours.

dag: Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam, ka bɛ yɛli, Nyama, nanima ayi bi tooi nyaŋ o, ka wula ka tinim ni tooi nyaŋ o.
en: But they were frozen with fear. They said, Not even two kings could resist him! How can we.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa yi ka luɣ shɛli nimaani nim baɣa ka shɛl ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: If a nation is not guided by God, the people will lose self-control, but the nation that obeys Gods law will be happy.

dag: Dindina a ni bi saɣi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛli zuɣu, a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi chɛ ka o niŋ a ni bɔri shɛli? Nyini n-ni pii, pa mani, dinzuɣu yɛlim a ni mi shɛli.
en: Will he repay you because you reject sin, for you must choose, not I; declare what you know.

dag: ka zaŋ anzinfa mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi. Ka dapaɣ yini ni ti mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka dapaɣili kam ti mali diba ayi, ka di dashɛbir ayi shɛb di ni.
en: And make silver bases for the frames. Each frame should have two silver bases to go under it—one base for each side pole.

dag: amaa yi ni shɛb bi niŋ li yɛda. Yisa daa pun mi piligu ni ha bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ni nyɛ so.
en: Yet some of you dont believe.Jesus knew from the beginning who wouldnt believe and the one who would betray him.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim Yawɛ ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: So Moses told the people of Israel everything that the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Tampiligim n kul nyɛ m bindirigu, ka n nintam kul tɔɣiri luri m binnyura ni.
en: Ive been eating ashes instead of bread. Ive been mixing tears into my drinks.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla n-yɛli so, dindina ti yi ti bi niŋ a ni chɛ ka ti po ni ti niŋ shɛli maa, ti ku mali taali zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: However, if you tell anyone what we have been doing, then we will not have to keep our promise which you have made us give you.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri yuri Yawɛ zaligu, ka bɔhindi li ka tɛhiri di yɛla wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: Instead, they find joy in obeying the Law of the Lord , and they study it day and night.

dag: O mɔŋ ma suhudoo; man tamla suhupiɛlli yɛla.
en: Ive rejected peace; Ive forgotten what is good.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N Duuma, di yɛn be lala yuui hal ni bɔ saha? Ka o yɛli ma, Di ni be lala hal ka tinsi ti lu n-dahim, ka so ku lan be di yiya ni, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim tiŋgban nɛli doya.
en: Then I asked the Lord , How long will this last? The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty.

dag: Zaŋmi li lo a nubihi ka sabi li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

dag: N dimnim kul sɔɣirimi yɛri ŋumaŋuma n-jɛndiri ma, ka lɔri ma nia biɛri dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: the speech of those who rise up against me, their incessant gossiping about me.

dag: Niriba biɛla bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya maa ni ti lab bɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sanna.
en: Those who are left in Jacobs family will again follow the Powerful God.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛtilihɛm din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama anab so daa sab yɛli:.
en: In the town of Bethlehem in Judea, they answered. For this is what the prophet wrote:.

dag: Piɛguliba maa ni daa nya biliɛɣu maa, ka bɛ yɛli malaika la ni daa yɛli ba bia maa yɛla shɛm zaa.
en: When they saw the baby, they told what the angels said about this child.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun tum zina ka bɛ gbaag o n-tahina ti zaŋ o zali sunsuuni.
en: The legal experts and Pharisees brought a woman caught in adultery. Placing her in the center of the group.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ a dabili min o daŋ polo la niŋ pali ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Now, Lord God, you promised to do something for me, your servant, and for my family. Now please do what you promised—make my family a family of kings forever!.

dag: Amaa bɛn ti yɛn be tiŋ maa kpaŋa ti yɛn nyɛla bahi mini baɣisi ni zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba ni buɣijɛmdiba ni bɛnkam yuri ʒiri, ka lan nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la.
en: But outside the city are the perverts and those who practice magic, the immoral and the murderers, those who worship idols and those who are liars both in words and deeds.

dag: Judas ni daa deei laɣ shɛli o daalahichi tumbu ni la, o daa zaŋ li dala palo, ka daa ti lu ka o zuɣu sani tiŋa, ka o puli tahi ka o nyɔri zaa yina.
en: With the money that Judas got for his evil act he bought a field, where he fell to his death; he burst open and all his insides spilled out.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul kpaai bɛ nina kpa zuɣusaa lihir o ni chani maa ha, ka bɛ nya ka niriba ayi ye binyɛr piɛla ʒe bɛ sani ka bɔhi ba.
en: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.

dag: Sokam zaa ni daa pun niŋdi tiliginsim nyabu tahima maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra, Amii Masia la m-bala bee so mi.
en: Everyone was hoping for the Messiah to come, and they wondered about John. They thought, Maybe he is the Messiah.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn nyɛ azichilaannim la, kummiya ka fabilimiya nandahima din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu.
en: And now, you rich people, listen to me! Weep and wail over the miseries that are coming upon you!.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba m-bala. Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: These were all the family groups from the tribe of Benjamin. The total number of men was .

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka zibisim titali daa zibi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni daba ata.
en: So Moses raised his hand into the air and a cloud of darkness covered Egypt. The darkness stayed in Egypt for three days.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a lan ti ma nyɛvili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun do gbala ni la kalinli ni.
en: Lord , you lifted me out of the grave. I was falling into the place of death, but you saved my life.

dag: Nyini n-nam nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo; Tabo Zoli mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli paɣir a yuli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni tahir o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: The people in front scolded him and told him to be quiet. But he shouted even more loudly, Son of David! Have mercy on me.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Galili Teeku maa yaɣili tiŋgban shɛli din yuli booni Gɛrasa.
en: Jesus and his followers sailed on across the lake. They sailed to the area where the Gerasene people live, across from Galilee.

dag: Ka n lan nya shɛli dunia ni, ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.

dag: Dindali maa ka n daa po pɔri ni n ni yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni pun bo n-zali ba ka di nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa.
en: On that day I promised to take you out of Egypt and lead you to the land I was giving to you. That was a good land filled with many good things. It was the most beautiful of all countries!.

dag: Farigudeeriba mini alahichinim zaa daa kul laɣindila Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti wum o wuhibu;.
en: All the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around Jesus to listen to him.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba na yoli niŋla tuuba, ka tum din tuhi n sani din nyɛ yi ni daa ti tab yolisim ka daa lo alikauli n sani n jɛmbu duu puuni la.
en: A short time ago you changed your hearts to do what is right. Everyone set free their fellow Hebrews who were slaves. And you even made an agreement before me in the Temple that is called by my name.

dag: Zinaniŋda gba kul guhirila wuntaŋ lubu ka yɛra, N je ni so nya ma. Ka zaŋ bini pili limsi o ninni.
en: The adulterers eye watches for twilight, thinking, No eye can see me, and puts a mask over his face.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla Naawuni niriba. Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni nir nyɛla ŋun wumdi tiri ti; ka ŋunkam mi pa Naawuni nir pala ŋun wumdi tiri ti. Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ Shi so ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli Shia, ka lan baŋ shi so ŋun nyɛ biriginsim shia.
en: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.

dag: A du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ gbiŋgbaŋ jaaŋgbe kabili din ni tooi kuhi nir ŋun zaŋ omaŋ dalim li nuu ŋɔ. Lala n-nyɛ Firawuna zaŋ chaŋ ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ dalim o polo.
en: You are expecting Egypt to help you, but that would be like using a reed as a walking stick—it would break and would jab your hand. That is what the king of Egypt is like when anyone relies on him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lɔri nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo Jɛrusalɛm, o daa zo n-kulila Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chɛ ka shɛb kar o naba Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: The people made a plan against Amaziah in Jerusalem, so he ran away to Lachish. But the people sent men after Amaziah to Lachish, and they killed him there.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya nasara saria karibu ni, ka alahichinim mi ku be wuntizɔriba ni.
en: Sinners will be condemned by God and kept apart from God's own people.

dag: Yinim malaikanima, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali yaa ka tumd o ni yɛli shɛm, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord !.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla yaɣimɛriba m-be Nɛtaim mini Gɛdɛra, Bɛ daa bela naa sani nimaani n-tumd o tuma.
en: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hashub bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Azirikam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Hashabia mini Bunni.
en: These are the Levites who moved into Jerusalem: Shemaiah son of Hasshub .

dag: Dama nyini n-ti o yiko ni o su daadam kam fukumsi, ka niŋ o yiko ni o ti ninvuɣ shɛb zaa a ni zaŋ ti o nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: You gave him authority over everyone so that he could give eternal life to everyone you gave him.

dag: Izar bidibisi ni, Shɛlomit n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣila dab paɣ bia maa kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bia kam shɛm, ka daa dɔɣi bilichin paɣ bia maa mi alikauli lɔbu puuni.
en: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab nya a ni niŋ ti shɛm maa, ka maani ti ansarisi, ka bɛn gili ti lari ti.
en: Youve made us a joke to all our neighbors; were mocked and ridiculed by everyone around us.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa lee bi baŋ o, ka daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm. Lala ka Daadam bia gba yɛn di wahala bɛ nuu ni.
en: But I tell you that Elijah has already come and people did not recognize him, but treated him just as they pleased. In the same way they will also mistreat the Son of Man.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim shɛb bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda dim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tiba ni, ka bɛ taai duŋ n-yiɣisi bɛ suhuri bahi Yisa nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: But the Jews who would not believe stirred up the Gentiles and turned them against the believers.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa vihi do shɛb bɛn kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa yɛla maa zaa naai.
en: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Hezekiah did what the Lord wanted him to do. He did what was right just as David his ancestor had done.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ dina yi ti bi yɛn niŋ yomyom yi n-chaŋ bee n-yi n-guui. Yawɛ nti yɛn be yi tooni mali ya chana. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni nyɛ ŋun yɛn be yi nyaaŋa polo n-nyɛ yi gula.
en: You will leave Babylon, but they will not force you to leave in a hurry. You will not be forced to run away. The Lord will be in front of you. The God of Israel will be behind you.

dag: Ka yi daa lan zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-kɔhi Giriikinim zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒi ba chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: You have taken the people of Judah and Jerusalem far from their own country and sold them to the Greeks.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb leei daba n-ʒi n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la ni yino. Di saha maa, Jɛhoyachin n-daa nyɛ Juda naa.
en: Kish was one of the people that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem, when he took King Jeconiah of Judah to Babylonia.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinim ni deela Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: John baptized people with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Izar bidibisi ni, Shɛlomit n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Izhars family: Shelomoth the first.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Siizaria ka bɛ zaŋ Pool ti zali Gomna maa tooni, ka zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti o.
en: The soldiers on horses entered Caesarea, gave the letter to Governor Felix, and then turned Paul over to him.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim maa zaa zaŋ Shihɔr din daa be Ijipti la hal ti kpa garibu shee din be Lɛbohamat la ni bɛ chaŋ Kiriatijiarim ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: So David gathered all the Israelites from the Shihor River in Egypt to the town of Lebo Hamath. They came together to bring the Box of the Agreement back from the town of Kiriath Jearim.

dag: Bɛ kpari Nɛgɛbinim niŋ bɛ fɔntinsi ni, ka so kani ŋun ni kparigi ba. Bɛ gbahi Judanim zaa chaŋ.
en: The towns of the arid southern plain will be surrounded; no one will get in or out; all Judah will be taken into exile; everyone will be led away.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa, Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la zaa.
en: Speak to the rebels, to the house of Israel, The LORD God proclaims: Enough of your detestable practices, house of Israel!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di n-tiɣi zaa, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ laɣisim bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi din guui maa zaa ka di shɛli ku bahi yoli.
en: When they had plenty to eat, he said to his disciples, Gather up the leftover pieces, so that nothing will be wasted.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai. He said.

dag: Amaa pihimiyala kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba kaman bɛ daŋ dɔɣirikpamba yuya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The land, however, will be apportioned by lot. They will inherit according to the names of their ancestral tribes.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri n-nya chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi, yuri mi tuhi pinaayi. Ka o daa zaŋ shɛb ti niŋ chɛchɛbunsi tinsi ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be o sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Solomon acquired more and more chariots and horses until he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he stationed in chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

dag: Karimi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Akar ŋun daa bo yɛla bahi Izraɛlnim la. O daa kpuɣila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli ti Naawuni.
en: Achan son of Carmi, one of Zerah's descendants, brought disaster on the people of Israel by keeping loot that had been devoted to God.

dag: N Naa ni n Naawuni, wummi n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim shɛm ŋɔ, dama nyini ka n suhira.
en: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ Naawuni n-kul sɔŋdi ma, dinzuɣu ka n ʒe kpe n-diri di shɛhira wɔɣira mini tarimba sani n-kul yɛrila Anabi Musa min anabinim ni daa yɛli ni shɛli ni ti niŋ pali la yɛla kɔŋko.
en: But to this very day I have been helped by God, and so I stand here giving my witness to all, to small and great alike. What I say is the very same thing which the prophets and Moses said was going to happen:.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Wummiya fabila yil shɛli n ni yiini niŋdi ya ŋɔ:.
en: Listen, people of Israel, to this funeral song which I sing over you:.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli Chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ nya zuɣusuŋ a sani. Di saha ka Hanna daa kuli ti di ka nyu, ka daa bi lan mali suhugarigu.
en: Hannah said, May you be happy with me. Then she left and ate something. She was not sad anymore.

dag: Ka Pool daa laɣisi dagansi na ti pa buɣim maa ni, ka gariŋga yi dari maa ni na buɣim maa tulim zuɣu n-kaai vil o nuu.
en: Paul gathered a pile of sticks for the fire. He was putting the sticks on the fire, and a poisonous snake came out because of the heat and bit him on the hand.

dag: Kiriatijiarim zuliya n-daa nyɛ Itirinim mini Putinim ni Shumatinim ni Mishiranima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zuliya ni ka Zɔranim mini Ɛshitaolnim yina.
en: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.

dag: yi ni zaŋdi nyɛvili yɛligu tiri ba la puuni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n-ti mali daliri din ni nyu bara Masia labbuna dabisili la dali, ka di wuhi ni n kpaŋmaŋtali mini n tuma bi kpalim yoli.
en: as you offer them the message of life. If you do so, I shall have reason to be proud of you on the Day of Christ, because it will show that all my effort and work have not been wasted.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mali sariakaribo nyolɔrigu viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni yɛn she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm, di simdi ka a ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: Make a breastpiece for the High Priest to use in determining God's will. It is to be made of the same materials as the ephod and with similar embroidery.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Amaria bia, ka Amaria nyɛ Azaria so bia, ka Azaria so maa nyɛ Mɛrayɔt bia.
en: Ahitub was the son of Amariah. Amariah was the son of Azariah. Azariah was the son of Meraioth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Labimi Balak sani nti zaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm yɛl o.
en: The Lord met Balaam, told him what to say, and sent him back to Balak to give him his message.

dag: Ka Mɛɔnɔtai daa nyɛ Ofira ba. Sɛraya daa nyɛla Jɔab ba, ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ Gɛharashimnim yabidoo. Din daa chɛ ka bɛ boli ba lala maa nyɛla, bɛ daa nyɛla nuhi tuumbaŋdiba.
en: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab the father of Ge-harashim, so-called because they were skilled workers.

dag: Suhim ma ka n zaŋ zuliya kam zaa ti a ka a su ba; ka dunia ŋɔ zaa leeg a ni su shɛli.
en: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka ti lan tiri ti tab zalige, yi mi di chɛliya ka ti tum din ni gu ti kpee soli bee n-chɛ ka o tuui lu.
en: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa moori buɣim mini lahi. Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa mali binshɛŋa zaa kuli.
en: The commander of the guard took the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls, which were made of pure gold and pure silver.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan kana ti yɛli, Naawuni buɣim n-yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku piɛri la mini piɛguliba la zaa, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: Before he had finished speaking, another servant came and said, Lightning struck the sheep and the shepherds and killed them all. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: Zaŋmiya nim viɛla zaa niŋ di ni, dina n-nyɛ: gbalipuɣa mini gaba, ka zaŋya boligo kɔba gba niŋ di ni.
en: Put in the pieces of meat. Put in every good piece, the thighs and the shoulders. Fill the pot with the best bones.

dag: amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa, din pala man tibu, amaa Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: but to sit at my right or left hand isnt mine to give. It belongs to those for whom it has been prepared.

dag: A yi ti yi palo, a ni bahi ba yoli kaman buɣim n-di ba la. Yawɛ ni bahi ba yoli zaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni, ka buɣim di ba.
en: He will destroy them like a blazing fire when he appears. The Lord will devour them in his anger, and fire will consume them.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ha ka ŋmani maa daa ŋmaai olivi tia vamahili n-gbab o noli lab o sanna ŋariŋ maa ni; ka Nuhu daa baŋ ni kom maa yipa nyuuya tiŋgban ni.
en: And that afternoon the dove came back to Noah. The dove had a fresh olive leaf in its mouth. This was a sign to show Noah that there was dry ground on the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa pie taba kulis anahi. Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni;.
en: They set in it four rows of gemstones. The first row was a row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald stones.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun diri ni ka bɛ ni diri shɛli yina; Ŋum mali kpiɔŋ ni ka din nyaɣisi yina. Ka di daa mali ti paai daba ata, ka bɛ na bi tooi baŋ ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: Samson told them this riddle: Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet. The men tried for three days to find the answer, but they couldnt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Nakɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣila shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, di saha ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali.
en: When Davids men came to the threshing floor of Nacon, the oxen stumbled, and Gods Holy Box began to fall off the wagon. Uzzah caught the Holy Box.

dag: Ka yi ʒiɛmannim ti baŋ ni n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, n daa chɛ ka bɛ bela suɣa ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Why? So all your descendants will know that I made the Israelites live in temporary shelters during the time I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

dag: N ni bo bɛn bɔrigi la shee, ka taɣi bɛn yirigi la labisina, ka zaŋ tana lo bɛn nya dansi la, ka kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi la. Amaa bɛn bara, ka mali yaa la, n ni ku ba. N ni zaŋ din tuhi dihi ba.
en: to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ niriba zuɣulaannim ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na nti nya ka baŋ alahichi shɛli din tum zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So Saul said, Bring all the leaders to me! Lets find who committed the sin today.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisahaku daa suhi alibarika din ti yɛn kana saha shɛli n-niŋ Yaakubu mini Iso ni.
en: It was faith that made Isaac promise blessings for the future to Jacob and Esau.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ni ti mali suhudoo. N ni ti ti o suhudoo o dimnim bɛn zaa gil o sani; dama o yuli nti yɛn booni Sulemaana. Ka n ni ti ti Izraɛlnim suhudoo, ka binshɛli ku lan dam ba o ʒiɛman ni.
en: But you have a son who is a man of peace. I will give your son a time of peace. His enemies around him will not bother him. His name is Solomon. And I will give Israel peace and quiet during the time that he is king.

dag: Yi vidibo ni yi filiŋ ni ti zani tariga. Yi ni ti be yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka yi daazichi ti nabi; ka yi ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: Instead of shame, their portion will be double; instead of disgrace, they will rejoice over their share. They will possess a double portion in their land; everlasting joy will be theirs.

dag: Yi bindir daŋda dina, yi ni tooi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ, amaa di bi simdi ka yi nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ni di leei din nyom viɛla.
en: You may bring yeast and honey to the Lord as an offering from the first harvest, but they must not be put on the altar to be burned as a sweet smell.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni paɣiba daa boli bia maa yuli Obɛd ka yɛli, Bɛ dɔɣi bidibiga ti Naomi! Ka Obɛd daa ti dɔɣi Jɛsi, ka Jɛsi mi dɔɣi Naa Dauda.
en: The women of the neighborhood named the boy Obed. They told everyone, A son has been born to Naomi! Obed became the father of Jesse, who was the father of David.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Arimatia tiŋbia ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ashilɔni Yɛhudianim zɔbu zuɣu la daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi. Ka o daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: After this, Joseph, who was from the town of Arimathea, asked Pilate if he could take Jesus' body. Pilate told him he could have the body, so Joseph went and took it away.

dag: Wuntizɔriba wuntitali n-tiligiri ba, amaa bilikɔɣinim nia biɛri nyɛla din gbahiri ba.
en: Righteousness rescues those who are honest, but those who can't be trusted are trapped by their own greed.

dag: Di kpari biɛla ka dunianim ku lan nya ma yaha; amaa yinim ni nyari ma. N ni mali nyɛvili be zuɣu, yi gba ni mali nyɛvili m-be.
en: Soon the world will no longer see me, but you will see me. Because I live, you will live too.

dag: Naawuni wuhiya ni o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee din nyɛ tiŋ puuni birininim la ni.
en: In the palaces of that city, God is known as the fortress.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ teebul la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nuzaa polo pateesa la nyaaŋa.
en: Then Moses put the table in the Meeting Tent on the north side of the Holy Tent. He put it in the Holy Place, in front of the curtain.

dag: N ni daa labi maa, ka n daa nya tihi pam mɔɣili maa duli yaɣa ayi.
en: where I saw dozens of trees on each side.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ gili Ifriim zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya tiŋgban ni tinsi zaa n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni, amaa ka niriba maa daa lari ba, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: The messengers went to every town in the area of Ephraim and Manasseh. They went all the way to the area of Zebulun, but the people laughed at the messengers and made fun of them.

dag: Ka Manɔa bɔh o, A yɛligu maa yi ti niŋ pali, bia maa biɛhigu ti yɛn nyɛla wula, ka tuun bɔ ka o lee ti yɛn tum.
en: So Manoah said, May what you say happen. Tell me, what kind of life will the boy live? What will he do.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl.
en: Then he set up an altar there and named it El Elohe Israel.

dag: ni dundɔŋ din gil la pilanim mini di binzahi ni kpahi ni mihi ni di nɛma zaa ni di neen kparisi zaa; ka a boli sokam zaa yuli n-wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn ʒi neen shɛŋa.
en: and the posts, bases, pegs, and ropes of the court around the Tent, with all the fittings used in setting them up. Each man will be responsible for carrying specific items.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, dindina yi mi ni ti ma silinchi kpar suma pihita mini binyɛr sun shɛŋa din nyɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra Ka bɛ yɛl o, yɛlim ti a ŋahili maa ka ti wum.
en: But if you can't tell me the answer, then each of you will have to give me a shirt and a full change of clothing. It's a bet! the Philistines said. Tell us the riddle.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa dɔɣi Nuhu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Lamech had more children.

dag: Chɛ ka m min a laɣi tab zɔri kaman a ba mini m ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, Anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ, n zaŋ li mi ti a pini. Larigim a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔsimdi alikauli la din ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Asa sent this message: My father and your father had a peace agreement. Now I want to make a peace agreement with you. I am sending you this gift of gold and silver. Please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and make him leave us alone.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni fa n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni bahi, dama o ni deei ma.
en: But God will pay the price to save me from the grave. He will take me to be with him. Selah.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam ni o ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The rest of Manassehs deeds, all that he accomplished, and the sin he committed, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya. Timiya ba bɛ tarili bɛ ba mabihi maa sani, ka bɛ ba tarili leei bɛ dini.
en: Zelophehads daughters are right in what they are saying. By all means, give them property as an inheritance among their fathers brothers. Hand over their fathers inheritance to them.

dag: Ka Jair daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Kamɔn.
en: Jair died and was buried at Kamon.

dag: A gbilisi tibili wum Naawuni yɛm yɛtɔɣa? Ka a tɛhiya ni a kɔŋko m-mali yɛm?.
en: Did you listen to Gods secret plans? Do you think you are the only wise person?.

dag: Yi ŋmari ʒiri n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba suhuri gbarigira, hal n ni bi gbarigir bɛ suhuri maa zaa yoli; ka kpaŋsiri ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba ni ka bɛ bi niŋdi tuuba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: You hurt the righteous with slander—I didnt wound them!—and you strengthened the hands of the wicked so that they survived without changing their evil ways!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna daa duh o bɔɣiri zuɣusaa kpa niriba maa polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka daa yi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni suhudoo sara malibu shee maa siɣina.
en: Aaron then raised his hands toward the people and blessed them. After performing the purification offering, the entirely burned offering, and the well-being sacrifice, he came down.

dag: Yi noli yi kuli yaa yɛli shɛli, yin palimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni kul yaai yi noli po pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani shɛm maa.
en: But whatever you say, you should be sure to make good on, exactly according to the promise you freely made to the LORD your God because you promised it with your own mouth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ŋma li n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa, ka o daa zaŋ li nti ti o ma.
en: It was taken on a serving plate to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti nya. Ka bɛ daa dol o nti nya o ni kpɛri shɛli, ka kpalim o sani dindali maa, dama di daa nyɛla zaawuni kurig anahi saha.
en: He replied, Come and see. So they went and saw where he was staying, and they remained with him that day. It was about four oclock in the afternoon.

dag: Jabɛz daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali jilima gar o mabihi zaa, o ma n-daa bol o yuli Jabɛz, ka yɛli ni dama o daa nya biɛrim pam o dɔɣibu ni.
en: Jabez was more honored than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, I bore him in pain.

dag: Ɛhud kum nyaaŋa, Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha.
en: After Ehud died, the people of Israel sinned against the Lord again.

dag: Di simdi ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛlaa maa zuɣu nyɛla lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛbihi la zuɣu dina, o kul bom o ni bɔri ni o ti shɛm tariga, ka bo kpam lita ata tahili kam zuɣu.
en: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zaŋ Yisa tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Then the whole group stood up and led Jesus away to Pilate.

dag: Yi Duuma ni chɛ ka yi nya wahala ni nahiŋgu, amaa ŋuna ŋun maŋmaŋ nyɛ yi karimba maa ku lan sɔɣi ka chɛn ya, amaa o ni chɛ ka yi nini nya o, ka o wuhi ya.
en: Though the Lord gives you the bread of distress and the water of oppression, your teacher will no longer hide, but you will see your teacher.

dag: Bɛ kul bemi kaman shihi la n-gili n luɣilikam, ka ŋmaligi kpi yomyom kaman buɣim n-di gɔhi la, ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They surrounded me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns. I cut them down in the LORDs name!.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Kaman n ni daa kul chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ titaŋa paai niriba ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka n lan yɛn chɛ ka n ni lo ba zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa alikauli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ paai ba.
en: The LORD proclaims: Just as I brought this great disaster on this people, so I will bring on them all the good I promised them.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni chɛ ka a dɔɣi bihi, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam. Ka n ti chɛ ka zuliya gbaliŋ yi a zuliya maa ni na, ka n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam. .
en: He said to me, I will give you many children, so that your descendants will become many nations; I will give this land to your descendants as their possession forever.

dag: N ni daa lɔnya alikauli shɛli ni ʒim yihibu sara maligu shɛhira la zuɣu, n ni ti yi niriba bɛn be dabitim ni la yolisim. N ni yihi ba dabitim kɔbil kuŋ la ni.
en: Moreover, by the blood of your covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ti laɣim taba, ka bɛ ni ti malila zuɣulaan yino, ka bɛ biɛhigu ti chaŋ tooni tiŋgbani maa ni, dama Jɛziriil dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali.
en: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will be reunited. They will choose for themselves a single leader, and once again they will grow and prosper in their land. Yes, the day of Jezreel will be a great day!.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi Juda Naa Amazia shɛm la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpe o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: His wife Jezebel went to him and asked, Why are you so depressed? Why won't you eat.

dag: Yi jɛmdila yi ni ʒi so, amaa tinim jɛmdila ti ni mi so, dama Yɛhudianim zuliya ni ka tiliginsim yina;.
en: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.

dag: Ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, Kamina pumpɔŋɔ, ka n zaŋ a chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo, di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu nimaani ti ma.
en: Balak said to Balaam, Come on, let's try another place. Maybe God will let you curse Israel from there.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ birigi n sani. Bahiyoli n-doli ba, dama bɛ zaɣisi ma. N naan tiligi ba, amaa ka bɛ beni ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: It will be very bad for those who left me. They refused to obey me, so they will be destroyed. I saved them, but they speak lies against me.

dag: Hal nandaamba ʒiʒiinitab je ba, amaa bundaannim bɛn mali zɔnim pam.
en: Even their neighbors hate the poor, but many love the wealthy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ni bɛ ti boli Naa Hɛzɛkia na. Ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun mi daa su bɛ ni sab gban shɛŋa sɔŋ tuma la daa yi bɛ sanna.
en: Then they called for the king. Hilkiahs son Eliakim, who was the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Asaphs son Joah the recorder went out to them.

dag: Yi yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, yin chɛliya ka yi mabi yino kpalim be sarika ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi bɛn kpalim ʒi bindira kuli ti ti kum ni mali yi yiŋnim shɛb maa.
en: If you are honest men, one of you must stay here in jail, and the rest of you can take the grain back to your starving families.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa wurim kpe yɔɣu ʒiizaa, ka bɛ doli ba, ka bɛn daa kpi yɔɣu maa ni daa gari bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛba.
en: The battle spread out over the entire countryside, and the forest devoured more soldiers than the sword that day.

dag: N daa mooi n nini n-yɛri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ niŋm tuuba Naawuni sani ka niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda.
en: I told everyone—Jewish and non-Jewish people—to change and turn to God. I told them all to believe in our Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka n daa zahim anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa naa min o saawaranim ni o kpambaliba ni Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be nimaani ni daa ti ni bɛ zaŋ tum ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma la ti ba.
en: I weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the equipment, the offering for the house of our God that the king, his counselors, his officials, and all Israel present there had offered.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa tir o ba min o yiŋnim zaa ni o biɛyanim maa bindira n-saɣisiri bɛ ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli tariga.
en: Joseph provided food for his father, his brothers, and his fathers entire household, in proportion to the number of children.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na dahin shɛl la, n daa bi yɛli ba shɛli bee n-zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara maligunim polo.
en: I gave your ancestors no commands about burnt offerings or any other kinds of sacrifices when I brought them out of Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa nya ŋarima ayi ka di ʒe duli; kulipalinima n-daa chɛ li zali ka chaŋ ti paɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: Jesus saw two boats sitting by the lake. The fishermen had gone ashore and were washing their nets.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi naai ka Jeemsi mi yɛli, M mabihi, wummiya n gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: When they had finished speaking, James spoke up: Listen to me, my friends!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binzahi maa diba anu n-zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ diba anu zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nuzaa polo; ka zaŋ kɔniŋdi bin la mi zali nudirigu polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo.
en: He placed five stands on the south of the temple and five on the north of the temple. He placed the Sea at the southeast corner of the temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa maa naai ka ŋmaligi, ka Ibrahimma gba daa ŋmaligi kuli.
en: After speaking with Abraham, the Lord left, and Abraham went back home.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ zuɣuri chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi pɔbi bɛ noya.
en: while the older ones stood.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-kpuɣi kuɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kuɣ o zuɣu la sa nimaani, ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu.
en: Jacob got up early next morning, took the stone that was under his head, and set it up as a memorial. Then he poured olive oil on it to dedicate it to God.

dag: ka yihiri wain na ka di tiri ninsalinim suhupiɛlli, ka yihiri olivi tihi kpam na ka di chɛ ka ninsalinim ninni nyɛlisira, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyari bindirigu diri ka di tiri ba kpiɔŋ.
en: and produce wine to make us happy, olive oil to make us cheerful, and bread to give us strength.

dag: So di ti zaŋ o nuu shih o, amaa bɛ ti labim o kuɣa ku o bee n-to o piɛma ku o. Biŋkɔbigu bee ninsala yi ti shihi li, bɛn kum o. Ka kikaa yi ti kum pam, di saha bɛn dum zoli maa zuɣu na.
en: No one should touch anyone who has touched it, or they must be either stoned to death or shot with arrows. Whether an animal or a human being, they must not be allowed to live. Only when the rams horn sounds may they go up on the mountain.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba, ka Sool nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was Kishs father. Kish was Sauls father. And Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malki Shua, Abinadab, and Esh Baal.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, ti ni so bi be o polo. Amaa anabi Ilaisha ŋun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-yɛri Izraɛl naa a ni be a duu tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam.
en: None of us, Your Majesty, one of them answered. It's an Israelite named Elisha. He's a prophet, so he can tell his king everything—even what you say in your own room.

dag: Yi bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli. Yi soya nyɛla sɔgolima, ka ŋunkam zaa dol li ka suhudoo, dama yi ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti maa hal ka o mini ti yaannim maa zaa daa ti kpi nimaani.
en: Then Jacob went to Egypt, where he and his sons died.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn lo nia biɛri bɛ suhuri ni, ka kul bɔrila zabili.
en: from those who plan to do evil and always cause trouble.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni tinsi n-nyɛ: Hɛlikat mini Hali ni Bɛtin ni Akishaf.
en: Their border included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph.

dag: Man yɛm, m mini baŋsim m-be, ka baŋsim mini fahim be n sani.
en: I am Wisdom. I live with Good Judgment. I am at home with Knowledge and Planning.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini Sapashin kpamba, Chamiya ti kali Izraɛlnim zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ti kpa Dan, ka labina ti yɛli ma di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka m baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: David gave orders to Joab and the other officers, Go through Israel, from one end of the country to the other, and count the people. I want to know how many there are.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yi ni ti nya ti yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni anabinim zaa ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ni, amaa ka Naawuni ti kari yinim di ni bahi. Yinim ni ti fabili ka dim yi nyina.
en: There will be weeping and grinding of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in Gods kingdom, but you yourselves will be thrown out.

dag: ni Ahilud bia Baana ŋun daa su Taanak mini Mɛgido ni bɔb shɛli zaa din zaŋ ti miri Bɛtishɛan din baɣi Zarɛtan ka be Jɛziriil tooni n-yi Bɛtishɛan n-zaŋ ti paai Ɛbɛlimɛhola n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jokimiam yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana son of Ahilud was governor of Taanach and Megiddo and all of Beth Shean next to Zarethan. This was below Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah across from Jokmeam.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni tiŋgbani;.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: In just a little while, I will make the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land quake.

dag: Mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam; dama a ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ chaŋ ti di tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima alikauli ni n ni zaŋ li ti ba la fali.
en: Be determined and confident, for you will be the leader of these people as they occupy this land which I promised their ancestors.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ka salo pam kul kabiri dol o;.
en: Now when Jesus had come down from the mountain, large crowds followed him.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli ti ni daa kul chɛ alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa malibu, ka bi lan boori kom bahir o, ti daa lan ka binshɛli, ka tɔbu mini kum kuri ti.
en: But since the time we stopped burning incense and offering wine sacrifices to her, we have been dying from war and hunger.

dag: bee alɔbo din be zibisim ni bee mbusim din paarina wuntaŋ ni agbaa saha la.
en: You will have no fear of diseases that come in the dark or terrible suffering that comes at noon.

dag: Gomna shɛb bɛn daŋ n tooni daa yi muɣisirila niriba maa, ka fari bɛ bindira mini wain m-pahi anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinahinahi zuɣu. Hal ka bɛ tumtumdiba daa chɛ ka niriba maa jɛmdi ba. Amaa man daa bi niŋ lala, dama n zɔri Naawuni.
en: Every governor who had been in office before me had been a burden to the people and had demanded forty silver coins a day for food and wine. Even their servants had oppressed the people. But I acted differently, because I honored God.

dag: ka yɛl o tumo, Cham ti lihi teeku polo. Ka o daa chaŋ ti lihi ka yɛli, M bi nya shɛli. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labimi yaha n-niŋ lala hal ti paai siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: Then Elijah said to his servant, Go up higher and look toward the sea. The servant went and looked. He came back and said, I saw nothing. Elijah told him to go look again. This happened seven times.

dag: Ti Duuma ni ti Ziɔn paɣiba zuɣutalisi ni dansi ka di niŋ yukaɣima. Yawɛ ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ zaɣim.
en: But I, the Lord , will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bi nɛɔŋ maa ti paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni ŋɔ ka di ku o, ŋuna n-nyɛ bia maa ma.
en: Solomon said, Don't kill the baby. Then he pointed to the first woman, She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni nyɛ naa n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dindali maa, Yawɛ yino nti yɛn be, ka o yuli gba nyɛ yu yini.
en: And the Lord will be the King of the whole world. At that time all people will worship him as the only Lord with only one name.

dag: hal n ni bi tum taali, ka kul suhiri Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga maa zaa yoli.
en: I was never cruel to anyone, and my prayers are pure.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. Ka fukumsi zaligu shɛl lan kani kpɛm gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: The second is this, You will love your neighbor as yourself . No other commandment is greater than these.

dag: Yinim yɛnnim ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ. Yinim baŋdiba ŋɔ, gbilisimiya tibili.
en: Listen to what I say, you wise men. Pay attention, you who know so much.

dag: N daa nya n suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam. N daa bi zaɣisi n suhu ni kul bɔri nyaɣisim shɛlikam. N daa nyu bara n ni tum nya shɛli zuɣu. N tuma laara zaa ni daa nyɛ shɛli m-bala.
en: Anything my eyes saw and wanted, I got for myself. My mind was pleased with everything I did. And this happiness was the reward for all my hard work.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa kul be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam. O daa nyɛla gbarigu.
en: Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the kings table. He was crippled in both feet.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ma ni Zɛbidii bihi ma la gba daa be bɛ ni.
en: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of James and John were some of these women.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla talahi ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim maa mali tarili, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛl zuliya daŋ yini niriba ku kpihim.
en: Israel must not lose one of its twelve tribes. We must find a way for the tribe of Benjamin to survive.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti nyɛla yɛnnim bee jɛra, so n-ku tooi baŋ. Amaa bɛna nti yɛn su n ni zaŋ n yɛm niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: And who knows whether that one will be wise or foolish? Either way, that person will have control over the results of all my hard work and wisdom here under the sun. That too is pointless.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka m pun piligi kuri ya ni m bahi ya yoli yi daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: So I have begun to punish you. I will destroy you because of your sins.

dag: Pashihur ni Amaria ni Malikija ni.
en: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zal omaŋmaŋ maligumaaniba buɣa jɛmbu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o ni daa mali bu so mini naɣisa so zali, ka di nyɛ o buɣili la.
en: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve in the high places, where he set up the goat and calf idols he had made.

dag: N kɔre yi daa kpe paɣa ni, ka n do n kpee yiŋ dunol ni gul o.
en: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirim ma na.
en: Jesus said to the man, Come up here to the front.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma daa pii ninvuɣ pisopɔin n-tim ba niriba ayiyi ni bɛ daŋ o tooni chaŋ tin shɛŋa zaa omaŋmaŋ gba ni daa yɛn chaŋ.
en: After these things, the Lord commissioned seventy-two others and sent them on ahead in pairs to every city and place he was about to go.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi deebu zaa.
en: This saying is reliable and deserves complete acceptance.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee yili ni. Miriya ka yi mi chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee paɣa ni bee o tumtumdi dɔbba bee o tumtumdi paɣiba ni bee o naɣilalantabili ni bee o buŋ ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpe yi kpee binshɛli ni.
en: You must not want to take your neighbors house. You must not want his wife. And you must not want his men and women servants or his cattle or his donkeys. You must not want to take anything that belongs to another person.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina ti yɛli Yaakubu, Ti chaŋ a biɛli Iso sani, ka o zaŋ ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kanna ni o ti tuh a soli.
en: The messengers came back to Jacob and said, We went to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you. He has men with him.

dag: Yinim bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, niŋmiy o naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: You who honor the LORD, trust in the LORD! God is their help and shield.

dag: Chamiya ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali anfaani mini atam maa ni, amaa n ku doli ya chaŋ nimaani. Di yi pa lala n ni ti kun ya sol ni, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: You are going to a rich and fertile land. But I will not go with you myself, because you are a stubborn people, and I might destroy you on the way.

dag: Bina anahi n-nyɛ bɛn gamdi giŋgaani bɛ biɛhigu ni.
en: There are four things that are impressive to watch as they walk:.

dag: Ka salo maa tahi bɛ zuɣu ni bɛ foma; amaa ka bɛ maan kuhi pam yɛli, Ti dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: Now the crowd scolded them and told them to be quiet. But they shouted even louder, Show us mercy, Lord, Son of David.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-labi yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni, ka yi yaannim gba daa bi mi li, ka yi ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa nimaani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, dama n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. .
en: So I will banish you from this land to a place that neither you nor your ancestors have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no mercy.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nol ni yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka o zaŋ yɛli zali zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni buɣim ti saɣim li ŋɔ. Di ʒiɛya gulila dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri ŋun Naawuni sizuura saria la.
en: But the heavens and the earth that now exist are being preserved by the same command of God, in order to be destroyed by fire. They are being kept for the day when godless people will be judged and destroyed.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa kpila maa ka yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti lan zaŋ li gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla ninsal ʒim liɣiri.
en: The chief priests picked up the money and said, This money was paid to have a man killed. We can't put it in the temple treasury.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka o zabi nyuli tinzun wuna zuɣu, ka daa lan niŋ binshɛŋa din chihira n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: Their idolatry made the Lord jealous; the evil they did made him angry.

dag: N ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka yaŋɔ paɣisara ti kana ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom.
en: Here I am, standing by this well of water, and the young women from the city are coming out to get water.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko sani ka wuntia ni kpiɔŋ be. Amaa ŋunkam zaa je ma ni di vi.
en: They will say, Goodness and strength come only from the Lord . And all who show their anger against him will be humiliated.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu somiya buri, ka kum ka fabili, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa na bi miligi ka chɛ ti.
en: So put on funeral clothing. Weep and wail, for the LORDs fierce anger hasnt turned away from us.

dag: Kul yumiya taba kaman yi nyɛla mabi yinsi la.
en: Keep loving each other like family.

dag: Ka o daa lu bɛ zuɣu ŋ-ŋmɛri kabiri bɛ sakpuri mini bɛ gbalipina n-daa niŋ lala ku ba pam. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Ɛtam ti kpe m-be tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: Then Samson started hacking them to pieces with his sword. Samson left Philistia and went to live in the cave at Etam Rock.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la ni ka di nyɛ kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali teeri Izraɛl bidibisi maa yɛla kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm.
en: The stones were attached to the vests shoulder pieces as reminder stones for the Israelites, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Ishia pa.
en: Uzziels oldest son was Micah, and Isshiah was his second son.

dag: Di yuun pihinahi nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi Anabi Musa zuɣu mɔɣu ni zo shɛli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini m-be tutuɣu ni kaman buɣim la.
en: Forty years later Moses was in the desert near Mount Sinai. An angel appeared to him in the flame of a burning bush.

dag: ka Amɔn nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔsia nyɛ o bia.
en: Manassehs son was Amon. Amons son was Josiah.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Ti yaa nyaŋ ba kaman ti ni pun nyandi ba shɛm la. Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lo nia yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti ŋmaligi zɔri ka bɛ dol ti, ka ti zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa solɔri zuɣu ha.
en: The men of Benjamin said, We are winning as before! The men of Israel were running away, but it was a trick. They wanted to lead the men of Benjamin away from their city and onto the roads.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum bee kɔnyuri mal a bee ka a nyɛ sana bee n-chani gbinfini bee ka a biɛra bee m-be sarika ni, ka ti baɣa ka a ni.
en: Then they will answer him, When, Lord, did we ever see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and we would not help you.

dag: Dinzuɣu shɛhiranim pam ŋɔ ni gili ti ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti yihi bin tibisili kam mini din nyɛ alahichi ni zaŋ shɛli tabili ti, ka chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo zo tizɔbo shɛli din ʒe n-gul ti ŋɔ.
en: As for us, we have this large crowd of witnesses around us. So then, let us rid ourselves of everything that gets in the way, and of the sin which holds on to us so tightly, and let us run with determination the race that lies before us.

dag: N leela n niriba zaa ni lari ninvuɣ so; bɛ yiini yila maani ma ansarisi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I have become a joke to all my people. All day long they sing songs about me and make fun of me.

dag: Amaa ka Ayuba garigi yɛl o, A yɛtɔɣa maa ŋmanila paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra la yɛtɔɣa. Ti deemi din viɛli Naawuni nuu ni, ka ku deei din bie dina? Yɛla ŋɔ zaa ni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi o noli yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: Job replied, Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well. In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God.

dag: Nyamya, n ni tim anabi Ilaija yi sanna pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm maa dali naanyi paai.
en: Look, I will send Elijah the prophet to you. He will come before that great and terrible time of judgment from the Lord .

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa na kul wuhiri niriba maa saha shɛli maa ka maligumaaniba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛma ni Sadusiinim dii vana ti zani bɛ tooni.
en: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, some Jewish leaders came up to them. There were some priests, the captain of the soldiers that guarded the Temple, and some Sadducees.

dag: Bɛ pun zaŋ baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba n-ka n sanna ni bɛ ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ di gbinni.
en: The wise men and the men of magic were brought to me to read this writing on the wall. I wanted them to explain to me what it means, but they could not explain it.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya. O ku tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni.
en: This is what the king says: Dont let Hezekiah fool you! He cannot save you from my power.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, ka so daa kani n-nyɛ dabili bee bilichina ka bi nya nahiŋgu ŋɔ; ka so mi daa kani din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma zaa yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni zali shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni yɛn ʒi shɛlikam mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam polo; ka a wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn su binshɛlikam zaa ʒibu fukumsi.
en: Moses and Aaron shall see to it that the Gershonites perform all the duties and carry everything that Aaron and his sons assign to them.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ Ishimail zuliya ni ti kpuɣi Ibrahimma bia Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ŋun yuli daa booni Mahalat ka o tizɔdoo nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt la na ti pah o ni daa pun mali paɣ shɛb maa zuɣu.
en: So he married Ishmael's daughter Mahalath, who was the sister of Nebaioth and the granddaughter of Abraham.

dag: Yi yi yihi di ni zaɣ viɛla zaka ka di li, yi bi tum taali. Amaa miriya ka yi ta Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri; yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: You won't be punished for eating it, as long as you have already offered the best parts to me. The gifts and sacrifices brought by the people must remain sacred, and if you eat any part of them before they are offered to me, you will be put to death.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi di ni daa fo n-dɔni baalim maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ ba na ti zali bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ zani kulino shɛl ni.
en: They were glad because of the calm, and he brought them safe to the port they wanted.

dag: Ka Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa biŋkumdiŋmɛriba zuɣulan la daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhiri bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri biŋkumda maa shɛm, dama ŋuna n-daa mi di ŋmɛbu.
en: Because of his skill in music Chenaniah was chosen to be in charge of the levitical musicians.

dag: nti nya zaɣ yini din mali shaara pam, ka chaŋ nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da li.
en: After finding a very valuable one, the owner goes and sells everything in order to buy that pearl.

dag: Ka ŋun maligumaana Ɛliɛza zaŋ o nubil tim o ʒim ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la tooni polo siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: Then Eleazar the priest must put some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle some of the blood toward the Holy Tent. He must do this seven times.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua mini Binnui ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛrɛbia ni Juda ni Matania ŋun min o tab daa su wumpaɣibo yila yilibu fukumsi la.
en: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah. These men, with Mattaniahs relatives, were in charge of the songs of praise to God.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali Bia maa mali nyɛvili; ka ŋunkam mi ka Naawuni Bia maa ka nyɛvili.
en: Whoever has the Son has life, but whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

dag: Ka Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma.
en: Ephron answered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ di gba mini di naa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku niriba bɛn zaa be di ni, ka so daa bi kpalim; ka daa niŋ di naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: The Lord also gave the Israelites victory over this city and its king. They spared no one, but killed every person in it. They did to the king what they had done to the king of Jericho.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be ni ni alaafee, ka me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri. N yi ti kari bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn zaa lihi ʒiɛm ba la saria, bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will live on it in safety. They will build houses, plant vineyards, and live in safety. When I execute judgments against all who hold them in contempt on every side, they will know that I, the LORD, am their God.

dag: dama pagɔrili ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli, paɣ zinalan ŋmanila kɔbil muɣiliŋga.
en: A prostitute is a deep pit, and a foreign woman is a narrow well.

dag: Poloya maa ni ti lir a min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa. .
en: The frogs will be all over you, your people, and your officials.

dag: Ka n daa pii yi bi shɛba n-leeg anabinima, ka pii yi nachimba shɛba n-leei Nazarinima. Izraɛlnima, bee pa lala n-nyɛ li? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I chose some of your sons to be prophets and some of your young men to be nazirites. Isn't this true, people of Israel? I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka vi gbahi ba, ka sokam baŋ a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Cover their faces with shame, O Lord , and make them acknowledge your power.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣimna, ka o yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mani n-daa yihi yinim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka fan ya Ijiptinim mini na shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi ya fitiina la zaa nuu ni bahi.
en: When everyone had arrived, Samuel said: The Lord God of Israel told me to remind you that he had rescued you from the Egyptians and from the other nations that abused you.

dag: A yi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa talim jɛrigu, di ŋmanila a zaŋla sua ŋmaag a napɔŋ bahi ka bɔri yɛla.
en: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.

dag: Dɔb ŋɔ zaa daa kpuɣila tinzun paɣiba, ka bɛ daa kari bɛ paɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: All these men had married foreign women, some of whom had borne children.

dag: O chɛ ka ti kul be ti nyɛvili ni, ka bi chɛ ka ti sarigi.
en: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Yaakubu min o bidibisi. Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bituuli la.
en: These are the names of the Israelites who went to Egypt, including Jacob and his sons. Jacobs oldest son was Reuben.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chana, ka n wum bɛ kpiŋkpama maa vuri ka di be kaman kokpɛɣu vuri la; di daa ŋmanila Kpiɔŋlan Naa kukoli, ka di vuri ŋmani tɔbbihi pam vuri. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni ti kari tuuni kam saria zaŋ tabili ashilɔni tuuni kam, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔbil nin shɛli ni ti puhigi, ka Dauda daŋ ni niriba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaŋ di kom su n-yi alahichi mini buɣijɛmbo daɣiri ni.
en: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Hɛzɛkia suhigu maa, ka chɛ niriba maa taali, ka bi ku ba.
en: The Lord listened to King Hezekiahs prayer and forgave the people.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋdi binshɛŋa din be kasi bahiri bahi bee n-zaŋdi binshɛŋa din mali buchi pam bahiri kuruchunima, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ no li fi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka ŋmaligina tin ya daŋa.
en: Dont give holy things to dogs, and dont throw your pearls in front of pigs. They will stomp on the pearls, then turn around and attack you.

dag: ni di pindigu din daa nyɛ bɛ ni nani piɛlahi gban shɛŋa n-niŋ moonsi mɔhi li la mini di pindigu shɛli din nyɛ teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana la ni pateesa la.
en: the covering of rams skins dyed red, the covering of beaded leather, and the veil for a screen.

dag: amaa biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni tim n tuumba na ka bɛ ti kpe a min a kpambaliba yinsi nti vihi, ka bɛ yi kul nya binshɛlikam ka di tiɣi bɛ nini, bɛn kpuɣim li. .
en: However, at this time tomorrow I will send my officers to you, and they will search your palace and the houses of your officers. Everything that you find valuable they will seize and take away.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ o niriba kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gul o ni pii na so la, ka tiligir o.
en: The Lord protects his people; he defends and saves his chosen king.

dag: Di sɔɣiya ka chɛ binnɛma zaa nina, di limsiya ka chɛ noombihi bɛn be zuɣusaa.
en: Shes hidden from the eyes of all the living, concealed from birds of the sky.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ŋɔ daa jɛmdi la Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛ buɣa; ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi na kul niŋdimi kaman bɛ yaannim maa ni daa niŋdi shɛm maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
