en: So now those other nations respected the Lord , but they also served their own idols. Their children and grandchildren did the same thing their ancestors did. They still do these things to this day.

dag: ka tiŋgbani daa bɔɣi, ka bɛ mini Kɔra zaa lu di ni ka buɣim di bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ kpi, ka tiŋgbani maa mum ba niŋ; ka di leei saɣisigu yɛlli ʒiɛya la.
en: That's when the Lord made the earth open up and swallow Dathan, Abiram, and Korah. At the same time, fire destroyed men as a warning to the other Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka so zali ya zaligunima zaŋ chaŋ yi ni ni di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli polo bee zaŋ chaŋ dabisi kasi shɛŋa mini gol palli chuɣu puhibu ni Vuhim Dabisili kaya dolibu polo.
en: So dont let anyone make rules for you about eating and drinking or about Jewish customs .

dag: Ka malaika ŋun daŋ tooni daa chaŋ ti kpaag o laa ni dini bahi dunia ni, ka yuma din bie ka kabiri ʒim daa niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biŋkɔbigu la dalinli ka jɛmd o binnan la.
en: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi dimnim ti nyaŋ ya, ka sun ya. Ka yi ti guura ka so bi kariti ya.
en: I will turn my face against you: you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you; and you will run away even when no one is chasing you.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nanim ni tum zina ni paɣ so, ka dunianim zaa nyu o zina maa wain n-kul la.
en: The rulers of the earth sinned sexually with her. The people of the earth became drunk from the wine of her sexual sin.

dag: O daa zali Yaakubu zuliya zaligu, ka zali zaligu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla o ni daa zali ti yaannim zaligu shɛli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children.

dag: N ni daa siɣisi mmaŋa n-yihi Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya ka bi deei ya shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi nya duhibu la, n tumla taali maa?.
en: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ pala ŋun ka yiko din ni tooi tiligi ya bee ŋun nyɛ tikpiralana, ka ku tooi wum yi suhigu.
en: Look, the Lord s power is enough to save you. He can hear you when you ask him for help.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun be tibi; ŋuna m-boli ya ni yi min o Bia Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la ti laɣim be.
en: God is faithful. He is the one who has chosen you to share life with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

dag: A mini Judanim ni Izraɛlnim daa niŋdila daabiligu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi alikama din yi Minnɛt na mini za ni shiri ni kpam ni ti shɛli din niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ka di bi poori la na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: Judah and Israel paid for your goods with wheat, honey, olive oil, and spices.

dag: Pa ŋun daa nam ma niŋ m ma puli ni n-daa nam bɛ gba? Pa ŋuna n-daa nam ti zaa niŋ ti manim puya ni?.
en: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa miri ba daa wum bɛ kuhigu ka guui; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Tiŋgbani ni vali ti gba.
en: The Israelites heard the cries of the men being destroyed. So they all ran in different directions and said, The earth will swallow us too.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kul bɔrila tin shɛli din so. Tin shɛli din be alizanda ni ka bɛ daa bɔra. Dinzuɣu vi bi mali Naawuni ni bɛ bol o bɛ Naawuni, dama o pun me tiŋ zali ba.
en: Instead, it was a better country they longed for, the heavenly country. And so God is not ashamed for them to call him their God, because he has prepared a city for them.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni gbahi jɛŋgbini bihi ka o suhu yiɣisi shɛm la, lala ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu. N ni dari tɔhi ba, ka ŋub ba kaman gbuɣinli la, kaman mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ŋ-ŋub ba la.
en: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa tim ti boli Juda kpamba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, ka bɛ laɣim o sanna.
en: King Josiah told all the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem to come and meet with him.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Paɣiŋoo ŋun bi dɔɣi, mali suhupiɛlli! Nyin ŋun ʒi bia dɔɣibu wolisibu biɛrim ŋɔ, yaam a noli n-tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu! Dama bɛ ni chɛ paɣ so bahi mali bihi pam n-gari ŋun mali yidana.
en: The Scriptures say, Be happy, woman—you who cannot have children. Be glad you never gave birth. Shout and cry with joy! You never felt those labor pains. The woman who is alone will have more children than the woman who has a husband. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka o nya alaafee.
en: So Moses prayed to the Lord , God, please heal her from this sickness.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla neen yinsi din nyɛ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tum tuun yinsi maa n wuɣi shɛlɔrigu niŋ di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: The finely woven belt, made of the same materials, was attached to the ephod so as to form one piece with it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ ŋun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: In time to come you will acknowledge that I am God and that I have spoken to you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu din nyɛ o shɛhira tanti jɛmbu duu m-be alizanda ni la, ka di yooi.
en: After this I looked, and the temple in heaven—that is, the tent of witness—was opened.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa boli Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba na.
en: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Do so daa be Jɛrusalɛm ka o yuli booni Simiɔn; o daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ ka zɔri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa be o ni, ka o daa yuuni Izraɛlnim Tiligira kandina soli.
en: At that time there was a man named Simeon living in Jerusalem. He was a good, God-fearing man and was waiting for Israel to be saved. The Holy Spirit was with him.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni bi sab gbaŋ yɛl ti a yɛla, ka ti mabi shɛb bɛn mi ka ya ŋɔ na bi tɔɣisi a zaɣ biɛ shɛli yɛla ti sani.
en: They responded, We havent received any letters about you from Judea, nor have any of our brothers come and reported or said anything bad about you.

dag: Ka ti yaannim maa daa zaɣis o noli, ka woligi bɛmaŋa ka chɛ o, ka daa paɣila Ijipti labbu bɛ suhuri ni.
en: Hes also the one whom our ancestors refused to obey. Instead, they pushed him aside and, in their thoughts and desires, returned to Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: The followers discussed the meaning of this. They said, He said this because we have no bread.

dag: Ti daa ʒiɛm o ka zaɣis o. O daa nyɛla ŋun mili suhugarigu mini wahala dibu. O daa ŋmanila niriba ni ŋmaligiri bɛ nina bahiri kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ so. Ti daa ʒiɛm o, ka bi lih o ka o nyɛ shɛli.
en: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, He is a nobody.

dag: Bɛ ku saɣi doli sana, amaa bɛ ni zomi ka chɛ o, dama bɛ bi mi saamba kukoya.
en: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti o ni o ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai. Ɛsta ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: and Esther gave him this message to take back to Mordecai:.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni. O nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim sahakam.
en: the Creator of heaven, earth, and sea, and all that is in them. He always keeps his promises;.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli. Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba. Kuruchunim maa daa nyɛla kaman tusaayi laasabu.
en: Jesus let them go, and they went out of the man and into the pigs. The whole herd of about , pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ, ka nyɛ n ni mali so nyuri bara. Nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha, dunia luɣilikam niriba ni ti ka a sanna ti yɛli, Ti yaannim daa bi di binshɛli fali n-naɣ pahila ʒiri mini binyoya din ka buchi.
en: Lord , you are the one who protects me and gives me strength; you help me in times of trouble. Nations will come to you from the ends of the earth and say, Our ancestors had nothing but false gods, nothing but useless idols.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shihi o kɔbili min o niŋgbuŋ pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: I swear, if you attack his flesh and bones, he will curse you to your face.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kom leei ʒim, ka chɛ ka bɛ zahim kpi.
en: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi m-mali sara maligu shɛlikam, kpam yi be di ni bee kpam yi ka di ni, di nyɛla Aduna bidibisi la zaa dini, di ni kul nyɛ yino dini shɛm, lala ka di nyɛ ŋun la gba dini.
en: But every other grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, will belong to all of Aarons sons equally.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka jila be di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ be di ni, ka gbaŋ pɔbi bɛ zaa. Amaa ka vuhim daa ka bɛ ni.
en: There before my eyes, I saw sinew and muscles begin to cover the bones. Skin began to cover them, but there was no breath in them.

dag: yin tooi ŋub bɛna, sakɔnooŋa min o balibu zaa ni sakɔnooŋa ŋun ka paɣiri min o balibu zaa ni paaŋa min o balibu zaa ni sakɔɣu min o balibu zaa.
en: You may eat locusts, crickets, or grasshoppers.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ zuliya la luya, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha! Bɛ chɛ ba sɔŋ tiŋa, ka so kani n-ni yiɣisi ba zali.
en: The virgin of Israel has fallen. She will not get up anymore. She was left alone, lying in the dirt. There is no one to lift her up.

dag: A ni tooi lo o mihi n-chɛ ka o ko a? Bee o ni tooi yɛbisi a kɔbu ti a ka a biri?.
en: Can you hold one with a rope and make him plow? Or make him pull a harrow in your fields?.

dag: N wum a ni suhi ma suhigu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ishimail gba polo maa. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam. O ni ti nyɛla nanim pinaayi yaba, ka n chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: As for Ishmael, I’ve heard your request. I will bless him and make him fertile and give him many, many descendants. He will be the ancestor of twelve tribal leaders, and I will make a great nation of him.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi wɔɣira nimdi, ka nyu dunia ŋɔ nanim ʒim mini piɛlahi ʒim ni piɛnyama ʒim ni buhi ʒim ni naɣilahi ʒim, bɛ zaa nyɛla Bashan biŋkɔb kpaba.
en: They are to eat the bodies of soldiers and drink the blood of the rulers of the earth, all of whom will be killed like rams or lambs or goats or fat bulls.

dag: n-yɛra, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: when he said, I'll give you the land of Canaan.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn wurimla n ni daa me shɛli zali, ka vuɣi n ni daa sa shɛli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: This is what you should say to him: The LORD proclaims: Im breaking down everything I have built up. Im digging up that which I have planted—the entire land.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-voog a yihi nuzaa polo maa katiŋ na n-kar a tahi Izraɛl zoya ni.
en: I will turn you about, drag you out, and bring you out of the far north, and I will bring you to Israels mountains.

dag: Ka n ni ti kari ba saria bɛ ni zaɣisi ma bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali kam puuni la zuɣu. Bɛ mali maligu ti buɣa, ka jɛm bɛmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: And I will announce judgment against my people, because they are evil and have turned away from me. They offered sacrifices to other gods and worshiped idols they made with their own hands.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Bɔaz maŋmaŋ gba yi Bɛtilihɛm paana nti puhi kachɛriba maa n-yɛli, Yawɛ kul kpalimmi be yi sani! Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: Later, Boaz came to the field from Bethlehem and greeted his workers. He said, The Lord be with you! And the workers answered, And may the Lord bless you.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri bee n-tu so labisi, amaa lee niŋmiyala alibarika niŋmi bɛn niŋdi ya zaɣ biɛɣu ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya ni di chɛ ka yi tooi nya o daalibarika.
en: Dont pay back evil for evil or insult for insult. Instead, give blessing in return. You were called to do this so that you might inherit a blessing.

dag: ni Hadad ni Tɛma ni Jɛturi ni Nafish ni Kɛdɛma.
en: Hadad; Tema; Jetur; Naphish; and Kedemah.

dag: Nyin ŋun lihiri daadamnim ŋɔ, n yi tumla alahichi, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum a? Bɔ n-chɛ ka a kul zaŋ dolila mani? Ka a kul liritila mani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka n yɛla muɣis a?.
en: You are always watching us! If I sinned, would that hurt you? Why have you made me your target? Have I become a problem for you?.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu. Ti ni daa be yi san la ti daa pala gbinnyaɣinima.
en: You yourselves know very well that you should do just what we did. We were not lazy when we were with you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni bi wumdi kuhigu din ka buchi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa baɣa ka di ni.
en: God will not listen to their worthless begging. God All-Powerful will not pay attention to them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni tutuɣu, ka faako yi ti kana, bɛ ku nya li. Bɛ ni ti bela tiŋgban nɛli tiŋ kuŋ ni. Tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yalim tiŋgbani, ka so ka di ni.
en: They will be like a desert shrub that doesnt know when relief comes. They will live in the parched places of the wilderness, in a barren land where no one survives.

dag: Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, wula ka yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi yi yi nol ni na ka yi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ? Dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa puuni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi bee n-galim Naawuni ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: In spite of everything that had happened, Job did not sin by blaming God.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a kumdi pampam? A lan kala naa? A saawaranim kpimi, ka biɛrim mal a kaman paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: Why do you cry out so loudly? Why are you suffering like a woman in labor? Is it because you have no king, and your counselors are dead?.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni la ha kul kpalim be yi suhuri ni. Yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni maa ha yi kul kpalim be yi ni, dindina yi gba ni be Bia maa min o Ba Naawuni ni.
en: As for you, what you heard from the beginning must remain in you. If what you heard from the beginning remains in you, you will also remain in relationship to the Son and in the Father.

dag: ka fara lir a kaman tayiɣ la, ka kum lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lo kpara la.
en: Suddenly poverty hits you and everything is gone!.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi niɣi chani vinvamli ni shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ Shia daa ti o niriba vuhim. Lala ka o daa wuh o niriba maa soli, ka di ti o yuli jilima.
en: As cattle are led into a fertile valley, so the Lord gave his people rest. He led his people and brought honor to his name.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn bahi maa ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ nyaandolitab sani nti yɛli ba maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa ni yɛli ba shɛm zaa.
en: After their release, Peter and John returned to the brothers and sisters and reported everything the chief priests and elders had said.

dag: dama binnamda zaa leela binchɔɣima, ka di pala binnamda maa yubu zuɣu. Naawuni ni yu ni di niŋ shɛm m-bala, amaa ka o lee ti binnamda maa tahima.
en: Creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice—it was the choice of the one who subjected it—but in the hope.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o deemba maa soli lu o sizuura, ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ. Ka bɛ daa puhi tab bɔhi tab daalaafee yɛla; ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Musa suɣili ni.
en: so Moses went out to meet him, bowed before him, and kissed him. They asked about each other's health and then went into Moses' tent.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔrili zaɣ titali kpiŋkpama ayi ti paɣ maa ni o yiɣi zo ka chɛ wahu maa n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti be luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn dihir o hal ti paai yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.

dag: A bi tiri di ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyura, ka mɔŋdi kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu.
en: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty.

dag: Miriya ka yi deeri birapu, dama birapu deebu zomdila niriba nina ka bɛ ŋariti bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: If someone tries to pay you to agree with them when they are wrong, dont accept that payment. A payment like that can blind judges so that they cannot see the truth. It can make good people tell lies.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yili ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa din be n nɛma duri puuni wuhi ba.
en: So Isaiah asked him, What did they see in your house? Hezekiah said, They saw everything in my palace. I showed them all my wealth.

dag: ka di daa ti paag o ni o kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti tuɣili tulaale zim kaman bɛ daadiini soli ni daa zali shɛm.
en: Following the customs of priestly service, he was chosen by lottery to go into the Lords sanctuary and burn incense.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-kpuɣi kuɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kuɣ o zuɣu la sa nimaani, ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu.
en: When Jacob got up early the next morning, he took the rock that he had used for a pillow and stood it up as a place of worship. Then he poured olive oil on the rock to dedicate it to God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum yi ni yɛli ma yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, ka yɛli ma, N wum niriba maa ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, bɛ mali yɛlimaŋli bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni.
en: The LORD heard what you said, when you said this to me. The LORD then told me: I heard what the people said when they spoke with you. Everything they suggest is good.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ o tumtumdiba ninvuɣ pia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa zɔrila o yiŋnim min o yanim ni o niŋ li wuntaŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa niŋ li la yuŋ.
en: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did just as the LORD had told him. But because he was too afraid of his household and the townspeople to do it during the day, he did it at night.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ puuni, a ka yɛlimaŋli, n ni garig a: Naawuni galisiya gari daadam kam.
en: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.

dag: N ni mihi n ninni niŋ ba, bɛ ni daa kul tiligi buɣim dili ni maa, buɣim na kul ni bahi di ba. Ka n yi ti mihi n ninni niŋ ba, a ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and will punish them. They have escaped one fire, but now fire will burn them up. When I punish them, you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Ibrahimma daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi: Yino daa nyɛla dab paɣ bia, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bilichin paɣ bia.
en: Its written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and one by the free woman.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ n-su di fukumsi; ka su teeku puuni zahim mini noonsi ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God blessed them and said to them, Be fertile and multiply; fill the earth and master it. Take charge of the fish of the sea, the birds in the sky, and everything crawling on the ground.

dag: Amaa yi yi taɣi yi suhuri ka zaɣisi wumbu ka birigi n-jɛmdi wuna.
en: But if you turn away from your God and refuse to listen, if you are led away to worship and serve other gods.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara piɛbila maa mini kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim zuɣu maa gahigahi, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest will take the male sheep for the compensation offering and the log of oil, and will lift them as an uplifted offering before the LORD.

dag: N daa deei sɔŋsim cheechi shɛŋa ni n-ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ ya. Di bemi kaman n daa fa ba mi n-sɔŋ ya maa.
en: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.

dag: Zaŋmiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: Bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Di tambu shee tiŋa zaŋ hal ni di tariga tiŋli ni ti nyɛla mita yini, ka di yɛliŋ ti nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu. Di naŋgbaŋkuɣili kara zaŋ ti paai naŋgbaŋkuɣili bihi ni ti nyɛla mita ayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu.
en: The lowest section of the altar, from the top of the base, was feet high. The next section was set back from the edge inches all around, and was feet high. The section after that was also set back from the edge inches all around.

dag: Uzia daa lan me du wɔɣila zali Jɛrusalɛm goon gɔŋ dunɔdal la polo mini vinvamli dunɔdali ni malaika dunɔdal la polo zaa, ka mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate, and at the place where the wall turned. He made them strong.

dag: Hanna daa suhiri Naawuni la o suhu ni, amaa ka o naŋgbampiba lee damda, ka so daa bi wumd o kukoli. Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa tɛhi ni o nyula dam kuli.
en: Hannah was praying in her heart. Her lips were moving, but since she did not say the words out loud, Eli thought she was drunk.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi fuɣ o gbaŋ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi to n-chib o kuriti gbaɣino ziɣinli ŋɔ?.
en: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?.

dag: Amaa o yi wum di yɛla ka di niŋ daba yi ha, di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛn zaɣisi li, dindina paɣ maa taali ni ʒi doo maa zuɣu.
en: But if he later annuls the vow, he must suffer the consequences for the failure to fulfill the vow.

dag: A ni tooi tim saanyaɣisibu ka di chaŋ ka labina ti yɛl a, Mani m-bɔŋɔ?.
en: Can you give a command to the lightning? Will it come to you and say, Here we are; what do you want, sir? Will it go wherever you want it to go?.

dag: Dan zuliya n-daa pah ayopɔin n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then land was given to the tribe of Dan. Each family in that tribe got its land.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino mi ti yɛl o, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Another disciple said to Jesus, Lord, let me wait till I bury my father.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Ɛliɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba pihinii pah o zuɣu.
en: from the clan of Hebron, Eliel, in charge of ;.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilis a tibili wum n kuhigu. Di nya n kumsi nintam ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu. N leela saan garito a sani, ka nyɛ sochanda kaman n yaannim la.
en: Listen, Lord , to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani hal abada, amaa o daalahichi maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But if you speak against the Holy Spirit, you can never be forgiven. That sin will be held against you forever.

dag: Biŋkpil shɛŋa din daa tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu zɔŋ ni la daa nyɛla paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi, ka di dubu pooi mita ayi biɛla.
en: The capitals on top of the columns in the porch were made like lilies, each six feet high.

dag: N suhu zaa kul bela Izraɛl sapashinnim bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu la ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: My heart is with the commanders of Israel, with the people who gladly volunteered. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa kpila Yawɛ tooni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ buɣim shɛli din bi simdi n-nyo sara maligu Sinai Zoli gbini mɔɣu ni la zuɣu. Bɛ daa ka bihi, dinzuɣu Ɛliɛza mini Itama n-daa tumdi maligumaana tuma n-sɔŋdi bɛ ba Aduna o ʒiɛman ni.
en: but Nadab and Abihu were killed when they offered unholy fire to the Lord in the Sinai Desert. They had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during Aaron's lifetime.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛba n-lan beni pahi yi zuɣu, amaa yinima n-kul nyɛ ti tahima mini ti suhupiɛlli ni ti nasara dibu barinyubo shɛli ti ni ti yɛn mali ti Duuma Yisa tooni o labbuna dali.
en: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi pam ka Ijiptinim ti wum o kuhigu maa, hal ka Firawuna yiŋnim gba ti wum o kuhigu maa.
en: He cried with such loud sobs that the Egyptians heard it, and the news was taken to the king's palace.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ zaliya ni yi zaŋ bindirigu maa lita ayi zuɣu zali yi bihi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka bɛ ti nya n ni daa zaŋ bindir shɛli dihiri ya tiŋgban nɛli ni saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: Moses said, The Lord has commanded us to save some manna, to be kept for our descendants, so that they can see the food which he gave us to eat in the desert when he brought us out of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka bɛn daa ti biɛra, ka man yɛla buɣu ka lo noli n-zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋ suhiri Naawuni;.
en: But when they were sick, I dressed in mourning; I deprived myself of food; I prayed with my head bowed low.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa nya ŋariŋ shɛli din chani Fɔnisia, ka ti kpe li chaŋ.
en: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, boarded, and put out to sea.

dag: Huram daa lan mali daanya taha pia, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita yini ni sɛntimita pihinii, ka di zaɣ yini kam daa deerila kom litanim kɔbisinii.
en: Huram also made ten bowls. There was one bowl for each of the ten carts. Each bowl was cubits across and could hold about gallons.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna, A zahima maa nyɛla zaɣ yini, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuhi nyin Firawuna maa.
en: Joseph replied: Your Majesty, both of your dreams mean the same thing, and in them God has shown what he is going to do.

dag: Dama bɛ suhuri kul palila nia biɛri n-diri kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu buɣim la. Yuŋ yi paai bɛ suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila wurigu buɣim doya, ka biɛɣu ti neei ka di taai kaman buɣim zibizibi la.
en: The people make their secret plans. Their hearts burn with excitement like an oven. Their excitement burns all night, and in the morning it is like a hot fire.

dag: N suhu ŋmanila wain koligu din pali wain, ka n yi bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di ni tahi.
en: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst.

dag: , m-pahi tin shɛŋa din daa be Avim zaŋ lab nudirigu polo.
en: The land of the Avvites.

dag: Ninsal dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu zaa puuni, o tuma zaa nyɛla din tir o biɛrim mini suhugarigu, hal ka o bi tooi vuhir o yubu yuŋ gba. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: All their days are pain, and their work is aggravation; even at night, their hearts dont find rest. This too is pointless.

dag: tiŋgbani maa tintariga; o ni yɛn su shɛli m-bala Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka n nanim maa ku lan muɣisi n niriba maa. Amaa bɛ ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim su tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman bɛ zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The land will be his property in Israel, and my princes will no longer oppress my people. They will give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

dag: Naawuni be lala tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka di kul ku vuui; Naawuni ni sɔŋ lala tiŋ maa biɛkaali saha.
en: God is in that city, so it will never be destroyed. He is there to help even before sunrise.

dag: Di simdi ni a nya tibidarigibo a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli mini din chihiri shɛl la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Now you must suffer for the terrible things you did. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Ɛkan, Bɔzuɣu ka a bo wahala ti ti? Yawɛ ni ti a wahala zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa lab o kuɣa, ka lab o malibu gba kuɣa, ka niŋ buɣim nyo ba.
en: And Joshua said, Why have you brought such trouble on us? The Lord will now bring trouble on you! All the people then stoned Achan to death; they also stoned and burned his family and possessions.

dag: Ka o daa shiri kpi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o tizo Jɔram daa di nam zan o zaani, Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la nam dibu yuma ayi saha, dama Ahazia daa ka bidibiga.
en: So Ahaziah died in agreement with the LORDs word that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Joram became king after him in the second year of Judahs King Jehoram, who was Jehoshaphats son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni o ni chɛ ka yi suhuri ba n-zani ka yi be tibi, ka be kasi ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la sani, saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o ninvuɣ gahinda yi ti labina.
en: In this way he will strengthen you, and you will be perfect and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all who belong to him.

dag: dindina n ni niŋ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm la, ka chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ leei noli ni di shɛli dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam sani.
en: If you continue to disobey, then I will do to this Temple what I did to Shiloh, and all the nations of the world will use the name of this city as a curse.

dag: Ka Judanim daa kana ti booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni nimaani n-zaŋ o leei Judanim naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Jabɛshigiliadnima n-daa sɔɣi Sool.
en: The people of Judah met with David at Hebron and poured olive oil on his head to show that he was their new king. Then they told David, The people from Jabesh in Gilead buried Saul.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka zaŋ dari mali adaka n-zaŋ li du zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka n sanna.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Cut two stone tablets like the first ones and make a wooden Box to put them in. Come up to me on the mountain.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili tiŋ maa ni tiŋbi so, ka o timd o o puu ni ka o ti dihir o kuruchunima.
en: He hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa ti bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: His disciples asked Jesus what this parable meant.

dag: Di yi zahira ni daɣiri tuma be yi sunsuuni, hal ka di tatabo ka chɛfirinim sunsuuni gba; dina n-nyɛ ni yi ni so zaŋ o ba paɣa dɔni.
en: Now, it is actually being said that there is sexual immorality among you so terrible that not even the heathen would be guilty of it. I am told that a man is sleeping with his stepmother!.

dag: Lala zuɣu di daa nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ din be alizanda ni ŋmahima la doli maligu malibu soli ŋɔ m-mali be kasi; amaa di nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni maŋmaŋ mali sara din so.
en: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M bindirigu nyɛla n tum ŋun tim ma na yubu, ka naag o tuma.
en: Jesus said, My food is to do what the one who sent me wants me to do. My food is to finish the work that he gave me to do.

dag: Ka sapashin so dabiyurigu daa biɛra n-tarigi.
en: A Roman officer there had a servant who was very dear to him; the man was sick and about to die.

dag: Ka so daa yi yɛn tɛh o naɣikɔra kubiɛlim bee o lɛbiɛlim, bɛ deer o la anzinfa laɣibaligu giram ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka so mi daa yi yɛn tɛh o kpanbiɛlim bee n-kpɛhi naɣikɔra peeŋkpaa, bɛ deer o la anzinfa laɣibaligu giram anahi.
en: The cost was two-thirds of a shekel for plowshares and mattocks, but one-third of a shekel for sharpening axes and for setting goads.

dag: Amaa naa daa bi saɣi zaŋ Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia ka nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la ŋun ti ba, ŋun Dauda mini Sool bia Jɔnatan ni daa lo tab alikauli shɛli Yawɛ tooni la zuɣu.
en: But the king protected Jonathans son, Mephibosheth. Jonathan was Sauls son, and David had made a promise in the Lord s name to Jonathan. So the king did not let them hurt Mephibosheth.

dag: Lɔris anahi maa zaa puuni, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣa me goma, ka me daansi tabili goma maa m-pie taba ti gili.
en: There was a brick wall around each of the four small courtyards, and there were places built into the brick walls for cooking.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ ti tooni chaŋ Troas nti gul ti.
en: They went on ahead and waited for us in Troas.

dag: O yaa bela o shee polo, ka o yiko be o pugbana puuni.
en: but look at the mighty muscles in its body.

dag: Ka Ziɔnnim wum li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka Juda fɔntinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ, a ni kariti saria shɛm zuɣu.
en: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.

dag: Ka ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda yi bɔri ni o woligi ka chɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda, ŋun niŋmi lala, dimbɔŋɔ puuni doo bee paɣa ŋun nyɛla yɛdaniŋda mali soli ni o niŋ o ni yu shɛm. Dama Naawuni bɔri ni ti malila suhudoo.
en: But if the husband or wife who is not a believer decides to leave, let them leave. When this happens, the brother or sister in Christ is free. God chose you to have a life of peace.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha, Ŋunkam deeri ya deerila mani, ka ŋunkam deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na.
en: Whoever accepts you also accepts me. And whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.

dag: Ka o ma yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn yɛl a no shɛli maa doli ma, nyin dee doli n ni wuh a shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti gbahi bubihi pola maa ti ma na.
en: His mother said to him, Your curse will be on me, my son. Just listen to me: go and get them for me.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa daa ti chirigi do so ka o yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, wuhim ti so shɛli din kuni tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ka ti niŋ a nirilim.
en: who saw a man leaving and said to him, Show us how to get into the city, and we won't hurt you.

dag: Dama o ni tilig a bɛn bariti zana nuu ni mini alɔbo din kuri niriba ni.
en: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Phinehas and these leaders went to Gilead and met with the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. They said:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-zahindi wuntizɔriba, nyini n-nyari din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn bɔhi ba biɛri shɛm, dama n zaŋ n yɛla maa niŋla a nuu ni.
en: Lord All-Powerful, you test good people. You look deeply into a persons mind. I told you my arguments against these people. So let me see you give them the punishment they deserve.

dag: Amaa yinim miriya ka yi niŋdi lala, dama yi Ba Naawuni pun mi din simdi ya hal ka yi na bi suh o li gba.
en: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.

dag: Di yi shiri nyɛla yi duhila yimaŋa n-jɛndi ma, ka zaŋ n filiŋ ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ku ŋma ʒiri bee n-taɣ o ni pun yɛli shɛm, dama o pala ninsala ka ni yɛli shɛli ka lan taɣi.
en: The one who lives forever, the God of Israel, does not lie and will not change his mind. He is not like a man who is always changing his mind.

dag: Alibarika be wuntizɔr ni, amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli ni.
en: Good people will receive blessings. The words of the wicked hide a violent nature.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, a ku di vi, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, a ku nya filiŋ. A ni tam a bipalitali saha vi yɛla, ka tam saha shɛli a ni daa nyɛ pakoli ka nya filiŋ shɛl la yɛla.
en: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Iso ka o mini ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi kanna. Ka o daa pirigi bihi ti Liya mini Reechɛl ni dabipaɣiba ayi la.
en: Jacob looked up and saw Esau approaching with four hundred men. Jacob divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two women servants.

dag: Tɛha maa ni daa be bɛ suhuri ni saha shɛli maa ka Yisa baŋ li ka dii bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew immediately what these teachers of the law were thinking. So he said to them, Why do you have these questions in your minds?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ daadam kam ni, ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi ninkura ti zahim zahima; ka yi nachimba mi ti nya ʒii.
en: After this, I will pour out my Spirit on all kinds of people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.

dag: Sool min o bidibis ata ni o neen ʒira ni o yiŋnim zaa ni daa laɣim kpi shɛm m-bala.
en: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka Samaria wurim n-leei mɔɣu ni, ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn sari wain tihi. Ka n ni ti va di kuɣa zaa ti bahi vinvamli ni, ka chɛ ka di tanzahi la yi n-do palo ni.
en: So I will make Samaria a pile of rubble in the open field, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley; her foundations I will lay bare.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun be tibi; ŋuna m-boli ya ni yi min o Bia Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la ti laɣim be.
en: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam n-yɛra, Zomiya Naawuni ka timiy o jilima, dama o ni yɛn kari saria saha shɛli paaya! Jɛmmiya ŋuna ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni teeku mini kɔbil nina la.
en: The angel shouted, Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.

dag: Lala ka di lan simdi ni yi zaŋ yi naɣilabil tuuli bee yi biŋkɔbbaligu bi tuuli kam ti ma. O ni be o ma sani daba ayopɔin, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ o ti ma.
en: Also, give me your firstborn cattle and sheep. Let the firstborn stay with its mother for seven days. Then on the eighth day, give him to me.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb mi daa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-zo nti kpe Gaad mini Giliad tiŋgbana ni. Di saha Naa Sool ŋun daa na bela Giligal, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa niŋgbuna ti sɔhira.
en: Still others went to Gad and Gilead on the other side of the Jordan River. Saul stayed at Gilgal. His soldiers were shaking with fear.

dag: N Naawuni, n tampiŋ, n ni sɔɣiri so sani. N nyɔtaɣirigu mini kpiɔŋlana ŋun tiligi ma. M birini mini n sɔɣisili shee, nyini n-nyɛ n tiligira ŋun tiligiri ma barina ni.
en: My God is my protection, and with him I am safe. He protects me like a shield; he defends me and keeps me safe. He is my savior; he protects me and saves me from violence.

dag: Amaa tinim ni nyɛ wuntaŋ ni niriba la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti maŋa ka zaŋ yɛda mini yurilim leei nyɔtaɣirigu m-pa ti nyɔri zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti tiliginsim tahima kaman tɔbutuhiri zuɣupila la pili.
en: But we belong to the day, and we should be sober. We must wear faith and love as a breastplate, and our hope of salvation as a helmet.

dag: Vinvamli din yuli booni Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ? Bɔzuɣu ka tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa tam mɔpila zuɣu puhiri chuɣu?.
en: This is a message about the Valley of Vision. What is happening? Why are all the people of the city celebrating on the roofs of the houses?.

dag: Dama yɛm ni ka a suhu ni na, ka baŋsim niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: You will gain wisdom, and knowledge will bring you joy.

dag: Asha zuliya ni, Okiran bia Pagiɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Asher—Pagiel son of Ocran;.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Then Isaiah told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord .

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa chɛ ka tɔbbi shɛb lɔɣi gilila Judanim maa nyaaŋa nti sɔɣi dɔni gu ba, ka bɛn kpalim mi be bɛ tooni polo.
en: Meanwhile Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to ambush the Judean army from the rear, while the rest faced them from the front.

dag: Di simdi ni yi dɔbba zaa kani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sanna buta yuuni puuni.
en: Three times a year all of your men must come to worship me, the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Di saha maa Jɔab daa na kul tuhirila Ammɔnnim bɛ tin zuɣu din nyɛ Raba la ni.
en: Meanwhile, Joab had been in the country of Ammon, attacking the city of Rabbah. He captured the royal fortress.

dag: Bee nir ni tooi no buɣimsal nɛɔŋ ka di ku nyoog o napɔŋ?.
en: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.

dag: Binzahi maa zaɣ yini kam daa malila bintaɣiris anahi di yaɣa anahi maa zaa. Bintaɣirisi maa mini binzahi maa zaa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: Around the top of each stand was a -centimeter strip, and there were four braces attached to the corners of each stand. The panels and the supports were attached to the stands.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri sunsuuni bee n-kɔrisi taɣi bɛ teensi bee n-chihi chiha bɛ niŋgbuna ni.
en: Priests must not shave bald patches on their heads or cut off the ends of their beards or make gashes in their bodies.

dag: Ka Dan bidibiga daa nyɛ Hushim.
en: Dans son was Hushim.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yihi ti dabitim ni labisi Ziɔn na, di daa ŋmanila zahindi ka ti zahinda.
en: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni wɔɣ ni tab shɛm, lala ka n soya be di ko ka chɛ yi soya, ka n tɛha gba be di ko ka chɛ yi tɛha.
en: As high as the heavens are above the earth, so high are my ways and thoughts above yours.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa sɔhigiya ka dam, dama Yawɛ ni lo nia ni o chɛ ka Babilɔn zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni la n-yɛn niŋ pali.
en: The land shakes and moves as if it is in pain. It will shake when the Lord does to Babylon what he plans— to make the land of Babylon an empty desert, a place where no one will live.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a kpiɔŋ zaa ni a tɛha zaa, ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. .
en: The man replied, The Scriptures say, Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind. They also say, Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself. .

dag: Bɛ ni ti labina ti ʒini m mahim. Bɛ ni ti yirigi puma kaman sambani puu la. Bɛ ni ti wali wala kaman wain tia la, ka bɛ nyom viɛlim ni ti ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn wain nyom viɛlim.
en: They will again live beneath my shadow, they will flourish like a garden; they will blossom like the vine, their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Ɛhab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Omri lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. His son Ahab succeeded him as king.

dag: A nyɛla nambɔzɔra ni ŋun chɛri taali paŋda, hal ti ni kul zaɣis a la zaa yoli.
en: But, Lord our God, you are kind and forgiving, even though we rebelled against you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika, ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Eighteen thousand Benjaminites fell, all of whom were strong warriors.

dag: Ka n yi ti na be n nyɛvili ni, nyin kul gbibi Yawɛ yurilim ŋɔ ni mani, ka ʒe ma yim din ni chɛ ka n ku kpi.
en: And if I remain alive, please keep your sacred promise and be loyal to me; but if I die.

dag: Di niŋya binshɛli nyuli zabbu tɛha puuni bee m-bɔri ni yi doli alaha soli nyu bara; amaa siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani ka miriya ka yi tɛhiri ni yi so yi taba.
en: In whatever you do, dont let selfishness or pride be your guide. Be humble, and honor others more than yourselves.

dag: Kalimiya Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn be Lɛvinim puuni bɛ ko kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Take a census of the Kohathites from among the Levites by their clans and their households.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn turila binshɛŋa bɛ ni bi mi; ka binshɛŋa bɛ ni baŋ kaman biŋkɔbiri ni baŋdi shɛm mi nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: But these people attack with insults anything they do not understand; and those things that they know by instinct, like wild animals, are the very things that destroy them.

dag: Ka yiŋbi so ŋun mi o duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛli ka bi mali shili bee n-tum kaman o duuma maa yubu ni nyɛ shɛm ni nya buri pam.
en: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka zibisim titali daa zibi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni daba ata.
en: So Moses raised his hand toward the sky, and an intense darkness fell on the whole land of Egypt for three days.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku saɣi guni kaman ti ni yɛli shɛm maa, dindina ti ni zaŋ ti bipuɣiŋga maa yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: But if you don't agree to be circumcised, we'll take Dinah and leave this place.

dag: Ka o tumtumdib kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, Tinzun paɣisar so ŋun daa doli Naomi yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bala.
en: The man answered, She is the one who came back from Moab with Naomi.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba ni nya li ka zo dabiɛm, di saha ka bɛ ni la a ka yɛli.
en: Righteous people will see this and be afraid; then they will laugh at you and say.

dag: Ti mabihi la zaa puhiri ya. Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ.
en: All the brothers and sisters here send their greetings. Give each other the special greeting of Gods people.

dag: Ka salo maa daa yɛl o, Ti pun wum Naawuni zaligu puuni ni Masia ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ka wula ka a yɛli ni shee bɛ zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Daadam Bia maa.
en: The people said, But our law says that the Messiah will live forever. So why do you say, The Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ Gaza, ka Ashikɛlɔn ti zani dabari. Bɛ ni ti taɣi Ashidɔdnim chaŋ wuntaŋ ni, ka wurim Ɛkurɔn.
en: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun be tibi; ŋuna m-boli ya ni yi min o Bia Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la ti laɣim be.
en: God is faithful, and you were called by him to partnership with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Pool kpe tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee saha shɛli ka o daa bɔhi sapashin kpɛm maa, A ni ti ma noli ka n yɛl a shɛli? Ka sapashin maa bɔh o, A wumdi Giriikili.
en: As Paul was about to be taken into the military headquarters, he asked the commander, May I speak with you? He answered, Do you know Greek?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yihi biŋkpam din daa be namanama ni zaa mini binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina mini di biŋkpam n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Moses took all the fat from the inner parts of the bull. He took the fat part of the liver with the two kidneys and the fat on them. Then he burned them on the altar.

dag: Farisiinim ni so daa ti boli Yisa ni o ka o yiŋ na ka bɛ ti laɣim di bindirigu; ka Yisa daa chaŋ o yiŋa nti ʒini bindirigu maa dibu shee ni bɛ di.
en: One of the Pharisees asked Jesus to eat with him. Jesus went into the Pharisees house and took a place at the table.

dag: Ka sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la ni zaŋ yaɣ yini tariga hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: The middle bar, halfway up the boards, should run from one end to the other.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli salo maa, Di zabiriya so nyuli o buni zuɣu, dama ninsal nyɛvili bi dolila o ni mali shɛli.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Be careful and guard against all kinds of greed. People do not get life from the many things they own.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa bahi noli, ka bɛ daa vihi luɣ shɛŋa litaafinim ni daa be Babilɔn.
en: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai Yisa sani n-nya ka o pun kpimi, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi kabi ŋun gbaya.
en: But when the soldiers came close to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead. So they did not break his legs.

dag: Hɛzirɔn bia Kalɛb min o paɣiba Azuba ni Jɛriɔt daa dɔɣi bihi. O bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛshɛr mini Shɔbab ni Aridɔn.
en: Caleb, Hezrons son, had children with his wife Azubah, and with Jerioth. These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

dag: ka nyo bɛ naawuna buɣim, bɛn dee pala naawun maŋa, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpe da shɛŋa ni kuɣ shɛŋa, dina n-chɛ ka o daa saɣim ba maa.
en: They destroyed the idols of wood and stone that the people of those nations had made and worshiped.

dag: Kuruwa kɔŋkɔba zaŋ zahim binyara nyɛla din chihira Yawɛ sani, ka ʒiri sanianim bi viɛla.
en: The Lord hates for people to use the wrong weights to cheat others. It is wrong to use scales that are not accurate.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa kul tahirimi. Bɛ kul malila suhupiɛlli ka yɔri vuri. Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi pala bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku shɛba, bɛ mi pala bɛn kpi tɔbu ni.
en: The whole city is in an uproar, filled with noise and excitement. Your people who died in this war did not die fighting.

dag: Jaazia bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔham mini Zakur ni Ibiri.
en: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti vuhi ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣ o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaashee.
en: He died and was buried in David's City, and his son Rehoboam succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o pul zuɣu suhiri Naawuni ni di yi ni nani, saha ŋɔ din miligim o zuɣu.
en: Then he went a short distance farther and fell to the ground. He prayed that, if possible, he might be spared the time of suffering.

dag: ni Ɛbal ni Abimeel ni Shiiba.
en: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana, ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka bɛ yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: Why do I say people are like that? Because John came, not eating like other people or drinking wine, and people say, He has a demon inside him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka anabi yi yimaŋmaŋ niriba ni na kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ti wummiya anabi maa yɛligu.
en: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.

dag: Babilɔnnima, yi bari yimaŋ zana ka di gbahi ya, amaa ka yi bi baŋ lala. Bɛ daa nyan ya n-gbahi ya yi ni daa mo Yawɛ la zuɣu.
en: Babylonia challenged me, the Lord God All-Powerful, but that nation doesn't know it is caught in a trap that I set.

dag: Kaman niriba ni kul zaŋdi anzinfa mini daanya ni kuriti ni samafuu ni dalima n-niŋdi binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara ni, ka vibiri buɣim niŋdi li ni di nyɛligi shɛm la, lala ka n ti yɛn zaŋ ya niŋ n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili puuni n-nyɛligi ya.
en: Workers put silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into a fire. They blow on the fire to make it hotter. Then the metals begin to melt. In the same way I will put you in my fire and melt you. That fire is my hot anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi be o tooni, dabiɛm m-mali ma, ka n yi tɛhi o yɛla, dabiɛm m-mali ma.
en: Therefore, I am scared by his presence; I think and become afraid of him.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Ŋunkam tu Naawuni, dilan daalahichi ni ʒin o zuɣu.
en: Then tell the people of Israel that anyone who curses God must suffer the consequences.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun paani o daalikauli bɛn ne mini kpiimba sani ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Bɔaz ni! Hal doo maa nyɛla ti dɔɣira ni Yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Lord bless Boaz! Naomi replied. He has shown that he is still loyal to the living and to the dead. Boaz is a close relative, one of those who is supposed to look after us.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi niŋ ania din ni chɛ ka yi tum Naawuni yubu, ka nya o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la palibu.
en: You need to be patient, in order to do the will of God and receive what he promises.

dag: lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana ti balim ba ni bɛ niŋm suɣilo, ka daa naanyi yihi ba bahi, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋ maa ni.
en: They came and consoled Paul and Silas, escorting them out of prison and begging them to leave the city.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim yi wum n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli ma.
en: Any sensible person will surely agree; and the wise who hear me will say.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-yihi ya kuriti nyɛligibu daaŋa ni na Ijipti ni yi ti leei omaŋmaŋ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba kaman yi ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But the Lord brought you out of Egypt to make you his own special people. He saved you from Egypt. It was as if he pulled you from a hot furnace. And now you are his people.

dag: Zaŋm a tuma niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni, ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa niŋ pali.
en: Turn to the Lord for help in everything you do, and you will be successful.

dag: O yɛliya, Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya, dama o ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: The king says this: Dont let Hezekiah lie to you. He wont be able to rescue you.

dag: Dinzuɣu gol so ŋun daa daŋ tooni yuun shɛli din pahir ayi maa ni dahin yini dali, ka o daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: So on the first day of the first month of the second year after they left Egypt, the Tent of the Lord 's presence was set up.

dag: Ka Jɔshua tuumba maa daa kpa zoya maa polo nti be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn daa biɛhi bɛ naba la ti lab kuli; dama bɛ daa vihimi m-bo ba sol ni zaa ka bi nya ba.
en: The spies went into the hills and hid. The king's men looked for them all over the countryside for three days, but they did not find them, so they returned to Jericho.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka pii ya leeg o niriba;.
en: Our friends, we know that God loves you and has chosen you to be his own.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa bɔb gbaag o tizo Bɛnjamin n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam; ka Bɛnjamin gba daa zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam.
en: He threw his arms around his brother Benjamins neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his shoulder.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa jɛm Naawuni Jɔshua ʒiɛman ni mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn daa doli Jɔshua nyaaŋa, ka daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la.
en: The people served the LORD throughout the rest of Joshuas life and throughout the next generation of elders who outlived him, those who had seen all the great things that the LORD had done for Israel.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi n-kɔri ba ti alizinnima.
en: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa yɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣ yini maa, ka yɛra, Chamiya Ramɔtigiliad ti di nasara. Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ naa nuu ni.
en: All the other prophets said the same thing. March against Ramoth and you will win, they said. The Lord will give you victory.

dag: A ti o o suhu ni bɔri shɛli; ka bi mɔŋ o o ni suh a bɔri binshɛli.
en: You did what he wanted most and never told him No.

dag: Izraɛlnima, dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti doli Yufretiiz Mɔɣili zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tintariga n-laɣim ya yinoyino kaman bɛ ni yihiri chi ka chɛri wurigu shɛm la.
en: At that time the Lord will begin separating his people from others. He will begin at the Euphrates River and will gather his people from there to the River of Egypt. You people of Israel will be gathered together one by one.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka o yi n-chaŋ ti zani ka yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi ka taali. Mani n-daa lo nia biɛɣu n-ku n dana, amaa ka ŋun mi n-lee ku bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: In the morning he went out and stood there to address all the people. You are innocent. Im the one who plotted against my master and killed him, but who killed all these people?.

dag: O daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Mɔabnima, ka bɛ leeg o daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani.
en: David also defeated the Moabites, and so they had to accept him as their ruler and pay taxes to him.

dag: Yi pun zaɣisi ma, ka chɛ ma jɛmbu ka di waɣa, ka yɛra, Ti ku jɛm a. Yi daa jɛm buɣa daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini.
en: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.

dag: ka zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be Alikauli Adaka maa luɣa ni la ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: He put the poles through the rings on each side of the Box.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ʒi karimbu.
en: If you give it to someone who can't read and ask him to read it to you, he will answer that he doesn't know how.

dag: Ka Yaakubu mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani la daa ka Luz din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: So Jacob and his people went to Luz, which is now called Bethel. It is in the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka Judanim daa laɣim ni bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka o sɔŋ ba. Bɛ daa yila Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni n-laɣimna ni bɛ ti niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ.
en: From every city of Judah people hurried to Jerusalem to ask the Lord for guidance.

dag: Ka Balaam garigi yɛl o, N di yɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni..
en: He answered, I can say only what the Lord tells me to say.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa bɔhi Ilaija, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ nyini ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti teei ma n daalahichi yɛla ka chɛ ka m bidibiga ŋɔ kpi.
en: She said to Elijah, Whats gone wrong between us, man of God? Have you come to me to call attention to my sin and kill my son.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa na kul kpalim bela teeku maa sunsuuni, ka Yisa kɔŋko mi kpalim be duli.
en: That night, the boat was still in the middle of the lake. Jesus was alone on the land.

dag: Bɛn zaa daa di li maa puuni, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu laasabu.
en: There were , men who ate the food.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ baŋya ni binshɛɣukam a ni zaŋ ti ma la yila a sanna;.
en: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ ŋun Keenan Naa Jabin maa muɣisigu hal ti ku o.
en: They pressed harder and harder against him until they destroyed him.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn guli piɛri mini niɣi, ka ʒi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi maa ni bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa na.
en: I will tell him that you are shepherds and take care of livestock and that you have brought your flocks and herds and everything else that belongs to you.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so daa ka shɛli din ni yo o, ka o daa chɛ sama maa ti bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu yɛlim ma, bɛ niriba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, ŋuni n-lee ni yuri sandihira ŋɔ gar o kpee.
en: Since neither of them could pay him back, the moneylender said that they didn't have to pay him anything. Which one of them will like him more.

dag: A chɛ ka pɔhim kpuɣi ma, ka chɛ ka m ba pɔhim maa, ka a tɔri ma gindi sanʒiɛɣu ni.
en: You let the strong wind blow me away. You throw me around in the storm.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Yi ni yino yɛliya, M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia, ka ŋun la mi yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ maa, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia. .
en: until finally he said, Both of you say this live baby is yours.

dag: Ti ni tooi paɣi Naawuni yi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ. Ti paɣir o ti ni mali suhupiɛl shɛli yi zuɣu ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: We have so much joy before our God because of you! So we thank God for you. But we cannot thank him enough for all the joy we feel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa bɔhi ma, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ninni ti lihiri suhugarigu lihigu lala? A mi bi biɛra, di nyɛla a suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira suhugarigu. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam.
en: So the king said, Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you. Even though I was frightened.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: The traitor had given the crowd a signal: The man I kiss is the one you want. Arrest him and take him away under guard.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ bɔh o shɛm ka bɔhi ba, N ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma maa gbinni ka yi bɔhiri taba ni yi baŋ maa?.
en: Jesus knew that they wanted to question him, so he said to them, I said, In a little while you will not see me, and then a little while later you will see me. Is this what you are asking about among yourselves?.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mini wɔɣira zaa nti pahi Naa Dauda bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim la zaa daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni doli Naa Sulemaana.
en: All the officials and soldiers, and even all of David's other sons, promised to be loyal to Solomon as king.

dag: Ka n wum damli shɛli binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni kaman kukol la ka di yɛra, Alikama lita yini nyɛla tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri, ka chi lita ata mi nyɛ tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri; amaa di niŋ kpam mini wain shɛli.
en: I heard what sounded like a voice coming from among the four living creatures, which said, A quart of wheat for a day's wages, and three quarts of barley for a day's wages. But do not damage the olive trees and the vineyards.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina saha shɛli ka Yisa kana ti ʒe teeku duli, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa na bi baŋ ni ŋun Yisa m-bala.
en: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.

dag: Teemiya saha shɛli din gari la ha, yi ni daa bɔhim baŋ Naawuni yɛla la nyaaŋa, yi daa niŋ ania di wahala bina pam ni, amaa yi mɔbu puuni di daa bi nyaŋ ya.
en: Remember how it was with you in the past. In those days, after God's light had shone on you, you suffered many things, yet were not defeated by the struggle.

dag: Jɔn daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John's clothes were made of camel's hair; he wore a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, dama di kpɛm pam. Mbusim be bɛ sujee zuɣu, dama ninkuunsi be di ni. N ni woligi ba Yaakubu daŋ ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ luɣilikam ni.
en: A curse be on their anger, because it is so fierce, And on their fury, because it is so cruel. I will scatter them throughout the land of Israel. I will disperse them among its people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla din viɛla kɔŋko, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla suhuyiɣisili.
en: What good people want always results in good; when the wicked get what they want, everyone is angry.

dag: A kɔŋko ka n tum alahichi maa, ka tum din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu a sani. Dinzuɣu a niŋ din tuhi, a ni wuhi ni m mali taali la puuni; a ka galimi a ni kari ma saria shɛm maa gba puuni.
en: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.

dag: Dabisili shɛli din pahir ayi dali, yi ni ti zaŋla bulaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara. Ka sara maligu bimbini maa yi daɣiri ni kaman naɣilaa la ni daa chɛ ka di yi daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: On the second day, you will present a flawless male goat as a purification offering. The priests will purify the altar just as they purified the altar with the bull.

dag: ni bindir viɛla din niŋdi kurimbuni ha zoya zuɣu ni bindira din niŋdi pam dabo kura zuɣu.
en: Let the hills and ancient mountains produce their best fruit.

dag: Ka o nyamma daa yɛligi ka o leei bundana.
en: Isaac became rich. He gathered more and more wealth until he became a very rich man.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni zali zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili be kom ni ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili gbamdi tiŋgban ni.
en: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Gaza goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri yuri ku tooi ti nir nasara, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ din galisi pam la ku tooi tiligi so.
en: War horses are useless for victory; their great strength cannot save.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ŋmari ʒiri, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din pa yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu, n suhu yiɣisimi bahi yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Therefore, the LORD God proclaims: Because you spoke worthless things and had false visions, Im against you. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Dauda bia Sulemaana dabili ŋɔ ti zaɣis a duuma.
en: But Jeroboam turned against his master. Jeroboam son of Nebat was one of the servants of Davids son Solomon.

dag: Ka Judanim daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din du pam mɔɣu ni la shee, ka bɛ daa du li n-lihi tɔbbi gbaliŋ la polo, n-nya ka kpiimba n-do tiŋa, ka bɛ so bi tiligi.
en: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ku chaŋ. Amaa di nyaaŋa ka o suhu ti lɛbigi ka o chaŋ.
en: No, I dont want to, he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.

dag: Takɔbi ni ti be samban ni, ka alɔbo mini kum be tiŋ puuni, bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn be sambani, ka kum min alɔbo mi lu bɛn be tiŋ puuni zuɣu.
en: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi kɔhigɔriba galisi gari saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Toliga fuɣisiya ka yiɣi chaŋ.
en: You have many traders who go places and buy things. They are as many as the stars in the sky. They are like locusts that come and eat until everything is gone and then leave.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim Malikia bia Pashihur mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la o sani la. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi.
en: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, Talk with Jeremiah for me. So they came to me and said.

dag: Hal Yisa ni daa yuri Lazarɔs mini Maata ni Mariama pam la zaa yoli.
en: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and brother.

dag: Bɛ tumtumdiba bɛn daa nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba kalinli daa nyɛla tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisita ni pihitanaayopɔin. Dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn daa nyɛ yiliyiiniba kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbisiyi.
en: not including their , male and female servants; they also had male and female singers.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Zaŋm a kpamdi ti ma pɔi.
en: But Jacob said, You must sell me your rights as the firstborn son.

dag: Di saha ka a dol a soli ni alaafee, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui shɛli.
en: You can go safely on your way and never even stumble.

dag: Di simdi ka a wuhi ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ni yɛn be shɛm mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm zaa.
en: You should teach them God's commands and explain to them how they should live and what they should do.

dag: ni Kɛriɔt ni Bɔzira ni Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ fɔntinsi zaa din be yoma mini katiŋa.
en: Kerioth, and Bozrah. Judgment has come on all the cities of Moab, far and near.

dag: Ka n yura maa daa zaŋ o nuu daai dunoli, ka n suhu dii kpe o ni.
en: My love put his hand in through the latch hole, and my body ached for him.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa yi n-chaŋ labina ti yɛl o dana maa, N niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka palo na kul beni.
en: Soon the servant said, Your order has been carried out, sir, but there is room for more.

dag: ka Naawuni daa sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ Hagirinim mini bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu maa zaa. Dama bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni yɛda ka suh o ni o sɔŋ ba tɔb maa ni.
en: The men from the tribes of Manasseh, Reuben, and Gad prayed to God during the war. They asked God to help them because they trusted him, so God helped them. He allowed them to defeat the Hagrites and those who were with the Hagrites.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bo bumbila m-ba kaman di ni daa sab shɛm la. Di sabiya:.
en: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, just as it is written.

dag: Amaa a ni bi niŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm maa yɛda zuɣu, a ni leei birigu ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa faashee n yɛligu ŋɔ zaa ti niŋ pali; di mi ti kul yɛn niŋla pali saha shɛli Naawuni ni zal li maa.
en: Now, listen! You will not be able to talk until the day when these things happen. You will lose your speech because you did not believe what I told you. But everything I said will really happen.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka bɔ n-lee bala.
en: The people were all amazed and confused. They asked each other, What is happening.

dag: Hɔdia so mi ni Bani ni Bɛninu.
en: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.

dag: n-nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ka di nyom nyɛ din tiɣir o nini.
en: Then turn the entire ram into smoke by burning it on the altar. It is an entirely burned offering for the LORD, a soothing smell, a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi nyaŋ ba, di saha yin kumiya bɛ zaa. Di ti lɔnya ba alikauli, yi mi di ti zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: once the LORD your God lays them before you, you must strike them down, placing them under the ban. Dont make any covenants with them, and dont be merciful to them.

dag: Miriya ka yi wum Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya shɛm maa; dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Timmiya sandaani niŋ ma, ka yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi diri yimaŋmaŋ wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi wala, ka nyuri yimaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi kom.
en: Dont listen to Hezekiah! This is what the king of Assyria says: Come out here and show me that you want peace. Then you will all be free to have grapes from your own vines, figs from your own trees, and water from your own well.

dag: Amaa di lee bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛl la: Ti Duuma Naawuni, ninsal lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhir o yɛla bee daadam bia lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be o ni?.
en: It is written some place in the Scriptures, Why are people so important to you? Why do you even think about them? Why do you care about the son of man ? Is he so important?.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal n ni daa kul zaŋ ba tahi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa yoli, mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha biɛla shɛli bɛ ni daa be tinsi maa ni maa.
en: Now tell your fellow exiles what I am saying. I am the one who sent them to live in far-off nations and scattered them in other countries. Yet, for the time being I will be present with them in the lands where they have gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tim anabinim mini yɛnnima ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yi sanna, ka yi ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka kpahi bɛ shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu, ka fiɛb bɛ shɛb mi yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka niŋ ba alaka tiŋ ni zaŋ ti kpa tiŋ ni.
en: And so I tell you that I will send you prophets and wise men and teachers; you will kill some of them, crucify others, and whip others in the synagogues and chase them from town to town.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, Daadam Bia mini malaika kasinim yi ti labina o Ba jilima ni, o gba ni ti zo vi ni o zaŋ dilan pah o niriba ni.
en: People today are so sinful. They have not been faithful to God. As you live among them, dont be ashamed of me and my teaching. If that happens, I will be ashamed of you when I come with the glory of my Father and the holy angels.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya o ka bɛ jɛm o; amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb biɛhim o.
en: On the mountain the followers saw Jesus. They worshiped him. But some of the followers did not believe that it was really Jesus.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Pool ka yɛli ni bɛ lom o zoligɔnima ayi; di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔhi ni o baŋ Pool ni nyɛ so min o ni tum shɛli.
en: The commander went over to Paul, arrested him, and ordered him to be bound with two chains. Then he asked, Who is this man, and what has he done.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nira, ka nyɛ namɔɣili be nayil la daa wum ni bɛ zaŋ Jɛrimia ti niŋ kɔbiliga maa puuni. Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka naa ʒi Bɛnjamin dunɔdal la gbini.
en: Ebedmelech from Ethiopia was an official at the palace, and he heard what they had done to me. So he went to speak with King Zedekiah, who was holding court at Benjamin Gate.

dag: Nyini n-galisi, ka su yiko mini jilima ni nasara ni nam dariza zaa, dama nyini n-su binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa ni tiŋa. Yawɛ, nyini n-nya duhibu gari sokam zaa.
en: Greatness, power, glory, victory, and honor belong to you, because everything in heaven and on earth belongs to you! The kingdom belongs to you, Lord ! You are the head, the Ruler over everything.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka wum n dimnim ni yɛri shɛm.
en: So I prayed, Lord , hear what I am saying and listen to what my enemies are saying about me.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin daa kpi.
en: So the LORD sent a plague throughout Israel, and seventy thousand Israelites fell dead.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanim ni daa me birininim gili fɔntin shɛŋa zaa n-tuhi deei li.
en: In the fourteenth year of the reign of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib, the emperor of Assyria, attacked the fortified cities of Judah and conquered them.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Hazaɛl, Bom pini n-chaŋ ti puhi Naawuni nir maa, ka chɛ ka o bɔhi Yawɛ nya n ni kpaŋ m barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: he said to Hazael, one of his officials, Take a gift to the prophet and ask him to consult the Lord to find out whether or not I am going to get well.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba laɣim to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: Early the next morning all the chief priests and the nation's leaders met and decided that Jesus should be put to death.

dag: Ka n dan maa paɣ Zara dɔɣi bidibiga ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; ka n dan maa zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ti o bia maa.
en: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.

dag: Sintani ni daa zahim Yisa zahimbu balibu kam ŋɔ zaa naai ka o daa na chɛ o, ka lan bɔri so shɛli yaha.
en: After the devil had finished testing Jesus in every way possible, he left him for a while.

dag: Di saha maa ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Mirimiya ma na ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-mir o. Ka o daa mali me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli bɛ ni daa daai luhi la zali.
en: Then Elijah said to all the people, Come here! All the people closed in, and he repaired the LORDs altar that had been damaged.

dag: Izraɛlnima, dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti doli Yufretiiz Mɔɣili zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tintariga n-laɣim ya yinoyino kaman bɛ ni yihiri chi ka chɛri wurigu shɛm la.
en: On that day, the LORD will beat grain from the channel of the Euphrates up to the Valley of Egypt. You will be collected, Israelites, one by one.

dag: yɛra, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ni ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: Listen, he told them, we are going up to Jerusalem where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law. They will condemn him to death and then hand him over to the Gentiles.

dag: ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: We spent many years wandering around outside the hill country of Seir.

dag: N niŋdi lala ni di chɛ ka bɛ malila suhukpeeni ka laɣim zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili taba yurilim puuni, ka lan mali yɛlimaŋli baŋsim din tahiri tahima zaa din ŋmani azichi na. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ baŋ Naawuni ashili din nyɛ Masia maŋmaŋ la.
en: My goal is that their hearts would be encouraged and united together in love so that they might have all the riches of assurance that come with understanding, so that they might have the knowledge of the secret plan of God, namely Christ.

dag: dama o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so a sɔŋsim zuɣu. Amaa a yi tum birigi, nyin zom dabiɛm, dama o bi sula fukumsi maa yoli; o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋ ŋun Naawuni suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛn tum birigi tibili.
en: because they are God's servants working for your own good. But if you do evil, then be afraid of them, because their power to punish is real. They are God's servants and carry out God's punishment on those who do evil.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti ka a sanna ka bi mali wuhibu ŋɔ na, nyin di saɣi ka o kpe a yiŋa; a mi di puhi lala nira.
en: Whoever comes to you who does not affirm this teaching should neither be received nor welcomed into your home.

dag: Ka m mini niriba biɛla bɛn daa be n sani daa ti yiɣisi yuŋ. N daa bi yɛli so n Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli niŋ n suhu ni ni n tum ti Jɛrusalɛm. Biŋkɔb so daa ka n sani m-pahi n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so la.
en: I set out at night, taking only a few people with me. I didnt tell anyone what my God was prompting me to do for Jerusalem, and the only animal I took was the one I rode.

dag: Kamina pumpɔŋɔ nti chɛ ka a mini n dan Asiria naa puli. N ni ti a yuri tusaayi, a yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni ba ba.
en: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people. He will give you , horses, if you have enough troops to ride them.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, n ni niŋ o marisa n-zaŋ o ka tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti tɔɣis o yurilim yɛtɔɣa.
en: So I, the Lord, will speak romantic words to her. I will lead her into the desert and speak tender words.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zɔri ni bɛ ti du tampima, ka zaŋ kur tibisa anahi din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kɔtiŋa di nyaaŋa polo, ka kari bɛ buɣa ka jiɣiri biɛɣu neebu zuɣu.
en: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gbaai Yisa maa zaŋ o tahi Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la yiŋa; nimaani ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to the house of Caiaphas, the High Priest, where the teachers of the Law and the elders had gathered together.

dag: Amaa di ku yuui ka yɛla ayi ŋɔ zaa paag a dahin yini puuni. A baɣibuɣibo min a tima la zaa yoli, a ni bahi kɔŋ yidana mini bihi.
en: These two things will happen to you: First, you will lose your children and then your husband. And none of your magic spells will help you.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari m-mali dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Make acacia-wood boards to stand upright as a frame for the dwelling.

dag: Izraɛl naa ni daa nya ba, o daa bɔhila Ilaisha, M ba, n kum ba? N kum ba.
en: The king of Israel saw the Aramean army and said to Elisha, My father, should I kill them? Should I kill them.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, ŋmaligimiya lab yi ni yi man so nyaaŋa pam la sanna.
en: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be! M paɣiri ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ maa! N kul ni tibigiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim maa.
en: You are the living Lord ! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.

dag: Ŋuna n-fa ti zibisim yiko ni bahi, ka zaŋ ti ni alaafee nti kpɛhi o Biyurigu la nam ni.
en: God made us free from the power of darkness. And he brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son.

dag: N daa gbihimi, amaa ka n suhu lee ne. Wumma, n yura n-kpahiri n dunoli maa. N yura ni n tizɔpaɣa, yoomi ka n kpɛna. N ŋmani ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi. Maligim lumi mahigi n zuɣu, ka yuŋ paɣili kpe m-mahigi n zabiri.
en: While I slept, my heart was awake. I dreamed my lover knocked at the door. Let me come in, my darling, my sweetheart, my dove. My head is wet with dew, and my hair is damp from the mist.

dag: Yi ni daa ŋme n-nyaŋ zuliya pam ka di bɛ nɛma la zuɣu, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim gba ni ti ŋmɛn ya ka di yi nɛma, yi ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb mini yi ni daa chɛ ka damli shɛli dam dunia ni fɔntinsi ni n-tabili bɛnkam zaa be di ni la zuɣu.
en: You have plundered the people of many nations, but now those who have survived will plunder you because of the murders you have committed and because of your violence against the people of the world and its cities.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa deei baptaizibu, ka Yisa gba daa deei baptaizibu ka suhiri Naawuni; di saha maa ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi.
en: When everyone was being baptized, Jesus also was baptized. While he was praying, heaven was opened.
