dag: Di saha ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa yiɣisi zani suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ niriba maa ni, ka Naawuni daa be alizanda ni o biɛhigu shee din nyɛ kasi la ka deei bɛ suhigu maa.
en: Then the levitical priests blessed the people, and their voice was heard when their prayer reached Gods holy dwelling in heaven.

dag: Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri niŋ Amnɔn kaman Absalom ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ o shɛm maa. Di saha ka nabihi maa zaa daa dii yiɣisi ba bɛ buntaansi zo.
en: Absalom's servants killed Amnon, just as Absalom had told them. The rest of the king's sons quickly rode away on their mules to escape from Absalom.

dag: Yi mi ni Stɛfanas yiŋnima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui niŋ Yisa yɛda Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu tuma ni. M mabihi, n suhiri ya.
en: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first believers in Achaia. They have given themselves to the service of Gods people. I ask you, brothers and sisters.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bo tuma zuɣulaannim ti ba ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma hal ka bɛ shia ti yi bɛmaŋ ni, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ me Firawuna nɛma zaashee fɔntinsi ti o Pitom mini Ramɛsis.
en: The Egyptians put slave bosses in charge of the people of Israel and tried to wear them down with hard work. Those bosses forced them to build the cities of Pithom and Rameses, where the king could store his supplies.

dag: A mini Judanim ni Izraɛlnim daa niŋdila daabiligu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi alikama din yi Minnɛt na mini za ni shiri ni kpam ni ti shɛli din niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ka di bi poori la na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: The people in Judah and Israel traded with you. They paid for the things you sold with the wheat, olives, early figs, honey, oil, and balm.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ sariakarita, yiɣisima. Tim karimbaannim din simdi ba!.
en: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhi ma ka n niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ti ba, dina n-nyɛ n chɛ ka bɛ daadambiɛligu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: The LORD God proclaims: I will also allow the house of Israel to ask me to do this for them: that I increase them like a human flock.

dag: n-nya tarimba, ka n daa kpahim bipola n-nya nachimbil so ŋun ka yɛm bɛ ni.
en: and I saw many inexperienced young men, but noticed one foolish fellow in particular.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Balaam, Di doli ba chaŋ, a mi miri ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla alibarika ni be shɛb ni.
en: But God replied, Don't go with Balak's messengers. I have blessed those people who have come from Egypt, so don't curse them.

dag: ka bɛ ni yino daa kani ka chɛ ma, ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ bini n-dari chɛrisichɛris o; ka m bi lan nya o hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: I let one son go away, and he was killed by a wild animal. And I havent seen him since.

dag: Binshɛɣukam puuni n wuhi ya ni sokam moom o nini n-tum lala sɔŋ bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la, ka teeya ti Duuma Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm la, Dina n-nyɛ ni Ŋun tiri mal alibarika gari ŋun deera. .
en: In everything I have shown you that, by working hard, we must help the weak. In this way we remember the Lord Jesus words: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya Jaza. Ka bɛ daa tuhi fa di tiŋkpansi, ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Moses sent some men to look at the town of Jazer. Then the Israelites captured that town and the small towns that were around it. They forced the Amorites who were living there to leave.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka sanzali zani, ka siɣili saa bi lan mira. Amaa ka yi nini kul moola zina niŋbu zuɣu, ka vi bi mali ya.
en: Thats why the showers have failed and the spring rains have ceased. Still you act like a brazen prostitute who refuses to blush.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina, ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: He tore open the sky and came down! He stood on a thick, dark cloud.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ dimnim maa pam hal ti naai, ka bi lan nyari so, dama bɛ ni shɛb daa zomi ti kpe bɛ tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gil ni.
en: Joshua and the men of Israel slaughtered them, although some managed to find safety inside their city walls and were not killed.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhuyiɣisili puuni ka n yɛn chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒe, ka chɛ ka sa titali mi n sujee puuni, ka sakuɣ kara luna n suhuyiɣisili maa ni saɣim li.
en: Now this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my anger I will send a strong wind, pouring rain, and hailstones to destroy the wall.

dag: Tɔbu lu di yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn be sunsuuni zaa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei paɣiba. Tɔbu lu bɛ daazichi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di li.
en: A sword against its horses and chariots, and the mercenaries in its midst so that they lose courage. A sword against its treasures so that they are looted.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa leeg alahichi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni; ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka di simdi ni bɛ yaag o daŋ maa n-kpihim di birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: This is the sin that caused the ruin and destruction of his kingdom.

dag: Ziɔnnim teei bɛ nuhi, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni maai bɛ suhuri. Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu ni o ʒiʒiinitaba ni ti leeg o dimnima. Jɛrusalɛm leela binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini bɛ sani.
en: Zion spreads out her hands; she has no comforter. The LORD commanded Jacobs enemies to surround him. Jerusalem is just a piece of garbage to them.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam Balaam ni daa chani maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ ti zani sol ni n-gu o soli. Balaam daa barila buŋa, ka o tumtumdiba ayi be o sani.
en: Then God became angry because he went. So while he was riding on his donkey accompanied by his two servants, the LORDs messenger stood in the road as his adversary.

dag: Bɛ yi kana ti kaai ma, bɛ tɛhirila yɛl biɛri yɛla. Bɛ yi lo yɛtɔɣ biɛri ŋɔ nia bɛ suhuri ni naai, bɛ yirimi chaŋ ti zaŋ li moli gili.
en: Those who come to see me are not sincere; they gather bad news about me and then go out and tell it everywhere.

dag: Musa ni daa piri tiŋgbani maa tari Mɔab bɔpiɛligu la ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la shɛm m-bala.
en: Moses gave all this land to these tribes. He did this while the people were camped on the plains of Moab. This was across the Jordan River, east of Jericho.

dag: Naa maa ni ti lihi ʒiɛm o yaannim wuna, ka lihi ʒiɛm paɣiba ni yuri wun shɛŋa gba. Hal o baɣa ti ku be wuni kam ni, dama o ni ti tɛhi ni ŋuna n-gari di zaa.
en: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi shihi yaɣiri laa kam, bɛn ŋmam li, ka di yi nyɛ dari bini, bɛn paɣimi li kom.
en: Any pottery jar that the one with the emission touches must be broken, and any wooden tool must be rinsed with water.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba maa daa kana, ka Lɛvinim daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: When all the leaders had gathered, then the Levites lifted the Covenant Box.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛli, Di ku niŋ lala. Nyin dee kul deemila Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni zaŋ yɛr a ŋɔ, ka di niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani, ka bɛ ku ku a.
en: I said, You will not be handed over to them. I beg you to obey the Lord 's message; then all will go well with you, and your life will be spared.

dag: Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Shɛbɛr mini Tirihana.
en: Caleb had another concubine, Maacah, who bore him two sons, Sheber and Tirhanah.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: And there was a voice from heaven: You are my Son, whom I dearly love; in you I find happiness.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣ a yuli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm ŋɔ. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Let them thank your great and awesome name. He is holy!.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni bee n daŋ lee nyɛ banima, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali n ni ʒe zaashe shɛl ni ŋɔ?.
en: Then King David went and sat in the LORDs presence. He asked: Who am I, LORD God, and of what significance is my family that you have brought me this far?.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni nti kpihim Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima bee anabinim yɛligu; m bi kamina ni nti kpihim di shɛli, amaa n kamina ni n ti chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: Dont think that I have come to destroy the Law of Moses or the teaching of the prophets. I have come not to destroy their teachings but to give full meaning to them.

dag: Ka Tama daa niŋ tampiligim buɣ o zuɣu ka darigi cheeg o ni daa ye saalo shɛli maa, ka kah o nuhi pa o zuɣu ni n-kuhiri pampam chana.
en: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the long-sleeved robe she was wearing. She put her hand on her head and walked away, crying as she went.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabinim mini wuntizɔriba pam suhuri daa yɛmi ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bi nya li; ka bɛ suhuri daa lan ye ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka daa bi wum li.
en: I can assure you, many prophets and godly people wanted to see what you now see. But they did not see it. And many prophets and godly people wanted to hear what you now hear. But they did not hear it.

dag: Ka Jɔash kpambaliba ayi daa ti yi o nyaaŋa n-ku o Millo yil shɛli din daa ʒe Silla soli zuɣu la puuni.
en: Joashs officers made plans against him. They killed Joash at the house of Millo on the road that goes down to Silla.

dag: N ni daa lɔnya alikauli shɛli ni ʒim yihibu sara maligu shɛhira la zuɣu, n ni ti yi niriba bɛn be dabitim ni la yolisim. N ni yihi ba dabitim kɔbil kuŋ la ni.
en: Jerusalem, we used blood to seal your agreement, so I am setting your people free from that empty hole in the ground.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ sanna ti di bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini biŋkpam la zaa sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu; niriba maa zaa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ tahi ka lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire, and it consumed the burnt offering and the fat parts on the altar. When the people saw it, they all shouted and bowed down with their faces to the ground.

dag: Ka gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa din be kasi zaa la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti kana.
en: The Jewish governor told them that they could not eat the food offered to God until there was a priest who could use the Urim and Thummim.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila lala ni bɛ zahim o nya o taali ka fiɣis o. Ka Yisa daa silim n-zaŋ o nubila sabiri tiŋa.
en: They were saying this to trick Jesus. They wanted to catch him saying something wrong so that they could have a charge against him. But Jesus stooped down and started writing on the ground with his finger.

dag: dama n wum a ni niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda shɛm min a ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba shɛm la yɛla.
en: because Ive heard of your love and faithfulness, which you have both for the Lord Jesus and for all Gods people.

dag: Yihim ma n suhuyubu alahichi tumbu ni; ka di chɛ ka di su ma. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n ku mali galimi, ka yi taali din galisi pam ni.
en: and save your servant from willful sins. Dont let them rule me. Then Ill be completely blameless; Ill be innocent of great wrongdoing.

dag: N dimnim maa kul bɔrila soli dabisili kam ni bɛ saɣim m bukaata; bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla bɛ loya ni bɛ niŋ ma la zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: My enemies make trouble for me all day long; they are always thinking up some way to hurt me!.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti garigi yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ alikauli, ka jɛmdila wun shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: Then they will answer that it is because you have abandoned your covenant with me, your God, and have worshiped and served other gods.

dag: N kul je ba la jɛri maŋli; n zaŋ ba leela n dimnima.
en: I hate them with a total hatred; I regard them as my enemies.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Daniɛl la, A ni tooi yɛli ma zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: The king asked Daniel, Can you tell me my dream and what it means.

dag: Naa, di gbinni m-bala. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm m-bala.
en: This, then, is what it means, Your Majesty, and this is what the Supreme God has declared will happen to you.

dag: Nyama, bɛ kahi kuɣa duhi n-teei gili tiŋ maa ni bɛ ŋme n-deei li. Ka tɔb maa mini kum ni alɔbo zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ Kalidianim bɛn tuhiri ni bɛ deei li maa nuu ni. A ni daa yɛli shɛm la n-niŋ pali, ka amaŋmaŋ dii nya li maa.
en: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni jɛmbu ka buchi. Ka o zaligunim dolibu bee ti yi be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani kaman ti kumdila kuli la, di daanfaani nyɛ ti dini?.
en: You said, It is useless to worship God. We did what the Lord All-Powerful told us, but we didnt gain anything. We cried like people at a funeral to show we were sorry for our sins, but it didnt help.

dag: A ni ti leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi mini bɛ ni turi so, ka di leei saɣisigu mini dabiɛm zuliya shɛb bɛn gil a la sani saha shɛlikam, ka darigi a tibili pam. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People around you will make fun of you, but you will also be a lesson for them. They will see that I was angry and punished you. I was very angry and I warned you. I, the Lord , told you what I would do.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa ŋme tɔbuchiriga bah o zuɣu ka o daa lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim yih o na n-vo o tahi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When the nations heard about him, they caught him in their trap and carried him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku labi n sanna maa zuɣu, bɛ ni labi Ijipti, ka Asiria naa ti leei bɛ naa.
en: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Juda zuliya piligu shee daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Zin mɔɣu ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ɛdom tintariga.
en: The clans of the Judah tribe were given land that went south along the border of Edom, and at its farthest point south it even reached the Zin Desert.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli pam daa be Jɛrusalɛm; dama Naa Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman nyaaŋa, bɛ daa bi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu maa tatabo Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.

dag: Jona ni daa be ziŋ karili maa puuni saha shɛli maa, ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli.
en: From deep inside the fish Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti di yi tuma nyɔri, ka di yi nia biɛri tiɣi.
en: Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani m-pah o zuɣu.
en: And so all the nations of the world will know that the Lord alone is God—there is no other.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋa bee o nahu ni lu n-do sol ni ka a baɣa kani, di simdi ni a sɔŋ yiɣis o zali.
en: If your neighbors donkey or ox has fallen down on the road, you must not ignore it. You must help your neighbor lift it up again.

dag: Aai! N ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa chɛfirinim ni zaŋdi maani maligu, bɛ zaŋdi li maanila alizin biɛri, pa ni Naawuni. Ka m mi bi bɔri ni yi mini alizin biɛri yɛla kpɛri tab ni.
en: No! What I am saying is that what is sacrificed on pagan altars is offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be partners with demons.

dag: N kul bela zibisim ni chana ka wuntaŋ kani; ka n ʒe kpamba laɣiŋgu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: I walk in the dark, lacking sunshine; I rise in the assembly and cry out.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa zaɣisi ka yɛl o dan paɣ maa, Nyama, n ni be n dan sani ŋɔ, o baɣa lan ka shɛl ni yil ŋɔ. O zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam niŋla n nuu ni.
en: But Joseph refused. He said, My master trusts me with everything in his house. He has given me responsibility for everything here.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim ka tarili bee fali bɛ mabihi maa sani. Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm maa.
en: That is why the tribe of Levi received no land as the other tribes did; what they received was the privilege of being the Lord 's priests, as the Lord your God promised.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a jilima kul be sahakam. Yawɛ, chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a tuma zuɣu.
en: May the Lord s glory continue forever! May the Lord enjoy what he made.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi saha gol so bɛ ni booni Nisan la puuni, Naa wain nyubu saha ni daa ti paai, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ti o. N daa na ʒi m-mali suhugarigu o tooni.
en: One day four months later, when Emperor Artaxerxes was dining, I took the wine to him. He had never seen me look sad before.

dag: Dama m mali yɛtɔɣa pam, ka n ku chɛ li tɔɣisibu.
en: for Im full of words. The spirit in my belly compels me.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli. N ni yɛli ni yi yɛla be n suhu ni la nyɛla din yi Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ suhu ni na.
en: God knows that I want very much to see you. I love all of you with the love of Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chani kpari Sɔdom polo, amaa ka Ibrahimma na kul ʒe Yawɛ tooni.
en: The men turned away and walked toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing in front of the LORD.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni bɛ ku gbilisi tibili wum bee n-deei n wuhibu maa.
en: Their ancestors did not listen to me or pay any attention. Instead, they became stubborn; they would not obey me or learn from me.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, a ni lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ka ti di wahala shɛŋa di ni bi simdi ni ti di?.
en: Lord , will these things always keep you from helping? Will you continue to say nothing? Will you punish us forever?.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: Jesus said to them, Havent you ever read in the scriptures, The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. The Lord has done this, and its amazing in our eyes?.

dag: Naa daa malila ŋariŋ shɛŋa din yi Tarishish na m-pahi Hiram ŋarima zuɣu ka di be teeku ni, ka nyɛ din zɔri pam. Ka ŋarima din daa yi Tarishish na maa daa yi ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: The king also had many cargo ships that he sent out to trade things with other countries. These were Hirams ships. Every three years the ships would come back with a new load of gold, silver, ivory, and apes and baboons.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yihi kuɣa maa, ka kaɣisi tari maa ka lan ta li, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa lan puhi yili maa ni yaha.
en: If the mildew breaks out again in the house after the stones have been removed and the house has been scraped and plastered.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ka nir chaŋchaŋ ti lan ŋmaligi gbamda. Ŋunkam niŋdi lala bi simdi Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Jesus said to him, No one who puts a hand on the plow and looks back is fit for Gods kingdom.

dag: Yisa daa bi be kaman o wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naɣ yɛlila Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda.
en: Jesus heard what they said, and he said to Jairus, Don't worry. Just have faith.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, ŋun pah ata n-daa nyɛ Jahaziɛl, ŋun pah anahi n-daa nyɛ Jɛkamiam.
en: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ ba niŋ Yisifu nuu ni ka o sɔŋdi ba. Ka bɛ daa be duu maa ni n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: They spent a long time in prison, and the captain assigned Joseph as their servant.

dag: Amaa yi mali kali din ti ma soli ni n yihi dansarika yino so yi ni bɔri bahi Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha; dinzuɣu yi bɔri ni n yihi Yɛhudianim Naa maa bahi.
en: But it is one of your customs for me to free one prisoner to you at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to free this king of the Jews.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika la bɛ zuɣu; a ni deei n noli maa zuɣu.
en: All the nations of the earth will be blessed because of your descendants, because you obeyed me.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: These poles were also made of acacia wood and covered with gold.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi nimaani gariti tooni, ka dɔbba ayi bɛn nyɛ zoomba dol o n-kuhiri pampam yɛra, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: Jesus left that place, and as he walked along, two blind men started following him. Have mercy on us, Son of David! they shouted.

dag: Di saha ka Dilaila daa bɔhi Samsin, Wula ka a yɛri ni a yuri ma ka a suhu ka n ni? Siɣimsiɣim buta zaa ka a boli ma jɛrigu, ka bi saɣi yɛli ma a kpiɔŋ din galisi pam maa ni be a luɣ shɛli.
en: So she said to him, How can you say you love me, when you don't mean it? You've made a fool of me three times, and you still haven't told me what makes you so strong.

dag: n wahala ŋɔ zaa lan chɛmi ka dabiɛm mali ma; dama m mi ni a ku yɛli ni n ka taali.
en: Im still afraid of all my suffering; I know that you wont declare me innocent.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, m ba Sool nuu ku shih a. Nyini nti yɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka m mi nyɛ wulana. M ba Sool gba mi lala.
en: Jonathan said to him, Dont be afraid! My father Sauls hand wont touch you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be your second in command. Even my father Saul knows this.

dag: Izar bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Nɛfɛg ni Zikiri.
en: Izhars sons were Korah, Nepheg, and Zicri.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum li, ka kari a daba saria, ka zaŋ taali maa galimi ʒili bɛn tum taali maa, ka bahi bɛn ka taali, ka ti ba laara bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: O Lord , listen in heaven and judge your servants. Punish the guilty ones as they deserve and acquit the innocent.

dag: Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia ŋɔ kpɛmmi ʒiɛya, ka kul ku vuui. O ni doli zaligu soli kari niriba saria.
en: Tell the nations that the Lord is King! The world stands firm and cannot be moved. He will judge all people fairly.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa nti ti Izraɛl naa. O ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yi paag a, nyin baŋmi ni mani n-chɛ ka Naaman ŋun nyɛ n tumtumda ŋɔ ka a sanna ni a ti tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: He also carried the letter to the king of Israel. It said, I am sending my servant Naaman to you. Would you cure him of his leprosy.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n wuntia ŋɔ, n yi suh a, nyin garigim ma. N daa be muɣisigu ni ka a ti ma faako. Niŋm ma nirilim ka deei n suhigu.
en: Answer me when I pray, O God, my defender! When I was in trouble, you helped me. Be kind to me now and hear my prayer.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia la daa mali suhukpeeni pam Kabiziil niriba ni. O daa tum tuun kara pam. Ŋuna n-daa ku Mɔabnim tɔbutuhiri biinsi ayi la, ŋuna n-daa lan siɣi bɔɣili ni ti ku gbuɣinli dahin shɛli sakuɣa ni daa lu la.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.

dag: Naawuni, a wum n ni lo alikauli shɛŋa la, ka pun ti ma pin shɛli a ni zaŋdi tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a yuli sizuura la.
en: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.

dag: dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. Nyini n-nyɛ binwɔɣinli shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari a dimnima.
en: because you have been my refuge, a tower of strength in the face of the enemy.

dag: N kɔre daa bi kpe yi ni so daanzinfa bee salima bee situra ni.
en: I have never wanted anyone's money or clothes.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam ni o kpiɔŋ tuma zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jehoahazs deeds, all that he accomplished, and all his powerful acts, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Ɛhab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Omri died and was buried in Samaria. His son Ahab became the new king after him.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa laɣim dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa n-zali luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Hiburuli ni Aamagɛdɔn la.
en: The spirits gathered them at the place that is called in Hebrew, Harmagedon.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni tia maa gbini gbihi. Ka malaika daa shih o ka yɛl o, Yiɣisim di bindirigu.
en: He lay down under the tree and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel touched him and said, Wake up and eat.

dag: M bilim ni n daa bela mmaŋmaŋ tindɔɣirili ni mini Jɛrusalɛm; ka di saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ Yɛhudianim zaa mi m bebu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: All the Jews know about my whole life. They know the way I lived from the beginning in my own country and later in Jerusalem.

dag: Gol maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Izraɛlnim daa laɣimna ti lo noli, ka pili buri ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.

dag: Ti ni tooi paɣi Naawuni yi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ. Ti paɣir o ti ni mali suhupiɛl shɛli yi zuɣu ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: Now we can give thanks to our God for you. We thank him for the joy we have in his presence because of you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya niriba la.
en: The other people from the Kohathite family groups were given towns that were in the areas that belonged to the tribe of Ephraim. They got these towns:.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ yiko min o jilima nyɛla din yi katiŋ kanna. O suhuyiɣisili shihirili nyɛla nyɔhi ni buɣim; ka o nol ni yɛtɔɣa ŋmani buɣim din dira.
en: The Lord 's power and glory can be seen in the distance. Fire and smoke show his anger. He speaks, and his words burn like fire.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ yiɣisi niriba mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba suhuri, ka bɛ daa kabina nti gbaai Stiivin tahi jintɔriba sani.
en: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the legal experts. They caught Stephen, dragged him away, and brought him before the Jerusalem Council.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, N ni jɛmdi Yawɛ so ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di yi di pala n ni ti Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat jilima zuɣu, n naan ku ŋmaligi lih a bee nti nya a.
en: Elisha said, I swear by the life of the LORD of heavenly forces, the one I stand before and serve, if I didnt care about Judahs King Jehoshaphat, I wouldnt notice you or even look at you!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nabia la leei Sulemaana dima n-yiɣisi lu o zuɣu.
en: So the LORD raised up an opponent for Solomon: Hadad the Edomite from the royal line of Edom.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi nɔzaɣisibo mini yi daalahichi tumbu zuɣu.
en: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi ku mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛli n-tum alahichi. Di maliya li ŋmahindi bin lɔɣu bee bin nyaŋ.
en: Dont ruin everything and make an idol for yourself: a form of any image, any likeness—male or female.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ninivenim daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda ka yɛli ni sokam lom noli, ka wɔɣira zaŋ tabili tarimba zaa daa so buri.
en: And the people of Nineveh believed God. They proclaimed a fast and put on mourning clothes, from the greatest of them to the least significant.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Hal man bi mi do so yi ni yɛri maa gba.
en: This time Peter began to curse and swear, I don't even know the man you're talking about.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni mini di nyaaŋa binshɛŋa bɛ ni mali pindi li tuma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su Pateesa shɛli din yili di dunol ni.
en: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance.

dag: Ka bɛ shini. Ka Yisa daa chɛ ka doo maa kpaŋ, ka bah o ka o lab kul o yiŋa.
en: But they would not answer his question. So he took the man and healed him. Then he sent the man away.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa ŋun pahi ayi ka nyɛ maligumaana leebu piɛlaa la na. Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then Moses brought the other ram. This ram was used for appointing Aaron and his sons to become priests. Aaron and his sons put their hands on the rams head.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ma na, ka n ŋubi m bia mɔɣu ni nimdi, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni. Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li ti o ka o di, ka o zaŋ wain pah o ka o nyu.
en: Then Isaac said, Bring me the food. I will eat it and bless you. So Jacob gave him the food, and he ate it. Then Jacob gave him some wine, and he drank it.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba la gba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra.
en: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the Law and the elders made fun of him:.

dag: Yawɛ, a vihi ma m-baŋ ma zaa.
en: LORD, you have examined me. You know me.

dag: Dama n dimnim kul tɔɣisirila n yɛla, ka bɛn puɣisiri ni bɛ ku ma laɣindi gbaari saawara.
en: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, bɛ nyarila vuhim bɛ kum maa puuni.
en: Those who live good lives find peace and rest in death.

dag: Ka banima n-daa lee ku Naawuni suli yuun pihinahi puuni la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa tum alahichi ka kpi n-do yɔɣu ni la?.
en: Who were the people that made God angry for years? Weren't they the ones that sinned and died in the desert?.

dag: Kamiya n sanna nti zaŋ n naɣikɔra dapua ye n-zaŋ yimaŋ tabili ma m-bɔhim biɛhigu n sani ka nya vuhim; dama n nyɛla tarima zaa.
en: Put on my yoke, and learn from me. Im gentle and humble. And you will find rest for yourselves.

dag: ka o bɛhi nyɛ kuriti, ka o napɔnvari shɛli polo nyɛ kuriti, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri.
en: The lower part of the legs was made from iron. Its feet were made partly of iron and partly of clay.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya bɛ mini Bɛnjamin, o daa yɛlila o yiŋ tumtumda, Zaŋm niriba maa kuli yiŋa, ka gbaai biŋkɔbigu kɔrigi m-mal o duɣi bindirigu, dama m mini niriba maa n-yɛn laɣim di wuntaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to his servant, Bring these men into my house. Kill an animal and cook it. They will eat with me at noon today.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa yɛli Jɛfita, Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti ka a sanna pumpɔŋɔ maa. Ti bɔrimi ni a kana ti pahi ti zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka a leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: The elders from Gilead said to Jephthah, That is the reason we have come to you now. Please come with us and fight against the Ammonites. You will be the commander over all the people living in Gilead.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa garigi yɛl o, Pa tuun sun shɛli zuɣu ka ti yɛn lab a kuɣa maa, amaa a ni mɔri Naawuni la zuɣu, dama a nyɛla daadam, amaa ka zaŋ amaŋ leei Naawuni.
en: The Jewish opposition answered, We dont stone you for a good work but for insulting God. You are human, yet you make yourself out to be God.

dag: ni Jɛuz ni Sakia ni Mirima. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ o bidibisi ka daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba.
en: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. His sons all became heads of families.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni yɛn ti a bi shɛba, ka paɣisarili ŋɔ dɔɣi ba ti a ni nyɛla bɛn ni ti chɛ ka a zuliya bemi kaman Pɛrɛz, Tama ni dɔɣ so ti Juda la.
en: May the children that the Lord will give you by this young woman make your family like the family of Perez, the son of Judah and Tamar.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa mɔni Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ n-daa siɣi di zuɣu na ni buɣim, ka di nyɔhi maa daa kpuɣi du kaman tampuli zuɣu nyɔhi la, ka zoli maa zaa daa dam pam.
en: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke. Smoke rose off the mountain like smoke from a furnace. This happened because the Lord came down to the mountain in fire. Also the whole mountain began to shake.

dag: M mabihi, di benya kaman bihi la yi tɛha ni, amaa benyami kaman bihi la zaŋ chaŋ din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu polo, ka lee bi dɔbba yi tɛha ni.
en: Do not be like children in your thinking, my friends; be children so far as evil is concerned, but be grown up in your thinking.

dag: Bipuɣiŋga, gbilisim a tibili wum; tamm a niriba min a ba yiŋ yɛla.
en: Bride of the king, listen to what I say— forget your people and your relatives.

dag: Lala zuɣu cheechi nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ cheechi zuɣu maa niŋgbuŋ; ka ŋun Masia nyɛ binshɛɣukam ni pali so ni, ka o mi nyɛ ŋun pali binshɛɣukam ni mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: The church is Christ's body, the completion of him who himself completes all things everywhere.

dag: N ni gbilisi tibili labila yɛtɔɣ ŋaha polo, ka ŋme mɔɣilo n-kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: I will turn my attention to proverbs and explain their meaning as I play the harp.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila nudirigu polo n-chaŋ gili hal ti paai nuzaa polo n-kul chani gindi hal ti paai di piligu shee yaha.
en: The wind blows south, the wind blows north—round and round and back again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani, ka yɛdaniŋdiba maa daa ti chɛbisi ba ni suhupiɛlli ka bɛ lab bɛn daa tim ba na maa sani. .
en: After Judas and Silas stayed there for a while, they left. They received a blessing of peace from the believers. Then they went back to those who had sent them.

dag: N zɔsimnim zaa zaŋ ma mi bahi, ka n ni daa yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la zaŋ ma bahi.
en: All my closest friends despise me; the ones I have loved turn against me.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Rom ka bɛ chɛ ka Pool bo o dahalali duu beni, ka bɛ daa bo tɔbbi so nti zali nimaani ka o gul o.
en: When we came to Rome, Paul was allowed to live alone. But a soldier stayed with him to guard him.

dag: Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa soya ka m bɔhim baŋ a daalahiziba tuma.
en: Help me to understand your laws, and I will meditate on your wonderful teachings.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Smɛɛna Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu ka nyɛ ŋun daa kpi ka lan nee la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.

dag: amaa ka daa lee yɛli ni bɛ di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama ni di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu zuɣu.
en: They said, We cannot arrest Jesus during Passover. We dont want the people to become angry and cause a riot.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa buɣisi bɔh o ba Zakaria ni bɛ baŋ o ni bɔri ni bɛ bol o bia maa yu shɛli.
en: Then they made signs to his father, What would you like to name him.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa dol o nyaaŋa paana ti kpe siliga maa ni n-nya ka bimpiɛlli maa doya.
en: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim maa daa yɛli Dauda, Anzinfa bee salima din pala din ni mali ti mini Sool ni o zuliya maa yɛlli maa, di mi pala ti bɔrimi ni ti ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ so. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: They answered, Our quarrel with Saul and his family can't be settled with silver or gold, nor do we want to kill any Israelite. What, then, do you think I should do for you? David asked.

dag: Paɣiba maa ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa, di saha ka siliga maa guliba maa ni shɛb daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba dinkam zaa daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: While the women were on their way, some soldiers who had been guarding the tomb went into the city. They told the chief priests everything that had happened.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba ni sɔhirimi, ka sokam ninni biɛhigu taɣira.
en: As they approach, everyone is terrified; every face turns pale.

dag: Puhimiya tab puhiri suŋ. Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa puhiri ya.
en: Say hello to each other with a holy kiss. All of Gods people say hello to you.

dag: A chɛ ka n zɔnim mini n ʒiʒiinitab zaɣisi ma. Zibisim n-kpalim n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛ ʒiʒiinitab maa zaa, ka yɛlli ŋɔ daa moli gili Judia zoya zuɣu tinsi zaa.
en: The neighbors were all filled with fear, and the news about these things spread through all the hill country of Judea.

dag: Ka Huram daa zaŋ daanya daantalisi maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ ni. O daa zaŋla daantal yini zali nudirigu polo, ka boli di yuli Jachin; ka zaŋ daantal yini zali nuzaa polo, ka boli di mi yuli Bɔaz.
en: He set up the columns at the temples porch. He named the south column Jachin. The north column he named Boaz.

dag: N suhiri ti Duuma ni o zom Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnim nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa kul kpaŋsiri n suhu waawaayili; ka vi bi mal o zoligɔnim din lo ma la zuɣu.
en: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim din zaa kpalim min anabinim yɛligu zaa tamla zaligunima ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: All the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets are based on these two commandments.

dag: Ka Rut daa kul be o kayiha maa ni hal ka zaawuni ti paai, ka o daa zaŋ o ni nya shɛm tariga m-bu li yɛli ka di niŋ kilɔgiram pia.
en: So Ruth gathered grain in the field until evening, and when she had beaten it out, she found she had nearly twenty-five pounds.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam ŋmanila saa ŋun kul yɔrita ka bi baara.
en: A nagging wife is like water going drip-drip-drip on a rainy day.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hɛburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohaths sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: Those who heard Jesus use this analogy didnt understand what he was saying.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni ka taali be yi mini yi tab sunsuuni, yin chɛliya paŋ taba din ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ gba chɛ yi taali paŋ ya. .
en: When you are praying and you remember that you are angry with another person about something, forgive that person. Forgive them so that your Father in heaven will also forgive your sins.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mi dol ti chana? Labimiya ka yi mini naa maa ti be, dama yinim nyɛla tinzunnima, ka lan nyɛ yi yanim ni kari shɛb bahi na.
en: The king said to Ittai the Gittite, Why are you coming with us too? Go back! Stay with King Absalom. You are a foreigner and an exile from your own country.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ wain tihi puri ni nti nya di daai pum. Ti cham ti nya di puma maa yirigiya, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi gba daai pum. Nimaani ka n ni wuh a n ni yur a shɛm.
en: At dawn let's slip out and see if grapevines and fruit trees are covered with blossoms. When we are there, I will give you my love.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla anabi mini maligumaana bee niriba bɛn yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna la, n ni darigi bɛ mini bɛ yinsinim tibili.
en: A prophet, or a priest, or maybe one of the people might say, This is an announcement from the Lord .... Because of that lie, I will punish that person and their whole family.

dag: ka di pala binnamda maa kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili tinim bɛn daŋ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋɔ gba kul ŋuhirimi ti suhuri ni n-guhiri saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti zal o bihi zaani, ka fa ti niŋgbuna zaa bahi la.
en: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ gili Mɔab tintarisi; ka fabila yɛtɔɣa daa tin ti to Ɛgilaimnim mini Bɛrilimnima.
en: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn muɣisiri bɛ yinsinim ti ku lan mali binshɛli yaha, ka jɛra ni ti tumdi tuma tiri yɛnnima.
en: Those who trouble their family will inherit the wind. The fool will be servant to the wise.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo bo o dokpee kaman paɣ la, di nyɛla din chihira.
en: No man is to have sexual relations with another man; God hates that.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa kuhirimi ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu, ka bɛn bɔɣiri mini bɛ gbaya daa kpi ni gbariti pam daa nya alaafee.
en: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ m mini nanim ni dunia saawaranima, bɛn daa lan lab me tin shɛŋa din wurim zaa ti bɛmaŋ la.
en: with the kings and their advisors who built palaces that are now in ruins.

dag: Ti daa pun bi yɛl a Ijipti ni a chɛl ti baalim ka ti jɛmdi Ijiptinima? Dama ti yi di daa jɛmdi Ijiptinim maa, di di so ti ni yɛn kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: While we were there, didn't we tell you to leave us alone? We'd rather be slaves in Egypt than die in this desert.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yuri ti m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni daa nyɛ alahichinim saha shɛl la ka Masia daa kpi ti zuɣu.
en: But God shows his love for us, because while we were still sinners Christ died for us.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulimpuhili polo na nti ʒe teeku maa kom labisi nyaaŋa yuŋ maa zaa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ tiŋ kuŋ.
en: Moses raised his hand over the Red Sea, and the Lord caused a strong wind to blow from the east. The wind blew all night long. The sea split, and the wind made the ground dry.

dag: amaa chamila n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: No, instead, go to my fathers household and to my relatives and choose a wife for my son.

dag: Naa ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali nyɛla piɛbih ayɔbu bɛn ka dansi mini piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: On the Sabbath the prince is to bring to the Lord , as sacrifices to be burned whole, six lambs and one ram, all without any defects.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bihi maa daa niŋ lala, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim maa ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa zali shɛm, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindira ti ba.
en: So Israels sons did that. Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh instructed, and he gave them provisions for the road.

dag: ka zaŋ sida dari maa mini taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee la m-pahi noombil nɛɔŋ la zuɣu tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so maa ʒim mini ko viɛlli maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi yili maa buyopɔin.
en: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti ti din viɛla, ka ti puri atam niŋ pam.
en: The Lord will make us prosperous, and our land will produce rich harvests.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya bɛn daa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa zali ba ni bɛ deem zaka Izraɛlnim sani. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni bɛ deem li la bɛmaŋmaŋ mabihi sani, hal bɛ mabihi maa gba ni daa kul nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya la zaa yoli.
en: And those descendants of Levi who are priests are commanded by the Law to collect one tenth from the people of Israel, that is, from their own people, even though they are also descendants of Abraham.

dag: A tumd alahiziba tuma tiri kpiimba? Kpiimba ni tooi yiɣisi zani paɣ a?.
en: Do you work wonders for the dead? Do ghosts rise up and give you thanks? Selah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Panniriba, dama yi pala n niriba, m mi pala yi Naawuni.
en: Then the LORD said, Name him Not My People because you are not my people, and I am not your God.

dag: N gbibila n wuntitali kirikiri ka ku wɔɣisi li; n suhu bi wuhi ni m mali galimi m biɛhigu ni dahin shɛli.
en: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Yisifu yuli Zafɛnatipania, ka zaŋ Pɔtifɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan la bipuɣiŋga Asɛnat n-ti Yisifu ni o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yisifu daa yiri chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: Then Pharaoh gave Joseph another name, Zaphenath Paneah. He also gave Joseph a wife named Asenath. She was the daughter of Potiphera, a priest in the city of On. So Joseph became the governor over the whole country of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka sapashini maa daa dolila ŋariŋ maa lana mini ŋariŋ maa tuma zuɣulana yɛligu gari Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But the captain and the owner of the ship did not agree with Paul. So the army officer accepted what they said instead of believing Paul.

dag: A min a tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a sani zaa ni ti lu Izraɛl zoya maa ni. Ka n ti zaŋ ya ti juri balibu kam mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ di.
en: Gog and his army and his allies will fall dead on the mountains of Israel, and I will let their bodies be food for all the birds and wild animals.

dag: Nyo bɔ ka n daa naan tooi nya bɛ nuhi tuma ni? Bɛ yaa zaa daa naaya.
en: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.

dag: O yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn chɛ saria karibu din bi doli zaligu soli mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyaaŋa zanibu?.
en: You must stop judging unjustly; you must no longer be partial to the wicked!.

dag: Gbihim biɛla, dɔnim biɛla, zaŋm a nuhi taɣili taba vuhi biɛla.
en: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.

dag: Ya ka n lee yɛn nya nimdi ti niriba ŋɔ zaa? Dama bɛ kumdimi niŋdi ma ka yɛra, Tim ti nimdi ka ti ŋubi.
en: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?.

dag: N yi zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a zaligunim maa zaa ni, n ku di vi.
en: Then I would never feel ashamed when I look closely at your commands.

dag: ka yi ti kari yi dimnim bɛn zaa be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm.
en: And you will force out all your enemies, just as the Lord said.

dag: Yi goma mɛbu dabisili kanna. Dindali maa yi tintarisi ni ti yɛligi pam pahi.
en: People of Jerusalem, the time to rebuild the city walls is coming. At that time your territory will be enlarged.

dag: Dama ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ mali n yuli tɔɣisiri maa. Pa mani n-tim ba na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They are telling lies, and they are saying that their message is from me. But I didnt send it. This message is from the Lord .

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli.
en: The commander told Paul he could speak. So he stood on the steps and waved his hand so that the people would be quiet. The people became quiet and Paul spoke to them in Aramaic.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan daa bɔhi Stiivin, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri paliya.
en: The high priest asked, Are these accusations true.

dag: A yi yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu, nyin lum o sizuura. A yi vu m-miri ti wum, di so jɛra ni maani sara shɛli, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu.
en: Be very careful when you go to worship God. It is better to listen to God than to give sacrifices like fools. Fools often do bad things, and they dont even know it.

dag: Dama n ni ti yihi Baalnim yuya o nol ni, ka o ku lan boli bɛ yuya yaha.
en: I will never let her speak the name of Baal again.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔhi malaika maa, Ka bɔ ka olivi tih ayi din ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu la yaɣa ayi la mi lee wuhira?.
en: Then I asked him, What do the two olive trees on either side of the lampstand mean?.

dag: Ka sariakaritiba maa ti vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, shɛhira maa yi nyɛla ʒiri shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ o kpee maa polo.
en: When the judges carefully ask their questions, they might find that the witness lied against the other person. If the witnesses tell lies.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be nimaani maa ka ninkur so ti yi o puuni na zaawuni. Doo maa daa yila Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni tiŋ ni na ti be Gibia maa. Amaa nimaaninim daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: Soon an old man came in through the gates on his way home from working in the fields. Most of the people who lived in Gibeah belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, but this man was originally from the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya baabiɛla, dama di dabisili maa ku kana faashee Naawuni zaɣisibu din bahindi nyaaŋa la ti niŋ, ka Zaliguzaɣisir so Naawuni ni pun lo ni o bah o yol la gba ti yi zahira.
en: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.

dag: Dauda bapira Jɔnatan n-daa nyɛ saawaralana ŋun mi niriba yɛlimuɣisira, ka lan nyɛ gbansabira karimba. O mini Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔni bia la n-daa nyɛ bɛn lihiri naa bidibisi.
en: Jonathan was a wise counselor and a scribe. He was Davids uncle. Jehiel son of Hacmoni took care of the kings sons.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila bɛ suhuri ni, Ti kul ku vuui; ʒiɛmani kam puuni muɣisigu shɛli ku paai ti.
en: They say to themselves, Nothing bad will ever happen to us. We will have our fun and never be punished.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa labi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni na. Ka Judanim maa daa ka Giligal na ni bɛ ti tuh o soli n-zaŋ o du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: King David came to the Jordan River. The people of Judah came to Gilgal to meet the king and take him across the Jordan River.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋumdi ti kparima ni kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka malaika ŋun su kum fukumsi daa bahi ba yol la.
en: Lets not grumble, like some of them did, and were killed by the destroyer.

dag: Musa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinii, ka Aduna mi yuma nyɛ yuun pihiniinaata saha shɛli bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: At the time when they spoke to the king, Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron was eighty-three.

dag: O daa lan me buɣa jɛmbu shee zali Juda fɔŋ kam ni, n-tuɣindi tulaale zim n-tiri buɣa, ka di daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la suhu yiɣisi.
en: In every city and town in Judah he built pagan places of worship, where incense was to be burned to foreign gods. In this way he brought on himself the anger of the Lord , the God of his ancestors.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa mali.
en: It will take seven months for the family of Israel to bury them. They must do this to make the land pure.

dag: Ka so yi yɛli ni o yuri Naawuni ka je o mabia, o nyɛla ʒirilana; dama ŋunkam bi yur o mabi so o nini ni nyari ku tooi yuri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o ni bi nyari so la.
en: Those who say, I love God and hate their brothers or sisters are liars. After all, those who dont love their brothers or sisters whom they have seen can hardly love God whom they have not seen!.

dag: Cheechi shɛŋa din be Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim puhiri ya. Akuila mini Prisila ni cheechi din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ puuni la puhiri ya pam ti Duuma ni.
en: The churches in Asia send you their greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you in the Lord. Also the church that meets in their house sends greetings.

dag: Ibizan kalinsi nyaaŋa, Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. O daa niŋ bɛ zuɣulan la yuun pia.
en: Elon from the Zebulun tribe was the next leader of Israel. He was a leader for ten years.

dag: Ka bɛ ti tan ya daɣiri zuliyanim maa ninni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: When you are degraded like this in the sight of the nations, then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di mi lan sabi yɛli, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures also say, Don't try to test the Lord your God! .

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋm nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa pa tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kpaai ʒiɛri maa pol li. Ka Gidiɔn daa niŋ lala.
en: Then Gods messenger said to him, Take the meat and the unleavened bread and set them on this rock, then pour out the broth. And he did so.

dag: ka yɛli, Lala ka Babilɔn ti yɛn shim ka ku lan puhi na yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa lu di zuɣu maa zuɣu. Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa maa tariga m-bala.
en: and say, This is what will happen to Babylonia—it will sink and never rise again because of the destruction that the Lord is going to bring on it. The words of Jeremiah end here.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim nyɛla bɛn fari niriba mini ŋmɛnditoya. Bɛ muɣisiri faranim mini nandaamba, ka fari saamba nɛma, ka bi labisiri li tiri ba.
en: The common people take advantage of each other. They cheat and steal from each other. They get rich by taking advantage of poor, helpless beggars, and they really cheat the foreigners. They are not fair to them at all!.

dag: Nyin ŋun suhu yiɣisi ka a dar tɔh amaŋ ŋɔ, a tɛhiya ni bɛ ni chɛ dunia ti a bee n-vuɣi tampiŋ di biɛhigu shee a zuɣu?.
en: To you who tear yourself in rage— will earth be forsaken for your sake, a rock be dislodged from its place?.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, N ku leei yi naa; ka m bidibiga gba ku leei yi naa sun ya; Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi naa ŋun sun ya.
en: Gideon answered, I will not be your ruler, nor will my son. The Lord will be your ruler.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal viɛla maa ni be shɛm maa, lala ka n lihi Juda ninvuɣ shɛb n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi n-zaŋ ba kpe chaŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka bɛ viɛla.
en: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-daa zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka leei bɛ Naawuni.
en: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.

dag: Dama Aram mini Ifriim zuliya ni Rɛmalia bia maa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka yɛra.
en: Aram has planned evil against you with Ephraim and Remaliahs son, saying.

dag: O daa zaŋla bɛ min o binshɛɣukam zaa duhi mɔɣili maa duli;.
en: After he had sent them across, he also sent across all that he owned.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, a zaɣisi ti ka filim ti. Ka ti tɔbbihi yi chani tɔb tuhibu, a lan ka bɛ sani.
en: But you left us and put us to shame. You did not go with us into battle.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma la, ka bɛ zaŋ li yo tumtumdiba bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma maa.
en: The priests must use that money to pay the workers to repair the Lord s Temple. They must give that money to the men who supervise the work on the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ti bi lan nyari ti shihira la yaha; anabi so lan kani, ka so bi mi di yuusim tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be o sani, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura na.
en: Johanan, the officers, and the other people. So I called them together.

dag: Sana yi be yi tiŋgban ni, yin di niŋy o zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni daa kuhi boli ba ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu shɛm, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli ma ka n gba zaɣisi ba garigibu.
en: Because they did not listen when I spoke, I did not answer when they prayed.

dag: ka o chɛ ka di niŋ pali tinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaansi ŋɔ sani maa, dina n-nyɛ o ni daa neei Yisa kum ni kaman di ni sabi Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛli din pah ayi ni shɛm la, ni Naawuni yɛliya: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it was written in the second psalm, You are my son; today I have become your father. .

dag: Niriba daa chɛla vuri ka gbilisiri tibili guhiri n ni yɛn di ba kpamli alizam shɛli.
en: In the past people listened to me. They waited quietly for my advice.

dag: Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; dama n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: You will look for me, but you wont find me, and where I am you cant come.

dag: Ka siɣili saha din nyɛ nanim ni daa yi tuhiri tɔbu saha shɛli la daa ti paai, ka Dauda daa tim Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Ammɔnnima, ka chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda ŋun daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: It was now spring, the time when kings go to war. David sent out the whole Israelite army under the command of Joab and his officers. They destroyed the Ammonite army and surrounded the capital city of Rabbah, but David stayed in Jerusalem.

dag: Yi daa zɔrila takɔbi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You are afraid of the sword, but I am bringing the sword against you! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti deei puu maa chuɣu puhibu la saha, di ni nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ pu shɛli ti Yawɛ. Maligumaana n-ni ti su li.
en: If you dont buy the land back by the year of Jubilee, the field will remain holy to the Lord —it will belong to the priest forever. It will be treated like any other thing that was given completely to the Lord.

dag: amaa ka malaika maa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Dama lahibal suŋ din mali suhupiɛlli pam ka nyɛ sokam zaa dini ka n ʒina ni n ti yɛli ya.
en: but the angel said to them, Don't be afraid! I am here with good news for you, which will bring great joy to all the people.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ n tizɔbihi.
en: Jesus answered, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yino maa n-tiri yiko din tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri sokam yinoyino kaman o ni yu ni o ti o pin shɛli.
en: One Spirit, the same Spirit, does all these things. The Spirit decides what to give each one.

dag: Bumiya yi nyɔri ni suhusaɣiŋgu yi tiŋgbani din vuhiri mini yi tiwala tihi din saɣim la zuɣu.
en: beating your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim mini Kalidianim zaa ni Pɛkɔdnima ni Shɔanima ni Kɔanima ni Asirianim zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla, ka gomnanim mini sapashin kpamba ni sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi ni ti be bɛ ni. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla wɔribariba.
en: I will bring all the Babylonians and Chaldeans, men from Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians. I will gather all those handsome young noblemen and officers, all those important officials and high-ranking cavalry officers.

dag: Fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: These are the commands that the Lord gave Moses on Mount Sinai for the people of Israel.

dag: Yi malila nina din bi nyara? Ka mali tiba din bi wumda? Ka yi bi lan teei yaha?.
en: Are your eyes blind and your ears deaf? Don't you remember.

dag: Dinzuɣu teemiya ka doli n zaligunim maa zaa, ka be kasi yi Naawuni sani.
en: You will remember to obey all my commands. Then you will be Gods special people.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa niŋ yɛda pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?.

dag: Ka tuumba maa mini cheechi kpamba maa daa laɣim ni bɛ to yɛlli maa jina.
en: Then the apostles and the elders gathered to study this problem.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa paɣ o binyɛra ka su kom, ka naanyi kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee; amaa ka maligumaana maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: After that, he is to wash his clothes and pour water over himself, and then he may enter the camp; but he remains ritually unclean until evening.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yɛl o, Yɛlim ti Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n-shiri nyɛ Masia Naawuni Bia la.
en: But Jesus kept quiet. Again the High Priest spoke to him, In the name of the living God I now put you under oath: tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, m be a sani. Mani n nyɛ a Naawuni. Kul di zɔri dabiɛm! N ni ti a kpiɔŋ ka sɔŋ a, n ni tilig a ka gul a, ka chɛ ka a di nasara.
en: Dont worry—I am with you. Dont be afraid—I am your God. I will make you strong and help you. I will support you with my right hand that brings victory.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim anabinim kaman kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, N cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee n di chaŋ? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: So Ahab called in the prophets, about four hundred of them, and asked them, Should I go and attack Ramoth, or not? Attack it, they answered. The Lord will give you victory.

dag: nyaanzuriba ni bɛn je Naawuni ni ninʒeensinima ni karimbaannima ni barinyuriba ni tuumbiɛri so pala bɔriba ni bɛn bi deeri bɛ laamba noli.
en: and say evil things about each other. They hate God. They are rude, proud, and brag about themselves. They invent ways of doing evil. They dont obey their parents.

dag: Saha shɛli Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa la ni daa ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ kum Yisa, ka o daa galim omaŋa, ka zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita la labisi ti ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba.
en: When Judas, who betrayed Jesus, saw that Jesus was condemned to die, he felt deep regret. He returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders, and.

dag: Yi mi ni di daa nyɛla n daalaafee kalinsi zuɣu ka n daa be yi sani n-tuui yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya;.
en: You know that I first preached the gospel to you because of an illness.

dag: Yi chɛ ka bɛ dolila teeku chani dari Ijipti kawaan shɛli bɛ ni ŋahi Nail Mɔɣili duli la kɔhira. Yi nyɛla zuliya kam kɔhigɔriba.
en: over the mighty waters. The grain of Shihor, the Niles harvest, was her income; she was the marketplace of nations.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi paɣ maa ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whoever touches anything she has sat on must wash their clothes and bathe in water. They will be unclean until evening.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa zaa daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa kul o yiŋa ni o ti suhi alibarika niŋ o yiŋnim ni.
en: Then everyone went home, and David went home to spend some time with his family.

dag: Ka so mi daa ti lan yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, n ni dol a; amaa lee chɛ ka n kuli nti chɛbisi n yiŋnim pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Someone else said, I will follow you, sir; but first let me go and say good-bye to my family.

dag: Tins ayɔbu ka yi yɛn yihi zali ka di nyɛ yi tiliginsim tinsi maa.
en: There will be six cities of safety.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Yinim Yaakubu zuliya zuɣulaannima ni yinim Izraɛl nanim ŋɔ, wummiya! Pa yinima n-di simdi ni yi mi zaligu ni wuhi ni shɛli tuhiya?.
en: But I said: Hear, leaders of Jacob, rulers of the house of Israel! Isnt it your job to know justice?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-chaŋ gili tiŋ maa napɔŋ yim, ka zaŋ li lab bɛ sansani maa ni ti gbe.
en: So Joshua made the priests carry the Holy Box of the Lord around the city one time. Then they went back to the camp and spent the night there.

dag: Ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa ti nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ matarika kuri salin shɛli din nyɛ alali.
en: Their flowers and their branches will be permanently attached to it. The whole lampstand should be one piece of pure hammered gold.

dag: Shallum daa nyɛla Jɛkamia ba, ka Jɛkamia mi daa nyɛ Ɛlishama ba.
en: Jekamiah, and Elishama.

dag: N zɔri ni di pa shɛli ka n ti lab yi sanna ka Naawuni ti siɣisi ma yi sani, ka n fabili bɛn daa tum alahichi ka na bi niŋ tuuba bɛ daɣiri tuma mini bɛ zina niŋbu ni bɛ kɔr biɛri tuun shɛŋa bɛ ni tumdila zuɣu.
en: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.

dag: Pita ni daa ti kul zaŋ o zuɣu tiriti dunol ni ka Kɔniilius dii yiɣisi nti gban o tooni jɛmd o.
en: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.

dag: Giriikinim shɛb daa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni chuɣu maa puhibu ni la kalinli ni.
en: There were some Greeks there too. These were some of the people who went to Jerusalem to worship at the Passover festival.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa niŋ Ibram nirilim viɛnyɛliŋga Zarai zuɣu. O daa ti Ibram piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni bundibisi ni bunnyama ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnima.
en: The king was good to Abram because of Sarai, and Abram was given sheep, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.

dag: Di yi kpe n-gari kpe m-be kaman munaafichilana a niriba sunsuuni, ka miri ka a yi n-zani a kpee nyɛvili yihibu zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not go around slandering your people. Do not stand by while your neighbors blood is shed; I am the LORD.

dag: N nyɛla a ni su so. Tiligim ma, dama n loya ni n dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa beni Jɔshua bia Joyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔzadak yaaŋa la saha mini Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la mini Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni zaligubaŋda la gba saha.
en: These served in the days of Joiakim, Jeshuas son and Jozadaks grandson, and in the days of Governor Nehemiah and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm hal ti kpi, ka shɛb di bɛ nɛma fali.
en: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.

dag: Ka Dauda daa po lala pɔri maa Sool sani. Di saha ka Sool daa kuli, ka Dauda min o niriba maa mi labi bɛ sɔɣisili maa shee.
en: So David made a promise to Saul. He promised that he would not kill Sauls family. Then Saul went back home. David and his men went back up to the fort.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, a kum dabisa miriya, bolimi Jɔshua ka yi ka man Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni na ka n ti zaŋ tuma maa ti o. Ka Musa mini Jɔshua daa chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses: Its almost time for you to die. Summon Joshua. The two of you must present yourselves at the meeting tent so I can command him. So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the meeting tent.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be, ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ mali alibarika, Tibigimiya n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ.
en: The Lord lives! Praise my defender! Proclaim the greatness of the strong God who saves me!.

dag: Doli naa zaligu, a ni po pɔri din nyɛ kasi la zuɣu.
en: Do what the king says, and don't make any rash promises to God.

dag: O ni daa nya ka lala niŋbu tiɣi Yɛhudianim nini zuɣu ka o daa gbaai Pita gba. Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu saha ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: Herod saw that many of the Jews liked this, so he decided to arrest Peter too. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

dag: N naba kul ʒiɛla luɣ pasi shee; ka n kul ni paɣiri nyin Yawɛ jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord .

dag: Bɛ yuri sara maligu pam. Bɛ zaŋdi nimdi maani sara ka ŋubiri li. Amaa Yawɛ ŋun baɣa ka di ni. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛ ni labi Ijipti.
en: They offer sacrifices to me and eat the meat of the sacrifices. But I, the Lord , am not pleased with them, and now I will remember their sin and punish them for it; I will send them back to Egypt!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim a ka yɛl a, Cham ti ku Amalɛknim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, ka tuhi kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: and he sent you out with orders to destroy those wicked people of Amalek. He told you to fight until you had killed them all.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria;.
en: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara, ka daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu ka chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa luhi, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ gili Mɔab tintarisi; ka fabila yɛtɔɣa daa tin ti to Ɛgilaimnim mini Bɛrilimnima.
en: You can hear crying everywhere in Moab— as far away as Eglaim and Beer Elim.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku wɔribara min o wɔhu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ku chɛchɛbunduhira.
en: to shatter horses and riders, to shatter chariots and their drivers.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ya ti niŋ o ni daa lo yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali fɔntin kara din viɛla, ka pa yi ni me shɛŋa.
en: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa.
en: Make the entire priestly vest of fine linen skillfully woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and decorate it with gold. It is to have two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastens around the waist.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ku ma suli, ka n suhu yiɣisi la, n daa loya ni n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba; ka daa bi taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: The Lord Almighty says, When your ancestors made me angry, I planned disaster for them and did not change my mind, but carried out my plans.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛl o, Naawuni ni ŋme nyin dukpin piɛlli ŋɔ! A ʒinimi ni a kari ma saria kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka ti yaɣi zaligu maa zuɣu yɛli ni bɛ ŋmɛm ma.
en: Paul said to him, God will certainly strike you—you whitewashed wall! You sit there to judge me according to the Law, yet you break the Law by ordering them to strike me.

dag: Niriba tusatusa m-be Saria Karibu Vinvamli maa ni. Dama Yawɛ dabisili la miriya Saria Karibu Vinvamli la ni.
en: Crowd after crowd fills the valley of judgment, for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of judgment.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa.
en: Who is the glorious King? The Lord All-Powerful is the glorious King. Selah.

dag: Biɛrim shɛli din mali ba ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ŋmanila bi jɛrigu ŋun bi bɔri ni o yi o ma pul ni na.
en: The pangs of a woman in childbirth come for him, but he is not aware of the time to be born; for at the proper time he doesnt present himself at the mouth of the womb.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu. Dama alizin biɛ bɔbigu n-daa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: Jesus asked him, What is your name? The man answered, Legion.

dag: O daa chɛ ka dɔro be o tooni chana, ka alɔbo doli nyaaŋa.
en: He sends disease before him and commands death to follow him.

dag: Ti bi yo ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; yinima n-naɣ yo yi suhuri zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: There are no limits to the affection that we feel for you. You are the ones who placed boundaries on your affection for us.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti vili baŋtab piɛla, ka so jinjɛm piɛla. Di bi simdi ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka woligu puhi ba lo bɛmaŋa.
en: They will wear linen turbans on their heads, and they will wear linen underwear. They will not wear anything that makes them sweat.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, Yawɛ yɛligu be o ni. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa mini Jɛhɔshafat ni Ɛdom naa daa chaŋ o sani.
en: He is a true prophet, King Jehoshaphat said. So the three kings went to Elisha.

dag: Bɛ zuya daa ŋmanila nɔnsi zuya, ka bɛ dimdi kaman nɔnsi la, ka bɛ dimbu lɔɣu din yɛn nahim niriba chira anu la do bɛ zuya maa ni.
en: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim, n suhigu paar a asiba.
en: Each morning I pray to you, Lord .

dag: Chɛliya ka dunianim zaa ni sɔhiri o tooni. Dunia nyɛla din ba n-ʒiɛya, ka ku lan vuui.
en: tremble before him, all the earth! The earth is set firmly in place and cannot be moved.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, doo bee paɣ yi bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka tum o kpee taali, dilan maa leei ŋun tum alahichi.
en: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Paɣa, niŋm ma yɛda ni saha kanna ka yi ti ku lan jɛm ti Ba Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu bee Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jesus said to her, Believe me, woman, the time will come when people will not worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di ti pa Aduna gbɛɣu zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka Aduna ti deei taali shɛli din ni be Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bɛ pin kasi shɛŋa zaa na ni bɛ ti mali sara kasi maa ni ʒi. Di simdi ka di kul pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ ba nirilim.
en: Aaron is to wear it on his forehead, so that I, the Lord , will accept all the offerings that the Israelites dedicate to me, even if the people commit some error in offering them.

dag: Amaa man Naawuni bɔhiri ninvuɣ biɛri, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul tɔɣisiri n zaligunim yɛla sahakam? Bee bɔzuɣu ka yi tɔɣisiri n daalikauli yɛla?.
en: But to the wicked God says, Why do you talk about my laws? Why do you even mention my covenant?.

dag: Zaŋmi m paɣiba mini m bi shɛb zuɣu n ni jɛm a ŋɔ ti ma ka n kuli, dama a mi n ni tum tuun shɛli ti a.
en: Give me my wives and my children. I have earned them by working for you. You know that I served you well.

dag: Ka n daa lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya ka yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni tinvura ni yiŋ biŋgbamda ni noonsi m-be di ni.
en: As I stared at it, wondering what it was, I saw four-legged animals—including wild beasts—as well as reptiles and wild birds.

dag: nti bɔhi, Ya polo ka bɛ ni dɔɣi Yɛhudianim Na so la lee be? Ti daa nyala o saŋmariga wulimpuhili polo, ka kana ni ti ti jɛm o.
en: and asked, Where is the baby born to be the king of the Jews? We saw his star when it came up in the east, and we have come to worship him.

dag: Yihimiya tɔbbihi maa tarili ni bin yini bini kɔbisinu kam puuni ti Yawɛ zaka. Di yi nyɛ ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi.
en: Take part of these things from the soldiers who went to war. That part will belong to the Lord . His share is one from every items. This includes people, cattle, donkeys, and sheep.

dag: Ti dimnim maa kpiya, ka buɣim di bɛ ni kani ka chɛ shɛli.
en: saying, Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.

dag: Shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhi ni o ni niŋ o ni lo a alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: A bɔri ni mahim chaŋla tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia bee di lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Isaiah said, This will be your sign from the LORD that he will make his promise come true: Should the shadow go forward ten steps or back ten steps.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ti kani, ka o bia Manaasa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hezekiah died, and his son Manasseh succeeded him as king.

dag: M mali tahima ti Duuma Yisa sani ni di ku yuui ka n tim Timoti yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣili maa daa gar o nyaandoliba maa pam. Ka o lan yɛli ba, M bihi, nyamiya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu ni to shɛm bɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ daazichi naani sani!.
en: The disciples were shocked to hear this. So Jesus told them again, It's terribly hard to get into God's kingdom!.

dag: Bindira balibu kam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ din viɛla mini sara maligu balibu kam nyɛla maligumaaniba dini. Di lan simdi ka yi zaŋ yi ni tuui ŋɔri zim shɛli ti maligumaaniba maa din ni chɛ ka alibarika be yi yinsi.
en: And the first part of the harvest from every kind of crop will be for the priests. You will also give the priests the first part of your flour. This will bring blessings to your house.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mi daa bi yɛli ni o ni kpihim Izraɛl yuli dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam tiligi ba.
en: But the LORD hadnt said he would erase Israels name from under heaven, so he saved them through Jeroboam, Joashs son.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ nandaamba alaka ka bɛ baɣa ka bɛ ni, bɛ fa yili shɛli din pa bɛ ni me shɛl la.
en: They crushed and abandoned the poor; stole a house they didnt build.

dag: Nyama pumpɔŋɔ ŋ-ŋɔ o sɔɣi vol shɛl ni bee luɣ shɛli polo. Ka niriba maa shɛb yi chaŋ ti lir o tuuli liribu ŋɔ ka o ku ba, ŋunkam wum di yɛla ni yɛli ni bɛ ku Absalom niriba pam.
en: Even now he has probably hidden himself in one of the caves or some other place. When some of the troops fall in the first attack, whoever hears it will say, The soldiers who follow Absalom have been defeated.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma, ka n ti yɔn ya din niŋ kamaata.
en: So he said to them, If you go and work in my field, I will pay you what your work is worth.

dag: Dinzuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuli n ya, amaa kamina ka n wuh a niriba ŋɔ ni ti yɛn niŋ a niriba shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: So now Im going to my people. Let me advise you what this people will do to your people in the days to come.

dag: Amaa a nam ba ka bɛ biɛhigu pooi nyin Naawuni biɛla. A zaŋ jiri mini jilima pili ba kaman zuɣupila la.
en: Youve made them only slightly less than divine, crowning them with glory and grandeur.

dag: O duhir o yee zama pam ni, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa fɔntinsi dunɔdaya gbini.
en: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa tɔɣisirila Lazarɔs kum yɛla, ka o nyaandoliba maa bɛn tɛhi ni o tɔɣisirila o daalaafee gom yɛla.
en: They thought Jesus meant that Lazarus was in a deep sleep, but Jesus had spoken about Lazarus death.

dag: Duma yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Ka so daa boli ma Siɛr yɛra, Tiŋgula, bɔ saha ka biɛɣu yɛn neei? Yɛlim biɛɣu maa ni yɛn neei saha shɛli.
en: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, Guard, how much longer before daylight.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya o taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt ni o kum o.
en: Even though they didnt find a single legal basis for the death penalty, they asked Pilate to have him executed.

dag: n-gbahi ba ti kpɛhi duu.
en: They seized the apostles and made a public show of putting them in prison.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ ti Naawuni ni ti Tiligira ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu mini nam jilima ni yiko ni fukumsi subu, dunia ŋɔ ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la mini pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, might, and authority, from all ages past, and now, and forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa ni shɛb yɛli, Dindina doo maa pala Naawuni nira, dama o bi doli Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu. Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Ka wula ka alahichilana ni tooi wuhi shihira ŋɔ tatabo? Ka bɛ noya woli.
en: Some Pharisees said, This man isnt from God, because he breaks the Sabbath law. Others said, How can a sinner do miraculous signs like these? So they were divided.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn doli dundɔŋ ni polo dunɔdal la kpe, di simdi ni bɛ yɛla binyɛr piɛla. Bɛ di ti ye biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri binyɛra, bɛ yi ti be dundɔŋ ni dunoya ni bee di puuni n-tumdi tuma.
en: When they enter the gates of the inner courtyard, they will wear linen clothes. They will not wear wool while they serve at the gates of the inner courtyard and in the Temple.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni, di nyɛla Yawɛ vuhim yuuni; di ti biriya yi puri bee n-wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi.
en: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Judanim maa daa bu tɔb zambu. Bɛ ni daa bu tɔb zambu maa, ka Naawuni daa nyaŋ Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Abija mini Judanim tooni maa.
en: The Judeans gave a loud shout, and led by Abijah, they attacked; God defeated Jeroboam and the Israelite army.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Libina mini Ɛta ni Ashan.
en: Libnah, Ether, Ashan.
