dag: wulimpuhili polo daa malila dunoya ata, nuzaa polo diba ata, nudirigu polo diba ata, wulinluhili polo mi diba ata.
en: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyar maa, daŋmi n tooni chaŋ daboli ŋɔ zuɣu, dama zuŋɔ m min a ni laɣim di bindirigu, ka n sa yɛl a din be a zuɣu ni biɛɣuni asiba ka chɛ ka a kuli.
en: I am the one who sees visions! Samuel answered. Go on up to the place of worship. You will eat with me today, and in the morning I'll answer your questions.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti taai duŋ niŋ a n-zaɣis a noli; ka daa lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa bir a fukumsi zaligu la. Bɛ daa ku a daanabinim shɛb bɛn kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ lab a sanna la. Bɛ daa mo a pam.
en: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya bɛ taali? Yisa Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daa kpi; ka din gari lala nyɛla, ŋuna n-daa neei kum ni, ka ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo n-suhiri Naawuni tiri ti.
en: Who, then, will condemn them? Not Christ Jesus, who died, or rather, who was raised to life and is at the right side of God, pleading with him for us!.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ka bɛ bɔri olivi kpa viɛlli na nti niŋdi firila ni din ni chɛ ka firila maa kul ne n-ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Command the people of Israel to bring you the best olive oil for the lamp, so that it can be lit each evening.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Doo maa n-daa bɔhi ti ti mini ti dɔɣiriba yɛla pam hal ti bɔhi ti, Yi ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Yi mali tizo? Ka ti mi daa garig o bɔhigunim maa; ti daa lee yɛn niŋ wula baŋ ni o ni yɛl ti, Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa na? .
en: They answered, He asked a lot of questions about us and our family. He wanted to know if you were still alive and if we had any more brothers. All we could do was answer his questions. How could we know he would tell us to bring along our brother.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Juda zuliya piligu shee daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Zin mɔɣu ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ɛdom tintariga.
en: The land that was given to Judah was divided among the families of that tribe. That land went to the border of Edom and south all the way to the desert of Zin at the edge of Teman.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ nudirigu gbali ti maligumaana, ka di leeg o tarili a suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.

dag: Ka niriba daa wum di yɛla ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi Filistianima.
en: Nations learned of this and trembled— Philistines shook with horror.

dag: Dinzuɣu pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti zuliya awɛi la mini Manaasa zuliya pirigili la, ka di leei bɛ dini.
en: So now divide up this land as a legacy for the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh. You will give it out from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the west. The Mediterranean Sea is the border.

dag: Amaa wula ka n yɛn yɛli? Dama o pun yɛli ma ni omaŋmaŋa n-niŋ li. Ka n suhu saɣim pam, ka n kɔŋ gom.
en: What can I say? The Lord has done this. My heart is bitter, and I cannot sleep.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale zim pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa, ka tulaale zim shɛli daa kani n-viɛl paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Naa Sulemaana maa.
en: Then she gave the king one hundred twenty kikkars of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again has such a quantity of spice come to Israel as when the queen of Sheba gave this gift to King Solomon.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya ŋun yɛn su n niriba; ka daa zaŋ bidibbihi n-kɔhi bo pagɔra, ka zaŋ bipuɣinsi mi n-kɔhi nyu wain.
en: and have cast lots for my people. They have traded boys for prostitutes, and sold girls for wine, which they drank down.

dag: Hal binshɛŋa din ka nyɛvili kaman yua bee mɔɣilo, ka pa ni bɛ piɛb li mi bee ŋ-ŋme li ka di doli soli, wula ka nir ni tooi baŋ di ni kum yɛli shɛm?.
en: Likewise, things that arent alive like a harp or a lyre can make a sound, but if there arent different notes in the sounds they make, how will the tune from the harp or the lyre be recognized?.

dag: Daadam Bia ni ti tim o malaikanim na, ka bɛ ti yaa binshɛɣukam din chɛ ka niriba tumd alahichi mini tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa bɛn be o nam ni.
en: the Son of Man will send out his angels to gather up out of his Kingdom all those who cause people to sin and all others who do evil things.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o ti kpalim be bɛ sani nimaani m-baptaiziri niriba.
en: After this, Jesus and his followers went into the area of Judea. There he stayed with his followers and baptized people.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni be kɔŋkɔba zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yisa leeg alikauli din so nyaanzaana.
en: So this means that Jesus is the guarantee of a better agreement from God to his people.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: He was years old when he became king, and he ruled for sixteen years in Jerusalem.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tooi baŋ Naawuni yɛla zaa dola palɔni bɛ sani, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-pun kahigi li wuhi ba.
en: God punishes them, because what can be known about God is plain to them, for God himself made it plain.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan bɔri ni o zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa ka daa zaŋ li ŋmaligi tahi la Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la yiŋa.
en: So he decided not to take it with him to Jerusalem; instead, he turned off the road and took it to the house of Obed Edom, a native of the city of Gath.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ sahakam. Ami, ami.
en: Our Lord , we praise you forever. Amen and amen.

dag: Dama mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka fan ya dabitim bandi ni bahi, ka daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam nyɛ yi toondaannima.
en: I will tell you what I did. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to you. I brought you from the land of Egypt. I freed you from slavery.

dag: Ka di yi yɛligi o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu.
en: If the spot spreads on the skin, the priest must announce that the person is unclean; it is an infection.

dag: Di saha ka zaligubaŋdib ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, a ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni a galindila ti gba.
en: One of the experts in the law said to Jesus, Teacher, when you say these things about the Pharisees, you are criticizing our group too.

dag: Wahu daa nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana n-gari Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb zaa. Ka wahu daa ti bɔhi paɣ maa, Naawuni yɛliya ni yi miri ka yi di puu ŋɔ ni ti shɛli wala.
en: The snake was the most intelligent of all the wild animals that the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, Did God really say that you shouldnt eat from any tree in the garden.

dag: O kul malila Naawuni biɛhigu sahakam, amaa o daa bi tɛhi ni di simdi ni o duh omaŋa n-wuhi ni o mini Naawuni saɣiya.
en: He was like God in every way, but he did not think that his being equal with God was something to use for his own benefit.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Naa Sool, A tum jɛrilim tuma. Dama a bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛli. Pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ naan chɛ ka a min a zuliya diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Samuel said, You did a foolish thing. You did not obey the Lord your God. If you had done what he commanded, the Lord would have let your family rule Israel forever.

dag: Molimi zuliya kam ni. Samiya tuuta, ka mol di yɛla. Miriya ka yi sɔɣi di shɛli. Yɛlimiya, Bɛ tuhi deei Babilɔn Bɛl di vi. Di niŋ Mariduk alahiziba. Bɛ dih o binnana vi, ka di gar o buɣa la.
en: Tell the news to the nations! Proclaim it! Give the signal and announce the news! Do not keep it a secret! Babylon has fallen! Her god Marduk has been shattered! Babylon's idols are put to shame; her disgusting images are crushed!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tim tuumba pinaayi maa ka kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, yi mi di kpɛnya Samarianim tin shɛl ni.
en: These twelve men were sent out by Jesus with the following instructions: Do not go to any Gentile territory or any Samaritan towns.

dag: dama a ni nya ka wum shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu a ni niŋ o shɛhiralana sokam zaa sani.
en: You will be his witness to all people. You will tell them what you have seen and heard.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: False messiahs and false prophets will come and work miracles and signs. They will even try to fool God's chosen ones.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya yɛm mini yɛla baŋbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.

dag: Dabisili kam yɛrila dabisili din dolina di yɛla, ka yuŋ kam yɛri yuŋ din dolina di yɛla.
en: One day gushes the news to the next, and one night informs another what needs to be known.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, ti bi zabiri dunia ŋɔ zabili.
en: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ ŋmaligi labi bɛ nyaaŋa nti dɔni Pihahirɔt tooni polo, Migidol mini teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din miri Baalizɛfɔn la; dɔnimiya miri teeku maa noli.
en: Tell the people to go back to Pi Hahiroth. Tell them to spend the night between Migdol and the Red Sea, near Baal Zephon.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli Pita, Malim shili ka zaŋ a namda piri. Ka o niŋ lala. Ka o lan yɛl o, Zaŋm a binyɛrigu ye n-doli ma.
en: The angel said, Get dressed and put on your sandals. Peter did as he was told. Then the angel said, Put on your coat and follow me.

dag: Turi tubu zuɣu ka bɛn bi wumdi yɛlimaŋli zabira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm nyɛla bɛn deeri saɣisigu.
en: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi bia maa ba, Bɔ saha ka di piligi niŋd o lala? Ka o yɛl o, O bilim ni.
en: Jesus asked the boys father, How long has this been happening to him? The father answered, Since he was very young.

dag: ka gbaan o tooni, di yi pa lala, o suhu ni yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka yi bahi yoli soli ni, dama o suhu yiɣisiri yomyom. Bɛnkam zaa sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: and bow down to him; or else his anger will be quickly aroused, and you will suddenly die. Happy are all who go to him for protection.

dag: Di saha gom daa wum Pita min o tab la pam, amaa ka bɛ lee ne n-ʒiya, ka daa ti nya Yisa jilima ni niriba ayi bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa.
en: Peter and the others were asleep. But they woke up and saw the glory of Jesus. They also saw the two men who were standing with him.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni daa di n-tiɣi naai ka bɛ pii ŋariŋ maa ni alikama kpalan shɛŋa bahi teeku maa ni ni ŋariŋ maa tibisim filim.
en: When they had eaten as much as they wanted, they lightened the ship by throwing the grain into the sea.

dag: ka o daa tim Tɛkɔa nti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun mali yɛm na ti yɛl o, Niŋmi kaman a nira n-kpi ka a kumd o zuɣu la. Zaŋmi kuyili situra niŋ amaŋa ka di ʒe kpam, amaa kul niŋmi kaman paɣ so ŋun nir kpi ka o kumd o zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ la.
en: and he sent someone to bring in the wise woman who lived in Tekoa. Joab told her, Put on funeral clothes and don't use any makeup. Go to the king and pretend you have spent a long time mourning the death of a loved one. Then he told her what to say.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ pun niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuma zaa puuni. O mi yi ni be tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ŋɔ ni chani ŋɔ yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul bela yi sani yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa, ka binshɛli bi pooi ya.
en: The Lord has helped us and taken care of us during the past years that we have been in this huge desert. We've had everything we needed, and the Lord has blessed us and made us successful in whatever we have done.

dag: O ni ti zan a zaani n-tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka a mi ti zani Naawuni zaani o sani.
en: Aaron will speak for you to the people. Hell be a spokesperson for you, and you will be like God for him.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a daba niŋgbuna ti juri bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ bɛn ʒe a yim niŋgbuna ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be tiŋgban ni.
en: They left the bodies of your servants for the wild birds to eat. They let wild animals eat the bodies of your followers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi bɛ dooshee maa chana, Yawɛ sagban la daa kul ʒiɛla bɛ zuɣusaa dɛde wuntaŋ ni.
en: The Lord s cloud was over them every day. And when they left their camp every morning, the cloud was there to lead them.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Ti ni niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Then all the people answered together, We will do everything that the Lord has said, and Moses reported this to the Lord .

dag: Ka n daa galim ba ka yɛli noli ti ba, ka bu bɛ ni shɛba ka dari sibi bɛ zabiri. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa chɛ ka bɛ po pɔri Naawuni yuli ni yɛli ni bɛmaŋmaŋ bee bɛ bihi ku lan kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba bee n-zaŋ bɛ bipuɣinsi n-ti ba ka bɛ niŋ bɛ paɣiba.
en: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa sani karim; ka kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: Hezekiah received the letters from the messengers and read them. Then he went up to the Lord s Temple and laid the letters out in front of the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlim Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima ni Yawɛ yɛliya, N nyɛla yaɣimɛra, ŋun maani zaɣ biɛɣu shili n jɛndiri ya, ka lɔri di nia zaŋ chaŋ yi sani. Pumpɔŋɔ yi zaa zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu maa tumbu ni, ka taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma.
en: Now say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem: This is what the LORD says: I am a potter preparing a disaster for you; Im working out a plan against you. So each one of you, turn from your evil ways; reform your ways and your actions.

dag: Bɛ suhuri yɛla niriba puri zuɣu, ka bɛ far li, ka ye niriba yinsi zuɣu, ka bɛ far li. Bɛ nahim yililana n-tabil o yiŋnima, ka nahim niriba n-tabili bɛ fali.
en: When they want fields, they seize them; when they want houses, they take them. No one's family or property is safe.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa ka di ti tamya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gbibbu.
en: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them.

dag: Bɛ yihi yɛli ni bɛ mi Naawuni, amaa ka bɛ tuma lee bi wuhi ni bɛ mi o. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim mini tipawumlinima ka ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suŋ kam tumbu polo.
en: They claim to know God, but they deny God by the things that they do. They are detestable, disobedient, and disqualified to do anything good.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Naa Sulemaana, Jɔab zo nti bela Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, nyama, o be sara maligu bimbini luɣili ni. Ka Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka yɛl o, Cham ti ŋme o luhi.
en: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the LORDs tent and was now beside the altar. So Solomon sent Benaiah, Jehoiadas son, instructing him, Go. Attack Joab.

dag: Di saha ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum Izraɛl Naawuni yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la daa laɣim gili ma zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi maa zuɣu. N daa kul ʒimi ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni hal ti paai zaawuni sara maligu saha.
en: Then all those who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me on account of the transgression of the returned exiles while I remained sitting in shock until the evening sacrifice.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinina ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li sani, amaa jɛrilim nyɛla din darigiri jɛra tibili.
en: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.

dag: A tumd alahiziba tuma tiri kpiimba? Kpiimba ni tooi yiɣisi zani paɣ a?.
en: Do you do miracles for the dead? Do ghosts rise up and praise you? No! Selah.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn min o daa chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti ku tooi tuhi niriba maa, dama bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: But the men who had gone with Caleb said, No, we are not strong enough to attack them; the people there are more powerful than we are.

dag: Bɛn muɣisiri ya ni yi guni la nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ duhi bɛmaŋa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu puuni, ka di daliri kul nyɛla ni bɛ di nya nahiŋgu Masia dapulli yɛla zuɣu;.
en: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.

dag: Ti yi be, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti be; ka ti yi kpi, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpi; dinzuɣu ti yi bemi bee ti yi kpimi, ti Duuma n-su ti.
en: If we live, we live for the Lord, and if we die, we die for the Lord. Therefore, whether we live or die, we belong to God.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a mali yɛm gari Daniɛl, ka ashili shɛli kani ka a bi mi li.
en: You think you're wiser than Daniel and know everything.

dag: Hanania bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛlatia mini Jɛshaya ni o bia Rɛfaya ni o bia Arinan ni o bia Obadia ni o bia Shɛkania.
en: Hananiahs family: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiahs family, Arnans family, Obadiahs family, and Shecaniahs family.

dag: Bɛn daa nyɛ jɛra maa daa zaŋla bɛ firilanima, ka lee bi ʒi kpam pahi ni bɛ ti gu bɛmaŋa;.
en: The foolish ones took their lamps, but no extra oil.

dag: n-yiini wumpaɣibo yila pampam, ka yɛr a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: while gratefully singing about your wonders.

dag: Ka hal n yi nyu bara gba, m bi tum jɛrilim, dama n ni tɔɣisila yɛlimaŋli di puuni. Amaa n zaɣisila lala niŋbu ni di chɛ ka so ku duhi ma n-gar o ni nya ma ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu bee o ni wum ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu.
en: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.

dag: Hal n yi yɛli ni n nya wahala pam, n kul gbibila yɛda.
en: I kept on believing, even when I said, I am completely crushed.

dag: A ni ti lula palɔni, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken! This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa su fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa daa bela nudirigu polo ha zaŋ kpa Ɛdom tintariga polo. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ Kabiziil mini Ɛda ni Jagur.
en: The tribe of Judah got all the towns in the southern part of the Negev. These towns were near the border of Edom. Here is a list of the towns: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur.

dag: Naad mini safurɔn ni kalamɔsi ni sinnamɔn ni firanki tulaale zim tihi zaa ni mɛɛr ni aloosi ni tulaale suma zaa be di ni.
en: nard and saffron, sweet cane and cinnamon, with all scented woods, myrrh, and aloes, with the very choicest perfumes!.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yino sani nti yɛl o ni o wuhim ma yɛla maa zaa gbinni. Ka o daa wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: I went up to one of those standing there and asked him to explain it all. So he told me the meaning.

dag: Zuliya kam ŋmanila kom biɛla din tɔɣ lu bokati puuni, ka be kaman taŋkpa zim din pa sania zuɣu o sani. Nyama, ŋuna n-zahindi teeku ni gili tiŋgban bihi shɛŋa kaman taŋkpaɣu biɛla la.
en: Look, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and valued as dust on a scale. Look, God weighs the islands like fine dust.

dag: Fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o kɔh o tiŋgban shɛli ti a, o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa o zuɣu n-ni kana ti yo o mabia maa ni kɔhi shɛli maa zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back.

dag: Ka din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li ni suhupiɛlli, amaa ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka zahimbu yi ti paai ba, bɛ zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: The seeds that fell on rocky ground stand for those who hear the message and receive it gladly. But it does not sink deep into them; they believe only for a while but when the time of testing comes, they fall away.

dag: N ni yiɣisi pumpɔŋɔ n-doli tiŋ puuni solɔri mini lɔrisi ni. M bo n suhu ni yuri so pam maa shee. M bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.

dag: Ka m mɔŋ ya saa saha shɛli yi bindira ni bɔri saa pam. N chɛ ka saa miri tin shɛlinima, ka bi miri tin shɛlinima; ka chɛ ka saa miri pu shɛl ni, ka chɛ ka o bi miri pu shɛl ni ka di bindira kpira.
en: I kept it from raining when your crops needed it most. I sent rain on one city, but not on another. Rain fell on one field, but another field dried up.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti saha shɛli, Yaakubu zuliya ni daa yi tinzun tiŋ ni saha shɛli.
en: When Israel came out of Egypt— when the house of Jacob came out from a people who spoke a different language.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni a zaŋ pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la gba yuya pahi pakoya kalinli ni, dama bɛ kɔre yi ti kpe dɔbba kulibu ni bɛ ŋmaligirimi ka chɛ Masia.
en: But dont accept younger widows for the list. When their physical desires distract them from Christ, they will want to get married.

dag: Dɔɣibu saha beni, ka kpibu saha beni. Biribu saha beni, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛli sib bahi saha beni.
en: He sets the time for birth and the time for death, the time for planting and the time for pulling up.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɛ pulaannim zuɣu, bɛ suhuri yi kul bɔr shɛli, bɛ dir li mi;.
en: Their greed is never satisfied.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa ka o labi alizanda ni nti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: After the Lord Jesus said these things to his followers, he was carried up into heaven. There, Jesus sat at the right side of God.

dag: Zaŋmiya jilima din simdi Yawɛ yuli ti o. Zaŋmiya pina tah o sanna, Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni tibiginsim din be kasi.
en: Give the Lord praise worthy of his glory. Come into his presence with your offerings. Worship the Lord in all his holy beauty.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi di ni chihiri ni Yɛhudia nira mini zuliya shɛb laɣim shɛm bee ka bɛ ti kpe zuliya shɛb yinsi yɛla; amaa Naawuni wuhi ma ni n di lihi so yoli bee n-siŋ so.
en: He said to them, You all realize that it is forbidden for a Jew to associate or visit with outsiders. However, God has shown me that I should never call a person impure or unclean.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni wuhi ni o bɔri shɛlikam ni di zaŋ tum o jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin bom lala binyara maa ka di zaŋ tum di tuma maa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhu ku yiɣisi bahi m mini bɛn ti yɛn doli n nyaaŋa di nam zuɣu.
en: Anything that the God of heaven has ordered for Ezra to get, you must give to Ezra quickly and completely. Do this for the Temple of the God of heaven. We dont want God to be angry with my kingdom or my sons.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni nya yolisim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ dolila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n tɛha ni, amaa ka doli alahichi zaligu n ninsalitali biɛhigu ni.
en: Thanks be to God, who does this through our Lord Jesus Christ! This, then, is my condition: on my own I can serve God's law only with my mind, while my human nature serves the law of sin.

dag: amaa ŋun mali paɣa baɣa bela dunia ŋɔ yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o paɣ nini.
en: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli din wuhiri din be ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni: Di gbinni nyɛla ni pina mini biŋkɔbiri sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi maani maligu nyɛla din ku tooi chɛ ka ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni suhu ni tɛha niŋ dɛde.
en: This is a symbol for the present time. It shows that the gifts and sacrifices that are being offered cant perfect the conscience of the one who is serving.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ n taba kaman bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm. N ni niŋ ba yo bɛ ni niŋ shɛm samli.
en: Dont say, You hurt me, so I will do the same to you. I will punish you for what you did to me.

dag: Amaa n ni kpalim be Ɛfɛsus hal ti paai Pɛntikɔst dali;.
en: Ill stay here in Ephesus until the Festival of Pentecost.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din ka tibbu gbaag o nyɔri.
en: Then after all this, the Lord brought on the king a painful disease of the intestines.

dag: Bɛ ni yi gbaai tayiɣa ka o di vi shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim gba yɛn di vi; bɛ mini bɛ nanima ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim.
en: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ ŋun Yisa yɛda ni daa ti yɛn deela yɛla ka o daa yɛri ba maa; dama Naawuni daa na bi tim o Shia Kasi na, Yisa ni daa na bi nya jilima shɛli din doli o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la zuɣu.
en: Jesus was talking about the Spirit. The Spirit had not yet been given to people, because Jesus had not yet been raised to glory. But later, those who believed in Jesus would receive the Spirit.

dag: ka daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli katiŋa din nyɛ daba ata soli chandi ka chɛ Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa gbib ŋun Leeban biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la.
en: Then Laban made Jacob keep the rest of the sheep and goats at a distance of three days' journey.

dag: ka Amasai nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Joɛl bia, ka Joɛl nyɛ Azaria bia, ka Azaria nyɛ Zɛfania bia.
en: Amasai was Elkanahs son; Elkanah was Joels son; Joel was Azariahs son; Azariah was Zephaniahs son;.

dag: Ka m mini niriba biɛla bɛn daa be n sani daa ti yiɣisi yuŋ. N daa bi yɛli so n Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli niŋ n suhu ni ni n tum ti Jɛrusalɛm. Biŋkɔb so daa ka n sani m-pahi n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so la.
en: I did not tell anyone what God had inspired me to do for Jerusalem. Then in the middle of the night I got up and went out, taking a few of my companions with me. The only animal we took was the donkey that I rode on.

dag: O ti ku kuhi bee n-duh o yee bee n-chɛ ka so wum o kukoli damli solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: He will not shout or raise his voice or make loud speeches in the streets.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli, N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor then motioned to Paul to speak, and Paul said, I know that you have been a judge over this nation for many years, and so I am happy to defend myself before you.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa kana ti nya shigbaŋ, ka shikpam do tiŋa.
en: The army and the people who lived nearby had gone into a forest, and they came to a place where honey was dripping on the ground. But no one ate any of it, because they were afraid of being put under the curse.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ biasan la zuliya m-be tooni, ka Juda zuliya kpamba paya, ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya kpamba doli nyaaŋa.
en: First comes Benjamin, the smallest tribe, then the leaders of Judah with their group, followed by the leaders of Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: ka zaŋ kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛbih ayopɔin maa zaɣ yini kam zuɣu;.
en: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn kpalim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ba yuri Yisifu pam gari bɛn nyɛ o biɛyanim maa zaa maa, ka bɛ daa je Yisifu di zuɣu, ka bi tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ni suhumahili.
en: When Josephs brothers saw that their father loved Joseph more than he loved them, they hated their brother because of this. They refused to say nice things to him.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣisi bɛ ni daa kɔhi kawana laɣ shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-zaŋ li tahi Firawuna yiŋa nti ti o.
en: As they bought grain, Joseph collected all the money and took it to the palace.

dag: Hal yi ni kul zaŋ bɔchaa mini chibo pam paɣi yimaŋ maa zaa yoli, man sani yi taali maa na kul beni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even if you wash yourself with lye, even if you use much soap, I can still see your guilt. This message is from the Lord GOD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nyaŋ tin shɛŋa din daa gili Gɛra maa nim zaa, dama Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm. Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ʒe fɔntinsi maa zaa nɛma chaŋ, dama nɛma daa be tinsi maa ni.
en: Asa and his army defeated all the towns near Gerar. The people living in those towns were afraid of the Lord . Those towns had very many valuable things. Asas army took those valuable things away from those towns.

dag: Duɣu ka bɛ mali buɣisiri anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim pam buɣisiri salima, amaa Yawɛ m-buɣisiri ninsal suhu.
en: Fire is used to make gold and silver pure, but a persons heart is made pure by the Lord .

dag: Di kul nyɛla zaɣ palli asiba kam. A ʒiɛyimtali galisiya.
en: Fresh as the morning, as sure as the sunrise.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni daa yɛli ni n ni niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛl la, n daa bi diɛmdimi maa.
en: They will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings were not empty threats.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je wuntizɔriba ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla n kpamdi sokam jaande ni bɛ suhimi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu, ka kul suhimi Naawuni din simdi ba gba zuɣu, ka timmi sandaani niŋmi Naawuni tiri niriba; ka paɣimi Naawuni sokam zaa zuɣu.
en: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, requests, and thanksgivings be offered to God for all people;.

dag: N yɛn ŋahila ŋaha. N yɛn tɔɣisila kurimbuni ha ashili yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will tell you a story. I will tell you about things from the past that are hard to understand.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa tumdila din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din viɛla, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But everyone has gone the wrong way. Everyone has turned bad. No one does anything good. No, not one person!.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o yiko yɛla, ka tam o ni daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni dahin shɛl la yɛla;.
en: They forgot his great power and the day when he saved them from their enemies.

dag: Ijiptinim ni tiri niriba sɔŋsim shɛli ka buchi, dinzuɣu man ni pa Ijipti yupaa m-bol li la Rahab ŋun nyɛ ʒinahigulana.
en: The help that Egypt gives is useless. So I have nicknamed Egypt, The Harmless Dragon.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mi bi tumdi tuma, amaa ka niŋ ŋun chɛ ka alahichilana yiri taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda, Naawuni zaŋd o gba zaani wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: But faith is credited as righteousness to those who dont work, because they have faith in God who makes the ungodly righteous.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: When a calf or a lamb or a kid is born, it must not be taken from its mother for seven days, but after that it is acceptable as a food offering.

dag: M bihi, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Ka yi ni daa pun wum ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Masiachihira ni ti kana la, hal Masiachihiriba pam pun kana gba, dinzuɣu ti baŋya ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa n-shiri bɔŋɔ.
en: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Dindina zaŋmiya wuna la bahi, ka zaŋya yi suhuri niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni.
en: Then get rid of those foreign gods that you have, he demanded, and pledge your loyalty to the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi ni jɛm niriba maa zuŋɔ, ka zaŋ zilin balli yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: They answered, If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should do what they ask today. Tell them you will make their work easier.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa daa kpe kpiimba biɛhigu shee zaɣ nɛma, ka tiŋgbani mum ba niŋ, ka bɛ daa bahi yoli niriba maa ni.
en: They went down into their grave alive. Everything they owned went with them. Then the earth closed over them. They were finished—gone from the camp!.

dag: ka yɛli, A ni yɛn kana ti paai shɛli tariga n-yɛn bɔŋɔ; di tirisi tooni. Kpe ka a kɔgbana din mali karimbaani maa yɛn zani.
en: I said to the sea, You can come this far, but no farther. This is where your proud waves will stop.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: I, the Lord , brought you out of Egypt so that you could be my special people and I could be your God. I am holy, so you must be holy too.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi kpe n niriba dunɔdaya ni bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali ba ansarisi bɛ wahala dibu mini bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Ka di mi daa bi simdi ni yi fa bɛ daazichi bɛ daashaara nyabu dali.
en: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n wum Ifriim daŋ ni fabindi yɛra, A darigi ti tibili, ka ti saɣi ti tibidarigibo maa. Ti daa ŋmanila naɣisa so bɛ ni bi baligi. Zaŋmi ti labisina, ka chɛ ka ti ka a sanna, dama nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: I hear the people of Israel say in grief, Lord , we were like an untamed animal, but you taught us to obey. Bring us back; we are ready to return to you, the Lord our God.

dag: Bɛ daa malila salima bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi pateesanim maa tuɣi taba, ka di daa chɛ ka Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa niŋ zaɣ mun yini.
en: Then they made gold rings to join the two curtains together. So the Holy Tent was joined together into one piece.

dag: Ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. Ka nir yi ni tooi gbaag omaŋ o suhuyiɣisili saha, di so ŋun ŋme n-deei tin muni.
en: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.

dag: Ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu Naawuni sani. Ka Yawɛ ti bol o zoli maa zuɣu yɛl o, A ni ti yɛn yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then Moses climbed up the mountain to meet with God. The Lord spoke to him on the mountain and said, Tell this to the Israelites, the great family of Jacob:.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zuliya kul beni sahakam; ka chɛ ka o zuliya diri nam ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: I will make his family continue forever. His kingdom will last as long as the skies.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be o sani la, Chamiya gili Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa ni, zaŋ Dan hal ti kpa Bɛrishiiba n-kali niriba maa ka m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: King David said to Joab, the captain of the army, Go through all the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba, and count the people. Then I will know how many people there are.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim niriba maa zaa chaŋ Raba ti tuhi deei li.
en: David called the rest of the army together and attacked Rabbah. He captured the city.

dag: Ka Jɛbusi tiŋbihi maa daa yɛli Dauda, A ku kuli ya ŋɔ na. Amaa ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: said to David, You cannot get inside our city. But David did defeat them. He took over the fortress of Zion, and it became the City of David.

dag: Ka binneen shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban ni ka nyɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri n-nyɛ: nantariga mini jɛŋgbariga ni wua min o balibu zaa.
en: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba, ka yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: One day when Jesus was in the Temple teaching the people and preaching the Good News, the chief priests and the teachers of the Law, together with the elders, came.

dag: Alahichinima chɛli bɛ daalahichi soli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri chɛ bɛ tɛhi biɛri, ka ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ka o ti zo ba nambɔɣu, dama o ni chɛ bɛ taali zaa.
en: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.

dag: ka Abishua nyɛ Buki ba, ka Buki nyɛ Uzi ba.
en: Abishua of Bukki, Bukki of Uzzi.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa nya lala ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, dama naa daa yi kul niŋ shɛli, di niŋdila niriba nyaɣisim.
en: All the people saw what happened, and they were pleased with what King David had done.

dag: Dama ti yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa daa kpiya ka lan neei yaha, ti lan niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn gbihiri kum ni la ti doli ti Duuma Yisa labina.
en: We believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will take back with Jesus those who have died believing in him.

dag: Hal bɛ yi gbi gbala n-kpe di ni, n ni zaŋ n nuu tim di ni yihi ba na. Ka bɛ yi dula zuɣusaa, n ni siɣisi ba na.
en: If they dig deep into the ground, I will pull them from there. If they go up into the skies, I will bring them down from there.

dag: Zaawuni sara maligu maa saha ka n daa yiɣisi n nolɔbo maa puuni ni m binyɛr tɔhima la. Ka n daa gbani n-teei n nuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then, when it was time for the evening sacrifice, I got up. I had made myself look shameful while I was sitting there. My robe and coat were torn, and I fell on my knees with my hands spread out to the Lord my God.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilisi tibili wum n siɣimbu.
en: Hear my words, LORD! Consider my groans!.

dag: Ka ti bɔri ni yi zaa yinoyino kul moor o nini lala hal ti paai di tariga, ka di chɛ ka yi ni mali tahima binshɛl zuɣu la niŋ pali.
en: But we desperately want each of you to show the same effort to make your hope sure until the end.

dag: nti zaŋ tulaale zim maa niŋ buɣim maa ni Yawɛ tooni, ka chɛ ka di nyɔhi tuɣi kpe bimpindigu din pili Alikauli Adaka la, di yi pa lala o ni kpi.
en: There in the Lord 's presence he shall put the incense on the fire, and the smoke of the incense will hide the lid of the Covenant Box so that he will not see it and die.

dag: Ka noonsi bɛn be zuɣusaa tɛri bɛ tɛri tihi din baɣi li zuɣu, ka be di wula zuɣu kumda.
en: In the trees near by, the birds make their nests and sing.

dag: Kom daa beni n-sɔŋ li. Ka tiŋgbani ziliŋ daa chɛ ka di zooi niŋ wɔɣilim, ka chɛ ka di mɔɣa kom daa zo n-tiɛli bɛ ni daa sa li luɣ shɛli maa, ka di kɔsoya kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa.
en: The water made the tree grow. The deep river made the tree tall. Rivers flowed around the place where the tree was planted. Only small streams flowed from that tree to all the other trees of the field.

dag: N daa lola n nina alikauli ni n ku lihi paɣisarili.
en: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa boli naa n-yɛl o. Ka naa daa yɛli, Di yi nyɛ o kɔŋko n-zɔrina maa dindina o ʒirila lahibali na. Ka o daa ti zo m-mirina.
en: The watchman called out and reported this to the king. The king said, If hes alone, its good news. The man got nearer and nearer.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu, yinim bɛn daa be katiŋ la yipa vu m-miri Naawuni Masia ʒim zuɣu.
en: But now, thanks to Christ Jesus, you who once were so far away have been brought near by the blood of Christ.

dag: ni o chɛ ka Pool lab Jɛrusalɛm na, dama bɛ daa lɔrila nia ni bɛ gu soli ku o.
en: if he would be willing to bring Paul to Jerusalem. They begged him to do this because they were planning to attack and kill Paul on the way.

dag: Di saha maa ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: A woman who had suffered from severe bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and touched the edge of his cloak.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ bahigu, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyu Kpiɔŋlan Naa suhuyiɣisili.
en: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.

dag: Ka Isaka zuliya ni toondaannim daa doli Dɛbɔra; Isaka zuliya niriba maa daa ʒe Barak yim, ka dol o du o napɔŋkpahi siɣi vinvamli maa ni. Amaa Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: The leaders of Issachar were with Deborah. The family of Issachar was true to Barak. Those men marched to the valley on foot. Reuben, there are many brave soldiers in your army groups.

dag: Yi ni ŋma n-wurisiwurisi kaman yaɣiri duɣu la, hal ka salichee din ni mooi buɣim bee n-tooi kom kɔduɣu ni ku lan beni.
en: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka niriba maa daŋ yiɣisibu me bimbini zali nimaani, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara.
en: And the next day, the people got up early and built an altar there. They offered entirely burned offerings and well-being sacrifices.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Mbaye, n daa zaɣisi biɛrisuŋ, ka zaɣisi zuɣuni kpahibu.
en: Then you will say, Why didnt I listen to my parents? Why didnt I pay attention to my teachers? I didnt want to be disciplined. I refused to be corrected.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn maa yuun pisaayika.
en: King Eglon of Moab ruled over the Israelites for years.

dag: Ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihiri ba, ka tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛn ti o la shɛli.
en: So he looked at them, expecting to get something from them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa, M bɔhiri ya mi, tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali? Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu? Din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li.
en: Then Jesus asked, On the Sabbath should we do good deeds or evil deeds? Should we save someone's life or destroy it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ fukumsi mini bɛ yiko zaa n-ti biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: These kings will be of one mind, and they will give their power and authority to the beast.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa gba daa kana ti damd o tooni ka yɛli, Ti nyɛla a daba.
en: Then his brothers themselves came and bowed down before him. Here we are before you as your slaves, they said.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti di biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ n-filim yimaŋa, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ saɣim ya, di yi pa lala yi ni leei bɛn be daɣiri ni.
en: Do not make yourselves detestable by means of any swarming creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean with them or be made unclean by them.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din pa salinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ takɔbi n-ku Asirianima. Bɛ ni ti yi tɔbu ni n-zo ni bɛ tiligi. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ nachimba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Assyria will fall, but not by a human sword— a sword not made by humans will devour them. They will flee before the sword; their young men will become forced laborers.

dag: Ka o daa booi kpam maa bahi Aduna zuɣu ni m-mal o ka o niŋ kasi.
en: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aarons head, thereby anointing him to make him holy.

dag: Ti Naa maa nam dibu chuɣu puhibu dabisili yi ti paai, o min o kpambaliba nyurila wain hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala, ka laɣim maani niriba ansarisi.
en: On the day of the king's celebration they made the king and his officials drunk and foolish with wine.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn be tinsi maa ni ka su li, ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee la nyɛ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa dini.
en: The cities will be theirs in which to live. Their pastures will be for their cattle, their possessions, and all their animals.

dag: M min a yi nyaɣisi pam; ti yi pahila salo zuɣu be Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: We had intimate talks with each other and worshiped together in the Temple.

dag: Bɛ daa paaya nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi ka chɛ di noli maa.
en: They found the stone rolled away from the entrance to the tomb.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti nya filiŋ Ijipti zo n-kuli maa ni, ka Firawuna ti chɛ ka bɛ di vi bɛ ni bɔri sɔŋsim shɛli maa puuni.
en: You will be disappointed, completely disgraced for trusting Egypt.

dag: Pool ni daa na do Atɛnsi n-guli Silas mini Timoti maa ka o suhu daa ti saɣim pam o ni daa nya ka tiŋ maa luɣilikam kul nyɛla buɣa la zuɣu.
en: While Paul was waiting for Silas and Timothy in Athens, he was upset because he saw that the city was full of idols.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔgila n-yi nimaani zaŋ gari hal ti paai Bɛtaraba nuzaa polo. Ka di tariga maa zaŋ lala hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini;.
en: extended up to Beth Hoglah, and went north of the ridge overlooking the Jordan Valley. Then it went up to the Stone of Bohan .

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai tiŋgbɔna nam kam zaa dabiɛm, bɛ ni daa wum Yawɛ ni tuhi Izraɛlnim dimnim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid.

dag: O ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a bol o yuli Yisa, dama o ni ti tilig o niriba bɛ daalahichi ni.
en: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake, Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judahili ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu ŋɔ wumda.
en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah said to the commander, Please speak to us in Aramaic. We understand that language. Dont speak to us in the language of Judah because the people on the wall will understand you.

dag: Deemiya ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm Naawuni dolibu ni, amaa ka di niŋy o naŋgbankpeeni o ni chihiri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Welcome the person who is weak in faith—but not in order to argue about differences of opinion.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n chaŋ tin shɛŋa gba ni ti yihi ba Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, dama di zuɣu ka Naawuni tim ma na.
en: But he said to them, I must preach the Good News about the Kingdom of God in other towns also, because that is what God sent me to do.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee buɣisi di tariga, bee n-teei mii sɔŋ buɣisi li? Biɛhiŋ kani, a mi di zaa!.
en: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa ti kani, ka o bia Bɛnhadad di nam zan o zaani.
en: King Hazael of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad became the new king after him.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti lan kana ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: One day the divine beings came to present themselves before the LORD. The Adversary also came among them to present himself before the LORD.

dag: N ni suhiri Naawuni yi zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhiri Naawuni ni yi yurilim mini yi baŋsim maŋli zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni baŋbu zoori pahira.
en: This is my prayer: that your love might become even more and more rich with knowledge and all kinds of insight.

dag: Bɛ daa kpala tanti, ka booni di puuni luɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni Luɣ Kasi Shee. Firilatamdigu mini teebuli shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro shɛli bɛ ni mali maani sara Naawuni sani m-pari di zuɣu la n-daa be nimaani.
en: This place was inside a tent. The first area in the tent was called the Holy Place. In the Holy Place were the lamp and the table with the special bread offered to God.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋaha puuni ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima; saha kanna ka n ti ku lan yɛli ya shɛli ŋaha puuni, amaa ka ni ti kahigi m Ba yɛla wuhi ya.
en: I have used figures of speech to tell you these things. But the time will come when I will not use figures of speech, but will speak to you plainly about the Father.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ŋɔ, yiɣisim zani!.
en: Lord , you are a God who punishes; reveal your anger!.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd min o tɔbbihi daa ʒiɛm Yisa ka mal o ansarisi; ka daa zaŋ kpar viɛlli yɛl o, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o labi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Herod and his soldiers made fun of Jesus and insulted him. They put a fine robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiri ka ti ku yi zahira, ka binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ku baŋ di yɛla ka di yi palo.
en: Everything that is hidden will become clear. Every secret thing will be made known, and everyone will see it.

dag: Juda nabihi ni daa wum din niŋ maa, ka bɛ daa yi nayili n-kabi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni nti ʒini bɛ ʒiishɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa Dunɔdal Palli la shee.
en: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni, ka be kasi ŋɔ, a pala ŋun daa pun be kurimbuni ha? Ti ku kpi. Yawɛ, nyini n-zali ba ni bɛ kari saria; nyini ŋun nyɛ ti tampiŋ ŋɔ n-zali ba ni bɛ darigiri niriba tibili.
en: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni Sinai Zoli gbin la, yi daa bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful.

dag: Bina ayɔbu m-beni ka Yawɛ je li, ka bina ayopɔin nyɛ din chihir o sani:.
en: The Lord hates these seven things:.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun niŋdi nirilim nyari jilima, amaa do so ŋun vari gindi ni leei bundana.
en: A gracious woman is respected, but a woman without virtue is a disgrace. Lazy people will never have money, but aggressive people will get rich.

dag: Ka n daa labina nti nya chirimbu shɛli Ɛliashib ni chirim chɛ ka Tɔbaya be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni dundɔŋ ni nɛma duu maa ni maa.
en: and returned to Jerusalem. That was when I saw the wrong that Eliashib had done on behalf of Tobiah by preparing him a room in the courtyards of Gods house.

dag: Zaŋmi gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinii ni anii, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make a table of acacia wood centimeters long, centimeters wide, and centimeters high.

dag: Bɛnkam niŋ bɛ buni naani ni lu, amaa wuntizɔriba ni zoori kaman vamaha la.
en: Those who trust in their wealth will wither, but the righteous will thrive like leafy trees.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim a suhuyiɣisili puuni, lum n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu la zuɣu; n Naawuni, malimi shili, a zali saria karibu saha.
en: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.

dag: Dam yɛlimaŋli mini yɛm ni wuhibu ni baŋsim, ka miri ka a zaŋ li kɔhi.
en: Truth, wisdom, learning, and good sense—these are worth paying for, but too valuable for you to sell.

dag: Lɛbanɔn tihi zaa dari ku saɣi sara maligu buɣim; ka di biŋkɔbiri zaa ku saɣi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la malibu.
en: All the animals in the forests of Lebanon are not enough for a sacrifice to our God, and its trees are too few to kindle the fire.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa zo nti kpe Afɛk, ka tiŋ maa gooni daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayopɔin bɛn kpalim. Ka Bɛnhadad gba daa zo nti kpe tiŋ maa ni sɔɣi.
en: The survivors fled into the city of Aphek, where the city walls fell on twenty-seven thousand of them. Benhadad also escaped into the city and took refuge in the back room of a house.

dag: Ka kpim maa dii neei kum ni n-yiɣisi ʒini gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka Yisa zaŋ o ti o ma maa.
en: The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave him to his mother.

dag: kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini paɣiŋoo ni tiŋgbani din bi nyuri kom tiɣira ni buɣim din na ʒi n-yɛli, Di saɣiya.
en: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.

dag: Yawɛ, a yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam. Di nyɛla din kul ba n-ʒe alizanda ni sahakam.
en: Your word, LORD, stands firm in heaven forever!.

dag: Di ŋmanila Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu maligim din zɔri luri Ziɔn Zoya zuɣu na. Dama nimaani ka Yawɛ lo alibarika alikauli din nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: It is like a gentle rain from Mount Hermon falling on Mount Zion. It is there that the Lord has promised his blessing of eternal life.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la, ka Yisa nyaandoliba bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: It was the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, and the Passover lambs were being killed. Jesus' disciples asked him, Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal.

dag: n-daa ti yi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ kuli Antiɔk, luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni ni bɛ tum bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛli naai maa la.
en: From there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been entrusted by Gods grace to the work they had now completed.

dag: N daa bi ʒini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sani, m mi daa bi mali suhupiɛlli; a daa chɛ ka n ʒila n ko, dama a daa chɛ ka n suhu miligi pam.
en: I did not spend my time with other people, laughing and having a good time. In obedience to your orders I stayed by myself and was filled with anger.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ! O wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu, o wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu.
en: I praise you, Lord ! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul zɔri kpari booli polo ni di chɛ ka n nya Naawuni ni boli ti boligu shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ zaa la Firawuna ninni, amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So the king of Egypt saw Moses and Aaron work miracles, but the Lord made him stubbornly refuse to let the Israelites leave his country.

dag: Haga n-nyɛ Sinai Zoli din be Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ŋmahinli; o lan nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ŋmahinli, dama o min o bihi bela dabitim ni.
en: Hagar, who stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia, is a figure of the present city of Jerusalem, in slavery with all its people.

dag: Lamɛk daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Lamech lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Yisa daa ti lan wuhiri niriba dahin shɛli, ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi m-mir o; bɛ daa yila Jɛrusalɛm mini Galili ni Judia tiŋkpansi na. Ka ti Duuma yiko din daa chɛ ka Yisa tibiri barinim maa daa be ŋun Yisa sani.
en: One day some Pharisees and experts in the Law of Moses sat listening to Jesus teach. They had come from every village in Galilee and Judea and from Jerusalem. God had given Jesus the power to heal the sick.

dag: Dama ti Duuma yɛla yɛtɔɣa daa bi yi yi sani m-paala Masidɔnia mini Akaia kɔŋko, amaa yi ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda shɛm yɛla pun gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Dinzuɣu di bi lan simdi ni ti yɛli shɛli pahi.
en: The message about the Lord rang out from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia but in every place. The news about your faithfulness to God has spread so that we dont even need to mention it.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa gbaai piɛbil ŋun na mɔɣiri kɔrigi n-zaŋ o zaɣ muni nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ. Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa deei Samuɛl suhigu maa.
en: Samuel took a baby lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord . He prayed to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord answered his prayer.

dag: Bɛnkam maani nandaamba ansarisi turila ŋun nam ba. Ka bɛnkam mali suhupiɛlli bɛ tab daashaara zuɣu ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: Whoever makes fun of beggars insults their Maker. Whoever laughs at someone elses trouble will be punished.

dag: N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: I have filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God—I have given him the skill and knowledge to do all kinds of things.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan bol a labisina kaman paɣ so bɛ ni zaɣisi ka o mali suhugarigu la. Naawuni yɛliya, A ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun kuli dooyili o paɣisarilim ni ka bɛ ti zaɣis o.
en: Like a woman whose husband has left her, you were very sad. You were like a young wife left all alone. But the Lord has called you back to him. This is what your God says.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒi m-baɣi kom pam ka mali buni pam ŋɔ, yi bahigu saha paaya. Yi shihi siɣiya.
en: That country has many rivers and rich treasures, but its time is up, and its thread of life is cut.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni tuhi tɔbu n-di biŋkɔb shɛb la naɣilahi kɔbisiyopɔin mini piɛri tusaayopɔin m-mali sara ti Yawɛ dindali maa.
en: That same day, they took bulls and , sheep and goats from what they had brought back from Gerar and sacrificed them as offerings to the Lord .

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛligu mi kul ku yiɣisi. Ka Naawuni yi daa bol o ni zaŋ o yɛligu ti ninvuɣ shɛb la ŋun Naawuni ŋmahinli.
en: This Scripture called those people gods—the people who received Gods message. And Scripture is always true.

dag: ni Shimia ni Hagia ni Asaaya.
en: Shimea was Uzzahs son. Haggiah was Shimeas son. Asaiah was Haggiahs son.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yi ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ polo, dahin shɛli kanna ka di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: But Jesus said, The time will come when all that you see here will be destroyed. Every stone of these buildings will be thrown down to the ground. Not one stone will be left on another.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ayuba bidibisi maa min o bipuɣinsi maa daa ti be bɛ biɛlikpɛm yiŋa n-diri bindira ka nyuri wain;.
en: Job's sons and daughters were having a feast in the home of his oldest son.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila yɛla pili ma. Yaɣimɛra mini yaɣiri pala yim. Bɛ ni mali binshɛli ku tooi yɛli ŋun mal li, Pa nyini m-mali ma; bee bɛ ni nam bin so ku tooi yɛli ŋun nam o, A bi nam ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You have everything backward! Should the potter be thought of as clay? Should what is made say of its maker, He didnt make me? Should what is shaped say of the one who shaped it, He doesnt understand?.

dag: Man kul chɛmi ka n suhu be kasi yoli, ka paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali yoli.
en: Meanwhile, Ive kept my heart pure for no good reason; Ive washed my hands to stay innocent for nothing.

dag: Ka n nya ka wɔr ʒiɛɣu yina pahi, ka bɛ daa niŋ ŋun bar o maa yiko, ka ti o takɔb titali ni o yihi suhudoo dunia ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka daadamnim ku taba.
en: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la.
en: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa bɔh o ba Sool, Bɔ zuɣu ka a yɛn ku o? Bɔ ka o lee niŋ.
en: Why should he die? Jonathan replied. What has he done.

dag: O larila dabiɛm, o bi zɔri dabiɛm, o bi tiriti gbini takɔbi zuɣu.
en: It laughs at fear; nothing makes it afraid! It does not run away from battle.

dag: nti tim nimdi maa ni be ʒɛduɣ shɛli ni maa n-kuhi nimdi maa, ka nim shɛli din doli dirigu maa yina, maligumaana maa n-su li. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋdi Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa yi chani Shilo nti maani sara.
en: he would stick the fork into the cooking pot, and whatever the fork brought out belonged to the priest. All the Israelites who came to Shiloh to offer sacrifices were treated like this.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisifu ni daa neei gom ni ka o niŋ kaman ti Duuma malaika ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chɛ ka bɛ kulis o na.
en: When Joseph woke up, he did just as an angel from God commanded and took Mary as his wife.

dag: ka mali tuuli biŋkɔbigu la yiko n-tumdi yiko tumtumsa tuma biŋkɔbigu maa tooni, ka muɣisiri dunia mini ŋunkam be di ni ni bɛ jɛmmi tuuli biŋkɔbigu ŋun daa mali dan titali din yɛn ku o ka daa lan tib la.
en: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.

dag: Kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛr mia barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka lan be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la, ka di daa kpɛrila kom litanim tuhi pihinahi.
en: The sides of the tank were inches thick. The rim around the tank was like the rim of a cup or like the petals on a flower. The tank held about , gallons of water.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli vuhim, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin vuhim, yim luɣa anahi zuɣu n-kana ti kpe bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima. .
en: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ dunɔdal shɛli din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la nti du dunɔdura maa m-buɣisi li di dunɔbia zaŋ kpe puuni, ka di nyɛ mita ata.
en: Then the man went to the east gate. He walked up its steps and measured the opening for the gate. It was one ruler wide.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛliya ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mɛbu saha na bi paai. .
en: that the Lord All-Powerful had said to them and to the people: You say this isn't the right time to build a temple for me. But is it right for you to live in expensive houses, while my temple is a pile of ruins? Just look at what's happening.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya tahima Yawɛ sani! Dama yurilim maŋli be Yawɛ sani, ka o mali yiko pam din ni tiligi niriba.
en: Israel, trust the Lord ! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ saha ka a dimnim maa lee yɛn chɛ a labu? Bɛ kul yɛn tarila a yuli daɣiri sahakam?.
en: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?.

dag: Ka yi ni zaɣisi n saɣisigu ka bi deei n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You ignored my advice and refused to be corrected.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun gari dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa; nyini n-gari dunia ŋɔ wuna zaa.
en: Lord Most High, you really are the ruler of the earth. You are much better than the gods.

dag: Chɛ ka a maligumaaniba zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kpɛhi bɛ kɔbili ni, ka chɛ ka a niriba bɛn ʒe a yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn ti Kalɛb kaman Musa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la; ka o daa kari Anaki bidibis ata la nimaani.
en: Moses had promised to give the land near Hebron to Caleb, so that land was given to Calebs family. The men of Caleb forced the three sons of Anak to leave that place.

dag: ka bantabiga din daa vili Yisa zuɣu la gba kpabikpabi do di ko ha ka chɛ bimpiɛlli maa.
en: He also saw the face cloth that had been on Jesus head. It wasnt with the other clothes but was folded up in its own place.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa zaŋ yi Kadɛshibarinia hal ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa daa nyɛla yuun pihinahaayika hal ka di ʒiɛman maa ni bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba zaa daa ti kpi sansani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri po pɔri yɛli ba shɛm la.
en: It was years from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until the time we crossed Zered Valley. As the Lord had promised, all the fighting men in our camp from that generation had died.

dag: Lala niŋbu ni ka Lɔt bipuɣins ayi maa zaa daa zaŋ puhi bɛ ba sani.
en: Both of Lots daughters became pregnant by their father.

dag: Puhimi Prisila mini Akuila ni Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnima.
en: Say hello to Prisca and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

dag: Di sɔɣiya ka chɛ binnɛma zaa nina, di limsiya ka chɛ noombihi bɛn be zuɣusaa.
en: Wisdom is hidden from every living thing on earth. Even birds in the sky cannot see it.

dag: Shiibanima mini Dɛdannima ni Speen kɔhigɔriba ni di tɔbbi pola zaa ni ti yɛl a, A kamina ni a ti di nɛma? A laɣimla a tɔbbihi na ni yi ti ŋme n-di nɛma, ka va anzinfa mini salima, ka zaŋ niɣi mini nɛma pam chaŋ.
en: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.

dag: Tarim mini ŋun nahindi niriba zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka bɛ zaa nina ne.
en: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Gbibiya n jɛmbu dabisili la, dama dina n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali ya ka yi be kasi.
en: Tell the Israelites: Be sure to keep my sabbaths, because the Sabbath is a sign between me and you in every generation so you will know that I am the LORD who makes you holy.

dag: Ka pako so ŋun nyɛ pako maŋli nyɛla ŋun kpalim o ko, ka zaŋ o tahima niŋla Naawuni ni, ka kul mali wunsuhigu suhiri Naawuni o ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi daŋ maa galisiya pam, di ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: This is what the Lord says: You people of Israel and Judah have a wound that cannot be cured. You have an injury that will not heal.

dag: amaa dabisa din kpalim nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni, o tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa la o Bia la nol ni. O Bia maa kɔbili ni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zal o ni o su binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dii lu Pita tooni kpi. Ka nachimba maa daa kpɛna nti nya ka o kpimi doya, ka bɛ kpuɣ o gba yi nti sɔɣ o baɣil o yidan maa gballi.
en: At that very moment, she dropped dead at his feet. When the young men entered and found her dead, they carried her out and buried her with her husband.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka niriba maa daŋ yiɣisibu me bimbini zali nimaani, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara.
en: Early the next morning, the Israelites built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask his blessing.

dag: Maak mini Aristakus ni Diimas ni Luk bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditab la gba puhiri ya.
en: and so do my co-workers Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋun pɔra ni ŋun nyɛ tarima daŋ ni yɛligi n-leei zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Di saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka di niŋ lala yomyom. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ!.
en: The smallest family will become a large family group. The smallest tribe will become a powerful nation. When the time is right, I, the Lord , will come quickly. I will make these things happen.

dag: Ka di mi pala bɛn zaa yi ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaan maŋa. Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Yisahaku zuliya n-yɛn nyɛ a yaan maŋa.
en: Nor are all of Abraham's descendants the children of God. God said to Abraham, It is through Isaac that you will have the descendants I promised you.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋ o mam maa yihi ti ti ba; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o goli yuŋ maa zaa hal ti neei biɛɣu. Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ zaŋ o bahi ka o chaŋ.
en: But the men refused to listen to him. So the Levite grabbed his secondary wife and sent her outside to them. They raped her and abused her all night long until morning. They finally let her go as dawn was breaking.

dag: Buri din tiri daŋa nyɛla din yihiri zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋmɛri nyɛ din maani ninsal niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: Sometimes it takes a painful experience to make us change our ways.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi du shɛli din daa tuhi sambani wulinluhili polo la mini di yaɣa ayi varandanima, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sunsuuni mini di puuni duu ni di samban ni zɔŋ la.
en: The man measured the length of the building in the restricted area at the rear of the Temple. It was cubits from one wall to the other wall. The Most Holy Place, the Holy Place, and the porch by the courtyard.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ŋmanila gumdi, ka bɛ tuma be kaman chɛbili la. Buɣim ni di bɛ mini bɛ tuma zaa, ka so ku kpihi li.
en: Just as straw is set on fire by a spark, so powerful people will be destroyed by their own evil deeds, and no one will be able to stop the destruction.

dag: Kalimiya Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn be Lɛvinim puuni bɛ ko kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Count the men in the families of the Kohath family group.

dag: Yi ni di vi pam, ka pa ni jilima. Yimaŋmaŋ gba nyumiya ka chani ʒiɛhira. Yawɛ nudirigu ni pipia la ni paai ya, ka yi jilima ti leei vi.
en: You have drunk your fill of dishonor rather than glory. So drink and stagger. The cup of the LORDs strong hand will come around to you; disgrace will engulf you.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi nya a ni darigi so tibili maa. Di luhiya ni paɣiba ŋubiri bɛ bihi? Bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba? Di luhiya ni bɛ ku maligumaaniba mini anabinim ti Duuma jɛmbu duu?.
en: LORD, look and see to whom you have done this! Should women eat their own offspring, their own beautiful babies? Should priest and prophet be killed in my Lords own sanctuary?.

dag: Ziɔnnima, di zɔriya dabiɛm! Nyamiya! Yi naa bari bumbil kani yi sanna.
en: Do not be afraid, city of Zion! Here comes your king, riding on a young donkey.

dag: Ahazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun yini. O ma yuli n-daa booni Atalia, o daa nyɛla Omri bia.
en: He was years old when he began to rule. He ruled one year in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Athaliah. Her fathers name was Omri.

dag: Yɛndaannim bela neesim ni, ka jɛra mi be zibisim ni. Amaa m mi ni yɛl yini n-ʒe n-guli bɛ zaa.
en: The wise can see where they are going, and fools cannot. But I also know that the same fate is waiting for us all.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Mbo, ti suhuyubu niŋya! A mi di chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o.
en: or say to each other, Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up.

dag: Ka di chɛliya ka ti naɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni chɛ ka di chandi zaɣisibu niŋ ba miligu shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti kpaŋsiri tab suhuri, di bahi bamdi yi ni nya ka ti Duuma Dabisili dal la vuri miriti la zuɣu.
en: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti bɔhi, Sool daŋ ni ninvuɣ so na beni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: David asked, Is there anyone from Sauls family still alive that I could show faithful love for Jonathans sake.

dag: Dina ka n dan mali nyuri kom, ka lan mal li nyar ashilɔni yɛla. Yi ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi tum taali. .
en: Why did you steal my master's silver cup? It is the one he drinks from, the one he uses for divination. You have committed a serious crime.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, kamiyana ka ti tɔɣisi mali ti yɛla maa. Hal yi daalahichi ni kul be kaman mulifu maa, di ni paligi kaman sakuɣa la; hal di ni kul be kaman zom maa, di ni paligi kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri la.
en: Come now, and lets settle this, says the LORD. Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be white as snow. If they are red as crimson, they will become like wool.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti neei kaman yuntisuɣu saha n-lɛbig omaŋ tuug o ka di gar o, o ni nya ka paɣ do o naba tiŋli maa zuɣu.
en: In the middle of the night, Boaz suddenly woke up and was shocked to see a woman lying at his feet.

dag: Dama Naawuni yɛliya: N daa wum yi suhigu n daalibarika saha, ka daa sɔŋ ya yi tiliginsim dabisili dali. Nyamiya! Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alibarika deebu saha. Nyamiya! Zuŋɔ n-nyɛ tiliginsim nyabu dabisili.
en: God says, I heard you at the right time, and I gave you help on the day of salvation. Isaiah : I tell you that the right time is now. The day of salvation is now.

dag: Ka o yi wurim binshɛli, so ku tooi lan me li zali. O yi kpɛhi so duu, so ku tooi yooi dilan bahi.
en: When God tears down, who can rebuild, and who can free those God imprisons?.

dag: O pun mal o bidibbina din mali lɔɣu la shili, n-zaŋ o piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la pa.
en: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni o naba tiŋli maa, amaa ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha shɛli so ni ku tooi nya o baŋ o, dama Bɔaz daa bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o ka nimaani na.
en: So she lay at his feet until morning. Then she got up before one person could recognize another, for he had said, No one should know that the woman came to the threshing floor.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun kariti saria ni wuntia; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, dama n zaŋla di binshɛɣukam niŋ a nuu ni.
en: LORD of heavenly forces, righteous judge, who tests the heart and mind, let me see your revenge upon them, because I have committed my case to you.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ ti ti, dama sakuɣa ŋɔ mini satahinsi ŋɔ saɣiya lala. N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, n ku lan chɛ ka yi be kpe yaha.
en: Pray to the LORD! Enough of Gods thunder and hail! Im going to let you go. You dont need to stay here any longer.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: But God spoke to a prophet named Shemaiah. He said.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di zuɣu kɔbiri maa bi paligi, ka di mi bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, amaa ka nyɛla din sabigi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the priest examines it and finds that the hairs in it have not turned white and that it is not deeper than the surrounding skin, but is light in color, the priest shall isolate you for seven days.

dag: Bɛ daa bu o la paa ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm n-chɛ ka n tum alahichi lala niŋbu ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli, ka mali ma ansarisi.
en: They hired Shemaiah to scare me and make me sin by going into that part of the Temple . They were planning those bad things against me so that they could shame me.

dag: Ka Naawuni bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a bela a zaɣim? A dila ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la.
en: He said, Who told you that you were naked? Did you eat from the tree, which I commanded you not to eat.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Then the Lord said, If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa ʒini naai di daba ata dali ka o daa yi Siizaria chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Three days after Festus had become governor, he went from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

dag: Timna daa nyɛla Iso bia Ɛlifaz mam. Ŋuna n-daa dɔɣi Ɛlifaz bia Amalɛk. Iso paɣ Ada bihi n-daa bala.
en: Timna was the secondary wife of Eliphaz, Esaus son, and she gave birth to Amalek for Eliphaz. These are the sons of Esaus wife Adah.

dag: Ti Duuma suhu yiɣisiya, ka o filim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga. O zaŋ Izraɛl jilima bahi, ka di yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na. O suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛli, o daa bi lan teeg o napɔntamdigu la yɛla.
en: The Lord in his anger has covered Zion with darkness. Its heavenly splendor he has turned into ruins. On the day of his anger he abandoned even his Temple.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa daa ku ba n-zaŋ ba niŋ kɔbiliga puuni.
en: When they arrived in the middle of the town, Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, and the men with him slaughtered them and threw their bodies into a cistern.

dag: Yawɛ, pa tinima, pa tinima, amaa a yuli ka ti tiri jilima, a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu.
en: To you alone, O Lord , to you alone, and not to us, must glory be given because of your constant love and faithfulness.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha yuun shɛli din pahir ata ni, ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ilaija, Cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi Ɛhab, ka n chɛ ka saa mi dunia ni.
en: After some time, in the third year of the drought, the Lord said to Elijah, Go and present yourself to King Ahab, and I will send rain.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, ka yi zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, dinzuɣu n ku lan fan ya bahi yaha.
en: But you left me and started worshiping other gods, so I refuse to save you again.

dag: Nir ni tooi zaŋ buɣim buɣi ka di ku di o situra?.
en: If you drop a hot coal in your lap, your clothes will be burned.

dag: ni a doli zaligu biɛr kasi puuni, ka ku mali galimi di ni hal ti paai ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tooi daaŋa ni tampiligim chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni, ka Musa daa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma, ka di daa tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: So they took ashes from the furnace, and they stood in front of Pharaoh. Moses threw the ash up in the air, and it caused skin sores and blisters to break out on people and animals.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sanna nti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba zaa ʒila o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini.
en: Balaam returned to him, while he and all the officials of Moab were standing next to his entirely burned offering.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo ti di, amaa ka kum na kul mali ba. Bɛ ni ti lan zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Hal bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bihi gba leei bindirigu.
en: People looked to the right and grabbed whatever they could, but they were still hungry. They grabbed whatever was on their left, but still they were not satisfied. So they turned on themselves and began to eat the bodies of their own children.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni paai Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ni ti yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, ka bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni suhugarigu naai.
en: The Lord will save his people. They will return to Zion with joy. They will be very happy. Their happiness will be like a crown on their heads forever. They will be singing with joy. All sadness will be gone far away.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o niriba maa, N ni tin ya chi mini wain ni kpam, ka yi tiɣi; ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb ku tooi lan mali ya ansarisi yaha.
en: The Lord spoke to his people. He said, I will send you grain, wine, and oil. You will have plenty. I will not shame you among the nations anymore.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yaai n noli, ka o zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ma ni n ŋubi.
en: So I opened my mouth, and he fed me the scroll.

dag: Piɛguliba ni ti zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu kana ti lu o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ti bɛ suɣa gil o. Bɛ ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam mɔri.
en: Shepherds come to her with their flocks. They pitch their tents around her and graze in their place.

dag: Ka a ti she zabbanim mini shɛlɔriti ni zuɣupila n-ti Aduna bidibisi. Di simdi ka a mal li ka di nyɛla bɛ jilima mini bɛ nachiinsi situra.
en: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.

dag: Masia ni daa kpe tanti duu la puuni n-gari ti kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee yim ka di naai zaa la, pa buhi mini naɣibihi ʒim ka o daa zaŋ mali sara, amaa omaŋmaŋ ʒim ka o daa zaŋ mali sara n-deei tiliginsim din ka bahigu Naawuni sani ti ti.
en: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana, dama mani n-sun ya. N ni yihi yi ninvuɣ yinoyino yi fɔntinsi ni na, ka yihi yi niriba ayiyi yi daŋ kam ni na n-zaŋ ya ka Ziɔn na.
en: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn zaŋ alikauli shɛli ti a ŋɔ niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: I will give you the Agreement. Put it into this Box.

dag: Amaa kom yi be bimbira maa ni ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli lu di zuɣu, bimbira maa leei daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.

dag: Sa zaŋm labihi m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zani Yawɛ tooni biɛɣuni, ka Yawɛ yi sa pii ninvuɣ so, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi. Yinim Lɛvi zuliya ŋɔ, yi va n-ʒi pam.
en: Tomorrow put fire in them and place incense on them in the LORDs presence. The man whom the LORD chooses, that one is holy. You Levites have gone too far.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baal mini Ashitarɔt din nyɛ Sirianim mini Sidɔnnim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim buɣa la, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka chɛ o jɛmbu.
