en: Once again the Israelites sinned against the Lord by worshiping the Baals and the Astartes, as well as the gods of Syria, of Sidon, of Moab, of Ammon, and of Philistia. They abandoned the Lord and stopped worshiping him.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ tan tolima anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: and they were sewn together to make two curtains with five panels each.

dag: Bɛ nyarila tibiginsim saha biɛla, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni suui lu n-kuui kaman vari la; ka bɛ ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri kaman ka zuɣuri la.
en: They might be successful for a while, but then they will be gone. Like everyone else, they will be cut down like grain.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma mini bɛn yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ma la laara.
en: But let all that be the reward my accusers get from the LORD, the reward for those who speak evil against me!.

dag: Ti zaa daa bela lala, ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, ka tumdi dinkam tiɣiri timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini ti tɛha nini. Ka ti zaa daa nyɛla bɛn ti yɛn di Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo wahala shɛli sokam ni ti yɛn di la.
en: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.

dag: amaa ka je Iso. N daa chɛ ka o tiŋ din be zoya ni la leei dabari, ka o tiŋgbani leei tiŋgban nɛli din nyɛ yɔbahi biɛhigu shee.
en: but I rejected Esau. I turned Esaus mountains into desolation, his inheritance into a wilderness for jackals.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa nyɛ Libini daŋ mini Shimɛi daŋ; Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa bala.
en: The families of Libni and Shimei belonged to the family of Gershon. They were the Gershonite family groups.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili ŋɔ ni maa, ti kul ŋuhirimi ni suhubɔhibo; ka di pala ti bɔrimi ni ti yee li sɔŋ, amaa ti bɔri ni ti yɛla alizanda ni din la pa di zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka nyɛvili tooi vali din kpira.
en: While we live in this earthly tent, we groan with a feeling of oppression; it is not that we want to get rid of our earthly body, but that we want to have the heavenly one put on over us, so that what is mortal will be transformed by life.

dag: Mɔɣili maa kom yi zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam, binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gbamda ni niŋ nyɛvili, kom maa yi paai nimaani zahim pam ni beni. Di ni niŋ nyaɣisim. Ka mɔɣili maa kom yi paai luɣ shɛlikam binshɛɣukam ni niŋ nyɛvili.
en: Wherever the river flows, every living thing that moves will thrive. There will be great schools of fish, because when these waters enter the sea, it will be fresh. Wherever the river flows, everything will live.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa lan laɣim Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa Shɛkɛm na nti boli bɛ kpamba mini sariakaritiba ni zuɣulaannima ni Izraɛl tuma zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ daa ka Naawuni tooni na.
en: Joshua called the tribes of Israel together for a meeting at Shechem. He asked the leaders, including the old men, the judges, and the officials, to come up and stand near the sacred tent.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, ka anabi Neetan mi kpɛna.
en: While she was still speaking with the king, the prophet Nathan arrived.

dag: o ni daa niŋ Ijipti tɔbbihi mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shɛm la ni o ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu di ba shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kariti doli ya la. Yawɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You saw how the Lord completely wiped out the Egyptian army, along with their horses and chariots, by drowning them in the Red Sea when they were pursuing you.

dag: Zaŋ Aroa din be Arinɔn vinvamli tariga ni la hal ni fɔntin shɛli din be vinvamli maa ni la m-mali hal ni Giliad, tiŋ daa kani din goma du n-nyaŋ ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa ti ti.
en: We defeated the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Valley and the other town in the middle of that valley. The Lord let us defeat all the cities between the Arnon Valley and Gilead. No city was too strong for us.

dag: La shɛli daa ʒe nimaani ka komihigu pali li, ka bɛ daa zaŋ gumdi tim di ni n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro gbab li n-zaŋ tiri ha n-niŋ o nol ni.
en: A jar full of sour wine was nearby, so the soldiers soaked a sponge in it, placed it on a hyssop branch, and held it up to his lips.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka sariakaritib la daa tim pirinsi nti yɛli dansarika gula maa ni o yoomi Pool mini Silas bahi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The next morning the legal authorities sent the police to the jailer with the order Release those people.

dag: Salima beni ka kuɣ viɛla pam din mali shaara beni, amaa noli din tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa n-nyɛ binshɛli din viɛl gari di zaa.
en: The right knowledge can bring you gold, pearls, and other expensive things.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli ma ni n doli ba chaŋ ka di chɛ ka n suhu zɔhira. Ka m mabih ayɔbu ŋɔ gba daa doli ma chaŋ, ka ti daa mali ti kpe doo maa yiŋa.
en: The Spirit told me to go with them without wondering if it was all right. These six brothers here also went with me, and we went to the house of Cornelius.

dag: Ka Dauda bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn ku Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so maa ka dabiɛm bi mal a.
en: David said to him, Why weren't you afraid to kill the Lord 's chosen king? And you even told what you did. It's your own fault that you're going to die! Then David told one of his soldiers, Come here and kill this man.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa pii kuɣ pinaayi shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la na n-sɔŋ Giligal maa.
en: They carried with them the twelve rocks that they had taken from the Jordan River, and Joshua set them up at Gilgal.

dag: Ka dunia zuliya kam ni be di neesim maa ni chana; ka dunia ŋɔ nanim ni zaŋ bɛ jilima na nti kpe di ni.
en: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.

dag: Di niŋdiya din bi tuhi yi saria karibu ni, di niŋya faralan nirilim bee n-chɛ yi ni di yɛn niŋ shɛm bundan zuɣu, amaa doliya wuntia soli n-kariti saria.
en: Be honest and just when you make decisions in legal cases; do not show favoritism to the poor or fear the rich.

dag: Arivadnim mini Hɛlɛchinim daa nyɛla bɛn ʒi a goma zuɣu ti gili, ka Gamadinim mi daa ʒe a binchunchuna gbini. Bɛ daa zaŋdila bɛ lɔɣubuya yiini a dukpina zuɣu ti tuui. Bɛna n-daa chɛ ka a viɛl zaa.
en: Your guards came from Arvad and Cilicia, and men from Gamad stood watch in your towers. With their weapons hung on your walls, your beauty was complete.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntia tuma sahakam mali alibarika.
en: The people who uphold justice, who always do what is right, are truly happy!.

dag: ka guhir o Bia ni o yi alizanda ni labina, ŋuna n-nyɛ o Bia Yisa so o ni daa neei kum ni ka o nyɛ ŋun fa ti Naawuni suhuyiɣisili din ti yɛn kana la ni bahi.
en: and you are waiting for his Son from heaven. His Son is Jesus, who is the one he raised from the dead and who is the one who will rescue us from the coming wrath.

dag: N daa malila suhudoo, ka o pirigi ma buyi, o daa gbaala n nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ ma ŋme n-chɛrisichɛrisi, ka kul liriti ma.
en: I was enjoying a quiet, peaceful life, but then God crushed me. Yes, he took me by the neck and broke me into pieces. He has made me his target.

dag: Dama Man Yawɛ bi taɣira. Dinzuɣu ka yinim Yaakubu zuliya bi bahi yoli.
en: I am the Lord , and I do not change. And so you, the descendants of Jacob, are not yet completely lost.

dag: Ka Sool daa po Yawɛ yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a ku nya tibidarigibo shɛli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then Saul made a sacred vow. By the living Lord I promise that you will not be punished for doing this, he told her.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa niŋ darigi Abimilɛk tibili o ni daa tum o ba tuumbiɛ shɛli din nyɛ o ni daa ku omaŋmaŋ ba bidibisi pisopɔin la zuɣu.
en: In that way God punished Abimelech for all the bad things he had done. Abimelech sinned against his own father by killing his brothers.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi taba, Ya polo ka o lee yɛn chaŋ ka ti ku lan nya o? O yɛn chaŋla Yɛhudianim ni wurim chaŋ nti be Giriikinim tin shɛŋa la ni ti wuhiri Giriikinim maa yɔɣɔ.
en: The Jewish opposition asked each other, Where does he intend to go that we cant find him? Surely he doesnt intend to go where our people have been scattered and are living among the Greeks! He isnt going to teach the Greeks, is he?.

dag: Naawuni pala ninsala ŋun ni ŋma ʒiri. O mi pala daadam ŋun taɣir o tɛha. O yi lo alikauli, o paani li mi. O mi yi yɛli shɛli, o niŋdi li mi.
en: God is no mere human! He doesn't tell lies or change his mind. God always keeps his promises.

dag: Fiɛbisi vuri mini chɛchɛbunsi kalima vuri. Yuri balisira, ka chɛchɛbunsi yiɣiri tɔra!.
en: Cracking whip and rumbling wheel, galloping horse and careening chariot!.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ŋahiba paɣ dɔni, o ŋahiba maa zaɣim ka o nya maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ku dɔɣi bia hal ti kpi.
en: A man must not have sexual relations with his uncles wife. It would be like having sexual relations with his uncle. That man and his uncles wife will be punished for their sins. They will die without children.

dag: Ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika n-kuri chɛrubinim ayi n-zaŋ ba tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: Make two winged creatures of hammered gold.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi mɔŋ ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi bi ti ma kom;.
en: You must go away because when I was hungry, you gave me nothing to eat. When I was thirsty, you gave me nothing to drink.

dag: N ni zani n ni guli luɣ shɛli polo, ka tam n gooni zuɣu lihiri nya o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm min o ni yɛn garigi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ n fabila polo.
en: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord 's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa kul teei gilila tiŋ maa hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini saha.
en: and kept it under siege until Zedekiah's eleventh year.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Bee yi tɛhiya ni Sailom du shɛli din daa du pam la ni daa lu n-ku ninvuɣ pisaayika shɛb la daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm la?.
en: What about those eighteen people who were killed when the tower of Siloam fell on them? Do you think that they were more guilty of wrongdoing than everyone else who lives in Jerusalem?.

dag: M puhiri Akuila mini Prisila bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Yisa Masia ni la.
en: Say hello to Prisca and Aquila, my coworkers in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun me wuni bee m-mali binnani bee binshɛlikam din chihiri Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba tuma n-zaŋ li zali ashilɔni, noli din dim o. Ka sokam garigi yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who makes an idol of stone, wood, or metal and secretly worships it; the Lord hates idolatry. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Ti yi niŋ ninsalinim shɛhiradibo yɛda, Naawuni shɛhiradibo n-dii gari, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛli.
en: If we receive human testimony, Gods testimony is greater, because this is what God testified: he has testified about his Son.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: until I put your enemies as a footstool under your feet.

dag: amaa bɛ zaŋmila tuun suma m-malimi bɛmaŋa kaman di ni niŋ kamaata ni paɣiba bɛn doli adiini soli niŋdi shɛm.
en: But they should make themselves attractive by the good things they do. That is more appropriate for women who say they are devoted to God.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali wuni ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee binshɛli din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni.
en: You must not make any idols. Dont make any statues or pictures of anything up in the sky or of anything on the earth or of anything down in the water.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Libianim daa mali tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba, amaa a ni daa niŋ Yawɛ naani la zuɣu, o daa zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.

dag: Naa daa yi ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, bɛ zaŋdila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan zaŋ li labisi ti niŋ di duu.
en: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord 's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.

dag: Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni?.
en: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord ?.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa zaligu yɛliya, Siɣim na yomyom! .
en: The king sent another officer with fifty men, who went up and said to Elijah, Man of God, the king orders you to come down at once.

dag: Amaa Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa, ka Mɔab naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan niŋ lala ti Izraɛl naa.
en: But when King Ahab of Israel died, Mesha rebelled against Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mi daa yɛli Filistia doo maa, Nyin kanila n sanna ni takɔbi mini kpan titali ni kpam bila, amaa man zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛl tɔbbihi Naawuni so a ni ta daɣiri ŋɔ yuli kan a sanna.
en: David answered: You've come out to fight me with a sword and a spear and a dagger. But I've come out to fight you in the name of the Lord All-Powerful. He is the God of Israel's army, and you have insulted him too!.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, di bi maari biɛrim n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n yi fo, di sɔŋsim lee nyɛ ma dini?.
en: But nothing I say helps, and being silent does not calm my pain.

dag: Ka niriba zaa wum di yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan niŋ tipawumli yaha.
en: All the people will hear about this punishment and be afraid. Then they will not be stubborn anymore.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n-yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa fa o o dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi, ka lan fa o Sool gba nuu ni bahi la nyaaŋa.
en: David sang this song to the Lord when the Lord saved him from Saul and all his other enemies.

dag: Naawuni pala ninsala ŋun ni ŋma ʒiri. O mi pala daadam ŋun taɣir o tɛha. O yi lo alikauli, o paani li mi. O mi yi yɛli shɛli, o niŋdi li mi.
en: God is not a man; he will not lie. God is not a human being; his decisions will not change. If he says he will do something, then he will do it. If he makes a promise, then he will do what he promised.

dag: Ifriim nyɛla m biyurigu. O nyɛla n suhu ni yuri so pam. N yi kul galim o bushɛm, lala ka n lan teer o yɛla. Dinzuɣu m puu biɛri o zuɣu pam. Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zo o nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel, you are my dearest child, the one I love best. Whenever I mention your name, I think of you with love. My heart goes out to you; I will be merciful.

dag: O ni daa deei litaafi maa naai, ka binnɛma anahi la mini kpamba pisinaanahi la gbani Piɛbil maa tooni. Bɛ zaa daa malila mɔɣilɔnim mini salima lahi, ka tulaale zim din nyɛ Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu pal lahi maa.
en: After the Lamb took the scroll, the four living beings and the elders bowed down before the Lamb. Each one of them had a harp. Also, they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of Gods holy people.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun daa pii Ibram ka yih o Ur din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka daa taɣ o yuli m-bol o Ibrahimma.
en: You, Lord God, chose Abram and led him out of Ur in Babylonia; you changed his name to Abraham.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ni ti jɛm o; bɛ ni ti yɛli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna niriba ti Duuma yɛla.
en: Our descendants will serve him. Those who are not yet born will be told about him.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, man ni zo n-kuli. Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Zom kuli. Di saha ka Ahimaaz daa ŋmaligi guui n-zo n-doli bɔpiɛligu polo nti gari Kush nir maa zuɣu.
en: I'll run no matter what! Ahimaaz insisted. All right then, run! Joab said. Ahimaaz took the road through the Jordan Valley and outran the Ethiopian.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, N ku tooi niŋ shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; n ni wum shɛm, dina ka m mali kariti saria, ka n sariakaribo maa mi nyɛla din tuhi, dama m bi bɔri mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka m bɔra.
en: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself.

dag: Ka o nyamma daa yɛligi ka o leei bundana.
en: He continued to prosper and became a very rich man.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pinaanahi ni kɔbisiyopɔin ka naanyi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Kɔra duŋ taabu ni la.
en: The number of people who died was . not counting those who died in Korah's rebellion.

dag: O yi daa tum a taali bee n-di a samli, nyin chɛ ka di dolila mani.
en: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to my account.

dag: Yawɛ ni pii so, ka o nyɛ ti nyɛviya vuhim ŋɔ, bɛ daa gbaag o bɛ bɔɣa ni chaŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ni daa yɛli ni ti ni kpe so mahim ni ka be dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: The LORDs chosen one, the very breath in our lungs, was caught in their traps— the one we used to talk about, saying, Under his protection we will live among the nations.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn lo ni bɛ kuli Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani maa, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ku ba, ka bɛ so ti ku kpalim bee n-tiligi alɔbo shɛli n ni yɛn chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu maa ni.
en: All the people who are determined to go and live in Egypt will die either in war or of starvation or disease. Not one of them will survive, not one will escape the disaster that I am going to bring on them.

dag: N wumla galimi shɛli din tu ma, m milinsi puuni ka n nya garigibu.
en: I hear teaching that insults me, but I am forced to answer based on my own understanding.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi kaman kurimbuni ha binyɛra buɣisibu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomon laid the foundations for these structures in order to build the temple of God. The length according to the old standard of measurement was ninety feet and the width thirty feet.

dag: N ni chaŋ nimaani ti nya bɛ shiri tumdi bɛ ni yɛri ni bɛ tumdi shɛm maa zaa bee bɛ bi tumdi li.
en: Now I am going down to see for myself if those people really are that bad. If they aren't, I would like to know.

dag: Anabinim bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni yi ka yi sanna ti wuhi ya shihirili bee alahiziba tuun shɛli.
en: A prophet or someone who explains dreams might come to you and tell you that they will show you a sign or a miracle.

dag: Ka n jilima yi ti garita, n ni zaŋ a niŋ tampiŋ maa lɔŋni, ka zaŋ n nuu pɔb a hal ti gari naai.
en: When the dazzling light of my presence passes by, I will put you in an opening in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ti lan laɣim ka Yisa sanna, ka daa ti lan ka bindirigu din ni di, ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba.
en: Another time there were many people with Jesus. The people had nothing to eat. So he called his followers to him and said.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Daniɛl, cham a chandi shee pumpɔŋɔ, dama yɛla ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn be ashilɔni n-sɔɣiya hal ti paai saha tariga.
en: He answered, You must go now, Daniel, because these words are to be kept secret and hidden until the end comes.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim ni ti pahi Ijiptinim mini Asirianim zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ zuliya ata niriba; ka bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka dunia zaa nya alibarika.
en: When that time comes, Israel will rank with Egypt and Assyria, and these three nations will be a blessing to all the world.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa na bi chaŋ alizanda ni, amaa ka daa yɛli: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: David didnt ascend into heaven. Yet he says, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side, .

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la pali zoya zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb la ti lu a daboya zuɣu min a vinvama ni ni a kɔsoya ni.
en: I will fill its highlands—your hills and your valleys, and all your ravines—with its slain. Those who are slain by the sword will fall on them.

dag: Lɔris anahi maa zaa puuni, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣa me goma, ka me daansi tabili goma maa m-pie taba ti gili.
en: All four had stone masonry all the way around, and hearths were built under this masonry all the way around.

dag: Di pala ninkura kɔŋko m-mali yɛm bee bɛn gbaai kpamli kɔŋko m-mi din tuhi.
en: The advanced in days arent wise; the old dont understand whats right.

dag: Chɛ ka o dabisa filim, ka so deeg o zaani zani.
en: Let his life be cut short, and let someone else take over his work.

dag: N niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ni n di di daanfaani.
en: All this I do for the gospel's sake, in order to share in its blessings.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kahig omaŋ wuhi Ijiptinima, ka bɛ baŋ o dindali maa ka jɛm o, ka bo pina mini sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti o. Bɛ ni ti pɔri pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka niŋ bɛ ni po ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm.
en: The Lord will reveal himself to the Egyptian people, and then they will acknowledge and worship him, and bring him sacrifices and offerings. They will make solemn promises to him and do what they promise.

dag: Ka salo maa daa yɛl o, Ti pun wum Naawuni zaligu puuni ni Masia ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ka wula ka a yɛli ni shee bɛ zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Daadam Bia maa.
en: The crowd said to Jesus, The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, n zaŋ n shia niŋ a nuu ni! O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o dii bahi.
en: Crying out in a loud voice, Jesus said, Father, into your hands I entrust my life . After he said this, he breathed for the last time.

dag: So yi bi pali alikauli ka tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani, ka di nyɛla o kpee n-zaŋ binshɛli puh o zalibu bee n-yɛl o ni o gul li, ka o ti yɔhim o bee o fala o kpee bee di yi nyɛla o zumi.
en: If you sin: by acting unfaithfully against the LORD; by deceiving a fellow citizen concerning a deposit or pledged property; by cheating a fellow citizen through robbery.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, labisim ti na yaha, ka ku a suhuyiɣisili la zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: Bring us back, O God our savior, and stop being displeased with us!.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya! Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: Show me a coin.Whose image and inscription does it have on it? Caesars, they replied.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Naa Dauda tiŋ la ni nanim silisi ni, dama o daa tum tuun suma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lan tum tuun suma ti Naawuni min o jɛmbu duu.
en: They buried him in the royal tombs in David's City in recognition of the service he had done for the people of Israel, for God, and for the Temple.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, di saha maa Juda ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa sabila gbana pam ti Tɔbaya, ka Tɔbaya gba daa sabi gbana ti ba.
en: During all this time the Jewish leaders had been in correspondence with Tobiah.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim Naawuni sani, dama di sabiya: Naawuni gbahiri yɛnnim la bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina puuni.
en: This worlds wisdom is foolishness to God. As its written, He catches the wise in their cleverness. .

dag: Ka ti bɔri ni yi zaa yinoyino kul moor o nini lala hal ti paai di tariga, ka di chɛ ka yi ni mali tahima binshɛl zuɣu la niŋ pali.
en: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.

dag: Bɛ tintariga daa kpuɣila Hɛlɛf zaŋ hal ti paai oki tia din be Zaananim la n-gari chaŋ hal ni Adaminɛkɛb mini Jabiniil m-mali lala hal ti paai Lakkum n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: The border of their land started at the large tree near Zaanannim. This is near Heleph. Then the border went through Adami Nekeb and Jabneel. It continued to Lakkum and ended at the Jordan River.

dag: Ka daɣila o kul yɛn kpaari ba mi ka chɛr o laŋa maa zaɣ kuŋ, ka kuri niriba ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun pa a niriba Izraɛlnim ni yino yi ti yi katiŋ na a yuli zuɣu.
en: Listen also to the immigrant who isnt from your people Israel but who comes from a distant country because of your reputation.

dag: Amaa ka a daa zaŋ binyɛra ŋɔ sɔɣ a suhu ni. M mi ni a nia ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: These things you hid in your heart; I know this is the case with you.

dag: O daa ku na kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He killed powerful kings; his love is eternal;.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee wuhi Naawuni o soli ni nyɛ shɛm, bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli Naawuni, A tum gala?.
en: Who has repaid him for his action, and who would ever say, Youve done wrong?.

dag: Ka Hakatan bia Jɔhanan daa nyɛ Azigad daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbiga ni pia daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Azgad: Johanan son of Hakkatan, and other men;.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi daa be Gɛba luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ Mikimash mini Aija ni Bɛtɛl ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: The people of Benjamin also lived from beyond Geba, at Michmash, Aija, Bethel and its villages.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma a yuli zuɣu. Wuhim ni n ka taali a kpiɔŋ zuɣu!.
en: Save me by your power, O God; set me free by your might!.

dag: N zali zaligu n nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa ni sokam lum Daniɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be, ka ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu. O nam maa kul ku saɣim, ka o yiko mi ku mali tariga.
en: I command that throughout my empire everyone should fear and respect Daniel's God. He is a living God, and he will rule forever. His kingdom will never be destroyed, and his power will never come to an end.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti saɣim yi wuna mini di binnan shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni dooi salima mini anzinfa pa, ka va li labi kaman binchɛr biɛr la ka yɛli, Wari ya.
en: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.

dag: A daa zaŋ nam tiŋgbana mini niriba ti ba, ka daa zaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei Hɛshibɔn din daa nyɛ Naa Sihɔn tiŋgbɔŋ la mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ la su.
en: You gave them kingdoms and nations, and you gave them faraway places where few people live. They got the land of King Sihon of Heshbon. They got the land of King Og of Bashan.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, O nyɛla Masia la. Ka shɛb mi bɔhi, Di wuhiya ni Masia yɛn yila Galili na?.
en: Others said, Hes the Christ. But others said, The Christ cant come from Galilee, can he?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli nachin kpɛm maa, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ daalibarika nir ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim ʒe sambani ŋɔ ni? Kpɛmina, dama m pun mali duu zal a, ka mali laakumnim ŋɔ gba biɛhigu shee zali.
en: Laban said, Sir, you are welcome to come in! You dont have to stand outside here. I have prepared a room for you to sleep in and a place for your camels.

dag: N daa fabindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zuɣu, ka m puu biɛri nandaamba zuɣu.
en: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din lu dahim ŋɔ, yilimi suhupiɛlli yila! Dama Yawɛ tilig o tiŋa, ka maag o niriba suhuri.
en: Break into song together, you ruins of Jerusalem! The LORD has comforted his people and has redeemed Jerusalem.

dag: Ka niriba daa jɛmdi waɣ biɛ titali maa, o ni daa zaŋ fukumsi din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ dini n-niŋ biŋkɔbigu la nuu ni zuɣu, ka bɛ daa jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu maa n-yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biŋkɔbigu ŋɔ bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tuh o tɔbu.
en: Everyone worshiped the dragon because he had given his authority to the beast. They worshiped the beast also, saying, Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it.

dag: daba ayopɔin m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di nyɛla laɣiŋgu tibisili; di ti tumiya tuma dindali maa.
en: For seven days you will offer food gifts to the LORD. On the eighth day you will have a holy occasion and must offer a food gift to the LORD. It is a holiday: you must not do any job-related work.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Sariakarita so n-daa be tinshee; o daa bi zɔri Naawuni, ka mi bi lan lihiri nyari daadam kam.
en: In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected people.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli nanim mini zuɣulaannim ni niriba bɛn pahi, Tuma maa galisiya ka di shɛhi wɔɣ ni taba, ka ti woliwoli taba gooni maa gbini.
en: Then I said to the officials, the officers, and the rest of the people, The work is very spread out, and we are far apart from each other along the wall.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka a min a yidan naai noli ni yi zahim ti Duuma Shia Kasi? Nyama, bɛn zaŋ a yidan yi nti sɔɣi n-na be soli kanna ŋɔ; bɛ ni zaŋ a gba yi.
en: So Peter said to her, Why did you and your husband decide to put the Lord's Spirit to the test? The men who buried your husband are at the door right now, and they will carry you out too.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛri be. Bɛ kul nyarila buni pahiri ka di bi to.
en: Those proud people are wicked, but they are rich and getting richer.

dag: dama bɛ yi yɛl a, Dum zuɣusaa ŋɔ na, di so ni bɛ filim a ninvuɣ titali tooni.
en: It is better to be asked to take a higher position than to be told to give your place to someone more important.

dag: Paɣa, ka pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba. Ka di pa ni n sabirila zaligu palli tir a, amaa di nyɛla ti ni daa pun deei shɛli piligu ni la.
en: And now, dear lady, I tell you: We should all love each other. This is not a new command. It is the same command we had from the beginning.

dag: o yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka bi niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka bi zaŋdi o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tuma ni, ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli m-maani niriba bɛn zabi yɛtɔɣa.
en: If someone wants to borrow money from him, he lends the money and doesnt charge interest on the loan. He refuses to be crooked. He is always fair with everyone. People can trust him.

dag: Bɛ ku lan jɛm buɣa, bɛ mi ku lan tum tuun galima n-saɣim bɛmaŋa bee n-kpe bɛ biriginsim ni. N ni tiligi ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ni, ka yihi ba daɣiri ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will not defile themselves with disgusting idols any more or corrupt themselves with sin. I will free them from all the ways in which they sin and betray me. I will purify them; they will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Kukol shɛli n-kuhiri yɛra: Malimiya soli mɔɣu ni ti Yawɛ! Malimiya soli maa tiŋgban nɛli ni ka di tuhi ti ti Naawuni maa!.
en: A voice cries out, Prepare in the wilderness a road for the Lord ! Clear the way in the desert for our God!.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nyɛ anabi zuɣu ka o daa mi ni Naawuni pun lo o alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ o zuliya ni ninvuɣ so leei naa ka o zani o zaani.
en: Because he was a prophet, he knew that God promised him with a solemn pledge to seat one of his descendants on his throne.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o niriba, Gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma! Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba zaɣ nɛma n-ku ba Bɛtɛkɛd bɔɣili gbini. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinahinaayi. Ka bɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ ni zaɣ yino gba.
en: Jehu ordered his men, Take them alive! They seized them, and he put them to death near a pit there. There were forty-two people in all, and not one of them was left alive.

dag: Amaa o daa timdi anabinim bɛ sani ni bɛ ti chɛ ka bɛ labi ŋun Yawɛ sanna. Ka anabinim maa daa saɣisi ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.

dag: Dama Sulemaana daa ŋmaligi dolila Sidɔnnim buɣili Asitati din nyɛ paɣ la mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Milikom din nyɛ daɣiri la.
en: He worshiped Astarte, the goddess of Sidon, and Molech, the disgusting god of Ammon.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani Pasidamim saha shɛli Filistianim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim chi puu ni ka Izraɛlnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ba la.
en: Eleazar was with David at Pasdammim. The Philistines had come to that place to fight a war. There was a field full of barley there. The Israelites ran away from the Philistines.

dag: Ka niriba bɔhira, Bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti? Ka yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ yɛl ti? Bihi bɛn ŋmaai bihili kɔŋko ka o yɛligu ni sɔŋ?.
en: The people say, Who does he think he is trying to teach and explain his message to? Does he think we are babies who were at their mothers breast only a very short time ago?.

dag: A ni ti kpi ni suhudoo. Bɛ ni daa tuɣili a yaannim bɛn daa daŋ a tooni n-nyɛ nanim la tulaale zim shɛm, lala ka bɛ ni ti tuɣili a gba tulaale zim, ka fabili a zuɣu yɛli, Mbaye ti dana. Dama mani n yɛli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa be bɛ ni daa kpiri kɔre pam; ka Izraɛlnim gba daa lan kum ka yɛli, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi.
en: The foreigners who had joined the Israelites began wanting other things to eat. Soon all the Israelites began complaining again. The people said, We want to eat meat!.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ sanna ti di bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini biŋkpam la zaa sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu; niriba maa zaa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ tahi ka lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Fire flew out from before the LORD and devoured the entirely burned offering and the fat pieces on the altar. All the people saw it. They shouted for joy and fell facedown.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, Ti ninkura mini ti bipola zaa ni ti bidibisi mini ti bipuɣinsi zaa zaŋ tabili ti biŋkɔbbaligu mini ti niɣi zaa. Dama ti yɛn chaŋmi ti puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Moses answered, All of our people, young and old, will go. And we will take our sons and daughters, and our sheep and cattle with us. We will all go because the Lord s festival is for all of us.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so daa ti nya Pita ni ʒi buɣim maa neesim ni n-lihir o ka ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ gba yi be Yisa sani.
en: and a servant girl saw him. Then after she had looked at him carefully, she said, This man was with Jesus.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ yuya nyɛviyanim litaafi la ni, ka di chɛ ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya pahi wuntizɔriba yuya ni.
en: Erase their names from the book of life. Dont let their names appear on the list of those who do what is right.

dag: Tummiya tuma daba ayɔbu, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la dali, yin vuhimiya, ka chɛ ka yi niɣi mini yi bunsi ni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb yi yinsi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa vuhi dindali maa.
en: Work for six days, but on the seventh day, rest! This will allow your slaves and other workers a time to rest and relax. And your bulls and donkeys will also have a time of rest.

dag: Bɛ ni teei wula, ka bɛ viɛlim ti ŋman olivi tihi viɛlim. Ka bɛ nyom ti viɛl kaman Lɛbanɔn nyom la.
en: They will be alive with new growth, and beautiful like olive trees. They will be fragrant like the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baai bɛ bandi la, ka chihi bɛ mihi la ti niŋgbuna ni.
en: They say, Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free.

dag: Chu shɛli din yuli booni Yaɣigari Chuɣu ka lan booni Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu daa ti miri.
en: The Festival of Unleavened Bread, which is called Passover, was approaching.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa bi tam Nuhu mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni la yɛla. Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛna, ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu.
en: God did not forget about Noah and the animals with him in the boat. So God made a wind blow, and the water started going down.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni maar a suhu shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din pɔr a sani, bee zilimballi yɛtɔɣa maa m-pa shɛli a sani?.
en: God offers you comfort; why still reject it? We have spoken for him with calm, even words.

dag: Bɛ kul bela nimaani n-yaari bɛ noya kumda, ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri bɛ noya ni na. Bɛ tɛhiya, Ŋuni n-lee ni wum ti ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to their threats and insults. They say such cruel things, and they dont care who hears them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka n ni ti nyu di zaɣ palli Naawuni nam ni.
en: I tell you, I will never again drink this wine until the day I drink the new wine in the Kingdom of God.

dag: Bɛn daa gbahi ti maa daa yɛli ti mi ni ti yilim yila, ka bɛn daa nahindi ti maa daa yɛli ti ni ti yilimi yila ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim, ka yɛra, Yilimiya Ziɔn yilli ka ti wum.
en: There in Babylon, those who captured us told us to sing. Our enemies told us to entertain them. They said, Sing us one of your songs about Zion.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam. O paɣibu yɛla kul ni be n nol ni sahakam.
en: I will praise the Lord at all times. I will never stop singing his praises.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti kpalim Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.

dag: Di saha n ni ti chɛ ka di koma niŋ viɛlim, ka chɛ ka di kulibɔna kom zɔri kaman kpam la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The water will be clear, and streams will be calm. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma maa ni zaŋdi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi chani Sharɔn bɔpiɛligu ni mini Akɔr Vinvamli ni ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: They will worship me and will lead their sheep and cattle to pasture in the Plain of Sharon in the west and in Trouble Valley in the east.

dag: Amaa n na ʒi n-zo ka chɛ piɛgulibo din nyɛ a ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti ma maa bee m-bɔri ni zaɣ biɛɣu paa ba. A mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yiri n nol ni na; dama di daa niŋla a ninni.
en: Lord, I did not run away from you. I followed you. I became the shepherd you wanted. I did not want the terrible day to come. You know what I said. You see all that is happening.

dag: N ni woligi n niriba ka chɛ a niriba. Biɛɣuni ka alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ sa yɛn tum. .
en: I will make a distinction between my people and your people. This miracle will take place tomorrow.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a lee nyuri bara zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni? Naawuni nirilim niŋbu kul benimi sahakam. Dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Why do you boast, great one, of your evil? God's faithfulness is eternal.

dag: ni ago sabilifaa ni ago ʒiɛkpeein ni ago ʒiɛkpain ni ago piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: blue, purple, and red yarn and fine linen; goat hair;.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka ŋun daa su bɛ fukumsi maa kul tiri ba la tarim bindirigu maa ka chɛ Naa ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tim ba bindir shɛŋa mini binnyur shɛl la.
en: After this, the guard let them eat vegetables instead of the rich food and wine.

dag: Bɛ ni daa me birini gili fɔŋ kar shɛŋa n-nyɛ: Zidim mini Zɛr ni Hammat ni Rakat ni Kinɛrɛt.
en: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth.

dag: ka bi zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ dunol ni na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ, dilan nyɛla ŋun mali taali nyɛvili dibu ni, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi dilan o niriba ni.
en: but does not bring it to the meeting tents entrance to present it as an offering to the LORD in front of the LORDs dwelling will be considered guilty of bloodshed; they have spilled blood. They will be cut off from their people.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla paɣa, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihita.
en: If the person is a female, her value is thirty shekels.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa wuh o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, amaa man ni ʒili ya ʒi tibisa gari lala. M ba daa malila barazim saɣisiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi saɣisiri ya.
en: and instead followed the young peoples advice. He said, My father made your workload heavy, but Ill make it even heavier; my father disciplined you with whips, but Ill do it with scorpions.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa nyarila o ninni ni nyaɣisira, ka o zaŋ sariga pili lir li, naɣila o ti lan chaŋ ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka Otiniɛl daa kpam o jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na; ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Now when she arrived, she prodded Othniel into asking for a field from her father. After she got down off her donkey, Caleb asked her, What do you want.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbia mini ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ tinzun nira m-be bɛ sani zaa, zaligu yini maa ka a yɛn zali bɛ ni ŋun chirim.
en: There will be one set of instructions for the Israelite citizen and the immigrant residing with you for anyone who commits an unintentional sin.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka bi saɣi ka naɣ yɛli ma mi, Di saɣiya, di lan yɛli ma yɛlli ŋɔ yaha.
en: But the LORD was angry with me because of you! He wouldnt listen to me. He said to me: Thats enough from you! Dont ever ask me about this again!.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa ku maai, faashee o niŋla o ni lo o suhu ni ni o niŋ shɛli maa. Dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ka yi ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: The LORDs fierce anger wont turn back until Gods purposes are entirely accomplished. In the days to come, you will understand what this means.

dag: O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ sariakaritiba doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ti bɛn ʒe dunɔdali gbini kariti bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti liri ba la suhukpeeni.
en: He will give a sense of justice to those who serve as judges, and courage to those who defend the city gates from attack.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ li n dabili Musa sani, n zaŋla n niriba zaa fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni.
en: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu ni yi zaa gbib naŋgban yini ka woligibu ku kpe yi sunsuuni, amaa ka yi naɣ ni zaŋla yi noya naai taba m-mali tɛhi yini ni naŋgban yini.
en: Brothers and sisters, by the authority of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg all of you to agree with each other. You should not be divided into different groups. Be completely joined together again with the same kind of thinking and the same purpose.

dag: Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Hezekiah did what was right in the LORDs eyes, just as his ancestor David had done.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani Bɛtɛl ti jɛmdi salima naɣibil din be nimaani la; ka shɛb mi chani hal Dan nti jɛmdi salima naɣibil ŋun la. Ka niriba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa leeg alahichi.
en: What a terrible sin this was, because the Israelites started going to the cities of Dan and Bethel to worship the calves.

dag: M bɔri ni yi yi yɛla muɣisigu puuni. Ŋun ka paɣa baɣa bela ti Duuma yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o nini;.
en: I want you to be free from concerns. A man who isnt married is concerned about the Lords concerns—how he can please the Lord.

dag: Dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam hal ka nir ni tooi ʒe luɣ kasi shee din be Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa tooni la ka lihi nya di zuɣuri mini di nyoya, amaa nir yi be samban ni, o ku tooi nya li, ka dapuhi maa na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The poles were so long that they could be seen from right outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.

dag: Ka di daa ti Yɛhudianim suhupiɛlli mini tahima din wuhi ni bɛ di nasara.
en: For the Jews there was joy and relief, happiness and a sense of victory.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka ninsalitali biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka n yi kul bɔri ni n tum din tuhi, zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu n-nyɛ din miriti ma.
en: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.

dag: N dabisa zɔri yomyom gari tizɔra; di kul zɔrimi gariti ka zaɣ viɛlli ka di ni.
en: My days are passing faster than a runner. They are flying by without any joy.

dag: Zaŋmiya tiliginsim kaman tɔbutuhir zuɣupila la pili, ka zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu din nyɛ Shia Kasi takɔb la gbibi.
en: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.

dag: ka zaŋ n ni daa be muɣisigu ni ka yaai n noli yɛli binshɛli yɛla, ka lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ li ti a la ti a.
en: the ones my lips uttered, the ones my mouth spoke when I was in deep trouble.

dag: Ka yɛra, M Ba, m Ba, binshɛɣukam nand a sani. Vuum pipia ŋɔ ka chɛ ma; amaa chɛ ka a yubu niŋ, pa n dini.
en: Father, he prayed, my Father! All things are possible for you. Take this cup of suffering away from me. Yet not what I want, but what you want.

dag: Mishima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamuɛl mini Zakur ni Shimɛi.
en: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani palo ni daa galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ daa ŋmaai di shɛli polo ti Simiɔn zuliya niriba; ka Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa puuni.
en: Since Judah's assignment was larger than was needed, part of its territory was given to the tribe of Simeon.

dag: dama kaman nir ni kahim bihim ka bihikpam yirina shɛm ni nir ni yi ŋmahim nyee pam ka ʒim yirina shɛm, lala ka suhuyiɣisili pam gba tahiri zabili na.
en: because churning milk makes curds, squeezing the nose brings blood, and stirring up anger produces strife.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Naawuni, N tum alahichi pam n ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛl mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali, dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: Then David said to God, I have sinned greatly in what I have done! Now please take away the guilt of your servant because I have done something very foolish.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu di niŋ ma nyaɣisim n ni daa ka nimaani maa zuɣu, dama dina n-ni chɛ ka yi niŋ yɛda. Ka yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o sani.
en: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka Naawuni deei li ka di leeg o daalahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You must put your hand on the animals head while it is being killed. So the Lord will accept it as your burnt offering to make you pure.

dag: N ni yɛli sarikanima, N tin ya yolisim! Ka yɛli bɛn be zibisim ni, Kamiya neesim ni na! Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn be zoya zuɣu tiŋgban nɛl ni ŋubiri mɔri la.
en: You will tell the prisoners, Come out of your prison! You will tell those who are in darkness, Come out of the dark! The people will eat along the road, and they will have food even on empty hills.

dag: Baa ni yi gbuɣi, ka lan labi ti dir li shɛm la, lala ka jɛrigu labir o jɛrilim tuma ni.
en: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.

dag: Ti nyɛviya dabisa nyɛla yuun pisopɔin, ka ti yi mali yaa, di ni niŋ yuun pihinii; amaa di yuma maa zaa tiri ti la wahala mini suhugarigu; ka di ku yuui ka di naai ka vuui.
en: We live about years or, if we are strong, years. But most of them are filled with hard work and pain. Then, suddenly, the years are gone, and we fly away.

dag: M bi bɔri jilima ninsalinim sani.
en: I dont want praise from you or any other human.

dag: amaa ka o daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa. Bɛ daa kul ʒiɛla tiŋ maa dunol kam ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa gu ni bɛ ku o.
en: but he was told of their plan. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih ayopɔin la zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and pounds with each lamb.

dag: N chaŋmi kaman zaawuni shilinshia la. Bɛ pihigi ma mi bahi kaman sakɔɣu la.
en: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.

dag: Di saha ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa kana ti labi Mikaya tapaɣa ka bɔh o, So dini ka Yawɛ shia maa lee doli yi n ni n-kana ti yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Then the prophet Zedekiah went up to Micaiah, slapped his face, and asked, Since when did the Lord 's spirit leave me and speak to you.

dag: Hal yi yi nyaŋ Babilɔn tɔbbi shɛb bɛn tuhiri ya maa zaa, ka di ti kpalimla bɛn nya dansi kɔŋko bɛ suɣa ni gba, bɛ ni yiɣisina ti nyo ya ŋɔ buɣim. .
en: People of Jerusalem, even if you could defeat all the Babylonian army that is attacking you, there would still be a few wounded men left in their tents. Even those few wounded men would come out of their tents and burn Jerusalem down.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛɣu birigiya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nia viɛla nyari jilima mini ʒiɛyimtali niriba sani.
en: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.

dag: Lala zuɣu ti suhuri saɣimmi; dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ti nina fulimmi.
en: For this reason, our hearts have become sick, and our eyes cannot see clearly.

dag: Ka ŋmana maa zaa daa ti pali; ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa ni yino, Zaŋm ŋman shɛl na. Ka o yɛl o, Ŋman shɛl lan kani. Ka kpam maa mi dii ŋmaai, ka bi lan yirina.
en: She filled many bowls. Finally, she said to her son, Bring me another bowl. But all the bowls were full. One of the sons said to her, There arent any more bowls. Then the oil in the jar was finished!.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa, dama di nyɛla dabisili din be kasi yi sani, ka ninvuɣ so yi bi gbib li, bɛn kum o. Ŋunkam tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn yihim dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yisifu zuliya, o daa bi pii Ifriim zuliya.
en: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.

dag: Amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n ni laɣim yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa na kaman piɛri bɛn yi mɔɣu ni na ni bɛ ti kpe buzɔŋ ni la. Niriba ni ti lan pali yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu ni be mɔri ŋubbu shee shɛm la.
en: But I will gather you together, all you people of Israel that are left. I will bring you together like sheep returning to the fold. Like a pasture full of sheep, your land will once again be filled with many people.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka gɔhi bili m puu ni, ka pa ni alikama, ka chɛ ka yihim bili ka pa ni chi. Ayuba yɛtɔɣa tariga m-bala.
en: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi dimnim nyaŋ ya. Yi ni ti doli so yini chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi ba, amaa ka ni ti ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-zo n-doli soya ayopɔin. Yi ni ti leei dunia nanim zaa ni je shɛba.
en: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima m-pahi malaikanim zaa, o ni ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee din mali jilima pam.
en: When the Son of Man comes as King and all the angels with him, he will sit on his royal throne.

dag: Ka Jɔshua garigi yɛli ba, Yi yi galisi pam, ka Ifriim zuliya niriba zoya tiŋgban la pɔri ka bi saɣi ya, yin chamiya Pɛrizinim mini Rɛfaimnim tiŋgban ni yɔɣu la ni nti ŋma nyɔŋ ʒini.
en: Then Joshua said, Yes, you are a numerous people. So go up to the forest and clear ground for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaim, because the Ephraimite highland is too small for you.

dag: Bɛ daa mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli o muɣisigu maa ni. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli o zuliya yɛla? Dama bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: In his humiliation justice was taken away from him. Who can tell the story of his descendants because his life was taken from the earth? .

dag: Kɔnsi maa ni daa mali ti paai sansani maa ni, bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla tanti suɣ yin ni nti di ka nyu, ka kpuɣi anzinfa mini salima ni situra n-chaŋ ti sɔɣi; ka lan lab ti kpe tanti suɣ shɛl ni yaha nti kpuɣi neen shɛŋa ti lan sɔɣi.
en: When the four men reached the edge of the camp, they went into a tent, ate and drank what was there, grabbed the silver, gold, and clothing they found, and went off and hid them; then they returned, entered another tent, and did the same thing.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka niriba ni ti yɛra, Yawɛ, ti paɣir a! A suhu daa yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu, amaa pumpɔŋɔ a suhu maaya, ka a lan kpaŋsi ti.
en: At that time you will say, I praise you, Lord ! You have been angry with me, but dont be angry with me now. Show your love to me.

dag: Ka ŋun Musa daa zaŋ o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu n-zaŋ o leei toondana kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bin yini ka m bɔri ni n suh a; a mi di mɔŋ ma li.
en: Now I have just one request of you. Dont refuse me! She said to him, Go on.

dag: Paɣ maa yi dɔɣila bipuɣiŋga, o ni be daɣiri ni biɛɣu pinaanahi kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la. Di nyaaŋa o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: But if the woman gives birth to a daughter, she will be unclean for two weeks—just as she is during her menstrual period—and will be in a state of blood purification for sixty-six days.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn ti bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Asha zuliya. Asha niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Okiran bia Pagiɛl.
en: Those camping on one side of him are the tribe of Asher. The chief of the people of Asher is Pagiel, Ochrans son.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na ti yɛli ba, Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni wuhiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bɔhimmiya li ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Moses called out to all Israel, saying to them: Israel! Listen to the regulations and the case laws that Im recounting in your hearing right now. Learn them and carefully do them.

dag: O daa suhi Naawuni, ka Naawuni daa wum o fabila ka deeg o suhigu maa, ka daa lan zaŋ o labisi Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ o nam maa ni yaha. Di saha ka Manaasa daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: Manasseh prayed to God and begged him for help. God heard his begging and felt sorry for him, so he let Manasseh return to Jerusalem and to his throne. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord was the true God.

dag: Amaa ka Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la mini Tɔbaya ŋun mi daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tumtumdiba zuɣulan la daa wum ni ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti tum tuun shɛli din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima, ka di daa bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim zaa.
en: Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what I was doing. They were very upset and angry that someone had come to help the Israelites.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa baŋ ni bɛ leei Dauda dimnim maa, ka bɛ daa chaŋ Sirianim tinsi ni Bɛtirɛhɔb mini Zɔba nti da Sirianim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn nyɛ tinchandiba tuhi pisi, ka Maaka naa daa yina ni tɔbbihi tuhili, ka Tɔbinim gba daa yina ni tɔbbihi tuhi pinaayi.
en: The Ammonites saw that they had become Davids enemies, so they hired Arameans from Beth Rehob and Zobah. There were , Aramean foot soldiers. The Ammonites also hired the king of Maacah with men and , men from Tob.

dag: ka yɛli, Lala ka Babilɔn ti yɛn shim ka ku lan puhi na yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa lu di zuɣu maa zuɣu. Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa maa tariga m-bala.
en: This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again. Jeremiah's writing ends here.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa yu ni bɛ niŋ lala, ka di mi shiri simdi ni bɛ niŋ lala ti ba, dama bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi daa nya Naawuni alibarika Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zuɣu, dindina di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba zaŋ dunia ŋɔ binyara sɔŋ ba.
en: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni ti tum ŋun tim ma na maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli wuntaŋ ni na be ŋɔ, dama yuŋ ni zibi ka so ku lan tooi tum tuma yaha.
en: As long as it is day, we must do the work of him who sent me; night is coming when no one can work.

dag: Ka Tama daa chaŋ o tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa ka o ti domi. Ka o daa niŋ zim ŋɔri mahibiɛli m-mali maha o nini maa ni.
en: She went there and found him in bed. She took some dough, prepared it, and made some cakes there where he could see her. Then she baked the cakes.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka jɛra gbibi liɣiri ni bɛ da yɛm, ka lee nyɛ bɛn ka yɛm din ni tooi bɔhim?.
en: Money is wasted on fools. They cannot buy wisdom when they have no sense.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: Zedekiah did evil things, just as King Jehoiakim had done. The Lord did not like Zedekiah doing those evil things.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhiɛl bia Shɛkania ŋun daa yi Ɛlam daŋ ni na la daa yɛli Ɛzra, Tinima n-zaɣisi ti Naawuni noli ka kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba sani, amaa di zaa yoli, Izraɛlnim na kul mali tahima.
en: Then Shecaniah, Jehiels son, from the family of Elam, spoke up and said to Ezra, Weve been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the neighboring peoples. But even now, there is hope for Israel in spite of this.

dag: ka yi ti bo bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ bipuɣinsi maa ni ti jɛmdi bɛ buɣa maa, ka yi bidibisi maa gba ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa.
en: Your men will even marry their women and be influenced to worship their gods.

dag: Yinim Aduna zuliya, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ayuba bidibisi maa min o bipuɣinsi maa daa ti be bɛ biɛlikpɛm yiŋa n-diri bindira ka nyuri wain;.
en: One day when Job's children were having a feast at the home of their oldest brother.

dag: Nyama, n ni kpihim nyin Baasha min a daŋ niriba zaa birili; ka niŋ a yiŋa kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋ shɛm la.
en: So Baasha, I will destroy you and your family, just as I did Jeroboam son of Nebat and his family.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli, ka nyɛ luɣ gahindili luɣ kasi shee tiŋgbani maa ni. Di ni ti nyɛla luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee n-tuɣi Lɛvinim tiŋgbani.
en: It belongs to them as a most special portion of the land, a most holy place, up to the border of the Levites.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino chuɣu puhibu binyɛra, amaa ka daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita mini chuɣu puhibu binyɛra ata ti Bɛnjamin.
en: He also gave each of them a change of clothes, but he gave Benjamin three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothes.

dag: Di saha ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zahim paɣiri la daa dii yi o nina ni luna, ka o nina maa dii neei. Ka o daa yiɣisi deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Immediately, something that looked like fish scales fell off Sauls eyes. He was able to see! Then he got up and was baptized.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: May grace be with all of you.

dag: O zaŋ m malibu chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n leei sana bɛn daa mi ma la zaa sani.
en: God has made my brothers hate me. Those who knew me have become strangers.

dag: N ni yili yil palli paɣi nyin Naawuni. N ni ŋme mɔɣilo din mali mihi pia paɣ a.
en: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.

dag: Ka Iso bɔh o ba, M ba, ka daɣila alibarika zaɣ yini kɔŋko ka a kul mali? M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni. Ka Iso daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: Father, Esau asked, don't you have more than one blessing? You can surely give me a blessing too! Then Esau started crying again.

dag: ka minya ni ninsal ni tum tuun suŋ shɛlikam, o ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, o yi nyɛla dabili bee bilichina.
en: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.

dag: Shɛli daa bi poori bɛ ni so, dama bɛnkam daa mali puri bee yiya daa kɔhi li mi n-zaŋ di liɣiri maa zaa na.
en: None of them could say they needed anything. Everyone who owned fields or houses sold them. They brought the money they got.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɔhi Sool zuɣu, ka zaŋ Dauda so o ni daa di shɛhira suŋ la leei bɛ naa. Naawuni daa yɛliya, N nya Jɛsi bia Dauda ka o nyɛla n nin ni tiɣ so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ni tum n yubu zaa.
en: After God removed him, he raised up David to be their king. God testified concerning him, I have found David, Jesses son, a man who shares my desires. Whatever my will is, he will do.

dag: Bɛ ni tarigi lɛb lu, amaa tinim ni yiɣisimi ʒe tibi.
en: Such people will stumble and fall, but we will rise and stand firm.

dag: ka Shɛmɛr nyɛ Mahili bia, ka Mahili nyɛ Mushi bia, ka Mushi nyɛ Mɛrari bia, ka Mɛrari mi nyɛ Lɛvi bia.
en: son of Mahli son of Mushi son of Merari son of Levi.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti lan yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la jɛmbu, ka taɣi deela wuna n-gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi li la zuɣu ka o chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa. .
en: People will answer, It is because they abandoned the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt. They gave their allegiance to other gods and worshiped them. That is why the Lord has brought this disaster on them.

dag: O daa lan mali kpa shɛli din be kasi shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni, ka lan mali tulaale zim alali din nyom viɛla kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi tiri mmaŋ jilima, n jilima maa nyɛla yoli; m Ba so yi ni yɛli ni o nyɛla yi Naawuni la n-tiri ma jilima.
en: Jesus replied, If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God.

dag: Bindir maŋli nyɛla ninkura bɛn zaŋ bɛ tɛha bɔhim baŋ zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu ni nyɛ shɛm dini.
en: But solid food is for people who have grown up. From their experience they have learned to see the difference between good and evil.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi n-tab Yisa maa bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa.
en: Leaning back toward Jesus, this disciple asked, Lord, who is it.

dag: Pinimiya zuɣukpina, yi ni yuri yi bi shɛb la zuɣu. Pinimiya zuɣukpina ka di be kaman juɣu zuɣu la, dama bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni.
en: So cut off your hair, make yourself bald, because you will cry for the children you love. Make yourself bald like an eagle and show your sadness, because your children will be taken away from you.

dag: Niŋmi ba kaman buɣim ni diri nyɔŋ shɛm la, bee kaman buɣim niɛm ni taari diri zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: As fire burns the forest, as flames set the hills on fire.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛra zaani zaashe kara ni, ka zaŋdi bundaannim zaani tarimba zaashee.
en: Stupid people are given positions of authority while the rich are ignored.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi puuni, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili n-deei li.
en: Assyrias King Sennacherib marched against all of Judahs fortified cities and captured them in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma n suhusaɣiŋgu saha. Gbilisim tibili wum, ka garigi ma yomyom n ni suhir a saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Dont hide your face from me in my time of trouble! Listen to me! Answer me quickly as I cry out!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɔri ni bɛ mali Naawuni sizuura lubu biɛhigu Yisa Masia zuɣu ni bahi nya alaka.
en: Everyone who wants to live a godly life in union with Christ Jesus will be persecuted;.

dag: Bɛtani do so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa ti biɛra. O min o tizɔpaɣiba Mariama mini Maata zaa ya n-daa bala.
en: A man named Lazarus, who lived in Bethany, became sick. Bethany was the town where Mary and her sister Martha lived. .

dag: Sool suhu daa na kul yiɣisiri bahirila ti Duuma nyaandoliba zuɣu, ka kul kpɛhiri ba dabiɛm ni o ni ku ba; ka daa chaŋ maligumaaniba zuɣulan sani.
en: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest.

dag: O daa lan mali teebuya pia n-zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, diba anu nudirigu polo, diba anu din la mi nuzaa polo, ka mali salima taha kɔbiga.
en: He also made ten tables and placed them in the main room, five on each side. And he made small gold sprinkling bowls.

dag: O daa ku do shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be o ba Asa ʒiɛman ni, ka nyɛ bɛn laɣim tumdi dagɔr tuma la.
en: He got rid of all the male and female prostitutes serving at the pagan altars who were still left from the days of his father Asa.

dag: N di yuya ni a zaŋ ma sɔɣi kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka a zaŋ ma sɔɣi nimaani hal ka a suhu ti maai, ka a di zali ma saha shɛli a ni yɛn teei n yɛla.
en: I wish you would hide me in the world of the dead; let me be hidden until your anger is over, and then set a time to remember me.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di yɛn niŋ? Dim suɣilo. Zom a daba nambɔɣu.
en: How much longer will your anger last? Have pity, O Lord , on your servants!.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo ŋɔ na. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tin ya ka yi nyuri bara bɛ zuɣu la lee be ya?.
en: Jerusalem, look! The enemy is coming from the north ! Where is the flock you were once in charge of? That beautiful flock is gone now.

dag: bɔzuɣu ka nyini zo shɛli dim mali chunchuna ŋɔ lihiri Naawuni ni bɔri ni zo shɛli nyɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ nyuli zabbu lihigu? Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bɔri ni o be sahakam.
en: Why from your mighty peaks do you look with scorn on the mountain on which God chose to live? The Lord will live there forever!.

dag: ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: They long for places of honor in the synagogues and at banquets.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumda gbilisiri tibili wumdi ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiŋmara mi gbilisiri tibili wumdi yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: An evildoer pays attention to guilty lips; a liar listens to a destructive tongue.

dag: Di simdi ka firilatamdigu maa ti mali jaba ayɔbu di luɣa zuɣu; jaba ata yaɣ yini polo, jaba ata yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: with three branches on each of its two sides.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana ka yuri wuntia tuma. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi n-nyɛ bɛn ni tooi nya o ni bɛ nini.
en: because the LORD is righteous! He loves righteous deeds. Those whose heart is right will see Gods face.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun mali shɛhira suŋ bɛn be kpaŋ sani, di yi pa lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti tum vi tuma, ka Sintani zana gbaag o.
en: An elder must also have the respect of people who are not part of the church. Then he will not be criticized by others and be caught in the devils trap.

dag: Yɛlim Yaakubu zuliya dimbɔŋɔ, molimi li Juda:.
en: Declare this to the people of Jacob, announce it in Judah.

dag: Daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa pa shɛli o sani; ŋuna n-su malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi. Ka so ku tooi goog o ka o chɛ o ni bɔri shɛli niŋbu bee m-bɔh o, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala?.
en: People on earth are not really important. God does what he wants with the powers of heaven and the people on earth. No one can stop his powerful hand or question what he does.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-nyɛ ti ni pun be so sani ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.

dag: Kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya yi ni niŋ tuuba zuɣu, amaa ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n kpuɣ o namda gbibi. Ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: I baptize you with water to show that you have repented, but the one who will come after me will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire. He is much greater than I am; and I am not good enough even to carry his sandals.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋ, ka bɛ nina ku nya shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri mi ku baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ labi n sanna, ka n tib ba.
en: God made the people blind. He closed their minds. He did this so that they would not see with their eyes and understand with their minds. He did it so that they would not turn and be healed. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka Keenan paɣ so ŋun daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni daa ka Yisa sanna ti kuhiri yɛra, N Duuma ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi m bipuɣiŋga zuɣu m-muɣisir o pam.
en: A Canaanite woman who lived in that region came to him. Son of David! she cried out. Have mercy on me, sir! My daughter has a demon and is in a terrible condition.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣira ata maa daa chaŋ ti tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm samban ni dunɔdali shee kɔbiliga maa ni ti tooi kom maa na ti ti Dauda ni o nyu. Amaa ka o daa bi nyu li, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: The Three Warriors sneaked through the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. They took it back to David, but he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured out the water as a sacrifice to the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa, ka zaŋ li niŋ o baɣaka.
en: Instead, he turned and went back to his palace without paying any attention even to this.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa chɛ kumsi, ka bɛ yɛli ba, Fomiya ka di chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla dabisili kasi.
en: The Levites went around calming the people and telling them not to be sad on such a holy day.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa be nimaani maa ka anab so ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa yi Judia na.
en: We had been there for several days when a prophet named Agabus arrived from Judea.

dag: O ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi li niŋ Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: All the other events of his reign, from beginning to end, are recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Ka o yɛl o, A mi ni su tins anu fukumsi.
en: To this one he said, You will be in charge of five cities.

dag: Lihimiya yi yab Ibrahimma mini Zaratu bɛn dɔɣi ya la. N daa piig o ka o nyɛla o ko, amaa ka n daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka o tuŋ teei.
en: Look to Abraham your ancestor, and to Sarah, who gave you birth. They were alone when I called them, but I blessed them and made them many.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di sabigi di paɣibu maa nyaaŋa, ŋun cheem di ni be situra maa ni luɣ shɛli maa bee gbaŋ maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bahi.
en: But if the spot has faded after being washed, he will tear away the spot.

dag: N daa lan zaŋ salima lahi pisi din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram anii ni pirigili ni daanya viɛlli lah ayi shɛŋa bɛ ni malimali, ka di mini salima viɛlim nyɛ yim.
en: And I gave them gold bowls. The bowls weighed about pounds. And I gave them two beautiful dishes made from polished bronze that were as valuable as gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn zaa be bɛ tiŋ maa ni laɣim yi n-kari doli Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi maa. Bɛ ni daa kariti doli Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ainim maa n-yi kpaŋ ka chɛ bɛ tin maa.
en: All the men in the city had been called together to go after them, and as they pursued Joshua, they kept getting farther away from the city.

dag: Ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be yinim bundaannim ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi pun di yi nyaɣisim.
en: But how terrible for you who are rich now; you have had your easy life!.

dag: Lihimiya nya bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa nyɛla din viɛl bee din bie, ka nya bɛ ni be fɔntin shɛŋa ni lee nyɛla tin yari bee di nyɛla bɛ ni me goma gili shɛŋa.
en: Learn about the land that they live in. Is it good land or bad land? What kind of towns do they live in? Do the towns have walls protecting them? Are the towns strongly defended?.

dag: Mɛshɛk mini Tubal beni, ka di tɔbbihi gbala yɛrigi di ni zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn bi guni. Takɔbi ka bɛ zaŋ ku ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The graves of soldiers from Meshech and Tubal are there. These godless soldiers who terrified people were all killed in battle.

dag: Hal Babilɔnnim yi du zuɣusaa ti me goondahi gili bɛmaŋa, n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba yi n sani chaŋ ti liri ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka so yi mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa, bɛn zaŋm o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: If any of you have a dreaded skin disease, you shall be brought to the priest.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiɛm wuhibu ni bo bahiyoli ti bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn tiri zaligu jilima ni nya laara.
en: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka di chɛ ka yi ni pun tum shɛli zuɣu la ku yi yi nuu ni, amaa ka di lee chɛ ka yi ti deela di laara zaa.
en: Be on your guard, then, so that you will not lose what we have worked for, but will receive your reward in full.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi tihi yɛla. Sida tihi din be Lɛbanɔn zaŋ tabili taaŋkɔro tuturi din bili tam goma zuɣu yɛla; ka daa lan tɔɣisi biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi ni nyɛbisi ni zahim gba yɛla.
en: He described the botany of trees, whether the cedar in Lebanon or the hyssop that grows out of the wall. He also described cattle, birds, anything that crawls on the ground, and fish.

dag: Lihimiya ma ka chɛ ka di gari ya, ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi pɔb yi noya.
en: Look at me. Isn't that enough to make you stare in shocked silence?.

dag: Pa dunia ŋɔ shia ka ti deei, amaa Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna ka ti deei ni ti tooi baŋ pin shɛŋa Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ti.
en: We received the Spirit that is from God, not the spirit of the world. We received Gods Spirit so that we can know all that God has given us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri moli nolɔbo molo, ka zaŋ Nabɔt ʒili jilima ʒiishee niriba maa ni.
en: The leaders announced that there would be a day when all the people would eat nothing. On that day they called all the people together for a meeting. They put Naboth in a special place before the people.

dag: Ka di ni nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini zuɣu, tinim bɛn galisi ŋɔ gba nyɛla niŋgbun yini, dama ti zaa laɣindi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini maa.
en: Because there is the one loaf of bread, all of us, though many, are one body, for we all share the same loaf.

dag: Ka salindooriba mini kɔhigɔriba daa mali me zuɣusaa duu din be gɔŋbu shee la mini Piɛri Dunɔdali sunsuuni la.
en: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message and told them, Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.

dag: So yi ti o kpee dalinli, bɛn niŋm o gba o ni niŋ shɛm maa labisi.
en: If someone injures a fellow citizen, they will suffer the same injury they inflicted.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima ka tummiya di tuma; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: Remember and obey my laws. I am the Lord . And I have made you my special people.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira maa ni bɛn ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba, di ŋubiya laakum, dama o gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa o ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, o nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: Some animals chew the cud, but they dont have split hooves. Dont eat these animals. Camels, rock badgers, and rabbits are like that, so they are unclean for you.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kpi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣimna ti kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ yiŋa Rama. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Samuel died. All the Israelites met together and mourned his death. They buried him at his home in Ramah. Then David moved to the desert of Maon.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul bɔrila zabili, ka tikuba mi woligir nir min o zɔsimo.
en: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, di daa birim o pam; dama ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛliya ni Jɔn Baptaizira n-neei kum ni na maa. Luk .-.
en: When Herod, the ruler of Galilee, heard about all the things that were happening, he was very confused, because some people were saying that John the Baptist had come back to life. Lk .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia Tapanhɛs maa.
en: when the Lord told me:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa bo chɛchɛbuŋ mini yuri ka zaŋ ninvuɣ pihinu bah o tooni.
en: After this, Absalom provided a chariot and horses for himself, and an escort of fifty men.

dag: O yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin yɛlimiya yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min o nyaandoliba lee yɛn ʒini puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: and when he goes into a house, say to the owner, Our teacher wants to know if you have a room where he can eat the Passover meal with his disciples.

dag: Buni mini jilima zaa yirila a sanna, nyini n-su binshɛɣukam zaa. A nuu ni ka yiko ni kpiɔŋ be, ka a zaŋ a nuu maa namdi wɔɣira, ka tiri sokam yaa.
en: Riches and honor come from you. You rule everything. You have the power and strength in your hand! And in your hand is the power to make anyone great and powerful!.

dag: Ka o daa mali ti paai yili maa ni n-zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu kpe yili maa ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni so dol o kpe naɣila bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma.
en: Jesus went into the house, but he did not let anyone else go with him, except Peter, John, James, and the girl's father and mother.

dag: N daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri n ni daa tim shɛb yi sanna la ni?.
en: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?.

dag: ka yɛli Kɔra min o nyaandoliba maa, Biɛɣuni asiba Yawɛ sa ni wuh o ni pii so ni ŋun be kasi ni o ni yɛn chɛ ka so ka o sanna. O ni pii so, o ni chɛ ka dilan ka o sanna.
en: Then Moses said to Korah and all his followers, Tomorrow morning the Lord will show who belongs to him. He will show who is holy, and he will bring that man near to him. He will choose him and bring that man near to him.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n tumtumda n-daa yɔhim ma, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Pam m buŋ ŋɔ gali ti ma ka m ba n-doli naa chaŋ, dama a mi ni mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla wɔbiga.
en: My master and king, Mephibosheth answered, my servant abandoned me! Because your servant is lame, I asked my servant, Saddle a donkey for me so I can ride and go to the king.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni di chɛ ka so ku mali noli din ni tooi yɛli shɛli, ka Naawuni ti kari dunianim zaa saria.
en: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.

dag: ka o yidana maa wum li, ka bi yɛl o shɛli o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ni zani.
en: If the husband hears about the promise and does not object, the woman must do what she promised.

dag: Yawɛ, wumma, zom ma nambɔɣu! Yawɛ, leemi ŋun sɔŋdi ma!.
en: LORD, listen and have mercy on me! LORD, be my helper.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu, ka o dii teei zaa zani ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: He placed his hands on her and she straightened up at once and praised God.

dag: M mali Ofiri salima din gari tɔn kɔbiga mini anzinfa din nyɛ alali tɔn kɔbisiyi ni pihinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li dooi pa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dukpina zuɣu.
en: I have given tons of the finest gold and tons of pure silver for decorating the walls of the Temple.

dag: Bɛ saɣim Mɔab, ka di bihi kuhira.
en: Moab will be destroyed. Her little children will cry for help.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka n yi m ba yiŋa n-chani gindi ŋɔ puuni, ka n yɛl o, A ni yɛn niŋ ma nirilim shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti paai luɣ shɛlikam, nyin yɛlimi ni n nyɛla a tizɔdoo. .
en: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni ti kum ka fabili. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun pirig o zaɣim ka ʒi tiŋa.
en: The city gates will mourn and cry, and the city itself will be like a woman sitting on the ground, stripped naked.

dag: N nyuli zabbu mini n suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Dindali maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti dam pam.
