en: In my jealousy and blazing anger I declare: On that day, a great quaking will come over Israels fertile land.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n yɛn darigila Amɔn ŋun nyɛ Tɛbis nir la tibili, ka darigi Firawuna mini Ijiptinim ni di wuna ni di nanim zaŋ tabili bɛn niŋ Firawuna naani la tibili.
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says, I am going to punish Amon, the god of Thebes, together with Egypt and its gods and kings. I am going to take the king of Egypt and all who put their trust in him.

dag: Ka bɛ lar o, bɛ ni daa mi ni o kpiya zuɣu.
en: The people laughed at him because they knew she was dead.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Now then, denounce them, mortal man.

dag: Di saha maa ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa kuli nti yɛl o taba Hanania mini Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Daniel went to his house and explained the situation to his friends Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana maa zaŋ sida dari mini taaŋkɔro wulli ni mi ʒee bahi buɣim din diri nahu maa ni.
en: Then he is to take some cedar wood, a sprig of hyssop, and a red cord and throw them into the fire.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali shee zɔntua, ka di nyɛ mita anahi.
en: He measured the porch of the gate opposite the temple: it was ten and a half feet.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zani gil o, ka o yiɣisi n-lan kpe tiŋ maa ni n-daa kaai biɛɣu ka o mini Baanabas yi nimaani chaŋ Dɛɛbi.
en: But when the believers gathered around him, he got up and went back into the town. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa kpe du shɛli din daa be puuni ha la ni nti buɣisi di dunoya pilanima, ka di nyɛ mita yiniyini, ka dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ata. Ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu.
en: Then he went into the inner room, and he measured the arches on both sides of the entrance; they were each three feet. The entrance was nine feet wide, and its depth was ten and a half feet.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ shɛlikam, nyin di niŋ li o nyaaŋa, ka o chɛ ka a soya tuhi.
en: Know him in all your paths, and he will keep your ways straight.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni nir doli ŋun be nam fukumsi ni yɛligu, ka di pa ni o yi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ni kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa o suhu ni tɛha gba dɔnibu zuɣu.
en: That is why it is necessary to place yourself under the governments authority, not only to avoid Gods punishment but also for the sake of your conscience.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, amaa o ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛli zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one lights a lamp and then covers it with a bowl or puts it under a bed. Instead, they put it on top of a lampstand so that those who enter can see the light.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa lan kpuɣi daanya pam Bɛta mini Bɛrɔtai din daa nyɛ Hadadɛza ni su fɔntin shɛŋa la ni.
en: David also took many things made of bronze from Tebah and Berothai.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ naa suhu ni, ka o ti Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la jilima ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord 's temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus said, Watch out that no one deceives you.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri chaŋ luɣ shɛli din miri Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: One day when Joseph's brothers had taken the sheep to a pasture near Shechem.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka zuɣusaa paɣ a daalahiziba tuma, ka chɛ ka a ʒiɛyimtali kul be a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Lord , the heavens praise you for the amazing things you do. The assembly of holy ones sings about your loyalty.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm gari niriba ayopɔin bɛn ni tooi garigi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A lazy person will think he is smarter than seven men who can give good reasons for their opinions.

dag: Yawɛ, di tam Ɛdomnim ni daa yɛli shɛm Jɛrusalɛm lubu dal la yɛla. Bɛ daa kul yɛrimi, Daamiya li luhi! Daamiya li luhi zaa.
en: LORD, remember what the Edomites did on Jerusalems dark day: Rip it down, rip it down! All the way to its foundations! they yelled.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka soya niŋ Mɔab luɣili zuɣu tintariga tinsi din nyɛ Bɛtijɛshimɔt mini Baalimiɔn ni Kiriataim din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa jilima tinsi la ni.
en: Ill open up the flank of Moab from the cities at its border, the lands splendid cities, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima ka di be kaman yi zaŋ yimaŋ tila ti Duuma la.
en: Wives, be willing to serve your husbands the same as the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ɛhab, Cham ti di ka nyu, dama saa vura.
en: Elijah then said to Ahab, Get up! Celebrate with food and drink because I hear the sound of a rainstorm coming.

dag: Wummi n suhigu maa, ka garigi ma. N suhu bi doya ka n kul jiɣinda n fabila maa zuɣu.
en: Pay attention! Answer me! I cant sit still while complaining. Im beside myself.

dag: Di kul shɛbisila tab ni hal ka pɔhim ku tooi kpe di sunsuuni gba.
en: One touches another; even air cant come between them.

dag: N zaŋdi buni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ma, ka chɛ ka bɛ daazichi duri paana.
en: giving wealth to those who love me, filling their houses with treasures.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni kuli nti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhi din mali nyina mini kuriti kuya ni kuriti lɛri tumd o tuma. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ Ammɔnnim maa tinsi zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda min o niriba maa zaa daa lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He brought out the people in Rabbah and forced them to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He did the same thing to all the cities of the Ammonites. Then David and all the army went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa n dimnim bɛn daa bi bɔri ni n su ba la, zaŋmiya ba na nti ku ba n nini ŋɔ ni.
en: Now where are my enemies? Where are the people who did not want me to be king? Bring my enemies here and kill them. I will watch them die.

dag: O bi zaŋdi kaburi jaambɔn titali buri buŋgu bee n-zaŋdi naɣikɔra tɔroko nɔri nili, amaa kaburi jaambɔn bila ka o zaŋdi buri buŋgu, ka zaŋdi li ŋmari nili.
en: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim, ka di pa dari zuɣu m-be sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: The priests shall burn all this on the altar along with the burnt offerings. The odor of this food offering is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Hal fiig tihi ni bi pum puma, ka wain tihi bi wali, ka olivi tihi bi wali, ka puri ni bindira bi niŋ, ka biŋkɔbbaligu lan ka buzɔna ni, ka niɣi lan ka naɣikpahi ni maa zaa yoli.
en: Even though the fig trees have no fruit and no grapes grow on the vines, even though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no grain, even though the sheep all die and the cattle stalls are empty.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, so baɣa kani bee m-baŋdi din tahi lala na. Amaa bɛ yi kpi, bɛ yila zaɣ biɛɣu ni kpe suhudoo ni.
en: All the good people are gone, and no one even noticed. The loyal followers were gathered up, but no one knows why. The reason they were gathered up is that trouble is coming.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Juda zuliya piligu shee daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Zin mɔɣu ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ɛdom tintariga.
en: The land determined by lot for the clans of the Judahite tribe ran southward to the border of Edom. The Zin wasteland was the southern limit.

dag: M bi suhir a ni a yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa n suhir a mi ni a gbib ba ka Sintani ku paai ba.
en: Im not asking that you take them out of this world but that you keep them safe from the evil one.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ʒi ʒiya yi yinsi bee n-tum tuun shɛli Vuhim Dabisili dali, amaa gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili maa ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi kaman n ni daa zali yi yaannim shɛm la.
en: Dont carry a load from your houses or do any kind of work on the Sabbath day. Rather, keep the Sabbath day holy as I commanded your ancestors.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu ka n nyɛ n ni nyɛ so ŋɔ, ka o daalibarika zaŋ chaŋ m polo pala yoli, dama n tumiya gari bɛ zaa, amaa pa mani n-tum li, Naawuni daalibarika din be n ni maa n-tum li.
en: But, because of Gods grace, that is what I am. And his grace that he gave me was not wasted. I worked harder than all the other apostles.

dag: Nir yi niŋ yomyom yɛli, N zaŋ bini yaakaza ti Naawuni, ka naanyi ti piligi tɛhir o ni po pɔri shɛli maa yɛla, di ni leei tɔŋ gbaag o.
en: Think carefully before you promise to give something to God. Later, you might wish you had not made that promise.

dag: mini Jɛrusalɛm ni Idumia ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli polo hal zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn laɣim o sanna, bɛ ni daa wum o ni tumdi tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla zuɣu.
en: and Jerusalem. People came from Idumea, as well as other places east of the Jordan River. They also came from the region around the towns of Tyre and Sidon. All of these crowds came because they had heard what Jesus was doing.

dag: Bɛ naa daa nyɛla bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la malaika ŋun Hiburu yuli booni Abadɔn, ka o Giriiki yuli mi booni Apoliɔn la. Di gbinni nyɛla, Saɣinda.
en: They have a king ruling over them, who is the angel in charge of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon; in Greek the name is Apollyon .

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ Dauda din viɛl zaa yɛla yɛl o ba Sool, ka lan yɛl o, Naa, di bi simdi ni a tum taali zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda polo, dama o na ʒi n-tum a taali, ka o tuma zaa lan nyɛ din sɔŋd a.
en: Jonathan talked to his father Saul. Jonathan said good things about David. He said, You are the king. David is your servant. David hasnt done anything wrong to you, so dont do anything wrong to him. He has always been good to you.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Tapua ni Rɛkɛm ni Shɛma.
en: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

dag: Pateesa shɛŋa din zaa daa yili gili lɔndo maa daa nyɛla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli.
en: All the curtains around the courtyard were made from fine linen.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm kul bɔhindila baŋsim pahira, ka yɛnnim tiba kul bɔri ni di wumdi baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Wise people want to learn more, so they listen closely to gain knowledge.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, a daa zo n kuŋa. A daa tiligi n nyɛvili.
en: You came to my rescue, Lord, and saved my life.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Ti ka taali. O suhu bi lan yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn kari ya la saria, dama yi yɛliya, Ti bi tum alahichi.
en: you still insist, Im innocent; as a result he will turn his anger away from me. Because you claim not to have sinned, I will pass judgment against you.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn bidibisi daa nyɛ: Sɛrɛd mini Ɛlɔn ni Jaaliil.
en: Zebulun and his sons: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

dag: ka bɛ mabih ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bihi ka kpi; di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: and finally to all seven brothers. At last the woman died.

dag: Di bo yomyom yaag a noli bee n-jiɣ a suhu ni n-yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli Naawuni tooni, dama Naawuni bela alizanda ni, ka a mi be dunia ŋɔ ni; dinzuɣu chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa pɔra.
en: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina o ni yihi paɣ so maa sani.
en: He told them, A man who divorces his wife and marries someone else is unfaithful to his wife.

dag: Dindali maa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni ni ti zaŋ bɛ bidibbina bahi ka zo ni nuzaŋa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On that day even the bravest soldiers will drop their weapons and run. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Bɛ ni teei bɛ nuhi kaman kɔduɣiriba ni teeri bɛ nuhi ni bɛ duɣi kom shɛm la. Amaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ shɛm zaa yoli, bɛ ni bahi di vi.
en: They will reach out their arms to escape like someone trying to swim. But their pride will sink with each stroke they take.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama bɛn be ti sani gari bɛn be bɛ sani.
en: Don't be afraid, Elisha answered. There are more troops on our side than on theirs.

dag: Amaa ti malimiya li la luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ni yi jɛmd o nimaani kɔŋko, ka yi ni ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa zaawuni wuntan luhili saha, yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la saha.
en: Instead, you must offer the Passover sacrifice at the location the LORD your God selects for his name to reside, at evening time, when the sun sets, which was the time you fled Egypt.

dag: ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka yɛlimaŋli maa yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.

dag: Dama nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri guri bɛ tɔbiri n-zaŋ bɛ piɛma pa tɔbimii zuɣu n-kpuɣi tiri ni bɛ to ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi zibisim ni.
en: You tell me, Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.

dag: Amaa yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma zahindi maa mini di gbinni, yi ni nya pina mini laara ni jilima pam n sani. Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma zahindi maa, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: But if you do explain the dream and its meaning, youll receive generous gifts and glorious honor from me. So explain to me the dream as well as its meaning.

dag: Lala ka tuun suma gba yiri palo, hal tuun sun shɛŋa yi bi yi palo viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi kul ku bahi kpalim sɔɣiya.
en: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa garigi yɛli ba ni Pool be duu Siizaria, ka omaŋmaŋ mi lɔri nia ni o lab nimaani daba ayi sunsuuni.
en: Festus answered, Paul is being kept a prisoner in Caesarea, and I myself will be going back there soon.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Salinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: All of you nations, come praise the Lord ! Let everyone praise him.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labisir o mi na ni n ti ti a, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni n zaŋla n suhu m-pah o zuɣu ti a.
en: I am sending him back to you, but its as hard as losing part of myself.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni bi ku ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn ka bɛ ti leeg o min o bihi daba hal ka Pɛriʒia nam ti nya zaa zani.
en: Finally, he exiled to Babylon anyone who survived the killing so that they could be his slaves and the slaves of his children until Persia came to power.

dag: Amaa n ni ti darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn zaŋ ba leei bɛ daba maa tibili, ka di nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti ʒi azichi pam yi nimaani na.
en: But I will punish the nation that enslaves them, and when they leave that foreign land, they will take great wealth with them.

dag: Ka daba ayɔbu dali bɛ ni tooi pihi daba ayi dibu tariga na ti duɣi.
en: But on the sixth day of each week they must gather and cook twice as much.

dag: Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ bɔhim baŋ shɛli, amaa ka lee ku tooi baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: These women are always learning, but they can never arrive at an understanding of the truth.

dag: Tɔŋ gbaai bɛ napɔŋkpahi, zana gbaai ba gbibi.
en: A trap grabs them by the heel; a snare tightens on them.

dag: Nyini n-nam nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo; Tabo Zoli mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli paɣir a yuli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: You created everything north and south. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon sing praises to your name.

dag: Waazuyihira maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchi; di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense.

dag: bee gurugulana bee diɣili bee do so ŋun nina bi ne viɛnyɛla bee ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri niŋgbuŋ ni bee ŋun mali yu kaɣima bee bɛ ni yihi do so lana.
en: no one who is a hunchback or a dwarf; no one with any eye or skin disease; and no eunuch.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Zikiri bia Amasia ŋun daa saɣi n-zaŋ omaŋ niŋ Yawɛ tuma ni la. O mi daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisiyi.
en: at his side was Amasiah, Zichris son, who volunteered for the LORD with two hundred thousand soldiers.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni n-gbiri binyara ŋubira; ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni. Ka o daa bahi ba noli.
en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs. Jesus gave them permission.

dag: Amaa Hiram ni daa ti yi Taai kana ni o ti nya tin shɛŋa Sulemaana ni zaŋ ti o maa, o nini daa bi tiɣi li.
en: So Hiram traveled from Tyre to see the cities that Solomon had given him. But Hiram was not pleased when he saw them.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa ŋma kuyila n-yili niŋ Naa Jɔsia. Ka baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa na kul yiini kuyila yɛri Jɔsia yɛla hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka sab li niŋ fabila litaafi ni.
en: The prophet Jeremiah composed a lament for King Josiah. It has become a custom in Israel for the singers, both men and women, to use this song when they mourn for him. The song is found in the collection of laments.

dag: O daa lan ti o niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni bihim ni waagasi ni piɛri mini piɛlahi kpam ni Bashan naɣilahi mini buhi ni alikama viɛlli. Yi daa nyu wain tiwala wain viɛlli.
en: He gave his people butter from the herd and milk from the flock. He gave them lambs and goats. They had the best rams from Bashan and the finest wheat. They drank the best wine made from the juice of red grapes.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili maa dali ti yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku beni. Dindali maa ti shiri yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku be di ni.
en: The day of the Lord will bring darkness and not light; it will be a day of gloom, without any brightness.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha bia;.
en: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa yɛn niŋ la saha daa ti paai, ka bindira maa daa shiri niŋ pam.
en: During the seven years of plenty the land produced abundant crops.

dag: nti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee yɛn ti ma ka n chɛ ka Yisa kpe yi nuu ni? Ka bɛ daa ti o anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihita.
en: and asked, What will you give me if I betray Jesus to you? They counted out thirty silver coins and gave them to him.

dag: M bia, alahichinim yi kpɛhir a kɔre, nyin di saɣi.
en: My son, those who love to do wrong will try to trick you. Dont listen to them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka tɔb daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɛza. Di saha ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Sipai ŋun daa yi tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na la, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa.
en: Once again war broke out at Gezer with the Philistines. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephah, and the Philistines were subdued.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd kum nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika so daa lan chaŋ Yisifu sani zahindi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o laɣim bɛn bi ʒe yim ni.
en: Then the master will come when the servant is not ready, at a time when the servant is not expecting him. Then the master will punish that servant and send him away to be with the other people who dont obey.

dag: Di galisim mini di wula wɔɣilim zuɣu daa chɛ ka di viɛla, dama di nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti kpe kom pam ni.
en: The tree was very beautiful. It was so large! It had such long branches. Its roots had plenty of water.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, zomiya buɣijɛmbo!.
en: My friends, you must keep away from idols.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Nyin Ahitub bia ŋɔ wumma. Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, n wumda.
en: Listen here, son of Ahitub, Saul said. Yes sir, he replied.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa tim ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ba Yaakubu min o daŋ zaa na; bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanu.
en: So Joseph sent a message to his father Jacob, telling him and the whole family, seventy-five people in all, to come to Egypt.

dag: O gba daa dolila Naa Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba, dama o ma n-daa nyɛ o saawaralana n-wuhir o ka o tumdi tuumbiɛri.
en: Ahaziah also lived the way Ahabs family lived because his mother encouraged him to do wrong things.

dag: Ibram mini Lɔt ni daa woligi maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo.
en: After Lot left, the Lord said to Abram, Look around you. Look north, south, east, west.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm yaɣi ti ni tɛhi ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu: Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋa n-ti ti Duuma ka naanyi zaŋ bɛmaŋa n-ti ti gba Naawuni yubu puuni.
en: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tim ti boli Ɛliɛza mini Ariɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛlnatan ni Jarib ni Ɛlnatan so yaha ni Neetan ni Zakaria ni Mɛshulam bɛn daa nyɛ zuɣulaannim la ni Joyarib mini Ɛlnatan so mi yaha bɛn daa nyɛ yɛnnim la.
en: So I called these leaders: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, and I called Joiarib and Elnathan.

dag: ka yɛl o kpambaliba, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-ni bala; ŋuna n-lan neei kum ni na maa, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko n-tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: and told his officials, This is John the Baptist! He has come back from death, and that's why he has the power to work these miracles.

dag: Pa pumpɔŋɔ ka yi boli ma, Ti ba, a nyɛla ŋun daa yuri ti ti bilim ni.
en: At the same time you say to me, My father, my friend since youth.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ maligumaaniba, ka bɛ pakoya daa bi tooi kum bɛ zuɣu.
en: Their priests were killed, but the widows had no time to mourn for them.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei paɣ shɛb niriba bɛn daa kpi kum ni ti ba. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaɣisi yolisim shɛli din nyɛ daadamnim dini, ka nya azaaba hal ti kpi di puuni ni bɛ ti neei kum ni m-mali nyɛvili din so.
en: Women received back their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured and refused to be released so they could gain a better resurrection.

dag: Ka Samsin paɣ maa daa chaŋ Samsin sani ti kumdi niŋd o yɛra, A bi yuri ma. A ŋahi n niriba ŋahili, ka bi wuhi ma ŋahili maa gbinni. Ka Samsin yɛl o, Nyama, hal m bi wuhi m ba bee m ma di gbinni, ka ti wuhiri nyini.
en: So Samson's wife went to him in tears and said, You don't love me! You just hate me! You told my friends a riddle and didn't tell me what it means! He said, Look, I haven't even told my father and mother. Why should I tell you.

dag: Yi min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka o zaŋdi yi gba m-pahiri bɛn zaa kpalim zuɣu m-mɛri du shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni ni ni be shɛl ni o Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: And in Christ you are being built together with his other people. You are being made into a place where God lives through the Spirit.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa yuri Jɛrusalɛm, maliya suhupiɛlli di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn zaa fabindi di zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli pam!.
en: Celebrate with Jerusalem; be happy with her, all you who love her! Rejoice with her in joy, all you who mourn over her.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A min a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, yiɣisimiya chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po pɔri Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu sani yɛli, N ni zaŋ li ti yi zuliya la ni.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Leave this place, you and the people you brought out of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob and to their descendants.

dag: Bɛ saɣim Mɔab, ka di bihi kuhira.
en: Moab has been destroyed; listen to the children crying.

dag: Ka n daa ŋmahiŋmahi m mam maa jilajila n-zaŋ tari Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama bɛna n-tum din chihiri ŋɔ mini biŋkɔb tuuni ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa.
en: I took her body, cut it in pieces, and sent one piece to each of the twelve tribes of Israel. These people have committed an evil and immoral act among us.

dag: Amaa yɛm din yiri alizanda ni na nyɛla alali, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri suhudoo mini biɛribaalimtali, ka nyɛ din deeri wuhibu, ka lan nyɛ din pali nambɔzɔbo mini tuun suma, ka mali ʒiɛyimtali ka ka bilikɔnsi baabiɛla.
en: What of the wisdom from above? First, it is pure, and then peaceful, gentle, obedient, filled with mercy and good actions, fair, and genuine.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku zani, di mi ku niŋ pali.
en: But the LORD God says: It wont happen; it wont take place.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Bɛrilahairoi; ka di do Kadɛshi mini Bɛrɛd sunsuuni.
en: So the well there was called Beer Lahai Roi. It is between Kadesh and Bered.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli jilima nyabu zuɣu. Fam ti bahi, ka chɛ ti daalahichi a yuli zuɣu.
en: Our God and Savior, help us! That will bring glory to your name. Save us and forgive our sins for the good of your name.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ shɛlikam, nyin di niŋ li o nyaaŋa, ka o chɛ ka a soya tuhi.
en: With every step you take, think about what he wants, and he will help you go the right way.

dag: Ka Firawuna kpamba daa yɛl o Bɔ saha ka doo ŋɔ yɛn chɛ ti zana baribu? Chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa, a na kul bi baŋ ni Ijipti bahi yoli zaa.
en: the king's officials asked, Your Majesty, how much longer is this man going to be a troublemaker? Why don't you let the people leave, so they can worship the Lord their God? Don't you know that Egypt is a disaster.

dag: Ka Hɔshaya mini Juda zuɣulaannim pirigili daa pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Following them went Hoshaiah and half the officials of Judah.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛli; ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla din chihiri n noli ni yibu na.
en: My mouth utters the truth; my lips despise wickedness.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ ya niŋ Naawuni nuu ni, ka lan zaŋ ya niŋ o daalibarika yɛtɔɣa din ni tooi kpaŋsi ya la ni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya tarili bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la ni.
en: Now I entrust you to God and the message of his grace, which is able to build you up and give you an inheritance among all whom God has made holy.

dag: Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm. Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka sokam yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: You all heard these insults to God. What do you think? Everyone agreed that Jesus was guilty and must be killed.

dag: Ka ninsalinim daa nyɛ tuhi pinaayɔbu. Ka Yawɛ zaka niriba kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ pihitanaayi.
en: The soldiers got , women. They gave women to the Lord .

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa yubu nyɛla ni n di bahi o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ti ma la ni yino, amaa ni n ti neei ba kum ni zaadali.
en: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa daa ti lan ŋmaligi ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni ka yɛri taba, Dauda daa tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi ti Filistianim nuu ni; ka o ti yiɣisi kpe pumpɔŋɔ n-zo Absalom zuɣu.
en: Everyone was arguing throughout Israels tribes, saying, The king delivered us from our enemies power, and he rescued us from the Philistines power, but now he has fled from the land and from controlling his own kingdom.

dag: Siria naa maa ni ti kpuɣi Ijipti azichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni bin suma shɛŋa din zaa pahi. O ni ti nyaŋ Libianim mini Itiɔpianima.
en: He will take control of Egypts hidden treasures of gold, silver, and all its precious things. Libyans and Cushites will follow at his feet.

dag: Ŋun Masia maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun daa ʒi ti daalahichi o niŋgbuŋ ni dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ wuntia polo. O fiɛbbu bɔba ni dansi la zuɣu ka yi nyari dɔriti tibi kpaŋ.
en: He carried in his own body on the cross the sins we committed. He did this so that we might live in righteousness, having nothing to do with sin. By his wounds you were healed.

dag: Kulla dindali maa ka bɛ daa yɛli naa bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb Susa puuni kalinli.
en: Later that day, someone told the king how many people had been killed in Susa.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni so yi ti ye binyɛr suma, ka piri salima nintuhi kpe yi laɣiŋgu ni na, ka nandana ŋun ye binchɛra gba kpɛna.
en: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.

dag: Daŋ kam puuni dunoya zuɣulaannim shɛb daa tɔhiya ni bɛ sɔŋ tuma maa. Gomna daa tila salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram anii ni taha pihinu ni maligumaaniba binyɛra kɔbisinu ni pihita.
en: Some of the heads of families made a donation for the work. The governor gave to the treasury , darics of gold, bowls, and priestly robes.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa zaa daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiniinaayopɔin bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya doli bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The family history shows there were , strong soldiers in all the tribes of Issachar.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa lan bɔhi Balaam, Pa a bun so a ni bari sahakam zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-nyɛ ma? Ka n na mi n-niŋ a lala? Ka o garigi yɛli, Aai.
en: The donkey replied, Am I not the same donkey on which you have ridden all your life? Have I ever treated you like this before? No, he answered.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa o biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Naawuni la.
en: you shall put your hand on its head and kill it in front of the Tent. The priests shall throw its blood against all four sides of the altar.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Hɔrihagidigad maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Jɔtibata.
en: They left Hor Haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

dag: bɔhira, Kpe ka Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la kpɛra.
en: They called out and asked, Is there a guest here by the name of Simon Peter.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa biri ti shɛli bɛ ni booni tamarisik tia la Bɛrishiiba, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni ŋɔ nimaani.
en: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and he worshipped there in the name of the LORD, El Olam.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alikauli zaligu kundi la na ti karim li ka niriba maa wum ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li, ka deeg o noli.
en: Then he took the book of the Covenant, in which the Lord 's commands were written, and read it aloud to the people. They said, We will obey the Lord and do everything that he has commanded.

dag: Ka n daa nya litaafi shɛli ka di be ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni, ka sabbu be di puuni mini di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ bintabinda ayopɔin n-dihi tabili di noli.
en: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.

dag: Areebia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Dɛdannim sochandiba bɛn dooni Areebia mɔɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: An oracle about the desert. In the woods, in the desert where you camp, caravans of the Dedanites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi Musa mini Aduna yɛtɔɣa ka zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim mini Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa polo n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yihim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But the Lord sent Aaron and Moses with a message for the Israelites and for the king. He also ordered Aaron and Moses to free the people from Egypt.

dag: N wuntia biɛhigu laara ka Yawɛ daa ti ma maa; n ni ka galimi la samli ka o yo ma maa.
en: You are good to me, Lord , because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.

dag: Absalom daa lan yɛli; Mani n-yi di nyɛ sariakarita Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ŋunkam yi di zaŋ o kpee tahi n sanna bee n-zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam na, n naan kari saria maa dɛde n-ti o nasara.
en: I wish someone would make me the judge around here! I would be fair to everyone.

dag: So yi bɔhi ya, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔri ba, ka o ni chɛ ka yi dii zaŋ ba na.
en: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, The Lord needs them. He will at once let you have the donkeys.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi bɛn na bi mi li ni wum li, ka bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili du nti deei li su la ni.
en: and so that their children, who dont yet know the Instruction, may hear it and learn to revere the LORD your God for as long as you live on the ground you are crossing the Jordan River to possess.

dag: O zaŋm binyɛribil piɛl kasi ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli, ka zaŋ shɛlɔr piɛlli lo o shee ni ka vili bantabiga. Di nyɛla situr shɛli din be kasi. O sum kom pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa.
en: Aaron must dress in a holy linen tunic and wear linen undergarments on his body. He must tie a linen sash around himself and wrap a linen turban around his head. These are holy clothes—Aaron will first bathe his body in water and then put them on.

dag: N ni bahi nyu bara. Di naɣ kala buchi, amaa n na kul ni tɔɣisi ʒiinim mini kahigibunim shɛŋa ti Duuma ni daa zaŋ ti ma la yɛla.
en: It is necessary to brag, not that it does any good. Ill move on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

dag: Amaa yi ni daa niŋ ma nirilim sɔŋ ma n wahala puuni la viɛli pam.
en: Still, you have done well to share my distress.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun kul be, ka nyɛ ninsalinim nini ni ku tooi nya so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka simdi tibigibu mini jilima tibu ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To the eternal King, immortal and invisible, the only God—to him be honor and glory forever and ever! Amen.

dag: ni Anduru ni Filip ni Baatolomiu ni Matiu ni Tomas ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: and Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, Alphaeus son; Thaddaeus; Simon the Cananaean.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm ka ti mabihi la zaŋ ti nti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the Lord's followers gladly welcomed us.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli biriginsim soli, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba pahi tuumbiɛrinim zuɣu n-darigi bɛ tibili. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: But, Lord , when you punish those who do evil, also punish those who have stopped following your way. Let Israel always enjoy peace!.

dag: Ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi tam daantalisi maa zuɣusaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-naai daantalisi maa tuma.
en: They put the flower-shaped capitals on top of the columns, and the work on the two columns was finished.

dag: Ka Naawuni yiko tuuni ŋɔ daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam. Niriba maa ni daa na kul tɛhiri Yisa ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛlikam zaa yɛla maa ka o daa yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: All the people were amazed at the mighty power of God. The people were still marveling at everything Jesus was doing, when he said to his disciples.

dag: Dinzuɣu zanimiya baalim pumpɔŋɔ n-nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tuun kar shɛli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: So now take a stand! Look at this awesome thing the LORD is doing.

dag: Ŋun pa maligumaana zuliya miri ka o di sara maligu kasi la. Sana yi be maligumaana yiŋa bee maligumaana yi bu so paa, o bi simdi ni o di sara maligu kasi maa.
en: No layperson is allowed to eat the holy offerings. No foreign guest or hired laborer of a priest can eat it.

dag: ka Azaria nyɛ Sɛraya ba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ Jɛhɔzadak ba.
en: Azariah was Seraiahs father. Seraiah was Jehozadaks father.

dag: Di saha ka Saimɔn Pita ŋun daa mali takɔb la ŋooi li n-chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi. Dabili maa yuli n-daa booni Malikus.
en: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priests servant, cutting off his right ear.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli Naa Sool Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la daa lihi nya ka Filistianim maa pam yiɣisi zɔri yiriŋ.
en: Saul's lookouts at Geba saw that the Philistine army was running in every direction, like melted wax.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma, Molimi molo pahi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka n tinsi maa lan tɔŋ, ka lan sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di wuhi ni mani n-su li.
en: The angel also told me to proclaim: The Lord Almighty says that his cities will be prosperous again and that he will once again help Jerusalem and claim the city as his own.

dag: Ka o daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They pleaded with Jesus not to send them out of that region.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wurim Mɔab, ka di niriba ku lan beni, bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ ti yaɣi Yawɛ san la zuɣu.
en: Moab will be destroyed once and for all because it has exalted itself above the LORD.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut yidan ma Naomi daa ti yɛl o, Di simdi ni m bo soli n-sɔŋ a ka a nya doo kuli, ka di chɛ ka a gba mal a dintoli biɛhigu shee.
en: Then Naomi, Ruths mother-in-law, said to her, My daughter, maybe I should find a husband and a good home for you. That would be good for you.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti faai siɣ o o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yiŋa, ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Manasseh died and was buried near the palace, and his son Amon became king.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan malila chɛchɛbunsi yuri duri tuhi pihinahi; ka mali wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi.
en: Solomon had forty thousand stalls for his chariot horses and twelve thousand cavalry horses.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka chɛ a daba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ taali ka deei bɛ suhigu; ka wuhi ba di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so viɛl shɛli; ka chɛ ka saa mi a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti a niriba maa ka bɛ di li fali ŋɔ ni.
en: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And please send rain on the land you gave them to be theirs forever.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka yɔɣili bili gara maa gbini n-zooi du nti pani gara maa zuɣusaa n-niŋ mahim ni Jona ʒi di lɔŋni ka o ni maha. Ka yɔɣili maa ni daa du m-pa Jona zuɣusaa shɛm maa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: Then the Lord God made a plant grow up over Jonah to give him some shade, so that he would be more comfortable. Jonah was extremely pleased with the plant.

dag: bee o tizɔpaɣ ŋun na ʒi doo, .
en: or unmarried sister living in his house.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mi ni bɛ yi lab me tiŋ maa ka me di goma maa gba naai, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni a ku lan tooi su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili maa nima.
en: We therefore are convinced that if this city is rebuilt and its walls are completed, Your Majesty will no longer be able to control West-of-Euphrates Province.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ doli Naawuni ni daa yɛli shɛm la: Yaakubu ka n yura, ka je Iso.
en: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ bu Jɛrimia, ka ba o bandi ʒili Bɛnjamin dunɔdali din daa be zuɣusaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu polo la.
en: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten. And he had Jeremiahs hands and feet locked between large blocks of wood. This was at the Upper Gate of Benjamin of the Lord s Temple.

dag: Sabbu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni nyɛla yɛl shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Yisa Masia ni o kahigi binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ wuh o daba. O daa timla o malaika o dabili Jɔn sani ka o ti kahigi li n-wuh o.
en: This book is the record of the events that Jesus Christ revealed. God gave him this revelation in order to show to his servants what must happen very soon. Christ made these things known to his servant John by sending his angel to him.

dag: Ka o daa boli bibil so na nti zaŋ o zali bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Jesus called a little child to come to him. He stood the child in front of the followers.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbilli kam din maha n-ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn mali nyɛvili zaŋ tabili noonsi balibu kam ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ni bɛ dira. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: And I have given the green plants as food for everything else that breathes, including animals, both wild and tame, and birds. And so it was.

dag: Ka mɔɣili kom daa zɔri yiri Idɛn na n-teeni puu maa; ka di daa woligi n-niŋ mɔɣ anahi nimaani.
en: From Eden a river flowed out to water the garden, then it divided into four rivers.

dag: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba ni Lɛvinima ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi tinsi ni ti puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Celebrate your festival: you, your sons, your daughters, your male and female servants, the Levites, the immigrants, the orphans, and the widows who live in your cities.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli kul ni beni sahakam. Yawɛ, a niriba kul ni mi a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: LORD, your name is forever! LORD, your fame extends from one generation to the next!.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o tɔbu n-darigi li ni o kpiɔŋ zaa n-to Jɔram bɔɣusapima sunsuuni, ka piɛm maa chaŋ ti gbaag o suhu, ka o lɛb lu o chɛchɛbuŋ puuni.
en: Jehu drew his bow, and with all his strength shot an arrow that struck Joram in the back and pierced his heart. Joram fell dead in his chariot.

dag: Ɛzra daa yila Babilɔn labina, o daa nyɛla gbansabira so ŋun mi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛli ti Musa la viɛnyɛliŋga, ka naa daa ti o o ni suh o shɛlikam zaa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ nuu daa pa o zuɣu.
en: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Instruction from Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given. Moreover, the king gave him everything he requested because the LORD his Gods power was with him.

dag: O ni yɛli, Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, yi ku tooi ka nimaani na la gbinni lee nyɛla wula?.
en: He says, You will look for me, but you will not find me. He also says, You cannot come where I am. What does this mean.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba daa chani gindina ti nya ma n-gbaai ma bu ma ti ma dansi. Ka tiŋ maa gooni guliba daa darigi fuɣi n chinchin shɛli din gbini n nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o ti kpuɣi paɣiba pam niŋ o paɣiba, di yi niŋ lala o suhu ni lɛbigi. O mi di ti va anzinfa bee salima pam mali.
en: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord . Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.

dag: O ni yɛli ma, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba ni n Naawuni ni n tiliginsim tampiŋ.
en: He will cry out to me: You are my father, my God, the rock of my salvation.

dag: Bɛ yi ti bi niŋ a yɛda bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ dihi a ni tuui niŋ shɛli ŋɔ tabili; di pa shɛli bɛ ni niŋ din pahi ayi ŋɔ yɛda.
en: If they wont believe you or pay attention to the first sign, they may believe the second sign.

dag: Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni chɛ ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sakuɣa lala na ʒi n-lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: All right. At this time tomorrow, he will bring on Egypt the worst hailstorm in its history.

dag: Absalom dii yɛrila dilana, Nyama, a yɛtɔɣa viɛla ka tuhi, amaa naa bi bo so zal o zaani ni o wum a ni mali shɛli.
en: Absalom would say, You deserve to win your case. It's too bad the king doesn't have anyone to hear complaints like yours.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Kul suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tim ti, ka o fa ti Filistianim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: The Israelites said to Samuel, Please dont stop praying to the LORD our God for us, so God will save us from the Philistines power.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Gomna Filiksi min o paɣ Drusila ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudia paɣ la daa ti kana n-tim ti boli Pool na ni bɛ ti wum Yisa Masia yɛla o sani.
en: Several days later Felix and his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish, went to the place where Paul was kept under guard. They sent for Paul and listened while he spoke to them about having faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛli kumsi, ka nyɛhi nintam a ninni, dama a tuma mali laara. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni labina.
en: But I, the Lord , say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.

dag: N ka yi sani, amaa n suhu din be yi sani, ka n gba pun kari ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa saria ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu kaman m bela yi san la. Yi yi ti laɣim ka n suhu pahi yi zuɣu ti Duuma Yisa yiko ni.
en: I cannot be there with you in person, but I am with you in spirit. And I have already judged the man who did this. I judged him the same as I would if I were really there.

dag: Di saha maa n ni ti yɛli ba, Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, m bi min ya. Wariya! .
en: But I will tell them, I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people.

dag: Sool saha la bɛna n-daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinima n-nyaŋ ba, ka ʒini bɛ tinsi maa ni Giliad wulimpuhili polo maa ni zaa la.
en: In the time of King Saul the tribe of Reuben attacked the Hagrites, killed them in battle, and occupied their land in the eastern part of Gilead.

dag: A ba Naawuni ni sɔŋ a. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa mi a. O ni chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgbani puuni na a zuɣu. O ni ti a bihi mini niɣi pam.
en: It is your father's God who helps you, The Almighty God who blesses you With blessings of rain from above And of deep waters from beneath the ground, Blessings of many cattle and children.

dag: Ka Haga daa boli Yawɛ ŋun tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa maa yuli, Naawuni ŋun nyara; dama o daa yɛlimi, Ka daɣila n shiri nyala Naawuni ka na be n nyɛvil ni n ni nya o maa nyaaŋa.
en: Hagar thought, Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it? So from then on she called him, The God Who Sees Me.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɛrari daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim la ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pinaayi.
en: So the clan of Merari was assigned a total of twelve cities.

dag: Naawuni timiya yaa mini kpiɔŋ din yir o yiko din galisi pam ka mali jilima la ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi niŋ ania ka mali suɣilo suhupiɛlli puuni.
en: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.

dag: Dama ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ mali n yuli tɔɣisiri maa. Pa mani n-tim ba na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I didnt send them, declares the LORD.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa kana ti bɔhi Gidiɔn, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannim ka bi bol ti? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Ka bɛ daa galim o pam di zuɣu.
en: But the men were really upset with Gideon and complained, When you went to war with Midian, you didn't ask us to help! Why did you treat us like that.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ li leei vuhim dabisili, ka piɛbi kikahi n-laɣim jɛm Naawuni.
en: Say to the Israelites: On the first day of the seventh month, you will have a special rest, a holy occasion marked by a trumpet signal.

dag: Pa ti ninni ka bindira maa zaa zani m-bahi yoli, ka suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim lan ka ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu?.
en: Isnt the food cut off right before our eyes? Arent joy and gladness also gone from our Gods house?.

dag: ni Mɛrayɔt ni Amaria ni Ahitub.
en: Meraioth was Zerahiahs son. Amariah was Meraioths son. Ahitub was Amariahs son.

dag: Ka Aduna garigi yɛl o, N dana, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi pam bahi n zuɣu, a mi ni niriba maa suhuri zaa kul yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: Aaron answered, Don't be angry with me; you know how determined these people are to do evil.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o yiŋnim dɔbba yinoyino zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Karimi bia Ɛkan ŋun daa nyɛ Zabidi mini Zɛra yaaŋa ka yi Juda zuliya ni na la.
en: Then Joshua told all the men in that family to come before the Lord . He chose Achan the son of Carmi.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Nyamiya, Jɔab puu m-baɣi m puu ka siŋkaafa be di ni la, chamiya ti niŋ buɣim nyo li. Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri chaŋ ti niŋ buɣim nyo puu maa.
en: So Absalom said to his servants, Look, Joab's field is next to mine, and it has barley growing in it. Go and set fire to it. So they went and set the field on fire.

dag: Bee a gari ti yab Yaakubu ŋun daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ ti ti hal ka o min o bihi ni o biŋkɔbiri daa nyuri di kom la.
en: It was our ancestor Jacob who gave us this well; he and his children and his flocks all drank from it. You don't claim to be greater than Jacob, do you.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali sara maligu bimbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla. Malimiya li zaɣ mɔɣu.
en: Make an altar out of acacia wood. It is to be square, 1⁄2 feet long and 1⁄2 feet wide, and it is to be 1⁄2 feet high.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba laɣim to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: Early in the morning all the chief priests and the elders made their plans against Jesus to put him to death.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord : You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.

dag: Ninsalinim dabisa pun buɣisimi zali, ka a mi bɛ chira kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyini n-zali bɛ tariga ni nyɛ luɣ shɛli ka bɛ ku tooi yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: The length of our life has been decided. You alone know how long that is. You have set the limits for us and nothing can change them.

dag: n-yɛri niriba maa, Yi yi ti kul nya ka maligumaaniba kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la ʒi n-chana, yin yiɣisimiya yi dooshee ŋɔ doli ba;.
en: and told the people, When you see the priests carrying the Covenant Box of the Lord your God, break camp and follow them.

dag: Di kpalim biɛla ka yuŋ gari, ka di ku yuui ka biɛɣu neei. Chɛliya ka ti chɛ zibisim tuma, ka zaŋ bidibbina n-tuhi tɔbu neesim ni.
en: The night is almost over, and the day is near. So lets get rid of the actions that belong to the darkness and put on the weapons of light.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidibisi shɛba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei namɔɣilisi ka bɛ be Babilɔn nayili.
en: The Babylonians will take your sons, and your sons will become officers in the palace of the king of Babylon.

dag: M mi na kul malila yaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ kaman n ni daa mali yaa shɛm saha shɛli Musa ni daa tim ma maa. Ka n na kul mali yaa din ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Im just as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. My strength then was as my strength is now, whether for war or for everyday activities.

dag: Bɛ daa mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli o muɣisigu maa ni. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli o zuliya yɛla? Dama bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He was shamed, and all his rights were taken away. His life on earth has ended. So there will be no story about his descendants. Isaiah :-.

dag: Bɛ sɔŋmi bɛ mabihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni ka bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma, amaa ka lee di lan zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo di tuun shɛli. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ Lɛvinim maa n-wuhi ba bɛ tuma.
en: Men who are at least years old will be on duty to help their brothers, but they will not do the work themselves. That is what you must do for the Levites so that they can do their duty.

dag: Pahatimɔab daŋ ni: Adina mini Kɛlal ni Bɛnaaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Matania so yaha ni Bɛzalɛl ni Binnui ni Manaasa.
en: Clan of Pahath Moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa, ka po ni o ni chɛ ka bɛ kpi yɔɣu maa ni.
en: So God raised his hand against them, making them fall in the desert.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa teei gili ma kaman tin shɛli bɛ ni liri, ka o tum ma o yurilim maŋli tuun shɛli din mali alahiziba la zuɣu.
en: Praise the Lord ! How wonderfully he showed his love for me when I was surrounded and attacked!.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋ yɛda ka suhi binshɛɣukam, yi ni nya li.
en: If you have faith, you will receive whatever you pray for.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun miligi naa suhu, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: A king is as terrifying as a lions growl. Those who anger him may lose their life.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa puuni ka din viɛl yirina ka bɛ dira, amaa bibiɛhi suhuri yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: People eat well from the fruit of their words, but the treacherous have an appetite only for violence.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri chaŋ luɣ shɛli din miri Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: One day when Joseph's brothers had gone to Shechem to take care of their father's flock.

dag: Obadia ni daa gbaai chandi, o nini nyabu yim ka o ti nya Ilaija m-baŋ o, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, N dan Ilaija, nyini m-bala.
en: While Obadiah was out searching, suddenly Elijah met up with him. When Obadiah saw him, he fell on his face. My master! he said. Are you Elijah.

dag: O daa wuhi ba: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli n dan Iso shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A dabili Yaakubu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N daa chaŋ ti bela Leeban sani hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Jacob told them to say to Esau, Master, I am your servant! I have lived with Laban all this time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa Kaiafas yiŋ maa ni n-tahi Gomna yiŋa asibaasi. Bɛmaŋmaŋ daa bi saɣi doli kpe Gomna yiŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ tum birigi bɛ kali din ni chɛ ka daɣiri tab ba ka bɛ ku tooi di Yaɣigari Chuɣu bindirigu.
en: The Jewish leaders led Jesus from Caiaphas to the Roman governors palace. It was early in the morning. So that they could eat the Passover, the Jewish leaders wouldnt enter the palace; entering the palace would have made them ritually impure.

dag: Hal bɛ bihi na teeri bɛ maligu bimbina mini Ashɛra binwɔɣila shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi ti mahili kam mini daboli kam zuɣu.
en: Your people worship at the altars and the symbols that have been set up for the goddess Asherah by every green tree and on the hilltops.

dag: Bɛn zaa be n san la puhir a. Puhimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ti daadiini soli zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu ni la ti ma. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: All who are with me send you greetings. Give our greetings to our friends in the faith. God's grace be with you all.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du duli ha.
en: That day, at evening, Jesus said to his followers, Come with me across the lake.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Build me seven altars here and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun daa teeg n nuu n-zaŋ n yiko din galisi pam yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la; damdimiya n tooni ka maani yi sara maligu tiri ma.
en: You shall obey me, the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt with great power and strength; you are to bow down to me and offer sacrifices to me.

dag: Di saha maa machɛli daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, dama Filistianim maa daa yɛlimi ni di yi pa lala Izraɛlnim ni ti kuri takɔbiri bee kpana zali.
en: There were no blacksmiths in Israel. The Philistines would not allow them because they were afraid the Israelites would make iron swords and spears.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa kum niŋ Yawɛ Midiannim zuɣu maa.
en: The Midianites did all these bad things, so the Israelites cried to the Lord for help.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli hal ti paai di tariga, ka Izraɛl laɣiŋgu maa zaa wum li.
en: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Ka sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di.
en: Why would people gain the whole world but lose their lives?.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ni leeg o daba din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ man Naawuni jɛmbu mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nanim jɛmbu ni pa yim shɛm.
en: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.

dag: Bɛ mi baɣa daa ka maligumaaniba tuma ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ niriba maa sani. So daa yi kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mali sara n-zaŋ di nimdi maa duɣira, maligumaana yiŋbia zaŋdila dirigu din mali jɛba ata kana.
en: or to the regulations concerning what the priests could demand from the people. Instead, when someone was offering a sacrifice, the priest's servant would come with a three-pronged fork. While the meat was still cooking.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Tiwula ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph said to him, This is the dreams interpretation: The three branches are three days.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛtilihɛm din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama anab so daa sab yɛli:.
en: They answered, In the town of Bethlehem in Judea, just as the prophet wrote:.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli foliŋga maa Zuɣusaa. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayi.
en: God named that space sky. There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the second day.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi bɛ biŋkɔbiri ni bɔri shɛli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna, bɛ nambɔzɔbo nyɛla putɔɣu niŋbu.
en: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.

dag: Ka so yi zaɣisi kandina zaŋ chaŋ daba ata sunsuuni, zuɣulaannim mini kpamba bɛn bahim noli ka bɛ fa o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka dilan ku lan mali soli ni o be bɛn yi Babilɔn n-lab kulina maa kalinli ni.
en: by order of the leaders of the people. If any failed to come within three days, all their property would be confiscated, and they would lose their right to be members of the community.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila maligumaaniba zuɣulana Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋ bipuɣin so ti kana.
en: Meanwhile, Peter was below in the courtyard. A woman, one of the high priests servants, approached.

dag: Yinim bɛn tiligi tɔbu ni ŋɔ, chamiya, di lan guhiriya. Teemiya Yawɛ yɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ maa ni, ka chɛliya ka Jɛrusalɛm yɛla be yi suhuri ni.
en: You people escaped the swords. You must hurry and leave Babylon. Dont wait! You are in a faraway land, but remember the Lord where you are and remember Jerusalem.

dag: O daa mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He made a rim inches wide around it and put a gold border around the rim.

dag: Ka o ni tooi be tiŋ maa ni hal ka bɛ ti kar o saria palɔni, ka o na kul ni be nimaani hal ni maligumaaniba zuɣulaan so ŋun beni ka o tum tuuni maa kum nyaaŋa, di saha ka o naanyi tooi lab o ya din nyɛ o ni daa zo luɣ shɛli maa ti beni.
en: You should stay in that city until the court has judged you and until the high priest dies. Then you may go back to your hometown.

dag: Satahins ayopɔin maa ni daa tahi saha shɛli maa ka n niŋ shili ni n sabi, amaa ka daa wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛra, Gbib satahins ayopɔin maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ashilɔni, ka di sab li sɔŋ.
en: The seven thunders spoke, and I started to write. But then I heard a voice from heaven that said, Dont write what the seven thunders said. Keep those things secret.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisiya pam ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: When the workers heard this, they got angry and started shouting, Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians.

dag: Ka ŋunkam niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yɛda mali shɛhira ŋɔ o suhu ni. Ka ŋunkam mi bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda zaŋ o leela ʒirilana, o ni bi niŋ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛl la yɛda zuɣu.
en: Whoever believes in the Son of God has the truth that God told us. But people who do not believe God make God a liar, because they do not believe what God told us about his Son.

dag: Yɛl biɛr ayi n-yɛn paai ya; ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili sɔŋ ya? Yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni wurim, ka kum lu yi zuɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn maai yi suhuri?.
en: A double disaster has fallen on you: your land has been devastated by war, and your people have starved. There is no one to show you sympathy.

dag: di yi nyɛla bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni n-tum alahichi maa, ka di taali meei niriba maa, di saha ŋun zaŋmi naɣilabil polli ŋun ka dalinli m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara ti Yawɛ.
en: If it is the anointed priest who has sinned, making the people guilty of sin, he must present to the LORD a flawless bull from the herd as a purification offering for the sin he has committed.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Libina mini Ɛta ni Ashan.
en: The fourth region was located in the central part of the lower foothills, and it had the following nine towns with their surrounding villages: Libnah, Ether, Ashan, Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib, Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ suhuri chihi pam, ka bɛ bɔhi Pita min o tab maa, Ti mabihi, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: When the people heard this, they were deeply troubled and said to Peter and the other apostles, What shall we do, brothers.

dag: dama kaman sokam zaa ni kpi Adam ni shɛm, lala ka sokam zaa ni neei kum ni Masia zuɣu.
en: In the same way that everyone dies in Adam, so also everyone will be given life in Christ.

dag: Amaa a daa niŋ a viɛlim maa naani, ka gɔri pagɔrisigu a yudua maa zuɣu. A daa chɛ ka a mini ŋunkam gariti nimaani dɔni.
en: You learned that you were attractive enough to have any man you wanted, so you offered yourself to every passerby.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Ninvuɣ kɔbisita shɛb bɛn mali bɛ zilima nyuri kom ŋɔ ka n ni zaŋ fan ya bahi, ka zaŋ Midiannim maa niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zaa lab kuli.
en: The Lord said to Gideon, I will rescue you and give you victory over the Midianites with the three hundred men who lapped the water. Tell everyone else to go home.

dag: Yɛm ni zaŋ jilima zuɣupiligu pil a, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli ti a.
en: She will place a graceful wreath on your head; she will give you a glorious crown.

dag: ka Ahaz nyɛ o bia, ka Hɛzɛkia nyɛ o bia, ka Manaasa nyɛ o bia.
en: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh.

dag: Goli ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ goya piligu goli yi sani, dina n-yɛn nyɛ gol tuuli yi sani yuuni puuni.
en: This month will be the first month; it will be the first month of the year for you.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, N dana, pɔŋ pia la pun be o sani.
en: The men said to the king, But sir, that servant already has ten bags of money.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi n dan maa, Ka paɣ yi ti bi saɣi n-doli ma na.
en: And I asked my master, What if she will not come with me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma, hal ka tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma ti yaɣi.
en: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;.

dag: Mikilɔt daa nyɛla Shimiam ba. Bɛmbɔŋɔ mini bɛ malibu daa ʒimi miri bɛ dɔɣiriba Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Mikloth was Shimeams father. Jeiels family lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

dag: Sɛt ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni anu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh.
en: When Seth was , he had a son named Enosh.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti zaɣisi zuɣulaannim maa noli; ka kul jɛmdila wuna. Di daa bi yuui ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ yaannim bɛn daa doli Yawɛ zaligunim ni daa doli so shɛl la, ka shiri bi dol li.
en: In years gone by, the Israelites had been faithful to the Lord , but now they were quick to be unfaithful and to refuse even to listen to these judges. The Israelites disobeyed the Lord , and instead of worshiping him, they worshiped other gods.

dag: N yɛr a mi ni a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: You won't get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba, Yi yi ti zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa yi ni baŋ ni mani m-bala, ka lan baŋ ni m bi niŋdi shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ni wuhi ma shɛm, dina ka m mali tɔɣisira.
en: So Jesus said to them, When the Human One is lifted up, then you will know that I Am. Then you will know that I do nothing on my own, but I say just what the Father has taught me.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib daa ʒe nimaani kul fiɣisir o ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: Then the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses stood up and accused him of all kinds of bad things.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu ka leei tipawumlinim kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ tipawumlinim shɛm ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛda la.
en: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.

dag: N ni zaŋ o kpa luɣ viɛlli shee viɛnyɛliŋga kaman kpaa la, ka o leeg o daŋ niriba jilima nam ʒiishee.
en: I will fasten him securely like a tent peg, and he will be a throne of honor for his ancestors house.

dag: Yi bemi kaman yidaampaɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi zina! Yi bi mi ni ŋun zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo nyɛla Naawuni dima? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo, dilana zaŋ omaŋ leela Naawuni dima.
en: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka o ti a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli.
en: Enjoy the LORD, and he will give what your heart asks.

dag: Ka o daa be zuɣusaa ha, ka tirina gbaai ma n-voo ma yihi ko tital ni na.
en: The Lord reached down from above and took hold of me; he pulled me out of the deep waters.

dag: N naan wum o ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm, ka baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm.
en: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣidira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.

dag: Yawɛ, n tarigimi, zom ma nambɔɣu. Yawɛ, n kɔba ni zaa chɔɣisimi dabiɛm zuɣu, tibimi ma.
en: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa nya dansi ni nahiŋgu maa. O ni daa nya tibidarigibo shɛli zuɣu n-chɛ ka nyaɣisim kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni. O fiɛbbu dansi zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti nyari tibbu.
en: He was pierced because of our rebellions and crushed because of our crimes. He bore the punishment that made us whole; by his wounds we are healed.

dag: Firawuna yi boli ya ti bɔhi ya, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tumda.
en: The king will call you in and ask what you do for a living.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Judas daa chaŋ ti zaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa tim tɔbbi shɛb mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuun shɛb la pa omaŋ zuɣu; ka bɛ bo firilanim mini buɣim mokpala ni bidibbina n-kari Yisa naba nimaani.
en: Judas brought a company of soldiers and some guards from the chief priests and Pharisees. They came there carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila Anakinima, ka niriba booni ba Rɛfaimnima, amaa Mɔabnim daa booni ba la Ɛmimnima.
en: Most people thought the Emim were Rephaim, like the Anakim were. But the Moabites called them Emim.

dag: yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman Naawuni niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ yɔɣu ni n-zahim o ka di chɛ ka o yɛli.
en: dont be stubborn as you were in the past, when you turned against God. That was the day you tested God in the desert.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ nachimbil maa kuli ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri daa maai pam.
en: The Lords followers took Eutychus home alive, and they were all greatly comforted.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin mini zahim maa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: He took the seven loaves of bread and the fish. Then he gave thanks to God for the food. He broke the bread into pieces, which he gave to the followers, and they gave the food to the people.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti yɛl a mini Yawɛ finafina; suhim Yawɛ ti ti ka o vuui tinvura maa ka chɛ ti. Ka Musa daa suhi Naawuni ti niriba maa.
en: The people came to Moses and said, We sinned when we spoke against the Lord and against you. Now pray to the Lord to take these snakes away. So Moses prayed for the people.

dag: Dama n ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia labirina saha shɛli, ka Reechɛl daa kpi sol ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nimaani mini Ɛfirat daa na wɔɣa. Ka n daa sɔɣ o Ɛfirat soli maa ni ; ka di daa ti ma suhugarigu pam.
en: When I came back from Paddan-aram, Rachel died, to my sorrow, on the road in the land of Canaan, with some distance yet to go to Ephrathah, so I buried her there near the road to Ephrathah, which is Bethlehem.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so ti chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A gba yi be Yisa ŋun yi Galili na ŋɔ sani.
en: While Peter was sitting outside in the yard, a servant girl came up to him. She said, You were with Jesus, that man from Galilee.

dag: Yi yinsi nyɛla tampima voya ni. Yi karimbaani n-yɔhim ya ka yi me yi yinsi maa tamla zoya zuɣu, ka ŋmaligi yɛli yimaŋa, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣisi ti tiŋ na.
en: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.

dag: Ka bɛ gbaag o zilima yɛlibu yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ o nyaandola, amaa tinim nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: They insulted him and said, You are that fellow's disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

dag: Din beni nyɛla, chɛliya ka ti kul chani tooni doli so shɛŋa ti ni pun doli hal ni pɔŋɔ la.
en: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.

dag: n-kpe Zakaria yiŋ ti puhi Ɛlizabɛt.
en: She went into Zechariah's house and greeted Elizabeth.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ, n suhir a, deemi n nyɛvili, dama n kum so m bebu.
en: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia, Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛli maa viɛla. Dama o daa yɛlila o suhu ni, Suhudoo mini alaafee yi ni be n ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, di viɛla.
en: Then Hezekiah told Isaiah, This message from the Lord is good.

dag: Dama n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla bindir maŋli, ka n ʒim mi nyɛ binnyur maŋli.
en: For my flesh is the real food; my blood is the real drink.

dag: ni Hazarigada ni Hɛshimɔn ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun so yaha; miriya ka yi gbani n-jɛm tinzunnim wuni.
en: You must never worship another god.

dag: Ka Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba ni yino ka nyɛ ŋun daa ti yɛn yi Yisa nyaaŋa la bɔhi.
en: Judas Iscariot, one of Jesus followers, was there—the one who would later hand Jesus over to his enemies. Judas said.

dag: Ɛfurɔn maŋmaŋ daa ʒila o tab Hitinim maa sani; ka ŋun Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma o tab Hitinim bɛn zaa daa ʒi tiŋ maa dunoli shee maa sani.
en: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka tiŋgbani mi nyɛ n napɔntamdigu. Ka yil bɔ ka yi lee yɛn me n-ti ma? Bee luɣ shɛli be dunia ŋɔ ni ka n ni ʒini nimaani vuhi?.
en: Heaven is my throne, says the Lord, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house would you build for me? Where is the place for me to live in?.

dag: Dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni ku n-naai n ni kari ya tahi zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa balibu. Amaa yinim bɛna, n ku naai yi balibu. N kul ni darigila yi tibili kaman di ni simdi shɛm. N kul ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu.
en: I will come to you and save you. I will destroy all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not destroy you. I will not let you go unpunished; but when I punish you, I will be fair. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Vumiya miri Naawuni, ka o mi vu m-miri ya. Yinim alahichinim ŋɔ, paɣimiya yi nuhi; yinim tɛhaayiyinim ŋɔ, malimiya yi suhuri ka di be kasi.
en: Come near to God and he will come near to you. You are sinners, so clean sin out of your lives. You are trying to follow God and the world at the same time. Make your thinking pure.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni di chɛ ka so ku mali noli din ni tooi yɛli shɛli, ka Naawuni ti kari dunianim zaa saria.
en: Now we know that everything in the Law applies to those who live under the Law, in order to stop all human excuses and bring the whole world under God's judgment.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa yaha, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: God spoke to Moses and said, I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa lan yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na lan di ma shɛhira.
en: Then Samuel said to the people, The Lord has seen what happened. He is the one who chose Moses and Aaron and brought your ancestors out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi yɛli shɛli, biɛhiŋ kani, n niriba ŋɔ naan kari doli bɛ mabihi maa hal ni biɛɣuni asiba.
en: Joab shouted back, I swear by the living God, if you hadn't spoken, my men would have chased their relatives all night.

dag: Filistia nanim mini bɛ niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi tuhilituhili ni daa ti garita, ka Dauda min o niriba pahi Akishi n-doli nyaaŋa na.
en: The Philistine rulers were marching in divisions of and men. David and his men were at the back with Achish.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi n-lo tɔbu; bɛ daa laɣimla Soko din be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka ti bɛ suɣa Soko maa mini Azɛka tiŋ shɛli din be Ɛfɛsidammim tiŋgban ni la sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines assembled their troops for war at Socoh of Judah. They camped between Socoh and Azekah at Ephes-dammim.

dag: N nyɛvili kul bela barina ni sahakam, amaa m bi tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: I am always ready to risk my life; I have not forgotten your law.

dag: O ni ti taɣi bihi laamba suhuri ti bɛ bihi, ka taɣi bihi suhuri ti bɛ laamba din ni chɛ ka n ku kana ti yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He will bring fathers and children together again; otherwise I would have to come and destroy your country.

dag: ni Ɛliɛnai ni Zilɛtai ni Ɛliɛl.
en: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel.

dag: N kpalimla kɔba noli, biɛla n-chɛ n naan kpi.
en: I am so thin, my skin hangs loose on my bones. I have little life left in me.

dag: Ti mini ti nanim ni ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim tum vi tuma, ka tum alahichi nyin Yawɛ sani.
en: and even our kings, our officials, and our ancestors.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ yihi ma la dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa m bi zaɣis a zaligunim maa.
en: They have almost succeeded in killing me, but I have not neglected your commands.

dag: Suhimiya alibarika tim bɛn yɛri ya zilima; ka suhimiya Naawuni tim bɛn turi ya la.
en: Bless those who curse you. Pray for those who mistreat you.

dag: O tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya nahiŋgu mini duŋtaariba nuu ni; bɛ nyɛviya nyɛla din viɛl pam o sani.
en: He rescues them from oppression and violence; their lives are precious to him.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, yilimi yila pampam. Izraɛlnima, tahimiya! Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga, mali suhupiɛlli, ka diri dari ni a suhu zaa!.
en: Rejoice, Daughter Zion! Shout, Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, Daughter Jerusalem.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam nimaani, dama Naawuni be wuntizɔriba sani.
en: But then they will be terrified, for God is with those who obey him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba alaka nyɛla bɛn turi ŋun nam ba, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba nirilim tir o la jilima.
en: If you oppress poor people, you insult the God who made them; but kindness shown to the poor is an act of worship.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura mini bɛn mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ o yurilim maŋli ŋɔ polo.
en: The Lord watches over those who obey him, those who trust in his constant love.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni naai, ka Yaakubu ŋmalig o ba Yisahaku sani yi, di daa bi yuui ka o biɛli Iso yi o mɔɣu gɔbu maa paa na.
en: Isaac finished blessing Jacob. Then, just as Jacob left his father Isaac, Esau came in from hunting.

dag: Shulam paɣa, labimina, labimina! Labimina, labimina ka ti ti nya a. Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri man Shulam paɣa, kaman m bela tɔbbihi bɛn pie tab ʒiɛya buyi sunsuuni wari waa ŋɔ?.
en: Dance, dance, girl of Shulam. Let us watch you as you dance. Why do you want to watch me as I dance between the rows of onlookers?.

dag: Bɛ daa daai ma la pam ka n yɛn lu, amaa ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ma.
en: My enemy attacked me and almost destroyed me, but the Lord helped me.

dag: Ka pateesa shɛŋa din daa yili dunoli maa yaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: On one side of the entrance the wall of curtains was cubits long. There were three posts and three bases on this side.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa tim tuumba Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Ŋuni n-lee lan su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ? Chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n sɔŋ a n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaa na ti ti a.
en: Abner sent some of his men to David with this message: You should be the ruler of the whole nation. If you make an agreement with me, I will persuade everyone in Israel to make you their king.

dag: Di saha naa maa ni ti ŋmaligi zaŋ kpa omaŋmaŋ ya sansana polo, amaa o ni ti tuui lu n-kpi.
en: The king will return to the fortresses of his own land, but he will be defeated, and that will be the end of him.

dag: Ka Samaria paɣ maa bɔh o, Di chaŋ wula ka nyin Yɛhudia nir ti suhiri man Samaria paɣ kom? Dama Yɛhudianim bi saɣiri ka bɛ mini Samarianim laɣindi timdi dira.
en: The Samaritan woman asked, Why do you, a Jewish man, ask for something to drink from me, a Samaritan woman.

dag: Di saha ka Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nyaaŋa ka nyɛ niriba maa zaa guliba la daa yiɣisi paya. Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: The banner of Dans camp, at the rear of the whole camp, marched with its military units. Ahiezer, Ammishaddais son, commanded its military.

dag: Tɔŋ gbaai bɛ napɔŋkpahi, zana gbaai ba gbibi.
en: a trap catches their heels and holds them.

dag: dilan ŋun baŋmi ni ŋunkam ŋmaligi alahichilana o biriginsim sol ni n-labisi zali yɛlimaŋli sol ni ni tiligi alahichilan maa kum ni, ka chɛ ka alahichi pam nya chɛ m-paŋ.
en: recognize that whoever brings a sinner back from the wrong path will save them from death and will bring about the forgiveness of many sins.

dag: Di saha ka o kuhi yɛli, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda nyaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: The blind man shouted, Jesus, Son of David, show me mercy.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ niŋmi lala, dama di daa nyɛla din tiɣi niriba maa zaa nini.
en: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.

dag: Musa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishom mini Ɛliɛza.
en: Moses family: Gershom and Eliezer.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisinaata.
en: of Bebai.

dag: Ɛhab bia Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun piniyini saha ka Ahazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaziah had become Judahs king in the eleventh year of Ahabs son Joram.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yɛri Yisifu lala dabisili kam maa zaa yoli, Yisifu daa bi saɣi ni o min o dɔni.
en: Every single day she tried to convince him, but he wouldnt agree to sleep with her or even to be with her.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɔhimi ba. Niriba yi lu, bɛ bi lan yiɣisir yaha? Ka bee bɛ yi birigi kpe yɔɣu, bɛ bi lan labirina?.
en: Jeremiah, say this to the people of Judah: This is what the Lord says: You know if a man falls down, he gets up again. And if a man goes the wrong way, he turns around and comes back.

dag: Nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo pɔhim, yiɣisimiyana! Ʒiɛmiya kpe m puu maa ni, ka di tulaale nyom gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Chɛ ka n yura ka o puu maa ni na nti di di tiwal suma.
en: Wake up, north wind. Come, south wind. Blow on my garden. Spread its sweet smell. Let my lover enter his garden and eat its pleasant fruit.
