dag: Zahimmi Asiria din nyɛ Lɛbanɔn sida tia, din mali wul viɛla, ka nyɛ tibɔŋ ni mahim, ka nyɛ din wɔɣa pam, ka di wulikpani chaŋ ti tɔri sagbana la.
en: Assyria was a cedar tree in Lebanon with beautiful branches, with forest shade, and very tall. Its top was among the clouds!.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi leeg o tulaalɛmaaniba min o bindir duɣiriba ni o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba.
en: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, cooks, or bakers.

dag: A daa zaŋ liiga shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi n-yɛli ba, ka zaŋ n kpam mini n tulaale zim la zali bɛ tooni.
en: Then you took the beautiful cloth and made clothes for those statues. You took the perfume and incense I gave you and put it in front of those idols.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ ti ŋmanila Yisahaku; ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi o daalikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: My brothers and sisters, you are children who were born because of Gods promise, just as Isaac was.

dag: O daa bi saɣi n-chɛ ka so nahim ba. O daa kpahi nanim zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha nti liri ba, saha shɛli Bɛnhadad mini nanim pihitanaayi bɛn daa sɔŋd o la ni daa nyu dam buɣi be bɛ suɣa ni.
en: At noon they marched for battle. Meanwhile, Ben-hadad and the thirty-two kings allied with him were getting drunk in their tents.

dag: n yi ti sahi n takɔb shɛli din nyaɣisiri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ saria karibu niŋ n nuu ni, n ni bɔhi n dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je ma la tibili.
en: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.

dag: Di simdi ka bansi maa miri naŋgbaŋkuɣila din ti yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa yi ni ti yɛn zaŋ buɣiri teebuli maa la.
en: The rings to hold the poles for carrying the table are to be placed near the rim.

dag: N ni tir a jilima dabisili kam, ka kul ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: I will bless you every day. I will praise your name forever and always.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu lahi la, miriya ka yi shihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri. Malimiya yimaŋ be kasi. Yimiya Babilɔn chaŋ.
en: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu lihi binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka yuŋ ni daa zibira ka o min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi ni lab Bɛtani.
en: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple. After he looked around at everything, because it was already late in the evening, he returned to Bethany with the Twelve.

dag: A yi ti naai li, nyin lan dɔnim pahi buyi, amaa a nudirigu zuɣu ka a ti yɛn dɔni n-ʒi Judanim gba tibidarigibo. N zal a la biɛɣu pihinahi. Dabisili kam yɛn zanila yuuni zaani.
en: When you have completed these days, lie on your right side to bear the guilt of the house of Judah. I appoint forty days to you, one day for each year.

dag: O ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam; dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: The people who heard him were amazed at the way he taught, for he wasn't like the teachers of the Law; instead, he taught with authority.

dag: O ku lan tooi zaŋ binshɛli zal o zaani bee n-zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o n-zaŋ zaɣ suŋ taɣi zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu taɣi zaɣ suŋ. Ka o yi zaŋla biŋkɔbigu ni o taɣi biŋkɔbigu, dindina o ni zaŋ so na ni o ti taɣ o maa min o zaa ni leei bɛn be kasi.
en: You must not put any other animal in its place. Dont try to trade a good animal for a bad one or a bad animal for a good one. If you try to change animals, both animals will become holy—they will both belong to the Lord.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋmi binshɛli kana ka bɛ ti zaŋ li tum Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o tum tuun shɛli maa zaa din nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu pina, bɛ daa zaŋdi li mi na ti tiri Yawɛ.
en: All the Israelites who wanted to help brought gifts to the Lord . They gave these gifts freely, because they wanted to. These gifts were used to make everything the Lord had commanded Moses and the people to make.

dag: Leeban ni daa wum o tizɔpaɣ bia Yaakubu yɛla maa, ka o guui ka o sanna nti bɔb gbaag o m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka zaŋ o kul o yiŋa. Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban binshɛlikam zaa.
en: As soon as Laban heard the news, he ran out to meet Jacob. He hugged and kissed him and brought him to his home, where Jacob told him everything that had happened.

dag: Riu ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Sɛrug.
en: When Reu was he had a son named Serug.

dag: N yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa ku nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, ti sa pun lab li mi yuŋ la zaa ka bi gbaai hal zin yino gba; amaa a ni kul yɛli ma shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni lab li.
en: Master, Simon answered, we worked hard all night long and caught nothing. But if you say so, I will let down the nets.

dag: ka lan pii din bi ŋmani shɛli, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li ka tɛhi ni di pa shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni la, ni o zaŋ li chɛ ka binshɛŋa din beni niŋ yoli.
en: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.

dag: Niŋmiya lala pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara zuɣu n-zaŋ di mini di binnyura sara mali sara. Di bi simdi ni bɛ mali dansi.
en: Offer these and the wine offering in addition to the daily burnt offering and grain offering.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima gabis ayi maa noya gɔhi salima bintaɣindisi la, ka di be o binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la tooni.
en: Fasten the other ends of the gold chains to the two settings. This will fasten them to the two shoulder pieces of the ephod on the front.

dag: Ka bɛ noya daa wol taba, ka Pool tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ka bɛ naanyi wurim. Pool daa yɛli ba mi, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia yɛli ti yaannim shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Anabi Aizaia daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya.
en: So they left, disagreeing among themselves, after Paul had said this one thing: How well the Holy Spirit spoke through the prophet Isaiah to your ancestors!.

dag: Yaa biɛla gba lan ka n niŋgbuna ni m bariŋ maa zuɣu, ka di muɣisi ma n suhu ni, ka n kul ŋuhira.
en: I am worn out and utterly crushed; my heart is troubled, and I groan with pain.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul piligi yiini wumpaɣibo yilli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka mbusim lu Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunim bɛn daa laɣim kana ti liri Judanim maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa birim ka ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu ku taba.
en: As soon as they began singing, the Lord confused the enemy camp.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ʒini Sool zuɣu m-muɣis o pam.
en: The Lord 's spirit left Saul, and an evil spirit sent by the Lord tormented him.

dag: Amaa niriba pam bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti leei nyaannima, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima.
en: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are last will be first.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee maani ansarisi ka tura? Ŋun zuɣu ka a lee tahira, ka niŋ karimbaani m-mirigir a nina niŋda? Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a mɔri maa.
en: But who did you insult and make fun of? Who did you speak against? You were against the Holy One of Israel. You acted like you were better than he was!.

dag: A bi mi ni kurimbuni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ daadam niŋ dunia ni la.
en: Do you know this from long ago— from when humans were placed on earth.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa teeg o nuu shihi n noli ka yɛli ma, Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa niŋ a noli ni.
en: Then the Lord reached out with his hand and touched my mouth. He said to me, Jeremiah, I am putting my words in your mouth.

dag: Nyini n-daa wuhi shihira mini alahiziba tuma Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka na kul wuhiri li hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini daadamnim zaa sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a zali yuli hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You have performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt as you do to this very day in Israel and everywhere else. Thats why you are so renowned.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so daa ti nya Pita ni ʒi buɣim maa neesim ni n-lihir o ka ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ gba yi be Yisa sani.
en: When one of the servant women saw him sitting there at the fire, she looked straight at him and said, This man too was with Jesus.

dag: Nyɔhi ni tuɣiri chani shɛm la, karim ba ka bɛ chaŋ lala. Shigbaŋ ni miriti buɣim ka nyɛligiri shɛm la, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛligi lala Naawuni tooni.
en: Like smoke is driven away, drive them away! Like wax melting before fire, let the wicked perish before God!.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zali saha shɛli yi ti paai, n ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli kari saria.
en: You have set a time to judge with fairness.

dag: Ka Gaad daa ka Dauda sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o, Cham Aruna Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili la ni ti me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: That day Gad came to David and said, Go and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

dag: Di saha ka paɣiba maa daa lan kum pam. Ka Opa ŋun daa chɛbisi Naomi ka ŋmaligi kuli, amaa ka Rut ŋun zaɣisi ka kul doli Naomi.
en: So again they cried very much. Then Orpah kissed Naomi goodbye, but Ruth hugged her and stayed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛ wula? N ni suhi Naawuni n shia ni, ka lan suhi Naawuni m milinsi ni; n ni yili yila n shia ni, ka lan yili yila m milinsi ni gba.
en: What should I do, then? I will pray with my spirit, but I will pray also with my mind; I will sing with my spirit, but I will sing also with my mind.

dag: Ka o bia maa yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani; hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba.
en: Father, the son said, I have sinned against God and against you. I am no longer fit to be called your son.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tim ti boli Reechɛl mini Liya ni bɛ ka o sanna o ni daa mal o biŋkɔbiri be mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli la.
en: So Jacob told Rachel and Leah to meet him in the field where he kept his flocks of sheep and goats.

dag: Dama o mi ninvuɣ yoya, ka o yi nya zaɣ biɛɣu, o ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: God knows which people are worthless; he sees all their evil deeds.

dag: N daa ŋme ba luhi n naba ni, ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: I strike them down, and they cannot rise; they lie defeated before me.

dag: Dinzuɣu, m bia, wummi n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ, yiɣisim zo n-kuli n tizɔdoo Leeban sani Haran.
en: Now, son, do what I say. Go at once to my brother Laban in Haran.

dag: Chɛrili nyɛla bɛn ka yaa, amaa bɛ nyari bindirigu diri siɣili saha.
en: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;.

dag: Ka zaŋ piɛlaa la mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pal la m-mali biɛrisuŋ sara Yawɛ sani; ka maligumaana maa lan mali chi sara mini binnyura sara din pahi la.
en: He will give the basket of bread without yeast to the Lord . Then he will kill the ram as a fellowship offering to the Lord. He will give it to the Lord with the grain offering and the drink offering.

dag: Amaa di sabiya ni ninsalinim nambu piligu ni, Naawuni daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti tim Adɔram ŋun daa su o tuun kpɛma tumbu fukumsi la Izraɛlnim sani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa pihi kuɣa lab ku o. Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa niŋ yomyom kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-zo kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoniram, who was in charge of the forced labor, to go to the Israelites, but they stoned him to death. At this, Rehoboam hurriedly got in his chariot and escaped to Jerusalem.

dag: n-daa kpalim ni niŋ chira ata. Ka daa ti yɛn yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria ka wum ni Yɛhudianim gu o soli, ka o daa lo nia ni o ni zaŋ doli Masidɔnia polo chaŋ.
en: he stayed for three months. Because the Jews hatched a plot against Paul as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided instead to return through Macedonia.

dag: Ka n garigi bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli ma, Man Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: I asked, Who are you, Lord? The voice said, I am Jesus from Nazareth, the one you are persecuting.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka sagbani sirigina wuntaŋ ni ti lim Ziɔn Zoli mini bɛnkam zaa laɣim nimaani, ka nyɛ nyɔhi ni buɣim niɛm din diri ne yuŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni jilima din be nimaani ni ti nyɛla leeŋa.
en: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di saha n ti ku kpihim yi birili zaa.
en: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ Naawuni nir maa sani Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu. Naawuni Nir maa ni daa nya paɣ maa ka o kanna ka o yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Nyama, Shunɛm paɣ la m-be katiŋ kanna ŋɔ.
en: The woman went to Mount Carmel to get the man of God. The man of God saw the Shunammite woman coming from far away and said to his servant Gehazi, Look, theres the Shunammite woman!.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la ni yino daa zaŋ salima lah ayopɔin din pali Naawuni ŋun be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili n-ti malaikanima ayopɔin maa.
en: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven gold bowls full of the anger of God, who lives forever and ever.

dag: Ka ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda yi bɔri ni o woligi ka chɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda, ŋun niŋmi lala, dimbɔŋɔ puuni doo bee paɣa ŋun nyɛla yɛdaniŋda mali soli ni o niŋ o ni yu shɛm. Dama Naawuni bɔri ni ti malila suhudoo.
en: However, if the one who is not a believer wishes to leave the Christian partner, let it be so. In such cases the Christian partner, whether husband or wife, is free to act. God has called you to live in peace.

dag: Bɛ vihiri mɔɣa piligu shee n-yihiri binshɛŋa din sɔɣiya palo ni.
en: They even find places where rivers begin. They bring to light what once was hidden.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba ni sɔhirimi, ka sokam ninni biɛhigu taɣira.
en: Before this army, people shake with fear. Their faces become pale from fear.

dag: Ŋuna ka n ti yɛn nya ka o baɣi ma, ka n nina ti nya o, ka pa ni so yaha. N suhu kul yɛla di zuɣu.
en: I will see him with my own eyes. I myself, not someone else, will see God. And I cannot tell you how excited that makes me feel!.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: Jesus finished by saying, The Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ n-saɣim bɛ nanim yinsi.
en: So get up! We will attack the city at night! Lets destroy the strong walls that are around Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ ŋma ʒiri pa Yawɛ, ka yɛli, O ku niŋ shɛli. Zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti, tɔbu bee kum ku lu ti zuɣu.
en: Those people lied about the Lord . They said, He will not do anything to us. Nothing bad will happen to us. We will never see an army attack us. We will never starve.

dag: Di saha naa maa ni ti ŋmaligi zaŋ kpa omaŋmaŋ ya sansana polo, amaa o ni ti tuui lu n-kpi.
en: After that happens, the northern king will go back to the strong forts of his own country. But he will be weak and will fall. He will be finished.

dag: Ka binnɛɔŋ balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, noonsi mini yiŋ biŋkɔbiri ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛn be dunia ni zaŋ tabili ninsalinim zaa.
en: Every living being on the earth died—every bird, every animal, and every person.

dag: O ni ti zani n-dih o biŋkɔbbaligu Yawɛ yiko ni, ka ni ti zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima ni. Ka bɛ ti be ni alaafee, dama pumpɔŋɔ o ni nyɛla ninvuɣ titali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: He will begin to rule Israel in the power of the Lord . Like a shepherd, he will lead his people in the wonderful name of the Lord his God. And they will live in safety because then his greatness will be known all over the world.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa beni Jɔshua bia Joyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔzadak yaaŋa la saha mini Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la mini Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni zaligubaŋda la gba saha.
en: They served in the days of Joiakim. Joiakim was the son of Jeshua, who was the son of Jozadak. And the gatekeepers also served in the days of Nehemiah the governor and in the days of Ezra the priest and teacher.

dag: Lee baŋmiya ni yi yi ku ma, ŋun ka taali ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi mini ya ŋɔ tiŋgbani ni ya ŋɔ nim zuɣu, dama yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ n-tim ma yi sanna ni n ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli ya ka yi wum.
en: But be sure of this: if you kill me, you and the people of this city will be guilty of killing an innocent man, because it is the Lord who sent me to give you this warning.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa nya zama maa, ka di niŋ ba nyuli ka bɛ ŋmɛri Pool ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa naŋgbankpeeni, ka tur o.
en: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy; they disputed what Paul was saying and insulted him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa du zuɣusaa n-yi tiŋ maa sunsuuni chaŋ ti zani zo shɛli din be tiŋ maa wulimpuhili polo la zuɣu.
en: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.

dag: Yi yi ni doli n ni zaŋ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o soya zaa, ka zaŋ yimaŋ ti o.
en: Its true: if you carefully keep all this commandment that Im giving you, by doing it, by loving the LORD your God, by walking in all his ways, and by clinging to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ soya maa ni ti nyɛla sariginli soya din be zibisim ni, bɛ ni ti yɛn kari ba bahi so shɛli zuɣu ka bɛ ti lu. Dama n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili yuun shɛli n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The paths they follow will be slippery and dark; I will make them stumble and fall. I am going to bring disaster on them; the time of their punishment is coming. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni be ti sani kaman o ni daa be ti yaannim maa sani shɛm la. O di chɛ ti bee n-zaŋ ti bahi.
en: The Lord our God was with our ancestors to help them, and I pray that he will be with us and never abandon us.

dag: M mabihi, lala zuɣu sokam kul kpalimmi be Naawuni sani kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni ti bol o.
en: My friends, each of you should remain in fellowship with God in the same condition that you were when you were called.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim niriba maa ni ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm ka o ni sɔhira, ŋun lab kuli. Ka Gidiɔn daa buɣisi ba lala, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi daa lab kuli; ka chɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia kɔŋko.
en: So call your troops together and tell them that anyone who is really afraid can leave Mount Gilead and go home. Twenty-two thousand men returned home, leaving Gideon with only , soldiers.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya n-daa pah ayi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa bela Juda zuliya tiŋgban ni.
en: The second assignment made was for the families of the tribe of Simeon. Its territory extended into the land assigned to the tribe of Judah.

dag: Kul kpaŋmiya yimaŋ chɛ ka suhudoo be yi mini sokam sunsuuni, ka maliya Naawuni biɛrikasitali din nyɛ nir ni ka shɛli ka ku tooi nya ti Duuma la.
en: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.

dag: ka booi kom din be kasi niŋ laa ni, ka tooi taŋkpaɣu din do Naawuni jɛmbu shee tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ li niŋ kom maa ni.
en: The priest will take holy water in a clay jar, and taking dust from the floor of the dwelling, the priest will place it in the water.

dag: Ɛfurɔn maŋmaŋ daa ʒila o tab Hitinim maa sani; ka ŋun Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma o tab Hitinim bɛn zaa daa ʒi tiŋ maa dunoli shee maa sani.
en: Now Ephron was a native Hittite. So Ephron the Hittite responded to Abraham publicly in order that the Hittites and everyone at his citys gate could hear.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔriti gbaai Firawuna min o yiŋnima, Ibram paɣ Zarai maa zuɣu.
en: But because the king had taken Sarai, the Lord sent terrible diseases on him and on the people of his palace.

dag: a yi shiri bo yɛm, ka moog a nini bahi tɛhi zilima zuɣu.
en: Call out for insight, and cry aloud for understanding.

dag: Di nyɛla ashil shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ sɔɣi niriba ʒiɛmana din gari la ha puuni, amaa ka yipa kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda pumpɔŋɔ.
en: which is the secret he hid through all past ages from all human beings but has now revealed to his people.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya alikauli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi di nasara yi tuuni kam ni.
en: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.

dag: Tɔɣisimiya Jɛrusalɛmnim suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa. Yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ di wahala saɣi lala. N darigi bɛ tibili ka di saɣi, ka yipa chɛ bɛ daalahichi taali zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord , made you pay double for your sins.

dag: Jɔshua yi di daa chɛ ka Naawuni niriba nya vuhim Naawuni sani, dindina ŋun Naawuni daa naan ku lan tɔɣisi dabisi shɛli yɛla yaha.
en: If Joshua had given the people the rest that God had promised, God would not have spoken later about another day.

dag: M paɣiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun ti ma yaa ni n tum ŋɔ. M paɣir o o ni lihi ma ka n simdi ni o pii ma ka n tum o tuma.
en: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord because he trusted me and gave me this work of serving him. He gives me strength.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kari ninvuɣ biɛri bahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord , the land will be yours.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ziŋ maa ni o gbuɣimi Jona bahi, ka o daa zaŋ o ti gbuɣi bahi duli.
en: Then the Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out of its stomach onto the dry land.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni, gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanu dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the fifteenth day of that month in the twelfth year of exile, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: ka boli laɣiŋgu maa niriba zaa ka bɛ ka Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni na.
en: and assemble the whole community at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Di zaa ni ti nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu; ka dapaɣili kam tam diba ayi zuɣu.
en: So there will be eight frames with their sixteen silver bases, two under each frame.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda yɛli Yuria, Kulimi yiŋ ti paɣ a naba. Ka Yuria daa yiɣisi nayili maa yi, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini dol o nyaaŋa ni bɛ ti ti o.
en: Then David said to Uriah, Go home and relax. So Uriah left the kings palace. The king also sent a gift to Uriah.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di lan yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ polo yaha. M pun zali ni a mini Ziba pirigim tiŋgbani maa ti taba.
en: The king answered, You don't have to say anything more. I have decided that you and Ziba will share Saul's property.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so mini bɛn daa pah o zuɣu ʒiɛya guli Yisa maa ni daa nya tiŋgbani dambu maa mini din niŋ maa, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: The officer and the soldiers guarding Jesus felt the earthquake and saw everything else that happened. They were frightened and said, This man really was God's Son.

dag: N ni ti ku binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri. Alɔbo titali nti yɛn lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: I will kill everyone living in this city; people and animals alike will die of a terrible disease.

dag: O bi ʒe tibi nyɛvili soli zuɣu. O soli kpɛla yɔɣu, ka o bi mi lala.
en: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.

dag: Ŋunkam daa nya ba ŋubiri ba mi, ka bɛ dimnim yɛli, Ti ka taali, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun guli ba ni yɛlimaŋli la, bɛ yaannim ni daa mali tahima Yawɛ so san la.
en: They are attacked by all who find them. Their enemies say, They sinned against the Lord , and so what we have done is not wrong. Their ancestors trusted in the Lord , and they themselves should have remained faithful to him.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa boli sapashinnima ayi na ti yɛli ba, Malimiya shili n-zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba pisopɔin ni kpan ŋmɛriba kɔbisiyi m-pa yimaŋ zuɣu ka yiɣisi kpe kurigu awɛi saha yuŋ ŋɔ n-chaŋ Siizaria.
en: Then the commander called two army officers. He said to them, I need some men to go to Caesarea. Get soldiers ready. Also, get soldiers on horses and men to carry spears. Be ready to leave at nine oclock tonight.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni la, n daa lo ba alikauli yɛli.
en: the God of Israel, told me to say to the people: I made a covenant with your ancestors when I rescued them from Egypt and set them free from slavery. I told them that.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ kpana pam to n-chib o gbaŋ bee n-zaŋ zahimgbahiri kpana to o zuɣu ni?.
en: Can you fill his hide with fishing spears or pierce his head with a harpoon?.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni, Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Simeon—Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;.

dag: Di yi niŋ kamaata ni n nyu bara, n ni nyula bara binshɛŋa din wuhiri n chɔɣinsi ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu.
en: If its necessary to brag, Ill brag about my weaknesses.

dag: Amaa buŋdibbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ni yi zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi tuuli bidibisi n-tiligi ba.
en: But every first male donkey you should ransom with a sheep. If you dont ransom it, you must break its neck. You should ransom every oldest male among your children.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir maa daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal a yi zaŋ a yiŋ pirigili ti ma, n ku dol a kuli. Ka m mi ku di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: The man of God said to the king, Even if you gave me half your palace, I wouldnt go with you, nor would I eat food or drink water in this place.

dag: ka mɛnya kuɣa sara maligu bimbini nimaani n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; di ti yɛn nyɛla kuɣa sara maligu bimbini, ka pa yi ni zaŋ kurugu bini shihi kuɣ shɛŋa.
en: Also, use some stones there to build an altar to the Lord your God. Dont use iron tools to cut the stones.

dag: Ka di nyɛla o ni zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila Sidɔnnim buɣili Asitati din nyɛ paɣ la mini Mɔabnim buɣili Chɛmɔshi ni Ammɔnnim buɣili Milikom, ka bi doli n soya n-tumdi din tuhi n sani ni n zaligunim mini n kaya kaman o ba Dauda ni daa niŋdi shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Solomon and the Israelites are not like their ancestor David. They will not listen to me, obey me, or do what is right. They have turned from me to worship Astarte the goddess of Sidon, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of Ammon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N tin ya nyina din viɛla, ka chɛ ka kum lu yi tiŋ kam ni, di zaa yoli ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I didnt give you any food to eat. There was no food in any of your cities, but you didnt come back to me. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka naa mali suhupiɛlli; a sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o mali suhupiɛlli pam maa.
en: Our Lord , your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha;.
en: Pray that it doesnt happen in winter.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The word of the Lord spread everywhere in that region.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-chaŋ ni o ti nya Sool, ka bɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Sool daa kala Kamɛl na nti me bɛ ni yɛn mali binshɛli teer o yɛla zali, ka gari chaŋ Giligal.
en: Early the next morning he went to talk with Saul. Someone told him, Saul went to Carmel, where he had a monument built so everyone would remember his victory. Then he left for Gilgal.

dag: Daba anii dali bɛ ni guni bia maa.
en: The baby boy must be circumcised on the eighth day.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa ni, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: Now, on the day when the dead rise to life, whose wife will she be? All of them had married her.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni fa ninvuɣ kura maa ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o labisi o ni daa pun be tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka bɛ ni daa booi kpam din be kasi bahi maligumaaniba zuɣulaan so zuɣu ni ti kpi.
en: If the community decides to protect you from the dead persons family, the community must take you back to your city of safety. You must stay there until the official high priest dies.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli; Aai, di simdi ni n da li kaman di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, dama n ku zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli n-nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka Dauda daa da kabɔɣili maa mini naɣikɔra maa anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: But the king said to Araunah, No! I must pay you for everything. I will not offer burnt offerings to the Lord my God that cost me nothing. So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for shekels of silver.

dag: Yɛm puuni ka nir mɛri yili, tɛhi zilima puuni ka yili mɛri zaana.
en: By wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established.

dag: Wummiya vuri! Wummiya, di kanna. Vuri pam n-yi nuzaa polo na ni di ti chɛ ka Juda fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka leei yɔbahi gɔbu shee.
en: Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.

dag: Yinim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be nyɔŋ puuni, kamiyana ti gbahi di.
en: Wild animals in the forest, come and eat.

dag: Bɛ noya ni alahichi mini bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛ ka bɛ karimbaani gbahi ba! Bɛ ninvuɣ tubo mini bɛ ʒiŋmabo zuɣu.
en: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa tooi baai du Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ n-nyɛ li la; amaa ka Ijiptinim daa kana ti tɔɣisi ba niŋ lala ka kom di ba.
en: By faith they crossed the Red Sea as if they were on dry land, but when the Egyptians tried it, they were drowned.

dag: O daa zaɣis o biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ tanti du shɛl ni o ni daa be ninsalinim sunsuuni la.
en: He abandoned his place at Shiloh, the Holy Tent where he lived among the people.

dag: Ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, Doo maa yi di bi yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani, nir naan tooi zaŋ o bahi kpe.
en: Agrippa told Festus, Paul could have been set free, if he had not asked to be tried by the Roman Emperor.

dag: Atɛr ni Hɛzɛkia ni Azur ni.
en: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum yi tuma zaa.
en: Six days you may work and do all your tasks.

dag: A ni ti tam a nandahima ŋɔ yɛla, a ni ti teei di yɛla ka di ŋmanila ko shɛli din pun zo n-gari.
en: Then you can forget your troubles, like water that has already passed by.

dag: Ka Maika daa bɔh o, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira, ka yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. N chani bɔrila luɣ shɛli ni n ʒini.
en: Micah asked him, Where have you come from? The young man answered, I am a Levite from the city of Bethlehem in Judah. I am looking for a place to live.

dag: Niriba ayi bɛn daa wum Jɔn ni yɛli shɛm ka doli Yisa maa ni yino n-daa nyɛ Anduru, Saimɔn Pita tizo.
en: One of them was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

dag: Amaa dɔro yi be situr shɛli ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli ni, ka yi paɣi li ka di yi, di simdi ka yi paɣi li pahi buyi, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi, ti niŋ yɛda ni ti min o ni lan laɣim mali nyɛvili.
en: But if we died with Christ, we have faith that we will also live with him.

dag: ka tooi chi zim maa nukurigu pali kaman di ni wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li niŋ buɣim ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka paɣ maa zaŋ kom maa nyu.
en: The priest will fill his hands with some of the grain and put it on the altar and let it burn there. After that he will tell the woman to drink the water.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ bihi yiri chani kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la, ka bɛ bihi maa yiɣiri jamda.
en: Their children run and play like lambs.

dag: bee gomnanim bɛn nyɛ o ni tim shɛb ni be ti darigi bɛn tumdi taali tibili, ka paɣi bɛn tumdi tuun suma la.
en: and to the governors, who have been appointed by him to punish the evildoers and to praise those who do good.

dag: Ka Ziɔnnim wum li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka Juda fɔntinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ, a ni kariti saria shɛm zuɣu.
en: Zion has heard and celebrates, the towns of Judah rejoice, because of your acts of justice, LORD.

dag: N Naawuni maa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o ni ka n sanna; n Naawuni maa ni chɛ ka n nyaŋ n dimnima.
en: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.

dag: Di kari ma a sani bahi, a mi di yih a shia kasi n ni.
en: Dont push me away or take your Holy Spirit from me.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai niriba maa pam ka bɛ yɛl o, Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ŋɔ? Bɛ daa baŋya ni o yila Yawɛ sani zɔra, dama omaŋmaŋa n-daa pun yɛli ba lala.
en: Jonah told the men he was running away from the Lord . The men became very afraid when they learned this. They asked Jonah, What terrible thing did you do against your God.

dag: Ka Leeban daa boli di yuli Jɛgarisahaduta; ka Yaakubu mi boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

dag: Yɛhudianim shɛb a ni zaŋ zali ni bɛ su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaɣ shɛŋa fukumsi la be kpe ka bi lihi nya a, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku jɛm a wuna maa bee n-damdi tiŋ jɛm salima binnan shɛl a ni mali zal la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo.
en: Now there are some Jews, ones you appointed to administer the province of Babylon—specifically, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—who have ignored your command. They dont serve your gods, and they dont worship the gold statue youve set up.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛli ba, Jɔn daa baptaizirila niriba tuuba niŋbu zuɣu, ka yɛri ba ni bɛ niŋm Yisa ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa na la yɛda.
en: Paul said, The baptism of John was for those who turned from their sins; and he told the people of Israel to believe in the one who was coming after him—that is, in Jesus.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti tim ti yɛli Jɛsi, Chɛ ka Dauda kpalim n yili ŋɔ n-tumdi n tuma; dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: Not long after this, Saul sent another message to Jesse: I really like David. Please let him stay with me.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa garigi yɛl o, Din kariya, din kariya ka n saɣim bee n-wurim ya ŋɔ.
en: Joab answered, No, no! I'm not trying to wipe you out or destroy your town!.

dag: Jɔn daa nyɛla firila din diri ka ne, ka yi daa saɣi m-mali suhupiɛlli o neesim maa ni daba ayi.
en: John was like a lamp, burning and shining, and you were willing for a while to enjoy his light.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni amaa ŋun Naawuni ni ti darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ o zuliya leei daba maa tibili; di nyaaŋa ka chɛ ka o zuliya maa nya faako n-lab kpe na ti jɛm ŋun Naawuni.
en: But I will punish the nation that made them slaves. And God also said, After those things happen, your people will come out of that country. Then they will worship me here in this place.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Make acacia-wood poles and cover them with gold.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba bɛn lo kpara ŋɔ zaa ni du n-chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa ti Yawɛ kaman nyin ti dan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa wum di yɛla, ka boli tiŋgbani maa yuli Akɛlidama.
en: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means Field of Blood.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt, Di sabi ni Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ, amaa sabimila, Doo ŋɔ yɛliya ni o nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa. .
en: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, He claimed to be King of the Jews. .

dag: Bee m-bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣi tiŋgban ni? .
en: Nor are you to ask, Who will go down into the world below? .

dag: Dama Naawuni n-zaani saha shɛl o ni bɔri ni daadamnim kan o sanna ka o ti kariti ba saria.
en: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.

dag: Amaa Musa mini maligumaana Aduna ni daa pun sab Izraɛlnim shɛb yuya Sinai mɔɣu ni la so daa ka bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya ŋɔ kalinli maa ni.
en: There wasnt one person among these from those enrolled by Moses and Aaron the priest when they enrolled the Israelites in the Sinai desert.

dag: Amaa bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka di ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: The seed scattered on good soil are those who hear the word and embrace it. They bear fruit, in one case a yield of thirty to one, in another case sixty to one, and in another case one hundred to one.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, O yɛli ma ni di bi simdi ni n lab kuna ni nuzaŋa, ka zaŋ chi ŋɔ zaa ti ma.
en: She also said, Boaz gave me this grain, because he didn't want me to come back without something for you.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ti lan yɛl o, Ŋmaligim ka chɛ ma dolibu; bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka n ku a? N yi ku a wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ lih a biɛli Jɔab ninni.
en: Once more Abner said to him, Stop chasing me! Why force me to kill you? How could I face your brother Joab.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli o kɔŋko suhiri Naawuni ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: One day when Jesus was praying alone, the disciples came to him. Who do the crowds say I am? he asked them.

dag: Bɛ yi gbaai jɛŋgbin nyaŋ bia ka chɛ o ka o chirig a, di so ni a zaŋ a nyɔɣu yo jɛrigu o jɛrilim tuma saha.
en: Safer to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than fools in their folly.

dag: Piɛm ku tooi kar o ka o guui, ka kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa ŋmani wurigu o sani.
en: Arrows cant make him flee; slingstones he turns to straw.

dag: Riu ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Sɛrug.
en: When Reu was years old, he had a son, Serug;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa siɣina Sinai Zoli maa kpaakpaanyom ni nti boli Musa du zoli maa kpaakpaanyom maa ni, ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So the Lord came down to Mount Sinai. He came from heaven to the top of the mountain. Then he called Moses to come up to the top of the mountain with him. So Moses went up the mountain.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n shia yɛn siɣi; ka wahala dabisa gbaai ma gbibi.
en: Now I am about to die; there is no relief for my suffering.

dag: M mi yi tɛha mini yi ni lo nia shɛli na ni yi ti birigi ma.
en: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.

dag: ni o bɔrila a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣ viɛla ni a bihi.
en: The message said, This is what Ben-hadad says: Your silver and your gold are mine. Your good-looking wives and children are mine.

dag: N ni be a sani yuun pisi shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zaa, a piɛri min a buhi ni zaɣ yino gba na ʒi m-mali baɣili nti zaŋ li bahi, ka m mi na ʒi n-gbaag a piɛlaa kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: I have worked years for you. During all that time none of the baby sheep and goats died during birth. And I have not eaten any of the rams from your flocks.

dag: dama o daa tib barinim pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ŋunkam mali dɔro ŋaɣisiri niriba maa ni ni o ti shih o.
en: He had healed so many people that everyone who was sick pushed forward so that they could touch him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ dimbɔŋɔnim leela bɛn birigi yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu puuni.
en: Some people have turned away from these and have lost their way in foolish discussions.

dag: Amaa a nam ba ka bɛ biɛhigu pooi nyin Naawuni biɛla. A zaŋ jiri mini jilima pili ba kaman zuɣupila la.
en: But you made them almost like gods and crowned them with glory and honor.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni zo Rɛzin mini Pɛka dabiɛm ka zaɣisi Shilɔa kulibɔŋ kom din doya baalim la zuɣu.
en: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal ka man ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim bia ŋɔ yi di nyɛ n nintu shɛli n ni mali dihiri binyara zuɣu la, ka di piri n nudirigu ni gba, n naan darigi fuɣ a n nubil maa ni.
en: The Lord said to King Jehoiachin, son of King Jehoiakim of Judah, As surely as I am the living God, even if you were the signet ring on my right hand, I would pull you off.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayi ni ka niriba pam daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: Many people came together in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month. It was a very large crowd.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi yi tum niriba gaŋbu tuun shɛli ashilɔni, o ni darigi yi tibili.
en: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you.

dag: Naawuni ni tim so na maa tɔɣisirila Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, dama Naawuni zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti o ka di ka buɣisibu.
en: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba daa mali niɣi pam. Bɛ ni daa nya ka Jaza mini Giliad tiŋgbana simdi niɣi biɛhigu shee.
en: The tribes of Reuben and Gad had many cattle. These people looked at the land near Jazer and Gilead. They saw that this land was good for their cattle.

dag: Vinvamli din yuli booni Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ? Bɔzuɣu ka tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa tam mɔpila zuɣu puhiri chuɣu?.
en: An oracle about the Valley of Vision. What is wrong with you, that you have all gone up to the rooftops.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma n suhusaɣiŋgu saha. Gbilisim tibili wum, ka garigi ma yomyom n ni suhir a saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.

dag: Ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be yinim bundaannim ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi pun di yi nyaɣisim.
en: But how bad it will be for you rich people, because you had your easy life.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Bia maa ku tooi niŋ shɛli omaŋmaŋ yubu ni naɣila o ni nya ka o Ba niŋdi shɛli, dama Ba maa ni niŋdi shɛli, dina ka Bia maa gba niŋda.
en: So Jesus answered them, I tell you the truth: the Son can do nothing on his own; he does only what he sees his Father doing. What the Father does, the Son also does.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daanya mali paɣibu tahili, ka mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Make a copper basin for washing along with its copper stand. Put it between the meeting tent and the altar, and put water in it.

dag: Bɛtilihɛmnim mini Nɛtɔfanim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihiwɛiayika.
en: The people of Bethlehem and Netophah.

dag: A nyu bara yɛli ni a gbi kɔbilisi tinzun tinsi ni n-nyu di kom, ka a tɔbbihi siɣi Nail Mɔɣili ni n-no n-gili ka di kom nyuui.
en: You boasted that you dug wells and drank water in foreign lands, and that the feet of your soldiers tramped the Nile River dry.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisi dali ka sagbani maa daa vuui alikauli biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa.
en: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpe mɔɣu chaŋ dabisi muni chandi nti teei ʒini ti shɛli gbini n-suhiri Naawuni bɔri ni o kpi. O daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, di saɣiya, deemi n nyɛvili pumpɔŋɔ, dama m bi so n yaannima.
en: He himself went farther on into the desert a days journey. He finally sat down under a solitary broom bush. He longed for his own death: Its more than enough, LORD! Take my life because Im no better than my ancestors.

dag: O daa pun wum Yisa yɛla, ka daa gil o nyaaŋa nti ŋaɣisi kpe salo maa ni nti shihi o binyɛrigu.
en: She had heard about Jesus, so she came in the crowd behind him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, bɛna ka o wuhiri di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so shɛli.
en: When people choose to follow the Lord , he shows them the best way to live.

dag: yi ni zaŋdi nyɛvili yɛligu tiri ba la puuni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n-ti mali daliri din ni nyu bara Masia labbuna dabisili la dali, ka di wuhi ni n kpaŋmaŋtali mini n tuma bi kpalim yoli.
en: and you offer them the teaching that gives life. So I can be proud of you when Christ comes again. You will show that my work was not wasted—that I ran in the race and won.

dag: Ka n ni ti saɣim yi jɛmbu shɛhi zaa, ka wurim yi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina, ka ti zaŋ ya zaɣ kpima pa yi buɣ kpima zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ya ni n suhu zaa.
en: I will destroy your high places. I will cut down your incense altars. I will put your dead bodies on the dead bodies of your idols. You will be disgusting to me.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana ka o daa bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: After that Judas waited for the best time to hand Jesus over to them.

dag: N ni darig o tibili o ni daa tam n yɛla Baalnim chuɣu dabisa saha, ka tuɣindi ba tulaale zim, ka pir o nintua, ka ye salima n-zo n-dol o mamanim la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel served false gods, so I will punish her. She burned incense to those false gods. She dressed up—she put on her jewelry and nose ring. Then she went to her lovers and forgot me. This is what the Lord has said.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum ni Yisa pun kpi maa ka di gar o pam, ka o daa boli sapashin la na nti bɔh o ni Yisa shiri kpiya?.
en: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, and he called in the army officer to find out if Jesus had been dead very long.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ni daa chaŋ ni o ti di ka nyu saha shɛli maa, ka Ilaija daa du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti kurim n-zaŋ o nini kpa o duna;.
en: So Ahab got up to celebrate with food and drink. But Elijah went up to the top of Mount Carmel. He bowed down to the ground and put his face between his knees.

dag: Daadam, nyama, bɛn Izraɛlnim yɛra, O ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa yuma na galisiya, ka o daanabitali maa nyɛ saha shɛli din be katiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: Human one, the house of Israel is now saying, The vision that he sees is for distant days; he prophesies about future times.

dag: Naawuni Kundi daa pun daŋ tiri wuhi ni Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka daa daŋ yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti Ibrahimma yɛli: A zuɣu ka zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika.
en: But when it saw ahead of time that God would make the Gentiles righteous on the basis of faith, scripture preached the gospel in advance to Abraham: All the Gentiles will be blessed in you .

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi n zuɣu na ka o yɛli ma, Yɛlima, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, yi ni tɛhi shɛm m-bala? M mi binshɛŋa din kpe yi tɛha ni.
en: The LORDs spirit took hold of me, and he said to me: Say, This is what the LORD God proclaims: So you have said, house of Israel! But I know what you really mean.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei nanim maa tinsi maa zaa, ka gbahi bɛ nanim gba zaa; ka daa zaŋ takɔb ku sokam zaa kaman Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: Joshua captured all these kings and their cities. He struck them down without mercy. He wiped them out as something reserved for God. This was exactly as Moses the LORDs servant had commanded.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu.
en: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a. Ka bɔ ka ti lee ti yɛn nya di zuɣu.
en: Then Peter spoke up. Look, he said, we have left everything and followed you. What will we have.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ daa naan ku chɛ li malibu? Ka niriba bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni lala yi daa shiri yi bɛ daalahichi ni, bɛ suhuri daa naan ku lan chihiri alahichi zuɣu.
en: Otherwise, wouldnt they have stopped being offered? If the people carrying out their religious duties had been completely cleansed once, no one would have been aware of sin anymore.

dag: Naawuni ni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛm m-bala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ mini zuɣusaa dahin shɛli.
en: This is the story about the creation of the sky and the earth. This is what happened when the Lord God made the earth and the sky.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni! A chɛ ka a jilima yi zahira zuɣusaa.
en: Lord our Lord, your name is the most wonderful in all the earth! It brings you praise everywhere in heaven.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ o dabili Ibrahimma zuliya mini Yaakubu bihi bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: you who are the offspring of Abraham, his servant, and the children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti gbarigi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suma tumbu polo dama ti yi bi gbarigi, chɛbu saha yi ti paai, ti ni chɛ ti ni biri shɛli.
en: Lets not get tired of doing good, because in time well have a harvest if we dont give up.

dag: A yi chana, binshɛli ku gabi a naba, ka a yi guui, a ku tuui.
en: Nothing will stand in your way if you walk wisely, and you will not stumble when you run.

dag: Ka zaŋya Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ tɔroko maa ni, ka zaŋ salima binyara din nyɛ yi daalahichi sanyoo pini la zali baɣili di luɣili ni n-daai li bahi n-chɛ ka di chaŋ di ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: Next, take the LORDs chest and put it in the cart. Set the gold items that you are giving God as a compensation offering in a box next to the chest. Then send it on its way.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa be yi sani, ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim; ti daa kul bela baalim, ka gbib ya kaman paɣ ni gbib o bihi shɛm la.
en: although we could have thrown our weight around as Christs apostles. Instead, we were gentle with you like a nursing mother caring for her own children.

dag: Yim kpe n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti sɔɣi dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Go from here and turn east. Hide by the Cherith Brook that faces the Jordan River.

dag: Itiɔpianim ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ biɛhigu bee jɛŋgbina ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuna bomaboma? Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn gba tum tuumbiɛri ka di mili ya ŋɔ, yi ku tooi lan tum tuun viɛla.
en: A black man cannot change the color of his skin, and a leopard cannot change its spots. In the same way, Jerusalem, you cannot change and do good. You always do bad things.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul kpuɣ bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa, bɛ bi lan nya so n-naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: The followers looked up, and they saw that Jesus was now alone.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna ka yi ti ku lan po n-yɛli Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu. .
en: But the time is coming, declares the LORD, when no one will say, As the LORD lives who brought up the Israelites from the land of Egypt.

dag: O maani ansarisimaaniba ansarisi, amaa ka niŋdi tarimba nirilim.
en: He will humiliate those who make fun of others, but he is kind to those who are humble.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛl o, A yuli ku lan booni Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ni boonila Izraɛl, dama a mini Naawuni ni ninsalinim vaya ka a di nasara.
en: Then he said, Your name wont be Jacob any longer, but Israel, because you struggled with God and with men and won.

dag: Daadam, niriba ŋɔ niŋla bɛ buɣa yɛda ka chɛ ka bɛ daalahichi leei bɛ kuɣituurili do bɛ tooni. N ni chɛ ka bɛ bɔhi ma baŋ shɛli?.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Do your best to come to me as soon as you can.

dag: N zɔnim maani ma la ansarisi, ka n kuhi ni nintam niŋ Naawuni.
en: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg.

dag: Amaa pako so ŋun tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, hal o ni na ne maa zaa yoli, o nyɛla ŋun kpi.
en: But a widow who tries to live a life of luxury is dead even while she is alive.

dag: Nira yi je yɛlimaŋli, o ni tooi su niriba? A ni galim ŋun nyɛ Wuntialana ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlana?.
en: Will one who hates justice rule; will you condemn the most righteous one?.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa bi lan yi o ya kana, dama Babilɔn naa daa deeg o ni su tiŋgban shɛli zaa din zaŋ Ijipti kulibɔŋ shee hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: The king of Babylon captured all the land between the Brook of Egypt and the Euphrates River. This land was previously controlled by Egypt. So the king of Egypt did not leave Egypt anymore.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti wum niriba ni yɔri vuri, ka o yɛli Musa, Niriba yɔrila tɔb tuhibu vuri sansani maa ni.
en: Joshua heard the noise from the party in camp. He said to Moses, It sounds like war down in the camp.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli Ɛli, Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yi tɔb maa tuhibu shee n-zo m-paai kpe na zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Ɛli bɔh o, M bia, tɔb maa be wula.
en: The man told Eli, Im the one who just came from the battle. I fled from the battle today. Whats the report, my son? Eli asked.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa bo paɣiba ayi ti o ka o zaŋ ba dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi.
en: Jehoiada had him marry two wives, and Jehoash fathered sons and daughters.

dag: Zaŋ kpa pal shɛli din daa do dundɔŋ ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pia la ni zaŋ kpa bɛ ni daa zaŋ kuɣa mali samban ni luɣ shɛli polo la, duri maa daa mɛmi tam taba buta zuɣu, ka yaɣ yini labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ din la tiŋli.
en: On one side of them was the meters of open space that ran alongside the temple, and on the other side was the sidewalk that circled the outer courtyard. The rooms were arranged in three levels.

dag: N firila baɣiri ni, ka n naba ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu kani, m paala kɔbulli ni, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri ma garita.
en: I have sunk into deep mud. My feet cant touch the bottom! I have entered deep water; the flood has swept me up.

dag: Ka kpa shɛli din na kpalim be maligumaana maa nuu ni maa, o zaŋm li ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa naanyi mali sanyoo sara ti dilana Yawɛ tooni.
en: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, n ni chɛ ka zuliya shɛb kana ti lu yi zuɣu. Bɛ ni nahim ya Lɛbohamat dunol la shee zaŋ hal ni Araba kulibɔŋ la ni.
en: Indeed, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel, says the LORD God of heavenly forces, and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the desert ravine.

dag: Amaa ka yuŋ daa ti paai ka o zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Liya nti ti Yaakubu ka o zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: However, in the evening, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and he slept with her.

dag: Ka Ahazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The other things that Ahaziah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Yila pia la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn ti yɛn su fukumsi nam maa ʒiɛman ni. Di nyaaŋa na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ ŋun be o ko ni o tab bɛn daŋ o tooni na la, ka ni ti yihi nanim ata nam ni.
en: The ten horns mean that from this kingship will rise ten kings, and after them will rise yet another. He will be different from the previous ones. He will defeat three kings.

dag: M mabiyurisi n suhiri ya, yi ni nyɛ saamba be tinzun tinsi ni la zuɣu, zomiya niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma din mini yi biɛhigu tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: Dear friends, since you are immigrants and strangers in the world, I urge that you avoid worldly desires that wage war against your lives.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi niŋ niriba maa nirilim, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini, ka zaŋ zilimballi yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: They replied, If you are kind to these people and try to please them by giving a considerate answer, they will always serve you loyally.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim bɛ zaa na mɔɣ shɛli din daa zɔri kuni fɔntin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Ahava la gbini. Ti daa laɣim dɔnila nimaani daba ata. Ka n daa nya niriba mini maligumaaniba, ka daa bi nya Lɛvinim zuliya ni so.
en: I called all these people to meet together at the river that flows toward Ahava. We camped at that place for three days. I learned there were priests in the group, but there were no Levites.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, kum n dimnima. N nyɛla a dabili, kum n dimnim zaa.
en: Wipe out my enemies because of your faithful love. Destroy everyone who attacks me, because I am your servant.

dag: dindina n gba ni chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ ni ti ŋmɛn ya buyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: then I will turn on you and punish you seven times harder than before.

dag: Dama nimaani ka saria karibu ʒiishɛhi be, saria karibu ʒiishɛhi din nyɛ Dauda zuliya dini.
en: Here the kings of Israel sat to judge their people.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ gba ti leei din bi kpira.
en: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka doo ŋɔ lee yɛli ŋɔ? O mali yiko ka su fukumsi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: The people were all amazed and said to one another, What kind of words are these? With authority and power this man gives orders to the evil spirits, and they come out.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi ba, ka o min o nyaandoliba dii kpe ŋariŋ m-baai du teeku duli chaŋ Dalimanuta tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: he got into the boat with the disciples and crossed to the territory near Dalmanutha.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Yi zaa nyumiya li.
en: Then he took a cup, gave thanks to God, and gave it to them. Drink it, all of you, he said;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ nyan ya ka ni darigi yi tibili. Yi chɛ ka Firawuna min o kpamba nyee nyɔni ti nyooni biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi niŋ bɛ nuu ni ni bɛ ku ti.
en: They said to Moses and Aaron, The Lord has seen what you have done and will punish you for making the king and his officers hate us. You have given them an excuse to kill us.

dag: Ka lan ti o yiko ni o kari saria, o ni nyɛ Daadam Bia la zuɣu.
en: He gives the Son authority to judge, because he is the Human One.

dag: ka chɛ ka sokam baŋ Naawuni daashili nia shɛli o ni daa lo la ni yɛn pali shɛm. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam zaa namda daa sɔɣ o daashili maa ʒiɛmana din gari la zaa puuni.
en: God sent me to reveal the secret plan that had been hidden since the beginning of time by God, who created everything.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin puuni o ku mali ninsal tɛha, amaa ka ni malila biŋkɔbigu tɛha.
en: For seven years he will not have a human mind, but the mind of an animal.

dag: Yi bundaannim nyɛla duŋtaariba, ka yi niriba nyɛ ʒiŋmariba, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa be bɛ noya ni.
en: Your rich people exploit the poor, and all of you are liars.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be Akasia saha shɛli ka bɛ daa piligi bɔri Mɔab paɣiba.
en: While the Israelites were camped at Acacia, some of the men had sex with Moabite women.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa, ka Aduna daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa bahi Firawuna min o kpamba tooni, ka di leei wahu.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to the king and did as the Lord had commanded. Aaron threw his walking stick down in front of the king and his officers, and it turned into a snake.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Chamiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa gbini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti pii kuɣ yiniyini m-pa yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu, ka di kalinli saɣisi yi Izraɛlnim zuliya pinaayi ŋɔ kalinli.
en: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.

dag: Iso zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ nanima m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso bituuli Ɛlifaz bidibisi. Bɛn daa nyɛ nanim maa n-nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfo ni Kɛnaz.
en: These are the tribal chiefs from Esaus sons. The sons of Eliphaz, Esaus oldest son: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz.

dag: Yi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa nyɛla tampiligim ŋaha, ka yi ni zaŋ shɛli taɣi yimaŋ nyɛla yaɣiri.
en: Your old sayings are proverbs made of ashes, your sayings defenses made of clay.

dag: Nir kul ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ka so ku garig o? Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ nyɛla din ni wuhi ni a ka galimi?.
en: This flood of words should be answered! Does all this talking make Job right?.

dag: Jɛhoyachin daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his father, Jehoiachin sinned against the Lord .

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa naai saha shɛli ka o daa yɛli ba.
en: Then Moses said these words to all Israel.

dag: Kamiyana, chɛliya ka ti teei dɔni ti puya zuɣu n-jɛm o; chɛliya ka ti gbani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti namda ŋɔ tooni!.
en: Come, let us bow down and worship him; let us kneel before the Lord , our Maker!.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa zani, ka chɛ Jɔab dini maa. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-kali niriba maa, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: But David would not change his mind. And so Joab went everywhere in Israel and Judah and counted the people. He returned to Jerusalem.

dag: n-zaŋ o binyɛr wɔɣinli din bɔɣiri wɔɣ maa nti ti bɛ ba ka yɛl o, Ti pihi li mi, lihim li nya, a bia binyɛrigu m-bala bee pa dina.
en: They took the long robe, brought it to their father, and said, We found this. See if its your sons robe or not.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa ka mali suhukpeeni, dama yi dan Sool kpiya ka Judanim mi zaŋ ma leei bɛ naa.
en: Now be strong and brave. Your lord, Saul, is dead, but the tribe of Judah has anointed me to be their king.

dag: n ni daa na mali yaa, ka Naawuni zɔtali na be n yiŋ la.
en: Those were the days when I was prosperous, and the friendship of God protected my home.

dag: Zomiya kɔr biɛri tuma! ŋun tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma tumdi li dalindirila omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa ninsal ni tumd alahichi balibu shɛŋa zaa pahi pala din dalind o niŋgbuŋ.
en: Avoid immorality. Any other sin a man commits does not affect his body; but the man who is guilty of sexual immorality sins against his own body.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A ba ka alaafee; ka o daa zaŋ o bidibis ayi la, Manaasa mini Ifriim chaŋ o sani.
en: Some time later Joseph learned that his father was very sick. So he took his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, and went to his father.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayɔbu saha, ka Baasha bia Ɛla daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuma ayi.
en: Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel after Asa had been king of Judah for years, and he ruled from Tirzah for two years.

dag: Yi yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, yin chɛliya ka yi mabi yino kpalim be sarika ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi bɛn kpalim ʒi bindira kuli ti ti kum ni mali yi yiŋnim shɛb maa.
en: To prove that you are honest, one of you will stay in the prison where you have been kept; the rest of you may go and take back to your starving families the grain that you have bought.

dag: O daa yihi ma na ti zali pal tital ni. O daa fa ma bahi, o nini ni daa tiɣ ma la zuɣu.
en: He was pleased with me, so he rescued me. He took me to a safe place.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka a yɛligu nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, ka a lo a dabili bin suŋ ŋɔ.
en: LORD God, you are truly God! Your words are trustworthy, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ laɣimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la na nti tuhi deei tiŋ maa amaŋmaŋa, di yi pa lala n yi tuhi deei tiŋ maa, bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli bol li.
en: So gather the rest of the troops, attack the city, and capture it. Otherwise, I will capture the city myself, and it will be named after me.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Omri sinned against the Lord more than any of his predecessors.

dag: Dauda ni daa chani Aruna sani ka Aruna nya o, o daa yila kabɔɣili maa ni chaŋ ti damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.

dag: Pa Jɔn maŋmaŋa n-daa nyɛ neesim maa, amaa o daa kamina ni o ti niŋ neesim maa shɛhiralana.
en: John wasn't this light. He came only to tell about the light.

dag: Ka Abija daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o ba zaani. Asa ʒiɛmani maa ni, bɛ mini so daa bi tuhi tɔbu hal ni yuun pia.
en: King Abijah died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City. His son Asa succeeded him as king, and under Asa the land enjoyed peace for ten years.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan kpe ŋariŋ maa m-baai du dul din la ha.
en: Then he left them. He again got into a boat and crossed over to the other side of the lake.

dag: Dama bɛ tɛhi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm yɛla, ka zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa maa ni, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: When they become alarmed and turn away from all their sins, they will surely live; they wont die.

dag: Dɔr biɛri ni ti ku ba. Ka so ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n sɔɣi ba. Bɛ ni ti dola tiŋgban ni kaman naɣibina la. Tɔbu mini kum ni ti ku ba, ka bɛ ti leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhu yɛmi ni n tumla a yubu, a zaligu be n suhu ni.
en: I want to do your will, my God. Your Instruction is deep within me.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la palibu saha daa ti miri, ka bɛ zuliya maa daa nab pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛl o, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: A voice said to him, Get up, Peter; kill and eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu a biɛhigu daa be di ko ka chɛ paɣ shɛb dini a pagɔrisigu tuma maa ni. Pa so m-puh a ni a tummi pagɔrisigu tuma. Pa bɛna n-daa yɔr a, amaa nyini n-daa lee yɔri ba, a biɛhigu daa shiri be di ko.
en: You are just the opposite of most prostitutes who force men to pay them, because you pay the men to have sex with you.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa wuh o niriba maa zaa, Hiburunim maa yi lan dɔɣi bidibiga, yin zaŋm o ti lɔhi Nail Mɔɣili ni, amaa chɛliya bipuɣinsi bɛna.
en: Finally the king issued a command to all his people: Take every newborn Hebrew boy and throw him into the Nile, but let all the girls live.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti laɣim Mizipa m-po pɔri yɛli, Ti ni so ku zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni doo.
en: At Mizpah, the men of Israel made a promise. This was their promise: Not one of us will let his daughter marry a man from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ dɔɣ ma mi ni tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni daa zali m pua saha shɛli ka m pun nyɛ alahichilana.
en: I have been evil from the day I was born; from the time I was conceived, I have been sinful.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bee Farisiinim ni so niŋ o yɛda?.
en: Have any of the leaders believed in him? Has any Pharisee?.

dag: O daa lan wuh o o ni ti yɛn piri maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma zaa shɛm ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋdi tumdi tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: David told Solomon about the groups of the priests and Levites. He told Solomon about all the work of serving in the Lord s Temple and about all the things to be used in the Temple service.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ di ni bɛ zaa ninni, ka zaŋ li ŋubi.
en: After saying this, Paul took some bread, gave thanks to God before them all, broke it, and began to eat.

dag: Pukpar so n-na ʒi n-kɔr o puu n-kul kɔri li yɛrigira.
en: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.

dag: M mabihi, fiig tia ni tooi wali olivi tia wala bee gaa ni tooi wali fiig tia wala? Lala ka ko nyaɣisili ku tooi yi ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ ni na.
en: A fig tree, my friends, cannot bear olives; a grapevine cannot bear figs, nor can a salty spring produce sweet water.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma yaha, A na ni nya bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa pam gari lala.
en: Then he said to me, If you come with me, you will see these men doing even more terrible things.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha dabili m-be.
en: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.

dag: yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman Naawuni niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ yɔɣu ni n-zahim o ka di chɛ ka o yɛli.
en: dont have stubborn hearts as they did in the rebellion, on the day when they tested me in the desert. .

dag: Yɔbuhi bela zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka sisirisi sɔɣiri di kuɣa lɔna ni.
en: The high mountains belong to the mountain goats; the ridges are the refuge of badgers.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Asaaya n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: from the clan of Merari came Asaiah, in charge of ;.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul mihirila bɛ nina ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛ soya yɛla.
en: Righteous people are sure of themselves; the wicked have to pretend as best they can.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋma solɔri pirigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa yaɣa ata zuɣu, ka ŋunkam ti ku ninsala ni tooi zo n-kuli di zaɣ yin ni.
en: Mark out the roads to them and divide the regions of the land the LORD your God is apportioning to you into three parts. These cities are the places to which a person who has killed can escape.

dag: Midian mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura zuliya.
en: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.

dag: Alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa yɛn puh o bia daamiliya lɔbu chuɣu.
en: Gods kingdom is like a king who prepared a wedding feast for his son.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya ti ti bɛ suɣa zali gbilligbilli wulinluhili polo. Ifriim niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ammihud bia Ɛlishama.
en: The flag of the camp of Ephraim will be on the west side. The division of Ephraim will camp there. The leader of the tribe of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.

dag: Ti sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: We write these things to you so that you can be full of joy with us.

dag: Naawuni, a daa chɛ ka saa mi pam luɣilikam; a chɛ ka a tiŋgbani din gbarigi la neei.
en: You caused abundant rain to fall and restored your worn-out land;.

dag: Ninsalinim dabisa pun buɣisimi zali, ka a mi bɛ chira kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyini n-zali bɛ tariga ni nyɛ luɣ shɛli ka bɛ ku tooi yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: The length of our lives is decided beforehand— the number of months we will live. You have settled it, and it can't be changed.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu ka n daa bi zaɣisi Naawuni ni wuhi ma shɛli ʒii maa puuni la.
en: King Agrippa, I obeyed this vision from heaven.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela zuliya kam ni maani shɛb ansarisi; ka leei niriba ni lari shɛba.
en: Youve made us a bad joke to the nations, something to be laughed at by all peoples.

dag: Ka shɛb yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, chɛliya ka bɛ niriba ata bee ayi kɔŋko n-tɔɣisiri ka tiri taba; ka chɛ ka so wuhi di gbinni.
en: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.

dag: Paɣisara maa ni daa laɣimna m-pahi buyi saha shɛli, Mɔdɛkai daa ʒila nayili dunol ni.
en: Mordecai was sitting next to the kings gate at the time the young women were gathered together the second time.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi bia maa ba, Bɔ saha ka di piligi niŋd o lala? Ka o yɛl o, O bilim ni.
en: Jesus asked his father, How long has this been going on? He said, Since he was a child.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb me bɛ tiŋ ʒini nimaani.
en: He led the hungry to that good land, and they built a city to live in.

dag: N yɛn dolila dunianim zaa ni doli so shɛl la. Mali yaa.
en: Im following the path that the whole earth takes. Be strong and be a man.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Ɛhab yuli sab gbana, ka zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili li n-zaŋ li ti ti Jɛziriil kpamba mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mini Nabɔt daa laɣim be tin yin ni la.
en: Then she wrote some letters, signed Ahab's name to them, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the officials and leading citizens of Jezreel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yi Bɛtɛl chani ti miri Ɛfirat ka Reechɛl piligi wolisibu ka o wolisibu maa daa kpɛm pam.
en: Jacob and his family left Bethel, and when they were still some distance from Ephrath, the time came for Rachel to have her baby, and she was having difficult labor.

dag: Teem a ni daa zal a dabili Musa zaligu shɛl la yɛla. A daa yɛl o, Yi yi bi ʒe ma yim, n ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni.
en: Remember the word that you gave to your servant Moses when you said, If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul yɛra, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di zaa yoli bɛ pɔri maa nyɛla ʒiri pɔri.
en: Everyone breaks promises made in my name.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, M bia, mirim na ti mɔɣisi n kpariŋ.
en: His father Isaac said to him, Come here and kiss me, my son.

dag: ka din pahi pinaayopɔin gbaai Hɛzir, ka din pahi pisaayika gbaai Hapizɛz.
en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez.

dag: Naa yi wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, o kpamba zaa yɛn nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: If a ruler pays attention to false information, all his officials will be liars.

dag: O daa bi saɣi ka so dol o pahila Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jeemsi tizo Jɔn.
en: He didnt allow anyone to follow him except Peter, James, and John, James brother.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa ti laɣim zaŋ bɛ noya naai Abinɛr ka bɛ min o leei zaɣ yini n-du zoli maa zuɣu ti zani.
en: The men from the tribe of Benjamin gathered around Abner at the top of the hill.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba suhuri fuŋya, ka niriba pam tuura. N zaŋ takɔbi maa naŋgbancholi zali bɛ dunoya zaa ni. Bɛ mal li mi ka di nyaɣisira ka saa la. Ka nyahi neei li ni di ku niriba.
en: They will lose all courage and stumble with fear. My slaughtering sword is waiting at every gate, flashing and ready to kill.

dag: O biɛhi ŋmanila alabasita daantalisi din tam salima binzahi zuɣu. O biɛhigu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn sida ti gahinda.
en: His thighs are columns of alabaster set in sockets of gold. He is majestic, like the Lebanon Mountains with their towering cedars.

dag: Bɛ zaa kalinsi nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: Last of all, the woman died.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ninkuunsi takɔbi ŋɔ ni; fam ma tinzunnim nuu ni bahi. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. Hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: Rescue me and deliver me from the power of strangers, whose mouths speak lies, and whose strong hand is a strong hand of deception.

dag: Yi ni sɔɣ yɛli shɛlikam zibisim ni ni ti yi neesim ni; ka yi ni sɔɣ ŋumsi shɛli duu puuni, bɛ ni mol li gili luɣilikam.
en: So then, whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in broad daylight, and whatever you have whispered in private in a closed room will be shouted from the housetops.

dag: ka yɛli ba, N yi ti paai sansani maa shee, yin lihimiya ma ka niŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: He told them, When I get to the edge of the camp, watch me, and do what I do.

dag: Amaa m-mali shɛhira din gari Jɔn shɛhira maa; dama tuun shɛŋa m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum, dina ka n tumda; ka tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi maa mi diri ma shɛhira ni m Ba n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I have a witness greater than Johns testimony. The Father has given me works to do so that I might complete them. These works I do testify about me that the Father sent me.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin kpɛm a duu nti yo a dunoli ka suh a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: But when you pray, go to your room, close the door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what you do in private, will reward you.

dag: nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa ni.
en: As they confessed their sins, he baptized them in the Jordan River.

dag: Ka kpatoon kpɛm daa vihi hal ti nya o nimaani m-bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka nyin doya gbihira? Yiɣisim suh a wuni ka o sɔŋ ti. Di pa shɛli ka o zo ti nambɔɣu tiligi ti nyɛviya.
en: The ship's captain went to him and said, How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.

dag: Ibrahimma bidibisi daa nyɛla Yisahaku mini Ishimail.
en: Abrahams sons were Isaac and Ishmael.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ti naba bari zaana, o nini yi tiɣi ti soli;.
en: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli niriba yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum, dindina n ni vuɣi di zuliya maa zaa n-ku ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But if a nation does not listen to my message, I will completely destroy it. I will pull it up like a dead plant. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm yaɣi ti ni tɛhi ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu: Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋa n-ti ti Duuma ka naanyi zaŋ bɛmaŋa n-ti ti gba Naawuni yubu puuni.
en: It was more than we could have hoped for! First they gave themselves to the Lord; and then, by God's will they gave themselves to us as well.

dag: A ni zaŋ binshɛli biri maa kul nyɛla bimbiɛlli ka pa ni bimbilli maŋmaŋa, di pa shɛli di ni nyɛla kabiɛlli bee bimbiɛl shɛli.
en: What you put in the ground doesnt have the shape that it will have, but its a bare grain of wheat or some other seed.

dag: Dauda daa di nam su Izraɛlnim la yuun pihinahi. O daa diya ʒini Hiburɔn la yuma ayopɔin, ka daa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm mi yuun pihitanaata.
en: He had been king of Israel for forty years, ruling seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

dag: ka daa tim o yiŋbihi ni bɛ ti yɛli o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na; amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi kandina.
en: He sent his servants to call those invited to the wedding party. But they didnt want to come.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Pumpɔŋɔ Shiiba Bikiri bia ŋɔ ni niŋ ti barina pam n-gari Absalom ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la, dinzuɣu zaŋm a dan tɔbbihi ŋɔ m-biɛh o naba, di yi pa lala o ni ti kpe tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ ni me goondahi gili ni, ka muɣisi ti.
en: David told Abishai, Bichris son Sheba will cause more trouble for us than Absalom did. Take your masters servants and chase after him before he finds fortified cities and escapes from us.

dag: Ka nachimba maa daa chaŋ nti yihi Reehab min o ba ni o ma ni o tizɔdɔbba ni o dɔɣiriba zaa n-zaŋ ba ti ʒili kpaŋ ha miri Izraɛlnim sansani.
en: So the young men who had been spies went and brought Rahab out, along with her father, her mother, her brothers, and everyone related to her. They brought her whole clan out and let them stay outside Israels camp.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa zal li shɛm o nia lɔbu min o milinsi puuni zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi mi daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o.
en: In accordance with his own plan God had already decided that Jesus would be handed over to you; and you killed him by letting sinful men crucify him.

dag: Ka Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: So Zelophehads daughters obeyed the Lord s command to Moses.

dag: Juda naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaata saha shɛli ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa, ka n gba kul mal li tɔɣisiri ya di zuŋɔ yuun pisinaata, amaa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu.
