en: I have been a prophet for these past years, from the th year that Josiah son of Amon was the king of Judah. And from that time until today, I have spoken messages to you from the Lord again and again. But you have not listened.

dag: So yi tahir a ʒiishee ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa yom, di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.

dag: So ku lan be nimaani saha shɛlikam yaha. Laribunim ku lan ti bɛ suɣa zali nimaani. Piɛguliba mi ku lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛri dɔni nimaani.
en: No one will ever live there again. No wandering Arab will ever pitch a tent there, and no shepherd will ever pasture a flock there.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛli, Naawuni daa ŋmahila tiwula maa bahi ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ma tuɣi.
en: You might say, Branches were broken off so that I could be joined to their tree.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛli Naawuni, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni n-chani Firawuna sani nti yihiri Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Moses said, Who am I to go to the king and lead your people out of Egypt.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri nti nya ka yilli maa lo tɔbu n-tuhi wuntizɔriba nyaŋ ba.
en: While I was looking, that horn made war on God's people and conquered them.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la kul bela n tooni, ka n dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali.
en: Your constant love is my guide; your faithfulness always leads me.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Di tamya ni m bela bandi ni. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli paɣ maa, Pumpɔŋɔ ti niŋ yɛda, ka pa ni a yɛligu la zuɣu yaha, dama timaŋmaŋ wum o yɛligu ka baŋ ni o shiri nyɛla dunia ŋɔ tiligira.
en: The people said to the woman, First we believed in Jesus because of what you told us. But now we believe because we heard him ourselves. We know now that he really is the one who will save the world.

dag: ti zaŋ anzinfa mini salima maa m-mali nam zuɣupiligu n-zaŋ li pili Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: Take silver and gold and make a crown. Place it on the head of the high priest Joshua, Jehozadaks son.

dag: Amaa Masia daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-fa ti fukumsi zaligu noli din daa doli ti la ni bahi, o ni daa zani ti zaani n-chɛ ka noli di o ti zuɣu la puuni, dama di sabiya: Noli di bɛ ni zaŋ sokam yili tia.
en: The law says we are under a curse for not always obeying it. But Christ took away that curse. He changed places with us and put himself under that curse. The Scriptures say, Anyone who is hung on a tree is under a curse.

dag: Di bi tu ka maligumaana Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun mali dalinli ti mirina ni o ti zaŋ Yawɛ pina maa nyo buɣim mali sara; o ni mali dalinli zuɣu, di bi simdi ni o mirina ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: If one of Aarons descendants has something wrong with him, he cannot approach the altar to bring gifts to the Lord . And he cannot carry the special bread to God.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ wuntitali kaman shɛlɔrigu la n-lo o shee ni; ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali kaman shɛlɔrigu la n-lo o shee ni pahi.
en: He will rule his people with justice and integrity.

dag: Tinzunnim ni ti yiɣisi guui kaman tɔhinima n-kari doli ba la bee kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni mini bɛ niriba sani.
en: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na bi di bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa tiɣi; bindirigu maa ni daa na kul be bɛ noya ni saha shɛli maa.
en: But they had not yet satisfied their craving and were still eating.

dag: Naawuni zomi ya nambɔɣu, ka tin ya suhudoo mini yurilim din kul zoori pahira!.
en: Mercy, peace, and love be yours more and more.

dag: Yi yi jɛmdi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi bindira mini yi kom ni, ka yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi kɔbili ni.
en: If you worship me, the Lord your God, I will bless you with food and water and take away all your sicknesses.

dag: Sool ni daa nya Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o suhu fuŋ pam.
en: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was terrified.

dag: Doo yi yɛn zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o kpee, ŋun di deeg o nɛli bee o nɛkaŋ sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o li, dama o yi niŋ lala, nyɛvili ka o deei sɔŋ talima pabu ni maa.
en: When you lend someone something, you are not to take as security his millstones used for grinding his grain. This would take away the family's means of preparing food to stay alive.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa nambɔɣu, ka o shihi bɛ nina maa ka di dii neei, ka bɛ yiɣisi doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus had pity on them and touched their eyes; at once they were able to see, and they followed him.

dag: Pinimiya yi zabiri bahi, ka kumiya kuyila zoya zuɣu, dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ya, ka zaŋ ya bahi, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi ŋɔ.
en: Mourn, people of Jerusalem; cut off your hair and throw it away. Sing a funeral song on the hilltops, because I, the Lord , am angry and have rejected my people.

dag: Amaa yi bi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni gbahi ba chaŋ la, n ni zaŋ ba kulisi nimaani ka bɛ ti baŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ʒiɛm maa.
en: You said that your children would be captured, but I will bring them into the land that you rejected, and it will be their home.

dag: Tummiya din viɛla ka chɛ din bie, ka tiligi. Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Make it your aim to do what is right, not what is evil, so that you may live. Then the Lord God Almighty really will be with you, as you claim he is.

dag: Yɛm malibu so salima nɛma zaa, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa shɛli buɣisi li.
en: Wisdom is worth more than fine jewels. Nothing you desire has more value.

dag: Yi yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, yin niŋmiya ania n-zaŋ li ti Laodisianim gba ka bɛ karim. Ka yi gba niŋ ania n-karim gban shɛli Laodisianim ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya na la.
en: After you read this letter, make sure that it is read also in the church at Laodicea. At the same time, you are to read the letter that the believers in Laodicea will send you.

dag: Hal bɛ yi kul lo noli, n ku wum bɛ kuhigu. Hal bɛ yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara, n ku deei li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku ba.
en: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, naa mini kpambaliba ti ku lan mali suhukpeeni. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi maligumaaniba, ka di niŋ anabinim alahiziba.
en: The Lord says, When this happens, the king and his officers will lose their courage. The priests will be filled with fear, and the prophets will be shocked.

dag: dindina maligumaana ni zali di daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, ka dilan ni yo di liɣiri dindali maa ka di leei din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: then the priest must count the years to the year of Jubilee and decide the price for the land. Then that land will belong to the Lord .

dag: Dama n ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni, ka yɛligi yi tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka so ti ku niŋ yi tiŋgbani maa kɔre.
en: After I have driven out the nations before you and extended your territory, no one will try to conquer your country during the three festivals.

dag: Bɛ bi yɛli nyini n dana Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la ka n niŋ shɛm? N daa zaŋla anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka niŋdi bindirigu mini kom ti tiri ba.
en: Wasnt my master told what I did when Jezebel killed the LORDs prophets? I hid one hundred of the LORDs prophets, fifty each in two caves. I also supplied them with food and water.

dag: Binshɛŋa din be ashilɔni nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ dini, amaa binshɛŋa din yi zahira nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini sahakam ni di chɛ ka ti doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni.
en: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.

dag: Yaa biɛla gba lan ka n niŋgbuna ni m bariŋ maa zuɣu, ka di muɣisi ma n suhu ni, ka n kul ŋuhira.
en: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.

dag: Miri ka a bo a piriba bee a mapira, dama nir yi niŋ lala o dɔɣira ka o bo maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili.
en: You must not have sexual contact with your mothers sister or your fathers sister, because that exposes your own close relative; both of you will be liable to punishment.

dag: Hal laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Its easier for a camel to squeeze through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: A ni tooi kali bɛ ni dandi bɛ baɣa chɛra shɛm tariga? Ka a mi bɛ dɔɣibu saha?.
en: Do you know how long they carry their young? Do you know the time for their birth?.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di kari Ayuba saria hal ti naai, dama o garigibu maa ŋmanila ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni garigiri yɛtɔɣa shɛm.
en: I think Job should be punished even more, because he answers us like someone who is evil!.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm, ka bɛ bidibbina bahi yoli!.
en: Heroes have fallen in battle. Their weapons of war are lost.

dag: N daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka di niŋ yuma pam; di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lab nimaani ni n ti zaŋ pina ti mmaŋmaŋ niriba ka mali sara.
en: After being away from Jerusalem for several years, I went there to take some money to my own people and to offer sacrifices.

dag: Harim daŋ — tuhili ni pinaayopɔin.
en: the descendants of Harim:.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni be ti bol o na ka bɛ tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣ shɛli. .
en: Jesus was still talking to the people when his mother and brothers arrived. They stood outside, asking to speak with him.

dag: Ka noonsi bɛn be zuɣusaa tɛri bɛ tɛri tihi din baɣi li zuɣu, ka be di wula zuɣu kumda.
en: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.

dag: A daa yɛli ma, Wumma, ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣa; n ni bɔh a bɔhigu, ka a garigi ma.
en: You said, Listen and I will speak; I will question you and you will inform me.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. M mi yi yurilim mini yi yɛda niŋbu ni yi ni tumdi shɛlikam n zuɣu zaŋ tabili yi daania niŋbu yɛla, ka lan mi yi pumpɔŋɔ tuma ni gari yi tuuli tuma shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.

dag: Yawɛ be katiŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa o deeri wuntizɔriba suhigu.
en: The Lord is far away from the wicked, but he always hears the prayers of those who do what is right.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima. Bɛ daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhi pihita, ka mali wɔribariba tusaayɔbu, ka bɛ tɔbbihi daa kul tɛli ʒiizaa kaman mɔɣibihigu la. Ka bɛ daa kana nti ti bɛ suɣa dɔni Mikimash Bɛtavɛn wulimpuhili polo.
en: The Philistines assembled to fight the Israelites; they had thirty thousand war chariots, six thousand cavalry troops, and as many soldiers as there are grains of sand on the seashore. They went to Michmash, east of Bethaven, and camped there.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yi jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-labi Jɛrusalɛm ti su Izraɛlnima.
en: So Solomon left the place of worship at Gibeon, where the Tent of the Lord 's presence was, and returned to Jerusalem. There he ruled over Israel.

dag: N yura, a viɛlimi kaman Tiriza, ka viɛli kaman Jɛrusalɛm la, ka a ni be shɛm ŋmanila tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanima.
en: My dearest, the cities of Tirzah and Jerusalem are not as lovely as you. Your charms are more powerful than all of the stars in the heavens.

dag: ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ yaɣ din la mi polo dapaɣa, ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ di nyaaŋa wulinluhili polo dapaɣa.
en: five braces for the other side, and five braces for the back of the Holy Tent .

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Ti ni tooi nya ninvuɣ so ka o be kaman Naawuni Shia ni be do so ni ŋɔ.
en: and Pharaoh said to his servants, Can we find a man with more God-given gifts than this one.

dag: Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Di pahiya shɛli di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni.
en: Do everything that I have commanded you; do not add anything to it or take anything from it.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilaa maa zuɣu; ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: You must also offer cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil with the bull, cups with the ram.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa ku so mam maa yɛli ba, M mini m mam n-daa chaŋ Gibia din nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋ la ni ni ti ti gbe.
en: The husband of the murdered woman answered: My wife and I went into the town of Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.

dag: Niriba maa tɛha daa zommi; ka di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Naawuni daalikauli kurili la yɛla, lala chinchin yini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha, dama Masia kɔŋko zuɣu ka di ni tooi piligi.
en: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.

dag: N ni yiɣisi pumpɔŋɔ n-doli tiŋ puuni solɔri mini lɔrisi ni. M bo n suhu ni yuri so pam maa shee. M bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: I will get up now! I will go around the city. In the streets and squares, I will look for the man I love. I looked for him, but I could not find him.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti darigi bɛnkam zaa kpahi yaɣi dunɔbia zuɣu mini bɛnkam zaŋ damli dambu ni ŋarili soya bo nɛma pali bɛ dan yiŋ la tibili.
en: I will punish the one leaping on the threshold on that day, those filling the house of their master with violence and deceit.

dag: Hɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrɛt mini Izar ni Ɛtinan.
en: Ashhur and Helah had three sons: Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

dag: Bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka kaɣi ʒe kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Bɛ bi zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ tuhi nintɔri n tooni.
en: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.

dag: Ka so yi mal o suhu n-yi din nyɛ daɣiri ni ka be kasi, dindina o ni leei la shɛli din mali jilima, ka mali shili ni di tum tuun suŋ kam, ka yil yidana ni woligi li n-zali di ko ni o zaŋ li tumd o tuma.
en: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan labina nti neei ma kaman nir ni yi gbihiri ka bɛ neeg o shɛm la.
en: The angel who had been speaking to me came again and roused me as if I had been sleeping.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na la yɛli, Biilzibul n-ʒi o zuɣu. Alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o karit alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: The legal experts came down from Jerusalem. Over and over they charged, Hes possessed by Beelzebul. He throws out demons with the authority of the ruler of demons.

dag: Yawɛ, viim sagbana ka sheena. Shihimi zoya n-chɛ ka nyɔhi yi di ni na.
en: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord . Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.

dag: Wuntia soli dolibu shiri nyɛla azichi din galisi, nir ŋun dee nini yi tiɣi o ni mali shɛli;.
en: Devotion to God is, in fact, a way for people to be very rich, but only if it makes them satisfied with what they have.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu din daŋ tooni ni din nyɛ kpɛma.
en: This is the greatest and the most important commandment.

dag: O yi niŋ ya kaman o daba n-nyɛn ya la bee n-saɣim yi bini bee n-din ya zalinsi bee n-ʒiɛm ya bee ŋ-ŋmɛn ya tapaɣa, yi dir o suɣilo.
en: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.

dag: ka o chɛ ka noonsi yiɣina ti lu bɛ sani. Bɛ daa galisiya pam ŋ-ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu;.
en: He rained meat on them as if it were dust in the air; he rained as many birds as the sand on the seashore!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛlnim zuliya dunoli kam dɔɣirikpamba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: So Moses gave these commands to Eleazar, Joshua, and the other leaders of Israel:.

dag: ni Madɔn naa ni Hazɔr naa.
en: Madon, Hazor.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒi gbariti mini bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni ni zoomba ni biriti ni dɔro balibu kam ni mali shɛb pam tahi o sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Large crowds came to him, bringing with them the lame, the blind, the crippled, the dumb, and many other sick people, whom they placed at Jesus' feet; and he healed them.

dag: Wurimbu, wurimbu, n ni wurim li! Di tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Naɣila ŋun mali soli ni o su li maa ti kana, ka n zaŋ li ti o. .
en: I will completely destroy that city! But this will not happen until the right man becomes the new king. Then I will let him have this city.

dag: n-daa ti yi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ kuli Antiɔk, luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni ni bɛ tum bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛli naai maa la.
en: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli Ayuba sanʒiɛɣu puuni.
en: Then out of the storm the Lord spoke to Job once again.

dag: ni Ifriim Dunɔdal la zuɣusaa ni Dunɔdal Kurili la gbini ni Zahim Dunɔdali ni Hananɛl Pia ni Kɔbiga Pia la gbini m-mali hal ti paai Piɛri Dunɔdal la gbini, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani Guliba Dunɔdal la gbini.
en: past the Gate of Ephraim and over the Mishneh Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred as far as the Sheep Gate. They came to a stop at the Gate of the Guard.

dag: A daalikaulinim nyɛla alikauli maŋa! Ka mani a dabili ŋɔ yuri li.
en: Your word has been tried and tested; your servant loves your word!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka o mini ba naai noli, ka o lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ku ku ba. Ka Izraɛl kpamba gba daa lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ni ʒe alikauli maa nyaaŋa.
en: Joshua made a treaty of friendship with the people of Gibeon and allowed them to live. The leaders of the community of Israel gave their solemn promise to keep the treaty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri ti Naa Sulemaana yɛm kaman o ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm, ka suhudoo daa be o mini Hiram sunsuuni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa niŋ naŋgban yini.
en: The Lord kept his promise and made Solomon wise. Hiram and Solomon signed a treaty and never went to war against each other.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Shilo n-lihi nya, ka daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnim kaman di ni daa simdi ni bɛ zuliya kam deei shɛm.
en: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nina ti ku ne, ka bɛ ti ku mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛŋa zo n-tiligi, ka bɛ tahima ti yɛn nyɛla bɛ vuhim ŋmaabu.
en: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Ɛkan, Bɔzuɣu ka a bo wahala ti ti? Yawɛ ni ti a wahala zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa lab o kuɣa, ka lab o malibu gba kuɣa, ka niŋ buɣim nyo ba.
en: Joshua said, You have brought disaster to us! May the LORD bring disaster to you today! Then all Israel stoned him. They burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya ma, mani m-bala. Wuni so lan kani m-pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kura, ka lan neera. Mani n-tir dansi; mani n-lan tibira, ka so ku tooi fa shɛli n nuu ni.
en: Now, look here: I myself, Im the one; there are no other gods with me. Im the one who deals death and gives life; Im the one who wounded, but now I will heal. Theres no escaping my hand.

dag: O zaŋ bin suma dihi ma n ni yɛn be saha shɛli puuni, ka di chɛ ka m bipolitali kpiɔŋ labina kaman tɔrili kpiɔŋ la.
en: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba na ti zaani tooni, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Juda zuliya.
en: Joshua got up early in the morning. He made Israel come forward tribe by tribe. The tribe of Judah was selected.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi ti kul chani suɣili maa ni niriba zaa yiɣisirimi, ka sokam ʒe o suɣili dunol ni lihir o hal ka o ti kpe suɣili maa puuni.
en: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.

dag: Do so ŋun dɔbilim yina ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o kpe daɣiri ni zaligu m-bala.
en: This concludes the Instruction concerning those with discharges: men with emissions of semen that make them unclean.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be wuhibu ni, ka gbilisi tibili wum baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Bring your mind to instruction, your ear to knowledgeable sayings.

dag: Kum maa ni daa mii pam maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bindira ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim gbarigi zaa.
en: There was no food in the land because the famine was so severe. The land of Egypt and the land of Canaan dried up from the famine.

dag: Ka Jeemsi mini Jɔn, Zɛbidii bihi la, daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti di bɔri ni a niŋ ti la ti ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus. Teacher, they said, there is something we want you to do for us.

dag: ka yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba maa, Ti bia ŋɔ nyɛla tipawumlilana ni nɔzaɣisira; o bi deeri ti noli; o nyɛla pulaandana ni danyura.
en: Then they will inform the citys elders: This son of ours is consistently stubborn and rebellious, refusing to listen to us. Whats more, hes wild and a drunkard.

dag: O daa laɣim teeku kom kaman luɣuluɣu ni kom la n-sɔŋ luɣ yini. O daa nam bula niŋ di biɛhigu shɛhi.
en: He gathered all the seas into one place; he shut up the ocean depths in storerooms.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Neetan Dauda sani, ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba ayi n-daa be tin shɛli, yino daa nyɛla bundana, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ faralana.
en: The Lord sent the prophet Nathan to David. Nathan went to him and said, There were two men who lived in the same town; one was rich and the other poor.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ ni daa niŋ saha shɛli maa, n daa ka Jɛrusalɛm, dama di daa nyɛla Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa yuun pihitanaayi saha ka n daa lab o sani. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lan suhi naa soli n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: While this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, because in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes was king of Babylon I had gone back to report to him. After some time I received his permission.

dag: ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo na la.
en: and has brought you back from foreign countries, from east and west, from north and south.

dag: N Duuma n-teegi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma ŋ-ŋɔ ni o yihi ma vi ni niriba sani maa.
en: Now at last the Lord has helped me, she said. He has taken away my public disgrace.

dag: o ni daa zali teeku di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka di kom ku zo n-yaɣi o ni zal li shɛli tariga, o ni daa booi tiŋgbani tarisi saha shɛli.
en: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.

dag: bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima n-chaŋ yi chandi maa bee n-yɛnya daliyanima ayiyi; yi mi di piriya namda bee n-gbibi jaaŋgbɛhi, dama tumtumda kam simdi ni bɛ ti o bindirigu.
en: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.

dag: Bɛ bi muɣiri taba, bɛ zaa dolila bɛ soya. Bɛ tooi gariti bɛ ni gu ba soli luɣ shɛli, ka binshɛli ku tooi taɣ ba zali.
en: They dont crowd each other; each keeps to their own path. Even if they fall among the weapons, they wont stop.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di kana, di niŋya. Dabisili ŋɔ yɛla ka n daa yɛl la.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, The day I spoke about is certain to come.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya li ti ma na.
en: Then bring them here to me, Jesus said.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka o daa yi Babilɔn m-piligi chandi n-daa mali ti paai Jɛrusalɛm gol so ŋun pah anu dahin yini dali, dama o Naawuni daalibarika nuu daa pa o zuɣu.
en: The journey from Babylon began on the first day of the first month, and they came to Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun su binshɛɣukam, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zo so dabiɛm, ŋuna n-chɛ ka suhudoo be o daalizanda din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni.
en: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.

dag: Bɛ tum vi tuma, ka tum din chihira, ka vi bi mali ba. Bɛ bi mi ʒiɛrige. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti lu kaman sokam ni luri shɛm n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli. Bɛ bahigu n-ti yɛn bala. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Were they ashamed because they did these disgusting things? No, they were not at all ashamed; they don't even know how to blush. And so they will fall as others have fallen; when I punish them, that will be the end of them. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: nti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee yɛn ti ma ka n chɛ ka Yisa kpe yi nuu ni? Ka bɛ daa ti o anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihita.
en: and asked, How much will you give me if I help you arrest Jesus? They paid Judas silver coins.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa kana di saha maa ti ku Anakinim zaa bɛn daa be zoya tinsi ni la. Bɛ daa bela Hiburɔn mini Dɛbir ni Anab ni zoya zuɣu tinsi din zaa daa be Juda mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔna ni la. Jɔshua daa ku niriba maa zaa, ka saɣim bɛ tinsi.
en: At this time Joshua went and destroyed the race of giants called the Anakim who lived in the hill country—in Hebron, Debir, Anab, and in all the hill country of Judah and Israel. Joshua completely destroyed them and their cities.

dag: Bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa ni daa su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi la n-daa daŋ tooni. Ka Bɛnhadad daa tim o naazɔnim ni bɛ yina ti nya, ka bɛ daa yina ti nya ka lab ti yɛl o, Niriba n-yi Samaria kanna.
en: The young soldiers advanced first. Scouts sent out by Benhadad reported to him that a group of soldiers was coming out of Samaria.

dag: Di ni daa biɛmbe zaŋ chaŋ di yuma ayi bahigu ni ka o dɔro maa daa ti chɛ ka o nyɔri yina, ka o daa nya biɛrim pam hal ti kpi. O ni daa kpi, o niriba daa bi mali buɣim n-ti o jilima kaman bɛ ni daa mali buɣim ti o yaannim jilima shɛm la.
en: For almost two years it grew steadily worse until finally the king died in agony. His subjects did not light a bonfire in mourning for him as had been done for his ancestors.

dag: Ka Naa Ahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛli, N tɛhiya ni ŋun samli galisi pam la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A shiri baŋya.
en: Simon replied, I suppose the one who had the largest debt canceled. Jesus said, You have judged correctly.

dag: Ti Duuma chɛ ka ti niŋ ya naani, ka mi ni yi niŋdi ti ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka kul ni niŋdi ti ni wuhi shɛm maa.
en: And the Lord gives us confidence in you, and we are sure that you are doing and will continue to do what we tell you.

dag: Musa ni daa wum li, o daa teemi dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: When Moses heard this, he threw himself on the ground and prayed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda yɛli Yuria, Kulimi yiŋ ti paɣ a naba. Ka Yuria daa yiɣisi nayili maa yi, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini dol o nyaaŋa ni bɛ ti ti o.
en: Then David told Uriah, Go home and clean up. Uriah left the king's palace, and David had dinner sent to Uriah's house.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, n ni wuɣ a mukuru pa a ninni, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam nya a zaɣim, ka nanim nya a ni di vi shɛm.
en: Look! I am against you, proclaims the LORD of heavenly forces. I will lift your skirts over your face; I will show nations your nakedness and kingdoms your dishonor.

dag: Dama ŋun saɣinda kana ni o ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ gbahi bɛ tɔbbihi, ka kabisi bɛ tɔburi, dama Yawɛ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun yɔri samli, o mi ni yo di zaa.
en: The army will come and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured, and their bows will be broken, This will happen because the Lord punishes people for the bad things they do. He gives them the full punishment they deserve.

dag: Miri ka a zabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli bee m-bɔri ni a mini ba be.
en: Don't be envious of evil people, and don't try to make friends with them.

dag: Di chira ata nyaaŋa ka ti daa ti kpe Alikizandria ŋariŋ shɛli din dalinli daa nyɛ bɛ buɣijahi ŋmahinli la. Di daa kpalim ʒe nimaani la kikaa saha zaa.
en: After three months we put out to sea in a ship that had spent the winter at the island. It was an Alexandrian ship with carvings of the twin gods Castor and Pollux as its figurehead.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: Jesus asked, Why do people say that the Messiah will be the son of King David?.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi; bɛ ni ŋun daa pɔri mini tɔbbihi kɔbiga daa saɣimi, ka ŋun daa gari bɛ zaa mi mini tɔbbihi tuhili daa saɣi.
en: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.

dag: ka tiligi shɛba kaman buɣim ni ka yi tim yihi ba la. Ka chɛliya ka shɛb mi yɛla niŋ ya nambɔɣu ni dabiɛm; ka leeya bɛn je bɛ binyɛr taɣilima din be tiŋli ka bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre gabisi li la.
en: save others by snatching them out of the fire; and to others show mercy mixed with fear, but hate their very clothes, stained by their sinful lusts.

dag: Amaa tin shɛli din yuli daa booni Ɛkibatana ka di be Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ yaɣili la ni ka bɛ daa ti nya litaafi shɛli ka sabbu ŋɔ be di ni:.
en: A scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana. This is what was written on that scroll: Official Note:.

dag: ni Keenannim bɛn daa be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la nim zaŋ tabili Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la nima ni Hivinim bɛn daa be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni Mizipa tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: He sent word to the Canaanites from east and west, to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the highlands, and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

dag: Pool ni daa lab du duu maa ni nti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro ŋubi naai, o daa lan gbaai ba la yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu n-daa mali lala hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o naanyi chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ.
en: Then he went back upstairs, broke bread, and ate. After talking with them for a long time, even until sunrise, Paul left.

dag: Di yɛliya di yɛla Gaat fɔŋ ni, di kul chɛliya ka nintam yi yi nina ni na. Bilimmiya taŋkpaɣu ni Bɛtiliafra tiŋ puuni.
en: Dont tell it in Gath. Dont cry in Acco. Roll yourself in the dust at Beth Ophrah.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ, ka yi na kul zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka kul kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma.
en: Then if you don't stop rebelling.

dag: Gbaamiya piɛ viɛlli biŋkɔbbaligu maa ni. Niŋmiya dari kuli daaŋa ni; duɣimiya nimdi maa; duɣimiya o kɔba gba.
en: Use the best animals in the flock. Pile the wood under the pot, and boil the pieces of meat. Boil the soup until even the bones are cooked.

dag: Amaa o yi zaŋ omaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka di wuhi ni o ka daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ŋun lan cham maligumaana maa sani yaha.
en: However, if the disease comes back, you must return to the priest.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a daa tiligi ba a yuli zuɣu, ni lala chɛ ka a wuh a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But God saved them for the sake of his good name, to make known his mighty power.

dag: Lala ka Asiria naa ti yɛn gbahi Ijiptinim leei daba, ka gbahi Itiɔpianim ninkura mini bipola n-zaŋ ba bɛ zaɣim ni bɛ napɔn zaŋa, ka bɛ gbina do palo ni, n-kuli o yiŋa, ka di dihi Ijiptinim vi.
en: The king of Assyria will defeat Egypt and Ethiopia. Assyria will take prisoners and lead them away from their countries. The people, young and old, will be led away without clothes or sandals. They will be completely naked.

dag: Ka Samsin daa yɛli, Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ninvuɣ tuhili. Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ba n-laɣim ba sɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: So Samson sang, With the jawbone of a donkey I killed a thousand men; With the jawbone of a donkey I piled them up in piles.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa kuri Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa tuhi Juda kpambaliba mini Ahazia mabihi bidibisi bɛn daa doli Ahazia maa soli n-daa ku ba.
en: As Jehu was carrying out God's sentence on the dynasty, he came across a group made up of Judean leaders and of Ahaziah's nephews that had accompanied Ahaziah on his visit. Jehu killed them all.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ ŋun pun guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan kul kpalimmi be lala. Ka so mi beni n-nyɛla ŋun bi guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan di bɔri ni o leei ŋun guni.
en: If a circumcised man has accepted God's call, he should not try to remove the marks of circumcision; if an uncircumcised man has accepted God's call, he should not get circumcised.

dag: Yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn lɔŋdi nanviɣu, amaa ka lee vaani laakum.
en: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa chaŋ Sukɔt ti yɛli ba, N-nyɛ Zɛba mini Zalimuna. Yi daa mɔŋ m mini n tɔbbi shɛb di ni daa wum pam la bindirigu, ka maani ma ansarisi yɛra, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna n-kpɛh a nuu ni, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu? .
en: So Gideon went to the people of Succoth and said, Here are Zebah and Zalmunna! You made fun of me because of them by saying, Havent you already almost gotten your hands on Zebah and Zalmunna? Why should we give food to your exhausted men now.

dag: Naa Hiram daa pun zaŋla salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi n-timna ti ti naa.
en: He sent Solomon only five tons of gold in return.

dag: Shɛb mali bɛ tab paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi tumdi daɣiri tuma, ka mali bɛ bihi paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi mali bɛ tizɔpaɣiba bɛn nyɛ bɛ manim nyintahi bipuɣinsi doon a ni.
en: or with someone else's wife. Some men even sleep with their own daughter-in-law or half sister.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba dii gbaai kumsi.
en: Jesus began to cry.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha waɣa? Kurimbuni ha ka m pun lo lala, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ maa. Dina n-nyɛ: Ni a saɣim fɔntin kara, ka di leei dabari.
en: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all this long ago. And you don't even realize that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.

dag: Amaa ka o daŋ ni nir maa ni ti kuhi yɛli dindali maa, N ku tooi leei yi tibira. N ka bindirigu bee binyɛrigu n yiŋa; yi ku zaŋ ma leei niriba zuɣulana.
en: But the brother will refuse and say, I cannot help you. I dont have enough food or clothes for my own family. You will not make me your leader.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim ʒe samban ni maa daa guhi Zakaria je, ka di daa gari ba o ni yuui Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Outside, the people were still waiting for Zechariah. They were surprised that he was staying so long in the Temple.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu, ka Ɛlhanan ŋun daa nyɛ Jair bia la daa ku Lahimi ŋun daa nyɛ Goliat Gaat nir la mabia, ka o kpani daɣu daa ŋmani kpalu daɣu.
en: There was another battle with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear had a shaft as thick as the bar on a weaver's loom.

dag: Di sabiya yaha, Ŋunkam yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ.
en: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.

dag: Amaa n na ʒi n-zo ka chɛ piɛgulibo din nyɛ a ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti ma maa bee m-bɔri ni zaɣ biɛɣu paa ba. A mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yiri n nol ni na; dama di daa niŋla a ninni.
en: Our Lord , you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.

dag: Bɛna n-daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni din la n-leei ti dini.
en: They said, Lets make this land our own— these fields of grass that belong to God.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi takɔro maa ni ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee be m polo? Ka m ba namɔɣilis ayi bee ata ŋmaligi lih o na.
en: Jehu looked up at the window and said, Who is on my side? Who? Two or three eunuchs looked out at Jehu.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛl o bidib tuuli Jɛta, Yiɣisim ku ba. Amaa ka bia maa daa bi saɣi ŋ-ŋoog o takɔbi. O daa zɔrila dabiɛm, o ni daa na nyɛ bipolli la zuɣu.
en: Then Gideon turned to Jether, his oldest son, and said, Kill these kings. But Jether was only a boy and was afraid, so he would not take out his sword.

dag: Zaŋmi kikaa kpa a noli, dama juɣu tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣu, bɛ ni saɣim n daalikauli ka birigi n zaligu la zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, Sound the alarm! Enemies are swooping down on my land like eagles! My people have broken the covenant I made with them and have rebelled against my teaching.

dag: N daa ti baɣisila vinnyaɣilan puu gari, ka daa ti lan baɣisi jɛrigu wain tihi puu gari.
en: I happened upon the field of a lazy person, by the vineyard of one with no sense.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni, ka ŋmaligi kpa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa polo ti bo o, bɛ daa nya o.
en: But when the Israelites had trouble, they turned again to the Lord , the God of Israel. They looked for him and found him.

dag: Nyaandoliba bɛn daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya ni na. Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya niriba shɛb daa chaŋ Dauda sani birini la ni.
en: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.

dag: Ka Hanania daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niriba maa zaa sani yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n yɛn kabi Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza naɣikɔra dapua la zuliya kam nyiŋgoya ni yuma ayi puuni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka anabi Jɛrimia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: He said before all the people, This is what the LORD says: Just as this yoke has been broken, I will break the yoke of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar from the neck of all the nations within two years. Then the prophet Jeremiah walked away.

dag: ni shɛlɔr shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyara pa di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: and the sash of fine linen and of blue, purple, and red wool, decorated with embroidery, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: O peentɔriba tari gili ma, ka o bɔɣibɔɣi n yaannina, ka bi zo ma nambɔɣu. O puhigi m binsom bahi tiŋa.
en: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.

dag: Ka Sool yaaŋa Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia maa daa ka Naa Dauda sanna nti lu n-gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura. Ka Dauda bol o, Mɛfibɔshɛt. Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: When Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul, arrived, he bowed down before David in respect. David said, Mephibosheth, and he answered, At your service, sir.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Karimba, mami daba ayi ŋɔ ni ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔri ni bɛ lab a kuɣa la, ka a ti lan yɛn lab nimaani yaha.
en: Teacher, they said, the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tiligi bɛn vu m-miri Naawuni o zuɣu la sahakam, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul be ni o timdi sandaani tiri ba Naawuni sani.
en: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.

dag: Nyama, Mani n-nam machɛle, ka ti zuɣiri pɔhim, ka di chɛ ka buɣimsala buɣim nyɛligira, ka machɛli kuriti bidibbini din ni ku di bukaata. Mani n lan nam ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ka o kuri niriba.
en: Look, I made the blacksmith. He blows on the fire to make it hotter. Then he takes the hot iron and makes the kind of tool he wants to make. In the same way, I made the Destroyer to destroy things.

dag: Naawuni, ti yaannim daa pun yɛli ti ka ti wum a ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa bɛ ʒiɛman ni kurimbuni ha la yɛla.
en: We have heard it, God, with our own ears; our ancestors told us about it: about the deeds you did in their days, in days long past.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi la ni.
en: In the two courtyards of the Temple he built altars for the worship of the stars.

dag: Ŋuni mini tuumbiɛtumdiba n-lee laɣim be, ka o mini ninvuɣ biɛri doli?.
en: He spends his time with sinners.

dag: Ka n daa wum bɛ ni tabili ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli, ka bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi bɛn nyɛ bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na:.
en: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were . and they came from every tribe of Israel:.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔb chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka nya bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam gari yi tɔbbihi, yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la be yi sani.
en: When you go out to fight against your enemies and you see chariots and horses and an army that outnumbers yours, do not be afraid of them. The Lord your God, who rescued you from Egypt, will be with you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribila maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: They made two gold rings and fastened them on the front of the lower part of the two shoulder pieces of the vest, at its seam just above the vests belt.

dag: N zaŋ jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma la ti ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm la.
en: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.

dag: Ka o zaŋ naɣilaa maa yi kpaŋa bɛ biɛhigu maa shee nti nyo buɣim kaman o ni di nyo o tuuli naɣilaa la shɛm la, di nyɛla zama alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: Then the priest will take the bull outside the camp and burn it, just as the first bull was burned. It is the purification offering for the assembly.

dag: Ka doo maa kɔŋ maa daa dii naai, ka o niŋgbuŋ lan lab di bebu ni zaa.
en: At once the man's leprosy disappeared, and he was well.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Di chaŋ wula ka yi baŋdi dunia ŋɔ mini sagbana shihira, ka lee bi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ din shihira.
en: Hypocrites! You can look at the earth and the sky and predict the weather; why, then, don't you know the meaning of this present time?.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali maa nyɛla din muɣisir a ninsal taba, ka a wuntitali nyɛ din sɔŋd a ninsal taba.
en: Job, the good and bad things you do affect only other people like yourself.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka buɣim daa diri zoli maa, ka alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi la daa be n nuh ayi ni.
en: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.

dag: Ijiptinima, o daa wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma yi sunsuuni n-darigi Firawuna min o niriba zaa tibili.
en: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.

dag: Yili kam nyɛla ninvuɣ so ni me shɛli, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun me binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.

dag: Ka o daa deei salima maa n-zaŋ li nyɛligi mali salima naɣilabila. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, This is the god who brought us out of Egypt.

dag: N ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka di ti gari yi dimnim bɛn ti yɛn kana ti be di ni.
en: I will make your land empty. And your enemies who come to live there will be shocked at it.

dag: O daa yɛli Dan zuliya: Dan zuliya ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun yiɣi yi Bashan na.
en: Moses said this about Dan: Dan is a lions cub that jumps out from Bashan.

dag: Niɣi mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ni ti do di ni, ka vikpiluri mini vitahiŋgbana ti tam di mɔpilinyuhi zuɣu. Viri ni ti kumdi di takɔriti ni, ka kahiŋkɔri ti kumdi di dunɔbihi zuɣu; dama bɛ ni zaŋ sida dari tum di tuun shɛŋa la ni ti bahi yoli.
en: It will be a place where flocks, herds, and animals of every kind will lie down. Owls will live among its ruins and hoot from the windows. Crows will caw on the doorsteps. The cedar wood of her buildings will be stripped away.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ li na ka o piligi li n-nya bia maa, ka bia maa dii gbaai kuhigu. Ka di daa niŋ o yoli, ka o yɛli, Hiburunim bihi la ni yino m-bala.
en: When she opened it, she saw the child. The boy was crying, and she felt sorry for him. She said, This must be one of the Hebrews children.

dag: Ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la; ka chib shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni din ni tooi paɣ li ka di piɛl lala.
en: And his clothes became much whiter than any bleach on earth could make them.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi mɔɣa mini kɔbilisirima ni, ka di leei ʒim.
en: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and the springs of water. The rivers and the springs of water became blood.

dag: O yidan niŋ o naani o suhu ni, ka shɛli ku poog o yidana maa.
en: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.

dag: Ka Shilɔnim bipuɣinsi yi ti yina ni bɛ ti wa wahi, yin yimiya wain tihi puri maa ni na, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti gbaag o paɣ ni yɛn nyɛ so Shilɔnim bipuɣinsi maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni.
en: and watch. When the young women of Shiloh come out to dance during the festival, you come out of the vineyards. Each of you take a wife by force from among them and take her back to the territory of Benjamin with you.

dag: Ka siɣili saha din nyɛ nanim ni daa yi tuhiri tɔbu saha shɛli la daa ti paai, ka Dauda daa tim Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Ammɔnnima, ka chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda ŋun daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In the spring, when kings go off to war, David sent Joab, along with his servants and all the Israelites, and they destroyed the Ammonites, attacking the city of Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.

dag: Yi yi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, o ni niŋ alibarikanim ŋɔ zaa niŋ yi ni.
en: Obey the Lord your God and all these blessings will be yours:.

dag: Nyama, a kari ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka kari ma a sani; ka n leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ŋunkam ti nya ma ni ku ma.
en: You are forcing me to leave the land, and I will not be able to be near you or have a home! Now I must wander from place to place, and anyone I meet could kill me.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa po Yawɛ n-yɛli, Adɔnija yi bi kɔŋ o nyɛvili yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu gar lala!.
en: Then Solomon said, By the Lord , I swear Ill make Adonijah pay for this with his life!.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun gbib o nuu vɔr o, Chɛ ka m bɔbili gbaai duu ŋɔ ni tam daantal shɛŋa zuɣu n-zaŋ mmaŋ dalim li.
en: A servant was holding his hand. Samson said to him, Put me where I can feel the columns that hold this temple up. I want to lean against them.

dag: Dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni daa be Gɛshur Aram tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa lo alikauli yɛli, Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka n labi Jɛrusalɛm, n ni jɛm o Hiburɔn. .
en: While I was living in Geshur in Syria, I promised the Lord that if he would take me back to Jerusalem, I would worship him in Hebron.

dag: Yihim Naawuni yɛligu waazu: kul yirigim di zuɣu saha shɛlikam zaa; saɣisim niriba; kpahimi niriba zuɣu ni; kpammi niriba jaande; wuhimi niriba suɣilɔdibo pam puuni.
en: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.

dag: Bɛ yihi suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim Mɔab tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niŋdi bindira pam la ni. N chɛ ka wain tɔɣibu ŋmaai wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ni. So bi lan tɔɣiri wain ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni yɔri vu shɛli maa pala suhupiɛlli vuri.
en: Happiness and joy have been taken away from the fertile land of Moab. I have made the wine stop flowing from the wine presses; there is no one to make the wine and shout for joy.

dag: N ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi, dama ti Naawuni maa galisiya gari wuni kam.
en: I intend to build a great temple, because our God is greater than any other god.

dag: Ka yihi di biŋkpam zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then he will remove all the fat from it and completely burn it on the altar.

dag: N ni daa bol a maa, a daa vu m-miri ma; a daa yɛli ma, Di zɔri dabiɛm.
en: You came to me on the day that I called out to you. You said to me, Dont be afraid.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli soya m-bala, ka bɛ yi yi dunia yili, shɛb ni kana ti zani bɛ zaani.
en: Surely its way is a joy, for from the dust other plants sprout.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o. Mɔabnim daa kul chanila Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛɣuni nti fari bɛ bindira yuuni kam.
en: Elisha died and was buried. Every year bands of Moabites used to invade the land of Israel.

dag: amaa n ni yɛli zuliya shɛli maa nim yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, n ni taɣi n tɛha, ka ku lan chɛ ka n ni lo ni alɔbo shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu maa paai ba.
en: and that nation turns from its evil, I will change my mind.

dag: Anabi Jona ni daa nyɛ Ninivenim shihirili shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim shihirili.
en: In the same way that the prophet Jonah was a sign for the people of Nineveh, so the Son of Man will be a sign for the people of this day.

dag: Dama Musa ni daa mali Yawɛ biɛhigu shee du shɛli tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa nyɔri sara maligunim la daa bela jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn la di saha maa.
en: because he was afraid of the angel's sword and did not want to go all the way to Gibeon. That's where the sacred tent that Moses had made in the desert was kept, as well as the altar where sacrifices were offered to the Lord .

dag: Zaŋmi Aduna min o bidibisi ni binyɛra la ni bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la ni alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa ni piɛlah ayi ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu.
en: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa labina di saha maa ti ŋme n-deei Hazɔr, ka zaŋ takɔb ku di naa, dama Hazɔr n-daa nyɛ nama maa zaa tin zuɣu.
en: Then Joshua went back and captured the city of Hazor and killed its king.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kul yiɣisir o, ka o yi bembe o ti kuhirimi; ka alizin biɛɣu maa darigir o hal ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋariti o noli, ka o kul nahind o ka bi bɔr o bahibu.
en: An evil spirit comes into him, and then he shouts. He loses control of himself and foams at the mouth. The evil spirit continues to hurt him and almost never leaves him.

dag: ka lab o mabihi maa sani ti yɛli ba, Bia maa kani, ka ya ka n lee yɛn kpe.
en: Reuben went to the brothers and said, The boy is not in the well! What will I do.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig awɛi saha ka o daa lan yi n-chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb ʒi daa ni yoli.
en: About nine oclock the man went to the marketplace and saw some other people standing there. They were doing nothing.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Failimɔn ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpe so ti ni yuri la.
en: Greetings from Paul, a prisoner for Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, our brother. To Philemon, our dear friend and worker with us.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ bahigu, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyu Kpiɔŋlan Naa suhuyiɣisili.
en: Let sinners bear their own punishment; let them feel the wrath of Almighty God.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣa daa wum Sulemaana yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu polo, ka kana nti bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa din kpɛma ni o buɣis o nya.
en: When the queen of Sheba heard reports about Solomon, due to the LORDs name, she came to test him with riddles.

dag: di simdi ni nir zaŋ o tapaɣa ti ka bɛ ŋme o, ka tu o.
en: He should offer his cheek for a blow; he should be filled with shame.

dag: ka ŋun boli ya maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a ni a yiɣisim ka ti ŋun gar a maa ʒiishee, di saha di ni mal a vi ni a chaŋ ti ʒini tariŋ ʒiishee.
en: And if you are sitting in the most important seat, they will come to you and say, Give this man your seat! Then you will have to move down to the last place and be embarrassed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa pii fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni ti Lɛvinima kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: So the Israelites obeyed this command from the Lord and gave the Levites these towns and the land around them for their animals:.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuma awɛi ni, gol so ŋun pahiri chir pia puuni ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛm n-teei gil li.
en: In the ninth year and the tenth month of Judahs King Zedekiah, Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar and his entire army came against Jerusalem and surrounded it.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni bi deeri alahichilan suhigu, amaa so yi jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni ka tumd o yubu, o deeri dilan suhigu.
en: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bɔri ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni bɛ suhuri zaa la daa yi Izraɛl bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa n-doli Lɛvinim kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la.
en: People from every tribe of Israel who had made up their minds to seek the LORD, Israels God, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee bo yɛlli ti Taainim ŋɔ? Taai din nyɛ tin shɛli din leeri nama, ka di kɔhigɔriba nyɛ nabihi, ka di daa bihi mi nyɛ bɛn mali jilima pam dunia ŋɔ ni la?.
en: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?.

dag: Yi ni tahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ na bi ʒiɛmdi buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun nyɛ ti ni jɛmdi buɣ so la n-tur o.
en: You have brought men in here who have not robbed temples or spoken against our goddess.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi doli n zalikpana maa, amaa ka zaɣisi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la dolibu, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nini kul moola bɛ yaannim buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu la.
en: The people of Israel did not obey my commands. They refused to obey my laws. They treated my special days of rest as though they were not important, and they worshiped the filthy idols of their fathers.

dag: Ti ni daa paai yiŋa, ti daa zaŋ nyini n dan ni daa yɛli shɛm maa yɛli ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: When we went back to our father, we told him what you had said.

dag: O mabia Hɛlɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔfa mini Imna ni Shɛlɛsh ni Amal.
en: His brother Hotham had four sons: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni kpe kuɣ shɛŋa m-me zɔŋ kulis ata tam taba, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi li kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: He built the inner courtyard with three rows of cut stone followed by one row of trimmed cedar.

dag: Amaa zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: On the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.

dag: ka o bia Ishimail mi daa nyɛ yuun pinaata bia saha shɛl o ni daa guni.
en: and his son Ishmael was thirteen.

dag: Naa Jɔash daa bi lan teei Zakaria ba Jɛhɔiada ni daa niŋ o nirilim shɛm la zaa yɛla, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o bia maa. Zakaria ni daa yɛn kpi, o daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, nyam bɛ ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ, ka bɔhi ba biɛri.
en: The king forgot about the loyal service that Zechariah's father Jehoiada had given him, and he had Zechariah killed. As Zechariah was dying, he called out, May the Lord see what you are doing and punish you.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni bi ku ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn ka bɛ ti leeg o min o bihi daba hal ka Pɛriʒia nam ti nya zaa zani.
en: Nebuchadnezzar took the people who were still alive back to Babylon and forced them to be slaves. They stayed in Babylon as slaves until the Persian kingdom defeated the kingdom of Babylon.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun kari zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam bahi ka chɛn ya, ka so na bi tooi zani yi tooni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord helped you defeat many great and powerful nations. He forced them to leave. No nation has been able to defeat you.

dag: Amaa yɛm din yiri alizanda ni na nyɛla alali, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri suhudoo mini biɛribaalimtali, ka nyɛ din deeri wuhibu, ka lan nyɛ din pali nambɔzɔbo mini tuun suma, ka mali ʒiɛyimtali ka ka bilikɔnsi baabiɛla.
en: But the wisdom that comes from God is like this: First, it is pure. It is also peaceful, gentle, and easy to please. This wisdom is always ready to help people who have trouble and to do good for others. This wisdom is always fair and honest.

dag: Amaa n zaŋsim daa be n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa saɣim shɛli bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb ni la.
en: So I had compassion on my holy name, which the house of Israel degraded among the nations where they had gone.

dag: Zuliya shɛli buɣa ni tooi chɛ ka saa mi? Bee zuɣusaa ni tooi chɛ ka sayuɣiyuɣi mi? Pa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-niŋdi li? Ti mali tahima a sani, dama nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: Can any of the false gods of the nations make it rain? Can the sky by itself bring showers? Arent you the LORD, our God? You are our hope, since only you can do such things.

dag: Di saha ti Duuma ni ti bu wanzam ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa paa ka o yi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli n-kana ti pini yi zuɣuri mini yi teensi ni yi niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri.
en: On that day, the Lord will shave with a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates—with the king of Assyria—the head and the pubic hair, and will cut off the beard as well.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba.
en: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds.

dag: N ni daa kana saha shɛl la, bɛ daa nyɛla biɛla; ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yipa nabimi pam, ka n yi kul ŋmaligi kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo, Yawɛ niŋdila alibarika niŋ a ni. Amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ, bɔ saha ka man lee yɛn zaŋ wolim gbaai ti n yiŋnim gba.
en: You didn't have much before I came, but the Lord has blessed everything I have ever done for you. Now it's time for me to start looking out for my own family.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jɛdiayɛl daŋ ni niriba, ka daa nyɛ zuɣulaannima bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyi.
en: They were heads of families in the clan and were all famous soldiers. Their descendants included , men eligible for military duty.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sɛrɛd daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Sɛrɛdnima; ka Ɛlɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛlɔnnima; ka Jaaliil daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaaliilnima.
en: The tribe of Zebulun: the clans of Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ a yuli kana ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa la, di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, o kul niŋdila a niriba maa putɔɣu, ka a bi niŋ shɛli ni a fa a niriba maa bahi.
en: Ever since you told me to speak to the king, he has caused nothing but trouble for these people. And you haven't done a thing to help.

dag: Nyini n-su wuntaŋ ni, ka lan su yuŋ gba; nyini n-zali wuntaŋ mini goli.
en: The day belongs to you! The night too! You established both the moon and the sun.

dag: O daa zaŋ zibisim din gil o leeg o sampaa, ka sagban tibisa leeg o kom dooshee.
en: He covered himself with darkness; thick clouds, full of water, surrounded him;.

dag: Di daba anu nyaaŋa ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Ananias daa zaŋ kpeen shɛba mini bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira ŋun yuli daa booni Tɛɛtulus la pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Siizaria. Bɛ daa chaŋmi ti zaŋ bɛ mini Pool yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Gomna Filiksi.
en: Five days later Ananias, the high priest, went to the city of Caesarea. He brought with him some of the older Jewish leaders and a lawyer named Tertullus. They went to Caesarea to make charges against Paul before the governor.

dag: O kɔŋko n-daa yɛrigi sagbana, ka no teeku kɔgbana sɔŋ.
en: He alone made the skies, and he walks on the ocean waves.

dag: Bɛ ni daa me birini gili fɔŋ kar shɛŋa n-nyɛ: Zidim mini Zɛr ni Hammat ni Rakat ni Kinɛrɛt.
en: They also owned the fortified cities Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth.

dag: Ti mi ni binnamda zaa kul ŋuhirimi ka wolisiri biɛrim zuɣu hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: and then the Lord told me.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Keep the religious festivals and honor the place where I am worshiped. I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya saŋmariga maa ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: When they saw the star, they were filled with joy.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti ma, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam kul ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum gbahi ya, ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zaŋ manna dihi ya, din daa nyɛ yi mini yi yaannim ni ʒi shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni pa bindirigu kɔŋko n-chɛ ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Yawɛ nol ni na n-chɛ ka daadam be.
en: He made you go hungry, and then he gave you manna to eat, food that you and your ancestors had never eaten before. He did this to teach you that you must not depend on bread alone to sustain you, but on everything that the Lord says.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ; o saria karibu la bela dunia ni zaa.
en: The LORD—he is our God. His justice is everywhere throughout the whole world.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ni o yihim ti tɛhibiɛrinim mini ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, dama pa sokam zaa n-nyɛ bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: Pray too that we will be rescued from inappropriate and evil people since everyone that we meet wont respond with faith.

dag: Anabi Jona ni daa nyɛ Ninivenim shihirili shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim shihirili.
en: Jonah was a sign for those who lived in Nineveh. It is the same with the Son of Man. He will be a sign for the people of this time.

dag: Dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun taɣ ma ka m bi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi kana yomyom ti nya ma, biɛɣuni asiba doo zaɣ yino gba sa naan ku lan guui Nabal yiŋa.
en: Otherwise, as surely as the LORD God of Israel lives—the one who kept me from hurting you—if you hadnt come quickly and met up with me, there wouldnt be one single one who urinates on a wall left come morning.

dag: Di saha ka Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar maa daa lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma. Di nyaaŋa ka Shafan daa karim li wuhi naa.
en: Then he added, I have here a book that Hilkiah gave me. And he read it aloud to the king.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa be Dauda sani daba ata n-diri ka nyura, dama bɛ mabihi daa pun malila binshɛɣukam shili zali ba.
en: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.

dag: bee gomnanim bɛn nyɛ o ni tim shɛb ni be ti darigi bɛn tumdi taali tibili, ka paɣi bɛn tumdi tuun suma la.
en: or to governors as those sent by the emperor. They are sent to punish those doing evil and to praise those doing good.

dag: Ka Pasɛa bia Joyada mini Bɛsɔdɛya bia Mɛshulam daa mali me Dunɔdal Kurili la. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah rebuilt Jeshanah Gate. They put the beams and the gates in place, and put in the bolts and bars for locking the gate.

dag: Alizanda ni nima, yilimiya yila! Dunianima, maliya suhupiɛlli! Zoya, yilimiya yila! Dama Yawɛ ni kpaŋs o niriba suhuri. O ni zo o niriba bɛn be muɣisigu ni nambɔɣu.
en: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord 's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa kul tahirimi. Bɛ kul malila suhupiɛlli ka yɔri vuri. Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi pala bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku shɛba, bɛ mi pala bɛn kpi tɔbu ni.
en: you who are filled with noise, you roaring city, you party town? Your dead werent slaughtered by the sword; they didnt die in battle.

dag: hal ka a ninvuɣ biɛtali ti yi palo? Pumpɔŋɔ a nyɛla Ɛdomnim mini Filistianim ni bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba ni maani ninvuɣ so ansarisi, ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: You did that before you were punished, before your neighbors started making fun of you. The daughters of Edom and Philistia are making fun of you now.

dag: ka sakuɣa lu n-sabigi ŋari di kɔsoya la.
en: like streams that swell with melting snow.

dag: Ka n daa nya biŋkɔb so ka o yiri teeku ni na; o daa malila yila pia, ka mali zuɣur ayopɔin, ka nam zuɣupila pia pili o yila maa, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya sab pa o zuɣuri maa zuɣu.
en: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.

dag: Teemi ni a daa me ma mi kaman yaɣiri la, ka lan yɛn chɛ ka n leei taŋkpaɣu?.
en: Remember that you made me from clay; are you going to crush me back to dust?.

dag: Yi bi bɔri ni yi saɣi ni dabisi biɛɣu dali mirina, amaa yi ni niŋdi shɛm lee chɛmi ka dindali maa mirina.
en: You refuse to admit that a day of disaster is coming, but what you do only brings that day closer.

dag: Ka Mɔab naa daa ti nya ka tɔb maa mii taɣ o na, ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ takɔbinyaɣiriba m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-tim Ɛdom naa polo ni o gari zo, amaa ka kɔŋ garibu.
en: When the king of Moab realized that he was losing the battle, he took seven hundred swordsmen with him and tried to force his way through the enemy lines and escape to the king of Syria, but he failed.

dag: Bɛ yɛri binyɛri shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ pa talima n-dooni bimbini kam gbini, ka nyuri wain shɛli bɛ ni deei bɛ sandiriba sani bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: At every place of worship people sleep on clothing that they have taken from the poor as security for debts. In the temple of their God they drink wine which they have taken from those who owe them money.

dag: Ka o mini ba zaa daa chaŋ Baalɛjuda ni bɛ ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na. Bɛ daa zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka o nam kuɣ tam chɛrubinim zuɣu la yuli boli Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: and led them to Baalah in Judah, in order to bring from there God's Covenant Box, bearing the name of the Lord Almighty, whose throne is above the winged creatures.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o zalikpana la min o fukumsi zaligunim la kaman yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Obey the Lord our God and follow his commands with all your heart, just as you are doing today.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande: Kpahimiya gbinyaɣinim zuɣu ni; ka kpaŋsimiya bɛn suhuri miligi la suhuri; ka sɔŋmiya bɛn gbarigi la; ka maliya suɣilo ni sokam.
en: Brothers and sisters, we urge you to warn those who are disorderly. Comfort the discouraged. Help the weak. Be patient with everyone.

dag: Ti ni niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika zuɣu ka ti tiligi shɛm, lala n-nyɛ bɛ gba.
en: No! We believe and are saved by the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛn mali yɛm di nyuri bara bɛ yɛm zuɣu, ka bɛn mali yaa di nyuri bara bɛ yaa zuɣu. Ka bɛn gba mali buni di nyuri bara bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, The wise should not boast of their wisdom, nor the strong of their strength, nor the rich of their wealth.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa tum shɛm, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata bahi yoli dahin yin la.
en: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about , died. Don't do shameful things as they did.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o nuhi puli pa tab zuɣu n-zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim ŋun daa nyɛ biasan la zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa mi pa Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ bituuli maa zuɣu ni.
en: But Jacob crossed his hands, and put his right hand on the head of Ephraim, even though he was the younger, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, who was the older.

dag: ka daa daŋ tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli nti mali shili n-gul o;.
en: He sent messengers ahead of him, who went into a village in Samaria to get everything ready for him.

dag: Amaa o daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom di Ijipti naa min o tɔbbihi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He drowned Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka nanim diri nam. Mani n-sɔŋdi zuɣulaannim ka bɛ zaani zaligu shɛŋa din doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.

dag: ka kaari ba asiba kam, ka zahindi ba saha shɛlikam?.
en: You inspect them every morning and test them every minute.

dag: Apil tia ni be nyɔŋ tihi sunsuuni shɛm la, lala ka n yura be nachimba sunsuuni. N yur o mahim ʒinibu ka o wala nyaɣisi pam n sani.
en: Like an apple tree among the wild trees, so is my lover among the young men. In his shade I take pleasure in sitting, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa ka bɔhir o, Bɔ ka ti yɛn nyu.
en: The people complained and said, Moses, what are we going to drink.

dag: Yɛm shɛli yɛla n ni mali tɔɣisiri maa nyɛla Naawuni daashili yɛmsɔɣirili shɛli o ni daa zali ti jilima nyabu zuɣu hal ka na bi nam dunia ŋɔ la.
en: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ sana zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-niŋ o fitiina, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.

dag: ni Anduru ni Filip ni Baatolomiu ni Matiu ni Tomas ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James, the son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon, the Zealot.

dag: Bɛnhadad min o natab bɛn daa ʒe o nyaaŋa la daa bela bɛ suɣa ni nyuri dam, ka bɛ zaŋ o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa na ti yɛli Bɛnhadad. Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi ni bɛ malim shili n-chaŋ ti liri Samarianim maa, ka bɛ daa teei zani.
en: Meanwhile, Benhadad and the other kings had been drinking in their tents. But when Ahab's reply came, he ordered his soldiers to prepare to attack Samaria, and they all got ready.

dag: daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka o dɔro maa dii naai.
en: She came up in the crowd behind Jesus and touched the edge of his cloak, and her bleeding stopped at once.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya la mi, kalim ba kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You will enroll the Merarites by their clans and their households.

dag: Dama ti bi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali Naawuni yɛligu n-niŋdi kaman neen shɛŋa bɛ ni kɔhiri alaha, amaa ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋlinima ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb tim, ka zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ti nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri Masia yɛla.
en: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.

dag: Di pa shɛli a shiri paɣirila Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa di pala din ni kpaŋsi so suhu.
en: Even if your prayer of thanks to God is quite good, other people are not helped at all.

dag: Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nin kara zaa daa puhigi, ka zuɣusaa sagbana kɔsoya gba yooi.
en: When Noah was six hundred years old, on the seventeenth day of the second month all the outlets of the vast body of water beneath the earth burst open, all the floodgates of the sky were opened.

dag: Ka Lɔt ŋun daa doli Ibram maa gba daa mali biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni tantinima.
en: During this time Lot was also traveling with Abram. Lot had many animals and tents.

dag: Ka o yi ka bipuɣiŋga, yin zaŋmiy o fali ti o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he has no daughter, everything he owns will be given to his brothers.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o lan yi o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn daa be sol ni kuni bɛ ya zuɣu.
en: After this, Jesus appeared in a different manner to two of them while they were on their way to the country.

dag: Yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba, miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmaai yimaŋa bee m-pini yi gbɛri yi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: You are the LORDs children. Dont cut yourselves and dont shave your foreheads for the dead.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa a zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, Dɔdo ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la bia.
en: Next among the famous Three was Eleazar son of Dodo, of the clan of Ahoh.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛl Anabi Hagai ni o bɔhim o niriba maa ŋ-ŋɔ:.
en: Again Haggai received a message from the Lord . Haggai spoke this message:.

dag: Ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛli yɛli, Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab Naa la n-zaŋ ma Siria wulimpuhili polo zoya ni tiŋ la ni na nti yɛli ma: Kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu ti ma. Wuhim ni Izraɛlnim simdi tibidarigibo.
en: Balaam uttered this prophecy: Balak king of Moab has brought me From Syria, from the eastern mountains. Come speak for me, he said. Put a curse on the people of Israel.

dag: dama Naawuni bi zaŋla shia ŋun ni chɛ ka ti zɔri dabiɛm ti ti, amaa shi so ŋun ni chɛ ka ti mali yiko mini yurilim ni maŋgbibbu ka o zaŋ ti ti.
en: God didnt give us a spirit that is timid but one that is powerful, loving, and self-controlled.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn paɣir a dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka nyɛ bɛn tibigir a wuntitali.
en: Your name always makes them happy. They praise your goodness.

dag: Gbuɣinli ni ŋum yɔɣu ni ka pa ni o nyala binshɛɣu? Ka gbuɣimbil ni ŋum vol ni ka pa ni o gbaala binshɛɣu?.
en: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?.

dag: Bɛ yi duɣi nimdi maa, Maligumaana ŋun yihim piɛ bɔɣu, ka pii maha din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini piɛɣu ni, ka pii karikaasi din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li niŋ Nazari nir maa nuhi ni o ni zaŋ o zuɣu shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri pinibu nyaaŋa.
en: Then, when the shoulder of the ram is boiled, the priest shall take it and put it, together with one thick loaf of bread and one thin cake from the basket, into the hands of the nazirite.

dag: Nyama, mɔɣili kopaliga yi ti kpɛma, o bi zɔri dabiɛm; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kopaliga yi ŋmɛr o noli o suhu ʒimi.
en: If the river floods, the behemoth will not run away. He is not afraid if the Jordan River splashes on his face.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam saha miriya.
en: In the same way, when you see all these things happening, you will know that Gods kingdom is very near.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: I received this message from the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ishitɔn daa nyɛla Bɛtirafa mini Pasia ni Tɛhina ba, ka Tɛhina mi daa nyɛ Irinahash ba, bɛna n-nyɛ Rɛkanima.
en: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaŋ o bia Abija ŋun daa nyɛ Maaka bia la n-leei nabi kpɛma, dama o nia daa nyɛla o ti zaŋ o leei naa.
en: Rehoboam named Abijah, Maacahs son, as his successor in order to make him king.

dag: Bɛ malila bindirigu dibu shili, ka yɛrigi kpahisi sɔŋ nimaani, ka bɛ ʒini di ka nyu. Ka sapashin kpamba yiɣisi niŋ kpam mali bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: setting the table, spreading the cloth, eating, drinking. Arise, captains! Polish the shields.

dag: Yim ka bɛ ti wum vu shɛli damli, ka di yi zuɣusaa na kaman pɔhim tital la nti pali bɛ ni daa ʒi du shɛli ni maa zaa.
en: Suddenly a noise came from heaven. It sounded like a strong wind blowing. This noise filled the whole house where they were sitting.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyari bindirigu diri tiɣira, amaa ka kum mali ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The righteous have enough to eat, but the wicked are always hungry.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Di pala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kali ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ biasani daŋ o biɛli doo kulibu.
en: Laban said, In our country we dont allow the younger daughter to marry before the older daughter.

dag: Sidɔnnim mini Arivadnim n-daa nyɛ a kpatoonsi. Ka Zɛmɛr yɛnnim nyɛ a ŋariŋ duhiriba.
en: Men from Sidon and Arvad rowed your boats for you. Tyre, your wise men were the pilots on your ships.

dag: ni o kpaŋsi yi suhuri zaa, ka chɛ ka yi mali kpiɔŋ yi zaɣ suŋ kam tumbu mini yi yɛtɔɣ suŋ kam tɔɣisibu ni.
en: encourage you and strengthen you to always do and say what is good.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa baɣisi mɔɣu maa tariga zaŋ kpa Nɔba mini Jɔgbɛha wulimpuhili polo nti lu bɛ tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, dama tɔbbihi maa daa bi mali shili gu.
en: Gideon went on the road along the edge of the desert, east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and attacked the army by surprise.

dag: Amaa n yi ti neei kum ni, n ni daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili.
en: But after I am killed, I will rise from death. Then I will go into Galilee. I will be there before you go there.

dag: amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun yuri zaɣ suŋ ni ŋun su omaŋa ni ŋun bebu tuhi ni ŋun bebu be kasi ni ŋun gbib omaŋa.
en: An elder must be ready to help people by welcoming them into his home. He must love what is good. He must be wise. He must live right. He must be devoted to God and pleasing to him. And he must be able to control himself.

dag: Yɛlim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ. Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya duɣu tam, zaŋmiya li tam, ka niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Tell my rebellious people this parable that I, the Sovereign Lord , have for them: Set the pot on the fire and fill it up with water.

dag: Ka o daa shiri taɣi doli so shɛli, ka bi lan dol o ni daa pun doli so shɛli ka Bɛtɛl na maa.
en: Then he started home down a different road.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya. Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner said to Joab, Lets have the young soldiers get up and have a contest here. Joab said, Yes, lets have a contest.

dag: Maligim maa ni daa ti vuui, ka Izraɛlnim maa nya ka binkpil bihi piɛla yɛrigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: When the dew evaporated, there was something thin and flaky on the surface of the desert. It was as delicate as frost.

dag: ka yɛli, Aai, ti ni ba yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zo n-tiligi, dindina zomiya tiligi. Yi tɛhiya ni yi yuri zɔri pam, amaa bɛn kariti doli ya maa yuri zɔri gari yi yuri.
en: Instead, you plan to escape from your enemies by riding fast horses. And you are right—escape is what you will have to do! You think your horses are fast enough, but those who pursue you will be faster!.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛm; baŋsim ka bɛ sani.
en: because they are not a thoughtful nation; they lack any insight.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu pam, amaa ka o bi garig o.
en: He asked him many questions, but Jesus said nothing.

dag: A zali di tariga ni di di chaŋ yaɣi di zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka di ku lan tooi zo n-tiɛli dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: You set the limits for the seas, and the water will never again rise to cover the earth.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Here are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah.

dag: ni a ku niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu kaman ti gba ni daa bi shih a bee n-niŋ a shɛli, amaa ka naɣ niŋ a la zaɣ viɛlli hal ti chɛ ka a yi n-chaŋ ni alaafee la. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni.
