en: not to harm each other. Remember, we have never hurt you, and when we sent you away, we let you go in peace. The Lord has truly blessed you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla o ni daa nyaŋ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa diri ʒi Ashitarɔt din be Ɛdirɛi la nyaaŋa.
en: This was after he defeated Sihon and Og.

dag: Piɛguliba pam saɣim n wain tihi puu, bɛ no n ni su shɛli sɔŋ tiŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka n tiŋgbɔn shɛli din viɛli pam la leei dabari ni tiŋgban nɛli.
en: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard; they have trampled down my field; they have reduced my treasured field to a desolate wilderness.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ malila omaŋmaŋ amaŋka, Lɛbanɔn tihi dapaɣa ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: King Solomon made a traveling chair for himself. The wood came from Lebanon.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinu Sɔdom puuni, n ni chɛ bɛ taali maa bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord replied, If I find good people in Sodom, I will save the city to keep them from being killed.

dag: N ku saɣi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be m biɛhigu ni. N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn birigi tuma. M mini ba ku mali jina.
en: I will not even look at anything shameful. I hate all wrongdoing. I want no part of it!.

dag: ka n ti tir a bindira nimaani, dama kum maa yuma na kpalim yuma anu, di yi pa lala kum maa ni ti miig a min a yiŋnim ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: If you are in Goshen, I can take care of you. There will still be five years of famine; and I do not want you, your family, and your livestock to starve.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛdɔr tooni Vinvamli wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located.

dag: N di yuya ni a zaŋ ma sɔɣi kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka a zaŋ ma sɔɣi nimaani hal ka a suhu ti maai, ka a di zali ma saha shɛli a ni yɛn teei n yɛla.
en: I wish you would hide me in the underworld, conceal me until your anger passes, set a time for me, and remember me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ni be Hɛshibɔn mini Aroa ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili fɔntin shɛŋa din zaa ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili la zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ yuun kɔbisita m-bɔŋɔ, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa pun bi deei li di saha maa zaa?.
en: For years, Israelites have been living in Heshbon and Aroer and the nearby villages, and in the towns along the Arnon River gorge. If the land really belonged to you Ammonites, you wouldn't have waited until now to try to get it back.

dag: Zuŋɔ yi dim maa be Nɔb; o ni kpilim o nuu gahi Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm zol la gbini.
en: This very day he will stand at Nob and shake his fist at Daughter Zions mountain, the hill of Jerusalem!.

dag: ka o chɛ ka noonsi yiɣina ti lu bɛ sani. Bɛ daa galisiya pam ŋ-ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu;.
en: He made quail fall like rain until they covered the ground. There were so many birds that they were like sand on the seashore.

dag: Bee a ʒiɛmla Naawuni nirilim din galisi min o nambɔzɔbo ni o suɣilɔdibo la? A bi mi ni din chɛ ka Naawuni niŋd a nirilim maa nyɛla o bɔrimi ni a niŋ tuuba?.
en: Or do you have contempt for the riches of Gods generosity, tolerance, and patience? Dont you realize that Gods kindness is supposed to lead you to change your heart and life?.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaani wuntaŋa ka o bi nyeera, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saŋmarisi bi peera.
en: He can keep the sun from rising, and the stars from shining at night.

dag: O daa boli nimaani yul la Bɛtɛl. Amaa nimaani yuli daa pun boonila Luz.
en: The name of that place was Luz, but Jacob named it Bethel.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini neen shɛŋa din be nayili zaa chaŋ; ka daa lan kpuɣi salima nyɔtaɣirisi shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa chɛ ka bɛ mali la.
en: He took away all the treasures in the Temple and in the palace, including the gold shields Solomon had made.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Jɛhɔzabad, o mi daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinu bɛn daa gbibi bidibbina m-mali shili gu tɔbu.
en: Jehozabad had , men ready for war.

dag: Anab so pakoli daa ti yɛli Ilaisha, A dab so ŋun yi nyɛ n yidan la kpiya. Ka a mi mi ni a dabili maa daa nyɛla ŋun zɔri Yawɛ, amaa ka o sandana kana ni o ti zaŋ m bidibis ayi nti leeg o daba.
en: The widow of a member of a group of prophets went to Elisha and said, Sir, my husband has died! As you know, he was a God-fearing man, but now a man he owed money to has come to take away my two sons as slaves in payment for my husband's debt.

dag: Ka Dilaila yɛl o, A boli ma la jɛrigu, ka ŋma ma ʒiri. Niŋm ania, yɛlim ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi.
en: You lied and made me look like a fool, Delilah said. Now tell me. How can I really tie you up.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri ninsalinim yɛligu balibu kam, hal zaŋ tabili malaikanim yɛligu, ka ka yurilim, dindina m bemi kaman dawule bee gbiŋgbarinlun shɛŋa bɛ ni mali ŋmɛri taba ka di yɔri vuri yiriŋ la.
en: I may speak in different languages, whether human or even of angels. But if I dont have love, I am only a noisy bell or a ringing cymbal.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yi Jeemsi zuɣu, ka daa lan yi o tuumba la zaa gba zuɣu.
en: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.

dag: a ni daa zaŋ a nudirigu sa wain ti shɛl la. Amaŋmaŋ ni daa sa wain ti pol shɛli la.
en: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yi, bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma ka bɛ kpi n-doya, ka zunzuya bɛn yɛn di ba bi kpira; ka buɣim din yɛn di ba gba bi kpira. Ka bɛ dooshee maa ni mali dabiɛm pam sokam zaa sani.
en: As they leave, they will see the dead bodies of those who have rebelled against me. The worms that eat them will never die, and the fire that burns them will never be put out. The sight of them will be disgusting to all people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi yi ti boli ma n-suhi ma, n ni wum yi suhigu maa.
en: Then you will call to me. You will come and pray to me, and I will answer you.

dag: Ka zoomba ayi daa ʒi sokpaŋa ka ti wum ni Yisa n-gariti maa, ka bɛ kuhi yɛli, Ti Dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: There were two blind men sitting by the road. They heard that Jesus was coming by. So they shouted, Lord, Son of David, please help us.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa min o ba malibu maa zaa, N ni chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, M ba min o malibu ni m biɛyanim bɛn be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kuli n sanna.
en: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to everyone who had come with them: I must go and tell the king that you have arrived from Canaan.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nudirigu tiri, ka tiŋgbani vali ba.
en: You raised your right hand to punish the enemy, and the ground opened up to swallow them.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami.
en: May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with everyone.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa balim o yɛli, Karimba, dim bindirigu.
en: In the meantime the disciples spoke to Jesus, saying, Rabbi, eat.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabi shɛb mini laasabuniŋdib shɛb bɛn be yi san la yɔhim ya. Di gbilisiya tibili wumdi bɛ ni zahindi zahin shɛŋa la.
en: I, the Lord , the God of Israel, warn you not to let yourselves be deceived by the prophets who live among you or by any others who claim they can predict the future. Do not pay any attention to their dreams.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka sagbani sirigina wuntaŋ ni ti lim Ziɔn Zoli mini bɛnkam zaa laɣim nimaani, ka nyɛ nyɔhi ni buɣim niɛm din diri ne yuŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni jilima din be nimaani ni ti nyɛla leeŋa.
en: Then the Lord will create a cloud of smoke in the day and a bright flame of fire at night over every building and over every meeting of the people on the mountain of Zion. And there will be a covering over everyone for protection.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nyɛ n dimnim yi liri ma m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma, bɛ ni tuui lu.
en: When evil people attack me and try to kill me, they stumble and fall.

dag: Amaa di yi pa lala, buɣim din yim Abimilɛk ni na ti di yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnima; ka chɛ ka buɣim yi yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim gba ni na ti di Abimilɛk.
en: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and burn up the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo; and let fire come out from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and burn up Abimelech.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm. Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo la.
en: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka naa maa gba suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o chɛ ka pirinsi kpɛh o duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o gba yo samli maa zaa.
en: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.

dag: Hal bɛ yi ti zoori kaman momaha la, Yawɛ pɔhim ni yi wulimpuhili polo mɔɣu ni na nti ʒe nyuui bɛ kɔbilnina, ka bɛ kɔzɔrima nyuui. Ka di ʒe bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni daazichi zaa chaŋ.
en: Even though Israel flourishes like weeds, I will send a hot east wind from the desert, and it will dry up their springs and wells. It will take away everything of value.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, duumanim shɛba n-yi su ti, amaa a kɔŋko ka ti mi.
en: Lord , you are our God, but in the past, we followed other lords. We belonged to other masters, but now we want people to remember only one name—yours.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman mɔpilli zuɣu mɔri, din ni kpi ka na bi zooi.
en: They will be like grass on a flat roof that dies before it has time to grow.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim tarili la ni, yihimiya bin yini bini pihinu kam puuni, di yi nyɛla ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi bee biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn pahi n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma fukumsi la.
en: From the part given to the rest of the people, take one out of every fifty prisoners and the same proportion of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats. Give them to the Levites who are in charge of the Lord 's Tent.

dag: O daa bi chɛ ka so niŋ ba fitiina, o daa daŋ kpahi nannim zuɣuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: God didnt let anyone oppress them. God punished kings for their sake.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyo naɣisaa maa buɣim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka su kom; o gba ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: The man who burned the cow must also wash his clothes and take a bath, but he is also unclean until evening.

dag: Zoya mini kunkuna ni tihi din wandi wala ni sida tihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, hills and mountains, fruit trees and forests;.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zahim ti biɛhigu nya, ka ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani.
en: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord .

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Kuɣ duli ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira m min a sunsuuni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban said, This mound is our witness today, and, therefore, he too named it Galeed.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee be ya.
en: Where now is Hamaths king, Arpads king, or the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena, or Ivvah.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbihi bee niɣi mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ luɣ shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la.
en: You must go to the place the Lord your God will choose to be the home for his name. There you must offer the Passover sacrifice to honor the Lord . You must offer the cattle and goats.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka m baŋ n kum dali. Ka daba ala n-lee kpalim ma? Chɛ ka m baŋ n nyɛvili ni naari yomyom shɛm.
en: Lord , how long will I live? When will I die? Tell me how soon my life will end.

dag: M bi chɛ a zaligu shɛŋa dim pahi la dolibu, dama nyini n wuhi ma li.
en: I have not neglected your instructions, because you yourself are my teacher.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa maa daa lan laɣim tab bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali n-lan ku ninvuɣ kɔbisita tiŋ maa puuni pahi. Amaa bɛ daa bi di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Jews in Susa joined together again, this time on the fourteenth day of the month of Adar. In Susa, they killed three hundred people, but they didnt lay a hand on anything the people owned.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, saha yuusim wula ka yi kul bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi maa ni? Saha yuusim wula ka ansarisimaaniba kul yɛn be ansarisi malibu ni? Ka saha yuusim wula ka jɛra kul yɛn zaɣisiri yɛm?.
en: How long will you clueless people love your naïveté, mockers hold their mocking dear, and fools hate knowledge?.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛli, N tɛhiya ni ŋun samli galisi pam la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A shiri baŋya.
en: Simon answered, I suppose it would be the one who had owed more and didn't have to pay it back. You are right, Jesus said.

dag: O chɛ ka kɔbulli ni kom gbirigiri kaman duɣu ni ka di be la; o chɛ ka teeku bemi kaman kpaʒiɛrim m-be duɣu ni la.
en: He causes the depths to churn like a boiling pot, stirs up the sea like a pot of scented oils.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa maa zaa yoli, n kɔba ni chɔɣisimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Zɛruya bihi maa nyɛla ninvuɣ yarisi. Yawɛ ni yo tuumbiɛrilana san shɛli din simd o putɔɣu tuma.
en: And today, though I am the anointed king, I am weak. These men, Zeruiahs sons, are too strong for me. May the LORD repay the one who does evil according to the evil they did.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ, Izraɛlnim bi saɣiri ŋubiri binsakpuɣu zuɣu nimdi, doo maa ni daa shihi Yaakubu sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: and the muscle on his hip joint had been injured. That's why even today the people of Israel don't eat the hip muscle of any animal.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa nyo nayili mini niriba yiya buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goma luhi.
en: The Babylonians burned down the royal palace and the houses of the people, and they destroyed the Jerusalem walls.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku bia maa kpiya.
en: The angel said, Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.

dag: Amaa kaman paɣ so ŋun bi ʒe o yidan yim ni zo ka chɛ o shɛm, lala ka yinim lzraɛlnim gba bi ʒe ma yim. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But as a woman betrays her lover, so you, people of Israel, have betrayed me, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli niriba maa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, ka be Jɛriko tooni polo la.
en: Moses and Eleazar obeyed and called together all the men of that age group. They assembled in the plains of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho. These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:.

dag: Ka alikauli maa daa shiri lɔrigi dindali maa. Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri maa ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri la daa lihiri ma nti baŋ ni Yawɛ n-wuhiri ba shɛli n ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: So that day the agreement was finished, and those poor sheep watching me knew that this message was from the Lord .

dag: M mi noonsi zaa, ka biŋkɔbiri zaa bɛn gɔri ginda nyɛla n dini.
en: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi, ka bɛ ti a vuhim, ka ti a suhupiɛlli.
en: Discipline your children and you can always be proud of them. They will never give you reason to be ashamed.

dag: dabisi shɛli din kanna ni di ti di Filistianim zaa ka mɔŋ Taainim mini Sidɔnnim sɔŋsim shɛŋa din kpalim la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ yɛn kula Filistianim bɛn kpalim be Kriit teeku duli la.
en: because the time has come to destroy all the Philistines. The time has come to destroy Tyre and Sidons remaining helpers. The Lord will destroy the Philistines, the survivors from the Island of Crete.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n daashili sɔɣibu shee ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: You are my defender and protector; I put my hope in your promise.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya niriba maa daa tim ni bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai Bɛtɛl nya di ni be shɛm. .
en: When they sent men to spy on Bethel, previously named Luz.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣili maa daa gar o nyaandoliba maa pam. Ka o lan yɛli ba, M bihi, nyamiya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu ni to shɛm bɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ daazichi naani sani!.
en: His words startled the disciples, so Jesus told them again, Children, its difficult to enter Gods kingdom!.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna maa tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: Then Pilate's soldiers took Jesus into the governor's palace, and the whole company gathered around him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi Firawuna min o kpambaliba yinsi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Ka zɔhi maa daa chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa saɣim.
en: So the Lord did just what he said. Millions of flies came into Egypt. The flies were in Pharaohs house, and they were in all his officials houses. They were all over Egypt. The flies were ruining the country.

dag: O mabihi n-daa nyɛ Gabai mini Sallai. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pihitaayika.
en: Gabbai and Sallai, close relatives of Sallu. In all, Benjaminites lived in Jerusalem.

dag: N daa loya n yɛm puuni ni n nyu dam n-nya suhupiɛlli, ka tum jɛrilim; ka yɛm daa kul be n tɛha ni. N daa tɛhiya ni di ni simdi ni nir zaŋ o dunia ŋɔ yili saha biɛla ŋɔ tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: I tried cheering myself with wine and by embracing folly—with wisdom still guiding me—until I might see what is really worth doing in the few days that human beings have under heaven.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla din pun beni, ka din yɛn beni nyɛla din pun beni. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mi din pun gari yɛla.
en: Whatever happens or can happen has already happened before. God makes the same thing happen again and again.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tɔbiri mini bɛ piɛma n-to n-ku bipola. Bɛ ku zo biliɛri mini bibihi nambɔɣu.
en: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi taba yɛla ni kaman di ni be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni shɛm.
en: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves.

dag: Dinzuɣu a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yihim nanim pihitanaayi la zaa nam ni, ka zaŋ sapashin kpamba zali bɛ zaashɛhi maa.
en: Here's what you should do. First, get rid of those kings and put army commanders in their places.

dag: Dama Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la niriba daa pun deei bɛ tarili.
en: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land.

dag: ni Kabɔn ni Lamam ni Chitilishi.
en: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish.

dag: Ka ti ni mali maligumaani titali ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: We have a great priest in charge of the house of God.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali Izraɛl zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sɔŋm o bia Sulemaana, ka lan yɛli ba.
en: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.

dag: Miri ka a sɔɣi doya ni a liri wuntizɔra yiŋa kaman ninvuɣ biɛɣu la. Miri ka a liri wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.

dag: ka buɣim kulibɔŋ zɔri yiri di ni na. Ka niriba tusatusa shɛm tumdi tuma tir o, ka niriba tuhipii ʒiibu tuhipia ʒe o tooni. Ka saria karibu daa piligi, ka litaafinim bɔɣi doya.
en: A river of fire flowed out from in front of the Ancient King. Millions of people were serving him. Hundreds of millions of people stood in front of him. Court was ready to begin, and the books were opened.

dag: M pun nya jɛra ni maani bɛ biɛhigu shee, amaa ka n yɛli noli niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee maa libigi ba.
en: Ive seen the foolish take root and promptly curse their house.

dag: Ka ŋun maligumaana Ɛliɛza zaŋ o nubil tim o ʒim ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la tooni polo siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: Eleazar the priest will take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle it seven times in front of the meeting tent.

dag: Nia shɛŋa din be ninsal suhu ni ŋmanila kɔbil zilinli puuni kom, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi ŋɔŋ di kom maa.
en: Getting information from someone can be like getting water from a deep well. If you are smart, you will draw it out.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.

dag: Chibimi gooni voli bɛ ninni n-kahi a nɛma doli nimaani yi.
en: While they watch, dig a hole through the wall and take your backpack out through it.

dag: Amaa dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ piɛɣu, dindina ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi na ti ti Yawɛ o ni tum taal shɛli maa zuɣu. Ka yino ti nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ so nyo buɣim mali sara.
en: If you cannot afford a sheep or a goat, you shall bring to the Lord as the payment for your sin two doves or two pigeons, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa na mi n-wum wuni kukoli ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa buɣim ni kaman yi ni daa wum shɛm maa, ka be?.
en: Has any people ever listened to a gods voice speaking out of fire, as each of you have, and survived?.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan kɔri binyɛra mali alizinnim bɛn ŋmani buhi la, bɛ ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋa shɛb sani la. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn nyɛla zaligu bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: In this way you will stop being unfaithful to me by offering sacrifices to your goat gods. This law will continue forever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi ba lala hal ti yaɣi Bɛtavɛn. Ka Yawɛ daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi dindali maa.
en: The LORD saved Israel that day, and the fighting carried on beyond Beth-aven.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, di kul pɔnya gba. Di pɔ alizanda, dama di nyɛla Naawuni nam ʒiishee.
en: But now I tell you: do not use any vow when you make a promise. Do not swear by heaven, for it is God's throne;.

dag: Ka jɛmbu du palli ŋɔ jilima ni gari jɛmbu du kurili la jilima, ka ni chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ kpe; man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This house will be more glorious than its predecessor, says the LORD of heavenly forces. I will provide prosperity in this place, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ti nyɛla jɛra Masia zuɣu, amaa ka yinima nyɛ yɛnnim Masia puuni. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima, amaa ka yinima nyɛ kpiɔŋlaannima. Yi nyɛla bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima, amaa ka tinim nyɛ bɛ ni ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: We are fools for Christ, but you are wise through Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, but we are dishonored!.

dag: ka yɛra, Na so ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Suhudoo be alizanda ni! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: God bless the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to God.

dag: Ka kɔŋlan so daa ka Yisa sanna nti damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, A yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: A man with leprosy came to Jesus and knelt down. He begged, You have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.

dag: Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di niŋ zina, a nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zina? Nyin ŋun je buɣa, a nyɛla ŋun zuri buɣa jɛmbu duu nɛma?.
en: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.

dag: N naɣ mali yɛm yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisirila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ba n-zani, amaa di pala ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛm bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim bɛn ni ti vuui ŋɔ yɛm.
en: What we say is wisdom to people who are mature. It isnt a wisdom that comes from the present day or from todays leaders who are being reduced to nothing.

dag: Din kariya, ka n yɛli ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli. Ka pa ni n kpimi, n kul ku bahi n nimmaŋtali maa.
en: I will not agree that you are right. Until my dying day, I wont give up my integrity.

dag: Din bi tuhi tumbu zaa nyɛla alahichi, amaa alahichi shɛŋa tumbu beni m-pala din tahiri nir kum ni.
en: All wrongdoing is sin, but there is sin which does not lead to death.

dag: Izraɛl paɣ kam ni ti chaŋ o ʒiʒiinikpee sani bee o mini saan so ŋun laɣim be sani nti suh o anzinfa mini salima nɛma ni situra, ka yi zaŋ li niŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi zaa din ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ Ijiptinim maa daazichi pam chaŋ.
en: Every woman will ask her neighbor along with the immigrant in her household for their silver and their gold jewelry as well as their clothing. Then you will put it on your sons and daughters, and you will rob the Egyptians.

dag: M mabiyurisi, ti ni mal alikaulinim ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti paɣ ti nuhi n-yi dinkam nyɛ din ni ta nir niŋgbuŋ min o shia daɣiri ni, ka chɛliya ka biɛrikasitali niŋ dɛde ti Naawuni zɔbu puuni.
en: My dear friends, since we have these promises, lets cleanse ourselves from anything that contaminates our body or spirit so that we make our holiness complete in the fear of God.

dag: . O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa. Ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka boli ba ninsalinima saha shɛl o ni daa nam ba maa.
en: He created them male and female. And on the same day he made them, he blessed them and called them humans.

dag: Ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li? Bɛ daa zɔrila niriba, dama sokam zaa daa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But we cant say that Johns baptism was from someone else.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa bɔhi, O yɛn kula omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka o yɛli ni o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ti ku tooi ka nimaani na maa.
en: The Jewish leaders said, He isnt going to kill himself, is he? Is that why he said, Where Im going, you cant come.

dag: Ka duɣuri mini lahi din zaa ʒe zaɣiyari ka binshɛli bi pil li, di gba ni leei din bi be nyam.
en: Any open jar in the tent is unclean.

dag: Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim ni so daa ʒi yɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama bɛ yi di daa mi li, bɛ daa naan ku kpahi ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ jilimalan la tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyamiya, n yoola dunoli n-tin ya, ka so ku tooi daa li yo. M mi ni yi yiko bi yaɣ lala, amaa di zaa yoli yi kul gbibi n yɛligu ka bi chihi n yuli.
en: I know your works. Look! I have set in front of you an open door that no one can shut. You have so little power, and yet you have kept my word and havent denied my name.

dag: Yisa daa lola noli biɛɣ pihinahi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: After Jesus had gone without eating for days and nights, he was very hungry.

dag: Ŋun yɛn fa ba bahi maa nyɛla kpiɔŋlana. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni lihi bɛ yɛlli maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka o ti dunianim vuhim, amaa o ku ti Babilɔnnim bɛn vuhim.
en: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, will rescue and protect them. I will bring peace to their land and trouble to yours.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka sa kura mini sakuɣa lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni ti lan chɛ ka buɣim mini chilibi lu o min o tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ shɛb bɛn be o sani zuɣu.
en: I will punish Gog with diseases and death. I will cause hailstones, fire, and sulfur to rain down on Gog and his groups of soldiers from many nations.

dag: Dunia ni ti zaɣi n-kuui zaa; ka sagbana mini dunia zaa zaɣi.
en: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.

dag: Yisa mini Pita ni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa ti paai Yisa nyaandol bɛn la sani nya ka salo pam n-laɣim gil ba, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib ŋmɛr o nyaandoliba maa naŋgbankpeeni.
en: When Jesus and his three disciples came back down, they saw a large crowd around the other disciples. The teachers of the Law of Moses were arguing with them.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha, ka Asa bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di Juda nam.
en: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became the king of Judah in Ahabs fourth year as king of Israel.

dag: Bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisiya, bɛ bi lan garigi shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli.
en: Job, these men lost the argument. They dont have anything more to say. They dont have any more answers.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli maa paai ma, ka tiligi ma kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: LORD, let your faithful love come to me— let your salvation come to me according to your promise.

dag: Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia ŋɔ kpɛmmi ʒiɛya, ka kul ku vuui. O ni doli zaligu soli kari niriba saria.
en: Announce to the nations, The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka o laɣis o kpamba min o sapashinnima ni Galili ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa na ni bɛ ti puhi di chuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Hɛrɔdias katari.
en: Finally, the time was right. It was on one of Herods birthdays, when he had prepared a feast for his high-ranking officials and military officers and Galilees leading residents.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Uzia bia Jɔtam mi daa di Juda nam.
en: In the second year of the reign of Pekah son of Remaliah as king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah became king of Judah.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan kani ŋun bi kana kpe ka nyɛ ti n-ni bɔhi so baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord 's prophets we can ask.

dag: Dama yɛm so salima nɛma, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa buɣisi yɛm.
en: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.

dag: Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Ziɔn ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya sɔŋ la, yɛlimaŋli, bɛn nyɛ bɛn kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm la, bɛ ni boli ba bɛn be kasi.
en: Whoever remains in Zion and is left in Jerusalem will be called holy, everyone who is on the list of those living in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka do so yi ti zahim zahindi yuŋ mahig omaŋa, dindina ŋun yim sansani maa ni, ka di lan kpe sansani maa ni na.
en: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there.

dag: Tol la ni daa ŋubi binshɛŋa zaa la, n ni labisi li tin ya kaman di yuma kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm; dama mani n daa tim toli bɛn daa yiɣira mini bɛn daa saɣinda ni bɛn daa ŋmahiri la na. Bɛ daa nyɛla n tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa, ka n tim ba yi sanna.
en: I will repay you for the years that the cutting locust, the swarming locust, the hopping locust, and the devouring locust have eaten— my great army, which I sent against you.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari. Lɛvi daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Levi lived to be ; his sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ bɔhim baŋ shɛli, amaa ka lee ku tooi baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: women who are always trying to learn but who can never come to know the truth.

dag: Toondaannim bɛn tumdi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga simdi ni niriba lihiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga, di bahi bamdi bɛn tumdi waazu yihibu mini wuhibu tuma la.
en: The elders who do good work as leaders should be considered worthy of receiving double pay, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi kana ti lihi yili maa, ka dɔro maa bi lan yɛligi pahi yili maa ni bɛ ni lab ta li maa nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun wuhimi ni yili maa nyɛla din ka daɣiri ni, dama dɔro maa naaya.
en: After new stones and plaster are put in a house, the priest must check the house. If the mildew has not spread through the house, the priest will announce that the house is clean, because the mildew is gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Labimiya n sanna, ka n gba lab yi sanna.
en: but now I say to you, Return to me, and I will return to you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa na ni bɛ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then Moses brought the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons put their hands on the rams head.

dag: Naawuni yiko ni o daa tɔɣisi luhi Yɛhudianima niriba ni, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni Kundi n-kahigiri wuhiri niriba ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Masia.
en: He argued very strongly against the Jews before all the people. He clearly proved that the Jews were wrong. He used the Scriptures and showed that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: O nyaya ka nimaani vuhim shee viɛla, ka di tiŋgbani biɛhigu mali kɔre. Dinzuɣu ka o deei talahi n-tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: But he sees that the resting place is good And that the land is delightful. So he bends his back to carry the load And is forced to work as a slave.

dag: N ni guli tiŋ ŋɔ ka tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu.
en: I will protect it for the sake of my own honor and because of the promise I made to my servant David.

dag: Man kul chɛmi ka n suhu be kasi yoli, ka paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali yoli.
en: Is it for nothing, then, that I have kept myself pure and have not committed sin?.

dag: Ka o daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o suhu saɣim pam, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: But when the man heard Jesus tell him to give away his money, he was sad. He didnt want to do this, because he was very rich.

dag: Bɛ daa lan sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba yɛla n-niŋ nanim yɛlikura litaafinim ni hal ti paai Ɛliashib bia Jɔhanan saha la.
en: The heads of the Levite families, however, were recorded in the official records only until the time of Jonathan, the grandson of Eliashib.

dag: ka zaŋ manna shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ʒi n-dihi ya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni o chɛ ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zahim ya, ka niŋ ya din viɛla di bahigu ni.
en: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.

dag: ka Maligumaana maa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi bee kawana sara la sara maligu bimbini la zuɣu. Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ mali taali ni yibu sanyoo sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa, ka o yi daɣiri ni.
en: He will then offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. In this way the priest will make that person pure, and that person will become clean.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnima ka bi diri tiɣiri la. Zuɣulaannim ŋɔ gba ka baŋsim. Bɛ zaa dolila bɛ suhuyubu soli, ka kul niŋdila din ni sɔŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko.
en: But the dogs have monstrous appetites. They never have enough. They are shepherds who dont understand. All of them have turned to their own ways, every last one greedy for profit.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛlnim daa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-chaŋ ti dɔni Giligal din daa be Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la.
en: The people crossed the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month and camped at Gilgal, east of Jericho.

dag: Di saha ka Pool min o tab la daa kpe ŋariŋ yiɣisi Pafɔs n-chaŋ Pɛɛga Pamfilia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Jɔn Maak daa ti zani nimaani ŋ-ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ka chɛ ba.
en: Paul and his companions sailed from Paphos to Perga in Pamphylia. John deserted them there and returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa zoli nyɛla din luri wurinda, ka tampiŋ vuɣiri di dooshee.
en: Mountains fall and crumble away. Large rocks break loose and fall.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab daa bɔhi Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat, A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka o garigi yɛl o, M bela a polo ka n niriba nyɛ a niriba, ti ni pah a zuɣu chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead? Israels King Ahab asked Judahs King Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat replied, I and my people will be united with you and your people in battle.

dag: ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda ku me n-tamla ninsalinim yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ni me n-tamla Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: I did this so that your faith might not depend on the wisdom of people but on the power of God.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, bimmɔriŋ piɛlli yi be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu din chɛ ka nimaani kɔbiri leei zaɣ piɛla ka mari na be bimmɔriŋ maa ni.
en: He must look at that person. If there is a white swelling on the skin, if the hair has become white, and if the skin looks raw in the swelling.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni ka Pool ti kpaŋsiri yɛdaniŋdiba suhuri.
en: Paul and Silas went through the countries of Syria and Cilicia, helping the churches grow stronger.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N tum tuma pam, amaa ka di ka nyɔri. N yihi n yaa tum, amaa ka shɛli bi yi di ni na. Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyaanzaana, ka n laara be n Naawuni sani.
en: I said to myself, I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti naai, n ni darigi Babilɔn naa maa min o niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tibili, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa kpalim zani dabari sahakam.
en: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.

dag: Ka Sool bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka kukoli maa yɛli, Man Yisa ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: Who are you? Saul asked. I am Jesus, the Lord answered. I am the one you are so cruel to.

dag: O daa ku na shɛb bɛn yuya du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.

dag: ni Gɛra ni Shɛfufan ni Huram.
en: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛra vinvamli ni.
en: So Isaac left that place and camped near the little river of Gerar. He stayed there and lived.

dag: ka bɛ ti yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa hal ka so ti ku lan nya tiŋgbani gba. Ka bɛ ti bahi ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa chɛ bindir shɛŋa zali ya la mini yi tihi din be mɔɣu ni.
en: that you won't be able to see the ground. Most of your crops were ruined by the hailstones, but these locusts will destroy what little is left, including the trees.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba na kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛri mini piɛlahi ni buhi tahiri nakɔha sani shɛm la.
en: I will take them to be slaughtered, like lambs, goats, and rams. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛl; di nyɛla Yaakubu Naawuni zaligu.
en: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi Naawuni kaman Naawuni maa zuɣu ka o chɛ ba bahi, ka bɛ tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri ka tumdi din chihiri tumbu.
en: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.

dag: N ni bɔhim so shɛli din ka galimi yɛla. Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn ka n sanna? N ni mali biɛhigu din viɛla n suhu ni n yiŋa.
en: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.

dag: A zaɣis a ni daa lo a dabili alikauli shɛl la; ka zaŋ o nam zuɣupiligu bahi tiŋa.
en: Youve canceled the covenant with your servant. Youve thrown his crown in the dirt.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn mali yɛm ŋɔ, wummiya: Din kariya ka Naawuni tum tuumbiɛri! Din kariya ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa tum taali!.
en: Therefore, intelligent ones, hear me; far be it from God to do evil and the Almighty to sin.

dag: Ka o dii ŋmaligi zo n-lab Naa maa sani ti yɛl o, M bɔri ni a zaŋla Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu niŋ pɔŋ ni ti ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The girl hurried back and told Herod, Here and now on a serving plate I want the head of John the Baptist.

dag: O yee daa kpɛm pam ka o bi zɔri vi. O daa bi ʒiini yiŋa.
en: She is noisy and defiant; her feet dont stay long in her own house.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa ti bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate questioned him, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus replied, Thats what you say.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: All of the temple servants and the descendants of Solomons servants totaled .

dag: N dan naa, niriba maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ anab Jɛrimia polo maa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ zaŋ o niŋla kɔbiliga ni ni kum ku o, dama bindirigu lan ka tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Ebedmelech said, Your Majesty, Jeremiah is a prophet, and those men were wrong to throw him into a well. And when Jerusalem runs out of food, Jeremiah will starve to death down there.

dag: Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil mabia la bidibisi m-bɔŋɔ: Masha ŋun daa nyɛ Zif ba la n-daa nyɛ o bituuli. Marɛsha bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Hiburɔn.
en: Caleb was Jerahmeels brother. Caleb had some sons. His first son was Mesha. Mesha was Ziphs father. There was also Calebs son Mareshah. Mareshah was the father of Hebron.

dag: O baŋsim puuni ka teeku daa yina, ka o daa chɛ ka saa yiri sagbana ni lurina.
en: With his knowledge, the watery depths burst open, and the skies drop dew.

dag: Paɣiba pam tum din viɛla, amaa nyini n-gari bɛ zaa.
en: He says, Many women are good wives, but you are the best of them all.

dag: Adam ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ŋman o m-bol o yuli Sɛt.
en: When Adam was years old, he became the father of a son in his image, resembling him, and named him Seth.

dag: Bɛ chɛ soli din tuhi ka birigi; bɛ dolila Bɛɔr bia Anabi Balaam ŋun daa tum din bi tuhi liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la naba.
en: They have left the straight path and have lost their way; they have followed the path taken by Balaam son of Beor, who loved the money he would get for doing wrong.

dag: Naawuni daanfaani maa zuɣu ka yi tiligi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Ka di bi yila yi kɔbili ni na, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: For it is by God's grace that you have been saved through faith. It is not the result of your own efforts, but God's gift, so that no one can boast about it.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Nan bia Jɔshua zali ka yɛl o, Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, n ni be a sani.
en: Then the Lord commissioned Joshua, Nuns son: Be strong and fearless because you are the one who will bring the Israelites to the land I swore to them. I myself will be with you.

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Akan.
en: Ezer was the ancestor of the clans of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni tam n yɛla, ka zaŋ ma niŋ a baɣaka zuɣu, dim a pagɔrisigu min a kɔre tuma maa nyɔri.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD said: Jerusalem, you forgot me. You threw me away and left me behind. So now you must suffer for leaving me and living like a prostitute. You must suffer for your wicked dreams.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli wuntia soli, ka tɔɣisiri din tuhi, ka bi zaŋdi bɛ kpiɔŋ fari niriba, ka bi diri birapu, ka je ni bɛ wum ninvuɣ kubo yɛla, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nina ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu;.
en: You can survive if you say and do what is right. Don't use your power to cheat the poor and don't accept bribes. Don't join with those who plan to commit murder or to do other evil things.

dag: Ka Hɛli daa nyɛ Matat bia, ka Matat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi nyɛ Mɛlikai bia, ka Mɛlikai nyɛ Jannai bia, ka Jannai mi nyɛ Yisifu so bia.
en: Eli was the son of Matthat. Matthat was the son of Levi. Levi was the son of Melchi. Melchi was the son of Jannai. Jannai was the son of Joseph.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi mali buɣa n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim, ka tumdi bukpahigu tuma, ka buɣiri baɣisi, ka saɣim bɛmaŋa n-tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They used magic and witchcraft to try to learn the future. They sold themselves to do what the Lord said was evil. They did this to make him angry.

dag: N yi di yu alahichi n suhu ni, n Duuma naan ku deei n suhigu.
en: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.

dag: M biyurisi, di niŋya ŋunkam yɛli ni o mali Naawuni Shia yɛda, amaa buɣisimiya ba nya bɛ ni mali shi so maa yila Naawuni sanna; dama anab ʒirinim pam yiɣisiya m-be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Dear friends, dont believe every spirit. Test the spirits to see if they are from God because many false prophets have gone into the world.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka kpaŋsir o bɔɣiri n-tumdi kpiɔŋ tuma.
en: She is a hard worker, strong and industrious.

dag: Yi yi ni doli n ni zaŋ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o soya zaa, ka zaŋ yimaŋ ti o.
en: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants.

dag: O ni tooi sɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari zahimbu pumpɔŋɔ, dama omaŋmaŋ daa nya zahimbu ka di wahala.
en: And now he can help those who are tempted. He is able to help because he himself suffered and was tempted.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tuui labina ti ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-daa nyɛ: Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba.
en: The first to return to their property in the cities included Israelite citizens, priests, Levites, and Temple workers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lɔri nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo Jɛrusalɛm, o daa zo n-kulila Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chɛ ka shɛb kar o naba Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: Some people in Jerusalem plotted against him. When Amaziah fled to Lachish, they sent men after him to Lachish, and they murdered him there.

dag: Yi birila ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka kpuɣi atam din bi doli yɛlimaŋli. Yi dila ʒiri tiwala. Yi ni niŋ yi chɛchɛbunsi mini yi tɔbbihi bɛn galisi ŋɔ naani la zuɣu.
en: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.

dag: Kɔra, a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: So Korah, you and all your followers should do this:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lo ti alikauli Sinai zoli gbini.
en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Mount Horeb.

dag: Yi nyuri bari yɛra, Ti nyɛla tiŋ kasi la tiŋbihi, ka zaŋ timaŋ dalim Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Bɛ zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita shɛli Izraɛlnim shɛb ni daa zal o daa shɛm la.
en: So the words of the prophet Jeremiah came true, They took the thirty silver coins, the price of a person among the people of Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nini tiɣi bɛmaŋ kasitali, amaa ka lee bi yi bɛ daɣiri ni.
en: There are those who think they are clean, but havent washed off their own excrement.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ŋubirila binkpima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka kuri niriba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa?.
en: You must tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: You eat meat with the blood still in it. You look to your idols for help. You murder people, so why should I give you this land?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Judas ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri. Ka o daa piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: They were pleased to hear what he had to say, and promised to give him money. So Judas started looking for a good chance to hand Jesus over to them.

dag: Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote this law for us: If a man dies and leaves a wife but no children, that man's brother must marry the widow so that they can have children who will be considered the dead man's children.

dag: Niŋm man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim; ka tiligi ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.

dag: Ka Judas daa bɔh o, N Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka a ni kahig amaŋ wuhi ti, ka ku kahig amaŋ wuhi dunianim bɛna.
en: Judas said, Lord, how can it be that you will reveal yourself to us and not to the world.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛl o, Biɛɣu neera, chɛ ka n chaŋ. Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N ku chɛ ka a chaŋ, faashee ka a niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: The man said, Let me go; daylight is coming. I won't, unless you bless me, Jacob answered.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi mini teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather.

dag: Naawuni daa ti tim tuun so ŋun yuli booni Jɔn na.
en: God sent a man named John.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ anzinfa duhi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka zaŋ situra duhi kaman yaɣiri maa zaa yoli.
en: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa tim ti boli Jɛrimia ka o kana Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoli din pahir ata la gbini. Ka naa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N yɛn bɔh a la yɛtɔɣ shɛli, a mi di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: King Zedekiah ordered that the prophet Jeremiah be brought to him at the third entrance of the LORDs temple, where the king said to Jeremiah, I want to ask you something, and dont hide anything from me.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali buɣilimbuɣilimbihi n-zaŋ li yiliyili pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi din daa be alichɛbba maa tiŋli la sunsuuni ti tuui ka di daa be pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi maa sunsuuni.
en: Then they made bells from pure gold. They hung these bells around the bottom edge of the robe between the pomegranates.

dag: Di saha maa ka gadama daa piligi Ɛfɛsus Yisa soli dolibu zuɣu.
en: But during that time there was some trouble in Ephesus about the Way. This is how it all happened:.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla din chɛ ka nir lara, amaa suhugarigu nyɛla din chɛ ka nandahima mali nira.
en: When people are happy, they smile, but when they are sad, they look depressed.

dag: Yi daalahichi zaɣisibu moli mɔbu puuni bɛ na bi yihi yi ni so ʒim ku o.
en: For in your struggle against sin you have not yet had to resist to the point of being killed.

dag: o yi bi diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛmdi Izraɛlnim buɣa, ka mi bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni bee m-bo paɣ so ŋun nya puuni ka di na bi naai.
en: He doesn't worship the idols of the Israelites or eat the sacrifices offered at forbidden shrines. He doesn't seduce another man's wife or have intercourse with a woman during her period.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo, bɛ daa piila Bɛza din be Rubin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la mini Ramɔt din be Giliad Gaad zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la ni Golan din be Bashan Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: Bezer, east of the Jordan River across from Jericho, in the desert area in the land of Reuben; Ramoth in Gilead in the land of Gad; and Golan in Bashan in the land of Manasseh.

dag: M bihi, miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa!.
en: Children, you must stay away from idols.

dag: N nintam kul zɔrimi, niriba ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: Rivers of tears stream from my eyes because your Instruction isnt being kept.

dag: Hɛman mini Jɛdutun n-daa nyɛ bɛn piɛbiri kikahi ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ni biŋkumdi shɛŋa din pahi n-yiini yila din be kasi la. Ka bɛ daa pii Jɛdutun bidibisi n-leei dunɔguliba.
en: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam ŋahiri ŋaha, ni ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛli, Ma ni be shɛm lala ka o bipuɣiŋga gba be.
en: All the people who talk about you will now have one more thing to say. They will say, Like mother, like daughter.

dag: N daa yɛli bɛ bihi tiŋgban nɛli maa ni, Miriya ka yi doli yi banim zaligunim la bee n-gbibi bɛ kaya la bee n-zaŋ bɛ buɣa la jɛmbu saɣim yimaŋa.
en: So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols.

dag: M mali Ofiri salima din gari tɔn kɔbiga mini anzinfa din nyɛ alali tɔn kɔbisiyi ni pihinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li dooi pa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dukpina zuɣu.
en: More than tons of my finest gold and almost tons of my silver will be used to decorate its walls.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika maa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔri ni n wuh a n yuli? Dama n yuli maa nyɛla alahiziba yuli.
en: The angel asked, Why do you want to know my name? It is a name of wonder.

dag: Amaa zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: But Tyre and Sidon will be better off at the judgment than you.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim daa bi niŋ yɛda bee dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ so ti niŋ yɛda ni dimnim ni tooi kpe Jɛrusalɛm puuni.
en: The kings of the earth could not believe what had happened. The people of the world could not believe what had happened. They could not believe that enemies would be able to come through the city gates of Jerusalem.

dag: Di moliya di yɛla gili Gaat fɔŋ ni; yi mi di moliya di yɛla doli Ashikɛlɔn solɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Filistia bipuɣinsi yiɣi jam, bee n-chɛ ka bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣinsi suhuri paligi.
en: Dont tell the news in Gath. Dont announce it in the streets of Ashkelon. Those Philistine cities would be happy! Those foreigners would be glad.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu maa ni daa ʒiɛri tuhi ŋariŋ maa, ka di ku tooi lan kpa ti ni bɔri ni di doli shɛli polo zuɣu ka ti daa chɛ li ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri li chana.
en: It hit the ship, and since it was impossible to keep the ship headed into the wind, we gave up trying and let it be carried along by the wind.

dag: N yi di bɔra, n naan tooi mali tahima bina lala tatabo ni. Ka so yi tɛhi ni o ni tooi mali tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni, m mali daliri ni n niŋ lala gar o.
en: Even if I am able to trust in myself, still I dont do it. If anyone else thinks they have a reason to trust in themselves, they should know that I have a greater reason for doing so.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa ti sɔɣi Sool ba Kish siliga ni Zɛla Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni, ka daa niŋ naa ni daa zali ni bɛ niŋm shɛlikam zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa naanyi deei bɛ suhigu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then they buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan in the grave of Saul's father Kish, in Zela in the territory of Benjamin, doing all that the king had commanded. And after that, God answered their prayers for the country.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo a dabili Dauda alikauli shɛli maa niŋ pali.
en: So now, LORD God of Israel, may your promise to your servant David come true.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa ʒini.
en: They did so, and everyone was seated.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka o daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa ka dunianim ti bi baŋ o.
en: The light was in the world, and the world came into being through the light, but the world didnt recognize the light.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma dabisili kam.
en: And he said to them all, If you want to come with me, you must forget yourself, take up your cross every day, and follow me.

dag: Dama n zuɣu ka a ni nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka a nyɛvili yuma pahi.
en: Through me your days will be many; years will be added to your life.

dag: ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni so sani yi ni tim ma ni n ti zaŋ yi fabila sɔŋ o tooni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: I said to them, The Lord , the God of Israel, to whom you sent me with your request has said.

dag: Di ni daa biɛmbe zaŋ chaŋ di yuma ayi bahigu ni ka o dɔro maa daa ti chɛ ka o nyɔri yina, ka o daa nya biɛrim pam hal ti kpi. O ni daa kpi, o niriba daa bi mali buɣim n-ti o jilima kaman bɛ ni daa mali buɣim ti o yaannim jilima shɛm la.
en: For almost two years he grew steadily worse, until two days before his death, when his intestines fell out, causing him to die in horrible pain. His people didnt make a fire in his honor as they had done for his ancestors.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ piɛbiri piɛla yila kikahi maa ka di kumdi yuui, yinim bɛn nyɛ tɔbbihi maa zaa yin duhimi yi yee n-kul tahiri pampam, di saha tiŋ maa goondaa maa ni kab lu, ka yi zaa kab ti kpe di ni.
en: Then they are to sound one long note. As soon as you hear it, all the people are to give a loud shout, and the city walls will collapse. Then the whole army will go straight into the city.

dag: Sidɔnnim mini Arivadnim n-daa nyɛ a kpatoonsi. Ka Zɛmɛr yɛnnim nyɛ a ŋariŋ duhiriba.
en: Your oarsmen were from the cities of Sidon and Arvad. Your own skillful men were the sailors.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ba tin ya, ka yi niŋ ba kaman n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm.
en: The Lord will give you victory over them, and you are to treat them exactly as I have told you.

dag: O yi ti zaŋ o paai yiŋa, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya m piɛ so ŋun daa bɔrigi la.
en: home, go to your friends and neighbors and say to them, Be happy with me because I found my lost sheep.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ bar so ŋun gbaya zaa kpi n-niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o kana ti bɔri soli ni bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: Some men were bringing a man who was paralyzed, lying on a cot. They wanted to carry him in and place him before Jesus.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ti ni ti yihim waazu ti niriba, ka wuhi ba ni ŋuna ka Naawuni zaŋ leei nyɛvilinim mini kpiimba zaa sariakarita.
en: Jesus told us to go and speak to the people. He told us to tell them that he is the one God chose to be the Judge of all who are living and all who have died.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o sani ka bɛ bɔri bindirigu la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered, You have read what David did when he and the people with him were hungry and needed food.

dag: Dindina yi ni shɛb ni bɔhi ma, Ka di yi nyɛ lala, di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni na kul nyari ninsalinim taali? Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu Naawuni yubu soli ka di ku niŋ.
en: So you are going to say to me, Then why does he still blame people? Who has ever resisted his will.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔn naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum Jɛfita ni tim na ti yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: But the Ammonite king refused to listen to the message that Jephthah sent to him.

dag: O nam dariza bi mali ya dabiɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ya o zuɣu?.
en: and his power will fill you with terror.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai bua n-kɔrigi zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu tim bua maa ʒim ni.
en: Joseph's brothers killed a goat and dipped Joseph's fancy coat in its blood.

dag: Famiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba bahi; tiligimiya ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.

dag: Yuŋ zahima yɛla tɛhibu puuni, saha shɛli niriba ni gbihi maai la.
en: In profound thoughts, visions of night, when deep sleep falls on people.

dag: ka o daa yɛli Yaakubu, Niŋm a ʒiɛri din mɔhi ŋɔ ti ma ka m piɛbi, dama kum wum ma pam. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o Ɛdom.
en: and said to Jacob, Im starving! Let me devour some of this red stuff. Thats why his name is Edom.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who dont have a problem accepting me.

dag: O ni ti liri nuzaa polɔnima, ka wurim Asiria. O ni ti chɛ ka Ninive kpalim dabari n kuui doya kaman tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.

dag: Dapaɣili kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Each board was fifteen feet long and twenty-seven inches wide.

dag: Zom jɛrigu sani, dama a ku nya baŋsim yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: Stay away from fools, there is nothing they can teach you.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mal li ka di be kasi zaa, ka binshɛlikam din ti shihi li ni niŋ kasi.
en: Dedicate these things in this way, and they will be completely holy, and anyone or anything that touches them will be harmed by the power of its holiness.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa yɛli sapashin la min o tɔbbihi, Niriba ŋɔ yi yi ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni; yi ku tiligi.
en: But Paul told the army officer and the other soldiers, If these men do not stay in the ship, you will lose all hope of survival.

dag: Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ tim ninsal kam laara o wuntitali min o ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka man lee bi saɣi teegi n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi nyin ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord rewards those who are faithful and righteous. Today he put you in my power, but I did not harm you, whom the Lord made king.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa bahi, ka di yi n nuh ayi maa ni lu tiŋ ŋ-ŋma yi ninni.
en: So I took the two stone tablets and threw them down. There before your eyes I broke the stones into pieces.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi nayili pu shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Manasseh lay down with his ancestors. He was buried in his palace garden, the Uzza Garden. His son Amon succeeded him as king.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ ma, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni yu binshɛŋa ka Yawɛ je li maa bahi bee n-chɛ Ijiptinim buɣa la jɛmbu. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi ni n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But they turned against me and refused to listen to me. They did not throw away their horrible idols. They did not leave their filthy statues in Egypt. So I decided to destroy them in Egypt—to let them feel the full force of my anger.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔhi taba, So n-tahi bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di yɔɣɔ.
en: The disciples asked each other, Has someone brought him food.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Naawuni daa pola pɔri zal li.
en: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind.

dag: Binshɛɣukam bɛn be kom ni ka ka gɔhi mini paɣiri nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: Anything in the water that does not have fins or scales is detestable to you.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti biri bimbir shɛli gari yi wain tihi puu ni, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi ni biri binshɛli maa mini wain tihi maa wala zaa.
en: Dont plant your vineyards with two types of seed; otherwise, the entire crop that you have planted and the produce of the vineyard will be unusable.

dag: O ni deei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima suhigu, o ku zaɣisi bɛ suhigu.
en: He will listen to the prayers of those in poverty. He will not ignore them.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn daa bi kpalim ʒe bɛ zaashee, ka daa chɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee la, Naawuni zaŋ saha din ka bahigu zoligɔnim lo ba zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali din nyɛ dabisi titali dal la.
en: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.

dag: Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Iru mini Ɛla ni Naam; ka Ɛla mi bidibiga daa nyɛ Kɛnaz.
en: The family of Caleb, Jephunnehs son: Iru, Elah, and Naam. This was Kenazs family.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Ɛziɔngɛba maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Zin mɔɣu ni .
en: They marched from Ezion-geber and camped in the Zin desert .

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba nti kpari duu ni biɛɣ neei, dama di daa nyɛla zaawun yuŋ.
en: They seized Peter and John and put them in prison until the next day.

dag: Yawɛ daalibarika chɛ ka nir leeri bundana, ka o bi zaŋdi suhugarigu pahiri di zuɣu.
en: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa nyɛ ŋun daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnima, Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la.
en: Moses is the one who said to the people of Israel, God will send you a prophet, just as he sent me, and he will be one of your own people.

dag: O zuɣu ka yi niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neeg o kum ni ka ti o jilima la naani ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi tahima niŋbu zaa bela Naawuni ni.
en: You believe in God through Christ. God is the one who raised him from death and gave honor to him. So your faith and your hope are in God.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya yɛla: Hal Izraɛl yaansi ni galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni niriba bɛn kpalim biɛla kɔŋko n-ni tiligi;.
en: And Isaiah cries out about Israel: There are so many people of Israel, they are like the grains of sand by the sea. But only a few of them will be saved.

dag: a ti ku mali suhugarigu a ni daa ku so ka di ka daliri zuɣu bee amaŋmaŋ ni daa bɔhi biɛri zuɣu. N dana, ka Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a sani, nyin di ti tam mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: dont let this be a blot or burden on my masters conscience, that you shed blood needlessly or that my master took vengeance into his own hands. When the LORD has done good things for my master, please remember your servant.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o yila nimaani n-kpe fɔntin shɛli ni, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa ni bo gabisi yina nti vo tiŋ maa ti bahi zolɔŋni hal ka nir ti ku lan nya di kuɣibil nimaani gba.
en: If he retreats into a city, our people will all bring ropes and just pull the city into the valley below. Not a single stone will be left there on top of the hill.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: And you also said that whoever does not bow down and worship the gold idol will be thrown into a very hot furnace.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan boli niriba pam na ti yɛli ba, Yi zaa luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: Then Jesus called the crowd to him once more and said to them, Listen to me, all of you, and understand.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ takɔbi chaŋ ti lu Nɔb din daa nyɛ maligumaaniba tiŋ la nim zuɣu n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi ni biliɛri ni naɣilahi ni bunsi ni piɛri. O daa zaŋla takɔbi ku bɛ zaa.
en: Saul also had all the other inhabitants of Nob, the city of priests, put to death: men and women, children and babies, cattle, donkeys, and sheep—they were all killed.

dag: N niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka niriba bɛn be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo baŋ ni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka so bi lan pahi n zuɣu.
en: I am doing this so that everyone will know that I am the only God. From the east to the west, people will know that I am the Lord and that there is no other God.

dag: Ka yi ni ti no ninvuɣ biɛri maa sɔŋ tiŋa, dama bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tampiligim n-do yi naba ni dahin shɛli n yi ti tum n tuma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will crush the wicked; they will be like dust beneath the soles of your feet on the day that I am preparing, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Ti ni yɛn woligi tab ŋɔ, n suhiri Yawɛ ni o gul ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa lan boli nimaani yuli Mizipa.
en: Laban also said, May the Lord keep an eye on us while we are separated from each other. So the place was also named Mizpah.

dag: M mabihi, n suhu zaa yuya ni mmaŋmaŋ zuliya tiligi, ka n kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ba di zuɣu.
en: Brothers and sisters, my hearts desire is for Israels salvation. Thats my prayer to God for them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Wahu n-yɔhim ma ka n di li.
en: The Lord God then asked the woman, What have you done? The snake tricked me, she answered, and I ate some of that fruit.

dag: Lɛbanɔn sipirɛs mini sida tihi malila suhupiɛlli naa maa lubu maa zuɣu, ka yɛra, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni lu ŋɔ, so ku lan ŋma ti luhi yaha. .
en: The cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon rejoice over the fallen king, because there is no one to cut them down, now that he is gone!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul ku su tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ wuntizɔriba tiŋgbani, ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka wuntizɔriba maa tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: The wicked will not always rule over the land of the righteous; if they did, the righteous themselves might do evil.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, ti bi zabiri dunia ŋɔ zabili.
en: Although we live in the world, we dont fight our battles with human methods.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a ba Naawuni. Di zɔri dabiɛm ni a kuli Ijipti, dama n ni chɛ ka a daŋ niriba ti leei zuliya bɛn galisi pam.
en: Then God said, I am God, the God of your father. Dont be afraid to go to Egypt. In Egypt I will make you a great nation.

dag: Yɛl yini n-kul paari sokam zaa. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl biɛɣu din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Din pahi nyɛla, zaɣ biɛɣu n-kul pali sokam zaa suhu ni. Yinyari biɛhigu n-kul be bɛ suhuri ni bɛ biɛhigu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ kpi.
en: Of all the things that happen in this life, the worst thing is that all people end life the same way. But it is also very bad that people always think evil and foolish thoughts. And those thoughts lead to death.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni ka ti a nama, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi; ka a leei zuliya pam yaba.
en: God Almighty will bless you, make you fertile, and give you many descendants so that you will become a large group of peoples.

dag: Yumiya taba kaman mabi yinsi la, ka timiya tab jilima viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Love each other in a way that makes you feel close like brothers and sisters. And give each other more honor than you give yourself.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti o ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: Now I have given all your countries to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. He is my servant. I will make even the wild animals obey him.

dag: Bɛ maŋmaŋ niŋgbuna biɛrim kɔŋko n-naɣi mali ba, ka bɛ kuhiri bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.

dag: A ni ti zaŋla ninsal bindi mali buɣim n-she chi bɔrɔbɔro maa ŋ-ŋub li bɛ ninni.
en: Eat it like barley bread, and bake it on human excrement while they watch.

dag: Ka naa mini Judanim zaa ni Jɛrusalɛmnim ni maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni sokam zaa bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira ni tarimba zaa daa laɣim Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka Naa Jɔsia ti karim Naawuni kundi shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni la yɛtɔɣa zaa ka bɛ wum.
en: and together they went to the Temple, accompanied by the priests and the Levites and all the rest of the people, rich and poor alike. Before them all the king read aloud the whole book of the covenant, which had been found in the Temple.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pagɔra ayi daa ti kana ti gbani naa tooni.
en: One day two prostitutes came to Solomon and stood before the king.

dag: Ka yi mi ti lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Ka yi yi yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, o suhu sa ni yiɣisi bahi tinim Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu biɛɣuni.
en: Now you are turning your backs on the Lord again. If you don't stop rebelling against the Lord at once, he will be angry with the whole nation.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu, ka n suhu kul yu a zaligu.
en: How I long for your saving help, O Lord ! I find happiness in your law.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi naa ŋɔ ni gul o niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima. Bɛ ni ti tahiri tɔb gɔɣu ni kaman danyuriba la, ka ti yihi bɛ dimnim ʒim, ka di zɔri kaman sara maligu ʒim ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ laa ni n-kpaai pa bimbini zuɣu la.
en: The Lord Almighty will protect his people, and they will destroy their enemies. They will shout in battle like drunk men and will shed the blood of their enemies; it will flow like the blood of a sacrifice poured on the altar from a bowl.

dag: Ti Duuma, a kurimbuni ha yurilim maŋli din nyɛ a ni daa po a ʒiɛyimtali puuni n-yɛli Dauda shɛli yɛla la lee be ya?.
en: Where now are your loving acts from long ago, my Lord— the same ones you promised to David by your own faithfulness?.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ dimnim maa pam hal ti naai, ka bi lan nyari so, dama bɛ ni shɛb daa zomi ti kpe bɛ tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gil ni.
en: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.

dag: dama pagɔrili ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli, paɣ zinalan ŋmanila kɔbil muɣiliŋga.
en: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—.

dag: Do so ŋun daa kpaŋ maa daa bi mi ŋun chɛ ka o kpaŋ maa ni nyɛ so, dama salo daa galisiya nimaani, ka Yisa mi pun yi ni chaŋ o chandi.
en: But the man who had been healed did not know who it was. There were many people there, and Jesus had left.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla a dahalali niriba, ka nyɛ a ni daa teeg a bɔɣu ni yiko din galisi yihi shɛb na. .
en: But they are your people, Lord. They belong to you. You brought them out of Egypt with your great power and strength.

dag: mini Shɛlɛmia ni Neetan ni Adaya so.
en: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah.

dag: O ni tooi di o Naawuni bindir shɛli din nyɛ zaɣ kasi zaa la mini din nyɛ zaɣ kasi la.
en: He is from the family of priests, so he can eat the holy bread. He can also eat the very holy bread.

dag: n-yɛra, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: He said, I will give you the land of Canaan. It will be your very own.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli buŋ maa, A ni dihi ma vi zuɣu. N yi di gbibi takɔbi n nuu ni, n naan ku a pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Balaam said to the donkey, Because youve tormented me. If I had a sword in my hand, Id kill you now.

dag: N ni kar a saria kaman bɛ ni kariti paɣ shɛb bɛn tum zina ka ku niriba ka bɛ kariti ba saria shɛm la, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒil a ni suhuyiɣisili mini nyuli.
en: Then I will punish you. I will punish you as a murderer and a woman who committed the sin of adultery. You will be punished as if by an angry and jealous husband.

dag: Buɣim niɛm mokpala n-yir o noli ni na n-tahiri yiɣiri ka buɣim yirina.
en: Burning torches come from his mouth. Sparks of fire shoot out.

dag: Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa yi bɛn na kpalim, ka tiligi yi niriba pam nyɛviya tin ya.
en: So God sent me here ahead of you so that I can save your people in this country.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kun ya, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi sɔŋ ya?.
en: I will destroy you, Israel; for you didnt realize that I could help you.

dag: N daa deei sɔŋsim cheechi shɛŋa ni n-ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ ya. Di bemi kaman n daa fa ba mi n-sɔŋ ya maa.
en: I accepted pay from other churches. I took their money so that I could serve you.

dag: n-zaŋ Hilikia pa, ka Tɛbalia daa pah ata, ka Zakaria pah anahi: Hɔsa mabihi min o bidibisi zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaata.
en: Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. In all there were thirteen members of Hosah's family who were Temple guards.

dag: Ŋuna n-gbaari yɛnnim bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina ni, ka yɛŋkiŋkabinanim ni lo nia shɛŋa zaani tariga yomyom.
en: He catches those who think they are wise in their own clever traps and brings to an end their evil plans.

dag: A daa pahi gili di zaashee ka di nyaɣa ba tiŋa, ka di zooi yɛligi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: You cleared the ground for it; then it planted its roots deep, filling the land.

dag: Yi zaa laɣimmiya na nti wum! Wun ŋuni n-lee pun yɛli dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla zali? Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so la ni niŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. O ni tuhi Babilɔnnim maa.
en: All of you, come here and listen to me. Did any of the false gods say these things would happen? No! The Lord s friend will do what he wants to Babylon and the Chaldeans.

dag: Binshɛŋa din be ashilɔni nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ dini, amaa binshɛŋa din yi zahira nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini sahakam ni di chɛ ka ti doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni.
en: There are some things that the Lord our God has kept secret. Only he knows these things. But he told us about some things. And these teachings are for us and our descendants forever. And we must obey all the commands in that law.

dag: Tiŋgbani daa bɔɣiya m-mum Datan, ka pi Abiram min o nyaandoliba.
en: The ground opened up and swallowed Dathan. Then the ground closed up and covered Abirams group.

dag: Di ni gu a ka chɛ pagɔrili, ka gu a ka chɛ paɣ zinalan naŋgbammalisim.
en: Wisdom will save you from that other woman, the other mans wife, who tempts you with such sweet words.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa yi nti mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: But they left and spread the news about Jesus all over that part of the country.

dag: Man kul chɛmi ka n suhu be kasi yoli, ka paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali yoli.
en: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?.

dag: Yawɛ nini ni tiɣi piɛlahi tusa shɛm mini kpam pam din be kaman mɔɣa tuhi pia kom la? N zaŋmi mmaŋmaŋ bituuli ŋun nyɛ n niŋgbuŋ nyɔri n-yo m biriginsim mini n daalahichi samli?.
en: Will the Lord be pleased with a thousand rams or with ten thousand rivers of oil? Should I offer him my first child to pay for my wrongs? Should I sacrifice my very own child for my sins?.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di kari Ayuba saria hal ti naai, dama o garigibu maa ŋmanila ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni garigiri yɛtɔɣa shɛm.
en: Think through everything that Job says; you will see that he talks like an evil man.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyuri bara, a nyɛla ŋun saɣindi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-dihiri ŋun Naawuni vi?.
en: If you brag about the Law, do you shame God by breaking the Law?.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim kari ninvuɣ biɛri zibisim bahi, ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ bɔɣu shɛli duhi zuɣusaa kabi.
en: Light is withheld from the wicked, the uplifted arm broken.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ti na kpalim ʒi kpe? Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa la ni nti kpi di ni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaliya ni ti ni kpi, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nti ti ni ti nyu, ti ni tum alahichi o sani zuɣu.
en: Why are we sitting here? Come, lets go to the fortified towns and meet our doom there. The LORD our God has doomed us by giving us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli Naawuni nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mi bi ʒiɛm so, o yɛm galisiya pam.
en: Look, God is mighty and doesnt reject anyone; he is mighty in strength and mind.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi; di chɛ ka n di vi. A wuntitali puuni, tiligim ma!.
en: Lord , I come to you for protection. Dont let me be disappointed. You always do what is right, so save me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka di yɛli Yawɛ tɔbu tuhibu Litaafi ni, Wahɛb fɔntiŋ din be Sufa bɔbili mini vinvama ni Arinɔn Mɔɣili.
en: That is why these words are written in the Book of the Wars of the Lord : ... and Waheb in Suphah, and the Valleys of the Arnon.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa gbibi Dauda biŋkumda la, ka maligumaaniba mi daa gbibi kikahi.
en: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.

dag: Ka n chaŋ hal ti paai teeku maa puuni zolɔna ni m-mal hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din dunoya nyɛ din yo n-kpari ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa, yaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, ka a yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli maa ni na ni nyɛvili.
en: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.

dag: Yili maa ni bihi mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa malila sala buɣim zali ʒiɛya wuɣisira, dama wari n-daa be; ka Pita gba daa ʒe bɛ sani n-wuɣisiri buɣim maa.
en: It was cold, so the servants and guards had built a fire. They were standing around it, warming themselves, and Peter was standing with them.

dag: Ɛhab bia Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun piniyini saha ka Ahazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year that Joram son of Ahab was king of Israel.

dag: Jɛfita daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayɔbu. Ka ŋun Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ya Giliad maa.
en: Jephthah led Israel for six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in one of the towns in Gilead.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa tu Naawuni maa yi bɛ sansani maa kpaŋa nti lab o kuɣa. Izraɛlnim maa daa tum Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: When Moses had said this to the people of Israel, they took the man outside the camp and stoned him to death. In this way the people of Israel did what the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: O lan ka kpe; o neei kum ni kaman o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kamiyana ti nya o ni daa do luɣ shɛli.
