en: He is not here; he has been raised, just as he said. Come here and see the place where he was lying.

dag: Ka kurim n-zaŋ o nubila n-lan sabiri tiŋa.
en: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lab ti Dauda suɣili din daa lu la zali. N ni ti mali di luɣ shɛŋa din daa saɣim la zaa, ka ti li zali ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la;.
en: The Lord says, A day is coming when I will restore the kingdom of David, which is like a house fallen into ruins. I will repair its walls and restore it. I will rebuild it and make it as it was long ago.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni di n-su shɛb kalinli ku mali tariga, amaa bɛn doli nyaaŋa na nini ku tiɣ o. Yɛlimaŋli dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: There may be no limit to the number of people a king rules; when he is gone, no one will be grateful for what he has done. It is useless. It is like chasing the wind.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ o sɔɣi, bɛ daa bi lan nya o, ka naɣ nyala o zuɣuŋmaŋ min o napɔnvari ni o nuchɛhi.
en: The men went to bury Jezebel, but they could not find her body. They could only find her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna suhu kpɛm pam; o zaɣisiya ni o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, The king is very stubborn and refuses to let the people go.

dag: O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba, ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku noli la yiŋa.
en: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.

dag: ni di chɛ ka cheechi maa viɛla, ka ka liɣisibu bee gurimbu, ka ni bela kasi ka ka galimi, ka o zaŋ li ti omaŋa.
en: He did this to present himself with a splendid church, one without any sort of stain or wrinkle on her clothes, but rather one that is holy and blameless.

dag: Zaŋ Aroa din be Arinɔn vinvamli tariga ni la hal ni fɔntin shɛli din be vinvamli maa ni la m-mali hal ni Giliad, tiŋ daa kani din goma du n-nyaŋ ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa ti ti.
en: The Lord our God let us capture all the towns from Aroer, on the edge of the Arnon Valley, and the city in the middle of that valley, all the way to Gilead. No town had walls too strong for us.

dag: Zuliya bɛn kpalim mi: Wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Bɛnjamin zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: South of this special section, each of the remaining tribes is to receive one section of land running from the eastern boundary west to the Mediterranean Sea, in the following order from north to south: Benjamin Simeon Issachar Zebulun Gad.

dag: O miri ka o ti yi luɣ kasi shee la n-saɣim o Naawuni luɣ kasi shee maa, dama o Naawuni kpa shɛli din be kasi ka bɛ boori li bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la nyɛla din be o zuɣu ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The high priest must not leave Gods holy place, because he might become unclean and then make Gods holy place unclean. The anointing oil was poured on the high priests head. This separated him from the rest of the people. I am the Lord .

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi; ka yi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni ŋɔ mi chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi.
en: Let the afflicted see it and be glad! You who seek God— let your hearts beat strong again.

dag: O daa pirigi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu buyi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He divided the Red Sea; his love is eternal;.

dag: Naawuni di saɣi ka n nyɛ sana m-be Mɛshɛk. O mi di saɣi ka m be Kɛdar suɣa ni.
en: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.

dag: Yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm tariga m-bala. Dabiɛm daa kpe man Daniɛl pam, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi, amaa ka n daa lee zaŋ yɛla maa niŋ n suhu ni.
en: And that was the end of the dream. I, Daniel, was very afraid. My face became very white from fear, and I did not tell the other people what I saw and heard.

dag: Ka Yisa gba daa ti yɛli do so, Doli ma! Ka dilan yɛli, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Jesus told someone else to come with him. But the man said, Lord, let me wait until I bury my father.

dag: nti zaŋ o leei naa ni o su Giliad mini Ashur ni Jɛziriil ni Ifriim ni Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: There Abner made Ishbosheth king of the territories of Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin, and indeed over all Israel.

dag: Miriya ka yi deeri birapu, dama birapu deebu zomdila niriba nina ka bɛ ŋariti bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: Dont take a bribe, because a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the cause of those who are in the right.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Yisahaku, Yiɣisim ti sani, dama a mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: Abimelech said to Isaac, Move away from us because you have become too powerful among us.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa niŋ Yisa saani pam o yiŋa, ka farigudeeriba pam mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa.
en: Then Levi gave a big dinner at his house for Jesus. At the table there were many tax collectors and some other people too.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o.
en: Acsah answered him, Give me a blessing. You gave me dry desert land in the Negev. Please give me some land with water on it. So Caleb gave her what she wanted. He gave her the upper and lower pools of water in that land.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee ko o wain tihi puu ka na bi di di wala? Dilan labimi kul o yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so di di nyaɣisim maa.
en: Is there any man here who has just planted a vineyard, but has not yet had the chance to harvest its grapes? If so, he is to go home. Otherwise, if he is killed in battle, someone else will enjoy the wine.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yi naa maa sani, zaŋ chaŋ o ti yɛn paai zɔn titali sunsuuni ka Yawɛ yɛl o.
en: Isaiah left the king, but before he had passed through the central courtyard of the palace the Lord told him.

dag: Adam daa bol o paɣ maa yul la Awa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninsalinim zaa ma.
en: The man named his wife Eve because she is the mother of everyone who lives.

dag: Kiriatijiarimnim mini Kɛfira ni Bɛrɔt niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaata.
en: from the towns of Kiriath Jearim, Kephirah, and Beeroth:.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha yuun shɛli din pahir ata ni, ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ilaija, Cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi Ɛhab, ka n chɛ ka saa mi dunia ni.
en: After many days, the LORDs word came to Elijah : Go! Appear before Ahab. I will then send rain on the earth.

dag: Bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu la gbariginsim puuni, amaa ka o lan be Naawuni yiko zuɣu. Ti gba nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima o ni, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo ti min o ni ti laɣim be Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: It is true that Christ was weak when he was killed on the cross, but he lives now by Gods power. It is also true that we share his weakness, but in dealing with you, we will be alive in him by Gods power.

dag: Ka o daa ti o niriba subu yiko mini jilima ni kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim tumdi tuma tir o. O yiko kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka o nam mi ku mali tariga.
en: He was given authority, honor, and royal power, so that the people of all nations, races, and languages would serve him. His authority would last forever, and his kingdom would never end.

dag: O ni ti zo n-dol o mamanima, amaa ka ku paai ba. O ni ti bo bɛ shee, amaa ka ku nya ba. Di saha o ni ti yɛli, N ni labi n yidaan taa la yiŋa; dama di daa so n zuɣu gari pumpɔŋɔ.
en: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.

dag: Kpihimmi alahichinim birili dunia ni, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: I wish sinners would disappear from the earth. I wish the wicked would be gone forever. My soul, praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti niŋ naani ka vu m-miri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ alibarikalan ŋɔ nam ʒiishee, ka di chɛ ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka ti nya alibarika din ni sɔŋ ti saha shɛli ti ni bɔri li.
en: Let us have confidence, then, and approach God's throne, where there is grace. There we will receive mercy and find grace to help us just when we need it.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba m-pa o buŋ nyaampara doli Mɔab kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: So the next morning Balaam saddled his donkey and went with the Moabite leaders.

dag: Ka piɛri maa zaa daa yi ti laɣim nimaani na, piɛguliba maa paarila kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu sɔŋ ka ŋɔŋ kom ti piɛri maa, ka lan labisi kuɣili maa pa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu.
en: Whenever all the flocks came together there, the shepherds would roll the stone back and water them. Then they would put the stone back in place.

dag: Tɔb daa yi ti lu Naa Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni saha shɛlikam, di saha Abinɛr nyarila yaa Sool niriba maa sani.
en: As the war went on between the families of David and Saul, Abner was gaining more power than ever in Saul's family.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di kari Ayuba saria hal ti naai, dama o garigibu maa ŋmanila ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni garigiri yɛtɔɣa shɛm.
en: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti o na ka o zaŋ o dɔni, Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa.
en: David sent messengers to go and bring Bathsheba to him. She had just purified herself after her monthly time of bleeding. She went to David, he had sexual relations with her, and then she went back to her house.

dag: N daa kul darigila yi niriba ŋɔ tibili yoli; bɛ daa bi deei saɣisigu. Yimaŋmaŋ takɔbiri ka yi daa zaŋ ku yi daanabinima kaman gbuɣinli ŋun kuri niriba.
en: I have disciplined your children in vain; they have rejected my correction. You have devoured your prophets like a hungry lion.

dag: Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa nyɛla bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni. Hal n jɛmbu duu puuni n nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Both prophet and priest are godless; I even find their evil in my temple, declares the LORD.

dag: Bɔhimiya Shɛkɛmnim zaa, yi lee yuya ni Gidiɔn bidibisi pisopɔin la zaa n-sun ya bee yi paɣiya ni o bidib yino n-sun ya? Teemiya ni n nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ni yi ʒim.
en: Ask all the leaders of Shechem, Which do you think is better to have ruling over you: seventy men—all of Jerubbaals sons—or one man? And remember that Im your flesh and blood.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka dabiɛm mali ba ka di gari ba pahi, ka bɛ daa ŋmanila tuturi mini mɔri ni mɔ shɛŋa din sa mɔpila zuɣu, ka mɔri dɔro gbaai li ka di kɔŋ zoobu.
en: Their citizens have lost their power. They are frightened and ashamed. Theyve become like plants in a field, tender green shoots, the grass on rooftops, burned up before it matures.

dag: Naawuni vuhim n-tahiri maasim na, nti chɛ ka ko titaŋa kilim.
en: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa doya hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o yiɣisi yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya, ka zɔr dabiɛm ni o yɛli Ɛli o ni nya ʒii shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Samuel lay down in bed until the morning came. He got up early and opened the doors of the Lord s house. Samuel was afraid to tell Eli about the vision.

dag: Ti ni daa zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihi tin ya la zuɣu ka Naawuni boli ya ni yi mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima.
en: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N na kul bɔri ni n yɛli n Duuma shɛli pahi. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pisi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pisi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Then Abraham said, I don't have any right to ask you, Lord , but what would you do if you find only ? Because of them, I won't destroy the city, was the Lord 's answer.

dag: Zaŋm daba ayopɔin mali alahichi sanyoo sara, sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini maa leei din be kasi zaa. Ka binshɛɣukam yi ti shihi sara maligu bimbini maa, di ni leei din be kasi.
en: Do this every day for seven days. Then the altar will be completely holy, and anyone or anything that touches it will be harmed by the power of its holiness.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Yaakubu je Liya maa, ka o ti Liya nama, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl nyɛ paɣiŋoo.
en: The Lord saw that Jacob loved Rachel more than Leah, so he made it possible for Leah to have children. But Rachel did not have any children.

dag: Amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n ni laɣim yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa na kaman piɛri bɛn yi mɔɣu ni na ni bɛ ti kpe buzɔŋ ni la. Niriba ni ti lan pali yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu ni be mɔri ŋubbu shee shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord , promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku tiŋgbani leei zaɣ kuŋ, ka o niriba daa chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu mɔɣili tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du. Ka ti daa mali suhupiɛlli o sani nimaani.
en: He changed the sea into dry land; our ancestors crossed the river on foot. There we rejoiced because of what he did.

dag: Dama ti bi mali baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zaa, ti mi bi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zaa;.
en: We know in part and we prophesy in part.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Dindina niŋmiya zim ti ma na. Ka o daa zaŋ zim maa yuɣisi ʒiɛri maa ni ka yɛli ba, Toomiya li ti niriba maa ka bɛ piɛbi. Ka barina shɛli daa lan ka di ni yaha.
en: Elisha asked for some meal, threw it into the pot, and said, Pour out some more stew for them. And then there was nothing wrong with it.

dag: Yawɛ, m bela muɣisigu pam ni ka kumdi niŋd a.
en: From the depths of my despair I call to you, Lord .

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi bi nyari soli din ni tooi ka yi sanna.
en: Thats why Ive been stopped so many times from coming to see you.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa niŋ pua, ka tim na ti yɛli Dauda ni o malila pua.
en: The woman conceived and sent word to David. Im pregnant, she said.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla a niriba, a mi ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla n niriba, ka n nyari jilima bɛ sani.
en: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine; and my glory is shown through them.

dag: Musa daa zali ti zaligu, ka di nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ni su shɛli.
en: Moses gave the Instruction to us— its the prized possession of Jacobs assembly.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku Ainim maa zaa naai bɛ ni daa kari ba ti zali mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛl la, bɛ zaa daa labila Ai tiŋ puuni nti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni zaa.
en: The Israelites killed every one of the enemy in the barren country where they had chased them. Then they went back to Ai and killed everyone there.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei asiba ka Dauda sabi gbaŋ ti o ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ ti ti Jɔab.
en: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.

dag: Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba bɛn be Wulinluhili polo daa deei tiŋgbani ŋɔ ka di leei bɛ dini.
en: The people of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their legacy.

dag: Di saha ka a pii di biɛla gbini a binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.

dag: Zaŋmi li lo a nubihi ka sabi li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Keep my teaching with you all the time; write it on your heart.

dag: Zuliya kam wum a vidibo yɛla, ka a kuhigu gili dunia zaa. Dama tɔbbia tuug o tɔbbi kpee, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu.
en: All nations have heard you weep; you are disgraced, and they know it. Your troops fall to the ground, stumbling over each other.

dag: Ka Musa bɔɣu daa ti ja, ka bɛ bo kuɣili na ti sɔŋ ka o ʒini di zuɣu, ka Aduna mini Hur daa gub gbaag o nuhi maa mali. Yino daa ʒiɛla o nudirigu polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe o nuzaa polo, ka o nuhi maa daa kul ʒe tibi hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: After a while, his arms were so tired that Aaron and Hur got a rock for him to sit on. Then they stood beside him and supported his arms in the same position until sunset.

dag: Ka o ti yihi bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini sara maligu kam puuni n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka di leei maligumaana ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa ʒim kpaai vie maa dini.
en: Offer one each of these different kinds of bread as a gift to the Lord . Then it will belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the fellowship offerings.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa tiligi ya nimaani; dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ maa.
en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord your God set you free; that is why I have given you this command.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Benya o naba ni jɛmm o. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Praise the Lord our God, and bow down before his footstool, for he is holy.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti dolila yɛlimaŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛliya ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mɛbu saha na bi paai. .
en: The Lord Almighty said to Haggai, These people say that this is not the right time to rebuild the Temple.

dag: Bɛn yɛn pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya. Manaasa niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl.
en: The tribe of Manasseh will camp next to Ephraims family. The leader of the tribe of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn kpalim mi daa ti salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pisopɔinayika ni anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pihinahi ni maligumaaniba binyɛra pihiyɔbunaayopɔin.
en: All together the other people gave pounds of gold, pounds of silver, and pieces of clothing for the priests.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika Yalim vinvamli ni ka labina, ka o yuli daa maan du pam.
en: David became even more famous when he returned from killing eighteen thousand Edomites in Salt Valley.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yɛli Kushi nir ŋun daa be o san la, Cham ti yɛli naa a nini ni nya shɛm. Ka Kush nir maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋ Jɔab tooni lu o sizuura ka ŋmaligi guui.
en: Someone from Ethiopia was standing there, and Joab told him, Go and tell the king what you have seen. The man knelt down in front of Joab, then got up and started running.

dag: N daanfaani so salima, hal salima alali gba. Ka n ni tiri niriba binshɛli gari anzinfa viɛlli.
en: What you get from me is better than the finest gold, better than the purest silver.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yi ni baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ be yi sani, ka ni kari Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Hivinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Gɛrigashinim ni Amɔrinim ni Jɛbusinima.
en: As you advance, he will surely drive out the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites. You will know that the living God is among you.

dag: Ka saha shɛlikam ti suhuri yi ti wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, Naawuni gari ti suhuri maa, ka mi binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bo niriba ashilɔni n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim ni bɛ wum ka Stiivin turi Anabi Musa ka mɔri Naawuni.
en: So they talked some men into saying, We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛri yɛlimaŋli dirila shɛhira maŋli, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralana ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.

dag: Amaa ka bɛna bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim maa daa ti niŋ karimbaani mini tipawumli n-zaɣis a zaligunim maa dolibu.
en: But our ancestors grew proud and stubborn and refused to obey your commands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa zaŋ niriba maa pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ nayili nɛma duu nti zaŋ situr chɛra n-zaŋ gabisi lo li n-zaŋ li ti Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ha.
en: Ebedmelech and the soldiers went to the palace and got some rags from the room under the treasury. He used ropes to lower them into the well.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Ɛbɛl kubu zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria kubu saha, bɛ ni daa ku so Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la, Naawuni shiri ni ti zaŋ di taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba!.
en: This includes the murder of every prophet—from Abel to Zechariah—who was killed between the altar and the holy place. Yes, Im telling you, this generation will be charged with it.

dag: So yi tum taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o, ka bɛ zaŋ o yili tia ku o.
en: Now if someone is guilty of a capital crime, and they are executed, and you then hang them on a tree.

dag: Ka Hiburunim bɛn daa pun be Filistianim sani hal ti paai tɔb maa tuhibu saha maa mini bɛn daa pahi doli ba chaŋ bɛ sansani maa ni zaa daa dii ŋmaligi pahi Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zuɣu.
en: There were Hebrews who served the Philistines in the past and who stayed in the Philistine camp. But now these Hebrews joined the Israelites with Saul and Jonathan.

dag: Nahiŋgu balibu kam n-kul beni, ka yɔhiŋgu balibu kam beni! Bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku baŋ ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: One bad thing followed another, and lies followed lies. The people refused to know me. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi niŋ yomyom m-ba buŋa, ka o paɣisara anu bɛn daa be o sani n-tumd o tuma pah o zuɣu ka bɛ doli Dauda tuumba maa chaŋ, ka o ti leei Dauda paɣa.
en: She rose quickly and mounted her donkey. Accompanied by her five maids, she went with David's servants and became his wife.

dag: Daŋ kam ni niriba daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn guli duno shɛŋa, bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: Each family, regardless of size, drew lots to see which gate it would be responsible for.

dag: Ka nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ti paai Yisa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira n-tim ti a sanna ni ti ti bɔh a ni nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ni ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: When they reached Jesus, they said, John the Baptist sent us to you. He asks, Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for someone else.

dag: Doo maa zuɣu ka n ni nyu bara, amaa n ku nyu bara maŋmaŋ zuɣu dina; n naɣ ni nyula bara mmaŋmaŋ chɔɣinsi zuɣu.
en: I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself. I will boast only about my weaknesses.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka sɔhigi; ka zoya gbina ni gba sɔhigi ka dam, o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: The earth rocked and shook; the bases of the mountains trembled and reeled because of Gods anger.

dag: Yawɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm, ka laɣindi bɛ ni daa kari Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb kpɛhi yɔɣu la na.
en: The Lord is restoring Jerusalem; he is bringing back the exiles.

dag: N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛha buyiyi, amaa n yur a zaligu dina.
en: Lord, I hate those who are not completely loyal to you, but I love your teachings.

dag: Yawɛ, n je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a. N ʒiɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpɛhir a nini.
en: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord , and refuses to obey.

dag: N ni baŋ ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Listen to the LORDs word.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa sab sabbu shɛli tabili Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Pilate told them to write a sign and put it on the cross. The sign said, jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews .

dag: Ka binshɛɣu din ti yɛn niŋ a bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas ti yɛn nyɛla shihirili a sani. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti yɛn kpila dahin yini.
en: When your two sons Hophni and Phinehas both die on the same day, this will show you that everything I have said will come true.

dag: Yinim tuumbiɛtumdiba ŋɔ zomiya ka chɛ ma; ka n doli n Naawuni zaligunima.
en: Go away from me, you sinful people. I will obey the commands of my God.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli din yɛli ni hal biŋkɔbigu yi shihi zoli maa, bɛn labim o kuɣa ku bee n-to o piɛm la daa kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka nyaŋ ba dolibu.
en: They couldnt stand the command, If even a wild animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned. .

dag: Ka Pita daa lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam n-saɣisiri ba yɛra, Tiligimiya yimaŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Peter made his appeal to them and with many other words he urged them, saying, Save yourselves from the punishment coming on this wicked people.

dag: Di kali ma pah alahichinim ni. Di ku ma kaman ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: Do not destroy me with the sinners; spare me from the fate of murderers—.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o garig o yɛm garigibu maa ka o yɛl o, A mini Naawuni nam bi wɔɣ ni taba. Di nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu shɛli yaha.
en: When Jesus saw that he had answered with wisdom, he said to him, You arent far from Gods kingdom. After that, no one dared to ask him any more questions.

dag: ka ti nyaandolitab bɛn be Rom daa wum ti damli ka kana hal ti paai luɣ shɛŋa din daa booni Apius Daa mini Yilikpɛra Ata la shee ni bɛ tuhi ti soli. Pool ni daa nya ba, ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o paɣiri Naawuni.
en: The brothers and sisters in Rome heard about us and came out to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw these believers, he thanked God and felt encouraged.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni yaai n noli ŋahi ŋaha, ka yɛli binshɛŋa din sɔɣi tum dunia piligu ni ha la yɛla.
en: He did this to make come true what the prophet had said, I will use parables when I speak to them; I will tell them things unknown since the creation of the world.

dag: Amaa ka pii din mali kpiɔŋ daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa ni tiŋ maa ni nanim zaa daa zo nti kpe di ni, ka yo di dunoli n-kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ di ni. Ka du pii maa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ti beni.
en: But inside the city there was a strong tower, so all the leaders and other men and women of that city ran to the tower. When the people were inside the tower, they locked the door behind them. Then they climbed up to the roof of the tower.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn gbe, ka bɛ ni yino lɔrig o kpalaŋa ni o niŋ bindirigu ti o buŋa ka nya ka liɣiri be o kpalaŋ maa nol ni;.
en: When they stopped to spend the night, one of them opened his sack to feed his donkey, and he saw his silver at the top of his sack.

dag: Pita ni daa ti ka Antiɔk na, n daa galim o o ninni, dama o ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla din simdi galimbu.
en: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he was wrong.

dag: Teeku n-doya ŋɔ, di galisiya ka yɛlim pam, biŋgbamda bɛn ka kalinli m-be di ni. Bɛ nyɛla binneen kara ni zaɣ bihi.
en: Look at the ocean, so big and wide! It is filled with all kinds of sea life. There are creatures large and small—too many to count!.

dag: Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia pala ŋun mi Naawuni, dama Naawuni nyɛla yurilim.
en: The person who doesnt love does not know God, because God is love.

dag: Hal di yi niŋ lala ŋun di laɣim yuri pam lo bee n-chɛ ka niriba maa labi Ijipti ni bɛ ti laɣim yuri pam na ti pahi; dama Yawɛ daa yɛliya, Di lan labiya nimaani yaha.
en: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni alizini ka bɛ nya maa.
en: They were terrified and afraid. They thought they were seeing a ghost.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa karibu yɛla, ka daa ti bo n-nya o bɔh o, A niŋ Daadam Bia la yɛda.
en: When Jesus heard what had happened, he found the man and asked him, Do you believe in the Son of Man.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa ti doli tiŋ maa gooni zuɣusaa n-chani garita, ka paɣ so kuhi yɛl o, N dan naa, sɔŋm ma.
en: The king of Israel was walking by on the city wall when a woman cried out, Help me, Your Majesty.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama n ni be a sani din ni fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.

dag: Gul a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, a ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd a luɣ shɛl la din ni chɛ ka a gbilisiri tibili n-wumd a dabili suhigu saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ n nini kpa a jɛmbu duu ŋɔ na ka suhir a.
en: Watch over this Temple day and night. You have promised that this is where you will be worshiped, so hear me when I face this Temple and pray.

dag: Ka yɛla maa daa muɣisi man Daniɛl pam, ka dɔro gbaai ma ka n dɔni paai dabisa shɛm. Ka n daa ti yiɣisi n lan labi nti tumdi tuun shɛŋa naa ni daa zali ma ni n tumdi la, amaa ka ʒii maa yɛla daa gari ma ka m bi tooi baŋ li.
en: I, Daniel, became very weak. I was sick for several days after that vision. Then I got up and went back to work for the king, but I was very upset about the vision. I did not understand what it meant.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu. Timiya niriba lala tatabo jilima.
en: Receive him, then, with joy, as a believer in the Lord. Show respect to all such people as he.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Yawɛ zoli maa gbini n-lu soli chaŋ daba ata chandi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la n-daŋ tooni chaŋ daba ata chandi ni di ti bo dooshee ti ba.
en: They marched from the LORDs mountain for three days. The LORDs chest containing the covenant marched ahead of them for three days to look for a resting place for them.

dag: A mi n ʒinibu saha, ka mi n yiɣisibu saha. Hal n yi tɛhi ni m bela katiŋa, a mi n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Tiŋgbana ayi ŋɔ mini di fɔntinsi ayi ŋɔ nyɛla ti dini, ka ti ni deei li su, hal Yawɛ ni kul be di ni maa zaa yoli.
en: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God.

dag: Bɛ nyo li buɣim; bɛ ŋma li luhi. Lihim ba suhuyiɣisili lihigu ka bɛ kpi.
en: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ti fali ti saamba, ka zaŋ ti yiya ti tinzunnima.
en: Our land has been turned over to strangers. Our houses have been given to foreigners.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun lihiri tiŋgbani ka di sɔhiri ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun shihi zoya, ka di tuɣiri nyɔhi.
en: He just looks at the earth, and it trembles. He just touches the mountains, and smoke rises from them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: and were made of acacia wood covered with gold.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla bɛn doli adiini soli kaya, amaa ka lee chihi di yiko. Gbaam amaŋ ni niriba ŋɔ tatabo.
en: they will hold to the outward form of our religion, but reject its real power. Keep away from such people.

dag: N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: when he said, I'll give you the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka Kɔnania min o mabihi Shɛmaya ni Nɛtanɛl ni Hashabia ni Jɛiɛl ni Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba la gba daa ti Lɛvinim piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tusaanu ni naɣilahi kɔbisinu ni bɛ zaŋ puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: Also Conaniah with Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad gave sheep and goats and bulls for Passover sacrifices to the Levites. These men were leaders of the Levites.

dag: Ka chira ayi maa daa ti naai ka o lab o ba sanna, ka o ti zaŋ o niŋ kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli ni o zaŋ o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa nyɛla paɣipiɛliga. Ka di daa leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then she went back to her father. He did what he had promised, and she never got married. That's why.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ daa pun niŋ anabinim bɛn daŋ yi tooni la gba alaka.
en: Be full of joy and be glad, because you have a great reward in heaven. In the same way, people harassed the prophets who came before you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Asahɛl chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti sɔɣ o o ba siliga din daa be nimaani la puuni. Ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa ŋmaligi doli tab yuŋ labi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei, ka bɛ paai Hiburɔn.
en: Joab and his men took Asahel's body and buried it in the family tomb at Bethlehem. Then they marched all night and at dawn arrived back at Hebron.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ ban yini gɔhi li tabili taba zuɣusaa polo, amaa ka chɛ ka di zaŋ siɣi tiŋ na woligi taba; lala ka yi ni ti niŋ diba ayi maa zaa, ka di niŋ lɔrisi ayi maa.
en: They should be spread out at the bottom but joined together at the top with one ring. In this way, these two boards will form the two corners.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ni chɛ ka n jilima zaa gar a tooni, ka m boli n yuli a tooni, Yawɛ. N ni bɔri ni n niŋ ninvuɣ so nirilim, n ni niŋ o nirilim. N ni lan bɔri ni n zo ninvuɣ so nambɔɣu, n ni zo o nambɔɣu.
en: The LORD said, Ill make all my goodness pass in front of you, and Ill proclaim before you the name, The LORD. I will be kind to whomever I wish to be kind, and I will have compassion to whomever I wish to be compassionate.

dag: ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Naa Dauda ba. Naa Dauda daa nyɛla o paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Yuria paɣa la bia Sulemaana ba;.
en: Jesse was the father of King David. David was the father of Solomon.

dag: Miri ka a pahi shɛli o yɛligu zuɣu, di yi pa lala o ni kpah a zuɣu ni, ka di wuhi ni a nyɛla ʒirilana.
en: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam Naa ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ku lu a sizuura? Dama lala n-simd a. Zuliya kam yɛnnim mini bɛ nanim zaa so m-bi ŋman a.
en: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.

dag: ni Nan ni Jɔshua.
en: Nun was Elishamas son. Joshua was Nuns son.

dag: O daa lan mali kpa shɛli din be kasi shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni, ka lan mali tulaale zim alali din nyom viɛla kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Then he made the holy anointing oil. He also made the pure, sweet-smelling incense. These things were made the same way that a perfume maker would make them.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali yi daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, and in this way perform the ritual of purification for the people.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri ni o saɣim o yuli yɛra, N daa kpuɣila paɣ ŋɔ, amaa ka m min o ti dɔni, ka m bi nya o paɣipalitali shihira.
en: He then spreads false claims about her to the point that she has a bad reputation, because he said such things as, I married this woman, but when I went to have sex with her, I couldnt find any proof that she was a virgin.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe cheechi niriba zaa pam zaŋ tabili bɛnkam zaa daa wum di yɛla.
en: The whole church and all the other people who heard about this were filled with fear.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi n zuɣu, a chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili maa ŋmanila kɔgbana, n-ŋme ma luhi.
en: Your anger presses down on me like a heavy weight. Its like one wave after another pounding against me. Selah.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaligu maa lan ka yaa, ka saria karibu gba bi lan tumdi tuma. Dama ninvuɣ biɛri gilila wuntizɔriba, dinzuɣu ka saria karibu bi lan tumdi tuma.
en: The law is weak and useless, and justice is never done. Evil people get the better of the righteous, and so justice is perverted.

dag: Dunɔguliba zuɣulaannim anahi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni du shɛŋa mini neen shɛŋa din mali bukaata fukumsi.
en: Due to their trustworthiness, the four master gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in charge of the rooms and the treasuries of Gods house.

dag: Di saha ka niriba daa bɔhi ma, A ku yɛli ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The people asked, Wont you tell us what your actions mean for us.

dag: Iso ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa lan booni so Ɛdom la zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the descendants of Esau, that is, Edom.

dag: Bɛ malila shili n-kariti doli ma, ka di pala n taali zuɣu. Yiɣisim kana ti sɔŋ ma ka nya.
en: nor because of any fault of mine, O Lord , that they hurry to their places.

dag: a mi di pɔ a zuɣu, dama a ku tooi chɛ ka di zabigu zaɣ yini lɛbigi zaɣ piɛlli bee zaɣ sabinli.
en: And dont even say that your own head is proof that you will keep your promise. You cannot make one hair on your head white or black.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ di tiŋli ti tuui ka mali salima buɣilimbuɣilimbihi n-zaŋ li yiliyili di sunsuuni gili.
en: Use blue, purple, and red yarn to make cloth pomegranates. Hang these pomegranates around the bottom edge of the robe, and hang gold bells between the pomegranates.

dag: n naŋgbampiba ku ŋma ʒiri, ka n zilinli mi ku tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: my lips will utter no wickedness; my tongue will mumble no deceit.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka o daa lan lab Naawuni jɛmbu duu yaha; ka niriba daa laɣim o sanna, ka o ʒini gbaai ba wuhibu.
en: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ti bari zani bɛ zaashɛhi Balitama n-zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo ba; ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la yi bɛ sɔɣibu shee din be Gɛba wulinluhili polo na.
en: So all the men ran away. They stopped at a place named Baal Tamar. Some of the men of Israel were hiding west of Gibeah. They ran from their hiding places.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mi n-ni ti zani Ɛbal zoli zuɣu n-yɛli noli dibu yɛtɔɣa maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Asha zuliya niriba ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba ni Dan zuliya niriba ni Naftali zuliya niriba.
en: And these are the tribes that will stand on Mount Ebal for the cursing: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, n yur a pam.
en: He said: I love you, LORD, my strength.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi ni chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha yaha; ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna ka o ti gbaai ba wuhibu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm.
en: Then Jesus left that place, went to the province of Judea, and crossed the Jordan River. Crowds came flocking to him again, and he taught them, as he always did.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ku lan deei liɣiri niriba maa sani; ka lan saɣi ni bɛn maligumaaniba maa ku mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The priests agreed that they wouldnt take any more money from the people nor be responsible for temple repairs.

dag: Ka Sool daa baŋ Dauda kukoli maa ka bɔh o, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Dauda garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n kukoli m-bala.
en: Saul recognized Davids voice and said, David, my son, is that your voice? David said, Yes it is, my master the king.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o ni lo ni o niŋ o niriba maa zaɣ biɛ shɛli maa niŋbu.
en: Then the LORD changed his mind about the terrible things he said he would do to his people.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia min o kpambaliba niŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba la nuu ni. N ni zaŋ ba niŋ Babilɔn naa tɔbbihi bɛn zo ka chɛn ya la nuu ni.
en: I will also hand over King Zedekiah of Judah and his officials to those who want to kill them. I will hand them over to the Babylonian army, which has stopped its attack against you.

dag: Bɛ chɛ soli din tuhi ka birigi; bɛ dolila Bɛɔr bia Anabi Balaam ŋun daa tum din bi tuhi liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la naba.
en: These false teachers left the right way and went the wrong way. They followed the same way that the prophet Balaam went. He was the son of Beor, who loved being paid for doing wrong.

dag: Ka Naa Amɔn kpambalib daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbaai bɛ naa ka o guui, ka o kpamba gba ti zaŋ bɛ tuutanim bahi ka guui dabiɛm zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun buɣim diri Ziɔn, ka o sara maligu buɣim shee be Jɛrusalɛm la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their place of safety will be destroyed. Their leaders will be defeated, and they will abandon their flag. The Lord , whose fireplace is on Zion and whose oven is in Jerusalem, is the one who said this.

dag: Ti Duuma ni ti Ziɔn paɣiba zuɣutalisi ni dansi ka di niŋ yukaɣima. Yawɛ ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ zaɣim.
en: But I will punish them—I will shave their heads and leave them bald.

dag: Bɛ bela zibisim ni wuntaŋ ni, ka bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman yuŋ la.
en: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun yɛli, N ni me mmaŋmaŋ yili titali, ka me zuɣusaa du kara, ka niŋ takɔriti niŋ li, ka zaŋ sida dari pa di zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ piɛnta ʒee piɛnti li.
en: Jehoiakim says, I will build myself a great palace, with huge rooms upstairs. So he built it with large windows. He used cedar wood for paneling, and he painted it red.

dag: O bi paɣi wɔr so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. O mi bi paɣi ninvuɣ so ŋun tooi zɔri pam.
en: His pleasure is not in strong horses, nor his delight in brave soldiers;.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni lihi yum maa ka yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, yum nyɛla daɣiri, dama di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: When the priest sees the raw skin, he must announce that the person is unclean. The raw skin is not clean. It is leprosy.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ n shɛhiralana bela alizanda ni, ka ŋun ʒe n nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋun be zuɣusaa.
en: There is someone in heaven to stand up for me and take my side.

dag: Ka o dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni. Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ tatabo.
en: While they all watched, the man got up, picked up his mat, and hurried away. They were all completely amazed and praised God, saying, We have never seen anything like this.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛl o, Bimbuɣisirigu. Di saha ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Nyama, n zaŋla bimbuɣisirigu sɔŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni; n ku lan ka bɛ sanna yaha.
en: Then he asked, Amos, what do you see? A measuring line, I answered. The Lord said, I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi zaa n-yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ Zairi, ka o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim ti lu Ɛdomnim bɛn daa teei gil o zuɣu n-niŋ ba buɣim; amaa ka o tɔbbihi daa zo n-kuli.
en: Then Jehoram and all his chariots went to Zair. The Edomite army surrounded them, but Jehoram and his officers attacked them and escaped. Jehorams soldiers all ran away and went home.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbibi n jɛmbu duu maa, ka tumdi di puuni tuun shɛli zaa din simdi tumbu.
en: I am assigning to them the menial work that is to be done in the Temple.

dag: Yisa ni daa baŋ ni niriba maa loya ni bɛ gbaag o ni kiŋkansi ti leei bɛ naa maa, ka o daa ŋoli yi bɛ sunsuuni n-chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu m-be nimaani o kɔŋko.
en: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla wuntialana ka a saria karibu nyɛ din tuhi.
en: Lord , you do what is right, and your decisions are fair.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa piripiri tinsi maa ni di momaha tiŋgbana maa tari Lɛvinima.
en: So the Israelites gave those towns and fields to the Levites.

dag: Dama ŋunkam niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima nyɛla Yawɛ ni bi bɔri so, binyɛra din chihiri ŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daŋ kariti ba maa.
en: All who do these things are detestable to the LORD! It is on account of these detestable practices that the LORD your God is driving these nations out before you.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ la o ni daa lo nia shɛli ka chɛ ka di pali ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la puuni.
en: This agrees with the plan God had since the beginning of time. He did what he planned, and he did it through Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ man Yawɛ ninni? Nyini n-ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka Ammɔnnim zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka a kpuɣ o paɣa n-leeg a paɣa.
en: Why did you disobey me and do such a horrible thing? You murdered Uriah the Hittite by letting the Ammonites kill him, so you could take his wife.

dag: Di yi pa lala bɛ ni nyuli kuli, ka tam zaligu yɛla, ka mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zaa yɛlimaŋli.
en: When they drink, they forget the laws and ignore the rights of people in need.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa n-zaŋ li ti zali baɣili shɛhira bini la.
en: As the Lord had commanded Moses, Aaron put it in front of the Covenant Box, so that it could be kept.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a kpiɔŋ zaa ni a tɛha zaa, ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. .
en: He responded, You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your being, with all your strength, and with all your mind, and love your neighbor as yourself .

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o piɛma n-to n-wurim ba; ka chɛ ka o saa nyaɣisiri ginda.
en: He scattered his enemies with his arrows— the lightning bolts that threw them into confusion.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Giliad mini Bashan ni di fɔntinsi ni zaa ni Sharɔn tiŋgban ni luɣ shɛŋa din daa mali biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zaa.
en: They lived in the territory of Bashan and Gilead, in the towns there and all over the pasture lands of Sharon. .

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun birigi ka chɛ yɛm soli ni chaŋ ti pahi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: Whoever leaves the path of wisdom will be on their way to an early death.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira, ka do yino paɣa kana ni o ti fa o yidana ŋun bur o maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o nuu gbaag o tooni.
en: If two men are fighting with each other—a man and his fellow Israelite—and the wife of one of them gets into the fight, trying to save her husband from his attacker and does so by reaching out and grabbing his genitals.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bahi, o daa yiɣisila nimaani n-kpe ŋariŋ yi kpaŋa. Ka salo daa wum o chandi maa damli, ka yi tinsi ni n-chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu kar o naba.
en: When Jesus heard the news about John, he left there in a boat and went to a lonely place by himself. The people heard about it, and so they left their towns and followed him by land.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Mbusim be n zuɣu, n lan ka tahima, dama yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-yiri n nol ni na, ka m mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri ni yiri ninvuɣ shɛb noya ni na laɣim be; amaa ka n nini nya naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: I was frightened and said, Oh, no! I will be destroyed. I am not pure enough to speak to God, and I live among people who are not pure enough to speak to him. But I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa tɔɣisi Lɛvinim maa zaa suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli tum Yawɛ tuma maa zuɣu. Ka niriba maa daa di chuɣu maa bindirigu daba ayopɔin, ka daa kɔri suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri, ka paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa yɛli, Nanim pisopɔin bɛn nubihilɔri mini bɛ napombihilɔri ŋmahiŋmahi n-yi gahindi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa n tooni, n ni niŋ shɛm ka Naawuni niŋ ma labisi maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Jɛrusalɛm ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: and he said, I've cut off the thumbs and big toes of kings and made those kings crawl around under my table for scraps of food. Now God is paying me back. The army of Judah took the king of Bezek along with them to Jerusalem, where he died.

dag: Ka bia maa tizɔpaɣa daa ʒe kpaŋa ni o nya din yɛn niŋ o.
en: The babys sister stayed and watched to see what would happen to the baby.

dag: dama mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri o tuumba maa zaa ni, hal ka m bi simdi ni bɛ boli ma o tumo gba, n ni daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka la zuɣu.
en: For I am the least of all the apostles—I do not even deserve to be called an apostle, because I persecuted God's church.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa wum bɛ vuri maa ka bɔhi Bɔ vuri ka Hiburunim ŋɔ lee ti yɔri bɛ sansani maa ni lala? Filistianim maa ni daa ti baŋ ni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na maa.
en: The Philistines heard the noise and said, What are those Hebrews shouting about? When the Philistines learned that the sacred chest had been brought into the camp.

dag: Kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm, lala ka ti nini nya li. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tiŋa din nyɛ ti Naawuni tiŋ la ni, ŋun Naawuni ni daa zali shɛli ni di beni sahakam la.
en: Yes, we heard the stories about your power. But we also saw it in the city of our God, the city of the Lord All-Powerful. God makes that city strong forever. Selah.

dag: di lan nyɛla paɣ so ŋun nya sɔrilim zaligu ni binshɛli ni yiri do so bee paɣ so tooni na zaa zaligu, ka lan nyɛ do so ŋun mini paɣ so ŋun na be daɣiri ni dɔni gba zaligu.
en: And these rules are for women who become unclean from their monthly time of bleeding. And these are the rules for anyone who becomes unclean by sleeping with another person who is unclean.

dag: A ti ti tibidarigibo balibu kam zaa din sab Musa zaligu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, ti na kul bi saɣi ni ti balim a bee ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ti daalahichi ka dol a yɛlimaŋli maa.
en: giving us all the punishment described in the Law of Moses. But even now, O Lord our God, we have not tried to please you by turning from our sins or by following your truth.

dag: Ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii ka o doya, ka bɛ daa dii yɛli Yisa o niŋgbun biisim maa yɛla.
en: Simons mother-in-law was very sick. She was in bed and had a fever. The people there told Jesus about her.

dag: Saawara niŋbu yi kani, nia lɔbu bi paana, amaa saawaranim pam yi beni, bɛ dirila nasara.
en: If you dont ask for advice, your plans will fail. With many advisors, they will succeed.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi ni Izraɛlnim zaa ni man Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: to give Aaron and his sons and all the people of Israel the following regulations.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔhi bɛ ni su shɛlikam zaa m-pirigipirigi ti taba kaman di ni daa simdi ni sokam deei shɛm tariga.
en: They would sell their property and possessions, and distribute the money among all, according to what each one needed.

dag: Man Saimɔn Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni o tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛda mali buchi kaman ti gba yɛda ni mali buchi shɛm ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia wuntitali puuni la.
en: Greetings from Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ. To all of you who share in the same valuable faith that we have. This faith was given to us because our God and Savior Jesus Christ always does what is good and right.

dag: Ka puu atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti miri, ka wɔɣiri kɔba pihita la ni niriba ata daa chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni. Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: Near the beginning of harvest time three of The Thirty went down to Adullam Cave, where David was, while a band of Philistines was camping in Rephaim Valley.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa puuni, ka lan zali tɔbbihi Juda tiŋgban ni min o ba Asa ni daa tuhi deei tin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la puuni.
en: He stationed troops in the fortified cities of Judah, in the Judean countryside, and in the cities which Asa had captured in the territory of Ephraim.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi nyaɣa kpe o ni m-ba n-zani kaman tia la. Ka me yimaŋ tam o zuɣu, ka ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga yi yɛda niŋbu puuni kaman bɛ ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la. Ka chɛliya ka wumpaɣibo pali yi suhuri hal nti puuri bahira.
en: Be rooted and built up in him, be established in faith, and overflow with thanksgiving just as you were taught.

dag: Amaa naa ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani, ka bɛnkam zaa zaŋ Naawuni yuli m-po pɔri ni mali suhupiɛlli dama ʒiŋmariba ni fo bɛ noya.
en: But the king should rejoice in God; everyone who swears by God should give praise when the mouths of liars are shut for good.

dag: Ka bɛ ti mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: who will make fun of him and spit on him. They will beat him and kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.

dag: Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Kul yim chaŋ, dama n yɛn tim a la katiŋ ha bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani. .
en: Then the Lord said to me, Go! I will send you far away to the Gentiles.

dag: Ibram daa mali buni pam. O daa mali biŋkɔbiri mini anzinfa ni salima.
en: Abram was very rich. He owned many cattle, sheep, and goats, and had a lot of silver and gold.

dag: Ka daɣila o kul yɛn kpaari ba mi ka chɛr o laŋa maa zaɣ kuŋ, ka kuri niriba ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Should he continue to empty his net and continue to slay nations without sparing them?.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun karindi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li ka doli din sabi litaafi ŋɔ puuni mal alibarika, dama saha maa miriya.
en: Great blessings belong to the person who reads the words of this message from God and to those who hear this message and do what is written in it. There is not much time left.

dag: A daa yi alizanda ni n-siɣi Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka ti ba zaligu maŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: You came down upon Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. You gave them proper judgments and true Instruction, good statutes and commandments.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n daa suhi n Duuma di zuɣu ni o yihi li n ni.
en: I pleaded with the Lord three times for it to leave me alone.

dag: yɛra, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ni ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: We are now on our way to Jerusalem where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses. They will sentence him to death and hand him over to foreigners.

dag: ni daŋ kam ni kpɛm bom jaaŋgbe yini ka jaaŋgbɛhi maa kalinli yiɣisi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ti a. Ka a sabi sokam yuli pa o jaaŋgbee zuɣu.
en: Speak to the Israelites and take from them a staff from each household, from each of the chiefs of their households, twelve staffs. Write each persons name on his staff.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Yinima n-tum birigi chaŋ ti kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim taali galisi.
en: Then Ezra the priest stood and said to them, You people have not been faithful to God. You have married foreign women. You have made Israel more guilty by doing that.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba, Yisahaku bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Iso mini Izraɛl.
en: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.

dag: Ka ti Duuma garigi yɛli, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlan zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: The Lord replied, Who are the faithful and wise managers whom the master will put in charge of his household servants, to give them their food at the proper time?.

dag: Ka o daa mali binyila tam di naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o daa niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: He made the projections at the top of the four corners, so that they formed one piece with the altar. He covered it all with bronze.

dag: Ka Balaam daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba ni ti bɛ suɣa doya gbilligbilli. Di saha ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na.
en: Balaam looked up and saw Israel camping by tribes. Then Gods spirit came on him.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa deei yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is a message about Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz received from God.

dag: Ti lo nia ni ti tumla din tuhi, ka di pala zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma sani kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim gba sani.
en: We care about doing the right thing, not only in the Lords eyes but also in the eyes of other people.

dag: A ni ti nyu li zaa n-lɛlilɛli di puuni, ka dim cheei li ka zaŋ di ŋmama maa ŋme m-bɔɣ a biha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Drink it, drain it dry, break it into pieces, and tear off your breasts, for I have spoken. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, Yawɛ yɛligu be o ni. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa mini Jɛhɔshafat ni Ɛdom naa daa chaŋ o sani.
en: Jehoshaphat said, He has the LORDs word! So Israels king and Jehoshaphat and Edoms king went down to see Elisha.

dag: yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Izraɛlnima wummiya, yi vu m-miri ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi ni sɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: The priest will say, Men of Israel, listen to me! Today you are going against your enemies in battle. Dont lose your courage. Dont be troubled or upset. Dont be afraid of the enemy.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaai Sintani ŋun yɔhindi ba maa n-zaŋ o bahi buɣim teeku din nyɛ chilibi buɣim ni, luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbigu la min o daanabi ʒirilan la ni pun be, ka bɛ ni nyari nahiŋgu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the Devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown; and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

dag: N daa nya a luɣ kasi shee la; N daa nya a yiko min a jilima la.
en: Yes, I have seen you in your Temple. I have seen your strength and glory.

dag: ka bo zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram yini n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla.
en: Also give a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil with each lamb. This will be a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bunu ka Yɛhudianim fiɛb ma barazim pihinahiyinikaka.
en: Five times the Jews have given me their punishment of lashes with a whip.

dag: A ŋariŋduhiriba n-zaŋ a chaŋ teeku bulli ni. Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒe n-saɣim a teeku bulli maa ni.
en: Your oarsmen rowed you far out to sea. But a powerful east wind will destroy your ship at sea.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, ka pumpɔŋɔ man na yɛn pahi ya la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi leei barazim saɣisiri ya.
en: My father forced you to work hard, but I will make you work much harder! My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with whips that have sharp metal tips.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka she tana ayɔbu la gba tuɣi taba ka kpabi tan shɛli din pah ayɔbu la ka di niŋ diba ayi, ka yi zaŋ li pa m biɛhigu shee maa tooni polo.
en: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.

dag: Nam jaaŋgbee ti ku yi Juda nuu ni. Nam jaaŋgbee mi ti ku yi o zuliya nuu ni hal ka ŋun su li ti kana. Ka niriba ni ti deer o noli.
en: You will have power and rule until nations obey you and come bringing gifts.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Ilaija binyɛr shɛli din daa yi o sani luna n-lab ti zani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: Elijah's coat had fallen off, so Elisha picked it up and walked back to the Jordan River.

dag: M Ba ni su binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla n dini; dina n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni o ni ti zaŋ n yɛla wuhi ya maa.
en: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you.

dag: N zaŋ n yɛligu niŋ a nol ni, ka zaŋ a niŋ n nuu mahim ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa, ka nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. N yɛli Ziɔnnima, Yi nyɛla n niriba.
en: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, Jerusalem, your people are mine.

dag: O bihi nyurila ʒim. Bɛ ni ku binyara luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka o be.
en: The eagles gather around dead bodies, and their young eat the blood.

dag: Birim a bimbira asiba ni zaawuni, dama a ku tooi baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ, dimbɔŋɔ bee din la bee di zaa nti yɛn niŋ.
en: Scatter your seed in the morning, and in the evening dont be idle because you dont know which will succeed, this one or that, or whether both will be equally good.

dag: Ka n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni zuɣu chɛ ka ti mabihi pam niŋ ti Duuma naani, naɣ kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni niriba biɛla. Ka bɛn niŋ naani maa kul mali suhukpeeni sahakam ka yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu ka dabiɛm zɔbu kani.
en: My being in prison has caused most of the believers to put their trust in the Lord and to show more courage in telling people Gods message.

dag: Bɛ daa kul sɔŋ la kuɣa maa dolisi dundɔŋ maa n-zaŋ hal ti paai dunɔdaya maa wɔɣilim tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛ ni sɔŋ kuɣ shɛŋa tiŋli.
en: The pavement was as wide as the gates were long. The pavement reached to the inside end of the gateway. This was the lower pavement.

dag: Bindirigu mini kom kɔŋko zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ lihiri taba ni suhuzɔhibo, ka bahi yoli bɛ tibidarigibo maa puuni.
en: That is because there will not be enough food and water for everyone. They will be terrified as they watch each other wasting away because of their sins.

dag: Amaa Musa mini maligumaana Aduna ni daa pun sab Izraɛlnim shɛb yuya Sinai mɔɣu ni la so daa ka bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya ŋɔ kalinli maa ni.
en: Many years before, in the desert of Sinai, Moses and Aaron the priest counted the Israelites. But all these people were dead. Not one of them was still alive.

dag: Yawɛ, n teer a yuli yɛla yuŋ, ka dol a zaligu.
en: LORD, I remember your name at nighttime, and I keep your Instruction.

dag: Dauda ni daa tuhi Amalɛknim maa ka labina Naa Sool kum maa nyaaŋa, o daa kpalimla Zikilag daba ayi.
en: After David defeated the Amalekites, he went back to Ziklag. This was just after Saul had been killed. David had been there two days.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi bihi mini yi puu atam ni yi niɣi bɛn yɛligi ni yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi.
en: The Lord will curse you by giving you only a few children, poor crops, and few cattle and sheep.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhudoo din yaɣi ninsal milinsi zuɣu la ni gbibi yi suhuri mini yi tɛha Yisa Masia ni.
en: Then the peace of God that exceeds all understanding will keep your hearts and minds safe in Christ Jesus.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba suhiri Naawuni sɔŋdi ti, ka di chɛ ka niriba pam paɣi Naawuni o ni deei bɛ wunsuhigu gbaliŋ ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni la zuɣu.
en: since you are helping with your prayer for us. Then many people can thank God on our behalf for the gift that was given to us through the prayers of many people.

dag: Ka ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ka Masia daa yi o zuɣu nyɛla man ŋun kpalim nyaaŋa dɔɣim palli nyabu ni ŋɔ;.
en: Last of all he appeared also to me—even though I am like someone whose birth was abnormal.

dag: Ka Yawɛ kari niriba maa tahi katiŋa, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim zaɣ kuŋ.
en: I will send the people far away and make the whole land desolate.

dag: Ka Amalɛknim daa lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim Rɛfidim maa.
en: Amalek came and fought with Israel at Rephidim.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabili ŋun suhu ye mahim zuɣu, ka ŋmani tumtumdiba bɛn guhiri bɛ yɔri.
en: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya o ka bɔh o, Asahɛl, nyini m-bala? Ka o yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: Abner looked back and said, Is that you, Asahel? Yes, he answered.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini karimba ʒirinim kul ni chani tooni n-tumdi din bie nti yaɣi, ka yɔhindi niriba, ka bɛmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti lu yɔhiŋgu ni.
en: But evil people and swindlers will grow even worse, as they deceive others while being deceived themselves.

dag: ni o ni yihi Sool nam ni ka zaŋ ŋun Dauda ʒili nam gbandi maa zuɣu, ka o su Judanim mini Izraɛlnim zaa, zaŋ Dan hal ti kpa Bɛrishiiba la niŋ pali, Naawuni ŋun darigim n tibili, hal ŋun darigim n tibili pam gba.
en: God said that he wouldn't let anyone in Saul's family ever be king again and that David would be king instead. He also said that David would rule both Israel and Judah, all the way from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba maa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa.
en: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh answered:.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba; ka daa pii so n-leei bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: During Jehoram's reign Edom revolted against Judah and became an independent kingdom.

dag: Dindali maa, fabila ni ti galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman bɛ ni daa fabili Hadadirimɔn zuɣu Mɛgido vinvamli ni shɛm la.
en: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni gba daa niŋ. O daa bɔri ni o wuhila o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm ka chɛ ka o yiko yi palɔni; dinzuɣu ka o daa di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi din kur o suli ka simdi ni o bahi ba yol la suɣilo.
en: It is the same way with what God has done. He wanted to show his anger and to let people see his power. But he patiently endured those he was angry with—people who were ready to be destroyed.

dag: Dama cheechi toondana ni su Naawuni tuma fukumsi la zuɣu, di simdi ni o malila biɛrisuŋ; di bi simdi ni o nyɛla barinyura bee suhuyiɣisililana bee ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee vubɔra bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: For since a church leader is in charge of God's work, he should be without fault. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered, or a drunkard or violent or greedy for money.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni labisi o ni ʒiɛm m pɔri shɛl la min o ni saɣim alikauli shɛli la ʒil o.
en: The Lord GOD makes this promise: By my life, I swear that I will punish the king of Judah, because he ignored my warnings and broke our agreement.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yil yidan yi di mi saha shɛli tayiɣ ni yɛn kana, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: But know this, if the homeowner had known what time the thief was coming, he wouldnt have allowed his home to be broken into.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ Dauda sani Zikilag saha shɛl o ni daa bi lan tooi yiri palo gɔr o yubu, Kish bia Sool zuɣu la gba daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋ o tuhi tɔbu la.
en: The following persons came to David at Ziklag while he was banished from the presence of Saul, Kishs son. They were some of the warriors who helped him in battle.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔpiɛliga dari mali di daantalis anahi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li, ka zaŋ salima mali di bansi. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ anzinfa mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni bɛ zaŋ pateesa maa yili li.
en: They made four posts using acacia wood, and they covered the posts with gold. Then they made gold hooks for the posts and four silver bases for the posts.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Jona ŋun nyɛ Amitai bia la.
en: The LORDs word came to Jonah, Amittais son.

dag: Naawuni be lala tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka di kul ku vuui; Naawuni ni sɔŋ lala tiŋ maa biɛkaali saha.
en: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni zuɣulaannim daa bi mi n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n ni niŋ shɛli. N daa na bi yɛli Yɛhudianim mini maligumaaniba ni kpamba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yɛn tum tuma maa ni so shɛli.
en: None of the local officials knew where I had gone or what I had been doing. So far I had not said anything to any of the other Jews—the priests, the leaders, the officials, or anyone else who would be taking part in the work.

dag: Ka Abija min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam, ka bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: Abijah and his army dealt the Israelites a crushing defeat—half a million of Israel's best soldiers were killed.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.

dag: Ka Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti be zuliya pam sunsuuni kaman maligim n-yi Yawɛ sanna la. Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila saa ŋun miri bahiri mɔri zuɣu ka di baɣa ka niriba ni bee n-lihiri daadam ninni la.
en: Then the few remaining in Jacob will be amid many peoples like dew from the LORD, like spring showers upon the grass, which does not hope for humans or wait for human ones.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o niriba maa, Sokam nyaɣim o takɔbi! Ka Dauda gba daa nyaɣ o takɔbi; ka niriba kɔbisinahi daa pah o zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka chɛ niriba kɔbisiyi ka bɛ mi kpalim guli bɛ nɛma.
en: Then David said to his soldiers, All of you, strap on your swords! So each of them strapped on their swords, and David did the same. Nearly four hundred men went up with David. Two hundred men remained back with the supplies.

dag: Ka naa maa daa mali saawara, ka zaŋ salima mali naɣilabih ayi zali; ka yɛli niriba maa, Yi chani Jɛrusalɛm ka di saha wɔɣa. Izraɛlnima, nyamiya yi buɣa bɛn daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: After thinking it over, he made two bull-calves of gold and said to his people, You have been going long enough to Jerusalem to worship. People of Israel, here are your gods who brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Nyin ʒe samban ni, ka a ni yɛn paŋ so bini maa zaŋ a ni yɛn deei binshɛli ti sɔŋ maa yina ti ti a.
en: wait outside and let him bring it to you himself.

dag: N tumdi tuun kpɛma ka nyari wahala, ka gaani gom waawaayili, ka kpiri kum ni kɔnyuri, ka kɔŋdi bindirigu waawaayili, ka chani gbinfini ka wari mali ma.
en: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma ayopɔin goli dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the ... month of the eleventh year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nini tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm nyɛla jɛra, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛm soli ni yi barina ni.
en: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa puuni ka nyɛ bɛn daa zo n-chaŋ o sani mini bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni la kuli Babilɔn.
en: Nebuzaradan, the Babylonian officer in charge of the guards, led away everyone from the city as prisoners, even those who had deserted to Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka salo pam daa doli Yisa nyaaŋa, ka paɣ shɛb daa be bɛ ni n-kuhiri ka fabind o zuɣu.
en: A huge crowd of people followed Jesus, including women, who were mourning and wailing for him.

dag: ka Joyada nyɛ Jɔnatan ba; ka Jɔnatan mi nyɛ Jadua ba.
en: Joiada was the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka bɛ yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo. Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la di tumtumsa ni.
en: When the Son of Man came, he ate and drank, and everyone said, Look at this man! He is a glutton and wine drinker, a friend of tax collectors and other outcasts! God's wisdom, however, is shown to be true by its results.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le da kol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim.
en: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ ni dabisi shɛli din paya dali zaa n-gbahi kɔrinsi maa; ŋun daa bi gbahi ba pam ni daa gbahi shɛb tibisim daa bi pooi kilɔgiram ayi ni biɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔŋ yɛrigi gili suɣa maa shee zaa.
en: Then the people arose and gathered the quail all that day, all night, and all the next day. The least collected was ten homers, and they laid them out around the camp.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn baŋ din viɛli piibu ka zaɣisi din bi viɛla, o ni ti dirila waagasi mini shiri.
en: He will eat milk curds and honey as he learns to choose good and refuse evil.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Guhimiya ka m-bɔhi Yawɛ wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi polo.
en: Moses answered, Wait until I receive instructions from the Lord .

dag: Laabira salo ŋɔ ʒi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, lala zuɣu Naawuni noli ni di ba.
en: But those people out there know nothing about the law. They are under Gods curse.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-ka Yawɛ tooni na Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti zaŋ ba ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.

dag: Ka Naaman yɛl o, Chɛ ka n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi ti a. Ka o daa balim o zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra maa n-niŋ kpalans ayi ni lo n-zaŋ ʒil o tumtumdiba ayi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ʒi m-be Gɛhaazi tooni.
en: Sure, Naaman replied. But why don't you take twice that amount of silver? He convinced Gehazi to take it all, then put the silver in two bags. He handed the bags and the clothes to his two servants, and they carried them for Gehazi.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya Pita mini Jɔn suhukpeeni, ka mi ni bɛ nyɛla tarimba ni zuɣusabila maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛ mini Yisa n-daa be.
en: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.

dag: N je yi chu shɛŋa yi ni puhiri la. M mi baɣa ka yi jɛma laɣiŋgunim ni.
en: The Lord says, I hate your religious festivals; I cannot stand them!.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ŋun nyɛ ŋun niŋdi zina bee ŋun tumdi daɣiri tuma bee ŋun kɔre kpɛri binyara ni ti ku nya shɛli Masia mini Naawuni nam ni, dama binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: You can be sure of this: No one will have a place in the kingdom of Christ and of God if that person commits sexual sins, or does evil things, or is a person who selfishly wants more and more. A greedy person like that is serving a false god.

dag: Ka yi lan wuhiri ni nir yi po sara maligu bimbini di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po sara shɛli din pa bimbini maa zuɣu, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: And you say, If anyone uses the altar to make a promise, that means nothing. But anyone who uses the gift on the altar to make a promise must keep that promise.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi sabilifaa niŋ li ni bɛ zaŋ li lɔri pari bantabiga maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: The scripture says, Abraham believed God, and because of his faith God accepted him as righteous.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be vinvamli maa yaɣ din la mini bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la daa nya ka Izraɛlnim ŋmaligi guui, ka Sool min o bidibisi kpi, ka bɛ daa yi n-zo ka chɛ bɛ tinsi, ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti be di ni.
en: When the Israelites across the valley and across the Jordan learned that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. So the Philistines came and occupied the towns.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya biɛr biɛɣu zaa mini yɛmbimbiɛri ni bilikɔnsi ni nyuli zabbu zaa ni munaafichi niŋbu zaa yi biɛhigu ni.
en: So then, stop doing anything to hurt others. Dont lie anymore, and stop trying to fool people. Dont be jealous or say bad things about others.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus replied, Watch out that no one deceives you.

dag: ka yɛra, Yawɛ bi nya; Yaakubu Naawuni maa ku baŋ.
en: Then they say, The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti lo tɔbu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni yi tuhi yi dimnim bɛn muɣisiri ya, di saha yin piɛbimiya kika biɛɣu, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ teei yi yɛla, ka tiligi ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni.
en: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord , will hear it and rescue you.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka ka dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni, ka mali yɛm ni baŋsim din ni tooi bɔhim baŋ viɛnyɛliŋga; ka bɛ zaŋ ba niŋ nayili ka bɛ tumdi tuma. Ashpɛnaz n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhi ba Babilɔnnim yɛtɔɣa karimbu mini di sabbu.
en: The king said, They must be healthy, handsome, smart, wise, educated, and fit to serve in the royal palace. Teach them how to speak and write our language.

dag: Ka niriba daa ʒiri barinim bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu mini bɛ daamaŋkanim ni na nti sɔŋdi sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi ni Pita ti gariti ka o shilinshia mahim lee lu bɛ ni shɛb zuɣu.
en: As a result, they would even bring the sick out into the main streets and lay them on cots and mats so that at least Peters shadow could fall on some of them as he passed by.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋ o mam maa yihi ti ti ba; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o goli yuŋ maa zaa hal ti neei biɛɣu. Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ zaŋ o bahi ka o chaŋ.
en: But the men would not listen to him. So the Levite took his concubine and put her outside with them. They raped her and abused her all night long and didn't stop until morning.

dag: Ka ti yi kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti doli Masia n-yi taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa ka nya ka ti nyɛla alahichinima kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, di wuhiri ni Masia nyɛla ŋun ʒe alahichi tumbu nyaaŋa? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: We Jews came to Christ to be made right with God, so it is clear that we were sinners too. Does this mean that Christ makes us sinners? Of course not.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun Ɛhud maŋmaŋ daa zani kuɣikpɛra shee din miri Giligal la ŋ-ŋmaligi labi ti yɛli, Naa, m malila ashili yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka naa maa daa yɛl o naazɔnim ni bɛ yima. Ka bɛ zaa daa yiɣis o sani yi.
en: But Ehud himself turned back at the carved stones near Gilgal, went back to Eglon, and said, Your Majesty, I have a secret message for you. So the king ordered his servants, Leave us alone! And they all went out.

dag: Naawuni lo nia ni o zaŋ ashil shɛli din wuhir o daazichi min o jilima pam zaŋ chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim polo n-kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda. Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Masia be yi ni! Dina n-nyɛ yi tahima ni yi min o ni ti laɣim mali Naawuni jilima.
en: God's plan is to make known his secret to his people, this rich and glorious secret which he has for all peoples. And the secret is that Christ is in you, which means that you will share in the glory of God.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima ka di be kaman yi zaŋ yimaŋ tila ti Duuma la.
en: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya kam kpamba: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses gave the following instructions to the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

dag: ka Naawuni jilima yi yi palo Daadam Bia zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni chɛ ka Daadam Bia gba jilima yi palo ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ zuɣu; ka di mi ku yuui ka o chɛ ka o nya jilima maa.
en: And if God's glory is revealed through him, then God will reveal the glory of the Son of Man in himself, and he will do so at once.

dag: amaa ka o daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa. Bɛ daa kul ʒiɛla tiŋ maa dunol kam ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa gu ni bɛ ku o.
en: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.

dag: N yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ mi ni yi di chɛ ka so zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa yɔhim ya.
en: I tell you, then, do not let anyone deceive you with false arguments, no matter how good they seem to be.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, Wuhim ti a yuli, ka a yɛligu maa ti niŋ pali ka ti ti a jilima.
en: Manoah said to the LORDs messenger, Whats your name, so that we may honor you when your words come true.
