dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba tiŋ maa puuni Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad.
en: He sent messengers to Ahab, Israels king, inside Samaria.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih ayopɔin la zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs.

dag: A pun mali paɣa? Di bɔri soli ni a yih o. A na ka paɣa? Di bo paɣa.
en: Do you have a wife? Then don't try to get rid of her. Are you unmarried? Then don't look for a wife.

dag: Dama o daa maanila Damaskusnim bɛn daa tuhi nyaŋ o la buɣa, ka yɛli, Siria buɣa maa n-daa sɔŋ Siria nanim maa ka bɛ tuhi nyaŋ ma maa, n gba ni maani ba ka bɛ sɔŋ ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ daa lee tahila mbusim na ti luhi o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: by sacrificing to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him. Since the gods of Arams kings are helping them, he said, Ill sacrifice to them too, so that they will help me. But they became the ruin of both him and all Israel.

dag: Kɛnan daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pia ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Kenan lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Ti paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋ ti niŋ ti dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ bahi ti yoli ŋɔ.
en: Let's praise the Lord ! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa daa vaai yiɣisi tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm kɔbil shɛli din daa do di dunol shee maa nti tooi di kom na ti ti Dauda. Amaa ka o zaɣisi li nyubu, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Naawuni.
en: The three famous soldiers forced their way through the Philistine camp, drew some water from the well, and brought it back to David. But he would not drink it; instead he poured it out as an offering to the Lord.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa, ka a wuntia zaligunim zaa nyɛla din kul ni be sahakam.
en: The first thing to know about your word is that it is true and that all your righteous rules last forever.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋda. N Duuma, nyini ka n suhiri ni a zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I called to you, Lord ; I begged for your help:.

dag: Shɛbuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Musa bia Gɛrishom mi bia la n-daa nyɛ kpɛm ŋun su azichinim fukumsi.
en: Shubael was the leader responsible for the valuable things kept in the Temple. Shubael was Gershoms son. Gershom was Moses son.

dag: Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o, amaa o ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: The LORD protects all who love him, but he destroys every wicked person.

dag: Ifriimnim gba kpɛla buɣ jɛmbo ni, chɛliya ba.
en: Ephraim is associated with idols— let him alone!.

dag: So shɛŋa din kuni Ziɔn kumdimi, dama so bi lan kanna ti puhiri churi. Bɛ chɛ o dunɔdaya zaa bahi, ka o maligumaaniba ŋuhira. O paɣisara malila nandahima; o nya naŋgbantom pam.
en: No one comes to the Temple now to worship on the holy days. The young women who sang there suffer, and the priests can only groan. The city gates stand empty, and Zion is in agony.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi tuumbiɛri galisiya, ka yi daalahichi gba galisi pam. Yi nahindi wuntizɔriba, ka diri birapu, ka kariti tarimba bahira.
en: I know how terrible your sins are and how many crimes you have committed. You persecute good people, take bribes, and prevent the poor from getting justice in the courts.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tintariga kpaa din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha bee n-fa kpibisi palo.
en: Dont remove an ancient boundary marker; dont invade the fields of orphans.

dag: Kɔhat daa malila bidibisi anahi, Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath had four sons. They were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: ka zaŋ kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛbih ayopɔin maa zaɣ yini kam zuɣu;.
en: and cups with each of the lambs.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa ŋme n-kari Anaki bidibis ata bɛn daa nyɛ: Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ ŋun Anaki zuliya la bahi.
en: Caleb removed the three sons of Anak from there: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. They were the offspring of Anak.

dag: Gbibi ma kaman nimbil biɛlim la; ka zaŋm ma sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim ni.
en: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka niŋdi yɛda binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka mali tahima binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan niŋdi ania binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Love never gives up on people. It never stops trusting, never loses hope, and never quits.

dag: O suhu kul yɛla yi zaa nyabu zuɣu, ka o suhu bi doya, dama yi daa wum ni o biɛra.
en: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.

dag: Naomi min o bia paɣ Rut ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab paɣ la ni daa yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Bɛtilihɛm na shɛm m-bala. Chi mi chɛbu piligibu saha ka bɛ daa paai Bɛtilihɛm maa.
en: This, then, was how Naomi came back from Moab with Ruth, her Moabite daughter-in-law. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the barley harvest was just beginning.

dag: So na ʒi n-chaŋ alizanda ni naɣila Daadam Bia ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: And no one has ever gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from heaven.

dag: O ni daa niŋ lala maa ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli ni yi gbib la shɛhira ʒim.
en: He told the people, With this blood God makes his agreement with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum maa ni daa ti lu n-gili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa puuni saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ yooi bindira duri maa zaa n-kɔhiri bindira maa Ijiptinim zaa zuɣu, dama kum maa daa miiya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The famine became bad everywhere in Egypt, so Joseph opened the storehouses and sold the grain to the Egyptians.

dag: Ɛba ni daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Peleg was born, Eber lived another years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan gbaai chandi n-kana ti ti o suɣa zali Ɛda pii tooni.
en: Jacob moved on and set up his camp on the other side of the tower of Eder.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa nya buŋ yɛno kɔbili kpuɣ li n-zaŋ li ku ninvuɣ tuhili.
en: Samson glanced around and spotted the jawbone of a donkey. The jawbone had not yet dried out, so it was still hard and heavy. Samson grabbed it and started hitting Philistines—he killed , of them!.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Zaawuni ŋɔ, yi ni baŋ ni Yawɛ n-daa shiri yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: So Moses and Aaron said to the Israelites, Tonight you will see the power of the Lord . You will know that he is the one who brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka miriya ka yi deei pakoli chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o.
en: You must make sure that foreigners and orphans are treated fairly. And you must never take clothes from a widow as security.

dag: Daba ayɔbu ka yi ni zaŋ tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili titali, ka nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di bi simdi ni yi tum tuma dindali, di nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Work for six days, but the seventh day, the Sabbath, will be a special day of rest, a holy meeting. You must not do any work. It is a day of rest to honor the Lord in all your homes.

dag: ni teebul la mini di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi.
en: the table and its poles, all the things on the table, and the special bread on the table;.

dag: N lan mali salin shɛli nuhi tuun baŋsimnim ni ti yɛn zaŋ tum salima tuma mini anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋ tum anzinfa tuma. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ omaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka ti binshɛli ka di nyɛla o suhuyubu zuɣu.
en: and for all the objects which the skilled workers are to make. Now who else is willing to give a generous offering to the Lord .

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka binshɛɣukam zaa lee niŋdi dɛde ka doli soli.
en: But everything should be done in a way that is right and orderly.

dag: Yi ni tooi lan da saan shɛb mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani mini bɛ malibu ni dɔɣi bi shɛb yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ sani, ka bɛ leei yi sulinsi.
en: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.

dag: Dama naa maa niŋla Yawɛ naani; ka Zallakudura Naa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu chɛ ka binshɛli ku tooi vuug o.
en: Because the king trusts the LORD, and because of the Most Highs faithful love, he will not stumble.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm zuɣulaannim zaa bɛn daa be pii la ni wum lala, ka zo nti kpe Ɛlibɛrit jɛmbu duu ti sɔɣi.
en: Earlier that day, the leaders of the temple of El Berith at Shechem had heard about the attack. So they went into the temple fortress.

dag: ka di pala o kandina maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa suhumaabo shɛli o ni daa nya yi san la gba zuɣu. O daa yɛli ti yi suhuri ni ye n nyabu zuɣu shɛm yɛla mini yi suhusaɣiŋgu ni yi baɣa ni be n ni shɛm gba yɛla, ka di daa chɛ ka n suhu maan paligi pahi.
en: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.

dag: Amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tuma maa daa lan pahi, ka o lan teeg o bilim saha o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla.
en: But she added to her promiscuities, bringing to mind her youthful days when she was a prostitute in the land of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka Sukɔt kpamba daa bɔh o, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu.
en: But the officials of Succoth replied, Havent you already almost gotten your hands on Zebah and Zalmunna? Why should we give food to your army now.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Kish, o daa nyɛla Abiɛl bia, ka Abiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛro bia, ka Zɛro nyɛ Bɛkɔrat bia, ka Bɛkɔrat mi daa nyɛ Afia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la bia, o daa mali buni pam.
en: Kish was an important man from the tribe of Benjamin. He was the son of Abiel. Abiel was the son of Zeror. Zeror was the son of Becorath. Becorath was the son of Aphiah, a man from Benjamin.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa puuni zuliya kam daa bahi me bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa n-zaŋ zalizali Samarianim ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la. Zuliya kam daa me buɣa maa zalizal la bɛ ni be tin shɛŋa ni.
en: But all those people made gods of their own. They put them in the temples at the high places that the people of Samaria had made. They did this wherever they lived.

dag: Ka bɛ ni teeri nam zuɣupiligu maa yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya ni Jɔsia n-yɛn su di fukumsi.
en: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Yawɛ zoli maa gbini n-lu soli chaŋ daba ata chandi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la n-daŋ tooni chaŋ daba ata chandi ni di ti bo dooshee ti ba.
en: So they began traveling from the mountain of the Lord . The priests took the Box of the Lord s Agreement and walked in front of the people. They carried the Holy Box for three days, looking for a place to camp.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ yɛda. Bɛ ni daa wum ni Yawɛ baɣa be Izraɛlnim ni ka nya bɛ wahala maa, ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: and everyone believed. They bowed down and worshiped the Lord because they knew that he had seen their suffering and was going to help them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinim mini Jɛturinim ni Nafishinim ni Nɔdabinima.
en: They started a war against the Hagrites and the people of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu kul yɛmi ni n chɛ ka o lab kuli yi sanna, ka yi ti nya o ka yi suhuri paligi yaha, ka man gba nandahima vuui.
en: So I want very much to send him to you. When you see him, you can be happy. And I can stop worrying about you.

dag: N ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni juɣu, ka ŋmani dabari ni viɣu.
en: I am like a lonely owl in the desert.

dag: Lala ka n yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Zaŋm a nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni, ka jɛm o min o niriba ka be.
en: I gave the same message to King Zedekiah of Judah. I said, Zedekiah, you must place your neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and obey him. If you serve the king of Babylon and his people, you will live.

dag: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni puhiri chuɣu yili shɛli ni ka a mini ba ti ʒini n-di ka nyu.
en: Jeremiah, dont go into a house where the people are having a party. Dont go into that house and sit down to eat and drink.

dag: Ka niriba ni ʒini nimaani ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri ku lan zɔhiri mbusim shɛli ti paai ba m-bahi ba yoli zuɣu.
en: People will dwell in it; it will never again be destroyed. Jerusalem will dwell securely.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn saɣim Judanim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara pam la.
en: The LORD proclaims: In the same way I will ruin the brazen pride of Judah and Jerusalem!.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: and I want you to be like me.

dag: Naawuni, a yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli! Ninsalinim zaa ni tooi sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim.
en: How precious, O God, is your constant love! We find protection under the shadow of your wings.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bo bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi sil shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni ka na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni la.
en: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that was dug in a wall of rock. This tomb had never been used before.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi ni.
en: He built altars for all the groups of stars in the two yards of the Lord s Temple.

dag: Buɣim mini nyɔhi ni chilibi din daa yiri yuri maa noya ni maa na n-daa nyɛ alɔbo diba ata din ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la;.
en: A third of the human race was killed by those three plagues: the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur coming out of the horses' mouths.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tooi pahi n zuɣu ka ti tuhi tɔb shɛli yi ni daa nya ka n tuhira, ka wum ni n na kul tuhiri li pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: Now you can take part with me in the battle. It is the same battle you saw me fighting in the past, and as you hear, the one I am fighting still.

dag: Naawuni yɛm puuni o bi chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim tooi zaŋ bɛ yɛm baŋ ŋun Naawuni; dina n-chɛ ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini ni o zaŋ ti ni yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu shɛli din ŋmani jɛrilim ŋɔ n-tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: This is what God in his wisdom decided: Since the world did not find him through its own wisdom, he used the message that sounds foolish to save those who believe it.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili din galisi pam la ni, ka di kom nyuui zaa ni di mali soli ti wulimpuhili polo nanima.
en: Then the sixth angel poured his bowl on the great river Euphrates. Its water was dried up so that the way was ready for the kings from the east.

dag: Di saha ka Amalɛknim mini Keenannim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi maa ni daa yina ti lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba n-kari ba hal ni Hɔrima.
en: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived there attacked and defeated them, and pursued them as far as Hormah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu min o mabihi maa ni bɛ ʒiɛman ni niriba zaa daa ti kpi.
en: Later, Joseph, his brothers, and all the people of that generation died.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa ʒini bɛ tinsi ni naai nyaaŋa, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka niriba maa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm naŋgban yini.
en: By the seventh month the people of Israel were all settled in their towns. Then they all assembled in Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛlim din beni, karimi saria ni wuntizɔbo. Zabimi faranim mini nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Speak out in order to judge with righteousness and to defend the needy and the poor.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa po pɔri ashilɔni Jɛrimia sani yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nyɛvili ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku ku a, m mi ku zaŋ a niŋ bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a maa nuu ni.
en: So King Zedekiah promised me in secret, I swear by the living God, the God who gave us life, that I will not put you to death or hand you over to the men who want to kill you.

dag: Di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, kul teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zaa shɛm la yɛla.
en: You must not be afraid of them. You must remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all the people of Egypt.

dag: Wula ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nyaaŋa ni tooi lan labi niŋ tuuba yaha? Bɔzuɣu? Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa pun be Naawuni neesim ni, ka nyɛ bɛn daa pun deei Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka baŋ alizanda ni pini ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Because its impossible to restore people to changed hearts and lives who turn away once they have seen the light, tasted the heavenly gift, become partners with the Holy Spirit.

dag: ka daa doli Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri n-yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: He went straight to the synagogues and began to preach that Jesus was the Son of God.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o duhi ya, ka yi nyari paɣibu mini yudua ni jilima n-gari o ni nam zuliya shɛb zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ti niŋ zuliya kasi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: in order to set you high above all the other nations that he made in praise, fame, and honor; and so that you are a people holy to the LORD your God, just as he said you would be.

dag: N di darigi bɛ tibili yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu? Ka n di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri? n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Shouldn't I punish them for these things and take revenge on a nation such as this?.

dag: ni Bɛtilɛbaut ni Sharuhɛn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaata m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen. There were towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni chɛ ka yi tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ n sani, dama yi yi ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, di ni leei tɔna gbahi ya.
en: Dont let them stay in your country. If you let them stay, they will be like a trap to you—they will cause you to sin against me. And you will begin worshiping their gods.

dag: Kum yi mal a dimnima, nyin tim ba bindirigu ka bɛ di, ka kɔnyuri yi mali ba, nyin tim ba kom ka bɛ nyu;.
en: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.

dag: N zaŋ n faako tibu mirina yomyom. N tiliginsim be soli, n ni bo yɛlimaŋli soli ti niriba. Bɛn be katiŋ ha kul guhiri ma mi, ka niŋ n yaa naani.
en: I will soon save you and show that I am fair. I will use my power and judge all nations. All the faraway places are waiting for me. They wait for my power to help them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa paɣ o binyɛra ka su kom, ka naanyi kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee; amaa ka maligumaana maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: Then the priest must wash himself and his clothes with water. Then he must come back into the camp. He will be unclean until evening.

dag: Baptaizibu shɛli n-na ʒe n-guli ma; di mi nyɛla din chɛ ka n suhu bi doya shee di ti niŋ naai.
en: I have a baptism to receive, and how distressed I am until it is over!.

dag: ka a ti yeei Aduna kpariti n-zaŋ li yɛl o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna kpi nimaani n-chaŋ o yaannim sani.
en: Then take Aaron's priestly robe from him and place it on Eleazar. Aaron will die there.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani din vuhiri leei wubilim tiŋgbani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: He made rich soil become a salty wasteland because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

dag: Yɔnahu ni saɣi tum a tuma? O ni saɣi gbe a naɣikpahi ni yuŋ?.
en: Will a wild ox work for you? Is he willing to spend the night in your stable?.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lan lih o, ka yum maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: The priest must look, and if the rash has spread, he must announce that the person is unclean. The disease is leprosy.

dag: dama ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira.
en: because our God really is a consuming fire.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mɛshulɛmɛt. O daa nyɛla Haruzi ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtiba nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Amon was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. His mother Meshullemeth was the daughter of Haruz from Jotbah.

dag: O daa malila paɣiba kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ nabipuɣinsi, ka mali mamanim mi kɔbisita; ka o paɣiba maa daa ti chɛ ka o birigi.
en: He had wives who were the daughters of leaders from other nations. He also had slave women who were like wives to him. His wives caused him to turn away from God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣirina, ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As they came down the mountain, Jesus ordered them, Don't tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has risen from death.

dag: Zaŋmi dam din kpɛma n-ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn kpi, ka zaŋ wain ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nandahima pam ni.
en: Alcohol is for people who are dying, for those who are in misery.

dag: Ka Aduna bia Ɛliɛza gba daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Gibia fɔntin shɛli din be Ifriim zoya tiŋgban ni, ka o daa zaŋ li ti o bia Finɛhas la.
en: When Eleazar the priest died, he was buried in the hill country of Ephraim on a hill that belonged to his son Phinehas.

dag: Dinzuɣu o yidana maa yi na be o nyɛvil ni ka o chaŋ ti kul do so, bɛ ni bol o zinaniŋda; amaa o yidana maa yi kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni; ka o yi lan kul do so, dindina o pala zinaniŋda.
en: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.

dag: Ilaija ni daa wum li saha shɛli, o daa zaŋla o binyɛrigu pɔb o nina yi nti ʒe vokabili maa dunol ni. Nyama, ka kukoli maa daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: When Elijah heard the voice, he used his coat to cover his face and went to the entrance to the cave and stood there. Then a voice said to him, Elijah, why are you here.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi bela Babilɔn, ka bɛ gba zaŋ ya leei bɛ daba yoli. Ka bɛn sun ya maa nyuri bara ka diri dari, ka kul maani ma ansarisi sahakam, ka ʒiɛmdi n yuli dabisili kam.
en: And now what have I here? says the LORD. My people are taken away for nothing. Their rulers wail, says the LORD, and continually all day long my name is despised.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri din nyaɣisa ni leei faralana, ka ŋunkam yuri wain mini kpam ku leei bundana.
en: Indulging in luxuries, wine, and rich food will never make you wealthy.

dag: N yi ti tim Aritimas bee Tikikus a sanna, nyin kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna Nikɔpolis, dama n loya ni m be nimaani kikaa saha.
en: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me in Nicopolis, because I have decided to spend the winter there.

dag: Daadam, tin shɛli nim yi bi ʒe yim ni mani ka tum alahichi, ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ka m mɔŋ ba bindirigu, ka chɛ ka kum lu bɛ zuɣu n-kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: Human one, suppose a land sins against me by acting faithlessly, so that I use my power against it, break off its food supply, let famine run rampant, and eliminate both humans and animals.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ba, M bɔri ni n ŋahi ya la ŋahili, ka yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni zaŋ chaŋ amiliya chuɣu daba ayopɔin ŋɔ dali, n ni tin ya silinchi kpar suma pihita mini binyɛr sun shɛŋa din nyɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra.
en: Then Samson said to the men, I want to tell you a story. This party will last for seven days. Try to find the answer during that time. If you can answer the riddle in that time, I will give you linen shirts and changes of clothes.

dag: dama o ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ titali ti Duuma sani. O ti ku nyu wain bee binnyura din mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti pal o la saha shɛl o ma ni dɔɣ o.
en: He will be a great man for the Lord. He will never drink wine or beer. Even before he is born, he will be filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Bɛ pihim kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ niriba galisi mini bɛn daŋ niriba pɔra.
en: Land will be given to each tribe—large and small. And you will throw lots to make the decisions.

dag: Joyakim saha la, maligumaaniba dunoya dɔɣirikpamba n-daa bɔŋɔ: Mɛraya n-daa nyɛ Sɛraya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Hanania daa nyɛ Jɛrimia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: These were the heads of the priestly families in the days of Joiakim: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah.

dag: Ka Giliad sapashinnim daa bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni chaŋ ti piligi Ammɔnnim ŋɔ tuhibu? Dilan ni leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: The leaders of the people living in the area of Gilead said, Whoever leads us in the attack against the Ammonites will become the head of all the people living in Gilead.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi suhigu nyɛla din tiɣir o nini.
en: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa.
en: Jesus said to them, Come with me, and I will teach you to catch people.

dag: Fiɛbiga mini zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla din tiri yɛm, amaa bɛ ni chɛ bi so bahi, dihirila o ma vi.
en: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.

dag: O chɛ ka buɣim sal nɛma mini chilibi buɣim kul luri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu; ka zaŋdi pɔhim tulli darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: He sends down flaming coals and burning sulfur on the wicked; he punishes them with scorching winds.

dag: o chanimi nti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani; ka dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam n-gari di ni daa pun be shɛm; lala nti yɛn niŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ nim gba.
en: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today.

dag: Ka nyini Ziɔn Zoli, din nyɛ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni be kaman piɛgula n-lihiri o niriba ŋɔ, a ni ti lan nya nam shɛli a ni daa pun su la.
en: And you, Tower of Flocks, your time will come. Ophel, hill of Zion, you will again have the right to rule. Yes, the kingdom will be in Jerusalem as it was in the past.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛl o, Zaŋm a bigaŋ Yisahaku so a ni yuri pam la n-chaŋ Mɔria tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la nimaani n ni ti yɛn wuh a zo shɛli zuɣu.
en: Then God said, Take your son to the land of Moriah and kill your son there as a sacrifice for me. This must be Isaac, your only son, the one you love. Use him as a burnt offering on one of the mountains there. I will tell you which mountain.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a ku ninsala, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee.
en: You have heard that it was said to our people long ago, You must not murder anyone. Any person who commits murder will be judged.

dag: Ti mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala din galisi shɛm, lala ka ti lan laɣindi nyari suhumaabo din galisi Masia zuɣu.
en: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Abib goli ŋɔ ni ka yi yɛn yi.
en: Today, in the month of Abib, you are leaving Egypt.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni ŋme n-wurim o dimnim la zuɣuri, o ni saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ka kul doli bɛ daalahichi soya la zuɣutalisi.
en: God will surely break the heads of his enemies, of those who persist in their sinful ways.

dag: Judanim bɛn daa be Mɔab mini bɛn daa be Ammɔnnim sani ni bɛn daa be Ɛdom ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni la zaa ni daa wum ni Babilɔn naa chɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim niŋ Juda, ka zaŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa la leei bɛ Gomna maa.
en: In the same way, all the Judeans living in Moab, Ammon, Edom, and in other countries heard that the king of Babylon had left a few people in the land and that he had put Gedaliah, Ahikams son and Shaphans grandson, in charge of them.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli naa N ni daa be n ya ka wum a tuma min a yɛm yɛla shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Then she said to King Solomon, The stories I heard in my country about your great works and your wisdom are true.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani. O daa bi siɣis omaŋ anab Jɛrimia ŋun daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o la sani.
en: He disobeyed the Lord his God and refused to change his ways, even after a warning from Jeremiah, the Lord 's prophet.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn tumla tuun pala. Di niŋdi pumpɔŋɔ gba; yi bi nya li? N yɛn ŋmɛla soli sɔŋ mɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: Watch for the new thing I am going to do. It is happening already—you can see it now! I will make a road through the wilderness and give you streams of water there.

dag: Amaa nahu maa yi pun ʒiɛri niriba ka bɛ yɛl o lana ka o bi niŋ o fukumsi, ka chɛ ka o ti ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, di simdi ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka ku nahu maa lan gba.
en: But if the bull had been in the habit of attacking people and its owner had been warned, but did not keep it penned up—then if it gores someone to death, it is to be stoned, and its owner is to be put to death also.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Antiɔk Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri.
en: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun mi daa deei pɔŋ tuhili la ŋun daa yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, m pun mi a halli ni nyɛ shɛm, dama a dirila a ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri a ni bi di atam shɛli wahala;.
en: Now the one who had received one valuable coin came and said, Master, I knew that you are a hard man. You harvest grain where you havent sown. You gather crops where you havent spread seed.

dag: O ni daa ka ti sanna maa o daa zaŋla Pool shɛlɔrigu lo omaŋmaŋ nuhi min o naba ka yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, Lala ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ti yɛn lo ninvuɣ so ŋun su shɛlɔrigu ŋɔ n-zaŋ o niŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He came to us, took Paul's belt, tied up his own feet and hands with it, and said, This is what the Holy Spirit says: The owner of this belt will be tied up in this way by the Jews in Jerusalem, and they will hand him over to the Gentiles.

dag: ni Amɔrinim ni Keenannim ni Gɛrigashinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbana la zaa.
en: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.

dag: Niriba pam beni n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra: Yawɛ, niŋm alibarika niŋ ti ni! Niŋm ti nirilim.
en: Many people say, We cant find goodness anywhere. The light of your face has left us, LORD.

dag: N niriba maa ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn bɔrigi, bɛn guli ba taɣi ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋ-ŋmaligiri ba gindi zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu, ka bɛ tam bɛ biɛhigu shee yɛla.
en: My people are like sheep whose shepherds have let them get lost in the mountains. They have wandered like sheep from one mountain to another, and they have forgotten where their home is.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. A sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord ! I come to you for safety.

dag: N kpuɣila n nuhi wuh a n-suhir a, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ ni bɔri kom shɛm la.
en: I stretch out my hands to you; my whole being is like dry dirt, thirsting for you. Selah.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni nam binshɛŋa galisiya pam. A yɛm puuni ka a nam di zaa. A binnɛma n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Lord , you have made so many things! How wisely you made them all! The earth is filled with your creatures.

dag: N ku chɛ a bee n-zo a nambɔɣu, n ni darigi a tibili a tuma zuɣu saha shɛli a ni tum din chihiri shɛli ni na be a kɔbili ni maa. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will not spare you or show you any mercy. I am going to punish you for the disgusting things you have done, so that you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yɛhudianima adiini kali soli dolibu puuni kɔsins ayɔbu daa ʒe nimaani bɛ ni paɣibu zuɣu, ka di zaa zaɣ yiniyini daa naan tooi deei ko guŋgɔna ayɔbuyɔbu bee ayopɔinpɔin.
en: Nearby were six stone water jars used for the Jewish cleansing ritual, each able to hold about twenty or thirty gallons.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ ni di wuhi ni n kɔŋla shɛli, dama m bɔhim ni n chɛ ka n nini tiɣi n ni mali shɛli.
en: Im not saying this because I need anything, for I have learned how to be content in any circumstance.

dag: Yi daa yi niŋdi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋuni n-lee kari ya ni yi di doli yɛlimaŋli maa?.
en: You were running well—who stopped you from obeying the truth?.

dag: Hal bihi tuma ni ka niriba baŋdi bɛ ni nyɛ shɛba, bɛ tuma yi nyɛla din viɛl ka tuhi.
en: Even children show what they are by what they do; you can tell if they are honest and good.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani ŋɔ na.
en: Then Huldah said to them, The Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me:.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la pahi maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa tim salo pam shɛba ka bɛ nyaɣiri takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi la dii paana.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve apostles came there. He had a big crowd of people with him, all carrying swords and clubs. They had been sent from the leading priests and the older leaders of the people.

dag: Ti yaannim daa di bindiri shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la. Di sabiya: O daa ti ba bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na ka bɛ di. .
en: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, God gave them bread from heaven to eat. .

dag: Ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a. Kɔhim a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: When Jesus heard this, he said to the leader, But there is still one thing you need to do. Sell everything you have and give the money to those who are poor. You will have riches in heaven. Then come and follow me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa duh o pam zaŋ o ʒili jilima ʒiishee, ka ti o yuli din tibisi gari yuli kam.
en: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.

dag: niriba mini nanim yi ti laɣim ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ.
en: when all people are gathered together— all kingdoms—to serve the LORD.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣirina, ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As Jesus and the followers were walking back down the mountain, he gave them these instructions: Dont tell anyone about what you saw on the mountain. Wait until after the Son of Man rises from death. Then you can tell people what you saw.

dag: ka nya ka gɔhi n-kul zooi lim li; ka yihim lan zibigi di ni, ka di kuɣa gooni lu n-doya.
en: They were full of thorn bushes and overgrown with weeds. The stone wall around them had fallen down.

dag: ka Shimia nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Baasɛya bia, ka Baasɛya nyɛ Malikija bia.
en: son of Michael son of Baaseiah son of Malchijah.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ ni di nyɛla talahi ni Masia di wahala n-leei ŋun tuui neei kum ni, ka moli tiliginsim lahibal suŋ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani n-neei bɛ nina.
en: that the Messiah must suffer and be the first one to rise from death, to announce the light of salvation to the Jews and to the Gentiles.

dag: Yawɛ, n gbib a zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka n di vi.
en: I follow your rules closely, Lord . Dont let me be put to shame.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa bi saɣi bahi omaŋ ti ba, dama o daa mi din be ninsal kam suhu ni.
en: But Jesus didnt trust himself to them because he knew all people.

dag: Guhimi Yawɛ, niŋmi yaa ka mali suhukpeeni. Guhimi Yawɛ!.
en: Trust in the Lord . Have faith, do not despair. Trust in the Lord .

dag: ka koma maa daa labina ti lim Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ni o tɔbbihi bɛn daa doli Izraɛlnim maa siɣi teeku maa ni zaa, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: The water returned to its normal level and covered the chariots and horse soldiers. Pharaohs army had been chasing the Israelites, but that army was destroyed. None of them survived!.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa ni daa yiri maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa n-kum pam. Ka Naa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ du, ka o min o niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: The people cried loudly as David's followers left. The king crossed Kidron Brook, followed by his men, and together they went out toward the wilderness.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa na bi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni faashee o ni daa ti lab o jilima shee la nyaaŋa, ka bɛ naanyi teei ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa pun sabimi zan o zuɣu, ka di mi shiri niŋ o lala.
en: His disciples didnt understand these things at first. After he was glorified, they remembered that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Zalimɔna maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Punɔn.
en: They marched from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

dag: Kum mihi daa vili ma, ka kokpɛɣu din ni di nir varisi ma.
en: Death had its ropes wrapped around me. A deadly flood was carrying me away.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa niŋ a daalikaulinim yɛda, ka yili yila paɣ a.
en: Then his people believed his promises and sang praises to him.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku lan kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ ma bee n-lan zaŋ bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ zaa ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri. Di saha bɛ ni ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni be a sani ka ni chɛ ka a nya nasara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu ni kaman o ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: In the resurrection, whose wife will she be? All seven were married to her.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha?.
en: The High Priest tore his robes and said, We don't need any more witnesses!.

dag: Hamɛdata ŋun daa yi Agag zuliya ni na bia Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim la n-daa ti chɛ ka bɛ pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya, ka ku Yɛhudianima. O daa lomi ni o bahi ba yoli zaa.
en: Haman son of Hammedatha—the descendant of Agag and the enemy of the Jewish people—had cast lots to determine the day for destroying the Jews; he had planned to wipe them out.

dag: O ni ti ʒini kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun paɣiri neeri anzinfa la; o ni ti paɣi neei Lɛvi zuliya kaman bɛ ni paɣiri neeri salima mini anzinfa shɛm la, hal ka bɛ ti zaŋ pina din tuhi ti Yawɛ.
en: He will sit as a refiner and a purifier of silver. He will purify the Levites and refine them like gold and silver. They will belong to the LORD, presenting a righteous offering.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ pun ku gbuɣima mini kunduna, ka Filistia do so ŋun bi guni ŋɔ gba ni lee bɛ ni yino, dama o ta Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ tɔbbihi daɣiri.
en: Your servant has fought both lions and bears. This uncircumcised Philistine will be just like one of them because he has insulted the army of the living God.

dag: Dama bɛ chaŋ Asiria kaman yɔɣuni buntaaŋa ŋun gɔr o ko la. I friimnim darila niriba ni bɛ sɔŋdi ba.
en: Stubborn as wild donkeys, the people of Israel go their own way. They have gone off to seek help from Assyria and have paid other nations to protect them.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai Sirakus n-zani nimaani niŋ daba ata.
en: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.

dag: O yi tihim, buɣim n-nyaɣisira, ka o nina ŋmani wuntaŋ m-puhirina asiba la.
en: His sneezes emit flashes of light; his eyes are like dawns rays.

dag: Bɛ kpamba n-daa nyɛ Ahiɛza mini Jɔash bɛn daa nyɛ Shɛmaa Gibia nir bihi la. Bɛn pahi n-daa nyɛ Jɛziɛl mini Pɛlɛt bɛn daa nyɛ Azimavɛt bihi la ni Bɛraka ni Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ Anatɔt nir la.
en: Ahiezer was the leader, then Joash, both Shemaahs sons from Gibeah; Jeziel and Pelet, Azmaveths sons; Beracah; Jehu of Anathoth.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ba.
en: The wicked plot against good people and glare at them with hate.

dag: Vi bi mali ma lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu, dama lahibal suŋ maa nyɛla Naawuni yiko din tiligiri ŋunkam niŋ li yɛda; Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: I am proud of the Good News, because it is the power God uses to save everyone who believes—to save the Jews first, and now to save those who are not Jews.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛli din nyɛ Saimɔn din ni, ka balim o ni o tirisim li zal o tooni biɛla. Ka o daa ʒini ŋariŋ maa ni wuhiri niriba maa.
en: Jesus got into one of the boats—it belonged to Simon—and asked him to push off a little from the shore. Jesus sat in the boat and taught the crowd.

dag: bɛn nyɛ yuun pihitata zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinunu, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi tum tuma ka ʒi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni ʒiya.
en: those to years old who were eligible to do the work and to carry the load of the meeting tent.

dag: Lɛvinim maa shɛb talahi tuma daa nyɛla bɛ su tah shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni kalibu fukumsi. Bɛ daa yi yɛn zaŋ li yi ni bɛ daa yi ti zaŋ li labisina.
en: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.

dag: Yi niŋdi wain paani pipihi n-nyura, ka niŋdi tulaale viɛla n-niŋdi yimaŋa, amaa ka yi baɣa ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli din paai Yisifu zuliya ŋɔ ni.
en: who drink bowls of wine, put the best of oils on themselves, but who arent grieved over the ruin of Joseph!.

dag: Di saha Naa Dauda daa bela zoli zuɣu birini puuni, ka Filistia tɔbbihi mi do Bɛtilihɛm.
en: At that time, David was in the fortress, and a Philistine fort was in Bethlehem.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi bi lan mali suhupiɛlli kaman yi ni daa pun mali shɛm la? N din ya shɛhira ni di yi di daa naan nani, yi daa naan kpaɣi yimaŋmaŋ nina ti ma.
en: You were so happy! What has happened? I myself can say that you would have taken out your own eyes, if you could, and given them to me.

dag: Ka Sool ba Kish bunsi daa ti bɔrigi dahin shɛli ka o yɛl o bia Sool, Zaŋmi tumtumdiba ŋɔ ni yino pah amaŋ zuɣu ka yi chaŋ ti bo bunsi maa shee.
en: Some donkeys belonging to Kish had wandered off, so he said to Saul, Take one of the servants with you and go and look for the donkeys.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N tum alahichi, dama m bi mi ni a ʒiɛla sol ni gu ma soli. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, di yi bi luhi a sani, n ni ŋmaligi labi kuli.
en: Balaam said to the LORDs messenger, Ive sinned, because I didnt know that you were standing against me in the road. Now, if you think its wrong, Ill go back.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be alizanda ni la daa yooi ka o Daalikauli Adaka la be di puuni; ka saa daa nyaɣisiri ka tahira, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda, ka sakuɣ kara luri na.
en: Then Gods temple in heaven was opened, and the chest containing his covenant appeared in his temple. There were lightning, voices, thunder, an earthquake, and large hail.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibisi ni daa nyɛ kpamba gari Itama bidibisi zuɣu ka bɛ daa piri ba la ʒiibupinaayɔbu zuɣu kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm, ka daa piri Itama bidibisi mi ʒiibunii zuɣu.
en: Eleazar's descendants were divided into groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni farigudeera maa daa yi n-kuli ka yi taali ni gari ŋun la; dinzuɣu ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ; ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: I tell you, said Jesus, the tax collector, and not the Pharisee, was in the right with God when he went home. For those who make themselves great will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be made great.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, dama di kpɛm pam. Mbusim be bɛ sujee zuɣu, dama ninkuunsi be di ni. N ni woligi ba Yaakubu daŋ ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ luɣilikam ni.
en: Cursed be their anger; it is violent, their rage; it is relentless. Ill divide them up within Jacob and disperse them within Israel.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Remember you were poor slaves in Egypt. That is why I tell you to do these things for the poor.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti namda, ka ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka o nam ti ni ti mali biɛhigu shɛli din ni tumdi tuun sun shɛŋa o ni daa pun zali ni ti tumdi la.
en: God has made us what we are. In Christ Jesus, God made us new people so that we would spend our lives doing the good things he had already planned for us to do.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli Izraɛlnim maa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni nasara la.
en: The Lord made the king so stubborn that he went after them, while the Israelites proudly went on their way.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suhi Naawuni maa nti fo ka bɛ laɣiŋgu maa shee ti gbaai dambu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kpe m-pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message.

dag: Gbaamiya saawara, amaa di ku ku buchi. Tɔɣisimiya gbaai yi ni lo shɛm, amaa di ku zani, dama Naawuni be ti sani.
en: Create a plan, but be frustrated! Speak a word, but it wont stand, for God is with us.

dag: Dindali maa vi ti ku din ya yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka zaɣisi n noli la zuɣu; dama di saha n ni ti yihi karimbaannim bɛn be yi ni ka mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu la, ka yi ti ku lan mali karimbaani n zoli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, Bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili ma yurilim puuni, n ni fa ba bahi. Bɛn mi n yuli, n ni guli ba.
en: God says, Because you are devoted to me, Ill rescue you. Ill protect you because you know my name.

dag: Ka na shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam gba pun di n-ʒini nimaani, ka daa su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣilinim zaa, ka deeri ba farigu.
en: Jerusalem has had powerful kings ruling over it and over the whole area west of the Euphrates River. Their kings received taxes, customs, fees, and tribute.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa kpuɣi paɣiba ayi, ka yino yuli booni Ada, ka yino mi yuli booni Zilla.
en: Lamech took two wives, the first named Adah and the second Zillah.

dag: Yɛm ni ti gul a, ka yɛla baŋbu gba taɣ a.
en: Your insight and understanding will protect you.

dag: Ka sana daa ti paai bundana maa, ka o je ni o piig o piɛri maa ni bee o niɣi maa yino n-niŋ o saani, amaa ka daa chaŋ ti gbaala faralan maa piɛsaa la na nti niŋ o san maa saani.
en: Now a traveler came to visit the rich man, but he wasnt willing to take anything from his own flock or herd to prepare for the guest who had arrived. Instead, he took the poor mans ewe lamb and prepared it for the visitor.

dag: Ka n ni di paai kɔbiliga maa gbinna zuŋɔ, ka n yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, a yi ni ti ma nasara n chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: Today I arrived at the spring, and I said, LORD, God of my master Abraham, if you wish to make the trip Im taking successful.

dag: Ti daa pun bi yɛl a Ijipti ni a chɛl ti baalim ka ti jɛmdi Ijiptinima? Dama ti yi di daa jɛmdi Ijiptinim maa, di di so ti ni yɛn kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: Didnt we tell you the same thing in Egypt? Leave us alone! Let us work for the Egyptians! It would have been better for us to work for the Egyptians than to die in the desert.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa bɛ ku tooi nya.
en: They have mouths, but they cant speak. They have eyes, but they cant see.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ. Ka Yisa daa ʒi omaŋmaŋ dapulli maa hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: He went out, carrying his cross, and came to The Place of the Skull, as it is called.

dag: ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim guli Sur Dunɔdal la, ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim be dunɔdali din be guliba nyaaŋa la zaa n-guli nayili.
en: another third are to stand guard at the Sur Gate, and the other third are to stand guard at the gate behind the other guards.

dag: N ni wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun shɛba ni bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi, ka bɛn gba bi mi ba, ka chɛ ka tɔb lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n ti kpihim bɛ birili.
en: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have heard about, and I will send armies against them until I have completely destroyed them.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛl o, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: Then a voice said to him, Get up, Peter; kill anything here and eat it.

dag: O lan tim ma mi na ni n ti moli ni o ni yɛn tilig o niriba saha shɛl la paaya, ka moli ni o ni yɛn bɔhi biɛri saha shɛl la paaya; o lan tim ma mi na yaha ni n ti maai bɛn fabindi la suhuri.
en: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wumma, Yawɛ piig a ni a me o jɛmbu duu din nyɛ luɣ kasi shee. Mali yaa n-tum di tuma.
en: You must realize that the Lord has chosen you to build his holy Temple. Now do it—and do it with determination.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: When Jesus had finished teaching all these things, he said to his disciples.

dag: Bɛ daa pun bar o la bandi ka lɔr o zoligɔnima, ka o chihiri li ka kabiri bandi maa; ka so ku tooi maag o nini.
en: He had been secured many times with leg irons and chains, but he broke the chains and smashed the leg irons. No one was tough enough to control him.

dag: Ka o yi shini, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi galim o? Ka o yi zaŋ o nini sɔɣi, ninvuɣ so beni ŋun ni tooi nya o? Amaa ŋuna n-su daadamnim mini zuliya kam zaa.
en: If God decided to do nothing at all, no one could criticize him. If he hid his face, we would be helpless.

dag: Ka sokam daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: And so they rested on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kpalim be Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim sani o yiŋa chira ata. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim ni ni o ni daa mali binshɛlikam zaa ni.
en: It stayed there three months, and the Lord blessed Obed Edom's family and everything that belonged to him.

dag: Yisa daa ti chani Jɛrusalɛm n-zaŋ doli Samaria mini Galili sunsuuni garita.
en: Jesus was traveling to Jerusalem. He went from Galilee to Samaria.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi di di zaa din dali maa, di bi simdi ka yi guui shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must eat the whole animal that day. You must not leave any of the meat for the next morning. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa kul o yiŋa Samaria ni sujee ti fo n-ʒiya.
en: So Israels king went to his palace at Samaria, irritated and upset.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n-chɛ ka n kpi zaŋ chaŋ di dolibu polo ni di chɛ ka n tooi be Naawuni zuɣu.
en: It was the law itself that caused me to end my life under the law. I died to the law so that I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti nya a, bɛ ni yɛli, O paɣa m-bala, ka ku ma ka chɛ a.
en: When the Egyptian men see you, they will say, This woman is his wife. Then they will kill me and keep you alive because they want you.

dag: A daa ku ba Ɛndo, ka bɛ niŋgbuna dɔni tiŋgban ni ti pooi.
en: They were destroyed at Endor; they became fertilizer for the ground.

dag: Miri ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka miri ka a zaŋ ʒiŋmabo kpɛh a kɔbili ni.
en: Dont bend the truth or say things that you know are not right.

dag: N ni zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ bɛ ni, ka niŋ ba din viɛla, ka ti lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zani, ka ku lan daai ba luhi. N ni zaŋ ba sa, ka ku lan sibigi ba.
en: I will watch over them and bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not pull them up.

dag: Ti wahala dibu din pɔri ka ku yuui ŋɔ nyɛla din niŋdi shili ni di tahi ti jilima din ka kpee na, ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: We have small troubles for a while now, but these troubles are helping us gain an eternal glory. That eternal glory is much greater than our troubles.

dag: N ni zaŋ daɣiri lab a, ka dih a vi, ka chɛ ka niriba lih a ka mal a ansarisi.
en: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni dini ka yi lee bɔra: Yi bɔri ni n ʒila fiɛbiga ka yi sanna bee yi bɔri ni n ʒila yurilim mini tarimtali kana?.
en: Which do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a whip, or in a spirit of love and gentleness?.

dag: Tihi din vari kul sabigi sahakam, fabilimiya, dama sida tihi luya; ti suma la zaa bahi yoli! Bashan oki tihi, fabilimiya, dama bɛ ŋma nyɔŋ tihi la zaa luhi!.
en: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ɛlim, ka kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani m-miri kom maa.
en: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They camped there by the water.

dag: ni shinshingooro ni wɔɣivaana balibu kam ni napakoli ni zɔŋ.
en: storks, any kind of heron, hoopoes, or bats.

dag: Ka yi ni so yɛl o ni o cham ni suhudoo; ka lan yɛl o ni Naawuni ni chɛ ka o nya n-ye ka di n-tiɣi, amaa ka bi ti o binshɛl din simd o niŋgbuŋ, di buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: What if one of you said, Go in peace! Stay warm! Have a nice meal!? What good is it if you dont actually give them what their body needs?.

dag: Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, a ni nya tibidarigibo, a ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɔh a biɛri ni ti mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Babylon, you will be destroyed. Happy are those who pay you back for what you have done to us—.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni nini daa tiɣi kurimbuni ha niriba.
en: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.

dag: O ni chɛ ka bidibbihi nyɛ bɛ nanima, ka biliɛri su ba.
en: He says, I will put young boys in charge of you. They will be your leaders.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Naawuni daa be Masia ni n-zaŋdi dunianim naari ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa, ka bi lan niŋdi bɛ daalahichi laasabu, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni yɛla niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: I mean that God was in Christ, making peace between the world and himself. In Christ, God did not hold people guilty for their sins. And he gave us this message of peace to tell people.

dag: O yi kana ti gbaag a kpɛhi duu, ka kar a saria, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni?.
en: If God arrests you and brings you to trial, who is there to stop him?.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ n nyɛvili bebu ni zaa. N ni yili yila paɣi n Naawuni hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I will praise the LORD with all my life; I will sing praises to my God as long as I live.

dag: O daa tɔɣis o nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o nam din du n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn maa nama.
en: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa bee o ku tib o, dama bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ nyala o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: The legal experts and the Pharisees were watching him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath. They were looking for a reason to bring charges against him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave Moses the following regulations.

dag: Ka ti daa wum kukoli din yi alizanda ni na di o shɛhira maa, dama ti daa be o sani zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.

dag: Yisifu daa laɣim bindira maa sɔŋ ka di galisim ti ŋmanila teeku ni bihigu hal ka o ti bi lan niŋdi di laasabu, dama nir daa naan ku tooi lan niŋ di laasabu.
en: Joseph amassed grain like the sand of the sea. There was so much that he stopped trying to measure it because it was beyond measuring.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni. O nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim sahakam.
en: God: the maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, God: who is faithful forever.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum yi tuma.
en: You may work six days a week to do your job.

dag: Ka bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa dol ba daa yi n-chaŋ.
en: The young men of King Ahab were the first to come out, but the rest of the army of Israel was following them.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni balind o ni o kam o yiŋ na.
en: A man named Jairus, who was a synagogue leader, came and fell at Jesus feet. He pleaded with Jesus to come to his house.

dag: Mani yi Duuma NAAWUNI kul pala n nini lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, n ni di bɛ nyɛviya dunia ŋɔ ni. Amaa n ku di Yaakubu daŋ niriba zaa nyɛviya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Look, the LORD God is eyeing the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth. However, I wont destroy fully the house of Jacob, says the LORD.

dag: Yi bi lan yuuni n sara din be kasi la zuɣu. Amaa yi bola tinzunnima n-chɛ ka bɛ zani yi zaani n-yuuni di zuɣu n jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: You did not take care of my holy things. No, you let foreigners have responsibility of my holy place.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mal o yiko, amaa leei di ku o.
en: So the Lord said to Satan, All right, Job is in your hands, but you are not allowed to kill him.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli ba, Nyama, n zaŋ binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni zaa ka mali biɛlim mini tia kam din wala mali kpila n-tin ya ni yi dira;.
en: I have provided all kinds of fruit and grain for you to eat.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛligu zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda pahi.
en: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.

dag: Sal ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla sala; ka Naawuni Shia mi ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla shia.
en: Whatever is born of the flesh is flesh, and whatever is born of the Spirit is spirit.

dag: ka zo yomyom ti yɛl o nyaandoliba ni o neei kum ni n-daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o. Nyamiya, mani n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: Now hurry! Tell his disciples he has been raised to life and is on his way to Galilee. Go there, and you will see him. This is what I came to tell you.

dag: M pun po n kasitali pumpɔŋɔ ni sahakam; n ku ŋma Dauda ʒiri.
en: By my holiness, I made a promise to him, and I would not lie to David.

dag: Doo yi tum zina ni o kpee paɣa, bɛn kum o mini paɣ maa zaa.
en: If a man has sexual relations with his neighbors wife, both the man and the woman are guilty of adultery and must be put to death!.

dag: ka tɛh o suhu ni ni o dii zaŋ kpani maa to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi li buyi zaa.
en: Saul thought, I'll pin David to the wall. He threw the spear at David twice, but David dodged and got away both times.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli ni n zaŋ mmaŋa mini n ni mali shɛlikam saɣim yi zuɣu. N ni yuri ya pam la zuɣu, yinima ni yuri ma la biɛla?.
en: So I am happy to give everything I have for you. I will even give myself for you. If I love you more, will you love me less?.

dag: Fabila maa m-bala. Zaŋmiya li yili yila. Zuliya kam paɣiba ni zaŋ li yili yila. Bɛ ni zaŋ li yili yila Ijipti mini di tɔbbihi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is your warning, and it will be used as a funeral song by foreign women to mourn the death of your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ka Bɛtishɛmɛshi ninvuɣ shɛba daa lihi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa puuni, ka o daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ pisopɔin zaa. Ka niriba daa kum bɛ zuɣu, Yawɛ ni daa ku ba pam shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord killed seventy of the men of Beth Shemesh because they looked inside the Covenant Box. And the people mourned because the Lord had caused such a great slaughter among them.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li gahigahi Yawɛ tooni din ni chɛ ka o deei ya. Di simdi ka maligumaana maa zaŋ li gahila Vuhim Dabisili di n-kaai biɛɣu.
en: on the day after the Sabbath. He will lift it up in dedication to me, and I will accept you.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bua, ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If the offering is a goat, you must bring it before the Lord .

dag: Hal n yi nyɛla ŋun ʒi yɛtɔɣa, amaa n lee bi kɔŋ baŋsim dina; binshɛɣukam puuni ti pun kahigiri dimbɔŋɔ yɛla n-wuhiri ya palɔni sahakam.
en: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka di mini li laɣim zooi ka gɔhi maa girimgirim li.
en: Some of the seed fell among thorn bushes, which grew up with the plants and choked them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la n-chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Now that we have been put right with God through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di chaŋ wula ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaani kpiimba zaani n-deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba? Kpiimba yi bi neeri kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka shɛb deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba?.
en: Otherwise, what are those who are getting baptized for the dead doing? If the dead arent raised, then why are they being baptized for them?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: They were too ashamed to return home. When David heard about what had happened, he sent word for them to stay in Jericho and not return until their beards had grown again.

dag: A mini Speen daa gɔrila kɔhigu tab tiŋgbɔna ni, yi ni daa mali azichi pam zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ di anzinfa mini kuriti ni dalima ni nuɣiso n-taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: You did business in Spain and took silver, iron, tin, and lead in payment for your abundant goods.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣi Naawuni o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ nyin Naawuni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sunsuuni ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: and to enable even the Gentiles to praise God for his mercy. As the scripture says, And so I will praise you among the Gentiles; I will sing praises to you.

dag: Nir yi tum din tuhi, di niŋdila wuntizɔriba suhupiɛlli, amaa ka lee tiri tuumbiɛtumdiba suhugarigu.
en: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.

dag: Be baalim Yawɛ sani, ka di suɣilo guhir o; di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɔŋsim yɛla muɣis a.
en: Trust in the Lord and wait quietly for his help. Dont be angry when people make evil plans and succeed.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Naawuni, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Cham ti liri ba, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked God, Should I go and fight the Philistines? Will you let me defeat them? The Lord answered David, Go. I will let you defeat the Philistines.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul tahiri bindira na ti tiri Naa Sulemaana mini bɛnkam zaa dir o yiŋa, bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o ni su gol shɛli, bɛ mi daa bi chɛri ka binshɛli poor o.
en: Each of the twelve regional officers brought food to Solomon and his household for one month of the year. They provided everything he needed.

dag: Rubin ni daa ti lab bɔɣili maa gbinna nti bi nya Yisifu di ni, o daa darigimi toog o binyɛra.
en: When Reuben returned to the well and did not find Joseph there, he tore his clothes in sorrow.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla doo ŋun paai yuun pihinu zaŋ chana, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pinaanu, ka paɣ mi nyɛ bini pia.
en: The price for a man who is years old or older is shekels. The price for a woman is shekels.

dag: Wuntia soli dolibu shiri nyɛla azichi din galisi, nir ŋun dee nini yi tiɣi o ni mali shɛli;.
en: Well, religion does make us very rich, if we are satisfied with what we have.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ li yɛli yi bihi mini yi yaansi n ni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa tum jɛrilim shɛm, ka n tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and in order that you may be able to tell your children and grandchildren how I made fools of the Egyptians when I performed the miracles. All of you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: M biyurisi, Naawuni yi yuri ti ŋ-ŋɔ, dindina di simdi ni ti gba yuri taba.
en: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.

dag: ni bɛ zaa leei zaɣ yini kaman nyini m Ba ni be n ni ka n gba be a ni shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka bɛ gba be ti ni, ka dunianim niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I pray they will be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. I pray that they also will be in us, so that the world will believe that you sent me.

dag: dama n ni ti a jilima pam. Ka a yi yɛli ni n niŋm shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li; kul kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu ti ma. .
en: I'll pay you very well and do whatever you ask. Just come and place a curse on these people.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi mi ni pa naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ka ti daa zaŋ ka yi sanna; Naawuni mi n-nyɛ ti shɛhiralana ni ti pala diribarilimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa limsi diribarilim maa.
en: You know that we never tried to influence you by saying nice things about you. We were not trying to get your money. We had no greed to hide from you. God knows that this is true.

dag: ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paai ba Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, bɛ dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: But they don't have roots, and they don't last very long. As soon as life gets hard or the message gets them in trouble, they give up.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa daa kul kpalim be Harihɛrɛs mini Aijalɔn ni Shaalibim, amaa ka Yisifu zuliya niriba daa muɣisi ba hal ka bɛ ti tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The Amorites were determined to live in Har-heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim, but Josephs household became strong, and the Amorites were forced to work for them.

dag: Amaa pu shɛŋa din be bɛ fɔntinsi maa tiŋgban ni, di bi simdi ka bɛ kɔhi dina, dama di nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli saha shɛlikam.
en: But the pastureland around their cities cannot be sold, because that is their permanent family property.

dag: Yi pun mali din simdi ya zaa! Yi pun niŋ bundaannima! Yi di nam ka chɛ ti! N di bi zaɣisi ka yi shiri nyɛla nanima, ka ti di pahi yi zuɣu n-di yi nam maa!.
en: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ. O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.

dag: dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-ku la.
en: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from death, after you had killed him by nailing him to a cross.

dag: Bumbɔni nyɛla asiba bɛ zaa sani, dama bɛ nyɛla bumbɔni mini dabiɛm zɔnima.
en: They fear the light of day, but darkness holds no terror for them.

dag: Masia ŋun nyɛ ti nyɛvili la yi ti yi palo, yi gba ni yi palo m-pah o zuɣu nya jilima.
en: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.

dag: Ka a ti niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ li pa di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di binyila maa zaa zuɣu, ka mali salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover its top, all four sides, and its projections with pure gold, and put a gold border around it.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi yum maa, di yi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di ni kɔbiri niŋ zaɣ dɔzim ka balisibalisi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni; di nyɛla dɔr shɛli din loora, ka nyɛ zuɣu ni bee teeŋa ni dɔr biɛɣu.
en: the priest will examine it. If it appears to be deeper than the skin, and there is thin yellow hair in it, the priest will declare the person unclean; it is a case of scabies—a skin disease of the head or beard.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, a kul yɛn dola nimaani hal ni saha dini? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn neei a gom ni?.
en: How long, lazy person, will you lie down? When will you rise from your sleep?.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino kpiŋkpan yini wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni chɛrubi kpiŋkpan yini nyol ni zaŋ ti kpa o kpiŋkpan din la nyol ni wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: and four and a half meters across. They had two wings, and the wings were just over two meters long.

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka ninsalinim tuma mini bɛ baŋsim puuni, bɛ zabirila tab nyuli. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I have also learned why people work so hard to succeed: it is because they envy the things their neighbors have. But it is useless. It is like chasing the wind.

dag: Hal nanim ni laɣindi ʒiini lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo la zaa yoli, mani a dabili ŋɔ kul ni bɔhind a zaligunima.
en: Even if rulers say bad things about me, I am your servant, and I continue to study your laws.

dag: O daa lan mali salima firilatamdisi pia kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, diba anu nudirigu polo, diba anu din la mi nuzaa polo.
en: They made ten gold lampstands according to the usual pattern, and ten tables, and placed them in the main room of the Temple, five lampstands and five tables on each side. They also made a hundred gold bowls.

dag: Ka bɛn daa doli Sool daa zaŋ o niŋ piɛɣu ni yuŋ du gooni n-zaŋ o siɣisi ti zali tiŋa.
en: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi n ni be fitiina shɛli ni, di biɛri m puuni, ka n suhu dam, n ni daa nyɛ ŋun zaɣis a noli zuɣu. Bɛ daa malila takɔbiri be soya zuɣu kuri niriba, ka kpibu be yiŋa.
en: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord ? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wum kukoli maa zibisim maa sunsuuni ka buɣim dir zoli maa, yi zuliya zuɣulaannim mini yi kpamba daa vumi miri ma na.
en: You heard the voice from the darkness while the mountain was burning with fire. Then all the elders and the other leaders of your tribes came to me.

dag: Ka nimmoo tɔb daa bili dindali maa, ka Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Abinɛr mini Izraɛlnim maa.
en: That contest turned into a terrible battle and Davids officers defeated Abner and the Israelites that day.

dag: Ka a lan yɛli ba: Yi ni ti yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam tiri Yawɛ ka di nyɛ yi sahakam sara n-nyɛ yuun yini piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will say to them: This is the food gift that you must present to the LORD: two flawless one-year-old lambs as the regular entirely burned offering every day.

dag: Amaa tin shɛli din yuli daa booni Ɛkibatana ka di be Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ yaɣili la ni ka bɛ daa ti nya litaafi shɛli ka sabbu ŋɔ be di ni:.
en: But a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of the province of Media, on which was written the following: A memorandum.

dag: Naawuni nyari jilima o ni sɔɣiri yɛla zuɣu; amaa nanim bɛn nyari jilima la bɛ ni vihiri yɛla n-yihiri li palo ni zuɣu.
en: It is the glory of God to hide something and the glory of kings to discover something.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya Nyini karimbaandan ŋɔ, n yi n-zan a zuɣu. A biɛɣu neeya, n ni yɛn darig a tibili saha shɛli maa paaya.
en: Babylon, you should be named, The Proud One. But the time has come when I, the Lord All-Powerful, will punish you.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Naawuni nol ni na zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures say: No one can live only on food. People need every word that God has spoken. .

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ni zali zaligu, ka yiya kara ŋma n-lu, ka yiya bihi mi lu m-burisiburisi.
en: Look, the LORD is giving an order; he will shatter the great house into bits and the little house into pieces.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim zaa daa naanyi gbi la kɔbilisi gili Nail Mɔɣili maa ni bɛ nya kɔnyurim, dama bɛ daa naan ku tooi lan nyu Nail Mɔɣili kom maa yaha.
en: The Egyptians had to dig holes along the banks of the Nile for drinking water, because water from the river was unfit to drink.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la jɛmbu duu ni kpɛbu, ka jɛmdila buɣili Ashɛra binyɛra mini binnana. Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu bɛ taali tumbu maa zuɣu.
en: They abandoned the temple of the LORD, their ancestors God, and worshipped sacred poles and idols. Anger came upon Judah and Jerusalem as a consequence of their sin.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; ka man gba ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli yi ni daa tum tuun shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: and I pray that the Lord will be kind and faithful to you. I will be your friend because of what you have done.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, amaa o daa deei zaka ti yab Ibrahimma sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋuna ŋun daa deei Naawuni daalikaulinim la ni.
en: Melchizedek was not even from the tribe of Levi, but Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. And Melchizedek blessed Abraham—the one who had Gods promises.

dag: Naa Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la nam dibu yuun tuuli la ni ka n daa yiɣisi n-niŋ nia kpaŋs o.
en: He is responsible for helping and defending me.

dag: Bɛ daa bela Arinɔn Mɔɣili duli guhira, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo. Bɛ daa ŋmanila noon shɛb bɛ ni kari bɛ tɛri ni bahi.
en: They wait on the banks of the Arnon River and move aimlessly back and forth, like birds driven from their nest.

dag: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ a kɔbilinina ni; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli paɣ so a ni daa kpuɣi a nachimbilim saha la zuɣu.
en: So be happy with your wife and find your joy with the woman you married—.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan sabilifaa n-she alichɛbba shɛli zuɣu o ni yɛn yɛri binyɛribila la para.
en: You will make the robe for the vest all of blue.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti Ijiptinim daŋ pam, ka lan tib ba. Bɛ ni ti lab Yawɛ sanna, ka o deei bɛ suhigu ka tib ba.
en: The LORD will strike Egypt; striking and then healing. They will return to the LORD, who will hear their pleas and heal them.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti zaŋ naɣilaa ni yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la bee alikauli palibu sara bee suhudoo biɛrisuŋ sara ti Yawɛ.
en: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing.

dag: ka o bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim ti o, ka o zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ʒe sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila la, ka kpaai binʒim maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: Then Aarons sons presented the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the altars horns. He poured the rest of the blood out at the altars base.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli niŋ a. O ni gul a nyɛvili.
en: The Lord will protect you from every danger. He will protect your soul.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛdomnim daa yɛl o, Yi ku kpe ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari, yi yi niŋ lala, ti ni ŋmɛn ya tɔbu.
en: Edom said to him, You wont cross through, or I will come out against you with a sword.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, o ni be? O ku be, o ni tum binshɛŋa din chihiri ŋɔ zaa zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani o ni kpi. Ka o kum maa taali ni ʒi omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: He lends money to people who need it, but he forces them to pay interest on the loan. The evil son will not be allowed to live. He will be put to death because he did such terrible things, and he will be responsible for his own death.

dag: Daadamnim saɣim dunia, dama bɛ birigi Naawuni zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli ni di kul beni sahakam la.
en: The people have ruined the land. They did what God said was wrong. They did not obey Gods laws. They made an agreement with God a long time ago, but they broke their agreement with God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa biligi kuɣili maa bahi. Ka Yisa duh o zuɣu zuɣusaa ka yɛli, M Ba, m paɣir a a ni deeri n suhigu zuɣu.
en: They took the stone away. Jesus looked up and said, I thank you, Father, that you listen to me.

dag: Vumiya miri Naawuni, ka o mi vu m-miri ya. Yinim alahichinim ŋɔ, paɣimiya yi nuhi; yinim tɛhaayiyinim ŋɔ, malimiya yi suhuri ka di be kasi.
en: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

dag: dama bɛ daa kul zaŋ li tila bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu malibu tuma maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tum di malibu maa tuma kɔŋko.
en: Instead, it was given directly to those who did the repair work; they used it to repair the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Yutikus daa ʒi takɔro zuɣu. Pool ni daa tɔɣisi yuui maa zuɣu ka nachimbil maa daa ti ʒeei gom n-gbihi biligi lu tiŋ ha. Zuɣusaa duu din pah ata ni ka o daa yi n-lu maa ha, ka bɛ daa kpuɣ o la kpima.
en: A young man named Eutychus was sitting in the window. He was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell from the third floor and died.

dag: Tim ma baŋsim, ka n gbib a zaligu, ka dol li ni n suhu zaa.
en: Explain your law to me, and I will obey it; I will keep it with all my heart.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Manɔa, N ni daa yɛli paɣ maa shɛlikam zaa la, di simdi ni o dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Lord 's angel answered, Your wife must be sure to do everything that I have told her.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: All who want to save their lives will lose them. But all who lose their lives because of me will save them.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri ninsalinim yɛligu balibu kam, hal zaŋ tabili malaikanim yɛligu, ka ka yurilim, dindina m bemi kaman dawule bee gbiŋgbarinlun shɛŋa bɛ ni mali ŋmɛri taba ka di yɔri vuri yiriŋ la.
en: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam, ka o biɛhigu zaa mali kɔre pam. Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n yura ni n zo maa ni be shɛm m-bala.
en: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.

dag: Pa yi zaa yɛla ka n yɛri maa, dama m mi n ni pun pii shɛba; amaa di kpala talahi ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni dihiri so gbi ma zamba bɔɣili.
en: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, The man who ate with me has turned against me.

dag: Amaa pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi dooyili yi po pɔri ni o niŋ shɛli, fashee ka di zani.
en: A widow or a divorced woman must keep every vow she makes and every promise to abstain from something.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ n ni da li ka deei gban shɛli ka n dalinli dihi tabili li, ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa ti ni daa zali be di ni mini di gban shɛli din pahi di zuɣu la.
en: Then I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy, with its terms and conditions, and the unsealed copy.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba nyari bɛ bindirigu la Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni? Ka yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tuma gba nyari bɛ bindirigu la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira?.
