en: Surely you know that the men who work in the Temple get their food from the Temple and that those who offer the sacrifices on the altar get a share of the sacrifices.

dag: Di saha, ti ku lan ŋmalig a sani zo yaha, tim ti nyɛvili, ka ti jɛmd a!.
en: then we will not turn away from you! Revive us so that we can call on your name.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhu yubu puuni bɛ tɔhiri kaman sokam ni o nyaŋbu tariga hal n-gari lala zuɣu gba.
en: I assure you that they gave what they could afford and even more than they could afford, and they did it voluntarily.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa ti bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: He asked Jesus, Are you the king of the Jews? Those are your words, Jesus answered.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka daadam ku tooi nyu bara Naawuni sani.
en: God did this so that no one can stand before him and boast about anything.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim, alɔbo ni di ba, ka bɛ pakoya ku kum bɛ kuya.
en: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N ni zaŋ n ninkurilim yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka Naawuni ni be a sani! Di simdi ka a zani niriba maa zaani Naawuni sani, ka zaŋdi bɛ naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣa n-sɔŋd o tooni.
en: Now, listen to me. Let me give you some advice. And I pray God will be with you. You should continue listening to the problems of the people. And you should continue to speak to God about these things.

dag: Bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma zaa la niriba nini zuɣu, ka niŋdi bɛ ni piriti sab shɛŋa mini din pari bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu ka di nyɛ zaɣ yɛlima, ka chɛri ka bɛ binyɛra naŋgbanzusa nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣila.
en: Everything they do, they do to be noticed by others. They make extra-wide prayer bands for their arms and long tassels for their clothes.

dag: Ka yi nɔdeebo yi ti niŋ pali, ti mali shili ni ti darigi bɛn tumdi nɔzaɣisibo tuma la tibili.
en: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Tama hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi koma dooshee n-zaŋ nimaani hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ nudirigu polo yaɣili.
en: The southern limit runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh and from there along the border of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This is the southern limit.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! n-yɛwaa! la gba di vi, ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: May those who make fun of me be dismayed by their defeat.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi niriba maa zuɣu ni ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla, amaa o ni daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bahi mol li gili.
en: Jesus told the people not to say anything about what he had done. But the more he told them, the more they talked about it.

dag: Di saha ka Filistianim daa kana ti dɔni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti liri Lɛhinima.
en: But it wasn't long before the Philistines invaded Judah and set up a huge army camp at Jawbone.

dag: ka nir yiŋnim ni nyɛla o dimnima.
en: Peoples enemies are members of their own households .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili kul paari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ŋun Naawuni noli.
en: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa maa puuni, timiya ba tins ayɔbu din yɛn nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku ninsala ka zo n-kuli di ni tiligi, ka ti ba tinsi pihinahinaayi pahi.
en: Six of the cities that you give to the Levites will be refuge cities. You will allow the person who kills someone to flee there. In addition to these you will give them forty-two cities.

dag: Ka Pool ŋahiŋga daa wum bɛ ni to jina gbaai shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti kpe tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee maa nti zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Pool.
en: But the son of Paul's sister heard about the plot; so he went to the fort and told Paul.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋa, ka kɔŋ yɛligu.
en: While he said this to me, I turned my face to the ground and kept quiet.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi jɛm wuna, dama man Yawɛ ŋun yuli booni Nyuli ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: Dont worship any other god. I am YAHWEH KANAH—the jealous Lord . That is my name. I hate for my people to worship other gods.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti yɛli Jɔab, Naa yɛliya ni a yim na. Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Aai, n ni kpi kpe. Ka Bɛnaaya daa lab naa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔab ni yɛli shɛm, ka garigi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He went to the Tent of the Lord 's presence and said to Joab, The king orders you to come out. No, Joab answered. I will die here. Benaiah went back to the king and told him what Joab had said.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Yi yɛda niŋbu bi yaɣi lala.
en: Jesus asked his disciples, Why were you afraid? Don't you have any faith.

dag: Bipuɣiŋga, gbilisim a tibili wum; tamm a niriba min a ba yiŋ yɛla.
en: Listen, daughter; pay attention, and listen closely! Forget your people and your fathers house.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima naɣibil yino zali Bɛtɛl, ka zaŋ yino mi zali Dan.
en: King Jeroboam put one golden calf in Bethel and the other one in the city of Dan.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti Maika ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔrɛshɛt nir la m-bɔŋɔ. Di daa nyɛla Jɔtam mini Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa nya binshɛŋa maa daa nyɛla Samaria mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah.

dag: N kul tɔɣisirimi kaman yinyaa n-nyɛ ma la. Bɛ nyɛla Masia tumtumdiba? N nyɛla Masia tumtumda gari ba: N tum pam gari ba gba; bɛ kpɛhi ma sarika n-gari ba: n nya buri din ka kalinli; ka be kum barina ni waawaayili.
en: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.

dag: Ti Duuma yi di bi filim di dabisa maa, so naan ti ku tiligi; amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn nyɛ o ni pii shɛb la zuɣu, o filim di dabisa maa.
en: But the Lord has reduced the number of those days; if he had not, nobody would survive. For the sake of his chosen people, however, he has reduced those days.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna, ka n ni ti ŋme tɔbuchiriga bahi Raba din nyɛ Ammɔnim tiŋ la zuɣu. Di ni ti zani dabari, ka buɣim di di tiŋkpansi. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim mi ti kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kari ba la. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Someday I will send an army to attack you in Rabbah, your capital city. It will be left in ruins, and the surrounding villages will lie in ashes. You took some of Israel's land, but on that day Israel will take yours!.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnim ti a, ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaɣila Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn nti niŋ sarika ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: Then the king of Babylon tore out Zedekiahs eyes. He put bronze chains on him and took him to Babylon. In Babylon he put Zedekiah into prison. He stayed in prison until the day he died.

dag: Bɛ daa tuui zaŋ o tahila Annas sani, dama Annas daa nyɛla Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la deemba.
en: and took him first to Annas. He was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was High Priest that year.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi deei binshɛli ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun zo nti be tiliginsim tiŋ ni lab ti be o ya ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan na bi kpi.
en: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.

dag: Dama di niŋ kamaata ni o diri nam hal ti nyaŋ o dimnim zaa n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: It is necessary for him to rule until he puts all enemies under his feet .

dag: Paɣ maa mi daa mali naɣipol kpabili o yiŋa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi yomyom chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi naɣipolli maa, ka o niŋ zim ŋɔri mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: The woman had a calf that she had been fattening. She quickly killed the calf. She took some flour and pressed it with her hands. Then she baked some bread without yeast.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa n lee bi bɔri ni n zaŋ tadabo sab li pa gbaŋ zuɣu tin ya. M mali tahima ni n ni kana ti kaai ya, ka m mini ya nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi, ka di chɛ ka ti nya suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: I have a lot to tell you. I dont want to use paper and ink, but I hope to visit you and talk with you face-to-face, so that our joy can be complete.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa suhi o wunsuhigu ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa yiɣisi zan o ni daa gba luɣ shɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini maa gbini n-kpuɣ o nuhi duhi zuɣusaa.
en: When Solomon prayed this prayer to the Lord , he was on his knees in front of the Lord s altar and his arms were raised toward heaven. When he finished praying, he stood up.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Dauda bidibisi nti pahi o mamanim bidibisi zuɣu, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Tama.
en: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.

dag: N ni zaŋ kuɣ yini shɛli din mali nina ayopɔin sɔŋ Jɔshua tooni; ka sab sabbu shɛli pa di zuɣu yɛli, Dahin yini puuni, n ni ti yihi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daalahichi bahi.
en: Look, I put a special stone in front of Joshua. There are seven sides on that stone. I will carve a special message on it. This will show that in one day, I will remove the guilt from this land.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o bia paɣ dɔni, bɛn kum bɛ niriba ayi maa, bɛ tumla taali bɛ ni nyɛ dɔɣiri yini zuɣu, bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒila bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. They have committed a terrible sexual sin! They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya mi daa su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi daa nyɛ nayili tuma kpamba.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.

dag: Ɛdom beni, di nanim mini di kpamba kpiɔŋ maa zaa, bɛna n-doya m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la zuɣu maa. Bɛ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni n-laɣim doya pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu maa.
en: Edom is there, its kings and all its princes, who, though strong, were put with those slain by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, like those who go down to the pit.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, tinim tɔɣisirila ti ni mi shɛli yɛla, ka diri ti nini ni nya shɛli shɛhira; amaa ka yi bi niŋdi ti shɛhira maa yɛda.
en: I assure you that we speak about what we know and testify about what we have seen, but you dont receive our testimony.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Yutikus daa ʒi takɔro zuɣu. Pool ni daa tɔɣisi yuui maa zuɣu ka nachimbil maa daa ti ʒeei gom n-gbihi biligi lu tiŋ ha. Zuɣusaa duu din pah ata ni ka o daa yi n-lu maa ha, ka bɛ daa kpuɣ o la kpima.
en: A young man by the name of Eutychus was sitting on a window sill. While Paul was speaking, the young man got very sleepy. Finally, he went to sleep and fell three floors all the way down to the ground. When they picked him up, he was dead.

dag: N tiŋgbani yi di kuhi jɛndi ma, ka m puu ni pimpama di laɣim kum.
en: If I have stolen the land I farm and taken it from its rightful owners—.

dag: ka yɛli Ɛfurɔn niriba maa zaa ninni, Amaa a yi di saɣi n naan yo a palo maa liɣiri. Saɣimi dee li, ka n zaŋ n kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: and spoke to Ephron publicly in the presence of the local citizens: If only you would accept my offer. I will give you the price of the field. Take it from me so that I can bury my dead there.

dag: Ka shɛb gba daa ʒi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋkpaŋ kɔɣilikɔɣili kana, ka bɛ zaa daa ti nya alaafee.
en: People came from all the towns around Jerusalem. They brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits. All of them were healed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Filistianim mini Ammɔnnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: So the Lord became angry with the Israelites, and let the Philistines and the Ammonites conquer them.

dag: ka din pah anu gbaai Malikija, ka din pah ayɔbu gbaai Mijamin.
en: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti suh a, nyin gbilisim tibili wum, ka sɔŋ ma yomyom.
en: I call to you, Lord ; help me now! Listen to me when I call to you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni ka bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he asked them, Why are you discussing among yourselves about not having any bread? What little faith you have!.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi tuhi nintɔri ka di shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka daɣiri, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa maani o tuumba maa ansarisi, ka zaɣis o yɛligu wumbu, ka lar o daanabinima, ka Yawɛ suhu ti yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu pam hal ka di ti kɔŋ tim.
en: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: n-zaŋ o nudirigu nubil tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ o nubil ni kpam maa mihi Yawɛ tooni ʒiibuyopɔin.
en: Then the priest will dip the finger of his right hand into the oil that is in his left palm. He will use his finger to sprinkle some of the oil seven times before the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ dimbɔŋɔnim leela bɛn birigi yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu puuni.
en: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.

dag: Ka di daantalisi anahi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa anahi zuɣu daa nyɛ daanya, ka di bansi daa nyɛ anzinfa, ka o daa niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni, ka di mihi gba daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: The curtain was supported by four posts and four bronze bases. The hooks on the posts were made from silver. The tops on the posts were covered with silver, and the curtain rods were also made from silver.

dag: O ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ noombil maa ʒim mini kom maa ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa ni sida dari ni taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee maa n-yihi yili maa daɣiri ni m-bala.
en: In this way he shall purify the house with the bird's blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the red cord.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla, o Keenan paɣ ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua la ni daa dɔɣi bidibisi ata shɛba m-bala. Juda bikpɛm sani ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛr maa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpi.
en: Judahs family: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him with Bath-shua the Canaanite. Although Er was Judahs oldest, the LORD considered him wicked and put him to death.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Shɛkɛmnim daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti do mɔɣu ni, ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: The next morning, the people of Shechem were getting ready to work in their fields as usual, but someone told Abimelech about it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma ka n sabi li shɛm. O daa kahigi tuma maa zaa ni yɛn tum shɛm wuhi ma.
en: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.

dag: A ŋme n-wurisi Rahab kaman binkpiŋ la, a zaŋ a kpiɔŋ wurim a dimnim bahi.
en: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.

dag: Amaa bɛ buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛŋa.
en: The gods of those nations are only statues that some human made from gold and silver.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Man deei yi kul yi tiŋ puuni tariga, n yɛn zaŋla n nuhi duhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi ŋɔ mini sakuɣa ŋɔ zaa chɛ. Sakuɣa ku lan beni, ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to him, As soon as Ive left the city, Ill spread out my hands to the LORD. Then the thunder and the hail will stop and wont return so that you will know that the earth belongs to the LORD.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yɛlim ba, Di chaŋya ti tuhi ba, dama n ku be yi sani, di yi pa lala yi dimnim maa ni nyaŋ ya. .
en: But the Lord said to me, Tell the people not to go up there and fight, because I will not be with them. Their enemies will defeat them.

dag: Ka Naaman yɛl o, Chɛ ka n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi ti a. Ka o daa balim o zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra maa n-niŋ kpalans ayi ni lo n-zaŋ ʒil o tumtumdiba ayi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ʒi m-be Gɛhaazi tooni.
en: Naaman said, Please, take pounds. He persuaded Gehazi to take the silver. Naaman put pounds of silver in two bags and took two changes of clothes. Then he gave these things to two of his servants. The servants carried these things for Gehazi.

dag: Ka Jɔbab daa ti kpi, ka Husham ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛmannim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Jobab died, Husham became the new king. Husham was from the country of the Temanites.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ m birini, ka n Naawuni nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri tampiŋ shɛli gbini.
en: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya la daa ti bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ tiŋgbani maa yaɣ yini polo din nyɛ din bi galisi ti ti? Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni zuɣu, ti galisiya pam.
en: The tribe of Joseph spoke to Joshua: Why have you only given us a single lot and a solitary parcel for a legacy? We are a numerous people whom the LORD has blessed so richly.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna Pailɛt yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: Pilates soldiers took Jesus into the governors palace . They called all the other soldiers together.

dag: dama yi yɛtɔɣa puuni ka yi ni ti yi taali ni, yi yɛtɔɣa puuni mi ka yi ni ti lan mali taali.
en: On that day they will be told they are either innocent or guilty because of the things they have said.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyakim daa ti kani ka o bia Jɛhoyachin di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoiakim died, and his son Jehoiachin became king.

dag: Amaa tin shɛli din yuli daa booni Ɛkibatana ka di be Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ yaɣili la ni ka bɛ daa ti nya litaafi shɛli ka sabbu ŋɔ be di ni:.
en: But it was in the city of Ecbatana in the province of Media that a scroll was found, containing the following record:.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti tim sandaani niŋ nandaamba, ka labisi bɛ buni ti ba.
en: and their children will make good what they stole from the poor.

dag: Dama zuliya pam mini na kara ni ti zaŋ bɛ gba leei daba, ka n ti yo ba bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ nuhi tuma samli kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ni niŋ lala, dindina yin lomiya kpara Yawɛ nini ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: So Moses told them, If you do all these things, this land will belong to you. But your soldiers must go before the Lord into battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n suhu daa yiɣisi ka n je suli niŋ Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka chɛ ka di bahi yoli n-leei dabari doya kaman di ni na kul doya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So I poured out my anger and fury on the towns of Judah and on the streets of Jerusalem, and I set them on fire. They were left in ruins and became a horrifying sight, as they are today.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti mini Pool chaŋ ti puhi Jeemsi, ka cheechi kpamba la zaa gba daa be o sani.
en: On the next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James. All of the elders were present.

dag: Musa ni daa ti Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili la naai dahin shɛli, o daa boola kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mali di mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa ka di be kasi, ka lan booi kpam bahi sara maligu bimbini mini di nɛma zaa zuɣu m-mali di gba ka di be kasi.
en: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord , together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl mini Liya daa yɛl o, Binshɛli ka ti ba yiŋa ka ti yɛn di li fali.
en: Rachel and Leah said to Jacob: There's nothing left for us to inherit from our father.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni bɛ ni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa nyaaŋa bɛ ni labi n sanna, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labina, ka bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa daa nya li.
en: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me, but she didnt. Her disloyal sister Judah saw this.

dag: Turi mini yɔhiŋgu ni niriba nahiŋgu yɛla n-kul be bɛ noya ni; ka zilima yɛlibu mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri kul be bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.

dag: Izar daŋ ni Shɛlomɔt n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shɛlomɔt bidibisi ni, Jahat n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: From the Izhar family group there was Shelomoth. Jahath was a descendant of Shelomoth.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa nyɛ Jaara ba, ka Jaara nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba, ka Zimiri nyɛ Mɔza ba.
en: Ahaz was the father of Jarah; and Jarah of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda yi mali pakoya o dɔɣiriba ni, di simdi ni o lihiri ba, ka di zaŋ di yɛla ʒili cheechi, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka cheechi mi tooi lihi pako shɛb bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her family, she should take care of them and not burden the church, so that it can help other widows who are truly needy.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn doli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu soli bo buni niŋ yi yinsi, ka te yi tɛri luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ni barina di paai ya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: You are doomed! You have made your family rich with what you took by violence, and have tried to make your own home safe from harm and danger!.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi binshɛŋa din nyɛ man Yawɛ dini maa, bɛ nyom o min o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa buɣim, o ni saɣim Yawɛ zaligu min o ni tum tuun shɛli n-dihi Izraɛlnim vi la zuɣu.
en: The person selected, who has the things reserved for God, must be put to death by burning. Burn everything that belongs to him too. This is because he has violated the LORDs covenant and has committed an outrage in Israel.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ Midiannim nanim niŋ yi nuu ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Orɛb mini Ziib. Ka n ni tum shɛli lee nyɛla dini, ka n-ni tooi zaŋ li buɣisi yi dini? Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ o sani maa kpi.
en: God handed you the Midianite officers Oreb and Zeeb. What have I been able to do compared to you? When he said this, their anger against him passed.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: di bɔhiriya tab biɛri; hal so yi lab a nudirigu polo tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o.
en: But I tell you, dont fight back against someone who wants to do harm to you. If they hit you on the right cheek, let them hit the other cheek too.

dag: Gooni maa ni daa me n-naai, ka m mali pununima n-kpɛhi di dunoya la zaa saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa pii dunɔguliba mini yiliyiiniba ni Lɛvinim n-ti ba bɛ tuma ni.
en: After we finished building the wall and put the doors in the gates, we chose the men who would guard the gates and the men to sing in the Temple and help the priests.

dag: dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa baɣisi Misia gari chaŋ Troas.
en: Passing by Mysia, they went down to Troas instead.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a yurilim yɛla yɛli cheechi din be kpe ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania sɔŋ ba ka bɛ bahi chaŋ bɛ chandi maa, dama lala niŋbu nyɛla din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: They told the church about the love you have. Please help them to continue their trip. Help them in a way that will please God.

dag: Ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ku di. Amaa ka o tumtumdiba la mini paɣ maa daa kpaŋ bɛmaŋa m-balim o hal ka o ti saɣi, ka daa yiɣisi tiŋa n-ʒini garo zuɣu.
en: But Saul refused. I cant eat! he said. But his servants and the woman urged him to do so, and so he did. He got up off the ground and sat on a couch.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti zaŋ o tam bɛ tiŋ maa ni daa me n-tam zo shɛli zuɣu naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ ni bɛ daag o luhi zoli maa lɔŋni sa ka o kpi.
en: They rose up, dragged Jesus out of town, and took him to the top of the hill on which their town was built. They meant to throw him over the cliff.

dag: Bɛnkam be yi ni n-nyɛ o niriba, bɛ Naawuni maa ŋun be bɛ sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi kuli Jɛrusalɛm, Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti lab me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ duu, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: May God be with all of you who are his people. You are to go to Jerusalem and rebuild the Temple of the Lord , the God of Israel, the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni di simdi ni yi ku sama.
en: At the end of every seven years, you must cancel debts.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi leei maligumaaniba ni zuliya kasi. A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bala.
en: a people dedicated to me alone, and you will serve me as priests.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi tiŋgban ni n-chaŋ ti su kom ka ʒe kpam, ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛm o. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yi n-kuli yiŋa nti bɔhi bindirigu yɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di.
en: David got up from the floor, took a bath, combed his hair, and changed his clothes. Then he went and worshiped in the house of the Lord . When he returned to the palace, he asked for food and ate it as soon as it was served.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, N daa pun yɛl a ni daa tim a tuun shɛb n sanna la.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Didnt I tell your messengers, whom you sent to me.

dag: ni man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai yiya ŋɔ nima mini di niriba kaman kundi maa puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam zaa, ka Juda naa karim li maa.
en: This is what the LORD says: I am about to bring disaster on this place and its citizens—all the words in the scroll that Judahs king has read!.

dag: Di saha n dima ni ti nya li, ka vi ti gbaai ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhiri ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni la lee bela ya? N nini ni ti nya o lubu, ka bɛ ti no o sɔŋ kaman palli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: My enemy said to me, Where is the Lord your God? But my enemy will see this, and she will be ashamed. At that time I will laugh at her. People will walk over her, like mud in the streets.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka so ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kpuɣi ba bee n-sɔɣi ba. Bɛ ni ti do tiŋgban ni kaman naɣ bina la.
en: On that day the bodies of those whom the Lord has killed will lie scattered from one end of the earth to the other. No one will mourn for them, and they will not be taken away and buried. They will lie on the ground like piles of manure.

dag: Ti bi be kaman Anabi Musa ŋun daa zaŋ sariga pili n-lir o ninni ni Izraɛlnim di nya jilima din daa ti yɛn vuu la bahigu la.
en: We are not like Moses, who put a covering over his face. He covered his face so that the people of Israel would not see it. The glory was disappearing, and Moses did not want them to see it end.

dag: N nya yɛl biɛ shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di nyɛ din ʒi daadamnim zuɣu.
en: I have noticed that in this world a serious injustice is done.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa.
en: You must not uncover the nakedness of your fathers wife; it is your fathers nakedness.

dag: Bɛ yiinila yila saɣisiri guŋgombihi mini mɔɣilo, ka kalambua kumsi niŋdi ba nyaɣisim.
en: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yaɣigari chuɣu puhibu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ, Di bi simdi ka tinzun nira di Yaɣigari chuɣu bindirigu maa.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron: This is the regulation for the Passover. No foreigner may eat it.

dag: Ka neesim maa nyaɣisibu zuɣu daa chɛ ka m bi lan ne, ka bɛ daa gbaala n nuu ni n-vo ma tahi Damaskus.
en: I could not see, because the bright light had made me blind. So the men led me into Damascus.

dag: Pomiya pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka niŋya kaman yi ni po shɛm maa. Chɛliya ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kɔɣilikɔɣili la nim zaa zaŋ pina na ti ti ŋun nyɛ binzɔrigu maa.
en: People, you made promises to the Lord your God. Now give him what you promised. People everywhere fear and respect God, and they will bring gifts to him.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi mini Naa Hɛrɔd dabindi la.
en: Jesus warned them, Be careful! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni deei n noli ka gbibi n daalikauli, n ni zaŋ ya leei n dahalali niriba zuliya kam sunsuuni, dama mani n-su dunia zaa.
en: So now, if you faithfully obey me and stay true to my covenant, you will be my most precious possession out of all the peoples, since the whole earth belongs to me.

dag: Dama ti pun wum yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom pirigi buyi m-mali soli tin ya la yɛla; ka lan wum yi ni daa niŋ Amɔri nanim ayi bɛn yuya booni Sihɔn mini Ogi la gba shɛm ku ba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la yɛla.
en: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.

dag: O ni daa yi zahira tumd o pagɔrisigu tuma, ka yihir omaŋ fini shɛm maa daa chɛ ka n ŋmalig o sani ni suhuyiɣisili kaman n ni daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o biɛli shɛm la.
en: When her seductions became known and her nakedness exposed, I recoiled from her just as I had recoiled from her sister.

dag: Ŋunkam bo n-nya yɛm nyɛla ŋun bɔri omaŋa, ka ŋunkam nyɛ tɛhi zilimalana nyɛla ŋun tɔŋda.
en: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa vu m-miri Dauda, ka o nyɔtaɣiriʒira be o tooni.
en: The Philistine slowly walked closer and closer to David. Goliaths helper walked in front of him, carrying a large shield.

dag: O kɔŋko n-daa yɛrigi sagbana, ka no teeku kɔgbana sɔŋ.
en: No one helped God spread out the heavens or trample the sea monster's back.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N ni zaŋ n ninkurilim yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka Naawuni ni be a sani! Di simdi ka a zani niriba maa zaani Naawuni sani, ka zaŋdi bɛ naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣa n-sɔŋd o tooni.
en: Now let me give you some good advice, and God will be with you. It is right for you to represent the people before God and bring their disputes to him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kun ya tɔbu ni, ka gbahi yi ni shɛba ti leei daba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa na ku zan tariga. O daa loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: How will you avoid crouching among the prisoners and falling among the slain? Even so, Gods anger hasnt turned away; Gods hand is still extended.

dag: mani yi Duuma ni chɛ ka Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Judanima. Bɛ ni ti kana kaman Yufretiiz Mɔɣili kom din galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam m-pali hal ti puuri bahiri la.
en: But the Lord will bring the king of Assyria and all his power against them. The Assyrians will come like their swift moving river, like water that rises and spills over its banks.

dag: Uzi n-daa nyɛ o bi kpɛma, ka o mabihi nyɛ Buz mini Kɛmuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Aram ba la.
en: They are Uz his oldest son, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di yi ti kpa ni n darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi tibidarigibo tibili, man di darigi bɛ tibili? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu. Di simdi ni yi nya tibidarigibo.
en: If even those who did not deserve to be punished had to drink from the cup of punishment, do you think that you will go unpunished? No, you must drink from the cup!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinim mini Jɛturinim ni Nafishinim ni Nɔdabinima.
en: They went to war against the Hagrite tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Kuɣ duli ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira m min a sunsuuni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban said to Jacob, This pile of rocks will help us both remember our agreement. That is why Jacob called the place Galeed.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, sɔŋm ma.
en: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, Please help me, Lord.

dag: Ka naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa nini daa tiɣi o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naa maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Mɛmukan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: King Xerxes and his officials liked what Memucan had said.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛli naa maa, Ashili shɛli nyin naa ni bɔri ni a baŋ maa, baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni timanim ni laasabuniŋdiba ku tooi wuh a di gbinni.
en: Daniel answered, King Nebuchadnezzar, no wise man, no man who does magic, and no Chaldean could tell the king the secret things he has asked about.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom so yo o zuɣu, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ salima niŋ dapaɣa maa, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima niŋ dapuhi maa.
en: They covered these frames with gold. Then they used gold to make the rings to hold the braces, and they covered the braces with gold.

dag: ka di be kaman n zo sumo bee m mabia zuɣu ka m mali nandahima maa. N daa kul gbami ni suhugarigu, ka chani gindi fabindi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ma kpi.
en: I mourned for them as I would for a friend or a brother. I bowed low with sadness, crying as I would for my own mother.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-bala.
en: The city of the dead will be named Hamonah. In this way they will make the country pure.

dag: Di saha ka a chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa zani Aduna min o bidibisi la tooni, ka a zaŋ ba ti Yawɛ kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la.
en: You will have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and you will present them as an uplifted offering to the LORD.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum a daba bɛn nyɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ suhigu ka chɛ bɛ taali maa, ka wuhi ba so viɛl shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ka a chɛ ka saa mi a tiŋgban shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti a niriba ni bɛ su li ŋɔ ni.
en: then listen from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the best way for them to follow, and send rain on your land that you gave to your people as an inheritance.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zo yomyom chaŋ ti di nɛma, ka tum din bi tiɣi Yawɛ nini.
en: Why, then, did you not obey him? Why did you rush to grab the loot, and so do what displeases the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu di nachimba ni ti lu di zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka bɛ ti ku di tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Soon, even your best soldiers will lie dead in your streets. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.

dag: N wumiya ni wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni, ka a mali ninneesim mini baŋsim ni yɛm.
en: I have heard that the spirit of the gods is in you and that you understand secrets and are very smart and very wise.

dag: Dama nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuhi mani a dabili ŋɔ ka yɛli, N ni me a yili ti a, dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a suhigu ŋɔ.
en: because you, LORD of heavenly forces, Israels God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a dynasty for him. That is why your servant has found the courage to pray this prayer to you.

dag: Di saha maa ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.

dag: ni Leedan ni Ammihud ni Ɛlishama.
en: his son Ladan, his son Ammihud, his son Elishama.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N nya ka Sintani yi zuɣusaa luna kaman saa n-nyaɣisi la.
en: Jesus replied, I saw Satan fall from heaven like lightning.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Ijipti mɔɣili la kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka pɔhim tulli ʒe na ti kpe Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka o ti pirigi li kulibombih ayopɔin m-mali soli ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋ du.
en: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi daania niŋbu maa niŋ pali, ka di chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani shɛlikam zaa puuni, ka ku kɔŋ shɛli.
en: If you let that patience work in you, the end result will be good. You will be mature and complete. You will be all that God wants you to be.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa saɣim alikauli maa Adam tiŋgban ni, nimaani ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe ma yim.
en: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.

dag: n-zaŋ ti tahi kpe na nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: So he brought us to this place. He gave us this land—a land filled with many good things.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni. O nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim sahakam.
en: He made heaven and earth. He made the sea and everything in it. He can be trusted to do what he says.

dag: O ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o di miri kpima.
en: If you have taken the Nazirite vow, you must not go near someone who is dying during that special time of dedication. You have given yourself fully to the Lord .

dag: Yi pun wum n ni daa mali biɛhigu shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa doli Yɛhudianim adiini sol la yɛla. N daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka pam, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n saɣim li.
en: You have been told how I used to live when I was devoted to the Jewish religion, how I persecuted without mercy the church of God and did my best to destroy it.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bia maa kuhigu maa; ka Naawuni malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Haga m-bɔh o, Haga, bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama Naawuni wum bia maa kuhigu o ni be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: God heard the boy crying, and Gods angel called to Hagar from heaven. He said, What is wrong, Hagar? Dont be afraid! God has heard the boy crying there.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔ kul yɛn beni? A kul yɛn sɔɣimi sahakam? A yɛn chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili be kaman buɣim la hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: Lord , will you hide yourself forever? How long will your anger burn like fire?.

dag: O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba tuhi pihiyɔbu. Ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi Ijipti mini Libia ni Sukiim ni Itiɔpia n-dol o daa ka kalinli.
en: Shishak had chariots, , horse riders, and an army that no one could count. In Shishaks large army there were Libyan soldiers, Sukkite soldiers, and Ethiopian soldiers.

dag: Bɛ nuhi mi tuumbiɛri tumbu pam; kpambaliba mini bɛ sariakaritiba diri birapu. Yikolaannim zaŋdi bɛ suhuyubu zaana, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ naari noli lɔri nia biɛri.
en: Their hands are skilled at doing evil. Official and judge alike ask for a bribe; the powerful speak however they like; this is how they conspire.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, di simdi ka di nyɛla dilan naɣikpahi ni nahu bee o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When any of you present a livestock offering to the LORD, you can present it from either the herd or the flock.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣu ŋmanila wahu lɔɣu. Bɛ ŋaritila bɛ tiba kaman sapaɣu ŋun ŋar o tiba.
en: They are full of poison like snakes; they stop up their ears like a deaf cobra.

dag: Onam bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shammai mini Jada. Shammai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abishur.
en: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.

dag: ka bɛ moli Yawɛ yuli Ziɔn, ka paɣ o Jɛrusalɛm.
en: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord .

dag: Gooni din ti yɛn gili fɔntiŋ maa zaa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita awɛi. Ka fɔntiŋ maa yuli ni ti boonila, Yawɛ Beni.
en: The distance around the city will be , cubits. From now on, the name of the city will be the lord is there . .

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ŋaha.
en: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will be given much more in this life. And in the future world they will have eternal life.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, m bɔri ni a mali duu zali ma, dama m mali tahima ni Naawuni ni deeg a suhigu, ka labisi ma ti a.
en: Also, one more thing—prepare a guest room for me. I hope that I will be released from prison to be with you because of your prayers.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam ti Duuma zuɣu, dama di ni yuui pam la nyaaŋa yi lan wuhi ni yi baɣa be n ni. M bi yɛlimi ni yi chɛ ma la lihibu, amaa yi yi bi nyala soli din ni doli niŋ li.
en: I am so happy, and I thank the Lord that you have again shown your care for me. You continued to care about me, but there was no way for you to show it.

dag: A niŋ amaŋ naani a tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka tɛhi ni so bi nya a. A yɛm min a baŋsim m-birig a, ka a yɛri a suhu ni, Mani, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: You felt sure of yourself in your evil; you thought that no one could see you. Your wisdom and knowledge led you astray, and you said to yourself, I am God— there is no one else like me.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa garigi yɛli Jɛfita, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, hal Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti min a zaa shɛhiralana.
en: They replied, We agree. The Lord is our witness.

dag: Di pa shɛli o turi ŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka Yawɛ lihi n wahala ŋɔ ka niŋ ma din viɛli zuŋɔ.
en: But if the Lord hears these curses and sees the trouble I'm in, maybe he will have pity on me instead.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm ka Ɛfurɔn ti zaŋ o tiŋgbani din daa be Makipɛla din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ti Ibrahimma m-bala. O daa zaŋ siliga mini tihi din zaa daa be tiŋgbani maa ni ti.
en: That is how the property which had belonged to Ephron at Machpelah east of Mamre, became Abraham's. It included the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees in the field up to the edge of the property.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus din nyɛ Sirianim tiŋ la ni. Ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani. Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: David stationed soldiers in Aram of Damascus, enslaved them, and required payment. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.

dag: Ka anabinim maa pihinu daa doli ba chaŋ ti kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ ha ka chɛ ba.
en: There were men from the group of prophets who followed them. Elijah and Elisha stopped at the Jordan River. The men stood far away from Elijah and Elisha.

dag: Amaa yi yi yɛli, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna ŋɔ zuɣu, m pun tim na ti yɛli ya, Di lan yɛliya, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna. .
en: And if they disobey my command and use the words the Lord 's burden, then tell them that.

dag: Ka Ibram daa niŋ Yawɛ yɛda, ka Yawɛ daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: Abram put his trust in the Lord , and because of this the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaŋ Pita tum tuun kara Yɛhudianim sani shɛm, lala ka o zaŋ man gba tum tuun kara bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan bol a, Chɛ m-bahi, bee m-bol a tiŋgbani, Zaɣ nɛli. Amaa bɛ ni ti bol a la, Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so, ka boli a tiŋgbani, Dooyililana. Dama Yawɛ nini tiɣ a, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti mali yidana.
en: No longer will you be called Forsaken, Or your land be called The Deserted Wife. Your new name will be God Is Pleased with Her. Your land will be called Happily Married, Because the Lord is pleased with you And will be like a husband to your land.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan lab pahi buta ti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: Again Jesus left them, went away, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ wahu kpahi tabili daɣu zuɣu n-zaŋ sa mɔɣu ni shɛm la, di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti zaŋ Daadam Bia gba sa zuɣusaa lala.
en: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so must the Human One be lifted up.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔri Yawɛ nia biɛɣu? O ni chɛ ka di zani tariga; o dim ku tooi mo o buyi.
en: So don't plot against the Lord ! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.

dag: Chi ni ti pali kaburi bɔɣa ni; ka wain mini kpam ti pali di tɔɣibu bɔɣa ni hal ti puuri bahira.
en: The threshing places will be full of grain; the pits beside the presses will overflow with wine and olive oil.

dag: Tɛha maa ni daa be bɛ suhuri ni saha shɛli maa ka Yisa baŋ li ka dii bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: At once Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them, Why do you think such things?.

dag: N ni zaŋ bɛ ni shɛb leei maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti yɛl a, A ku wuhi ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni.
en: Your people will ask you to explain what that means.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Apis guui? Bɔzuɣu ka yi naɣilaa maa di bi zani? Yawɛ ni ŋme o luhi zuɣu.
en: Egypt, your strong soldiers will be killed. They will not be able to stand because the Lord will push them down.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n ni pili n-chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam niriba zɔn ya dabiɛm, bɛ yi wum yi yɛla dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira ka biɛrim pam mali ba.
en: Today I will make all people everywhere afraid of you. They will hear the news about you, and they will be afraid and shake with fear.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa, ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Othniel son of Kenaz, Calebs younger brother, captured it; so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah as a wife.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yɛla wumdi daadam ka di ka yɛtɔɣa. Nini bi nyari tiɣira, ka tibili mi bi wumdi tiɣira.
en: All words are tiring; no one is able to speak. The eye isnt satisfied with seeing, neither is the ear filled up by hearing.

dag: Sool ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa, ka Naawuni shia siɣ o zuɣu na ni kpiɔŋ pam, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Then the Spirit of God suddenly took control of Saul and made him furious.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ polo, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt. Tell him and his people.

dag: Di ti Sintani soli hal biɛla!.
en: Dont give the devil a way to defeat you.

dag: A ŋme n-wurisi Rahab kaman binkpiŋ la, a zaŋ a kpiɔŋ wurim a dimnim bahi.
en: You defeated Rahab. You scattered your enemies with your own powerful arm.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tum tuma ti yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, dama n suhu yiɣisiya, ka n dabi buɣim din kul ni diri sahakam.
en: People of Judah, I will make you slaves of your enemies. You will be slaves in a land that you never knew. I am very angry. My anger is like a hot fire, and you will be burned.

dag: Gbuɣinli ni ŋum yɔɣu ni ka pa ni o nyala binshɛɣu? Ka gbuɣimbil ni ŋum vol ni ka pa ni o gbaala binshɛɣu?.
en: Does a lion roar in the forest when it has no prey? Does a young lion cry out from its den if it has caught nothing?.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla o bia, ka Azaria nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔtam nyɛ o bia.
en: his son Amaziah, his son Azariah, his son Jotham.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun mali shɛhira suŋ bɛn be kpaŋ sani, di yi pa lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti tum vi tuma, ka Sintani zana gbaag o.
en: They should also have a good reputation with those outside the church so that they wont be embarrassed and fall into the devils trap.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋme n-fa Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban shɛli bɛ ni daa pun su la nyaaŋa, ka bɛ gba daa chaŋ ti liri Lɛshɛmnima ŋ-ŋme n-fa li ʒini ka zaŋ bɛ yab Dan yuli boli tiŋ maa.
en: When the people of Dan lost their land, they went to Laish and attacked it. They captured it, killed its people, and claimed it for themselves. They settled there and changed the name of the city from Laish to Dan, naming it after their ancestor Dan.

dag: Ka paɣa maa daa lan yɛli, N dan naa, n suhir a, chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Please, Your Majesty, let me say just one more thing, the woman said. All right, he answered.

dag: Ka a kpamba ŋɔ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni yɛli ma, A min a niriba zaa bɛn dol a yimiya chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka n ni chaŋ. Ka o daa ŋmaligi Firawuna sani n-yi ni suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: Your leaders will come and bow down, begging me to take my people and leave your country. Then we will leave. Moses was very angry; he turned and left the king.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka daa labina dabisili din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: Rehoboam replied, Give me three days to consider the matter. Then come back. So the people left.

dag: A bɔhiya, Ŋuni n-lee beni n-sɔɣiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, mani n-daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni. N daa tɔɣisila binshɛŋa yɛla ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam, ka m bi baŋ li.
en: You said, Who is this darkening counsel without knowledge? I have indeed spoken about things I didnt understand, wonders beyond my comprehension.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di niŋ kamaata ni yi teei ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuumba ni daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zal la yɛla.
en: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Maligumaaniba n-daa nyɛ: Jɛdaya mini Jɛhoyarib ni Jachin.
en: These are the priests who lived in Jerusalem: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jakin, and.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanani daa ka Juda Naa Asa sanna ti yɛl o, A ni niŋla Siria naa naani ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ naani la zuɣu, Siria naa tɔbbihi maa ni ti zo ka chɛ a.
en: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti niŋ binchimda zim maa shɛli mini kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim maa zaa nyo buɣim n-yihi di chihili. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: The priest will burn that part of the meal and oil that is to serve as a token, and also all the incense, as a food offering to the Lord .

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim daa bi niŋ yɛda bee dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ so ti niŋ yɛda ni dimnim ni tooi kpe Jɛrusalɛm puuni.
en: The earths rulers didnt believe it—neither did any who inhabit the world— that either enemy or adversary could enter Jerusalems gates.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba pahi, Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: He said, Whatever house you enter, remain there until you leave that place.

dag: Ka kuriti nyɔtaɣirisi din ŋmani zahim paɣiri pɔb bɛ nyɔri, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama vuri kaman chɛchɛbunsi wɔr bɔbili ni yi zɔri chani tɔbu tuhibu shɛm la.
en: Their chests looked like iron breastplates. The sound their wings made was like the noise of many horses and chariots hurrying into battle.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa chaŋ Farisiinim sani ti yɛli ba Yisa ni tum shɛm maa.
en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli ba, Ŋuna m-bɔŋɔ; o bela yi nuu ni, dama man naa ka yi yiko.
en: King Zedekiah answered, Very well, then, do what you want to with him; I can't stop you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o ka o kabiri dari maa daa zaŋ o tahi Musa mini Aduna ni niriba maa zaa sani.
en: The people who saw him gathering the wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole community of Israel.

dag: Gallimnima, tahimiya! Laishanima, Wummiya! Anatɔtnima, garigimiya!.
en: Shout, people of Gallim! Listen, people of Laishah! Answer, people of Anathoth!.

dag: N yi ti ŋari zuɣusaa kɔsoya ka saa bi lan mira bee toli yi ti ŋubiri yi bimbilima bee n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu n niriba maa zuɣu.
en: When I close the sky so that there is no rain or I order the locusts to consume the land or I send a plague against my people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Sool bipuɣiŋga la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya Naa Dauda ni wari waa ka yiɣiri jɛmda, ka o ʒiɛm o o suhu ni.
en: As the Box was being brought into the city, Michal, Saul's daughter, looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and leaping for joy, and she was disgusted with him.

dag: Di zaɣisi ma n kuriginsim saha, a mi di chɛ ma bahi n gbariginsim saha.
en: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.

dag: saha shɛli n ni daa pii zuɣulaannim zali ka bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim maa la. N ni chɛ ka a nya nyee vuhi a dimnim zaa sani. M-pahi, man Yawɛ lan yɛl a ni n ni me yili ti a.
en: when I let judges rule my people. And I have kept your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that you and your descendants will be kings.

dag: Ka shihir karili daa puhi zani alizanda ni. Paɣ so n-daa ye wuntaŋa kaman chinchini la, ka goli be o naba tiŋli, ka nam zuɣupiligu din mali saŋmarisi pinaayi pil o zuɣu.
en: Then a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

dag: Lɛvinima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, Yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Yawɛ, paɣimiy o!.
en: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord ! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord .

dag: M bela Yawɛ tooni chani nyɛvilinim tiŋgban ni.
en: And so I walk in the presence of the Lord in the world of the living.

dag: amaa pumpɔŋɔ ti gbarigimi, ka binshɛli kani n-naɣ pahila manna shɛli ti ni kul lihiri ŋɔ.
en: Now our lives are wasting away. There is nothing but manna in front of us.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpil shɛli din daŋ tooni ti Naawuni yi be kasi, dindina bɔrɔbɔro maa zaa ni be kasi. Ka tia nyaɣa yi be kasi, di wula gba ni be kasi.
en: If the first piece of bread is given to God, then the whole loaf is his also; and if the roots of a tree are offered to God, the branches are his also.

dag: Dama Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la niriba daa pun deei bɛ tarili.
en: because the tribe of Reuben by their households and the tribe of Gad by their households, and half the tribe of Manasseh have taken their inheritance.

dag: Kum kɔgbana daa gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka bahi yoli kɔgbana liri ma.
en: The waves of death were all around me; the waves of destruction rolled over me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so daa ka shɛli din ni yo o, ka o daa chɛ sama maa ti bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu yɛlim ma, bɛ niriba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, ŋuni n-lee ni yuri sandihira ŋɔ gar o kpee.
en: When they couldnt pay, the lender forgave the debts of them both. Which of them will love him more.

dag: A zuɣu ka bɛ kul turi ma, ka n kul diri vi.
en: It is for your sake that I have been insulted and that I am covered with shame.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yi Tɔfɛt din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o chaŋ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa labina, o daa zanila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni yɛli niriba.
en: Then Jeremiah left Topheth where the Lord had told him to speak. Jeremiah went to the Lord s Temple and stood in the courtyard of the Temple. Jeremiah said to all the people:.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisima n-lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba. Zaŋm a takɔbi n-fa n nyɛvili ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi.
en: Do something, Lord ! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zal o tumtumdiba zaa bɛn ʒe o dunol ni ni bɛ tim Haman jilima n-damdir o tiŋa. Amaa ka Mɔdɛkai ŋun daa zaɣisi ni o ku damd o tiŋa bee n-ti o jilima.
en: All the royal workers at the Kings Gate would kneel and bow facedown to Haman because the king had so ordered. But Mordecai didnt kneel or bow down.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka chɛ ka di leei shɛhira m min a sunsuuni.
en: So I am ready to make an agreement with you. We will set up a pile of stones to show that we have an agreement.

dag: Yi mabihi bɛn be Babilɔn ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb kaman yinim la puhiri ya; ka m bia Maak gba puhiri ya.
en: The church in Babylon sends you greetings. They were chosen just as you were. Mark, my son in Christ, also sends his greetings.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun yɛli ya ka yi bi niŋ yɛda. N ni mali m Ba yuli tumdi tuun shɛŋa maa n-diri ma shɛhira;.
en: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.

dag: Gɔhi ni ti zibigi bɛ nam yiya ni mini goma ni gili bɛ tin shɛŋa ni, ka yɔbahi mini viri ni be nimaani.
en: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.

dag: ka tiŋkpaŋ maa nim daa ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg o, o ni daa pun lo nia ni o gari chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu.
en: but the Samaritan villagers refused to welcome him because he was determined to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya ma naani ka labina nti nya kpiɔŋ ka tiligi. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi.
en: Therefore, the LORD God, the holy one of Israel, says: In return and rest you will be saved; quietness and trust will be your strength— but you refused.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kuri yi liɣiri binshɛli din pa bindirigu zuɣu, ka tumdi tuma din ku tiɣi ya zuɣu? Wummiya n yɛligu viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dinya din viɛla ni bindir suma ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Why spend money on what does not satisfy? Why spend your wages and still be hungry? Listen to me and do what I say, and you will enjoy the best food of all.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba, ka yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: One day, Jesus was teaching in the temple and telling the good news. So the chief priests, the teachers, and the nation's leaders.

dag: Ka o ya kpamba maa mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn min o daa laɣim be tin yini maa ni daa niŋ kaman Jɛzibɛl ni daa sab gbana wuhi ba shɛm maa.
en: The officials and leading citizens of Jezreel did what Jezebel had commanded.

dag: Ti chaŋya ka duu maa dunoya zaa kparimi kirikiri, ka dansarika guliba ʒe dunoya ni gu, amaa ka ti kparigi ka bi nya so duu maa ni.
en: They said, The jail was closed and locked. The guards were standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors, the jail was empty.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti vulim vuliŋga m-boli Ijiptinim ka bɛ yi Nail Mɔɣili polo kana kaman zɔhi la, ka Asirianim gba ti kana kaman shihi la.
en: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.

dag: Dauda daa bi chɛ ka binshɛli kpalim nimaani. Neem bihi bee neen kara bee bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi ni bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa la mini Amalɛknim maa ni daa kpuɣi bɛ neen shɛŋa zaa, Dauda daa zaŋ di zaa lab kuli.
en: Nothing was missing from the plunder or anything that they had taken, neither old nor young, son nor daughter. David brought everything back.

dag: Zahimmiya dimbɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn tam Naawuni yɛla ŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni dari tɔhi ya zaa ka so ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: You people who have forgotten God, understand what I am telling you, or I will tear you apart, and no one will be able to save you!.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbaai Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn zaɣisi ma bɛ buɣa zuɣu la suhuri.
en: So Ill seize the hearts of the house of Israel, whose idols have made them all strangers to me.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda ni o ninvuɣ gahinda ni yino la daa yɛli, N dan Musa, karim ba.
en: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, Sir, you must stop them.

dag: O lan bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi sara pahi di zuɣu asiba kam pari taba, ni kpam lita yini n-zaŋdi ŋmiriti zim viɛlli maa m-mali chi sara ti Yawɛ. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din yɛn ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Also, you will offer a grain offering with the lamb every morning. You will give / ephah of flour and / hin of oil to make the fine flour moist. It will be the daily grain offering to the Lord .

dag: Di zaŋ ma pahi ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ni dari ma chaŋ, bɛn tɔɣisiri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab suhudoo yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka jɛlinsi be bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Dont treat me like the evil people who do wicked things. They greet their neighbors like friends, but secretly plan to hurt them.

dag: Ka Gomna maa daa lan bɔhi ba pahi, Niriba ayi maa ni, ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Barabas.
en: Pilate said, I have Barabbas and Jesus. Which one do you want me to set free for you? The people answered, Barabbas.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛnkam yɛn tuhi, ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka yi dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛn ya.
en: I will make the people who oppose you afraid of me; I will bring confusion among the people against whom you fight, and I will make all your enemies turn and run from you.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi kuli.
en: The man stood up and went home.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, M ba Sool bɔrimi ni o ku a, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni asiba sa miri ka a yi palo; sa sɔɣimi luɣ shɛli polo.
en: and so he told him, My father is trying to kill you. Please be careful tomorrow morning; hide in some secret place and stay there.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi zaligu din tahi nyɛvili din be Yisa Masia ni na nti ti ti la yihi ma alahichi mini kum zaligu taali ni.
en: The law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has set you free from the law of sin and death.

dag: Bɛ fa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni nɛma, ka bɛ kpalim gbihirimi; ka tɔbbi so ku lan tooi zaŋ o nuu ku buchi shɛli.
en: They thought they were strong, but now they lie dead in the fields. Their bodies are stripped of all they owned. They could not defend themselves.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla, o Keenan paɣ ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua la ni daa dɔɣi bidibisi ata shɛba m-bala. Juda bikpɛm sani ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛr maa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpi.
en: Judahs sons were Er, Onan, and Shelah. Bathshua from Canaan was their mother. The Lord killed Er, the first son, because he saw that he was evil.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: So Pilate said to him, Dont you hear all these charges they are making against you? Why dont you answer.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yaakubu daa ti duɣi ʒiɛri, ka Iso yi mɔɣu ni na ka kum wum o pam.
en: One day while Jacob was cooking some bean soup, Esau came in from hunting. He was hungry.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛli n taali, ka chɛ ka m min a labi, ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: But now please forgive my sin! Come back with me, so I can worship the LORD.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ ba na ti ʒil amaŋmaŋ zoli zuɣu, nyini Yawɛ ni pii luɣ shɛli n-leeg a biɛhigu shee la. Nyin Yawɛ ni zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nuhi me a jɛmbu du shɛl la ni.
en: You will lead your people to your own mountain. You will let them live by the place that you, Lord , prepared as your home. It is the Temple, Lord, that you yourself built.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli pateesa yil li, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: The enclosure is to be yards long, yards wide, and 1⁄2 yards high. The curtains are to be made of fine linen and the bases of bronze.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o kpamba, Yi bi mi ni ŋun nyɛ sapashin kpeeni ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ titali ka Izraɛlnim kɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: The king told his soldiers, Dont you know that a prince and a great man in Israel has fallen today?.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka yi tab nyaansi, ka je taba.
en: Many will give up and will betray and hate each other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ kul birigirila bɛ suhuri ni waawaayili, ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: So I was angry with them. I said, Their thoughts are always wrong. They have never understood my ways.

dag: ni kikahi kumsi ni kukoli yɛtɔɣa vubu din mali dabiɛm hal ka bɛn daa wum li suhi Naawuni ni o di lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yaha la.
en: There is no sound of a trumpet or a voice speaking words like those they heard. When they heard the voice, they begged never to hear another word.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma, Molimi molo pahi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka n tinsi maa lan tɔŋ, ka lan sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di wuhi ni mani n-su li.
en: Call out again, The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: My cities will again overflow with prosperity. The LORD will again show compassion to Zion and will again choose Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun kar shɛŋa tariga? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi puh o ka di saɣi?.
en: Who can tell all the great things he has done? Who can praise him enough?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, sɔŋm ma! Tiligim ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba bɛn daa ye buri Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia sani.
en: He sent Eliakim, the official in charge of the palace, Shebna, the court secretary, and the senior priests to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz. They also were wearing sackcloth.

dag: ka Gidiɔni bia Abidan daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulana.
en: Abidan, Gideonis son, commanded the military of the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya shɛli din niriba be ŋ-ŋɔ biɛri?.
en: You need to be punished, and so I will take revenge.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei dari mali buɣim, ka yi ʒim ti kpe tiŋgban ni, ka so ku lan teei yi yɛla. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will be destroyed by fire. Your blood will be shed in your own country, and no one will remember you any more. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Be special. Make yourselves holy, because I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka olivi tiwula ayi shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi salima bimmulima ayi shɛŋa ni bɛ ni boori olivi kpam la mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: And what is the meaning of the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes from which the olive oil pours.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim be bɛ sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ wum di yɛligu ka saɣisi bɛmaŋa.
en: Abraham said, Your brothers have Moses and the prophets to warn them; your brothers should listen to what they say.

dag: A yi mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni a yɛli, nyin garigim ma. Tɔɣisima, dama m bɔri ni n wuhi ni a ka taali.
en: If you have words, answer me; speak, for I want to be innocent.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli, Paɣ ŋɔ nyɛla tuumbiɛri kɔtomsi. Ka o daa dihi paɣ maa ʒili piɛɣu maa ni ka zaŋ di liŋ maa pil li.
en: The angel said, This represents wickedness. Then he pushed her down into the basket and put the lid back down.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni malaika daa yɛli ma zahindi maa ni, Yaakubu, ka n saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: The angel of God spoke to me in that dream. The angel said, Jacob! I answered, Yes.

dag: Tim ba suhusaɣiŋgu; chɛ ka a noli di ba.
en: Make them stubborn and then curse them.

dag: Di saha ka Judas ŋun daa yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa bɔh o, Karimba, mani? Ka Yisa yɛl o, Iin, nyini.
en: Now Judas, who would betray him, replied, Its not me, is it, Rabbi? Jesus answered, You said it.

dag: Ka yi ni daa tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di yipa nyɛ vi yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, nyɔ bɔ ka yi daa lee nya di ni? Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahigu nyɛla kum.
en: You did evil things, and now you are ashamed of what you did. Did those things help you? No, they only brought death.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, ti di nasara yaɣi Masia ŋun yuri ti la zuɣu.
en: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.

dag: O lan bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi sara pahi di zuɣu asiba kam pari taba, ni kpam lita yini n-zaŋdi ŋmiriti zim viɛlli maa m-mali chi sara ti Yawɛ. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din yɛn ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Also an offering of five pounds of flour is to be made every morning, along with one quart of olive oil for mixing with the flour. The rules for this offering to the Lord are to be in force forever.

dag: Nyin daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi ni yɛri shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti biriginsim mini ti daalahichi tibisim marigi ti mi ka ti tarigi. Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ be.
en: The Lord spoke to me. Mortal man, he said, repeat to the Israelites what they are saying: We are burdened with our sins and the wrongs we have done. We are wasting away. How can we live.

dag: Di saha ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, N dana, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ a ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt mini Dauda daa kul laɣindi timdi diri kaman naa maŋmaŋ bidibisi ni yino n-nyɛ o la.
en: He said to King David, I am your servant. I will do everything that my lord the king commands. So Mephibosheth ate at Davids table like one of the kings sons.

dag: Gbahim ŋɔri mini bɛ bihi bɛn saɣindi ti wain tihi puri la. Dama ti wain tihi maa daari pum.
en: Catch the foxes for us— the little foxes that spoil the vineyard. Our vineyard is now in bloom.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ Yaakubu ti neendiriba, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim ti ŋmɛnditoya? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni tum alahichi so sani, ka bi dol o zaligu ni o soya la n-niŋ lala maa.
en: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.

dag: ka din pahi pisinaata gbaai Dɛlaiya, ka din pahi pisinaanahi gbaai Maazia.
en: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

dag: So yi bɔhi ya, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔri ba, ka o ni chɛ ka yi dii zaŋ ba na.
en: If anyone says anything to you, say that their master needs them. He sent them off right away.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla Iso bidibisi , bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ nanima.
en: All of these clans descended from Esau, who was known as Edom.

dag: Yi kul yɛra, Ti nyee nyɔniya, ka naɣiri yi nyɛhi niŋdi ma. Yi zaŋdi yi ni fa biŋkɔb shɛb bee biŋkɔb gbariti bee biŋkɔb barinim na ti maani sara tiri ma, yi tɛhiya ni n ni dee li yi sani? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you say, How tedious! and you groan about it, says the LORD of heavenly forces. You permit what is stolen, lame, or sick to be brought for a sacrifice, and you bring the grain offering. Should I accept such from your hands? says the LORD.

dag: Miriya ka yi lo tab zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. Yi mi miriya ka yi pɔri pɔri n-diri ʒiri shɛhira. N je dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Dont make secret plans to hurt your neighbors. Dont make false promises. You must not enjoy doing these things, because I hate them! This is what the Lord said.

dag: Piɛgul shɛb daa be tiŋ maa ni mɔɣu ni gul bɛ piɛri yuŋ.
en: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The rest of Josiahs deeds and all that he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ijipti naa daa yih o nam maa ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka zali Judanim ni bɛ yom farigu din nyɛ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini salima kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi.
en: Then King Neco from Egypt made Jehoahaz a prisoner. Neco made the people of Judah pay / tons of silver and pounds of gold for a fine.

dag: n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N Duuma Yawɛ, di ku a niriba bɛn nyɛ a dahalali ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa fa m-bahi a yiko ni, ka zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ yihi ba Ijipti maa na.
en: and prayed: Our Lord , please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tim Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ puuni gari chaŋ Pamfilia.
en: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia.

dag: Juda Naa Manaasa ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa, hal ka tum tuumbiɛri gari Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka chɛ ka Judanim jɛm o buɣa n-tum alahichi la zuɣu.
en: Judahs King Manasseh has done detestable things, things more evil than the Amorites had done before his time. He has caused Judah to sin with his images.

dag: Yisifu daa beni hal ti nya Ifriim bihi ni o yaantibichahi. O daa lan beni hal ti nya Manaasa bihi ni Makiri gba bihi n-zaŋ ba ʒil o naba zuɣu.
en: Joseph lived long enough to see Ephraim's children and grandchildren. He also lived to see the children of Manasseh's son Machir, and he welcomed them into his family.

dag: Sɛnaa — tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihita.
en: from the town of Senaah:.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋm chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnima, ka di niŋ din pahi napɔŋ buyi.
en: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, Make yourself flint knives. Circumcise the Israelites for a second time.

dag: Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: This was done by the Lord; what a wonderful sight it is.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Then the man knelt down and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Shɛb daa nyɛla jɛra n-tum tuumbiɛri, ka daa di wahala bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.

dag: Di niŋdiya din bi tuhi yi saria karibu ni, di niŋya faralan nirilim bee n-chɛ yi ni di yɛn niŋ shɛm bundan zuɣu, amaa doliya wuntia soli n-kariti saria.
en: You must be fair in judgment. You must not show special favor to the poor. And you must not show special favor to important people. You must be fair when you judge your neighbor.

dag: N yuri bɛn yuri ma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ma ni nimmoo nyari ma.
en: I love those who love me, and those who look for me will find me.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi Naa Agiripa, Naa, a niŋ anabinim yɛligu yɛda? M mi ni a niŋ bɛ yɛligu yɛda.
en: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Mɛsopoteemia m-mali hal ti paai Shɛkɛm din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ni alaafee nti ti suɣa dɔni tiŋ maa tooni polo.
en: After leaving northern Syria, Jacob arrived safely at Shechem in Canaan and set up camp outside the city.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun be di ni nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi; o bi tumdi din bie. O kariti saria asiba kam, ka ʒi n-naɣi li nolɔɣu kukoli kam. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi zɔri vi.
en: The LORD is righteous in her midst. He does nothing unjust. Morning by morning he renders justice, but the unrighteous one knows no shame.

dag: Pukpar so n-na ʒi n-kɔr o puu n-kul kɔri li yɛrigira.
en: Does a farmer plow his field all the time? No, he doesnt work the soil all the time.

dag: ni alahichi sanyoo sara bula yino m-pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also offer male goat as a sin offering. This must be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: ka Tɔa nyɛ Zuf bia, ka Zuf nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Mahat bia, ka Mahat nyɛ Amasai bia.
en: Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai.

dag: ka daa lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: They tied him up and led him away to Pilate the governor.

dag: Zuliya pam niriba ni ka yi neesim maa ni na, ka nanim ka yi biɛkaali neesim ni na.
en: Then the nations will come to your light. Kings will come to your bright sunrise.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ suhuri ni ye Shia Kasi pina bɔbu zuɣu shɛm, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye din ni kpaŋsi cheechi ni niriba gba zuɣu lala.
en: The same holds true for you: since you are ambitious for spiritual gifts, use your ambition to try to work toward being the best at building up the church.

dag: Ti mi ni ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yil shɛl ni ŋɔ yi saɣim, ti mali yil shɛli Naawuni sani, ka di nyɛ din ni be alizanda ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka di mi pala ninsal nuhi ni me shɛli.
en: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.

dag: Bee bɔndali ka ti daa nya o ka a biɛra bee nti be sarika ni, ka ti ka a sanna ti kaag a.
en: or visit you while you were sick or in jail.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali firilatamdigu. O daa zaŋla matarika n-kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili. Ka di mini di pipihi ni di bintira kɔtomsi la ni di tipuma kɔtomsi la zaa daa nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: Then he made the lampstand. He used pure gold and hammered it to make the base and the shaft. Then he made flowers, buds, and petals and joined everything together into one piece.

dag: Ka ŋun Yaakubu maŋmaŋ daa daŋ bɛ tooni n-chaŋ ti damdi tiŋ napɔŋ buyopɔin hal ti mir o biɛli maa tooni.
en: He himself went in front of them and bowed to the ground seven times as he was approaching his brother.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa suug o koyuli maa na yomyom gbibi ka yɛl o, N dana, nyuma.
en: I'll be glad to, she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Oi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ! Bɛ kul yɛrila n yɛla yɛra, Pa saliŋ lɔha ka o lɔhi maa? .
en: Then I said, Oh, LORD God! They say about me, Isnt he one for making metaphors.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee nyɛ li? Ka o garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla piɛɣu, ka nyɛ din ʒe bɛ daalahichi zaani dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: I said, I dont know. What is it? He said, That is a measuring bucket. He also said, That bucket is for measuring the sins of the people in this country.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi nyaŋ o, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah. He arrested Jehoiakim and put him in chains, and he sent him to the capital city of Babylon.

dag: amaa yi ni shɛb bi niŋ li yɛda. Yisa daa pun mi piligu ni ha bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ni nyɛ so.
en: Yet some of you do not believe.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sulemaana n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Salima sara maligu bimbini mini salima teebuli shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: Solomon gave orders to make the following temple furnishings out of gold: the altar; the table that held the sacred loaves of bread;.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs yuli ka Mɔdɛkai daa zaŋ sab gbana maa, ka zaŋ ŋun naa nintua dalinli dihi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li tim wɔribariba bɛn daa bari nayili wɔrikpaa ni wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam, ka bɛ zaŋ li tahi.
en: Mordecai had the letters written in the name of King Xerxes, and he stamped them with the royal seal. They were delivered by riders mounted on fast horses from the royal stables.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ tuma zaa kul wuhirila lala, bɛ zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, lala ka bɛ niŋd a gba maa.
en: They are doing to you only what theyve been doing to me from the day I brought them out of Egypt to this very minute, abandoning me and worshipping other gods.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni omaŋmaŋ n-yɛn nyɛ buɣim gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm n-gul li, ka be di ni ni o jilima zaa.
en: But I will be a wall of fire around it, says the LORD, and I will be glorious inside it.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni Izraɛlnim kpe o tiŋgbani maa ni gari, ka daa laɣim o tɔbbihi na ti dɔni Jahaz n-tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: Sihon didn't think the Israelites could be trusted, so he called his army together. They set up camp at Jahaz, then they attacked the Israelite camp.

dag: Ka m mi ni n yi ti ka yi sanna n ni ʒi Masia daalibarika din galisi pam na.
en: And I know that when I visit you, I will bring you Christs full blessing.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dɔɣi Anabi Musa, ka o daa viɛli pam ka Naawuni nini tiɣ o, ka o ba min o ma daa mal o duu hal ti paai chira ata.
en: Thats when Moses was born. He was highly favored by God, and for three months his parents cared for him in their home.
