dag: N daa zaŋ wuntitali niŋ mmaŋa, ka di pili ma. N yɛlimaŋli tuma daa ŋmanila zabba mini baŋtabiga.
en: I have always acted justly and fairly.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛlaa maa kul mal o yila maa n-ʒiɛri kpari wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo. Ka biŋkɔb so daa kani n-ni tooi taɣ o zali bee n-zo n-yi o nuu ni tiligi. Piɛlaa maa daa kul tumdila o suhuyubu, ka duhir omaŋa.
en: I watched the ram run into things with its horns. I watched the ram run to the west, to the north, and to the south. No animal could stop the ram, and no one could save the other animals. That ram did whatever it wanted, and it became very powerful.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa lu o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa yirigi zana pil o n-gbaag o bɛ ni daa gbi bɔɣ shɛli sɔŋ ni.
en: The nations gathered to fight him; people came from everywhere. They spread their hunting nets and caught him in their trap.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, yiɣisim ka ti chaŋ. Amaa ka o bi garigi. Ka o daa kpuɣi paɣ maa pa o buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kul o ya.
en: Get up, he said to her, lets go. But there was no response. So he laid her across a donkey, and the man set out for home.

dag: Yawɛ n-tim ba ni bɛ cham gili kaai dunia ŋɔ nya.
en: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.

dag: Nandaamba ni ti di n-tiɣi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ni paɣ o. Naawuni chɛ ka yi kul tɔŋdi sahakam.
en: Let all those who are suffering eat and be full! Let all who seek the LORD praise him! I pray your hearts live forever!.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa ayɔbu mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: For the back of the dwelling on the west, they made six boards.

dag: N ni lan chahi yi sarisi ŋɔ, ka fa n niriba bɛn be yi nuu ni maa bahi, ka bɛ ku lan be yi nuu ni n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn ku shɛba. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will rip off your scarves and let my people escape from your power once and for all. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Jɛhɔshafat, A ni saɣi pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka Jɛhɔshafat garigi yɛli Izraɛl naa, A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, Would you go to Ramoth with me and attack the Syrians? Just tell me what to do, Jehoshaphat answered. My army and horses are at your command.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni wurim n-leei dabari, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya maa ti jɛm Babilɔn naa yuun pisopɔin.
en: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for years.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi tɔbu kikaa, o kumdimi ni suhupiɛlli. Tɔbu yi be katiŋa, o taɣirila di ʒiɛɣu, ka wumdi sapashin kpamba ni tahira kaman saa tahigu la.
en: At each blast of the trumpet they snort; they can smell a battle before they get near, and they hear the officers shouting commands.

dag: Yisa ni daa niŋ li Vuhim Dabisili dali maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim maa muɣisi Yisa pam.
en: Jesus was doing all this on the Sabbath day. So these Jews began trying to make him stop.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi o zuɣu biŋkpam bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so biŋkpam tum tuun shɛli, amaa miriya ka yi ŋub li.
en: The fat of an animal that has died a natural death or has been killed by a wild animal must not be eaten, but it may be used for any other purpose.

dag: Bɛ daa dolila bɛ kɔribiɛri soli mɔɣu maa ni, ka daa buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Simiɔn zuliya yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, doo kam ŋun paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ ŋunkam ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Simeon, registered by their clans and their households. Every male years old and above eligible for military service was individually recorded by name.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa mini bɛ fiilinima ni sipuɣisinim ni bɛ kpiŋkpama ni kalima maa zaa daa malila nina ti tuui.
en: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa dolila ʒiri, ka doli yɔhiŋ soli yomyom.
en: I am not dishonest or deceitful.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: This is what the people from the Merari family will do to serve in the work for the Meeting Tent. Ithamar son of Aaron the priest will be responsible for their work.

dag: Miri ka a ku ninsala.
en: Do not commit murder.

dag: Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pumpɔŋɔ, ka di pala yi suhuri ni daa saɣim maa zuɣu, amaa yi suhuri ni daa saɣim ka yi niŋ tuuba la zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun saɣi ka yi suhuri daa saɣim maa, dinzuɣu yi bi kɔŋ shɛli ti ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: Now I am happy, not because you were made sad, but because your sorrow made you decide to change. That is what God wanted, so you were not hurt by us in any way.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa yiɣisi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: So Assyrias King Sennacherib left and went back to Nineveh, where he stayed.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li n-girimgirim li.
en: Some of the seed fell among thorn bushes, which grew up and choked the plants.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti lan labisi Mɔabnim daazichi ti ba dabisa shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni. Mɔabnim tibidarigibo tariga m-bala.
en: Moabs people will be taken away as captives. But in days to come, I will bring them back. This message is from the Lord . This ends the judgment on Moab.

dag: Yi daa tim tuumba Jɔn Baptaizira sani, ka o gba daa di yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ shɛhira.
en: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: There they put me to the test and tried me, although they had seen what I did for them.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti Yawɛ zaa, di yi nyɛla daadam bee biŋkɔbigu bee o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali, di bi simdi ni bɛ kɔhi li bee n-yo di zuɣu ka dee li, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Yawɛ nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Also note that everything someone devotes to the LORD from their possessions—whether humans, animals, or pieces of land from their family property—cannot be sold or bought back. Every devoted thing is most holy to the LORD.

dag: N dihi dimbɔŋɔ tabili, dinzuɣu m mi ni n na ni be. M mini ya zaa na ni be ka n sɔŋ chɛ ka yi tooni chandi mini yi suhupiɛlli zooi pahi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni.
en: I am sure of this, so I know that I will stay here and be with you to help you grow and have joy in your faith.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yinim bɛn yiɣisiri asiba n-gbaai dam nyubu la, yi kul niŋdila lala hal ni yuŋ n-nyu li buɣi.
en: How terrible it will be for you people who rise early in the morning and go looking for beer to drink. You stay awake late at night, getting drunk on wine.

dag: O ni daa karim gbaŋ maa naai ka o bɔhi ni luɣ dini ka Pool lee yina. O ni daa wum ni o yila Kilikia na.
en: The governor read the letter. Then he asked Paul and found out that he was from Cilicia.

dag: Ka viri mini kahiŋkɔri zaŋ li leei bɛ biɛhigu shee. Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka di lan leei tiŋgban kpiŋ yaha, kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks.

dag: Amaa ka naa maa daa bɔh o, Siɣimsiɣim bula ka n kul yɛr a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: But the king said, How many times must I demand that you tell me the truth when you speak in the name of the LORD.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lab kpe saria karibu shee maa ka boli Yisa na ti bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Pilate went back into the palace. He summoned Jesus and asked, Are you the king of the Jews.

dag: dinzuɣu m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma nam shɛm, lala ka n gba zali ya nam.
en: and just as my Father has given me the right to rule, so I will give you the same right.

dag: Dama bɛ zina niŋbu maa daa bi muɣisi ba. Bɛ daa saɣim tiŋgbani maa, ka niŋ zina kuɣili kam mini tia kam gbini.
en: She didnt think twice about corrupting the land and committing adultery with stone and tree.

dag: Bɛ buɣa maa ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa zali watamilo puu ni n-varisiri binnɛma, ka bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la. Niriba n-kpuɣiri ba chana, dama bɛ ku tooi chaŋ. Miriya ka yi zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ mi ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: They are no different than a scarecrow in a cucumber patch: they cant speak; they must be carried because they cant walk. Dont be afraid of them, because they cant do harm or good.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul beni n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma, ka mali tampiɛlli din be kaman mukur la lɔr o shee ni.
en: In the meantime the boy Samuel continued to serve the Lord , wearing a sacred linen apron.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yuri ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu. Maranaata! Ti Duuma, kamina!.
en: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.

dag: Siprɛs tihi ni ti bili zani gɔhi zaashee. Ka ti shɛli bɛ ni booni mitil la mi ti bili suligunyinyari zaashee. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ shihirili shɛli din ni beni sahakam ka ku vuui.
en: Cypress trees will grow where now there are briers; myrtle trees will come up in place of thorns. This will be a sign that will last forever, a reminder of what I, the Lord , have done.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋdila bɛn niŋdi ya viɛnyɛliŋga zaɣ viɛlli, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba niŋdila lala.
en: If you do good to those who do good to you, why should you be commended? Even sinners do that.

dag: Di bi wumdi bɛ ni so, bɛ so mi bi tuura. Gom bi gbaari ba bee ka bɛ ti gbihi. Bɛ ni so shɛlɔrigu bi wɔɣisi bee bɛ namdili ti chihi.
en: Not one is tired; not one stumbles; they dont rest or sleep; no belt is loose; no sandal broken.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Mbo n-faaŋa, bi suŋ ni n yɛdalana ŋun ʒe ma yim! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ a leei bin din zooi pam zuɣulana; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli kaman n suhu ni piɛli shɛm ŋɔ.
en: The master answered, You did right. You are a good servant who can be trusted. You did well with that small amount of money. So I will let you care for much greater things. Come and share my happiness with me.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya sochanda ka o ʒi tiŋ maa sokpaŋa; ka ninkurigu maa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Bee ya ka a lee chana.
en: He looked up and saw the traveler in the city square. Where are you heading and where have you come from? the old man asked.

dag: Dama n nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka m mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. N ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka ni tooi yɛli n dabili mi ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: Im a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I say to one, Go, and he goes, and to another, Come, and he comes. I say to my servant, Do this, and the servant does it.

dag: n ni mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani. N ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ sani.
en: I will still be joyful and glad, because the Lord God is my savior.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔhi taba, So n-tahi bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di yɔɣɔ.
en: His disciples started asking each other, Has someone brought him something to eat.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti naai, n ni darigi Babilɔn naa maa min o niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tibili, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa kpalim zani dabari sahakam.
en: When the seventy years are over, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation for their wrongdoing, declares the LORD. I will reduce the land of the Babylonians to a wasteland for all time.

dag: Diimas ni yuri dunia ŋɔ la zuɣu, o zoya chaŋ Tɛsalɔnaika ka chɛ ma; Krɛshɛnsi chaŋ Galɛshia, ka Taitus mi chaŋ Dalimatia.
en: Demas fell in love with this present world and has deserted me, going off to Thessalonica. Crescens went to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbihi daa woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnima n-zani kahigi bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi wuhi.
en: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ kul ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Our Lord , you will rule forever!.

dag: Dama Masia n-chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ʒiɛmani zan tariga ni di chɛ ka ŋunkam niŋ yɛda yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith.

dag: N ni kar a saria kaman bɛ ni kariti paɣ shɛb bɛn tum zina ka ku niriba ka bɛ kariti ba saria shɛm la, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒil a ni suhuyiɣisili mini nyuli.
en: I will convict you of adultery and murder, and I will hand you over in bloody fury and zeal.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli tumo maa, A ni yɛn chaŋ ti yɛli Jɔab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ kpaŋs o suhu, Di chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ muɣis a, dama takɔb bi chihiri so kubu, mali suhukpeeni ka liri tiŋ maa nim ni nimmoo n-nyaŋ ba. .
en: David said to the messenger, Give this message to Joab: Dont be too upset about this. A sword can kill one person as well as the next. Make a stronger attack against Rabbah and you will win. Encourage Joab with these words.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Gɛhaazi na ti yɛl o, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa na. Ka o bol o. Ka paɣ maa kana, ka o ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a bia.
en: Elisha called Gehazi and told him to call the boy's mother. When she came in, he said to her, Here's your son.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

dag: Yi daa tim tuumba Jɔn Baptaizira sani, ka o gba daa di yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ shɛhira.
en: John is the one to whom you sent your messengers, and he spoke on behalf of the truth.

dag: Dama bɛ dɔɣi bia ti ti, bɛ ti ti bidibiga; o nyɛla ŋun su fukumsi; ka o yuli ni ti booni, Alahiziba mini Saɣisira ni Kpiɔŋlan Naawuni ni Saha din ka bahigu Ba ni Suhudoo Nabia.
en: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.

dag: n naŋgbampiba ku ŋma ʒiri, ka n zilinli mi ku tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: my lips will never say anything evil, my tongue will never tell a lie.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ nayili dunɔdali din yuli daa booni wɔhu dunɔdal la gbini nti ku o nimaani.
en: Then those men grabbed Athaliah when she came to the entrance of the Horse Gate at the kings palace. Then they killed her there.

dag: A bɔhiya, Ŋuni n-lee beni n-sɔɣiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, mani n-daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni. N daa tɔɣisila binshɛŋa yɛla ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam, ka m bi baŋ li.
en: You asked, Who is this ignorant person saying these foolish things? I talked about things I did not understand. I talked about things too amazing for me to know.

dag: ni Goshɛn ni Holɔn ni Gilo: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara piniyini m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh. In all, there were eleven towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Ka Sisɛra ma daa vɔbisiri lihiri takɔro ni. O daa kul vɔbisiri lihirila takɔro maa voya ni ka bɔhira, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ti yuui kundina lala? Bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka di yuui ka ti kul bi wumd o yuri napɔn chinchiba damli.
en: Sisera's mother looked out through her window. Why is he taking so long? she asked. Why haven't we heard his chariots coming.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka niriba daa tahi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu zaa Yisa sanna.
en: That night, after the sun went down, the people brought to Jesus many who were sick. They also brought those who had demons inside them.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din daa lo ni di tahi nyɛvili na la, man sani di tahila kum na.
en: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.

dag: Amaa Kɔra zuliya bɛn daa bi kpi.
en: But Korahs descendants didnt die.

dag: Bɛ daa tam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiligira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun daa tum tuun kara Ijipti la yɛla.
en: They forgot all about God, the one who saved them, the one who did the miracles in Egypt.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ bindira maa zali ŋun daa guli bɛ nɛma sani, ka guui ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni chaŋ ti puh o biɛyanim maa.
en: David left the food with the officer in charge of the supplies, ran to the battle line, went to his brothers, and asked how they were getting along.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili dali miriya. Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu na dabisi shɛli dali maa miriya. Fabilimiya!.
en: Howl in pain! The day of the Lord is near, the day when the Almighty brings destruction.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa dɔɣi Tɛra maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisiyinika. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Nahor had more children and died at the age of .

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa yiɣisi zani n-darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka pini o zuɣu, ka gbani tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Job arose, tore his clothes, shaved his head, fell to the ground, and worshipped.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli din tuhi, ka niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: Offer the right sacrifices to the Lord , and put your trust in him.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di lan pahi lala! Ka daa zaŋ o nuu shihi doo maa tibili maa ka di lab tabili yaha.
en: Jesus said, Stop! Then he touched the servants ear and healed him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka niriba pam ka bɛ sanna nti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka ʒe bɛ nɛma.
en: So I, the Lord God, now say to these sisters: I will call together an angry mob that will abuse and rob you.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa, ka Aduna daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa bahi Firawuna min o kpamba tooni, ka di leei wahu.
en: Moses and Aaron went to the king and his officials and did exactly as the Lord had commanded—Aaron threw the stick down, and it turned into a snake.

dag: N Naawuni, n yɛrimi, di zaŋ ma n nyɛvili sunsuuni, nyini ŋun kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni ŋɔ.
en: So I said, Dont let me die while I am still young. God, you will live forever and ever!.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, Kulima! A ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, alizin biɛɣu maa zoya ka chɛ a bia maa.
en: Then he told her, That is a very good answer. You may go. The demon has left your daughter.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmiya yomyom ka bɛ ti yɛli Dauda ni o di gbe kulibɔŋ duli maa yuŋ ŋɔ, amaa ni o chɛ ka o min o niriba maa tirisi tooni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kpimsi ŋun naa mini niriba bɛn be o sani maa birili zaa.
en: Then he said, Hurry! Send someone to warn David not to spend the night on this side of the Jordan. He must get across the river, so he and the others won't be wiped out.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka o zaŋ ti leeg o bihi yɛlimaŋli yɛligu la puuni ni di chɛ ka ti leeg o bikpamba o binnamda zaa puuni.
en: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth.

dag: Niriba ni daa nya Pool ni niŋ shɛm maa ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee kuhi yɛli pam Laikɔnia yɛligu ni, Ti buɣa n-leei ninsalinim ka ti sanna ŋɔ.
en: Seeing what Paul had done, the crowd shouted in the Lycaonian language, The gods have taken human form and come down to visit us.

dag: Zuɣusaa wuhir o wuntitali; ka zuliya kam zaa nyar o jilima.
en: Heaven has proclaimed Gods righteousness, and all nations have seen his glory.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi ti nya zahimbu balibu kam, yin maliya suhupiɛlli di puuni.
en: My brothers and sisters, you will have many kinds of trouble. But this gives you a reason to be very happy.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni daa nyɛla bɛ lihiri binshɛŋa din be kasi pam la.
en: These are the responsibilities of the Kohathites in the meeting tent: the most holy things.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa bi deei Naawuni yɛligu saha shɛl o ni daa di suɣilo guhiri ba Anabi Nuhu ʒiɛman ni la. Di saha ka Anabi Nuhu daa kpahiri ŋariŋ shɛli niriba biɛla bɛn nyɛ niriba anii kɔŋko ni daa kpe n-tiligi kom dibu ni la.
en: These were the spirits of those who had not obeyed God when he waited patiently during the days that Noah was building his boat. The few people in the boat—eight in all—were saved by the water.

dag: Mabihi yi laɣim be ka mali naŋgban yini, di viɛli ka nyaɣisi pam!.
en: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.

dag: Tim ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu.
en: Give us the bread we need for today.

dag: Amazia ni daa tuhi Ɛdomnim naai ka labiri kuna, o daa kpuɣila bɛ wuna m-mali kuli ti zaŋ li leeg omaŋmaŋ wuna n-jɛmdi li ka maani li.
en: When Amaziah returned after defeating the Edomites, he brought the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down before them, and burned incense to them.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din daa nyɛ kuɣ kara ka mali shaara, ka di shɛŋa wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili, ka shɛŋa mi nyɛ mita anahinahi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali duri maa tanzahi.
en: The foundations were made of large stones prepared at the quarry, some of them twelve feet long and others fifteen feet long.

dag: Yɛlimiya Amasa, A nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n yi bi zaŋ a leei n tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, Naawuni ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba. .
en: David also told them to say to Amasa, You are my relative. From now on I am putting you in charge of the army in place of Joab. May God strike me dead if I don't.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ kɔŋko nti di bindir shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara bɛ maligumaaniba leebu saha maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun pa maligumaana ti di li, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha ka Yisa lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti wuhiri niriba, ka do so ŋun nudirigu bɔɣu kpi daa beni.
en: On another Sabbath Jesus was teaching in a synagogue, and a man with a paralyzed right hand was there.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri bɔri ma? Yi bi mi ni di nyɛ ma la talahi ni m be m Ba duu.
en: Jesus answered, Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kana ti zani sansani maa dunɔdali ni ka yɛli, Ŋunkam be Yawɛ polo, ŋun kam n sanna. Ka Lɛvi bidibisi zaa daa laɣimna ti zani gil o.
en: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, Everyone who is on the Lord 's side come over here! Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Lala viɛla. Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Laban said, All right; lets do it.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ paɣila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o yurilim maŋli la naani.
en: but he takes pleasure in those who honor him, in those who trust in his constant love.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, so yi di naan chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di samban ni dunɔdali shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: David was thirsty for some water from his hometown, so he said, Oh, if only I could have some water from that well by the gate in Bethlehem.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan zaŋ ʒim mihi tanti Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mini binshɛlikam bɛ ni daa mali tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma.
en: In the same way Moses also sprinkled the blood on the Sacred Tent and over all the things used in worship.

dag: Dauda ni daa kul yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Jɔnatan suhu dii gbaai Dauda, ka o daa yur o kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm.
en: As soon as David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathans life became bound up with Davids life, and Jonathan loved David as much as himself.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa gindi fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi yihiri waazu, ka mali Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ yɛla wuhiri niriba. Ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la daa be o sani.
en: Soon afterward, Jesus traveled through the cities and villages, preaching and proclaiming the good news of Gods kingdom. The Twelve were with him.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛgilɔn daa laɣim Ammɔnnim mini Amalɛknima m-pah o min o niriba zuɣu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka fa dɔbino tihi tiŋ la bɛ sani.
en: who had joined forces with the Ammonites and the Amalekites to attack Israel. Eglon and his army captured Jericho.

dag: Nail Mɔɣili kom ni filim, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui zaa.
en: The water will be low in the Nile, and the river will gradually dry up.

dag: Tinzunnim ni guli yi biŋkɔbbaligu tin ya, ka ko yi puri tin ya, ka guli yi tihi puri tin ya.
en: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm, ka bɛ bidibbina bahi yoli!.
en: The brave soldiers have fallen, their weapons abandoned and useless.

dag: ka yi gba deei nyɛvili maŋli o sani, yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gari alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi zaa.
en: And because you belong to Christ you are complete, having everything you need. Christ is ruler over every other power and authority.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na nti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Ka wula ka a na kul doli suhiri karimba maa.
en: While Jesus was saying this, some messengers came from Jairus' house and told him, Your daughter has died. Why bother the Teacher any longer.

dag: A ni daa ku Sool so min o yiŋnim shɛba, ka di nam zan o zaani la biɛri ka Yawɛ bɔhir a, ka fa a nam maa ti a bia Absalom maa. Nyama a bahila yoli maa, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ kura.
en: the Lord is paying you back for killing so many in Saul's family. You stole his kingdom, but now the Lord has given it to your son Absalom. You're a murderer, and that's why you're in such big trouble.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a wuntitali biɛhigu la zuɣu, karimi saria n-ti ma nasara; di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma.
en: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me.

dag: Amaa a nyara, hal a nya muɣisigu mini wahala shɛŋa bɛ ni dira, chɛ ka yɛla maa be a nuu ni. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri sɔŋsim zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋla a nuu ni; a mi pun nyɛla kpibisi sɔŋda.
en: But, Lord, you do see the pain and suffering they cause. You see it, so punish them. Those who were left helpless put their trust in you. After all, you are the one who cares for orphans.

dag: Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: What do you think? They answered, He is guilty and deserves to die.

dag: ka ŋun pahi pia nyɛ Jɛrimia, ka ŋun pahi piniyini nyɛ Makibanai.
en: Jeremiah tenth, Machbannai eleventh.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa a ni daa nya la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn na bi di nam, amaa bɛ ni ti ti ba yiko ka bɛ di nam pahi biŋkɔbigu la zuɣu awa yini.
en: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet begun to rule, but who will be given authority to rule as kings for one hour with the beast.

dag: Ka chanya yɛtɔɣ yoya mini yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu ni asahi kpɛma niŋbu. Di zaa ŋɔ shɛli bi simdi niŋbu, amaa din simdi niŋbu nyɛla wumpaɣibo.
en: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.

dag: ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o, ka o neei kum ni daba ata dali kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: he was buried, and he rose on the third day in line with the scriptures.

dag: Zaŋm amaŋa n-niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka niŋ o naani ka o tum di ni simdi ni o tum shɛm.
en: Depend on the Lord . Trust in him, and he will help you.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim tuumba o biɛli Iso sani Siɛr Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daŋ o tooni.
en: Jacobs brother Esau was living in the area called Seir in the hill country of Edom. Jacob sent messengers to Esau.

dag: Amaa Hiram ni daa ti yi Taai kana ni o ti nya tin shɛŋa Sulemaana ni zaŋ ti o maa, o nini daa bi tiɣi li.
en: When Hiram went to see the towns, he did not like them.

dag: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bi galisi, ka nyɛ saamba di ni la.
en: When they were few in number— insignificant, just immigrants.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yiɣisi Rɛfidim chaŋ ti paai Sinai tiŋgban nɛli maa ni. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa dɔnila tiŋgban nɛli maa ni. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa maa la Sinai Zoli gbini.
en: They had traveled from Rephidim to the Sinai desert. The Israelites camped in the desert near Mount Sinai.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi tumla alahichi paai Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti labina, salo maa zaa daa yiɣisimi m-puh o ni o paabuna, dama bɛ daa pun yuun o la soli.
en: When Jesus returned to the other side of the lake, the people welcomed him, because they had all been waiting for him.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa nimdi duɣi luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Take the ram for the ordination and boil its meat in a holy place.

dag: Yɛligu maa ni ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛvili daa yina, ka nyɛvili maa daa nyɛ neesim ninsalinim sani.
en: The Word was the source of life, and this life brought light to people.

dag: M puhiri Rufus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ti Duuma ni la min o ma ŋun nyɛ n gba ma la.
en: Say hello to Rufus, who is an outstanding believer, along with his mother and mine.

dag: Sagbani maa ni daa kul vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa saha shɛli, nyama, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu dii gbaai Miriam, ka o niŋgbuŋ paligi zaa kaman gumbɔrigu la. Ka Aduna daa ŋmaligi lihi Miriam polo n-nya ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-gbaag o.
en: and the cloud left the Tent, Miriam's skin was suddenly covered with a dreaded disease and turned as white as snow. When Aaron looked at her and saw that she was covered with the disease.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ buhi kɔbiri wuɣi tana piniyini n-zaŋ li pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa.
en: As the material for protecting the tent, goat hair was used to weave eleven sections meters by meters each.

dag: Ti loya ni ti ku niŋ din ni chɛ ka so galim ti yurilim pina din galisi ŋɔ taribu ni.
en: We are being careful so that no one will criticize us about the way we are caring for this large gift.

dag: Yi kul ni kpalim bela Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol maa ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ tumdi Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm hal ni daba ayopɔin, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama Yawɛ n-zali ma lala.
en: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ ka yi niŋ yɛda ni mani n-shiri nyɛ n ni yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la.
en: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.

dag: hal ka di pala bɛ zuliya maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ni o laɣim Naawuni bihi bɛn wurim kpe yɔɣu na la gba ka bɛ ti lee zaɣ yini.
en: Yes, he would die for the Jewish people. But he would also die for Gods other children scattered all over the world. He would die to bring them all together and make them one people.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi dol li n-tum di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Now we know that the Law is good if used appropriately.

dag: dama kaman sokam zaa ni kpi Adam ni shɛm, lala ka sokam zaa ni neei kum ni Masia zuɣu.
en: For just as all people die because of their union with Adam, in the same way all will be raised to life because of their union with Christ.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba ŋɔ bɛn kpe yɔɣu ka bi lan labina? Bɛ dolila yɔhiŋ soli ka zaɣisi labbuna.
en: Why then, my people, do you turn away from me without ever turning back? You cling to your idols and refuse to return to me.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi nya Yawɛ dabisili la zuɣu. Zaɣ viɛl bɔ ka Yawɛ dabisili maa yɛn tum ya? Di yɛn nyɛla zibisim dabisili, ka pa ni neesim dabisili.
en: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, niŋmiya tuuba ni yi suhuri zaa, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna ni nolɔbo mini kumsi ni fabila.
en: This is the Lord s message: Now come back to me with all your heart. Cry and mourn, and dont eat anything! Show that you are sad for doing wrong.

dag: Maligumaana yi zaŋ kawana bee chi na ti mali sara, di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim, di bi simdi ni bɛ di li.
en: Every grain offering that a priest gives must be completely burned. It must not be eaten.

dag: A daa lan zaŋ n ni ti a salima min anzinfa yɛ viɛli shɛŋa la m-mali binnana din nyɛ dɔbba n-zaŋ ba tum pagɔrisigu tuma.
en: You took the silver and gold jewelry that I had given you, used it to make male images, and committed adultery with them.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N dana, ka yuri ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka malaika so ŋun daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa garigi yɛli ma, N ni wuh a bɛ yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka do so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa daa garigi yɛli.
en: I said, Sir, what are these horses for? Then the angel speaking to me said, I will show you what these horses are for.

dag: Daba n-su ti, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ti bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Our rulers are no better than slaves, and no one can save us from their power.

dag: ni Umma ni Afɛk ni Rɛhɔb gba daa pahi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pisinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob; in total: twenty-two cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ Bɛtani ti gbe nimaani.
en: Then Jesus left the city and went out to the village of Bethany, where he spent the night.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ti lan gariti du shɛli din yuli du pam ŋɔ gbini, di ni gari ba, ka bɛ bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini jɛmbu duu ŋɔ lala.
en: The Temple is now greatly honored, but then everyone who passes by it will be amazed and will ask, Why did the Lord do this to this land and this Temple.

dag: Ka bɛn fabindi be kaman bɛn bi fabinda, ka bɛn mali suhupiɛlli be kaman bɛn ka suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn dari nɛma be kaman bɛn bi su nɛma maa;.
en: Those who are sad should be like people who arent crying. Those who are happy should be like people who arent happy. Those who buy something should be like people who dont have possessions.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm piɛgul so ŋun ka buchi nɛma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Next, the Lord said to me, Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu.
en: Look, your house is left to you deserted.

dag: A bela alizanda ni ha ka kari saria; ka dabiɛm kpe dunianima, ka bɛ fo baalim.
en: You have announced judgment from heaven. The earth grew afraid and fell silent.

dag: M bi paɣiri ya n ni yɛn wuhi ya wuhibu shɛli ŋɔ puuni, dama yi yi laɣim di bi sɔŋdi ya, amaa di naɣ saɣindi ya mi.
en: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni ku dɔɣi bihi, ka buɣim ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei birapu yiya.
en: There will be no descendants for godless people, and fire will destroy the homes built by bribery.

dag: Hal sakpaleensi mɛrila bɛ duri, ka ŋmanʒiɛhi mali bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛri a jɛmbu duu puuni; ka mali bɛ bihi sɔŋdi baɣind a sara maligu bimbini; nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ n naa ni n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Lord All-Powerful, my King, my God, even the birds have found a home in your Temple. They make their nests near your altar, and there they have their babies.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kabiri kpɛri fɔntinsi ni, ka duri goma, ka duri kpɛri yiya puuni ka duri kpɛri takɔriti ni kaman tayiɣisi la.
en: They rush against the city; they run over the walls; they climb up the houses and go in through the windows like thieves.

dag: Kalima anahi maa daa du pam ka mali dabiɛm. Ka nimbihi daa pie di fiilinim ni ti tuui.
en: The rims of the wheels were covered with eyes.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka saha daa ti paai ni bɛ zaŋ o ti bahi, ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa pihi bia maa ni o ti wums o n-zaŋ o leeg omaŋmaŋ bia.
en: and when he was put out of his home, the king's daughter adopted him and brought him up as her own son.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa kar o yihi Idɛn puu maa ni ni o ti kɔr o ni daa yi tiŋgban shɛli ni na maa.
en: So the Lord God sent them out of the Garden of Eden and made them cultivate the soil from which they had been formed.

dag: ka yi yi gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-nyɛ yi ni tiligi shɛli zuɣu, ka naɣila yi daa naɣ niŋla yɛda yoli.
en: That Good News, the message you heard from me, is Gods way to save you. But you must continue believing it. If you dont, you believed for nothing.

dag: Izraɛl daa yuri Yisifu pam gar o bihi bɛn kpalim maa zaa, o ni daa nyɛ o ni dɔɣi bi so o kuriginsim saha la zuɣu. O daa shɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din baɣiri wɔɣa n-ti o.
en: Joseph was born at a time when his father Israel was very old, so Israel loved him more than he loved his other sons. Jacob gave him a special coat, which was long and very beautiful.

dag: Amaa Dauda ni daa nya ka o kpambaliba maa sɔɣiri yɛri tab maa ka o baŋ ni bia maa kpiya; ka bɔh o kpamba maa, Bia maa kpiya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O kpiya.
en: David noticed his servants whispering, and he knew the boy was dead. Did my son die? he asked his servants. Yes, he did, they answered.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi li, ka dalima din be o niŋgbuŋ ni maa yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛl tim, dindina di kul nyɛla saŋkpambihi n-niŋ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu maa, o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: a priest must look at them. If the spots on that persons skin are dull white, the disease is only a harmless rash. That person is clean.

dag: Ka gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa din be kasi zaa la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti kana.
en: The governor ordered them not to eat any of the most holy food until a priest could use the Urim and Thummim to ask God what to do.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛla tin titali, amaa niriba bɛn be di ni daa bi yaɣ lala, dama bɛ daa na bi lab me yiya pam di ni.
en: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni maligumaaniba zuɣulan Annas mini Kaiafas nti pahi Jɔn mini Alikizanda ni bɛnkam daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan dɔɣiriba zaa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The next day the Jewish leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law gathered in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, Nyɛvili bi ʒir ka dimsira! Ninsal ni zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa taɣi o nyɛvili.
en: The Adversary responded to the LORD, Skin for skin—people will give up everything they have in exchange for their lives.

dag: Ka bɛ nahiŋgu maa buɣim nyɔhi ni kpuɣi du zuɣusaa hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ku mali vuhim yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu la min o binnani la ni bɛnkam deeg o yuli dalinli la.
en: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.

dag: Ka o daa yul o luɣa ni ka bi nya so, ka daa ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa n-zaŋ o pi bihigu ni.
en: Moses looked around to see if anyone was watching, then he killed the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Dan tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ti paai Bɛrishiiba tiŋgban ni nim zaa kul be ni alaafee, ka sokam ʒin omaŋmaŋ yiŋ wain tihi mini fiig tihi gbina ni Sulemaana ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: During Solomons life everyone in Judah and Israel, all the way from Dan to Beersheba, lived in peace and security. The people were at peace sitting under their own fig trees and grapevines.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa kul be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam. O daa nyɛla gbarigu.
en: So Mephibosheth, who was crippled in both feet, lived in Jerusalem, eating all his meals at the king's table.

dag: Dama o daa lab mɛla o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee luɣ shɛŋa la zaa, ka me maligu bimbina zali Baalnima, ka lan lab me Ashɛranim ŋmahima zali, ka daa gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi saŋmarisi zaa.
en: He rebuilt the shrines that his father Hezekiah had destroyed, set up altars for the Baals, and made sacred poles. He bowed down to all the stars in the sky and worshipped them.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn daa mali kikah ayopɔin la niŋ shili ni bɛ piɛb bɛ kikahi maa.
en: Then the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to blow their trumpets.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima da li, ka nir ku tooi zaŋ anzinfa buɣisi di daa.
en: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma! Dama kom paala n nyiŋgoli tariga.
en: Save me, God, because the waters have reached my neck!.

dag: M bia, a yi deei n yɛligu, ka doli n zaligunim din be a suhu ni.
en: My child, learn what I teach you and never forget what I tell you to do.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu na nti yɛli zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo n-chɛ ka niriba maa zaa ŋum bɛ kparima ni niŋ Yawɛ la.
en: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n dan naa, di chɛ ka di muɣis a kaman a bihi maa zaa n-shiri kpi la, dama Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi.
en: So dont let this bother you, my master; dont think that all the princes are dead, because only Amnon is dead.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa shiri niŋ Judanima kaman Yawɛ ni zali shɛm ni o yihi ba o sani. Manaasa ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la.
en: and now he was making it happen. The country of Judah was going to be wiped out, because Manasseh had sinned.

dag: n-nya tarimba, ka n daa kpahim bipola n-nya nachimbil so ŋun ka yɛm bɛ ni.
en: I looked among the naive young men and noticed among the youth, one who had no sense.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛlikam zaa kaman anabinim ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm zaa la, ka bɛ daa siɣis o dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi siliga ni.
en: And after they had done everything that the Scriptures say about him, they took him down from the cross and placed him in a tomb.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be yoma mini tin shɛŋa din be katinsi zaa ni ti mali ya ansarisi, tin shɛli din yuli bi du ka gadama pali di ni ŋɔ.
en: Those from near and far will mock your infamous name and great chaos.

dag: Di saha maa Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ anabi, ka nyɛ Lapidɔt paɣ la n-daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was a leader of Israel at that time.

dag: Nuhu nini ni daa ti neei, ka bɛ yɛl o o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani maa ni niŋ o shɛm.
en: When Noah sobered up and learned what his youngest son had done.

dag: O dimnim fa o bin viɛla zaa. Hal o nya zuliya shɛba ni kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu la puuni; a ni daa zali ni di chihiri ni zuliya shɛb kpe a niriba laɣiŋgu ni la.
en: The enemies robbed her of all her treasures. She saw them enter the Temple itself, Where the Lord had forbidden Gentiles to go.

dag: ka din pah ata gbaai Harim, ka din pah anahi gbaai Siɔrim.
en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim shɛb zaa bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ kali ba kaman sokam ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm la, bɛ dɔbba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaayi.
en: The total number of all the Levite males one month old or older that Moses enrolled by clans at the command of the Lord , was .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa labi kuli maa kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: All together, there were , people in the group who came back. This is not counting their men and women slaves. They also had men and women singers with them.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun gbibi tɔbu ti ku tooi zani, ka ŋun tooi zɔri pam ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa, ka wɔribara gba ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: Archers will not stand their ground, fast runners will not get away, and men on horses will not escape with their lives.

dag: Dama a Duuma saɣisirila o ni yuri so, ka fiɛbiri o ni zaŋ so leeg o bia.
en: because the Lord disciplines whomever he loves, and he punishes every son or daughter whom he accepts. .

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ tooni ka o sanna ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋ pia.
en: The first servant came and said, Sir, with the money you gave me I have earned ten times as much.

dag: ka bahi noli ni niriba maa ni yu shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: Pilate issued his decision to grant their request.

dag: O daa di wahala pam timanim sani n-saɣim o ni daa mali shɛlikam zaa ha, ka di bi niŋd o soochi ka kul maan pahirimi.
en: even though she had been treated by many doctors. She had spent all her money, but instead of getting better she got worse all the time.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ni be shɛli, naŋgbankpeeni gba bela nimaani. Ka jilima tibu yi ka shɛli, filiŋ bela nimaani.
en: Do something evil, and people will hate you. Do something shameful, and they will have no respect for you.

dag: A yi zaŋ n ni wuh a shɛli ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la, a ni niŋ Yisa Masia tumtumdi suŋ, a ni zaŋ yɛda niŋbu yɛtɔɣa mini wuhibu suŋ shɛli a ni pun dol la n-dih amaŋ la zuɣu.
en: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala shiri gbahi zahim pam, hal ka bɛ lansi maa ti pili chɛhibu;.
en: They let them down and caught such a large number of fish that the nets were about to break.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Judah, Nahshon, Amminadabs son.

dag: Ti yi ti nya saɣisigu, di saha maa di bemi kaman din to ka pa din tiri suhupiɛlli; amaa di nyaaŋa bɛn deei saɣisigu tibidarigibo puuni ti nyari suhudoo din nyɛ wuntia biɛhigu laara.
en: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.

dag: Bɛnkam suhuri ye buni zuɣu, ka zaŋ kiŋkansi bɔrili bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Di dirila bɛn su li nyɛviya.
en: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life.

dag: M mali kpamdi zilinkom din viɛla mini yɛm maŋli. M mali tɛhi zilima, ka lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: I have advice and ability, as well as understanding and strength.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam!.
en: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.

dag: n-zaŋ Hilikia pa, ka Tɛbalia daa pah ata, ka Zakaria pah anahi: Hɔsa mabihi min o bidibisi zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaata.
en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All of Hosahs family and relatives numbered .

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda yi mali pakoya o dɔɣiriba ni, di simdi ni o lihiri ba, ka di zaŋ di yɛla ʒili cheechi, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka cheechi mi tooi lihi pako shɛb bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: But if any Christian woman has widows in her family, she must take care of them and not put the burden on the church, so that it may take care of the widows who are all alone.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi a yiŋ dundɔŋ ni na n-lu a zuɣu; ka n ti zaŋ a paɣiba ti a ʒiʒiinikpee ka o zaŋ ba dɔni palo ni wuntaŋ ni a ninni.
en: I swear to you that I will cause someone from your own family to bring trouble on you. You will see it when I take your wives from you and give them to another man; and he will have intercourse with them in broad daylight.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Karimba, mami daba ayi ŋɔ ni ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔri ni bɛ lab a kuɣa la, ka a ti lan yɛn lab nimaani yaha.
en: They answered, But Teacher, those Jews there tried to stone you to death. That was only a short time ago. Now you want to go back there.

dag: Ɛdom daa ka naa; wulana n-daa nyɛ naa.
en: The country of Edom had no king at the time, so a lower official ruled the land.

dag: Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni ʒi shɛba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni mi shɛb viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti bemi kaman bɛn kpira, amaa nyamiya, ka lee nyɛ bɛn be. Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni darigi shɛb tiba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni bi ku shɛba.
en: as unknown, yet we are known by all; as though we were dead, but, as you see, we live on. Although punished, we are not killed;.

dag: Chɛli n ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bipalital ni la taali. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli min a nirilim zuɣu, teemi n yɛla!.
en: Forgive the sins and errors of my youth. In your constant love and goodness, remember me, Lord !.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa kpi maa, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la so shɛli din daa kuni Ɛfirat la sokpaŋa, nimaani ka bɛ booni Bɛtilihɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Rachel was buried beside the road to Ephrath, which is also called Bethlehem.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la, ka zaɣis o zaligunim gba dolibu.
en: He deserted his ancestors God, the LORD—he didnt walk in the LORDs way.

dag: Ti daa pun yɛli ya ni yi miri ka yi mali Yisa yuli ŋɔ yihiri waazu tiri niriba, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ka bahi zaŋ li moli gili Jɛrusalɛm zaa, ka bɔri ni yi zaŋ o kum zambu ʒil ti.
en: In no uncertain terms, we demanded that you not teach in this name. And look at you! You have filled Jerusalem with your teaching. And you are determined to hold us responsible for this mans death.

dag: Ka bɛn daa kpalim la mi zaŋ daparilana mini ŋariŋ dapaɣ shɛŋa pa kom maa zuɣu n-gba du duli. Ka ti zaa daa duɣi du duli tiligi.
en: The others used wooden boards or pieces of the ship. And this is how all the people went safely to land.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi kariti ti saria, o darigirila ti tibili ni ti di pahi dunianim zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: But we are judged and punished by the Lord, so that we shall not be condemned together with the world.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa tɔɣisi Lɛvinim maa zaa suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli tum Yawɛ tuma maa zuɣu. Ka niriba maa daa di chuɣu maa bindirigu daba ayopɔin, ka daa kɔri suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri, ka paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Hezekiah praised the Levites for their skill in conducting the worship of the Lord . After the seven days during which they offered sacrifices in praise of the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

dag: Yɛlimiya yi bihi di yɛla; ka bɛ mi ti zaŋ di yɛla maa n-yɛli bɛ bihi, ka bɛ gba ti zaŋ di yɛla n-yɛli ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna niriba.
en: Tell it to your children, and have your children tell their children, and their children tell their children.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye naa bindir nyaɣisa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla yɔhiŋ bindira.
en: Don't be greedy for the fine food he serves; he may be trying to trick you.

dag: Chɛ ka Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu nim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka Juda tinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, a saria karibu zuɣu.
en: let the people of Zion be glad! You give right judgments; let there be joy in the cities of Judah!.

dag: ni o wuh o kpambaliba o ni bɔri shɛm, ka wuh o kpamba mi yɛm.
en: with power over the king's officials and authority to instruct his advisers.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa chaŋ Yisa sani yuŋ la gba daa bo mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la mini bɛ ni booni ti shɛli aloosi la sum gari taba n-zaŋ na. Di tibisim daa nyɛla kaman kilɔgiram pihita laasabu.
en: Nicodemus, the one who at first had come to Jesus at night, was there too. He brought a mixture of myrrh and aloe, nearly seventy-five pounds in all.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? Ka Naa Sool garigi yɛl o, A ni daa zali dabisi shɛli maa ni paai ka n nya ka a bi kanna, ka Filistianim mi lo tɔbu n-do Mikimash ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani maa wurindi ka chɛri ma.
en: Samuel asked, What have you done? Saul answered, I saw the soldiers leaving me. You were not here on time, and the Philistines were gathering at Micmash.

dag: Nyama, Sulemaana daamaŋka m-bala ka tɔbbihi pihiyɔbu bɛn mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gil li.
en: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.

dag: Din simdi ya m-bala. N ni lo ni n niŋ ya shɛm m-bala! Dama yi tam n yɛla, ka niŋla ʒiri naani. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what will happen to you. This is your part in my plans. This message is from the Lord . Why will this happen? Because you forgot me. You trusted false gods.

dag: Di saha ka malaika bɔbili daa dii yi alizanda ni na nti pahi malaika yino maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Suddenly a great army of heaven's angels appeared with the angel, singing praises to God:.

dag: Dama n nya ka a mali putɔɣu, ka be alahichi bandi ni.
en: I see that you are full of bitter jealousy and cannot stop yourself from doing wrong.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba nyari bɛ bindirigu la Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni? Ka yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tuma gba nyari bɛ bindirigu la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira?.
en: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la shɛm tarisi m-bɔŋɔ: Yisifu ni ti malila tarili buyi.
en: The LORD God proclaims: These are the boundaries of the portions of land that will be distributed as an inheritance to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph will receive two portions.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisifu ni daa neei gom ni ka o niŋ kaman ti Duuma malaika ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chɛ ka bɛ kulis o na.
en: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.

dag: Dama n yi be, Masia n-nyɛ n nyɛvili, ka m mi yi kpi, di nyɛla din so.
en: For what is life? To me, it is Christ. Death, then, will bring more.

dag: Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o bia Yisahaku ni. Yisahaku daa bela Bɛrilahairoi.
en: After the death of Abraham, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa lan nyɛ: Maɔn mini Kamɛl ni Zif ni Juta.
en: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni nya li ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi; bɛ ni ti dim bɛ nyina ka bahi yoli; ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu ni kpalim yoli.
en: The wicked become angry when they see this. They grind their teeth in anger, but then they disappear. They will never get what they want most.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Yɛl titali paai ma, chɛ ka n kpɛla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam, amaa di chɛ ka n kpe ninsal nuu ni.
en: David replied to Gad, I am in a desperate situation! But I don't want to be punished by people. Let the Lord himself be the one to punish me, because he is merciful.

dag: yɛra, Bɛn yoli ka tuma ŋɔ ni na kul tumla awa yini kɔŋko, ka tinim bɛn lee di tuma ŋɔ wahala ka wuntaŋ kpe ti biɛɣu zaa pahi ŋɔ mini ba zaa yɔri ti nyɛ yim.
en: They said, The ones who were hired last worked for only one hour. But you paid them the same that you did us. And we worked in the hot sun all day long.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija saha sanzali ni daa zani yuma ata ni chira ayɔbu ka kum lu luɣilikam, ka pakoya daa yam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Listen to me: it is true that there were many widows in Israel during the time of Elijah, when there was no rain for three and a half years and a severe famine spread throughout the whole land.

dag: Barabas daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ tiŋ maa ni yino, ka daa lan nyɛ ŋun ku nir ka bɛ kpɛh o duu di zuɣu.
en: Barabbas had been thrown into prison because of a riot that had occurred in the city, and for murder.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛba yi niŋ bɛ buɣa yɛda, ka chɛ ka bɛ buɣa maa leei bɛ kuɣituurili do bɛ tooni, amaa ka bɛ ka anabi sanna, man Yawɛ ni garigi bɛn zaŋ bɛ buɣa pam kana.
en: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.

dag: Pirigim a ni mali shɛlikam ʒii buyopɔin bee bunii zuɣu, dama a ku tooi baŋ barina shɛli din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Put your investments in several places—many places even—because you never know what kind of bad luck you are going to have in this world.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Kalidianim mini Sirianim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi kana ti liri Judanim ni bɛ ku ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiding parties against Jehoiakim, sending them against Judah in order to destroy it. This was in agreement with the word that the LORD had spoken through his servants the prophets.

dag: A ni daa na bi kɔhi li la, pa nyini n-daa su li? Ka a ni kɔhi li maa, pa nyini n-na kul su di liɣiri maa? Ka bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tɛha ŋɔ tatabo kpɛh a suhu ni? Ka yɛl o, Pa ninsalinim ka a ŋma ʒiri maa, amaa Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: Before you sold the field, it belonged to you, right? And even after you sold it, you could have used the money any way you wanted. How could you even think of doing such a thing? You lied to God, not to us.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl. Kɔhat daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaata dunia yili.
en: The Kohathites: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived years.

dag: M pun yɛl o ni n ni darig o yiŋnim tibili hal ni saha din ka bahigu, tuumbiɛ shɛli yɛla o ni pun mila zuɣu, dama o bihi mɔri man Naawuni ka o bi yihi ba di ni.
en: He knew that his sons refused to respect me, and he let them get away with it, even though I said I would punish his family forever.

dag: Salima min anzinfa nɛma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu ni kɔbisinahi. Ka Shɛshibaza daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa yi Babilɔn kuli Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi tinduli n-labi kuni la.
en: In all there were , gold and silver bowls and other articles which Sheshbazzar took with him when he and the other exiles went from Babylon to Jerusalem.

dag: Dama din daa bi yɛn yuu la yi daa kana ni jilima, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ jilima gari lala.
en: If the glory that fades away was glorious, how much more glorious is the one that lasts!.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa chɛ, ka Aduna labi Musa sani Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the meeting tent once the plague stopped.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa daa garigi yɛl o, O ni ku padir biɛri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa ti padir shɛb bɛn ni zaŋ di daatam maa ti o di kpuɣibu saha.
en: They said, He will totally destroy those wicked farmers and rent the vineyard to other tenant farmers who will give him the fruit when its ready.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd pie kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: The second row was a turquoise, a sapphire, and a moonstone.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi chɛ ba bahi mɔɣu maa ni. Sagban shɛli din daa wuhiri ba sol la daa bi vuui ka chɛ ba wuntaŋ ni, ka buɣim din daa ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba soli la gba daa bi chɛ ba.
en: you, in your great mercy, didnt abandon them in the wilderness. The column of cloud continued to guide them on their journey during the day, and the column of lightning lit their path during the night.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko yɛla ka bi bɔri ni bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, amaa ka dolila tuumbiɛtali soli la, Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o suli min o suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛ tibili.
en: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.

dag: ka bipuɣins ayopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana so bihi daa ti kana ti toori kom niŋdi bɔɣili ni ni bɛ nyuhi bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri.
en: the seven daughters of Jethro, the priest of Midian, came up to water their father's sheep and goats.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. A yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Izraɛlnima; ka lan yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Yisahaku zuliya.
en: Now then hear the LORDs word. You say, Dont prophesy against Israel, and dont preach against the house of Isaac.

dag: Sa malimi shili biɛɣuni asiba n-du Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti zaŋ amaŋ ti ma zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Get ready tomorrow morning, and come up Mount Sinai to meet me there at the top.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni bɛ ku gbilisi tibili wum bee n-deei n wuhibu maa.
en: but they did not obey me. They did not pay attention to me. Your ancestors were very stubborn. I punished them, but it did not do any good. They did not listen to me.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, Labim a ba min a dɔɣiriba tiŋgban ni. N ni be a sani.
en: Then the Lord said to him, Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives. I will be with you.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka nir lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: His disciples responded, How can anyone get enough food in this wilderness to satisfy these people.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa bɔb gbaag o tizo Bɛnjamin n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam; ka Bɛnjamin gba daa zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam.
en: Joseph and Benjamin hugged each other and started crying.

dag: Dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni daa be Gɛshur Aram tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa lo alikauli yɛli, Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka n labi Jɛrusalɛm, n ni jɛm o Hiburɔn. .
en: I made that promise while I was still living in Geshur in Aram. I said, If the Lord brings me back to Jerusalem, I will serve the Lord in a special way.

dag: Amaa Yuria daa bi kul o yiŋa, ka daa yi nti dɔnila nayili samban dunol ni tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli nayili maa sani.
en: However, Uriah slept at the palace entrance with all his masters servants. He didnt go down to his own house.

dag: Ka ti ba maa daa ti lan yɛli ti, Labimiya ti da bindira biɛla ti ti na.
en: Later, our father said, Go back and buy us some more food.

dag: N yɛligu bi bemi kaman buɣim bee zali din nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli ŋmɛri wurindi kuɣa la? Man Yawɛ m-bɔhi lala maa.
en: My message is like a fire and like a hammer that breaks rocks in pieces.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi Sukɔt kpamba n-zaŋ ba pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba. O daa niŋla lala ni o wuhi Sukɔtinim maa yɛm.
en: Then he seized the citys elders, and he beat the people of Succoth with desert thorns and briars.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm ti Duuma Yisa yɛda, ka a min a yiŋnim zaa tiligi.
en: They replied, Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.

dag: N daa bi deei n karimbanim yɛtɔɣa bee n-luɣi n tiba wum n karimbanim maa wuhibu.
en: I paid no attention to my teachers.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali daa ti paai, dabisi shɛli dali naa zaligu maa ni daa yɛn tum tuma. Dindali maa ka Yɛhudianim dimnim daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni gari ba yiko ku ba. Amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa n-daa lee ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa.
en: On the th day of the twelfth month , the people were supposed to obey the kings command. This was the day the enemies of the Jews hoped to defeat them, but now things had changed. The Jews were stronger than their enemies who hated them.

dag: Ifriim zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi ni kɔbisinu. Yisifu zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba m-bala.
en: These were the family groups from the tribe of Ephraim. The total number of men was . These family groups of Manasseh and Ephraim are all the descendants of Joseph.

dag: Zaŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ yi wumpaɣibo sara maligu na, ka moliya yi ni tiri pin shɛŋa pahiri la molo, dama yinim Izraɛlnim ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: And offer a thank offering made with yeast. Tell everyone about the freewill offerings. Israel, you love to do those things. So go and do them. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Tayiɣ bi kanna ka pa ni o yɛn zumi bee n-ku bee n-saɣim bahi. Amaa man kamina ni niriba ti nya nyɛvili n-kul nya li la pam.
en: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.

dag: Bɛ ku kpalim be Yawɛ tiŋgbani maa ni. Amaa Ifriimnim ni labi Ijipti nti di bindir shɛli din bi be kasi Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The people of Israel will not remain in the Lord 's land, but will have to go back to Egypt and will have to eat forbidden food in Assyria.

dag: O lihi ti la tinzunnima. O zaŋ ti mi kɔhi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋ laɣ shɛli yo ti zuɣu maa dira.
en: Doesnt he think of us as foreigners since he sold us and has even used up the payment he received for us?.

dag: Ibizan kalinsi nyaaŋa, Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. O daa niŋ bɛ zuɣulan la yuun pia.
en: After Ibzan, Elon from Zebulun led Israel; he did so for ten years.

dag: Kaman m Ba Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni tim ma na ka m be m Ba maa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ gba ni be n zuɣu.
en: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.

dag: Yuuni kam o ma daa yi shɛrila binyɛr bila m-mali chani ti tir o saha shɛl o min o yidana daa yi ti chaŋ ni bɛ ti mali yuuniyuuni sara maa.
en: Each year his mother would make a little robe and take it to him when she accompanied her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

dag: ni Parua bia Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa be Isaka tiŋgban ni la.
en: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was governor of Issachar.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku ti a daŋa dabisili puuni, ka goli gba ku ti a dɔro yuŋ.
en: The sun cannot harm you during the day, and the moon cannot harm you at night.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba laɣiŋgunim daa laɣim yi luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Nɛtɔfa tiŋkpansi.
en: The Levite families of singers gathered from the area where they had settled around Jerusalem and from the towns around Netophah.

dag: So di yɔhim omaŋa! So yi be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yɛndana, ŋun leemi jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka o leei yɛndana.
en: Dont fool yourself. If some of you think they are worldly-wise, then they should become foolish so that they can become wise.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣ silig shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni la, ka bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo siliga maa noli.
en: Joseph bought a linen sheet, took the body down, wrapped it in the sheet, and placed it in a tomb which had been dug out of solid rock. Then he rolled a large stone across the entrance to the tomb.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Zaŋmi binchɛra maa niŋ gabisi maa min a bɔɣulɔna puuni. Ka Jɛrimia daa niŋ lala.
en: Ebed Melech, the Ethiopian, said to Jeremiah, Put these old rags and worn-out clothes under your arms. When we pull you out, these rags will pad your underarms. Then the ropes will not hurt you. So Jeremiah did as Ebed Melech said.

dag: Yi ni na mali neesim maa zuɣu, niŋmiya neesim maa yɛda, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi leei neesim maa bihi. Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa chaŋmi ti sɔɣi.
en: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light. After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka kom maa daa nyuui tiŋgban ni, ka Nuhu daa piligi binshɛli din pili ŋariŋ maa, ka lihi nya ka tiŋgbani ŋme pɔhim.
en: When Noah was years old, on the first day of the first month, the water was gone. Noah removed the covering of the boat, looked around, and saw that the ground was getting dry.

dag: Ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya paɣiba ayi ka bɛ yiɣiri kpari m polo na, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama ŋmani shinshingooro kpiŋkpama. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣ piɛɣu maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ li yiɣi chaŋ.
en: I looked up again and saw two women going out. There was a wind in their wings; their wings were like the wings of a stork. They carried the basket between the earth and the sky.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛli, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa wurimmi be zoya zuɣu kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la. Ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ka zuɣulana, chɛ ka sokam labi kul o yiŋ ni suhudoo. .
en: Micaiah answered, I can see the army of Israel scattered over the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the Lord said, These men have no leader; let them go home in peace.

dag: Bɛ na mi n-vii kpiimba biɛhigu shee dunoya ka a nya, bee a na mi n-nya zibisim titali dunoya?.
en: Have deaths gates been revealed to you; can you see the gates of deep darkness?.

dag: A ni daa nya ka kuriti mini yaɣiri gari tab shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni ti kpuɣiri tab bipuɣinsi n-lɔri ba amiliya ni di chɛ ka bɛ laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa kuriti mini yaɣiri ni ku tooi gari taba n-leei zaɣ yini shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba ku tooi leei zaɣ yini.
en: You also saw that the iron was mixed with the clay. This means that the rulers of that empire will try to unite their families by intermarriage, but they will not be able to, any more than iron can mix with clay.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni lan kpalim be alizanda ni hal ka binshɛɣukam zaa ti niŋ pali kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: He must remain in heaven until the time comes for all things to be made new, as God announced through his holy prophets of long ago.

dag: Ka yi ni su tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zalimiya nir ni yɛn kɔh o tiŋgbani ka ti lan yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛli.
en: Throughout the whole land that you possess, you must allow for the land to be bought back.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Asaaya n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: There were people from the tribe of Merari. Asaiah was their leader.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, di ni lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bimbilima din be puri ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, Stretch your arm toward the sky, so that hailstones will fall on people, animals, and crops in the land of Egypt.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka teeku kɔgbana daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: God quieted the storm to a whisper; the seas waves were hushed.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu ni saa tahibu la yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa n-su nam!.
en: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ dabindi gari chi bee kawana sara ti Yawɛ, dama di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ dabindi bee shiri nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o nuu niŋ Ibrahimma gbalipina lɔŋni, ka po pɔri zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: So the servant put his hand under his master Abrahams thigh and gave him his word about this mission.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi deei farigu yaɣi bɛ ni zali ya ni yi deemi shɛm tariga.
en: John told them, Don't make people pay more than they owe.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi zani Zakaria sani n-ʒe tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu shee nudirigu polo.
en: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar where the incense was burned.

dag: Ka Aduna ti nyɔr li zaani Alikauli Adaka la gbini Yawɛ tooni pateesa la nyaaŋa jɛmbu suɣili maa puuni zaawuni hal ni asiba sahakam. Di ni ti nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Each evening Aaron shall light them and keep them burning until morning, there in the Lord 's presence outside the curtain in front of the Covenant Box, which is in the Most Holy Place. This regulation is to be observed for all time to come.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na nti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Ka wula ka a na kul doli suhiri karimba maa.
en: While Jesus was still there speaking, some men came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. They said, Your daughter is dead. There is no need to bother the Teacher.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa nya alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum maa, ka lan wum ka bihi yɛriti saɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ka di daa ku ba suli pam.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law became angry when they saw the wonderful things he was doing and the children shouting in the Temple, Praise to David's Son.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti bɔri bɛ biɛrisuŋ bee m-bɔri bɛ tɔŋbu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi nyɛvili ni.
en: As long as you are a nation, never do anything to help these nations or to make them prosperous.

dag: Mbaye Sidɔn, a di vi, dama teeku birini yɛliya, N na ʒi n-wolisi bee n-dɔɣi. M mi na ʒi n-wumsi nachimpola bee paɣipiɛlisi.
en: City of Sidon, you are disgraced! The sea and the great ocean depths disown you and say, I never had any children. I never raised sons or daughters.

dag: Bɛ zaa kul tulimi kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu la, ka kuri bɛ nanima. Bɛ ku nanim zaa, ka bɛ so bi suhi ma ni n sɔŋ o.
en: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings have fallen; none of them call upon me.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa boli naa n-yɛl o. Ka naa daa yɛli, Di yi nyɛ o kɔŋko n-zɔrina maa dindina o ʒirila lahibali na. Ka o daa ti zo m-mirina.
en: The watchman shouted to tell King David. King David said, If the man is alone, he is bringing news. The man came closer and closer to the city.

dag: Yawɛ, Garigim ma, garigim ma din ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ baŋ ni nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri labis a sanna.
en: Please answer me, so these people will know that you are the Lord God, and that you will turn their hearts back to you.

dag: Yawɛ yoog o bidibbina ni be luɣ shɛli n-yih o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina, dama ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ mali tuma ni o tum Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The LORD has opened his arsenal and brought out his brutal weapons. The LORD God of heavenly forces has a job to do in the land of the Babylonians.

dag: Ti ni daa ti miriti Saipurus ka ti chɛ li bahi ti nuzaa polo ka chaŋ Taai din be Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa yɛn yihi nɛma ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: We came within sight of Cyprus and then sailed south of it on to the port of Tyre in Syria, where the ship was going to unload its cargo.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni zuɣu ka ti be kum barina ni asiba hal nti paai yuŋ; bɛ lihi ti mi kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave the following regulations to Moses.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ tulaale zim tuɣindi laa m-mooi buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni m-pal li, ka niŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla nukurigu pali buyi ŋ-ŋmiri li biɛlabiɛla n-zaŋ li kpe pateesa maa puuni.
en: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa tim ti gbaai Jɔn na ti kpɛhi duu, ŋun Hɛrɔd ni daa fa omaŋmaŋ tizo Filip paɣ Hɛrɔdias niŋ o paɣa la zuɣu.
en: Herod himself had ordered his soldiers to arrest John and put him in prison. Herod did this to please his wife Herodias. She had been married to Herods brother Philip, but then Herod married her.

dag: Ka yili maa ni paɣa daa zaŋ bini pa kɔbiliga maa noli n-yɛrigi chi diɛli di zuɣu, ka so daa bi baŋ ni shɛli be nimaani.
en: The man's wife took a covering, spread it over the opening of the well and scattered grain over it, so that no one would notice anything.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, Naawuni yur a pam. Yiɣisim zani n-luɣ a tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga; bɛ tim ma la a sanna. O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n yiɣisi zani ka n ni na kul sɔhira.
en: The man said to me, Daniel, you are greatly treasured. Now grasp the meaning of what Im saying to you. And stand up, because Ive been sent to you. As he said this to me, I stood up, shaking.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kul wum ni Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa kpiya maa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti deeg o puu maa su.
en: When Ahab heard that Naboth had died, he got up and went down to Naboths vineyard to take ownership of it.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba tizɔpaɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: You must not have sexual contact with your fathers sister; she is your fathers blood relative.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa niŋ binshɛŋa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, anabi Aizaia ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔz bia la daa sab li.
en: Everything else Uzziah did while he was king is in the records written by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu maa shee, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sin tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: They marched from the Reed Sea and camped in the Sin desert.

dag: Bɛ nolɔbo maa mini bɛ Naawuni suhibu nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So the church fasted and prayed. They laid their hands on Barnabas and Saul and sent them out.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee n-zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: But a few seeds did fall on good ground where the plants produced or or times as much as was scattered.

dag: Bɛ wurim n suɣili, ka chihi di mihi zaa. M bihi chaŋya ka chɛ ma; bɛ lan kani, ka so kani ŋun ni lan ti n suɣili maa yaha, ka zaŋ m pateesanim yili di ni.
en: My tent is ruined. All its ropes are broken. My children left me. They are gone. No one is left to put up my tent. No one is left to fix a shelter for me.

dag: bee n-zo nandan nambɔɣu o saria karibu ni o ni nyɛ nandan zuɣu.
en: In court, dont treat a person in a special way simply because that person is poor.

dag: N tiŋgbani yi di kuhi jɛndi ma, ka m puu ni pimpama di laɣim kum.
en: I did not use my land in a wrong way. I never caused it to suffer.

dag: Kaman karakɔhi ni kul daari yiɣiri gindi shɛm bee sakpaleensi ni yiɣiri shɛm, lala ka noli yɛlibu din bi simdi gba bi chani shɛli.
en: Like a darting sparrow, like a flying swallow, so an undeserved curse never arrives.

dag: A ŋmanila kom din bi do baalim, a mi ku gari sokam, dama a daa zaŋ a ba paɣ dɔni o bindoo zuɣu n-ta li daɣiri. A daa dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: You are like a raging flood, But you will not be the most important, For you slept with my concubine And dishonored your father's bed.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buta yaha, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma? Ka Pita suhu saɣim o ni bɔh o m-pahi buta ni o yur o maa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, N Duuma, a mi binshɛɣukam zaa; a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: He asked a third time, Simon son of John, do you love me? Peter was sad that Jesus asked him a third time, Do you love me? He replied, Lord, you know everything; you know I love you. Jesus said to him, Feed my sheep.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Kiriatijiarim maa yuui pam. Di daa niŋ la yuun pisi nimaani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa kul ye Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: and it stayed there for years. During this time everyone in Israel was very sad and begged the Lord for help.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ ni ni o chaŋ, ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa balim o ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ.
en: When Jesus was getting into the boat, the man begged to go with him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba bɛn daa ye buri Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia sani.
en: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests to the prophet Isaiah, Amozs son. They were all wearing mourning clothes.

dag: Binshɛɣukam ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla n dini, bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi yi bidib shɛb zaa mini yi niɣi ni yi piɛri ni tuui dɔɣi naɣila shɛb ni piɛla shɛb zaa nyɛla n dini.
en: Every first offspring is mine. That includes all your male livestock, the oldest offspring of cows and sheep.

dag: Hal yi ya ŋɔ taŋkpa shɛli din puɣ ti naba ŋɔ, ti ni pihi li bahi yi zuɣu, amaa lee baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam miri ya.
en: Even the dirt from your town that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you. But remember that Gods kingdom is coming soon.
