dag: ka hal teeku kɔgbana yi vuri ka ŋmuɣinda, ka hal di vubu maa yi chɛ ka zoya sɔhira, ti ku zɔri dabiɛm.
en: even if the seas roar and rage, and the hills are shaken by the violence.

dag: Dɛdannima, ŋmaligimiya guui, sɔɣimiya; dama n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu niŋ Iso zuliya saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili.
en: You people living in Dedan, run away and hide, because I will punish Esau for the bad things he did.

dag: Hal n ni kul wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni la zaa yoli, bɛ ni be katinsi maa ha ka teeri n yɛla. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni tiligi, ka ni ti laɣim tab labina.
en: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daa ka taɣinamsi, di daa kul bela vau, ka zibisim limsi bɔɣ zilinli, ka Naawuni shia daa be kom zuɣusaa ginda.
en: The earth was barren, with no form of life; it was under a roaring ocean covered with darkness. But the Spirit of God was moving over the water.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti yi mɔɣu ni na zaawuni, ka Liya yi nti tuh o soli yɛl o, N yɛn kpɛla a sanna zuŋɔ, dama n zaŋla m bia ŋmaankpihiga yo a zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu min o daa dɔni dindali maa yuŋ.
en: When Jacob came back from the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, You must sleep with me because Ive paid for you with my sons erotic herbs. So he slept with her that night.

dag: Nimaani ka sapashini maa daa nya Alikizandria ŋariŋ din chani Itali, ka o daa zaŋ ti kpɛhi di ni.
en: There the army officer found a ship from the city of Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he put us on it.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi kpe ŋɔ mini ninsalinim ni biŋkɔbiri ni puri ni tihi ni tiŋgbani atam zuɣu. N suhuyiɣisili maa ni bemi kaman buɣim la, ka so ku tooi kpihi li.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: I will show my anger against this place. I will punish people and animals. I will punish the trees in the field and the crops that grow in the ground. My anger will be like a hot fire—no one will be able to stop it.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka ʒiɛnya dɛde yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Benya kaman dɔbba! Maliya yaa!.
en: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa nya malaika so ka o be alizanda sunsuuni yiɣiri ginda, ka mali lahibal suŋ din ka bahigu ni o yɛli niriba balibu kam mini dɔɣim kam ni zuliya balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima bɛn be dunia ni.
en: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilahi ni dabidɔbba ni paɣiba ti Ibrahimma, ka zaŋ o paɣ Zara gba labisi ti o.
en: Then Abimelech gave Sarah back to Abraham, and at the same time he gave him sheep, cattle, and slaves.

dag: Ka Sɛt daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Ɛnɔsh. Di saha maa ka ninsalinim daa piligi jɛmdi Yawɛ.
en: Seth also fathered a son and named him Enosh. At that time, people began to worship in the LORDs name.

dag: Ka a ŋariŋduhiriba kuhigu vuri daa chɛ ka teeku duli sɔhigi.
en: You send your merchants to faraway places. Those places will shake with fear when they hear your pilots cry!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fabili fabila ŋɔ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: David sang a sad song about Saul and his son Jonathan.

dag: Ŋmaligim n suhu niŋ a zaligunim dolibu ni, ka chɛ azichi yoya bɔbu.
en: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.

dag: Di simdi ni a nya tibidarigibo a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli mini din chihiri shɛl la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You must suffer for the obscene, disgusting things you have done. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi, ka ŋunkam ti tum tuma dindali, bɛn kum o.
en: Do your work for six days, but the seventh day should be holy to you, a Sabbath of complete rest for the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath will be put to death.

dag: dama o daa na bela o yab Ibrahimma niŋgbuŋ ni, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣ o saha shɛli Mɛlikizɛdɛk ni daa tuhi ti yab Ibrahimma sol la.
en: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ lahibali ni daa ti nti to Hazɔr Naa Jabin saha shɛli, ka o daa tim ti yɛli Madɔn Naa Jɔbab mini Shimrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: When the news of Israel's victories reached King Jabin of Hazor, he sent word to King Jobab of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph.

dag: Leeban ni daa nya nintua la mini bansi la, ka wum o tizɔpaɣa Ribɛka ni yɛli ni doo maa yɛl o shɛm zuɣu, ka o daa guui chaŋ doo maa sani nti nya ka o ʒiɛla laakumnim maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.
en: Laban had seen the nose ring and the bracelets on his sister's arms and had heard her say what the man had told her. He went to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashɛranima.
en: The Israelites sinned against the Lord by forgetting him and worshiping idols of Baal and Astarte.

dag: Abiata ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana saha shɛl la ka ŋun Naa Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li nti ti bɛn daa be o sani la.
en: so he went into the house of God and ate the bread offered to God. This happened when Abiathar was the High Priest. According to our Law only the priests may eat this bread—but David ate it and even gave it to his men.

dag: n ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka paɣisar so yi ti kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom, ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, niŋm a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ti ma ka n nyu.
en: I will stand by this well and wait for a young woman to come to get water. Then I will say, Please give me water from your jar to drink.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je wuntizɔriba ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: Evil will kill the wicked; those who hate the righteous will be punished.

dag: Jɛshua min o bidibisi ni o dɔɣiriba ni Kadimiɛl min o bidibisi ni Binnui mini Hɔdavia nti pahi Hɛnadad bidibisi ni Lɛvinim mini bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa laɣim su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tumtumdiba fukumsi.
en: The Levite Jeshua and his sons and relatives, and Kadmiel and his sons joined together in taking charge of the rebuilding of the Temple.

dag: N di kul gbilisirila tibili, amaa yɛlimaŋli, yi ni so bi wuhi ni Ayuba mali taali bee n-garig o yɛtɔɣa maa shɛli.
en: I listened carefully to what you said. Not one of you proved Job wrong. Not one of you answered his arguments.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbini la kpɛhi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali pateesa la tooni.
en: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi niŋ yomyom m-ba buŋa, ka o paɣisara anu bɛn daa be o sani n-tumd o tuma pah o zuɣu ka bɛ doli Dauda tuumba maa chaŋ, ka o ti leei Dauda paɣa.
en: Then Abigail got up quickly and rode on her donkey, with five of her young women going with her. She followed Davids messengers and became his wife.

dag: Ka o daa sabi yɛtɔɣ yinsi shɛŋa o ni daa tuui sab la pa kuɣ parilana maa zuɣu. Yɛtɔɣa maa n-nyɛ fukumsi zalikpana pia shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛli ya buɣim sunsuuni yi laɣiŋgu dal la, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ li ti ma.
en: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila wɔhu chɛmi; ka piɛgul yɛtɔɣ ŋaha mi ŋmani kuriti kpa shɛŋa bɛ ni kpahi ka di kpaŋ zani.
en: The sayings of the wise are like the sharp sticks that shepherds use to guide sheep, and collected proverbs are as lasting as firmly driven nails. They have been given by God, the one Shepherd of us all.

dag: Paɣ ŋɔ niŋ ma o kpiɔŋ tariga, dama o zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma n-gula n sɔɣibu.
en: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body ahead of time for burial.

dag: N ni ti wurim yi fɔntinsi din be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka daai yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa luhi.
en: I will destroy the cities in your land and tear down all your defenses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi ba lala hal ti yaɣi Bɛtavɛn. Ka Yawɛ daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi dindali maa.
en: fighting all the way beyond Bethaven. The Lord saved Israel that day.

dag: Hal o yi tum a taali siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin dahin yini ka ŋmaligi deeg o galimi siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin maa zaa, di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ m-paŋ o.
en: Even if one of them mistreats you seven times in one day and says, I am sorry, you should still forgive that person.

dag: ka filim ya, ka yi di vi din ka naabu, ka ku tam di yɛla.
en: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa tahirila alibarika na, ka yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa kaman di ni daa niŋ shɛm yi sani dahin shɛli yi ni daa tuui wum Naawuni daanfaani yɛla ka baŋ ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli la.
en: which has come to you. This message has been bearing fruit and growing among you since the day you heard and truly understood Gods grace, in the same way that it is bearing fruit and growing in the whole world.

dag: Yawɛ bela n sani ni o sɔŋ ma. N ni di nasara bɛn je ma sani.
en: The LORD is for me—as my helper. I look in victory on those who hate me.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni! Ami!.
en: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.

dag: Dinzuɣu chira awɛi ni biɛɣ pisi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So after nine months and twenty days they returned to Jerusalem, having traveled through the whole country.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ suhuri ni ye Shia Kasi pina bɔbu zuɣu shɛm, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye din ni kpaŋsi cheechi ni niriba gba zuɣu lala.
en: Since you are eager to have the gifts of the Spirit, you must try above everything else to make greater use of those which help to build up the church.

dag: O chɛ ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm ma, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛri n ninni.
en: He makes me a popular proverb; Im like spit in peoples faces.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi dol li n-tum di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: We know that the Law is good if it is used as it should be used.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n-daa darigi di tibili, ka di gbuɣi di niriba maa bahi maa.
en: They made the land filthy. Now the land is sick of those things, and it will vomit out the people who live there.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ŋɔ daa jɛmdi la Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛ buɣa; ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ yaansi na kul niŋdimi kaman bɛ yaannim maa ni daa niŋdi shɛm maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So those people worshiped the Lord , but they also worshiped their idols; and to this day their descendants continue to do the same.

dag: Dama kaman niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini ka mali yaɣ bɔbili, ka di yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa nyɛ niŋgbun yin la, lala mi n-nyɛ Masia gba.
en: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.

dag: Yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni daa ti bɔri alibarika o ba san la, o daa bi tooi nya li, dama o daa bi nya soli din ni doli taɣi o ni daa tum shɛm la hal o ni daa kul bo li ni nintam la zaa yoli.
en: You know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected because he couldnt find a way to change his heart and life, though he looked for it with tears.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha a ni gbib bidibiga a nuu ni. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Aai. Wɛi, n dana, a nyɛla Naawuni nira, di yɔhim man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ.
en: Elisha said, About this time next spring, you will be holding your own baby boy in your arms. The woman said, No, sir! Man of God, dont lie to me.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N tum alahichi; dama m birigi Yawɛ zaligu, ka lan zaɣis a noli. N daa zɔrila niriba maa dabiɛm ka saɣi bɛ noli.
en: Yes, I have sinned, Saul replied. I disobeyed the Lord 's command and your instructions. I was afraid of my men and did what they wanted.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Ti tɔŋya; ti nyɛla azichilaannima ka bi lan bɔri shɛli. Amaa ka bi mi ni yi nyɛla nandahimanim mini nambɔ niriba ni faranima ni zoomba ni bɛn chani bɛ zaɣim.
en: You say you are rich. You think you have become wealthy and dont need anything. But you dont know that you are really miserable, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Shɛm ni; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: Give praise to the Lord , the God of Shem! Canaan will be the slave of Shem.

dag: N suhir a, fam ma m biɛli Iso nuu ni bahi. N zɔr o, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti kana ti ku m mini m bihi ni bɛ manim ŋɔ zaa.
en: Please rescue me from my brother. I am afraid he will come and attack not only me, but my wives and children as well.

dag: Yinim danyuriba, yiɣisimiya kum; yinim wain nyuriba zaa, kummiya wain nyaɣisili la zuɣu, dama yi noli ŋmaala di nyubu maa.
en: Drunks, wake up and cry! All of you who drink wine, cry because your sweet wine is finished. You will not taste it again.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnima m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Give the Israelites the following laws:.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ŋubirila binkpima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka kuri niriba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa?.
en: So say to them, The LORD God proclaims: You eat with the blood, you lift your eyes to the idols, and you shed blood. Should you inherit the land?.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o yuli; malimiya soli ti ŋuna ŋun be sagbana ni n-chani maa. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ, maliya suhupiɛlli o sani!.
en: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord , and we celebrate as we worship you.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: Gods grace be with you all.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni. Ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li.
en: A very bad wind came up on the lake. The waves were coming over the sides and into the boat, and it was almost full of water.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni nyu a biɛli pipi shɛli din yɛlima ka zilim la ni binnyurigu. Bɛ ni ti la a, ka mal a ansarisi, dama di puuni bini galisiya pam.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: You will drink your sisters cup of poison. It is a tall, wide cup of poison. It holds much poison. People will laugh at you and make fun of you.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim ni niriba zaa daa wum Jɛrimia ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni maa.
en: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said.

dag: Naa Asa daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinahi ni yini ka faai siɣ o yaannim sani.
en: In the forty-first year of his rule, Asa lay down with his ancestors.

dag: Amaa tinim ni lo kpara gari Izraɛlnim tooni chaŋ ti nya ʒiishee ti ba, ka ti bihi be bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zuɣu la ni.
en: Then our children can be safe from the other people who live in this land. But we will gladly come and help the other Israelites. We will bring them to their land.

dag: Ka yi ni diri biŋkɔb so kam yi kpi, ŋunkam shihi zaɣ kpiŋ maa ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.

dag: Dama ti bi mali baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zaa, ti mi bi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zaa;.
en: For our gifts of knowledge and of inspired messages are only partial;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali bindirigu mini situra, ti n-chɛ ka ti nini tiɣ li.
en: So, if we have food and clothes, we will be satisfied with that.

dag: Ninsal nini ni ni tooi nya Masia so la nyɛla Naawuni so ninsal nini ni ku tooi nya ŋɔ ŋmahinli, ka lan nyɛ Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun gari binnamda zaa.
en: No one can see God, but the Son is exactly like God. He rules over everything that has been made.

dag: ka din pahi pinaayopɔin gbaai Hɛzir, ka din pahi pisaayika gbaai Hapizɛz.
en: The seventeenth was Hezirs group. The eighteenth was Happizzezs group.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ku vuui, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ku kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.

dag: O tahiri teeku zuɣu, ka di kom nyuura. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka mɔɣa kom nyuura; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl tihi vari suura, ka Lɛbanɔn tipuma suura.
en: He can blast the sea and make it dry up; he can dry up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither; the bud of Lebanon withers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Absalom ti bahi bɔɣ zilinli ni mɔɣu maa ni, ka kahi kuɣa na ti pa o zuɣu, ka di du pam. Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa yinoyino daa zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: They took Absalom's body, threw it into a deep pit in the forest, and covered it with a huge pile of stones. All the Israelites fled to their own hometowns.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ ni: Jɛhɔhanan mini Hanania ni Zabai ni Atilai.
en: Of the family of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

dag: To, Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni be vinvama ni la zuɣu, biɛɣuni, sa ŋmaligimiya kpe mɔɣu n-doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: The Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valley. So tomorrow you must leave this place. Go back to the desert on the road to the Red Sea.

dag: Ti ni daa nya filiŋ la o daa bi tam ti yɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He did not forget us when we were defeated; his love is eternal;.

dag: Di saha ka yi dol o na ka o ti ʒini n nam ʒiishee, dama ŋuna ka m pii ni o zani n zaani n-di nam su Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: You will follow him. He will enter and sit on my throne, and so he will succeed me as king. I have appointed him to become ruler over Israel and Judah.

dag: Waazuyihira maa boya ni o nya yɛtɔɣa din tuhi, ka o ni sab yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa.
en: The Philosopher tried to find comforting words, but the words he wrote were honest.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N tin ya nyina din viɛla, ka chɛ ka kum lu yi tiŋ kam ni, di zaa yoli ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I, the Lord , took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.

dag: di yi pa lala, so yi wum li, o ni dih a vi, ka a yu saɣiŋgu ku mali tariga.
en: Otherwise everyone will learn that you can't keep a secret, and you will never live down the shame.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn mali yɛm ŋɔ, wummiya: Din kariya ka Naawuni tum tuumbiɛri! Din kariya ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa tum taali!.
en: Listen to me, you men who understand! Will Almighty God do what is wrong?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zani Gibia kaman bɛ ni daa pun niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Then for the third straight day they marched against the army of Benjamin and placed their soldiers in battle position facing Gibeah, as they had done before.

dag: din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi yi ni gbib bɛmaŋa, ka doli ma ni ʒiɛyimtali ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shia zaa, a kul ku kɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒiini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: You and your descendants must always faithfully obey the Lord . If you do, he will keep the solemn promise he made to me that someone from our family will always be king of Israel.

dag: Benya kaman biliɛri la din ni chɛ ka yi suhuri kul ye Naawuni yɛligu din ŋmani bihim alal la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi zooi nya tiliginsim.
en: Instead, like a newborn baby, desire the pure milk of the word. Nourished by it, you will grow into salvation.

dag: Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba; amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana yi baŋ o, dama yi pun nya o.
en: Now that you have known me, he said to them, you will know my Father also, and from now on you do know him and you have seen him.

dag: Ka tuumbaŋdiba bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee maa daa ti yi bɛ tuma shee na.
en: Finally, all the skilled workers left the work they were doing on the holy place, and they went to speak to Moses. They said.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim naa ka o dol a zaligu kariti saria, ka zaŋ a wuntia ti naa bia.
en: Teach the king to judge with your righteousness, O God; share with him your own justice.

dag: Zaŋmiya bidib tuuli kam ti ma. Bɛ ni kul tuui dɔɣi binshɛɣukam ka o nyɛ zaɣ lɔɣu, ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu Izraɛlnim sunsuuni nyɛla n dini.
en: Dedicate all the first-born males to me, for every first-born male Israelite and every first-born male animal belongs to me.

dag: Amaa di ni shɛba ni ti gali, bɛ ni ti yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ka bɛ ka n sanna, ka a yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu maa polo.
en: If some survive and save their children, look at them when they come to you. See how evil they are, and be convinced that the punishment I am bringing on Jerusalem is justified;.

dag: ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro na ti tam di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: and placed on it the bread offered to the Lord , just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin biɛɣu maa bahi.
en: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked him, Why couldn't we drive the demon out.

dag: M mabia, a yurilim maa zuɣu chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli mini suhukpaŋsibo, dama Yisa nyaandoliba nyari suhukpaŋsibo a sani.
en: I have great joy and encouragement because of your love, since the hearts of Gods people are refreshed by your actions, my brother.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua mini Binnui ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛrɛbia ni Juda ni Matania ŋun min o tab daa su wumpaɣibo yila yilibu fukumsi la.
en: The Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who was in charge of the thanksgiving songs along with his associates.

dag: Dama yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya kɔŋko, laara bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Pa lala ka farigudeeriba gba niŋda?.
en: If you love only those who love you, what reward do you have? Dont even the tax collectors do the same?.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa gariti kpahirila bɛ nuhi niŋd a. Bɛ maan a la ansarisi, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd a, nyin Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga. Tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni tin viɛlli zaa, ka nyɛ dunia zaa suhupiɛlli shee la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Those who pass by on the road clap their hands and laugh at you. They make fun of Jerusalem, shaking their heads at the sight of her. They ask, Is this the city that people called The Most Beautiful City and The Joy of all the Earth.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li; ka daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa ni di naa ni di fɔndi ni niriba zaa. Bɛ daa bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino gba kpalim. Bɛ ni daa niŋ Ɛgilɔnnim shɛm la, lala ka bɛ daa saɣim Hiburɔn, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be di ni.
en: They captured the town and the nearby villages, then killed everyone, including the king. They destroyed Hebron in the same way they had destroyed Eglon.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti zaŋ n niriba maa chaŋ n ni daa wuh a luɣ shɛli maa. Nyama, m malaika ni be a tooni. Amaa bɛ tibidarigibo biɛɣu yi ti neei, n ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: So now, go down and lead the people where I tell you to go. My angel will go before you and lead you. When the time comes to punish those who sinned, they will be punished.

dag: Bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ ma nahimbu, ka chɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yi ni mali dariti tɔhiri ma ŋɔ?.
en: How long will you hurt me and crush me with your words?.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul yɛri lala maa, ka sagbani dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam bɛ ni kpe sagbani maa ni maa zuɣu.
en: While Peter was saying these things, a cloud came all around them. Peter, John, and James were afraid when the cloud covered them.

dag: Amaa o min o kpambaliba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa bi wum Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia zaŋ yɛli ba maa.
en: But neither Zedekiah nor his officials nor the people obeyed the message which the Lord had given me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi yi n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti mal li ka di be kasi, ka zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini bulaa maa ʒim shɛli n-niŋ binyila din be sara maligu bimbini la ni ti gili.
en: Aaron will then go to the altar that is before the LORD and make reconciliation for it: He will take some of the bulls blood and some of the goats blood and put it on each of the altars horns.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi niŋ kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ o yiŋnim kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti be nimaani yuma ayopɔin.
en: The woman did exactly what Elisha had said and went to live in Philistine territory. She and her family lived there seven years.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni ti zaŋ ba zali luɣ shɛli din sarigiri shee n-chɛ ka bɛ sarigi lu m-bahi yoli.
en: You will definitely put them on a slippery path; you will make them fall into ruin!.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal n ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya la, di daa pala ŋun tum taali la zuɣu bee o ni daa tum so taali la zuɣu, amaa di daa nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka yi baɣa ni be ti ni shɛm la yi palo Naawuni sani.
en: The main reason I wrote that letter was not because of the one who did the wrong or the one who was hurt. I wrote so that you would realize, before God, how very much you care for us.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa boli Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Sokam bom biŋkɔb bila kaman o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm nti kɔrigi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: Then Moses called together all of Israels elders and said to them, Go pick out one of the flock for your families, and slaughter the Passover lamb.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, niŋmi alibarika niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuliya ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ kul be a sani sahakam. Dama nyini Yawɛ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ binshɛli ni, alibarika maa kul ni kpalim be di ni sahakam.
en: You have been kind enough to bless my family. You were kind enough to promise that my family will serve you forever. Lord , you yourself blessed my family, so my family really will be blessed forever.

dag: yin ti zaŋmiya bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba zaa ti Yawɛ. Yi biŋkɔbiri ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣilɔ shɛb zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: From then on, you must give him every first-born son from your families and every first-born male from your animals, because these belong to him.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Shallum ba.
en: Ahitub of Zadok, Zadok of Shallum.

dag: Ŋunkam doli zaligu, zaɣ biɛɣu ku paag o, ka yɛndana mi o ni yɛn niŋ lala saha shɛli.
en: As long as you obey his commands, you are safe, and a wise person knows how and when to do it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa na ti ti Musa, ka daa lan zaŋ suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;.

dag: Ti mi yi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, niriba ni lab ti kuɣa, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But if we say, Its of human origin, all the people will stone us to death because they are convinced that John was a prophet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Ijipti na. O daa nyɛla sana m-be nimaani luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Ham la.
en: Thats how Israel came to Egypt, how Jacob became an immigrant in the land of Ham.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛliya ni ti ni ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi bɛnkam zaa je ti gba nuu ni.
en: He has brought salvation from our enemies and from the power of all those who hate us.

dag: o daa yɛlimi, O nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yɛli ni o paɣa m-bala. O daa tɛhimi ni o yi yɛl lala, di pa shɛli ka nimaani nim maa ti ku o Ribɛka zuɣu, dama o daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: His wife Rebekah was very beautiful. The men of that place asked Isaac about Rebekah. He said, She is my sister. He was afraid to tell them Rebekah was his wife. He was afraid the men would kill him so that they could have her.

dag: A daanzinfa saɣimya, ka kom gari a wain ni.
en: Jerusalem, you were once like silver, but now you are worthless; you were like good wine, but now you are only water.

dag: Pool ni daa paana ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana la zani gil o m-mali yɛl biɛ shɛŋa pam bɛmaŋmaŋ ni ku tooi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli fiɣisir o.
en: Paul came into the room, and the Jews who had come from Jerusalem stood around him. They made many serious charges against him, but they could not prove anything.

dag: Samuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Joɛl ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Abija ŋun daa pa o zuɣu.
en: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.

dag: N ni fa a ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi, ka tilig a ninvuɣ galima gbaabu ni.
en: I will rescue you from the power of wicked and violent people. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n daa sabi gbaŋ la tin ya ni m buɣisi ya nya yi deeri noli binshɛɣukam ni.
en: I wrote you that letter because I wanted to find out how well you had stood the test and whether you are always ready to obey my instructions.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpuɣ a nuu zuɣusaa, amaa bɛ bi nya li. Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ a ni yur a niriba shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi. Zaŋm a ni yɛn zaŋ buɣim shɛli wɔb a dimnim la wɔb ba.
en: LORD, your hand is lifted up, but they dont see. Let them see and shrink back because of your zeal for your people; your burning anger that consumes your enemies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi gbani n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, man ŋun nyɛ yi dabipaɣ ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun ni paɣi n dan tumtumdiba naba.
en: Abigail bowed down to the ground and said, I am his servant, ready to wash the feet of his servants.

dag: ka daa gari n salalaantab tooni Yɛhudianim adiini soli dolibu ni; ka di nyɛla n suhu ni daa kul ye n yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I was becoming a leader in the Jewish religion. I did better than most other Jews my own age. I tried harder than anyone else to follow the traditions we got from our ancestors.

dag: Amaa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛb bahi ni bɛ maani wain tihi, ka kɔra.
en: But Nebuzaradan left some of the poorest people behind in the land. He left them to work in the vineyards and the fields.

dag: ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti leei yi Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and who is bringing you out of the land of Egypt to be your God; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani gindi tiŋkpansi n-yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋdi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: The apostles left and went from village to village, telling the good news and healing people everywhere.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi nyuri bara yi suhuri ni yi yab ni nyɛ Ibrahimma la zuɣu; dama n yɛri ya mi ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi zaŋ kuɣa ŋɔ nam ninsalinima, ka bɛ leei Ibrahimma zuliya.
en: And dont even think about saying to yourselves, Abraham is our father. I tell you that God is able to raise up Abrahams children from these stones.

dag: Ʒiŋmabo nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa bɛn ʒe yim nyɛla o suhu ni piɛli shɛb zuɣu.
en: The LORD detests false lips; he favors those who do what is true.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya; dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia. Saha maa paaya! Miriya ka yi ti doli ba!.
en: Jesus said, Watch out that you arent deceived. Many will come in my name, saying, Im the one! and Its time! Dont follow them.

dag: Ka tihi puu maa lana daa yɛli, Ka wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N ni timla mmaŋmaŋ biyurigu ŋɔ; di pa shɛli bɛ ni ti ti ŋun jilima.
en: The owner then said to himself, What am I going to do? I know what. I'll send my son, the one I love so much. They will surely respect him.

dag: Obadia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ daa tim o tumo zuliya shɛb sani, ka ti wum o yɛligu maa. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Malimiya shili ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnima.
en: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: I, the Lord , have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa, zomiya Yawɛ! Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, lumiy o sizuura!.
en: Everyone on earth should fear and respect the Lord . All the people in the world should fear him.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛli Izraɛl naa, Daŋ bɔhi Yawɛ m-baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: But, Jehoshaphat said to Israels king, first lets see what the LORD has to say.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti leei bukpahinima. Di ti bɔnya bɛ shee din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ya daɣiri ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not resort to dead spirits or inquire of spirits of divination—you will be made unclean by them; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋdimi ni di chɛ ka tiŋgbani tiɣi kom, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ dabari ka ka buchi, ni di chɛ ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni.
en: Who waters the dry and thirsty land, so that grass springs up?.

dag: Amaa ka o daa nya bɛ nandahima maa, ka wum bɛ fabila.
en: But God saw their distress when he heard their loud cries.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei salima binshɛŋa sapashin kpamba mini sapashin bihi shɛb bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga sani maa tibisim daa miri kilɔgiram kɔbisiyi.
en: The gold that the commanders and captains gave to the Lord weighed about pounds.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam! Dama nandahima pam ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka Naawuni suhu ti yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: How terrible it will be at that time for women who are pregnant or for women who are nursing their children. There will be great agony on the earth and angry judgment on this people.

dag: O yi bi niŋ bini ata ŋɔ ti o, dindina paɣ maa ŋun yim chaŋ yoli, ka di yo shɛli.
en: The man must do these three things for her. If he does not, the woman is made free, and it will cost her nothing. She owes no money to the man.

dag: Bɛ daa kul mɛri bɛ ni jɛmdi Baal luɣ shɛŋa n-zaŋdi bɛ bihi nyɔri buɣim maani maligu tiri Baal, ka di pa n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋdi shɛm, ka di tɛha mi na ʒi n-kpe n suhu ni.
en: and they have built altars for Baal in order to burn their children in the fire as sacrifices. I never commanded them to do this; it never even entered my mind.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu ka lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti guhi pɔi nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana nti siɣis o na bee o ku kana.
en: One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa nya pakoli maa ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu ka o yɛl o, Di kuhira.
en: When he saw her, the Lord had compassion for her and said, Dont cry.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa ʒi gbaridɔɣirili na nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duno shɛli din yuli daa booni Duno Viɛlli la shee. Bɛ daa yi pun ʒir o la lala na nti sɔŋdi nimaani sahakam ka o maani bɛn kpɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bara.
en: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.

dag: Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ni ti bɔ Izraɛlnim taali kɔŋ, ka Judanim daalahichi ti kpihim. Dama n ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ n ni tiligi shɛb la taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When that time comes, no sin will be found in Israel and no wickedness in Judah, because I will forgive those people whose lives I have spared. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Nahash ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim naa la daa kpi, ka o bia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Some time later, the Ammonite King Nahash died, and his son succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka so yi wuhiri wuhibu shɛli din be di ko, ka bi saɣi deei ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛligu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli la mini wuhibu shɛli din mini din luri Naawuni sizuura taɣili tab la.
en: If anyone teaches anything different and doesnt agree with sound teaching about our Lord Jesus Christ and teaching that is consistent with godliness.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɔhi Sool zuɣu, ka zaŋ Dauda so o ni daa di shɛhira suŋ la leei bɛ naa. Naawuni daa yɛliya, N nya Jɛsi bia Dauda ka o nyɛla n nin ni tiɣ so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ni tum n yubu zaa.
en: After removing him, God made David their king. This is what God said about him: I have found that David son of Jesse is the kind of man I like, a man who will do all I want him to do.

dag: Di saha Ijiptinim daa sɔɣirila bɛ bikpamba shɛb zaa Yawɛ ni daa ku la. Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ buɣa gba.
en: The Egyptians were burying all the people the Lord killed. They were burying all their firstborn sons. The Lord had shown his judgment against the gods of Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti tim ba niriba ayiyi; ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: Then he called together his twelve apostles and sent them out two by two with power over evil spirits.

dag: Ashaara doli alahichinima, amaa tɔŋbu n-nyɛ wuntizɔriba laara.
en: Trouble pursues sinners, but good things reward the righteous.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛli Musa, Mani n-nyɛ Mani. Ka lan yɛli yaha, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Mani n-tim ma yi sanna. .
en: God said, I am who I am. You must tell them: The one who is called I AM has sent me to you.

dag: Ka Shɛm mini Jafɛt daa kpuɣi kparibu m-pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu n-tirisi bɛ nyaaŋa kpe nti zaŋ li pa bɛ ba zuɣu, ka bi nya bɛ ba zaɣim.
en: Then Shem and Japheth took a robe and held it behind them on their shoulders. They walked backward into the tent and covered their father, keeping their faces turned away so as not to see him naked.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ʒiɛmdila bɛn nya yɛl biɛri, amaa ka di lee mali shili gu bɛn naba bi ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Those who have no troubles make fun of those who do. They hit a man when he is down.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti wumya ni Izraɛl nanim nyɛla nambɔzɔriba, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ buri so, ka zaŋ gabisi n-kaŋka n-vili ti zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl Naa maa sani, di pa shɛli ka o tilig a nyɛvili.
en: Ben-hadads officers said to him, Listen, we have heard that the kings of Israel are merciful kings. Allow us to put mourning clothes on our bodies and cords around our heads. We will then go to Israels king. Perhaps he will let you live.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɛri ŋma n-saɣim a jɛmbu duu maa ni da shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi la.
en: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.

dag: N yuya ni Naawuni noli di ma ka m mini Masia woligi tab gba mmaŋmaŋ zuliya bɛn nyɛ m mabihi la zuɣu.
en: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.

dag: N zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuma zaa yɛla, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuun kara yɛla.
en: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa lan yɛli Izraɛl naa maa, Daŋ bɔhi baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm pɔi.
en: But first let's ask the Lord what to do.

dag: Ka salo pam daa doli Yisa nyaaŋa, ka paɣ shɛb daa be bɛ ni n-kuhiri ka fabind o zuɣu.
en: A large crowd followed Jesus. Some of the women were sad and crying. They felt sorry for him.

dag: Ibram ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun pia nyaaŋa, ka Ibram paɣ Zarai daa zaŋ o dabili Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti bipuɣiŋga la n-ti o yidana Ibram ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: After Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, Abrams wife Sarai took her Egyptian servant Hagar and gave her to her husband Abram as his wife.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku ba hal ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi guui. Dauda daa kula Siria chɛchɛbumbariba kɔbisiyopɔin, ka ku wɔribariba mi tuhi pihinahi, ka daa ti Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ kamɔna kpɛm maa daŋa, ka o kpi nimaani.
en: and the Israelites drove the Syrian army back. David and his men killed seven hundred Syrian chariot drivers and forty thousand cavalry, and they wounded Shobach, the enemy commander, who died on the battlefield.

dag: Chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiba kpiri, ka chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nina lihi nya, ka zaŋ bɛ tiba wum, ka zaŋ bɛ suhuri baŋ shɛli gbinni, ka ŋmaligina nya tibbu.
en: Make the minds of this people dull. Make their ears deaf and their eyes blind, so they cant see with their eyes or hear with their ears, or understand with their minds, and turn, and be healed.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni Judanim ni ti tiligi, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mi ti be ni alaafee. Ka bɛ ni ti yɛn booni li yu shɛli n-nyɛ: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia.
en: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, The Lord Gives Justice.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa na kul kpalim bela teeku maa sunsuuni, ka Yisa kɔŋko mi kpalim be duli.
en: Evening came and the boat was in the middle of the lake, but he was alone on the land.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ ma, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni yu binshɛŋa ka Yawɛ je li maa bahi bee n-chɛ Ijiptinim buɣa la jɛmbu. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi ni n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But they rebelled against me and refused to listen to me. No one cast off their disgusting things or abandoned their Egyptian idols. So I declared that I would pour out my wrath on them and satisfy my anger against them in the land of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Gɛrasa tiŋkpannim zaa daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbahi ba pam. Ka o daa lan kpe ŋariŋ ni lab o nyaaŋa.
en: Then all the people from that territory asked Jesus to go away, because they were terribly afraid. So Jesus got into the boat and left.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyini ŋun yuri nyaɣisim pam ni nyini ŋun tɛhi ni shɛli ku niŋ a la, wumma! A tɛhiya ni a galisimi m-be kaman Naawuni la, ka so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A bi tɛhi ni a ni leei pakoli bee n-kɔŋ bihi.
en: So listen to this, luxuriant one who sits secure, who says in her heart, Im utterly unique; Ill never sit as a widow; Ill never know childlessness.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyam bɛ ni kpɛhi ti dabiɛm shɛm. Chɛ ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ na kul tɔɣisim a yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: And now, Lord, listen to what they are saying. They are trying to make us afraid. We are your servants. Help us to say what you want us to say without fear.

dag: Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the Lord God All-Powerful told the prophet Haggai.

dag: Miri ka a bo a piriba bee a mapira, dama nir yi niŋ lala o dɔɣira ka o bo maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili.
en: If a man has intercourse with his aunt, both of them must suffer the consequences for incest.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti karim Naawuni zaligu min anabinim sabbu naai ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulaannim daa tim so ni o cham ti yɛli Pool min o nyaaŋa maa, Ti mabihi, yi yi mali yɛligu din ni kpaŋsi niriba ŋɔ suhuri, yin yɛlimiya li.
en: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders invited them, Brothers, if one of you has a sermon for the people, please speak.

dag: Ka bɛ gbaag o zilima yɛlibu yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ o nyaandola, amaa tinim nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: The leaders insulted the man and said, You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba na ti ʒili, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ku lan tooi yihi ba n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa ni yaha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will plant them upon their land, and they will never again be plucked up out of the land that I have given them, says the LORD your God.

dag: Miriya ka yi kpuɣi dimbɔŋɔ gbibi! Miriya ka yi di dimbɔŋɔ! Miriya ka yi shihi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Don't handle this, Don't taste that, Don't touch the other?.

dag: O daa tum tuun kara Juda fɔntinsi ni. O daa zaŋ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ti ʒili Jɛrusalɛm.
en: where supplies were stored in huge amounts. In Jerusalem he stationed outstanding officers.

dag: Di ŋubiya bɛ nimdi, yi mi di shihiya bɛ zaɣ kpima. Bɛ nyɛla daɣiri bina yi sani.
en: Dont eat the meat from these animals. Dont even touch their dead bodies! They are unclean for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di di simdi ka bɛna m-be kpe n-zan a tooni wuhi bɛ ni nya ka n taali nyɛ shɛli.
en: Some Jews from Asia were there at that time, and if they have anything to say against me, they should be here now.

dag: Naa ni daa yi niŋdi shɛm nyɛla o bɔhi baŋdiba baŋ zaligu mini kaya ni nyɛ shɛm, dinzuɣu ka o daa tim ti bol o saawaranim bɛn ni tooi baŋ bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm na.
en: Now, when a need arose, the king would often talk with certain very smart people about the best way to handle it. They were people who knew both the kingdoms written laws and what judges had decided about cases in the past.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Bɔhimi nya ŋun bia bala.
en: Then go and find out, Saul ordered.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari bihikpam, amaa ka lee lo tɔbu o suhu ni; o yɛtɔɣa bali gari kpam, amaa ka ŋmari kaman sudirili la.
en: His words about peace are as smooth as butter, but he has only war on his mind. His words are as slick as oil, but they cut like a knife.

dag: A paɣiba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a nayili bihi bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni wumd a yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Your wives and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.

dag: Ka o daa shiri fa ba bahi m-mali ba ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa, ka wuhiri shihira Ijipti tiŋ puuni mini Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni ni mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi.
en: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for years.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee kpalim dɔɣibu maa ni. O ni daa ti yɛn bahi saha shɛli ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Bɛnɔni, amaa ka o ba mi daa bol o yuli Bɛnjamin.
en: But she was dying, and as she breathed her last, she named her son Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ŋmanila azichi wain ti shɛli din wali wala. Bɛ zuliya ni kul galisiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul mɛri maligu bimbina pahira. Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ dariza ni kul pahiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul pahiri bɛ ni jɛmdi binwɔɣil shɛŋa la gba dariza.
en: The people of Israel were like a grapevine that was full of grapes. The more prosperous they were, the more altars they built. The more productive their land was, the more beautiful they made the sacred stone pillars they worship.

dag: Ka bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka baŋ di gbinni, ka di ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: But what about the seed that fell on the good ground? That is like the people who hear the teaching and understand it. They grow and produce a good crop, sometimes times more, sometimes times more, and sometimes times more.

dag: Nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din mali yaa! Amaa ka bɔzuɣu ka yi galindi ma?.
en: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa ti yɛli Yisifu, N zahimla zahindi ka bi nya so ŋun ni wuhi ma di gbinni; ka n wum ka bɛ yɛli ma ni bɛ yi yɛl a zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm, a ni tooi wuhi di gbinni.
en: The king said to him, I had a dream, yet no one can explain what it means. I am told that you can interpret dreams.

dag: N daa pun mi a mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam a a ma puli ni. N daa pun piig a mi zali pɔi ka bɛ ti naanyi dɔɣ a; ka n zaŋ a leei zuliya kam anabi.
en: Before I created you in the womb I knew you; before you were born I set you apart; I made you a prophet to the nations.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli ba, Bomiya la palli n-niŋ yalim niŋ di ni ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa bo li na ti ti o.
en: He said, Bring me a new bowl, and put some salt in it. They did so.

dag: Ka wula ka man Dauda ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lee lan yɛn yɛli yaha zaŋ chaŋ a ni tibigi ma shɛm ŋɔ polo? A mi a dabili.
en: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa po pɔri n-lo Yawɛ alikauli yɛli, A yi ni zaŋ Ammɔnnim maa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: Jephthah made a promise to the Lord . He said, If you will let me defeat the Ammonites.

dag: Naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb kɔŋko n-ni nya li, ka n ni ti zaŋ o napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ti o min o bihi, o ni ʒe Yawɛ yim ni o suhu zaa zuɣu.
en: Only Caleb son of Jephunneh will see that land. I will give Caleb the land he walked on, and I will give that land to his descendants, because he did all that I, the Lord , commanded.

dag: Yi yi di be n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, n gba naan tooi yɛli kaman yi ni yɛri shɛm ŋɔ. N naan tooi yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa pam, ka vili n zuɣu niŋ ya.
en: In your situation I could speak like you; I could put words together to oppose you, shake my head over you.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Yiya mɛbu saha na bi miri. Tiŋ ŋɔ nyɛla duɣu, ka ti mi nyɛ nimdi.
en: These men say, We will be building our houses again very soon. We are as safe in this city as meat in a pot.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti ŋubi biŋkpam bee binʒim yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: This rule will continue forever through all your generations. Wherever you live, you must never eat fat or blood.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O tin ya suhudoo luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la niŋ n nuu ni, ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leei ŋun Yawɛ min o niriba ni su shɛli.
en: David said to these leaders, The Lord your God is with you. He has given you a time of peace. He helped me defeat the people living around us. The Lord and his people are now in control of this land.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa Arinɔn zaŋ ti paai Jabok n-lan zaŋ hal ni Ammɔnnim tintariga, dama Ammɔnnim daa gula bɛ tintariga viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: But the Israelites killed many of the enemy in battle and occupied their land from the Arnon River north to the Jabbok, that is, to the Ammonites, because the Ammonite border was strongly defended.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nti yɛn nyɛ o suhu ni yuri shɛli. O ti ku kari nimmira saria bee n-kari, Bɛ yɛliya, saria.
en: He will find joy in obeying the Lord . This king will not judge people by the way things look. He will not judge by listening to rumors.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania, Hanania, wumma, pa Yawɛ n-tim a na ka a ti chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ ʒiri yɛda maa.
en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, Listen, Hananiah! The Lord did not send you. But you have made the people of Judah trust in lies.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia yɛligu ba jila yi suhuri ni pam. Wuhimiya taba ka kpammiya tab jaande yɛm zaa puuni, ka zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila n-yiini paɣiri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: The word of Christ must live in you richly. Teach and warn each other with all wisdom by singing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing to God with gratitude in your hearts.

dag: Naawuni zom ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n ni wuhi so shɛli ŋɔ min o niriba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima alali la zaa nambɔɣu, ka ti ba suhudoo!.
en: Peace and mercy to those who follow this rule—to all Gods people.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: The Philistines arrived at Rephaim Valley and occupied it.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi niriba maa sani n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni ti gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei bɛ sani.
en: Moses and Aaron went away from the assembly to the entrance of the meeting tent and they fell on their faces. Then the LORDs glory appeared to them.

dag: A ni tooi yɛli saŋmarisi bɛ ni yɛn yina saha shɛli? Bee a ni tooi wuhi saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Baa min o bihi la soli?.
en: Can you guide the stars at their proper times, lead the Bear with her cubs?.

dag: Niriba kul pɔrila pɔri, ka ŋmari ʒiri, ka kuri niriba, ka zura, ka niŋdi zina. Bɛ baɣa lan ka shɛlikam ni, kubu n-naɣ kul beni.
en: They are always cursing, lying, killing, stealing, and committing adultery. They murder one person after another.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti nya Yisa duli din maa polo bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ saha ka a ka kpe na.
en: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, Rabbi, when did you get here.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa yɛl o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi, M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa man maan yɛn pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa nɔnsi ka man yɛn zaŋ fiɛb ya.
en: and instead followed the young peoples advice. He said, My father made your workload heavy, but Ill make it even heavier! My father disciplined you with whips, but Ill do it with scorpions.

dag: Di jiɣindiya yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di zuɣu;.
en: So don't be all upset, always concerned about what you will eat and drink.

dag: Ba maa yur o Bia maa, ka wuhir o omaŋmaŋ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka ni lan wuh o tuun kara gari dimbɔŋɔnima din ni chɛ ka di niŋ ya alahiziba.
en: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi gari tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba. Ka bɛ daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi paɣ maa.
en: This perfume could have been sold for almost a years pay and the money given to the poor. And they scolded her.

dag: Machɛlizuɣiri kul zuɣirimi ni nimmoo, amaa ka buɣim bi diri yihiri daɣiri; bɛ daɣiri ni yibu maa kul nyɛla yoli, dama bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa bi yi bɛ ni.
en: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Alizanda nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka dunia ŋɔ nyɛ n naba zaashee. Ka yili bɔ ka yi yɛn me n-ti ma? Ka bee luɣ dini n-lee yɛn nyɛ n vuhibu shee?.
en: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?.

dag: Ka o dii ŋmaligi zo n-lab Naa maa sani ti yɛl o, M bɔri ni a zaŋla Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu niŋ pɔŋ ni ti ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: So right then the girl went back in to the king. She said to him, Please give me the head of John the Baptizer. Bring it to me now on a plate.

dag: Naftali zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jaziil daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jaziilnima; ka Guni daŋ niriba nyɛ Guninima;.
en: The tribe of Naphtali: the clans of Jahzeel, Guni.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya. O ku tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni.
en: He warns you not to let Hezekiah deceive you. Hezekiah can't save you.

dag: N dimnim mini bɛn nahindi ma galisiya pam, amaa m bi chɛ a zaligunim dolibu.
en: My oppressors and enemies are many, but I havent turned away from your laws.

dag: Man Daniɛl ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa, n daa kul bɔri ni m baŋ di gbinni. N nini nyabu yim ka n daa nya ka so ʒe n tooni ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ninsal kɔtomsi la.
en: I was trying to understand what the vision meant, when suddenly someone was standing in front of me.

dag: A daa lo a suhu ni ni a ni du zuɣusaa ha n-chaŋ ti yaɣi Naawuni saŋmarisi zuɣu n-zaŋ a nam kuɣ zali nimaani. A daa tɛhiya ni a ni chaŋ ti ʒini laɣiŋgu zoli din du pam ka be nuzaa polo la zuɣu.
en: You always told yourself, I will go to the skies above. I will put my throne above Gods stars. I will sit on Zaphon, the holy mountain where the gods meet.

dag: N ku chɛn ya, n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm saha shɛli yi ni tum din chihiri shɛli maa ni na be yi kɔbili ni maa. Di saha yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun darigiri niriba tibili.
en: I wont shed a tear or show any pity when I turn your ways against you, and your detestable practices stay with you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am the one who strikes you!.

dag: Dahin shɛli tinzunnim ni daa kana ti ʒi bɛ daazichi chaŋ la, dindali maa yi daa kaɣimi ʒe kpaŋa. Saamba maa ni daa kpe bɛ dunɔdaya ni nti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn piri Jɛrusalɛm nɛma shɛm la, yi gba daa bemi kaman bɛ ni daa be shɛm.
en: You joined the enemies of Israel. Strangers carried Israels treasures away. Foreigners entered Israels city gate. They threw lots to decide what part of Jerusalem they would get. And you were right there with them, waiting to get your share.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ ania di suɣilo hal ti shiri nya alikauli maa palibu.
en: Abraham was patient, and so he received what God had promised.

dag: Amaa nyin wuhimila din mini wuhibu maŋli taɣili tab la.
en: You, however, must tell everyone how to live in a way that agrees with the true teaching.

dag: Amaa nir yi lihi Naawuni zaligu din be tibi ka nyɛ din tiri daadamnim yolisim la ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka kul dol li dɛde ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni ŋun wumdi li mi kɔŋko, o ni nya alibarika Naawuni sani o ni tumdi shɛm maa puuni.
en: But if you look closely into the perfect law that sets people free, and keep on paying attention to it and do not simply listen and then forget it, but put it into practice—you will be blessed by God in what you do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma, hal ka tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma ti yaɣi.
en: There are those— how arrogant are their eyes; how their eyebrows are raised!.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ wumpaɣibo mali sara ti ma la ti ma la jilima, ka bɛnkam mi doli soli din tuhi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya tiliginsim man Naawuni sani.
en: Whoever gives a thank offering shows me honor. And whoever decides to live right will see my power to save.

dag: O labisi n yaa ti ma. O wuhi ma soya din tuhi o yuli zuɣu.
en: he keeps me alive. He guides me in proper paths for the sake of his good name.

dag: amaa ŋunkam zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣisi dilana m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: But those who reject me publicly, I will reject before my Father in heaven.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa be dunia ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti kpuɣi binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili bin la zuɣusaa zoya zuɣu, yin lihimiya! Bɛ yi ti piɛb kikaa, yin gbilisimiya tibili wum.
en: All you who inhabit the world, who live on earth, when a signal is raised on the mountains, you will see! When the trumpet blasts, you will hear!.

dag: A nyɛla puu ni kɔbil nini mini nyɛvili kom kɔbiliga ni kulibɔna kom din zɔri yiri Lɛbanɔn na.
en: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon.

dag: Yisa daa ti zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo doli fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba chana.
en: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he taught the people in the towns and villages.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi tuumbiɛri galisiya, ka yi daalahichi gba galisi pam. Yi nahindi wuntizɔriba, ka diri birapu, ka kariti tarimba bahira.
en: I am the Lord , and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.

dag: Dama bɛ kumdila pampam duri Luhit zoli, ka wum biɛrim mini nandahima kuhigu Hɔrɔnaim zolɔŋni.
en: Hear the sound of their sobs along the road up to Luhith, the cries of distress on the way down to Horonaim.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ piɛbil so ŋun ka galimi bee liɣisibu la ʒim din mali shaara la ka o daa zaŋ pa talima tiligi ya.
en: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.

dag: Ibram daa lan yɛli, Nyama, a ni bi ti ma bia maa zuɣu, bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so n yiŋ puuni la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: You have given me no children, and one of my slaves will inherit my property.

dag: Dindali maa yi ti paai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni tiligi ba kaman piɛgul ni tiligir o piɛri barina ni shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti nyɛlisiri bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni kaman nam zuɣupiligu ni waya la.
en: At that time the Lord their God will save his people like a shepherd saves his sheep. They will be very precious to him. They will be like sparkling jewels in his land.

dag: M bi galim ya yi sara maligu mini yi ni kul mali biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-zaŋdi ba nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la zuɣu.
en: I do not reprimand you because of your sacrifices and the burnt offerings you always bring me.

dag: Zɛdɛkia ni daa di Juda nam, di piligu ni yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anahi gol so ŋun pahir anu puuni ka Azur ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn nir la bia anabi Hanania daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maligumaaniba mini niriba zaa sani yɛli.
en: That same year, early in the rule of Judahs King Zedekiah, in the fifth month of his fourth year, the prophet Hananiah, Azzurs son from Gibeon, spoke to me in the LORDs temple before the priests and all the people.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashe kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha ka Asa daa leei Juda naa.
en: During Jeroboams th year as king over Israel, Asa became king of Judah.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa pun yɛli Ɛsta shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi saɣi wuh o ni nyɛ zuliya shɛli bee o niriba ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: Esther hadnt told anyone her race and family background because Mordecai had ordered her not to.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan ŋɔ di ma shɛhira ni n yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi sani pala Iin mini Aai yɛla.
en: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been Yes and never No.

dag: ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni booni kasia la kilɔgiram ayɔbu, ka yi ti zaŋ luɣ kasi shee sania la zahim di zaa. Ka a bo olivi kpam lita anahi pahi di zuɣu.
en: and pounds of cassia . Add one gallon of olive oil.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi bindir shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ.
en: The priest will then completely burn all of this on the altar as food—as a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Bɛ ni mali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu soli ti wuntizɔriba, ka ŋunkam zaa be tibi o suhu ni ni dol li.
en: No, but justice will once again meet up with righteousness, and all whose heart is right will follow after.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi kom maa ni na maa ka ti Duuma Shia Kasi daa kpuɣi Filip chaŋ, ka namɔɣili maa bi lan nya o, ka mi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away. The official did not see him again, but continued on his way, full of joy.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri alizanda nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus went everywhere in the country of Galilee. He taught in the synagogues and told the Good News about Gods kingdom. And he healed all the peoples diseases and sicknesses.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam zaa jɛmdi li ni di vi. Daadamnim bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba m-me wuna bee n-kpe li zali. Chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣimna nti yiɣisi zani. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ba ka bɛ zaa di vi.
en: All its worshippers will be ashamed, and its artisans, who are only human. They will all gather and stand, tremble and be ashamed together.

dag: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levis sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla bɛn baɣa ka niriba ni ka lan nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka n timd a bɛ sani ni a ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I am sending you to speak to them, but they are very stubborn. They are very hardheaded, but you must speak to them. You must say, This is what the Lord GOD says.

dag: O daa tɔɣis o nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o nam din du n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn maa nama.
en: Evil Merodach spoke kindly to Jehoiachin. He gave Jehoiachin a place of honor higher than the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

dag: Di kari mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ saria, dama so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ka taali a sani.
en: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lan lih o, ka yum maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: If the priest sees that the rash has spread over the skin, the priest will declare the person unclean; it is a case of skin disease.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri teeku duli, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: Then Jesus made the followers get into the boat. He told them to go to the other side of the lake. He said he would come later. He stayed there to tell everyone they could go home.

dag: Bɛ niŋdi yomyom chani ni bɛ ti ku niriba.
en: They are always ready to kill someone.

dag: Ka yi sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni duɣi bindir shɛli tahilaa puuni, di simdi ka di nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka kpam be di ni.
en: If your offering is grain prepared in a pan, it must be made of choice flour with oil.

dag: O daa kul muɣisirila sokam. Wɔɣira mini tarimba ni bundaannim mini faranim ni bilichinnim mini daba ni o dalim ba bɛ nudiriti ni bee bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: It forces everyone—the small and great, the rich and poor, the free and slaves—to have a mark put on their right hand or on their forehead.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri di yɛla chani maa ka Yisa chirigi ba sol ni, ka bɛ min o doli chana;.
en: While they were discussing these things, Jesus himself arrived and joined them on their journey.

dag: ka yɛli, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan naa ti kani man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ sanna? Ka Dauda yɛl o, N yɛn dala a kabɔɣili ŋɔ m-me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, ka di chɛ ka o vuug alɔbo ŋɔ ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: and asked, Your Majesty, why are you here? David answered, To buy your threshing place and build an altar for the Lord , in order to stop the epidemic.

dag: N daa lola n nina alikauli ni n ku lihi paɣisarili.
en: Ive made a covenant with my eyes; how could I look at a virgin?.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia ka nyɛ Kabiziil nir la gba daa nyɛla suhukpeendan ŋun tum tuun kara. Ŋuna n-daa ku Mɔabnim wɔɣiri kɔba ayi, ka daa ti lan siɣi bɔɣili ni ti ku gbuɣinli paɣili ni daa kpe dahin shɛl la.
en: Jehoiadas son Benaiah was a hero from Kabzeel who performed great deeds. He killed the two sons of Ariel from Moab. He once went down into a pit and killed a lion on a snowy day.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali, dama n zani m ba Dauda zaani n-di nam ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: Now, the Lord has done what he said he would do. I am the new king in my fathers place. David was my father. Now I am Israels king. That is what the Lord promised, and I have built the Temple for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni paag a, ka a bi mi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Bahiyoli ni paag a yim libig a, ka a ʒi di yɛla.
en: Now evil will come against you, something you wont anticipate. A curse will fall upon you, something you wont be able to dispel. Destruction will come upon you suddenly, something you wont foresee.

dag: Bɛ nina ku nya kulibɔna, kulibɔn shɛŋa din zɔri shiri mini bihim.
en: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.

dag: Ka niriba pam tah o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: Many scolded him, telling him to be quiet, but he shouted even louder, Son of David, show me mercy.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ malimiya tɔroko palli, ka bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣira, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ʒi n-zaŋ dapuhi ga shɛba nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, amaa ka taɣiya bɛ bihi kuli yiŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: So prepare a new wagon and two cows that have never been yoked; hitch them to the wagon and drive their calves back to the barn.

dag: amaa naɣ zalimiyala yi daazichi alizanda ni; nimaani ka di bi zahinda, ka lɛla ku saɣim li, ka tayiɣisi mi ku kab kpe n-zu li.
en: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu ni wuhiri shɛm m-bala.
en: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, Ka chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ shɛb kpalim pah a zuɣu. Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, lala bi kpa, n kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka a suhu m-maai ni mani.
en: So Esau said, Then I will leave some of my men to help you. But Jacob said, That is very kind of you, but there is no need to do that.

dag: ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmani maa ʒim shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ʒi shɛli din kpalim yi m-bahi sara maligu bimbini maa gbini, di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: The priest will sprinkle the blood from the sin offering on the side of the altar. Then he will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

dag: Di zɔntua daa kpala dundɔntitali polo. Ka bɛ daa ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣili kam. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini.
en: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piripiri dunɔgulibo tuma maa Kɔra daŋ niriba mini Mɛrari daŋ niriba maa sunsuuni shɛm m-bala.
en: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari.

dag: Di saha ka Hagai ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ tumo maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu n-yɛli niriba maa. Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni be yi sani.
en: Then Haggai gave the Lord 's message to the people: I will be with you—that is my promise.

dag: Di saha ka buɣili Zius ŋun duu daa be tiŋ maa tooni la tindana daa bo naɣilahi mini vari n-ka tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni na ni o mini niriba maa ti kɔrigi mali ba.
en: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.

dag: Dama m ba daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima n-tuhi fan ya Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: Remember that my father fought for you. He risked his life to save you from the Midianites.

dag: Chi ni ti pali kaburi bɔɣa ni; ka wain mini kpam ti pali di tɔɣibu bɔɣa ni hal ti puuri bahira.
en: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli. Famiya bɛ ni ŋari ninvuɣ so n fa o ŋun nahind o maa nuu ni bahi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ gala bee kpeengarigu niŋ sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli bee n-ku ŋun ka taali kpe ŋɔ.
en: The LORD proclaims: Do what is just and right; rescue the oppressed from the power of the oppressor. Dont exploit or mistreat the refugee, the orphan, and the widow. Dont spill the blood of the innocent in this place.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ suma n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali nyɛ bɛn ni ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Those who have integrity will dwell in the land; the innocent will remain in it.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ, dama kpe pala vuhim shee, daɣ shɛli din tahiri saɣiŋgu na ni tahi saɣiŋgu shɛli din bie na zuɣu.
en: Rise up and go! This cant be the resting place; because of its uncleanness, it destroys and the destruction is horrific.

dag: ka lihi di goma, ka kpahindi di birininima din ni chɛ ka yi ti tooi yɛli ʒiɛmani din payana niriba:.
en: Examine its defenses closely; tour its fortifications so that you may tell future generations.

dag: Ka n ni ti zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim labisi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti lab me tin shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la m-be di ni. Bɛ ni ti ko tiwala puri ka nyu di wala kom. Bɛ ni ti ko tihi puri ka di di wala.
en: I will improve the circumstances of my people Israel; they will rebuild the ruined cities and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; and they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi bɔri ni a niŋ shɛlikam dɛde, nyin cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba n-zali buni alizanda ni, di nyaaŋa ka kana ti doli ma.
en: Jesus answered, If you want to be perfect, then go and sell all that you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and follow me.

dag: Nir yi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o yiŋa, di ŋmanila noombila n-kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o tiɛɣu.
en: A man away from home is like a bird away from its nest.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ, dama kpe pala vuhim shee, daɣ shɛli din tahiri saɣiŋgu na ni tahi saɣiŋgu shɛli din bie na zuɣu.
en: Get up and go; there is no safety here any more. Your sins have doomed this place to destruction.

dag: Zaŋmiya nim viɛla zaa niŋ di ni, dina n-nyɛ: gbalipuɣa mini gaba, ka zaŋya boligo kɔba gba niŋ di ni.
en: Add meat to it, every good piece. With shoulder and thigh, the meatiest bones, fill it up.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: Israel, listen! Our God is the LORD! Only the LORD!.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi do n-gbihira? Yiɣisimiya yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: He said to them, Why are you asleep? Wake up and pray that you won't be tested.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm kawana pali bɛ kpalansi ka labisi bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi maa ni, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindirigu ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala ti ba.
en: Joseph gave orders to fill his brothers' packs with grain, to put each man's money back in his sack, and to give them food for the trip. This was done.

dag: Mɛshɛk mini Tubal beni, ka di tɔbbihi gbala yɛrigi di ni zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn bi guni. Takɔbi ka bɛ zaŋ ku ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Meshech, Tubal, and all their armies are there. Their graves are around it. All those foreigners were killed in battle. When they were alive, they made people afraid.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma. Bɛ daa tuui lu ka kɔŋ ŋun ni sɔŋ ba.
en: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim polo, Naawuni buɣisiri ba mi ni o wuhi ni ninsalinim ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri.
en: I also thought, Where human beings are concerned, God tests them to show them that they are but animals.

dag: N ni labi laŋ piri ba saha shɛli bɛ ni chani maa. N ni siɣisi ba tiŋ na kaman noombihi la. N ni fiɛb ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: But I will spread out a net and catch them like birds as they go by. I will punish them for the evil they have done.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋariti taba, amaa zomiya yi Naawuni, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must not cheat each other. You must honor your God. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni kariti ninvuɣ biɛri saria shɛm m-pal a kɔbili ni, ka saria karibu mini yɛlimaŋli gbaag a.
en: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla ka o lan tim tuun shɛba, ka bɛ gba ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Ka Sool daa lan tim tuun shɛb yaha m-pahi buta, ka bɛ gba daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Saul heard about this, so he sent other messengers, but they also began prophesying. So Saul sent messengers a third time, and they also began prophesying.

dag: Ka nyini Izraɛl na biɛɣu ŋun dabisa pali ŋɔ, a tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha paaya.
en: And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Din yiri ninsal suhu ni na, dina n-tar o daɣiri.
en: And he went on to say, It is what comes out of you that makes you unclean.

dag: Miriya ka yi muɣisi sana, dama yi mi sana suhu ni be shɛm, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dont oppress an immigrant. You know what its like to be an immigrant, because you were immigrants in the land of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o bidibbina maa ti o bia maa ka yɛl o, Zaŋmi li kuli yiŋa.
en: Jonathan gave his bow and arrows to the boy and told him to go back to town.

dag: Ka n ti ba suhuyini, ka zaŋ shi palli kpɛhi bɛ ni. Ka n ti yihi suhu shɛli din be kaman kuɣili ŋɔ bɛ ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Pa doo ŋɔ ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi. Barabas ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi! Barabas daa nyɛla ŋmɛnditoli.
en: They shouted, Not this man! Give us Barabbas.

dag: O darigi n tibili siɣimsiɣim bushɛm dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa labina nti nya o mini paɣ maa ni diri alizama maa ka di gari ba pam, amaa bɛ ni so daa bi bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra? Bɛ mi daa bi bɔhi Yisa, Bɔzuɣu ka a mini paɣ maa diri alizama.
en: At that moment Jesus' disciples returned, and they were greatly surprised to find him talking with a woman. But none of them said to her, What do you want? or asked him, Why are you talking with her.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Naawuni ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la?.
en: As for the resurrection of the dead, havent you read what God told you.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ ka o zaŋ su niriba; o tiri ba bindirigu pam.
en: This is how he feeds the people and provides an abundance of food.

dag: O kpani maa daa ŋmanila kpalu dapua, ka o kpani maa zuɣu tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayopɔin. Ka ŋun ʒir o nyɔtaɣirigu be o tooni.
en: and his spear was so big that the iron spearhead alone weighed about seven kilograms. A soldier always walked in front of Goliath to carry his shield.

dag: Dama n ʒi naŋgban malisim niŋbu, di yi nyɛ lala ŋun nam ma ŋɔ ŋun chɛ ka m bahi pumpɔŋɔ.
en: for I dont know flattery; otherwise my maker would quickly whisk me away.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Midian tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Labimi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku a maa zaa kpiya.
en: The LORD said to Moses in Midian, Go back to Egypt because everyone there who wanted to kill you has died.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti ni baai du n-chaŋ bɛ sani ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi ba.
en: All right then, Jonathan said. Well go over to the men and show ourselves.

dag: N Duuma, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ ka n lee lan guhira? Kulla a sani ka m mali tahima.
en: What, then, can I hope for, Lord? I put my hope in you.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Keep yourselves holy, because I am the Lord your God.

dag: Gbibi n nyɛvili, dama n zaŋla mmaŋ zaa ti a; tiligim a dabili ŋun niŋ a naani ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: I am your follower, so please protect me. I am your servant, and you are my God. I trust in you, so save me.

dag: Bɛ gbibila tɔbiri mini kpana; bɛ nyɛla putɔɣunima, ka bi zɔri nambɔɣu. Bɛ chandi vuri ŋmanila teeku vuri. Bɛ barila yuri, ka lo kpara kaman tɔbutuhira n-chani tɔbu tuhibu n-kanna ni bɛ ti liri nyini Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga.
en: They have taken up their bows and swords; they are cruel and merciless. They sound like the roaring sea, as they ride their horses. They are ready for battle against Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan kɔri binyɛra mali alizinnim bɛn ŋmani buhi la, bɛ ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋa shɛb sani la. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn nyɛla zaligu bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.

dag: Yɛlimiya ti din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ka di chɛ ka ti baŋ ni yi shiri nyɛla wuna. Niŋmiya zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe ti ka ti tarigi.
en: What signs did you give in the past to prove that you really are gods? Do something! Do anything, good or bad, so that we can see that you are alive. Then we might fear and respect you.

dag: N ni darigi Bɛl din be Babilɔn ŋɔ tibili, ka chɛ ka o gbuɣ o ni daa vali binshɛŋa la bahi. Zuliya kam ku lan jɛm o. Babilɔn goma luya.
en: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble.

dag: Kaman nira ni so jinjɛŋŋmaa ka di tab o niŋgbuŋ shɛm la, lala ka n daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini Judanim tabi ma din ni chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n yuli du, ka n nya paɣibu mini jilima, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
