en: Just as a linen undergarment clings to the body, so I created the people of Israel and Judah to cling to me, declares the LORD, to be my people for my honor, praise, and grandeur. But they wouldnt obey.

dag: n-zaŋ ti tahi kpe na nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: He brought us to this place and gave us this land—a land full of milk and honey.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa garigi yɛli Iso, M pun zaŋ o leeg a dana, ka zaŋ o mabihi zaa leeg o daba; ka zaŋ kawana mini wain ti o. M bia, ka bɔ ka n ni tooi lan niŋ ti a mi.
en: Isaac answered, I have already made him master over you, and I have made all his relatives his slaves. I have given him grain and wine. Now there is nothing that I can do for you, son.

dag: O kul gbibila bɛ kɔba zaa, ka di zaɣ yini gba ku kabigi.
en: He protects all their bones; not even one will be broken.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti kul kpalimmi be alahichi tumbu ni ka di chɛ ka Naawuni daalibarika zooi?.
en: What shall we say, then? Should we continue to live in sin so that God's grace will increase?.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yi ku nya pɔhim bee saa, amaa kom ni tɛli baa ŋɔ ni ka yi mini yi niɣi ni yi biŋkɔbiri nyu. .
en: This is what the LORD says: You wont see any wind or rain, but that valley will be full of water. Then youll be able to drink—you, your cattle, and your animals.

dag: Bɛ ku lan jɛm buɣa, bɛ mi ku lan tum tuun galima n-saɣim bɛmaŋa bee n-kpe bɛ biriginsim ni. N ni tiligi ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ni, ka yihi ba daɣiri ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Bɛ na mi n-vii kpiimba biɛhigu shee dunoya ka a nya, bee a na mi n-nya zibisim titali dunoya?.
en: Has anyone ever shown you the gates that guard the dark world of the dead?.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnima bɛ mabihi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yɛli, Daŋ yini niriba ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Israelites had a change of heart concerning their relatives the Benjaminites. They said, Today one tribe has been cut off from Israel.

dag: Shɛli kani din ni lan ti ma suhupiɛlli gari n yi ti wum ni m bihi doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: I have no greater joy than this: to hear that my children are living according to the truth.

dag: Amɔs daa yɛliya, Bɛ wum Yawɛ damli Ziɔn zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli tahigu yi Jɛrusalɛm na. Biŋkɔbiri mɔŋubira kuuya, ka Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu kuui.
en: Amos said, The Lord will shout like a lion in Zion. His loud voice will roar from Jerusalem. The green pastures of the shepherds will turn brown and die. Even Mount Carmel will become dry.

dag: Naawuni ni nam binshɛɣukam nyɛla din viɛla, ka di bi simdi ni ti siŋ li, tinim dee yi di li ni Naawuni paɣibu.
en: Everything that God has created is good; nothing is to be rejected, but everything is to be received with a prayer of thanks.

dag: N yɛm maa yɛn yila katiŋ na, ka di wuhi ni ŋun nam ma nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: I will draw from my broad knowledge, attribute justice to my maker.

dag: Chɛ ka zaligu litaafi ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa kul be a nol ni sahakam, kul bɔhimmi li wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ din ni chɛ ka a tooi doli din sab di ni maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka di chɛ ka a tɔŋ a sol ni, ka lan chɛ ka a di nasara viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Always remember what is written in that book of law. Speak about that book and study it day and night. Then you can be sure to obey what is written there. If you do this, you will be wise and successful in everything you do.

dag: O mi ku kabigi gbiŋgban dalim bee n-kpihim firila mia buɣim hal nti tahi yɛlimaŋli nasara dibu na.
en: He will not break off even a bent stem of grass. He will not put out even the weakest flame. He will not give up until he has made justice victorious.

dag: Ka zaŋ di shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka booi kpam maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa mini di zuɣu lahi ni di kɔniŋdi bini ni di naba zaashee zuɣu m-mali di zaa kasi.
en: He took some of the oil and sprinkled it seven times on the altar and its equipment and on the basin and its base, in order to dedicate them to the Lord .

dag: Dama ti daa wum yi ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm la yɛla;.
en: We thank him because we have heard about the faith you have in Christ Jesus and the love you have for all of Gods people.

dag: Amaa hal yi ni sari li ka di daari pum dindali, ka neeri biɛɣu zoori la zaa yoli, di ku wali ka yi pɔhi li; di kul yɛn tin ya la nandahima ni biɛrim.
en: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony.

dag: Yi mi Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli nti yɛli Izraɛlnim la yɛla; bɛ daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu wuhi ni suhudoo yirila Yisa Masia sanna. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Duuma.
en: You know the message he sent to the people of Israel, proclaiming the Good News of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya Saimɔn min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: As Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were fishermen and were casting their nets into the lake.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam. O paɣibu yɛla kul ni be n nol ni sahakam.
en: I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will always be in my mouth.

dag: ka o yɛl o mabihi maa, Bɛ zaŋla n liɣiri labisi niŋ ma, dina m-be n kpalaŋ ni ŋɔ. Ka bɛ suhuri daa fuŋ di zuɣu, ka bɛ ni sɔhiri ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka tuun bɔ ka Naawuni lee tum ti ŋɔ.
en: My money has been returned to me, he called to his brothers. Here it is in my sack! Their hearts sank, and in fear they asked one another, What has God done to us.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yir o nyɛvoya ni na, ka buɣimniɛm din diri binyɛra yir o nol ni na; ka sala buɣimniɛm yir o sanna.
en: Smoke came from his nose. Burning flames came from his mouth. Red-hot coals fell from him.

dag: O yi nyaŋ ma ku ma, dindina ti ni leei yi daba, amaa ka m mi yi nyaŋ o ku o, yi gba ni leei ti daba tumdi ti tuma.
en: If that man kills me, he wins and we Philistines will become your slaves. But if I kill your man, then I win, and you will become our slaves. You will have to serve us.

dag: O ka ba bee ma bee zuliya; o ka piligu, o mi ka bahigu, amaa o ŋmanila Naawuni Bia, ka kul nyɛ maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: He is without father or mother or any family. He has no beginning or end of life, but hes like Gods Son and remains a priest for all time.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, n niriba maa pirigili n-daa tumdi mɛbu maa tuma, ka pirigili mi ye gbaɣinɔnima ka gbib kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni tɔbiri. Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul ʒe Judanim zaa bɛn mɛri gooni maa nyaaŋa.
en: From then on half of my men worked and half stood guard, wearing coats of armor and armed with spears, shields, and bows. And our leaders gave their full support to the people.

dag: ka daa ti yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti lab Judia.
en: he said to his disciples, Lets return to Judea again.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima mali ni bɛ jɛmdi li la bahi nantarisi mini zɔna dindali maa.
en: On that day, people will toss to the rodents and to the bats their idols of silver and idols of gold, which they made for themselves to worship.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ daa na bi kpɛhi Jɔn duu.
en: John hadnt yet been thrown into prison.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi dimnim maani ya ansarisi yɛra, To, pumpɔŋɔ zo kura la leela ti dini.
en: The LORD God proclaims: The enemy mocked you and said, The ancient heights belong to us.

dag: nti kul be Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: They stayed at the Temple all the time, praising God.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sɔdom naa mini Gomɔra naa ni Adima naa ni Zɛbɔiim naa ni Bɛla naa bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Zɔa la daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ Siddim vinvamli ni.
en: Then the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bera took up battle positions in the Siddim Valley.

dag: Ka yaɣ din la gba mali pateesa shɛŋa din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayɔbu ni pirigili, ka mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: There should be twenty-two and a half feet of drapes on the other side with three posts and three bases for them.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti yiɣisi ni o dam dunia ŋɔ, niriba ni ti zo nti kpe tampima lɔna voya ni mini tiŋgbani vokaba ni ni bɛ tilig o dabiɛm zɔbu ni min o jilima dabiɛm zɔbu ni.
en: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.

dag: Di saha goli ti ku piɛla, ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti di nam ʒini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ti kahig o jilima wuh o niriba toondaannima.
en: The Lord will rule as king on Mount Zion in Jerusalem. His Glory will be shown to the city leaders with such brightness that the moon will be embarrassed and the sun will be ashamed.

dag: Di simdi ka suhuyiɣisililan nya tibidarigibo, amaa a yi fa o bahi, shee ka a lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: People who are quick to become angry must pay the price. Protect them from punishment, and they become worse.

dag: Miri ka a nahind amaŋa buni nyabu zuɣu, niŋmi yɛm din ni chɛ ka a yi di yɛla ni.
en: Be wise enough not to wear yourself out trying to get rich.

dag: Ka bɛ kukoya maa vuri daa chɛ ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli tanzaa sɔhigi, ka nyɔhi pali duu maa zaa.
en: The sound of their voices made the foundation of the Temple shake, and the Temple itself became filled with smoke.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔriba mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka sɔɣ o sani. Bɛnkam zaa bebu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni tibigim o.
en: All righteous people will rejoice because of what the Lord has done. They will find safety in him; all good people will praise him.

dag: M mi ni di ni simdi ni daadamnim niŋ shɛli nyɛla bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, ka di nyaɣisim hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: I learned that the best thing for people to do is to be happy and enjoy themselves as long as they live.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni, ka yi yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam mi dunia ŋɔ ni, di ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: I can assure you that when you speak judgment here on earth, it will be Gods judgment. And when you promise forgiveness here on earth, it will be Gods forgiveness.

dag: Parɔsh daŋ — tusaayi ni kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: the descendants of Parosh:.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam lihi paɣa kɔre lihigu pun niŋ zina ni paɣ maa o suhu ni.
en: But I say to you that every man who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery in his heart.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔbigu ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla Yawɛ ni su so, di bi simdi ka so ti lan zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, o nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: But note that a person cannot dedicate any oldest offspring from livestock, which already belongs to the LORD because it is the oldest. Whether ox or sheep, it belongs to the LORD.

dag: Ka piɛri maa zaa daa yi ti laɣim nimaani na, piɛguliba maa paarila kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu sɔŋ ka ŋɔŋ kom ti piɛri maa, ka lan labisi kuɣili maa pa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu.
en: Shepherds would roll the rock away when all their sheep had gathered there. Then after the sheep had been watered, the shepherds would roll the rock back over the mouth of the well.

dag: Di saha maa ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N wum suhigu shɛli a ni suhi zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Then Isaiah, Amozs son, sent a message to Hezekiah: This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: I have heard your prayer about Assyrias King Sennacherib.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani ni o ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve disciples, went off to the chief priests in order to betray Jesus to them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba Baalipɛrazim n-nyaŋ ba nimaani ka yɛli, Naawuni n-chɛ ka n kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baalipɛrazim.
en: So they marched up to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them there. By my strength, David exclaimed, God has burst out against my enemies, the way water bursts out. Thats why the place is called Baal-perazim.

dag: Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayɔbu dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu n-ti Anabi Hagai ni o ti Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la.
en: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a boli ma ninvuɣ suŋ? Ninvuɣ suŋ kani n-naɣ pahila Naawuni.
en: Jesus replied, Why do you call me good? Only God is good.

dag: m-pahi Yisifu yiŋnim zaa min o biɛyanim ni o ba yiŋnim zaa daa pahi Yisifu zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Kulla bɛ bihi mini piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi kɔŋko n-daa kpalim be Goshɛn tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: All the people in Josephs family, his brothers, and all the people in his fathers family went with him. Only the children and the animals stayed in the land of Goshen.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli maligumaana Abiata, Kulim a ya Anatɔt. Dama a di simdila kubu, amaa n ku chɛ ka bɛ ku a pumpɔŋɔ, a ni daa ʒiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ Alikauli Adaka m-be m ba Dauda tooni la min a ni daa di m ba wahala balibu kam la zuɣu.
en: The king said to the priest Abiathar, Go to your fields at Anathoth, because you are a condemned man. However, I wont kill you today because you carried the LORDs chest in front of my father David and because you shared in all my fathers sufferings.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihitaniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛdida, o daa nyɛla Adaya, Bɔzikat nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Josiah was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother Jedidah was the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Juda zuliya ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tusatusa fukumsi puuni, Adina daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisita.
en: according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from the clans of Judah, and he had , soldiers under him.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yi fari niriba, ŋun chɛli fabu maa ka tummila omaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihir omaŋa hal ka ni tooi sɔŋdi nandaamba.
en: If you used to rob, you must stop robbing and start working, in order to earn an honest living for yourself and to be able to help the poor.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ nyaaŋa, n ni kabis o bɔɣiri din mali yaa mini din pun kabi la, ka chɛ ka takɔbi yi o nuu ni lu.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against Pharaoh, king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the strong arm and the arm that is already broken. I will make the sword fall from his hand.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba soli tum alahichi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi.
en: He did what the Lord said was wrong. He sinned just as his father Jeroboam did when he caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Yi yi kpe kom puuni ni yi gari, n ni be yi sani, ka yi yi siɣila mɔɣa ni, di ku niŋ ya shɛli. Ka yi yi kpɛla buɣim ni, di ku din ya; di buɣim niɛm ku tooi din ya.
en: When you have troubles, I am with you. When you cross rivers, you will not be hurt. When you walk through fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not hurt you.

dag: Chɛliya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma maa baalim. Chɛliya Juda gomna mini Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa baalim ka bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili la ni.
en: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi, N ni ti kpila n tiɛɣu ni, ka ni ti chɛ ka n dabisa galisi kaman bihigu la.
en: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Diblaim bipuɣiŋga Goma ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.

dag: Di yi pa lala n ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o shɛm. N ni niŋ o kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din tam chaai la, ka chɛ ka kɔnyuri ku o.
en: If she refuses to stop her adultery, I will strip her naked and leave her like the day she was born. I will take away her people, and she will be like an empty, dry desert. I will kill her with thirst.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo mi di daa chaŋmi ti ŋmaligi kpa Hannatɔn polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Ɛfitahɛl Vinvamli ni.
en: At Neah the border turned again, went north to Hannathon, and then continued to the Valley of Iphtah El.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina, ka chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: but its insides and lower legs must be washed with water. Then the priest will present all of it and completely burn it on the altar. It is an entirely burned offering, a food gift of soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: di yi pa lala a ni daa yihi ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na maa nim ni yɛli, Yawɛ ni kɔŋ ba zaŋ tahi o ni daa lo ba alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la zuɣu min o ni je ba zuɣu ka o yihi ba tahi tiŋgban nɛl ni ni o ti chɛ ka bɛ kpi.
en: Otherwise, that land out of which you brought us will say: The LORD wasnt strong enough to bring them into the land hed promised them. Because he didnt care for them in the least, he brought them out to die in the desert.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ tɛhima, ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali na mi n-kpi? Bee ya polo ka bɛ mi n-zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun biɛhigu tuhi?.
en: No truly innocent person has ever died young.

dag: bɛna n-nyɛ Zilipa so Leeban ni daa zaŋ ti o bipuɣiŋga Liya la bidib shɛb o ni daa dɔɣi ti Yaakubu, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ pinaayɔbu.
en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah. She bore these to Jacob, a total of persons.

dag: Di nahindiya yimaŋ bindir shɛli din ni saɣim zuɣu, amaa bomiyala bindir shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Dina n-nyɛ Daadam Bia ni mali shɛli tiri ya la, dama ŋuna ka ti Ba Naawuni zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili.
en: Do not work for food that spoils; instead, work for the food that lasts for eternal life. This is the food which the Son of Man will give you, because God, the Father, has put his mark of approval on him.

dag: Dama yi yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbahi yi mabihi mini yi bihi la ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi lab o sani, o ku zaɣisi ya.
en: When you return to the LORD, your relatives and your children will receive mercy from their captors and be allowed to return to this land. The LORD your God is merciful and compassionate. He wont withdraw his presence from you if you return to him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai tab bɔhibu ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yino ŋun yɛn niŋ lala maa.
en: Then the apostles asked each other, Which one of us would do that.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti yi paɣ maa zuɣu yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi, amaa a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: The angel of the Lord appeared to Manoahs wife and said, You have not been able to have children. But you will become pregnant and have a son.

dag: N daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, so ku lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di nyaaŋa, dama n yɛtɔɣa daa yi kpɛri ba pam.
en: When I finished speaking, they had nothing more to say. My words fell gently on their ears.

dag: ka mol ti Duuma faako tibu saha molo.
en: and to announce that the time has come for the Lord to show his kindness. Isaiah :-; :.

dag: ka daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm li la.
en: and disobeyed the Lord 's command not to worship idols.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim kana ti taai di nimdi maa mini dari maa ni kuɣa ni taŋkpaɣu, ka chɛ ka ko shɛli din daa be bɔɣili maa ni farifari nyuui.
en: Then fire came down from the Lord and burned the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and the ground around the altar. Then it dried up all the water in the ditch.

dag: Maligumaaniba: Jɛdaya daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: This is a list of how many returned from each family of priests: descendants of Jeshua from Jedaiah; , from Immer; , from Pashhur; and , from Harim.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tim Shilo nti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka maa na. O nam ʒiishee daa bela chɛrubinim sunsuuni. Ka Ɛli bihi ayi Hofini mini Finɛhas daa doli Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: So the people sent men to Shiloh. The men brought back the Lord All-Powerfuls Box of the Agreement. On top of the Box are the Cherub angels. They are like a throne where the Lord sits. Elis two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, came with the Box.

dag: A tintarisi bela teeku puuni. Bɛn daa me a, daa me a ka a viɛl zaa.
en: But your territory is in the depths of the sea, and its your builders who made you beautiful.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Jɔshua sani; ka o yuli daa du pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread through the whole country.

dag: O ni yo n dimnim bɛ tuumbiɛri samli. O ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu, o ni kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.

dag: Kɔbiliga ni kul gbibi di kom shɛm, lala ka Jɛrusalɛm nim gbibi bɛ tuumbiɛri. Duŋtaabo mini ninvuɣ kubo yɛla ka n kul wumdi di puuni; dɔriti mini dansi ka n nini kul nyara.
en: As a well brings forth fresh water, she brings forth evil. Violence and destruction are heard within her; injury and wounds are ever before me.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya Yisa ni daa kuhi lala ka bahi maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: A Roman army officer was standing in front of Jesus. When the officer saw how Jesus died, he said, This man really was the Son of God.

dag: Judanim mi Naawuni, o yuli tibisi pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: God is known in Judah; his name is honored in Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribila maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees asked, Why are you doing what our Law says you cannot do on the Sabbath.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni tuɣili Ijiptinima, ka bɛ tuhi taba. Nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee ni tuhi taba, ka tins ayinim tuhi taba, ka nanim tuhi taba.
en: The Lord says, I will cause the Egyptians to fight against themselves. Men will fight their brothers. Neighbors will be against neighbors. Cities will be against cities. Kingdoms will be against kingdoms.

dag: ka chɛ ka kahiŋkɔɣu doli nimaani yi. Kahiŋkɔɣu maa ni daa yiɣi yi, o daa kul yiɣirimi gindi hal ka kom maa ti nyuui.
en: and sent out a raven. It did not come back, but kept flying around until the water was completely gone.

dag: N ni ti yɛn darigi Ijiptinim tibili shɛm m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will execute judgments in Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: Tell me, what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes indeed, but you saw much more than a prophet.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Dauda zuliya ni so di nam nimaani. A ni guli n ni pii na so maa.
en: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp.

dag: O daa di wahala pam timanim sani n-saɣim o ni daa mali shɛlikam zaa ha, ka di bi niŋd o soochi ka kul maan pahirimi.
en: She had suffered a lot under the care of many doctors, and had spent everything she had without getting any better. In fact, she had gotten worse.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na. Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: When it was time to harvest the crop, he sent a servant to ask the renters for his share of the grapes. But they beat up the servant and sent him away without anything.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Nyama, n zaŋ Jɛriko mini di naa ni di tɔbbi biinsi niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, I am putting into your hands Jericho, with its king and all its brave soldiers.

dag: Kulla sɔhila ka yi paai kpe na; ka n chɛ ka yi doli ma chani gindi ka m bi mi n ni kuni luɣ shɛli polo gba? Zaŋm a mabihi maa ka yi labi. Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim din bi naari min o ʒiɛyimtali.
en: You have lived here only a short time, so why should I make you wander around with me? I don't even know where I'm going. Go back and take all your people with you—and may the Lord be kind and faithful to you.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nudirigu tiri, ka tiŋgbani vali ba.
en: You stretched out your right hand, and the earth swallowed our enemies.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn deei bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bɛ suhupiɛlli mini bɛ jilima, ka bɛ nini tiɣi li, ka bɛ suhuri yu li pam m-pahi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi la.
en: The Lord said, Ezekiel, I will soon destroy the temple that makes everyone feel proud and safe, and I will take away their children as well.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias yɛli bɛn ʒe m-miri Pool maa ni bɛ ŋmɛm o naŋgbani.
en: Ananias, the high priest, was there. When he heard this, he told the men who were standing near Paul to hit him in the mouth.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni. N ni ti zaŋ li tin ya ka di leei yi ni su shɛli. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will bring you to the land that I solemnly promised to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; and I will give it to you as your own possession. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: If no one will ever be raised from death, then Christ has never been raised.

dag: Di ŋmanila yu biɛɣu m-be n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n dimnim maani ma ansarisi, ka kul bɔhiri ma, ka a Naawuni maa lee be ya?.
en: I am crushed by their insults, as they keep on asking me, Where is your God.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n sani n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, saha shɛli bɛ yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti na hal ni zuŋɔ la zuɣu. .
en: I will do this to my people because they have sinned against me and have stirred up my anger from the time their ancestors came out of Egypt to this day.

dag: O no n-gur o tɔbu kaman o nyɛla ti dima, ka zaŋ o nudirigu tiri ti kaman ti dim la. O ku ti ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyuri bara Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga tanti suɣili puuni la. O chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili yina kaman buɣim la.
en: He aimed his arrows at us like an enemy; He killed all those who were our joy and delight. Here in Jerusalem we felt his burning anger.

dag: Hakalia bia Nɛhimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pisi puuni gol so bɛ ni booni Kisilɛv ni, man Nɛhimia daa bela Susa tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin zuɣu la ni.
en: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n kana ti kaag a, amaa n sabiri yɛl shɛŋa din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tir a mi.
en: I hope to come to you quickly. But Im writing these things to you so that.

dag: N Naawuni ni n Naa, n ni duh a, ka paɣ a yuli sahakam.
en: I will proclaim your greatness, my God and king; I will thank you forever and ever.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ yi be ka soli wuhibu ka di ni, di lurimi, amaa saawarimaaniba ni galisi luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka niriba be ni alaafee.
en: A nation will fall if it has no guidance. Many advisers mean security.

dag: ka ŋun chaŋ ti bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee nyari azaaba, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ti yab Ibrahimma katiŋ ha, ka Lazarɔs be o sani.
en: He was sent to the place of death and was in great pain. He saw Abraham far away with Lazarus in his arms.

dag: N yi zaŋ chibo paɣi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ bɔchaa paɣi n nuhi.
en: No soap can wash away my sins.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisi dali ka sagbani maa daa vuui alikauli biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa.
en: On the twentieth day of the second month in the second year after the people left Egypt, the cloud over the Tent of the Lord 's presence lifted.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ o kɔhimma nyɔri ti yaɣi ni o nya buni pam, o bɔri li zaanila ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi nandaamba nirilim.
en: If you get rich by charging high interest rates, your wealth will go to someone who is kind to the poor.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti niŋ anabinim ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la naani pam. Ka yi yi niŋ ania dol li, yi niŋ din tuhi viɛnyɛliŋga, dama di ŋmanila firila din ne zibisim ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neerina ka biɛŋmariga neesim neei yi suhuri ni la.
en: In addition, we have a most reliable prophetic word, and you would do well to pay attention to it, just as you would to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu n-nam ninsala, ka vuhi nyɛvili vuhim niŋ o nyee ni; ka ninsal leei ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: Then the Lord God took dust from the ground and made a man. He breathed the breath of life into the mans nose, and the man became a living thing.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dɔbba zaa.
en: And when the Lord your God lets you take the city, you must kill all the men in it.

dag: ka di nyɛla o chaŋmi ti jɛm wuna, di yi nyɛla wuntaŋa bee goli bee saŋmarisi din nyɛ din chihiri n san la.
en: by worshiping and serving other gods or the sun or the moon or the stars, contrary to the Lord 's command.

dag: N ni zaŋ alibarika shɛli mini noli yɛlibu shɛli zali yi tooni ŋɔ yi ti niŋdi ya, ka yi teeri di yɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn kari ya tahi zuliya shɛba zaa ni ŋɔ sani.
en: Now, once all these things happen to you, the blessing and the curse that Im setting before you, you must call them to mind as you sit among the various nations where the LORD your God has driven you.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri zabili nyɛla ŋun yuri alahichi. Ŋun me dunɔbia din du pam nyɛla ŋun bɔri kɔb kaba.
en: To like sin is to like making trouble. If you brag all the time, you are asking for trouble.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Naawuni, Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab naa la n-tim ba na ti yɛli ma.
en: Balaam said to God, Moabs King Balak, Zippors son, sent them to me with the message.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Toomiya daaŋa ni tampiligim nukurigu palipali ka Musa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa Firawuna ninni.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, Take handfuls of ashes from a furnace and have Moses throw it up in the air in front of Pharaoh.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo dunoli maa, niriba ayɔbuyɔbu n-daa yi gul li dabisili kam, ka niriba anahinahi daa yi guli nuzaa polo dunoya la dabisili kam, ka niriba ayiyi mi daa guli nɛma duu la dabisili kam.
en: Six Levites stood guard every day at the East Gate. Four Levites stood guard every day at the North Gate. Four Levites stood guard at the South Gate. And two Levites guarded the house where the valuable things were kept.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed.

dag: M mali tahima Naawuni sani ni wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ni neei kum ni, kaman bɛ gba ni mali di tahima shɛm.
en: The hope I have in God I also share with my accusers, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the unrighteous.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa kuhi bahi Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna ka ti wuhi ya binshɛli. Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa, Doli n nyaaŋa na, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni.
en: Then the troops in the fort yelled to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, Come on up! Well teach you a lesson! So Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, Follow me, because the LORD has handed them over to Israel.

dag: hal a ni kul mi ni n ka taali, ka so kani ŋun ni tooi fa ma a nuu ni bahi maa zaa yoli?.
en: You know that Im not guilty, yet no one delivers me from your power.

dag: Shɛli bi to Yawɛ sani. N shiri ni ti labina yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, ka Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: I am the Lord ! There is nothing too difficult for me. I'll come back next year at the time I promised, and Sarah will already have a son.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yi nimaani chaŋ Pɛnuɛl nti lan suhi bɛ gba bindirigu. Ka Pɛnuɛluɛlnim daa garigi yɛl o kaman Sukɔtinim ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: After leaving Succoth, Gideon went to Penuel and asked the leaders there for some food. But he got the same answer as he did at Succoth.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛhudia nira n-nyɛ ma? Amaŋmaŋ niriba mini maligumaaniba kpamba n-zaŋ a tahi n sanna! Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka a lee tum.
en: Pilate said, Im not a Jew! It was your own people and their leading priests who brought you before me. What have you done wrong.

dag: Miriya ka yi taɣi Naawuni Shia Kasi zali;.
en: Dont stop the work of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba Anabi Musa min anabinim zaa ha litaafinim ni daa yɛli ŋun Yisa yɛla shɛm.
en: Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Masia be yi suhuri ni yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi ba nyaɣa zani ka me yimaŋ tam yurilim zuɣu.
en: and I pray that Christ will make his home in your hearts through faith. I pray that you may have your roots and foundation in love.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisiya pam ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: Once they heard this, they were beside themselves with anger and began to shout, Great is Artemis of the Ephesians.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, Napaɣ Ɛsta, wula? Bɔ ka a bɔra? N ni ti a a ni bɔri shɛli maa, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: What is it, Queen Esther? the king asked. Tell me what you want, and you shall have it—even if it is half my empire.

dag: Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa ni a kpiɔŋ tariga.
en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind, and all your strength.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni, ka yi yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam mi dunia ŋɔ ni, di ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: And so I tell all of you: what you prohibit on earth will be prohibited in heaven, and what you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ lala. O daa zaŋ firilanim maa zali ni di ne firilatamdigu maa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Aaron did this. He put the lamps in the right place so that they lighted the area in front of the lampstand. He obeyed the command that the Lord gave Moses.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri niriba yɛligu, o ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali; doli yɛnnim ni yɛn wuh a so shɛli n-tuhi tɔbu.
en: Plans are firmed up by advice; wage wars with good guidance.

dag: Malaikanim la daa yɛliya ni bɛ chɛli di tigbirigu la firi tiŋa. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni a ni ti lan lab a nam maa ni na saha shɛli a yi ti baŋ ni Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa fukumsi.
en: The command to leave the stump of the tree and its roots in the ground means this: Your kingdom will be given back to you. This will happen when you learn that Most High God rules your kingdom.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa ti leei Naawuni dini, ka bɛ sɔɣ pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Ahazia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoram died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City, and his son Ahaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la kuna. Ka Jɔab daa chɛ ka Yuria kuli Dauda sani.
en: David then sent a message to Joab: Send me Uriah the Hittite. So Joab sent him to David.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka a mini Haman kana yuŋ ŋɔ nti di bindira ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni pun niŋ zali nyin naa ŋɔ.
en: Esther replied, If it please Your Majesty, I would like you and Haman to be my guests tonight at a banquet I am preparing for you.

dag: N duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni, n duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni ni o deei n suhigu.
en: I cry out loud to God— out loud to God so that he can hear me!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa ti kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: Joshua, Nuns son and the LORDs servant, died when he was years old.

dag: Ka bɛ ni bɛn kpalim daa guui tiligi zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn kuɣili la gbini. Ka bɛ daa ŋme n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tusaanu sol ni. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul kariti doli ba hal ni Gidom ti lan ku bɛ ninvuɣ tusaayi.
en: Some other warriors of Benjamin turned and ran down the road toward Rimmon Rock in the desert. The Israelites killed , of them on the road, then chased the rest until they had killed , more.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: And so the news about Jesus spread to every place in the whole area.

dag: O ni kpaai tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma maa, o niŋ li mi gu n sɔɣibu.
en: She has poured perfume on my body to prepare it for burial.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa ti be Tɛsalɔnaika la yi daa tim sɔŋsim na ti ti ma, ka daa lan niŋ lala di nyaaŋa zaŋ chana.
en: You sent contributions repeatedly to take care of my needs even while I was in Thessalonica.

dag: Anabinim zaa kpiya; ka nyin lee zaŋ amaŋ leela ŋuni? A gari ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa kpi maa.
en: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died and the prophets died, so who do you make yourself out to be.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Jɔshua, Amaŋmaŋ nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ nanim ayi ŋɔ shɛm zaa, lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn garina shɛb tinsi ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then I told Joshua, You saw how the Lord our God helped us destroy King Sihon and King Og. So don't be afraid! Wherever you go, the Lord will fight on your side and help you destroy your enemies.

dag: Dama yi ni yɛn kari zuliya shɛb maa nyɛla bɛn doli baɣisi mini bihiŋmɛriba yɛligu, amaa yinim bɛna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi saɣi ni yi niŋ lala.
en: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.

dag: Bɛ kpirila ninvuɣ kaha, ka bɛ nyɛviya bahigu nyɛla vi bahigu.
en: They die young; they are among the holy ones.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan wuhi ma binshɛli. Nyama, o daa wuhi ma la tiwal moma ni pali piɛ shɛli.
en: This is what the LORD God showed me: a basket of summer fruit.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi chɛ ka m mɔɣisi n yaansi maa mini m bipuɣinsi maa kparima n-chɛbisi ba? A tum gala.
en: You didnt even let me kiss my sons and my daughters good-bye. Now youve acted like a fool.

dag: Yi paɣiba mini yi bihi ni yi biŋkɔbiri bɛn ni kpalim be n ni zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa tin ya maa ni.
en: Only your wives, children, and livestock—I know you have a lot of livestock—will remain behind in the towns that I have assigned to you.

dag: Kulla pumpɔŋɔ ka n nam yɛla maa. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi wum di yɛla maa; dinzuɣu yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi pun mi li.
en: This is something that is happening now, not long ago. You have not heard about it before today. So you cannot say, We already knew that.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia bia Zakaria la n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔgula.
en: Zechariah, Meshelemiahs son, was gatekeeper at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Joash lay down with his ancestors. He was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. His son Jeroboam succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N nini nya Naawuni ka bi kpi. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛniɛl.
en: So Jacob named that place Peniel. He said, At this place, I saw God face to face, but my life was spared.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋdi hal ti paai yuma ayi, ka Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka be Ɛsha daa wum ti Duuma yɛligu maa.
en: This went on for two years, so that all the people who lived in the province of Asia, both Jews and Gentiles, heard the word of the Lord.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka alahichi yirina, amaa yɛndana nyɛla ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni yɛtɔɣa pam tɔɣisibu.
en: The more you talk, the more likely you are to sin. If you are wise, you will keep quiet.

dag: Turi mini putɔɣu m-pali bɛ noya ni.
en: their speech is filled with bitter curses.

dag: Nyam salima la ni daɣi shɛm. Nyam salima alali la ni daɣi shɛm. Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu kuɣ viɛla la wurim do soya zuɣu luɣilikam.
en: See how the gold has grown dark, how the pure gold has changed. There are jewels scattered all around at every street corner.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N yi chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zaa chaŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ be yi sani? Zaɣ biɛɣu ka yi lo maa.
en: The king replied, The Lord had better watch over you on the day I let you leave with your families! You're up to no good.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam mili mi bi bɔri da palli, dama o yɛrimi ni da kurili ko n-nyaɣisi o sani.
en: No one who drinks a well-aged wine wants new wine, but says, The well-aged wine is better.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa.
en: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord , the All-Powerful!.

dag: N di yuya ni a zaŋ ma sɔɣi kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka a zaŋ ma sɔɣi nimaani hal ka a suhu ti maai, ka a di zali ma saha shɛli a ni yɛn teei n yɛla.
en: I wish you would hide me in my grave. I wish you would hide me there, until your anger is gone. Then you could pick a time to remember me.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, maliya suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka paɣ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: All you that are righteous be glad because of what the Lord has done! Remember what the holy God has done, and give thanks to him.

dag: Ka daɣila di daa bi simdi ni Masia nya wahala ŋɔ zaa ka naanyi nya jilima.
en: The prophets said the Messiah must suffer these things before he begins his time of glory.

dag: Ŋuna n-deeri dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannim yɛm ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi mɔɣu.
en: takes away the power to think from earths leaders, making them wander in untraveled wastelands.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee nim malila shili ni bɛ deei Babilɔn naa. Bɛnkam zaa daa nyɛ nanim dunia ŋɔ ni yiɣisiya ni bɛ puh a. Bɛn zaa daa nyɛ zuliya shɛb nanim ni yiɣisi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi puh a.
en: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.

dag: Dama o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim na bela o ni. O daa kpaai li pala tampiŋ zuɣu. O daa bi kpaai li bahi tiŋa ni o niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: The people of Jerusalem murdered innocent people in the city and didn't even try to cover up the blood that flowed out on the hard ground.

dag: A bi kpini shɛli yɛla ŋɔ ni, a mi nuu ka di ni, dama a suhu bi ʒe yim ni Naawuni.
en: You cannot share with us in this work. Your heart is not right before God.

dag: Amaa o ni daa duh omaŋa ka niŋ karimbaani, ka mali hali yoli ni ninkuunsi la zuɣu ka Naawuni daa vuug o o nam ʒiishee, ka o kɔŋ o jilima zaashee maa.
en: But when he became proud and stubborn, his glorious kingdom was taken from him.

dag: Naa ni daa wum zaligu kundi yɛtɔɣa maa, o daa darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: When King Josiah heard the words of the law being read, he tore his clothes.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa ŋun tim ma na ni n ti baptaizi niriba kom ni maa n-daa yɛli ma, A yi ti nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi siɣina ti tam so zuɣu, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi baptaizi niriba la.
en: I still did not know that he was the one, but God, who sent me to baptize with water, had said to me, You will see the Spirit come down and stay on a man; he is the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be! M paɣiri ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ maa! N kul ni tibigiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim maa.
en: The LORD lives! Bless God, my rock! Let the God of my salvation be lifted high!.

dag: amaa wuuni ka bɛ laɣisiri bɛ bindira sɔŋda, atam kpuɣibu saha ka bɛ vari bɛ bindira sɔŋda.
en: but they store up food during harvest season.

dag: Ka di daa bili n-leela yɔɣili din zɔra, amaa ka lee bi do tiŋa, ka ŋmaligi kpala o polo. Ka di nyaɣa kul kpalim ʒe di zaashee. Lala zuɣu di daa leela yɔɣili n-niŋ wula mini vari.
en: The seeds grew and became a grapevine. It was a good vine. The vine was not tall, but it spread to cover a large area. The vine grew stems, and smaller vines grew very long.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa zani Ariɔpagus jintɔriba maa sunsuuni yɛli, Yinim Atɛnsinim ŋɔ, n nyaya ka yi doli yi jɛmbu soli viɛnyɛliŋga shɛlikam puuni.
en: Then Paul stood up before the meeting of the Areopagus council and said, Men of Athens, everything I see here tells me you are very religious.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa guui ti tuh o soli yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ka n nyu.
en: The servant ran to meet her and said, Please give me a drink of water from your jar.

dag: Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin zalimi zaligu n-chɛ ka bɛ ku ba. A yi ni niŋ lala, n lo alikauli ni n ni tooi zaŋ anzinfa din sania zuɣu tibisim paai kilɔgiram tuhi kɔbisita ni pihinahi n-niŋ a liɣiri kpanjɔɣu ni.
en: If the king wishes, let a written order be sent out to destroy them, and I will hand over ten thousand kikkars of silver to those in charge of the kings business. The silver can go into the kings treasuries.

dag: ka su Hɛrimɔn Zoli mini Salɛka ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga ni Giliad pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn tintariga la.
en: His kingdom included Mount Hermon, Salecah, and all of Bashan as far as the boundaries of Geshur and Maacah, as well as half of Gilead, as far as the territory of King Sihon of Heshbon.

dag: ka ania niŋbu tahiri biɛrisuntali na, ka biɛrisuntali tahiri tahima na.
en: endurance produces character, and character produces hope.

dag: dama n ni ti tin ya yɛm ni noli ka yi dimnim ti ku tooi tɔɣisi luhi ya bee n-tooi garigi yi bɔhigu.
en: because I will give you such words and wisdom that none of your enemies will be able to refute or contradict what you say.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ, ka o wum ti kuhigu maa ka daa tim o malaika na ka o ti yihi ti Ijipti maa na, ka ti kana ti be Kadɛshi tin shɛli din miri a tintariga la.
en: and when we begged our Lord for help, he answered our prayer and brought us out of that land. Now we are camped at the border of your territory, near the town of Kadesh.

dag: N kpalimla yɔbahi mabia, ka nyɛ taatahi dolinikpee.
en: My voice is as sad and lonely as the cries of a jackal or an ostrich.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ʒim yihibu maa taali yɛn labina ti ʒini ŋun Jɔab min o nyaaŋa zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa Dauda min o nyaaŋa ni o yiŋnim ni o nam ʒiishee ni mali suhudoo din yi Yawɛ sanna sahakam.
en: May the bloodguilt for their deaths return on Joabs head and on the head of his family line forever. But may the LORDs peace be on David, his family, and his royal house forever.

dag: Amaa o daa dolila Izraɛl nanim biɛhigu. Hal o daa zaŋla kuriti m-mali Baal binnana zali.
en: He followed the bad example of the kings of Israel. He used molds to make idols to worship the Baal gods.

dag: Sool ni daa nya ka Dauda chani ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, ka o bɔhi Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ nachimbil maa? Ka Abinɛr garigi yɛli, Naa, nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi mi.
en: Saul watched David go out to fight Goliath. Saul spoke to Abner, the commander of the army. Abner, who is that young mans father? Abner answered, I swear I dont know, sir.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n kamina ni n ti yɛli nyini n dan naa dimbɔŋɔ, dama niriba maa chɛmi ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam ka n tɛhi ni n yi yɛli nyin naa, di pa shɛli a ni niŋ man ŋun nyɛ o dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni bɔr shɛm maa.
en: I have come to my master the king to talk about this because people have made me afraid. Your servant thought, I must speak with the king. Maybe the king will act on the request of his servant.

dag: Bɛ zoorimi kaman momaha la asibaasi; zaawuni ka bɛ ti zaɣi kpi.
en: that grows and looks so fresh in the morning, but in the evening it is dry and dying.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu bara ni o ni ti pini ka bi ti li ŋmanila saa ni yi ku ka bi mi la.
en: People who brag about a gift never given are like clouds and wind that produce no rain.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be anabi Samuɛl ʒiɛman ni mini anab shɛb bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa pun yɛli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Samuel, and all the other prophets who spoke for God after Samuel, said that this time would come.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli jintɔriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi ni lo ni yi niŋ niriba maa shɛm maa;.
en: and then he said to the Council, Fellow Israelites, be careful what you do to these men.

dag: Dama pa malaikanim yɛla m-muɣis o, amaa ti yab Ibrahimma yaansi yɛla m-muɣis o.
en: For it is clear that it is not the angels that he helps. Instead, he helps the descendants of Abraham.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun ni nyu Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain shɛli o ni booi niŋ o suhuyiɣisili pipia ni ka binshɛli bi pilisi di ni la. Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ chilibi buɣim n-nahim dilana malaika kasinim mini Piɛbil la tooni.
en: They will drink the wine of Gods anger. This wine is prepared with all its strength in the cup of Gods anger. They will be tortured with burning sulfur before the holy angels and the Lamb.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda naa ni Ɛdom naa daa laɣim chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai daba ayopɔin chandi tariga ka kom pooi ba, hal ka shɛli kani ka bɛ tɔbbihi mini bɛ ni daa ʒiri biŋkɔb shɛb chani ni nyu.
en: So Joram, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom led their troops out. But seven days later, there was no drinking water left for them or their animals.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu m-mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: Make the poles from acacia wood and cover them with gold. The table should be carried with these poles.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Lomiy o nuhi min o naba n-zaŋ o ti bahi kpaŋ ha zibisim shee. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina. .
en: So the king told some servants, Tie this mans hands and feet. Throw him out into the darkness, where people are crying and grinding their teeth with pain.

dag: Maata ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ o tizo Mariama sani nti sɔɣi yɛl o, Karimba kana, ka boon a.
en: After she said this, she went and spoke privately to her sister Mary, The teacher is here and hes calling for you.

dag: Niriba ayi yi do n-tab taba, bɛ ni ni tula, amaa nir yi do o ko, wula ka o yɛn niŋ ka o ni tula?.
en: If it is cold, two can sleep together and stay warm, but how can you keep warm by yourself?.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba zaa ka nimaani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpe ŋarima maa n-chaŋ Kapɛrinium ni bɛ ti bo Yisa shee.
en: When the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and came to Capernaum looking for Jesus.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yɛri sakuɣa, Lum tiŋgban ni, ka yɛli sa titali ŋɔ, Lumina pam.
en: He says to the snow, Fall to earth, and to the downpour of rain, Be a mighty shower.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili ni wurim, amaa ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suɣili kul ni ʒiɛya.
en: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi la daa lan lab Izraɛl naa sanna ti yɛl o, Lan malimiya shili gu, ka baŋ yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama zaŋ chaŋ shɛɣuni, Siria naa ni lan labina ti liri ya.
en: The prophet came to Israels king and said to him, Maintain your strength! Know and understand that at the turn of the coming year, Arams king will attack you again.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi leei yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ bihi, dama ŋuna n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ neeri ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zaa zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka saa miri ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri tinsi ni.
en: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam, ka o binnamda zaa kul ni paɣir o sahakam.
en: I will praise you, Lord , and everyone will respect your holy name forever.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋa m-baŋ Yawɛ, o kandina ka biɛhiŋ kaman biɛɣu neebu ni ka biɛhiŋ shɛm la. O ni ka ti sanna kaman sayuɣiyuɣi ni miri shɛm la. Kaman siɣili saa ni miri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yɛn ka ti sanna.
en: Lets learn about the Lord . Lets try very hard to know him. We know he is coming, just as we know the dawn is coming. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the ground.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di zɔr o dabiɛm, dama n zaŋ o min o niriba maa zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ a nuu ni. Niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn shɛm la.
en: But the Lord said to me, Don't be afraid of him. I am going to give him, his men, and all his territory to you. Do the same thing to him that you did to Sihon the Amorite king who ruled in Heshbon.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ di vi, ka dabiɛm mali ba sahakam; ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi ni vi.
en: Let them be shamed and terrified forever. Let them die in disgrace.

dag: A yuli zuɣu, di tabigi ti bahi. Miri ka a filim a nam ʒiishee din mali jilima ŋɔ. Teema, ka miri ka a saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la.
en: For your names sake, dont reject us, dont scorn your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us; dont break it.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zani gil o, ka o yiɣisi n-lan kpe tiŋ maa ni n-daa kaai biɛɣu ka o mini Baanabas yi nimaani chaŋ Dɛɛbi.
en: When the disciples surrounded him, he got up and entered the city again. The following day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋub li ni nya tibidarigibo. Dama o saɣim Yawɛ binshɛli din be kasi, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi lala nir maa o niriba ni.
en: You will be guilty of sin if you do that because you did not respect the holy things that belong to the Lord . If you do that, you will be separated from your people.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ. Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi.
en: Praise the Lord 's glorious name; bow down before the Holy One when he appears.

dag: Ka bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka baŋ di gbinni, ka di ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: As for what was planted on good soil, this refers to those who hear and understand, and bear fruit and produce—in one case a yield of one hundred to one, in another case a yield of sixty to one, and in another case a yield of thirty to one.

dag: Yi niriba anu ni ti kar doli niriba kɔbiga, ka yi niriba kɔbiga ni ti kar doli niriba tuhi pia n-zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dimnim maa.
en: Five of you will chase men, and of you will chase , men. You will defeat your enemies and kill them with your sword.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɔmam. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotans family: Hori and Homam; Lotans sister was Timna.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun wumdi bɛn be sarika ni ŋuhibu, ka fari bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la bahira.
en: And he will hear the prisoners prayers. He will free those who were condemned to die.

dag: ni ŋun wuhiri bɛn ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni din tuhi biɛribaalimtali puuni. Dama di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka bɛ baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli ka niŋ tuuba.
en: You must gently teach those who dont agree with you. Maybe God will let them change their hearts so that they can accept the truth.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa nya alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum maa, ka lan wum ka bihi yɛriti saɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ka di daa ku ba suli pam.
en: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka a bi dol a ni daa po pɔ shɛli Yawɛ sani maa mini zaligu shɛli n ni daa zal a maa.
en: Why, then, have you broken your promise and disobeyed my command?.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ diba anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: Sew five of them together in one set, and do the same with the other five.

dag: ka lab o mabihi maa sani ti yɛli ba, Bia maa kani, ka ya ka n lee yɛn kpe.
en: He returned to his brothers and said, The boy is not there! What am I going to do.

dag: N daa laɣisi anzinfa mini salima ni nanim azichi na ti puli, ka su tiŋgbana. N daa mali baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka daa mali mamanim pam n-di niŋgbuŋ nyaɣisim.
en: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi kpe m-me sara maligu bimbini maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then offer up on that altar entirely burned sacrifices to the LORD your God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, A bi yɛn mali tiŋgbani bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bee m-mali tarili bɛ sani. Mani n-nyɛ a tarili ni a ni su shɛli Izraɛlnim sani.
en: The Lord also said to Aaron, You will not get any of the land. And you will not own anything that the other people own. I myself will be yours. The Israelites will get the land that I promised, but I am my gift to you.

dag: Ka o sɔrilim maa yi na bi naai ka o dɔni binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, o yi lan ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu, di gba ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Anything on which she sits or lies during her monthly period is unclean.

dag: Ka ti mi ni Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni la ni ti neei ti gba kum ni pahi Yisa zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti mini ya tahi ŋun Naawuni sani.
en: We know that God, who raised the Lord Jesus to life, will also raise us up with Jesus and take us, together with you, into his presence.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ, bɛ daa kuhirimi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi lan zaŋ salima nɛma niŋ omaŋa.
en: The people heard this bad news and became very sad, so they stopped wearing jewelry.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Labimi Balak sani nti zaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm yɛl o.
en: The Lord appeared to Balaam and gave him another message, then he told him to go and tell Balak.

dag: Samarianim suhuri zɔhirimi Bɛtavɛn naɣibil la zuɣu. Di niriba ni ti kum naɣibil maa zuɣu. Ka di tindaannim la ti kum di zuɣu pam. Bɛ ni ti kum pam di ni kɔŋ jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: The people from Samaria worship the calves at Beth Aven. They will cry. The priests will cry, because their beautiful idol is gone. It was carried away.

dag: Anabi yi zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli ka di bi niŋ bee ka shɛli bi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, di pala Yawɛ ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli: Anabi maa n-kul ŋme nyɔɣu n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa; yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya.
en: Heres the answer: The prophet who speaks in the LORDs name and the thing doesnt happen or come about—thats the word the LORD hasnt spoken. That prophet spoke arrogantly. Dont be afraid of him.

dag: N dimnim kul lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. Bɛ bɔrimi ni n kpi ka n yuli gba kpi m-pahi.
en: My enemies say bad things about me. They ask, When will he die and be forgotten.

dag: A daa zaŋ a situra maa shɛli n-dih a buɣa jɛmbu shee nachiinsi n-dɔni di zuɣu n-tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: You took some of your clothing to make colorful shrines and prostituted yourself in them.

dag: ka ninvuɣ galima bɛn ka buchi laɣimna ti pah o zuɣu, ka bɛ zaɣisi Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun daa na nyɛ bipolli ka o yɛm na bi ziligi ka o ku tooi nyaŋ ba la noli.
en: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.

dag: ka daa daŋ tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli nti mali shili n-gul o;.
en: He sent messengers on ahead of him. Along the way, they entered a Samaritan village to prepare for his arrival.

dag: N ni yiini yila paɣiri Yawɛ hal ni n nyɛvili tariga; n ni kul be ŋɔ, n ni yiini yila paɣiri n Naawuni.
en: I will sing to the Lord all my life; as long as I live I will sing praises to my God.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ bi zaŋ o ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee na, di di kul simdi ni yi ŋub li luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee kaman n ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli beni ka di kom nyɛla din tiri Naawuni tiŋ la suhupiɛlli, luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ Zallakudura Naa biɛhigu shee la.
en: There is a river whose streams gladden Gods city, the holiest dwelling of the Most High.

dag: Dindali maa, di simdi ka naa ti bo naɣila polli m-mali sara o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: On that day, the prince will provide a young bull as the purification offering for himself and for the people of the land.

dag: Ka Jɔab mini Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim ni wɔɣira zaa daa pahi Abishai zuɣu ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ni bɛ ti biɛhi Bikiri bia Shiiba maa naba.
en: So Joabs men marched out after Sheba—this included the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the warriors. They marched out of Jerusalem to pursue Bichris son Sheba.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Biɛɣuni sa nyɛla gol palli dabisili, ka bɛ sa ni bɔ a kɔŋ, dama a sa ku ʒi a ʒiishee.
en: After this Jonathan said: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, and people will wonder where you are, because your place at the table will be empty.

dag: Chɛ ka a ba min a ma mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka paɣ ŋun dɔɣ a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Make your parents proud, especially your mother.

dag: M mabihi, n daa naan ku tooi tɔɣisi ya kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, amaa n daa tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dolila daadam biɛhigu bee kaman bɛn na nyɛ biliɛri Masia dolibu ni.
en: As a matter of fact, my friends, I could not talk to you as I talk to people who have the Spirit; I had to talk to you as though you belonged to this world, as children in the Christian faith.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim zim shɛli mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi. Ka naa daa zaŋ li niŋ Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yil la ni.
en: He also made smaller shields of hammered gold. He used almost pounds of gold for each shield. The king put them in the Forest-of-Lebanon House.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tabilakpihi daŋ yi tooni nti dim kari Hivinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinima ka chɛ soli tin ya.
en: I will send the hornet in front of you. He will force your enemies to leave. The Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites will leave your country.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o yihi luɣ kasi shee maa daɣiri ni ni Izraɛlnim daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi la zaa zuɣu; ka di simdi ka o niŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili din be bɛ sani bɛ daɣiri tuma ni maa lala.
en: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.

dag: To, ninvuɣ so yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi chani gindi yɛra, N ni yihi ya waazu din wuhiri ni wain mini binnyuri kpɛma pam nyubu viɛla, ŋuna ka yi ni bɔri ni o nyɛ yi waazuyihira.
en: These people want the kind of prophet who goes around full of lies and deceit and says, I prophesy that wine and liquor will flow for you.

dag: N niriba bɔhiri dari binyara ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi wuhiri ba binyara din ti yɛn niŋ. Dama zina niŋbu n-vo ba kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka bɛ chɛ Naawuni ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: My people are asking pieces of wood for advice. They think those sticks will answer them! They have chased after those false gods like prostitutes and have left their own God.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sɛrɛd daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Sɛrɛdnima; ka Ɛlɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛlɔnnima; ka Jaaliil daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaaliilnima.
en: Zebuluns descendants according to their clans: from Sered, the Seredite clan; from Elon, the Elonite clan; from Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan me omaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi zali. O daa mali niɣi mini piɛri pam, dama Naawuni daa ti o buni pam.
en: Hezekiah also built many towns, and he got many flocks of sheep and cattle. God gave him much wealth.

dag: dama bɛ tɛha zaa nyɛla duŋtaabo, ka bɛ noya tɔɣisiri barina yɛtɔɣa.
en: In their hearts they plan to do evil. All they talk about is making trouble.

dag: Ka o daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti tim ba niriba ayiyi; ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: He called the twelve disciples together and sent them out two by two. He gave them authority over the evil spirits.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun garigi bɔhigu ni yɛlimaŋli nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zɔsimdi.
en: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mali ti shili gu dimbɔŋɔ, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: This is what God himself made us for. And he has given us the Spirit as the first payment to guarantee the life to come.

dag: Ŋun Yisa n-daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu ka lan neei kum ni ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Because of our sins he was given over to die, and he was raised to life in order to put us right with God.

dag: Ka Manaasa zuliya mini Ifriim zuliya ni ti lu tab zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti laɣim lu Juda zuliya zuɣu. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ku chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zan tariga. O na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.

dag: Dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana. N suhu saɣimya pam.
en: because I am poor and needy, and my heart is broken.

dag: Dama o daa dolila Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam soli, ka tumdi alahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la.
en: Like Jeroboam before him, he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by his sins and by leading the people into sin and idolatry.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Firawuna sani labira, ka bɛ nya Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ʒiɛya guhiri ba.
en: When they were leaving the meeting with Pharaoh, they passed Moses and Aaron. Moses and Aaron were waiting for them.

dag: O yi ti kana, yin deemiy o kaman Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni deeri niriba shɛm ti Duuma zuɣu la; ka o yi ti bɔri shɛli yi sani, yin sɔŋmiy o, dama o nyɛla ŋun sɔŋ niriba pam zaŋ tabili mmaŋmaŋ gba.
en: Receive her in the Lord's name, as God's people should, and give her any help she may need from you; for she herself has been a good friend to many people and also to me.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Taitus polo, o nyɛla n tumtumdikpee ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tumdi ni ti sɔŋ ya; ka zaŋ chaŋ ti mabihi la mi polo, bɛ nyɛla cheechi tuumba Masia jilima nyabu zuɣu.
en: As for Titus, he is my partner and works with me to help you; as for the other brothers who are going with him, they represent the churches and bring glory to Christ.

dag: Ka Inok daa dɔɣi Irad; ka Irad daa nyɛ Mɛhujaɛl ba, ka Mɛhujaɛl nyɛ Mɛtushaɛl ba, ka Mɛtushaɛl mi nyɛ Lamɛk ba.
en: Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad had a son named Mehujael. Mehujael had a son named Methushael. And Methushael had a son named Lamech.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ galisiya gari wuna zaa, o ni daa tiligi niriba maa Ijiptinim nuu ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa niŋdi ba fitiina la zuɣu.
en: Now I know the Lord is greater than all the gods. They thought they were in control, but look what God did.

dag: Lee di taaya duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka di zɔriya tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba dabiɛm, ti ni nyaŋ ba. Binshɛli din guli ba vuuya ka chɛ ba; ka Yawɛ mi be ti sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: Only dont rebel against the LORD and dont be afraid of the people of the land. They are our prey. Their defense has deserted them, but the LORD is with us. So dont be afraid of them.

dag: Yawɛ wurindi karimbaandan yili, amaa ka guli pakoli tiŋgbani tarisi.
en: The Lord will destroy the homes of arrogant men, but he will protect a widow's property.

dag: Amaa Amnɔn daa mal o zo so ka o yuli booni Jɔnadab, o daa nyɛla Dauda mabia Shamma dapala, ka daa mali yɛm pam.
en: Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, who was the son of David's brother Shimeah. Jonadab always knew how to get what he wanted.

dag: Masia ŋun nyɛ ti nyɛvili la yi ti yi palo, yi gba ni yi palo m-pah o zuɣu nya jilima.
en: When Christ, who is your life, is revealed, then you also will be revealed with him in glory.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mariama daa yiɣisi chaŋ yomyom ti paai zoya ni tin shɛli din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Mary got up and went quickly to a town in the hill country of Judea.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ o yurilim maŋli min o ni tumdi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa tiri daadamnim la zuɣu.
en: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ya dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa sunsuuni n-zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: Do this because you are the Lord s own people. From all the people on earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his special people—people who belong only to him.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛli naa maa, Ashili shɛli nyin naa ni bɔri ni a baŋ maa, baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni timanim ni laasabuniŋdiba ku tooi wuh a di gbinni.
en: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, not even the smartest person in all the world can do what you are demanding.

dag: Dindali maa mi yi ti ku bɔhi binshɛli yɛla n sani. Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: In that day you will not have to ask me about anything. And I assure you, my Father will give you anything you ask him for in my name.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Yi ni yino yɛliya, M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia, ka ŋun la mi yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ maa, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia. .
en: Then King Solomon said, Each of you says that the living baby is your own and that the dead baby belongs to the other woman.

dag: Ka amiliya aŋgo maa daa ti yuui kandina, ka gom gbahi bɛ zaa ka bɛ gbihi.
en: The bridegroom was late in coming, so they began to nod and fall asleep.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina ti teei zani bɛ tiŋ maa tooni, ka na shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba maa mi ʒe mɔɣu ni palo ni bɛ ko.
en: The Ammonites marched out and took up their position at the entrance to Rabbah, their capital city, and the kings who had come to help took up their position in the open countryside.

dag: Di saha ka kpambaliba daa yɛli naa, Doo ŋɔ simdila kubu, o ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-chɔɣisiri tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim tiŋ ŋɔ ni mini niriba zaa kɔba ni maa zuɣu. Dama doo ŋɔ bi bɔri niriba maa zaɣ viɛlli, bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu ka o naɣ bɔra.
en: Then the officials said to the king: This man must be put to death! By saying such things, he is discouraging the few remaining troops left in the city, as well as all the people. This man doesnt seek their welfare but their ruin.

dag: Ti ni nyuri bara binshɛli zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ: Ti suhuri ni tɛha diri ti shɛhira ni ti biɛhigu doli biɛrikasitali mini wuntia soli dunia ŋɔ ni, di bahi bamdi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani, ka di pala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu.
en: We are proud that our conscience assures us that our lives in this world, and especially our relations with you, have been ruled by God-given frankness and sincerity, by the power of God's grace and not by human wisdom.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam nimaani, ka biɛrim mali ba kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: Fear grabbed them; they trembled like a woman giving birth.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pahi;.
en: When Pilate heard this, he was more afraid.

dag: Ka saamba di yi buni, ka yi tuma nyɔri kuli tinzun nir yiŋa;.
en: Yes, strangers will take all your wealth, and what you have worked for will belong to someone else.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Jesus strictly warned his disciples not to tell anyone about this.

dag: N yɛn gbib biɛrim n suhu ni ti paala bɔ saha? N yɛn malila suhugarigu dabisi muni puuni zaa? N dimnim kul yɛn nyandi ma ka di yuusim paala bɔ saha?.
en: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?.

dag: Yawɛ, saha yuusim wula ka a yɛn tam n yɛla? A ni tam n yɛla sahakam? A yɛn ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma ka di yuusim paai bɔ saha?.
en: How much longer will you forget me, Lord ? Forever? How much longer will you hide yourself from me?.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi daa firi bayaɣiti ni n-kɔŋ chandi. Di saha ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo ka chɛ Izraɛlnim maa, dama Yawɛ tuhirila Ijiptinim pahiri bɛ zuɣu.
en: Their chariot wheels got stuck, and it was hard for them to move. So the Egyptians said to one another, Let's leave these people alone! The Lord is on their side and is fighting against us.

dag: Niŋmiya siɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinitaba polo, ka miriya ka yi niŋ yi mabia kam naani, dama mabihi zaa nyɛla yɔhindiba, ka ʒiʒiinikpee kam nyɛ ŋun chani saɣindi niriba yuya.
en: Everyone must be on guard against their friends, and no one can trust their relatives; for all relatives are as deceitful as Jacob, and everyone slanders their friends.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di dabisa maa puuni ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini.
en: Can any of you live a bit longer by worrying about it?.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti liri tiŋgbɔn shɛli nim bɛn bi me goma gili bɛ tiŋkpansi ŋɔ. N ni chaŋ ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim ni suhudoo, ka bɛ zaa so bi me goma gili bɛ tinsi, ka mi ka dunokparita bee dunoyɔriti ŋɔ.
en: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, bɛ nyɛla bɛn chani kpɛri yiya ni n-saɣindi bɛ dahima; ka di pala di kɔŋko, bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn leei niriba nyaanzuriba mini bɛn dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-yɛri din bi simdi ni bɛ yɛli.
en: Also, they learn to be lazy by going from house to house. They are not only lazy, but they also become gossips and busybodies, talking about things they shouldnt.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa nya Ilaija, o daa bɔh o mi, Nyin ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnim maa m-bala.
en: When Ahab saw him, he said, So there you are—the worst troublemaker in Israel.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o zo n-chaŋ tampima zo shɛli din daa be Maɔn yɔɣu ni la zuɣu. Ka Sool daa wum lala ka kari Dauda naba Maɔn yɔɣu maa ni.
en: When Saul and his troops went looking for him, David was told about it, so he went down to a certain rock there and stayed in the Maon wilderness. When Saul heard that, he went into the Maon wilderness after David.

dag: N daa chɛ a Kriit ni a niŋla binshɛŋa din simdi niŋbu la, ka pii cheechi toondaannima n-zali tiŋ kam ni kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm la.
en: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you.

dag: Chɛ ka o sandan fa o ni mali shɛlikam zaa; ka saamba ʒe o ni tum tuma nya binshɛlikam zaa.
en: Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Let strangers get everything he worked for.

dag: ka zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu neen shɛŋa din nyɛ buɣim moori binyara mini gbabɔnima ni soobuya ni taha ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma zaa pa di zuɣu, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili kul paari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ŋun Naawuni noli.
en: Because of such things God's anger will come upon those who do not obey him.

dag: Di saha goli ti ku piɛla, ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti di nam ʒini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ti kahig o jilima wuh o niriba toondaannima.
en: The moon will grow dark, and the sun will no longer shine, for the Lord Almighty will be king. He will rule in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and the leaders of the people will see his glory.

dag: O mɔŋ ma suhudoo; man tamla suhupiɛlli yɛla.
en: I thought I would never have peace again. I forgot about good things.

dag: bɛ daa malila pin shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ti Yisifu la zali gu o kundina saha wuntaŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa wumya ni bɛ min o n-yɛn laɣim di.
en: They got their gifts ready to present to Joseph when he arrived at noon, because they had been told that they were to eat with him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ o ti ti, ka ti ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa.
en: But the Lord our God gave him to us. We defeated King Sihon, his sons, and all his people.

dag: ŋun woligim omaŋ ka chɛ wain mini binnyuri kpɛma, ka di nyu bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi komihigu mali shɛli bee binnyuri kpeen shɛli, o mi di nyu wain tiwala kom bee n-di di zaɣ maha bee di zaɣ kuma.
en: that person must refrain from wine and brandy. He or she may not drink wine vinegar or brandy vinegar, nor drink any grape juice or eat grapes, whether fresh or dried.

dag: Zɔfa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sua mini Harinɛfa ni Shual ni Bɛri ni Imira.
en: Zophahs sons were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah.

dag: Di saha maa ka nyuli daa gbaai Yawɛ o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu, ka o zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yɛli zali, ka di ti niŋ. Tinzun wun so na ʒi n-niŋ lala. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: I am the one who spoke to you, saved you, and told you those things. It was not some stranger who was with you. You are my witnesses, and I am God.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni mali maligumaaniba shɛba ka bɛ be kasi, ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya bɛn doli n zaligu la dini. Bɛna n-daa bi birigi kaman Lɛvinim ni daa niŋ shɛm saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la.
en: This land is for Zadoks descendants. These men were chosen to be my holy priests, because they continued to serve me when the other people of Israel left me. Zadoks family did not leave me like the other people from the tribe of Levi.

dag: Ka bɛ ti lo tɔbu n-tuhi Piɛbil la, amaa ka Piɛbil maa ni ti nyaŋ ba, dama o nyɛla duumanim zaa Duuma ni nanim zaa Naa, ka bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb o ni boli min o ni pii ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe o yim.
en: They will make war on the Lamb, but the Lamb will emerge victorious, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings. Those with him are called, chosen, and faithful.

dag: ka bɛn kpalim mi gbahi naa maa yiŋbihi maa n-dihi ba vi, ka ku ba.
en: while others grabbed the servants, beat them, and killed them.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yihiri waazu yɛri niriba ni bɛ niŋmi tuuba.
