en: The apostles left and went to other places. They talked to the people and told them to change their hearts and lives.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mini niriba bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa daa chaŋ jɛmbu shee din daa be Gibiɔn la, dama Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa mali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣ shɛli tiŋgban nɛl ni la daa bela nimaani.
en: Then Solomon, accompanied by the whole assembly, went to the shrine at Gibeon because that is where Gods meeting tent was, the tent that the LORDs servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

dag: M bia, wumma, niŋmi yɛm, ka niŋ tɛha niŋ a suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a biɛhigu polo.
en: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab mini Abishai bɛn daa kari doli Abinɛr, zaŋ chaŋ wuntan luhili saha ka bɛ daa paai Amma Zoli din be Gia polo Gibiɔn mɔɣu ni soli zuɣu la gbini.
en: But Joab and Abishai went after Abner. Finally, about sunset, they came to the hill of Ammah, not far from Giah on the road to Gibeon Desert.

dag: din nyɛ o ni daa po pɔ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma polo la yɛla.
en: With a solemn oath to our ancestor Abraham he promised to rescue us from our enemies and allow us to serve him without fear.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ cheechi sɔŋdiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ mali biɛrisuŋ, ka di yɛri naŋgbanvoya ayiyi, ka di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyuri dam kuuna bee bɛn suhuri ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: In the same way, the men who are chosen to be special servants must have the respect of others. They must not be men who say things they dont mean or who spend their time drinking too much. They must not be men who will do almost anything for money.

dag: N ni zaŋ Ijiptinim niŋ na biɛɣu ŋun mali putɔɣu nuu ni ka o su ba. Man yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will hand Egypt over to a harsh master; a strong king will rule them, says the LORD God of heavenly forces.

dag: Zaŋm Lɛvi zuliya na nti zali Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la tooni, ka bɛ sɔŋd o.
en: Bring all the men from the tribe of Levi. Bring them to Aaron the priest. These men will be his helpers.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti a biɛli Adɔnija ka o n-niŋ o paɣa.
en: Allow your brother Adonijah to marry Abishag, she answered.

dag: So beni n-ni tooi ŋme ma naŋgbankpeeni? Dindina n ni fo n noli, ka kpi.
en: If anyone can prove I am wrong, I will shut up and wait to die.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N ku chaŋ; n ni labi n dɔɣiriba sani ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Hobab said to him, I wont go; Id rather go to my land and to my folk.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi tɔŋ pam yi bihi dɔɣibu ni mini yi biŋkɔbiri dɔɣibu ni ni yi puri atam ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ jɛlinsi lu a zuɣu n-fa a ni tum tuma nya binshɛŋa la zaa, ka chɛ a zaɣ nɛli. Ka a pagɔrisigu tuma la yi palo. A kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuma maa.
en: They will cruelly take away everything you have worked for and strip you naked. Then everyone will see you for the prostitute you really are. Your own vulgar sins.

dag: Amaa binneembihi bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali naba anahi chana, ka lan tom mali gbaya pahi m-mal li tɔri tiŋ yiɣira.
en: except those that hop.

dag: Kalim Gɛrishɔn gba zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Take a census of the Gershonites also, by their households and their clans.

dag: Nuhu yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbisiyɔbu saha shɛli kom ni daa di dunia maa.
en: Noah was years old at the time the rains came.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa bi lan yi o ya kana, dama Babilɔn naa daa deeg o ni su tiŋgban shɛli zaa din zaŋ Ijipti kulibɔŋ shee hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: The Egyptian king never left his country again because the Babylonian king had taken over all the territory that had previously belonged to him—from the border of Egypt to the Euphrates River.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm. Salima machɛlinim zaa ni di vi bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu; dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binnana ka bi vuhira.
en: But people are so stupid. They dont understand what God has done. Skilled workers make statues of false gods. Those statues are only false gods. They show how foolish those workers are. Those statues are not alive.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisibutali pun be di tuma tumbu ni, amaa din yɛn niŋ maa na ku niŋ faashee Naawuni ti vuui ŋun taɣi di niŋbu zali maa.
en: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ti Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ so ka o fa ba Sirianim maa nuu ni bahi; ka Izraɛlnim daa lan ʒi bɛ yinsi ni suhudoo kaman bɛ ni daa pun ʒiya shɛm.
en: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu yi zuɣu, ka bɛ be yi sani n-gbahi yi bihi mini yi niɣi n-chɛ ka yi kalinli filim, ka yi soya bili mɔri.
en: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.

dag: Gbib a yɛda niŋbu min a suhu ni tɛha ka di ku mali galimi. Ninvuɣ shɛb ni bi doli suhu ni tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ yɛda niŋbu saɣim.
en: Continue to trust in God and do what you know is right. Some people have not done this, and their faith is now in ruins.

dag: To, ninvuɣ so yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi chani gindi yɛra, N ni yihi ya waazu din wuhiri ni wain mini binnyuri kpɛma pam nyubu viɛla, ŋuna ka yi ni bɔri ni o nyɛ yi waazuyihira.
en: These people dont want to listen to me. But if a man comes telling lies, they will accept him. They would accept a false prophet if he comes and says, There will be good times in the future, with plenty of wine and beer.

dag: Bɛ yi yiɣiri luri zoya zuɣu, di vurimi kaman chɛchɛbunsi vubu la; ka lan vuri kaman buɣim n-diri mokuma ka di tahiri la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila tɔbbi gbaliŋ n-teei zani ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb la.
en: like the rumbling of chariots. They leap on the mountaintops— like the crackling of a fires flame, devouring the stubble; like a powerful army ready for battle.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, vi mali ma pam ni n kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa a tooni. Dama n Naawuni, ti daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi ti zuɣuri zuɣu; ka ti taali du hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: and said, My God, Im too ashamed to lift up my face to you. Our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has grown to the heavens.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni, niŋm ti nirilim ka chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ. Iin, chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ!.
en: Let the kindness of the Lord our God be over us. Make the work of our hands last. Make the work of our hands last!.

dag: Ka Jɔsifia bia Shɛlomit daa nyɛ Bani daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbiga ni pihiyɔbu daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Bani: Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and other men;.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka o kpaŋ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Sɔhila kurugu yini saha ka o niŋgbun biisim maa sa bah o.
en: He asked them what time it was when his son got better, and they answered, It was one o'clock yesterday afternoon when the fever left him.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi a ni na ka nyɛ ŋun lo Yawɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka wuhiri yikombiɛlim.
en: From you goes out one who plots evil against the LORD— a worthless counselor!.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ tin ya n-yɛli ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma laɣim be.
en: I wrote to you in my earlier letter not to associate with sexually immoral people.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa dɔɣi Kɛnan maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pinaanu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Kenans birth, Enosh lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di nyɛla m mini yi pinaayi ŋɔ ni yino ŋun laɣim mali bɔrɔbɔro suɣiri ʒiɛri la yin ni ŋɔ.
en: Jesus answered, It is one of you twelve—the one who is dipping his bread in the same bowl with me.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zɛfania daa karim gbaŋ maa ka anabi Jɛrimia wum.
en: Zephaniah read the letter to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa di ka nyu dindali maa ni suhupiɛlli pam Yawɛ tooni. Ka bɛ daa lan booi kpam bahi Dauda bia Sulemaana zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei naa ti Yawɛ m-pahi buyi, ka zaŋ Zadok leei maligumaana.
en: They ate and drank with great joy before the LORD that day and made Davids son Solomon the king. They anointed him in the LORDs presence as prince, and Zadok as priest.

dag: ni kikahi kumsi ni kukoli yɛtɔɣa vubu din mali dabiɛm hal ka bɛn daa wum li suhi Naawuni ni o di lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yaha la.
en: a blast of a trumpet, and a sound of words that made the ones who heard it beg that there wouldnt be one more word.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa deei bia maa buɣi, ka paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: But the Lord made Pharaoh stubborn, so he refused to listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku deei pin shɛli a sani. Ka Naaman daa balim o ni o deem li, amaa ka o zaɣisi.
en: I am a servant of the living Lord , Elisha answered, and I swear that I will not take anything from you. Naaman kept begging, but Elisha kept refusing.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛla teebu mali alibarika. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun yuli ni kpi.
en: Good people leave memories that bless us, but the wicked are soon forgotten.

dag: Dinzuɣu Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: So the Son of Man is Lord of every day, even the Sabbath.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi taba yɛla ni kaman di ni be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni shɛm.
en: And look out for one another's interests, not just for your own.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni Naawuni yɛligu kɔŋla palibu, dama pa bɛn zaa yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Izraɛl yaan maŋa.
en: I am not saying that the promise of God has failed; for not all the people of Israel are the people of God.

dag: Sool ni daa kul yɛri maligumaana maa lala saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa zɔbu yiriŋ mini bɛ vuri maa daa kul maan pahira; ka Sool daa yɛli maligumaana maa, Chɛl li.
en: As Saul was talking to the priest, the confusion in the Philistine camp continued to grow. Saul said to the priest, Withdraw your hand.

dag: Yawɛ, so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A galisiya, ka a yuli tibisa, ka mali yiko.
en: LORD, no one is like you! You are great, and great is your mighty name.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo pam laɣim gil o maa ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ baami n-du duli ha.
en: When Jesus saw the crowd, he went across Lake Galilee.

dag: ka bɔhi Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa, Ka ŋuni n-lee be kpe ha palo ni n-chani tuhiri ti soli ŋɔ na? Ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N dana m-bala. Ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ sariga pa n-lims o ninni.
en: and said to the servant, Who is this man walking through the pasture to meet us? The servant said, Hes my master. So she took her headscarf and covered herself.

dag: Ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, pa lala n-nyɛ li. So n-yi di neei kum ni chaŋ bɛ sani nti yɛli ba, bɛ naan niŋ tuuba.
en: The rich man said, No, father Abraham! But if someone came to them from the dead, then they would decide to change their lives.

dag: So ku lan be nimaani saha shɛlikam yaha. Laribunim ku lan ti bɛ suɣa zali nimaani. Piɛguliba mi ku lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛri dɔni nimaani.
en: No one will ever resettle or live there for generations. No Arab will camp there; no shepherds will rest flocks there.

dag: Yisifu ni daa ti kuna, ka bɛ zaŋ pin shɛli din be bɛ sani maa kpɛhi ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: When Joseph came home, the brothers gave him the gifts they had brought with them. Then they bowed down to the ground in front of him.

dag: Dama ti yi di bi kpalim ʒiya, ŋ-ŋɔ ti di pun chaŋ pahi buyi ka labina.
en: If we hadnt waited so long, we wouldve returned twice by now.

dag: O paɣ ŋun yuli daa booni Hɔdɛsh la daa dɔɣi bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Jɔbab mini Zibia ni Mɛsha ni Malikam.
en: He had children with his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa piligi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la. Amaa bɛ daa na bi sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa tampuɣili.
en: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to present entirely burned offerings to the LORD. However, the foundation of the LORDs temple had not yet been laid.

dag: Bɛ kabi kana kaman tɔbbihi n-doli gooni voli ni kpɛna la; binshɛɣukam ni daa luri saha shɛl la, ka bɛ daa kul kabirina.
en: and leaving me crushed.

dag: Ka Anabi Musa daa bɔhim Ijiptinim maa baŋsim n-leei ninvuɣ titali o yɛtɔɣa min o tuma ni.
en: The Egyptians taught Moses everything they knew. He was powerful in all he said and did.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Shuham zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: All the Shuhamite clans according to their enrollment were .

dag: Amaa di ku yuui ka yɛla ayi ŋɔ zaa paag a dahin yini puuni. A baɣibuɣibo min a tima la zaa yoli, a ni bahi kɔŋ yidana mini bihi.
en: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛ daa dɔɣ a la alahichi puuni, ka nyin ti lee nyɛ ŋun wuhiri ti? Ka bɛ daa kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: The leaders told the man, You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything? Then they said, You can never come back into any of our synagogues.

dag: Ka du shɛli din dunoli kpa nuzaa polo ŋɔ nyɛ maligumaana ŋun su sara maligu bimbini fukumsi duu. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yi Zadok zuliya ni na. Bɛ kɔŋko m-mali soli Lɛvi zuliya niriba sunsuuni ni bɛ miri Yawɛ sani nti tum o tuma.
en: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord 's priests.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n kamina ni n ti yɛli nyini n dan naa dimbɔŋɔ, dama niriba maa chɛmi ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam ka n tɛhi ni n yi yɛli nyin naa, di pa shɛli a ni niŋ man ŋun nyɛ o dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni bɔr shɛm maa.
en: Now, Your Majesty, the reason I have come to speak to you is that the people threatened me, and so I said to myself that I would speak to you in the hope that you would do what I ask.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai o daa chaŋla Kapɛrinium.
en: After Jesus finished presenting all his words among the people, he entered Capernaum.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia, Asiria na tital la ni bɔhir a shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: The Assyrian official told them that the emperor wanted to know what made King Hezekiah so confident.

dag: Ti ni yuri ya la zuɣu ka ti daa lo ni ti pirigi ti ni mali shɛli tin ya, ka di pala Naawuni lahibal suŋ la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili timaŋmaŋ nyɛviya gba, ka di nyɛla ti ni kul yuri ya pam la zuɣu.
en: We were glad to share not only Gods good news with you but also our very lives because we cared for you so much.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ; dinzuɣu ka o daa guni Timoti, Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni la zuɣu, dama bɛ zaa daa mi ni Timoti ba nyɛla Giriiki doo.
en: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.

dag: O min o biɛyanim maa ni daa na mali alizama saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim tiyaawumya ŋun yuli booni Goliat ka o nyɛ Gaat nir la daa yi Filistianim maa sanna nti lan yɛr o ni daa pun yɛri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la. Ka Dauda daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: While David was talking with his brothers, the Philistine champion fighter came out from the Philistine army. This was Goliath, the Philistine from Gath. Goliath shouted things against Israel as usual. David heard what he said.

dag: Bɛn daa gbahi ti maa daa yɛli ti mi ni ti yilim yila, ka bɛn daa nahindi ti maa daa yɛli ti ni ti yilimi yila ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim, ka yɛra, Yilimiya Ziɔn yilli ka ti wum.
en: because thats where our captors asked us to sing; our tormentors requested songs of joy: Sing us a song about Zion! they said.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa daa shiri chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa su, ka a daa chɛ ka bɛ su Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim la, ka daa zaŋ bɛ nanim mini bɛ niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ni bɛ niŋ ba bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: Their children took the land. They defeated the Canaanites living there. You let them defeat those people. You let them do whatever they wanted to those nations, people, and kings.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ninsal kpi n-do mɔɣu ni ka yi bi mi ŋun ku o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ka yi su li maa ni.
en: In the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you might find a dead body in a field, but no one knows who killed that person.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Lɛvinim mini bɛ daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔnnima; ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba nyɛ Kɔhatinima; ka Mɛrari daŋ niriba nyɛ Mɛrarinima.
en: These are the ones enrolled as Levites according to their clans: from Gershon, the Gershonite clan; from Kohath, the Kohathite clan; from Merari, the Merarite clan.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyuri wain pam zuɣu bee n-zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye nimdi ŋubbu zuɣu;.
en: Dont hang out with those who get drunk on wine or those who eat too much meat.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni ha nti nya Alifius bia Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma! Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: He was walking beside the lake, and he saw a man named Levi, son of Alphaeus. Levi was sitting at his place for collecting taxes. Jesus said to him, Follow me. Then Levi stood up and followed Jesus.

dag: Ka Mikal daa zaŋ biŋŋmahindili na ti sɔŋ garo zuɣu n-zaŋ bukɔbiri difiɛli sɔŋ zaŋ di zuɣu kuɣ li, ka zaŋ chinchini pil li.
en: Michal put a statue in his bed. She put goat hair on its head and dressed it in some of David's clothes.

dag: Ka o yi ti lan kana zaawuni ni o ti nyo firilanim maa, di simdi ka o lan tuɣili tulaale zim maa, ka di nyɛ tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni yɛn tuɣindi sahakam Yawɛ tooni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: And again when Aaron lights the lamps at twilight, he will burn incense. It should be a regular incense offering in the LORDs presence in every generation.

dag: yi ni sɔŋ ma lahibal suŋ la tuma ni di piligu dali hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ shɛm la zuɣu.
en: because of the way in which you have helped me in the work of the gospel from the very first day until now.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum din bahiri niriba yoli mini buɣim din dira ni alɔbo din ni chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaŋ bɛ nyina liri ba lu bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ tinvura lɔɣu lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: They will become thin from hunger. Terrible diseases will destroy them. I will send wild animals against them. Poisonous snakes and lizards will bite them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ku lan kum. Yi Duuma nyɛla nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi kum niŋ o, o ni wum ka garigi ya.
en: You people who live in Jerusalem on Mount Zion will not continue crying. The Lord will hear your crying, and he will comfort you. When he hears you, he will help you.

dag: Di ni daa tiɣ o nini ni o kahig o Bia wuhi ma ka di chɛ ka n yih o yɛla waazu ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, n daa bi niŋ so saawara.
en: to reveal his Son to me, so that I might preach the Good News about him to the Gentiles, I did not go to anyone for advice.

dag: Di saha ka Stiivin daa yɛli, Nyamiya, n nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Daadam Bia la ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: He exclaimed, Look! I can see heaven on display and the Human One standing at Gods right side.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa beni Jɔshua bia Joyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔzadak yaaŋa la saha mini Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la mini Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni zaligubaŋda la gba saha.
en: These people lived during the time of Joiakim, the son of Joshua and grandson of Jehozadak, and the time of Nehemiah the governor, and the time of Ezra, the priest who was a scholar of the Law.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla din chɛ ka nir lara, amaa suhugarigu nyɛla din chɛ ka nandahima mali nira.
en: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Labimi mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din miri Damaskus la. A yi paai nimaani, nyin boom kpam bahi Hazaɛl zuɣu ni ka o leei Siria naa;.
en: The LORD said to him, Go back through the desert to Damascus and anoint Hazael as king of Aram.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Paɣa, niŋm ma yɛda ni saha kanna ka yi ti ku lan jɛm ti Ba Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu bee Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jesus said, Believe me, woman! The time is coming when you will not have to be in Jerusalem or on this mountain to worship the Father.

dag: dama niriba pam suhuri ni tɛha ni ti yi palo o zuɣu. Ka suhusaɣiŋgu ti ŋma amaŋmaŋ gba suhu kaman takɔb la.
en: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Ka m mi lee nyɛla ŋuni ka n Duuma ma ti kani n sanna?.
en: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni bɛ tummi din viɛla, ka nyɛ bundaannim tuun suma tumbu ni; ka lan nyɛ bɛn tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli, ka yu ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli n-sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: Tell them to do good, to be rich in the good things they do, to be generous, and to share with others.

dag: Ka o zuɣuri la ni yini daa mali dan titali din ŋmani din yɛn ku o; amaa ka daa lee lan naai, ka di daa niŋ dunianim zaa alahiziba ka bɛ kab dol o.
en: One of the heads of the beast looked as if it had been wounded and killed, but the death wound was healed. All the people in the world were amazed, and they all followed the beast.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn din nyɛ nir ni daa yi ku o kpee ka zo n-kuli tin shɛli n-tiligiri la mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daŋ niriba. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Libina.
en: So they gave the city of Hebron to Aarons descendants. They also gave Aarons descendants the towns of Libnah.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi tinzun buɣa maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka Izraɛlnim nandahima yɛlli maa daa muɣis o pam.
en: Then the Israelites got rid of the idols of the foreign gods, and they began worshiping only the Lord . Finally, there came a time when the Lord could no longer stand to see them suffer.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ n dɔɣiriba, yi nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yinim ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa n-zaŋ man naa labisi.
en: He is your brother, your own relative! Why haven't you done anything to bring him back.

dag: Bi shɛb bɛn doli zaligu nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm. Amaa bi shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi pulaannim zuɣu nyɛla bɛn dihiri bɛ banim mini bɛ manim vi.
en: Intelligent children follow Instruction, but those who befriend gluttons shame their parents.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni bɛ ti boli Yisa na.
en: Then Jesus' mother and brothers arrived. They stood outside the house and sent in a message, asking for him.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be, ka nyɛ n ni ʒe so tooni ŋɔ zuɣu, n shiri ni zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi Ɛhab zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Elijah said, As surely as the LORD of heavenly forces lives, the one I serve, I will appear before Ahab today.

dag: Kpiimba bi paɣiri Yawɛ, ka bɛn chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba bi paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: The dead dont praise the LORD, nor do those who go down to silence.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Yɛhudianim kpamba la zuɣu ka so daa bi saɣi tɔɣis o yɛla palɔni.
en: No one spoke about him publicly, though, for fear of the Jewish authorities.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti di daa, ka bɛ saɣi ni o yom ba tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri; ka o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ o puu maa ni.
en: He agreed to pay them the regular wage, a silver coin a day, and sent them to work in his vineyard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bulahi bɛn nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri maa ka naa mini zama maa sanna, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Finally they took the goats to the king and to the other worshipers, who laid their hands on them.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa su fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa daa bela nudirigu polo ha zaŋ kpa Ɛdom tintariga polo. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ Kabiziil mini Ɛda ni Jagur.
en: The cities farthest south that belonged to them, those that were near the border of Edom, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur.

dag: Yihim yɛlimuɣisira n suhu ni, ka yihi ma n nandahima ni.
en: Relieve me of my worries and save me from all my troubles.

dag: Ka yi ni gahi yi bimbɔba dahin shɛli maa, zaŋmiya piɛlaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dindali.
en: On the day when you present the sheaf, you will offer a one-year-old male lamb. There must be nothing wrong with that lamb. That lamb will be a burnt offering to the Lord .

dag: Zakaria min o maligumaanitab daa yi tumdila maligumaanitali tuma deeri taba.
en: Zechariah was serving as a priest before God for his group. It was his groups time to serve.

dag: Amaa ka Nabɔt yɛli Ɛhab, Yawɛ di wuhi gba, ka n zaŋ n yaannim fali ti a.
en: Naboth answered, This vineyard has always been in my family. I won't let you have it.

dag: Ka a ti daŋ n tooni chaŋ Giligal, nyama, n ni ka nimaani na ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligunima. Di simdi ka a ti guhi ma nimaani daba ayopɔin hal ka n ti kana ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Then go down to Gilgal ahead of me. Ill come down to meet you to offer entirely burned offerings and to make well-being sacrifices. Wait seven days until I get to you, then Ill tell you what you should do next.

dag: Miriya ka yi ta yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa daɣiri. N gba bela di ni, dama man Yawɛ bela Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
en: Do not defile the land where you are living, because I am the Lord and I live among the people of Israel.

dag: Ka sagbana mini sakuɣa ni sala buɣim daa puhi yi neesim din be o tooni maa ni na.
en: Gods clouds went ahead of the brightness before him; hail and coals of fire went too.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yinima n-di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yinim pii ni yi ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋɔ. Ka bɛ yɛli, Tinima n-di timaŋ shɛhira maa.
en: Joshua said, You have heard yourselves say that you will worship and obey the Lord . Isn't that true? Yes, it's true, they answered.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, n suhir a, a nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin be ti sani ti chandi maa ni, hal ti ni kul nyɛ tipawumlinim maa zaa yoli, chɛl ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi maa taali, ka zaŋ ti leeg a niriba.
en: He said, Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I ask you to go with us. These people are stubborn, but forgive our evil and our sin, and accept us as your own people.

dag: Ka naa maa mini ba zaa daa ti di alizama, ka o nya ka Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla n-kpe o nyaɣisim gari bɛ tab la zaa. Ka bɛ daa leei bɛn ʒiini naa tooni nayili.
en: The king talked with them all, and Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah impressed him more than any of the others. So they became members of the king's court.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa mini anabinim maa, Doo ŋɔ bi simdi ni ti ku o, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ka o zaŋ tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.

dag: m-pah o ni daa deeri salima shɛli daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nanim zaa ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gomnanim san la zuɣu.
en: not including income from the traders, the merchants and their profits, all the Arabian kings, and the officials of the land.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai, ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o n-zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: After they finished making fun of him, the soldiers took off the robe and put his own clothes on him again. Then they led him away to be killed on a cross.

dag: A biɛhigu ni ti ne kaman wuntaŋ ni la, ka di zibisim ti ne kaman asiba neesim la.
en: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.

dag: Ka n yi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, ka tooi baŋdi yɛlisɔɣira, ka mali baŋsim zaa, hal n yi mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka n tooi vuui zoya di dooshɛhi, ka ka yurilim, dindina m pala shɛli.
en: I may have the gift of prophecy, I may understand all secrets and know everything there is to know, and I may have faith so great that I can move mountains. But even with all this, if I dont have love, I am nothing.

dag: O zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti o niriba n-wuhi ba o yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He has shown his people how powerful he is by giving them the land of other nations.

dag: Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛbat bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha ka Abijam daa leei Juda naa.
en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of King Jeroboam of Israel, Abijah became king of Judah.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yum ayi saha ka o daa ti zahim zahindi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔŋ gom.
en: In the second year that Nebuchadnezzar was king, he had a dream. It worried him so much that he couldn't sleep.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa ye nam kpariti din nyɛ zaɣ sabilifaa, ka piɛlipiɛla ni kpar shɛli din nyɛ tangari, ka pili salima zuɣupil titali n-yi nayili kuna. Ka niriba daa kab doli Susa tiŋ puuni solɔri yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Mordecai went out from the kings presence in a blue and white royal robe wearing a large gold crown and a white and red-purple coat. The city of Susa greeted him with shouts of joy.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni: Di saha maa alizanda nam ni ti ŋmanila paɣipiɛlisi pia bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ firilanim chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi amiliya aŋgo soli.
en: At that time the Kingdom of heaven will be like this. Once there were ten young women who took their oil lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

dag: N ni yih a a tuma ni, ka yih a a zaashee maa. .
en: I will force you out of your position here. Your new leader will take you away from your important job.

dag: A yɛliya, N lo n ni pii ninvuɣ so alikauli, n daa poya yɛli n dabili Dauda;.
en: You said, I have made a covenant with the man I chose; I have promised my servant David.

dag: Bɛ ni pam daa yɛlimi, Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu! O kpɛla yinyari! Bɔzuɣu ka yi wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Many of them said, He has a demon and has lost his mind. Why listen to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim daa chaŋ ti chɛ ka Sulemaana ba Naa Dauda buntaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: So Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and the royal bodyguards put Solomon on King David's mule and escorted him to Gihon Spring.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda nimaani.
en: And many people there believed in him.

dag: Ka o bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛnkam zaa tɔhi liɣiri maa;.
en: Jesus told his disciples to gather around him. Then he said: I tell you that this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

dag: Amaa yum yi na be o niŋgbuŋ ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: But from the moment an open sore appears, you are unclean.

dag: Satahins ayopɔin maa ni daa tahi saha shɛli maa ka n niŋ shili ni n sabi, amaa ka daa wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛra, Gbib satahins ayopɔin maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ashilɔni, ka di sab li sɔŋ.
en: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, Keep it secret! Don't write these things.

dag: Zabili daa be Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni yuui pam, ka Dauda yaa daa kul pahira, ka Naa Sool niriba maa mi yaa daa kul gbarigiri pahira.
en: The war between Sauls house and Davids house was long and drawn out. David kept getting stronger, while Sauls house kept getting weaker.

dag: ka o baŋ ni o Ba pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni, ka lan mi ni o daa yila Naawuni sanna ka ni lan lab o sani.
en: The Father had given Jesus power over everything. Jesus knew this. He also knew that he had come from God. And he knew that he was going back to God.

dag: O wahala dibu nyaaŋa, o ni ti nya o tuma nyɔri ka o nini tiɣi li. N dabili ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra maa baŋsim zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni. O ni deei bɛ daalahichi ʒi.
en: After his deep anguish he will see light, and he will be satisfied. Through his knowledge, the righteous one, my servant, will make many righteous, and will bear their guilt.

dag: Di nyuriya dam kuuna, dama di nyubu puuni ka ninvuɣ yotali yirina, amaa lee chɛliya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pali yi suhuri ni.
en: Dont get drunk on wine, which produces depravity. Instead, be filled with the Spirit in the following ways.

dag: O bom ŋman ʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋman bih ayi na nti ti maligumaana Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni daba anii dali.
en: On the eighth day the person will bring two turtledoves or two young doves to the priest at the entrance of the meeting tent.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: The ax is already at the root of the trees. Therefore, every tree that doesnt produce good fruit will be chopped down and tossed into the fire.

dag: ka ti nyaandolitab bɛn be Rom daa wum ti damli ka kana hal ti paai luɣ shɛŋa din daa booni Apius Daa mini Yilikpɛra Ata la shee ni bɛ tuhi ti soli. Pool ni daa nya ba, ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o paɣiri Naawuni.
en: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka ka galimi bɛ biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: Those whose way is blameless— who walk in the LORDs Instruction—are truly happy!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma laara n wuntitali mini m biɛrisuntali zaŋ chaŋ o sani zuɣu.
en: And so the LORD restored me for my righteousness, because I am clean in his eyes.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu firilanim din pie tab la ni di nɛma zaa ni firila kpam.
en: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;.

dag: Ka n daa da puu din be Anatɔt maa m mabia Hanamɛl sani, ka daa kali liɣiri maa ti o. Di daa nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaayopɔin.
en: So I bought the field in Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel, and weighed out for him seventeen shekels of silver.

dag: So miri ka o laɣim paɣ min o bipuɣiŋga dɔni, ka miri ka o bo o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga, bɛ nyɛla paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ o dɔɣiriba ni yɛlimaŋli. Lala nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: You must not have sexual relations with a mother and her daughter or her granddaughter. It doesnt matter if this granddaughter is the daughter of this womans son or daughter. Her granddaughters are her close relatives. It is wrong to do this.

dag: Ʒiri sanianim mini ʒiri binzahindisi zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: False weights and measures— the LORD detests them both.

dag: N ʒiɛyimtali mini n yurilim maŋli kul ni be o ni; ka o ni di nasara n yuli zuɣu.
en: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, A tiŋgbani ku vuhira, ka maligim mi ku lur a tiŋgban ni.
en: Then Isaac said to him, No dew from heaven for you, No fertile fields for you.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kari doli ma kaman yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni maa? N niŋgbuŋ ni be shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko bi saɣi lala yi sani?.
en: Why must you persecute me the way God does? Haven't you tormented me enough?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ bindirigu din mali nyɛvili n-yi alizanda ni na maa. Ka ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; bindiri shɛli mi n ni yɛn zaŋ ti dunianima ka bɛ nya nyɛvili di zuɣu maa nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ.
en: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my body. I will give my body so that the people in the world can have life.

dag: A niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri kaman saɣiri la, dinzuɣu ka n yur a zaligunima.
en: You dispose of all the wicked people on earth like waste— thats why I love your laws.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ʒini nimaani yuui, ka kul tɔɣisiri ti Duuma yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa daanfaani yɛl shɛŋa maa nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa.
en: So Paul and Barnabas stayed in Iconium a long time, and they spoke bravely for the Lord. They told the people about Gods grace. The Lord proved that what they said was true by causing miraculous signs and wonders to be done through them.

dag: Ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim daa saɣisi ti saha biɛla puuni kaman bɛ ni tɛhi ni di tuhiya shɛm zuɣu; amaa Naawuni niŋdi lala la ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim mal o biɛrikasitali.
en: Our human parents disciplined us for a little while, as it seemed best to them, but God does it for our benefit so that we can share his holiness.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N dabili, m mali tuun kara ni n ti a, ka a labisi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zali bɛ zaashee. N ni zaŋ a leei neesim ti tinzunnima, ka di chɛ ka n tiliginsim paai dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nima.
en: Now the Lord says to me, It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-naai saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa be nimaani ka di niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk daa ti lihi takɔro ni nya ka Yisahaku diɛmd o paɣ Ribɛka.
en: After Isaac had lived there for some time, the Philistines King Abimelech looked out his window and saw Isaac laughing together with his wife Rebekah.

dag: ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: who choose the reserved seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ? Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Yiɣisim bahi paai Damaskus tiŋ puuni, nimaani ka bɛ ni ti wuh a n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: I said, What shall I do, Lord? The Lord answered, Get up and go into Damascus. There you will be told all that I have planned for you to do.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ yi mini yi ni pii yi na so ka o sun ya maa n-tahi yi mini yi yaannim ni daa bi mi zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa.
en: The Lord will send you and your king away to a nation you dont know. You and your ancestors have never seen that nation. There you will serve false gods made of wood and stone.

dag: Tahima shɛlikam bɛ ni niŋ zaŋ chaŋ o gbaabu polo ku di nasara. Hal niriba yi nya o, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi.
en: Do you think you can defeat him? Well, forget it! There is no hope. Just looking at him will scare you!.

dag: O yi di deeg o shia, ka deeg o vuhim.
en: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us.

dag: Sana yi be yi tiŋgban ni, yin di niŋy o zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: When immigrants live in your land with you, you must not cheat them.

dag: ni o ni daa chɛ ka Musa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa ni o ni daa wuhi yiko din mali dabiɛm Izraɛlnim zaa ninni shɛm la.
en: No other prophet ever did as many powerful and amazing things as Moses did for the Israelites to see.

dag: Ti mi ni timaŋmaŋ biɛr kurili daa pahila o zuɣu ka bɛ kpahi ti tabili dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daalahichi biɛr kurili maa kpi, ka ti ku lan nyɛ alahichi daba.
en: We know that our old life was put to death on the cross with Christ. This happened so that our sinful selves would have no power over us. Then we would not be slaves to sin.

dag: Dunia niriba ŋmanila nooŋa tiɛɣu, ka n laɣim bɛ daazichi n-vaai li kaman nir ni vari gala shɛm la, ka so bi zaŋ o kpiŋkpaŋ gahi ma bee n-yaag o noli ni o chɛ n-kari ma.
en: The nations of the world were like a bird's nest, and I gathered their wealth as easily as gathering eggs. Not a wing fluttered to scare me off; no beak opened to scream at me.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi biɛhigu shee wɔɣa, ka yi ku tooi zaŋ li chaŋ nimaani, ka di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii tin shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani wɔɣilim maa zuɣu.
en: But if the trip is too long, because the location the LORD your God has selected to put his name is far away from where you live so that you cant transport the tenth part—because the LORD your God will certainly bless you.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wumdi yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ a suhu niŋ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Listen to what is wise and try to understand it.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ku vuui, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ku kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked wont dwell in the land.

dag: Di pa shɛli n ni ti kpalim yi sani hal ka kikaa ti gari, di nyaaŋa ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ luɣ shɛli n ni ti yɛn chaŋ.
en: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: I just want to talk with you. All right, she told him, go ahead.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di yi buni, ka ʒe yi daguya. Bɛ ni ti daai yi goma luhi, ka wurim yi yil viɛla la. Bɛ ni ti va yi kuɣa mini yi taabɔdari ni yi taŋkpazim ti bahi kom ni.
en: Nebuchadnezzars men will take away your riches. They will take the things you wanted to sell. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will throw the wood and stones into the sea like garbage.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu naai, ka o daa zaŋ alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi ti o. Naawuni daa zaŋla o nubila n-sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu.
en: When God finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, God gave him the two covenant tablets, the stone tablets written by Gods finger.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ni kpaŋsi Jɛrusalɛm, ka sɔŋ o luɣ shɛli polo din lu n-dahim. N ni chɛ ka o tiŋgban nɛli be kaman Idɛn puu din nyɛ man Yawɛ puu la; ka chɛ ka suhupiɛlli mini wumpaɣibo yila be o ni.
en: The LORD will comfort Zion; he will comfort all her ruins. He will make her desert like Eden and her wilderness like the LORDs garden. Happiness and joy will be found in her— thanks and the sound of singing.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti zaa ni ti kahigi ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi Naawuni.
en: So each of us will have to explain to God about the things we do.

dag: Ka Ahitɔfɛl daa yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ a ba mamanim shɛb o ni chɛ n-niŋ nayili ni bɛ maani li la dɔni, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa baŋ ni a leeg a ba dataa, ka bɛnkam zaa be a polo ni kpaŋsi bɛmaŋa.
en: Ahithophel answered, Go and have intercourse with your father's concubines whom he left behind to take care of the palace. Then everyone in Israel will know that your father regards you as his enemy, and your followers will be greatly encouraged.

dag: Wuhibunim ŋɔ yirila ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn nyɛ ʒirinima, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha diɣilim kaman kur tulli n-tabili li n-di li la sanna.
en: Those teachings come through people who tell lies and trick others. These evil people cannot see what is right and what is wrong. It is like their conscience has been destroyed with a hot iron.

dag: N chɛ ka a nya jilima dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tum tuun shɛlikam a ni daa ti ma ni n tum la naai.
en: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.

dag: ka zaŋ o bidibisi maa na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba;.
en: Then present his sons and put the tunics on them.

dag: Judanim pam daa pola pɔri n-zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabil o, o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Ara bia Shɛkania ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu. O bia Jɛhɔhanan daa kpuɣila Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam bipuɣiŋga.
en: Many people in Judah were on his side because of his Jewish father-in-law, Shecaniah son of Arah. In addition, his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.

dag: Di ŋmanila yu biɛɣu m-be n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n dimnim maani ma ansarisi, ka kul bɔhiri ma, ka a Naawuni maa lee be ya?.
en: With my bones crushed, my foes make fun of me, constantly questioning me: Wheres your God now.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ di ku ba, amaa ni bɛ nahimmi ba mi chira anu, ka bɛ mi yi dim nira, di biɛrim ŋmanila nɔŋ dimbu biɛrim.
en: The locusts werent allowed to kill them, but only to make them suffer for five months—and the suffering they inflict is like that of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni bɛ nya, ka daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi.
en: Time and time again they tested God, provoking the holy one of Israel.

dag: Tiŋ maa gooni maa daa me n-tamla di gbinni kuɣa pinaayi zuɣu, ka Piɛbil la tuumba pinaayi la yuya sab pa kuɣa pinaayi maa zuɣu.
en: The city wall had twelve foundations, and on them were the twelve names of the Lambs twelve apostles.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhima.
en: and he said to them, The sorrow in my heart is so great that it almost crushes me. Stay here and keep watch.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ n ni be shɛm.
en: I am sending you Tychicus, the brother we love. He is a faithful servant of the Lords work. He will tell you everything that is happening with me. Then you will know how I am and what I am doing.

dag: Tahat ni Uriɛl ni Uzia ni Shaul.
en: Tahath was Assirs son. Uriel was Tahaths son. Uzziah was Uriels son. Shaul was Uzziahs son.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa ysɛli Anabi Hosea litaafi ni: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa n niriba, n ni boli ba, N niriba. Ka zuliya shɛb n ni bi yura, n ni boli ba, N ninvuɣ yurisi.
en: As the Scriptures say in the book of Hosea, The people who are not mine— I will say they are my people. And the people I did not love— I will say they are the people I love. Hosea :.

dag: Yɛhudianim daa mal adiini jɛmbu du shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Bilichinnim jɛmbu duu. Di ni niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-yi Sairiini mini Alikizandria ni bɛn daa yi Kilikia ni Ɛsha na n-daa laɣim ŋmɛri Stiivin naŋgbankpeeni;.
en: But he was opposed by some men who were members of the synagogue of the Freedmen , which had Jews from Cyrene and Alexandria. They and other Jews from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia started arguing with Stephen.

dag: Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni o zuɣulaantab bɛn daa nyɛ tuumba, ka be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili ni la daa sabi gbaŋ tim Naa Darius sani.
en: Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors sent a report to Darius.

dag: M bi yɛn pahi so zuɣu bee n-niŋ so naŋgban malisim.
en: I will treat you the same as I would treat anyone else. I will not praise you to win your favor.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisifu ni daa mali ti paag o biɛyanim maa sani, bɛ daa darigimi fuɣ o binyɛr shɛli o ni daa ye ka di nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣinli ka mali bɔɣ wɔɣila la;.
en: When Joseph came up to his brothers, they ripped off his long robe with full sleeves.

dag: bɔhim dunia ni tihi ka di wuh a; ka teeku ni zahim ni yɛl a.
en: the flowers and the fish.

dag: N yi tɛhi di yɛla, di gariti ma mi, ka dabiɛm mali ma, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: When I think of what has happened to me, I am stunned, and I tremble and shake.

dag: Amaa paɣ ni tiligi bihi dɔɣibu puuni, ka di mi ni yila o yi kul mali yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim ni biɛr kasi zaŋ tabil omaŋgbibbu ni na.
en: But a woman will be saved through having children, if she perseveres in faith and love and holiness, with modesty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Di ku niŋ lala. So yi ku nyin Keen, bɛn kum niriba ayopɔin yo a kubu maa samli. Ka Yawɛ daa dalim Keen ni di chɛ ka so ti nya o, ka ku ku o.
en: The LORD said to him, It wont happen; anyone who kills Cain will be paid back seven times. The LORD put a sign on Cain so that no one who found him would assault him.

dag: Ka yi ti sab li pa yi yinsi dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm mɛmi kaman fɔntin titali din me n-shɛbisi tab ni.
en: This is New Jerusalem! The city has been rebuilt as one united city.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbala du shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ kalo paligi di nyaansi ka di lihibu viɛla, amaa ka kpiimba kɔba mini daɣiri balibu kam pali di puuni la.
en: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look fine on the outside but are full of bones and decaying corpses on the inside.

dag: Yi niŋla yi takɔbiri naani, ka tumdi din chihira, ka yi zaa yinoyino bɔri yi tab paɣiba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: You depend on your own sword. Each of you does terrible things. Each of you commits sexual sins with his neighbors wife, so you cannot have the land.

dag: Amaa pa Yisa maŋmaŋa n-daa baptaiziri ba, o nyaandoliba n-daa baptaiziri ba.
en: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Hazaɛl, Bom pini n-chaŋ ti puhi Naawuni nir maa, ka chɛ ka o bɔhi Yawɛ nya n ni kpaŋ m barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: Then the King Ben-Hadad said to Hazael, Take a gift and go meet the man of God. Ask him to ask the Lord if I will get well from my sickness.

dag: Bɛ ninani ni daa be shɛm m-bala. Bɛ kpiŋkpama daa yirigila zuɣusaa. Binneen yino kam daa malila kpiŋkpama ayiyi, ka di zaɣ yini chaŋ ti shih o kpee dini. Ka kpiŋkpama ayi din la pɔbi bɛ niŋgbuna.
en: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.

dag: Maligumaana zuɣulana Ɛliashib bia Joyada bidibisi ni yino daa nyɛla Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la bipuɣiŋga yidana, ka n daa kar o n sani.
en: Joiada was the son of Eliashib the high priest. One of Joiadas sons was a son-in-law of Sanballat from Horon. I forced him to leave this place. I forced him to run away.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ninvuɣ biɛri biɛhigu shee ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, lala n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pini zuɣukpina, ka so buri a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum a zuɣu ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini fabila pam.
en: They will shave their heads for you. They will put on sackcloth. They will cry for you like someone crying for someone who died.

dag: Di chɛ ka munaafichinim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu di bɛn yuri duŋ taabu pam!.
en: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a yaa ti paɣiba, a mi di zaŋ a soya ti bɛn kuri nanima.
en: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka yi yɔri lampoo gba zuɣu, dama nam fukumsinim nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn tuma nyɛ ni bɛ niŋ lala.
en: That is also why you pay taxes, because the authorities are working for God when they fulfill their duties.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bi simdi ni ti gbihiri kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti ne n-ʒiya ka gbibi ti maŋa.
en: So then, lets not sleep like the others, but lets stay awake and stay sober.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi Ijipti na ka nyɛ bɛn paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana bɛ so nini ku nya n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la; dama bɛ bi doli ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I swear that because they did not remain loyal to me, none of the men twenty years old or older who came out of Egypt will enter the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: amaa yi ni kpi kaman sal kam ni kpiri shɛm; ka yi nyɛviya zani tariga kaman naa kam la.
en: But you will die like mortals; you will fall down like any prince.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Nyama, o ni daa kul yɛri maa o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nabihi maa dii kpɛna nti duhi bɛ yee kumda, ka naa min o kpamba zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: When Jonadab finished speaking, the princes arrived. They broke into loud crying, and the king and his servants cried hard as well.

dag: A nya Ɛhab ni siɣis omaŋ n sani shɛm bebɔ? O ni siɣis omaŋ n sani shɛm maa zuɣu, n ku lan chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu maa paag o o ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, amaa o bia ʒiɛman ni ka n ni ti chɛ ka di paag o daŋ niriba.
en: Look, Ahab has humbled himself before me. So I will not make that disaster happen during his lifetime. I will wait until his son is king. Then I will destroy his family.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pa ʒii buyopɔin kɔŋko, amaa pisopɔin mi ʒii buyopɔin.
en: No, not seven times, answered Jesus, but seventy times seven.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yɛhudianim chu shɛli daa ti yɛn puhi, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for a special Jewish festival.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan wum ka kukol shɛli yi alizanda ni na yɛra, N niriba, yimiya o ni na ka o daalahichi ku tabili ya, ka o daalɔbo balibubalibu mi ku din ya.
en: Then I heard another voice from heaven say, Come out of that city, my people, so that you will not share in her sins. Then you will not suffer any of the terrible punishment she will get.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa shɛm m-bala.
en: That is the land to be divided among the tribes of Israel.

dag: Babilɔn wuna bahigu m-bɔŋɔ! Bɛl mini Nɛbo daa nyɛla bɛ ni jɛmdi wun shɛŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ zaŋ li ʒilila bunsi; ka di nyɛ ʒi shɛŋa din chɛ ka di wum bunsi maa.
en: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.

dag: Di pala timaŋmaŋ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri ya, amaa Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri maa, ka wuhiri ya ni timaŋmaŋ mi nyɛla yi daba ŋun Yisa zuɣu.
en: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa, Ninvuɣ so yi ku doo ŋɔ ka yihi filiŋ ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɔ ka bɛ yɛn niŋ ti dilana? Dama Filistia nir ŋun bi guni ŋɔ mi leei nyɛ ŋuni hal ti kana ni o ti ta Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ tɔbbihi daɣiri.
en: David asked some soldiers standing nearby, What will a man get for killing this Philistine and stopping him from insulting our people? Who does that worthless Philistine think he is? He's making fun of the army of the living God.

dag: ka ni deei ti ni suhi shɛlikam o sani, ti ni dol o zaligunim ka tumdi din tiɣir o nini la zuɣu.
en: We receive whatever we ask from him because we keep his commandments and do what pleases him.

dag: Nir ni ti zaŋ tɔbu mini piɛma kpe nimaani ni o ti go mɔɣu, dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: People will go hunting there with bows and arrows. Yes, the whole country will be full of briers and thorn bushes.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali tɛhi yini mini yurilim yini, ka mali suhu yini tɛhi yini puuni, ka di chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa.
en: then do what will make my joy complete: Agree with each other, and show your love for each other. Be united in your goals and in the way you think.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niŋ Yawɛ naani. N chɛ ka a baŋ li zuŋɔ, iin, n chɛ ka a baŋ li.
en: I will teach you these things now. I want you to trust the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul bela a tooni kumdi niŋd a yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: LORD, God of my salvation, by day I cry out, even at night, before you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun birigi ka chɛ yɛm soli ni chaŋ ti pahi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: People who wander from the path of insight will rest in the company of the dead.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa tintariga daa kpuɣi Akirabim hal ni Sɛla n-yi nimaani zaŋ du ha.
en: North of Sela, the Edomite border ran through Akrabbim Pass.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Ɛlim maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni miri Teeku Ʒiɛɣu.
en: They marched from Elim and camped by the Reed Sea.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-laɣim tɔbbihi pahi Izraɛlnim kpamba zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ Ai.
en: Joshua got up early in the morning and mustered the people. Then he and the elders of Israel went up in front of the people to Ai.

dag: Zaŋmiya tampiɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia m-mali m biɛhigu shee, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain, n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: Make the interior of the sacred Tent, the Tent of my presence, out of ten pieces of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Embroider them with figures of winged creatures.

dag: Wummiya! Man Pool yɛri ya mi ni yi yi gunda, Masia ku mali ya buchi.
en: Listen! I, Paul, tell you that if you start following the law by being circumcised, then Christ cannot help you.

dag: Chɛ ka Speen mini teeku ni tiŋgban bihi nanim kana ti jɛm o, ka chɛ ka Shiiba nanima mini Siiba nanim ʒi pina na ti ti o.
en: May the kings of Tarshish and all the faraway lands by the sea bring gifts to him. May the kings of Sheba and Seba bring their tribute to him.

dag: Samla ni daa ti kpi, Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔt, tin shɛli din be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo nir la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him.

dag: N ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, dama bɛ tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa maligu zoya zuɣu, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. N shiri ni darigi bɛ tibili pam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: your sins and the sins of your ancestors as well, says the LORD. Since they burned incense on the mountains, and mocked me in the hills, I will count out to them full payment for their actions.

dag: A yi ni tooi garigi ma, nyin garigim ma; malimi a yɛtɔɣa shili n-zani n tooni.
en: Answer me if you can. Prepare your arguments.

dag: Ka Pita daa yɛl o, Ɛnias, Yisa Masia tib a; dinzuɣu yiɣisima m-mal a bindoo maa yɛrigi! Ka o daa dii vaai yiɣisi.
en: Peter said to Aeneas, Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed. At once he stood up.

dag: hal ka ti ti paai ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la mini ti Naawuni Bia baŋbu la m-bi niriba ka ti biɛhigu buɣisibu saɣisi Masia biɛhigu zaa la.
en: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.

dag: Ashaara doli alahichinima, amaa tɔŋbu n-nyɛ wuntizɔriba laara.
en: Trouble chases sinners wherever they go, but good things happen to good people.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal n ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya la, di daa pala ŋun tum taali la zuɣu bee o ni daa tum so taali la zuɣu, amaa di daa nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka yi baɣa ni be ti ni shɛm la yi palo Naawuni sani.
en: So, even though I wrote that letter, it was not because of the one who did wrong or the one who was wronged. Instead, I wrote it to make plain to you, in God's sight, how deep your devotion to us really is.

dag: ni Anab ni Ɛshitɛmo ni Anim.
en: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ buŋ yɛno kɔbili maa bahi. Ka bɛ daa bol o ni zaŋ li bahi luɣ shɛli maa yuli Ramatilɛhi.
en: When he finished speaking, he tossed away the jawbone. So that place became known as Ramath-lehi.

dag: Ka paɣ bundan maa daa ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni do so ŋun doli yiri ti sanna waawaayili ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: She said to her husband, I am sure that this man who comes here so often is a holy man.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la palibu saha daa ti miri, ka bɛ zuliya maa daa nab pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: When the time drew near for God to keep the promise he had made to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had grown much larger.

dag: Samaria anabinim sani, n nya binshɛli din bi viɛla. Bɛ malila Baal yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka n niriba birigi.
en: I have seen the sin of Samaria's prophets: they have spoken in the name of Baal and have led my people astray.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord answered Moses.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul nyurila bara bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri zuɣu; ka bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim mi kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ ka tur o.
en: The wicked are proud of their evil desires; the greedy curse and reject the Lord .

dag: Buɣim ni di li wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa sahakam. Ka di tiŋgbani ni leei tiŋgban nɛli doya ʒiɛmani kam ni; ka so ku lan ka di ni na.
en: It will burn day and night, and smoke will rise from it forever. The land will lie waste age after age, and no one will ever travel through it again.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Nyamiya, Yawɛ bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: Then Moses said to the Israelites, Look, the Lord has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Ka Sool daa laɣim ba luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Bɛzɛk la. Izraɛlnim kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita. Ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ tuhi pihita.
en: Saul gathered them at Bezek: there were , from Israel and , from Judah.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa Arinɔn zaŋ ti paai Jabok n-lan zaŋ hal ni Ammɔnnim tintariga, dama Ammɔnnim daa gula bɛ tintariga viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Israel defeated them and took over the Amorite territory from the Arnon River gorge in the south to the Jabbok River gorge in the north. Beyond the Jabbok was the territory of the Ammonites, who were much stronger than Israel.

dag: Dan ni ti nyɛla o niriba naa kaman Izraɛl zuliyanim ni yino.
en: Dan, you are the tribe that will bring justice to Israel.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin kpɛm a duu nti yo a dunoli ka suh a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: But when you pray, you should go into your room and close the door. Then pray to your Father. He is there in that private place. He can see what is done in private, and he will reward you.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka shiri na kpalim be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Having said this, he stayed in Galilee.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka doliya zaligunim ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Remember that you used to be slaves in Egypt, so obey these laws.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: There in the desert they started complaining to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ziɔn nachimbihi daa ŋmanila salima ti sani. Nyam bɛ ni niŋ ba shɛm kaman yaɣiri duɣ shɛŋa yaɣimɛra ni zaŋ o nuhi me la.
en: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami.
en: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.

dag: Yinim peentɔriba zaa, teemiya zani yi zaashɛhi gili Babilɔn. Tomiya ba piɛma, di tɔn ya ka guui peen gaŋa, dama bɛ tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Archers, line up for battle against Babylon and surround it. Shoot all your arrows at Babylon, because it has sinned against me, the Lord .

dag: Ka Zifinim daa ti ka Sool sanna Gibia nti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela Hachila Zoli din mini Jɛshimɔn nin tuhi tab la zuɣu.
en: Some men from Ziph came to Saul at Gibeah and told him that David was hiding on Mount Hachilah at the edge of the Judean wilderness.

dag: nti pahi Ramɔt mini Anɛm ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa din be Isaka tiŋgban ni la ti ba.
en: Ramoth with its pasturelands and Anem with its pasturelands.

dag: Dindina yi ni shɛb ni bɔhi ma, Ka di yi nyɛ lala, di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni na kul nyari ninsalinim taali? Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu Naawuni yubu soli ka di ku niŋ.
en: So one of you will ask me, If God controls what we do, why does he blame us for our sins.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu maa naai, ka o zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni;.
en: When he had finished offering the sacrifices, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord Almighty.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: And Jesus concluded, The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ chaŋ? Dama Sool yi wum di yɛla o ni ku ma. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Bom naɣisaa chaŋ ti yɛli, N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: How can I do that? Samuel asked. When Saul hears of it hell kill me! Take a heifer with you, the LORD replied, and say, I have come to make a sacrifice to the LORD.

dag: Bɛ bi mali noli ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko saɣisiri tumtumdiba, dama hal bɛ yi kul baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm, bɛ baɣa ku bɛ di ni.
en: Servants arent disciplined by words; they might understand, but they dont respond.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ŋub li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Somiya yi kpalansi, ka piri yi namda, ka kpuɣiya yi jaaŋgbɛhi gbibi, ka ŋub li yomyom, dama di nyɛla Yawɛ yaɣigari.
en: When you eat the meal, you must be fully dressed and ready to travel. You must have your sandals on your feet and your walking stick in your hand. You must eat in a hurry, because this is the Lord s Passover.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda Aiya bipuɣiŋga Rizipa ŋun daa nyɛ Sool mam la ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: When David heard what Rizpah had done.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔŋda ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi ni m mali taali? Bɛ zaa ni kpi kaman siturili la. Lɛla ni ŋub ba zaa.
en: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.

dag: Farisiinima n-daa tim tuumba maa Jɔn sani maa.
en: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.

dag: Ka so mi bi nyɔri firila n-zaŋdi lɔɣu pindi li, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni di ne sokam zaa yili maa ni.
en: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they put it on top of a lampstand, and it shines on all who are in the house.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee nyɛ li? Ka o garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla piɛɣu, ka nyɛ din ʒe bɛ daalahichi zaani dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: I don't know what it is, was my reply. It's a big basket, he said. And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.

dag: Ka bimbini maa gba daa shiri wurim, ka tampiligim maa kpaai bahi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun wuhi ni Yawɛ yɛliya ni o ni chɛ ka di niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then the altar broke into pieces, and all its ashes fell onto the ground. This proved that what the man of God had said came from the Lord .

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: No one knows, however, when that day and hour will come—neither the angels in heaven nor the Son; the Father alone knows.

dag: amaa ninsal ku tooi maai zilinli nini. Di nyɛla din bi saɣi ni so su li, ka lan nyɛ lɔɣu ni pali shɛl ni!.
en: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.

dag: Nyama, m mini bi shɛb Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ nyɛla shihirili din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ sanna.
en: Here I am with the children the Lord has given me. We are here as signs from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion. He is using us to show his plans for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum yi ni yɛli ma yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, ka yɛli ma, N wum niriba maa ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, bɛ mali yɛlimaŋli bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni.
en: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi chaŋ jinwariba sani bee bukpahinim sani nti doli ba, n ni pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: I will also oppose anyone who resorts to dead spirits or spirits of divination and faithlessly follows those things. I will cut such an individual off from their people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din niŋ kamaata yɛlibu, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣ kaha.
en: The lips of the wise know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked knows only what is perverse.

dag: n yi di di daatam ka bi yo di zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛn su li kpi.
en: if I have eaten its yield without payment and caused its owners grief.

dag: Yi yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, yin niŋmiya ania n-zaŋ li ti Laodisianim gba ka bɛ karim. Ka yi gba niŋ ania n-karim gban shɛli Laodisianim ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya na la.
en: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Jɔab, dama Jɔab daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe Adɔnija nyaaŋa hal o ni daa bi ʒe Absalom ŋun nyaaŋa la zaa yoli. Ka ŋun Jɔab daa zo n-chaŋ Yawɛ Jɛmbu Duu nti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, fam ma bahi. Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, sɔŋm ma yomyom.
en: Hurry, God, to deliver me; hurry, LORD, to help me!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi dindali bee di saha.
en: So, my disciples, always be ready! You don't know the day or the time when all this will happen.

dag: n-zaŋ Naawunitali shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: The LORD has filled him with the divine spirit that will give him skill, ability, and knowledge for every kind of work.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: What do you want me to do for you? he asked.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa boli Obadia ŋun daa su nayili tuma fukumsi la na. Obadia daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛmdi Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: Ahab had called Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace affairs. Obadiah greatly feared the LORD.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: All of the temple servants and the family of Solomons servants.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n ka kpe ŋɔ na ni n ti tumla a yubu kaman di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm nyin Naawuni Kundi ni la. .
en: Then Christ said, And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.

dag: M mi ni yi nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya; amaa di mi zaa yoli, yi bɔri ni yi ku ma, dama n yɛligu bi kpɛri yi suhuri ni.
en: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi Firawuna sani yi tiŋ maa tariga nti duh o nuhi zuɣusaa suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi maa mini sakuɣa maa daa chɛ, ka saa maa baai.
en: Moses left Pharaoh and went outside the city. He lifted his hands in prayer to the Lord . And the thunder and hail stopped, and then even the rain stopped.

dag: Miriya ka yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama bɛ ni boori Yawɛ kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la be yi ni. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: But you must not leave the meeting tent, or you will die because the LORDs anointing oil is on you. So they did what Moses ordered.

dag: N yi bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti be teeku tariga.
en: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.

dag: Di di daa simdi ni a zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni, n ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: You could have at least put my money in the bank, so I could have earned interest on it.

dag: ka lan fari pakoya yinsi, ka suhiri Naawuni yuuri ni niriba tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam.
en: They are the ones who cheat widows out of their homes, and to show off they say long prayers. They will be judged most harshly.

dag: Nazari nir zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: saha shɛl o ni zaŋ wolig omaŋ maa tariga yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm o na ti zali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: After their time of dedication is ended, Nazirites must go to the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa guhirila tin shɛli Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni zali di tanzaa ka lan nyɛ ŋun me li, ka di ku vuui.
en: Abraham was waiting for the city that has real foundations. He was waiting for the city that is planned and built by God.

dag: Ka niriba maa yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka saa bi mira, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na n-kuhi bol a yuli ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa ka suh a.
en: When the sky holds back its rain because Israel has sinned against you, but they then pray toward this place, give thanks to your name, and turn away from their sin because you have punished them for it.

dag: Naa maa ni ti lihi ʒiɛm o yaannim wuna, ka lihi ʒiɛm paɣiba ni yuri wun shɛŋa gba. Hal o baɣa ti ku be wuni kam ni, dama o ni ti tɛhi ni ŋuna n-gari di zaa.
en: The king will ignore the god his ancestors served, and also the god that women love. In fact, he will ignore every god, because he will think he is greater than any of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zali Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab maa samli ka bɛ yo, ka bɛ naanyi bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: They made Jason and the other believers deposit money to guarantee that there would be no more trouble. Then they let them go.

dag: Hal bɛ yi gbi gbala n-kpe di ni, n ni zaŋ n nuu tim di ni yihi ba na. Ka bɛ yi dula zuɣusaa, n ni siɣisi ba na.
en: If they dig through into the underworld, from there my hand will take them. If they climb up to the heavens, from there I will bring them down.

dag: Di dubihi atata din be di yaɣa ayi la mini di pilanima ni di zɔntua zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: This gateway, its three rooms on each side, and its porch all measured the same as the first gate. The gateway was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o ŋmaligi yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: But so you will know that the Human One has authority on the earth to forgive sins—he said to the man who was paralyzed—Get up, take your cot, and go home.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka toli yina nti ŋubi bimbil shɛŋa zaa sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Raise your hand over the land of Egypt to bring the locusts. They will come and eat everything that grows, everything that has survived the hail.

dag: Masia Naawunitali yiko chɛ ka ti nya binshɛɣukam zaa din simdi ni ti zaŋ mali nyɛvili mini biɛhigu din luri Naawuni sizuura, ŋuna ŋun bol ti o jilima min o zaɣisuntali baŋbu puuni la zuɣu.
en: Jesus has the power of God. And his power has given us everything we need to live a life devoted to God. We have these things because we know him. Jesus chose us by his glory and goodness.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman bɛn mali fahim; yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I speak to you as sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.

dag: Ka Pool daa yi chani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla, ka o daa lɛbigiri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tɛha.
en: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa lo nia biɛri ni yi saɣim yi tab la, yi nia biɛri maa ni ŋmaligi din ya. Man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya. Yi bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: The Lord says, Look, you people want to do whatever you want. So light your own fires and torches, but you will be punished. You will fall into your fires and torches and be burned. I will make that happen.

dag: Ka shɛb pun yɛli ba a yɛla ni a wuhirila Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn be bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tinsi ni la ni bɛ zaɣisim Anabi Musa zaligu, ka lan yɛri ba ni bɛ di gundi bɛ bihi, ka mi di lan doli bɛ kaya.
en: They have been told that you have been teaching all the Jews who live in Gentile countries to abandon the Law of Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or follow the Jewish customs.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Jɔshua, Amaŋmaŋ nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ nanim ayi ŋɔ shɛm zaa, lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn garina shɛb tinsi ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then I instructed Joshua: You have seen all that the Lord your God did to those two kings, Sihon and Og; and he will do the same thing to everyone else whose land you invade.

dag: O nina daa ŋmanila buɣim zilinli, ka nam zuɣupila pam pil o zuɣu ni; ka yu shɛli sabi tab o, ka so ʒi li pah o zuɣu.
en: His eyes were like a fiery flame, and on his head were many royal crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows but he himself.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ duno shɛli din kpɛri dundɔŋ maa puuni, ka n daa lihi nya ka voli be gooni ni.
en: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi ni, Uriɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and of his relatives;.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni sɔŋ o ni pii na so ŋɔ; o ni be o daalizanda din be kasi la ni ka garig o, ka chɛ ka o nudirigu sɔŋ o ka o di nasara din galisi.
en: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed one; God answers his anointed one from his heavenly sanctuary, answering with mighty acts of salvation achieved by his strong hand.

dag: Ka Mariama yɛli, Chɛ ka di niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma dabili ŋɔ kaman a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Di saha ka malaika maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: Then Mary said, I am the Lords servant. Let it be with me just as you have said. Then the angel left her.

dag: Ka di nyɛla Baasha min o bia Ɛla ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa la mini bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi shɛŋa ka di yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu la zuɣu.
en: Baasha and Elah sinned and caused the Israelites to sin, and they made the Lord angry by worshiping idols.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni so ku tooi yɛli ni n yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya.
en: so that nobody can say that you were baptized in my name!.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun nyɛ Babilɔn naa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa nazuɣu ŋɔ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba ni tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa n-yi nuzaa polo na ti liri Taainima.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, I am going to bring the greatest king of all—King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia—to attack Tyre. He will come from the north with a huge army, with horses and chariots and with cavalry.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin maa daa zaŋ kawaan kar ayopɔin maa vali. Ka n zaŋ li yɛli timanima, amaa ka bɛ ni so bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: These heads of grain swallowed the full ones. I told my dreams to the magicians, but none of them could tell me the meaning of the dreams.

dag: bɛ ni kpi n-chaŋ ti pahi bɛ yaannim ni m-be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ zibisim shee hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.

dag: A ŋmanila kom din bi do baalim, a mi ku gari sokam, dama a daa zaŋ a ba paɣ dɔni o bindoo zuɣu n-ta li daɣiri. A daa dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: Uncontrollable as a flood, you slept with my wife and disgraced my bed. And so you no longer deserve the place of honor.

dag: Chɛ ka a ni niŋ yɛda shɛm a suhu ni be a mini Naawuni sunsuuni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tɛha bi chihir o suhu o ni niŋdi shɛli zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Keep what you believe about this matter, then, between yourself and God. Happy are those who do not feel guilty when they do something they judge is right!.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim pam daa ka Maata mini Mariama sanna ni bɛ ti maai bɛ suhuri bɛ tizɔdoo Lazarɔs kum maa zuɣu.
en: Many Jews had come to see Martha and Mary. They came to comfort them about their brother Lazarus.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun daa sabiri bina yɛla zaani la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka lab Hɛzɛkia sanna nti yɛl o Rabishake maa ni yɛli shɛm.
