en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah tore their clothes in grief and went and reported to the king what the Assyrian official had said.

dag: O kɔrila naɣilahi mini naɣ pol kpaba ni piɛri pam mali sara, ka boli nabihi zaa mini maligumaana Abiata ni tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Jɔab, amaa ka bi bol a bia Sulemaana ŋuna.
en: He has prepared large quantities of oxen, fattened cattle, and lamb. He has invited all the royal princes as well as Abiathar the priest and Joab the general. However, he didnt invite your servant Solomon.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa sɔŋdi niriba pam, amaa jɛra kpirila bɛ yɛm kalinsi zuɣu.
en: Good people say things that help others, but the wicked die from a lack of understanding.

dag: Ti ni daa be Tabɛra mini Masa ni Kiburɔtihataava la gba, yi daa lan chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisimi.
en: You also made the Lord your God angry when you were at Taberah, Massah, and Kibroth Hattaavah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa be faranim ni mal alibarika; bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba.
en: Those who help the poor succeed will get many blessings. When trouble comes, the Lord will save them.

dag: amaa ti shɛli din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu la, miri ka a di li, dama a yi ti di li dahin shɛli, a ni kpi.
en: But you must not eat from the tree that gives knowledge about good and evil. If you eat fruit from that tree, on that day you will certainly die.

dag: ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pili ba; ka maligumaanitali maa leei bɛ dini sahakam. A ni ti yɛn zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa leei maligumaaniba shɛm m-bala.
en: put sashes around their waists and tie caps on their heads. That is how you are to ordain Aaron and his sons. They and their descendants are to serve me as priests forever.

dag: Hal bɛmaŋmaŋ nam puuni min a ni niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli pam shɛl la puuni ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn tital shɛli din mali kulim ti ba la zaa yoli, bɛ daa zaɣis a jɛmbu, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: Even in their own kingdom, surrounded by the great goodness that you gave to them, even in the wide and rich land that you gave them, they didnt serve you or turn from their wicked works.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a mi, dama a nyɛla ŋun ni garigiri ma, lala zuɣu ka n suhir a maa; dinzuɣu gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu maa.
en: I cry out to you because you answer me. So tilt your ears toward me now— listen to what Im saying!.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa yɛl o namɔɣilisi kpɛma Ashpɛnaz ni o lihim Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛ ni gbahina maa ni m-pii nabihi mini kpambaliba;.
en: The king ordered Ashpenaz, his chief official, to select from among the Israelite exiles some young men of the royal family and of the noble families.

dag: Ka yɛm shia daa pali Nan bia Jɔshua, dama Musa daa zaŋla o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa deeg o noli, ka niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Joshua, Nuns son, was filled with wisdom because Moses had placed his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to Joshua, and they did exactly what the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Dama Jɛrɔbɔam min o bidibisi daa kari ba mi ni bɛ di lan tum Yawɛ maligumaaniba tuma. Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ tiŋgbana ni n-chɛ bɛ binshɛɣukam ka kuli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The Levites left their grasslands and their own fields and came to Judah and Jerusalem. The Levites did this because Jeroboam and his sons refused to let them serve as priests to the Lord .

dag: Ka din pahi pia gbaai Shimɛi min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the tenth to Shimei, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Ka n yi na be n nyɛvil ni ka ni tooi tum tuun shɛli din mali buchi, dindina m bi jɛndi mi n ni yɛn pii shɛli bina ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: If I continue living here on earth, I will be able to work for the Lord. But what would I choose—to live or to die? I dont know.

dag: Dama Keenannim mini bɛnkam be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yi wum li, bɛ ni kana ti teei gil ti, ka kpihim ti birili dunia ŋɔ ni; ka di yi niŋ lala, wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ a yuli din galisi ŋɔ.
en: The Canaanites and all the other people in this country will hear about what happened. Then they will attack us and kill all of us! Then what will you do to protect your great name.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus went around visiting all the towns and villages. He taught in the synagogues, preached the Good News about the Kingdom, and healed people with every kind of disease and sickness.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔpiɛliga dari mali di daantalis anahi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li, ka zaŋ salima mali di bansi. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ anzinfa mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni bɛ zaŋ pateesa maa yili li.
en: They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti Yisahaku mini Ribɛka suhusaɣiŋgu pam.
en: They made life very difficult for Isaac and Rebekah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim na kul mali duŋ ni Dauda yilinim hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Ever since that time the people of the northern kingdom of Israel have been in rebellion against the dynasty of David.

dag: M piila Lɛvinim Izraɛlnim puuni n-zaŋ ba zali Izraɛlnim bikpamba zaani. Lɛvinim maa nyɛla n ni su shɛba.
en: I claim the Levites from the Israelites in place of all the oldest males who open an Israelite womb. The Levites are mine.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Eliphaz from Teman said:.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ishimail sani maa ni daa nya Karia bia Jɔhanan ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa be o sani, bɛ suhuri daa paligimi.
en: When Ishmael's prisoners saw Johanan and the leaders of the forces with him, they were glad.

dag: nti suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili. Ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: Then they begged him that they might just touch the edge of his clothes. Everyone who touched him was cured.

dag: Di yi pala Yawɛ m-me yili, bɛn mɛri li dirila wahala yoli. Di yi pala Yawɛ n-guli tiŋa, tiŋguliba gul li la yoli.
en: Unless it is the LORD who builds the house, the builders work is pointless. Unless it is the LORD who protects the city, the guard on duty is pointless.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa woligi piɛbihi bɛ ko, ka ŋmaligi biŋkɔbiri maa nina kpa Leeban biŋkɔbiri bɛn mali bomaboma mini zaɣ sabila zaa la polo; ka wolig o biŋkɔbiri zali bɛ kɔŋko ka bi chɛ ka bɛ laɣim Leeban biŋkɔbiri maa ni.
en: Jacob kept the sheep separate from the goats and made them face in the direction of the streaked and black animals of Laban's flock. In this way he built up his own flock and kept it apart from Laban's.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, a bahiyoli paag a, di saha paaya, di biɛɣu neeya, di ti yɛn nyɛla suhusaɣiŋgu dabisili, ka pa ni suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu zoya zuɣu.
en: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.

dag: ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: Are you the one who is to come, or should we look for another.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya n taali yim ŋɔ yaha, ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa ti ma ka o yihi ma kum ŋɔ ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Please forgive my sin this time. Pray to the LORD your God just to take this deathly disaster away from me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba bihi ni be ni alaafee. Bɛ zuliya ni ti nya zaa zani a sani.
en: We are your servants today. Our children will live here, and their descendants will come here to worship you.

dag: Zuliya shɛb tiŋgbana n yaannim ni daa tuhi nyaŋ la buɣa daa tooi fa ba bahi? Di tiŋgbana maa n-nyɛ: Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ni Ɛdin niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa la.
en: Did the gods of those nations save their people? No, my ancestors destroyed them all. They destroyed Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden living in Tel Assar.

dag: Ka napɔŋ yi yɛli ni di pala nuu, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni; lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: Suppose a foot says, I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body. Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?.

dag: Ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini Dauda tɔbbihi mi daa yi n-chaŋ ti paai ba Gibiɔn biaŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ yini polo ka bɛn la mi chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ din la polo.
en: Joab, Zeruiahs son, and Davids soldiers also came out and confronted them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat on one side of the pool; the other sat on the opposite side of the pool.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, N dana, a tiligi ti nyɛviya; ka di yi niŋ a nyaɣisim, ti ni leei Firawuna daba.
en: They answered, You have saved our lives; you have been good to us, sir, and we will be the king's slaves.

dag: Yi tamla Naawuni ni zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ omaŋmaŋ bihi la yɛla? O yɛliya: M bia, a Duuma yi saɣis a, nyin wumma; ka o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu miligi.
en: You are children of God, and he speaks words of comfort to you. You have forgotten these words: My child, dont think the Lords discipline is worth nothing, and dont stop trying when he corrects you.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din yiri kpaŋ na nti kpɛri ninsal ni ku tooi ta o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri. .
en: There is nothing that goes into you from the outside which can make you ritually unclean. Rather, it is what comes out of you that makes you unclean.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Ijipti baŋdiba mini bukpahinim bɛn nyɛ timanim na, ka bɛ gba daa ti tum bɛ tabibi tuma niŋ lala.
en: Then the king called for his wise men and magicians, and by their magic they did the same thing.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Jɛziriil, ka Jɛzibɛl wum o yɛla, o daa bal la chilo, ka mal o zuɣu n-vɔbisi lihiri takɔro ni.
en: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.

dag: Izraɛlnim ti ku lan nya suligunyinyaɣu bee goo bɛ ʒiʒiinitab bɛn daa maani ba ansarisi la zaa so sani, ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: When that happens, the people of Israel will no longer have cruel neighbors that abuse them and make them feel as though they are in a field of thorns and briers. And the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu. Timiya niriba lala tatabo jilima.
en: Welcome him in the Lord with much joy. Give honor to people like Epaphroditus.

dag: Hadadɛza kpambaliba ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Dauda, ka leeg o ni su shɛba. Dinzuɣu ka Sirianim maa daa bi lan bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋ Ammɔnnim maa yaha.
en: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. Never again would the Arameans come to the aid of the Ammonites.

dag: Di saha n ni ti chɛ ka di koma niŋ viɛlim, ka chɛ ka di kulibɔna kom zɔri kaman kpam la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I will make the water in Egypt calm. I will cause their rivers to run slowly—they will be slick like oil. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: dama m Ba maa maŋmaŋ yuri ya, yi ni yuri ma ka niŋ yɛda ni n yila m Ba maa sanna zuɣu.
en: The Father himself loves you because you have loved me. And he loves you because you have believed that I came from God.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o deemba maa Yawɛ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim shɛm zaa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnima. Ka lan yɛl o muɣisigu shɛŋa zaa din paai ba soli maa ni yɛla ni Yawɛ ni yihi ba muɣisigu maa ni shɛm.
en: where Moses told him everything the Lord had done to protect Israel against the Egyptians and their king. He also told him how the Lord had helped them in all of their troubles.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, zomiya doli di pala n-lihi gili nya! Lihimiya zama ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-nya yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ yino ŋun tuma viɛla, ka o gbibi yɛlimaŋli, ka n chɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim taali o zuɣu.
en: Search every street in Jerusalem, comb the squares, look far and wide for one person, even one who acts justly and seeks truth that I may pardon her!.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ Naa ŋun ka bahigu. O suhu yi yiɣisi, tiŋgbani sɔhigirimi, ka zuliya shɛli ku tooi zan o suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: But the LORD is the true God! Hes the living God and the everlasting king! When hes angry, the earth quakes; the nations cant endure his rage.

dag: Di daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi la daa nyɛla daanya. Amaa ban shɛŋa din daa yili daantalisi maa mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa.
en: supported by twenty bronze posts in twenty bronze bases, with hooks and rods made of silver.

dag: Siria naa maa ni ti kpuɣi Ijipti azichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni bin suma shɛŋa din zaa pahi. O ni ti nyaŋ Libianim mini Itiɔpianima.
en: He will get treasures of gold and silver and all the riches of Egypt. The Libyans and Ethiopians will obey him.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria Gomnanim mini sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi bɛn zaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ bɛmaŋa ni bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kɔre. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla.
en: She wanted the Assyrian leaders and officers. She wanted those soldiers in blue uniforms riding their horses. They were all handsome young men.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa niŋla Bɛtani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn ni daa baptaiziri niriba kom ni la.
en: All this happened in Bethany on the east side of the Jordan River, where John was baptizing.

dag: Jeemsi daa lan yɛli, Dinzuɣu n tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni ti nahim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ tuuba maa;.
en: Therefore, I conclude that we shouldnt create problems for Gentiles who turn to God.

dag: O ni daa nya Yisa ka o chahi pam ka kana nti damd o tooni kuhi bɔh o, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a, di nahim ma.
en: When he saw Jesus, he gave a loud cry, threw himself down at his feet, and shouted, Jesus, Son of the Most High God! What do you want with me? I beg you, don't punish me.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa shɛli niŋ Aduna nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.
en: Moses killed it and took some of the blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti duhiri timaŋa ka tumdi din yiɣisiri tab suhuri bee n-zabiri tab nyuli.
en: We must not be proud or irritate one another or be jealous of one another.

dag: Amaa ni malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin ni ti yɛn piɛb o kikaa dahin shɛl la ka Naawuni daashili yɛl shɛŋa o ni daa yɛl o daanabinim la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: In the days when the seventh angel blows his trumpet, Gods mysterious purpose will be accomplished, fulfilling the good news he gave to his servants the prophets.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti ni yɛli ni a nyɛla Samaria nira ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi a zuɣu la, di pala yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Jews there answered, We say you are a Samaritan. We say a demon is making you crazy! Are we not right when we say this.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo kuɣ shɛŋa zali bɛ ni daa yihi kuɣ shɛŋa la zaani, ka lan bo tari na ti ta yili maa.
en: Then other stones are to be used to replace the stones that were removed, and new plaster will be used to cover the walls.

dag: O daa ʒe yim ŋun piig o maa sani kaman Anabi Musa ni daa ʒe yim o tuma ni Naawuni niriba sani shɛm la.
en: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa baŋ ni yɛm so jɛrilim kaman neesim ni so zibisim shɛm la.
en: I saw that wisdom is more beneficial than folly, as light is more beneficial than darkness.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and that the people who live in your towns along the coast will be killed. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa sanʒiɛɣu puuni yɛli.
en: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:.

dag: Ka Dauda daa sɔɣi mɔɣu maa ni. Ka gol palli dali maa daa ti paai, ka naa ʒini ni o di bindirigu.
en: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon came, the king sat at the feast to eat.

dag: O yila Rimmon n-kana Aiyat. O chaŋ ti kpe Migirɔn gari. O chɛ o nɛma sɔŋla Mikimash.
en: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash.

dag: Yawɛ, n daa bela gballi din zilim pam puuni, ka suh a.
en: From the bottom of the pit, O Lord , I cried out to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋmanila asiba paɣili bee maligim din kpahi lu bi to la bee bɛ ni yɛli kabɔɣili ni wurigu shɛli bahi la bee nyɔhi din yiri takɔro ni la.
en: And so these people will disappear like morning mist, like the dew that vanishes early in the day. They will be like chaff which the wind blows from the threshing place, like smoke from a chimney.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ m birini, ka n Naawuni nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri tampiŋ shɛli gbini.
en: But the Lord defends me; my God protects me.

dag: ka duh o yee suhi Naawuni bɔh o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n ni kana ti be pako so sani ŋɔ bidibiga ŋɔ kpi n-ti o suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: and prayed, Lord God, why did you do such a terrible thing to this woman? She's letting me stay here, and now you've let her son die.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa be kaman taŋkuɣibihi la lurina, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo di wari?.
en: He sends hail like gravel; no one can endure the cold he sends!.

dag: Ka n ni ti zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim labisi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti lab me tin shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la m-be di ni. Bɛ ni ti ko tiwala puri ka nyu di wala kom. Bɛ ni ti ko tihi puri ka di di wala.
en: I will bring my people back to their land. They will rebuild their ruined cities and live there; they will plant vineyards and drink the wine; they will plant gardens and eat what they grow.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya yi putarisi zaa daatam bee ka yi ti lan labi ti yihi binyiha yi daatam kpuɣibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ yaha: Naawuni zaɣisila o niriba? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Mmaŋmaŋ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma yaaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na.
en: So I ask you, has God rejected his people? Absolutely not! Im an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: ka Obɛd, dɔɣi Jɛsi, ka Jɛsi mi dɔɣi Naa Dauda.
en: Obed was the father of Jesse. Jesse was the father of David.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣ shɛli yi ni mali yɔri farigu zuɣu maa na ka n nya. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ laɣifu na ti ti o.
en: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes. They brought him a silver coin.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tim ti boli Yisahaku na ti bɔh o, O nyɛla a paɣa; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa? Ka Yisahaku garigi yɛl o, N tɛhimi ni n yi yɛli ni m paɣa m-bala, bɛ ni ku ma o zuɣu.
en: So Abimelech summoned Isaac and said, Shes your wife, isnt she? How could you say, Shes my sister? Isaac responded, Because I thought that I might be killed because of her.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: Someone standing there pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa ti paai yuun pihitayinika saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Tɛra.
en: After Nahor was years old, his son Terah was born.

dag: Nyama, yi yi lo noli yi ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni ka zabiri buri taba buri biɛɣu. Yi ni lɔri noli maa shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ku chɛ ka Naawuni deei yi suhigu.
en: You are hungry, but not for food. You are hungry for arguing and fighting, not for bread. You are hungry to hit people with your evil hands. This is not the way to fast if you want your prayers to be heard in heaven!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Nandahima gbaai ma pam. Chɛ ka ti kpalimla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya. Amaa di chɛ ka n kpalim ninsalinim nuu ni.
en: David was really frightened and said, It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni daa zahim nya ka di be kaman n yɛn kɔŋ la n nyɛvili maa, ka n daa teeg a yɛla ka suh a, ka a be a jɛmbu du kasi la ni ka wum n suhigu.
en: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.

dag: O bi darigiri ti tibili kaman ti daalahichi ni simdi shɛm bee n-yɔri ti ti tuumbiɛri samli.
en: We sinned against him, but he didnt give us the punishment we deserved.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu maa shee, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sin tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: They made fun of Jesus and shouted, Hey, you king of the Jews.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, n suhir a, a nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin be ti sani ti chandi maa ni, hal ti ni kul nyɛ tipawumlinim maa zaa yoli, chɛl ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi maa taali, ka zaŋ ti leeg a niriba.
en: He said, If you approve of me, my Lord, please go along with us. Although these are stubborn people, forgive our guilt and our sin and take us as your own possession.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Dauda ni man Yawɛ yɛliya: Bin diba ata ka n zal a ni a pii di ni zaɣ yini, ka n niŋ li ti a.
en: Go and tell David, This is what the LORD says: Im offering you three punishments. Choose one of them, and that is what I will do to you.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba yihi yi ni deei zaka binshɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim sani maa mi zaka ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ din nyɛ Yawɛ dini maa ti maligumaana Aduna.
en: In this way you will also give an offering to the Lord just as the other Israelites do. You will get the one-tenth that the Israelites give to the Lord , and then you will give one-tenth of that to Aaron the priest.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli nimaani yuli Masa ni Mɛriba, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ o taali, ka daa lan zahim Yawɛ yɛra, Amii Yawɛ be ti sani bee o kani.
en: Moses named that place Meribah and Massah, because this was the place that the Israelites turned against him and tested the Lord . The people wanted to know if the Lord was with them or not.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣimiy o!.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! Shout the Lord 's praises in the highest heavens.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di lan zɔri ya Babilɔn naa kaman yi ni yi zɔr o shɛm la, dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya, ka fan ya o nuu ni bahi.
en: You dont have to be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. You dont have to be afraid of him anymore, declares the LORD, for I will be with you to save you and rescue you from his hand.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee m-pirig o kparibu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ bɔdua mil o shee ni.
en: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa zali Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka wuh o niriba ni bɛ niŋm ʒim vie bɛ yinsi dunoya, ka di chɛ ka Kum malaika so ŋun daa yɛn kana ti ku bikpamba la ti ku ku bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bikpamba.
en: Moses prepared the Passover and spread the blood on the doorways of the people of Israel, so that the angel of death would not kill their firstborn sons. Moses did this because he had faith.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul bɔrila din tuhi, ka mi kul ku chɛ o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim. O kul ni gul ba sahakam, amaa o ni kari ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bihi bahi.
en: The Lord loves what is right, and he will never leave his followers without help. He will always protect them, but he will destroy the families of the wicked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, A na ʒi n-di ti ni so bini zalinsi bee n-nahim ti bee n-fa ti ni so bini.
en: The people answered, No, you have not cheated us or oppressed us; you have not taken anything from anyone.

dag: Teem a niriba la, ka kpam ba jaande Naawuni zuɣu ni bɛ zom yi yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu din tahiri naŋgbankpeeni na la ni. Di ka buchi, di naɣ saɣindila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li.
en: Keep on telling everyone these truths. And warn them before God not to argue about words. Such arguments dont help anyone, and they ruin those who listen to them.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidib shɛb bɛn kpalim daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni n-di nɛma bɛ tizɔpaɣ maa zuɣu.
en: Jacob's other sons came and took everything they wanted. All this was done because of the horrible thing that had happened to their sister.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ lala ni o kahigila o daanfaani din galisi pam la wuhi palɔni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna ni, ka di yila o ni wuhi ti yurilim shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la ni na.
en: God did this so that his kindness to us who belong to Christ Jesus would clearly show for all time to come the amazing richness of his grace.

dag: Izraɛlnim ŋmanila gbuɣima ni kari doli piɛ shɛba n-wurim ba bahi. Tuuli, Asiria naa n-daa liri ba, ka pumpɔŋɔ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mi bahi naai ba.
en: Israelites are scattered sheep, driven away by lions. First the king of Assyria devoured them, and now Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar has ravaged them.

dag: Ka sapashin kpamba maa yi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa maa naai, sapashinnim bɛn leemi bɛn su tɔbbihi maa fukumsi.
en: Then, after the officers have finished speaking to the army, they must choose captains to lead the soldiers.

dag: Ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li? Bɛ daa zɔrila niriba, dama sokam zaa daa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But we cant say, Its of earthly origin. They said this because they were afraid of the crowd, because they all thought John was a prophet.

dag: Ka Gaad daa ka Dauda sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o, Cham Aruna Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili la ni ti me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: That same day Gad came to David and told him, Go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah from Jebus.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din viɛla.
en: Fools say in their hearts, There is no God. They are corrupt and do evil things; not one of them does anything good.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka m mali mmaŋa m-be kasi ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi a yɛlimaŋli maa puuni.
en: I made myself holy on their behalf so that they also would be made holy in the truth.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: and said: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.

dag: ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ na kpalim ʒiɛya. Di saha maa ka dɔbba ayi bɛn daa ye binyɛr nyɛlisira dii puhi zani paɣiba maa sani.
en: They did not understand this. While they were wondering about it, two men in shining clothes stood beside them.

dag: Ka hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ na kul dolila bɛ kal kura maa. Bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ bee n-doli o zalikpana la min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ ni daa zali Yaakubu so o ni daa boli Izraɛl la bihi ni bɛ dol la.
en: Even today, they live the same way they did in the past. They dont honor the Lord . They dont obey the rules and commands of the Israelites. They dont obey the law or the commands that the Lord gave to the children of Jacob.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord told Moses.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti chɛ ka yilli bili Izraɛl, ka n chɛ ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bɛ sani. Di saha ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When that happens, I will make the people of Israel strong and let you, Ezekiel, speak out where everyone can hear you, so that they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: A niriba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a kpambaliba bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni sahakam n-wumd a yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa gba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your people and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi zoli maa zuɣu na nti chɛ ka niriba maa paɣi bɛ situra, ka o mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: After Moses went down the mountain, he gave orders for the people to wash their clothes and make themselves acceptable to worship God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi naa ŋɔ ni gul o niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima. Bɛ ni ti tahiri tɔb gɔɣu ni kaman danyuriba la, ka ti yihi bɛ dimnim ʒim, ka di zɔri kaman sara maligu ʒim ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ laa ni n-kpaai pa bimbini zuɣu la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful will protect them. The soldiers will use rocks and slings to defeat the enemy. They will spill the blood of their enemies. It will flow like wine. It will be like the blood that is thrown on the corners of the altar!.

dag: Lala zuɣu di daa nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ din be alizanda ni ŋmahima la doli maligu malibu soli ŋɔ m-mali be kasi; amaa di nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni maŋmaŋ mali sara din so.
en: These things are copies of the real things that are in heaven. These copies had to be made clean by animal sacrifices. But the real things in heaven must have much better sacrifices.

dag: Ka a zaŋ binyɛra yɛli Aduna. Dina n-nyɛ: zabbanim mini alichɛbba ni binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni nyolɔrigu; ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛlɔrigu lo o.
en: Then take the priestly clothes and put them on Aaron: the tunic, the vests robe, the vest itself, and the chest pendant. Put the vest on him with the vests belt.

dag: Izraɛlnim nyɛla daba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛb niŋ dabitim ni? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka niriba fari ba?.
en: Is Israel a slave, a servant by birth? If not, why then has he become prey?.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa gɔb chinchin piɛlli kɔŋko doli Yisa, ka bɛ daa yɛn gbaag o gba.
en: One of those following Jesus was a young man wearing only a linen cloth. When the people tried to grab him.

dag: Di ni tɔɣisi binshɛŋa yɛla zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma so polo ŋɔ daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, ka o zuliya ni so mi daa bi tum maligumaaniba tuma bimbini gbini.
en: The person we are talking about belongs to another tribe, and no one ever served at the altar from that tribe.

dag: Ŋuna n-su teeku, dama ŋuna n-daa nam li; ŋuna n-su tiŋgbani din nyɛ o nuhi tuma la.
en: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ ni yino, ka nyɛ ŋun daa pun chaŋ Yisa san la bɔhi ba.
en: But Nicodemus was there in that group. He was the one who had gone to see Jesus before. He said.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ n dimnima ka daliri shɛli kani la, daa yimi teei bɔri ma kaman n nyɛla noombil la.
en: I was trapped like a bird by enemies who had no cause to hate me.

dag: N nia lɔbu nyɛla ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ŋɔ luɣ shɛli niriba ni na bi wum Masia yuli yɛla, ka di chɛ ka n ku me n-tam so mɛbu zuɣu.
en: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Ŋunkam nyu kɔbiliga ŋɔ kom, kɔnyuri ni lan gbaag o yaha.
en: Jesus answered, Everyone who drinks this water will get thirsty again.

dag: Ka o mayilinim maa daa zan o zaani n-zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Shɛkɛmnim zaa ti o, ka Shɛkɛmnim maa daa wuhi ni bɛ ni doli Abimilɛk, dama ni o nyɛla bɛ mabia.
en: So his mothers brothers spoke all these words on his behalf to all the leaders of Shechem. They decided to follow Abimelech because they said, Hes our relative.

dag: Daadam, yi mabihi mini yi zuliya niriba ni yi tab Izraɛlnim bɛn be tinzun tiŋ ni ŋɔ zaa ka Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛra, Bɛ chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ Yawɛ. Tinim ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ti ni ti su li.
en: Human one, when the people living in Jerusalem said, Theyve gone far from the LORD, and weve been given the land as an inheritance, they were talking about your family, your nearest relatives, the whole house of Israel, all of it.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni naa yɛliya, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ kpɛhi duu ka tir o bindirigu biɛlabiɛla mini kom biɛlabiɛla hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them to put Micaiah in prison. Give him nothing but bread and water to eat. Keep him there until I come home from the battle.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ biɛri ka yɛlibiɛri paara? Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri n-nyari ashaara?.
en: He sends trouble to the wicked and disaster to those who do wrong.

dag: A mabia Sɔdom taali m-bɔŋɔ: O min o bipuɣinsi daa malila karimbaani. Bɛ daa mali bindira pam, ka bɛ nyamma galisi, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔŋdi nandaamba mini bɛn ka.
en: They were arrogant and spoiled; they had everything they needed and still refused to help the poor and needy.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛlamnim polo Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni.
en: This is what the LORD told the prophet Jeremiah concerning Elam at the beginning of the rule of Judahs King Zedekiah.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa lan lab Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni chani ginda, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: They arrived once again in Jerusalem. As Jesus was walking in the Temple, the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and the elders came to him.

dag: Alahichilana yi tum alahichi bukɔbiga, ka kul be o nyɛvil ni yuui, m mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Naawuni yɛla ni so, bɛ ni zɔr o maa zuɣu.
en: Wrongdoers may commit a hundred crimes but still live long lives. But I also know that it will go well for those who fear God, for those who are reverent before God.

dag: Amaa ka wuntizɔriba bɛn kul gbibi be wuntizɔbo soli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi viɛla kul nyari yaa pahira.
en: But those who do right will continue to do what is right. Those who are not guilty grow stronger and stronger.

dag: Dama o pala ninsala kaman n ni nyɛ ninsal shɛm ŋɔ, ka n ni tooi garigi yɛl o shɛli, bee ka m min o ni ti chaŋ ʒiishee.
en: God is not a man like me—someone I could answer— so that we could come together in court.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N suhu kul yɛla Ziɔn sɔŋbu zuɣu, ka n zabiri nyuli ni suhuyiɣisili di zuɣu. .
en: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kul maari bɛn suhuri saɣindi suhuri ŋɔ daa maai ti suhuri Taitus kandina la zuɣu.
en: But God encourages those who are troubled, and he certainly encouraged us by bringing Titus to us.

dag: Yawɛ daalibarika chɛ ka nir leeri bundana, ka o bi zaŋdi suhugarigu pahiri di zuɣu.
en: The LORDs blessing makes a person rich, and no trouble is added to it.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahaz daa tim Asiria naa sani ti yɛl o ni o zo o kuŋa.
en: At that time King Ahaz sent for help from the king of Assyria.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du mɔɣili maa ni bɛ ti zaŋ naa malibu duhi na, ka niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm. Naa ni daa ti yɛn du mɔɣili maa saha shɛli, ka Shimɛi Gɛra bia maa daa kana ti damdi naa tooni.
en: to do the work of ferrying over the kings household and to do whatever pleased him. Geras son Shimei fell down before the king when he crossed the Jordan.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa Firawuna min o kpamba ninni, O daa yaag o jaaŋgbee maa n-fiɛbi kom din daa be Nail Mɔɣili maa ni, ka di zaa daa shiri leei ʒim.
en: So Moses and Aaron did what the Lord commanded. Aaron raised the walking stick and hit the water in the Nile River. He did this in front of Pharaoh and his officials. So all the water in the river changed into blood.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa shiri niŋ Judanima kaman Yawɛ ni zali shɛm ni o yihi ba o sani. Manaasa ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la.
en: The Lord commanded this to happen to Judah. In this way he would remove them from his sight. He did this because of all the sins that Manasseh committed.

dag: Dama di luhiya ti mini Naawuni Shia Kasi sani ni ti di ʒili ya ʒi tibisa n-naɣ pahila yɛl shɛŋa din simdi niŋbu ŋɔ.
en: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.

dag: Paɣ maa mi daa mali naɣipol kpabili o yiŋa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi yomyom chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi naɣipolli maa, ka o niŋ zim ŋɔri mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: At once the woman killed a calf that she had been fattening up. She cooked part of the meat and baked some thin bread.

dag: Mbaye tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu!.
en: Land of Judah, I am the Lord . Now listen to what I say!.

dag: O zaani tiŋgbani zaligu, ka o ni yɛli shɛm niŋdi yomyom.
en: He gives a command to the earth, and what he says is quickly done.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla Hiburunima? N gba nyɛla Hiburu. Bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya? N gba nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya. Bɛ nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi? N gba nyɛla o yaaŋa.
en: Are those people Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites ? So am I. Are they from Abrahams family? So am I.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ania zahimbu puuni mal alibarika, dama zahimbu maa yi buɣis o ka o nyaŋ li, o ni ti nya laara din nyɛ nyɛvil shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la.
en: Happy are those who remain faithful under trials, because when they succeed in passing such a test, they will receive as their reward the life which God has promised to those who love him.

dag: Yi ni tooi gaŋ niriba ti o? Yi ni tooi zabi Naawuni zuɣu?.
en: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?.

dag: Ɛliashib mini Joyada ni Jɔhanan ni Jadua saha la, bɛ daa sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba yɛla hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sabi luɣ shɛli polo shɛm la: Nyin gɔgbihira, yiɣisima n-neei kum ni! Ka Masia ti a neesim.
en: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋmamiya di tihi luhi. Kahimiya kuɣa duhi gili Jɛrusalɛm. Tiŋ shɛli din simdi tibidarigibo m-bala. Shɛli ka di puuni naɣila alaka niŋbu.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.

dag: ni sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi pihinunu fukumsi ni zuɣulaannima ni bɛn wuhiri niriba din niŋ kamaata ni alahiziba tumtumsa tumdiba ni bukpahinima.
en: commander and celebrity; counselor, clever craftsman, and cunning charmer.

dag: O mabia Ɛliɛza bia n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia, ka Rɛhabia bia nyɛ Jɛshaya, ka Jɛshaya bia nyɛ Jɔram, ka Jɔram bia nyɛ Zikiri, ka Zikiri bia nyɛ Shɛlomɔt.
en: These were Shubaels relatives: His relatives from Eliezer were Rehabiah, Eliezers son; Jeshaiah, Rehabiahs son; Joram, Jeshaiahs son; Zicri, Jorams son; and Shelomith, Zicris son.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi Kiburɔtihataava maa n-chaŋ Hazɛrɔt.
en: From there the people moved to Hazeroth, where they made camp.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm kaman di ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm la.
en: In fact, I tell you that Elijah has come, but they did to him whatever they wanted, just as it was written about him.

dag: din ni chɛ ka a mali a filiŋ min a vi a ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka di ti ba suhumahili maa zuɣu.
en: so that you will bear your disgrace and be humiliated by all that youve done to make them feel better.

dag: Dama yi yi bi pal alikauli zaŋ chaŋ laɣ yoya ŋɔ polo, ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi zaŋ azichi maŋli niŋ yi nuu ni?.
en: If you havent been faithful with worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?.

dag: Doo maa zuɣu ka n ni nyu bara, amaa n ku nyu bara maŋmaŋ zuɣu dina; n naɣ ni nyula bara mmaŋmaŋ chɔɣinsi zuɣu.
en: Ill brag about this man, but I wont brag about myself, except to brag about my weaknesses.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɔri ni bɛ mali Naawuni sizuura lubu biɛhigu Yisa Masia zuɣu ni bahi nya alaka.
en: In fact, anyone who wants to live a holy life in Christ Jesus will be harassed.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla, ka dunia ŋɔ nim wumdi tiri ba.
en: And they belong to the world, so what they say is from the world too. And the world listens to what they say.

dag: Naawuni ni yiɣisi zani ni o kari saria tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni la zuɣu.
en: when God rose up to establish justice, when God rose up to save all of the earths poor. Selah.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ma, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You made my enemies turn and run away. I destroyed those who hated me.

dag: So bi lan nyuri wain ka yiini yila; ka binnyuri kpɛma leei din to bɛn nyuri li sani.
en: No one drinks wine or sings; beer is bitter to its drinkers.

dag: N ni ti lo a alikauli ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will keep this solemn promise, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Amaa sokam zaa ni o saha: Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ tooni; ka o ni ti yɛn su shɛb o labbuna saha mi naanyi paya.
en: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.

dag: N lan kpahim baŋ yɛm mini jɛrilim ni yinyatali ni nyɛ shɛm; ka nya ka di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: But when I set my mind to understand wisdom, and also to understand madness and folly, I realized that this too was just wind chasing.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kuhi niŋ Musa; ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ka buɣim maa kpi.
en: So the people cried to Moses for help. He prayed to the Lord and the fire stopped burning.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la, ka so ku lan nya ba. Bɛ ni kari ba kaman yuŋ ʒii la.
en: Like a dream, he will fly away, never to be found. He will be chased away like a bad dream.

dag: Nir yi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o yiŋa, di ŋmanila noombila n-kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o tiɛɣu.
en: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria. Ka o bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz succeeded him as king.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ ya na ti paai Amɔrinim bɛn be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa tuhi ya, amaa ka n daa chɛ ka yi nyaŋ ba; ka n ku ba ka chɛ ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: then I brought you into the land east of the Jordan River. The Amorites were living there, and they fought you. But with my help, you defeated them, wiped them out, and took their land.

dag: Ka Sool daa chaŋ Amalɛknim maa ya nti sɔɣi dɔni vinvamli ni.
en: Then he and his men went to the city of Amalek and waited in ambush in a dry riverbed.

dag: Bee a gari ti yab Yaakubu ŋun daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ ti ti hal ka o min o bihi ni o biŋkɔbiri daa nyuri di kom la.
en: You arent greater than our father Jacob, are you? He gave this well to us, and he drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabihi pinaata mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will present an entirely burned offering, a food gift as a soothing smell to the LORD: thirteen bulls from the herd, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old. They will be flawless.

dag: Di yi zahira ni daɣiri tuma be yi sunsuuni, hal ka di tatabo ka chɛfirinim sunsuuni gba; dina n-nyɛ ni yi ni so zaŋ o ba paɣa dɔni.
en: Everyone has heard that there is sexual immorality among you. This is a type of immorality that isnt even heard of among the Gentiles—a man is having sex with his fathers wife!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa wuɣi lans ayi din nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri ka mali zoligo bansi niŋ li n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpila din tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu la. Daantaliga kam daa malila di laŋa.
en: The caps were decorated with seven rows of designs that looked like chains.

dag: O yi yɛn malila wumpaɣibo sara maligu, ŋun zaŋm bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim ni mali mah shɛŋa, ka dabindi ka di ni mini karikaasi shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛl ni mali mah shɛŋa m-mali wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa.
en: If you are offering it for thanksgiving, you must offer the following with the communal sacrifice of thanksgiving: unleavened flatbread mixed with oil, unleavened thin loaves spread with oil, and flatbread of choice flour thoroughly mixed with oil.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, n yi yɔhi yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: My people, I will open your graves and bring you up out of your graves, and then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Sool ni daa ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee, o daa tuh o dimnim bɛn be bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa. O daa tuhi Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnima ni Ɛdomnima ni Zɔba nanima ni Filistianima; o ni daa tuhi shɛb zaa, o daa dila nasara.
en: Saul secured his kingship over Israel. He fought against his enemies on every side: against Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the king of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he was victorious.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun ka buchi ka saɣim, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu leeg o kom nyuri ŋɔ yɛla?.
en: People are even worse. They are disgusting and dirty. They drink up evil like water.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa dihili ni ti nyɛla dɛde hal bɛ ni mali tarili bɛ dɔɣiriba ni kɔhiri bɛ daŋ ni neen shɛŋa ni la zaa yoli.
en: He is to receive the same amount of food as the other priests, and he may keep whatever his family sends him.

dag: nti zaŋ Izraɛlnim ni daa zaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma maa ti ba. Ka niriba maa daa na kul zaŋdi pina na ni bɛ suhuyubu asiba kam nti tir o.
en: and he gave them the gifts that the people of Israel had donated for building the place of worship. In fact, so much was being given each morning.

dag: Bɛ mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni biŋgbamda balibu kam ni noonsi balibu kam ni binyiɣira zaa n-daa kpe di ni.
en: With them went every kind of animal, domestic and wild, large and small, and every kind of bird.

dag: O daa yɛli ma, Izraɛl nyɛla n dabili, a sani ka n yɛn nya jilima.
en: saying to me, You are my servant, Israel, in whom I show my glory.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli yi sariakaritiba maa, Wummiya yi niriba yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka karimiya yɛtɔɣa din be nir min o kpee sunsuuni zaŋ tabili saamba bɛn be yi sani saria ka di tuhi.
en: At that time I instructed them, Listen to the disputes that come up among your people. Judge every dispute fairly, whether it concerns only your own people or involves foreigners who live among you.

dag: Chɛ ka o zuliya kpi zaa; ka o yuli kpihim ʒiɛmana din pahir ayi ni.
en: May his family come to an end. May his name be unknown to future generations.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zani baɣil o ka yɛli, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a ni do tiŋgban shɛli ni ŋɔ ti a min a zuliya;.
en: Suddenly the LORD was standing on it and saying, I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya N je paɣ yihibo, n je ni so niŋ o paɣa kiŋkansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi nyɛ bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, says, I hate divorce, and I hate the cruel things that men do. So protect your spiritual unity. Dont cheat on your wife.

dag: Bɛn zaa be n san la puhir a. Puhimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ti daadiini soli zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu ni la ti ma. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: All the people with me here send you their greetings. Give my greetings to those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.

dag: Ŋun boli ya maa nyɛla ŋun ni niŋ li, dama o nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim.
en: He who calls you will do it, because he is faithful.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnima nti ku ba, ka n daa bi ŋmaligi labi n nyaaŋa hal ka ti naai bɛ balibu zaa.
en: I chased my enemies and destroyed them! I didnt come home until I finished them off.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe ma yim maa wuhiya ni bɛ taali bi paai Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa taali.
en: Then the LORD said to me: Unfaithful Israel is less guilty than disloyal Judah.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ chamiya ti bom mɔri yi n-ni nya li luɣ shɛli na, amaa yi tuma bi yɛn filim hal biɛla gba. .
en: Go and get the straw on your own, wherever you can find it. But your work wont be reduced at all.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim Mizipa n-tooi kom booi bahi Yawɛ tooni nimaani ka lo noli dindali maa ka yɛli, Ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ka Samuɛl daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana Mizipa maa.
en: So they assembled at Mizpah, and they drew water and poured it out in the LORDs presence. They fasted that same day and confessed, We have sinned against the LORD. Samuel served as judge of the Israelites at Mizpah.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa pii ma zali hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma, ka boli ma o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: But God in his grace chose me even before I was born, and called me to serve him. And when he decided.

dag: Ŋuna n-fa ti zibisim yiko ni bahi, ka zaŋ ti ni alaafee nti kpɛhi o Biyurigu la nam ni.
en: He rescued us from the control of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of the Son he loves.

dag: n ni teei n ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa alikauli shɛli maa yɛla; ka kom mi ku lan niŋ kokpɛɣu n-di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: I will remember my promise to you and to all other living creatures. Never again will I let floodwaters destroy all life.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na chana, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna nti tiriti wuhir o Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duri.
en: Jesus left the Temple area and was walking away. But his followers came to him to show him the Temples buildings.

dag: Jɔnatan ni daa yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa sani maa zuɣu tampiŋ kara ayi n-daa doya; yini daa dola yaɣili ka yini mi do yaɣ din la. Tampiŋ yini yuli daa boonila Bɔzɛz ka yini mi yuli booni Sɛne.
en: Jonathan was planning to go through a pass to get to the Philistine camp. There was a large rock on each side of the pass. The large rock on one side was named Bozez. The large rock on the other side was named Seneh.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi ti ba pin shɛli noo ti gba ni daa niŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛda ka o ti ti la, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ma ka n ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni.
en: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?.

dag: Ka dansarika gula maa daa yɛli Pool ni sariakaritib maa tim na ti yɛl o ni o yoom ba bahi ka bɛ chaŋ; dinzuɣu ni bɛ yim n-chaŋ ni suhuʒia.
en: So the jailer told Paul, The officials have sent an order for you and Silas to be released. You may leave, then, and go in peace.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa lab Giligal sansani maa ni.
en: Then Joshua and all the Israelites returned to their camp at Gilgal.

dag: Nam ʒiishee maa daa malila dura diba ayɔbu, ka napɔna tambu shee din daa tuɣi nam ʒiishee maa nyɛ salima. Nam ʒiishee maa yaɣili kam daa malila nuhi pabu shee, ka bɛ daa mali gbuɣima ayi kɔtomsi n-zali baɣili nuhi pabu shee maa.
en: Six steps led up to the throne, and there was a footstool attached to it, covered with gold. There were arms on each side of the throne, and the figure of a lion stood at each side.

dag: To, bidibis ayi maa ni ŋuni n-daa lee tum o ba yubu? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Kpɛm san la. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, farigudeeriba mini pagɔra daŋ ya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Which of the two sons obeyed his father? The Jewish leaders answered, The first son. Jesus said to them, The truth is, you are worse than the tax collectors and the prostitutes. In fact, they will enter Gods kingdom before you enter.

dag: Ka Zakaria daa nya malaika maa ka di gar o, ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pam.
en: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi gba daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were priests.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a kul nyɛ dabari sahakam, ka so ku lan ʒini a fɔntinsi ni yaha. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will turn you into an eternal desolation. Your cities wont be inhabited, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi Filistia doo maa zuɣu maa n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, amaa ka daa lee zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma ti niŋ ŋun Dauda maŋmaŋ suɣili ni.
en: David took Goliath's head to Jerusalem, but he kept Goliath's weapons in his own tent.

dag: Maligumaaniba n-daa nyɛ: Joyarib bia Jɛdaya mini Jachin.
en: Four priests settled in Jerusalem. The first was Jedaiah; he was the son of Joiarib and the uncle of Jachin.

dag: Teeku, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa zo? Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa ŋmaligi lab a nyaaŋa?.
en: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.

dag: O daa yɛli Yisifu zuliya: Yawɛ daalibarika ni be o tiŋgban ni m-pahi zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani puuni pin gahinda.
en: Then he told Joseph: I pray that his land is blessed by God: with heavens gifts from above, with the deep waters stretching out underneath.

dag: ni muli ni wolisi ni kparibuhi ni bambuhi.
en: deer, wild sheep, wild goats, or antelopes—.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, Pirigim a ni ye binyɛr shɛli pa zuɣusaa ŋɔ n-teei li sɔŋ. Ka o daa pirigi li na, ka o tooi chi ka di ni paai kaman kilɔgiram pisi n-kpaai niŋ o di ni, ka kpuɣi li sɔŋ o ka o ʒi li kuli.
en: Boaz said to her, Take off your cloak and spread it out here. She did, and he poured out almost fifty pounds of barley and helped her lift it to her shoulder. Then she returned to town with it.

dag: Ka n daa ta ba daɣiri bɛmaŋmaŋ pina tibu ni din nyɛ bɛ bidib tuuli kam zaŋ mali sara puuni ni di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri saɣim din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I let them make themselves filthy with their gifts. They even began to sacrifice their own firstborn children. In this way I would destroy them. Then they would know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannim dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa. Ka bɛ daa kana ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa.
en: The men who had been taking care of the pigs ran away and spread the news in the town and among the farms. People went out to see what had happened.

dag: ni Ɛliaba ŋun daa nyɛ Shaalibɔn nir la ni Jashɛn bihi ni Jɔnatan.
en: Eliahba from Shaalbon; Jashen the Gizonite; Jonathan.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim ninvuɣ yoya pah omaŋ zuɣu n-leei bɛ salo maa zuɣulana. Dauda ni daa ku o dimnim Sirianim la nyaaŋa ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa. Ka Rɛzɔn min o niriba maa daa chaŋ ti ʒini Damaskus, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o leei Damaskus naa.
en: Rezon recruited men and became leader of a band when David was killing them. They went to Damascus, stayed there, and ruled it.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, deemiya saɣisigu, di yi pa lala n ni je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛn ya, ka chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.

dag: Yawɛ yi bahi li noli, wula ka di lee yɛn tooi fo? O zal li mi ni di liri Ashikɛlɔnnim mini bɛn be teeku noli.
en: But how can my sword rest, when I have commanded it to attack Ashkelon and the seacoast?.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ku ti Duuma Yisa mini anabinima, ka daa niŋ ti gba alaka la. Bɛ kul tumdila din bi tiɣiri Naawuni nini, ka kul guri ninsalinim soli.
en: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.

dag: Adam ni daa dɔɣi Sɛt maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Seth was born, Adam lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni zali zaligu, ka dam Izraɛlnim bɛn be zuliya kam tinsi ni. M mi yɛn niŋ ba mi kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la, hal ka kabiɛl yini gba ku lu tiŋa.
en: Look, I am giving orders, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as one sifts dirt with a screen, but no pebble will fall to the ground.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, neemiya, neemiya! Yiɣisimiya zani. Yi nyu Yawɛ ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo binnyur shɛl la buɣi. Yi nyu li, ka di chɛ ka yi chani laana.
en: Wake up! Wake up! Jerusalem, get up! The Lord was very angry with you. So you were punished. It was like a cup of poison you had to drink, and you drank it all.

dag: Mani m-piig a dɔɣiriba Lɛvinima Izraɛlnim ni; bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni su shɛba; ka o zaŋ ba ti a ni bɛ tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma.
en: I am the one who has chosen your relatives the Levites from among the Israelites as a gift to you. They are dedicated to me, so that they can carry out their duties in the Tent.

dag: Di saha maa ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: On the way, there was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She came close behind Jesus and touched the bottom of his coat.

dag: Bɛn daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba pahi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: There was a total of , priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ ka yi nya, yi suhu ni paligi, ka yi nya kpiɔŋ mini alaafee, ka zoori kaman momaha la; ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deeri n noli; ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisiri bahiri n dimnim zuɣu.
en: When you see this, your heart will rejoice; your entire being will flourish like grass. The LORDs power will be known among his servants, but his fury among his enemies.

dag: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba ni Lɛvinima ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi tinsi ni ti puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Enjoy it with your children, your servants, and the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows who live in your towns.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka sanzali zani tiŋgban ni mini di zoya zuɣu ni puri ni zaŋ tabili tihi puri ni ni olivi kpam tihi puri ni ni binshɛɣukam din yiri tiŋgban ni na; ka chɛ ka di miisim maa tabili ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ nuhi tuuni kam. .
en: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.

dag: Ka binfalafala daa be binnɛma maa zuɣusaa ka nyaɣisira kaman bɛ ni booni shɛli kirisital la.
en: The shape above the heads of the creatures was a dome; it was like glittering ice stretched out over their heads.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi sizuura lubu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ na titali. Ŋuna n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Because the LORD Most High is awesome, he is the great king of the whole world.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ m-piig a leei maligumaana n-zali maligumaana Jɛhɔiada zaashee ni a guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka yinyaa yi zaŋ omaŋ leeg a anabi, yi n-gbaam o n-zaŋ zoligo ga o, ka zaŋ baŋ yɛl o nyiŋgol ni.
en: You said to Zephaniah: The LORD has appointed you priest in charge of the LORDs temple instead of Jehoiada. You are responsible for putting every madman who prophesies into stocks and neck irons.

dag: Ŋunkam mali maligu ti buɣili ka pa ni Yawɛ kɔŋko, yin kum dilana.
en: Condemn to death anyone who offers sacrifices to any god except to me, the Lord .

dag: Baalihanan ni daa ti kpi, Hadad n-daa di nam zan o zaani, o ya yuli n-daa booni Pai, o paɣ yuli n-daa booni Mɛhɛtabɛl, Mɛhɛtabɛl ma yuli n-daa booni Matirɛd, ka o yabipaɣa mi yuli daa booni Mɛzahab.
en: When Baal Hanan died, Hadad became the new king. Hadads city was named Pau. Hadads wife was named Mehetabel. Mehetabel was Matreds daughter. Matred was Mezahabs daughter.

dag: Yi yi ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, ka kahim yi wain naai, yin zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu.
en: Once you have collected the food and drink you need, perform the Festival of Booths for seven days.

dag: Dinzuɣu lzraɛlnima, baŋmiya ni Yisa so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu maa ka Naawuni zaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ nim zaa Duuma ni bɛ Masia.
en: So, all the people of Israel should know this for certain: God has made Jesus to be Lord and Messiah. He is the man you nailed to the cross.

dag: Ka buɣim daa doli tiŋgbani dambu maa nyaaŋa na, amaa ka Yawɛ daa ka buɣim maa gba ni. Ka kukol balli zaɣ bilifu daa ti doli buɣim maa dibu nyaaŋa na.
en: After the earthquake there was a fire—but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire there was the soft whisper of a voice.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa mini Izraɛlnima n-daa tuhi nyaŋ nanim maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ dabili Musa daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana n-ti Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses the LORDs servant and the Israelites struck them down. Moses the LORDs servant gave their land as property to the Reubenites, Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba mini naa daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: Then the leaders of Judah and King Rehoboam were sorry and humbled themselves. They said, The Lord is right.

dag: Ka din gari di zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yɛda niŋbu leei bintaɣirisi din ni chɛ ka yi tooi tiligi Sintani piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la nyɔɣibu.
en: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o niriba maa, Sokam nyaɣim o takɔbi! Ka Dauda gba daa nyaɣ o takɔbi; ka niriba kɔbisinahi daa pah o zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka chɛ niriba kɔbisiyi ka bɛ mi kpalim guli bɛ nɛma.
en: Everybody get your swords! David ordered. They all strapped on their swords. Two hundred men stayed behind to guard the camp, but the other followed David.

dag: Ka bɛ daa go n-gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa n-daa mali ti paai tin shɛli din yuli booni Pafɔs. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chirigi do so ŋun nyɛ bukpaha ka o yuli booni Baajiisɛs. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia nira ŋun nyɛ anab ʒirilana.
en: They traveled throughout the island until they arrived at Paphos. There they found a certain man named Bar-Jesus, a Jew who was a false prophet and practiced sorcery.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o suhu ni, Di simdi ni n zaŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli sɔɣi Ibrahimma?.
en: And the Lord said to himself, I will not hide from Abraham what I am going to do.

dag: O ni chɛ ka bidibbihi nyɛ bɛ nanima, ka biliɛri su ba.
en: I will make youths their commanders; mischief makers will rule over them.

dag: N yura, niŋm yomyom, be kaman molifu la bee kparibua ŋun be tulaale tihi zoya zuɣu.
en: Hurry, my lover! Be like a gazelle or a young deer on the mountains of spice.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa kul jiɣindi sahakam; amaa yi Ba Naawuni mi ni di zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa yi tum din chihi Anabi Musa zaligu, bɛ kur o mi niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira zuɣu ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: This is the work of the Gershonite clans in the dwelling. Their responsibility will be under Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

dag: Kpahimmiya noonsi bɛn yiɣiri ŋɔ: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna; amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-dihiri ba. Ka yi bi mali bukaata pam gari ba?.
en: Look at the birds in the sky. They dont sow seed or harvest grain or gather crops into barns. Yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Arent you worth much more than they are?.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa lan yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba gba di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni o ti yɛl o Izraɛlnim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni lo ni bɛ niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli zaa yɛla.
en: Abner also spoke directly to the Benjaminites. He then went to inform David in person at Hebron regarding everything that all Israel and the house of Benjamin were willing to do.

dag: Bɛ bihi ʒiɛla bɛ tooni, ka bɛ nina nya bɛ yaansi.
en: Their children are always with them, their offspring in their sight.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn yɛri dari, Neemiya gom ni! Bee n-yɛri kuɣili din fo n-doya, Yiɣisim zan a tolitoli! ŋɔ zuɣu. Di ni tooi wuhi so binshɛli? Nyama, salima mini anzinfa ka bɛ zaŋ mal li, ka di bi vuhiri hal baabiɛla.
en: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, Get up and do something.

dag: dama bɛn kpalim maa ni ti yi Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na n-galisi pam. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o ni chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: Those who remain will go out from Jerusalem, and those who survive will go out from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of heavenly forces will do this.

dag: So yi zaŋ liɣiri bee binshɛli nti puh o kpee sɔŋbu, ka bɛ zu bini maa dilan yiŋa, ka bɛ gbaai tayiɣ maa, di simdi ka tayiɣ maa yo bini maa zuɣu ʒii buyi.
en: When someone entrusts money or other items to another person to keep safe and they are stolen from the other persons house and the thief is caught, the thief must pay back double.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ.
en: and he asked them, Whose face and name are these.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ yi yɛn me duu maa dikili, bɛn zaŋm kuɣa me kulis ata, ka zaŋ dari mi n-niŋ kuliga zaɣ yini n-tam di zuɣu. Ka yihi nam fukumsi kpanjɔɣu ni liɣiri n-yo duu maa mɛbu tuma samli.
en: The walls are to be built with one layer of wood on top of each three layers of stone. All expenses are to be paid by the royal treasury.

dag: Ka bɛ yiŋlan maa daa yuug o gɔrim maa polo hal ti kuna, ka bɛ min o daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mal o liɣiri maa laasabu.
en: Now after a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

dag: Ti Duuma be a nudirigu polo. O ni ti nyaŋ nanima o suhuyiɣisili dali.
en: My master, by your strong hand, God has crushed kings on his day of wrath.

dag: Amaa yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa nyɛla zoya mini vinvama tiŋgbɔŋ, ka saa miri nimaani.
en: but the land that you are about to enter is a land of mountains and valleys, a land watered by rain.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani nyɛla Kɔɔban .
en: But you teach that people can say to their father or mother, I have something I could use to help you, but I will not use it for you. I will give it to God.

dag: ni Oholibama ni Ɛla ni Pinɔn ni.
en: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon.

dag: Ka Kɔra ŋun daa nyɛ Izar bia ka nyɛ Kɔhat ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir yaaŋa la mini Ɛliab bihi Datan mini Abiram ni Pɛlɛt bia On.
en: Korah—Izhars son, Kohaths grandson, and Levis great-grandson—with Dathan and Abiram, Eliabs sons, and On, Peleths son, descendants of Reuben.

dag: Ka saha daa ti paai ka Yisa min o tuumba maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: When the hour came, Jesus took his place at the table with the apostles.

dag: Yi yi kariti ma saria bee dunianim yi kariti ma saria m baɣa kani; hal n gba kariti mmaŋ saria.
en: I couldnt care less if Im judged by you or by any human court; I dont even judge myself.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ Uzia ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: All the people of Judah chose Amaziah's sixteen-year-old son Uzziah to succeed his father as king. .

dag: Di saha ka paɣ so daa tuhir o soli na. O daa yɛla nɛma kaman pagɔrili la, ka o lihibu mali kɔre ni kukolimahim.
en: And then she met him; she was dressed like a prostitute and was making plans.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Izraɛl kpambaliba daa yiɣisi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni chani gindi.
en: At the end of three days the officers went through the middle of the camp.

dag: Yihimiya tɔbbihi maa tarili ni bin yini bini kɔbisinu kam puuni ti Yawɛ zaka. Di yi nyɛ ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi.
en: You will offer as tribute to the LORD from each warrior who went into battle one living being in five hundred, whether human, oxen, donkeys, or flocks.

dag: ka o tiligi ti, ka di daa pala ti ni tum wuntia tuun shɛŋa zuɣu, amaa o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu ka o paɣ ti ka ti yi, ka ti ti nyɛvil palli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka ti nya biɛr palli saha shɛl la.
en: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.

dag: O yi nyaŋ ma ku ma, dindina ti ni leei yi daba, amaa ka m mi yi nyaŋ o ku o, yi gba ni leei ti daba tumdi ti tuma.
en: If he wins and kills me, we will be your slaves; but if I win and kill him, you will be our slaves.

dag: Ka Pool daa be yil shɛl ni o ni daa haayi duu la yuun muna ayi. Ka o daa kul tiri sokam bɛn kan o sanna soli ka bɛ nyar o.
en: For two years Paul lived in a place he rented for himself, and there he welcomed all who came to see him.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa yɛl o ma, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a suhirila Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili maa n-tiri Adɔnija? Dindina suhim ma nam ŋɔ gba ti o; dama o nyɛla m biɛli, ka maligumaana Abiata mini Zɛruya bia Jɔab la be o polo.
en: King Solomon answered his mother, Why are you asking me to give Abishag to Adonijah? Why dont you just ask me to give him the whole kingdom! After all, he is my older brother, and both Abiathar the priest and Joab support him.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mɛshulɛmɛt. O daa nyɛla Haruzi ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtiba nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Amon was years old when he became king, and he ruled for two years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Meshullemeth; she was Haruzs daughter and was from Jotbah.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa kana ti dii ŋme Naa Hɛrɔd o ni daa bi tiri Naawuni jilima la zuɣu, ka zunzuya wɔɣ o ni ŋ-ŋub o ka o kpi.
en: Herod did not give the glory to God. So an angel of the Lord caused him to get sick. He was eaten by worms inside him, and he died.

dag: Jɛra tuma nyɛla din gbarigiri ba, hal ka bɛ bi lan mi yiŋ soli gba.
en: Only someone too stupid to find his way home would wear himself out with work.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun yɛn be yi sani niŋ daba ayi bee ŋun yɛn be yi sani sahakam o yi bɔri ni o mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la, ŋun niŋmi kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Foreigners will live among you. If they give gifts to please the Lord , they must offer them the same way you do.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guui li zali hal ni asiba kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka di daa bi saɣim bee n-wɔɣi zunzuya.
en: So the people saved the rest of the food for the next day, as Moses had commanded, and none of the food spoiled or had worms in it.

dag: Kumiya o bihi bɛ ba taali zuɣu. Di chɛliya ka bɛ so ti yiɣisina ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ bee m-me tinsi zali dunia ŋɔ ni yaha.
en: Prepare to kill his children, because their father is guilty. His children will never take control of the land. They will never fill the world with their cities.

dag: Ka Harim bia Malikija mini Pahatimɔab bia Hashub daa mali me yaɣ shɛli mini Bɔrɔbɔro Shɛbu Duri Shee Pia la.
en: Malchijah, Harims son, and Hasshub, Pahath-moabs son, repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.

dag: Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina.
en: John said, Change your hearts and lives, because Gods kingdom is now very near. .

dag: O ni daa kul suhiri Yawɛ maa, ka Ɛli lihir o noli.
en: Hannah continued to pray to the Lord for a long time, and Eli watched her lips.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani ŋun yɔhim dunia zaa la min o malaikanima m-bahi dunia ni na.
en: The huge dragon was thrown out—that ancient serpent, named the Devil, or Satan, that deceived the whole world. He was thrown down to earth, and all his angels with him.

dag: Nyamiya! N ni siɣisi ya m Ba Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la na, dinzuɣu kul benya Jɛrusalɛm hal ti deei yiko shɛli din yɛn yi alizanda ni na maa.
en: Look, Im sending to you what my Father promised, but you are to stay in the city until you have been furnished with heavenly power.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa buɣisi n-kpe ka di mali shaara mini sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duri maa zuɣusaa.
en: On top of these stones there were other expensive stones and cedar beams.

dag: Ti mabihi, di kpala talahi ni ti kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam. Di tuhiya ni ti niŋ lala, dama yi yɛda kul zoorimi, ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab sani gba kul zoori pahira.
en: Our friends, we must thank God at all times for you. It is right for us to do so, because your faith is growing so much and the love each of you has for the others is becoming greater.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli, N daa ŋma Jɔn zuɣu; ka ŋuni mi yɛla ka n lee lan wumdi ŋɔ? Ka daa lo nia ni o nya Yisa.
en: Herod said, I had John's head cut off; but who is this man I hear these things about? And he kept trying to see Jesus.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka niriba maa daa kar o naba nti bo n-nya o, ka bi saɣi ni o lan woligi ba;.
en: When daybreak arrived, Jesus went to a deserted place. The crowds were looking for him. When they found him, they tried to keep him from leaving them.

dag: Hal bihi tuma ni ka niriba baŋdi bɛ ni nyɛ shɛba, bɛ tuma yi nyɛla din viɛl ka tuhi.
en: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.

dag: Karimbaandan maa ni tuui lu ka so ku beni ŋun ni yiɣis o zali. Ka n ti nyo o fɔntinsi buɣim, ka di di binshɛɣukam din gil o.
en: Proud Babylon will stumble and fall, and no one will help her get up. I will start a fire in her towns. That fire will completely burn up everyone around her.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibi fifinyiiŋa gba ku yiɣisi fashee di zaa ti naɣ niŋla pali.
en: I assure you that nothing will disappear from the law until heaven and earth are gone. The law will not lose even the smallest letter or the smallest part of a letter until it has all been done.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛl kpamba ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi daa chaŋ Obɛdɛdom yiŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: So King David, the leaders of Israel, and the military commanders went to the house of Obed Edom to get the Covenant Box, and they had a great celebration.

dag: O daa bela Paran mɔɣu ni, ka o ma daa ti bo Ijipti paɣ ti o.
en: His mother found a wife for him in Egypt. They continued to live in the Paran desert.

dag: O tɔbbihi ni shɛb ni ti kana ti daɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sansani. Ka o ni ti kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu din tahiri saɣiŋgu na zali di zaani.
en: His forces will come and make the sanctuary fortress impure. They will stop the daily sacrifice and set up a desolating monstrosity.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Izraɛl toondaannima n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb maa, ka niriba maa daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu.
en: We praise you, Lord ! Our soldiers volunteered, ready to follow you.

dag: Yawɛ, so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A galisiya, ka a yuli tibisa, ka mali yiko.
en: Lord , there is no one like you. You are great! Your name is great and powerful!.

dag: Amaa ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ niriba anii n-zo n-tiligi Jɔhanan nuu ni kuli Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Ishmael and eight of his men escaped and went to Ammon.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali dahima, yin chɛliya ka ti tum sokam zaa tuun suma, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ mabi yinsi yɛda niŋbu puuni la.
en: When we have the opportunity to do good to anyone, we should do it. But we should give special attention to those who are in the family of believers.

dag: Amaa ni malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin ni ti yɛn piɛb o kikaa dahin shɛl la ka Naawuni daashili yɛl shɛŋa o ni daa yɛl o daanabinim la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: But when the seventh angel blows his trumpet, then God will accomplish his secret plan, as he announced to his servants, the prophets.

dag: Di dabisi tuuli dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka miriya ka yi tum tuma.
en: On the first day of this festival you must rest from your work and come together for worship.

dag: Amaa yi ni da dab so ka gun o, o ni tooi di bindirigu maa o gunibu nyaaŋa.
en: Your slaves may eat the meal if they have been circumcised.

dag: Di saha ka shɛb dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka pɔb o nina ka ŋmɛr o ka yɛra, Wuhim ti a daanabitali ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa gba ŋmɛr o.
en: Some began to spit on him. Some covered his face and hit him, saying, Prophesy! Then the guards took him and beat him.

dag: A sujee naai ti mi zaa; ka a suhuyiɣisili nyaŋ ti zaa.
en: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee m-bilina zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: But some of the seed fell on good ground. There it began to grow, and it made grain. Some plants made times more grain, some times more, and some times more.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛri alikauli palli yɛla maa, di wuhiya ni o lihi tuuli din maa la zaɣ kurili. Ka binshɛli din kurigiri ka kpaari mi ku yuui ka leei din ku lan beni yaha.
en: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti zaŋ n niriba maa chaŋ n ni daa wuh a luɣ shɛli maa. Nyama, m malaika ni be a tooni. Amaa bɛ tibidarigibo biɛɣu yi ti neei, n ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Now go, lead the people to the place I told you about. Remember that my angel will guide you, but the time is coming when I will punish these people for their sin.

dag: M puhir a a ni deei n suhigu ka leei n tiligira ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Lord, I thank you for answering my prayer. I thank you for saving me.

dag: Yinim mi n-nyɛ n shɛhiranim dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha ni.
en: you must tell everything that has happened.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla. A ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o lee naa la yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, bɛ maan o la ansarisi.
en: the ones your enemies, LORD, use— the ones they use to abuse every step your anointed one takes.

dag: Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi pirigili yim bɛn daa be o sani daa kab chaŋ ti zanila tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka bɛ pirigili ʒii buyi mi kab ti lu bɛn be mɔɣu ni maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: Abimelech and his company charged forward and took a position at the entrance of the citys gate, while the other two companies charged at all those in the fields and attacked them.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi biŋgolinsi maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ tanti yini.
en: Make fifty copper clasps. Put the clasps into the loops and join the tent together so that it becomes one whole structure.

dag: Di chɛliya ka wuhibu balibubalibu mini wuhibu kɔŋkɔba din be di ko la birigi ya; di niŋ kamaata ni ti nya suhukpaŋsibo la Naawuni daanfaani puuni, ka pa ni bindira chihibu din bi sɔŋdi bɛn doli di wuhibu sol la.
en: Dont let all kinds of strange teachings lead you into the wrong way. Depend only on Gods grace for spiritual strength, not on rules about foods. Obeying those rules doesnt help anyone.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahigi alizanda nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa o bi kahigi li wuhi bɛn kpalim bɛna.
en: Jesus answered, The knowledge about the secrets of the Kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
