dag: O suhi ma mi ni n chɛ ka o doli kachɛriba maa nyaaŋa yihiri kayiha. Ka o kul bela o tuma ni asibaasi la zaa zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ, o na kul bi ʒini vuhi biɛla gba.
en: She asked if she could pick up grain left by the harvest workers, and she has been working all morning without a moment's rest.

dag: N yi ti saɣim Ijiptinim nam sulinsi, ka bɛ bara nyubu yiko naai, wuntaŋ ni ni ti zibigi Tɛhafinɛhɛs, ka sagbana ti lim tiŋ maa. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ tiŋkpansi niriba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: At Tehaphnehes the day will go dark when I break Egypts yoke and bring an end to its proud strength. A cloud will cover it, and the towns around it will go into captivity.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila wɔbinyina ka bɛ zaŋ me pii zali. A nina ŋmanila Hɛshibɔn kom din do m-miri Batirabim dunol la. A nyee ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn pia din be Damaskus polo la.
en: Your neck is like ivory, and your eyes sparkle like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-Rabbim. Your nose is beautiful like Mount Lebanon above the city of Damascus.

dag: ka o ni yihi bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ la n-gbib li omaŋmaŋ nuu ni na. O ti zaŋm biŋkpam mini bimbihili na, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bimbihili maa gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: Your own hands must bring the LORDs food gifts. You will bring the fat with the breast so that the breast can be lifted as an uplifted offering before the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N wum Mɔabnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla, ka wum Ammɔnnim turi yɛla. Bɛ maani n niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara ni bɛ ni fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The Lord Almighty says, I have heard the people of Moab and Ammon insulting and taunting my people, and boasting that they would seize their land.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Dama Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba. .
en: for the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma min o kurigu gbaɣino yɛli Dauda, ka zaŋ kurigu zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: Saul had his own military clothes and armor put on David, and he gave David a bronze helmet to wear.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Bahim niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di ka gbe nimaani, dama kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni.
en: Late in the afternoon, the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, No one lives in this place. Send the people away. They need to find food and places to sleep in the farms and towns around here.

dag: Nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi nyɛla yɔhiŋ, ka viɛlim nyɛ din naara, amaa paɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu.
en: Charm is deceptive and beauty fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.

dag: Dama noli zaɣisibu mini baɣibuɣibo zaa alahichi nyɛla yim. Ka tipawumli mini buɣijɛmbo mi nyɛ alahichi yini. Ka a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu ŋɔ zuɣu, o gba zaɣisiya ni a ku lan nyɛ naa.
en: because rebellion is as bad as the sin of divination; arrogance is like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected what the LORD said, he has rejected you as king.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib gba daa maan o ansarisi ka yɛri taba, O daa tiligi shɛba ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: In the same way, the chief priests were making fun of him among themselves, together with the legal experts. He saved others, they said, but he cant save himself.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Ninive naa, ka o yiɣis o nam ʒiishee m-pirig o nam binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buɣu pili n-teei ʒini tampiligim mahili ni wuhi bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When word of it reached the king of Nineveh, he got up from his throne, stripped himself of his robe, covered himself with mourning clothes, and sat in ashes.

dag: Ka Aduna zaŋ Lɛvinim maa zali Yawɛ tooni kaman Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahi zuɣusaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi tum Yawɛ tuma.
en: Aaron will give the Levites to the Lord as an offering from the Israelites. Then the Levites will be ready to do their special work for the Lord .

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu! Yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani la kul chanimi gindi ŋumdi kaman gbuɣinli la m-bɔri ni o gbaai so ŋubi.
en: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli, o ni daa nam ninsala n-niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu; ka o suhu daa saɣim pam di zuɣu.
en: The Lord was sorry that he had made people on the earth. It made him very sad in his heart.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla o ni daa nyaŋ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa diri ʒi Ashitarɔt din be Ɛdirɛi la nyaaŋa.
en: This was after the defeat of Sihon, the Amorite king who ruled in Heshbon, and Og, Bashans king, who ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni tam pagɔr so yɛla ŋɔ, kpuɣim a mɔɣilo chaŋ gili tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛm biŋkumda ka di nyaɣisa, ka yili yila pam ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan teeg a yɛla.
en: Take a harp, go around the city, forgotten prostitute. Play well, sing many songs, so theyll remember you.

dag: Naftali ŋmanila walinyaŋ so ŋun gɔr o yubu, ka dɔɣi bi viɛla.
en: Naphtali is like a deer running free, and his words are beautiful.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, N jilima naaya. N ni daa niŋdi binshɛŋa zaa tahima Yawɛ san la naaya.
en: I thought: My future is gone, as well as my hope from the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Daniɛl ka naa sanna ka naa maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ʒi dab shɛba yi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na yino, ka a yuli booni Daniɛl la?.
en: When Daniel was brought in, the king said: So you are Daniel, one of the captives my father brought back from Judah!.

dag: Ka Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm tuma maa zaa min o ni daa me yil shɛl la.
en: The queen of Sheba heard Solomon's wisdom and saw the palace he had built.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn chɛ ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ kpuɣi Ilaija chaŋ alizanda ni saha shɛli, o mini Ilaisha daa yila Giligal m-be soli zuɣu chana.
en: The time came for the Lord to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind. Elijah and Elisha set out from Gilgal.

dag: N suhu zaa kul bela Izraɛl sapashinnim bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu la ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: My heart is with Israels commanders, who willingly offered themselves among the people—bless the LORD!.

dag: Ifriimnim bela muɣisigu ni, ka diri wahala saria karibu ni, bɛ ni lo ni bɛ dolila binshɛŋa din ka buchi zuɣu.
en: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.

dag: Iso daa kpuɣila Keenan paɣiba. Bɛ yuya n-nyɛ: Ada ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛlɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir bipuɣiŋga la mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn ŋun nyɛ Hivi nir bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la.
en: He married three Canaanite women: The first was Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite; the second was Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and the granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite;.

dag: bɛ yi tiri yɛlimaŋgɔba, yi tɛhiya ni ti Duuma bi nyari li?.
en: subverting a persons lawsuit—doesnt my Lord see all this?.

dag: ka o daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm di puuni nti nya bɛ ni niŋdi vi binshɛŋa din chihiri shɛm kpe.
en: He told me, Go in and look at the evil, disgusting things they are doing there.

dag: Ka ti daa ti chani Naawuni suhibu shee n-tuhi bipuɣin so ŋun daa nyɛ dabili ka lan nyɛ kpilikparisilana soli. Bɛn daa su o daa diri kpilikparisi maa baɣitali nyɔri pam.
en: One day, when we were on the way to the place for prayer, we met a slave woman. She had a spirit that enabled her to predict the future. She made a lot of money for her owners through fortune-telling.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka she tana ayɔbu la gba tuɣi taba ka kpabi tan shɛli din pah ayɔbu la ka di niŋ diba ayi, ka yi zaŋ li pa m biɛhigu shee maa tooni polo.
en: Join five of the curtains together, and join the six other curtains together. Double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tent.

dag: O lan tim ma mi na ni n ti moli ni o ni yɛn tilig o niriba saha shɛl la paaya, ka moli ni o ni yɛn bɔhi biɛri saha shɛl la paaya; o lan tim ma mi na yaha ni n ti maai bɛn fabindi la suhuri.
en: to proclaim the year of the LORDs favor and a day of vindication for our God, to comfort all who mourn.

dag: Amaa man ni yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣ a, ka mali sara jɛm a; ka pali n ni lo alikauli shɛli a sani. Tiliginsim yirila nyin Yawɛ sanna.
en: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord . I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni no n-taai ninvuɣ shɛb la di vi; chɛ ka tarimba mini nandaamba paɣ a yuli.
en: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.

dag: Zaŋmiya sania maŋa mini kuruwa maŋa ni taha din nyɛ zaɣ maŋa n-zahindi binyara.
en: Stop cheating people. Use accurate scales and measures!.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naawuni, Wara ka chɛ ti. Bɔ ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛn tooi niŋ ti?.
en: They told God, Leave us alone! and said, God All-Powerful cannot do anything to us.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli, M ba zaŋ muɣisigu zali tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima, nyamiya n ni di shiri biɛla ŋɔ ka nya yaa shɛm.
en: Jonathan said, My father has caused you a lot of trouble. Look at me! I ate only a little of this honey, but already I feel strong and alert.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun ka buchi ka saɣim, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu leeg o kom nyuri ŋɔ yɛla?.
en: And we drink evil as if it were water; yes, we are corrupt; we are worthless.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka dunianim baŋ a soli, ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ a tiliginsim yiko yɛla.
en: so that your way becomes known on earth, so that your salvation becomes known among all the nations.

dag: Naawuni daa pun lo lahibal suŋ ŋɔ alikauli o daanabinim noya ni ka di yuui, hal ka di yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni.
en: The Good News was promised long ago by God through his prophets, as written in the Holy Scriptures.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o lan pala dabili kɔŋko, amaa o gari dabili; o yipa nyɛla ti mabiyurigu Masia ni. O mali ma buchi pam, amaa nyini ka o lee ni mali buchi pam, o ni nyɛ a dabili la min o ni nyɛ a mabia ti Duuma zuɣu la puuni.
en: not to be just a slave, but better than a slave, to be a dear brother. Thats what he is to me. And I know he will mean even more to you, both as your slave and as one who shares your faith in the Lord.

dag: A nyu bara yɛli ni a gbi kɔbilisi tinzun tinsi ni n-nyu di kom, ka a tɔbbihi siɣi Nail Mɔɣili ni n-no n-gili ka di kom nyuui.
en: I have dug wells, have drunk water in foreign lands. With my own feet, I dried up all of Egypts streams.

dag: Pa Naawuni yino maa n-nam paɣ maa? Niŋgbina mini shia maa zaa nyɛla o dini. Ka bɔ ka o lee bɔra? O bɔri ni Naawuni biɛhigu be ti bihi ni. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka di chɛn ya ka so bi ʒe o ni daa kpuɣi paɣ so o bipolitali ni yim.
en: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn boli niriba ka bɛ ka a yiŋ na ti di bindira, nyin bolimila nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni gbariti mini zoomba.
en: When you give a feast, invite the poor, the paralyzed, the lame, and the blind.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lan yɛli, Yi ku gari. Ka Ɛdom naa maa daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam bɛn gbib bidibbina pam kana ti gu ba soli.
en: But he said, You wont cross. Then Edom came out against them with a powerful army and a strong hand.

dag: Doo maa ni daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi Yisifu yiŋa, ka ti ba kom ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka bo mɔri ti bɛ bunsi naai.
en: The servant took the brothers into the house. He gave them water so that they could wash their feet, and he fed their donkeys.

dag: Yi ni ti tuuri wuntaŋ ni, ka anabinim pahi yi zuɣu ka yi tuuri yuŋ. N ni saɣim yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.

dag: Leedan daa malila bidibisi ata, Jɛhiɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Zɛtam pa, ka Joɛl daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ata.
en: Ladan had three sons. His oldest son was Jehiel. His other sons were Zethan and Joel.

dag: ka tiwula ata be di zuɣu, ka di ni sa kul piligi puhiri vari ka dii daai pum n-wali wala ka di mooi.
en: On the vine there were three branches. I watched the branches grow flowers and then become grapes.

dag: Bɛ yi ti nya so, bɛ ni zaŋ bini kuh o ka di pili yi, ka bɛ mi yi ti gbaai so, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku o.
en: Anyone who is caught will be stabbed to death.

dag: Bolimi ma, ka n garig a, ka yɛl a yɛl kara mini binshɛŋa din sɔɣi ka a bi mi li.
en: Call to me, and I will answer you; I will tell you wonderful and marvelous things that you know nothing about.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindi timaŋa, ka o be kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka bɛ su zahim mini noonsi ni niɣi ni dunia ŋɔ zaa ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi.
en: God said, Now we will make humans, and they will be like us. We will let them rule the fish, the birds, and all other living creatures.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika ŋ-ŋmɛnŋme li mal li; ka yi mal li piɛbiri laɣindi niriba, ka mal li piɛbiri ka bɛ yiɣisira chana.
en: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.

dag: Bɛ yi kpe Baka vinvamli la ni ni bɛ gari, bɛ chɛrimi ka di puhigir kom zɔra; ka siɣili saa ŋun daŋ mibu chɛri ka di kpɛri paana.
en: As they pass through the Baca Valley, they make it a spring of water. Yes, the early rain covers it with blessings.

dag: Ka Sool daa wum Jɔnatan ni yɛl o shɛm maa zaa, ka po pɔri yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku lan ku o.
en: Saul listened to Jonathan and then swore, As surely as the LORD lives, David wont be executed.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la mini Zɛruya bia Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la, Ŋuni n-lee ni doli ma chaŋ Sool sansan ni? Ka Abishai daa yɛli, Man ni dol a chaŋ.
en: Then David asked Ahimelech the Hittite, and Abishai the brother of Joab , Which of you two will go to Saul's camp with me? I will, Abishai answered.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi bɔhi.
en: Bildad from Shuah said:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bol o yaha, Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka o yɛl o, M bia, m bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni.
en: Again the Lord called out Samuel's name. Samuel got up and went to Eli. Here I am, he said. What do you want? Eli told him, Son, I didn't call you. Go back to sleep.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli din be nuzaa polo katiŋ ha la du pam ka viɛla; di nyɛla na titali tiŋa din tiri dunianim zaa suhupiɛlli.
en: is a beautiful summit, the joy of the whole world. Mount Zion, in the far north, is the city of the great king.

dag: Amaa zom a Naawuni, ka di zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o.
en: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.

dag: o ni daa wum Lazarɔs bariŋ maa yɛla o daa kpalim o ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa n-niŋla biɛr ayi pahi;.
en: Yet when he received the news that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was for two more days.

dag: Dama Naawuni ŋun daa yɛli ni neesim neem zibisim ni la, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka o neesim neei ti suhuri ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ Naawuni jilima neesim din neeri yiri Masia ninni na la.
en: The Scriptures say, God commanded light to shine in the dark. Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka n daa gbi mɔɣa ŋ-ŋɔŋdi di kom yɔɣiri li.
en: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.

dag: Ka naa maa gba suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o chɛ ka pirinsi kpɛh o duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o gba yo samli maa zaa.
en: The king was very angry, and he sent the servant to jail to be punished until he should pay back the whole amount.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi tinsi ni mini yi puri ni.
en: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, ka ti deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma maa;.
en: The sons answered, Yes, we can! Jesus said to the sons, It is true that you will drink from the cup that I drink from. And you will be baptized with the same baptism that I must go through.

dag: N tir a zaligunim din nyɛ n ni yuri shɛli maa jilima; n kul ni bɔhindi li.
en: Not only do I love your commands, but I also honor them. I will study your laws.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ teebul la zali pateesa maa nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la zali tuhi teebuli maa zaŋ labi nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ teebuli maa zali nuzaa polo.
en: Place the table outside the veil, and set the lampstand opposite the table by the south wall of the dwelling. Place the table by the north wall.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba mini Midian kpamba maa daa zaŋ baɣibuɣiri liɣiri chaŋ Balaam sani ti yɛl o Balak ni yɛli shɛm.
en: So the elders of Moab and Midian went with the payment for divination in their hands. They came to Balaam and told him Balaks words.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣu daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: On the next day, which was a Sabbath, the chief priests and the Pharisees went together to Pilate.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun daa bɔhi biɛri ti ma, ka zaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: This is the God who avenges on my behalf, who subdues peoples before me.

dag: Nyini n-wuhiri niriba tusatusa a yurilim din bi taɣira, amaa ka lee darigiri bihi tibili bɛ laamba taali zuɣu. Nyini Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka mali yiko, ka a yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: You act with mercy toward thousands upon thousands, but you also bring the consequences of the fathers sins on their children after them. Great and mighty God, whose name is the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zaŋ Yisa tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: The whole group rose up and took Jesus before Pilate.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And what about the seed that fell on rocky ground? That is like the people who hear the teaching and quickly and gladly accept it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi nam fukumsinim yɛligu dolibu zaɣisila Naawuni ni zali shɛli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala ni bo tibidarigibo ti bɛmaŋa.
en: Whoever opposes the existing authority opposes what God has ordered; and anyone who does so will bring judgment on himself.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni kuli nti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhi din mali nyina mini kuriti kuya ni kuriti lɛri tumd o tuma. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ Ammɔnnim maa tinsi zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda min o niriba maa zaa daa lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He took the people of the city and put them to work with saws, iron hoes, and axes. He did the same to the people of all the other towns of Ammon. Then he and his men returned to Jerusalem.

dag: A nina ni nya alahiziba binyara, ka a tɛha yɛtɔɣa gabi.
en: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.

dag: A dolila a biɛli naba, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ o pipia maa gbibil a.
en: You followed in your sisters path, so I have put her cup into your hand.

dag: N ni daa nya ka a bihi la ni shɛb doli yɛlimaŋli kaman ti Ba Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm la, di daa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: I was overjoyed to find some of your children living in the truth, just as we had been commanded by the Father.

dag: Di pala yi kalinli n-daa zooi gari zuliya shɛb zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu gbaai ya ka o pii ya maa, dama yinima n-daa pɔri gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: You were the weakest of all nations.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka she tana ayɔbu la gba tuɣi taba ka kpabi tan shɛli din pah ayɔbu la ka di niŋ diba ayi, ka yi zaŋ li pa m biɛhigu shee maa tooni polo.
en: Join five of the curtains together into one group. Then join the other six curtains together into another group. Fold back half of the sixth curtain at the front of the Tent.

dag: Ka a yɛli niriba maa, Yi yɛn kpɛla yi dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya ka be Ɛdom la tiŋgban ni gari, bɛ ni zɔri ya dabiɛm. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa.
en: Command the people as follows: You are about to enter into the territory of your relatives who live in Seir: Esaus descendants. They will be afraid of you, so watch yourselves most carefully.

dag: N daa ʒila niriba pam yi kpe chaŋ, amaa ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka n labimina ni nuzaŋa. Ŋun Yawɛ n-chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa paai ma, ka wula ka yi lan booni ma Naomi.
en: I went away full, but the LORD has returned me empty. Why would you call me Naomi, when the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has deemed me guilty.

dag: Zomiya yi yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ n sani la tumbu ni, ka chɛ ka yi suhuri mini yi shihi leei zaɣ pala. Izraɛlnima, bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn kpi?.
en: Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins?.

dag: Ka Simiɔn zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ shɛba daa ti chaŋ Ɛdom zoli zuɣu, kaman niriba kɔbisinu laasabu. Bɛ daa malila bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ Pɛlatia mini Niaria ni Rɛfaya ni Uziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ Ishi bidibisi la.
en: Five hundred other members of the tribe of Simeon went east to Edom. They were led by the sons of Ishi: Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la min o dabipaɣiba ayi ni o bihi piniyini la chaŋ ti gbaai Jabok Mɔɣili du.
en: During the night, Jacob got up and began moving his two wives, his two maids, and his eleven sons across the Jabbok River at the crossing.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa zaŋ Ahazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔram kaluɣi la n-leei naa zal o ba zaani; dama ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa doli Laribunim maa ka sansani maa ni na daa ku Jɛhɔram bikpamba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa leei Juda naa maa.
en: The people of Jerusalem chose Ahaziah to be the new king in Jehorams place. Ahaziah was Jehorams youngest son. The people who came with the Arabs to attack Jehorams camp killed all of Jehorams older sons. So Ahaziah began to rule in Judah.

dag: N daa niŋ ninvuɣ titali gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa pun daŋ n tooni di Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa lan mali yɛm pam.
en: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Chɛ ka m bihi ŋɔ ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ti ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: What do you want? Jesus asked her. She answered, Promise me that these two sons of mine will sit at your right and your left when you are King.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la kul bela n tooni, ka n dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali.
en: I always remember your faithful love. I depend on your faithfulness.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti Naawuni. Zaɣisimiya Sintani, ka o zo ka chɛn ya.
en: So then, submit yourselves to God. Resist the Devil, and he will run away from you.

dag: N ku chɛ yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya yihibu biɛri bɔhibu. Ka biŋkɔbigu yi ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo. Ka so yi ku o mabia, bɛn kum o yo.
en: Also, I will demand your blood for your lives. That is, I will demand the life of any person or animal that takes a human life.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛla bɛ noya jɛndi ma, ka yɛra, Iin, Iin, ti nini nya li.
en: They are telling lies about me. They say, Aha! We know what you did.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni daa bi boli ti ni ti ti tumdila niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, amaa o daa boli ti ni ti ti dolila kasitali biɛhigu soli.
en: God didnt call us to be immoral but to be dedicated to him.

dag: Bomiya yalim ti Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ka di ku yiɣi, dama di ni wurim; di fɔntinsi ni zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Set up a tombstone for Moab; it will soon be destroyed. Its towns will be left in ruins, and no one will live there again. .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yaɣigari chuɣu puhibu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ, Di bi simdi ka tinzun nira di Yaɣigari chuɣu bindirigu maa.
en: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following instructions for celebrating Passover: Only Israelites may eat the Passover meal.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni kari saria wuhi din be piɛ titali mini piɛ kɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: So I, the Lord God, will separate you strong sheep from the weak.

dag: N daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman taŋkpa zim la. N daa burisi ba ka no n-taai ba kaman soli zuɣu batibati la.
en: I ground them to dust, and I squashed them like mud in the streets.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pa nyini n-yɛn me yili ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: God said, Go and tell this to my servant David: The Lord says, David, you are not the one to build a house for me to live in.

dag: Ka Dauda daa duh o yee bɔhi tɔbbihi maa mini Nɛr bia Abinɛr la, Abinɛr, a ku garigi ma? Ka Abinɛr garigi bɔhi, Nyin ŋuni n-lee booni naa maa.
en: David shouted to the army and to Abner son of Ner, Answer me, Abner! Abner answered, Who are you? Why are you calling the king.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni; yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Keep watch and pray that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.

dag: N ni yili yila yɛli ʒiɛyimtali mini zaligu soli yɛla. N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: My song is about loyalty and justice, and I sing it to you, O Lord .

dag: Yi mi ni di daa nyɛla n daalaafee kalinsi zuɣu ka n daa be yi sani n-tuui yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya;.
en: You remember why I preached the gospel to you the first time; it was because I was sick.

dag: Mɛmiya duɣuri n-zaŋdi tampiligim niŋdi di puuni, ka mali soobuya mini taha ni dirijaba ni lahi din ni niŋdi buɣim. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali di lahi mini duɣuri zaa.
en: Make pails for removing its ashes and its shovels, bowls, meat forks, and trays. Make all its equipment out of copper.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛm min o ni daa deei Damaskus mini Hamat din nyɛ Judanim ni su shɛl la shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jeroboam II did, his brave battles, and how he restored Damascus and Hamath to Israel, are all recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Dunoli kam daa malila yoobu buyi, ka yoobu kam mali chɛulo diba ayi.
en: and each door had two sections that could fold open.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti sa vuhim shee, kom ni be luɣ shɛli pam din ni chɛ ka di niŋ wula n-wali wala, ka niŋ yɔɣili din mali jilima.
en: But the vine had already been planted in a fertile, well-watered field so that it could grow leaves and bear grapes and be a magnificent vine.

dag: Hal fiig tihi ni bi pum puma, ka wain tihi bi wali, ka olivi tihi bi wali, ka puri ni bindira bi niŋ, ka biŋkɔbbaligu lan ka buzɔna ni, ka niɣi lan ka naɣikpahi ni maa zaa yoli.
en: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi chaŋchaŋ gili duu maa ni, ka ti lan lab ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu yaha. Ka bia maa daa tihim siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin, ka neeg o nina.
en: Elisha got up, walked around the room, and then went back and again stretched himself over the boy. The boy sneezed seven times and then opened his eyes.

dag: Kpɛm sani yuli n-daa booni Ohola, ka o tizo maa mi yuli booni Oholiba. Ka n daa kpuɣi ba leei m paɣiba, ka bɛ dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bɛ yuya maa ni wuhi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ohola nyɛla Samaria, ka Oholiba mi nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa yɛliya ni doo yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: They asked, Teacher, Moses said, If a man who doesnt have children dies, his brother must marry his wife and produce children for his brother.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lala, dama binshɛŋa din chihira ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni je shɛŋa zaa, bɛ niŋdi li tiri bɛ wuna maa, dama hal bɛ daa mi n-zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyo buɣim mali bɛ wuna maa.
en: Dont do that to the Lord your God! These people do all kinds of bad things that the Lord hates. They even burn their children as sacrifices to their gods!.

dag: Dama di naan tibisi gari teeku bihigu. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri yiriŋ maa.
en: for now its heavier than the sands of the sea; therefore, my words are rash.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, dinzuɣu ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo.
en: Whoever sheds human blood, by a human his blood will be shed; for in the divine image God made human beings.

dag: Saha shɛli ha a daa kana ti tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam, ka ti bi tɛhi ni a ni niŋ lala, ka zoya daa sɔhig a tooni.
en: There was a time when you came and did terrifying things that we did not expect; the mountains saw you and shook with fear.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni; ka din pahi nyɛla, n ni chɛ ka o dɔɣi bidibiga ti a. N shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o leei zuliya pam yabipaɣa; ka nanim ni ti yi o zuliya ni na.
en: I will bless her and even give you a son from her. I will bless her so that she will become nations, and kings of peoples will come from her.

dag: Mirimiya ma na ti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm. Piligu ni zaŋ kana, n na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni. N daa pun beni ka yɛlli ŋɔ na bi niŋ. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-zaŋ o shia niŋ n ni n-tim ma.
en: Come here and listen to me! I was there when Babylon began as a nation. And from the beginning, I spoke clearly so that people could know what I said. Now, the Lord GOD sends me and his Spirit to tell you these things.

dag: Ka o daa boli bipuɣin kpɛm sani yuli Jɛmaima, ka boli ŋun paya yuli Kɛzia, ka boli ŋun pah ata maa mi yuli Kɛrɛnhapuk.
en: He named the first daughter Jemimah and the second daughter Keziah. He named the third daughter Keren Happuch.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; ka n niŋ o naani. Ka n nyari sɔŋsim, ka n suhu piɛla; ka n yiini yila paɣir o.
en: The Lord is my strength and shield. I trusted him with all my heart. He helped me, so I am happy. I sing songs of praise to him.

dag: Lee di taaya duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka di zɔriya tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba dabiɛm, ti ni nyaŋ ba. Binshɛli din guli ba vuuya ka chɛ ba; ka Yawɛ mi be ti sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: So dont turn against the Lord ! Dont be afraid of the people in that land. We can defeat them. They have no protection, nothing to keep them safe. But we have the Lord with us, so dont be afraid.

dag: Binshɛɣukam puuni n wuhi ya ni sokam moom o nini n-tum lala sɔŋ bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la, ka teeya ti Duuma Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm la, Dina n-nyɛ ni Ŋun tiri mal alibarika gari ŋun deera. .
en: I always showed you that you should work just as I did and help people who are weak. I taught you to remember the words of the Lord Jesus: You will have a greater blessing when you give than when you receive.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlana zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: Who then are the faithful and wise servants whom their master puts in charge of giving food at the right time to those who live in his house?.

dag: Nyama, n yaai n noli, ka n zilinli din be n nol ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Everything I will say.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔb bia ka nyɛ Zɔba naa la, saha shɛli ŋun Hadadɛza ni daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi deei Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo la.
en: Then he defeated the king of the Syrian state of Zobah, Hadadezer son of Rehob, as Hadadezer was on his way to restore his control over the territory by the upper Euphrates River.

dag: A mi sagbana ni yili zuɣusaa shɛm? Ŋuna ŋun mi binshɛɣukam ŋɔ daalahiziba tuma ni ka di niŋda.
en: Do you know how clouds float in the sky, the work of God's amazing skill?.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla din pun beni, ka din yɛn beni nyɛla din pun beni. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mi din pun gari yɛla.
en: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , because he is good; his love is eternal.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni tooi lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Aŋgo ni na be bɛ sani maa, bɛ ku tooi lo noli.
en: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a daa yɔhim Jɛrusalɛmnim pam n-yɛli, Shɛli ti ku niŋ ya, amaa ka takɔbi ti be bɛ kukoya ni.
en: Then I, Jeremiah, said, Lord GOD, you have tricked the people of Judah and Jerusalem. You said to them, You will have peace. But now the sword is pointing at their throats.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Yawɛ tooni na.
en: Moses asked the Lord what should be done.

dag: Ka nabihi kukoya daa fo, ka bɛ kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: even the most important men kept silent.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ gbaai tab bɔhibu, Ka ŋuni n-lee ti yɛn biligi kuɣ shɛli din yo siliga maa nol la ti ti?.
en: They were saying to each other, Whos going to roll the stone away from the entrance for us.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛl o niriba zaa, Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm alikauli kundi ni la.
en: King Josiah ordered the people to celebrate the Passover in honor of the Lord their God, as written in the book of the covenant.

dag: Bɛna n-daa sɔŋ Dauda tuhi ŋmɛnditoya la, dama bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka lan nyɛ sapashin kpamba.
en: They served David as officers over his troops, because they were all outstanding soldiers. Later they were officers in the Israelite army.

dag: Yinim tinvura ŋɔ! Yinim garinsi ŋɔ! Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ nti zo n-yi buɣim ni?.
en: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?.

dag: Yi yi ti birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ soli, yi ni ti wum o kukoli yi nyaaŋa polo ka di yɛra, Soli maa m-bɔŋɔ, doliya li.
en: If you stray to the right or the left, you will hear a word that comes from behind you: This is the way; walk in it.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha: Ti Duuma mi ka yɛnnim tɛha nyɛla yoli.
en: The Scriptures also say, The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise. He knows that their thoughts are worth nothing.

dag: dama yi mi ni buɣisibu shɛli din buɣisiri yi yɛda niŋbu chɛmi ka yi niŋdi ania.
en: for you know that when your faith succeeds in facing such trials, the result is the ability to endure.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisa ni daa ti paai kaman yuun pihita, ka o daa piligi o tuma, ka niriba daa tɛhi ni o nyɛla Yisifu bia. Yisifu daa nyɛla Hɛli bia.
en: When Jesus began to preach, he was about years old. Everyone thought he was the son of Joseph. But his family went back through Heli.

dag: Dama yi zaŋ yi nyɔri mini yi bɔɣusapima ni yi yila daai biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la zaa hal ti wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu katiŋa.
en: You shove with shoulder and flank, and with your horns you ram all the weak sheep until youve scattered them outside.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha n ni ti nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn be maa sani, dama bɛ zaa ninni ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba, ka yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But I did not destroy them. I had already told the Egyptians that I would bring my people out of Egypt. I did not want to ruin my good name, so I did not destroy Israel in front of those other people.

dag: Ka n ni darigi Dauda zuliya tibili, amaa m bi yɛn darigi li hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: I will punish the descendants of David, but not forever.

dag: Hal paɣ shɛb bɛn nini zɔri nambɔɣu gba daa ti zaŋdila bɛ bihi duɣira. Bɛna n-daa leei bɛ bindirigu, bɛ ni daa kuri n niriba maa saha shɛli maa.
en: Then even nice women cooked their own children. The children were food for their mothers. This happened when my people were destroyed.

dag: Ka daliri din chɛ ka o daa leei Naa Sulemaana dim maa m-bɔŋɔ: Sulemaana daa mɛla Millo gooni ŋari foliŋga din daa be o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni la.
en: Here is how it happened: While Solomon's workers were filling in the land on the east side of Jerusalem and repairing the city walls.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi diri nam, niriba malila suhupiɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi su fukumsi, niriba fabindimi.
en: When the rulers are good, the people are happy. When the rulers are evil, the people complain.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la n-garita.
en: They told him, Jesus, the one from Nazareth, is coming here.

dag: Ka yu shɛli sabi pa o binyɛrigu min o gbalipini zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF Lord S.

dag: Ka Naa Sairus maŋmaŋ daa zaŋ neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la nti niŋ o buɣa duu la na.
en: King Cyrus brought out the equipment of the LORDs house—those items that Nebuchadnezzar brought from Jerusalem and placed in the house of his gods.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni mi, bɛ daa yihila Mashal mini Abidɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: The Gershon families also got the towns of Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob from the tribe of Asher. They also got the fields near those towns.

dag: Do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias ka o nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la daa nyɛla ŋun mali yu suŋ nimaani Yɛhudianim zaa sani.
en: In Damascus a man named Ananias came to me. He was a man who was devoted to God and obeyed the Law of Moses. All the Jews who lived there respected him.

dag: Ka bɛ yi wuh o la samli, di simdi ka o yo bɛ ni wuh o sam shɛli maa zaa o nyɛvili tiligibu zuɣu.
en: But the family of the dead man may accept money. If they accept money, the man who owned the bull should not be killed. But he must pay as much money as the judge decides.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa ni m-pahila kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa Musa ni daa zaŋ niŋ di ni Sinai Zoli gbini luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: Nothing was in the chest except the two stone tablets Moses had placed there while at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they left Egypt.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn pun kpi la ni ti neei kum ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka shɛb mi ti di vi din ka bahigu.
en: Many of those who have already died will live again: some will enjoy eternal life, and some will suffer eternal disgrace.

dag: Chamiya Mirataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Chamiya ti liri ba, ka liri Pɛkɔdnima n-ku bɛ zaa. Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, Attack the country of Merathaim! Attack the people living in Pekod! Attack them! Kill them and destroy them completely! Do everything I commanded you!.

dag: Alahichi nyɛla din tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa bɛ suhuri puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ suhuri ni.
en: Deep in the hearts of the wicked a voice tells them to do wrong. They have no respect for God.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ vuui yomyom kaman kɔzɔrim la; ka chɛ ka bɛ no n-taai ba kaman sol zuɣu mɔri la ka bɛ kpi.
en: May they disappear like water draining away; may they be crushed like weeds on a path.

dag: Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla, o daa chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋla tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: David heard that the Ammonites were getting ready for war. So he sent Joab and the whole army of Israel to fight the Ammonites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Zuliya ayi m-be a pul maa ni. Niriba ayi ka a ti yɛn dɔɣi, ka bɛ ni ti woligi. Yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gari yino; ka kpɛm ni ti ŋmaligi jɛm biasani.
en: The Lord said to her, The leaders of two nations are in your body. Two nations will come from you, and they will be divided. One of them will be stronger, and the older will serve the younger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa jɛm o, ka lan lab Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli.
en: They worshiped him and went back into Jerusalem, filled with great joy.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun do teeku sunsuuni, ka ŋmani ŋun do ŋariŋ puuni daantaliga zuɣu.
en: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya ka tuumbiɛri n-kul be dunia ŋɔ ni, dama sokam zaa daa kul dolila tuumbiɛri soli.
en: God looked at the world and saw that it was evil, for the people were all living evil lives.

dag: Ka daa lan kpihim zaligu shɛli din mini di soya daa galindi ti ka kul nyari ti taali la n-daa zaŋ li kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-yihi li zaa bahi.
en: He destroyed the record of the debt we owed, with its requirements that worked against us. He canceled it by nailing it to the cross.

dag: Dama o suhu bi yu ni o nahim ti bee n-ti ti ni so suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: He takes no pleasure in causing us grief or pain.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu kul yɛmi ni n chɛ ka o lab kuli yi sanna, ka yi ti nya o ka yi suhuri paligi yaha, ka man gba nandahima vuui.
en: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa ti sɔɣi Sool ba Kish siliga ni Zɛla Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni, ka daa niŋ naa ni daa zali ni bɛ niŋm shɛlikam zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa naanyi deei bɛ suhigu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The bones of Saul and his son Jonathan were then buried in Zela, in Benjaminite territory, in the tomb of Sauls father Kish. Once everything the king had commanded was done, God responded to prayers for the land.

dag: O chɛ ka goli mini saŋmarisi su yuŋ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: the moon and the stars to rule over the night; his love is eternal.

dag: Dama o kul pala nina lihiri ninsalinim biɛhigu, ka nyari bɛ napɔna yaabu zaa.
en: God watches everything we do.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni doli n zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zali ba la mini n dabili Musa ni daa zali ba la zaa, n ku chɛ ka bɛ lan yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n-ti bɛ yaannim maa ni n-chani dari ginda.
en: And if the people of Israel will obey all my commands and keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them, then I will not allow them to be driven out of the land that I gave to their ancestors.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya putariga bindira, yi mi di ti labiya ti yihi binyiha di ni yaha. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Mani Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God!.

dag: Ka niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa mini nudirigu polo na ti ʒini Naawuni nam ni n-diri ka nyura.
en: People will come from east and west, north and south, and sit down to eat in Gods kingdom.

dag: yin miriya ka yi tam Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: watch yourself! Dont forget the LORD, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ ni yili yila yɛl a tuma yɛla, dama nyin Yawɛ jilima galisiya pam.
en: They will sing about what the Lord has done, because the glory of the Lord is very great.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la n daa saɣisi ba ni nimmoo, ka kul saɣisiri ba waawaayili hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-yɛra, Deemiya n noli.
en: When I brought their ancestors out of Egypt, I solemnly warned them to obey me, and I have kept on warning the people until this day.

dag: Bɛ bela bɛ olivi tihi folinsi ni n-kahindi kpam, ka kahindi wain, amaa ka kɔnyuri kuri ba.
en: crush olives between millstones, tread winepresses, but remain thirsty.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti zaŋ daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda tiŋgbana ni.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will plant seeds in Israel and Judah, and both people and animals will spring up.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim kari ninvuɣ biɛri zibisim bahi, ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ bɔɣu shɛli duhi zuɣusaa kabi.
en: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee gbarigi, ka o gbariginsim maa bi tabili ma? Ŋuni ka so lee luhi, ka n suhu bi yiɣisi bahi ŋun luh o maa zuɣu?.
en: I feel weak every time another person is weak. I feel deeply upset every time another person is led into sin.

dag: daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ yiliguliba dundɔŋ ni ti zaŋ Jɛrimia na; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la nuu ni ni o zaŋ o kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ niriba sani.
en: had me brought from the palace courtyard. They put me under the care of Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam and grandson of Shaphan, who was to see that I got home safely. And so I stayed there among the people.

dag: Yɛlim Sulemaana bia Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Juda mini Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni la.
en: Tell Judahs King Rehoboam, Solomons son, and all Israel in Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ polo, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: Human one, face Pharaoh, Egypts king, and prophesy against him and against all of Egypt.

dag: N ni tooi tam ninvuɣ biɛtali azichi din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi mini bɛ ni mali kuruwabihi shɛŋa zahindi binyara ka niriba galindi ba la yɛla?.
en: Do the wicked still hide treasures that they have stolen? Do they still cheat people with baskets that are too small? Yes, all of this is still happening!.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni nya tibiginsim din tuhi niŋbu ni, ka Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ wuh o kasitali maa wuntitali puuni.
en: But the LORD of heavenly forces will be exalted in justice, and the holy God will show himself holy in righteousness.

dag: Di saha ka n yura maa yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanima, Nyamiya m mini n tihi puu ŋɔ yɛla ŋɔ.
en: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli;.
en: They crucified him and then divided his clothes among them by throwing dice.

dag: A kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma bahi kpaŋa, a suhu ni yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa boli ba, ka Aduna mini bɛ laɣiŋgu zuɣulaannim zaa daa ka o sanna, ka o ti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses called them closer. So Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and Moses spoke with them.

dag: Tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ŋmari li mi luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: And any tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown in the fire.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ dunoli, ka so yi doli ma kpe, o ni tiligi. O ni doli ma kpɛri ka yira, ka nyari dihili.
en: I am the gate. Those who come in by me will be saved; they will come in and go out and find pasture.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o. Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: They were repulsed by him and fell into sin. But Jesus said to them, Prophets are honored everywhere except in their own hometowns and in their own households.

dag: ka nyɛ bɛn bi zuri bɛ taba nyaaŋa, ka bi tumdi bɛ zɔnim taali, ka mi bi mali bɛ ʒiʒiinitab yɛla n-chani moona.
en: and who do not slander others. They do no wrong to their friends nor spread rumors about their neighbors.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini Sapashin kpamba, Chamiya ti kali Izraɛlnim zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ti kpa Dan, ka labina ti yɛli ma di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka m baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: So David told Joab and the leaders of the people, Go throughout all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and take a census of the people so I know how many people there are.

dag: M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ chandi maa bɛn daa chɛ ka dabiɛm kpɛla Izraɛlnima, amaa ka man daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: The men who went with me, however, made our people afraid. But I faithfully obeyed the Lord my God.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi ba n-zani dabisi biɛɣu dali, ka yi yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, yi shiri ni ba n-zani.
en: Therefore, pick up the full armor of God so that you can stand your ground on the evil day and after you have done everything possible to still stand.

dag: Bina anahi n-nyɛ bɛn gamdi giŋgaani bɛ biɛhigu ni.
en: There are three things that are excellent in their stride, four that are excellent as they walk.

dag: Kopaliga zaŋ ba guui yomyom, ka noli di bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛli, ka so napɔŋ bi lan no bɛ wain tihi puri ni yaha.
en: They are scum on the waters surface; their portion of the land is cursed; no one walks down a path in the vineyards.

dag: Pa kapinta ŋun nyɛ Mariama bia la m-bala? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Joses ni Judas ni Saimɔn la? Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o.
en: Isn't he the carpenter, the son of Mary, and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon? Aren't his sisters living here? And so they rejected him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb be a ni ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri ka kuri niriba, ka shɛb be a ni n-diri bindira zoya zuɣu ka be biɛriyoli.
en: In Jerusalem, people tell lies in order to kill innocent people. They go to the mountains to worship false gods and then come back to Jerusalem to eat their fellowship meals. In Jerusalem, people commit many sexual sins.

dag: Dama Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim daa yiɣisimi lu Ɛdom Zoli zuɣunim maa zuɣu kuri ba. Bɛ ni daa ti ku ba naai, ka bɛ lan ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu n-ku taba.
en: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!.

dag: Amaa dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam, ka dabiɛm maa tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Dama man Naawuni ni to n-wurim ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba. Bɛ ni di vi, dama man Naawuni zaɣisi ba.
en: They will be filled with fear— a fear like they have never felt before! People of Israel, you will defeat those who attacked you, because God has rejected them. And he will scatter their bones.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra; dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: He said to them: A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers. Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a nimdi bahi zoya zuɣu, ka zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ maa pali vinvama ni.
en: I will scatter your body on the mountains. I will fill the valleys with your dead body.

dag: Shafan bia Ɛlasa mini Hilikia bia Gɛmaria bɛn daa nyɛ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim shɛba Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza san la n-daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa mali chaŋ. Di daa yɛlimi.
en: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote.

dag: A daa wuhi ba a Vuhim Dabisili din be kasi yɛla, ka daa zaŋ a zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-ti a dabili Musa ka o ti ba.
en: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.

dag: Yi ni kpi n-do mɔɣu ŋɔ ni; ka yinim bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani zaa, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya, ka yi nyɛ bɛn ŋum yi kparima ni niŋ ma la.
en: Your dead bodies will fall in this desert. None of you who were enlisted and were registered from years old and above, who complained against me.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ku vuui bɛ zaashee; bɛ kul ni teeri bɛ yɛla sahakam.
en: A good person will never fail; he will always be remembered.

dag: Ka o ni ti mali biɛrisuŋ mini yiko kaman Anabi Ilaija ni daa mali shɛm, ka o ni ti daŋ tooni ti lɛbigi bihi banim suhuri ti bɛ bihi, ka lɛbigi tipawumlinim suhuri ka bɛ gba doli wuntizɔriba yɛm soli, ka chɛ ka niriba mali shili gu bɛ Duuma.
en: He will go ahead of the Lord, strong and mighty like the prophet Elijah. He will bring fathers and children together again; he will turn disobedient people back to the way of thinking of the righteous; he will get the Lord's people ready for him.

dag: Ka o daa boli bidib so ŋun pah ayi mi yuli Ifriim, ka yɛli, Naawuni ti ma nama n ni di wahala tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: He named the second Ephraim, because, he said, God has given me children in the land where Ive been treated harshly.

dag: Yi yab Ibrahimma suhu daa piɛli ni o nya n saha ŋɔ, ka mi daa shiri nya li ka di niŋ o suhupiɛlli.
en: Your father Abraham was really glad to see me.

dag: Ka sokam daa kul omaŋmaŋ ya ni bɛ ti sab o yuli.
en: Everyone went to their own cities to be enrolled.

dag: Ka ŋun maligumaana Ɛliɛza zaŋ o nubil tim o ʒim ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la tooni polo siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: He will dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times in the direction of the sacred tent.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa bela Giligal. Nimaani ka n nyee daa piligi ba nyɔnibu. Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu n ni kari ba yihi n yiŋa. N ku lan yuri ba yaha; bɛ kpamba zaa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi ma.
en: Every wickedness of theirs began at Gilgal; there I came to hate them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them out of my house. I will love them no more; all their officials are rebels.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, n yi zaŋ n nuhi tum taali.
en: O Lord , my God, if I have wronged anyone, if I have betrayed a friend or without cause done violence to my enemy — if I have done any of these things—.

dag: A nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ puuni ka a ŋme m-paag a dimnima. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili di ba zaa kaman mɔ kuma ka bɛ chɛ n-sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: In your great majesty you destroyed those who stood against you. Your anger destroyed them, like fire burning straw.

dag: Ka shi so daa gari n ninni baalim, ka n niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri yirigi.
en: A breeze swept by my face; the hair of my skin bristled.

dag: Di bi simdi ka Izraɛl bipuɣinsi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu pagɔrili bee ka bidibisi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu dagɔrili.
en: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Abishai daa chaŋ tɔbbihi maa sani yuŋ, ka Sool ti dola sansani maa sunsuuni gbihiri ka o kpani sa o zuɣusaa, ka Abinɛr mini tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: So that night David and Abishai entered Saul's camp and found Saul sleeping in the center of the camp with his spear stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the troops were sleeping around him.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ka o zaŋ omaŋ leei kaman o yidan la o niriba sunsuuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim omaŋa.
en: You must not make yourself unclean for in-laws, defiling yourself by doing so.

dag: O tiri bɛn gbarigi yaa, ka tiri bɛn ka yaa yiko.
en: giving power to the tired and reviving the exhausted.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti lan yɛli Hiburunim maa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba bɛn yuya daa booni Shifira mini Pua.
en: Finally, the king called in Shiphrah and Puah, the two women who helped the Hebrew mothers when they gave birth.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kpuɣim tɔbu mini piɛma; ka o kpuɣi tɔbu mini piɛma maa.
en: Elisha told Joash, Get a bow and some arrows. So he brought Elisha a bow and some arrows.

dag: Dama nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi ni n daa tum taali, dinzuɣu ka mani n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ yi Yisifu zuliya ni kana ni n ti tuhi nyini n dan naa soli maa.
en: I know, sir, that I have sinned, and this is why I am the first one from the northern tribes to come and meet Your Majesty today.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn boli niriba ka bɛ ka a yiŋ na ti di bindira, nyin bolimila nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni gbariti mini zoomba.
en: Instead, when you give a feast, invite the poor, the crippled, and the blind.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: You must put your hand on the animals head and kill it at the place for the burnt offering.

dag: M mabihi, teemiya yi ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛba ka Naawuni boli ya la yɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛla polo, yi ni pam daa pala yɛnnima bee yikolaannima bee nam zuliyanima.
en: Brothers and sisters, God chose you to be his. Think about that! Not many of you were wise in the way the world judges wisdom. Not many of you had great influence, and not many of you came from important families.

dag: O ni daa paai naa sani, ka naa bɔh o, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka Makaya garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: Then Micaiah went to Ahab, and Ahab asked, Micaiah, should I attack the Syrians at Ramoth? Yes! Micaiah answered. The Lord will help you defeat them.

dag: So yi lab a tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o; ka so yi fa a binyɛrigu, nyin di mɔŋ o a chinchini gba.
en: If anyone hits you on one cheek, let him hit the other one too; if someone takes your coat, let him have your shirt as well.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun tiri ti nasara ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!.

dag: Di simdi ni ti zaŋ ti niɣi zaa chaŋ, hal naɣ takarifeeni ku kpalim. Di simdi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa, dama ti bi mi ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ shɛli mali sara ti Yawɛ naɣila ti paala nimaani.
en: No, we will take our animals with us; not one will be left behind. We ourselves must select the animals with which to worship the Lord our God. And until we get there, we will not know what animals to sacrifice to him.

dag: Dama bɛ suhuri kul palila nia biɛri n-diri kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu buɣim la. Yuŋ yi paai bɛ suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila wurigu buɣim doya, ka biɛɣu ti neei ka di taai kaman buɣim zibizibi la.
en: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋdi kaman yi ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ niŋdi shɛm la. Ka miriya ka yi ti niŋdi kaman n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kulisi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ŋɔ nim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Miriya ka yi ti niŋ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: You must not do things like they are done in the land of Egypt, where you used to live. And you must not do things like they are done in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You must not follow the practices of those places.

dag: Ka wula ka ninsal lee ni tooi be kasi Naawuni tooni? Wula ka paɣ ni dɔɣi so lee ni tooi be ka ka daɣiri?.
en: Can anyone be righteous or pure in God's sight?.

dag: Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Move back from these people, and I will destroy them immediately.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daansi ŋɔ ni ka bɛn tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni yɛn duɣiri niriba maa sara maligu binyara.
en: He said to me, These are the kitchens where those who minister in the temple cook the peoples sacrifices.

dag: So miri ka o ti zaŋ o ma dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa ka nyɛ o ma, di bi simdi ni o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa ti Izraɛlnim vuhim ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gili ba niŋ sunsuuni bi tooi niŋ ba shɛli ka di yuui pam la nyaaŋa, Jɔshua gba daa kurigiya pam di saha maa.
en: The Lord gave Israel peace from their enemies around them. He made Israel safe. Many years passed, and Joshua became very old.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuu shihi bɛ nina ka yɛli, Yi yɛda niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmiya lala.
en: Then Jesus touched their eyes and said, You believe that I can make you see again, so it will happen.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku a min a niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm jɛndi zuliya shɛli din zaɣisi ni di ku jɛm Babilɔn Naa la?.
en: Why should you and your people die by sword, famine, and disease, as the LORD pronounced against any nation that wont serve the king of Babylon?.

dag: O gbarigi n yaa m biɛhigu puuni, ka filim n dabisa.
en: God broke my strength in midstride, cutting my days short.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi yo alizanda nam dunoli ni niriba di kpe di ni. Yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi bi saɣiri ni bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni kpe. .
en: It will be bad for you teachers of the law and you Pharisees! You are hypocrites! You close the way for people to enter Gods kingdom. You yourselves dont enter, and you stop those who are trying to enter.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kpi m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu. Bɛ zaŋ Ijiptinim tila takɔbi ni bɛ gbahi bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: among those who fall slain by the sword. A sword is appointed, and all his hordes will carry him off.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti chirigi Pɔntus tiŋbi so ŋun yuli booni Akuila min o paɣ Prisila bɛn daa yoli yi Itali na la, dama Rom Naa Klɔdius n-daa zali zaligu ni Yɛhudianim zaa yim Rom, ka bɛ mi daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima.
en: There he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus. He had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul visited with them.

dag: di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo mini di sambani gba yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The area in front of the house and the yard to the east was one hundred fifty feet also.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ti ni ti doli zaligunim ŋɔ zaa; ka zom ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka ti be kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Then the Lord our God commanded us to obey all these laws and to honor him. If we do, he will always watch over our nation and keep it prosperous.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Yawɛ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: The portion that you will set aside for the LORD will be . miles long and . miles wide.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋna nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani.
en: Jesus told them, Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.

dag: M mi kɔŋsim biɛhigu, ka mi malibu gba biɛhigu. M pun bɔhim baŋ ashili ŋɔ: N ni be luɣ shɛlikam mini saha shɛlikam zaa puuni, n yi nya n-di bee n yi gbe kum, ka n yi mali pam bee n yi malila biɛla n nini tiɣiri li mi.
en: I know the experience of being in need and of having more than enough; I have learned the secret to being content in any and every circumstance, whether full or hungry or whether having plenty or being poor.

dag: daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm.
en: went into the boat with Noah, as God had commanded.

dag: Zaŋ Sinai Zoli n-doli yi Siɛr Zoli polo hal ti paai Kadɛshibarinia nyɛla biɛɣ pinyini chandi.
en: It is eleven days from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea along the Mount Seir route.

dag: Asa daa tum din tuhi ka viɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Asa pleased the Lord , his God, by doing what was right and good.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija.
en: The LORDs word came to Elijah.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa teemi gili ma, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: All the nations surrounded me, but I cut them down in the LORDs name.

dag: A zaɣis a ni daa lo a dabili alikauli shɛl la; ka zaŋ o nam zuɣupiligu bahi tiŋa.
en: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.

dag: nti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo piɛɣu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o mali alahichi sanyoo sara luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la.
en: You must press your hand on the head of the purification offering. It will be slaughtered as a purification offering in the place where the entirely burned offering is slaughtered.

dag: ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ yiɣina ti lu bɛ sansani maa ni n-gili bɛ biɛhigu maa shee zaa.
en: God brought the birds down in the center of their camp, all around their dwellings.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛbihi ni ti laɣindi dira, ka gbuɣima ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman niɣi la, ka tinvura bindirigu ni nyɛla taŋkpaɣu. Bɛ ti ku lan dim so bee n-ku so n zoli din be kasi maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Wolves and little lambs will eat together. Lions will eat hay like cattle, and snakes will eat only dust. They will not hurt or destroy each other on my holy mountain. This is what the Lord said.

dag: M Ba ni yuri ma shɛm, lala ka n gba yuri ya. Benya n yurilim ni.
en: I have loved you as the Father has loved me. Now continue in my love.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa min o gbaŋ ni o nimdi ni o bindi dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɔrili zaɣ titali ŋun daa mali kpiŋkpaŋ kara, ka o kpiŋkpan piɛma wɔɣa, ka o mali kɔb garigari pam daa ti ka Lɛbanɔn na. O daa gbaala sida tia.
en: so they will understand what I am saying to them: A large eagle with strong wings and beautiful feathers once flew to Lebanon. It broke the top branch off a cedar tree.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Di ŋubiya biŋkpam, nahu kpam bee piɛɣu kpam bee bua kpam.
en: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yi bi sɔŋ a, wula ka man ni tooi sɔŋ a? M malila chi bee wain.
en: The king of Israel said, If the Lord does not help you, how can I help you? I cannot give you grain from the threshing floor or wine from the winepress.

dag: Jakim mini Zikiri ni Zabidi.
en: Shimeis sons were Jakim, Zicri, Zabdi.

dag: Ka napaɣ kuro daa wum naa min o kpambaliba ni tɔɣisiri yɛlli maa yɛla ka kpe bɛ chuɣu puhibu duu maa ni na ti yɛli, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Di chɛ ka yɛla maa muɣis a ti yaɣi, ka a chɛ ka a ninni biɛhigu taɣi.
en: The queen mother heard the noise made by the king and his noblemen and entered the banquet hall. She said, May Your Majesty live forever! Please do not be so disturbed and look so pale.

dag: Ka Hanna daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, Naawuni ti ma suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka n nya kpiɔŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani. N larila n dimnima, dama m mali suhupiɛlli n nasara dibu puuni.
en: Then Hannah prayed: My heart rejoices in the LORD. My strength rises up in the LORD! My mouth mocks my enemies because I rejoice in your deliverance.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa kali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;.

dag: Yɛm mɛrila o yili, amaa jɛrilim ŋun wurindila o yili.
en: A wise woman makes her home what it should be, but the home of a foolish woman is destroyed by her own actions.

dag: Amaa yi yi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so, yi tum alahichi, ka Naawuni zaligu nya yi taali ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla zaligusaɣindiba.
en: But when you show favoritism, you are committing a sin, and by that same law you are exposed as a lawbreaker.

dag: Kpuɣim a nɛma maa buɣi a bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu bɛ ninni, ka zaŋ bini pɔb a nina n-ʒi li yi liɣa din ni chɛ ka a nini ku nya tiŋgbani. Dama n zaŋ a leela shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: While they watch, shoulder your backpack and carry it out in the dark. Cover your face so that you cant see the land, because Im making you a sign for the house of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba ni ti deei nam maa n-su li sahakam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ka n daa po pɔri yɛli Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu, N zaŋ li ti yi Zuliya. N chɛ ka a nini nya li, amaa a ku paai nimaani.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses: This is the land that I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I promised: I will give it to your descendants. I have shown it to you with your own eyes; however, you will not cross over into it.

dag: Ka ti zaa daa lu tiŋa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri ma Hiburuli ni, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka? Di to ni a tabigi gɔhi.
en: All of us fell to the ground, and I heard a voice say to me in Hebrew, Saul, Saul! Why are you persecuting me? You are hurting yourself by hitting back, like an ox kicking against its owner's stick.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ yi biɛhigu shee bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ zim kuruwa ayi malina, ka bɛ ti zaŋ gahi. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka yi ti niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, ka di leei bindir tuuli shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: On that day bring two loaves of bread from your homes. That bread will be lifted up to show it was offered to God. Use yeast and cups of flour to make those loaves of bread. That will be your gift to the Lord from your first harvest.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam nya sɔɣibu shee a sani mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka bɛ kul yiini suhupiɛlli yila sahakam. Guli ba, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli nya suhupiɛlli a sani.
en: But let all who take refuge in you celebrate. Let them sing out loud forever! Protect them so that all who love your name can rejoice in you.

dag: O daa zaŋ o niriba kpe mɔɣu ni gari. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He led his people through the desert; his love is eternal.

dag: Di saha yi ni baŋ wuntitali mini zaligu soli ni biɛrisuntali ni so viɛlli kam.
en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, as well as integrity, every good course.

dag: N yɛli ya ni yinyahi m-pooi ma, ka yi ti zaŋ doo ŋɔ na ni o ti tumd o yinyahili tuma ŋɔ n tooni? Doo ŋɔ ni tooi be n yili ŋɔ.
en: Don't I have enough madmen already? Why bring another one to bother me with his crazy actions right here in my own house.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ birigi n sani. Bahiyoli n-doli ba, dama bɛ zaɣisi ma. N naan tiligi ba, amaa ka bɛ beni ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: They are doomed! They have left me and rebelled against me. They will be destroyed. I wanted to save them, but their worship of me was false.

dag: Ka zoomba mini gbariti daa ka o sanna Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Some blind people and some who were crippled came to Jesus in the Temple area. Jesus healed them.

dag: Nahimmiya Midiannima, ka ku ba.
en: Go after the Midianites and destroy them.

dag: O chɛ ka bɛ mini nanim ʒiina, nanim bɛn nyɛ o niriba nanima.
en: to seat them with leaders— with the leaders of his own people!.

dag: yin zaŋmiya ŋun tum lala maa niŋ Sintani nuu ni ka o niŋgbuŋ saɣim, ka di chɛ ka o shia lee ti tiligi ti Duuma Dabisili la dali.
en: you are to hand this man over to Satan for his body to be destroyed, so that his spirit may be saved in the Day of the Lord.

dag: Bɛ karimbaani biɛhigu zuɣu, bɛ yɛrimi, Naawuni ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo; ka bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla, Naawuni kani.
en: At the peak of their wrath, the wicked dont seek God: Theres no God— thats what they are always thinking.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa, Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ di gbinni. Yi ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli.
en: God said, Go and say to this people: Listen intently, but dont understand; look carefully, but dont comprehend.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niɣi maa na ti ti Yisifu, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ yuri mini piɛri ni buhi ni bunsi. Ka o daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ niɣi zaa di yuuni maa puuni.
en: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, sheep, goats, cattle, and donkeys. That year he supplied them with food in exchange for all their livestock.

dag: M-pahi, Uzia daa lan mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu, ka bɛ piripiri ba ka bɛ kalinli dolila Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpɛm la ni daa wuhi Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la mini Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpamba ni yino la shɛm.
en: Uzziah's army was always ready for battle. Jeiel and Maaseiah were the officers who kept track of the number of soldiers, and these two men were under the command of Hananiah, one of Uzziah's officials.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri teeku duli, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: Then Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead to the other side of the lake, while he sent the people away.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa sabi yilli ŋɔ dindali maa n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa nyɛla bundana ni yɛndana n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: King Solomon far exceeded all the earths kings in wealth and wisdom.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, hal binshɛlikam din niŋ ti ti daalahichi mini ti taali zuɣu ŋɔ ti mi ni a bi darigi ti tibili kaman ti tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti ni shɛb tiligi ŋɔ.
en: Even after everything that has happened to us in punishment for our sins and wrongs, we know that you, our God, have punished us less than we deserve and have allowed us to survive.

dag: Lɛvi do so daa ti kpuɣi Lɛvi zuliya ni paɣa.
en: During this time a man from the tribe of Levi married a woman of his own tribe.

dag: Naawuni, a tɛha nyɛla din viɛli pam n sani, di galisiya.
en: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.

dag: Amaa ka shɛb daa ti chaŋ daba ayopɔin maa dali ni bɛ ti pihi li ka bi nya shɛli.
en: On the seventh day some of the people went out to gather bread, but they found nothing.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni, o ni bɔh o bɔhigunim tuhili, ka o ku tooi garigi bɔhigu yini gba.
en: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ti gba, ti ni daa nyɛ bihi ka na bi zooi wuntia soli dolibu ni la, ti daa nyɛla bɛn be dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni.
en: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.

dag: Hɔrinim nanima n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana.
en: The clans of the Horites were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli bee n-doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, dindina noli dibu ŋɔ zaa ni lu yi zuɣu din ya.
en: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-nyaŋ Kiriatisɛfanim ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣipini.
en: Caleb said, I will give my daughter in marriage to the man who attacks and conquers Kiriath Sepher.

dag: N ni bo zuɣulaannim bɛn ni guli ba, ka bɛ ku lan zɔri dabiɛm bee n-gbarigi bee ka bɛ ni so ti bɔrigi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will place over them shepherds who care for them. Then they will no longer be afraid or dread harm, nor will any be missing, declares the LORD.

dag: Kum maa ni daa mii pam maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bindira ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim gbarigi zaa.
en: The famine was so severe that there was no food anywhere, and the people of Egypt and Canaan became weak with hunger.

dag: O mi ku kabigi gbiŋgban dalim bee n-kpihim firila mia buɣim hal nti tahi yɛlimaŋli nasara dibu na.
en: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.

dag: Ka buɣim maa buɣim niɛm daa kpuɣi bimbini maa zuɣu du zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ malaika maa yiɣi kpe di ni n-dol li du zuɣusaa, ka Manɔa min o paɣ daa nya lala ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: The fire blazed up toward the sky, and the Lord 's angel went up toward heaven in the fire. Manoah and his wife bowed down low when they saw what happened.

dag: M bi bɔri mmaŋ jilima tibu, amaa yino n-naɣ beni m-bɔri ni n nya jilima, ŋun mi n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: Im not trying to bring glory to myself. Theres one who is seeking to glorify me, and hes the judge.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla nyin Yawɛ ni ti ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni atam din daŋ niŋbu na ti ti a. Ka a zaŋ li zali tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka kurim tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: So now I bring to the Lord the first part of the harvest that he has given me. Then set the basket down in the Lord 's presence and worship there.

dag: Zaŋmiya binyara sa n-dalim yi pala, malimiya dapaɣa din mali sabbu. Kpahimmiya palidaa la viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ni daa doli shɛli chaŋ la. Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ labimiyana. Labimiya yi tinsi ŋɔ ni na.
en: People of Israel, repair the road signs. Put up signs that show the way home. Watch the road. Remember the road you are leaving on. Israel, my bride, come home. Come back to your towns.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn sani nti yɛl o.
en: The Israelites sent this message to King Sihon of the Amorites:.

dag: Ti ni daa lu soli chani Bashan saha shɛli ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa daa yina ti liri ti ni bɛ tuhi ti tɔbu Ɛdirɛi.
en: Next we turned and went up along the road to Bashan. Og, Bashans king, came out with all his forces to meet us in battle at Edrei.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, kpɛmiya kpe na. Ka yɛri bɛn ka yɛm mi;.
en: Whoever needs instruction, come. She invites all the simple people and says.

dag: Ka yi ti chaŋ maligumaana ŋun tumdi tuma di saha maa sani ti yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni m paai ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
en: Go to the priest who is in office at that time and say to him: I am declaring right now before the LORD my God that I have indeed arrived in the land the LORD swore to our ancestors to give us.

dag: Ka gooni maa yi ti lu, bɛ ni bɔhi ya, Yi ni daa zaŋ binshɛli paligi li la lee be ya? .
en: When the wall falls down, the people will ask the prophets, What happened to the plaster you put on the wall.

dag: Bɛ yi kuhi boli ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni saɣi. Bɛ yi suhiri ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: I will answer them before they call for help. I will help them before they finish asking.

dag: Kahimiya yi nɛma ka bɛ gbahi ya daba chaŋ, yinim bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ. Dama Mɛmfisi ni ti leei dabari n-wurim doya, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: People of Egypt, pack your things. Get ready for captivity, because Memphis will be a ruined, empty land. Those cities will be destroyed, and no one will live there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaɣisi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa, ka daa nahim ba, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛn yɛn bahi ba yoli nuu ni hal ti kari ba o sani bahi.
en: So the LORD rejected all of Israels descendants. He punished them, and he handed them over to enemies who plundered them until he finally threw them out of his sight.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka bɛ daa to jina bɔri so shɛli bɛ yɛn doli ku o.
en: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.

dag: Naawuni nia lɔbu min o ni zali shɛm puuni ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋda; ka ŋun Naawuni pii ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba ti mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun lo ka zal li shɛm omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni piligu ni ha la zuɣu.
en: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nahiri tintarisi vulɔnima, ka fari biŋkɔbbaligu n-zaŋdi ba chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri bɛmaŋmaŋ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu mini suhugarigu ni nintam pam puuni ka n daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya, ka di daa pala n lomi ni n tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu, amaa n daa bɔrimi ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ n yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: I wrote to you in tears, with a very troubled and anxious heart. I didnt write to make you sad but so you would know the overwhelming love that I have for you.
