dag: O nyɛla ŋun viɛla kaman saŋkpaliŋ la, ka simdi ni a yu o. Chɛ ka o biha tiɣ a nini sahakam, ka chɛ ka o ni yur a shɛm ku a zuɣu.
en: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ ni Yisa baŋya ni ŋuna n-shih o maa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni salo maa zaa ninni, n-kahigi wuhi daliri din chɛ ka o shih o ka dii nya alaafee maa.
en: When the woman saw that she could not hide, she came forward, shaking. She bowed down before Jesus. While everyone listened, she told why she touched him. Then she said that she was healed immediately when she touched him.

dag: Masia zuɣu ka tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa ni tooi chaŋ ti Ba Naawuni sani o Shi yino la zuɣu.
en: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.

dag: Bɔ saha ka o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani maa? Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la bee o gunibu la nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o zali di ni maa? Di nyɛla o ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la, ka pa ni o ni daa gun la nyaaŋa.
en: When did this take place? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? It was before, not after.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu Samaria; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam ʒin o nam ʒiishee.
en: Jehoash died and was buried in the royal tombs in Samaria, and his son Jeroboam II succeeded him as king.

dag: O daa me o jɛmbu duu ka di be kaman alizanda la, ka be kaman o ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ ka di kul beni sahakam shɛm la.
en: There he built his Temple like his home in heaven; he made it firm like the earth itself, secure for all time.

dag: ka yɛl o, Di ni nyɛ a suhuyubu ni ka a zaɣis a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛl la mini n ni daa zal a zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu zuɣu, n ni deeg a nam maa n-zaŋ li ti a kpambal so.
en: So the Lord said to Solomon, You have chosen to break your agreement with me. You have not obeyed my commands. So I promise that I will tear your kingdom away from you and give it to one of your servants.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima mini anzinfa ni daanya ni kuriti ni dalima ni kurizim.
en: Gold, silver, copper, iron, tin, and lead.

dag: Ka Hiburɔn daa leei Jɛfune ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb ni su shɛli hal ni zuŋɔ, o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yim la zuɣu.
en: And that city still belongs to the family of Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite. That land still belongs to his people because he trusted and obeyed the Lord , God of Israel.

dag: Ka o kɔre daa kul be o mamanim bɛn yoya be kaman bunsi yoya, ka bɛ bɔri paɣiba kaman yuri la ni.
en: She was filled with lust for oversexed men who had all the lustfulness of donkeys or stallions. .

dag: Amaa bɛ ni mali bidibbin shɛlikam jɛndi ya ku tooi niŋ ya shɛli; ka yi ni tooi garigi ŋunkam zaŋ ya taali bɔhigu. Man Yawɛ ni zabi n daba zuɣu, ka ti ba nasara.
en: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord , promise to bless you with victory.

dag: ka chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, dama ti gba chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali. Ka di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni. .
en: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted. .

dag: Ahitɔfɛl daa nyɛla naa Saawaralana, ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir la daa nyɛ naa zo sumo.
en: Ahithophel was adviser to the king, and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend and counselor.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilaa maa zuɣu; ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: Offer the proper grain offering of flour mixed with olive oil: pounds of flour with the bull, pounds with the ram.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa moori buɣim mini lahi. Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa mali binshɛŋa zaa kuli.
en: as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.

dag: Dabo shɛŋa zaa zuɣu bɛ ni daa kɔri bindira, gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim nimaani ka so ku tooi kpe di ni, amaa nimaani ni ti leela niɣi mini piɛri gɔrim shee.
en: As for the hills that were once farmed with hoes, you wont go there for fear of the thorns and thistles. They will become places where cattle are turned loose and sheep wander.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di bi kpan ya ni yi baŋ di dabisa bee saha shɛli m Ba Naawuni ni zal li o yiko ni.
en: Jesus replied, It isnt for you to know the times or seasons that the Father has set by his own authority.

dag: ni Uri bia Gɛba ŋun daa be Giliad din nyɛ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka zuɣulaan yino daa be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: Geber son of Uri: the region of Gilead, which had been ruled by King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan Besides these twelve, there was one governor over the whole land.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: An argument broke out among the disciples as to which one of them was the greatest.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul mi wuntizɔriba soli ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bahi yoli.
en: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛligu bi lan yɛn yuui. Amaa n yi kul tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ni niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: So tell them that I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: There will be no more delay. What I have said will be done. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannim dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa. Ka bɛ daa kana ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa.
en: The men taking care of the pigs ran to the town and the farms to spread the news. Then the people came out to see what had happened.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Ayuba daa lan niŋ yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi pahi. Ka o nini daa nya o yaantibichahi mi yaansi.
en: Job lived for another years—long enough to see his great-grandchildren have children of their own—.

dag: Wula ka yi lee tɛhiri Masia yɛla? Ŋun yaaŋa n-lee nyɛ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from? They answered, He will be a son of King David.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣ do n-gu m-bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun sɔɣi doya.
en: They are like a lion eager to rip its prey; they are like a strong young lion lying in wait.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri, amaa tummiyala din viɛla ka sokam zaa nya.
en: If someone has done you wrong, do not repay him with a wrong. Try to do what everyone considers to be good.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri, ka bɛ jilima zaa ŋmanila mɔpuma. Mɔri kpira, ka di puma kpahiri lura.
en: The Scriptures say, Our lives are like the grass of spring, and any glory we enjoy is like the beauty of a wildflower. The grass dries up and dies, and the flower falls to the ground.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa du zuɣusaa ha la gbinni lee nyɛ wula? Di gbinni nyɛla ni o daa tuui siɣimi na hal n-gari siɣi tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: When it says, He went up, what does it mean? It means that he first came down low to earth.

dag: Rɛsɛn din be Ninive mini Kala din nyɛ tin tital la sunsuuni.
en: and Resen, the great city between Nineveh and Calah.

dag: Yihim ma n suhuyubu alahichi tumbu ni; ka di chɛ ka di su ma. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n ku mali galimi, ka yi taali din galisi pam ni.
en: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Sara maligu shee alahichi yɛn ʒila a min a bidibisi ni a yaannim zuliya bɛn be a sani zuɣu; ka maligumaanitali alahichi ʒi a min a bidibisi maa kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Aaron, You, your sons, and the Levites must suffer the consequences of any guilt connected with serving in the Tent of my presence; but only you and your sons will suffer the consequences of service in the priesthood.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋdi binshɛŋa din be kasi bahiri bahi bee n-zaŋdi binshɛŋa din mali buchi pam bahiri kuruchunima, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ no li fi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka ŋmaligina tin ya daŋa.
en: Do not give what is holy to dogs—they will only turn and attack you. Do not throw your pearls in front of pigs—they will only trample them underfoot.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ ni nam dabisi shɛli. Chɛliya ka ti suhuri paligi ka mali suhupiɛlli di ni.
en: This is the day the LORD acted; we will rejoice and celebrate in it!.

dag: Amaa alahichinim bɛn ni ti bahi yoli zaa, ka ninvuɣ biɛri zuliya ti bahi yoli.
en: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnima, Pɔhim tulli ni ti yi n sani daboya zuɣusaa n-ʒe n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti ʒe n-kpa n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ polo, di pala pɔhim shɛli din ni yɛli binyara bee din ni pɔbisi binyara saɣiri chaŋ.
en: When disaster comes, the Lord will tell you people of Jerusalem, I am sending a windstorm from the desert— not a welcome breeze. And it will sweep you away as punishment for your sins.

dag: Zɔn tital la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili di kazala la zaa mɛbu ni, bɛ daa yi zaŋla kuɣikpɛra m-me kulis ata, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: The surrounding great courtyard had three rows of cut stones and a row of trimmed cedar just like the inner courtyard of the LORDs temple and its porch.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi yɛli, Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ pala alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu yɛtɔɣa. Alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu ni tooi neei zom nina.
en: But others were saying, A man with a demon could not talk like this! How could a demon give sight to blind people.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu zaligu din wuhiri ni di nyɛla daɣiri bee di pala daɣiri.
en: These laws determine when something is unclean and when it is clean.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuma awɛi ni, gol so ŋun pahiri chir pia puuni ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛm n-teei gil li.
en: This is how Jerusalem was captured: During the tenth month of the ninth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He surrounded the city to defeat it.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa zali dunɔguliba Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya ni ni bɛ kariti bɛn bi be kasi.
en: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisa; di kul chanimi ti dooni niŋgbina ni.
en: The words of gossips are like choice snacks; they go down to the inmost parts.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha. Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla, ka bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a nyɛla Galili tiŋbia.
en: But he denied it again. A short time later, those standing around again said to Peter, You must be one of them, because you are also a Galilean.

dag: N ni zaŋ alikama zaɣ suma dihi ya, ka zaŋ tampiŋ ni shiri tin ya ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: I would give the best wheat to my people. I would give them the purest honey, until they were satisfied.

dag: Ti Duuma kpalim ŋmanila ti dima. O wurim Izraɛl; O wurim di nanim yiya la zaa, ka wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. O chɛ ka Juda bipuɣiŋga fabila min o kuhigu maan pahi.
en: Like an enemy, the Lord has destroyed Israel; He has left her forts and palaces in ruins. He has brought on the people of Judah unending sorrow.

dag: So ni tooi wuhi Naawuni ŋun kariti wɔɣira saria ŋɔ yɛm?.
en: No one can teach God anything he doesnt already know. God judges even those in high places.

dag: Nyam n ni yur a zaligunim maa shɛm. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili.
en: See how I love your instructions, Lord . Your love never changes, so save me!.

dag: Yihimiya ansarisimaana yi kɔbili ni, ka zabili naai, ka naŋgbankpeeni mini turi chɛ.
en: Get rid of the proud who laugh at what is right, and trouble will leave with them. All arguments and insults will end.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti mali m-be kasi Yisa Masia ni daa tum Naawuni yubu, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mali sara yim ka di yɛla naai zaa la zuɣu.
en: We have been made holy by Gods will through the offering of Jesus Christs body once for all.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti lu Dɛbirinim zuɣu. Dɛbir tuuli yuli n-daa nyɛ Kiriatisɛfa.
en: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ o yɛda maa, Yi yi doli n yɛligu, yi ni niŋ n nyaandol maŋa.
en: Jesus said to the Jews who believed in him, You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teaching.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba ni ʒirinim maa kpi n-kpe gbala ni, ka bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni yuusim pirigili na bi paai gba. Amaa nyini ka man kul ni niŋ naani.
en: But you, God, bring the wicked down to the deepest pit. Let bloodthirsty and treacherous people not live out even half their days. But me? I trust in you!.

dag: Ka n ti wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will force the Egyptians to live as prisoners in foreign nations, and they will know that I, the Lord , have punished them.

dag: O vuhibu pɔhim din be kaman kokpɛɣu din ʒiri binshɛɣukam chani la be o tooni n-kuri zuliya shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaani tariga.
en: He sends the wind in front of him like a flood that carries everything away. It sweeps nations to destruction and puts an end to their evil plans.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Sool ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pool la, ka o mirig o nina niŋ bukpaha maa.
en: Then Saul—also known as Paul—was filled with the Holy Spirit; he looked straight at the magician.

dag: Ka wula ka a bɔhi ma lala? Bɔhimila bɛn wum n wuhibu maa m-baŋ n ni yɛli ba shɛm, dama bɛ mi n ni yi yɛri ba shɛm.
en: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dab so Naawuni ni pii ka boli ni n leei tumo m-moli ŋun Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sanna.
en: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛlaa maa kul mal o yila maa n-ʒiɛri kpari wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo. Ka biŋkɔb so daa kani n-ni tooi taɣ o zali bee n-zo n-yi o nuu ni tiligi. Piɛlaa maa daa kul tumdila o suhuyubu, ka duhir omaŋa.
en: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yuri ya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka a lee yuri ti? Yawɛ yɛliya, Iso daa pala Yaakubu mabia? Di zaa yoli, n daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: The Lord says to his people, I have always loved you. But they reply, How have you shown your love for us? The Lord answers, Esau and Jacob were brothers, but I have loved Jacob and his descendants.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bihi maa daa niŋ lala, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim maa ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa zali shɛm, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindira ti ba.
en: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them good wagons just as Pharaoh had promised. And Joseph gave them enough food for their trip.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni asiba m-mal lala hal ti paai saha shɛl o ni daa zal li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin.
en: So the Lord sent an epidemic on Israel, which lasted from that morning until the time that he had chosen. From one end of the country to the other seventy thousand Israelites died.

dag: Ka kuŋ daa ti ŋme yuntisuɣu yɛli, Aŋgo maa paana! Yimiyana ti tuh o soli.
en: It was already midnight when the cry rang out, Here is the bridegroom! Come and meet him.

dag: Naawuni, n nyɛla ŋun ka yaa ni nandana. Kam n sanna yomyom. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira, di yuui.
en: I am weak and poor; come to me quickly, O God. You are my savior and my Lord — hurry to my aid!.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara tila alizinnima, pa Naawuni, ka mali maliŋ ti wun shɛb bɛ ni pun bi mi. Bɛ daa lan mali wun pal shɛb bɛn na yoli yina ka nyɛ yi yaannim ni daa bi lu shɛb sizuura.
en: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ tuma zuɣulaantab la daa niŋ kaman Naa Darius ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: So Tattenai the governor of the area west of the Euphrates River, Shethar Bozenai, and the men with them obeyed King Darius order. They obeyed the order quickly and completely.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa buɣiri kpana, ka gbibi nyɔtaɣira kalinli daa nyɛla tɔbbihi tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisinii.
en: from Judah, carrying shield and spear, , troops armed for battle.

dag: O daa wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima tibisim shɛm tariga mali teebuli din nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro piɛri tab sɔŋdi shɛli zuɣu ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali anzinfa teebuli kam.
en: David told him how much gold should be used for each table for the holy bread and how much silver should be used for the silver tables.

dag: Gibiɔn daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiwɛinaanu.
en: of Gibeon.

dag: Di mi bi tuhi ni ti zahim ti Duuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka tinvura dim ku ba la.
en: We should not test Christ as some of them did. Because of that, they were killed by snakes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhiri booni tab yɛra, Kasi, kasi, kasi! N-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. O jilima palila dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: The angels were calling to each other, Holy, holy, holy is the Lord All-Powerful. His Glory fills the whole earth.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm; ka Naawuni daa yo Nuhu niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: Male and female of every creature went in, just as God had commanded him. Then the LORD closed the door behind them.

dag: Pa mani ka o di tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa maa jɛndira, ka n ku zaŋ yi yɛtɔɣa maa garig o.
en: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Amaa o daa lee bi tummi kaman o ba min o ma ni daa tum shɛm la; dama o daa wurim o ba ni daa me Baal binwɔɣinli shɛli zal la.
en: He did what the Lord said was wrong. But he was not like his father and mother, because he removed the pillar that his father had made for worshiping Baal.

dag: Zomiya dinkam nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and stay away from everything that is evil.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, pumpɔŋɔ ŋmaligim a nina kpa ti polo na ka gbilisi tibili wum ti suhigu kpe ŋɔ.
en: Lord God, hear us when we pray in this temple.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa nim kpillikpilli mini zuɣu ti o, ka o nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛ nandaamba, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi nyɛ bundaannima. Ŋuna n-filindi nira, ŋuna n-lan duhiri nira.
en: He makes some people poor and others rich; he humbles some and makes others great.

dag: Yuun pihinahi zaa ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul birigiri bɛ suhuri ni ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: I was angry with them for years. I said, They are not faithful to me. They refuse to do what I say.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-deeri o ba saɣisigu, amaa ansarisimaana bi deeri zuɣu ni kpahibu.
en: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.

dag: Amaa ka putɔɣulaannim mini ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa pahi doli Dauda chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti bi yɛn ti ba ti ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa ŋɔ shɛli, naɣila bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ka ti ni zaŋ ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ, dama bɛ daa bi dol ti chaŋ.
en: Some of David's men were good-for-nothings, and they said, Those men didn't go with us to the battle, so they don't get any of the things we took back from the Amalekites. Let them take their wives and children and go.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛ vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ! A mi ni n dirila n ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri n ni bi di atam shɛli wahala bebɔ?.
en: The master of the servant told him, You are lazy and good-for-nothing! You know I harvest what I don't plant and gather crops where I haven't scattered seed.

dag: Bɛ daa guhiri ma mi kaman bɛ ni guhiri saa shɛm la. Bɛ suhuri daa kul yɛla n zuɣu kaman niriba suhuri ni ye siɣili saa zuɣu shɛm la.
en: they waited for me as for rain, opened their mouth as for spring rain.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba leei zuliya yini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Izraɛl zoli zuɣu, ka na yino ti nyɛ bɛ zaa naa. Bɛ ti ku lan nyɛ zuliya diba ayi, bɛ mi ti ku lan pirigi n-nyɛ nam buyi.
en: I will unite them into one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. They will have one king to rule over them, and they will no longer be divided into two nations or split into two kingdoms.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka di ka nyu. Ka o daa bo difu ti bɛ bunsi la gba.
en: Then the old man took the Levite and the people with him to his house. He fed their donkeys. They washed their feet and then had something to eat and drink.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, di bi maari biɛrim n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n yi fo, di sɔŋsim lee nyɛ ma dini?.
en: Nothing I say makes my pain go away. But keeping quiet does not help either.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni darigi Amalɛknim ŋɔ tibili bɛ ni daa niŋ Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila zuɣu.
en: When the Israelites were on their way out of Egypt, the nation of Amalek attacked them. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and now I am going to make Amalek pay!.

dag: Dama zuliya kam wuna zaa nyɛla binnana; amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.

dag: Zuliya kam, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu, ka mol li gili teeku noli tiŋgbana din be katinsi. Yɛlimiya, Ŋun daa wurim Izraɛlnim kpɛhi yɔɣu la ni lan laɣim ba, o ni gul ba kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la.
en: Listen to the LORDs word, you nations, and announce it to the distant islands: The one who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them safe, as a shepherd his flock.

dag: Ka Amiram daa kpuɣ o piriba Jokɛbɛd n-zaŋ o dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa. Amiram daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Amram married his father's sister Jochebed, who bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived years.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna. Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Bring us back, Lord God Almighty. Show us your mercy, and we will be saved.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ a binyɛrigu ni. Ka o zaŋ o nuu niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu gbaai li, ka di paligi zaa paratɛte kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: Again, the LORD said to Moses, Put your hand inside your coat. So Moses put his hand inside his coat. When he took his hand out, his hand had a skin disease flaky like snow.

dag: ka yɛli, Nyin Sintani bia ŋɔ, nyin ŋun nyɛ wuntia tuuni kam dima, ka yɔhiŋgu mini bilikɔnsi tuma pal a kɔbili ni ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun kul kpaŋd amaŋ ni a zaŋ ti Duuma yɛlimaŋli soya leei ʒiri.
en: and said, You son of the Devil! You are the enemy of everything that is good. You are full of all kinds of evil tricks, and you always keep trying to turn the Lord's truths into lies!.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma.
en: Balaam said, Build seven altars here, then bring me seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: n-yɛra, O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: He gave it as a law to Jacob. He gave it to Israel as an agreement that will last forever!.

dag: Pa Dauda so yɛla bɛ ni wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku niriba tuhi piapia la m-bala? .
en: The Israelites even dance and sing, Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand.

dag: Ka shɛb daa niŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛda, ka bɛn kpalim mi biɛhim li.
en: Some of them were convinced by his words, but others would not believe.

dag: Di saha maa ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This gave full meaning to what God said through the prophet Jeremiah:.

dag: Di yi shiri nyɛla yi duhila yimaŋa n-jɛndi ma, ka zaŋ n filiŋ ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: You think you are better than I am, and regard my troubles as proof of my guilt.

dag: M mi ni yi nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya; amaa di mi zaa yoli, yi bɔri ni yi ku ma, dama n yɛligu bi kpɛri yi suhuri ni.
en: I know you are Abraham's descendants. Yet you are trying to kill me, because you will not accept my teaching.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul laɣindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni suhu yini biɛɣukam, ka laɣindi taba yinsi n-laɣindi diri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Every day, they met together in the temple and ate in their homes. They shared food with gladness and simplicity.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din be tibi; ka nyɛ din tiri nyɛvili. Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din mali naani niŋbu, ka lan nyɛ din tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi shɛli baŋsim.
en: The Lord s teachings are perfect. They give strength to his people. The Lord s rules can be trusted. They help even the foolish become wise.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni di ba. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi n-chaŋ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Kalidianim bɛn teei gili ya ŋɔ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tuhi lu di saha maa, ka Judanim di nasara, dama bɛ daa niŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la naani.
en: And so the people of Judah were victorious over Israel, because they relied on the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, garim niriba maa tooni leei bɛ zuɣulana ka yi lan gbaai soli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni.
en: Instead, he told me, Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.

dag: Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni ka naanyi kpi m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:.

dag: Amaa ka yi niŋ tipawumli, ka zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi baɣaka. Yi tum tuumbiɛri pam n-gari yi yaannim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: But they didnt listen to me or pay attention; they were stubborn and did more harm than their ancestors.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba. Lala zuɣu ka yi chirim maa.
en: Jesus said to them, Isnt this the reason you are wrong, because you dont know either the scriptures or Gods power?.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn garigi yɛl o, Ndana, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi fa Izraɛlnim bahi? Nyama, n daŋ niriba nyɛla bɛn ka yaa Manaasa zuliya ni, ka m mi nyɛ ŋun pɔri n yiŋnim ni.
en: Gideon replied, But how can I rescue Israel? My clan is the weakest one in Manasseh, and everyone else in my family is more important than I am.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi yɛn galim a, a ni mali yɛlimaŋli, amaa chɛ ka m bɔh a m bɔhigu ŋɔ. Bɔzuɣu ka tuumbiɛrilana tɔŋda? Bɔzuɣu ka ʒiŋmariba kul tɔŋda?.
en: Lord , if I argued my case with you, you would prove to be right. Yet I must question you about matters of justice. Why are the wicked so prosperous? Why do dishonest people succeed?.

dag: bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li duhi, amaa ninvuɣ suma n-ni ye li, ka bɛn ka taali mi ti pirigi anzinfa maa ti taba.
en: but some good person will wear the clothes, and someone honest will get the silver.

dag: Kɔz daa nyɛla Anub mini Zɔbɛba ba, ka daa lan nyɛ Harum bia Aharihɛl daŋ niriba yaba.
en: Koz was the father of Anub and Zobebah, and the ancestor of the clans descended from Aharhel son of Harum.

dag: M mabihi ŋmarila ʒiri kaman kulibɔŋ kɔzɔrim la, bee kaman saa ni yi mi ka kom zɔri garita.
en: But I cannot depend on you, my brothers. You are like a stream that has no water when the weather is dry but is flooded when the rains come.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Jafɛt tɔŋ! Naawuni chɛ ka o zuliya mini Shɛm zuliya laɣim be; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: I pray God will give Japheth more and more land and let him take over the territory of Shem. May Canaan be his slave.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a mi Sool ni niŋ shɛm, o kari bukpahinim mini jinwariba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka wula ka a ti kana ti bari n nyɛvili tɔŋ ni a chɛ ka n kpi.
en: The woman answered, Surely you know what King Saul has done, how he forced the fortunetellers and mediums to leave Israel. Why, then, are you trying to trap me and get me killed.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu boli zaɣ viɛlli, ka zaŋ zaɣ viɛlli boli zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ zibisim leei neesim, ka zaŋ neesim leei zibisim, ka zaŋ bintɔɣu boli binnyaɣisili, ka zaŋ binnyaɣisili boli bintɔɣu.
en: Doom to those who call evil good and good evil, who present darkness as light and light as darkness, who make bitterness sweet and sweetness bitter.

dag: Di pala o ni daa saɣi ti ni daa kpam o jaande shɛm la kɔŋko, amaa omaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu ka o gba suhu daa ye yi sani kandina zuɣu.
en: Titus agreed to do what we asked. In fact, he himself wanted very much to come see you.

dag: Zaŋmi kikaa kpa a noli, dama juɣu tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣu, bɛ ni saɣim n daalikauli ka birigi n zaligu la zuɣu.
en: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.

dag: ni yi chirimya pam. Dama yimaŋmaŋ n-daa tim ma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani yɛra, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yi yɛli shɛli, nyin yɛlimi ti ka ti niŋ li.
en: You asked me to pray and find out what the Lord our God wants you to do, and you promised to obey him. But that was a terrible mistake.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ yɛm mini baŋsim azichi zaa ni sɔɣi so ni.
en: All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden in him.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kari ma a sani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma?.
en: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhi ni m mali taali; ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan tumdi tuma yoli?.
en: I myself am thought guilty; why have I tried so hard in vain?.

dag: ka paɣimiya Naawuni shɛlikam zaa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yu shɛli yi biɛhigu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Whatever happens, always be thankful. This is how God wants you to live in Christ Jesus.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka teeku kɔgbana puɣiri luri yɔri vuri. N yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: I am the Lord your God, the one who stirs up the sea and makes the waves roar. The Lord All-Powerful is his name.

dag: Tins ayɔbu maa yɛn nyɛla Izraɛlnim mini saamba bɛn ʒi bɛ sani ni saan shɛb bɛn gariti tiliginsim tinsi, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala sarati kubu ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: These six cities will be refuge for Israelites, immigrants, and temporary residents, as a place to flee for anyone who kills a person by accident.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka piɛlaa ŋun mali yil wɔɣila ayi ʒe mɔɣili maa noli. O yila maa zaɣ yini daa wɔɣimi gari yin la, ka nyɛ din bahindi nyaaŋa yina.
en: I looked up and saw a ram standing at the side of the river. The ram had two long horns. The horns were both long, but one horn was longer than the other horn. The long horn was farther back than the other horn.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma bi wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛna n-nyɛ laakuma mini soonsi ni ŋɔŋa, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa bɛ ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛlnim zaa lala.
en: This is what Moses said to Aaron, his sons, and to all the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi kul ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ, yi wuhirila ti Duuma kum yɛla hal ni o ti labina.
en: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.

dag: M bia wumma, deemi n yɛligu ka nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: Listen, my son, and take in my speech, then the years of your life will be many.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpe o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: His wife Jezebel came to him. Why are you upset and not eating any food? she asked.

dag: Chɛrubinim ayi maa kpiŋkpama zaŋ tuɣi taba wɔɣilim daa nyɛla kaman mita awɛi, ka bɛ daa ʒe bɛ naba zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa dunoli.
en: The wings of these creatures extended thirty feet. They stood on their feet facing the main room.

dag: N lan bɔri ni paɣiba gba zaŋdi situra din veeni ba ka ku mali galimi ka nyɛ din simdi m-maani bɛmaŋa, ka pa ni zuɣuri pambu mini salima ni waya yɛri yɛbu ni binyara din mali shaara zaŋ niŋ bɛmaŋa;.
en: And I want the women to make themselves attractive in the right way. Their clothes should be sensible and appropriate. They should not draw attention to themselves with fancy hairstyles or gold jewelry or pearls or expensive clothes.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri ya, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri daadam ŋun ni kpi ŋɔ dabiɛm? Daadam ŋmanila mɔri, o kul ku beni sahakam.
en: The Lord says, I am the one who comforts you. So why should you be afraid of people? They are only humans who live and die like the grass.

dag: Dama di ni yuui ka Izraɛlnim ku lan mali naa bee zuɣulana, ka ku lan mali maligu, ka binwɔɣila ku lan be bɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan mali wuni bee baɣibihi.
en: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu.
en: This wine is my blood, which will be poured out to forgive the sins of many and begin the new agreement from God to his people.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n ni pili n-chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam niriba zɔn ya dabiɛm, bɛ yi wum yi yɛla dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira ka biɛrim pam mali ba.
en: From today on I will make people everywhere afraid of you. Everyone will tremble with fear at the mention of your name.

dag: ka di gari Farisii maa, o ni daa nya ka Yisa bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣ o nuhi ka ʒini ni o di maa zuɣu.
en: When the Pharisee saw that Jesus didnt ritually purify his hands by washing before the meal, he was astonished.

dag: Dan zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shuham daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shuhamnima. Dan zuliya niriba m-bala.
en: These are Dans descendants according to their clans: from Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These are the Danite clans according to their clans.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo tintariga ni ti zaŋla Damaskus mini Hauran sunsuuni la m-baɣisi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili n-tim Giliad mini Izraɛl tiŋgbana sunsuuni gari n-zaŋ hal ni wulimpuhili polo teeku ni n-zaŋ hal ti paai Tama. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ wulimpuhili polo yaɣili.
en: On the east side, the border will go from Hazar Enan between Hauran and Damascus and continue along the Jordan River between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the eastern sea and all the way to Tamar. This will be the eastern border.

dag: N bɔbi n gar bila zali. N zaŋla Ijipti tampiɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ shim niŋ pa di zuɣu.
en: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu, ka bahi ba, ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Hanun seized David's messengers, shaved off their beards, cut off their clothes at the hips, and sent them away.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu tir o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, These are my mother and my brothers!.

dag: Ijipti naa ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim maa zoya maa, ka o min o kpamba zaa suhuri daa lan taɣi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka ti daa niŋ lala? Bɔzuɣu ka ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ka chɛ ti tuma.
en: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had escaped, he and his officials changed their minds and said, What have we done? We have let the Israelites escape, and we have lost them as our slaves.

dag: dama ti wum ka o yɛli ni Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ni wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka taɣi ka shɛŋa Anabi Musa ni daa zali ni ti dol la.
en: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.

dag: Ka di mi ni yila yi yi kul ʒe yim ka ba n-zani, ka bi damdi zaŋ chaŋ lahibal suŋ tahima shɛli yɛla yi ni daa wum la polo. Di zuɣu ka man Pool leei tumtumda ŋun tumdi lahibal suŋ maa tuma din nyɛ bɛ ni pun yihi shɛli waazu ti sokam zaa dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn zaŋ yi ni lo nia shɛŋa sɔɣi Yawɛ, ka tumdi yi tuma zibisim ni ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi yɛra, So bi nyari ti, So mi bi mi ti.
en: Those who try to hide their plans from the Lord are doomed! They carry out their schemes in secret and think no one will see them or know what they are doing.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi yɛm, ka vihiri baŋdi salinim suhuri, ka tiri sokam zaa ka di doli bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ni bɛ tuma nyɔri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Biŋkpam zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn kpa shɛli polo ni ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Jeremiah, pray that the Lord your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do.

dag: Ka paɣisarili maa daa guui chaŋ ti zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛl o ma yiŋnima.
en: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.

dag: M pun yɛli ya di yɛla zali ka di wɔɣa pɔi ka di naanyi ti niŋ maa ni di chɛ ka yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi wuna bee yi dari binnana mini anzinfa binnana n-niŋ li.
en: I informed you long ago; before they came about I proclaimed them to you so you wouldnt say, My idol did them; my wood statue and metal god commanded them.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni booni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la puuni, kpaŋsimiya tab dabisili kam ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku niŋ tipawumlilana alahichi yɔhiŋgu zuɣu;.
en: Instead, encourage each other every day, as long as its called today, so that none of you become insensitive to God because of sins deception.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti niŋ naani ka vu m-miri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ alibarikalan ŋɔ nam ʒiishee, ka di chɛ ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka ti nya alibarika din ni sɔŋ ti saha shɛli ti ni bɔri li.
en: Finally, lets draw near to the throne of favor with confidence so that we can receive mercy and find grace when we need help.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika mini Naawuni yurilim ni Naawuni Shia Kasi dolintabitali kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami!.
en: I pray that you will enjoy the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi lan labina, n ku nya yɛndana yi ni.
en: But none of my friends show any sense.

dag: Piligu ni, zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini n-daa be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛ yɛtɔɣ yinsi.
en: At first, the people of the whole world had only one language and used the same words.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti suui yi noli. O nyaandoliba maa ni so daa bi buɣisi ni o bɔh o, Ŋuni n-nyɛ a? Bɛ daa mi ni bɛ Duuma m-bala.
en: Jesus said to them, Come and eat. None of the followers would ask him, Who are you? They knew he was the Lord.

dag: ka bɔhira, O labbuna alikauli lɔbu palibu la lee be ya? Dama ti banim kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ni pɔŋɔ, binshɛɣukam na kul bemi kaman di ni daa be shɛm dunia nambu saha la.
en: and say, Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.

dag: n-chɛ ka paɣ maa nyu kɔtɔɣu din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na. Ka ko shɛli din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na ni kpe paɣ maa ni n-ti o biɛrim pam.
en: Then the woman must drink the water that brings trouble. This water will enter her and, if she is guilty, it will cause her much suffering.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, hal bɛ yi yɛn kpɛh a la duu, m min a ni laɣim kpe duu maa; di mi yi nyɛla kum, m min a ni laɣim kpi.
en: Peter responded, Lord, Im ready to go with you, both to prison and to death.

dag: Ti yi dol o zaligunima, dina n-ni chɛ ka ti baŋ ni ti mi o.
en: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kab chaŋ bɛ ni daa tuhi fa neen shɛŋa maa gbini nti kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi ni naɣinyama sɔŋ, ka niriba maa daa ŋub ba, bɛ mi daa bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They had taken sheep, cattle, and calves from the Philistines. Now they were so hungry that they killed the animals on the ground and ate them. And the blood was still in the animals.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛligu Pɛɛga naai bɛ daa gari chaŋla Atalia.
en: There they preached the message in Perga and then went to Attalia.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni noli zuɣu, di chɛliya ka kɔr biɛri be yi biɛhigu ni kaman di ni daa be yi ni shɛm yi ni daa na be ʒilinsi puuni la.
en: Dont be conformed to your former desires, those that shaped you when you were ignorant. But, as obedient children.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o ni o niŋm shɛm maa. Ka ŋun Balak mini Balaam daa kɔrigi naɣila yino mini piɛla yino m-mali sara pa bimbin yini kam zuɣu.
en: Balak did what Balaam asked. Then Balak and Balaam killed a ram and a bull on each of the altars.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Naa Dauda daa bol o o Duuma? O daa yɛliya:.
en: Jesus replied, How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka yi yi gundi nira Vuhim Dabisili dali ni Anabi Musa zaligu maa di saɣim, di chaŋ wula ka yi je suli niŋ ma n ni chɛ ka ninsal niŋgbuŋ zaa nya alaafee Vuhim Dabisili dali zuɣu?.
en: If a man can be circumcised on the Sabbath without breaking Moses Law, why are you angry with me because I made an entire man well on the Sabbath?.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Zaawuni ŋɔ, yi ni baŋ ni Yawɛ n-daa shiri yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, This evening you will know that it was the Lord who brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Yɔhiŋ sania zaŋ zahim binyɛra nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa binyɛra zahimbu sania zuɣu din tuhi nyɛla din paligir o suhu.
en: The LORD detests dishonest scales, but delights in an accurate weight.

dag: M-pahi bɛ ni daa nya ka do so ŋun kpaŋ maa ʒe bɛ sani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: But there was nothing that they could say, because they saw the man who had been healed standing there with Peter and John.

dag: ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu biɛlabiɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu dali, ka kom maa daa filim.
en: and the water gradually went down for days.

dag: So yi tum o kpee taali, ka kana ni o ti po pɔri duu ŋɔ ni sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini.
en: Whoever does wrong to someone will be brought to this altar. If they are not guilty, they will make an oath and promise that they are innocent.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti lan da yiya mini puri ni wain tihi puri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaha. .
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says, In the future my people will once again buy houses, fields, and vineyards in the land of Israel.

dag: Dabiɛm chɛmi ka ti ŋumdi kaman biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bee la, ka nandahima mi chɛ ka ti kumdi kaman ŋmana la. Ti kul guhirila yɛlimaŋli, ka bi nyari li; ka bɔri ŋun ni fa ti bahi, ka bi nyara.
en: We are always complaining; we growl like bears and moan like doves. We are waiting for justice, but there is none. We are waiting to be saved, but salvation is still far away.

dag: ka bi tum so taali, o bi deeri talima, o bi fari niriba, amaa ka naɣ zaŋd o bindirigu dihiri kum ni mali shɛba, ka sooni gbinfini ni mali shɛb la.
en: He doesnt cheat anyone, either by seizing collateral for loans or committing robbery. He gives his food to the hungry and clothes to the naked.

dag: Dauda ni daa ku Filistia doo maa ka labina ka bɛ kuni yiŋa, ka paɣiba daa yi Izraɛl tinsi zaa ni na n-yiini suhupiɛlli yila, ka ŋmɛri biŋkumda ka chaɣisiri chaɣisanim wari waa kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi Naa Sool soli.
en: As David was returning after killing Goliath and as the soldiers were coming back home, women from every town in Israel came out to meet King Saul. They were singing joyful songs, dancing, and playing tambourines and lyres.

dag: dama m bi yɛri shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa n-zali ma n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ka tɔɣisi shɛm.
en: I dont speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me regarding what I should speak and say.

dag: Pa kapinta ŋun nyɛ Mariama bia la m-bala? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Joses ni Judas ni Saimɔn la? Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o.
en: Isnt this the carpenter? Isnt he Marys son and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Arent his sisters here with us? They were repulsed by him and fell into sin.

dag: Ka di mi pala yi ni tum shɛli zuɣu ka yi tiligi, dinzuɣu shɛli kani ka yi ni nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: Its not something you did that you can be proud of.

dag: Niŋgbun yini mini Shi yino m-beni kaman tahima yini din nyɛ Naawuni ni boli ya shɛli zuɣu ni beni shɛm la.
en: There is one body and one Spirit, just as there is one hope to which God has called you.

dag: N ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla saha shɛli maa, ka bula so daa yi wulinluhili polo na n-kul kpaŋ zɔri yomyom hal ka o naba bi shihiri tiŋ gba. Ka o daa mali yil gahindili ka di sa o nina ayi sunsuuni.
en: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn.

dag: Ka Zilipa ŋun daa nyɛ Liya dabipaɣ la mi bidibisi daa nyɛ Gaad mini Asha. Yaakubu ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Mɛsopoteemia m-bala.
en: His sons by Zilpah, Leahs maid, were Gad and Asher. These were Jacobs sons who were born in Paddan Aram.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter.

dag: Yi tuuli yabidoo daa tum alahichi, ka yi yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisiriba tum alahichi n sani.
en: Your earliest ancestor sinned; your leaders sinned against me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma ni n yɛl a ni o ni niŋ a shɛm la ka o niŋ a maa, dama o darigi deei nam maa a nuu ni n-zaŋ ti Dauda ŋun nyɛ a kpee la.
en: The Lord has done to you what he told you through me: he has taken the kingdom away from you and given it to David instead.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bidibis ata daa be nimaani, bɛna n-nyɛ Jɔab mini Abishai ni Asahɛl. Asahɛl daa guurimi kaman molifu la.
en: Zeruiah's three sons were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel could run as fast as a deer in an open field.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛl o, Naawuni ni ŋme nyin dukpin piɛlli ŋɔ! A ʒinimi ni a kari ma saria kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka ti yaɣi zaligu maa zuɣu yɛli ni bɛ ŋmɛm ma.
en: Paul turned to the high priest and said, You whitewashed wall! God will hit you. You sit there to judge me by the Law of Moses. But at the same time you order men to break the Law by hitting me.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɛla zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni di bɛ tuma nyɔri.
en: Tell those who obey God, You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tooi daaŋa ni tampiligim chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni, ka Musa daa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma, ka di daa tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: So they got some ashes and stood before the king; Moses threw them into the air, and they produced boils that became open sores on the people and the animals.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Malimiya soli ti n niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ labi n sanna. Vuɣimiya tigbirigu kam din be bɛ soli zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.

dag: Niriba ni nya a zaɣim, ka a di vi bɛ sani. N ni bɔhi biɛri, m mi ku tiligi so.
en: Men will see your naked body and use you for sex. I will make you pay for the bad things you did, and I will not let anyone help you.

dag: Goma tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi zaa mini Bɛtitɔgarima din be nuzaa polo la tɔbbihi zaa be a sani, bɛ galisiya pam.
en: There will also be Gomer with all its groups of soldiers, and there will be the nation of Togarmah from the far north with all its groups of soldiers. There will be many people in that parade of prisoners.

dag: Yawɛ neeri zoomba nina. Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lu. Yawɛ yuri wuntizɔriba.
en: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people.

dag: Yi nini na kul bi neei? N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu n-dihi niriba tusaanu la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi li pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: Don't you understand? Have you forgotten about the , people and all those baskets of leftovers from just five loaves of bread?.

dag: Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A good tree cant produce bad fruit. And a rotten tree cant produce good fruit.

dag: Bɛna ka n suhir a tira; m bi suhir a tirila dunianima. A ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma maa ka n suhir a tira, dama bɛ nyɛla a niriba.
en: I pray for them now. I am not praying for the people in the world. But I am praying for these people you gave me, because they are yours.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ o naba ni. Amaa di ni sab yɛli ni o zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni maa, di bi wuhi ni ŋun Naawuni pah o ni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛli sɔŋ o naba ni maa zuɣu.
en: since he has brought everything under control under his feet. When it says that everything has been brought under his control, this clearly means everything except for the one who placed everything under his control.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Ilaija, ka o yiɣisi zo ni o tilig o nyɛvili. O daa zaŋla o tumo la n-zo n-kuli Bɛrishiiba din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti chɛ o nimaani.
en: Elijah was afraid and fled for his life; he took his servant and went to Beersheba in Judah. Leaving the servant there.

dag: Ka n daa lan kab jaaŋgbe shɛli din pah ayi ka di yuli booni Naŋgban yini la, ka Juda mini Izraɛl naŋgbanyini biɛhigu la daa saɣim.
en: Then I cut the stick named Union into two pieces. I did this to show that the union between Judah and Israel had been broken.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dilan nyɛla ŋun nya o ba zaɣim, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual intercourse with his fathers wife, he has uncovered his fathers nakedness. Both of them must be executed; their blood is on their own heads.

dag: Naawuni zaliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: For God said, Honor your father and your mother, and The person who speaks against father or mother will certainly be put to death .

dag: Di saha ka Hagai ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ tumo maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu n-yɛli niriba maa. Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni be yi sani.
en: Then Haggai, the LORDs messenger, gave the LORDs message to the people: I am with you, says the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛn fabindi be kaman bɛn bi fabinda, ka bɛn mali suhupiɛlli be kaman bɛn ka suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn dari nɛma be kaman bɛn bi su nɛma maa;.
en: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.

dag: Samuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Joɛl ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Abija ŋun daa pa o zuɣu.
en: Samuels family: the oldest Joel, and the second Abijah.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: No one patches old clothes by sewing on a piece of new cloth. The new piece would shrink and tear a bigger hole.

dag: M puhiri Ampiliatus n ni yuri so ti Duuma ni la.
en: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.

dag: ni Jarimut ni Ɛnganim ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Jarmuth and its pastures, En-gannim and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: Bɛ mi di yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim so, ka di ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni, amaa ka lee be baalim, ka mali sizuura lubu biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani.
en: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.

dag: Nyama, bihi ayi bɛn nyɛ Zadok bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan be bɛ sani nimaani, a ni tooi tim ba ka bɛ kana ti yɛli ma a ni wum shɛlikam zaa. .
en: They have their sons Ahimaaz and Jonathan with them, and you can send them to me with all the information you gather.

dag: Ka a pii Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ba ti Aduna min o bidibisi, ka bɛ nyɛ o ni su shɛb fukumsi zaa.
en: You will give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They have been assigned as a gift to him from the Israelites.

dag: Shulam paɣa, labimina, labimina! Labimina, labimina ka ti ti nya a. Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri man Shulam paɣa, kaman m bela tɔbbihi bɛn pie tab ʒiɛya buyi sunsuuni wari waa ŋɔ?.
en: Come back, come back, Shulammite! Come back, come back, so we may admire you. How you all admire the Shulammite as she whirls between two circles of dancers!.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ; ka paɣimiy o yuli; yɛlimiya o tiliginsim lahibali suŋ yɛla dabisili kam.
en: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Share the news of his saving work every single day!.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira, ka nyɛ Taasus din be Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi pɔri la tiŋbia. Ka lan yɛl o, N suhir a noli ni a chɛ ka n tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa. .
en: Paul replied, Im a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of an important city. Please, let me speak to the people.

dag: Dindali maa, yɛlimiya yi bihi Yawɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa tin ya shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la, di zuɣu ka yi puhiri di chuɣu maa.
en: Then on the seventh day you must explain to your children that you do this because the Lord brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino mali sara pa bimbini kam zuɣu.
en: Balak did just as Balaam said. He offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la nyɛla din ka gbinni? Di ni yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni ni zaŋ shi so niŋ ti ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka o suhu kul ye ti zuɣu.
en: Do you think the Scriptures mean nothing? The Scriptures say, The Spirit God made to live in us wants us only for himself.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ deebu la daa dii zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa wolim nya nyɔri ka di min o laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: As soon as the man had gone, the servant with the , coins used them to earn , more.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa be Ijipti Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Bɛ daa nya azichi pam nimaani, ka daa dɔɣi bihi ka bɛ zuliya maa nab pam.
en: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen. They settled in it, had many children, and became numerous.

dag: O mabia Shɛmɛr mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahi mini Rɔga ni Jɛhuba ni Aram.
en: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.

dag: Nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo pɔhim, yiɣisimiyana! Ʒiɛmiya kpe m puu maa ni, ka di tulaale nyom gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Chɛ ka n yura ka o puu maa ni na nti di di tiwal suma.
en: Wake up, North Wind. South Wind, blow on my garden; fill the air with fragrance. Let my lover come to his garden and eat the best of its fruits.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o pam; dama Gibiɔn daa nyɛla tin titali kaman tin titali kam din mali naa. Di daa galisi gari Ai, ka di dɔbba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la? Ka bɛ zaa yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate asked them, What am I to do with Jesus, who is called the Messiah? They all yelled, Nail him to a cross.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zooi lim zoya maa, ka di ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita ayopɔin zoya maa zuɣu.
en: The waters rose twenty-three feet high, covering the mountains.

dag: N ni ku bɛ naa, ka ku bɛ nabihi zaa pah o zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo tɔb na ti liri Judanima, ka kpe nayili ti ʒe bɛ ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa nayili maa ka gbah o paɣiba min o bidibisi zaa chaŋ. Bɛ daa gbah o bidibisi zaa ka ti naɣ chɛla o kaluɣi ŋun yuli daa booni Ahazia la kɔŋko.
en: They attacked Judah, broke down its defenses, and hauled off all the goods that were found in the royal palace, along with the kings children and wives. Only Jehoahaz, Jehorams youngest son, was spared.

dag: ka nyo bɛ naawuna buɣim, bɛn dee pala naawun maŋa, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpe da shɛŋa ni kuɣ shɛŋa, dina n-chɛ ka o daa saɣim ba maa.
en: and burned up their gods—which were no gods at all, only images of wood and stone made by human hands.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka o ti a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli.
en: Enjoy serving the Lord , and he will give you whatever you ask for.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba kana ti mali Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ mali neen shɛŋa zaa;.
en: All of you who are skilled workers should make all the things the Lord commanded:.

dag: N yuri Yawɛ, dama o wumdi n ni yɛri shɛm; ka deeri n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: I love the Lord for hearing me, for listening to my prayers.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bibil so na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni n-kpuɣ o buɣi ka yɛli ba.
en: Then Jesus took a small child and stood the child in front of the followers. He held the child in his arms and said.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la kul be n sani wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka a yilli mi be n sani yuŋ. Di nyɛla n suhigu zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n nyɛvil la sani.
en: May the Lord show his constant love during the day, so that I may have a song at night, a prayer to the God of my life.

dag: Ka sapashini ŋun pa o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Jɛhɔhanan. O daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinii.
en: Jehohanan was second in command, with , soldiers under him.

dag: Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa garigi yɛli naa, Nɛbukadnɛza, di bi kpa ni ti garig a shɛli yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered, Your Majesty, we will not try to defend ourselves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋma n-chihi kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kom maa ni, ka daa lan ŋma n-chihi mi shɛŋa din daa lo da shɛŋa din ŋmaligiri ŋariŋ maa, ka zaŋ ŋariŋ maa tanti lo n-tuhi pɔhim, ka pɔhim maa daa ʒe ba duhi duli.
en: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Yɛlimiya ma.
en: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ ŋun pun guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan kul kpalimmi be lala. Ka so mi beni n-nyɛla ŋun bi guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan di bɔri ni o leei ŋun guni.
en: If a man was already circumcised when he was chosen, he should not change his circumcision. If a man was without circumcision when he was chosen, he should not be circumcised.

dag: ka bɛ moli Yawɛ yuli Ziɔn, ka paɣ o Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then people in Zion will tell about the Lord . They will praise his name in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa mal litaafi bil shɛli ka di kpabigi be o nuu ni, ka o zaŋ o nudirigu napɔŋ zali teeku ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa napɔŋ mi zali duli.
en: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

dag: Tinzunnim ni guli yi biŋkɔbbaligu tin ya, ka ko yi puri tin ya, ka guli yi tihi puri tin ya.
en: Foreigners will stay and shepherd your sheep, and strangers will be your farmers and vinedressers.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Ishimail ŋun nyɛ Haga, Zara dab paɣa ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ ni daa dɔɣ so la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Ishmael was the son of Abraham and Hagar, the slave woman of Sarah.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Amasa, Cham ti boli Judanim zaa ka bɛ laɣim n sanna daba ata sunsuuni, ka a gba beni pahi.
en: The king said to Amasa, Call the men of Judah together and be back here with them by the day after tomorrow.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔzuɣu ka a fiɛbi buŋ maa buta ŋɔ zaa? N kamina ni n ti gu a soli, dama m bi yu a ni chani chandi shɛli maa.
en: The LORDs messenger said to him, Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? Ive come out here as an adversary, because you took the road recklessly in front of me.

dag: Dauda ni daa yi Hiburɔn na nyaaŋa o daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi, ka bo mamanim pahi, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pah o.
en: David moved from Hebron to Jerusalem. In Jerusalem, he got more slave women and wives. So David had more children who were born in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o na. O ni daa ti mirina ka Yisa bɔh o.
en: Jesus stopped and called for the man to be brought to him. When he was present Jesus asked.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, N wuhirila niriba palɔni, ka kul wuhiri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛŋa Yɛhudianim ni laɣindi la. N na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni.
en: Jesus answered, I have always spoken openly to all people. I always taught in the synagogues and in the Temple area. All the Jews come together there. I never said anything in secret.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru la lo o shee ni n-wa waa ni o yaa zaa Yawɛ tooni.
en: David was dancing in front of the Lord . He was wearing a linen ephod.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma gbuɣinli nyinyɛhi ni bahi ka lan fa ma kunduŋ nyinyɛhi ni bahi ŋɔ ni lan fa ma Filistia doo ŋɔ gba nuu ni bahi. Ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, Chama, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The LORD, David added, who rescued me from the power of both lions and bears, will rescue me from the power of this Philistine. Go! Saul replied to David. And may the LORD be with you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka shiri zaŋ Keenannim maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni; ka bɛ daa ku ba ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Hɔrima.
en: The Lord heard them and helped them conquer the Canaanites. So the Israelites completely destroyed them and their cities, and named the place Hormah.

dag: N daa mi do so ŋun be Masia ni yuun pinaanahi din gari ŋɔ puuni, ka Naawuni daa kpuɣ o du zuɣusaa m-mali ti paai alizanda puuni ha. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: I know a man in Christ who was taken up to the third heaven. This happened years ago. I dont know if the man was in his body or out of his body, but God knows.

dag: Yawɛ ni pii so, ka o nyɛ ti nyɛviya vuhim ŋɔ, bɛ daa gbaag o bɛ bɔɣa ni chaŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ni daa yɛli ni ti ni kpe so mahim ni ka be dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: The king was very important to us. He was like the breath we breathe, but he was trapped by them. The Lord himself chose the king, and we said this about the king, We will live in his shadow. He protects us from the nations.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka tiŋ maa nim yina ti nya ka bɛ wurimla Baal bimbini maa, ka daai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi, ka me bimbin shɛli zali di zaashee maa, ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi mali sara pa di zuɣu n-nyo o buɣim.
en: When the people in town got up early the next morning, they found that the altar to Baal and the symbol of Asherah had been cut down, and that the second bull had been burned on the altar that had been built there.

dag: Ka Gɛza naa Hɔram daa kana ti sɔŋ Lakishinim maa, amaa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku o min o tɔbbihi zaa hal ka bɛ ni so bi tiligi.
en: Then Gezers King Horam came up to help Lachish. But Joshua struck him and his people down, until no survivors were left.

dag: N dabisa chani yomyom gari kpalua gombo, ka m paari di tariga, ka tahima kani.
en: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle.

dag: N daa lola n nina alikauli ni n ku lihi paɣisarili.
en: I have made a solemn promise never to look with lust at a woman.

dag: A daa chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi n-galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka a daa zaŋ ba na ti niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ su li la ni.
en: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-lan yi palo maa yaha, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni anab kura la ni yino n-neei kum ni na maa.
en: Others said, Elijah has come to us. And some others said, One of the prophets from long ago has risen from death.

dag: N yi tɛh a soya yɛla, ŋ-ŋmaligirimi dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I have considered my conduct, and I promise to follow your instructions.

dag: Chɛ ka n naba yaabu doli soli ka n chani kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka di chɛ ka tuumbiɛri nyaŋ ma.
en: As you have promised, keep me from falling; don't let me be overcome by evil.

dag: Bɛ kpiya ka ku lan be yaha. Bɛ shihi ku lan yiɣisi, dama a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi; so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: Those dead lords will not come to life. Those ghosts will not rise from death. You decided to destroy them, and you destroyed everything that makes us think about them.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni maa Bia la zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ anfaani niŋ ti ni, ka ti ti suhudoo, ka chɛ ka di leei ti dini yɛlimaŋli mini yurilim puuni.
en: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ tibig a yuli ʒiɛmani kam ni ka yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka a chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaashee zani a tooni.
en: so that your name will be great forever when people say, The LORD of heavenly forces is Israels God! May your servant Davids household be established before you.

dag: Lala zuɣu Masia ŋun daa zaŋ omaŋ mali sara yim ni o kpihim niriba pam daalahichi la ni lan labina pahi buyi, ka di pala alahichi zuɣu, amaa o yɛn labina ti tiligila bɛn suhuri kul ye o labbuna zuɣu ka guhir o la.
en: So Christ was offered as a sacrifice one time to take away the sins of many people. And he will come a second time, but not to offer himself for sin. He will come the second time to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tiligi Izraɛlnim Ijiptinim nuu ni dindali maa shɛm m-bala. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya Ijiptinim ni kpi n-do teeku duli shɛm.
en: On that day the Lord saved the people of Israel from the Egyptians, and the Israelites saw them lying dead on the seashore.

dag: Ka Juda daa nyɛ o paɣ Tɛma bihi Pɛrɛz mini Zɛra ba, ka Pɛrɛz nyɛ Hɛzirɔn ba, ka Hɛzirɔn mi nyɛ Ram ba.
en: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah. Perez was the father of Hezron. Hezron was the father of Ram.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpɛhi Naawuni nini, ka lo kpara ni bɛ tuhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa;.
en: That is because that evil man shook his fist at God, refusing to obey. He dared to attack God All-Powerful.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N ni po pɔri maa.
en: Abraham said, I give you my word.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi li, ka dalima din be o niŋgbuŋ ni maa yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛl tim, dindina di kul nyɛla saŋkpambihi n-niŋ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu maa, o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: if the priest sees that there are faded white shiny spots on the skin of the body, it is just a rash that has broken out on the skin; the person is clean.

dag: So yi zaŋ liɣiri bee binshɛli nti puh o kpee sɔŋbu, ka bɛ zu bini maa dilan yiŋa, ka bɛ gbaai tayiɣ maa, di simdi ka tayiɣ maa yo bini maa zuɣu ʒii buyi.
en: Suppose a neighbor asks you to keep some silver or other valuables, and they are stolen from your house. If the thief is caught, the thief must repay double.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, sɔŋm ma! Tiligim ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Lord my God, help me! Show your faithful love and save me!.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti mali Babilɔn naa ansarisi yɛli, Na putɔɣulan la luya ka ku lan tooi nahim so yaha!.
en: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ baɣa be nandaamba ni, ka o zabiri faranim zuɣu.
en: I know that the LORD will take up the case of the poor and will do what is right for the needy.

dag: ka me Tadimɔr din daa be tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini tin shɛŋa din daa be Hamat ka nɛma be di ni la zaa.
en: He also built the town of Tadmor in the desert. He built all the towns in Hamath to store things in.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa daa yaai di noli n-vali bɛ mini bɛ yiŋnima ni Kɔra ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, including every human that belonged to Korah and all their possessions.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni n-nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ daa gbarigila Izraɛlnima ni bɛ di chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa.
en: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.

dag: Leedan daa malila bidibisi ata, Jɛhiɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Zɛtam pa, ka Joɛl daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ata.
en: Ladans family: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnima ti a ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Holy Spirit led David to say, The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.

dag: O yiko ni ka o chɛ ka teeku fo n-dɔni baalim. O yɛm ka o daa zaŋ ku Reehab.
en: By his power he stilled the Sea; split Rahab with his cleverness.

dag: Pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi maa daa nyɛla bini pihiwɛinaayɔbu m-be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka pumpɔrinchihi din daa gɔhigɔhi kur shɛŋa din gabigabi taba gili maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga.
en: There were pomegranates evenly spaced around each column, and a total of pomegranates were located above the chains.

dag: Binshɛɣukam tariga paabu saha miriya, dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu suhiri Naawuni.
en: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.

dag: Amaa nyin kul gbaam amaŋa yɛlli kam ni; mali suɣilo wahala dibu ni; tummi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma, ka tummi Naawuni ni piig a ni a tum tuun shɛl la.
en: But you must keep control of yourself in all circumstances; endure suffering, do the work of a preacher of the Good News, and perform your whole duty as a servant of God.

dag: ni Chɛfaramɔni ni Ofini ni Gɛba: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba. In total: twelve cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Ɛlikana daa yi kɔrigi binshɛli m-mali sara dahin shɛli o ŋmahirila nimdi tar o paɣ Pɛnina min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi zaa.
en: Whenever Elkanah offered a sacrifice, he gave some of the meat to Peninnah and some to each of her sons and daughters.

dag: O ni lan chɛ ka a lara, ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: He will let you laugh and shout again.

dag: Ka o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu maa n-yɔhim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bahi yol la. Din chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn bahi yoli maa nyɛla bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ yu yɛlimaŋli ka tiligi la zuɣu.
en: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka o yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: So they told Jesus, We don't know. Jesus said, Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.

dag: ni kpa shɛli din yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni yi ni yɛn zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛl tuɣindi luɣ kasi shee la. Di simdi ka bɛ tum n ni zal a ni a tum shɛlikam zaa.
en: the anointing oil, and the sweet-smelling incense for the sanctuary. They will do just as I have commanded you.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam nimaani, dama Naawuni be wuntizɔriba sani.
en: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni zali duri maa tooni zaŋ labi dundɔntitali polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: At the lower level the outer wall of the building was solid for feet, half its length; and there were rooms in the remaining feet. At the top level there were rooms in the entire length of the building.

dag: Ka Jɛzibɛl daa tim ti yɛli Ilaija, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n yi sa bi ku a kaman a ni ku anabinim ŋɔ shɛm maa, n wuna bɛn kum ma.
en: Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah with this message: May the gods do whatever they want to me if by this time tomorrow I havent made your life like the life of one of them.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔh o mi, A yi pala Masia bee Anabi Ilaija bee bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la, di chaŋ wula ka a baptaiziri niriba.
en: They said to John, You say you are not the Messiah. You say you are not Elijah or the Prophet. Then why do you baptize people.

dag: Yawɛ yi bahi li noli, wula ka di lee yɛn tooi fo? O zal li mi ni di liri Ashikɛlɔnnim mini bɛn be teeku noli.
en: But how can it rest, when I have given it work to do? I have commanded it to attack Ashkelon and the people who live on the coast.

dag: Dinzuɣu tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn niŋ yɛda la sani, amaa anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn bi niŋ yɛda la sani.
en: So then, tongues are a sign for those who dont believe, not for those who believe. But prophecy is a sign for believers, not for those who dont believe.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin.
en: Jesus asked, How much bread do you have? They said, Seven loaves.

dag: ka ti mi yi ye li, di ni chɛ ka ti ku be ti zaɣim.
en: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-chaŋ ni o ti nya Sool, ka bɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Sool daa kala Kamɛl na nti me bɛ ni yɛn mali binshɛli teer o yɛla zali, ka gari chaŋ Giligal.
en: Samuel got up early in the morning to meet Saul, and was told, Saul went to Carmel, where he is setting up a monument for himself. Then he left and went down to Gilgal.

dag: Ti ni daa du duli tiligi maa, ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl ti ni bɛ ya maa yuli m-booni Malta.
en: After reaching land safely, we learned that the island was called Malta.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa tiligi Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka o suhu bi piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ zaligu saɣindiba daɣiri tuma zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: He rescued Lot, a good man, who was distressed by the immoral conduct of lawless people.

dag: Goli palli dabisili dali, o ni ti bo naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa mini piɛbihi pola ayɔbu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi.
en: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya nyɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma. Ka Zadok mini Abiata nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: the general Benaiah, Jehoiadas son; the priests Zadok and Abiathar.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Jɛrimia bee anabinim la ni yino.
en: Some say John the Baptist, they answered. Others say Elijah, while others say Jeremiah or some other prophet.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa daa ti chirigi do so ka o yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, wuhim ti so shɛli din kuni tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ka ti niŋ a nirilim.
en: the spies saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, Show us the way into the city, and well be loyal to you in return.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti zali ya ni yi gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ gbinnyaɣinima ka bi doli wuhibu shɛli ti ni daa wuhi ya la.
en: Brothers and sisters, by the authority of our Lord Jesus Christ we tell you to stay away from any believer who refuses to work. People who refuse to work are not following the teaching that we gave them.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ dunianim zaa yipa vuhiya, ka nya suhudoo, ka sokam yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Now at last the whole world enjoys rest and peace, and everyone sings for joy.

dag: A chɛ ka mɔri zoori ka biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka chɛ bindira bimbilima ti ninsalinim ni bɛ kɔri li ka di yihiri bindirigu tiŋgban ni na.
en: You make the grass grow to feed the animals. You provide plants for the crops we grow— the plants that give us food from the earth.

dag: Yawɛ mali yaa gari kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ vubu. O mali yaa gari teeku kɔgbana. Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa zuɣusaa!.
en: But mightier than the sound of much water, mightier than the seas waves, mighty on high is the LORD!.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ kurimbuni ha, a nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa.
en: Long ago, you made the world. You made the sky with your own hands!.

dag: ka fɔntin shɛli din ti miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba ni bo naɣisa so bɛ ni na ʒi n-zaŋ tum tuma bee n-zaŋ dapua pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.

dag: Ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi lihi bɛ luɣa zuɣu, ka bi lan nya so naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: The followers looked, but they saw only Jesus there alone with them.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ ka di ti paag a sanna, ka nyin ka suɣilo? Di shihir a mi, ka nyin yihi tahima.
en: But now you feel discouraged when struck by trouble.

dag: Dina n-ni ti chɛ ka yi niŋ n shɛhiranima.
en: This will be your chance to tell the Good News.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa vinvamli din be Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la. Amaa so bi mi bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord buried him in a valley in Moab, opposite the town of Bethpeor, but to this day no one knows the exact place of his burial.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri wuntitali mini nirilim niŋbu ni nya nyɛvili mini jilima.
en: People who try hard to do good and be faithful will find life, goodness, and honor.

dag: ka tiligi bɛ shihi ka di ku kpe gballi ni; ka chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: He does this to save them from death. He wants to keep them from being destroyed.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ tin ya n-yɛli ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma laɣim be.
en: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.

dag: Wuntaŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka goli viɛlim be di ko, ka saŋmar so viɛlim be di ko ka chɛ saŋmar so mi viɛlim.
en: The sun has one kind of glory, the moon has another kind of glory, and the stars have another kind of glory .
