dag: Palo shɛli din kpalim ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili la ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa palo. Bɛ ni ti tooi me yiya nimaani bee n-chɛ ka di nyɛ palo doya, tiŋ maa ni ti be di sunsuuni.
en: The remaining area, . miles wide and . miles long, is for ordinary use for the city, for residences, and for pastures. The city will be in the middle of it.

dag: Ka Pool daa be yil shɛl ni o ni daa haayi duu la yuun muna ayi. Ka o daa kul tiri sokam bɛn kan o sanna soli ka bɛ nyar o.
en: Paul stayed two full years in his own rented house. He welcomed all the people who came and visited him.

dag: O zuliya daa bela Havila mini Shur luɣ shɛli din daa tuhi Ijipti dɛde zaŋ labi Asiria polo la. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti be ka chɛ Ibrahimma zuliya bɛn zaa kpalim la.
en: The descendants of Ishmael lived in the territory between Havilah and Shur, to the east of Egypt on the way to Assyria. They lived apart from the other descendants of Abraham.

dag: Tɔbbi so ŋun mali yɛm ni tooi nyaŋ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi nyaŋ ŋun mali yaa;.
en: Wisdom makes a man more powerful. Knowledge gives a man strength.

dag: Mɛshɛzabɛl bia Pɛtahia ŋun daa yi Zɛra daŋ ni na, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya nir la n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒe niriba zaani Pɛriʒia Naa sani saria dibu shee bɛ yɛlli kam ni.
en: Advising the king in all matters concerning the people was Pethahiah, Meshezabels son, from the family of Zerah, Judahs son.

dag: ka Shɛfufam daŋ niriba nyɛ Shufamnima; ka Hufam daŋ niriba nyɛ Hufamnima.
en: Shephupham, and Hupham.

dag: Daadam ŋun nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi so ŋɔ dabisa bi yaɣi lala, ka wahala n-kul pali di ni.
en: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa man yɛligu ku yiɣisi.
en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun su buɣim fukumsi gba daa yi bimbini gbin na n-duh o yee pam yɛli malaika so ŋun gbib gɔr dirili maa, Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala, dama di wala maa mooya zaa.
en: Still another angel, who has power over fire, came out from the altar. He said in a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, Use your sharp sickle to cut the clusters in the vineyard of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.

dag: ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: we finally turned and went into the desert, on the road to the Gulf of Aqaba, as the Lord had commanded, and we spent a long time wandering about in the hill country of Edom.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa, tɛha ni ti kpe a suhu ni, ka a bo zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu soya.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: At that time an idea will come into your mind. You will begin to make an evil plan.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa yɛli, Di daa niŋla daliri ka n chaŋ Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu nti chirigi Sool ka o zaŋ omaŋ dalim o kpani, ka chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba daa kabiri kani o sanna.
en: He answered, I happened to be on Mount Gilboa, and I saw that Saul was leaning on his spear and that the chariots and cavalry of the enemy were closing in on him.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim maa daa yili yilli ŋɔ m-paɣiri Yawɛ yɛra: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima; o daai wɔribara min o wɔhu niŋ teeku ni.
en: Then Moses and the Israelites began singing this song to the Lord : I will sing to the Lord ! He has done great things. He threw horse and rider into the sea.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi Naa Agiripa, Naa, a niŋ anabinim yɛligu yɛda? M mi ni a niŋ bɛ yɛligu yɛda.
en: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you do.

dag: naɣila o talahi nira, kaman o ba bee o ma bee o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga bee o mabidoo.
en: except for your closest relatives: for your mother, father, son, daughter, brother.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chɛ ka so guli piɛri maa, ka o zaŋ bindira maa chaŋ kaman o ba Jɛsi ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. O daa paai sansani maa shee la saha shɛli bɛ ni daa maani shili ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣ ni, ka buri zambu.
en: David obeyed his father. He got up early the next morning and left someone else in charge of the sheep; then he loaded the supplies and started off. He reached the army camp just as the soldiers were taking their places and shouting the battle cry.

dag: So yi mali buɣim ka di looi mɔɣu n-chaŋ ti di bɛ ni chɛ bindir shɛŋa sɔŋ bee bɛ ni na bi chɛ bindir shɛŋa bee n-di so puu zaa, di simdi ni ŋun mali buɣim maa yo di zuɣu zaa.
en: A man might start a fire to burn thornbushes on his field. But if the fire grows and burns his neighbors crops or the grain growing on the neighbors field, the man who started the fire must pay for what he burned.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni gba daa niŋ. O daa bɔri ni o wuhila o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm ka chɛ ka o yiko yi palɔni; dinzuɣu ka o daa di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi din kur o suli ka simdi ni o bahi ba yol la suɣilo.
en: And the same is true of what God has done. He wanted to show his anger and to make his power known. But he was very patient in enduring those who were the objects of his anger, who were doomed to destruction.

dag: Ka so daa ka alizanda ni bee dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia tiŋgbani puuni ŋun ni tooi bɔɣi litaafi maa bee nti tooi lihi di puuni.
en: But there was no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth who could open the scroll or look inside it.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Dama di chɛ biɛla ka bɛ lab ma kuɣa.
en: Moses prayed earnestly to the Lord and said, What can I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋun su kom fukumsi yɛli, Yaa ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ka be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, a saria karibu ŋɔ nyɛla din tuhi!.
en: I heard the angel in charge of the waters say, The judgments you have made are just, O Holy One, you who are and who were!.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayɔbu dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah anii mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the sixth day of this festival, you must offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba pahi, Ka daɣila yi na kul bi baŋ.
en: Then he said to them, You remember these things I did, but you still dont understand.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa pii maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas m-pahi bɛ daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba pia zuɣu n-tim ba Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then the people of Israel sent Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, to the people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh in the land of Gilead.

dag: Yinim Filistianim zaa, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya pam. Yi tiŋ mini di dunoya kuhima! Dama taŋkpagbiligu ni yi nuzaa polo na, di nyɛla tɔbbihi bɛn kanna ka dabiɛmlana ka bɛ ni.
en: Howl and cry for help, all you Philistine cities! Be terrified, all of you! A cloud of dust is coming from the north—it is an army with no cowards in its ranks.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋ jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: Anyone who does not bow down and worship will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Kapɛrinium ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto deeriba kana ti bɔhi Pita, A karimba ŋɔ bi tɔhiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto la.
en: When Jesus and his disciples came to Capernaum, the collectors of the Temple tax came to Peter and asked, Does your teacher pay the Temple tax.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi chɛ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu so shɛli o ni daa doli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la dolibu. Dina n-nyɛ salima naɣibihi shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl mini Dan la jɛmbu.
en: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.

dag: Ziɔnnim teei bɛ nuhi, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni maai bɛ suhuri. Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu ni o ʒiʒiinitaba ni ti leeg o dimnima. Jɛrusalɛm leela binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini bɛ sani.
en: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa kum o kuli maa ni daa ti gari, ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna yiŋnima, N suhiri ya, yi nini yi tiɣi ma, yin yɛlimiya Firawuna.
en: When the time of mourning was over, Joseph said to the Egyptian leaders, If you consider me your friend, please speak to the king for me.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa yɛn vih o maa dii yiɣis o sani yi; ka dabiɛm daa kpe sapashin kpɛm maa gba o ni daa baŋ ni Pool nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka o lo o zoligɔnim lala maa zuɣu.
en: The men who were about to beat and question Paul quickly backed off. And the commander himself was frightened when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai palo shɛli din wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu n-ti Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la ka di nyɛ bɛ ni su shɛli, ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntinsi be di ni.
en: I will give the other half of my land to the Levites who work in my temple, and the towns where they will live will be there.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will receive much more in this present age and eternal life in the age to come.

dag: Ka o yaa daa kul pahiri biɛɣukam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: He grew stronger all the time, because the Lord God Almighty was with him.

dag: n-nya malaikanim ayi ka bɛ ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒi Yisa ni daa do luɣ shɛl la: Yino o zuɣu polo, ŋun la mi o naba polo.
en: She saw two angels dressed in white sitting where Jesus body had been. One was sitting where the head had been; the other was sitting where the feet had been.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛŋa mini kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛla.
en: and spices and oil for the lamps, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Bɛ wurim m biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni sibigiri piɛgul tanti suɣili shɛm la. N daa kpabi la n nyɛvili kaman kpalua ni kpabiri tana shɛm la, ka bɛ ŋmaai ma yihi kpalu dari ni. Wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul wuhirila n nyɛvili tariga.
en: My lifetime is plucked up and taken from me like a shepherds tent. My life is shriveled like woven cloth; God cuts me off from the loom. Between daybreak and nightfall you carry out your verdict against me.

dag: Binshɛli beni ka di daa simdi ni n niŋ di ni ka m bi niŋ li? N daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, ka bɔ n-chɛ ka di ti zaŋ walila wal biɛri?.
en: What more was there to do for my vineyard that I havent done for it? When I expected it to grow good grapes, why did it grow rotten grapes?.

dag: Ka Judanim daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana ti liri ti? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo Samsin mihi n-zaŋ o chaŋ ti niŋ o o ni niŋ ti shɛm labisi.
en: The men of Judah asked them, Why are you attacking us? They answered, We came to take Samson prisoner and to treat him as he treated us.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa piripiri tinsi maa ni di momaha tiŋgbana maa tari Lɛvinima.
en: In this way the Israelites gave the Levites the towns with their pasturelands.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti lihi bo Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka yi yi ti bo o ni yi suhu zaa ni yi shia zaa, yi ni nya o.
en: You will seek the LORD your God from there, and you will find him if you seek him with all your heart and with all your being.

dag: Di simdi ka a daa beei chɛriga gili zoli maa, ka di chɛ ka so baai yaɣ li, ka yɛli ba ni so di miri zoli maa gbini bee so ti du li. Ka ŋunkam ti shihi zoli maa, bɛn kum o.
en: Set up a fence for the people all around and tell them, Be careful not to go up the mountain or to touch any part of it. Anyone who even touches the mountain must be put to death.

dag: Amaa zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu be asama gari Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibil fifinyiiŋa gba yiɣisibu.
en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the smallest detail of the Law to be done away with.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kuhi pam yɛli.
en: In the synagogue there was a man who had an evil spirit from the devil inside him. The man shouted loudly.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa kpariti yi dunoya nyɛla kuriti mini daanya. Yi dabisa ni yɛn be shɛm, lala ka yi yaa yɛn be.
en: May his towns be protected with iron gates, And may he always live secure.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka a chɛ ka saa bi lan mira, di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ti niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu ka ŋmaligi kpa kpe na m-bol a yuli ka suh a zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tibidarigibo maa polo.
en: When you hold back the rain because your people have sinned against you and then when they repent and face this Temple, humbly praying to you.

dag: Dɔr biɛri ni ti ku ba. Ka so ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n sɔɣi ba. Bɛ ni ti dola tiŋgban ni kaman naɣibina la. Tɔbu mini kum ni ti ku ba, ka bɛ ti leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: They will die of horrible diseases. No one will mourn for them or bury them. They will be like refuse lying on the ground. They will die from the sword and by famine, and their corpses will be food for birds and wild animals.

dag: Teeku Ʒiɛɣu daa nyaya ka zo; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋmaligi lab di nyaaŋa.
en: The sea saw it happen and ran away; the Jordan River retreated!.

dag: N ni yuri so yi tum ma tuumbiɛɣu, o mali soli ni o lan be n yiŋa? Pɔri pɔbu bee biŋkɔbiri sara maligu ni tooi vuui mbusim maa? O ni tooi mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: What are my loved ones doing in my temple while working out their many evil schemes? Can sacred offerings cancel your sin so that you revel in your evil deeds?.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa bɔh o Hanna, bɔ n-niŋ ka a mali suhugarigu, ka kumdi hal ti zaɣisi bindirigu? M bi gari bihi pia a sani.
en: her husband Elkanah said to her, Hannah, why are you crying? Why wont you eat? Why are you so sad? You have me. Isnt that better than having even ten sons.

dag: N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔɣi bihi n-nabi pahi, ka n kul gbibi n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la.
en: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.

dag: Ka o daa boli bidib so ŋun pah ayi mi yuli Ifriim, ka yɛli, Naawuni ti ma nama n ni di wahala tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: Joseph named the second son Ephraim. Joseph gave him this name because he said, I had great troubles, but God has made me successful in everything.

dag: Zuliya shɛli buɣa ni tooi chɛ ka saa mi? Bee zuɣusaa ni tooi chɛ ka sayuɣiyuɣi mi? Pa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-niŋdi li? Ti mali tahima a sani, dama nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: None of the idols of the nations can send rain; the sky by itself cannot make showers fall. We have put our hope in you, O Lord our God, because you are the one who does these things.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo ŋɔ na. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tin ya ka yi nyuri bara bɛ zuɣu la lee be ya?.
en: Lift up your eyes and see who is approaching from the north. Where is the flock entrusted to you, your beautiful flock?.

dag: Amaa doo yi chirigi paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti doo mɔɣu ni n-gbaag o goli, dindina do so ŋun gol o maa kɔŋko ka bɛ ni ku.
en: But if the man met up with the engaged woman in a field, grabbing her and having sex with her there, only the man will die.

dag: Tibikpara viɛl a tapaɣisi zuɣu ka nyiŋgokɔriti viɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Your cheeks are so beautiful with those ornaments hanging beside them. Your neck is so lovely under that beautiful string of jewels.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe ma yim maa wuhiya ni bɛ taali bi paai Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa taali.
en: The Lord said to me, Israel was not faithful to me, but she had a better excuse than unfaithful Judah.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa, ka gba bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi; ka ŋun pah ata gba lala;.
en: Then the second one married the woman, and he also died without having children. The same thing happened to the third brother.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi: O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino n-jɛm o, ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

dag: Mani n-daa nyɛ zoomba nina, ka nyɛ gbariti napɔna.
en: I was like eyes for the blind, like feet for the crippled.

dag: Yidaampaɣ suŋ nyɛla o yidan nam zuɣupiligu, amaa paɣ so ŋun dihir o yidan vi ŋmanila dɔro o yidan kɔbili ni.
en: A strong woman is a crown to her husband, but a disgraceful woman is like rot in his bones.

dag: Ka o mi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba, dama o nyɛla ŋun mi shɛlikam. O bi yɛri ka labiri nyaaŋa. O ni darigi tuumbiɛtumdiba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa tibili.
en: But he is the wise one who is bringing the disaster. And they will not be able to stop what he commanded. The Lord will attack those who are evil and all who try to help them.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni, ka zaŋdi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa ti mini ti yaannim ni bi tooi ʒi ni yi ʒili ba?.
en: So then, why do you now want to put God to the test by laying a load on the backs of the believers which neither our ancestors nor we ourselves were able to carry?.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba, Yumiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ karimbaandan tibili pam.
en: Love the Lord , all of you who are his loyal followers. The Lord protects those who are loyal to him. But he punishes those who brag about their own power. He gives them all the punishment they deserve.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kul birigiri Yawɛ zaligu? Dama lala ku nani.
en: But Moses replied, You're disobeying the Lord ! Your plan won't work.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o ti o bidibiga ni o niŋ o paɣa, di simdi ka o gbib o kaman o bipuɣiŋga la.
en: If the master promised to let the slave woman marry his son, he must treat her like a daughter, not like a slave.

dag: Harif daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pinaayi.
en: of Hariph.

dag: O tɔbbihi laɣimmina, nti gbi bɔɣa do n-guli ma. Bɛ teei gilila n yili.
en: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. *.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini kom na ti tuhi ya soli saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la zuɣu mini bɛ ni daa lan da Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr ŋun yi Pɛtɔr din be Mɛsopoteemia na bia la ni o ti yɛli noli tin ya la zuɣu.
en: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi suhuri ni zɔhiri shɛlikam zuɣu yɛla niŋ o nuu ni, dama o baɣa be yi ni.
en: Leave all your worries with him, because he cares for you.

dag: Inok daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu.
en: In all, Enoch lived years.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ yi bi so ti ni bɛ nyo buɣim mali buɣili Molɛk ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi saɣim yi Naawuni yuli. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not give any of your children to offer them over to Molech so that you do not defile your Gods name: I am the LORD.

dag: Ka n yɛtɔɣa mini n waazu yihibu daa pala yɛm yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi ninsalinim baŋsim ni na, amaa di daa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi tuma min o yiko ni na.
en: and my teaching and message were not delivered with skillful words of human wisdom, but with convincing proof of the power of God's Spirit.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biɛkaali, ka piɛli kaman goli, ka ne kaman wuntaŋa, ka o ni be shɛm ŋmani tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanim chani la?.
en: Who is this whose glance is like the dawn? She is beautiful and bright, as dazzling as the sun or the moon.

dag: Lala n-shiri niŋ Babilɔn maa bɛ ni daa nya anabinim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni la ʒim di puuni la zuɣu.
en: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam! Dama nandahima pam ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka Naawuni suhu ti yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: How terrible it will be in those days for women who are pregnant and for mothers with little babies! Terrible distress will come upon this land, and God's punishment will fall on this people.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba naba vuri tulaale tihi maa zuɣu, nyin lirim ba, dama di saha maa man Yawɛ daŋla a tooni ni n ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa ti a maa.
en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, you must act quickly because that is the sign that the Lord has gone out in front of you to defeat the Philistines. .

dag: Amaa n ni be, ka chɛ ka man Yawɛ jilima pali dunia ŋɔ zaa la zuɣu.
en: But as I live and as the LORDs glory fills the entire earth.

dag: ni Bɛtuɛl ni Hɔrima ni Zikilag.
en: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag.

dag: N ni chɛ ba n-zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni doli man Yawɛ soli kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: I will use them to find out whether or not these Israelites will follow my ways, as their ancestors did.

dag: Saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi yɛn liri nira? Yi zaa yɛn bula yi ni gbaai ninvuɣ so, kaman yi ni yɛn niŋ dikili ŋmaŋ bee kikara din kab ŋuniya m-bɔri ni di lu shɛm la?.
en: How long will you people attack me? Do you all want to kill me? I am like a leaning wall, like a fence ready to fall.

dag: A chɛ ka n dabisa bi yaɣ lala. N nyɛvili yuusim pa shɛli a sani. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal kam biɛhigu ŋmanila vuhim.
en: Youve made my days so short; my lifetime is like nothing in your eyes. Yes, a human life is nothing but a puff of air! Selah.

dag: Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli: Zallakudura Naa yi di daa bi chɛ ti shɛba, ti naan kpi zaa kaman Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim la.
en: As Isaiah prophesied, If the Lord of the heavenly forces had not left descendants for us, we would have been like Sodom, and we would have become like Gomorrah. .

dag: Naawuni yɛm puuni o bi chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim tooi zaŋ bɛ yɛm baŋ ŋun Naawuni; dina n-chɛ ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini ni o zaŋ ti ni yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu shɛli din ŋmani jɛrilim ŋɔ n-tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: For God in his wisdom made it impossible for people to know him by means of their own wisdom. Instead, by means of the so-called foolish message we preach, God decided to save those who believe.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yinima n-di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yinim pii ni yi ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋɔ. Ka bɛ yɛli, Tinima n-di timaŋ shɛhira maa.
en: Joshua told them, You are your own witnesses to the fact that you have chosen to serve the Lord . Yes, they said, we are witnesses.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun ni nyu Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain shɛli o ni booi niŋ o suhuyiɣisili pipia ni ka binshɛli bi pilisi di ni la. Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ chilibi buɣim n-nahim dilana malaika kasinim mini Piɛbil la tooni.
en: will themselves drink God's wine, the wine of his fury, which he has poured at full strength into the cup of his anger! All who do this will be tormented in fire and sulfur before the holy angels and the Lamb.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi nyo tin shɛŋa din daa me n-tam zoya zuɣu la buɣim, gbaai yihila Hazɔr kɔŋko ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo m-bahi.
en: But the army of Israel did not burn any cities that were built on hills. The only city built on a hill that they burned was Hazor. This is the city Joshua burned.

dag: Ɛba ni daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Peleg was born, Eber lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Nyama, n zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, Know this: Ive given you authority over the entire land of Egypt.

dag: N Naawuni, n kuhi bol a wuntaŋ ni, amaa ka a bi garigi ma; ka n kuhi bol a yuŋ, ka bi nya gom gbihi.
en: My God, I kept calling by day, and I was not silent at night. But you did not answer me.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin maa daa ti gari, ka paɣ maa yi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-lab o ya nti chaŋ ni o ti yɛli naa ka o zaŋ o yili min o tiŋgbani labisi ti o.
en: After seven years she returned from the land of the Philistines. She went to speak with the king to ask him to help her get back her house and land.

dag: Ka fiig tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wal viɛla din nyaɣisi la wolibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: The fig tree replied to them, Should I stop producing my sweetness and my delicious fruit, so that I can go to sway over the trees.

dag: Ka di mahim chaŋ ti luri zoya zuɣu; ka di wula mi zooi lim sida ti kara la.
en: The mountains were covered by its shade; the mighty cedars were covered by its branches.

dag: Di pa shɛli n ni ti kpalim yi sani hal ka kikaa ti gari, di nyaaŋa ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ luɣ shɛli n ni ti yɛn chaŋ.
en: I shall probably spend some time with you, perhaps the whole winter, and then you can help me to continue my trip, wherever it is I shall go next.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ dɔɣ ma mi ni tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni daa zali m pua saha shɛli ka m pun nyɛ alahichilana.
en: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.

dag: Adɔnikam daŋ bɛn daa ti doli nyaaŋa na, bɛ yuya n-nyɛ: Ɛlifɛlɛt mini Jɛwɛl ni Shɛmaya, bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ zuɣulaannima, ka dɔbba pihiyɔbu daa pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: of the last of Adonikam, namely Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah and with them men.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-wurim ba, o baɣa lan ka bɛ ni. Maligumaaniba lan ka jilima, ka niriba bi lan niŋdi kpamba nirilim.
en: The Lord himself destroyed them. He didnt look after them anymore. He didnt respect the priests. He was not friendly to the elders of Judah.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni, ninvuɣ tusaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: From the tribe of Levi there were men.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini jintɔriba timmiya ti yɛli sapashin kpɛm maa ni o sa zaŋm Pool tahi yi sanna, ka di be kaman yi bɔrimi ni yi vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ti mali shili ni ti ti ku o ka o na bi paai yi sanna.
en: You and the council must explain to the commander that you need Paul brought down to you. Pretend that you want to examine his case more closely. Were prepared to kill him before he arrives.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, pa mani ka o niŋ yɛda, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa ka o niŋ yɛda maa.
en: Jesus said in a loud voice, Whoever believes in me believes not only in me but also in him who sent me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Gazanim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋgbɔn muni niriba chaŋ ti ti Ɛdomnima ka bɛ zaŋ ba leei daba.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.

dag: Bɛ yi kana ti kaai ma, bɛ tɛhirila yɛl biɛri yɛla. Bɛ yi lo yɛtɔɣ biɛri ŋɔ nia bɛ suhuri ni naai, bɛ yirimi chaŋ ti zaŋ li moli gili.
en: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.

dag: ni Hazarigada ni Hɛshimɔn ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Bethpelet.

dag: Bɛ yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnima, ashee bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: They say they are wise, but they are fools;.

dag: Amaa bɛ so bi bɔhi, Naawuni ŋun nam ma, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ma yaa yuŋ ŋɔ lee be ya?.
en: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba ni bɛ cham ti puɣisi nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Nɛgɛb tooni ha n-gari chaŋ zoya ni tinsi ni.
en: When Moses sent them out to explore the land of Canaan, he said to them, Go up there into the arid southern plain and into the mountains.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n kana ni n ti tumla a yubu. Naawuni daa kpihim tuuli sara maligunim la ka zalila din pah ayi.
en: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, I have come to do what you want.

dag: Ŋunkam doli wuntitali soli ni be, amaa ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri ni kpi.
en: The righteous are headed toward life, but those who pursue evil, toward death.

dag: Ti yi zahim timaŋa ni yɛlimaŋli, dindina ti ku lan nya saria karibu.
en: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.

dag: Bee Tiligimiya ma n dim nuu ni? Bee Famiya ma bɛn nahindi ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi?.
en: Rescue me from the hand of my enemy? Ransom me from the grip of the ruthless.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be yi sani tumd o tuma la, ti suhiri ya ni yi lum ba sizuura. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn wuhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande la.
en: Brothers and sisters, we ask you to respect those who are working with you, leading you, and instructing you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samsin mabihi min o dɔɣiriba zaa daa chaŋ ti kpuɣ o ti sɔɣ o ba Manɔa siliga shɛli din daa be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la ni. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuun pisi.
en: His brothers and the rest of his family came down to get his body. They took him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah. He had been Israel's leader for twenty years.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n gba zaɣisi ba ka zaŋ ba tahi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di saha bɛ yi ti siɣisi bɛmaŋ bɛ suhuri din mali daɣiri maa ni ka niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: and caused me to turn against them and send them into exile in the land of their enemies. At last, when your descendants are humbled and they have paid the penalty for their sin and rebellion.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: But I said, I cant do that, Lord! I have never eaten anything that is not pure or fit to be used for food.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa dii guui chaŋ ti du n-tam Filistia doo maa zuɣu, ka darigi ŋooi ŋun Filistia doo maa maŋmaŋ takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-zaŋ li ku o, ka ŋma o zuɣu. Filistianim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ tiyaawumya maa kpi maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: so he ran and stood beside the Philistine. Then David took Goliaths own sword out of its sheath and used it to cut off his head. That is how David killed the Philistine. When the other Philistines saw their hero was dead, they turned and ran.

dag: Man ŋuna, n tɔŋbu puuni, n daa yɛliya, Shɛli ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: When I was comfortable, I said, I will never stumble.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, yi yi ti laɣim ni yi di ti Duuma Bindirigu maa, yin guhimiya taba.
en: So, my brothers and sisters, when you come together to eat, wait for each other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife. In this way two people become one.

dag: Amaa Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani. N ni pirigi n namda pa Ɛdom zuɣu; ka tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim mi.
en: But Moab is my washbowl; Ill throw my shoe at Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia!.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Aai, yi kana ni yi ti nyala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He said to them, No. Youve come to look for the countrys weaknesses.

dag: N daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka di niŋ yuma pam; di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lab nimaani ni n ti zaŋ pina ti mmaŋmaŋ niriba ka mali sara.
en: After an absence of several years, I came to Jerusalem to bring gifts for the poor of my nation and to offer sacrifices.

dag: Bɛcha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛmira mini Jɔash ni Ɛliɛza ni Ɛliɔnai ni Omri ni Jɛrimɔt ni Abija ni Anatɔt ni Alɛmɛt. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Bɛcha bidibisi.
en: Bechers family: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. These were all Bechers family.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila tibihi din nyaɣa na bi ba tiŋa, ka Naawuni yi chɛ ka tulim kana ti kpe li, di kuurimi ka pɔhim ʒe li ti bahi kaman wurigu la.
en: They are like young plants, just set out and barely rooted. When the Lord sends a wind, they dry up and blow away like straw.

dag: N naa daa dola o bindoo zuɣu, ka n tulaale nyom deei nimaani zaa.
en: With my king close by, my perfume filled the air.

dag: Deem pina maa bɛ sani n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinima kaman sokam tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaŋ ba tum suɣili maa ni tuma.
en: Accept these gifts from the leaders. These gifts can be used in the work of the Meeting Tent. Give them to the Levites to help them do their work.

dag: Ŋun daa pah anii n-su chira anii ni n-daa nyɛ Sibɛkai ŋun daa yi Husha na ka nyɛ Zɛra daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The eighth commander, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai from Hushah and from Zerahs family. There were , men in Sibbecais group.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o kpamba, Yi bi mi ni ŋun nyɛ sapashin kpeeni ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ titali ka Izraɛlnim kɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: David said to his officials, Don't you realize that today one of Israel's great leaders has died?.

dag: Ka Jɛfita yɛli ba, M mini n niriba ni Ammɔnnima n-daa mali naŋgbankpeen titali, ka n daa ŋme kuŋ boli ya, ka yi bi kana ti fa ma bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: But Jephthah told them, My people and I had a serious quarrel with the Ammonites. I did call you, but you would not rescue me from them.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a niriba ni, ka yili yila paɣ a zuliya kam ni.
en: Lord , I will praise you before all people. I will sing praises about you to every nation.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi kambɔna mini yi tuma zaa ni; o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: The LORD will command the blessing to be with you—in your barns and on all the work you do—and he will bless you on the land the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima n-shiri nyɛ ti barinyubo mini ti suhupiɛlli!.
en: You alone are our glory and joy!.

dag: Dama n nyari bɛ ni kul niŋdi shɛlikam zaa; di shɛli bi sɔɣi n sani, ka bɛ daalahichi bi sɔɣi n sani.
en: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a jɛmbu duu shiri nyɛla luɣ shɛli din viɛli shee.
en: How I love your Temple, Lord Almighty!.

dag: Ka nandaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa yi chani ti dooni bundan maa yiŋ dunol ni, ka yuma kul nyaɣim o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: There was also a very poor man named Lazarus. Lazarus body was covered with sores. He was often put by the rich mans gate.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn guli piɛri mini niɣi, ka ʒi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi maa ni bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa na.
en: The men are shepherds, because they own livestock. Theyve brought with them their flocks and herds and everything they own.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ di kɔhigu nɛma mini di liɣiri ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ti ku zaŋ di shɛli sɔŋ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ di liɣiri maa da bindira pam ni situr shɛŋa di ni simdi ni bɛ mali.
en: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord , and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord .

dag: Di saha maa n daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Yi mini sɔŋdiba zaa kpalimmi gbɛm Jɛrusalɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ guli ti yuŋ ka tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni.
en: I also said to the people at that time, Let every man and his servant spend the night in Jerusalem so that we can guard during the night and work during the day.

dag: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni puhiri chuɣu yili shɛli ni ka a mini ba ti ʒini n-di ka nyu.
en: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.

dag: Amaa o min o kpambaliba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa bi wum Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia zaŋ yɛli ba maa.
en: But Zedekiah, his servants, and the people of Judah did not pay attention to the messages the Lord had given to Jeremiah the prophet.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa zaa naai, ka o daa zaŋ o ba Naa Dauda ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nɛma zaashee.
en: When King Solomon finished all the work on the Temple, he placed in the Temple storerooms all the things that his father David had dedicated to the Lord —the silver, gold, and other articles.

dag: Salima min anzinfa nɛma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu ni kɔbisinahi. Ka Shɛshibaza daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa yi Babilɔn kuli Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi tinduli n-labi kuni la.
en: Altogether, there were , gold and silver dishes, bowls, and other articles. Sheshbazzar took them with him when he and the others returned to Jerusalem from Babylonia.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni ni o chɛ ka gomna maa ku niŋ yɛda.
en: But Elymas the sorcerer opposed them, trying to steer the governor away from the faith.

dag: Adɔnikam daŋ — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: of Adonikam.

dag: Daadam, chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm baŋ di ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins.

dag: Doo maa yuli n-daa booni Nabal, ka o paɣa mi yuli booni Abigeel. Paɣ maa daa viɛl pam, ka mali yɛm. Amaa ka doo maa ŋun daa nyɛ jɛrigu ka mali biɛm pam. O daa nyɛla Kalɛb daŋ ni nira.
en: The mans name was Nabal, and his wifes name was Abigail. She was an intelligent and attractive woman, but her husband was a hard man who did evil things. He was a Calebite.

dag: O yi ti kana, o ni wuhi dunianima alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: When he comes, he will show the world it was wrong about sin, righteousness, and judgment.

dag: Kpambal so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna ka naa yura, amaa kpambal so ŋun tumdi vi tuma, o suhu yiɣisirimi bahir o zuɣu.
en: Kings are pleased with intelligent officials, but they will punish shameful ones.

dag: ni Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Paliti nir la ni Ira Ikɛsh ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa nir la bia.
en: Helez the Paltite; Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa;.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin kpɛm a duu nti yo a dunoli ka suh a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. O yɛliya ni biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria ŋɔ dunɔdal ni.
en: Elisha answered, Listen to what the Lord says! By this time tomorrow you will be able to buy in Samaria ten pounds of the best wheat or twenty pounds of barley for one piece of silver.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa pun wuhi niriba maa shɛm la zuɣu, maligumaaniba ayopɔin bɛn gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la n-daa gari tooni chani ka piɛbiri kikahi maa, ka bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa doli ba.
en: After Joshua finished speaking to the people, the seven priests with the trumpets began marching before the Lord , blowing the trumpets as they marched. The priests carrying the Lord s Holy Box followed them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti laɣim Mizipa m-po pɔri yɛli, Ti ni so ku zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni doo.
en: When the Israelites had met at Mizpah before the war with Benjamin, they had made this sacred promise: None of us will ever let our daughters marry any man from Benjamin.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti yɛli yi suhuri ni, Timaŋmaŋ yiko mini ti nuhi kpiɔŋ ka ti zaŋ nya azichi ŋɔ.
en: Dont think to yourself, My own strength and abilities have produced all this prosperity for me.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma bahi. N Naawuni, di be ma katiŋa!.
en: Lord , dont leave me. My God, stay close to me.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nyɛla yino, ka o mi bi bɔri sandaantimda ŋun Naawuni yino maa zuɣu.
en: Now the mediator does not take one side; but God is one.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛn me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun kpe di kpɛbu shee m-me li, ka di chɛ ka so daa bi wum matarika bee lɛhu bee kuribini vuri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ ni daa mɛri li maa.
en: The stones with which the Temple was built had been prepared at the quarry, so that there was no noise made by hammers, axes, or any other iron tools as the Temple was being built.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: He obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the word of the Lord came to me again.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim mali laara, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali putɔɣu tumdila bɛmaŋ barina.
en: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.

dag: Ana bihi n-daa nyɛ: Dishɔn mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Ana maa bipuɣiŋga la.
en: These are Anahs children: Dishon and Anahs daughter Oholibamah.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan labina ti yɛl o, Naa, A mi ni Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu shɛŋa naa ni zali ku tooi taɣi.
en: Then the men went as a group to the king and said to him, Remember, King, that the law of the Medes and Persians says that no law or command signed by the king can ever be canceled or changed.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii piri la.
en: Its like yeast, which a woman took and hid in a bushel of wheat flour until the yeast had worked its way through the whole.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa bi deei lahibal suŋ maa. Anabi Aizaia bɔhiya, Ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ o ni wum shɛli ti sani maa yɛda.
en: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, Lord, has anyone believed what we said.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli maa shee hal ti paai o yiŋ maa tariga m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house.

dag: Ka yi ni so miri ka o nyɛ ŋun kuri niriba bee tayiɣa bee tuumbiɛ tumda bee ŋun kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-nyari wahala di zuɣu.
en: You may suffer, but dont let it be because you murder, steal, make trouble, or try to control other peoples lives.

dag: din ni chɛ ka a mali a filiŋ min a vi a ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka di ti ba suhumahili maa zuɣu.
en: Then you will be ashamed of how you've acted, and Sodom and Samaria will be relieved that they weren't as sinful as you.

dag: Nyama, n lɔr a la mihi, ka a ku tooi lan lɛbigi yaɣ yini polo dɔni yaɣ din la hal ka a ti naai a teei gili dabisa maa.
en: Now look, I am tying ropes on you. You will not be able to roll over from one side to the other until your attack against the city is finished.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima, o noli ni ka yɛm yɛtɔɣa yirina. Amaa ŋun ka yɛm yaaŋa deerila fiɛbiga.
en: Wisdom is found on the lips of those who have understanding, but there is a rod for the back of those with no sense.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm o suhu ni n-doli zaligunima. Amaa jɛrigu ŋun mali yɛtɔɣ yoya ni bahi yoli.
en: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.

dag: Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib zuɣu! Dama yi ŋooi baŋsim bɔhimbu dunoli saafɛbia; yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi guri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni soli.
en: How terrible for you teachers of the Law! You have kept the key that opens the door to the house of knowledge; you yourselves will not go in, and you stop those who are trying to go in.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛhab bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anu saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la daa di nam.
en: In the fifth year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab as king of Israel, Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah.

dag: Dama bɛ dɔɣi bia ti ti, bɛ ti ti bidibiga; o nyɛla ŋun su fukumsi; ka o yuli ni ti booni, Alahiziba mini Saɣisira ni Kpiɔŋlan Naawuni ni Saha din ka bahigu Ba ni Suhudoo Nabia.
en: A child is born to us, a son is given to us, and authority will be on his shoulders. He will be named Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Eternal Father, Prince of Peace.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni darigi Amalɛknim ŋɔ tibili bɛ ni daa niŋ Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila zuɣu.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: I am going to punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel: how they attacked the Israelites as they came up from Egypt.

dag: O tɔbbihi laɣimmina, nti gbi bɔɣa do n-guli ma. Bɛ teei gilila n yili.
en: He sends his army to attack me. They build attack towers around me. They camp around my tent.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold and put gold trim around it.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di mi lan sabi yɛli, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: Jesus answered, But the Scriptures also say, You must not test the Lord your God.

dag: ka gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛri suŋ, ka nyɛ bɛn gbib bɛ yinsi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi nirilim, ka nyɛ bɛn wumdi n-tiri bɛ yidaannima, ka di chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa nim daa pun baŋ ni Mɔdɛkai mali yiko pam nayili, ka o yiko maa mi kul pahirimi.
en: Mordecai had become a very important man in the kings palace. Everyone in the provinces knew his name and knew how important he was. And Mordecai became more and more powerful.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinim.
en: Canaan was also the ancestor of the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi ninsal ŋun kpi, bɛ ni leei bɛn bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: Those who touch a dead body will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Neem a nina nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim suhigu, ka gbilisi a tibili wum ti suhigu ti yi ti suh a saha shɛlikam.
en: Open your eyes to your servants request and to the request of your people Israel. Hear them whenever they cry out to you.

dag: n ni ti laɣim zuliya kam zaa n-zaŋ ba ti zali Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni. N ni ti kari ba saria nimaani bɛ ni daa niŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim shɛm la zuɣu. Dama bɛ nyɛla n ni su shɛba. Bɛ daa kari ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni, ka pirigi n tiŋgbani ti taba.
en: I will gather all the nations and bring them to the Valley of Judgment. There I will judge them for all they have done to my people. They have scattered the Israelites in foreign countries and divided Israel, my land.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal n ni daa kul zaŋ ba tahi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa yoli, mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha biɛla shɛli bɛ ni daa be tinsi maa ni maa.
en: So tell them this: The Lord GOD says, It is true, I forced my people to go far away to other nations. I did scatter them among many countries. But I will be their temple for a short time while they are in those other countries.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ŋubi nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din be piɛɣu puuni la Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili ŋɔ dunol ni.
en: Aaron and his sons will eat the rams meat and the bread that is in the basket at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: To, yinima n-su Ɛhab bidibisi la fukumsi, ka su o chɛchɛbunsi min o yuri ni bidibbina ni bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛŋa la, dinzuɣu yi yi deei gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: You are in charge of the king's descendants, and you have at your disposal chariots, horses, weapons, and fortified cities. So then, as soon as you receive this letter.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛligu zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda pahi.
en: Many more believed because of his message.

dag: O kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam zoori kpɛri tab ni, ka niŋgbuŋ maa zaa kpe n-saɣisi tab ni di tuɣili kam shee. Ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam yi tumdi di tuma viɛnyɛliŋga kaman di ni simdi ni di tumdi shɛm, niŋgbuŋ maa zaa zoorimi yurilim puuni.
en: and the whole body depends on him. All the parts of the body are joined and held together, with each part doing its own work. This causes the whole body to grow and to be stronger in love.

dag: Dama a sani ka nyɛvili kɔbilisirim be. A neesim zuɣu ka ti nyari neesim.
en: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa Gɔg yi ti kana ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ, n suhu ni yiɣisi pam.
en: On that day, the day when Gog comes against Israels fertile land, my wrath will be aroused. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ paɣ so ŋun bala: Ka so yɛl o, Iliam bia Batishiiba ŋun nyɛ Yuria Hiti nir la paɣa m-bala.
en: so David sent for his officers and asked them who she was. An officer answered, That is Bathsheba, daughter of Eliam. She is the wife of Uriah the Hittite.

dag: ka daa bol o yiŋbihi pia na nti ti bɛ zaa pɔŋlipɔŋli, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ mal li gom kɔhigu hal ka o ti labina.
en: But before leaving, he called in ten servants and gave each of them some money. He told them, Use this to earn more money until I get back.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Daniɛl la, A ni tooi yɛli ma zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: The king said to Daniel , Can you tell me what I dreamed and what it means.

dag: O ŋmɛri bɔbili din nyaɣisira pari kom zuɣu o nyaaŋa. So ni tɛhi ni kɔbulli maa ni nyɛla zabipiɛla.
en: When he swims, he leaves a sparkling path behind him. He stirs up the water and makes it white with foam.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yihi ma biŋkɔbigulibo maa ni ka yɛli ma, Cham ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ti n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣ do n-gu m-bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun sɔɣi doya.
en: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.

dag: Ka Uzia daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nanim gbala ni m-baɣil o yaannima, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi ni o nyɛla kɔŋlana. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Uzziah died and was buried near his ancestors in the field near the kings burial places. This was because the people said, Uzziah has leprosy. And Uzziahs son Jotham became the new king in his place.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa nimdi duɣi luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samsin mabihi min o dɔɣiriba zaa daa chaŋ ti kpuɣ o ti sɔɣ o ba Manɔa siliga shɛli din daa be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la ni. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuun pisi.
en: Samsons brothers and all the people in his fathers family went down to get his body. They brought him back and buried him in his fathers tomb, which is between the cities of Zorah and Eshtaol. Samson was a judge for the Israelites for years.

dag: ka dihi bɛn kpiri kum bindir suma, ka kari bundaannim ni nuzaŋa bahi.
en: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai maa ka o vuhi bahi bɛ polo ka yɛli ba, Deemiya Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋɔ.
en: Then he breathed on them and said, Receive the Holy Spirit.

dag: Hal yi ni ninvuɣ zuɣu ŋun nyɛ bilichina ni ti mɔŋ o mabia bindirigu, o ni ti mɔŋ o paɣiyurigu hal zaŋ tabili o bi shɛb bɛn kpalim puuni ŋun nyɛ bia.
en: Even the most kind and gentle man among you will become cruel. He will be cruel to his family, and he will be cruel to his wife he loves so much. And he will be cruel to his children who are still alive.

dag: Atarɔt mini Dibɔn ni Jaza ni Nimira ni Hɛshibɔn ni Ɛliale ni Siibam ni Nɛbo ni Bɛɔn.
en: The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep.

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam daa kpuɣ kuɣili din ŋmani nɛ titali m-bahi teeku puuni ha ka yɛra, Lala ka nyin Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ ti shiri yɛn lu n-wurim zaa, ka so ti ku lan mi a zaashee yaha!.
en: Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, This is how the great city Babylon will be violently thrown down and will never be seen again.

dag: Sida dari n-nyɛ ti yiŋ dapuhi, ka ti yɔɣira nyɛ timaha.
en: The ceilings of our chambers are cedars; our rafters, cypresses.

dag: O bihi nyurila ʒim. Bɛ ni ku binyara luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka o be.
en: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.

dag: M mabihi, miriya ka yi ni so mali suhu biɛɣu din biɛhinda, ka nyɛ din ni birigi ya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ sani.
en: So, brothers and sisters, be careful that none of you has the evil thoughts that cause so much doubt that you stop following the living God.

dag: Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bituuli maa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi.
en: Reuben, the oldest of Jacob's sons, had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: Naa, n tɛhi ni n nyɛla zuɣusuŋlana n ni zan a tooni zuŋɔ ni n tɔɣisi chihi mmaŋ noli Yɛhudianim ni fiɣisiri ma yɛl shɛŋa zaa zuɣu la.
en: He said, King Agrippa, I feel fortunate that I can stand here before you today and answer all the charges these Jews have made against me.

dag: Izraɛl paɣ bia ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ijipti do so daa doli Izraɛlnim maa chana, ka Izraɛl paɣ bia maa mini Izraɛl doo daa ti zabi bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: There was a son of an Israelite woman and an Egyptian father. He was walking among the Israelites, and he started fighting in camp.

dag: Ka Abiata maa daa yɛli Dauda ni Sool ku Yawɛ maligumaaniba la.
en: Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the Lord s priests.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Dindina zaŋmiya wuna la bahi, ka zaŋya yi suhuri niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni.
en: So now put aside the foreign gods that are among you. Focus your hearts on the LORD, the God of Israel.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi daa yi zuɣusaa na ti tuhi tɔbu; bɛ daa yila bɛ biɛhigu shee na ti tuhi Sisɛra.
en: The stars fought them from heaven. From their paths across the sky, they fought against Sisera.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli mɔɣili maa duli labi.
en: Then the man said to me, Son of man, did you pay close attention to the things you saw? Then the man led me back along the side of the river.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka doo sabirila amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ pɔi ka naanyi yih o paɣa.
en: They said, Moses allowed a man to write a divorce certificate and to divorce his wife.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: He prayed to the Lord :.

dag: Tim ti ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu;.
en: Give us the bread we need for today.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool ni Dauda zo n-kuli Gaat, ka o daa chɛ o shee bɔbu.
en: When Saul heard that David had fled to Gath, he gave up trying to find him.

dag: yɛlimaŋli, yi ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ninvuɣ so n-leei yi naa ka o sun ya. Yi ni tooi zaŋ yi zuliya ni nira n-leei yi naa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ tinzun nira ŋun pa yi mabia n-leei yi naa.
en: Be sure that the man you choose to be king is the one whom the Lord has chosen. He must be one of your own people; do not make a foreigner your king.

dag: ka daa bahi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuliyanima ayopɔin yoli, ka chɛ ka ti yaannim maa di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa fali.
en: God conquered seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave the Israelites their land as an inheritance.

dag: O ni zaŋ tɔbutuhira piɛma din noya diri mini sɔɣu tia sala buɣim darigi yi tibili.
en: You will get a soldiers sharp arrow and hot coals to punish you.

dag: Mɔabnima, mbusim be yi zuɣu! Yinim Chɛmɔshinima, Chɛmɔshi niriba ŋɔ ni bahi yoli zaa. O chɛ ka o bidibisi leei bɛn zo n-kpe yɔɣu, ka o bipuɣinsi mi leei Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn daba.
en: You are doomed, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He gave his sons as fugitives, and his daughters as captives to the Amorite king Sihon.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi nuhi tiri luɣ kasi shee la m-paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Raise your hands in prayer in the Temple, and praise the Lord !.

dag: ni binyɛr shɛŋa din she n-viɛla, din nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaani la binyɛr kasi la min o bidibisi la binyɛr shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: the woven clothing, the holy clothes for Aaron the priest and for his sons for their service as priests.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha bia;.
en: But thats not the way it will be with you. Whoever wants to be great among you will be your servant.

dag: ka a dihi nam n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba ni bɛ jɛmdi ti Duuma Naawuni, ka ni ti diri nam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi na nti ti ba bidibbina ni bɛ yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba. Bɛ daa pirigila buyi dɔni kaman buhi biɛla la, amaa ka Siria tɔbbihi maa bɛn kul yɛrigila luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Israelites also prepared to fight. They marched out to meet the Syrians, and the two armies camped across from each other. The Syrians covered the whole area, but the Israelites looked like two little flocks of goats.

dag: Zatu daŋ — kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: of Zattu.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu saha kanna ka bɛ ti ku lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbu saha shɛli, ka o daa lan kpuɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bipuɣiŋga n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Sɛgub.
en: When Hezron was sixty years old, he married Machir's daughter, the sister of Gilead. They had a son named Segub.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔsia daa zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ o, ka daa bo binyara niŋ omaŋa n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. O daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Nɛko yɛl o shɛm maa; ka daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti lir o Mɛgido bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: But Josiah wouldnt turn back. Instead, he camouflaged himself in preparation for battle, refusing to listen to Necos words from Gods own mouth, and went to fight Neco on the plain of Megiddo.

dag: Ka do so daa be Maɔn ka o tuma shee nyɛ Kamɛl. Doo maa daa mali buni pam. O daa malila piɛri tusaata, ka mali buhi tuhili. Ka o daa ti chɛr o piɛri maa kɔbiri Kamɛl maa.
en: Nabal was a very rich man who lived in Maon. He owned , sheep and , goats, which he kept at Carmel. His wife Abigail was sensible and beautiful, but he was from the Caleb clan and was rough and mean.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: The servant bowed and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ba n-daa wuhiri bɛ zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu biŋkumda din daa nyɛ: guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisanim mini mɔɣilɔnim ni goonjɛnima Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm. Naa n-daa wuhiri Asaf mini Jɛdutun ni Hɛman bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Heman led all his sons in singing in the Lord s temple. His sons used cymbals, lyres, and harps. That was their way of serving in Gods temple. King David chose these men.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ti be soli n-chana, ka do so ti yɛl o, N ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: They were all traveling along the road. Someone said to Jesus, I will follow you anywhere you go.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa daa balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ. Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o.
en: the man who had been healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him off and said.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yɛli zali, ka di ti niŋ. Tinzun wun so na ʒi n-niŋ lala. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: I predicted what would happen, and then I came to your aid. No foreign god has ever done this; you are my witnesses.

dag: Yɛlim ba, N nyɛla shihirili yi sani, n ni niŋ shɛm maa, lala nti yɛn niŋ ya. Bɛ ni ti gbahi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tinzun tiŋ ti niŋ dabitim ni.
en: Tell them, I am an example for all of you. What I have done will happen to you. You will be forced to go to a faraway country as prisoners.

dag: Bee Tiligimiya ma n dim nuu ni? Bee Famiya ma bɛn nahindi ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi?.
en: or to save me from some enemy or tyrant?.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa pii kuɣili sa nimaani ni di nyɛ din teeri ba.
en: So Jacob got a stone and set it up as a memorial.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindi timaŋa, ka o be kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka bɛ su zahim mini noonsi ni niɣi ni dunia ŋɔ zaa ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi.
en: Then God said, And now we will make human beings; they will be like us and resemble us. They will have power over the fish, the birds, and all animals, domestic and wild, large and small.

dag: Amaa ka yi chɛ ka Nazarinim maa nyuri wain, ka yɛri anabinima ni bɛ miri ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: But you made the Nazirites drink wine. You told the prophets not to prophesy.

dag: Niŋmiya binshɛɣukam ka kparima ni ŋumbu bee naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu kani.
en: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.

dag: A bidibisi yi ni gbibi n daalikauli maa mini n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa wuhi ba, bɛ bidibisi gba ni ti ʒiini a nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu sahakam.
en: If your descendants obey my agreement and the laws I teach them, then the king will always be someone from your family.

dag: Ka Uzai bia Palal daa mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee mini pia din du n-gari nayili jirambisa din miri nayili guliba biɛhigu shee la tooni. Ka Parɔsh bia Pɛdaya daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Palal, Uzais son, repaired from the point opposite the Angle and the tower projecting from the upper house of the king at the court of the guard. After him, Pedaiah, Paroshs son.

dag: N ni zaŋ o leei m bituuli, ka o gari dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.

dag: ni laakumnim bɛn mali bihim pihita mini bɛ bihi ni naɣinyama pihinahi mini naɣilahi pia ni bunnyama pisi mini bundibisi pia.
en: He took camels and their colts, cows and bulls, female donkeys and male donkeys.

dag: Di yi ni nani, yin chɛliya ka yi mini sokam ʒini ni suhudoo.
en: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti paai ya saha shɛli yi nandahima maa ni, yi ni ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani nti deeg o yɛligu.
en: When you are in trouble—when all these things happen to you—then you will come back to the Lord your God and obey him.

dag: N dimnim zaa maani ma la ansarisi, ka n ʒiʒiinitab kaɣiri ma, ka n leei binzɔrigu bɛnkam mi ma sani; ka bɛnkam mi nya ma sol ni guurimi ka chɛri ma.
en: My enemies despise me, and even my neighbors have turned away. When my friends see me in the street, they turn the other way. They are afraid to be around me.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Faashee Daadam Bia nya wahala pam, ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa ti zaɣis o, ka chɛ ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: He also told them, The Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law. He will be put to death, but three days later he will be raised to life.

dag: Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: God never said to any of the angels, Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: From there, Jesus went to the regions of Tyre and Sidon.

dag: A bi kpini shɛli yɛla ŋɔ ni, a mi nuu ka di ni, dama a suhu bi ʒe yim ni Naawuni.
en: You have no part or share in our work, because your heart is not right in God's sight.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, So di dam o kɔba; kul chɛliya li ka di doya baalim. Ka bɛ daa chɛ o mini anab so ŋun daa yi Samaria la na kɔba.
en: Let it be, Josiah said. No one should disturb his bones. So they left his bones untouched, along with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, Labim a ba min a dɔɣiriba tiŋgban ni. N ni be a sani.
en: One day the Lord said, Jacob, go back to your relatives in the land of your ancestors, and I will be with you.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi be kaman o yab Dauda. O daa niŋ o ba Jɔash ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes, but not as well as his ancestor King David. He did everything his father Jehoash did.

dag: M mabihi, m bi tɛhi ni m pun nya li, amaa n ni niŋdi bin yini shɛli nyɛla n tamdila binshɛɣukam din be n nyaaŋa yɛla, ka kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m paala din be n tooni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I myself dont think Ive reached it, but I do this one thing: I forget about the things behind me and reach out for the things ahead of me.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni zahim bɛn be teeku ni zaa ni zɔri ya. N zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: All the animals, birds, and fish will live in fear of you. They are all placed under your power.

dag: Asiria naa Sarigɔn ni daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi zuɣulana chaŋ ti liri Ashidɔdnima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba yuun shɛl la.
en: Under the orders of Emperor Sargon of Assyria, the commander-in-chief of the Assyrian army attacked the Philistine city of Ashdod.

dag: Ka Sool daa yiɣisi zani n-neeg o nina ka bi lan ne; ka bɛ daa gbaag o nuu ni n-vo o hal ni Damaskus.
en: Saul got up from the ground and opened his eyes, but he could not see. So the men with him held his hand and led him into Damascus.

dag: Ka yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa yihi Jɛrimia ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: When commander Nebuzaradan found Jeremiah, he spoke to him. He said, Jeremiah, the Lord , your God, announced that this disaster would come to this place.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti me buɣili zali yimaŋa.
en: Dont make idols.

dag: Biŋkpila maa daa tamla daantalis ayi la zuɣu, ka be duu maa gɔŋbu shee zuɣusaa lansi luɣili ni, ka pumpɔrinchihi kɔbisiyi kulis ayi gili biŋkpil yini, ka lan gili biŋkpil din la gba lala.
en: The chain designs on the caps were right above the rounded tops of the two columns, and there were pomegranates in rows around each cap.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mali bindir shɛli ka yi bi mi li.
en: Jesus said to them, I have food to eat that you dont know about.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m bɔɣusapiŋ kɔbili kparigi ka m bɔɣu kabi.
en: then may my arms be broken; may they be torn from my shoulders.

dag: Ka Pool daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛ zuɣu na, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa min anabitali yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: Then Paul placed his hands on them. The Holy Spirit was given to them, and they spoke unknown languages and prophesied.

dag: Ka n daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka yi gbɛri gooni maa gbini? Yi yi lan pahi lala, n ni gbahi ya. Ka di saha maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa bi lan labina Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha.
en: I warned them, It's no use waiting out there for morning to come. If you try this again, I'll use force on you. From then on they did not come back on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka wahu maa daa tuhi kom o nol ni na kaman mɔɣili kom la ni di zo n-doli paɣ maa ti di o.
en: Then from his mouth the snake poured a river of water after the woman so that the river would sweep her away.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni sɔŋ o ni pii na so ŋɔ; o ni be o daalizanda din be kasi la ni ka garig o, ka chɛ ka o nudirigu sɔŋ o ka o di nasara din galisi.
en: Now I know the Lord helps his chosen king. From his holy heaven he answered. With his great power he saved him.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn zaŋ kuɣa me sara maligu bimbini ti ma, yin di zaŋya kuɣ kpɛra me li, dama yi yi zaŋ chiriga shihi kuɣ shɛli, di ni leei kuɣ shɛli din mali daɣiri.
en: But if you do make for me an altar from stones, dont build it with chiseled stone since using your chisel on the stone will make it impure.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ Dauda sani Zikilag saha shɛl o ni daa bi lan tooi yiri palo gɔr o yubu, Kish bia Sool zuɣu la gba daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋ o tuhi tɔbu la.
en: This is a list of the men who came to David while he was at Ziklag. This was when David was hiding from Saul son of Kish. These men helped David in battle.

dag: ni Keenannim bɛn daa be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la nim zaŋ tabili Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la nima ni Hivinim bɛn daa be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni Mizipa tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: He also sent word to the Canaanites on both sides of the Jordan, to the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, and the Jebusites in the hill country, as well as to the Hivites who lived at the foot of Mount Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

dag: N yura ŋmanila tipum din yirigi Ɛngɛdi wain tihi puu ni.
en: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka piɛgula yino ŋun nyɛ n dabili Dauda guli ba ka dihiri ba. O ni ti dihiri ba ka nyɛ bɛ piɛgula.
en: I will appoint for them a single shepherd, and he will feed them. My servant David will feed them. He will be their shepherd.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn mini ba daa be m-miri taba ni daa kana, bɛ daa yɛli ti siɣimsiɣim bupia, Ti dimnim maa ni yi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kana ti liri ti.
en: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima mini anzinfa ni daanya ni kuriti ni dalima ni kurizim.
en: Everything that will not burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, is to be purified by passing it through fire. Everything else is to be purified by the water for purification.

dag: ka yihi nanim bɛ nama ni, ka tibigi tarimba.
en: He has brought down mighty kings from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly.

dag: Ka daa yi Janɔa maa m-mali hal ti paai Atarɔt mini Naara n-zaŋ hal ni Jɛriko n-kul mali lala hal ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, reaching Jericho and ending at the Jordan.

dag: Samiya Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa gol tuuli dahin yini dali.
en: On the first day of the first month set up the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: N yura maa viɛlimi pam ka mali yaa. Ninvuɣ tuhili puuni so bi ŋman o.
en: My lover is tanned and radiant. He would stand out among , men.

dag: Shaharaim daa dɔɣi bidibisi Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa kar o paɣiba bɛn yuya daa booni Hushim mini Baara la nyaaŋa.
en: Shaharaim had children in the country of Moab after he divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ a dabili min o daŋ polo la niŋ pali ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Now, LORD God, confirm forever the promise you have made about your servant and his dynasty. Do just as you have promised.

dag: M mali tahima Naawuni sani ni wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ni neei kum ni, kaman bɛ gba ni mali di tahima shɛm.
en: I have the same hope in God that these Jews have—the hope that all people, good and bad, will be raised from death.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ bɛ ʒiʒiinitab ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn zaa mi bɛ yuli ŋɔ, fabilimiya bɛ zuɣu. Yɛlimiya, Nyamiya nam jaaŋgbe kpiɔŋ din mali jilima la ni kabigi shɛm.
en: Grieve for this nation, you neighbors of Moab, all you who know his name. Proclaim how its mighty scepter and magnificent staff are shattered!.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o sani ka bɛ bɔri bindirigu la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered, Have you never read what David did that time when he needed something to eat? He and his men were hungry.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Amalɛknim maa sani ka bɛ ʒi ba na, niriba maa n-daa chɛ piɛ viɛla mini naɣ viɛla maa n-zaŋ ba na ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ; amaa ti daa saɣim dinkam kpalim zaa.
en: The army took them from the Amalekites, Saul explained. They kept the best sheep and cattle, so they could sacrifice them to the Lord your God. But we destroyed everything else.

dag: Paɣ maa nini ni daa ti nya Samuɛl, o daa ŋmɛla kuŋ pam ka bɔhi Sool, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma? Nyini n-nyɛ Sool.
en: And it happened—the woman saw Samuel and screamed. She said to Saul, You tricked me! You are Saul.

dag: Yisa daa ti yɛli salo pam, Yi yi ti nya ka sagbani dɔni gbinni, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi, ka o ti shiri mi.
en: Then Jesus said to the people, When you see clouds growing bigger in the west, you say, A rainstorm is coming. And soon it begins to rain.

dag: O daa tuhi deei Izraɛl tintariga tinsi Lɛbohamat dunol shee zaŋ hal ti paai Araba Teeku ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Jona Amitai bia ŋun daa yi Gatihɛfa la na yɛli shɛm la.
en: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.

dag: Malimiya dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo dapaɣa pisi.
en: Make twenty frames for the south side.

dag: Di daa bi yuui, ka o kuhi yɛli, Wɔribariba be chɛchɛbuŋ ni, ka yuri ayi vɔri li kanna! Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli, Babilɔn luya, di luya! Ka di wuna binnana zaa lu n-wurisiwurisi do tiŋa.
en: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops. At once someone shouted, Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti ŋme mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi kikahi ti kpe Yawɛ duu.
en: They entered Jerusalem accompanied by harps, lutes, and trumpets, and they went to the LORDs temple.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi n nini ka chɛ ba ka bɛ ta n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ daɣiri. Ŋmɛnditoya ni ti kpe di ni nti ta li daɣiri.
en: I will turn my head away from them—I will not look at them. The strangers will ruin my Temple—they will go into the secret parts of that holy building and make it unfit for worship.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ti shɛhira gbaŋ din sab ti suhuri ni ni sokam nya li karim.
en: You yourselves are the letter we have, written on our hearts for everyone to know and read.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa yɛli, Aai, di bi simdi ni ti ku so zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnim faako.
en: But Saul said, No one will be executed because today the LORD has saved Israel.

dag: Yinim tinvura ŋɔ! Yinim garinsi ŋɔ! Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ nti zo n-yi buɣim ni?.
en: You snakes and children of snakes! How do you expect to escape from being condemned to hell?.

dag: ni yi ni yɛn nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di lahi zaa ni tahili ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar for burnt offerings and all its equipment, the washbasin and its base.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Ribɛka na nti bɔh o, A ni doli doo ŋɔ chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni dol o chaŋ.
en: They called her and asked her, Do you want to go with this man now? Rebekah said, Yes, I will go.

dag: N yɛligu bi bemi kaman buɣim bee zali din nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli ŋmɛri wurindi kuɣa la? Man Yawɛ m-bɔhi lala maa.
en: Isnt my word like fire and like a hammer that shatters rock? declares the LORD.

dag: O labisi n yaa ti ma. O wuhi ma soya din tuhi o yuli zuɣu.
en: He gives me new strength. He guides me in the right paths, as he has promised.

dag: N ni yiɣisi pumpɔŋɔ n-doli tiŋ puuni solɔri mini lɔrisi ni. M bo n suhu ni yuri so pam maa shee. M bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: I went wandering through the city, through its streets and alleys. I looked for the one I love. I looked, but couldn't find him.

dag: Bɛ pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒii buyopɔin ka sab wuhi di ni nyɛ shɛm na ti ti ma, ka m bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni n-lihi nya.
en: But you will write a report in seven parts and bring the report back here to me. Then I will cast the lot for you here, before the LORD our God.

dag: Naawuni nia lɔbu min o ni zali shɛm puuni ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋda; ka ŋun Naawuni pii ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba ti mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun lo ka zal li shɛm omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni piligu ni ha la zuɣu.
en: We have also received an inheritance in Christ. We were destined by the plan of God, who accomplishes everything according to his design.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ bindira nyo buɣim mali sara daba ayopɔin. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani. Niŋmiya li pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di binnyura zuɣu.
en: In the same way, for seven days offer to the Lord a food offering, an odor pleasing to him. Offer this in addition to the daily burnt offering and wine offering.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli, kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya, amaa ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma, hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi; ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: Johns answer to this was, I baptize you in water, but there is someone coming later who is able to do more than I can. I am not good enough to be the slave who unties his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa chaŋ Damaskus ni o ti nya Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza, ka o daa nya bimbin shɛli Damaskus maa. Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa zaŋ bimbini maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni di yɛlli kam zaa n-tim ti ti maligumaana Yuria.
en: When King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Emperor Tiglath Pileser, he saw the altar there and sent back to Uriah the priest an exact model of it, down to the smallest details.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Ijiptinima n-daa yi nyɛ o yaa, ka di mi daa ka tariga. Putinim mini Libianim n-daa nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o.
en: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.

dag: N kumdila Mɔabnim zuɣu! Bɛ zo n-kuli Zɔa mini Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama shɛb lu soli kuni Luhit, ka kumdi chana; ka shɛb mi zo n-kuli Hɔrɔnaim ni suhugarigu pam.
en: My heart cries, full of sorrow for Moab. Its people run away to Zoar for safety. They run to Eglath Shelishiyah. The people are crying as they go up the road to Luhith. They are crying loudly as they walk on the road to Horonaim.

dag: Di lan simdi ka o bo ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli, ka bɛ ti zaŋ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: and two turtledoves or two pigeons, whatever they can afford—one as a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ ka yi nya, yi suhu ni paligi, ka yi nya kpiɔŋ mini alaafee, ka zoori kaman momaha la; ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deeri n noli; ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisiri bahiri n dimnim zuɣu.
en: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa dolila wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: Then the LORDs glory came into the temple by way of the east gate.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, dindina ŋun yom di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi ka di leeg o dini.
en: If you wish to buy your field back, you must pay the price plus an additional percent.

dag: N Naawuni maa yɛliya, Alahichinim ka suhudoo.
en: But I, the Lord , have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.

dag: Hashum daŋ — kɔbisiyi ni pisinaata.
en: the descendants of Hashum:.

dag: ka o zaŋ li ŋubi bɛ zaa nini maa ni.
en: He took it and ate it as they watched.

dag: Ka o daa yuuni salo maa gindi ni o nya ŋun niŋ lala maa.
en: But Jesus turned to see who had touched him.

dag: ka fara lir a kaman tayiɣ la, ka kum lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lo kpara la.
en: and poverty will come on you like a prowler, deprivation like a man with a shield.
