dag: Di zaa yoli Yawɛ daa bi bɔr ni o bahi Dauda daŋ maa yoli, o ni daa lo Dauda alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. O daa lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ nam ti o min o zuliya ka bɛ be kaman firila la sahakam.
en: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa be Ijipti Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Bɛ daa nya azichi pam nimaani, ka daa dɔɣi bihi ka bɛ zuliya maa nab pam.
en: The Israelites lived in Egypt in the region of Goshen, where they became rich and had many children.

dag: Ka a nuu bee a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini bee a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi bee napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Aai, a paɣ Zara ni dɔɣi bidibiga ti a, ka a bol o yuli Yisahaku. Ka n ni lo a min o zuliya alikauli shɛli din ni be sahakam.
en: But God said, No. Your wife Sarah will bear you a son and you will name him Isaac. I will keep my covenant with him and with his descendants forever. It is an everlasting covenant.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul jiɣindimi biɛɣu kam ni o nya pam pahi, ka wuntizɔra mi kul tiri pini ka bi vil o ni su shɛli gbini.
en: The lazy desire things constantly, but the righteous give without holding back.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wɔbi yi olivi tiwala, yin di lan labi ti yihi din kpalim; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: Similarly, when you beat the olives off your olive trees, dont go back over them twice. Let the leftovers go to the immigrants, the orphans, and the widows.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Jɛhɔshafat, A ni saɣi pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka Jɛhɔshafat garigi yɛli Izraɛl naa, A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: He said to Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me into battle at Ramoth-gilead? Jehoshaphat said to Israels king, I am with you, and my troops and my horses are united with yours.

dag: Dama Atalia ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ putɔɣulan la bidibisi daa kabila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa kpe, hal ka daa lan zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen kasinim zaa ti jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: In the past, Athaliahs sons broke into Gods Temple and used the holy things in the Lord s Temple for their worship of the Baal gods. Athaliah was a very wicked woman.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ ka yi niŋ yɛda ni mani n-shiri nyɛ n ni yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la.
en: Im telling you this now, before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I Am.

dag: Kaman sagani ni yi booi sagbana ni saa mibu dali shɛm la, lala ka jilima din daa gili o maa daa be. Yawɛ jilima kɔtomsi ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala. N ni daa nya li maa ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka wum so kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord 's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jahaziɛl zuɣu na niriba maa ni. Jahaziɛl daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka Zakaria nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia, ka Bɛnaaya nyɛ Jɛiɛl bia, ka Jɛiɛl mi nyɛ Matania ŋun daa yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Asaf daŋ ni nir la bia.
en: Then the LORDs spirit came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah son of Benaiah son of Jeiel son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the line of Asaph, as he stood in the middle of the assembly.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa kuhi yɛli ma, Nyama, wɔr shɛb bɛn zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la nyɛla bɛn chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu maai.
en: he shouted to me, Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord 's Spirit wants them to do there.

dag: Ti ni daa nya so ka wum o yɛla maa yɛla ka ti yɛri ya maa ni di chɛ ka ti mini ya mali dolintabitali, ka ti mi dolintabitali maa bela ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia Yisa Masia sani.
en: What we have seen and heard we announce to you also, so that you will join with us in the fellowship that we have with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.

dag: Nir ni tooi yɛli ni Lɛvi ŋun daa deeri zaka la gba daa be ti yab Ibrahimma ni n-yihi zaka ti Mɛlikizɛdɛk;.
en: And, so to speak, when Abraham paid the tenth, Levi also paid it.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim pala ti ni niriba; lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yi ti ni. Bɛ yi di daa nyɛla ti ni niriba, bɛ daa naan kpalim be ti sani. Amaa bɛ daa yi ti ni ni di kahigi wuhi ni bɛ zaa pala bɛn be ti ni.
en: These enemies were in our group, but they left us. They did not really belong with us. If they were really part of our group, they would have stayed with us. But they left. This shows that none of them really belonged with us.

dag: N yɛn gbib biɛrim n suhu ni ti paala bɔ saha? N yɛn malila suhugarigu dabisi muni puuni zaa? N dimnim kul yɛn nyandi ma ka di yuusim paala bɔ saha?.
en: How long must I wonder if you have forgotten me? How long must I feel this sadness in my heart? How long will my enemy win against me?.

dag: Yurilim bi naara; amaa di yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa yɛla, di gba nyɛla din garita.
en: Love will never end. But all those gifts will come to an end—even the gift of prophecy, the gift of speaking in different kinds of languages, and the gift of knowledge.

dag: Ka salo maa galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bara maa zaŋ paai Yisa sani, ka daa dula duu maa zuɣusaa nti chib voli Yisa zuɣusaa dɛde. Bɛ ni daa chib voli maa, ka bɛ zaŋ bara maa mini amaŋka maa siɣisi li ti sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: They couldnt carry him through the crowd, so they tore off part of the roof above where Jesus was. When they had made an opening, they lowered the mat on which the paralyzed man was lying.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ Naawuni ni daa lo o niriba alikauli ni bɛ ti yɛn nya shɛl la shihirili, hal ka tinim bɛn nyɛ omaŋmaŋ niriba nya yolisim maŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: The Holy Spirit is the down payment on our inheritance, which is applied toward our redemption as Gods own people, resulting in the honor of Gods glory.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa niŋ buɣim dab li; ka zaŋ ba bahi ka bɛ zo nti kpe Filistianim kawana ni. Ka buɣim maa taai bɛ kawaan puri maa n-di bɛ ni pun ŋahi luɣ shɛŋa mini bɛ ni na bi ŋahi shɛŋa n-tabili bɛ olivi tihi puri.
en: Then he set fire to the torches and turned the foxes loose in the Philistine wheat fields. In this way he burned up not only the wheat that had been harvested but also the wheat that was still in the fields. The olive orchards were also burned.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o wuni Nisirok jɛmbu duu jɛmd o, ka o bidibisi Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: One day when he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, two of his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords and then escaped to the land of Ararat. Another of his sons, Esarhaddon, succeeded him as emperor.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla. A ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o lee naa la yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, bɛ maan o la ansarisi.
en: Your enemies insult your chosen king, O Lord ! They insult him wherever he goes.

dag: kaman Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la mini Mɔabnim bɛn be Ar la ni daa niŋ ma shɛm hal ka n ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
en: just as Esaus descendants who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for me—until we cross the Jordan River into the land that the LORD our God is giving to us.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala m-be yi sani? Chamiya ti nya. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti lihi ka labina ti yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi ko m-beni.
en: So Jesus asked them, How much bread do you have? Go and see. When they found out, they told him, Five loaves and also two fish.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei kpiimba maa situra, ka nya Sool min o bidibis ata maa ni do Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The next day, the Philistines came to take valuable things from the dead bodies. They found Sauls body and the bodies of his sons on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Jokitan daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ: Alimɔdad mini Shɛlɛf ni Hazarimavɛt ni Jɛra ni.
en: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka Yisa yɛl lala maa nyɛla, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu la.
en: He said this because the legal experts were saying, Hes possessed by an evil spirit.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayɔbu bɛ tinsi maa ni na nti pahi Gibianim zuɣu.
en: The people from the tribe of Benjamin got , soldiers together who were trained for war. They also had trained soldiers from the city of Gibeah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa da jinjɛŋŋmaa maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa n-zaŋ li so.
en: So I bought a linen loincloth, just as the Lord told me to do, and I put it around my waist.

dag: Amaa zaawuni yi ti paai, ŋun sum kom, ka wuntaŋ yi ti lu, o ni tooi lan labi sansani maa ni na.
en: When the next evening arrives, he must wash with water; and when the sun sets, he can come back to the camp.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la.
en: The day had come for the Festival of Thin Bread, and it was time to kill the Passover lambs.

dag: N zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti o ka di leeg o tuma yɔri, dama n tuma ka bɛ daa tum ti ma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar as a reward for the hard work he did for me. This is what the Lord GOD said!.

dag: Ti daa wum bɛ yɛla ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisimi, ka biɛrim pam mali ti, ka biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: We have heard the news, say the people of Jerusalem, and our hands hang limp; we are seized by anguish and pain like a woman in labor.

dag: Amaa naŋgbammalisim ka bɛ daa kul niŋd o, bɛ daa ŋmar o la ʒiri.
en: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;.

dag: Di gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: MENE gbinni nyɛla Naawuni pun kali a nam dabisa m-paai di tariga.
en: And this is what it means: number, God has numbered the days of your kingdom and brought it to an end;.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kana, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa gili luɣilikam maa, laɣimmiya nimaani. Yawɛ, timmi a tɔbbihi na!.
en: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather in the valley. Send down, O Lord , your army to attack them!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Now this happened to fulfill what the prophet said.

dag: Leeban daa zaŋla o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Liya ni o sɔŋd o.
en: Laban gave his slave woman Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her maid.

dag: O daa fa li la Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknim sani, ni o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza Rɛhɔb bia ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la ka di neen shɛŋa la zaa.
en: Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, Amalek, and from King Hadadezer of Zobah.

dag: Ka o daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yuŋ maa ti yɛli ba, Yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yiɣisimiya n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka chɛ n niriba ŋɔ; chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: That same night the king sent for Moses and Aaron and said, Get out, you and your Israelites! Leave my country; go and worship the Lord , as you asked.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ buhi kɔbiri wuɣi tana piniyini n-zaŋ li pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa.
en: They also made curtains of goats hair for a tent over the dwelling. They made eleven curtains.

dag: N ni daa kana saha shɛl la, bɛ daa nyɛla biɛla; ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yipa nabimi pam, ka n yi kul ŋmaligi kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo, Yawɛ niŋdila alibarika niŋ a ni. Amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ, bɔ saha ka man lee yɛn zaŋ wolim gbaai ti n yiŋnim gba.
en: While in my care, what little you had has multiplied a great deal. The LORD blessed you wherever I took your livestock. Now, when will I be able to work for my own household too.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Shɛkɛm pii la zaa laɣim bela nimaani.
en: Abimelech was told that they had gathered there.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo, anabi maa mini ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhi ni o baŋ maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛla yim.
en: The prophet and the inquirer alike will bear their guilt.

dag: Zo kpima chɛ ka tulaale nyom niŋdila biɛribiɛri; lala ka jɛrilim biɛla saɣindi yɛm mini jilima.
en: A few dead flies will make even the best perfume stink. In the same way, a little foolishness can ruin much wisdom and honor.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti ninvuɣ shɛba yi ninni, ka yi yuli ba soli ka yi nina ti fulim dindali maa zaa, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: Your sons and daughters will be given as slaves to foreigners while you look on. Every day you will strain your eyes, looking in vain for your children to return.

dag: Bɛ tɛha din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ nyɛla din be zibisim ni; ka bɛ nuu ka Naawuni ni ti nyɛvil shɛl la ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ka nyɛ suhutunanima.
en: and they are in the dark in their reasoning. They are disconnected from Gods life because of their ignorance and their closed hearts.

dag: Bɛ ni ti doli Yawɛ, ka o ti ŋum kaman gbuɣinli la; yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti ŋum, ka o niriba ti yi wulinluhili polo na ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They will walk after the LORD, who roars like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.

dag: Kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu, ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna.
en: Now there was no water for the community, and they assembled against Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pia puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pinaayi dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Ten years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the twelfth day of the tenth month. He said:.

dag: Hal ka n kuhi pam bɔri sɔŋsim ka o zaɣisi n suhigu deebu.
en: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni shɛb nyɛla bɛn doli yɛŋkiŋkabina soli n-kpɛri yiya ni ti liriti paɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhimbu bi to, ka lan nyɛ bɛn daalahichi taali muɣisiri ba ka kɔre balibu kam mali ba niŋdi di yubu la.
en: Some of them go into people's houses and gain control over weak women who are burdened by the guilt of their sins and driven by all kinds of desires.

dag: zaŋ Aroa din daa be Arinɔn vinvamli naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ la hal ti paai Siriɔn Zoli .
en: from Aroer, which is on the banks of the Arnon River, all the way to Mount Sion, also known as Hermon.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The Lord is loving and merciful, slow to become angry and full of constant love.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tiligi Izraɛlnim Ijiptinim nuu ni dindali maa shɛm m-bala. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya Ijiptinim ni kpi n-do teeku duli shɛm.
en: So that day the Lord saved the Israelites from the Egyptians. Later, the Israelites saw the dead bodies of the Egyptians on the shore of the Red Sea.

dag: Pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii, ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla; di daa nyɛla zaɣ yɔri, ka di tibisim nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Each column was about twenty-seven feet high and eighteen feet around. They were hollow, but the bronze was about three inches thick.

dag: Bin biɛri balibu kam ŋɔ zaa yirila ninsal suhu ni na, ka nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: All of these come from your heart, and they are what make you unfit to worship God.

dag: Binzahi maa zaɣ yini kam daa malila bintaɣiris anahi di yaɣa anahi maa zaa. Bintaɣirisi maa mini binzahi maa zaa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: There were supports at each of the four corners of the carts. They were made as one piece with the cart.

dag: N daa dolila Vinvamli Dunɔdal la yi yuŋ chaŋ ti gari Wɔɣ Kurili kɔbilinini la shee n-chaŋ Saɣiri Dunɔdal la ni. N daa chanimi n-kaari ni n nya Jɛrusalɛm goma maa ni lunlu shɛm mini buɣim ni daa di n-saɣimsaɣim di dunɔdaya la shɛm.
en: While it was dark I went out through the Valley Gate. I rode toward the Dragon Well and the Gate of the Ash Piles. I was inspecting the walls of Jerusalem that had been broken down and the gates in the wall that had been burned with fire.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛba yo wuntizɔriba talima samli, ka zaŋ bɛn ka yɛda yo bɛn biɛhigu tuhi samli.
en: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ku niriba, ka wurim bɛ tɔbbihi ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu, ka chɛ ka bɛ solɔri kpalim zaɣ kuma ka so bi lan dol li; ka chɛ ka bɛ fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka ninsalinim lan ka di ni, ka vuhirigu kam lan ka di ni.
en: The Lord says, I have wiped out whole nations; I have destroyed their cities and left their walls and towers in ruins. The cities are deserted; the streets are empty—no one is left.

dag: Shɛm daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Shɛm ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Aripakishad, yuma ayi din daa doli dunia ŋɔ kom dibu nyaaŋa la.
en: This is the history of Shems family. Two years after the flood, when Shem was years old, his son Arphaxad was born.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka Ɛhab bia Jɛhɔram daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi.
en: Joram son of Ahab became king over Israel at Samaria. He began to rule during Jehoshaphats th year as king of Judah. Joram ruled years.

dag: ka Ira ŋun daa nyɛ Jair nir la mi daa nyɛ Dauda maligumaana.
en: And Ira from Jair was Davids personal priest.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyumiya hal ti kuli, ka ti li bahi, ka lu ka ku lan tooi yiɣisi yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka tɔb shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Tell the people that I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, am commanding them to drink until they are drunk and vomit, until they fall down and cannot get up, because of the war that I am sending against them.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka salo pam daa ti doli Yisa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli ba.
en: Large crowds were walking along with Jesus, when he turned and said:.

dag: Ka di yi na mali puma ka bɛ bi chɛ li sɔŋ, di daŋdila mɔɣu kam kuubu.
en: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.

dag: A yi ni doli Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga, a biɛhigu ni tɔŋ. Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, Di zɔri dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: Then, if you carefully follow the regulations and case laws that the LORD commanded Moses concerning Israel, youll prosper. Be strong and brave. Dont be afraid or lose heart!.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, o ni pɔbilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirigi o kpiŋkpama na ti to Mɔabnima.
en: The LORD proclaims: Look! One who soars like an eagle and spreads its wings over Moab.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim, saha shɛli zaa yi ni ti yɛn be yi dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka di leei dabari maa, di saha maa di ni vuhi, ka di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim.
en: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.

dag: Uzi n-daa nyɛ o bi kpɛma, ka o mabihi nyɛ Buz mini Kɛmuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Aram ba la.
en: Uz the first-born, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: and prayed.

dag: O chɛ ka sɔŋsim yi o jɛmbu duu mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na ti sɔŋ a.
en: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka Yisahaku mi dɔɣi Yaakubu mini Iso. Ka n daa zaŋ Ɛdom zoya zuɣu tiŋgbani ti Iso ni di nyɛ o dini, amaa ka Yaakubu ŋun min o bihi daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti.
en: And I gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau. To Esau, I gave the land around the mountains of Seir. Jacob and his sons did not live there. They went to live in the land of Egypt.

dag: Kum mini nyɛvili bela zilinli yiko ni, ka bɛn yuri li ni di di nyɔri.
en: What you say can preserve life or destroy it; so you must accept the consequences of your words.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma n-leei lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molomoona mini di tumo ni di karimba.
en: God has appointed me as an apostle and teacher to proclaim the Good News.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralan maanila zaligu ansarisi, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli vaani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: A worthless witness mocks justice; the wicked mouth gulps down trouble.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them, and said, Take; this is my body.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me yaɣ shɛli din daa be pia din du pam la tooni hal ti paai Ofɛl gooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: The men from Tekoa repaired the rest of that section from the big tower all the way to the Ophel wall.

dag: Tɛma kɔhigɔriba lihirimi bɔri kom, ka Shiiba sochandiba mali tahima ni bɛ gba ni nya kom.
en: Traders from Tema search for it. Travelers from Sheba hope to find it.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa chaŋ nti gari Amfipolis mini Apolɔnia m-mali ti paai Tɛsalɔnaika, ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu daa be nimaani.
en: Paul and Silas traveled through the cities of Amphipolis and Apollonia. They came to the city of Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

dag: O ni gah o nuu boli zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋa, ka vulim vuliŋga boli dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam niriba, ka bɛ zɔri yomyom kanna!.
en: The Lord gives a signal to call for a distant nation. He whistles for them to come from the ends of the earth. And here they come, swiftly, quickly!.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha;.
en: Pray to God that these things will not happen in the winter!.

dag: Nyini n-nyandi ba sahakam, ka bɛ kpira, ka a taɣi bɛ ninni biɛhigu ka kari ba bahi.
en: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ ʒim maa mihi niriba maa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la ʒim, di nyɛla din doli o ni yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Moses then took the blood and threw it over the people. Moses said, This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD now makes with you on the basis of all these words.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa tim ni bɛ kuli ti yɛli Dauda tɔb maa lahibali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Joab sent a complete report of the battle to David.

dag: Ka yɛl biɛ shɛli ti kana ti ŋme n-ku li, hal ka bɛ ti bi chɛ shɛli zali bɛ bihi gba.
en: Then that wealth is lost in a bad business venture so that when they have children, they are left with nothing.

dag: Ka o daa lu bɛ zuɣu ŋ-ŋmɛri kabiri bɛ sakpuri mini bɛ gbalipina n-daa niŋ lala ku ba pam. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Ɛtam ti kpe m-be tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: He attacked them fiercely and killed many of them. Then he went and stayed in the cave in the cliff at Etam.

dag: M min a ni chaŋ Ijipti, ka n ti lan zaŋ a labisi kpe na yaha; ka Yisifu maŋmaŋ nuu ni ti daag a nina pɔbi.
en: I will go with you to Egypt, and later I will bring your descendants back here. Your son Joseph will be at your side when you die.

dag: Bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yo Yawɛ o ni niŋ ma nirilim shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu?.
en: What can I give back to the LORD for all the good things he has done for me?.

dag: Ka yɛm yi pooi yi ni so, ŋun suhimi Naawuni ka o ti o li; dama Naawuni nyɛla ŋun tiri sokam ka di galisira, ka bi nyari so taali di puuni.
en: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam dunia ŋɔ, ŋuna ŋun daa pil li, ka zal li ŋɔ, o yuli m-booni Yawɛ, O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The LORD proclaims, the LORD who made the earth, who formed and established it, whose name is the LORD.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini ninvuɣ kubo ni zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ʒiri shɛhiradibo ni nyaanzubo.
en: All these bad things begin in the mind: evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual sins, stealing, lying, and insulting people.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: How happy are those who have no doubts about me.

dag: Ŋuni ka o daa niŋ saawara ni o baŋ shɛli, ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o yɛlimaŋli soli. Ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o baŋsim bee n-wuh o o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm?.
en: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya m biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni daa zaŋ leei n jɛmbu shee la nti nya n ni daa niŋ li shɛm n niriba Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!.

dag: N ni bɔri nolɔbo shɛli n-nyɛ: Yi lɔrigi yi ni nahindi shɛb la mihi, ka suui yi ni mɔŋ shɛb yɛlimaŋli ka ʒili ba ʒi tibisa la ʒiya; ka bahi yi ni nahindi shɛb la.
en: The kind of fasting I want is this: Remove the chains of oppression and the yoke of injustice, and let the oppressed go free.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yawɛ bɛ yɛlimuɣisira zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim taai bɛ sani n-di bɛ suɣa maa gulinyaansi luɣ shɛŋa.
en: When the people complained intensely in the LORDs hearing, the LORD heard and became angry. Then the LORDs fire burned them and consumed the edges of the camp.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lan labi pahi naba ayi ka Yisifu daa kahig omaŋ n-wuh o biɛyanim maa ka bɛ baŋ o, ka Firawuna gba daa baŋ ŋun Yisifu biɛyanim maa.
en: Then they went there a second time. This time Joseph told his brothers who he was. And Pharaoh learned about Josephs family.

dag: A ni daa na bi nam zoya bee a ni daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini dunia ŋɔ, nyini n-daa nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni.
en: Before you created the hills or brought the world into being, you were eternally God, and will be God forever.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim zaa. Paɣimiy o! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri ŋarima teeku ni mini teeku puuni binnɛma zaa ni teeku dulinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ; sing his praise, all the world! Praise him, you that sail the sea; praise him, all creatures of the sea! Sing, distant lands and all who live there!.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ Naawuni ŋun bi kpiri ŋɔ jilima taɣi ti binnana din ŋmani ninsalinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ bee noonsi bee biŋkɔbiri bee biŋgbamda.
en: instead of worshiping the immortal God, they worship images made to look like mortals or birds or animals or reptiles.

dag: Di saha ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ paɣ yoli ŋun bi zani tuhi bia ŋɔ. A tɛhi ni m bi mi ni a zaŋ Jɛsi dapala maa kpɛh a kɔbili ni ni a dihila amaŋ vi, ka lan dih a ma gba vi?.
en: Saul was very angry with Jonathan and said to him, You son of a twisted, rebellious woman! I know that you have chosen to support that son of Jesse. This will bring shame to you and to your mother.

dag: Fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o kɔh o tiŋgban shɛli ti a, o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa o zuɣu n-ni kana ti yo o mabia maa ni kɔhi shɛli maa zuɣu ka deei li.
en: When one of your fellow Israelites faces financial difficulty and must sell part of their family property, the closest relative will come and buy back what their fellow Israelite has sold.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti she di nimdi maa dindali yuŋ maa ŋ-ŋubi di mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to.
en: That same night they should eat the meat roasted over the fire. They should eat it along with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka niriba duh a yuli, ka tibigi li sahakam ka yɛra, Yawɛ nyɛla Tɔbbihi Naa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni. Chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaa zani a sani.
en: Your fame will be great, and people will forever say, The Lord Almighty is God over Israel. And you will preserve my dynasty for all time.

dag: Niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka shɛb yi nuzaa polo n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo n-zɔri gindi bɔri Yawɛ yɛligu, amaa ka ti ku nya li.
en: The people will wander around the country, from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the north part of the country to the east. They will go back and forth looking for a message from the Lord , but they will not find it.

dag: O ni ti nyɛla suhudoolana. Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti liri ti, ti ni chɛ ka piɛguliba ayopɔin mini niriba anii shɛb ti ni zaŋ leei nanima la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: he will become one of peace. When Assyria invades our land and treads down our fortresses, then we will raise up against him seven shepherds and eight human princes.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la nyɛla din ka gbinni? Di ni yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni ni zaŋ shi so niŋ ti ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka o suhu kul ye ti zuɣu.
en: Don't think that there is no truth in the scripture that says, The spirit that God placed in us is filled with fierce desires.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yiɣisi Obɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Abarim yɔɣu din daa miri Mɔabnim tintariga zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: After leaving that place, they camped at the ruins of Abarim in the wilderness east of Moabite territory.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti tooi li ti niriba maa ni bɛ piɛbi. Bɛ ni daa piɛbiri ʒiɛri maa ka bɛ ti kuhi yɛli, Wɛi, Naawuni nira, Lɔɣu be duɣu maa ni! Ka bɛ daa kɔŋ li piɛbbu.
en: The stew was served to the men, but as they started to eat it, they cried out and said, There is death in that pot, man of God! They couldnt eat it.

dag: O daa piila tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din viɛla n-leeg o dini; dama nimaani ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali sapashin kpɛma. O daa ka niriba maa zuɣulaannim sanna. O daa zaŋ Yawɛ fukumsi zaligunim min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim pahi la tum tuma.
en: He chose the best part for himself because there, where the commanders portion was, the leaders of the people gathered together. Gad executed the LORDs justice and the Lords judgments for Israel.

dag: Siria naa mi ni ti kana ti liri Ijiptinima, amaa o ni ti kɔŋ nasara ka ŋmaligi lab kul o ya.
en: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.

dag: Di saha Naa Dauda daa bela zoli zuɣu birini puuni, ka Filistia tɔbbihi mi do Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Another time David was in the fortress, and a group of Philistines soldiers was stationed in Bethlehem.

dag: ka bindira balibu kam din nyɛ bɛ ni daa she shɛli ti Firawuna be piɛ shɛli din tam zuɣusaa ni, amaa ka noombihi lee kana ti diri li n zuɣu ni piɛri maa ni.
en: The top basket was full of all kinds of baked things for the king, but birds were eating them.

dag: Biŋgbamda zaa bɛn be tiŋgban ni gbamda nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira, di bi simdi ka yi di ba.
en: You must treat all the crawling animals that live on the dirt as disgusting things that you must not eat.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa lab Giligal sansani maa ni.
en: Then Joshua along with all Israel came back to the camp at Gilgal.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi ŋuna n-yɛn kpi. Bia ku di wahala o ba daalahichi zuɣu. Ka bialan ku di wahala o bia daalahichi zuɣu. Wuntizɔra wuntia tuma yɛn nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ko dini, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu mi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ko dini.
en: The one who sins is the one who will be put to death. A son will not be punished for his fathers sins, and a father will not be punished for his sons sins. A good mans goodness belongs to him alone, and a bad mans evil belongs to him alone.

dag: Amaa n kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o mi ni tiligi ma.
en: But I call out to God, and the LORD will rescue me.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bo niriba ashilɔni n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim ni bɛ wum ka Stiivin turi Anabi Musa ka mɔri Naawuni.
en: Then they secretly enticed some people to claim, We heard him insult Moses and God.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni zaligu bela bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi sarigiri bɛ napɔna yaabu ni.
en: They keep the law of their God in their hearts and never depart from it.

dag: Amaa m-mali shɛhira din gari Jɔn shɛhira maa; dama tuun shɛŋa m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum, dina ka n tumda; ka tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi maa mi diri ma shɛhira ni m Ba n-shiri tim ma na.
en: But I have a witness on my behalf which is even greater than the witness that John gave: what I do, that is, the deeds my Father gave me to do, these speak on my behalf and show that the Father has sent me.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛliya ni ti ni ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi bɛnkam zaa je ti gba nuu ni.
en: that he would save us from our enemies, from the power of all those who hate us.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; dama m bela nandahima ni, deemi n suhigu yomyom.
en: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!.

dag: A yi ni jɛm Naawuni, ka suhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa.
en: So why don't you turn to him.

dag: Yawɛ, a yi yɛn niŋ ti daalahichi laasabu, ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee ni tiligi?.
en: If you kept track of sins, LORD— my Lord, who would stand a chance?.

dag: Timiya o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima. Chɛliya ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmdi Yawɛ mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Be proud of his holy name. You followers of the Lord , be happy!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri kul ye ni bɛ niŋ bundaannim zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi zahimbu ni ka jɛritali mini barina kɔre zana din saɣindi daadamnim ka bahiri ba yoli zaa kahikahi la gbahi ba.
en: People who want to be rich bring temptations to themselves. They are caught in a trap. They begin to want many foolish things that will hurt them. These things ruin and destroy people.

dag: Yawɛ m-paɣir a, dama nyini n-yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka chɛ ka n dimnim bi di dari niŋ ma.
en: I praise you, Lord , because you have saved me and kept my enemies from gloating over me.

dag: Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini Alikauli Adaka la mini di yɔrigu ni suɣili maa puuni nɛma zaa.
en: the Meeting Tent; the Box of the Agreement; the mercy-cover that is on it;.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lan da puri tiŋgbɔn shɛli bɛ ni yɛra, Di leela dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri lan ka di ni, bɛ zaŋ li niŋla Kalidianim nuu ni la.
en: The people are saying that this land will be like a desert where neither people nor animals live, and that it will be given over to the Babylonians. But fields will once again be bought in this land.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ n tiliginsim; dina n-nyɛ ni ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku paag o sanna.
en: Also this will be my vindication, that a godless person wont come before him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi yiɣisiri bɛ sani chani mɔɣu ni ti suhiri Naawuni.
en: But he would go away to lonely places, where he prayed.

dag: Taataa kpiŋkpama vibiri ni suhupiɛlli, amaa o ka kpiŋkpaŋkɔbiri kaman tɔrili la.
en: How fast the wings of an ostrich beat! But no ostrich can fly like a stork.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila yɛndaan so ŋun daa me o yili tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: Whoever hears these teachings of mine and obeys them is like a wise man who built his house on rock.

dag: o chanimi ti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie n-gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani. Di saha dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam gari di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Then the evil spirit goes out and brings back seven other spirits more evil than itself. They all go and live there, and that person has even more trouble than before.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔrinim bɛn daa be zoya ni tiŋ maa ni daa ti kar doli ya kaman shihi la nti ŋmɛri ya luhira Ɛdom hal ti paai Hɔrima.
en: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha maa ti Yaakubu ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So Rachel gave Bilhah to her husband Jacob. He had sexual relations with Bilhah.

dag: dama Naa Hɛrɔd daa zɔri Jɔn pam ka gul o viɛnyɛliŋga, o ni daa mi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋli ni wuntizɔra la zuɣu. Jɔn Baptaizira yɛligu daa yi chihiri Naa Hɛrɔd suhu pam, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa yi wumdi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Herod was afraid to kill John, because he knew that he was a good and holy man. So he protected him. He liked listening to John, although what John said left him with so many questions.

dag: A zaŋla ti tuumbiɛri zal a tooni, ka ti ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa ashilɔni yi n-do palɔni a ninni.
en: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make a Box out of acacia wood, inches long, inches wide, and inches high.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi ne ka niŋ ma yɛda ku lan kpi hal abada. Ka bɔhi Maata, A niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yɛda.
en: And everyone who lives because of faith in me will never really die. Do you believe this.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima mini diɣi buɣisi li bee nir ti zaŋ li taɣi salima din viɛli yɛri.
en: It is worth more than gold, Than a gold vase or finest glass.

dag: Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni ka naanyi kpi m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God gave the Israelites before he died.

dag: Man Yawɛ je ŋmɛndintoli tuma mini alahichi, amaa m bɔrila yɛlimaŋli soli. N ʒiɛyimtali puuni, n ni tin ya laara, ka lɔn ya alikauli din ku zani tariga.
en: I, the Lord , love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka mi yi ni nahindi shɛm yɛla mini yi daania niŋbu ni yi ni je tuumbiɛrinim shɛm yɛla. N lan mi yi ni kpahim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-boli Yisa tuumba, amaa ka pa o tuumba la ni yi ni nya ka bɛ nyɛla ʒirinim la.
en: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.

dag: O kparima ŋmanila tulaale tihi vuɣa din wandi tulaale din nyom viɛla. O naŋgbampiba ŋmanila paɣiviɛligakushihikom, ka mɛɛr kom be di ni.
en: His cheeks are as lovely as a garden that is full of herbs and spices. His lips are like lilies, wet with liquid myrrh.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a ni so a taba? Bɔ ka a lee mali ka di pala pini ka Naawuni zaŋ li ti a? Ka a yi daa dee li mi o sani, di chaŋ wula ka a nyuri bara kaman pa pini ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li ti a la?.
en: Who says that you are better than anyone else? What do you have that you didnt receive? And if you received it, then why are you bragging as if you didnt receive it?.

dag: Zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Giliad tiŋgbani ni Gaad niriba mini Rubin niriba ni Manaasa niriba tiŋgbana zaa n-lan zaŋ Aroa din baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la hal ti paai Giliad mini Bashan tiŋgbana.
en: He won the land east of the Jordan River—all the land of Gilead, including the land that belonged to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh. He won all the land from Aroer by the Arnon Valley to Gilead and Bashan.

dag: n-wuhiri Naawuni ni daa ti Yisa Nazarɛt nira Shia Kasi yiko ka o gindi tumdi tuun suma, ka chɛ ka Sintani ni daa nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa kpaŋdi shɛm, dama Naawuni daa be o sani.
en: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, Dinzuɣu bɔ ka a lee lan guhira? Yiɣisima n-deei kom baptaizibu ka kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ka a daalahichi kpihim. .
en: And now, why wait any longer? Get up and be baptized and have your sins washed away by praying to him.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi chaŋchaŋ gili duu maa ni, ka ti lan lab ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu yaha. Ka bia maa daa tihim siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin, ka neeg o nina.
en: Then Elisha got down and paced back and forth in the house. Once again he got up on the bed and bent over the boy, at which point the boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

dag: ka nya so ka o ʒe di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani daadam. O daa yɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din chaŋ ti lim o napɔnvari, ka salima nyolɔrigu lo o nyɔɣu.
en: In the middle of the lampstands I saw someone who looked like the Human One. He wore a robe that stretched down to his feet, and he had a gold sash around his chest.

dag: Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: When has he ever said to any of the angels, Sit at my right side until I put your enemies under your feet like a footstool? .

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ma ni n wuhim ya zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka yi ti gbib li yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa ni.
en: At that time the Lord also commanded me to teach you the other laws and rules that you must follow in the land you are going to take and live in.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tinima bee malaika so ŋun yi alizanda ni na yi yihi lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ ti ni daa pun yihi shɛli waazu tin ya la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: However, even if we ourselves or a heavenly angel should ever preach anything different from what we preached to you, they should be under a curse.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be anabi Samuɛl ʒiɛman ni mini anab shɛb bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa pun yɛli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛla.
en: And all the prophets who had a message, including Samuel and those who came after him, also announced what has been happening these days.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu maa shee, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sin tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: They left the Red Sea and camped in the western Sinai desert.

dag: A yi ti yi palo, a ni bahi ba yoli kaman buɣim n-di ba la. Yawɛ ni bahi ba yoli zaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni, ka buɣim di ba.
en: When you appear, LORD, you will light them up like an oven on fire. God will eat them whole in his anger; fire will devour them.

dag: Dama n ni kul wum a puhigu maa, bia ŋun be m pul ni maa dii dammi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.

dag: Hal yi zuɣu ka Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yɛli, A gba ku kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.

dag: Ka Aduna daa lan kɔri naɣilaa mini piɛlaa bɛn daa nyɛ niriba maa suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri la, ka o bidibisi maa daa taɣi binʒim zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: Aaron also killed the bull and the ram that were the fellowship offerings from the people. His sons brought the blood to him, and he sprinkled this blood around on the altar.

dag: Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛli, N nyala alimɔnd tiwulli.
en: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, What do you see, Jeremiah? I answered, A branch of almonds that ripen early.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya sokam talahi tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ninkura mini bihi ni karimbanim ni karimbihi zaa.
en: They threw lots to choose the different kinds of work each person was to do. Everyone was treated the same. Young and old were treated the same. And the teacher was treated the same as the student.

dag: Miri ka a tu naa, hal di sɔɣi tu o; a mi miri ka a tu bundana, hal di tu o a duu puuni gba, dama di pa shɛli ka nooŋa bee binyiɣirigu kam ti zaŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa chaŋ ti yɛli.
en: Dont curse a king even in private; dont curse the rich in your bedroom, because a bird could carry your voice; some winged creature could report what you said!.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawuni, ka kɔrinsi kana ti lu bɛ suɣa maa gbini luɣ shɛlikam zaa. N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka maligim lu suɣa maa shee.
en: In the evening a large flock of quails flew in, enough to cover the camp, and in the morning there was dew all around the camp.

dag: Naawuni, di simdi ni ti paɣ a Ziɔn. Ka zaŋ ti ni lo alikauli ni ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa ti a la ti a.
en: God of Zion, to you even silence is praise. Promises made to you are kept.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim suhuri daa paligi pam, bɛ ni daa yi n-chaŋ maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa kpalim zɔri ba mi.
en: Egypt celebrated when they left, because the dread of Israel had come upon them.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ binʒim maa kpaai vie Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni la, ka zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim ka di nyɛ din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: Then the priest will throw their blood onto the Lord s altar near the entrance of the Meeting Tent. And the priest will burn the fat from those animals on the altar as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: N ni zaŋ o leei m bituuli, ka o gari dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: Yes, Ill make him the one born first— Ill make him the high king of all earths kings.

dag: Amaa bomiya nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli yi zuliyanim maa zaa sani n-leeg o biɛhigu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani la.
en: The Lord your God will choose a special place among your tribes. That will be the home for his name. You must go to that place to worship him.

dag: Yi bi yɛli ni di kpalim chira anahi ni puu atam kpuɣibu? Amaa n yɛri ya mi, kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi puri ni, di daatam maa biya zaa, ka di kpalimla chɛbu.
en: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛl o, Labim a lan maa sani nti zaŋ amaŋ ti o.
en: The LORDs messenger said to her, Go back to your mistress. Put up with her harsh treatment of you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti saɣim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din be Avɛn, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim daalahichi la. Ka gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ti bili di maligu bimbina maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti yɛli zoya, Limsimiya ti. Ka yɛli daboya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na.
en: Israel sinned and built many high places. The high places of Aven will be destroyed. Thorns and weeds will grow on their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, Cover us! and to the hills, Fall on us.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ m-piig a leei maligumaana n-zali maligumaana Jɛhɔiada zaashee ni a guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka yinyaa yi zaŋ omaŋ leeg a anabi, yi n-gbaam o n-zaŋ zoligo ga o, ka zaŋ baŋ yɛl o nyiŋgol ni.
en: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.

dag: Ka o yɛli Gɛhaazi, Yɛlim o, Nyama, a niŋ wahala pam sɔŋ ti; ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni ti niŋ ti a? A bɔri ni ti yɛli naa bee sapashin kpɛm yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti a? Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛli, Mmaŋmaŋ niriba ni ka m be maa.
en: Elisha told his servant, Now say to her, Look, you have done your best to take care of us. What can we do for you? Do you want us to speak to the king for you, or to the captain of the army? She answered, I am fine living here among my own people.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn saɣim Judanim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara pam la.
en: This is how I will destroy the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

dag: M pun yɛl a, Chɛ ka m bia maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma, ka a zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka o chaŋ, dinzuɣu n ni ku a bidib kpɛma.
en: And I am telling you to let my son go and worship me. If you refuse to let Israel go, then I will kill your firstborn son.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ na kul tumdila alahichi pahira. Bɛ zaŋ kuriti mali binnana, ka baŋsimnim dooi anzinfa mali buɣa, ka di zaa nyɛ machɛl ni mali shɛli, ka bɛ yɛri niriba, Malimiya buɣa ŋɔ. Ka ninsalinim jɛmdi naɣibihi.
en: They still keep on sinning by making metal images to worship—idols of silver, designed by human minds, made by human hands. And then they say, Offer sacrifices to them! How can anyone kiss those idols—idols in the shape of bulls!.

dag: O daa lan yih o yabipaɣ Maaka napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me Ashɛra binnan shɛli din chihiri zal la zuɣu. Ka Asa daa ŋme n kab o binnani maa luhi n-zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni.
en: He removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother, because she had made an obscene idol of the fertility goddess Asherah. Asa cut down the idol and burned it in Kidron Valley.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, n ku deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, n ni chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa hal ni o nyɛvili tariga n dabili Dauda ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pii so ka o doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: But I wont take the whole kingdom from his hand. I will keep him as ruler throughout his lifetime on account of my servant David, who did keep my commands and my laws.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala Yaakubu zuliya ni, ka o ku lan di shɛhira bee n-garigi yɛtɔɣ shɛli bee n-zaŋ pina na ti ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: The Lord will remove them from Judahs family. They might bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful—but it will not help.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa tir o ba min o yiŋnim zaa ni o biɛyanim maa bindira n-saɣisiri bɛ ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli tariga.
en: Joseph provided food for his father, his brothers, and all the rest of his father's family, including the very youngest.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma ni di n-tiɣi ka nyu, amaa ka kum ni kɔnyuri mali yinima. Bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli, amaa ka yinim di vi.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: My servants will eat, but you evil people will be hungry. My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. My servants will be happy, but you will suffer shame.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala o ni lo shɛm bee di pun bela o suhu ni, amaa o lola nia ni o saɣim ka kpihim zuliya pam birili.
en: But Assyria does not understand that I will use him. He does not think of himself as my tool. He only wants to destroy other people. He only plans to destroy many nations.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla din tuhi ninvuɣ so ŋun baŋ di gbinni sani, ka nyɛ din tuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim sani.
en: If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa bi tam Nuhu mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni la yɛla. Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛna, ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu.
en: God remembered Noah, all those alive, and all the animals with him in the ark. God sent a wind over the earth so that the waters receded.

dag: Ninsalinim yi yɛn po pɔri, bɛ pɔrila ŋun gari ba; ka naŋgbankpeeni kam puuni, pɔri n-nyɛ din ŋmaari li.
en: People always use the name of someone greater than themselves to make a promise with an oath. The oath proves that what they say is true, and there is no more arguing about it.

dag: Adam daa bol o paɣ maa yul la Awa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninsalinim zaa ma.
en: The man Adam named his wife Eve because she would become the mother of all who live.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika mini Naawuni yurilim ni Naawuni Shia Kasi dolintabitali kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami!.
en: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu. Timiya niriba lala tatabo jilima.
en: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, Ɛlihu ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda mabihi ni yino la n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, Isaka zuliya ni, Omri ŋun daa nyɛ Maikil bia la n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma.
en: for Judah—Eliab, one of Davids relatives; for Issachar—Omri, Michaels son.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o.
en: The traitor had given the crowd a signal: The man I kiss is the one you want. Arrest him.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. Nyin nyɛbiga ŋun bahibahi amaŋ be ko sunsuuni ka yɛra, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli. Mani n-daa gbi li.
en: Say that this is what the Sovereign Lord is telling the king of Egypt: I am your enemy, you monster crocodile, lying in the river. You say that the Nile is yours and that you made it.

dag: ka yɛli, Din kariya ni n niŋ lala n Naawuni sani. N ni tooi nyu niriba ŋɔ ʒim ŋɔ? Dama bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ zaŋ pa talima chaŋ ti tooi kom ŋɔ na. Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaɣisi li nyubu maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: David said, God, I cannot drink this water. It would be like drinking the blood of the men who risked their lives to get this water for me. That is why David refused to drink the water. The Three Heroes did many brave things like that.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa guui, ka bɛ kari dol o ti gbaag o ŋ-ŋmah o nubihilɔri min o napombihilɔri bahi.
en: The ruler of Bezek tried to escape, but the men of Judah chased him and caught him. When they caught him, they cut off his thumbs and big toes.

dag: Ka din kpalim leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni.
en: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons as a most holy portion from the LORDs food gifts.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ wain ti maŋli la, ka m Ba mi nyɛ di gula.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣ o mabia paɣa, o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, ka nya o mabia zaɣim, bɛ ku dɔɣi bia.
en: If a man marries his brothers wife, it is indecent. He has uncovered his brothers nakedness; the man and the woman will be childless.

dag: Ka Sool daa chaŋ Amalɛknim maa ya nti sɔɣi dɔni vinvamli ni.
en: Then Saul went to the city of Amalek and waited in the valley.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli;.
en: Always be full of joy.

dag: Ka di daa gar o pam bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chani gindi tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba.
en: He was appalled by their disbelief. Then Jesus traveled through the surrounding villages teaching.

dag: Naawuni n-nam zuɣusaa n-teei li pa. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Ŋuna n-ti ninsalinim zaa nyɛvili ni vuhim. Ka pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa yɛl o dabili.
en: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, Izraɛlnima, yi ŋmanila Itiɔpianima n sani? Pa mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na? Pa mani n-daa yihi Filistianim Kafitɔr na, ka daa yihi Aramnim Kiri na?.
en: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ni yɛli shɛm ka n wum maa, n ni niŋ ya lala.
en: Say to them, As I live, says the LORD, just as Ive heard you say, so Ill do to you.

dag: Mbaye, dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali, ka di kpee kani. Di nyɛla Yaakubu suhusaɣiŋgu saha, amaa bɛ ni tilig o di ni.
en: That day is awful, beyond words. A time of unspeakable pain for my people Jacob. But they will be delivered from it.

dag: Naawuni kul tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa sahakam, amaa ka ninsalinim bi baŋdi li.
en: But maybe God does explain what he does but speaks in ways that people dont understand.

dag: Amaa pu shɛŋa din be bɛ fɔntinsi maa tiŋgban ni, di bi simdi ka bɛ kɔhi dina, dama di nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli saha shɛlikam.
en: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, a kpani maa m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nachimba maa ni yino kana ti zaŋ li.
en: David replied, Here is your spear, Your Majesty. Let one of your men come over and get it.

dag: Ka o daa lan yihi Ashɛra binnani din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la na nti zaŋ li yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ tariga n-chaŋ Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti nyo li buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmɛnŋme m-burisi li n-va li ti bahi tiŋ maa gbala ni.
en: He removed the Asherah image from the LORDs temple, taking it to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem. There he burned it, ground it to dust, and threw the dust on the public graveyard.

dag: Miri ka a bɔri ni yuŋ zibi din nyɛ din ʒiri niriba chani la.
en: Dont be like those who wish darkness would come and hide them. They try to disappear into the night.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa nambɔɣu, ka o ku samli maa zaa o min o sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The king felt sorry for him, so he forgave him the debt and let him go.

dag: Ka yi yi pɔhi yi wain tihi wala, di nyaaŋa yin di lan chaŋ ti yihi di zaɣ yaha; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: Again, when you pick the grapes of your vineyard, dont pick them over twice. Let the leftovers go to the immigrants, the orphans, and the widows.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa saɣisi miri buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ha ka boli, Shadirak! Mɛshak! Abɛdnɛgo! Yinim Zallakudura Naa daba ŋɔ, yimiyana ka kpe na! Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa dii yi buɣim maa ni na.
en: Nebuchadnezzar went near the opening of the furnace of flaming fire and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out! Come here! Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came out of the fire.

dag: Yawɛ wum n ni suh o bɔri shɛli maa. Yawɛ ni deei n suhigu.
en: The LORD has listened to my request. The LORD accepts my prayer.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn chɛmi ka n yɛligu din yiri a noli ni na be kaman buɣim la, ka niriba maa mi be kaman dari la, ka buɣim maa di ba.
en: Therefore, the LORD God of heavenly forces proclaims: Because you have spoken this way, I will put my words in your mouth as a fire; it will consume the people, who are but kindling.

dag: Biɛri bɔhibu mini sanyoo nyɛla n dini, saha shɛli bɛ napɔna yi ti sarigi; dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha kanna yomyom.
en: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve — suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.

dag: Ka yi tintariga maa ni ŋmaligi nudirigu polo n-zaŋ ti paai Akirabim kunkuni n-zaŋ ti gari Zin, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Kadɛshibarinia nudirigu polo; ka zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hazarada n-gari hal ni Azimɔn.
en: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.

dag: O daa ku tiŋgbana pam niriba, ka ku nanim bɛn mali yaa.
en: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings.

dag: Amaa ti doliyala ti Duuma Yisa Masia biɛrisuŋ la soli, ka di bo so shɛli ti ni ni doli n-tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma.
en: But take up the weapons of the Lord Jesus Christ, and stop paying attention to your sinful nature and satisfying its desires.

dag: Ka n daa dihi n nuu di gbana zuɣu, ka zaŋ n dalinli dihi tabili li, ka chɛ ka shɛhiranim kana ka n ti zahim liɣiri maa sania zuɣu.
en: I signed the deed, sealed it, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Ɛgilɔn gari chaŋ Hiburɔn ti liri ba.
en: Joshua along with all Israel went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

dag: Ka yi mi ti lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Ka yi yi yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, o suhu sa ni yiɣisi bahi tinim Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu biɛɣuni.
en: And now you are doing the same thing. You are turning against the Lord . Will you refuse to follow the Lord ? If you dont stop what you are doing, he will be angry with everyone in Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali dabili, ka o nyɛla ŋun kɔri bee ŋun guli biŋkɔbiri ka ti kuna, ka a dii yɛl o, Kamina ti ʒini di bindirigu.
en: Would any of you say to your servant, who had just come in from the field after plowing or tending sheep, Come! Sit down for dinner?.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛm saɣisigu, di ŋmanila salima nintua bee salima yɛri.
en: Wise correction to an ear that listens is like a gold earring or jewelry of fine gold.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Dindina zaŋmiya wuna la bahi, ka zaŋya yi suhuri niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni.
en: Joshua said, But you still have some idols, like those the other nations worship. Get rid of your idols! You must decide once and for all that you really want to obey the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣ yoya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee tɔɣisi a yɛtɔɣ yoya.
en: You have said terrible things about me, says the Lord . But you ask, What have we said about you.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi n-gbaai bɛ naba biɛhibu hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni dol duri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili. Bɛn daa biɛhiri bɛ naba maa ni daa kul yi n-naai, ka bɛ lan yo dunoli maa yaha.
en: The men from Jericho chased after them in the direction of the Jordan up to the fords. As soon as those chasing them went out, the gate was shut behind them.

dag: Daba ni lihiri ŋun su ba ninni shɛm la, dab paɣa ni lihiri ŋun su o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ti kul lihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ninni, hal ni o ti zo ti nambɔɣu.
en: As a servant depends on his master, as a maid depends on her mistress, so we will keep looking to you, O Lord our God, until you have mercy on us.

dag: M bi bɔri ni n ti nyan ya la biɛla ka gari; ti Duuma yi saɣi n niŋdi tahima ni n ni ti yuui yi sani.
en: I want to see you more than just briefly in passing; I hope to spend quite a long time with you, if the Lord allows.

dag: Amaa Amnɔn daa mal o zo so ka o yuli booni Jɔnadab, o daa nyɛla Dauda mabia Shamma dapala, ka daa mali yɛm pam.
en: But he had a friend, a very shrewd man named Jonadab, the son of David's brother Shammah.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N ni zaŋ n ninkurilim yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka Naawuni ni be a sani! Di simdi ka a zani niriba maa zaani Naawuni sani, ka zaŋdi bɛ naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣa n-sɔŋd o tooni.
en: Now listen to me and let me give you some advice. And may God be with you! Your role should be to represent the people before God. You should bring their disputes before God yourself.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma, hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm yuun pihinahi puuni la zaa yoli.
en: That is where your ancestors challenged and tested me, though they had seen my work for forty years. .

dag: Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun bi be lala, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim nyɛ o ni su zuliya shɛba. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: The God of Jacob is not like them; he is the one who made everything, and he has chosen Israel to be his very own people. The Lord Almighty is his name.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Anabi Ilaija m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, O ŋmanila anab kura la ni yino.
en: Others were saying, He is Elijah. Still others were saying, He is a prophet like one of the ancient prophets.

dag: ni pipihi ni firila kpihindisi ni taha ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu lahi ni salima alali buɣim moori taha ni salima chɛulɔnim din gbib Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni Luɣ Kasi shee la pununim mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sambani polo pununim la.
en: the cups, wick trimmers, bowls, ladles, and censers of pure gold; and the gold sockets for the doors to the most holy place and for the doors to the main hall.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ti ma vuhim luɣilikam, ka n ka dima bee zuɣubiɛɣu yɛl shɛli.
en: But now the Lord my God has given me peace along all the borders of my country. I have no enemies, and my people are in no danger.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa yɛl o namɔɣilisi kpɛma Ashpɛnaz ni o lihim Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛ ni gbahina maa ni m-pii nabihi mini kpambaliba;.
en: Nebuchadnezzar instructed his highest official Ashpenaz to choose royal descendants and members of the ruling class from the Israelites.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa di nam ʒin o ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka o nam maa daa ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Now Solomon was king. He sat on the throne of his father David and was in complete control of his kingdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛliya ka lala niŋ; dama Yawɛ daa lo Naa Dauda alikauli yɛli, N dabili Dauda nuu ka n ti yɛn zaŋ fa n niriba Izraɛlnim Filistianim mini bɛ dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi. .
en: Its time to act because the LORD has said about David: I will rescue my people Israel from the power of the Philistines and all their enemies through my servant David.

dag: Ka Abiata daa yina, nyama, ka Zadok gba mini Lɛvinim zaa daa kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na ti zaŋ li zali hal ka niriba maa zaa ti yi tiŋ maa ni na.
en: Zadok and Abiathar the priests were there along with several men from the tribe of Levi who were carrying the sacred chest. They set the chest down, and left it there until David and his followers had gone out of the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ti ku mali bia ŋun ni ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee. Bɛ ni ku o labi, ka wuntaŋ tulim kpe o wuntaŋ ni, ka maligim mi ti lu o zuɣu yuŋ.
en: So I, the Lord , promise that you will be killed and your body thrown out on the ground. The sun will beat down on it during the day, and the frost will settle on it at night. And none of your descendants will ever be king of Judah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gɔb, ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Saf ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni nir la.
en: After this there was a battle with the Philistines at Gob, during which Sibbecai from Hushah killed a giant named Saph.

dag: O miri ka o ti yi luɣ kasi shee la n-saɣim o Naawuni luɣ kasi shee maa, dama o Naawuni kpa shɛli din be kasi ka bɛ boori li bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la nyɛla din be o zuɣu ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ni o buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni dol o zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa ka o ti bɛ yaannim la bee bɛ ku dol li.
en: They were to be the test for Israel, to find out whether they would obey the LORDs commands, which he had made to their ancestors through Moses.

dag: Amaa alɔbo maa ni daa pun ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi.
en: A total of , people died from that sickness.

dag: Yin yɛlimiya ba ni di nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maligu. Dama o ni daa kuri Ijiptinima, o daa yaɣila tinim yiya gari, ka bi ku ti. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋ jɛm Naawuni.
en: you will answer, It is the sacrifice of Passover to honor the Lord , because he passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt. He killed the Egyptians, but spared us. The Israelites knelt down and worshiped.

dag: A yi niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nirilim, bɛ bi bɔhindi din tuhi niŋbu. Hal bɛ ni kul be wuntizɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zaa yoli, bɛ bi niŋdi din tuhi. Bɛ bi saɣi ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi.
en: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord .

dag: Yi ni daa kpalim be Kadɛshi n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ la nyaaŋa.
en: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbin la mini buɣa jɛmbu duri din be Samaria tinsi ni shɛm la shiri ni ti niŋ pali.
en: The words that he spoke at the Lord 's command against the altar in Bethel and against all the places of worship in the towns of Samaria will surely come true.

dag: dama nyuli zabbu chɛ ka yidan suhu yiɣisir pam, ka o yi yɛn bɔhi biɛri, o ku lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: Jealousy makes a man rage; hell show no mercy on his day of revenge.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa piligi yihiri waazu n-yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina .
en: From that time Jesus began to announce, Change your hearts and lives! Here comes the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia.
en: He asked them, And what about you? Who do you say that I am? Peter answered, You are the Christ.

dag: n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani Kiriatijiarim Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ boli nimaani yuli, Mahanɛdan hal ni zuŋɔ. Di mi bela Kiriatijiarim wulinluhili polo.
en: They went up and camped west of Kiriath Jearim in Judah. That is why the place is still called Camp of Dan.

dag: Bɛ yi ti biɛra, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba, ka tib bɛ dɔriti zaa.
en: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ata maa ni ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Izraɛl naa sani.
en: During the third year King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to visit King Ahab of Israel.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ siɣi dapulli ŋɔ zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti nya ka niŋ o yɛda. Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi shɛb tabili dapula m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: If he is the Messiah, the king of Israel, let him come down from the cross! Then we will see and believe. The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim Aduna bidibisi mini Lɛvi bidibisi na.
en: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:.

dag: Dama a noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhiri a tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli ka a yula yɛŋkiŋkabina yɛtɔɣa.
en: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka n ka yi sanna ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni yubu puuni, ka nya suhukpaŋsibo m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim be zuɣu.
en: And so I will come to you full of joy, if it is God's will, and enjoy a refreshing visit with you.

dag: ni di chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣa maa zaa ku gaŋdi taba, amaa ka di baɣa lee ni bela tab ni.
en: And so there is no division in the body, but all its different parts have the same concern for one another.

dag: Dama ti Duuma kul ku zaɣisiri nir sahakam.
en: The Lord won't always reject us!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai sokam ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka niriba mali ba ansarisi ka yimaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: Because of this the Lord has been angry with Judah and Jerusalem, and what he has done to them has shocked and frightened everyone. You know this very well.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu ka kpabi yim zuɣu, ka di wɔɣilim ti nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: It is to be square and folded double, inches long and inches wide.

dag: N ni zaŋ alibarika shɛli mini noli yɛlibu shɛli zali yi tooni ŋɔ yi ti niŋdi ya, ka yi teeri di yɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn kari ya tahi zuliya shɛba zaa ni ŋɔ sani.
en: I have now given you a choice between a blessing and a curse. When all these things have happened to you, and you are living among the nations where the Lord your God has scattered you, you will remember the choice I gave you.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n yaa; ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiliginsim.
en: The Lord is my strength and my reason for singing. He saved me!.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ni tɔŋda, ka bɛ bihi ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: They will live a good life, and their descendants will possess the land.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun pa a niriba Izraɛlnim ni yino yi ti yi katiŋ na a yuli zuɣu.
en: People from other places will hear about your greatness and your power. They will come from far away to pray at this Temple.

dag: Yawɛ, a tuma galisiya pam! A tɛha zilim pam!.
en: How great are your actions, Lord ! How deep are your thoughts!.

dag: Alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa yɛn puh o bia daamiliya lɔbu chuɣu.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding party for his son.

dag: N Duuma, dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka niriba be, din nim zaa zuɣu ka n nyɛvili be. Tim ma alaafee, ka n lan be!.
en: The LORD Most High is the one who gives life to every heart, who gives life to the spirit!.

dag: Ka kɔŋlan so daa ka Yisa sanna nti damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, A yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: A man suffering from a dreaded skin disease came to Jesus, knelt down, and begged him for help. If you want to, he said, you can make me clean.

dag: Aduna mini Musa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛba saha shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli zuɣu la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the family history of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord talked to Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti bo so shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan nabi. Di yi pa lala ti mini ti dimnim yi ti yɛn tuhi, bɛ ni pahi ti dimnim maa zuɣu tuhi ti ka nya soli zo n-yi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: In case of war they might join our enemies in order to fight against us, and might escape from the country. We must find some way to keep them from becoming even more numerous.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri teeku duli, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: Right then, Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side of the lake while he dismissed the crowds.

dag: bɛn chɛ yɛlimaŋli soli bahi, ka yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu la pun niŋ la. Lala ka bɛ niŋdi n-gbarigiri ninvuɣ shɛb yɛda.
en: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili puuni ka a daa no tiŋgbani. A sujee puuni ka a daa du n-tam zuliya shɛb zuɣu no ba.
en: In fury, you stride the earth; in anger you tread the nations.

dag: Laɣimmi niriba zaa n-gil amaŋa, ka ʒini a nam ʒiishee alizanda ni su ba.
en: Let the assembled peoples surround you. Rule them from on high!.

dag: Ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-lu naa sizuura, ka naa bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Bathsheba bowed low before the king, and he asked, What do you want.

dag: ka ŋun pa o zuɣu mini.
en: The second one married his brother's widow, and he also died without having any children.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛl o, Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka n yɛl a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: But Ahab answered, How many times do I have to tell you? Tell me the truth. What does the Lord say.

dag: N yiɣisirila yuntisuɣu m-paɣir a, a wuntia zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: In the middle of the night I wake up to praise you for your righteous judgments.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔdɛkai daa lan lab ti ʒi nayili samban dunol maa ni yaha; ka Haman mi daa zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu tabil o nina ŋ-ŋmaligi kuli yomyom ni suhugarigu.
en: Mordecai then went back to the palace entrance while Haman hurried home, covering his face in embarrassment.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Judah were .

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn puh o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni tim a suhudoo, ka ti a malibu suhudoo, ka chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni su shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: Say this to him: Peace to you, your household, and all that is yours!.

dag: Dama bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛliya, Ti mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi galisiya pam. Di simdi ni ti nya chi din ni chɛ ka ti di n-tiligi.
en: and said, We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Everyone ate until they were full. When they finished eating, the followers filled twelve baskets with the pieces of food that were not eaten.

dag: Kɔra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asir mini Ɛlikana ni Abiasaf. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ niriba.
en: The Korahites: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.

dag: A ba daalibarika mali kpiɔŋ gari zoya din doya sahakam ŋɔ mini kuŋkuna din kul beni sahakam ŋɔ daalibarika. Naawuni chɛ ka o daalibarika ŋɔ zaa be Yisifu ŋun min o mabihi daa woligi ŋɔ zuɣu ni, ka be o gbɛɣu zuɣu.
en: Blessings of grain and flowers, Blessings of ancient mountains, Delightful things from everlasting hills. May these blessings rest on the head of Joseph, On the brow of the one set apart from his brothers.

dag: nti yɛl o, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kali ti ni su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi n-nya ka ti zaa beni.
en: and said, Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be a niriba bɛn nyɛ a ni pii shɛba, ka bɛ galisi pam ka ka kalinli ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.

dag: Mbusim be ti zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ti buɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nuu ni bahi? Buɣ shɛŋa din daa zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam luhi Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku ba mɔɣu ni la m-bala.
en: We're in big trouble! Who can save us from these powerful gods? They're the same gods who made all those horrible things happen to the Egyptians in the desert.

dag: dama n ni ti a jilima pam. Ka a yi yɛli ni n niŋm shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li; kul kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu ti ma. .
en: I will pay you very much, and I will do whatever you ask. Come and curse these people for me.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili m-pali n ni, ka n ku lan tooi gbib li yaha. Kpaam li bahi bihi zuɣu sol ni, ka lan kpaai li bahi nachimba laɣiŋgu shee gba. Bɛ ni ti gbaai doo min o paɣa chaŋ, ka gbahi ninkura mini bɛn kurigi zaa chaŋ.
en: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.

dag: N yur a zaligunim maa pam. Di nyɛla n saawaranima.
en: Yes, your laws are my joy— they are my most trusted advisors!.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mal li ka di be kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.

dag: nti nya o yɛl o, Sokam kul lihiri bɔrila a shee.
en: and when they found him, they said, Everyone is looking for you.

dag: Naawuni, a yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli! Ninsalinim zaa ni tooi sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim.
en: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.

dag: Saŋmariga maa yuli daa boonila Yabiga. Ka kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei kɔtɔɣu yabiga maa zuɣu, ka niriba pam daa nyu li ka kpi, kom maa ni daa to maa zuɣu.
en: A third of the water turned bitter, and many people died from drinking the water, because it had turned bitter.

dag: Nyini n-zali zoya a kpiɔŋ puuni. A mali yiko pam.
en: You set the mountains in place by your strength, showing your mighty power.

dag: Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka be Tiriza.
en: As soon as Baasha learned this, he stopped building Ramah and stayed in Tirzah.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛ zaa.
en: He said, This poor widow gave only two small coins. But the truth is, she gave more than all those rich people.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-chaŋ Jɛziriil, dama nimaani ka Jɔram daa biɛri be. Ka Juda Naa Ahazia daa kana ni o ti kaag o.
en: Then Jehu got on a chariot and drove to Jezreel because Joram was resting there. Judahs King Ahaziah had also come to visit Joram.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed.

dag: Binzusa maa yi be yi sani, yi ni lihiri li ka teeri Yawɛ zaligunim yɛla ka dol li, ka ku doli yi suhuyubu ni yi nini ni tiɣi shɛli.
en: This will be your fringe. You will see it and remember all the LORDs commands and do them. Then you wont go exploring the lusts of your own heart or your eyes.

dag: Ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tusaanii Yalim Vinvamli ni.
en: Abishai, Zeruiahs son, struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Salt Valley.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, man mini m mabihi ni n tumtumdiba zaŋla ti liɣiri mini chi m-paŋ ba. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chɛ ti ni bɔri ni bɛ labisi nyɔri shɛli n-yo ti la ti ba.
