en: I have let the people borrow money and grain from me, and so have my companions and those who work for me. Now let's give up all our claims to repayment.

dag: O chanimi kahind o nimbihi ka mal o napɔna vuri tiŋa, ka mal o nubihi tirita.
en: They wink and make gestures to deceive you.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa yo bɛn daa yoli kana maa tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: When the workers arrived, the ones who had been hired at five in the afternoon were given a full day's pay.

dag: Paɣ ŋuni pul ni ka maasim kpikpikpi lee yina? Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi ko shɛli din kilim yiri alizanda ni na ŋɔ?.
en: From whose belly does ice come; who gave birth to heavens frost?.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa kuhi pam suhi Naawuni yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz begged the Lord for help.

dag: Doo yi goli biŋkɔbigu, bɛn kum o, ka ku biŋkɔbigu maa gba.
en: If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he and the animal shall be put to death.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa chaŋ Damaskus ni o ti nya Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza, ka o daa nya bimbin shɛli Damaskus maa. Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa zaŋ bimbini maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni di yɛlli kam zaa n-tim ti ti maligumaana Yuria.
en: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet up with Assyrias King Tiglath-pileser. King Ahaz noticed the altar that was in Damascus, and he sent the altars plan and details for its construction to the priest Uriah.

dag: Amaa yinim ni ti mali suhupiɛlli ka yili yila kaman Naawuni chuɣu puhibu dali yuŋ. Yi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn piɛbiri yuhi yiini yila chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim tampiŋ ŋɔ zoli zuɣu.
en: You will sing happy songs, like the nights when you begin a festival. You will be very happy walking to the Lord s mountain and listening to the flute on the way to worship the Rock of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi cheechinima, ka lan kahigi wuhi ni ti ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu ti mabihi maa sani shɛm la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Show your love to them, so that all the churches will be sure of it and know that we are right in boasting about you.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di miri kpe na, pirigim a namda maa, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee.
en: God said, Do not come any closer. Take off your sandals, because you are standing on holy ground.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o kɔrigi nahu maa, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ binʒim maa ti ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ li mihi gili Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: You must kill the young bull in front of the Lord . Then Aarons sons, the priests, will bring the blood to the altar that is near the entrance of the Meeting Tent. He will splash the blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Yawɛ mi ti tɛha, ka di nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.

dag: Kpammi bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ binyara bundaannim la jaande ni bɛ di mali karimbaani, ka mi di zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ buni din nyɛ din kul ku be sahakam ŋɔ ni, amaa ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ tahima niŋla Naawuni ŋun tiri ti binshɛɣukam ni ti mali maani ti bukaata ŋɔ ni.
en: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kpɛma tusaayopɔin mini tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim tuhili bɛn zaa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu kuli Babilɔn.
en: He also led away , soldiers and , skilled workers, all of them trained for battle.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tim o dabili Musa mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ o ni daa pii so la.
en: So the Lord sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, his chosen priest.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti zaŋ o tam bɛ tiŋ maa ni daa me n-tam zo shɛli zuɣu naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ ni bɛ daag o luhi zoli maa lɔŋni sa ka o kpi.
en: that they got up and threw him out of town. They dragged him to the edge of the cliff on which the town was built, because they wanted to throw him down from there.

dag: O yi ti paana yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli n-nya ba lala, bɛ ni nya alibarika.
en: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.

dag: Nimdi din shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi bi simdi ni bɛ ŋub li. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be kasi ni tooi ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi.
en: Flesh that touches any unclean thing must not be eaten; it must be burned with fire. Any clean person may eat the flesh.

dag: Di saha n dima ni ti nya li, ka vi ti gbaai ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhiri ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni la lee bela ya? N nini ni ti nya o lubu, ka bɛ ti no o sɔŋ kaman palli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: Then my enemy will see; shame will cover her who said to me: Where is the LORD your God? My eyes will see her ruin; now she will become something to be trampled, like mud in the streets.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Cham Shɛbina ŋun nyɛ nayili tumtumdiba zuɣulan la sani nti bɔh o.
en: The Sovereign Lord Almighty told me to go to Shebna, the manager of the royal household, and say to him.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu;.
en: That evening the disciples came to Jesus and said, This place is like a desert, and it's already late.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa yoli, bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ʒiri mabihi maa daa bi labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa ka naɣ ŋmarila ʒiri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Yet even after all this, disloyal sister Judah didnt return to me with all her heart but only insincerely, declares the LORD.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi fuɣ o gbaŋ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi to n-chib o kuriti gbaɣino ziɣinli ŋɔ?.
en: No one can pierce his skin. It is like armor!.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Naa Sool, A tum jɛrilim tuma. Dama a bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛli. Pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ naan chɛ ka a min a zuliya diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: That was stupid! Samuel said. You didn't obey the Lord your God. If you had obeyed him, someone from your family would always have been king of Israel.

dag: n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, pa nyini n-nyɛ alizanda Naawuni? Pa nyin n-nyɛ ŋun su zuliya kam zaa nam fukumsi? Kpiɔŋ mini yiko bela a nuu ni, ka so ku tooi mo a.
en: and prayed: You, Lord , are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa piligi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la. Amaa bɛ daa na bi sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa tampuɣili.
en: Although the people had not yet started to rebuild the Temple, they began on the first day of the seventh month to burn sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka Pita mini Jɔn yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni saha shɛli maa, ka o maani ba bara.
en: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka nir yi ni tooi kali bihigu, o ni ti tooi kal a zuliya gba.
en: I will make your people so many that they will be like the dust of the earth. If people could count all the particles of dust on earth, they could count your people.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, dama bɛ ta maligumaaniba tuma zaŋ tabil a ni daa lo maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la daɣiri.
en: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priests and the Levites!.

dag: N kul yɛla n noli vuhiri nyahigira, dama n suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: I honestly want to know everything you teach.

dag: So yi tahir a ʒiishee ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa yom, di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: If anyone wants to take you to court, make friends with them quickly. Try to do that before you get to the court. If you dont, they might hand you over to the judge. And the judge will hand you over to a guard, who will throw you into jail.

dag: Ka n lan chɛ ka tins ayi bee tins ata niriba chani tin yin ni ni bɛ ti nya kom nyu, ka bɛ yi chaŋ, bɛ ti bi nyari nyuri ka di saɣiri ba; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So the people from two or three cities staggered to another city to get water, but there was not enough water for everyone. Still you didnt come to me for help. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Dama n tɛhiya ni Naawuni zaŋ tinim tuumba ŋɔ zalila zaashe shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni, ka ti be kaman bɛ ni bahi noli ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb palɔni, ka leei malaikanim mini ninsalinim ni lihiri shɛb ninliha dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: I suppose that God has shown that we apostles are at the end of the line. We are like prisoners sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle in the world, both to angels and to humans.

dag: Di saha maa ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti bɔhi Pool, Yɛlim ma, a shiri nyɛla Rom tiŋbia? Ka Pool saɣi, Iin.
en: So the commander went to Paul and asked him, Tell me, are you a Roman citizen? Yes, answered Paul.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa asiba, zaŋ chani zaawuni ka m paɣa kpi. Dindali maa yi biɛɣu asiba ka n daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni zali ma shɛm maa.
en: One morning, I was talking with the people as usual, and by sunset my wife was dead. The next day I did what the Lord had told me.

dag: dama m bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛli; n kahigi Naawuni yɛlli kam wuhi ya.
en: For I have not held back from announcing to you the whole purpose of God.

dag: Ka Pɛntikɔst Chuɣu dali daa ti paai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim luɣ yini.
en: When the day of Pentecost came, all the believers were gathered together in one place.

dag: ni Bɛtipɛɔr ni Pisiga zolɔŋni ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt.
en: Beth Peor, the hills of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth.

dag: A mini Dɛdannim daa niŋdila wɔrinyaampara daabiligu.
en: Dedan provided good business and traded with you for saddle blankets and riding horses.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhir a ni a kul tim ma bini diba ayi kɔŋko, di nyaaŋa n ku lan sɔɣi mmaŋa a sani.
en: Only dont do two things to me, then I wont hide from your face.

dag: N yi tɛh a soya yɛla, ŋ-ŋmaligirimi dol a zaligunim maa.
en: Ive considered my ways and turned my feet back to your laws.

dag: Naawuni lo nia ni o zaŋ ashil shɛli din wuhir o daazichi min o jilima pam zaŋ chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim polo n-kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda. Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Masia be yi ni! Dina n-nyɛ yi tahima ni yi min o ni ti laɣim mali Naawuni jilima.
en: God wanted to make the glorious riches of this secret plan known among the Gentiles, which is Christ living in you, the hope of glory.

dag: Ka bi shɛb a ni yɛn dɔɣi ka bɛ doli bɛ nyaaŋa n-yɛn nyɛ a bihi. Bɛ biɛyanim maa yuya ka bɛ ti yɛn zaŋ nya bɛ tarili.
en: If you have any more sons, they will not be considered mine; the inheritance they get will come through Ephraim and Manasseh.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyini Masia, a daanabitali puuni wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: and said, Prophesy for us, Christ! Who hit you.

dag: O ku yihi tahima bee n-gbarigi, hal ka o ti wuhi zaligu soli ni nyɛ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tin shɛŋa din be katinsi nim ti ʒiya guhir o wuhibu.
en: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kpuɣi bihi maa o naba zuɣu, ka damdi n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph made his sons move away from Jacob's knees, and Joseph bowed down in front of him with his face to the ground.

dag: ka m bi zaŋ m piɛri kɔbiri situra ti o ka o pili ka paɣi ma o suhu ni.
en: if they havent blessed me fervently, or if they werent warmed by the wool from my sheep.

dag: Ka o daa bɔh o bipuɣinsi maa, Ka o be ya? Wula ka yi chɛ o zali samban ni? Bolimiy o na ka o ti di bindirigu.
en: Reuel said to his daughters, So where is he? Why did you leave this man? Invite him to eat a meal with us.

dag: Dilaila ni daa baŋ ni Samsin yipa yɛl o yɛlimaŋli zaa maa, ka o tim ti yɛli Filistianim nanim la, O yipa yɛl ma yɛlimaŋli zaa, dinzuɣu kamiyana pumpɔŋɔ. Ka Filistianim nanim maa daa bɔ liɣiri ka o sanna.
en: When Delilah realized that he had told her the truth, she sent a message to the Philistine kings and said, Come back one more time. He has told me the truth. Then they came and brought the money with them.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tiligi Izraɛlnim bɛ daalahichi zaa ni.
en: He will save his people Israel from all their sins.

dag: Niriba ayi bee niriba ata yi di shɛhira yin kumiy o. Miriya ka yi ku nira ninvuɣ yino kɔŋkɔ shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: But no one should be punished with death if only one witness says that person did that evil thing. But if two or three witnesses say it is true, the person must be killed.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ maligumaaniba, ka bɛ pakoya daa bi tooi kum bɛ zuɣu.
en: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, O nyɛla Masia la. Ka shɛb mi bɔhi, Di wuhiya ni Masia yɛn yila Galili na?.
en: Others said, He is the Messiah! Others even said, Can the Messiah come from Galilee?.

dag: ka filim ya, ka yi di vi din ka naabu, ka ku tam di yɛla.
en: I will make you an object of disgrace and enduring shame that no one will ever forget.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lura, nyin zaŋmi li labisi ti ti o, ka o zaŋ o chinchini maa pili gbihi ka paɣ a, ka di ti a laara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: You must give his security back to him every evening. Then he will have clothes to sleep in. He will bless you, and the Lord your God will accept this as living right and doing good.

dag: Ka bɛnkam wum pɔri ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka tɛhi ni bɛ mali alibarika ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Ti tiligiya, hal ti ni kul doli ti tipawumli soya ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ashaara lu ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zuɣu.
en: Make sure that there is no one here today who hears these solemn demands and yet convinces himself that all will be well with him, even if he stubbornly goes his own way. That would destroy all of you, good and evil alike.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Samsin zuɣu na pam, ka o zaŋ o nuzaŋa gbaai gbuɣinli maa n-darigi pirig o kaman nir ni darigiri pirigiri bubil shɛm la. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba bee o ma o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The LORDs spirit rushed over him, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as one might tear apart a young goat. But he didnt tell his father or mother what he had done.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka lan ka buchi shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Dama a yɛliya, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli, mani n-daa gbi li.
en: Egypt will be empty and destroyed. Then they will know that I am the Lord . God said, Why will I do these things? Because you said, This is my river. I made this river.

dag: N yaa nyɛ dini ka n yɛn guhira? Ka m bahigu lee nyɛ dini ka n ni di suɣilo?.
en: What strength do I have to keep on living? Why go on living when I have no hope?.

dag: Ka yi yi deei so chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ o ni bɔr shɛli paŋ o, yin labisim li ti o pɔi ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu.
en: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan.

dag: Ka Ɛli bɔh o, Wula ka o sa lee yɛl a? Di sɔɣ ma shɛli, a yi sɔɣ ma yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa puuni, Naawuni ŋun zaŋm o ni di yɛn niŋ ma shɛm maa niŋ a, hal ŋun niŋm a gari lala gba.
en: Eli asked, What did God say to you? Dont hide it from me. God will punish you if you hide anything from the message he spoke to you.

dag: Bom yɛm, bom tɛhi zilima. Mira ka a tam bee n-zaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n noli ni bahi.
en: Try to get wisdom and understanding. Dont forget my teaching or ignore what I say.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ nachimba, ka kum ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise that I will soon punish those people. Their young men will die in war. Their sons and daughters will die from hunger.

dag: Dama bia maa yi bi doli ma kuli, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi labi m ba sani? N zɔri ni n nini nya zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn paai m ba maa.
en: How can I face my father if Benjamin isn't with me? I couldn't bear to see my father in such sorrow.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbia mini ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ tinzun nira m-be bɛ sani zaa, zaligu yini maa ka a yɛn zali bɛ ni ŋun chirim.
en: This law is for everyone who makes a mistake and sins. The same law is for the people born in the family of Israel and for the foreigners living among you.

dag: Amaa ka farigudeera maa ʒe o ko ha, ka bi saɣi ni o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka naɣ kul malila o nuhi bur o nyɔɣu ka yɛra, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, zom man alahichilan ŋɔ nambɔɣu.
en: But the tax collector stood at a distance and would not even raise his face to heaven, but beat on his breast and said, God, have pity on me, a sinner.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnima, di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ; amaa n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ yi ni daa saɣim shɛli zuliya shɛb sani yi ni daa be la zuɣu.
en: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name.

dag: Di yuun pihinahi nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi Anabi Musa zuɣu mɔɣu ni zo shɛli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini m-be tutuɣu ni kaman buɣim la.
en: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses in the flame of a burning bush in the wilderness near Mount Sinai.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa lo tɔbu yi Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol.
en: So men from the tribe of Dan left the cities of Zorah and Eshtaol. They were ready for war.

dag: Ɛnɔsh daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni anu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Enosh lived years, and he died.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee m-pirig o kparibu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ bɔdua mil o shee ni.
en: So while they were eating, Jesus stood up and took off his robe. He got a towel and wrapped it around his waist.

dag: Ka Obadia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab, ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti nya Ilaija.
en: So Obadiah went to King Ahab and told him, and Ahab set off to meet Elijah.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Judas, puhigu mini kpariŋ mɔɣisibu ka a yɛn zaŋ yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa.
en: Jesus said to him, Judas, would you betray the Human Onewith a kiss.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu ni ka yɛli: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku ni daa jɛm so ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bihi ŋɔ ni! Naawuni ŋun gbib ma hal ti paai zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni!.
en: Then he blessed Joseph: May God, whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac served, bless these boys! May God, who has led me to this very day, bless them!.

dag: Yisa tuumba maa daa wuhiri shihira pam, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa niriba sani; ka yɛdaniŋdib la zaa daa laɣim be Sulemaana Kazala ni.
en: The apostles were given the power to do many miraculous signs and wonders among the people. They were together in Solomons Porch, and they all had the same purpose.

dag: Dindali maa n shiri ni ti ŋmaligi n nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa din nyɛ bɛ ni jɛmdi wuna la zuɣu.
en: And I will refuse to help them then, because they have done evil and worshiped other gods.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. O chɛ ka o neesim paai ti. Ŋahimiya tihi vari ka ti di chuɣu puhibu dari n-chaŋ ti gili sara maligu bimbini.
en: The LORD is God! He has shined a light on us! So lead the festival offering with ropes all the way to the horns of the altar.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti Naawuni ka pa ni Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti tampiŋ pahi ti Naawuni ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: There is no God except the Lord . There is no Rock except our God.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa bi bɔh a ni bɔ ka a leei niŋdi maa?.
en: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti yɛligi, ka chɛ ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ tintarisi yɛligi pahi, ka ti ti a jilima di zuɣu.
en: Lord , you have made our nation grow, enlarging its territory on every side; and this has brought you honor.

dag: N ni be a sani yuun pisi shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zaa, a piɛri min a buhi ni zaɣ yino gba na ʒi m-mali baɣili nti zaŋ li bahi, ka m mi na ʒi n-gbaag a piɛlaa kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: In all the years that I've worked for you, not one of your sheep or goats has had a miscarriage, and I've never eaten even one of your rams.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka nyɛ na titali ŋun gari wuna zaa.
en: For the Lord is a great God, the great King ruling over all the other gods.

dag: Zuliya kam wummi dimbɔŋɔ! Salinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Listen to this, all you nations. Pay attention, all you people on earth.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli zaɣisi wumbu.
en: But my people stubbornly refused to listen. They closed their minds.

dag: Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ saɣim yimaŋa.
en: I am the LORD your God. You must keep yourselves holy and be holy, because I am holy. You must not make yourselves unclean by any swarming creature that crawls on the ground.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Aduna zuɣu hal ka o ti bɔr ni o ku o, amaa ka n daa lan suhi Naawuni Aduna gba zuɣu di saha maa.
en: The Lord was very angry with Aaron—enough to destroy him! So I also prayed for Aaron at that time.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi zaa daa laɣimna. Bɛ tɔbbihi maa daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ galisim maa daa ti ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi gba daa galisi pam.
en: The kings and their armies went to Merom Pond, where they set up camp, and got ready to fight Israel. It seemed as though there were more soldiers and horses and chariots than there are grains of sand on a beach.

dag: M mabihi, di benya kaman bihi la yi tɛha ni, amaa benyami kaman bihi la zaŋ chaŋ din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu polo, ka lee bi dɔbba yi tɛha ni.
en: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.

dag: Shamga Anat bia saha la mini Jaɛl saha la, sochandiba bɛn daari doli taba daa bi lan chana, ka bɛn gɔri mi kpalim baɣisirila sokpansi.
en: In the time of Shamgar son of Anath, and now again in Jael's time, roads were too dangerous for caravans. Travelers had to take the back roads.

dag: Nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka mali yɛm, o so ninvuɣ kurigu ŋun nyɛ naa, ka nyɛ jɛrigu ŋun ku saɣi deei saɣisigu.
en: Someone may rise from poverty to become king of his country, or go from prison to the throne, but if in his old age he is too foolish to take advice, he is not as well off as a young man who is poor but intelligent.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yiɣisim lu m piɛgul ŋɔ zuɣu ku o, ka piɛri maa wurim, ka n lu bɛ zaɣ bihi gba zuɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, Sword, wake up and strike the shepherd, my friend! Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will run away. And I will punish those little ones.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim shɛb daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti la shihirili.
en: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law answered Jesus. They said, Teacher, we want to see you do a miracle as a sign from God.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kamina! Ka Pita daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni n-tam kom zuɣu chani Yisa sani;.
en: And Jesus said, Come. Then Peter got out of the boat and was walking on the water toward Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli Bɛri bia Hozia Naa Uzia mini Naa Jɔtam ni Naa Ahaz ni Naa Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ni Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛmana ni m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me.

dag: Amaa tinim n-ni paɣi Yawɛ pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: But we, the living, will give thanks to him now and forever. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kumiya bidibbihi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma: Bɛ paɣiba ŋmaligi n-gɔndila bɛ paɣ taba;.
en: Because they do this, God has given them over to shameful passions. Even the women pervert the natural use of their sex by unnatural acts.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma nambɔɣu zɔbu. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la kul guli ma.
en: You, Lord , never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi kaman kurimbuni ha binyɛra buɣisibu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Temple which King Solomon built was feet long and feet wide.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi Ibrahimma, Bɔzuɣu ka Zara la ka yɛli, N ni kurigi shɛm ŋɔ, n ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: The LORD said to Abraham, Why did Sarah laugh and say, Me give birth? At my age.

dag: ni di chɛ ka nyuli gbaai Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ mmaŋmaŋ zuliya la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni shɛb tiligi.
en: Perhaps I can make the people of my own race jealous, and so be able to save some of them.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le da kol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim.
en: Also, no one ever pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would break them. The wine would spill out, and the wineskins would be ruined.

dag: Ŋun zo n-tiligi maa kandina dazɔhigu dali zaawuni, Yawɛ nuu daa pala n zuɣu. Amaa ŋun zo n-tiligi maa ni daa paai n sanna asiba saha shɛli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka n zilinli lɛbigi, ka n noli yaai, ka n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: The LORDs power was with me in the evening before the survivor arrived, and just before he arrived in the morning, God opened my mouth. So my mouth was opened, and I was no longer speechless.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛla tin titali, amaa niriba bɛn be di ni daa bi yaɣ lala, dama bɛ daa na bi lab me yiya pam di ni.
en: Jerusalem was a large city, but not many people were living in it, and not many houses had been built yet.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ʒi karimbu.
en: And when the scroll is given to one who cant read, saying, Read this, that one will say, I cant read.

dag: Ka sabi li pa yi yiŋ dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n lo nia ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni, dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: No one knows the day or the time. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.

dag: Bɛ zaa kul tulimi kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu la, ka kuri bɛ nanima. Bɛ ku nanim zaa, ka bɛ so bi suhi ma ni n sɔŋ o.
en: In the heat of their anger they murdered their rulers. Their kings have been assassinated one after another, but no one prays to me for help.

dag: Dama ŋun saɣinda kana ni o ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ gbahi bɛ tɔbbihi, ka kabisi bɛ tɔburi, dama Yawɛ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun yɔri samli, o mi ni yo di zaa.
en: He certainly comes against her; the destroyer comes against Babylon. Her warriors are captured; their bows are broken. The LORD is an exacting God who repays in full.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim bɛn gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa nuu ni la yɛla.
en: The Israelites did not remember the Lord their God, who had saved them from all their enemies living around them.

dag: Ka yɛlli maa daa muɣisi Siria naa maa pam ka o bol o sapashinnim na nti bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee be Izraɛl naa polo.
en: Arams king was extremely upset about this. He called his officers and said to them, Tell me! Who among us is siding with Israels king.

dag: A yi kpahi ansarisimaana zuɣu ni, o ni leei ŋun je a. A yi kpahi ŋun mali yɛm zuɣu ni, o ni yur a.
en: Dont correct the impudent, or they will hate you; correct the wise, and they will love you.

dag: ka Jɔram nyɛ o bia, ka Ahazia nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔash nyɛ o bia.
en: Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛli taba, Ti bi niŋ din tuhi. Zuŋɔ nyɛla lahiba suŋ dabisili. Ka ti yi zaŋ li shini hal ni biɛɣu ti neei, tibidarigibo shɛli ni ti paai ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti yɛli nayilinima.
en: They said to each other, This isn't right. Today is a day to celebrate, and we haven't told anyone else what has happened. If we wait until morning, we will be punished. Let's go to the king's palace at once and tell the good news.

dag: Ka doo gbɛɣu zabiri min o tapaɣisi kɔbiri yi guhi, o malila gbɛ palo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: If the hair is lost at the sides of the forehead, the person has a receding hairline, but they are clean.

dag: Ka Pita daa bɔh o, Ananias, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka Sintani kpe a suhu ni ka a pii liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka ŋmari Naawuni Shia Kasi ʒiri?.
en: Peter said, Ananias, why did you let Satan fill your mind with such an idea? You kept part of the money for yourself and lied about it to the Holy Spirit!.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Tama, Cham a tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti o.
en: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: Please go to your brother Amnons house and prepare some food for him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu Ijiptinim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ku niriba Ijipti ka va bɛ daazichi chaŋ, ka daai di tanzahi luhi. Biɛrim pam ni ti be Itiɔpia.
en: A sword will come against Egypt! People in Ethiopia will shake with fear, when Egypt falls. The army of Babylon will take the Egyptians as prisoners. Egypts foundations will be torn down.

dag: Bɛ daa yila Midian chaŋ Paran ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba m-pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ mini ba zo n-kuli Ijipti nti chaŋ Ijipti naa Firawuna sani. Ka naa maa daa ti Hadad yili mini tiŋgbani ni bindirigu.
en: They left Midian and went to Paran, where some other men joined them. Then they traveled to Egypt and went to the king, who gave Hadad some land and a house and provided him with food.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ me bimbini tam Ɛbal Zol zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag zaɣ nɛɔŋ, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba maa zaa.
en: He captured Agag the Amalekite king alive, but Saul placed all the people under the ban, killing them with the sword.

dag: Ʒiɛman shɛŋa din gari la ni, o daa chɛ ka zuliya kam doli bɛ suhu yubu.
en: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.

dag: Bɛ no n-taai nandaamba niŋ taŋkpaɣu ni, ka daai bɛn diri wahala bahi, ka doo min o ba laɣindi mali dabipaɣ yino. Lala ka bɛ niŋ saɣim n yuli din be kasi la.
en: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa tin ya, yihimiya Yawɛ dini ni nyɛ shɛli zaa di puuni. Din nyɛ din viɛli gari di zaa ka yi yɛn zaŋ ti o.
en: You will present each gift offering to the LORD from all your gifts, from its best portions and its holiest parts.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o mabia paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o mabia maa paɣa.
en: You will not uncover the nakedness of your brothers wife; it is your brothers nakedness.

dag: Ka n yɛtɔɣa mini n waazu yihibu daa pala yɛm yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi ninsalinim baŋsim ni na, amaa di daa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi tuma min o yiko ni na.
en: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.

dag: ka Jɛza daŋ niriba nyɛ Jɛzanima; ka Shilɛm daŋ niriba nyɛ Shilɛmnima.
en: Jezer—the Jezerite family group; Shillem—the Shillemite family group.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu zalim zaligu maa, ka dih a nuu di gbɔŋ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka di tum tuma. Di mi nyɛla Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu, di bi taɣira.
en: So let Your Majesty issue this order and sign it, and it will be in force, a law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be changed.

dag: A yi bi fa bɛ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ so chani ni bɛ ti ku m-bahi, ka o chani ŋun yɛn ku o sani ka o naba sɔhira.
en: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa pun yɛli Ɛsta shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi saɣi wuh o ni nyɛ zuliya shɛli bee o niriba ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: Now, on the advice of Mordecai, Esther had kept it secret that she was Jewish.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n dana, jaande wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania wum n fabila ŋɔ, ka di lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ maa ni ka n ti kpi nimaani.
en: Now, my master and king, I beg you, dont send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or Ill die there.

dag: Ti zaa bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaayɔbu.
en: There were people on the ship.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Zɛbulɔn zuliya: Yinim Zɛbulɔn zuliya, Maliya suhupiɛlli yi yibu ni. Yinim Isaka zuliya, bɛnya yi suɣa puuni.
en: Moses said this about Zebulun: Zebulun, be happy when you go out. Issachar, be happy in your tents at home.

dag: ka o yɛl o, Dindina bɛn fiɣis a maa n-ni kana ka n naanyi wum a nol ni. Ka daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd yiŋa n-gul o.
en: the governor said, I will hear your case when your accusers arrive. Then he ordered that Paul be kept in custody in Herods palace.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli suhuyiɣisili soli n-nahindi bɛ ni su zuliya shɛba, ka kul bi chɛri ba putɔɣu nahiŋgu maa.
en: who were furious and never stopped abusing the people of other nations.

dag: A ni yɛn deei pin shɛŋa bɛ sani m-bɔŋɔ: Salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: These offerings are to be: gold, silver, and bronze;.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa tim ti boli Ɛliab bihi, Datan mini Abiram. Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ku kana.
en: Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, Eliabs sons. But they said, We wont come up!.

dag: O ni daa mali tɔrokɔnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: di daa malila dapaɣa, ka o zaŋ li kpɛhi firimnim ni.
en: This is how each stand was made: There were panels connected between the legs.

dag: Amaa bɛn so bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛ ni bi dɔɣi shɛb ka bɛ nini nya ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma din tumdi dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: But better off than either are those who have never been born, who have never seen the injustice that goes on in this world.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋ yi Samaria chaŋ maa ni yino daa labi nti ʒini Bɛtɛl n-wuhiri ba Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: So an Israelite priest who had been deported from Samaria went and lived in Bethel, where he taught the people how to worship the Lord .

dag: A deeg o nam jaaŋgbee o nuu ni, ka daag o nam luhi.
en: Youve put an end to his splendor. Youve thrown his throne to the ground.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ti o ni daa nya malaika o yiŋ shɛm, ka o yɛl o ni o timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house, who said to him, Send someone to Joppa for a man whose full name is Simon Peter.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yaɣigari chuɣu puhibu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ, Di bi simdi ka tinzun nira di Yaɣigari chuɣu bindirigu maa.
en: The Lord told Moses and Aaron, These are the rules for Passover: No foreigner is allowed to eat the Passover meal.

dag: Ka niriba pam ni ti doli karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ kɔr biɛri soya, ka bɛ biɛhigu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalim yɛlimaŋli sol la.
en: Many people will follow them in the morally wrong things they do. And because of them, others will say bad things about the way of truth we follow.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered Job:.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb tinzun tiŋ ni maa ni ti yɛli ya, Ti ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ pɔra; bomiya palo pahi ti ka ti ʒini.
en: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city.

dag: Ka Shafan mi daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti naa ka yɛl o, A ni zal a kpambaliba maa ni bɛ tum tuun shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ be di tumbu ni.
en: Shaphan brought the book to King Josiah. Shaphan reported to the king, Your servants are doing everything you told them to do.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan bɔri ni o zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa ka daa zaŋ li ŋmaligi tahi la Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la yiŋa.
en: He decided not to take it there. Instead, he turned off the road and took it to the home of Obed Edom, who was from Gath.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka gɔhi bili m puu ni, ka pa ni alikama, ka chɛ ka yihim bili ka pa ni chi. Ayuba yɛtɔɣa tariga m-bala.
en: If I ever did any of these bad things, let thorns and weeds grow in my fields instead of wheat and barley! Jobs words are finished.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu, ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani.
en: The next time Jesus went into the synagogue, a man with a paralyzed hand was there.

dag: Bɛn ka cheechi ni saria karibu yɛla bi kpa ma. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni kari ba saria. Amaa bɛn be yi cheechi ni n-nyɛ yi ni kariti shɛb saria. Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun be yi ni bahi.
en: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti boli niriba na ti yɛli ba, Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni:.
en: Jesus called the crowd together and said, Pay attention and try to understand what I mean.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka doo maa bo piɛlaa ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti mali taali sanyoo sara.
en: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa malila bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbila bɛn zaa daa labina maa mini bɛ maligumaanitaba ni bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ nabihi naani.
en: including strong leaders.

dag: Nyin ŋun gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-daa yaag a noli yɛl li, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You have kept the promise you made to my father David; today every word has been fulfilled.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn bidibisi daa nyɛ: Sɛrɛd mini Ɛlɔn ni Jaaliil.
en: Zebuluns sons were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa kul niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Bɛ ni daa tiri bɛ suɣa ʒiini bɛ tuutanim gbini shɛm, lala ka sokam min o malibu daa doli chani kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So the people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded Moses. They camped, each under his own banner, and they marched, each with his own clan.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla nyin Yawɛ ni ti ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni atam din daŋ niŋbu na ti ti a. Ka a zaŋ li zali tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka kurim tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Now, Lord , I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord 's altar and bow down to worship him.

dag: O saa nyaɣisibu neesim neeri dunia ŋɔ ni; ka dunianim nyari li ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.

dag: Di saha maa ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Yim ya ŋɔ, dama Naa Hɛrɔd lɔri nia ni o ku a.
en: At that time, some Pharisees approached Jesus and said, Go! Get away from here, because Herod wants to kill you.

dag: Ka dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi maa, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini na ti mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O di ti niŋ kpam bee firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: If you cannot afford two doves or two pigeons, you shall bring two pounds of flour as a sin offering. You shall not put any olive oil or any incense on it, because it is a sin offering, not a grain offering.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa suhi Naawuni shɛm ni anab shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yuli tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa la zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Manassehs deeds, including his prayer to God and what the seers told him in the name of the LORD, Israels God, are found in the records of Israels kings.

dag: Ti Duuma ni ti Ziɔn paɣiba zuɣutalisi ni dansi ka di niŋ yukaɣima. Yawɛ ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ zaɣim.
en: The Lord will put sores on the heads of those women in Zion. The Lord will make their heads bald.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee biɛhindi n yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ?.
en: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Shɛmaria ni Zaham.
en: They had three sons, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya kɔŋko ka a ku kali, a mi di sab bɛ yuya pahi Izraɛlnim ni.
en: You must not enlist the tribe of Levi, nor should you take their census along with the Israelites.

dag: Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm; ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛli, dama ti bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: Tell us what we should say to him; we cant present our case due to darkness.

dag: A ni nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa zaa, n ni zaŋ li ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam.
en: because all the land that you see I give you and your descendants forever.

dag: Yi yi di fo yi noya, di naan leei yi baŋsim.
en: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o daa pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianima.
en: When Joab saw that the battle would be fought on two fronts, he chose some of Israels finest warriors and deployed them to meet the Arameans.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Din yɛn niŋ ma, dina n-yɛn niŋ jɛra; ka bɔzuɣu ka di lee simdi ni m mali yɛm pam? Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: So I thought to myself, What happens to the fool will also happen to me. So why have I been so very wise? I said to myself, This too is pointless.

dag: Sulemaana daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zahim nɛma maa m-baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm; dama di daa zooya pam. Bɛ daa bi baŋ daanya maa tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Due to the very large number of objects, Solomon didnt even try to weigh the bronze.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Shallum ŋun daa di nam zan o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni gbaai so kpe n-zaŋ o chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku lan labi kpe na yaha.
en: This is what the Lord says about Jehoahaz son of Josiah, who became king of Judah after his father Josiah died: Jehoahaz has gone away from Jerusalem. He will never return.

dag: Ŋunkam ka dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tɛhijihilana ni zoma, ka lan nyɛla ŋun tam ni o daalahichi pun kpihim.
en: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri din viɛla ni nimmoo ni nya jilima, amaa zaɣ biɛɣu chanila ŋun bɔri li sani.
en: Those who look for good find favor, but those who seek evil—it will come to them.

dag: ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: They asked him, Are you the one we have been expecting, or should we wait for someone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan bol li Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Ninvuɣ kubo Vinvamli. Dama bɛ ni ti sɔɣi ba Tɔfɛt hal ka palo ti lan kani.
en: And so, the time will come when it will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley, but Slaughter Valley. They will bury people there because there will be nowhere else to bury them.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daa ka taɣinamsi, di daa kul bela vau, ka zibisim limsi bɔɣ zilinli, ka Naawuni shia daa be kom zuɣusaa ginda.
en: the earth was without life and not yet useful for anything. Deep waters covered the earth, and darkness covered the water. Gods Spirit was moving like a storm over the surface of the water.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yi salima bimbin shɛli din do Naawuni tooni la yila anahi ni na.
en: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice coming from the four corners of the gold altar standing before God.

dag: Yurilim mini ʒiɛyimtali n-nyɛ din gbibi naa, ka wuntitali mi nyɛ din chɛ ka o nam ʒiɛya.
en: A king who is loyal and true will keep his power. Loyalty will keep his kingdom strong.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni n nyɛla a dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun su a gbibbu fukumsi, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ dɔɣim maa puuni nira ka miri dɔɣim maa gari ma gba beni.
en: Now, although its certainly true that Im a redeemer, theres a redeemer who is a closer relative than I am.

dag: Ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti ku tooi labi. Ti tizo ŋɔ yi ku dol ti chaŋ, dindina ti ku chaŋ; dama ti tizo maa yi ka ti sani, doo maa nini ku nya ti.
en: But we said, We cant go down. We will go down only if our youngest brother is with us. We wont be able to gain an audience with the man without our youngest brother with us.

dag: Juda zuliya n-daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta daŋ yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli gbaai chandi. Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: The three divisions from Judahs camp went first. They traveled under their flag. The first group was the tribe of Judah. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the commander of that group.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, N daalibarika saɣ a, dama n yaa niŋdi dɛde chɔɣinsi ni. Ka n kul ni nyuri bara m-pahiri ni suhupiɛlli n chɔɣinsi zuɣu ka di chɛ ka Masia yiko tooi be n ni.
en: But his answer was: My grace is all you need, for my power is greatest when you are weak. I am most happy, then, to be proud of my weaknesses, in order to feel the protection of Christ's power over me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni yaai n noli ŋahi ŋaha, ka yɛli binshɛŋa din sɔɣi tum dunia piligu ni ha la yɛla.
en: This was to make clear the full meaning of what the prophet said: I will speak using stories; I will tell things that have been secrets since the world was made. Psalm :.

dag: A nini pɔbbu biɛla, gom gbihibu biɛla, zali nuhi ʒia vuhi biɛla.
en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the arms to lie down.

dag: O teeg o nambɔzɔbo yɛla, ka sɔŋ o dabili Izraɛl.
en: He has come to the aid of his servant Israel, remembering his mercy.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔram daa lab kuli Jɛziriil ni o ti tibi dan shɛli Sirianim ni daa ti o Rama saha shɛl o mini Siria Naa Hazaɛl ni daa tuhiri tab la. Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa chaŋ Jɛziriil ni o ti kaai Ɛhab bia Jɔram, o ni daa biɛri la zuɣu.
en: so he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. Ahaziah went there to visit him.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka vi mali ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu! Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yɛndan shiri ka yi ni ŋun ni tooi kari yi mabihili puuni yɛla saria?.
en: I say this to shame you. Surely there is someone in your group wise enough to judge a complaint between two believers.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli, ka gbilisiya tibili wum fabila shɛŋa din yɛn yi n noli ni na.
en: and listen to my argument.

dag: Amaa n ti ku yihi n suhu o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n suhu Sool ŋun daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: But I will never stop loving him. I will continue to be loyal to him. I took away my love and kindness from Saul. I pushed Saul away when I turned to you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Zanimi piɛgul zaani n-gul piɛ shɛb bɛ ni yɛn ku ŋɔ.
en: This is what the LORD my God says: Shepherd the flock intended for slaughter.

dag: Chɛ ka n jɛma tiɣ a nini, dama m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: May my words be pleasing to him. The Lord is the one who makes me happy.

dag: ka zaŋ firilanim la tamtam di zuɣu Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord .

dag: Ninkura yiɣisi dunɔdali gbini, ka nachimba chɛ bɛ biŋkumda ŋmɛbu.
en: The elders no longer sit at the gates of the city. The young men no longer make music.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be tintan zuɣu nya saria karibu. Dina n-nyɛ: Holɔn mini Jaaza ni Mɛfaat.
en: People on the high plain have been punished. Judgment has come to the towns of Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba daa ŋmaligi Abishai tooni guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yi Ammɔnnim maa tuhibu yɔɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The Ammonites saw that the Arameans were running away, so they ran away from Abishai and went back to their city. So Joab came back from the battle with the Ammonites and went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa daa bɔri ni o paɣ omaŋa ka bɔhi Yisa, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: But the legal expert wanted to prove that he was right, so he said to Jesus, And who is my neighbor.

dag: ka yɛli Dauda, A nyɛla wuntizɔra pam gari ma, dama a tum ma din viɛla, ka man zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo a samli.
en: He said, You are right, and I am wrong. You were good to me, even though I have been bad to you.

dag: Yɛnnim wuhibu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbiliga, di ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: The teachings of the wise are a fountain of life; they will help you escape when your life is in danger.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti nya ka ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali galisi pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha zaa kul nyɛla din bie sahakam.
en: The LORD saw that humanity had become thoroughly evil on the earth and that every idea their minds thought up was always completely evil.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Musa birigi kanna ni o ti nya li maa, ka Naawuni daa bol o tutuɣu maa ni, Musa! Musa! Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: When the Lord saw Moses coming near, he called him by name from the bush, and Moses answered, Here I am.

dag: Naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa filim Judanim maa, dama o daa bi gbibi Judanim viɛnyɛla, ka daa bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim.
en: The LORD was humiliating Judah on account of Israels King Ahaz, because he had exercised no restraint in Judah and had been utterly unfaithful to the LORD.

dag: Ka Nahɔr mam ŋun yuli daa booni Riuma la mi daa dɔɣi Tɛba mini Gaham ni Tahash ni Maaka.
en: Also Nahor had four other sons from his slave woman Reumah. The sons were Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

dag: Lan yɛlimiya, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira ŋɔ, fam ti. Yihim ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim ti na nti tiligi ti, ka ti paɣir a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka paɣir a ni jilima.
en: Say: Save us, God, our savior! Gather us! Deliver us from among the nations so we can give thanks to your holy name and rejoice in your praise.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha nti ku o. Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ ba?.
en: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What, then, will the owner of the vineyard do to the tenants? Jesus asked.

dag: N daa zaŋ ya bela tiŋgban nɛl ni yuun pihinahi, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba ni namda gba daa bi chahi.
en: For forty years the Lord led you through the desert, and your clothes and sandals never wore out.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Leeban zuɣu ka o bɔhi Leeban, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a? Ka alahichi dini ka n lee tum ka a kariti n naba na?.
en: Jacob became very angry and said to Laban: What have I done wrong? Have I committed some crime? Is that why you hunted me down?.

dag: A ni lo nia ni a niŋ bin suŋ shɛŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura galisiya pam. Ka a lan nyɛ ŋun lo nia ni a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo na ti sɔɣ a sani din viɛli pam sokam zaa ninni.
en: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli, zaɣ biɛɣu ku milig o yiŋa.
en: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.

dag: Ka o ni po pɔ shɛŋa bee o noli ni faag o ka o yɛli ni o niŋ shɛli, o yi ti kuli doo.
en: If an unmarried woman makes a vow, whether deliberately or carelessly, or promises to abstain from something, and then marries.

dag: Ŋunkam bi doli zaligu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who doesnt support the words of this Instruction by carrying them out. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ŋmaŋkɔhiriba la mi, Zaŋmiya yi binyara yi! Di zaŋya m Ba duu leei daa.
en: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.

dag: ka daa me binwɔɣila mini Ashɛra binnana zalizali zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: They set up sacred pillars and sacred poles on every high hill and beneath every green tree.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yiɣisi dol o paɣ maa chaŋ doo maa sani ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa tɔɣisi paɣ ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa la? Ka o yɛli, mani.
en: Manoah got up and followed his wife. He went to the man and asked, Are you the man who talked to my wife? Yes, he answered.

dag: M mi Ifriim, ka Izraɛlnim pala bɛn ni sɔɣi ka n ku nya ba. Dama Ifriimnima, pumpɔŋɔ yi tum yolimyolim. Ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: I know what Israel is like—she cannot hide from me. She has been unfaithful, and her people are unfit to worship me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi yiɣisiri bɛ sani chani mɔɣu ni ti suhiri Naawuni.
en: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray.

dag: Ka Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana ka lan nyɛ Musa deemba la daa wum Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ti Musa mini Izraɛlnima ni Yawɛ ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti shɛm la yɛla.
en: Jethro was the priest of Midian and the father-in-law of Moses. He heard what the Lord God had done for Moses and his people, after rescuing them from Egypt.

dag: Ka n nya malaika ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka o kuhiri pampam bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee simdi ni o tabigi bintabinda ŋɔ ka bɔɣi litaafi ŋɔ n-lihi di puuni.
en: And I saw a mighty angel, who announced in a loud voice, Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa.
en: Who is this great king? The triumphant Lord —he is the great king!.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa nya li maa ka di gar o pam, ka o tirisi mir li ha ni o lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka wum ti Duuma kukoli.
en: Enthralled by the sight, Moses approached to get a closer look and he heard the Lords voice.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiri shɛli yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina di lan pala alikauli lɔbu zuɣu; amaa Naawuni daa zaŋ li tila ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: For if God's gift depends on the Law, then it no longer depends on his promise. However, it was because of his promise that God gave that gift to Abraham.

dag: Tulaale mini tulaalɛzim nyɛla din paligiri suhu, amaa yɛlimuɣisirili nyɛla din kabiri suhu.
en: Perfume and incense make you feel good, and so does good advice from a friend.

dag: Ka yɛl o nyaandola maa mi, N-nyɛ a ma! Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka nyaandola maa daa zaŋ Yisa ma maa mali kul o yiŋa.
en: Then he said to the disciple, She is your mother. From that time the disciple took her to live in his home.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ so n ni doli ŋɔ ni chɛ ka a min o malaika doli chaŋ, ka ti a nasara ka a kpuɣi paɣa n yaannim ya ni n dɔɣiriba sanna ti ti m bia maa.
en: But my master said to me, I serve the Lord , and he will send his angel with you and help you. You will find a wife for my son among my people there.

dag: N daa mali nyɛvili saha shɛli n ni daa na ʒi zaligu yɛla la, amaa n ni daa ti baŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa, ka alahichi neei ka man lee kpi.
en: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔri maa daa zaŋ kawaan kara ayopɔin maa vali. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei n-nya ka di nyɛla zahindi.
en: The thin heads of grain ate the seven good heads of grain. Then Pharaoh woke up again and realized it was only a dream.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Balaam daa yiɣisi kul o ya, ka Balak gba ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: Then Balaam got ready and went back home, and Balak went on his way.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mini noon shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then Noah built an altar to honor the Lord . Noah took some of all the clean birds and some of all the clean animals and burned them on the altar as a gift to God.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni; bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti du tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋ lu tiŋ sa;.
en: Then the devil led Jesus to Jerusalem and put him on a high place at the edge of the Temple area. He said to him, If you are the Son of God, jump off!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi bi tum daɣiri tuma mini daɣiri ni ka shɛb suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi jɛmdi buɣa, ka mi bi doli yɔhiŋgu soli alikauli lɔbu ni.
en: Those who are pure in act and in thought, who do not worship idols or make false promises.

dag: Ka din nyɛ yɛlikpeeni nyɛla, baŋmiya ni anabitali yɛtɔɣa din be Naawuni Kundi ni pala ninsal ni ni tooi kahigi shɛli gbinni wuhi omaŋmaŋ baŋsim puuni;.
en: Most important, you must know that no prophecy of scripture represents the prophets own understanding of things.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋub o zaɣ kpiŋ maa ŋun paɣim o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam gba kpuɣi zaɣ kpiŋ maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: And if any of you eat any part of the animal, you must wash your clothes, but you will still be unclean until evening; any of you who carry the dead body must wash your clothes, but you will still be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli Firawuna, Pa mani n-wuhiri di gbinni maa, amaa Naawuni ni wuhi nyin Firawuna di gbinni ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: Your Majesty, Joseph answered, I can't do it myself, but God can give a good meaning to your dreams.

dag: Zaŋmi Aduna min o bidibisi ni binyɛra la ni bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la ni alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa ni piɛlah ayi ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu.
en: Take Aaron and his sons with him, the priestly clothing, the anointing oil, a bull for the purification offering, two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread.

dag: Bɛ bi dɔni pahi tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa lu tɔb ni kurimbuni ha ka zaŋ bɛ bidibbina mali chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu, bɛn takɔbiri daa kuɣi bɛ zuɣuri, ka nyɔtaɣirisi pa bɛ kɔba zuɣu la. Dama tɔbutuhiriba dabiɛm daa be nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They were not given a proper burial like the heroes of long ago, who were buried with their swords under their heads and with their shields over their bodies. These were the heroes who made their enemies panic.

dag: A mi saha shɛli bɛ ni dooni dɔɣiri bɛ bihi? Ka a mi saha shɛli bɛ bihi maa ni yirina?.
en: These animals lie down, they feel their birth pains, and their babies are born.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ma ni n zaŋ wuhi ya ka yi ti doli li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: These are the commands, the laws, and the rules that the Lord your God told me to teach you. Obey these laws in the land that you are entering to live in.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ taali galisi pahi; di chɛ ka bɛ nya gaafara a sani.
en: Pile guilt on top of their guilt! Dont let them come into your righteousness!.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim tahima; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha. Wula ka a be kaman sana n-nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee kaman yuŋ ni sabigi sochanda so ka o yɛn zani gbe luɣ shɛli maa?.
en: God, you are the hope of Israel! You save Israel in times of trouble. But now it seems like you are a stranger in the land, like a traveler who only stays one night.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sɔɣimi doya gu ma ni bɛ ku ma; amaa a zaligunim maa yɛla ka man kul tɛhira.
en: The wicked are waiting to kill me, but I will meditate on your laws.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi tiligira. N ni zaɣisi Ijipti mini Itiɔpia ni Siiba, ka tiligi ya.
en: Thats because I, the Lord , am your God. I, the Holy One of Israel, am your Savior. I gave Egypt to pay for you. I gave Ethiopia and Seba to make you mine.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam o jɛmbu duu puuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni! O tir o niriba yiko mini kpiɔŋ. Paɣimiya Naawuni!.
en: God, you are awesome in your Temple! The God of Israel is the one who gives strength and power to his people. Praise God!.

dag: Naawuni daa pun lo lahibal suŋ ŋɔ alikauli o daanabinim noya ni ka di yuui, hal ka di yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni.
en: God promised long ago through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures to give this Good News to his people.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ yoya ŋmanila takɔbi n-kuhiri niriba, amaa yɛndana yɛtɔɣa tahirila tibbuna.
en: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.

dag: N ni chɛ ka anabi ŋun be kaman nyini ŋɔ yi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni na m-be bɛ sani, ka n zaŋ n zilinli niŋ anab maa nol ni, ka o ti yɛri ba n ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa.
en: Ill raise up a prophet for them from among their fellow Israelites—one just like you. Ill put my words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɛ mabihi m-mali bɛmaŋ be kasi n-kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti mal li ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuhi naa ka o zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord , just as Hezekiah had commanded.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijiptinim mini Firawuna nuu ni maa.
en: and said, Praise the Lord , who saved you from the king and the people of Egypt! Praise the Lord , who saved his people from slavery!.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa m-miri ba ka pa ni saa, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: He made the rain become hail. Lightning struck throughout their land.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam, ka o lo tɔbu n-tuhi Siria naa hal ti gbah o tɔbbihi maa pam.
en: In his anger the king of Egypt will go to war against the king of Syria and capture his huge army.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Suhudoo ka n zaŋ tin ya; mmaŋmaŋ suhudoo mi ka n zaŋ tin ya maa. Di pala dunianim ni tiri suhudoo shɛm la ka n tin ya maa. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: I leave you peace. It is my own peace I give you. I give you peace in a different way than the world does. So dont be troubled. Dont be afraid.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛli, Di viɛla, amaa a yi da tiŋgbani maa Naomi sani, shee ka a zaŋ Rut ŋun nyɛ pakoli ka lan nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba pahi, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa.
en: Then Boaz said, On the day when you buy the field from Naomi, you also buy Ruth the Moabite, the wife of the dead man, in order to preserve the dead mans name for his inheritance.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ n tizɔbihi.
en: Jesus asked, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers.

dag: amaa paɣ ŋun yi mali zab wɔɣila, di pahir o la jilima. Dama Naawuni ti o zabiri maa la o zuɣu pilibu zuɣu.
en: but if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? This is because her long hair is given to her for a covering.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, mbusim be a zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, You are doomed! Doomed! You did all that evil, and then.

dag: O bela o biɛhigu shee ka lihiri zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: He is so high above us that he must look down to see the sky and the earth.

dag: Di chɛ ka n yɛla gbaag a dabiɛm, m bi yɛn nahim a pam.
en: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do.

dag: Dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin baŋmiya ni mani ka bɛ pun daŋ zaɣisi ka naanyi ti jɛn ya maa.
en: If the world hates you, remember that they hated me first.

dag: Asiria naa maa daa timla Rabishake, ka o yi Lakishi n-zaŋ tɔbbihi pam pa omaŋ zuɣu ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm. O daa zanila kɔso titali din be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ solɔɣu din labiri kpaluhi ʒiishee polo la.
en: He sent his commander with a large army to King Hezekiah in Jerusalem. The commander and his army left Lachish and went to Jerusalem. They stopped near the aqueduct by the Upper Pool, on the street that leads up to Laundrymans Field.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a mabia Sɔdom min o bipuɣinsi daa bi tum tuumbiɛri ka di paag a min a bipuɣinsi ni tum shɛm ŋɔ.
en: As surely as I am the living God, the Sovereign Lord says, your sister Sodom and her villages never did the evil that you and your villages have done.

dag: Di pa shɛli Judanim yi wum n ni lo ni n niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ yɛla bɛ zaa ni chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ daalahichi taali.
en: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about all the destruction that I intend to bring on them, they will turn from their evil ways. Then I will forgive their wickedness and their sins.

dag: O ni daa nya ka lala niŋbu tiɣi Yɛhudianim nini zuɣu ka o daa gbaai Pita gba. Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu saha ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: When he saw that this pleased the Jews, he went ahead and had Peter arrested.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋ kam ni daa laɣimmi mali shili gu ni bɛ mini ŋunkam kana ni o ti liri ba zaŋ nya taba. Ka niriba bɛn daa be luɣ shɛlikam daa zɔri ba ka so ku tooi zani bɛ tooni.
en: and in the cities of every province they came together to attack their enemies. Everyone was afraid of the Jews, and no one could do anything to oppose them.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa boli sapashinnima ayi na ti yɛli ba, Malimiya shili n-zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba pisopɔin ni kpan ŋmɛriba kɔbisiyi m-pa yimaŋ zuɣu ka yiɣisi kpe kurigu awɛi saha yuŋ ŋɔ n-chaŋ Siizaria.
en: Then the commander called two of his officers and said, Get two hundred soldiers ready to go to Caesarea, together with seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen, and be ready to leave by nine o'clock tonight.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa suhi naa ka o zaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo zali Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni. Amaa ka Daniɛl ŋun daa kul kpalim be nayili.
en: At Daniel's request the king put Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in charge of the affairs of the province of Babylon; Daniel, however, remained at the royal court.

dag: Bɛ ni ti puh a ka ti a bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi, ka a deei li bɛ nuu ni.
en: These three men will say hello to you. They will offer you two bread offerings reserved for priests, and you will accept that bread.

dag: A nini ti yɛn nya li la, ka di chaŋ; dama yim ka di yɛn bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la.
en: Your money can be gone in a flash, as if it had grown wings and flown away like an eagle.

dag: N tuumbiɛri mini n daalahichi lee nyɛla diba ala? Chɛ ka m baŋ m biriginsim mini n daalahichi.
en: What are my sins? What wrongs have I done? What crimes am I charged with?.

dag: Naawuni ʒila o nam ʒiishee din be kasi la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ zuliya kam zaa naa.
en: God sits on his sacred throne; he rules over the nations.

dag: Ka salo maa galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bara maa zaŋ paai Yisa sani, ka daa dula duu maa zuɣusaa nti chib voli Yisa zuɣusaa dɛde. Bɛ ni daa chib voli maa, ka bɛ zaŋ bara maa mini amaŋka maa siɣisi li ti sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: Because of the crowd, however, they could not get the man to him. So they made a hole in the roof right above the place where Jesus was. When they had made an opening, they let the man down, lying on his mat.

dag: Asha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣa Sɛra.
en: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin dabisi shɛli din daŋ tooni dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli. Dindali maa, piɛbimiya kikahi.
en: The first day of the seventh month will be a holy occasion for you. You will not do any job-related work. It will be for you a day of the trumpets sound.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Empty words, Job! Empty words!.

dag: ka din pahi pisinaata daa gbaai Mahaziɔt min o bidibisi ni o Mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam dindali maa ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli n yiŋa.
en: David was afraid of the Lord and thought, Should I really take the sacred chest to my city.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Pita mini Jɔn daa ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni kurig ata saha din nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naawuni jɛmbu saha la.
en: One day Peter and John went to the Temple at three o'clock in the afternoon, the hour for prayer.

dag: Bee yi na ʒi n-karim zaligu ni ni maligumaaniba tumdi tuun shɛŋa Naawuni jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ka ka galimi di zuɣu?.
en: Or have you not read in the Law of Moses that every Sabbath the priests in the Temple actually break the Sabbath law, yet they are not guilty?.

dag: Yi yi yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o noli, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ ti yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri nambɔɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti zo bɛ gba nambɔɣu.
en: Great blessings belong to those who show mercy to others. Mercy will be given to them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dundɔŋ maa. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ mita pihinu. Di daa nyɛla mɔɣumɔɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni.
en: The man measured the inner courtyard, and it was feet square. The Temple was on the west side, and in front of it was an altar.

dag: Yi karitila nimmira saria, amaa man bi kariti so saria.
en: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.

dag: Di simdi ni shɛhiranim maa n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni daŋ zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ bɛ ni yɛn ku ninvuɣ so maa kubu ni, di nyaaŋa ka sokam naanyi zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpɛhi di ni. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: The witnesses are to throw the first stones, and then the rest of the people are to stone them; in this way you will get rid of this evil.

dag: din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi yi ni gbib bɛmaŋa, ka doli ma ni ʒiɛyimtali ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shia zaa, a kul ku kɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒiini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: And if you obey the Lord , he will keep his promise about me. He said, If your sons carefully live the way I tell them, sincerely, with all their heart, the king of Israel will always be a man from your family.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba mini bɛ mabia Simiɔn zuliya niriba daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Keenannim bɛn be Zɛfat la n-ku ba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Hɔrima.
en: The people of Judah went with the people of Simeon, and together they defeated the Canaanites who lived in the city of Zephath. They put a curse on the city, destroyed it, and named it Hormah.

dag: Niriba Zuɣulaannim n-daa nyɛ: Parɔsh mini Pahatimɔab ni Ɛlam ni Zatu ni Bani so mi ni.
en: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyɛra ni ka ni tooi zaŋ dari kpe m-mali nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuuni kam.
en: He can cut and set stones and jewels. He can work with wood and make all kinds of things.

dag: Jɛfita kalinsi nyaaŋa, Ibizan ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: After Jephthah, a man named Ibzan was a judge for the Israelites. Ibzan was from the city of Bethlehem.

dag: Pagɔrili noli ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli; Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu n-yɛn lu di puuni.
en: Adultery is a trap—it catches those with whom the Lord is angry.

dag: ka bɛ moli Yawɛ yuli Ziɔn, ka paɣ o Jɛrusalɛm.
en: And so his name will be proclaimed in Zion, and he will be praised in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ yi kurim bee bɛ yi damdi, bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb maa lurimi bɛ kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: The helpless victims lie crushed; brute strength has defeated them.

dag: Ka Timoti ni daa yi yi sani labina, o daa yɛli ti yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi yurilim yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. O yɛli ti ni yi kul tɛhirila ti yɛla ka bɔri ni yi nya ti kaman ti gba suhuri ni ye yi nyabu zuɣu shɛm.
en: Now Timothy has returned to us from you and has given us good news about your faithfulness and love! He says that you always have good memories about us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: di bɔhiriya tab biɛri; hal so yi lab a nudirigu polo tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o.
en: But I say to you that you must not oppose those who want to hurt you. If people slap you on your right cheek, you must turn the left cheek to them as well.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛl o paɣa, Yiɣisima n-taɣ a biɛhigu ka so ku baŋ ni a nyɛla Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa n-chaŋ Shilo Anabi Ahija ni be luɣ shɛl la. Nyama, Anabi Ahija ŋun daa yɛli ma ni n ni leei Izraɛlnim naa la be nimaani.
en: Jeroboam said to his wife, Go to Shiloh and see the prophet Ahijah. He is the one who said that I would become king of Israel. Dress yourself so that people will not know that you are my wife.

dag: zaŋ tabili bɛn tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba ni bɛn zaŋdi muɣisigu gbahiri niriba ni ʒiŋmariba ni bɛn zaa niŋdi din chihiri wuhibu maŋa la zuɣu.
en: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching.

dag: yaansi bɛn daa doli bɛ nyaaŋa m-be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa bi tooi ku shɛb zaa la, ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ leei daba ka bɛ tum dabitim tuun kpɛma, ka lala ka bɛ na kul nyɛ daba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: that is, the descendants of such people who were still in the land because the Israelites werent able to wipe them out—Solomon forced into the labor gangs that are still in existence today.

dag: Nam jaaŋgbee ti ku yi Juda nuu ni. Nam jaaŋgbee mi ti ku yi o zuliya nuu ni hal ka ŋun su li ti kana. Ka niriba ni ti deer o noli.
en: Judah will hold the royal scepter, And his descendants will always rule. Nations will bring him tribute And bow in obedience before him.

dag: Saliŋgbiriba zaŋdi bɛ firilanima n-nyandi zibisim tiŋgbani puuni, ka gbiri chani bɛ ni ni tooi paai luɣ shɛli tariga m-bɔri tahiʒiɛɣu kuɣa bumbɔn ni.
en: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.

dag: Ka Jair daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Kamɔn.
en: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Wɛi, n niriba bɛn mali tipawumli, ka lɔri nia shɛli din pa n dini, ka lan laɣiri niriba zɔri ka di pa n ni yu shɛli. Bɛ kul tumdila alahichi pahira.
en: This is the Lord 's message for his rebellious people: You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim zim shɛli mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi. Ka naa daa zaŋ li niŋ Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yil la ni.
en: He also made smaller gold shields, using almost two kilograms for each one, and he put the shields in his palace in Forest Hall.

dag: Yawɛ guli bɛn nyɛ tarimba. N daa be muɣisigu ni, ka o tiligi ma.
en: The Lord takes care of helpless people. I was without help, and he saved me.

dag: Bɛ yila dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa na. Yawɛ zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina na ni o ti saɣim dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They are coming from a distant land, from the faraway heavens, the LORD and the instruments of his fury, to destroy the whole land.

dag: Yi tam yi namda ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa ka zali dunia ŋɔ tanzaa la yɛla. Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri yiɣisi, ka bɛ nahindi ya ka bɔri ni bɛ kun ya la dabiɛm? Bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa ku tooi niŋ ya shɛli.
en: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la. Ka bɛ ni daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daa pun zaŋ o yɛligu n-ti anabinim shɛb bɛn daŋ tooni na yɛligu la zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: and made their hearts as hard as rock. Because they would not listen to the teaching which I sent through the prophets who lived long ago, I became very angry.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa ŋun biriti bee ŋun mihiri kom maa n-nyɛ shɛli, amaa Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka di zoori maa n-nyɛ shɛli.
en: So the one who plants is not important, and the one who waters is not important. Only God is important, because he is the one who makes things grow.

dag: N ni wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun shɛba ni bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi, ka bɛn gba bi mi ba, ka chɛ ka tɔb lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n ti kpihim bɛ birili.
en: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa yi n-chaŋ ti yɛl o deennim bɛn daa yɛn kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi la, Yiɣisimiya n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, dama Yawɛ yɛn saɣim li mi. Amaa ka o deennim maa daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ asahi.
en: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city. But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.

dag: ni Sallu ni Amok ni Hilikia ni Jɛdaya so mi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini bɛ taba Jɛshua saha la.
en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai.
en: When Solomon finished the stonework on the Temple.

dag: Ka Jɛfita yɛli ba, M mini n niriba ni Ammɔnnima n-daa mali naŋgbankpeen titali, ka n daa ŋme kuŋ boli ya, ka yi bi kana ti fa ma bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: But I did ask for your help, Jephthah answered. That was back when the people of Gilead and I were having trouble with the Ammonites, and you wouldn't do a thing to help us.

dag: Ka din pah ayopɔin daa gbaai Jɛsarɛla min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi;.
en: Seventh, there were men chosen from Asarelahs sons and relatives.

dag: Miriya ka yi me napɔna dubu shee n-zali n sara maligu bimbini gbini n-dur li din ni chɛ ka so nya yi zaɣim. .
en: And you must not make steps leading up to the altar. If there are steps, when people look up to the altar, they will be able to see under your clothes.

dag: Dama o daa lab mɛla o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee luɣ shɛŋa la zaa, ka me maligu bimbina zali Baalnima, ka lan lab me Ashɛranim ŋmahima zali, ka daa gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi saŋmarisi zaa.
