en: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. And he continued to worship the stars.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi yi taali ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu yihi yimaŋa Masia ni, ka lan ka Naawuni daalibarika puuni.
en: Those of you who try to be put right with God by obeying the Law have cut yourselves off from Christ. You are outside God's grace.

dag: Ka Naomi daa bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya di zaa lala? Ŋun puu ni ka a chaŋ ti yih a kayiha maa? Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi nya a maa ni! Di saha ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi ni do so ŋun yuli booni Bɔaz la puu ni ka o chaŋ ti yihi kayiha maa.
en: Naomi asked her, Where did you gather all this grain today? Whose field have you been working in? May God bless the man who took an interest in you! So Ruth told Naomi that she had been working in a field belonging to a man named Boaz.

dag: A yi ti ba bindirigu maa, bɛ laɣisiri li mi sɔŋ. A yi teeg a nuu, bɛ nyarila binsuŋ kam tiɣi.
en: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are filled completely full!.

dag: Amaa alahichinim ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din bi doya baalim, ka kul puɣiri lura n-ʒiri daɣiri mini yaɣiri kpɛhiri teeku ni la.
en: But the wicked are like the churning sea that cant keep still. They churn up from their waters muck and mud.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa bari zani puu maa sunsuuni n-zabi di zuɣu, ka daa ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ di nasara pam.
en: But Shammah stood in the middle of the field and defended it. He defeated the Philistines. The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: About this time the disciples came to Jesus and asked him who would be the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma, n jilima zoya kaman pɔhim n-ʒe li chaŋ la, ka n tɔŋsim zo kaman sagbani n-fuɣi gari la.
en: Terrors crash upon me; they sweep away my honor like wind; my safety disappears like a cloud.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa yɛla garila wulinluhili polɔnima, ka dabiɛm gbahi wulimpuhili polɔnima.
en: From east to west, all who hear of their fate shudder and tremble with fear.

dag: Naa Jɔash daa bi lan teei Zakaria ba Jɛhɔiada ni daa niŋ o nirilim shɛm la zaa yɛla, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o bia maa. Zakaria ni daa yɛn kpi, o daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, nyam bɛ ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ, ka bɔhi ba biɛri.
en: Joash the king didnt remember Jehoiadas kindness to him. Jehoiada was Zechariahs father. But Joash killed Zechariah, Jehoiadas son. Before Zechariah died, he said, May the Lord see what you are doing and punish you.

dag: Di ni lu yi zuɣu n-din ya; di ni lu yi zuɣu asiba n-gari yim, ka lu yi zuɣu wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ. Ka yɛl biɛɣu kam ni chɛ ka yi baŋ Naawuni yɛligu gbinni!.
en: Every time it passes through it will take you, for morning by morning it will pass, by day and by night. It will be nothing but terror to understand the message.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ ka o zaŋ su niriba; o tiri ba bindirigu pam.
en: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ni ti chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Let the wicked go straight to the grave, the same for every nation that forgets God.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ka Abimilɛk kpi maa, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: When the Israelites saw that Abimelech was dead, they all went home.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: and the LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali din be dundɔn titali ni zaŋ labi nuzaa polo la ziliŋ mini di yɛliŋ.
en: the one facing north at the outer courtyard. He measured its length and width.

dag: Bin yini mi kɔŋko n-simdi bɔbu. Mariama pii din viɛli maa, ka di mi ku lan yi o nuu ni.
en: Only one thing is important. Mary has made the right choice, and it will never be taken away from her.

dag: Ɛnɔsh daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni anu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Enosh lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ku niriba, ka wurim bɛ tɔbbihi ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu, ka chɛ ka bɛ solɔri kpalim zaɣ kuma ka so bi lan dol li; ka chɛ ka bɛ fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka ninsalinim lan ka di ni, ka vuhirigu kam lan ka di ni.
en: The Lord says, I have destroyed whole nations and their defense towers. I destroyed their streets and now no one goes there anymore. Their cities are empty—no one lives there anymore.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa vinvamli din be Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la. Amaa so bi mi bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord buried him in a valley in Moabite country across from Beth-peor. Even now, no one knows where Moses grave is.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn deei n noli, ka doli n zaligunima?.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, How long will you people refuse to obey my commands and teachings?.

dag: ŋun be chɛchɛbuŋ ni zuɣusaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Wummiya o kukoli din mali kpiɔŋ la tahigu.
en: Sing to the one who rides through heaven, the most ancient heaven. Look! God sends forth his voice, his mighty voice.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o daa zaŋ buɣim lu Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu; ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: And so the Lord was angry when he heard them; he attacked his people with fire, and his anger against them grew.

dag: Namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa daa taɣi ba la yuya: O daa boli Daniɛl la Bɛlitishaaza, ka boli Hanania Shadirak, ka boli Mishɛl Mɛshak, ka boli Azaria mi Abɛdnɛgo.
en: But the chief official gave them new names. He named Daniel Belteshazzar, Hananiah Shadrach, Mishael Meshach, and Azariah Abednego.

dag: Ka anab maa daa lan chaŋ do so sani ti yɛl o, Ŋmɛm ma. Ka doo maa daa ŋme o, ŋ-ŋme n-ti o daŋa.
en: The prophet found someone else and said, Hit me! So this man beat him up.

dag: Nimaani sarikanim laɣimmi be ni suhudoo; bɛ bi lan wumdi bɛ guliba tahigu.
en: Everyone is there—.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi ninsal ŋun kpi, bɛ ni leei bɛn bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: Those who touch a corpse are ritually unclean for seven days.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Timna ti nya Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga;.
en: One day, Samson went to Timnah, where he saw a Philistine woman.

dag: Shɛla ni daa dɔɣi Ɛba maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Shelah had more children and died at the age of .

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim Jɛhudi ni o ti zaŋ gbaŋ maa na. Ka o daa zaŋ li Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa duu maa ni na nti karim li wuhi naa mini kpambaliba bɛn zaa daa ʒe naa sani maa.
en: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll. He took it from the room of Elishama and read it to the king and all the officials who were standing around him.

dag: Bɛ lubu vuri ni ti dam tiŋgbani, ka bɛ kuhigu ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: The earth quakes as the Edomites go down; their screams echo as far as the Reed Sea.

dag: Hal ka wuhiri li buri ni mini duu kpɛhibu ni ni muɣisigu nyabu duŋtaariba nuu ni ni tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ni gɔgaliga ni ni kumkpibo puuni.
en: We have been beaten, jailed, and mobbed; we have been overworked and have gone without sleep or food.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli Naawuni, A daa wuh a yurilim din galisi ka ka tariga ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m ba Dauda sani, ka zaŋ ma leei naa zal o zaani.
en: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnim hal ti gbahi ba; n daa bi chɛ ba dolibu hal ti ku bɛ zaa ha.
en: I chased my enemies and caught them. I did not stop until they were destroyed.

dag: Ka o yi ti yoog omaŋmaŋ piɛri maa zaa, o bela bɛ tooni ka piɛri maa dol o, bɛ ni mi o kukoli zuɣu.
en: Whenever he has gathered all of his sheep, he goes before them and they follow him, because they know his voice.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yihi yɛli ni o bela neesim ni ka je o mabia, o na kul bela zibisim ni.
en: The one who claims to be in the light while hating a brother or sister is in the darkness even now.

dag: Bɛ yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa zali tanza kpeeni n-gu dahin shɛli; ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi vili n-gbib nyɛvili din nyɛ nyɛvili maŋli la.
en: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ yiko mini dunia ŋɔ nama zaa zoosim ti Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nam maa ku mali tariga, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni ti kana ti tumdi tuma tiri ba, ka deei bɛ noli.
en: Then Gods holy people will rule over the kingdom and all the people from all the kingdoms of earth. This kingdom will last forever, and people from all the other kingdoms will respect and serve them.

dag: Ŋunkam mi deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani.
en: And whoever welcomes in my name one such child as this, welcomes me.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla alahichi dabili.
en: Jesus said to them, I am telling you the truth: everyone who sins is a slave of sin.

dag: saha shɛli taŋkpagbiligu yi ti laɣim niŋ tampuɣa ka tampuɣa maa tabili taba?.
en: The rain makes the dust become mud, and the clumps of dirt stick together.

dag: Yihim daɣiri din be anzinfa ni, ka machɛli zaŋ li mali duɣu.
en: Remove the worthless things from silver to make it pure, and a worker can make something beautiful.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ni sokam zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, amaa Naawuni tiri sokam la pin kɔŋkɔba ka di saɣisirila o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm; ka so dini be di ko ka chɛ o kpee dini.
en: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.

dag: Bindirigu mini kom kɔŋko zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ lihiri taba ni suhuzɔhibo, ka bahi yoli bɛ tibidarigibo maa puuni.
en: They will run out of bread and water; they will be in despair, and they will waste away because of their sins.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Hiburunim Naawuni n-daa ka ti sanna, dinzuɣu ti suhir a mi, chɛ ka ti chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti.
en: Then they said, The Hebrews God has appeared to us. Let us go on a three-day journey into the desert so we can offer sacrifices to the LORD our God. Otherwise, the LORD will give us a deadly disease or violence.

dag: N niriba ni wuhi ni yi yuli leela noli n-din ya, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi kpi, amaa n ni ti n niriba maa yuli din nyɛ zaɣ palli.
en: Your names will be like curses to my chosen servants. The Lord GOD will kill you, and then he will call his servants by a new name.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa n-doli tuumba maa wuhibu, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni n-wuhiri bɛ dolintabitali ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ laɣimdi mini bɛ wunsuhigu ni.
en: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa daa mali zim bihi biɛla pahi, ka o daa zaŋ di gba niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm li tari ba pahi.
en: They also had a few small fish. Jesus gave thanks for these and told the disciples to distribute them too.

dag: Duuma yino mini ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la ni baptaizibu yini m-beni.
en: There is one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ko bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni biri n-daa ti kpuɣi di daatam ka di gari o ni daa zaŋ shɛm biri maa ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Isaac planted fields in that place, and that year he gathered a great harvest. The Lord blessed him very much.

dag: Naawuni zomi ya nambɔɣu, ka tin ya suhudoo mini yurilim din kul zoori pahira!.
en: May you have more and more mercy, peace, and love.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa tuhi tɔbu shɛm ni o ni daa di nam shɛm zaa yɛla sab niŋ Izraɛl nanim Litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that King Jeroboam did, the wars he fought and how he ruled, are all recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: N ni ti ba suhu shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni; dama bɛ ni ti labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: I will make them want to know me. They will know that I am the Lord . They will be my people, and I will be their God. I will do this because the prisoners in Babylon will turn to me with their whole hearts.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ mi bɛ yudua mini bɛ barikuma nyubu ni bɛ ʒiri tuma yɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I myself know about its arrogance, declares the LORD, the idle talk, the empty deeds.

dag: A nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam ma, tim ma yɛm, ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: You created me, and you keep me safe; give me understanding, so that I may learn your laws.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni so pun nya m Ba maa; naɣila ŋun yi ŋun Naawuni sanna la n-naɣ nyɛ ŋun nya o.
en: I dont mean that there is anyone who has seen the Father. The only one who has ever seen the Father is the one who came from God. He has seen the Father.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga jilima zaa naaya. O nanim ŋmanila bambu dibisi bɛn bi nyari mɔri. Bɛ bela bɛn kariti ba tooni n-zɔri ka yaa kani.
en: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti ka a sanna ka bi mali wuhibu ŋɔ na, nyin di saɣi ka o kpe a yiŋa; a mi di puhi lala nira.
en: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Duuma Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba ni doli solɔri n-kumdi ka fabindi yɛra, Mbaye! mbaye! Bɛ ni ti boli pukpariba na ti pahi bɛ ni tiri shɛb liɣiri ka bɛ kumdi kuyila zuɣu, ka bɛ kum ka fabili.
en: The Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful says, People will be crying in the public places. They will be crying in the streets. They will hire the professional criers.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa garigi yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ ka di pooi bee n-niŋ ka di yaɣi.
en: Balaam answered and said to Balaks servants, If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I wouldnt be able to do anything, small or great, to break the command of the LORD my God.

dag: N ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ sɔŋda; n ni lab yi sanna.
en: When I go, you will not be left all alone; I will come back to you.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim mini maligumaaniba bɛn kpalim ni Lɛvinim bɛn kpalim daa bela Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni. Bɛ zaa daa bela bɛ tiŋgbana ni.
en: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.

dag: Ka doo maa daa gbibi binshɛli din buɣisiri la o nuu ni n-kpa wulimpuhili polo nti buɣisi mita kɔbisinu tariga, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ napɔŋkpuɣila tariga.
en: The man walked east with a tape measure in his hand. He measured cubits. Then he told me to walk through the water at that place. The water was only ankle deep.

dag: Yi mi di lihiy o kaman o nyɛla yi dima, amaa lee saɣisimiy o mi kaman yi mabia la.
en: Dont treat them like enemies, but warn them like you would do for a brother or sister.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa lan lab gbi kɔbil shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun gbi o ba Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la, dama Filistianim n-daa ŋar li Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ yu shɛŋa bol kɔbilisi maa la n-lan bol li.
en: where he cleaned out those wells that the Philistines had stopped up. Isaac also gave each of the wells the same name that Abraham had given to them.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Sulemaana tuma fukumsi m-bɔŋɔ, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinu ni pihinu bɛn lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumd o tuma.
en: Solomon appointed officers to be in charge of his workers and to watch over his building projects.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti pirigi Yisa binyɛra ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: They stripped him and put a red military coat on him.

dag: Zahimmiya yimaŋa n-nya yi shiri doli yi yɛda niŋbu soli. Buɣisimiya yimaŋa! Yi bi mi ni Masia be yi ni? Di yi pa lala yi daa naɣ bi nyaŋla yimaŋ buɣisibu la.
en: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya daantalis ayi, zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaanu, ka bɛ daa mali zuɣuri tamtam di zuɣu, ka zuɣu yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sa duu maa tooni.
en: The king had two columns made, each one feet tall, and placed them in front of the Temple. Each one had a capital 1⁄2 feet tall.

dag: Tikuba kul chani moonila ashili yɛtɔɣa, amaa niriba ni dihi so tabili ŋun gbibila ashili.
en: People who tell secrets about others cannot be trusted. Those who can be trusted keep quiet.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ n daalahichi, ka kpihim n tuumbiɛri zaa.
en: Hide your face from my sins; wipe away all my guilty deeds!.

dag: Dindali zaŋ chana Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: And the house of Israel will know that I, the LORD, am their God, from that day on.

dag: Hal ti tuumbiɛri ni kul di shɛhira jɛndi ti maa zaa yoli, Yawɛ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli zuɣu. Ti zoya ka chɛ a siɣimsiɣim bushɛm, ka tum alahichi pam a sani.
en: Even though our sins testify against us, help us, LORD, for your names sake. We have turned away from you and sinned against you time and again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli paɣ maa, Pumpɔŋɔ ti niŋ yɛda, ka pa ni a yɛligu la zuɣu yaha, dama timaŋmaŋ wum o yɛligu ka baŋ ni o shiri nyɛla dunia ŋɔ tiligira.
en: and they said to the woman, We no longer believe because of what you said, for we have heard for ourselves and know that this one is truly the savior of the world.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa yi ni chaŋ Taasus ni o ti bo Sool shee.
en: Then Barnabas went to the city of Tarsus to look for Saul.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa lɛbila ninsala m-be ti sani, ka anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli pal o kɔbili ni. Ka ti nya o jilima shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Bi gaŋ ŋun yi o Ba sanna jilima.
en: The Word became a human being and, full of grace and truth, lived among us. We saw his glory, the glory which he received as the Father's only Son.

dag: A ni ti kurigi zaa ka naanyi dɔn a gballi ni kaman bɛ ni yi chɛ siŋkaafa ti sɔŋ siŋkaafabɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: Like wheat that ripens till harvest time, you will live to a ripe old age.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali maa nyɛla din muɣisir a ninsal taba, ka a wuntitali nyɛ din sɔŋd a ninsal taba.
en: Others suffer from your sins, and the good you do helps them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ni o yihi ba sansani maa ni hal ka bɛ zaa daa ti shiri kpi.
en: The Lord had opposed those men until they were all dead and gone from our camp.

dag: chaŋ Ofiri nti zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanahi na nti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: They sailed to the land of Ophir and brought back to Solomon about sixteen tons of gold.

dag: Ti ni daa mali ti yaɣi Kilikia mini Pamfilia teeku noya zuɣu, ti daa paala Maira din be Lisia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: We crossed over the sea off Cilicia and Pamphylia and came to Myra in Lycia.

dag: Bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina din so maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka n ni lan wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli gari shɛlikam.
en: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.

dag: A naŋgbampiba ŋmanila gali ʒee, ka a noli viɛli pam. A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Like a crimson ribbon are your lips; when you smile, it is lovely. Like a slice of pomegranate is the curve of your face behind the veil of your hair.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa ni daa baŋ ni binshɛɣukam niŋya naai maa ka o daa yɛli, Kɔnyuri mali ma. O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, I am thirsty.

dag: Yisa ʒim zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim. Dina n-nyɛ alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka di mi nyɛla o daanfaan shɛli din galisi.
en: We have been ransomed through his Sons blood, and we have forgiveness for our failures based on his overflowing grace.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa galim alikauli kurili ʒiɛmani maa ni niriba yɛli: Yi Duuma yɛliya, Dabisi shɛŋa saha kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: But God finds fault with his people when he says, The days are coming, says the Lord, when I will draw up a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.

dag: Bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baal mini Ashitarɔt.
en: They went away from the LORD and served Baal and the Astartes.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii piri la.
en: It is like what happens when a woman mixes yeast into three batches of flour. Finally, all the dough rises.

dag: A mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni; zaŋmi n nintam niŋ a luɣuluɣu ni. Bee di yɛla bi sab be a litaafi ni?.
en: You know how troubled I am; you have kept a record of my tears. Aren't they listed in your book?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam kun ya, bɛ ni ku o gba. Bɛ ni gbahi yi dimnim zaa daba chaŋ. Bɛnkam fa yi nɛma, bɛ ni fa bɛ gba nɛma. Ka bɛnkam zaa di yi nɛma, n ni chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ gba nɛma.
en: Yet all who ravage you will be ravaged; all who oppress you will go into exile. Those who rob you will be robbed, and all who plunder you will be plundered.

dag: Amaa ka a dabili nini daa ti moog o tuma zuɣu, ka doo maa zo n-tiligi. Ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, A saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala; dama amaŋmaŋ pun wuhi samli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But I got busy with other things, and the man escaped. The king answered, You have pronounced your own sentence, and you will have to pay the penalty.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti niŋ bindira ka yi di n-tiɣi, ka be ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: The land will give its fruit so that you can eat your fill and live securely on it.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tarimba, ka tumd o ni zali ya shɛm ŋɔ, jɛmmiya Yawɛ. Bomiya wuntitali mini tarimtali, di pa shɛli ka yi ti nya sɔɣisili shee Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali.
en: Turn to the Lord , all you humble people of the land, who obey his commands. Do what is right, and humble yourselves before the Lord . Perhaps you will escape punishment on the day when the Lord shows his anger.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim mini maligumaaniba bɛn kpalim ni Lɛvinim bɛn kpalim daa bela Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni. Bɛ zaa daa bela bɛ tiŋgbana ni.
en: The rest of the people of Israel and the remaining priests and Levites lived on their own property in the other cities and towns of Judah.

dag: Tiŋ maa dunoya ti ku yɔri wuntaŋ ni, ka yuŋ mi ti ku zibiri nimaani.
en: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi nya Yawɛ ni pii so maa? Niriba ŋɔ zaa ni so bi be kaman ŋuna. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili.
en: Can you see the one the LORD has chosen? Samuel asked all the people. He has no equal among the people. Then the people shouted, Long live the king.

dag: Amaa di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n gbaai soli zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ dali; dama anabi bi kɔŋd o nyɛvili luɣ shɛli ka pa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After that I must go, because all prophets should die in Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara, ka zaŋ li da yaɣimɛr so palo ni bɛ mali saamba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: So they decided to use the money to buy a field called Potters Field. This field would be a place to bury people who died while visiting in Jerusalem.

dag: A ni ti nyu m-buɣi, ka nya suhugarigu. A biɛli Samaria pipia maa nyɛla bahiyoli mini dabiɛm pipia.
en: It will make you miserable and drunk, that cup of fear and ruin, your sister Samaria's cup.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Ammihul bia Shɛmuɛl.
en: from the tribe of Simeon—Shemuel son of Ammihud;.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la palibu saha daa ti miri, ka bɛ zuliya maa daa nab pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The number of our people in Egypt grew. There were more and more of our people there. The promise that God made to Abraham was soon to come true.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛli ba, M pun lo n suhu ni ni n chɛ ka yinim n-yɛli ma zahindi maa, ka lan wuhi maa di gbinni. Yi yi ku tooi niŋ lala, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋmahiŋmahi ya chɛrachɛra, ka chɛ ka bɛ wurim yi yinsi.
en: But the king replied, No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.

dag: A bahi ti dimnim yoli zaa; ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: The enemy is finished! You destroyed their cities. There is nothing left to remind us of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan tirisi tooni ha nti nya Zɛbidii min o bih ayi: Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni n-liɣiri bɛ lansi. Ka Yisa daa boli bɛ gba;.
en: Continuing on, he saw another set of brothers, James the son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with Zebedee their father repairing their nets. Jesus called them and.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ garig o, bee n nya yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o?.
en: Yet I myself will answer him; Ill choose my words in a contest with him.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti dana, a daba kala bindira dabu na.
en: But the brothers said to him, No, sir, we come as your servants. We have come only to buy food.

dag: O nam sulinsi ni zaŋla teeku noli hal ti kpa teeku shɛli noli yaha, ka lan zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli hal ti kpa dunia tariga zaa.
en: Let the king rule from sea to sea, from the river to the ends of the earth.

dag: Bɛ yi ti bi niŋ a yɛda bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ dihi a ni tuui niŋ shɛli ŋɔ tabili; di pa shɛli bɛ ni niŋ din pahi ayi ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Then God said, If the people dont believe you when you use your walking stick, then they will believe you when you show them this sign.

dag: ka a zaŋ li ti ti a ba ka o di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Then you will carry the food to your father, and he will bless you before he dies.

dag: Dinzuɣu man kpahimbu puuni, di ni simdi ni ninsalinim niŋ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla bɛ kul diri ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama suhupiɛlli mini bɛ tuma n-kul yɛn doli taba Naawuni ni ti ba nyɛvili shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ puuni.
en: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.

dag: A ni ti tooi yɛli ni a nyɛla wuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku a maa tooni? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti a daŋ maa sani, a nyɛla ninsala, ka pa wuni.
en: When you face your murderers, will you still say, Im God? In your killers hands, you are mortal, not divine.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha n ni ti nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: The Lord says, The time is coming when I will be the God of all the tribes of Israel, and they will be my people.

dag: N tir a zaligunim din nyɛ n ni yuri shɛli maa jilima; n kul ni bɔhindi li.
en: I respect and love your commandments; I will meditate on your instructions.

dag: Lihimiya Ziɔn din nyɛ ti ni puhiri ti daadiini churi tin shɛli ni la. Lihimiya Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ alaafee biɛhigu shee la. Di tanti suɣili bi vuura, ka di dasara kul ku vuɣi, ka di gabisi mi bi chihira.
en: Gaze upon Zion, our festival town. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a carefree dwelling, a tent that is not packed up, whose stakes are never pulled up, whose ropes wont snap.

dag: Ka Musa mini Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, chɛliya vuri ka wum, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi leei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba.
en: Moses stood together with the priests and said, Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.

dag: Naa Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu du shɛli maa puuni wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin; ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili.
en: The Temple was cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi ŋma nti ʒe sochira zuɣu n-gu ni yi gbahi bɛ ni shɛb bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la. Di mi daa bi simdi ni yi gbahi bɛn kpalim ti bɛ dimnima bɛ nandahima dabisili dali.
en: You shouldnt have waited on the roads to destroy his escapees; you shouldnt have handed over his survivors on the day of defeat.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa zaŋ Yisa n-tahi mɔɣu ni ni Sintani ti zahim o.
en: Then the Spirit led Jesus into the desert to be tempted by the Devil.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mi daa bi yɛli ni o ni kpihim Izraɛl yuli dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam tiligi ba.
en: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa chɛ kumsi, ka bɛ yɛli ba, Fomiya ka di chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla dabisili kasi.
en: The Levites helped the people to calm down. They said, Be quiet, calm down, this is a special day. Dont be sad.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti zaŋ n niriba maa chaŋ n ni daa wuh a luɣ shɛli maa. Nyama, m malaika ni be a tooni. Amaa bɛ tibidarigibo biɛɣu yi ti neei, n ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Now go and lead the people to the place I described to you. My messenger here will go in front of you. When the day of reckoning comes, Ill count their sin against them.

dag: Laɣimmiya yi zuliya ni kpamba mini yi sapashin kpamba zaa n sanna, ka n ti yɛli ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ wum, ka n chɛ ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani di shɛhira jɛndi ba.
en: Bring together all the officers and leaders of your tribes. I will tell them these things. And I will call heaven and earth to be witnesses against them.

dag: Ka o daa lan nya ka Yaakubu deeg o ba min o ma noli ka shiri kuli Mɛsopoteemia.
en: He found out that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Mesopotamia.

dag: Ka bɛ daa saɣi n-chɛ ka o kpe bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka ŋariŋ maa dii mali ti to bɛ ni daa baari duri yaɣ shɛli polo maa.
en: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed.

dag: A teei teeku pa di zuɣu kaman binyɛrigu la, ka chɛ ka kom lim zoya.
en: You covered it with water like a blanket. The water covered even the mountains.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu a yi saɣi nyin zalim zaligu ni nyin naa mini Vashiti ku lan kpe yaha; ka chɛ ka bɛ sab li pahi Pɛriʒianim mini Miidianim zaligunim ni, ka di leei din ku lan taɣi yaha. Ka a zaŋ o zaashee maa ti paɣ so ŋun so o.
en: If it please Your Majesty, issue a royal proclamation that Vashti may never again appear before the king. Have it written into the laws of Persia and Media, so that it can never be changed. Then give her place as queen to some better woman.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ ni dabisi shɛli din paya dali zaa n-gbahi kɔrinsi maa; ŋun daa bi gbahi ba pam ni daa gbahi shɛb tibisim daa bi pooi kilɔgiram ayi ni biɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔŋ yɛrigi gili suɣa maa shee zaa.
en: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu; ka chɛ ka n nuhi mali yaa din ni tooi zaŋ daanya tɔb to.
en: He trains me for battle, so that I can use the strongest bow.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla yɛm wuhibu ni be shɛli ni, ka maŋsiɣisibu be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: Reverence for the Lord is an education in itself. You must be humble before you can ever receive honors.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi gɔriti dama atam kpuɣibu saha paaya. Kamiyana ti siɣi no, dama wain bɔɣili paliya. Wain ni tɔɣiri niŋdi binshɛŋa ni maa palimi hal ti puuri bahira; dama bɛ tuumbiɛri galisiya pam.
en: They are very wicked; cut them down like grain at harvest time; crush them as grapes are crushed in a full wine press until the wine runs over.

dag: Ka Ahitɔfɛl daa ti lan yɛli Absalom yaha, Chɛ ka m pii niriba tuhi pinaayi n-zaŋ ba biɛhi Dauda naba yuŋ ŋɔ.
en: Then Ahithophel said to Absalom, Let me pick twelve thousand men, and I will go after David tonight.

dag: A yi saɣi ni n tim a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari, n kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari, m bi yɛn birigi nudirigu bee nuzaa polo.
en: Let us pass through your country. We will go straight through and not leave the road.

dag: N yi ti kuhi bol a dahin shɛli, n dimnim maa ni ŋmaligi zo. Dama m mi ni nyin Naawuni be m polo.
en: I know that when l call for help, my enemies will turn and run. I know that because God is with me!.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o kuhi pam yɛli, Lazarɔs, yimina.
en: After Jesus said this he called in a loud voice, Lazarus, come out.

dag: Bɛ noya ni yɛtɔɣa piinimi ni jɛritali, ka naari ni putɔɣu ni yinyari.
en: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.

dag: Kɛlub ŋun daa nyɛ Shuha mabia la daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Mɛhir. Mɛhir maa n-daa nyɛ Ɛshitɔn ba.
en: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa la o ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni liɣiri tɔhibu shee la; amaa ka so daa bi gbaag o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come.

dag: Di simdi ni cheechi sɔŋdiba malila paɣ yinoyino, ka tooi gbib bɛ bihi mini bɛ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.

dag: Nyama, pa bɛ buni ka bɛ gbibi bɛ nuhi ni maa? Man kul ku deei ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa.
en: They claim they succeed by their own strength, but their way of thinking I can't accept.

dag: Ka o bɔhi n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so, ka n yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk nira.
en: Saul asked me, Who are you? An Amalekite, I answered.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni tuhi yi dimnim ka di azichi nɛma pam din nyɛ niɣi mini anzinfa ni salima ni daanya ni kuriti ni situra pam ŋɔ kuli yi tiŋgban ni nti pii ti yi mabihi.
en: He said, You have become very rich. You have many animals. You have gold, silver, and expensive jewelry. You have many beautiful clothes. You have taken many things from your enemies. Go home and divide these things among yourselves.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla viɛli pam. Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ zuɣu.
en: How excellent are the Lord 's faithful people! My greatest pleasure is to be with them.

dag: Ti ka soli ni bɛ ti ti bindirigu mini kom?.
en: Dont we have the right to eat and drink?.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-nyaŋ Kiriatisɛfanim ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣipini.
en: He told his men, The man who captures Kiriath-Sepher can marry my daughter Achsah.

dag: Paɣiba bɛn zaa be naa nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima. Bɛ ni yɛli, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa tim ti boli Napaɣ Vashiti ni o kana ka o zaɣisi.
en: I say this, because all the other women will hear about what Queen Vashti did. Then they will stop obeying their husbands. They will say to their husbands, King Xerxes commanded Queen Vashti to be brought to him, but she refused to come.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti chaŋ ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ʒi m-baɣi teeku la n-tuhi nyaŋ bɛ pam. Amaa tinshee sapashin so ni ti kana ti nyaŋ o n-chɛ ka o karimbaani maa zan tariga. Yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti labis o karimbaani maa yɛl biɛri ʒil o.
en: After that he will attack the nations by the sea and conquer many of them. But a foreign leader will defeat him and put an end to his arrogance; indeed he will turn the arrogance of Syria's king back on him.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ata, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ata yɛli, Kamina! Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr sabinli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi sania o nuu ni.
en: Then the Lamb broke open the third seal; and I heard the third living creature say, Come! I looked, and there was a black horse. Its rider held a pair of scales in his hand.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti kpe yili maa ni, ka Leeban daa paai laakumnim maa ʒiya, ka niŋ taɣitaɣi mini mɔri ti o ni o ti laakumnim maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Leeban daa tooi kom na ti ti o mini bɛn daa be o sani ni bɛ paɣi bɛ naba.
en: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.

dag: Daadamnim mini yɔnaɣila kara ni naɣila pola zaa ni ti lu n-doya. Bɛ ʒim ni ti zo n-tiɛli bɛ tiŋgbani, ka tiŋgbani maa nyu bɛ kpam tiɣi.
en: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: If someone should say, Here is the Messiah! or There he is! don't believe it.

dag: Naa Hiram daa pun zaŋla salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi n-timna ti ti naa.
en: Hiram had sent King Solomon about pounds of gold to use in building the Temple.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So yi ni tooi zaŋ bini buɣisi zuɣusaa bee n-vihi baŋ tiŋgbani puuni tanzahi ni nyɛ shɛli, di saha n ni zaɣisi Izraɛlnim bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: If one day the sky could be measured and the foundations of the earth explored, only then would he reject the people of Israel because of all they have done. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Ka o ti bɔhi ba, Alizam bɔ ka yi lee diri chani maa? Ka bɛ kpalim zani ni suhugarigu.
en: Jesus said to them, What are you talking about to each other, as you walk along? They stood still, with sad faces.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ nahim Izraɛlnim mini Judanima. Ka bɛn daa gbahi ba maa zaa kul gbib ba kirikiri, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: The people of Israel were oppressed, together with the people of Judah. Their captors held them and refused to let them go.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa du n-tam zo shɛli din yuli booni Zɛmaraim Zoli din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya ni la zuɣu ka yɛli, Nyin Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: Abijah stood on the heights of Mount Zemaraim in Ephraims highlands and said: Listen to me, Jeroboam and all Israel!.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba laɣim to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: Early in the morning all the chief priests and the elders of the people reached the decision to have Jesus put to death.

dag: di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka n ti nya neesim din ne pam gari wuntaŋa ka di yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili m mini bɛn daa laɣim chani maa soli maa ni.
en: On the way there, at noon, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun. It shined all around me and those traveling with me.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni chɛ ka kokpɛɣu kpe dunia ŋɔ ni n-di vuhirigu kam zaa ŋun mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka binshɛɣukam zaa din be dunia ŋɔ ni kpi.
en: I am going to send a flood on the earth to destroy every living being. Everything on the earth will die.

dag: M min o gbɛri kparila taba, ka n tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ka di do palɔni, ka pa ni ŋaha puuni; ka o nyari man Yawɛ kɔtomsi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi bi zo dabiɛm ni yi galim n dabili Musa maa.
en: When I speak to him, I talk face to face with him. I dont use stories with hidden meanings—I show him clearly what I want him to know. And Moses can look at the very image of the Lord . So why were you brave enough to speak against my servant Moses.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa mali hal ti kurigi ka naanyi kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o ba Jɔash siliga ni Abiɛza daŋ niriba ya Ofira.
en: Gideon, Joashs son, died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka niriba pam yi tiŋkpansi n-daŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti doli bɛ kali soli m-mali bɛmaŋa ka Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa dali na bi paai.
en: It was almost time for the Jewish Passover, and many people went from the countryside up to Jerusalem to purify themselves through ritual washing before the Passover.

dag: m-pah o ni daa deeri salima shɛli daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nanim zaa ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gomnanim san la zuɣu.
en: The merchants and traders, as well as the kings of Arabia and rulers from Israel, also gave him gold.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a yihi ba di ni, dama di nyɛla vi ni bɛ mali wuhibu shɛŋa bɛ ni ka soli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi so m-birigiri yiya pam puuni niriba liɣiri nyabu zuɣu.
en: These people must be stopped, because they are destroying whole families by teaching what they should not teach. They teach only to cheat people and make money.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neeg asiba ka dam maa yi o ninni, ka o paɣ maa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka o suhu kabi, ka o be kaman kuɣili la.
en: But when he sobered up the next morning, Abigail told him everything that had happened. Nabal had a heart attack, and he lay in bed as still as a stone.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku doo mini paɣa. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku do kurugu mini bidibbila. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku nachimbil mini paɣisaribila.
en: to kill men and women, to slay old and young, to kill boys and girls.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna maa nyɛla Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋ tin ya ka o be yi ni la duu? Yi bi su yimaŋa.
en: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya yaa ti Duuma min o kpiɔŋ ni o yiko ni.
en: Finally, build up your strength in union with the Lord and by means of his mighty power.

dag: Yi paɣiba mini yi bihi ni yi biŋkɔbiri bɛn ni kpalim be n ni zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa tin ya maa ni.
en: However, your wives, children, and herds—I know you have lots of herds!—may remain in the towns that I have given to you.

dag: Amaa lee bomiyala Naawuni nam dubu, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: Instead, desire his kingdom and these things will be given to you as well.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pinaayopɔin dali, ka ŋariŋ maa daa kana ti tam Ararat Zoli zuɣu.
en: Then on the seventeenth day of the seventh month of the year, the boat came to rest somewhere in the Ararat mountains.

dag: O suh a nyɛvili, ka a ti o li; ka di nyɛ nyɛvil wɔɣinli din ka bahigu.
en: He asked for life, and you gave it. You gave him life that goes on forever.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa kpuɣi Putiɛl bipuɣinsi ni yino n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Finɛhas. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Aarons son Eleazar married one of Putiels daughters. She gave birth to Phinehas. These were the leaders of Levite households by their clans.

dag: Bɛn daa zaŋla lɔɣu ni be bindir shɛli ni ti ma ni n di; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka bɛ zaŋ yabiga kom ti ma ni n nyu.
en: They gave me poison, not food. They gave me vinegar, not wine.

dag: Jɛhɔzadak ka bɛ daa gbaai chaŋ tinzun tiŋa saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim niŋ Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni ka o gbahi ba chaŋ la.
en: Jehozadak went away when the LORD caused Judah and Jerusalem to be exiled by Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: So yi sɔɣi gbaai o Izraɛl kpee n-zaŋ o leei dabili bee n-zaŋ o kɔhi, dindina ŋun gbaag o maa simdi kubu, ka lala chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community.

dag: Di simdi ni a baŋ a biŋkɔbbaligu daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka lihi a niɣi viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: Learn all you can about your sheep. Take care of your goats the best you can.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ dabisa biɛla o sani ka Gomna Fɛstus daa ti pii Pool yɛla maa n-yɛli Naa Agiripa. O daa yɛl o mi, Gomna Filiksi daa chɛ do so niŋ sarika ni ya ŋɔ;.
en: They had been there for several days, when Festus told the king about the charges against Paul. He said: Felix left a man here in jail.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni suui bɛ ni zaŋ ʒi tibisa shɛŋa ʒili ya la, ka kabi bɛ ni ban ya bandi shɛŋa la.
en: Now I will break off his yoke from you and tear off your chains.

dag: Tibigim yɛm, ka o duh a. A yi vili yɛm gbibi, o ni ti a jilima.
en: Love wisdom, and she will make you great. Embrace her, and she will bring you honor.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ bɛ daa yɛlimi, Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ din kpɛm pam; ŋuni n-lee ni tooi deei li.
en: When Jesus followers heard this, many of them said, This teaching is hard. Who can accept it.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla yi yɛli ma mi, Ti du m-bala Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Pa o bimbina ka Hɛzɛkia pun wurim ka yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Yi yɛn jɛmd o la bimbini ŋɔ gbin la.
en: Now suppose you say to me, We trust in the LORD our God. Isnt he the one whose shrines and altars Hezekiah removed, telling Judah and Jerusalem, You must worship only at this altar?.

dag: Ka bikpɛm maa daa je suli zaɣisi duu kpɛbu; ka o ba daa yina ti balim o.
en: The older son was angry and would not go in to the party. So his father went out and begged him to come in.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi ni noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋ zaa bɛba ayiyi, zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: From the clean and unclean animals, from the birds and everything crawling on the ground.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ tariga ka m be ka kuhiri boon a n nandahima saha maa. Zaŋm ma tahi kuɣ shɛli din du n-gari ma gbini.
en: In despair and far from home I call to you! Take me to a safe refuge.

dag: O bela o biɛhigu shee ka lihiri zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.

dag: Ka Pita daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi; ka o gban tiŋ suhi Naawuni, ka naanyi ŋmaligi kpim maa polo yɛl o, Tabita, yiɣisima! Ka o neeg o nina nya Pita, ka dii yiɣisi ʒini.
en: Peter put them all out of the room, and knelt down and prayed; then he turned to the body and said, Tabitha, get up! She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

dag: Ka Huram daa zaŋ daanya daantalisi maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ ni. O daa zaŋla daantal yini zali nudirigu polo, ka boli di yuli Jachin; ka zaŋ daantal yini zali nuzaa polo, ka boli di mi yuli Bɔaz.
en: Huram put these two bronze columns at the porch of the Temple. One column was put on the south side of the entrance and one was put on the north side of it. The column on the south was named Jakin. The column on the north was named Boaz.

dag: O zaŋla o nuzaa gbaai n zuɣu mali, ka zaŋ o nudirigu bɔbindi ma.
en: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.

dag: Di saha nir yi ti tooi mali naɣisa yino mini piɛr ayi.
en: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep.

dag: O daa lan mali me Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zoli zuɣu la mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zolɔŋni la, ka me goondahi gil li, ka niŋ dunɔdaya mini binyara din kpariti dunɔdaya maa niŋ di ni.
en: Solomon also built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon as fortress cities with walls, gates, and crossbars.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba, Yisahaku bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Iso mini Izraɛl.
en: Abraham was the father of Isaac. Isaacs sons were Esau and Israel.

dag: amaa tinim sani, Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni, ka binshɛɣukam yila o sanna, ka ti bela o zuɣu. Duuma yino ko mi m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam nambu ni yi so tuma ni na la, ka ti gba bela o zuɣu.
en: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei Makɛda dindali maa, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di naa min o niriba. O daa ku sokam zaa, ka bi chɛ hal ninvuɣ yino gba; ka daa niŋ Makɛda naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: Later that day, Joshua captured Makkedah and killed its king and everyone else in the town, just as he had done at Jericho.

dag: Yaakubu daa niŋla yuun pinaayopɔin Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni; ka o yuma kalinli daa yiɣisi yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi ni ayopɔin.
en: Jacob lived in Egypt years, so he was years old.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi pahi ʒiibukɔbiga zuɣu, ka bɛ zaa ni nyɛla n dan naa tɔbbihi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa lan bɔr ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha? Bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa bɔri ni o bo taali ti Izraɛlnima.
en: Joab answered, May the Lord make the people of Israel a hundred times more numerous than they are now! Your Majesty, they are all your servants. Why do you want to do this and make the whole nation guilty.

dag: A yi mali Lɛvinim maa kasi, ka zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni tooi kpe laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni ti tum tuma.
en: So make the Levites pure and give them to the Lord as a special offering. After you do this, they can come and do their work at the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka Yawɛ mi deei yi daalikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi nyɛla omaŋmaŋ niriba kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni di simdi ni yi dol o zaligunim la.
en: And today the Lord has accepted you to be his own people. He has promised you this. The Lord also said that you must obey all his commands.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa ti pahiri yuun pinaanahi ni, ka Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋd o daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Rɛfaim din be Ashitɛrɔtikarinaim tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Zuzim din be Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Ɛmim din be Shavɛkiriataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings of his alliance came and attacked the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim.

dag: Pa Naawuni ŋun boli ya la n-nyɛ ŋun kari ya di ni.
en: It was not done by God, who calls you.

dag: Dama ni o nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka o mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. Ka o ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka mi ni tooi yɛl o dabili ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: I know this because I am a man under the authority of other men. And I have soldiers under my authority. I tell one soldier, Go, and he goes. And I tell another soldier, Come, and he comes. And I say to my servant, Do this, and my servant obeys me.

dag: Yilimiya yila niŋ o. Yilimiya yila paɣ o. Yɛlimiya o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: Sing praise to the Lord ; tell the wonderful things he has done.

dag: Ka nandaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa yi chani ti dooni bundan maa yiŋ dunol ni, ka yuma kul nyaɣim o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: There was also a poor man named Lazarus, covered with sores, who used to be brought to the rich man's door.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim sansan ni ka n yi n-zo na maa.
en: David asked him, Where have you come from? I have escaped from the Israelite camp, he answered.

dag: binnɛɔŋ kam naan laɣim kpi, ka daadam di labi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: all flesh would die together, and humans would return to dust.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o nuhi ni o naba n-gbam du, ka o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa dol o nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔnatan daa ti ŋmɛri ba luhiri ka o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa mi dol o nyaaŋa kuri ba.
en: So Jonathan scrambled up on his hands and feet with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan. His armor-bearer, coming behind him, would then finish them off.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagban ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then they will see the Human Onecoming on a cloud with power and great splendor.

dag: Ka yi yi zaŋ ŋumbɔŋɔ gba chaŋ, ka binshɛli ti niŋ o, yi ni chɛ ka n kpi ni n zab piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: If you take my other son away from me, and something happens to him, I will be sad enough to die.

dag: O daa yɛli ma mi, A bia Sulemaana n-ni ti me n yili maa mini n dundɔna, dama mani m-piig o leei m bia, ka m mi leeg o ba.
en: The Lord said to me, Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul diri wahala Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba tooi nya tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni ka mali jilima din ku naai la.
en: This is why I endure everything for the sake of those who are chosen by God so that they too may experience salvation in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

dag: Sisɛra daa suh o la kom, amaa ka o ti o la bihim; o daa zaŋ bihim maa niŋla pipi viɛli ni na ti ti o.
en: Sisera asked for water, but she gave him milk; she brought him cream in a beautiful bowl.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai naa maa n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn naa sani Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka o ti di o saria.
en: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Dauda, N ni yiɣisi chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-ka n dan naa sanna ka bɛ ti lo a alikauli, ka di chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri shɛb zaa. Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛbisi Abinɛr ka o kuli ni suhudoo.
en: Abner told David, I will go now and win all Israel over to Your Majesty. They will accept you as king, and then you will get what you have wanted and will rule over the whole land. David gave Abner a guarantee of safety and sent him on his way.

dag: Di veeni ni nir nya wahala la o bilim ni.
en: And it is best to learn this patience in our youth.

dag: Hal paɣ shɛb bɛn nini zɔri nambɔɣu gba daa ti zaŋdila bɛ bihi duɣira. Bɛna n-daa leei bɛ bindirigu, bɛ ni daa kuri n niriba maa saha shɛli maa.
en: The disaster that came to my people brought horror; loving mothers boiled their own children for food.

dag: Chɛ ka o be kaman saa ŋun miri bahiri bindira zuɣu la, ka chɛ ka o be kaman sakurili ŋun maari tiŋgbani la.
en: Let him fall like rain upon fresh-cut grass, like showers that water the earth.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika mini Naawuni yurilim ni Naawuni Shia Kasi dolintabitali kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami!.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Yawɛ be a sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti min a laɣim lo tab alikauli.
en: They answered, We now know for certain that the Lord is with you, and we have decided there needs to be a peace treaty between you and us. So let's make a solemn agreement.

dag: Saha paaya ni nyin Yawɛ niŋ shɛli, dama niriba saɣim a zaligu.
en: Lord , it is time for you to do something. The people do what is against your teachings.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan kari niriba maa tin ya. Bɛ ni leei yi dimnima; ka bɛ wuna leei zana gbahi ya.
en: And so, I'll stop helping you defeat your enemies. Instead, they will be there to trap you into worshiping their idols.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa m-me bimbini zali Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa, ka booi wain mini kpam bahi di zuɣu ti Naawuni.
en: There, where God had spoken to him, Jacob set up a memorial stone and consecrated it by pouring wine and olive oil on it.

dag: N-nyɛ kuɣ duli shɛli n ni pihi sɔŋ m min a sunsuuni.
en: Here are the rocks that I have put between us, and here is the special rock to show that we made an agreement.

dag: Ŋuna n-duhiri tarimba, ka tiri bɛn be nandahima ni nasara.
en: exalts the lowly, raises mourners to victory.

dag: Piimiya zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zuliya kam puuni niriba atata ti ma, ka n tim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti chaŋchaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-buɣisi li nya, ka sab wuhi di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ su yaɣ shɛŋa yɛla zaa na ti ti ma.
en: Let me have three men from each tribe. I will send them out over the whole country to map out the territory that they would like to have as their possession. Then they are to come back to me.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa tum din bie, dama o daa bi zaŋ o suhu zaa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu ni.
en: But Rehoboam did what was evil because he didnt set his heart on seeking the LORD.

dag: A chɛ ka n dabisa bi yaɣ lala. N nyɛvili yuusim pa shɛli a sani. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal kam biɛhigu ŋmanila vuhim.
en: How short you have made my life! In your sight my lifetime seems nothing. Indeed every living being is no more than a puff of wind.

dag: N di yuya ni bɛ zaŋ n nahiŋgu ŋɔ mini n suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: I wish my suffering could be weighed and all my trouble be put on the scales.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bindirigu mini kom tuhi Izraɛlnim soli na nti ti ba saha shɛli bɛ ni daa be soli chani la zuɣu. Amaa ka bɛ daa naɣ bula Balaam paa ni o yɛli nol ti Izraɛlnima, amaa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nol yɛlibu maa ŋmaligi leela alibarika.
en: That law was written because those people didnt give the Israelites food and water. And they had paid Balaam to say a curse against the Israelites. But our God changed that curse and made it a blessing for us.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛɣu ŋɔ, amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa ka n yɛn zaŋ kar a saria! A mi ni m mali halli, ka bɔri ni n nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri n ni bi biri binshɛli bebɔ?.
en: You worthless servant! the king told him. You have condemned yourself by what you have just said. You knew I am a hard man, taking what isn't mine and harvesting what I've not planted.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mal alaafee ka lan yuui dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: so that things will go well for you, and you will live for a long time in the land .

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so dabidoo bee dabipaɣa, di simdi ka nahu maa lan yo dabili maa lana anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o.
en: But if the bull kills a slave, the owner of the animal must pay the master pieces of silver. And the bull must also be killed with stones. This law will be the same for men and women slaves.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa kpe suɣili maa ni nti nya ka Aduna jaaŋgbee din daa nyɛ Lɛvinim din la puhila vari, ka daai pum n-wali alimɔnd wal moma.
en: The next day Moses entered the covenant tent, and Aarons staff of Levis household had sprouted. It grew shoots, produced blossoms, and bore almonds.

dag: Doliya yi ni bɔhim shɛli mini yi ni deei shɛli n san la zaŋ tabili n yɛtɔɣa mini n tuma; ka Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la ni be yi sani.
en: Put into practice what you learned and received from me, both from my words and from my actions. And the God who gives us peace will be with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya suhukpeeni, dama n niŋ Naawuni yɛda ni o ni chɛ ka o malaika maa yɛli ma shɛm maa shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: So men, there is nothing to worry about. I trust God, and I am sure everything will happen just as his angel told me.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa kpila maa ka yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti lan zaŋ li gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla ninsal ʒim liɣiri.
en: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, This is blood money, and it is against our Law to put it in the Temple treasury.

dag: ka a zuliya ni ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka yi ni yɛligi kpa wulinluhili polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a min a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: They will be as numerous as the specks of dust on the earth. They will extend their territory in all directions, and through you and your descendants I will bless all the nations.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi din niŋ ti la yɛla; lihimi ti ni nya filiŋ shɛm.
en: Our Lord , don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.

dag: ka boli Yisa tuumba maa na ti fiɛb ba, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan zaŋ Yisa yuli tɔɣisiri niriba, ka daa bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni ye binyar shɛŋa taɣi m biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam binyɛra. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa shiri ye binyara n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe. Then Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni bɛ yi me tiŋ la mini di goma maa naai, bɛ ku lan yo farigu balibu kam ti a, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka a nam farigu liɣiri filim.
en: May it be known to the king that if this city is rebuilt and the walls completed, they will not pay tribute or tax or dues, and the royal revenue will be reduced.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia bia Zakaria la n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔgula.
en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Holy Tent.

dag: bɛn yɛli tia, Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ka yɛli kuɣili, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi ti. Dama bɛ lɛbila bɛ nyaansi biri ma, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ ma. Amaa muɣisigu yi ti paai ba, bɛ booni ma mi, Kamina ti tiligi ti.
en: when they say to a piece of wood, You are my father, and to a stone, You gave me birth. They have turned their backs to me and not their faces. Yet in their time of trouble they say, Arise and save us.

dag: O daa niŋ lala la o ni daa zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu kaman kom paɣ li m-mal li ka di be kasi la puuni.
en: He did this to dedicate the church to God by his word, after making it clean by washing it in water.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kuli nti di ka nyu, ka niŋ shɛli tari, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa baŋ bɛ ni karim shɛli n-wuhi ba maa gbinni la zuɣu.
en: Then all of the people went to eat and to drink, to send portions, and to have a great celebration, because they understood what had been said to them.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka teeku kom nyuui, ka a mali soli kom puuni sɔŋ, ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la dol li du.
en: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?.

dag: Tumo ŋun biɛ tahirila yɛla na, amaa tumo ŋun ʒe yim tahirila faako na.
en: Unreliable messengers cause trouble, but those who can be trusted bring peace.

dag: Ka ninsalinim daa ti tumdi tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka duŋ taabo daa kul be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: but everyone else was evil in God's sight, and violence had spread everywhere.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni saɣim n luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ yi ni mali shɛli nyuri bara, ka yi nini tiɣi li, ka yi suhuri yu li la, ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin shɛba yi ni chɛ yiŋ la.
en: to give you Israelites this message: You are proud of the strength of the Temple. You like to look at it and to visit it, but the Lord is going to profane it. And the younger members of your families who are left in Jerusalem will be killed in war.

dag: Ti ni ŋma a ni bɔri Lɛbanɔn dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa ti a, ka lo li n-zaŋ niŋ teeku ni n-dolisi kom tahi Jɔpa na, ka yi kana ti kpuɣi li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In the mountains of Lebanon we will cut down all the cedars you need, tie them together in rafts, and float them by sea as far as Joppa. From there you can take them to Jerusalem.

dag: Daadam Bia kamina ni o ti tiligi nyɛviya, ka pa ni o ti di nyɛviya. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi taɣi tiŋkpan shɛli.
en: and they went on to another village.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Iso daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ɛdom zoya tiŋ ni. Iso ka bɛ lan booni Ɛdom la.
en: So Esau, that is, Edom, lived in the mountains of Seir.

dag: A dabili yɛn guhi hal ti paai bɔ saha? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka la tibili?.
en: How much longer must I wait? When will you punish those who persecute me?.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Dauda daa niŋ yuun bɔbili ka kurigi pam; ka bɛ daa kul mali chinchin tibisa m-pind o, amaa di zaa yoli, di daa bi kur o wari.
en: King David was now an old man, and he always felt cold, even under a lot of blankets.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi. .
en: And everyone who trusts in the Lord will be saved. Joel :-.

dag: Amaa di yi pala o pun lomi ni o ku o, ka di nyɛla Naawuni n-chɛ ka di niŋ, dindina n ni wuhi ya luɣ shɛli zali ka ŋun ku nir maa zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: But if it was an accident and he did not mean to kill him, he can escape to a place which I will choose for you, and there he will be safe.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa daa kana ti paala salo, ka bɛ ni do so daa kana ti damdi Yisa tooni yɛli.
en: When they returned to the crowd, a man came to Jesus, knelt before him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, m bela yi polo, ka ni ŋmaligi kpa yi polo na, ka yi ko m-biri.
en: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.

dag: zaŋ Aroa din daa be Arinɔn vinvamli naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ la hal ti paai Siriɔn Zoli .
en: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.

dag: Ŋun nam tibili ni nyɛ ŋun bi wumda? Ŋun nam nini ni nyɛ ŋun bi nyara?.
en: The one who made the ear, cant he hear? The one who formed the eye, cant he see?.

dag: Karimbaani tahirila saɣiŋgu na, ka maŋduhibu mi tahiri lubu na.
en: Pride comes before disaster, and arrogance before a fall.

dag: Ka du shɛli din daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee duu maa tooni wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisaayika.
en: In front of this, the main hall was sixty feet.

dag: Bɛ gbiri kɔsoya tampima ni, ka bɛ nina nyari binviɛla kam.
en: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka zibisim titali daa zibi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni daba ata.
en: Moses stretched his arm toward the sky, and Egypt was covered with darkness for three days.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo tɔb na ti liri Judanima, ka kpe nayili ti ʒe bɛ ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa nayili maa ka gbah o paɣiba min o bidibisi zaa chaŋ. Bɛ daa gbah o bidibisi zaa ka ti naɣ chɛla o kaluɣi ŋun yuli daa booni Ahazia la kɔŋko.
en: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.

dag: Bipuɣiŋga, gbilisim a tibili wum; tamm a niriba min a ba yiŋ yɛla.
en: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo:.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses. This was in the Jordan Valley in Moab, near the Jordan River, across from Jericho. He said.

dag: Yi bundaannim nyɛla duŋtaariba, ka yi niriba nyɛ ʒiŋmariba, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa be bɛ noya ni.
en: The rich in that city are still cruel. The people there still tell lies. Yes, they tell their lies.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram bidibisi ni, Shubaɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shubaɛl bidibisi ni, Jɛdɛiya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Yaakubu pam ka o suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa pirig o niriba bɛn be o sani min o biŋkɔbbaligu ni o niɣi ni o laakumnim ʒii buyi.
en: Jacob was frightened and worried. He divided into two groups the people who were with him, and also his sheep, goats, cattle, and camels.

dag: Hɛzɛkia mini kpambaliba ni daa kana ti nya di ni doya gbilligbilli shɛm maa, ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ min o niriba Izraɛlnim di zuɣu.
en: When King Hezekiah and his officials saw how much had been given, they praised the Lord and praised his people Israel.

dag: Jɛhoyakim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛkɔnia mini Zɛdɛkia.
en: Jehoiakims family: his son Jeconiah and his son Zedekiah.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla bɛ biɛhigu puuni zaa, bɛ bela zibisim ni n-dira ni suhuyiɣisili mini sujee, ka dɔriti gbaari ba.
en: We get to live our lives in darkness and grief, worried, angry, and sick.

dag: So yi da o ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, di saha o ni tooi chɛ ka paɣ maa yiŋnim yo o zuɣu ka deeg o. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o tom kɔhi tinzunnim zuɣu, dama o pun niŋ o din bi tuhi.
en: If she doesn't please the man who bought her to be his wife, he must let her be bought back. He cannot sell her to foreigners; this would break the contract he made with her.

dag: Yi tihi mini yi puri atam zaa ni ti leei toli bindirigu.
en: All your trees and crops will be devoured by insects.

dag: Izar daŋ ni, Kɛnania min o bidibisi ka bɛ daa pii ni bɛ tumdi samban ni tuma, ka nyɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn maani Izraɛlnim yɛla.
en: Among the descendants of Izhar, Chenaniah and his sons were assigned administrative duties: keeping records and settling disputes for the people of Israel.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, yilimi yila pampam. Izraɛlnima, tahimiya! Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga, mali suhupiɛlli, ka diri dari ni a suhu zaa!.
en: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!.

dag: Ka o daa dihiri Izraɛlnim vi, ka Dauda mabia Shimɛi bia Jɔnatan mi daa ku o.
en: He defied the Israelites, and Jonathan, the son of David's brother Shammah, killed him.

dag: Ka o daa kahig o daashili zaa wuh o ka yɛl o, N nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani hal n ni daa na be m ma pul ni saha shɛli, ka piliŋ na ʒi n-shihi n zuɣu ni. Ka n yi pini, n kpiɔŋ maa ni yi n ni ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: that he finally told her the truth. My hair has never been cut, he said. I have been dedicated to God as a nazirite from the time I was born. If my hair were cut, I would lose my strength and be as weak as anybody else.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu. Yɛlimaŋli, hal n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu.
en: I wait for the Lord more eagerly than sentries wait for the dawn— than sentries wait for the dawn.

dag: Dama Naawuni jɛrilim nyɛla yɛm gari ninsalinim yɛm, ka Naawuni chɔɣinsi mi nyɛ kpiɔŋ gari ninsalinim kpiɔŋ.
en: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.

dag: Ŋun baɣa ka Yawɛ tuma ni, noli ni di o, ka ŋun bi bɔri ni o zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba, noli ni di o.
en: Curse those who do not do the Lord 's work with all their heart! Curse those who do not slash and kill.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kul niŋdi ba fitiina shɛm, lala ka bɛ zuliya maa daa kul nabiri ka yɛligiri pahira. Ka jɛlinsi mini dabiɛm daa kpe Ijiptinim maa suhuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But even though the Israelites were mistreated, their families grew larger, and they took over more land. Because of this, the Egyptians feared them worse than before.

dag: Ka alikauli maa daa shiri lɔrigi dindali maa. Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri maa ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri la daa lihiri ma nti baŋ ni Yawɛ n-wuhiri ba shɛli n ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: So the covenant was canceled on that day. Those who bought and sold the sheep were watching me, and they knew that the Lord was speaking through what I did.

dag: Di saha maa Ibrahimma mini Zara zaa daa kurigiya pam hal ka Zara bi lan nyari sɔrilim gba.
en: Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was well past the age for having children.

dag: mini dɔr biɛɣu din be situra ni bee yil ni.
en: for skin disease on clothing or in houses.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ bɛ ni daŋ shɛb tinsi tibu. Bɛ daa piila fɔntinsi pinaata Juda mini Simiɔn ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaana la daŋ niriba.
en: The lot went out for the clans of the Kohathites. The descendants of Aaron the priest from among the Levites acquired thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam zaa niŋ Yisifu nuu ni. Yisifu ni daa be o sani maa zuɣu, o baɣa daa lan ka shɛl ni n-naɣ pahila bindir shɛl o ni daa diri ni. Yisifu daa yi nachimbil viɛlli pam, ka o lihibu viɛla.
en: Potiphar turned over everything he had to the care of Joseph and did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Joseph was well-built and good-looking.

dag: N ni yi be bɛ sani maa, n yi gbib ba la a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu. N kul gbib ba viɛnyɛliŋga hal ka bɛ ni yino bi bɔrigi naɣila bahi yoli bia la ni di chɛ ka nyin Naawuni yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power of your name, the name you gave me. I protected them, and not one of them was lost, except the man who was bound to be lost—so that the scripture might come true.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi la daa zani nam ʒiishee la mini binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la tooni n-yili yil palli. Ka so daa naan ku tooi bɔhim yilli maa m-pahila bɛn bɛn daa tiligi dunia ni la kɔŋko.
en: The people sang a new song before the throne and before the four living beings and the elders. The only ones who could learn the new song were the , who had been bought from the earth. No one else could learn it.

dag: Nail Mɔɣili kom ni filim, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui zaa.
en: The waters of the sea will dry up; the river will be parched and bare.

dag: Di mi bi tuhi ni ti zahim ti Duuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka tinvura dim ku ba la.
en: We must not put the Lord to the test, as some of them did—and they were killed by snakes.

dag: A yi paai nimaani, nyin lihim bo Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la shee n-kpe nti bol o o tab sani n-zaŋ o kpe duu ashilɔni.
en: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu.
en: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka Sintani dii kana nti yihi yɛligu shɛli din lu bɛ suhuri ni maa.
en: Sometimes the teaching falls on the path. That is like some people who hear the teaching of God. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the teaching that was planted in them.

dag: chɛ ka a pɔhim biɛɣu doli ba lala, ka chɛ ka a sanʒiɛ titali kpɛhi ba dabiɛm!.
en: chase them away with your storm and terrify them with your fierce winds.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ bɛ fɔntin titali din mali yaa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni di nyɛla goon shɛli din du pam.
en: Rich people, however, imagine that their wealth protects them like high, strong walls around a city.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kana, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa gili luɣilikam maa, laɣimmiya nimaani. Yawɛ, timmi a tɔbbihi na!.
en: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations; gather yourselves there; bring your mighty ones, LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu yɛli, Fom a noli ka wara! Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa bɛ sunsuuni, ka chaŋ ka chɛ o, ka bi ti o daŋa.
en: But Jesus warned the evil spirit to stop. He said, Be quiet! Come out of the man! The evil spirit threw the man down on the ground in front of everyone. Then the evil spirit left the man and did not hurt him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n ta yi nanim bɛn be n sara maligu shee daɣiri, ka chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paai Yaakubu zuliya, ka chɛ ka bɛ tu Izraɛlnima.
en: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Farisiinim zuɣu! Dama yi yuri kpamba ʒiishee ʒinibu yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka lan yuri puhigu dahi ni.
en: It will be bad for you Pharisees because you love to have the most important seats in the synagogues. And you love for people to show respect to you in the marketplaces.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ li leei bɛmaŋmaŋ mini bɛ zuliya ni ŋunkam yu ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei Yɛhudia nira kali. Ka di saha daa yi ti paai yuuni kam puuni, bɛ puhirila di chuɣu maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: The Jews agreed that they, their children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren, as well as all non-Jews who become Jews, should always keep these two days. They agreed to follow the written rules—and at the proper time too—every year.

dag: Hal bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni tuma zuɣulaannim mini gomnanim ni kpambaliba ni bɛnkam zaa daa ʒe nam fukumsi zaashee daa sɔŋla Yɛhudianim maa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Mɔdɛkai.
en: All the leaders of the provinces, rulers, governors, and those in charge of the kings business helped the Jews because they were afraid of Mordecai.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba naba vuri tulaale tihi maa zuɣu, nyin lirim ba, dama di saha maa man Yawɛ daŋla a tooni ni n ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa ti a maa.
en: When you hear the sound of marching in the treetops, then attack because I will be marching ahead of you to defeat the Philistine army.

dag: dama m bipolitali saha ka n daa wums o kaman o ba la, ka kul sɔŋdi pakoli sahakam.
en: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be kasi la ʒi n-gbaai chandi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa ti sa pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai ni.
en: Then the Levite clan of Kohath would start out, carrying the sacred objects. By the time they arrived at the next camp, the Tent had been set up again.

dag: Salo daa yiɣisi zani n nudirigu polo, bɛ daa kari ma bahi, ka ŋma n kubu pala sɔŋ.
en: On the right, upstarts rise and target my feet, build their siege ramps against me.

dag: M maŋmaŋ ni bo shɛhiradiriba ayi shɛb n ni dihi tabili. Bɛna n-nyɛ maligumaana Yuria mini Zakaria ŋun nyɛ Jɛbɛrikia bia la.
en: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ba ba bandi, ka bɛ be wahala mia ni.
en: So if people are punished, if they are tied with chains and ropes, they did something wrong.

dag: Nyama, o kanimina kaman sagbana la, o chɛchɛbunsi ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o yuri zɔri yomyom gari tɔrili. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti bahi yoli.
en: Look! The enemy army swoops down like an eagle; their cavalry and chariots race faster than storm clouds blown by the wind. Then you will answer, We are doomed.

dag: Yawɛ buɣisiri wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa biɛhigu, ka o suhu je bɛn yuri duŋ taabu.
en: The Lord examines those who are good and those who are wicked; he hates those who enjoy hurting others.

dag: dama zuliya kam pun nyu o kɔr biɛri wain la, ka dunia nanim niŋ zina o sani, ka dunia kɔhigɔriba niŋ bundaannima o kɔr biɛri din galisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.

dag: Amaa yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma zahindi maa mini di gbinni, yi ni nya pina mini laara ni jilima pam n sani. Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma zahindi maa, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: However, if you do tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be greatly rewarded and highly honored. Now tell me the dream and explain what it means.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣisaribila n-zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa, di nyaaŋa ka o lan je o.
en: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.

dag: Tiligim ma ninsalinim nahiŋgu ni, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.

dag: Yihim ninvuɣ biɛri naa kɔbili ni, ka o nam maa leei wuntitali nam.
en: Remove the wicked from the kings presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

dag: dama yi yi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu yi ni kpi, amaa yi yi chɛ ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku yi ninsalitali biɛhigu maa tuma yi ni, yi ni be.
en: For if you live according to your human nature, you are going to die; but if by the Spirit you put to death your sinful actions, you will live.

dag: Naa maa ni daa garigi yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Man Naa n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri gomna Rɛhum mini yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmara Shimshai ni yi tab bɛn kpalim be Samaria zaŋ tabili bɛn zaa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polɔnima.
en: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa gbinni; di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi baŋ di gbinni maa.
en: But the Twelve understood none of these words. The meaning of this message was hidden from them and they didnt grasp what he was saying.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛl o deemba maa, Niriba maa kanimina ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ Naawuni yɛla.
en: Moses answered, Because they come here to find out what God wants them to do.
