dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Neesim shɛŋa neemiya zuɣusaa sagbana ni n-woligi wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ yuŋ, ka neesim maa wuhiri shihira ni saha ni dabisa ni yuma;.
en: Then God said, Let there be lights in the sky. These lights will separate the days from the nights. They will be used for signs to show when special meetings begin and to show the days and years.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bari ma la zana, amaa m bi birigi a zaligunim maa.
en: Though the wicked have set a trap for me, I wont stray from your precepts.

dag: Ka gbarigu maa daa kul vili Pita mini Jɔn gbibi kirikiri, ka di niŋ niriba alahiziba, ka bɛ kab doli ba hal ni kazal shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni.
en: As the man held on to Peter and John in Solomon's Porch, as it was called, the people were amazed and ran to them.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la mali zuɣusuŋ gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be bɛ nyɛviya ni.
en: I decided that it is better for those who have died than for those who are still alive.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ba, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka guliya Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ ya leei Naawuni piɛ shɛb guliba la, ka dihiri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni Cheechi shɛli o ni daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Bia ʒim fa m-bahi la.
en: Look after yourselves and everyone the Holy Spirit has placed in your care. Be like shepherds to God's church. It is the flock he bought with the blood of his own Son.

dag: Mɔɣisim n kpariŋ; a yurilim so wain.
en: Cover me with kisses, for your love is better than wine.

dag: nti zaŋ li da yi suhu ni bɔri shɛli; yi ni tooi da niɣi bee piɛri bee wain bee dam din mali kpiɔŋ bee yi suhu ni kul bɔri shɛli, ka yi mini yi yinsinim ti di li nimaani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.

dag: Yi yi jɛmdi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi bindira mini yi kom ni, ka yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi kɔbili ni.
en: You must serve the Lord your God. If you do this, I will bless you with plenty of bread and water. I will take away all sickness from you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛra n-dar chahi li, ka bɛnkam daa be o sani gba daa niŋ lala.
en: Then David grabbed his clothes and ripped them—and all his soldiers did the same.

dag: Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa, amaa ka lee nyɛ pagɔrili bia. Jɛfita ba n-daa nyɛ Giliad.
en: Jephthah, a brave soldier from Gilead, was the son of a prostitute. His father Gilead.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chani Zarɛfat nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni ka nya pako so ka o be nimaani pihiri dari, ka o bol o yɛl o, Kpɛm ti tooi kom biɛla niŋ pipia ni ti ma na ka n nyu.
en: So Elijah went to Zarephath. He went to the town gate and saw a woman there gathering wood for a fire. She was a widow. Elijah said to her, Would you bring me a small cup of water to drink.

dag: ni yi mali biɛhigu shɛli din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun boli ya kpɛh o nam ni min o jilima ni la nini.
en: We encouraged you, we comforted you, and we told you to live good lives for God. He calls you to be part of his glorious kingdom.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa dol o tab maa gbin na duh o yee pam yɛra, Ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛm biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ka deeg o dalinli la pa o gbiɛɣu zuɣu bee o nuu ni.
en: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.

dag: Di saha Sool daa pun zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la n-ti do so ŋun yuli booni Paliti ka o nyɛ Laishi Gallim nir bia la.
en: Meanwhile, Saul had arranged for Michal to marry Palti the son of Laish, who came from the town of Gallim.

dag: Bɛ daa tila Pɛriʒia gomnanti tuma zuɣulaannim birapu ni bɛ gbarigi bɛ ni daa lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus ʒiɛman ni zaŋ hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: They also bribed Persian government officials to work against them. They kept on doing this throughout the reign of Emperor Cyrus and into the reign of Emperor Darius.

dag: Ka n ni ti ka nimaani na nti to piɛma ata kaman n zahimla binshɛli ka tɔr la.
en: On the third day I will go to that hill and shoot three arrows as if I am shooting at a target.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yaa Izraɛl Naawuni, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛl a dabili m ba Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛli maa niŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: So now, God of Israel, may your promise to your servant David, my father, come true.

dag: Amaa a zuɣu, bɛ kul kuri ti mi dabisili kam, ka niŋdi ti kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Leeban bidibisi yɛrimi, Yaakubu n-fa ti ba binshɛɣukam zaa, ka binshɛlikam din nyɛ ti ba dini, dina ka o zaŋ nya buni.
en: Jacob heard that Labans sons were saying, Jacob took everything our father owned and from it he produced all of this wealth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka yi niŋ, ka n shini, ka yi tɛhi ni m bemi kaman yinim la. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n wuhi ya yi taali, ka galim ya.
en: You have done all this, and I have said nothing, so you thought that I am like you. But now I reprimand you and make the matter plain to you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi bɔri ni a niŋ shɛlikam dɛde, nyin cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba n-zali buni alizanda ni, di nyaaŋa ka kana ti doli ma.
en: Jesus said to him, If you want to be perfect, go and sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven; then come and follow me.

dag: Ka nandaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa yi chani ti dooni bundan maa yiŋ dunol ni, ka yuma kul nyaɣim o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: But a poor beggar named Lazarus was brought to the gate of the rich man's house.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni piɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa zuɣu? Bɛ ni suhiri Naawuni sahakam?.
en: It will be too late for them to enjoy talking with God All-Powerful. They should have prayed to God all the time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti Naa Jɔash daŋa ka chaŋ ka chɛ o, ka o kpambaliba daa lo o nia biɛɣu ka ku o o bindoo zuɣu, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada bia ʒim yihibu la zuɣu. Ka o daa kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o nanim silisi la ni.
en: The Arameans left him badly wounded, but his own officials plotted against him for murdering the son of the priest Jehoiada. So they killed him in his bed. He died and was buried in Davids City but not in the royal cemetery.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ wuhi ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni, amaa pa daliri suŋ zuɣu ka bɛ niŋdi lala. Bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ woligi m mini ya din ni chɛ ka yi baɣa be bɛ ni.
en: They are so concerned about you, though not with good intentions. Rather, they want to shut you out so that you would run after them.

dag: ni di chɛ ka o yihi ba kpaŋa, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka yihi ba karimbaani ni.
en: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride.

dag: Bɛ bi tɛhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋuna n-chɛ ka siɣili saa mini sheen saa mira bɛ mibu saha. Ŋuna n-zaani ti puri atam kpuɣibu saha tiri ti.
en: They dont say in their hearts, Lets fear the LORD our God, who provides rain in autumn and spring and who assures us of a harvest in its season.

dag: Yi na ʒi n-wum di yɛla bee m-mi li. Piligu ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ tipawumlinima. Dama m mi ni yi ni tum yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, ka lan mi ni yi bilim ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ duŋtaariba.
en: You havent heard, nor have you known; as in ages past your ears are closed, because I knew what a traitor you were; you were known as a rebel from birth.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Ti shihila kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka bɔzuɣu ka tinim ku tooi pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu n-zaŋ Yawɛ pini na ti ti o di tibu saha.
en: and said to Moses, We touched a dead body and became unclean. But why must we be kept from offering our gifts to the Lord at the chosen time with the rest of the Israelites.

dag: N Duuma, luɣim a tiba wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu min a daba bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti a yuli jilima la suhigu. Tim a dabili nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka o nya nambɔzɔbo naa sani. Di saha maa mani n-daa nyɛ ŋun boori wain tiri naa.
en: Listen now to my prayer and to the prayers of all your other servants who want to honor you. Give me success today and make the emperor merciful to me. In those days I was the emperor's wine steward.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, yi ni yɛn puhiri chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinim yi sani, ka nyɛ man Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Tell the Israelites: You will announce the Lord s chosen festivals as holy meetings. These are my special festivals.

dag: O daa jɛm Naawuni Zakaria ŋun daa wuh o Naawuni jɛmbu sol la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa jɛmdi Yawɛ saha shɛli maa zaa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Zechariah was Uzziah's advisor and taught him to obey God. And so, as long as Zechariah was alive, Uzziah was faithful to God, and God made him successful.

dag: Ka di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi dɔni bindoo kam zuɣu di ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Any bed on which someone with an emission lies will be unclean, and any object on which that person sits will be unclean.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Zafɔn ti bɔhi Jɛfita, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka bi yɛl ti ka ti kana ti pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ? Ti ni niŋ buɣim nyo a yiŋa ka di di n-kab lu a zuɣu.
en: The men from the tribe of Ephraim called all their soldiers together. Then they went across the river to the city of Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, Why didnt you call us to help you fight the Ammonites? We will burn your house down with you in it.

dag: Hal a yɛn yɛlimi ni m mali galimi? A wuhimi ni m mali galimi din ni wuhi ni a mali yɛlimaŋli?.
en: Are you trying to show that I am unfair? Are you trying to look innocent by saying that I am guilty?.

dag: Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya. Yi yi ku kana n ni kana kaman buɣim la nti lu Yisifu zuliya zuɣu. Ka buɣim maa ni di Bɛtɛlnima, ka so kani n-ni kpihi li.
en: Go to the Lord , and you will live. If you do not go, he will sweep down like fire on the people of Israel. The fire will burn up the people of Bethel, and no one will be able to put it out.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu. Dama alizin biɛ bɔbigu n-daa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: Jesus asked the man, What is your name? He answered, My name is Lots. He said this because there were lots of demons in him.

dag: Chɛliya ka sokam be kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni o be shɛm min o ni daa pun be shɛm ka ti Duuma bol o la. N ni zali shɛm cheechi kam ni m-bala:.
en: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dee lala, ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi yil yidan maa.
en: When they got their silver coin, they complained to the man who owned the land.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɛri ŋma n-saɣim a jɛmbu duu maa ni da shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi la.
en: They looked like woodsmen cutting down trees with their axes.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa mali binshɛŋa daa galisiya pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi laɣim be luɣ yini. Bɛ niɣi zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛli maa bi saɣi ba.
en: He left because the land where he and Jacob were living was not able to support them; they had too much livestock and could no longer stay together.

dag: Ŋunkam miri Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ yi ni kpi, dindina ti zaa kul kpimi maa.
en: and doomed if we even go near the sacred tent.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛli, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa wurimmi be zoya zuɣu kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la. Ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ka zuɣulana, chɛ ka sokam labi kul o yiŋ ni suhudoo. .
en: So Micaiah answered, I can see the army of Israel scattered all over the hills, like sheep with no one to lead them. This is what the Lord says: These men have no leaders. Let them go home in peace.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti neei kaman yuntisuɣu saha n-lɛbig omaŋ tuug o ka di gar o, o ni nya ka paɣ do o naba tiŋli maa zuɣu.
en: During the night he woke up suddenly, turned over, and was surprised to find a woman lying at his feet.

dag: Dama di simdi ni ninvuɣ kura maa kul kpalim be tiliginsim tiŋ maa ni hal ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ti kpi, amaa maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa kum nyaaŋa, ninvuɣ kura maa ni tooi lab omaŋmaŋ ya.
en: Any of you guilty of manslaughter must remain in the city of refuge until the death of the High Priest, but after that you may return home.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni wuhi ya shihirili. Nyamiya, paɣisari so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl.
en: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.

dag: dimbɔŋɔ ka n yɛn niŋ ya, n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya, ka chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din bahiri nir yoli lu yi zuɣu, dɔr shɛli din saɣindi nina ka nyɛ din diri nyɛvili. Ka yi ti biri yi bimbira yoli, dama yi dimnima n-ni ti di li.
en: then I will do the following to you: I will bring horrific things: wasting diseases and fevers that make the eyes fail and drain life away. You will plant seed for no reason because your enemies will eat the food.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɔhiri taba kum ni neebu maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So they kept it to themselves. But they wondered what he meant by the words raised from death.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Di bi sabi yimaŋmaŋ zaligu ni ni Naawuni yɛliya ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ŋmahinli?.
en: Jesus answered, It is written in your law that God said, I said you are gods.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu, dama bɛ zaŋ wuntizɔriba n-kɔhi deei anzinfa laɣibaligu, ka zaŋ nandaamba n-taɣi namda.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of Israel, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because they have sold the innocent for silver, and those in need for a pair of sandals.

dag: Makiri paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maaka la daa dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Pɛrɛsh. O mabia yuli n-daa booni Shɛrɛsh; o mi mabihi yuya n-daa booni Ulam mini Rɛkɛm.
en: Machirs wife Maacah gave birth to a son and named him Peresh. His brothers name was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.

dag: Dinzuɣu m po pɔri yɛli Ɛli min o yiŋnima ni sara maligu bee wumpaɣibo pini lan kani din ni tooi nyahi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa hal abada.
en: I warned Eli that sacrifices or offerings could never make things right! His family has done too many disgusting things.

dag: O yiŋ nyɛla so shɛli din kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka nyɛ din kuni kum shee.
en: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.

dag: O yurilim maŋli la naala zaa? O daalikaulinim la zanila tariga sahakam maa?.
en: Is his love gone forever? Will he never again speak to us?.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla jɛlinsi yɛtɔɣa m-muɣisiri ma, ka lu n zuɣu ka di ka daliri.
en: They are saying hateful things about me. They are attacking me for no reason.

dag: Rama mini Gɛba — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisiniyini.
en: from the towns of Ramah and Geba:.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai, ka ti yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣili noli luɣ shɛli ti ni daa tɛhi ni Naawuni suhibu shee be n-daa ti ʒini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim sani n-tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: On the Sabbath day we went out the city gate to the river. There we thought we might find a special place for prayer. Some women had gathered there, so we sat down and talked with them.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Anabi Aizaia ni daa pun yɛli yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli kaman di ni daa sab shɛm ni Naawuni yɛliya: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: Jesus replied: You are nothing but show-offs! The prophet Isaiah was right when he wrote that God had said, All of you praise me with your words, but you never really think about me.

dag: Ka bo wɔr shɛb Pool ni ti yɛn ba n-zali, ka mal o baalim tahi Gomna Filiksi sani.
en: Have horses ready for Paul to ride, so they may take him safely to Governor Felix.

dag: Ka pukpar kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, N dana, chɛl li zali yuuni ŋɔ pahi, ka n gbi bɔɣili gil li n-niŋ kulim niŋ li.
en: But the gardener answered, Leave it alone, sir, just one more year; I will dig around it and put in some fertilizer.

dag: bɛ daŋ niriba maa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tusaata ni kɔbisiyi.
en: There were men in the families of the Merari family group who were qualified.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔritiŋmana.
en: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a nambɔzɔbo min a yurilim maŋli la yɛla; dama di nyɛla din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha.
en: Remember, O Lord , your kindness and constant love which you have shown from long ago.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ niriba pam na ti lir a, ka bɛ ti lab a kuɣa, ka zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmahiŋmah a jilajila.
en: They will bring a crowd of people and throw rocks at you to kill you. Then they will cut you into pieces with their swords.

dag: Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani, ka Ɛdom nyɛ n ni pirigiri n namda sɔŋdi luɣ shɛli; n ni ŋme nasaridibo kuŋa m-bahi Filistianim zuɣu.
en: But Moab is my washbowl; Ill throw my shoe at Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia!.

dag: amaa ka yi bi niŋ yɛda, ka di nyɛla yi ni pa m piɛri la zuɣu.
en: but you dont believe because you dont belong to my sheep.

dag: Man Yawɛ je ŋmɛndintoli tuma mini alahichi, amaa m bɔrila yɛlimaŋli soli. N ʒiɛyimtali puuni, n ni tin ya laara, ka lɔn ya alikauli din ku zani tariga.
en: Thats because I am the Lord and I love justice. I hate stealing and everything that is wrong. So I will give the people what they deserve. I will make an agreement with my people forever.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ! Kul paɣimiy o ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ami! Ami!.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel. He always was, and he always will be. Amen and Amen!.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, O tum zina hal ti gbarigi, amaa ka dɔbba na kul bɔr o.
en: Then I spoke to one of the women who was worn out from her sexual sins. I asked her, Will they continue to do sexual sins with her, and she with them.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa shiri ni niŋ pali ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: Great blessings are yours because you believed what the Lord said to you! You believed this would happen.

dag: Noli ni ti din ya yi fɔntinsi ni, ka din ya yi puri ni.
en: The Lord will curse you in the city and in the field.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Piimiya yi ni na yoli gbahi zahin shɛb maa ni na.
en: Jesus told his disciples, Bring some of the fish you just caught.

dag: yɛl o, Chɛl a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ka yiɣisi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-looi n ni yɛn wuh a tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: God told him, Leave your homeland and kin, and go to the land that I will show you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Magdol mini Tapanhɛs ni Mɛmfisi zaŋ tabili Patrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word for the Judeans living in the land of Egypt, those living in Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis and in the land of Pathros.

dag: Abija ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛrɔbɔam daa bi lan nya yaa, ka Yawɛ daa ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: Jeroboam failed to regain power during the time of Abijah. The LORD finally struck him down, and he died.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ o ba sani ti bol o, M ba! Ka o saɣi ka bɔh o, Ka m bi ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: Then Jacob went to his father and said, Father! Yes, he answered. Which of my sons are you.

dag: A yɛligu ka n zaŋ sɔɣi n suhu ni, ni di chɛ ka n ku tum alahichi a sani.
en: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.

dag: Yi yi ti daai yi dimnim pihi luhi ka ku ba dahin shɛli, kom ni ti zɔri yiri zoya din du pam mini kuŋkuna din du pam zaa ni na.
en: On the day when the forts of your enemies are captured and their people are killed, streams of water will flow from every mountain and every hill.

dag: amaa bɛ daa ka bia, dama Ɛlizabɛt daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo m-pahi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa lan kurigi pam.
en: But they had no children. Elizabeth could not have a baby, and both of them were very old.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti yuri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni bihi. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti yuri Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima.
en: This is how we know that we love God's children: it is by loving God and obeying his commands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The tenth day of the seventh month is the day when the annual ritual is to be performed to take away the sins of the people. On that day do not eat anything at all; come together for worship, and present a food offering to the Lord .

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Niriba nahindi ma ka di ka soli. Sɔŋm ma!.
en: All your commands can be trusted. Those people are wrong to persecute me. Help me!.

dag: Saha shɛli Sulemaana ni daa ti kurigi, o paɣiba maa daa shiri ŋmalig o suhu n-labisi buɣa jɛmbu polo; ka o daa bi lan doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ o suhu ni ni yɛlimaŋli kaman o ba Dauda la.
en: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods. He wasnt committed to the LORD his God with all his heart as was his father David.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo faralan maa piɛr anahi, o ni tum shɛm maa min o ni bi zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: He must pay four times the price of the lamb because he did this terrible thing and because he had no mercy.

dag: Bi shɛb bɛn doli zaligu nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm. Amaa bi shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi pulaannim zuɣu nyɛla bɛn dihiri bɛ banim mini bɛ manim vi.
en: A smart son obeys the laws, but a son who spends time with worthless people brings shame to his father.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti yi mabihi maa vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo ba alikauli shɛm la, dinzuɣu labimiya kuli yi biɛhigu shee din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli polo, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun zaŋ luɣ shɛli tin ya la.
en: The Lord your God promised to give the Israelites peace. And now, he has kept his promise, so now you can go home. The Lord s servant Moses gave you the land on the east side of the Jordan River. Now you can go home to that land.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa man yɛligu ku yiɣisi.
en: The sky and the earth won't last forever, but my words will.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so n-niŋ amaŋka ni n-ʒi o ka Yisa sanna; ka Yisa daa nya bɛ ni niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: People brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a cot. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man who was paralyzed, Be encouraged, my child, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, ka so bi yɛri yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ wuhila bɛ zilima ʒiri ŋmabu. Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri ka di gbarigi ba hal ka bɛ ku lan tooi niŋ tuuba.
en: One cheats the other; no one tells the truth; they train themselves to lie; they wear themselves out by doing wrong.

dag: Zaŋm neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni zaŋ ti a ni a zaŋ ti Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni, ka bɛ mal li tumdi yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma la ti.
en: You are to present to God in Jerusalem all the utensils that have been given to you for use in the Temple services.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa yihi Izraɛlnim zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gbilligbilli.
en: And on that same day the Lord brought Israel's families and tribes out of Egypt.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Sariakarita so n-daa be tinshee; o daa bi zɔri Naawuni, ka mi bi lan lihiri nyari daadam kam.
en: He said, In a certain city there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected people.

dag: Dama tinim ku tooi chɛ ti ni daa nya ka wum shɛli maa yɛla tɔɣisibu.
en: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.

dag: Niriba yɛri a yurilim maŋli yɛla gballi ni? Bee a ʒiɛyimtali tumdi tuma saɣiŋgu shee?.
en: The dead in their graves cannot talk about your faithful love. People in the world of the dead cannot talk about your faithfulness.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, Chamiya ti sɔɣi do wain tihi pur la ni gu.
en: So they instructed the Benjaminites, Go and hide like an ambush in the vineyards.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum n Duuma kukoli ka di yɛra, Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn tim, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti ti? Ka n daa yɛli, N-nyɛ ma; timmi ma.
en: After this, I heard the Lord ask, Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us? I'll go, I answered. Send me.

dag: Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Bɔ ka yi lee du m-ba ka na kul be ti ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛli ŋɔ puuni maa.
en: I am King Sennacherib of Assyria, and I have Jerusalem surrounded. Do you think you can survive my attack?.

dag: Ka di yi di nyɛla n niŋ o la zaɣ biɛɣu ka binshɛli mi bi sɔɣiri naa sani, di saha a ku zani n nyaaŋa.
en: But if I had disobeyed the king and killed Absalom, the king would have heard about it—he hears about everything—and you would not have defended me.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb mi Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shimia mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi, o paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua, ka o nyɛ Ammiɛl bipuɣiŋga la bihi.
en: and during that time, he had more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa ti paai Mariama sani o yɛl o mi, M puhir a nyin ŋun mal alibarika pam ŋɔ, ti Duuma be a sani! A mal alibarika paɣiba ni.
en: The angel came to her and said, Peace be with you! The Lord is with you and has greatly blessed you.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, M bia, Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni ti ti piɛ so ti ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul dol tab chana.
en: Abraham said, The lamb for the entirely burned offering? God will see to it, my son. The two of them walked on together.

dag: O nol daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka kuko shɛli yi zuɣusaa na yɛli, Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N deeg a nam yiko a sani.
en: The words were still in his mouth when a voice came from heaven. The voice said, King Nebuchadnezzar, these things will happen to you: Your power as king has been taken away from you.

dag: O daa bi nya ka di nyɛ shɛli ni o tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la tatabo. O daa kpuɣila Sidɔn Naa Ɛtibaal bipuɣiŋga Jɛzibɛl n-niŋ o paɣa, ka daa jɛmdi buɣili Baal.
en: It was not enough for him to sin like King Jeroboam; he went further and married Jezebel, the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon, and worshiped Baal.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ maa, ka bɛ tiŋsi lab nyaaŋa ti lu tiŋa.
en: At once they all backed away and fell to the ground.

dag: hal ka di pala bɛ zuliya maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ni o laɣim Naawuni bihi bɛn wurim kpe yɔɣu na la gba ka bɛ ti lee zaɣ yini.
en: and not only for them, but also to bring together into one body all the scattered people of God.

dag: Dama n niriba ŋɔ tibidarigibo maa galisi gari Sɔdomnim tibidarigibo la, din daa wurim nini pɔbbu ni neebu ka so nuu daa bi shihi li la.
en: Greater was the punishment of the daughter of my people than Sodoms penalty, which was quickly overthrown without any hand-wringing.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; chamiya ti yɛli m mabihi maa ni bɛ cham Galili; nimaani ka bɛ ni ti nya ma.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Dont be afraid. Go and tell my brothers that I am going into Galilee. They will see me there.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garig o bɔhigunim maa zaa, ka binshɛɣu daa kani din sɔɣi ka Sulemaana bi tooi kahigi li wuhi paɣ maa.
en: He answered them all; there was nothing too difficult for him to explain.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ; nyamiya, ŋun yi n nyaaŋa maa paana.
en: Stand up! We must go. Here comes the one who will hand me over.

dag: Wummiya! Man Pool yɛri ya mi ni yi yi gunda, Masia ku mali ya buchi.
en: Look, I, Paul, am telling you that if you have yourselves circumcised, having Christ wont help you.

dag: Aai, bɛ zaa pa shɛli, bɛ tuma ka buchi; bɛ binnana gba ka yiko.
en: All these gods are useless; they can do nothing at all— these idols are weak and powerless.

dag: A niŋ bindirigu zali n tooni n dimnim ninni. A niŋ kpam ʒe n zuɣu. A chɛ ka m pipia pali hal ti puuri bahira.
en: You prepared a meal for me in front of my enemies. You welcomed me as an honored guest. My cup is full and spilling over.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli Rut, M bia, guhimi nya yɛla maa zaa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm. Doo maa ku vuhi ka pa ni o nyala yɛla maa kpaa shee zuŋɔ.
en: Naomi said to her, Now be patient, Ruth, until you see how this all turns out. Boaz will not rest today until he settles the matter.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Jɔn Baptaizira gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ŋun pɔri alizanda nam ni galisi gar o.
en: I assure you that John the Baptist is greater than anyone who has ever lived. But the one who is least in the Kingdom of heaven is greater than John.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa dii zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni n-zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu.
en: Quickly, one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled the sponge with sour wine and tied the sponge to a stick. Then he used the stick to give the sponge to Jesus to get a drink from it.

dag: Ka bulaa la mi wuhiri Giriis naa yɛla. Ka o yil gahindili din daa sa o nina ayi sunsuuni la nyɛla di tuuli naa.
en: The goat is the king of Greece. The big horn between its eyes is the first king.

dag: Ka Hanania daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niriba maa zaa sani yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n yɛn kabi Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza naɣikɔra dapua la zuliya kam nyiŋgoya ni yuma ayi puuni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka anabi Jɛrimia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: Then he said, The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years. I left the temple.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa kana ti ʒini n tooni ni bɛ bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ binshɛli.
en: One day some of the elders of Israel came to me to ask the Lord for advice. This was on the tenth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of exile. The elders sat down in front of me.

dag: Asa ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahiyinika o nam maa ni saha shɛli, ka naba polo dɔro daa gbaag o, ka o dɔro maa daa muɣis o pam; amaa dɔro maa ni daa muɣis o maa zaa yoli, o daa bi suhi Yawɛ, amaa ka naɣ dolila timanim bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, Asa developed a severe foot disease. But even in his illness he refused to seek the LORD and consulted doctors instead.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa maan o ansarisi ka ŋmɛr o.
en: The men who were holding Jesus in custody taunted him while they beat him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim puuni Naawuni Shia Kasi kahigi wuhi ni tuuli tanti duu la ni daa na kul ʒiɛya la zuɣu, di wuhiya ni Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la soli na bi yooi.
en: The Holy Spirit clearly teaches from all these arrangements that the way into the Most Holy Place has not yet been opened as long as the outer tent still stands.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Sool Dauda ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Sauls servants reported what David said.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi.
en: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.

dag: Ka bɛn fabindi be kaman bɛn bi fabinda, ka bɛn mali suhupiɛlli be kaman bɛn ka suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn dari nɛma be kaman bɛn bi su nɛma maa;.
en: It should not be important whether you are sad or whether you are happy. If you buy something, it should not matter to you that you own it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani ka boli ba na ti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: Jesus stopped and said to them, What do you want me to do for you.

dag: Ka Shɛm mini Jafɛt daa kpuɣi kparibu m-pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu n-tirisi bɛ nyaaŋa kpe nti zaŋ li pa bɛ ba zuɣu, ka bi nya bɛ ba zaɣim.
en: Shem and Japheth took a robe, put it across their shoulders, and walked backward into the tent. Then they covered their father without looking at him.

dag: ni pipihi ni firila kpihindisi ni taha ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu lahi ni salima alali buɣim moori taha ni salima chɛulɔnim din gbib Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni Luɣ Kasi shee la pununim mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sambani polo pununim la.
en: the cups, lamp snuffers, bowls, dishes for incense, and the pans used for carrying live coals; and the hinges for the doors of the Most Holy Place and of the outer doors of the Temple. All these furnishings were made of gold.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa lee bela ya? Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam, ka dabiɛm kpe ba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: Then he said to the disciples, Where is your faith? But they were amazed and afraid, and said to one another, Who is this man? He gives orders to the winds and waves, and they obey him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni kahig o ni chɛ ka nir yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani shɛm yɛla wuhi palɔni, ka di pala fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu min anabinim yɛligu gba nyɛla din pun di dimbɔŋɔ shɛhira.
en: But now Gods righteousness has been revealed apart from the Law, which is confirmed by the Law and the Prophets.

dag: Amaa yi ni yi alahichi dabitim ni pumpɔŋɔ n-yipa leela Naawuni daba ŋɔ, yi ni nya nyɔ shɛli di ni nyɛla biɛr kasi, ka di bahigu nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: But now you are free from sin. You have become slaves of God, and the result is that you live only for God. This will bring you eternal life.

dag: Zaligu shɛli din gbibi niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so daɣiri ni yibu saha zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: These are the rules for people who have had a skin disease and have been made well. These rules are for making them clean. A priest must look at those who had the skin disease.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Samaria, o daa kula Ɛhab daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim Samaria zaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Ilaija shɛm la.
en: Jehu came to Samaria and killed all Ahabs family who were still alive in Samaria. He killed them all. He did what the Lord had told Elijah.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: But if you keep on being faithful right to the end, you will be saved.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti zo n-tiligi tɔb maa ni ni ti yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla niriba biɛla. Ka Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa kpalim, ka chaŋ ti be Ijipti la ti baŋ ŋun yɛligu yɛn niŋ pali, n dini bee bɛ dini.
en: But a few of you will escape death and return from Egypt to Judah. Then the survivors will know whose words have come true, mine or theirs.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Tiŋgbana ayi ŋɔ mini di fɔntinsi ayi ŋɔ nyɛla ti dini, ka ti ni deei li su, hal Yawɛ ni kul be di ni maa zaa yoli.
en: You said, These two nations and countries, Israel and Judah, will be mine. We will take them for our own. But the Lord is there!.

dag: Tizɔra ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka yaalana ti kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka kpiɔŋlana ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: Not even fast runners will escape; strong men will lose their strength, and soldiers will not be able to save their own lives.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nira niŋ siɣa ni yɛm dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Zuɣur ayopɔin maa nyɛla zoya ayopɔin shɛŋa zuɣu paɣ maa ni du n-ʒiya;.
en: You need wisdom to understand this. The seven heads on the beast are the seven hills where the woman sits. They are also seven rulers.

dag: Dama ti wum kuhigu damli Ziɔn. Ti bahi yoli. Ti di vi zaa! Di simdi ni ti yi ti tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ daai ti yinsi luhi.
en: Listen to the sound of crying in Zion: We are ruined! We are completely disgraced! We must leave our land; our homes have been torn down.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani binnɛma anahi. Bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa ŋmanila ninsalinima.
en: Inside the cloud, there were four living beings that looked like people.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara pinaata ni di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna zuliya niriba.
en: Thirteen cities in all, with their pasture lands, were given to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.

dag: Nyamiya, n paɣimi neei ya zaa. Pa bɛ ni paɣiri anzinfa shɛm la, amaa wahala ka n zaŋ buɣisi ya.
en: Look, I will make you pure, but not in the way you make silver pure. I will make you pure by giving you troubles.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa wuh o di sol la zuɣu.
en: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord .

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: If those who have died are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.

dag: Bɛ yuri maa ni ti galisi hal ka bɛ taŋkpagbiligu ti lim ya, ka wɔribariba mini bɛ tɔrokɔnim ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi vuri ti chɛ ka yi dikiya sɔhigi, bɛ ni kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman nira ni kpɛri tin shɛli din wurim ni shɛm la.
en: The dust from all his horses will cover you when he enters your gates as one who enters a breached city. Your walls will quake at the thundering of the charioteers and chariot wheels.

dag: Ka zoya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la, ka daboya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la.
en: The mountains leaped away like rams; the hills leaped away like lambs!.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi di binshɛli din mali dabindi, Di simdi ni yi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: Stay away from yeast, no matter where you live. No one is allowed to eat anything made with yeast!.

dag: Dama m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni kum bee nyɛvili bee malaikanim bee alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bee binyara din be pumpɔŋɔ bee binyara din ti yɛn kana bee yikombiɛri.
en: For I am certain that nothing can separate us from his love: neither death nor life, neither angels nor other heavenly rulers or powers, neither the present nor the future.

dag: Buɣim mini sakuɣa ni gulisigu ni sanʒiɛɣu din deer o noli, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, fire and hail, snow and clouds, and the stormy winds that obey him.

dag: Samarianim ni ti ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu, dama bɛ zaɣisi bɛ Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi tiŋ chɛrisichɛrisi, ka karigi bɛ paɣipuhinim puya.
en: Samaria must be punished because she turned against her God. The Israelites will be killed with swords. Their children will be torn to pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya ni kpamba anahi daa beni, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Jɔhanan bia Azaria mini Mɛshilɛmɔt bia Bɛrɛkia ni Shallum bia Jɛhizikia ni Hadilai bia Amasa; bɛna n-daa yiɣisi zani galim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi tɔb tuhibu yɔɣu kuli maa na.
en: At this, some of the Ephraimite leaders—Johanans son Azariah, Meshillemoths son Berechiah, Shallums son Jehizkiah, and Hadlais son Amasa—confronted those returning from battle.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: The total number of men in these family groups from the tribe of Gad was .

dag: Mbusim be dunia ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛŋa din be di ni n-chɛri ka niriba birigiri tumd alahichi zuɣu! Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nira alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi zuɣu.
en: I feel sorry for the people in the world because of the things that make people sin. These things must happen, but it will be very bad for anyone who causes them to happen.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ka yi su li yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua.
en: These are the men who will help you divide the land: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun.

dag: Di saha ka kpambaliba maa daa yɛli Baruk, Cham ka a mini Jɛrimia ti sɔɣi, ka di chɛnya ka so baŋ yi ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: The officials said, You and Jeremiah must go into hiding, and don't tell anyone where you are going.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa wum li, ka o chaŋ ti du n-tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu n-kuhi yɛli ba, Yinim Shɛkɛmnima, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, ka Naawuni wum yi gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm!.
en: Jotham heard what they were doing. So he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted down to the people who were there at the meeting: Leaders of Shechem, listen to me, and maybe God will listen to you.

dag: Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: I have not come to call respectable people to repent, but outcasts.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ka yi ti tɛhi ni yi ni mali niriba pam, ka lan mali salima naɣila shɛb Jɛrɔbɔam ni mali tin ya, ka bɛ nyɛ yi buɣa la zuɣu yi ni tooi tuhi Yawɛ nam shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ Dauda bihi nuu ni ŋɔ.
en: Now, you people have decided to defeat the Lord s kingdom—the kingdom that is ruled by Davids sons. You have so many people with you and you have the golden calves—the gods that Jeroboam made for you.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni n-lee zali wuntaŋa ni di ne dabisili puuni, ka zali goli mini saŋmarisi ni bɛ mi ne yuŋ? Ka ŋuni n-lee damdi teeku ka di kɔgbana vura? O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: He makes the sun shine in the day, and he makes the moon and the stars shine at night. He stirs up the sea so that its waves crash on the shore. The Lord All-Powerful is his name. This is what the Lord says:.

dag: Yi bi bɔri ni yi saɣi ni dabisi biɛɣu dali mirina, amaa yi ni niŋdi shɛm lee chɛmi ka dindali maa mirina.
en: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka yi daa guni gunibu shɛli din pa ninsal ni niŋ shɛli, amaa ka nyɛla Masia maŋmaŋ ni niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛ o ni yihi ya niŋgbuŋ din tumd alahichi ŋɔ alahichi maa yiko dabitim puuni la zuɣu.
en: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not administered by human hands. The circumcision of Christ is realized in the stripping away of the whole self dominated by sin.

dag: Amaa nyin kul dol a ni daa bɔhim yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa yɛla ka niŋ li yɛda la viɛnyɛliŋga. A mi a karimbanim ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: But you should continue following the teaching you learned. You know it is true, because you know you can trust those who taught you.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So obey the LORD your Gods voice. Do his commandments and his regulations that Im giving you right now.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ li ka maligumaana sanna, ka maligumaana maa ti too li nukurigu pali n-yihi di chihili maa n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la zuɣu; di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You shall bring it to the priest, who will take a handful of it as a token that it has all been offered to the Lord , and he will burn it on the altar as a food offering. It is an offering to take away sin.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla mani bee bɛna, lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri tiri ya, ka lahibal suŋ maa mi nyɛ yi ni daa niŋ shɛli yɛda la.
en: So then it is not important if I told you Gods message or if it was the other apostles who told you—we all tell people the same message, and this is what you believed.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun na yoli niŋ tuuba; di yi nyɛ lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti niŋ karimbaani duh omaŋa, ka saria karibu di o kaman di ni daa di Sintani shɛm la.
en: They shouldnt be new believers so that they wont become proud and fall under the devils spell.

dag: N ni yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni na, ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni laɣim taba n-zaŋ ba tahi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni ti dihiri ba Izraɛl zoya zuɣu mini kom ni be luɣ shɛŋa ni ni niriba ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: I will gather and lead them out from the countries and peoples, and I will bring them to their own fertile land. I will feed them on Israels highlands, along the riverbeds, and in all the inhabited places.

dag: ka ti daai yi dikiya luhi n-dahimdahim li pa yi mini yi bihi zuɣu; hal ka tandaɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu, yi ni bi baŋ saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa kana ni o ti tiligi ya la zuɣu.
en: They will level you to the ground and kill your people. Not one stone in your buildings will be left on top of another. This will happen because you did not see that God had come to save you.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ka wɔɣawɔɣa, ka nyɛ Anaki zuliya bɛn nyɛ yi ni pun mi shɛb la. Yi pun wum ka niriba yɛri bɛ yɛla, Ŋuni n-leei ni tooi zani Anakinim tooni.
en: The people themselves are tall and strong; they are giants, and you have heard it said that no one can stand against them.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu din mali nyɛvili ka ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu ka yi nya dɔɣim palli, ka yɛligu maa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din bi kpira, ka mi ku pooi.
en: Do this because you have been given new birth—not from the type of seed that decays but from seed that doesnt. This seed is Gods life-giving and enduring word.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya n taali yim ŋɔ yaha, ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa ti ma ka o yihi ma kum ŋɔ ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Forgive me one more time and ask the Lord to stop these insects from killing every living plant.

dag: ka Naawuni jilima yi yi palo Daadam Bia zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni chɛ ka Daadam Bia gba jilima yi palo ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ zuɣu; ka di mi ku yuui ka o chɛ ka o nya jilima maa.
en: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.

dag: Yi Duuma ni chɛ ka yi nya wahala ni nahiŋgu, amaa ŋuna ŋun maŋmaŋ nyɛ yi karimba maa ku lan sɔɣi ka chɛn ya, amaa o ni chɛ ka yi nini nya o, ka o wuhi ya.
en: The Lord will make you go through hard times, but he himself will be there to teach you, and you will not have to search for him any more.

dag: Tuuli, n daa wumya ni yi yi mali cheechi laɣiŋgu, woligibu be yi sunsuuni, ka n tɛhiri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: First of all, when you meet together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you, and I partly believe it.

dag: dama Naa Hɛrɔd daa zɔri Jɔn pam ka gul o viɛnyɛliŋga, o ni daa mi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋli ni wuntizɔra la zuɣu. Jɔn Baptaizira yɛligu daa yi chihiri Naa Hɛrɔd suhu pam, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa yi wumdi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: because Herod was afraid of John and protected him. He knew that John was a good and holy man. Even though Herod was confused by what John said, he was glad to listen to him. And he often did.

dag: Ka Zimiri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Zimris deeds and the plot he carried out, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa garigi yɛli Adɔnija, Aai, dama ti dan Naa Dauda zaŋ Sulemaana leei naa;.
en: But Jonathan answered, No, it is not good news for you! King David has made Solomon the new king.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ŋariŋ maa tumtumdiba ka bɛ zaa yinoyino gbaai bɛ wuna kabu, ka kpuɣiri ŋarin titali maa ni nɛma bahiri kom ni ni di chɛ ka ŋarin titali maa tibisim filim. Amaa ka Jona ŋun daa kpɛla ŋarin titali maa puuni ha nti doya gbihira.
en: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa laɣim doli kuli Nazarɛt, ka o daa deeri bɛ noli. Ka o ma daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: Jesus went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. His mother cherished every word in her heart.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri kuri ba solɔri zuɣu, ka dabiɛm pam ti be duri puuni. Di ni paai nachimbihi mini paɣipiɛlisi ni bimɔɣirisi ni ninkura bɛn zuɣuri paligi.
en: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ: kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim ni tammɛriba, ka da dari mini kuɣ bɔɣa din yɛn zaŋ mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Use that money for the carpenters, stonemasons, and stonecutters. Also use that money to buy the timber and cut stones that are needed to repair the Temple.

dag: Bia maa ni daa kul ŋmaligi naai, di daa bi yuui ka Dauda yi kuɣa maa lɔŋni na nti lu n-gbani n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka silim o zuɣu buta; ka bɛ va m-bibigi taba, ka kum niŋ taba. Dauda n-daa kum pam gari Jɔnatan.
en: After the boy had left, David got up from behind the pile of stones, fell on his knees and bowed with his face to the ground three times. Both he and Jonathan were crying as they kissed each other; David's grief was even greater than Jonathan's.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa ni noonsi balibu kam ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛn chani gindi dunia ni balibu kam zaa daa dol taba yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: All the animals, all the livestock, all the birds, and everything crawling on the ground, came out of the ark by their families.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, M Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni bi sa ti shɛlikam ni vuɣi lu.
en: Jesus replied, Every plant that my heavenly Father didnt plant will be pulled up.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi.
en: After everyone had eaten all they wanted.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zaadali Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I assure you that it will be more bearable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on Judgment Day than it will be for that city.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: Ahimaaz spoke to Joab again, No matter what happens, I still want to go. And besides, the Ethiopian has already left. Joab said, Why should you go? You won't get a reward for the news you have.

dag: N daa wum a yɛla la n tibili ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n nini nya a;.
en: My ears had heard about you, but now my eyes have seen you.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n na zaŋdila pini tahiri Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti sɔŋ Yisa nyaandoliba.
en: But now Im going to Jerusalem, to serve Gods people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pɔri Samaria buɣili Ashima yɛra, Dan, a buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu, bee n-yɛra, Bɛrishiiba buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu; bɛ ni lu ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria, and say, As your god lives, Dan, and, As the way of Beer-sheba lives— even they will fall and never rise again.

dag: Bɛ pala dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm.
en: Just as I do not belong to the world, they do not belong to the world.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala. Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Gidiɔn yiɣisi asiba, o daa kahim piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu maligim palila pipia.
en: And that is exactly what happened. Gideon got up early the next morning and squeezed the sheepskin. He was able to drain a bowl full of water from it.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ wuntitali zuɣupil shɛli ti Duuma ŋun mali wuntia n-kariti saria la ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti ma di dabisili la dali n-do n-guli ma, ka di pala n kɔŋko ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ti, amaa o ni ti zaŋ li ti bɛnkam zaa gba suhuri ye o labbuna zuɣu la.
en: And now there is waiting for me the victory prize of being put right with God, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give me on that Day—and not only to me, but to all those who wait with love for him to appear.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee sɔŋ ya ka yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ? Ka ŋuni shia n-lee yi yi sanna maa.
en: Who helped you say these things? Whose spirit inspired you to speak?.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn tɛhi lala baŋ ni ti ni yɛri shɛm ti gbana puuni maa, lala ka ti ni niŋ ti yi ti be yi sani gba.
en: Those people should know this: When we are there with you, we will show the same power that we show now in our letters.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Tama, A yidan ba chanila Timna ni o ti chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: Tamar found out that her father-in-law Judah was going to Timnah to shear his sheep.

dag: Sulemaana daa dila nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa yuun pihinahi.
en: After Solomon had ruled years from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bulaa la mi wuhiri Giriis naa yɛla. Ka o yil gahindili din daa sa o nina ayi sunsuuni la nyɛla di tuuli naa.
en: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n noli paɣi Yawɛ pam; n ni paɣ o salo sunsuuni.
en: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord , when your people meet.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, Naawuni darigi a tibili naai a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ku lan chɛ ka a be tinzun tiŋ ni. Amaa nyini Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga, a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ni darig a tibili. O ni yih a daalahichi maa palo.
en: Zion has paid for her sin; the Lord will not keep us in exile any longer. But Edom, the Lord will punish you; he will expose your guilty acts.

dag: Ka sala buɣimniɛm yiri neesim shɛli din be o sani maa ni na.
en: burning coals flamed up from the lightning before him.

dag: Ɛli bidibisi daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yoya; bɛ baɣa daa ka Yawɛ ni.
en: Now Elis sons were despicable men who didnt know the LORD.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi bɛba ayopɔin daa doli bɛ nyaaŋa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na nti zani naɣ bɛmbala maa sani Nail Mɔɣili maa duli.
en: Then seven other cows came up; they were thin and bony. They came and stood by the other cows on the riverbank.

dag: M mabihi, n yɛri ya mi ni saha maa bi lan wɔɣa. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni bɛn mali paɣiba be kaman bɛn ka paɣiba.
en: Brothers and sisters, this is what I mean: We dont have much time left. So starting now, those who have wives should be the same as those who dont.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa ti kpe yili maa ni dahin shɛli ni o ti tum o tuma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be yili maa ni kani.
en: One day Joseph went into the house to do his work. He was the only man in the house at the time.

dag: ka a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino bee bɛ zaa yi mi bɛ wahala mini bɛ suhugarigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka teei bɛ nuhi tiri duu ŋɔ polo na n-fabili niŋ a ka suh a.
en: Please listen when anyone in Israel truly feels sorry and sincerely prays with arms lifted toward your temple.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti ka lu ti zuɣu; a je suli niŋ ti. Labisim ti zali yaha!.
en: You have rejected us, God, and defeated us; you have been angry with us—but now turn back to us.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman daba anii dali ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: About eight days after Jesus said these things, he took Peter, John, and James and went up on a mountain to pray.

dag: Ka o ni daa kul tum tuun shɛlikam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni min o ni daa gbibi Naawuni zaligu shɛm ni o ni daa bo Naawuni shɛm, o daa niŋ li mi ni o suhu zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka o di nasara.
en: He was successful, because everything he did for the Temple or in observance of the Law, he did in a spirit of complete loyalty and devotion to his God.

dag: Di saha a ni ti teei a ni daa be shɛm la yɛla, ka vi gbaag a. Saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ a mabihi bɛn nyɛ a biɛli min a tizo la ti a kaman a bipuɣinsi la. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala n ni lo a alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: You will remember how you have acted, and be ashamed of it when you get your older sister and your younger sister back. I will let them be like daughters to you, even though this was not part of my covenant with you.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hɛburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: O kɔŋko n-daa yɛrigi sagbana, ka no teeku kɔgbana sɔŋ.
en: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ti ku ba, amaa bɛn ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, bɛn ni be. Bɛ ni ti leei bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba ka be.
en: the Lord had said, Whoever stays on in the city will die in war or of starvation or disease. But those who go out and surrender to the Babylonians will not be killed; they will at least escape with their life.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banim mi di yihiriya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka bɛ ti yihi tahima.
en: Parents, dont provoke your children in a way that ends up discouraging them.

dag: M biɛhigu shee ni ti be bɛ sani ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ gba nyɛ n niriba.
en: My Holy Tent will be with them. Yes, I will be their God and they will be my people.

dag: Filistianim ni daa zaŋ bintɔra kɔtomsi salima din nyɛ alahichi sanyoo pini m-pahi ti ti Yawɛ la zaɣ yini daa nyɛla Ashidɔdnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gazanim dini, ka yini nyɛ Ashikɛlɔnnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gaatinim dini, ka yini mi nyɛ Ɛkurɔn nim dini.
en: The Philistines sent the five gold tumors to the Lord as a gift to pay for their sins, one each for the cities of Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.

dag: O mali ninkuunsi ni o bihi, di bi ŋman o bihi n-nyɛ ba; hal o wahala ni yɛn bahi yoli maa o baɣa kani.
en: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.

dag: Dama Babilɔn naa maa ʒiɛla sochira zuɣu ni o vihi nya o ni yɛn doli so shɛli. O chaɣisi piɛma, ka niŋ buɣa saawara, ka vihi maligu biŋkɔbigu binsabili.
en: The king of Babylonia stands by the signpost at the fork of the road. To discover which way to go, he shakes the arrows; he consults his idols; he examines the liver of a sacrificed animal.

dag: ka yi yi karim n ni pun sab shɛli maa, yi ni tooi nya n ni baŋ Masia daashili maa yɛla shɛm.
en: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.

dag: ni bɛnkam zaa daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi ni Lɛbanɔn hal ti paai Misirɛfɔtimaim hal ni Sidɔnnim zaa. Man maŋmaŋa n-yɛn be Izraɛlnim tooni n-kari ba bahi, nyin dini nyɛla a piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnim ka bɛ su li kaman n ni pun yɛl a shɛm la.
en: I myself will remove the entire population of the highlands from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim before the Israelites, that is, all the Sidonians. You have only to allot it to Israel as a legacy exactly as I commanded you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi n-chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: He did this so as to make come true what God had said through the prophet Isaiah:.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: Jesus followers began to have an argument about which one of them was the greatest.

dag: Ti suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la maŋmaŋ mini ti Duuma Yisa ni bɛ mali soli ti ti ka ti kana ti kaai ya.
en: May our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus prepare the way for us to come to you!.

dag: Di daba anu nyaaŋa ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Ananias daa zaŋ kpeen shɛba mini bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira ŋun yuli daa booni Tɛɛtulus la pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Siizaria. Bɛ daa chaŋmi ti zaŋ bɛ mini Pool yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Gomna Filiksi.
en: Five days later the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus. They pressed charges against Paul before the governor.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yihi saliŋ shɛŋa din be bɛ tiba ni n-zaŋ na ti ti Aduna.
en: Everybody took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpɛhi bɛ yuri dabiɛm, ka kpɛhi bɛn bari ba mi yinyari. Amaa n ni ti guli Judanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yuri zom.
en: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.

dag: Kɔbiliga ni kul gbibi di kom shɛm, lala ka Jɛrusalɛm nim gbibi bɛ tuumbiɛri. Duŋtaabo mini ninvuɣ kubo yɛla ka n kul wumdi di puuni; dɔriti mini dansi ka n nini kul nyara.
en: As a well keeps its water fresh, so Jerusalem keeps its evil fresh. I hear violence and destruction in the city; sickness and wounds are all I see.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn darigiri bɛ tibili saha shɛli maa ti yɛn nyɛla o niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgɔna mini mɔɣilɔnim saha shɛli. Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni tuhi Asirianim maa.
en: And as the Lord beats Assyria, his people will keep the rhythm with their drums and harps.

dag: N zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini la ti Lɛvinima ni di nyɛ bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri.
en: The Israelites will give one-tenth of everything they have. So I give that one-tenth to the Levites. This is their payment for the work that they do while they serve at the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ matarika kuri salima ŋ-ŋmahi li kaman gal la n-zaŋ li garisi gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-wuɣi binyɛra pa tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli zuɣu.
en: They hammered out sheets of gold and cut them into thin strips to be worked into the fine linen and into the blue, purple, and red wool.

dag: amaa n daa bi nya Yisa Masia tuumba maa ni so naɣila ti Duuma tizo Jeemsi.
en: I met no other apostles—only James, the brother of the Lord.

dag: Ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei ti min o kum ni ni ti min o laɣim ʒin o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni.
en: And God raised us up and seated us in the heavens with Christ Jesus.

dag: Ti yi chɛ ka o niŋdi lala, sokam zaa ni niŋ o yɛda, ka Romnim kana ti saɣim ti Naawuni jɛmbu shee, ka bahi ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him. Then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our people.

dag: Ka a ni tum din chihiri mini pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, a bi teeg a ni daa nyɛ bia saha shɛli, ka be a zaɣim n-do a ʒim ni talindi la yɛla.
en: In all your detestable practices and promiscuities, you didnt remember the days of your infancy when you lay completely naked, flailing about in your blood.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa daari taba ni bɛ paag o shihi, dama o niŋgbuŋ ni ka tibbu yiko maa daa yirina n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpaŋda.
en: All the people tried to touch him, for power was going out from him and healing them all.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia ka di ʒe sokpaŋa; ka o chaŋ di gbini nti bi nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu n-naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko. Ka Yisa daa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga a ku lan wali wala hal abada! Ka tia maa daa dii zani yim kuui.
en: He saw a fig tree along the road, but when he came to it, he found nothing except leaves. Then he said to it, Youll never again bear fruit! The fig tree dried up at once.

dag: Bɛ gbibila tɔbiri mini kpana; bɛ nyɛla putɔɣunima, ka bi zɔri nambɔɣu. Bɛ chandi vuri ŋmanila teeku vuri. Bɛ barila yuri, ka lo kpara kaman tɔbutuhira n-chani tɔbu tuhibu n-kanna ni bɛ ti liri nyini Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga.
en: The soldiers carry bows and spears. They are cruel; they have no mercy. They are so powerful. They sound like the roaring ocean as they ride their horses. That army is coming, ready for battle. It is coming to attack you, Jerusalem. .

dag: Doo yi chirigi bɛ ni bi zaŋ paɣisaribil so ti doo n-zaŋ o dɔni ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: If a man meets up with a young woman who is a virgin and not engaged, grabs her and has sex with her, and they are caught in the act.

dag: Dama o chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-kabisi ma, ka kul chɛ ka n dansi pahira, ka di ka daliri.
en: Who bruises me with a tempest and multiplies my wounds for no reason?.

dag: N yi ti do m bindoo zuɣu n teerila a yɛla; ka kul tɛhir a yɛla yuntisuɣu saha;.
en: whenever I ponder you on my bed, whenever I meditate on you in the middle of the night.

dag: Bɛ yi daa pun mali tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni bɛ zɔri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima zaa sahakam, dindina binshɛɣukam naan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ mini bɛ bihi sani.
en: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛn ʒiri bɛ nɛma be tooni, ka bɛ ŋmaligi doli.
en: Then the men from the tribe of Dan and the Levite priest turned and left Micahs house. They put their little children, their animals, and all their things in front of them.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛri ya, Pumpɔŋɔ, yi zaa zomiya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu ni din ni chɛ ka yi kul kpalim be Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim kurimbuni ha la ni sahakam.
en: They told you to turn from your wicked way of life and from the evil things you are doing, so that you could go on living in the land that the Lord gave you and your ancestors as a permanent possession.

dag: Kaman nira ni so jinjɛŋŋmaa ka di tab o niŋgbuŋ shɛm la, lala ka n daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini Judanim tabi ma din ni chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n yuli du, ka n nya paɣibu mini jilima, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me.

dag: n naŋgbampiba ku ŋma ʒiri, ka n zilinli mi ku tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will tell only the truth.

dag: Ka m mali biɛhigu shee nimaani ni n zaŋ Yawɛ daalikauli ni be Adaka shɛl ni la zali. O ni daa yihi ti yaannim Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka o daa lo ba alikauli maa.
en: There Ive placed the chest that contains the covenant that the LORD made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tɛhiri yi yɛla, ka o baɣa shiri be yi yɛla ni.
en: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.

dag: Kul paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni binshɛɣukam zaa puuni sahakam ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu.
en: always give thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: O zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba nambɔɣu; ka tiligiri nandaamba nyɛviya.
en: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But they didnt understand what he said to them.

dag: ka o suhu ti maai ka o tam a ni niŋ o shɛm maa yɛla. Di nyaaŋa ka n naan yi tim na ka bɛ ti zaŋ a na. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn kɔŋ m bidibis ayi zaa dahin yini.
en: When your brother forgets what you did to him, I will send a servant to bring you back. I dont want to lose both of my sons the same day.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu pina na; ka niriba maa daa ʒini tiŋa ni bɛ di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi diɛmdi kɔr biɛri mini vi diɛma.
en: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.

dag: Dama so ku tooi lan zali tanza shɛli pahila din pun zali maa, dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia.
en: For God has already placed Jesus Christ as the one and only foundation, and no other foundation can be laid.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla yuŋ leei biɛkaali. Bɛ yɛliya, Neesim maa mirila zibisim.
en: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.

dag: Amaa daliri shɛli zuɣu n ni chɛ a maa nyɛla m bɔrimi ni n wuh a n yiko ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia ni zaa.
en: But he has kept you alive, just to show you his power and to bring honor to himself everywhere in the world.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka sa kura mini sakuɣa lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni ti lan chɛ ka buɣim mini chilibi lu o min o tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ shɛb bɛn be o sani zuɣu.
en: I will punish him with disease and bloodshed. Torrents of rain and hail, together with fire and sulfur, will pour down on him and his army and on the many nations that are on his side.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa zab Yisa zaŋ o tahi maa na.
en: He knew very well that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him because they were jealous.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: News about this spread throughout that whole region.

dag: Lɛvinim zuɣulaannima n-daa nyɛ: Hashabia mini Shɛrɛbia ni Kadimiɛl bia Jɛshua mini bɛ taba bɛn daa ʒe n-tuhi ba n-yiini wumpaɣibo yila ka puhiri Naawuni kaman Dauda ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir la ni daa wuhi ba shɛm.
en: These were the leaders of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua, Kadmiels son, and their associates who stood opposite them to praise and give thanks in turn according to the commandment of David, the man of God, namely.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa be yili maa ni kuhiri ka fabindi kpim maa zuɣu yɔri vuri. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di kuhiriya, dama bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: Everyone was crying and weeping for the girl. But Jesus said, The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.

dag: Di bi simdi ka naa ti deei niriba maa tiŋgbani ka kari ba di ni. O ti zaŋmi omaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgban shɛli ti o bidibisi din ni chɛ ka n niriba ni so ti ku kɔŋ o tiŋgbani.
en: The ruling prince must not take any of the people's property away from them. Any land he gives to his sons must be from the land that is assigned to him, so that he will not oppress any of my people by taking their land.

dag: wula ka din nyɛ Naawuni Shia din la ku gari lala?.
en: how much greater is the glory that belongs to the activity of the Spirit!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Miriam yihi kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, ka niriba maa daa bi yiɣisi chaŋ hal ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ Miriam labina.
en: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli din yɛli ni Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la niŋ pali; dina n-chɛ ka Naawuni daa bol o o zo.
en: And the scripture came true that said, Abraham believed God, and because of his faith God accepted him as righteous. And so Abraham was called God's friend.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba maa daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa. Ka Dauda bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni di nyɛla asama ni n leei naa deemba? Dama yi nya ka n nyɛla faralana, ka pa yulilana.
en: Sauls officers said these things to David, but David answered, Do you think it is easy to become the kings son-in-law? I am just a poor, ordinary man.

dag: Ka di yi ti simdi ni n gba chaŋ, n ni pahi bɛ zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: If it seems good for me to go too, we can all travel together.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ, dama a zaŋ ma leei naa ni n su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi ka taŋkpaɣu ŋɔ.
en: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Gibia dal la ka yi daa tum alahichi. Nimaani ka bɛ daa dii gbaai alahichi tumbu. Dinzuɣu tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu Gibia.
en: Israel, you have sinned since the time of Gibeah. Those evil people at Gibeah will be trapped by war.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim. Jɔtam n-nyɛ ŋun daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunol la.
en: But the pagan places of worship were not destroyed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. It was Jotham who built the North Gate of the Temple.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa naai ka o yiɣisi n-zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo.
en: After Jesus said this, he went on in front of them toward Jerusalem.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei gunibu maŋli, dama ti jɛmdila Naawuni o Shia Kasi zuɣu ka mali suhupiɛlli ti bebu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ti ka tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni.
en: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ ninsalinim yɛm mini yɛtɔɣ yoya din yi ninsalinim kaya yɛla ni na, ka pa Masia din la yɔhim ya n-zaŋ ya leei alizinnim bɛn su dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda fukumsi la daba.
en: Be sure you are not led away by the teaching of those who have nothing worth saying and only plan to deceive you. That teaching is not from Christ. It is only human tradition and comes from the powers that influence this world.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Yi bɔri ni n yihila Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ bahi.
en: Pilate asked them, Do you want me to free the king of the Jews.

dag: Balak ni daa wum ni Balaam kanna, o daa yimi chaŋ ti tuh o soli Ar fɔntiŋ shɛli din ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Mɔab tintariga polo la.
en: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went to meet him at the town of Ir on the Arnon River, which is the northern border of Moab.

dag: ka a bɔri ni a nya n taali, ka vihiri ni a baŋ n daalahichi.
en: that you search for my wrongdoing and seek my sin?.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa zo a tiŋgbɔŋ la nambɔɣu; ka daa chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya lan tɔŋ yaha.
en: Lord , you have been so kind to your land. You have brought success again to the people of Jacob.

dag: M mabiyurisi, zaŋmiya yi daadiini wuhibu din be kasi la kpaŋsiri yimaŋa, ka kul suhimiya Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa bol o kpambal so na ti yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya maa na yomyom.
en: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋya nirilim shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, pomiya ni yi gba ni ti niŋ m mini m ba yiŋnim nirilim lala, ka wuhi ma di shihirili.
en: Now swear by him that you will treat my family as kindly as I have treated you, and give me some sign that I can trust you.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ jilima n-taɣi naɣibil ŋun ŋubiri mɔri kɔtomsi.
en: They traded their glorious God for a statue of a grass-eating bull!.

dag: Dabisili din pah anii dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.

dag: N ni tooi chɛ ka sagbana sabigi libilibi kaman di kumdila so kuli la.
en: I clothe the heavens with darkness and cover them with funeral clothing.

dag: amaa di sabiya ni ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma sani, chinchini maa piligirimi.
en: But when someone changes and follows the Lord, that covering is taken away.

dag: Ka naa yi bi yura ka tum birigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi kpe taali ni.
en: If it is a ruler who sins and becomes guilty of breaking one of the Lord 's commands without intending to.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala. Ka Ijiptinim maa biŋkɔbiri zaa daa kpi, amaa ka Izraɛlnim bɛn so biŋkɔbigu daa bi kpi.
en: The next day the Lord did as he had said, and all the animals of the Egyptians died, but not one of the animals of the Israelites died.

dag: Hal bɛ yi kari ya tahi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni laɣim ya nimaani n-zaŋ ya nimaani labisina.
en: Even if you were sent to the farthest parts of the earth, the Lord your God will gather you from there and bring you back.

dag: Paɣimi n tuumbiɛri zaa bahi, ka nyahi n daalahichi.
en: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd mini Gomna Pailɛt daa malila dimdi ni taba, amaa dindali maa zaŋ chana bɛ daa laɣila tab zɔri.
en: In the past Pilate and Herod had always been enemies. But on that day they became friends.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul gbaai nyuubu zaŋ hal ti paai gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali, ka zoya zuɣusaa daa nyili.
en: The water continued to go down, and by the first day of the tenth month, the tops of the mountains were above the water.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ, dama a zaŋ ma leei naa ni n su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi ka taŋkpaɣu ŋɔ.
en: Now, Lord God, continue to keep your promise to my father David. You made me king over so many people that they are like the dust of the earth.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, di zɔri dabiɛm. Naawuni pun deeg a suhigu dabisi shɛli dali a ni daa tɛhi baŋ ka siɣis amaŋa ni di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛla maa la. A suhigu maa deebu zuɣu ka n kana maa.
en: Then he said, Daniel, don't be afraid. God has heard your prayers ever since the first day you decided to humble yourself in order to gain understanding. I have come in answer to your prayer.

dag: Bɛ ni niriba pam ni tuui lu n-nya dansi; tɔŋ ni gbahi ba.
en: Many of them will stumble and fall, and be broken, snared, and captured.

dag: M bi galim ya yi sara maligu mini yi ni kul mali biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-zaŋdi ba nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la zuɣu.
en: Im not punishing you for your sacrifices or for your entirely burned offerings, which are always before me.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima a sani, nyin di chɛ ka o tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: If any Israelites living near you become so poor that they sell themselves to you as a slave, you shall not make them do the work of a slave.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim sahakam. Sinai Zoli gbini ka bɛ daa zali di niŋbu, ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: It is the regular entirely burned offering begun at Mount Sinai, a food gift that is a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa nya Ilaija, o daa bɔh o mi, Nyin ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnim maa m-bala.
en: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, Is that you, the one who troubles Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza naai Ijipti daazichi zaa.
en: The LORD God proclaims: I will bring an end to the hordes of Egypt through the power of Babylons King Nebuchadrezzar.

dag: amaa ti bi mi din chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, ti mi bi mi ŋun neeg o nina maa. O mi pala bia; bɔhimiy o; omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ya.
en: But we dont know how he now sees, and we dont know who healed his eyes. Ask him. Hes old enough to speak for himself.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din be tooni naŋgbambili, ka lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa gba naŋgbambili.
en: They made fifty loops on the edge of the outer curtain of the one set and fifty loops on the edge of the other set of curtains.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa ti yɛn chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri Baalihazɔr din mini Ifriim bi wɔɣ ni tab la, ka daa boli nabihi zaa ni bɛ kana.
en: Two years later Absalom was having his sheep sheared at Baal Hazor, near the town of Ephraim, and he invited all the king's sons to be there.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me again. He said.

dag: Amaa dilan yi bɔr ni o yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, ŋun yom daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zali da shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If you want to buy back the animal, then you must add one-fifth to the price.

dag: Yiɣisim zabi n zuɣu, n Duuma ni n Naawuni! Yiɣisim mali n yɛla maa ti ma!.
en: Wake up! Get up! My God and my Lord, fight for me, and bring me justice.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ daa bi niŋ o daalikauli yɛda, ka daa ʒiɛm tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa.
en: Then they rejected the pleasant land, because they did not believe God's promise.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Hɔr Zoli din daa be Ɛdom tintariga maa gbini.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor on the border of the land of Edom.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai tiŋkpan shɛli, ka paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maata zaŋ o ti kpɛh o yiŋa.
en: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.

dag: Ka Zikiri ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa ku nabia Maasɛya mini Azirikam ŋun daa nyɛ nayili sapashin kpɛm la ni Ɛlikana ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpɛma m-pa naa zuɣu la.
en: Zicri was a brave soldier from Ephraim. He killed the kings son Maaseiah. He also killed Azrikam, the officer in charge of the kings palace, and Elkanah, who was second in command to the king.

dag: Amaa yimaŋmaŋ tumdi tab taali ka diri tab zalinsi, hal yimaŋmaŋ mabihi ka yi niŋdi lala maa.
en: But you are the ones doing wrong and cheating. And you do this to your own brothers and sisters in Christ!.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ o bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la n-leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: Then all the people of Judah made Azariah the new king. Azariah was years old.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni nti kurigi n ni daa zaŋ jinjɛŋŋmaa maa pi luɣ shɛli maa n-yihi li na. Amaa ka jinjɛŋŋmaa maa daa saɣim ka lan ka buchi.
