en: So I went back, and when I found the place where I had hidden them, I saw that they were ruined and were no longer any good.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu. N ni tɔɣisi n fabila ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka shɛli ku kaɣili ma. N ni tɔɣisi ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.

dag: Tiligim ma n daalahichi zaa ni, ka di chɛ ka jɛra mali ma ansarisi.
en: Save me from all my sins, and don't let fools make fun of me.

dag: Yawɛ ni gul a, a yibu min a lab kpe ni; pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: He will protect you as you come and go now and forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Naawuni, ti puhir a ka paɣir a yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ.
en: Now, our God, we give you thanks, and we praise your glorious name.

dag: Di saha ti daa kul larimi, ka yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn daa gil ti yɛra, Yawɛ tum tuun kara ti ba.
en: Our mouths were suddenly filled with laughter; our tongues were filled with joyful shouts. It was even said, at that time, among the nations, The LORD has done great things for them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din be nuzaa polo la gbini. Paɣiba n-daa ʒi nimaani n-kumdi Tammuz kuli.
en: Then God led me to the entrance to the Lord s Temple. This gate was on the north side. I saw women sitting there and crying. They were sad about the false god Tammuz !.

dag: ka Ɛlimɛlɛk daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi min o bidibis ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: Elimelech died, and Naomi was left alone with her two sons.

dag: ka olivi tih ayi ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu maa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo.
en: There are two olive trees beside the lampstand, one on each side of it.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ti tam o daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla. Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra.
en: The Lord does not let us forget his wonderful actions; he is kind and merciful.

dag: Shɛmida bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahian mini Shɛkɛm ni Likihi ni Aniam.
en: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a tum alahiziba tuma ti ti; a lo ti nia suma pam; ka so mi bi ŋman a. N yi yɛn yɛli di zaa yɛla, di ni galisi pam ka nira ku tooi kal li!.
en: You have done many things for us, O Lord our God; there is no one like you! You have made many wonderful plans for us. I could never speak of them all— their number is so great!.

dag: Ka Naawuni gba daa di o shɛhira yiko shihira wuhibu ni mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni ni alahiziba tuma balibu pam ni min o ni daa zaŋ o Shia Kasi pina ti niriba kaman o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Izraɛl kpambaliba daa yiɣisi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni chani gindi.
en: Three days later the leaders went through the camp.

dag: M mabihi, so yi yɛli ni o mali yɛda, amaa ka di bi tumdi tuma, di buchi lee nyɛla dini? Yɛda niŋbu ŋɔ tatabo ni tooi tilig o?.
en: My friends, what good is it for one of you to say that you have faith if your actions do not prove it? Can that faith save you?.

dag: N ni yaai n noli ni suhupiɛlli saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn yili yila paɣ a. N shia din nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛl la gba ni yili yila paɣ a.
en: I will shout for joy, singing songs of praise to you for saving me.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa zaŋ Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa yiŋa n-ti Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta. Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli naa ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla o dɔɣim. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Mɔdɛkai nya soli kpɛri naa sani.
en: That same day King Xerxes gave Queen Esther all the property of Haman, the enemy of the Jews. Esther told the king that Mordecai was related to her, and from then on Mordecai was allowed to enter the king's presence.

dag: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levi and his sons: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Farisii maa daa kaɣimi ʒe o kɔŋko ha suhiri Naawuni yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, m paɣir a pam n ni bi be kaman ninvuɣ fariba bee zalinsi diriba bee zinaniŋdiba bee farigudeera ŋun ʒiɛya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Pharisee stood apart by himself and prayed, I thank you, God, that I am not greedy, dishonest, or an adulterer, like everybody else. I thank you that I am not like that tax collector over there.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti nyu wain; chɛliya ka ti nyu binnyuri kpɛma. Biɛɣuni sa ni be kaman zuŋɔ, hal di sa ni gari lala gba.
en: Let's get some wine, these drunkards say, and drink all we can hold! Tomorrow will be even better than today.

dag: M piɛri mi n kukoli, ka n gba mi ba, ka bɛ doli ma;.
en: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

dag: Teemiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla, ka teei o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni daa kari saria shɛm yɛla.
en: Remember the amazing things he has done. Remember his miracles and his fair decisions.

dag: Niriba ni ʒe teeku noli n-gbahiri zahim zaŋ Ɛngɛdi hal ni Ɛnɛglaim. Di ni ti nyɛla lansi labbu shee. Ka zahim balibu pam ni ti be di ni kaman bɛ ni be Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni shɛm la.
en: You can see fishermen standing by the river all the way from En Gedi to En Eglaim. You can see them throwing their fishing nets and catching many kinds of fish. There are as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Yi bi da tulaale viɛlli ti ma bee n-zaŋ yi sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ti ma. Amaa yinim lee chɛmi ka yi daalahichi yɛla muɣisi ma, ka chɛ ka n nyee nyɔni yi tuumbiɛri.
en: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.

dag: Dama Naawuni daalibarika niŋbu min o niriba piibu yɛla bi taɣira.
en: For God does not change his mind about whom he chooses and blesses.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ bia maa ti yɛn yaag o noli yɛli, M ba bee M ma, di saha Asiria naa ni ti kana ti zaŋ Damaskus azichi, ka di Samaria nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: Before the boy is old enough to say Mamma and Daddy, all the wealth of Damascus and all the loot of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.

dag: Piɛbimiya gbɛri Gibia tiŋ puuni, ka piɛbiya kikahi Rama tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛmiya tɔb chiriga Bɛtavɛn tiŋ puuni. Bɛnjamin zuliya, lumiya abirima.
en: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!.

dag: Ka laɣ shɛli din daa nyɛ taali tumbu sanyoo liɣiri mini alahichi sanyoo liɣiri, bɛ daa bi zaŋ li tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama din daa nyɛla maligumaaniba dini.
en: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.

dag: Ka o daa ti wumis o bi yino, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu, ka daa ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: She singled out one of her cubs and he became a strong young lion; he learned to tear flesh and devour humans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o ku n-vu o ti bahi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha.
en: They grabbed him, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses and said.

dag: Ɛlam din pahi la — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: of the other Elam .

dag: N daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi kaman n ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tuuli la. Ka Yawɛ daa lan deei n suhigu, ka daa bi lan lo ni o kun ya.
en: Just as the first time, I remained on the mountain forty days and nights. And the LORD listened to me again in this instance. The LORD wasnt willing to destroy you.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Mani n-nyɛ buzɔŋ dunoli.
en: So Jesus said again, I assure you, I am the gate for the sheep.

dag: Lubu din mali dabiɛm pam mini chirachira be Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli ni, ka bɛ daai ti tiŋ goma luhi, ka ŋme sɔŋsim bɔbu kuŋ bahi zoya ni nima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-niŋ lala maa.
en: The Lord GOD All-Powerful chose a special day for there to be riots and confusion. People trampled on each other in the Valley of Vision. The city walls were pulled down. People in the valley shouted up at those on the mountain.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti lan zahim zahindi shɛli, ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa yaha. O daa yɛli ba mi: Nyamiya, n lan zahimla zahindi shɛli. N sa nyami ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi piniyini damdi ma tiŋa.
en: Joseph later had another dream, and he told his brothers, Listen to what else I dreamed. The sun, the moon, and eleven stars bowed down to me.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani. Ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.

dag: Binshɛli bi lan kpalim bɛ yiŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ chilibi yaɣiri bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa.
en: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛli maligumaana Hilikia mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Mikaya bia Akibɔr ni gbaŋŋmara Shafan ni naa kpambal Asaaya.
en: At once he called together Hilkiah, Shaphan, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, and his own servant Asaiah. He said.

dag: Naa Lɛmuɛl yɛtɔɣa, din nyɛ o ma ni daa wuh o anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ka Siizaria na ni bɛ ti puhi Gomna Fɛstus.
en: After several days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived in Caesarea to welcome Festus.

dag: ka Machi bia Gɛuɛl daa yi Gaad zuliya ni na.
en: from the tribe of Gad—Geuel son of Maki.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o baŋ ni o bidib tuuli nyɛla o ni bi yur paɣ so la bidibiga maa, ka pirig o ni su shɛli maa ʒiibuyi zuɣu ti o, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ saha bia, ka bituuli tarili nyɛla o dini.
en: The man must accept the firstborn son from the wife he does not love. The man must give that son a double share of everything he owns because that son is his first child. The right of the firstborn belongs to that son.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina zaashee ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuma zuɣu la n-ka yi sanna.
en: Barnabas and Paul have given their lives to serve our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di zɔriya yi ni yɛn nya nahiŋgu shɛli. Nyamiya, Sintani ni ti kpɛhi yi ni shɛb sarika n-zahim ya, ka yi ni nya nahiŋgu biɛɣ pia. Ka ŋun ʒe yim hal ti paai kum, n ni ti o nyɛvili nam zuɣupiligu.
en: Dont be afraid of what you are going to suffer. Look! The devil is going to throw some of you into prison in order to test you. You will suffer hardship for ten days. Be faithful even to the point of death, and I will give you the crown of life.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pia saha shɛli din daa nyɛ Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.

dag: Shammai bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Maɔn, ka Maɔn daa nyɛ Bɛtizur ba.
en: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi maŋgbibbu pahi yi baŋsim zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi ʒiɛyimtali pahi yi maŋgbibbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi Naawuni sizuura lubu pahi yi ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu.
en: self-control, patience, devotion to God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: The total number of the Israelite men was .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa kanimina ni n ti liri ya n-kari ya saria zuliya kam ninni.
en: And so I, the Sovereign Lord , am telling you that I am your enemy. I will pass judgment on you where all the nations can see it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Doli yɛlimaŋli soli ka tummi din tuhi, dama di ku yuui ka n tiligi ya.
en: The Lord said these things, Be fair to all people. Do what is right, because soon my salvation will come to you. My goodness will soon be shown to the whole world.

dag: Di saha ka n di zaŋ n zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun wuhi yɛlimaŋli so shɛli n ni yɛn doli kpuɣi ŋuna n dan maa dɔɣim bipuɣiŋga nti ti o bia maa.
en: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be baalim, ka chɛ ka yi zaɣa be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka bɔnya yimaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma tummi kaman ti ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la.
en: Aim to live quietly, mind your own business, and earn your own living, just as I told you.

dag: A zaɣisila Judanim zaa? A suhu lan je Ziɔnnima? Wula ka a ŋme ti luhi ka so ku tooi lan tibi ti yaha? Ti yuuni bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ti bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, ka yuuni bɔri faako saha, amaa ka naɣ nyarila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Have you rejected Judah, Lord ? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.

dag: Di zaŋya yimaŋ bali bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba ni, dama wula ka wuntia mini din pa wuntia ni tooi laɣim be bee zɔtali bɔ m-be neesim mini zibisim sunsuuni?.
en: Dont be tied up as equal partners with people who dont believe. What does righteousness share with that which is outside the Law? What relationship does light have with darkness?.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la dolibu.
en: But suppose someone unintentionally fails to keep some of these regulations which the Lord has given Moses.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha dabili.
en: Whoever wants to be first among you will be the slave of all.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wum kukoli maa zibisim maa sunsuuni ka buɣim dir zoli maa, yi zuliya zuɣulaannim mini yi kpamba daa vumi miri ma na.
en: When the whole mountain was on fire and you heard the voice from the darkness, your leaders and the chiefs of your tribes came to me.

dag: Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: All the other things that Amaziah did from the beginning to the end of his reign are recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: O wuhi ma yili palli, di nyɛla yil shɛli din nyɛ ti Naawuni paɣibu yilli. Niriba pam ni nya ka lu Yawɛ sizuura, ka niŋ o naani.
en: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.

dag: Dama hal a min a mabihi bɛn be dundɔn yin ni nyɛla bɛn lo a zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ kul yimi zani a zuɣu; hal bɛ yi kul paɣir a gba nyin di niŋ ba yɛda.
en: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ŋun mali binyɛra ayi, ŋun piimi zaɣ yini ti o kpe so ŋun ka; ka ŋun mi malila bindirigu, ŋun niŋmi lala.
en: John told them, If you have two coats, give one to someone who doesn't have any. If you have food, share it with someone else.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-naan chɛ ka n suhu maai. Di biɛrim yi di be ka bo, n naan mali suhupiɛlli; dama m bi zaɣisi ŋun be Kasi ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: Id still take comfort, relieved even though in persistent pain; for Ive not denied the words of the holy one.

dag: O yi yiɣisi zani, dabiɛm gbahirila wuna, ka bɛ zɔri dabiɛm ka labi nyaaŋa.
en: When he gets up, even the strongest people are afraid. They run away when he swings his tail.

dag: Amaa bɛ nimdi nyɛla yi dini kaman bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu nyɔɣu polo mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli gahiri zuɣusaa mini nudirigu gbalipaɣa ni nyɛ yi dini shɛm la.
en: The meat from them belongs to you, like the breast and the right hind leg of the special offering.

dag: Tim Yawɛ jilima a ni mali shɛlikam ni, ka zaŋ a puu bindir daŋda zaa gba ti o jilima.
en: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.

dag: Ka salo bɛn be o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: Some of the people were walking ahead of Jesus. Others were walking behind him. They all shouted, Praise to the Son of David! Welcome! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Psalm :- Praise to God in heaven.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Ka dindina zaŋmiy o chaŋ ti doli yimaŋmaŋ zaligu soli kar o saria. Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti ka soli ni ti ku nira.
en: Pilate responded, Take him yourselves and judge him according to your Law. The Jewish leaders replied, The Law doesnt allow us to kill anyone. .

dag: Baŋmiya ni mani n-su nyɛviya zaa. Mani n-su bihi laamba nyɛviya, mani n-lan su bia nyɛvili. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi kɔŋko n-ni kpi.
en: The lives of all people belong to me—parents as well as children. However, only those who sin will be put to death.

dag: Lamɛk daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus left that place and went off to the territory near the cities of Tyre and Sidon.

dag: Ka Zifinim daa ti ka Sool sanna Gibia nti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela Hachila Zoli din mini Jɛshimɔn nin tuhi tab la zuɣu.
en: Once again, some people from Ziph went to Gibeah to talk with Saul. David has a hideout on Mount Hachilah near Jeshimon out in the desert, they told him.

dag: A ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka bi ku Amalɛknim zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa la zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ a o ni niŋ a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The LORD has done this very thing to you today because you didnt listen to the LORDs voice and didnt carry out his fierce anger against the Amalekites.

dag: Ka o daa ti wumis o bi yino, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu, ka daa ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: She taught one of them to hunt, and he learned to eat people.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim ni daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ daa tala bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma daɣiri. Bɛ ni daa be shɛm n sani daa ŋmanila paɣa ni nya sɔrilim ka bi lan be nyam shɛm la.
en: Human one, when the house of Israel lived on their fertile land, they polluted it with their ways and deeds. Their ways before me were polluted like the blood of menstruation.

dag: Di pa shɛli yi ni saɣi ni m bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya, amaa ka lee yɛli ni n nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana ŋun zaŋ yɔhiŋgu gbahi ya.
en: You will agree, then, that I was not a burden to you. But someone will say that I was tricky, and trapped you with lies.

dag: Miriya ka yi taɣi Naawuni Shia Kasi zali;.
en: Do not restrain the Holy Spirit;.

dag: Di chɛ ka n lihiri binshɛŋa din ka buchi. Tim ma nyɛvili a soli zuɣu.
en: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Make me live by your way.

dag: Benya n ni, ka n gba be yi ni. Tiwulli ku tooi wali wala dimaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka pa ni di tuɣila tia; yi gba ku tooi wali wala, shee yi tuɣila mani.
en: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba yi ti yɛri ni suhudoo mini gom beni, di saha maa ka bahi yoli dii yɛn paai ba, ka bɛ ku tiligi. Di ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: People will say, We have peace and we are safe. At that time destruction will come to them quickly, like the pains of a woman giving birth. And those people will not escape.

dag: Ayuba ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: by saying to God:.

dag: ka boli Yisa tuumba maa na ti fiɛb ba, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan zaŋ Yisa yuli tɔɣisiri niriba, ka daa bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: They called the apostles in again. They beat them and told them not to speak anymore using the name of Jesus. Then they let them go free.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ni ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: Those who eat my flesh and drink my blood have eternal life, and I will raise them to life on the last day.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Zɛbidii bih ayi la pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee. Grief and anguish came over him.

dag: N ni teegi n nuu n-tum alahiziba tuma n-darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili, di nyaaŋa ka o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ.
en: So Ill use my strength and hit Egypt with dramatic displays of my power. After that, hell let you go.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni chɛ ka a zani dabari, ka leei zuliya kam bɛn gil a ni yɛn maani so ansarisi bɛnkam gariti ninni.
en: Everyone from the nations around you who passes by will sneer at you and keep their distance.

dag: N ni chɛ li ka di bahi yoli. N ku wahi di nyoya ni bahi bee m-mali di ni, ka suligunyinyari mini gɔhi zooi lim li. N ni chɛ ka sagbana ku tɔɣisi kom bahi di ni.
en: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.

dag: Salo maa ni daa baŋ ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nir maa ka bɛ zaŋ kaman awa mun ayi n-duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: But when they recognized that he was a Jew, they all shouted together the same thing for two hours: Great is Artemis of Ephesus.

dag: N lan nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhiri binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla. Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa mi n-zaŋ o yaa maa n-nahind o taba.
en: I observed all of this as I paid attention to all that happens under the sun. Sometimes people exercise power over each other to their detriment.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul zɔrimi, ka nyaandol ŋun maa daa zo ŋ-ŋma Pita zuɣu daŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: They were both running, but the other follower ran faster than Peter and reached the tomb first.

dag: Yisa kum la tatabo kul bela ti niŋgbuna ni ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili gba tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: So we constantly experience the death of Jesus in our own bodies, but this is so that the life of Jesus can also be seen in our bodies.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yiɣisi doli Giliad kpamba maa kuli, ka Giliadnim ti zaŋ o leei bɛ zuɣulana ni bɛ sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɛfita daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛm zaa Yawɛ sani Mizipa.
en: So Jephthah went with the leaders of Gilead, and the people made him their ruler and leader. Jephthah stated his terms at Mizpah in the presence of the Lord .

dag: Musa daa woligi pirigili shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili ka chɛ tɔbbihi la dini.
en: As for the half-share of the Israelites that Moses divided from those who had gone out to battle.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka ŋunkam mi chibi gooni voli, wahu ni dim o.
en: If you dig a hole, you might fall into it. If you break down a wall, you might be bitten by a snake.

dag: Amaa buɣisimiya binshɛɣukam nya, ka gbibiya din viɛla.
en: but examine everything carefully and hang on to what is good.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔbbihi la, ka mali suhupiɛlli kaman wain nyuriba la. Bɛ bihi ni ti teei bɛ nasara dibu maa yɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Israel will be strong like soldiers, happy like those who have been drinking wine. Their descendants will remember this victory and be glad because of what the Lord has done.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimaŋli soli be ti katiŋa, ka din tuhi gba bi paari ti. Ti bɔrila firila, amaa ka zibisim n-gil ti, ti bɔri neesim, amaa ka bela bumbɔn ni.
en: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.

dag: Amaa nyin bi taɣira, ka a yuma mi ka tariga.
en: But you never change. You will live forever!.

dag: ka daa bi lan saɣi ni so ʒi binshɛɣu gari kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: He refused to allow anyone to carry things through the Temple area.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa zo Yawɛ dabiɛm pam, ka mali sara n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd o.
en: When the men saw this, they began to fear and respect the Lord . They offered a sacrifice and made special promises to the Lord .

dag: dama a yihi ma kum ni. A mi ku saɣi n-chɛ a ni yuri so niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee n-chɛ ka a dabili kpalim gballi ni pooi.
en: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.

dag: O daa malila biŋkɔbbaligu tusaayopɔin mini laakumnim tusaata ni naɣilakɔra tuhili ni bunnyama kɔbisinu, ka mali tumtumdiba pam; ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nyɛ ninvuɣ titali gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa.
en: He owned , sheep, , camels, pair of oxen, donkeys, and a large number of servants. He was the richest person in the East.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpuɣi paɣ so pah o zuɣu, di bi simdi ka o filim o bindirigu bee situra bee n-zaɣis o min o dɔnibu.
en: If the master marries another woman, he must not give less food or clothing to the first wife. And he must continue to give her what she has a right to have in marriage.

dag: Kul zanimiyala yim saɣi ni yi tum taali, ni yi daa taai duŋ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka zaŋ yi yurilim yaɣiri saamba sani ti mahili kam gbini ka bi deei n noli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Only acknowledge your wrongdoing: how you have rebelled against the LORD your God, and given yourself to strangers under every lush tree and havent obeyed me, declares the LORD.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ ka ti niriba maa baŋ ni di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma n-sɔŋ bɛn simdi sɔŋbu, ka pa ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din ka nyɔri.
en: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.

dag: O daa mali daantalis ayi mini biŋkpila ayi din tam daantalis ayi maa zuɣu. O daa lan wuɣi binyara ayi n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpila ayi din daa tam daantalisi maa zuɣu la;.
en: two columns; two bowl-shaped caps for the tops of the columns; two chain designs on the caps;.

dag: Tins ayɔbu ka yi yɛn yihi zali ka di nyɛ yi tiliginsim tinsi maa.
en: You will establish six refuge cities for yourselves.

dag: Ka Musa deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daŋ niriba daa yiɣisi abie tihi tiŋ la ni n-dol Juda zuliya niriba maa ti ʒini Juda tiŋgban ni din lab Nɛgɛb polo m-miri Arad la. Bɛ daa ʒini pahila nimaani nim zuɣu.
en: The people who belonged to the Kenite clan were the descendants of the father-in-law of Moses. They left Jericho with the people of Judah and settled near Arad in the Southern Desert of Judah not far from the Amalekites.

dag: Amaa ka bɛna bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim maa daa ti niŋ karimbaani mini tipawumli n-zaɣis a zaligunim maa dolibu.
en: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.

dag: Ti daa tɛhiya ni di bemi kaman bɛ bahila noli ni bɛ kum ti la. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka ti ku zaŋ timaŋa n-dalim timaŋmaŋa, amaa ka ni zaŋ timaŋa n-dalimla Naawuni ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni la.
en: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To God be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jehus deeds, all that he accomplished, and all his powerful acts, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a kul nyɛ dabari sahakam, ka so ku lan ʒini a fɔntinsi ni yaha. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Naawuni be lala tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka di kul ku vuui; Naawuni ni sɔŋ lala tiŋ maa biɛkaali saha.
en: God is in that city. It will never crumble. God will help it when morning dawns.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla anabi.
en: The woman said, Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.

dag: Bɛ zuya daa ŋmanila nɔnsi zuya, ka bɛ dimdi kaman nɔnsi la, ka bɛ dimbu lɔɣu din yɛn nahim niriba chira anu la do bɛ zuya maa ni.
en: They have tails and stings like those of a scorpion, and it is with their tails that they have the power to hurt people for five months.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa Buzi bia Ɛzɛkiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: There in Babylonia beside the Chebar River, I heard the Lord speak to me, and I felt his power.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ gulila m ba piɛri, ka gbuɣinli bee kunduŋ daa yi ti kana ti gbaai piɛbila guui;.
en: Your Majesty, David said, I take care of my father's sheep. Any time a lion or a bear carries off a lamb.

dag: Nooŋa ni siɣi zana ni ka bɛ bi bari li? Ka tɔŋ ni tooi tɔhi ka pa ni bɛ bari li mi ka binshɛɣu no li?.
en: A bird doesnt fly into a trap unless there is food in it. If a trap closes, it will catch the bird.

dag: Ti mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu, ti ni niŋ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ naani zuɣu.
en: Our heart rejoices in God because we trust his holy name.

dag: Zaŋmiya di binnyura lita yini sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu, ka booi binnyuri kpiɔŋ bahi luɣ kasi shee m-mali binnyura sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Their drink offering will be a fourth of a hin for each lamb. In the sanctuary a drink offering of brandy will be poured out for the LORD.

dag: Amaa niriba kul ni be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam, ka niriba kul ni be Jɛrusalɛm ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem for all generations.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim maa zaa ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They counted every man who was years old or older and able to serve in the army. Each man was listed with his family.

dag: Yi ni ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, amaa di ti chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: You will hear about wars and reports of wars. Dont be alarmed. These things must happen, but this isnt the end yet.

dag: Ka Ahija daa ti gbaag o ni ye binyɛr shɛli maa n-dari tɔhi li zaɣ tolima pinaayi.
en: Ahijah took his new coat and tore it into twelve pieces.

dag: Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi pirigili yim bɛn daa be o sani daa kab chaŋ ti zanila tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka bɛ pirigili ʒii buyi mi kab ti lu bɛn be mɔɣu ni maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: Abimelech and his group ran to a place near the gate to Shechem. The other two groups ran out to the people in the fields and killed them.

dag: Yi vidibo ni yi filiŋ ni ti zani tariga. Yi ni ti be yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka yi daazichi ti nabi; ka yi ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: Your shame and disgrace are ended. You will live in your own land, And your wealth will be doubled; Your joy will last forever.

dag: Yinim Samaria paɣiba bɛn ŋmɛlim be kaman Bashan naɣ shɛb bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga la, wummiya, yi nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba, ka yɛri yi yidaannima, Timiya ti wain ka ti nyu.
en: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on Mount Samaria, who cheat the weak, who crush the needy, who say to their husbands, Bring drinks, so we can get drunk.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa daa daŋ tooni na la daa nyɛla tayiɣisi ni ŋmɛnditoya, ka piɛri maa daa bi wum ti ba.
en: All those who came before me were thieves and robbers. The sheep did not listen to them.

dag: Lahibal suŋ daa kala ti sanna kaman di ni daa chaŋ bɛ sani shɛm; ka bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa daa bi ku ba buchi, dama bɛn daa wum li maa daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.

dag: Ka Firawuna kpamba daa yɛl o Bɔ saha ka doo ŋɔ yɛn chɛ ti zana baribu? Chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa, a na kul bi baŋ ni Ijipti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Pharaohs officials said to him, How long will this man trap us in a corner like this? Let the people go so that they can worship the LORD their God. Dont you get it? Egypt is being destroyed.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ mini n gooni din gili ma ni ŋun fari ma bahira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni ni n tampiŋ. Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n tiliginsim yiligu ni m birini.
en: The Lord is my protector; he is my strong fortress. My God is my protection, and with him I am safe. He protects me like a shield; he defends me and keeps me safe.

dag: Ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di zuɣu, ka shinshingoorɔnim tɛri bɛ tɛri gɔhi tihi zuɣu.
en: where the birds make their nests, where the stork has a home in the cypresses.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa saɣim o suhu pam ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: When the man heard this, gloom spread over his face, and he went away sad, because he was very rich.

dag: O wuhi kpiɔŋ, ka wurim karimbaannima bɛ suhuri ni tɛhi biɛri zuɣu.
en: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered those with arrogant thoughts and proud inclinations.

dag: Ham bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Kush mini Ijipti ni Put ni Keenan.
en: The sons of Ham—Cush, Egypt, Libya, and Canaan—were the ancestors of the peoples who bear their names.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wun so ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni ŋ-ŋman a; a dol a ni lo alikauli shɛli ka mali yurilim din bi naari zaŋ chaŋ a daba zaa sani.
en: he said: LORD God of Israel, theres no god like you in heaven above or on earth below. You keep the covenant and show loyalty to your servants who walk before you with all their heart.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Pool, Di ni bɔŋɔ a tɛhiya ni a ni lɛbigi ma Kristiɛn saha biɛla ŋɔ puuni.
en: King Agrippa said to Paul, Do you think you can persuade me to become a Christ-follower so easily.

dag: Asa daa bi wurim luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa ʒe Yawɛ yim o suhu ni hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Even though Asa did not destroy all the pagan places of worship, he remained faithful to the Lord all his life.

dag: N ni yɛri ya yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda.
en: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.

dag: O bia Yisahaku maa daba anii dali ka ŋun Ibrahimma daa gun o kaman Naawuni ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili maa ni daa ti yi palo, ti daa nya o ka di o shɛhira, ka yɛri ya ŋuna ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu ka daa be ti Ba Naawuni sani, ka ŋun Naawuni daa kahig o wuhi ti la yɛla.
en: The life was revealed, and we have seen, and we testify and announce to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim karimbanim ni yino, ka ʒi dimbɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka o bihi deer o noli ka tir o jilima binshɛɣukam puuni;.
en: He must be a good leader of his own family. This means that his children obey him with full respect.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa yi chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bɛ jɛma saha nti tumdi bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ yab Aduna zali ba shɛm la.
en: These were the groups chosen to serve in the Lord s Temple. They obeyed Aarons rules for serving in the Temple. The Lord , the God of Israel, had given them to Aaron.

dag: din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi yi ni gbib bɛmaŋa, ka doli ma ni ʒiɛyimtali ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shia zaa, a kul ku kɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒiini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: If you obey him, the Lord will keep the promise he made when he told me that my descendants would rule Israel as long as they were careful to obey his commands faithfully with all their heart and soul.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ni ŋun nam ba la yɛliya, Yi ni tooi bɔhi ma bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ m bihi polo? Bee n-wuhi ma di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm?.
en: The Lord God is the Holy One of Israel. He created Israel, and he says, My children, you asked me to show you a sign. You told me to show you what I have done.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛruya bia Abishai daa kana ti sɔŋ Dauda n-ku Filistia doo maa. Di saha ka Dauda niriba maa daa po pɔri yɛl o, A ku lan doli ti chaŋ tɔb ni, di yi pa lala a ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim firila kpi.
en: But Abishai came to the rescue and killed the Philistine. David's soldiers told him, We can't let you risk your life in battle anymore! You give light to our nation, and we want that flame to keep burning.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa bɔri ni bɛ ʒi Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi.
en: Barnabas wanted to take John Mark with them.

dag: Di saha ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Faashee ka yi ti ʒi yi tizo maa mali na, di yi pa lala, yin di ti chɛ ka n nini nyan ya.
en: Then you said, You will not be admitted to my presence again unless your youngest brother comes with you.

dag: Ka baŋdiba shɛb bɛn be bɛ ni ni ti wuhi bɛ ni niriba pam din tuhi. Amaa di ti ku yuui ka bɛ ku bɛ ni shɛba tɔbu ni, ka nyo shɛb buɣim ku ba, ka gbahi shɛb mi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: The peoples teachers will help many understand, but for a time they will fall by sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder.

dag: Ʒim la ni ti nyɛla shihirili din wuhiri yi ni be yi yiya shɛŋa ni. Ka n yi ti kuri Ijiptinim na ti paai ya ka nya ʒim maa, n ni kpahi yaɣ ya gari, ka yinim yi alɔbo maa ni.
en: The blood on the houses will show me where you live, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you. Then you won't be bothered by the terrible disasters I will bring on Egypt.

dag: N daa yooi dunoli maa ti n yura maa, amaa ka o bi kpɛna ka ŋmaligi chaŋ. N ni daa kul wum o kukoli, ka n suhu kpe o ni. Ka n daa yina lihi bo o, amaa ka bi nya o. Ka n daa bol o, amaa ka o bi garigi.
en: I went and opened for my love, but my love had turned, gone away. I nearly died when he turned away. I looked for him but couldnt find him. I called out to him, but he didnt answer me.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei zuɣu, ka pa ni zuli, ka chɛ ka yi kul chani tooni ka ku lab nyaaŋa, yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Lord will make you be like the head, not the tail. You will be on top, not on the bottom. This will happen if you listen to the commands of the Lord your God that I tell you today. You must carefully obey these commands.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buri pili, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba. Vi ni ti be bɛ zaa nina ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri zaa ti nyɛ zuɣukpina.
en: They will put on mourning clothes, and horror will cover them. On every face, shame; on all their heads, baldness.

dag: ka daa bol o yiŋbihi pia na nti ti bɛ zaa pɔŋlipɔŋli, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ mal li gom kɔhigu hal ka o ti labina.
en: Before he left, he called his ten servants and gave them each a gold coin and told them, See what you can earn with this while I am gone.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn fiɣisiri ma maa nya filiŋ, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ vi ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: Let my accusers be dressed in shame; let them wear their disgrace like a coat.

dag: ka daa doli Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri n-yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: Right away, he began to preach about Jesus in the synagogues. He is Gods Son, he declared.

dag: Dunia nanima mini zuliya kam zaa ni nabihi ni tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth.

dag: Nyamiya ti Ba Naawuni ni yu ti yurilim shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o bol ti ŋun Naawuni bihi; ka lala n-shiri nyɛ ti. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim bi mi ti, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni bi mi o la zuɣu.
en: The Father has loved us so much! This shows how much he loved us: We are called children of God. And we really are his children. But the people in the world dont understand that we are Gods children, because they have not known him.

dag: Daŋ kam piimi bɛ daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim ka mali yu suŋ ka bɛ leei yi zuɣulaannima.
en: Choose some wise, understanding, and experienced men from each tribe, and I will put them in charge of you.

dag: N daa chɛ n yaaŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buri ma, ka chɛ n jira ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dariti sibiri n teeŋkɔbiri. M mi daa bi ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi bee bɛn tuhiri nintɔri viɛri ma.
en: I bared my back to those who beat me. I did not stop them when they insulted me, when they pulled out the hairs of my beard and spit in my face.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kurigi, bɛ na kul ni wandi wala; ka mali sum, ka bɛ vari kul nyɛ vamaha.
en: Even when they are old, they will continue producing fruit like young, healthy trees.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a me jɛmbu duu ti ma maa, a niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a ni lo lala a suhu ni maa zuɣu.
en: the Lord said, It's good that you want to build a temple where I can be worshiped.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni yɛl o, Man ni niŋ o naŋgban malisim. Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, So dini ka a lee yɛn doli.
en: until a spirit stepped forward, approached the Lord , and said, I will deceive him. How? the Lord asked.

dag: A ni daa darigi n tibili maa, di viɛla. Di ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: Suffering was good for me; I learned your laws.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya Juda fɔntinsi ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa tɔhi liɣiri ka yi zaŋ li na ka ti ti maani yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuuni kam. Niŋmiya lala yomyom. Amaa ka Lɛvinim maa daa bi niŋdi yomyom.
en: He gathered the priests and the Levites and said, Go to the cities of Judah and collect the annual tax of silver due from all Israel for the upkeep of Gods temple. Do it right away. But the Levites procrastinated.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti mali sara maligu shɛli ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi la; di daa nyɛla ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi.
en: They offered a sacrifice in keeping with whats stated in the Law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons .

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa moli gili. Miriya ka yi zaŋ yi noli naai ninvuɣ biɛɣu m-pah o zuɣu di shɛhira kpɛma.
en: Do not spread false rumors, and do not help a guilty person by giving false testimony.

dag: Dindina ka ya polo ka yɛm lee yirina? Ka ya polo ka baŋsim lee be?.
en: But wisdom, where does she come from? Where is the place of understanding?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni: Di saha maa alizanda nam ni ti ŋmanila paɣipiɛlisi pia bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ firilanim chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi amiliya aŋgo soli.
en: At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten young bridesmaids who took their lamps and went out to meet the groom.

dag: Dama hal a min a mabihi bɛn be dundɔn yin ni nyɛla bɛn lo a zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ kul yimi zani a zuɣu; hal bɛ yi kul paɣir a gba nyin di niŋ ba yɛda.
en: Even your relatives, members of your own family, have betrayed you; they join in the attacks against you. Do not trust them, even though they speak friendly words.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi laŋ maa bahi yi ŋariŋ maa nudirigu polo; yi yi niŋ lala yi ni nya shɛli. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-gbahi zahim pam hal nti tarigi laŋ maa vɔbu zahim maa galisim zuɣu.
en: So he told them, Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish. They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ baɣisi fiig tia wala ta bintɔrigu maa ka a nya alaafee.
en: Isaiah told the king to put a paste made of figs on his boil, and he would get well.

dag: Ka yi daa gbi kɔbɔɣili sɔŋ goma ayi sunsuuni ni beeŋ kurili la ni kom zɔrina ti luri di ni. Amaa ka bi lihi nya ŋun daa pun niŋ li bee n-chɛ ka yi baɣa be ŋun daa pun lo di nia zali ka di waɣ la ni.
en: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa garigi yɛli, Ti ku nyu wain, dama ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛkab bia la daa yɛli ti ni ti mini ti bihi di nyu wain.
en: But they answered, We do not drink wine. Our ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab told us that neither we nor our descendants were ever to drink any wine.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ yi yɛn me duu maa dikili, bɛn zaŋm kuɣa me kulis ata, ka zaŋ dari mi n-niŋ kuliga zaɣ yini n-tam di zuɣu. Ka yihi nam fukumsi kpanjɔɣu ni liɣiri n-yo duu maa mɛbu tuma samli.
en: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.

dag: Amaa o yi zaɣisi wumbu, nyin bom ninvuɣ yino bee niriba ayi pah amaŋ zuɣu lab o sani, ka niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira dibu zuɣu ti chɛ ka yɛtɔɣili kam mali nyaanzaana.
en: But if he will not listen to you, take one or two other persons with you, so that every accusation may be upheld by the testimony of two or more witnesses, as the scripture says.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ takɔbiri maa ni ŋmaligi ku ba; ka Naawuni kabisi bɛ tɔbiri maa.
en: but they will be killed by their own swords, and their bows will be smashed.

dag: Yawɛ ni sabi niriba maa yuya sɔŋ. O ni sabi, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa teei Yisa yɛligu maa.
en: Then the women remembered what Jesus had said.

dag: Ka Ɛr daa nyɛ Jɔshua bia, ka Jɔshua nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza nyɛ Jɔrim bia, ka Jɔrim nyɛ Matat so bia, ka Matat maa mi nyɛ Lɛvi so bia.
en: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla Naawuni niriba. Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni nir nyɛla ŋun wumdi tiri ti; ka ŋunkam mi pa Naawuni nir pala ŋun wumdi tiri ti. Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ Shi so ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli Shia, ka lan baŋ shi so ŋun nyɛ biriginsim shia.
en: But we belong to God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever does not belong to God does not listen to us. This, then, is how we can tell the difference between the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

dag: Ka n daa lihi, n nya wɔr fufuhigu, ka ŋun bar o yuli booni Kum, ka Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee dol o nyaaŋa, ka Naawuni daa ti ba yiko ni bɛ tooi zaŋ takɔbiri mini kum ni alɔbo ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri n-ku daadamnim niriba anahi kam puuni ninvuɣ yino.
en: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba yi ti yɛri ni suhudoo mini gom beni, di saha maa ka bahi yoli dii yɛn paai ba, ka bɛ ku tiligi. Di ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: When people say, Everything is quiet and safe, then suddenly destruction will hit them! It will come as suddenly as the pains that come upon a woman in labor, and people will not escape.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka doo kpuɣi paɣa, amaa ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, ka di nyɛla binshɛli ka o nya ka di bi viɛl o sani, ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka o sabi paɣ yihibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa ka o chaŋ.
en: Lets say a man marries a woman, but she isnt pleasing to him because hes discovered something inappropriate about her. So he writes up divorce papers, hands them to her, and sends her out of his house.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Bɛrilahairoi; ka di do Kadɛshi mini Bɛrɛd sunsuuni.
en: That's why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered, The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.

dag: Chɛ ka n dol a zaligunim soli, dama n suhu yuri li pam.
en: Keep me obedient to your commandments, because in them I find happiness.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa zo ka chɛ Yisa, ka malaikanim kana ti kpaŋs o suhu.
en: Then the devil left Jesus, and angels came to help him.

dag: Wɔr sabila ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la daa zaŋ kpala nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la, ka wɔr piɛla ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka wɔr fufuhisi ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la mi zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa kali Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm kalinli n-daa bala.
en: These are the enrolled of the Gershonite clans, all who worked in the meeting tent, and whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the LORDs command.

dag: N ni tim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣindi na ka bɛ ti saɣim a. Bɛ zaa gbibila bɛ bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti ŋmahi yi sida da viɛl la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: I will summon destroyers against you, who will use their weapons to cut down your finest cedars and hurl them into the fire.

dag: ka duh o yee suhi Naawuni bɔh o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n ni kana ti be pako so sani ŋɔ bidibiga ŋɔ kpi n-ti o suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Then Elijah cried out to the Lord . He said, Lord my God, this widow is letting me stay in her house. Will you do this bad thing to her? Will you cause her son to die.

dag: Maligumaana Aduna bidibisi mi n-yɛn piɛbiri kikahi maa. Kikahi maa n-yɛn nyɛ yi kali soli bini yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The trumpets are to be blown by Aaron's sons, the priests. The following rule is to be observed for all time to come.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa yɛli Yisahaku, Hiti paɣiba ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu bi doya. Yaakubu yi kpuɣi Hiti paɣa ka o be kaman bɛmbɔŋɔ, bebu bukaata lan yɛn nyɛ bɔ n sani.
en: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, Your son Esau married Hittite women. I am very upset about this, because they are not our people. Ill have nothing to live for if Jacob marries one of these women.

dag: ka yɛl o, Wuhim ma a ba ni nyɛ so. Duri be a ba yiŋa ka ti ni gbe nimaani.
en: He said, Please tell me who your father is. Is there room in his house for my men and me to spend the night.

dag: n-zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri maa bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: and will throw the evil ones into a burning furnace. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.

dag: ka daa ti lan yi Bamɔt mi chaŋ vinvamli shɛli din daa do Mɔab tintariga Pisiga zolɔŋni zaŋ lab tiŋgban nɛli polo la.
en: and from Bamoth to the valley in the territory of the Moabites, below the top of Mount Pisgah, looking out over the desert.

dag: n-tuhi Juda Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba soli m-bɔhi ba, Banima n-lee nyɛn ya? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba, ka kana ni ti ti kaai nabihi mini napaɣ Jɛzibɛl bidibisi.
en: There he met with the relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah. Jehu asked, Who are you? They answered, We are the relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah. We have come down to visit the kings children and the queen mothers children.

dag: Asa ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahiyinika o nam maa ni saha shɛli, ka naba polo dɔro daa gbaag o, ka o dɔro maa daa muɣis o pam; amaa dɔro maa ni daa muɣis o maa zaa yoli, o daa bi suhi Yawɛ, amaa ka naɣ dolila timanim bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: In the thirty-ninth year that Asa was king, he was crippled by a severe foot disease; but even then he did not turn to the Lord for help, but to doctors.

dag: Ka niriba bɔhira, Bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti? Ka yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee yɛn zaŋ yɛl ti? Bihi bɛn ŋmaai bihili kɔŋko ka o yɛligu ni sɔŋ?.
en: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord 's message?.

dag: ka yɛra, Aai, ti ni kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli ti ni ku lan nya tɔbu tuhibu bee n-wum kikahi kumsi bee ka kum ti lan gbahi ti, nimaani ka ti yɛn be.
en: And you might say, No, we will go and live in Egypt. We will not be bothered with war there. We will not hear the trumpets of war, and in Egypt we will not be hungry.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun doli n nyaaŋa na la hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi li.
en: He is coming after me, but I am not good enough even to untie his sandals.

dag: Ifriimnim tum tuun shɛli din tahi suhuyiɣisili pam na, dinzuɣu Yawɛ chɛ ka ninvuɣ kubo taali la ʒi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ni ti darigi bɛ tibili bɛ ni daa tur o la zuɣu.
en: The people of Israel have made the Lord bitterly angry; they deserve death for their crimes. Their Lord will punish them for the disgrace they have brought on him.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ lala; bɛ daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Aaron did what the Lord commanded.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a fɔh a nuu ka chɛ ti, hal ka di nyɛla a nudirigu gba? Yihim a nuhi a jɔɣu ni na m-bahi ba yoli.
en: Why wont you help us? Use your power to defeat our enemies!.

dag: bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili dukpina maa zaa gili, ka dur ata maa zaa daa mali takɔriti ti kpa. Di takɔriti maa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔbia polo, bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili di tiŋ polo gili hal ti taɣi di takɔriti.
en: were paneled all around, including the ceilings, closed windows, and its three courses of promenades that adjoined the ceiling. From the ground up to the windows was covered.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ gari ti ni suhi shɛm tariga mini ti ni tɛhi shɛm zuɣu la yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma ti ni la zuɣu.
en: To him who by means of his power working in us is able to do so much more than we can ever ask for, or even think of:.

dag: A nini daa nya ma n nambu saha. N dabisa zaa daa pun sabila a litaafi ni pɔi ka di naanyi piligi.
en: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Sool bipuɣiŋga la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya Naa Dauda ni wari waa ka yiɣiri jɛmda, ka o ʒiɛm o o suhu ni.
en: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord , she was disgusted.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ bar so ŋun gbaya zaa kpi n-niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o kana ti bɔri soli ni bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: There was a man who was paralyzed, and some other men were carrying him on a mat. They tried to bring him and put him down before Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi yiri palo ka kpɛhiri ba saria karibu ni; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb mi daalahichi sɔɣiri ni di ti yi palo dahin shɛli ha.
en: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe Kapɛrinium tiŋ puuni saha shɛli, ka Rom sapashin so daa ka o sanna nti balind o yɛra.
en: Jesus went to the city of Capernaum. When he entered the city, an army officer came to him and begged for help.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali yɛm gari biŋkɔbiri bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ lee be ya.
en: He is the one who makes us smarter than any animal on earth and wiser than any bird.

dag: amaa Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa zaɣisi Naawuni ni zali ba shɛm, ka bɛn daa bi deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani.
en: But the Pharisees and legal experts rejected Gods will for themselves because they hadnt been baptized by John.

dag: Ti zaa nyɛla alahichinima, ka ti wuntia tuma zaa ŋmanila binchɛr biɛri. Ti daalahichi zuɣu chɛ ka ti ŋmanila vari din kuui n-suui lu ka pɔhim ʒe li bahi.
en: We are all dirty with sin. Even our good works are not pure. They are like bloodstained rags. We are all like dead leaves. Our sins have carried us away like wind.

dag: Naɣilahi pam n-teei gili ma. Bashan naɣilahi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-kul teei gili ma.
en: My enemies surround me like angry bulls. They are like the powerful bulls of Bashan, and they are all around me.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: The ax is ready to cut down the trees at the roots; every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown in the fire.

dag: Dama yi yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbahi yi mabihi mini yi bihi la ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi lab o sani, o ku zaɣisi ya.
en: If you return to the Lord , then those who have taken your relatives away as prisoners will take pity on them and let them come back home. The Lord your God is kind and merciful, and if you return to him, he will accept you.

dag: Lɛvinim daŋ ni: Jɔzabad mini Shimɛi ni Kɛlaya, bɛ ni daa lan booni la ni Pɛtahia ni Juda ni Ɛliɛza.
en: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

dag: Ka pukpar kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, N dana, chɛl li zali yuuni ŋɔ pahi, ka n gbi bɔɣili gil li n-niŋ kulim niŋ li.
en: The gardener answered, Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl yɛl o, Karimba, a nyɛla Naawuni Bia! A nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa.
en: Nathanael said, Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa paɣ o nɛma, ka pin o zabiri zaa, ka su kom yi daɣiri ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi labi yi biɛhigu shee maa na, amaa o ni ti bela o suɣili samban ni daba ayopɔin.
en: The people going through this purification ceremony must wash their clothes, shave off all their hair, and wash with water. Then they will be clean. They may then go into the camp, but they must stay outside their tent for seven days.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbihi padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam ti o na.
en: When it was time for harvest, he sent his servants to the tenant farmers to collect his fruit.

dag: N Naawuni, n kuhi bol a wuntaŋ ni, amaa ka a bi garigi ma; ka n kuhi bol a yuŋ, ka bi nya gom gbihi.
en: My God, I cry out during the day, but you dont answer; even at nighttime I dont stop.

dag: O zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ o zaligu wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: He gives his message to his people, his instructions and laws to Israel.

dag: bɛ daa malila pin shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ti Yisifu la zali gu o kundina saha wuntaŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa wumya ni bɛ min o n-yɛn laɣim di.
en: They prepared the gift, anticipating Josephs arrival at noon, since they had heard that they would have a meal there.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhi bol a, ka a fa ba bahi; bɛ daa niŋ a naani ka bi di vi.
en: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Shia Kasi n-tahiri ma Jɛrusalɛm, ka m mi bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ ma nimaani.
en: But now I must obey the Spirit and go to Jerusalem. I dont know what will happen to me there.

dag: amaa ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi ni nya jilima mini paɣibu ni suhudoo, Yɛhudianima n-lan daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: But he will give glory, honor, and peace to everyone who does good—to the Jews first and also to those who are not Jews.

dag: Lɛbanɔn, yoom a dunoya ka buɣim tooi di a sida tihi luhi.
en: Lebanon, open your gates so that the fire will come and burn your cedar trees.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Sabimi a ni nya ʒii shɛli maa ka chɛ ka di yi zahira pa kuɣiparilana zuɣu, ka ŋun guura ni tooi karim li. .
en: Then the Lord told me: I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia mini tia kam:.
en: Then Jesus told them this parable: Think of the fig tree and all the other trees.

dag: Ŋɔŋmiya kom m-mali shili gu bɛn yɛn teei gili ya. Pahimiya yi birininim yaa. Nomiya yaɣiri, nomiya tandi, ka zaŋya bilichiisi ŋmarigu niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Draw water for yourself to prepare for siege! Strengthen your fortifications! Tread the clay, trample the mortar, grab the brick mold!.

dag: A bɔhiya, N wuntitali maa nyɔri lee nyɛ dini? Ka n ni bi tum alahichi maa, di nyɔri lee nyɛ ma dini.
en: or to ask God, How does my sin affect you? What have I gained by not sinning.

dag: ni ashaara dali ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tiligirimi, ka nyari faako suhuyiɣisili dali?.
en: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.

dag: Di yi pa lala a yi paɣiri Naawuni la a shia ni kɔŋko, wula ka ŋun ka yi kalinli ni ka lan ʒi a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni ni tooi yɛli, Ami, a Naawuni paɣibu maa zuɣu?.
en: After all, if you praise God in the Spirit, how will the people who arent trained in that language say Amen! to your thanksgiving, when they dont know what you are saying?.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, N nyɛla Hiburu, ka jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun nam tiŋgbani mini teeku ŋɔ.
en: Jonah answered, I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.

dag: Ka bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa dol ba daa yi n-chaŋ.
en: So the servants of the district governors with the army behind them marched out from the city.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi boli nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ o gbaɣino ʒira yomyom yɛl o, Ŋoom a takɔbi kuhi ku ma, di yi pa lala, niriba ni yɛli ni paɣa n-ku ma. Ka o nachimbil maa daa shiri zaŋ o takɔbi kuh o, ka o kpi.
en: Then he quickly called the young man who was carrying his weapons and told him, Draw your sword and kill me. I don't want it said that a woman killed me. So the young man ran him through, and he died.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim yi be yi ni galisi pam, di ni chɛ ka yi nyɛla bɛn tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ bɛn mali buchi baŋbu shɛli din yiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni na la puuni.
en: If all these things are in you and growing, you will never fail to be useful to God. You will produce the kind of fruit that should come from your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Paɣ yi birigi n-tum daɣiri tuma saha shɛl o ni be o yidan sulinsi ni, ka o yidan maa zilis o.
en: So this is the law about jealousy. This is what you should do when a woman sins against her husband while she is married to him.

dag: Ka bɛ shini. Ka Yisa daa chɛ ka doo maa kpaŋ, ka bah o ka o lab kul o yiŋa.
en: But they did not say a word. Jesus took hold of the man. Then he healed him and sent him away.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ o sani nti fiɣisi Pool, ka balim o.
en: The leading priests and the important Jewish leaders made charges against Paul before Festus.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali sania balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ karili mini zaɣ bila yi kola ni.
en: Do not cheat when you use weights and measures.

dag: Bɛ ni yi gbaai tayiɣa ka o di vi shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim gba yɛn di vi; bɛ mini bɛ nanima ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim.
en: A thief is ashamed when people catch him stealing. The people of Israel should be ashamed too and so should their kings and leaders, priests and prophets.

dag: Dinzuɣu man kpahimbu puuni, di ni simdi ni ninsalinim niŋ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla bɛ kul diri ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama suhupiɛlli mini bɛ tuma n-kul yɛn doli taba Naawuni ni ti ba nyɛvili shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ puuni.
en: So I decided it was more important to enjoy life because the best thing people can do in this life is to eat, drink, and enjoy life. At least that will help people enjoy the hard work God gave them to do during their life on earth.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi tahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din gbibi ya.
en: Jesus turned and rebuked them.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yi lu, ŋun la ni yiɣis o zali. Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko zuɣu. O yi lu, o ka ŋun ni yiɣis o zali.
en: If one of them falls down, the other can help him up. But if someone is alone and falls, it's just too bad, because there is no one to help him.

dag: Bɛraya mi zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hɛbɛr daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Hɛbɛrnima; ka Malikiɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Malikiɛlnima.
en: The clans of Heber and Malchiel traced their descent from Beriah.

dag: Ka Hakatan bia Jɔhanan daa nyɛ Azigad daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbiga ni pia daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Azgad, Johanan, Hakkatans son and with him men.

dag: Ka zaŋ ti m-buɣisi ti nachintab bɛn diri nayili bindirigu ka nyuri di binnyura la n-nya ti bebu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ka a yi kpahim ti nya, nyin niŋm tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kaman a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm.
en: Then compare our appearance to the appearance of the young men who eat the kings food. Then deal with your servants according to what you see.

dag: N ni daa lihi binnɛma maa, ka n daa nya ka kalinli zaɣ yiniyini ʒe m-baɣi binnɛma maa. Bɛba anahi maa zaa yino kam daa sula zaɣ yini.
en: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel.

dag: Di ni ti yɛn kpalim dabari saha shɛli maa ni zaa di ni ti vuhi vuhim shɛli yi ni daa be nimaani ka di bi nyari yi vuhim dabisa dal la.
en: During the time that the land is empty, it will get the time of rest that you did not give it while you lived there.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yi lu, ŋun la ni yiɣis o zali. Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko zuɣu. O yi lu, o ka ŋun ni yiɣis o zali.
en: If one person falls, the other person can reach out to help. But those who are alone when they fall have no one to help them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim kum nyɛla yɛlikpani Yawɛ sani.
en: Very dear to the Lord are the lives of his followers. He cares when they face death.

dag: Ka ŋun Firawuna daa pirig o nuu ni nintu shɛli o ni mali dalindi binyara n-zaŋ li piri Yisifu, ka zaŋ bimpiɛl viɛlli kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ salima dolibi yɛl o;.
en: Then the king took off his royal ring and put it on Joseph's finger. He gave him fine clothes to wear and placed a gold chain around his neck.

dag: Guŋgombihi din kumsi tiri suhupiɛlli mini mɔɣilɔnim kumsi foya, ka bɛn yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri gba fo.
en: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl mini Liya daa yɛl o, Binshɛli ka ti ba yiŋa ka ti yɛn di li fali.
en: Rachel and Leah answered him, Is there any share or inheritance left for us in our fathers household?.

dag: Di saha maa ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Yim ya ŋɔ, dama Naa Hɛrɔd lɔri nia ni o ku a.
en: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said, You had better get away from here, because Herod wants to kill you.

dag: Ɛhud kum nyaaŋa, Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha.
en: After the death of Ehud, the Israelites again started disobeying the Lord .

dag: Hal bɛ ni booni binshɛŋa buɣa la yi bela zuɣusaa bee dunia ŋɔ ni, dama buɣa pam mini duumanim pam shiri beni.
en: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi sokam vi, ka siɣisi karimbaannima.
en: Everyone, common people and leaders alike, will be humbled. Those who are now so proud will bow their heads in shame.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin cham ti wuh o o taali maa a min o kɔŋko. O yi deeg o galimi, a zaŋ o labisi yi mabiligu maa puuni yaha m-bala.
en: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.

dag: Dauda daa laɣimla Izraɛl kpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima zaa.
en: David gathered all the leaders of Israel and also the priests and Levites.

dag: Tol bɔbili kana nti lu ti tiŋgbɔŋ zuɣu. Bɛ mali yiko pam, ka lan galisi hal nti ka kalinli. Bɛ nyina dirimi kaman gbuɣinli nyina la, ka bɛ nyindari be kaman gbuɣinnyaŋ nyindari la.
en: An army of locusts has attacked our land; they are powerful and too many to count; their teeth are as sharp as those of a lion.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim kul nyɛla din wuhiri bindira mini binnyura ni Yɛhudianim adiini kaya balibu kam din nyɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zaligunim din yɛn beni hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti lan yɛn taɣi mali binshɛlikam zal la.
en: These are superficial regulations that are only about food, drink, and various ritual ways to wash with water. They are regulations that have been imposed until the time of the new order.

dag: ka lan mi o yubu, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa, ka di nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuh a lala zuɣu.
en: you know what God wants you to do, and you have learned from the Law to choose what is right;.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni doli n zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zali ba la mini n dabili Musa ni daa zali ba la zaa, n ku chɛ ka bɛ lan yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n-ti bɛ yaannim maa ni n-chani dari ginda.
en: I will never again remove Israel from the land I gave to their ancestors, provided they carefully do everything I have commanded them—keeping all the Instruction my servant Moses commanded them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi kari zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa yomyom, ka mi daa bi chɛ ka Jɔshua kari ba.
en: That's why the Lord had not let Joshua get rid of those enemy nations all at once.

dag: Juda min o mabihi maa ni daa paai Yisifu yiŋa, o daa na be yiŋa, ka bɛ daa damd o tooni.
en: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Josephs house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground in front of him.

dag: hal ka di pala bɛ zuliya maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ni o laɣim Naawuni bihi bɛn wurim kpe yɔɣu na la gba ka bɛ ti lee zaɣ yini.
en: and not only for the nation. Jesus would also die so that Gods children scattered everywhere would be gathered together as one.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di dabisa maa puuni ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: The days will come when the groom will be taken from them, and then they will fast.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhoyakim daa tim Akibɔr bia Ɛlnatan mini do shɛba Ijipti.
en: But King Jehoiakim dispatched Elnathan, Achbors son, and others to Egypt.

dag: Kum ku gbuɣinli ŋun mali yaa, ka gbuɣinnyaŋ bihi wurim.
en: the lion perishes without prey, and its cubs are scattered.

dag: Ka chɛ ti taali paŋ ti kaman ti gba ni chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali shɛm la.
en: Forgive our sins, just as we have forgiven those who did wrong to us.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N suhu paligiya! Dama paɣiba ni boli ma suhupiɛlli; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Asha.
en: and Leah said, Im happy now because women call me happy. So she named him Asher.

dag: Lala ka n ti yɛn yiɣisi n suhu bahi gooni maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ya, Gooni maa lan kani, ka bɛn daa zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa gba lan kani.
en: I will exhaust my fury on the wall and on those who laid plaster on it. Then I will say to you, Where is the wall? and Where are those who plastered it.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan mali ʒiʒiriba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣikpɛriba tuhi pihinii zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: He also had , workers to cut stone in the hill country of Israel, , workers to carry the stones.

dag: Kulla dindali maa yuŋ ka bɛ daa ku Bɛlishaaza ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim naa maa.
en: That same night Belshazzar, the king of Babylonia, was killed;.

dag: Bɛ daa laɣimla Jɛrusalɛm Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu gol so ŋun pahir ata la ni.
en: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na maa.
en: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.

dag: O daa lan me n-gili Adɔraim mini Lakishi ni Azɛka.
en: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ so ŋunkam mali salima yihi li na. Ka bɛ daa yihi li na ti ti ma, ka n zaŋ li bahi buɣim ni, ka naɣibil ŋɔ yina.
en: So I said to them, Whoever has gold, take it off! So they gave it to me, I threw it into the fire, and out came this bull calf.

dag: Kaman dam din miha ni to noli ni, ka nyɔhi biɛri nimbihi ni shɛm, lala ka vinnyaɣinim gba be bɛ tumalaannim sani.
en: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so are lazy people to those who authorize them.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha bɔh o, N shia di ka a sani saha shɛli doo la ni di yi o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-kana ti tuh a sol la? Pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla saha shɛli di ni simdi ni a deeri liɣiri mini binyɛra ni olivi tihi ni tihi puri ni piɛri ni niɣi ni dabidɔbba ni dabipaɣiba?.
en: Elisha said to him, That is not true! My heart was with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you. This is not the time to take money, clothes, olives, grapes, sheep, cattle, or men and women servants.

dag: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu bini pihinahi. Dapaɣ yini daa malila di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka dapaɣ yini gba mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi.
en: and forty silver bases, two bases under the first board, two bases under the next board, and so on.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi kum shɛli Pita ni daa ti yɛn kpi, ka di ti Naawuni jilima la. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli Pita, Doli ma.
en: Then Jesus said to him, Follow me.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, Dinzuɣu bɔ ka a lee lan guhira? Yiɣisima n-deei kom baptaizibu ka kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ka a daalahichi kpihim. .
en: Now, dont wait any longer. Get up, be baptized and wash away your sins, trusting in Jesus to save you. .

dag: Ka o gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni, ka takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi yir o nol ni na, ka o ninni ne kaman wuntaŋ ni yi neei ni o kpiɔŋ zaa shɛm la.
en: He held seven stars in his right hand. A sharp two-edged sword came out of his mouth. He looked like the sun shining at its brightest time.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yisahaku zuliya jɛmbu shee saɣim; ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim sara maligu bimbin la shee saɣim; chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam zuliya zaa.
en: Isaacs high places will be destroyed. Israels holy places will be made into a pile of rocks. I will attack and kill Jeroboams family with swords.

dag: Ka ti dimnim maa daa yɛli, Bɛ ku baŋ bee n-nya binshɛli pɔi, ka ti kana ti liri ba ku ba, ka tuma maa zani tariga.
en: Our enemies were saying, Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.

dag: Di zuɣu ka yi leei bɛn mali biɛrisuŋ yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn zaa be Masidɔnia mini Akaia la sani.
en: As a result you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

dag: Ka di yi na mali puma ka bɛ bi chɛ li sɔŋ, di daŋdila mɔɣu kam kuubu.
en: No, they will dry up before harvest. They will be too small to cut and use.

dag: A yi zab ti zuɣu, ka niriba wum zabili maa damli, bɛ zɔrimi.
en: At the noise, peoples fled; on account of your roar, nations scattered.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lan yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash, Kpuɣim piɛma; ka o kpuɣ li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋm li fiɛb tiŋa; ka o zaŋ li fiɛb tiŋ buta ka chɛ lala.
en: Elisha said, Take the arrows. Jehoash took the arrows. Then Elisha said to him, Hit on the ground. Jehoash hit the ground three times. Then he stopped.

dag: Ka Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa wum o kum maa yɛla, ka chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti sɔɣi.
en: When John's disciples heard about this, they came and got his body, and buried it.

dag: Yawɛ guli saamba, ka gbibi pakoya mini kpibisi. Amaa o saɣindi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo nia shɛŋa.
en: The LORD: who protects immigrants, who helps orphans and widows, but who makes the way of the wicked twist and turn!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri diri ma shɛhira biɛri, ka wuhi ni n tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa, ka n ʒi di yɛla.
en: There are witnesses trying to harm me. They ask me questions that I know nothing about.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Doo maa n-daa bɔhi ti ti mini ti dɔɣiriba yɛla pam hal ti bɔhi ti, Yi ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Yi mali tizo? Ka ti mi daa garig o bɔhigunim maa; ti daa lee yɛn niŋ wula baŋ ni o ni yɛl ti, Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa na? .
en: They said, The man asked us pointedly about our family: Is your father still alive? Do you have a brother? So we told him just what weve said. How were we to know hed say, Bring your brother down here.

dag: Bɛ ni teei gili yinim ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ, kpuɣimiya yi daadiikunim tiŋgban ni.
en: Get everything you own and prepare to leave. People of Judah, you are trapped in the city, and the enemy is all around it.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi paɣiba mini bɛnkam daa be nimaani n-nyɛ bihi ni ninkura zaa. Bɛ daa bi ku so, amaa bɛ daa kul gbahi ba mi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: and had taken away the women and children.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni boli shɛb la, wummiya! Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ piligu. Mani n-nyɛ naabu.
en: Listen to me, Jacob; Israel, whom I called: I am the one; I am the first and I am the last.

dag: O yɛliya, Maamiya yi ni ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun yuli du zuliya kam sani, ka nyɛ ŋun yuli du dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Our God says, Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa bol o yiŋbihi na ni o ti mal o liɣiri din be bɛ sani laasabu.
en: So Gods kingdom is like a king who decided to collect the money his servants owed him.

dag: Yɛhudianim pam ni daa wum ni Yisa be nimaani maa ka bɛ daa kana. Pa Yisa kɔŋko zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana, amaa bɛ daa kamina ni bɛ ti nya Lazarɔs so Yisa ni daa neei kum ni la.
en: A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death.

dag: wulikpani nyoli ni ŋ-ŋmaai di zaɣ maani n-zaŋ li chaŋ daabiligu tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti zaŋ li sa kɔhigɔriba tiŋ ni.
en: He plucked a twig from the cedars crown, brought it to the land of traders, and set it down in a city of merchants.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili din galisi pam la ni, ka di kom nyuui zaa ni di mali soli ti wulimpuhili polo nanima.
en: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates. The water in the river was dried up. This prepared the way for the rulers from the east to come.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka tiliginsim paag a yili ŋɔ na, dama a gba yila Ibrahimma zuliya ni na.
en: Jesus said to him, Salvation has come to this house today, for this man, also, is a descendant of Abraham.

dag: A tizɔpaɣ yurigu la bihi puhir a.
en: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.

dag: Zomiya tiligi yi nyɛviya. Zomiya kaman mɔɣu ni buŋa m-be tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Run away! Run for your lives! Run away like a weed blowing through the desert.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni, Gidiɔni bia Abidan n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Benjamin—Abidan son of Gideoni;.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a ti ŋma a zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yili tia ka noonsi di a nimdi.
en: After three days, Pharaoh will give you an audience and will hang you from a tree where birds will peck your flesh from you.

dag: Naawuni yila Tɛman na. Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yila Paran Zoli zuɣu na. Ka o jilima pili zuɣusaa. Ka o paɣibu pali dunia zaa.
en: God is coming from Teman. The Holy One is coming from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covers the heavens, and his praise fills the earth!.

dag: Ka Pita daa zani dunol ni niŋdi gaafara, ka paɣisar so ŋun yuli booni Roda daa kana ni o ti nya ŋun bala.
en: When Peter knocked at the outer gate, a female servant named Rhoda went to answer.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli yiri Shiiba na maa buchi lee nyɛ dini n sani? Bee binnyoma din yi katiŋ na maa buchi lee nyɛ di ni n sani? N ku deei yi ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara la. M mi nini bi lan tiɣi yi sara maligunima.
en: Why do you bring me incense from the country of Sheba ? Why do you bring me sweet-smelling cane from a faraway country? Your burnt offerings dont make me happy. Your sacrifices dont please me.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binzahi maa diba anu n-zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ diba anu zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nuzaa polo; ka zaŋ kɔniŋdi bin la mi zali nudirigu polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo.
en: He put five stands on the south side of the temple, five stands on the north side, and the large bowl at the southeast corner of the temple.

dag: Bilichiisi duri luya, amaa ti ni kpe kuɣa m-me shɛŋa zali di zaani. Sinsabisi tihi vuɣi lu, amaa ti ni bo sida tihi sa n-zali di zaani.
en: Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa taai bahi Musa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, Ti yi di daa pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu kpi Yawɛ tooni, di naan so.
en: and complained: It would have been better if we had died in front of the Lord 's Tent along with the other Israelites.
