dag: Ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Yɛlim ma a ni mali shɛl a yiŋa. Ka o yɛl o, A dabipaɣa ka shɛli; kulla kpaŋman yini kɔŋko ka m mali.
en: Elisha answered, How can I help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house? The woman said, I dont have anything in the house except a jar of olive oil.

dag: Nam din ti yɛn doli a nam ŋɔ nyaaŋa ti ku paag a dini ŋɔ. Di nyaaŋa, ka nam din pah ata n-nyɛ daanya ka ti yɛn su dunia zaa la deei.
en: Another kingdom will come after you, but it will not be as great as your kingdom. Next, a third kingdom will rule over the earth—that is the bronze part.

dag: Di ni tilig a zaɣ biɛɣu ni, ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: These will keep you from following the wrong path and will protect you from those who have evil plans.

dag: Di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be tiŋkpansi zaŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali leei suhupiɛlli vuhim mini chuɣu puhibu dabisili, ka daa niŋ bindira tari taba.
en: That is why Jews who live in villages make the fourteenth day of the month of Adar a day of rejoicing and feasts, a holiday. It is a day on which they send gifts of food to each other.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti vuhi pam bahi mɔri zuɣu, di kuurimi, ka tipum kpahiri lura; yɛlimaŋli, ninsalinim shiri ŋmanila mɔri.
en: When a wind from the Lord blows on them, the grass dies and the flower falls. Yes, all people are like grass.

dag: Ti zaa chirindi pam, ka so yi bi chirim o yɛtɔɣa puuni, dilan nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu be dɛde, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali yiko din ni tooi gbib o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: We all make many mistakes. A person who never said anything wrong would be perfect. Someone like that would be able to control their whole body too.

dag: Dama yɛm so salima nɛma, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa buɣisi yɛm.
en: Wisdom is better than pearls; nothing is more delightful than she.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa din pahi ni o yɛm tuma la yɛla sab be Sulemaana tuma litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Solomon did, from the beginning to the end, is written in the book, The History of Solomon .

dag: Yawɛ n-sɔŋdi ba, ka fari ba bahira; ŋuna n-fari ba ka tiligiri ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; bɛ ni zɔrina nti sɔɣir o sani zuɣu.
en: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.

dag: Giliad tizɔpaɣ Hamolɛkɛt n-daa dɔɣi Ishɔd mini Abiɛza ni Mahila.
en: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, Mahlah, and Shemida.

dag: M be yi sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm. N ni laɣim yi zuliya bɛn be wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo zaa na.
en: So dont be afraid, because I am with you. I will gather your children and bring them to you. I will gather them from the east and from the west.

dag: ka ʒi o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-labiri kuni ka karindi Anabi Aizaia litaafi.
en: Now he was on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot reading from the book of Isaiah the prophet.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave Moses the following regulations.

dag: Asa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Asas deeds, from beginning to end, are written in the official records of Israels and Judahs kings.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zali yiya tuɣi taba, ka gbahi paliti tuɣi taba hal ka so ti ku lan nya palo nimaani pahi yi zuɣu, ka yi kɔŋko n-kul be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Doom to those who acquire house after house, who annex field to field until there is no more space left and only you live alone in the land.

dag: luɣ shɛli o ni daa be n-lihir o piɛ shɛb bɛn mali bihi la ni o ti leei ŋun su Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim la.
en: God brought him from shepherding nursing ewes to shepherd his people Jacob, to shepherd his inheritance, Israel.

dag: Di saɣi ka so ʒiɛm a a bipalitali zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa min a ni niŋdi shɛm ni a yurilim ni a yɛda niŋbu ni a biɛr kasi wuhi ni a biɛhigu nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba ni ni dol shɛli naba.
en: Dont let anyone look down on you because you are young. Instead, set an example for the believers through your speech, behavior, love, faith, and by being sexually pure.

dag: N niriba, wummiya n wuhibu; wummiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.

dag: Lɔt saha la gba, lala n-daa nyɛ li: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka dari ka kɔhira; ka biriti ka mɛri yiya.
en: When Lot lived, people were also eating and drinking. They were buying, selling, planting, and building.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, N ni daa be yi sani ka yɛri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la m-bɔŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim ni ni Yila litaafi ni zaŋ chaŋ n polo la daa kpami ni di zaa ha niŋ pali.
en: Jesus said to them, While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.

dag: Hɛbɛr n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt mini Shoma ni Hɔtam ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Shua ba.
en: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni zaɣisi n yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: You refused to listen to me.

dag: Nir yi daŋ deeg o fali yomyom piligu ni, di bahigu ti ka anfaani.
en: The more easily you get your wealth, the less good it will do you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins ata Naftali zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Kɛdɛshi din be Galili, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tiligiri la mini Hamɔtidɔr ni Karitan m-pahi di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu.
en: From the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, the refuge city for the killer, and its pastures; Hammoth-dor and its pastures; and Kartan and its pastures; in total: three cities.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ biɛri firila kpiya ka bɛ buɣim bi lan ne.
en: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria;.
en: Dont judge, so that you wont be judged.

dag: Ka o daa kpɛri bɛ jɛmbu duri ni ti wuhiri ba, ka sokam zaa daa tibigir o pam.
en: He taught in their synagogues and was praised by everyone.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan boli niriba pam na ti yɛli ba, Yi zaa luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: Then Jesus called the crowd again and said, Listen to me, all of you, and understand.

dag: Kaman saa pɔhim ni tahiri sakom na shɛm, lala ka nyaanzum tahiri suhuyiɣisili na.
en: The north wind stirs up rain, and a person who plots quietly provokes angry faces.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a tiri ninvuɣ so dabili zalige? O zanibu bee o lubu nyɛla o duuma yɛla. Ka o shiri ni zani, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi chɛ ka o zani.
en: You cannot judge the servants of someone else. Their own master decides if they are doing right or wrong. And the Lords servants will be right, because the Lord is able to make them right.

dag: O daa wuhi ba: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli n dan Iso shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A dabili Yaakubu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N daa chaŋ ti bela Leeban sani hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ.
en: He gave them these orders: Say this to my master Esau. This is the message of your servant Jacob: Ive lived as an immigrant with Laban, where Ive stayed till now.

dag: Ti bi lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni nyara, amaa ti lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni bi nyara, dama nir nini ni nyari binshɛŋa nyɛla din ku yuui, amaa binshɛŋa nir nini ni bi nyari nyɛla din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: So we think about what we cannot see, not what we see. What we see lasts only a short time, and what we cannot see will last forever.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu sɔɣira, o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee muɣisigu saha.
en: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.

dag: Ti Naa maa nam dibu chuɣu puhibu dabisili yi ti paai, o min o kpambaliba nyurila wain hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala, ka laɣim maani niriba ansarisi.
en: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyini Masia, a daanabitali puuni wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: said, Prophesy for us, Messiah! Guess who hit you.

dag: A situra tulimi, pɔhim tulli ni ʒiɛri zuɣu.
en: No, you can only suffer in the heat when the south wind oppresses the land.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa zaŋ Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa yiŋa n-ti Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta. Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli naa ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla o dɔɣim. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Mɔdɛkai nya soli kpɛri naa sani.
en: That same day King Ahasuerus gave Queen Esther what Haman the enemy of the Jews owned. Mordecai himself came before the king because Esther had told the king that he was family to her.

dag: ka Samuɛl mi daa do Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ni daa be la, ka bɛ daa na bi kpihi Naawuni firila.
en: The special lamp in the Lord s temple was still burning, so Samuel lay down in the temple near where the Holy Box was.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini di kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o lee naa maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani.
en: Jehoiakim was years old when he became the new king of Judah. He was king in Jerusalem for eleven years. Jehoiakim did not obey God. He did what the Lord his God considered evil.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, This is my blood which is poured out for many, my blood which seals God's covenant.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni naai, ka Yaakubu ŋmalig o ba Yisahaku sani yi, di daa bi yuui ka o biɛli Iso yi o mɔɣu gɔbu maa paa na.
en: Right after Isaac had given Jacob his blessing and Jacob had gone, Esau came back from hunting.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu maa ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani. Di yuuni maa ni, di ti biriya bee n-kpuɣi bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli bee m-pɔhiya yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni wala.
en: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.

dag: Lumiya bɛn zuɣuri paligi sizuura, ka timiya ninkura jilima, ka zomiya yi Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Show respect for old people and honor them. Reverently obey me; I am the Lord .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Magadan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After dismissing the crowds, Jesus got into the boat and came to the region of Magadan.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa bo niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi do zoya zuɣu gu Abimilɛk, ka daa kul fari bɛnkam zaa doli nimaani gariti nɛma. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: Then they sent some men to hide on the hilltops and watch for Abimelech and his troops, while they sent others to rob everyone that went by on the road. But Abimelech found out what they were doing.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ku Chɛmɔshi niriba, ka gbahi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi daba chaŋ.
en: It will be bad for you, Moab. Chemoshs people are being destroyed. Your sons and daughters are being taken away as prisoners and captives.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam pala bindira mini binnyura yɛla, amaa di nyɛla wuntia mini suhudoo ni suhupiɛlli yɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: For God's Kingdom is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of the righteousness, peace, and joy which the Holy Spirit gives.

dag: ka yɛli, N tum alahichi, dama n yi ŋun ka taali nyaaŋa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka dimbɔŋɔ nya ti ya? A yɛla m-bala.
en: and said, I have sinned by betraying a man who has never done anything wrong. So what? That's your problem, they replied.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla Hiburunima? N gba nyɛla Hiburu. Bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya? N gba nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya. Bɛ nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi? N gba nyɛla o yaaŋa.
en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Benya o naba ni jɛmm o. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Magnify the LORD, our God! Bow low at his footstool! He is holy!.

dag: Amaa dilan yi bɔr ni o yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, ŋun yom daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zali da shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional percent.

dag: Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ni ti no n-gili yi solɔri zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi niriba, ka daai yi daantali kara la luhi tiŋa.
en: His troops will ride through your streets, killing people left and right, and your strong columns will crumble to the ground.

dag: Zuŋɔ yi dim maa be Nɔb; o ni kpilim o nuu gahi Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm zol la gbini.
en: Today the enemy are in the town of Nob, and there they are shaking their fists at Mount Zion, at the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ takɔbi chaŋ ti lu Nɔb din daa nyɛ maligumaaniba tiŋ la nim zuɣu n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi ni biliɛri ni naɣilahi ni bunsi ni piɛri. O daa zaŋla takɔbi ku bɛ zaa.
en: He put the whole priestly city of Nob to the sword: men and women, children and infants, even oxen, donkeys, and sheep.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, zuliya kam ni ti nya a nasara dibu, ka nanim zaa ti nya a jilima. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ yu palli shɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti a la bol a.
en: Then all nations will see your goodness. All kings will see your honor. Then you will have a new name that the Lord himself will give you.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Ka a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela neesim ni; amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela zibisim ni.
en: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi ka Izraɛl kpamba daa dol o ka bɛ chaŋ Datan mini Abiram sani.
en: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya bɛn nuhi gbarigi la mini bɛn duna gbarigi la.
en: Give strength to hands that are tired and to knees that tremble with weakness.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia.
en: Then Isaiah received this message from the Lord :.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sanna nti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba zaa ʒila o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini.
en: So he went back and found Balak still standing by his burnt offering with all the leaders of Moab.

dag: N shia, labim a vuhim shee na, dama Yawɛ niŋ a nirilim pam.
en: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.

dag: N ni fo baalim, ka ku yɛli shɛli, dama nyini n-niŋ lala.
en: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.

dag: ka taɣi ma ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ liri ma la ku paa ma. Bɛna n-nyɛ n dimnim bɛn gili ma niŋ sunsuuni m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la;.
en: Save me from the wicked people who are trying to destroy me. Protect me from those who come to hurt me.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: When he came, the woman said, Are you Joab? Yes, I am, he answered. She said, Please, listen to what I have to say. All right, he said. I'll listen.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni niŋ a ni lo ma alikauli ni a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti ma. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam. Di zaŋ a nuhi tuma bahi.
en: You, Lord , will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ tɛhima, ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali na mi n-kpi? Bee ya polo ka bɛ mi n-zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun biɛhigu tuhi?.
en: Think! What innocent person has ever perished? When have those who do the right thing been destroyed?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi Ibrahimma, Bɔzuɣu ka Zara la ka yɛli, N ni kurigi shɛm ŋɔ, n ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: The Lord asked Abraham, Why did Sarah laugh? Does she doubt that she can have a child in her old age?.

dag: yɛl o, Kpɛm Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni nti zaŋ binshɛli dalim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa siɣinda ka ŋuhira bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa zaa di ni la gbɛri zuɣu.
en: Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.

dag: Pako so yi mali bihi bee yaansi, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ daadiini fukumsi ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ dɔɣiriba polo din ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi niŋ bɛ laamba mini bɛ yabipaɣiba din simdi labisi, dama lala niŋbu n-nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.

dag: O daa lan bɔri ni o kahigila o jilima din galisi n-wuhi o ni daa zaŋ li niŋ tinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya o nambɔzɔbo la ni, ka mali ti zali ni ti ti nya o jilima.
en: And he also wanted to reveal his abundant glory, which was poured out on us who are the objects of his mercy, those of us whom he has prepared to receive his glory.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni! Ami!.
en: My brothers and sisters, I pray that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ will be with your spirits. Amen.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jɛfita zuɣu na. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti tim Giliad mini Manaasa tiŋgbana ni n-gari chaŋ Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni la n-daa yi Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni maa gari chaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgban ni.
en: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah, and he passed through the area of Gilead and Manasseh. He went through the city of Mizpah in Gilead on his way to the land of the Ammonites.

dag: Bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baal mini Ashitarɔt.
en: The Israelites stopped following the Lord and began worshiping Baal and Ashtoreth.

dag: Ʒiɛman yini niriba ni paɣ a a ni tum shɛm zuɣu ʒiɛman shɛli niriba sani, ka yɛl a yiko tuma yɛla.
en: Each generation will praise you and tell the next generation about the great things you do.

dag: Ka Dauda mi bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan ti kariti doli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum?.
en: Why, David continued, is my master chasing me, his servant? What have I done and what wrong am I guilty of?.

dag: Ka kpatoon kpɛm daa vihi hal ti nya o nimaani m-bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka nyin doya gbihira? Yiɣisim suh a wuni ka o sɔŋ ti. Di pa shɛli ka o zo ti nambɔɣu tiligi ti nyɛviya.
en: The captain found him there and said to him, What are you doing asleep? Get up and pray to your god for help. Maybe he will feel sorry for us and spare our lives.

dag: Bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidib dɔɣirisi shɛb chaŋ ka bɛ ti leei namɔɣilisi be Babilɔn naa yiŋa.
en: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣi Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, man daa pun beni.
en: I am telling you the truth, Jesus replied. Before Abraham was born, I Am.

dag: Ka ti daa yi Taai m-be kom maa ni m-mali ti paai Tolɛmais n-daa chaŋ ti puhi ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani, ka gbe bɛ sani dahin yini.
en: We sailed from Tyre to Ptolemais, where we greeted the followers and stayed with them for a day.

dag: Nahiŋgu balibu kam n-kul beni, ka yɔhiŋgu balibu kam beni! Bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku baŋ ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.

dag: Tiŋ maa daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa nyɛ yim; ka o daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa buɣisi tiŋ maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi; ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni di dubu zaa nyɛ yim.
en: The city was built in a square. Its length was equal to its width. The angel measured the city with the rod. The city was , stadia long, , stadia wide, and , stadia high.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa po pɔri yɛli ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ku lan zaŋ ba tahi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa la ni.
en: So in the desert I swore another solemn pledge, that I wouldnt bring them to the land that I had given to them, a land full of milk and honey, a land more splendid than any other.

dag: A ni yiɣisi zo Ziɔn nambɔɣu, dama saha paaya ni a niŋ li nirilim; di saha maa mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti niŋ Naa Ɛhab naŋgban malisim ka o chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad ka bɛ ti ku o? Ka ŋumbɔŋɔ yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The Lord asked, Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed? They talked about it for a while.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a chɛ ti bahi yɔbahi sunsuuni, ka lan chɛ ti niŋ zibisim tital ni.
en: Yet you left us helpless among wild animals; you abandoned us in deepest darkness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a baɣa be n ni ka garigi ma. Tim ma yaa yaha, di yi pa lala n ni kpi.
en: Look at me! Answer me, LORD my God! Restore sight to my eyes! Otherwise, Ill sleep the sleep of death.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ, ka bɔ nti yɛn nyɛ a kandina mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu shihira? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: Now while Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately and said, Tell us, when will these things happen? What will be the sign of your coming and the end of the age.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni niŋ di shɛli nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la shihirili.
en: Then the priest will take part of the grain offering and lift it up as a memorial offering. He will bring it to the altar to be burned up as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, bɛ chani kabirila yiya kpɛra, ka biɛɣu neei, ka bɛ kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ duri; bɛ bi mi neesim.
en: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa kuri su shɛli din mali naŋgbana ayi, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kaman sɛntimita pihinu ka o zaŋ li lo n-tabil o nudirigu gbalipini n-ye o binyɛrigu limsi li.
en: Now Ehud made for himself a double-edged sword that was about a foot and a half long, and he strapped it on his right thigh under his clothes.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunim wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la. .
en: Their worship of me is worthless. The things they teach are only human rules. Isaiah :.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ bee anabi bee maligumaana yi ti bɔh a, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna lee nyɛ dini?, nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya: Yinima n-nyɛ yɛlimuɣisirili maa. N ni kari ya bahi. .
en: When these people or a prophet or a priest asks you, What is the LORDs message? say to them, What message? I will cast you off, declares the LORD.

dag: Ŋuni n-leei beni ka ku kpi? Ka ŋuni n-leei ni tooi tiligi kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni?.
en: Who can live and never die? How can we humans keep ourselves from the grave?.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya gban shɛli ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira.
en: I looked up again and saw a flying scroll.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛr ayi maa daa kana ti ʒin tuh o, ka fiɣisi Nabɔt yɛli, Nabɔt turila Naawuni mini naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: Then the two liars came and sat in front of him. They testified against Naboth in front of the people, Naboth cursed God and king! So the people took Naboth outside the town and stoned him so that he died.

dag: Hal bɛ daa yi zaŋ anchitinima bee situra din shihi ŋun Pool nti pa barinim zuɣu bɛ nyarila alaafee, ka alizin biɛri gba daa zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: Even the small towels and aprons that had touched his skin were taken to the sick, and their diseases were cured and the evil spirits left them.

dag: Chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni viɛnyɛliŋga: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: Dont forget what I will tell you now: The Son of Man will soon be handed over to the control of other men.

dag: Dama alahichi tumbu yɔri nyɛla kum, amaa Naawuni pini nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: The wages that sin pays are death, but Gods gift is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Di zɔnya yi dimnim dabiɛm! Kul maliya suhukpeeni ka di kahigi wuhi ba ni bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, amaa ka yinim ti tiligi, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nasara.
en: And you will not be afraid of those who are against you. All of this is proof from God that you are being saved and that your enemies will be lost.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ li lee kali ni zaligu Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka bɛ dol li hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: David made this an order and rule for Israel. This rule continues even today.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti ŋmaligi chaŋ bɛ namda ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani.
en: Then the people will look up to the one who made them. Their eyes will see the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi n ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yɛla ni n ni daa kpaŋ mmaŋ shɛm niŋ li, ka di zaa kul nyɛla din ka buchi. Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim, ka binshɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni mali buchi.
en: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka po pɔri yɛli ma ni n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ, ni n ku kpe tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su la ni.
en: The LORD was angry with me because of your deeds and swore that I couldnt cross the Jordan River or enter the wonderful land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nir maa daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl naa, Miri ka a doli yaakaza polo, dama Sirianim yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni la nimaani.
en: But the man of God sent a message to the king of Israel. Elisha said, Be careful! Dont go by that place, because the Aramean soldiers are hiding there.

dag: Ka yɛli Izraɛlnima, Zaŋmiya bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ naɣibil ŋun paai yuuni mini piɛbil ŋun paai yuuni m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la;.
en: Then tell the people of Israel to take a male goat for a sin offering, a one-year-old calf, and a one-year-old lamb without any defects for a burnt offering.

dag: Ka di yi pa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni nini ku tiɣi nira. Dama ŋunkam chaŋ Naawuni sani, di niŋ kamaata ni o niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni beni ka deeri bɛn bɔr o ni bɛ suhuri zaa suhigu.
en: Without faith no one can please God. Whoever comes to God must believe that he is real and that he rewards those who sincerely try to find him.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba mini salo maa, M bi nya doo ŋɔ taali.
en: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, I find no legal basis for action against this man.

dag: M bia, gbibi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka n ni zal a shɛm be a suhu ni.
en: My son, keep my words; store up my commands within you.

dag: Yisa ni daa yiɣisi ni n-chaŋ naai ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kul gbaag o nol ni luɣisibu ni di chɛ ka o yɛli din bie.
en: When Jesus went out, the teachers of the law and the Pharisees began to give him much trouble. They tried to make him answer questions about many things.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ ban yini gɔhi li tabili taba zuɣusaa polo, amaa ka chɛ ka di zaŋ siɣi tiŋ na woligi taba; lala ka yi ni ti niŋ diba ayi maa zaa, ka di niŋ lɔrisi ayi maa.
en: The frames at the corners should be joined together at the bottom. At the top a ring will hold the frames together. Do the same for both corners.

dag: Ka di daa ti paai biɛɣu pia maa, ka bɛ nina ni kul nɛmi zaa kasi, ka bɛ lan ŋmɛlim gari bɛ tab bɛn zaa daa diri nayili bindirigu maa.
en: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti vuui, amaa nyin kul ni kpalim be; di zaa ni kurigi kaman situra ni kurigiri shɛm la.
en: These things will disappear, but you will stay. They will all wear out like old clothes.

dag: A mini naa yi ʒini ni yi di bindirigu, nyin kpahimmi baŋ din ʒe a tooni maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, carefully consider what is in front of you.

dag: ka Izraɛlnim zaa gba naanyi tiligi kaman di ni sab yɛli Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Tiligira ni ti yi Ziɔn na; o ni ti yihi Yaakubu zuliya tuumbiɛri zaa bahi.
en: And that is how all Israel will be saved. The Scriptures say, The Savior will come from Zion; he will take away all evil from the family of Jacob.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni mani n-zali ya zaligu ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛl la zani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you will know that I have given you this command, so that my covenant with the priests, the descendants of Levi, will not be broken.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayi ni ka niriba pam daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: A huge crowd gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month. A very large congregation gathered.

dag: Lɛvi mabia Asaf ŋun daa be o nudirigu polo jɛmbu duu maa ni la daa nyɛla Bɛrɛkia bia, ka Bɛrɛkia nyɛ Shimia bia.
en: His relative was Asaph, who stood on his right, that is, Asaph son of Berechiah son of Shimea.

dag: Amaa nyamiya, m mini ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa n-laɣim ʒi teebuli gbini diri ŋɔ.
en: But look! My betrayer is with me; his hand is on this table.

dag: O dolila wuntia soli kariti dunianim saria; o bi gaŋdi so o saria karibu ni.
en: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti be Ɛngɛdi sɔɣisili shee.
en: Then David went from there and lived at the En-gedi fortresses.

dag: Ti Duuma, deem ti suhigu ka chɛ m-paŋ ti. Ti Duuma, wummi ti suhigu maa ka niŋ ti ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni nyini n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni. Di chɛ ka di lan yuui! Tiŋ maa mini niriba maa nyɛla a dini.
en: Lord, listen to me! Forgive us! Lord, pay attention, and then do something! Dont wait! Do something now! Do it for your own good! My God, do something now, for your city and your people who are called by your name.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Kamiyana ka ti chaŋ Giligal nti lan leei ti nam maa.
en: Then Samuel said to the people, Come, lets go to Gilgal. At Gilgal we will again make Saul the king.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛli shɛm maa tiɣi Izraɛlnim maa nini, ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni, ka bi lan yɛli tɔbu lo n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba, ka saɣim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni daa ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa yɛla.
en: The Israelites were also satisfied. They were happy and thanked God. They decided not to go and fight against the people of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh. They decided not to destroy the land where those people live.

dag: Jaazia bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔham mini Zakur ni Ibiri.
en: Jaaziah son of Merari had sons named Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛmani maa ni ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka Jɛhoyakim daa zaŋ omaŋ ti o n-jɛm o yuma ata; di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti zaɣis o jɛmbu.
en: In Jehoiakims days, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon attacked. Jehoiakim had submitted to him for three years, but then Jehoiakim changed his mind and rebelled against him.

dag: Yi bi mi ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu ka ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ti ku bahi yoli.
en: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa bi deei lahibal suŋ maa. Anabi Aizaia bɔhiya, Ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ o ni wum shɛli ti sani maa yɛda.
en: But everyone hasnt obeyed the good news. As Isaiah says, Lord, who has had faith in our message? .

dag: Ka o daa nya ŋarima ayi ka di ʒe duli; kulipalinima n-daa chɛ li zali ka chaŋ ti paɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: He saw two boats pulled up on the beach; the fishermen had left them and were washing the nets.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus daa zaŋ li n-tila Mitrɛdat ŋun daa nyɛ laɣiguliba kpɛm ŋun daa niŋ di laasabu n-ti Juda gomna Shɛshibaza la.
en: King Cyrus of Persia told Mithredath, the man who keeps his money, to bring those things out. So Mithredath brought them out to Sheshbazzar, the leader of Judah.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligubaŋda kam ŋun bɔhim alizanda nam yɛla m-baŋ li viɛnyɛliŋga ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun bi kɔŋdi bin pala mini bin kura o nɛma ni.
en: So he replied, This means, then, that every teacher of the Law who becomes a disciple in the Kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who takes new and old things out of his storage room.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ma, Di niŋ lala! N nyɛla a min a mabihi bɛn nyɛ anabinima ni bɛn dol litaafi ŋɔ puuni yɛligu la dab kpee. Jɛmmi la Naawuni.
en: But the angel said to me, Dont worship me! I am a servant like you and your brothers the prophets. I am a servant like all those who obey the words in this book. You should worship God.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gbaai Yisa maa zaŋ o tahi Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la yiŋa; nimaani ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: The men who arrested Jesus led him to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The teachers of the law and the older Jewish leaders were gathered there.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buŋ maa tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu ka o ba.
en: The disciples led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back, and Jesus got on.

dag: Daba ayi nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka ti lan niŋ nyɛvili, ka o yiɣisi ti daba ata dali maa n-chɛ ka ti min o lan be.
en: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will raise us up, so that we may live before him.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni lahibal sun shɛli waazu n ni daa yihi la pala din yi daadam tɛha ni na.
en: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.

dag: Ka n yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ Filistianim ŋɔ ni kana ti liri ma Giligal, ka n na bi suhi Yawɛ sɔŋsim; lala zuɣu ka m muɣisi mmaŋa m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: I thought to myself, The Philistines will come here and attack me at Gilgal, and I havent asked the Lord to help us yet. So I forced myself to offer the burnt offering.

dag: ka daadamnim ni ti tarigi binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋdi dunia ni maa dabiɛm zuɣu, dama yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam.
en: They will be afraid and worried about what will happen to the world. Everything in the sky will be changed.

dag: Ka so daa yi yɛn tɛh o naɣikɔra kubiɛlim bee o lɛbiɛlim, bɛ deer o la anzinfa laɣibaligu giram ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka so mi daa yi yɛn tɛh o kpanbiɛlim bee n-kpɛhi naɣikɔra peeŋkpaa, bɛ deer o la anzinfa laɣibaligu giram anahi.
en: The Philistine blacksmiths charged / ounce of silver for sharpening plows and hoes and / ounce of silver for sharpening picks, axes, and the iron tip on ox goads.

dag: dama a tahi yɛl pal shɛŋa ti ni na ʒi n-wum di yɛla na. Dinzuɣu ti bɔri ni ti baŋ yɛla maa gbinni.
en: The things you are saying are new to us. We have never heard this teaching before, and we want to know what it means.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni mali tahima shɛli alizanda ni la zuɣu. Yi daa pun wum dimbɔŋɔ yɛla la yɛlimaŋli lahibal suŋ din daa ka yi sanna la ni.
en: When the true message, the Good News, first came to you, you heard about the hope it offers. So your faith and love are based on what you hope for, which is kept safe for you in heaven.

dag: Yilimiya o yuli jilima yila. Paɣimiy o jilima paɣibu!.
en: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbihi padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam ti o na.
en: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent his slaves to the tenants to receive his share of the harvest.

dag: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ yi mini tiŋ shɛŋa din wɔɣa ni taba, ka pa zuliya shɛb bɛn be kpe ŋɔ tinsi la nima.
en: That is what you must do to all the cities that are very far from you—the cities that are not in the land where you will live.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi, ka chɛ ka di tahi bɔɣi; liɣimi di tahibu maa, dama di kul sɔhirimi.
en: Youve made the ground quake, splitting it open. Now repair its cracks because its shaking apart!.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: Offer the proper grain offering of flour mixed with olive oil: pounds with each bull, pounds with the ram.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, N ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani ni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim alikauli shɛli maa shihirili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: And God said, I will give you something to prove that I made this promise to you. It will continue forever to show that I have made an agreement with you and every living thing on earth.

dag: ni Tapua naa ni Hɛfa naa.
en: the king of Tappuah one.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ sarika ni daba ata.
en: With that, he put them in prison for three days.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni zaa hal ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba; ka daa nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: The army of Israel killed everyone in that city and completely destroyed all the people. There was nothing left alive. Then they burned the city.

dag: Dama yɛm so salima nɛma, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa buɣisi yɛm.
en: Wisdom is better than pearls, and nothing you desire compares with her.

dag: Kɔhat daa malila bidibisi anahi, Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: O ba ŋun ni daa ŋariti niriba, ka fari o mabihi, ka tumdi din bi viɛla o niriba sani la zuɣu, o ni kpi o tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: As for his father: If he exploited the weak or committed robbery, or did anything else that wasnt good for the people, he will die because of his own guilt.

dag: N ni zaŋ li tila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ya la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa pun yɛli ya, Teemiya dɔni ka ti du n-tam yi zuɣu n-nɔri ya chani kaman tiŋgbani n-nyɛn ya la.
en: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.

dag: Ka Ɛsha ninvuɣ zuɣuri shɛb bɛn nyɛ Pool zɔnim gba daa tim ti balim Pool ni o di kpe salo maa laɣiŋgu maa shee.
en: Some of the provincial authorities, who were his friends, also sent him a message begging him not to show himself in the theater.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa mi n-kpalim zani zaawuni hal ni asiba, ka sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui asiba saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi bee di daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya wuntan yini bee yuŋ yini, di yi ti kul vuui, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.
en: Sometimes the cloud stayed only during the night—the next morning the cloud moved. So the people gathered their things and followed it. If the cloud moved, during the day or during the night, they followed it.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi di di zaa din dali maa, di bi simdi ka yi guui shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a nam maa ku lan chaŋ tooni, dama Yawɛ pun piig o suhu ni yu ninvuɣ so n-zaŋ o leeg o niriba naa, dama a bi doli Yawɛ ni zal a shɛm.
en: but now your rule wont last. The LORD will search for a man following the Lords own heart, and the LORD will commission him as leader over Gods people, because you didnt keep the LORDs command.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti miri tiŋkpan shɛli bɛ ni kuni maa, ka o ŋmani ŋun bɔri ni o garila tooni.
en: As they came near the village to which they were going, Jesus acted as if he were going farther;.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa lan yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na lan di ma shɛhira.
en: Then Samuel told the people: The witness is indeed the LORD, who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your ancestors up from the land of Egypt.

dag: Nyini Ijipti paɣipiɛliga, Cham Giliad ti bom tim. A ni niŋ tima pam maa zaa, yoli ka a niŋ li maa; a ku tibi kpaŋ.
en: Egypt, go to Gilead and get some medicine. You will make up many medicines, but they will not help. You will not be healed.

dag: Nyamiya n ni zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu n-sab bachibihi kar shɛŋa tin ya!.
en: Look at the large letters Im making with my own handwriting!.

dag: O ni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ kara m-mo Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, ka ni ti no n-taai wuntizɔriba. O ni ti kpaŋ omaŋa ni o taɣi bɛ daadiini zaligunim mini churi puhibu saha, ka ni ti su wuntizɔriba yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: He will speak against the Supreme God and oppress God's people. He will try to change their religious laws and festivals, and God's people will be under his power for three and a half years.

dag: A ti ti tibidarigibo balibu kam zaa din sab Musa zaligu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, ti na kul bi saɣi ni ti balim a bee ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ti daalahichi ka dol a yɛlimaŋli maa.
en: All this trouble came upon us, exactly as it was written in the Instruction of Moses, but we didnt try to reconcile with the LORD our God by turning from our wrongdoing or by finding wisdom in your faithfulness.

dag: Ka yi ni ti zaŋ o ʒim shɛli niŋ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila anahi la, ka niŋniŋ di tariga kɔnanim anahi la zuɣu, ka niŋniŋ di baŋa din kɔɣili li gil la. Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi, ka yi zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: You will take some of its blood and set it on the four horns of the altar and on the four sides of the ledge and on the curb all around. So you will purify it and purge it.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ m bia, wummi n noli n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ ni.
en: Now, son, Rebecca continued, listen to me and do what I say.

dag: dama nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda, ka n kul be a kpiŋkpama mahim ni n-yiini suhupiɛlli yila.
en: because you have always been my help. In the shadow of your wings I sing for joy.

dag: A tim a tuumba na ka bɛ ti nyu bara niŋ ma yɛli ni a zaŋ a chɛchɛbunsi din galisi nyaŋ Lɛbanɔn zoya zuɣu nima; a nyu bara yɛri ni a ŋma sida ti wɔɣila mini sipirɛs ti viɛla luhi, hal ka kpe di nyɔŋ puuni gba.
en: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Lakishinim niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme n-deei li dabisi shɛli din pah ayi dali, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Libinanim shɛm la.
en: The Lord allowed them to defeat the city of Lachish. They defeated it on the second day. The Israelites killed everyone in the city, just as they had done in Libnah.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: Ka ʒiri mi ka bɛ ni so nol ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka galimi hal baabiɛla.
en: They are not guilty of telling lies; they are without fault.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asiba ka Yisa labiri Jɛrusalɛm ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: Early the next morning, Jesus was going back to the city. He was very hungry.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Dauda ni man Yawɛ yɛliya ni bini diba ata ka n zal o, ni o piimi di ni zaɣ yini ka n niŋ li ti o.
en: Go and tell David, This is what the LORD says: Im offering you three punishments. Choose one of them, and that is what I will do to you.

dag: Ka bɛn daa be sansani maa ni mini bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni ni niriba maa zaa suhuri dii fuŋ, ka tɔbbihi zaŋ tabili ŋmɛnditoya zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira ka tiŋgbani daa dam, ka bɛ yɛma ŋma pam.
en: The whole Philistine army panicked—those in camp, those on guard duty, those in the fields, and those on raiding patrols. All of them were afraid and confused. Then God sent an earthquake, and the ground began to tremble.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka o ku lan tooi sɔɣ o yaha, ka o daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ kulikaɣa wuɣi piɛ shɛli n-zaŋ kootaali tanta li din ni chɛ ka kom ku tooi kpe di ni. Ka o daa zaŋ o bia maa niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti zali kaɣili ni mɔɣili duli.
en: But when she could no longer keep him hidden, she made a basket out of reeds and covered it with tar. She put him in the basket and placed it in the tall grass along the edge of the Nile River.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Yuma ala ka a yɛn niŋ nimaani, ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn labina? Di saha o paani daa ʒimi baɣ o. Ka di daa niŋ naa nyaɣisim ni o tim ma, ka n daa yɛl o n ni yɛn labina saha shɛli.
en: The emperor, with the empress sitting at his side, approved my request. He asked me how long I would be gone and when I would return, and I told him.

dag: Bɛ gbala n-nyɛ bɛ yinsi sahakam. Nimaani ka bɛ kul yɛn be ʒiɛmani kam ni hal bɛ ni daa kul deei tiŋgbani paliti n-leei bɛ din la zaa yoli.
en: Their graves are their homes forever; there they stay for all time, though they once had lands of their own.

dag: Pa pumpɔŋɔ ka yi boli ma, Ti ba, a nyɛla ŋun daa yuri ti ti bilim ni.
en: And now you say to me, You are my father, and you have loved me ever since I was a child.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma bari ma la tɔŋ, ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti ma biɛrim la mi yu ni m bahi yoli; bɛ na ʒi n-chɛ ma yikombiɛlim tuma tumbu dabisili kam puuni.
en: Those who want me dead lay traps; those who want me harmed utter threats, muttering lies all day long.

dag: M mabihi, n kul bela kum barina ni dabisili kam. N ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ ti ni mali biɛhigu shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛl lala maa.
en: I face death every day. That is true, brothers and sisters, just as it is true that I am proud of what you are because of Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa, ka bɛ daa kum pam.
en: When Moses told the Israelites what the Lord had said, they mourned bitterly.

dag: Pa kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ka ti daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa Masia yiko min o kandina yɛla, amaa ti nyɛla shɛhiranim bɛn nini daa nya o jilima.
en: We didnt repeat crafty myths when we told you about the powerful coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. Quite the contrary, we witnessed his majesty with our own eyes.

dag: Dama a nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bahira; amaa ka siɣisiri karimbaannima.
en: You help those who are humble, but you humiliate the proud.

dag: Amaa di liɣisibu maa yi kul kpalim be luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi gil o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, amaa ka sabigi, di nyɛla bimmɔriŋ din yi buɣim yum maa ni na, ka di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla buɣim wuliɛɣu.
en: But if the shiny spot remains where it was, has not spread over the skin, and is faded, it is just swelling from the burn. The priest will declare the person clean, because it is just the scar from the burn.

dag: Lan zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din kpalim la n-niŋ a min a dɔɣiriba ni nya ka di simdi shɛm, ka lee chɛ ka di nyɛla din doli yi Naawuni maa yubu.
en: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba. Bɛ ŋmanila bɔrɔbɔro du shɛli bɛ ni mali buɣim niŋ ka di bii, ka bɔrɔbɔromaana bi lan niŋ buɣim niŋ di ni bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔribu saha hal ti paai di dubu saha la.
en: Everyone burns with desire— they are like coals in an oven, ready to burst into flames.

dag: naɣila o talahi nira, kaman o ba bee o ma bee o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga bee o mabidoo.
en: unless it is his mother, father, son, daughter, brother.

dag: Ka n daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a kpalim be n sani dabisi gbaliŋ. Di bi simdi ka a lan go pagɔrisigu bee n-chɛ ka do so su a yaha. N gba ni be a sani lala.
en: I told her that for a long time she would have to wait for me without being a prostitute or committing adultery; and during this time I would wait for her.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka Manaasa daa zaŋ niriba maa m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ birigi n-tum tuumbiɛri hal gari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka Naawuni ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa ʒin nimaani la.
en: But the people did not listen to God. Manasseh did more evil things than all the nations that lived in Canaan before Israel came. And the Lord destroyed those nations when the Israelites came to take their land.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla Yisa Masia zuɣu m paɣiri Naawuni yi zaa zuɣu, dama yi yɛda niŋbu moli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because the whole world is hearing about your faith.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla kum, amaa nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla nyɛvili mini suhudoo.
en: If your thinking is controlled by your sinful self, there is spiritual death. But if your thinking is controlled by the Spirit, there is life and peace.

dag: dama yi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ pala din tiri Yisa nyaandoliba din simdi ba kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla din chɛ ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu pam di zuɣu.
en: The service you are offering helps Gods people with their needs, but that is not all it does. It is also bringing more and more thanks to God.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa naai saha shɛli ka o daa yɛli ba.
en: Then Moses went and spoke these words to all the Israelites.

dag: Areebia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Dɛdannim sochandiba bɛn dooni Areebia mɔɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam saɣi deeg o yɛligu maa ni dihi tabili ni Naawuni nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: Whoever accepts his testimony confirms that God is true.

dag: Yisifu ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Ijipti daa nyɛla bidibis ayi. Yaakubu yiŋnim zaa bɛn daa kuli Ijipti kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin.
en: Also, Joseph had two sons in Egypt. With these two grandsons, Jacobs family in Egypt numbered people in all.

dag: Nyini n-shiri nyɛ n tampiŋ mini m birini; a yuli zuɣu, be n tooni, ka wuhiri ma.
en: Yes, you are my Rock and my protection. For the good of your name, lead me and guide me.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim laɣim pahi Ibrahimma Naawuni la niriba zuɣu. Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa. Ŋuna n-simdi duhibu pam.
en: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!.

dag: Di saha ka Sɛrafinim maa ni yino ŋun daa gbib buɣim sal nɛɔŋ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ gbabo gbabi yihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu daaŋa ni n-yiɣi ka n sanna.
en: There was a fire on the altar. One of the Seraph angels used a pair of tongs to take a hot coal from the fire. Then the angel flew to me with it in his hand.

dag: Hal goli bi piɛli o sani gba; ka saŋmarisi mi pa bɛn ka daɣiri o sani.
en: In Gods eyes even the moon is not pure and bright; even the stars are not pure.

dag: O daa kul chanila buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini nti maani maligu ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.

dag: Ŋun daa pahi piniyini n-su chir piniyini ni n-daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya ŋun daa yi Piratɔn na ka nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the eleventh month, Benaiah from Pirathon in the territory of Ephraim;.

dag: Piligu ni ka Naawuni ni booni so Yɛligu la daa be. Yɛligu maa daa bela Naawuni sani. Yɛligu maa daa nyɛla Naawuni.
en: In the beginning, before the earth was made, the Word was there. The Word was with God, and the Word was God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, Dauda be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: Saul heard that David was there in the camps near Ramah.

dag: Paɣimiy o, o yiko tumtumsa zuɣu. Paɣimiy o, o ni galisi pam zuɣu.
en: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.

dag: Yiliyiiniba m-be tooni, ka biŋkumdiŋmɛriba doli nyaaŋa, ka paɣisara be bɛ sunsuuni n-chaɣisiri sayɛya.
en: The singers are in front, the musicians are behind, in between are the young women beating the tambourines.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu, dama bɛ zaŋ wuntizɔriba n-kɔhi deei anzinfa laɣibaligu, ka zaŋ nandaamba n-taɣi namda.
en: The Lord says, The people of Israel have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They sell into slavery honest people who cannot pay their debts, the poor who cannot repay even the price of a pair of sandals.

dag: Ka o daa kuli n-daa ti chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti moli Yisa ni daa tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla zaa gili; ka di daa niŋ sokam zaa alahiziba.
en: So the man left and went all through the Ten Towns, telling what Jesus had done for him. And all who heard it were amazed.

dag: Yi kul nahindi yimaŋa n-chani bɔri buɣa shee ni yi jɛm li, ka bi yɛri ni di ka buchi. Yi tɛhiya ni dina n-tiri ya kpiɔŋ, ka yi bi gbarigira.
en: You wear yourselves out looking for other gods, but you never give up. You think your obscene idols give you strength, and so you never grow weak.

dag: Zɔfa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sua mini Harinɛfa ni Shual ni Bɛri ni Imira.
en: Zophahs family: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah.

dag: O ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi li niŋ Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Ahazs deeds, from beginning to end, are written in the official records of Israels and Judahs kings.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya ayopɔin daa kpalim ka na bi deei bɛ tiŋgbana tarili.
en: Among the Israelites, seven tribes were left that had not yet received their legacy.

dag: Ka o daa sabi yɛtɔɣ yinsi shɛŋa o ni daa tuui sab la pa kuɣ parilana maa zuɣu. Yɛtɔɣa maa n-nyɛ fukumsi zalikpana pia shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛli ya buɣim sunsuuni yi laɣiŋgu dal la, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ li ti ma.
en: And the Lord wrote on the stones the same words he had written before—the Ten Commandments he spoke to you from the fire, when you were gathered together at the mountain. Then the Lord gave the two stone tablets to me.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya Izraɛl kpamba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zibisim ni bebɔ? Sokam bela o binnana duu. Dama bɛ yɛlimi, Yawɛ bi nya ti, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. .
en: God asked me, Mortal man, do you see what the Israelite leaders are doing in secret? They are all worshiping in a room full of images. Their excuse is: The Lord doesn't see us! He has abandoned the country.

dag: A nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ puuni ka a ŋme m-paag a dimnima. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili di ba zaa kaman mɔ kuma ka bɛ chɛ n-sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: What a great victory was yours, when you defeated everyone who opposed you. Your fiery anger wiped them out, as though they were straw.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim bɛn daa niŋ zina o sani ni kɔr biɛr la yi ti nya o buɣim dibu nyɔhi, bɛ ni kum ka fabili pam.
en: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.

dag: Nyama, m mini bi shɛb Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ nyɛla shihirili din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ sanna.
en: Look! I and the children the LORD gave me are signs and wonders in Israel from the LORD of heavenly forces, who lives on Mount Zion.

dag: Nyini n-zali dunia di tariga, nyini n-zali woligu saha mini kikaa saha.
en: You set the limits for everything on earth. And you created summer and winter.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli, Yɛlimiya noli ti Mɛrɔz, yɛlimiya no biɛɣu ti di niriba, bɛ ni bi kana ti sɔŋ Yawɛ n-tuhi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ sɔŋ o la zuɣu.
en: Curse Meroz, says the LORDs messenger, curse its inhabitants bitterly, because they didnt come to the LORDs aid, to the LORDs aid against the warriors.

dag: Bani daŋ — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinahinaayi.
en: the descendants of Bani:.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa be suɣa ni gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni kɔbiga. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛn yiɣisi doli chani pahi buta.
en: The total number of men in Ephraims camp is . They will be the third family to move when the people travel from one place to another.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ ŋun taɣi Gihɔn zuɣusaa polo kulibɔŋ la kom zali ka ŋmaligi li ka di zɔri chani Dauda tiŋ la wulinluhili polo. Hɛzɛkia daa di nasara o tuuni kam puuni.
en: It was Hezekiah who built a tunnel that carried the water from Gihon Spring into the city of Jerusalem. In fact, everything he did was successful!.

dag: Dama man bi yu ni yi so kpi. Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I dont want to kill you! Please come back and live! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Masia daa yihi ti dabitim ni, ka ti leei bilichinnima. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di lan niŋya nti leei daba yaha.
en: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.

dag: Yawɛ daalibarika chɛ ka nir leeri bundana, ka o bi zaŋdi suhugarigu pahiri di zuɣu.
en: It is the Lord 's blessing that makes you wealthy. Hard work can make you no richer.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ka n daa po pɔri yɛli Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu, N zaŋ li ti yi Zuliya. N chɛ ka a nini nya li, amaa a ku paai nimaani.
en: The Lord said, Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la. Ka o daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: An evil and unfaithful generation searches for a sign. But it wont receive any sign except Jonahs sign. Then he left them and went away.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: Then Jesus said to the Pharisees, The Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath day.

dag: Ka Ɛsha ninvuɣ zuɣuri shɛb bɛn nyɛ Pool zɔnim gba daa tim ti balim Pool ni o di kpe salo maa laɣiŋgu maa shee.
en: Even some officials of the province of Asia, who were Pauls friends, sent word to him, urging him not to risk going into the theater.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ bini pɔbi goli muni ninni, ka yɛrig o sagbani pa di zuɣu.
en: He hides the full moon behind a cloud.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi dii pali ma, ka n nya ka nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni ka so ʒi nimaani.
en: At once the Spirit took control of me. There in heaven was a throne with someone sitting on it.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ni ti nya ka vi gbahi ba ka bɛ yaa zaa naai, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi tabi bɛ noya, ka bɛ tiba ti kpiri.
en: Nations will see and be ashamed of all their strength; they will cover their mouths; their ears will be deaf.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Naawuni tooni nimaani n-duhi bɛ yee kum pam ka fabili yɛli.
en: The Israelites went to the city of Bethel. There they sat before God until evening. They cried loudly as they sat there.

dag: N ni ti gbaag a pahi zuliya shɛb ni n-zaŋ a chaŋ a ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka di muɣisi niriba pam.
en: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction with nations from lands you didnt know.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni daa taai duŋ niŋ ma Zin mɔɣu ni la, a daa zaɣisi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka niriba maa bi nya n kasitali kom la shee. .
en: because both of you rebelled against my command in the wilderness of Zin. When the whole community complained against me at Meribah, you refused to acknowledge my holy power before them.

dag: Shɛm mini Aripakishad ni Shɛla.
en: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa sabi tibidarigibo maa yɛla niŋ litaafi ni m-paɣ li niŋ kɔtɔɣu maa ni.
en: The priest will write these curses in the scroll and wipe them off into the water of bitterness.

dag: Di bemi kaman yi ni daa nyɛ nɔzaɣisiriba Naawuni sani, amaa ka yipa nya nambɔzɔbo pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim nɔzaɣisibo maa zuɣu la.
en: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.

dag: Yawɛ, daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa ti be bɛ ni bee ninsalinim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla?.
en: Lord , what are mortals, that you notice them; mere mortals, that you pay attention to us?.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka ku tum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa tuma.
en: But if you dont obey me and all my commands, bad things will happen to you.

dag: Binshɛŋa din ŋmani sakuɣa la na mi n-kɔŋ Lɛbanɔn tampima la lɔna ni? Ka zoya ni kulibɔŋ maha la kɔzɔrim na mi n-nyuui?.
en: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.

dag: Nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi nyɛla yɔhiŋ, ka viɛlim nyɛ din naara, amaa paɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu.
en: Grace and beauty can fool you, but a woman who respects the Lord should be praised.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔb maa tuhibu dali, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Naa Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zaa so daa ka takɔbi bee kpani; amaa Naa Sool min o bia Jɔnatan n-daa naɣi mali.
en: So on the day of the battle, no swords or spears were to be found in the possession of any of the troops with Saul and Jonathan, but Saul and his son Jonathan had them.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee dola palo ni Naawuni tooni, ka bahiyoli ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: But God can see clearly into that place of death. Death is not hidden from God.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a ti ŋma a zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yili tia ka noonsi di a nimdi.
en: Before the end of three days, the king will take you out of this prison and cut off your head! He will hang your body on a pole, and the birds will eat it.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli, Di simdi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa be ti mini Yisa sani Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa baptaiz o saha shɛl la hal ti paai o ni daa ti lab alizanda ni dahin shɛl la pahi ti zuɣu n-di ti Duuma Yisa kum ni neebu la shɛhira.
en: Therefore, we must select one of those who have accompanied us during the whole time the Lord Jesus lived among us.

dag: ka daa ti lan yi Bamɔt mi chaŋ vinvamli shɛli din daa do Mɔab tintariga Pisiga zolɔŋni zaŋ lab tiŋgban nɛli polo la.
en: Finally, they reached Moabite territory, where they camped near Mount Pisgah in a valley overlooking the desert north of the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Labimi Balak sani nti zaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm yɛl o.
en: The LORD granted Balaam an appearance and gave him a message. He said, Return to Balak and say this.

dag: N ni guli tiŋ ŋɔ ka tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu.
en: I will protect this city and save it. I will do this for myself and for my servant David.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa nambɔɣu, ka o shihi bɛ nina maa ka di dii neei, ka bɛ yiɣisi doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus felt sorry for the blind men. He touched their eyes, and immediately they were able to see. Then they became followers of Jesus.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi bɛn mini bɛ malibu daa kuli Ijipti yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When Jacob went to Egypt, his sons and their families went with him. Here are the names of those sons:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa tuui baptaiziri niriba la nti be nimaani.
en: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there.

dag: Bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yo Yawɛ o ni niŋ ma nirilim shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu?.
en: What must I give you, Lord , for being so good to me?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka Bɔaz yɛli Rut, Kamina ti deei bɔrɔbɔro suɣi kpam. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini kachɛriba maa sani, ka Bɔaz zaŋ chi bɔrɔbɔro ti o. Ka o daa ŋub li tiɣi ka guui shɛli.
en: At mealtime Boaz said to Ruth, Come, eat with us. Have some bread and dip it in the sauce. At once she sat down with the workers, and Boaz handed her some roasted grain. Ruth ate all she wanted and had some left over.

dag: M mi ni a ni chɛ ka n kpi n-kuli yili shɛli a ni zaŋ zali nyɛvililan kam la ni.
en: I know you will lead me to my death, to that place where all the living must go.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a daa yɔhim Jɛrusalɛmnim pam n-yɛli, Shɛli ti ku niŋ ya, amaa ka takɔbi ti be bɛ kukoya ni.
en: Then I said, LORD God, no! You have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem by promising them peace even though the sword is at their throats.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna nti yɛli ba, Suhimiya Yawɛ ka o yihi poloya maa ka chɛ m mini n niriba ŋɔ, ka n chɛ ka yi niriba maa chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, If you pray to the LORD to get rid of the frogs from me and my people, then Ill let the people go so that they can offer sacrifices to the LORD.

dag: N yuya ni n ʒe yim n soya ni, ka lala chɛ ka n tooi dol a zaligunima!.
en: How I wish I could be more faithful in obeying your laws!.

dag: Jɔab n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya la mi daa su Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim fukumsi.
en: Now Joab was in command of Israels army; Jehoiadas son Benaiah commanded the Cherethites and the Pelethites.

dag: Dinzuɣu, daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli Gɔg, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa n niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti be ni alaafee, amaŋmaŋ ni ti yiɣisi.
en: So the Sovereign Lord sent me to tell Gog what he was saying to him: Now while my people Israel live in security, you will set out.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ tulaale alali lita pirigili ka Yisa sanna ti booi li niŋ o naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhinyɛhi o naba maa, ka tulaale maa nyom deei yili maa zaa. Bɛ ni booni ti shɛli naad la ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali tulaale maa, ka di mali shaara pam.
en: Then Mary took an extraordinary amount, almost three-quarters of a pound, of very expensive perfume made of pure nard. She anointed Jesus feet with it, then wiped his feet dry with her hair. The house was filled with the aroma of the perfume.

dag: Ka n daa kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli din yuli booni Anfaani la ni n lɔrigi Yawɛ ni daa lo zuliya kam alikauli shɛl la.
en: Then I took the stick called Favor and broke it, to cancel the covenant which the Lord had made with all the nations.

dag: Ka n ni kpaŋ mmaŋ niŋ di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm, ka di chɛ ka yi ti tooi teeri dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla sahakam n kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: I will do my best, then, to provide a way for you to remember these matters at all times after my death.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn nyu shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo. Nyɛvili bi gari bindirigu ka niŋgbuŋ mi bi gari situra?.
en: So I tell you, dont worry about the things you need to live—what you will eat, drink, or wear. Life is more important than food, and the body is more important than what you put on it.

dag: Ti zaɣisi dinkam tahiri vi na mini yɔhiŋgu tuma; ka zaɣisi yɛmbimbiɛri tuma, ka mi bi zaŋdi yɔhiŋgu kpɛhiri Naawuni yɛligu ni. Amaa yɛlimaŋli wuhibu puuni ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi sokam bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ni ti dolila din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: Instead, we reject secrecy and shameful actions. We dont use deception, and we dont tamper with Gods word. Instead, we commend ourselves to everyones conscience in the sight of God by the public announcement of the truth.

dag: Yawɛ ʒin o nam ʒiishee kokpɛɣu zuɣu. Yawɛ n-ʒi o nam ʒiishee n-nyɛ naa ŋun kul beni sahakam.
en: The Lord rules over the deep waters; he rules as king forever.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi maa mabia la pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko.
en: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John the brother of James and went up on a high mountain. They were all alone there.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ʒiɛmdila bɛn nya yɛl biɛri, amaa ka di lee mali shili gu bɛn naba bi ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi n ni be fitiina shɛli ni, di biɛri m puuni, ka n suhu dam, n ni daa nyɛ ŋun zaɣis a noli zuɣu. Bɛ daa malila takɔbiri be soya zuɣu kuri niriba, ka kpibu be yiŋa.
en: Look, O Lord , at my agony, at the anguish of my soul! My heart is broken in sorrow for my sins. There is murder in the streets; even indoors there is death.

dag: O daa piila kuɣa pinaayi n-saɣisi Yaakubu so Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, A yuli n-nyɛ Izraɛl la bidibisi kalinli.
en: He took twelve stones, one for each of the twelve tribes named for the sons of Jacob, the man to whom the Lord had given the name Israel.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka yi tinzun tinsi balibu kam ni na la daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: There were some godly Jews in Jerusalem at this time. They were from every country in the world.

dag: Dama Yawɛ chɛ ka gom gbaai ya ni yi gbihi gbihiri biɛɣu. O pɔbi yi daanabinim nina, ka zaŋ bini pili yi nyariba zuɣuri.
en: The Lord has made you drowsy, ready to fall into a deep sleep. The prophets should be the eyes of the people, but God has blindfolded them.

dag: kaman yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti ba zuɣulaannima m-mali hal ti paai Anabi Samuɛl saha.
en: All this happened in about years. After this, God gave our people judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.

dag: Hal bɛ bihi na teeri bɛ maligu bimbina mini Ashɛra binwɔɣila shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi ti mahili kam mini daboli kam zuɣu.
en: Their children remember their altars and sacred poles by the lush trees and high hills.

dag: Di saha Sool daa pun zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la n-ti do so ŋun yuli booni Paliti ka o nyɛ Laishi Gallim nir bia la.
en: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, Davids wife, to Palti, Laishs son, from Gallim.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di ku ba. A ni ku a ni zaŋ a takɔb min a tɔbu n-gbahi shɛb leeg a daba? Bomi la bindirigu ti ba ka bɛ di ka nyu kom, ka lab bɛ naa sani.
en: He said, No, dont kill them. Did you capture them with your own sword or bow? Do you have the right to kill them? Put food and water in front of them so they can eat and drink and return to their master.

dag: N yi ti kuhi bol a dahin shɛli, n dimnim maa ni ŋmaligi zo. Dama m mi ni nyin Naawuni be m polo.
en: Then my enemies will retreat when I cry out. I know this because God is mine.

dag: Ɛlam beni, ka di tɔbbihi zaa gili di gballi. Takɔbi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi guni ka kpe tiŋgban ni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ di vi chaŋ ti pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee zuɣu.
en: Elam is there, her entire horde round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the world below, who caused terror in the land of the living. They bore their shame like those who go down to the pit.

dag: Yuŋ nyoorila n kɔb tuɣa ni; ka biɛrim shɛli din dimdi ma bi naara.
en: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment.

dag: ka lan bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla m bia Iso? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: Isaac asked, Are you really my son Esau? Yes, I am, Jacob answered.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, ka mali baŋsim shɛli din yiri Zallakudura Naa sanna. O nyɛla ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii. O luya, amaa ka bi pɔb o nina.
en: Who can hear what God is saying And receive the knowledge that comes from the Most High. With staring eyes I see in a trance A vision from Almighty God.

dag: Ka o daa tim Izraɛl nachimba ka bɛ chaŋ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa kɔri naɣilahi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ.
en: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala dab paɣ maa bihi, amaa ti nyɛla bilichin paɣ la bihi.
en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we arent the slave womans children, but we are the free womans children.

dag: O teeya ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima, ka ŋmani pɔhim din ʒe n-gari ka ku lan tooi labina.
en: God kept remembering that they were just flesh, just breath that passes and doesnt come back.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli salo min o nyaandoliba.
en: Then Jesus spoke to the people and to his followers. He said.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Ziba, Nyama, Mɛfibɔshɛt ni daa su shɛlikam zaa leeg a dini pumpɔŋɔ. Ka Ziba garigi yɛli, N nyɛla ŋun luri n dan sizuura. Chɛ ka nyini n dan naa nini kul tiɣiri ma sahakam.
en: Look here, the king said to Ziba. Everything that belonged to Mephibosheth now belongs to you. Ziba said, I bow out of respect! Please think well of me, my master and king.

dag: ni Aijalɔn ni Gatirimɔn ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Aijalon, and Gath Rimmon. In all, Dan gave them four towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: Niriba zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa yi Babilɔn doli ma n-lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu ʒiɛman ni la yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the names of the family leaders and the other people who came with me to Jerusalem from Babylon. We came to Jerusalem during the rule of King Artaxerxes. Here is the list of names:.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Matiu maa yiŋa n-daa ti ʒini ni o di bindirigu, ka farigudeeriba pam mini alahichinim kana nti ʒini pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: As Jesus sat down to eat in Matthews house, many tax collectors and sinners joined Jesus and his disciples at the table.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ni niŋ lala, dindina yin lomiya kpara Yawɛ nini ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses answered, If you really mean what you say, then here in the presence of the Lord get ready to go into battle.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa boli bindirigu maa Manna, di daa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din nyɛ zaɣ piɛla, ka nyaɣisi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ shiri mali karikaasi shɛŋa.
en: The Israelites called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and delicious as wafers made with honey.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, n kamina ni n ti ti a yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: He explained as he spoke with me: Daniel, heres why Ive come: to give you insight and understanding.

dag: Lala zuɣu cheechi nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ cheechi zuɣu maa niŋgbuŋ; ka ŋun Masia nyɛ binshɛɣukam ni pali so ni, ka o mi nyɛ ŋun pali binshɛɣukam ni mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: The church is Christs body. It is filled with him. He makes everything complete in every way.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya kɔŋko ka a ku kali, a mi di sab bɛ yuya pahi Izraɛlnim ni.
en: Dont count the men from the tribe of Levi or include them with the other Israelites.

dag: Chɛliya ka ŋunkam zaa be Ziɔn duh o yee yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka be kasi ŋɔ be o niriba sunsuuni.
en: People of Zion, shout about these things! The Holy One of Israel is with you in a powerful way. So sing and be happy!.

dag: O zaŋ kuɣikpɛra me ŋ-ŋari n soli. O chɛ ka n soya niŋla so gɔna.
en: He walled in my paths with stonework; he made my routes crooked.

dag: ka zaŋ di mini di nɛma zaa pɔbi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni, ka zaŋ li tam amaŋka dapuhi zuɣu.
en: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Naawuni daa be Masia ni n-zaŋdi dunianim naari ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa, ka bi lan niŋdi bɛ daalahichi laasabu, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni yɛla niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: In other words, God was reconciling the world to himself through Christ, by not counting peoples sins against them. He has trusted us with this message of reconciliation.

dag: Ŋunkam goli biŋkɔbigu kam, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who has sexual relations with any kind of animal! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, n ni zaŋ ba Bashan n-labisi kpe na. N ni yihi ba teeku bulli ni na.
en: The Lord has said, I will bring your enemies back from Bashan; I will bring them back from the depths of the ocean.

dag: O yuri wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ yurilim maŋli kul palila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He loves righteousness and justice; the LORDs faithful love fills the whole earth.

dag: A nyɛla do viɛlli dɔbba puuni; a zilinkom viɛla. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni sahakam.
en: You are more handsome than anyone, and you say such pleasant things. So God will always bless you.

dag: Amaa n ni niŋ a yurilim din galisi ŋɔ naani. M mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: But I trust in your faithful love, Lord. I will be happy when you save me.

dag: Bɛ daa kpaŋsi n suhu kaman bɛ ni daa kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri shɛm; ka bɛn niŋdi lala maa simdi paɣibu.
en: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.

dag: M bia, wumma, niŋmi yɛm, ka niŋ tɛha niŋ a suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a biɛhigu polo.
en: Listen, my child, be wise and give serious thought to the way you live.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi be o tooni, dabiɛm m-mali ma, ka n yi tɛhi o yɛla, dabiɛm m-mali ma.
en: I tremble with fear before him.

dag: Yɛm ŋɔ tatabo bi yirila alizanda ni na, amaa di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ mini daadamtali biɛhigu ni Sintani dini.
en: This is not the wisdom that comes down from above. Instead, it is from the earth, natural and demonic.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya nia nyɛla nia biɛri, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila buɣim nyoori niriba.
en: Troublemakers create disasters. Their advice destroys like a wildfire.

dag: Di ni ti ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee yina; ŋun yɛn ku zuliya pam yi palo. O yi o biɛhigu shee na ni o bahi yi tiŋgbani yoli. Yi fɔntinsi ni wurim, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: A lion has come out of his cave. A destroyer of nations has begun to march. He has left his home to destroy your land. Your towns will be destroyed. There will be no one left to live in them.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaa lee tumdila din ni tiɣi ti kpee nini o zaɣ viɛlli nyabu min o kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa n-yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛrishiiba nti mali sara o ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: So Israel began his trip to Egypt. First he went to Beersheba. There he worshiped God, the God of his father Isaac. He offered sacrifices.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti zani Niriba Dunɔdal la ni, Juda nanim ni doli shɛli yira, ka lan dol li kpɛri la, ka lan chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya zaa ni.
en: The LORD proclaimed to me: Go and stand by the Peoples Gate where Judahs kings go in and out, and then by all the gates of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka niriba pam yi tiŋkpansi n-daŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti doli bɛ kali soli m-mali bɛmaŋa ka Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa dali na bi paai.
en: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches the body of the one with the emission must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililan nyɛla ŋun tahiri zabili na, ka suhuyiɣisili pam tahiri biriginsim pam na.
en: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋmaligi po omaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N je Yaakubu karimbaani la. N je bɛ ni me bɛ yiya suma shɛŋa la. N ni zaŋ bɛ tin tital la niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The Lord GOD used his own name and made an oath. The Lord God All-Powerful said, I hate what Jacob is proud of. I hate his strong towers. So I will let an enemy take the city and everything in it.

dag: Ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba, ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri ye n-chaŋ Amɔz bia anab Aizaia sani.
en: Hezekiah sent Eliakim, the palace manager, Shebna, the royal secretary, and the elders of the priests to the prophet, Isaiah son of Amoz. They wore the special clothes that showed they were sad and upset.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Huramabi ŋun nyɛ tuumbaŋda, ka mali yɛm pam la ka a sanna.
en: I will send you a skilled craftsman named Huram Abi.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be ʒilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
