en: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb kaman piɛri la zal o nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb mi kaman buhi la zal o nuzaa polo.
en: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka bi lan niŋ o tiliginsim yiko naani la zuɣu.
en: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.

dag: N ni mihi n ninni niŋ ba, bɛ ni daa kul tiligi buɣim dili ni maa, buɣim na kul ni bahi di ba. Ka n yi ti mihi n ninni niŋ ba, a ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will punish the people of Jerusalem with fire. Some of them have escaped one destruction, but soon they will be completely burned. And when that happens, you, Ezekiel, will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Wuntia puuni ka a daa zal a zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali zaa.
en: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.

dag: O tiri kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb kom, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb bindir suma.
en: He satisfies those who are thirsty. He fills those who are hungry with good things.

dag: Ka hal yɛlli maa yi lula Gomna tibili ni gba, ti ni bo shɛli ti o ka o ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: And if the governor hears about this, we will take care of it with him so you will have nothing to worry about.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.

dag: A ni tooi vihi baŋ ni di bi gari biɛɣ pinaayi zuŋɔ ka n daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti jɛm Naawuni.
en: It was no more than twelve days ago that I went to worship in Jerusalem. You can find this out easily enough.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ gili yɛli niriba maa ni bɛ bom bindira m-mali shili gu, dama ni di kpalim daba ata ni bɛ gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: go through the camp and say to the people, Get some food ready, because in three days you are going to cross the Jordan River to occupy the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: dama bɛ daa pun deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, amaa ka na lee bi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka nyini Izraɛl na biɛɣu ŋun dabisa pali ŋɔ, a tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha paaya.
en: You wicked, unholy ruler of Israel, your day, the day of your final punishment, is coming.

dag: Giliad nyɛla n dini, ka Manaasa nyɛ n dini; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurugu zuɣupiligu; ka Juda nyɛ n nam jaaŋgbee.
en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh too; Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my royal scepter.

dag: Yi min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka o zaŋdi yi gba m-pahiri bɛn zaa kpalim zuɣu m-mɛri du shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni ni ni be shɛl ni o Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: In union with him you too are being built together with all the others into a place where God lives through his Spirit.

dag: Niriba pam n-nyɛ naa jilima, amaa niriba yi kani, naa pala shɛli.
en: Kings of large nations have great honor. Rulers without a country have nothing.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a sɔɣi ka zilinli fiɛbiga ku paag a, ka saɣiŋgu yi ti paag a, a ku zɔri li.
en: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.

dag: M mali kpamdi zilinkom din viɛla mini yɛm maŋli. M mali tɛhi zilima, ka lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: I have good advice and common sense to offer. I have understanding and power.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa tim ti boli Jɛrimia ka o kana Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoli din pahir ata la gbini. Ka naa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N yɛn bɔh a la yɛtɔɣ shɛli, a mi di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: King Zedekiah had me brought to his private entrance to the temple, and he said, I'm going to ask you something, and I want to know the truth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti zali Naa Dauda ni daa ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni, ka daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara ti Naawuni.
en: The Levites brought Gods Holy Box and put it inside the tent David had set up for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to God.

dag: M bɔri ni yi baŋ ni bɛ yihi ti mabia Timoti sarika ni; o yi paana tu n kandina saha, n ni zaŋ o pahi mmaŋ zuɣu na ti nyan ya.
en: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been let out of prison. If he comes soon enough, I will have him with me when I see you.

dag: Yuma maa yi galisi, nyin pahimi liɣiri, ka yuma maa yi bi galisi, nyin filimmi liɣiri maa, dama a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam shɛm ka o kɔhiri tir a maa.
en: If there are many years before the next Jubilee, the price will be high. If the years are few, the price will be lower. So your neighbor is really only selling a number of crops to you. At the next Jubilee, the land will again belong to that family.

dag: Masia Naawunitali yiko chɛ ka ti nya binshɛɣukam zaa din simdi ni ti zaŋ mali nyɛvili mini biɛhigu din luri Naawuni sizuura, ŋuna ŋun bol ti o jilima min o zaɣisuntali baŋbu puuni la zuɣu.
en: By his divine power the Lord has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of the one who called us by his own honor and glory.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ li yɛli yi bihi mini yi yaansi n ni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa tum jɛrilim shɛm, ka n tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I also did this so that you could tell your children and your grandchildren about the miracles and other wonderful things that I have done in Egypt. Then all of you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said:.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa paai bɛ kpalansi yomyom sɔŋ tiŋa, ka lɔrigilɔrigi di noya.
en: Everyone quickly lowered their sacks down to the ground and each opened his sack.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn biri yuun shɛli din pahir anii ni, yi ni ti dirila bindir kura, ka yi ti kul ni dirila bindir kura maa hal ni yuun shɛli din pahir awɛi, ka bindir pala ti naanyi niŋ.
en: You can plant again in the eighth year and eat food from the previous years produce until the ninth year. Until its produce comes, you will eat the food from the previous year.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ, ka di nyom viɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni ku o bee o kum dali yi paai, o ni kpi bee ŋun chaŋ tɔb ni ka bɛ ti ku o.
en: As surely as the LORD lives, David continued, it will be the LORD who will strike him down, or his day will come and he will die, or hell fall in battle and be destroyed.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm buɣisi ya m-bɔŋɔ: m po Firawuna ni yi ku kuli ka pa ni yi tizo ŋun nyɛ yi zaa biasani maa gba kala kpe na.
en: But here is how to prove yourselves: As Pharaoh lives, you wont leave here until your youngest brother arrives.

dag: Ka bɛ daa neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti! Ka o neei n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: The disciples went to Jesus and woke him up, saying, Master, Master! We are about to die! Jesus got up and gave an order to the wind and to the stormy water; they quieted down, and there was a great calm.

dag: Ka goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, yin chɛ ka bɛ piɛb kikahi pampam. Ka dabisi shɛli din nyɛ samli yɔbu dali maa, yin chɛliya ka bɛ piɛbi kikahi gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Then, on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement, send someone to blow a trumpet throughout the whole land.

dag: Chɛ ka di biɛŋmarisi leei zibisim, ka chɛ ka di niŋ neesim tahima, amaa ka bi nya li. Di chɛ ka asiba neesim lan neei di ni.
en: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri bɔri ma? Yi bi mi ni di nyɛ ma la talahi ni m be m Ba duu.
en: Jesus replied, Why were you looking for me? Didnt you know that it was necessary for me to be in my Fathers house.

dag: Yɛndaan yino chaŋ ti liri tɔbutuhiriba tiŋa n-wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli ka bɛ niŋ li naani la.
en: A wise person fought a city of warriors and brought down the stronghold in which they felt safe.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Anabi Musa litaafinima, chinchini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha;.
en: Even today, whenever they read the Law of Moses, the veil still covers their minds.

dag: o chanimi nti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani; ka dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam n-gari di ni daa pun be shɛm; lala nti yɛn niŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ nim gba.
en: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself. They go in and make their home there. That person is worse off at the end than at the beginning. This is the way it will be also for this evil generation.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ. O chɛ ka n naba bemi kaman woliga naba la, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana. Di nyɛla kaman baansi toondana ni zaŋ biŋkumda din mali mihi n-yil li shɛm.
en: The Lord GOD gives me my strength. He helps me run fast like a deer. He leads me safely on the mountains. To the music director. On my stringed instruments.

dag: Dama o daŋ maa pala din ni tibi kpaŋ. Di looi Judanima. Di paai n niriba dunɔdal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The nation is fatally wounded. Judah is doomed. Jerusalem will fall.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ. O chɛ ka n naba bemi kaman woliga naba la, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana. Di nyɛla kaman baansi toondana ni zaŋ biŋkumda din mali mihi n-yil li shɛm.
en: The LORD God is my strength. He will set my feet like the deer. He will let me walk upon the heights. To the director, with stringed instruments.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai, ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o n-zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: When they finished mocking him, they stripped him of the military coat and put his own clothes back on him. They led him away to crucify him.

dag: bee n-di m bindirigu n kɔŋko, ka kpibiga bi di li.
en: or let orphans go hungry while I ate.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianim bɛn guni gunibu shɛli bɛ ni niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ni la ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni. Teemiya yi bebu ni daa nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called uncircumcised by those who take pride in being circumcised.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, man Naawuni maa ni kul yɛli ni n yɛli shɛli, dina ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say, Micaiah replied.

dag: N ni yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi suhuri saɣim.
en: But you are filled with sadness because I have told you all this.

dag: ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ka naabu? Bee bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya ka yi na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Are you going to keep on talking forever? Do you always have to have the last word?.

dag: Amaa o yi mali daŋa, ka di nyɛ dan titali, kaman o yi nyɛ napombara bee o yi nyɛ zoma, yin di zaŋy o mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔhi zom maa yaha, O ni neeg a nina maa, a lee tɛhiya ni o nyɛla ŋuni? Ka o yɛli ba, O nyɛla anabi.
en: They asked the man again, Since it was your eyes he healed, what do you say about him? He answered, He is a prophet.

dag: ka di pala binnamda maa kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili tinim bɛn daŋ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋɔ gba kul ŋuhirimi ti suhuri ni n-guhiri saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti zal o bihi zaani, ka fa ti niŋgbuna zaa bahi la.
en: Not only the world, but we also have been waiting with pain inside us. We have the Spirit as the first part of Gods promise. So we are waiting for God to finish making us his own children. I mean we are waiting for our bodies to be made free.

dag: Ka Ram daa nyɛ Aminadab ba, ka Aminadab nyɛ Nashɔn ba, ka Nashɔn mi nyɛ Salimɔn ba.
en: Aram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Salmon.

dag: A biɛhigu ni ti ne kaman wuntaŋ ni la, ka di zibisim ti ne kaman asiba neesim la.
en: Your life will be brighter than sunshine at noon, and life's darkest hours will shine like the dawn.

dag: Amaa yi ni naɣ niŋdi zaɣ viɛl shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Yi je Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba tuma kaman man gba ni je li shɛm.
en: But you have this in your favor: you hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, which I also hate.

dag: Mani n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka nam ninsalinim niŋ di ni. N nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa, ka su binshɛɣukam din be nimaani fukumsi.
en: I am the one who made the earth and created human beings to live there. By my power I stretched out the heavens; I control the sun, the moon, and the stars.

dag: dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣ mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: Nothing is hidden that wont be revealed, and nothing is secret that wont be brought out into the open.

dag: n-kpe bɛ tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li; dama yi Duuma NAAWUNI ni zaŋ li niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: you come out of hiding. The Lord our God will help you capture the town.

dag: Yurilim maa nyɛla ni ti doli Naawuni zaligunima. Ka o zaligu maa dolibu nyɛla ni ti yum taba kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm piligu ni la.
en: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.

dag: Ka pako so ŋun nyɛ pako maŋli nyɛla ŋun kpalim o ko, ka zaŋ o tahima niŋla Naawuni ni, ka kul mali wunsuhigu suhiri Naawuni o ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: A widow who is all alone, with no one to take care of her, has placed her hope in God and continues to pray and ask him for his help night and day.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni yili a yurilim maŋli la yila sahakam, n ni moli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla molo ʒiɛmani kam zaa niriba sani.
en: Our Lord , I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.

dag: Ka Ananias daa chaŋ ti kpe yili maa ni n-zaŋ o nuhi pa Sool zuɣu ka yɛli, M mabia Sool, ti Duuma Yisa ŋun daa yi a zuɣu sol ni a ni daa kanna la n-tim ma a sanna ni a nina ti neei, ka Naawuni chɛ ka o Shia Kasi pal a.
en: Ananias went to the house. He placed his hands on Saul and said, Brother Saul, the Lord sent me—Jesus, who appeared to you on the way as you were coming here. He sent me so that you could see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa kul zoomiyala ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia daanfaani min o baŋbu puuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Instead, grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and savior Jesus Christ. To him belongs glory now and forever. Amen.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni tooi niŋ suhukpeeni yɛli: N Duuma nyɛla n sɔŋda; n ku zo dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma.
en: So we can feel sure and say, The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. People can do nothing to me. Psalm :.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni yino daa kana nti wum ka Yisa garigi bɛn daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni maa bɔhigu viɛnyɛliŋga ka bɔh o, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: One of the teachers of the Law of Moses came up while Jesus and the Sadducees were arguing. When he heard Jesus give a good answer, he asked him, What is the most important commandment.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbal shɛŋa niriba ni nɔri gariti ka bi mi ni gbala m-bala.
en: How terrible for you! You are like unmarked graves which people walk on without knowing it.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb ni nyɛla ninkuunsinima mini halikpɛmanima ni munaafichinima ni bɛn bi gbaari bɛmaŋa ni ninvuɣ yarisi ni bɛn je zaɣ suŋ.
en: they will be unkind, merciless, slanderers, violent, and fierce; they will hate the good;.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-saɣim yimaŋa, dama n ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb ka chɛri palo tiri ya ŋɔ zaŋla dimbɔŋɔnim saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these acts, for that is how the pagans made themselves unclean, those pagans who lived in the land before you and whom the Lord is driving out so that you can go in.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣira ata maa daa chaŋ ti tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm samban ni dunɔdali shee kɔbiliga maa ni ti tooi kom maa na ti ti Dauda ni o nyu. Amaa ka o daa bi nyu li, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: The three famous soldiers forced their way through the Philistine camp, drew some water from the well, and brought it back to David. But he would not drink it; instead he poured it out as an offering to the Lord.

dag: M-pahi bɛ ni daa nya ka do so ŋun kpaŋ maa ʒe bɛ sani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: However, since the healed man was standing with Peter and John before their own eyes, they had no rebuttal.

dag: Dinzuɣu, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn yɔhila yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ n-zaŋ ya labisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So speak to them for me. Tell them this is what the Lord GOD says: My people, I will open your graves and bring you up out of them! Then I will bring you to the land of Israel.

dag: Di ni ti lu n-doya ka noonsi ti tamdi di mundili maa zuɣu, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ti be di wulikpana maa ni.
en: The birds will come and perch on the fallen tree, and the wild animals will walk over its branches.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya ni yi yi kul bɔri binshɛɣukam ka suhi Naawuni, yin niŋmiya yɛda ni yi ni nya li, ka yi shiri ni nya li.
en: Therefore I say to you, whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you will receive it, and it will be so for you.

dag: N Naawuni, n kuhi bol a wuntaŋ ni, amaa ka a bi garigi ma; ka n kuhi bol a yuŋ, ka bi nya gom gbihi.
en: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.

dag: Di yuuni maa ni gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali, ka bindirigu daa lan ka tiŋ maa ni, ka kum lu niriba maa zuɣu.
en: On the ninth day of the month, the famine in the city got so bad that no food remained for the common people.

dag: ka zaŋ namda kura din chahi ka bɛ shɛnshe li piri; ka zaŋ binyɛr chɛra ye, ka bɛ bindira zaa kul kuui mili ka kpe yue.
en: They put on ragged clothes and worn-out sandals that had been mended. The bread they took with them was dry and moldy.

dag: Yaakubu daa kul bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni din nyɛ o ba ni daa be luɣ shɛl la.
en: Jacob lived in the land of Canaan, where his father Isaac had lived.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka ŋunkam mi chibi gooni voli, wahu ni dim o.
en: Whoever digs a pit may fall into it, and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

dag: N zɔsimnim zaa zaŋ ma mi bahi, ka n ni daa yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la zaŋ ma bahi.
en: My closest friends look at me with disgust; those I loved most have turned against me.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋdi buhi mini naɣilahi ʒim ni naɣisa so bɛ ni daa zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la tampiligim mihiri niriba niŋgbuna ni di chɛ ka bɛ mali be kasi, ka yi bɛ daadiini kaya dolibu taali ni.
en: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a cow were sprinkled on those who were no longer pure enough to enter the place of worship. The blood and ashes made them pure again—but only their bodies.

dag: Kɛlub bia Ɛzri n-daa su kpariba fukumsi.
en: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko pam nam zuɣusaa mini dunia. Binshɛli kani din kpɛm nyaŋ a.
en: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, gunibu mali buchi la a yi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm; amaa a yi bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, dindina a bemi kaman ŋun bi guni.
en: Circumcision is an advantage if you do what the Law says. But if you are a person who breaks the Law, your status of being circumcised has changed into not being circumcised.

dag: Bɛ ni ti suui bɛ wain wal kaha bahi kaman wain tia la; ka suui bɛ puma bahi kaman olivi tia la.
en: They will be like vines that lose their unripe grapes; like olive trees that drop their blossoms.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Taitus suhu ye yi sɔŋbu zuɣu kaman ti gba la.
en: I thank God because he gave Titus the same love for you that I have.

dag: Bɛ laɣimmi naai noli, ka lo nia biɛɣu jɛnd a.
en: They plot with a single-minded heart; they make a covenant against you.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa nyaaŋa, ka Sintani kpe ŋun Judas suhu ni. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋmi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛli maa yomyom.
en: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus said to him, Hurry and do what you must.

dag: Yi nya nir ni yiri taali ni Naawuni sani o tuma tumbu zuɣu shɛm, ka pa ni o yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yi nti bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn suhi Naa? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yɛlim o ni a bɔrila Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu.
en: The girl left and asked her mother, What do you think I should ask for? Her mother answered, The head of John the Baptist.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pa liɣiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ dan ya leei daba maa. Dinzuɣu pa liɣiri ka n yɛn zaŋ yo yi zuɣu n-yihi ya dabitim maa ni.
en: The Sovereign Lord says to his people, When you became slaves, no money was paid for you; in the same way nothing will be paid to set you free.

dag: M mabihi n yɛri ya mi, Ʒim ni be niŋgbun shɛl ni ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni, ka din poori mi ku tooi be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: What I mean, friends, is that what is made of flesh and blood cannot share in God's Kingdom, and what is mortal cannot possess immortality.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n daa dihirila Yɛhudianim mini zuɣulaannim ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi tinzun tinsi din gili ti ni n-ka ti sanna.
en: One hundred fifty Jews and officials, along with those who came to us from the surrounding nations, gathered around my table.

dag: N kuhiri boonila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ma binshɛlikam din simdi ma.
en: I pray to you, my protector.

dag: So miri ka o ti ta Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa na ti mali sara ti Yawɛ la daɣiri.
en: The Israelites will bring offerings to the Lord . These offerings become holy, so the priests must not let them be used in a wrong way.

dag: luɣ shɛli zunzuya ni bi kpira, ka buɣim mi bi kpiri ni.
en: Thats a place where worms dont die and the fire never goes out .

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o o ni pa ti ni yino maa zuɣu.
en: John spoke up, Master, we saw a man driving out demons in your name, and we told him to stop, because he doesn't belong to our group.

dag: O zaŋla dunia ŋɔ niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; o pɔbila di sariakaritiba nina; di yi pala ŋuna, ka ŋuni?.
en: The earth is handed over to the wicked; he covers the faces of its judges. If not God, then who does?.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋun taali tumbu zuɣu n-lee chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ ti paai ti ŋɔ? Yɛlim ti! Tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda? Tiŋkani ka a lee yina? Ka zuliya bɔ n-lee nyɛ a.
en: So they said to him, Now, then, tell us! Who is to blame for this? What are you doing here? What country do you come from? What is your nationality.

dag: Chɛ ka dilan maa biɛhigu ti be kaman Yawɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa ka bi zo li nambɔɣu la. Chɛ ka o kul wumdi kuhigu asiba, ka wumdi tɔbuchiriga wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha.
en: May the bearer of that news be like the cities that the LORD destroyed without mercy. May he hear screams in the morning, and the battle cries at noon.

dag: Nyini, yilimi fabila yilli ŋɔ niŋ Izraɛl nanima.
en: You, raise a lament for Israels princes.

dag: N daa mali nyɛvili saha shɛli n ni daa na ʒi zaligu yɛla la, amaa n ni daa ti baŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa, ka alahichi neei ka man lee kpi.
en: Before I knew the law, I was alive. But when I heard the laws command, sin began to live.

dag: Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Amaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira pam paai ma, ka m mini kum bi lan wɔɣ ni taba.
en: I am deeply troubled and close to death;.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka bɛ ti zaŋ Sool n-leei naa Yawɛ tooni Giligal ka mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni nimaani. Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: So everyone went to Gilgal, and there at Gilgal they made Saul king in the LORDs presence. They offered well-being sacrifices in the LORDs presence, and Saul and all the Israelites held a great celebration there.

dag: Bɛ pala tuum maŋa; bɛ nyɛla tumtumdiba bɛn yɔhindi niriba, ka lɛbigi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ be kaman Masia tuumba n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Those men are not true apostles—they are false apostles, who lie about their work and disguise themselves to look like real apostles of Christ.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul zɔrimi hal so yi bi kariti doli ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la.
en: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: Then Moses put the curtain at the entrance to the Holy Tent.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛŋa o ba ni daa bi niŋ, ka diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu la, ka zaŋdi o kpee paɣa doona.
en: He does things his father never did. He goes to the mountains and eats foods offered to false gods. He commits the sin of adultery with his neighbors wife.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa wum di yɛla, ka boli tiŋgbani maa yuli Akɛlidama.
en: All the people living in Jerusalem heard about it, and so in their own language they call that field Akeldama, which means Field of Blood.

dag: Ka o daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; o daa bela pɔhim kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-kana yomyom.
en: He flew across the sky, riding on a Cherub angel racing on the wings of the wind.

dag: O daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma mini nayili nɛma zaa, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma salima la shɛŋa zaa Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm.
en: Nebuchadnezzar took from Jerusalem all the treasures in the Lord s Temple and all the treasures in the kings palace. He cut up all the golden dishes that King Solomon of Israel had put in the Lord s Temple. This happened just as the Lord had said.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ gbuɣinli ŋun nyɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ka bi zɔri so dabiɛm ŋɔ.
en: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani ŋɔ kalinli nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu, ka a yɛli, N ni ti ba nimdi ka bɛ ŋubi gol muni zaa?.
en: Moses said to the Lord , Here I am leading , people, and you say that you will give them enough meat for a month?.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Ilaija so ŋun yɛn kana la.
en: And if you believe what they said, then John is Elijah. He is the one they said would come.

dag: N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi lee m bia. N ti ku yihi n yurilim maŋli o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n yurilim ŋun daa daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. Saul was the king before you, and I took away my support from Saul. But I will never stop loving your son.

dag: Nyin daadam, a ni kari saria, a ni kari tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa.
en: Son of man, will you judge the city of murderers? Will you tell her about all the terrible things she has done?.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti je suli niŋ o, ka zo n-kul o ba yiŋ Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti niŋ chira anahi nimaani.
en: but she was unfaithful and went back to live with her family in Bethlehem. Four months later.

dag: ka lan nyɛ ŋun be nyɛvili ni; nyama, n daa pun kpimi ka neei, ka mi ku lan kpi hal abada. Mani n-su kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee saafɛbihi fukumsi.
en: I am the one who lives. I was dead, but look, I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa bi zali saria karibu saha? Ka bɔzuɣu ka bɛn mi o na ʒi n-nya o ni zali saha dabisa shɛŋa ni?.
en: Why doesnt the Almighty establish times for punishment? Why cant those who know him see his days?.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya shɛb bɔhira, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be.
en: Why should the nations wonder where our God is?.

dag: Nimaani ka Masia be ka su binshɛɣukam zaa zaŋ tabili alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yikolaannim ni bɛn nyɛ duumanima, ka o yuli tibisi gari yuli kam ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni mini ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna ni.
en: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.

dag: Chɛliya ba! Bɛ nyɛla zoomba bɛn vɔri bɛ taba, Ka zom yi vɔri zoma, bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ni ti lula bɔɣili ni.
en: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi, dama yi yi bi niŋ yɛda ni n nyɛla n ni pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la, yi shiri ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi.
en: That is why I told you that you will die in your sins. And you will die in your sins if you do not believe that I Am Who I Am.

dag: Kaman kom ni yi zo n-liilii kuɣa, ka kopaliga ʒi tiŋgbani taŋkpaɣu chaŋ shɛm, lala ka a saɣindi daadam tahima.
en: Water wears away boulders; floods carry away soil; you destroy a peoples hope.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ ni: Matania mini Zakaria ni Jɛhiɛl ni Abidi ni Jɛrɛmɔt ni Ɛlia.
en: Clan of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, zaŋmiya yi dunia ŋɔ laɣ yoya ŋɔ bo simdi, ka di yi ti naai, yi ni tooi kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee.
en: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves so that when its gone, you will be welcomed into the eternal homes.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka tiliginsim paag a yili ŋɔ na, dama a gba yila Ibrahimma zuliya ni na.
en: Jesus said, Today is the day for this family to be saved from sin. Yes, even this tax collector is one of Gods chosen people.

dag: N ni zaŋ li tila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ya la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa pun yɛli ya, Teemiya dɔni ka ti du n-tam yi zuɣu n-nɔri ya chani kaman tiŋgbani n-nyɛn ya la.
en: I will give it to those who oppressed you, to those who made you lie down in the streets and trampled on you as if you were dirt.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ka niriba baŋ a kpiɔŋ tuma min a nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla.
en: to inform all human beings about Gods power and the majestic glory of Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋmaligi yɛl o, Mani n-tim a, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ŋɔ chaŋ ti fa Izraɛlnim Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: The Lord turned toward Gideon and said, Then use your great power and go save the Israelites from the Midianites. I am sending you to save them.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni n ni yɛn tiligi n niriba yuun shɛli paaya, ka n ni yɛn darigi n niriba dimnim tibili saha shɛli gba paai.
en: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.

dag: ka buɣim kulibɔŋ zɔri yiri di ni na. Ka niriba tusatusa shɛm tumdi tuma tir o, ka niriba tuhipii ʒiibu tuhipia ʒe o tooni. Ka saria karibu daa piligi, ka litaafinim bɔɣi doya.
en: A river of fire flowed out from his presence; thousands upon thousands served him; ten thousand times ten thousand stood ready to serve him! The court sat in session; the scrolls were opened.

dag: Ka Shaul daa ti kpi, ka Baalihanan Akibɔr bidibiga la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Shaul died, Baal Hanan ruled that country. Baal Hanan was the son of Acbor.

dag: Sool ba n-daa nyɛ Kish, ka Abinɛr ba Nɛr mi daa nyɛ Abiɛl bia.
en: Saul's father Kish and Abner's father Ner were sons of Abiel.

dag: Suhudoo be ŋmɛnditoya yinsi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ wuna niŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuu ni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisiri ŋɔ lee nyɛ bɛn yiri barina ni.
en: But robbers tents are not bothered. Those who make God angry live in peace, even though God has them in his power.

dag: Ka n daa paai Jɛrusalɛm m-be nimaani dabisi muna ata.
en: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem.

dag: Naa Asa daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinahi ni yini ka faai siɣ o yaannim sani.
en: Two years later he died.

dag: Amaa bin yini ŋɔ ka n naɣ kpahim nya: Naawuni nam ninsalinim dɛde, amaa tinim lee bo yɛligabira pam ti timaŋa. .
en: This is all that I have learned: God made us plain and simple, but we have made ourselves very complicated.

dag: ka Bɛnaaya mini Jahaziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la mi nyɛ bɛn yɛn piɛbiri kikahi m-be Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: and two priests, Benaiah and Jahaziel, were to blow trumpets regularly in front of the Covenant Box.

dag: ka Naawuni yi di yiɣisi zani, wula ka n di yɛn niŋ? Ka o yi bɔhi ma, wula ka n yɛn garigi yɛl o?.
en: If I did not, how could I then face God? What could I say when God came to judge me?.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Di chaŋ wula ka yi booni ma yi Duuma, yi Duuma, ka lee bi tumdi tuun shɛŋa n ni wuhi ya ni yi tum?.
en: Why do you call me, Lord, Lord, and yet don't do what I tell you?.

dag: A bɔɣu nyɛla din mali kpiɔŋ; a nuu maa shiri mali kpiɔŋ, di bamdi a nudirigu.
en: You are strong and mighty!.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m paɣa duɣi dihi do so, ka chɛ ka do so dɔn o.
en: then let my wife serve someone else, and let other men sleep with her.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ; n kul guhir o mi, ka mali tahima o yɛligu ni.
en: I wait eagerly for the Lord 's help, and in his word I trust.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o zali ni bɛ be kaman o Bia la, ka di chɛ ka o Bia maa leei bikpɛma o mabihi pam ni.
en: Those whom God had already chosen he also set apart to become like his Son, so that the Son would be the first among many believers.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ zaliya ni yi zaŋ bindirigu maa lita ayi zuɣu zali yi bihi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka bɛ ti nya n ni daa zaŋ bindir shɛli dihiri ya tiŋgban nɛli ni saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: Moses told the people what the Lord said: Save a basket of this food for your descendants. Then they can see the food that I gave to you in the desert when I took you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka sokam daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: So the people did no work on the seventh day.

dag: Ka Maika yɛl o, Kpalimmi n sani leei m ba ni m maligumaana. N ni tir a anzinfa kpila pia yuuni kam, ka tir a situra mini bindirigu pahi.
en: So Micah said to him, Stay with me and be a father and a priest to me, and Ill give you ten pieces of silver a year, a set of clothes, and your basic needs.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, zomiya doli di pala n-lihi gili nya! Lihimiya zama ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-nya yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ yino ŋun tuma viɛla, ka o gbibi yɛlimaŋli, ka n chɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim taali o zuɣu.
en: People of Jerusalem, run through your streets! Look around! See for yourselves! Search the marketplaces! Can you find one person who does what is right and tries to be faithful to God? If you can, the Lord will forgive Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin mini Hashub daa mali me bɛ yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Maasɛya bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ Anania yaaŋa la daa mali me o yiŋ luɣili ni m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.

dag: Ka baŋdiba shɛb bɛn be bɛ ni ni ti wuhi bɛ ni niriba pam din tuhi. Amaa di ti ku yuui ka bɛ ku bɛ ni shɛba tɔbu ni, ka nyo shɛb buɣim ku ba, ka gbahi shɛb mi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.

dag: Yi ni na mali neesim maa zuɣu, niŋmiya neesim maa yɛda, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi leei neesim maa bihi. Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa chaŋmi ti sɔɣi.
en: Believe in the light, then, while you have it, so that you will be the people of the light. After Jesus said this, he went off and hid himself from them.

dag: Ijiptinim nyɛla ninsalinima ka pa Naawuni, ka bɛ yuri nyɛ biŋkɔbiri ka pa lahizibu binyara. Yawɛ yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu, bɛn nyɛ sɔŋdiba maa ni ti tuui, ka bɛ ni sɔŋdi shɛb maa lu, ka bɛ zaa laɣim bahi yoli.
en: The Egyptians are not gods—they are only human. Their horses are not supernatural. When the Lord acts, the strong nation will crumble, and the weak nation it helped will fall. Both of them will be destroyed.

dag: Teemiya yi zuɣulaannim bɛn daa wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa la yɛla, ka kpahimya bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai kum la, ka chɛliya ka yi yɛda niŋbu be kaman bɛ yɛda niŋbu.
en: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, M mabihi n-daa bala. M mini ba zaa nyɛla ma pu yin ni bihi. Yawɛ zuɣu, yi yi di daa chɛ ba, n naan ku kun ya.
en: They were my very own brothers! Gideon said. I swear by the living Lord that if you had let them live, I would let you live.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba ni bɛ su li. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He gave their land to Israel. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir daa ka Izraɛl naa sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Sirianim ni yɛli ni man Yawɛ nyɛla zoya zuɣu Naawuni ka pa vinvama ni Naawuni la zuɣu, n ni chɛ ka yi nyaŋ tɔbbi gbaliŋ maa zaa, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: A prophet went to King Ahab and said, This is what the Lord says: Because the Syrians say that I am a god of the hills and not of the plains, I will give you victory over their huge army, and you and your people will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Naawuni ni daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa di zuɣu.
en: God heard and became enraged; he rejected Israel utterly.

dag: Ka yi ni bɛn ti kpalim ni ti bahi yoli yi dimnim tiŋgbɔna ni bɛ mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛ yaannim maa.
en: The few of you who survive in the land of your enemies will waste away because of your own sin and the sin of your ancestors.

dag: Naawuni, fam ma ʒim yihibu taali ni bahi; nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ n zilinli yili yila pam yɛl a fa m-bahi maa yɛla.
en: Spare my life, O God, and save me, and I will gladly proclaim your righteousness.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa labi kuli maa kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: The whole assembly together totaled .

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka ŋmaligi yɛli wain tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Then the trees said to the vine, You come and be king over us.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka o wum vu shɛli damli ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Im about to mislead him, so when he hears a rumor, hell go back to his own country. Then Ill have him cut down by the sword in his own land.

dag: ka sɔŋmiya taba. Yi ni so yi mali yɛli shɛli ni o kpee, yin chɛliya tab taali paŋ taba; di niŋ kamaata ni yi chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman ti Duuma ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba shɛm la.
en: Be tolerant with one another and forgive one another whenever any of you has a complaint against someone else. You must forgive one another just as the Lord has forgiven you.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, buni nyɛla din yɔhindi nira. Karimbaannim ku be. Bɛ yɛla bɛ lɔna kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee la. Bɛ ŋmanila kum, bɛ bi tiɣira. Bɛ laɣim zuliya kam leei bɛ niriba, bɛ zaŋ niriba zaa lee bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni paɣi ma. Hal yɔbahi mini taatahi gba ni paɣi ma, dama n ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni n-ti n ni pii ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: Even the wild animals will honor me; jackals and ostriches will praise me when I make rivers flow in the desert to give water to my chosen people.

dag: ka koma maa daa labina ti lim Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ni o tɔbbihi bɛn daa doli Izraɛlnim maa siɣi teeku maa ni zaa, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: The waters returned and covered the chariots and the cavalry, Pharaohs entire army that had followed them into the sea. Not one of them remained.

dag: O yuli yiko n-ti gbarigu ŋɔ alaafee maa; o yuli yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi nya ka wum din niŋ ŋɔ. Yɛda niŋbu zaŋ chaŋ Yisa sani zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu maa nya alaafee zaa yi zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: It was the power of his name that gave strength to this lame man. What you see and know was done by faith in his name; it was faith in Jesus that has made him well, as you can all see.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ saha shɛli yin ni nya o. Suhimiy o saha shɛli o ni miri ya.
en: Seek the LORD when he can still be found; call him while he is yet near.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihinahi, ka mali yaansi bɛn nyɛ bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ daa bari bunsi pisopɔin. Abidɔn daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma anii.
en: Abdon had sons and grandsons. They rode on donkeys. Abdon was a judge for the Israelites for eight years.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee mi ma? Ka Yisa garigi n-yɛl o, A ni di be fiig tia gbini ka Filip na bi nya a la, ka n di nya a.
en: How do you know me? Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n chɛ ka ti mabia Ɛpafurɔditus ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee mini n tɔbbikpee, ka lan nyɛ yi tumo ŋun sɔŋ ma la lab kuli yi sanna.
en: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me.

dag: Ka paɣ yino yɛli, N dana, m mini paɣ ŋɔ n-laɣim be yil yini, ka n daa ti dɔɣi, ka o kul bela yili maa ni.
en: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home.

dag: Teemi Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun daa neei kum ni kaman n ni daa wuhi shɛm n lahibal suŋ molo molibu ni la yɛla.
en: Remember Jesus Christ, who was raised from death, who was a descendant of David, as is taught in the Good News I preach.

dag: Wuntizɔra ni mali shɛli ka di pɔra so ninvuɣ biɛri daazichi pam.
en: The little that a good person owns is worth more than the wealth of all the wicked.

dag: n karitimi dol o hal ti ŋme n-fa piɛbila maa o nol ni; ka o yi lɛbigi doli ma na, n gbaarila o nyiŋgol ni ŋme n-ku o.
en: I go after it and beat the wild animal until it lets the sheep go. If the wild animal turns and attacks me, I grab it by the throat and kill it.

dag: Amaa n yi ti neei kum ni, n ni daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili.
en: But after I am raised to life, I will go to Galilee ahead of you.

dag: Ti mali yɛla pam ni ti yɛli ya zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo ka di mi kahigibu to, dama yi nyɛla suhutunanima.
en: We have a lot to say about this topic, and its difficult to explain, because you have been lazy and you havent been listening.

dag: Ka bee a tɛhiya ni a gari la Mɔab Naa Balak Zipɔr bia la? O daa ŋme Izraɛlnim naŋgbankpeeni bee n-lo tɔbu ni o tuhi ba?.
en: Are you any better than Balak son of Zippor ? He was the king of the land of Moab. Did he argue with the Israelites? Did he actually fight with the Israelites?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn dol Naawuni zaligunima, ka ʒe Yisa yim la mal ania.
en: This calls for endurance on the part of God's people, those who obey God's commandments and are faithful to Jesus.

dag: Chɛ ka di be kaman chinchin la, ka o zaŋ li vil omaŋa, ka chɛ ka di be kaman shɛlɔrigu la, ka o zaŋ li lɔri dabisili kam.
en: Let them be like the clothes he wears, like a belt that is always around him.

dag: Bɛ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu. Ninni din nyɛ tuuli maa daa nyɛla chɛrubi ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buyi nyɛ ninsal ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buta nyɛ gbuɣinli ninni, ka ninni din pahi bunahi mi daa nyɛ tɔrili ninni.
en: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.

dag: Kalimiya yuma ayopɔin ʒiibuyopɔin. Di yuma maa ni ti nyɛla yuun pihinuyinika.
en: You will also count seven groups of seven years. This will be years. During that time there will be seven years of rest for the land.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: So the spirits begged Jesus, Send us to the pigs, and let us go into them.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma n-ti niriba ŋɔ. Miri ka a duh a yee n-suhi bɛ zuɣu, a mi miri ka a balim ma, n ku deeg a suhigu.
en: The Lord said, Jeremiah, do not pray for these people. Do not cry or pray on their behalf; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.

dag: Ka di daa bili n-leela yɔɣili din zɔra, amaa ka lee bi do tiŋa, ka ŋmaligi kpala o polo. Ka di nyaɣa kul kpalim ʒe di zaashee. Lala zuɣu di daa leela yɔɣili n-niŋ wula mini vari.
en: The seed sprouted and grew into a grapevine that spread over the ground. It had lots of leaves and strong, deep roots, and its branches grew upward toward the eagle.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei ka teeku maa kom maa lan nahi taba, ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛn zo n-yi dini, ka Yawɛ daai ba niŋ teeku maa bulli ni.
en: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea. At daybreak, the sea returned to its normal depth. The Egyptians were driving toward it, and the LORD tossed the Egyptians into the sea.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan ŋubi niriba, yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But I, the Lord , promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Kamina ka ti dɔni bo taba hal ka biɛɣu ti neei. Chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli taba bɔbu ni.
en: Let's go there and make love all night.

dag: Zuɣulaannim kul nahindi ma mi ka di ka soli, amaa n kul lurila a yɛligu sizuura n suhu ni.
en: Powerful people attack me unjustly, but I respect your law.

dag: Ka o daa boli bipuɣin kpɛm sani yuli Jɛmaima, ka boli ŋun paya yuli Kɛzia, ka boli ŋun pah ata maa mi yuli Kɛrɛnhapuk.
en: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti kuhimi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: As a pregnant woman close to childbirth is in labor pains, crying out in her pangs, so were we because of you, LORD.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa ti Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn kpiɔŋ ka o lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: Again the Israelites did things the Lord considered evil, and the Lord saw them doing these things. So the Lord gave King Eglon of Moab power to defeat the Israelites.

dag: Di tamiya, teemiya yi ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi shɛm tiŋgban nɛl ni la yɛla. Dahin shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mali hal ti paai kpe na ŋɔ yi kul nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: Remember how you made the Lord your God angry in the desert. Never forget that! From the day you left the land of Egypt to the day you came to this place, you have refused to obey the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: So their answer to Jesus was, We don't know. Jesus said to them, Neither will I tell you, then, by what right I do these things.

dag: Amaa nyin kpuɣim a jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa n-teeg a nuu tiri teeku maa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du.
en: Raise the walking stick in your hand over the Red Sea, and the sea will split. Then the people can go across on dry land.

dag: Ka Farisii so ŋun daa boli Yisa na maa daa nya lala ka yɛli o suhu ni, Doo ŋɔ yi di nyɛla anabi, o naan baŋ paɣ ŋun shihir o ŋɔ ni nyɛ so, dama o nyɛla tuumbiɛrilana.
en: When the Pharisee saw this, he said to himself, If this man really were a prophet, he would know who this woman is who is touching him; he would know what kind of sinful life she lives.

dag: N ni ti mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ mini sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka lan mali Aduna min o bidibisi la gba ka bɛ be kasi, ka tumdi maligumaaniba tuma tiri ma.
en: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ niŋmi ni Naawuni Kundi yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: Day after day, I was with you, teaching in the temple, but you didnt arrest me. But let the scriptures be fulfilled.

dag: Ka Dauda niriba maa daa ti nya Ijipti nachimbil so mɔɣu maa ni n-zaŋ o ka Dauda sanna nti ti o bɔrɔbɔro ka o ŋubi, ka ti o kom ka o nyu.
en: Some of David's men found an Egyptian out in a field and took him to David. They gave the Egyptian some bread, and he ate it. Then they gave him a drink of water.

dag: O daa lan wurim dagɔra du shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛli paɣiba ni daa wuɣiri Ashɛra jɛmbu binyɛra la.
en: Then King Josiah broke down the houses of the male prostitutes who were in the Lord s Temple. Women also used these houses and made little tent covers to honor the false goddess Asherah.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi la daa ti binnani maa vuhim hal ka binnani maa ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa gba, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi binnani maa jɛmbu.
en: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tiɛriŋ zuɣu m-bilina, ka mahili ni daa bi yuuri tiŋ nimaani zuɣu chɛ ka di zaɣi kpi.
en: Other seed fell on rock. As it grew, it dried up because it had no moisture.

dag: Amaa a daa niŋ a viɛlim maa naani, ka gɔri pagɔrisigu a yudua maa zuɣu. A daa chɛ ka a mini ŋunkam gariti nimaani dɔni.
en: But you took advantage of your beauty and fame to sleep with everyone who came along.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kpi maa, o bia Ahazia n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahab lay down with his ancestors. His son Ahaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: N yi ti kpihim a birili, n ni chɛ ka zuɣusaa zibigi, ka saŋmarisi ku lan ne. N ni ti chɛ ka sagbana limsi wuntaŋa, ka goli ti ku lan paligi.
en: When you are snuffed out, I will cover the sky, and I will darken the stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon wont radiate its light.

dag: Dauda tɔbutuhiri biinsi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jashɔbiam ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔn nira, ka daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la kpɛma. Ŋuna n-daa ti zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa saha yin la.
en: This is a list of Davids special soldiers: Jashobeam the Hacmonite was the leader of the kings special forces. Jashobeam used his spear to kill men at one time.

dag: ka Izraɛlnim zaa gba naanyi tiligi kaman di ni sab yɛli Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Tiligira ni ti yi Ziɔn na; o ni ti yihi Yaakubu zuliya tuumbiɛri zaa bahi.
en: And this is how all Israel will be saved. As the scripture says, The Savior will come from Zion and remove all wickedness from the descendants of Jacob.

dag: ka n tɛhi ni di simdi ni n yɛl a di yɛla. To, a yi bɔri li, nyin dam li salo bɛn ʒi kpe ŋɔ mini n tiŋ kpamba ŋɔ ninni. Ka a yi bi bɔri li, nyin yɛlima, dama nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ tooni n-simdi ni a da li, ka m paya. Ka doo maa yɛl o, N ni da li.
en: and I think you ought to know about it. Now then, if you want it, buy it in the presence of these men sitting here. But if you don't want it, say so, because the right to buy it belongs first to you and then to me. The man said, I will buy it.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa chɛ ka tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa yi Ifriim tiŋgban ni na maa lab kuli. Ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam bahi Judanim zuɣu ka bɛ je suli pam lab kuli.
en: So Amaziah sent the hired troops away and told them to go home. At this they went home, bitterly angry with the people of Judah.

dag: Ti ni mali dunia ŋɔ ni doo la kɔtomsi shɛm, lala ka ti ni ti mali do so ŋun yi alizanda ni na la gba kɔtomsi.
en: Just as we wear the likeness of the man made of earth, so we will wear the likeness of the Man from heaven.

dag: Nyam tumo ŋun mali lahiba suŋ mini suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-zɔri duri zoya kanna ŋɔ naba ni viɛli pam shɛm! O moonila tiliginsim molo yɛri Ziɔnnima, Yi Naawuni nyɛla naa.
en: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.

dag: N ni zaŋ di mini Ammɔnnim niŋ wulimpuhili polo nim nuu ni, ka bɛ su ba, ka zuliya shɛb ku lan teei Ammɔnnim yɛla.
en: Ill hand it over, along with the Ammonites, to people in the east for them to take possession. And so Ammon will no longer be remembered among the nations.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din ni miligi Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bee Naawuni cheechinim suhuri.
en: Dont offend either Jews or Greeks, or Gods church.

dag: ni Kiriataim ni Bɛtigamul ni Bɛtimɛɔn.
en: to Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon.

dag: O daa zaŋla chɛchɛbun gahinda kɔbisiyɔbu ni Ijipti chɛchɛbunsi zaa, ka tɔbbihi daa be di zaa ni.
en: He took of his best men and all of his chariots. There was an officer in each chariot.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, chɛ ka n sɔŋsim bɔbu kuhigu ŋɔ paag a.
en: Lord , hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for help.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda.
en: While Jesus was saying these things, many people came to believe in him.

dag: So mi n-nyɛ bundana, ka mali suhudoo ka binshɛli yɛla bi muɣis o, ka o ti kpi.
en: Some people stay healthy till the day they die; they die happy and at ease, their bodies well-nourished.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi, bɛ kanimina nti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: They come back every evening, growling like dogs, prowling around the city.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ paɣa n-tin ya, amaa ka do so zaŋ o dɔni, yi ni ti me yi yili ka bi kpe di ni. Yi ni ti sa yi wain tihi, ka ku di di wala.
en: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.

dag: Hɛman bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani n-daa nyɛ: Bukia mini Matania ni Uziɛl ni Shɛbuɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Hanania ni Hanani ni Ɛliata ni Gidalit ni Romamtiɛza ni Jɔshibɛkasha ni Mallɔti ni Hɔtir ni Mahaziɔt.
en: The fourteen sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ naɣitɔroko palli ni n-yi Abinadab yiŋ chana, ka Yuza mini Ahio daa vɔri li chana.
en: They moved Gods chest on a new cart from Abinadabs house. Uzzah and Ahio were guiding the cart.

dag: O ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa m-bɔŋɔ: Daanya daantalis ayi mini zuɣuri ayi din daa tam daantalis ayi maa zuɣu la mini zoligɔnim din daa lo biŋkpila maa la.
en: two columns, two bowl-shaped caps for the tops of these columns, two chain designs on the caps.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam nim zaa ni ti teei, ka ŋmaligi lab Yawɛ sanna, ka zuliya kam niriba zaa ni ti jɛm o.
en: May those in faraway countries remember the Lord and come back to him. May those in distant lands worship him.

dag: Yawɛ, wun ŋuni n-lee lan ŋman a? Ŋun nam dariza min o kasitali n-lee ŋman a, ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm ni jilima, ka o tumd alahiziba tuma?.
en: Lord , who among the gods is like you? Who is like you, wonderful in holiness? Who can work miracles and mighty acts like yours?.

dag: Bɛ nyuri dam kuuna n-chani tumdi yolimyolim. Bɛ paɣila vidibo gari jilima nyabu.
en: Though they have stopped drinking, they continue to behave like prostitutes; indeed, they love; shame is their pride.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu firilanim din pie tab la ni di nɛma zaa ni firila kpam.
en: the lampstand of pure gold, its lamps, all its equipment, and the oil for the lamps;.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni be kaman zunzuya Ifriimnim sani ka be kaman bin pɔŋ Judanim sani.
en: Now I, the Lord , will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.

dag: Teemiya Amalɛknim ni daa niŋ ya shɛm yi ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: Remember what the Amalekites did to you as you were coming from Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ kahig omaŋ wuhi, o kari saria ka tuumbiɛrinim maŋmaŋ nuhi tuma leei zana ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The Lord has revealed himself by his righteous judgments, and the wicked are trapped by their own deeds.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa n-garigi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: The Lord answered the angel with comforting words.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi gbani n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, man ŋun nyɛ yi dabipaɣ ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun ni paɣi n dan tumtumdiba naba.
en: She bowed down and said, I would willingly be David's slave and wash his servants' feet.

dag: M pun nya ka binshɛɣukam zaa viɛlim malila tariga, amaa a zaligunim din viɛlim nyɛla din ka tariga.
en: I have learned that everything has limits; but your commandment is perfect.

dag: M mabihi, yi mi n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, dama n yɛrila yinim bɛm mi zaligu yɛla. Zaligu lo nir la kulla o ni na be o nyɛvil ni la.
en: Brothers and sisters, you all understand the Law of Moses. So surely you know that the law rules over people only while they are alive.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛli ma, ka n yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa. Amaa nyin ŋuna, n ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi n-niŋ zuliya titali.
en: Now leave me alone! Let my fury burn and devour them. Then Ill make a great nation out of you.

dag: Ka Sintani daa ti yiɣisi lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, m-piɛli Dauda ni o kali Izraɛlnima.
en: Satan decided to cause trouble for Israel by making David think it was a good idea to find out how many people there were in Israel and Judah.

dag: Sal ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla sala; ka Naawuni Shia mi ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla shia.
en: A person is born physically of human parents, but is born spiritually of the Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti suui li zali, o yɛrimi, Yawɛ labimi Izraɛlnim tuhituhi zuɣa ŋɔ sanna.
en: When it rested, he would say, Return, LORD of the ten thousand thousands of Israel.

dag: ka doo maa gba ti lan je o ka sabi amiliya larigibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa bee do so ŋun kpuɣ o maa yi kpi.
en: But this new husband also dislikes her, writes up divorce papers, hands them to her, and sends her out of his house .

dag: Ka o kul zaɣisira, amaa di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛli o suhu ni, Wun ni m bi zɔri Naawuni ka mi bi lihiri nyari daadam kam ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: For a long time the judge refused to act, but at last he said to himself, Even though I don't fear God or respect people.

dag: n-daa tim ba Iddo ŋun daa nyɛ Kasifiya fɔŋ zuɣulan la sani ka yɛli ba bɛ ni ti yɛn yɛli Iddo min o tab bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba Kasifiya shɛm. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ tim ti tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: I sent the men to Iddo, leader in the town of Casiphia. I told them what to say to Iddo and his relatives, who are the Temple workers in Casiphia. I told the men to ask Iddo and his relatives to send us workers to serve in Gods Temple.

dag: Di daanabinim zanila bɛ zaani n-zaŋ piɛnta piɛlli paligi bɛmaŋa, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka buɣiri ba ʒiri baɣiri yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Amaa ka Yawɛ bi yɛli shɛli.
en: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba; dama Jabin daa malila kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi; ka daa zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Izraɛlnim pam yuun pisi.
en: Jabin's army had iron chariots, and for years he made life miserable for the Israelites, until finally they begged the Lord for help.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka a tibiginsim du n-gari zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ni zaa.
en: Exalt yourself, God, higher than heaven! Let your glory be over all the earth!.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun doli n nyaaŋa na la hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi li.
en: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana daa bi zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o daba ni bɛ tumd o tuma, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi min o sapashin kpamba ni kpamba bɛn daa su o chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba fukumsi.
en: However, Solomon didnt force the Israelites to work as slaves; instead, they became warriors, chief officers, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.

dag: O ni daa paai yiŋa Ifriim zoya ni tinsi maa ni, o daa piɛb la kikaa; ka Izraɛlnim daa yi zoya tinsi maa ni laɣim o sanna, ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: When Ehud came to Seirah, he blew a trumpet there in the hill country of Ephraim. The Israelites heard the trumpet and went down from the hills with Ehud leading them.

dag: Ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yɛhudianima ni Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ la.
en: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lab o naɣikɔra maa sani nti zaŋ ba kɔrigi, ka zaŋ bɛ dapuhi m-mali buɣim duɣi ba n-zaŋ ti niriba ka bɛ ŋubi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti doli Ilaija n-sɔŋd o.
en: Elisha left and took his oxen with him. He killed them and boiled them over a fire he had made with the wood from his plow. He gave the meat to the people who were with him, and they ate it. Then he left with Elijah and became his assistant.

dag: O ni tiligi ma ni alaafee n ni tuhiri tɔb shɛŋa la ni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: I have fought in many battles, but he has always rescued me and brought me back safely.

dag: Dim liɣiri maa ka di doli soli. Zaŋm li da naɣilahi mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi ni kawana ni wain n-zaŋ di mini biŋkɔbiri maa zaa mali sara yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu sara maligu bimbini zuɣu Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Use this money to buy bulls, rams, and male lambs. Buy the grain offerings and drink offerings that go with these sacrifices. Then sacrifice them on the altar in the Temple of your God in Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni zuɣu, n kpamdi yi zaa jaande ni yi ni so di tɛhi ni omaŋmaŋ bebu gari o bebu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa lee tɛhimiyala nimmoo tɛha, ka zahimmiya yimaŋa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Naawuni ni ti sokam yɛda shɛm.
en: God has given me a special gift, and that is why I have something to say to each one of you. Dont think that you are better than you really are. You must see yourself just as you are. Decide what you are by the faith God has given each of us.

dag: Ka bɛn kpi maa dɔɣim yi kpuɣi kum maa yi yili maa ni, ka bɔhi ninvuɣ so ŋun na kpalim be yili maa puuni, So na beni? O ni yɛli, Aai! Ka lan yɛli, Foma! Di bi simdi ni ti boli Yawɛ yuli.
en: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, Are there others? You will answer, No! Then your relative will reply, Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord .

dag: Ti Duuma suhu yiɣisiya, ka o filim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga. O zaŋ Izraɛl jilima bahi, ka di yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na. O suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛli, o daa bi lan teeg o napɔntamdigu la yɛla.
en: Look how the Lord has covered daughter Zion with the cloud of his anger. He has thrown her, the glory of Israel, from the sky to the ground. In his anger he showed no care even for the Temple where he rests his feet.

dag: ka boli laɣiŋgu maa niriba zaa ka bɛ ka Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni na.
en: Then call the whole community together there.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela zuliya kam ni maani shɛb ansarisi; ka leei niriba ni lari shɛba.
en: You have made us a joke among the nations; they shake their heads at us in scorn.

dag: Ʒii maa nyabu puuni, n daa nya ka m bela Susa nayili tin shɛli din be vinvamli ni Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka daa lan nya ka n ʒɛla Ulai Mɔɣili noli.
en: I saw this vision, and as I experienced it I was in the walled city of Susa in the province of Elam, by the Ulai canal.

dag: Yi yi kariti ma saria bee dunianim yi kariti ma saria m baɣa kani; hal n gba kariti mmaŋ saria.
en: But I dont consider your judgment on this point to be worth anything. Even an opinion from a court of law would mean nothing. I dont even trust my own judgment.

dag: Ti bi nyuri bara n-yaɣiri di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga ninvuɣ shɛb tuma zuɣu, amaa ti tahima nyɛla ni yi yɛda yi zooi pahi, ti tuma soya gba ni yɛligi yi sani.
en: We dont take pride in what other people do outside of our boundaries. We hope that our work will be extended even more by you as your faith grows, until it expands fully .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o yɛligu paai Hanani bia Jɛhu zaŋ chaŋ Baasha polo yɛli.
en: The LORDs word came to Jehu, Hananis son, against Baasha.

dag: Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n sɔŋda. Ŋuna n Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi n nyɛvili.
en: But look here: God is my helper; my Lord sustains my life.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tim ti boli Pool na ka Tɛɛtulus gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra: N dan Filiksi, a zuɣu ka ti ʒiya ni alaafee, ka a tumdi tuun suma tiri ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then Paul was called in, and Tertullus began to make his accusation, as follows: Your Excellency! Your wise leadership has brought us a long period of peace, and many necessary reforms are being made for the good of our country.

dag: Ka Naawuni sɔŋ Judanim gba n-ti ba naŋgbanyini ni bɛ niŋ naa min o kpambaliba ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm kaman Yawɛ yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded.

dag: N ni darigi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa tibili, ka kpihim Baal tuma din kpalim mini buɣa maligumaaniba yuya kpe.
en: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will eliminate whats left of Baal from this place and the names of the priests of foreign gods.

dag: Amaa ka Naomi yɛli ba, M bihi, labimiya kuli. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔri ni yi doli ma kuli? Yi tɛhiya ni n ni lan tooi dɔɣi bidibisi yaha ka yi kuli ba?.
en: You must go back, my daughters, Naomi answered. Why do you want to come with me? Do you think I could have sons again for you to marry?.

dag: Yi ni tooi pihi li hal ni daba ayɔbu dali, amaa daba ayopɔin dali din nyɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, di shɛli ku beni.
en: Six days you will gather it. But on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will be nothing to gather.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt puu maa chira ayɔbu ni ka Naawuni daa tim malaika Gabirɛl Galili fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la.
en: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kana ti mɛhim vinvama din be gbirimagbirima ni, ni tampima voya ni, ka mɛhim gɔhi tuturi mini mɔri ni.
en: They will settle in the deep valleys and in the caves, by the thornbushes and watering holes.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ Gaza, ka Ashikɛlɔn ti zani dabari. Bɛ ni ti taɣi Ashidɔdnim chaŋ wuntaŋ ni, ka wurim Ɛkurɔn.
en: No one will be left in the city of Gaza. Ashkelon will be deserted. The people of Ashdod will be driven out in half a day, and the people of Ekron will be driven from their city.

dag: M mabihi, m bi tɛhi ni m pun nya li, amaa n ni niŋdi bin yini shɛli nyɛla n tamdila binshɛɣukam din be n nyaaŋa yɛla, ka kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m paala din be n tooni.
en: Of course, my friends, I really do not think that I have already won it; the one thing I do, however, is to forget what is behind me and do my best to reach what is ahead.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni nyu a biɛli pipi shɛli din yɛlima ka zilim la ni binnyurigu. Bɛ ni ti la a, ka mal a ansarisi, dama di puuni bini galisiya pam.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, You will drink from your sister's cup; it is large and deep. Everyone will scorn and mock you; the cup is full.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tooi baŋ Naawuni yɛla zaa dola palɔni bɛ sani, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-pun kahigi li wuhi ba.
en: This is because what is known about God should be plain to them because God made it plain to them.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zal o dabili Musa shɛm, lala ka Musa gba daa zali Jɔshua; ka Jɔshua mi daa niŋ kaman o ni zal o shɛm. O daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka bi chɛ di shɛli bahi.
en: Long ago the Lord commanded his servant Moses to do this. Then Moses commanded Joshua to do this. So Joshua obeyed God. He did everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: O kɔba ŋmanila daanya mulima din mali yɔri, ka o gbaya min o bɔɣiri ŋmani kurimulima.
en: His bones are as strong as bronze, and his legs are like iron bars.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaa daa niŋ nia ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa. Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi polo Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: The whole community was threatening to stone them to death, but suddenly the people saw the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence appear over the Tent.

dag: Niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti du n-tam Ziɔn Zol la zuɣu, ka deei Iso Zoli su. Ka di ti leei Yawɛ nam.
en: The deliverers will go up to Mount Zion to rule Mount Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORDs.

dag: amaa ka bahi yi nyaaŋa! Niriba ŋɔ tatabo ti ku lan nya soli doli niŋ tuuba, dama bɛmaŋmaŋ lan labisi Naawuni Bia kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka dih o vi palɔni m-bala.
en: They are crucifying Gods Son all over again and exposing him to public shame.

dag: Ka n daa lihi n-nya Piɛbila ka o ʒe Ziɔn zol zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi ʒe o sani, ka o yuli min o Ba yuli sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Then I looked, and there was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion. With him were one hundred forty-four thousand who had his name and his Fathers name written on their foreheads.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn Zol zuɣu; m-moli nolɔbo molo, ka laɣim niriba.
en: Blow the trumpet on Mount Zion; give orders for a fast and call an assembly!.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Pa Bɛnjamin zuliya din pɔri gari Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa la ni nira n-nyɛ ma? Pa n yiŋnim m-pɔri gari sokam Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni? Ka wula ka a ti tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Saul answered, I belong to the tribe of Benjamin, the smallest tribe in Israel, and my family is the least important one in the tribe. Why, then, do you talk like this to me.

dag: Jɛra yi bɔhi jɛrilim bɔhigu, nyin di garigi ba jɛrilim garigibu, di yi pa lala a gba ni leei jɛrigu.
en: Dont answer fools according to their folly, or you will become like them yourself.

dag: ka o yidana maa wum li, ka bi yɛl o shɛli o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ni zani.
en: she must do everything that she vowed or promised unless her husband raises an objection when he hears about it.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Galili maa, ka Galilinim maa deeg o ni suhupiɛlli bɛ nini ni daa pun nya o ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa chuɣu puhibu ni Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu, dama bɛ gba daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni.
en: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.

dag: Ka a daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa m bela a sani n-nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a. N ni chɛ ka a yuli du kaman dunia ŋɔ ni wɔɣira yuya ni daa du shɛm la.
en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have defeated all your enemies as you advanced. I will make you as famous as the greatest leaders in the world.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa wurim nimaani, ka sokam lab omaŋmaŋ daŋ niriba min o malibu sani, ka bɛ daa yi nimaani lab bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: At the same time the rest of the Israelites left, and every man went back to his own tribe and family and to his own property.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-naɣ wuhiri ma tiŋ kam ni ni sarika kpɛbu mini wahala n-guli ma nimaani.
en: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit has warned me that prison and troubles wait for me.

dag: Naa ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-yihiri ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋdi kaburi dari buri ba.
en: A wise king will find out who is doing wrong, and will punish him without pity.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata.
en: He was years old at the time, and he ruled only months from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ gbaag o zilima yɛlibu yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ o nyaandola, amaa tinim nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: They insulted him: You are his disciple, but we are Moses disciples.

dag: O daa zaŋla din buɣisiri maa buɣisi wulimpuhili polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was meters long.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bia maa kuhigu maa; ka Naawuni malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Haga m-bɔh o, Haga, bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama Naawuni wum bia maa kuhigu o ni be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: God heard the boy crying, and from heaven the angel of God spoke to Hagar, What are you troubled about, Hagar? Don't be afraid. God has heard the boy crying.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yubu nyɛla ni ŋunkam nya o Bia la ka niŋ o yɛda ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: This is my Fathers will: that all who see the Son and believe in him will have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Mɛkɔna ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: Ziklag, Meconah.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka bɛ daa doli ka tiri bɛ suɣa doona, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu yiɣisiri chana. Bɛ daa dolila Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Musa zali ba zaligu shɛli n-tumdi Yawɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: So the people obeyed the Lord s commands. They camped when the Lord told them to, and they moved when he told them to. They watched carefully and obeyed the Lord s commands to Moses.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhiri anabinim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli ya? bee Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: So this is what you should say to the prophet: What has the LORD said to you? What has the LORD declared.

dag: Ka naa daa ti yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi dan kpambaliba m-pahi yimaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ba mmaŋmaŋ buntaaŋa la, ka yi zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: he told them: Take along some of my officials and let Solomon ride my own mule to Gihon Spring.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Darius Ahasivɛrɔs bia ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la daa deei Kalidianim nam di.
en: In the first year of Darius rule—Darius, who was Ahasuerus son, a Median by birth and who ruled the Chaldean kingdom.

dag: Wari yi beni o suhu bi zɔhiri o yiŋnim zuɣu, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛrila situr tibisa.
en: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.

dag: Bɛ daa ti tahi alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi zoom bir so zuɣu Yisa sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ zaa, ka o nina maa gba neei, hal ka o lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira.
en: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Hiburunim Naawuni n-daa ka ti sanna, dinzuɣu ti suhir a mi, chɛ ka ti chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti.
en: They answered, The Lord God of the Hebrews has appeared to us. Please let us walk three days into the desert where we can offer sacrifices to him. If you don't, he may strike us down with terrible troubles or with war.

dag: Ka Daniɛl dimnim la daa naai noli kana ti nya o ka o suhiri la o Naawuni.
en: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: People brought their small children to Jesus so that he could lay his hands on them to bless them. But the followers told the people to stop bringing their children to him.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; amaa karimbia ŋun nya wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga, o baŋsim min o karimba baŋsim ti saɣirila taba.
en: Are students better than their teacher? But when they are fully trained, they will be like their teacher.

dag: Yisa daa wuhi shihira pam o nyaandoliba maa ninni, ka din yɛla bi sabi niŋ litaafi ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus did many other miraculous signs that his followers saw, which are not written in this book.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinunaayi ka ti daa zaŋ tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma zaa n-naai li gol so bɛ ni booni Ɛlul la biɛɣ pisinaanu dali.
en: After fifty-two days of work the entire wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month of Elul.

dag: Mbayooi! Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni tim na.
en: Ah! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Are you here to destroy us? I know who you are: you are God's holy messenger.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni o nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianim maa.
en: Joab saw that there were enemies in front of him and behind him. So he chose some of the best Israelite soldiers and lined them up for battle against the Arameans.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, palim a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kul ku kɔŋ a zuliya ni, a bihi yi ni lihi bɛ soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka doli ma kaman a ni daa doli ma shɛm la.
en: Lord God of Israel, you promised my father that someone from his family would always be king of Israel, if they do their best to obey you, just as he did.

dag: Di saha ka tumo daa kana ti yɛli Sool, Kulimina yomyom, dama Filistianim kana ti liri ti.
en: But a messenger suddenly came to Saul. Come quick! he said. The Philistines have invaded the land.

dag: A biha ayi ŋmanila muli zaɣ pola ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi.
en: Your breasts are like twin fawns of a young gazelle.

dag: Ŋun nam tibili ni nyɛ ŋun bi wumda? Ŋun nam nini ni nyɛ ŋun bi nyara?.
en: God made our ears—can't he hear? He made our eyes—can't he see?.

dag: Wumm a ba ŋun dɔɣ a yɛligu. Miri ka a ʒiɛm a ma o yi ti kurigi.
en: Listen to your father; without him you would not exist. When your mother is old, show her your appreciation.

dag: Di saha ka n daa neei gom ni n-lihi ka n gom maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: So then, people will say, I went to sleep and woke up refreshed.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Gɛhaazi, Malim shili kpuɣi n jaaŋgbee ŋɔ chaŋ. A yi ti nya so sol ni, nyin di puh o; ka so yi puh a, nyin di saɣi. A yi ti paai, nyin zaŋmi n jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni.
en: Elisha turned to Gehazi and said, Hurry! Take my walking stick and go. Don't stop to greet anyone you meet, and if anyone greets you, don't take time to answer. Go straight to the house and hold my stick over the boy.

dag: Din beni nyɛla, chɛliya ka ti kul chani tooni doli so shɛŋa ti ni pun doli hal ni pɔŋɔ la.
en: However that may be, let us go forward according to the same rules we have followed until now.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni yiya mini Juda nanim yiya shɛŋa bɛ ni daa wurim zaŋ taɣi bɛmaŋa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa teei gili ba, ka kahi kuɣa duhi ni bɛ tuhi ba la polo m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I, the Lord , the God of Israel, say that the houses of Jerusalem and the royal palace of Judah will be torn down as a result of the siege and the attack.

dag: Bɛ kul ku tam nandaamba yɛla sahakam; ka faranim tahima niŋbu mi kul ku kpalim yoli sahakam.
en: The needy will not always be neglected; the hope of the poor will not be crushed forever.
