dag: Amaa nyin kpuɣim a jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa n-teeg a nuu tiri teeku maa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du.
en: Lift up your walking stick and hold it out over the sea. The water will divide, and the Israelites will be able to walk through the sea on dry ground.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam mini alaka balibu kam din yɛla bi sabi zaligu kundi ŋɔ ni lu yi zuɣu hal ti naai yi balibu.
en: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law .

dag: So beni n-ni tooi ŋme ma naŋgbankpeeni? Dindina n ni fo n noli, ka kpi.
en: Who would dare contend with me, for then I would be quiet and die.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa zali Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka wuh o niriba ni bɛ niŋm ʒim vie bɛ yinsi dunoya, ka di chɛ ka Kum malaika so ŋun daa yɛn kana ti ku bikpamba la ti ku ku bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bikpamba.
en: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, in order that the destroyer could not touch their firstborn children.

dag: O yi kana ti gbaag a kpɛhi duu, ka kar a saria, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni?.
en: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ kom din tahiri tibidarigibo ŋɔ na ni kpe a pul nyɔri ni n-chɛ ka a dɔɣibu soli ŋari, ka a leei paɣiŋoo. Ka paɣ maa ni garigi yɛli, Ami Ami.
en: The priest must say, You must drink this water that causes trouble. If you have sinned, you will not be able to have children. Any baby you have will die before it is born. And the woman should say, I agree to do as you say.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ saria karibu saha; ka Naawuni ni yihi dunia ŋɔ naa bahi.
en: Now is the time for this world to be judged; now the ruler of this world will be overthrown.

dag: Ka a nudirigu mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini, di so ni a niŋgbuŋ zaa ti kpe buɣim ni.
en: If your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away! It is much better for you to lose one of your limbs than to have your whole body go off to hell.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba maa ŋmaligi yuuni taba, ka bi baŋ o ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: The disciples looked at one another, completely puzzled about whom he meant.

dag: Dama n wumla kuhigu kaman paɣa n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la. Ka di biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn tuui dɔɣi la. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi vuhibu ka kuhira, ka teeg o nuhi ka yɛra, Mbusim paai ma! N tarigiri lurila bɛn yɛn ku ma tooni. .
en: I hear the cry of a woman in labor, the distress of one delivering her first child. It is the cry of Daughter Zion, gasping for breath, her arms stretched out, and moaning, Im about to fall into the hands of murderers.

dag: N ku zo dabiɛm muɣisigu saha, saha shɛli n dimnim yi ti teei gili ma.
en: I am not afraid in times of danger when I am surrounded by enemies.

dag: Ka Pool daa garigi yɛli Di chaŋ wula ka yi kuhiri ŋ-ŋmari n yɛma? M mali shili gu shɛlikam, pa ni bɛ ti lo ma mihi Jɛrusalɛm n-kpɛhi duu kɔŋko, amaa n loya ni n ti kpi nimaani gba n Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: Paul replied, Why are you doing this? Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? Im ready not only to be arrested but even to die in Jerusalem for the sake of the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka di nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli n ni ku lan tooi du, dama kom maa daa pahimi, di ziliŋ daa saɣiya ni nira duɣi li, di daa nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli nira ni ku tooi siɣi gari.
en: He measured yards more, and there the stream was so deep I could not wade through it. It was too deep to cross except by swimming.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash kum nyaaŋa.
en: King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah lived years after the death of King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋ ni nyini ni bahi yoli; a ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe a yim yoli.
en: Look! Those far from you die; you annihilate all those who are unfaithful to you.

dag: Daba ayɔbu dali bɛ daa yi pihirila ʒii buyi zuɣu. Bɛ daa pihirila lita anahi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana ti yɛli Musa di yɛla.
en: On the sixth day they gathered twice as much food, four quarts for each person. All the leaders of the community came and told Moses about it.

dag: Dama pagɔrili samli yɔri nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, amaa so paɣ bɔbu nyɛla din diri nir nyɛvili.
en: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi nimaani kul o ya, ka o nyaandoliba daa dol o.
en: Jesus left that place and went back to his hometown, followed by his disciples.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and had them take a ritual bath.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya mini Nɛtania ni Zɛbadia ni Asahɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhɔnatan ni Adɔnija ni Tɔbija ni Tɔbadɔnija m-pahi Maligumaaniba Ɛlishama mini Jɛhɔram.
en: Jehoshaphat also sent Levites with these leaders. These Levites were Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, and Tobijah. He also sent the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

dag: N zaɣisi n yiŋa. N zaŋ n ni su shɛli bahi. N zaŋ n suhu ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb pam niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: I have abandoned my house. I have left my own property. I have given Judah, the one I love, to her enemies.

dag: Ka n daai yi ni zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi goon shɛli maa luhi tiŋa n-wurim li ka chɛ di tanzahi zali. Di ni ti lu n-kun ya, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will tear down the wall on which you laid plaster. I will raze it to the ground and expose its foundation. When it falls, you will be destroyed with it, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Zakaria, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka a paɣ Ɛlizabɛt ni niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a ti bol o yuli Jɔn.
en: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni fɔŋ kara n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Shiiba ni Molada.
en: This is the land that was given to that tribe: Beersheba , Moladah.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla wuntia sariakarita; ka wuhir o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo dabisili kam.
en: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.

dag: Di saha yiliguliba ni ni ti sɔhira, ka kpiɔŋlaannim pɔri gɔɣi, ka paɣiba bɛn niɛmdi chɛ niɛmbu, bɛ ni bi lan galisi zuɣu, ka din lihiri takɔriti ni niŋ liti.
en: Then your arms, that have protected you, will tremble, and your legs, now strong, will grow weak. Your teeth will be too few to chew your food, and your eyes too dim to see clearly.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soya nyɛla din viɛl zaa! Yawɛ daalikauli nyɛla zaɣ maŋli. O nyɛla bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: This God—how perfect are his deeds! How dependable his words! He is like a shield for all who seek his protection.

dag: Bɛ kuri pakoya mini saamba, ka kuri kpibisi.
en: They kill widows and immigrants; they murder orphans.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi Midian mini Ɛfa laakum pola na ti niŋ yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni. Ka Shiibanim zaa ʒi salima mini tulaale zim na; ka leei bɛn paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: Great caravans of camels will come, from Midian and Ephah. They will come from Sheba, bringing gold and incense. People will tell the good news of what the Lord has done!.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛligu mi kul ku yiɣisi. Ka Naawuni yi daa bol o ni zaŋ o yɛligu ti ninvuɣ shɛb la ŋun Naawuni ŋmahinli.
en: We know that what the scripture says is true forever; and God called those people gods, the people to whom his message was given.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba na nti zali jintɔriba maa tooni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa gbaai ba vihibu ka yɛli ba.
en: The apostles were brought before the council where the high priest confronted them.

dag: O daa kari dɔbba dagɔr tuma tiŋgbani maa ni, ka wurim buɣ shɛŋa zaa o yaannim ni daa me n-zal la.
en: He expelled from the country all the male and female prostitutes serving at the pagan places of worship, and he removed all the idols his predecessors had made.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka wula ka n ni yɛli? N ni yɛli, M Ba, chɛ ka saha ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu? Aai, dama di zuɣu ka n kana nti kpalim beni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.

dag: Di bi simdi ka maligumaana di biŋkɔb so bee noon so ŋun kpi o zuɣu bee biŋkɔbiri ni ku so. .
en: The priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies naturally or is torn apart by prey.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ suhuri chihi pam, ka bɛ bɔhi Pita min o tab maa, Ti mabihi, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, Friends, what should we do.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi nyɛla bi biɛɣu, ka yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundina.
en: But what will happen if that servant is evil and thinks his master will not come back soon?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ hal ti paai Zifurɔn, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Hazarɛnan; yi nuzaa polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.

dag: ka Jɔnatan daa nyɛ Maluki daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ Shɛbania daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa nya Sool maa, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni sa yɛl a ninvuɣ so yɛla la m-bala, Ŋuna n-yɛn su n niriba maa.
en: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD told him, Thats the man I told you about. Thats the one who will rule my people.

dag: Ka salo pam bɛn daa yi Galili mini Tinsi Pia tiŋgbana ni na mini bɛn yi Jɛrusalɛm ni Judia zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kabiri dol o.
en: Large crowds followed him—people from Galilee, the Ten Towns, Jerusalem, Judea, and the area across the Jordan River.

dag: Dinzuɣu shia ni ka niŋgbun shɛl ni ni nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kpiŋ shɛm la, lala ka yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma gba nyɛ yɛda kpiŋ.
en: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara din gari ninsal yɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: We cannot understand the great things he does, and to his miracles there is no end.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ gali pa o buŋa n-chaŋ Gaat naa Akishi sani ni o ti bo o daba maa shee. Ka o daa shiri bo n-nya ba n-zaŋ ba lab yiŋ na.
en: he saddled his donkey and went to King Achish in Gath, to find his slaves. He found them and brought them back home.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Ka bɔzuɣu ka yinim zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni, Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n yuli ni yɛn be sahakam la.
en: Manasseh built altars for false gods in the Lord s Temple. The Lord said about the Temple, My name will be in Jerusalem forever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gari nimaani n-lan gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ ti yɛn lu ka bɛ paai Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: So they traveled on, and the sun set when they were near Gibeah in Benjamin.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bol o kpambaliba na nti zaŋ yɛla maa zaa yɛli ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam.
en: Abimelech got up early in the morning and summoned all of his servants. When he told them everything that had happened, the men were terrified.

dag: N yura ŋmanila mɛɛr kpalambila m-pa m biha sunsuuni.
en: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;.

dag: M banima, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun mi ŋun daa be piligu ni ha la zuɣu. Nachimbihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun nyaŋ Tuumbiɛrilan la zuɣu.
en: I write to you, fathers, because you know the one who existed from the beginning. I write to you, young people, because you have defeated the Evil One.

dag: Dama o daa teeg o daalikauli kasi la min o dabili Ibrahimma yɛla.
en: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima. Di chɛliya ka naɣ bal shɛb zuliya du yi naɣinyama. Di biriya bimbira balibu buyi pu yin ni, yi mi di yɛnya taŋgari binyɛrigu.
en: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.

dag: Anabi shɛb bɛn daa daŋ m min a tooni na kurimbuni ha la daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri tɔbu tuhibu mini kum ni alɔbo yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndiri tiŋgbɔna mini nam shɛŋa din niriba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: There were prophets long before you and I became prophets, Hananiah. They spoke against many countries and great kingdoms and always warned that war, hunger, and disease would come to them.

dag: Alɔbo maa lubu nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza.
en: After the great sickness, the Lord spoke to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛn ʒiri bɛ nɛma be tooni, ka bɛ ŋmaligi doli.
en: They turned around and started off, with their children, their livestock, and their belongings going ahead.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta duu bihi mini namɔɣilisi ni daa kana ti yɛl o Mɔdɛkai yɛla, di daa niŋ o suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka o daa bo binyɛra n-ti ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Mɔdɛkai ka o ye ka chɛ buɣu maa, ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: When Esther's servant girls and her other servants told her what Mordecai was doing, she became very upset and sent Mordecai some clothes to wear in place of the sackcloth. But he refused to take them.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim lala, dama yi tuumbiɛri galisiya pam. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛkaali, bɛ ni ti ku Izraɛlnim naa.
en: That is what will happen to you, people of Bethel, because of the terrible evil that you have done. As soon as the battle begins, the king of Israel will die.

dag: ni Zabad ni Shutɛla ni Ɛzɛr mini Ɛliad bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti taɣi Gaatinim niɣi chaŋ ka bɛ ku ba.
en: his son Zabad, his son Shuthelah, and Ezer and Elead. The men of Gath, who were born in the land, killed them when they came down to take their cattle.

dag: Bɛ naɣ zaŋdi li mi maani buɣim. Ka di zuɣu polo mini di nyoya polo yi di buɣim ka chɛ di sunsuuni ka di leei sala doya, di ni tooi lan ku buchi yaha?.
en: People throw that wood into the fire. The ends burn, and the middle is scorched.

dag: Masia n-nyɛ ti suhudoo. Ŋuna n-daai dimdi goon shɛli din be Yɛhudianim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim la sunsuuni la luhi, ka zaŋ ba naai taba.
en: Christ is the reason we are now at peace. He made us Jews and you who are not Jews one people. We were separated by a wall of hate that stood between us, but Christ broke down that wall. By giving his own body.

dag: N Duuma, sɔŋm ma ka n yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: Help me to speak, Lord, and I will praise you.

dag: amaa cheechi ni m paɣi ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa diba anu m milinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka n wuhi niriba gari ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa tuhi pia tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: But in the church Id rather speak five words in my right mind than speak thousands of words in a tongue so that I can teach others.

dag: ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa yɛli ma o yɛla, ka yɛli ni n karim o saria n-luh o ti ba.
en: and when I went to Jerusalem, the chief priests and the Jewish leaders came and asked me to find him guilty.

dag: M puhiri Yuribanus ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpee Masia ni la mini Stachis n ni yuri so la.
en: Say hello to Urbanus, our coworker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa chaŋ Farisiinim sani ti yɛli ba Yisa ni tum shɛm maa.
en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus did.

dag: Yi ni daa yi Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka n daa pun lɔnya alikauli ni n kul ni be yi sani. Di zɔriya dabiɛm. .
en: I made an agreement with you when you left Egypt, and I have kept my promise. My Spirit is with you, so dont be afraid.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa ba yi zaɣisi zaa ni o ku zaŋ o bia maa ti doo maa, di simdi ka doo maa yo paɣipiɛliga bɔbu liɣiri ti paɣ maa ba.
en: But if her father refuses to let her marry the man, the bride price must still be paid.

dag: Yi noli yi kuli yaa yɛli shɛli, yin palimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni kul yaai yi noli po pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani shɛm maa.
en: but if you make one voluntarily, be sure that you keep it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa baŋ ni yɛm so jɛrilim kaman neesim ni so zibisim shɛm la.
en: Oh, I know, Wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zaawuni maa n-zo ni bɛ tiligi, ka chɛ bɛ tanti suɣa mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ bunsi. Bɛ daa kul zomi ka chɛ bɛ sansani maa kaman di ni daa kul be shɛm.
en: The Arameans ran away early that evening. They left everything behind. They left their tents, horses, and donkeys and ran for their lives.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni di ba. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi n-chaŋ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Kalidianim bɛn teei gili ya ŋɔ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: Whoever stays in the city will die by the sword, famine, and disease. But whoever leaves the city and surrenders to the Babylonians will live; yes, their lives will be spared.

dag: Ka di daa moli gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ni Naa Sool nyaŋla Filistianim tɔbbi shɛba ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Izraɛlnim leei Filistianim dimnima. Ka bɛ daa boli niriba maa ni bɛ yina nti pahi Sool zuɣu Giligal.
en: The messengers then said to the people of Israel, Saul has destroyed the Philistine army camp at Geba. Now the Philistines really hate Israel, so every town and village must send men to join Saul's army at Gilgal.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ti kul suhir o ni o chɛ ka ti mini ya lan nya taba, ka ti tooi zaŋ din pooi ya yi yɛda niŋbu ni la sɔŋ ya.
en: Night and day, we pray more than ever to see all of you in person and to complete whatever you still need for your faith.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, ka anabi Neetan mi kpɛna.
en: Just then, Nathan the prophet arrived.

dag: A ni tiligi pagɔrili ŋun nyɛ zinalana naŋgbammalisim ni.
en: You will be able to resist any immoral woman who tries to seduce you with her smooth talk.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni gbiri anzinfa luɣ shɛli beni, ka bɛ ni doori salima luɣ shɛli beni.
en: There are mines where people get silver and places where people melt gold to make it pure.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisiri neesim la, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn bi mili di soya ka bi ʒe di soya zuɣu la.
en: Some rebel and refuse to follow the light.

dag: O ni darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. O suhu ni yiɣisi bah o dimnim zuɣu pam, ka o bɔhi ba biɛri. Hal o ni bɔhi bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ gba biɛri kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God will repay according to their actions: wrath to his foes, retribution to enemies, retribution to the coastlands.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi pina na ti ti Yawɛ. Ŋunkam mali yurilim o suhu ni, ŋun zaŋmi Yawɛ pina din nyɛ: salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;.

dag: Zaŋm a tuma niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni, ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa niŋ pali.
en: Share your plans with the Lord , and you will succeed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhu yini, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun mali suhu yini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinima, a nyɛla ŋun nyandi ba.
en: You are pure to those who are pure, but hostile to those who are wicked.

dag: Benya yɛm biɛhigu bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm.
en: Be wise in the way you act with those who are not believers. Use your time in the best way you can.

dag: O suhu daa yiɣisiya, ka o lan je ma, ka dari tɔhi ma. O daa dim o nyina ni niŋ ma. O mirig o nina niŋ ma kaman o dima n-nyɛ ma la.
en: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.

dag: di saha ka yi ti puhi dakulɔdakulo chuɣu, ka zaŋ yi suhuyubu pina kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya shɛlikam na.
en: and then celebrate the Harvest Festival, to honor the Lord your God, by bringing him a freewill offering in proportion to the blessing he has given you.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu maa di puhibu saha yuuni kam.
en: So remember this festival every year at the right time.

dag: Naawuni, a ni daa be a niriba tooni m-mali ba chani la, a ni daa kpe mɔɣu ni gari la.
en: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga jilima zaa naaya. O nanim ŋmanila bambu dibisi bɛn bi nyari mɔri. Bɛ bela bɛn kariti ba tooni n-zɔri ka yaa kani.
en: Daughter Zion lost all her glory. Her officials are like deer that cant find pasture. They have gone away, frail, before the hunter.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli, Ka yi nini yi tiɣi tinim bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ, yin zaŋmiya tiŋgbani maa ti ti ka di leei ti dini, ka di zaŋya ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: If it pleases you, we would like this land to be given to us. Dont take us to the other side of the Jordan River.

dag: So ni tooi mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei Naawuni Shia Kasi kaman ti gba ni daa deei shɛm la kom baptaizibu.
en: These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.

dag: Bɛ yi di nyɛla n saawaranima, dindina bɛ naan moli n yɛligu maa n niriba sani; bɛ naan yihi ba bɛ biɛriyoli ni, ka yihi ba bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, dolimi Ishimail nyɛvili.
en: Then Abraham said to God, I hope Ishmael will live and serve you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Kpalimmi kpe zuŋɔ yaha, ka n sa bah a ka a lab biɛɣuni. Ka Yuria daa kpalim Jɛrusalɛm dindali maa neei biɛɣu.
en: Then David told Uriah, Stay here one more day. Tomorrow Ill send you back. So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day. The next day.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But when the sun rose, it burned the plants. The plants died because they did not have deep roots.

dag: Dinzuɣu lzraɛlnima, baŋmiya ni Yisa so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu maa ka Naawuni zaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ nim zaa Duuma ni bɛ Masia.
en: Therefore, let all Israel know beyond question that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ti ni ti kari malaikanim gba saria? Ka di yi nyɛ lala, dindina ti ni tooi kari ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu yɛla saria gari lala!.
en: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.

dag: Nyini n-su wuntaŋ ni, ka lan su yuŋ gba; nyini n-zali wuntaŋ mini goli.
en: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.

dag: N-kaai biɛɣu ka bɛ paai Siizaria, ka Kɔniilius pun laɣim o dɔɣiriba min o zo suma na ka bɛ ti ʒiya guli ba.
en: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.

dag: ka o zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina; ka di chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ku be kaman piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: Your people need someone to lead them into battle, or else they will be like sheep wandering around without a shepherd.

dag: Amaa wahu ni daa zaŋ o yɛmbimbiɛri n-yɔhim Awa shɛm la, n zɔri ni yi gba tɛha ti ŋmaligi kpe yɔɣu lala ka chɛ yi suhuyini mini yi ʒiɛyimtal shɛli yi ni mali zaŋ chaŋ Masia san la.
en: But I am afraid that your minds will be led away from your true and pure following of Christ. This could happen just as Eve was tricked by that snake with his clever lies.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din ni miligi Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bee Naawuni cheechinim suhuri.
en: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.

dag: Ka o daa lan po pɔri yɛl o, A yi kul yɛli ma a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa hal di yi nyɛ n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni ti a li.
en: Then he swore to her, Whatever you ask I will give to you, even as much as half of my kingdom.

dag: ka bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka bi niŋdi ba nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka doli n zaligunima ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam, o ku kpi o ba tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: and refuses to do anything evil or to charge interest. And he obeys all my laws and teachings. Such a man will live. His own father sinned, but this good man will not be put to death for the sins of his father.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia, Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: He told her, I am your father's relative, the son of Rebecca. She ran to tell her father;.

dag: Ka n daa lihi bɔri bɛ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun ni mali me gooni maa zali, ka zani tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaani gooni maa voli ni n tooni din ni chɛ ka n ku wurim li, amaa ka bi nya so.
en: I asked the people to change their lives and protect their country. I asked people to fix the walls. I wanted them to stand by those holes in the wall and fight to protect their city. But no one came to help!.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ yɔhim bɛmaŋa n-niŋ din ka buchi naani, dama din ka buchi maa n-ni ti nyɛ bɛ sanyoo.
en: That evil man should not fool himself by trusting in worthless things, because he will keep nothing.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni. Bɛ ni daa ti yi suɣili maa ni na, bɛ daa suhila alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni; ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi zahira niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Moses and Aaron then entered the meeting tent. When they came out, they blessed the people, and the LORDs glorious presence appeared to all the people.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli ba ni bɛ labimi ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai:.
en: Esther sent a message to Mordecai, saying.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa lihi Amalɛknima, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Amalɛknima n-daa be zuliya kam tooni, Amaa bɛ bahigu ni ti nyɛla bahi yoli zaa.
en: He looked at Amalek and raised his voice and gave his address: Amalek is foremost among the nations, but its end is to perish forever.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ wuɣi tan ʒiɛkpeein mini tan sabilifaa ni zaɣ ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli, ka mali chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ li yili dunoli maa.
en: He made the curtain from blue, purple, and red materials and expensive linen. There were Cherub angels on the curtain.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa duh a niriba ni, ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Go back and tell Jeroboam that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Jeroboam, I chose you from among all the Israelites. I made you the ruler of my people.

dag: A daa nam o ka o jilima pooi malaikanim jilima saha biɛla puuni; a daa chɛ ka o mali jiri mini jilima.
en: You made them for a little while lower than the angels; you crowned them with glory and honor.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nya lala ka o suhu yiɣisi, ka o tabig o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi bahi.
en: When the Lord saw this, he was angry and rejected his sons and daughters.

dag: Ka yɛndana ŋun nyɛ nandana daa be tiŋ maa ni; ka daa zaŋ o yɛm maa fa tiŋ maa nim bahi. Amaa ka so daa bi teei nandana maa yɛla.
en: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.

dag: Di nanim deerila birapu ka kariti saria, ka di maligumaaniba deeri liɣiri ka wuhiri niriba, ka di daanabinim tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka deeri liɣiri, amaa bɛ zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ be ti sani; zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti.
en: Her officials give justice for a bribe, and her priests teach for hire. Her prophets offer divination for silver, yet they rely on the LORD, saying, Isnt the LORD in our midst? Evil wont come upon us.

dag: ni Ishimaya ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn nira, ka nyɛ tɔbbi so ŋun yuli daa du, ka o gba su ninvuɣ pihita fukumsi la ni Jɛrimia ni Jahaziɛl ni Jɔhanan ni Jɔzabad ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛdɛra nir la.
en: Ishmaiah from Gibeon, a warrior in the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad from Gederah.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa chaŋ Farisiinim kpeen so yiŋa ni o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka Farisiinim maa daa kul kpahind o.
en: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to share a meal in the home of one of the leaders of the Pharisees, they were watching him closely.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam Ziɔn; bɛ duh o gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.

dag: Adin daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinunaanu.
en: of Adin.

dag: To, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti, ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nir ka o yuli booni Pɔtifa la daa da o Ishimail zuliya bɛn daa ʒi o kuli nimaani maa sani.
en: When Joseph had been taken down to Egypt, Potiphar, Pharaohs chief officer, the commander of the royal guard and an Egyptian, purchased him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.

dag: Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo; m bi kamina ni n ti ti suhudoo, amaa takɔbi ka n tahina.
en: Dont think that Ive come to bring peace to the earth. I havent come to bring peace but a sword.

dag: Dama n dabisa kul chanimi gariti kaman nyɔhi la, ka n kɔba ni mi diri buɣim kaman daaŋa ni buɣim la.
en: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.

dag: Di saha zaŋ chana, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lo nia ni o bahi Yisa, amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa kuhi yɛl o, A yi bahi doo ŋɔ a pala Naa Siiza sima, dama ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ leei naa lola Naa Siiza zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: From that moment on, Pilate wanted to release Jesus. However, the Jewish leaders cried out, saying, If you release this man, you arent a friend of the emperor! Anyone who makes himself out to be a king opposes the emperor.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pinaayi laasabu.
en: Altogether, there were about twelve people.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa yi n-kpe yɔɣu ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima. Bɛ daa tuhi tab la Ifriim tiŋgban ni yɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: So the troops marched into the field to meet the Israelites. The battle was fought in the Ephraim forest.

dag: ka lan nyɛ ŋun be nyɛvili ni; nyama, n daa pun kpimi ka neei, ka mi ku lan kpi hal abada. Mani n-su kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee saafɛbihi fukumsi.
en: and the living one. I was dead, but look! Now Im alive forever and always. I have the keys of Death and the Grave.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm, ka ŋmari ma ʒiri, ka bi lan tɛhiri n yɛla yi suhuri ni? N ni shini ya ka di yuui, ka ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi lan zɔri ma maa.
en: The Lord says, Who are these gods that make you afraid, so that you tell me lies and forget me completely? Have you stopped honoring me because I have kept silent for so long?.

dag: Naɣilaa bee piɛlaa ŋun gbali bee o bɔɣu zaɣ yini wɔɣ gari di tab maa bee n-nyɛ zaɣ jia n-gari di tab maa, yi ni tooi zaŋ o na ti mali yi suhu yubu sara, amaa yi yi zaŋ o mali sara ni yi yo yi ni po pɔr shɛli samli, n ku deei li.
en: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔh o, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ a? Ka o yɛli ma, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga. Ka n zaŋ nintua m-pir o, ka zaŋ bansi pir o.
en: Then I asked her, Who is your father? She answered, My father is Bethuel the son of Milcah and Nahor. Then I gave her the ring and bracelets for her arms.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni kpuɣi yi mini n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim ŋɔ zuɣusaa n sani n-zaŋ labi katiŋa.
en: But you called my message a heavy load, so I will pick you up like a heavy load and throw you away from me. I gave the city of Jerusalem to your ancestors. But I will throw you and that city away from me.

dag: Bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o bela bɛ sochandi tab sani, ka daa chaŋ dabisi muni chandi zaa ka naanyi ti gbaag o bɔbu bɛ dɔɣiriba mini bɛ nimmiriba sani.
en: They traveled for a whole day thinking that Jesus was with them in the group. They began looking for him among their family and close friends.

dag: Abiata ŋun nyɛ Ahimɛlɛk bia la ni daa yɛn zo n-chaŋ Dauda sani Kɛila maa, o daa zaŋla tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la mali chaŋ.
en: Now after Abiathar, Ahimelechs son, fled to David, he had accompanied David to Keilah, bringing a priestly vest with him.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi paŋ liɣiri so sani, bɛ je ni bɛ yo li, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyɛla bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ka tiri pini.
en: The wicked borrow and never pay back, but good people are generous with their gifts.

dag: Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka kpabi yim zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: They made the chest pendant square and doubled, nine inches long and nine inches wide when doubled.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini buɣa sunsuuni? Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ jɛmbu duu kaman ŋun Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm la: N ni be bɛ ni, ka chani gindi bɛ sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: What agreement can there be between Gods temple and idols? Because we are the temple of the living God. Just as God said, I live with them, and I will move among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people. .

dag: Nyin ŋun daa chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka wurim di tin kara, ka bi bahiri a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ kuni la m-bala?.
en: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi la mini binnɛma anahi la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee la ka yɛra, Ami! Haliluya.
en: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God, who is seated on the throne, and they said, Amen. Hallelujah.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Hazaɛl, Bom pini n-chaŋ ti puhi Naawuni nir maa, ka chɛ ka o bɔhi Yawɛ nya n ni kpaŋ m barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: So the king said to Hazael, Take a gift with you and go to meet the man of God. Question the LORD through him: Will I recover from this sickness.

dag: Yisifu bihi puuni, Ifriim zuliya ni, Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-yɛn sɔŋ ya; ka Manaasa gba zuliya ni, Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Josephs sons: from Ephraim, Elishama, Ammihuds son; from Manasseh, Gamaliel, Pedahzurs son.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tɛhiri yi yɛla, ka o baɣa shiri be yi yɛla ni.
en: He is the only one who shares my feelings and who really cares about you.

dag: Di lan chaŋya ti chɛ mɔri na ti ti ba ka bɛ ŋma bilichiisi maa. Chɛliya ka bɛ maŋmaŋ chani ti chɛri mɔri maa na.
en: Dont supply the people with the straw they need to make bricks like you did before. Let them go out and gather the straw for themselves.

dag: Di bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee ŋun nyɛ vubɔra, amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun be baalim, ka pa ni ŋun ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu nti yaɣi.
en: He must not drink too much, and he must not be someone who likes to fight. He must be gentle and peaceful. He must not be someone who loves money.

dag: Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin yɛlim ti. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi yɛli ya, yi ku niŋ yɛda;.
en: They said, If you are the Christ, tell us! He answered, If I tell you, you wont believe.

dag: N yi chaŋ tooni ha, o ka nimaani bee n yi labi nyaaŋa, n ku tooi nya o.
en: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: The LORD spoke to Joshua.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka duh o nam maa ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: David knew that the Lord had made him king of Israel and that he had made him a powerful ruler for the good of his people.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ti mali biɛhigu shee maa zali ya, n ni labina nti zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu shee, ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yi gba ni ti be.
en: After I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back. Then I will take you with me, so that you can be where I am.

dag: Bɛ di ti kpuɣi pakoli bee n-kpuɣi paɣ so ŋun yi doo yili. Amaa di simdi ni bɛ ti kpuɣila paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Izraɛlnim zuliya ni bee bɛ ni tooi kpuɣi maligumaana pakoli.
en: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni pirigi yi situra n-dihi ya vi.
en: I myself will pull up your skirt over your face and expose your shame.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai zoli maa gbini, ka o deei li bɛ sani n-zaŋ kpɛhi duu; ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi labi.
en: When they reached the hill where Gehazi lived, he took the bags from the servants and placed them in his house, then sent the men away. After they had gone.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali maa daa moli bahi ha, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li yɛli nayilinima.
en: The guards announced the news, and it was reported in the palace.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa daa guni yomyom, dama o suhu daa yu Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa hal ti yaɣi. O daa nyɛla yulilana o daŋ ni.
en: and the young man lost no time in doing what was suggested, because he was in love with Jacob's daughter. He was the most important member of his family.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa bɔh o, Ka paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o doli ma kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni be ŋɔ na, man zaŋm a bia maa kulis a ya maa.
en: The servant said to him, What if the woman doesnt agree to come back with me to this land? Shouldnt I take your son back to the land you left.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever hits their father or their mother must be killed.

dag: Firawuna ni yɛli Izraɛlnim yɛla, Bɛ bela tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni dari ginda, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo, ka tiŋgban nɛli taɣi ba zali.
en: Pharaoh will think that the Israelites are lost in the desert and that the people will have no place to go.

dag: N tumdila m Ba ni zali ma shɛm ni dunianim baŋ ni n yuri m Ba maa. Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ kpe ha.
en: but the world must know that I love the Father; that is why I do everything as he commands me. Come, let us go from this place.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛlana bee m-be kaman Iso ŋun baɣa daa ka Naawuni yɛla ni ka zaŋ o kpamdi taɣi saɣiŋmani yin la.
en: Let no one become immoral or unspiritual like Esau, who for a single meal sold his rights as the older son.

dag: O daa va salima mini anzinfa n-tabili Naawuni jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa din daa beni ka Obɛdɛdom bihi gul li la zaa, ka va nayili daazichi zaa, ka gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-lab kuli Samaria.
en: He took back to Samaria as loot all the gold and silver in the Temple, the Temple equipment guarded by the descendants of Obed Edom, and the palace treasures. He also took hostages with him.

dag: Filip mini Baatolomiu ni Tomas ni Matiu ŋun daa nyɛ farigudeera la ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni.
en: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.

dag: A daa pala shɛli ka n duh a ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka a mi ti dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli n-chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa tum alahichi, ka bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: I raised you up from the dust and made you a leader over my people Israel, but you walked in Jeroboams ways, making my people Israel sin, making me angry with their sins.

dag: Lihimiya Ziɔn din nyɛ ti ni puhiri ti daadiini churi tin shɛli ni la. Lihimiya Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ alaafee biɛhigu shee la. Di tanti suɣili bi vuura, ka di dasara kul ku vuɣi, ka di gabisi mi bi chihira.
en: Look at Zion, the city of our religious festivals. Look at Jerusalem—that beautiful place of rest. Jerusalem is like a tent that will never be moved. The pegs that hold her in place will never be pulled up. Her ropes will never be broken.

dag: Din chɛ ka bɛ ni bu so paa zɔri maa nyɛla o ni guli ba la liɣiri zuɣu maa n-chɛ ka o baɣa dii ka bɛ ni.
en: Hes only a hired hand and the sheep dont matter to him.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi daa yi zuɣusaa na ti tuhi tɔbu; bɛ daa yila bɛ biɛhigu shee na ti tuhi Sisɛra.
en: From their pathways in the sky the stars fought Sisera.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa piɛb o kikaa, ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zo titali ka buɣim diri di zuɣu la yiɣ ti lu teeku ni.
en: Then the second angel blew his trumpet. Something that looked like a huge mountain on fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea was turned into blood.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba mini zuɣulaannima ni salo maa zaa na.
en: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi nti nya ka Izraɛlnim niriba ayi ŋmaligi zabira, ka o chaŋ ni o ti gooi ba ka yɛli, M mabihi, yi nyɛla mabi yinsi, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan ŋmaligi zabira.
en: The next day he saw two Israelites fighting, and he tried to make peace between them. Listen, men, he said, you are fellow Israelites; why are you fighting like this.

dag: Dama yimaŋmaŋ nina daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord 's mighty power do all these things.

dag: Ka o bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛnkam zaa tɔhi liɣiri maa;.
en: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, I assure you that this poor widow has put in more than everyone whos been putting money in the treasury.

dag: Binnamdi so ku tooi sɔɣi Naawuni, dama binshɛɣukam dola palɔni o sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zaa ni ti yɛn kahigi ti bebu ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi so.
en: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma nambɔɣu zɔbu. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la kul guli ma.
en: Lord , do not hide your mercy from me. Let your love and loyalty always protect me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu, N lo nia ni n kpihim ninsalinim zaa birili, dama bɛna n-chɛ ka tuumbiɛri pali dunia ŋɔ ni. Nyama, n ni kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: So God said to Noah, Everyone has filled the earth with anger and violence. So I will destroy all living things. I will remove them from the earth.

dag: Amaa n daa ŋmanila piɛ tarim so bɛ ni zaŋ chaŋ ni bɛ ti kɔrigi. N daa bi baŋ ni mani ka bɛ lɔri nia biɛɣu maa yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ŋmaai tia maa mini di wala luhi. Chɛliya ka ti yih o dunia ni, ka so ku lan teeg o yuli yɛla.
en: Before he showed me this, I was like a gentle lamb waiting to be butchered. I did not understand that they were against me. They were saying this about me: Let us destroy the tree and its fruit! Let us kill him! Then people will forget him.

dag: Karimbaannim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa, bɛ ni ti siɣisi ba; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: Proud people will stop being proud. They will bow down to the ground with shame, and only the Lord will still stand high.

dag: Nyama, m min a zaa nyɛla yim Naawuni sani. Taŋkpaɣu ka o daa zaŋ nam man gba.
en: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mal alaafee ka lan yuui dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: so that all may go well with you, and you may live a long time in the land.

dag: Naa, n tɛhi ni n nyɛla zuɣusuŋlana n ni zan a tooni zuŋɔ ni n tɔɣisi chihi mmaŋ noli Yɛhudianim ni fiɣisiri ma yɛl shɛŋa zaa zuɣu la.
en: King Agrippa, I consider myself especially fortunate that I stand before you today as I offer my defense concerning all the accusations the Jews have brought against me.

dag: Ka Musa mini Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, chɛliya vuri ka wum, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi leei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba.
en: Moses and the Levite priests spoke to all the Israelites. Moses said, Be quiet and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.

dag: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ yi mini tiŋ shɛŋa din wɔɣa ni taba, ka pa zuliya shɛb bɛn be kpe ŋɔ tinsi la nima.
en: Thats what you must do to all the cities that are located far away from you—specifically, those cities that dont belong to these nations here.

dag: Di tamya saamba saani niŋbu yɛla, dama shɛb daa niŋdi saani lala hal ti niŋ malaikanim saani ka bi baŋ ni malaikanim m-bala.
en: Always remember to help people by welcoming them into your home. Some people have done that and have helped angels without knowing it.

dag: Miriya ka yi di binshɛŋa din chihiri dibu.
en: Dont eat any detestable thing.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti yɛl ti, Guhimiya hal ka ti ti ka yi sanna, di saha ti ni kpalim ʒe nimaani ka ku lan chaŋ bɛ sani.
en: If they say to us, Stay there until we get to you, then well stay where we are and wont go up to them.

dag: Ŋun daa pah ayɔbu n-su gol so ŋun pah ayɔbu ni n-daa nyɛ Ira. O daa nyɛla Ikɛsh ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa nir la bia; ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The sixth for the sixth month was Ira the Tekoite Ikkeshs son. His division numbered .

dag: Aduna mini Musa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛba saha shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli zuɣu la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: When the Lord talked with Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Cham ti bo tiŋgul zali, ka yɛl o ni o nini yi nya shɛlikam, ŋun yɛlima.
en: The Lord said to me, Go find someone to guard this city. He must report whatever he sees.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mal li ka di be kasi zaa, ka binshɛlikam din ti shihi li ni niŋ kasi.
en: Make them holy so that they may be perfectly holy. Whatever touches them will become holy.

dag: Ka Shupim mini Hupim daa nyɛ Iri bidibisi, ka Hushim mi daa nyɛ Ahɛr bidibiga.
en: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim.

dag: Yi kul lɔrila nia biɛri sahakam, ka jiɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu; ka niŋdi yomyom chani ti kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Yi yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, yi saɣindimi bahi.
en: Their feet run to evil; they rush to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of malice; desolation and destruction litter their highways.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayɔbu yuya ni pa kuɣ yini zuɣu, ka niriba ayɔbu la mi yuya pa kuɣ din la zuɣu, ka a ti chɛ ka di ti doli bɛ kpamli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Write six names on one jewel and six names on the other jewel. Write the names in order, from the oldest son to the youngest.

dag: N Duuma Yisa zuɣu, m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni binshɛɣ kani m-mali daɣiri dimaŋmaŋ puuni, amaa so yi tɛhi ni binshɛli mali daɣiri, o sani di shiri mali daɣiri.
en: My union with the Lord Jesus makes me certain that no food is of itself ritually unclean; but if you believe that some food is unclean, then it becomes unclean for you.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛligu daa maan chaŋ tooni, ka nyaandoliba maa kalinli daa zooi pahi Jɛrusalɛm puuni hal ka maligumaaniba pam gba daa niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: And so the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew larger and larger, and a great number of priests accepted the faith.

dag: Dunianim zaa ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋla Yawɛ yuli booni ya, ka bɛ ti zɔri ya.
en: All the earths peoples will see that you are called by the LORDs name, and they will be in awe of you.

dag: N naba kul ʒiɛla luɣ pasi shee; ka n kul ni paɣiri nyin Yawɛ jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni.
en: I am safe from all dangers; in the assembly of his people I praise the Lord .

dag: ka zaŋ suhudoo lahibal suŋ molo molibu leei namdanim piri.
en: and as your shoes the readiness to announce the Good News of peace.

dag: Amaa n ni lan chɛ ka bɛ nya tibbu mini alaafee, ka tib ba, ka kahigi tɔŋsim pam mini binshɛŋa din ni taɣi ba barina ni wuhi ba.
en: But then I will heal the people in that city. I will let them enjoy peace and safety.

dag: A ni ku bɛ zuliya bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yihi bɛ bihi ninsalinim ni.
en: None of their descendants will survive; the king will kill them all.

dag: Yi daa nya n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la mini n ni daa zaŋ ya tam tɔra kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ sanna la.
en: You saw what I, the Lord , did to the Egyptians and how I carried you as an eagle carries her young on her wings, and brought you here to me.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag zaɣ nɛɔŋ, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba maa zaa.
en: Every Amalekite was killed except King Agag.

dag: Ka o daa lu bɛ zuɣu ŋ-ŋmɛri kabiri bɛ sakpuri mini bɛ gbalipina n-daa niŋ lala ku ba pam. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Ɛtam ti kpe m-be tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: Samson attacked the Philistines and killed many of them. Then he went and stayed in a cave in a place named the Rock of Etam.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: Hal ŋunkam jɛri suli niŋd o kpee gba ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee; ka ŋunkam tu o kpee, Ninvuɣ fini ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee; ka ŋunkam mi bol o kpee, Jɛr yoli ni ti be buɣim ni kpɛbu barina ni.
en: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa gbaai Sɔstɛniiz ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la m-bu o saria karibu duu maa dunol ni. Ka Gallio bi gbiligi lihi ba gba.
en: but everyone seized Sosthenes, the synagogue leader, and gave him a beating in the presence of the governor. None of this mattered to Gallio.

dag: Ka yi zaa daa ka n sanna ti yɛli, Chɛ ka ti tim niriba ka bɛ daŋ ti tooni chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti, ka ʒi lahibali labina ti yɛli ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa ni ti ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: But all of you came to me and said, Lets send some men to look at the land first. They can spy out the land and come back and tell us the way we should go and which cities we will come to.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa piig o Bia n-tuui tim o la yi sanna ni o ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka taɣi yi zaa biɛhigu n-yihi ya yi tuumbiɛri ni.
en: God has sent his special servant Jesus. He sent him to you first. He sent him to bless you by causing each of you to turn away from your evil ways.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili azichi biɛhigu shee la n-tim ti ti Asiria naa pini.
en: And Ahaz took the silver and the gold that was in the LORDs temple and in the palace treasuries, and sent a gift to Assyrias king.

dag: Zuliya kam buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima, ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: The gods of the nations are made of silver and gold; they are formed by human hands.

dag: Ka o daa kpab litaafi maa zaŋ li labisi ti jɛmbu duu maa sɔŋda so ŋun ʒe nimaani ka naanyi ʒini. Ka bɛnkam daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni kpaai bɛ nina kpa o.
en: Jesus rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. All the people in the synagogue had their eyes fixed on him.

dag: Ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li? Bɛ daa zɔrila niriba, dama sokam zaa daa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: On the other hand, these people think that John was a prophet. So we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. They were afraid of the crowd.

dag: Ka Jɛfita nin ni daa kul nya o bia maa, o dii darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, m bia! A chɛ ka n suhu saɣim. A leei ŋun ti ma nandahima; dama m pun yaai n noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, ka ku tooi lan yi di nyaaŋa.
en: Oh no! Jephthah cried. Then he tore his clothes in sorrow and said to his daughter, I made a sacred promise to the Lord , and I must keep it. Your coming out to meet me has broken my heart.

dag: N yura, kamina ka ti yi kpaŋa nti gbɛri tiŋkpansi.
en: Come, darling, let's go out to the countryside and spend the night in the villages.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni, yin di mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ din ka gbinni kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ zuɣu ka Naawuni ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: And when you pray, dont be like the people who dont know God. They say the same things again and again. They think that if they say it enough, their god will hear them.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn be dahima biɛhigu Ziɔn zuɣu. Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be luɣ viɛlli shee Samaria Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ninvuɣ kara bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni kani shɛb sanna nti bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: Doom to those resting comfortably in Zion and those trusting in Mount Samaria, the chiefs of the nations, to whom the house of Israel comes!.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ ni mali wun shɛŋa la be ya? Bɛ yi ni tooi tiligi ya, yin chɛliya ka bɛ kana ti tiligi ya yi muɣisigu saha, dama yinim Judanima, yi fɔntinsi ni kul galisi shɛm, lala ka yi wuna gba galisi.
en: Where are the gods that you made for yourselves? When you are in trouble, let them save you—if they can! Judah, you have as many gods as you have cities.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa paɣi Yawɛ zama maa zaa ninni ka yɛli, Ti paɣiri nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yab Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Then David blessed the LORD before the whole assembly: Blessed are you, LORD, God of our ancestor Israel, forever and always.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa bahi noli ka bɛ mali duri maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka n daa labisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lahi mini chi ni kawana sara ni tulaale zim la niŋ di ni.
en: I gave commands for the rooms to be made pure and clean. Then I put the Temple dishes and things, the grain offerings, and the incense back into the rooms.

dag: bee n-suh o galli, ka o gbaai nɔŋa ti o?.
en: Or would you give him a scorpion when he asks for an egg?.

dag: Dama hal mmaŋmaŋ ni kul ka yi sani maa zaa yoli, n suhu din be yi sani, ka m mali suhupiɛlli yi biɛrisuŋ mini yi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi ni niŋ Masia yɛda shɛm la polo.
en: because even though I am absent physically, Im with you in spirit. Im happy to see the discipline and stability of your faith in Christ.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and left during the night for Egypt.

dag: ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa ti ni tɛhiri ni di buchi bi yaɣ lala la nyɛla ti ni lihiri shɛŋa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din bi viɛl la, dina ka ti lee niŋdi din tu kamaata shɛli.
en: The parts of the body that we think are less honorable are the ones we honor the most. The private parts of our body that arent presentable are the ones that are given the most dignity.

dag: N ni mihi n ninni niŋ ba, bɛ ni daa kul tiligi buɣim dili ni maa, buɣim na kul ni bahi di ba. Ka n yi ti mihi n ninni niŋ ba, a ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will punish those people. But some of them will be like the sticks that dont burn completely. They will be punished, but they will not be destroyed completely. You will see that I punished them, and you will know that I am the Lord !.

dag: ka yɛli Yisa, Karimba, paɣ ŋɔ bela zina tumbu ni ka ti gbaag o.
en: they said to Jesus, Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of committing adultery.

dag: ni binshɛɣukam din mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa daa kpi.
en: Everything on earth that breathed died.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, chibimi gooni maa voli. N ni daa chibi gooni maa ka di niŋ voli.
en: God said, Make this hole bigger. And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.

dag: Ka chanya yɛtɔɣ yoya mini yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu ni asahi kpɛma niŋbu. Di zaa ŋɔ shɛli bi simdi niŋbu, amaa din simdi niŋbu nyɛla wumpaɣibo.
en: Nor is it fitting for you to use language which is obscene, profane, or vulgar. Rather you should give thanks to God.

dag: Ka zoya tiŋgban la ni kul nyɛ nyɔŋ la zaa yoli, yi ni tooi ŋma n-neei li ka di leei yi dini di piligu shee zaŋ ti kpa di tariga. Ka Keenannim maa ni kul mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi ka mali kpiɔŋ la zaa yoli, yi ni tooi kari ba.
en: The hill country will be yours. Even though it is a forest, you will clear it and take possession of it from one end to the other. As for the Canaanites, you will drive them out, even though they do have iron chariots and are a strong people.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ ni ni o chaŋ, ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa balim o ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ.
en: Jesus was preparing to leave in the boat. The man who was now free from the demons begged to go with him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu n-zaŋ o noli min o nina kpa bia maa noli ni o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o nuhi zuɣu; ka teeg omaŋ dolisi bia maa, ka o niŋgbuna piligi biibu.
en: Then he lay down on the boy, placing his mouth, eyes, and hands on the boy's mouth, eyes, and hands. As he lay stretched out over the boy, the boy's body started to get warm.

dag: N yur a zaligunim soli maa pam kaman n ni yuri azichi balibu kam shɛm.
en: I enjoy following your rules as much as others enjoy great riches.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa bi kpi n dɔɣibu saha? N ni daa yi m ma puli ni na maa ka daa dii kpi.
en: Why didnt I die when I was born? Why didnt I die as I came from my mothers womb?.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Naawuni ni ti kari niriba saria yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni tɔɣisi zuɣu;.
en: I tell you that people will have to answer on Judgment Day for every useless word they speak.

dag: Gbuɣima ŋum bahi bɛ zuɣu. Bɛ ŋumiya pam. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbani bahi yoli, ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: Like a lion the enemy has roared at Israel. They have destroyed your land. Your cities have been burned, and no one is left in them.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ba binshɛlikam n-ʒini di gali zuɣu, gali maa ni leei din be daɣiri ni.
en: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Bundan maa daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam.
en: The rich man had many cattle and sheep.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa chɛ ka Dauda lan lo o yurilim alikauli yaha, dama o daa yur o mi kaman omaŋmaŋ la.
en: Jonathan loved David as himself, and because of this love, he asked David to repeat this agreement for himself.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ m bia, wummi n noli n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ ni.
en: Now, my son, listen to me, to what Im telling you to do.

dag: Ka m mi ni ŋun piligi tuun suŋ ŋɔ yi ni maa ni tum li hal ti naai li ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: I am sure that the good work God began in you will continue until he completes it on the day when Jesus Christ comes again.

dag: ka me bimbini n-chɛ ka di kuɣa do m-pa tab zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga tam zoli ŋɔ zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi la mali sara zaŋ o pa Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli shɛli a ni daai luhi la dari zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim.
en: Build a well-constructed altar to the Lord your God on top of this mound. Then take the second bull and burn it whole as an offering, using for firewood the symbol of Asherah you have cut down.

dag: Suhuyiɣisilinim tahirila zabili na, amaa bɛn suhuri bi yiɣisiri yomyom goorila zabili.
en: A quick temper causes fights, but patience brings peace and calm.

dag: Bɛ ni yino ni daa nya ka o kɔŋ maa naai maa ka o ŋmaligi labiri ka duhir o yee paɣiri Naawuni m-mal.
en: When one of them discovered that he was healed, he came back, shouting praises to God.

dag: Dundombil ni dunɔdali samban ni, duri daa beni din nyɛ baansi duri. Yini daa bela nuzaa polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nudirigu polo, ka zaɣ yini mi ʒe nudirigu polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nuzaa polo.
en: There were two rooms in the inner courtyard. One was by the north gate facing south. The other room was by the south gate facing north.

dag: Mirimiya ma na ti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm. Piligu ni zaŋ kana, n na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni. N daa pun beni ka yɛlli ŋɔ na bi niŋ. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-zaŋ o shia niŋ n ni n-tim ma.
en: Now come close to me and hear what I say. From the beginning I have spoken openly and have always made my words come true.

dag: Bɛ kul tɔŋdimi bɛ soya ni sahakam. Bɛ ku tooi baŋ a ni kariti saria shɛm. Bɛ kul maanila bɛ dimnim ansarisi.
en: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.

dag: Dama yi mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi lo tab alikauli, ka bɛ ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, ka mal li, bɛ ni boli ya ka yi ti di di maligu bindira.
en: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.

dag: Aruna daa bela o kabɔɣili maa ni buri alikama, ka daa ti ŋmaligi lihi nya malaika maa, ka o bidibis anahi bɛn daa be o sani daa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: Ornan turned around and saw the king. His four sons who were with him hid themselves, but Ornan continued threshing wheat.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni dini ka yi lee bɔra: Yi bɔri ni n ʒila fiɛbiga ka yi sanna bee yi bɔri ni n ʒila yurilim mini tarimtali kana?.
en: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa zaa kalinli nyɛla tinsi pihinuayika ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: So you will give a total of cities to the Levites. You will also give them the land around those cities.

dag: Ti bemi kaman suhugarigunima, amaa ka lee kul mali suhupiɛlli. Ti bemi kaman faranima, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka niriba pam leeri bundaannima. Ti bemi kaman bɛn ka shɛli, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn su binshɛɣukam.
en: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.

dag: dama n ni ti tin ya yɛm ni noli ka yi dimnim ti ku tooi tɔɣisi luhi ya bee n-tooi garigi yi bɔhigu.
en: I will give you the wisdom to know what to say. None of your enemies will be able to oppose you or to say that you are wrong.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes. He didnt deviate from all the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit.

dag: ka Dauda yiɣisi zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti ku Filistianim kɔbisiyi, ka ŋmahi bɛ yokol gbana n-zaŋ di zaa ti ti naa din ni chɛ ka o leei naa deemba. Ka Sool daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: David and his men went and killed two hundred Philistines. He took their foreskins to the king and counted them all out to him, so that he might become his son-in-law. So Saul had to give his daughter Michal in marriage to David.

dag: N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Ijipti, ka Pɛlusiumnim ti nya suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka sanʒiɛɣu ti ʒe Tɛbis n-da di goma luhi, ka Mɛmfisinim dimnim ti liri ba wuntaŋ ni.
en: I will set fire to Egypt, and Pelusium will be in agony. The walls of Thebes will be broken down, and the city will be flooded.

dag: saha shɛli zaa n ni na kul vuhira, ka Naawuni shia be n nyɛvoya ni ŋɔ.
en: and while he gives me breath.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ ninsal maa niŋ Idɛn puu maa ni ni o kɔr li, ka yuuni li.
en: The Lord God put the man in the Garden of Eden to work the soil and take care of the garden.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa ni m-pahila kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa Musa ni daa zaŋ niŋ di ni Sinai Zoli gbini luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: There was nothing inside the Covenant Box except the two stone tablets which Moses had placed there at Mount Sinai, when the Lord made a covenant with the people of Israel as they were coming from Egypt.

dag: Ka doo maa yi taali ni, amaa ka paɣ maa ŋun taali ʒi o zuɣu.
en: The husband will not be guilty of doing anything wrong, but the woman will suffer if she has sinned.

dag: Bɛ ni so ti ku lan wuh o kpee bee n-yɛl o kpee, Baŋmi Yawɛ. Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ zaa ni ti baŋ ma, bibihi zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa. Dama n ni kpihim bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: They will no longer need to teach each other to say, Know the LORD! because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD; for I will forgive their wrongdoing and never again remember their sins.

dag: Yawɛ je tuumbiɛtumdiba. O bɔri ni o kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: but he opposes those who do evil, so that when they die, they are soon forgotten.

dag: Nyin naa, a yi shiri ni niŋ ma nirilim ka ti ma n ni bɔri shɛli, dindina m bɔri ni a mini Haman sa labina biɛɣuni nti di ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni sa yɛn niŋ zali ya. Yi yi sa kana, n sa ni yɛl a n ni bɔri shɛli maa.
en: If the king is pleased with me and thinks it good to give me what I ask for, let the king and Haman come tomorrow. I will prepare another party for them. Then I will tell what I really want.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ yɛndan ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu Yisa Masia zuɣu! Ami!.
en: Glory forever to the only wise God through Jesus Christ. Amen.

dag: Jɔn saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛn suhuri ye alizanda nam ni kpɛbu zuɣu kul kabirimi chani ni bɛ ti zaŋ kpiɔŋ kpe di ni.
en: Since the time John the Baptizer came until now, Gods kingdom has been going forward strongly. And people have been trying to take control of it by force.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa ka o sanna, ka o leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka Otiniɛl daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Otiniɛl nyaŋ o. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: The LORDs spirit was in Othniel, and he led Israel. When he marched out for war, the LORD handed over Arams King Cushan-rishathaim. Othniel overpowered Cushan-rishathaim.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛli maligumaana Hilikia mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Mikaya bia Akibɔr ni gbaŋŋmara Shafan ni naa kpambal Asaaya.
en: and gave the following order to Hilkiah the priest, to Ahikam son of Shaphan, to Achbor son of Micaiah, to Shaphan, the court secretary, and to Asaiah, the king's attendant:.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Sabimiya ni doo ŋɔ bi dɔɣi bihi, do so ŋun kul ku di nasara o nyɛvili ni. Dama o bihi ni so ti ku nya soli n-ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee n-lan su Judanim yaha.
en: This man is condemned to lose his children, to be a man who will never succeed. He will have no descendants who will rule in Judah as David's successors. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a mini Jɛsi bia ŋɔ gbiri ma zamba bɔɣa? Bɔzuɣu ka a daa ti o bindirigu ka ti o takɔbi ka lan bɔhi Naawuni n-nya o yɛla ti o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yiɣisi lu n zuɣu n-sɔɣi do n-gu ma kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Saul said to him, Why have you conspired against me—you with Jesses son—giving him food and a sword and questioning God for him so that he is now against me, waiting in ambush, which is what has happened today.

dag: Daniɛl ni daa baŋ ni naa dih o nuu zaligu gbɔŋ maa zuɣu maa, ka o daa kul o yiŋa. O yiŋ zuɣusaa duu takɔro daa yoori bahila Jɛrusalɛm polo. Ka o daa gbaani suhir o Naawuni, ka paɣir o siɣimsiɣim buta dahin yini puuni kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm.
en: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi Samuɛl yɛligu maa wumbu ka yɛli, Aai! Ti bɔri ni ti mali naa ka o su ti.
en: But the people refused to listen to Samuel and said, No! There must be a king over us.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri maa bi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni, amaa ka nyini lee tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: If you do warn them, and they keep sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.

dag: Lɛvinim zuɣulaannima n-daa nyɛ: Hashabia mini Shɛrɛbia ni Kadimiɛl bia Jɛshua mini bɛ taba bɛn daa ʒe n-tuhi ba n-yiini wumpaɣibo yila ka puhiri Naawuni kaman Dauda ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir la ni daa wuhi ba shɛm.
en: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa wuhirila o Bia yɛla: Zaŋ chaŋ o daadamtali polo, bɛ daa dɔɣ o la Naa Dauda zuliya ni;.
en: The Good News is about Gods Son, Jesus Christ our Lord. As a human, he was born from the family of David, but through the Holy Spirit he was shown to be Gods powerful Son when he was raised from death.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o, yɛli.
en: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Yawɛ lan yɛli ma, Cham Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti yihi n ni daa yɛl a ni a zaŋ jinjɛŋŋma shɛli ti sɔɣi nimaani la na.
en: Many days later the Lord said to me, Now, Jeremiah, go to Perath. Get the loincloth that I told you to hide there.

dag: Dama n suhuyiɣisili maa dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka ni di hal ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Di saɣindi dunia mini di binshɛɣukam, ka niŋdi buɣim nyɔri zoya tanzahi.
en: My anger will burn like a fire, burning down to the deepest grave, burning the earth and all it produces, burning deep down below the mountains.

dag: O daa zaŋ salima alali mali teebuli maa zuɣu duɣuri mini di parantɛnima ni di lahi din ni tuɣindi tulaale zim ni pipi shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain.
en: He made the containers of pure gold that were to be on the table: its plates, dishes, bowls, and jars for pouring drink offerings.

dag: Bɛ chanila gbala ni yuŋ ti buɣiri kpiimba baɣiri, ka ŋubiri kuruchunim nimdi; ka piɛbiri buɣa maligu nimdi bim.
en: At night they go to caves and tombs to consult the spirits of the dead. They eat pork and drink broth made from meat offered in pagan sacrifices.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ alimug dari maa sa n-tuɣi tab gili Yawɛ jɛmbu duu min o yil la, ka zaŋ shɛli m-mali mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima n-ti baansi; ka so m-bi lan nya alimug dari maa tatabo hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The king used the almug wood to make parapets for the LORDs temple and for the royal palace as well as lyres and harps for the musicians. To this day, that much almug wood hasnt come into or been seen in Israel.

dag: Nyini n-daa wuhi shihira mini alahiziba tuma Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka na kul wuhiri li hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini daadamnim zaa sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a zali yuli hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Long ago you performed miracles and wonders in Egypt, and you have continued to perform them to this day, both in Israel and among all the other nations, so that you are now known everywhere.

dag: Yawɛ, saɣisim ma, amaa saɣisim ma kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni, di yi pa lala n ni bahi yoli.
en: Correct your people, Lord , but do not be too hard on us or punish us when you are angry; that would be the end of us.

dag: Bɛ pun zaŋ baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba n-ka n sanna ni bɛ ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ di gbinni.
en: Neither my advisors nor the men who talk with the spirits of the dead could read this writing or tell me what it means.

dag: Man gba ni kpahi n nuhi, ka tum n suhuyiɣisili tuma. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then I will stop being angry, and I will clap my hands in victory. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani m-pah o zuɣu.
en: If he will do these things, all the people of the world will know that the Lord is the only true God.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, N tum taali, amaa di zaa yoli, tim ma jilima n kpamba ŋɔ mini Izraɛlnim zaa tooni, ka chɛ ka m min a labi ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma Naawuni maa.
en: I have sinned, Saul replied. But at least show me respect in front of the leaders of my people and all of Israel. Go back with me so that I can worship the Lord your God.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti? Di tam ti wahala dibu mini ti nahiŋgu ŋɔ yɛla!.
en: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.

dag: ka bɛ mabih ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bihi ka kpi; di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: None of the seven left any children. Finally, the woman died.

dag: Ka o daa ti maani Izraɛlnima ansarisi, ka Dauda Mabia Shimia bia Jɔnatan daa ku o.
en: So when that man made fun of Israel, Jonathan killed him. Jonathan was Shimeas son. Shimea was Davids brother.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, tinzun yɛligu balibu paai shɛm be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di shɛli mi kani ka bi mali gbinni.
en: There are many different languages in this world, and all of them make sense.

dag: Nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali ni di ti tum tuma o kalinsi nyaaŋa, di bi tumdi tuma naɣila o ti shiri kpimi;.
en: When there is a will, you need to confirm the death of the one who made the will.

dag: Amaa a halibiɛɣu min a tipawumli zuɣu chɛ ka a bɔri Naawuni suhuyiɣisili zaani gur amaŋ zaadali din nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari saria din tuhi dahin shɛl la.
en: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.

dag: Ka Amazia nam yiko ni daa ti ba jila zaa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku o kpambal shɛb bɛn daa ku o ba la.
en: At the time that Amaziah had strong control of the kingdom, he killed the officers who had killed his father.

dag: Buɣisim nya Yawɛ ni viɛli shɛm; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo nti sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ dɔɣ ma mi ni tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni daa zali m pua saha shɛli ka m pun nyɛ alahichilana.
en: Yes, I was born in guilt, in sin, from the moment my mother conceived me.

dag: Ka o daa ti zaŋ bɛ farigu tahi ti yo Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn. Naa Ɛgilɔn daa nyɛla ninvuɣ karili.
en: Then he took the gifts to Eglon, who was a very fat man.

dag: Di saha ka shɛb dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka pɔb o nina ka ŋmɛr o ka yɛra, Wuhim ti a daanabitali ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa gba ŋmɛr o.
en: Some of the people there spit at him. They covered his eyes and hit him with their fists. They said, Be a prophet and tell us who hit you! Then the guards led Jesus away and beat him.

dag: Ka yi mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.

dag: N labirila a sanna pumpɔŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n ni na be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ, ni n suhupiɛlli pali bɛ suhuri ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋdila bɛn niŋdi ya viɛnyɛliŋga zaɣ viɛlli, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba niŋdila lala.
en: If you do good only to those who do good to you, should you get any special praise for doing that? No, even sinners do that!.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ku yi tibidarigibo ni, ka ʒirilan mi ni kpi.
en: False witnesses wont go unpunished, and liars will perish.

dag: A ni bi lan teeg a bilim ni yɛla, amaa ka niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni labis a tuma maa ʒil a. Pa pagɔrisigu tuma ka a daa tum gar a ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa la zaa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You made me furious by doing all these disgusting things and by forgetting how I took care of you when you were young. Then you made things worse by acting like a prostitute. You must be punished! I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ Pita niŋ duu, amaa ka cheechi daa kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo o zuɣu.
en: So Peter was kept in jail, but the church was constantly praying to God for him.

dag: Ka di simdi ni cheechi buɣisi ba pɔi, ka bɛ biɛhigu yi wuhi ni bɛ ka galimi, ka cheechi naanyi chɛ ka bɛ tum cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma.
en: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.

dag: N niriba, zomiya yi di ni. Tiligimiya yi nyɛviya Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ ni.
en: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!.

dag: N yi zo n-du zuɣusaa, a be nimaani, ka n yi yɛrigi m bindoo sɔŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a be nimaani.
en: If I go up to heaven, you will be there. If I go down to the place of death, you will be there.

dag: Wɔr ʒiɛhi n-daa vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din daŋ tooni, ka wɔr sabila vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi.
en: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;.

dag: Zabili piligu ŋmanila bɛ ni yi cheei kom bahi la, dinzuɣu zom yi zabili ni ka di na bi piligi.
en: The start of an argument is like a small leak in a dam. Stop it before a big fight breaks out.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni bi niŋ din tuhi? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: Shall we say, then, that God is unjust? Not at all.

dag: O bom ŋman ʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋman bih ayi na nti ti maligumaana Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni daba anii dali.
en: Then on the eighth day, you must bring two doves or two young pigeons and give them to the priest at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim ni daa tuui lu la, di wuhiri ni bɛ daa lumi zaa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Amaa bɛ biriginsim zuɣu ka tiliginsim paai bɛn pa Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zab nyuli.
en: I ask, then: When the Jews stumbled, did they fall to their ruin? By no means! Because they sinned, salvation has come to the Gentiles, to make the Jews jealous of them.

dag: Yawɛ, ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari hal ni bɔ saha? Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari maa hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: Lord , how long will the wicked have their fun? How much longer?.

dag: Yawɛ, di tam Ɛdomnim ni daa yɛli shɛm Jɛrusalɛm lubu dal la yɛla. Bɛ daa kul yɛrimi, Daamiya li luhi! Daamiya li luhi zaa.
en: Lord , be sure to punish the Edomites for what they did when Jerusalem was captured. They shouted, Destroy its buildings! Pull them down to the ground.

dag: Inok ni daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai yuun kɔbisita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After that, Enoch lived in fellowship with God for years and had other children.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Itam bidibisi: Jɛziriil mini Ishima ni Idibash. Bɛ tizɔpaɣ yuli n-daa booni Hazɛlɛlipɔni.
en: Etams sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And they had a sister named Hazzelelponi.

dag: Ti ni daa doli ti niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa chɛ ka ti kɔr biɛri yiɣisi, ka ti tumdi tuun shɛŋa din nyɛ kum dini ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣili kam ni.
en: For when we lived according to our human nature, the sinful desires stirred up by the Law were at work in our bodies, and all we did ended in death.

dag: Ka di yi kahigi wuhi bɛn ʒiya maa ni so ni o wuhi shɛli, yin chɛliya ka ŋun tuui tɔɣisirila fo;.
en: But if someone sitting in the meeting receives a message from God, the one who is speaking should stop.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namda. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Mourn in silence and don't show that you are grieving. Don't remove your turban or take off your sandals; don't cover your face to show your sorrow, or eat the food that mourners eat.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Ɛkan, M bia, paɣimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka ti o jilima, ka yɛli ma a ni tum tuun shɛli, ka di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: Joshua said to him, My son, tell the truth here before the Lord , the God of Israel, and confess. Tell me now what you have done. Don't try to hide it from me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu n ni bɔr a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: For the sake of the LORD our Gods house I will pray for your good.
