dag: Din pahi, o daa lan me fɔntinsi zali Juda zoya ni, ka daa lan me yiya mini du wɔɣila n-zali yɔɣu puuni, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: He also built towns in the hill country of Judah. He built fortresses and towers in the forests.

dag: n yɛri ya la zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi zaa ni ti kpi, yi ti ku yuui yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nti dee li su maa ni.
en: you will be destroyed—I warn you here and now. You will not live long in that land across the Jordan that you are about to occupy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ, ka di nyɛ mita anu. Ka o daa buɣisi foliŋga din kpe dunɔdali maa ni, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu ni pirigili.
en: The man measured the entrance to the gateway. It was cubits wide and cubits long.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni la ha kul kpalim be yi suhuri ni. Yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni maa ha yi kul kpalim be yi ni, dindina yi gba ni be Bia maa min o Ba Naawuni ni.
en: Be sure, then, to keep in your hearts the message you heard from the beginning. If you keep that message, then you will always live in union with the Son and the Father.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa daa vaai yiɣisi tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm kɔbil shɛli din daa do di dunol shee maa nti tooi di kom na ti ti Dauda. Amaa ka o zaɣisi li nyubu, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Naawuni.
en: So the Three Heroes fought their way through the Philistine army and got some water from the well near the city gate in Bethlehem. They took it to David, but he refused to drink it. He poured it on the ground as an offering to the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɔn nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Jɔn ti sɔɣi, ka chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: Johns followers came and got his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus what happened.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani n-galisi pam la daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu di saha maa. Niriba maa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni Lɛbohamat dunol la shee zaŋ hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ la shee.
en: There at the Temple, Solomon and all the people of Israel celebrated the Festival of Shelters for seven days. There was a huge crowd of people from as far away as Hamath Pass in the north and the Egyptian border in the south.

dag: Amaa Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi ka kpi. O daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi ko. Ka Kish ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni nir la bidibis daa kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi maa.
en: but Eleazar died without having any sons, only daughters. His daughters married their cousins, the sons of Kish.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa guhi hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman Samuɛl ni daa zal o shɛm, amaa ka Samuɛl daa na bi ka Giligal na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sool sani maa ti zɔri ka chɛr o.
en: and they were starting to run off and leave him. Saul waited there seven days, just as Samuel had ordered him to do, but Samuel did not come.

dag: Muɣisigu nyabu dali, o ni zaŋ ma sɔɣ o sɔɣisili shee, o ni zaŋ o tanti pili ma; ka zaŋ ma tam tampin shɛli din du zuɣu.
en: In times of trouble he will shelter me; he will keep me safe in his Temple and make me secure on a high rock.

dag: Tɔbbihi bɛn daa doya maa ni daa wum li, bɛ yɛlimi, Zimiri lo nia biɛɣu n-ku naa. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Omri ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la n-leei Izraɛl naa sansani maa ni dindali maa.
en: Omri was the commander of the army of Israel. The men in the camp heard that Zimri had made secret plans against the king and killed him. So in the camp all the soldiers made Omri the new king.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti lan yɛli Hiburunim maa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba bɛn yuya daa booni Shifira mini Pua.
en: The king of Egypt spoke to two Hebrew midwives named Shiphrah and Puah.

dag: Yisa min o ni daa yur o nyaandol so la n-daa ʒi n-tab taba.
en: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal.

dag: M banima mini m mabihi, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zabi mmaŋ zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: My fellow Jews, listen to me as I make my defense before you.

dag: Ibram daa mali buni pam. O daa mali biŋkɔbiri mini anzinfa ni salima.
en: Abram was a very rich man, with sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as silver and gold.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa ni lɔris anahi ni daa malila dundombihi, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaanu. Diba anahi maa zaa daa saɣila taba.
en: In all four corners of the courtyard, these courtyards were constructed to handle smoke. All four were the same size, sixty feet long by forty-five feet wide.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba kana ti mali Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ mali neen shɛŋa zaa;.
en: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be zilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: David calls the Messiah Lord. So how can he be Davids son.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ba daa chaŋ ti kpe fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus and his disciples went to the town of Capernaum. Then on the next Sabbath he went into the synagogue and started teaching.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiy o, A dabili Yaakubu n-su ba, ka zaŋ ba ti ti ni ti zaŋ ba na ti ti nyini n-dan Iso pini, ka din pahi nyɛla, omaŋmaŋ doli ti nyaaŋa na. .
en: then you should answer, These animals belong to your servant Jacob. He sent them as a gift to you, my master Esau. And he also is coming behind us.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ti lan laɣim ka Yisa sanna, ka daa ti lan ka bindirigu din ni di, ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba.
en: In those days there was another large crowd with nothing to eat. Jesus called his disciples and told them.

dag: N zaŋdi buni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ma, ka chɛ ka bɛ daazichi duri paana.
en: to provide for those who love me and to fill up their treasuries.

dag: ka yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun yu n dan maa yurilim maŋli din ka kpee, ka ʒe o yim ŋɔ. Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi polo, Yawɛ kul zaŋ ma mi na ti kpɛhi n dan maa dɔɣiriba yiŋa.
en: He said, Praise the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has faithfully kept his promise to my master. The Lord has led me straight to my master's relatives.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, N ni pun sab shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: Pilate answered, I will not change what I have written.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni yi ti bi filim di dabisa maa, so ti ku tiligi, amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda la zuɣu ka o ni ti filim di dabisa maa.
en: But God has already reduced the number of days; had he not done so, nobody would survive. For the sake of his chosen people, however, God will reduce the days.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul zɔri kpari booli polo ni di chɛ ka n nya Naawuni ni boli ti boligu shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: So I run straight toward the goal in order to win the prize, which is God's call through Christ Jesus to the life above.

dag: Saɣimi ti Naawuni, ka tim sandaani niŋ o, ka bin viɛla lan ka a sanna.
en: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di niŋ kamaata ni yi teei ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuumba ni daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zal la yɛla.
en: But remember, my friends, what you were told in the past by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: n ni chɛ ka a nam kul beni sahakam kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli n-yɛli ni so kul ku kɔŋ o daŋ ni ŋun ni di nam su Izraɛlnim la.
en: then I will establish your royal throne, just as I promised your father David: You will never fail to have a successor ruling in Israel.

dag: Ti luya zaa; ti kul teei dola taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banim mi di yihiriya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka bɛ ti yihi tahima.
en: Fathers, dont upset your children. If you are too hard to please, they might want to stop trying.

dag: Di saha ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli. Ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka tampima bɔɣi.
en: When Jesus died, the curtain in the Temple was torn into two pieces. The tear started at the top and tore all the way to the bottom. Also, the earth shook and rocks were broken.

dag: Dinzuɣu dahin yini ka alɔbo balibu paai shɛm ni ti lu o zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: Dɔro mini fabila ni kum. Ka buɣim ni ti di o, dama ŋun yɛn kar o saria lala maa n-nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: This is why her plagues will come in a single day—deadly disease, grief, and hunger. She will be consumed by fire because the Lord God who judges her is powerful.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lan da puri tiŋgbɔn shɛli bɛ ni yɛra, Di leela dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri lan ka di ni, bɛ zaŋ li niŋla Kalidianim nuu ni la.
en: Fields will be bought in this land, a land you have said is bleak and uninhabited and in the possession of the Babylonians.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ ŋun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Therefore, my people will know my name on that day; Im the one who promises it; Im here.

dag: Ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri nazuɣuri mini bɛn su fukumsi din ni chɛ ka ti be ni alaafee, ka mali suhudoo n-niŋdi din luri Naawuni sizuura ka tumdi din tuhi daadamnim ninni;.
en: Pray for kings and everyone who is in authority so that we can live a quiet and peaceful life in complete godliness and dignity.

dag: O daa zaŋla o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ ti gbaai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ o zuɣu kpa zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la polo.
en: When Jacob crossed the Euphrates River and headed for the hill country of Gilead, he took with him everything he owned.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛnkam daa yi mi a. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie pam, ka a ku lan beni yaha. .
en: Everyone among the peoples who knows you will be appalled because of you. You will become a terror. From that time on, you will be nothing.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋuni n-lee ku zo a ka tibig a yuli? Dama a ko m-be kasi. Zuliya kam ni kana nti jɛm a, dama a wuntia saria karibu yi palo.
en: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba sani ti yɛli ba, Ti pola pɔri ni shee ti ku Pool, di yi pa lala ti ku di shɛli.
en: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, We have solemnly promised to eat nothing until we have killed Paul.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim ka Shunɛm na nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani; ka Sool gba daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ mi ti bɛ suɣa do Gilibɔa.
en: The Philistines prepared for war. They came to Shunem and made their camp at that place. Saul gathered all the Israelites together and made his camp at Gilboa.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa mirig o nina kpa Hazaɛl n-kul lihir o hal ka vi ti gbaag o. Ka Ilaisha kumda.
en: Elisha began to stare. He stared for an embarrassingly long time. Then the man of God began to cry.

dag: Bɛ ni ti saɣim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din be Avɛn, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim daalahichi la. Ka gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ti bili di maligu bimbina maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti yɛli zoya, Limsimiya ti. Ka yɛli daboya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na.
en: The sin of Israel, the shrines of Aven will be torn down. Thorn and thistle will sprout up on their altars. They will say to the mountains, Cover us, to the hills, Fall on us.

dag: Tim ma baŋsim, ka n gbib a zaligu, ka dol li ni n suhu zaa.
en: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.

dag: Ka Bɛtishɛmɛshi ninvuɣ shɛba daa lihi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa puuni, ka o daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ pisopɔin zaa. Ka niriba daa kum bɛ zuɣu, Yawɛ ni daa ku ba pam shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Some of the men of Beth-Shemesh looked inside the sacred chest, and the Lord God killed of them. This made the people of Beth-Shemesh very sad.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Ibram na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi yɛli ma ni o nyɛla a paɣa?.
en: Pharaoh called Abram and said to him, You have done a very bad thing to me! Why didnt you tell me Sarai was your wife?.

dag: Amaa o yi mali daŋa, ka di nyɛ dan titali, kaman o yi nyɛ napombara bee o yi nyɛ zoma, yin di zaŋy o mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But if an animal has something wrong with it—if it is crippled or blind or has something else wrong with it—then you must not sacrifice that animal to the Lord your God.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures say: Worship the Lord your God and serve only him! .

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ o yiko puuni. O yɛm puuni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ. O baŋsim puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: The Lord made the earth by his power; by his wisdom he created the world and stretched out the heavens.

dag: Di saha maa ka Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa la daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia biɛra, ka sabi gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi di zuɣu tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah had been sick, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.

dag: Asiba zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni bɛ pun kpi. Bɛ kul kpirimi zaa, ka bi mi di yɛla.
en: We may be alive in the morning, but die unnoticed before evening comes.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Mahili bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza mini Kish.
en: Meraris sons were Mahli and Mushi. Mahlis sons were Eleazar and Kish.

dag: Ti daa pun yɛli ya ni yi miri ka yi mali Yisa yuli ŋɔ yihiri waazu tiri niriba, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ka bahi zaŋ li moli gili Jɛrusalɛm zaa, ka bɔri ni yi zaŋ o kum zambu ʒil ti.
en: We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o ni daa zaŋ o nubil sabi sabbu shɛli pa kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa zuɣu la ti ma, ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa buɣim sunsuuni zoli la gbini laɣiŋgu dal la sabi pa di zuɣu.
en: The Lord gave me the two stone tablets. He wrote his commands on the stones with his finger. The Lord wrote everything he said to you from the fire when you were gathered together at the mountain.

dag: ka Ira ŋun daa nyɛ Jair nir la mi daa nyɛ Dauda maligumaana.
en: Ira from Jair was David's priest.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ daa karim Musa litaafi n-wuhi niriba maa, ka bɛ daa nya di ni luɣ shɛli din sabi yɛli ni di bi simdi ka bɛ chɛ ka Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali Naawuni niriba ni bɛ laɣiŋgu ni.
en: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.

dag: Yuuni kam o ma daa yi shɛrila binyɛr bila m-mali chani ti tir o saha shɛl o min o yidana daa yi ti chaŋ ni bɛ ti mali yuuniyuuni sara maa.
en: and the clothes his mother made for him. She brought new clothes every year, when she and her husband came to offer sacrifices at Shiloh.

dag: Sabimi ti Filadɛlfia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana, ka mali Naa Dauda saafɛbia, ka nyɛ ŋun ni yooi ka so ku tooi daai yo, ka ni yo ka so ku tooi yoo la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: These are the words of the one who is holy and true, who has the key of David. Whatever he opens, no one will shut; and whatever he shuts, no one opens.

dag: Saha shɛli ha a daa kana ti tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam, ka ti bi tɛhi ni a ni niŋ lala, ka zoya daa sɔhig a tooni.
en: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.

dag: amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun kul tumdila o maligumaanitali tuma, dama o kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: In contrast, he holds the office of priest permanently because he continues to serve forever.

dag: Bɛ ni ti sɔɣ o mi kaman bɛ ni sɔɣiri buŋ shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti vu o ti labi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdali tooni ha.
en: With the funeral honors of a donkey, he will be dragged away and thrown outside Jerusalem's gates.

dag: Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Iru mini Ɛla ni Naam; ka Ɛla mi bidibiga daa nyɛ Kɛnaz.
en: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋ ni nyini ni bahi yoli; a ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe a yim yoli.
en: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku la, n ni zaŋ li ti a, ka ni lan zaŋ li ti a zuliya a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: The land I gave to Abraham and to Isaac, I give to you; and I will give the land to your descendants after you.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul bɔrila duŋtaabo, amaa bɛ ni tim tumo ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana ka o lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Evil people seek only rebellion; a cruel messenger will be sent against them.

dag: Di saha ka Juda zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini Bɛnjamin zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni sokam bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni daa neei shɛb suhuri daa mali shili ni bɛ kuli nti lab me Yawɛ duu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then God caused many of his people to want to go to Jerusalem. These included the family leaders of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and Levites, and many others. They all prepared to go and rebuild the Lord s Temple.

dag: Amaa doo maa yi mali bidibiga ŋun nya o ba ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka ŋun bi tum lala.
en: But suppose this evil man has a son who sees his father do these things and refuses to act like him.

dag: Bipola kpiɔŋ n-nyɛ bɛ jilima, amaa ninkura mi zab piɛla n-nyɛ bɛ jilima.
en: We admire the strength of youth and respect the gray hair of age.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa chani gindi alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni m-be kaman tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o be la. Ka o mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn daa ti yɛn di alikauli maa fal la daa kul bela tantinim ni.
en: By faith he lived as a foreigner in the country that God had promised him. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who received the same promise from God.

dag: Bɛ ni bahi yoli yomyom n-chaŋ ti kpe luɣ shɛli din mali dabiɛm!.
en: They are instantly destroyed; they go down to a horrible end.

dag: Chuɣu maa puhi naai dali n-daa nyɛ chuɣu maa dabisi tital dali, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi zani kuhi yɛli, Kɔnyuri yi wum so, ŋun kam n sanna ti nyu.
en: On the last and most important day of the festival Jesus stood up and said in a loud voice, Whoever is thirsty should come to me, and.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka niriba maa kul be yiriŋ maa.
en: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tummi sara maligu shee mini sara maligu bimbini maa gbini tuma, ka di chɛ ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: You will perform the duties of the sanctuary and the altar. Then there will no longer be any anger against the Israelites.

dag: Ifriimnim ŋmanila ŋmani. Bɛ jɛrigiya zaa, ka ka yɛm. Bɛ boonila Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba, ka lan booni Asirianim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba.
en: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo n-wuhiri shihir kara, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: False christs and false prophets will appear, and they will offer great signs and wonders in order to deceive, if possible, even those whom God has chosen.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti lan deei Yawɛ noli, ka doli o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord .

dag: Ka di bi simdi ka yi chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni asiba. Ka shɛli yi guui zani hal ni biɛɣ asiba, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: You must not leave any of it until morning; if any is left over, it must be burned.

dag: Amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa n-yi beni pahi, di ni tooi mali jintɔriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Additional disputes can be resolved in a legal assembly.

dag: Ka mɔɣili maa kɔsoya ni kom ni nyɔni, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui; ka kaɣili mini kulimɔri ti kuui zaa.
en: All the rivers will smell very bad. The canals in Egypt will be dry, and the water will be gone. All the water plants will rot.

dag: Ɛlizafan bidibisi ni, Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi pah o zuɣu.
en: There were people from the tribe of Elizaphan. Shemaiah was their leader.

dag: Vinnyaɣinim ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma ni nimmoo ni nya buni din viɛla.
en: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.

dag: A ni nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa zaa, n ni zaŋ li ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam.
en: I will give you and your family all the land you can see. It will be theirs forever!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiligira ŋɔ, chɛ ka n nol ni yɛtɔɣa mini n suhu ni tɛha zaa nyɛ din tiɣi a nini.
en: May my words and thoughts please you. Lord , you are my Rock—the one who rescues me.

dag: Diribarilimlan nyɛla ŋun bɔri zabili, amaa ŋunkam niŋ Yawɛ naani ni tɔŋ.
en: Greedy people might sue you in court, but those who trust the Lord are rewarded.

dag: Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa na kul be o nyɛvil ni ka mal alaafee. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: They answered, Your servant our father is still alive and well. And again they bowed down to Joseph.

dag: O daa lan mali bidibis anu, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Hashuba mini Ohɛl ni Bɛrɛkia ni Hasadia ni Jushabihɛsɛd, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu.
en: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ti ni bo bin gbaliŋ shɛŋa zaa ni ti me jɛmbu duu n-ti a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din yi a nuu ni na, ka nyɛ a ni su shɛli.
en: Lord our God, we gathered all these things to build your Temple. We build it to honor your name. But all these things have come from you. Everything belongs to you.

dag: Ilaisha ni daa nya lala maa, ka o kuhi yɛli, M ba, m ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi mini di wɔribariba. Ka o daa bi lan nya Ilaija yaha. Di saha ka o daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu darigi tooi li buyi.
en: Elisha saw it, and shouted, My father! My father! The chariot of Israel and his horses! Elisha never saw Elijah again. Elisha grabbed his own clothes and tore them in two to show his sadness.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ galisiya pam, ka yi bɔri ni bɛ chɛ tuma bebɔ.
en: You people have become more numerous than the Egyptians. And now you want to stop working.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, dama bɛ daa bɔrimi ni bɛ nya o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: Some Jews there were watching Jesus closely. They were waiting to see if he would heal the man on a Sabbath day. They wanted to see Jesus do something wrong so that they could accuse him.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya, ka na ʒi n-leei so daba; ka di chaŋ wula ka a ti yɛli ni ti ni yi dabitim ni.
en: They answered, We are Abrahams descendants. And we have never been slaves. So why do you say that we will be free.

dag: ka daa ti yi Matana maa chaŋ Nahaliɛl n-daa ti lan yiɣisi Nahaliɛl maa chaŋ Bamɔt.
en: and from there they went on to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bo bindirigu, ka niŋ kom niŋ kom koligu ni n-zaŋ li nyaɣili Haga, ka zaŋ bia maa pah o n-chɛ ka o chaŋ. Ka Haga daa chaŋ ti be Bɛrishiiba yɔɣu ni dari ginda.
en: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and water and gave them to Hagar. She carried them and left with her boy. She left that place and wandered in the desert of Beersheba.

dag: Ka daɣila o kul yɛn kpaari ba mi ka chɛr o laŋa maa zaɣ kuŋ, ka kuri niriba ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Are they going to use their swords forever and keep on destroying nations without mercy?.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa ti yɛli Samsin, Niŋm ania wuhi ma din chɛ ka a mali kpiɔŋ pam maa, ka wuhi ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi nyaŋ a.
en: So Delilah said to Samson, Tell me why you are so strong. How could someone tie you up and make you helpless.

dag: Dama Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ti o niriba suhudoo, ka ni kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: David had said, The Lord , the God of Israel, has given peace to his people. And he has come to live in Jerusalem forever.

dag: Ka hal Izraɛlnim ni daa ti niŋ kpiɔŋ, bɛ daa bi kari Keenannim maa zaa, amaa ka daa naɣ lee muɣisiri ba mi ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: When the Israelites grew strong, they subjected the Canaanites to hard labor but didnt remove them.

dag: Musa daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses said to all the Israelites, This is what the Lord commanded:.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yɛn dolila Ar polo ti gari Mɔabnim tintariga.
en: Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border.

dag: dindina n ni pa n nina lihiri doo maa min o yiŋnima, ka ku o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol o jɛmdi Molɛk maa.
en: But I will be against these people and their families. I will separate them from their people. I will separate anyone who is unfaithful to me and chases after Molech.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri. Bɛ ti ku wum amiliya mini aŋgo kukoya Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm solɔri zuɣu. Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti zani dabari.
en: I will silence the sound of joy and delight as well as the voice of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, for the country will be reduced to a wasteland.

dag: Dinzuɣu di wum bɛ yɛligu maa, dama bɛ niriba gari ninvuɣ pihinahi do sol ni gu o. Bɛ laɣimmi po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ guhirila a nol ni yɛligu.
en: But please don't do what they say. More than men are going to attack Paul. They have made a vow not to eat or drink anything until they have killed him. Even now they are waiting to hear what you decide.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee pateesanim mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni di bimpindigu ni biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ din yɛn pa di zuɣusaa la ni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni pateesa la.
en: They will carry the fabric of the dwelling, the meeting tent with its covering, the outer covering of fine leather, the screen for the entrance of the meeting tent.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛl o, Ti ni doli solɔɣu maa gari; ka ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri yi nyu yi kom, ti ni yo di zuɣu; ti ni kul bɔri shɛli nyɛla yi chɛ ka ti kana ti gari.
en: The Israelites answered, We will travel along the main road. If our animals drink any of your water, we will pay you for it. We only want to walk through your country. We dont want to take it for ourselves.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Doliya Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu, ka miriya ka yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma soli.
en: What I say is this: let the Spirit direct your lives, and you will not satisfy the desires of the human nature.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔdɛkai daa lan lab ti ʒi nayili samban dunol maa ni yaha; ka Haman mi daa zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu tabil o nina ŋ-ŋmaligi kuli yomyom ni suhugarigu.
en: Afterwards, Mordecai returned to his duties in the king's palace, and Haman hurried home, hiding his face in shame.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan nya ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri ŋɔ bee n-tum buɣijɛmbo tuma. N ni tiligi n niriba yi nuu ni. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Therefore, you will no longer see empty visions or perform divinations. I will rescue my people from your clutches, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: O mi yi ŋme n-vuɣ o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nyini, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nyini maa zuɣu.
en: The same law applies if you knock out a slave's tooth—the slave goes free.

dag: bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ ni deei binshɛŋa talima labisi ti bindana, ka labisi bɛ ni zaŋ kpiɔŋ fa binshɛŋa ti dilana, ka doli zaligu shɛŋa din tiri nyɛvili, ka bi lan tumdi alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: For example, they need to return anything they have taken as security for a loan and anything they have stolen. Then if they stop doing evil and start obeying my Law, they will live.

dag: Naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa filim Judanim maa, dama o daa bi gbibi Judanim viɛnyɛla, ka daa bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim.
en: The Lord gave troubles to Judah because King Ahaz of Judah encouraged the people of Judah to sin. He was very unfaithful to the Lord .

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa lan nya tiŋ maa ni kpamba pia m-boli ba ni bɛ gba kamina ti ʒin nimaani. Bɛ ni daa ʒini.
en: Boaz also gathered ten of the elders of the city. He told them, Sit here! So they sat down.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ n nandahima puuni. N Naawuni ka n daa boli maa. Ka o daa be o jɛmbu duu puuni ka wum n kukoli; ka n kuhigu maa daa lu o tiba ni.
en: In my trouble I called to the Lord . Yes, I cried out to my God for help. There in his temple he heard my voice. He heard my cry for help.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba sani ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi gbaai o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: He went out and discussed with the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard how he could hand Jesus over to them.

dag: dama bɛ daa yurila salinim paɣibu gari Naawuni paɣibu.
en: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God.

dag: Rubin, nyini n-nyɛ m bituuli, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ; ka lan nyɛ n dɔtali tuuli bia. A nyɛla toondana ka mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Reuben, you are my oldest son, my strength and my first contender, superior in status and superior in might.

dag: Ninsal kam ŋun tumdi tuumbiɛri ni nya nahiŋgu mini wahala, Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya;.
en: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.

dag: Ka Maikil bia Zɛbadia daa nyɛ Shɛfatia daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pihinii daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Shephatiah, Zebadiah, Michaels son and with him men.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanania daa paai naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kabigi li.
en: Then the prophet Hananiah took hold of the yoke that was on the prophet Jeremiahs neck and broke it.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu din galisi. Di simdi ka ti lur o sizuura gari wuni kam.
en: because the LORD is great and so worthy of praise. He is awesome beyond all other gods.

dag: O yidana Yisifu daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ suŋ pam, dinzuɣu ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yihi li palɔni n-dihi Mariama vi, amaa ka daa lee lo ni o ku lan kpuɣ o.
en: Joseph was a man who always did what was right, but he did not want to disgrace Mary publicly; so he made plans to break the engagement privately.

dag: O daa lan me bindira mini wain palli ni kpama zaashee duri, ka daa lan me o niɣi balibu kam duri ni o biŋkɔbbaligu buzɔna.
en: Storehouses were also built for his supply of grain, wine, and olive oil; barns were built for his cattle, and pens were put up for his sheep.

dag: A mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni tooi mali jina? A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ din pa yɛlimaŋli leei din tuhi ni tooi mali jina?.
en: But you are opposed to dishonest lawmakers.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Hal a ni bi mi ma maa zaa yoli, n ni ti a yaa.
en: I am the LORD, and there is no other; besides me there is no God. I strengthen you— though you dont know me.

dag: N ku lan tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa pam, dama dunia ŋɔ naa kanna, amaa o ka n yiko.
en: I cannot talk with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. He has no power over me.

dag: Naa ni daa wum Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbini maa shɛm maa, ka o zani bimbini maa gbini ka teeg o nuu tiri ka yɛli, Gbaamiy o! Ka o ni daa teeg o nu shɛli tir o ka yɛl lala maa dii kpaŋ dilinli ka o kɔŋ li pɔribu.
en: When King Jeroboam heard the message from the man of God about the altar in Bethel, he took his hand off the altar and pointed at the man. He said, Arrest that man! But when the king said this, his arm became paralyzed. He could not move it.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul yɛra, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di zaa yoli bɛ pɔri maa nyɛla ʒiri pɔri.
en: The people make promises and say, As the Lord lives. But they dont really mean it.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yi o nyaaŋa n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: Amon's officials plotted against him and assassinated him in the palace.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Samsin zuɣu na pam, ka o zaŋ o nuzaŋa gbaai gbuɣinli maa n-darigi pirig o kaman nir ni darigiri pirigiri bubil shɛm la. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba bee o ma o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Suddenly the power of the Lord made Samson strong, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands, as if it were a young goat. But he did not tell his parents what he had done.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi n-nya ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri ka loori maa naai, ka kɔbiri bili di ni, o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni, di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if he thinks you are completely well, he will say, You are clean.

dag: Dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun taɣ ma ka m bi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi kana yomyom ti nya ma, biɛɣuni asiba doo zaɣ yino gba sa naan ku lan guui Nabal yiŋa.
en: If you hadn't come to meet me so quickly, every man and boy in Nabal's family and in his servants' families would have been killed by morning. I swear by the living Lord God of Israel who protected you that this is the truth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba, ka yɛli Baruk, Di simdi ka ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ti yɛli naa.
en: When they heard all its words, they were alarmed and said to Baruch: We must at once report all this to the king.

dag: Ka Firawuna suhu daa yu Hadad pam hal ka o ti gbaag o paɣ Tapɛnis tizo n-ti o paɣ pini.
en: Hadad won the friendship of the king, and the king gave his sister-in-law, the sister of Queen Tahpenes, to Hadad in marriage.

dag: Asaf bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani ka o wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-daa nyɛ: Zakur mini Yisifu ni Nɛtania ni Asharɛla. Naa n-daa wuhiri ba luɣ shɛŋa ni saha shɛli di ni simdi ni bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: From Asaphs family: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. Asaphs family was under Asaphs direction and prophesied by order of the king.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ma nyintaa bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ o ba dapala dɔni, dama o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa.
en: You must not have sexual contact with the daughter of your fathers wife, who was born into your fathers family; she is your sister.

dag: O daa zaŋ li ti o daba Izraɛlnima. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: As an inheritance to Israel, his servant— Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Zanim a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini, ka n yi kpaŋ ha; di pa shɛli ka Yawɛ ka n sanna. Ka o yi wuhi ma shɛlikam, n ni zaŋ li yɛl a. Ka o daa chaŋ ti du n-tam kuŋkun nɛli zuɣu.
en: Then Balaam said to Balak, Stay here near this altar. I will go to another place. Then the Lord will come to me, and he will tell me what I must say. Then Balaam went away to a higher place.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yihi yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli yi puri ni pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu zali yuuni kam.
en: Set aside a tithe—a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Abija daa di nam n-zan o zaani.
en: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.

dag: Ka o yi mali luɣ kasi shee maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni sara maligu bimbini maa ka di be kasi naai, ŋun zaŋm bu nɛɔŋ la na.
en: So Aaron will make the Most Holy Place, the Meeting Tent, and the altar pure. Then he will bring the living goat to the front of the tent.

dag: Yihim ma vi shɛli n ni zɔri ni, dama a zaligunim viɛla.
en: Take away the shame I fear. Your laws are good.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Avimnim bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi zaŋ hal ni Gaza la, Kafitɔrimnim bɛn daa yi Kafitɔr na la daa ku ba ka ʒini bɛ ʒiishee maa.
en: The land along the Mediterranean coast had been settled by people from the island of Crete. They had destroyed the Avvim, the original inhabitants, and had taken over all their land as far south as the city of Gaza.

dag: dama bɛ tɛha zaa nyɛla duŋtaabo, ka bɛ noya tɔɣisiri barina yɛtɔɣa.
en: Their hearts are focused on violence, and their lips speak of trouble.

dag: N nyala putɔɣu yɛl shɛŋa din niŋdi ʒii. Di nyɛla nyaanyira ni ŋun tumdi saɣiŋgu tuma ʒii. Ɛlam tɔbbihi, lirimiya ba. Miidia tɔbbihi, dɔnimiya gili tinsi gu. Naawuni ni chɛ ka Babilɔnnim ni tahi wahala shɛli na maa zan tariga.
en: I was given a vision of the hard times to come. I see traitors turning against you. I see people taking your wealth. Elam, go against them! Media, surround the city! I will put an end to all their moaning.

dag: Di saha Chɛmɔshi yɛla ni ti gbaai Mɔabnim vi kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl naani ka di yɛla ti gbahi ba vi shɛm la.
en: Then the people of Moab will be ashamed of their false god, Chemosh. They will be like the people of Israel who trusted that god in Bethel but were ashamed when he did not help them.

dag: Ka na palo daa ti di Ijipti, ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu.
en: Then a new king began to rule Egypt. He did not know Joseph.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a shɛm polo, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli, bɛ daa bi ŋmaag a nyuɣu; bɛ daa bi su a kom n-yihi a biɛri ni bee n-niŋ kpam ʒe a bee n-zaŋ chinchini pil a.
en: This is how you were treated on the day you were born: Your umbilical cord wasnt cut, you werent washed clean with water or rubbed with salt, and you werent wrapped in blankets.

dag: Ŋun tumdi putuma deerila shɛli o tuma zuɣu, ka laɣindi atam maa sɔŋdi guli nyɛvili din ka bahigu saha ni di chɛ ka ŋun biriti mini ŋun chɛri zaa ti laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.

dag: Bɛ tibirila n niriba maa daŋa bɛ baɣa ka tibbu ka yɛra, Di mali soochi, di mali soochi. Ka soochi mi kani.
en: They act as if my people's wounds were only scratches. All is well, they say, when all is not well.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, Mani? Mani.
en: The followers were very sad to hear this. Each one said to Jesus, Surely I am not the one.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe di ni deei li su. Amaa bɛ daa bi deeg a noli bee n-dol a zaligunima. Bɛ daa bi niŋ a ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛl la. Dinzuɣu ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa.
en: But when our ancestors took over the land, they did not obey you. And now you have punished Israel with disaster.

dag: Dama ni o nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka o mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. Ka o ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka mi ni tooi yɛl o dabili ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: Im also a man appointed under authority, with soldiers under me. I say to one, Go, and he goes, and to another, Come, and he comes. I say to my servant, Do this, and the servant does it.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu pahi yi Naawuni sizuura lubu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi yurilim mi pahi yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: to your devotion add kindness toward your brothers and sisters in Christ, and to this kindness add love.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bɛ yi ku niŋ Anabi Musa min anabinim yɛligu yɛda, hal so yi neei kum ni chaŋ ti yɛli ba, bɛ ku niŋ o gba yɛligu yɛda. .
en: Abraham said, If they dont listen to Moses and the Prophets, then neither will they be persuaded if someone rises from the dead.

dag: A yi ni chɛ ka ti tizo maa dol ti chaŋ, ti ni chaŋ ti da bindira maa na ti a;.
en: If you agree to send our brother with us, then we will go down and buy you food.

dag: O ba ŋun ni daa ŋariti niriba, ka fari o mabihi, ka tumdi din bi viɛla o niriba sani la zuɣu, o ni kpi o tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: The father hurts people and steals things. He never does anything good for my people! He will die because of his own sins.

dag: Bɛ malila ka shɛŋa din bi simdi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ Romnim ŋɔ doli n-wuhiri niriba.
en: They are teaching customs that are against our law; we are Roman citizens, and we cannot accept these customs or practice them.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o Izraɛl nanim Silisi la ni. Ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz died and was buried with his ancestors. The people buried him in the city of Jerusalem. But they didnt bury him in the same burial place where the kings of Israel were buried. Ahazs son Hezekiah became the new king in his place.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla shɛli ka pa shɛli, o yɔhindila omaŋa.
en: If you think you are too important to do this, you are only fooling yourself.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ ya na ti paai Amɔrinim bɛn be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa tuhi ya, amaa ka n daa chɛ ka yi nyaŋ ba; ka n ku ba ka chɛ ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: Then I brought you to the land of the Amorites, east of the Jordan River. Those people fought against you, but I allowed you to defeat them. I gave you the power to destroy them, and you took control of that land.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa zaŋ bia maa yi jirambisa maa zuɣu n-siɣina kpɛhi yili maa ni nti ti o ma maa ka yɛli, Nyama, a bia maa lan leei nyɛvililana yaha.
en: Elijah took the boy back downstairs to his mother and said to her, Look, your son is alive.

dag: Bɔ ka yɛnnim lee zaŋ so jɛra? Ka nyɔ bɔ ka tarimba lee nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa niriba ni?.
en: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.

dag: Ka mɔɣili kom daa zɔri yiri Idɛn na n-teeni puu maa; ka di daa woligi n-niŋ mɔɣ anahi nimaani.
en: A river flowed from Eden and watered the garden. The river then separated and became four smaller rivers.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ Bɛtani ti gbe nimaani.
en: Jesus left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

dag: Bɛnjamin bihi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Ashibɛl ŋun daa pa o zuɣu ni Ahara ŋun daa pah ata.
en: Benjamin had five sons. In order of age they were Bela, Ashbel, Aharah.

dag: Ka n daa garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ti nasara. Tinim bɛn nyɛ o daba ŋɔ ni piligi mɛbu maa. Amaa yinima nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka tarili bee n-su shɛli bee ka so ti teei yi yɛla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I answered, The God of Heaven will give us success. We are his servants, and we are going to start building. But you have no right to any property in Jerusalem, and you have no share in its traditions.

dag: Di ti yɛn nyɛla dabisi gahindili. Di ti ku mali wuntaŋ ni, di mi ti ku mali yuŋ, dama yuŋ gba ti yɛn malila neesim. Yawɛ kɔŋkɔ m-mi lala ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli.
en: On one day known to the LORD, there will be neither day nor night, but at evening time there will be light.

dag: Ka lan ti o yiko ni o kari saria, o ni nyɛ Daadam Bia la zuɣu.
en: And the Father has given him the power to judge all people because he is the Son of Man.

dag: Nyin ŋun suhu yiɣisi ka a dar tɔh amaŋ ŋɔ, a tɛhiya ni bɛ ni chɛ dunia ti a bee n-vuɣi tampiŋ di biɛhigu shee a zuɣu?.
en: Your anger is hurting no one but you. Do you think this world was made for you alone? Do you think God should move mountains just to satisfy you?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi Sintani, A tɛhi n dabili Ayuba yɛla? So bi ŋman o dunia ni. O nyɛla ŋun ka galimi ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Then the Lord asked, What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli ba Yisa ni di yɛli ba shɛm la, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: The followers answered the way Jesus told them, and the people let them take the donkey.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila lala ni bɛ zahim o nya o taali ka fiɣis o. Ka Yisa daa silim n-zaŋ o nubila sabiri tiŋa.
en: They said this to trap Jesus, so that they could accuse him. But he bent over and wrote on the ground with his finger.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka n naba be kaman saŋkpaliŋ naba la, ka chɛ ka n du n-tam luɣ shɛŋa din du.
en: who makes my step as sure as the deers, who lets me stand securely on the heights.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka a nya nirilim niŋbu mini yu suŋ Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.

dag: Izraɛlnim ti ku lan nya suligunyinyaɣu bee goo bɛ ʒiʒiinitab bɛn daa maani ba ansarisi la zaa so sani, ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: The house of Israel will no longer suffer from the pricking thorn or painful briar of any of its neighbors who hold it in contempt. And they will know that I am the LORD God.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ m-piig a leei maligumaana n-zali maligumaana Jɛhɔiada zaashee ni a guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka yinyaa yi zaŋ omaŋ leeg a anabi, yi n-gbaam o n-zaŋ zoligo ga o, ka zaŋ baŋ yɛl o nyiŋgol ni.
en: The Lord made you a priest in place of Jehoiada, and you are now the chief officer in the Temple. It is your duty to see that every crazy person who pretends to be a prophet is placed in chains with an iron collar around the neck.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ maani niriba maa yɛla saha shɛlikam. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ kpeeni kam ka a sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, di simdi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn mal li shɛm din ni chɛ ka tuma maa niŋ valimbo a sani, ka a mini ba zaa laɣim ʒiri ʒili maa.
en: These judges can handle the ordinary cases and bring the more difficult ones to you. Having them to share the load will make your work easier.

dag: Jɛdiayɛl bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan, ka Bilihan mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Bɛnjamin ni Ɛhud ni Chɛnaana ni Zɛtan ni Tarishish ni Ahishahar.
en: Jediaels family: Bilhan. Bilhans family: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

dag: Neem a nina nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim suhigu, ka gbilisi a tibili wum ti suhigu ti yi ti suh a saha shɛlikam.
en: Please listen to my prayers and to the prayers of your people Israel. Listen to their prayers any time that they ask you for help.

dag: Di simdi ni o ŋmaligi ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu ka tumdila din tuhi. Di simdi ni o bola suhudoo, ka kul biɛhiri di naba hal ti nya li.
en: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm, ka bɛ bidibbina bahi yoli!.
en: Our warriors have fallen, and their weapons are destroyed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi Izraɛl kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb a ni mi ka bɛ nyɛ niriba maa kpamba ni zuɣulaannim bɛn su ba n-zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbinna, ka bɛ ti zani nimaani pah a zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Assemble seventy respected men who are recognized as leaders of the people, bring them to me at the Tent of my presence, and tell them to stand there beside you.

dag: Bɛ dihi ti vi, dama bɛ turi ti. Ti lan ka jilima, dama tinzunnim kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Were humiliated by their taunts; were disgraced that strangers have violated the sacred places of the LORDs temple.

dag: N ni chɛ ka anabi ŋun be kaman nyini ŋɔ yi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni na m-be bɛ sani, ka n zaŋ n zilinli niŋ anab maa nol ni, ka o ti yɛri ba n ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa.
en: I will send them a prophet like you. This prophet will be one of their own people. I will tell him what he must say, and he will tell the people everything I command.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa tɔɣis o bihi maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa vuui la o naba pa o bindoo zuɣu dɔni n-leei Naawuni dini pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: After Jacob finished talking to his sons, he lay down, put his feet back on the bed, and died.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o, Bɔ m-poog a n sani ka a bɔri ni a kul a ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka Hadad yɛl o, Kul chɛ ka n kuli.
en: But Pharaoh answered, I have given you everything you need here. Why do you want to go back to your own country? Hadad answered, Please, just let me go home.

dag: Di saha maa, anab kam ti ku lan nyu bara ʒii nyabu zuɣu bee n-wuhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee n-ye binyɛr shɛli din mali biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri di ni n-yɔhim niriba.
en: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.

dag: Yi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu puuni, yi mali yi suhu ni bɔri binshɛɣukam ka diri nyaɣisim pam. Yi dihi yimaŋa ŋ-ŋmɛlim kaman biŋkɔbiri bɛn ʒe n-guli bɛ kɔrigibu dali.
en: You have lived a self-satisfying life on this earth, a life of luxury. You have stuffed your hearts in preparation for the day of slaughter.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, zomiya buɣijɛmbo!.
en: So then, my dear friends, keep away from the worship of idols.

dag: dama bɛ bari ma la zana, ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ ni bɛ di n nyɛvili, ka di ka daliri.
en: Because they hid their net for me for no reason, they dug a pit for me for no reason.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm.
en: If you can hear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.

dag: ka yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu nabi, ka yi daazinfa mini yi salima nabi, ka yi binshɛɣukam nabi.
en: and when your herds and your flocks are growing large, your silver and gold are multiplying, and everything you have is thriving.

dag: Yawɛ bela zuɣusaa o luɣ kasi shee ka lihirina. O bela alizanda ni ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ na.
en: The Lord will look down from his Holy Place above. He will look down at the earth from heaven.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini chiyaama buɣim kul dola palɔni Yawɛ sani, ka wula ka ninsalinim suhuri ni yɛla ku do palo ni o sani.
en: The grave and the underworld lie open before the LORD; how much more the hearts of human beings!.

dag: dama n nyɛla tarim dɔɣirili, amaa o bi chɛ ma piibu di zuɣu. Ka zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, ʒiɛmani kam nim ni boli ma alibarika paɣa;.
en: He has looked with favor on the low status of his servant. Look! From now on, everyone will consider me highly favored.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi deei Yawɛ daalikauli ni o nyɛ yi Naawuni ka yi ni dol o soli ka gbib o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka deeg o noli.
en: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.

dag: Amaa a nam ba ka bɛ biɛhigu pooi nyin Naawuni biɛla. A zaŋ jiri mini jilima pili ba kaman zuɣupila la.
en: Yet you made them inferior only to yourself; you crowned them with glory and honor.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli nyɛla din mali yiko; o kukoli mali jilima pam.
en: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima zaa niŋla buni nyaɣisim dibu ni, bɛ ni ti chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: They live out their lives in peace and quietly die without suffering.

dag: Ŋun zaŋ omaŋ tabili tayiɣa je omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili; o yi wumdi niriba ni yɛri zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn niŋ tayiɣ maa, amaa ka o bi viir o gbini.
en: Those who share plunder with thieves hate themselves; even under oath, they dont testify.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yiɣisima n-chaŋ ti tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa suhumahili yɛtɔɣa; dama m po Yawɛ, a yi bi chaŋ, so ku kpalim a sani yuŋ ŋɔ, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa ni bie n-gari zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din pun niŋ a a nachimbilim ni zaŋ na hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Now go and reassure your men. I swear by the Lord 's name that if you don't, not one of them will be with you by tomorrow morning. That would be the worst disaster you have suffered in all your life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa gbini, dama bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka yoori di dunoya biɛɣ asiba kam.
en: They stayed up all night guarding Gods Temple, and they had the job of opening Gods Temple every morning.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛligu daa maan chaŋ tooni, ka nyaandoliba maa kalinli daa zooi pahi Jɛrusalɛm puuni hal ka maligumaaniba pam gba daa niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: The word of God was reaching more and more people. The group of followers in Jerusalem became larger and larger. Even a big group of Jewish priests believed and obeyed.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, so ti ku lan be nimaani, amaa di ni ti kpalimla dabari. Ŋunkam ti gari Babilɔn di ni gar o, ka niŋ o alahiziba di ni wurim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Because of my anger no one will live in Babylon; it will be left in ruins, and all who pass by will be shocked and amazed.

dag: Yɛlimiya Yisifu, Jaande chɛl a biɛyanim ŋɔ ni daa tum a taal shɛl la. Pumpɔŋɔ, tinim bɛn nyɛ a yaannim Naawuni daba ŋɔ suhir a mi, chɛl ti ni daa tum a taal shɛli maa ti ti. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Yisifu, o daa kummi.
en: he told us to ask you, Please forgive the crime your brothers committed when they wronged you. Now please forgive us the wrong that we, the servants of your father's God, have done. Joseph cried when he received this message.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei Jɛhu gbaŋ maa, ka bɛ gbahi naa bidibisi pisopɔin maa n-ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri niŋ piɛri ni n-zaŋ li tahi Jɛziriil ti ti o.
en: So when the letter came to them, they took the kings sons and slaughtered all seventy of them. They placed their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ di gula, ka yɔɣiri li kom sahakam. N kul gul li mi yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka so ku tooi niŋ li shɛli.
en: I watch over it and water it continually. I guard it night and day so that no one will harm it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiri pini mali alibarika, dama bɛ niŋdi bɛ bindirigu tiri nandaamba.
en: Generous people will be blessed, because they share their food with the poor.

dag: O ni ti mali luɣ kasi shee maa, ka mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka yo maligumaaniba mini niriba maa zaa daalahichi samli.
en: He will reconcile the holiest part of the sanctuary and will do the same for the meeting tent and the altar. He will make reconciliation for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mini ŋun laɣim suɣiri ʒiɛri ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa.
en: Jesus answered, One who dips his bread in the dish with me will betray me.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai ka Yisa nyaandoliba ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: On the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal.

dag: Ka yi gba daa tumdila lala yi ni daa siɣi ʒe di puuni saha shɛl la.
en: You used to live this way, when you were alive to these things.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya ma bahi teeku ŋɔ ni ka teeku maa fo n-dɔni baalim, dama m mi ni n zuɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu ŋɔ ʒiɛri ya maa.
en: Jonah told them, Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.

dag: Daadam, wula ka tuŋ din be tibɔŋ ni wulli lee yɛn tooi gari tia wulli tibɔŋ maa ni?.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ kpani kahigi wuhi dimbɔŋɔ puuni, ka man sani n nyaya ka di wuhirila Masia mini cheechi yɛla.
en: There is a deep secret truth revealed in this scripture, which I understand as applying to Christ and the church.

dag: O doli zaligu soli kariti saria tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba bindirigu. Yawɛ yoori bɛn be sarika ni bahira.
en: he judges in favor of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, M biɛhimi ŋmɛnditoya ŋɔ naba? N ni paai ba? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Biɛhimi bɛ naba, a ni paa ba n-fa a niriba maa.
en: Then David asked the Lord , Should I go after the people who raided our town? Can I catch up with them? Go after them, the Lord answered. You will catch up with them, and you will rescue your families.

dag: N daa zaŋ liiga viɛlli yɛl a, ka zaŋ gban duɣira namda pir a, ka zaŋ bɔb piɛlli bɔb a, ka zaŋ chinchin nyɛlisira sol a.
en: I clothed you with colorful garments, put fine sandals on you, wrapped your head in linen, and covered you with jewels.

dag: Dama n yi lan labi m-me n ni daa pun wurim shɛl la, dindina n leela ŋun tum din chihi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛɣu birigiya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nia viɛla nyari jilima mini ʒiɛyimtali niriba sani.
en: You will earn the trust and respect of others if you work for good; if you work for evil, you are making a mistake.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o paɣ tizɔdoo Hɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ o deemba Riuɛl Midian nir bia la, Ti yiɣisiri kunila luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl ti, N ni zaŋ li tin ya la ni. Dol ti, ka ti ti niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli; dama Yawɛ pun lo Izraɛlnim zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu alikauli.
en: Moses said to Hobab the Midianite, Reuels son and Moses father-in-law, Were marching to the place about which the LORD has said, Ill give it to you. Come with us and well treat you well, for the LORD has promised to treat Israel well.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa po pɔri Yawɛ sani yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, a yi ni zaŋ niriba ŋɔ niŋ ti nuu ni, ti ni saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi zaa.
en: The Israelites prayed, Our Lord , if you will help us defeat these Canaanites, we will completely destroy their towns and everything in them, to show that they belong to you.

dag: Ka Kishɔn Mɔɣili kokpɛɣu daa ʒi ba chaŋ. Kishɔn kom din zɔri n-daa ʒi ba chaŋ. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi ni kpiɔŋ!.
en: The Kishon River, that ancient river, swept Siseras men away. My soul, march on with strength!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti dalim siliga maa noli kuɣili la, ka zali tɔbbihi ka bɛ gul li.
en: So they all went to the tomb and made it safe from thieves. They did this by sealing the stone in the entrance and putting soldiers there to guard it.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ya yi ni daa nyari biɛrim shɛli mini wahala shɛŋa ni, ka yihi ya tuun kpɛma mini bɛ ni daa muɣisiri ya ka yi tumdi tuun shɛŋa la tumbu ni.
en: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni, o daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka o nubihi min o napombihi zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na.
en: Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum n Duuma kukoli ka di yɛra, Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn tim, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti ti? Ka n daa yɛli, N-nyɛ ma; timmi ma.
en: Then I heard the Lords voice saying, Whom should I send, and who will go for us? I said, Im here; send me.

dag: Di saha ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, N dana, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ a ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt mini Dauda daa kul laɣindi timdi diri kaman naa maŋmaŋ bidibisi ni yino n-nyɛ o la.
en: Then Ziba said to the king, Your servant will do whatever my master the king commands. So Mephibosheth ate at Davids table, like one of the kings own sons.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kɛhɛlata maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Shɛfa Zoli gbini.
en: They marched from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti lo nia ni o ku Jɛrɔbɔam, amaa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zo n-kuli Ijipti Naa Shishak sani nti be Ijipti maa hal ka Sulemaana ti kpi.
en: When Solomon learned what the Lord had told Jeroboam, Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam. But he escaped to King Shishak of Egypt and stayed there until Solomon died.

dag: O ni gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim, amaa o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna m-bahi zibisim ni; dama ninsal ku tooi di nasara omaŋmaŋ yiko ni.
en: He protects his holy people. He keeps them from stumbling. But evil people will be destroyed. They will fall in the darkness. Their power wont help them win.

dag: Dama Hɛshibɔn daa nyɛla Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn tiŋa. Ŋuna n-daa tuhi Mɔab na kuro ka fa o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zaŋ hal ni Arinɔn.
en: Heshbon was the capital city of the Amorite king Sihon, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had captured all his land as far as the Arnon River.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaligu maa lan ka yaa, ka saria karibu gba bi lan tumdi tuma. Dama ninvuɣ biɛri gilila wuntizɔriba, dinzuɣu ka saria karibu bi lan tumdi tuma.
en: The law is weak and not fair to people. Evil people win their fights against good people. So the law is no longer fair, and justice does not win anymore.

dag: Rɛhabia daŋ ni, ŋun Rɛhabia bidibisi ni, Ishia n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: from Rehabiah and his family: Isshiah the first.

dag: A ni niŋ o naani o ni mali kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka chɛ a tuma jɛl o?.
en: Can you rely on his great strength and expect him to do your heavy work?.

dag: tiri m biyurigu Timoti. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Timothy, my dear child. Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa gbibi Dauda biŋkumda la, ka maligumaaniba mi daa gbibi kikahi.
en: So the Levites stood ready with Davids instruments of music, and the priests stood ready with their trumpets.

dag: ni Zalimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la ni Maharai ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la.
en: Zalmon the Ahohite; Maharai from Netophah;.

dag: dama nir yi bi mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima, wula ka o ni tooi gbibi Naawuni cheechi?.
en: because if they dont know how to manage their own household, how can they take care of Gods church?.

dag: Naawuni ni daa neeg o kum ni ka o ku lan labi niŋgbuŋ poobu ni zuɣu ka o daa lan yɛli: N ni zaŋ alibarika suŋ shɛli n ni daa niŋniŋ Naa Dauda ni la n-niŋ a ni.
en: And this is what God said about raising him from death, never to rot away in the grave: I will give you the sacred and sure blessings that I promised to David.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mbaye, n yidan kpimi ka n kpalim pakoli.
en: What is wrong? the king asked her. Its terrible! she said. I am a widow; my husband is dead.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din be tibi; ka nyɛ din tiri nyɛvili. Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din mali naani niŋbu, ka lan nyɛ din tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi shɛli baŋsim.
en: The law of the Lord is perfect; it gives new strength. The commands of the Lord are trustworthy, giving wisdom to those who lack it.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bɛrishiiba ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: and Hazarshual, and in Beersheba and the villages around it.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli, Mani m-mali n suhu ka di yi daɣiri ni, n yi n daalahichi ni.
en: Can any of us really say, My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone?.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana malila biɛrisuŋ; di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino; ka di mi simdi ni o bihi nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba, ka pa ni niriba ni ni tooi galim shɛba bɛ ni bi gbaari bɛmaŋ shɛm bee bɛ tipawumli zuɣu.
en: To be an elder, a man must not be guilty of living in a wrong way. He must be faithful to his wife, and his children must be faithful to God. They must not be known as children who are wild or dont obey.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa nya ma kul maani ma la ansarisi; ka mɛrigiri bɛ noya niŋdi ma, ka viini bɛ zuɣuri niŋdi ma ka yɛra.
en: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tahiri kum na, amaa ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tiligiri ba.
en: Evil people use their words to hurt others, but the words from good people can save others from danger.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni nya alibarika pam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o nya buni yomyom ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: Reliable people will have abundant blessings, but those with get-rich-quick schemes wont go unpunished.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti tooi li ti niriba maa ni bɛ piɛbi. Bɛ ni daa piɛbiri ʒiɛri maa ka bɛ ti kuhi yɛli, Wɛi, Naawuni nira, Lɔɣu be duɣu maa ni! Ka bɛ daa kɔŋ li piɛbbu.
en: Then they poured some of the soup for the men to eat. But when they began to eat the soup, they shouted out, Man of God! Theres poison in the pot! The food tasted like poison, so they could not eat that food.

dag: Di saha ka buɣim daa yi Yawɛ sanna ti di ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu bɛn daa tuɣili tulaale zim maa.
en: Then the Lord sent a fire that blazed out and burned up the men who had presented the incense.

dag: Nir yi bo n-nya azichi yomyom di dii bi nabira, amaa bɛn bɔri nyari li biɛlabiɛla, di nabirimi.
en: Riches gotten quickly will dwindle, but those who acquire them gradually become wealthy.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya yaa n-chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn du n-chaŋ ti ʒini maa ni.
en: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land.

dag: Naa ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali nyɛla piɛbih ayɔbu bɛn ka dansi mini piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: On the Sabbath, the ruler will bring six lambs and one ram to be offered as sacrifices to please me. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.

dag: Ka o ni daa zaŋ yaɣiri mɛri duɣ shɛli maa daa saɣim o nuu ni, ka o daa zaŋ li taɣi me o ni daa nya ka duɣ shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Whenever a piece of pottery turned out imperfect, he would take the clay and make it into something else.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya Filip la Azɔtus, ka o doli nimaani tinsi n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu hal ti paai Siizaria.
en: But Philip appeared in a city called Azotus. He was going to the city of Caesarea. He told people the Good News in all the towns on the way from Azotus to Caesarea.

dag: Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba bɛn be Wulinluhili polo daa deei tiŋgbani ŋɔ ka di leei bɛ dini.
en: The descendants of Joseph, the tribes of Ephraim and West Manasseh, received this land as their possession.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, ka pumpɔŋɔ man na yɛn pahi ya la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi leei barazim saɣisiri ya.
en: So if my father made your workload heavy, Ill make it even heavier! If my father disciplined you with whips, Ill do it with scorpions.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ ku bihi laamba bɛ bihi zuɣu bee n-ku bihi bɛ laamba zuɣu; kulila sokam maŋmaŋ tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ ni ku o.
en: Parents must not be put to death for something their children did. And children must not be put to death for something their parents did. People should be put to death only for a bad thing that they themselves did.

dag: Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpuɣi Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir ŋun daa yi Mɛsopoteemia la na bipuɣiŋga la. Ribɛka daa nyɛla Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir la tizɔpaɣa.
en: Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebecca, the daughter of Bethuel and sister of Laban.

dag: zaŋ tabili Kɛnnim mini Kɛnizinim ni Kadimɔninim.
en: including the lands of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: Everything happened just as the Lord had told Moses—he made the king too stubborn to listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti nya li, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: when they saw it, they were stunned; they panicked and ran away frightened.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka Miidianim maani shili ni bɛ liri ba. Bɛ je anzinfa, bɛ mi baɣa ka salima ni.
en: The Lord says, Look, I will cause the armies of Media to attack Babylon. Nothing will stop them, even if someone offers them gold and silver.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpalim guhiri saha shɛli maa, ka Ɛhud daa chaŋ hal ti gari kuɣikpɛra shee la n-zo n-kuli Siɛra tiligi.
en: But by that time, Ehud had already escaped past the statues. Ehud went to the town of Seirah.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili nɛma duu la zaa ti o.
en: So Hezekiah collected all the silver from the Lord 's temple and the royal treasury.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o zɔri ninvuɣ so o ni bɔri nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka o ni bɔri ninvuɣ so mi suhu kul kpɛma.
en: So God shows mercy to those he wants to show mercy to and makes stubborn those he wants to make stubborn.

dag: Bɛ daa nyuri binnyura maa dolila zaligu ni wuhi shɛm. Bɛ daa bi muɣisi so ni o nyu li; dama naa maa daa pun yɛl o yiŋbihi ni bɛ tim sokam wain maa kaman bɛ ni bɔri li shɛm tariga.
en: The rule about the drinks was No limits! The king had ordered everyone serving wine in the palace to offer as much as each guest wanted.

dag: Ka doo kam ŋun bi guni, bɛn yihim o o daŋ ni, o ni bi gbibi n daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: Any man who isn't circumcised hasn't kept his part of the promise and cannot be one of my people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu tuhi; o nyɛla n tampiŋ, ka dinkam pa wuntia tuuni ka o ni.
en: in order to proclaim: The LORD is righteous. Hes my rock. Theres nothing unrighteous in him.

dag: Yi bi bɔri ni yi saɣi ni dabisi biɛɣu dali mirina, amaa yi ni niŋdi shɛm lee chɛmi ka dindali maa mirina.
en: You people are rushing toward the day of punishment. You bring near the rule of violence.

dag: Ka Musa daa lo alikauli dindali maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli a ni ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim maa zuɣu, a napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ ni ti leeg a min a bihi ni yɛn su shɛli sahakam.
en: The same day I came back, Moses told me, Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.

dag: Ti Duuma, deem ti suhigu ka chɛ m-paŋ ti. Ti Duuma, wummi ti suhigu maa ka niŋ ti ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni nyini n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni. Di chɛ ka di lan yuui! Tiŋ maa mini niriba maa nyɛla a dini.
en: My Lord, listen! My Lord, forgive! My Lord, pay attention and act! Dont delay! My God, do all this for your own sake, because your city and your people are called by your name.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani baɣisiri Galili Teeku n-daa ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ti ʒini.
en: Jesus left there and went along by Lake Galilee. He climbed a hill and sat down.

dag: a yi yɛli, Nyama, ti di bi mi dimbɔŋɔ. Ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni la nya li. Ŋun gul a bi mi li? O ku yo nira o tuma samli?.
en: Don't say, I didn't know it! God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yilimiya yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli ti Yaakubu, ka duhiya yi yee m-paɣi ŋuna ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam naa ŋɔ. Molimiya, ka paɣimiy o yɛra, Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, Come and rescue your people, Lord ! Save what's left of Israel.

dag: N lɔn ya alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka kom di binnɛma zaa, ka m mi ku lan chɛ ka kom di dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: I promise every living creature that the earth and those living on it will never again be destroyed by a flood.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi -amba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: On the following day we left and arrived in Caesarea. There we stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the seven men who had been chosen as helpers in Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛndan tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, amaa jɛrilim n-yiri jɛra noya ni na.
en: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.

dag: Bɛ lan labimi ti tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bɛ yaannim bɛn daa zaɣisi n nol la ni daa tumdi kurimbuni ha la. Bɛ jɛmdila wuna. Izraɛlnim mini Judanim saɣim n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli maa.
en: They are committing the same sins that their ancestors did. Their ancestors refused to listen to my message. They followed and worshiped other gods. The family of Israel and the family of Judah have broken the agreement I made with their ancestors.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi yila yilibu zani tariga, ka so ku lan wum yi mɔɣilɔnim kumsi.
en: You will have no reason to sing or play music on harps.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim nuu ni ka bɛ su ba yuun pihinahi.
en: The Israelites sinned against the Lord again, and he let the Philistines rule them for forty years.

dag: Bahi yoli mini wahala m-be bɛ ni doli so shɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.

dag: Dama wulimpuhili zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili, n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani, ka bɛ kul tuɣindi tulaale zim ka maani sara din be kasi tiri ma luɣilikam, dama n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Nevertheless, from sunrise to sunset, my name will be great among the nations. Incense and a pure grain offering will be offered everywhere in my name, because my name is great among the nations, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ŋuna n-kahigiri yɛl shɛŋa din baŋbu to min ashili yɛla wuhiri niriba; o mi din sɔɣi bumbɔn ni, neesim mi n-gil omaŋmaŋa.
en: He knows hidden secrets that are hard to understand. Light lives with him, so he knows what is in the dark and secret places.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi kpuɣi di ni wuhi ni yi saɣimmi binshɛɣukam maa ni binshɛli, dama yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni bo yɛla ti Izraɛlnima, ka di bahi ba yoli bɛ sansan ni.
en: But you are not to take anything that is to be destroyed; if you do, you will bring trouble and destruction on the Israelite camp.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ yurilim maŋli la yɛla. O ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti ti la zuɣu, n ni paɣ o. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Izraɛlnim ni.
en: I will tell of the Lord 's unfailing love; I praise him for all he has done for us. He has richly blessed the people of Israel because of his mercy and constant love.

dag: Shiina Naa Amirafɛl mini Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ni Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal.
en: Amraphel was the king of Babylonia, Arioch was the king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer was the king of Elam, and Tidal was the king of Goiim.

dag: Dama a sabi yɛl shɛŋa din to pam jɛndi ma, ka chɛ ka n di wahala n ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li, ŋunkam bi chɛ o ni mali shɛlikam ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: In the same way, concluded Jesus, none of you can be my disciple unless you give up everything you have.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa bi saɣi lala, dina n-daa chɛ ka di kpama talahi ni n yɛli ni n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Naa Siiza sanna. Di mi pala n kamina ni n ti fiɣisi mmaŋmaŋ zuliya.
en: When the Jews objected, I was forced to appeal to Caesar. Dont think I appealed to Caesar because I had any reason to bring charges against my nation.

dag: Dɔro ni daa mali do so yuun pihinahaayika gba daa do nimaani.
en: One of the men lying there had been sick for years.

dag: Yawɛ daa be alizanda ni ka tahi bahina, ka bɛ daa wum Zallakudura Naa kukoli.
en: The LORD thundered from heaven; the Most High made his voice heard.

dag: ka o yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli baa din kuui ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: and he said, This is what the Lord says: Dig ditches all over this dry stream bed.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ ku Lazarɔs gba.
en: The chief priests decided that they would kill Lazarus too.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Deemi suhuyiɣisili wain pipia ŋɔ n nuu ni n-chɛ ka n ni yɛn tim a zuliya shɛb sani ŋɔ zaa nyu li.
en: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibubalibu kpe bɛ suhuri ni nti ku yɛligu maa, ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: but the worries about this life, the love for riches, and all other kinds of desires crowd in and choke the message, and they don't bear fruit.

dag: M bɔri ni Izraɛlnim nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Yawɛ yi chɛ ka o niriba lan tɔŋ, di ni niŋ Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim nyaɣisim, ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: I wish the one who lives on Mount Zion would bring victory to Israel! When the Lord makes his people successful again, the people of Jacob will be happy; the people of Israel will be glad.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma ni ti Naawuni, nyini n-simdi tibigibu ni jilima tibu ni yiko malibu, dama nyini n-nam binshɛɣukam zaa, a yubu ni ka a daa nam li, ka chɛ ka di be.
en: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, because you created all things. It is by your will that they existed and were created.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ni kpi, amaa ŋun gbilisi tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga ni di shɛhira viɛlli.
en: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti yi kpaŋa chaŋ luɣ shɛli ti vuhi biɛla. Dama niriba daa kul kanila o sanna ka chana, hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ dahima diri bindirigu.
en: But so many people were coming and going that Jesus and the apostles did not even have a chance to eat. Then Jesus said, Let's go to a place where we can be alone and get some rest.

dag: Ka Naawuni gba daa di o shɛhira yiko shihira wuhibu ni mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni ni alahiziba tuma balibu pam ni min o ni daa zaŋ o Shia Kasi pina ti niriba kaman o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: God also proved it by using miraculous signs, wonders, and all kinds of miracles. And he proved it by giving people various gifts through the Holy Spirit in just the way he wanted.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka Naawuni deei li ka di leeg o daalahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You must press your hand on the head of the entirely burned offering so that it will be accepted for you, to make reconciliation for you.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni, ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be brave! We must be courageous for the sake of our people and the cities of our God. The LORD will do what is good in his eyes.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba zuɣulana daa yi zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la ti maani sara alahichi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maa zaɣ muna yiri tin tariga ti nyɔri buɣim.
en: The Jewish high priest brings the blood of the animals into the Most Holy Place to offer it as a sacrifice for sins; but the bodies of the animals are burned outside the camp.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni ti daa chaŋla Juda yaɣili Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ duu la ni. Bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni kpe kuɣ shɛŋa mɛri li, ka zaŋ dapaɣa kpɛhi di goma ni. Bɛ tumdi tuma maa viɛnyɛliŋga pam, ka di kul chani tooni.
en: Let the king know that we went to the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. It is being built with dressed stone and with timber set into the walls. This work makes good progress and prospers in their hands.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Naawuni ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah did everything exactly as God commanded him.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, N ni pun sab shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: Pilate answered, What I have written stays written.

dag: ka bi zaŋ li ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni na ti mal li ti Yawɛ, bɛn yihim dilan Yawɛ niriba ni.
en: They must take the sacrifice to the entrance of the Meeting Tent and offer it to the Lord . Whoever does not do this will be separated from their people.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntua mini dina la daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili ni di zɔntua maa ni. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
