en: In fact, everything along the passageway was also the same size, including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, the entrance room at the far end, and the windows. This gate, like the others, was meters long and . meters wide.

dag: Ka Musa daa chani nti paai luɣ shɛli gbe nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti bɔri ni o ku o.
en: One night while Moses was in camp, the Lord was about to kill him.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni daa kpe hal ti pibigi gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni la, bɛna n-daa baai du li chaŋ ti kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be vinvamli ni wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo zaa la.
en: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river.

dag: Ka bina ayi ŋɔ nyɛla din ku tooi taɣi, ka Naawuni mi ku ŋma ʒiri di puuni. Lala zuɣu di simdi ni tinim bɛn nya sɔɣibu shee Naawuni sani ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni pam gbibi tahima shɛli din be ti tooni la kirikiri.
en: There are these two things, then, that cannot change and about which God cannot lie. So we who have found safety with him are greatly encouraged to hold firmly to the hope placed before us.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Gomna Filiksi min o paɣ Drusila ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudia paɣ la daa ti kana n-tim ti boli Pool na ni bɛ ti wum Yisa Masia yɛla o sani.
en: After a few days Felix came with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jew. Felix asked for Paul to be brought to him. He listened to Paul talk about believing in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka yi ni so yɛl o ni o cham ni suhudoo; ka lan yɛl o ni Naawuni ni chɛ ka o nya n-ye ka di n-tiɣi, amaa ka bi ti o binshɛl din simd o niŋgbuŋ, di buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: you shouldn't just say, I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat. What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ yi ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ mi ti leei din bi kpira, di saha maa di ni ti niŋ kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Kum kɔŋ nasara!.
en: And when the rotting body has been clothed in what cant decay, and the dying body has been clothed in what cant die, then this statement in scripture will happen: Death has been swallowed up by a victory .

dag: Di bi wumdi so yɛligu; di bi deeri so saɣisigu; di bi niŋdi Yawɛ naani; di mi bi vuri miriti di Naawuni.
en: She listened to no voice; she accepted no discipline. She didnt trust in the LORD, nor did she draw near to her God.

dag: Ka yi ti kpi tinzunnim maa sunsuuni, ka yi dimnim maa tiŋgbani ti vali ya.
en: Many of you will die in foreign lands.

dag: Yuuni maa puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pisiniyini dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai na ni o ti yɛl ti.
en: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu, ka di leei o ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.

dag: dama binnamda zaa leela binchɔɣima, ka di pala binnamda maa yubu zuɣu. Naawuni ni yu ni di niŋ shɛm m-bala, amaa ka o lee ti binnamda maa tahima.
en: For creation was condemned to lose its purpose, not of its own will, but because God willed it to be so. Yet there was the hope.

dag: Kaman sagani ni yi booi sagbana ni saa mibu dali shɛm la, lala ka jilima din daa gili o maa daa be. Yawɛ jilima kɔtomsi ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala. N ni daa nya li maa ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka wum so kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: The light shining around him was like a rainbow in a cloud. It was the Glory of the Lord . As soon as I saw that, I fell to the ground. I bowed with my face to the ground, and then I heard a voice speaking to me.

dag: Ka Sool tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la daa zaŋ Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt n-zo chaŋ Mahanaim.
en: Meanwhile, Abner, Ners son, the commander of Sauls army, had taken Ishbosheth, Sauls son, and brought him over to Mahanaim.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Zara mi, Nyama, n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ti a tizɔdoo maa ni di wuhi bɛnkam zaa be a sani mini sokam zaa ni a bi tum taali.
en: To Sarah, he said, Ive given your brother one thousand pieces of silver. It means that neither you nor anyone with you has done anything wrong. Everything has been set right.

dag: Jɔram ni daa ti nya Jɛhu, o daa bɔh o mi, Jɛhu, alaafee? Ka Jɛhu garigi bɔh o, Wula ka alaafee lee yɛn niŋ beni, ka a ma Jɛzibɛl sotali min o buɣijɛmbo tuma la na kul beni pam.
en: Are you coming in peace? Joram asked him. How can there be peace, Jehu answered, when we still have all the witchcraft and idolatry that your mother Jezebel started.

dag: Ka Sintani yi kariti Sintani bahira, o ŋmaligimi tuhir omaŋa m-bala; ka wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani?.
en: So if Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last?.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri suhuyubu niŋ; di chɛ ka bɛ di nasara bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa chɛ salo maa ka kul o yilikpɛrili. Ka o nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Wuhim ti piriŋkpana din be puu ni la yɛla ŋahili la gbinni.
en: When Jesus had left the crowd and gone indoors, his disciples came to him and said, Tell us what the parable about the weeds in the field means.

dag: Nyamiya ti Ba Naawuni ni yu ti yurilim shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o bol ti ŋun Naawuni bihi; ka lala n-shiri nyɛ ti. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim bi mi ti, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni bi mi o la zuɣu.
en: See how much the Father has loved us! His love is so great that we are called God's children—and so, in fact, we are. This is why the world does not know us: it has not known God.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni na, tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛn malila di vuhim yuuni Yawɛ sani.
en: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb malila bɛ chɛchɛbunsi nyuri bara; ka shɛb mi mali bɛ yuri nyuri bara, amaa tinim malila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli nyuri bara.
en: Some people trust in chariots, others in horses; but we praise the LORDs name.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o dɔɣiriba ni o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: Jesus said to them, Prophets are respected everywhere except in their own hometown and by their relatives and their family.

dag: Naɣ kara bɛba ayopɔin la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kar ayopɔin la gba gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin; zahindi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The seven fat cows are seven years, and the seven full heads of grain are also seven years; they have the same meaning.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gindi napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ka maligumaaniba piɛbiri kikahi saha shɛli, ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa, Tahimiya! Dama Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: The seventh time around, when the priests were about to sound the trumpets, Joshua ordered the people to shout, and he said, The Lord has given you the city!.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba, Yisahaku bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Iso mini Izraɛl.
en: Abraham's son Isaac had two sons, Esau and Jacob.

dag: Ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka paɣiba maa zaŋ tulaale shɛli bɛ ni daa mali zal la chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early in the morning on the first day of the week, the women went to the tomb, bringing the fragrant spices they had prepared.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kahig omaŋ wuhi Ijiptinima, ka bɛ baŋ o dindali maa ka jɛm o, ka bo pina mini sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti o. Bɛ ni ti pɔri pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka niŋ bɛ ni po ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm.
en: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord . They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.

dag: Farisiinim daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ saha ka Naawuni nam yɛn piligi? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni nam bi yɛn piligimi ni shihira ka niriba nya li ni bɛ nini;.
en: Pharisees asked Jesus when Gods kingdom was coming. He replied, Gods kingdom isnt coming with signs that are easily noticed.

dag: Ka bɛ noya daa wol taba, ka Pool tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ka bɛ naanyi wurim. Pool daa yɛli ba mi, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia yɛli ti yaannim shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Anabi Aizaia daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya.
en: They disagreed with each other and were starting to leave when Paul made one more statement: The Holy Spirit spoke correctly when he said to your ancestors through Isaiah the prophet.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n firila, Yawɛ tiri ma neesim n zibisim ni.
en: Our Lord and God, you are my lamp. You turn darkness to light.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa lee bela ya? Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam, ka dabiɛm kpe ba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: He said to his disciples, Where is your faith? Filled with awe and wonder, they said to each other, Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him.

dag: Daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi ti wum ka n yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, nyin zaŋmi saɣisigu din yi n sanna saɣisi ba.
en: Son of man, I am making you a watchman for Israel. I will tell you about bad things that will happen to them, and you must warn Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti ka a sanna ka bi mali wuhibu ŋɔ na, nyin di saɣi ka o kpe a yiŋa; a mi di puhi lala nira.
en: So then, if some come to you who do not bring this teaching, do not welcome them in your homes; do not even say, Peace be with you.

dag: Teeku n-nyɛ ma bee binneen titali ŋun be teeku ni n-nyɛ ma, ka a chɛ ka bɛ guli ma?.
en: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya M poya, Bɔzira ni leei dabeenzɔbo mini ansarisimalibo tiŋa, ka zani dabari ni niriba ni yɛn turi shɛli, ka di fɔntinsi ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam.
en: I, the Lord , swear in my own name that your city of Bozrah and all your towns will suffer a horrible fate. They will lie in ruins forever, and people will use the name Bozrah as a curse word.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim kul nyɛla din wuhiri bindira mini binnyura ni Yɛhudianim adiini kaya balibu kam din nyɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zaligunim din yɛn beni hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti lan yɛn taɣi mali binshɛlikam zal la.
en: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Nan bia Jɔshua zali ka yɛl o, Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, n ni be a sani.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun and told him, Be confident and determined. You will lead the people of Israel into the land that I promised them, and I will be with you.

dag: A chɛ ka n zɔnim mini n ʒiʒiinitab zaɣisi ma. Zibisim n-kpalim n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: You have made even my closest friends abandon me, and darkness is my only companion.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni nya li ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi; bɛ ni ti dim bɛ nyina ka bahi yoli; ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu ni kpalim yoli.
en: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.

dag: Pahat ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab nir la min o bidibisi daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisinii ni pihinunaanahi.
en: of Pahath-moab, that is, of the descendants of Jeshua and Joab .

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi ku mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛli n-tum alahichi. Di maliya li ŋmahindi bin lɔɣu bee bin nyaŋ.
en: that you do not sin by making for yourselves an idol in any form at all—whether man or woman.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi la zaa mabihili puhigu ti ti.
en: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.

dag: Di ni ti ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee yina; ŋun yɛn ku zuliya pam yi palo. O yi o biɛhigu shee na ni o bahi yi tiŋgbani yoli. Yi fɔntinsi ni wurim, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ ti ti, dama sakuɣa ŋɔ mini satahinsi ŋɔ saɣiya lala. N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, n ku lan chɛ ka yi be kpe yaha.
en: Pray to the Lord ! We have had enough of this thunder and hail! I promise to let you go; you don't have to stay here any longer.

dag: Nyɛvili be wuntizɔbo soli ni, ka nir yi doli di soli maa o ku kpi.
en: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu n-ku bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: they will be helpless, completely destroyed.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim chɛ ka daboya mini vinvama yi palo ni, kaman binyɛrigu kpabbu bɔba la, ka ne n-doya kaman bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli dihi yaɣiri zuɣu ka yihi li ka di bɔbili doya shɛm la.
en: Daylight makes the hills and valleys stand out like the folds of a garment, clear as the imprint of a seal on clay.

dag: ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni o daanfaani zuɣu, ka leeg o falidiriba zaŋ chaŋ nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima niŋbu la polo.
en: So, since we have been made righteous by his grace, we can inherit the hope for eternal life.

dag: Ka Mikal daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o doli takɔro ni yi n-zo n-tiligi.
en: She helped David leave through a window and climb down to the ground. As David ran off.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku a bihi. Alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo ni lu a zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu a zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sool min o bidibis ata ni o gbaɣinɔʒira ni o niriba zaa ni daa laɣim kpi dahin yini shɛm m-bala.
en: And that is how Saul, his three sons, and the young man died; all of Saul's men died that day.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, amaa o ni kari o ni yɛli noli ti ninvuɣ shɛb la bahi.
en: Those blessed by God will possess the land, but those cursed by God will be cut off.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa lab Jɛrusalɛm nti nya ka Yisa tuumba piniyini maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb laɣim ʒiya.
en: They got up at once and went back to Jerusalem, where they found the eleven disciples gathered together with the others.

dag: N ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ n ni ti ba binshɛli, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛli bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ba.
en: I will kill them all with a terrible sickness. I will destroy them, and I will use you to make another nation. Your nation will be greater and stronger than these people.

dag: Amaa Naawuni tiligim ma ka n nyu bara shɛli zuɣu ka pa ni ti Duuma Yisa Masia dapulli la kɔŋko zuɣu. Masia dapulli maa zuɣu dunia nyɛla binkpiŋ n sani, ka n gba nyɛ binkpiŋ dunia ŋɔ sani.
en: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli Manɔa, A yi gooi ma ʒili, n ku di yi bindirigu maa; amaa yi yi niŋ shili ni yi zaŋ li mali sara nyo buɣim, yin zaŋmiya li na ti ti Yawɛ.
en: But the LORDs messenger replied to Manoah, If you persuaded me to stay, I wouldnt eat your food. If you prepare an entirely burned offering, offer it to the LORD. Indeed, Manoah didnt know that he was the LORDs messenger.

dag: Amaa a zuɣu, bɛ kul kuri ti mi dabisili kam, ka niŋdi ti kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: All day long we died for you. We are like sheep being led away to be killed.

dag: N kul ni nyuri bara Yawɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu wum li ka mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: I will praise him for what he has done; may all who are oppressed listen and be glad!.

dag: Bɛ daa bi mi ni Yisifu wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa, dama so n-daa deeri yɛtɔɣa maa lɛbigiri tiri ba.
en: They did not know that Joseph could understand them, since he was speaking through an interpreter.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa ni labina ti tuhi tiŋ ŋɔ nima. Bɛ ni tuhi deei li, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: After that the army from Babylon will come back here and attack Jerusalem. Then they will capture and burn it.

dag: Bɛ nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, bɛ kpalim bela zuliyanim maa sani kaman duɣu kpiŋ din lan ka buchi la.
en: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.

dag: Di nyɛla ashil shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ sɔɣi niriba ʒiɛmana din gari la ha puuni, amaa ka yipa kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Im completing it with a secret plan that has been hidden for ages and generations but which has now been revealed to his holy people.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa ti paana yɛli naa, Bɛ zaa mal alaafee, Ka silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je nyini n dan naa niŋ ti nuu ni ŋɔ simdi paɣibu.
en: Ahimaaz called to the king, All is well! Ahimaaz bowed with his face to the ground in front of the king and said, Praise the Lord your God! The Lord has defeated the men who were against you, my lord and king.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa ni daa wum li, ka tinzunnim bɛn gili ti zaa daa nya li, ka bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni ti Naawuni sɔŋsim ni ka tuma maa tum naai maa.
en: When our enemies heard about this, all of the nations around us were afraid and their confidence was greatly shaken. They knew that this work was completed with the help of our God.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bindirigu ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o.
en: Who among you will give your children a stone when they ask for bread?.

dag: di saha n nyarila Naawuni tuma zaa, ka baŋ ni so ku tooi baŋ din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn kpaŋm bɛmaŋ kabo, bɛ ku tooi baŋ li. Hal yɛnnim ni wuhiri ni bɛ mi li la, bɛ kul ku tooi baŋ li.
en: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be Akasia saha shɛli ka bɛ daa piligi bɔri Mɔab paɣiba.
en: When the Israelites were camped at Acacia Valley, the men began to have sexual intercourse with the Moabite women who were there.

dag: Niŋm man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim; ka tiligi ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Shine your face on your servant; save me by your faithful love!.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ bɛ ʒiʒiinitab ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn zaa mi bɛ yuli ŋɔ, fabilimiya bɛ zuɣu. Yɛlimiya, Nyamiya nam jaaŋgbe kpiɔŋ din mali jilima la ni kabigi shɛm.
en: I will order the nearby nations to mourn for you and say, Isn't it sad? Moab ruled others, but now its glorious power has been shattered.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe Pita yiŋa n-nya ka Pita deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ bii ka o doya;.
en: Jesus went to Peter's home, and there he saw Peter's mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini jilima n-nyɛ o situra, o suhu bi zɔhiri saha shɛŋa din kanna zuɣu.
en: She is strong and respected and not afraid of the future.

dag: Nimaani sarikanim laɣimmi be ni suhudoo; bɛ bi lan wumdi bɛ guliba tahigu.
en: Even prisoners enjoy peace, free from shouts and harsh commands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka tia kam din lihibu viɛla ka simdi dibu bili yi tiŋgban ni na. Ka nyɛvili tia mini tia din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu gba daa be puu maa sunsuuni.
en: The Lord God filled the garden with all kinds of beautiful trees and fruit trees. Two other trees were in the middle of the garden. One of these gave life—the other gave the wisdom to know the difference between right and wrong.

dag: Naawuni vuhim n-tahiri maasim na, nti chɛ ka ko titaŋa kilim.
en: Gods breath makes ice and freezes even large bodies of water.

dag: N teeg a ni mali yɛda maŋli shɛl la yɛla. Di nyɛla yɛda shɛli a yabipaɣa Lɔis mini a ma Yunis ni daa mal la tatabo, ka m mi ni a gba shiri mal li.
en: Im reminded of your authentic faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice. Im sure that this faith is also inside you.

dag: Bɛ noya ni yɛtɔɣa piinimi ni jɛritali, ka naari ni putɔɣu ni yinyari.
en: Fools begin by saying something foolish. But in the end, they speak nonsense.

dag: Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim kuhiya, ka bɛ kuhigu maa chaŋ ti paai Jahaz mini Zɔa ni Hɔrɔnaim ni Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama hal Nimrim kom gba nyuuya.
en: The people of Heshbon and Elealeh cry out, and their cry can be heard as far as Jahaz; it can be heard by the people in Zoar, and it is heard as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah. Even Nimrim Brook has dried up.

dag: Mɔɣisim n kpariŋ; a yurilim so wain.
en: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine.

dag: Bɛ nini yi ti nya bi shɛba n ni yɛn ti ba, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-tum lala maa, ka ti ma jilima ka lu man ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura.
en: Yes, when they see all their children, the children I myself have made for them, they will honor my name as holy. They will honor the Holy One of Jacob, and they will respect the God of Israel.

dag: Dahin shɛli n ni daa yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim Ijipti la na hal ni wayo n daa bi pii Izraɛl zuliya ni fɔntin shɛli ni bɛ me duu ka n yuli be nimaani amaa ka daa piila Dauda ni o su n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: From the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt I havent selected a city from any Israelite tribe as a site for the building of a temple for my name. But now I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kun ya, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi sɔŋ ya?.
en: Israel, I helped you, but you turned against me. So now I will destroy you.

dag: Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu! Bɛ pala zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni niŋ niriba shɛm, lala ka bɛ yɛn niŋ bɛ gba.
en: But evil people are doomed; what they have done to others will now be done to them.

dag: Ka o yi bi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuuni maa puuni, dindina yili din be bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni maa ni leela ŋun da li maa dini sahakam o ʒiɛman ni, ka di bi simdi ka bɛ ti deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o suhupiɛlli min o churi puhibu ni o goli paliga churi puhibu ni o vuhim dabisa ni o ni zali chu shɛŋa zaa la zani tariga.
en: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri bɛ tumtumsa ni, ka bɛ tuma maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi ʒe yim.
en: They made themselves impure by their actions and were unfaithful to God.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Kalidianim mini Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-dee li.
en: The Lord also said, I will soon give the city of Jerusalem to the Babylonian army and to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. The army will capture the city.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn guli piɛri mini niɣi, ka ʒi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi maa ni bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa na.
en: I will tell him that you are shepherds and that you have brought your sheep, goats, cattle, and everything else you own.

dag: Ka Ashikɛlɔnnim nya li, ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka Gazanim gba nya li, ka di zab ba pam. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛkurɔnnim gba, ka bɛ tahima zaa ni bɔrigi. Gaza ni kɔŋ naa, ka Ashikɛlɔn kpalim zan dabari.
en: The city of Ashkelon will see this and be afraid. The city of Gaza will see it and suffer great pain. So will Ekron, and her hopes will be shattered. Gaza will lose her king, and Ashkelon will be left deserted.

dag: N ni siɣina ti tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani; ka zaŋ shi so ŋun be a zuɣu maa yiko shɛli niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ ʒi niriba maa ʒili maa sɔŋ a, ka a kɔŋko ku lan ʒi li.
en: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the spirit I have given you and give it to them. Then they can help you bear the responsibility for these people, and you will not have to bear it alone.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu, hal n ni mali suhukpeeni Masia zuɣu ni n tooi wuh a di ni niŋ kamaata ni a niŋ shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: There is something that you should do. And because of the authority I have in Christ, I feel free to command you to do it.

dag: O daa lan ʒila o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba hal ti yaɣi.
en: He said this because he didnt know how to respond, for the three of them were terrified.

dag: Yisa daa yiɣisi bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni yi n-chaŋ ti kpɛla Saimɔn yiŋa; ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii pam, ka bɛ balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.

dag: dama n sani, di bi tuhi ni n chɛ ka bɛ tahi dansarika so Naa Siiza sani ka m bi sabi wuhi o taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: After all, it would be foolish to send a prisoner without specifying the charges against him.

dag: Dama yi zaŋ yi nyɔri mini yi bɔɣusapima ni yi yila daai biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la zaa hal ti wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu katiŋa.
en: You pushed the sick ones aside and butted them away from the flock.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu yi yi bi chɛri yi mabihi taali paŋdi ba yi suhuri ni, lala ka m Ba Naawuni gba ti yɛn niŋ yi zaa yinoyino.
en: This king did the same as my heavenly Father will do to you. You must forgive your brother or sister with all your heart, or my heavenly Father will not forgive you.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun wuhir a tab ŋɔ, a ku wuh amaŋa? Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di zu, a nyɛla ŋun zura?.
en: then why dont you who are teaching others teach yourself? If you preach, No stealing, do you steal?.

dag: a yi bo li kaman anzinfa la, ka bo li ni nimmoo kaman azichi shɛli din sɔɣi la.
en: Look for it as hard as you would for silver or some hidden treasure.

dag: Ka pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Ribɛka ni daa zaŋ jahi pua ti yab Yisahaku sani.
en: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Nyama, n lan nya dimbɔŋɔ, n zaŋla binshɛŋa pahi di tab ni ni m baŋ di laasabu.
en: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka dab paɣ bia maa gba nam zuliya, dama o gba nyɛla a zuliya.
en: I will also give many children to the son of the slave woman, so that they will become a nation. He too is your son.

dag: Di kɔŋkɔba bebu din pahi nyɛla, di daa simdi ni bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔbili bɛ ni daa kpiri ka bɛ tuma zaani tariga la zuɣu;.
en: There is another difference: there were many of those other priests, because they died and could not continue their work.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, dindali maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, So di dam o kɔba; kul chɛliya li ka di doya baalim. Ka bɛ daa chɛ o mini anab so ŋun daa yi Samaria la na kɔba.
en: Josiah said, Leave the man of God alone. Dont move his bones. So they left his bones and the bones of the man of God from Samaria.

dag: ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni so sani yi ni tim ma ni n ti zaŋ yi fabila sɔŋ o tooni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then Jeremiah said to them, You sent me to the Lord , the God of Israel, and I asked him what you wanted me to ask. This is what he says:.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi nyɛla din tuhi ni jilima ka yi ti Gidiɔn min o malibu maa, yin maliya suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ Abimilɛk sani, ka o gba mali suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: so if youve acted faithfully and innocently toward Jerubbaal and his household today, then be happy with Abimelech and let him be happy with you.

dag: Ka Omri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa wuhi kpiɔŋ shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Omris deeds and his powerful acts, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi tampiŋ ni na n-zɔri kaman mɔɣa kom la.
en: He brought a stream of water out of the rock and made it flow like a river!.

dag: Doo kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu;.
en: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.

dag: O daa tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim hal ti paai Gaza mini di tintariga tinsi; ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili di fɔntinsi.
en: Hezekiah defeated the Philistine towns as far away as Gaza—from the smallest towns to the large, walled cities.

dag: Ka banima n-daa lee ku Naawuni suli yuun pihinahi puuni la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa tum alahichi ka kpi n-do yɔɣu ni la?.
en: And who was God angry with for years? He was angry with those who sinned. And their dead bodies were left in the desert.

dag: Gbaam amaŋ ni jɛritali yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu, dama a mi ni di bahigu tahirila naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu na.
en: But keep away from foolish and ignorant arguments; you know that they end up in quarrels.

dag: Di chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la nyaŋ ma, ka di dari niŋ ma; a mi di chɛ ka bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri la chani n-kaɣiri bɛ nina lihiri ma.
en: Dont let those who are my enemies without cause celebrate over me; dont let those who hate me for no reason wink at my demise.

dag: ni Ɛnrimɔn ni Zɔra ni Jarimut.
en: in En-rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth.

dag: dama o kanna ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O ni ti doli wuntia soli kari dunianim saria, O ni ti zaŋ yɛlimaŋli soli kari niriba saria.
en: Sing before the Lord because he is coming to judge the world. He will rule the world fairly. He will rule the people with goodness.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti lab bɛ yilikpɛrili na ka bɛ bɔh o yɛtɔɣ yini maa gbinni yaha.
en: Later, when the followers and Jesus were in the house, they asked him again about the question of divorce.

dag: N daa bi di bindir nyaɣisili bee ŋ-ŋub nimdi bee n-chɛ ka wain to n noli, m mi daa bi niŋ kpam ʒe n ni hal ka bakɔi muna ata maa ti gari.
en: I didnt eat any rich foods. Neither meat nor wine passed my lips, and I didnt clean up at all until the three weeks were up.

dag: Hal n ni kul ka taali maa zaa yoli n ku tooi garig o. N naɣ ni suhila ŋun zaŋ ma taali maa, ka o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: Even if Im innocent, I cant answer; I must plead for justice.

dag: Ka yi yi bi tum taali ka diri wahala, ka mali suɣilo di puuni Naawuni zuɣu, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani.
en: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Do so ŋun yɛl ti lala maa yɛla biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ gbaŋ lo o shee ni. Ka o yɛli, Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la m-bala.
en: They said to him, He wore clothes made of hair with a leather belt around his waist. Ahaziah said, That was Elijah from Tishbe.

dag: O gurim ma ʒili, ka di leei shɛhira jɛndi ma; ka n kɔɣisibu nyɛ din di shɛhira jɛndi ma.
en: seized me, which became grounds for an accusation. My leanness rises to bear witness against me.

dag: Zakaria ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Karimi saria n-ti ma nasara, lihimi din tuhi.
en: You will make the right decision, because you can see the truth.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa be bɛ ni galim Yisa nyaandoliba maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi diri ka nyura.
en: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners.

dag: Ka Firawuna tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa buri bɛ mi ni daa pii Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ lihiri bɛ tab maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ŋma bilichiisi sɔhila mini zuŋɔ kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm dabisili kam la.
en: The Israelite supervisors, whom Pharaohs slave masters had set over them, were also beaten and asked, Why didnt you produce the same number of bricks yesterday and today as you did before.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni saɣim yɛnnim yɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali fahim fahim ŋari.
en: The scripture says, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise and set aside the understanding of the scholars.

dag: Ka Husham daa ti kpi, ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛdad bia, ka nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi nyaŋ Midiannim Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa di nam zan o zaani, o ya yuli n-daa booni Avit.
en: When Husham died, Hadad, Bedads son who defeated Midian in the Moabite countryside, succeeded him; his city was called Avith.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn zaŋ tuuli piɛbil maa mali sara maa, yin zaŋmiya zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini mini kpa viɛlli lita yini gari taba n-zaŋ wain shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ booi bahi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu lita yini m-pahi mali sara maa.
en: With the first lamb offer two pounds of fine wheat flour mixed with one quart of pure olive oil. Pour out one quart of wine as an offering.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ti pin kɔŋkɔb shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zaŋ li tum tuma ŋun Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ ti ni la zuɣu: Naawuni ni ti ti pin shɛli yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, chɛliya ka ti tɔɣisi li kaman ti yɛda ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: So we are to use our different gifts in accordance with the grace that God has given us. If our gift is to speak God's message, we should do it according to the faith that we have;.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nya du kara ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Jesus replied, Do you see these huge buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.

dag: ni Ɛliab ni Jɛrɔham ni Ɛlikana.
en: Eliab was Nahaths son. Jeroham was Eliabs son. Elkanah was Jerohams son. Samuel was Elkanahs son.

dag: Lala zuɣu ti suhuri saɣimmi; dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ti nina fulimmi.
en: Because of all this our heart is sick; because of these things our glance is dark.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya di puuni na nti zaŋ ya niŋ tinzunnim nuu ni, ka bɛ kari ya saria.
en: I will take you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners. I have sentenced you to death.

dag: N ni yihi ba Ijipti mini Asiria labisina ti ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni zaŋ ba ʒili Giliad mini Lɛbanɔn, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ti pali niriba hal ka palo ti ku lan beni.
en: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.

dag: Ka Ammɔn kpamba daa bɔhi Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni jilima ka o ti a ba maa? O tuumba maa kamina ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ ya ŋɔ daashili zaa, ka o kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: the Ammonite leaders said to the king, Do you think that it is in your father's honor that David has sent these men to express sympathy to you? Of course not! He has sent them here as spies to explore the land, so that he can conquer it.

dag: Ka o daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na. O daa nyɛla ŋun mal alaafee, ka o nimbihi kul viɛla, ka o lan nyɛ nachimbil viɛlli. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Yiɣisim booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni; ŋuna m-bala.
en: So Jesse sent and brought him in. He was reddish brown, had beautiful eyes, and was good-looking. The LORD said, Thats the one. Go anoint him.

dag: ka Joyada nyɛ Jɔnatan ba; ka Jɔnatan mi nyɛ Jadua ba.
en: Joiada the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan the father of Jaddua.

dag: Ninsal shia yi mali yaa di deeri dɔro, amaa nira kɔba ni yi chɔɣisi, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi gbibi li?.
en: The human spirit sustains a sick person, but who can bear a broken spirit?.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi, ka o chaŋ Ɛhab sani Samaria. Ka Ɛhab daa kɔri piɛri mini niɣi pam n-niŋ o mini bɛn daa kana saani, ka daa balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima.
en: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din kuri niriba mini fiɛɣufiɛɣu ni bimmɔrima ni biisim titali ni sanzali ni yi ni bi mi dɔr shɛŋa ni maligu lu yi zuɣu m-mali ya hal ka yi ti kpi.
en: The Lord will strike you with infectious diseases, with swelling and fever; he will send drought and scorching winds to destroy your crops. These disasters will be with you until you die.

dag: Sokam dirila tiŋgbani daatam, hal naa gba dirila tiŋgbani daatam anfaani.
en: Even the king is a slave—his country owns him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun pihinahi maa yi ti naai n ni yihi Ijiptinim maa bɛ ni daa wurim be ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni na.
en: The LORD God proclaims: At the end of forty years, I will gather the Egyptians from among the nations where they are scattered.

dag: Ka Maata yɛl o, M mi ni o ni ti neei kum ni zaadali.
en: I know, she replied, that he will rise to life on the last day.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ni saɣim alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima, ka zaɣisi n nol la zuɣu.
en: The Lord was angry with Israel and said: The Israelites have broken the agreement I made with their ancestors. They won't obey me.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara pam; dinzuɣu timiya Naawuni jilima yi niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: he bought you for a price. So use your bodies for God's glory.

dag: Kaman paɣili ni bi simdi siɣili saha shɛm bee di ni bi simdi ni saa mi puri atam kpuɣibu saha shɛm, lala ka jilima bi simdi jɛrigu.
en: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.

dag: Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, a kul yoli piligimi n-wuhir a dabili a galisim min a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, wuni ŋuni n-lee be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani zuɣu n-ni tooi tum yiko tuma mini tuun kar shɛŋa a ni tum ŋɔ?.
en: Please, LORD God! You have only begun to show your servant your greatness and your mighty hand. What god in heaven or on earth can act as you do or can perform your deeds and powerful acts?.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi di daa maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o dini.
en: If you wish to buy your house back, you must pay the price plus an additional percent.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ ŋubiri bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka bɛ zaa ti ŋubiri taba bɛ dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya ka teei gili ba la nahiŋgu zuɣu.
en: The enemy will surround the city and try to kill its people. The siege will be so terrible that the people inside the city will eat one another and even their own children.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: Two women will be grinding grain with a mill. One will be taken and the other will be left.

dag: Di wuhi ni a nyɛla wuntizɔra ti yaɣi, a mi di wuhi ni a nyɛla yɛndan ti yaɣi. Di niŋ lala ku amaŋa.
en: Dont be too righteous or too wise, or you may be dumbfounded.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama bɛn be ti sani gari bɛn be bɛ sani.
en: Dont be afraid, Elisha said, because there are more of us than there are of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia gbarigimi n ni, ka n yihi tahima n suhu ni.
en: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.

dag: Dama di ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka chɛ ka a biɛhigu tɔŋ pam.
en: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.

dag: Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ bɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa la puhibu dali mini Yawɛ chuɣu puhibu dali?.
en: They will not be able to celebrate the Lord s feasts or festivals.

dag: Ti yi zaŋ Naawuni Shia yɛla biri yi suhuri ni, dindina di zooya ni ti deei dunia ŋɔ ni binyara yi sani?.
en: We have sown spiritual seed among you. Is it too much if we reap material benefits from you?.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sagban piɛlli, ka so ʒi di zuɣu ŋ-ŋmani daadam ka pil salima nam zuɣupiligu, ka gbib gɔr dirili o nuu ni.
en: Then I looked, and there was a white cloud. On the cloud was seated someone who looked like the Human One. He had a gold crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

dag: tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Kolɔsai ka nyɛ ti mabihi bɛn ʒe yim Masia san la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: To the holy and faithful brothers and sisters in Christ in Colossae. Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba bɛn be kasi. Yawɛ n-daa pii ya dunia ŋɔ zuliya pam sunsuuni n-leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: This is because you are different from other people. You belong to the Lord your God. From all the people in the world, the Lord chose you to be his own special people.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima din ŋmɛli kaman gabisi maa n-gɔhi bansi diba ayi din be nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya maa.
en: and fasten the two gold cords to the two rings.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila! Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi ti naa maa. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila!.
en: Sing praise to God; sing praise to our king!.

dag: Zaŋ hal ni ʒiɛmani din pahiri buta ni, yi ni tooi deei bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Children born to them are permitted to belong to the LORDs assembly starting with the third generation.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka ti Duuma daa kana nti zani baɣili Pool yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, dama a ni niŋ n shɛhiralana Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka a ni ti niŋ n shɛhiralana Rom gba.
en: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, Be encouraged! Just as you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so too you must testify in Rome.

dag: Ka Sool daa tɛh o suhu ni, N ni zaŋ o ti Dauda ka o leei tɔŋ gbaag o, ka Filistianim ku o. Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa lan yɛli Dauda pahi buyi, Pumpɔŋɔ a yi pa ni leei n deemba.
en: He said to himself, I'll give Michal to David; I will use her to trap him, and he will be killed by the Philistines. So for the second time Saul said to David, You will be my son-in-law.

dag: O kul ku nyari nir taali sahakam, bee n-jɛri suli sahakam.
en: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;.

dag: Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ naa min o nabihi kuli tinzun tiŋ ni, Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Yaakubu min o bidibisi. Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bituuli la.
en: The members of Jacob's family who went to Egypt with him were his oldest son Reuben.

dag: Ka Tomas bɔh o, N Duuma, ti bi mi a ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka wula ka ti ni tooi baŋ di soli.
en: Thomas said to him, Lord, we do not know where you are going; so how can we know the way to get there.

dag: O ni doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o lan yɛn doli labi; o ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will go back by the same road he came, without entering this city. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋmi li bahi tiŋa. Ka o zaŋ li bahi tiŋa ka di leei wahu, ka Musa tirisi lab nyaaŋa ka chɛ li.
en: Then God said, Throw your walking stick on the ground. So Moses threw his walking stick on the ground, and it became a snake. Moses ran from it.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔŋ mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its guardrooms, its entrance room, and its inner walls measured the same as those in the other gateways. There were windows all around, and in the entrance room also. The total length was feet and the width feet.

dag: Ka o daa va bɛ nɛma zaa, ka zaŋ o dɔɣim Lɔt min o nɛma gba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni paɣiba m-pahi labina.
en: and got back all the loot that had been taken. He also brought back his nephew Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other prisoners.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o puli paana, o noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o lan tiɣira.
en: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.

dag: O ni daa di wahala kpi la nyaaŋa o daa lan zaŋ omaŋa wuhi ba shihira balibu pam puuni ni o shiri neei kum ni. Ka bɛ nina daa nya o ka bɛ min o be hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o daa wuhi ba Naawuni nam yɛla pam.
en: After his suffering, he showed them that he was alive with many convincing proofs. He appeared to them over a period of forty days, speaking to them about Gods kingdom.

dag: Mɔabnim daa zaŋla piɛbila n-yi Sɛla din be tiŋgban nɛli polo la kana ti ti ŋun diri nam ʒi Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: Send lambs to the ruler of the land, from Sela through the desert to the mountain of Daughter Zion.

dag: Bɛ laɣiŋgu maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka Yɛhudianim mini niriba pam bɛn daa doli Yɛhudianim daadiini soli kabiri doli Pool mini Baanabas. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ni bɛ kul kpalimmi be Naawuni daanfaani ni.
en: When the people in the synagogue were dismissed, many Jews and devout converts to Judaism accompanied Paul and Barnabas, who urged them to remain faithful to the message of Gods grace.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa kpila maa ka yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti lan zaŋ li gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla ninsal ʒim liɣiri.
en: The chief priests picked up the silver pieces and said, According to the Law its not right to put this money in the treasury. Since it was used to pay for someones life, its unclean.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God. I brought you out of the land of Egypt to give the land of Canaan to you and to become your God.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jahat mini Zina ni Jɛushi ni Bɛraya, bɛ niriba anahi maa n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi bidibisi.
en: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ saha shɛli yin ni nya o. Suhimiy o saha shɛli o ni miri ya.
en: Turn to the Lord and pray to him, now that he is near.

dag: O ŋmɛri bɔbili din nyaɣisira pari kom zuɣu o nyaaŋa. So ni tɛhi ni kɔbulli maa ni nyɛla zabipiɛla.
en: He leaves a shining path behind him and turns the sea to white foam.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka yi nimaani; ka niriba pam daa dol o, ka o chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni zaa kpaŋ.
en: Jesus knew what the Pharisees were planning. So he left that place, and many people followed him. He healed all who were sick.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba sahakam; ka nyin Yawɛ nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: You established your people Israel as your own people forever, and you, LORD, became their God.

dag: Yawɛ, hal a ni kul be zuɣusaa ha maa zaa yoli, a baɣa be tarimba ni, amaa a be katiŋ ka chɛ karimbaannima.
en: The Lord has the highest place above all others, but he still cares for the humble. Even from there, so high above, he knows what the proud do.

dag: Daadam ni tooi lo nianim pam o suhu ni, amaa Yawɛ ni yu shɛli n-niŋda.
en: People might make many plans, but what the Lord says is what will happen.

dag: Ya polo ka Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva buɣa la lee be? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A tuhi tɔbu pam, ka ku niriba pam, di bi simdi ka a me jɛmbu duu n-ti ma jilima, dama a ku niriba pam dunia ŋɔ ni n ninni.
en: But the Lord said to me, David, you have fought many wars and you have killed many people. So you cannot build a temple for my name.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu, Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa waawaayili ka yi zaɣisi wumbu, ka n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku saɣi.
en: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the LORD, because you havent listened when I spoke to you again and again or responded when I called you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ, bɛna n-nyɛ o zɔnima, ka o kahigir o daalikauli wuhiri ba.
en: The Lord is the friend of those who obey him and he affirms his covenant with them.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa kurigi zaa, ka o dabisa ti pali ka o naanyi kpi.
en: And then he died at a very great age.

dag: Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba: Sɔtai daŋ niriba mini Sofɛrɛt daŋ niriba ni Pɛrida daŋ niriba.
en: Clans of Solomon's servants who returned from exile: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Amon.

dag: Naaman ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa sapashin kpɛma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali, ka mali jilima pam o naa maa sani, dama o zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa tiri Sirianim nasara. O daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhir biiŋa; amaa ka kɔŋ lee mal o.
en: Naaman was the captain of the army of the king of Aram. He was very important to his king because the Lord used him to lead Aram to victory. Naaman was a great and powerful man, but he was also sick with leprosy.

dag: Ka n daa wum yɛtɔɣa kukolibil ni, ka n tibili daa wum di ni sɔɣiri yɛra.
en: Once a message came quietly, so quietly I could hardly hear it.

dag: ka yɛli Taai din be teeku noli, ka bɛ mini tin shɛŋa din be teeku duli nim niŋdi daabiligu la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, a yɛliya, N viɛl zaa.
en: that city which stands at the edge of the sea and does business with the people living on every seacoast. Tell her what the Sovereign Lord is saying: Tyre, you boasted of your perfect beauty.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuɣulaannima, Yi zaa yinoyino kum yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe Pɛɔr Baal jɛmbu ni maa.
en: Moses told Israel's officials, Each of you must put to death any of your men who worshiped Baal.

dag: N ni ti wurim yi fɔntinsi din be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka daai yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa luhi.
en: I will cut down the cities of your land; I will tear down your defenses!.

dag: Dama n leela ŋun ka buchi kaman wain koligu din yili nyɔhi ni; amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ daa bi niŋ o daalikauli yɛda, ka daa ʒiɛm tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa.
en: But then they rejected the land that was so desirable. They didnt trust Gods promise.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa suhi Yawɛ ti o paɣ maa, dama o daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo; ka Yawɛ daa deeg o suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka o paɣ Ribɛka niŋ pua.
en: Rebekah still had no children. So Isaac asked the Lord to let her have a child, and the Lord answered his prayer.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka n paɣir a dahin yini, a wuntia zaligunim la zuɣu.
en: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.

dag: Ŋun kur niriba yiɣisirila zaawuni n-chana ni o ku nandaamba mini faranima. Yuŋ yi paai, o ŋmanila tayiɣa.
en: The murderer rises at twilight, kills the poor and needy; at night, they are like a thief.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛri ya, Pumpɔŋɔ, yi zaa zomiya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu ni din ni chɛ ka yi kul kpalim be Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim kurimbuni ha la ni sahakam.
en: They said, Each one of you, turn from your evil ways and deeds and live in the fertile land that the LORD gave you and your ancestors for all time.

dag: Ka Ibram daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa, ka Naawuni yɛl o.
en: Abram bowed down with his face touching the ground, and God said.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa zaŋ kpani to o ni o ku o; di saha ka Jɔnatan daa baŋ ni o ba shiri loya ni o ku Dauda.
en: At that, Saul threw his spear at Jonathan to strike him, and Jonathan realized that his father intended to kill David.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, dama bɛ daa bɔrimi ni bɛ nya o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: The Pharisees wanted to accuse Jesus of doing something wrong, and they kept watching to see if Jesus would heal him on the Sabbath.

dag: Yuria ni daa ka Dauda sanna, ka o ti puh o bɔhi Jɔab mini tɔbbihi maa zaa yɛla ni tɔb maa ni chani shɛm.
en: to David's palace, and David asked him, Is Joab well? How is the army doing? And how about the war.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti sɔ yi dini.
en: But I say to you that it will be better for the land of Sodom on the Judgment Day than it will be for you.

dag: Yi yi me yil palli, yin niŋm bini kɔɣili yi mɔpilli ti tuui, di yi pa lala so yi yi di zuɣu luna kpi o ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi yili maa zuɣu.
en: Whenever you build a new house, you must build a railing for the roof so that you dont end up with innocent blood on your hands because someone fell off of it.

dag: Ibrahimma daa lan kpuɣi paɣ so. O yuli n-daa booni Kɛtuura.
en: Abraham married again. His new wife was named Keturah.

dag: Yawɛ ni ka o niriba sanna; o ni to o piɛma ka di be kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ni ti piɛb kikaa; ka ni ti be nudirigu polo pɔhim ni kanna.
en: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.

dag: Dɔro di bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa, kum bituuli di bɛ nuhi min bɛ naba.
en: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.

dag: Dama Naa mi yɛla ŋɔ zaa, di zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri li bahiri mmaŋa o sani maa; yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli bi sɔɣi o sani, dama di daa bi niŋla ashilɔni.
en: King Agrippa knows about all this, and I can speak freely to him. I know that he has heard about these things, because they happened where everyone could see them.

dag: dama kaman Naawuni ni daa yihi paɣa doo ni na shɛm, lala zuɣu ka paɣ gba dɔɣiri doo pumpɔŋɔ. Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla Naawuni ni nam shɛli.
en: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.

dag: Ŋunkam deei n zaligu ka dol li, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun yuri ma; ka m Ba ni yuri ŋun yuri ma maa, ka n gba ni yuri dilana ka kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir o.
en: Those who accept my commandments and obey them are the ones who love me. My Father will love those who love me; I too will love them and reveal myself to them.

dag: ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam, ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: The stars will fall from the sky, and everything in the sky will be changed.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Sool daa yihi Dauda o sani n-zaŋ o leei tɔbbihi tuhili zuɣulana, ka o daa zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ka labirina.
en: Saul sent David away and made him a commander over soldiers. This put David out among the men even more as they went into battle and returned.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n fabindi Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman kalambua ka bɛ piɛbiri la, dama bɛ ni daa nya bun shɛli zaa la naaya.
en: Therefore, my heart wails for Moab like a mournful flute that plays the dirge; my heart wails for the people of Kir-heres, like a mournful flute. Their abundance is now gone.

dag: Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn zaŋ saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisi ka o chɛ ka bɛ wum? Nyama, bɛ tiba ŋarimi, bɛ ku tooi wum. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla ansarisi bini bɛ sani. Bɛ baɣa ka di ni.
en: Who can I speak to? Who can I warn? Who will listen to me? The people of Israel have closed their ears, so they cannot hear my warnings. They dont like the Lord s teachings. They dont want to hear his message.

dag: N daa kuhi boli n zɔnima, amaa ka bɛ yɔhim ma. M maligumaaniba mini n kpamba daa kpila tiŋ maa ni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bɔri bindirigu ni bɛ di n-nya yaa la.
en: I called to my allies, but they refused to help me. The priests and the leaders died in the city streets, Looking for food to keep themselves alive.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisifu daa ti yɛn kpi ka teei n-tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm yɛla zali; ka daa wuhi ba bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sɔɣibu polo.
en: And when Joseph was almost dead, he spoke about the people of Israel leaving Egypt. And he told them what they should do with his body. He did this because he had faith.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Man bi mi bee m-baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Ka zo n-yi nti ʒe dunol ni, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Peter replied, That isn't true! I don't know what you're talking about. I don't have any idea what you mean. He went out to the gate, and a rooster crowed.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka n paɣir a dahin yini, a wuntia zaligunim la zuɣu.
en: I praise you seven times a day for your righteous rules.

dag: Di saha maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Filistia Teeku noli ni ti yɛli, Nyamiya din niŋ ti ni zaŋ ti tahima niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni la mini ti ni daa zo nti paai shɛb ni bɛ fa ti Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tiligi? .
en: When that time comes, the people who live along the coast of Philistia will say, Look at what has happened to the people we relied on to protect us from the emperor of Assyria! How will we ever survive.

dag: Di pa shɛli n niŋgbuŋ mini n suhu zaa ni ti gbarigi. Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ n suhu ni ni ŋun kul su ma sahakam.
en: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa wum yi yɛligu maa ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o po pɔri yɛli.
en: The Lord heard your complaints and became angry, and so he solemnly declared.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka niŋdi n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka doli n zaligunim zaa.
en: If you serve me faithfully as your father David did, obeying my laws and doing everything I have commanded you.

dag: Siliga maa bela Makipɛla pu shɛli din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ibrahimma n-daa da siliga maa Ɛfurɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la sani n-leeg o dini ni di nyɛ o ni yɛn sɔɣir o kpiimba luɣ shɛli.
en: in the cave thats in the field of Machpelah near Mamre in the land of Canaan that Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite as a burial property.

dag: O ni daa paɣi bɛ naba maa naai, ka o zaŋ o kparibu ye n-lab ti ʒini ka bɔhi ba, Yi baŋ n ni niŋ ya shɛm ŋɔ gbinni?.
en: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sujee kuri jɛrigu, ka nyuli zabbu mi kuri ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa zaa daa kana ti gar o zuɣu, ka Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim ni Gaatinim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa doli naa yi Gaat la na zaa daa gar o tooni.
en: All his officials stood next to him as the royal bodyguards passed by in front of him. The six hundred soldiers who had followed him from Gath also passed by.

dag: Dan zuliya n-daa pah ayopɔin n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The lot went out seventh for the clans of the Danite tribe.

dag: Ka bɛ yi boli so na ni o ti di o nini ni nya shɛli bee o ni mi shɛli yɛla shɛhira, amaa ka o zaɣisi ka bi yɛli shɛli, o tum alahichi, ka o taali maa ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: Sin offerings are required in the following cases. If you are officially summoned to give evidence in court and do not give information about something you have seen or heard, you must suffer the consequences.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: The Israelites divided up the land exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yinim lzraɛlnim bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani, miriya ka yi ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni.
en: That is why the Lord has told the people of Israel that neither they nor any foreigner living among them shall eat any meat with blood still in it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: When they had finished making fun of him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes back on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan ku Ijipti do so ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣirili, ka o wɔɣilim daa gari mita ayi la. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni ka di barilim daa ŋmani kpalua dapua. Amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa o kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man seven and a half feet tall, who was armed with a gigantic spear. Benaiah attacked him with a club, snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand, and killed him with it.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ŋub o suhudoo sara maligu maa nimdi daba ata maa dali, dilan sara maligu maa ku lan gbaai, ka bɛ ku kal li kpɛhi sara maligu ni, di ni ti nyɛla din bi be kasi, ka ŋun ti ŋub li ni ti ʒi di zambu.
en: If anyone eats the meat from the fellowship offering on the third day, the Lord will not accept it as a sacrifice. It will have no value for that person, and to the Lord it will be like rotten meat! Whoever eats it will be responsible for their sin.

dag: Di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-diri ti shɛhira ti suhuri ni ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.

dag: Ti teei ti ni daa yi ŋubiri zahim shɛli yoli Ijipti la mini kukombanim ni watamilo ni gabo ni alibarisa ni tafarinom la yɛla;.
en: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o mapira dɔni, dama o nyɛla a ma dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: You must not have sexual contact with your mothers sister because she is your mothers blood relative.

dag: N yɛn yuuni bɔrila bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni bɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Juda ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, tɔbu mini kum ni ku ba hal ka bɛ ni yino ti ku kpalim.
en: Instead of watching over you, I will watch for chances to harm you. Some of you will die in war, and others will starve to death.

dag: To, ka yi yi ti nya ka Daadam Bia labiri o ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la, wula ka di lee ni ti ben ya?.
en: What if you were to see the Human One going up where he was before?.

dag: Zaŋm Lɛvi zuliya na nti zali Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la tooni, ka bɛ sɔŋd o.
en: Bring forward the tribe of Levi and appoint them as servants of Aaron the priest.

dag: Naawuni, nyini m-pun wuhi ma m bilim ni ha, ka n na kul mooni a daalahiziba tuma molo.
en: God, you have taught me since I was a young boy. And to this day I have told people about the wonderful things you do.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ yo shɛb daa yɛra, Wula ka doo ŋɔ yɛn tooi niŋ tiligi ti? Ka bɛ daa ʒiɛm o, ka zaɣis o pina tibu. Amaa ka o daa kul shini.
en: But some despicable people said, How can this man save us? They despised Saul and didnt bring him gifts, but Saul didnt say anything.

dag: N tuhi tuhiri suŋ; n zo tizɔbo la naai; n gbib yɛda niŋbu la.
en: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the race. I have served the Lord faithfully.

dag: Yinim zoomba ŋɔ, bina ayi maa ni dini n-lee gari di kpee: Sara maa bee bimbini din chɛ ka sara maa be kasi maa?.
en: You blind people! Which is greater, the gift or the altar that makes the gift holy?.

dag: Ŋunkam tiri nandaamba pini, shɛli ku poog o, amaa ŋunkam lab o nini kpaŋa, noli ni di o.
en: Those who give to the poor will lack nothing, but those who turn a blind eye will be greatly cursed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ba. Ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu;.
en: Then the people brought their little children to Jesus so that he could lay his hands on them to bless them and pray for them. When the followers saw this, they told the people to stop bringing their children to him.

dag: Ka o daa ti zaŋ bɛ farigu tahi ti yo Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn. Naa Ɛgilɔn daa nyɛla ninvuɣ karili.
en: So Ehud brought the gift to King Eglon of Moab. Eglon was a very fat man.

dag: Ram daa nyɛla Aminadab ba, ka Aminadab daa nyɛ Nashɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Juda bidibisi ni asanza nir la ba.
en: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii zuɣulaannim ti ba; ka zuɣulaannim maa daa tiligi ba ŋmɛnditoya maa nuu ni.
en: Then the Lord chose leaders called judges. These leaders saved the Israelites from the enemies who took their possessions.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi Ɛlamnim bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba sani. N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yɛlibiɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni chɛ ka tɔbu lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n ti kpihim bɛ birili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make the people of Elam afraid of their enemies, who want to kill them. In my great anger I will destroy the people of Elam and send armies against them until I have wiped them out.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili puuni ka a daa no tiŋgbani. A sujee puuni ka a daa du n-tam zuliya shɛb zuɣu no ba.
en: In anger you walked on the earth and punished the nations.

dag: N dabili Musa kpiya, dinzuɣu a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa yiɣisim pumpɔŋɔ n-chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yinim Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni.
en: He said, My servant Moses is dead. Get ready now, you and all the people of Israel, and cross the Jordan River into the land that I am giving them.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli yili wumpaɣibo yila.
en: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord .

dag: Ka hal bɛ dimnim yi gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya ka bɛ ti nyɛ daba, n ni chɛ ka be zaŋ takɔbi ku ba nimaani. N ni pa n nini lihiri ba n-niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni zaɣ suŋ.
en: If they are forced from their homes before their enemies, there I will give an order to the sword, and it will kill them. I will fix my eyes on them for harm and not for good.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn wuhi ba mi, n ni wuhi ba n yaa mini n yiko, ka bɛ baŋ ni n yuli m booni Yawɛ.
en: Therefore, I will teach them; this time I will teach them my power and my might. They will understand that I am the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni omaŋmaŋ n-yɛn nyɛ buɣim gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm n-gul li, ka be di ni ni o jilima zaa.
en: The Lord has promised that he himself will be a wall of fire around the city to protect it and that he will live there in all his glory.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Naawuni nam kana ni yiko.
en: Then Jesus said, Believe me when I say that some of you people standing here will see Gods kingdom come with power before you die.

dag: Ka Pool mi daa pii Silas pah omaŋ zuɣu ka yɛdaniŋdiba daa zaŋ ba niŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni, ka bɛ mi naanyi chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ wain tihi puri ni nti nya di daai pum. Ti cham ti nya di puma maa yirigiya, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi gba daai pum. Nimaani ka n ni wuh a n ni yur a shɛm.
en: We will get up early and look at the vines to see whether they've started to grow, whether the blossoms are opening and the pomegranate trees are in bloom. There I will give you my love.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, o kul kumdila pampam, ka nintam zo n-tiɛl o kparima. O mamanim la zaa so lan kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. O zɔnim zaa yila o nyaaŋa; bɛ leela o dimnima.
en: She cries bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. She has no one to comfort her. Many nations were friendly to her, but not one of them comforts her now. All her friends have turned their backs on her and have become her enemies.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Ishibɔshɛt Sool bia maa polo na, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi mi yi Dauda tɔbbihi maa polo na.
en: So twelve men, representing Ishbosheth and the tribe of Benjamin, fought twelve of David's men.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra;.
en: So he said to his disciples, The harvest is large, but there are few workers to gather it in.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, n yur a pam.
en: I love you, Lord ! You are my strength.

dag: A chɛ ka daadamnim vuura kaman zahindi la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila mɔri din puhiri yirina asibaasi.
en: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass.

dag: Yawɛ ni be nyini n dan naa sani shɛm, o kul be Sulemaana gba sani lala ka chɛ ka o nam gari nyini n dan Naa Dauda nam.
en: The Lord has always watched over you, and I pray that he will now watch over Solomon. May the Lord help Solomon to be an even greater king than you.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya ʒii yuŋ ka ti Duuma yɛl o di ni, Di zɔri dabiɛm; kul yihim waazu maa ka di shini!.
en: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!.

dag: Zaŋm a nudirigu di nasara, ka deei ti suhigu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a fa a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bahi.
en: Use your great power and help us! Answer my prayer and save the people you love.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa kpalim be Gɛra. Ka nimaani nim ni daa ti bɔh o bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ polo.
en: So Isaac lived in Gerar.

dag: Ka di ni nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini zuɣu, tinim bɛn galisi ŋɔ gba nyɛla niŋgbun yini, dama ti zaa laɣindi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini maa.
en: Since there is one loaf of bread, we who are many are one body, because we all share the one loaf of bread.

dag: Ŋun daa pah ayɔbu n-su gol so ŋun pah ayɔbu ni n-daa nyɛ Ira. O daa nyɛla Ikɛsh ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa nir la bia; ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The sixth commander, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh from the town of Tekoa. There were , men in Iras group.

dag: Ka naa kpamba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, tinim bɛn nyɛ a kpamba ŋɔ mali shili ni ti niŋ nyini n dan naa ni lo shɛli.
en: The kings officers told him, We will do whatever you tell us.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa tim anab so Izraɛlnim sanna ka o ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti na, ka yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: and he sent them a prophet who brought them this message from the Lord , the God of Israel: I brought you out of slavery in Egypt.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli booni Judas la mini salo daa paana. Ka Judas daa chaŋ Yisa sani nti puh o ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: While Jesus was speaking, a crowd came up. It was led by Judas, one of the twelve apostles. He came over to Jesus to kiss him.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ leei binshɛli din bie, ka mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa sani, ka nya filiŋ mini ansarisi malibo ni turi, ka noli ni di ba n ni kari ba tahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba daa be Ofɛl, ka daa mali me hal ti paai Kom Dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la mini pia din daa du pam la shee.
en: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived.

dag: Amaa kul ʒiɛnya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim kaman yi ni pun niŋdi shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ la.
en: Be as faithful to the Lord as you have always been.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Ka di sambani mini di duu ni goma wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: Then he measured the temple. It was one hundred fifty feet long. The yard, the structure, and its walls were also one hundred fifty feet.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka yi nimaani; ka niriba pam daa dol o, ka o chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni zaa kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia gba daa bɔhi, Shihirili dini n-lee wuhiri ni n ni chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then King Hezekiah asked, What is the sign to prove that I will be able to go to the Temple.

dag: Amaa paɣisar shɛb bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la, chɛliya bɛna n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi paɣiba.
en: But all the young girls who have not known a man intimately by sleeping with him, spare for yourselves.

dag: Ka Piɛgul Kpɛm la yi ti kana, yi ni deei nam zuɣupila din mali jilima ka di viɛlim ku kpaai.
en: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the glorious crown which will never lose its brightness.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni bɛnkam zaa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn labina maa daa yooi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika n-niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya li nyu ka ti taba.
en: Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he told the apostles, Take this wine and share it with each other.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli o tuun viɛla yɛla n-sani, ka daa zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o. Ka Tɔbaya daa kul sabiri gbana tiri ma na ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm.
en: And in the past, those people had made a special promise to Tobiah. So they kept telling me how good Tobiah was. And they kept telling Tobiah what I was doing. Tobiah kept sending me letters to make me afraid.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii niriba ayi zali; bɛna n-nyɛ: Yisifu so bɛ ni daa booni Barisabas mini Mataias.
en: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.

dag: Amaa nyini daadam, wummi n ni yɛl a shɛm maa, ka miri ka a niŋ duŋtaara kaman duŋtaariba maa. Yaam a noli n-di n ni zaŋ binshɛli tir a ŋɔ.
en: Son of man, listen to what I am telling you. Dont turn against me like those people who refuse to obey. Now open your mouth to receive the words I will give you to speak.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli polo niriba bɛn labina. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb kuli Babilɔn la zuliya. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ zaa ti kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni.
en: These are the people of the province who returned from captivity. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon had taken these people as prisoners to Babylon. They now returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to their own town.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai ba, yɛtɔɣa maa ka o daa shiri zaŋ yɛli ba.
en: When the servant caught up with them, he repeated these words.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi biɛɣ asiba, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anab Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la n-yɛl o.
en: When David got up in the morning, the Lord gave this message to Gad, Davids seer:.

dag: Ka n zaŋ buɣu leei n situra ye, ka bɛ maani ma ansarisi.
en: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti biri bimbir shɛli gari yi wain tihi puu ni, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi ni biri binshɛli maa mini wain tihi maa wala zaa.
en: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.

dag: Dinzuɣu siɣisimiya yimaŋa Naawuni nuu din mali yiko la ni, ka di chɛ ka o ti duhi ya o ni yu saha shɛli.
en: Humble yourselves, then, under God's mighty hand, so that he will lift you up in his own good time.

dag: Bɛ ni daa karim gbaŋ maa, di yɛligu maa daa paligi bɛ suhuri pam.
en: When the believers read it, they were happy. The letter comforted them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa Arinɔn zaŋ ti paai Jabok n-lan zaŋ hal ni Ammɔnnim tintariga, dama Ammɔnnim daa gula bɛ tintariga viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: But the Israelites defeated the king and took his land from the Arnon River to the Jabbok River. The Israelites took the land as far as the Ammonite border. They stopped at that border because it was strongly defended by the Ammonites.

dag: Nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma bahi? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dimnim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: God, you are my place of safety. Why have you turned me away? Why must I suffer this sadness that my enemies have brought me?.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, di saha maa Juda ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa sabila gbana pam ti Tɔbaya, ka Tɔbaya gba daa sabi gbana ti ba.
en: Also in those days after the wall had been completed, the rich people of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and he was answering their letters.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa yɛl o, A di amaŋ shɛhira; dinzuɣu a shɛhira maa pala shɛhira maŋli.
en: The Pharisees objected, You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true.

dag: ka niŋmi paɣikura kaman a manim la; ka niŋmi paɣisara mi kaman a tizɔpaɣiba la biɛr kasi zaa puuni.
en: treat older women like your mother, and treat younger women like your sisters with appropriate respect.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya yɛm mini yɛla baŋbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Happy are those who find wisdom and those who gain understanding.

dag: Yi yi doli Naawuni nam zaligu kaman di ni wuhi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la, yi niŋ din tuhi. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: You will be doing the right thing if you obey the law of the Kingdom, which is found in the scripture, Love your neighbor as you love yourself.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka a bi dol a ni daa po pɔ shɛli Yawɛ sani maa mini zaligu shɛli n ni daa zal a maa.
en: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord .

dag: n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa; ka bipuɣiŋga maa mi daa zaŋ li ti ti o ma.
en: The guard put the head on a serving plate and took it to the girl. Then she gave it to her mother.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo bɛ fɔntin shɛŋa ni bɛ ni daa be mini bɛ sansana zaa buɣim.
en: and burned all their cities and camps.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi, bɛ kanimina nti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.

dag: Ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Kum o! Kum o! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, N kpahimi yi Naa maa tabili dapulli zuɣu? Ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ka naa pahila Naa Siiza.
en: They shouted back, Kill him! Kill him! Crucify him! Pilate asked them, Do you want me to crucify your king? The chief priests answered, The only king we have is the Emperor.

dag: Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa ni daa wum bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: When Abrahams servant heard this, he bowed to the ground before the Lord .

dag: Piimi n wuhibu ŋɔ ka chɛ anzinfa. Piimi baŋsim ka chɛ salima din viɛla.
en: Choose discipline over silver and knowledge over the finest gold.

dag: Bɛ valila azichi, ka lan ti li bahina, Naawuni n-yihi li bɛ puya ni bahina.
en: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.

dag: Naawuni mi n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb azichi mini nɛma ni jilima, ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa shɛli bi poori ba, amaa ka o bi chɛ ka bɛ tooi diri di nyaɣisim, ka naɣ chɛ ka ninvuɣ zino n-diri di nyaɣisim maa. Dimbɔŋɔ ka buchi, ka nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam.
en: God may give some people plenty of wealth, riches, and glory so that they lack nothing they desire. But God doesnt enable them to enjoy it; instead, a stranger enjoys it. This is pointless and a sickening tragedy.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa ka n sanna ti wum n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni wuhi ya o ni ŋmani so.
en: Anyone who comes and listens to me and obeys me.

dag: Dama so yi nyɛla ŋun wumdila yɛligu maa kɔŋko, ka pa ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, o ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi diɣi ni n-nya o ninni m-baŋ omaŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror.

dag: Nir yi niŋ yomyom yɛli, N zaŋ bini yaakaza ti Naawuni, ka naanyi ti piligi tɛhir o ni po pɔri shɛli maa yɛla, di ni leei tɔŋ gbaag o.
en: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɔhim anabi maa ka o yɛli shɛli, di wuhiya ni man Yawɛ n-yɔhim anabi maa, ka n ni teei n nuu n-jɛnd o n-ku o n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
