en: If any prophets are deceived into giving a false answer, it is because I, the Lord , have deceived them. I will remove them from the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa hal ni pɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-zaŋ n yuli suhi shɛli; dinzuɣu suhimiya, Naawuni ni tin ya, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli.
en: You have never asked for anything in this way before. But ask in my name, and you will receive. And you will have the fullest joy possible.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: These are the Manassehite clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: Bɛ gbiri kɔsoya tampima ni, ka bɛ nina nyari binviɛla kam.
en: cut channels into rocks; their eyes see everything precious.

dag: Ka ti mi ni Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni la ni ti neei ti gba kum ni pahi Yisa zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti mini ya tahi ŋun Naawuni sani.
en: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.

dag: ni naɣilima ni vinvama din zaŋ hal ni Ar zaŋ lab Mɔabnim tintariga polo la.
en: with its valleys that lie alongside the Moabite border and extend to the town of Ar.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa ti je suli pam niŋ Taainim mini Sidɔnnima. Ka bɛ daa laɣim chaŋ Blastus ŋun daa nyɛ Naa Hɛrɔd yɛdalan la sani ni bɛ ti balim o ka o maai Naa Hɛrɔd suhu ti ba, dama bɛ bindira daa yirila o tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Herod was very angry with the people from the cities of Tyre and Sidon. But these cities needed food from his country, so a group of them came to ask him for peace. They were able to get Blastus, the kings personal servant, on their side.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa o ni daa suh o shɛlikam m-pahi ŋun Naa Sulemaana ni daa pun niŋ o nirilim ti o pin shɛŋa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o min o niriba daa lab kul o ya Shiiba.
en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she wanted and all that she had asked for, in addition to what he had already given her from his own personal funds. Then she and her servants returned to her homeland.

dag: A daa lo a suhu ni ni a ni du zuɣusaa ha n-chaŋ ti yaɣi Naawuni saŋmarisi zuɣu n-zaŋ a nam kuɣ zali nimaani. A daa tɛhiya ni a ni chaŋ ti ʒini laɣiŋgu zoli din du pam ka be nuzaa polo la zuɣu.
en: You said to yourself, I will climb up to heaven; above Gods stars, I will raise my throne. Ill sit on the mount of assembly, on the heights of Zaphon.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa gindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yihiri waazu, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka shihir shɛŋa din wuhiri ni lahibal suŋ maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli niŋda.
en: The followers went everywhere in the world telling people the Good News, and the Lord helped them. By giving them power to do miracles the Lord proved that their message was true.

dag: Yi yi ŋub li daba ata maa dali, di nyɛla din chihira, ka n ku deei li.
en: You must not eat any of that sacrifice on the third day. It will be unclean, and it will not be accepted.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N nyala so shia ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Dont be afraid! the king said to her. What do you see? The woman said to Saul, I see a god coming up from the ground.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o binyɛr piɛlli ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-va buɣim mini di sara maligu maa ka chɛ tampiligim shɛli sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini maa luɣili zuɣu.
en: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa; n ni yɛl a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I will praise you, Lord , with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Dan tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ti paai Bɛrishiiba tiŋgban ni nim zaa kul be ni alaafee, ka sokam ʒin omaŋmaŋ yiŋ wain tihi mini fiig tihi gbina ni Sulemaana ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: The people of Judah and Israel from Dan all the way to Beer-sheba lived securely under their vines and fig trees throughout the days of Solomon.

dag: Bɛ yi kana ti kaai ma, bɛ tɛhirila yɛl biɛri yɛla. Bɛ yi lo yɛtɔɣ biɛri ŋɔ nia bɛ suhuri ni naai, bɛ yirimi chaŋ ti zaŋ li moli gili.
en: Whenever they come to visit, they say nothing of value. Their hearts collect evil gossip; once they leave, they tell it to everybody.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nyɛ faranima ka ka bindirigu diri zuɣu, bɛ daa nyirila taŋkpa kuma tiŋgbani nɛli ni.
en: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.

dag: Ka Naawuni ti o binyɛr piɛlli din nyɛlisiri ka be nyam ni o ye. Binyɛr piɛlli maa nyɛla wuntizɔriba wuntia tuma.
en: She was given fine, pure white linen to wear, for the fine linen is the saints acts of justice.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ka yi ti tɛhi ni yi ni mali niriba pam, ka lan mali salima naɣila shɛb Jɛrɔbɔam ni mali tin ya, ka bɛ nyɛ yi buɣa la zuɣu yi ni tooi tuhi Yawɛ nam shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ Dauda bihi nuu ni ŋɔ.
en: And now do you intend to challenge the LORDs royal rule, entrusted to Davids descendants? You may have a numerical advantage, as well as the gold calves Jeroboam made for you as gods.

dag: Duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa. Ŋuni n-lee nam saŋmarisi? Ŋuna ŋun zali ba zaɣ bɔbili maa mi bɛ kalinli, ka mi bɛ zaa yuya. O yaa ni o yiko ni galisi zuɣu, o na ʒi n-kali pooi bɛ ni so.
en: Look up at the sky and consider: Who created these? The one who brings out their attendants one by one, summoning each of them by name. Because of Gods great strength and mighty power, not one is missing.

dag: Ka n daa labina nti nya chirimbu shɛli Ɛliashib ni chirim chɛ ka Tɔbaya be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni dundɔŋ ni nɛma duu maa ni maa.
en: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a mi, dama a nyɛla ŋun ni garigiri ma, lala zuɣu ka n suhir a maa; dinzuɣu gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu maa.
en: I pray to you, O God, because you answer me; so turn to me and listen to my words.

dag: Yi yi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o shiri ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, amaa yi yi bi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o daalahichi maa na kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you forgive the sins of anyone, their sins are forgiven. If there is anyone whose sins you dont forgive, their sins are not forgiven.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa deei bia maa buɣi, ka paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Simeon took the baby in his arms and thanked God:.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa boli bindirigu maa Manna, di daa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din nyɛ zaɣ piɛla, ka nyaɣisi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ shiri mali karikaasi shɛŋa.
en: The Israelite people called it manna. It was like coriander seed, white, and tasted like honey wafers.

dag: bee m-mirigi bɛ nina kpa tiŋgban ni, amaa bɛ ni nyala suhusaɣiŋgu mini zibisim ni bumbɔni din mali barina ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli puuni bɛ ni yɛn kari ba ti kpɛhi.
en: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛrusalɛm Naa Adɔnizɛdɛk daa tim ti yɛli Hiburɔn Naa Hɔham mini Jarimut naa Piram ni Lakishi Naa Jafia ni Ɛgilɔn Naa Dɛbir.
en: So Adonizedek sent the following message to King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and to King Debir of Eglon:.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni yi gba mali suhupiɛlli, ka di chɛ ka n gba pahi yi zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: In the same way, you too must be glad and share your joy with me.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa laɣim maa fo baalim wumdi Baanabas mini Pool ni daa kahigiri shihir shɛŋa bɛ ni wuhi mini alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum bɛn pa Yɛhudianim maa sani yɛla wuhiri ba.
en: Then the whole group became quiet. They listened while Paul and Barnabas told about all the miraculous signs and wonders that God had done through them among the non-Jewish people.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mi daa bo oniɣisi kuɣa mini kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie tab binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyolɔrigu la zuɣu na.
en: The leaders brought different kinds of jewels to be sewn on the special clothes and the breastpiece for the high priest.

dag: Yi goma mɛbu dabisili kanna. Dindali maa yi tintarisi ni ti yɛligi pam pahi.
en: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.

dag: ni Oholibama ni Ɛla ni Pinɔn.
en: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Yi mi ma, ka mi n ni shiri yi shɛl na? Pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n kana; ka ŋun tim ma na maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa yi bi mi o.
en: Jesus was still teaching in the Temple area when he said loudly, Do you really know me and where I am from? I am here, but not by my own decision. I was sent by one who is very real. But you dont know him.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa wum ni Itiɔpia naa Tirihaka mini Ijipti tɔbbihi kanna ni bɛ ti tuh o. O ni daa wum lala maa, ka o tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani.
en: Then the Assyrian king learned that Cushs King Tirhakah was on his way to fight against him. So he sent messengers to Hezekiah again.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku pirigi ka chɛ ka bɛ siɣi di ni gari, o daa chɛ ka kom laɣim ti dɔni kaman kunkuni la.
en: He divided the sea and took them through it; he made the waters stand like walls.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, Kulima! A ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, alizin biɛɣu maa zoya ka chɛ a bia maa.
en: Jesus answered, That's true! You may go now. The demon has left your daughter.

dag: Amaa o yi yiɣisi ni o guui, o larila wɔribara min o wɔhu.
en: When she flaps her wings high, she laughs at horse and rider.

dag: Barikɔs ni Sisɛra ni Tɛma ni.
en: Barkos, Sisera, Temah.

dag: Yi ni ti yi nimaani gba n-kahi yi nuhi pa yi zuɣuri ni zɔna. Dama man Yawɛ zaɣisi yi ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb naani maa, ka yi ku tɔŋ bɛ sani.
en: From there you will go out with your hands on your heads, because the LORD has rejected those you rely on; they wont help you.

dag: mini Bɛndɛka ŋun daa be Makaz la ni Shaalibim ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni Ɛlɔnbɛtihanan.
en: Ben Deker was governor of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Bethhanan.

dag: Ka o lan tim so yaha, ka bɛ daa ti ku ŋuna. Ka o lan tim niriba pam pahi, ka bɛ ti fiɛb bɛ shɛba, ka ku bɛ gba ni shɛba.
en: So the man sent another servant. The farmers killed this servant. The man sent many other servants to the farmers. The farmers beat some of them and killed the others.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: The Lord had told Moses how to divide the land among the tribes of Israel. The Israelites divided the land the way the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka so yi tah a ʒiishee nti deeg a binyɛrigu, nyin chɛ ka o deeg a chinchini gba pahi.
en: If anyone wants to sue you in court and take your shirt, let them have your coat too.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi Yawɛ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛ bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli, bɛ mi bi mi ni o laɣim ba mi kaman kabɔba ka bɛ lo n-sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni la.
en: But they dont know the plans of the LORD; they cant understand his scheme, namely, that he will bring them like grain to the threshing floor!.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a nya ma ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: Those who honor you will be glad when they see me, because I trust in your promise.

dag: Ŋuna n-filim kurimbuni ha wuna la, ka o nuhi din ka bahigu ŋɔ gbibi ya. O ni kari yi dimnim bɛn be yi tooni la bahi ka yɛli, Kumiya ba.
en: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama ti yɛl o Sool ni niŋ o shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka o mini Samuɛl daa chaŋ ti be Naiɔt.
en: So David fled and escaped. When he reached Samuel at Ramah, he reported to him everything Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to stay in the camps.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti? Di tam ti wahala dibu mini ti nahiŋgu ŋɔ yɛla!.
en: Why are you hiding your face, forgetting our suffering and oppression?.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl bɔh o, Ya ka a dabili ŋun nyɛ baa ŋɔ yɛn nya yiko n-tum tuun karili ŋɔ! Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ kahigi wuhi ma ni a ni ti leei Siria naa.
en: How could I ever be that powerful? Hazael asked. I'm a nobody! The Lord has shown me that you will be king of Syria, Elisha replied.

dag: N ni kul wuhi ba ka ti ba yaa maa zaa yoli, bɛ bo soya n-tum tuumbiɛri jɛndi ma.
en: It was I who gave them their strength, yet they plot evil against me.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yili ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa din be n nɛma duri puuni wuhi ba.
en: So Isaiah said, What did they see in your house? Hezekiah said, They saw everything in my house. There was nothing in my storerooms that I didnt show them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛn la daa ti labina ti yɛra, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kparigim ka ti gari.
en: Later, the other girls came. They said, Sir, sir! Open the door to let us in.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa wuh o di sol la zuɣu.
en: Jehoash always did what was right in the LORDs eyes, because the priest Jehoiada was his teacher.

dag: Amaa m-mali shɛhira din gari Jɔn shɛhira maa; dama tuun shɛŋa m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum, dina ka n tumda; ka tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi maa mi diri ma shɛhira ni m Ba n-shiri tim ma na.
en: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, man ni zo n-kuli. Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Zom kuli. Di saha ka Ahimaaz daa ŋmaligi guui n-zo n-doli bɔpiɛligu polo nti gari Kush nir maa zuɣu.
en: Whatever happens, Ahimaaz said again, I want to go. Then go, Joab said. So Ahimaaz ran off down the road through the Jordan Valley, and soon he passed the slave.

dag: Pa kapinta ŋun nyɛ Mariama bia la m-bala? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Joses ni Judas ni Saimɔn la? Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o.
en: Isnt he just the carpenter we know—Marys son, the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? And dont his sisters still live here in town? So they had a problem accepting him.

dag: Ka Tama daa niŋ tampiligim buɣ o zuɣu ka darigi cheeg o ni daa ye saalo shɛli maa, ka kah o nuhi pa o zuɣu ni n-kuhiri pampam chana.
en: Tamar tore the robe she was wearing and put ashes on her head. Then she covered her face with her hands and cried loudly as she walked away.

dag: Bɛ daa yi kamina nti kpa tanti suɣa do Izraɛlnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-saɣindi bɛ bindira zaŋ hal ti paai Gaza, hal ka binshɛli zaŋ tabili piɛri mini niɣi ni bunsi gba bi kpalim.
en: They would camp on the land and destroy the crops as far south as the area around Gaza. They would take all the sheep, cattle, and donkeys, and leave nothing for the Israelites to live on.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ŋɔ, pa ninsal wuhibu ka o zaɣisi, amaa Naawuni ŋun ti ti o Shia Kasi la wuhibu ka o zaɣisi maa.
en: So anyone who refuses to obey this teaching is refusing to obey God, not us. And God is the one who gives you his Holy Spirit.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni o ni bi zaɣisi n suhigu maa zuɣu, bee o ni bi vuui o yurilim maŋli ka chɛ ma la zuɣu.
en: I praise God, because he did not reject my prayer or keep back his constant love from me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka zɔri salo, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni Yisa nyɛla anabi.
en: So they looked for a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to, because the people thought he was a prophet.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni daalibarika n-tim bɛn niŋdi ya alaka; chɛliya ba turi, ka kul suhimiyala Naawuni daalibarika tim ba.
en: Ask God to bless those who persecute you—yes, ask him to bless, not to curse.

dag: Yawɛ, a vihi ma m-baŋ ma zaa.
en: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord , and you know all about me.

dag: Niŋmiy o larigim ka miriya ka yi kul chaŋ mir o yiŋ dunoli.
en: Keep away from such a woman! Don't even go near her door!.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam n sani, hal di nyaɣisi n nol ni pam gari shiri!.
en: Your word is so pleasing to my taste buds— its sweeter than honey in my mouth!.

dag: Yawɛ, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, n sɔŋda, kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ma.
en: O Lord , don't stay away from me! Come quickly to my rescue!.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, bee n-chɛ ka bɛ kari ba saria n-wuhi ni bɛ kum ba.
en: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.

dag: Yi yi jɛmdi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi bindira mini yi kom ni, ka yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi kɔbili ni.
en: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.

dag: Ka fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Gibiɔn mini Rama ni Bɛrɔt.
en: The tribe of Benjamin also got Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yidaampaɣ maŋli? O gari salima.
en: A competent wife, how does one find her? Her value is far above pearls.

dag: N zaŋla tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni sinnamɔn tulaalɛnim la mihi li.
en: Ive sprinkled my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa wuh o maa, ka Ibrahimma me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka zaŋ dari maa pa di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga. Di saha ka o daa lo o bia Yisahaku maa mihi n-zaŋ o pa bimbini maa zuɣu dari maa zuɣu.
en: They arrived at the place God had described to him. Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He tied up his son Isaac and laid him on the altar on top of the wood.

dag: Wuntizɔriba pihinu yi be tiŋ maa ni, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa ka ku tiligi li wuntizɔriba pihinu bɛn be di ni maa zuɣu?.
en: What if there are fifty innocent people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not save the place for the sake of the fifty innocent people in it?.

dag: Ka ŋun daŋ tooni daa yina m-mɔha, ka o niŋgbuŋ zaa mali kɔbiri m-be kaman biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri siturili la; ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Iso.
en: The first baby was red. His skin was like a hairy robe. So he was named Esau.

dag: Jɛfita ni daa ti labiri kuni yiŋ na Mizipa, o bipuɣiŋga n-daa daŋ o soli tuhibu na n-gbib chaɣisa chaɣisiri ka wari waa. O kɔŋko mi n-daa kul nyɛ o bia. O daa lan ka bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga pah o zuɣu.
en: When Jephthah returned to his home in Mizpah, the first one to meet him was his daughter. She was playing a tambourine and dancing to celebrate his victory, and she was his only child.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣ a yuli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm ŋɔ. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Everyone will praise his great and majestic name. Holy is he!.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: Worship no god but me.

dag: N suhu daa yiɣisiya bahi n niriba zuɣu, ka n daa niŋ ba kaman bɛ pala n niriba la. N daa zaŋ ba niŋla yi nuu ni, ka yi daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu, hal ka daa nahim bɛ ninkura pam.
en: I was enraged with my people; I made my inheritance impure and put them under your power. You took no pity on them. You made your yoke heavy even on the elderly.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo bee m-booi li bahi ninvuɣ yiriŋ zuɣu ni, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni. .
en: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord 's people.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya. O ku tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni.
en: This is what the king says: Dont let Hezekiah lie to you. He wont be able to rescue you from the power of Assyrias king.

dag: Ifriim tiŋgbɔŋ ku lan mali birini, ka Damaskusnim kɔŋ nam. Ka Aramnim bɛn kpalim ni kɔŋ jilima kaman Izraɛlnim ni kɔŋ shɛm la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti kul mali suhukpeeni. Ti mi ni ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni, ti na ka ti Duuma yiŋa m-bala.
en: So we are always full of courage. We know that as long as we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord's home.

dag: O zaŋla dunia ŋɔ niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; o pɔbila di sariakaritiba nina; di yi pala ŋuna, ka ŋuni?.
en: God gave the world to the wicked. He made all the judges blind. And if God didn't do it, who did?.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia; Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: Learn a lesson from a fig tree. When its branches sprout and start putting out leaves, you know summer is near.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, a nyɛla binzɔrigu! A suhu yi yiɣisi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani a tooni?.
en: God, you are awesome! No one can stand against you when you are angry.

dag: Ti Duuma daa yi Sinai Zoli zuɣu n-ka luɣ kasi shee la na ni chɛchɛbunsi din mali kpiɔŋ pam tusatusa din ka kalinli.
en: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini?.
en: Can any of you live a bit longer by worrying about it?.

dag: Lan bomiya zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu; ka lan zaŋ zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: With each bull, you must give a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil. And with the ram, you must give a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil.

dag: Noombihi shɛb yi ni yɛn chihiri dibu m-bɔŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni yi di ba; bɛ nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu. Bɛna n-nyɛ: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: You must also treat some birds as things that are wrong to eat. Stay away from them. It is a sickening thought for you to eat any of these birds: eagles, vultures, buzzards.

dag: Ɛhab daa malila bidibisi pisopɔin, ka bɛ be Samaria. Ka Jɛhu daa sab gbana zaŋ tim Samaria nti ti tiŋ maa nanim mini tiŋ kpamba ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi Ɛhab bidibisi maa n-yɛli.
en: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the senior officers of the city, the elders, and the guardians of Ahabs sons.

dag: Di saha maa, do so daa beni n-nyɛ ŋun yi Zɔra na, ka o yuli booni Manɔa. O daa nyɛla Dan zuliya ni nira, ka o paɣ nyɛ paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi.
en: There was a man named Manoah from the city of Zorah. He was from the tribe of Dan. Manoah had a wife, but she was not able to have any children.

dag: M mabiyurisi, di chɛliya ka binshɛli yɔhim ya.
en: Do not be deceived, my dear friends!.

dag: Ka o ba Yisahaku bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o yɛl o, Mani a bituuli Iso.
en: His father Isaac said to him, Who are you? And he said, Im your son, your oldest son, Esau.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yiɣisi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu duu maa ni yi nayili tihi puu ni. Ka Haman daa baŋ ni naa ni darig o tibili yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpalim ni o suh o nyɛvili Napaɣ Ɛsta sani.
en: The king was so angry that he got up, left his wine, and went out into the palace garden. Haman realized that the king had already decided what to do with him, and he stayed and begged Esther to save his life.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋya yi naani niŋbu bahi, dama di mali laara pam.
en: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.

dag: Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ bɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa la puhibu dali mini Yawɛ chuɣu puhibu dali?.
en: What will you do on the day of appointed festival, on the day of the LORDs festival?.

dag: Gbuɣim pola mi n-ti kɔŋ bindirigu dira, ka kum mali ba; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn kul ku kɔŋ binsuma.
en: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord , you will never miss out on anything good.

dag: Tim ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu.
en: Give us our food for today.

dag: Di saha maa Ibrahimma mini Zara zaa daa kurigiya pam hal ka Zara bi lan nyari sɔrilim gba.
en: Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah had stopped having her monthly periods.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ bɛ wain puri ni ti pihi wain wala na nti kahim di kom niŋ wain n-zaŋ li chaŋ bɛ wuni jɛmbu duu ti puhi chuɣu nimaani, ka diri ka nyura, ka turi Abimilɛk.
en: They all went out into their vineyards and picked the grapes, made wine from them, and held a festival. They went into the temple of their god, where they ate and drank and made fun of Abimelech.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-chɛ ka bɛ mi bɛ ni chani luɣ shɛli, amaa jɛra bɛn jɛrilim kpɛhiri ba la yɔɣu.
en: By their wisdom the prudent understand their way, but the stupidity of fools deceives them.

dag: ka Jɔhanan nyɛ Azaria ba. Azaria maa n-daa nyɛ maligumaana m-be Sulemaana ni daa me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛli din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la puuni.
en: Azariah .

dag: Kukol shɛli n-kuhiri yɛra: Malimiya soli mɔɣu ni ti Yawɛ! Malimiya soli maa tiŋgban nɛli ni ka di tuhi ti ti Naawuni maa!.
en: Someone is shouting: Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɛ ŋmanila zahindi shɛli nir ni yi zahim ka neei la, o yi neei di bemi kaman shilinshia la.
en: They are like a dream that goes away in the morning; when you rouse yourself, O Lord, they disappear.

dag: Naawuni daa tum alahiziba tuun gahinda n-chɛ ka yiko be Pool nuhi ni.
en: God was doing unusual miracles through Paul.

dag: Ŋuna ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Juda naa Amɔn bia Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pinaata saha la.
en: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram ʒii nyabu puuni, Ibram, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, n ni gbib a ka chɛ ka a laara ti galisi pam.
en: After this, Abram had a vision and heard the Lord say to him, Do not be afraid, Abram. I will shield you from danger and give you a great reward.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni daalikauli zaligunim zaa yɛla yɛli niriba zaa la nyaaŋa, o daa zaŋla naɣibihi mini buhi ʒim ni kom n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro vari mini piɛkɔb ʒɛhi tim di ni n-zaŋ li mihi Naawuni Zaligu Kundi la mini niriba maa zaa.
en: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.

dag: N daa niŋdi ba alaka waawaayili Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m muɣisi ba ka bɛ tu Yisa. N suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu pam maa zuɣu ka n daa du tin duya ni ni m paai ba nimaani ti niŋ ba alaka.
en: Many times I had them punished in the synagogues and tried to make them deny their faith. I was so furious with them that I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti shiri niŋ o ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The disciples went and did just as Jesus had ordered them.

dag: Di saha ka Ila bia Hɔshia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Rɛmalia bia Pɛka polo ŋ-ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani, Uzia bia Jɔtam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha.
en: In the twentieth year of the reign of Jotham son of Uzziah as king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against King Pekah, assassinated him, and succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi jintɔriba maa sani n-yi ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni ni kali ba pahi bɛn simdi ni bɛ di vi Yisa yuli zuɣu kalinli ni maa zuɣu.
en: As the apostles left the Council, they were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer disgrace for the sake of Jesus.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali ka bɛ laɣim tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o daa pii kuɣikpɛriba ni bɛ kpe kuɣa ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: David gave orders to gather the immigrants living in the land of Israel, and he appointed masons who would cut stones for building Gods temple.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti siɣis o bimbini maa zuɣu na. Ka o daa kana nti damdi lu Naa Sulemaana sizuura. Ka Sulemaana daa yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋa.
en: Then he sent someone to the altar to get Adonijah. After Adonijah came and bowed down, Solomon said, Adonijah, go home.

dag: M bia, dol a ba zaligu, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: My son, remember your fathers command, and dont forget your mothers teaching.

dag: Dinzuɣu paɣ maa ni daa nya ka tia maa wala lihibu mali kɔre, ka viɛl ni dibu, ka lan nyɛ ti shɛli din ni ti nir baŋsim maa, ka o pɔhigi li di, ka zaŋ di shɛli ti ti o yidana, ka o gba di.
en: The woman stared at the fruit. It looked beautiful and tasty. She wanted the wisdom that it would give her, and she ate some of the fruit. Her husband was there with her, so she gave some to him, and he ate it too.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: Wherever you are welcomed, stay in the same house until you leave that town;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sa Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa dahin shɛli, ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili din nyɛ alikauli suɣili maa. Sagbani maa daa bela Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa m-be kaman buɣim la yuŋ zaŋ hal ni asiba.
en: On the day the dwelling was erected, the cloud covered the dwelling, the covenant tent. At night until morning, the cloud appeared with lightning over the dwelling.

dag: Judas ŋun daa yi o nyaaŋa la daa mi tihi puu maa ni, dama Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yi kul chanila nimaani waawaayili.
en: Judas, the one responsible for handing Jesus over, knew where this place was. He knew because Jesus often met there with his followers.

dag: Hakalia bia Nɛhimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pisi puuni gol so bɛ ni booni Kisilɛv ni, man Nɛhimia daa bela Susa tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin zuɣu la ni.
en: These are the words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: I, Nehemiah, was in the capital city of Susa in the month of Kislev. This was in the th year that Artaxerxes was king. While I was in Susa.

dag: kaman Daadam Bia gba ni be shɛm la; o bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o, amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: just as the Human One didnt come to be served but rather to serve and to give his life to liberate many people.

dag: Yin ni di biŋkɔb shɛba n-nyɛ niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi.
en: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.

dag: Naa maa yi ti yɛn kpe, ŋun doli zɔntua din be dunɔdal la ni kpe, ka ti lan doli nimaani yi.
en: The ruler must come through the entrance room of the east gate and leave the same way.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi nabi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi galisim ŋmanila saŋmarisi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The LORD your God has multiplied your number—you are now as countless as the stars in the sky.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila jɛr so ŋun daa me o yili zali bihigu ni.
en: But anyone who hears these words of mine and does not obey them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

dag: Sool ʒiɛman ni zaa, o mini Filistianim daa kul tuhirimi ni nimmoo, dinzuɣu o daa yi kul nya do so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ bee suhukpeeni o zaŋd o mi leeg o tɔbbia.
en: Saul was at war with the Philistines for as long as he lived. Whenever he found a good warrior or a brave man, Saul made him join his army.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa ka o sanna siɣimsiɣim buyi nti yɛl o ni o miri ka o jɛm buɣa la zaa yoli; Sulemaana daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o jɛmbu. Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ Sulemaana.
en: Even though the Lord , the God of Israel, had appeared to Solomon twice and had commanded him not to worship foreign gods, Solomon did not obey the Lord but turned away from him. So the Lord was angry with Solomon.

dag: Bɛ yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa zali tanza kpeeni n-gu dahin shɛli; ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi vili n-gbib nyɛvili din nyɛ nyɛvili maŋli la.
en: By doing this, they will be saving up a treasure for themselves. And that treasure will be a strong foundation on which their future life will be built. They will be able to have the life that is true life.

dag: tarimtali ni maŋgbibbutali. Ka zaligu shɛli kani din galindi dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against these kinds of things.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na ka o nyaandoliba ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, nyam kuɣa ŋɔ mini duri ŋɔ ni viɛl shɛm.
en: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, Teacher, look at these beautiful stones and wonderful buildings.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ pina tari nandaamba ni bɛ suhuri zaa, bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam. Bɛ ni duhi ba ti ba jilima.
en: They freely give to the poor. Their goodness will continue forever. They will be honored with victory.

dag: Yuma shɛm nyaaŋa ha, Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia Naa saha shɛl la, do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Ɛzra. Ɛzra daa nyɛla Sɛraya bia, ka Sɛraya nyɛ Azaria bia, ka Azaria nyɛ Hilikia bia.
en: Many years later, when Artaxerxes was emperor of Persia, there was a man named Ezra. He traced his ancestors back to Aaron, the High Priest, as follows: Ezra was the son of Seraiah, son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa labi kuli maa kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: Total number of exiles who returned - , Their male and female servants - , Male and female musicians - Horses - Mules - Camels - Donkeys - .

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi ni kpiimba be nimaani, ka o saamba be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Those simple people dont realize that her house is full of ghosts and that her guests have entered the world of the dead.

dag: Ka Farisiinim bɔh o, Nyama! Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees asked Jesus, Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do that.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnima ti a ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: With the help of the Holy Spirit, David himself says, The Lord God said to my Lord: Sit by me at my right side, and I will put your enemies under your control. Psalm :.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa piɛb o kikaa, ka saŋmar titali ŋun ne kaman buɣim mokpalli la yi zuɣusaa n-lu mɔɣa ata kam zaɣ yin ni mini kɔbilisi ni.
en: The third angel blew his trumpet. Then a large star, burning like a torch, fell from the sky. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, Naawuni biɛhigu ni be o ni ka o nyɛ Naawuni bia maa zuɣu ka o ku tooi tum alahichi.
en: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, dama daba ayopɔin ka ti yɛn zaŋ leei ya maligumaaniba.
en: You shall not leave the entrance of the Tent for seven days, until your ordination rites are completed.

dag: N suhu ni daa miligi ka biɛrim lan mali ma n suhu ni la.
en: When my thoughts were bitter and my feelings were hurt.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni, ka chɛ ka kom zɔri teeni puri.
en: He sends rain all over the earth and waters the fields.

dag: Amaa ka dindali maa biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka Naawuni chɛ ka zunzuli lu yɔɣili maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋub li ka di kpi.
en: But God provided a worm the next day at dawn, and it attacked the shrub so that it died.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ ti ŋmahi tihi balibu diba ata wula n-kɔrisikɔrisi di paɣiri ka chɛ ka di mali piɛlimpiɛlim, ka chɛ ka di piɛlimpiɛlim maa be palo ni ka di piɛlipiɛla.
en: Then Jacob took new branches from poplar, almond, and plane trees; and he peeled white stripes on them, exposing the branches white color.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leela dabiɛm shee, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li sahakam. Bɛnkam zaa gari nimaani, dabiɛm gbahi ba mi ka bɛ viini bɛ zuɣuri.
en: They have made this land a thing of horror, to be despised forever. All who pass by will be shocked at what they see; they will shake their heads in amazement.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai bɛ sansani maa ni, Izraɛlnim zaa daa yola vuri hal ka tiŋgbani ti damda.
en: When the Covenant Box arrived, the Israelites gave such a loud shout of joy that the earth shook.

dag: Yi yi ti laɣim taba, di pala ti Duuma bindirigu dibu zuɣu ka yi laɣim;.
en: So when you get together in one place, it isnt to eat the Lords meal.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti garigi zuɣusaa ka di mi garigi tiŋgbani.
en: On that day I will answer, says the LORD. I will answer the heavens and they will answer the earth.

dag: N ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ n ni ti ba binshɛli, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛli bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ba.
en: I will send an epidemic and destroy them, but I will make you the father of a nation that is larger and more powerful than they are.

dag: Yi mi ni n tum tuma ni n yaa zaa ti yi ba.
en: You know that Ive worked for your father as hard as I could.

dag: Yinim bɛn mi din tuhi ŋɔ, wummiya! Yinim bɛn gbibi n wuhibu yi suhuri ni ŋɔ, di zɔriya niriba ni maani ya ansarisi shɛli. Ka bɛ yi turi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di muɣisi ya.
en: Listen to me, you that know what is right, who have my teaching fixed in your hearts. Do not be afraid when people taunt and insult you;.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa niriba daa be kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ yaannim maa n-daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Mɛshulam ni Shiiba ni Jɔrai ni Jakan ni Zia ni Ɛba. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: The seven brothers in their families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya n-daa pah ata n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Sarid.
en: The lot turned up third for the clans of Zebulun. The border of their legacy ran as far as Sarid.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yur o paɣ Hanna maa zaa yoli, o daa kul ŋmaarila ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko tarili tir o, dama Yawɛ daa na bi ti o bia.
en: And even though he loved Hannah very much he would give her only one share, because the Lord had kept her from having children.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Amiliya lɔbu maa shili biya, amaa n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la bi simdi li.
en: After that the king said to his servants, The wedding feast is ready. I invited those people, but they were not good enough to come to my feast.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali salima bintaɣindisi ayi mini salima bans ayi, ka zaŋ salima bans ayi maa goli gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya.
en: They made two gold settings and two gold rings. They attached the two rings to the two edges of the chest pendant.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa ni baŋsim pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika be o ni.
en: The child grew and became strong; he was full of wisdom, and God's blessings were upon him.

dag: dama yuri maa yiko daa bela bɛ noya ni mini bɛ zuya ni. Ka bɛ zuya ŋmani tinvura ka mali zuɣuri; dina ka bɛ daa mali dimdi niriba.
en: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and also in their tails. Their tails are like snakes with heads, and they use them to hurt people.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni tɔbu ni din ya, ka kum kun ya, ka alɔbo din ya luɣ shɛli yi ni bɔri ni yi chaŋ ti ʒini maa.
en: So then, remember this: you will die in war or of starvation or disease in the land where you want to go and live.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa lo nia yɛli ni bɛ zaa yinoyino bom o yaa ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga, ka bɛ zaŋ talim ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa dabisili din pah ayi dali.
en: Then the army of Israel came near the army of Benjamin. This was the second day of the war.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka m mali mmaŋa m-be kasi ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi a yɛlimaŋli maa puuni.
en: And for their sake I dedicate myself to you, in order that they, too, may be truly dedicated to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaai Sool zuɣu, ka yeeg o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, ka bahi bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa m-moli lahibali suŋ maa ti bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.

dag: A zuɣulaannim nyɛla tipawumlinim mini tayiɣisi zɔnima. Bɛ zaa yuri birapu dibu ni faɣiri dibu. Bɛ bi sɔŋdi kpibisi bɛ saria dibu ni, ka bi saɣiri ka pakoya zaŋdi bɛ yɛlimuɣisira kani bɛ sanna.
en: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.

dag: yi ti wum kikahi mini yuhi ni mɔɣilɔnim ni biɛri ni goonjɛnim ni alijeetanim ni biŋkumda balibu kam zaa kumsi, bɛn damdim tiŋa n-jɛm salima binnan shɛli Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni mali zali ŋɔ.
en: When you hear the sound of the horn, pipe, zither, lyre, harp, flute, and every kind of instrument, you must bow down and worship the gold statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Fukumsi zaligunim zaa ni, din nyɛ kpɛma nyɛla, Izraɛlnima, wummiya! Ti Duuma Naawuni nyɛla Duuma yino.
en: Jesus replied, The most important one is this: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only Lord.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka tiligira so lan kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I myself am the Lord , and there is no other Savior.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhu daa bahi ku Ɛhab daŋ niriba min o ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni o zɔnim ni o tindaannim zaa bɛn daa kpalim be Jɛziriil, ka o ninvuɣ so daa bi kpalim.
en: Then Jehu put to death all the other relatives of Ahab living in Jezreel, and all his officers, close friends, and priests; not one of them was left alive.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi di nya soli n-tuhi fa bindir shɛŋa bɛ dimnim ŋɔ sani di naan so, dama bɛ dii bi ku Filistianim maa pam zuŋɔ.
en: It would have been much better for the men to eat the food that they took from their enemies today. We could have killed more Philistines.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba o wuhibu maa ni, Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la.
en: As he taught them, he said, Watch out for the teachers of the Law, who like to walk around in their long robes and be greeted with respect in the marketplace.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa nim daa pun baŋ ni Mɔdɛkai mali yiko pam nayili, ka o yiko maa mi kul pahirimi.
en: Because Mordecai was very important in the palace, news about him was sweeping through the provinces. Indeed, Mordecai was becoming more and more important every day.

dag: Ninsal ni kul ni niŋ shɛli nyɛla o di ka nyu, ka di o tuma nyaɣisim. N nyaya ka dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: There is no one who has tried to enjoy life more than I have. And this is what I learned: The best thing people can do is eat, drink, and enjoy the work they must do. I also saw that this comes from God.

dag: N daa lan zaŋ salima lahi pisi din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram anii ni pirigili ni daanya viɛlli lah ayi shɛŋa bɛ ni malimali, ka di mini salima viɛlim nyɛ yim.
en: twenty gold bowls worth one thousand darics, and two containers of highly polished copper, which were as precious as gold.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ziɔnnima, paɣimiya yi Naawuni!.
en: Praise the Lord , O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!.

dag: Ka kpa shɛli din na kpalim be maligumaana maa nuu ni maa, o zaŋm li ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa naanyi mali sanyoo sara ti dilana Yawɛ tooni.
en: He shall put the rest of the oil that is in the palm of his hand on your head. In this way he shall perform the ritual of purification.

dag: Ti yipa baŋya ni a mi binshɛɣukam zaa, ka di bi lan simdi ni so vih a; dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka ti baŋ ni a shiri yila Naawuni sanna.
en: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bari ma la zana, amaa m bi birigi a zaligunim maa.
en: The wicked lay a trap for me, but I have not disobeyed your commands.

dag: Di saha ka Judanim maa daa bu tɔb zambu. Bɛ ni daa bu tɔb zambu maa, ka Naawuni daa nyaŋ Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Abija mini Judanim tooni maa.
en: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin la zaa ni. Gbaŋ maa puuni yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛla Yɛhudianim suhudoo mini yɛlimaŋli puhigu.
en: So Mordecai sent letters to all the Jews in the provinces of King Xerxes kingdom. He told the people that the festival should bring peace and make people trust each other.

dag: O ni daa ba n-chana, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni.
en: He rode along the road toward Jerusalem. The followers spread their coats on the road before him.

dag: A ti o o suhu ni bɔri shɛli; ka bi mɔŋ o o ni suh a bɔri binshɛli.
en: You have given him his heart's desire; you have answered his request.

dag: O ni daa nam zuɣusaa, n daa beni, o ni daa booi booli gili teeku zuɣu, n daa beni.
en: I was there when he set the sky in place, when he stretched the horizon across the ocean.

dag: N ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri fo bɛ sani. Ka nir ku lan wum aŋgo kukoli bee amiliya kukoli bee n-wum nɛya niɛmbu vuri bee n-nya firila neesim.
en: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and happiness in those places. There will be no more happy sounds of the brides and bridegrooms. I will take away the sound of people grinding meal. I will take away the light of the lamp.

dag: Ŋunkam ti di binʒim kam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni. .
en: Anyone who eats blood must be separated from their people.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Midiannima, ka bɛ ku lan tooi niŋ ba shɛli yaha. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi Gidiɔn ʒiɛman ni.
en: So Midian was brought down before the Israelites and no longer raised its head. The land was peaceful for forty years during Gideons time.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim polo pɔhim ni ŋme shɛli ka di zaɣi daa to n-yina pahi kawaan kara maa zuɣu.
en: Then he saw seven more heads of grain sprouting, but they were thin and scorched by the hot wind.

dag: Ka so yi ti bi deei ya bee n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu wumbu, yi yi ti yɛn yi yili maa ni bee di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi di zuɣu.
en: And if some home or town will not welcome you or listen to you, then leave that place and shake the dust off your feet.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ lala n-yiɣisi chaŋ Shilo nti chaŋ Ahija yiŋa. Di saha maa Ahija ni daa kurigi zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina niŋla liti ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So the kings wife did what he said. She went to the home of Ahijah the prophet in Shiloh. Ahijah was very old and had become blind.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N lihiri bɔrila m biɛyanima, ka yɛli, N suhir a, wuhim ma bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa be luɣ shɛli polo ka bɛ ŋubiri mɔri maa.
en: Joseph answered, I'm looking for my brothers who are watching the sheep. Can you tell me where they are.

dag: Piɛguliba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka zuɣulaannim gba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: The shepherds have no place to hide; the masters of the flock cant escape.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣiri ka suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli paari nir nyɛla din chɛ ka o niŋdi tuuba n-nyari tiliginsim, ka di pa din tahiri suhumiligibo na; amaa dunia ŋɔ ni chɛ ka nir nyari suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli nyɛla din tahiri kum na.
en: For the sadness that is used by God brings a change of heart that leads to salvation—and there is no regret in that! But sadness that is merely human causes death.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ bini pɔbi goli muni ninni, ka yɛrig o sagbani pa di zuɣu.
en: hid the face of the full moon, spreading his cloud over it.

dag: Amaa shee o di wahala balibu kam pɔi, ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ti zaɣis o.
en: But first he must suffer terribly and be rejected by the people of today.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Daadam Bia labina ni o nam.
en: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.

dag: Ti yi kul mal ania, ti min o ni ti laɣim di nam. Ti yi zaɣis o, o gba ni ti zaɣisi ti.
en: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis a zaligunim dolibu. Bɛ yɔhiŋgu soya nyɛla yoli.
en: You reject all who dont obey your laws, because they are liars and did not do what they said.

dag: Ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Yɛlim ma a ni mali shɛl a yiŋa. Ka o yɛl o, A dabipaɣa ka shɛli; kulla kpaŋman yini kɔŋko ka m mali.
en: Elisha said to her, What can I do for you? Tell me what you still have left in the house. She said, Your servant has nothing at all in the house except a small jar of oil.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun mali takarifiɛma, ka o takarifiɛma maa wɔrigi, ka o gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiya lala biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: that has divided hoofs and that also chews the cud.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee be sagbana ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ? Ŋuni n-leei be alizanda ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ?.
en: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa mali naɣibil so maa nyo buɣim m-baɣisi li ka di niŋ zim, ka o zaŋ li niŋ kom ni n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nyu li.
en: Then Moses destroyed the calf that the people had made. He melted it in the fire. Then he ground the gold until it became dust and threw it into the water. Then he forced the Israelites to drink that water.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya mi daa su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi daa nyɛ nayili tuma kpamba.
en: Benaiah was responsible for leading the Kerethites and Pelethites. Benaiah was Jehoiadas son. And Davids sons were important officials. They served at King Davids side.

dag: N dana, palo maa liɣiri kul nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisinahi kɔŋko, ka dimbɔŋɔ lee nyɛ bɔ m min a sunsuuni? Zaŋm a kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: Sir, land worth only four hundred pieces of silver—what is that between us? Bury your wife in it.

dag: Bɛn ne mi ni bɛ ni kpi, amaa bɛn kpi bɛn lan ʒi shɛli yaha. Bɛ lan ka jina ni, hal ka niriba bi teeri bɛ yɛla.
en: The living know that they will die, but the dead dont know anything. They have no more reward. People will soon forget them.

dag: A sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o jilima galisi; ka a chɛ ka o yuli du ka o nam mali dariza.
en: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.

dag: min o ni daa lan ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali n-chɛ ka bɛ ʒim zo n-tiɛli Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ taali.
en: and because of the innocent blood that he had spilled. Manasseh had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD didnt want to forgive that.

dag: So bi lan nyuri wain ka yiini yila; ka binnyuri kpɛma leei din to bɛn nyuri li sani.
en: They no longer sing as they drink their wine. The beer now tastes bitter to those who drink it.

dag: Bɛ balim ti ni nimmoo ni ti ti ba soli ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuu kpɛhi Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu ni.
en: they begged us and pleaded for the privilege of having a part in helping God's people in Judea.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee mi ka tinim bi mi li? Bɔ gbinni ka a lee baŋ ka tinim bi baŋ li?.
en: Do you know and understand something we don't?.

dag: A yi yɛn goog o, di ŋmanila pɔhim ka a yɛn gooi bee kpa kom ka a yɛn zaŋ kpib a nudirigu ni.
en: anyone who can control her can control the wind or pick up oil in his hand.

dag: A nyari paɣibu bibihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni a dimnim zuɣu. A chɛ ka a dima mini ŋun nyɛ biɛribɔhira fo bɛ noya.
en: From the mouths of nursing babies you have laid a strong foundation because of your foes, in order to stop vengeful enemies.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of Levi with their descendants.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti lu Dɛbirinim zuɣu. Dɛbir tuuli yuli n-daa nyɛ Kiriatisɛfa.
en: Then he went up from there against the population of Debir. Debir used to be called Kiriath-sepher.

dag: Nyin ŋun be Zallakudura Naa sani sɔɣibu shee mini ŋun kpalim be Kpiɔŋlan Naa mahim ni.
en: Whoever goes to the Lord for safety, whoever remains under the protection of the Almighty.

dag: Ka a niriba ŋɔ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, , ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka a chɛ ka bɛ dimnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba ka gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya din be katiŋ bee din be yoma.
en: When your people sin against you—and there is no one who does not sin—and in your anger you let their enemies defeat them and take them as prisoners to some other land, even if that land is far away.

dag: dama ti bi ʒi shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni ti shiri ku tooi ʒi shɛli yi dunia ŋɔ ni gba.
en: When we came into the world, we brought nothing. And when we die, we can take nothing out.

dag: Di simdi ka Izraɛlnim zaa dol li.
en: The whole Israelite community should observe it.

dag: A ni daa mali karimbaani saha shɛli la a daa bi maanila a mabia Sɔdom ansarisi.
en: but you will no longer talk about your sister Sodom as in your haughty days.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n gba zaɣisi ba ka zaŋ ba tahi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di saha bɛ yi ti siɣisi bɛmaŋ bɛ suhuri din mali daɣiri maa ni ka niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: which made me oppose them, so I took them into enemy territory—or if their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they make up for their guilt.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔguliba tuma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔra daŋ ni, bɛ daa piila Kɔre ŋun daa nyɛ Asaf bidibiga la bia Mɛshɛlɛmia.
en: These are the assignments of work for the Levites who served as Temple guards. From the clan of Korah there was Meshelemiah son of Kore, of the family of Asaph.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti nya sagani sagbana ni, n ni teei alikauli shɛli din be man Yawɛ mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni, ka nyɛ din ku yiɣisi la yɛla.
en: The bow will be in the clouds, and upon seeing it I will remember the enduring covenant between God and every living being of all the earths creatures.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa tim tuumba Jɛsi sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋm a dapala Dauda ŋun guli piɛri la ti ma na.
en: Saul sent a message to Jesse: Tell your son David to leave your sheep and come here to me.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Naa n-tim ma ni n ti niŋ shɛli ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka so baŋ timsim maa yɛla bee n ni tim a ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Amaa m mini nachimba bɛn chani maa, n wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn paai ma luɣ shɛli.
en: I am here on the king's business, David answered. He told me not to let anyone know what he sent me to do. As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.

dag: amaa n ni yɛli zuliya shɛli maa nim yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, n ni taɣi n tɛha, ka ku lan chɛ ka n ni lo ni alɔbo shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu maa paai ba.
en: but if that nation I warned turns from its evil, then Ill relent and not carry out the harm I intended for it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni bɛ pɔri Naawuni sani mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Happy are those who know they are spiritually poor; the Kingdom of heaven belongs to them!.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa tu Naawuni maa yi bɛ sansani maa kpaŋa nti lab o kuɣa. Izraɛlnim maa daa tum Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Moses told this to the Israelites. So they took the one who had cursed outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did just as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: M puhiri Apɛlees ŋun wuh o ʒiɛyimtali Masia ni ni nyɛ shɛm la. M puhiri Aristɔbulus yiŋnim zaa.
en: Say hello to Apelles, who is tried and true in Christ. Say hello to the members of the household of Aristobulus.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a zaligunim wuhiri Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ a zalikpana wuhiri Izraɛlnima. Bɛ ni ti tuɣili tulaale zim a tooni, ka maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la a sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di di buɣim zaa.
en: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.

dag: Rama tiŋ puuni ka bɛ wum vuri din nyɛ fabila mini kumsi ni nandahima yɛla pam. Reechɛl kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka bɛ balim o je, dama bɛ zaa lan kani.
en: A sound is heard in Ramah, the sound of bitter weeping. Rachel is crying for her children; she refuses to be comforted, for they are dead.

dag: Yi yuri yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu; ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: You are always ready to speak evil; you never hesitate to tell lies.

dag: M bɔri ni zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani din ya shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n zaŋla nyɛvili mini kum ni alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu piimiya nyɛvili, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mini yi zuliya be.
en: I am now giving you the choice between life and death, between God's blessing and God's curse, and I call heaven and earth to witness the choice you make. Choose life.

dag: Ŋun Yisa n-daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu ka lan neei kum ni ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Nyin Saimɔn, Jona bia, a mal alibarika! Dama pa daadam ni o zabigu n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuh a, amaa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-kahigi li wuh a.
en: Then Jesus replied, Happy are you, Simon son of Jonah, because no human has shown this to you. Rather my Father who is in heaven has shown you.

dag: ka n naanyi chaŋ ka ku lan labi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa mini zibisim titali ŋɔ ni na.
en: I am going soon to the land of no return, the place of death and darkness—.

dag: di yi pa lala, so yi wum li, o ni dih a vi, ka a yu saɣiŋgu ku mali tariga.
en: Whoever hears it will lose their respect for you and will never trust you again.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidib shɛb bɛn kpalim daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni n-di nɛma bɛ tizɔpaɣ maa zuɣu.
en: After the slaughter Jacob's other sons looted the town to take revenge for their sister's disgrace.

dag: Ka chɛliya ka ti chɛ ka ti biɛhigu be dɛde kaman bɛn be neesim ni, ka pa ni bɛn tumdi yoliyoli bee n-nyuri dam kuuna. Ti miri ka ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini zina balibu kam. Ti mi miri ka ti bɔri zabili bee n-zabiri nyuli.
en: Let us conduct ourselves properly, as people who live in the light of day—no orgies or drunkenness, no immorality or indecency, no fighting or jealousy.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ŋmahindi paɣ yoli, dama n ni kul be kpe saha shɛli maa zaa, n yɛlimuɣisira mini n suhugarigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa.
en: Dont think your servant is some good-for-nothing woman. This whole time Ive been praying out of my great worry and trouble.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sa Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa dahin shɛli, ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili din nyɛ alikauli suɣili maa. Sagbani maa daa bela Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa m-be kaman buɣim la yuŋ zaŋ hal ni asiba.
en: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, So di dam o kɔba; kul chɛliya li ka di doya baalim. Ka bɛ daa chɛ o mini anab so ŋun daa yi Samaria la na kɔba.
en: Leave it as it is, Josiah ordered. His bones are not to be moved. So his bones were not moved, neither were those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: I am the LORD your God.

dag: N ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka di ti gari yi dimnim bɛn ti yɛn kana ti be di ni.
en: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.

dag: So yi tum o kpee taali, ka kana ni o ti po pɔri duu ŋɔ ni sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini.
en: When people are accused of wronging others and are brought to your altar in this Temple to take an oath that they are innocent.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa malila binshɛli bɛ kpiŋkpama lɔna ni ka di ŋmani ninsal nuhi.
en: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings.

dag: Di saha ka napaɣ Hagit bia Adɔnija daa ti ka Sulemaana ma Batishiiba sanna. Ka Batishiiba bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana maa? Ka o garigi yɛli, Iin, alaafee.
en: One day, Adonijah went to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and she asked, Is this a friendly visit? Yes.

dag: N ni lo ba alikauli din ka bahigu din ni chɛ ka n ku lan chɛ ba zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura bɛ suhuri ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ ma.
en: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, never to stop treating them graciously. I will put into their hearts a sense of awe for me so that they wont turn away from me.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nyɛ ti naa? Bee a shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn su ti fukumsi? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani daa maan pahi, o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa maa min o yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: Do you think you are going to be a king and rule over us? his brothers asked. So they hated him even more because of his dreams and because of what he said about them.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa garigi yɛli, Biɛɣu ni neei, amaa yuŋ ni lan zibi yaha. A yi bɔri ni a bɔhi, nyin lan labimina ti bɔhi.
en: I answer, Morning is coming, but night will come again. If you want to ask again, come back and ask.

dag: Lala ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la gba daa niŋ yi taali ni Naawuni sani, o ni daa deei tuumba la n-chɛ ka bɛ taɣi doli so shɛli n-zo n-tiligi la puuni.
en: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.

dag: Binshɛli beni ka di daa simdi ni n niŋ di ni ka m bi niŋ li? N daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, ka bɔ n-chɛ ka di ti zaŋ walila wal biɛri?.
en: Is there anything I failed to do for it? Then why did it produce sour grapes and not the good grapes I expected?.

dag: Yi yihi n niriba paɣiba bɛ yiya din viɛl ni, ka yihi n daalibarika bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: You drive out the women of my people, each from her cherished house; from their young children you take away my splendor forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu naa, kamina pumpɔŋɔ kaman a suhu ni yu dahin shɛli, di nyɛla ti talahi tuma ni ti gbaag o ti a.
en: We know, Your Majesty, how much you want to capture him; so come to our territory, and we will make sure that you catch him.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni Yɛhudianim bɛn yi a sani n-kuli ti sanna la chaŋ ti ʒinila Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ lab mɛrila di tiŋ din nyɛ tin biɛɣu ni duŋtaabo tiŋ maa yaha. Bɛ pun sɔŋ di tanzahi, ka me di goma maa miri naabu.
en: May it be known to the king that the Jews who left you and came to us have arrived in Jerusalem. They are rebuilding the rebellious and wicked city; they are completing the walls and repairing the foundations.

dag: Alibarika pipi shɛli ti ni niŋd alibarika niŋdi di ni la, di pala Masia ʒim ka ti laɣindi nyura? Ka bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti ni ŋmahiri la, di pala Masia niŋgbuŋ ka ti laɣindi ŋubiri maa?.
en: The cup we use in the Lord's Supper and for which we give thanks to God: when we drink from it, we are sharing in the blood of Christ. And the bread we break: when we eat it, we are sharing in the body of Christ.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ya, Ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda ansarisi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri soli ni ti beni.
en: They said to you, When the last days come, people will appear who will make fun of you, people who follow their own godless desires.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: The ax is now ready to cut down the trees. Every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla bɛn baɣa ka niriba ni ka lan nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka n timd a bɛ sani ni a ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: They are stubborn and do not respect me, so I am sending you to tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to them.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, hal bɛ yi yɛn kpɛh a la duu, m min a ni laɣim kpe duu maa; di mi yi nyɛla kum, m min a ni laɣim kpi.
en: Peter answered, Lord, I am ready to go to prison with you and to die with you.

dag: Nimaani ka sapashini maa daa nya Alikizandria ŋariŋ din chani Itali, ka o daa zaŋ ti kpɛhi di ni.
en: There the officer found a ship from Alexandria that was going to sail for Italy, so he put us aboard.

dag: Jɛhoyachin daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Jehoiachin did what the Lord said was wrong. He did all the same things that his father had done.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o yab Dauda soli, ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee o nuzaa polo.
en: He followed the example of his ancestor David and always obeyed the Lord .

dag: A yi chɛ ka nahu buri a chi, nyin miri ka a zaŋ bini pɔb o noli.
en: Do not muzzle an ox when you are using it to thresh grain.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni chɛ ka a zani dabari, ka leei zuliya kam bɛn gil a ni yɛn maani so ansarisi bɛnkam gariti ninni.
en: I will turn you into a desolation to the ridicule of the nations all around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

dag: Dɔbba kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu. Ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ chɛ ka salo maa ʒini gbilligbilli kaman ninvuɣ pihinunu laasabu.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Seat them in groups of about fifty.

dag: Farisiinim bɛn yuri liɣiri pam la ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ maan o ansarisi.
en: The Pharisees were listening to all these things. They criticized Jesus because they all loved money.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa tuui baptaiziri niriba la nti be nimaani.
en: Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had baptized at first, and he stayed there.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-nya ka so kpira ka di nyɛla o ni ka situra zuɣu bee ka nandana ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: I provided clothes for the poor.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha bia;.
en: This, however, is not the way it shall be among you. If one of you wants to be great, you must be the servant of the rest;.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kpe Yaakubu suɣili ni n-yi nimaani kpe Liya suɣili ni, ka yi nimaani kpe dabipaɣiba ayi la suɣa ni, amaa ka bi nya shɛli di ni. Ka o daa yi Liya suɣili ni chaŋ ti kpe Reechɛl suɣili ni.
en: Laban went and searched Jacob's tent; then he went into Leah's tent, and the tent of the two slave women, but he did not find his gods. Then he went into Rachel's tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahi tayiɣis ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo. .
en: They crucified two outlaws with him, one on his right and one on his left.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a kpuɣim a bindoo chaŋ maa.
en: They asked him, Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Jɛrɔbɔam daa na kul bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o daalahichi tumbu soli maa, amaa ka na kul lihirila niriba maa zaa ni m-piiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni saɣi n-leei buɣa tindaannima.
en: King Jeroboam of Israel still did not turn from his evil ways but continued to choose priests from ordinary families to serve at the altars he had built. He ordained as priest anyone who wanted to be one.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa nambɔɣu, ka o ku samli maa zaa o min o sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The master had compassion on that servant, released him, and forgave the loan.

dag: Di saha ka a niriba zaa ti leei bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka su tiŋgbani maa sahakam. Mani n-nam ba, ka zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani ni di chɛ ka n nya jilima.
en: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.

dag: Ka biɛrisuntal maŋa din nyɛ Masia kɔŋko ni tiri shɛl la kpe m-pali yi bebu ni zaa Naawuni tibigibu min o paɣibu zuɣu.
en: I pray that you will then be filled with the fruit of righteousness, which comes from Jesus Christ, in order to give glory and praise to God.

dag: Bee a gari ti yab Yaakubu ŋun daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ ti ti hal ka o min o bihi ni o biŋkɔbiri daa nyuri di kom la.
en: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yihimi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zaɣ yiha kaman bɛ ni yihiri wain tia wala yiha shɛm la, ka lan zaŋ a nuhi doli di wula kaman wain tiwalipɔhira la.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Gather the people of Israel who were left on their land. Gather them the way you would gather the last grapes on a grapevine. Check each vine, like the workers check each vine when they pick the grapes.

dag: Di ni lan sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛm wuhibu mini wuntitali ni zaligu dolibu ni nimmaŋtali polo.
en: They will teach you to develop your mind in the right way. You will learn to do what is right and to be honest and fair.

dag: Miri ka a bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yuun shɛŋa din gari la so pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ? Dama lala bɔhigu pala yɛm bɔhigu.
en: Dont say, Life was better in the good old days. What happened? Wisdom does not lead us to ask that question.

dag: Yawɛ, so lan kani ŋ-ŋman a, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pah a zuɣu kaman ti tiba ni wum shɛm.
en: LORD, no one can compare to you, no God except you, just as we have heard with our own ears.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma ŋɔ zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka Ijipti Naa Nɛko daa chaŋ Karikɛmish din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la ni o ti tuhi tɔbu; ka Jɔsia gba daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Naa Nɛko.
en: Josiah did all these good things for the Temple. Later, King Neco of Egypt led an army to fight against the town of Carchemish on the Euphrates River. King Josiah went out to fight against Neco.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun daŋ tooni daa chaŋ ti kpaag o laa ni dini bahi dunia ni, ka yuma din bie ka kabiri ʒim daa niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biŋkɔbigu la dalinli ka jɛmd o binnan la.
en: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth. Terrible and painful sores appeared on those who had the mark of the beast and on those who had worshiped its image.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So kul ku kɔŋ Dauda daŋ ni ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee.
en: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants.

dag: Bɛ yi kɔhi a ʒilɛl ni Yɛhudia doo bee paɣa a zuɣu, ka o tum tuma ti a yuma ayɔbu, yuun shɛli din pahira ayopɔin ni, nyin bahimi dilana ka o chaŋ.
en: You might buy a Hebrew man or woman to serve you as a slave. You may keep that person as a slave for six years. But in the seventh year, you must let that person go free.

dag: Yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti! Ti bi tum yi ni so taali; ti bi saɣim yi ni so; ti mi bi di yi ni so zalinsi.
en: Open your hearts to us. We have not done wrong to anyone or caused harm to anyone. And we have not cheated anyone.

dag: Bɛ ni lan me du shɛŋa din daa lu la zali. Binshɛɣukam din daa saɣim ka di yuui la zaa, bɛ ni lan mal li zali di zaashee.
en: They will rebuild cities that have long been in ruins.

dag: Yili maa yi nyɛla yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim di ni; amaa di yi pala yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim yi sani.
en: If the people in that house welcome you, let your greeting of peace remain; but if they do not welcome you, then take back your greeting.

dag: Kurigu n-sahiri di kpee, ka ninsalinim gba nyari baŋsim tab sani.
en: As one piece of iron sharpens another, so friends keep each other sharp.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din be tibi, ka o tuma zaa nyɛ din tuhi.
en: The Lord s word is true, and he is faithful in everything he does.

dag: Ka o daa lan wuhi ba yɛra, Di yi niŋ ka yi ni so mali o zo ka ti chaŋ o sani yuntisuɣu ti yɛl o, Zɔri, paŋm ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila ata.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Suppose one of you went to your friends house very late at night and said to him, A friend of mine has come into town to visit me. But I have nothing for him to eat. Please give me three loaves of bread.

dag: M ma, mbusim be n zuɣu a ni daa dɔɣi ma zuɣu. Tiŋ maa nim zaa kul mali ma la naŋgbankpeeni mini zabili. N na ʒi n-dihi so samli bee n-di so samli, amaa bɛ zaa kul turi ma mi.
en: Mother, I am sorry that you gave birth to me. I am the one who must accuse and criticize the whole land. I have not loaned or borrowed anything, but everyone curses me.

dag: Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi n ni daa yɛl a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa jɛndi Izraɛlnim mini Judanima ni zuliya kam la niŋ di ni. N ni daa kul yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la.
en: since the time Josiah was king, I have been speaking to you about Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Now, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ Mɔdɛkai sani tiŋ puuni pal shɛli din daa miri nayili dunol la shee.
en: Hathach went to Mordecai in the city square in front of the palace gate.

dag: nti zaŋ yi ba mini yi malibu kuli n sanna ka n ti tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka yi ti diri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira yi yubu.
en: Let them get their father and their families and come back here. I will give them the best land in Egypt, and they will have more than enough to live on.

dag: O darigi deei m binyɛrigu, o ʒe n-dila m binyɛrigu nyiŋgoli mali.
en: With great force he grasps my clothing; it binds me like the neck of my shirt.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk bɔhi Ibrahimma, A ni woligi piɛsah ayopɔin shɛb zali bɛ ko maa mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: and Abimelech asked, Why have you done this.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni dini n-lee be asama ni nira yɛli: A yi yɛli so ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ.
en: Is it easier for me to tell this man his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?.

dag: ni o ni daa tum tuun shɛli tin ya tiŋgban nɛl ni hal ka yi ti paai kpe ŋɔ na.
en: It was you, not your children, who saw everything he did for you in the desert until you came to this place.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee dola palo ni Naawuni tooni, ka bahiyoli ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: The grave is naked before God; the underworld lacks covering.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛhiŋ la suhuri;.
en: Help those who have doubts.

dag: amaa Masia ŋun daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba san la o ni nyɛ Naawuni Bia la zuɣu. Ka ti gba nyɛla o niriba, tinim dee yi kul mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ ti ni mali tahima shɛl la naani hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: But Christ is faithful in ruling Gods house as the Son. And we are Gods house, if we remain confident of the great hope we are glad to say we have.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Naa n-tim ma ni n ti niŋ shɛli ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka so baŋ timsim maa yɛla bee n ni tim a ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Amaa m mini nachimba bɛn chani maa, n wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn paai ma luɣ shɛli.
en: I'm on a mission for King Saul, David answered. He ordered me not to tell anyone what the mission is all about, so I ordered my soldiers to stay somewhere else.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o ni lo Izraɛlnim alikauli sun shɛŋa la zaa zaɣ yini gba bi yiɣisi. O daa chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: The Lord promised to do many good things for Israel, and he kept his promise every time.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbutuhiriba chɛ tɔbu tuhibu. Bɛ kpalim bela bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yaa. Bɛ kpalimla paɣiba. Bɛ niŋ buɣim dabi bɛ yiya, ka kabisi bɛ dunɔdaya dakparita.
en: Babylons soldiers have stopped fighting. They stay in their forts. Their strength is gone. They have become like frightened women. Babylons houses are burning. The bars of her gates are broken.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti bol o bia Sulemaana na ti yɛl o ni o mɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa zaa tooni, ka kuhi yɛli, Sokam yiɣisim n sani yi. Dinzuɣu so daa ka Yisifu sani saha shɛl o ni daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa o ni nyɛ so.
en: Joseph was no longer able to control his feelings in front of his servants, so he ordered them all to leave the room. No one else was with him when Joseph told his brothers who he was.

dag: Ka amiliya aŋgo maa daa ti yuui kandina, ka gom gbahi bɛ zaa ka bɛ gbihi.
en: When the groom was late in coming, they all became drowsy and went to sleep.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya galisi pam. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a yuli du pam, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will bless you and make your descendants into a great nation. You will become famous and be a blessing to others.

dag: Di daa zɔri dolila tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu sunsuuni, ka bɛ ni booni ti shɛli nyɛvili tia la sa n-doli mɔɣili maa yaɣa ayi zaa, ka wala balibu pinaayi be di zuɣu, ka di wandi goli kam, ka di vari mi nyɛ din tibiri zuliya kam.
en: It flows down the middle of the street of the city. The tree of life is on each side of the river, and it produces fruit every month, twelve times a year. The leaves of the tree are for healing the nations.

dag: ka baŋ ni dilana nyɛla tɛhitilimalana ni alahichilana ŋun maŋmaŋ tuma kar o saria. Wuhibu shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are.

dag: Bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni yihi bɛ paɣiba maa, ka daa zaŋ piɛlaa m-mali sara bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: They promised to divorce their wives, and they offered a ram as a sacrifice for their sins.

dag: Ka n daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka a chana? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, N Chanimi ni n ti buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm m-baŋ di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I asked him, Where are you going? He said to me, I am going to measure Jerusalem, to see how wide and how long it is.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Balaam, Doli ba chaŋ, amaa kul yɛlimila n ni yɛl a ni a yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ka Balaam daa doli Balak kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: It's all right for you to go, the Lord 's angel answered. But you must say only what I tell you. So Balaam went on with Balak's officials.

dag: Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu sokam zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la. .
en: Whoever falls on this stone will be crushed. And the stone will crush the person it falls on.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa teemi gili ma, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord .

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔhi Ilaisha, N daa yɛli nyini n dana ni a tim ma bia? N daa pun bi yɛl a ni a di yɔhim ma.
en: The woman said, Sir, I begged you not to get my hopes up, and I didn't even ask you for a son.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yiri tiŋ maa tariga, ka Samuɛl yɛli Sool, Yɛlim a tumtumda maa ni o cham ti tooni, o yi chaŋ naai nyin zanim kpe biɛla, ka n yɛl a Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm.
en: When they arrived at the edge of town, Samuel said to Saul, Tell the servant to go on ahead of us. The servant left, and Samuel continued, Stay here a minute, and I will tell you what God has said.

dag: Dama ti yi daa nyɛ Naawuni dimnima, amaa ka simdi yipa kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni o Bia la kum zuɣu, dindina din gari lala nyɛla, simdi ni kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ maa zuɣu, ti ni tilig o bia maa nyɛvili zuɣu.
en: If we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son while we were still enemies, now that we have been reconciled, how much more certain is it that we will be saved by his life?.

dag: Juda ŋmanila gbuɣimbila. M bia, a ku a dima, ka ŋmaligi kpe a yiŋa. A teeg amaŋ dɔni kaman gbuɣinli la. A ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi dam a?.
en: Judah is a lions cub; from the prey, my son, you rise up. He lies down and crouches like a lion; like a lioness—who dares disturb him?.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa laɣim tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara bahi, ka bo liɣiri ti siliga guliba maa.
