en: Then the priests met with the older Jewish leaders and made a plan. They paid the soldiers a lot of money.

dag: Itiɔpianim ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ biɛhigu bee jɛŋgbina ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuna bomaboma? Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn gba tum tuumbiɛri ka di mili ya ŋɔ, yi ku tooi lan tum tuun viɛla.
en: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla Manaasa daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali pam hal ka bɛ ʒim ti kul zɔri doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri, di yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ din la polo m-pah o ni daa chɛ ka Judanim tum alahichi mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la.
en: Manasseh spilled so much innocent blood that he filled up every corner of Jerusalem with it. And this doesnt include the sins he caused Judah to commit so that they did what was evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Ti Duuma dabisili dali ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa ti pali ma, ka n wum kukol shɛli n nyaaŋa polo ka di tahiri kaman kikaa vur la.
en: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and I heard a loud voice, that sounded like a trumpet, speaking behind me.

dag: Yaakubu min o malibu yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Yisifu ŋun yuma daa nyɛ yuun pinaayopɔin la min o biɛyanim bɛn daa nyɛ o ba paɣiba Biliha mini Zilipa bihi la n-daa guli bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri. Ka Yisifu daa zaŋdi bɛ tuumbiɛri yɛtɔɣa na ti yɛri bɛ ba.
en: This is the account of Jacobs descendants. Joseph was years old and tended the flock with his brothers. While he was helping the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his fathers wives, Joseph told their father unflattering things about them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔn sani ti yɛl o, Karimba, ŋun daa be a sani Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili yaɣili ka a di o shɛhira la baptaizirila niriba pumpɔŋɔ, ka sokam zaa kabiri chani o sani.
en: So they went to John and told him, Teacher, you remember the man who was with you on the east side of the Jordan, the one you spoke about? Well, he is baptizing now, and everyone is going to him.

dag: Judas ni daa deei laɣ shɛli o daalahichi tumbu ni la, o daa zaŋ li dala palo, ka daa ti lu ka o zuɣu sani tiŋa, ka o puli tahi ka o nyɔri zaa yina.
en: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.

dag: Di saha paɣisarili maa ba min o ma bɛn zaŋmi paɣ maa paɣipalitali shihira na ti wuhi tiŋ maa kpamba dunɔdali gbini.
en: At that point, the young womans father and mother will bring proof of her virginity to the citys elders at the city gate.

dag: Piɛguliba maa ni daa nya biliɛɣu maa, ka bɛ yɛli malaika la ni daa yɛli ba bia maa yɛla shɛm zaa.
en: When they saw this, they reported what they had been told about this child.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya ŋumaŋuma shɛli yi ni wumdi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu. Yi kul wumdila ŋumaŋuma yuuni kam. Yi wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni bɛ yɛn taala duŋ, ka na so yɛn tuhi na so.
en: Dont be distracted or frightened by the rumors you hear in the land. Sometimes you hear one thing and another time something else: rumors of violence and uprisings.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa niŋdila binyari viɛla mini situr sabilifaa shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi ni duu puuni tiŋgban ni kuntu shɛŋa bɛ ni liɣisiliɣisi, ka zaŋ mihi wuɣi ka di mali yaa daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: They sold you luxurious clothing, purple cloth, and embroidery, brightly colored carpets, and well-made cords and ropes.

dag: Mani n-nam neesim mini zibisim, mani n-tahiri alibarika na, ka lan tahiri tɔbu na. Man Yawɛ n-niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: I create both light and darkness; I bring both blessing and disaster. I, the Lord , do all these things.

dag: Wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, ka Yawɛ zaligunim be ti sani? Zaligubaŋdib ʒirinim zaŋ li leei ʒiri.
en: How can you say that you are wise and that you know my laws? Look, the laws have been changed by dishonest scribes.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o dɔɣiriba ni o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: Then Jesus said to them, People everywhere give honor to a prophet, except in his own town, with his own people, or in his home.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛl o bidib tuuli Jɛta, Yiɣisim ku ba. Amaa ka bia maa daa bi saɣi ŋ-ŋoog o takɔbi. O daa zɔrila dabiɛm, o ni daa na nyɛ bipolli la zuɣu.
en: Then he said to Jether, his oldest son, Go ahead, kill them! But the boy did not draw his sword. He hesitated, because he was still only a boy.

dag: Ka bɛ yiŋlan maa daa yuug o gɔrim maa polo hal ti kuna, ka bɛ min o daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mal o liɣiri maa laasabu.
en: After a long time the master of those servants came back and settled accounts with them.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o niriba daa yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ ti piri tab ʒii bunahi zuɣu n-dɔni gili Shɛkɛm.
en: So Abimelech and all the men who were with him got up that night and set an ambush around Shechem in four companies.

dag: Yawɛ mali shili ni o saɣim dunia ŋɔ n-dahimdahim li sɔŋ. O ni chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam ka sokam gbaai zɔbu.
en: Look! The LORD will devastate the earth and destroy it, will twist its face and scatter its inhabitants.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka ala ka n lee yɛn yo a? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, di bi kpa talahi ni a yo ma shɛli. N na kul ni gul a biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: Laban asked, Then what should I give you? Jacob answered, I dont want you to give me anything! I only want you to let me do this one thing: I will go back and take care of your sheep.

dag: N ni na kul be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ, n nyɛla dunia ŋɔ neesim.
en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buŋ maa tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu ka o ba.
en: They brought the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks over the animal, and Jesus got on.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, N dana, ka bɔ ka chɛchɛbunsi ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: Sir, I asked the angel. What do these stand for.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Manaasa min o niriba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: The Lord tried to warn Manasseh and the people about their sins, but they ignored the warning.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun tiri dunianim bɛn tumd o yubu suhudoo ŋɔ.
en: Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.

dag: ka daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm li la.
en: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka di shiri niŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti yi nya li so sani, dilan ni leei n dabili, ka yinim bɛn kpalim ku mali taali.
en: Good! the man replied, I'll do what you have said. But only the one who has the cup will become my slave. The rest of you can go free.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣila yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi;.
en: Offer a burnt offering as a food offering to the Lord , an odor pleasing to him: one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Ti mabihi, din pahi nyɛla yi pun bɔhim ti sani di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm n-tiɣi Naawuni nini yɛla. Hal lala ka yi kul be, ka ti suhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.

dag: Yawɛ sani, o daa nyɛla tɔha ŋun mali yaa pam; dinzuɣu ka niriba daa yi yɛra, Yawɛ chɛ ka a nyɛ tɔha so ŋun mali yaa kaman Nimrɔd.
en: He was a great hunter before the Lord . That is why people compare other men to him and say, That man is like Nimrod, a great hunter before the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ni kpe binnan shɛŋa zali yɛda, ka yɛli ni binnana maa n-nyɛ bɛ wuna, bɛ ni di vi ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: But some of them have left me. They say to their gold statues, You are my gods. They trust their false gods, but they will be disappointed and shamed.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣim yuma ayopɔin maa bindira zaa din daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-sɔŋ fɔntinsi ni, ka laɣim fɔntiŋ kam ni puri ni bindira n-sɔŋ lala tinsi maa ni.
en: Joseph saved the food in Egypt during those seven years and stored the food in the cities. In every city he stored grain that grew in the fields around the city.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Kɛdar zuliya mini Hazɔr nam sulinsi polo, Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa tuhi nyaŋ shɛb la, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, lirimiya Kɛdarinima, wurimmiya wulimpuhili zuliya maa.
en: This is what the Lord said about the tribe of Kedar and the districts controlled by Hazor, which were conquered by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia: Attack the people of Kedar and destroy that tribe of eastern people!.

dag: Ka Ibram daa lan gbaai chandi zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb polo.
en: Then he moved on from place to place, going toward the southern part of Canaan.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pali a min a niriba ni Ijiptinim zaa yinsi. Ka yi banim bee yi yaannim daa na ʒi n-nya lala tatabo bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ba saha shɛli zaŋ kana zuŋɔ. Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa ŋmaligi Firawuna sani yi.
en: Your palace, the homes of your officials, and all the other houses in Egypt will overflow with more locusts than have ever been seen in this country. After Moses left the palace.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni nya tibiginsim din tuhi niŋbu ni, ka Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ wuh o kasitali maa wuntitali puuni.
en: But the Lord Almighty shows his greatness by doing what is right, and he reveals his holiness by judging his people.

dag: Ka Sisɛra ma daa vɔbisiri lihiri takɔro ni. O daa kul vɔbisiri lihirila takɔro maa voya ni ka bɔhira, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ti yuui kundina lala? Bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka di yuui ka ti kul bi wumd o yuri napɔn chinchiba damli.
en: There is Siseras mother, looking out the window, looking through the curtains and crying. Why is Siseras chariot so late? Why cant I hear his wagons.

dag: Ti piligima n-lan tibigiri timaŋ yaha? Bee di nyɛla talahi ni ti tin ya shɛhira gbana bee n-deei shɛhira gbana yi sani kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: Are we starting to commend ourselves again? We dont need letters of introduction to you or from you like other people, do we?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Yi daa bi mi Naawuni so, naɣila mani. Ka tiligira so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, I am the Lord your God, who led you out of Egypt. You have no God but me. I alone am your savior.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa zaa yi sansani maa ni na ni bɛ ti zani Naawuni tooni, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani zoli maa gbini.
en: Then Moses led the people out of the camp to a place near the mountain to meet God.

dag: M mabihi, doliya anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ ti Duuma yuli tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa la naba yi suɣilɔdibo din yuuri yi wahala dibu puuni la.
en: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi jɛmdi buɣa bo wahala pam ti bɛmaŋa. N ku pahi bɛ ni n-kɔrigi binyara ʒim vie buɣa maa; m mi kul ku yaai n noli boli di yuya.
en: Those who rush to other gods bring many troubles on themselves. I will not take part in their sacrifices; I will not worship their gods.

dag: Dɔbba ŋɔ mi nyɛla bɛn tɛha bie ni bɛn yɛda niŋbu pa alali. Janeez mini Jambireez ni daa chihi Anabi Musa yɛligu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ gba chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli;.
en: Just as Jannes and Jambres fought against Moses, these people fight against the truth. Their thinking has been confused. The faith they have and teach is worthless.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ zaa ni gbilisi tibili wum, ka taɣi bɛ biɛhigu din bi viɛl maa, ka n gba taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ n ni lo ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu la polo.
en: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.

dag: O kabiri daanya dunoyɔriti ka kabiri kuriti dunokparitisi.
en: He breaks down their bronze gates. He shatters their iron bars.

dag: Yi wuntaŋ mini yi goli ku lan lu, dama Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam; ka yi fabila dabisa la zani tariga.
en: Your sun will never go down again. Your moon will never again be dark. Thats because the Lord will be your light forever, and the dark days of mourning will end.

dag: ka bɛ bɔh o, A wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa bebɔ? Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Iin. Amaa yi na bi karim din sabi Naawuni Kundi ni? Di sabiya: Bihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu ni yɛlimaŋli. .
en: They said to Jesus, Do you hear what these children are saying? Yes, he answered. Havent you ever read, From the mouths of babies and infants youve arranged praise for yourself? .

dag: Ka Pita teei ka yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, nyam fiig ti shɛli a ni sa yɛli noli ti la ni kuui zaa shɛm.
en: Peter remembered what had happened and said to Jesus, Look, Teacher, the fig tree you cursed has died.

dag: Maata ni daa ti wum ni Yisa be soli kanna o daa yiɣisimi ti tuh o soli, ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim be yiŋa.
en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him, while Mary remained in the house.

dag: Yi barinyubo ka gbinni. Yi bi mi ni dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita?.
en: It is not right for you to be proud! You know the saying, A little bit of yeast makes the whole batch of dough rise.

dag: Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa yɛli Karia bia Jɔhanan, Di niŋ lala, dama ʒiri ka a ŋma m-pa Ishimail maa.
en: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam told Johanan, Kareahs son, Dont do such a thing, for what you are saying about Ishmael is wrong.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ka yi su li yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua.
en: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the people.

dag: Daantalisi maa ni daa yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu daa nyɛla daanya, amaa daantalisi maa bansi mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa, ka bɛ daa niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni, ka lɔndo maa daantalisi mihi zaa daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: The bases for the posts were made of bronze, and the hooks, the rods, and the covering of the tops of the posts were made of silver. All the posts around the enclosure were connected with silver rods.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee buɣisi di tariga, bee n-teei mii sɔŋ buɣisi li? Biɛhiŋ kani, a mi di zaa!.
en: Who set its measurements? Surely you know. Who stretched a measuring tape on it?.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani palo ni daa galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ daa ŋmaai di shɛli polo ti Simiɔn zuliya niriba; ka Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa puuni.
en: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon.

dag: Amaa n dimnim bɛn daa bi bɔri ni n su ba la, zaŋmiya ba na nti ku ba n nini ŋɔ ni.
en: Now, as for those enemies of mine who did not want me to be their king, bring them here and kill them in my presence.

dag: Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni daa sab ninvuɣ shɛb yuya saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili Jɛriko tooni polo la m-bala.
en: Moses and Eleazar counted the Israelites while they were camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab Ɛnmishipat bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Kadɛshi la. Ka bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛk tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Amɔrinim bɛn daa be Hazazɔntarima la zaa.
en: Then they turned back, came to En-mishpat , and attacked the territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.

dag: Bɔ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi nya li? Bɛ daa bi bo li la yɛda niŋbu puuni, amaa ka daa bo li la bɛmaŋmaŋ tuma puuni. Bɛ daa tuui kuɣ tuurili shɛli.
en: Why? Its because they didnt go for it by faith but they went for it as if it could be reached by doing something. They have tripped over a stumbling block.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanima; yi mi di puhiya daadam kam sol ni.
en: Don't take along a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals. And don't waste time greeting people on the road.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Shɛkɛmnim gba nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tibidarigibo kaman Gidiɔn bia Jɔtan la ni daa pun yɛli noli ti ba wuhi ni di ni niŋ ba shɛm la.
en: God also punished the men of the city of Shechem for the bad things they had done. So the things said by Jotham son of Gideon came true.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi daboli maa zuɣu kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindoo n-du pii zuɣu ti yɛrigi sɔŋ Sool, ka o daa dɔni nimaani gbihi.
en: After they finished eating, they came down from the place for worship and went back to town. Samuel made a bed for Saul on the roof.

dag: A ni niŋdi laasabu shɛŋa la zaa yoli, a gbarigiya. Chɛ ka bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla tilig a, ka chɛ ka saŋmaribaŋdiba bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla yɛl a goli kam puuni binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ a.
en: You are powerless in spite of the advice you get. Let your astrologers come forward and save you— those people who study the stars, who map out the zones of the heavens and tell you from month to month what is going to happen to you.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Jɛfita, Kamina ti leei ti zuɣulana n-zaŋ ti chaŋ ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima.
en: Please come back to Gilead! If you lead our army, we will be able to fight off the Ammonites.

dag: Biɛɣu daa yi neei, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka sagban daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-wuhiri ba soli, yuŋ mi daa yi ti zibi, o chɛrimi ka buɣim daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-ne ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ chani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: The Lord led the way. During the day, he used a tall cloud to lead the people. And during the night, he used a tall column of fire to lead the way. This fire gave them light so that they could also travel at night.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni kpihim ŋahali maa ka bɛ ku lan ŋahi li Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Amaa yɛlim ba ni dabisa maa miriya, ka ʒii kam ni niŋ pali.
en: Now tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , have to say about that. I will put an end to that proverb. It won't be repeated in Israel any more. Tell them instead: The time has come, and the predictions are coming true!.

dag: o chanimi ti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie n-gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani. Di saha dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam gari di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Then it goes out and brings seven other spirits even worse than itself, and they come and live there. So when it is all over, that person is in worse shape than at the beginning.

dag: Mɛshɛk mini Tubal beni, ka di tɔbbihi gbala yɛrigi di ni zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn bi guni. Takɔbi ka bɛ zaŋ ku ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Meshech and Tubal are there, and all their hordes around their graves, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, for they caused terror in the land of the living.

dag: Teem ŋun nam a yɛla a bipolitali saha, ka wahala saha na bi paai, ka yuun shɛŋa ni a ni ti yɛn yɛli, M baɣa lan ka shɛl ni la gba saha na bi paai.
en: So remember your Creator while you are still young, before those dismal days and years come when you will say, I don't enjoy life.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka zooi pam ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anakinim la. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa ku ba ka chɛ ka Ammɔnnim maa deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani.
en: There were many Rephaites, and they were very strong and tall like the Anakites. But the Lord helped the Ammonites destroy them. The Ammonites took that land and live there now.

dag: Ka o yi po pɔri shɛlikam ni o niŋ shɛli, o yidana mali soli ni o saɣi li bee n-zaɣisi li.
en: Her husband may allow any solemn promise or any binding pledge of self-denial to stand or be broken.

dag: Amaa n kul ni mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, n ni yili yila paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But I will never stop speaking of the God of Jacob or singing praises to him.

dag: Ka Yaakubu maa daa nyɛ Yisifu ba; ka Yisifu mi daa nyɛ Mariama ŋun daa dɔɣi Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la yidana.
en: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary—of whom Jesus was born, who is called the Christ.

dag: Ka naa daa po n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi ka nyɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The king made a solemn pledge and said, As surely as the LORD lives, who rescued me from every trouble.

dag: Ka tɔbu daa yiɣisi alizanda ni. Malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil min o malaikanima n-daa tuhiri waɣ biɛ titali maa min o gba malaikanima.
en: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.

dag: Dama pa malaikanim yɛla m-muɣis o, amaa ti yab Ibrahimma yaansi yɛla m-muɣis o.
en: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Malimiya shili zaŋ chaŋ dali, so di chɛ ka o mini paɣa dɔni.
en: He told the men, Prepare yourselves for three days. Dont go near a woman.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du duli ha.
en: On the evening of that same day Jesus said to his disciples, Let us go across to the other side of the lake.

dag: Daadam, a bela duŋtaariba sunsuuni, bɛn mali nina din ni nya, amaa ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba din ni wum, amaa ka bi wumda, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Human one, you live in a household of rebels. They have eyes to see but they dont see, ears to hear but they dont hear, because they are a household of rebels.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yɛla wumdi daadam ka di ka yɛtɔɣa. Nini bi nyari tiɣira, ka tibili mi bi wumdi tiɣira.
en: Everything leads to weariness—a weariness too great for words. Our eyes can never see enough to be satisfied; our ears can never hear enough.

dag: Jɔab mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa ni daa kuna ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Nɛr bia Abinɛr la kala naa sanna ka o bah o ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: Joab and all his army arrived at Hebron. The army said to Joab, Abner son of Ner came to King David, and David let Abner leave in peace.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Bipuɣinsi ŋɔ nyɛla m bipuɣinsi, ka bihi ŋɔ nyɛ m bihi, ka biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ nyɛ m biŋkɔbiri; ka a ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa kpe ŋɔ nyɛla n dini. Amaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ wula ka n yɛn niŋ m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ mini bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛb ŋɔ?.
en: Laban said to Jacob, These women are my daughters. These children belong to me, and these animals are mine. Everything you see here belongs to me, but I can do nothing to keep my daughters and their children.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be strong and courageous! Let's fight hard for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the Lord 's will be done.

dag: Bɛ daa me li tamla bimbin kurili la tanzaa zuɣu, hal bɛ ni daa kul zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab dabiɛm la zaa yoli. Ka bɛ daa maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu tiri Yawɛ asiba ni zaawuni.
en: They were afraid of the other people living near them, but that didnt stop them. They built the altar on its old foundation and offered burnt offerings on it to the Lord . They offered sacrifices in the morning and in the evening.

dag: n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka yi kaari ma; ka n daa ti be sarika ni, ka yi kani n sanna ti kaari ma.
en: I was naked and you gave me clothes to wear. I was sick and you took care of me. I was in prison and you visited me.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋdi hal ti paai yuma ayi, ka Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka be Ɛsha daa wum ti Duuma yɛligu maa.
en: for two years, until every Jew and Gentile in Asia had heard the Lord's message.

dag: Gbaamiya piɛ viɛlli biŋkɔbbaligu maa ni. Niŋmiya dari kuli daaŋa ni; duɣimiya nimdi maa; duɣimiya o kɔba gba.
en: Pile wood underneath the pot, and let the meat and bones boil until they are done.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, bɔ ka n lee niŋ ya? Bimbɔ ka n zaŋ muɣisi ya? Garigimiya ma!.
en: My people, what did I ever do to you? How have I wearied you? Answer me!.

dag: Alɔbɔnima n-doli taba, tiŋgbani maa zaa bahila yoli. Yim ka bɛ daa ti dii saɣim n suɣa, ka chahi m pateesanima.
en: One disaster follows another; the whole country is left in ruins. Suddenly our tents are destroyed; their curtains are torn to pieces.

dag: Amaa sokam ni ti ʒila o wain tia bee o fiig tia gbini, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yaag o noli yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa o ni ʒina ka di nyɛ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa. Ka so n-daa bi ti Naa Sulemaana tulaale ka di galisi paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa ti o tulaale shɛli maa.
en: She presented to King Solomon the gifts she had brought: almost five tons of gold and a very large amount of spices and jewels. The amount of spices she gave him was by far the greatest that he ever received at any time. .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa nya malaikanima anahi, ka bɛ ʒe dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ n-gu pɔhim soli ni di di ʒe n-kpe dunia ni bee teeku ni bee n-ʒe tihi.
en: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth. They held back the earths four winds so that no wind would blow against the earth, the sea, or any tree.

dag: Leeban daa chaŋla o piɛri kɔbiri chɛbu, ka Reechɛl daa zu n-kpuɣ o ba wuna.
en: Before Rachel left, she stole the household idols while Laban was out shearing his sheep.

dag: Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni kpiimba bi neeri kum ni, dindina Naawuni daa bi neei Masia kum ni m-bala, ka ti gba leei bɛn ŋma ʒiri pa Naawuni, dama ti pun di Naawuni shɛhira ni o daa neei Masia kum ni.
en: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim ni niriba zaa daa wum Jɛrimia ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni maa.
en: The priests, the prophets, and all the people heard me saying these things in the Temple.

dag: Ka salo pam dii laɣimna hal ka palichee ti lan ka yili maa ni, ka so daa naan ku tooi lan miri dunol ni gba, ka Yisa yihiri ba waazu.
en: A large crowd gathered to hear him speak. The house was so full that there was no place to stand, not even outside the door. While Jesus was teaching.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum Gaad yɛligu maa ka chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: So David did what Gad told him to. David did what the Lord wanted and went to see Araunah.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ti Yawɛ o ni daa me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa varanda tooni la zuɣu.
en: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar which he had built in front of the Temple.

dag: N jɛmd a mi ni n suhu zaa, di chɛ ka m birig a zaligunima.
en: With all my heart I try to serve you; keep me from disobeying your commandments.

dag: Nyama, m min a zaa nyɛla yim Naawuni sani. Taŋkpaɣu ka o daa zaŋ nam man gba.
en: You and I are the same before God. He used clay to make us both.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi biɛɣu zuɣu, dama biɛɣu gba jiɣindila dimaŋ zuɣu. Dabisili kam wahala saɣiri li mi.
en: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o, Bɔ m-poog a n sani ka a bɔri ni a kul a ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka Hadad yɛl o, Kul chɛ ka n kuli.
en: Why? the king asked. Have I failed to give you something? Is that why you want to go back home? Just let me go, Hadad answered the king. And he went back to his country. As king of Edom, Hadad was an evil, bitter enemy of Israel.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti zaɣisi anab maa ni yɛn zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa wumbu, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti kari dilan saria.
en: I myself will hold accountable anyone who doesnt listen to my words, which that prophet will speak in my name.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yi o ba bihi maa sani chaŋ ti be Tɔb tiŋgban ni. Ka nimaani bibiɛhi daa laɣim Jɛfita sanna ti dol o chani ŋ-ŋmɛri fari dira.
en: So Jephthah ran away from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Worthless men gathered around Jephthah and became his posse.

dag: Dama di sabiya, Yinim Yɛhudianim zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kul ʒiɛmdi Naawuni yuli.
en: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have poor people with you, but you will not always have me.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni ti zaŋ n ni zaŋ n yɛligu shɛli ti a la yɛli ba.
en: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kɔniŋdi bini maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo lɔrigi ni.
en: The large bowl called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the temple.

dag: Ka o zo maa ni do duu puuni ha ka garigi yɛl o, Di nahim ma, dama n dunol kparimi ka m mini m bihi do gom ni; dinzuɣu n ku tooi yiɣisi zaŋ li ti a.
en: And suppose your friend should answer from inside, Don't bother me! The door is already locked, and my children and I are in bed. I can't get up and give you anything.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpe bɛ sani asiba n-nya ka bɛ malila suhugarigu.
en: When Joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were upset.

dag: Ka n ti ba suhuyini, ka zaŋ shi palli kpɛhi bɛ ni. Ka n ti yihi suhu shɛli din be kaman kuɣili ŋɔ bɛ ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ bɛ ni.
en: I will bring them together and make them like one person. I will put a new spirit in them. I will take away that heart of stone, and I will put a real heart in its place.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbutuhiriba chɛ tɔbu tuhibu. Bɛ kpalim bela bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yaa. Bɛ kpalimla paɣiba. Bɛ niŋ buɣim dabi bɛ yiya, ka kabisi bɛ dunɔdaya dakparita.
en: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul bela a tooni kumdi niŋd a yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: Lord God, my savior, I cry out all day, and at night I come before you.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa niŋ wɔɣirili, dama o daa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa soli.
en: Jotham was securely established because he maintained a faithful life before the LORD his God.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi n-lo tɔbu; bɛ daa laɣimla Soko din be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka ti bɛ suɣa Soko maa mini Azɛka tiŋ shɛli din be Ɛfɛsidammim tiŋgban ni la sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines gathered for battle in Socoh, a town in Judah; they camped at a place called Ephes Dammim, between Socoh and Azekah.

dag: O ku lan tooi zaŋ binshɛli zal o zaani bee n-zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o n-zaŋ zaɣ suŋ taɣi zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu taɣi zaɣ suŋ. Ka o yi zaŋla biŋkɔbigu ni o taɣi biŋkɔbigu, dindina o ni zaŋ so na ni o ti taɣ o maa min o zaa ni leei bɛn be kasi.
en: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.

dag: Bɛn daa zaŋla lɔɣu ni be bindir shɛli ni ti ma ni n di; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka bɛ zaŋ yabiga kom ti ma ni n nyu.
en: They gave me poison for food. To quench my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

dag: Di ni leei tim tib a niŋgbuŋ, ka chɛ ka a niŋgbuna maai.
en: If you do this, it will be like a refreshing drink and medicine for your body.

dag: Ɛmim zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ wɔɣira ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anaki zuliya, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam la n-daa pun be nimaani.
en: Now the Emim had lived there before. They were big and numerous and tall—just like the Anakim.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi bɛn Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim maa nɛma mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ.
en: The four kings took everything in Sodom and Gomorrah, including the food, and went away.

dag: Di simdi ka Izraɛlnim zaa dol li.
en: The whole community of Israel must do this ceremony.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni daa pii ti yaannima n-chɛ ka bɛ nab pam hal saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nyɛ tinzunnima m-be Ijipti la. Ka o daa ti yihi ba nimaani o yiko ni.
en: The God of this people Israel chose our ancestors. God made them a great people while they lived as strangers in the land of Egypt. With his great power, he led them out of that country.

dag: ka bɛ dii chɛ bɛ ba mini ŋariŋ maa ka dol o.
en: and at once they left the boat and their father, and went with him.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria. Ka o bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehu died and was buried with his ancestors. The people buried him in Samaria. His son Jehoahaz became the new king of Israel after him.

dag: M mi ni di ni simdi ni daadamnim niŋ shɛli nyɛla bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, ka di nyaɣisim hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: So I realized that all we can do is be happy and do the best we can while we are still alive.

dag: Zaŋmiya zaligu kundi ŋɔ ti sɔŋ baɣili Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la, ka di be nimaani nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Take this Instruction scroll and put it next to the chest containing the LORD your Gods covenant. It must remain there as a witness against you.

dag: Ka n ni zali yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga la Teeku Ʒiɛɣu noli zaŋ hal ni Filistianim Teeku noli, ka lan zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli tariga. Dama n ni ti zaŋ di niriba maa niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi kari ba.
en: I will make the borders of your land extend from the Gulf of Aqaba to the Mediterranean Sea and from the desert to the Euphrates River. I will give you power over the inhabitants of the land, and you will drive them out as you advance.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N saha na bi paai; amaa yinim nyɛla bɛn kul mali saha sahakam.
en: Jesus said to them, The right time for me has not yet come. Any time is right for you.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba ti shihi ma, ka di yi niŋ lala, di ni wuhi ni n mal o la ansarisi maa; ka di ni chɛ ka o yɛli noli ti ma ka pa ni o niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: If my father touches me, he will know that I am not Esau. Then he will not bless me—he will curse me because I tried to trick him.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa be Jɛrusalɛm, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi ni di taɣi Judanima.
en: Rehoboam remained in Jerusalem and had fortifications built for the following cities of Judah and Benjamin:.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm. Naa ni tooi niŋ o ni bɔr shɛm, dinzuɣu o tooni zanibu yi ti mali barina, nyin zom yomyom.
en: Dont be afraid to give suggestions to the king, and dont support something that is wrong. But remember, the king gives the commands that please him.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa, ka zaŋ li niŋ o baɣaka.
en: Pharaoh turned and went back to his palace. He wasnt impressed even by this.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o laɣim bɛn bi ʒe yim ni.
en: then the master will come back one day when the servant does not expect him and at a time he does not know. The master will cut him in pieces and make him share the fate of the disobedient.

dag: M bɔhim din be a zaligunim puuni ka di wɔɣa, ni a zal li mi ni di kul be sahakam.
en: Long ago, I learned from your rules that you made them to last forever.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Amiliya lɔbu maa shili biya, amaa n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la bi simdi li.
en: Then he said to the servants, It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa chihi yɛli, M bi la, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbaag o. Ka o yɛli, Aai, a laya.
en: Sarah was so frightened that she lied and said, I didn't laugh. Yes, you did! he answered.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyaya ni di nyɛla bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi tooi nya vuhim maa.
en: So we see that they were not allowed to enter and have Gods rest, because they did not believe.

dag: Di saha maa yi ni ti yɛli, Ti min a n-daa yi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka a be pala zuɣu wuhiri ti la.
en: Then you will answer, We ate and drank with you; you taught in our town.

dag: A ni ku bɛ zuliya bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yihi bɛ bihi ninsalinim ni.
en: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti taai duŋ niŋ Ijipti naa. Ka nyin Daniɛl zuliya ni ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb gba ni ti taai duŋ pahi ni di chɛ ka ʒii la ni yɛla la niŋ pali, amaa bɛ ni ti kɔŋ nasara.
en: Then many people will rebel against the king of Egypt. And some violent people from your nation, Daniel, will rebel because of a vision they have seen, but they will be defeated.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, luɣim a tiba wum ti suhigu ŋɔ, ka ŋmalig a nini n-lihi ti nya ti ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni, ka nya a yuli ni tab tin shɛl la ni diri wahala shɛm. A ni zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu ka ti suhir a, ka pa ni ti wuntitali zuɣu.
en: Open your ears, my God, and listen! Open your eyes and look at our devastation. Look at the city called by your name! We pray our prayers for help to you, not because of any righteous acts of ours but because of your great compassion.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Naawuni, N na doli Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni? Amaa ka o bi garig o dindali maa.
en: Saul asked God, Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help us win? This time God did not answer.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu ka di simdi ni n na be n nyɛvil ni.
en: However, its more important for me to stay in this world for your sake.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili din be kasi, dama dindali maa ka Naawuni daa vuh o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa binshɛɣukam nambu ni maa jɛlinsi.
en: God blessed the seventh day and made it a holy day. He made it special because on that day he rested from all the work he did while creating the world.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa yihi anzinfa mini salima binyara ni chinchina ti Ribɛka; ka ti o tizɔdoo maa min o ma gba nachiinsi binshɛŋa din liɣiri galisi pam.
en: Then he gave Rebekah the gifts he brought. He gave her beautiful clothes and gold and silver jewelry. He also gave expensive gifts to her mother and brother.

dag: Daadam, fabilim Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka yɛl o, A tɛhiya ni a nyɛla gbuɣinli zuliya kam sani, amaa a ŋmanila nyɛbiga m-be mɔɣili ni. A luri a kulibɔna kom ni, ka zaŋ a naba siɣiri kom maa ni n-saɣim a kulibɔna maa puuni kom.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt and tell him I am saying: You act like a lion roaming the earth; but you are nothing more than a crocodile in a river, churning up muddy water with your feet.

dag: Amaa Musa daa yi chaŋ Yawɛ sani ni o min o ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, o piligirila sariga maa o ninni, naɣila o ti yina. Ka o daa yi yina ti yɛli Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni yɛl o shɛm.
en: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord . And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.

dag: Iso ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi saha shɛli ka o daa kpuɣi Judit ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Bɛri la bipuɣiŋga mini Basɛmat ŋun gba nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛlɔn la bipuɣiŋga.
en: When Esau was years old, he married Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

dag: ka yɛli a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba, ka yɛli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla yuŋ.
en: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.

dag: N ŋmanila sana n dɔɣiriba sani; ka ŋmani tinzun nira m ma puuni bihi sani.
en: I have become a stranger to my own brothers, an immigrant to my mothers children.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli ka duh a. Zallakudura Naa, n ni yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: You make me happy, so I will rejoice in you. God Most High, I praise your name.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ni bɛ mali baŋsim maa birigiya ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: When some people adopted this false knowledge, they missed the goal of faith. May grace be with you all.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka noli yɛlibu yɛla ŋɔ zaa di yi dimnim bɛn daa nahim ya la.
en: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you and chase you.

dag: Ka a ba yi ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, nyin yɛlim o, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ o ya Bɛtilihɛm, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛn malila yuuniyuuni sara.
en: If Saul wonders where I am, tell him, David asked me to let him go to his hometown of Bethlehem, so he could take part in a sacrifice his family makes there every year.

dag: Cham ti yɛli ba ka bɛ labi bɛ suɣa ni.
en: Go and tell them to return to their tents.

dag: Zuɣulaan so ŋun daa pah anu n-su gol so ŋun pahi anu ni n-daa nyɛ Shamhut, o daa nyɛla Izira nira. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the fifth month, Shamhuth from the Izrah clan;.

dag: Bɛ tintariga daa kpuɣila Hɛlɛf zaŋ hal ti paai oki tia din be Zaananim la n-gari chaŋ hal ni Adaminɛkɛb mini Jabiniil m-mali lala hal ti paai Lakkum n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: their border ran from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim and Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

dag: A zo yi ti a dansi di mali daliri, amaa a dim ŋun kul yɛn mɔɣisirila a kpariŋ bushɛm.
en: You can trust what your friend says, even when it hurts. But your enemies want to hurt you, even when they act nice.

dag: O daa mali salima bans anahi n-zaŋ li ga teebuli maa luɣ anahi zuɣu naba la.
en: He made four gold rings for the table. He fastened the rings to the four corners at its four legs.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ zula biŋkɔbigu maa dilan sani, dindina di simdi ni o yo o zuɣu.
en: but if the animal was stolen, the man must repay the owner.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa wum lala ka bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, a bɔri ni ti chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba kaman Anabi Ilaija ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: When the disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to consume them.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Mbaye! Yawɛ zaŋla ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: Finally, the king of Israel said, Oh, I think the Lord really brought us three kings together only to let the Moabites defeat us.

dag: M mi ni a ni chɛ ka n kpi n-kuli yili shɛli a ni zaŋ zali nyɛvililan kam la ni.
en: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa je suli niŋ o, ka yɛli, Di di simdi ni a zaŋ li fiɛbila siɣimsiɣim bunu bee buyɔbu; dindina a naan ŋme Sirianim hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili, amaa a ni bi niŋ lala maa zuɣu, a ni ŋme n-nyaŋ ba la siɣimsiɣim buta kɔŋko.
en: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.

dag: Amaa nir nyari zahimbu din ni chɛ ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la omaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri yi ti voog o kpɛhi di ni n-gbaag o kaman tɔŋ la.
en: You are tempted by the evil things you want. Your own desire leads you away and traps you.

dag: Karimbaandan maa ni tuui lu ka so ku beni ŋun ni yiɣis o zali. Ka n ti nyo o fɔntinsi buɣim, ka di di binshɛɣukam din gil o.
en: You are proud, but you will stumble and fall, and no one will help you up. I will set your villages on fire, and everything around you will go up in flames.

dag: Kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni fɔntin shɛŋa din baɣi li ni daa wurim shɛm la, lala ka di gba ni wurim; ka so ti ku lan be nimaani, ka so mi ti ku lan ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah and their surrounding towns, says the LORD. No one will live there; no human will dwell in it.

dag: Di yi pa lala Yawɛ ni nya li, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o ku lan yiɣisi o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord will know if you are gloating, and he will not like it; and then maybe he won't punish them.

dag: Kpahimmiya m-baŋ yi galimi ni yi shɛl na, ka niŋ tuuba n-lan lab yi tuuli yurilim la ni yaha. Di yi pa lala n ni kana nti kpuɣi yi firilatamdigu la di zaashee.
en: So remember where you were before you fell. Change your hearts and do what you did at first. If you dont change, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin suhimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni, chɛ ka a yuli du;.
en: This, then, is how you should pray: Our Father in heaven: May your holy name be honored;.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi ŋmanila yalim dunia ŋɔ ni. Yalim mi yi ti niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha; bɛ ni kpaa li mi bahi ka niriba nɔri li, dama di lan ka buchi.
en: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.

dag: Niriba pam daa di o shɛhira kpɛma, amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa daa lee bi doli taba.
en: Many brought false testimony against him, but they contradicted each other.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kumiya dɔbba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: You must do this! You must kill every man in Jabesh Gilead and every woman who has had sexual relations with a man. But do not kill any woman who has never had sex with a man. So the soldiers did these things.

dag: Salo daa yiɣisi zani n nudirigu polo, bɛ daa kari ma bahi, ka ŋma n kubu pala sɔŋ.
en: This mob attacks me head-on; they send me running; they prepare their final assault.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Then Jesus said, You people who hear me, listen.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti muɣisiri ba ka bɛ fabili niŋ Yawɛ la, ka o daa tim Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ti yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-zaŋ ba na ti ʒili kpe ŋɔ.
en: When Jacob and his family went to Egypt and the Egyptians oppressed them, your ancestors cried to the Lord for help, and he sent Moses and Aaron, who brought them out of Egypt and settled them in this land.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii niriba ayi zali; bɛna n-nyɛ: Yisifu so bɛ ni daa booni Barisabas mini Mataias.
en: They put two men before the group. One was Joseph Barsabbas. He was also called Justus. The other man was Matthias.

dag: ka Sulemaana daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔam ba, ka Rɛhɔbɔam nyɛ Abija ba, ka Abija mi nyɛ Ɛsa ba.
en: Solomon was the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam was the father of Abijah. Abijah was the father of Asaph.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam mili mi bi bɔri da palli, dama o yɛrimi ni da kurili ko n-nyaɣisi o sani.
en: And you don't want new wine after drinking old wine. The old is better, you say.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna suhu kpɛm pam; o zaɣisiya ni o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Pharaoh is being stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlabil yino mali sara asiba, ka zaŋ piɛlabil so ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali sara zaawuni.
en: Offer the first lamb in the morning, and the second in the evening.

dag: o nyɛla do so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ka maligumaana yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, o nyɛla ŋun mali dɔro o zuɣu ni.
en: This is leprosy—you are unclean.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, A tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri zaa lu n-kpi n-doya.
en: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.

dag: Jeemsi daa lan yɛli, Dinzuɣu n tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni ti nahim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ tuuba maa;.
en: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.

dag: Ka o lan maa yi be katiŋa bee a yi bi mi o lana, dindina nyin taɣim o kul a yiŋa, ka o ti be a sani hal ka o lan maa ti bɔh o yɛla, ka a zaŋ o ti o.
en: But if its owner lives a long way off or if you don't know who owns it, then take it home with you. When its owner comes looking for it, give it to him.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nira, ka nyɛ namɔɣili be nayil la daa wum ni bɛ zaŋ Jɛrimia ti niŋ kɔbiliga maa puuni. Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka naa ʒi Bɛnjamin dunɔdal la gbini.
en: Ebed-melech the Cushite, a court official in the royal palace, got word that they had thrown Jeremiah into the cistern. Since the king was sitting at the Benjamin Gate.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kana ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋa anu.
en: The second servant came and said, Sir, I have earned five gold coins with the one you gave me.

dag: Bɛ kul bemi kaman shihi la n-gili n luɣilikam, ka ŋmaligi kpi yomyom kaman buɣim n-di gɔhi la, ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They swarmed around me like bees, but they burned out as quickly as a brush fire; by the power of the Lord I destroyed them.

dag: Wummi n suhigu, dama bɛ filim ma. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni, dama bɛ mali yaa gari ma.
en: Pay close attention to my shouting, because Ive been brought down so low! Deliver me from my oppressors because theyre stronger than me.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka kayeeniba kpe Babilɔn nti yɛl li. Bɛ ni ti yi luɣilikam na nti naai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali.
en: I will send foreigners to destroy Babylonia like a wind that blows straw away. When that day of destruction comes, they will attack from every side and leave the land bare.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ti o bɛ ni zaŋ fiig tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa mini wain wal kuma yila ayi. O ni daa di n-naai ka o nini neei, dama o daa bi di shɛli bee n-nyu kom wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ dabisi muna ata.
en: some dried figs, and two bunches of raisins. After he had eaten, his strength returned; he had not had anything to eat or drink for three full days.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dii bah o ni o chama.
en: After Jesus strictly warned the man, he sent him on his way.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Balaam daa yiɣisi kul o ya, ka Balak gba ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: After Balaam finished, he started home, and Balak also left.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa.
en: For the breastpiece they made chains of pure gold, twisted like cords.

dag: Mushi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa n-doli bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: and Mushis family: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the Levites according to their households.

dag: N ni ti ŋme a tɔbu a nuzaa ni bahi, ka a piɛma yi a nudirigu ni lu.
en: I will strike your bow from your left hand, and make your arrows fall from your right.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tim tuumba pinaayi maa ka kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, yi mi di kpɛnya Samarianim tin shɛl ni.
en: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: Stay away from the Gentiles and don't go to any Samaritan town.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Kitirɔn bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Nahalol, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu; amaa ka bɛ daa lee muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The tribe of Zebulun didnt drive out the people living in Kitron or Nahalol. These Canaanites lived with them but were forced to work for them.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti zaŋ n yuli suhi Naawuni; ka m bi yɛli ni n ni ti suhi m Ba tin ya.
en: Then you will be able to ask the Father for things in my name. Im not saying that I will have to ask the Father for you.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ bɛ tab niriba ayi maa.
en: Now when the other ten disciples heard about this, they became angry with the two brothers.

dag: yɛl o, Chɛl a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ka yiɣisi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-looi n ni yɛn wuh a tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: God said to him, Leave your country and your people, and go to the country I will show you.

dag: Di bi wumdi so yɛligu; di bi deeri so saɣisigu; di bi niŋdi Yawɛ naani; di mi bi vuri miriti di Naawuni.
en: They didnt listen to me or accept my teachings. Jerusalem didnt trust the Lord . Jerusalem didnt go to her God.

dag: Bɛ daa kpahi ŋmɛnditoya ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu; yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo.
en: The soldiers also nailed two criminals on crosses, one to the right of Jesus and the other to his left.

dag: Ka nyini m bia, bɛ ni ti boon a la Zallakudura Naa daanabi, dama a ni ti daŋ ti Duuma tooni nti mal o soya gu o;.
en: Now you, little boy, will be called a prophet of the Most High God. You will go first before the Lord to prepare the way for him.

dag: N teeya ni n ni daa naɣ lan baptaizi shɛb nyɛla Stɛfanas yiŋnima, din mi nyaaŋa m bi tɛhi ni n lan baptaizi so yaha.
en: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun tɛhi ni o ʒe dɛde, ŋun miri ka o ti niŋ lu.
en: So anyone who thinks they are standing strong should be careful that they dont fall.

dag: N ni daa wum o kukoli, n daa lu n-dɔn la tiŋa n-liɣi ka n nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Then I heard the sound of the mans words. When I heard it, I fell into a trance with my face on the ground.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ʒini gbilligbilli: Shɛb kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi pihinunu.
en: So the people sat down in rows, in groups of a hundred and groups of fifty.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Bɛtimaakabɔt ni Hazarisusa.
en: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah.

dag: O chɛ ka sokam chɛ o tuma, ni di chɛ ka bɛ tɛhi ŋun Naawuni tuma yɛla.
en: He stamps the hand of every person so all can know his work.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ammɔnnim naa daa ti kpi ka o bia Hanun daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Some time later King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.

dag: Chɛ ka ti bidibisi zoori kaman tipola din zoori ni kpiɔŋ la, ka ti bipuɣinsi mi be kaman nayili zɔŋ daantalisi la.
en: May our sons in their youth be like plants that grow up strong. May our daughters be like stately columns which adorn the corners of a palace.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul tumdi tuumbiɛri, dindina o ni kpihim yi mini yi naa maa zaa birili.
en: But if you and your king do evil, the Lord will wipe you out.

dag: Nam din ti yɛn doli a nam ŋɔ nyaaŋa ti ku paag a dini ŋɔ. Di nyaaŋa, ka nam din pah ata n-nyɛ daanya ka ti yɛn su dunia zaa la deei.
en: But in your place, another kingdom will arise, one inferior to yours, and then a third, bronze kingdom will rule over all the earth.

dag: Yisa so bɛ ni lan booni Justus la gba puhiri ya. Niriba ata ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Naawuni nam zuɣu; bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpaŋsiri n suhu pam.
en: Joshua, also called Justus, sends greetings too. These three are the only Jewish believers who work with me for the Kingdom of God, and they have been a great help to me.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn zaŋ noombihi nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋmila ŋmanʒiɛhi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi.
en: If you offer a bird as a burnt offering to the Lord , that bird must be a dove or a young pigeon.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ n zɔnim ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi, di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi lan niŋ shɛli pahi.
en: I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot afterward do anything worse.

dag: Miri ka a pahi shɛli o yɛligu zuɣu, di yi pa lala o ni kpah a zuɣu ni, ka di wuhi ni a nyɛla ʒirilana.
en: If you claim that he said something that he never said, he will reprimand you and show that you are a liar.

dag: O daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ni o malila Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shili ka bɛ tum Naawuni tuma n-chɛ ka ŋun Masia niŋgbuŋ la zooi.
en: He did this to prepare all God's people for the work of Christian service, in order to build up the body of Christ.

dag: Ka o daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntinsi, vuhim ni daa be tiŋgbani maa ni saha shɛli, dama o mini so daa bi zabira. O daa bi tuhi tɔbu di yuma maa ni, dama Yawɛ daa ti o vuhim.
en: He built fortifications for the cities of Judah during this time, and for several years there was no war, because the Lord gave him peace.

dag: N zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bɔhi n yɛla, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bo ma nya ma. N yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn bi suhiri ma, Mani m-bɔŋɔ, mani m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I was ready to respond to those who didnt ask. I was ready to be found by those who didnt look for me. I said, Im here! Im here! to a nation that didnt call on my name.

dag: O miri ka o di binshɛlikam din yi wain tia zuɣu na bee n-nyu wain bee n-nyu binnyuri kpiɔŋ bee n-di binshɛli din chihiri dibu. Chɛ ka o doli n ni zal o shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: She must not eat or drink anything made from grapes. She must not drink wine or beer or eat anything forbidden by God's laws. I told her exactly what to do.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni o ni chɛ ka yi suhuri ba n-zani ka yi be tibi, ka be kasi ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la sani, saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o ninvuɣ gahinda yi ti labina.
en: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Zɛbidii bih ayi la pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: Jesus took along Peter and the two brothers, James and John. He was very sad and troubled.

dag: Di zaŋ pako so ŋun na bi paai yuun pihiyɔbu yuli pahi pakoya kalinli ni. Ka din pahi nyɛla, di simdi ni ŋun yuli ni tooi pahi bɛ kalinli ni nyɛla ŋun daa pun kulila do yino kɔŋko;.
en: Do not add any widow to the list of widows unless she is over sixty years of age. In addition, she must have been married only once.

dag: Ka Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia la daa leei bɛ zuɣulan saha shɛli ha, ka Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: Phinehas son of Eleazar—may the Lord be with him!—had supervised them at one time.

dag: Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛsi bia Dauda daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ ni duhi ninvuɣ so, Yaakubu Naawuni ni pii ninvuɣ so ka o ŋma yil nyaɣisa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: David son of Jesse was the man whom God made great, whom the God of Jacob chose to be king, and who was the composer of beautiful songs for Israel. These are David's last words:.

dag: ka zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu neen shɛŋa din nyɛ buɣim moori binyara mini gbabɔnima ni soobuya ni taha ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma zaa pa di zuɣu, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They shall put on it all the equipment used in the service at the altar: fire pans, hooks, shovels, and basins. Then they shall put a fine leather cover over it and insert the carrying poles.

dag: mini Bɛndɛka ŋun daa be Makaz la ni Shaalibim ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni Ɛlɔnbɛtihanan.
en: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Paɣ ni tooi tam o bimɔɣirigu yɛla bee n-zaɣis o ni dɔɣi bi so nambɔɣu zɔbu? Hal o yi ni tam gba, man Yawɛ ku tam yi yɛla.
en: But the Lord says, Can a woman forget her baby? Can she forget the child who came from her body? Even if she can forget her children, I cannot forget you.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin bidibisi daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Ashibɛl ni Gɛra ni Naaman ni Ɛhi ni Rɔshi ni Mupim ni Hupim ni Arid.
en: Benjamins sons were Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

dag: Ka n daa wum ninvuɣ so kukoli ka di yi Ulai Mɔɣili la ni na m-booni yɛra, Gabirɛl, wuhim o o ni nya shɛli maa gbinni.
en: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, Gabriel, help him understand the vision.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni ka bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew what they were discussing and said, You people of weak faith! Why are you discussing among yourselves the fact that you dont have any bread?.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri duŋtaabo ni ʒi ba chaŋ, bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku tum din tuhi zuɣu.
en: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, for they refuse to act with justice.

dag: Di chira ata nyaaŋa ka ti daa ti kpe Alikizandria ŋariŋ shɛli din dalinli daa nyɛ bɛ buɣijahi ŋmahinli la. Di daa kpalim ʒe nimaani la kikaa saha zaa.
en: After three months we sailed away on a ship from Alexandria, called The Twin Gods, which had spent the winter in the island.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Saha kanna, n ni niŋ li. N ku chɛ li niŋbu, n ku tilig a, n suhu ku maai. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma min a biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not ignore your sins or show pity or be merciful. You will be punished for what you have done. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Amaa ti bɔri ni ti bahi wum din be a sani, dama ti mi ni adiini so shɛli a ni doli ŋɔ, niriba kul tɔɣisiri galindi li mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: We want to hear your ideas. We know that people everywhere are speaking against this new group.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋzaalan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: You will suck the milk of nations, and nurse at royal breasts. You will know that I am the LORD, your savior and your redeemer, the mighty one of Jacob.

dag: Ka di daa kpaŋsi nimaani yɛdaniŋdib suhuri, ka niriba kul pahiri bɛ zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: So the churches were made stronger in the faith and grew in numbers every day.

dag: Zɛbulɔn tiŋgbani mini Naftali tiŋgbani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi teeku polo, ka nyɛ tiŋgban shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Galili chɛfirinim tinsi la.
en: Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!.

dag: Toli maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila yuri bɛn mali shili gu tɔbu tuhibu, ka binshɛŋa din be kaman salima nam zuɣupila la pil bɛ zuɣuri, ka bɛ ninani ŋmani daadam ninni.
en: The locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads were what seemed to be gold crowns. Their faces were like human faces.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti paai tin shɛlikam ka bɛ bi deei ya, yin doliya di pala yɛra.
en: Whenever you enter a city and the people dont welcome you, go out into the streets and say.

dag: Ti daa da puu maa mini siliga din be di ni maa la Hitinim sani.
en: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. Bury me there.

dag: Ka n ku zo o bihi nambɔɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla pagɔrili bihi.
en: I will have no pity on her children because they are the children of prostitution.

dag: Di zɔri yɛlibiɛ libigirili dabiɛm bee sanʒiɛɣu din ʒiɛri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Dont fear sudden terror or the ruin that comes to the wicked.

dag: Di sab Naawuni zaligu ni ni ti Duuma yɛliya: N ni zaŋ niriba bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa mini tinzunnim noya ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ, amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ku bahi wum n yɛligu.
en: As the Scriptures say, Using those who speak a different language and using the lips of foreigners, I will speak to these people. But even then, they will not obey me. Isaiah :- This is what the Lord says.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka ŋun kɔri ni ti niŋdi yomyom gari ŋun kpuɣiri puu atam, ka ŋun kahindi wain wala kom ni ti niŋdi yomyom gari ŋun biriti li. Wain nyaɣisili ni ti yi zoya zuɣu n-tɔɣiri lurina, ka di ni ti zo n-tiɛli daboya zaa.
en: The days are coming, says the Lord , when grain will grow faster than it can be harvested, and grapes will grow faster than the wine can be made. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti va bɛ yiŋ daazichi chaŋ, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali ka bɛ ti yɛn va li maa.
en: Their household wealth will be carried off by rushing streams on the day of his anger.

dag: ka zaŋ o kuli a yiŋa, di simdi ka o pini o zuɣu, ka ŋmah o nyinyɛhi.
en: Take her to your home, where she will shave her head, cut her fingernails.

dag: Saha shɛli Amazia ni daa chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu maa, ka bɛ daa lo ni bɛ ku o Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa zo n-kuli Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa chɛ ka shɛb chaŋ Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: As soon as Amaziah started disobeying the Lord , some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah. He was able to escape to the town of Lachish, but another group of people caught him and killed him there.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei paɣ shɛb niriba bɛn daa kpi kum ni ti ba. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaɣisi yolisim shɛli din nyɛ daadamnim dini, ka nya azaaba hal ti kpi di puuni ni bɛ ti neei kum ni m-mali nyɛvili din so.
en: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.

dag: Man Daniɛl ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa, n daa kul bɔri ni m baŋ di gbinni. N nini nyabu yim ka n daa nya ka so ʒe n tooni ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ninsal kɔtomsi la.
en: Now I, Daniel, needed help understanding the vision I saw. Suddenly standing in front of me was someone who looked like a man.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti a Ba maa ni nyɛ so! Dina ka ti kul bɔra.
en: Philip said, Lord, show us the Father; that will be enough for us.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lu saha shɛli ka o ni yi daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi di bin kasinim la, dama o bindirigu m-bala.
en: He will be clean only after the sun goes down. Then he can eat the holy food because it is his share.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ bindirigu din mali nyɛvili n-yi alizanda ni na maa. Ka ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; bindiri shɛli mi n ni yɛn zaŋ ti dunianima ka bɛ nya nyɛvili di zuɣu maa nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ.
en: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever, and the bread that I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.

dag: Di saha ka Siria naa kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Izraɛlnim Naawuni nyɛla zoya zuɣu Naawuni, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti maa, amaa chɛliya ka ti tuhi ba la bɔpiɛligu ni, biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni nyaŋ ba.
en: Meanwhile, Benhadad's officials went to him and explained: Israel's gods are mountain gods. We fought Israel's army in the hills, and that's why they defeated us. But if we fight them on flat land, there's no way we can lose.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋ ti hal ti ni kul bi tam a yɛla bee n-saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la zaa.
en: All this has come upon us, but we havent forgotten you or broken your covenant.

dag: Paɣipiɛl so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl. Di gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni be ti sani.
en: Look! A virgin will become pregnant and give birth to a son, And they will call him, Emmanuel.

dag: Ka o zo maa ni do duu puuni ha ka garigi yɛl o, Di nahim ma, dama n dunol kparimi ka m mini m bihi do gom ni; dinzuɣu n ku tooi yiɣisi zaŋ li ti a.
en: Your friend inside the house answers, Go away! Dont bother me! The door is already locked. My children and I are in bed. I cannot get up and give you the bread now.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlli ŋɔ puuni, so miri ka o tum o kpee din bi tuhi bee ŋ-ŋar o kpee. Ti daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka na kul kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ni ti Duuma ni darigi bɛn tumdi din bi tuhi ŋɔ tatabo tibili.
en: In this matter, then, none of you should do wrong to other Christians or take advantage of them. We have told you this before, and we strongly warned you that the Lord will punish those who do that.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They came to the land of Gilead, to the people of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ nam maa siɣisi dimaŋa, ka ku duhi dimaŋa. Ka di yi gbibi alikauli maa, dina n-ni chɛ ka di zani.
en: Thus it would be a lowly kingdom, not asserting its own interests but observing the agreement so that it would survive.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam li pa teeku zuɣu, ka chɛ ka di pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: He built it on the deep waters beneath the earth and laid its foundations in the ocean depths.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n zuɣu nyɛ kɔbiliga, ka n nina nyɛ nintam kɔbilinini ka n di tooi kuhiri bɛ ni ku n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: If my head were filled with water, and if my eyes were a fountain of tears, I would cry day and night for my people who have been destroyed.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa taali, ka yɛra, Tim ti kom ka ti nyu. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Wula ka yi zaŋ ma taali? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi Yawɛ.
en: They complained to Moses and said, Give us water to drink. Moses answered, Why are you complaining? Why are you putting the Lord to the test.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinim ayi maa daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛri ba, Dumiya kpe na! Ka bɛ daa kpe sagban ni n-du alizanda ni bɛ dimnim maa ninni.
en: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, Come up here. And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.

dag: Nanim ni ti be kaman yi banim la, ka bɛ paɣiba bɛn nyɛ nanim be kaman yi manima. Bɛ ni ti damdi ya tiŋa ka lun ya sizuura. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ; ka bɛnkam zaa guhiri n sɔŋsim ku di vi.
en: Kings will be your attendants, and their queens your nursemaids. With faces to the ground they will bow down to you; they will lick the dust from your feet. You will know that I am the LORD; the one who hopes in me wont be ashamed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba na ti zali maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Zomiya tiligi! Yi mi miriya ka yi ŋmaligi lihi yi nyaaŋa bee n-zani vinvamli ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli. Kul zomiya ti du zoya ŋɔ ha, di yi pa lala, buɣim ni din ya.
en: Then one of the angels said, Run for your lives! Don't look back and don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, so that you won't be killed.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli, ka gbilisiya tibili wum fabila shɛŋa din yɛn yi n noli ni na.
en: Hear my teaching and pay attention to the arguments of my lips.

dag: Ka yi mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the lower part of the front of the two shoulder straps of the ephod, near the seam and above the finely woven belt.

dag: A kuhigu maa nyɛla din ni sɔŋ yih a muɣisigu ni bee a yaa zaa n-ni ti a sɔŋsim?.
en: Will he arrange your rescue from distress or from all your exertions of strength?.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti deei puu maa chuɣu puhibu la saha, di ni nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ pu shɛli ti Yawɛ. Maligumaana n-ni ti su li.
en: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi Azimɔn maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni m-mali lala hal ni teeku ni.
en: From Azmon the border will go to the River of Egypt, and it will end at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Yuri, chamiya tooni, chɛchɛbunsi, bilimmiya yomyom! Chɛ ka tɔbbihi cham tooni. Itiɔpianim mini Libianim n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi ka Lidianim mi nyɛ peentɔriba.
en: Charge, you horses; advance, you chariots! Attack, you soldiers with your shield in hand, you people of Cush and Put with your bow drawn, you archers from Lud.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, bee n-chɛ ka bɛ kari ba saria n-wuhi ni bɛ kum ba.
en: But the Lord will not let the wicked defeat them. He will not let good people be judged guilty.

dag: Ka tulaale zim ni daa pali salima lahi pinaayi shɛŋa la zaɣ yini kam tibisim nyɛ giram kɔbiga ni pia kaman Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri tibisim zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka salima lahi maa zaa tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram yini ni giram pihitanaayi.
en: the twelve gold bowls full of incense weighing ten shekels each according to the sanctuary shekel—all the gold of the bowls weighed one hundred twenty shekels.

dag: ni Mɛjarikɔn ni Rakɔn ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili chaŋ ti gili Jɔpa.
en: Me Jarkon, Rakkon, and the area near Joppa.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ka bɛ daa daŋ tiŋgbani tibu kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa dola Juda mini Yisifu zuliya niriba tiŋgbana sunsuuni.
en: The lot for the clans of the Benjaminite tribe appeared first. The border of their allotment went out between the people of Judah and the people of Joseph.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mɛri wuna pa shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri ni yuri binshɛŋa bi kuri ba buchi. Bɛ shɛhiranim ku tooi nya shɛli bee m-baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni di vi.
en: All those who make idols are worthless, and the gods they prize so highly are useless. Those who worship these gods are blind and ignorant—and they will be disgraced.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa bɛ ku tooi wum; bɛ mi bi vuhira.
en: They have ears, but cannot hear. They have mouths, but no breath.

dag: Tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, ka tiŋgban kuŋ gba ti mali suhupiɛlli ka bimpuma ti yirigi di ni m-be kaman taaŋkɔro la.
en: The desert will rejoice, and flowers will bloom in the wastelands.

dag: N dimnim kul lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. Bɛ bɔrimi ni n kpi ka n yuli gba kpi m-pahi.
en: My enemies say cruel things about me. They want me to die and be forgotten.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom vuui ka chɛ soli tin ya hal ka yi ti gbaai li du. Di daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom vuui ka chɛ soli ti ti hal ka ti ti gbaai li du shɛm la.
en: This was because the LORD your God dried up the water of the Jordan before you until you crossed over. This was exactly what the LORD your God did to the Reed Sea. He dried it up before us until we crossed over.

dag: O darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili. Yawɛ ku niŋ zinchili zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili darigibu polo.
en: but he will not hesitate to punish those who hate him.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa.
en: Jesus said to them, Come, follow me, and I will make you a different kind of fishermen. You will bring in people, not fish.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niriba chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Nɛtania bia Ishimail. Bɛ daa ti paag o la Gibiɔn been tital la ni.
en: So they went after him with their men and overtook him near the large pool at Gibeon.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ me bimbini tam Ɛbal Zol zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal to the LORD, the God of Israel.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira balibu kam, ka dabiɛm daa kpe sokam.
en: Many miracles and wonders were being done through the apostles, and everyone was filled with awe.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira maa neei biɛɣu, ka manna la daa chɛ lubu na. Ka Izraɛlnim daa bi lan nya li di yaha, amaa ka daa kpalim dirila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira di yuuni maa ni.
en: The manna stopped on that next day, when they ate food produced in the land. There was no longer any manna for the Israelites. So that year they ate the crops of the land of Canaan.

dag: Maligumaana yi yɛn kpe dundɔŋ maa ni, di bi simdi ka o nyu wain.
en: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka niriba daa tahi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu zaa Yisa sanna.
en: After the sun had set and evening had come, people brought to Jesus all the sick and those who had demons.

dag: Di saha Samuɛl daa na bi mi Yawɛ ka Yawɛ mi daa na ʒi n-kahig o yɛligu wuh o.
en: Now Samuel didnt yet know the LORD, and the LORDs word hadnt yet been revealed to him.

dag: Bee n yi di zaŋ takɔbi lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu ka yɛli, Takɔbi, lum tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: Or I might send an enemy army to fight against that country. The soldiers would destroy that country—I would remove all the people and animals from that country.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses.

dag: Ka n yi pirigi n ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ tari, hal ka zaŋ n niŋgbuŋ ti ni bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka ka yurilim, dindina di ku ku ma buchi.
en: If I give away everything that I have and hand over my own body to feel good about what Ive done but I dont have love, I receive no benefit whatsoever.

dag: O ni daa ti neei kum ni la nyaaŋa ka o nyaandoliba teei ni o daa pun yɛli yɛlli ŋɔ zali; ka daa niŋ Naawuni Kundi mini Yisa ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa yɛda.
en: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered what he had said, and they believed the scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.

dag: M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi ni niriba pam bɔri ni yi niŋ karimbanima, dama yi mi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ karimbanim ni ti nya saria karibu gari sokam.
en: My brothers and sisters, not many of you should become teachers, because we know that we teachers will be judged more strictly.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu bi dalimla yɛda niŋbu, dama di sabiya: Ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: The law does not depend on faith. No, it says that the only way a person will find life by the law is to obey its commands.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la kɔŋ nasara, ka di vi! Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo la birim ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o yiɣisi Galili n-chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha;.
en: After Jesus said all these things, he left Galilee. He went into the area of Judea on the other side of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kul pahirila baŋsim mini zoosim, ka mali zuɣu pam Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: Jesus matured in wisdom and years, and in favor with God and with people.

dag: Ninsal nini ni ni tooi nya Masia so la nyɛla Naawuni so ninsal nini ni ku tooi nya ŋɔ ŋmahinli, ka lan nyɛ Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun gari binnamda zaa.
en: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the one who is first over all creation.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli.
en: The master of those servants will come on a day when they are not expecting him, at a time they couldnt predict.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa lee baŋya ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu fukumsi niŋ n nuu ni ni n yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kaman o ni zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu fukumsi niŋ Pita nuu ni ni o yihi li ti Yɛhudianim shɛm.
en: But these leaders saw that God had given me a special work, the same as Peter. God gave Peter the work of telling the Good News to the Jews. But God gave me the work of telling the Good News to the non-Jewish people.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa lan yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu, m bɔrimi ni n lan zaŋ piɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ buɣisi bin yini pahi. N suhir a, chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gili piɛ gbaŋ maa, amaa ka chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kuma.
en: Then Gideon said to God, Don't be angry with me; let me speak just once more. Please let me make one more test with the wool. This time let the wool be dry, and the ground be wet.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu daa ti zahim zahindi ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani maan pahi.
en: One time Joseph had a special dream. Later, he told his brothers about this dream, and after that his brothers hated him even more.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi.
en: Then the Lord said, Do you think it is right for you to be angry.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o yi ku yiɣisi zaŋ li ti o o min o simdi maa zuɣu, amaa o nimmoo suhigu maa zuɣu o ni yiɣisi zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa ti o.
en: He may not get up and give you the bread, just because you are his friend. But he will get up and give you as much as you need, simply because you are not ashamed to keep on asking.
