dag: N tiligim ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee chandi? N tiligim ba kum ni? Nyin kum, a daalɔbɔnim la lee be ya? Nyin kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a bahiyol la lee be ya? N nini bi lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: Should I, the Lord , rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋlan ŋun fari ma bahira. A zaŋ bini pili n zuɣu tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: My LORD God, my strong saving help— youve protected my head on the day of battle.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilabil yino maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: Offer the proper grain offering of flour mixed with olive oil: pounds of flour with the bull, pounds with the ram.

dag: Daadam shia nyɛla Yawɛ firila din vihiri baŋdi din be daadam niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: Your spirit is like a lamp to the Lord . He is able to see into your deepest parts.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa baŋ dinkam zaa niŋ maa, ka o suhu daa saɣim, ka o dar tɔh o situra, ka zaŋ buɣu pili, ka niŋ tampiligim puɣ o zuɣu n-yi n-kpe tiŋ puuni chani gindi kuhiri fabila kuhigu pampam ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: When Mordecai learned what had been done, he tore his clothes, dressed in mourning clothes, and put ashes on his head. Then he went out into the heart of the city and cried out loudly and bitterly.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kul wum ni Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa kpiya maa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti deeg o puu maa su.
en: Ahab got up and went to take over the vineyard.

dag: Ka a ni ti lan nya ka a zuliya galisi. Ka a bihi ti galisi kaman mɔri ni galisi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: You will have many children. They will be as many as the blades of grass on the earth.

dag: Bɛ bi fabindi niŋdi ma ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa bɛ dola bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu kuhira. Dama bɛ zaŋ bini ŋma bɛmaŋa bɛ kawana mini bɛ wain zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ma.
en: They have not prayed to me sincerely, but instead they throw themselves down and wail as the heathen do. When they pray for grain and wine, they gash themselves like pagans. What rebels they are!.

dag: A ni sabi jaaŋgbe shɛŋa zuɣu maa yi ti be a nuu ni ka bɛ nya li.
en: When the two sticks that youve written on are in your hand in their sight.

dag: So ku tooi yo omaŋmaŋ talima samli bee n-yo Naawuni o nyɛvili samli.
en: But no one has enough to buy back a life, and you cannot bribe God.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ nandan nirilim dihila Yawɛ samli, ka o ni ti yo o di zaa.
en: Those who are gracious to the poor lend to the LORD, and the Lord will fully repay them.

dag: Musa ni daa kpi saha shɛli maa, o yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi. O nina daa na kul nɛmi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o niŋgbuŋ ni yaa daa bi filim.
en: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died; he was as strong as ever, and his eyesight was still good.

dag: A me binshɛŋa din dundu maa zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ a viɛlim maa tum pagɔrisigu tuma. A zaŋ amaŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋunkam garita, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam.
en: You built your mounds at the head of every road. Then you degraded your beauty. You used it to catch every man who walked by. You raised your skirt so that they could see your legs, and you acted like a prostitute with those men.

dag: n-zaŋ di zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi maa gahigahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei nuhi gahibu sara Yawɛ sani.
en: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.

dag: ka bɛ ni yino daa kani ka chɛ ma, ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ bini n-dari chɛrisichɛris o; ka m bi lan nya o hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: One of them was already missing and had not been seen for a long time. My father thinks the boy was torn to pieces by some wild animal.

dag: Kaman saa pɔhim ni tahiri sakom na shɛm, lala ka nyaanzum tahiri suhuyiɣisili na.
en: Gossip brings anger just as surely as the north wind brings rain.

dag: Ŋuni mini tuumbiɛtumdiba n-lee laɣim be, ka o mini ninvuɣ biɛri doli?.
en: and travels a path with wrongdoers, walking with evil persons.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi ŋmɛnditol shɛba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: Even the bandits who had been crucified with him insulted him in the same way.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli jilima nyabu zuɣu. Fam ti bahi, ka chɛ ti daalahichi a yuli zuɣu.
en: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti tim Judas mini Silas ni bɛ ti yɛli ya ti ni sab yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ bɛmaŋmaŋ nol ni pahi.
en: We send you, then, Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things we are writing.

dag: Di zaŋya yimaŋ bali bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba ni, dama wula ka wuntia mini din pa wuntia ni tooi laɣim be bee zɔtali bɔ m-be neesim mini zibisim sunsuuni?.
en: You are not the same as those who dont believe. So dont join yourselves to them. Good and evil dont belong together. Light and darkness cannot share the same room.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi booi kpam maa bahi bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gba mini di nɛma la zaa zuɣu, ka malimali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di leei din be kasi zaa.
en: Next, dedicate the altar and all its equipment by anointing it, and it will be completely holy.

dag: Pa palo n-kul do a tooni ŋɔ? Woligim ka chɛ ma. A yi zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo, n ni zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo; ka a yi zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo, m mi ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo.
en: We should separate. You can choose any place you want. If you go to the left, I will go to the right. If you go to the right, I will go to the left.

dag: ni Umma ni Afɛk ni Rɛhɔb gba daa pahi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pisinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob. In all there were towns and the fields around them.

dag: ka hal ti ni daa nyɛ bɛn kpi ti nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu la, o daa neei ti mini Masia kum ni. Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka yi tiligi.
en: that while we were spiritually dead in our disobedience he brought us to life with Christ. It is by God's grace that you have been saved.

dag: Ka yi mini yi yiŋnim zaa ni tooi di li luɣ shɛlikam zaa; dama yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri m-bala.
en: You and your household may eat it anywhere, because it is payment for your service in the meeting tent.

dag: Saawara niŋbu yi kani, nia lɔbu bi paana, amaa saawaranim pam yi beni, bɛ dirila nasara.
en: Get all the advice you can, and you will succeed; without it you will fail.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni gba ku chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri nti nya ka yilli maa lo tɔbu n-tuhi wuntizɔriba nyaŋ ba.
en: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Maasɛya so mini Ɛlia ni Shɛmaya ni Jɛhiɛl ni Uzia.
en: Of the family of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

dag: N kul yɛn kariti ba la biɛlabiɛla hal ka yi daadam biɛligu ti nabi n-su tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: Instead, I will drive them out little by little, until there are enough of you to take possession of the land.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Yinim Dauda zuliya ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, yi ni niŋdi shɛm chɛ ka ninsalinim nyee nyooni la, lala ka yi bɔri ni yi niŋ chɛ ka n Naawuni ŋɔ gba nyee nyɔni.
en: Then Isaiah said, Listen, house of David! Isnt it enough for you to be tiresome for people that you are also tiresome before my God?.

dag: Ka Mariama daa kpalim Ɛlizabɛt sani kaman chira ata laasabu, ka naanyi kul o ya.
en: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months, and then returned to her home.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋna nti nya zoondɔɣirili.
en: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who was blind from birth.

dag: N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛha buyiyi, amaa n yur a zaligu dina.
en: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.

dag: Ka n daa suhi Yawɛ di saha maa gba yɛli.
en: Then I begged the Lord to do something special for me. I said.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa kpɛhi Juda zuliya niriba maa dabiɛm, ka gbarigi ba zaŋ chaŋ mɛbu maa polo.
en: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.

dag: Naawuni ti o naa nasara din galisi; ka wuhi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili la polo; zaŋ chaŋ Dauda min o zuliya sani pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: God gives great victories to his king; he shows constant love to the one he has chosen, to David and his descendants forever.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli, ka nyɛ luɣ gahindili luɣ kasi shee tiŋgbani maa ni. Di ni ti nyɛla luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee n-tuɣi Lɛvinim tiŋgbani.
en: This share from this holy part of the land will be especially for these priests. It will be next to the land of the Levites.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli daa bi yaɣi lala? A bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni kul dirila nyaɣisim saha biɛla kɔŋko?.
en: no wicked people have been happy for long.

dag: hal ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu daa ti di Ijipti nam.
en: But then another king rose to power over Egypt who didnt know anything about Joseph. .

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Giliad maa ti Manaasa bia Makiri ka o ʒini nimaani.
en: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir, and they lived there.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, O yi nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ, hal o zabigu zaɣ yini gba ku lu tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be o kɔbili ni, o ni kpi.
en: Solomon answered, If Adonijah doesn't cause any trouble, I won't hurt him. But if he does, I'll have him killed.

dag: N Naawuni maa tim o malaika na ka o ti mum gbuɣima maa noya, ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ ma shɛli. Naa, o niŋla lala, dama n ka taali o sani, ka ka taali a gba sani; ka m mi bi tum a taal shɛli.
en: My God sent his messenger, who shut the lions mouths. They havent touched me because I was judged innocent before my God. I havent done anything wrong to you either, Your Majesty.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka zuɣusaa paɣ a daalahiziba tuma, ka chɛ ka a ʒiɛyimtali kul be a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: The heavens sing of the wonderful things you do; the holy ones sing of your faithfulness, Lord .

dag: n-zaŋ ba zali tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu suhi Naawuni ti ba.
en: Then they put these men before the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai naa bia Abija.
en: At that time King Jeroboam's son Abijah got sick.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim a niriba ŋɔ suhuri kpa a polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni mali nia shɛŋa mini tɛhi shɛŋa ŋɔ kul ni be bɛ suhuri ni sahakam.
en: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.

dag: Hamɛdata ŋun daa yi Agag zuliya ni na bia Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim la n-daa ti chɛ ka bɛ pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya, ka ku Yɛhudianima. O daa lomi ni o bahi ba yoli zaa.
en: Indeed, Haman, Hammedatha the Agagites son, the enemy of all the Jews, had planned to destroy the Jews. He had servants throw pur to find the best month and day to trouble greatly and destroy them.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna daa kul nyɛlisiri la ŋubi. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei.
en: The seven sick cows ate the seven healthy cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.

dag: Dama noli zaɣisibu mini baɣibuɣibo zaa alahichi nyɛla yim. Ka tipawumli mini buɣijɛmbo mi nyɛ alahichi yini. Ka a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu ŋɔ zuɣu, o gba zaɣisiya ni a ku lan nyɛ naa.
en: Rebelling against God or disobeying him because you are proud is just as bad as worshiping idols or asking them for advice. You refused to do what God told you, so God has decided that you can no longer be king.

dag: Karimbaannim bari ma la tɔŋ, ka teei bɛ mihi sɔŋ kaman laŋ la, bɛ bari ma la zana soli zuɣu.
en: These proud people are trying to trap me. They spread nets to catch me; they set traps in my path. Selah.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, hal di pa shɛli yi ni yɛn nya wahala din ku yuui zahimbu balibu shɛŋa din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu la zaa yoli;.
en: I know the thought of that is exciting, even if you must suffer through different kinds of troubles for a short time now.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi la daa ti binnani maa vuhim hal ka binnani maa ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa gba, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi binnani maa jɛmbu.
en: The second beast was given power to give life to the idol of the first beast. Then the idol could speak and order all those who did not worship it to be killed.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, N sapashinnim zaa nyɛla nanima.
en: He says: Arent my commanders all kings?.

dag: Dama ti Duuma yɛla yɛtɔɣa daa bi yi yi sani m-paala Masidɔnia mini Akaia kɔŋko, amaa yi ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda shɛm yɛla pun gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Dinzuɣu di bi lan simdi ni ti yɛli shɛli pahi.
en: For not only did the message about the Lord go out from you throughout Macedonia and Achaia, but the news about your faith in God has gone everywhere. There is nothing, then, that we need to say.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ka Yawɛ zali ya ni yi niŋ, ka ŋun Yawɛ jilima yi zahira yi sani.
en: Moses said, You must do what the Lord commanded. Then the Glory of the Lord will appear to you.

dag: Chɛ ka di yuŋ maa leei bumbɔn titali. Di chɛ ka di leei suhupiɛlli dabisili pahi yuuni puuni dabisa zuɣu. Di kal li pahi goya dabisa ni.
en: Erase that night from the calendar and conceal it with darkness.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini nam shɛŋa din niriba bi jɛmd a la zuɣu.
en: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋm a mabihi bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ka nyɛ a daŋ niriba la na ka bɛ ti pah a zuɣu n-sɔŋd a min a bidibisi maa saha shɛli yi yi ti be alikauli suɣili maa gbini tumdi tuma.
en: The Levites are your relatives and are here to help you in your service at the tent.

dag: Ka Naa maa mi ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa niŋdi m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi maa.
en: Then the king will answer, The truth is, anything you did for any of my people here, you also did for me.

dag: Di simdi ka yi lo biŋkɔbigu maa zali hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, dindali zaawuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni ti kɔri bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: You should watch over the animal until the th day of the month. On that day all the people of the community of Israel must kill these animals just before dark.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kummiya ka fabili dabisili maa zuɣu.
en: Son of man, speak for me. Say, This is what the Lord GOD says: Cry and say, A terrible day is coming.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa lan nya tiŋ maa ni kpamba pia m-boli ba ni bɛ gba kamina ti ʒin nimaani. Bɛ ni daa ʒini.
en: Then Boaz got ten of the town leaders and also asked them to sit down. After they had sat down.

dag: N ni ŋme solɔɣu du n zoya zaa, ka mali n soya ka di viɛla.
en: I will make a road for my people. The mountains will be made flat, and the low roads will be raised.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya biɛrim, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam. Biɛrim maa ni ti ŋmanila paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ni ti lihiri tab ninni ka dabiɛm mali ba. Bɛ nini ni ti mooi.
en: Everyone will be afraid. They will stare at each other with shock on their faces. Fear will grip them like the pains of a woman in childbirth.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yaa Izraɛl Naawuni, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛl a dabili m ba Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛli maa niŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: So now, O God of Israel, let everything come true that you promised to my father David, your servant.

dag: Ka n tɛhi ni a yihi ma la a sani bahi, ka n ku lan nya a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: Then I thought, Now I must go where you cannot see me, but I continued looking to your holy Temple for help.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chaŋ naai ka niriba maa yi kɔbiliga maa ni na n-chaŋ ti yɛli Naa Dauda, bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim yomyom gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du, dama n-nyɛ Ahitɔfɛl ni wuhi yikombiɛlim shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: After the soldiers had gone, Jonathan and Ahimaaz climbed out of the well. They went to David and said, Hurry! Get ready to cross the river! Then they told him about Ahithophel's plan.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela mɔɣu ni yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So John the Baptist showed up in the desert and told everyone, Turn back to God and be baptized! Then your sins will be forgiven.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu, ka lan zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa kam zuɣu m-mali sara din nyɛ o chi min o kawana sara, ka bo kpam lita ata pahi kawaan tahili kam zuɣu.
en: He will also provide the grain offerings, one ephah for each bull, and one ephah for each ram, with one hin of oil for each ephah.

dag: Tɔbu lu di yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn be sunsuuni zaa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei paɣiba. Tɔbu lu bɛ daazichi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di li.
en: Then your chariot horses and the foreigners in your army will refuse to go into battle, and the enemy will carry away everything you treasure.

dag: Yi zaŋ kpamli yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm, ka tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa pam.
en: You have given such wonderful advice to this foolish man! You have provided so much useful information!.

dag: Amaa ka n daa yɛli, Ka mani ŋɔ tatabo zo? Mani ŋɔ tatabo ni zo nti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni n tiligi? N ku niŋ lala.
en: But I replied, Should someone like me run away? Who like me would go into the temple to save his life? I wont go in.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, yin deem o binyɛrigu sɔŋ, deemiy o ni zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli maa, ka di leei saamba talima bini.
en: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a saɣisigu wuhiri ma soli, ka dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, a ni ti deei ma ni jilima.
en: You lead me and give me good advice, and later you will lead me to glory.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba maa yɛl o, A suhu ni yi yuri binshɛŋa la zaa zoya ka chɛ a, ka a buni min a bin suma zaa zo ka chɛ a, ka a ku lan nya li yaha.
en: O Babylon, the good things you wanted have left you. All your rich and fancy things have disappeared. You will never have them again.

dag: ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro na ti tam di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: He set the bread in its proper place on the table in the LORDs presence, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Yi gba lihimiya yimaŋ kaman yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: In the same way you are to think of yourselves as dead, so far as sin is concerned, but living in fellowship with God through Christ Jesus.

dag: N yi tɛhi Naawuni yɛla, n kul ŋuhirimi, ka n yi kul zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋ suhir o, gbariginsim nti kpɛri n ni.
en: I remember God and I moan. I complain, and my spirit grows tired. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa ni yino daa yɛli, A ba pola pɔri yɛli niriba, Ŋunkam di bindirigu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Niriba maa daa kul gbarigimi zaa.
en: Then a soldier told him, Your father swore that anyone who ate food today would be put under a curse, and we agreed not to eat. That's why we're so weak.

dag: Nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa pa shɛli, amaa Naawuni zaligu dolibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: It is not important if anyone is circumcised or not. What is important is obeying Gods commands.

dag: Dama laɣiyubo nyɛla bin biɛɣukam nyaɣili; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa kul ye liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la birigi ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu, ka suhugarigu balibu kam din be kaman piɛma la kuhi bɛ suhuri.
en: The love of money causes all kinds of evil. Some people have turned away from what we believe because they want to get more and more money. But they have caused themselves a lot of pain and sorrow.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti dɔni ti vi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti filiŋ pili timaŋa. Dama ti mini ti yaannim tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ, ka bi saɣi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa noli.
en: We have rebelled against you just like our ancestors, and we are ashamed of our sins.

dag: Ka so yi do m-baɣ o ka ti kpi n-libig o, ka di chɛ ka o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa bi lan be kasi, dindina ŋun pinim o zuɣu maa o ni ti yɛn yi daɣiri ni dahin shɛli. O pinim li daba ayopɔin dali.
en: If someone suddenly dies nearby, defiling the head of the nazirite, he or she will shave the head on the day of cleansing; they will shave it on the seventh day.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ Naa Sihɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba. Dina n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim daa deei Amɔrinim ni daa be tiŋgban shɛl ni maa zaa su.
en: The LORD, Israels God, handed over Sihon and his entire army to the Israelites, and they defeated Sihon. So the Israelites took possession of all the land of the Amorites who were living in that area.

dag: A mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl daŋ kam dunoli dɔɣirikpamba niŋmi bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa din nyɛ ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri maa na laasabu.
en: Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli ni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ni suhuyiɣisili pam. Yawɛ bɔhir o dimnim biɛri, ka yiɣisir o suhu pam bahir o dimnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord God tolerates no rivals; he punishes those who oppose him. In his anger he pays them back.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛli ba o ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa saha shɛli Baruk ni daa karindi gbaŋ maa ka niriba maa wumdi maa.
en: Micaiah told them everything that he had heard Baruch read to the people.

dag: Di saha maa ka Daadam Bia shihirili ni ti be zuɣusaa, ka zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti fabili, ka nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then there will be something in the sky that shows the Son of Man is coming. All the people of the world will cry. Everyone will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds in the sky. He will come with power and great glory.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni maa Bia la zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ anfaani niŋ ti ni, ka ti ti suhudoo, ka chɛ ka di leei ti dini yɛlimaŋli mini yurilim puuni.
en: May God the Father and Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, give us grace, mercy, and peace; may they be ours in truth and love.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa zaŋ o gɔbiga tim o nudirigu gbalipini maa polo darigi ŋoog o sua maa n-zaŋ kuhi naa maa puli;.
en: With his left hand Ehud took the sword from his right side and plunged it into the king's belly.

dag: Di saha maa ka yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be Ziɔn din nyɛ n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni nyɛla tin shɛli din be kasi, ka tinzunnim ku lan tooi tuhi fa li yaha.
en: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.

dag: Ka paɣ so mi yi mali yidan ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda, ka doo maa yu ni o mal o, ŋun miri ka o yi o yiŋa.
en: And if a Christian woman is married to a man who is an unbeliever and he agrees to go on living with her, she must not divorce him.

dag: Ti wahala dibu din pɔri ka ku yuui ŋɔ nyɛla din niŋdi shili ni di tahi ti jilima din ka kpee na, ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa.
en: Jesus answered: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind.

dag: Shɛlini so shɛli ni tooi beni ŋmani din viɛla, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛ kum soli.
en: What you think is the right road may lead to death.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni tiligi ya. M bolila yi yuli, mani n-sun ya.
en: Jacob, the Lord created you. Israel, he made you, and now he says, Dont be afraid. I saved you. I named you. You are mine.

dag: N ni yo ba bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ tuumbiɛri maa samli ʒiibuyi zuɣu, dama bɛ zaŋ buɣa maligu nimdi na ti saɣim n tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka tum din chihira n ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni zaa.
en: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma. Mani m-bala.
en: But Jesus quickly spoke to them. He said, Dont worry! Its me! Dont be afraid.

dag: N daa malila suhudoo, ka o pirigi ma buyi, o daa gbaala n nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ ma ŋme n-chɛrisichɛrisi, ka kul liriti ma.
en: I was at rest, but he shattered me, seized me by the back of my neck, dashed me into pieces; he raised me up for his target.

dag: Bɛ kul dolila bɛ nia biɛri maa soli n-gbaari nia ni bɛ bari zana ashilɔni; ka tɛhira, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya ti?.
en: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, Let's set traps! No one can see us.

dag: Yi mi lan kala Yisa ŋun nyɛ sandaantimdi so ŋun zali alikauli palli min o ʒi shɛli din mihibu wuhiri ti yɛl shɛŋa din sɔ Ɛbɛl maŋmaŋ ʒim la sanna.
en: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ naa ni daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ shɛlikam polo bee zaŋ chaŋ nɛma duri polo la.
en: The Israelites did not change or disobey any of Solomons instructions to the priests and Levites. They did not change any of the instructions, even in the way they should keep the valuable things.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla bɛ biɛhigu puuni zaa, bɛ bela zibisim ni n-dira ni suhuyiɣisili mini sujee, ka dɔriti gbaari ba.
en: They only get days that are filled with sadness and sorrow. In the end, they are troubled, sick, and angry.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Neetan, N tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ka Neetan garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ chɛ a taali maa, a ku lan kpi.
en: David said, I have disobeyed the Lord . Yes, you have! Nathan answered. You showed you didn't care what the Lord wanted. He has forgiven you, and you won't die. But your newborn son will.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe m-pali dunia, ka ŋariŋ maa du m-pa di zuɣu.
en: The waters rose and spread out over the earth. The ark floated on the surface of the waters.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti nyu wain; chɛliya ka ti nyu binnyuri kpɛma. Biɛɣuni sa ni be kaman zuŋɔ, hal di sa ni gari lala gba.
en: They come and say, I will drink some wine. I will drink some beer. I will do the same thing tomorrow, but I will drink even more.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn pa lala, bɛ ŋmanila wurigu shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri bahira.
en: But the wicked are not like that. They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

dag: Dama Ɛhab daŋ niriba zaa ni kpi. N ni ku Ɛhab daŋ ni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Ahabs whole family will die. I will eliminate from Ahab everyone who urinates on a wall, whether slave or free, in Israel.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri n-liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko n-cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.

dag: ka nyin Ayuba yaag a noli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka bi mi di gbinni maa.
en: So Job mouths emptiness; he piles up ignorant words.

dag: M bela bina ayi maa sunsuuni: N suhu kul yɛmi ni n kpi n-chaŋ ti be Masia sani, dama dina n-so shɛlikam;.
en: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.

dag: Ŋunkam ʒiya kpahindi pɔhim ku biri binshɛli, ka ŋunkam mi ʒiya lihiri sagbana ku kpuɣi puu atam.
en: But there are some things that you cannot be sure of. You must take a chance. If you wait for perfect weather, you will never plant your seeds. If you are afraid that every cloud will bring rain, you will never harvest your crops.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yili yilli ŋɔ: Yilimiya yila yɛli di yɛla; Kɔbiliga, chɛ ka kom yi a ni na;.
en: That's also the same well the Israelites sang about in this song: Let's celebrate! The well has given us water.

dag: N ni chaŋ wɔɣira sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la. Amaa hal bɛ gba nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ fukumsi ka bi deeg o noli.
en: Let me go and speak to the powerful people, for they will surely know the LORDs way and the justice of their God. But they too have broken their yoke and shattered the chains.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɛ pulaannim zuɣu, bɛ suhuri yi kul bɔr shɛli, bɛ dir li mi;.
en: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.

dag: ka yɛl o, Yoom wulimpuhili polo takɔro ŋɔ; ka o yoo li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Toma, ka o to li. Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ nasara dibu piɛm m-bɔŋɔ, nasara dibu piɛm din yɛn nyaŋ Sirianima m-bala! Dama a ni tuhi Sirianim Afɛk hal nti ku n-naai ba.
en: and said, Open the window to the east. The king did so. Now shoot! Elisha told him. Joash shot, then Elisha announced, Thats the LORDs rescue arrow! The rescue arrow against the Arameans! You will finish the Arameans off at Aphek.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa kali Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm kalinli n-daa bala.
en: So these men from the Gershon family group were given their special work to do for the Meeting Tent. Moses and Aaron did this the way the Lord had told Moses to do.

dag: Ka Samuɛl nini daa bi lan nya Sool hal ti kpi. Amaa ka o suhu daa lee saɣim pam Sool zuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli o ni daa pii Sool n-leei Izraɛlnim naa maa zuɣu.
en: Even though Samuel felt sad about Saul, Samuel never saw him again. The Lord was sorry he had made Saul the king of Israel.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn shihi ba, ŋun zaŋmila kur bini mini kpan dɔɣu n-niŋ lala, ka buɣim di ba zaa nimaani.
en: You must use an iron tool or a spear; they will be burned completely.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa galisi pam Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi pam kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi dari la.
en: During his reign silver was as common in Jerusalem as stone, and cedar was as plentiful as ordinary sycamore in the foothills of Judah.

dag: N ni labi laŋ pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn ti kar o saria nimaani, o ni taai duŋ niŋ ma la zuɣu.
en: I will spread out a hunter's net and catch him in it. I will take him to Babylonia and punish him there, because he was unfaithful to me.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ti lan laɣim ka Yisa sanna, ka daa ti lan ka bindirigu din ni di, ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba.
en: Not long afterward another large crowd came together. When the people had nothing left to eat, Jesus called the disciples to him and said.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi ba ni bɛ zabbanim yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee Kpaŋa kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.

dag: Ŋunkam kpuɣi paɣa nya binsuŋ, ka nya nirilim niŋbu Yawɛ sani.
en: If you find a wife, you have found something good. She shows that the Lord is happy with you.

dag: amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun yuri zaɣ suŋ ni ŋun su omaŋa ni ŋun bebu tuhi ni ŋun bebu be kasi ni ŋun gbib omaŋa.
en: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.

dag: Yinim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be nyɔŋ puuni, kamiyana ti gbahi di.
en: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.

dag: Amaa di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛ ni daa na bi yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb o yɛla nini ni nya o; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-wum o yɛla ni baŋ o.
en: As the scripture says, Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni la pirigibu bɛn pahi buyi daa zaŋ kpa gooni maa zuɣu nuzaa polo, ka m mi zaŋ bɛ pirigili n-doli bɛ nyaaŋa gooni maa zuɣu Kpimkpimbihi Pia zuɣusaa polo m-mali hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: The second group of singers started out in the other direction, to the left. I followed them as they went up to the top of the wall. Half of the people also followed them. They went past the Tower of Ovens to the Broad Wall.

dag: Dinzuɣu, m bia, wummi n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ, yiɣisim zo n-kuli n tizɔdoo Leeban sani Haran.
en: So, son, do what I say. My brother Laban is living in Haran. Go to him and hide.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔhi salima ka di gari tɔn kɔbiga ni pisopɔin, ka tɔhi anzinfa tɔn kɔbisita ni pihinahi, ka tɔhi daanya kaman tɔn kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisi ka tɔhi kuriti gari tɔn tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li tum Naawuni duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: the following for the work on the Temple: tons of gold, tons of silver, tons of bronze, and , tons of iron.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Leeban zuɣu ka o bɔhi Leeban, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a? Ka alahichi dini ka n lee tum ka a kariti n naba na?.
en: Jacob was angry and complained to Laban, What have I done wrong and whats my crime that youve tracked me down like this?.

dag: Bɛn gbilisi tibili wum yɛlli ni tɔŋ. Ka bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Those with insight find prosperity; those who trust the LORD are blessed.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni niŋdi anfaan shɛli niŋdi ti ni galisiya pam; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni Kundi yɛli, Naawuni zaɣisiri karimbaannima, amaa ka lee niŋdi anfaani niŋdi bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ ni.
en: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.

dag: Bɛnkam niŋ bɛ buni naani ni lu, amaa wuntizɔriba ni zoori kaman vamaha la.
en: Those who depend on their wealth will fall like the leaves of autumn, but the righteous will prosper like the leaves of summer.

dag: A buhi bihim ni saɣ a min a yiŋnim bindirigu, ka dih a daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba.
en: Then there will be plenty of goats milk for you and your family, with enough to keep the servants healthy.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli, Kalidianim laɣimla tab ʒiibuta zuɣu n-kana ti lu laakumnim la zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn guli ba maa, ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: Before that servant finished speaking, a third one raced up and said, Three gangs of Chaldeans attacked and stole your camels! All of your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: ka chɛ ka dɔro gbaag a nyɔri, ka dɔro maa ni nyɛla din kul yɛn pahiri dabisili kam hal ka a nyɔri ti yirina.
en: You yourself will suffer a painful intestinal disease that will grow worse day by day.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla nyin daadam, a niriba bɛn ʒe goma gbini mini bɛn ʒe dunoya ni yɛri taba, ka sokam yɛri o ʒiʒiinikpee, Kamiyana ti wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi Yawɛ sanna ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, the people with you in Babylonia talk about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say, Let's ask Ezekiel what the Lord has said today.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ŋmaai Izraɛl zuɣu ni o nyoli kaman kpikpal tia wulli bee gbiŋgbaŋ la bahi dahin yini.
en: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.

dag: A zaŋla ti tuumbiɛri zal a tooni, ka ti ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa ashilɔni yi n-do palɔni a ninni.
en: You know about all our sins. You see every one of our secret sins.

dag: Ka nira yi vuɣi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee, di nyaaŋa bɛ biɛhigu shee maa ni zaɣisi ba ka yɛli, Man na ʒi n-nyan ya.
en: But then pull them up— no one will ever know they were there.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ paɣ maa yina, ka o tim ti yɛl o yidan ba Juda, Do so ŋun su nɛma ŋɔ n-ti ma pua maa. N suhir a, lihim li nya ŋuni n-lee su li. Nɛma maa n-nyɛ: nintua din mali dalinli ŋɔ mini zoligo ŋɔ ni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ.
en: As Tamar was being dragged off, she sent someone to tell her father-in-law, The man who gave me this ring, this cord, and this walking stick is the one who got me pregnant.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi salo maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi n-kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa? M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma.
en: Then Jesus said to the crowd, Why do you come to get me with swords and clubs as if I were a criminal. Every day I sat in the Temple area teaching. You did not arrest me there.

dag: Di simdi ni Izraɛl tiŋbia kam ŋun yɛn mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: This is the way every citizen of Israel must give gifts to please the Lord .

dag: n-zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri maa bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: and will throw them into the fiery furnace, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Abija daa di nam n-zan o zaani.
en: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. Then Rehoboams son Abijah became the next king after him.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Pɛnuɛluɛlnim maa, N yi ti labina ni alaafee, n ni daai yi pii ŋɔ luhi.
en: So he also told the people of Penuel, When I return in victory, Ill break down this tower.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima, ka a tahima maa ni niŋ pali.
en: If it is, you have a bright future.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko yɛla ka bi bɔri ni bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, amaa ka dolila tuumbiɛtali soli la, Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o suli min o suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Other people are selfish and reject what is right, in order to follow what is wrong; on them God will pour out his anger and fury.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka sagbana zibigi ka sagani booi sagbana maa ni.
en: When I bring clouds over the earth and the bow appears in the clouds.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa bahi nimaani, ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa kahi di zaa chaŋ.
en: David and his troops also carried away the idols that the Philistines had left behind.

dag: Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Lahibal suŋ la zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim laɣim nya Naawuni daalibarika; bɛ daa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣa, ka laɣim diri Naawuni ni daa lo alikauli shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la nyɔri.
en: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.

dag: di saha yin miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.

dag: Ka Alikizanda mini Rufus ba ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini nira, ka o yuli booni Saimɔn la daa yi tinshee garita; ka bɛ daa bol o na nti muɣis o ni o ʒim Yisa dapulli maa.
en: On the way they met a man named Simon, who was coming into the city from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry Jesus' cross.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma dabisili la dali ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni chani shɛm la; di saha maa zuɣusaa ni ti vuui ni vuɣɔbu pam, ka buɣim ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa nyɛligi; ka buɣim ti di dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binyara din be di zuɣu.
en: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N yi bi ŋma Shafat bia Ilaisha la zuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma din gari lala.
en: He said, I pray that God will punish me terribly, if Elisha's head is still on his shoulders by this time tomorrow.

dag: Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali, ka Vuhim Dabisili maa yɛn kpe.
en: It was late on Preparation day. When the sun went down, the Sabbath day would begin.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N dabili, m mali tuun kara ni n ti a, ka a labisi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zali bɛ zaashee. N ni zaŋ a leei neesim ti tinzunnima, ka di chɛ ka n tiliginsim paai dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nima.
en: He said: It is not enough, since you are my servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back the survivors of Israel. Hence, I will also appoint you as light to the nations so that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth.

dag: A malila ninsal nina? A nyarila binyɛra kaman ninsalinim ni nyari shɛm?.
en: Do you have human eyes? Do you see things the way people do?.

dag: O ni ti deei yi bindira mini yi wain tihi wala pirigibu bupia kam puuni vaabu yim ti o kpambaliba min o tumtumdiba.
en: He will also take a tenth of your grain and grapes and give it to his officers and officials.

dag: ka Naawuni nira Ilaisha sɔŋda Gɛhaazi yɛl o suhu ni, N dana fa Naaman ŋun nyɛ Siria nir ŋɔ bahi, o ni zaɣis o ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na nti ti o la zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kar o naba ti deei shɛli o sani.
en: Gehazi said to himself, Elisha let that Syrian off too easy. He should have taken Naaman's gift. I swear by the living Lord that I will talk to Naaman myself and get something from him.

dag: Amaa m pun suhi Naawuni a zuɣu ni a yɛda di filim; ka a yi ti lan lab zani dɛde, nyin kpaŋsim a mabihi suhuri.
en: But Simon, I have prayed that your faith will be strong. And when you have come back to me, help the others.

dag: Riu ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Sɛrug.
en: After Reu was years old, his son Serug was born.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni niŋdi anfaan shɛli niŋdi ti ni galisiya pam; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni Kundi yɛli, Naawuni zaɣisiri karimbaannima, amaa ka lee niŋdi anfaani niŋdi bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ ni.
en: But the grace that God gives is even stronger. As the scripture says, God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim daa chaŋ ti chɛ ka Sulemaana ba Naa Dauda buntaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: So Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and the kings officers obeyed King David. They put Solomon on Davids mule and went with him down to Gihon Spring.

dag: O wuhiya ni n chɛ ka bɛn fabindi Ziɔn ka mali nandahima la mali suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn mali suhugarigu la yili wumpaɣibo yila. Bɛ ni ŋmanila Yawɛ ni sa oki ti shɛŋa. Bɛ zaa ni tum din tuhi, ka Yawɛ nya paɣibu bɛ ni tum shɛm zuɣu.
en: to provide for Zions mourners, to give them a crown in place of ashes, oil of joy in place of mourning, a mantle of praise in place of discouragement. They will be called Oaks of Righteousness, planted by the LORD to glorify himself.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka vuhim kpe yi ni ka yi niŋ nyɛviyanima.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says to you: I will cause breath to come into you, and you will come to life!.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ma sa zuɣusaa, n ni vooi sokam zaa tahi n sanna.
en: I will be lifted up from the earth. When that happens, I will draw all people to myself.

dag: Hal nanim ni laɣindi ʒiini lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo la zaa yoli, mani a dabili ŋɔ kul ni bɔhind a zaligunima.
en: The rulers meet and plot against me, but I will study your teachings.

dag: O daŋdila yiɣisibu di ni na bi neei saha shɛli n-niŋdi bindirigu tir o yiŋnima, ka tir o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi tuma.
en: She wakes up early in the morning, cooks food for her family, and gives the servants their share.

dag: A daa kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ ba ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A daa darigi lala zuliyanim maa tibili, amaa ka chɛ bɛna.
en: how you yourself drove out the heathen and established your people in their land; how you punished the other nations and caused your own to prosper.

dag: ka Kallai daa nyɛ Sallai daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Ɛba daa nyɛ Amok daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber.

dag: M mabihi, miriya ka yi ni so mali suhu biɛɣu din biɛhinda, ka nyɛ din ni birigi ya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ sani.
en: My friends, be careful that none of you have a heart so evil and unbelieving that you will turn away from the living God.

dag: Yi daa yɛliya, Tim ti naa mini kpambaliba. Yi naa maa lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ n-ni tooi tiligi ya? Yi kpambaliba maa lee be ya n-ni tooi zabi yi zuɣu?.
en: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔr shɛŋa lu zuliya shɛb zuɣu la lu bɛ gba zuɣu.
en: And if the family of Egypt doesnt go up and doesnt present itself, then no rain will fall on them. There will be a plague like the one with which the LORD struck the nations that didnt go up to celebrate the Festival of Booths.

dag: Ti mini ti nanim ni ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim tum vi tuma, ka tum alahichi nyin Yawɛ sani.
en: Our kings, our rulers, and our ancestors have acted shamefully and sinned against you, Lord.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li n-girimgirim li.
en: Other seed fell among thorny plants. The thorny plants grew and choked them.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ tiŋgbani maa nim zaa nyaɣisim, ka tiŋ maa daa maai, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Atalia maa nyaaŋa.
en: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was at peace now that Athaliah had been executed at the palace.

dag: Ka Musa daa pii asanza niriba Izraɛlnim maa puuni n-zaŋ ba leei niriba maa zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ shɛb su niriba tuhilituhili, ka shɛb su niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, ka shɛb su niriba pihinunu ka shɛb mi su niriba piapia fukumsi.
en: He chose some competent leaders from every tribe in Israel and put them over groups of , , , and .

dag: n-zaŋ li na ti zali Sool min o tumtumdiba maa tooni ka bɛ di, ka daa yiɣisi kuli yuŋ maa.
en: Then she served the food to Saul and his officers, who ate and left before daylight.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mi a sujee yiko ni nyɛ shɛm? A suhuyiɣisili galisimi kaman bɛ ni lur a sizuura shɛli ni galisi shɛm.
en: Who can comprehend the power of your anger? The honor that is due you corresponds to your wrath.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bia maa kuhigu maa; ka Naawuni malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Haga m-bɔh o, Haga, bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama Naawuni wum bia maa kuhigu o ni be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: God heard the boys cries, and Gods messenger called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, Hagar! Whats wrong? Dont be afraid. God has heard the boys cries over there.

dag: O ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni maa, ka o daa naanyi bo sɔŋsim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka siɣis omaŋ pam o yaannim Naawuni sani.
en: When these troubles came to him, Manasseh begged for help from the Lord his God. He humbled himself before the God of his ancestors.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni duri duli, ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi tiŋ maa puuni tuhir o sol na; o daa chɛ situra yɛbu ka di yuui, o mi daa bi gbɛri yiŋa; gbal kaba ni ka o daa kul gbɛra.
en: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, a certain man met him. The man was from the city and was possessed by demons. For a long time, he had lived among the tombs, naked and homeless.

dag: Ka gbib yɛlimaŋ shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun be ti ni ni zaŋ niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: Protect this good thing that has been placed in your trust through the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

dag: nti zaŋ a kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o; ka zaŋ a yiko niŋ o nuu ni, ka o leei Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ba.
en: I will give him your robe and wrap him in your sash, and I will hand over to him your authority. He will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛlli ŋɔ puuni? Ŋun chaŋ tɔb maa tuhibu shee tarili ni nyɛ shɛm, ŋun ʒiya guli nɛma gba tarili yɛn nyɛla lala. Bɛ zaa tarili yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: No one can agree with what you say! All must share alike: whoever stays behind with the supplies gets the same share as the one who goes into battle.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa lee be ya? Wuhim ti a yura maa ni kpa shɛli polo ka ti bo o sɔŋ a.
en: Most beautiful of women, where has your lover gone? Tell us which way your lover went, so that we can help you find him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi bia maa ba, Bɔ saha ka di piligi niŋd o lala? Ka o yɛl o, O bilim ni.
en: How long has he been like this? Jesus asked the father. Ever since he was a child, he replied.

dag: Zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ puuni, yinim ka m pii, dinzuɣu n ni darigi yi tibili yi tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu.
en: There are many families on earth, but you are the only family I chose to know in a special way. And you turned against me, so I will punish you for all your sins.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini kom na ti tuhi ya soli saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la zuɣu mini bɛ ni daa lan da Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr ŋun yi Pɛtɔr din be Mɛsopoteemia na bia la ni o ti yɛli noli tin ya la zuɣu.
en: The Ammonites and Moabites refused to give you bread and water on your trip at the time you came from Egypt. They also tried to hire Balaam, the son of Beor from the Mesopotamian city of Pethor, to curse you.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli ba nti gbaai Zɛdɛkia Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza Ribila din daa be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka o daa kar o saria nimaani.
en: But the Babylonian army chased them down and caught Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They arrested him and brought him before Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar at Riblah in the land of Hamath. There the king put him on trial.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ shɛlikam, nyin di niŋ li o nyaaŋa, ka o chɛ ka a soya tuhi.
en: Remember the Lord in everything you do, and he will show you the right way.

dag: Ka Iso daa nya paɣiba mini bihi maa ka bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Naawuni ni niŋ mani a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ti ma bi shɛba m-bala.
en: When Esau noticed the women and children he asked, Whose children are these? Jacob answered, These are the children the Lord has been kind enough to give to me, your servant.

dag: Dama tiŋgbani ni chɛri ka bimbira puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na shɛm ni kaman puu ni chɛri ka bɛ ni zaŋ bimbiri shɛŋa biri di ni zoori shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka wuntia tuma yi zahira, ka zuliya kam zaa tibig o.
en: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lura, ka sokam zaŋ bɛ bar shɛb dɔro balibu kam ni mali tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zaŋmiya yi yɛtɔɣa na, ka zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi yɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo na.
en: The Lord , the king of Jacob, says, Come, present your arguments. Show me your proof.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi nyala daŋa, dindina yin doliya zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: But if the woman herself is injured, the punishment shall be life for life.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naftali zuliya paya. Naftali niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛnan bia Ahira.
en: The tribe of Naphtali will also camp next to the tribe of Dan. The leader of the tribe of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa lan tum tuun biɛ shɛli pahi; dina n-nyɛ o ni daa gbaai Jɔn kpɛhi duu la.
en: Then Herod did an even worse thing by putting John in prison.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba nyari bɛ bindirigu la Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni? Ka yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tuma gba nyari bɛ bindirigu la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira?.
en: Dont you know that those who serve in the temple get to eat food from the temple, and those who serve at the altar share part of what is sacrificed on the altar?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum Musa kuli Mɔabnim bɔpiɛligu maa ni hal ni biɛɣu pihita, di nyaaŋa ka Musa kuli maa kumbu daa naai.
en: Back down in the Moabite plains, the Israelites mourned Moses death for thirty days. At that point, the time for weeping and for mourning Moses was over.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n niŋ li. N ku chɛ ka bɛ galim n yuli maa. N ku zaŋ n jilima ti so.
en: For the sake of my reputation, for my own sake, I will act, for why will my name be made impure? I wont give my glory to another.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Sokam tiligim o nyɛvili. Di kpinya di taali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ni bɔhiri biɛri saha shɛli m-bɔŋɔ; o yɔr li la di tuma samli.
en: Run away from Babylon. Run to save your lives! Dont stay and be killed because of Babylons sins! It is time for the Lord to punish the Babylonians for the bad things they have done. Babylon will get the punishment that she should have.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔra kpahi n zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka ŋun ʒe yim saɣisi ma. Di chɛ ka m bo jilima ninvuɣ biɛɣu sani, dama n kul galindila bɛ tuumbiɛri maa n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: Instead, let the righteous discipline me; let the faithful correct me! Let my head never reject that kind of fine oil, because my prayers are always against the deeds of the wicked.

dag: N ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka yaŋɔ paɣisara ti kana ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom.
en: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka so ni ti yi Jɛsi zuliya ni na n-lee shihirili zuliya kam sani, ka o biɛhigu shee ni ti viɛla, ka niriba ti bɔhiri bɔr o shee.
en: On that day, the root of Jesse will stand as a signal to the peoples. The nations will seek him out, and his dwelling will be glorious.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni; amaa ka yɛl o, Ti mabia, a nya Yɛhudianim tusatusa ni niŋdi yɛda ka na kul kumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu shɛm bebɔ?.
en: After hearing him, they all praised God. Then they said, Brother Paul, you can see how many thousands of Jews have become believers, and how devoted they all are to the Law.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ tiŋkpansi mini di paliti polo, Judanim shɛb daa bela Kiriatariba tiŋkpansi mini Dibɔn ni di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛkabiziil ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: The people of Judah lived in these towns: In Kiriath Arba and the small towns around it, in Dibon and the small towns around it, in Jekabzeel and the small towns around it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu min o bidibisi maa.
en: Again, God said to Noah and his sons:.

dag: ni bɛ daazichi zaa ni bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ni binshɛɣukam din daa be bɛ yinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: They took everything of value, captured all the women and children, and carried off everything in the houses.

dag: ka Salimɔn dɔɣi Bɔaz, ka Bɔaz dɔɣi Obɛd.
en: Salmon the father of Boaz, Boaz the father of Obed.

dag: din nyɛ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ya dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zali zaligunim maa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni polo la.
en: The Lord gave you those commands through Moses, and they have been in effect from the day they were given throughout the generations until today.

dag: Bɛ chani gindila zoya zuɣu bɔri mɔri, ka chani bɔri momaha kam.
en: They live in the mountains. That is their pasture. That is where they look for food to eat.

dag: N suhu zaa kul bela Izraɛl sapashinnim bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu la ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: I praise you, Lord , and I am grateful for those leaders and soldiers who volunteered.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha bee Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Pray that it will not be winter or a Sabbath day when these things happen and you have to run away.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kuɣ pinaayi, ka a ti zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu. Niŋmi li kaman bɛ ni niŋdi dalinli shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la din ni chɛ ka zuliya pinaayi maa yuya be di ni.
en: Each of these twelve stones is to have engraved on it the name of one of the sons of Jacob, to represent the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim maa daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lab kuli bɛ ya Rama. Ka Ɛlikana min o paɣ Hanna daa ti dɔni, ka Yawɛ teei Hanna yɛla.
en: Early the next morning Elkanahs family got up. They worshiped the Lord and then went back home to Ramah. Elkanah had sexual relations with his wife Hannah, and the Lord remembered Hannah.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku deei pin shɛli a sani. Ka Naaman daa balim o ni o deem li, amaa ka o zaɣisi.
en: Elisha answered, By the living Lord , whom I serve, I swear that I will not accept a gift. Naaman insisted that he accept it, but he would not.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai bua n-kɔrigi zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu tim bua maa ʒim ni.
en: Then they killed a goat and dipped Joseph's robe in its blood.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana n-daa ti me jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni.
en: But it was Solomon who built him a house.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni yi gba mali suhupiɛlli, ka di chɛ ka n gba pahi yi zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda ni o ninvuɣ gahinda ni yino la daa yɛli, N dan Musa, karim ba.
en: Joshua, Nuns son and Moses assistant since his youth, responded, My master Moses, stop them.

dag: Firawuna ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Naawuni daa bi zaŋ ba doli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ polo, nimaani polo ni daa nyɛ so jia maa zaa yoli, dama Naawuni daa yɛlimi, Tɔbu yi ŋme niriba maa, bɛ tɛha ni taɣi ka bɛ zo n-labi Ijipti.
en: When Pharaoh let the people go, God didnt lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, even though that was the shorter route. God thought, If the people have to fight and face war, they will run back to Egypt.

dag: A ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be a biɛhigu shee mal alibarika! Ti nini ni tiɣi a jɛmbu du kasi maa puuni bin suma.
en: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni mani n-zali ya zaligu ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛl la zani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.

dag: Kaman n ni kul lihiri ba ka bɔri ni n darigi tɔhi ba, ka wurim ba bahi, ka daai ba luhi, ka ku ba, ka chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba la, lala ka n ni ti guli ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ beni, ka n ti ba yaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Just as I watched over them to dig up and pull down, to overthrow, destroy, and bring harm, so I will watch over them to build and plant, declares the LORD.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ti zaŋ kuɣ parilana maa niŋ n ni daa mali adaka shɛli maa puuni, ka di be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ma shɛm maa.
en: So I came back down the mountain. I put the tablets in the chest that Id made, and thats where they are now, exactly as the LORD commanded me. .

dag: A ni suh o, ka o deeg a suhigu, ka a niŋ a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni niŋ binshɛŋa la.
en: When you pray, he will answer you, and you will keep the vows you made.

dag: Zaŋmiya ʒilinsi biɛhigu bahi ka be, ka doliya tɛhi zilima soli.
en: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.

dag: Ka Maata saɣi, Iin n Duuma, n niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-nyɛ Masia, Naawuni Bi so bɛ ni daa yɛli ni o ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la.
en: Martha answered, Yes, Lord. I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God. You are the one who was coming to the world.

dag: Ka o tizo daa gbib o napɔŋkpaa n-dol o yina; ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Yaakubu. Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihiyɔbu nira saha shɛli Ribɛka ni daa dɔɣi jahi maa.
en: The second baby grabbed on to his brother's heel, so they named him Jacob. Isaac was years old when they were born.

dag: min o ni daa lan ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali n-chɛ ka bɛ ʒim zo n-tiɛli Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ taali.
en: and caused many innocent people to die. The Lord would not forgive this.

dag: Ka Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: So Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, did as the Lord had commanded Moses, and they married their cousins.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yihi waazu, ka pa ni bɛ tim ba mi? Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛn mali lahibal suŋ waazu na ni bɛ ti yihi ŋɔ paabuna tiri suhupiɛlli.
en: And before anyone can go and tell them, they must be sent. As the Scriptures say, How wonderful it is to see someone coming to tell good news.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa kana ti dii ŋme Naa Hɛrɔd o ni daa bi tiri Naawuni jilima la zuɣu, ka zunzuya wɔɣ o ni ŋ-ŋub o ka o kpi.
en: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi biɛɣ asiba, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anab Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la n-yɛl o.
en: When David got up the next morning, the LORDs word came to the prophet Gad, Davids seer.

dag: Bɛ di ti zaŋ li kɔhi bee n-zaŋ li taɣi so dini. Bɛ di ti zaŋ tiŋgbani kasi maa taɣi ti so. Dama di nyɛla tiŋgban kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: and they must never sell or trade any of this land—it is the best land and belongs to me.

dag: ka zaŋ bubihi pola maa gbandi pɔb o nuchɛhi min o nyiŋgoli;.
en: She took the skins of the goats and put them on Jacobs hands and on his neck.

dag: Tim ka Giliad? Dɔɣite ka nimaani? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ bi nya alaafee?.
en: Surely there is some medicine in Gilead. Surely there is a doctor in Gilead. So why are the wounds of my people not healed?.

dag: Nyin ŋun gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-daa yaag a noli yɛl li, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni!.
en: Praise the LORD! Let my whole being praise the LORD!.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli beni ka di kom nyɛla din tiri Naawuni tiŋ la suhupiɛlli, luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ Zallakudura Naa biɛhigu shee la.
en: There is a river whose streams bring happiness to Gods city, to the holy city of God Most High.

dag: M pun nyaŋ Kalino mini Karikɛmish, ka nyaŋ Hamat mini Aripad, ka nyaŋ Samaria mini Damaskus.
en: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.

dag: ka bɛ laɣimbu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbia ni o ti yɛl o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaa ni bɛ kana ni binshɛɣukam shili biya.
en: When it was time for the feast, he sent his servant to tell his guests, Come, everything is ready.

dag: Ŋuna n-su dunia tiŋgbani puuni ziliŋ; ka su zo kara la gba.
en: He rules over the whole earth, from the deepest caves to the highest hills.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka di nyɛla Liya. Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi Leeban, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Reechɛl zuɣu ka n tum tuma ti a, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma.
en: Not until the next morning did Jacob discover that it was Leah. He went to Laban and said, Why did you do this to me? I worked to get Rachel. Why have you tricked me.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɔri maligunim buɣim, ka tumdi alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka bi deer o noli bee n-dol o zaligunim zaa la zuɣu ka yɛlibiɛɣu ŋɔ paai ya kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: The reason all those bad things happened to you is that you made sacrifices to other gods. You sinned against the Lord . You didnt obey him or follow his teachings or the laws he gave you. You didnt keep your part of the agreement. .

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka n yi m ba yiŋa n-chani gindi ŋɔ puuni, ka n yɛl o, A ni yɛn niŋ ma nirilim shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti paai luɣ shɛlikam, nyin yɛlimi ni n nyɛla a tizɔdoo. .
en: So when God sent me from my father's house into foreign lands, I said to her, You can show how loyal you are to me by telling everyone that I am your brother.

dag: Ka Husham daa ti kpi, ka Bɛdad ŋun daa nyaŋ Midiannim Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni la bidibiga Hadad daa di nam zan o zaani. O ya yuli n-daa booni Avit.
en: After Husham died, Hadad, Bedads son who defeated Midian in the countryside of Moab, became king; his citys name was Avith.

dag: Yawɛ ni wuhi ti o jilima, ka chɛ ka ti ʒini baɣili mɔɣ kara mini kulibɔna, amaa ka ti dimnim ŋarima ku gari nimaani.
en: The Lord will show us his glory. We will live beside broad rivers and streams, but hostile ships will not sail on them.

dag: ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Rɛfaimnim.
en: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim.

dag: Amaa ka Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia maa bidib so ŋun yuli booni Abiata la ŋun daa zo n-tiligi chaŋ Dauda sani.
en: But one of the sons of Ahimelech, Ahitubs son, escaped. His name was Abiathar, and he fled to David.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kari ya bɛ jɛmbu duri ni. Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka ŋunkam ti kun ya ni tɛhi ni o tumla Naawuni yubu.
en: They will expel you from the synagogue. The time is coming when those who kill you will think that they are doing a service to God.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligu ti ba, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka n ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: The new covenant that I will make with the people of Israel will be this: I will put my law within them and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ata.
en: There was evening and there was morning: the third day.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Hɛrɔdias lo Jɔn zaɣ biɛɣu m-bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka daa bi tooi.
en: So Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him, but she could not because of Herod.

dag: Abija tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o yɛtɔɣa ni o tuma zaa, bɛ sabi li niŋ anab Iddo yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The rest of the history of Abijah, what he said and what he did, is written in The History of Iddo the Prophet .

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilabil yino maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: Their grain offering will be fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the ram.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa ti niŋ ŋun kani Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Tɛra daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: Terah lived years, and he died in Haran.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa siɣina Sinai Zoli maa kpaakpaanyom ni nti boli Musa du zoli maa kpaakpaanyom maa ni, ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord came down to the top of Mount Sinai and told Moses to meet him there.

dag: O ni daa mali ti miriti Damaskus, o nini nyabu yim ka neesim shɛli yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gil o;.
en: As Saul was coming near the city of Damascus, suddenly a light from the sky flashed around him.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni zaligubaŋda ti bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu ni o zahim o.
en: One of them was an expert in the Jewish Law. So he tried to test Jesus by asking.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Ti ku tooi zaŋ ti tizɔpaɣ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun bi guni, dama lala nyɛla vi ti sani.
en: They said to them, We cant do this, allowing our sisters to marry uncircumcised men, because its disgraceful to us.

dag: Ka di simdi ni o be o sani yuuni kam kaman padir la. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o yi ninni.
en: But that person will live like a hired worker with the foreigner every year. Dont let the foreigner be a cruel master over that person.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu. A yurilim maŋli min a nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, kpihimmi n daalahichi!.
en: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa luri Naawuni sizuura ŋɔ, kamiyana ka n ti yɛli ya o ni tum shɛli ti ma ka yi wum.
en: All you people who worship God, come and I will tell you what he has done for me.

dag: ka bɔhi Musa, Gbala n-daa lee ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti na ni ti ti kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti yi Ijipti na?.
en: They said to Moses, Why did you bring us out of Egypt? Did you bring us out here in the desert to die? We could have died peacefully in Egypt; there were plenty of graves in Egypt.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi bi yuri ka tum birigi n ni zali ya ni yi di tum shɛl la n-tum alahichi.
en: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do.

dag: Chɛ ka teeku mini di puuni binshɛɣukam zaa ŋum; ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Let the sea and everything in it shout for joy! Let the fields and everything in them be happy!.

dag: O me o tiŋa n-tam zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain.

dag: Ka o daa lan saɣim Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni la ni di chɛ ka so ku lan zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga m-mali buɣili Molɛk.
en: Topheth was a place in the Valley of Hinnoms Son where people killed their children and burned them on an altar to honor the false god Molech. Josiah ruined that place so that no one could use it again.

dag: ka Sɔdi bia Gaddiɛl daa yi Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel, Sodis son.

dag: Amaa Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛn tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba shɛm.
en: But Moses gave no legacy to the tribe of Levi. The LORD God of Israel is their legacy, exactly as he promised them.

dag: Nail Mɔɣili kom ni filim, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui zaa.
en: The water in the Nile River will dry up and disappear.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya lala maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni ŋun niŋ ninsalinim yiko ŋɔ tatabo maa.
en: When the crowds saw what had happened, they were afraid and praised God, who had given such authority to human beings.

dag: dama mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri o tuumba maa zaa ni, hal ka m bi simdi ni bɛ boli ma o tumo gba, n ni daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka la zuɣu.
en: Im the least important of the apostles. I dont deserve to be called an apostle, because I harassed Gods church.

dag: Dama nir tibiginsim bi yirila wulimpuhili polo na bee wulinluhili polo na; ka di mi bi yirila mɔɣu ni na.
en: Judgment does not come from the east or from the west, from the north or from the south;.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus min o kpamba ni daa niŋ tab saawara naai ka o yɛli Pool, A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani. Dindina Naa Siiza sani ka a shiri ni bahi chaŋ.
en: Then Festus, after conferring with his advisers, answered, You have appealed to the Emperor, so to the Emperor you will go.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Jɔn daa bɔhi salo bɛn ka o sanna ni o ti baptaizi ba maa, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: Crowds of people came to be baptized by John. But he said to them, You are all snakes! Who warned you to run from Gods judgment that is coming?.

dag: Ka din pahi pisinaanahi mi daa gbaai Romamtiɛza min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ gba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: and the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his family, and his relatives, .

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Bia maa kum la zuɣu chɛ ka yi leela Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛba n-naag omaŋa ni di chɛ ka yi be kasi ka ka daɣiri ka mi ku mali galimi, ka o zaŋ ya labis omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: But now he has reconciled you by his physical body through death, to present you before God as a people who are holy, faultless, and without blame.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. Chɛ ka a suhu doya, a ku kpi.
en: Calm down! the Lord told Gideon. There's nothing to be afraid of. You're not going to die.

dag: Ka yi ni shɛb mi doli Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba wuhibu din nyɛ n ni je shɛl la.
en: In the same way, you have some who follow the Nicolaitans teaching.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi daalahichi tumbu mini yi ni pa bɛn doli gunibu kali sol la zuɣu. Amaa ka Naawuni neei yi mini Masia kum ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka chɛ ti daalahichi zaa paŋ ti.
en: When you were dead because of the things you had done wrong and because your body wasnt circumcised, God made you alive with Christ and forgave all the things you had done wrong.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ zaŋ o shia ti ma. O tim ma mi ni n zaŋ lahiba suŋ ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka maai bɛn suhuri saɣim la suhuri; ka yihi bɛn nyɛ daba la dabitim ni; ka yooi bɛn be sarika ni la bahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me. The Lord has chosen me to tell good news to the poor and to comfort those who are sad. He sent me to tell the captives and prisoners that they have been set free.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yi o biɛhigu shee alizanda ni kana ti darigi dunianim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ashilɔni zaa yɛla ni ti yi palo, ka tiŋgbani ti ku lan sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: The Lord is coming from his heavenly dwelling place to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The murders that were secretly committed on the earth will be revealed, and the ground will no longer hide those who have been killed.

dag: Di saha ka Musa min o sɔŋda Jɔshua daa lu soli, ka Musa daa du Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.

dag: M Ba ni su binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla n dini; dina n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni o ni ti zaŋ n yɛla wuhi ya maa.
en: All that my Father has is mine; that is why I said that the Spirit will take what I give him and tell it to you.

dag: Saha shɛli naa ni daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka Lɛvi zuliya do so daa zaŋ o mam ŋun yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee din be katiŋa.
en: At that time the Israelites did not have a king. There was a Levite who lived far back in the hill country of Ephraim. He had taken as a wife a slave woman. She was from the city of Bethlehem in the country of Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa yuya niŋ Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni. Ka bɛ daa gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn bɛ ni daa bi ʒe yim la zuɣu.
en: All the people of Israel were listed according to their families, and this information was recorded in The Book of the Kings of Israel . The people of Judah had been deported to Babylon as punishment for their sins.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ dunɔdali din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: The man led me to the east gate.

dag: Yihim ma sarika ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka m paɣ a yuli. Wuntizɔriba ni laɣim gili ma, dama a ni niŋ ma nirilim pam.
en: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Galimi dini ka yi yaannim daa lee nya n sani, ka zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi binyoya ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ gba maŋmaŋ daa leei ninvuɣ yoya la?.
en: and I, the Lord , will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.

dag: Amaa lee bomiyala Naawuni nam dubu, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well.

dag: yin di chɛ ka o gbe tia maa zuɣu, amaa yin sɔɣimiy o dindali maa, dama bɛ ni yili ninvuɣ so mia nyɛla Naawuni noli ni di so, di bi simdi ni yi ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa daɣiri.
en: You must not let that body stay on the tree overnight. You must be sure to bury this man on the same day, because the one who hangs on a tree is cursed by God, and you must not let the land that the Lord your God is giving you become unclean.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: So I am not really the one who does this thing; rather it is the sin that lives in me.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ pina tari nandaamba ni bɛ suhuri zaa, bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam. Bɛ ni duhi ba ti ba jilima.
en: They give freely to those in need. Their righteousness stands forever. Their strength increases gloriously.

dag: Bee di yi nyɛla buɣim nyooi so ka buɣim yum maa ti liɣisi zaɣ piɛlli din mooi bee zaɣ piɛlli.
en: In case any of you have been burned, if the raw flesh becomes white or reddish-white.

dag: O niŋdila o yidana din viɛla o biɛhigu ni zaa, ka pa ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: She brings him good and not trouble all the days of her life.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu pahi buyi, bɛn suɣa be nudirigu polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi. Bɛ yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ saha shɛlikam, bɛn piɛbimi kika biɛɣu maa.
en: When short blasts are sounded a second time, the tribes on the south will move out. So short blasts are to be sounded to break camp.

dag: Ka gomna maa daa nya din niŋ maa ka niŋ yɛda, dama ti Duuma yɛligu maa wuhibu daa gar o pam.
en: When the governor saw what had happened, he believed; for he was greatly amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Hiburɔn din be Juda tiŋgban ni mini di momaha tiŋgbana din gil li la ti ba.
en: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soya nyɛla din viɛl zaa! Yawɛ daalikauli nyɛla zaɣ maŋli. O nyɛla bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: God! His way is perfect; the LORDs word is tried and true. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

dag: O yi ti dɔni, nyin kpahimmi baŋ o ni dɔni luɣ shɛli maa, ka o ti ʒeei gom bahi ka a chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli. O ni ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: When he lies down, notice the place where he is lying. Then go, uncover his feet, and lie down. And he will tell you what to do.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabi kam maŋmaŋ yanim pun bi deer o.
en: He said, I assure you that no prophet is welcome in the prophets hometown.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi nuhi tiri luɣ kasi shee la m-paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Lift your hands toward the Temple, and praise the Lord .

dag: N ni ti a alizanda nam saafɛbihi, ka a yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni; ka a yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, di mi ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.

dag: dama o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima Masia tuma zuɣu hal ti kpi. O daa niŋ lala ni o ti ma la sɔŋsim shɛli yi ni daa naan ku tooi ti ma.
en: He should be honored because he almost died for the work of Christ. He put his life in danger so that he could help me. This was help that you could not give me.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun niŋdi nirilim nyari jilima, amaa do so ŋun vari gindi ni leei bundana.
en: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.

dag: O kul gbibila bɛ kɔba zaa, ka di zaɣ yini gba ku kabigi.
en: He will protect them completely. Not one of their bones will be broken.

dag: Ka Aduna daa miri sara maligu bimbini maa nti kɔrigi omaŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo naɣila polli maa.
en: So Aaron went to the altar. He killed the bull for the sin offering. This sin offering was for himself.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye Jɛrusalɛmnima, zuŋɔ yi yi di baŋ din di naan tin ya suhudoo di di so; amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi bela zibisim ni zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: and said, I wish you knew today what would bring you peace. But it is hidden from you now.

dag: Filistianim maa daa ŋari kɔbil shɛŋa o ba Ibrahimma ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka o tumtumdiba gbi la.
en: So they filled in all the wells which the servants of his father Abraham had dug while Abraham was alive.
