dag: Simiɔn mini Lɛvi nyɛla nir ni o mabia. Bɛ malila bɛ bidibbina tumdi barina.
en: Simeon and Levi are brothers. They use their weapons to commit violence.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti leei yi zɔnim la yi ti leei yi zuɣulaannima, wula ka yi lee yɛn yɛli? Di biɛrim maa ku ŋmanila paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni so ti ku yɛli ni o biɛra. Ka Naawuni ni ti chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani daalahichi zaa taali.
en: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, I feel sick.

dag: Dahin shɛli a yi ti yɛn tuhi a dimnima, a tɔbbihi ni ti saɣi ti a. A nachimba ni ti ŋmanila asiba maligim n-laɣimna ti gil a sheeni zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: On the day you fight your enemies, your people will volunteer. Like the dew of early morning your young men will come to you on the sacred hills.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli salo min o nyaandoliba.
en: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and his disciples.

dag: Zaŋmi nam mini tibiginsim ye kaman salima nɛma la, ka zaŋ nam dariza mini yaa ye kaman situra la.
en: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yihi biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides.

dag: Di ni daa biɛmbe zaŋ chaŋ di yuma ayi bahigu ni ka o dɔro maa daa ti chɛ ka o nyɔri yina, ka o daa nya biɛrim pam hal ti kpi. O ni daa kpi, o niriba daa bi mali buɣim n-ti o jilima kaman bɛ ni daa mali buɣim ti o yaannim jilima shɛm la.
en: His intestines fell out two years later because of his sickness. He died in very bad pain. The people did not make a large fire to honor Jehoram as they did for his father.

dag: ka nya ka pako faralan so daa tɔhi pihinu diba ayi.
en: and he also saw a very poor widow dropping in two little copper coins.

dag: Niriba maa zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi bɛ ni ŋooi takɔb shɛli mini bɛ ni vooi tɔb shɛli ni bɛ to barina ni.
en: They have fled from swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and from the intensity of battle.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋ yur anu bɛn kpalim ŋɔ chaŋ, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni gba kul bela barina ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti tim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya.
en: One of his officers replied, We have a few horses left—why don't we let some men take five of them and go to the Syrian camp and see what's happening? We're going to die anyway like those who have already died.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛri gulibu ni na ni a ti leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: David, this is what I, the Lord All-Powerful, say to you. I brought you in from the fields where you took care of sheep, and I made you the leader of my people.

dag: ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn timmi nti zaŋ n dabili Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza na ka o ti me o nam ʒiishee tam n ni pi kuɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka ti o sampaa gil li.
en: Then tell them that I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, have sent for my servant, Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. I will bring him here and have him set up his throne and his royal tent over these stones that I told you to bury.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛ ka o mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni, yin kum o.
en: You must not allow anyone to have sexual relations with an animal. If this happens, that person must be killed.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Shilo n-lihi nya, ka daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnim kaman di ni daa simdi ni bɛ zuliya kam deei shɛm.
en: Joshua drew lots to consult the Lord for them, and assigned each of the remaining tribes of Israel a certain part of the land.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun tiri ti nasara ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: But we thank God who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!.

dag: Ka n daa kpahim yɛlli maa nti baŋ ni di pala Naawuni n-wuh o ni o yɛli lala, amaa ka daa baŋ ni Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat n-daa ti o liɣiri m-puh o ni o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: Then I realized that God hadnt sent him at all but that he spoke this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

dag: Ti ni daa paai yiŋa, ti daa zaŋ nyini n dan ni daa yɛli shɛm maa yɛli ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: So we went back to our father and told him what you said.

dag: Amaa sapashin kpɛm maa daa naɣ chɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛba ni bɛ maani tihi puri ka kɔra.
en: The commander of the guard left some of the lands poor people behind to work the vineyards and be farmers.

dag: N daa yɛn malila sara, ka zuŋɔ n niŋ n ni daa po pɔri ni n niŋ shɛli maa.
en: I made my offerings today and have the meat from the sacrifices.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa wum bɛ vuri maa ka bɔhi Bɔ vuri ka Hiburunim ŋɔ lee ti yɔri bɛ sansani maa ni lala? Filistianim maa ni daa ti baŋ ni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na maa.
en: When the Philistines heard the sound of that shout, they asked, What is that loud shouting in the Hebrew camp about? When they learned that the LORDs chest had come into the camp.

dag: Amaa kul zoomiyala ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia daanfaani min o baŋbu puuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Glory be to him, now and forever! Amen.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm, tiŋ maa zaa daa dammi ka bɛ bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, Who can this be.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛliya ka lala niŋ; dama Yawɛ daa lo Naa Dauda alikauli yɛli, N dabili Dauda nuu ka n ti yɛn zaŋ fa n niriba Izraɛlnim Filistianim mini bɛ dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi. .
en: Now here is your chance. Remember that the Lord has said, I will use my servant David to rescue my people Israel from the Philistines and from all their other enemies.

dag: Ka Yisa nimmiriba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o yi Galili na daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: And everyone who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance observing these things.

dag: Amaa n ni daa tɛhi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni, n daa nyaya ka di nyɛla tuun shɛli din to n sani.
en: It was hard for me to understand all this!.

dag: Yi ni tooi gaŋ niriba ti o? Yi ni tooi zabi Naawuni zuɣu?.
en: Are you trying to defend him? Are you going to argue his case in court?.

dag: O daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, M biɛli Iso yi ti tuhi ya soli bɔhi ya, Ŋuni n-lee sun ya? Ka ya polo ka yi lee chana? Ka ŋuni n-lee su biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ.
en: He ordered the first servant, When my brother Esau meets you and asks, Who is your master? Where are you going? Who owns these animals in front of you.

dag: To, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ sunsuuni, a tɛhiya ni ŋuni n-lee lihi ŋmɛnditoya ni daa liri do so maa kaman o ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: What do you think? Which one of these three was a neighbor to the man who encountered thieves.

dag: N dana, a daa bɔhila tinim a daba ŋɔ, Yi mali ba bee tizo.
en: You asked us if our father was still alive and if we had any more brothers.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bia maa ŋun yi yihi ya dabitim ni, yi shiri yiya ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Therefore, if the Son makes you free, you really will be free.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla ti suhuri piɛli ti wahala dibu puuni, dama ti mi ni wahala dibu tahirila ania niŋbu na.
en: And we are also happy with the troubles we have. Why are we happy with troubles? Because we know that these troubles make us more patient.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa be yi sani, ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim; ti daa kul bela baalim, ka gbib ya kaman paɣ ni gbib o bihi shɛm la.
en: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.

dag: ka yɛli Ɛfurɔn niriba maa zaa ninni, Amaa a yi di saɣi n naan yo a palo maa liɣiri. Saɣimi dee li, ka n zaŋ n kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: He said to Ephron before all the people, But I want to give you the full price for the field. Accept my money, and I will bury my dead.

dag: N yi zo n-du zuɣusaa, a be nimaani, ka n yi yɛrigi m bindoo sɔŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a be nimaani.
en: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.

dag: ka Maligumaana maa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi bee kawana sara la sara maligu bimbini la zuɣu. Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ mali taali ni yibu sanyoo sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa, ka o yi daɣiri ni.
en: and offer it with the grain offering on the altar. In this way the priest shall perform the ritual of purification, and you will be ritually clean.

dag: Ka nandaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa yi chani ti dooni bundan maa yiŋ dunol ni, ka yuma kul nyaɣim o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: At his gate lay a certain poor man named Lazarus who was covered with sores.

dag: Amaa anabi so ŋun ti zaŋ wuna yuya tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bee anab so ŋun zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni bi zal o ni o tɔɣisi, di daanab maa ni kpi.
en: But if any prophet dares to speak a message in my name when I did not command him to do so, he must die for it, and so must any prophet who speaks in the name of other gods.

dag: Ka gbaai naɣila kpabili na ti kɔrigi ka ti ŋubi, ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma;.
en: Get the best calf and prepare it, so we can eat and celebrate.

dag: N yuri a zaligu pam! N kul tɛhirila di yɛla dabisili kam.
en: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.

dag: Bee bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nira ŋun bɔbi? Ka o lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbiri ka niŋdi bɛ suhu yubu bela nanim yinsi.
en: What kind of man did you really go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who wear expensive clothes and live in luxury are in the king's palace.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n suhu piɛla, ka m paɣiri Naawuni pam. Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, n niŋgbuŋ gba mali tahima;.
en: So my heart is happy, and the words I speak are words of joy. Yes, even my body will live with hope.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa paai Aizaia sani.
en: When these leaders went to Isaiah.

dag: Ŋunkam zu ninsal ti kɔhi bee n-na gbib o ka bɛ gbaag o, bɛn kum o.
en: Death is the punishment for kidnapping. If you sell the person you kidnapped, or if you are caught with that person, the penalty is death.

dag: Ɛvilmɛrɔdak daa tɔɣisi Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o jilima ʒiishee n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin. He gave him a more important place to sit than the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri ka guri bɛ tɔbiri ni bɛ nyaŋ faranim mini nandaamba, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.

dag: Lala zuɣu di daa nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ din be alizanda ni ŋmahima la doli maligu malibu soli ŋɔ m-mali be kasi; amaa di nyɛla talahi ni binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni maŋmaŋ mali sara din so.
en: Those things, which are copies of the heavenly originals, had to be purified in that way. But the heavenly things themselves require much better sacrifices.

dag: Yawɛ be n sani, m bi zɔri dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: The Lord is with me, so I will not be afraid. No one on earth can do anything to harm me.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Di zaa ni ti saɣim, amaa nyin kul ni beni sahakam. Di ni ti kpi kaman siturili la. A taɣiri li mi kaman situra la, ka di kul kpira.
en: These things will pass away, but you will last. All of these things will wear out like clothing; you change them like clothes, and they pass on.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: The Lord also said:.

dag: Kamina ka ti dɔni bo taba hal ka biɛɣu ti neei. Chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli taba bɔbu ni.
en: Come on! Let's make love all night long. We'll be happy in each other's arms.

dag: M mi Ifriim, ka Izraɛlnim pala bɛn ni sɔɣi ka n ku nya ba. Dama Ifriimnima, pumpɔŋɔ yi tum yolimyolim. Ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: I know Ephraim. I know what Israel has done. Ephraim, right now you act like a prostitute. Israel is dirty with sin.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim pam daa ka Maata mini Mariama sanna ni bɛ ti maai bɛ suhuri bɛ tizɔdoo Lazarɔs kum maa zuɣu.
en: Many Jews had come to comfort Martha and Mary after their brothers death.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: You must not worship any other gods except me.

dag: A wuntitali ŋmanila zoya din du pam; ka a saria karibu ŋmani teeku bulli din zilim pam. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri ninsalinim zaŋ tabili binnɛma.
en: Your righteousness is like the strongest mountains; your justice is like the deepest sea. LORD, you save both humans and animals.

dag: Ka bɔ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛn niŋ? Niriba yi niŋdi lala ni tɛhi biɛri bee tɛhi suma, Masia yɛla molo kul bahi mooni ginda, ka m mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu. Iin, n shiri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: It does not matter! I am happy about it—just so Christ is preached in every way possible, whether from wrong or right motives. And I will continue to be happy.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbaai nyin Pashihur mini bɛn be a yiŋ zaa daba n-zaŋ ya kuli Babilɔn, ka a min a zɔnim zaa ti kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣi ya nimaani. A zɔnim shɛba a ni yi tɔɣisiri ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la.
en: As for you, Pashhur, you and all your family will also be captured and taken off to Babylonia. There you will die and be buried, along with all your friends to whom you have told so many lies.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o ma min o ni daa yuri nyaandol so la ʒe nimaani maa, ka o yɛl o ma, N-nyɛ a bia.
en: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, Woman, here is your son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdal la n-chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni, ka n ti lihi n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima m-pal o jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the Temple. As I looked, I saw that the Temple of the Lord was filled with the dazzling light of his presence. I threw myself face downward on the ground.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni ka di nyɛ din bi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa sani. Ka bɛ daa lan me buɣijɛmbo shee zali bɛ fɔntinsi zaa ni mini tiŋkpan bihi ni ni bɛ ni me birini gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni;.
en: The Israelites did things that the Lord their God disapproved of. They built pagan places of worship in all their towns, from the smallest village to the largest city.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun viɛla kaman saŋkpaliŋ la, ka simdi ni a yu o. Chɛ ka o biha tiɣ a nini sahakam, ka chɛ ka o ni yur a shɛm ku a zuɣu.
en: pretty and graceful as a deer. Let her charms keep you happy; let her surround you with her love.

dag: Ka malaika daa yi alizanda ni na ti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: Then an angel from heaven came to help him.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni pala din yi ti Ba Naawuni sanna, amaa di nyɛla din yi dunia ŋɔ ni na. Dina n-nyɛ: Niŋgbuŋ kɔre mini nini kɔre ni barinyubo dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini ba lo alikauli bee n-lo bɛ buɣa la alikauli.
en: Dont make any covenants with them or their gods.

dag: Yi ni ti di biŋkpam hal ti tiɣi, ka nyu ʒim hal ti buɣi sara maligu chu shɛli shili n ni maani tiri ya maa ni.
en: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.

dag: N yi be a jɛmbu duu dahin yini, di so ni m be luɣ shɛli polo m-paai biɛɣ tuhili; m paɣiya ni n nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔgula n-gari m be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi.
en: One day spent in your Temple is better than a thousand anywhere else; I would rather stand at the gate of the house of my God than live in the homes of the wicked.

dag: M biyurisi, Naawuni yi yuri ti ŋ-ŋɔ, dindina di simdi ni ti gba yuri taba.
en: That is how much God loved us, dear friends! So we also must love each other.

dag: Ka o daa yi n nyaaŋa n-kana ti ŋma ʒiri pa ma nyini n dan naa sani. Amaa nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: He lied about me to Your Majesty, but you are like God's angel, so do what seems right to you.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Chɛli di zaa ha ka chaŋ, dama o nyɛla n ni pii so ni o zaŋ n yuli wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini nazuɣuri ni Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord said to Ananias, Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.

dag: Pool daa ti chaŋ Dɛɛbi mini Listra gba. Yisa nyaandol so daa be nimaani ka o yuli booni Timoti. O ma daa nyɛla Yɛhudia paɣa ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola, ka o ba mi nyɛ Giriiki doo.
en: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa ti ma. Ka o daa bol o, ka o kana ti zan o tooni.
en: Elisha said to his servant Gehazi, Call this Shunammite woman. The servant called the Shunammite woman, and she stood in front of Elisha.

dag: Yi gba mali suhusaɣiŋgu pumpɔŋɔ, amaa n ni ti lan nyan ya yaha, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli, ka so ti ku tooi yihi yi suhupiɛlli maa yi suhuri ni.
en: In the same way, you have sorrow now; but I will see you again, and you will be overjoyed. No one takes away your joy.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ daba ayopɔin dali, n ni chɛ ka saa lu dunia ni na m-mi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa biɛɣ pihinahi n-ku n ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ tiŋgban ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: Seven days from now, I will send much rain on the earth. It will rain for days and nights, and I will wipe everything off the face of the earth. I will destroy everything I made.

dag: Bɛ yi wum bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi be bɛ sani. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Whether they listen or whether they refuse, since they are a household of rebels, they will know that a prophet has been among them.

dag: ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya n jilima mini n ni pun tum alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Ijipti mini mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka zahim ma paai siɣimsiɣim pia, ka zaɣisi n noli ŋɔ.
en: none of the men who saw my glory and the signs I did in Egypt and in the desert, but tested me these ten times and havent listened to my voice.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa yi chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bɛ jɛma saha nti tumdi bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ yab Aduna zali ba shɛm la.
en: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron.

dag: Ka duu ŋɔ ni lu n-dahim, ka bɛnkam ti gariti nimaani yi nya li, di ni niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ yɛli, wɛi, ka bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini duu ŋɔ lala.
en: Everyone who passes by this temple, so lofty now, will be shocked and will whistle, wondering, Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and this temple?.

dag: Naa zaligu lahibali maa ni daa paai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni, Yɛhudianim daa kul kuhirila fabila kuhigu pampam. Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa lo noli n-kum ka fabili, ka bɛ ni niriba pam daa pili buri n-teei do tampiligim ni.
en: Throughout all the provinces, wherever the king's proclamation was made known, there was loud mourning among the Jews. They fasted, wept, wailed, and most of them put on sackcloth and lay in ashes.

dag: Ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: Suddenly, seven fat, healthy cows came up from the river and started eating grass along the bank.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ chɛ ka Ziinas ŋun nyɛ zaligubaŋda la mini Apolɔs niŋ yomyom gbaai soli chaŋ, ka zaŋ di ni simdi ni bɛ mali shɛli ti ba.
en: Help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey with enthusiasm so that they wont need anything.

dag: N nini nya n dimnim lubu; ka n tiba wum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn liriti ma azaaba nyabu kuhigu.
en: I have seen the defeat of my enemies and heard the cries of the wicked.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni vil o bahi o bindoo zuɣu, ka o mini bɛnkam niŋ o zina ni nya wahala pam naɣila bɛ niŋla tuuba bɛ ni tum shɛm o sani maa zuɣu.
en: Look! Im throwing her onto a sickbed. I am casting those who have committed adultery with her into terrible hardship—if they dont change their hearts from following her practices.

dag: Ŋunkam ka dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tɛhijihilana ni zoma, ka lan nyɛla ŋun tam ni o daalahichi pun kpihim.
en: Whoever lacks these things is shortsighted and blind, forgetting that they were cleansed from their past sins.

dag: kaman tɔŋ la, dama di ni ti paai ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: like a trap. This day will surprise everyone on earth.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa boli Musa mini Aduna labisi Firawuna sanna, ka o ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa; amaa ka banima n-lee yɛn chaŋ maa.
en: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh, and he said to them, Go! Worship the LORD your God! But who exactly is going with you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi di ni chihiri ni Yɛhudia nira mini zuliya shɛb laɣim shɛm bee ka bɛ ti kpe zuliya shɛb yinsi yɛla; amaa Naawuni wuhi ma ni n di lihi so yoli bee n-siŋ so.
en: He said to them, You yourselves know very well that a Jew is not allowed by his religion to visit or associate with Gentiles. But God has shown me that I must not consider any person ritually unclean or defiled.

dag: Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya ha ka ti wum binyiɣira kpiŋkpama vubu damli.
en: Look at the land along the rivers of Ethiopia where you can hear the buzzing of insect wings.

dag: Di bi kpa talahi ni n sabi n-wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yuri yi mabihi shɛm, dama Naawuni pun wuhi ya yimaŋmaŋ ni yɛn yuri tab shɛm.
en: You dont need us to write about loving your brothers and sisters because God has already taught you to love each other.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Ninive naa, ka o yiɣis o nam ʒiishee m-pirig o nam binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buɣu pili n-teei ʒini tampiligim mahili ni wuhi bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa zaŋ bɛ farigu binyara maa yo n-naai, o daa chɛmi ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi li tahi na kuli.
en: When Ehud had given him the gifts, he told the men who had carried them to go back home.

dag: n-yi a biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo katiŋ kana. A mini niriba bɛn be a sani zaa nyɛla wɔribariba, ka nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa ka galisi pam.
en: you will lead your powerful cavalry from your kingdom in the north.

dag: Sidɔnnima, yi ku lan mali suhupiɛlli, ka yi niriba ni nya nahiŋgu. Hal bɛ yi zo n-kuli Saipurus, bɛ na kul bi yi.
en: He said, Daughter Sidon, you have been hurt badly, so you will no longer rejoice like a bride. Go ahead, go to Cyprus for help, but you will not find a place to rest there either.

dag: Ka Obɛdɛdom daa yina ti deei duno shɛli din daa be nudirigu polo la, ka bɛ daa zaŋ nɛma duri fukumsi niŋ o bidibisi nuu ni.
en: Obed-edom was assigned the South Gate, and his sons were assigned the storehouses.

dag: Miriya ka yi birigi mɔɣu bee n-doli pala, dama yi dimnim maa gbibila takɔbiri ka dabiɛm be luɣilikam.
en: We don't dare go to the countryside or walk on the roads, because our enemies are armed and terror is all around us.

dag: Sokam kul kpalimmi be kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni bol o.
en: Each person should stay in the situation they were in when they were called.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ labimi kuli ni suhudoo, ka miri ka a chɛ ka Filistia nanim suhuri ti miligi a zuɣu.
en: Go on back home and try not to upset them.

dag: Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: So it goes back and finds the house clean and all fixed up.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai zom maa nuu ni vo o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti tuhi nintɔri ta o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi shih o ka bɔh o, A nya shɛli.
en: Taking the blind mans hand, Jesus led him out of the village. After spitting on his eyes and laying his hands on the man, he asked him, Do you see anything.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ n-tirila Taitus ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zo a nambɔɣu ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Titus, a true son to me in the faith we share together. Grace and peace to you from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi di nya soli n-tuhi fa bindir shɛŋa bɛ dimnim ŋɔ sani di naan so, dama bɛ dii bi ku Filistianim maa pam zuŋɔ.
en: How much better it would have been today if our people had eaten the food they took when they defeated the enemy. Just think how many more Philistines they would have killed.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa baŋ ni Naa Sɛnachɛrib loya ni o tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnim maa.
en: Hezekiah knew that Sennacherib came to Jerusalem to attack it.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But when the sun came up, it scorched the plants, and they dried up because they had no roots.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti karim Naawuni zaligu min anabinim sabbu naai ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulaannim daa tim so ni o cham ti yɛli Pool min o nyaaŋa maa, Ti mabihi, yi yi mali yɛligu din ni kpaŋsi niriba ŋɔ suhuri, yin yɛlimiya li.
en: After the reading from the Law of Moses and from the writings of the prophets, the officials of the synagogue sent them a message: Friends, we want you to speak to the people if you have a message of encouragement for them.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yɛda niriba bɛn dir o nuu ni nti yɛn luh o; ka o tɔbbihi ti wurim, ka bɛ ku bɛ ni pam mi.
en: His closest advisers will ruin him. Many of his soldiers will be killed, and his army will be wiped out.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Zanim a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini, ka n yi kpaŋ ha; di pa shɛli ka Yawɛ ka n sanna. Ka o yi wuhi ma shɛlikam, n ni zaŋ li yɛl a. Ka o daa chaŋ ti du n-tam kuŋkun nɛli zuɣu.
en: Then Balaam said to Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering, while I go to see whether or not the Lord will meet me. I will tell you whatever he reveals to me. So he went alone to the top of a hill.

dag: N di yuya ni Naawuni saɣi ku ma. O wɔɣisim o nuu ka chɛ ka n lu.
en: If only he would go ahead and kill me!.

dag: N daa zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ baŋsim bɔbu ni ni m bo n-nya yɛm mini binyara pam, ka m baŋ ni ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla jɛrilim, ka jɛrilim nyɛ yinyari.
en: I turned my mind to know, to investigate, and to seek wisdom, along with an account of things, to know that wickedness is foolishness and folly is madness.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm lala, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zali zaligu Susa tiŋ puuni. Ka bɛ daa shiri zaŋ Haman bidibisi maa ti yili gar dari.
en: The king ordered that this be done, and the law became public in Susa. They impaled the ten sons of Haman just as she said.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ bɛ ʒiʒiinitab ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn zaa mi bɛ yuli ŋɔ, fabilimiya bɛ zuɣu. Yɛlimiya, Nyamiya nam jaaŋgbe kpiɔŋ din mali jilima la ni kabigi shɛm.
en: Mourn for that nation, you that live nearby, all of you that know its fame. Say, Its powerful rule has been broken; its glory and might are no more.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Amnɔn daa kul lan je Tama yɛlli zaa, hal ka o ni daa je o shɛm maa gar o ni daa yur o shɛm la gba. Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim yi.
en: Then Amnon hated her even more than he had loved her before. So he told her, Get up and get out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba pahi Yisa zuɣu ni bɛ ti ku ba.
en: There were also two criminals led out with Jesus to be killed.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi be di ni maa ni.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: I am giving you a land to be your home. When you enter that land.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn pa a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka yi tinshee katiŋ kana a yuli din galisi ŋɔ min a yiko tuma ni a ni kul tumdi shɛlikam zuɣu, bɛ yi ti zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: People from other places will hear about your greatness and your power. They will come from far away to pray at this Temple.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri ti Duuma pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ ka bi doli so shɛli din tiri Naawuni jilima di ni, o ni mali taali zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ min o ʒim polo.
en: This is why those who eat the bread or drink the cup of the Lord inappropriately will be guilty of the Lords body and blood.

dag: Hal Naa Hɛrɔd gba bi nya o taali, dama o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o lab ti sanna. Nyamiya, o bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum.
en: Nor did Herod find him guilty, for he sent him back to us. There is nothing this man has done to deserve death.

dag: Ka goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, yin chɛ ka bɛ piɛb kikahi pampam. Ka dabisi shɛli din nyɛ samli yɔbu dali maa, yin chɛliya ka bɛ piɛbi kikahi gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Then have the trumpet blown on the tenth day of the seventh month. Have the trumpet blown throughout your land on the Day of Reconciliation.

dag: Yɛhudia do so daa be Susa din nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni ka o yuli booni Mɔdɛkai. O daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira. Mɔdɛkai ba n-daa nyɛ Jair. O yaba n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi, ka o yab do kurili mi nyɛ Kish.
en: Now there was a Jew from the tribe of Benjamin named Mordecai. Mordecai was the son of Jair, and Jair was the son of Shimei, and Shimei was the son of Kish. Mordecai was in the capital city, Susa.

dag: Di biɛɣu pia nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa.
en: Ten days later, the Lord gave me an answer for.

dag: Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ nini nyaya, di zaŋ li shini! N Duuma, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma!.
en: Lord , surely you can see what is happening. So dont keep quiet. Lord, dont leave me.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan kɔre ni be shɛli ni pam nyɛla din kur o. Dama vinnyaɣilana nuhi je tuma.
en: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.

dag: Amaa o zuɣu palo maa ni bee gbɛ palo maa ni yi mali dɔr biɛɣu bimmɔriŋ zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu m-piligir o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni maa.
en: But if there is a red and white infection on his scalp, it is a skin disease.

dag: O daa lan dɔɣi bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: He also got seven sons and three daughters.

dag: Jɛrigu yi ŋahi ŋahili, di ŋmanila nir ni nyu dam kuli ka bɔri ni o ŋooi goo o nuu ni la.
en: A fool trying to say something wise is like a drunk trying to pick a thorn out of his hand.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; amaa karimbia ŋun nya wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga, o baŋsim min o karimba baŋsim ti saɣirila taba.
en: No pupils are greater than their teacher; but all pupils, when they have completed their training, will be like their teacher.

dag: Di saha ka Pita mini Jɔn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: When the two apostles laid their hands on the people, they received the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, Fom a noli ka wara.
en: Jesus told the evil spirit, Be quiet and come out of the man.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura; dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura binshɛli bi poori ba.
en: Honor the Lord , all his people; those who obey him have all they need.

dag: N daa zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ baŋsim bɔbu ni ni m bo n-nya yɛm mini binyara pam, ka m baŋ ni ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla jɛrilim, ka jɛrilim nyɛ yinyari.
en: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Remember how you were a slave in Egypt. Thats why I am commanding you to do this thing.

dag: N suhu je yi goli pala churi mini yi ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu la. Di leela ʒitibisili n sani, di ʒibu wum ma pam.
en: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.

dag: amaa ka labina nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom luɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom la zuɣu, o ku chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a sɔɣi pah a yaannim ni. .
en: Instead, you returned and ate a meal in a place he had ordered you not to eat in. Because of this you will be killed, and your body will not be buried in your family grave.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti kabi bɛ ni daa kpahi niriba ayi shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu pahi Yisa zuɣu la ŋun daŋ tooni min o kpee la gbaya;.
en: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men on the crosses beside Jesus.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o la daa naanyi di ka nyu, ka gbe nimaani. Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka o yiɣisi ka yɛli ba, N suhiri soli ni n labi n dan sani.
en: Then Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, and spent the night there. When they got up in the morning, he said, Let me go back to my master.

dag: N ni darigi yi bihi tibili, ka zaŋ yi sara biŋkɔbiri bindi ʒe yi nina ni, ka kari ya n sani.
en: I am about to denounce your offspring; I will scatter feces on your faces, the feces of your festivals. Then I will lift you up to me.

dag: ni Kiriataim ni Bɛtigamul ni Bɛtimɛɔn.
en: Kiriathaim, Bethgamul, Bethmeon.

dag: Amaa Nuhu kɔŋko ka Yawɛ nini daa naɣ kul tiɣi.
en: But Noah pleased the Lord .

dag: N kul guhima, bɛ ni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli maa zuɣu? Bee bɛ ni ʒiɛya ka bi lan garigi n-yɛli shɛli zuɣu?.
en: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni. N ni ti zaŋ li tin ya ka di leei yi ni su shɛli. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Ill bring you into the land that I promised to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Ill give it to you as your possession. I am the LORD.

dag: Yi dimnim tɔbbi yino ni ti kari yi ninvuɣ tuhili ka yi ŋmaligi guui, ka bɛ tɔbbih anu ni tooi kari ya ka yi zaa ŋmaligi guui, ka yi tɔbbi yino gba ti ku kpalim zani naɣila binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili din be zoli zuɣu la n-ni ti kpalim beni.
en: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill.

dag: Ti wuhiri ni nir yiri taali ni Naawuni san la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka pa ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu.
en: No, not at all, but through the law of faith. We consider that a person is treated as righteous by faith, apart from what is accomplished under the Law.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Dinzuɣu tihi puu maa lana yi ti kana, wula ka o lee yɛn niŋ padiriba maa.
en: Now, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants? Jesus asked.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa lan yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu, m bɔrimi ni n lan zaŋ piɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ buɣisi bin yini pahi. N suhir a, chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gili piɛ gbaŋ maa, amaa ka chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kuma.
en: But Gideon prayed to God again. Don't be angry with me, Gideon said. Let me try this just one more time, so I'll really be sure you'll help me. Only this time, let the skin be dry and the stone floor be wet.

dag: Mani n-yɛli lala maa. Iin, mani m-bol o. Mani n-zaŋ o na, ka o mi ni di nasara o tuma ni.
en: I, I have spoken and told him the things that will happen to him; I will make him succeed.

dag: O ni daa paai Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbani maa dunɔdali gbini, ka Shɛlɛmia bia Irija ŋun daa nyɛ Hanania yaaŋa ka nyɛ dunɔgul la daa be nimaani, ka o daa gbaai anabi Jɛrimia ka yɛra, A zɔrimi doli Babilɔnnim maa ni a chaŋ.
en: I was leaving Jerusalem through Benjamin Gate, when I was stopped by Irijah, the officer in charge of the soldiers at the gate. He said, Jeremiah, you're under arrest for trying to join the Babylonians.

dag: O daa deei liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba sani anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu, ka di nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga la.
en: He took the money from the oldest of the Israelites, , shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

dag: Yi mi Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli nti yɛli Izraɛlnim la yɛla; bɛ daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu wuhi ni suhudoo yirila Yisa Masia sanna. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Duuma.
en: This is the message of peace he sent to the Israelites by proclaiming the good news through Jesus Christ: He is Lord of all!.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka bɛ boli kalima maa yuli, Kalima din wari ginda.
en: And I heard a voice calling these the wheels that spin.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: When Jesus finished speaking all these words, he said to his disciples.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi saha gol so bɛ ni booni Nisan la puuni, Naa wain nyubu saha ni daa ti paai, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ti o. N daa na ʒi m-mali suhugarigu o tooni.
en: In the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, the king was about to be served wine. I took the wine and gave it to the king. Since I had never seemed sad in his presence.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa dolila wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: The Glory of the Lord came into the Temple through the east gate.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti niŋ binchimda zim maa shɛli mini kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim maa zaa nyo buɣim n-yihi di chihili. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: The priest must burn part of the crushed grain, the oil, and all the frankincense on it as a memorial offering. It is a gift to the Lord .

dag: dama n sani, di bi tuhi ni n chɛ ka bɛ tahi dansarika so Naa Siiza sani ka m bi sabi wuhi o taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: I think it is foolish to send a prisoner to Caesar without making some charges against him.

dag: Zilim balli nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din chɛ ka nir suhu saɣinda.
en: Wholesome speech is a tree of life, but dishonest talk breaks the spirit.

dag: Di daba anahi dali ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Samsin paɣa, Doli yɛŋkiŋkabina soli n-chɛ ka a yidana wuhi ti o ŋahili maa, di yi pa lala, ti ni nyo a ba yiŋ buɣim ka di di li tabili amaŋmaŋa. Yi bol ti mi na ni yi ti ti ti samli.
en: On the fourth day they said to Samsons wife, Seduce your husband so hell tell us the answer to the riddle, or else well set fire to you and your household. Were we invited here just to become poor.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa niŋ darigi Abimilɛk tibili o ni daa tum o ba tuumbiɛ shɛli din nyɛ o ni daa ku omaŋmaŋ ba bidibisi pisopɔin la zuɣu.
en: And so it was that God paid Abimelech back for the crime that he committed against his father in killing his seventy brothers.

dag: Yɛnnim ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla bɛ ni daa wum shɛli bɛ yaannim sani.
en: what the wise have told and have not concealed from their family.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa wurim nimaani, ka sokam lab omaŋmaŋ daŋ niriba min o malibu sani, ka bɛ daa yi nimaani lab bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Afterwards, the rest of the Israelites returned to their homes and families.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihira, ka na kul wumdi yilli zaɣ bil la yɛtɔɣ kara la. Ka n ni daa na kul lihiri maa, ka n ti nya ka bɛ ku biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la n-zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim ni, ka di di n-saɣim o.
en: I kept watching. I watched from the moment the horn started bragging until the beast was killed and its body was destroyed, handed over to be burned with fire.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, na so ŋun daa leeg o nam ka o yuli ʒiɛm o ni daa po pɔri shɛli la, ka saɣim alikauli maa ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ Babilɔn maa ni ka o ni kpi.
en: The Lord GOD says, By my life, I swear that this new king will die in Babylonia! Nebuchadnezzar made this man the new king of Judah, but he broke his promise with Nebuchadnezzar. This new king ignored that agreement.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi biŋkɔbigu la nam ʒiishee, ka o nam sulinsi tariga zaa daa zibigi, ka niriba daa dimdi be zilima biɛrim zuɣu.
en: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.

dag: dama o ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ titali ti Duuma sani. O ti ku nyu wain bee binnyura din mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti pal o la saha shɛl o ma ni dɔɣ o.
en: for he will be great in the Lords eyes. He must not drink wine and liquor. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before his birth.

dag: Ka Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia nira, ka nyɛ yuun pihiyɔbunaayi nir la daa deei nam maa di.
en: Darius the Mede received the kingdom at the age of .

dag: Bɔ saha ka ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋum niŋ ma? N wum ŋumaŋuma shɛli Izraɛlnim maa ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma maa.
en: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ o lala, dama niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: And that's exactly what happened—the officer was trampled to death.

dag: Bɛ zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Ishimail bituuli n-daa nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt, bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-daa nyɛ: Kɛdar mini Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: The sons of Ishmael became the heads of twelve tribes: Nebaioth , Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam.

dag: Wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: The Scriptures say, God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni ka a lee bɔri ni n chɛ ka o yina? Ka o yɛl o, M bɔri ni a chɛ ka Samuɛl n-yina.
en: Who do you want me to bring up? she asked. Bring up the ghost of Samuel, he answered.

dag: So yi mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla o yɛn yola o ni po pɔr shɛli samli bee o kul yɛn malila o suhu yubu sara, ka di nyɛla o piila o niɣi ni bee o piɛri ni na, n yi ni deei li, di simdi ka o nyɛla ŋun viɛl zaa. Di bi simdi ka o mali daŋa.
en: Whenever someone presents a communal sacrifice of well-being to the LORD from the herd or flock—whether it is payment for a solemn promise or a spontaneous gift—it must be flawless to be acceptable; it must not have any imperfection.

dag: A bi saɣi n-chɛ ka n dimnim gbaai ma; a zaŋ ma zali palo ni.
en: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.

dag: ni binyɛr shɛŋa din she n-viɛla, din nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaani la binyɛr kasi la min o bidibisi la binyɛr shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: the special clothes for Aaron the priest; the special clothes for Aarons sons when they serve as priests;.

dag: Bɛn daŋ niriba galisi, nyin pirigim pal titali ti ba, ka bɛn mi daŋ niriba pɔra, nyin pirigim palo din pɔri ti ba. Tim daŋ kam niriba bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli kaman bɛ ni sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: A large tribe will get much land, and a small tribe will get less land. The land that they get will be equal to the number of people who were counted.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bihi maa, N yɛn chaŋ ti pahila n yaannim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Zaŋmiya ma ti sɔɣi siliga din be Ɛfurɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la puu la ni m-pahi n yaannim zuɣu.
en: Then Israel gave them a command. He said, When I die, I want to be with my people. I want to be buried with my ancestors in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba zaa mini salo zaa daa bi lan ʒe yim hal ti yaɣi. Bɛ daa kul tumdila din chihiri kam kaman zuliya shɛb ni tumdi shɛm, ka ta Yawɛ ni pun mal o jɛmbu du kasi shɛli zali Jɛrusalɛm la daɣiri.
en: Also, all the leaders of the priests and the leaders of the people of Judah sinned worse and became more unfaithful to the Lord. They followed the evil example of the other nations. They ruined the Temple that the Lord had made holy in Jerusalem.

dag: M mabihi bɛn mali be kasi ka saɣi alizanda ni boligu ŋɔ, tɛhimiya Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti daadiini tumo ni maligumaani tital la yɛla.
en: Therefore, brothers and sisters who are partners in the heavenly calling, think about Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession.

dag: Zoya daa nya a ka sɔhigi. Kopaliga daa ŋme n-gari, ka teeku bulli duhi di kukoli. Wuntaŋ duhi di nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi n-laɣim gbaai soli kuni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi soli ha.
en: They left the place where they had been living and started walking back to the land of Judah.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋma ti shɛŋa yi ni mi ka di bi wandi wala. Yi ni tooi ŋma li n-zaŋ li mali bindura tabili tiŋ maa gooni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi kpe di ni ti nyaŋ ba.
en: That said, if you know that a tree is not a food-producing tree, you are allowed to destroy it, cutting it down and using it in the siege against the city that is fighting against you until it falls.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Firawuna, Zalim ma saha shɛli a ni bɔri ni n suhi Naawuni ti a min a niriba ni a kpamba zaa, ka poloya maa kpi yi yinsi, ka chɛla bɛn be Nail Mɔɣili ni la kɔŋko.
en: All right, Moses answered. You choose the time when I am to pray for the frogs to stop bothering you, your officials, and your people, and for them to leave your houses and be found only in the river.

dag: Sɔŋmiya Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be wahala ni, ka niŋmiya saani.
en: Share with Gods people who need help. Look for people who need help and welcome them into your homes.

dag: To, ninvuɣ so yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi chani gindi yɛra, N ni yihi ya waazu din wuhiri ni wain mini binnyuri kpɛma pam nyubu viɛla, ŋuna ka yi ni bɔri ni o nyɛ yi waazuyihira.
en: If someone were to go about inspired and say deceitfully: I will preach to you for wine and liquor, such a one would be the preacher for this people!.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti nya Dauda ashilɔni yɛl o, Nyama, naa suhu yur a pam, ka o tumtumdib zaa nini tiɣ a, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ leemi naa deemba! .
en: Saul instructed his servants, Tell David in private: Look, the king likes you, and all his servants love you. You should become the kings son-in-law.

dag: N yi tam a yɛla, bee n yi bi lihi nyin Jɛrusalɛm ka a gari shɛlikam m bebu ni, n zilinli din leemi zilin tabinli.
en: If I fail to remember you, may I never sing again. I will always remember Jerusalem as my greatest joy!.

dag: Ka o daa mali Ɛlat me n-ti Judanima, Naa Amazia kalinsi maa nyaaŋa.
en: He rebuilt Eloth, restoring it to Judah after King Amaziah had lain down with his ancestors.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tihi daa laɣim ni bɛ bɔ ŋun yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Olivi tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: One day the trees decided to choose a king to rule over them. The trees said to the olive tree, You be king over us.

dag: dindina o ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli tum tuma kaman o Lɛvi tab zaa ni zaani Yawɛ tooni tumdi tuma nimaani shɛm.
en: And this Levite may serve in the name of the Lord his God, the same as all his brother Levites who are on duty before the Lord .

dag: O yi kana, Kɛilanim ni gbaai ma ti o? O shiri nyɛla ŋun ni kana kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni wum shɛm maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, yɛlim mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛl o, O ni kana.
en: Will the citizens of Keilah hand me over to Saul? Will Saul really come, as I have heard? Lord , God of Israel, I beg you to answer me! The Lord answered, Saul will come.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yoli, di daa muɣisi ba ni bɛ tooi gooi niriba maa ka bɛ ku mali ba maligu maa.
en: Even with these words the apostles could hardly keep the crowd from offering a sacrifice to them.

dag: ka yi ti bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman zoma ni bɔbindi gindi zibisim ni shɛm la, amaa ka ku nya soli ka bɛ naɣ ti kul filindi ya mi, ka fari yi nɛma waawaayili, ka so ku beni ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Saimɔn n-chaŋ Yisa sani. Ka Yisa daa ti yul o ka yɛl o, Nyini n-nyɛ Saimɔn, Jɔn bia la. Ka lan yɛl o, Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a yuli m-booni Siifas. Yuli ŋɔ mini Pita nyɛla zaɣ yini. Di gbinni nyɛla Kuɣili.
en: He led him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, You are Simon, son of John. You will be called Cephas .

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir ŋun yi Zɛrɛda na, ka nyɛ Sulemaana kpambala, ka o ma nyɛ pako so ŋun yuli daa booni Zɛrua la gba daa leei naa dima.
en: Another man who turned against King Solomon was one of his officials, Jeroboam son of Nebat, from Zeredah in Ephraim. His mother was a widow named Zeruah.

dag: N ni yɛri ya shɛm ŋɔ, sokam zaa ka n yɛra, Di gbihiriya.
en: What I say to you, then, I say to all: Watch.

dag: Zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni.
en: These words that I am commanding you today must always be on your minds.

dag: Ka n daa nya litaafi shɛli ka di be ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni, ka sabbu be di puuni mini di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ bintabinda ayopɔin n-dihi tabili di noli.
en: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one sitting on the throne. The scroll had writing on both sides and was kept closed with seven seals.

dag: Yisa ni daa neei kum ni bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi maa o daa tuui yila Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa kari alizin biɛri ayopɔin so zuɣu la.
en: They promptly reported all of the young mans instructions to those who were with Peter. Afterward, through the work of his disciples, Jesus sent out, from the east to the west, the sacred and undying message of eternal salvation. Amen. .

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi di mi Naawuni pini, ka mi ŋun suhir a ni a niŋ kom ti o ka o nyu ŋɔ, a gba naan suh o ka o ti a nyɛvili kom.
en: Jesus responded, If you recognized Gods gift and who is saying to you, Give me some water to drink, you would be asking him and he would give you living water.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋun su kom fukumsi yɛli, Yaa ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ka be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, a saria karibu ŋɔ nyɛla din tuhi!.
en: Then I heard the angel of the waters say, You are just, holy one, who is and was, because you have given these judgments.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o be Naawuni ni, di niŋ kamaata ni o be kaman Masia ni daa be shɛm la.
en: The one who claims to remain in him ought to live in the same way as he lived.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Zoya tiŋgbani maa ku saɣ ti, ka Keenannim mi ʒi tintan ni, ka mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi. Bɛ ni shɛb bɛn be Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni bɛn be Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni la zaa mal li mi.
en: The people of Joseph said, The highland isnt enough for us. But all the Canaanites who live in the valley region have iron chariots, both those in Beth-shean and its dependent cities and those in the Jezreel Valley.

dag: Yil yidan yi ti yiɣisi kpari dunoli maa ka yi kana ti ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara yɛra, Ti Duuma, yoom ti ka ti gari, o ni ti garigi yɛli ya, N ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na.
en: If a man locks the door of his house, you can stand outside and knock on the door, but he wont open it. You can say, Sir, open the door for us. But he will answer, I dont know you. Where did you come from.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi. .
en: I will just have him beaten with a whip and set free.

dag: Amaa ka Gɛshurinim mini Sirianim daa fa Havɔtijairi mini Kɛnat ni di tiŋkpansi bɛ sani, di daa nyɛla tinsi pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bihi.
en: But Geshur and Aram took Jairs villages. Among them were Kenath and the small towns around it. There were small towns in all. All these towns belonged to the sons of Makir, the father of Gilead.

dag: Di kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Salima taha pihita min anzinfa taha tuhili ni tahi shɛŋa pihitayinika.
en: This is what Mithredath brought out of the Lords Temple: gold dishes, silver dishes, knives and pans.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ gali pa o buŋa n-chaŋ Gaat naa Akishi sani ni o ti bo o daba maa shee. Ka o daa shiri bo n-nya ba n-zaŋ ba lab yiŋ na.
en: Shimei saddled his donkey and went to Achish in Gath to look for his servants. Shimei then brought his servants back from Gath.

dag: Kɔhat daa malila bidibisi anahi, Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohaths family: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, N daalibarika saɣ a, dama n yaa niŋdi dɛde chɔɣinsi ni. Ka n kul ni nyuri bara m-pahiri ni suhupiɛlli n chɔɣinsi zuɣu ka di chɛ ka Masia yiko tooi be n ni.
en: But he replied, My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak. So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.

dag: Ka Zakius daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ti Duuma Yisa, N Duuma, n ni zaŋ n nɛma pirigili ti nandaamba, ka n yi daa dila so bini zalinsi, n ni lan labisi dilan bini lala siɣimsiɣim bunahi zuɣu ti o.
en: Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, Listen, sir! I will give half my belongings to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will pay back four times as much.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Piimi dɔbba n-sa chaŋ ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Biɛɣuni n sa ni zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ n nuu ni n-chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli zuɣu.
en: So Moses said to Joshua, Choose some men and go and fight the Amalekites tomorrow. I will stand on the top of the hill and watch you. I will be holding the walking stick God gave me.

dag: Nyama, mbusim din pah ayi gariya; ka din pah ata yɛn doli di nyaaŋ na pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The second horror is over. The third horror is coming soon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee daa kpuɣila Atarɔtada wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn Duli polo.
en: This is the land that was given to the people of Ephraim: Their eastern border started at Ataroth Addar near Upper Beth Horon.

dag: N tim ya mi ni yi ti kpuɣi yi ni bi di puu atam shɛli wahala. Shɛba m-pun di di wahala ka yinim ti lee yɛn di di nyɔri.
en: I have sent you to reap a harvest in a field where you did not work; others worked there, and you profit from their work.

dag: Amaa ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, a ni kariti ma shɛm ŋɔ n-lee bie n-gari a ni niŋ ma shɛm maa gba. Amaa ka Amnɔn daa zaɣis o yɛligu maa wumbu;.
en: Tamar said to Amnon, No! Dont send me away like this. That would be even worse than what you did before! But Amnon refused to listen to Tamar.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti nya Yisa di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, dama o daa pun wum o yɛla ka di wɔɣa, ka bɔri ni o nya o ni o nini, ka daa lan tɛhiri ni di pa shɛli Yisa ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛli ka o nya.
en: For a long time Herod had wanted to see Jesus and was very happy because he finally had this chance. He had heard many things about Jesus and hoped to see him work a miracle.

dag: Yawɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm, ka laɣindi bɛ ni daa kari Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb kpɛhi yɔɣu la na.
en: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem. He brings back the Israelites who were taken as prisoners.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: After Johns messengers were gone, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John. What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A stalk blowing in the wind?.

dag: Man gba ni garigi, Man gba ni yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: So now I will give you my answer. Yes, I will tell you what I think.

dag: O tiri kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb kom, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb bindir suma.
en: He satisfies those who are thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o niriba zaa na nti lo tɔbu ni bɛ chaŋ Kɛila ti teei gili Dauda min o niriba maa niŋ di ni.
en: Saul called all his army together for battle. They prepared to go down to Keilah to attack David and his men.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi mɔɣu polo kanna ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o yura ŋɔ? Apil tia gbini ka n daa neeg a. Nimaani ka a ma daa be n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣ a; nimaani ka ŋun daa dɔɣ a daa be n-wolisira.
en: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.

dag: Amaa bomiya n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa tɔŋsim, ka suhimiya Yawɛ tim li, dama di tɔŋsim puuni ka yi gba ni tɔŋ.
en: Work for the good of the cities where I have made you go as prisoners. Pray to me on their behalf, because if they are prosperous, you will be prosperous too.

dag: Bɛ kul ku tam nandaamba yɛla sahakam; ka faranim tahima niŋbu mi kul ku kpalim yoli sahakam.
en: It may seem that those who are poor and needy have been forgotten, but God will not forget them. He will not leave them without hope.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela n sani kaman tɔbbia ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm la. Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka maa ni tuui lu. Bɛ ku nyaŋ ma. Bɛ ni di vi kara, dama bɛ ku di nasara. Bɛ ni nya filiŋ sahakam, ka di yɛla ka tambu.
en: But you, Lord , are on my side, strong and mighty, and those who persecute me will fail. They will be disgraced forever, because they cannot succeed. Their disgrace will never be forgotten.

dag: Yi mal alibarika saha shɛli niriba yi ti jɛn ya, ka gaŋdi ya, ka turi ya, ka saɣindi yi yuya yɛri ni ninvuɣ biɛri n-nyɛn ya Daadam Bia zuɣu.
en: Happy are you when people hate you, reject you, insult you, and condemn your name as evil because of the Human One.

dag: Miri ka a laɣi suhuyiɣisilinim zɔri, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a mini haliyoyanim laɣim be.
en: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.

dag: Naawuni, kom ni daa nya a, kom maa ni daa shiri nya a, dabiɛm daa gbaai li mi, ka kɔbulli ni daa sɔhira.
en: When the waters saw you, O God, they were afraid, and the depths of the sea trembled.

dag: Yi ŋmari ʒiri n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba suhuri gbarigira, hal n ni bi gbarigir bɛ suhuri maa zaa yoli; ka kpaŋsiri ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba ni ka bɛ bi niŋdi tuuba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.

dag: Zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ di di simdi ni yi nyɛla yi tab sowuhiriba, amaa ka yi ti na bɔrimi ni so n-wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa bɔhimbu piligu ni yɛla. Yi na kul nyurila bihim, ka pa ni bindir maŋli.
en: Although you should have been teachers by now, you need someone to teach you an introduction to the basics about Gods message. You have come to the place where you need milk instead of solid food.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda naa ni Ɛdom naa daa laɣim chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai daba ayopɔin chandi tariga ka kom pooi ba, hal ka shɛli kani ka bɛ tɔbbihi mini bɛ ni daa ʒiri biŋkɔb shɛb chani ni nyu.
en: So King Joram and the kings of Judah and Edom set out. After marching seven days, they ran out of water, and there was none left for the men or the pack animals.

dag: Ka amiliya yilinim maa wain daa ti pooi ba, ka Yisa ma yɛl o, Bɛ lan ka wain din nyura.
en: At the wedding there was not enough wine, so Jesus mother said to him, They have no more wine.

dag: Dindali maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntins anu nim ni ti tɔɣisi Keenannim yɛtɔɣa, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. Ka tinsi maa ni zaɣ yini yuli ni ti boonila Wuntaŋ tiŋa.
en: On that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan and swear loyalty to the LORD of heavenly forces. One of them will be called the city of the sun.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la n-garita.
en: They told him, Jesus the Nazarene is passing by.

dag: Lahibali suŋ din yi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni katiŋ na ŋmanila kɔnyuri ni yi wum nir ka o ti nya komahili la.
en: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: Worship no god but me.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ kul be n sani sahakam, dama o kul bela n nudirigu polo, ka shɛli ku tooi dam ma.
en: I am always aware of the Lord 's presence; he is near, and nothing can shake me.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛb bee nam shɛli din niriba zaɣisi ya jɛmbu, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: Any nation or kingdom that does not serve you will be destroyed.

dag: Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib zuɣu! Dama yi ŋooi baŋsim bɔhimbu dunoli saafɛbia; yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi guri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni soli.
en: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka anabi shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka tɔɣisiri bɛ suhuyubu anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ yɔhiŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ lala niŋbu?.
en: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?.

dag: Tin shɛli nim daa bi tim sandaani n-niŋ Izraɛlnima, naɣila Hivinim bɛn daa be Gibiɔn la kɔŋko. Amaa ka bɛ daa ŋme n-ku bɛn zaa kpalim la tɔb ni.
en: There wasnt one city that made peace with the Israelites, except the Hivites who lived in Gibeon. They captured every single one in battle.

dag: Ka dunia zuliya kam ni be di neesim maa ni chana; ka dunia ŋɔ nanim ni zaŋ bɛ jilima na nti kpe di ni.
en: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri mini alɔbo dɔriti ni daa mali shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka kari alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahi, ka neei zoomba pam gba nina.
en: At that time Jesus was healing many people who were sick or in pain or were troubled by evil spirits, and he was giving sight to a lot of blind people.

dag: Di simdi ka dari maa ti kpalim be adaka maa bansi maa ni, di ti yihiya li.
en: These poles should always stay in the rings of the Box. Dont take the poles out.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti yo ba li bɛ nyɛviya ni, ka bɛ wula ti ku maha.
en: Before their time is up they will wither, wither like a branch and never be green again.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ niŋ kom biɛla tin ya na ka yi paɣi yi naba, ka ʒini tia ŋɔ gbini vuhi.
en: Let a little water be brought so you may wash your feet and refresh yourselves under the tree.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi ti ŋmaai bɔrɔbɔro suɣ ʒiɛri n-zaŋ ti so, ŋuna m-bala. Ka daa ŋmaai bɔrɔbɔro suɣ ʒiɛri n-zaŋ ti Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la.
en: Jesus answered, I will dip this piece of bread in the sauce and give it to the one I was talking about. Then Jesus dipped the bread and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daamiy o bahina. Ka bɛ daa daai Jɛzibɛl bahina, ka o ʒim yiɣ vie dukpini mini yuri, ka bɛ du n-tam o zuɣu n-nɔnno o.
en: Jehu said, Throw Jezebel down! Then the eunuchs threw her down. Some of her blood splashed on the wall and on the horses that trampled her body.

dag: Ka Lidanim mini Sharɔnnim zaa daa nya doo maa, ka niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: All the people living in Lydda and Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

dag: Ka Keen yɛli Yawɛ, N tibidarigibo maa galisiya gari ma.
en: This punishment is too hard! Cain said.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ kpa shɛli din kpalim be o nuu ni maa ʒe ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni n-yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest will put whatever is left of the oil in his hand on the head of the person needing purification, to make reconciliation for them before the LORD.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, lum a niriba bɛn bipuɣinsi zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛha tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la zuɣu. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: The Lord said, Now, mortal man, look at the women among your people who make up predictions. Denounce them.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri yi palo a sani, ka a niŋ ba kaman a ni niŋ ma shɛm n tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu ŋɔ. Dama n ŋuhibu maa yaɣiya; ka n suhu saɣim.
en: Let all their evil come before you. Then injure them like youve injured me because of all my wrong acts; my groans are many, my heart is sick.

dag: Bɛ daa wuh o shihira bɛ sani, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.

dag: Yisa daa wuhi shihira pam o nyaandoliba maa ninni, ka din yɛla bi sabi niŋ litaafi ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.

dag: ka Yaakubu kɔbiliga daa do nimaani. Di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ na ka di ti wum o, ka o chaŋ ti ʒini kɔbiliga maa gbini ni o vuhi.
en: Jacobs well was there. Jesus was tired from his long trip, so he sat down beside the well. It was about noon.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pii dɔbba zali ka bɛ gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam n-sɔɣiri bɛn daa kana ti liri ba maa kpiimba bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ mali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin vihi.
en: Workers will be given a full-time job burying the dead soldiers to make the land pure. The workers will work for seven months. They will go around looking for dead bodies.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bi nɛɔŋ maa ti paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni ŋɔ ka di ku o, ŋuna n-nyɛ bia maa ma.
en: Then the king answered, Give the first woman the living newborn. Dont kill him. She is his mother.

dag: Di saha ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum Izraɛl Naawuni yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la daa laɣim gili ma zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi maa zuɣu. N daa kul ʒimi ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni hal ti paai zaawuni sara maligu saha.
en: I sat there grieving until the time for the evening sacrifice to be offered, and people began to gather around me—all those who were frightened because of what the God of Israel had said about the sins of those who had returned from exile.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirimina ti zani kpe. Ka o dii yiɣisi zani niriba maa ni.
en: Jesus knew their thoughts, so he said to the man with the withered hand, Get up and stand in front of everyone. He got up and stood there.

dag: ka o zaŋ omaŋ wuhi bɛn daa dol o yi Galili chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm la dabisi gbaliŋ. Bɛna n-nyɛ o shɛhiranim niriba sani pumpɔŋɔ.
en: After this, for many days, those who had gone with Jesus from Galilee to Jerusalem saw him. They are now his witnesses to our people.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba dimnim ni daa wum ni bɛn labina maa mɛrila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ duu la.
en: When the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the returned exiles were building a temple for the LORD, the God of Israel.

dag: Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo din kul zoori pahiri Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa baŋbu puuni!.
en: May you have more and more grace and peace through the knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Naa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ niŋ sarika ni, ka tir o bɔrɔbɔro biɛlabiɛla mini kom hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them to put Micaiah in prison. Give him nothing but bread and water to eat. Keep him there until I come home from the battle.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la mini ŋun maŋmaŋ ni mali pin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima binyɛra la zaa nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: He placed in the Temple all the objects his father Abijah had dedicated to God, as well as the gold and silver objects that he himself dedicated.

dag: hal o yi kul sɔɣ o jɛlinsi maa o bilikɔnsi yɛtɔɣa ni, dim maa ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bahi yi palo niriba ni.
en: Everyone will see through those evil plans.

dag: O ni ti mali luɣ kasi shee maa, ka mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka yo maligumaaniba mini niriba maa zaa daalahichi samli.
en: and make the Most Holy Place, the Meeting Tent, and the altar pure. He will also make the priests and all the people pure.

dag: N daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ka yi sanna, ka daa lan chɛ ka ti mabi so pah o zuɣu na. Taitus daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri? Pa biɛhigu yini ka ti mali? Pa so yini ka ti doli?.
en: I begged Titus to go, and I sent the other believer with him. Would you say that Titus took advantage of you? Do not he and I act from the very same motives and behave in the same way?.

dag: di zaa yoli, a ni zaŋ ma bahi daɣiri ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ situra gba zaɣisi ma.
en: God throws me into a pit with filth, and even my clothes are ashamed of me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yɛli zali, ka di ti niŋ. Tinzun wun so na ʒi n-niŋ lala. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi wulinluhili polo m-buɣisi li, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He turned to the west side, seven hundred fifty feet.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ tan tolima anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: They sewed five of them together in one set and did the same with the other five.

dag: Ka tɔrili zaɣ titali so daa lan beni m-mali kpiŋkpan kara, ka mali kɔbiri pam. Nyama, ka yɔɣili maa ŋmaligi di nyaɣa kpa o polo, ka teei di wula kpa o polo ni o niŋ kom yɔɣi li, ka bɛ sibigi li bɛ ni biri li luɣ shɛli maa.
en: There was another eagle with strong wings and thick feathers. The roots and branches of the grapevine soon turned toward this eagle, hoping it would bring water for the soil.

dag: A bɔhiya, N wuntitali maa nyɔri lee nyɛ dini? Ka n ni bi tum alahichi maa, di nyɔri lee nyɛ ma dini.
en: Yet you ask, What does it benefit you? What have I gained by avoiding sin.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa o karimbaani maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa bi lu bɛ zuɣu Hɛzɛkia ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: Finally, however, Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem humbled themselves, and so the Lord did not punish the people until after Hezekiah's death.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa maa, ti ku tooi nya o; o yiko min o yɛlimaŋli galisiya; o nimmaŋtali din galisi zuɣu, o bi zaŋ kiŋkansi doli so.
en: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.

dag: Amaa ka Pita daa garigi yɛl o, A min a liɣiri maa zaa bahim yoli! Dama a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi zaŋ liɣiri da Naawuni pini.
en: Peter said to him, You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!.

dag: Amaa ka aŋgo maa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ʒin ya.
en: But the bridegroom answered, Certainly not! I dont even know you.

dag: ka Inan bia Ahira mi nyɛ Naftali zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Ahira son of Enan was in command of the tribe of Naphtali.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ leei suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: As the Scriptures say, God caused the people to fall asleep. Isaiah : God closed their eyes so that they could not see, and he closed their ears so that they could not hear. This continues until now. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Ɛrastus kpalim bela Kɔrinti; ka n daa chɛ Trɔfimus mi Milɛtus o ni daa ka alaafee zuɣu.
en: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus in Miletus, because he was sick.

dag: Ɛlifaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfi ni Gatam ni Kɛnaz ni Timna ni Amalɛk.
en: Eliphaz was the father of Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka ninsal nuchee daa ti puhi yina n-sabiri sabbu shɛli pari nayili maa dukpini zuɣu m-miri firila ni ʒe luɣ shɛli polo ne viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka naa maa daa nya nuchee maa ni sabiri sabbu maa.
en: Right then the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the kings palace wall in the light of the lamp. The king saw the hand that wrote.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka yi ku ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ʒim yihibu taali ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Then innocent people will not be killed in the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And you will not be guilty for any such deaths.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa ti nyo buɣim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Then you will take the bull selected as the purification offering, and the priests will burn it in a designated place of the temple outside of the sanctuary.

dag: dama ŋunkam nya vuhim Naawuni sani chɛ o tuma ka vuhirimi kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ omaŋmaŋ tuma ka vuhi shɛm la.
en: For those who receive that rest which God promised will rest from their own work, just as God rested from his.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ti ni bo bin gbaliŋ shɛŋa zaa ni ti me jɛmbu duu n-ti a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din yi a nuu ni na, ka nyɛ a ni su shɛli.
en: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Gaad zuliya yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Gad was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn ti kana.
en: All the Books of the Prophets and the Law of Moses told what was going to happen up to the time of John.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni o nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianim maa.
en: Joab saw that the enemy troops would attack him in front and from the rear, so he chose the best of Israel's soldiers and put them in position facing the Syrians.

dag: Yisa ni pun chaŋ ti kpe ti zuɣu la, dama o daa leei maligumaani titali ŋun tuma be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: On our behalf Jesus has gone in there before us and has become a high priest forever, in the priestly order of Melchizedek.

dag: O suhu zaa daa kul yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu zuɣu, ka din pahi nyɛla o daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini Ashɛrim ŋmahima zaa din be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: He took pride in serving the Lord and destroyed all the pagan places of worship and the symbols of the goddess Asherah in Judah.

dag: Dama di yi niŋ daba ayi n ni doli soli chaŋ ka ku lan labina.
en: A number of years will surely pass, and then Ill walk a path that I wont return.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: And Jesus concluded, Listen, then, if you have ears.

dag: Ɛkurɔn mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi gba daa beni Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli daa nyɛla.
en: There was Ekron with its towns and villages.

dag: Ula bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ara mini Hanniɛl ni Rizia.
en: and the descendants of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

dag: So yi ti o kpee dalinli, bɛn niŋm o gba o ni niŋ shɛm maa labisi.
en: And whoever causes an injury to their neighbor must be given the same kind of injury:.

dag: Naa Darius daa pii kpambaliba kɔbiga ni pisi zal o tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni.
en: Darius divided his kingdom into states and placed a governor in charge of each one.

dag: Yi gba mali suhusaɣiŋgu pumpɔŋɔ, amaa n ni ti lan nyan ya yaha, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli, ka so ti ku tooi yihi yi suhupiɛlli maa yi suhuri ni.
en: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.

dag: Maika mabia Ishia bidibisi ni, Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Isshiah was Micahs brother. Isshiahs son was Zechariah.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, dinzuɣu ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo.
en: Human beings were made like God, so whoever murders one of them will be killed by someone else.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Naawuni nam kana ni yiko.
en: Jesus continued, I assure you that some standing here wont die before they see Gods kingdom arrive in power.

dag: A bi nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu?.
en: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli pahi, Yisa ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa neei kum ni ka ti zaa leei di shɛhiranima.
en: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!.

dag: O daa yɛli ba mi, Wummiya n ni sa zahim zahindi shɛli ŋɔ:.
en: Joseph said, I had a dream.

dag: Ka ŋun pah anahi nyɛ Adɔnija. O ma n-daa nyɛ Haggit; ka ŋun pah anu nyɛ Shɛfatia, o ma n-daa nyɛ Abital.
en: the fourth was Adonijah, by Haggith; the fifth was Shephatiah, by Abital.

dag: Bɛ wahala maa puuni ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: So they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and God delivered them from their desperate circumstances.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn namdi tuumbiɛri tumbu, ka wuhiri niriba yikombiɛlim tuma tiŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord said, Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaai Sool zuɣu, ka yeeg o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, ka bahi bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa m-moli lahibali suŋ maa ti bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: The Philistines took things from Sauls body. They took Sauls head and armor. They sent messengers through all their country to tell the news to their false gods and to their people.

dag: Ka Sool bia Jɔnatan daa yiɣisi chaŋ Dauda sani Hɔrɛshi maa nti zaŋ Naawuni yuli kpaŋs o suhu.
en: Jonathan went to him there and encouraged him with assurances of God's protection.

dag: Taai Naa Hiram n-daa bo sida mini sipirɛs dari ni salim shɛli Naa Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o zaŋ tum o tuma maa ti o. Ka Sulemaana mi daa zaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntinsi pisi ti Naa Hiram.
en: King Hiram of Tyre had provided him with all the cedar and pine and with all the gold he wanted for this work. After it was finished, King Solomon gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of Galilee.

dag: Kalim Izraɛlnim kaman sokam min o malibu ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Sabimiya doo kam yuli.
en: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men years and older who are able to fight in battle.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Asahɛl chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti sɔɣ o o ba siliga din daa be nimaani la puuni. Ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa ŋmaligi doli tab yuŋ labi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei, ka bɛ paai Hiburɔn.
en: They took Asahel and buried him in his fathers tomb in Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night. When daylight came, they were in Hebron.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo li buɣim.
en: The Philistines had left their idols at Baal Perazim. David ordered his men to burn the idols.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ti, Yi mi di kul mɛnya yiya bee m-biri bimbira bee n-sa wain tihi bee m-mali dimbɔŋɔnim zaa shɛli. Amaa kul benya suɣa ni yi nyɛvili biɛhigu ni zaa din ni chɛ ka yi ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni be kaman saamba ŋɔ yuui.
en: Also you must never build houses, plant seeds, or plant vineyards. You must never do any of those things. You must live only in tents. If you do that, you will live a long time in the land where you move from place to place.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Duɣu shɛli din zahim, ka di zahimbu maa bi yi. Yaami nimdi maa di puuni yiniyini, ka miri ka a gahinda.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Horror! You bloody city, you corroded pot; pot whose corrosion cant be removed! Empty it piece by piece. She is rejected.

dag: Ka Sool daa chɛ Dauda kari doli ka lab kuli ni o ti tuhi Filistianim maa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani zo n-tiligi tampiŋ.
