en: So Saul stopped chasing David and went to fight the Philistines. That is why people call this place Slippery Rock.

dag: Yilimiya yila pampam paɣi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ!.
en: Shout for joy to God our defender; sing praise to the God of Jacob!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ʒiɛmdila bɛn nya yɛl biɛri, amaa ka di lee mali shili gu bɛn naba bi ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: a torch of contempt to one who is idle, a fixed point for slipping feet.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni di simdi ni yi ku sama.
en: Every seven years you must announce, The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back. Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa chɛ salo maa ka kul o yilikpɛrili. Ka o nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Wuhim ti piriŋkpana din be puu ni la yɛla ŋahili la gbinni.
en: Then Jesus left the people and went into the house. His followers came to him and said, Explain to us the meaning of the story about the weeds in the field.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka ʒiɛnya dɛde yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Benya kaman dɔbba! Maliya yaa!.
en: Stay awake, stand firm in your faith, be brave, be strong.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm mali ba kasi m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋm ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la mihi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ pini bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri zaa, ka paɣi bɛ situra m-mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: This is what you should do to make them clean: Sprinkle the special water from the sin offering on them. This water will make them clean. Then they must shave their bodies and wash their clothes. This will make their bodies clean.

dag: ka zaŋ kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛbih ayopɔin maa zaɣ yini kam zuɣu;.
en: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs.

dag: Niriba yɛri a yurilim maŋli yɛla gballi ni? Bee a ʒiɛyimtali tumdi tuma saɣiŋgu shee?.
en: Is your faithful love proclaimed in the grave, your faithfulness in the underworld?.

dag: Niriba ayi laɣim be so ninvuɣ yino, dama bɛ ni tooi tum bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Two people are better than one. When two people work together, they get more work done.

dag: Cham ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puri ni n-saɣim li, amaa di saɣim di zaa. Ŋmahimi di wula zaa bahi, dama di pala man Yawɛ ni su shɛli.
en: Climb through her vineyards and ravage them, although not completely. Prune back her branches, because they arent the LORDs.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-tiligi amaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: dama a kpe a ʒiʒiinikpee maa nuu ni, cham yomyom ti balim a ʒiʒiinikpee maa.
en: You will be under the power of other people, so you must go and free yourself. Beg them to free you from that debt.

dag: Dama pagɔrili naŋgbampiba malisimi kaman shiri la, ka o yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari kpam.
en: The lips of another man's wife may be as sweet as honey and her kisses as smooth as olive oil.

dag: Sulemaana daa dari yuri la Ijipti mini Silisia. O kɔhigɔriba n-daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomons horses were imported from Egypt and Kue, purchased from Kue by the kings agents at the going price.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa. O daa deei zoya zuɣu tinsi mini Nɛgɛb polo tinsi zaa ni Goshɛn tiŋgbani zaa ni tintan ni tinsi ni Araba ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu tinsi la.
en: Joshua captured all the land—the hill country and foothills, both north and south, all the area of Goshen and the dry country south of it, as well as the Jordan Valley.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Naawuni nol ni na zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: But Jesus answered, The scripture says, Human beings cannot live on bread alone, but need every word that God speaks.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your eye makes you sin, take it out and throw it away. It is better for you to have only one eye and have eternal life than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga kam ŋun mali tarili Izraɛlnim daŋ shɛli puuni, di simdi ni o kulila o yaannim daŋ ni doo, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛl nir kam kul su o yaannim fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi laŋ maa bahi yi ŋariŋ maa nudirigu polo; yi yi niŋ lala yi ni nya shɛli. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-gbahi zahim pam hal nti tarigi laŋ maa vɔbu zahim maa galisim zuɣu.
en: He said, Cast your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some. So they did, and there were so many fish that they couldnt haul in the net.

dag: Jɛrigu ku tooi baŋ li; ka ŋun ka laasabu ku tooi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ma bahi kɔbulli ŋɔ ni, ka m mali hal ti paai teeku ŋɔ puuni kɔtiŋa. Ka kokpɛɣu kul gili n luɣilikam, ka a kɔgban kara la zaa zɔri duri ma garita.
en: You had cast me into the depths in the heart of the seas, and the flood surrounds me. All your strong waves and rushing water passed over me.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni nya bindirigu pam n-di n-tiɣi; ka paɣi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum ya tuun kara maa. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: Now you will have plenty to eat, and be satisfied. You will praise the Lord your God, who has done wonderful things for you. My people will never be despised again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Manaasa zuliya yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Manasseh, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: O daa yɛlila yɛtɔɣa, ka koma din be zuɣusaa gbaai vubu. Ka o daa chɛ ka paɣili yi tiŋgban ni luɣilikam na, ka chɛ ka saanyaɣisibu be saa ni; ŋuna n-daa yihi pɔhim di biɛhigu shee na.
en: At the sound of Gods voice, the heavenly waters roar. God raises the clouds from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain and sends the wind from his treasuries.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Paɣa, a yɛda galisiya pam! Di ni niŋ kaman a ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka o bipuɣiŋga maa daa dii kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Jesus answered, Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want. At that moment her daughter was healed.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn gbihiri kum ni la polo, ka di chɛ ka yi ku fabindi bɛn kpi la zuɣu kaman bɛn ka tahima ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Brothers and sisters, we want you to know about people who have died so that you wont mourn like others who dont have any hope.

dag: Shɛm daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Shɛm ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Aripakishad, yuma ayi din daa doli dunia ŋɔ kom dibu nyaaŋa la.
en: These are the descendants of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was years old, he had a son, Arpachshad.

dag: Ka kuŋ daa ti ŋme yuntisuɣu yɛli, Aŋgo maa paana! Yimiyana ti tuh o soli.
en: But at midnight there was a cry, Look, the groom! Come out to meet him.

dag: amaa n yi tumdi li, hal yi yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, yin niŋmiya n tuma maa yɛda, ka di chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ ka niŋ yɛda ni m Ba be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: But if I do them, and you dont believe me, believe the works so that you can know and recognize that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka piɛgula yino ŋun nyɛ n dabili Dauda guli ba ka dihiri ba. O ni ti dihiri ba ka nyɛ bɛ piɛgula.
en: After that, I will give you a shepherd from the family of my servant King David. All of you, both strong and weak, will have the same shepherd, and he will take good care of you.

dag: Lihimi puu maa ni n-nyari bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam polo chɛra, ka kul doli ba. M pun yɛli n kachɛriba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba maa ni bɛ miri ka bɛ niŋ a shɛli. Ka kɔnyuri yi ti mal a, nyin cham ti tooi bɛ ni ŋɔŋ kom pali kɔduɣ shɛŋa zal la ni nyu.
en: Keep your eyes on the field that they are harvesting and go along after them. Ive ordered the young men not to assault you. Whenever you are thirsty, go to the jugs and drink from what the young men have filled.

dag: Chɛ ka yɛnnim gba wum li, ka nya yɛm pahi, ka leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn woligiri binyara.
en: Even the wise could become wiser by listening to these proverbs. They will gain understanding and learn to solve difficult problems.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe sol ni; ka buŋ maa daa birigi kpe mɔɣu, ka Balaam fiɛb o ni o ŋmalig o lu soli.
en: When the donkey saw the angel standing there holding a sword, it left the road and turned into the fields. Balaam beat the donkey and brought it back onto the road.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛli.
en: Job continued to speak:.

dag: Bɛ daa lo nanim nuhi n-zaŋ ba yili zuɣusaa. Bɛ bi tiri kpamba jilima.
en: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.

dag: Ninni zaɣ yini daa nyɛla ninsal ninni, ka di ŋmaligi kpa abie tia maa ni be shɛli polo. Ka ninni din la mi nyɛ gbuɣim polli ninni, ka ŋmaligi kpa abie tia din la polo. Bɛ daa ŋme ba pala Naawuni jɛmbu duu dukpina zuɣu zaa gili.
en: A human face turned toward one palm tree, and the face of a lion turned toward another. They were carved on the temple all the way around.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Jarib ni Zɛra ni Shaul.
en: Simeons sons were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: I assure you that on the Judgment Day God will show more mercy to the people of Tyre and Sidon than to you!.

dag: Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛli, dina ka n gba yɛra. .
en: even if you gave me all the silver and gold in your palace, I could not disobey the command of the Lord by doing anything of myself. I will say only what the Lord tells me to say.

dag: Ka Miriam daa yiini yila yɛra: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima, ka daai wɔribara min o wɔhu zaa niŋ teeku ni.
en: Miriam sang the refrain back to them: Sing to the LORD, for an overflowing victory! Horse and rider he threw into the sea!.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Miri ka a muɣisi Mɔabnima bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgban shɛli tin ya ka yi su li, n ni pun zaŋ Ar ti Lɔt zuliya la zuɣu. .
en: The Lord said to me, Don't trouble the people of Moab, the descendants of Lot, or start a war against them. I have given them the city of Ar, and I am not going to give you any of their land. .

dag: N lola noli hal ka n duna ti gbarigi, ka n niŋgbuna ti kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: My knees are weak from fasting. I have lost weight and become thin.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zɔri yiriŋ doli solɔri, ka kabiri kpɛri niriba ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa. Bɛ bemi kaman buɣim mokpala la, ka bɛ labiri kpana kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: The chariots race wildly through the streets; they rush back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart like bolts of lightning.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa zaŋ Ahazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔram kaluɣi la n-leei naa zal o ba zaani; dama ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa doli Laribunim maa ka sansani maa ni na daa ku Jɛhɔram bikpamba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa leei Juda naa maa.
en: Some Arabs had led a raid and killed all of King Jehoram's sons except Ahaziah, the youngest. So now the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah king as his father's successor.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, N ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani ni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim alikauli shɛli maa shihirili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: God said, This is the symbol of the covenant that I am drawing up between me and you and every living thing with you, on behalf of every future generation.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa nti kɔŋ gom dindali maa yuŋ. O daa bi di shɛli bee n-saɣi ka so ŋme biŋkumdi shɛli n-niŋ o.
en: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.

dag: Rubin ni daa ti lab bɔɣili maa gbinna nti bi nya Yisifu di ni, o daa darigimi toog o binyɛra.
en: Reuben had been gone, but when he came back to the well, he saw that Joseph was not there. He tore his clothes to show that he was upset.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba maa yi kamina ni bɛ ti bol a, nyin yiɣisim doli ba chaŋ; amaa kul niŋmila n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: That night, God said, Balaam, I'll let you go to Moab with Balak's messengers, but do only what I say.

dag: Malaikanim la daa yɛliya ni bɛ chɛli di tigbirigu la firi tiŋa. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni a ni ti lan lab a nam maa ni na saha shɛli a yi ti baŋ ni Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa fukumsi.
en: The angel ordered the stump to be left in the ground. This means that you will become king again when you acknowledge that God rules all the world.

dag: N daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛli Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa tim ma ka n yi Kadɛshibarinia n-kana ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; ka daa ʒi di lahiba maŋli ti yɛl o.
en: Moses, the Lord s servant, sent me to look at the land where we were going. I was years old at that time. When I came back, I told Moses what I thought about the land.

dag: Dabisa kanna, ka bɛ ni ti duhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli ŋɔ ka di du n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboya. Ka niriba ti daai ka di gbinna.
en: But in the days to come, the mountain of the LORDs house will be the highest of the mountains; it will be lifted above the hills; peoples will stream to it.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o ka o yɛli, Kpe nyɛla dabiɛm zɔbu shee! Kpe nyɛla Naawuni yiŋa. Alizanda dunoli m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Jacob was afraid and said, This is a very great place. This is the house of God. This is the gate to heaven.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so yi be Masia ni, o biɛhigu leela biɛr palli; nyama, ka o biɛr kurili la din gari; ka biɛr palli maa deei di zaani zani.
en: Anyone who is joined to Christ is a new being; the old is gone, the new has come.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku Hɛliɔpolis mini Bubastis nachimba, ka gbahi tinsi maa nim ti leei daba.
en: The elite troops of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.

dag: So daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-viɛli paai Absalom. O daa ka dalinli o napɔnvari ni zaŋ hal ni o zuɣu ni.
en: No man throughout Israel was as praised for his good looks as Absalom. From the soles of his feet to the crown of his head there was nothing wrong with him.

dag: Niriba, niŋmiy o naani sahakam. Yɛlimiy o yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛlikam zaa, Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Trust in God at all times, my people. Tell him all your troubles, for he is our refuge.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab daa baŋ lala ka zaŋ o tahi Siizaria nti chɛ ka o kul o ya Taasus.
en: When the believers found out about this, they took Saul to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus.

dag: Amaa nyin Izraɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, nyin Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ n ni pii so, ka lan nyɛ n zo Ibrahimma zuliya ŋɔ;.
en: The Lord says, You, Israel, are my servant. Jacob, I chose you. You are from the family of my friend, Abraham.

dag: Cheechi maa ni zaŋ dimaŋ ti Masia shɛm la, lala ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣiba gba zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti bɛ yidaannim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: If you have ears, pay attention!.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu shɛli din bɔri ni a niŋ din tuhi ti ma ŋɔ. Wummi n kuhigu ŋɔ; gbilisim a tibili wum man ŋun nyɛ ʒiri ni ka so nol ni ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ.
en: Listen to whats right, LORD; pay attention to my cry! Listen closely to my prayer; its spoken by lips that dont lie!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn darigila Babilɔn naa tibili n-tabil o tiŋgbɔŋ kaman n ni daa darigi Asiria naa tibili shɛm la.
en: So this is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: I will soon punish the king of Babylon and his country as I punished the king of Assyria.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa zuɣu, bɛ suhuri ku zɔhiri bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: Indeed, people shouldnt brood too much over the days of their lives because God gives an answer in their hearts joy.

dag: N kpamd a jaande ni a kul kpalimmi be Ɛfɛsus kaman n ni daa gariti chani Masidɔnia ka yɛl a shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka a kpahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhiri ʒiri wuhibu la zuɣu ni ka bɛ chɛ li.
en: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.

dag: Ka bɛ nini daa mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛri ni o kul kpahim o mi tabili dapulli zuɣu. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ti bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa.
en: The people kept on shouting as loud as they could for Jesus to be put to death.

dag: Ka Sintani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ zahinda la daa chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣa ŋɔ leei bindirigu ka a di.
en: Then the devil came to him and said, If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi biɛhigu shee wɔɣa, ka yi ku tooi zaŋ li chaŋ nimaani, ka di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii tin shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani wɔɣilim maa zuɣu.
en: If the place of worship is too far from your home for you to carry there the tithe of the produce that the Lord has blessed you with, then do this:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? A tizo maa ʒim kukoli kuhigu n-yi tiŋgban ni ka n sanna.
en: The LORD said, What did you do? The voice of your brothers blood is crying to me from the ground.

dag: O daa tuɣindila tulaale zim Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka doli Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔn maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la ni daa tumdi din chihiri shɛl la soli n-zaŋd o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani buɣa.
en: burned incense in Hinnom Valley, and even sacrificed his own sons as burnt offerings to idols, imitating the disgusting practice of the people whom the Lord had driven out of the land as the Israelites advanced.

dag: Hal di wumdi bipala ka bɛ gbarigira, ka di wumdi nachimba ka bɛ lura.
en: Even those who are young grow weak; young people can fall exhausted.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti zaa ni ti kahigi ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi Naawuni.
en: Every one of us, then, will have to give an account to God.

dag: Ka nimmoo tɔb daa bili dindali maa, ka Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Abinɛr mini Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Then a furious battle broke out, and Abner and the Israelites were defeated by David's men.

dag: So yi yu ni o tum Naawuni yubu, o ni baŋ ni wuhibu ŋɔ yila ŋun Naawuni sanna bee m-baŋ ni di nyɛla mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka n wuhiri li.
en: People who really want to do what God wants will know that my teaching comes from God. They will know that this teaching is not my own.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli yaha, M mabihi, n ni maan yɛli ya ti yab Naa Dauda yɛla. O daa kpiya ka bɛ sɔɣ o, ka o gballi na be kpe hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.

dag: Asa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Amaa ka Dauda mabia Shamma dapala Jɔnadab daa yɛli, N dana, di tɛhi ni bɛ ku nabihi maa zaa, Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi. Absalom n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla o ni pun lo shɛli dahin shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔn o tizɔpaɣa Tama la zuɣu.
en: Then David's nephew Jonadab said, Your Majesty, not all of your sons were killed! Only Amnon is dead. On the day that Amnon raped Tamar, Absalom decided to kill him.

dag: Nyini n-zali tɔrili ni o yiɣimi du zuɣusaa katiŋa ka tɛr o tiɛɣu luɣ shɛli din du pam la?.
en: Are you the one who told the eagle to fly high into the sky? Did you tell it to build its nest high in the mountains?.

dag: Tim ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu.
en: Give us today the food we need.

dag: Ka Anduru daa dii chaŋ ti bo n-nya o mabia Saimɔn n-yɛl o, Ti nya Masia la.
en: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, We have found the Messiah! The Hebrew word Messiah means the same as the Greek word Christ.

dag: Niŋm mani a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m be, ka doli a yɛligu.
en: Treat me with kindness, Lord , so that I may live and do what you say.

dag: Ŋun pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ni lan pal alikauli ni bin din galisi. Ŋun mi bi pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ku pal alikauli ni bin din galisi.
en: Whoever is faithful in small matters will be faithful in large ones; whoever is dishonest in small matters will be dishonest in large ones.

dag: Di saha ka Shɛkɛm gba daa yɛli Daina ba min o tizɔdɔbba maa, Yi yi saɣi ti ma, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni yi bɔri shɛlikam.
en: Shechem said to Dinahs father and brothers, If you approve of me, tell me what you want, and I will give it to you.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma ti kpɛhi bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli ŋɔ ni? Ka ŋun n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma tahi Ɛdom?.
en: I wish someone would bring me to a fortified city! I wish someone would lead me to Edom.

dag: Di saha ka dansarika gula maa kuhi yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm firila na, ka o daa guui kpe ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o ni sɔhira, ka o damdi Pool mini Silas tooni.
en: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o, dama o kɔŋko n-nyɛ Jɛrɔbɔam bi so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sɔɣi gballi ni; dama o kɔŋko ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ nini tiɣi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni.
en: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Obɛdɛdom bidibisi. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ mabihi daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim, ka simdi ni bɛ tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Obɛdɛdom daŋ maa ni niriba.
en: Obed Edom's family furnished a total of sixty-two highly qualified men for this work.

dag: Tuumba maa ni daa ti paai Gibia din nyɛ Sool ya la nti yɛli yɛlli maa ka di lu niriba tiba ni, bɛ daa dii duhila kuŋa n-kuhiri pampam.
en: The messengers arrived at Gibeah, where Saul lived, and when they told the news, the people started crying in despair.

dag: Piɛguliba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka zuɣulaannim gba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *.

dag: Kul doliya zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka ti ʒini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: Goodness and Fairness! You must try very hard to be good and fair all the time. Then you will live and keep the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti me timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka me pii tam di zuɣu ka di du hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana n-zali yuli, dama di yi pa lala, ti ni ti wurim gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then the people said, Lets build ourselves a city and a tower that will reach to the sky. Then we will be famous. This will keep us together so that we will not be scattered all over the earth.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma so shɛŋa din kuni nyɛvili shee, ka chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa, n ni be a san la zuɣu. .
en: You have shown me the paths that lead to life, and your presence will fill me with joy.

dag: Sokam daa yul o tuma maa, sokam daa ʒiɛla katiŋa ka yuuni li.
en: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen.

dag: ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni;.
en: They love to sit in places of honor at banquets and in the synagogues.

dag: Teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di puuni vuma, dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni, yilimiya yila.
en: Let the sea and everything in it roar; the world and all its inhabitants too.

dag: Ti sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: We write this in order that our joy may be complete.

dag: Ka naa maa baŋdiba daa kana ti zani, amaa ka so daa ka bɛ ni ŋun ni tooi karim sabbu maa bee n-wuhi di gbinni.
en: Then all the kings sages arrived, but they couldnt read the writing or interpret it for the king.

dag: Ka ŋun daa yɛl o niriba, Nyamiya, Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zooya, ka lan mali yaa gari ti.
en: He said to his people, These Israelites are so numerous and strong that they are a threat to us.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun yɛli, N ni me mmaŋmaŋ yili titali, ka me zuɣusaa du kara, ka niŋ takɔriti niŋ li, ka zaŋ sida dari pa di zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ piɛnta ʒee piɛnti li.
en: He says, Ill build myself a grand palace, with huge upper chambers, ornate windows, cedar paneling, and rich red decor.

dag: Yawɛ soya zaa nyɛla yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali soya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib o daalikauli min o zaligunim sani.
en: With faithfulness and love he leads all who keep his covenant and obey his commands.

dag: N na mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa yi na ku tooi deei li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: I have much more to tell you, but now it would be too much for you to bear.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dii yi Mizipa na n-kar doli Filistianim maa n-kuri ba hal ti miri Bɛtikar.
en: The Israelite soldiers came out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines. They struck them down until they reached a place just below Beth-car.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa to jina naai noli, ka lo Yisa mihi zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: At daybreak, the chief priests—with the elders, legal experts, and the whole Sanhedrin—formed a plan. They bound Jesus, led him away, and turned him over to Pilate.

dag: O doli zaligu soli n-zabiri kpibisi mini pakoya zuɣu, ka yuri saamba, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini situra.
en: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.

dag: Bɛ yuri zɔri gari jɛŋgbina, ka mali suhuyiɣisili gari kunduna bɛn gɔri zaawuni. Ka bɛ yuri ni nyam. Bɛ wɔribariba yila katiŋ na. Bɛ yiɣirimi kaman tɔrili ni yiɣiri yomyom ni o ti to binshɛli shɛm la.
en: Their horses are faster than leopards, fiercer than hungry wolves. Their cavalry troops come riding from distant lands; their horses paw the ground. They come swooping down like eagles attacking their prey.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Hɔr Zoli din daa be Ɛdom tintariga maa gbini.
en: on the Edomite border, the Lord said.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Biŋkɔb kara anahi maa wuhirila nanima anahi bɛn ti yɛn yiɣisi zani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He said, These four huge beasts are four empires which will arise on earth.

dag: A ku tooi zo n-tilig o nuu ni, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag a n-zaŋ a ti ti o. A mini Babilɔn naa maa nini ni ti nya taba, ka a zani o tooni, ka a min o tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kuli Babilɔn.
en: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.

dag: Nyaandoliba bɛn daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya ni na. Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya niriba shɛb daa chaŋ Dauda sani birini la ni.
en: Some Benjaminites and Judahites also came to David at the fortress.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Obɔt.
en: Then the Israelites marched and they camped at Oboth.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii teeg o nuu na n-gbaag o ka bɔh o, Nyin ŋun yɛda pɔri ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a biɛhinda.
en: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt.

dag: Dama bɛ daa bi tooi puhi li di puhibu saha, maligumaaniba bɛn daa mali bɛmaŋ be kasi kalinli ni daa bi paai, ka niriba mi daa bi laɣim Jɛrusalɛm na la zuɣu.
en: They could not celebrate the Passover Festival at the regular time, because not enough priests had made themselves ready for holy service and the people had not gathered in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ pakoya zooya gari teeku noli bihigu. N ku nachimba wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ bɛ manima, ka chɛ ka biɛrim mini dabiɛm lu bɛ zuɣu libigi ba.
en: Their widows will outnumber the sand on the shore. I will bring a destroyer in broad daylight against the mothers of young men. Suddenly I will bring distress and terror upon them.

dag: M mali tahima ti Duuma Yisa sani ni di ku yuui ka n tim Timoti yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: If it is the Lord's will, I hope that I will be able to send Timothy to you soon, so that I may be encouraged by news about you.

dag: Teemiy o ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni kari saria shɛŋa la.
en: Remember the wondrous works he has done, all his marvelous works, and the justice he declared.

dag: Di ni simdi ni shɛli be daadam biɛhigu ni nyɛla ʒiɛyimtali, ka nir yi nyɛ faralana di so ʒiŋmara.
en: People want a friend they can trust. It is better to be poor than to be a liar.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tiligi Izraɛlnim bɛ daalahichi zaa ni.
en: He is the one who will redeem Israel from all its sin.

dag: ti yɛra, Doo ŋɔ wuhirila niriba ni bɛ doli Naawuni zaligu ni bi wuhi shɛm n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: This man is persuading others to worship God unlawfully, they declared.

dag: Dama n ni ti zo ba nambɔɣu bɛ biriginsim puuni, ka ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla hal abada.
en: I will forgive their sins and will no longer remember their wrongs.

dag: So shɛŋa din kuni Ziɔn kumdimi, dama so bi lan kanna ti puhiri churi. Bɛ chɛ o dunɔdaya zaa bahi, ka o maligumaaniba ŋuhira. O paɣisara malila nandahima; o nya naŋgbantom pam.
en: Zions roads are in mourning; no one comes to the festivals. All her gates are deserted. Her priests are groaning, her young women grieving. She is bitter.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ ni yili yila yɛl a tuma yɛla, dama nyin Yawɛ jilima galisiya pam.
en: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.

dag: Amaa man ni yili yila n-yɛl a kpiɔŋ yɛla; n ni duhi n yee n-yili yila asiba n-yɛl a yurilim maŋli yɛla. Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha.
en: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa piri tɔbbihi maa sɔŋ n-gu tɔbu maa. Bɛ daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam dola tiŋ maa nuzaa polo, ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim mi do tiŋ maa wulinluhili polo. Amaa ka Jɔshua daa gbe vinvamli maa ni.
en: The people positioned the main camp on the north side of the city and its rear guard on its west side. That night, Joshua went into the middle of the valley.

dag: Amaa di zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka leei din bie n-gari zuliya shɛŋa mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din gil li zaa ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la.
en: But she rebelled against my case laws and my regulations with greater treachery than these nations and surrounding countries, who also rejected my case laws and didnt follow my regulations.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi tin ya vuhim yi dimnim bɛn gili ya ŋɔ sani tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya ni yi su li maa ni, yin kpihimmiya Amalɛknim maa birili dunia ŋɔ ni, Miriya ka yi ti tam.
en: So once the LORD your God gives you relief from all the enemies that surround you in the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, you must wipe out Amaleks memory from under the heavens. Dont forget this!.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa dɔɣi Lamɛk maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiniinaayi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Lamech was born, Methuselah lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya saha shɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: In times to come your children will ask you, Why did the Lord our God command us to obey all these laws.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim la zali Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: Put the gold altar for burning incense in front of the Covenant Box and hang the curtain at the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛfɛr mini Ishi ni Ɛliɛl ni Aziriɛl ni Jɛrimia ni Hɔdavia ni Jadiɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛn yuya du, ka bɛ daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba.
en: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers.

dag: Binneembihi zaa bɛn mali kpiŋkpama nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani, ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋub ba.
en: Also, all winged insects are off-limits for you. They are not to be eaten.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣ yoya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee tɔɣisi a yɛtɔɣ yoya.
en: You have spoken harshly about me, says the LORD; but you say, What have we spoken about you.

dag: Amaa ka n niriba bɛn tam n yɛla, ka mali binyara nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri binshɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ tuui bɛ so shɛli din nyɛ so kurili maa zuɣu, ka taɣi doli so kpansi, din pa so lɔɣu.
en: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban nɛli ni ni ti kana ti damd o tooni, ka o dimnim mi ti kana ti lu o tooni ka bɛ noya vaai taŋkpaɣu.
en: The peoples of the desert will bow down before him; his enemies will throw themselves to the ground.

dag: O ku deei sandaani sanyoo kam, o mi ku deei birapu, di yi kul galisi kabo.
en: He wont accept compensation; hell refuse even a large bribe.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda Naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba tɔbu ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: But Amaziah would not listen to Jehoashs warning. So King Jehoash of Israel went to fight against King Amaziah of Judah at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

dag: Ka n zaŋ buɣu leei n situra ye, ka bɛ maani ma ansarisi.
en: When I wear sackcloth to show my sorrow, they tell jokes about me.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka anabinim shɛb daa ti yɛli Ilaisha, Nyama, luɣ shɛli ti ni be ka a wuhiri ti ŋɔ pɔri pam.
en: The group of prophets said to Elisha, We are staying in that place over there, but it is too small for us.

dag: Yi yi ka n tooni na ni yi ti jɛm ma, ŋuni n-lee yɛli ya ni yi zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa na? Ŋuni n-lee puhi ya ni yi be n jɛmbu duu n-nɔri ginda?.
en: When you people come to meet with me, you trample everything in my yard. Who told you to do this?.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni, fɔntins anahi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba. Dina n-nyɛ: Gibiɔn mini Gɛba.
en: From the territory of Benjamin they were given four cities: Gibeon, Geba.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ jilima ni yi zahira ka sokam zaa nya li. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala.
en: Then the glory of the Lord will be revealed, and all people will see it. The Lord himself has promised this.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu, hal n ni mali suhukpeeni Masia zuɣu ni n tooi wuh a di ni niŋ kamaata ni a niŋ shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni n ni wurim ba bahi katiŋa, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla;.
en: I thought about it: I could have struck them down, erased them from human memory.

dag: Zaŋmi gbantolima mini dapua m-mali naɣikɔra dapua n-zaŋ pa a nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: This is what the LORD said to me: Make a yoke of straps and bars and wear it on your neck.

dag: Naawuni lo nia ni o zaŋ ashil shɛli din wuhir o daazichi min o jilima pam zaŋ chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim polo n-kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda. Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Masia be yi ni! Dina n-nyɛ yi tahima ni yi min o ni ti laɣim mali Naawuni jilima.
en: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.

dag: Ka Hiburunim bɛn daa pun be Filistianim sani hal ti paai tɔb maa tuhibu saha maa mini bɛn daa pahi doli ba chaŋ bɛ sansani maa ni zaa daa dii ŋmaligi pahi Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zuɣu.
en: Some Hebrews, who had been on the Philistine side and had gone with them to the camp, changed sides again and joined Saul and Jonathan.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira; ka m bi bɔri ni bɛ kuli ni kum, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti tarigi sol ni.
en: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, I feel sorry for these people, because they have been with me for three days and now have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away without feeding them, for they might faint on their way home.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee ko o wain tihi puu ka na bi di di wala? Dilan labimi kul o yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so di di nyaɣisim maa.
en: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.

dag: Riu ni daa dɔɣi Sɛrug maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Reu had more children and died at the age of .

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ti ku mali ninvuɣ so ŋun ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya yi tintariga bɔbili ni nyɛ shɛli Yawɛ niriba sunsuuni.
en: And so you will never again own property among the Lord 's people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia Tapanhɛs maa.
en: The LORDs word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni noli zuɣu, di chɛliya ka kɔr biɛri be yi biɛhigu ni kaman di ni daa be yi ni shɛm yi ni daa na be ʒilinsi puuni la.
en: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ bɛ paɣiba ti shɛba, ka zaŋ bɛ puri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyaŋ ba maa, dama bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa suhu kul yɛla alaha dibu zuɣu. Anabinim zaŋ tabili maligumaaniba zaa bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli.
en: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-su yurilim maŋli. Dama nyini n-tiri sokam zaa o tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: and I am very kind. The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ni ti chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Death is the destiny of all the wicked, of all those who reject God.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani ka o yɛli ba, Suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: When they got there, he told them, Pray that you won't be tested.

dag: Ka bɛ mabihi maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la daa nyɛ bɛn maani bɔrɔbɔro kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani sara Vuhim Dabisili dali kam la.
en: Members of the clan of Kohath were responsible for preparing the sacred bread for the Temple every Sabbath.

dag: Ti saɣindi naŋgbankpeeni mini binshɛɣukam din duhiri dimaŋa ka nyɛ din guri Naawuni baŋsim sol la; ka gbahiri tɛha kam n-niŋdi li fukumsi ni ti chɛ ka di deei Masia noli.
en: and we tear down every proud idea that raises itself against the knowledge of God. We also capture every thought and make it give up and obey Christ.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tabilakpihi daŋ yi tooni nti dim kari Hivinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinima ka chɛ soli tin ya.
en: Ill send insect swarms in front of you and drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites before you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ni kpe binnan shɛŋa zali yɛda, ka yɛli ni binnana maa n-nyɛ bɛ wuna, bɛ ni di vi ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: All who trust in idols, who call images their gods, will be humiliated and disgraced.

dag: A tihi ŋmanila pumpɔrinchihi tihi puu din wandi wal suma din nyɛ hɛnna mini naad.
en: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard.

dag: M pun yɛli ya di yɛla zali ka di wɔɣa pɔi ka di naanyi ti niŋ maa ni di chɛ ka yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi wuna bee yi dari binnana mini anzinfa binnana n-niŋ li.
en: So long ago I told you what would happen. I told you about those things long before they happened. I did this so that you could not say, The gods we made did this. Our idols, our statues, made this happen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa na bi kpe gom, ka Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ ninkura mini bipola zaa daa laɣimna nti teei gili yili maa.
en: Before they went to bed, the men of the city of Sodom—everyone from the youngest to the oldest—surrounded the house.

dag: Nyini n-ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu; ka a sɔŋsim chɛ ka n lee wɔɣirili.
en: Lord, you have given me your shield to protect me. It is your help that has made me great.

dag: Nyini n-fa ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi. Yɛlimaŋli, a duhi ma ka n gari n dimnima; ka yihi ma duŋtaariba nuu ni.
en: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ leei suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: just as the Scriptures say, God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.

dag: N suhu ŋmanila wain koligu din pali wain, ka n yi bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di ni tahi.
en: I feel like a jar of wine that has never been opened. I am like a new wineskin ready to burst.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-yi Hazaɛl takɔbi kubu ni, Jɛhu ŋun kum o; ka ŋun ti zo n-yi Jɛhu takɔbi kubu ni, Ilaisha mi ŋun kum o.
en: Hazael will start killing the people who worship Baal. Jehu will kill those who escape from Hazael, and Elisha will kill those who escape from Jehu.

dag: Paɣimiya Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni, dama o kana ti kaag o niriba ka tiligi ba.
en: Let us praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to the help of his people and has set them free.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan lab pahi buta ti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: He left them and prayed the same prayer once more.

dag: N dimnim kul yɛri ma la zilima dabisili kam puuni; ka bɛn maani ma ansarisi zaŋ n yuli leei turi.
en: All day long my enemies make fun of me; those who mock me curse using my name!.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa lahibali moli gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini tin shɛŋa din gili nimaani zaa.
en: This news about Jesus went out through all the country and the surrounding territory.

dag: Naawuni ti o naa nasara din galisi; ka wuhi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili la polo; zaŋ chaŋ Dauda min o zuliya sani pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You are the one who gives great victories to your king, who shows faithful love to your anointed one— to David and to his descendants forever.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o ti nya Ɛliab ka yɛl o suhu ni, Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni pii so maa n-ʒe o tooni ŋɔ.
en: When Jesse and his sons arrived, Samuel noticed Jesse's oldest son, Eliab. He has to be the one the Lord has chosen, Samuel said to himself.

dag: Abiata ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana saha shɛl la ka ŋun Naa Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li nti ti bɛn daa be o sani la.
en: During the time when Abiathar was high priest, David went into Gods house and ate the bread of the presence, which only the priests were allowed to eat. He also gave bread to those who were with him.

dag: Yinim Galilinim ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee ʒiɛya lihiri zuɣusaa lala? Ka lan yɛli ba, Yisa so yi ni nya ka o yi yi sani chani alizanda ni shɛm maa, lala ka o ti lan yɛn labina.
en: They said, Men from Galilee, why are you standing here looking into the sky? You saw Jesus carried away from you into heaven. He will come back in the same way you saw him go.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun yuri yɛm, amaa bɛn je ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ galimi nyɛla jɛra.
en: Any who love knowledge want to be told when they are wrong. It is stupid to hate being corrected.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula; ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛla pam.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, he saw the large crowd that was like sheep without a shepherd. He felt sorry for the people and started teaching them many things.

dag: Laligim ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la; di nyɛla din kariti niriba Naawuni sani tahiri katiŋa.
en: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Ɛkan, M bia, paɣimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka ti o jilima, ka yɛli ma a ni tum tuun shɛli, ka di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: Achan, Joshua said, the Lord God of Israel has decided that you are guilty. So tell me what you did, and don't try to hide anything.

dag: ka dihi ti nam n-zaŋ ti leei maligumaaniba ni ti jɛmd o Ba Naawuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu, ka simdi ni o su yiko hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba Baalipɛrazim n-nyaŋ ba nimaani ka yɛli, Naawuni n-chɛ ka n kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baalipɛrazim.
en: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood. So he named the place The Lord Broke Through.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi n-laɣim gbaai soli kuni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi soli ha.
en: She left the place where she had been, and her two daughters-in-law went with her. They went along the road to return to the land of Judah.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka saa ku n-zibigi, ka pɔhim gbaai ʒiɛbu, ka sa kurili dii piligi mibu. Ka Ɛhab daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-zo nti kpe Jɛziriil.
en: After a little while, the sky became dark with clouds, and a wind came up with a huge rainstorm. Ahab was already riding on his way to Jezreel.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi dabisa ti nabi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ ti yi yaannim la ni n-yuui nimaani kaman sagbana ni be tiŋgbani zuɣusaa shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Then both you and your children will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised to give to your ancestors. You will live there as long as the skies are above the earth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, ka yi zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, dinzuɣu n ku lan fan ya bahi yaha.
en: But you have gone away from me and served other gods, so I wont rescue you anymore!.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N ni zaŋ n ninkurilim yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka Naawuni ni be a sani! Di simdi ka a zani niriba maa zaani Naawuni sani, ka zaŋdi bɛ naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣa n-sɔŋd o tooni.
en: God will help you if you follow my advice. You should be the one to speak to God for the people.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ nabia Jɔash n-yina ti booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam; ka zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o; ka zaŋ Naawuni kundi ti o; ka bɛ kpahi bɛ nuhi ka yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: Then Jehoiada led Joash out, placed the crown on his head, and gave him a copy of the laws governing kingship. Then Joash was anointed and proclaimed king. The people clapped their hands and shouted, Long live the king.

dag: Jɛshua daa nyɛla Joyakim ba; ka Joyakim nyɛ Ɛliashib ba, ka Ɛliashib nyɛ Joyada ba;.
en: Jeshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim the father of Eliashib, Eliashib the father of Joiada.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣiriba daa wum lala, ka kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o, dama niriba daa yɛliya ni o zuɣu n-lɛbigi.
en: When his family heard about it, they set out to take charge of him, because people were saying, He's gone mad.

dag: Yumakaʒe din garila ka o daa nam ma, mani ka o daa daŋ nambu pɔi ka naanyi nam dunia ŋɔ.
en: I was made in the very beginning, at the first, before the world began.

dag: Yin yɛlimiya ba ni di nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maligu. Dama o ni daa kuri Ijiptinima, o daa yaɣila tinim yiya gari, ka bi ku ti. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋ jɛm Naawuni.
en: you will say, This Passover is to honor the Lord , because when we were in Egypt, he passed over the houses of Israel. He killed the Egyptians, but he saved the people in our houses. Then the people bowed down and worshiped the Lord.

dag: Ka salo maa daa vu m-miri Gomna Pailɛt nti yɛl o ni o niŋmi ka o ni yi pun niŋdi ba shɛm la.
en: The crowd now came and asked Pilate to set a prisoner free, just as he usually did.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui, ka sokam daa zo n-kul o yiŋa. Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama Izraɛlnim tɔbbi tinchandib tuhi pihita ka bɛ daa ku.
en: So the Philistines fought very hard and defeated the Israelites. The Israelite soldiers ran away and went home. It was a terrible defeat for Israel. , Israelite soldiers were killed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: May you receive blessings from the Lord , who made heaven and earth.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi nɔzaɣisibo mini yi daalahichi tumbu zuɣu.
en: In the past you were spiritually dead because of your disobedience and sins.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la biɛr yoli n-daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: Manasseh did what the Lord said was wrong. He followed the terrible and sinful ways of the nations that the Lord had forced out of the land before the Israelites.

dag: Bɛna n-daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba, ka sokam min o tizo daa pihi kuɣu sɔŋ lihi nya jɛmbu duu tuma maa kaman bɛ mabihi Aduna bihi la gba ni daa niŋ shɛm Dauda mini Zadok ni Ahimɛlɛk ni bɛ daŋ ni kpamba ni maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim zaa ninni la.
en: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.

dag: O daa kpihim binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni birili; ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri ni biŋgbamda ni noonsi zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Kulla Nuhu mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni kɔŋko n-daa naɣ tiligi.
en: The Lord destroyed all living beings on the earth—human beings, animals, and birds. The only ones left were Noah and those who were with him in the boat.

dag: Nyin ka n vili gbibi, ka a nudirigu kul gbib ma ka n ku lu.
en: I cling to you, and your hand keeps me safe.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti be bɛ sani. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I could make a home among them. I am the LORD their God.

dag: Di daa sabila Hiburuli ni mini Latinli ni ni Giriikili ni. Ka Yɛhudianim pam daa karim di ni sab shɛm maa, dama bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa daa mirila tiŋ maa.
en: The sign was written in Aramaic, in Latin, and in Greek. Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was nailed to the cross was near the city.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be o sani zaa ŋmaligi guui n-niŋ kaman Ainim nyaŋ ba mi la n-zo n-kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: Then Joshua and all Israel let themselves be beaten before them. They fled in the direction of the desert.

dag: O bɔɣiri nyɛla salima, ka yɛri din viɛli dolibi pir o bɔɣiri maa. O niŋgbuna nyɛlisirimi kaman wɔbinyina mini safaya kuɣa la.
en: His arms are like gold rods, filled with jewels. His body is like smooth ivory with sapphires set in it.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri din viɛla ni nimmoo ni nya jilima, amaa zaɣ biɛɣu chanila ŋun bɔri li sani.
en: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala Yaakubu zuliya ni, ka o ku lan di shɛhira bee n-garigi yɛtɔɣ shɛli bee n-zaŋ pina na ti ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri alahichinim nyuli, amaa kul jɛmmila Yawɛ.
en: Don't be jealous of sinners, but always honor the Lord .

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ba kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni chana, o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ kpi kɔnyuri. O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na ka bɛ nyu.
en: When the Lord led his people through a hot, dry desert, they did not suffer from thirst. He made water come from a rock for them; he split the rock open, and water flowed out.

dag: Bɛnkam doli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ba so shɛli, bɛna n-nyɛ Naawuni bihi.
en: All who are led by Gods Spirit are Gods sons and daughters.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do bɛ lan laa gbini diri bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: The woman said, Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the pieces of food that fall from their masters table.

dag: Ka Musa daa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, niriba ma tum alahichi titali, dama bɛ zaŋla salima mali buɣili.
en: So Moses went back to the Lord and said, Please listen! These people committed a terrible sin and made a god from gold.

dag: Ʒii maa nyabu puuni, n daa nya ka m bela Susa nayili tin shɛli din be vinvamli ni Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka daa lan nya ka n ʒɛla Ulai Mɔɣili noli.
en: in which I was in Susa, the chief city of Babylonia's Elam Province. I was beside the Ulai River.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-nya ka so kpira ka di nyɛla o ni ka situra zuɣu bee ka nandana ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: Whenever I found people suffering because they didnt have clothes or saw a poor man with no coat.

dag: Yuma ayi ka kum ŋɔ na niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di na kpalim yuma anu, ka so ku ko bee n-kpuɣi puu atam.
en: There has already been a famine for two years, and for five more years no one will plow fields or harvest grain.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la daa yi Bahurim kana yomyom ti pahi Judanim maa zuɣu ni bɛ tuhi Naa Dauda soli.
en: Shimei the son of Gera was there with them. He had hurried from Bahurim to meet David. Shimei was from the tribe of Benjamin, and.

dag: N daamiliya, yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Sheemi Amana Zoli zuɣu na. Sheemi Sɛnir mini Hɛrimɔn Zoya din nyɛ gbuɣima mini jɛŋgbina ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu na.
en: Come with me from the Lebanon Mountains, my bride; come with me from Lebanon. Come down from the top of Mount Amana, from Mount Senir and Mount Hermon, where the lions and leopards live.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛlabihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, n gba ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli noli ti a, n gba ni yɛli noli ti ba. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you. I will use you to bless all the people on earth.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darig a tibili kaman a ni daa niŋ shɛm maa, nyin ŋun bi lihi nya pɔri, ka saɣim alikauli ŋɔ.
en: This is what the Lord GOD said: I will treat you like you treated me! You broke your marriage promise. You did not respect our agreement.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni, Naawuni ni ti kari wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri saria, dama o zali yɛlli kam mini tuuni kam saha.
en: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.

dag: Dama naa ni wum n fabila maa ka fa m mini m bia ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔr ni o ku ti n-kpihim ti birili Naawuni ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni la nuu ni bahi.
en: because the king will agree to deliver his servant from the power of anyone who would destroy both me and my son from the inheritance God gave.

dag: Nyamiya, m bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo mini doo maa mam m-bɔŋɔ; chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na pumpɔŋɔ; ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm, amaa di tumiya doo ŋɔ ŋun vi tuun shɛli.
en: Heres my daughter, the young woman, and his secondary wife. Let me send them out, and you can abuse them and do whatever you want to them. But dont do such a disgraceful thing to this man.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o bahi noli ni bɛ niŋmi lala.
en: King Herod was very sad. But he had promised to give the daughter anything she wanted. And the people eating with Herod had heard his promise. So he ordered what she asked to be done.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bee na ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuh o kpee, ka ku ʒini niŋ laasabu nya o ni tooi zaŋ tɔbbihi tuhi pia chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ o kpee ŋun mali tɔbbihi tuhi pisi?.
en: If a king is going to fight against another king, first he will sit down and plan. If he has only , men, he will try to decide if he is able to defeat the other king who has , men.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ ti zaa yinoyino ni nya salima binshɛŋa din nyɛ nuhi ni bansi ni zoligɔnim ni nintuhi din dihiri gbana zuɣu ni tibikpara ni yɛri na ni ti ti mali sara ti daalahichi zuɣu Yawɛ sani.
en: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.

dag: Amaa yi daalahichi n-leei kuɣituurili be yi mini yi Naawuni maa sunsuuni. Yi daalahichi maa zuɣu ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ya, ka ku wum yi suhigu.
en: It is your sins that separate you from your God. He turns away from you when he sees them.

dag: Amaa dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ piɛɣu, dindina ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi na ti ti Yawɛ o ni tum taal shɛli maa zuɣu. Ka yino ti nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ so nyo buɣim mali sara.
en: If you are poor and cannot afford to bring an animal, you may bring two doves or two pigeons. One of these will be a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, and the other will be a sacrifice to please me.

dag: Yinim Aroanima, zanimiya palli noli lihira! Doo bee paɣa yi ti zɔri garita, ka yi bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee niŋ.
en: Stand by the roads and watch, you inhabitants of Aroer. Ask the men who flee and the women who run off, Whats happened.

dag: Yinim bɛn be dabitim ni ka mali tahima pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, labimiya yi birini ni na. N yɛri ya mi, n ni niŋ alibarika ʒii buyi zuɣu niŋ yi ni.
en: Return, you exiles who now have hope; return to your place of safety. Now I tell you that I will repay you twice over with blessing for all you have suffered.

dag: Zaŋmiya Alikauli Adaka la zali di puuni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili limsi li.
en: Place in it the Covenant Box containing the Ten Commandments and put the curtain in front of it.

dag: A paɣiba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a nayili bihi bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni wumd a yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: How fortunate are your wives! And how fortunate your servants, who are always in your presence and are privileged to hear your wise sayings!.

dag: Shɛb daa ʒila zibisim mini bumbɔn ni, ka nyɛ sarikanima, ka bɛ ba ba bandi ʒili ka bɛ diri wahala.
en: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains.

dag: A bɔɣu nyɛla din mali kpiɔŋ; a nuu maa shiri mali kpiɔŋ, di bamdi a nudirigu.
en: How powerful you are! How great is your strength!.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa lan tum tuun biɛ shɛli pahi; dina n-nyɛ o ni daa gbaai Jɔn kpɛhi duu la.
en: So Herod added another bad thing to all his other wrongs: He put John in jail.

dag: Dunia ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la, ka Naawuni daa pun pii ti leeg o niriba Masia zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi ka ka galimi ŋun Naawuni sani. Naawuni yurilim zuɣu.
en: God chose us in Christ to be holy and blameless in Gods presence before the creation of the world.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa gun o bia Ishimail mini bɛ ni daa dɔɣi dab bidib shɛb o yiŋa bee o ni daa zaŋ o liɣiri da shɛba. Doo kam ŋun daa be Ibrahimma yiŋa, o daa guni ba dindali maa kaman Naawuni ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: On that same day Abraham obeyed God by circumcising Ishmael. Abraham was also circumcised, and so were all the other men and boys in his household, including his servants and slaves. He was years old at the time, and his son Ishmael was .

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila yɛndaan so ŋun daa me o yili tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: Everybody who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise builder who built a house on bedrock.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu, ka garigi ma, dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana.
en: Listen to me, Lord , and answer me, for I am helpless and weak.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ ni gbib buɣim kana. O chɛchɛbunsi yuri zɔbu yɛn ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o zaŋ li kana ti darig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu tibili.
en: The Lord will come with fire. He will ride on the wings of a storm to punish those he is angry with.

dag: Yawɛ tim o niriba kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka ti ba suhudoo.
en: The Lord gives strength to his people and blesses them with peace.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa yuri tinzun paɣiba pam. O ni daa kpuɣi Ijipti Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la nyaaŋa, o daa lan kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba mini Ammɔn paɣiba ni Hiti paɣiba ni Sidɔn paɣiba ni Ɛdom paɣiba.
en: In addition to Pharaohs daughter, King Solomon loved many foreign women, including Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites.

dag: Nashɔn daa nyɛla Salima ba, ka Salima daa nyɛ Bɔaz ba.
en: Nahshon was the father of Salma, Salma was the father of Boaz.

dag: Jɔab mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa ni daa kuna ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Nɛr bia Abinɛr la kala naa sanna ka o bah o ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: Right after they arrived, someone told Joab, Abner visited the king, and the king let him go. Abner even left without causing any trouble.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ n di domi baalim; ŋ-ŋɔ n di gbihiya; di nyaaŋa ka n di vuhi.
en: For now I would be lying down quietly; Id sleep; rest would be mine.

dag: A yi ti ba bindirigu maa, bɛ laɣisiri li mi sɔŋ. A yi teeg a nuu, bɛ nyarila binsuŋ kam tiɣi.
en: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma ka n sabi li shɛm. O daa kahigi tuma maa zaa ni yɛn tum shɛm wuhi ma.
en: King David said, All this is contained in the plan written according to the instructions which the Lord himself gave me to carry out.

dag: Lɔɣimi li, di doli li, ŋmaligim chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ: kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim ni tammɛriba, ka da dari mini kuɣ bɔɣa din yɛn zaŋ mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: the carpenters, the builders, and the masons, and buy the timber and the stones used in the repairs.

dag: Binshɛɣukam ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla n dini, bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi yi bidib shɛb zaa mini yi niɣi ni yi piɛri ni tuui dɔɣi naɣila shɛb ni piɛla shɛb zaa nyɛla n dini.
en: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Chɛliya ka yi ni shɛb lo kpara n-chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannima m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti Yawɛ.
en: Moses spoke to the people: Equip some of your men for battle so that they may go against Midian and execute the LORDs just punishment against Midian.

dag: Hal ti ni daa paai Masidɔnia ti niŋgbuna daa bi nya vuhim baabiɛla. Ti daa nya wahala shɛlikam ni: Zabili daa yiri kpaŋ na, ka dabiɛm be ti suhuri ni.
en: When we came into Macedonia, we had no rest. We found trouble all around us. We had fighting on the outside and fear on the inside.

dag: Ka o daa be mɔɣu maa ni biɛɣ pihinahi, ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-daa be mɔɣu maa ni, ka malaikanim daa kanna nti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: where he stayed forty days, being tempted by Satan. Wild animals were there also, but angels came and helped him.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni o ni bi zaɣisi n suhigu maa zuɣu, bee o ni bi vuui o yurilim maŋli ka chɛ ma la zuɣu.
en: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.

dag: ka yɛli di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N je a yɛlli, n ni ŋooi n takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni.
en: Say to Israels fertile land, The LORD proclaims: Im now against you! I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off both the righteous and the wicked from you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bibihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa nya lala ka tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: Some people brought their small children to Jesus so that he could lay his hands on them to bless them. But when the followers saw this, they told the people not to do this.

dag: Chɛli sujee mini suhuyiɣisili. Chɛli suhuyiɣisili, dama di nyɛla din kpɛhiri nir zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Let go of anger and leave rage behind! Dont get upset—it will only lead to evil.

dag: ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ na kpalim ʒiɛya. Di saha maa ka dɔbba ayi bɛn daa ye binyɛr nyɛlisira dii puhi zani paɣiba maa sani.
en: and they did not know what to think. Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhuri ye Naawuni zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ Naawuni bɔbu milinsi maa lee bi doli soli.
en: I can say this about them: They really try hard to follow God, but they dont know the right way.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o ba yiŋ Ofira nti ku o ba bihi ninvuɣ pisopɔin bɛn nyɛ Gidiɔn bidibisi la tampin yini zuɣu. Amaa ka Jɔtam ŋun daa nyɛ Gidiɔn kaluɣ la ŋun daa sɔɣi, ka bɛ bi nya o ku o.
en: He went to his household in Ophrah and killed all seventy of his brothers, Jerubbaals sons, on a single stone. Only Jotham the youngest of Jerubbaals sons survived, because he had hidden himself.

dag: Jarɛd ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiyɔbunaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Inok.
en: When Jared was years old, he became the father of Enoch.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi tɔŋ pam yi bihi dɔɣibu ni mini yi biŋkɔbiri dɔɣibu ni ni yi puri atam ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: And the Lord will give you many good things. He will give you many children. He will give your cows many calves. He will give you a good harvest in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors to give you.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri naa nam dibu yuma ayopɔin la ni gol so ŋun pahir anu ni ka o daa paai Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.

dag: Yawɛ, n nyɛla a dabili. N nyɛla a dab bipuɣiŋga bia. A kabisi m bandi.
en: Lord , I am your servant! Yes, I am your slave, as my mother was. You set me free from the chains of death.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin maa ni yino kana nti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun du n-ʒi kulisi koma zuɣu ŋɔ saria karibu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came to me and said, Come, and I will show you how the famous prostitute is to be punished, that great city that is built near many rivers.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ nini kul mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛra, O piligila o wuhibu maa Galili n-wuhi li Judia tinsi zaa ni zaŋna hal ti paai kpe, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba taari duŋ.
en: But they kept on saying, His teaching is causing trouble all over Judea. He began in Galilee, and now he is here.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yomyom ti yɛli ba, N tum taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani ni yi gba sani.
en: Pharaoh called urgently for Moses and Aaron and said, Ive sinned against the LORD your God and against you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naaman kɔŋ maa ni lu a min a bihi zuɣu n-kul maliya sahakam! Ka Gɛhaazi daa ŋmalig o sani n-yi ni kɔŋa; ka o niŋgbuna dii paligi laɣilaɣi kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: Now you and your children will catch Naamans disease. You will have leprosy forever! When Gehazi left Elisha, his skin was as white as snow! He was sick with leprosy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ŋɔ, pa ninsal wuhibu ka o zaɣisi, amaa Naawuni ŋun ti ti o Shia Kasi la wuhibu ka o zaɣisi maa.
en: Therefore, whoever rejects these instructions isnt rejecting a human authority. They are rejecting God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni, Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n yuli ni yɛn be sahakam la.
en: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods.

dag: Ka o yi wurim binshɛli, so ku tooi lan me li zali. O yi kpɛhi so duu, so ku tooi yooi dilan bahi.
en: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, man Rut m-bala. Kpuɣim ma leeg a paɣa, dama a nyɛla n dɔɣira ŋun ni tooi gbib ma.
en: Who are you? he asked. She replied, Im Ruth your servant. Spread out your robe over your servant, because you are a redeemer.

dag: Di tuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi n-garigi, ka chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpe m-pali ba?.
en: Will the wise respond with windy knowledge and fill their belly with the east wind?.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lab o naɣikɔra maa sani nti zaŋ ba kɔrigi, ka zaŋ bɛ dapuhi m-mali buɣim duɣi ba n-zaŋ ti niriba ka bɛ ŋubi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti doli Ilaija n-sɔŋd o.
en: Elisha turned away from him and went back. He killed the oxen and used the yoke for firewood. He boiled the meat, gave it to the people, and they all ate together. Then Elisha went to follow Elijah and became his helper.

dag: Ka o yiŋbihi maa daa yi n-doli solɔri maa laɣim bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb zaa na; ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma hal ka amiliya lɔbu duu maa ti tiɣi salo.
en: They went out on the streets and brought in everyone they could find, good and bad alike. And the banquet room was filled with guests.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Zaŋm tɔbbihi zaa yiɣisi chaŋ Ai; nyama, n zaŋ Ai naa min o niriba ni o tiŋ maa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, Dont be afraid or terrified. Take the entire army with you. Start to go up to Ai. Look! I have given the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land into your power.

dag: Hal di wumdi bipala ka bɛ gbarigira, ka di wumdi nachimba ka bɛ lura.
en: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya biɛɣu mini mɔɣilo paɣ o.
en: Praise him with trumpets. Praise him with harps and lyres.

dag: N naan shiri yiɣi chaŋ katiŋa nti be mɔɣu ni.
en: I would go and live in some distant desert.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbani ni la dina. Di zaa yoli, Asa daa kul ʒiɛla yim o biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: Asa did not destroy the high places, even though he was faithful to God all his life.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina shee n zuɣu, ka m puhiri ba pam di zuɣu, ka di pala n kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim cheechinim zaa gba puhiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti paai, ka tiŋ maa zaa damna ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: On the next Sabbath, almost everyone in the city gathered to hear the Lords word.

dag: Tulaale mini tulaalɛzim nyɛla din paligiri suhu, amaa yɛlimuɣisirili nyɛla din kabiri suhu.
en: Oil and incense make the heart glad, and the sweetness of friends comes from their advice.

dag: hal ti paai palo din be dunoli zuɣusaa hal ni puuni duu la ni ni di samban ni. Ka bɛ ŋme binyara pa puuni duu maa dukpina zaa zuɣu mini di sunsuuni zaa ti gili.
en: The inside walls of the Temple, up as high as above the doors, were completely covered with carvings.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti labi me tiŋ maa ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi li la Hananɛl Du wɔɣinli la shee hal ti paai Gooŋgɔŋ Dunɔdal la shee.
en: The time is coming, says the Lord , when all of Jerusalem will be rebuilt as my city, from Hananel Tower west to the Corner Gate.

dag: Di saha ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli naa Bɔ n-niŋ ka ba kpiŋ ŋɔ doli yɛri n dan naa zilima lala? Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, Why should this dying dog curse you, my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off Shimeis head.

dag: Amaa saha ni daa ti paai, Naawuni daa tim o Bia na n-chɛ ka paɣ dɔɣ o fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni.
en: But when the fulfillment of the time came, God sent his Son, born through a woman, and born under the Law.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu maa daa nya yiko n-tɔɣisiri duhimaŋtali mini Naawuni mɔbu yɛtɔɣa, ka mali soli ni o wuh o fukumsi yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm chira pihinahinaayi.
en: The beast was given a mouth that spoke boastful and blasphemous things, and it was given authority to act for forty-two months.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb Jeemsi ni daa tim la ni daa na bi paana, Pita mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim daa laɣindimi timdi dira, amaa ka bɛ daa ti paana, ka o yaag omaŋa bɛ ni n-woligi ka chɛ ba, dama o daa zɔrila bɛn kpaŋsiri gunibu yɛla.
en: He had been eating with the Gentiles before certain people came from James. But when they came, he began to back out and separate himself, because he was afraid of the people who promoted circumcision.

dag: Yi zaa laɣim ʒiɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Yi daŋ ni kpamba mini yi zuɣulaannim ni yi sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa.
en: Today you are standing in the presence of the Lord your God, all of you—your leaders and officials, your men.

dag: Ka n wum damli shɛli binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni kaman kukol la ka di yɛra, Alikama lita yini nyɛla tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri, ka chi lita ata mi nyɛ tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri; amaa di niŋ kpam mini wain shɛli.
en: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.

dag: Amaa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛb bahi ni bɛ maani wain tihi, ka kɔra.
en: Only the very poorest were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.

dag: Yino daa bela adaka yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ yini polo, ka yino la mi be yaɣ din la polo. O daa kuri ba tabili la adaka yɔrigu maa, ka bɛ mini li nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: one for each end of the lid. He made them so that they formed one piece with the lid.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, o kul kumdila pampam, ka nintam zo n-tiɛl o kparima. O mamanim la zaa so lan kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. O zɔnim zaa yila o nyaaŋa; bɛ leela o dimnima.
en: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo maa na zuɣu ka bɛ kpi.
en: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men.

dag: Yawɛ, n nya wahala pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la.
en: My sufferings, Lord , are terrible indeed; keep me alive, as you have promised.

dag: N naan bo sɔɣibu shee yomyom, ka pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ku tooi paai ma.
en: Id hurry to my hideout, far from the rushing wind and storm.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ yi alahichi ni, ka paɣi bɛ binyɛra, ka Aduna daa zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la zali Yawɛ tooni, ka mali sara ti ba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu m-mali ba kasi.
en: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron dedicated them as a special gift to the Lord . He also performed the ritual of purification for them.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa na.
en: Jesus answered, You faithless and crooked generation, how long will I be with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.

dag: Di saha ka paɣiba maa daa lan kum pam. Ka Opa ŋun daa chɛbisi Naomi ka ŋmaligi kuli, amaa ka Rut ŋun zaɣisi ka kul doli Naomi.
en: They cried again. Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth held on to her.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. O chɛ ka o neesim paai ti. Ŋahimiya tihi vari ka ti di chuɣu puhibu dari n-chaŋ ti gili sara maligu bimbini.
en: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.

dag: So yi yu ni o tum Naawuni yubu, o ni baŋ ni wuhibu ŋɔ yila ŋun Naawuni sanna bee m-baŋ ni di nyɛla mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka n wuhiri li.
en: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a pala ŋun pun nyɛ ti naa la, ka lan niŋ ti kaman ti pun pala a niriba la.
en: For too long we have been like those you dont rule, like those not known by your name.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piri tɔbbihi maa ʒii buta zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Jɔab su yim zuɣu, ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab tizo la su yim zuɣu, ka Itai Gaat nir la mi daa su bɛn kpalim la. Ka naa daa yɛli niriba maa, Mmaŋmaŋ gba ni yina pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: He sent out one third of his army under the command of Joab, another third under the command of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, and the rest under the command of Ittai from Gath. He told the soldiers, I'm going into battle with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yi Mɔab bɔpiɛligu maa ni n-du Nɛbo Zoli nti paai Pisiga Zo shɛli din be Jɛriko tooni polo la zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa wuh o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa, zaŋ Giliad hal ni Dan.
en: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Mount Pisgah east of Jericho, and there the Lord showed him the whole land: the territory of Gilead as far north as the town of Dan;.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka doo maa bo piɛlaa ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti mali taali sanyoo sara.
en: The man must bring his guilt offering to the Lord at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. He must bring a ram for a guilt offering.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana, Nyama, Adɔnija zɔrila nyin Naa Sulemaana, dama nyama, o gbaala sara maligu bimbini bin yila la gbibi ka yɛra, Faashee Naa Sulemaana daŋ po pɔri yɛli ma ni o ku ku man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ. .
en: Then someone told Solomon, Adonijah is afraid of you, King Solomon. He is at the Holy Tent holding onto the horns of the altar, and he refuses to leave. Adonijah says, Tell King Solomon to promise that he will not kill me.

dag: Yinim ninsalinima, saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi kul yɛn dihiri ma vi? Saha yuusim wula puuni, ka yi kul yɛn yuri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka doli din nyɛ ʒiri?.
en: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.

dag: di simdi ni nir zaŋ o tapaɣa ti ka bɛ ŋme o, ka tu o.
en: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.

dag: Miriya ka yi di ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndi yi kpee.
en: Do not accuse anyone falsely.

dag: Ka anab maa daa bo tani n-lo o nini n-taɣ o biɛhigu ŋ-ŋmaligi yi sol ni ti ʒiɛya guhiri naa.
en: So the prophet wrapped his face with a cloth. This way no one could see who he was. The prophet went and waited for the king by the road.

dag: Dama ti wumya ni ninvuɣ shɛb be yi ni n-nyɛ ʒinahigunima ka je ni bɛ tum shɛli, ka bɛ tuma naɣ kul nyɛla dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni kɔŋko.
en: We say this because we hear that there are some people among you who live lazy lives and who do nothing except meddle in other people's business.

dag: N ʒiɛyimtali mini n yurilim maŋli kul ni be o ni; ka o ni di nasara n yuli zuɣu.
