en: My faithfulness and my loyal love will be with him. He will be strengthened by my name.

dag: O ni daa kari ninsal yihi Idɛn puu maa ni maa, o daa zaŋla chɛrubinim mini takɔbi din nyɛ buɣim niɛm ka ŋmaligiri luɣilikam zali Idɛn puu maa wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ gu so shɛli din chani ti shɛli din tiri nyɛvil maa gbini.
en: Then at the east side of the garden he put living creatures and a flaming sword which turned in all directions. This was to keep anyone from coming near the tree that gives life.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi ni be hal ti kurigi n-kpi ni suhudoo, ka bɛ sɔɣ a.
en: You yourself will live to be very old. You will die in peace and will be buried with your family.

dag: Wuhim ma n ni bi nyari shɛli, di yi nyɛla n tumla tuumbiɛri, n ku lan tum lala yaha?.
en: Show me the sins I am not able to see. If I have done wrong, I will not do it again.

dag: ka di ʒiɛmya anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: Dont brush off Spirit-inspired messages.

dag: Dinzuɣu paɣ maa ni daa nya ka tia maa wala lihibu mali kɔre, ka viɛl ni dibu, ka lan nyɛ ti shɛli din ni ti nir baŋsim maa, ka o pɔhigi li di, ka zaŋ di shɛli ti ti o yidana, ka o gba di.
en: The woman saw how beautiful the tree was and how good its fruit would be to eat, and she thought how wonderful it would be to become wise. So she took some of the fruit and ate it. Then she gave some to her husband, and he also ate it.

dag: Bɛ ni bi tum ʒiɛyimtali tuma maa zuɣu n ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will turn the land into a ruin because they acted faithlessly, proclaims the LORD God.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ti n yidan la zuɣu, Naawuni deei n suhigu; ka boli bia maa yuli Isaka.
en: She said, God has given me a reward because I gave my slave to my husband. So she named her son Issachar.

dag: Naɣilabil tuuli jilima nyɛla o dini. O yila nyɛla yɔnahu yila. Dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ʒe niriba n-kari ba ti bahi dunia tarisi. Bɛna n-nyɛ Ifriim zuliya niriba tuhi pia; bɛna n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya niriba tusa shɛm la.
en: Joseph is like a powerful bull. His two sons are like bulls horns. They will attack other people and push them to the ends of the earth! Yes, Manasseh has thousands of people, and Ephraim has ten thousands.

dag: A ko pin titali zali amaŋa, ka me binshɛŋa din dundu zal amaŋa niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam.
en: you built a pavilion for yourself and set up platforms in every square.

dag: Yawɛ dimnim ni chɛrisichɛrisi. Zallakudura Naa ni be alizanda ni ka tahi bɛ zuɣu na. Yawɛ ni kari dunia ŋɔ nim zaa saria. O ni ti o naa yaa, ka ti o ninvuɣ gahindili yiko.
en: The Lord destroys his enemies. God Most High will thunder in heaven against people. The Lord will judge even the lands that are far away. He will give power to his king. He will make his chosen king strong.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin dali. Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka yi puhiri Yawɛ chuɣu maa.
en: For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast, and on the seventh day you are to celebrate a festival in honor of the Lord .

dag: Ka din nyari niriba taali yi mali jilima ŋɔ tatabo, dindina din chɛ ka niriba yiri taali ni shiri ni mali jilima gari lala.
en: If the ministry that brought condemnation has glory, how much more glorious is the ministry that brings righteousness?.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti chɛ ka dimdi kpe Abimilɛk mini Shɛkɛmnim sunsuuni, ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa.
en: Then God stirred up ill will between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem, and they acted like traitors toward Abimelech.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ m biɛhigu shee maa zali kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Then set up the dwelling according to the plan for it that you were shown on the mountain.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa yi n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa saɣi Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm ni yɛli shɛm maa; ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa yi n-chaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa guni.
en: All the citizens of the city agreed with what Hamor and Shechem proposed, and all the males were circumcised.

dag: Yihim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa yi biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ ku ta bɛ biɛhigu shee din nyɛ n ni be bɛ sani luɣ shɛli maa daɣiri.
en: Whether they are a man or a woman, send them away so that the camp where I am living among you will not be made unclean.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa niŋ yomyom bo luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn zani kum, dama o suhu n-daa palig o tizo maa zuɣu ti yaɣi. O daa kpɛla o duu puuni ti kum.
en: Then Joseph left suddenly, because his heart was full of tender feelings for his brother. He was about to break down, so he went to his room and cried.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lar o. Amaa ka o daa kari bɛ zaa yihi, ka zaŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma pahi bɛn daa be o san la zuɣu kpe bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa do du shɛli ni maa.
en: But the people laughed at him. After Jesus had sent them all out of the house, he took the girl's father and mother and his three disciples and went to where she was.

dag: Ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa Bɛtihɔrɔn polo, ka yim zuɣu la mi daa zaŋ kpa tintariga luɣ shɛli nir ni ni zani lihi bahi tin shɛli din yuli booni Zɛbɔiim la zolɔŋ din be mɔɣu ni la polo.
en: Another took the road to Beth-horon, and the last took the border road that overlooks the Zeboim Valley toward the desert.

dag: O chɛ ka a dunokparitisi mali kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.

dag: Ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, pa lala n-nyɛ li. So n-yi di neei kum ni chaŋ bɛ sani nti yɛli ba, bɛ naan niŋ tuuba.
en: Then the rich man said, No, that's not enough! If only someone from the dead would go to them, they would listen and turn to God.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: But the pagan places of worship were not destroyed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

dag: A puli ni fahiri ka a puuni biɛri waawaayili la zuɣu, di lan nyuri kom kɔŋko, amaa nyum wain biɛlabiɛla pahira.
en: Dont drink water anymore, but use a little wine because of your stomach problems and your frequent illnesses.

dag: Masia maŋmaŋ ni lo alikauli ni o ti ti shɛli nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: And this is what the Son promised us—eternal life.

dag: Ka a zaŋ a noli yɛtɔɣa duhiri amaŋa n-niŋdi ma, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa pam jɛndiri ma, n wum li.
en: I have heard the wild, boastful way you have talked against me.

dag: Bihi nyɛla pini din yi Yawɛ sanna. Bihi nyɛla bidɔɣibo laara din yi Yawɛ sanna.
en: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord .

dag: Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka be Tiriza.
en: When Baasha heard about these attacks, he stopped building up Ramah and went back to Tirzah.

dag: Paɣ so a ni daa nya maa ni nyɛla tin tital shɛli din su dunia nanim zaa yiko.
en: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.

dag: Bɛ kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbani maa ti, ka sana daa bi gari bɛ ni.
en: These are important people in our country! Everyone knows who they are.

dag: Malaika so ŋun daa yihi ma yɛl biɛri ni la, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni! Naawuni chɛ ka bihi ŋɔ zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mini n yab Ibrahimma ni m ba Yisahaku yuya ku kpi! Naawuni tim ba bihi pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi.
en: May the angel, who has rescued me from all harm, bless them! May my name and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac live on through these boys! May they have many children, many descendants.

dag: M mi ni a ni tooi niŋ binshɛɣukam, ka so ku tooi yiɣisi a ni lo ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: I know, Lord , that you are all-powerful; that you can do everything you want.

dag: Yino ni ti nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi chi sara zuɣu, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli Yawɛ sani.
en: He must offer one of these birds as a sin offering and the other bird as a burnt offering. He must offer the birds with the grain offering. In this way the priest will make that person pure before the Lord , and that person will become clean.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kɔral bee kirisital la buɣisi li. Yɛm liɣiri gari yɛri liɣiri.
en: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.

dag: dama ti bidibbina pala dunia ŋɔ bidibbina, amaa di nyɛla din mali Naawuni yiko di ni, ka daari tinsi goon kara luhira.
en: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa mini Samarianim zaa ni nya li. Amaa bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ duhimaŋtali zuɣu, bɛ ni yɛli.
en: the people all knew it— Ephraim and the one who rules in Samaria. But with a proud and arrogant heart they said.

dag: Ka Juda maa daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia, ka Yaakubu nyɛ Yisahaku bia, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Ibrahimma bia, ka Ibrahimma nyɛ Tɛra bia, ka Tɛra mi nyɛ Nahɔr bia.
en: Judah was the son of Jacob. Jacob was the son of Isaac. Isaac was the son of Abraham. Abraham was the son of Terah. Terah was the son of Nahor.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi chana, ka dabiɛm gbaai tiŋ shɛŋa din daa gili ba nim pam, ka bɛ daa bi kari doli Yaakubu bihi maa.
en: When Jacob and his sons started to leave, great fear fell on the people of the nearby towns, and they did not pursue them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord said to Moses:.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n yiŋa daa yɛra, Bɛnkam kpe yili ŋɔ na dirimi tiɣira.
en: No one ever went hungry at my house.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa bol o bi so Zara ni dɔɣi ti o maa yuli Yisahaku.
en: Abraham named him Isaac.

dag: Ka do so yi mali bidibiga ŋun nyɛ tipawumlilana ŋun bi deer o ba min o ma noli, ka bɛ yi darig o tibili o ni bi deeri bɛ yɛligu zuɣu.
en: Suppose someone has a son who is stubborn and rebellious, a son who will not obey his parents, even though they punish him.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka Naa Jɔash mini niriba lo Yawɛ alikauli ni bɛ ni nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ niriba; ka lan chɛ ka niriba maa mini naa gba lo tab alikauli.
en: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord .

dag: Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o.
en: Look, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Human One will be handed over to the chief priests and legal experts. They will condemn him to death.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa kpila yɛda niŋbu puuni ka na bi nya Naawuni ni daa lo ba binshɛŋa alikauli maa, amaa ka daa lee lihi nya li katiŋ ha, ka dee li ni suhupiɛlli, ka saɣi ni bɛ nyɛla saamba ni tinzunnima dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: All these people died in faith without receiving the promises, but they saw the promises from a distance and welcomed them. They confessed that they were strangers and immigrants on earth.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, ka tiŋ maa nim nya ka sɔɣ li ka bi ku o.
en: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka naa maa paag o sanna ti yɛl o, Ti muɣisigu ŋɔ yila Yawɛ sanna! Ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan yɛn guhi ŋun Yawɛ yaha.
en: While Elisha was still talking with the elders, the messenger came to him. This was the message: This trouble has come from the Lord . Why should I wait for the Lord any longer.

dag: Amaa Siria naa ŋɔ bihi ni ti laɣim tɔbbihi pam lo tɔbu. Bɛ ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam chaŋ kaman kokpɛɣu la n-tuhi tɔb maa hal ti paai bɛ dimnim sansan ni.
en: The sons of the king of Syria will prepare for war and gather a large army. One of them will sweep on like a flood and attack an enemy fortress.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o ti nya Ɛliab ka yɛl o suhu ni, Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni pii so maa n-ʒe o tooni ŋɔ.
en: When they arrived, Samuel saw Jesse's son Eliab and said to himself, This man standing here in the Lord 's presence is surely the one he has chosen.

dag: ni Adina ŋun daa nyɛ Shiza ŋun nyɛ Rubin zuliya nir la bia ni ŋun lan nyɛ Rubin zuliya maa toondana ka su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi la.
en: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, a leader of the Reubenites, and thirty with him.

dag: Ka bihi daa ti var o pul ni ka o yɛli, Di yi yɛn nyɛ ŋ-ŋɔ n ni be? Ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti bɔhi Yawɛ nya.
en: She was going to have twins, and before they were born, they struggled against each other in her womb. She said, Why should something like this happen to me? So she went to ask the Lord for an answer.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛbihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You must also give the right amount of grain and drink offerings with the bulls, rams, and lambs.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni, ka yi yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam mi dunia ŋɔ ni, di ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.

dag: din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa nyaŋ tin shɛŋa nim ti Izraɛlnim la nyɛla di ni simdi ni niɣi be tiŋgban shɛŋa ni; ka tinim bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ mi mali niɣi.
en: the land that the LORD struck down before the Israelite community. It is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.

dag: N niriba, wummiya, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm: N ni zaŋ n wuhibu wuhi niriba, n zaligunim ni ti zuliya kam zaa neesim.
en: Pay attention to me, my people; listen to me, my nation, for teaching will go out from me, my justice, as a light to the nations.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri din viɛla ni nimmoo ni nya jilima, amaa zaɣ biɛɣu chanila ŋun bɔri li sani.
en: If your goals are good, you will be respected, but if you are looking for trouble, that is what you will get.

dag: Dama Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia daa ti la niriba maa naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tusaayopɔin ni bɛ kɔri. Ka kpamba gba daa ti ba naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tuhi pia. Ka maligumaaniba pam daa mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi.
en: Judahs King Hezekiah contributed one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep for the congregation, while the officials provided another thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep, and great numbers of priests made themselves holy.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi Samuɛl, Banima n-daa lee yɛli ni Sool ku tooi niŋ ti naa la? Chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba na ka ti ku ba.
en: Then the people of Israel said to Samuel, Where are the people who said that Saul should not be our king? Hand them over to us, and we will kill them.

dag: Ka bɔh o, A tɛhiya ni di bi simdi ni n zaŋ n ni su binshɛli niŋ n yubu ni nyɛ shɛm bee yi zabiri ma la nyuli n nirilim niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous.

dag: Ɛdom yɛla ni ti mali dabiɛm. Ŋunkam ti gari nimaani dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka di gar o yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn niŋ nimaani la zuɣu.
en: People passing by your country will be shocked and horrified to see a disaster.

dag: Niriba ni nya a zaɣim, ka a di vi bɛ sani. N ni bɔhi biɛri, m mi ku tiligi so.
en: People will see you naked; they will see you humbled and shamed. I will take vengeance, and no one will stop me.

dag: ni Ahimaaz ŋun daa be Naftali.
en: Ahimaaz was in charge of the territory of Naphtali and was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi nya yaa, biriginsim pahirimi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni nya bɛ lubu.
en: If the wicked are ruling the nation, sin will be everywhere, but those who live right will win in the end.

dag: Di saha Lɛvinim ni ti duhi bɛ yee yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa:.
en: The Levites will address every individual Israelite with a loud voice.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ min o kpiɔŋ; ka suhimiy o sahakam.
en: Pursue the LORD and his strength; seek his face always!.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi zoli maa zuɣu na nti chɛ ka niriba maa paɣi bɛ situra, ka o mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Then Moses came down the mountain and told the people to get ready for worship. So they washed their clothes.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi nya Yawɛ ni pii so maa? Niriba ŋɔ zaa ni so bi be kaman ŋuna. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili.
en: Look closely at the man the Lord has chosen! Samuel told the crowd. There is no one like him! The crowd shouted, Long live the king.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya bahi kaman pɔhim din yi tiŋgban nɛli polo na ni ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri shɛm la.
en: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.

dag: Di piligirila zuɣusaa yaɣ shɛli tariga, n-zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la tariga. Ka binshɛli ku tooi sɔɣi ka di biisim ku paa li.
en: It rises in one end of the sky; its circuit is complete at the other. Nothing escapes its heat.

dag: A gbilisi tibili wum Naawuni yɛm yɛtɔɣa? Ka a tɛhiya ni a kɔŋko m-mali yɛm?.
en: Did you overhear the plans God made? Does human wisdom belong to you alone?.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa bi kpi n dɔɣibu saha? N ni daa yi m ma puli ni na maa ka daa dii kpi.
en: Why didn't I die at birth?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zaligu sulinsi ʒiɛman ni, kul gbaai yihi bina biɛla kɔŋko, ʒim n-daa yi maani binshɛɣukam din kpalim ka di be kasi; ka ʒim yi bi yi, alahichi chɛ m-paŋ kani.
en: Indeed, according to the Law almost everything is purified by blood, and sins are forgiven only if blood is poured out.

dag: Bɛ duhimi bɛ yee paɣi Naawuni, ka zaŋ takɔbiri din mali noya ayiyi gbibi.
en: Let the people shout praise to God. And with a sharp sword in their hand.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti tim Adɔniram ŋun daa su tuma fukumsi la Izraɛlnim sani, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lab o kuɣa ku. Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa yiɣisi n-niŋ yomyom kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-zo kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: A man named Adoniram was one of the men who directed the workers. King Rehoboam sent Adoniram to talk to the people, but the Israelites threw stones at him until he died. King Rehoboam ran to his chariot and escaped to Jerusalem.

dag: Chɛ ka a ba min a ma mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka paɣ ŋun dɔɣ a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Make both of your parents happy. Give your mother that same joy.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum? Dahin shɛli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kana ti kpe a tuma ni hal ni zuŋɔ, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum ka di bi tiɣ a nini, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ku tooi doli chaŋ ti tuhi n-dan naa dimnima.
en: David asked, What have I done wrong? Have you found anything wrong with me since the day I came to you? So why wont you let me go to fight the enemies of my lord the king.

dag: Amaa ka ti yaannim ni daa ku Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sul la zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Kalidia nir la daa kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba; ka wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka gbahi niriba maa n-ʒi ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: But our ancestors made the God of heaven angry, so God gave our ancestors to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar destroyed this Temple, and he forced the people to go to Babylon as prisoners.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi, faashee yi wuntizɔbo zooi gari Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim dini, di yi pa lala yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni abada.
en: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ yɛm mini baŋsim azichi zaa ni sɔɣi so ni.
en: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.

dag: Yawɛ be n sani, m bi zɔri dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.

dag: N niriba alahichi tumbu puuni ka bɛ nyari bindirigu, ka bɔri ni bɛ kul tumdi alahichi.
en: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm nyɛla ŋun mi yɛla woligibu, yɛtɔɣa viɛla mi kpaŋsiri balima.
en: The skilled mind is called discerning, and pleasant speech enhances teaching.

dag: Ka Filistianim shɛb daa ʒiri pina mini anzinfa na ti jɛmdi Jɛhɔshafat. Ka Laribunim gba daa zaŋ piɛlahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini bulahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin na ti ti o.
en: Some of the Philistines brought a load of silver as tribute to Jehoshaphat. The Arabians also brought flocks to Jehoshaphat: seventy-seven hundred rams and seventy-seven hundred goats.

dag: Bɛ sani, a ŋmanila yiliyiina ŋun yiini yurilim yila, ŋun kukoli viɛla, ka o mi biŋkumda ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga. Bɛ wumd a ni yɛri shɛm, amaa bɛ ku niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: To them you are like a singer of love songs with a lovely voice and skilled technique. They listen to your words, but no one does them.

dag: Di wuhi ni a nyɛla wuntizɔra ti yaɣi, a mi di wuhi ni a nyɛla yɛndan ti yaɣi. Di niŋ lala ku amaŋa.
en: So don't be too good or too wise—why kill yourself?.

dag: Yi mɔŋdi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli, ka fari yɛlimaŋli n niriba bɛn nyari nahiŋgu la sani, ka fari pakoya mini kpibisi nɛma.
en: That is how you keep the poor from having their rights and from getting justice. That is how you take the property that belongs to widows and orphans.

dag: Amaa o daa dolila Izraɛl nanim biɛhigu. Hal o daa zaŋla kuriti m-mali Baal binnana zali.
en: and followed the example of the kings of Israel. He had metal images of Baal made.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa zaŋ niriba maa pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ nayili nɛma duu nti zaŋ situr chɛra n-zaŋ gabisi lo li n-zaŋ li ti Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ha.
en: So Ebed-melech took the men and returned to the palace, to an underground supply room, where he found some old rags and scraps of clothing. Ebed-melech lowered them down the cistern by the ropes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-chani zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi ni ka yɛra, Tinima m-be kpe ŋɔ, ti ni kuli Yawɛ ni lo ti alikauli ni ti kuli tin shɛl maa ni, ti tum alahichi.
en: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, We were wrong to complain about the Lord . Let's go into the land that he promised us.

dag: Bina ayɔbu m-beni ka Yawɛ je li, ka bina ayopɔin nyɛ din chihir o sani:.
en: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:.

dag: Ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani! .
en: Because of my anger I swore: They will never enter my rest! .

dag: Bɛ lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a niriba polo; ka niŋdi tab saawara zaŋ chaŋ a ni guli a ninvuɣ shɛb la polo.
en: They are making secret plans against your people; they are plotting against those you protect.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi maa dihili ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ka Izraɛlnim yi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, di simdi ni bɛ yihi li ti ba.
en: Those parts will be given to Aaron and his sons from the Israelites as a permanent provision, because they are a gift offering. They will be a gift offering from the Israelites, their gift offering to the LORD from their well-being sacrifices.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: Pay attention! I am setting blessing and curse before you right now.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ibram, Yim a ya ŋɔ min a ba yiŋa ni a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ sani n-chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The LORD said to Abram, Leave your land, your family, and your fathers household for the land that I will show you.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ sɔɣisili shee tinsi la ti Aduna bidibisi. Dina n-daa nyɛ: Hiburɔn mini Libina zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana ni Jatir ni Ɛshitɛmɔa zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: The following towns were assigned to Aaron's descendants: Hebron, a city of refuge, Jattir, and the towns of Libnah, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth Shemesh, with their pasture lands.

dag: Ka Yisa bol o, Mariama! Ka o ŋmalig o polo ka yɛli Hiburuli ni, Rabɔni! Di gbinni nyɛla, Karimba.
en: Jesus said to her, Mary. She turned toward him and said in Aramaic, Rabboni, which means Teacher.

dag: Yi ni daa labina ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, Yawɛ daa bi wum yi kuhigu maa bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa be yi ni.
en: When you came back, you cried before the LORD, but he wouldnt respond to your tears or give you a hearing.

dag: Bɛ yi kurim bee bɛ yi damdi, bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb maa lurimi bɛ kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: Again and again they hurt people who are already weak and suffering.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim shɛb bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda dim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tiba ni, ka bɛ taai duŋ n-yiɣisi bɛ suhuri bahi Yisa nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: However, the Jews who rejected the faith stirred up the Gentiles, poisoning their minds against the brothers.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli, A bihi yi ni doli n zaligunim kaman a ni dol li shɛm, a kul ku kɔŋ ŋun ni zan a zaani n sani ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: You promised that someone from his family would always be king of Israel, if they do their best to obey you, just as he did.

dag: Ka Salɛm Naa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun daa lan nyɛ Zallakudura Naa maligumaana la daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini wain na nti ti Ibram;.
en: Now Melchizedek the king of Salem and the priest of El Elyon had brought bread and wine.

dag: Ka n daa nya do so ʒii puuni yuŋ ka o bari wɔr ʒiɛɣu. O daa ʒiɛla vinvamli ni mitil tihi sunsuuni, ka wɔr ʒiɛ so mini wɔr ʒiɛ taŋkpaɣu ni wɔr piɛlli dol o nyaaŋa.
en: Tonight I looked and saw a man riding on a red horse, which was standing among the myrtle trees in the valley; and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.

dag: Ka alɔbo shɛli din ŋmani alɔbo ŋɔ ni lu bɛ dimnim yuri mini buntaansi ni laakumnim ni bunsi ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be bɛ sansan ni maa ni zuɣu.
en: A terrible disease will also fall on the horses, the mules, the camels, and the donkeys—on all the animals in the camps of the enemy.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka laɣim niriba maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni.
en: Moses did what the Lord commanded him. The people met together at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi binshɛli din ka daɣiri binshɛli din mali daɣiri ni na? So ku tooi.
en: No one can make something clean from something so dirty.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka sagbana yiri dunia tariga na. Ŋuna n-nam saa nyaɣisibu niŋ saa ni, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zal li luɣ shɛŋa na.
en: He brings the clouds from the other side of the earth. He sends the lightning and the rain, and he opens the doors to release the winds.

dag: Dama zuliya kam zaa wuna nyɛla binnana, amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: All the gods in other nations are nothing but statues, but the Lord made the heavens.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Pɔɔshius Fɛstus daa kana ni o ti deei Gomna Filiksi, ka Gomna Filiksi ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim ni yu shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ Pool niŋ sarika ni.
en: After two years had passed, Porcius Festus succeeded Felix as governor. Felix wanted to gain favor with the Jews so he left Paul in prison.

dag: N Duuma, n nyɛla faralana ni nandana; amaa a bi tam n yɛla. N Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira. Niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: My Lord, I am only a poor, helpless man, but please pay attention to me. You are my helper, the one who can save me. My God, dont be too late.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaanu laasabu chaŋ ti dɔni Ai wulinluhili polo luɣ shɛli din be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: Joshua had already sent , soldiers to the west side of the town to hide and wait to attack.

dag: Bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ka o leei maligumaana zan o ba zaani n-ni ti ye binyɛr piɛl kasi m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa.
en: In the future, this ceremony will be done by the priest who will be anointed and appointed to serve after his father. That priest will put on the holy linen clothes.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka lɔri alikauli, ka pɔri pɔri din ka buchi, dinzuɣu saria karibu tɔhi zanna kaman mɔ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɔchaa ni bili puu ni shɛm la.
en: They utter empty words and make false promises and useless treaties. Justice has become injustice, growing like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

dag: Yawɛ, pa tinima, pa tinima, amaa a yuli ka ti tiri jilima, a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu.
en: Lord , you should receive the honor, not us. The honor belongs to you because of your faithful love and loyalty.

dag: Amaa binneembihi zaa bɛn mali paɣiri, ka mali nab anahi nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: But stay away from all the other insects that have wings and crawl.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gbaai Yisa maa zaŋ o tahi Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la yiŋa; nimaani ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: Those who arrested Jesus led him to Caiaphas the high priest. The legal experts and the elders had gathered there.

dag: Yi niŋdi wain paani pipihi n-nyura, ka niŋdi tulaale viɛla n-niŋdi yimaŋa, amaa ka yi baɣa ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli din paai Yisifu zuliya ŋɔ ni.
en: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n daa yi m ma puli ni na ni n ti nyari muɣisigu mini suhugarigu, ka vi kul yɛn diri ma hal ni n nyɛvili tariga?.
en: Why was I ever born when all I see is suffering and misery, and my days are filled with shame?.

dag: Mɛnahɛm ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Menahem did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Mani n-yiɣisi Sairus n wuntia puuni. N ni mal o soya ka di tuhi. O ni me n tiŋ la, ka ti n niriba yolisim. O bi yɛn niŋ li ka deei shɛli. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I have a right to awaken Cyrus; I will smooth all his paths. He will build my city and set my exiles free, not for a price and not for a bribe, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka di wula daa teei hal ti paai teeku ni, ka di nyaɣa teei hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: It extended its branches to the Mediterranean Sea and as far as the Euphrates River.

dag: Molimiya nolɔbo molo; laɣimmiya salo maa zaa na! Laɣimmiya kpamba mini bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la ni nti kum niŋ ŋun Yawɛ.
en: Demand a fast, request a special assembly. Gather the elders and all the lands people to the temple of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi Gibia na ti tuhi ku Izraɛlnim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayi dindali maa.
en: The army of Benjamin came out of the city, and before the day was over they had killed twenty-two thousand Israelite soldiers.

dag: M bihi, kamiyana nti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ; n yɛn wuhi ya la Yawɛ sizuura lubu.
en: Come, my young friends, and listen to me, and I will teach you to honor the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni ti gari, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o niŋ tipawumli maa ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni kaman o ni niŋ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But King Sihon of Heshbon would not let us pass through his country. The Lord your God had made him very stubborn and ready to fight. The Lord did this so that he could help you defeat King Sihon. And today we know that is what happened.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Gibia dal la ka yi daa tum alahichi. Nimaani ka bɛ daa dii gbaai alahichi tumbu. Dinzuɣu tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu Gibia.
en: Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, Israel; there they have continued. Will not war overtake them in Gibeah?.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa tim ti boli Juda kpamba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, ka bɛ laɣim o sanna.
en: King Josiah called together the older leaders of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Yi mi ku lan nya karimbaannim bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ saani yi sani ka yi ʒi li, ka ku tooi baŋ di gbinni la.
en: You will no longer see any arrogant foreigners who speak a language that you can't understand.

dag: ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni yɛli ni yi daa dɔɣi yi bi so zom la m-bɔŋɔ? Di yi nyɛla ŋuna, ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: and asked them, Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba, ka yɛli Baruk, Di simdi ka ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ti yɛli naa.
en: After they heard what was written on the scroll, they were worried and said to each other, The king needs to hear this! Turning to Baruch, they asked.

dag: Mani n-yɛli lala maa. Iin, mani m-bol o. Mani n-zaŋ o na, ka o mi ni di nasara o tuma ni.
en: I am the one who spoke and called him; I led him out and gave him success.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa paai Sinai tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: The Israelites left Rephidim and arrived at the desert. Then two months after leaving Egypt, they arrived at the desert near Mount Sinai, where they set up camp at the foot of the mountain. This was two months after they had left Egypt.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti ni yɛli ni a nyɛla Samaria nira ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi a zuɣu la, di pala yɛlimaŋli.
en: They asked Jesus, Were we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon in you.

dag: Niriba kul paɣir a mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka a yuli du pam dunia ŋɔ zaa ni; ka a doli yɛlimaŋli soli su nam.
en: Your praise, God, just like your reputation, extends to the far corners of the earth. Your strong hand is filled with righteousness.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa chɛ ka tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa yi Ifriim tiŋgban ni na maa lab kuli. Ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam bahi Judanim zuɣu ka bɛ je suli pam lab kuli.
en: Amaziah released the Ephraimite troops who had joined him so they could go home, but this only infuriated them against Judah, and they left in a rage.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa maa daa gbaai ma dabiɛm, ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: I, Daniel, was confused and worried. The visions that went through my mind bothered me.

dag: N naɣ mali yɛm yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisirila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ba n-zani, amaa di pala ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛm bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim bɛn ni ti vuui ŋɔ yɛm.
en: We teach wisdom to people who are mature, but the wisdom we teach is not from this world. It is not the wisdom of the rulers of this world, who are losing their power.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmiya yomyom ka bɛ ti yɛli Dauda ni o di gbe kulibɔŋ duli maa yuŋ ŋɔ, amaa ni o chɛ ka o min o niriba maa tirisi tooni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kpimsi ŋun naa mini niriba bɛn be o sani maa birili zaa.
en: Hushai added, Quick, now! Send a message to David not to spend the night at the river crossings in the wilderness, but to cross the Jordan at once, so that he and his men won't all be caught and killed.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. Binshɛɣukam shiri luhiya, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa n-kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: We are allowed to do anything, so they say. That is true, but not everything is good. We are allowed to do anything—but not everything is helpful.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya niriba ni o nyaandoliba n-kana ti zu n-yih o yuŋ saha shɛli yi ni daa ʒeei gom.
en: and said to them, Tell the people that Jesus followers came during the night and stole the body while you were sleeping.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti Asiria naa maa nuu ni, ka dunia ŋɔ nama zaa niriba baŋ ni a kɔŋko n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: But you are the Lord our God, so please save us from the king of Assyria. Then all the other nations will know that you are the Lord , the only God.

dag: Ka Pool daa yiɣisi zani n-kpuɣ o nuu gahiri ka yɛri ba, Yinim Izraɛlnim mini yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Naawuni, wummiya!.
en: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm pam la dali naanyi kana.
en: The sun will be darkened, and the moon will turn red as blood before the great and terrible day of the Lord comes.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri; ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la.
en: It is like this. A man takes a mustard seed, the smallest seed in the world, and plants it in the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake, Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judahili ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu ŋɔ wumda.
en: Hilkiahs son Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the field commander, Please speak to your servants in Aramaic because we understand it. Dont speak with us in Hebrew, because the people on the wall will hear it.

dag: Amaa hal ni pɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-zaŋ n yuli suhi shɛli; dinzuɣu suhimiya, Naawuni ni tin ya, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli.
en: Up to now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask and you will receive so that your joy will be complete.

dag: A ni yɛligi kpa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo, ka a niriba ni su zuliya shɛba, ka yi ti ʒini tin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ dabari la ni.
en: You will extend your boundaries on all sides; your people will get back the land that the other nations now occupy. Cities now deserted will be filled with people.

dag: Bɛ wain tihi yila Sɔdom wain tihi ni na, ka yi Gomɔra wain tihi puri ni na. Bɛ wain tiwala nyɛla wala din mali lɔɣu. Di zaɣ yila nyɛla din to.
en: Their vines and fields will be destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah. Their grapes are like bitter poison.

dag: So ka pɔhim yiko din ni tooi gooi li, so mi ka kum dabisili yiko. So ku tooi lɔrigi kpara sɔŋ tɔbu tuhibu saha. Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma gba ku tooi tiligi ŋun tumdi li.
en: No one has control over the life-breath, to retain it, and theres no control over the day of death. Theres no release from war, and wickedness wont deliver those who practice it.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba, Yihimiya salima tibikpara din be yi paɣiba tiba ni mini yi bipuɣinsi tiba ni ni din be yi bidibisi sani n-zaŋ na ti ti ma.
en: Aaron said to them, Take off the gold earrings which your wives, your sons, and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me.

dag: M bia, Yawɛ yi saɣis a, nyin di lihi ʒiɛm li bee o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a nyee nyɔni.
en: My son, dont reject the Lord s discipline, and dont be angry when he corrects you.

dag: Ka n yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ Filistianim ŋɔ ni kana ti liri ma Giligal, ka n na bi suhi Yawɛ sɔŋsim; lala zuɣu ka m muɣisi mmaŋa m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: I thought, The Philistines are about to march against me at Gilgal and I havent yet sought the LORDs favor. So I took control of myself and offered the entirely burned offering.

dag: Amaa ka yi yi bi niŋ o ni daa sab shɛm maa yɛda, wula ka yi lee ni niŋ n yɛligu yɛda.
en: If you dont believe the writings of Moses, how will you believe my words.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi n ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu, ka bi deei n noli.
en: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo;.
en: Then Jesus said to the disciples, And so I tell you not to worry about the food you need to stay alive or about the clothes you need for your body.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali firilatamdigu, ka zaŋ matarika kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili, ka di mini di lahi ni bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi zaa din be di ni ti nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: Make a lampstand of pure hammered gold. The lampstands base, branches, cups, flowers, and petals should all be attached to it.

dag: N yɛr a mi ni a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: There you will stay, I tell you, until you pay the last penny of your fine.

dag: Wula ka bɛ zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi nya soli ka nyɛ Naawuni ni sa gariche gili so?.
en: God keeps their future hidden and hems them in on every side.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la.
en: Early the next morning Abraham hurried to the place where he had stood in the presence of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni ti chɛ bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn kpi sɔŋ palo ni, ka zoya zuɣu noonsi mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri di ba, ka ŋub ba. Noonsi ni ti di ba shɛɣu ni, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mi ŋub ba kikaa saha.
en: They will all be left to the mountain birds and to the beasts of the land. The birds will eat them in summer, all the beasts of the land in winter.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛman nim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: But Jesus replied: You want a sign because you are evil and won't believe! But the only sign you will get is the sign of the prophet Jonah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa.
en: They made chains of pure gold, twisted like cords, for the chest pendant.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul maanila sara buɣa jɛmbu shee maa, amaa bɛ daa maani li n-tirila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa.
en: The people continued to offer sacrifices at the high places, but their sacrifices were only to the Lord their God.

dag: N daa zaŋ yɛ viɛla dih a paɣisarilim, ka zaŋ bansi pir a nuhi ni, ka zaŋ dolibi yɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: I also gave you some jewelry. I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck.

dag: Bɛ daa birila alikama, ka ti chɛla gɔhi. Bɛ tum tuma ka di wum ba, amaa ka bi nya shɛli. Bɛ yi ti kpuɣi bɛ puri atam, vi ni gbahi ba, Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame!.

dag: Bɛn mali ba bemi kaman bɛ ni be shɛm. Lala n-nyɛ bɛnkam zaa niŋ wuna maa naani.
en: Let the people who made these idols and all who trust in them become just like them!.

dag: Nyin ka n vili gbibi, ka a nudirigu kul gbib ma ka n ku lu.
en: My whole being clings to you; your strong hand upholds me.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔri maa daa zaŋ kawaan kara ayopɔin maa vali. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei n-nya ka di nyɛla zahindi.
en: The thin heads of grain swallowed the seven full heads. Again the king woke up, and it had only been a dream.

dag: Yi ni tahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ na bi ʒiɛmdi buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun nyɛ ti ni jɛmdi buɣ so la n-tur o.
en: You have brought these men here even though they have not robbed temples or said evil things about our goddess.

dag: N ni zaŋ li tila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ya la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa pun yɛli ya, Teemiya dɔni ka ti du n-tam yi zuɣu n-nɔri ya chani kaman tiŋgbani n-nyɛn ya la.
en: I will put it in the hand of your tormentors, who said to you, Lie down so that we can walk on you. Make your back like the ground, like a street for those walking on it.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ti ni ti doli zaligunim ŋɔ zaa; ka zom ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka ti be kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.

dag: N tiliginsim mini n jilima yirila Naawuni sanna; ŋuna n-nyɛ n gula ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: My salvation and honor depend on God; he is my strong protector; he is my shelter.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm maa min o nyaaŋa daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na; amaa bɛ daa bi lan gbahi ba ni kiŋkansi yaha, dama bɛ daa zɔrimi ni niriba ti lab ba kuɣa.
en: Then the captain left with his guards and brought the apostles back. They didnt use force because they were afraid the people would stone them.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Do so n-daa mal o bidibis ayi.
en: Jesus went on to say, There was once a man who had two sons.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya luɣilikam, ka yi wurim, ka sokam kpa o kpabu polo, ka so ku lan beni ŋun ni laɣim kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba luɣ yini.
en: I will bring terror on you from every side. You will all run away. Each one will run for his life, and there will be no one to bring your troops together again.

dag: Di saha maa ka n ni tɔɣis a wuntitali yɛla, ka tɔɣis a paɣibu yɛla dabisi muni zaa puuni.
en: Then my tongue will talk all about your righteousness; it will talk about your praise all day long.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi tiligira; labimiya n sanna. Dama n vuui yi tuumbiɛri mini yi daalahichi bahi kaman sagbani bee paɣili ni vuuri shɛm la.
en: Your sins were like a big cloud, but I wiped them all away. Your sins are gone, like a cloud that disappeared into thin air. I rescued and protected you, so come back to me.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ nina neei ka bɛ baŋ o, ka o daa dii bɔrigi ka chɛ ba ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, but he disappeared from their sight.

dag: Gaal ni daa nya niriba maa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli Zɛbul, Nyama, niriba n-yiri zoya ŋɔ zuɣu sigirina! Ka Zɛbul garigi yɛl o, Pa niriba m-bala. Zoya maa shilinshihi ka a nya ka di ŋmani ninsalinim maa.
en: Gaal saw the men and said to Zebul, Look! People are coming down from the hilltops. Zebul replied to him, The shadows on the hills just look like persons to you.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bi nɛɔŋ maa ti paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni ŋɔ ka di ku o, ŋuna n-nyɛ bia maa ma.
en: Then King Solomon said, Stop, dont kill the baby. Give him to this woman. She is the real mother.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa be bɛ sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David will be their prince. I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti zaŋ kpani maa m-bɔr ni o to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi Sool, ka o zaŋ kpani maa to n-nyɔɣila dukpini. Ka Dauda daa guui n-zo n-tiligi yuŋ maa.
en: Saul threw his spear at David and tried to pin him to the wall. David jumped out of the way, so the spear missed him and stuck in the wall. That night, David ran away.

dag: Amaa buɣisimiya binshɛɣukam nya, ka gbibiya din viɛla.
en: Put all things to the test: keep what is good.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli naa maa ni biɛhiŋ kani, o ni kpaŋ; amaa Yawɛ lee kahigi wuhi ma ni o ni bahi kpi.
en: Tell him he will, Elisha said to Hazael. But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ di mini bindir pala bɔrɔbɔro ni piɛbihi ayi n-gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara Yawɛ sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ zaŋ ti maligumaana maa.
en: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.

dag: Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ti banima, ka gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Our fathers were killed in battle, and our wives and children have been taken away as prisoners.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa garigi yɛli, Ti ku nyu wain, dama ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛkab bia la daa yɛli ti ni ti mini ti bihi di nyu wain.
en: But the Recabite family answered, We never drink wine. We never drink it because our ancestor Jonadab son of Recab gave us this command: You and your descendants must never drink wine.

dag: Ka o daa kari alizin birigu maa doo maa zuɣu bahi, ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira; ka di daa niŋ salo maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya tuuni ŋɔ tatabo Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus forced the demon out, and the man was able to talk. The people were amazed and said, We have never seen anything like this in Israel.

dag: Dama n daa zɔrila wahala din yɛn yi Naawuni sanna dabiɛm, ka n daa naan ku tooi zan o jilima tooni.
en: Because I fear God's punishment, I could never do such a thing.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni ka jɛmdila Naawuni ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbani maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛ ʒini maa buɣa.
en: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.

dag: N Ba ŋun zaŋ ba ti ma maa gari sokam, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba m Ba maa nuu ni.
en: What my Father has given me is greater than everything, and no one can snatch them away from the Father's care.

dag: ka Shimɛi nyɛ Jahat bia, ka Jahat nyɛ Gɛrishom bia, ka Gɛrishom mi nyɛ Lɛvi bia.
en: Jahath, Gershon, Levi.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul ku su tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ wuntizɔriba tiŋgbani, ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka wuntizɔriba maa tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: The wicked will not always control the land of those who do right. If they did, even those who do right might start doing wrong.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba binshɛɣukam.
en: He said to them, The secret of Gods kingdom has been given to you, but to those who are outside everything comes in parables.

dag: Ka kikaa ni ti tahi pam, ka o ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: At the sound of a loud trumpet, he will send his angels to bring his chosen ones together from all over the earth.

dag: Mɔri shiri kuura, ka tipum kpahiri lura, amaa ti Naawuni maa ŋun yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The grass dries up; the flower withers, but our Gods word will exist forever.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa ti tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayopɔin saha shɛli, di daa niŋ kaman awa pirigili ka alizanda ni binshɛɣukam kul fomi chichi.
en: The Lamb opened the seventh seal. Then there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

dag: Di saha ka Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la yɛl o nyaandolitab maa, Dindina chɛliya ka ti zaa dol o chaŋ ka ti min o ti laɣim kpi.
en: Thomas, whose nickname was Twin, said to the other disciples, Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.

dag: ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim, ka di dunoya kabisikabisi.
en: Ruin remains in the city, and the gate is battered to wreckage.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni yihi ya Ijiptinim dabitim maa ni. N ni teei n nuu tum tuun kara n-darigi bɛ tibili ka tiligi ya.
en: So tell the Israelites that I say to them, I am the Lord . I will save you. You will no longer be slaves of the Egyptians. I will use my great power to make you free, and I will bring terrible punishment to the Egyptians.

dag: N daa je suli n-tin ya nanima, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi, ka n lan deei ba ka chɛn ya.
en: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ti yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Salo pam yi Ɛdom kanna ni bɛ ti lir a, bɛ yila teekubil duli yaɣ din la polo kanna, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela Hazazɔntarima.
en: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, There is a large army coming against you from Edom. They are coming from the other side of the Dead Sea. They are already in Hazazon Tamar.

dag: Yawɛ kpe o niriba kpamba mini bɛ nanim saria karibu ni. O yɛliya, Yinima n-ʒe tihi puri, ka di tarimba nɛma ti niŋ yi yinsi.
en: The Lord is bringing the elders and leaders of his people to judgment. He makes this accusation: You have plundered vineyards, and your houses are full of what you have taken from the poor.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu bimbir shɛŋa yi ni yɛn biri zuɣu, bimbira maa ni viɛla.
en: If any part of a dead, unclean animal falls on seed that is to be planted, that seed is still clean.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake maa. Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judanim yɛtɔɣa ni ka niriba bɛn be gooni zuɣu ŋɔ wumdi li.
en: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the field commander, Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, because we understand it. Dont speak with us in Hebrew, because the people on the wall will hear it.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya kɔŋko ka a ku kali, a mi di sab bɛ yuya pahi Izraɛlnim ni.
en: When you take a census of the men fit for military service, do not include the tribe of Levi.

dag: Di ŋmanila nam leebu kpa shɛli din daa yi Aduna zuɣu ni n-zo nti tɛl o teeŋa n-zo hal ti tɛl o binyɛrigu nyiŋgol la.
en: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.

dag: O yuli daa duya pam ninvuɣ pihita maa ni, amaa di daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei o tɔbbihi bɛn gul o zuɣulana.
en: He was famous among the Thirty, but he didnt become one of the Three. David placed him in command of his own bodyguard.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!.

dag: O zaŋ li bahi sagbana tiŋli zaa, ka chɛ ka o saanyaɣisibu paai dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: He looses it under the whole sky, his lightning on earths edges.

dag: Tibili bi wumdila yɛtɔɣa ka zahindi li kaman zilinli ni lamdi bindirigu shɛm la?.
en: But just as the tongue tastes food, the ears test the words they hear.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛ daa dɔɣ a la alahichi puuni, ka nyin ti lee nyɛ ŋun wuhiri ti? Ka bɛ daa kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: The Jewish leaders answered, You were born full of sin! Are you trying to teach us? And they told the man to get out of the synagogue and to stay out.

dag: Ka anab maa daa viligi tan shɛli o ni zaŋ lo o ninni maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa baŋ ni o nyɛla anabinim ni yino.
en: The man quickly tore the bandage off his face, and Ahab saw that he was one of the prophets.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa duri maa, maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla mɔɣili maa sunsuuni tiŋkuŋ zuɣu hal ka niriba maa zaa ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa naai.
en: So the priests carrying the LORDs covenant chest stood firmly on dry land in the middle of the Jordan. Meanwhile, all Israel crossed over on dry land, until the entire nation finished crossing over the Jordan.

dag: n-zaŋ li gari taba m-mali tulaale zim kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka niŋ yalim niŋ di ni din ni chɛ ka di be kasi ka ku mali daɣiri.
en: Like a skilled perfume maker, carefully blend them together and make incense, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrikɔnim daa kana ti yɛli Ilaisha, Ti dana, yiya ŋɔ ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ viɛli pam kaman a gba ni nya li shɛm, amaa di kom nyɛla ko biɛɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: One day the people of Jericho said, Elisha, you can see that our city is in a good spot. But the water from our spring is so bad that it even keeps our crops from growing.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ni daa ʒin o nam ʒiishee, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani ka chɛ ka o mali yiko pam.
en: Solomon, the son of David, became a very strong king, because the Lord his God was with him and made him very great.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni so pun nya m Ba maa; naɣila ŋun yi ŋun Naawuni sanna la n-naɣ nyɛ ŋun nya o.
en: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa do bɛ sansana ni n-lihiri taba daba ayopɔin. Ka bɛ daa ti gbaai tab tuhibu daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Sirianim tɔbbihi bɛn chan tiŋ tuhi kɔbiga dindali maa.
en: The two armies camped opposite each other for seven days. On the seventh day, the battle began. The Israelites attacked and destroyed one hundred thousand Aramean foot soldiers in a single day.

dag: nti yɛl o, N dana, ti daa pun kala kpe na ti da bindira.
en: If you please, sir, we came here once before to buy food.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Jɛra maanila alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ansarisi, amaa Naawuni niŋdi wuntizɔriba nirilim.
en: Fines are needed to make fools obey the law, but good people are happy to obey it.

dag: Nyama, zibisim ni ti be dunia ni, ka niriba be bumbɔn ni. Amaa Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o neesim neei gili ya, ka chɛ ka o jilima siɣi yi zuɣu na.
en: Though darkness covers the earth and gloom the nations, the LORD will shine upon you; Gods glory will appear over you.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, Take this. It is my body.

dag: Ka ti niŋ yɛda ka mi ni nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: We believe in you. We know that you are the Holy One from God.

dag: yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɔrili zaɣ titali ŋun daa mali kpiŋkpaŋ kara, ka o kpiŋkpan piɛma wɔɣa, ka o mali kɔb garigari pam daa ti ka Lɛbanɔn na. O daa gbaala sida tia.
en: to let them know what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to them: There was a giant eagle with beautiful feathers and huge wings, spread wide. He flew to the Lebanon Mountains and broke off the top of a cedar tree.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣa me binwɔɣinli zali, dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni ni je shɛŋa.
en: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.

dag: bɛ so nini ku nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po ni n ni zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim la. Bɛn ʒiɛm ma la so nini ku nya li.
en: They will never enter the land which I promised to their ancestors. None of those who have rejected me will ever enter it.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ saria karibu saha; ka Naawuni ni yihi dunia ŋɔ naa bahi.
en: Now is the time for judgment of this world. Now this worlds ruler will be thrown out.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka bɔh o, Paɣa, ka bɛ be ya? Bɛ ni so bi lan yɛli ni a simdi kubu.
en: He straightened up and said to her, Where are they? Is there no one left to condemn you.

dag: Di saha m ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: My father David wanted to build a temple for the name of the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o ba min o ma maa daa yɛli ni o gba lan pala bia, dinzuɣu ni bɛ bɔhim o maa.
en: Thats why his parents said, Hes old enough. Ask him.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Guhimiya ka m-bɔhi Yawɛ wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi polo.
en: Moses said, Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul bɛ ti sani; naɣila ti chaŋmi ti da bindirigu din ni saɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa na.
en: But Jesus said to the apostles, You give them something to eat. They said, We have only five loaves of bread and two fish. Do you want us to go buy food for all these people? There are too many!.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ zuliya kam zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni yi wɔbi olivi tiwala din bahindi nyaaŋa ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha bɛ ni yi wɔbi li naai saha shɛli la.
en: It will be like this in the central part of the land and among the peoples, like an olive tree that has been shaken, like remains from the grape harvest.

dag: So yi bi lih o dɔɣiriba, di bahi bamdi omaŋmaŋ malibu, dindina o tum din chihir o daadiini soli zuɣu, ka leei ŋun bie n-gari ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda.
en: Everyone should take care of all their own people. Most important, they should take care of their own family. If they do not do that, then they do not accept what we believe. They are worse than someone who does not even believe in God.

dag: Bɛ sani binshɛli din nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ bin jɛmdili la zomla bɛn bɛn bi niŋ yɛda maa nina, ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku nya lahibal suŋ la neesim din kahigiri Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋmaŋ ŋmahinli ŋɔ jilima wuhiri la.
en: The ruler of this world has blinded the minds of those who dont believe. They cannot see the light of the Good News—the message about the divine greatness of Christ. Christ is the one who is exactly like God.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa mɔɣis o biɛyanim maa zaa kparima ka kum pam, di nyaaŋa ka o biɛyanim maa daa naanyi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then Joseph cried as he kissed all his brothers. After this, the brothers began talking with him.

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Ɛliada bia Rɛzɔn ŋun daa zo o lan Zɔba Naa Hadadɛza san la leei Sulemaana dima.
en: God also raised up another man to become one of Solomons enemies. This man was Rezon, son of Eliada. Rezon ran away from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni ni tum shɛlikam kul ni beni sahakam. So ku tooi zaŋ shɛli pahi di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Naawuni n-tum lala ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa zo o.
en: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa, ka bɛ daa bi lan buɣisi ni bɛ liri ba bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni yaha, ka Yawɛ daa kul darigiri Filistianim maa tibili Samuɛl ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: So the Philistines were defeated, and they stopped coming into Israelite territory. The LORDs hand was against the Philistines throughout Samuels life.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya Saimɔn min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: As Jesus walked along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two fishermen, Simon and his brother Andrew, catching fish with a net.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim maa ni yu shɛm zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Pool, A bɔri ni a chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar a saria nimaani.
en: But Festus wanted to gain favor with the Jews, so he asked Paul, Would you be willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried on these charges before me there.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ kɔŋko nti di bindir shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara bɛ maligumaaniba leebu saha maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun pa maligumaana ti di li, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: These offerings were used to take away their sins when they were made priests. Now they should eat these offerings.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa daa ŋmanila n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa kana ni o ti wurim tiŋ maa la, ka lan ŋmani n ni daa nya ʒii shɛli n ni daa be Kɛba Mɔɣili noli la. Ka n daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: What appeared when I looked was like what I had seen when he came to destroy the city, and also like what I saw at the Chebar River, and I fell on my face.

dag: Kɛnaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Otiniɛl mini Sɛraya, ka Otiniɛl mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hatat mini Mɛɔnɔtai.
en: Kenazs family: Othniel and Seraiah. Othniels family: Hathath and Meonothai.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti ŋme n-chib o zuɣu ka dih o vi.
en: Then the owner sent another slave; the tenants beat him over the head and treated him shamefully.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, ti suŋ kam wandila wal suma, ka ti biɛɣukam mi wandi wal biɛri.
en: A healthy tree bears good fruit, but a poor tree bears bad fruit.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka vuhim kpe yi ni ka yi niŋ nyɛviyanima.
en: Tell them that I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to them: I am going to put breath into you and bring you back to life.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, di chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛli yi ni nyaŋ alizin biɛri maa zuɣu; amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛlila yi yuya ni sab alizanda ni la zuɣu.
en: But don't be glad because the evil spirits obey you; rather be glad because your names are written in heaven.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n suhir a, taɣimi tim so.
en: But Moses said, Please, my Lord, just send someone else.

dag: Ka o daa yi nimaani chaŋ Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu, ka daa ti yi nimaani lab Samaria.
en: Elisha went on to Mount Carmel and later returned to Samaria.

dag: ka Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf nyɛ Gaad zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was in command of the tribe of Gad.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ di kahigi wuhi ni so ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama di sabiya: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: But since no one is made righteous by the Law as far as God is concerned, it is clear that the righteous one will live on the basis of faith .

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa chaŋ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Mordecai then left and did everything that Esther had told him to do.

dag: Hur n-daa nyɛ Uri ba, ka Uri mi daa nyɛ Bɛzalɛl ba.
en: Hur was Uris father. Uri was Bezalels father.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n timdi m biyurigu Timoti ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma dolibu ni la yi sanna ni o ti teei ya n ni doli so shɛŋa Masia dolibu ni, ka wuhiri li shɛm luɣ shɛlikam cheechinim ni la.
en: That is why I am sending Timothy to you. He is my son in the Lord. I love him and trust him. He will help you remember the way I live in Christ Jesus—a way of life that I teach in every meeting of the church wherever I am.

dag: Niriba maa mi daa niŋ ti viɛnyɛliŋga pam, bɛ daa bi niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu, ti mi binshɛli daa ʒi m-bɔrigi saha shɛli ti ni daa be bɛ sani mɔɣu maa ni maa.
en: But the men were very good to us and didnt mistreat us. Nothing of ours went missing the whole time we were out with them in the fields.

dag: Turi maa nyɛla din saɣim n suhu; ka n lan ka tahima. N daa lihi bo nambɔzɔbo, amaa ka bi nya li; ka lihi bo bɛn ni maai n suhu, ka bi nya so.
en: I feel the pain of their insults. The shame makes me feel like dying! I wanted some sympathy, but there was none. I waited for someone to comfort me, but no one came.

dag: Jɔshua daa yɛla binyɛr daɣiri ʒe malaika maa tooni.
en: Joshua was standing there, wearing filthy clothes.

dag: Dinzuɣu kom maa na kul nyɛla ko viɛlli hal ni zuŋɔ kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: And that water has been pure ever since, just as Elisha said it would be.

dag: Yiɣisim doli tiŋgbɔŋ maa wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ nya, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: So go. Walk through your land. I now give it to you.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa yihi ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ puuni binyara n-lan bahi kom maa ni.
en: Then on the third day, with their bare hands they threw overboard some of the ship's gear.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ toomiya li ti ti aŋgo zo. Ka bɛ tooi li ti ti o.
en: and then he told them, Now draw some water out and take it to the man in charge of the feast. They took him the water.

dag: Yawɛ, n zaŋ tiliginsim lahiba suŋ la yɛla n-yɛli niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni. Yawɛ, nyama, a mi ni n kul ku fo n noli zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Ive told the good news of your righteousness in the great assembly. I didnt hold anything back— as you well know, LORD!.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha bia;.
en: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.

dag: Ka Uzia daa chɛ ka bɛ kuri nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana ni kuriti woliɣisi ni kuriti gbaɣinɔnima ni tɔbiri ni kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa n-ti tɔbbihi maa zaa.
en: Uzziah gave the army shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and stones for the slings.

dag: Miriya ka yi wum Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya shɛm maa; dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Timmiya sandaani niŋ ma, ka yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi diri yimaŋmaŋ wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi wala, ka nyuri yimaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi kom.
en: Dont listen to Hezekiah, because this is what Assyrias king says: Surrender to me and come out. Then each of you will eat from your own vine and fig tree, and drink water from your own well.

dag: So yi tum taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o, ka bɛ zaŋ o yili tia ku o.
en: A man might be guilty of a sin that must be punished by death. People might kill him and hang his body on a tree.

dag: dama m mi yi ni pun yu ni yi niŋ shɛm yɛla. Ka n nyuri bara yi zuɣu Masidɔnianim sani, ka yɛri ni Akaianim gba pun malila shili yuuni la ha, ka yi ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi bɛ ni shɛb pam suhuri.
en: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.

dag: Wula ka nir lee yɛn garigi yɛli Filistianim tuumba? Yawɛ m-me Ziɔn zali, ka o niriba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ni nya biɛhigu shee nimaani.
en: But what will the messengers from that nation report about us? They will say, The Lord made Zion strong, and his poor people went there for safety.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul niŋdi lala hal ka wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ti gari, ka bɛ kul mali lala hal ti paai zaawuni sara malibu saha, ka bi wum so kukoli, ka so mi bi garigi ba.
en: They kept on ranting and raving until the middle of the afternoon; but no answer came, not a sound was heard.

dag: Amaa nyin wuhimila din mini wuhibu maŋli taɣili tab la.
en: But you should talk in a way that is consistent with sound teaching.

dag: O mali so palli din nyɛ nyɛvili soli din doli kpɛri chinchin tibisili la ni ti ti. Chinchin tibisili maa nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ ŋmahinli.
en: through a new and living way that he opened up for us through the curtain, which is his body.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidibisi shɛba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei namɔɣilisi ka bɛ be Babilɔn nayili.
en: Some of your own direct descendants will be taken away and made eunuchs to serve in the palace of the king of Babylonia.

dag: Ti mi ni binnamda zaa kul ŋuhirimi ka wolisiri biɛrim zuɣu hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: We know that everything God made has been waiting until now in pain like a woman ready to give birth to a child.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli ya na din ni chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbi gbaliŋ maa zuɣu, ka Ijiptinim maa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: I will make him stubborn, and he will pursue you, and my victory over the king and his army will bring me honor. Then the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord . The Israelites did as they were told.

dag: Amaa di yi pala o pun lomi ni o ku o, ka di nyɛla Naawuni n-chɛ ka di niŋ, dindina n ni wuhi ya luɣ shɛli zali ka ŋun ku nir maa zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: But if an accident happens, and a person kills someone without planning it, then God allowed that thing to happen. I will choose some special places where people can run to for safety. So that person can run to one of those places.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti woligi ba bɛ ko Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa ni n-chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba kaman noli yɛlibu zaa din be alikauli puuni, ka sabi be zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni la.
en: The Lord will make an example of him before all the tribes of Israel and will bring disaster on him in accordance with all the curses listed in the covenant that is written in this book of the Lord 's teachings.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmaligi dolila buɣa n-jɛmdi li. Di nyɛla buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun bi mi ni o ni daa bi zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa ti ba.
en: The Israelites started serving other gods—gods they never worshiped before. The Lord told his people not to worship those gods.

dag: Niriba bɛn be zibisim ni baŋdi a daalahiziba tuma yɛla? Bee bɛ baŋd a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla bɛ tamsim shee?.
en: The dead who lie in darkness cannot see the amazing things you do. Those in the world of the forgotten cannot talk about your goodness.

dag: Alikauli kurili maa yi di daa be dɛde, di di bi lan kpa talahi ni din pah ayi kana.
en: If there had been nothing wrong with the first covenant, there would have been no need for a second one.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa lan nyɛ Rɛfa mini Rɛshɛf ni Tɛla ni Tahan.
en: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, whose descendants were as follows: Resheph, Telah, Tahan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Wummi niriba maa ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa, dama pa nyini ka bɛ zaɣisi, amaa mani ka bɛ zaɣisi ni n di lan nyɛ bɛ naa maa.
en: The Lord told Samuel, Do what the people tell you. They have not rejected you. They have rejected me. They dont want me to be their king.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bee na ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuh o kpee, ka ku ʒini niŋ laasabu nya o ni tooi zaŋ tɔbbihi tuhi pia chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ o kpee ŋun mali tɔbbihi tuhi pisi?.
en: What will a king do if he has only , soldiers to defend himself against a king who is about to attack him with , soldiers? Before he goes out to battle, won't he first sit down and decide if he can win?.

dag: Sujee nyɛla putɔɣu, ka suhuyiɣisili kɔŋ tim, amaa nyuli zabbu m-bie n-gari di zaa.
en: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbanbiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: Then they made two more gold rings and put them on the other two corners of the judgment pouch. This was on the inside edge of the judgment pouch next to the ephod.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli.
en: God spoke, and these were his words:.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Jɛriko nti tim di tiŋ puuni garita.
en: Jesus went on into Jericho and was passing through.

dag: Amaa man ni lih a ninni wuntitali puuni; n yi ti neei n-lihi nya a kɔtomsi, di ni ti tiɣi n nini.
en: But me? I will see your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be filled full by seeing your image.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa yɛli ba, So na ʒi n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman doo maa.
en: The guards answered, Nobody has ever talked the way this man does.

dag: O nyari bina pam, amaa ka bi baŋdi li; o tiba mali voya, amaa di bi wumda.
en: You have seen many things, but dont keep watch. With ears open, you dont hear.

dag: Mabihi yi laɣim be ka mali naŋgban yini, di viɛli ka nyaɣisi pam!.
en: Oh, how wonderful, how pleasing it is when Gods people all come together as one !.

dag: nti bɔhi, Ya polo ka bɛ ni dɔɣi Yɛhudianim Na so la lee be? Ti daa nyala o saŋmariga wulimpuhili polo, ka kana ni ti ti jɛm o.
en: and said, Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ansarisi maaniba ʒiɛla n sani, ka n lihiri bɛ ni kuri ma suli shɛm.
en: I watch how bitterly everyone mocks me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan boli do so ŋun daa nyɛ zom maa na m-pahi buyi nti yɛl o, Paɣimi Naawuni; amaa ti lee mi ni doo ŋɔ nyɛla alahichilana.
en: So the Jewish leaders called the man who had been blind. They told him to come in again. They said, You should honor God by telling the truth. We know that this man is a sinner.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpuɣi paɣ so pah o zuɣu, di bi simdi ka o filim o bindirigu bee situra bee n-zaɣis o min o dɔnibu.
en: If a man takes a second wife, he must continue to give his first wife the same amount of food and clothing and the same rights that she had before.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpe yili maa ni, o daa dola o bindoo zuɣu o dugbɛrili ni gbihira, ka bɛ zaŋ sua n-kuhi ku o, ka ŋmaag o zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o zuɣu maa doli Araba polo yuŋ.
en: Once inside, they went to Ishbosheth's bedroom, where he was sound asleep, and killed him. Then they cut off his head, took it with them, and walked all night through the Jordan Valley.

dag: dama o daa niŋ yɛda ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Naawuni ni tooi niŋ o ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛl la.
en: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.

dag: A ni vihi m binshɛɣukam zaa ni maa, a yiŋ bimbɔ ka a nya di ni? Zaŋm li zali n dɔɣiriba min a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ninni, ka bɛ baŋ ti ni ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: You looked through everything I own and found nothing that belongs to you. If you found something, show it to me. Put it here where our men can see it. Let our men decide which one of us is right.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? A na ni nya din chihiri pam gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: He asked, Mortal man, do you see that? You will see even more disgusting things.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti nya li, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ lala. Shɛb daa pihi pampam, ka shɛb mi pihi biɛlabiɛla.
en: So that is what the Israelites did. Some people gathered a large amount, some people gathered a little.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba yɛla muɣis a. Di zabiri ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli;.
en: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, bɛn daa nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛr o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maa.
en: Then I told the crowd:.

dag: Amaa dunia ŋɔ ni ti leei tiŋgban nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did.

dag: N yi tum alahichi, a nyari ma mi, ka ku chɛ n-taali.
en: If I sinned, you would be watching me so that you could punish me for doing wrong.

dag: Amaa yinim ta li daɣiri yi ni yɛli ni ti Duuma bindirigu shee bi be nyam, ka di bindirigu maa nyɛ bɛ ni ni tooi ʒiɛm shɛl la zuɣu.
en: But you dishonor me when you say that my altar is worthless and when you offer on it food that you despise.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti zaɣisi nyin Yawɛ ka jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashitarɔt. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ fam ti ti dimnim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi, ka ti jɛmd a.
en: Then they cried to the Lord for help and said, We have sinned, because we turned away from you, Lord , and worshiped the idols of Baal and Astarte. Rescue us from our enemies, and we will worship you.

dag: dama o daa wuhirila o nyaandoliba yɛri ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni ka bɛ ti ku o; amaa bɛ yi ti ku o, o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: He wanted to teach his followers alone. He said to them, The Son of Man will be handed over to the control of other men, who will kill him. After three days, he will rise from death.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli din varim daɣiri, ka saɣim dimaŋa, ka nahindi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jerusalem, your people fought against God. They hurt other people, and you have been stained with sin.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe ŋariŋ ni yiri kpaŋa.
en: So they started out in a boat by themselves to a lonely place.

dag: Tampiligim n kul nyɛ m bindirigu, ka n nintam kul tɔɣiri luri m binnyura ni.
en: My great sadness is my only food. My tears fall into my drink.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi n nini ka chɛ ba ka bɛ ta n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ daɣiri. Ŋmɛnditoya ni ti kpe di ni nti ta li daɣiri.
en: I will not interfere when my treasured Temple is profaned, when robbers break into it and defile it.

dag: N ni garig a min a zɔnim bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: I am going to answer you and your friends too.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o mabia maa gba daa yina ka gali ʒee maa lo o nuu, ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Zɛra.
en: Afterward, his brother with the red thread on his hand came out, and he was named Zerah.

dag: Naa maa ni daa garigi yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Man Naa n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri gomna Rɛhum mini yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmara Shimshai ni yi tab bɛn kpalim be Samaria zaŋ tabili bɛn zaa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polɔnima.
en: Then King Artaxerxes sent this answer: To Rehum the commanding officer, Shimshai the secretary, and all the people with them living in Samaria and other places west of the Euphrates River. Greetings:.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ka Abimilɛk kpi maa, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: And when the Israelite soldiers saw that their leader was dead, they went back home.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa bi garig o. Ka o nyaandoliba balim o yɛli, Karim paɣ maa, dama o kuhiri doli ti.
en: But he didnt respond to her at all. His disciples came and urged him, Send her away; she keeps shouting out after us.

dag: N ni zaŋ di mini Ammɔnnim niŋ wulimpuhili polo nim nuu ni, ka bɛ su ba, ka zuliya shɛb ku lan teei Ammɔnnim yɛla.
en: Then I will give these cities to the people of the east. They will get your land. I will also let those people from the east destroy the Ammonites, and people will forget they were ever a nation.

dag: Bɛ ni ti puh a ka ti a bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi, ka a deei li bɛ nuu ni.
en: They will greet you and offer you two of the loaves, which you are to accept.

dag: ni Tiriza naa, ka bɛ zaa kalinli yiɣisi nanim pihita ni yini.
en: and the king of Tirzah. The total number of kings was .

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yɛli ya n ni yɛn niŋ n tihi puu maa shɛm. N ni sibigi di gariche bahi, ka wurim gooni din gil li, ka chɛ ka binsaɣinda kana ti saɣim li, ka daai li luhi.
en: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will pull up the thornbushes that protect it, and I will burn them. I will break down the stone wall and use the stones for a walkway.
