dag: Ka Zarai daa ti yɛli Ibram, Nyama, Yawɛ bi chɛ ka n dɔɣi bihi, dinzuɣu zaŋmi n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ dɔni, di pa shɛli o ni dɔɣi bihi ti ma. Ka Ibram daa saɣi Zarai ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Sarai told Abram, The Lord has not allowed me to have children, so sleep with my slave. Maybe she can have a son, and I will accept him as my own. Abram did what Sarai said.

dag: Chɛ ka di yuŋ maa leei bumbɔn titali. Di chɛ ka di leei suhupiɛlli dabisili pahi yuuni puuni dabisa zuɣu. Di kal li pahi goya dabisa ni.
en: I wish the darkness had carried away that night, that it was left off the calendar and not included in any of the months.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa kul maag o ni n-lihir o ni o nya Yawɛ chɛ ka o dila nasara o chandi maa ni maa bee.
en: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.

dag: Dama gɔgbihiriba gbihirila yuŋ, ka danyuriba gba nyuri kuuni yuŋ.
en: People who sleep sleep at night, and people who get drunk get drunk at night.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa nimdi duɣi luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Take the meat of the ram used for the ordination of Aaron and his sons and boil it in a holy place.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒili ti n-daari ti chana; di wum ti, ka bɛ bi chɛ ka ti vuhi.
en: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: A ni suhi ma yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.

dag: Dɛdannima, ŋmaligimiya guui, sɔɣimiya; dama n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu niŋ Iso zuliya saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Turn, flee, and run for cover, you inhabitants of Dedan. Im bringing disaster on Esau: its day of reckoning.

dag: O ni daa siɣis omaŋ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa milig o zuɣu, ka o daa bi ku ba zaa, ka biɛhigu daa lan niŋ nyaɣisim viɛnyɛliŋga Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Because he submitted to the Lord , the Lord 's anger did not completely destroy him, and things went well for Judah.

dag: Ka so yi ti nya zahimbu, ŋun miri ka o yɛli ni Naawuni n-zahim o, dama zahimbu din ni chɛ ka nir tum zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi zahim Naawuni, ka ŋun Naawuni mi ku zahim so lala.
en: Whenever you feel tempted to do something bad, you should not say, God is tempting me. Evil cannot tempt God, and God himself does not tempt anyone.

dag: Di zaŋya fukumsi biɛɣu su piɛ shɛb Naawuni ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la, amaa lee maliya biɛhigu shɛli din simdi ni bɛ doli di naba.
en: Dont be like a ruler over those you are responsible for. But be good examples to them.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, nyama, n niriba Izraɛlnim maa fabila maa paai ma, ka n nya Ijiptinim maa ni tiri ba wahala shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Now the Israelites cries of injustice have reached me. Ive seen just how much the Egyptians have oppressed them.

dag: ka lihi di goma, ka kpahindi di birininima din ni chɛ ka yi ti tooi yɛli ʒiɛmani din payana niriba:.
en: take notice of the walls and examine the fortresses, so that you may tell the next generation:.

dag: Ka Shɛlɛmia bia Hanania mini Hanun ŋun daa nyɛ Zalaf bia ŋun pah ayɔbu la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam daa mali me o ni daa be luɣ shɛli la tooni.
en: After him, Hananiah, Shelemiahs son, and Hanun, Zalaphs sixth son, repaired another section. After them, Meshullam, Berechiahs son, made repairs opposite his own room.

dag: Mabi so bɛ ni tum taali mali yaa gari fɔntiŋ din nyɛ zaɣ titali, ka lala zabili ŋmanila dapua din kpari birini dunoli.
en: Help your relatives and they will protect you like a strong city wall, but if you quarrel with them, they will close their doors to you.

dag: Judas ni daa deei laɣ shɛli o daalahichi tumbu ni la, o daa zaŋ li dala palo, ka daa ti lu ka o zuɣu sani tiŋa, ka o puli tahi ka o nyɔri zaa yina.
en: In fact, he bought a field with the payment he received for his injustice. Falling headfirst, he burst open in the middle and all his intestines spilled out.

dag: Amaa ka yi yi bi niŋ o ni daa sab shɛm maa yɛda, wula ka yi lee ni niŋ n yɛligu yɛda.
en: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how can you believe what I say.

dag: Yihim ʒiri mini yɔhiŋ n kɔbili ni. Di chɛ ka n nyɛ faralana bee bundana. Tim ma bindir shɛli din ni saɣi ma.
en: Fraud and lies— keep far from me! Dont give me either poverty or wealth; give me just the food I need.

dag: Yi yi bi nya saɣisigu kaman o bihi zaa, dindina di wuhiri ni yi pala o bihi alali, amaa yi nyɛla kaman dagɔr bihi.
en: If you are not punished, as all his children are, it means you are not real children, but bastards.

dag: Amaa o yi wum di yɛla ka di niŋ daba yi ha, di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛn zaɣisi li, dindina paɣ maa taali ni ʒi doo maa zuɣu.
en: But if the husband hears about the promises and stops them, he is responsible for breaking her promises.

dag: Amaa miri ka a lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Bɛtɛl ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla naa sara maligu bimbini shee, ka nyɛ o nam sulinsi jɛmbu shee.
en: but never again prophesy at Bethel, for it is the kings holy place and his royal house.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jɛdiayɛl daŋ ni niriba, ka daa nyɛ zuɣulaannima bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyi.
en: All of Jediaels sons were leaders of their families. They had , soldiers ready for war.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ mal o ansarisi ka dih o vi, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o.
en: He will be handed over to foreigners, who will make fun of him, mistreat him, and spit on him.

dag: Ka o zabiri piɛli kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri bee gumbɔrigu; ka o nina be kaman buɣim zilinli la.
en: His head and hair were white as white wool—like snow—and his eyes were like a fiery flame.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa bi lɛbira, ka Yawɛ daa zo ba nambɔɣu n-chɛ ka malaikanim maa gbah o min o paɣ ni o bipuɣins ayi maa nuhi ni n-vo ba yihi tiŋ maa tariga ti zali.
en: Lot hesitated. The Lord , however, had pity on him; so the men took him, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.

dag: N nyɛla a dabili; tim ma baŋsim, din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Paɣ ni tooi tam o bimɔɣirigu yɛla bee n-zaɣis o ni dɔɣi bi so nambɔɣu zɔbu? Hal o yi ni tam gba, man Yawɛ ku tam yi yɛla.
en: So the Lord answers, Can a woman forget her own baby and not love the child she bore? Even if a mother should forget her child, I will never forget you.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli suhuyiɣisili soli n-nahindi bɛ ni su zuliya shɛba, ka kul bi chɛri ba putɔɣu nahiŋgu maa.
en: that struck peoples in rage with ceaseless blows, that ruled nations with anger, with relentless aggression.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam. Ka n suhuyiɣisili maa ti lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n nini ti tiɣi li. Ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala n nyuli zabbu puuni, n suhu yi ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord , was furious because of your disobedience.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi alizanda ni na, ka o jilima neesim daa neei dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam.
en: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa ba yi zaɣisi zaa ni o ku zaŋ o bia maa ti doo maa, di simdi ka doo maa yo paɣipiɛliga bɔbu liɣiri ti paɣ maa ba.
en: But if her father absolutely refuses to let them marry, he must still pay the same amount as the bride-price for young women.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu maa paag a, gbilisim tibili wum n kuhigu shɛli n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: Hear my prayer; listen to my cry for help!.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ situra zaa.
en: Once more the Lord spoke to Moses: Go back and tell the people that today and tomorrow they must get themselves ready to meet me. They must wash their clothes.

dag: Bee ŋuni n-na mi n-dih o samli ka di nyɛ talahi ni o yo dilana?.
en: Who has ever given him anything, so that he had to pay it back.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o dan Ibrahimma laakumnim pia, ka deei pin suma balibu kam o sani n-yiɣisi chaŋ Nahɔr ya din be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: The servant took ten of Abrahams camels and left that place. The servant carried with him many different kinds of beautiful gifts. He went to Mesopotamia, to Nahors city.

dag: di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so nti yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa ti ma.
en: but you will never build it. It is your son, your own son, who will build my temple.

dag: Ka maligumaana leebu nimdi maa bee bɔrɔbɔro maa yi ti guui n-zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, dindina yin di lan ŋub li, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: If any of the meat from that ram or any of the bread is left the next morning, then it must be burned. You must not eat that bread or the meat because it should be eaten only in a special way at a special time.

dag: Iso ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi saha shɛli ka o daa kpuɣi Judit ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Bɛri la bipuɣiŋga mini Basɛmat ŋun gba nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛlɔn la bipuɣiŋga.
en: When Esau was forty years old, he married two Hittites, Judith the daughter of Beeri, and Basemath the daughter of Elon.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Nyama, n zaŋ Jɛriko mini di naa ni di tɔbbi biinsi niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, Look. I have given Jericho and its king into your power, along with its mighty warriors.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya ni zuliya yɛla saria ka mali niriba pam yɛla ti ba. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri kuri naɣikɔra kubiɛlima, ka zaŋ bɛ kpana kuri gɔriti. Ka zuliya ni zuliya ti ku lan zaŋ takɔbiri tuhi taba bee m-bɔhim tɔb tuhibu yaha.
en: God will judge between the nations, and settle disputes of mighty nations. Then they will beat their swords into iron plows and their spears into pruning tools. Nation will not take up sword against nation; they will no longer learn how to make war.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul maani ma ninʒeensi ansarisi ka bi chɛra, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ma.
en: Like those who would mock a cripple, they glared at me with hate.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ o daa zaŋla Yisa yihina nti ʒin o saria karibu ʒiishee din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gabata Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla luɣ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali.
en: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as The Stone Pavement. In Aramaic this pavement is called Gabbatha.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔguliba tuma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔra daŋ ni, bɛ daa piila Kɔre ŋun daa nyɛ Asaf bidibiga la bia Mɛshɛlɛmia.
en: These are the groups of the gatekeepers from the Korah family: There was Meshelemiah, son of Kore. Kore was from the family of Asaph.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Stiivin, ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa nya Naawuni jilima, ka nya ka Yisa ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw God's glory and Jesus standing at the right side of God.

dag: Ŋmaligim n suhu niŋ a zaligunim dolibu ni, ka chɛ azichi yoya bɔbu.
en: Give me the desire to obey your laws rather than to get rich.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ dari kpe chɛrubinima, n-dooi salima pa bɛ zuɣu, ka o zaŋ ba zali luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa.
en: He made two Cherub angels to put in the Most Holy Place. The workers covered the Cherub angels with gold.

dag: Ka n ni yɛn ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni maa zuɣu, n takɔbi ni yi di tɔɣu ni n-ku sokam bɛn be nudirigu polo mini nuzaa polo zaa.
en: From south to north, people will die.

dag: Ti nyari wahala binshɛɣukam zaa ni, amaa ti bi ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi; ti birinda, amaa ti suhuri bi saɣinda;.
en: We have troubles all around us, but we are not defeated. We often dont know what to do, but we dont give up.

dag: Hal Kriitinim ni booni bɛ ni ninvuɣ so anabi la maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya, Kriitinim kul nyɛla ʒiŋmariba mini biŋkɔb biɛri ni diribarilimnima.
en: It was a Cretan himself, one of their own prophets, who spoke the truth when he said, Cretans are always liars, wicked beasts, and lazy gluttons. For this reason you must rebuke them sharply, so that they may have a healthy faith.

dag: N Naawuni ni n Naa, n ni duh a, ka paɣ a yuli sahakam.
en: I will lift you up high, my God, the true king. I will bless your name forever and always.

dag: Paɣ maa daa yɛla ago ʒiɛɣu, ka o luɣilikam nyaɣim salima mini kuɣ viɛla yɛri ni waya, ka o gbib salima pipia o nuu ni ka chihi biɛri min o zina niŋbu tabizahim daɣiri pal li.
en: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and covered with gold ornaments, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup full of obscene and filthy things, the result of her immorality.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa ni ti nyɛla Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu zuliya biriginsim maa lee nyɛ dini? Pa Samaria? Ka Judanim buɣijɛmbo shee lee nyɛ dini? Pa Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.

dag: Ka Liya min o bihi kana ti gban o tiŋa, ka Yisifu mini Reechɛl gba doli nyaaŋa na ti gban o tiŋa.
en: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down; finally, Joseph and Rachel also came and bowed down.

dag: ka o ti kɔrig o sara maligu bimbini la nuzaa polo Yawɛ tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa ti zaŋ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: You shall kill it on the north side of the altar, and the priests shall throw its blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: amaa bɛ daa ka bia, dama Ɛlizabɛt daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo m-pahi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa lan kurigi pam.
en: They had no children because Elizabeth could not have any, and she and Zechariah were both very old.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda ka bɔhira, Masia yi ti kana, o ni wuhi shihira n-lan gari doo ŋɔ ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, di simdi ni yi niŋ n ni zali ya shɛm n-gbibi n zaligunim ka dol li.
en: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.

dag: nti kpe ŋariŋ ni bɛ baai du Kapɛrinium polo. Ka di daa mali ti zibi ka Yisa na bi ka bɛ sanna.
en: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them.

dag: A ku tooi zo n-tilig o nuu ni, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag a n-zaŋ a ti ti o. A mini Babilɔn naa maa nini ni ti nya taba, ka a zani o tooni, ka a min o tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kuli Babilɔn.
en: You wont escape but will be captured and handed over to him. You will see the king of Babylon with your very own eyes and speak to him personally, and you will be taken to Babylon.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ka chɛ buɣa jɛmbu bee n-woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those who trust the Lord , who do not turn to idols or join those who worship false gods.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: Jesus asked them, How can it be said that the Messiah will be the descendant of David?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Tama, A yidan ba chanila Timna ni o ti chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: Tamar learned that Judah, her father-in-law, was going to Timnah to cut the wool from his sheep.

dag: Ti mi yi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, niriba ni lab ti kuɣa, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: And we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. The crowd will stone us to death, because they think John was a prophet.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi di nasara, niriba malila suhupiɛlli pam, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba sɔɣirimi.
en: When good people become leaders, everything is great, but when the wicked rise to power, everyone hides.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee kpalim n-nyɛ ŋun nini daa nya n jɛmbu du kurili la jilima ni daa be shɛm? Yi ni nya jɛmbu du dini ŋɔ maa, wula ka di lee be yi sani? Di pa shɛli di bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: Is there anyone among you who can still remember how splendid the Temple used to be? How does it look to you now? It must seem like nothing at all.

dag: ka o ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi, ka kum ku lan beni bee fabila bee kumsi, ka biɛrim gba ku lan beni yaha, dama bin kura la zaa vuuya.
en: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.

dag: Ka pako faralaan so daa kana nti tɔhila pihinu diba ayi din nyɛ kɔbo.
en: Then a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth less than a penny.

dag: Sara maligu bimbini maa ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣumɔɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu.
en: The hearth is twenty-one feet square; each side is equal to the others.

dag: Di mi mali dabiɛm ni nir kpe Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ nuu ni!.
en: It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God!.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi; ka yi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni ŋɔ mi chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi.
en: Poor people, you came to worship God. You will be happy to know these things.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛn yɛli Zɛdɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then the Lord spoke to me, and I told those who had been sent to me.

dag: O chɛ ka kɔbulli ni kom gbirigiri kaman duɣu ni ka di be la; o chɛ ka teeku bemi kaman kpaʒiɛrim m-be duɣu ni la.
en: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil.

dag: Di saha ka bia maa tizɔpaɣ maa daa bɔhi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa, N cham ti boli Hiburu paɣ so ŋun mali bihim na ka o ti mɔɣis a bia maa bihim ti a.
en: At once the baby's older sister came up and asked, Do you want me to get a Hebrew woman to take care of the baby for you.

dag: Yi yi di fo yi noya, di naan leei yi baŋsim.
en: I wish you would just be quiet. That would be the wisest thing you could do.

dag: Di lan simdi ka o bo ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli, ka bɛ ti zaŋ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: and two doves or two young pigeons. Even poor people can afford these things. One bird will be a sin offering, and the other will be a burnt offering.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai di puuni palo din nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di leei Naawuni jɛmbu duu palo, ka di yaɣili kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu. Ka yi ŋmaai palo din yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu gili di zaa.
en: Out of this portion, an area seven hundred fifty feet by seven hundred fifty feet square will be for the sanctuary. All around it will be an open space seventy-five feet wide.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisirila ti zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu.
en: But we hear them in our own languages. How is this possible? We are from all these different places:.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni, ka niŋ kɔpaɣirim niŋ di ni.
en: He put the washbasin between the meeting tent and the altar, and put water in it for washing.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu kana ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni booni Naawuni sara maligu bimbini la. Ka niriba ni ti kumdi ka fabinda, ka tiŋ maa zaa ni be kaman ʒim ni ŋam sara maligu bimbin shɛli.
en: But I will punish Ariel. The city will be filled with sadness and crying, but it will always be my Ariel.

dag: ni Alammɛlɛk ni Amad ni Mishal. Zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, di daa zaŋmi hal ni Kamɛl mini Shihɔrilibinat.
en: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. It touched Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath.

dag: Nir ni tooi di bindir shɛli din be piti ka pa ni yalim be di ni? Bee nyaɣisim bɔ n-lee be no gal piɛlli ni?.
en: But who can eat flat, unsalted food? What taste is there in the white of an egg?.

dag: Paɣ ŋɔ niŋ ma o kpiɔŋ tariga, dama o zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma n-gula n sɔɣibu.
en: She has done all she could by pouring perfume on my body to prepare it for burial.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka a yɛla mali dabiɛm pam. A nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni a ni lo alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunim polo.
en: Lord God of Heaven! You are great, and we stand in fear of you. You faithfully keep your covenant with those who love you and do what you command.

dag: Yi daa wum di yɛla la ti tumtumdikpee Ɛpafiras so ti ni yura, ka o nyɛ Masia tumtumda ŋun ʒe yim ka ʒe ti zaani la sani.
en: You learned of God's grace from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who is Christ's faithful worker on our behalf.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni. Bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: People wont live any longer because of wealth; theyre just like the animals that pass away.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣim chaŋ Mizipa. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa, Yɛlim ti bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛɣu maa shɛm.
en: Meanwhile the people of Benjamin heard that all the other Israelites had gathered at Mizpah. The Israelites asked, Tell us, how was this crime committed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Itiɔpianim maa ti Asa mini Judanima ka Itiɔpianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Then the Lord used Asas army from Judah to defeat the Ethiopian army. And the army ran away.

dag: A bia maa ni ti bemi kaman mɔɣu ni buŋ la. O ti ku bɔri so yɛla, ka so gba ti ku bɔr o yɛla; ka o min o dɔɣiriba zaa ti ku tooi laɣim be.
en: But your son will live like a wild donkey; he will be against everyone, and everyone will be against him. He will live apart from all his relatives.

dag: dama Naa Hɛrɔd daa zɔri Jɔn pam ka gul o viɛnyɛliŋga, o ni daa mi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋli ni wuntizɔra la zuɣu. Jɔn Baptaizira yɛligu daa yi chihiri Naa Hɛrɔd suhu pam, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa yi wumdi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: This was because Herod respected John. He regarded him as a righteous and holy person, so he protected him. Johns words greatly confused Herod, yet he enjoyed listening to him.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ n taba kaman bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm. N ni niŋ ba yo bɛ ni niŋ shɛm samli.
en: Don't say, I'll do to them just what they did to me! I'll get even with them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛla n-kul yiri bɛ suhuri ni na, ka nia biɛri lɔbu yɛla kul be bɛ tɛha ni.
en: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi nya Yawɛ dabisili la zuɣu. Zaɣ viɛl bɔ ka Yawɛ dabisili maa yɛn tum ya? Di yɛn nyɛla zibisim dabisili, ka pa ni neesim dabisili.
en: Doom to those who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you want the day of the LORD? It is darkness, not light.

dag: Ka Dauda nachimba maa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Dauda yuli yɛli Nabal yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka kpalim ʒiɛya guhira.
en: When Davids young men arrived, they said all this to Nabal on Davids behalf. Then they waited.

dag: Yawɛ daalikaulinim nyɛla alali; di nyɛla alali kaman anzinfa maŋli shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she tiŋgban ni buɣim ni m-mal li buyopɔin ka di yi zaa la.
en: Our Lord , you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.

dag: Ka o gba daa duɣi o ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti o ba. O daa yɛlila o ba, M ba, yiɣisim ŋub a bia mɔɣu ni nimdi ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: He too made some delicious food, brought it to his father, and said, Let my father sit up and eat from his sons game so that you may bless me.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya Yila litaafi puuni: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: In the book of Psalms, David himself says, The Lord God said to my Lord: Sit by me at my right side.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suui bɛ noli maa naai ka Yisa bɔhi Saimɔn Pita, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma gari bɛmbɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛbihi.
en: When they finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, Simon son of John, do you love me more than these? Simon replied, Yes, Lord, you know I love you. Jesus said to him, Feed my lambs.

dag: Yi bindir daŋda dina, yi ni tooi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ, amaa di bi simdi ka yi nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ni di leei din nyom viɛla.
en: You can present those as first-choice offerings to the LORD, but they must not be entirely burned up on the altar as a soothing smell.

dag: O ni mi bɛ tuma zuɣu, yuŋ ka o ŋmɛri paari ba, ka ŋmɛri kabisiri ba.
en: When he learns what people have done, he defeats them, and overnight they are gone.

dag: M pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla siɣimsiɣim paai shɛm, ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan labi yɛli ya di yɛla ni nintam. Niriba pam beni ka bɛ biɛhigu zaŋ ba leela Masia dapulli zuɣu kum la dimnima.
en: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again.

dag: Dama o ni lo ni o niŋ ma shɛli maa, o ni niŋ li naai; ka lala binyara pam kul be o suhu ni.
en: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa tahibu mini tiŋgbani dambu ni pɔhim biɛɣu ni buɣim biɛɣu kana nti fa a bahi.
en: the LORD of heavenly forces will come to you with thunder, earthquake, and a mighty voice, with whirlwind, tempest, and flames of devouring fire.

dag: Di yi pa lala Yawɛ ni nya li, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o ku lan yiɣisi o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: or the LORD will see it and be displeased, and he will turn his anger from them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi mi din niŋ kamaata, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn mi li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi kuhi boli bɛ ni bi niŋ so yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi niŋ bɛ ni na bi wum so yɛla yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi wum ka pa ni waazuyihira m-beni?.
en: But before people can pray to the Lord for help, they must believe in him. And before they can believe in the Lord, they must hear about him. And for anyone to hear about the Lord, someone must tell them.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla; ka o yurilim maŋli kul beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , because he is good, and his love is eternal.

dag: A zaligunim viɛli pam, dinzuɣu ka n dol li n suhu ni.
en: Your teachings are wonderful; I obey them with all my heart.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni zaŋ a mini Izraɛlnim niŋ Filistianim nuu ni, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni a min a bidibisi sa ni be n sani, dama Yawɛ ni zaŋ Izraɛl tɔbbihi niŋ Filistianim nuu ni.
en: The LORD will now hand over both you and Israel to the Philistines. And come tomorrow, you and your sons will be with me! The LORD will hand Israels army over to the Philistines.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛli, Mmaŋmaŋ kɔbili mini mmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ m-bɔŋɔ. O yuli m-booni paɣa, dama doo niŋgbuŋ ni ka o yina.
en: The human said, This one finally is bone from my bones and flesh from my flesh. She will be called a woman because from a man she was taken.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋ Izraɛlnim maa zaa tooni.
en: Moses and Aaron bowed low to the ground in front of all the people gathered there.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o mabia paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o mabia maa paɣa.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your brothers wife. That would be like having sexual relations with your brother.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Shɛmaria ni Zaham.
en: The sons she bore him were Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

dag: Teebuya anahi n-daa ʒe di puuni, ka diba anahi ʒe samban ni dunɔdali yaɣili. Teebuya anii n-daa nyɛ li, ka bɛ kɔriti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri di zuɣu.
en: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni yi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria, o sariakaribo maa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: We know that God is right when he judges the people who do such things as these.

dag: Dabiɛm chɛmi ka ti ŋumdi kaman biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bee la, ka nandahima mi chɛ ka ti kumdi kaman ŋmana la. Ti kul guhirila yɛlimaŋli, ka bi nyari li; ka bɔri ŋun ni fa ti bahi, ka bi nyara.
en: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa lo nia biɛri ni yi saɣim yi tab la, yi nia biɛri maa ni ŋmaligi din ya. Man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya. Yi bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: Look! All of you are kindling fire, igniting torches. Walk by the light of your fire, by the torches you have ignited. This is what will happen to you by my hand: you will lie down in grief.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lo ti alikauli Sinai zoli gbini.
en: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o.
en: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and.

dag: ka bi tɛhi ni napɔŋ ni tooi no ŋ-ŋma li, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba ni tooi no li.
en: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ mini Speen ŋarima ʒirila Naawuni niriba kulisirina. Bɛ zaŋla salima mini anzinfa pahi bɛ zuɣu na ni bɛ ti tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yuli, dama o chɛ ka yi nya jilima.
en: Im the hope of the coastlands. Ships from Tarshish are in the lead to bring your children from afar, their silver and gold with them for the name of the LORD your God and for the holy one of Israel, who has glorified you.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ leei Naawuni zaligu karimbanima, amaa ka lee bi baŋdi bɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-tɔɣisiri maa gbinni bee m-mi bɛ ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ka tɔɣisiri di yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They want to be teachers of the law, but they dont know what they are talking about. They dont even understand the things they say they are sure of.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni sa gɔhi ŋar o soli, ka me gooni gu o soli, ka o ku lan tooi nya soli.
en: Therefore, I will line her path with thorns; and I will build a wall against her, so that she cant find her paths.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kaman bɛ zuliya maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm, bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannima ka be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: All these Levites were leaders of their families. They were listed as leaders in their family histories. They lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa niŋmi Barizillai ŋun nyɛ Giliad nir la bihi nirilim, ka zaŋ ba pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. Dama bɛ daa niŋ ma nirilim saha shɛli a biɛli Absalom ni daa kariti doli ma ka n zɔri la.
en: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai from Gilead and take care of them, because they were kind to me when I was fleeing from your brother Absalom.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N dabili, m mali tuun kara ni n ti a, ka a labisi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zali bɛ zaashee. N ni zaŋ a leei neesim ti tinzunnima, ka di chɛ ka n tiliginsim paai dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nima.
en: The Lord said to me, I have a greater task for you, my servant. Not only will you restore to greatness the people of Israel who have survived, but I will also make you a light to the nations— so that all the world may be saved.

dag: N ni chaŋ nimaani ti nya bɛ shiri tumdi bɛ ni yɛri ni bɛ tumdi shɛm maa zaa bee bɛ bi tumdi li.
en: I will go and see if they are as bad as I have heard. Then I will know for sure.

dag: Hal ti tuumbiɛri ni kul di shɛhira jɛndi ti maa zaa yoli, Yawɛ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli zuɣu. Ti zoya ka chɛ a siɣimsiɣim bushɛm, ka tum alahichi pam a sani.
en: My people cry out to me, Even though our sins accuse us, help us, Lord , as you have promised. We have turned away from you many times; we have sinned against you.

dag: Dama bɛ zina niŋbu maa daa bi muɣisi ba. Bɛ daa saɣim tiŋgbani maa, ka niŋ zina kuɣili kam mini tia kam gbini.
en: and was not at all ashamed. She defiled the land, and she committed adultery by worshiping stones and trees.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya li, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya n laɣifu din daa bɔrigi la.
en: When she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, Celebrate with me because Ive found my lost coin.

dag: Yi yi chana, yin yihimiya waazu yɛra, Alizanda nam mirina.
en: When you go, tell them this: Gods kingdom is now very near. .

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi lu soli gbaai chandi m-mali hal ti paai wulimpuhili polɔnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then Jacob continued his trip. He went to the country in the East.

dag: Ka kum daa wum o pam ka o bɔri bindirigu ni o di, amaa ka bɛ daa na duɣirimi; di saha maa ka o daa nya ʒii.
en: He became hungry and wanted to eat. While others were preparing the meal, he had a visionary experience.

dag: Nyama, niriba yi nuzaa polo kanna. Zuliya din mali kpiɔŋ mini nanim pam yi dunia yaɣa din be katiŋa n-damdi li kanna.
en: Look! There are people coming from the north. They come from a powerful nation. Many kings are coming together from all around the world.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Jɛrusalɛm shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A piligu shee mini bɛ ni dɔɣ a luɣ shɛli nyɛla Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A ba daa nyɛla Amɔri nira, ka a ma mi nyɛ Hiti nira.
en: Tell Jerusalem what the Sovereign Lord is saying to her: You were born in the land of Canaan. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi duɣu n-doori anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim titali n-doori salima shɛm, lala ka bɛ buɣisiri ninsal gba o paɣibu ni.
en: Fire tests gold and silver; a person's reputation can also be tested.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vihi yɛlli maa n-nya ka bɛ ni wum shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ niriba ayi maa n-zaŋ ba yili dasara. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ sab yɛlli maa yɛla niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛlikura litaafi ni o ninni.
en: There was an investigation, and it was discovered that the report was true, so both men were hanged on the gallows. The king ordered an account of this to be written down in the official records of the empire.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli suhuyiɣisili soli n-nahindi bɛ ni su zuliya shɛba, ka kul bi chɛri ba putɔɣu nahiŋgu maa.
en: In anger, the king of Babylon beat the people. He never stopped beating them. He was an evil ruler who ruled in anger. He never stopped hurting people.

dag: O nol daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka kuko shɛli yi zuɣusaa na yɛli, Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N deeg a nam yiko a sani.
en: Before the words were out of his mouth, a voice spoke from heaven, King Nebuchadnezzar, listen to what I say! Your royal power is now taken away from you.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛla mal a dabiɛm; sɔhigima, kul di chɛ ka binshɛli be a ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Be stunned at such a thing, you heavens; shudder and quake, declares the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a mɔgɔr nɛma min a tɔbu ni a lɔɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti ku mɔɣu ni valiga na.
en: So go hunting with your bow and arrows and kill a wild animal.

dag: Gbaam amaŋ ni jɛritali yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu, dama a mi ni di bahigu tahirila naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu na.
en: Avoid foolish and thoughtless discussions, since you know that they produce conflicts.

dag: Yi bi mi m mini n yaannim ni daa niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba zaa shɛm la yɛla? Tiŋgbɔna maa buɣa daa tooi tiligi di niriba n nuu ni?.
en: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?.

dag: Amaa a yi zɔri dabiɛm ni a chaŋ, nyin zaŋm a tumtumda Pura pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ.
en: but if you're still afraid, you and your servant Purah should sneak down to their camp.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha ni bɛ zaŋm tɔrokɔnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni m-mali kuli ti zaŋ bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bibihi ni yi ba n-kuli kpe na.
en: Also give your brothers some of our best wagons. Tell them to go to Canaan and bring your father and all the women and children back in the wagons.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti tɔɣisiri kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Naawuni ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu la yɛla. Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Some of the followers were talking about the Temple. They said, This is a beautiful Temple, built with the best stones. Look at the many good gifts that have been offered to God.

dag: Ka Daniɛl dimnim la daa naai noli kana ti nya o ka o suhiri la o Naawuni.
en: When Daniel's enemies observed him praying to God.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti maa na, bɛ daa kpɛla yɔɣu ni chaŋ na hal ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu n-gbaai li du n-ka Kadɛshi na.
en: When the Israelites came out of the land of Egypt, they went into the desert. They went to the Red Sea. Then they went to Kadesh.

dag: Ti mi ni o yila Juda zuliya ni na, ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda zuliya polo, Anabi Musa daa bi kali ba pahi maligumaaniba ni.
en: Its clear that our Lord came from the tribe of Judah, but Moses never said anything about priests from that tribe.

dag: Ŋunkam doli wuntitali soli ni be, amaa ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri ni kpi.
en: Anyone who is determined to do right will live, but anyone who insists on doing wrong will die.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti nyɛla yɛnnim bee jɛra, so n-ku tooi baŋ. Amaa bɛna nti yɛn su n ni zaŋ n yɛm niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.

dag: ka zaŋ noonsi gba zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni n-gbib ba ka bɛ birili ku kpihim dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Get seven pairs of all the birds. This will allow all these animals to continue living on the earth after the other animals are destroyed.

dag: Niriba ni yɛli a yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka n gba yɛli a ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: They will speak of the power of your awesome deeds; I will declare your great accomplishments.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a lee nyuri bara zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni? Naawuni nirilim niŋbu kul benimi sahakam. Dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la mini Zɛruya bia Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la, Ŋuni n-lee ni doli ma chaŋ Sool sansan ni? Ka Abishai daa yɛli, Man ni dol a chaŋ.
en: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Joab's brother Abishai, Which one of you will go with me into Saul's camp? I will! Abishai answered.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni n nyɛla a dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun su a gbibbu fukumsi, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ dɔɣim maa puuni nira ka miri dɔɣim maa gari ma gba beni.
en: It's true that I am one of the relatives who is supposed to take care of you, but there is someone who is an even closer relative.

dag: Yuuni maa puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pisiniyini dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai na ni o ti yɛl ti.
en: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke again through the prophet Haggai.

dag: Bɛn lihi ʒiɛm bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba nyɛla alahichinima, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ nandana nirilim mali alibarika.
en: It is wrong to say bad things about your neighbors. Be kind to the poor, and you will be blessed.

dag: ka zaŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa leeg a salima min a daanzinfa din viɛli pam.
en: Let Almighty God be your gold, and let him be silver, piled high for you.

dag: Daadam ŋun mali bahigu ŋɔ ni tooi be tibi gari Naawuni? Daadamnim ni tooi be kasi gari ŋun nam ba?.
en: No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hashub bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Azirikam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Hashabia mini Bunni.
en: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah son of Bunni.

dag: Bɛ karimbaani biɛhigu zuɣu, bɛ yɛrimi, Naawuni ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo; ka bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla, Naawuni kani.
en: The wicked are too proud to ask God for help. He does not fit into their plans.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka anabi yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti gbib ba.
en: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up from Egypt, and by a prophet he was guarded.

dag: O daa wuh o ni bɛ zaŋmi salima din nyɛ alali m-mali dirijaba mini taha ni pipihi, o daa lan wuhi salima laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka lan wuhi anzinfa laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: He told Solomon how much pure gold should be used to make the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers. He told him how much gold should be used to make each gold dish and how much silver should be used to make each silver dish.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn daa bɔri taali ni yibu din ni yi zaligu dolibu ni Naawuni san la daa bi nya li zaligu maa dolibu puuni.
en: And the people of Israel, who tried to make themselves right with God by following the law, did not succeed.

dag: Di saha hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la suhuri ni fuŋ dabiɛm zuɣu, dama Izraɛlnim zaa mi ni a ba mali kpiɔŋ. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani maa nyɛla bɛn mali suhukpeeni.
en: Then even your bravest men will be frightened, because all the Israelites know that your father is a powerful soldier and that his men are very brave.

dag: Di mi mali dabiɛm ni nir kpe Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ nuu ni!.
en: It is a terrible thing to face punishment from the living God.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛlishaaza daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ago kparibu na ti yɛli Daniɛl, ka bo salima dolibi din mali jilima na ti yɛl o pahi, ka chɛ ka o leei naa ŋun pah ata o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: Then Belshazzar gave an order for Daniel to be dressed in purple clothes. A gold chain was put around his neck, and he was appointed the third highest ruler in the kingdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnima, N ni darigi yi tibili, ka n ni yɛn niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu, malimiya shili gu man ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!.

dag: N ni paɣiri Naawuni so yɛligu maa, ŋuna ka n niŋ naani ka bi zɔri dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: I trust God, so I am not afraid of what people can do to me! I praise God for his promise to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ni be shɛli, naŋgbankpeeni gba bela nimaani. Ka jilima tibu yi ka shɛli, filiŋ bela nimaani.
en: When the wicked arrive, so does contempt; with shame comes insult.

dag: Yi niŋgbuna ni ti leei noombil kam mini dunia ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu, ka so ti ku beni ŋun ni kari ba.
en: Your corpses will be food for every bird in the sky and animal on earth; no one will frighten them off.

dag: Ka daa yɛli Aduna, Malimi buɣa ti ti ka di gul ti, dama ti bi lan mi Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti na maa ni kpalim shɛli.
en: So they said to Aaron, Make us some gods who will lead us. We do not know what has happened to that man Moses, who brought us out of Egypt.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi ni o kar o naba ti balim o zaŋ o lab o yiŋa. Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋla o tumtumda pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ buns ayi chaŋ. Ka o daa mali ti paari paɣ maa ba yiŋa, ka paɣ maa ba maa nya o ka chaŋ ti tuh o soli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the man decided to go after her and try to persuade her to return to him. He took his servant and two donkeys with him. The woman showed the Levite into the house, and when her father saw him, he gave him a hearty greeting.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɛfita daa tim tuumba Ammɔnnim naa sani ti bɔh o, Taal bɔ n-lee be m min a sunsuuni, ka a ti kana ni a ti tuhi ma n tiŋgbani zuɣu.
en: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king, saying, What is the problem between us that youve come against me to make war in my land.

dag: Dama a sabi yɛl shɛŋa din to pam jɛndi ma, ka chɛ ka n di wahala n ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: You even write bitter things about me, make me inherit my youthful indiscretions.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Jahinjɛya ayi bi kɔhirila siidi yini? Ka bɛ ni yino mi ku lu tiŋa ka di pala yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni.
en: Arent two sparrows sold for a small coin? But not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father knowing about it already.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhu daa bahi ku Ɛhab daŋ niriba min o ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni o zɔnim ni o tindaannim zaa bɛn daa kpalim be Jɛziriil, ka o ninvuɣ so daa bi kpalim.
en: So Jehu killed all the people in Ahabs family living in Jezreel. He killed all the important men, close friends, and priests. None of Ahabs people were left alive.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti nya. Ka bɛ daa dol o nti nya o ni kpɛri shɛli, ka kpalim o sani dindali maa, dama di daa nyɛla zaawuni kurig anahi saha.
en: Come and see, he answered. So they went with him and saw where he lived, and spent the rest of that day with him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Cham tiŋgban nɛli ni ti tuhi Musa soli. Ka o daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Naawuni zol la gbini m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: The Lord sent Aaron to meet Moses in the desert. So Aaron met Moses at Mount Sinai and greeted him with a kiss.

dag: Bɛ ni ti va bɛ yiŋ daazichi chaŋ, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali ka bɛ ti yɛn va li maa.
en: All their wealth will be destroyed in the flood of God's anger.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, N ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni n ti karila saria ka di chɛ ka bɛn bi nyari nya, ka bɛn nyari mi leei zoomba.
en: Jesus said, I came to this world to judge, so that the blind should see and those who see should become blind.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Absalom yiŋa nti bɔh o, Bɔ zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a tumtumdiba nyo m puu buɣim.
en: So Joab went straight to Absaloms house and said to him, Why have your servants set my property on fire.

dag: O bi nya ka zuɣubiɛɣu be Yaakubu zuliya ni; bee n-nya ka muɣisigu shɛli be Izraɛlnim sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa be bɛ sani. Ka bɛ yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ naa m-be bɛ sani.
en: I foresee that Israel's future Will bring her no misfortune or trouble. The Lord their God is with them; They proclaim that he is their king.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Kɛdar mini Nɛbaiɔt piɛri na nti tin ya. Yi ni ti tooi zaŋ ba mali sara n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu; ka n tibigi n jɛmbu duu din mali jilima maa.
en: All the sheep of Kedar and Nebaioth Will be brought to you as sacrifices And offered on the altar to please the Lord . The Lord will make his Temple more glorious than ever.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: Simon Peter spoke up, You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.

dag: Sagbana mini zibisim zaa gil o mi; wuntitali mini zaligu soli n-nyɛ o nam ʒiishee tanzaa.
en: Clouds and thick darkness surround God. His throne is built on righteousness and justice.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛl o niriba maa, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Sool. Ka Sool daa ti yiɣisi voli maa ni yina chaŋ o chandi.
en: So David held his soldiers in check by what he said, and he wouldnt allow them to attack Saul. Saul then left the cave and went on his way.

dag: Ka kuŋ daa ti ŋme yuntisuɣu yɛli, Aŋgo maa paana! Yimiyana ti tuh o soli.
en: At midnight someone announced, The bridegroom is coming! Come and meet him.

dag: Lihimiy o ka mali suhupiɛlli; ka vi ku be yi ninni.
en: The oppressed look to him and are glad; they will never be disappointed.

dag: Amaa Yisa ni daa nya lala maa ka di ku o suli, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: When Jesus saw this, he became angry and said, Let the children come to me! Don't try to stop them. People who are like these little children belong to the kingdom of God.

dag: ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o bɔh a, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chaŋ miri tiŋ maa ni yi ti tuhi ba? Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni tɔn ya piɛma goma zuɣu na?.
en: The king might get upset and ask, Why did Joabs army go that close to the city to fight? Surely he knows that there are men on the city walls who can shoot arrows down at his men?.

dag: Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔanim yabidoo la daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli n-daa booni Hɛla, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Naara.
en: Ashhur, Tekoas father, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

dag: Sanzali mini biisim ni chɛ ka maligim kuuri shɛm, lala ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba darigiri deeri alahichinima.
en: Drought and heat steal melted snow, just as the underworld steals sinners.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka di niŋ a alahiziba? N ni yɛl a paɣ maa min o ni bar biŋkɔb so ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia maa daashili yɛla.
en: Then the angel said to me, Why are you amazed? I will tell you the hidden meaning of this woman and the beast she rides—the beast with seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ paɣ shɛb zaa bɛn kpalim Juda nayil la chaŋ ti ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba ka bɛ yɛra, A ni daa niŋ a zo shɛb naani la n-yɔhim a nyaŋ a maa. Pumpɔŋɔ a naba firi baɣiri ni, ka bɛ zo ka chɛ a.
en: then the women of your palace will be taken prisoner by Nebuchadnezzar's officials. And those women will say to you: Friends you trusted led you astray. Now you're trapped in mud, and those friends you trusted have all turned away.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa du Galili Teeku maa duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus and his disciples crossed Lake Galilee and came to shore near the town of Gerasa.

dag: N niriba, wummiya, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm: N ni zaŋ n wuhibu wuhi niriba, n zaligunim ni ti zuliya kam zaa neesim.
en: Listen to me, my people, listen to what I say: I give my teaching to the nations; my laws will bring them light.

dag: Ŋunkam yɔhindi niriba, dilan ku be n yiŋa; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi ŋmari ʒiri, m mini dilan gba ku kpe.
en: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini, ka zaŋ Olivi tihi kpam din viɛli lita yini ŋ-ŋmiri li mali chi sara.
en: with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering mixed with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil.

dag: Kaman anzinfa ni nyɛligiri binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara puuni shɛm la, lala ka yi ni ti nyɛligi di puuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu maa.
en: In that city, you will be like silver melting in a fire. Then you will know that I am the Lord , and that I poured out my anger on you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a nam zuliya pam, ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi, ka nanim ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: I will give you many descendants, and some of them will be kings. You will have so many descendants that they will become nations.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa da palo maa Hitinim sani. Nimaani ka bɛ daa sɔɣi Ibrahimma min o paɣ Zara.
en: Thus Abraham and his wife Sarah were both buried in the field Abraham had purchased from the Hittites.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu la leei yuun kasi, ka moli yolisim nyabu molo ti bɛnkam be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani, ka sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su shɛlikam, ka lab o malibu sani.
en: You will make the th year a special year. You will announce freedom for everyone living in your country. This time will be called Jubilee. Each of you will go back to your own property. And each of you will go back to your own family.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm, lala ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: But Micaiah answered, As surely as the LORD lives, I will say only what the LORD tells me to say.

dag: Naawuni, kabisim bɛ nyina; Yawɛ, kabisim gbuɣim pola maa nyin wɔɣila la.
en: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chaŋ ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa pipihi ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa kpuɣi Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu na maa, ka naa min o kpambaliba ni o paɣiba ni o mamanim ti mal li nyuri wain maa;.
en: So they brought the gold cups that had been taken from the Temple of God in Jerusalem, and the king and his officials, his wives, and his women slaves drank from them.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be taŋkpaɣu yiya ni, ka bɛ piligu shee nyɛla taŋkpaɣu ni, ka bɛ ni tooi no n-ku ba kaman zunzuli ŋɔ?.
en: Do you think he will trust a creature of clay, a thing of dust that can be crushed like a moth?.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ni fan ya Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la, yi bi mi ni o yɔhindi ya mi ni kum ni kɔnyuri kun ya maa.
en: Hezekiah tells you that the Lord your God will save you from our power, but Hezekiah is deceiving you and will let you die of hunger and thirst.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yi ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ polo, dahin shɛli kanna ka di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: All this you see—the time will come when not a single stone here will be left in its place; every one will be thrown down.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ a hal ni n nyɛvili tariga. N ni kpuɣi n nuhi zuɣusaa m-paɣ a yuli.
en: I will give you thanks as long as I live; I will raise my hands to you in prayer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi niŋ ma, ka n daa zaŋ zibisim niŋ bɛ mini Ijiptinim maa sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka teeku kom mum ba niŋ n-di ba, ka yi nini daa nya n ni niŋ Ijiptinim maa shɛm. Ka yi daa be mɔɣu ni yuui pam.
en: they cried out to me for help, and I put darkness between them and the Egyptians. I made the sea come rolling over the Egyptians and drown them. You know what I did to Egypt. You lived in the desert a long time.

dag: Ka paɣa yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o paɣisarilim ni saha shɛl o ni be o ba yiŋa.
en: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord .

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the twelfth month. He said:.

dag: O yila Rimmon n-kana Aiyat. O chaŋ ti kpe Migirɔn gari. O chɛ o nɛma sɔŋla Mikimash.
en: The enemy army has captured the city of Ai! They have passed through Migron! They left their supplies at Michmash!.

dag: yi ni sɔŋ ma lahibal suŋ la tuma ni di piligu dali hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Im glad because of the way you have been my partners in the ministry of the gospel from the time you first believed it until now.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ pirigi teeku kom buyi; ka daa ŋme m-bɔri wɔɣ biɛri la zuɣuri kom ni.
en: With your mighty strength you divided the sea and smashed the heads of the sea monsters;.

dag: O ni daa tuui me sara maligu bimbini zali luɣ shɛl la; nimaani ka Ibram daa jɛm Yawɛ.
en: This was where Abram had built an altar earlier. So he worshiped the Lord there.

dag: Bɛ yi ti muɣisi ya tin shɛl ni, yin yimiya ni n-taɣi tiŋa; dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi na ku chaŋ tuui Izraɛl tinsi zaa ka Daadam Bia labina.
en: Whenever they harass you in one city, escape to the next, because I assure that you will not go through all the cities of Israel before the Human One comes.

dag: Di saha n ni ti taɣi niriba yɛtɔɣa ka di leei alali yɛtɔɣa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaa ti laɣim booni Yawɛ yuli n-jɛmd o ni naŋgban yini.
en: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord .

dag: Ti ni daa deei Musa noli shɛlikam ni shɛm, lala ka ti yɛn deeg a noli, amaa ti lee suhirimi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ be a sani kaman o ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la!.
en: We will obey you in the same way that we obeyed Moses. Just let the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses!.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ni ti mali ba ansarisi, ka sabisi ba bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.

dag: Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira, ka tibiri barinima;.
en: Jesus called together his twelve apostles and gave them complete power over all demons and diseases.

dag: Dauda daa lan bo kuriti pam ni bɛ mali kpahi din ni kpahi dunɔdaya pundi mini chɛulɔnima. O daa lan bo daanya pam, hal nir daa naan ku tooi zaŋ li pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: David also provided a huge amount of iron for nails for the doors of the gates and for the braces, so much bronze that it couldnt be weighed.

dag: Di ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuliya shɛb yɛri ŋumaŋuma, ka Gɛshɛm gba yɛli ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni a mini Yɛhudianim lola nia ni yi taai duŋ ni dizuɣu n-chɛ ka yi lab mɛri gooni maa. O lan yɛli ma ni a loya ni a zaŋla amaŋ leei naa.
en: It stated: It is reported among the nations and confirmed by Geshem that you and the Jews intend to rebel. This is why you are rebuilding the wall. According to these reports, you intend to become their king.

dag: Tuma maa nyɛla balibubalibu, amaa kulla Naawuni yino maa n-chɛ ka di zaa tumdi sokam zaa ni.
en: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.

dag: Ka ŋun Haman daa nyu bara o daazichi min o ni mali bidibisi shɛm zuɣu bɛ sani. O daa lan nyu bara zaŋ chaŋ naa ni duh o n-zaŋ o zali zaashe shɛl ni la min o ni nyɛ ninvuɣ titali n-gar o tab bɛn nyɛ naa tuma zuɣulaannim la gba zuɣu.
en: Haman started bragging about how rich he was. He was bragging to his friends about his many sons, and about all the ways the king had honored him. And he was bragging about how the king had promoted him higher than all the other leaders.

dag: Ka Mariama paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dali daa ti paai kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm. Ka bɛ zaŋ bia maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ti ti Duuma.
en: The time came for Joseph and Mary to perform the ceremony of purification, as the Law of Moses commanded. So they took the child to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu shɛhiranim pam ŋɔ ni gili ti ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti yihi bin tibisili kam mini din nyɛ alahichi ni zaŋ shɛli tabili ti, ka chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo zo tizɔbo shɛli din ʒe n-gul ti ŋɔ.
en: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋari ma ka sɔɣi zo, ka bi yɛli ma. N naan chɛbis a ni suhupiɛlli, ka ŋme goonjɛnim ka chaɣisi sayɛya ka yili yila niŋ a.
en: Why did you sneak away without telling me? I would have given you a going-away party with singing and with music on tambourines and harps.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛli ni o paɣ Zara nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa. Ka Gɛra Naa Abimilɛk daa tim ti zaŋ Zara na.
en: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.

dag: ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa, dilan yi nyɛla ninkurigu bee bia bee doo bee paɣa, bɛn kum o.
en: Anyone, young or old, male or female, who did not worship him was to be put to death.

dag: zaŋ tabili tiŋkpan shɛŋa zaa din gil li zaŋ hal ti paai Baalatibeer . Simiɔn zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: In addition were all the areas that surround these cities as far as Baalath-beer and Ramah of the arid southern plain. This is the legacy of the clans of the Simeonite tribe.

dag: Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka kpabi yim zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: It was square and folded double, inches long and inches wide.

dag: M mi ni yi nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya; amaa di mi zaa yoli, yi bɔri ni yi ku ma, dama n yɛligu bi kpɛri yi suhuri ni.
en: I know that you are Abrahams children, yet you want to kill me because you dont welcome my teaching.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya, Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner said to Joab, Lets have the young soldiers get up and have a contest here. Joab said, Yes, lets have a contest.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai palo shɛli din wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu n-ti Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la ka di nyɛ bɛ ni su shɛli, ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntinsi be di ni.
en: The other half of the area is to be set aside as the possession of the Levites, who do the work in the Temple. There will be towns there for them to live in.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee tiri kahiŋkɔɣu nimdi saha shɛli kum yi ti mal o bihi ka bɛ kumdi niŋdi man Naawuni, ka chani bɔri bindirigu?.
en: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry to God, move about without food?.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai tab bɔhibu ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yino ŋun yɛn niŋ lala maa.
en: Then the apostles started arguing about who would ever do such a thing.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun kura, ka lan nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ŋuna n-tahiri niriba kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka lan neeri ba.
en: The Lord kills and restores to life; he sends people to the world of the dead and brings them back again.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa neei Balaam nina ka o nya Yawɛ malaika maa ni ʒe soli ni ŋ-ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni shɛm maa, ka o silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Then the Lord allowed Balaam to see the angel. The Lord s angel was standing in the road, holding a sword in his hand. Balaam bowed low to the ground.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi Pita. Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla.
en: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter, and Peter remembered the Lords words: Before a rooster crows today, you will deny me three times.

dag: Tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini mini di dapuhi ni kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili dunol la.
en: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul laɣi zuliya shɛba zɔri maa zaa yoli, n ni laɣim bɛ zaa luɣ yini, ka di ku yuui ka bɛ piligi diri wahala bɛ nanim mini bɛ kpambaliba nuu ni.
en: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.

dag: O daa ku Amɔri Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi ni Keenan nanim zaa.
en: He defeated Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms in Canaan.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima, yiɣisima, niŋmi yaa! Naawuni tiŋ kasi ŋɔ, zaŋm a situr suma ye. Chɛfirinim mini daɣirinim ku lan kpe a puuni yaha.
en: Jerusalem, be strong and great again! Holy city of God, clothe yourself with splendor! The heathen will never enter your gates again.

dag: Di daa nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi ni, ka naa daa ʒi o kikaa saha yili ni, ka buɣim be kurupooti ni ʒe o tooni.
en: It was winter and the king was sitting in his winter palace in front of the fire.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Sool bipuɣiŋga la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya Naa Dauda ni wari waa ka yiɣiri jɛmda, ka o ʒiɛm o o suhu ni.
en: As the chest containing the LORDs covenant entered Davids City, Michal, Sauls daughter, looked out the window. When she saw King David leaping and dancing, she lost all respect for him.

dag: Zaŋm ma mali kuli, chɛ ka ti niŋ yomyom. Naa zaŋ ma kpe o duu. Ti ni di dari ka mali suhupiɛlli a zuɣu; ti ni paɣ a yurilim maa gari wain; dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yur a maa.
en: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ m bɔri ni n teei ya n ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya la. Yi daa dee li ka ʒe di ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want to call your attention to the good news that I preached to you, which you also received and in which you stand.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Juda zuliya yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gari lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Judah was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ma, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu; di saha n suhu daa paligiya pam!.
en: It made me glad when they said, Let's go to the house of the Lord .

dag: Amaa niriba biɛla be yinim Saadisinim ni n-na bi gabisi bɛ binyɛra. M mini ba ni ye binyɛr piɛla n-laɣim dol taba, dama bɛ simdi lala.
en: But you have a few people in your group there in Sardis who have kept themselves clean. They will walk with me. They will wear white clothes, because they are worthy.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ku a dabili Stiivin la, n gba daa be bɛ ni ka yu o kubu maa, ka daa gbib bɛn ku o maa binyɛra.
en: And when your witness Stephen was put to death, I myself was there, approving of his murder and taking care of the cloaks of his murderers.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Foliŋga, niŋmi kom ŋɔ sunsuuni m-pirigi kom maa buyi.
en: Then God said, Let there be a space to separate the water into two parts.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu lan yɛli ba, Di kul nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: But Joseph said to them, No! I can see that I am right. You are spies.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni.
en: Later, I went to the areas of Syria and Cilicia.

dag: N yi zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a zaligunim maa zaa ni, n ku di vi.
en: Then I wouldnt be ashamed when I examine all your commandments.

dag: Hal maligumaaniba zuɣulana mini ya ŋɔ jintɔriba zaa ni tooi di ma shɛhira, dama bɛ sani ka n daa deei gbana n-chani ni n ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Damaskus la, ka gbahi bɛn doli soli ŋɔ n-lo ba mihi tahi Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ na ka bɛ ti darigi bɛ tiba.
en: The high priest and all the council members can tell you this is true. They even gave me letters to the Jewish leaders in Damascus, so that I could arrest people there and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka tɔb daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɛza. Di saha ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Sipai ŋun daa yi tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na la, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa.
en: Later, the Israelites went to war with the Philistines at the town of Gezer. At that time Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, who was one of the sons of the giants. So those Philistines became like slaves to the Israelites.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima, o noli ni ka yɛm yɛtɔɣa yirina. Amaa ŋun ka yɛm yaaŋa deerila fiɛbiga.
en: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ti lan gariti du shɛli din yuli du pam ŋɔ gbini, di ni gari ba, ka bɛ bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini jɛmbu duu ŋɔ lala.
en: This temple is now magnificent. But when these things happen, everyone who walks by it will be shocked and will ask, Why did the Lord do such a terrible thing to his people and to this temple.

dag: ka fara lu a zuɣu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka fakari lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbia ŋun gbibi bidibbina la.
en: But while he sleeps, poverty will attack him like an armed robber.

dag: Di doli wumdi niriba ni yɛri shɛlikam, di yi pa lala, a ni ti wum ka a tumtumda tur a.
en: Don't pay attention to everything people say—you may hear your servant insulting you.

dag: Ti jɛmbu duu maa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee din mali jilima, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa pun duhi shɛli piligu ni ha.
en: From the very beginning, our Temple has been a glorious throne for God. It is a very important place.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋ o mam maa yihi ti ti ba; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o goli yuŋ maa zaa hal ti neei biɛɣu. Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ zaŋ o bahi ka o chaŋ.
en: But those evil men would not listen to the old man. So the Levite took his slave woman and put her outside with them. They hurt her and raped her all night long. Then, at dawn, they let her go.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, N yi kul yi a sani chaŋ, n ni suhi Yawɛ ni o chɛ ka zɔhi pam ŋɔ zo nyin Firawuna min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa sani biɛɣuni ŋɔ. Amaa lee di lan yɔhim n-chɛ ka niriba maa bi chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Moses answered, As soon as I leave, I will pray to the Lord that tomorrow the flies will leave you, your officials, and your people. But you must not deceive us again and prevent the people from going to sacrifice to the Lord .

dag: ka Ahimaaz nyɛ Azaria ba, ka Azaria nyɛ Jɔhanan ba.
en: Azariah, Johanan.

dag: dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanima ni bɛ nanim ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim tum zaɣ biɛɣu n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: I will destroy Jerusalem because of all the evil things the people of Israel and Judah have done. The people, their kings, leaders, their priests and prophets, the people of Judah, and the people of Jerusalem have all made me angry.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum Abarim zoya din pie tab ŋɔ zuɣu ti nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa.
en: The Lord said to Moses, One day you will go up into the Abarim Mountains, and from there you will see the land I am giving the Israelites.

dag: Ka laɣ shɛli din daa nyɛ taali tumbu sanyoo liɣiri mini alahichi sanyoo liɣiri, bɛ daa bi zaŋ li tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama din daa nyɛla maligumaaniba dini.
en: The money given for the repayment offerings and for the offerings for sin was not deposited in the box; it belonged to the priests.

dag: bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba shɛb bɛn daa gbibi kikahi la daa pa bɛ zuɣu. Ka Jɔnatan bia Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛmaya yaaŋa la pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: all of them blowing trumpets. Next, there was Zechariah of the Asaph clan.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdiba, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; di bi simdi ka yi kɔhi ba kaman daba la.
en: because they are my servants. I brought them out of slavery in Egypt. They must not become slaves again.

dag: Lihimiya Ziɔn din nyɛ ti ni puhiri ti daadiini churi tin shɛli ni la. Lihimiya Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ alaafee biɛhigu shee la. Di tanti suɣili bi vuura, ka di dasara kul ku vuɣi, ka di gabisi mi bi chihira.
en: Look at Zion, the city where we celebrate our religious festivals. Look at Jerusalem! What a safe place it will be to live in! It will be like a tent that is never moved, whose pegs are never pulled up and whose ropes never break.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa zali ba dabisili ni bɛ ka o sanna. Ka dindali maa daa ti paai ka o ye o nam binyɛrigu ʒin o nam ʒiishee n-tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: On the scheduled day Herod dressed himself in royal attire, seated himself on the throne, and gave a speech to the people.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli A bidibisi la min a bipuɣinsi la bela bɛ biɛlikpɛm la yiŋ diri bindira, ka nyuri wain.
en: That servant was still speaking, when a fourth one dashed up and said, Your children were having a feast and drinking wine at the home of your oldest son.

dag: Ka o daa ti laɣim o tumtumdiba mini bɛn mini ba tuma nyɛ tuun yinsi na nti yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni ti nyarila liɣiri ti tuma ŋɔ ni.
en: He called a meeting with these craftspeople and others working in related trades and said, Friends, you know that we make an easy living from this business.

dag: Ka bia maa tizɔpaɣa daa ʒe kpaŋa ni o nya din yɛn niŋ o.
en: The baby's older sister stood off at a distance to see what would happen to him.

dag: Zilim balli maari suhuyiɣisili, amaa yɛtɔɣ yoli yiɣisirila nir suhu.
en: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.

dag: Saha paaya ni n nyɛvili leei sara maligu Naawuni sani; n dunia ŋɔ ni yibu saha miriya.
en: My life is being given as an offering for God. The time has come for me to leave this life here.

dag: Ka so daa yɛli bɛ tab Izraɛlnim la, Nyamiya, Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la mɛla sara maligu bimbini zali Gɛlilɔt Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili polo na din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛl la.
en: The rest of the people of Israel were told, Listen! The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have built an altar at Geliloth, on our side of the Jordan.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: But Pharaoh was stubborn once again, and he wouldnt let the people go.

dag: Amaa yin teemiya yi nuu n-zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa paŋ o ni yi suhu zaa ka di saɣ o, hal di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam.
en: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunim wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la. .
en: It is no use for them to worship me, because they teach human rules as though they were my laws.

dag: nti yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ a kurigiya, ka a bihi ŋɔ mi bi dol a naba, dinzuɣu bom naa ti ti ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam ni mali nanim shɛm ŋɔ.
en: and said, You are an old man. You set a good example for your sons, but they haven't followed it. Now we want a king to be our leader, just like all the other nations. Choose one for us.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so daa ti nya Pita ni ʒi buɣim maa neesim ni n-lihir o ka ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ gba yi be Yisa sani.
en: Then a servant woman saw him sitting in the firelight. She stared at him and said, This man was with him too.

dag: Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli Ibram, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa yih a Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a ka a su li.
en: He said to Abram, I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land as your possession.

dag: Tin shɛli nim daa bi tim sandaani n-niŋ Izraɛlnima, naɣila Hivinim bɛn daa be Gibiɔn la kɔŋko. Amaa ka bɛ daa ŋme n-ku bɛn zaa kpalim la tɔb ni.
en: The only city that made peace with the people of Israel was Gibeon, where some of the Hivites lived. All the others were conquered in battle.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti Naa Jɔash daŋa ka chaŋ ka chɛ o, ka o kpambaliba daa lo o nia biɛɣu ka ku o o bindoo zuɣu, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada bia ʒim yihibu la zuɣu. Ka o daa kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o nanim silisi la ni.
en: He was severely wounded, and when the enemy withdrew, two of his officials plotted against him and killed him in his bed to avenge the murder of the son of Jehoiada the priest. He was buried in David's City, but not in the royal tombs. .

dag: amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: These things are only the beginning of troubles, like the first pains of a woman giving birth.

dag: A mi nini bi tiɣiri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la.
en: You are not pleased with the sacrifices of animals killed and burned or with offerings to take away sins.

dag: Ka Jona daa yi tiŋ maa tariga wulimpuhili polo ti ʒini. O daa sa la gara n-kpe n-ʒi di mahim guhiri ni o nya din yɛn niŋ Ninive.
en: But Jonah went out from the city and sat down east of the city. There he made himself a hut and sat under it, in the shade, to see what would happen to the city.

dag: Di bi simdi ni tinzun nir ŋun niŋ Yawɛ yɛda ti yɛli, Yawɛ ku saɣi ka m pah o niriba ŋɔ ni. Di mi bi simdi ni namɔɣili ti yɛli, Man nyɛla ti kuŋ.
en: Dont let the immigrant who has joined with the LORD say, The LORD will exclude me from the people. And dont let the eunuch say, Im just a dry tree.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a gbaai n suhu. A nina lihibu min a nyiŋgokɔrigu yabiɛlim yini chɛ ka a gbaai n suhu.
en: The look in your eyes, my sweetheart and bride, and the necklace you are wearing have stolen my heart.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ bubil polli maa ti o zo ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la ni o ti ti paɣ maa ka deeg o neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira la na, amaa ka o daa bi nya paɣ maa.
en: Judah sent his friend Hirah to take the goat and get back from the woman the articles he had pledged, but Hirah could not find her.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote this law for us: If a man dies and leaves a wife but no children, that man's brother must marry the widow so that they can have children who will be considered the dead man's children.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ʒila n ni kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma ni n kamina ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Now, do you think I came to this country to destroy it without the Lord s help? No, the Lord said to me, Go up against this country and destroy it.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa n lee bi bɔri ni n zaŋ tadabo sab li pa gbaŋ zuɣu tin ya. M mali tahima ni n ni kana ti kaai ya, ka m mini ya nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi, ka di chɛ ka ti nya suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: I have so much to tell you, but I would rather not do it with paper and ink; instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you personally, so that we shall be completely happy.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa niŋ a naani di vi; amaa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taari duŋ niŋd a ka di ka daliri la n-di vi.
en: Defeat does not come to those who trust in you, but to those who are quick to rebel against you.

dag: ka o yɛli Musa, Gbahim niriba maa toondaannima n-zaŋ kpana kuhi ba tabili bini zali wuntaŋa man Yawɛ tooni, ka n vuui n suhuyiɣisili titali maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: So he said to Moses, Take the Israelite leaders who are responsible for this and have them killed in front of my sacred tent where everyone can see. Maybe then I will stop being angry with the Israelites.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm, ŋun baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ gbinni. Ŋun nyɛ baŋda, ŋun baŋmi li. Dama Yawɛ soya nyɛla yɛlimaŋli soya, ka wuntizɔriba dol li, amaa alahichinim bɛn tuuri la di zuɣu.
en: Whoever is wise understands these things. Whoever observes carefully knows them. Truly, the LORDs ways are right, and the righteous will walk in them, but evildoers will stumble in them.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God. I am the one who brought you out of Egypt. I did this to be your God. I am the Lord your God.

dag: dindina o ni tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha dɛde, saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini saa ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa, ka yi puri atam niŋ pam, ka yi nya wain mini kpam.
en: then he will provide rain for your land at the right time—early rain and late rain—so you can stock up your grain, wine, and oil.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛlli ŋɔ puuni? Ŋun chaŋ tɔb maa tuhibu shee tarili ni nyɛ shɛm, ŋun ʒiya guli nɛma gba tarili yɛn nyɛla lala. Bɛ zaa tarili yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: Who would pay attention to you, anyway? Soldiers who stay behind to guard the camp get as much as those who go into battle.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla ŋun be neesim ni, ka shɛli ka di ni din ni chɛ ka so tuui.
en: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa niriba daa be kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ yaannim maa n-daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Mɛshulam ni Shiiba ni Jɔrai ni Jakan ni Zia ni Ɛba. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.

dag: m-bol o yuli Nuhu ka yɛli, Bia ŋɔ ni sɔŋ ti ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni, Yawɛ ni yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: and said, From the very ground on which the Lord put a curse, this child will bring us relief from all our hard work; so he named him Noah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi Izraɛl kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb a ni mi ka bɛ nyɛ niriba maa kpamba ni zuɣulaannim bɛn su ba n-zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbinna, ka bɛ ti zani nimaani pah a zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Moses: Choose of Israel's respected leaders and go with them to the sacred tent.
