dag: Zimiri daa ku Baasha daŋ niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛhu yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Baasha polo la.
en: Zimri destroyed the entire house of Baasha in agreement with the LORDs word that had been spoken by the prophet Jehu to Baasha.

dag: N yi tam a yɛla, bee n yi bi lihi nyin Jɛrusalɛm ka a gari shɛlikam m bebu ni, n zilinli din leemi zilin tabinli.
en: May I never be able to sing again if I do not remember you, if I do not think of you as my greatest joy!.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni zaligu malaikanim nuu ni, amaa ka lee bi dol li.
en: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ man Yawɛ ninni? Nyini n-ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka Ammɔnnim zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka a kpuɣ o paɣa n-leeg a paɣa.
en: Why have you despised the LORDs word by doing what is evil in his eyes? You have struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and taken his wife as your own. You used the Ammonites to kill him.

dag: Bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka kaɣi ʒe kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Bɛ bi zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ tuhi nintɔri n tooni.
en: They treat me with disgust; they think they are too good for me, and even come and spit in my face.

dag: Nyin zoli din do Zɛrubabɛl tooni ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee nyɛ a? A ni leei tintani. O ni me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa. Ka o yi ti zaŋ kuɣ shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa pa di zuɣu, di saha maa niriba ni ti kuhi yɛli, Naawuni nirilim galisiya, Naawuni nirilim galisiya. .
en: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, God has been very kind.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a ʒim zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani hal ti taɣi zoya, ka a ti pali kulibɔna.
en: and your blood will flow throughout the land and fill up the streams.

dag: Dama yi dolila Omri zaligunima, ka tumdi Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa, ka doli bɛ kaya. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi yiya kpalim zani dabari, ka di niriba nya filiŋ, ka zuliya kam zaa ti mali ya ansarisi.
en: This will happen because you have followed the evil practices of King Omri and of his son, King Ahab. You have continued their policies, and so I will bring you to ruin, and everyone will despise you. People everywhere will treat you with contempt.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bia, n daa tɔɣisirila bilim yɛtɔɣa, ka mali bia tɛha, ka buɣisiri yɛla bilim buɣisibu; amaa n ni daa ti bi doo, ka n chɛ bilim soya zaa.
en: When I was a child, I used to speak like a child, reason like a child, think like a child. But now that I have become a man, Ive put an end to childish things.

dag: Yawɛ, guli ma ka yihi ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, Guli ma ka yihi ma duŋtaariba bɛn lo ni bɛ chɛ ka n lu la nuu ni.
en: Protect me, Lord , from the power of the wicked; keep me safe from violent people who plot my downfall.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai mɔɣu ni bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la nyaaŋa yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni la ni n-yɛli.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Sinai desert in the first month of the second year after they had left the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb bɛn zooi gari o ni tuui tim shɛb maa, ka bɛ ti niŋ bɛ gba lala.
en: Again the man sent other slaves, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.

dag: dama daba ayopɔin dali yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli yɛli: Naawuni daa vuh o tuma zaa puuni daba ayopɔin dali.
en: Then somewhere he said this about the seventh day of creation: God rested on the seventh day from all his works. .

dag: Musa daa nyɛla tarima n-gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Moses was a humble man, more humble than anyone else on earth.

dag: Ti sa bela puu ni lɔri kabɔba, yim ka n ti nya ka n kabɔbili yiɣisi zani, ka yi kabɔba laɣimna ti gili n kabɔbili maa n-damdi li tiŋa.
en: We were all working in the field, tying stacks of wheat together. Then my stack got up. It stood there while all of your stacks of wheat made a circle around mine and bowed down to it.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa lan yi Libina n-gari chaŋ Lakishi ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: Joshua along with all Israel moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They camped near it and attacked it.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: You people are captives. I forced you to leave Jerusalem and go to Babylon. So listen to the message from the Lord .

dag: Tiŋ maa ni yulilaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Pubilius ka o puri do m-miri nimaani la n-daa deei ti kpɛhi o yiŋa n-niŋ ti saani dabisi muna ata.
en: Not far from that place were some fields that belonged to Publius, the chief of the island. He welcomed us kindly and for three days we were his guests.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ neen yinsi din nyɛ salima kɔtomsi gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-wuɣi shɛlɔrigu ka di mini binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: The vests belt should be attached to it and made in the same way of gold, of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and fine twisted linen.

dag: Amaa maligumaana Zadok mini Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ni anabi Neetan ni Shimɛi ni Rɛi ni Dauda ninvuɣ kpɛma la daa ka Adɔnija polo.
en: But Zadok the priest, Jehoiadas son Benaiah, the prophet Nathan, Shimei and his friends, and Davids veterans didnt join Adonijah.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa m-miri ba ka pa ni saa, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha din daa nyɛ Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia mi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha la, ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa kana ti teei gili Samarianima.
en: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Ti Duuma ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ sahi takɔbi, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei.
en: Son of man, speak to the people for me. Say this, This is what the Lord says: Look, a sword, a sharp sword, and it has been polished.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee maa zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋme tampiŋ maa buyi, ka kom pam daa yi di ni na, ka niriba maa mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa daa nyu.
en: He raised his stick in the air and struck the rock two times. At once, water gushed from the rock, and the people and their livestock had water to drink.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tam Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi maa ni la yɛla, dama bɛ ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: Do not neglect the Levites who live in your towns; they have no property of their own.

dag: dama Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa zaŋ wuntia soli ka yi sanna la, yi daa bi niŋ o yɛda; amaa ka farigudeeriba mini pagɔra bɛn daa niŋ o yɛda. Ka hal yi ni daa nya lala maa zaa yoli, di nyaaŋa yi daa bi niŋ tuuba ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: For John came to you on the righteous road, and you didnt believe him. But tax collectors and prostitutes believed him. Yet even after you saw this, you didnt change your hearts and lives and you didnt believe him.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n taali niŋ kpalaŋ ni lo li, ka a ti zaŋ bini limsi n tuumbiɛri.
en: It would be as if you had sealed my sins in a bag. It would be as if you had covered my guilt with plaster.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, M ba mini m biɛyanim zaŋ bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ ni su shɛlikam yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, bɛ be Goshɛn tiŋgban ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: So Joseph took five of his brothers and went to the king. He told him, My father and my brothers have come from Canaan with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own. They are now in the region of Goshen.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ nira n-ti yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa, bɛ naa ti yɛn yila bɛ sunsuuni na. N ni voog o mirina, ka o ti be n sani. Dama so ku tooi ka n sanna omaŋmaŋ yiko ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their ruler will come from their own nation, their prince from their own people. He will approach me when I invite him, for who would dare come uninvited? They will be my people, and I will be their God. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa naai Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min omaŋmaŋ yili maa tuma zaa. Naa Sulemaana ni daa lo nia ni o tum tuun shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni min omaŋmaŋ yili maa ni maa daa tum naai zaa.
en: The Lord 's temple and Solomon's palace were now finished. In fact, everything Solomon had planned to do was completed.

dag: Ka o daa bi tooi baŋ o, dama o nuhi daa malila kɔbiri ŋ-ŋman o biɛli Iso nuhi. Ka o daa yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: He did not recognize Jacob, because his arms were hairy like Esau's. He was about to give him his blessing.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, A ni zaŋ paɣ so ti ma ni o be n san la, ŋuna n-zaŋ tia maa walli maa ti ma ka n di.
en: It was the woman you put here with me, the man said. She gave me some of the fruit, and I ate it.

dag: Di zaŋya bɛ ni ja biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmahim biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni chahi biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai biŋkɔb so lana m-mali sara ti Yawɛ bee m-mali sara yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If an animal has bruised, crushed, or torn testicles, you must not offer that animal to the Lord . You must not do this anywhere in your land.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa wum naa ni kari saria maa ŋ-ŋmaai li shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa lu naa maa sizuura, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni Naawuni yɛm be o ni, ka o ni kariti saria ka di doli zaligu soli.
en: When the people of Israel heard of Solomon's decision, they were all filled with deep respect for him, because they knew then that God had given him the wisdom to settle disputes fairly.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi binyɛra maa ni be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni dilan paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean. They must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: A wuhiya ni chɛfirinim mali taali, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bahi yoli; ka a kpihim bɛ yuya zaa zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.

dag: O nina daa ŋmanila buɣim zilinli, ka nam zuɣupila pam pil o zuɣu ni; ka yu shɛli sabi tab o, ka so ʒi li pah o zuɣu.
en: His eyes were like burning fire. He had many crowns on his head. A name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew its meaning.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa yiŋbihi daa kana ti bɔh o, Ti dana, pa alikama suma ka a daa biri a puu la ni? Ka di chaŋ wula ka piriŋkpana ti be di ni.
en: The servants of the landowner came and said to him, Master, didnt you plant good seed in your field? Then how is it that it has weeds.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, a kul darigirila n tibili; ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai kaman wuuni saha tulim ni nyuuri mahili shɛm la.
en: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.

dag: Bɛ mali nuhi, amaa di bi tabisiri shɛli. Bɛ mali naba, amaa di bi chana. Bɛ ku tooi zaŋ bɛ kukoya yɛli shɛli.
en: They have hands, but they cant feel. They have feet, but they cant walk. They cant even make a noise in their throats!.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: The Kohathite family groups were given the area to the south of the Holy Tent. This was the area where they camped.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani tariga daa nyɛla Jaza zaŋ tabili Giliad tin kara zaa ni Amɔrinim tiŋgbani pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Aroa din be Raba wulimpuhili polo la.
en: It included the town of Jazer, and in the Gilead region their territory took in the land and towns as far east as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah. This was about half of the land that had once belonged to the Ammonites.

dag: Di saha ka n kuhi yɛli, N Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, dim suɣilo. Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: Then I said, Stop, O Sovereign Lord ! How can your people survive? They are so small and weak.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bemi kaman Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, If you hear God's voice today.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la kalinsi nyaaŋa, Juda Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu pahi dunia yili.
en: Amaziah lived years after Jehoash died.

dag: Adam ni daa dɔɣi Sɛt maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After that, Adam lived another years. He had other children.

dag: A ni neei zoomba nina, ka yihi dansarikanim bɛn be zibisim ni la bahi.
en: You will make the blind able to see. You will free those who are held as captives. You will lead those who live in darkness out of their prison.

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣimla Mizipa, ka bɛ nanim daa lo tɔbu n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi ba. Ka Izraɛlnim daa wum li ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had assembled at Mizpah, the Philistine rulers went up to attack Israel. When the Israelites learned of this, they were afraid of the Philistines.

dag: Di yi ti nyɛ asiba, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla zaawuni. Ka zaawuni yi ti paai, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla asiba. Dabiɛm din ti yɛn be yi suhuri ni mini yi nina ni ti yɛn nya binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Your hearts will pound with fear at everything you see. Every morning you will wish for evening; every evening you will wish for morning.

dag: amaa benyala kasi yi biɛhigu zaa puuni kaman Naawuni ŋun boli ya la ni be kasi shɛm.
en: Instead, be holy in all that you do, just as God who called you is holy.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim ni bɛn nyu wain buɣi la, bɛ ni ti no n-taai ba.
en: The drunks of Ephraim are proud of their beautiful crown, but that city will be trampled down.

dag: Dama ti Duuma kul ku zaɣisiri nir sahakam.
en: The Lord is merciful and will not reject us forever.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini niɣi ni biŋgbamda ni binyiɣira zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord !.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa tuumba ayi maa ni bɛ na yim kpaŋ pɔi. Ka jintɔriba maa daa niŋ tab saawara.
en: So they told them to leave the Council room, and then they started discussing among themselves.

dag: Ka Sool daa yi kul tim Dauda luɣ shɛlikam zaa, o ti nyarila nasara, lala zuɣu ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda leei tɔbbihi zuɣulana, ka lala daa tiɣi niriba zaa nini, ka lan tiɣi Sool tumtumdiba zaa nini.
en: David was a success in everything that Saul sent him to do, and Saul made him a high officer in his army. That pleased everyone, including Saul's other officers.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord had told Moses:.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni tumtumdiba, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn tumd o yubu ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ.
en: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord !.

dag: Bidɔɣirisurigu tam bɛ yɛla, ka zunzuya di ba ka bɛ nyaɣisa; ka so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛtali lurimi kaman tia la.
en: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.

dag: Zoya ni fɔntinsi ni mini Shɛfɛla fɔntinsi ni ni Nɛgɛb fɔntinsi ni ni Bɛnjamin zuliya fɔntinsi ni ni luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm la ni Juda fɔntinsi ni piɛguliba ni ti lan kaani bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In the towns in the hill country, in the foothills, and in southern Judah, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem, and in the towns of Judah, shepherds will once again count their sheep. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa Naawuni so be alizanda ni ka nyɛ ŋun kahigiri ashiya gbinni wuhiri niriba. Dina n-chɛ ka o kahigi yɛl shɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha n-wuhi nyin Naa Nɛbukadnɛza. N ni yɛl a a zahindi maa min a ni daa nya ʒii shɛli a gom puuni maa.
en: But the God who rules from heaven can explain mysteries. And while you were sleeping, he showed you what will happen in the future.

dag: Amaa Rubin ni daa wum li, ka o fa o bɛ nuu ni ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka ti di o nyɛvili.
en: When Reuben heard what they said, he saved him from them, telling them, Lets not take his life.

dag: Yi yi ti di n-tiɣi, ka me yiya viɛla be di ni.
en: When you eat, get full, build nice houses, and settle down.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yiɣisim taŋkpaɣu ni n-dam amaŋa. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yihim mii din be a nyiŋgol ni bahi.
en: Shake the dust off yourself; rise up; sit enthroned, Jerusalem. Loose the bonds from your neck, captive Daughter Zion!.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, M bihi, n ku lan yuui yi sani. Yi ni ti bo ma kɔŋ; n ni daa yɛli Yɛhudianim shɛm la, lala ka n yɛri yi gba maa, n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: Little children, Im with you for a little while longer. You will look for me—but, just as I told the Jewish leaders, I also tell you now—Where Im going, you cant come.

dag: Yi Duuma lan yɛli yaha, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnima dabisi shɛŋa din kanna ni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ tɛha ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni; ka n ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi ti nyɛ n niriba.
en: This is the new agreement I will give the people of Israel. I will give this agreement in the future, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their minds, and I will write my laws on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Ka Mɛɔnɔtai daa nyɛ Ofira ba. Sɛraya daa nyɛla Jɔab ba, ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ Gɛharashimnim yabidoo. Din daa chɛ ka bɛ boli ba lala maa nyɛla, bɛ daa nyɛla nuhi tuumbaŋdiba.
en: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called Valley of Crafts because the people who lived there were experts in making things.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda, Nyini n-nyɛ lala nir maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa piig a leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka daa fa a Sool nuu ni bahi.
en: Then Nathan said to David, You are that rich man! This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I chose you to be the king of Israel. I saved you from Saul.

dag: Pool ni daa nya ʒii maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa dii gbaai nia lɔbu ni ti chaŋ Masidɔnia maa ti ni daa baŋ ni Naawuni n-tim ti ni ti ti yihi Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ waazu ti nimaani nim gba zuɣu.
en: As soon as Paul had this vision, we got ready to leave for Macedonia, because we decided that God had called us to preach the Good News to the people there.

dag: Amaa yiya din be tiŋkpan shɛŋa bɛ ni bi me goma gili ni, din mini puri din be mɔɣu ni ni ti nyɛla yim, bɛ ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, ka ni ti tooi lan deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: Towns without walls around them will be treated like open fields. So houses built in these small towns will go back to the first owners at the time of Jubilee.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n je anabi shɛb bɛn mali bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisiri ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I am also against those prophets who speak their own words and claim they came from me.

dag: O daa chɛ ka mɔɣa leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina kuui.
en: The Lord made rivers dry up completely and stopped springs from flowing.

dag: dama bɛ daa wum ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa paɣiri Naawuni. Di saha ka Pita bɔhi.
en: For they heard them speaking in strange tongues and praising God's greatness. Peter spoke up:.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o sɔŋda Bidikar, Yihim o bahi Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ŋɔ ni. Ka bɔh o, A teei m min a ni daa laɣim dol o ba Ɛhab nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo la?.
en: Jehu said to his chariot driver Bidkar, Take Jorams body up and throw it into the field of Naboth from Jezreel. Remember when you and I rode together with Jorams father Ahab, the Lord said this would happen to him.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa ŋme tɔbuchiriga bah o zuɣu ka o daa lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim yih o na n-vo o tahi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The nations heard about him and trapped him in a pit. With hooks they dragged him off to Egypt.

dag: N ni ti yihi yi ni bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba la mini bɛn birigi n sani la bahi. N ni ti yihi ba bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nyɛ saamba la na, amaa bɛ ti ku kpe Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will take away from among you those who are rebellious and sinful. I will take them out of the lands where they are living now, but I will not let them return to the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Yisahaku, Yiɣisim ti sani, dama a mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: Abimelech said to Isaac, Leave our country. You have become much more powerful than we are.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa garigi yɛli Jɛfita, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, hal Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti min a zaa shɛhiralana.
en: You have our word, the leaders answered. And the Lord is a witness to what we have said.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Di chaŋ wula ka yi booni ma yi Duuma, yi Duuma, ka lee bi tumdi tuun shɛŋa n ni wuhi ya ni yi tum?.
en: Why do you keep on saying that I am your Lord, when you refuse to do what I say?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla bundaannima, amaa ka ka shɛli, ka shɛb mi niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla faranima, amaa ka mali buni pam.
en: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.

dag: Di ni sɔhigi kaman buɣim ni chɛ ka kom din tam di zuɣu kpeeri shɛm la. Kamina ti wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm a dimnim sani, ka zuliya kam zaa ni sɔhig a tooni.
en: They would tremble like water boiling over a hot fire. Come and reveal your power to your enemies, and make the nations tremble at your presence!.

dag: Abishur paɣ yuli n-daa booni Abiheel, ŋuna n-daa dɔɣi Ahiban mini Molid.
en: Abishur married a woman named Abihail, and they had two sons, Ahban and Molid.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma mi tuhi pia. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba du Sɛla Zoli zuɣu nti daai ba Sɛla Zoli maa zuɣu luhi zolɔŋni, ka bɛ zaa chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: He captured , more soldiers and dragged them to the top of a high cliff. Then he pushed them over the side, and they all were killed on the rocks below.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa yɛli, Naa Agiripa mini yi zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, doo ŋɔ yɛla ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini ya ŋɔ zaa kul mali doli ma n-kuhiri yɛri ni o bi simdi ni o be la.
en: Festus said, King Agrippa and all who are here with us: You see this man against whom all the Jewish people, both here and in Jerusalem, have brought complaints to me. They scream that he should not live any longer.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali takɔriti niŋ li, ka di sambani polo yɛlima, ka di puuni polo nyɛ zaɣ muɣilinga.
en: The windows were narrow on the outside but wide on the inside.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi.
en: There were once seven brothers. The first one married, but died without having any children.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla yɛm wuhibu ni be shɛli ni, ka maŋsiɣisibu be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: The fear of the LORD is wise instruction, and humility comes before respect.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi tumla alahichi paai Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He sinned against the Lord , but not as much as the kings who had ruled Israel before him.

dag: Teebuya ayi n-daa ʒe zɔntua maa samban ni dunɔdali nuzaa polo, ka teebuya ayi ʒe zɔntua maa dunɔdali yaɣ din la polo.
en: Outside, two pairs of tables flanked the entrance of the north gate at both ends, at the steps on one end and the porch on the other.

dag: Hal bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ zaa. N yi zo ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni nya mbusim.
en: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm viɛnyɛliŋga din ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni? Banim ka Yawɛ lee tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li moli? Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bahi yoli doya kaman tiŋgban nɛli, ka so bi lan gariti nimaani?.
en: I said to the Lord , None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa ŋmari daɣu ka o lɛbiɛlim ti kpaai lu kom ni. Ka o kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Ndana! N suhi li mi na.
en: But when one man was cutting down a tree, the iron ax head slipped from the handle and fell into the water. He shouted, Oh, master! I borrowed that ax.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Uzia bia Jɔtam mi daa di Juda nam.
en: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Firawuna, Zalim ma saha shɛli a ni bɔri ni n suhi Naawuni ti a min a niriba ni a kpamba zaa, ka poloya maa kpi yi yinsi, ka chɛla bɛn be Nail Mɔɣili ni la kɔŋko.
en: Moses said to Pharaoh, Have it your way. When should I pray for you and your officials and your people to remove the frogs from your houses, courtyards, and fields? Theyll stay only in the Nile.

dag: Di kali ma pah alahichinim ni. Di ku ma kaman ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: Lord, dont treat me like one of those sinners. Dont kill me with those murderers.

dag: A yi ŋmaligi labi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, o ni labis a zali a zaashe kurili ni. A yi yihi ninvuɣ biɛtali zaa a yiŋa.
en: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.

dag: Bɛ yi kul saɣisiri nira, ka o kul niŋdi tipawumli, o ni ti kabisi yim ka ku lan tooi tib kpaŋ.
en: One who stays stubborn after many corrections will be suddenly broken, beyond healing.

dag: Zoomba nina neera, ka wɔbisi chana, ka kɔnsi tibiri kpaŋda, ka tikpiranim wumda, hal ka kpiimba gba neeri kum ni, ka lahibal suŋ waazu mi yihiri tiri tarimba.
en: the blind can see, the lame can walk, those who suffer from dreaded skin diseases are made clean, the deaf hear, the dead are brought back to life, and the Good News is preached to the poor.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: How happy are those who have no doubts about me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus went from there to the area of Tyre and Sidon.

dag: Paɣ bi simdi ni o ye doo situra, ka doo gba bi simdi ka o ye paɣ situra, dama ŋunkam niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima, di nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Women must not wear mens clothes, and men must not wear womens clothes. Everyone who does such things is detestable to the LORD your God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya Adɔnibɛzɛk Bɛzɛk maa n-chɛ ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Keenannim mini Pɛrizinim maa.
en: They found Adonibezek there and fought him.

dag: Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la ti ma suhumahili kaman a ni lo mani a dabili ŋɔ alikauli shɛm la.
en: Let your constant love comfort me, as you have promised me, your servant.

dag: Dama n ni zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will defend this city and save it for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.

dag: Amaa bɛn zo n-tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka di be kasi. Ka Yaakubu zuliya ni ti lan deei bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ la su yaha.
en: The Lord 's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa be n-yɛri ago kpariti mini binyɛr suma, ka dir o suhu yubu sahakam.
en: There was once a rich man who wore expensive clothes and every day ate the best food.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ, n suhir a, deemi n nyɛvili, dama n kum so m bebu.
en: Now then, Lord , let me die. I am better off dead than alive.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: This is a message from the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: O daa lan wuhi ma shɛli. Nyama, n daa nyami ka n Duuma ʒe bɛ ni zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu buɣisi m-me goon shɛli gbini; ka bimbuɣisirigu maa be o nuu ni.
en: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din kuri niriba mini fiɛɣufiɛɣu ni bimmɔrima ni biisim titali ni sanzali ni yi ni bi mi dɔr shɛŋa ni maligu lu yi zuɣu m-mali ya hal ka yi ti kpi.
en: The LORD will strike you with consumption, fever, and inflammation; with scorching heat and drought; with destruction and disease for your crops. These things will chase you until you are dead and gone.

dag: Miriya ka yi ta yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa daɣiri. N gba bela di ni, dama man Yawɛ bela Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
en: You will not make the land in which you live unclean, the land in the middle of which I reside, for I the LORD reside among the Israelites.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Bɔhimi nya ŋun bia bala.
en: Then find out! Saul told him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti be Ɛngɛdi sɔɣisili shee.
en: David left and went to the region of Engedi, where he stayed in hiding.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbihi daa kul lɔri tɔbu na ti tuhiri ba, amaa bɛ daa yi kul lo tɔb na, Dauda n-tuhiri diri nasara gariti Sool sapashinnim maa zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Dauda yuli du pam.
en: The Philistine armies would come and fight, but in every battle David was more successful than any of Saul's other officers. As a result David became very famous.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ŋun nyɛ ŋun niŋdi zina bee ŋun tumdi daɣiri tuma bee ŋun kɔre kpɛri binyara ni ti ku nya shɛli Masia mini Naawuni nam ni, dama binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: Because you know for sure that persons who are sexually immoral, impure, or greedy—which happens when things become gods—those persons wont inherit the kingdom of Christ and God.

dag: ka n daa ti nya ʒii ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Zom yom yi Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ ku deeg a shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ m polo.
en: I saw Jesus, and he said to me, Hurry and leave Jerusalem now! The people here will not accept the truth you tell them about me.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so dabidoo bee dabipaɣa, di simdi ka nahu maa lan yo dabili maa lana anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o.
en: If the bull kills a slave, you must pay the slave owner pieces of silver for the loss of the slave, and the bull must be killed by stoning.

dag: Jarɛd ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiyɔbunaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Inok.
en: When Jared was , he had a son named Enoch.

dag: O wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu; ka di chɛ ka n ni tooi zaŋ n nuhi dahim daanya tɔbu.
en: who trains my hands for war so my arms can bend a bronze bow.

dag: Paɣimiya Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni, dama o kana ti kaag o niriba ka tiligi ba.
en: Bless the Lord God of Israel because he has come to help and has delivered his people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka o kukoli be o tɔbbihi tooni tahira. Dama o tɔbbihi galisiya pam, ka bɛn deer o noli ka kalinli. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ dabisili nyɛla dabisili titali ka mali dabiɛm pam. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li?.
en: because the LORD utters his voice at the head of his army. How numerous are his troops! Mighty are those who obey his word. The day of the LORD is great; it stirs up great fear—who can endure it?.

dag: N kul gbibi n yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani sahakam, ka gbibi m min o daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I will always keep my promise to him, and my covenant with him will last forever.

dag: Ŋuni mini tuumbiɛtumdiba n-lee laɣim be, ka o mini ninvuɣ biɛri doli?.
en: He is a friend of evil people. He likes to spend time with the wicked.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinu.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Gad were .

dag: Ka yi yi bi pal alikauli ni so bini, ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ yimaŋmaŋ dini ni nyɛ shɛli tin ya?.
en: And if you cannot be trusted with the things that belong to someone else, you will not be given anything of your own.

dag: Tinzun nira yi di a samli, a ni tooi bɔh o dee li, amaa a mabia ŋun be yi ʒilɛl ni ŋuna, di simdi ni a ku san shɛli din be a min o sunsuuni.
en: You are allowed to demand payment from foreigners, but whatever is owed you from your fellow Israelites you must forgive.

dag: bɛn ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ yuli.
en: who stand in the Lord 's house, in the Temple of our God.

dag: Yɛhudianim pam ni daa wum ni Yisa be nimaani maa ka bɛ daa kana. Pa Yisa kɔŋko zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana, amaa bɛ daa kamina ni bɛ ti nya Lazarɔs so Yisa ni daa neei kum ni la.
en: Many of the Jews heard that Jesus was in Bethany, so they went there to see him. They also went there to see Lazarus, the one Jesus raised from death.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn min o nyaandoliba ayi ʒiɛya;.
en: The next day John was standing again with two of his disciples.

dag: Yisa min o ni daa yur o nyaandol so la n-daa ʒi n-tab taba.
en: One of the disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was sitting next to Jesus.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa yɛli, Naa Agiripa mini yi zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, doo ŋɔ yɛla ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini ya ŋɔ zaa kul mali doli ma n-kuhiri yɛri ni o bi simdi ni o be la.
en: Festus said, King Agrippa and all of you gathered here with us, you see this man. All the Jewish people, here and in Jerusalem, have complained to me about him. When they complain about him, they shout that he should be killed.

dag: Ka a yihi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi din be piɛɣu puuni n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la zaɣ kpil yini mini maha din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini.
en: Add one loaf of bread, one flatbread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that was presented to the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli naa, N suhir a mi, a yi ku chaŋ, nyin lee chɛ ka ti mini m mabia Amnɔn chaŋ. Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔri ni yi min o chaŋ.
en: Then Absalom said, If you wont come, then let my brother Amnon go with us. Why should he go with you? they asked him.

dag: Amaa zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu be asama gari Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibil fifinyiiŋa gba yiɣisibu.
en: Its easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for the smallest stroke of a pen in the Law to drop out.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya biŋkɔb so ka o yi tiŋgban ni na. O daa malila yila ayi kaman piɛbil yila la, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o lɔŋ ŋmani waɣ biɛ tital la lɔŋ.
en: Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, but he talked like a dragon.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn baŋ ka a pun chɛ ba luhi kaman mɔri la. Nyin Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni, a ni pɔbisi ba bahi ka bɛ na nɛmi.
en: Before they know it, they are cut down like weeds; in his fierce anger God will blow them away while they are still living.

dag: Daadam Bia ni chaŋ kaman di ni ʒe o shɛm, amaa mbusim be ŋun yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will die as God has decided, but how terrible for that man who betrays him.

dag: Madimɛnanim mini Gɛbimnim zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi.
en: The people of Madmenah and Gebim are running for their lives.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ tumtumdiba maa ni tuumbaŋdiba zaa daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa; ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi.
en: The most skilled men among those doing the work made the Tent of the Lord 's presence. They made it out of ten pieces of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma maŋmaŋa ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna la ni o timiya suhudoo sahakam mini yɛlli kam ni. Ti Duuma kul kpalimmi be yi zaa sani!.
en: May the Lord himself, who is our source of peace, give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with you all.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti dana, ti bɔri ni a neela ti nina ŋɔ ti ti.
en: They answered, Lord, we want to be able to see.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna Pailɛt yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: During the festival, Pilate released one prisoner to them, whomever they requested.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tia kam wulli zooi ka viɛla. Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa tiligi ni ti nya ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiwala viɛla, ka nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: At that time the Lord s plant will be very beautiful and glorious. The people in Israel who survived will be very proud of what the land grows.

dag: Man a dabili ŋɔ kul ni dolila nyini naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ n-chaŋ biɛla ha. Bɔzuɣu ka nyini naa ti yɛn yo ma san titali ŋɔ?.
en: I'll cross the river with you, but I'll only go a little way on the other side. You don't have to be so kind to me.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa gindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yihiri waazu, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka shihir shɛŋa din wuhiri ni lahibal suŋ maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli niŋda.
en: The disciples went and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and proved that their preaching was true by the miracles that were performed. .

dag: Bɛtɛlnima n-daa tim Sharɛza mini Rɛgɛmmɛlɛk m-pahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu ni bɛ chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regemmelech and their men to the Temple of the Lord Almighty to pray for the Lord 's blessing.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim yɛn chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa su, ka yi bɔri ni yi gbarigi ba?.
en: Why would you destroy the Israelites resolve to cross into the land that the LORD gave them?.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli, Naawuni di saɣi ka n niŋ lala! Kulla n ni nya pipia maa so sani maa kɔŋko n-ni leei n dabili; amaa yinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, kulimiya yi ba sani ni alaafee.
en: Joseph told them, I would never punish all of you. Only the one who was caught with the cup will become my slave. The rest of you are free to go home to your father.

dag: N ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, n daa dari tɔhila m binyɛra, ka dari sibi n zabiri mini n teeŋa ka teei ʒini tiŋa, ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni.
en: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim Juda zuɣulaannima n-zaŋ ba du n-tam gooni maa zuɣu m-pirigi ba gbilligbilli ʒii buyi n-chɛ ka bɛ chani gindi gooni maa zuɣu m-paɣiri Naawuni. Bɛn daŋ tooni daa zaŋ kpala gooni maa zuɣu nudirigu polo n-zaŋ doli Saɣiri Dunɔdal la polo.
en: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up onto the wall and organized two large groups to give thanks. The first group went in procession on the wall toward the right, in the direction of the Dung Gate.

dag: Tinzunnim deei bɛ yaa zaa, ka bɛ bi baŋ lala. Bɛ bi mi ni bɛ kum saha bi lan waɣa.
en: Strangers have eaten up his strength, yet he doesnt know it; gray hairs are sprinkled here and there upon him, yet he doesnt know it.

dag: O yaar o noli yɛra, ka di nyɛligira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛri li, ka di leeri kom zɔra.
en: Then he gives another command, and warm air begins to blow. The ice melts, and water begins to flow.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka bɛ gbaai yibu yinoyino. Ninkura n-daa daŋ yibu; ka di ti kpalimla Yisa kɔŋko, ka paɣ maa ʒe o tooni.
en: When they heard this, they began to leave one by one. The older men left first, and then the others. Jesus was left alone with the woman standing there in front of him.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni san la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu. Sokam zaa nyɛla yim.
en: Gods righteousness comes through the faithfulness of Jesus Christ for all who have faith in him. Theres no distinction.

dag: Ka din daa chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ ti niŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim ni daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la sani zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa yihi ba Ijipti Naa Firawuna nuu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti kpalim jɛmdila buɣa.
en: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka ninsalitali biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka n yi kul bɔri ni n tum din tuhi, zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu n-nyɛ din miriti ma.
en: So I have learned this rule: When I want to do good, evil is there with me.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya biŋkɔb so ka o yi tiŋgban ni na. O daa malila yila ayi kaman piɛbil yila la, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o lɔŋ ŋmani waɣ biɛ tital la lɔŋ.
en: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi gba daa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti mi lee yɛn niŋ? Ka o yɛli ba, Di muɣisiriya niriba bee n-diri shɛhir kpɛma fari bɛ nɛma; ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣimi yi yɔri.
en: Some soldiers also asked him, What about us? What are we to do? He said to them, Don't take money from anyone by force or accuse anyone falsely. Be content with your pay.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka tiŋ maa nim yina ti nya ka bɛ wurimla Baal bimbini maa, ka daai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi, ka me bimbin shɛli zali di zaashee maa, ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi mali sara pa di zuɣu n-nyo o buɣim.
en: When the people of the town got up the next morning, they saw that Baal's altar had been knocked over, and the sacred pole next to it had been cut down. Then they noticed the new altar covered with the remains of the sacrificed bull.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti duhiri timaŋa ka tumdi din yiɣisiri tab suhuri bee n-zabiri tab nyuli.
en: We must not feel proud and boast about ourselves. We must not cause trouble for each other or be jealous of each other.

dag: Din gari shɛlikam nyɛla, kul yumiya taba ni yɛlimaŋli, dama yurilim limsiri taali balibu pam.
en: Above all, show sincere love to each other, because love brings about the forgiveness of many sins.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣina ti pali bia maa ba Zakaria, ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra.
en: Then Zechariah, Johns father, was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the people a message from God:.

dag: Ka Mɛɔnɔtai daa nyɛ Ofira ba. Sɛraya daa nyɛla Jɔab ba, ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ Gɛharashimnim yabidoo. Din daa chɛ ka bɛ boli ba lala maa nyɛla, bɛ daa nyɛla nuhi tuumbaŋdiba.
en: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the founder of Handcraft Valley, where all the people were skilled workers.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa chɛ ka o bidibis ayopɔin maa kana ti gari Samuɛl tooni, ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Jɛsi, Yawɛ bi pii bɛmbɔŋɔ ni so.
en: In this way Jesse brought seven of his sons to Samuel. And Samuel said to him, No, the Lord hasn't chosen any of these.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋubi noombil kam ŋun be nyam.
en: You can eat any clean bird.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ zali ya ni sokam pihim o dimma tarig la. Di simdi ka sokam baŋ o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm tariga, ka pihi lita ayi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: This is what the LORD has commanded: Collect as much of it as each of you can eat, one omer per person. You may collect for the number of people in your household.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Ti ni tooi nya ninvuɣ so ka o be kaman Naawuni Shia ni be do so ni ŋɔ.
en: Then Pharaoh told them, I dont think we can find anyone better than Joseph to take this job! Gods Spirit is in him, making him very wise.

dag: Ka jɛmbu du palli ŋɔ jilima ni gari jɛmbu du kurili la jilima, ka ni chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ kpe; man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace.

dag: O teeya ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima, ka ŋmani pɔhim din ʒe n-gari ka ku lan tooi labina.
en: He remembered that they were only people, like a wind that blows and then is gone.

dag: Ka yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo hal ni Gatihɛfa m-mali hal ni Ɛtikazin nti ŋmaligi kpa Niya polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Rimɔn.
en: Then the border continued to the east to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin. It ended at Rimmon. Then it turned and went to Neah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni; amaa ka yɛl o, Ti mabia, a nya Yɛhudianim tusatusa ni niŋdi yɛda ka na kul kumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu shɛm bebɔ?.
en: Those who heard this praised God. Then they said to him, Brother, you see how many thousands of Jews have become believers, and all of them keep the Law passionately.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli.
en: As for you, even the hairs of your head have all been counted.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: A total of descendants of temple workers and of Solomon's servants returned.

dag: Do so daa be Siizaria ka o yuli booni Kɔniilius. O daa nyɛla sapashini n-su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Italinim Bɔŋ la.
en: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called The Italian Unit.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king.

dag: Di pa shɛli Onɛsimus daa yi a sani n-zomi ni o yi kpaŋ biɛla, ka ti lan lab a sanna n-yipa ti beni sahakam.
en: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb bɛn laɣim lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ n sani maa lala. Bɛ biɛhigu ni zan tariga, ka bɛ kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: You sinful people who ganged up against me will die here in the desert.

dag: Di zaŋya fukumsi biɛɣu su piɛ shɛb Naawuni ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la, amaa lee maliya biɛhigu shɛli din simdi ni bɛ doli di naba.
en: Dont shepherd by ruling over those entrusted to your care, but become examples to the flock.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni, ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has given me all things. No one knows who the Son is—only the Father knows. And only the Son knows who the Father is. The only people who will know about the Father are those the Son chooses to tell.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyari paɣibu a kpiɔŋ zuɣu! Ti ni yili yila paɣ a yiko maa.
en: Lord , we lift you up with our songs of praise. We sing and play songs about your power!.

dag: O kum maa saha, o kul yɛn ŋmɛlimmi, ka o kɔba ni kpam kul maha.
en: their buckets full of milk, their bones marrow-filled and sound.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bidibisi, ka Abiheel daa nyɛ Huri bia, ka Huri nyɛ Jarɔa bia, ka Jarɔa nyɛ Giliad bia, ka Giliad nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Jɛshishai bia, ka Jɛshishai nyɛ Jado bia, ka Jado mi nyɛ Buz bia;.
en: They were descendants of Abihail son of Huri, whose ancestors were traced back as follows: Abihail, Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, Buz.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni naai ma zaa, o ku m mini bɛn be zaa.
en: Now God has surely worn me out. You have destroyed my entire group.

dag: Bɛ dihila Mɔab vi, dama bɛ wurim li. Kuhimiya ka fabili. Molimiya di yɛla Arinɔn mɔɣili duli ni Mɔab lu n-dahim.
en: Moab is shamed and shocked; weep and wail! Tell it by the Arnon River: Moabs been destroyed!.

dag: ka a dabisa yi ti pali ka a dɔni a yaannim tooni, n ni piig a bihi ni yino ŋun nyɛ a dahalali bia n-chɛ ka o nam nya zaashee zani.
en: When you die and are buried with your ancestors, I will make one of your sons king and will keep his kingdom strong.

dag: N yi pala tumo zaŋ chaŋ shɛb sani, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n nyɛla tumo yinim sani, dama yinima n-nyɛ n tumɔtali shihirili ti Duuma sani.
en: If Im not an apostle to others, at least I am to you! You are the seal that shows Im an apostle.

dag: Bɛ ni lu Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo la zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti laɣim di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulimpuhili polo nim nɛma. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnima, ka Ammɔnnim ti jɛmdi ba.
en: But they will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; together they will plunder the people to the east. Edom and Moab will be under their power, and the Ammonites will be their subjects.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Zadok bia, ka o yuli booni Jɛrusha.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother Jerusha was the daughter of Zadok.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima nanima, niŋmiya yɛm, yinim dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannima, deemiya saɣisigu ŋɔ.
en: So, kings and rulers, be smart and learn this lesson.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino.
en: This is why a man will leave his father and mother and be united with his wife, and the two of them will be one body .

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa wum Ahaz ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ Damaskus nti ŋme n-nyaŋ ba, ka ku Rɛzin; ka gbahi di niriba n-kuli Kɛɛr nti leei daba.
en: The Assyrian king heard the request and marched against Damascus. He captured it and sent its citizens into exile to Kir. He also killed Rezin.

dag: Di yɛli a ʒiʒiinikpee, Cham ka sa labina biɛɣuni ka n zaŋ li ti a, di yi be a sani.
en: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba Anabi Musa min anabinim zaa ha litaafinim ni daa yɛli ŋun Yisa yɛla shɛm.
en: Then he interpreted for them the things written about himself in all the scriptures, starting with Moses and going through all the Prophets.

dag: ka paɣimiya Naawuni shɛlikam zaa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yu shɛli yi biɛhigu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.

dag: Ka Manaasa bia Jair daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei tiŋkpan shɛŋa, ka bol li Havɔtijairi.
en: Jair, of the tribe of Manasseh, attacked and captured some villages and named them Villages of Jair.

dag: M-pahi, Uzia daa lan mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu, ka bɛ piripiri ba ka bɛ kalinli dolila Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpɛm la ni daa wuhi Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la mini Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpamba ni yino la shɛm.
en: Uzziah had a standing army equipped for combat whose units went to war according to the number determined by the scribe Jeiel and Maaseiah, an officer under the authority of Hananiah, one of the kings officials.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni yino daa kana nti wum ka Yisa garigi bɛn daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni maa bɔhigu viɛnyɛliŋga ka bɔh o, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: A teacher of the Law was there who heard the discussion. He saw that Jesus had given the Sadducees a good answer, so he came to him with a question: Which commandment is the most important of all.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn diri wahala Jɛrusalɛm, ka buɣi ka di pala wain ka yi nyu ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention.

dag: Nyama pumpɔŋɔ ŋ-ŋɔ o sɔɣi vol shɛl ni bee luɣ shɛli polo. Ka niriba maa shɛb yi chaŋ ti lir o tuuli liribu ŋɔ ka o ku ba, ŋunkam wum di yɛla ni yɛli ni bɛ ku Absalom niriba pam.
en: Right now he is probably hiding in a cave or some other place. As soon as David attacks your men, whoever hears about it will say that your men have been defeated.

dag: Yawɛ daa lo ba la alikauli n-yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa bee n-damdi di tooni bee n-jɛm li bee m-mal li.
en: The Lord made an agreement with the Israelites. He commanded them, You must not honor other gods. You must not worship them or serve them or offer sacrifices to them.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu kpiɔŋ daa galisi pam hal ka ŋarin titali maa ti be kaman di yɛn chɛrisimi la.
en: But the Lord brought a great storm on the sea. The wind made the sea very rough. The storm was very strong, and the boat was ready to break apart.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Bɛnijaakan maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hɔrihagidigad.
en: They left Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Haggidgad.

dag: Ɛdomnima mini Ishimail zuliya ni Mɔabnima ni Hagirinima ni.
en: They are the clans of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbihi bee niɣi mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ luɣ shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la.
en: Go to the one place of worship and slaughter there one of your sheep or cattle for the Passover meal to honor the Lord your God.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, suhupiɛlli pam ni be alizanda ni o zuɣu gari wuntizɔriba kɔbigayinika bɛn bi lan simdi ni bɛ niŋ tuuba la.
en: In the same way, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine respectable people who do not need to repent.

dag: Naomi ni daa nya ka Rut shiri bɔri ni o dol o kuli ni o suhu zaa maa zuɣu, ka o daa shini ka bi lan yɛli shɛli.
en: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she said nothing more.

dag: Ka m bo o nuzaa polo, ka o sɔɣi, ka n ku tooi nya o, ka n ŋmaligi nudirigu polo, amaa ka bi tooi nya o.
en: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n lo nia ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ kaman ŋun Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli m ba Dauda, N ni ti yɛn zaŋ a bi so leei naa zal a zaashee n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma.
en: The Lord promised my father David, Your son, whom I will make king after you, will build a temple for me. And I have now decided to build that temple for the worship of the Lord my God.

dag: Kɔnyuri gbaai biliɛɣu hal ka o lɔŋni ti kuui zaa. Bihi suhiri bindirigu, amaa ka so bi tiri ba shɛli.
en: Babies are so thirsty their tongues stick to the roof of their mouths. Young children ask for bread, but no one gives them any.

dag: N ni darigi dunia ŋɔ nim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, ka darigi ninvuɣ biɛri tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. N ni siɣisi karimbaannim mini bɛnkam duhiri bɛmaŋa ni putɔɣunima.
en: I will bring disaster upon the world for its evil, and bring their own sin upon the wicked. I will end the pride of the insolent, and the conceit of tyrants I will lay low.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: These people honor me with their words, but I am not really important to them.

dag: Amaa yinim ti miriya! Dinzuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: But you, watch out! Ive told you everything ahead of time.

dag: ka Maikil bia Sɛtur daa yi Asha zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Asher—Sethur son of Michael;.

dag: Absalom daa zaŋla Amasa leeg o tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani. Amasa daa nyɛla do so ŋun yuli booni Itira, ka o nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la dapala. Itira maa daa kpuɣila Jɔab ma Zɛruya tizo Abigeel Nahash bipuɣiŋga.
en: Absalom had put Amasa in charge of the army instead of Joab. Amasa was the son of a man named Ithra, an Ishmaelite who had married Abigail, who was Nahashs daughter and the sister of Zeruiah, Joabs mother.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be bɛnkam zaa yuri ti Duuma Yisa Masia yurilim shɛli din ku naai la ni!.
en: Gods grace to all of you who love our Lord Jesus Christ with love that never ends.

dag: Yihimiya putɔɣu mini suhuyiɣisili ni sujee ni zabili ni nyaanzubo ni biɛr biɛɣu zaa yi bebu ni.
en: Put aside all bitterness, losing your temper, anger, shouting, and slander, along with every other evil.

dag: Ka Jɔn garigi yɛli, Kom ni ka man baptaiziri niriba; amaa so ʒe yi sani kpe, ka yi bi mi o.
en: John answered, I baptize people with water. But there is someone here with you that you dont know.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu; nyini n-chɛ ka n dimnim lu n naba ni.
en: God, you made me strong in battle. You made my enemies fall before me.

dag: Dindina nir yi mɔɣi tampiligim di so. O suhu ni tɛha m-birig o maa, ka o ku tooi tilig omaŋa bee n-yɛli, N ni gbib binshɛli n nudirigu ni ŋɔ pala Naawuni.
en: It makes as much sense as eating ashes. His foolish ideas have so misled him that he is beyond help. He won't admit to himself that the idol he holds in his hand is not a god at all.

dag: Di nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana, ka bɔ ka a lee ni tooi niŋ? Di nyɛla din zilim gari kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka bɔ ka yɛn tooi baŋ?.
en: The sky is no limit for God, but it lies beyond your reach. God knows the world of the dead, but you do not know it.

dag: Yisa Masia ni sa be shɛm sɔhila, lala ka o be zuŋɔ, ka kul ni be lala hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Gbɛmiya kpe, ka n sa zaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm yɛli ya. Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa gbe Balaam sani.
en: Balaam said to them, Stay here for the night. I will talk to the Lord and tell you the answer he gives me. So the leaders of Moab stayed there with Balaam that night.

dag: Ka di yi na mali puma ka bɛ bi chɛ li sɔŋ, di daŋdila mɔɣu kam kuubu.
en: While still tender, uncut, it will wither before every other grass.

dag: Bɛ pun zaŋ baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba n-ka n sanna ni bɛ ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ di gbinni.
en: The advisers and magicians were brought in to read this writing and tell me what it means, but they could not discover the meaning.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Musa daa ʒini ni o mali niriba yɛla, ka niriba maa daa ʒe n-gili Musa asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: The next day Moses was settling disputes among the people, and he was kept busy from morning till night.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku Hɛliɔpolis mini Bubastis nachimba, ka gbahi tinsi maa nim ti leei daba.
en: The young soldiers in the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the rest of the people will be taken prisoner.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam ŋmanila saa ŋun kul yɔrita ka bi baara.
en: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa maa daa lan laɣim tab bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali n-lan ku ninvuɣ kɔbisita tiŋ maa puuni pahi. Amaa bɛ daa bi di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Jews in Susa met together on the th day of the month of Adar. They killed men in Susa, but they didnt take the things that belonged to them.

dag: N daa wuhi ba n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi. Ka ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: I gave them my regulations and made known to them my case laws, which bring life to all who observe them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban nɛli ni ni ti kana ti damd o tooni, ka o dimnim mi ti kana ti lu o tooni ka bɛ noya vaai taŋkpaɣu.
en: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.

dag: Zaŋm a yiko ŋɔ shɛli ti o, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa deer o noli.
en: and tell them they must now obey him, just as they obey you.

dag: Ka nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro maa shɛli yi guui, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: But you must burn whatever is left over of the meat and bread with fire.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim maa vie bɛ dunɔpaɣira mini bɛ dunoya zuɣusahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋubi nimdi maa.
en: Some of the blood must be put on the two doorposts and above the door of each house where the animals are to be eaten.

dag: Tinzunnim kanna ti damdiri ma la tiŋa. Bɛ yi kul wum ka n yɛli shɛlikam, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: Foreigners fall helpless before me! As soon as they heard about me, they were ready to obey.

dag: ni o ni daa chɛ ka Musa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa ni o ni daa wuhi yiko din mali dabiɛm Izraɛlnim zaa ninni shɛm la.
en: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So the people of Israel settled in the territory of the Amorites.

dag: Maika mabia Ishia bidibisi ni, Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Micahs brother Isshiah; from Isshiahs family: Zechariah.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda ya la, amaa ka ŋmaligi zaŋ li tahila Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Giiti nir la yiŋa.
en: So David did not take it with him to Jerusalem. Instead, he left it at the house of a man named Obed Edom, a native of the city of Gath.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Doo maa boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: After hearing him, some standing there said, Hes calling Elijah.

dag: ka o tim puɣisiriba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka Sool shiri be ni.
en: So David sent out spies to know for certain that Saul had come after him again.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Zaawuni ŋɔ, yi ni baŋ ni Yawɛ n-daa shiri yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Moses and Aaron told the people, This evening you will know that the Lord was the one who rescued you from Egypt.

dag: Dindali maa tikpiranim ni ti wum bɛ ni karindi litaafi puuni yɛri shɛm, ka zoomba bɛn be zibisim ni ti neei bɛ nina lihi nya.
en: When that day comes, the deaf will be able to hear a book being read aloud, and the blind, who have been living in darkness, will open their eyes and see.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntuhi mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim. Ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its rooms, side walls, and porch also measured the same as the other gates. There were windows all around the gateway and its porch. The gateway was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Yawɛ daa naan ku tooi lan deei yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa maa, dinzuɣu ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari ka bahi yoli doya ka bɛ turi li, ka so ka di ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: It got so bad that the LORD could no longer bear your evil and shameless acts; it was at that point that your land was reduced to an utter wasteland and a curse, as it is today.

dag: Di luɣa ni barilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni pirigili, ka palo din daa do Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini luɣa zuɣu duri la sunsuuni.
en: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls.

dag: ka mɛnya kuɣa sara maligu bimbini nimaani n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; di ti yɛn nyɛla kuɣa sara maligu bimbini, ka pa yi ni zaŋ kurugu bini shihi kuɣ shɛŋa.
en: Build an altar there made of stones that have had no iron tools used on them.

dag: Naawuni yiko ni o daa tɔɣisi luhi Yɛhudianima niriba ni, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni Kundi n-kahigiri wuhiri niriba ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Masia.
en: For with his strong arguments he defeated the Jews in public debates by proving from the Scriptures that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: Yimiya Babilɔn; zomiya ka chɛ ba. Tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu n-yɛli di yɛla. Ka mol li ka dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nim wum li. Yɛlimiya, Yawɛ tilig o dabili Yaakubu zuliya.
en: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa bɔhi Ahitɔfɛl, Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Absalom turned to Ahithophel and said, Give us your advice! What should we do.

dag: Ibram ni daa nyaŋ Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn be o sani ka labirina saha shɛli, ka Sɔdom naa daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Shave vinvamli ni bɛ ni daa booni luɣ shɛli Naa Vinvamli la.
en: Then Abram went home after he defeated Kedorlaomer and the kings with him. On his way home, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋ maa nim daa yɛli Jɔash, Yihim a bia maa na ka ti ku o. O ni wurim Baal bimbini, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi la zuɣu.
en: The townspeople said to Joash, Bring out your son for execution because he tore down the altar to Baal and cut down the Asherah that was beside it.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣisi ninvuɣ so mali suhupiɛlli. Dinzuɣu miri ka a ʒiɛm Kpiɔŋlan Naa saɣisigu.
en: Look, happy is the person whom God corrects; so dont reject the Almightys instruction.

dag: Zuliya kam wum a vidibo yɛla, ka a kuhigu gili dunia zaa. Dama tɔbbia tuug o tɔbbi kpee, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu.
en: The nations will hear you crying. Your cries will be heard all over the earth. One brave soldier will run into another brave soldier. And both brave soldiers will fall down together.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else Jehoiakim did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka Uzai bia Palal daa mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee mini pia din du n-gari nayili jirambisa din miri nayili guliba biɛhigu shee la tooni. Ka Parɔsh bia Pɛdaya daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Palal son of Uzai worked across from the bend in the wall near the tower. This is the tower at the kings upper house. That is near the courtyard of the kings guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh worked next to Palal.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli Tiriza. O ni daa kul mali ti kpɛri bɛ yiŋ dunol ni, ka bia maa dii leei Naawuni dini.
en: Jeroboam's wife left and went back home to the town of Tirzah. As soon as she set foot in her house, her son died.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa jɛmd a mi; bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a, bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a yuli.
en: Let the whole world worship you. Let everyone sing praises to your name. Selah.

dag: Ka sokam ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-shiri ŋooi n takɔbi maa di tɔɣu ni ka ku lan labisi li su di tɔɣu maa ni yaha.
en: knowing that my sword will never be put away.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na ni n ti tum tuma ŋɔ zaa, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ yubu ka n tumda.
en: Moses said, By this you will know that the LORD sent me to do these deeds and that it wasnt my own desire.

dag: Ka o bi so yi ti leei maligumaana n-zan o ba zaani, o yi ti yɛn ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni na nti tum o tuma luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee, ŋun yɛm binyɛra maa daba ayopɔin.
en: The son of Aaron who succeeds him as priest and who goes into the Tent of my presence to serve in the Holy Place is to wear these garments for seven days.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig awɛi saha ka o daa lan yi n-chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb ʒi daa ni yoli.
en: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.

dag: amaa ŋunkam zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣisi dilana m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda zuɣu ka Naawuni daa ŋmahi ba bahi, amaa nyin gba kpalim ʒiɛla a yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu. Dinzuɣu di nyuri bara; amaa chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: That is true. They were broken off because they did not believe, while you remain in place because you do believe. But do not be proud of it; instead, be afraid.

dag: amaa ka o nini daa bi tiɣi Keen ŋun min o sara maa. Dinzuɣu ka Keen suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zuŋ o ninni.
en: But he did not accept Cain and his offering. Cain was sad because of this, and he became very angry.

dag: ka daa lee yɛli, Ti di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu maa zuɣu.
en: They were saying, We must not do it during the festival, because the people will riot.

dag: Abijam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu.
en: The rest of Abijams deeds and all that he did, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, nyini n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi n niriba ŋɔ na, a mi daa bi chɛ ka m baŋ a ni yɛn tim so na ka m min o ti chaŋ, amaa di zaa yoli ka a yɛli ma, M mi a viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n nini lan tiɣ a.
en: Moses said to the LORD, Look, youve been telling me, Lead these people forward. But you havent told me whom you will send with me. Yet youve assured me, I know you by name and think highly of you.

dag: Ka Amazia daa bɔhi Naawuni nira maa, Ka n ni pun zaŋ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi shɛli da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiriba maa na, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ chaŋ di polo? Ka Naawuni nira maa garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni tooi ti a anzinfa din gari li.
en: Amaziah asked the man of God, What about the hundred kikkars I paid for the Israelite troops? God can give you much more than that, the man of God replied.

dag: Ka di daa moli gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ni Naa Sool nyaŋla Filistianim tɔbbi shɛba ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Izraɛlnim leei Filistianim dimnima. Ka bɛ daa boli niriba maa ni bɛ yina nti pahi Sool zuɣu Giligal.
en: When all Israel heard that Saul had attacked the Philistine fort and that Israel was hated by the Philistines, the troops were called to Sauls side at Gilgal.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yinim laɣila kum zɔri, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee lo tab alikauli. Yi niŋ yɛda ni alɔbo yi lu, di ku din ya, dama yi tɛhiya ni ʒiri mini yɔhiŋgu ni tiligi ya.
en: You boast that you have made a treaty with death and reached an agreement with the world of the dead. You are certain that disaster will spare you when it comes, because you depend on lies and deceit to keep you safe.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di yi ti kpa ni n darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi tibidarigibo tibili, man di darigi bɛ tibili? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu. Di simdi ni yi nya tibidarigibo.
en: This is what the Lord says: Some people dont deserve to be punished, but they suffer. But, Edom, you deserve to be punished, so you will really be punished. You will not escape the punishment you deserve. You will be punished.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n yuli m-bala. M bi zaŋdi n jilima tiri so. M mi bi zaŋdi m paɣibu tiri binnana.
en: I am YAHWEH. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another. I will not let statues take the praise that should be mine.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni laɣiyubo, ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣi yi ni mali shɛli, dama Naawuni yɛliya, N kul ku chɛ a, ka mi ku bah a.
en: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o bi yɛn yɛli zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu kɔŋko.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, I told you that he never prophesies anything good for me; it's always something bad.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ kum kuyila bahi ti zuɣu yomyom, ka nintam yi ti nina ni na, ka nintam ti tɛli ti niŋkari zaa.
en: The people answered, Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.

dag: M mabihi, miriya ka yi ni so mali suhu biɛɣu din biɛhinda, ka nyɛ din ni birigi ya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ sani.
en: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.

dag: N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: and I have filled him with my power. I have given him understanding, skill, and ability for every kind of artistic work—.

dag: amaa benyala kasi yi biɛhigu zaa puuni kaman Naawuni ŋun boli ya la ni be kasi shɛm.
en: you must be holy in every aspect of your lives, just as the one who called you is holy.

dag: A me a yili tamla zuɣusaa kom zuɣu, ka zaŋ sagbana leeg a chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ba pɔhim kpiŋkpama.
en: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli shia din be daadam ni, ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ŋɔ n-chɛ ka daadam baŋdi binyara.
en: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.

dag: Yi mini yi tɔbbihi ni yi niriba pam bɛn be yi sani ni ti kana kaman sanʒiɛɣu, ka be kaman sagbani din limsi tiŋgban la.
en: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa po Yawɛ n-yɛli, Adɔnija yi bi kɔŋ o nyɛvili yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu gar lala!.
en: King Solomon swore by the LORD, May God do to me as he sees fit! Adonijah has made this request at the cost of his life!.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi ka yinsi din ni di ka nyu nimaani bee yi ʒiɛmla Naawuni cheechi ka dihiri bɛn ka shɛl la gba vi? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn yɛli ya? N ni paɣi ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Aai! N ku paɣi ya!.
en: Don't you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or would you rather despise the church of God and put to shame the people who are in need? What do you expect me to say to you about this? Shall I praise you? Of course I don't!.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, ŋunkam yɛn mali suhudoo sara maligu ti man Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋm li ka man Yawɛ sanna. O suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: Say to the Israelites: If you wish to offer a communal sacrifice of well-being to the LORD, you are allowed to bring your offering to the LORD as your communal sacrifice of well-being.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa piligi niriba maa kalibu, amaa o daa bi kali ba naai, ka alɔbo daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu niriba kalibu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa bi sabi bɛ kalinli maa niŋ Naa Dauda yɛla teebu litaafi ni.
en: Joab, Zeruiahs son, began to count them, but he never finished. Since Israel experienced wrath because of this, the number wasnt entered into the official records of King David.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ daa zali Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu saha shɛl o ni daa zali Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ sara maligunim na ti ti ŋun Yawɛ Sinai mɔɣu ni la.
en: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.

dag: Teebuya ayi n-daa ʒe zɔntua maa samban ni dunɔdali nuzaa polo, ka teebuya ayi ʒe zɔntua maa dunɔdali yaɣ din la polo.
en: Outside the room there were four similar tables, two on either side of the entrance of the north gate.

dag: Asha bipuɣiŋga yuli n-daa booni Sɛra.
en: Asher had a daughter named Serah.

dag: Ka nabipuɣiŋga maa be o duu n-zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ salima gali wuɣi situr shɛli binyɛrigu di nachiinsi.
en: The princess is so beautiful in her gown, like a pearl set in gold.

dag: Amaa nyin Daniɛl, kul ʒe yim hal ni di bahigu ni. A ni ti vuhi, ka ni ti zani a zaashee zaadali.
en: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tia dari m-mali pund ayi n-zaŋ yo Luɣ Kasi shee din be puuni la ha dunoli, ka dapaɣili din pa dunoli maa zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira dasara daa mulisi ka mali yaɣ anu.
en: The workers made two doors from olive wood. They put these doors at the entrance of the Most Holy Place. The frame around the doors was made with five sides.

dag: Hal n yi nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni n nyu bara maa shɛm zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ fukumsi shɛli ti Duuma ni zaŋ niŋ ti nuu ni la polo, vi ku mali ma di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla fukumsi shɛli din yɛn mɛnya zali, ka pa ni din yɛn daai ya luhi.
en: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.

dag: Ka paɣ so yi yila o yidana yiŋa, ŋun kpalimmi ʒiya; ka di yi pa lala, ŋun niŋmi sandaani niŋ o yidan kuro maa, ka lan lab o yiŋa. Ka doo mi miri ka o yih o paɣa.
en: but if she does, she must remain single or else be reconciled to her husband; and a husband must not divorce his wife.

dag: Ka tin tital la daa bɔɣi ʒii buta, ka zuliya kam tinsi daa lu n-dahim zaa. Ka Naawuni daa teei Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la yɛla, ka zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili wain pipia la n-ti Babilɔnnima ni bɛ nyu di zaa.
en: The great city split into three parts. The cities of the nations were destroyed. And God did not forget to punish Babylon the Great. He gave that city the cup filled with the wine of his terrible anger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bipola ni ninkura ni niɣi ni piɛri ni bunsi; ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ maa ni zaa.
en: With their swords they killed everyone in the city, men and women, young and old. They also killed the cattle, sheep, and donkeys.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla tila suŋ, amaa suhugarigu din nyɛla din kuuri kɔba.
en: A joyful heart helps healing, but a broken spirit dries up the bones.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Jɔn gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pɔri Naawuni nam ni galisi gar o.
en: I tell you, no one ever born is greater than John. But even the least important person in Gods kingdom is greater than John.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa ayɔbu mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: For the back of the Tent, on the west, they made six frames.

dag: yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: He said, I promise you that I will bless you and give you many descendants.

dag: Hal Ijiptinim yi wum ni Taai wurimya, di ni niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: When Egypt hears the news about Tyre, it will feel the pain of sorrow.

dag: Di niŋya niriba bina fabu naani; yi mi di zaŋya tahima yoli niŋ ŋmɛnditoli tuma ni. Hal yi daazichi yi zoori pahira, yin di niŋya li naani.
en: Dont trust in your power to take things by force. Dont think you will gain anything by stealing. And if you become wealthy, dont put your trust in riches.

dag: Nyama, a du m-bala Ijiptinima bɛ mi nyɛla kaɣili jaaŋgbe kabili din ni kuhi ŋun dihiri li nuu. Lala ka Ijipti naa Firawuna be zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn du m-ba o polo. .
en: Are you depending on Egypt to help you? Egypt is like a broken walking stick. If you lean on it for support, it will only hurt you and make a hole in your hand. Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, cannot be trusted by anyone who depends on him for help.

dag: Naa daa yi ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, bɛ zaŋdila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan zaŋ li labisi ti niŋ di duu.
en: Every time the king went to the Temple, the guards carried the shields and then returned them to the guardroom.

dag: Bɛ ŋmarila tab ʒiri; naŋgbammalisim mini tɛha ayiyi yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisira.
en: All of them lie to one another; they deceive each other with flattery.

dag: Sool mam daa beni ka o yuli booni Rizipa. O daa nyɛla Aiya bipuɣiŋga, ka Ishibɔshɛt daa ti bɔhi Abinɛr, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ m ba mam maa dɔni.
en: One day Ishbosheth son of Saul accused Abner of sleeping with Saul's concubine Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa na, ka Aduna min o bidibisi ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then Moses brought out the bull of the sin offering. Aaron and his sons put their hands on the bulls head.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la malimi yi luɣili pinaayi zaa ka di be kasi, ka gbibi yi niŋgbuna zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni yi shihi zaa ka di mali yaa ka ti ku mali taali hal baabiɛla ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dali.
en: Now, may the God of peace himself cause you to be completely dedicated to him; and may your spirit, soul, and body be kept intact and blameless at our Lord Jesus Christs coming.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ti shɛhira gbaŋ din sab ti suhuri ni ni sokam nya li karim.
en: You are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everyone.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi la zaa mabihili puhigu ti ti.
en: Give all the brothers and sisters the special greeting of Gods people.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim tiɣisirila tab ʒiina, ka zuɣulaannim laɣindi tɔri jina jɛndiri Yawɛ min o ni pii na so la yɛra.
en: Their kings revolt, their rulers plot together against the Lord and against the king he chose.

dag: ni Lɛbaɔt ni Shilihim ni Ain ni Rimɔn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pihitayinika m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. In total: twenty-nine cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi Sukɔt kpamba n-zaŋ ba pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba. O daa niŋla lala ni o wuhi Sukɔtinim maa yɛm.
en: He then took thorns and briers from the desert and used them to punish the leaders of Sukkoth.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti mali m-be kasi Yisa Masia ni daa tum Naawuni yubu, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mali sara yim ka di yɛla naai zaa la zuɣu.
en: Because Jesus Christ did what God wanted him to do, we are all purified from sin by the offering that he made of his own body once and for all.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛnkam be yoma ni katiŋ zaa wum n ni niŋ shɛm ka baŋ ni m mali yiko.
en: Let everyone near and far hear what I have done and acknowledge my power.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: Another message came to me from the Lord .
