dag: Baŋmi ni yɛm gba nyɛla din nyaɣis a suhu ni. A yi nya yɛm, a ni nya dahin shɛli biɛhigu, ka a tahima ku zani soli.
en: In the same way, know that wisdom is good for you. Wisdom will give you something to hope for that will not disappoint you.

dag: So miri ka o ʒiɛm o, ka chɛliya ka o ti yi yi sani ni suhudoo lab n sanna, dama n kul lihirila o mini ti mabihi la soli.
en: So none of you should refuse to accept Timothy. Help him continue on his trip in peace so that he can come back to me. I am expecting him to come back with the other brothers.

dag: Dinzuɣu naa, kamina pumpɔŋɔ kaman a suhu ni yu dahin shɛli, di nyɛla ti talahi tuma ni ti gbaag o ti a.
en: If you come, we will help you catch him.

dag: Atɛnsinim mini saamba bɛn daa be nimaani daa bi tumdi tuun shɛli pahila yɛtɔɣ pala tɔɣisibu mini yɛl pala wumbu zuɣu.
en: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ka bi chaŋ.
en: But you refused to go into the land. You refused to obey the Lord your God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ ba naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu; dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli dimdi kɔbiliga.
en: Isaac's servants dug another well, and the shepherds also quarreled about it. So that well was named Jealous.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Lɛvi maa yiŋa, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni farigudeeriba pam ni alahichinim laɣim ʒini diri bindirigu, dama bɛ pam n-daa doli Yisa na.
en: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Levi's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners had become followers of Jesus, and they were also guests at the dinner.

dag: N yi chaŋ tooni ha, o ka nimaani bee n yi labi nyaaŋa, n ku tooi nya o.
en: I have searched in the East, but God is not there; I have not found him when I searched in the West.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa diri tiɣiri zaŋ bɛmaŋ pa talima pumpɔŋɔ ni bɛ nya bindirigu di, amaa kum bi lan mali di ni daa mali shɛb la yaha. Paɣiŋoo dɔɣi bih ayopɔin, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi bihi pam la kɔŋ bihi.
en: Those who were filled full now sell themselves for bread, but the ones who were starving are now fat from food! The woman who was barren has birthed seven children, but the mother with many sons has lost them all!.

dag: daba ayopɔin m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di nyɛla laɣiŋgu tibisili; di ti tumiya tuma dindali maa.
en: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.

dag: Aai Dama di yi nyɛ lala, wula ka Naawuni ni tooi kari dunianim saria?.
en: Of course not. If God could not punish us, how could he judge the world?.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake maa. Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judanim yɛtɔɣa ni ka niriba bɛn be gooni zuɣu ŋɔ wumdi li.
en: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛl o, Samsin, Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a! Ka o yirigi neei ka yɛli, N yaai ni yi n-chaŋ kaman n ni yi pun chani shɛm la, ka dam mmaŋa ka shɛli ku gu ma soli. O daa bi baŋ ni Yawɛ lan ka o sani.
en: Then Delilah called out to him, Samson, the Philistine men are going to capture you! He woke up and thought, I will escape as I did before and free myself. But Samson did not know that the Lord had left him.

dag: ka gbala yɔhi; ka kpiimba pam bɛn daa nyɛ wuntizɔriba la neei kum ni.
en: The graves opened, and many of Gods people who had died were raised from death.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli din yɛli ni hal biŋkɔbigu yi shihi zoli maa, bɛn labim o kuɣa ku bee n-to o piɛm la daa kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka nyaŋ ba dolibu.
en: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.

dag: Di ku paai yuuni ka yinim bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ ni sɔhigi. Wain tihi ku wali, ka di daatam kpuɣibu ku beni.
en: You may be satisfied now, but this time next year you will be in despair because there will be no grapes for you to gather.

dag: Niriba yi diri ʒiɛvari kɔŋko ka mali yurilim ni taba, di so ni niriba ŋubiri naɣ kpaba ka je taba.
en: It is better to eat a little where there is love than to eat a lot where there is hate.

dag: Ka o daa be zuɣusaa ha, ka tirina gbaai ma n-voo ma yihi ko tital ni na.
en: From on high God reached down and grabbed me; he took me out of all that water.

dag: Ka a ti deei nyɛviya tiliginsim liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim sani n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni, ka di leei yi nyɛviya tiligibu sara maligu, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri di yɛla Yawɛ sani.
en: Take the compensation money from the Israelites and use it to support the service of the meeting tent. It will serve for the Israelites as a reminder in the LORDs presence of the compensation paid for your lives.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yini pahi piɛlabihi pinaanahi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.

dag: Judas ŋun daa yi o nyaaŋa la daa mi tihi puu maa ni, dama Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yi kul chanila nimaani waawaayili.
en: Jesus had often met there with his disciples, and Judas knew where the place was.

dag: Amaa din beni nyɛla, saria karibu mini buɣim din mali dabiɛm ka nyɛ din ti yɛn bahi bɛn tuhiri Naawuni yol la n-naɣ kpalim.
en: Instead, all that is left is to wait in fear for the coming Judgment and the fierce fire which will destroy those who oppose God!.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli pal shɛli din yuli booni Dɛde la nti bɔhi ka bɛ wuh a Judas yiŋa, ka a bɔhi Sool ŋun nyɛ Taasus nir la yɛla. Nyama, o be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: The Lord instructed him, Go to Judas house on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul. He is praying.

dag: Dindali maa ti Duuma ni ti yihi bɛ napɔnchahi ni nachintɛri mini bɔbisi ni dolibinima.
en: Then the Lord will take away everything they are proud of: the beautiful ankle bracelets, the necklaces that look like the sun and the moon.

dag: Kuɣili tibisa, ka bihigu tibisa, amaa jɛrigu ni tahiri suhuyiɣisili shɛl na tibisi gari di zaa.
en: A stone is heavy, and sand is hard to carry, but the irritation caused by a fool is much harder to bear.

dag: Ka so yi wum n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ku kar o saria, dama m bi kamina ni n ti kari dunianim saria, amaa n kamina ni n ti tiligi dunianima.
en: If people hear my message and do not obey it, I will not judge them. I came, not to judge the world, but to save it.

dag: Dama m bi timd a la zuliya shɛb bɛn yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to sani, amaa n timd a la Izraɛlnim sani.
en: I am not sending you to a nation that speaks a difficult foreign language, but to the Israelites.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mini Yisa nyaandoliba ni so daa doli Yisa chaŋ. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol ŋuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka ŋun doli Yisa kpe maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni.
en: Simon Peter and another one of Jesus followers went with Jesus. This follower knew the high priest. So he went with Jesus into the yard of the high priests house.

dag: Naa Sulemaana yilli din nyɛ yila puuni yili viɛlli.
en: Solomons Most Wonderful Song.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani Bɛtɛl ti jɛmdi salima naɣibil din be nimaani la; ka shɛb mi chani hal Dan nti jɛmdi salima naɣibil ŋun la. Ka niriba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa leeg alahichi.
en: And so the people sinned, going to worship in Bethel and in Dan.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya saŋkpalima bee muli zaɣ nyama ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li, ka di saha na bi paai.
en: Women of Jerusalem, promise me by the gazelles and wild deer, dont awaken love, dont arouse love, until I am ready.

dag: Dama zuliya kam zaa wuna nyɛla binnana, amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: because all the gods of the nations are just idols, but it is the LORD who created heaven!.

dag: Ti mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu, ti ni niŋ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ naani zuɣu.
en: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa lo tab alikauli Bɛrishiiba. Di nyaaŋa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa lab kuli Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After they had made this agreement at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol went back to Philistia.

dag: Nyin ʒe samban ni, ka a ni yɛn paŋ so bini maa zaŋ a ni yɛn deei binshɛli ti sɔŋ maa yina ti ti a.
en: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.

dag: Dauda ni daa kurigi ka o dabisa ti pali, o daa zaŋla o bia Sulemaana leei Izraɛlnim naa.
en: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.

dag: O gba daa zaŋ o puu kɔhi n-zaŋ di liɣiri ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: sold a field he owned, brought the money, and turned it over to the apostles.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛhab daa ti yɛli Nabɔt, Zaŋm a puu ŋɔ ti ma ka n zaŋ niŋ n ʒiɛvari puu, dama di miri n yiŋa; ka n ti a pu shɛli din viɛli gari dimbɔŋɔ bee a yi bɔra, n ni yo a di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: One day, Ahab said, Naboth, your vineyard is near my palace. Give it to me so I can turn it into a vegetable garden. I'll give you a better vineyard or pay whatever you want for yours.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim nuu ni ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm o yuma anii.
en: The LORD became angry with Israel and gave them over to King Cushan-rishathaim of Aram-naharaim. The Israelites served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ kuriba bɛn nuhi tum taali; ka yi lan ŋmari ʒiri ka zaŋ yi zilima tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: Thats because your hands are covered with blood from the people you murdered. You tell lies and say evil things.

dag: O nuu ni ka binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili mini ninsal kam vuhim be.
en: It is God who directs the lives of his creatures; everyone's life is in his power.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yini maa tɔɣis o yɛra, A ni zaŋ Hiburu dab so na ti gari ti ni la kpɛmina ni o ti lihi ʒiɛm ma;.
en: Then she said, That Hebrew slave of yours tried to rape me!.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa chaŋ Yisa sani yuŋ la gba daa bo mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la mini bɛ ni booni ti shɛli aloosi la sum gari taba n-zaŋ na. Di tibisim daa nyɛla kaman kilɔgiram pihita laasabu.
en: Nicodemus, who at first had gone to see Jesus at night, went with Joseph, taking with him about one hundred pounds of spices, a mixture of myrrh and aloes.

dag: Ka Naa Akishi kpambaliba daa bɔh o, Pa Dauda ŋɔ n-nyɛ o ya naa la? Pa o yɛla ka bɛ daa wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Naa Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia la? .
en: The king's officials said to Achish, Isn't this David, the king of his country? This is the man about whom the women sang, as they danced, Saul has killed thousands, but David has killed tens of thousands.

dag: Tiŋbihi mini saamba zaa zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini; dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: The law will be the same for foreigners and for people from your own country. This is because I am the Lord your God.

dag: ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chaŋya ti tuhi yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, Man Yawɛ sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Di saha ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli ba shɛm maa ka lab kuli, ka daa bi lan chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrɔbɔam.
en: Do not attack your own relatives. Go home, all of you. What has happened is my will. They obeyed the Lord 's command and did not go to fight Jeroboam.

dag: Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri pam kaman bɛ ni daa be Gibia la. Naawuni ni ti teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: They are hopelessly evil in what they do, just as they were at Gibeah. God will remember their sin and punish them for it.

dag: ka di leei nyɛvili a sani, ka leei nachiinsi bini a nyiŋgol ni.
en: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa chaŋ ni o ti niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Gaad yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Gad told David this, and David went to Araunahs threshing floor.

dag: Di kpari biɛla ka dunianim ku lan nya ma yaha; amaa yinim ni nyari ma. N ni mali nyɛvili be zuɣu, yi gba ni mali nyɛvili m-be.
en: In a very short time the people in the world will not see me anymore. But you will see me. You will live because I live.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni ti zaŋ n ni zaŋ n yɛligu shɛli ti a la yɛli ba.
en: Get up and go to Nineveh, that great city, and declare against it the proclamation that I am commanding you.

dag: Amaa lee ti wurimmiya bɛ maligu bimbina, ka kabisi bɛ binwɔɣila, ka wurim bɛ buɣili Ashɛra la.
en: So destroy their altars, break the stones they worship, and cut down their idols.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ. M Ba ni mi ma ka n gba mi m Ba shɛm, lala ka m mi m piɛri ka m piɛri maa gba mi ma; ka n zaŋdi n nyɛvili taɣiri m piɛri maa dini.
en: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.

dag: Ka noonsi bɛn be zuɣusaa tɛri bɛ tɛri tihi din baɣi li zuɣu, ka be di wula zuɣu kumda.
en: Overhead, the birds in the sky make their home, chirping loudly in the trees.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, zaɣ viɛlli mini yurilim din galisi kul ni be m biɛhigu ni n nyɛvili ni zaa, ka n kul ni be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Your goodness and mercy will be with me all my life, and I will live in the Lord s house a long, long time.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ bɛ paɣiba ti shɛba, ka zaŋ bɛ puri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyaŋ ba maa, dama bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa suhu kul yɛla alaha dibu zuɣu. Anabinim zaŋ tabili maligumaaniba zaa bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli.
en: Therefore, I will give their wives to others and their fields to their captors. From the least to the greatest, all are eager to profit. From prophet to priest, all trade in falsehood.

dag: Yɛm mini baŋsim din chɛ ka o tooi kahigiri zahima mini yɛliŋaha ni yɛlimuɣisira wuhiri niriba shia be o ni. Dinzuɣu timmi ti boli Daniɛl ŋun nyɛ naa ni daa boli so Bɛlitishaaza la na, ka o ti wuh a yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni.
en: He has unusual ability and is wise and skillful in interpreting dreams, solving riddles, and explaining mysteries; so send for this man Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar, and he will tell you what all this means.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi maa na ka Musa ti niŋ binʒim maa niŋ bɛ nudiriti tibinyaɣa ni mini bɛ nudiriti polo nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti polo napombihilɔri. Ka Musa daa kpaai ʒim maa vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Then he brought Aaron's sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Moses then threw the rest of the blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Ka ŋun Ahazia daa pahi Ɛhab bia Jɔram la zuɣu, ka bɛ lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Siria Naa Hazaɛl Ramɔtigiliad, ka Sirianim daa ti ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: Ahaziah went with Joram, Ahabs son, to fight against Arams King Hazael at Ramoth-gilead, where the Arameans wounded Joram.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lo ni a niŋ Naawuni niriba zaɣ biɛɣu? Dama naa yi bi chɛ ka o bia ŋun be yɔɣu la labina yaha, dindina naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din gbaag omaŋmaŋa.
en: The woman said, Why have you planned the very same thing against Gods people? In giving this order, the king has become guilty because the king hasnt restored his own banished son.

dag: N nyɛla a ni su so. Tiligim ma, dama n loya ni n dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I am yours—save me! I have tried to obey your commands.

dag: Ŋunkam kahind o tab nini nyɛla ŋun tahiri yɛla na, amaa ŋunkam mali suhukpeeni kpahiri niriba zuɣuri ni nyɛla ŋun tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Those who wink an eye bring trouble; those who speak foolishly are ruined.

dag: Naa suhu yi ti piɛla, alaafee benimi. Ka o nirilim ŋmanila sagbana din tahiri siɣili saa na.
en: Theres life in the light of the kings face. His favor is like a cloud that brings spring rain.

dag: Dama ti wumya ni ninvuɣ shɛb be yi ni n-nyɛ ʒinahigunima ka je ni bɛ tum shɛli, ka bɛ tuma naɣ kul nyɛla dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni kɔŋko.
en: We hear that some of you are living an undisciplined life. They arent working, but they are meddling in other peoples business.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan ŋɔ di ma shɛhira ni n yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi sani pala Iin mini Aai yɛla.
en: But if you can believe God, then you can believe that what we tell you is never both yes and no.

dag: Ka di zaa ha yi di nyɛla yaɣ yini, ya ka niŋgbuŋ naan be?.
en: If all were one and the same body part, what would happen to the body?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ lan yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Bɛ mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pisinaayi. Jɛrɔham bia Adaya daa nyɛla Pɛlalia yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Amizi mini Zakaria so mi ni Pashihur ni Malikija.
en: and their associates who carried out the work in the temple: . There was also Adaiah son of Jeroham son of Pelaliah son of Amzi son of Zechariah son of Pashhur son of Malchijah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim paai Nɛbonima, di zani dabari. Kiriataimnim di vi, bɛ ŋme n-deei li. Bɛ daai di goondaa luhi n-dihi ba vi.
en: Concerning Moab: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: How awful for Nebo; it lies in ruins. Kirathaim is captured and shamed; the fortress is disgraced, reduced to rubble.

dag: Ka kuhigu pam ni ti be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ yaha.
en: There will be loud crying all over Egypt, such as there has never been before or ever will be again.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa diri tiɣiri zaŋ bɛmaŋ pa talima pumpɔŋɔ ni bɛ nya bindirigu di, amaa kum bi lan mali di ni daa mali shɛb la yaha. Paɣiŋoo dɔɣi bih ayopɔin, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi bihi pam la kɔŋ bihi.
en: People who once had plenty to eat must now hire themselves out for only a piece of bread. But you give the hungry more than enough to eat. A woman did not have a child, and you gave her seven, but a woman who had many was left with none.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o.
en: Dogs will eat anyone of Ahabs family who dies in town, and birds will eat anyone who dies in the country. .

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni duh a ka paɣ a yuli. A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, a pal a ni daa pun lo nia shɛŋa kurimbuni ha, ka di mali alahiziba la.
en: You, Lord , are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi ka shiri niŋ ba lala biɛɣu pia.
en: The guard decided to go along with their plan and tested them for ten days.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ninsal maa, Dim tihi din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: He told him, You may eat the fruit of any tree in the garden.

dag: Yawɛ yi di bi sɔŋ ma, ŋ-ŋɔ n shia di be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: And if the Lord had not helped me, I would have been silenced by death.

dag: O daa gbimi vuɣi kuɣa nimaani, ka bo ti viɛla na ti sa nimaani; ka sa gara zali puu maa sunsuuni, ka mali wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili sɔŋ di ni. O daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, amaa ka di ti walila wal biɛri.
en: He dug the soil and cleared it of stones; he planted the finest vines. He built a tower to guard them, dug a pit for treading the grapes. He waited for the grapes to ripen, but every grape was sour.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Then Jesus said to his followers, And who do you say I am.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka dunianim baŋ a soli, ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ a tiliginsim yiko yɛla.
en: Let everyone on earth learn about you. Let every nation see how you save people.

dag: Ka Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Amaŋmaŋ yiɣisim ku ti. Dama doo ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ gba. Ka Gidiɔn daa yiɣisi ku Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka yihi bɛ laakumnim nyiŋgoya ni nachiinsi binyara.
en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said to Gideon, Come on, kill us yourself. You are a man and strong enough to do the job. So Gideon got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna. Then Gideon took the decorations shaped like the moon off their camels necks.

dag: ka goli daa kpalim zani di jilima shee; a piɛma neesim din daa gariti yomyom la min a kpani din daa nyaɣisira la zuɣu.
en: At the flash of your speeding arrows and the gleam of your shining spear, the sun and the moon stood still.

dag: Amaa nyin tum alahichi n-gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni. A daai ma baɣil a nyaaŋa ka me buɣa, ka mali binnana zali n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: You have committed far greater sins than those who ruled before you. You have rejected me and have aroused my anger by making idols and metal images to worship.

dag: O ni ti yihi biŋkɔb yino yi biŋkɔbiri pia kam puuni ka yi ti leeg o daba.
en: He will take one-tenth of your flocks, and then you yourselves will become his slaves!.

dag: Bina anahi yɛla n-niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: There are three things that are hard for me to understand—really, four things that I dont understand:.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma, ka zoya na kani, ka daboya gba na kani.
en: I was born before the mountains and hills were set into place.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋ hal ka o ti saɣi ka Amnɔn mini nabihi maa zaa daa dol o chaŋ.
en: But Absalom kept on insisting until David finally let Amnon and all his other sons go with Absalom. Absalom prepared a banquet fit for a king.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham Juda tin shɛl ni ti ʒini? Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Chama. Ka Dauda lan bɔhi, N cham tiŋ kani? Ka o yɛl o, Cham Hiburɔn.
en: Later David asked the Lord for advice. David said, Should I take control of any of the cities of Judah? The Lord said to David, Yes. David asked, Where should I go? The Lord answered, To Hebron.

dag: Dama di sabiya, Yinim Yɛhudianim zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kul ʒiɛmdi Naawuni yuli.
en: The scripture says, Because of you Jews, the Gentiles speak evil of God.

dag: Ka maligumaana leebu nimdi maa bee bɔrɔbɔro maa yi ti guui n-zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, dindina yin di lan ŋub li, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: If any meat for the ordination or any of the bread is left over until morning, then you should burn the leftovers with fire. It shouldnt be eaten because its holy.

dag: A yi paai nimaani, nyin lihim bo Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la shee n-kpe nti bol o o tab sani n-zaŋ o kpe duu ashilɔni.
en: When you arrive, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Then go in and make him get up from among his brothers. Take him to an inner room.

dag: ka lan bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla m bia Iso? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: Isaac said, Are you really my son Esau? Jacob answered, Yes, I am.

dag: So ti ku me o yili ka shɛb deei li kpe m-beni, ka so mi ti ku sa tihi ka shɛb deei di wala di. N niriba maa ni di bɛ nuhi tuma daanfaani. Tihi ni yɛn yuuri shɛm, lala ka n niriba maa gba yɛn yuura.
en: Never again will one person build a house and another person live there. Never again will one person plant a garden and another eat the fruit from it. My people will live as long as the trees. My chosen people will get full use of whatever they make.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ni Yisa tɔɣisi luhi Sadusiinim maa, ka bɛ daa laɣim tab ka o sanna.
en: When the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they came together.

dag: Dama Ibrahimma paɣ Zara zuɣu, Yawɛ daa ŋarila Abimilɛk yiŋ paɣiba maa bidɔɣibo soya.
en: Because of the incident with Abrahams wife Sarah, the LORD had kept all of the women in Abimelechs household from having children.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Jɔn gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pɔri Naawuni nam ni galisi gar o.
en: I tell you, Jesus added, John is greater than anyone who has ever lived. But the one who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than John.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin dali daa ti yɛn paai, ka Naawuni pun naai o ni daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa maa tuma; ka vuhi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zaa vuhim daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: On the sixth day God completed all the work that he had done, and on the seventh day God rested from all the work that he had done.

dag: Yi yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpan shɛlikam n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛmd o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri ti anzansi ka kpaŋsiri ti suhuri ŋɔ chɛ ka yi doli Yisa Masia ka mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: And may God, the source of patience and encouragement, enable you to have the same point of view among yourselves by following the example of Christ Jesus.

dag: Saha paaya ni n nyɛvili leei sara maligu Naawuni sani; n dunia ŋɔ ni yibu saha miriya.
en: Im already being poured out like a sacrifice to God, and the time of my death is near.

dag: Chɛliya yi kpibisi; n ni gbib ba, ka chɛ ka yi pakoya niŋ ma naani.
en: No one will be left to care for his children. His wives will have no one to depend on.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ daa chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: His answer surprised them so much that they walked away.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka Aduna kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee fiɛb taŋkpaɣu, ka pɔri daa yi n-lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zuɣu, taŋkpaɣu maa zaa daa leela pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: They obeyed, and when Aaron struck the ground with the stick, gnats started swarming on people and animals. In fact, every speck of dust in Egypt turned into a gnat.

dag: N ni wuh o o ni yɛn di wahala shɛm n yuli zuɣu.
en: I will show him how much he must suffer for the sake of my name.

dag: Kiriatijiarim mini Chɛfira ni Bɛrɔt — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaata.
en: from the towns of Kiriath Jearim, Kephirah, and Beeroth:.

dag: N ni paɣiri Naawuni so yɛligu maa, ŋuna ka n niŋ naani ka bi zɔri dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.

dag: Ka Maikil bia Zɛbadia daa nyɛ Shɛfatia daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pihinii daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Shephatiah: Zebadiah son of Michael, and other men;.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Bɛ zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita shɛli Izraɛlnim shɛb ni daa zal o daa shɛm la.
en: This showed the full meaning of what Jeremiah the prophet said: They took silver coins. That was how much the people of Israel decided to pay for his life.

dag: Nyin ŋun bol amaŋa Yɛhudia ŋɔ, wula n-lee nyɛ li a sani? A niŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu naani ka nyuri bara a Naawuni milinsi zuɣu.
en: But, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the Law; if you brag about your relationship to God.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti pala puɣisiriba, ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba.
en: But we told him, We're honest men, not spies.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo bɛ fɔntin shɛŋa ni bɛ ni daa be mini bɛ sansana zaa buɣim.
en: Then they burned all their towns and villages.

dag: Kulla naa kɔŋko m-mali soli ni o ʒini di puuni n-di bindirigu Yawɛ tooni. O ni dolila dunɔdali maa polo zɔntua kpe, ka lan doli nimaani yi.
en: The ruling prince, however, may go there to eat a holy meal in my presence. He is to enter and leave the gateway through the entrance room at the inner end.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a lan zaŋ piɛla ŋun la na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Take the second ram, and have Aaron and his sons lay their hands on the rams head.

dag: Ka o yɛli, A mi ni mani n-daa su nam ŋɔ, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yu ni mani n-di li, amaa ka nam maa ti ŋmaligi leela n tizo dini, dama Yawɛ n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: You know that I was king for a little while, Adonijah replied. And everyone in Israel accepted me as their ruler. But the Lord wanted my brother to be king, so now things have changed.

dag: Yɛhudianim mali soya balibu pam din chɛ ka bɛ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, Naawuni daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa niŋla Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zali pateesa shɛli din yili Alikauli Adaka tooni la mi tooni. Alikauli Adaka maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuh a.
en: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.

dag: Amaa n ni ti deei nam maa o bia nuu ni n-zaŋ li ti nyin ŋun su zuliya pia ŋɔ.
en: I will take the kingdom away from Solomon's son and will give you ten tribes.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi ʒiɛra, ka teeku maa kɔgbana kul puɣiri lura.
en: By then a strong wind was blowing and stirring up the water.

dag: Bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo a jɛmbu duu maa, ka ta a ni be luɣ shɛl la daɣiri. Bɛ daai li luhi zaa.
en: They burned down your Holy Place. It was built to honor your name, but they pulled it down to the ground.

dag: Amaa yin teemiya yi nuu n-zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa paŋ o ni yi suhu zaa ka di saɣ o, hal di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam.
en: You must be willing to share with them. You must lend them whatever they need.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na ka o nyaandoliba ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, nyam kuɣa ŋɔ mini duri ŋɔ ni viɛl shɛm.
en: As Jesus left the temple, one of his disciples said to him, Teacher, look! What awesome stones and buildings.

dag: Ka nyini m bia, bɛ ni ti boon a la Zallakudura Naa daanabi, dama a ni ti daŋ ti Duuma tooni nti mal o soya gu o;.
en: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ ŋun maŋmaŋ nuzaa ni.
en: The priest shall take some of the olive oil and pour it in the palm of his own left hand.

dag: Di nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli nyin Firawuna shɛm la, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuh a.
en: It is just as I said—God has shown what he intends to do.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛl o, ka o yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir yɛl la. O daa yɛliya, Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl niŋgbuŋ Jɛziriil tintariga;.
en: When the men came back and told Jehu, he said, The Lord told his servant Elijah the Tishbite to give this message: Dogs will eat the body of Jezebel in the area of Jezreel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zaɣa zaa niŋ o ni, dama o daa pun chɛ ka o bukpahitali maa tabibi tuma niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka di wɔɣa.
en: They paid this attention to him because for such a long time he had astonished them with his magic.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn Zol zuɣu; m-moli nolɔbo molo, ka laɣim niriba.
en: Blow the trumpet at Zion. Call for a special meeting. Call for a special time of fasting.

dag: Bɛ ni niŋ shɛli naani ka yaa, di ŋmanila kpatinariga yili.
en: They trust a thread—a spider's web.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yoomiya vol maa yihi nanima anu la ti ma na.
en: Joshua said, Open up the mouth of the cave. Bring those five kings out of the cave to me.

dag: ka kari ba saria kaman di ni sab zali shɛm. Naawuni niriba bɛn ʒe yim nasara dibu m-bala. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tɔb nɛma maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣ shɛli jɛmbu duu, ka daa zaŋ o zuɣu maa ti yili bɛ buɣili Dagɔn jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: They placed his armor in their gods temple and displayed his skull on a pole in the temple of Dagon.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di manna maa yuun pihinahi hal ti paai bɛ ni daa yɛn ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa. Bɛ daa kul dirila manna maa hal ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Israelites ate manna for the next forty years, until they reached the land of Canaan, where they settled. .

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima suhu yɛla baŋsim zuɣu, amaa jɛrilim m-be jɛra noya ni.
en: An understanding heart seeks knowledge; but fools feed on folly.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sihɔn min o niriba zaa ni daa yina ti liri ti n-tuhi ti Jahaz.
en: Then King Sihon and all his people came out to fight against us at Jahaz.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ suhuri chihi pam, ka bɛ bɔhi Pita min o tab maa, Ti mabihi, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: When the crowd heard this, they were deeply troubled. They said to Peter and the other apostles, Brothers, what should we do.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa dooi bini mali naɣibil zali ka daa yɛli, Yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti na la m-bɔŋɔ! la, bɛ daa mo nyin Naawuni pam.
en: You didnt leave them even when they made golden calves and said, These are the gods that led us out of Egypt.

dag: N ni ti ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri bɛn be kulisi ni, ka ninsalinim naba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha, ka niɣi takarifiɛma gba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha.
en: I will slaughter your cattle that graze by the river, and no people or livestock will be left to muddy its water.

dag: Ka n ni daa dɔɣi maa nyaaŋa, di daba ata dali, ka paɣ ŋɔ gba daa dɔɣi, m min o kɔŋko n-kul be yili maa ni, ka so ka ti sani n-kul pahila ti niriba ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: and three days later her baby was born. Nobody else was there with us.

dag: Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam dindali maa; dama Sool daa pola pɔri yɛli, Ŋunkam di bindirigu ka wuntaŋ na bi lu n ni bɔhiri n dimnim biɛri dahin shɛli ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Lala zuɣu niriba maa ni so noli daa bi to bindirigu.
en: But Saul made a big mistake that day. He made this oath: If any man eats food before evening comes, before I finish defeating my enemies, he will be under a curse. He made the soldiers promise not to eat. So none of them ate anything.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli, Nyama, wuntaŋ ni n-na bɔŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri maa taɣ kuli yiŋ saha na bi paai, dinzuɣu ŋɔŋmiya kom ti piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu, ka yi zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: Jacob said, Look, it is still day and long before the sun sets. It is not yet time for the animals to be gathered together for the night. So give them water and let them go back into the field.

dag: Amaa yum maa yi ti lan taɣi m-paligi, di saha ŋun kam maligumaana sanna.
en: If the raw skin changes and becomes white, the person must come to the priest.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli? Amaa tinim nyɛla bɛn mali Masia tɛha.
en: As the scripture says, Who knows the mind of the Lord? Who is able to give him advice? We, however, have the mind of Christ.

dag: Kul doliya zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka ti ʒini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: Righteousness! Pursue righteousness so that you live long and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: Yɛlimiya Amasa, A nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n yi bi zaŋ a leei n tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, Naawuni ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba. .
en: And tell Amasa, Arent you my flesh and bones too? May God deal harshly with me and worse still if you dont become commander of my army from now on instead of Joab.

dag: Dama alahichi ku lan tooi sun ya yi ni yi fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni kpe Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni la zuɣu.
en: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, Di nyɛla din ni dini? Ka Yisa yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma;.
en: The man asked, Which ones? Jesus answered, You must not murder anyone, you must not commit adultery, you must not steal, you must not tell lies about others.

dag: N daa ti lihi n yiŋ takɔro voya ni.
en: Once I was looking out the window of my house.

dag: M muɣisigu puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: I was in trouble, so I called to the Lord for help. The Lord answered and made me free.

dag: Adam ni daa dɔɣi Sɛt maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Seths birth, Adam lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Di simdi ni ti ŋme goonje mini mɔɣilo paɣ a, ka ŋme biɛɣu paɣ a.
en: with the music of stringed instruments and with melody on the harp.

dag: ka daa lan nyɛ bɛn dari gindi tinsi, n-kpe zuliya shɛli ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe zuliya shɛli ni ni n-kpe na so tiŋ ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe na so tiŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to the next.

dag: ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa tiri ya ka di nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu ti yi bihi din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: he told them: Set your mind on all these words Im testifying against you right now, because you must command your children to perform carefully all the words of this Instruction.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe nti di ka nyu ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya noli ni di paɣ so maa ti sɔɣi; dama o nyɛla nabipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.

dag: M ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o ni me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: When my father wanted to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi Dauda paɣiba ayi la gba chaŋ; Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la.
en: The Amalekites had taken Davids two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, who had been the wife of Nabal from Carmel.

dag: Di daanabinim baɣa ka shɛli ni, ka nyɛ bɛn ka yɛda. Ka di maligumaaniba saɣim binshɛŋa din be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛn birigi zaligu.
en: The prophets are irresponsible and treacherous; the priests defile what is sacred, and twist the law of God to their own advantage.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti, ka yihi ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim luɣ yini, ka ti paɣ a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka ti a jilima ti paɣibu maa puuni.
en: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahi naaya yi yaannim tuma maa!.
en: So keep on doing everything they did.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n ta yi nanim bɛn be n sara maligu shee daɣiri, ka chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paai Yaakubu zuliya, ka chɛ ka bɛ tu Izraɛlnima.
en: So I made the holy officials impure, handed over Jacob to destruction and Israel to abuse.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Asha zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Mishal mini Abidɔn.
en: From the territory of Asher they received four cities: Mishal, Abdon.

dag: Naɣ kara bɛba ayopɔin la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kar ayopɔin la gba gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin; zahindi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The seven good cows stand for seven years, and so do the seven good heads of grain.

dag: Gbariti ni ti yiɣi jɛm kaman waliga la, ka biriti ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli. Kom ni ti zɔri yiri tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ nɛl la ni na. Ka mɔɣa ti dɔni di ni.
en: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yi di daa bi chɛ ka shɛb tiligi, ti tiŋ maa naan bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra.
en: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive.

dag: Bindirigu mini kom kɔŋko zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ lihiri taba ni suhuzɔhibo, ka bahi yoli bɛ tibidarigibo maa puuni.
en: When their food and water dwindles away, everyone will be horrified, and they will waste away because of their guilt.

dag: N yi chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari m-bahi yoli bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: They will know that I am the LORD when I make the land an uninhabitable waste because of all their detestable practices.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ pin kasinim maa, ka di kpɛhi ba alahichi ni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: They must not let the people eat these offerings. If they do, they are guilty of doing wrong, and they must pay for it. I am the Lord , the one who makes these offerings holy.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi tuumbiɛri mini din chihiri shɛŋa ninvuɣ biɛri ni tumda, bɛ ni be? N ku lan teei bɛ ni daa tum wuntitali tuun shɛŋa maa yɛla. Dama bɛ bilikɔnsi taali mini bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu bɛ ni kpi.
en: But if a righteous person stops doing good and starts doing all the evil, disgusting things that evil people do, will he go on living? No! None of the good he did will be remembered. He will die because of his unfaithfulness and his sins.

dag: A daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhi shihira Firawuna min o tumtumdiba zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa sani, a ni mi bɛ ni daa niŋ ti fitiina shɛm la zuɣu. A daa zali yuli ti amaŋa, ka di kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You showed the miracles to Pharaoh. You did amazing things to his officials and his people. You knew that the Egyptians thought they were better than our ancestors. But you proved how great you are, and they remember that even today.

dag: a ti ku mali suhugarigu a ni daa ku so ka di ka daliri zuɣu bee amaŋmaŋ ni daa bɔhi biɛri zuɣu. N dana, ka Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a sani, nyin di ti tam mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: and now your conscience will be clear, because you won't be guilty of taking revenge and killing innocent people. When the Lord does all those good things for you, please remember me.

dag: Yi yi saɣi li, ka deei n noli, yi ni di tiŋgbani ŋɔ bin suma anfaani.
en: If you will only obey me, you will eat the good things the land produces.

dag: Yɛm mali biɛhigu shee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛhi zilima tɛha ni, amaa di ka jɛra bɛn suhuri ni.
en: Wisdom is in every thought of intelligent people; fools know nothing about wisdom.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum buyi.
en: But Jesus said to him, I assure you that on this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; dabili mi bi garit o duuma.
en: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.

dag: ni Mikilɔt . Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ niriba daa ʒini baɣilila bɛ dɔɣim maa Jɛrusalɛm fɔŋ ni.
en: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.

dag: Dinzuɣu di wum bɛ yɛligu maa, dama bɛ niriba gari ninvuɣ pihinahi do sol ni gu o. Bɛ laɣimmi po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ guhirila a nol ni yɛligu.
en: But dont believe them! More than of them are hiding and waiting to kill him. They have all promised not to eat or drink until they have killed him. Now they are waiting for you to say yes.

dag: Binneembihi zaa bɛn mali kpiŋkpama nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani, ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋub ba.
en: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.

dag: Di ni sab zani so zuɣu ni o niŋ dabili ni bahi leei dabili; ka ŋunkam mali takɔbi kur o taba, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku o gba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mal ania ka niŋ yɛda.
en: If any are to be taken captive, then into captivity they will go. If any are to be killed by the sword, then by the sword they will be killed. This calls for endurance and faithfulness on the part of the saints.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya polo ka niriba maa lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ yila Babilɔn din nyɛ tin shɛli din be katiŋ la n-ka n sanna.
en: Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah and asked, Where did these messengers come from and what did they say to you? Hezekiah answered, They came from a very distant country, from Babylonia.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya Izraɛl kpamba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zibisim ni bebɔ? Sokam bela o binnana duu. Dama bɛ yɛlimi, Yawɛ bi nya ti, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. .
en: God said, Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.

dag: Di gbihi bee m-pɔb a nini.
en: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.

dag: Bɛ ni wuh a, ka yɛl a bɛ ni mi shɛlikam zaa.
en: But let the ancient wise people teach you; listen to what they had to say:.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the Lord s angel said this to Joshua:.

dag: Ziɔnnima, Maliya suhupiɛlli pam! Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu! Nyamiya, Yi naa kani yi sanna! O nyaŋmi ka di nasara n-kanna maa, amaa o nyɛla siɣisimaŋlana, ka bari buŋa ŋun nyɛ buŋ polli.
en: Rejoice greatly, Daughter Zion. Sing aloud, Daughter Jerusalem. Look, your king will come to you. He is righteous and victorious. He is humble and riding on an ass, on a colt, the offspring of a donkey.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa je ma sɔɣirimi yɛri taba n yɛla. Bɛ kul tɛhirila zaɣ biɛɣu tiri ma.
en: All of those who hate me talk about me, whispering to each other, plotting evil against me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima niŋ binyɛribila maa naŋgbambiya.
en: They made shoulder pieces for it attached to its two edges so that they could be joined together.

dag: Ka Isaka bidibisi daa nyɛ: Tola mini Puva ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn.
en: Issachars sons were Tola, Puah, Job, and Shimron.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yisa m-bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o.
en: who took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi Bɔzira din be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ye binyɛr ʒee kanna ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ye binyɛr viɛlli n-kanna ni yiko ni o kpiɔŋ ŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun mali yiko ka ni tooi tiligi niriba la n-kanna ni o ti mol o nasara dibu la molo.
en: Who is this coming from Edom, from the city of Bozrah? His clothes are stained bright red. He is glorious in his clothes. He is walking tall with his great power. He says, I have the power to save you, and I speak the truth.

dag: Zɔri, Yawɛ ni to n-kpuɣ a ni suli n-zaŋ ti labi. O ni gbaag a kirikiri.
en: The LORD is about to hurl you down, mighty man! He is surely going to cover you with darkness.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni zaligu bela bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi sarigiri bɛ napɔna yaabu ni.
en: The Instruction of their God is in their hearts; they dont miss a step.

dag: Bɛ maŋmaŋ niŋgbuna biɛrim kɔŋko n-naɣi mali ba, ka bɛ kuhiri bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: They only feel the pain in their bodies, and they alone cry for themselves.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu mini Rɛkab bia Jɛhɔnadab daa kpe Baal duu maa ni, ka o yɛli Baal jɛmdiba maa, Di chɛliya ka Yawɛ jɛmda be yi ni, amaa chɛliya ka di kul nyɛla yinim bɛn nyɛ Baal jɛmdiba maa kɔŋko.
en: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.

dag: A ni di biɛla shɛli maa, a ni ti li bahi, ka a yɛtɔɣ viɛla bahi yoli.
en: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted.

dag: Mani n-su anzinfa mini salima zaa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The silver and the gold belong to me, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti Maika ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔrɛshɛt nir la m-bɔŋɔ. Di daa nyɛla Jɔtam mini Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa nya binshɛŋa maa daa nyɛla Samaria mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: The LORDs word that came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Judahs Kings Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔhi ma bin suŋ yɛla? Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko n-nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ. Amaa a yi bɔri ni a ti nya nyɛvili, nyin doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima.
en: Jesus answered, Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. But if you want to have eternal life, obey the laws commands.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka tiŋgban shɛli din daa mali atam pam la leela tiŋgban nɛli, ka di fɔntinsi la zaa wurim do Yawɛ tooni, o suhuyiɣisili din galisi zuɣu.
en: I looked and the fertile land was a desert; all its towns were in ruins before the LORD, before his fury.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka sagbana yiri dunia tariga na. Ŋuna n-nam saa nyaɣisibu niŋ saa ni, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zal li luɣ shɛŋa na.
en: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun paani o daalikauli bɛn ne mini kpiimba sani ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Bɔaz ni! Hal doo maa nyɛla ti dɔɣira ni Yɛlimaŋli.
en: Naomi replied to her daughter-in-law, May he be blessed by the LORD, who hasnt abandoned his faithfulness with the living or with the dead. Naomi said to her, The man is one of our close relatives; hes one of our redeemers.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana.
en: His children born there were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi niriba ŋaha yɛli.
en: Jesus again used parables in talking to the people.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi piligu ni hal ti paai di bahigu ni, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Hanani bia Jɛhu yɛlikura sabbu ni, ka di be Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Jehoshaphats deeds, from beginning to end, are written in the records of Jehu, Hananis son, which are included in the records of Israels kings.

dag: M min a ni chaŋ Ijipti, ka n ti lan zaŋ a labisi kpe na yaha; ka Yisifu maŋmaŋ nuu ni ti daag a nina pɔbi.
en: I will go with you to Egypt, and I will bring your descendants back to this land. Joseph will be with you when you die.

dag: m ba daa wuhiri ma, ka yɛri ma, Chɛ ka n yɛligu kpe a suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga; gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli ka be.
en: my father would teach me. He would say, Remember what I say and never forget it. Do as I tell you, and you will live.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yɛla, dama o yuli daa duya pam. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛli, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-lan neei kum ni na, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: Jesus became so well-known that Herod the ruler heard about him. Some people thought he was John the Baptist, who had come back to life with the power to work miracles.

dag: Ka Asa daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Asa did what pleased the Lord , as his ancestor David had done.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maami tab suhuri.
en: So encourage each other with these words.

dag: O daa ʒila niriba pam pahi laakumnim bɛn ʒiri tulaale zim mini salima pam ni kuɣ viɛla n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na. O ni daa paai Sulemaana sani, o daa yɛl o din be o suhu ni zaa.
en: She brought with her a large group of attendants, as well as camels loaded with spices, jewels, and a large amount of gold. When she and Solomon met, she asked him all the questions that she could think of.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba mabia ŋun nyɛ doo paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ma.
en: Do not have intercourse with your uncle's wife; she, too, is your aunt.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ma, Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kɔba maa, Yinim kɔb kuma ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: He said, Prophesy to the bones. Tell these dry bones to listen to the word of the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu Filistianima, bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la, di yi pa lala, yi ni leei Hiburunim maa daba kaman bɛ ni yi nyɛ yi daba shɛm la; bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la n-tuhi ba.
en: Philistines, be brave and fight hard! If you don't, those Hebrews will rule us, just as we've been ruling them. Fight and don't be afraid.

dag: Naa, ti gba ni nyar a nam daanfaani la zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi bɔri ni ti nya a filiŋ, dinzuɣu ka ti timna ti yɛl a.
en: Now, because we are under obligation to Your Majesty, we do not want to see this happen, and so we suggest.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka nuchee ŋɔ puhi yina ti sab sabbu ŋɔ.
en: So because of that, God sent the hand that wrote on the wall.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ma la zaɣ nɛɔŋ niŋ gballi ni, ka kahi kuɣa pa n zuɣu.
en: They caught me alive in a pit and threw stones at me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n sa ni ku bɛ zaa ti Izraɛlnima; ka yi sa chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri napɔn jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi buɣim.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, Dont be afraid of them. By this time tomorrow, I will make them all dead bodies in Israels presence. Cripple their horses! Burn their chariots.

dag: Ka Filip daa guui paag o sani nti wum ka o karindila Anabi Aizaia litaafi. Ka Filip bɔh o, A baŋ a ni karindi litaafi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: Philip ran over and heard him reading from the book of the prophet Isaiah. He asked him, Do you understand what you are reading.

dag: Yɛndaannim bela neesim ni, ka jɛra mi be zibisim ni. Amaa m mi ni yɛl yini n-ʒe n-guli bɛ zaa.
en: Wise people use their minds like eyes to see where they are going. But for fools, it is as if they are walking in the dark. I also saw that fools and wise people both end the same way.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka saa kum ka mi dindali maa. Ka Yawɛ mini Samuɛl yɛla daa gbahi niriba maa zaa dabiɛm pam.
en: So Samuel prayed, and on that same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. Then all the people became afraid of the Lord and of Samuel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paɣ o chɛchɛbuŋ maa sɔŋ miri Samaria biaŋ, ka bahi daa kana ti lɛl o ʒim; ka pagɔra gba kana nti su di kom kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: They took his chariot to the large pool in Samaria to clean it. The dogs licked up Ahabs blood while the prostitutes washed the chariot. This happened just as the Lord said it would.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa naa; Yilimiya yila paɣ o!.
en: God is the King of the whole world. Sing songs of praise!.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-nyɛ: Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nadab.
en: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Then Job answered the Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Chama, ka daa chɛ ka o chaŋ ni o ti niŋ chira ayi. Ka o daa ŋmaligi ka o min o dol tab chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-fabil o ni yɛn kpi ni o paɣipiɛlital maa zuɣu.
en: Jephthah said, Go. He sent her away for two months. Jephthahs daughter and her friends stayed in the mountains. They cried for her because she would not marry and have children.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee pateesanim mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni di bimpindigu ni biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ din yɛn pa di zuɣusaa la ni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni pateesa la.
en: the Tent, its inner cover, its outer cover, the fine leather cover on top of it, the curtain for the entrance.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, dama di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani ni bɛ di baŋ li, ka bɛ mi daa zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: But the disciples did not know what this meant. It had been hidden from them so that they could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask him about the matter.

dag: O daa bi tooi tum tuun kar shɛli nimaani n-naɣ pahila o daa kul zaŋla o nuhi pa barinim biɛla zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus was not able to do any miracles there except the healing of some sick people by laying his hands on them.

dag: Ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa daa po pɔri yɛli bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm ni yi tum tuma ti Babilɔnnima. Ʒinimiya tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛla tin ya.
en: Gedaliah told them, There's no need to be afraid of the Babylonians. Everything will be fine, if we live peacefully and obey King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka ŋunkam zaɣis a zaligu dolibu bee n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu, a ni zali ni o niŋ shɛlikam ni, bɛn kum o. Kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam.
en: Then anyone who refuses to obey your commands or turns against you will be killed. Just be strong and brave.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka bɛ zaŋ kikahi ayopɔin ti malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn ʒe Naawuni tooni.
en: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.

dag: Bɛ daa bela Arinɔn Mɔɣili duli guhira, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo. Bɛ daa ŋmanila noon shɛb bɛ ni kari bɛ tɛri ni bahi.
en: The daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon are like orphaned birds pushed from the nest.

dag: So yi tahir a sariakarita sani ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa; di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita maa sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.

dag: Ka tulaale zim shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni kasia nyom be a situra ni; ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali a nam yil shɛl la ni biŋkumda chɛ ka a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: The perfume of myrrh and aloes is on your clothes; musicians entertain you in palaces decorated with ivory.

dag: dama m mabih anu na beni, ka o chaŋ ti lee saɣisi bɛna, ka bɛn ti ku kana ti kpe azaaba shɛl ni n ni be ŋɔ.
en: where I have five brothers. Let him go and warn them so that they, at least, will not come to this place of pain.

dag: O daa ku Amɔri Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi ni Keenan nanim zaa.
en: Sihon the Amorite king, Og the king of Bashan, and all the Canaanite kings.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na zo ma nambɔɣu kaman a ni pun niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli shɛm la.
en: Come back to me and have mercy on me; thats only right for those who love your name.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛlimaŋli maa lee nyɛla dini? Gomna Pailɛt ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan yi Yɛhudianim maa sani ti yɛli ba, M bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: What is truth? Pilate asked. After Pilate said this, he returned to the Jewish leaders and said, I find no grounds for any charge against him.

dag: Yɛm puuni ka nir mɛri yili, tɛhi zilima puuni ka yili mɛri zaana.
en: Good homes are built on wisdom and understanding.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ lan zaŋm daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa yaha. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: All the people agreed to stay seven more days. They were joyful as they celebrated the Passover for seven more days.

dag: Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba kalinli ni zooi gari Lɛvinim kalinli kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata la zuɣu.
en: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra men and boys must be bought back from me.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa biri ti shɛli bɛ ni booni tamarisik tia la Bɛrishiiba, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni ŋɔ nimaani.
en: Abraham planted a special tree at Beersheba and prayed to the Lord , the God who lives forever.

dag: Dabiɛm vuri kul bela bɛ tiba ni, azichi pam puuni ka bahiyolilan yɛn liri ba.
en: Voices of terror will scream in their ears, and robbers attack when they think they are safe.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ taali sanyoo sara piɛlaa maa mali sara Yawɛ tooni o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: and with it the priest shall perform the ritual of purification to remove the man's sin, and God will forgive him.

dag: di simdi ni nir zaŋ o tapaɣa ti ka bɛ ŋme o, ka tu o.
en: He should turn his cheek to the one who hits him and let people insult him.

dag: Ti ni nya nɛma balibu kam din mali shaara, ka ŋme n-di nɛma pam ti pali ti yinsi.
en: We'll find all kinds of riches and fill our houses with loot!.

dag: nti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yiliya la tooni.
en: He must put his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times in front of the curtain before the Lord .

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣim chaŋ Mizipa. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa, Yɛlim ti bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛɣu maa shɛm.
en: And the Benjaminites got word that the Israelites had marched up to Mizpah. The Israelites inquired, Tell us how this evil act happened.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ŋɔ, dama a chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli suŋ. Amaa n yi mali taali, amaŋmaŋ nyin kum ma, dama bɔ zuɣu ka a lan yɛn zaŋ ma chaŋ a ba sani yaha.
en: So be loyal to your servant, because youve brought your servant into a sacred covenant with you. If Im guilty, then kill me yourself; just dont take me back to your father.

dag: A yi yɛli niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ bɔh a, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ kara ŋɔ zaa jɛndi ti? Ti taali lee nyɛla dini? Alahichi bɔ ka ti lee tum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: When you tell them all this, they will ask you why I have decided to punish them so harshly. They will ask what crime they are guilty of and what sin they have committed against the Lord their God.

dag: O daa zaŋ o zali tiŋgbani luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu; ka daa zaŋ puri ni bindira dihir o. O daa zaŋ tampima voya ni shiri mini chɛribo kuɣa voya ni kpam dih o.
en: He let them rule the highlands, and they ate what grew in the fields. They found wild honey among the rocks; their olive trees flourished in stony ground.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum din bahiri niriba yoli mini buɣim din dira ni alɔbo din ni chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaŋ bɛ nyina liri ba lu bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ tinvura lɔɣu lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: They will die from hunger and fever; they will die from terrible diseases. I will send wild animals to attack them, and poisonous snakes to bite them.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n daa yi m ma puli ni na ni n ti nyari muɣisigu mini suhugarigu, ka vi kul yɛn diri ma hal ni n nyɛvili tariga?.
en: Why did I have to come out of her body? All I have seen is trouble and sorrow, and my life will end in shame.

dag: O tiri binnɛɔŋ kam bindirigu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God is the one who provides food for all living things— Gods faithful love lasts forever!.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ lahibali ni daa ti nti to Hazɔr Naa Jabin saha shɛli, ka o daa tim ti yɛli Madɔn Naa Jɔbab mini Shimrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: King Jabin of Hazor heard about everything that had happened. So he decided to call together the armies of several kings. He sent a message to King Jobab of Madon to the king of Shimron, to the king of Acshaph.

dag: hal ka bɛ ni so ti ku kpalim. Dama Anatɔtnim tibidarigibo yuuni yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: No one from the city of Anathoth will be left. No one will survive. I will punish them and cause something bad to happen to them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-yɛn nyɛ yi zaligunima yi ni yɛn be luɣ shɛlikam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: These rules will be the law forever in all the towns of your people.

dag: Ka Ibram daa lan gbaai chandi zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb polo.
en: Then Abram set out toward the arid southern plain, making and breaking camp as he went.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: When Jesus was eating with his twelve disciples that evening, he said, One of you will surely hand me over to my enemies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Jɛrubaal mini Barak ni Jafta ni Samsin ka bɛ kana ti fan ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni bahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka chɛ ka yi beni ka barina shɛli lan kani.
en: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samson, and he delivered you from the power of your enemies on every side. And you lived safe and secure.

dag: Nir yi daŋ deeg o fali yomyom piligu ni, di bahigu ti ka anfaani.
en: If your wealth was easy to get, it will not be worth much to you.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba. N ni nya bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, dama bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanima. Bɛ nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: I will no longer help them, he said; then I will see what happens to them, those stubborn, unfaithful people.

dag: O ni yɛli, N ni lan chɛ ka ŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛli din wuhiri ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ binnamda ka damdi la ni vuui ni di chɛ ka binshɛŋa din ku tooi dam la kpalim be.
en: The words once again mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli wuntia soli m-me o yili mini ŋun bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli m me o jirambisa, ka chɛ ka o taba tum o tuma yoli ka o bi yo ba zuɣu.
en: How terrible for Jehoiakim, who builds his house with corruption and his upper chambers with injustice, working his countrymen for nothing, refusing to give them their wages.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n yɛn darigila Amɔn ŋun nyɛ Tɛbis nir la tibili, ka darigi Firawuna mini Ijiptinim ni di wuna ni di nanim zaŋ tabili bɛn niŋ Firawuna naani la tibili.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Im going to punish Amon of Thebes, Egypt and its gods and kings, as well as Pharaoh and all who rely on him.

dag: Di saha ka Zifinim daa chaŋ Sool sani Gibia ti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela ti ya Hɔrɛshi sɔɣisili shee din be Hachila zo shɛli din labiri Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la zuɣu.
en: Some people from Ziph went to Saul at Gibeah and said, David is hiding out in our territory at Horesh on Mount Hachilah, in the southern part of the Judean wilderness.

dag: amaa ka malaika maa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Dama lahibal suŋ din mali suhupiɛlli pam ka nyɛ sokam zaa dini ka n ʒina ni n ti yɛli ya.
en: The angel said to them, Dont be afraid. I have some very good news for you—news that will make everyone happy.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ ni, do shɛb bɛn daa kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa n-nyɛ: Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua min o mabihi daŋ ni: Maasɛya mini Ɛliɛza ni Jarib ni Gɛdalia.
en: These are the names of the descendants of the priests who married foreign women: From the descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and Jeshuas brothers, these men: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Baal anabinim maa, Yi ni galisi maa zuɣu, daŋmiya pii yi naɣilaa kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa, ka suhi yi buɣili maa; amaa ka lee di niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, There are many of you, so you go first. Choose a bull and prepare it, but dont start your fire.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naawuni, Wara ka chɛ ti. Bɔ ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛn tooi niŋ ti?.
en: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa kpahiri yi nuhi, ka mali yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yi suhuri paligi yi ni lo zaɣ biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo la zuɣu.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: You clapped your hands and jumped for joy. You despised the land of Israel.

dag: A ku tooi zo n-tilig o nuu ni, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag a n-zaŋ a ti ti o. A mini Babilɔn naa maa nini ni ti nya taba, ka a zani o tooni, ka a min o tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kuli Babilɔn.
en: You will not escape; you will be captured and handed over to him. You will see him face-to-face and talk to him in person; then you will go to Babylonia.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Yawɛ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: An area in the center of this land will belong to me. It will be twelve and a half kilometers long and ten kilometers wide.

dag: Ʒilinsi saha la ha Naawuni daa di ti suɣilo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o zali shɛlikam zaa ni sokam niŋmi tuuba;.
en: In the past people did not understand God, and he overlooked this. But now he is telling everyone in the world to change and turn to him.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma maa yɛl o, Niŋm a suhu ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, dama m be a sani, ka a suhu ni kul be shɛm, lala ka n gba suhu be.
en: Do whatever you want, the soldier answered. I'll be right there with you.

dag: A yi ti naai li, nyin lan dɔnim pahi buyi, amaa a nudirigu zuɣu ka a ti yɛn dɔni n-ʒi Judanim gba tibidarigibo. N zal a la biɛɣu pihinahi. Dabisili kam yɛn zanila yuuni zaani.
en: When you finish that, turn over on your right side and suffer for the guilt of Judah for forty days—one day for each year of their punishment.

dag: Shimilan bɔri ni o nyala buni yomyom, ka bi mi ni ashaara nyɛla din yɛn kana ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: The stingy try to get rich fast, unaware that loss will come to them.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa ni ti kpila bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu. Ŋunkam di wain tiwala din miha nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma la di vi ka bahi yoli. Chɛ ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: Defeat my enemies. Destroy them completely! They are trying to hurt me. Let them suffer shame and disgrace.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ka so mi ku tooi yiɣisi li. O pun teeg o nuu, ka so mi ku tooi pɔri li.
en: The Lord Almighty is determined to do this; he has stretched out his arm to punish, and no one can stop him.

dag: M bi sɔɣi a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla n suhu ni, n kul yɛr a ʒiɛyimtali min a sɔŋsim maa yɛla. M bi sɔɣ a ʒiɛyimtali min a yurilim maŋli yɛla niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni.
en: I told about the good things you did. I did not hide these things in my heart. I spoke of how you can be trusted to save us. I did not hide your love and loyalty from those in the great assembly.

dag: Yɛlim paɣ kura la gba ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura, ka pa ni munaafichinima bee bɛn nyɛ danyubo daba. Di simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn wuhiri din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Likewise, tell the older women to be reverent in their behavior, teaching what is good, rather than being gossips or addicted to heavy drinking.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun zaŋmi daba ayopɔin niŋ o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa, ka paɣ o situra, ka su ko viɛlli n-yi daɣiri ni.
en: When the man with the emission is cleansed of his emission, he will count off seven days for his purification. He must wash his clothes and bathe his body in running water; then he will be clean again.

dag: Ka di yi di nyɛla n niŋ o la zaɣ biɛɣu ka binshɛli mi bi sɔɣiri naa sani, di saha a ku zani n nyaaŋa.
en: He always finds out what's going on. I would have been risking my life to kill Absalom, because you would have let me take the blame.

dag: Niriba pam yɛr ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim, amaa bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee nyɛ nir ni yɛn dihi so tabili?.
en: Everyone talks about how loyal and faithful he is, but just try to find someone who really is!.

dag: Miriya ka yi zahim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni daa zahim o shɛm Masa la.
en: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o puli zuɣu suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini.
en: He went a little farther on, threw himself face downward on the ground, and prayed, My Father, if it is possible, take this cup of suffering from me! Yet not what I want, but what you want.

dag: Damaskusnim lan ka yaa, ka ŋmaligi ni bɛ guui, ka dabiɛm kpe ba. Biɛrim mini suhugarigu mali ba mi kaman paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: Damascus staggers about; she tries to flee, but panic overwhelms her. Shes gripped by anguish and pain, like a woman in labor.

dag: Yɛm mɛrila o yili, amaa jɛrilim ŋun wurindila o yili.
en: A wise woman builds her house, while a foolish woman tears hers down with her own hands.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim. O ni tin ya kpiɔŋ, ka gbib ya ka Sintani ku paai ya.
en: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and keep you safe from the Evil One.

dag: Shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhi ni o ni niŋ o ni lo a alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: A bɔri ni mahim chaŋla tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia bee di lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Isaiah said, Which do you want? Should the shadow go forward ten steps or go back ten steps? This is the sign for you from the Lord to show that the Lord will do what he said he would do.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu ni tɛha bi kpɛma yi nya nyin ŋun mali baŋsim ŋɔ ka a ʒi buɣili maligu shee diri bindirigu, di ku kpaŋsi dilan maa suhu ka o di bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa?.
en: Suppose someone sees you eating in an idols temple. Wont the person with a weak conscience be encouraged to eat the meat sacrificed to false gods?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba pahi Yisa zuɣu ni bɛ ti ku ba.
en: Two other men, both of them criminals, were also led out to be put to death with Jesus.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya zaa daa laɣim ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a niŋgbuŋ ni a ʒim.
en: All the Israelite tribes came to David at Hebron and said, Listen: We are your very own flesh and bone.

dag: Wummiya n wuhibu, ka niŋ yɛm. Miriya ka yi zaɣisi li.
en: Listen to instruction, and be wise; dont avoid it.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Man ʒi doo maa. Di saha maa ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Then he cursed and swore, I dont know the man! At that very moment the rooster crowed.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Ɛfɛsus Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni m-be salima firilatamdis ayopɔin sunsuuni n-chani gindi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: Here is a message from the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.

dag: Bɛ nini yi ti nya bi shɛba n ni yɛn ti ba, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-tum lala maa, ka ti ma jilima ka lu man ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura.
en: When you see the children that I will give you, then you will acknowledge that I am the holy God of Israel. You will honor me and stand in awe of me.

dag: M mabihi, m mi n suhu ni ka biɛhiŋ kani ni yi mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali baŋsim zaa, ka ni tooi wuhi taba.
en: My brothers and sisters, I myself am convinced that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, and are able to teach each other.

dag: Ɛlifaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfo ni Gatam ni Kɛnaz.
en: Eliphazs sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

dag: Aduna ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisiri Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi tiŋgban nɛli polo n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima yi zahira sagban ni.
en: Aaron was speaking to them, when everyone looked out toward the desert and saw the bright glory of the Lord in a cloud.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛn la daa ti labina ti yɛra, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kparigim ka ti gari.
en: Later the others returned and shouted, Sir, sir! Open the door for us.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Manaasa zuliya pirigili la kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses had given a part of the land to the families of half the tribe of Manasseh as their possession.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yaɣili maa ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm, amaa Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba ni Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ la zaa daa bela bɛmaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi ni ni bɛmaŋmaŋ paliti ni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: These are the leaders of the province who lived in Jerusalem; while the Israelites, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the descendants of Solomons servants lived in the towns of Judah on their own property in their towns.

dag: Ŋuni ka yi lee yɛn zaŋ ma buɣisi ka nya ka m min o saɣi? So beni ŋ-ŋmani ma?.
en: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?.

dag: N lan zali zaligu ni so yi taɣi zaligu ŋɔ, bɛn darigim ŋooi ŋun tum taali maa yiŋ yɔɣirili n-zaŋ li sa n-zaŋ o yil li, ka o yiŋ zani dabɔɣu.
en: I further command that if any disobey this order, a wooden beam is to be torn out of their houses, sharpened on one end, and then driven through their bodies. And their houses are to be made a rubbish heap.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o binyɛrigu ti mɔhi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nɔri wain tiwala binyɛrigu la?.
en: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like those of one who stomps on grapes?.

dag: ka yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zaani ya ni yi doli so shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi, din mi n-nyɛ noli dibu maa.
en: But you will get the curse if you refuse to listen and obey the commands of the Lord your God. So dont stop living the way I command you today, and dont follow other gods that you dont know.

dag: Nasara dibu suhupiɛlli yila be wuntizɔriba suɣa shee, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: The Lord is powerful!.

dag: Pinimiya yi zabiri bahi, ka kumiya kuyila zoya zuɣu, dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ya, ka zaŋ ya bahi, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi ŋɔ.
en: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.

dag: Zaligunim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Musa zali Izraɛlnima Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi Jɛriko polo la.
en: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.

dag: Kamiyana nti dinya nanim mini sapashinnim ni kpiɔŋlaannim ni yuri mini bɛn bari ba zaŋ tabili daadam kam bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba ni wɔɣira mini tarimba nimdi.
en: Come and eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of generals, the flesh of the powerful, and the flesh of horses and their riders. Come and eat the flesh of all, both free and slave, both small and great.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri nyɛla n ʒim. Ka Yaakubu daa be o sani goli yini.
en: Then Laban said, This is wonderful! You are from my own family. So Jacob stayed with Laban for a month.

dag: Ka Tɔi ŋun daa nyɛ Hamat naa daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa;.
en: King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated all of Hadadezer's army.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi la zaa mabihili puhigu ti ti.
en: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ buŋ nyaampara pa buŋa, ka o yɛl o tumtumda, Niŋm buŋ maa ka o chani yomyom, ka di chɛ ka o baligi chandi naɣila mani nti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o baligi chandi.
en: Then she put a saddle on a donkey and said to her servant, Lets go, and hurry! Go slow only when I tell you.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpe o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: His wife Jezebel went to him and asked him, Why are you upset? Why do you refuse to eat.

dag: Famiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba bahi; tiligimiya ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: Rescue the lowly and the needy. Deliver them from the power of the wicked!.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? After all, she had been married to all seven brothers.

dag: Yi ku niriba pam yi tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, ka zaŋ yi ni ku shɛb maa pali di solɔri zuɣu.
en: You have killed many people in this city. You have filled the streets with dead bodies.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni bɔri ni yi nya shihirili din wuhiri ni Masia yiko ni ka n tɔɣisirila zuɣu. Masia pala ninvuɣ gbariŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhir o yiko yi sunsuuni.
en: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!.

dag: Molimi molo Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛli: Piɛbimi kikaa gili tiŋgbani maa ni, ka tahiri pampam yɛra, Laɣimmiya taba ka ti chaŋ ti kpe bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni.
en: Blow the trumpet throughout the land! Shout loud and clear! Tell the people of Judah and Jerusalem to run to the fortified cities.

dag: Yawɛ yurilim din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi kpi; o nambɔzɔbo ka tariga.
