en: We are still alive because the Lord s faithful love never ends.

dag: Aduna bihi n-daa nyɛ Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: To Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: O tim buɣim ka di yi zuɣusaa na, ka di nyooi ma hal ti kpe n kɔba ni. O bari zana, ka di gbaai n naba. O kari ma labisi. O chɛ ka bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka n tarigi doya dabisili kam zaa puuni.
en: From above he sent fire into my bones; he trampled them. He spread a net for my feet; he forced me backward. He left me devastated, constantly sick.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani tin ya ka di leei yi tarili.
en: I will give you the land of Canaan, he said. It will be your own possession.

dag: Dindali maa, di simdi ka naa ti bo naɣila polli m-mali sara o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: On the first day of the festival the ruling prince must offer a bull as a sacrifice for his sins and for those of all the people.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa kana ti nya shigbaŋ, ka shikpam do tiŋa.
en: Because of the fighting, the people went into some woods. Then they saw a honeycomb on the ground. The Israelites went up to the honeycomb, but they didnt eat any of it. They were afraid to break the promise.

dag: Bɛ daa kpuɣi duɣuri mini soobuya ni buɣim kpihiri bina ni taha ni chɛriti ni daanya la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni chaŋ.
en: The army of Babylon also took these things from the Temple: pots, shovels, lamp snuffers, large bowls, pans, and all the bronze things that were used in the Temple service.

dag: Amaa ka Itai daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini n dan naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n dan ni yɛn kpe luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla kum shee bee nyɛvili shee, nimaani ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛn kpe.
en: Ittai answered, Your Majesty, just as surely as you and the Lord live, I will go where you go, no matter if it costs me my life.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun diri ni ka bɛ ni diri shɛli yina; Ŋum mali kpiɔŋ ni ka din nyaɣisi yina. Ka di daa mali ti paai daba ata, ka bɛ na bi tooi baŋ ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: He said to them, Out of the eater there came something to eat. Out of the strong there came something sweet. For three days they couldnt tell the answer to the riddle.

dag: O daa wurim tinzun buɣa maligu bimbina la mini buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka ŋme n-kabisi di daantalisi, ka wurim Ashɛrim.
en: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.

dag: Amaa a yi zɔri dabiɛm ni a chaŋ, nyin zaŋm a tumtumda Pura pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ.
en: If you are afraid to go alone, take your servant Purah with you. Go into the camp of the Midianites.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa wum Yisa yɛla, ka tim Yɛhudianim kpeen shɛba ni bɛ ti suhi Yisa ka o kana ti tib o dabili maa ti o.
en: When the officer heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to ask him to come and heal his servant.

dag: Ka n chaŋ hal ti paai teeku maa puuni zolɔna ni m-mal hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din dunoya nyɛ din yo n-kpari ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa, yaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, ka a yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli maa ni na ni nyɛvili.
en: at the base of the undersea mountains. I have sunk down to the underworld; its bars held me with no end in sight. But you brought me out of the pit.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: But now, all you exiles I deported from Jerusalem to Babylon, listen to the LORDs word.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa malaikanim ni daa tɔɣisi la kahigi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka ŋunkam daa bi dol li bee n-deei di noli yi daa nya tibidarigibo din simd o.
en: If the message that was spoken by angels was reliable, and every offense and act of disobedience received an appropriate consequence.

dag: M bihi, kul kpalimmiya be o ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka o ti yi palo ka ti tooi mali suhukpeeni, ka ti ku tiri gbini n-zo o sani vi zuɣu o labbuna dali.
en: And now, little children, remain in relationship to Jesus, so that when he appears we can have confidence and not be ashamed in front of him when he comes.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zo n-gili bimbini maa, ka pali bɔɣili la gba.
en: until finally, the water ran down the altar and filled the ditch.

dag: A nyɛla a ma ŋun daa zaɣis o yidana min o bihi la bipuɣiŋga. A nyɛla a biɛyanim bɛn daa zaɣisi bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi la tizo. A ma daa nyɛla Hiti paɣa, ka a ba mi nyɛ Amɔri doo.
en: You are your mothers daughter! She loathed her husband and also her children. You are just like your sisters too! They also loathed their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father was an Amorite.

dag: M bi yɛn kari ba yuun yini puuni, ka tiŋgbani maa doya yoli, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yɛligi nti muɣisi ya.
en: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa ni yihiri bindiri sun shɛŋa zaa na nyɛla a ni chɛ ka na shɛb su ti maa dini ti daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛna n-lan su ti niŋgbuna yiko zaŋ tabili ti binnɛma n-niŋdi bɛ suhuyubu, ka ti be nandahima pam ni.
en: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi binfalafala din daa be chɛrubinim zuɣuri zuɣusaa la, ka binshɛli daa be bɛ zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani safaya kuɣili, di kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee.
en: Then I looked up at the bowl over the heads of the Cherub angels. The bowl looked clear blue like sapphire, and there was something that looked like a throne over it.

dag: Shaul ni daa ti kpi, Baalihanan ŋun daa nyɛ Akibɔr bia la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.

dag: Hal Saimɔn maŋmaŋ gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu; di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ tabili Filip n-nyari shihira mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa din daa niŋdi maa, ka di gar o pam.
en: Simon himself also believed, and after he was baptized, he stayed close to Philip. When he saw the miraculous signs and powerful things Philip did, he was amazed.

dag: Dama nyama, Ijiptinim ni ti laɣim ba, ka Mɛmfisinim sɔɣi ba, ka lan deei bɛ daazinfa neen viɛla la, ka gɔhi bili bɛ yinsi.
en: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni bi deeri alahichilan suhigu, amaa so yi jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni ka tumd o yubu, o deeri dilan suhigu.
en: We know that God doesnt listen to sinners. God listens to anyone who is devout and does Gods will.

dag: Ahi daa nyɛla Abidiɛl bia, ka Abidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Guni bia la daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and grandson of Guni, was head of these clans.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka o daa paɣi bɛ fiɛbbu dansi la, ka Pool mini Silas daa baptaizi dansarika gula maa min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: At that very hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; and he and all his family were baptized at once.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bar maa, Zɔri, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, Friend, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Palo shɛli din kpalim ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili la ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa palo. Bɛ ni ti tooi me yiya nimaani bee n-chɛ ka di nyɛ palo doya, tiŋ maa ni ti be di sunsuuni.
en: The part of the special area that is left, miles by miles, is not holy, but is for the general use of the people. They may live there and use the land. The city is to be in the center of it.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka ŋun daa su bɛ fukumsi maa kul tiri ba la tarim bindirigu maa ka chɛ Naa ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tim ba bindir shɛŋa mini binnyur shɛl la.
en: So the guard continued to take away the kings special food and wine and to give only vegetables to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

dag: O daa kul bela gbala maa shee, ka so daa naan ku tooi zaŋ hal bandi m-ba o ʒili luɣ yini gba.
en: This man lived among the tombs, and no one was ever strong enough to restrain him, even with a chain.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ noya ni; bɛ suhuri kul yula saɣiŋgu. Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbal kaba, ka bɛ lan mali naŋgban malisim.
en: Because theres no truth in my enemies mouths, all they have inside them is destruction. Their throats are open graves; their tongues slick with talk.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-gbibi m biriginsim ashilɔni kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm, din nyɛ n zaŋ n tuumbiɛri sɔɣi n jɔɣu ni.
en: If I have hidden my transgressions like Adam, concealing my offenses inside me.

dag: So daa bi lo a nuhi, so mi daa bi ba a naba bandi. A lumi kaman nir ni lu putɔɣulan tooni shɛm la. Ka niriba maa zaa daa lan kum o zuɣu yaha.
en: Abner, your hands were not tied. Your feet were not put in chains. No, Abner, evil men killed you! Then all the people cried again for Abner.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka vi gbahi ba, ka sokam baŋ a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord .

dag: Amaa paɣisar shɛb bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la, chɛliya bɛna n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi paɣiba.
en: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.

dag: Ka niriba chɛ solɔri dolibu, ka sochandiba chɛ so kara dolibu. Ka zɔtali saɣim, ka alikaulinim saɣim, ka so baɣa ka di yɛla ni.
en: The roads are empty; there is no one walking along the paths. People dont respect each other. They have broken the agreements they made, and they refuse to believe what witnesses tell them.

dag: Ka zaŋya taaŋkɔro tim ʒi shɛli yi ni taɣi niŋ taha ni zali la ni n-zaŋ vie yi dunoya zuɣusahi mini dunɔpaɣira, ka di chɛliya ka so doli dunoli maa yi hal ni asiba.
en: Take a sprig of hyssop, dip it in the bowl containing the animal's blood, and wipe the blood on the doorposts and the beam above the door of your house. Not one of you is to leave the house until morning.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ baŋya ni binshɛɣukam a ni zaŋ ti ma la yila a sanna;.
en: and now they know that everything you gave me comes from you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa taali ni ti ʒi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba zuɣu.
en: I assure you that all these things will come upon this generation.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim naa ka o dol a zaligu kariti saria, ka zaŋ a wuntia ti naa bia.
en: God, give your judgments to the king. Give your righteousness to the kings son.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa balim ba pam; ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi dol o kpe o yiŋa; ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi, ka o zaŋ li niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di.
en: But Lot continued to ask them to come to his house, so they agreed and went with him. Lot gave them something to drink. He baked some bread for them, and they ate it.

dag: Amaa sanʒiɛɣu n-lee ni ti ʒe ti ti bahi tiŋgban bil din be kom sunsuuni zuɣu.
en: But we will be driven ashore on some island.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim zaa daa ti chaŋ Naawuni sani ni bɛ yaa ti mali yuuniyuuni sara la Yawɛ sani, ka pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: Elkanah went to Shiloh to offer the sacrifice for that year and the gift he had promised to the Lord . He took his family with him.

dag: Ya polo ka ti lee chana? Ti mabihi maa ni labina ti yɛli shɛm maa chɛ ka ti suhuri fuŋ. Bɛ yɛliya, Niriba maa mali yaa ka lan wɔɣiwɔɣ gari ti, ka bɛ fɔntinsi maa galisi, ka bɛ me goma gil li hal ti taɣi sagbana. Hal ti nyala Anakinim nimaani. .
en: What are we doing? Our brothers have made our hearts sick by saying, People far stronger and much taller than we live there, and the cities are huge, with walls sky-high! Worse still, we saw the descendants of the Anakites there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa yuui ha, ka Ammɔnnim daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: It was some time later that the Ammonites went to war against Israel.

dag: Ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di zuɣu, ka shinshingoorɔnim tɛri bɛ tɛri gɔhi tihi zuɣu.
en: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.

dag: Naawuni pun tin ya dahima ni yi doli Masia, ka di pala ni yi niŋ o yɛda kɔŋko, amaa ni yi di wahala gba o zuɣu.
en: For you have been given the privilege of serving Christ, not only by believing in him, but also by suffering for him.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim maa bɛn tim bɛ suɣa gili alikauli suɣili maa n-gul li, ka Naawuni suhu ti ku yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.

dag: Di saha maa ka Kalidianim shɛb daa nya soli ni bɛ doli fiɣisi Yɛhudianima.
en: Some Babylonians used this as a chance to accuse the Jews to King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Yɔhiŋ sania zaŋ zahim binyɛra nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa binyɛra zahimbu sania zuɣu din tuhi nyɛla din paligir o suhu.
en: The Lord hates people who use dishonest scales. He is happy with honest weights.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti nya Dauda ashilɔni yɛl o, Nyama, naa suhu yur a pam, ka o tumtumdib zaa nini tiɣ a, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ leemi naa deemba! .
en: He ordered his officials to speak privately with David and tell him, The king is pleased with you and all his officials like you; now is a good time for you to marry his daughter.

dag: O daa gindila Bɛtɛl mini Giligal ni Mizipa yuuni kam nti maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani zaa.
en: Each year he traveled between Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, serving as Israels judge in each of those locations.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! n-yɛwaa! la gba di vi, ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Embarrass and shame those who say, We told you so.

dag: Naomi min o bia paɣ Rut ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab paɣ la ni daa yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Bɛtilihɛm na shɛm m-bala. Chi mi chɛbu piligibu saha ka bɛ daa paai Bɛtilihɛm maa.
en: The barley harvest was just beginning when Naomi and Ruth, her Moabite daughter-in-law, arrived in Bethlehem.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zani Gibia ni bɛ liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa.
en: They went to attack the army of Benjamin, and placed the soldiers in position facing the city.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti ʒe Gɛnɛsarɛt Teeku noli, ka niriba pam kpaɣiri chan o sani ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: One day Jesus was standing on the shore of Lake Gennesaret while the people pushed their way up to him to listen to the word of God.

dag: Cham ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puri ni n-saɣim li, amaa di saɣim di zaa. Ŋmahimi di wula zaa bahi, dama di pala man Yawɛ ni su shɛli.
en: Go along the rows of Judahs grapevines. Cut down the vines. Cut off all their branches, because they dont belong to the Lord .

dag: Ka lan zaŋ bindira nyo buɣim mali sara daba ayopɔin. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani. Niŋmiya li pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di binnyura zuɣu.
en: Like these, you will also offer each day for seven days a food gift as a soothing smell to the LORD. It will be offered in addition to the regular entirely burned offering and its drink offering.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yɛli Kushi nir ŋun daa be o san la, Cham ti yɛli naa a nini ni nya shɛm. Ka Kush nir maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋ Jɔab tooni lu o sizuura ka ŋmaligi guui.
en: Then he said to his Ethiopian slave, Go and tell the king what you have seen. The slave bowed and ran off.

dag: Amaa nyamiya! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nyaannim ni ti leei toonnima, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ toonnim mi ti leei nyaannima.
en: People who have the lowest place in life now will have the highest place in Gods kingdom. And people who have the highest place now will have the lowest place in Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili Jɔpa zaa, ka niriba pam daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: The news spread throughout Joppa, and many put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ n yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, m paɣir a ka tir a jilima. A ni ti ma yɛm mini kpiɔŋ; ka kahigi ti ni suh a shɛl la wuhi ma, ka wuhi ti ni a deei ti suhigu, ka lan wuhi ti ti ni yɛn yɛli naa shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I acknowledge and praise you, my fathers God! Youve given me wisdom and might, and now youve made known to me what we asked of you: youve made known to us the kings demand.

dag: Ka binfalafala daa be binnɛma maa zuɣusaa ka nyaɣisira kaman bɛ ni booni shɛli kirisital la.
en: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.

dag: ni kanaafiri ni binnyoon viɛla balibu kam ni tulaale zim ni tulaale zin shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr ni firanki tulaale zim la ni wain ni kpam ni zim balli mini chi ni niɣi mini piɛri ni yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi zaŋ tabili daba mini ninsalinim nyɛviya la.
en: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.

dag: Pita ni daa nya o maa ka o bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula.
en: When Peter saw him behind them, he asked Jesus, Lord, what about him.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani m-mali suhudoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ daa wum bɛ ni suh o Izraɛl tiŋgbani maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka vuug alɔbo maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: Then David built an altar to the Lord there and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. The Lord answered his prayer for the country. He stopped the disease in Israel.

dag: Ka n yi nyɛ yi Duuma ni yi karimba ka paɣi yi naba, dindina di simdi ni yi gba paɣiri tab naba lala;.
en: I, your Lord and Teacher, have just washed your feet. You, then, should wash one another's feet.

dag: ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa kpihiri firilanima ni taha ni chɛrisi. O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali buɣim moori lahi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli pundi mini luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee dunoli pundi zaa daa nyɛla salima.
en: and the wick trimmers, bowls, ladles, and censers of pure gold. As for the temple entrance, the inner doors to the most holy place as well as the doors to the main hall were made of gold.

dag: Dama n ni zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will defend this city and protect it, for the sake of my own honor and because of the promise I made to my servant David.

dag: N ni ti nyo Damaskus gooni la buɣim, ka di di Bɛnhadad kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la.
en: I will set fire to your city walls and burn down the fortresses King Benhadad built.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa be yili maa ni kuhiri ka fabindi kpim maa zuɣu yɔri vuri. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di kuhiriya, dama bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: Everyone there was crying and mourning for the child. Jesus said, Don't cry; the child is not dead—she is only sleeping.

dag: Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri ni o yi gbuɣinli gbaabu ni nti tuhi biŋkɔb so ŋun bie n-gari gbuɣinli soli bee nir yi kpe duu nti zaŋ o nuu dihi dukpini, ka wahu dim o la.
en: as if someone fled from a lion, and was met by a bear; or sought refuge in a house, rested a hand against the wall, and was bitten by a snake.

dag: ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa.
en: the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi bi nyari soli din ni tooi ka yi sanna.
en: And so I have been prevented many times from coming to you.

dag: Ŋuna ka Naawuni zali ni o ʒim zuɣu chɛ ka niriba nya tiliginsim bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu. Naawuni niŋ lala ni o kahigila o wuntia tuma wuhi, dama kurimbuni ha o daa di bɛn tum alahichi suɣilo;.
en: Through his faithfulness, God displayed Jesus as the place of sacrifice where mercy is found by means of his blood. He did this to demonstrate his righteousness in passing over sins that happened before.

dag: Ka lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni. Ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa bi lan ʒiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa bee bɛ ni daa mali neen shɛŋa tumdi di tuma maa gindi yaha.
en: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.

dag: Zaŋ Sinai Zoli n-doli yi Siɛr Zoli polo hal ti paai Kadɛshibarinia nyɛla biɛɣ pinyini chandi.
en: It takes eleven days to travel from Mount Sinai to Kadesh Barnea by way of the hill country of Edom.

dag: Yawɛ, amaa a miri ma, ka a zaligunim zaa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: But you, LORD, are nearby too, and all your commandments are true.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Hɛrɔd saha la ka baŋdib shɛb daa yi wulimpuhili polo ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in the territory of Judea during the rule of King Herod, magi came from the east to Jerusalem.

dag: Wummiya vu shɛli din yɔri pampam tiŋ puuni ŋɔ, ka wumya vuri din yiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu na ŋɔ! Yawɛ n-darigir o dimnim tibili maa!.
en: The sound of an uproar from the city! A sound from the temple! The sound of the LORD repaying his enemies what they have earned.

dag: ka yɛli sariakaritiba maa, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi saria karibu ni, dama pa ninsalinim ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira, amaa Yawɛ ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira. O be yi sani yi saria karibu ni.
en: He told the judges, Be careful in what you are doing, because you are not judging for people, but for the Lord . He will be with you when you make decisions.

dag: Ka o daa lan sabi gbana n-ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daɣiri, ka tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ yoya pam jɛnd o yɛra, Tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba buɣa ni daa bi tooi tiligi bɛ niriba n nuu ni shɛm, lala ka Hɛzɛkia Naawuni ŋɔ gba ku tooi tilig o niriba n nuu ni.
en: The letter that the emperor wrote defied the Lord , the God of Israel. It said, The gods of the nations have not saved their people from my power, and neither will Hezekiah's god save his people from me.

dag: N daa bela Jɔpa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka n nya binshɛli din kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la ʒii puuni, ka di yi zuɣusaa sirigiri n sanna.
en: I was in the city of Joppa. While I was praying, I had a vision. I saw something coming down from heaven. It looked like a big sheet being lowered to the ground by its four corners. It came down close to me.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa na bi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni faashee o ni daa ti lab o jilima shee la nyaaŋa, ka bɛ naanyi teei ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa pun sabimi zan o zuɣu, ka di mi shiri niŋ o lala.
en: The followers of Jesus did not understand at that time what was happening. But after he was raised to glory, they understood that this was written about him. Then they remembered that they had done these things for him.

dag: Yawɛ mali yiko pam, amaa o suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom. Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ku chɛ alahichilana tibili darigibu. O soli nyɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga mini sanʒiɛɣu, ka sagbana nyɛ o napɔna taŋkpagbiligu.
en: The Lord is patient, but he is also very powerful! The Lord will punish the guilty; he will not let them go free. He will use whirlwinds and storms to show his power. People walk on the dusty ground, but he walks on the clouds.

dag: Ibram ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa; doli ma, ka tummi din tuhi.
en: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said, I am the Almighty God. Obey me and always do what is right.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni; dama yi puu biɛri n zuɣu.
en: The LORD bless you because you have shown this kindness to me! Saul said.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N yi naai n ni niŋdi shɛlikam Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm, n ni darigi Asiria naa tibili o karimbaani min o barinyubo zuɣu.
en: But the Lord says, When I finish what I am doing on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, I will punish the emperor of Assyria for all his boasting and all his pride.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara, n ni ti chɛ ka o di nyɛvili ti shɛli din be Naawuni yil la wala.
en: Everyone who hears this should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To those who win the victory I will give the right to eat the fruit from the tree of life, which is in Gods paradise.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi di ni chihiri ni Yɛhudia nira mini zuliya shɛb laɣim shɛm bee ka bɛ ti kpe zuliya shɛb yinsi yɛla; amaa Naawuni wuhi ma ni n di lihi so yoli bee n-siŋ so.
en: and Peter said to them, You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.

dag: bɛ kul durila tab dari maa gbini, ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa ti dɔɣi bi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim.
en: So when the goats bred in front of the branches, they produced young that were streaked, speckled, and spotted.

dag: Neemi n nina ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n nya alahiziba binshɛŋa din be a zaligu puuni.
en: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.

dag: Pin suma mini pina din be tibi zaa yirila Naawuni ŋun nam alizanda mini neesim, ka nyɛ ŋun ka taɣibu, ka mi ka shilinshia din limsiri neesim maa la sanna.
en: Every good gift and every perfect present comes from heaven; it comes down from God, the Creator of the heavenly lights, who does not change or cause darkness by turning.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, N yi zaŋ o ti a, di so ni n zaŋ o ti do so, kpalimmi n sani.
en: Laban said, It would be better for her to marry you than someone else. So stay with me.

dag: Obil ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la daa lihirila laakumnima, ka Jɛdɛiya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrɔnɔt nir la daa lihiri bunsi, ka Jaziz ŋun daa nyɛ Hagiri nir la mi daa lihiri piɛri mini buhi.
en: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.

dag: O daa ku Bashan Naa Ogi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: and Og, king of Bashan; his love is eternal.

dag: Di saha ka o daa wuhi ma Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulan la ka o ʒe Yawɛ malaika tooni, ka Sintani ʒe o nudirigu polo ni o fiɣis o.
en: Then the LORD showed me the high priest Joshua, standing before the messenger from the LORD, and the Adversary was standing by his right side to accuse him.

dag: N kul ku tam yi yɛla. Nyama, n pun sab yi yuli niŋ n nutaya ni.
en: I drew a picture of you on my hand. You are always before my eyes.

dag: N duumanima, ŋmaligimiya kpe mani yi dabili ŋɔ yiŋ na nti paɣi yi naba, ka gbe kpe n-sa daŋ yibu chaŋ yi chandi shee. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti ni gbe solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: He said, Come to your servants house, spend the night, and wash your feet. Then you can get up early and go on your way. But they said, No, we will spend the night in the town square.

dag: Di saha ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka di ti mii. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, malimi shɛlikam shili zali, dama a ku lan yiɣisi, a ni kpi.
en: About this time King Hezekiah became sick and almost died. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to see him and said to him, The Lord tells you that you are to put everything in order because you will not recover. Get ready to die.

dag: Ka ŋun yur o ba bee o ma gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma; ka ŋun yur o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: Those who love father or mother more than me arent worthy of me. Those who love son or daughter more than me arent worthy of me.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa di bi wumda. Bɛ mali nyɛhi, amaa di bi wumdi nyom.
en: They have ears, but cannot hear, and noses, but cannot smell.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka Miidianim maani shili ni bɛ liri ba. Bɛ je anzinfa, bɛ mi baɣa ka salima ni.
en: The Lord says, I am stirring up the Medes to attack Babylon. They care nothing for silver and are not tempted by gold.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o ni lo Izraɛlnim alikauli sun shɛŋa la zaa zaɣ yini gba bi yiɣisi. O daa chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: Not one of all the good things that the LORD had promised to the house of Israel failed. Every promise was fulfilled.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla kom din zilima, ka yɛm kɔbilinini nyɛ kulibɔŋ kom din zɔra.
en: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zaŋ Yisa tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: The whole assembly got up and led Jesus to Pilate and.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi. .
en: So, after I punish him a little, I will let him go free.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim maa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu duli n-chaŋ ti kpe Shur tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka bɛ daa chaŋ dabisi muna ata chandi ka bi nya kom.
en: Moses led the Israelites away from the Red Sea and into the desert of Shur. They traveled for three days in the desert. They could not find any water.

dag: Di kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam kaman goli ŋun kul nyɛ shɛhiralana m-be sagbana ni ŋɔ.
en: Like the moon, it will continue forever. The sky is a witness to the agreement that can be trusted. Selah.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: Jesus and his followers were coming closer to Jerusalem. They came to the towns of Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives. There Jesus sent two of his followers to do something.

dag: Ʒimiya liɣiri pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ laɣ shɛli labisi niŋ yi kpalansi noya ni la zuɣu mali chaŋ, di pa shɛli bɛ daa chirimmi maa.
en: Take with you also twice as much money, because you must take back the money that was returned in the top of your sacks. Maybe it was a mistake.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! N ni puhi Yawɛ ni n suhu zaa, o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Praise the Lord ! With all my heart I will thank the Lord in the assembly of his people.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa moli gili. Miriya ka yi zaŋ yi noli naai ninvuɣ biɛɣu m-pah o zuɣu di shɛhira kpɛma.
en: Don't spread harmful rumors or help a criminal by giving false evidence.

dag: ni Kiriataim ni Sibima ni Zɛrɛtishaha din daa be vinvamli ni zol zuɣu la.
en: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ yi yab Ibrahimma Mɔɣili duli maa polo na nti chɛ ka o chaŋ gili Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa. Ka n daa ti o bihi pam. N daa chɛ ka o dɔɣi Yisahaku;.
en: But I took your father Abraham out of the land on the other side of the River. I led him through the land of Canaan and gave him many children. I gave Abraham his son Isaac.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu maa wumbu, hal n ni ti yɛn tum alahiziba shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: But I will make Pharaoh stubborn so that he will not do what you tell him. Then I will do many miracles in Egypt to prove who I am.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun pihinahi maa yi ti naai n ni yihi Ijiptinim maa bɛ ni daa wurim be ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni na.
en: Then after those years have passed, I will bring your people back from the places where I scattered them.

dag: ni Zanɔa ni Adulam ni di tiŋkpansi ni Lakishi ni di puri ni Azɛka ni di tiŋkpansi ka bɛ daa ʒini Bɛrishiiba zaŋ hal ni Hinnom Vinvamli ni.
en: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its villages. So they settled from Beer-sheba to the Hinnom Valley.

dag: N ni kum ka fabili zoya zuɣu, ka fabili mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu, dama di bahila yoli doya ka so bi lan gariti nimaani. So bi lan wumdi niɣi kumsi nimaani. Noombihi mini biŋkɔbiri zaa yi nimaani zo.
en: I, Jeremiah, will cry for the mountains. I will sing a funeral song for the empty fields, because all the animals were taken away. No one travels there now. The sounds of cattle cannot be heard. The birds have flown away, and the animals are gone.

dag: Ka o daa tim Abimilɛk sani Aruma nti yɛl o, Nyama, Ɛbɛd bia Gaal la min o dɔɣiriba kala Shɛkɛm na nti wuhiri Shɛkɛmnim yikombiɛlim soya zaŋ kpa a polo.
en: He sent messengers to Abimelech at Arumah to say, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem, and they are not going to let you into the city.

dag: N niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ leela zaɣ sabinli ŋ-ŋmaari lura, ka tulim diri n kɔba.
en: My skin has turned dark; I am burning with fever.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilabil yino maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: You will also offer cups of fine flour mixed with oil with the bull, cups with the ram.

dag: dama saha shɛli Tiudas ni daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ omaŋ leei wɔɣirili ka niriba paai kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi daa dol o la, bɛ daa ti ku o, ka bɛn dol o maa zaa wurim, ka o tuma maa gba daa zan tariga.
en: You remember that Theudas appeared some time ago, claiming to be somebody great, and about four hundred men joined him. But he was killed, all his followers were scattered, and his movement died out.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Kamiya kpe na nti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Then Joshua said to the people, Come here and listen to what the Lord your God has to say.

dag: yi mi miriya ka yi tam Man Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla. Kul miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: You must not forget the agreement that I made with you. You must not respect other gods.

dag: ka lan nyɛ ŋun be nyɛvili ni; nyama, n daa pun kpimi ka neei, ka mi ku lan kpi hal abada. Mani n-su kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee saafɛbihi fukumsi.
en: I am the living one! I was dead, but now I am alive forever and ever. I have authority over death and the world of the dead.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa bari zani puu maa sunsuuni n-zabi di zuɣu, ka daa ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ di nasara pam.
en: but Shammah stood in the middle of the field and killed the Philistines. The crops were saved, and the Lord gave Israel a great victory.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, chamiya ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛlimuɣisir shɛli ŋɔ. Bɛ tiŋ maa ka dunɔdaya bee dunokparitisi. Di ʒiɛla di ko.
en: Get ready to attack a nation that feels safe and secure, declares the LORD, one without barred gates that lives by itself.

dag: O yi tihim, buɣim n-nyaɣisira, ka o nina ŋmani wuntaŋ m-puhirina asiba la.
en: Light flashes when he sneezes, and his eyes glow like the rising sun.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim maa daa gbaai tab naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu, ka jintɔriba maa noya daa woli taba.
en: When Paul said this, a big argument started between the Pharisees and the Sadducees. The group was divided.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mini noon shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Noah built an altar to the LORD. He took some of the clean large animals and some of the clean birds, and placed entirely burned offerings on the altar.

dag: N dabisa chani yomyom gari kpalua gombo, ka m paari di tariga, ka tahima kani.
en: My days pass by faster than a weavers shuttle, and my life will end without hope.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba mini wawariba zaa yɛra, N kɔbilinina zaa bela a ni.
en: All who sing or dance will say, I too am from Zion.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Zadok mini Itama bia Ahimɛlɛk daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o piripiri Aduna bidibisi maa kaman bɛ talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.

dag: Ka Pita daa zani dunol ni niŋdi gaafara, ka paɣisar so ŋun yuli booni Roda daa kana ni o ti nya ŋun bala.
en: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka m mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nyu di zaɣ palli m Ba Naawuni nam ni.
en: I tell you, I wont drink wine again until that day when I drink it in a new way with you in my Fathers kingdom.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: In the Sinai Desert the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ biɛri firila kpiya ka bɛ buɣim bi lan ne.
en: To be sure, the light of the wicked goes out; the blaze of their fire doesnt shine.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya ma ka boli ma, ka n garigi yɛl o, N-nyɛ ma.
en: Saul looked back and saw me. He called to me and I answered him.

dag: Hal ti nyari ka yɛnnim kpira, ka jɛra mini bɛn ka laasabu gba kpira. Bɛ zaa mi kpirimi n-chani ka chɛri bɛ daazichi tiri shɛba.
en: Look, the wise die the same as fools and stupid people. They die and leave their wealth to others.

dag: Di to ni ninvuɣ so saɣi kpi wuntizɔra zuɣu, amaa di pa shɛli so ni saɣi kpi ninvuɣ sun so zuɣu.
en: Very few people will die to save the life of someone else, even if it is for a good person. Someone might be willing to die for an especially good person.

dag: Ka fɔntiŋ maa kpamba zaŋ naɣisaa maa chaŋ vinvamli ni kulibɔŋ shɛli din kom zɔr ni, ka so na ʒi n-ko nimaani bee m-biri binshɛli nimaani nti kabi naɣisaa maa nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni.
en: The leaders of that town must then bring the cow down to a valley with running water. It must be a valley that has never been plowed or had anything planted in it. Then the leaders must break the cows neck there in that valley.

dag: Dama a yɛliya, M biɛhigu nyɛla din be kasi, ka n ka daɣiri Naawuni sani!.
en: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa paai Mahanaim. Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa mi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
en: David had reached the town of Mahanaim by the time Absalom and the Israelites had crossed the Jordan. .

dag: Chɛ ka n wuhibu ŋɔ lu kaman saa la, ka n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣi lu kaman maligim la bee kaman saa ni yi luna baalim bahi mɔri zuɣu shɛm la; ka lan be kaman sa yuɣiyuɣi din yuɣisiri bahiri bimbilima zuɣu la.
en: My teaching will fall like raindrops; my speech will settle like dew— like gentle rains on grass, like spring showers on all that is green.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abiata, N ni daa kul nya Doɛg Ɛdom nir la dindali maa, n daa pun baŋ ni o ni yɛli Sool di yɛla. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun bo kum ti a ba daŋ ŋɔ zaa maa.
en: David said to him, When I saw Doeg there that day, I knew that he would be sure to tell Saul. So I am responsible for the death of all your relatives.

dag: ti daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti labir o kuɣa. Ka bɛn daa di o kubu maa shɛhira ka lan nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku o maa fuɣi bɛ binyɛra ti sɔŋ nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Sool la tooni.
en: threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses left their cloaks in the care of a young man named Saul.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe Babilɔn, ka ŋunkam ti ʒe li ni tiɣi. Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: Babylonia will be conquered, and its enemies will carry off everything they want.

dag: n-zaŋ Naawunitali shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: And he has filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God—he gave Bezalel special skill and knowledge to do all kinds of things.

dag: ka ŋmaligi yɛli mmaŋa n suhu ni, M mali nɛma pam din ni gbib ma yuun bɔbigu; n ni ʒini vuhi n-dira ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Then I will say to myself, Lucky man! You have all the good things you need for many years. Take life easy, eat, drink, and enjoy yourself.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ dimdi niŋ a mini paɣ sunsuuni ni a zuliya min o zuliya sunsuuni, ka paɣ zuliya maa ni ti ŋme m-bɔr a zuɣu, ka a mi zuliya ti dim o zuliya napɔŋkpaa.
en: I will put contempt between you and the woman, between your offspring and hers. They will strike your head, but you will strike at their heels.

dag: Nyama, n-nyɛ Ribɛka, zaŋm o kuli nti chɛ ka o leeg a dan bia maa paɣa kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Here is Rebekah, right in front of you. Take her and go. She will be the wife of your masters son, just as the LORD said.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimaŋli soli be ti katiŋa, ka din tuhi gba bi paari ti. Ti bɔrila firila, amaa ka zibisim n-gil ti, ti bɔri neesim, amaa ka bela bumbɔn ni.
en: All fairness and goodness is gone. There is only darkness around us, so we must wait for the light. We hope for a bright light, but all we have is darkness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒi ba lab Shɛkɛm tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti sɔɣi ba ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣipiɛligu da sil shɛli Hamɔr bihi san la ni.
en: Their bodies were taken to Shechem, where they were buried in the grave which Abraham had bought from the clan of Hamor for a sum of money.

dag: Dama n ku tɔɣisi shɛli yɛla n-naɣ pahila Masia ni zaŋ ma tum tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim deeg o noli n yɛligu mini n tuma ni.
en: I will be bold and speak only about what Christ has done through me to lead the Gentiles to obey God. He has done this by means of words and deeds.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni so yi ti ye binyɛr suma, ka piri salima nintuhi kpe yi laɣiŋgu ni na, ka nandana ŋun ye binchɛra gba kpɛna.
en: Suppose a rich man wearing a gold ring and fine clothes comes to your meeting, and a poor man in ragged clothes also comes.

dag: Ka din pahi pia gbaai Shimɛi min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Tenth, there were men chosen from Shimeis sons and relatives.

dag: Yisa daa ti lihi nya bundaannim ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu;.
en: Jesus looked up and saw some rich people putting their gifts to God into the Temple collection box.

dag: N ni daa labi maa, ka n daa nya tihi pam mɔɣili maa duli yaɣa ayi.
en: As I walked back along the side of the river, I saw many trees on both sides of the water.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni chani ginda.
en: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.

dag: Ka o daa booi kpam maa bahi Aduna zuɣu ni m-mal o ka o niŋ kasi.
en: He ordained Aaron by pouring some of the anointing oil on his head.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Ɛdomnim tinsi din kpalim la mini tin shɛŋa din zaa daa pun nyɛ n tinsi la. Yawɛ ŋun yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ maa n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord , have spoken, and my words will come true.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaai Sool zuɣu, ka yeeg o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, ka bahi bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa m-moli lahibali suŋ maa ti bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: They stripped him, carried off his head and armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to spread the news to their idols and to the people.

dag: Ka Naaman daa saɣi, ka chaŋ ti mim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa, ka nya alaafee zaa. Ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni m-be kaman bibil niŋgbuna la.
en: So Naaman went down to the Jordan, dipped himself in it seven times, as Elisha had instructed, and he was completely cured. His flesh became firm and healthy like that of a child.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la. Ka o daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: You want a sign because you are evil and won't believe! But the only sign you will be given is what happened to Jonah. Then Jesus left.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim kana ti taai di nimdi maa mini dari maa ni kuɣa ni taŋkpaɣu, ka chɛ ka ko shɛli din daa be bɔɣili maa ni farifari nyuui.
en: The Lord immediately sent fire, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones. It scorched the ground everywhere around the altar and dried up every drop of water in the ditch.

dag: Dunianim mini zuɣusaa binnamda, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku mini binnɛma bɛn be di ni, yomiya vuri;.
en: Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be happy! Let the sea and everything in it shout for joy!.

dag: Kulla pumpɔŋɔ ka n nam yɛla maa. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi wum di yɛla maa; dinzuɣu yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi pun mi li.
en: They are created now, not long ago; before today you hadnt heard of them, so you wont say, I already knew them.

dag: Amaa niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi bɛna, di deeya binshɛli zali bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaashee n-tiligi ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi. Niŋmiya bɛ ʒim mihi sara maligu bimbini, ka zaŋ bɛ kpam nyo buɣim mali sara; di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: But the first-born of cows, sheep, and goats are not to be bought back; they belong completely to me and are to be sacrificed. Throw their blood against the altar and burn their fat as a food offering, an odor pleasing to me.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa yi n-chaŋ ti yɛl o deennim bɛn daa yɛn kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi la, Yiɣisimiya n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, dama Yawɛ yɛn saɣim li mi. Amaa ka o deennim maa daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ asahi.
en: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, the men who had married his other daughters. He said, Hurry and leave this city! The Lord will soon destroy it! But they thought he was joking.

dag: M mabiyurisi, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ. Di simdi ni sokam wumdi yomyom, ka gbaam omaŋa o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni, ka mi di jɛri suli yomyom.
en: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.

dag: Dabisili din pah ata dali, zaŋmiya naɣilahi piniyini mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka Naa Hɛrɔd ti kpi. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n yihi m Bia maa na.
en: Joseph stayed in Egypt until Herod died. This gave full meaning to what the Lord said through the prophet: I called my son to come out of Egypt.

dag: Dama cheechi toondana ni su Naawuni tuma fukumsi la zuɣu, di simdi ni o malila biɛrisuŋ; di bi simdi ni o nyɛla barinyura bee suhuyiɣisililana bee ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee vubɔra bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: This is because supervisors should be without fault as Gods managers: they shouldnt be stubborn, irritable, addicted to alcohol, a bully, or greedy.

dag: Amaa o bela o kɔŋko, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi taɣ o? O ni bɔri shɛli, dina ka o niŋda.
en: He is of one mind; who can reverse it? What he desires, he does.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu soli ŋmanila kɔbilinini din bilisiri ko biɛɣu bee bɛ ni saɣim kɔbil shɛli kom.
en: Good people who dont stand strong against evil are like springs that have been polluted or pools that have turned dirty and muddy.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di yipa kahigi wuhi ti Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira kandina la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa nyaŋ kum zaa, ka kahigi wuhi ni nyɛvili mini niŋgbun shɛli din bi poori beni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu.
en: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.

dag: ka daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim anahi mini naɣilah anii ti Mɛrari bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka maligumaana Aduna bia Itama nyɛ bɛ tuma zuɣulana.
en: Then Moses gave four wagons and eight oxen to the men in Meraris group. They needed the wagons and oxen for their work. Ithamar son of Aaron the priest was responsible for the work of all these men.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni yɛn kana ti tuhi Ijiptinim la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the word that the LORD spoke to the prophet Jeremiah about the military offensive of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar against the land of Egypt.

dag: Aai, lala ku niŋ. Yi dɔbba kɔŋko cham ti jɛm Yawɛ, dama yi ni bɔri shɛm m-bala. Ka bɛ daa kari ba Firawuna tooni yihi.
en: No! Only the men may go and worship the Lord if that is what you want. With that, Moses and Aaron were driven out of the king's presence.

dag: Yawɛ wum n ni suh o bɔri shɛli maa. Yawɛ ni deei n suhigu.
en: he listens to my cry for help and will answer my prayer.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Yi dimnim ni kana nti teei gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ n-saɣim yi ni zaŋ binshɛŋa taɣi yimaŋa, ka ʒe yi nayiya nɛma maa.
en: Therefore, the LORD my God proclaims: An enemy will surround the land; he will bring you down from your protected places, and your palaces will be robbed.

dag: zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yi vihiri ti mi ni yi baŋ tuun sun shɛli din sa tum ti gbarigu ŋɔ ka o kpaŋ maa.
en: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.

dag: Ka daa chɛ ka Timoti mini Ɛrastus bɛn daa nyɛ o sɔŋdib la chaŋ Masidɔnia, amaa ka ŋun Pool maŋmaŋ daa kpalim Ɛsha n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: So he sent Timothy and Erastus, two of his helpers, to Macedonia, while he spent more time in the province of Asia.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti shiri niŋ o ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So the disciples went and did what Jesus had told them to do:.

dag: Bee n yi di zaŋ takɔbi lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu ka yɛli, Takɔbi, lum tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.

dag: O wurindi wɔɣira ka bi vihiri ba, ka zaŋdi shɛb zaani bɛ zaani.
en: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.

dag: Nia biɛri nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din viɛla.
en: The LORD detests evil plans, but gracious words are pure.

dag: Ka Haran daa ti kani ka chɛ o ba, o dɔɣiritiŋ din daa nyɛ Ur ka be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Haran died while with his father Terah in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun lo paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti o amiliya niŋ din viɛla, amaa ŋun bi lo amiliya n-nyɛ ŋun niŋ din so.
en: So the man who marries his fiancée does right, and the man who does not marry does better.

dag: Jɔshua daa karim Musa ni daa zali zaligu shɛŋa maa zaa wuhi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu maa zaa zaŋ tabili paɣiba ni bihi ni tinzunnim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: There wasnt a single word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua failed to read aloud in the presence of the entire assembly of Israel. This assembly included the women and small children, along with the immigrants who lived among them.

dag: Ŋunkam ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛlimaŋli mini ŋunkam galim wuntizɔra, di zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: Condemning the innocent or letting the wicked go—both are hateful to the Lord .

dag: Daŋ kam piimi bɛ daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim ka mali yu suŋ ka bɛ leei yi zuɣulaannima.
en: So choose some men from each tribe, and I will make them leaders over you. Choose wise men with experience who understand people.

dag: Yɛm piligu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bom yɛm, ka a ni yɛn bo shɛli pahi nyɛla tɛhi zilima.
en: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Nyama, luɣ shɛli be n sani kpe ka a ni tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: but here is a place beside me where you can stand on a rock.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ di kahigi wuhi ni so ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama di sabiya: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Now, it is clear that no one is put right with God by means of the Law, because the scripture says, Only the person who is put right with God through faith shall live.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yabidoo Dan ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia la yuli m-boli tiŋ maa. Amaa tiŋ maa yuli daa tuui boonila Laishi.
en: They changed its name from Laish to Dan, after their ancestor Dan, the son of Jacob.

dag: Bɛ daa tim na nti yɛli ma la zilin yini maa siɣimsiɣim bunahi, ka n gba daa labisi garigibu yini maa ti ba.
en: They sent me a message like this four times, and every time I gave them a similar reply.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa bɔhi ma, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ninni ti lihiri suhugarigu lihigu lala? A mi bi biɛra, di nyɛla a suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira suhugarigu. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam.
en: So the king asked me, Are you sick? Why do you look sad? I think your heart is full of sadness. Then I was very afraid.

dag: A kpaʒiɛrima nyom viɛla; a yuli ŋmanila tulaale. Dinzuɣu ka paɣiba yur a maa.
en: There is a fragrance about you; the sound of your name recalls it. No woman could keep from loving you.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka sariakaritib la daa tim pirinsi nti yɛli dansarika gula maa ni o yoomi Pool mini Silas bahi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.

dag: N ku chɛ yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya yihibu biɛri bɔhibu. Ka biŋkɔbigu yi ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo. Ka so yi ku o mabia, bɛn kum o yo.
en: I will surely demand your blood for a human life, from every living thing I will demand it. From humans, from a man for his brother, I will demand something for a human life.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yɛri Yisifu lala dabisili kam maa zaa yoli, Yisifu daa bi saɣi ni o min o dɔni.
en: The woman talked with Joseph every day, but he refused to sleep with her.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn yɛra, Zuŋɔ bee biɛɣuni ti ni chaŋ tiŋ yaakaza nti be nimaani yuun muni n-wolindi nyari nyɔri la.
en: Now listen to me, you that say, Today or tomorrow we will travel to a certain city, where we will stay a year and go into business and make a lot of money.

dag: Bɛ zaa mi yɛn dɔnila taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zunzuya di ba.
en: In the end, both of these people will lie together in the dirt. The worms will cover them both.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini. .
en: But when the tenants saw him, they said to one another, This is the owner's son. Let's kill him, and his property will be ours.

dag: Ŋunkam mali yɛm, ŋun wummi dimbɔŋɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tɛhi Yawɛ yurilim maŋli ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things, carefully considering the LORDs faithful love.

dag: Ka ŋun paya yɛli, N dala naɣikɔra pia, ka yɛn zaŋ ba chaŋ ti zahim bɛ tuma, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: Another said, I bought five teams of oxen, and Im going to check on them. Please excuse me.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Sirianim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la nim sani nti zaŋ ba na, Ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la ti leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: The Aramean leaders saw that Israel had defeated them. So they sent messengers to get help from the Arameans living east of the Euphrates River. Shophach was the commander of Hadadezers army from Aram. Shophach also led the other Aramean soldiers.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa chɛ o kɔchuɣu zali nimaani ka lab fɔŋ ni ti yɛli niriba.
en: Then the woman left her water jar, went back to the town, and said to the people there.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Din yiri ninsal suhu ni na, dina n-tar o daɣiri.
en: Its what comes out of a person that contaminates someone in Gods sight, he said.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ma m ba yiŋa ni n dɔɣiri tiŋ ni na, ka po n-yɛli ma, N ni ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. O ni tim o malaika ka o daŋ a tooni, ka a chaŋ nimaani ti kpuɣi paɣ na nti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.

dag: N ni niŋ n daalibarika niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu maa ni din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yuma ata bindira.
en: The Lord will bless the land in the sixth year so that it will produce enough food for two years.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu palli bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na, dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: A good person produces good from the good treasury of the inner self, while an evil person produces evil from the evil treasury of the inner self. The inner self overflows with words that are spoken.

dag: So ku lan zaŋ jɛrigu boli ninvuɣ titali bee n-zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛrilana boli ninvuɣ suŋ.
en: Fools would not be called great men. People would not respect men who make secret plans.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi kpaŋsi yi suhuri n ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla yɛtɔɣa la mini ashili yɛlimaŋli din daa sɔɣi kurimbuni ha.
en: Let us give glory to God! He is able to make you stand firm in your faith, according to the Good News I preach about Jesus Christ and according to the revelation of the secret truth which was hidden for long ages in the past.

dag: ka daa ʒi nimaani gul o.
en: The soldiers stayed there to guard him.

dag: N kul ku nyari n niriba maa taali bee n yiɣisiri n suhu bahiri bɛ zuɣu sahakam, dama di yi nyɛ lala n ni ti bɛn ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛvili maa ni kpi.
en: I will not accuse my people forever. I will not always be angry. If I continued to show my anger, then the human spirit, the life I gave them, would die before me.

dag: Masia gba daa bi pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima. Naawuni n-daa lee piig o ka yɛl o: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: It is the same with Christ. He did not choose himself to have the honor of becoming a high priest. But God chose him. God said to him, You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. Psalm :.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka bɛ mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Bɛ daa kɔrila naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛlahi tuhili ni piɛbihi pola tuhili, m-pahi bɛ binnyura pina zuɣu m-mali sara pam Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: The next day, the Israelites slaughtered , bulls, , rams, and , lambs, and they offered them as sacrifices to please the Lord , along with offerings of wine.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi bi paɣ o nuhi ka shihi ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If the one with the emission touches someone without first rinsing his hands with water, that person must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Amiram bihi n-daa nyɛ: Aduna mini Musa ni Miriam. Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Amrams family: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aarons family: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Dauda daa di nam su Izraɛlnim la yuun pihinahi. O daa diya ʒini Hiburɔn la yuma ayopɔin, ka daa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm mi yuun pihitanaata.
en: He ruled over Israel forty years—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe a yim, a gba ʒe ba la yim; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi, a wuhir o a gba ni ka galimi shɛm.
en: Lord, you are faithful to those who are faithful. You are good to those who are good.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o puli zuɣu suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini.
en: Then Jesus went on a little farther away from them. He fell to the ground and prayed, My Father, if it is possible, dont make me drink from this cup. But do what you want, not what I want.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila wɔridib shɛba bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kɔre be wɔrinyama ni la; sokam kɔre daa bela o kpee paɣa bɔbu ni.
en: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi zim mali binshɛli bɔrɔbɔro duu puuni mini bɛ ni chim shɛli zaa tahilaa bee mahilaa puuni, maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: Any grain offering that is baked in an oven or that is prepared in a pan or on a griddle also belongs to the priest who offered it.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na nti zaŋ li mali kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: He presented the entirely burned offering and did with it according to the regulation.

dag: Niriba ayi maa ni daa ti ŋmaligi chani saha shɛli ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini. Ŋun Pita daa ʒi o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: As the two men were about to leave Jesus, Peter said to him, Master, its good that were here. We should construct three shrines: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah—but he didnt know what he was saying.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o ni su binshɛlikam zaa ti Yisahaku.
en: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac;.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya maa n-tahi ti ti tiŋ ŋɔ ni gomna Amɔn mini naa bia Jɔash.
en: Ahab shouted, Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi saɣi, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna; ka n yi ti kana, n ni baŋ bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ maa ni mali shɛli, ka di pala bɛ ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko, amaa bɛ yiko gba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If the Lord is willing, however, I will come to you soon, and then I will find out for myself the power which these proud people have, and not just what they say.

dag: Gbansabiriba zuliya bɛn daa ʒi Jabɛz n-daa nyɛ: Tiratinim mini Shimiatinim ni Sukatinima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Kɛnnim bɛn daa yi Hammat na, ka bɛ yabidoo daa nyɛ Rɛkab la.
en: The following clans of experts in writing and copying documents lived in the town of Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. They were Kenites who had intermarried with the Rechabites.

dag: N yɛli ya ni yinyahi m-pooi ma, ka yi ti zaŋ doo ŋɔ na ni o ti tumd o yinyahili tuma ŋɔ n tooni? Doo ŋɔ ni tooi be n yili ŋɔ.
en: I have enough crazy men. I dont need you to bring this man to my house to act crazy in front of me. Dont let this man come into my house again.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa yiɣisi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei la ka bɛ zaa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka bɛ yino bi kpalim ka bi du.
en: David and the others got ready and started crossing the Jordan River. By sunrise all of them were on the other side.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaŋ a na ti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bɔɣ zilinli ni.
en: But that did not happen. You were brought down to the deep pit—Sheol, the place of death.

dag: Jilima mini nam dariza bela o sani, ka kpiɔŋ ni suhupiɛlli be o biɛhigu shee.
en: Greatness and grandeur are in front of him; strength and joy are in his place.

dag: ni Joɛl Neetan mabia la ni Mibihar ŋun daa nyɛ Hagiri bia la.
en: Joel, Nathans brother; Mibhar son of Hagri;.

dag: Ka yi ni diri biŋkɔb so kam yi kpi, ŋunkam shihi zaɣ kpiŋ maa ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If one of the animals that you are allowed to eat dies naturally, anyone who touches its dead body will be unclean until evening.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni daa bɔri ni o kahigi wuhi bɛn ti yɛn nya o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la palibu, ka lan wuhi ni o ku taɣ o ni lo shɛm la zuɣu, ka o daa po pɔri pah o daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.

dag: Di simdi ka yi be kasi n sani; dama man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be kasi, ka woligi ya zuliyanim ni ni yi nyɛ n dahalali.
en: I am the Lord , the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.

dag: N yaa kuumi kaman salichee la, ka n zilinli chaŋ ti tabili n yɛno; a zaŋ ma sɔŋ la kum taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: My mouth is as dry as a piece of baked pottery. My tongue is sticking to the roof of my mouth. You have left me dying in the dust.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam bɛn ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: But dont eat anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales. It is not a clean food for you.

dag: M Ba yuri ma, n ni zaŋ n nyɛvili sɔŋ ni n ti lan kpuɣ li la zuɣu.
en: This is why the Father loves me: I give up my life so that I can take it up again.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Judanim la mini bɛ yaansi su n zoya ni tiŋgbana la. N ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn jɛmdi ma n-yɛn be nimaani.
en: I will bless the Israelites who belong to the tribe of Judah, and their descendants will possess my land of mountains. My chosen people, who serve me, will live there.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ŋɔ, dama a chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli suŋ. Amaa n yi mali taali, amaŋmaŋ nyin kum ma, dama bɔ zuɣu ka a lan yɛn zaŋ ma chaŋ a ba sani yaha.
en: Please do me this favor, and keep the sacred promise you made to me. But if I'm guilty, kill me yourself! Why take me to your father to be killed.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ yɛm niŋ nir puuni? Bee n-chɛ ka baŋsim be nir zuɣu ni?.
en: Who tells the ibis when the Nile will flood, or who tells the rooster that rain will fall?.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tan shɛli din guui, ka nyɛ tani maa pirigili la n-yili m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa polo.
en: Half of the end curtain of this tent will hang down below the back edge of the Holy Tent.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali di daantalis anu mini di bansi, ka niŋ salima pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni mini di mihi zuɣu, amaa di ni yɛn tamdi bina anu shɛŋa zuɣu la dina, daanya ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: For this curtain they made five posts fitted with hooks, covered their tops and their rods with gold, and made five bronze bases for the posts.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa tim ti deeg o o yidan Palitiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Laishi bia la sanna.
en: So Ishbosheth had her taken from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.

dag: Dan zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shuham daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shuhamnima. Dan zuliya niriba m-bala.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Dan were Shuham—the Shuhamite family group. That was the family group from the tribe of Dan.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka dɔro din nyuuri niriba lu bɛn di n-tiɣ la zuɣu. Buɣim ni ti taai bɛ jilima n di li zaa.
en: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.

dag: Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa bi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la, dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the people of the tribe of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem, and the Jebusites have continued to live there with the people of Benjamin ever since.

dag: Aai, bɛ zaa pa shɛli, bɛ tuma ka buchi; bɛ binnana gba ka yiko.
en: Look, all of them are frauds; their deeds amount to nothing; their images are a total delusion.

dag: Amaa a yi birigi n-chɛ ka do so zaŋ a dɔni, ka a ta amaŋ daɣiri a ni be a yidan fukumsi ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: But if you have had an affair while married to your husband, if you have defiled yourself, and a man other than your husband has had intercourse with you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: In the desert someone is shouting, Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him. .

dag: Dama a sabi yɛl shɛŋa din to pam jɛndi ma, ka chɛ ka n di wahala n ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: You bring bitter charges against me, even for what I did when I was young.

dag: Dinzuɣu n labila Jɛrusalɛm na nti zo li nambɔɣu, bɛ ni lab me n jɛmbu duu la yaha, ka n chɛ ka bɛ teei bimbuɣisirigu m-buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I have come back to Jerusalem to show mercy to the city. My Temple will be restored, and the city will be rebuilt.

dag: Ka o daa siɣim pam ka yɛli, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim bɔri shihirili? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ku nya shihirili hal baabiɛla.
en: But Jesus gave a deep groan and said, Why do the people of this day ask for a miracle? No, I tell you! No such proof will be given to these people.

dag: O daa mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He made a frame around it that was four inches wide and gold molding around the frame.

dag: Niriba bɛn be zibisim ni baŋdi a daalahiziba tuma yɛla? Bee bɛ baŋd a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla bɛ tamsim shee?.
en: Are your wonders known in the land of darkness, your righteousness in the land of oblivion?.

dag: Yi bi mi ni tizɔbo ni, tizɔriba zaa yi kul zɔra, ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko nti yɛn zo n-di? Dinzuɣu zomiya viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zo n-di.
en: You know that in a race all the runners run, but only one runner gets the prize. So run like that. Run to win!.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: So Joab approached her, and the woman said, Are you Joab? I am, he answered. Pay close attention to the words of your female servant, she said. Im listening, Joab replied.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya M poya, Bɔzira ni leei dabeenzɔbo mini ansarisimalibo tiŋa, ka zani dabari ni niriba ni yɛn turi shɛli, ka di fɔntinsi ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam.
en: I myself have sworn that the city of Bozrah will become a horrifying sight and a desert; people will make fun of it and use its name as a curse. All the nearby villages will be in ruins forever. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Jɛzibɛl ni daa kul wum ni bɛ lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o, ka o yɛli Ɛhab, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti deei Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la wain tihi pu shɛli o ni daa zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ kɔh a zuɣu la su, dama Nabɔt lan ka o nyɛvil ni, o kpiya.
en: When Jezebel heard this, she said to Ahab, Naboth is dead. Now you can go and take the vineyard that you wanted.

dag: Sool daa bela Gibia tintariga pumpɔrinchihi tia din be Migirɔn la gbini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: who was camping under a pomegranate tree in Migron, not far from Gibeah; he had about six hundred men with him.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi bɛ tinsi ni n-laɣim Gibia na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: Instead, the Benjaminites from all the cities came together at Gibeah to march out for battle against the Israelites.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o zilima pam ka tur o.
en: Insulting him, they said many other horrible things against him.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri ba, ka bi chɛra, ka bɛ zo yomyom ni bɛ yi pɔhim kpiɔŋ maa ni.
en: it will blow down on them without pity while they try their best to escape.

dag: Di saha goli ti ku piɛla, ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti di nam ʒini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ti kahig o jilima wuh o niriba toondaannima.
en: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.

dag: N zaŋ jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma la ti ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm la.
en: I gave them the same glory you gave me, so that they may be one, just as you and I are one:.

dag: Yoomi wuntitali dunoya ti ma, ka n dol li kpe nti puhi Yawɛ.
en: Open the gates of righteousness for me so I can come in and give thanks to the LORD!.

dag: Piimiya ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Each tribe will send , men to fight.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya Nyini karimbaandan ŋɔ, n yi n-zan a zuɣu. A biɛɣu neeya, n ni yɛn darig a tibili saha shɛli maa paaya.
en: Im against you, you arrogant one! declares the LORD God of heavenly forces. Your day has come, your time of reckoning.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi daa pala ninvuɣ maŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nyɛla Naawuni niriba; ka saha shɛli ha yi daa bi nya Naawuni nambɔzɔbo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nya nambɔzɔbo o sani.
en: Once you werent a people, but now you are Gods people. Once you hadnt received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

dag: nyini ŋun deeri ti suhigu ŋɔ! Ninsalinim zaa ni ka a sanna.
en: you listen to prayer— and all living things come to you.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛliya: N Duuma Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛ bindiriyubo leei zana mini tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ lu ka nya tibidarigibo.
en: And David says, Their table should become a pitfall and a trap, a stumbling block and payback to them for what they have done. .

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham miri ha ti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a shɛm zaa, ka ti wum ka niŋ li.
en: Moses, you go near and hear everything the Lord our God says. Then tell us everything the Lord tells you. We will listen to you, and we will do everything you say.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka o kpaŋ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Sɔhila kurugu yini saha ka o niŋgbun biisim maa sa bah o.
en: The man asked, What time did my son begin to get well? They answered, It was about one oclock yesterday when the fever left him.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, man mini m mabihi ni n tumtumdiba zaŋla ti liɣiri mini chi m-paŋ ba. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chɛ ti ni bɔri ni bɛ labisi nyɔri shɛli n-yo ti la ti ba.
en: My men, my brothers, and I are also lending money and grain to the people. But lets stop forcing them to pay interest on these loans.

dag: Ka yɛndana ŋun nyɛ nandana daa be tiŋ maa ni; ka daa zaŋ o yɛm maa fa tiŋ maa nim bahi. Amaa ka so daa bi teei nandana maa yɛla.
en: But there was a wise man in that town. He was poor, but he used his wisdom to save his town. After everything was finished, the people forgot about the poor man.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma ŋɔ? N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi n dimnim zuɣu, nyama, ka a ti bi niŋ ba shɛli, ka naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, but all you have done is bless them.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, May Your Majesty live forever!.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, o ni pɔbilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirigi o kpiŋkpama na ti to Mɔabnima.
en: Moab, an enemy swoops down like an eagle spreading its wings over your land.

dag: Zaliguzaana ni sariakarita yino kɔŋko ŋun ni tooi tiligi niriba ka ni tooi bahi ba yoli m-beni. Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a mi ka a karit a daadamkpee saria?.
en: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone?.

dag: A yi lo alikauli ka bi pal li, dindina a yi bi lo li, di so.
en: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di wɔɣ zuɣusaa gari mɔɣu ni tihi zaa. Di wulikpani daa bara, ka di wula wɔɣa, di ni daa nyari kom pam zoori la zuɣu.
en: But this tree towered over those other trees, and its branches grew long and thick.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ yi ni booni so Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ.
en: Then Pilate asked the crowd, What do you want me to do with this man you say is the king of the Jews.

dag: Bɛ ni nya alibarika Yawɛ sani, ka yi taali ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiliginsim ŋɔ sani.
en: The Lord will bless them and save them; God will declare them innocent.

dag: ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi bi zaŋ yimaŋ zali bia zaani yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: Then he said, The truth is, you must change your thinking and become like little children. If you dont do this, you will never enter Gods kingdom.

dag: amaa niriba daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu, Masia daa malila sara maligu yim din kul ni ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛda ni o yi nya turi Masia zuɣu, di so Ijipti azichi, dama o daa lihirila o ni ti yɛn nya laara shɛli dahin shɛl ha la.
en: He thought it was better to suffer for the Messiah than to have all the treasures of Egypt. He was waiting for the reward that God would give him.

dag: O ni daa mali bia maa chani Yisa sani ka alizin biɛɣu maa yiɣis o n-darig o. Ka Yisa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bia maa kpaŋ, ka o zaŋ o labisi ti o ba maa.
en: While he was coming, the demon threw him down and shook him violently. Jesus spoke harshly to the unclean spirit, healed the child, and gave him back to his father.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini maligumaaniba kpamba daa lɔri nia ni bɛ gbaai Yisa, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim maa, amaa ka daa lee zɔri niriba.
en: The teachers of the Law and the chief priests tried to arrest Jesus on the spot, because they knew that he had told this parable against them; but they were afraid of the people.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini wain sara pahi naɣilabihi maa mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi pola maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Offer with them all the other offerings required for the first day.

dag: Asa daa bi wurim luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa ʒe Yawɛ yim o suhu ni hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Asa did not destroy the high places, even though he was faithful to the Lord all his life.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigiri buŋ maa.
en: Some people standing around said to them, What are you doing, untying the colt.

dag: Naawuni, ti paɣir a, ti paɣir a; dama a miri ti. Sokam yɛr a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: We praise you, God! We praise you because you are near to us. We tell about the amazing things you have done.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nɛr ni Nadab.
en: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: Bɛ zaa mi yɛn dɔnila taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zunzuya di ba.
en: They lie together in the dust and worms cover them.

dag: Ti mabihi la zaa puhiri ya. Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ.
en: All the brothers and sisters greet you. You in turn should greet each other with a holy kiss.

dag: N yi daa yɛli, N kul ni tɔɣisiri lala, n naan nyɛla ŋun bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli a bihi puuni.
en: If I said, I will talk about all this, I would have been unfaithful to your children.

dag: Dabo shɛŋa zaa zuɣu bɛ ni daa kɔri bindira, gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim nimaani ka so ku tooi kpe di ni, amaa nimaani ni ti leela niɣi mini piɛri gɔrim shee.
en: People once worked the soil and grew food on these hills, but at that time they will not go there, because the fields will be covered with weeds and thorns. It will be a place where cattle graze and sheep wander.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra.
en: Joshua and Caleb became very upset.

dag: Aristakus ŋun be sarika ni pahi n zuɣu ŋɔ mini Maak ŋun nyɛ Baanabas ŋahiŋga la puhiri ya. Yi pun wum di ni simd ni yi niŋ o shɛm; ka o yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o.
en: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ Ninivenim dini. Nahum ŋun nyɛ Ɛlikɔsh nir la ni daa nya ʒii shɛli litaafi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh.

dag: Yawɛ n-su ti naba chandi ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ baŋ timaŋmaŋ soya?.
en: A persons steps are from the LORD; how then can people understand their path?.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm buɣisi ya m-bɔŋɔ: m po Firawuna ni yi ku kuli ka pa ni yi tizo ŋun nyɛ yi zaa biasani maa gba kala kpe na.
en: But I will let you prove that you are telling the truth. In the name of Pharaoh, I swear that I will not let you go until your youngest brother comes here.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa tɔbbihi nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme n-dee li.
en: And this is what the Lord says: This city of Jerusalem will surely be given to the army of the king of Babylon. He will capture this city.

dag: Bɛ ʒim mini bɛ kpam ni ti ŋam Yawɛ takɔb maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋ piɛ shɛb mini bu shɛb mali sara ʒim ni bɛ kpam la. Dama Yawɛ ni mali sara Bɔzira. O ni ku niriba pam Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
