en: His sword will be covered with their blood and fat, like the blood and fat of lambs and goats that are sacrificed. The Lord will offer this sacrifice in the city of Bozrah; he will make this a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

dag: Zɛbadia mini Mɛshulam ni Hiziki ni Hɛbɛr.
en: Elpaals family: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber.

dag: Aai, yɛligu maa kul bela yi sani, di bela yi noya ni mini yi suhuri ni ni yi dol li.
en: No, the word is very near to you. It is in your mouth and in your heart. So you can obey it.

dag: Niriba pam daa di o shɛhira kpɛma, amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa daa lee bi doli taba.
en: Many people came and told lies against Jesus, but they all said different things. None of them agreed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka ka kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbibi n nuu ni du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Nyin Daniɛl, pumpɔŋɔ kpabimi litaafi maa, ka zaŋ bintabinda n-dihi tabili li sɔŋ hal ti paai saha tariga. Amaa niriba pam ni ti zɔri ginda, ka baŋsim ti yɛligiri pahira.
en: He said to me, And now, Daniel, close the book and put a seal on it until the end of the world. Meanwhile, many people will waste their efforts trying to understand what is happening.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba mini m ma ti chɛ ma bahi, amaa Yawɛ ŋun kul ni gbib ma.
en: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa ka dol o soya ka zɔr o.
en: You must obey the commands of the Lord your God. Follow him and respect him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛlila Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, n yi lan doli ya biɛla pahi n ni ti kun ya. Dinzuɣu yihimiya salima nɛma din be yi ni, ka m baŋ n ni yɛn niŋ ya shɛm. .
en: because the LORD had said to Moses, Tell the Israelites, You are a stubborn people. If I were to go up with you even for a single moment, I would destroy you. So now take off your jewelry, while I figure out what to do with you.

dag: ka di daa kpa o talahi ni o doli yi Samaria.
en: This time he had to go through Samaria.

dag: Nuhu daa malila bidibis ata, bɛ yuya n-daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Taai Naa Hiram, A ni daa ti m ba Dauda sida dari ka o me o yil la, niŋmi n gba lala.
en: Solomon sent the following message to King Huram of Tyre: When my father David was building his palace, you sent him cedar logs.

dag: Ka yinim teeku noli tinsi ŋɔ, yi ni ti leei biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee mini piɛguliba ni yɛn chɛri momaha luɣ shɛli, ka leei biŋkɔbbaligu gbɛbu shee.
en: Your land by the sea will become empty fields for shepherds and their sheep.

dag: N ni labisi Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daazichi ti ba, ka mali ba zali kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm piligu ni la.
en: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.

dag: Lala ka niriba ŋɔ zahindi zahima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu, ka turi bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la.
en: Yet, even knowing this, these dreamers in the same way pollute themselves, reject authority, and slander the angels.

dag: Dama zuliya kam wuna zaa nyɛla binnana; amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: The gods of all other nations are only idols, but the Lord created the heavens.

dag: Bomiya bua mini naɣilaa ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara hal ti paai daba ayopɔin.
en: Each day for seven days you are to offer a goat, a bull, and a ram as sacrifices for sin. All of them must be without any defects.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: I spoke foolishly, Lord . What can I answer? I will not try to say anything else.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli, Mani m-mali n suhu ka di yi daɣiri ni, n yi n daalahichi ni.
en: Can anyone say their heart is pure? Who can say, I am free from sin?.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ shɛb ni tumdi shɛm polo, n nyɛla ŋun dol a zaligu, m mi bi zaŋ mmaŋ bali duŋtaariba ni.
en: Unlike most people, I have obeyed your commands, so I have never been like those who are cruel and evil.

dag: Paɣa bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o yidana n-su li; lala mi n-nyɛ li, doo gba bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o paɣa n-su li.
en: A wife is not the master of her own body, but her husband is; in the same way a husband is not the master of his own body, but his wife is.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ chama, ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔni bɛ sɔɣibu shee din daa be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Ai wulinluhili polo la; amaa ka Jɔshua ŋun daa kpalim gbe niriba maa sani.
en: now go! The , soldiers went to a place on the west side of Ai, between Ai and Bethel, where they could hide and wait to attack. That night, Joshua stayed in camp with the rest of the army.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka niriba pam ka bɛ sanna nti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka ʒe bɛ nɛma.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Bring a mob to terrorize them and rob them.

dag: Ibram paɣa Zarai daa bi dɔɣi bihi. Zarai daa mali Ijipti dab bipuɣiŋga ka o yuli booni Haga.
en: Abram's wife Sarai had not been able to have any children. But she owned a young Egyptian slave woman named Hagar.

dag: Zab piɛla nyɛla jilima nam zuɣupiligu, Wuntizɔbo biɛhigu puuni ka di yirina.
en: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.

dag: O daa kamina ni o ti di neesim maa shɛhira, ka bɛnkam zaa wum o yɛligu niŋ yɛda o zuɣu.
en: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛri maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka duɣi sara maligu kasi biŋkɔbiri nimdi mi duɣuri ni mini ankɔraŋmahi ni ni taha ni n-zaŋ li yomyom ti tari niriba maa zaa.
en: The Levites roasted the Passover sacrifices over the fire, according to the regulations, and boiled the sacred offerings in pots, kettles, and pans, and quickly distributed the meat to the people.

dag: Ka Jɔsia daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa Izraɛl nanim ni daa me n-zali Samaria n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi la zaa kaman o ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbina la shɛm la.
en: Moreover, Josiah removed all the shrines on the high hills that the Israelite kings had constructed throughout the cities of Samaria. These had made the LORD angry. Josiah did to them just what he did at Bethel.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛn mi, amaa ka zaɣisi ni bɛ saɣi ni tum dunia piligu ni ha, Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛtɔɣa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ. Kom ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka di yi kom ni na.
en: They purposely ignore the fact that long ago God gave a command, and the heavens and earth were created. The earth was formed out of water and by water.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ bɛ buɣa tooni, ka zaŋ yi kɔba yɛrigi gili yi maligu bimbina gbini.
en: I will scatter the corpses of the people of Israel; I will scatter their bones all around the altars.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa na.
en: Jesus said to them, You people are stubborn and don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Then Jesus said to the man, Bring your son to me.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yi shihi di nimdi maa di gba ni leei din be kasi. Ka di ʒim yi tɔɣ vie binyɛrigu, di simdi ka yi paɣi di ni tɔɣ vie binyɛr shɛli maa luɣ kasi shee.
en: Anyone or anything that touches the flesh of the animal will be harmed by the power of its holiness. If any article of clothing is spattered with the animal's blood, it must be washed in a holy place.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Dɔr bɔ n-lee be a suhu ni ka a tum dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa, din nyɛ vi kalinsi pagɔrisigu tuma ŋɔ?.
en: How sick was your heart—the LORD God proclaims—that you could do all these things, the deeds of a hardened prostitute.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani di shɛhira jɛndi ba. Amaa ka bɛ bi ŋmaligi chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni sani bee n-suh o dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: I am the Lord , their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Leemi ti naa su ti; ka a bidibiga min a nyaaŋa gba ti nyɛ ti nanim su ti, a ni fa ti Midiannim nuu ni bahi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: After that, the Israelites said to Gideon, Be our ruler—you and your descendants after you. You have saved us from the Midianites.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka saa miri ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli mini tiŋgban nɛli ni din nyɛ daadamnim ni ka luɣ shɛli?.
en: on empty deserts where no one lives?.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni ti tum ŋun tim ma na maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli wuntaŋ ni na be ŋɔ, dama yuŋ ni zibi ka so ku lan tooi tum tuma yaha.
en: While it is daytime, we must continue doing the work of the one who sent me. The night is coming, and no one can work at night.

dag: Di saha ka wuntizɔriba maa ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum mal a, ka ti ti a bindirigu? Bee ka kɔnyuri daa mal a, ka ti ti a kom?.
en: Then the godly people will answer, Lord, when did we see you hungry and give you food? When did we see you thirsty and give you something to drink?.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni. Yi shiri chirimya pam.
en: So they were not still dead, because he is the God only of living people. You Sadducees are so wrong.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi kuli Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli puuni niriba, dindina ti yaannim tarili ni ka bɛ tarili ni yina, ka bɛ zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni; di saha ka di yi ti tarili ni.
en: If they are married to someone from another Israelite tribe, their inheritance will be taken away from our household and given to another tribe into which they marry. Then it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli Sukɔtinima, N suhiri ya, niŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro ti n niriba bɛn doli ma ŋɔ; dama di wum ba pam, ka m mi na kariti dolila Midian nanim Zɛba mini Zalimuna.
en: The town of Succoth was nearby, so he went there and asked, Please give my troops some food. They are worn out, but we have to keep chasing Zebah and Zalmunna, the two Midianite kings.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa yihi kom baptaizibu yɛla waazu la nyaaŋa ka yɛligu ŋɔ daa pili Galili m-mol gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: You know what happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism John preached.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka gbaŋŋmara Shafan lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma; ka daa zani naa maa tooni karim li.
en: But there's something else, Your Majesty. The priest Hilkiah gave me this book. Then Shaphan read it out loud.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna maa nyɛla Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋ tin ya ka o be yi ni la duu? Yi bi su yimaŋa.
en: Or dont you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you? Dont you know that you have the Holy Spirit from God, and you dont belong to yourselves?.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa lo Dauda alikauli, dama o daa yur o mi kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm la.
en: Jonathan swore eternal friendship with David because of his deep affection for him.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, n-nyɛ yi ni pii na so maa, dama yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔri so maa ka Yawɛ zaŋ leei naa n-tin ya maa.
en: Now here is the king you chose; you asked for him, and now the Lord has given him to you.

dag: Ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ bom ŋariŋ zal o, salo maa ti muɣi m-miris o pam zuɣu;.
en: The crowd was so large that Jesus told his disciples to get a boat ready for him, so that the people would not crush him.

dag: Yi ni tooi lan da saan shɛb mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani mini bɛ malibu ni dɔɣi bi shɛb yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ sani, ka bɛ leei yi sulinsi.
en: You may also buy the children of the foreigners who are living among you. Such children born in your land may become your property.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka lihi bɛmaŋ suhupiɛlli niriba, ka bɛ paɣiri ba bɛ nasara dibu zuɣu la.
en: A wealthy man might tell himself how well he has done in life. And other people might praise him.

dag: dindina yi kpamba mini sariakaritiba bɛn cham ti buɣisi o ni do luɣ shɛli maa zaŋ chaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa din miri nimaani wɔɣilim.
en: Your leaders and judges must come out and measure the distance to the towns around the dead body.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim daa kana nti laɣim gil o bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ ka ti chɛ biɛhiŋ? Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin kahigim li yɛli ti.
en: The Jewish opposition circled around him and asked, How long will you test our patience? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.

dag: Siria Naa daa pun bahila o sapashinnim pihitanaayi bɛn su o chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi noli yɛli, Di ti tuhiya wɔɣiri so bee tarim so, naɣila Izraɛl naa kɔŋko.
en: The king of Syria had ordered his chariot commanders to attack only Ahab.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nim suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.

dag: Yisa ni pun chaŋ ti kpe ti zuɣu la, dama o daa leei maligumaani titali ŋun tuma be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Thats where Jesus went in advance and entered for us, since he became a high priest according to the order of Melchizedek.

dag: Laakumnim maa ni daa nyu kom maa naai, ka nachin kpɛm maa zaŋ nyee ni baŋa din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu pirigili mini bans ayi din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu bupia ti o ni o pir o nuhi ni.
en: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.

dag: Tinzunnim deei bɛ yaa zaa, ka bɛ bi baŋ lala. Bɛ bi mi ni bɛ kum saha bi lan waɣa.
en: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.

dag: A dimnim bela a jɛmbu duu maa luɣ kasi shee la n-tahiri nasara dibu tahigu; ka zaŋ bɛ tuutanim sa nimaani.
en: Your enemies have shouted in triumph in your Temple; they have placed their flags there as signs of victory.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so mini bɛn daa pah o zuɣu ʒiɛya guli Yisa maa ni daa nya tiŋgbani dambu maa mini din niŋ maa, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: When the army officer and the soldiers with him who were watching Jesus saw the earthquake and everything else that happened, they were terrified and said, He really was the Son of God.

dag: Bɔ saha ka ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋum niŋ ma? N wum ŋumaŋuma shɛli Izraɛlnim maa ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma maa.
en: How long will these evil people continue to complain against me? I have heard their complaints and their griping.

dag: Dindina yi ni shɛb ni bɔhi ma, Ka di yi nyɛ lala, di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni na kul nyari ninsalinim taali? Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu Naawuni yubu soli ka di ku niŋ.
en: But one of you will say to me, If this is so, how can God find fault with anyone? Who can resist God's will.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ daa bi deei Yawɛ noli. Ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Tapanhɛs.
en: They disobeyed the Lord 's command and went into Egypt as far as the city of Tahpanhes.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o bia maa ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But when the farmers saw the son, they said to each other, This is the owners son. This vineyard will be his. If we kill him, it will be ours.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum a daba bɛn nyɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ suhigu ka chɛ bɛ taali maa, ka wuhi ba so viɛl shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ka a chɛ ka saa mi a tiŋgban shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti a niriba ni bɛ su li ŋɔ ni.
en: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And send rain on the land you promised them forever.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni, yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu n fabila ŋɔ puuni. Fam n nyɛvili bahi, dama n zɔrila n dimnima.
en: Listen to me when I complain, God! Protect my life from the enemys terror!.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi so mi yaha, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a? Ka o yɛl o, Za ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ taɣi sab pihinii.
en: Then he asked another one, And you—how much do you owe? A thousand bushels of wheat, he answered. Here is your account, the manager told him; write eight hundred.

dag: Yi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa nyɛla tampiligim ŋaha, ka yi ni zaŋ shɛli taɣi yimaŋ nyɛla yaɣiri.
en: The wise sayings you quote are worthless. Your arguments are as weak as clay.

dag: Ka o yɛl ba, Yi nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka yi yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ.
en: The king answered, You are lazy and don't want to work, and that is why you ask me to let you go and offer sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi gba daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of the Kerethites and Pelethites, and Davids sons were priests.

dag: Ka daɣila m piɛri maa yɛn ŋubila yi ni no mo shɛŋa sɔŋ maa, ka nyu yi ni zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli maa?.
en: My other sheep have to eat the grass you trample down and drink the water you muddy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o, ka wuɣ gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o;.
en: They put a purple robe on Jesus, made a crown out of thorny branches, and put it on his head.

dag: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɛza mini Finɛhas ni Abishua.
en: Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n diri wahala ŋɔ. Amaa vi bi mali ma, dama m mi n ni niŋ so yɛda, ka mi ni o ni tooi gbibi n ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ o nuu ni la hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: and it is for this reason that I suffer these things. But I am still full of confidence, because I know whom I have trusted, and I am sure that he is able to keep safe until that Day what he has entrusted to me.

dag: Niriba ni nya a zaɣim, ka a di vi bɛ sani. N ni bɔhi biɛri, m mi ku tiligi so.
en: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.

dag: Tindaannim maa daa bi kani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la gbin na, amaa ka lee pahiri bɛ mabihi zuɣu ŋ-ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din ka dabindi la.
en: Those priests were not allowed to serve in the Temple, but they could eat the unleavened bread provided for their fellow priests.

dag: Nyin ŋun be puri ni ŋɔ, n zɔnim wumd a yɛtɔɣa; chɛ ka n gba wum li.
en: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice!.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa o ni daa suh o bɔri binshɛŋa zaa. O daa ti o pina ka di gari ŋun paɣ maa ni daa ʒi pin shɛŋa na ti ti ŋun naa, di nyaaŋa ka o min o niriba maa daa lab kuli bɛ ya.
en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she asked for. This was in addition to what he gave her in exchange for the gifts she brought to him. Then she and her attendants returned to the land of Sheba.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan bɔhi Ibrahimma, Wula ka a daa lee tɛhi hal ti niŋ lala maa.
en: What were you afraid of? Why did you do this to me.

dag: Di simdi ni yi lihi ti kaman Masia tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ o daashili yɛlimaŋa fukumsi niŋ shɛb nuu ni.
en: You should think of us as servants of Christ, the ones God has trusted to do the work of making known his secret truths.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti be sagbana ni kanna, ka sokam nina ni ti nya o, hal bɛn daa zaŋ kpani kuh o luɣili la gba ni ti nya o, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ti fabili bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛm zuɣu. Lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ. Ami.
en: Look, he is coming on the clouds! Everyone will see him, including those who pierced him. All peoples on earth will mourn over him. So shall it be!.

dag: Anabi Habakuk wunsuhigu. Di dolila Shigiɔnɔt ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: This is a prayer of the prophet Habakkuk:.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ o tumtumdiba ninvuɣ pia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa zɔrila o yiŋnim min o yanim ni o niŋ li wuntaŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa niŋ li la yuŋ.
en: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did what the Lord had told him. He was too afraid of his family and the people in town to do it by day, so he did it at night.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yi bihi zaa bɛn be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni so yi ti mali daɣiri ka miri binyɛr kasi shɛŋa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ ti man Yawɛ la, n ni yihi dilana n sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.

dag: Ka n nya lala, ka di shɛhira ni ŋuna n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa.
en: I have seen it, said John, and I tell you that he is the Son of God.

dag: Ka yihi di biŋkpam zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then he must take all the fat from the animal and bring it to the altar.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Rom ka bɛ chɛ ka Pool bo o dahalali duu beni, ka bɛ daa bo tɔbbi so nti zali nimaani ka o gul o.
en: When we arrived in Rome, Paul was allowed to live by himself with a soldier guarding him.

dag: Zaŋ Sinai Zoli n-doli yi Siɛr Zoli polo hal ti paai Kadɛshibarinia nyɛla biɛɣ pinyini chandi.
en: The trip from Mount Horeb through the mountains of Seir to Kadesh Barnea takes only eleven days.

dag: Ka tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi zoli maa zuɣu n-zaŋ hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔna n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ti paai tiŋ kar shɛŋa din ʒi Ɛfurɔn Zoli zuɣu la. Ka di daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ŋmaligi n-zaŋ hal ti paai Baala bee Kiriatijiarim.
en: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.

dag: Paɣ maa nini ni daa ti nya Samuɛl, o daa ŋmɛla kuŋ pam ka bɔhi Sool, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma? Nyini n-nyɛ Sool.
en: When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed and said to Saul, Why have you tricked me? You are King Saul.

dag: A zaligunim viɛli pam, dinzuɣu ka n dol li n suhu ni.
en: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Bashan oki tihi m-mali a ŋariŋ duhirisi. Bɛ zaŋla Saipurus teeku duli wolifahi dari mali a puuni ka niŋ wɔbinyina pa di zuɣu.
en: They used oak trees from Bashan to make your oars. They used pine trees from Cyprus to make the cabin on your deck. They decorated that shelter with ivory.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuui ʒini nimaani, bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima kana nti gbahi bɛ ni shɛb ku.
en: When these people began to live in Samaria, they did not honor the Lord , so the Lord sent lions to attack them. The lions killed some of them.

dag: Ŋun biriti mini ŋun mihiri kom zaa nyɛla yim, ka bɛ zaa ni ti deei bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm laara.
en: The one who plants and the one who waters work together, but each one will receive their own reward for their own labor.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka mi bi lan niŋ di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ. Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa wum ninsal ni yɛli shɛm, dama Yawɛ daa tuhi ti Izraɛlnima.
en: That had never happened before, and it has never happened again. That was the day the Lord obeyed a man. The Lord really was fighting for Israel!.

dag: Amaa ka o ba maa yɛl o yiŋ bihi, Zaŋmiya kpar suŋ na yomyom ti yɛl o, ka zaŋ nintua na ti pir o, ka zaŋ namda na ti pir o pahi.
en: But his father said to the servants, Hurry and bring the best clothes and put them on him. Give him a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhɔram daa dii yiɣisi Samaria di saha maa n-chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa.
en: Then King Joram went out of Samaria and gathered together all the men of Israel.

dag: Ninsalinim daa di malaikanim bindirigu. O daa ti ba li pam.
en: These people ate the food of angels. God sent plenty of food to satisfy them.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti mali di lahi mini di parante shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali tuɣindi tulaale zim, ka mali duɣuri ni kuruwa shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mal li.
en: Make the plates, the spoons, the pitchers, and the bowls from pure gold. The pitchers and bowls will be used for pouring the drink offerings.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni kɔŋko ka ti mali tahima Masia ni, dindina ti nyɛla nambɔ niriba gari sokam zaa.
en: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.

dag: Amaa din sabi niŋ di ni ŋɔ sabimi ni yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia, ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili o yuli zuɣu.
en: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa deei pipia maa Yawɛ nuu ni n-chɛ ka o ni daa tim ma zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa nyu li.
en: I took the cup from the Lord 's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.

dag: Hal ŋun nyɛ n zo simo, ka n niŋ o yɛda, ka m min o laɣindi diri la gba yila n nyaaŋa.
en: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.

dag: N ku gbihi bee n-ʒeei gom.
en: I wont let my eyes close, wont let my eyelids sleep.

dag: Ka Jɔshua garigi yɛli ba, Yi yi galisi pam, ka Ifriim zuliya niriba zoya tiŋgban la pɔri ka bi saɣi ya, yin chamiya Pɛrizinim mini Rɛfaimnim tiŋgban ni yɔɣu la ni nti ŋma nyɔŋ ʒini.
en: Joshua answered, If there are so many of you and the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, then go into the forests and clear ground for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.

dag: Dama n leela ŋun ka buchi kaman wain koligu din yili nyɔhi ni; amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: because Ive become like a bottle dried up by smoke, though I havent forgotten your statutes.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ nam maa siɣisi dimaŋa, ka ku duhi dimaŋa. Ka di yi gbibi alikauli maa, dina n-ni chɛ ka di zani.
en: so that the rest of the people of Judah would obey only him and never gain control of their own country again.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila Anakinima, ka niriba booni ba Rɛfaimnima, amaa Mɔabnim daa booni ba la Ɛmimnima.
en: The Anakites were part of the Rephaites. People thought the Emites were also Rephaites, but the people of Moab called them Emites.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate asked him, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus replied, Thats what you say.

dag: ka gbihiri yuŋ kam, ka yiɣisiri asiba kam, ka bimbira maa mali hal nti bilina zooi, ka o bi mi din chɛ ka di niŋ lala maa.
en: The farmer sleeps at night and is up and around during the day. Yet the seeds keep sprouting and growing, and he doesn't understand how.

dag: Yi yaanniin daa di bindir shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni ka kpi.
en: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, but they died.

dag: N ni wurim kuŋkuna mini zoya, ka chɛ ka tihi mini mɔri din be di zuɣu zaa kuui. N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa kuui kpakpa, ka chɛ ka kɔpurima nyuui.
en: I will destroy the hills and mountains. I will dry up all the plants that grow there. I will change rivers to dry land and dry up pools of water.

dag: Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo din kul zoori pahiri Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa baŋbu puuni!.
en: Grace and peace be given to you more and more, because now you know God and Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Whoever has ears to listen should pay attention.

dag: m-bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ yɛda maa, yi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Aai, ti na ʒi n-wum ni Naawuni Shia beni gba.
en: He asked them, Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you came to believe? They replied, Weve not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; dama m bela n ko ka be nahiŋgu ni.
en: I am hurt and lonely. Turn to me, and show me mercy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa to tɛte, ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la di, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgbani ti bɛ zuliya maa pirigili kaman daŋ kam ni yɛn deei shɛm, bɛ daa zaŋla fɔntinsi pia ti ba.
en: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, gbilisimiya tibili wum n noli ni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Now, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to what I say.

dag: Filistia doo maa ni daa yiɣisi vu m-miri Dauda ni o ti tuh o saha shɛli, ka Dauda gba daa dii guui yi tɔb gɔɣu maa ni ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: Goliath started walking toward David again, and David ran quickly toward the Philistine battle line to fight him.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nim suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: There was great rejoicing in that city.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu n-nam ninsala, ka vuhi nyɛvili vuhim niŋ o nyee ni; ka ninsal leei ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: The Lord God took some soil from the ground and made a man. God breathed life into the man, and the man started breathing.

dag: ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka yɛlimaŋli maa yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

dag: N yuun kɔbiga ni pisi m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. N lan ka yaa din ni chaŋ shɛli. Ka Yawɛ pun yɛli ma, A ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: and said, I am now a hundred and twenty years old and am no longer able to be your leader. And besides this, the Lord has told me that I will not cross the Jordan.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani, ka o ni niŋ binshɛŋa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o kpe taali ni maa kpihim.
en: The priest shall offer the sacrifice for your sin, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ka m mi yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Hushai told the priests Zadok and Abiathar what advice he had given to Absalom and the Israelite leaders and what advice Ahithophel had given.

dag: Naawuni kukoli daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ o lo alikauli yɛli, N ku lan chɛ ka tiŋgbani kɔŋko dam, amaa n ni lan chɛ ka zuɣusaa gba dam.
en: When he spoke before, his voice shook the earth. But now he has promised, Once again I will shake the earth, but I will also shake heaven.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi jiɣindi situra zuɣu? Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda, di mi bi miri gumdi.
en: And why do you worry about clothes? Notice how the lilies in the field grow. They dont wear themselves out with work, and they dont spin cloth.

dag: Yaakubu daa kul bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni din nyɛ o ba ni daa be luɣ shɛl la.
en: Jacob lived in the land of Canaan where his father was an immigrant.

dag: Ɛlam ŋun pahi la niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: the inhabitants of the other Elam .

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya ka biriti maa leei bɛn tɔɣisira, ka bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni maa kpaŋ, ka gbariti chana, ka zoomba gba nina neei maa, ka bɛ daa tibigi Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ pam.
en: So the crowd was amazed when they saw those who had been unable to speak talking, and the paralyzed cured, and the injured walking, and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni malaika daa yɛli ma zahindi maa ni, Yaakubu, ka n saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: The angel of God spoke to me in the dream and said, Jacob! Yes, I answered.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum kum ni neebu yɛla maa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Pool ansarisi, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni dahin shɛli ka bɛ ni ti lan wum o yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: When they heard Paul speak about a raising from death, some of them made fun of him, but others said, We want to hear you speak about this again.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Arimatia tiŋbia ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ashilɔni Yɛhudianim zɔbu zuɣu la daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi. Ka o daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: Later, a man named Joseph from Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Pilate said Joseph could take Jesus body, so he came and took it away.

dag: O ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee, dama bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa leei dabari tɔb biɛ shɛli din lu di ni la min o suhuyiɣisili pam la zuɣu.
en: The lion is on the prowl, and the land is reduced to nothing, because of the fierce sword, because of his fierce anger.

dag: Dama n zuɣu ka a ni nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka a nyɛvili yuma pahi.
en: Wisdom will add years to your life.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tooi wumda, di zuɣu ka n ku tooi garigi yɛli shɛli.
en: I am like those who do not answer, because they cannot hear.

dag: Amaa bin yini ŋɔ ka n naɣ kpahim nya: Naawuni nam ninsalinim dɛde, amaa tinim lee bo yɛligabira pam ti timaŋa. .
en: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, o yi zaŋla salima bee anzinfa bee kuɣ viɛla bee dari bee mɔri bee kaɣa me.
en: So, whether someone builds on top of the foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, grass, or hay.

dag: Dama di niŋ kamaata ni o diri nam hal ti nyaŋ o dimnim zaa n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: For Christ must rule until God defeats all enemies and puts them under his feet.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la yi taali ni.
en: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.

dag: N kɔŋko ku tooi gbibi niriba ŋɔ zaa, dama bɛ galisi nyaŋ ma.
en: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana, ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti chɛ ka Napaɣ Vashiti zaŋ o napaɣ nam zuɣupiligu pili, ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Napaɣ maa daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli, ka naa maa daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o viɛlim maa wuh o tuma zuɣulaannim min o saamba maa zaa.
en: to bring Queen Vashti to him. The king wanted her to wear her crown and let his people and his officials see how beautiful she was.

dag: N ni ti yihi bukpahigu yi kɔbili ni, ka baɣisi ti ku lan beni.
en: You will no longer try to do magic. You will have no more fortunetellers.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi ti kpe fɔŋ maa ni n-chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o ti kpe o ni kuni yil shɛli.
en: Jesus replied, When you go into the city, a man carrying a water jar will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters.

dag: ka o zaŋ li ŋubi bɛ zaa nini maa ni.
en: Taking it, he ate it in front of them.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, Zaŋmiya yi ni gbahi yi mabi shɛb daba ŋɔ na labisi, dama Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. .
en: Send these prisoners back home—they are your own relatives. If you don't, the Lord will punish you in his anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N ni kpihim ninsal shɛba n ni daa nam niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri mini biŋgbamda ni noonsi birili, dama di niŋ ma yoli pam n ni daa nam ba maa zuɣu.
en: that he said, I will wipe out these people I have created, and also the animals and the birds, because I am sorry that I made any of them.

dag: Buni nyɛla din taɣiri nir nyɛvili, amaa so bi varisiri faralana.
en: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ niŋ nimmoo n-chɛ ka yi bolibu mini yi piibu la ba n-zani, dama yi yi niŋ lala yi ku lu.
en: So then, my friends, try even harder to make God's call and his choice of you a permanent experience; if you do so, you will never abandon your faith.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu n-lɔri ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu nia zuɣu. Biɛɣu yi ti neera, bɛ tumdila tuumbiɛri maa, dama bɛ mali di tumbu yiko.
en: How terrible it will be for those who lie awake and plan evil! When morning comes, as soon as they have the chance, they do the evil they planned.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhiranima m-pahi Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋdi tiri bɛn deeri ŋun Naawuni nol la.
en: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.

dag: Tim ka Giliad? Dɔɣite ka nimaani? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ bi nya alaafee?.
en: Is there no medicine in Gilead? Are there no doctors there? Why, then, have my people not been healed?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ mali ti paai ko shɛli, ka namɔɣili maa yɛl o, Nyam kom ŋɔ! Bɔ n-lee ni chɛ ka n ku deei kom baptaizibu? .
en: As they traveled down the road, they came to a place where there was some water, and the official said, Here is some water. What is to keep me from being baptized.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi kpaŋ ti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm; ka anabinim ni daa sab shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ Daadam Bia polo la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: Jesus took the twelve apostles aside and said: We are now on our way to Jerusalem. Everything that the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will happen there.

dag: Wulimpuhili zaŋ chaŋ wulinluhili ni waɣ shɛm, lala ka o yihi ti daalahichi bahi katiŋa.
en: As far as the east is from the west, so far does he remove our sins from us.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sɔdom naa mini Gomɔra naa ni Adima naa ni Zɛbɔiim naa ni Bɛla naa bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Zɔa la daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ Siddim vinvamli ni.
en: At that time the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela joined together to fight against their enemies in the Valley of Siddim.

dag: Jɔnatan tɔbu daa ʒi n-lab kuli ka pa ni o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ʒim mini kpiɔŋlaannim kpam n-varim li. Ka Sool mi takɔbi na ʒi n-chɛ n-ziŋ.
en: The arrows of Jonathan struck, and warriors died. The sword of Saul cut the enemy apart.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gballi ni. Ka bɛ daa kum o kuli yɛra, Mbaye, m mabia.
en: He buried it in his own family grave, and he and his sons mourned over it, saying, Oh my brother, my brother.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buyi, Saimɔn Jɔn bia a yuri ma? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: A second time Jesus said to him, Simon son of John, do you love me? Yes, Lord, he answered, you know that I love you. Jesus said to him, Take care of my sheep.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa, amaa filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee.
en: Then the young men who grew up with him answered, Those people came to you and said, Your father forced us to work very hard. Now make our work easier. So you should tell them, My little finger is stronger than my fathers whole body.

dag: Ka daɣila yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni ŋun ku kari saria n-ti o ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb bɛn suhir o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam la nasara? O ku sɔŋ ba yomyom?.
en: Gods people shout to him night and day, and he will always give them what is right. He will not be slow to answer them.

dag: A mi nini bi tiɣiri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la.
en: You are not pleased with animals burned whole on the altar or with sacrifices to take away sins.

dag: O daa yɛli ba ni bɛ suhim Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu n-kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ ba pahi Babilɔn baŋdiba shɛb bɛn kpalim la zuɣu ku.
en: Then he said, Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bibil so na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni n-kpuɣ o buɣi ka yɛli ba.
en: Then he took a child and had him stand in front of them. He put his arms around him and said to them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni wuhiri ba bɛ galimi ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ ninni? Ka ŋuni n-lee yɔri ba bɛ tuma samli?.
en: Who can criticize their behavior to their faces; they act, and who can avenge them?.

dag: Ka n daa nya malaika so ka o yi alizanda ni na n-gbib bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la saafɛbia mini zoligo titali o nuu ni.
en: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding in his hand the key of the abyss and a heavy chain.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ba yina ti bɔhi ba, N duumanima, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ tiligi.
en: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, What must I do to be saved.

dag: Di saha nir yi ti tooi mali naɣisa yino mini piɛr ayi.
en: At that time someone might keep only one young cow and two sheep alive.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka chilibi buɣim yi o sani alizanda ni n-lu Sɔdom mini Gomɔra zuɣu na.
en: and the Lord began to destroy Sodom and Gomorrah. He caused fire and burning sulfur to fall from the sky.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa zab Yisa zaŋ o tahi maa na.
en: Pilate knew that the leading priests had handed Jesus over to him because they were jealous of him.

dag: bɛna n-ni tiligi. Bɛ biɛhigu shee ni ti nyɛla zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣibu shee ti nyɛ kuɣa birininim puuni, ka bɛ ti tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: He will live on the heights; fortresses in the cliffs will be his refuge. His food will be provided, his water guaranteed.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, sɔŋm ma.
en: But she knelt before him and said, Lord, help me.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim Naawuni sani, dama di sabiya: Naawuni gbahiri yɛnnim la bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina puuni.
en: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.

dag: ni suhuyiɣisili, Yisa nyaandoliba ayi maa ni daa wuhiri niriba n-yɛri ni Yisa ni neei kum ni maa zuɣu kum ni neebu beni la zuɣu.
en: They were upset because of what Peter and John were teaching the people. By telling people about Jesus, the apostles were teaching that people will rise from death.

dag: Yi ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa piligu ni ha la nyɛla ni ti yum taba.
en: This is the teaching you have heard from the beginning: We must love each other.

dag: Pagɔr bia bi simdi ni o be Yawɛ niriba ni, hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, di bi simdi ni bɛ chɛ ka o bia kpe Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No one born of an illegitimate marriage can belong to the LORDs assembly either. Not even the tenth generation of such children can belong to the LORDs assembly.

dag: O daa piila tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din viɛla n-leeg o dini; dama nimaani ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali sapashin kpɛma. O daa ka niriba maa zuɣulaannim sanna. O daa zaŋ Yawɛ fukumsi zaligunim min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim pahi la tum tuma.
en: He chose the best part for himself. He took the kings share. The leaders of the people come to him. He did what the Lord says is good. He did what is right for the Israelites.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa nya din niŋ maa, ka zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannima dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa.
en: When the men taking care of the pigs saw this, they ran to spread the news in the town and on the farms.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi pa di zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa bɛ ni ŋme binshɛŋa kɔtomsi maa zuɣu n-saɣisi taba.
en: and decorated with carved figures of winged creatures, palm trees, and flowers, which were evenly covered with gold.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ na kul tumdila alahichi pahira. Bɛ zaŋ kuriti mali binnana, ka baŋsimnim dooi anzinfa mali buɣa, ka di zaa nyɛ machɛl ni mali shɛli, ka bɛ yɛri niriba, Malimiya buɣa ŋɔ. Ka ninsalinim jɛmdi naɣibihi.
en: Now the Israelites sin more and more. They make idols for themselves. Workers make those fancy statues from silver, and then they talk to their statues. They offer sacrifices to them, and they kiss those calf idols.

dag: Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ni ti no n-gili yi solɔri zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi niriba, ka daai yi daantali kara la luhi tiŋa.
en: Their cavalry will storm through your streets, killing your people with their swords. Your mighty pillars will be thrown to the ground.

dag: Ka Judas daa bɔh o, N Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka a ni kahig amaŋ wuhi ti, ka ku kahig amaŋ wuhi dunianim bɛna.
en: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world.

dag: A yi yɛn goog o, di ŋmanila pɔhim ka a yɛn gooi bee kpa kom ka a yɛn zaŋ kpib a nudirigu ni.
en: Stopping her is like trying to stop the wind or trying to hold oil in your hand.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ matarika n-kuri salima chɛrubinim ayi tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: He made two winged heavenly creatures of hammered gold for the two ends of the cover.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: when your ancestors tested me and scrutinized me, even though they had already seen my acts.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nia ka di waɣa? Ka pumpɔŋɔ n chɛ ka di niŋ pali. N daa ti a yiko ka a wurim bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa, ka di leei dabari.
en: Have you never heard that I planned all this long ago? And now I have carried it out. I gave you the power to turn fortified cities into piles of rubble.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ti ku lan tum tuumbiɛri, bɛ mi ti ku ŋma ʒiri, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa mi ti ku be bɛ noya ni. Di saha bɛ ni ti di ka dɔni, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: The survivors of Israel will not do bad things or tell lies. They will not try to trick people with lies. They will be like sheep that eat and lie down in peace—and no one will bother them.

dag: Ka yɛdaniŋdib bɛn daa be Bɛria daa dii chɛ ka Pool chaŋ teeku noli, amaa ka Silas mini Timoti bɛn daa kpalim nimaani.
en: So the believers immediately sent Paul away to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum buyi.
en: Jesus replied, This very night before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa deei baptaizibu, ka Yisa gba daa deei baptaizibu ka suhiri Naawuni; di saha maa ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi.
en: While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up.

dag: Naawuni yila Tɛman na. Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yila Paran Zoli zuɣu na. Ka o jilima pili zuɣusaa. Ka o paɣibu pali dunia zaa.
en: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kana ti teei gili yi fɔntinsi zaa hal ka yi goon wɔɣila shɛŋa din gili ya, ka yi niŋ li naani ŋɔ ti lu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Bɛ ni ti teei gili ya yi fɔntinsi zaa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni.
en: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma ni deei bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa maa. Naawuni ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa bahi teeku ni, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim ka di di n-lu n-dahim.
en: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.

dag: Lala ka bɛ yɛn ku yi gba m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni la zuɣu.
en: But you, you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and you will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

dag: ka so ku baŋ ni a lɔri noli naɣila a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: so that others cannot know that you are fasting—only your Father, who is unseen, will know. And your Father, who sees what you do in private, will reward you.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛl o paɣa, Yiɣisima n-taɣ a biɛhigu ka so ku baŋ ni a nyɛla Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa n-chaŋ Shilo Anabi Ahija ni be luɣ shɛl la. Nyama, Anabi Ahija ŋun daa yɛli ma ni n ni leei Izraɛlnim naa la be nimaani.
en: Jeroboam said to his wife, Please go with a disguise so no one will recognize you as Jeroboams wife. Go to Shiloh where the prophet Ahijah is. He told me I would be king of this people.

dag: Yurilim bi mali dimaŋ kuuna bee n-ʒiɛmdi so. Yurilim bi zabiri dimaŋ yubu zuɣu; di bi mali suhuyiɣisili; di mi bi zaŋdi yɛla niŋdi suhu ni.
en: it isnt rude, it doesnt seek its own advantage, it isnt irritable, it doesnt keep a record of complaints.

dag: Ka pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yili dunɔdali yaɣ yini polo wɔɣilim ti pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di ti mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: There should be twenty-two and a half feet of drapes on one side with three posts and three bases for them.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim, ka o daa ku o gba.
en: The LORD considered what he did as wrong and put him to death too.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat daa tim o tumtumda na m-pahi bunu ni o zilin yini maa. O daa sabila gbaŋ din bi kpabi ka o gbibi li o nuu ni na.
en: Finally, Sanballat sent an official to me with an unsealed letter.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi zaŋ din buɣisiri maa m-buɣisi nuzaa polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He measured the north side. It was cubits long.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu maa mini alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmanila taba. Di zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini. Maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: There is one regulation that applies to both the sin offering and the repayment offering: the meat belongs to the priest who offers the sacrifice.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o mi zuɣu nyɛ Shamma Agee ŋun daa nyɛ Hara nir la bia. Filistianim daa ti laɣim tab lo tɔb Lɛhi luɣ shɛli tuya balibu pam ni daa be la, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa.
en: The third of the famous three was Shammah son of Agee from Harar. The Philistines had gathered at Lehi, where there was a field of peas. The Israelites fled from the Philistines.

dag: Bɛzai daŋ — kɔbisita ni pisinaata.
en: the descendants of Bezai:.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa chɛ Pita niŋ duu, amaa ka cheechi daa kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo o zuɣu.
en: So Peter was kept in jail, but the people of the church were praying earnestly to God for him.

dag: Amaa n ŋmanila zunzuli, ka pa ni ninsala; ka n tab ʒiɛm ma, ka niriba maani ma ansarisi!.
en: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa lan yɛli, Wummiya sariakarita bilikɔɣindan maa ni daa yɛli shɛm.
en: The Lord said, Listen, there is meaning in what the bad judge said.

dag: Dama Naawuni nina kul gɔrimi gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam ni o kpaŋsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani suhuri. A tum jɛrilim dimbɔŋɔ puuni, dama pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, a kul yɛn bela tɔb tuhibu ni.
en: because the LORDs eyes scan the whole world to strengthen those who are committed to him with all their hearts. Your foolishness means that you will have war on your hands from now on.

dag: Di sabi Yisa maa yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Kuɣ shɛli yinim tammɛriba ŋɔ ni daa zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: Jesus is the stone that you builders thought was not important. But this stone has become the cornerstone. Psalm :.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔhimi, Pa Yisifu bia Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti ni mi so ba min o ma la m-bala? Ka di chaŋ wula ka o ti yɛli ni o yila alizanda ni na.
en: They asked, Isnt this Jesus, Josephs son, whose mother and father we know? How can he now say, I have come down from heaven.

dag: N kpɛla yɔɣu kaman piɛ so ŋun bɔrigi la. Bom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ shee, dama m bi tam a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.

dag: Ti mabi shɛb ni daa ti paana nti yɛl a ni doli yɛlimaŋli shɛm min a ni shiri kul be yɛlimaŋli maa ni sahakam shɛm, di daa niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam.
en: I was so happy when some Christians arrived and told me how faithful you are to the truth—just as you always live in the truth.

dag: Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla tiŋŋmara ni ninvuɣ tuɣinda Yɛhudianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka lan nyɛ bɛ ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb Nazarinim la adiini soli toondana.
en: This man has been found to be a real pest and troublemaker for our people all over the world. He is also a leader of a group called Nazarenes.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa deei pipia maa Yawɛ nuu ni n-chɛ ka o ni daa tim ma zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa nyu li.
en: So I took the cup of wine from the Lord s hand. I went to those nations and I made them drink from the cup.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Sokam zaŋm o takɔbi nyaɣ o luɣili zuɣu n-chaŋ gili sansani ŋɔ ni zaa n-kpe suɣili kam puuni, ka sokam ti ku o mabia ni o mini ŋun doli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee. .
en: and he said to them, The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gba, ti ku saɣim tin shɛli a ni yɛri maa.
en: The angel said to Lot, Very well, Ill let you do that. I will not destroy that town.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛtali yi suhuri ni ka tiligi. Nia biɛri maa kul yɛn bela yi ni sahakam?.
en: Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart, so that you may be saved. How long will you go on thinking sinful thoughts?.

dag: Bɛ ni kɔhiri nin shɛli zaa nakɔhi duu, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya.
en: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.

dag: Di saha Napaɣ Vashiti gba daa laɣimla paɣiba na, ka bɛ ti be nayili maa puhiri bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu maa.
en: Queen Vashti also gave a party for the women in the kings palace.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa wuhi ma nyɛvili kom mɔɣili, ka di zɔri yiri Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la gbin na n-doya nyaɣisiri kaman diɣi la.
en: Then the angel showed me the river of life-giving water, shining like crystal, flowing from the throne of God and the Lamb.

dag: Ka n daa ti yɛli piɛri maa, N ku lan nyɛ yi gula. Yi ni bɛn yɛn kpi, kpima; ka bɛn yɛn bahi yoli, bahi yoli; ka chɛ bɛn kpalim ka bɛ ŋmaligi ŋub taba.
en: Then I said, I wont shepherd you. Let the dying die, and let what is to be removed be removed. Let those who are left devour the flesh of their neighbor.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dɛbɔra mini Barak Abinɔam bia la daa yili yilli ŋɔ:.
en: After the battle was over that day, Deborah and Barak sang this song:.

dag: Mbaye Sidɔn, a di vi, dama teeku birini yɛliya, N na ʒi n-wolisi bee n-dɔɣi. M mi na ʒi n-wumsi nachimpola bee paɣipiɛlisi.
en: Sidon, you should be very sad, because now the Sea and the Fort of the Sea say, I have no children. I have never felt the pain of birth; I have never given birth to children. I have never raised young men and women.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa tim tuumba nti yɛli Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl Naa Jɛhu yaaŋa la, Kamina ka ti ti zaŋ ti gbɛri kpa taba.
en: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: Come out and face me in battle.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni maligumaaniba bɛn daa deeri zaka niriba san la daa nyɛla bɛn kpira, amaa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun gba daa deeri zaka la, ŋun daa nyɛla ŋun kul be nyɛvili ni kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: In the case of the priests the tenth is collected by men who die; but as for Melchizedek the tenth was collected by one who lives, as the scripture says.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut yidan ma Naomi daa ti yɛl o, Di simdi ni m bo soli n-sɔŋ a ka a nya doo kuli, ka di chɛ ka a gba mal a dintoli biɛhigu shee.
en: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, My daughter, shouldnt I seek security for you, so that things might go well for you?.

dag: Suhuyiɣisilinim tahirila zabili na, amaa bɛn suhuri bi yiɣisiri yomyom goorila zabili.
en: Hot tempers cause arguments, but patience brings peace.

dag: Amaa baŋmiya ni Yawɛ m-pii wuntizɔra ti omaŋa; ka n yi bol o, ŋun Yawɛ wumdi m boligu.
en: Remember that the Lord has chosen the righteous for his own, and he hears me when I call to him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligu ti ba, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka n ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: No, this is the covenant that I will make with the people of Israel after that time, declares the LORD. I will put my Instructions within them and engrave them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka niriba daa tahi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu zaa Yisa sanna.
en: That evening after sunset, all who were sick or had demons in them were brought to Jesus.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ka tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ jilima. Ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib bɛ ni po pɔ shɛŋa, hal di yi ni ti ba wahala shɛlikam.
en: someone who despises those who act wickedly, but who honors those who honor the LORD; someone who keeps their promise even when it hurts.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, dindali maa yuŋ niriba ayi ni ti do bindo yini zuɣu, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: On that night, I tell you, there will be two people sleeping in the same bed: one will be taken away, the other will be left behind.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Ŋun daa zo o nambɔɣu la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A gba cham ti niŋmi lala.
en: The teacher of the Law answered, The one who was kind to him. Jesus replied, You go, then, and do the same.

dag: Ka Paɣ maa yi ʒinila bindoo zuɣu bee binshɛlikam zuɣu, ka dilan shihi li, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whenever anyone touches something—whether it was on the bed or where she has been sitting—they will be unclean until evening.

dag: Yisa ʒim zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim. Dina n-nyɛ alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka di mi nyɛla o daanfaan shɛli din galisi.
en: In Christ we are made free by his blood sacrifice. We have forgiveness of sins because of Gods rich grace.

dag: Kɔnyuri gbaai biliɛɣu hal ka o lɔŋni ti kuui zaa. Bihi suhiri bindirigu, amaa ka so bi tiri ba shɛli.
en: The babys tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth, thirsty. Children ask for bread, beg for it—but there is no bread.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ Yisifu yiŋ tumtumda maa sani yili maa dunol ni.
en: So the brothers went to the servant in charge of Josephs house.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa ti ka Yisa sanna nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti mini Farisiinim lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: Then the followers of John came to Jesus and said, We and the Pharisees fast often, but your followers dont ever fast. Why.

dag: Dama yi yi zaɣisi ka zaŋ yimaŋa n-tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni ŋɔ, ka kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi n-niŋdi yi paɣiba ka bɛ gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi n-niŋdi bɛ paɣiba.
en: Never stop following him. Dont become friends with those people who did not leave when you took the land. They are not part of Israel. Dont marry any of their people. If you become friends with those people.

dag: Bɛnkam chaŋ o sani bi lan labina bee n-lan nya nyɛvili soli.
en: No one who visits her ever comes back. He never returns to the road to life.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa taɣ omaŋ biɛhigu, ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ niriba ayi pa omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ paɣ maa sani yuŋ, ka o ti yɛl o, Vihim nya n-ti ma, ka chɛ ka n ni yɛn boli ninvuɣ so yuli ŋɔ shia yina.
en: So Saul disguised himself, dressing in different clothes. Then he and two men set out, going to the woman at nighttime. Please call up a ghost for me! Bring me the one I specify, Saul said.

dag: ka Ɛnɔsh nyɛ Kɛnan ba, ka Kɛnan nyɛ Mahalalɛl ba, ka Mahalalɛl nyɛ Jafɛt ba;.
en: Kenan the father of Mahalalel, Mahalalel the father of Jared.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti ŋmanila tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima o niriba bɛn tiligi sani.
en: On that day, the LORD of heavenly forces will be a splendid garland and a beautiful wreath for the people who survive.

dag: ka gbaan o tooni, di yi pa lala, o suhu ni yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka yi bahi yoli soli ni, dama o suhu yiɣisiri yomyom. Bɛnkam zaa sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: kiss his feet or else he will become angry, and your way will be destroyed because his anger ignites in an instant. But all who take refuge in the LORD are truly happy!.

dag: Bɛ ni mɔɣisi sapaɣ lɔɣu; gariŋga zilinli ni ku ba.
en: What the evil people swallow is like poison; it kills them like the bite of a deadly snake.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira zaa ni ti gbani n-jɛm o; bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni ni ti gban o tooni, ka n ti beni sahakam.
en: The people have eaten all they wanted and bowed down to worship him. Yes, everyone will bow down to him— all who are on the way to the grave, unable to hold on to life.

dag: Musa ni daa wum li, o daa teemi dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: When Moses heard this, he bowed his face to the ground to show he was not being proud.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be samban ni, o ni ku ma sol ni.
en: A person who is lazy and wants to stay home says, There is a lion outside, and I might be killed in the streets.

dag: Chɛ ka o be kaman saa ŋun miri bahiri bindira zuɣu la, ka chɛ ka o be kaman sakurili ŋun maari tiŋgbani la.
en: May the king be like rain on the fields, like showers falling on the land.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ni ti ŋmanila buɣim; ka Yisifu zuliya mi ŋmani buɣimniɛm. Iso zuliya ni ti ŋmanila kaɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ buɣim nyo ka di di zaa; ka Iso zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ yino gba ku tiligi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau straw; they will burn them up completely, and there will be no one left of the house of Esau, for the LORD has spoken.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika ŋɔ niŋla bɛn guni kɔŋko ni bee o daa niŋ li niŋ bɛn bi guni gba ni? Ti pun yɛli ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani la o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka mɔɣu ni damda. Yawɛ chɛ ka Kadɛshi mɔɣu ni dam.
en: His voice makes the desert shake; he shakes the desert of Kadesh.

dag: Ka daa kari alizin biɛri pam niriba zuɣu bahi, ka zaŋ kpam ʒe barinim pam gbiɛri n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: They drove out many demons, and rubbed olive oil on many sick people and healed them.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi bi lan mali suhupiɛlli kaman yi ni daa pun mali shɛm la? N din ya shɛhira ni di yi di daa naan nani, yi daa naan kpaɣi yimaŋmaŋ nina ti ma.
en: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛn Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani maa ni daa tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Manasseh did what the Lord said was wrong. He did the terrible things the other nations did.

dag: Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni bela yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ya yɛlimaŋli zaa soli; dama o bi ti yɛn yɛli shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa o ni wum shɛlikam, dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ yɛli, ka ni ti wuhi ya binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ.
en: However, when the Spirit of Truth comes, he will guide you in all truth. He wont speak on his own, but will say whatever he hears and will proclaim to you what is to come.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Nyama, n zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, I now make you governor over all of Egypt.

dag: Ka Maata tizo so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la daa chaŋ ti ʒini Yisa tooni wumd o yɛtɔɣa;.
en: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lords feet and listened to his message.

dag: Ka o daa ʒini ka boli bɛ pinaayi maa na ti yɛli ba, Ŋun bɔri ni o gari sokam zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei bia sokam zaa sani, ka zaŋ omaŋ leei sokam zaa dabili.
en: Jesus sat down, called the twelve disciples, and said to them, Whoever wants to be first must place himself last of all and be the servant of all.

dag: Ka kokpɛɣu din galisi pam maa daa kul kpɛri pahiri hal ti paai biɛɣu pihinahi, ka kom maa kul zoori pahira, ka kpuɣi ŋariŋ maa zuɣusaa, ka di du ka chɛ tiŋgbani.
en: The flood continued for forty days, and the water became deep enough for the boat to float.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni so ti ku yɛli ni o biɛra. Ka Naawuni ni ti chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani daalahichi zaa taali.
en: And no inhabitant will say, Im sick. The people living there will be forgiven their sin.

dag: M puhiri Traifɛna mini Traifɔsa bɛn nyɛ ti Duuma tumtumdiba la. M puhiri Pɛrisis n ni yuri so ka o nyɛ ŋun tum tuma pam ti Duuma ni la.
en: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.

dag: ka lan pii din bi ŋmani shɛli, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li ka tɛhi ni di pa shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni la, ni o zaŋ li chɛ ka binshɛŋa din beni niŋ yoli.
en: And God chose what the world thinks is not important—what the world hates and thinks is nothing. He chose these to destroy what the world thinks is important.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ, ka nyɛ n ni mali so nyuri bara. Nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha, dunia luɣilikam niriba ni ti ka a sanna ti yɛli, Ti yaannim daa bi di binshɛli fali n-naɣ pahila ʒiri mini binyoya din ka buchi.
en: LORD, you are my strength and my stronghold; you are my refuge in time of trouble. The nations will flock to you from the ends of the earth, and they will say: Our ancestors have inherited utter lies, things that are hollow and useless.

dag: O daa niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ naani, ka so daa ka Juda nanim zaa ni bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman o.
en: Hezekiah trusted the Lord God of Israel. No other king of Judah was like Hezekiah, either before or after him.

dag: Ka n daa nya litaafi shɛli ka di be ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni, ka sabbu be di puuni mini di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ bintabinda ayopɔin n-dihi tabili di noli.
en: I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one who sits on the throne; it was covered with writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.

dag: Ka Ɛliab mi zuliya daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛl mini Datan ni Abiram. Datan mini Abiram daa nyɛla niriba ni daa pii shɛba. Bɛna n-daa pahi Kɔra min o nyaaŋa zuɣu n-taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka yɛli Musa mini Aduna finafina.
en: Eliab had three sons—Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. Remember, Dathan and Abiram were the two leaders who turned against Moses and Aaron. They followed Korah when Korah turned against the Lord .

dag: Naa maa ni daa garigi yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Man Naa n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri gomna Rɛhum mini yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmara Shimshai ni yi tab bɛn kpalim be Samaria zaŋ tabili bɛn zaa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polɔnima.
en: The king sent this answer: Greetings to Rehum the royal deputy and Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their colleagues who live in Samaria and elsewhere in the province Beyond the River.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti sa Ashɛra tia baɣili yi ni ti yɛn me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbin shɛl la.
en: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.

dag: Jɛra noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-saɣindi ba, ka bɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛ zana din gbahiri bɛmaŋmaŋa.
en: Fools hurt themselves when they speak. Their own words trap them.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi ti nya zahimbu balibu kam, yin maliya suhupiɛlli di puuni.
en: My brothers and sisters, think of the various tests you encounter as occasions for joy.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Man bi mi bee m-baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Ka zo n-yi nti ʒe dunol ni, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: But he denied it, saying, I dont know what youre talking about. I dont understand what youre saying. And he went outside into the outer courtyard. A rooster crowed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋdi anzinfa pari sania zuɣu zahindi li, ka zaŋdi bɛ kola ni salima pahiri tiri machɛlinim ka bɛ maani wuna tiri ba, ka bɛ damdiri tiŋ jɛmdi li!.
en: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti paɣ Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni. O ma ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn paɣ la yuli n-daa booni Naama. Ka o bia Abijam daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: When Rehoboam died, he was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His mothers name was Naamah from Ammon. His son Abijam succeeded him as king.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu pahi yi Naawuni sizuura lubu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi yurilim mi pahi yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: concern for others, and love.

dag: Na so ŋun doli zaligu soli, o tiŋ ni mali suhudoo, amaa na so ŋun yu liɣiri pam ni wurim o tiŋa.
en: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ, ka yi na kul zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka kul kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma.
en: If you still refuse to listen to me, and if you still turn against me.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale zim pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa, ka tulaale zim shɛli daa kani n-viɛl paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Naa Sulemaana maa.
en: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, a large amount of jewels, and the best spices anyone had ever seen.

dag: Zaligu lola paɣa tabil o yidana hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, amaa o yidan maa yi ti kpi, o nya yolisim din ni tooi kuli do so o suhu ni bɔra; di mi simdi ni o kul la ŋun doli ti Duuma.
en: A married woman is not free as long as her husband lives; but if her husband dies, then she is free to be married to any man she wishes, but only if he is a Christian.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Taai polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti kuri niriba a puuni, ka bɛn dɛhi dansi la ŋuhira, ka bɛ ti daag a luhi, a lubu damli ni ti sɔhigi tin shɛŋa din ʒe teeku duli.
en: The Sovereign Lord has this to say to the city of Tyre: When you are being conquered, the people who live along the coast will be terrified at the screams of those who are slaughtered.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni shɛb nyɛla bɛn doli yɛŋkiŋkabina soli n-kpɛri yiya ni ti liriti paɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhimbu bi to, ka lan nyɛ bɛn daalahichi taali muɣisiri ba ka kɔre balibu kam mali ba niŋdi di yubu la.
en: Some will slither into households and control immature women who are burdened with sins and driven by all kinds of desires.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinima n-yɛn tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni tuma ka bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi ʒi bɛ zuɣu. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ li yi ʒiɛmani kam ni. Lɛvinim mi ku pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu su tiŋgbani palo.
en: The Levites will perform the service of the meeting tent, and they will be responsible for their own sins. This is a permanent regulation for all time. But they will not inherit land among the Israelites.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yuŋ ŋɔ yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Jesus told the followers, Tonight you will all lose your faith in me. The Scriptures say, I will kill the shepherd, and the sheep will run away. Zechariah :.

dag: N ni lan chɛ ka a zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ m mini n saawaranim maa ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun jɛmbu duu be Jɛrusalɛm maa ka di nyɛ ti suhuyubu pina la m-mali chaŋ.
en: I and my advisors are giving gold and silver to the God of Israel, who lives in Jerusalem. You must take this gold and silver with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ba ka bɛ doli tipawumli soya n-tumdi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni yu shɛm.
en: So I let them go their stubborn ways and do whatever they wanted.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o Bia maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: A nyɛla Naawuni, a nam ʒiishee kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Wuntia jaaŋgbee n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni a nam fukumsi tam la wuntia zuɣu.
en: But God says about his Son, You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina, ka Pool balim niriba maa zaa ni bɛ dim bindirigu ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ pahirila biɛɣ pinaanahi ka nandahima mali ya ka yi bi di bindirigu.
en: Just before daybreak, Paul urged everyone to eat. He said, This is the fourteenth day youve lived in suspense, and youve not had even a bite to eat.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni yi nya suhudoo n zuɣu. Yi ni nya nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! M pun nyaŋ dunia.
en: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-labi yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni, ka yi yaannim gba daa bi mi li, ka yi ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa nimaani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, dama n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. .
en: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.

dag: N ni ŋuhiri pampam zuɣu, n kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: I groan aloud; I am nothing but skin and bones.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiya ni o tɔɣisi zab omaŋ zuɣu. O zaniya ni o kari o niriba saria.
en: Look, the Lord is standing to judge his people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahim a la ni ka a sanna. Bɛ ni kana ti damdi tiŋ lu a sizuura. Bɛnkam zaa daa ʒiɛm a la ni kana ti jɛm a. Bɛ bol a Yawɛ tiŋa; ka lan bol a Ziɔn din nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la tin titali.
en: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, You are Zion, the city of the Lord , the holy One of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me.

dag: Di wɔɣilim din ti yɛn kpalim dolisi luɣ kasi shee la ni ti nyɛla kilomita anu wulimpuhili polo, ka nyɛ kilomita anu wulinluhili polo. Di ni ti do m-baɣila luɣ kasi shee. Di ni atam ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bindirigu.
en: The remaining area alongside the holy portion is . miles on the east and . miles on the west. These areas that adjoin the holy portion will produce the food for the citys workers.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti kuhi bahi Jɔab ha bɔh o, Ti kul yɛn zaŋla takɔbiri ŋɔ n-kuri tab hal ni saha din ka bahigu? A bi mi ni di bahigu ti yɛn nyɛla dimdi din ku naai? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn yɛl a niriba maa ka bɛ chɛ bɛ mabihi ŋɔ kari doli.
en: Abner yelled down to Joab, Must the sword keep killing forever? Dont you realize that this will end bitterly? How long before you order the troops to stop chasing their brothers.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛla mal a dabiɛm; sɔhigima, kul di chɛ ka binshɛli be a ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Tell the heavens to tremble with fear!.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi, ka ŋunkam ti tum tuma dindali, bɛn kum o.
en: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord , as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa kpi, bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi shɛba bɛ kpiɔŋ saha.
en: He killed the first-born sons of all the families of Egypt.

dag: Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛsi bia Dauda daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ ni duhi ninvuɣ so, Yaakubu Naawuni ni pii ninvuɣ so ka o ŋma yil nyaɣisa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are Davids last words: This is the declaration of Jesses son David, the declaration of a man raised high, a man anointed by the God of Jacob, a man favored by the strong one of Israel.

dag: Ka so daa kani n-ni fa ba bahi, dama bɛ ya maa mini Sidɔn daa wɔɣ pam. Ka bɛ mi mini so daa ka jina ni taba. Bɛ tiŋ maa daa bela Bɛtirɛhɔb vinvamli ni. Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa lab mali tiŋ maa me n-ʒini.
en: No one was there to rescue them because the city was far away from Sidon and had no dealings with anyone else. It was in the Beth-rehob Valley. They rebuilt the city and settled in it.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni ti ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.

dag: M bolila nuzaa polo ninvuɣ so ka o kana. O yila wulimpuhili polo na ka nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi ma. O ni du n-tam nanim zuɣu n-no ba kaman tandi la bee kaman yaɣimɛr ni nɔri yaɣiri shɛm la.
en: I woke up one from the north and he came; from the east, one who calls my name. He tramples governors like mud, as a potter treads clay.

dag: M bolila nuzaa polo ninvuɣ so ka o kana. O yila wulimpuhili polo na ka nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi ma. O ni du n-tam nanim zuɣu n-no ba kaman tandi la bee kaman yaɣimɛr ni nɔri yaɣiri shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord , appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Naawuni ni, ka ku tam Naawuni tuma yɛla, ka kul dol o zaligunima.
en: to put their hope in God— never forgetting Gods deeds, but keeping Gods commandments.

dag: Dunɔguliba maa daa ʒiɛla luɣ anahi zuɣu, wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa ni nudirigu polo.
en: There were gates on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.

dag: Din pahi, o daa lan me fɔntinsi zali Juda zoya ni, ka daa lan me yiya mini du wɔɣila n-zali yɔɣu puuni, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: In the mountains of Judah he built cities, and in the forests he built forts and towers.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yihi biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: and present the following parts as a food offering to the Lord : all the fat on the internal organs.

dag: Ka m mali biɛhigu shee nimaani ni n zaŋ Yawɛ daalikauli ni be Adaka shɛl ni la zali. O ni daa yihi ti yaannim Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka o daa lo ba alikauli maa.
en: I've also made a place in the temple for the sacred chest. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he led them out of Egypt.

dag: Amaa yinim ta li daɣiri yi ni yɛli ni ti Duuma bindirigu shee bi be nyam, ka di bindirigu maa nyɛ bɛ ni ni tooi ʒiɛm shɛl la zuɣu.
en: But you make my name impure when you say, The table of the LORD is polluted. Its fruit, its food, is despised.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; dabili mi bi garit o duuma.
en: Disciples arent greater than their teacher, and slaves arent greater than their master.

dag: Dama nir tibiginsim bi yirila wulimpuhili polo na bee wulinluhili polo na; ka di mi bi yirila mɔɣu ni na.
en: Because what exalts someone doesnt come from the east or west; its not from the south either.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa nam ya yi manim puya ni; n ni sɔŋ ya. N dabili Yaakubu zuliya, Jɛshurun ŋun nyɛ n ni pun pii so ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun daa lo ti nyɛvili shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni alikauli la yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.

dag: Lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali. Malaikanim ni ti kana nti gahim ninvuɣ suma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Thats the way it will be at the end of the present age. The angels will go out and separate the evil people from the righteous people.

dag: N ni puh a salo laɣiŋgu ni; n shiri ni paɣ a salo ni.
en: Then I will thank you in the assembly of your people; I will praise you before them all.

dag: Yi lan wum ka di pun sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a yi a pɔri nyaaŋa, amaa niŋmila a ni pɔ pɔri ni a niŋ shɛli maa ti ti Duuma.
