en: You have heard that it was said to our people long ago, When you make a vow, you must not break your promise. Keep the vows that you make to the Lord.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Balaam, Labimi ti zaŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm yɛli Balak.
en: The LORD gave Balaam something to say, and said to him, Return to Balak and say this.

dag: Naawuni kukoli daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ o lo alikauli yɛli, N ku lan chɛ ka tiŋgbani kɔŋko dam, amaa n ni lan chɛ ka zuɣusaa gba dam.
en: His voice shook the earth at that time, but now he has promised, I will once more shake not only the earth but heaven as well.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: Anyone who is not for me is really against me; anyone who does not help me gather is really scattering.

dag: Amaa yinim birigimi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ soli, ka yi wuhibu chɛ ka niriba pam tuui, yi saɣim n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛli maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you priests stopped following me! You used the teachings to make people do wrong. You ruined the agreement with Levi. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul dari gindila luɣ shɛlikam, ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu kul be daadamnim biɛhigu ni.
en: The wicked roam all over the place, while depravity is praised by human beings.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, N ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni n ti karila saria ka di chɛ ka bɛn bi nyari nya, ka bɛn nyari mi leei zoomba.
en: Jesus told him, I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim ni ti fabili. Daŋ kam puuni niriba ni ti fabili kɔŋkɔba. Dauda daŋ puuni niriba dɔbba ti yɛn bela bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda. Ka Neetan daŋ puuni niriba dɔbba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: The land will mourn, each of the clans by itself: the clan of Davids house by themselves, and their women by themselves; the clan of Nathans house by themselves, and their women by themselves.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, nyama, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni chɛ ka tinsi pam kana ti lir a kaman teeku ni chɛ ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri shɛm la.
en: Now then, this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: I am your enemy, city of Tyre. I will bring many nations to attack you, and they will come like the waves of the sea.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn kpalim la daa pah o zuɣu n-dol o bilikɔnsi soli maa hal ka Baanabas gba daa birigi pahi bɛ zuɣu n-doli bɛ bilikɔnsi soli maa.
en: So Peter was a hypocrite. The other Jewish believers joined with him, so they were hypocrites too. Even Barnabas was influenced by what these Jewish believers did.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sabi luɣ shɛli polo shɛm la: Nyin gɔgbihira, yiɣisima n-neei kum ni! Ka Masia ti a neesim.
en: Yes, everything is made clear by the light. This is why we say, Wake up, you who are sleeping! Rise from death, and Christ will shine on you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig anu saha ka o daa lan chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb lan ʒiya ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ʒi kpe yoli biɛɣu zaa.
en: Around five in the afternoon he went and found others standing around, and he said to them, Why are you just standing around here doing nothing all day long.

dag: A ni daa ku Sool so min o yiŋnim shɛba, ka di nam zan o zaani la biɛri ka Yawɛ bɔhir a, ka fa a nam maa ti a bia Absalom maa. Nyama a bahila yoli maa, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ kura.
en: The LORD has paid you back for all the blood of Sauls family, in whose place you rule, and the LORD has handed the kingdom over to your son Absalom. You are in this trouble because you are a murderer.

dag: Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: The people were amazed and said, What kind of person is this? Even the winds and the lake obey him.

dag: Tiŋgbani damdila bɛ tooni; ka sagbana sɔhira. Ka wuntaŋ mini goli niŋ zim, ka saŋmarisi gba bi lan ne.
en: The earth quakes before them; the heavens shake. The sun and the moon are darkened; the stars have stopped shining.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim ya ka yi ŋmaligi doli wuna jɛmdi li, dama di saha.
en: But watch yourselves! Otherwise, your heart might be led astray so you stray away, serving other gods and worshipping them.

dag: N daanfaani so salima, hal salima alali gba. Ka n ni tiri niriba binshɛli gari anzinfa viɛlli.
en: What I give is better than fine gold. What I produce is better than pure silver.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kaman bɛ zuliya maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm, bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannima ka be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The men named above were heads of Levite families, according to their ancestral lines. They were the leaders who lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai ti gbɛbu shee n-yooi ti kpalansi nya ka ti zaa yinoyino liɣiri noli bela ti kpalansi maa noya ni, dinzuɣu ka ti ʒi li mali na.
en: On the way home, we opened our sacks and found our money in every sack. We dont know how it got there, but we brought that money with us to give it back to you. And we have brought more money to pay for the food that we want to buy this time.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ ni o kpiɔŋ; Doliya din ni chɛ ka yi kul be o sani sahakam.
en: Go to the Lord for help; and worship him continually.

dag: Ka Keenannim tintariga daa yi Sidɔn Gɛra polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Gaza zaŋ lab Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni Adima ni Zɛbɔiim zaŋ hal ti paai Lasha.
en: The land where the Canaanites lived went from Sidon down along the coast to Gerar and from Gaza as far east as Sodom and Gomorrah and from Admah and Zeboiim as far north as Laish.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ gbib niriba ŋɔ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Give me wisdom and knowledge so I can lead this people, because no one can govern this great people of yours without your help.

dag: N je yi chu shɛŋa yi ni puhiri la. M mi baɣa ka yi jɛma laɣiŋgunim ni.
en: I, the Lord , hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.

dag: Buɣim be bɛ tooni dira ka buɣim zilima be bɛ nyaaŋa polo dira, ka tiŋgbani din be bɛ tooni be kaman Idɛn puu la, amaa ka bɛ nyaaŋa polo ŋmani tiŋgban nɛli, ka binshɛli kani n-ni tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: In front of them a fire consumes; and behind them a flame burns. Land ahead of them is like Edens garden, but they leave behind them a barren wasteland; nothing escapes them.

dag: Kaman sara maligu biŋkɔbbaligu ni galisi shɛm ni kaman Jɛrusalɛm churi puhibu ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni beni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa maa ni ti pali daadambiɛligu. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: The cities that are now in ruins will then be as full of people as Jerusalem was once full of the sheep which were offered as sacrifices at a festival. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Brothers will turn against their own brothers and hand them over to be killed. Fathers will hand over their own children to be killed. Children will fight against their own parents and have them killed.

dag: Maligumaana Ɛliashib ŋun daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri fukumsi la mini Tɔbaya daa nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: The priest Eliashib, who was in charge of the Temple storerooms, had for a long time been on good terms with Tobiah.

dag: Ŋɔŋmiya kom m-mali shili gu bɛn yɛn teei gili ya. Pahimiya yi birininim yaa. Nomiya yaɣiri, nomiya tandi, ka zaŋya bilichiisi ŋmarigu niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Draw water to prepare for a siege, and strengthen your fortresses! Trample the clay to make bricks, and get the brick molds ready!.

dag: Dabisili din pahi piniyini dali, Okiran bia Pagiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Asha zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the eleventh day Ashers Chief Pagiel, Ochrans son.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ dunia zaa Duuma Daalikauli Adaka maa naba yi ti kul shihi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom, di kom maa ni chɛ zɔbu, ka di kom din zɔri yiri mɔɣili maa zuɣusaa polo n-sirigirina la mi fo n-zani n-tiɣisi dɔni luɣ yini.
en: When the priests who carry the Covenant Box of the Lord of all the earth put their feet in the water, the Jordan will stop flowing, and the water coming downstream will pile up in one place.

dag: niriba mini nanim yi ti laɣim ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ.
en: when nations and kingdoms come together and worship the Lord .

dag: A sani ka n ni paɣir a shɛm yirina a niriba laɣiŋgu tital ni; ka n ni mali n ni pun po pɔri ni m mali sara shɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura sani la.
en: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord , and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo n-chani ginda m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara.
en: When an evil spirit goes out of a person, it travels over dry country looking for a place to rest. If it can't find one.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ŋun nyɛ na titali la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la m-puhir a. Ka pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Instruction from the God of heaven. Peace! And now.

dag: Di saha maa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani yɛli Yisa Galilinim ni daa maani ʒim yihibu sara ka Gomna Pailɛt chaŋ ti ku bɛ ni shɛb la yɛla.
en: Some who were present on that occasion told Jesus about the Galileans whom Pilate had killed while they were offering sacrifices.

dag: Di piligu dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, daba ayopɔin maa dali gba, di simdi ka yi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di bi simdi ka yi tum tuma di dabisa maa ni, amaa yi ni tooi duɣi yi bindira dina.
en: Meet together for worship on the first and seventh days of the festival. The only work you are allowed to do on either of these two days is that of preparing the bread.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni ti wɔɣa, ka di nyoli chaŋ ti be sagbana ni, ka di ni mali karimbaani maa zuɣu.
en: Now then, I, the Sovereign Lord , will tell you what is going to happen to that tree that grew until it reached the clouds. As it grew taller it grew proud;.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di tuhiya ni n neei yi tɛha ka yi teeri yɛla ŋɔ, n ni na kul be n nyɛvili ni ŋɔ.
en: While I am still living here on earth, I think it is right for me to remind you of them.

dag: Ka di daa bi niŋ Ibrahimma nyaɣisim, dama o gba daa nyɛla o bia.
en: Abraham was worried about Ishmael.

dag: Nir suhu yi bɔri binshɛli ka o ka yɛm, di bi viɛla, ka nir ŋun chani yomyom ti yaɣi bahirila soli.
en: Ignorant desire isnt good; rushing feet make mistakes.

dag: Amaa m Ba ni yɛn tim Sɔŋda so ŋun nyɛ o Shia Kasi, ka o zaŋ n yuli kana la ni ti wuhi ya binshɛɣukam zaa; ka n ni daa wuhi ya shɛlikam zaa la, o ni ti teei ya li.
en: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.

dag: N yɛm maa yɛn yila katiŋ na, ka di wuhi ni ŋun nam ma nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.

dag: Wuntizɔriba pihinu yi be tiŋ maa ni, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa ka ku tiligi li wuntizɔriba pihinu bɛn be di ni maa zuɣu?.
en: What if there are fifty good people in that city? Will you still destroy it? Surely you will save the city for the fifty good people living there.

dag: Ka din niŋ ba maa wuhiya ni yɛliŋahili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ŋahili maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Baa labi dir o tiri, ka bɛ ni su kuruchu so kom mi lan ŋmaligi labi ti bilindi baɣiri ni yaha.
en: What they did is like these true sayings: A dog vomits and goes back to what it threw up. And, After a pig is washed, it goes back and rolls in the mud again.

dag: Yawɛ di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa, amaa lee saami kpan shɛli din sa o zuɣusaa ŋɔ ka kpuɣ o ko gaɣili ŋɔ ka ti chaŋ.
en: The LORD forbid that I lift my hand against the LORDs anointed! But go ahead and take the spear by Sauls head and the water jug and lets go.

dag: So daa naan ku tooi woligi suhupiɛlli tahigu vuri ka chɛ kuhigu vuri maa, dama niriba maa daa kul tahirila pampam, ka di vuri maa daa chaŋ katiŋ pam.
en: The sound could be heard far away. All of them made so much noise that no one could tell the difference between the shouts of joy and the crying.

dag: Joyakim saha la, maligumaaniba dunoya dɔɣirikpamba n-daa bɔŋɔ: Mɛraya n-daa nyɛ Sɛraya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Hanania daa nyɛ Jɛrimia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: In the days of Joiakim, these men were the leaders of the families of priests: The leader of Seraiahs family was Meraiah. The leader of Jeremiahs family was Hananiah.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa do bɛ sansana ni n-lihiri taba daba ayopɔin. Ka bɛ daa ti gbaai tab tuhibu daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Sirianim tɔbbihi bɛn chan tiŋ tuhi kɔbiga dindali maa.
en: For seven days the two armies stayed in their camps, facing each other. Then on the seventh day the fighting broke out, and before sunset the Israelites had killed , Syrian troops.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o kuhi pam yɛli, Lazarɔs, yimina.
en: After he had said this, he called out in a loud voice, Lazarus, come out.

dag: Bɛ nina ni lihibu di ba shɛhira; bɛ tum alahichi palɔni ka bi sɔɣiri li kaman Sɔdomnima. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Dama bɛ bo yɛl biɛɣu ti bɛmaŋa.
en: Their prejudices will be held against them. They sin as openly as the people of Sodom did. They are doomed, and they have brought it on themselves.

dag: Ka Sool yɛli Dauda, A ku tooi chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, dama a na nyɛla bia, ka o mi nyɛ doo ŋun pun tuhiri tɔbu o bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You don't have a chance against him, Saul replied. You're only a boy, and he's been a soldier all his life.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anahi, ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah anahi yɛli, Kamina.
en: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, Come out.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka toli mini sakɔri bɛn ka kalinli waɣi yɛrigi.
en: He commanded, and the locusts came, countless millions of them;.

dag: ka bɛ laɣimbu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbia ni o ti yɛl o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaa ni bɛ kana ni binshɛɣukam shili biya.
en: When it was time for the dinner to begin, he sent his servant to tell the invited guests, Come! The dinner is now ready.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba. Sool daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Gibia ka anab bɔbili shiri tuh o soli ka Naawuni shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na pam, ka o pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Saul and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a group of prophets met him. Suddenly the spirit of God took control of him, and he joined in their ecstatic dancing and shouting.

dag: Ti bi mali timaŋa ŋ-ŋmahindi bee m-buɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣiri bɛmaŋ la. Bɛ yi mali bɛmaŋ maɣisiri taba, ka mali bɛmaŋ buɣisiri taba, bɛ bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zaŋ a leei zuliya pam yaba. Dinzuɣu alikauli maa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa niŋ Naawuni so yɛda maa sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa din kani be.
en: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.

dag: N ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka di ti gari yi dimnim bɛn ti yɛn kana ti be di ni.
en: I will destroy your land so completely that the enemies who occupy it will be shocked at the destruction.

dag: Amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima bɛ kpaŋsibu mini bɛ saɣisibu ni bɛ suhumaabo zuɣu.
en: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala ninsal yubu bee o ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu.
en: So God will choose anyone he decides to show mercy to, and his choice does not depend on what people want or try to do.

dag: M ma, mbusim be n zuɣu a ni daa dɔɣi ma zuɣu. Tiŋ maa nim zaa kul mali ma la naŋgbankpeeni mini zabili. N na ʒi n-dihi so samli bee n-di so samli, amaa bɛ zaa kul turi ma mi.
en: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.

dag: Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ni yihi ya yi bi ʒiɛyimtali maa ni. Ti ka a sanna, dama nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: People of Israel, you are unfaithful to me, but come back to me. Come back and I will forgive you for being unfaithful. Just say, Yes, we will come back, because you are the Lord our God.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ni o suhu zaa. O daa bi chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli dolibu.
en: But Jehu was not careful to follow the law of the Lord with all his heart. Jehu did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam that caused Israel to sin.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia min o malaikanim yi ti labina o Ba Naawuni jilima ni, o ni ti ti sokam bɛ tuma laara.
en: For the Son of Man is about to come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will reward each one according to his deeds.

dag: Doo kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu;.
en: Every man who prophesies or prays with his head covered brings shame to his head.

dag: N ni fo ka yi wuhi ma. Chɛliya ka m baŋ n ni tum gala shɛli.
en: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Dauda, Nyama, Filistianim tuhirila Kɛilanima, ka fari bɛ bindira bɛ puri ni.
en: David was told, The Philistines are now attacking Keilah and looting the threshing floors.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi, Ka di chaŋ wula ka n wumdi piɛri kumsi mini niɣi ŋumbu.
en: Samuel asked, Why, then, do I hear cattle mooing and sheep bleating.

dag: Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni kpiimba bi neeri kum ni, dindina Naawuni daa bi neei Masia kum ni m-bala, ka ti gba leei bɛn ŋma ʒiri pa Naawuni, dama ti pun di Naawuni shɛhira ni o daa neei Masia kum ni.
en: And we will also be guilty of lying about God, because we have told people about him, saying that he raised Christ from death. And if no one is raised from death, then God never raised Christ from death.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tahi Ɛkurɔn. Amaa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ni daa paai Ɛkurɔn na, ka Ɛkurɔnnim daa kuhi yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la tahi ti ya ŋɔ na ni di ti ku ti mini ti niriba.
en: So the Philistines sent Gods Holy Box to Ekron. But when Gods Holy Box came into Ekron, the people of Ekron complained. They said, Why are you bringing the Box of the God of Israel to our city Ekron? Do you want to kill us and our people.

dag: N zahindi maa puuni, n daa lan nya ka kawana ayopɔin nyaɣi tam kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu n-kul ŋmɛlim baribara;.
en: I went to sleep again and saw in my dream seven full and healthy ears of grain growing on one stalk.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa yɛl o, A di amaŋ shɛhira; dinzuɣu a shɛhira maa pala shɛhira maŋli.
en: But the Pharisees said to Jesus, When you talk about yourself, you are the only one to say that these things are true. So we cannot accept what you say.

dag: Ka daɣila m piɛri maa yɛn ŋubila yi ni no mo shɛŋa sɔŋ maa, ka nyu yi ni zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli maa?.
en: My flock must eat the grass you crushed with your feet, and they must drink the water you stir with your feet.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi ni, ka Ijipti dɔr biɛ shɛŋa zaa din daa gbahiri ya la, o ku lan chɛ ka di gbahi ya. Amaa o ni chɛ ka di gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa jɛn ya.
en: The Lord will protect you from all sickness, and he will not bring on you any of the dreadful diseases that you experienced in Egypt, but he will bring them on all your enemies.

dag: Ti Duuma kpalim ŋmanila ti dima. O wurim Izraɛl; O wurim di nanim yiya la zaa, ka wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. O chɛ ka Juda bipuɣiŋga fabila min o kuhigu maan pahi.
en: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi ŋmɛnditol shɛba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: The outlaws who were crucified with him insulted him in the same way.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bidib kpɛm kam ti kpi. Firawuna bikpɛm ŋun ti yɛn di nam o kalinsi nyaaŋa gba ni kpi hal zaŋ tabili dab paɣ ŋun gba nɛli zuɣu niɛmdi bikpɛm ni kpi ni bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb zaa.
en: and every first-born son in Egypt will die, from the king's son, who is heir to the throne, to the son of the slave woman who grinds grain. The first-born of all the cattle will die also.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi pahi biŋkɔbigu ʒim zuɣu m-mali sara ti ma bee n-chɛ ka yi ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara biŋkpam zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: When you kill an animal and offer its blood as a sacrifice, you must not include anything that has yeast in it. And when you burn the fat from my sacrifice, dont let any of it remain until morning.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la Amɔrinim nanim maa nuu ni, zaŋ Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini.
en: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.

dag: O daa bi niŋ bɛ sani n-gari biɛɣ pia bee biɛr anii, ka yiɣisi lab Siizaria. N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o chaŋ ti ʒin o sariadibo ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pool na.
en: Festus stayed in Jerusalem for eight or ten more days before going to Caesarea. Then the next day he took his place as judge and had Paul brought into court.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun ka buchi ka saɣim, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu leeg o kom nyuri ŋɔ yɛla?.
en: how much less those who are abominable and corrupt, for they drink sin like water.

dag: Ka Dauda niriba maa daa yɛl o, Zuŋɔ n-nyɛ dabisi shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl a, Nyama, n zaŋ a dim niŋ a nuu ni, niŋm o a ni bɔri shɛm la. Di saha ka Dauda daa puɣisi chaŋ ti sɔɣi ŋmaai Naa Sool kparibu naŋgbambili.
en: Davids soldiers said to him, This is the day the LORD spoke of when he promised you, I will hand your enemy over to you, and you can do to him whatever you think best. So David snuck up and cut off a corner of Sauls robe.

dag: n-chani kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri ka kpamdi ba jaande ni bɛ kul gbibi yɛda, ka yɛli ba ni nir yi bɔri ni o kpe Naawuni nam ni, o ni bahi di wahala.
en: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ bi lan bɔri bindirigu, ka bɛ kɔre lan ka bindir viɛlli ni gba.
en: Those who are sick lose their appetites, and even the finest food looks revolting.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yi fa Lɔdɛba. Ka lan nyuri bara yɛri ni yi kpiɔŋ ka yi zaŋ fa Karinaim.
en: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, We did it on our own.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ la shɛŋa din kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini Juda nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Listen to what I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, say about the treasures that are left in the Temple and in the royal palace in Jerusalem:.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka so ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kpuɣi ba bee n-sɔɣi ba. Bɛ ni ti do tiŋgban ni kaman naɣ bina la.
en: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn.

dag: Pomiya pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka niŋya kaman yi ni po shɛm maa. Chɛliya ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kɔɣilikɔɣili la nim zaa zaŋ pina na ti ti ŋun nyɛ binzɔrigu maa.
en: Give the Lord your God what you promised him; bring gifts to him, all you nearby nations. God makes everyone fear him;.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N ka yidana. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A ni yɛli ni a ka yidan maa di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli;.
en: The woman answered, But I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You are right to say you have no husband.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Izraɛl tin yini ninvuɣ tuhili yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ kɔbiga n-ni ti labina. Ka tin shɛli nim mi ninvuɣ kɔbiga yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, ninvuɣ pia n-ni ti labina.
en: The Lord God has warned, From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.

dag: Ka a nuu yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi ka ti kpe buɣim din bi kpiri ni .
en: So if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed than to have two hands and be thrown into the fires of hell that never go out.

dag: Ka Akishi daa garigi yɛli Dauda, M mi ni a ka galimi shɛli kaman Naawuni malaika ni ka galimi shɛm la, amaa di zaa yoli, Filistia sapashinnim maa yɛliya ni a di dol ti chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Achish said: I believe that you're as good as an angel of God, but our army commanders have decided that you can't fight in this battle.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa min o ba malibu maa zaa, N ni chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, M ba min o malibu ni m biɛyanim bɛn be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kuli n sanna.
en: Joseph said to his brothers and to his fathers household, Let me go up and inform Pharaoh and tell him, My brothers and my fathers household who were in the land of Canaan have arrived.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: Jesus called all the followers together. He said, The non-Jewish people have men they call rulers. You know that those rulers love to show their power over the people. And their important leaders love to use all their authority over the people.

dag: Ka alizanda ni tɔbbihi ye binyɛr piɛla din piɛli ka be kasikasi m-bari wɔr piɛla dol o.
en: The armies of heaven were following the rider on the white horse. They were also riding white horses. They were dressed in fine linen, white and clean.

dag: N yi ti kuhi bol a dahin shɛli, n dimnim maa ni ŋmaligi zo. Dama m mi ni nyin Naawuni be m polo.
en: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali, bomiya yuma ayi piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi, ka bo zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam ŋmiri li m-pahi binnyura sara zuɣu.
en: On the Sabbath day: two flawless one-year-old male lambs and two-tenths of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ n-tirila Taitus ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zo a nambɔɣu ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: I write to Titus, my true son in the faith that we have in common. May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior give you grace and peace.

dag: Ɛfa ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Haran mini Mɔza ni Gazɛz, ka Haran daa nyɛ Gazɛz ba.
en: Caleb had a concubine named Ephah, and by her he had three more sons: Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran also had a son named Gazez. .

dag: Nandahima ni daa mali ma dahin shɛli, ka bɛ daa kana ti liri ma; amaa ka Yawɛ daa nyɛ ŋun guli ma.
en: They came at me on the very day of my distress, but the LORD was my support.

dag: Yim kpe n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti sɔɣi dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Leave this place and go east and hide yourself near Cherith Brook, east of the Jordan.

dag: Izraɛlnim mini Judanim Naawuni, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ bi zaɣisi ba, hal alahichi ni kul pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani maa zaa yoli.
en: God, the LORD of heavenly forces, hasnt abandoned Israel and Judah, even though they live in a land filled with guilt before the holy one of Israel.

dag: Ka n yaannim Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Ibrahimma Naawuni ka nyɛ Yisahaku ni jɛmdi so ŋɔ yi di ka n sani, biɛhiŋ kani, a naan chɛ ka n chaŋ ni nuzaŋa. Naawuni nya n wahala mini n ni tum tuun shɛŋa, ka sa kpah a zuɣu ni yuŋ maa.
en: If the God of my father—the God of Abraham and the awesome one of Isaac—hadnt been with me, youd have no doubt sent me away without anything. God saw my harsh treatment and my hard work and reprimanded you yesterday.

dag: Ka Rut daa shiri doli Bɔaz kachɛriba maa n-yihiri kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ chi maa zaa naai. Ka Rut daa kul kpalim be o yidan ma maa sani.
en: Thus she stayed with Boazs young women, gleaning until the completion of the barley and wheat harvests. And she lived with her mother-in-law.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrig o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o, amaa ni o ni lan zaŋ o labisina pumpɔŋɔ.
en: If anyone says to you, Why are you doing this? say, Its master needs it, and he will send it back right away.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, A mi ni su tins anu fukumsi.
en: The king said, You will be given five cities.

dag: N di mmaŋ shɛhira, ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba di ma shɛhira pahi.
en: I am one of the witnesses who speaks about myself. And the Father who sent me is my other witness.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa maa daa tim ni bɛ chaŋ ti boli timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni baɣisi ni Kalidianim na ka bɛ ti wuh o o zahindi maa gbinni. Ka bɛ daa kana ti ʒini naa maa tooni.
en: The king summoned the dream interpreters, enchanters, diviners, and Chaldeans to explain his dreams to him. They came and stood before the king.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn kum o.
en: You have six days in which to do your work, but the seventh day is a solemn day of rest dedicated to me. Whoever does any work on that day is to be put to death.

dag: Ŋunkam ti zɔri ni o yi dabiɛm maa ni ni ti lu bɔɣili ni. Ka ŋunkam ti yiri bɔɣili maa ni na, tɔŋ ni gbaag o. Dama Mɔabnim tibidarigibo dali, n ni ti chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim niŋ ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People will be afraid and run away, and they will fall into the deep holes. Anyone who climbs out of the deep holes will be caught in the traps. I will bring the year of punishment to Moab. This is what the Lord said.

dag: O ni daa yɛli bia maa yɛla shɛm maa daa chɛ ka di gar o ba min o ma pam.
en: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.

dag: ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa tam di zuɣu; ka Ahio daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: with Ahio walking in front of it.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔhi Gaad mini Rubin zuliya maa, Yi mabihi maa cham ti tuhi tɔbu ka yinim kpalim be kpe?.
en: Moses said to the Gadites and the Reubenites, Should your brothers go to war, while you stay here?.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?.

dag: A ni tum tuun kpɛma ka woligu yiri a ni ka a nyari bindirigu diri hal ti lab tiŋgbani maa ni, dama di ni ka a daa yina. Taŋkpaɣu n-nyɛ a, ka a ni ti lan lab taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: You will have to work hard and sweat to make the soil produce anything, until you go back to the soil from which you were formed. You were made from soil, and you will become soil again.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Duhimiya Yawɛ tuuta maa zuɣusaa, Yawɛ kul ni tuhiri Amalɛknim maa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Then Moses explained, This is because I depended on the Lord . But in future generations, the Lord will fight the Amalekites again and again.

dag: kaman Daadam Bia gba ni be shɛm la; o bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o, amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: like the Son of Man, who did not come to be served, but to serve and to give his life to redeem many people.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni di wahala pam, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani, o yurilim maŋli ni be bɛ sani.
en: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord .

dag: ka leei yi Ba, ka yi mi leei m bidibisi mini m bipuɣinsi. Ti Duuma Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-yɛl lala maa.
en: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa bi bɔri wuntaŋ bee goli ni di ne di ni, dama Naawuni jilima n-nyɛ di neesim, ka Piɛbil maa mi nyɛ di firila.
en: The city doesnt need the sun or the moon to shine on it, because Gods glory is its light, and its lamp is the Lamb.

dag: yin zaŋmiya ŋun tum lala maa niŋ Sintani nuu ni ka o niŋgbuŋ saɣim, ka di chɛ ka o shia lee ti tiligi ti Duuma Dabisili la dali.
en: Then turn this man over to Satan. His sinful self has to be destroyed so that his spirit will be saved on the day when the Lord comes again.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya Naawuni nam.
en: I assure you that there are some here who will not die until they have seen the Kingdom of God.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Nyam bɛn je ma ni chɛ ka n di wahala shɛŋa! Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yihiri ma kum ni.
en: Have mercy on me, LORD! Just look how I suffer because of those who hate me. But you are the one who brings me back from the very gates of death.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa fa Amɔrinim maa fɔntinsi zaa n-ʒini Hɛshibɔn zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: The Israelites settled in the Amorite towns, including the capital city of Heshbon with its surrounding villages.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka ti Duuma daa kana nti zani baɣili Pool yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, dama a ni niŋ n shɛhiralana Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka a ni ti niŋ n shɛhiralana Rom gba.
en: That night the Lord stood beside Paul and said, Don't worry! Just as you have told others about me in Jerusalem, you must also tell about me in Rome.

dag: Di nyɛla din chihiri ni nanim tum zaɣ biɛɣu, dama wuntitali soli ka bɛ doli zali nam.
en: Kings hate to see anyone doing wrong, because kingdoms grow strong only when everyone is honest and fair.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa yɔri maa, ka salo laɣimna nti wum ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa tɔɣisirila bɛn bɛn laɣimna maa zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu, ka di gari ba pam.
en: When they heard this noise, a large crowd gathered. They were all excited, because all of them heard the believers talking in their own languages.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama m bela muɣisigu ni. N kummi hal ka n nina ti biɛra, ka n niŋgbuŋ gba gbarigi.
en: Lord , I have many troubles, so be kind to me. I have cried until my eyes hurt. My throat and stomach are aching.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mini sapashim bihi bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi daa ka Musa sanna.
en: Then the leaders of the army came to Moses.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali zoligɔnim kaman nyiŋgokɔriti la n-zaŋ li pa daantalisi maa zuɣusaa, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi bini kɔbiga n-zaŋ li yiliyili zoligɔnim maa.
en: The tops of the columns were decorated with a design of interwoven chains and one hundred bronze pomegranates.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim ni daa tuui lu la, di wuhiri ni bɛ daa lumi zaa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Amaa bɛ biriginsim zuɣu ka tiliginsim paai bɛn pa Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zab nyuli.
en: So I ask: When the Jews fell, did that fall destroy them? No! But their mistake brought salvation to those who are not Jews. The purpose of this was to make the Jews jealous.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi ŋmaligi kpa bɛ Naawuni polo. Dama yolimyolim maa pun kpe bɛ kɔbili ni, ka bɛ bi lan mi Yawɛ.
en: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka so zali ya zaligunima zaŋ chaŋ yi ni ni di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli polo bee zaŋ chaŋ dabisi kasi shɛŋa mini gol palli chuɣu puhibu ni Vuhim Dabisili kaya dolibu polo.
en: So let no one make rules about what you eat or drink or about holy days or the New Moon Festival or the Sabbath.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa ti kurigi ka o nina niŋ liti, ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli, ka o daa bol o bituuli Iso na ti yɛl o, M bia. Ka o saɣi yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: When Isaac had grown old and his eyesight was failing, he summoned his older son Esau and said to him, My son? And Esau said, Im here.

dag: N zɔsimnim zaa zaŋ ma mi bahi, ka n ni daa yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la zaŋ ma bahi.
en: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ. Di saha ka ti daa chaŋ ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa.
en: Then we crossed the Zered River as the Lord told us to do.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni ni ti mali bindir suma. O ni ti mali bindir shɛŋa di ni simdi ni naa di.
en: Ashers land will grow much good food. He will have food fit for a king!.

dag: Chɛ ka yɛnnim gba wum li, ka nya yɛm pahi, ka leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn woligiri binyara.
en: These proverbs can even add to the knowledge of the wise and give guidance to the educated.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ dari kpe chɛrubinima, n-dooi salima pa bɛ zuɣu, ka o zaŋ ba zali luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa.
en: In the most holy place he formed two statues of winged creatures and covered them with gold.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli wuntia soli m-me o yili mini ŋun bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli m me o jirambisa, ka chɛ ka o taba tum o tuma yoli ka o bi yo ba zuɣu.
en: King Jehoiakim, you are doomed! You built a palace with large rooms upstairs.

dag: Di saha ka Musa min o sɔŋda Jɔshua daa lu soli, ka Musa daa du Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So Moses and his assistant Joshua got up, and Moses went up Gods mountain.

dag: N Naawuni, niŋm ba kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga taŋkpagbiligu la; ka niŋ ba kaman pɔhim n-ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri la.
en: Scatter them like dust, O God, like straw blown away by the wind.

dag: Ka o ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa mali ba pam.
en: Again he came and found them sleeping. Their eyes were heavy with sleep.

dag: Ka o daa tim tɔbbihi pam, ka bɛ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti teei gili tiŋ maa.
en: he sent a large force there with horses and chariots. They reached the town at night and surrounded it.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla zoomba, yi naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yɛliya ni yi nyara, dinzuɣu yi taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you wouldnt have any sin, but now that you say, We see, your sin remains.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi nam ʒiishee maa gbin na yɛra, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba, ka nyɛ Naawuni daba bɛn zɔr o ŋɔ paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: Then a voice came from the throne and said, Praise our God, all you who serve him! Praise our God, all you small and great who honor him.

dag: A bela a biɛhigu shee ka chɛ ka saa yiri zuɣusaa luri zoya zuɣu na, ka tiŋgbani diri a tuma nyɔri.
en: From your lofty house, you water the mountains. The earth is filled full by the fruit of what youve done.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, n suhir a, a nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin be ti sani ti chandi maa ni, hal ti ni kul nyɛ tipawumlinim maa zaa yoli, chɛl ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi maa taali, ka zaŋ ti leeg a niriba.
en: Lord, if you are pleased with me, please go with us. I know that these are stubborn people, but forgive us for the bad things we did. Accept us as your people.

dag: Ka ti yi nyɛla Naawuni bihi, dindina ti nyɛla o bindiriba. Ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ Naawuni bindiriba, tinim dee min o yi laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka ti min o ti laɣim nya jilima.
en: If we are Gods children, we will get the blessings God has for his people. He will give us all that he has given Christ. But we must suffer like Christ suffered. Then we will be able to share his glory.

dag: Kumiya o bihi bɛ ba taali zuɣu. Di chɛliya ka bɛ so ti yiɣisina ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ bee m-me tinsi zali dunia ŋɔ ni yaha.
en: Prepare a place to slaughter his sons for the guilt of their father. Dont let them arise to take over the earth or fill the world with cities.

dag: ka zaŋ tani n-yirigi pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka kpuɣi binshɛli din yɛn pili suɣili maa pil li kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: He spread the tent out over the dwelling, and he put the covering of the tent over it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: N daa darigi deei nam maa la Dauda daŋ ni ti a, amaa ka a ti bi be kaman n dabili Dauda ŋun daa doli n zalikpana, ka doli ma ni o suhu zaa ka tumdi din tuhi n san la.
en: I took the kingdom away from David's descendants and gave it to you. But you have not been like my servant David, who was completely loyal to me, obeyed my commands, and did only what I approve of.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni lo a alikauli; amaa bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni a niŋ, dina n-nyɛ: a yi ti yɛn kana ti nya ma nyin zaŋm Mikal Sool bipuɣiŋga la mali na, di yi pa lala a yi ti kana a ku nya n ninni.
en: Good! David replied. I will make a covenant with you, but on one condition: dont show yourself in my presence unless you bring Sauls daughter Michal when you come to see me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi zuɣu ka o daa kari ba o sani bahi.
en: The Lord became so angry with the people of Jerusalem and Judah that he banished them from his sight.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ni gbib yi mini yi bihi. Lala ka o daa lan lo ba alikauli ka kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri.
en: So dont be afraid. I will take care of you and your children. And so Joseph said kind things to his brothers, and this made them feel better.

dag: Bɛ naɣilahi kul durila viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ naɣinyama kul dɔɣira, ka na ʒi n-zaŋ bahi.
en: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;.

dag: M paɣa nyee nyɔni ma, ka m mabihi gba nyee nyɔni ma.
en: My wife hates the smell of my breath. My own brothers hate me.

dag: Amaa ka o ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaŋ li niŋ asahi, ka bɛ ni yino zaŋ kpa o puu polo, ka yino chaŋ o tuma shee.
en: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni. Yiɣisim darigi zuliya kam zaa tibili. Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino gba tiligi.
en: You are the Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Israel! Get up and punish them. Dont show any mercy to those traitors. Selah.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ya, Yi paai Amɔrinim zoya ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ti la ni.
en: I told you, You have now come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God, the God of our ancestors, is giving us. Look, there it is. Go and occupy it as he commanded. Do not hesitate or be afraid.

dag: saha shɛli Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa tuhiri Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntin shɛŋa zaa din daa kpalim ka nyɛ Lakishi mini Azɛka la, dama di kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa ka di na kpalim ʒiɛya.
en: when the army of the king of Babylon was attacking Jerusalem and all the remaining Judean towns, Lachish and Azekah—the only fortified towns still standing in Judah.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. Yilimiya yila paɣ o yuli, dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim.
en: praise the LORD, because the LORD is good! Sing praises to Gods name because it is beautiful!.

dag: Sulemaana wain tihi puu daa bela Baalihamɔn ka pukpariba daa haayi li o sani, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yɔrila anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He put men in charge of the vineyard. Each man brought in grapes worth shekels of silver.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o ti kpalim be bɛ sani nimaani m-baptaiziri niriba.
en: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku zani, di mi ku niŋ pali.
en: But I, the Lord , declare that this will never happen.

dag: Buni palila wuntizɔriba yinsi, amaa ashaara kul lurila ninvuɣ biɛri nyamma zuɣu.
en: Good people are rich in many ways, but those who are evil get nothing but trouble.

dag: ka fara lu a zuɣu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka fakari lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbia ŋun gbibi bidibbina la.
en: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔri nanima anu bɛn daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-teei gili ba.
en: When these five Amorite kings called their armies together and attacked Gibeon.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu ni ka bol o, Bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisima.
en: Jesus took hold of the girl's hand and said, Child, get up.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣ yoya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee tɔɣisi a yɛtɔɣ yoya.
en: The Lord says, You said cruel things to me. But you ask, What did we say about you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti wummi tin ya n-tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ, ka yi ti Naawuni nyaaŋa kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba maa.
en: Are we then to follow your example and disobey our God by marrying foreign women.

dag: Ka m biɛrimaŋtali tuma ni ti yi palo a yi ti kana ni a ti nya n yɔri maa dahin shɛli. Ka bu shɛb mini piɛbihi shɛb bɛn bi liɣisiliɣisi ka mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ sabila yi ti be m biŋkɔbiri ni, di wuhiya ni n zu ba mi maa.
en: In the future you can easily find out if I've been honest. Just look and see if my animals are either spotted or speckled, or if the lambs are black. If they aren't, they've been stolen from you.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But then the sun rose and the plants were burned. They died because they did not have deep roots.

dag: Chɛli ma ka n ku ba n-kpihim bɛ yuli dunia ni, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka galisi gari ba.
en: Now stand back. I am going to wipe them out. I will erase their name from under heaven, then I will make a nation out of you—one stronger and larger than they were.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ bolim o na. Ka bɛ daa bol zom maa ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma! Yiɣisima, o boon a.
en: Jesus stopped and said, Call him over! They called out to the blind man and said, Don't be afraid! Come on! He is calling for you.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, bidibiga ka a dɔɣi maa. Ka o bi garigi shɛli.
en: and she was dying. But the women taking care of her said, Don't be afraid—it's a boy! She didn't pay any attention to them.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Then King Solomon and all the Israelites with him offered sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N sara maligu dabisili maa dali, n ni ti darigi kpambaliba mini nabihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri tinduya ni binyɛra la tibili.
en: The Lord said, On the Lord s day of sacrifice, I will punish the kings sons and other leaders. I will punish all the people wearing clothes from other countries.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Hal a ni bi mi ma maa zaa yoli, n ni ti a yaa.
en: Only I am the Lord ! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.

dag: Bɛnkam mali ba mini bɛnkam niŋ ba naani ni be kaman bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa maa.
en: May all who made them and who trust in them become like the idols they have made!.

dag: Tun dunia piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ so na ʒi n-wum ni so neei zoondɔɣirili nina.
en: No one has ever heard of a healing of the eyes of someone born blind.

dag: ka lan mi o yubu, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa, ka di nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuh a lala zuɣu.
en: if you know the will of God; if you are taught by the Law so that you can figure out the things that really matter.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niɣi maa na ti ti Yisifu, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ yuri mini piɛri ni buhi ni bunsi. Ka o daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ niɣi zaa di yuuni maa puuni.
en: From then on, they brought him their horses and donkeys and their sheep and goats in exchange for grain. Within a year Joseph had collected every animal in Egypt.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wuhi ba zahindi ni ni bɛ di lan lab Naa Hɛrɔd sani; ka bɛ daa taɣi so shɛli kuli bɛ ya.
en: Because they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country by another route.

dag: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maa binʒim mini biŋkpam mali sara maa ni ti su nudirigu gbali, ka di leeg o tarili.
en: The right thigh will belong to the son of Aaron who offers the blood and fat of the well-being offering.

dag: Ka o daa zom dabisi muna ata, ka bi di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: For three days, Saul could not see; he did not eat or drink.

dag: Bɛn tɛha bi zilima bɛn kul niŋdila binshɛɣukam yɛda, amaa yɛnnim bɛn kpahindila yɛla ni chani shɛm.
en: A fool will believe anything; smart people watch their step.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun do teeku sunsuuni, ka ŋmani ŋun do ŋariŋ puuni daantaliga zuɣu.
en: When you lie down, you will think you are on a rough sea and feel like you are at the top of the mast.

dag: Machɛle yi zaŋ kurigu she buɣim ni, o zaŋdila o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-kpuɣi zali ŋ-ŋme li hal ti mal li ka di niŋ o ni bɔri li shɛm. O yi tumda, kum mini kɔnyuri gbaar o, ka di wumd o pahi.
en: A blacksmith with his tools works it over coals, and shapes it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He even becomes hungry and weak. If he didnt drink water, hed pass out.

dag: Yuun tuhili yi ti gari, di ŋmanila sɔhila a sani, bee ŋ-ŋmani kaman yuŋ saha biɛla yuusim.
en: because in your perspective a thousand years are like yesterday past, like a short period during the night watch.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa zali ba dabisili ni bɛ ka o sanna. Ka dindali maa daa ti paai ka o ye o nam binyɛrigu ʒin o nam ʒiishee n-tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: Herod decided on a day to meet with them. On that day he was wearing a beautiful royal robe. He sat on his throne and made a speech to the people.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, o ni be? O ku be, o ni tum binshɛŋa din chihiri ŋɔ zaa zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani o ni kpi. Ka o kum maa taali ni ʒi omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: and takes interest and profit. Should he live? He should not. He engaged in all these detestable practices. He will surely die, and his blood will be on him.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka dabiɛm mali ba? Bɛ tirila gbini. Bɛ ŋme bɛ tɔbutuhiriba luhi, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui yomyom. Bɛ bi kaɣiri lihiri bɛ nyaaŋa, dabiɛm n-kul be luɣilikam! Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: What do I see? That army is afraid. The soldiers are running away. Their brave soldiers are defeated. They run away in a hurry. They dont look back. There is danger all around. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din be nuzaa polo la gbini. Paɣiba n-daa ʒi nimaani n-kumdi Tammuz kuli.
en: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.

dag: N nya ka Kushan suɣa be muɣisigu ni, ka nya ka Midian tiŋgbɔŋ suɣa pateesanim sɔhira.
en: I saw that the cities of Cushan were in trouble and that the houses of Midian trembled with fear.

dag: N ni daa nya li yuŋ maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɔhim n-daa kul ʒiɛri kpari luɣ shɛlikam teeku kom zuɣu.
en: of what I saw that night: Winds were blowing from all directions and lashing the surface of the ocean.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, A bia Yisifu kana; ka o daa kpaŋ omaŋ yiɣisi ʒin o bindoo zuɣu.
en: When Joseph arrived, someone told Jacob, Your son Joseph has come to see you. Jacob sat up in bed, but it took almost all his strength.

dag: Du bihi shɛŋa daa be di ni, ka du bil yini kam yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ata, ka di wɔɣilim gba nyɛ mita ata. Ka goma din daa be du bihi maa sunsuuni barilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili. Ka zɔŋ duno shɛli bɛ ni daa doli kpɛri puuni ha dunɔbia nyɛ mita ata.
en: The guardrooms were one ruler long and one ruler wide. The walls between the rooms were cubits thick. The opening by the porch at the end of the gateway that faced the Temple was also one ruler wide.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Naawuni daa pola pɔri zal li.
en: In addition, there is also God's vow. There was no such vow when the others were made priests.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Mɔabnim polo m-bala.
en: This is the word that the LORD had spoken concerning Moab long ago.

dag: Dabisi muni puuni, di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la; di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni luɣilikam zaa.
en: They surround me on every side. I feel like a drowning man.

dag: ka ninvuɣ galima bɛn ka buchi laɣimna ti pah o zuɣu, ka bɛ zaɣisi Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun daa na nyɛ bipolli ka o yɛm na bi ziligi ka o ku tooi nyaŋ ba la noli.
en: When some useless, worthless people joined his cause, they overpowered Rehoboam, Solomons son, who was too young and timid to resist them.

dag: Yi ni di bindira, amaa ka ku tiɣi, ka kum na kul ni mali ya. Yi ni ti zaŋ yi binyara sɔɣi, amaa ka di ku tiligi. Ka yi yi ti zali binshɛŋa, n ni chɛ ka tɔbu di li.
en: You will eat, but not be satisfied—in fact you will still be hungry. You will carry things off, but you will not be able to save them; anything you do save I will destroy in war.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bɔri naa, ka Naawuni daa pii Kish bia Sool leei bɛ naa, ka o daa di nam maa yuun pihinahi. Sool daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira.
en: but the people demanded a king. So for years God gave them King Saul, the son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim zani n-zab amaŋ zuɣu! Teemi jɛra ni maan a ansarisi dabisi muni zaa puuni shɛm la yɛla.
en: Rouse yourself, God, and defend your cause! Remember that godless people laugh at you all day long.

dag: ni Hazɔr ni Rama ni Giteem.
en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti nabi n-yɛligi pali tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di saha bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka. Di yɛla ti ku lan be bɛ tɛha ni bee ka bɛ ti teei di yɛla. Bɛ ti ku lan zaŋ di yɛla muɣisi bɛmaŋa bee nti lan mali shɛli yaha.
en: You will increase in numbers, and there will be no need to remember the sacred chest or to make a new one.

dag: O bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Shiira. Ŋuna n-daa me Bɛtihɔrɔn tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa polo ni Uzɛnishiira la.
en: Ephraim had a daughter named Sheerah. She built the towns of Upper and Lower Beth Horon, and Uzzen Sheerah.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ bimbira pam chaŋ yi puri ni, amaa ka ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, dama toli ni ti ŋub di zaa.
en: You will plant plenty of seed, but reap only a small harvest, because the locusts will eat your crops.

dag: A daanab shɛb bɛn daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛri ni Babilɔn naa ku kana ti tuh a bee n-tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim la lee be ya?.
en: Where are your prophets now who prophesied that the king of Babylon wouldnt attack you and this land?.

dag: Bɛ sɔŋmi bɛ mabihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni ka bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma, amaa ka lee di lan zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo di tuun shɛli. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ Lɛvinim maa n-wuhi ba bɛ tuma.
en: Each may assist his fellow Levites in the meeting tent with some responsibilities, but he may not perform service. This is how you should assign responsibilities to the Levites.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi bi tum daɣiri tuma, ka nyɛla ŋun ka taali, dindina di ku niŋ o shɛli, o ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: But if the woman hasnt defiled herself and she is pure, then she will be immune and able to conceive.

dag: Aduna daŋ niriba, di ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tarili n-daŋ tooni la zuɣu. Aduna daa nyɛla Kɔhat daŋ nira, ka Kɔhat mi nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nira.
en: to the descendants of Aaron who were of the clan of Kohath, which was descended from Levi. Their assignment was the first to be made.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba leei zuliya yini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Izraɛl zoli zuɣu, ka na yino ti nyɛ bɛ zaa naa. Bɛ ti ku lan nyɛ zuliya diba ayi, bɛ mi ti ku lan pirigi n-nyɛ nam buyi.
en: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.

dag: Nyama, n nini nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka n tiba wum, ka m baŋ di gbinni.
en: I have seen all this before. I have already heard everything you say. I understand all these things.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o chɛ ka buɣim di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka daadamnim be kaman kpam la ka buɣim di ba, ka so bi lan zɔr o kpee nambɔɣu.
en: The land was scorched by the rage of the LORD of heavenly forces; the people were like fuel for the fire. Not one person pitied another.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili din be kasi, dama dindali maa ka Naawuni daa vuh o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa binshɛɣukam nambu ni maa jɛlinsi.
en: God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it God rested from all the work of creation.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa daa yuri Dauda, dama ŋuna n-daa yi zaŋdi ba chani tɔb ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina.
en: Everyone in Israel and Judah loved David because he led them out in war and back again.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini niriba laɣiŋgu shee. Di saha ka Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mir o la kana ni o ti gari nimaani, ka Bɔaz bol o, Zɔri, kamina kpe ti ʒini. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini.
en: Boaz went to the meeting place at the town gate and sat down there. Then Elimelech's nearest relative, the man whom Boaz had mentioned, came by, and Boaz called to him, Come over here, my friend, and sit down. So he went over and sat down.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu mini Rɛkab bia Jɛhɔnadab daa kpe Baal duu maa ni, ka o yɛli Baal jɛmdiba maa, Di chɛliya ka Yawɛ jɛmda be yi ni, amaa chɛliya ka di kul nyɛla yinim bɛn nyɛ Baal jɛmdiba maa kɔŋko.
en: After that, Jehu himself went into the temple with Jonadab son of Rechab and said to the people there, Make sure that only worshipers of Baal are present and that no worshiper of the Lord has come in.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi Jɛsi, A bidibisi maa zaa m-be kpe ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Di kpalimla biasani, amaa ŋun gulila piɛri. Ka Samuɛl yɛli Jɛsi, Timmi ti zaŋ o na, dama ti ku ʒini ka pa ni o paala kpe na.
en: Then Samuel asked Jesse, Is that all of your boys? There is still the youngest one, Jesse answered, but hes out keeping the sheep. Send for him, Samuel told Jesse, because we cant proceed until he gets here.

dag: Di saɣi ka so ʒiɛm a a bipalitali zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa min a ni niŋdi shɛm ni a yurilim ni a yɛda niŋbu ni a biɛr kasi wuhi ni a biɛhigu nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba ni ni dol shɛli naba.
en: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.

dag: Dama a piɛma nyɔɣ ma n-kpe nti lim, ka a zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma.
en: You have wounded me with your arrows; you have struck me down.

dag: ka gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛri suŋ, ka nyɛ bɛn gbib bɛ yinsi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi nirilim, ka nyɛ bɛn wumdi n-tiri bɛ yidaannima, ka di chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yɛligu.
en: and to be sensible, morally pure, working at home, kind and submissive to their own husbands, so that Gods word wont be ridiculed.

dag: O daa bela tiŋ maa gomna ŋun yuli daa booni Sɛrigius Poolus ŋun mali yɛm pam la yiŋa. Ka gomna maa daa boli Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti tɔɣis o Naawuni yɛligu.
en: He was a friend of the governor of the island, Sergius Paulus, who was an intelligent man. The governor called Barnabas and Saul before him because he wanted to hear the word of God.

dag: dama a yurila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a, ka je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a. Zuŋɔ a kahigi wuhi ni sapashin kpamba mini tɔbbihi pa shɛli a sani. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ m baŋya ni Absalom yi di ne ka tinim zaa kpi, a naam paɣ lala.
en: You're more loyal to your enemies than to your friends. What you've done today has shown your officers and soldiers that they don't mean a thing to you. You would be happy if Absalom was still alive, even if the rest of us were dead.

dag: N ni zaŋ o wain tihi puu la labisi ti o, ka chɛ ka Akɔr Vinvamli leei tahima dunoli. Nimaani o ni ti saɣi ti ma kaman o paɣisarilim saha la ni kaman o ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la.
en: I will give back to her the vineyards she had and make Trouble Valley a door of hope. She will respond to me there as she did when she was young, when she came from Egypt.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: Nations will give you what you need, like a child drinking milk from its mother. But you will drink riches from kings. Then you will know that it is I, the Lord , who saves you. You will know that I, the Great God of Jacob, protect you.

dag: Ka hal n yi nyu bara gba, m bi tum jɛrilim, dama n ni tɔɣisila yɛlimaŋli di puuni. Amaa n zaɣisila lala niŋbu ni di chɛ ka so ku duhi ma n-gar o ni nya ma ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu bee o ni wum ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu.
en: But if I wanted to say more about myself, I would not be a fool, because I would be telling the truth. But I wont say any more, because I dont want people to think more of me than what they see me do or hear me say.

dag: Din bi tuhi tumbu zaa nyɛla alahichi, amaa alahichi shɛŋa tumbu beni m-pala din tahiri nir kum ni.
en: Every unrighteous action is sin, but there is a sin that does not result in death.

dag: Ka dilan maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti zuɣulana ni ti sariakarita? A lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la? Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Musa, ka o tɛhi ni o ni sa niŋ shɛli maa yi palo.
en: The man answered, Did anyone say you could be our ruler and judge? Tell me, will you kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday ? Then Moses was afraid. He thought to himself, Now everyone knows what I did.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kumiya doo maa. Zaŋmiy o yi tiŋ tariga, ka niriba maa zaa ti pihi kuɣa lab o.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses: The man should be put to death. The entire community should stone him outside the camp.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛla.
en: When Arphaxad was years old, his son Shelah was born.

dag: Di wɔɣilim din ti yɛn kpalim dolisi luɣ kasi shee la ni ti nyɛla kilomita anu wulimpuhili polo, ka nyɛ kilomita anu wulinluhili polo. Di ni ti do m-baɣila luɣ kasi shee. Di ni atam ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bindirigu.
en: The land that is left after the city has been built in the area immediately to the south of the holy area— miles by miles on the east and miles by miles on the west—is to be used as farmland by the people who live in the city.

dag: Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi. Ka o daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-daa ku bɛ zaa, ka gba daa zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of The Famous Thirty. He fought with his spear against three hundred men and killed them, and became famous among The Thirty.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ mi ni daa nyu tibidarigibo binnyur shɛli zoli din be kasi zuɣu shɛm la, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya la zaa gba ni nyu li. Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti chani jeena, ka leei bɛn be kaman bɛn kani.
en: My people have drunk a bitter cup of punishment on my sacred hill. But all the surrounding nations will drink a still more bitter cup of punishment; they will drink it all and vanish away.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun paani o daalikauli bɛn ne mini kpiimba sani ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Bɔaz ni! Hal doo maa nyɛla ti dɔɣira ni Yɛlimaŋli.
en: May the Lord bless Boaz! Naomi exclaimed. The Lord always keeps his promises to the living and the dead. And she went on, That man is a close relative of ours, one of those responsible for taking care of us.

dag: ni nanim shɛb bɛn daa be nuzaa polo zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la ni Araba din daa be Kinɛrɔt nudirigu polo la ni tintan ni tinsi la nima ni Nafɔtido din daa be wulinluhili polo la nima.
en: He sent word to the kings from the north part of the highlands, in the desert plain south of Chinneroth, in the lowlands, and in Naphoth-dor on the west.

dag: Ka o paɣ tab bɛn mali yɛm daa garig o yɛli, Aai. Ka o garigi yɛl omaŋa.
en: Her wisest attendants answer; indeed, she replies to herself.

dag: di saha ka a chɛ ka zahima varisiri ma, ka chɛ ka ʒiinim nyabu kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm;.
en: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *.

dag: Ka yiliŋ kam ti ŋari, ka zoya mini daboya zaa ti nahi taba, ka luɣ shɛlikam din golim ti tuhi, ka soli kam din be gbirimagbirima ti niŋ polipoli.
en: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be leveled. The crooked will be made straight and the rough places made smooth.

dag: Amaa di wuhiri yi gba yɛla: Di simdi ni yidan kam yur o paɣa kaman omaŋmaŋ la; ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣ kam gba lur o yidan sizuura.
en: But it also applies to you: every husband must love his wife as himself, and every wife must respect her husband.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa daa niŋ ba mi n-leei yɛliŋmahima, ka di sabi zali tinim bɛn be ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ni wuhibu zuɣu.
en: The things that happened to those people are examples. They were written to be warnings for us. We live in the time that all those past histories were pointing to.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri wuna ni birim. Di ni gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ di vi.
en: They will all be shamed and disgraced; the makers of idols will end up disgraced together.

dag: hal a ni kul mi ni n ka taali, ka so kani ŋun ni tooi fa ma a nuu ni bahi maa zaa yoli?.
en: You know I am innocent, but no one can save me from your power!.

dag: N zaŋ ya tahi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bindira pam ni ni yi ti di di tiwala mini di bin viɛla. Amaa ka yi ni kpe di ni yi saɣimla n tiŋgbani maa, ka zaŋ m pini maa leei zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I brought you into a land of plenty, to enjoy its gifts and goodness, but you ruined my land; you disgraced my heritage.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus replied, Foxes have dens, and birds have nests. But the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.

dag: Ka Shamshɛrai mini Shɛharia ni Atalia.
en: Jerohams sons were Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, ŋunkam daa kpe yili maa ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kpar li zali la nyɛla ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who enters the house during the entire period when it is quarantined will be unclean until evening.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka yi nyiŋgoya kpɛm gari kurigu, ka yi gbɛri mi be kaman daanya la.
en: I did that because I knew you were stubborn. You were like iron that will not bend, with heads as hard as bronze.

dag: ka bɛ ba Ifriim daa kum bɛ zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ, ka o dɔɣiriba daa kana ti maag o suhu la.
en: Their father Ephraim mourned for them for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.

dag: ka chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, dama ti gba chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali. Ka di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni. .
en: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who has wronged us. And dont lead us into temptation.

dag: Ishimail daa lan ku Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Gɛdalia sani mini Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Ishmael also murdered all the Judeans who had rallied around Gedaliah at Mizpah as well as the Babylonian soldiers who were posted there.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan yih a wahala ni n-zaŋ a tahi palo ni be luɣ shɛli ka muɣisigu kani, ka nim kpaba daa pali a ŋman ni.
en: In fact, God wants to help you out of your troubles. He wants to take away your burdens that are crushing you. He wants to load your table with plenty of food.

dag: Bɔ ka Yɛhudianim lee zaŋ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim? Bee gunibu buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: So, do Jews have anything that others dont have? Do they get any benefit from being circumcised?.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhir a, teemi n yɛla, ka lan ti ma kpiɔŋ yim kɔŋko pahi, yaa n Duuma Naawuni, ka m bɔhi Filistianim ŋɔ biɛri labisi n nina ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then Samson said a prayer to the Lord , Lord GOD, remember me. God, please give me strength one more time. Let me do this one thing to punish these Philistines for tearing out both of my eyes.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi wɔribariba noli, ka bɛ ba nayili yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zaŋ gbana maa tahi yomyom. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm moli Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa puuni.
en: At the king's command the riders mounted royal horses and rode off at top speed. The decree was also made public in Susa, the capital city.

dag: Ka Tama daa chaŋ o tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa ka o ti domi. Ka o daa niŋ zim ŋɔri mahibiɛli m-mali maha o nini maa ni.
en: When she got there, he was lying in bed. She mixed the dough, made the loaves, and baked them while he watched.

dag: Amaa ka tɔbbihi maa ni yino daa zaŋ kpani kuhi Yisa luɣili, ka ʒim mini kom dii zɔri yirina.
en: One of the soldiers, however, plunged his spear into Jesus' side, and at once blood and water poured out. .

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli naa, Di yi niŋ nyin naa nyaɣisim, nyin tim ma gbana ka n ti ti gomnanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti ma soli ka n gari hal ti paai Juda.
en: Then I asked him to grant me the favor of giving me letters to the governors of West-of-Euphrates Province, instructing them to let me travel to Judah.

dag: Musa ni daa ti kul kana ti miri suɣa maa gbini n-nya naɣibila maa, ka nya bɛ ni wari waa maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaŋ bimparilana din daa be o nuu ni maa bahi zoli maa gbini ka di ŋma.
en: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.

dag: Ka yi tɛhiya ni tibidarigibo bɔ n-lee simdi ninvuɣ so ŋun no n-taai Naawuni Bia, ka lihi ʒiɛm alikauli ʒi shɛli din daa mal o ka o be kasi, ka niŋdi din dihiri Naawuni daalibarika Shia la vi la?.
en: So think how much more punishment people deserve who show their hate for the Son of God—people who show they have no respect for the blood sacrifice that began the new agreement and once made them holy or who insult the Spirit of Gods grace.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, Wuhim ti a yuli, ka a yɛligu maa ti niŋ pali ka ti ti a jilima.
en: Then Manoah asked the angel of the Lord , What is your name? We want to know so that we can honor you when what you have said really happens.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna, ka Balaam daa yɛl o, M me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaa zuɣu.
en: When God appeared to him, Balaam said, I have built seven altars and have sacrificed a bull and a ram on each one.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi.
en: So Jesus said to the sons, You dont understand what you are asking. Can you drink from the cup that I must drink from? The sons answered, Yes, we can.

dag: Di saha man gba ni saɣi ni amaŋmaŋ nudirigu ni tooi ti a nasara.
en: If you can do any of these things, then even I will praise you. And I will admit that you can save yourself by your own power.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni kuli nti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhi din mali nyina mini kuriti kuya ni kuriti lɛri tumd o tuma. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ Ammɔnnim maa tinsi zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda min o niriba maa zaa daa lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns. David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ daa kpahi ŋmɛnditoya ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu; yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo.
en: They crucified with him two outlaws, one on his right side and one on his left.

dag: ka daadamnim ni ti tarigi binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋdi dunia ni maa dabiɛm zuɣu, dama yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam.
en: People will faint from fear as they wait for what is coming over the whole earth, for the powers in space will be driven from their courses.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saha shɛli maa ka Rubin daa zaŋ ŋun o ba dabipaɣa Biliha dɔni, ka ŋun Izraɛl wum li. Yaakubu bidibisi daa nyɛla pinaayi.
en: While Jacob was living in that land, Reuben had sexual intercourse with Bilhah, one of his father's concubines; Jacob heard about it and was furious. Jacob had twelve sons.

dag: Ka Atalia daa wum bɛ ni zɔri gindi ka paɣiri naa maa, ka o daa kpe Yawɛ duu maa ni niriba maa sani.
en: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, O biɛhigu lee nyɛla wula? Ka o yɛl o, Do kurili n-zaŋ kparibu pɔb omaŋa n-yirina. Di saha ka Sool daa baŋ ni Samuɛl m-bala, ka damdi zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: Saul asked, What does he look like? The woman answered, He looks like an old man wearing a special robe. Then Saul knew it was Samuel, and he bowed down. His face touched the ground.

dag: Ka Sool daa baŋ Dauda kukoli maa ka bɔh o, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Dauda garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n kukoli m-bala.
en: Saul could tell it was David's voice, and he called out, David, my son! Is that you? Yes it is, Your Majesty.

dag: Zɔn tital la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili di kazala la zaa mɛbu ni, bɛ daa yi zaŋla kuɣikpɛra m-me kulis ata, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: There were walls around the palace yard and around the yard and porch of the Lord s Temple. The walls were built with three rows of stone and one row of cedar timbers.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni zaŋ yi binyoya mini yi ni tum tuumbiɛri din chihiri shɛŋa zaa n-ta n-jɛmbu duu daɣiri la zuɣu, n ni kun ya, n ku yuli yaɣi so zuɣu, m mi ku zo so nambɔɣu.
en: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.

dag: M bihi, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Ka yi ni daa pun wum ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Masiachihira ni ti kana la, hal Masiachihiriba pam pun kana gba, dinzuɣu ti baŋya ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa n-shiri bɔŋɔ.
en: My children, the end is near! You were told that the Enemy of Christ would come; and now many enemies of Christ have already appeared, and so we know that the end is near.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Libini ni Shimɛi ni Yuza.
en: Meraris family: Mahli, his son Libni, his son Shimei, his son Uzzah.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dooshee din nyɛ gbuɣim polli dibu shee, ka nyɛ gbuɣindaa ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka gbuɣimbihi be ni, ka so ku tooi dam ba la lee be ya?.
en: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ Reechɛl niŋ o paɣa, ka yur o gari Liya; ka daa lan tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti Leeban.
en: Jacob slept with Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah. He worked for Laban seven more years.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan ku Ijipti do so ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣirili, ka o wɔɣilim daa gari mita ayi la. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni ka di barilim daa ŋmani kpalua dapua. Amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa o kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.

dag: Jintɔriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka suli ku ba pam, ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku Yisa tuumba maa.
en: When the council members heard this, they became furious and wanted to kill the apostles.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun niŋdi nirilim nyari jilima, amaa do so ŋun vari gindi ni leei bundana.
en: A kind and gentle woman gains respect, but violent men gain only wealth.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni yi gba mali suhupiɛlli, ka di chɛ ka n gba pahi yi zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: You also should be glad and share your joy with me.

dag: Ka paɣa maa daa lan yɛli, N dan naa, n suhir a, chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: The woman said, My lord and king, please let me say something else to you. The king said, Speak.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka nanim diri nam. Mani n-sɔŋdi zuɣulaannim ka bɛ zaani zaligu shɛŋa din doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: I help kings to govern and rulers to make good laws.

dag: Yawɛ, yihim ma ʒirinim mini bɛn yɔhindi niriba nuu ni.
en: Come and save me, Lord , from deceitful liars.

dag: amaa ka Maikil min o malaikanim maa daa nyaŋ waɣ biɛ titali maa min o malaikanima, ka bɛ lan ka biɛhigu shee alizanda ni.
en: but they were not strong enough. The dragon and its angels lost their place in heaven.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa labina, di saha maa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jabɛshigiliad paɣ shɛb bɛ ni daa bi kula ti ba. Amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi saɣi ba.
en: So the men of Benjamin came back to Israel. The Israelites gave them the women from Jabesh Gilead who they had not killed. But there were not enough women for all the men of Benjamin.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ nanim maa zaa, ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔna maa yim, dama ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa tuhi ti bɛn Izraɛlnim maa.
en: The Lord fought on Israel's side, so Joshua and the Israelite army were able to capture these kings and take their land. They fought one battle after another, then they went back to their camp at Gilgal after capturing all that land.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa puuni ka din viɛl yirina ka bɛ dira, amaa bibiɛhi suhuri yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: Good people will be rewarded for what they say, but those who are deceitful are hungry for violence.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka niriba ŋmaligi paɣiri ba, ka bi nya bɛ taali.
en: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.

dag: Bee n yi chɛ ka alɔbo lu di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka n suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni n ku ba, ka n kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: If I send an epidemic on that country and in my anger take many lives, killing people and animals.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vooi li kpɛhi di puuni; ka bo mihi lo ŋarin titali maa gba kiŋkiŋ. Bɛ ni daa zɔri ni bɛ ti chaŋ ti firi Libia kulinol bihigu ni zuɣu ka bɛ daa sirigi tanti din sɔŋdi ŋariŋ maa ka di chanila lo tiŋli, ka pɔhim daa ʒiɛri ti chana.
en: After the men brought the lifeboat in, they tied ropes around the ship to hold it together. The men were afraid that the ship would hit the sandbanks of Syrtis. So they lowered the sail and let the wind carry the ship.

dag: Sahimiya piɛma pali lɔɣiri. Yawɛ piɛlila Miidia nanim bahina, dama o nia nyɛla o wurim Babilɔn. Dama Yawɛ n-yɛn bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu la zuɣu.
en: Sharpen your arrows; prepare your shields. The LORD is stirring up the spirit of kings from Media. He intends to destroy Babylon; this is the LORDs retribution, a day of reckoning for his temple.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Hɔr Zoli din daa be Ɛdom tintariga maa gbini.
en: Mount Hor was near the border of Edom. The Lord said to Moses and Aaron.
